title: crab spinach casserole
steps:
1. Spread spinach in bottom of a well buttered square 8" baking dish
2. Combine mayonnaise , flour , salt , pepper , garlic , paprika , rosemary and thyme in a medium saucepan
3. Add onion and mushrooms , and cook over medium heat until bubbly , stirring frequently
4. Gradually add milk , and cook over medium heat until thickened , stirring constantly
5. Stir in eggs
6. Pour into baking dish
7. Top with crab and cheese
8. Bake at 350 degrees f for 30 minutes or until bubbly and cheese is melted

title: curried beef
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large saucepan , over medium heat
2. Add onions , garlic , scotch bonnet pepper and curry powder
3. Stir until onions begin to soften
4. Add beef , and stir until meat is browned and well coated with the spice mixture
5. Add broth , thyme , salt and pepper
6. Bring to a boil
7. Reduce heat , then simmer , covered , for 1 to 1-1 / 2 hours , or until the meat is tender
8. Meat should be almost covered with liquid at all times
9. Add more broth if necessary
10. If you like a thicker gravy , mix together the cold water and flour
11. Bring the curry to a boil , and stir whilst adding the water / flour mix
12. Simmer until thickened

title: delicious steamed whole artichokes
steps:
1. Put the parsley , garlic , bay leaves , lemons , wine , oil and water in a large pot and bring to a simmer
2. Season the liquid with salt and pepper
3. In the meantime prepare the artichokes:
4. Wash artichokes under cold water
5. Using a heavy stainless steel knife , cut off the stems close to the base
6. Pull off the lower petals that are small and tough
7. Cut off the top inch of the artichoke and rub with half a lemon to preserve the green color
8. Or you may put the artichokes in water that has some lemon juice in it
9. If you wish , trim the thorny
10. Place the artichokes in the steaming broth , bottom up
11. Cover and simmer for about 30 minutes
12. The artichokes are done when a knife is inserted into the base and there is no resistance
13. To eat , pull off a leaf and scrape the meat off the tender end with your front teeth
14. Dip the ends of the leaves in lemon juice and melted butter if desired
15. When you reach the center cone of purple prickly leaves , remove it
16. This is the choke that protects the heart
17. Now , scrape away the thistle fuzz covering the artichoke heart
18. The heart is the meatiest and in my opinion , the best part of the artichoke
19. Steamed artichokes may be served hot or cold
20. Enjoy !
21. You may dip the artichoke in mayonnaise that has lemon added to it , or butter and lemon juice
22. Yum !

title: pork tenderloin with hot mustard sauce
steps:
1. Combine first 9 ingredients
2. Rub mixture all over pork
3. Remember to let meat come to room temperature before roasting
4. Place pork in a casserole sprayed with nonstick cooking spray or use a roasting pan
5. Sprinkle sesame seeds all over pork
6. Bake pork at 400 degrees for 45 minutes or until internal temperature reaches 160 degrees
7. Remove pork from oven and let rest for 5 minutes
8. For the sauce: combine horseradish , mustard and honey in a bowl
9. Microwave 1-2 minutes , just until sauce is heated through
10. If sauce is too strong or spicy , you can tame it down by adding more honey and a tablespoon of water
11. Slice pork and serve with hot mustard sauce

title: mixed barbecue sauce
steps:

6. Use a decorator bag and
7. Use writing

title: creamy cheesy scrambled eggs   christmas morning eggstravaganza
steps:
1. Preheat frying pan over medium heat
2. Whilst that's heating , process eggs , milk , cheese and s & p in blender until frothy
3. Turn heat in pan down to medium-low , drop butter into pan , smear it around
4. Immediately add blender ingredients and cook without stirring until eggs set on bottom
5. Draw a spatula across the bottom to form large curds
6. Continue cooking , eggs should be thickened but still moist for best texture and edibilty
7. Do not stir constantly !
8. Remove from heat
9. Sprinkle with chives , serve warm

title: pilgrim s sandwich spread
steps:
1. Chop chicken in food processor
2. Grate carrots , celery and cheese
3. Chop onion and egg
4. Combine all ingredients with enough mayonnaise to bind , mixing well
5. Refrigerate for about four hours , then mix well again
6. Serve as sandwiches or on crackers

title: creme de menthe gelato
steps:
1. Set aside a large bowl of ice water
2. In a saucepan , bring milk and half of sugar to a simmer , stirring until sugar is dissolved
3. Add crme de menthe
4. In another bowl , mix or whisk yolks and remaining sugar until thick and pale
5. To this add hot milk slowly , whisking , and pour mixture back into saucepan when finished
6. Cook over moderately low heat , stirring constantly , for approx 20 minutes
7. Do not allow mixture to boil !
8. Pour custard through a fine sieve into a freezer container , stir in cream and set in the bowl of ice water to cool
9. Chill in refrigerator until cold
10. Press plastic wrap to the surface of the mixture and cover container with a lid
11. Put in the freezer until frozen ,
12. Remove from freezer and whisk with a hand blender to break up any ice crystals
13. Return to freezer
14. Repeat process one to three more times until it reaches desired smoothness
15. Garnish with mint leaves or shaved chocolate

title: lamb patties with yoghurt and cucumber dressing
steps:
1. For the lamb patties put the bulgur wheat in a bowl and cover with hot water
2. Set aside and allow to swell
3. Mix the lamb mince and crushed garlic
4. Season with salt and pepper to taste
5. Add the chopped mint , coriander and the harrisa paste
6. Squeeze the water from the wheat and add to the meat , mix well
7. Form the mix into little patties , roughly the size of a flat golf ball
8. Cover with clingfilm and chill for a minimum of 1 hour
9. Heat oil in a non-stick frying pan and fry until cooked through and golden , 5-10 minutes
10. For the dressing put the grated cucumber in a colander and sprinkle with salt , leave for 30 minutes
11. Squeeze the cucumber dry and mix with yoghurt and mint
12. Season with black pepper to taste

title: hamburger salad
steps:

title: szechuan noodles with minced beef
steps:
1. Dissolve corn flour in water to get corn flour solution
2. Heat oil in a pan , lightly fry the garlic , onion and chili paste until fragrant
3. Add the beef and fry for 5 minutes
4. Add the wine , hoisin sauce , salt and pepper and cook for another 2 minutes
5. Add the stock , bring to boil and thicken with corn flour solution
6. Pour the sauce over the cooked noodles
7. Garnish with sliced spring onion , coriander leaves and chili padi
8. Ready to serve

title: barbecue cola chicken
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , mix barbecue sauce , minced onion and cola beverage
2. Divide barbecue sauce mixture evenly into 2 resealable food storage plastic bags
3. Add 6 chicken breasts to each bag
4. Seal bags and turn to coat
5. Refrigerate at least 6 hours or overnight to marinate , turning bags once or twice
6. When ready to cook chicken , heat gas or charcoal grill
7. When grill is heated , carefully oil grill rack
8. Remove chicken from marinade
9. Reserve marinade
10. Place chicken on gas grill over medium heat or on charcoal grill over medium coals
11. Cover grill
12. Cook 12 to 15 minutes , turning occasionally , until juice is no longer pink when centers of thickest pieces are cut and thermometer inserted in centers read 170
13. In a 1 quart saucepan , heat remaining marinade to boiling
14. Boil 3-4 minutes
15. Serve chicken with sauce

title: cream of onion soup
steps:
1. Melt butter in heavy large pot over medium heat
2. Add 9onions and saute until very tender and pale golden , about 25 minutes
3. Add garlic , and stir 1 minute
4. Add broth and potato and bring to boil
5. Reduce heat
6. Cover and simmer until potato is very tender , about 25 minutes
7. Cool slightly
8. Working in batches , puree soup in blender
9. Return to pot
10. Stir in cream , sherry and thyme
11. Simmer about 10 minutes
12. Season with salt and pepper
13. Sprinkle with chives

title: haricots verts with browned garlic
steps:

3. Cook 2-3 minutes or until crisp-tender
4. Drain
5. Melt butter in a pan over medium heat
6. Add in garlic and shallots
7. Cook 4 minutes or until lightly browned , stirring occasionally
8. Add teaspoon salt , beans , rosemary , and pepper
9. Cook 4 minutes or until thoroughly heated , stirring occasionally

title: chili lovers chili 1
steps:

4. Bring just to a boil then reduce heat

6. Simmer for about 2 to 3 hours
7. Add beans during the last half hour

title: s mores drip cake
steps:
1. Make 3 layers of chocolate cake following package instructions for 8-inch cake pans
2. To make buttercream:
3. In a medium bowl , hand blend butter and shortening until creamy and well-mixed
4. Add marshmallow cream and vanilla extract
5. Blend until combined
6. Add powdered sugar in batches to avoid a mess , blend after each addition
7. Add milk and mix until incorporated
8. Remove 1 1 / 2 cup of buttercream and place in a new , small bowl
9. Add cocoa powder and mix until combined
10. To the other half of buttercream , add graham cracker crumbs and mix
11. Set both the chocolate and graham cracker butter cream aside
12. To make meringue:
13. In a stand mixer , combine egg whites and sugar
14. Mix until stiff , glossy peaks form
15. To make ganache:
16. Using a double boiler , add the mini chocolate chips and the cream to a heat proof bowl sitting above hot water
17. Mix until melted and remove from heat
18. Fill piping bag or clean squeezer bottle with the ganache once its cooled a bit
19. Assembly:
20. Cut tops of chocolate cakes so they are all flat and even
21. Place your first layer on a cake board and secure with a small dab of graham buttercream
22. Spread a layer of butter cream on top
23. Stack another chocolate cake layer on top and spread another layer of graham buttercream on top
24. Layer your third and final cake round on top of the other two , and spread graham buttercream on top and around the sides of the cake
25. After the cake is covered , use an icing smoother to perfect the top and edges
26. Pipe 3 stripes of chocolate butter cream around the cake's sides and flatten using an icing smoother
27. Gently press graham cracker crumbs around the base of the cake
28. Pipe ganache around the top edge of the cake so that vertical lines cascade along the sides of the cake
29. Pour and spread the remaining ganache on top of the cake and spread evening using an offset spatula
30. Let set at bit before the next step
31. Spread the meringue topping on the top of the cake , making dramatic waves and peaks , then , using a kitchen torch , lightly roast the marshmallow topping a la s'mores
32. Serve immediately

title: bahama breeze tostones con pollo
steps:
1. Heat vegetable oil in fryer or deep skillet over medium high heat until sizzling when a small drop of water is added
2. Fry frozen tostones in batches of 5 or 6 until crispy and golden
3. Sprinkle with salt and set aside
4. In separate skillet heat butter over medium heat
5. Add chicken , cumin and taco seasoning , stirring occasionally until nearly cooked through
6. Add in bell peppers , onions and mushrooms
7. Cover and cook until soft
8. Stir in cheese until melted
9. To serve , top 6-7 tostones with chicken mixture
10. Top with a few spoonfulls of fresh salsa and sour cream if desired

title: banana walnut pancake  paleo compliant
steps:
1. In a large bowl , mash bananas , add eggs , flour , baking powder , baking soda , vanilla , and cinnamon
2. Mix thoroughly
3. Let sit for 20 minute add coconut milk to thin out if too thick to pour
4. Grease cast-iron skillet or griddle with butter or coconut oil
5. Pour 1 / 4 cup per pancake
6. Sprinkle with walnuts
7. Turn , once set and beginning to brown
8. Brown on other side
9. Remove and keep warm
10. Don't use as high a heat as you would regular pancakes
11. The banana pancakes need time to set and you don't want them to burn
12. If they break when turning , just form back together--it's all good
13. Another method that works well is to use a small , non-stick fry-pan with a lid
14. The lid helps to get the pancake to set quicker
15. Serve with raw honey or other paleo--approved toppings
16. I like to puree strawberries with a tablespoon of honey

title: hot mulled cider   german glhmost
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan , combine wine , apple cider , cinnamon , cloves , and cardamom
2. Bring to a simmer over medium-low heat
3. Add honey , to taste , and garnish with a lemon slice
4. Serve hot

title: leah s easy food processor salsa
steps:
1. Put garlic cloves and jalapeo pieces in food processor , pulse a few time until coarsely chopped
2. Place roma tomatoes in a microwaveable dish and microwave for 1 minute or so on high , then remove skins
3. Add diced tomatoes , lime juice , pepper , salt , and red pepper flakes to food processor , pulse 3 or 4 times until everything looks well mixed
4. Add onion , roma tomatoes , and cilantro , and pulse just a few times until onion is at desire consistency
5. Adding onions at the end is very important , otherwise they will become pureed and make a gross texture for the salsa
6. If you want to remove the remaining metallic taste of the fresh tomato , cook over medium low heat in a non-reactive pot for about 15-20 minutes
7. For best flavor , refrigerate over night to let flavors mingle

title: laugenbrotchen  pretzel rolls
steps:
1. Mix the first 6 ingredients together and knead to a soft dough , about 10 minutes
2. Then let it rest in an oiled bowl , covered , until the dough has doubled in size
3. Form into 14 bread rolls / pretzels / croissants
4. Place on baking paper well spaced , and allow to rise again
5. Mix the water , salt and bicarb in a stainless steel pan and bring to the boil
6. Take it off the heat
7. Take the risen bread rolls , and using a slotted spoon , dip them one by one in the bicarb water , drain well and set back on the paper
8. Cut slits in the bread rolls with a sharp knife and sprinkle with extra coarse salt
9. Bake for 20-25 minutes in the middle of a preheated 200 degree celcius oven

title: twice baked ranch potatoes
steps:
1. Bake potatoes in 400f oven until tender
2. Cook bacon until crisp
3. Pat dry and crumble
4. Drain almost all fat from bacon pan and cook onion until soft
5. Cut baked potatoes in half
6. Scoop out potatoes leaving 1 / 4" shell
7. Mash potatoes until smooth and mix in dressing , cheese , bacon and onion
8. Spoon mixture back into skins
9. Bake at 350f until heated through
10. Broil for 2-3 minutes to brown lightly

title: mini chicken caesar salad cups
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400f
2. In small bowl , mix chicken and dressing
3. Separate dough into 10 biscuits
4. Divide each into 2 rounds
5. Press dough rounds in bottom and up sides of 20 ungreased mini muffin cups , extending dough 1 / 4 inch above edge of cups
6. Fill each cup with about 2 teaspoons of the chicken mixture
7. Bake 8-11 minutes or until crust is deep golden brown
8. Remove from muffin pan
9. Top each with lettuce and cheese
10. Serve warm

title: roasted green lentils with tomatoes
steps:
1. Place the dal in a large saucepan and stir over medium heat until dry
2. Add the oil , chiles de arbol , garam masala , feugreek & asafoetida and cook stirring until the dal is golden , about 3 minutes reduce heat if too much smoke arises
3. Add ginger , garlic , serrano peppe , coriander & paprika and stir for another 5 minutes
4. Add water and salt and bring to a boil over high heat
5. Recuce heat to low , cover pan , and cook stirring occasionally , until the dal is soft & creamy , about 1 hr , adding more water if it dies too quickly
6. Mix in the tomatoes and cook until they are quite soft , about 5 minutes transfer to a serving dish , mix in the cilantro and serve

title: turkish coffee mocha
steps:
1. Mix the coffee and cardamom in a coffee filter and brew the coffee in your coffeemaker with the water
2. Heat the almond milk , sugar and chocolate syrup in a saucepan on medium heat
3. Pour the brewed coffee into the pan , stir , and then pour into four cups
4. Serve and enjoy !

title: updated waldorf classic
steps:
1. Mix mayonnaise , lemon peel and fresh lemon juice in medium bowl to blend
2. Season with salt and pepper to taste
3. Refrigerate
4. Toss apples , celery , radishes , cranberries and red onions in large bowl
5. Add lemon mayonnaise and toss to coat
6. Can be prepared 1 day in advance
7. Cover and refrigerate
8. Right before serving , fold in the cashews

title: coconut chicken and pineapple skewers
steps:
1. Soak bamboo skewers in water for at least 30 minutes
2. Cut chicken into 3 / 4-inch cubes and place in a bowl
3. Place garlic , shallot , ginger , cilantro , salt , cumin , peanut oil , lime juice and coconut milk in processor or blender
4. Puree until smooth liquid forms
5. Pour marinade over chicken and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 3 hours , turning occasionally
6. Preheat grill to medium
7. Add marinated chicken cube then pineapple cube then another marinated chicken cube to each bamboo skewer
8. Grill until chicken is slightly golden all over , turning as needed

title: banana rice pudding   nuwave flavorwave ovens
steps:
1. Cook up rice using regular directions and then set aside
2. Mix rice , sweetened condensed milk , vanilla , cinnamon , brown sugar , nutmeg and banana
3. Mix well
4. Check to see if this is to your liking , add more vanilla or cinnamon depending on what you like
5. In large flan pan or two square pans
6. Cook 30 minutes on hi or until set

title: sea scallops with spinach and oranges
steps:
1. Mix finely chopped shallots and garlic set aside
2. Segment oranges and place segments in a small mixing bowl
3. Add the thin strips of basil to the orange segments , add 1 / 2 of the finely chopped shallots & garlic to the orange segments
4. Add 1-ounce of olive oil & cracked pepper , gently mix
5. Set aside
6. Place two saute pans on medium-high heat
7. Season scallops with salt and pepper
8. Divide the remaining olive oil into the two preheated pans: in one pan , add butter , add reserved garlic and shallots , quickly stir for 10 to 15 seconds and add spinach
9. Saute 20 to 30 seconds
10. Remove from heat and season
11. In the other pan , add the seasoned scallops , sear for about 1 to 2 minutes , flip over scallops and sear other side for about 1 to 2 minutes
12. Remove from heat
13. The center will look slightly translucent when cooked properly
14. Place sauteed spinach in center of plate , arrange scallops and oranges around the spinach , serve

title: easy chicken pizza casserole
steps:
1. Place whole chicken breasts into a casserole dish
2. Sprinkle on the onion salt and the oregano
3. Add onions , mushrooms , green pepper , olives
4. Pour pizza sauce over chicken and veggies
5. Bake uncovered at 350 degrees for 40-45 minutes , remove from oven and top with cheese
6. Bake another 5 to 10 minutes or till the cheese is bubbly
7. Serve with a green salad !
8. I hope you enjoy it !

title: sunshine rice
steps:
1. Heat oil in medium saucepan
2. Add celery and onions and saute until tender
3. Add water , juices , and hot sauce
4. Bring to a boil
5. Stir in rice and bring back to boil , let stand covered until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed
6. Stir in almonds , serve immediately

title: barefoot contessa s caramelized onions
steps:
1. Cut the onions in half and then slice them into 1 / 8-inch thick half-rounds
2. Heat the butter and oil in a large saute pan over medium heat
3. Add the onions , cayenne , salt , and pepper and saute for 10 minutes
4. Reduce the heat to medium-low and cook , stirring occasionally , for 20 more minutes until the onions are browned and caramelized

title: garden vegetable salad stacker
steps:
1. Place 6 of the tomato slices on a chilled serving platter , or on 6 individual chilled salad plates
2. Top each with 1 cheese slice
3. Drizzle with 1 / 2 of the dressing
4. Top each salad with one onion slice , 2 cucumber slices and second tomato slice
5. Drizzle with remaining dressing
6. Add a little freshly ground or cracked black pepper
7. Top each salad with a basil leaf
8. Serve with chilled salad forks

title: chicken enchiladas made healthier
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine chicken , 3 / 4 cup monterey jack cheese , 1 / 2 chives , garlic , cumin , and pepper
2. Set aside
3. Spread 1 / 2 cup of the enchilada sauce in a 13"x9"x2" baking pan
4. Transfer the remaining sauce to a large skillet and heat until warm
5. To soften each tortilla , completely submerge it in the sauce
6. Shake off the excess sauce and transfer tortilla to a plate
7. Spoon about 1 / 4 cup filling down the center and roll up to enclose
8. Place , seam down , in the prepared baking pan
9. Repeat until all are filled
10. Pour the remaining sauce over the filled tortillas and top with remaining monterey jack cheese , chedder cheese , remaining 1 / 2 cup of chives , and the olives
11. Cover with foil and bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes or until bubbly

title: tuscan style peppered chicken
steps:
1. Rub each chicken half all over with 2 tablespoons oil , then 1 1 / 2 teaspoons pepper
2. Sprinkle generously with salt
3. Let stand at room temperature 1 hour
4. Preheat broiler
5. Arrange chicken , skin side down , on broiler pan
6. Watching closely to avoid burning , broil chicken 5 to 6 inches from heat source until golden brown , about 12 minutes
7. Remove broiler pan from oven
8. Using tongs , transfer chicken to plate
9. Pour off any pan drippings
10. Return chicken , skin side up , to broiler pan
11. Broil until skin is crisp and golden brown , about 5 minutes
12. Turn chicken over , skin side down again , and broil until cooked through , about 8 minutes longer
13. Transfer chicken to platter
14. Let stand 5 minutes
15. Serve with lemon wedges to squeeze over chicken

title: chicken provencal stew in the crock pot
steps:
1. Cut up the chicken into portions
2. Cut the potatoes into cubes , slice the onions , garlic and peppers
3. Place chicken and potatoes into the crock pot dish
4. In a bowl , combine the onion , garlic , green pepper , tomatoes , wine and italian seasoning
5. Pour the mixture into the crock pot and mix with chicken portions and potatoes
6. Cook on low for 8 to 10 hours
7. Enjoy !

title: holiday mushrooms
steps:
1. Clean and slice mushrooms
2. Layer about a third of mushrooms in a 2-quart baking dish
3. Layer with a third of bread crumbs and drizzle with a third of melted butter
4. Sprinkle with salt and pepper to taste
5. Repeat for second layer
6. Cover with remaining mushrooms
7. Sprinkle with salt and pepper and wine
8. Cover and bake in 325 degree oven for about 35 minutes
9. Mix remaining crumbs and butter and spoon over mushrooms
10. Bake , uncovered 10 minutes or until crumbs are toasted

title: upside down popover pizza
steps:
1. In a large skillet , cook sausage until browned and pour off any excess fat
2. Add onion and green pepper
3. Cook for a few minutes
4. Stir in flour , basil , marjoram , and tomato sauce
5. Heat well , then pour into 9x13" baking pan
6. Arrange mozzarella slices on top
7. Popover batter:
8. Beat together the eggs and add flour , milk , oil , and salt
9. Whisk together until combined
10. Pour popover batter over all and sprinkle with parmesan cheese
11. Bake at 425 for 25 to 30 minutes or until well browned and serve at once

title: lights of havana
steps:
1. Stir together rum , midori , orange juice , and pineapple juice in a tall glass with ice
2. Slowly add sprite soda and stir gently
3. Serve garnished with fresh fruit , if desired

title: chocolate snow balls
steps:
1. Bring butter , milk , sugar& water to a boil in saucepan , stirring occasionally
2. Boil& stir for 3 to 4 minutes or until sugar dissolves
3. Stir in cocoa
4. Cool slightly
5. Stir in 2 cups of coconut , then oats and vanilla
6. Shape into 1 inch balls , roll in 1 1 / 2 cups coconut then place on waxed paper

title: fruit vodka slush
steps:
1. Simmer sugar and water for 3 minutes
2. Cool
3. Blend 1-1 / 2 c of the pineapple juice , lemonade , orange juice & mashed bananas
4. Add the sugar mixture , then the remaining 1-1 / 2 c pineapple juice & 1-1 / 2 c vodka
5. Freeze in 9x13 covered pan
6. Scoop into glasses & pour 7-up or ginger ale over to serve

title: baked ham with a brown sugar  rum and cayenne glaze
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Using a large knife , cut off the skin and all but 1 / 4 inch of the fat from the ham , leaving the surface as smooth as possible
3. Score the top and sides of the ham diagonally in two opposite directions about 1 1 / 2 inches apart , creating a diamond pattern
4. Stick a clove into the corners of each diamond
5. Place the ham on a rack in a roasting pan
6. Add the apple cider and 2 cups water to the pan
7. Bake for 2 hours , adding more water after an hour if needed
8. While ham bakes , combine the brown sugar , rum , salt and cayenne pepper to taste in a bowl
9. Stir until smooth
10. Let stand for 10 minutes to allow sugar to dissolve partially
11. Remove ham from the oven and brush the glaze evenly over the ham
12. Reserve the leftover glaze
13. Return the ham to the oven and bake for 1 hour longer , brushing with the glaze every 15 minutes
14. Transfer ham to a large platter and cover loosely with foil
15. Allow to rest for 15 to 30 minutes
16. While ham rests , pour the liquid from the roasting pan into a fat separator or a large glass measuring pitcher
17. Let the fat rise to the surface , then pour or spoon off as much fat as possible
18. Float a piece of paper towel on the surface to absorb the remaining fat
19. Pour the degreased liquid into a small saucepan and add the remaining glaze to make a sauce
20. Rewarm and pour in a sauceboat
21. Serve ham warm with the sauce

title: viva madrid red wine pear and blue cheese toasts
steps:
1. Preheat over to 350 degrees
2. Simmer wine , sugar and lemon juice and mix for about 10 minutes
3. Cut up pears into thin half moon slices
4. Simmer pears in wine until liquid begins to thicken slightly
5. You want a syrupy consistency , not molasses
6. Cut half of the baguette into slices
7. Grease a baking pan to fit the slices
8. Smear a layer of blue cheese on top of each piece of bread
9. Using tongs , gently place 2 poached pear slices on each piece of bread
10. Bake for 15 minutes , or until bread looks lightly toasted

title: applebee s maple butter sauce
steps:
1. Combine syrup and butter , cook over low heat until butter is melted
2. Stir in brown sugar until dissolved
3. Add walnuts , if desired

title: hockey sticks and pucks cookies
steps:
1. Lightly grease cookie sheets
2. Let dough stand at room temperature about 15 minutes
3. Combine dough and flour in large bowl
4. Knead until well blended
5. Divide dough into 24 pieces
6. Shape each piece into 6-inch-long rope
7. Place ropes on prepared cookie sheets
8. Bend ropes about 1-3 / 4 inches from ends to form hockey stick shapes
9. Freeze about 10 minutes
10. Preheat oven to 350f bake 8 to 10 minutes or until lightly browned
11. While cookies are still hot , place one mint on bottom part of each cookie for puck
12. Cool completely on cookie sheets
13. Decorate with icings as desired

title: baby green salad
steps:
1. Combine salad greens , onions and desired amount of vinaigrette in a medium sized bowl
2. Arrange on serving platter and garnish with blue cheese and pecans
3. Serve immediately
4. Orange vinaigrette: combine first 4 ingredients in medium-sized bowl
5. Gradually whisk in olive oil , then 1 / 2 cup water
6. Continue whisking until smoothly blended
7. Add additional 1 / 4 cup water if a thinner consistency is desired

title: nona s italian pasta casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Cut pacetta or canadian bacon into pieces
3. Break pasta in half and boil it until it's still a little hard
4. Drain pasta and set aside
5. In a skillet heat the olive oil
6. Saut celery , mushrooms , and onion until tender
7. Add meat and spices and cook until meat is brown
8. Set aside
9. Mix all other ingredients in a large bowl
10. Add to meat mixture and blend well
11. Pour into a baking dish and cook until cheese is melted and pasta is thoroughly cooked
12. The mushroom pieces should be sized to the cooks personal taste
13. I prefer bigger pieces while my mother likes smaller
14. Canadian bacon works just great

title: curry dip ii
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together and serve with fresh vegetables
2. Let stand in refrigerator for 1 hour before serving
3. Tastes better chilled

title: baked beef brisket recipe from the 1970s
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 dg
2. And place brisket fat side up in baking pan
3. Bake uncovered for 2 hours
4. Mix sauce ingredients and simmer a few minutes in saucepan , stirring until well-blended
5. Pour sauce over brisket , cover and cook 2 more hours
6. Remove from oven and remove meat from sauce
7. Reserve sauce and refrigerate both overnight
8. The next day , slice brisket thinly , place in a flat baking pan and cover with sauce
9. Place in 350 dg
10. Oven and bake covered until heated thoroughly and tender , which usually takes about 30-45 minutes
11. Serve warm on round sandwich buns with pickles , cole slaw , a fruit salad and dessert of choice
12. Enjoy !

title: sweet  n  sour salad dressing
steps:
1. In a jar with a tight-fitting lid , combine the first seven ingredients
2. Shake well
3. Serve over salad greens

title: escalloped eggplant
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees
2. On medium-size ovenproof platter , arrange eggplant slices , then tomato and onion slices
3. Drizzle with 1 / 4 cup melted butter
4. Sprinkle with salt and basil
5. Bake , covered , 20 minutes
6. Cut mozzarella slices in thirds
7. Arrange over top
8. Stir crumbs into rest of melted butter
9. Sprinkle over top
10. Then sprinkle with parmesan cheese
11. Bake , uncovered , 10 minutes , or until cheese is bubbly

title: caramelized onion toasts
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400f
2. Heat 4 tablespoons butter in a large skillet over medium heat
3. Add the onions , chopped anchovies , thyme , salt and pepper and cook until the onions are sweet and golden brown , about 20 minutes
4. Meanwhile , holding the knife parallel to the cutting board , shave off the rounded top and bottom of the baguette with a serrated knife so that it lies flat
5. Then cut the baguette in half lengthwise to make 2 long slices of bread
6. Brush both sides of each with the remaining 4 tablespoons butter
7. When the onions are cooked , put the bread slices on a baking sheet and spread with the onions
8. Garnish with olives , drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with parsley
9. Place in the oven and bake until the bread is crispy , about 15 minutes
10. Shower with parmigiano
11. Cut into pieces and serve hot
12. Serving suggestions: store bought italian cured meats

title: black and white bean salad
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine beans , tomato , onion and celery
2. Gently stir in vinegar and sprinkle with parsley
3. Season to taste and serve

title: laurie s microwave peanut clusters
steps:
1. Melt almond bark on high for 4 minutes in microwave
2. Add peanuts to mixture
3. Mix together well
4. Drop by teaspoonful on waxed paper
5. Let set

title: easy peanut patties
steps:
1. Combine the sugar , pudding mix , and milk in medium sauce pan over medium high heat stirring frequently
2. Bring the mixture to a boil
3. Reduce the heat to medium and boil for 5 minutes
4. Remove from the heat and stir in the vanilla
5. Beat for 3 minutes until thickens and stir in the peanuts
6. Drop by tablespoon full onto wax paper and allow candy to harden
7. Store in an airtight container
8. For gifts , give in tins

title: barefoot contessa thumbprint cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. In an electric mixer fitted with the paddle attachment , cream together the butter and sugar until just combined , and then add the vanilla
3. Separately , sift together the flour and salt
4. With the mixer on low speed , add the flour mixture to the creamed butter and sugar
5. Mix until the dough starts to come together
6. Dump on a floured board and roll together into a flat disk
7. Wrap in plastic wrap and chill for 30 minutes
8. Roll the dough into 1 1 / 4-inch balls
9. Dip each ball into the egg wash and then roll it in coconut
10. Place the balls on an ungreased cookie sheet and press a light indentation into the top of each with your finger
11. Drop 1 / 4 teaspoon of jam into each indentation
12. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes , until the coconut is a golden brown
13. Cool and serve

title: rosemary beef and tomato over noodles
steps:
1. In a 4-6 quart slow cooker , combine butter , onion , beef base , salt , pepper and beef
2. Mix well
3. Cover
4. Cook on low for 9-10 hours
5. About 15 minutes before serving , cook noodles as directed on package
6. Add tomatoes and rosemary to beef and mix well
7. Increase heat to high
8. Cover and cook an additonal 10 minutes
9. Serve beef over noodles

title: mustard relish
steps:
1. Peel and seed cukes and finely chop
2. Finely chop onions and peppers
3. Place in a colander and drain for 1 hour-squeeze and toss into a large pot
4. Add vinegar , mustard , horseradish , salt , celery seed and ginger
5. Add pectin and mix well
6. Bring to a full rolling boil and all the sugar
7. Bring to a hard boil again and boil for 1 minute-your doing a lot of stirring also
8. Remove from heat , skim and ladle into hot sterilized jars leaving 1 / 8 inch head space
9. Process for 10 minutes at altitudes up to 1000 feet

title: frozen strawberries gelatin pie
steps:
1. Make gelatin according to instructions and cool until cool to touch , but not firm yet
2. Slice strawberries , and fill bottom of pie crust with some them , setting the rest aside
3. Pour liquid gelatin over strawberries , filling pie crust until 1 / 4 inch from the top
4. You most likely will not use all of the gelatin
5. Place in fridge for 3 hours
6. Spread cool whip across the top , and decorate with remaining strawberries
7. Freeze for one hour for easier cutting
8. Refreeze any uneaten portions

title: curried quinoa salad with cranberries
steps:
1. Rinse quinoa in plenty of water , drain
2. In medium saucepan , bring the two cups of water to a boil over high heat
3. Stir in quinoa
4. Reduce heat and simmer , uncovered , for 15 minutes or until water is absorbed
5. Remove from heat and let cool
6. In small bowl , mix soy sauce , vinegar , honey , curry powder and red pepper flakes , stirring until completely blended
7. Combine , in a serving bowl , remaining ingredients
8. Gently stir in cooled quinoa , then soy sauce mixture

title: kamuela tomato salad
steps:
1. Place lettuce on a plate
2. Slice tomatoes in thick slices
3. Place on lettuce bed
4. Add onion slices and drizzle with vinaigrette
5. Add blue cheese if using

title: peaches and cream jelly roll
steps:
1. For the cake:
2. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees
3. With an electric mixer fitted with a wire whip , beat the eggs and 1 cup of the sugar on medium-high speed in a large mixing bowl until the mixture is pale yellow and thick and has tripled in volume , about 8 minutes
4. Sift the flour , baking powder , and salt together in a medium-size mixing bowl
5. Fold into the egg mixture and blend thoroughly until smooth
6. Add the vanilla and 2 tablespoons of the butter
7. Mix gently
8. Grease a 17 by 12 inch baking pan with the remaining 2 teaspoons of the butter
9. Sprinkle with the remaining 2 tablespoons sugar
10. Pour the cake batter into the prepared pan , spreading it evenly
11. Bake until the cake springs back when touched , about 15 minutes
12. Cool for about 2 minutes , then gently flip it out onto a large piece of parchment paper
13. For the filling:
14. In a mixing bowl , combine the egg yolks , cornstarch , and 1 cup of the heavy cream
15. Whisk to blend well
16. Set aside
17. Combine the remaining 1 1 / 2 cups cream and sugar in a large heavy-bottom saucepan over medium heat
18. Whisk to dissolve the sugar and bring to a gentle boil , about 10 minutes
19. Slowly add the egg yolk mixture , whisking constantly and cook until it thickens , about 5 minutes
20. Be forewarned: the mixture will break
21. Don't be alarmed
22. Pour it into a glass bowl
23. Press a piece of plastic wrap down over the surface of the mixture to prevent a skin from forming
24. Let cool completely at room temperature
25. When cooled pour the mixture into the bowl of an electric mixer fitted with a wire whip
26. Beat at a medium speed to combine the mixture
27. If it will not combine , warm another 1 / 2 cup heavy cream and slowly add it to the mixture
28. Whip until you have a thick and creamy custard
29. For the peaches:
30. Heat the butter in a large saute pan over medium-high heat
31. Add the light brown sugar and cinnamon , stir until it dissolves
32. Add the peaches and cook , stirring , until the sugar starts to turn dark amber in color , 5 to 6 minutes
33. Add the rum , carefully ignite it , and flambe the peaches
34. Remove from the heat and allow to cool for about 10 minutes
35. Place in the bowl of a food processor , pulse several times or until the peach mixture is spreadable
36. To assemble:
37. Place the parchment-lined cake on a work surface
38. Peel off the cooking paper and roll and unroll the cake in the paper several times
39. Using a small pallet knife , spread the peach mixture evenly over the cake
40. Spread the pastry cream evenly over the peaches
41. Starting at one end and using the paper underneath , roll the filled cakes as tightly as possible
42. Wrap the entire jelly roll in plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 4 hours
43. Remove from the refrigerator and slice diagonally 2 inches thick
44. Place on each serving plate
45. Garnish with whipped cream , mint and powdered sugar

title: oven roasted new potatoes
steps:
1. Scrub the potatoes and cut into bite size pieces
2. Cook in water to cover in a saucepan just until tender
3. Place half the potatoes in a 2 quart baking dish
4. Season with salt and pepper
5. Drizzle with half the melted butter
6. Sprinkle with half the bacon , half the cheese and half the scallions
7. Repeat layers with the remaining ingredients
8. Bake at 350f for 20 minutes or until bubbly and heated through

title: hash browns chicken soup
steps:
1. Mix together soups and water
2. Heat until very hot
3. Drop hash browns into hot soup to cook potatoes and thicken soup
4. Add cooked chicken and seasonings and heat through

title: pepperoni parmesan cheese ball
steps:
1. Mix all ing
2. Together , roll into ball
3. Store in refridgerator

title: crock pot ginger teriyaki pork chops
steps:
1. Mix kikkoman teriyaki sauce , brown sugar and ginger together
2. Place chops in crock pot
3. Pour sauce over the chops
4. Cook on low for 7 hours

title: no beans about it mock pecan pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Blend all ingredients well and pour into the unbaked pie crust
3. Bake for 30-35 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center of pie comes out clean and pie is browned
4. Set aside to firm up and serve
5. Can be served either hot or at room temperature

title: coconut tres leches hot chocolate
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan combine the low fat milk , coconut milk , and sweetened condensed milk
2. Bring to a simmer over medium low heat , stirring occasionally
3. Whisk in cocoa powder until well combined
4. Remove from heat and stir in the vanilla
5. You may add more sugar if desired
6. Serve in mugs topped with the whipped cream and chocolate shavings if desired
7. Enjoy !

title: cabbage goulash
steps:
1. Brown the beef and sausage in a large pot
2. Add chili powder and salt and pepper to taste
3. Add cabbage , vinegar and tomato paste and simmer , covered for c
4. 20 minutes
5. I serve with warm bread
6. Enjoy

title: potato pancakes   kartoffelpletter
steps:
1. Cook the potatoes in their jackets , in a pot of boiling water , until just tender
2. Drain and cool slightly
3. Peel potatoes , add salt and mash while warm
4. Work the flours into the mashed potatoes , a little at a time with egg whites
5. Knead the dough well
6. Divide dough into eight pieces and roll each piece on a lightly floured board into a thin round cake
7. Cook on both sides on a greased griddle over medium-low heat until done
8. Watch them closely to keep them from burning
9. Serve with toppings of your choice

title: easy velveeta salsa dip
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan combine the beer , cumin , dried oregano and garlic powder
2. Bring to a simmer
3. Add in the refried beans and salsa , stir until heated through
4. Add in the cubed velveeta
5. Stir over low heat until cheese melts
6. Transfer to a bowl and serve warm with tortilla chips or tacos

title: girl scout cookies  samoas or caramel de lites
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. In a large mixing bowl , cream together butter and sugar
3. Mix in flour , baking powder and salt at a low speed , followed by the vanilla and milk , adding in the milk as needed to make the dough come together without being sticky
4. The dough should come together into a soft , not-too-sticky ball
5. Add in a bit of extra flour if your dough is very sticky
6. Roll the dough out between pieces of wax paper to about 1 / 4-inch thickness and use a 1 1 / 2-inch cookie cutter to make rounds
7. Place on a parchment lined baking sheet and use a knife , or the end of a wide straw , to cut a smaller center hole
8. Repeat with remaining dough
9. Alternatively , use scant tablespoons of dough and press into an even layer in a mini donut pan to form the rounds
10. Bake cookies for 10-12 minutes , until bottoms are lightly browned and cookies are set
11. If using a mini donut pan , bake for only about 10 minutes , until edges are light gold
12. Cool for a few minutes on the baking sheet then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely
13. Preheat oven to 300
14. Spread coconut evenly on a parchment-lined baking sheet and toast 20 minutes , stirring every 5 minutes , until coconut is golden
15. Cool on baking sheet , stirring occasionally
16. Set aside
17. Unwrap the caramels and place in a large microwave-safe bowl with milk and salt
18. Cook on high for 3-4 minutes , stopping to stir a few times to help the caramel melt
19. When smooth , fold in toasted coconut with a spatula
20. Using the spatula or a small offset spatula , spread topping on cooled cookies , using about 2-3 tsp per cookie
21. Reheat caramel for a few seconds in the microwave if it gets too firm to work with
22. While topping sets up , melt chocolate in a small bowl
23. Heat on high in the microwave in 45 second intervals , stirring thoroughly to prevent scorching
24. Dip the base of each cookie into the chocolate and place on a clean piece of parchment paper
25. Transfer all remaining chocolate into a piping bag or a ziplock bag with the corner snipped off and drizzle finished cookies with chocolate
26. Let chocolate set completely before storing in an airtight container
27. Makes about 3 1 / 2-4 dozen cookies

title: curry spiced steamed mussels
steps:
1. Combine dry spices
2. Heat a 5-6 quart pot over medium heat
3. Add butter and oil , add onion after foam subsides and saute until onion is translucent
4. Stir in garlic and dry spices
5. Cook stirring until the spices are aromatic
6. Stir in tomatoes and cook for another 2 minutes
7. Add liquid and mussels
8. Cover and cook until mussels are open-- 5-7 minutes
9. Transfer mussels to individual soup bowls with a slotted spoon discarding any unopened mussels
10. Ladle broth over mussels
11. Drizzle each serving with lemon juice and garnish with cilantro leaves

title: onion rye loaf  bread machine
steps:
1. Measure ingredients into baking pan in the order recommended by the manufacturer
2. Insert pan into the oven chamber
3. Select basic cycle
4. When the baking cycle ends , immediately remove the bread from the pan and place it on a rack
5. Let cool to room temperature before slicing

title: arnies chicken dinner
steps:
1. Marinade chicken in teriyaki sauce for 1 plus hours
2. Preheat oven to 400
3. Crush fried onions to small pieces
4. I use the back of a big spoon
5. Place in a bowl
6. Dip chicken in onions crumbs
7. Place chicken chicken on a sprayed cookie sheet
8. Bake for 20 minutes or until done

title: pineapple   marzipan cake  ananas marzipankuchen
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 190c / 375f / gas 5
2. Mix butter , eggs , vanilla sugar and sugar in a mixing bowl until well combined
3. Add the marzipan and continue to stir until smooth
4. Sieve together the flour and baking powder and slowly add little by little , stirring until you have a smooth dough
5. Add the pineapple chunks and stir into the dough
6. Pour into a greased loaf pan that has been lined with baking paper
7. Bake for 50-65 minutes , if you feel it is getting too dark , cover with foil
8. Depending on your oven and the size of your loaf pan it may take longer than 65 minutes , but not to worry
9. Check for doneness by inserting a wooden skewer , if it comes out clean the cake is ready
10. Allow to cool before removing from tin
11. If you want you can cover with ganache , but it's great without

title: low carb pizza crust
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Spray two 12-inch pizza pans with non-stick cooking spray
3. Mix all ingredients together into a smooth , pancake-batter-like mixture
4. Spread the batter as thinly and evenly as possible over the two pizza pans
5. Bake for 12-15 minutes , or until browned and firm to the touch
6. Then turn oven to 400 degrees , top pizza with whatever you like , and return to oven for another 10-12 minutes
7. Cut each pizza into 8 pieces

title: oatcakes
steps:
1. Combine all of the dry ingredients
2. Add margarine to the dry mixture until crumbly
3. Melting the margarine helps
4. Add egg , vanilla , and water
5. Form into a dough
6. Divide the dough into 16 bars , approximately 1 / 2 inch thick
7. Bake at 350f for 15 minutes on a parchment-lined cookie sheet
8. Flip them over and bake for another 10 minutes

title: good eats pan bagnat
steps:
1. In a small mixing bowl , whisk together vinegar , mustard , salt and pepper
2. While continuing to whisk , gradually add olive oil
3. Set aside
4. Slice the bread horizontally into 2 pieces
5. Tear out some of the bread from the bottom piece , making a slight well
6. Place the tuna , then green pepper , red onion , egg , olives and tomato on the bottom side of the bread in that order
7. Drizzle the vinaigrette over the vegetables and top with second piece of bread
8. Wrap tightly in plastic wrap and let stand at room temperature for 2 hours before serving
9. Cut into 4 sandwiches and serve

title: caribbean stuffed pork with orange sweet potatoes and plantains
steps:
1. Cut the pork down the centre making sure not to go all the way through pound pork with a meat mallet until same thickness all over
2. Season with salt and pepper on both sides
3. In a frying pan melt butter , add onions , cook until soft , add herbs , breadcrumbs , rum , chopped mango and salt and pepper to taste , stir to combines
4. Spoon stuffing down on half of pork remembering to leave enough of an edge so when you fold , the other half over , it will cover the stuffing completely
5. Fold the other half of the pork over and secure with kitchen string at 11 / 2-2 inch intervals
6. In a lightly oiled roasting pan , place pork and bake in a preheated oven 180c for about 1 hr
7. Baste meat several times during cooking with reserved juice , i even poured a little over the pork when i started , so the pork juices combined with this made for some great juices i could use for sauce later
8. Mango sauce:
9. Drain the mango reserving the juice , blend or process mango until smooth , pour into saucepan , leave on a low heat
10. Heat a little olive oil in a pan , add onion and garlic cook until onion is soft and garlic has just started to brown , add to mango , turn up the heat to medium
11. Add the rest of the ingredients and stir until jam has melted and sugar dissolved , that's it easy peasy sauce is done
12. This can just be left over a very low heat to keep warm
13. When the pork is cooked just add the 3 tablespoon of juices and stir to combine
14. If sauce is not quite hot enough , turn the heat up at this time and heat for a couple of minutes until hot
15. Serve over pork
16. Orange-baked sweet potatoes:
17. Peel sweet potatoes and chop into pieces place in a pan cover with water and boil until tender then drain
18. While potatoes are cooking , slice the tops off of 4 oranges and scoop out the flesh be careful not to break the shells
19. Cut the peel from the tops into thin strips to use as garnish later
20. Squeeze the juice from the pulp and grate a teaspoon of rind from the fifth orange
21. Mash the sweet potato until smooth
22. Add butter , cream , sugar , rum , orange juice and cinnamon , whisk to combine or bar mix away whatever is easier mix in grated rind and season with salt and pepper
23. Spoon mashed potato mixture into the orange shells
24. Place on a baking tray and bake in a preheated oven at 180c bake for 15-20 minutes , until you have golden brown top
25. Garnish with the reserved strips of orange peel and serve
26. Plantain chips:
27. Peel plantains and thinly slice them into rounds
28. Heat the oil in a deep frying pan and fry plantains until crispy and golden
29. Drain on absorbent paper and season with salt
30. Oh so easy and oh so delicious , just remember you need some for dinner , so don't sneak to many while cooking :)
31. To serve: arrange pork slices on plate pour sauce over the top
32. Arrange plantain chips and place orange shell on top of them
33. Bon appetit

title: traditional biscuits n  gravy  w sausage   gluten free
steps:
1. Cook 2 sausage links and 1 tsp onion in a medium sized saucepan over medium-high heat until no longer pink in center
2. Remove sausage , leaving behind drippings and onion
3. Reduce heat to low and add 1 tbsp butter
4. Meanwhile cut up the sausage into small pieces and set aside
5. When butter is melted , add 1
6. 5 tbsp cornstarch and whisk into butter until it is fully mixed into a thick paste
7. Increase heat to high and add milk
8. Immediately whisk until flour paste dissolves
9. Reduce heat to med-high or medium once gravy begins to thicken
10. Return sausage to pan , stirring in 1 / 8 tsp salt and pepper to taste
11. Reduce heat to low once it reaches desired thickness stirring occasionally
12. Place biscuits on serving plates and split in half arranging so they are open-faced
13. Pour a generous amount of the gravy mixture over each biscuit letting it spill over the sides onto the plate
14. If it thickens too much , simply add a little more milk to thin it out

title: honey whole wheat cornbread
steps:
1. Coat 12-cup muffin tin with cooking spray
2. Place in oven
3. Preheat oven to 425f
4. Whisk together cornmeal , flour , baking soda , and salt
5. In separate bowl , whisk together yogurt , milk , eggs , applesauce , and honey
6. Mix wet and dry ingredients
7. Remove pan from oven and carefully spoon batter into cups
8. Bake for 20 minutes , until golden brown

title: holiday merry mint milkshake  by bird
steps:
1. Place all shake ingredients in a blender in the order listed
2. Blend until it's as smooth as you like it
3. Pour into a large parfait glass
4. Top with whipped cream , sprinkle with chocolate sprinkles , green colored sugar , then place the cherry on top
5. Insert a long-handled spoon , two straws , and a candy cane
6. Serve cuddled by the fireside listening to your favorite christmas carols and watching your holiday tree glisten
7. Just like two turtle doves
8. Enjoy !

title: chocolate marshmallow cream bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. 1st layer:
3. Cream the 1st three ingredients
4. Add vanilla , eggs , flour , salt
5. Spray and flour a 10x15-inch cookie sheet type pan
6. Spread creamed mixture into pan
7. Bake for 20 minutes
8. 2nd layer:
9. Spread evenly the marshmallow cream on the first layer when still partially warm
10. 3rd layer:
11. Melt over low heat the peanut butter , chocolate chips , and butterscotch chips , blend well
12. Add the rice krispies
13. Spread this mixture over the top of the marshmallow cream layer a spoonful at a time

title: coconut rice  nasi lemak
steps:
1. Combine stock , coconut milk , pandan leaves , garlic powder and salt in a saucepan
2. Simmer over low heat
3. In the meantime dry fry dessicated coconut with the spices until lightly browned
4. I usually cook the rice with the stock in a rice cooker but you can cook it in the same saucepan for about 20 minutes or until all liquid is absorbed
5. Add the dessicated coconut and mix well before serving
6. May serve with malaysian chicken curry

title: simple stroganoff
steps:
1. Saute onion and brown hamburger / crumbles
2. Add soup mix , 1 / 2 to 1 cup of water , soup , sour cream , worcestershire , mushrooms and garlic salt
3. Simmer 1 / 2 hour over medium heat , stirring occasionaly
4. Serve over cooked egg noodles

title: pizza bread
steps:
1. Mix yeast with water until dissolved
2. Add sugar , oil , salt , chopped garlic and 1 cup flour stirring until smooth
3. Add enough flour until easy to handle and knead on floured surface until smooth and elastic , adding flour as necessary
4. Allow to rise until doubled
5. Punch down dough and shape into 13"x18" rectangle
6. Layer on remaining ingredients as you would like then roll up in jelly roll fashion and seal all edges well
7. Place corner to corner on greased jelly roll pan and bake in preheated 400 degree oven until browned
8. Let cool before slicing or if you are like me chill in refridgerator until ready to serve and serve it cold

title: buffet style fluffy oven scrambled eggs for a crowd
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees f
2. Spray a 13 x 9-inch glass baking pan with cooking spray then pour the melted butter into the pan
3. In a bowl whisk eggs and salt until smooth and well blended
4. Gradually whisk in the half and half and milk
5. Pour into the baking pan
6. Bake uncovered for 10 minutes
7. Remove the pan from the oven then stir the eggs
8. Return to oven and bake another 15-20 minutes or until the eggs are just set
9. Serve immediately

title: pakoras
steps:
1. Combine flour and baking soda
2. Add cold water slowly
3. Stir until moistened
4. Add rest of ingredients but don't over-mix
5. Drop by tablespoonfuls into hot oil
6. Fry until both sides are golden brown
7. Caution: don't put too much dough in at once , or it will turn out gooey in the middle

title: linguine with red pepper sauce
steps:
1. Coat a nonstick skillet with cooking spray
2. Add oil
3. Place over medium heat until hot
4. Add sweet red pepper and garlic
5. Cook , uncovered , 30 minutes , stirring occasionally
6. Set aside , and cool slightly
7. Place pepper mixture in container of an electric blender or food processor
8. Add chopped basil and next 3 ingredients
9. Cover and process until smooth , stopping once to scrape down sides
10. Cook pasta according to package directions , omitting salt and fat
11. To serve , top pasta with pepper sauce
12. Garnish with basil sprigs , if desired

title: tuna pierogi casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. With nonstick cooking spray , coat bottom of 9x13 casserole dish
3. In a large pot over high heat , thaw pierogies in boiling water for 5 minutes
4. Drain
5. Place in prepared dish
6. In large skillet , over medium-high heat , heat oil
7. Add celery and onion
8. Saute about 5 minutes , or until onions are softened
9. Remove from heat
10. Add tuna , soup and mayonnaise , stir until well mixed
11. Spoon tuna mixture over pierogies in dish
12. Place cheese on top
13. Bake uncovered 45 minutes , or until hot and bubbly and cheese is melted

title: grilled chicken chocolate chili
steps:
1. Fry first 7 ingredients in the 2 tbsp
2. Oil 'til onions are transparent
3. Add next 6 ingredients , simmer 45 mins
4. , meanwhile prepare chicken:
5. Cut chicken into bite-sized pieces
6. In a bowl , cover breast chunks with olive oil , add salt , cilantro and set aside
7. Add more water to the chili if necessary
8. Add the pepper chunks , simmer for 1 / 2 hr
9. Meanwhile , remove chicken from marinade and grill 4-5 mins
10. I use a george forman grill , or broil
11. When the chili is ready , gently stir-in the grilled chicken
12. Don't cook , just heat low for 20 minutes
13. Adjust seasoning
14. Optional: 1 / 4 tsp cayenne pepper can be added
15. Serve over rice or in a bread bowl
16. Toppings: sour cream , grated jalapeno-jack cheese

title: simple mango salsa
steps: 1. Combine all ingredients and serve

title: pecan fruitcake squares  or any nut you prefer
steps:
1. Place raisins and rum , in a small microwaveable bowl
2. Microwave , uncovered , on high for 1 minute to warm raisins so they will soak up brandy
3. Stir , then set aside
4. Preheat oven to 350f
5. In a large mixing bowl , using electric mixer or spoon , beat butter with sugar until creamy
6. Beat in vanilla
7. In another bowl , use a fork to blend 2 1 / 4 cups flour with salt
8. Gradually stir into butter mixture press into ungreased 10x15-inch jelly roll pan
9. Bake in center of oven until lightly golden , about 10 minutes
10. Meanwhile , whisk eggs in a large bowl
11. Add corn syrup , brown sugar , and the last 2 tablespoons of flour
12. Stir until mixed
13. Stir in raisins and any remaining brandy , nuts and candied fruit
14. Spread over partially baked warm crust , evenly distributing nuts and fruit
15. Bake in center of oven until it starts to set in the middle , from 20-25 minutes
16. I find 20-22 minutes is usually enough
17. Set pan on rack to cool , then cut into bars
18. Store in a covered container in a cool dry place , they will keep well for at least a week and can be frozen

title: boilermaker tailgate chili
steps:
1. Heat a large stock pot over medium-high heat
2. Crumble the ground chuck and sausage into the hot pan , and cook until evenly browned
3. Drain off excess grease
4. Pour in the chili beans , spicy chili beans , diced tomatoes and tomato paste
5. Add the onion , celery , green and red bell peppers , chile peppers , bacon bits , bouillon , and beer
6. Season with chili powder , worcestershire sauce , garlic , oregano , cumin , hot pepper sauce , basil , salt , pepper , cayenne , paprika , and sugar
7. Stir to blend , then cover and simmer over low heat for at least 2 hours , stirring occasionally
8. After 2 hours , taste , and adjust salt , pepper , and chili powder if necessary
9. The longer the chili simmers , the better it will taste
10. Remove from heat and serve , or refrigerate , and serve the next day
11. To serve , ladle into bowls , and top with corn chips and shredded cheddar cheese

title: cheddar stuffed eggs
steps:
1. Cut eggs in half lengthwise
2. Remove yolks
3. In small bowl mix yolks , cheeses and parsley until well blended
4. Stuff whites of eggs with mixture

title: olive tapenade for your panini
steps: 1. Pulse all ingredients in food processor until mixture is coarse but uniform

title: crackle candy
steps:
1. Melt chocolate bits , butterscotch bits and peanut butter over low heat in large non-stick pan
2. When completely melted turn off heat and quickly add and stir in rice krispies
3. Drop by teaspoons onto wax paper lined cookie sheets and put into fridge to harden
4. If it is humid or hot out , you may have to keep these in the fridge to keep them from melting
5. Otherwise , they may be left out of the fridge

title: 1 dish hot fudge swirl cake
steps:
1. Spray a 9 1 / 2 inch deep-dish pie pan with cooking spray
2. In the prepared pan , mix the flour , yeast , sugar , salt , water , and melted butter
3. Top the batter with evenly-spaced spoonfuls of the hot fudge sauce
4. Using the spoon , swirl fudge sauce into the batter without mixing
5. Place the pie pan in a cold oven
6. Set the temperature to 350 degrees and bake for 25-30 minutes , until lightly browned and firm in the center
7. Cool 10 minutes
8. Combine powdered sugar and milk and drizzle over warm cake

title: broiled tomatoes with horseradish
steps:
1. Cut tomatoes in half , crosswise
2. Combine crumbs , horseradish , lemon juice , salt and paprika
3. Spread mixture over tomatoes halves
4. Sprinkle with chopped parsley and the cheese
5. Place in a broiler pan
6. Broil 3 inches from heat 3 to 5 minutes until heated through
7. Serve immediately

title: cake mix lemon pecan cookies
steps:
1. With mixer blend butter , eggs , milk and extract
2. Mix in cake mix and chopped pecans
3. Chill dough before placing on parchment lined baking sheet
4. Form into large balls , place on baking sheet and press down with fork
5. Bake 350 degrees for 12 minutes
6. Let cool before removing from baking sheet

title: walleye crab cakes
steps:
1. Mix all , form into small patties , roll in crumbs , put on a well greased cookie sheet
2. Bake in oven on top rack at 350 degrees for about 15 minutes , flipping once , until golden on both sides
3. Alternative: instead of baking , i have also greased a pan and browned the cakes on the top of the stove
4. Medium heat
5. Just cook for about 4-5 minutes on each side
6. Serve immediately with lemon dill sauce on the side

title: mashed potatoes with bacon and cheddar
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f peel potatoes , and cut into 1-inch chunks
2. Place in a large saucepan , and add enough cold water to cover by about 2 inches
3. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat , and reduce to a simmer
4. Cook until easily pierced with a paring knife , about 20 minutes
5. Transfer to a colander to drain
6. Return to pan , cover , and set aside
7. Meanwhile , heat a large skillet over medium heat
8. Add bacon , and cook until crisp and browned , turning once
9. Transfer to paper towels
10. Let cool , and crumble
11. Using a fork , mash potatoes in pan until light and fluffy
12. Add cream cheese , butter , and sour cream , and stir until combined and smooth
13. Add the onion and any onion juice , chives , 2 cups cheese , half the bacon , salt , and pepper
14. Stir until well combined
15. Transfer to a buttered 3-quart baking dish
16. Top with remaining 1 / 2 cup cheese
17. Bake until top is slightly golden and potatoes are heated through , about 30 minutes
18. Remove from oven
19. Garnish with remaining bacon
20. Serve immediately

title: lemon thins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f and lightly grease baking sheet
2. In a large bowl , beat the egg and sugar with an electric mixer for 3 minutes on high
3. Add the potato starch , lemon zest , lemon juice , vanilla , salt and oil , beating on low speed until well blended
4. Drop small teaspoon amounts onto the baking sheet , spacing the cookies at least 2 inches apart
5. Bake 7-10 minutes or until the edges begin to turn golden brown
6. Remove the cookies from the oven and sprinkle with sugar
7. Immediately move cookies to a wire rack to cool
8. Store in an airtight container

title: schreiners butter baked chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Melt butter in large frying pan
3. Add oil and heat
4. Dredge pieces of chicken in flour then lightly brown chicken in butter mixture , turning as needed
5. When done , transfer chicken to baking dish
6. Top with seasoned salt
7. In medium bowl , combine soups , onion , celery , poultry seasoning , garlic powder and water
8. Mix well
9. Pour over chicken
10. Return casserole uncovered in preheated oven until chicken is tender , 1 to 1 1 / 2 hours , basting with sauce occasionally

title: black bean soup  asian style
steps:
1. Saut onions and garlic in oil for 5 minutes
2. Add the next 5 ingredients plus cup water
3. Bring to a boil
4. Simmer for 20 minutes
5. Puree of the soup and return
6. Stir in orange juice
7. Simmer 5 minutes

title: sirloin rolls
steps:
1. In a small bowl , mix cheeses , spinach , oregano , salt , pepper , and garlic
2. Mix well
3. Spread cheese mixture over sirloin steaks
4. Spoon tomato sauce over top
5. Roll up steaks
6. Place seam side down
7. Cut into 5" pieces and place seam sides down into lightly sprayed pan
8. Bake at 400 for about 25 minutes

title: butter mint sugar cookie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. In a medium bowl , whisk together the flour , baking powder , and salt
3. Set aside
4. Place buttermints and a 1 / 2 cup granulated sugar in a sturdy plastic sandwich bag and crush with rolling pin , meat mallet , or hammer
5. In a large bowl , combine crushed mint mixture with butter , with an electric mixer set at medium speed , beat for 2-3 minutes
6. Add egg and vanilla extract
7. Continue beating until well mixed
8. Reduce speed to low , and add gradually add flour mixture
9. Beat until well mixed
10. Shape balls into 1-inch balls
11. Roll in decorator sugar if desired
12. Place 2 inches apart onto ungreased cookie sheets
13. Bake for 10-12 minutes or until edges are slightly browned
14. Immediately remove cookies and transfer to a cooling surface

title: yakitori domburi
steps:
1. Mix soy sauce , mirin , gingerroot and garlic in medium glass or plastic bowl
2. Place chicken in soy mixture , marinate for 15 minutes
3. Drain chicken , reserving soy mixture
4. Heat oil in 12-inch skillet until hot
5. Cook chicken over medium heat until brown on both sides and done , about 15 minutes
6. Heat water , sugar and reserved soy mixture to boiling in 3-quart saucepan
7. Boil and stir 2 minutes
8. Stir in scallions
9. Cut each chicken breast half into 6 diagonal slices by holding the knife or cleaver at a 45-degree angle to the cutting surface
10. Place 6 slices on rice in soup bowl
11. Spoon hot liquid over chicken

title: jolean s chili
steps:
1. Heat oil in frying pan and partially cook onion , green pepper , celery and garlic
2. Push to the side
3. Add ground chuck and brown
4. Chop into large chunks , and then drain grease
5. Dump cooked meat mixture and all other ingredients into crock pot and mix well
6. Cook on high for 1 hour , then turn on low for 4 hours
7. Add red kidney beans during last 15 minutes of cooking

title: jamaican jerk pork
steps:
1. In a large bowl combine the first 7 ingredients
2. Mix thoroughly
3. In a food processor combine green onions and garlic , peppers , onion , lemon juice , oil , soy sauce , malt vinegar and ginger
4. Blend until very smooth
5. Place pork in a glass bowl or large freezer bag , combine all ingredients and coat pork well
6. Cover and stir or flip often
7. Marinate for at least 8 hours
8. Take out of the fridge 1 hour before grilling
9. Preheat grill to medium high , skewer pork , 4 cubes to a skewer
10. Cook for 6-8 minutes on one side , flip and 6-8 minutes on the other

title: crock pot spinach special
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl
2. Pour into crock pot
3. Cook on high 1 hour
4. Reduce heat to low and cook 3 more hours

title: maple black walnut fudge
steps:
1. Combine evaporated milk and sugar in a saucepan
2. Bring to a boil over medium heat
3. Stirring constantly -- until mixture reaches 234
4. Remove from heat , stir in almond bark , mix till combined
5. And then add remaining ingredients
6. Pour into a buttered 9" pan
7. Cool , then cut into pieces

title: kenn s raspberry balsamic reduction
steps:
1. Wash raspberries and pat dry with a lint-free cloth
2. In a sauce reduction pan or 9" skillet , pour in vinegar and rapidly bring up to temperature
3. Add sugar and dissolve
4. Raise temperature to near boil
5. Add raspberries and stir mixture until reduced by about 2 / 3
6. Be careful not to scorch
7. You must continue stirring until complete
8. This can be canned in 4 ounce jars for gift giving
9. Canning instructions: while still hot
10. Dip reduction into sanitized 4 ounce canning grade jars , leaving " headspace
11. Place sanitized sealable lids onto jars and place in water bath canner and process for 10 minutes

title: chicken roulade susie
steps:
1. Pound the chicken breasts very thin--like the thinnest scallopini
2. Simmer the chopped apricots and the raisins in the white wine till apricots are soft and raisins are plump
3. Remove from heat and allow to cool slightly
4. Mash the garlic cloves into a paste and set aside
5. If using raw cashews , grind in coffee grinder until the nuts form a paste
6. If using cashew butter , proceed to next step
7. Spread a thin layer of cashew butter / paste over the pounded chicken
8. Lay a layer of spinach leaves over the chicken
9. Scatter the apricots and raisins over the chicken
10. Roll the chicken up tightly , tucking in the ends
11. Beat one egg
12. Dip each chicken roll into the beaten egg
13. Roll each chicken roll in the breadcrumbs till lightly coated
14. Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat
15. Saute the chicken rolls , turning with tongs , until cooked on all sides
16. Remove chicken rolls to an oven-proof plate
17. Tent with foil
18. Keep warm
19. If necessary , add additional olive oil to pan
20. Add anchovies and saute till anchovies dissolve into oil
21. Add garlic paste and pepper
22. Add chicken stock and bring to a boil and reduce slightly
23. Lower heat
24. Mix remaining egg with cornstarch
25. Whisk in lemon juice and continue to whisk until mixture is smooth
26. Temper in some of the chicken stock mixture
27. Gently add egg / lemon mixture to chicken stock mixture
28. Return to low heat
29. Whisk till smooth and thickened to the consistency of thin custard
30. Slice chicken rolls on the diagonal
31. Pool sauce on dinner plates
32. Lay chicken slices on top of sauce and serve

title: zucchini with yoghurt
steps:
1. Saute onions and zucchini in olive oil over medium heat 5 minutes
2. Cover and cook 2- 3 more minutes , or until tender
3. Combine last 5 ingredients , pour on top
4. Serve immediately

title: great great aunt jessie s 1940 s cranberry sweet potato patties
steps:
1. Mash potatoes
2. Add egg , milk , salt and shortening
3. Mix thoroughly
4. Form into 3 inch patties and roll in bread crumbs
5. Place in shallow , greased baking pan
6. Bake in moderate oven for 15 minutes
7. In the meantime combine orange juice , rind and sugar in saucepan
8. Boil gently 5 minutes
9. Add cranberries and cook 5 minutes longer
10. Place spoonfuls of cranberry-orange sauce over each patty and continue to bake 5 minutes longer
11. Serve immediately

title: heart shaped cakes  little house
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees f
2. In a mixing bowl , mix flour , sugar , baking soda , and nutmeg
3. With cold fingers , rub the cold lard into the dry ingredients
4. Make a well in the center , add buttermilk , and work with one hand into a dough that can be rolled out
5. Dust rolling surface with flour
6. Shape the dough into a ball and roll it out into an 8 inch circle
7. With a table knife dipped in flour , cut the circle in half , then the halves in thirds , to produce six equal wedges
8. Shape each wedge into a heart
9. Grease baking sheet and place hearts on it so they do not touch
10. Bake for 15 minutes , until cakes are puffy and nicely browned
11. Remove from oven and sprinkle tops immediately with sugar
12. When cool , wrap with blue tissue paper , the traditional wrapping of white sugar crystals , for gift giving

title: rachael ray s chicken shawarma
steps:
1. Preheat an indoor or outdoor grill to high
2. In a bowl , combine the coriander , cumin , cardamom , chili powder , paprika and grill seasoning
3. And the juice of half a lemon , the garlic and about 3 tablespoons evoo and stir until it is paste-like
4. Slather the mixture all over the chicken until it is well-coated
5. Transfer to the grill and cook on each side for 6-7 minutes , until cooked through
6. Remove from the grill and let the chicken rest before thinly slicing
7. Once the chicken is working , preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat with 2 turns of the pan of evoo , about 2 tablespoons
8. Once you see the oil ripple , add the onions and peppers , and season with some salt and pepper
9. Cook , stirring frequently , for about 5 minutes until the veggies start to wilt
10. Once the onions are working make the sauce: in a bowl , combine the juice of the remaining half lemon , the tahini , yogurt , some salt and a small drizzle of evoo
11. Mix to combine
12. Place the pitas on the grill to warm them and give them a light char , about 1 minute on each side
13. To assemble , place some of the sliced chicken on each pita , top with some of the pepper and onion mixture , and a good dollop of the yogurt-tahini sauce

title: egg peeling for egg salad
steps:
1. Place eggs in pan with water and bring to a boil
2. Boil for 12 minutes
3. Fill a medium size bowl with cold water and a trays worth of ice cubes
4. Place eggs in ice water after the 12 min for 2 minutes and keep water in pan boiling or bring back to a boil
5. Gently drop eggs back in boiling water for 30 seconds to 1 minute
6. They are ready to peel i put them back in the ice cold water agian just to cool off for a minute
7. So easy and i do it every time now ! i got this from the joy of cooking cook book
8. Let me know what you think

title: quick new orleans beignets
steps:
1. Flatten and stretch each roll slightly
2. Pour oil to the depth of 2 inches in fry pan
3. Heat to 375f
4. Fry 4 at a time in hot oil for 1 to 2 minutes or until golden , turning often
5. Drain on the paper towels
6. Sprinkle with powdered sugar
7. Serve immediately

title: chicken and papaya stir fry
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , combine the soy sauce with the wine and cornstarch
2. Add the chicken and turn to coat
3. Heat the oil in a wok or large skillet over moderately high heat
4. Add the onion , ginger and garlic and stir-fry for 30 seconds
5. Add the chicken and stir-fry for 5 minutes
6. Add the poblano and crushed red pepper and continue stir-frying until the chicken is cooked through and the poblano softens , about 3 minutes
7. Add the soy sauce and stir-fry for 30 seconds
8. Using a slotted spoon , transfer the chicken to a plate
9. Add the orange juice to the wok and boil until slightly thickened , about 3 minutes
10. Return the chicken to the wok , add the papaya and stir-fry until hot , about 1 minute
11. Add the lemon juice , season with salt and pepper and transfer to a platter
12. Garnish with the scallion and serve

title: sausage and cheese breakfast strudels
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Melt 2 t
3. Butter in a saucepan and blend in flour
4. Cook over medium heat until smooth and bubbly , about 1 minute
5. Gradually add milk and cook until mixture boils and thickens , stirring constantly
6. Boil one minute
7. Add swiss cheese and 2 t
8. Parmesan , salt , cayenne and nutmeg
9. Stir until cheeses are melted and set aside
10. In medium skillet , brown sausage
11. Drain
12. Stir in eggs and thyme and cook over medium heat until eggs are just set
13. Stir in cheese sauce and 1 t
14. Parsley
15. Cool completely
16. Unroll phyllo and cover with plastic wrap or a damp cloth to keep moist
17. Brush one sheet with melted butter and sprinkle with bread crumbs
18. Fold in half lengthwise
19. Brush with butter
20. Place 1 / 2 cup filling on bottom of short side of phyllo , leaving a one inch edge on bottom and sides
21. Roll up
22. Place seam side down on ungreased cookie sheet
23. In a small bowl , combine topping ingredients
24. Brush strudel with melted butter and sprinkle with topping
25. Repeat until all five strudels are made
26. Bake for 15 minutes or until crisp and light brown
27. These can be prepared , covered and refrigerated a day ahead , then baked as directed

title: nut and grain pancakes
steps:
1. Lightly oil a skillet or griddle , and preheat it to medium heat
2. Grind the oats in a blender or food processor until fine , like flour
3. Combine ground oats , whole wheat flour , baking soda , baking powder and salt in a medium bowl
4. In another bowl combine buttermilk , oil , egg and sugar with an electric mixer until smooth
5. Combine dry ingredients with wet ingredients , add nuts and mix well with mixer
6. Ladle 1 / 3 cup of the batter onto the hot skillet and cook the pancakes for 2 to 4 minutes per side or until brown

title: persian rice pilaf
steps:
1. Bring water and salt to a rolling boil in a large saucepan
2. Add cinnamon stick , cloves , cracked peppercorns , cardamom seeds , and juniper berries
3. Add two cups of basmati or other long-grain rice , slowly , so the water doesn't stop boiling
4. Cook for about eight to ten minutes , stirring from time to time to keep the rice from sticking to the bottom , until the rice is just barely done
5. Pour everything into a strainer or colander and let the rice drain
6. Leave the spices in the rice
7. While the rice is boiling , chop the dried fruit
8. Throw the fruit on top of the rice draining in the colander
9. Thinly slice one-half of a large onion and saut it until golden in 5t of unsalted butter with several pinches of saffron or one teaspoon of turmeric
10. While onions are cooking , grease a round casserole with a bit of butter and turn the spiced rice and fruit into a large bowl
11. Turn the golden onions into the bowl and mix everything up
12. Spoon the mixture into the casserole and pat the rice firmly in place with the back of a spoon
13. Drizzle 3 tbsp of melted butter over the top and cover with two thicknesses of aluminum foil and seal the edges well
14. Add a lid if your casserole has one
15. Set the casserole in a preheated 350f oven and let it bake for an hour
16. Then remove it from the oven and let it sit for 15 minutes or so before removing the foil and unmolding it onto a platter
17. Surround with the persian chicken

title: easy vegetable paninis
steps:
1. In a large nonstick skillet , heat the oil over medium heat
2. Add mushroom slices and cook 6-7 minutes or until tender , stirring occasionally
3. Spray one side of 4 slices of bread with nonstick cooking spray
4. Place bread slices , sprayed side down , on work surface
5. Layer each slice of bread with 1 slice cheese and equal portions of mushrooms , onions , spinach and red peppers
6. Sprinkle with salt and pepper , and top with 1 more slice of cheese
7. Spray one side of remaining 4 bread slices with cooking spray , then place sprayed side up over fillings
8. Preheat grill pan over medium heat
9. Cook sandwiches 3-4 minutes per side or until bread is golden brown and cheese melts , weighing them down with a heavy skillet or pressing down with large spatula
10. Cut sandwiches in half diagonally to serve

title: rich and chewy pecan pie muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Place paper liners in 9 muffin cups and spray with nonstick spray
3. In a large bowl , combine the pecans , sugar , flour , and wheat germ
4. Make a well in the center of the mixture
5. In a separate bowl , beat the eggs until foamy
6. Add the melted butter and vanilla , stir to combine
7. Pour the egg mixutre into the well in the dry ingredients , stirring just until moistened
8. Spoon the batter into the cups , filling each two thirds full
9. Bake the muffins 20 minutes , or until a toothpick comes out clean when inserted in a muffin
10. Remove the muffins from the pans immediately and cool on wire racks
11. Enjoy !

title: fruit pizza with orange glaze
steps:
1. Grease a round pizza pan well
2. Slice cookie dough 1 / 4" and cover the pan with dough overlapping
3. Bake as directed
4. Slice the assorted fruit while cookie is baking
5. Allow cookie to cool then spread cream cheese over dough
6. Arrange fruit over cream cheese
7. Glaze: combine orange juice , lemon juice , sugar and corn starch in a sauce pan
8. Cook on low until thickened
9. Once sauce is thickened allow to cool completely before pouring over fruit pizza
10. Refrigerate several hours before serving

title: emerald city  martini
steps:
