1. Mix it all together
2. Shake with ice or serve with ice in- your preference

title: carrot   tuna salad
steps:
1. Put the carrots in a microwave-safe bowl or dish
2. Mix in the onions , garlic , and oil
3. Cover and microwave for 1- 1 1 / 2 minutes at 600 watts
4. Drain the tuna
5. Mix the vinegar , mustard , soy sauce , and salt and pepper to taste to make a dressing
6. Once the carrots are lightly cooked but still crisp , add the tuna and then the dressing and mix well
7. Serve warm or cold
8. She

title: spicy stir fried chicken in hoisin sauce
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl , combine soy sauce , sherry and cornstarch
2. Add the chicken and toss until coated
3. Let chicken stand in marinade for at least 10 minutes
4. In a sprayed+oiled wok or saute pan , heat the vegetable oil over high heat until just smoking
5. Add the scallions and ginger , and stir-fry for about 30 seconds
6. Add the chicken , reserving any remaining marinade , and stir-fry for about 5 minutes , until the chicken is just done
7. Add the vegetables+mushrooms , green peppers and stir-fry for another minute
8. Add the hoisin sauce , sherry , salt and black pepper , and combine
9. Add sesame oil to the marinade remaining in the bowl , stir it , and add to the wok
10. Toss to blend well and boil , then simmer until slightly thickened
11. Taste ? remove from the heat , drizzle with the sesame oil

title: feather dumplings
steps:
1. Sift the dry ingredients together
2. Add the egg , melted butter and enough milk to make a moist , stiff batter
3. Drop by heaping teaspoons into boiling liquid
4. Cover and cook for 18 minutes

title: sloshed strawberries for my valentine
steps:
1. Mix honey , wine and brandy until smooth
2. Pour berries & preserves into blender
3. Whirl for 15 seconds
4. Add wine mixture
5. Whirl again until well-blended
6. Pour into a 13x9 pan
7. Freeze for 3-4 hours
8. Serving suggestion #1: scrape spoons-ful into tall glass , cover with choice of gingerale , sprite or 7-up
9. Stir to mix
10. Add a straw or long-handled spoon
11. Serve
12. Garnish with fresh strawberry on a pick-stick or sliced mid-way & perched on the edge of the glass
13. Serving suggestion #2: scrape spoons-ful into blender jar , add 1 cup gingerale and whirl until smooth , pour into glasses and serve with spoon or straw
14. Garnish with fresh strawberry on a pick-stick or sliced mid-way & perched on the edge of the glass
15. Serving suggestion #3: scrape spoons-ful of the frosty confection into pretty serving dishes
16. Pour 2-3 t
17. Gingerale or white wine over
18. Serve with a spoon--eat slowly to avoid brain-freeze
19. Garnish with fresh strawberry on a pick-stick or sliced in half top to bottom and arranged artfully on the top
20. Variations: other berries work magnificently for this , too , as well as mangos

title: cheesy chicken and artichoke pizza
steps:
1. Heat oven to 450
2. On cookie sheet , place pizza crust
3. In medium bowl , mix mayonnaise , parmesan , artichokes , and garlic , if using
4. Spread artichoke mixture over crust , leaving a 1 inch border
5. Top with 1 cup of the cheese , the chicken and onions
6. Top with remaining 1 / 2 cup cheese
7. Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until cheese is melted and pizza is thoroughly heated

title: spiced applesauce pancakes  dairy free
steps:
1. Preheat a large skillet or griddle to medium heat
2. In a medium mixing bowl , stir together flour , sugar , baking powder , baking soda , salt and spices
3. In another medium mixing bowl , whisk one egg until frothy
4. Then add applesauce , vegetable oil , water and vanilla and whisk until combined
5. Make a well in the center of the dry ingredients and whisk in the wet ingredients all at once
6. Using a 1 / 4 cup sized measuring cup , pour batter onto the hot , greased skillet / griddle over medium heat , leaving enough space between each pancake for them to expand
7. With the bottom of your measuring cup or the back of a spoon , spread out the batter in a circular motion until pancake is an even layer
8. Cook for 2-4 minutes or until surface begins to bubble and edges appear slightly dry
9. Turn and cook for another 2 minutes until golden brown
10. Serve hot with butter and maple syrup

title: twice baked garlic potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Cut off and discard top of garlic
3. Place garlic on piece of foil , drizzle with olive oil and wrap tightly
4. Bake potatoes and garlic for 1 hour
5. Cut potatoes in half lengthwise , scoop out into a bowl and reserve shells
6. Unwrap garlic and squeeze cloves into potatoes
7. Mash potatoes and garlic with butter and enough milk to moisten
8. Blend in cream cheese , parsley , onions and salt
9. Spoon mixture back into potato shells
10. Sprinkle with cheese and paprika
11. Bake until cheese melts , 25 minutes

title: cheddar bay biscuit loaf
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease a 95 loaf pan with oil
3. In a bowl , whisk together the first 5 ingredients
4. Carefully stir in cheese cubes until covered in flour mixture , this will help prevent your cheese sinking to the bottom of your loaf of bread
5. In a different bowl , whisk together the remaining ingredients
6. Fold the wet mixture into the flour and cheese mixture , stir until just combined , do not over stir
7. Spread the mixture into the loaf pan
8. Bake for 45-50 minutes
9. Let cool 10 minutes and then remove from pan
10. Allow to cool for one hour before slicing and serving

title: breaded artichoke hearts
steps:
1. Drain and season artichoke hearts with salt and pepper
2. While working , heat oil over fairly high heat
3. Dredge artichokes in egg and then bread crumbs
4. Deep fry about 3-4 minutes , turning frequently , or until golden
5. Drain on paper towels and serve with lemon wedges

title: crunchy coating happy family fried chicken
steps:
1. Heat oil in large skillet over medium high heat
2. Combine chicken pieces , egg , salt , pepper , and milk in large ziploc bag
3. Shake to combine , and set aside
4. In another large ziplock bag combine cornmeal , flour , italian dressing mix , and cayenne pepper
5. Shake to combine
6. 1-3 pieces at a time , remove chicken pieces from egg mix and place chicken pieces in the cormeal mix and shake to completely cover all chicken pieces
7. Take out coated chicken pieces , put into hot oil , and repeat process 3 at a time until all pieces have been coated
8. Fry chicken pieces turning once each side is browned until chicken is cooked through and juices run clear
9. Drain on paper towels

title: chinese chicken salad with peanut butter dressing
steps:
1. To make dressing: in a blender or food processor , puree the oils , peanut butter , vinegar , lime juice , soy sauce , honey , garlic , ginger , and chili powder
2. To make the salad: cut up chicken into small bite size pieces
3. Mix the ingredients
4. Just before serving , toss the salad with the dressing
5. I use mongolian fire oil and hot chili sesame oil over the top with chopped peanuts
6. Yummmmmmyyyyy !
7. Nutrition per serving: 348 calories
8. 37 g protein
9. 15 g carbohydrates
10. 16 g fat
11. 83 mg cholesterol
12. 4 g fiber
13. 628 mg sodium

title: pave de biscoito maria  layered cookie tart
steps:
1. Hard ladyfingers or graham crackers may be substituted
2. Remove label from condensed milk can
3. Place unopened can in a large saucepan and cover it with water
4. Boil for 1 to 1
5. 5 hours , making sure that the top of the can is always covered with at least a half-inch of water to prevent an explosion
6. Remove can from water with tongs or a strainer and set aside to cool
7. Allow can to come to room temp before opening
8. With a mixer , beat the butter / margarine and sugar until well-mixed
9. Add yolks , one by one , beating well after each addition
10. Add cocoa powder now if you want a chocolate pav
11. Beat in vanilla extract and heavy cream
12. Pour milk or half-and-half in a shallow dish for moistening cookies
13. In a 2-quart glass casserole or 8x8" dish , dip cookies one by one and form a layer to cover the bottome of the casserole
14. Next , spread half of the butter-cream mixture over the cookies
15. Top with another layer of moistened cookies and rest of the butter-cream mixture , ending with a layer of moistened cookies
16. Spread entire can of room-temp dulce de leche over the dessert
17. Sprinkle with roasted peanuts , and decorate with maraschino cherries that have been patted dry
18. Refrigerate for 4 hours or overnite to allow layers to fully blend

title: buttery ritz haddock on the grill
steps:
1. Rinse fish with cold water , pat dry
2. Add parsley , dill , garlic powder and parmesan cheese to ritz cracker crumbs , mix
3. Brush heavy duty foil with some of the melted butter
4. Dip fish into beaten egg , then into crumb mixture
5. Set onto prepared foil
6. Drizzle fish with remaining melted butter
7. Put foil / fish onto medium heat grill , close cover and grill for 4-5 minutes
8. With a spatula , very carefully flip each piece of fish , trying not to break the pieces
9. Continue to cook about another 3-4 minutes , or until white and flakes easily with fork

title: molten spiced chocolate cabernet cakes
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 425 degrees f
2. Butter 4 6oz
3. Custard cups or souffle dishes
4. Place on baking sheet
5. Microwave chocolate and butter in large bowl on high for 1 minute or until butter is melted
6. Whisk until chocolate is completely melted
7. Stir in wine , vanilla , and sugar until blended
8. Whisk in eggs and yolk
9. Stir in remaining ingredients
10. Spoon evenly unto prepared dishes
11. Bake in pre-heated oven for 15 minutes or until sides are firm and centers are soft
12. Let stand 1 minute
13. Loosedn edges with knife
14. Invert onto serving plate
15. Sprinkle with powdered sugar

title: chicken and sausage jambalaya
steps:
1. Pat chicken dry and season with salt
2. Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a 10- to 12-inch heavy skillet over moderately high heat until hot but not smoking , then brown chicken in batches , without crowding , turning once , 6 to 8 minutes total
3. Transfer to a bowl as browned
4. Reduce heat to moderate and brown sausage in 4 batches in fat remaining in skillet , turning , 3 to 4 minutes
5. Transfer to a paper-towel-lined bowl as browned
6. Pour off all but about 1 tablespoon fat from skillet , then cook onions , celery , and bell pepper in skillet over moderate heat , stirring occasionally , until onions are golden brown and softened , about 8 minutes
7. Add garlic and cook , stirring , 1 minute
8. Add 1 cup stock and cook , stirring , 1 minute
9. Transfer mixture to a wide 8-quart heavy pot and add chicken , water , tomatoes , cayenne , and remaining cup stock
10. Simmer , partially covered , until chicken is tender , about 30 minutes
11. Preheat oven to 325f
12. Transfer chicken with tongs to a clean bowl and measure cooking liquid with vegetables , adding additional water as necessary to measure 7 cups
13. If over 7 cups , boil to reduce
14. Stir rice into cooking liquid
15. Arrange chicken over rice , then bring to a boil over high heat , uncovered , without stirring
16. Bake , covered , in middle of oven until rice is tender and most of liquid is absorbed , about 30 minutes
17. Remove from heat and let jambalaya stand , covered , 10 minutes
18. Gently stir in scallion greens , sausage , and salt to taste

title: simply irresistable baked beans
steps:
1. Brown sausage and onion
2. Mix together with beans
3. Add mustard and molasses
4. Spread in a 9 x 13 inch pan
5. Cover beans with sliced apples
6. Sprinkle with brown sugar
7. Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes

title: tomato garlic onion soup
steps:
1. Blanche the garlic for about 30 seconds until slightly soft
2. Cool , peel , and thinly slice
3. Saute onions in oil until they are soft and golden
4. About 10-15 minutes
5. Add garlic , tomatoes and tomato juice to onions
6. Bring to a boil , then reduce and simmer 30 minutes
7. Preheat oven to 450f
8. Add beef broth and bring back to a boil
9. Ladle into oven-proof bowls and top with toast and cheese
10. Put in oven until cheese is melted

title: curried shrimp with brown rice
steps:
1. Coat a large , nonstick skillet with cooking spray and preheat over medium heat
2. Add the shrimp , onion and garlic and cook , stirring frequently , for about 4 minutes or until shrimp turn pink and are thoroughly cooked
3. Add the peas , broth and curry paste , reduce heat to medium
4. Cover and cook for a minute or two or just until the peas are thawed and heated through
5. Add the rice and sesame oil
6. Toss the mixture gently over medium heat for a minute or two or until heated through
7. Add more broth if mixture seems too dry
8. Serve hot

title: garlic spaghetti with pan fried vegetables
steps:
1. Cook the spaghetti in water and some salt , until al dente
2. Set aside
3. In a large shallow pan , add extra virgin oil oil
4. When pan becomes hot , throw in onions and fry till soft
5. When onions are soft , add in potatoes
6. Sprinkle with salt and pepper
7. Cook on shallow pan for about 10 minutes until potatoes are soft , but not completely cooked
8. Add in celery and carrots , followed by rosemary , parsley and oregano flakes
9. Another pinch of pepper
10. Stir-fry on low to medium flame for about 5 minutes
11. Add a spruce of white wine for flare
12. Once potatoes are browned and crunchy on the outside and soft on the inside , add in tomato puree
13. Stir-fry for a further 10 min or until sauce is thick enough for your liking
14. On individual serving plates , place spaghetti on plate
15. Use a fork and whirl spaghetti until it looks pleasantly stacked and visually appealing
16. Top with spaghetti sauce
17. Season & garnish with parsley flakes and oregano flakes
18. Serve warm

title: parmesan roasted sweet potato skins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
2. Prick the sweet potatoes with a fork , then place them on a baking sheet & bake for about 35-45 minutes or until they are tender but not mushy , then remove them from the oven & set them on a wire rack to cool , while increasing the oven temperature to broil
3. In a medium bowl , combine the parmesan cheese , parsley , garlic , oregano , rosemary , salt & ground pepper
4. When potatoes are cool enough to handle , halve them lengthwise & scoop the flesh out of the skins , leaving a shell from 1 / 4-inch to 1 / 2-inch thick
5. Cut each sweet potato shell lengthwise into 1 / 2-inch-wide wedges
6. Add the skins to the herbed parmesan mixture & gently toss to combine
7. Place the sweet potato wedges on a baking sheet & broil from 4 to 5 inches from the heat for 4 to 6 minutes , or until the cheese is melted & bubbly
8. Serve hot & enjoy !

title: scrambled eggs with flavor
steps:
1. In a bowl add eggs , salt , water and beat till whites and yolks are well blended
2. Fold in the chopped cilantro & chillis
3. In a skillet on medium heat add oil & butter till melted-- add the egg mixture , let the eggs cook and keep mixing with a slow movement till egg mixture takes shape , keep folding , lightly stirring till mixture is not runny
4. Switch off the heat
5. The cooked eggs should have a sheen on the surface and should slip off easily from the skillet without sticking
6. Serve with hot toast no need to butter the toast
7. Use it as a filling with a tortilla but you will have to cook the eggs a minute more

title: tgi friday s candy cane beverage
steps:
1. Combine liqueurs , half and half , ice cream , and crushed ice in a blender
2. Blend until smooth
3. Swirl grenadine syrup around the inside of a tall glass
4. Quickly pour the drink into the glass
5. Serve topped with whipped cream and the candy cane which doubles as a drink stirrer
6. A non-alcoholic version of this drink may be made using 1 cup vanilla ice cream , 1 / 2 cup milk , and 5-6 drops peppermint extract

title: raw eggnog
steps:
1. In a glass or ceramic mug , blend the molasses , nutmeg and egg yolk with a fork
2. Pour in a little milk and mix until blended
3. Add remaining milk and stir

title: enlightened caesar salad
steps:
1. Using a food processor or blender , mix together garlic , mustard powder , anchovy pasty , worcestershire sauce , light mayonnaise , olive oil , lemon juice and parmesan cheese together until well blended
2. Season to taste with salt and pepper
3. Serve tossed with romaine lettuce and garnished with freshly grated parmesan cheese

title: jessica s milk and honey bread
steps:
1. Place ingredients in bread machine pan as listed
2. Run bread machine on regular white bread setting
3. Remove from pan as soon as it is done
4. Allow to cool a few minutes before slicing
5. Enjoy !

title: chocolate clusters
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients amd spoon teaspoonfuls into trays lined with non-stick baking paper
2. Allow to set

title: rhubarb ginger compote
steps:
1. Mix the following in a pot: 4 cups of washed , cut up rhubarb , 1 1 / 2 cups sugar , 1 thumb grated fresh ginger and 1 / 2 cup water
2. Heat over medium heat until the mixture starts to boil
3. Turn the heat to medium-low and simmer until the rhubarb disintegrates , and most of the liquid has evaporated
4. Adjust for sugar and / or ginger
5. When mixture is a good sauce-like consistency , pour off into sterilized half pint jars and seal

title: chili rellenos
steps:
1. Separate the eggs , beat the whites until stiff then fold in the yolks , water and flour
2. Remove seeds and clean chilies , then stuff with cheese
3. Spoon a portion of the egg mixture onto a heated frying pan then place a chili on top of the mixture
4. Then add another portion of egg mixture on top of the chili
5. Brown one side then the other

title: honey vanilla challah
steps:
1. In a large bowl , use a whisk to combine the yeast , sugar , salt and 1 cup of the flour
2. Add warm milk , 2 eggs , 4 tbsp olive oil , honey , and vanilla
3. Vigorously mix the ingredients until smooth , scraping the sides of the bowl halfway through , about 3 minutes
4. Add remaining flour , 1 / 2 cup at a time , switching to a wooden spoon when the dough becomes too thick for the whisk
5. Continue mixing the dough until too stiff to stir
6. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface and knead until soft and springy , about 4 minutes
7. If the dough is sticky , dust with flour 1 tablespoon at a time - just enough to prevent it from sticking to the surface
8. The dough is done when its smooth and small air bubbles show under the skin
9. If you press your thumb into it the impression should bounce back
10. This is a slightly firm dough , which is exactly what you want for easy braiding later on
11. Place the dough in a deep container greased with 1 tsp of olive oil
12. Turn the dough once to coat the top and cover with plastic wrap
13. Allow it to rise at room temperature until doubled in bulk , about 1 1 / 2 to 2 hours
14. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper or lightly grease it with non-stick spray
15. Gently deflate the dough by pressing your fingers into it , then turn it out onto a lightly floured surface
16. Divide into 3 equal portions , and roll each portion out into a smooth , thick strip about 20 inches long , with the ends slightly thinner than the middle
17. Lay these ropes side-by-side , not quite touching
18. Beginning in the middle and working towards you , braid the lower half of the three ropes
19. To braid , alternately move the outside ropes over the one in the center - left over , right over , left over -until you come to the end
20. Now go to the other side of your working space and braid the other half , this time moving the outside ropes under the center one
21. Braid tightly - you dont want any gaps
22. When you finish braiding each side crimp the tapered ends together , then tuck them under
23. Preheat oven to 350 f and place the braided dough on a baking sheet
24. Cover loosely with plastic wrap and let rise until almost doubled in bulk , 30 to 40 minutes
25. Just before the rising time has finished whisk together 1 egg and 1 teaspoon of olive oil , this is going to be the glaze for your bread
26. Gently brush the dough with a thick layer of it
27. Place the dough in the oven and bake for 30 to 35 minutes , or until the bread is a deep golden brown and sounds hollow when you thump it on the bottom
28. Transfer to a baking rack to cool
29. Allow to cool before slicing

title: husband s delight   hungarian style
steps:
1. Brown steak in hot oil
2. Add onion and garlic and cook until golden
3. Stir in flour and remaining ingredients
4. Mix thoroughly
5. Turn into greased casserole
6. Bake uncovered at 300 degrees for 1 hour and 30 minutes or until meat is tender stirring a couple times
7. Serve over rice , noodles or mashed potatoes

title: italian chopped salad
steps:
1. Arrange the lettuce on a platter
2. Scatter the scallions , tomatoes , artichokes , bocconcini , haricots verts and roasted red pepper over the lettuce
3. Make the dressing:
4. Whisk together the mustard , agave , anchovies and vinegar
5. Slowly whisk in the olive oil and season to taste with salt and pepper
6. Drizzle the dressing over the salad and serve
7. Dress your salad lightly or to your preference

title: gooey marshmallow brownies
steps:
1. Melt butter on low in saucepan
2. Stir in cocoa and set aside
3. Beat together eggs , sugar , and vanilla
4. Mix in butter and cocoa mixture
5. Mix in flour and salt
6. Pour in a 9x13 baking dish and bake for 30-35 minutes
7. Meanwhile , mix together frosting ingredients , all except the hot water
8. Once the brownies have baked , remove from the oven and cover with mini marshmallows
9. Return to oven until marshmallows have swollen just a little
10. While brownies are in the oven , add enough hot water to the frosting to make it pourable
11. A few tablespoons should be enough
12. Mix until there are no lumps
13. Take brownies from the oven and pour frosting on top
14. You have to do this while the brownies are still very hot or the frosting wont sink inches let brownies cool before cutting
15. Enjoy !

title: cinnamon ginger bars  4 ingredients
steps:
1. Put molasses , butter , sugar& cinnamon / ginger in large saucepan
2. Cook to 300 , or to hard crack stage
3. Pour the mixture into buttered pans
4. Cut into bars , and wrap in waxed paper

title: vegan coconut ice
steps:
1. In blender combine coconut milk and tofu , sugar and vanilla: mix well
2. Test for sweetness and add more sugar if desired
3. Transfer the mixture to the ice cream maker and freeze according to the manufacturer's instructions

title: traditional british bangers
steps:
1. Knead together the pork , veal , fat , and bread
2. Stir the salt , pepper , cayenne , nutmeg , mace , thyme , marjoram , sage , onion powder and lemon peel into the egg , and then knead into the meat mixture
3. Chef's
4. Firmly stuff the mixture into the prepared hog casings
5. Prick any air pockets with a pin
6. Poach , broil , grill , or fry them before serving
7. Serve the bangers , drowned in nice thick onion and mushroom gravy , with a heap of mashed potatoes
8. The raw sausages can be refrigerated for 3 days , cooked sausages for 1 week
9. They can also be frozen for 3 months

title: chicken pepperoni
steps:
1. Cook the chicken breasts , i use a very small amount of water and kind of"steam" them
2. In the same pan add pepperoni , peppers , mushrooms , garlic , onion and salt and pepper let the peppers"steam" a little also
3. When chicken is done cut into bite sized pieces
4. Cook pasta as per instructions on package , we usually use rotini but it's good with any kind add sauce to chicken mixture and heat
5. Serve over the drained pasta
6. Top with cheese

title: spooned up meatloaf
steps:
1. Brown meat in a large skillet
2. Drain off the excess fat
3. Stir in next 8 ingredients
4. Cover and simmer for about 5 minutes , stirring occasionally
5. Stir in the sour cream and eggs
6. Spread the mixture evenly in an oven proof skillet or baking dish and then sprinkle the cheese over the top
7. Set under broiler until cheese turns a lovely color
8. Serve with catsup , if desired

title: darlene s make ahead meatballs  oamc
steps:
1. In a large bowl , beat eggs
2. Add the next five ingredients
3. Add beef
4. Mix well
5. Shape into 1 inch balls , about 12 dozen
6. Place in single layers in ungreased 15in x 10in x 1 in baking pans
7. Bake at 400 degrees for 10-15 minutes or until no longer pink , turning often
8. Drain
9. Cool
10. Place about 30 meatballs into freezer containers
11. May be frozen for up to 3 months

title: southwestern cheesy eggs
steps:
1. Combine flour , salt and butter in a large bowl
2. Add eggs , cottage cheese , chilies and cheese
3. Mix well
4. Pour mixture into a lightly greased 8 x 8 baking dish
5. Bake uncovered at 375 degrees for 30 minutes
6. Allow to sit for 5 minutes before serving

title: warm goat cheese   balsamic onion personal pizzas
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. On a large , dry , metal baking sheet , place your tortillas in a single layer
3. Place on center rack of oven and heat for 5 minutes
4. Remove from heat , flip , and heat again on middle rack for an additional 2 minutes
5. Remove from heat and set aside
6. In the meantime , heat a small non-stick skillet on medium heat
7. Once hot , add the sliced onions
8. Toss with tongs for about 2 minutes , until they begin to soften
9. Add the balsamic vinegar and saut for an additional 1 to 2 minutes
10. Turn off heat
11. Evenly divide sauted onions onto the toasted tortillas
12. Then crumble the goat cheese on top
13. Heat on middle rack of oven for 2 minutes
14. Remove from heat
15. Top with fresh mixed greens or arugula and a crack of freshly ground black pepper and serve !

title: lime cilantro shrimp
steps:
1. Combine shrimp , juice of two limes and chopped cilantro , to taste , and place in air-tight container
2. Shake periodically to coat evenly
3. Refrigerate for four hours or overnight
4. Garnish with lemon and lime wedges
5. Serve with salsa and chips

title: balsamic strawberry salsa
steps:
1. Mix diced tomatoes , strawberries , green onions , and cilantro in a medium bowl
2. In a small bowl , whisk together olive oil , vinegar , and salt
3. Pour over vegetable mixture and toss till evenly coated
4. Cover with lid or plastic wrap and let chill for at least one hour
5. Serve with tortilla chips

title: garlic aioli
steps:
1. Blend egg , pepper , vinegar , garlic and salt together until pale
2. With the blender motor on , add the oil in a thin stream until all has been added and the mixture is pale and creamy
3. Refrigerate a few hours to let flavours intensify

title: memphis style pork ribs
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300 degrees f
2. Mix rub ingredients together well
3. Lay the ribs on a rack in a foil-lined pan , and rub all of the spice mix evenly onto both sides of both rib racks
4. Bake meat-side up for 2 hours , or until each rack droops on both sides when picked up with tongs in the middle
5. Serve with favorite bbq sauce , or dry
6. Hint: can bake ahead , especially if making for a crowd
7. To reheat , bake partially covered with foil for 30 minutes at 250 degrees f

title: double apple bran muffins  cooking light
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Place 12 paper muffin cup liners in muffin cups
3. Set aside
4. Combine brown sugar and butter in a medium bowl
5. Beat with a mixer at medium-high speed until light and fluffy
6. Add egg
7. Beat 1 minute or until well blended
8. Beat in egg white until well blended
9. Add milk , applesauce , molasses , and vanilla extract
10. Beat on low speed until well blended
11. Lightly spoon flour into a dry measuring cup
12. Level with a knife
13. Combine flour , bran , baking powder , salt , and cinnamon in a large bowl
14. Make a well in center of mixture
15. Add milk mixture to flour mixture , stirring just until moist
16. Gently stir in apples
17. Spoon batter evenly into prepared muffin cups
18. Sprinkle evenly with turbinado sugar , if desired
19. Bake at 400 for 18 minutes or until muffins spring back when touched lightly in center

title: everyone s favorite buns
steps:
1. Place milk and 4 tablespoons butter in 2-cup glass measuring cup
2. Microwave on high for 1 1 / 2 minutes
3. Add enough warm water to measure 2 cups
4. Combine sugar , egg and salt in large bowl
5. Mix well
6. Add milk mixture
7. Mix well
8. Stir in yeast
9. Let stand 2 minutes
10. Add 3 cups flour
11. Beat at medium speed , scraping bowl often , until smooth and elastic
12. Add 2 cups flour
13. Mix dough with hook or stir in by hand until smooth
14. Stir in enough remaining flour by hand to make dough easy to handle
15. Place dough into greased bowl
16. Melt remaining 2 tablespoons butter
17. Brush top of dough
18. Reserve remaining melted butter
19. Cover
20. Let rise until double in size
21. Punch down dough
22. Divide in half
23. Shape each half on lightly floured surface into 12 buns
24. Place buns onto two greased jelly-roll pans
25. Brush with reserved melted butter
26. Cover
27. Let rise until double in size
28. Heat oven to 375f bake for 14 to 16 minutes or until golden brown
29. Remove from pan immediately
30. Brush buns with reserved melted butter , if desired

title: german kinder mandarinen bowle  kiddie punch
steps:
1. Place pitted and stemmed cherries into a large clear glass punch bowl
2. Add the mandarin oranges , including their canning juices
3. Pour in the orange juice and the mineral water
4. Add ice cubes and serve immediately

title: whole wheat zucchini muffins
steps:
1. 1 preheat the oven to 350f
2. In a large bowl combine the sugar , eggs , and vanilla
3. Stir in the grated zucchini and then the melted butter
4. In a separate bowl , mix together the flour , baking soda , nutmeg , and cinnamon
5. Stir these dry ingredients into the zucchini mixture
6. Stir in walnuts , raisins or cranberries if using
7. 2 coat each muffin cup in your muffin pan with a little butter or vegetable oil spray
8. Use a spoon to distribute the muffin dough equally among the cups , filling the cups up completely
9. Bake on the middle rack until muffins are golden brown , and the top of the muffins bounce back when you press on them , about 25 to 30 minutes
10. Test with a long toothpick or a thin bamboo skewer to make sure the center of the muffins are done
11. Set on wire rack to cool for 5 minutes
12. Remove muffins from the tin let cool another 20 minutes
13. I got about 14 muffins from this batch , and that included filling the muffin cups up as far as they could possibly go

title: fish with macadamia butter sauce
steps:
1. Heat the olive oil in a pan over medium heat
2. Add the fish fillets and cook 2- 3 minuts each side
3. Transfer to a warmed plate and cover with foil to keep warm
4. Reduce heat to medium low
5. Add the butter and chopped macadamias
6. Cook , stirring , for about a minute- until the butter and nuts are light golden brown
7. Watch carefully as you dont want the butter to burn
8. Remove from the heat
9. Season with salt and pepper
10. Stir in the parsley
11. Serve the fish and spoon over the macadamin and butter sauce
12. Serve with lemon wedges

title: mini bacon egg cheese quiches
steps:
1. Combine the butter and cream cheese
2. Cream until smoothy
3. Add in flour , mix well
4. Form the dough into 30 1 inch balls
5. Put the balls in lightly greased muffin tins
6. Press dough in cups , to form a shell
7. With a fork , pierce bottoms , sides of shells
8. Bake shells at 400 degrees for 5 minutes
9. Let cool
10. Combine the first 8 ingredients
11. Stir mixture well
12. Pour into the ready made shells
13. Bake at 350 , for 20 minutes

title: vegetarian chili  low gi
steps:
1. Put burghul in a small-medium bowl then add 250ml hot water
2. Leave to soak for 10 minutes
3. While burghul is soaking heat oil in a large saucepan and cook onion over med-low heat for 10 minutes , until soft and golden
4. Stir often
5. Add garlic and spices and cook , stirring for 1 minute
6. Mix in the burghul , stock and tomatoes
7. Bring to the boil and simmer for 10 minutes
8. Stir in the beans , chickpeas , corn and tomato paste then simmer for 20 minutes
9. Stir often
10. Garnish with parsley
11. You can also top with a little low-fat natural yoghurt and grated low-fat cheese

title: asparagus  snap pea and avocado salad
steps:
1. In a large pot of boiling salted water , cook asparagus until bright green , about 2 minutes
2. Add snap peas
3. Cook 30 seconds
4. With a slotted spoon or a small sieve , scoop out vegetables
5. Transfer to a bowl
6. Return water to a boil
7. Add pasta and cook until al dente , according to package directions
8. Drain
9. Reserving 1 cup pasta water
10. Set pasta aside in colander
11. In pasta pot , melt 2 tablespoons butter over medium heat
12. Add asparagus , snap peas and garlic
13. Season with salt and pepper
14. Cook , tossing until vegetables are crisp-tender
15. About 2 minutes
16. Add remaining 2 tablespoons butter , cooked pasta , avocado , herbs , cheese , and reserved pasta water
17. Toss to combine
18. Season with salt and pepper
19. Serve topped with additional cheese
20. If desired

title: salade au chevre  goat cheese salad
steps:
1. Preheat broiler to hot
2. Put walnuts in a bowl and cover with boiling water
3. Let stand 1 minute , drain and shake dry
4. Toast under broiler 3-4 minutes until golden
5. Sprinkle with sea salt , toss and cool
6. Put the baguette slices under broiler and toast one side until lightly golden
7. Remove and rub toasted side with cut garlic
8. Allow to cool a few minutes and turn over and place chevre slices on untoasted side
9. Broil 2 minutes , or until chevre browns slightly
10. For the dressing , mix oils , vinegar and garlic together and season with salt and pepper
11. Toss the mesclun , onion , and toasted walnuts together
12. Place on a large platter and top with chevre croutons
13. Drizzle with the dressing
14. Serve while croutons are still warm

title: winnie s cheese cookies
steps:
1. Mix butter and cheese together well with mixer
2. Add tabasco and worcestershire sauce
3. Slowly add flour
4. When mixed , add rice crispies
5. Roll into small balls
6. Place on ungreased cookie sheet
7. Flatten with fork
8. Bake at 325f for 25 minutes
9. They should look lightly brown , but may still be soft until they cool
10. Cool on baking rack
11. These freeze well

title: greek grilled ribeye steaks
steps:
1. Combine salt , pepper , and oregano in a small bowl
2. Whisk together the oil and wine and add to spices
3. Rub steaks on both sides with the mixture and place in a single layer in a shallow pan
4. Cover and marinate for at least one hour before cooking
5. Mix 3 tablespoons of olive oil with the lemon juice or zest and brush the steaks just before cooking
6. Grill to taste over hot coals or medium heat on a gas grill and brush with oil and lemon mixture a couple of times while cooking
7. Serve with lemon wedges on the side

title: baguettes  whole wheat
steps:
1. Dissolve yeast and sugar in warm water in a large bowl , let stand 5 minutes
2. Add 3 1 / 2 cups of the bread flour , wheat flour , semolina and salt to yeast mixture
3. Stir with a whisk until well blended
4. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface
5. Knead until smooth and elastic
6. Add enough of remaining bread flour 1 tablespoon at a time , to prevent douogh from sticking to hands dough will feel tacky
7. Place dough in a large bowl coated with cooking spray , turning to coat top
8. Cover and let rise in a warm place , free from drafts , 45 minutes or until doubled in size
9. Punch dough down , cover and let rest 5 minutes
10. Divide into thirds
11. Working with one portion at a time , roll each portion into a 16-inch rope on a floured surface
12. Place ropes on a large baking sheet sprinkled with cornmeal
13. Cover and let rise 40 minutes or until ropes are doubled in size
14. Uncover dough
15. Cut 3 slits in top of each rope
16. Preheat oven to 425f
17. Throw water onto floor of oven
18. Place baking sheet in oven
19. Quickly close oven door
20. Bate at 425f for 30 minutes or until loaves are golden brown and sound hollow when tapped
21. Remove from pan , and cool on wire racks
22. Cut each loaf into 12 slices

title: beet   onion pizza w goat cheese
steps:
1. 1
2. In a sauce pan or skillet , melt the butter and then saute the garlic until slightly brown
3. 2
4. Reduce to low heat and add beets and onions
5. Cook until onions become soft , stirring regularly
6. 3
7. Remove the beets & onions from the pain with a slotted spoon , leaving the leftover butter in the pan
8. 4
9. Prepare your pizza dough on a floured surface , stretching it very thin , then transfer to a pizza peel dusted lightly with semolina flour
10. 5
11. Spread the leftover butter & garlic mixture across the top of the pizza dough using the back of a spoon to spread it around
12. 6
13. Take small chunks of the goat cheese and scatter them evenly around the pizza
14. 7
15. Place the beets & onions evenly around the pizza
16. 8
17. Top with shredded fontina or parmesan cheese
18. 9
19. Bake in a pizza oven , or in a regular oven heated to 500 until the crust is browned and the cheese is bubbly

title: cabbage skillet hasty tasty
steps:
1. In a heavy skillet , stir the meat until browned
2. Add remaining ingredients and bring to a boil
3. Reduce heat to very low , cover the skillet and simmer for about 45 minutes or until rice is tender , stirring once or twice to keep from sticking
4. Serve with green salad and whole wheat rolls
5. Have dinner on the table in less than an hour

title: tangy carolina bbq sauce
steps:
1. Sautee onions in butter until tender , about 5 minutes
2. Add spices and stir
3. Add all other ingredients
4. Bring to a soft boil , then turn down heat and simmer for 20 minutes
5. Serve warm or cool

title: vanilla pikelets with banana   maple yoghurt
steps:
1. Combine yoghurt & 2 tblsp maple syrup , chill until required
2. Sift flour & baking powder into a bowl , add combined yoghurt drink & egg , whisking until just combined
3. Heat a frypan , spray with cooking spray
4. Cook tablespoon measuresd of the mixture in several batches for 1-2 mins each side , keep warm
5. Combine extra maple syrup with cinnamon and spread over bananas which have been sliced lengthways then crossways
6. Cook bananas for 1-2 mins until brown on both sides
7. Serve bananas on top of pikelets drizzled with maple yoghurt & any remaining cinnamon syrup

title: hawaiian tacos
steps:
1. Marinade: place chopped chicken breast pieces in a quart size plastic bag
2. Mix marinade ingredients and pour over chicken , seal bag and squish around to distribute marinade
3. Place in the refridgerator for at least 6 hours or overnight
4. After chicken has marinated , make the pineapple salsa: dice all of the salsa ingredients and gently fold them together until mixed
5. You can use all pineapple or a combination of pineapple , kiwi , mangos , and mandarine orange segments
6. Sprinkle with the lime juice and season with salt and pepper
7. To cook chicken: preheat a large saute pan over medium heat
8. Add the chicken and marinade to the pan being careful of the rising steam and cook until the chicken is cooked through , stirring occasionally
9. Turn up the heat to high and cook until the liquid evaporates and the chicken just begins to char - make sure to keep your eyes on it at this point as it can burn quickly - remove the pan from the heat
10. Let your family build their own tacos using the tortillas , chicken , shredded cheese , chopped green chiles , sour cream , salsa , and pineapple salsa

title: bloody marys by ree drummond
steps:
1. Fill 2 mason jars with ice
2. Divide the vodka between the jars and squeeze in the lime juice
3. Add a few sprinkles of steak seasoning , 2 or 3 dashes of worcestershire sauce and a dash of cayenne pepper to each
4. Divide the tomato juice between the jars and add a dash each of salt and pepper to each jar
5. Use a celery stick to push a squeezed lime half into the bottom of each jar , then stir everything around with the celery

title: slow cooker beef burritos
steps:
1. Trim fat from meat
2. Rub seasoning mix over both sides of meat
3. Place meat in an electric slow cooker coated with cooking spray
4. Add onion , garlic vinegar , and green chiles
5. Cover with lid
6. Cook on low-heat setting for 9 hours
7. Remove meat from slow cooker , reserving cooking liquid
8. Shred meat with two forks
9. Combine meat and reserved cooking liquid
10. Stir well
11. Warm beans and tortillas according to package directions
12. Spread 2 tablespoons beans down the center of each tortilla
13. Spoon a heaping 1 / 3 cup meat mixture on top of beans
14. Top each with 2 tablespoons cheese , 2 tablespoons tomato , and 1 tablespoon sour cream
15. Roll up
16. I serve with additional salsa , chopped lettuces , cilantro and chopped green onions to garnish

title: zucchini heaven casserole
steps:
1. Rinse zucchini and squash , slice lengthwise and quarter
2. Boil in salted water until just tender
3. Drain and set aside
4. In large nonstick skillet , saut chopped onion , green pepper , and mushrooms in butter until tender
5. Add diced tomatoes , flour and sugar
6. Cook and stir about 3 minutes until slightly thickened
7. Coat a 9 x 13-inch pan with cooking spray
8. Add zucchini and squash
9. Top with vegetable mixture
10. Top with cheese
11. Top with enough bread crumbs to cover with a medium thickness
12. Dot with butter
13. Bake at 350f until bubbly and golden brown

title: steak sandwiches with tarragon mayonnaise
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine the mayonnaise , tarragon , lemon juice and salt and mix well
2. Layer the bread with lettuce and steak and drizzle with the tarragon mayonnaise
3. Serve open-faced sandwiches

title: libby s mulberry rhubarb jam
steps:
1. Cook mulberries , rhubarb , and sugar together for 15 minutes in a large saucepan
2. Add lemon jell-o and bring just to a boil
3. Pour into jelly jars and process in a hot water bath until sealed or freeze in freezer containers

title: 4 cheese baked macaroni   italian style
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 375
2. Mix first 4 ingredients with a pinch of salt and pepper in a bowl
3. Set aside
4. Cook pasta al dente , drain and rinse under cold water
5. Set pasta aside
6. Heat 4 tablespoons of the butter , add onions and saute , stirring until onions are translucent
7. Add garlic , stir until garlic is fragrant
8. Add flour
9. Lower heat and cook , stirring frequently
10. Add half and half a 1 / 2 cup at a time , stirring after each addition , until sauce thickens
11. Stir in the cheeses , saving 1 cup of the fontina
12. Simmer until cheese is melted and sauce is creamy
13. Taste and adjust salt and pepper
14. Add cayenne
15. Use cooking spray to coat casserole- you should need about a 3 qt size
16. Place pasta in casserole
17. Top with sauce , stir to distribute evenly
18. Place reserved fontina on top
19. Sprinkle bread crumbs
20. Dot with remaining butter
21. Bake 40 minutes , until top is brown and it's bubbly

title: french influenced braised beef short ribs
steps:
1. Season ribs with salt and pepper
2. Heat 2 tbs
3. Oil in large dutch oven or braiser over medium high heat , add short ribs and brown as evenly as possible
4. Do in batches
5. Remove ribs and set aside
6. Reduce heat to medium and add onions , carrots , celery , garlic and cook until tender
7. Add tomato paste , beef broth , red wine and cook , stirring , until incorporated , add ribs and bay leaves , reduce to a simmer , cover and cook over low heat for 3 - 3 1 / 2 hours or until meat easily falls off the bone
8. Remove from heat and let sit for about 15 minutes for fat to rise to the top , skim off any fat with a ladle
9. If sauce isn't thick enough remove ribs and add water / cornstarch mixture and bring to a boil , stir to thicken
10. Serve ribs over egg noodles and top with sauce
11. Garnish with scallions

title: andrew weil s shiitake teriyaki
steps:
1. Reconstitute 1 cup dried shiitake by covering with hot water and let stand till caps are completely soft
2. Cut off and discard stems
3. Squeeze excess liquid from caps and slice into 1 / 4 inch pieces
4. Place pieces in saucepan with 1 / 4 cup sake , 1 / 4 cup soy , and 2 tbsp light brown sugar
5. Bring to boil and simmer , uncovered , till liquid is almost evaporated , tossing mushrooms occasionally
6. Remove from heat , cool , and chill
7. Sprinkle with finely chopped green onions and a few drops of dark sesame oil
8. Serve as appetizer , side dish , or over rice

title: chocolate french toast sandwich
steps:
1. Prepare a 13x9" baking pan
2. In a bowl , beat eggs , milk , sugar , vanilla and salt
3. Pour half of the egg / milk mixture into an ungreased 13x9" pan
4. Arrange 6 slices of bread in a single layer over egg mixture
5. Place 1 piece of chocolate in the center of each piece of bread
6. Top with remaining bread
7. Pour remaining egg mxture over all
8. Let stand for 5 minutes
9. In a large skillet , melt the butter over medium heat
10. Fry sandwiches until golden brown on both sides
11. Remove from frypan and dust with icing sugar
12. Cut sandwiches diagonally
13. Serve warm

title: mushroom cheeseburgers
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , combine beef , mushrooms , onion , oregano , salt , and pepper
2. Mix well
3. Shape into four patties
4. Grill burgers , over medium-hot grill for 5-6 minutes on each side or until desired doneness
5. Top each burger with a slice of cheese
6. Serve on buns with desired accompaniments

title: tafelspitz  boiled beef austrian style
steps:
1. Put beef and bones into a soup pot and add water to cover
2. Add salt , peppercorns and cleaned vegetables
3. Bring to a boil , lower heat and simmer about 3 hours or until beef is tender , but not falling apart
4. Strain the bouillon and season to taste with salt , white pepper and nutmeg
5. Save and serve as first course
6. Slice beef and vegetables and serve with plain horseradish , apple-horseradish sauce or chive sauce
7. To make the chive sauce , soak bread crumbs in cold water then squeeze dry
8. Combine bread crumbs and egg yolks in cuisinart
9. Add olive oil a little at a time
10. Season with salt , pepper , sugar and vinegar
11. Add chives and mix well

title: angel hair pasta with basil   tomatoes
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to package directions
2. Drain and keep warm
3. Meanwhile , spray 10-inch nonstick skillet with no-stick cooking spray
4. Add garlic
5. Cook over medium heat 1 minute
6. Add tomatoes and basil
7. Continue cooking , stirring occasionally , until heated through
8. Toss together hot pasta , tomato mixture and light butter in large serving bowl
9. Sprinkle with cheese

title: the best peanut butter cookies
steps:
1. Set oven to 350
2. In a mixing bowl , cream peanut butter , shortening and brown sugar
3. Add egg
4. Mix well
5. Stir in milk and vanilla
6. Combine flour , baking soda and salt
7. Gradually add to the creamed mixture
8. Stir in the chips
9. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls onto ungreased baking sheets
10. Bake for 7-9 minutes or until golden brown

title: awesome blueberry muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
2. Grease muffin cups or line with muffin liners
3. Combine 1 1 / 2 cups flour , 3 / 4 cup sugar , salt and baking powder
4. Place vegetable oil into a 1 cup measuring cup
5. Add the egg and enough milk to fill the cup
6. Mix this with flour mixture
7. Fold in blueberries
8. Fill muffin cups right to the top , and sprinkle with crumb topping mixture
9. To make crumb topping: mix together 1 / 2 cup sugar , 1 / 3 cup flour , 1 / 4 cup butter , and 1 1 / 2 teaspoons cinnamon
10. Mix with fork , and sprinkle over muffins before baking
11. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes in the preheated oven , or until done

title: decadent mashed potatoes
steps:
1. Place cut potatoes in a 6-quart saucepan and cover with cold water
2. Add 1 teaspoon sea salt , cover and bring to a simmer
3. Cook for 20 minutes
4. Meanwhile , in a small saucepan over low heat , melt butter with cream , 1 tablespoon sea salt , and a pinch of white pepper
5. When potatoes are cooked thoroughly , drain in a colander
6. While still hot , pass potatoes through a food mill with a medium sieve attachment , or through a potato ricer , and put back into the pot in which they were cooked
7. Slowly pour the warm butter-cream mixture into the potatoes
8. Incorporate gently with a wooden spoon
9. Taste and adjust seasoning
10. Garnish with fresh chives or basil
11. Serve immediately

title: stuffed fish  middle eastern  palestine
steps:
1. Clean the fish , and let soak in vinegar and salt for 10 minutes
2. Use the lemon juice , oil , paprika , salt , pepper , and cumin and coat the fish inside and out
3. Brown the pine nuts and set aside
4. Mix the chopped parsley , garlic , tomato , and onion and add with the pine nuts
5. Add olive oil , salt , pepper , and lemon juice , and mix in the pine nuts
6. Place fish on aluminum foil
7. Stuff the fish and close with a needle and thread or any other way you use to close your fish
8. Make light cuts on the top of the fish and take any of the lemon juice , oil , and spices the fish was sitting in that is left and pour on top of the fish
9. Wrap the fish in the aluminum foil to prevent it from drying out and bake at 450 degrees for about 30 to 40 minutes
10. If preferred , take the fish out of the foil when it is finished and put it under the broiler to brown it
11. Enjoy =)

title: queso de cabra con tomate  goat cheese baked in tomato sauce
steps:
1. Preheat conventional oven or toaster oven to 350f
2. Mix together the garlic and olive oil and spread over bread slices and place on a baking sheet
3. Pat the goat cheese into a 1 / 2-inch pancake and place in shallow baking dish
4. Ladle tomato sauce into dish to come up to top edge of cheese
5. Bake , uncovered , until sauce begins to bubble at edges and cheese is hot , about 25 minutes
6. During last 10 minutes of baking , toast bread until golden brown
7. Garnish cheese with basil if using

title: creamy pork chops  mushroom and potato casserole
steps:
1. Het oven to 325 degrees
2. Butter a 13 x 9-inch baking dish
3. Heat oil with butter in a skillet
4. Season the chops with seasoned salt and black pepper , add to the skillet and lightly brown on both sides
5. Remove to a plate and set aside
6. To the same skillet add in onion , garlic , celery and mushroom pieces
7. Saute for about 3 minutes
8. Remove from heat
9. Arrange the potato slices in the buttered baking dish , then top with the onion / celery mixture
10. In a bowl combine the mushroom soup with sour cream , milk and parmesan cheese , 1 cup grated old cheddar cheese , 1 teaspoon seasoned salt and black pepper to taste
11. Spoon the soup mixture over the potatoes and onions
12. Arrange the browned chops on top
13. Cover with foil and bake about 1-3 / 4 to 2 hours or until the chops and potatoes are tender
14. Remove from oven and sprinkle with about 1 cup grated old cheddar cheese , then return to oven uncovered for another 8-10 minutes
15. Let stand about 10 minutes before serving

title: broccoli cauliflower mac and cheese
steps:
1. Steam broccoli and cauliflower until just tender
2. Preheat oven to 375 degrees and grease a 3 quart baking dish
3. Cook pasta 2 minutes less than package directions
4. While pasta cooks , in a medium saucepan over medium heat , melt butter
5. Ass flour and shallot , and cook 2 minutes , stirring frequently
6. In a slow stream , add milk , whisking constantly
7. Increase heat to medium-high and bring to simmer
8. Cook for 2-4 minutes until thickened
9. Off heat , add salt and cheeses , stirring until cheese is just melted
10. Combine pasta with cheese sauce , broccoli and cauliflower , and pour the mixture into a baking dish
11. Bake until sizzling and lightly browned on top , about 20 minutes
12. Let stand at least 5 minutes before serving

title: pina colada tamales
steps:
1. Use a food processor to finely chop the dried banana
2. Combine the banana , almonds and coconut in a bowl
3. Use 2 husks to make strips for tying the tamales
4. Take about 1 cup of the pineapple and puree it with the fruit juice and brown sugar
5. Cream the shortening and sugar
6. In a separate bowl , mix together the masa and salt
7. Alternately add the masa and juice to the creamed shortening to make a firm dough
8. Beat in the baking powder last
9. Assembly: spread 1 tablespoon filling in the center of a husk
10. Sprinkle 1 to 2 teaspoons of the banana / almond mixture over the dough and press a pineapple chunk into the dough
11. Spread another tablespoon of the dough over the the filling and fold and tie the tamale
12. Steam for about 1 hour 15 minutes
13. To serve: open the tamale and top with sauce , whipped cream , and lime zest

title: vegan oatmeal pancakes
steps:
1. Grind oats using a blender into a flour
2. Take the oat flour and put it in a bowl , mix in the cinnamon , baking powder , salt , and sugar
3. Then add the water
4. Now is the time to add in extras like extracts
5. Mix until well combined , lumps are ok
6. If your using any kind of fruit gently fold in ,
7. Heat a griddle and spoon out some of the mixture , let cook until bubbles appear and pop at the surface and it will lift without falling apart
8. Gently flip and let throughly cook through about 1-2 minutes
9. Keep warm
10. Yummy !

title: georgia hash
steps:
1. In electric frying pan or large skillet saute onions and peppers until onions soften
2. Add corned beef
3. Continue to cook until cubes fall apart
4. Add frozen hash browns
5. Add seasoning if desired
6. Cook , stirring often until potatoes are done and start to brown

title: superfantabulious strawberry cheesecake dip
steps:
1. Process cream cheese , strawberries , sugar , sour cream , liqueur and vanilla in a blender or food processor until very smooth
2. Pour into bowl
3. Cover and chill 2 hours before serving

title: simple tex mex rice
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a medium-sized saucepan
2. Heat over medium-high heat until water begins to boil
3. Cover saucepan with tight fitting lid , and reduce heat to low
4. Cook over low heat for 15 minutes without removing lid or stirring
5. After 15 minutes , remove lid and fluff rice with a fork
6. ~
7. I use penzey's "bold taco seasoning"

title: chickpea tuna salad
steps:
1. Throw all ingredients into a food processor and blend until smooth
2. Serve on toast , pita bread , as a tortilla wrap or on crackers

title: curried chicken or tofu
steps:
1. Sprinkle the chicken or tofu with the lime juice and set aside
2. Heat the oil in a large skillet
3. Add the onions , garlic , and ginger
4. Cook over medium heat , stirring often , until the onions are translucent , about 5 minutes
5. Do not brown
6. Add the curry powder , stir well , and continue to saut the mixture for 3 more minutes , stirring frequently
7. Add the tomatoes and juice
8. Stir , cover , and let simmer for 15 minutes , stirring occasionally
9. Uncover the skillet and add the chicken or tofu
10. Stir well and cook over medium heat for 10 to 15 minutes or until the chicken is thoroughly cooked
11. If youre using tofu , 3 to 5 minutes should be enough cooking time
12. Serve immediately

title: lime yogurt cake
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
2. Grease an 8 1 / 2 by 4 1 / 4 by 2 1 / 2-inch loaf pan
3. Sift together the flour , baking powder , and salt into 1 bowl
4. In another bowl , whisk together the yogurt , 1 cup sugar , the eggs , lime zest , and vanilla
5. Slowly whisk the dry ingredients into the wet ingredients
6. With a rubber spatula , fold the vegetable oil into the batter , making sure its all incorporated
7. Pour the batter into the prepared pan and bake for about 50 minutes , or until a cake tester placed in the center of the loaf comes out clean
8. Meanwhile , cook the 1 / 3 cup lime juice and remaining 1 / 3 cup sugar in a small pan until the sugar dissolves and the mixture is clear
9. Set aside
10. When the cake is done , allow it to cool in the pan for 10 minutes
11. Carefully place on a baking rack over a sheet pan
12. While the cake is still warm , pour the lime-sugar mixture over the cake and allow it to soak inches cool
13. For the glaze , combine the powdered sugar and lemon juice and pour over the cake when completely cooled

title: amazing veggie burgers
steps:
1. Drain beans , then rinse with cold water
2. Drain well , then pat dry with paper towels
3. Place in a food processor fitted with a metal blade
4. Add onion , garlic , egg , 2 tbsp of the barbecue sauce , worcestershire , oil , salt and pepper
5. Pulse just until beans are about the size of peas
6. Dont pure
7. Turn into a large bowl
8. 2
9. Stir in flour with a spatula until evenly mixed
10. Sprinkle with bread crumbs
11. Stir inches mixture will be very thick
12. Scatter with cheese and work in with your hands
13. Divide mixture into 6 portions
14. Using well-floured hands , shape into burgers , about 1 / 2 in thick
15. If making ahead , refrigerate in a sealed container up to 1 day or freeze
16. 3
17. Cook burgers in a well-oiled frying pan over medium heat for 5 minutes , or until browned on the bottom
18. Turn over and spoon the remaining barbecue sauce on top
19. Cover and continue cooking until heated through , about 5 minutes more

title: cranberry orange muffins   diabetic friendly
steps:
1. Combine cranberries and sugar while sifting dry ingredients together -- then add and stir into dry ingredients
2. Combine egg , juice and oil and grated peel and add to dry ingredients until just moistened
3. Pour batter into 12 muffin cups , lightly sprayed or into paper muffin liners
4. Bake muffins at 375 degs for 25"
5. Bake loaf at 350 degs for 50"

title: tuna broccoli casserole
steps:
1. Boil water and cook pasta
2. When pasta is almost done , add in broccoli and cook until both are soft
3. Drain
4. Put back into pot , add in tuna , soup , and cream cheese
5. Stir until cream cheese is melted , on medium heat
6. Serve immediately

title: virtually fat free zucchini bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Spray a small loaf pan with nonstick cooking spray
3. In a large bowl , combine flour , sugar , baking soda , baking powder , salt , cinnamon and nutmeg
4. In another small bowl , combine the liquid egg product , applesauce and zucchini
5. Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and using an electric mixer , mix until well blended
6. Pour mixture into loaf pan and spread evenly- can sprinkle a little sugar and cinnamon on top if desired
7. Bake 45-50 minutes , or until a toothpick comes out clean

title: barbara s chinese noodle salad
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to package directions
2. Drain and cool
3. In a small bowl , combine liquids thoroughly with the sugar
4. Whisk thoroughly until the sugar is dissolved
5. Add sauce to cooked noodles and mix with hands until they are evenly coated
6. I refrigerate the salad for a few hours and mix periodically to allow the sauce to absorb into the noodles
7. Before serving , add sesame seeds , carrots and green onions
8. Toss and serve

title: pizza tomato sauce
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees f
2. In 2 pans place tomato halves cut side up
3. Sprinkle with oil , salt and pepper , onion , garlic , and herbs
4. Bake tomatoes for 2 hours
5. Check the tomatoes after 1 hour and turn down the heat if they seem to be cooking too quickly
6. Then turn the oven to 400 degrees and bake another 30 minutes
7. Remove from the oven and process tomatoes through a food mill using a medium dye over a small saucepan
8. Discard skins
9. Add wine , bring to a boil , reduce heat to low and cook for 5 minutes

title: easy bruschetta chicken
steps:
1. Pour 4 tablespoons of the dressing over chicken in resealable plastic bag and seal
2. Turn bag over several times to evenly coat chicken with dressing
3. Refrigerate 10 minutes to marinate
4. While chicken is marinating , combine tomatoes , cheese , basil and remaining 2 tablespoons of dressing
5. Remove chicken from marinade bag and place in baking dish
6. Bake at 350 degrees for 10 minutes
7. Spoon tomato mixture over chicken breasts and bake an additional ten minutes

title: apricot dressing
steps:
1. Whisk together all ingredients until well combined
2. Refrigerate until required

title: crisp garlic yukon gold potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400f brush a baking sheet with 1 tablespoon of the oil and sprinkle with salt and pepper
2. Arrange the gold potatoes on the baking sheet , cut side down , and bake for 45 minutes , or until crisp and golden brown
3. Transfer the potatoes to a bowl
4. Heat the remaining 3 tablespoons of oil in a large skillet
5. Add the garlic and cook over moderately low heat , stirring , until crisp and lightly browned
6. Do not let the garlic get too brown or it will be bitter
7. Pour the garlic and oil over the potatoes , add the parsley and toss
8. Season with salt and pepper and serve at once

title: nairobi meat  rub
steps:
1. Combine salt , black pepper , red pepper , sugar , and ginger , garlic powder , and onion powder
2. Put into a storage container for barbecues
3. Rub this mixture into the fatty parts of the ribs , pork , or skins of chickens with the fingers
4. Cook meat over grill until done
5. Meats should never be basted with sauces , or oil
6. If your meat appears to be dry , keep a light salad oil ready to brush on during cooking

title: southwestern sweet potatoes and black beans
steps:
1. Scrub and dry sweet potatoes
2. Prick each potato with a fork in several places
3. Wrap in foil and bake in a 375 degree oven for 50-60 minutes or until tender all the way through
4. Meanwhile , in a small sauce pan , saute onion in olive oil until clear
5. Add black beans , rotel , cumin , paprika , coriander , salt and red pepper flakes
6. Simmer bean mixture on medium heat for about 15 minutes
7. Remove potatoes from oven , unwrap and slice potatoes lengthwise , making several cuts
8. Then slice crosswise , making a cross-hatch pattern , opening up the potato
9. Spoon half of the bean mixture onto each potato
10. Top each potato with a 1-2 tablespoons of sour cream and sprinkle with cilantro or chives , if desired

title: top secret recipes version of p f  chang s mai tai bytodd wilbur
steps:
1. Fill a 16-ounce glass with ice
2. Add the light rum , triple sec , orgeat , orange juice , and pineapple juice
3. Then give the drink a quick stir
4. Splash the 151 and dark rum on top
5. Do not stir
6. Make a small cut in the pineapple wedge , then stick a toothpick into the pineapple wedge on the opposite edge
7. Pierce a maraschino cherry onto the toothpick
8. Slip the pineapple slice onto the rim of the glass
9. Add a straw and serve

title: brown sugared turkey bacon
steps:
1. Arrange bacon in a single layer in an aluminum foil-lined broiler pan coated with cooking spray
2. Sprinkle evenly with brown sugar and pepper
3. Bake at 425 for 14 to 18 minutes or until done
4. Serve immediately

title: award winning cherry coffee cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Butter an 11x15 inch jelly roll pan
3. In a lrg bowl , beat sugar , butter , shortening , baking powder , vanilla extract , almond extract & eggs on low until incorporated
4. Then on high for 3 minutes
5. Stir in flour
6. Spread 2 / 3 of batter in pan
7. Spread pie filling evenly over batter
8. Drop the remaining batter evenly in dollops over pie filling
9. Bake till toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
10. Drizzle w / glaze while still warm

title: dead by xmas
steps:
1. Build in a short glass over ice
2. Stir
3. Enjoy

title: cheesecake bites
steps:
1. Mix brown sugar , flour , and nuts
2. Stir in margarine until blended
3. Reserve 1 / 3 cup of mixture
4. Pat remainder in a greased 8-inch square baking pan
5. Bake in a pre-heated 350 degree oven fo 12-15 minutes
6. Beat cream cheese and sugar until smooth
7. Beat in remaining ingredients
8. Pour over baked crust
9. Sprinkle with reserved pecan mixture
10. Return to oven and bake 25 minutes
11. Cool slightly
12. Then cut in two-inch squares

title: mushroom orzo pilaf
steps:
1. Melt 3 tbsp butter in large skillet , add shallots , garlic , 3 tsp thyme , and saute add mushrooms , saute 8 minutes until softened
2. Add remaining butter , orzo , broth , nutmeg , salt and pepper to taste , heat to boil lower to simmer , cover and cook 15 minutes until liquid is absorbed
3. Stir in remaining thyme

title: low fat berry good smoothie
steps:
1. Combine the kefir , grape juice , honey and banana in a blender
2. Add the berries and blend until smooth
3. Strain or put through sieve {
4. I eliminate the blackberries

title: fabulous chicken
steps:
1. In a large non-stick frying pan , heat oil and cook onions until almost soft
2. Add garlic and mushrooms , cook til mushrooms soften
3. Set aside and keep warm
4. Chop chicken into bite sized pieces brown chicken in hot pan , adding more oil if required
5. Add onion , garlic and mushroom mixture back to pan
6. Stir in chicken broth and italian herbs
7. Cover and cook for 20 minutes , simmering over low heat
8. Add sour cream , thickened cream and bacon , stir through until warmed , do not boil as it will separate
9. Just heat it gently for a few minutes until the flavours blend
10. For a change , add broccoli pieces in the last few minutes of cooking , or green beans , corn niblets -- serve over pasta if you like or as a dish on it's own
11. A definite favourite at my house !

title: ham  mushroom and cheese omelette
steps:
1. Beat eggs , add mushrooms and ham
2. Heat frying pan , and coat with cooking spray or oil
3. Add egg mixture to hot pan and cook until almost set
4. Flip over and when egg is set , top with cheese
5. Cook until cheese is melted
6. Serve with hashbrowns , toast , or rice
7. Sometimes i even add chopped green onion , or any color pepper we have on hand

title: pizza pasta pie
steps:
1. In a bowl , beat 1 egg , stir in spaghetti , 2 tablespoons parmesan , and butter
2. Spread onto the bottom and up the sides of a greased 9 inch pie plate
3. Spread spinach over top
4. In a bowl , beat remaining egg
5. Stir in ricotta and remaining parmesan
6. Spread over spinach
7. Combine pizza sauce , carrot , mushrooms , oregano , basil , and garlic powder
8. Pour over cheese mixture
9. Bake , uncovered , at 350 degrees for 25 minutes
10. Sprinkle with mozzarella and bake 5 more minutes , until cheese melts
11. Let stand for 5 minutes before slicing
12. Try to have each layer slightly less filled to the edge , so that each layer is visible
13. Cooking time does not include boiling pasta

title: lentil cookies
steps:
1. In a small pot over medium heat , combine the lentils and the water
2. Bring to a simmer , cover , and simmer for 30 to 40 minutes , or until lentils are tender
3. Remove from the heat and puree
4. If using immediately , let cool
5. The puree may be stored in the refrigerator for 3 to 4 days or in the freezer for 2 to 3 months
6. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f
7. In a medium bowl , combine the flour , baking powder , salt , cinnamon and allspice
8. In the bowl of a stand-mixer with a whisk attachment , cream together the sugar and butter on medium speed
9. Add the egg and mix until just incorporated
10. Add the vanilla and lentil puree and mix until combined
11. Add the flour mixture and blend on low speed until just combined
12. Remove the bowl from the mixer and stir in the oats , dried fruit and coconut
13. Form the dough into balls about 2 teaspoons in size and place on a baking sheet with parchment paper , leaving about 1-inch of room in between
14. Bake for 15 to 17 minutes , or until an internal temperature of 195 degrees f is reached on an instant-read thermometer

title: rode kool  red cabbage  dutch recipe
steps:
1. Cut and shred cabbage
2. Cook in a small amount of boiling water with salt , cloves and pepper for about 45 minutes
3. Don't let it boil dry , but don't add too much water
4. During the last 10 minutes of cooking time add the vinegar
5. Just before serving add the butter and seasoning

title: roast beef au jus
steps:
1. Heat a tablespoon of olive oil in a large cast iron skillet
2. Brown the roast in the skillet on all sides
3. Cover the outside of the roast on all sides with lots of black pepper
4. Place covered skillet in oven for at least one hour at 350
5. At the end of one hour add flour to the hot oil in the skillet until it is dissolved
6. Add both cans of soup to the roast and the onion
7. Cook another hour in the oven
8. Salt if needed
9. Serve the roast thinly slice within the hot rolls and a small dish of the gravy

title: chilli king prawns  shrimp  skewers with pistachio coriander rub
steps:
1. Shell and devein prawns
2. Thread four prawns onto each skewer
3. Blend or process spices , green chilli , coconut , ginger , nuts , coconut milk and oil until mixture forms a paste
4. Transfer to small bowl and stir in the water
5. Rub paste into prawns
6. Cook skewers on heated oiled grill plate , brushing occasionally with remaining paste , until prawns have changed colour and cooked through
7. Serve skewers sprinkled with coriander leaves

title: wake up stuffed french breakfast panini
steps:
1. Cut two slices french bread diagonally , each slice about an inch thick , or
2. Cut just one slice french bread diagonally , about 2 inches thick , and carefully open one end and remove some of the bread , making a pocket
3. Mix cream cheese and preserves
4. Spread cream cheese / preserve mixture on one side of sliced bread , and top with remaining slice , making a sandwich or
5. Stuff pocket in the 2 inch slice of bread with cream cheese / preserve mixture
6. Spread the outside of bread with melted butter
7. Place on grill
8. When browned to your likeness , dust with powdered sugar
9. Or you may make it with cream cheese only , and drizzle with syrup

title: maureen s stuffed peppers
steps:
1. Precook peppers in boiling slated water about 5 minutes
2. Sprinkle salt inside
3. Brown meat and onions
4. Add tomatoes , rice , worcestershire sauce
5. Cover and simmer for about 5 minutes
6. Stuff mixture in peppers and add cheese on top
7. Bake 350 degrees for 25 minutes untill done

title: muddled herb red potatoes
steps:
1. Boil potatoes 10 minutes , or until tender
2. Drain well
3. Place potatoes in a bowl , add remaining ingredients , and coarsely mash to"muddle" or bruise , the herbs to release their flavors , serve

title: breakfast polenta with dried cranberries and almonds
steps:
1. Place the milk and cranberries in a medium , heavey saucepan
2. Bring the milk almost to a boil , turn off the heat and let sit until the cranberries are soft and plump , about 5 minutes
3. Toast almonds in dry fry pan over medium heat , shaking offten and being careful not to burn
4. Use a slotted spoon to transfer the cranberries to a small bowl
5. Bring the milk almost back to a boil and whisk in the polenta in a very slow , steady stream
6. Cook over medium-low heat , stirring constantly with a wooden spoon , until the polenta thickens and starts to pull away ftom the sides of the pan , about 3-5 minutes
7. Stir in the cranberries and divide among individual bowls
8. Sprinkle the toasted almonds over each bowl and drizzle with honey

title: no fat apple carrot muffins recipe
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients
2. Spray muffin tins with pam
3. Divide equally
4. Bake at 350f for 25 minutes

title: dilled pot roast  crock pot
steps:
1. If necessary , cut roast to fit into a 3 1 / 2 to 4 quart crockery cooker
2. In a large skillet brown roast on all sides in hot oil
3. Transfer to cooker
4. Add the water to cooker
5. Sprinkle roast with 2 teaspoons of the fresh dillweed or 3 / 4 teaspoon of the dried dillweed , salt , and pepper
6. Cover and cook on high heat setting for 5 to 6 hours or on low heat setting for 10 to 12 hours , until meat is tender
7. Transfer roast to a serving platter , reserving juices
8. Cover roast and keep warm
9. Pour cooking juices into a glass measuring cup
10. Skim off fat
11. Measure 1 cup of the reserved juices
12. For sauce , in a small saucepan stir together yogurt and flour until well combined
13. Stir in the 1 cup reserved cooking juices and remaining dillweed
14. Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly
15. Cook and stir 1 minute more
16. Serve meat with sauce and noodles

title: slow cooker pork chops with sauerkraut
steps:
1. In a skillet , heat oil over med-high heat and add pork chops in batches to brown on both sides , then add to slow cooker
2. Sprinkle with flour , salt , pepper , cayenne , and dry mustard
3. In a bowl , combine sauerkraut and grated apple , then spread over he top of the pork and add chicken stock
4. Cover and cook on low for about 5 hours or high for about 2 1 / 2 hours

title: peach pie moonshine a la mode
steps:
1. In large pot put grape peach juice , sugar , sliced peaches , cinnamon sticks and 1 / 2 cup of schnapps
2. Bring to boil , reduce heat and let simmer on medium low for 30-45 minutes covered
3. Remove from heat and let cool to room temperature
4. Add 1 cup of everclear , 1 cup of vanilla vodka and remaining 1 / 2 cup of peach schnapps
5. Pour into mason jar with one each of the cinnamon sticks from mixture and one peach from mixture
6. Refrigerate for at least a week to mellow

title: the realtor s chocolate surprise
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Melt butter , add flour and 1 / 2 cup nuts
3. Mix and press into bottom of 13x9 pan
4. Bake for 15 minutes
5. Cream powdered sugar , cream cheese and 1 cup cool whip
6. Spread over cooled crust
7. Mix instant pudding with milk
8. Spread over cream cheese layer
9. Spread remainder of whipped cream over chocolate pudding layer
10. Sprinkle with chopped nuts if desired
11. Chill overnight

title: scottish coke bread
steps:
1. In a large bowl , stir together the flour , rolled oats , sugar , baking powder , baking soda , and salt
2. In another bowl , beat with a fork , the egg , shortening , and vanilla extract until well blended
3. Add to the flour mixture
4. Add the coke , prunes , and nuts
5. Blend thoroughly with a spoon
6. Turn into a well-greased , lightly floured , 9x5x3-inch loaf pan
7. Bake in a preheated , 350f oven for about 1 hour or until a wooden toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean
8. Cool on a rack for 20 minutes before removing the bread from the pan
9. Store in foil overnight before slicing

title: chocolate caramel raspberry sauce
steps:
1. Over low heat in a heavy saucepan melt caramels and chocolate
2. Gradually add condensed milk , butter , jam and whipping cream
3. Melt together and stir unti smooth
4. Serve warm over ice cream or pound cake or both

title: easy coffee cake
steps:
1. Cream butter , cheese and sugar until light and fluffy
2. Add eggs and vanilla
3. Beat well
4. Add dry ingredients and beat until smooth
5. Spread into greased 13" x 9" pan
6. Combine topping ingredients until mixture resembles small crumbs
7. Sprinkle topping over cake
8. Bake at 350 degrees for 30-35 minutes

title: easy excellent salsa
steps:
1. Chop green onions and cilantro
2. Put in blender or food processor
3. Add the remaining ingredients and pulse several times or blend fo about 30 sec

title: original recipe sicilian succo  meatballs   sauce
steps:
1. In a heavy sauce pan mix together garlic , tomato sauce , tomato paste , parsley and basil
2. Bring sauce to a boil and turn down the heat to simmer
3. In a large bowl mix together the ground beef , ground pork , bread crumbs , parmesan cheese , garlic powder and parsley
4. Shape into balls the size of a golf ball
5. Try to make 40 meat balls
6. In a skillet , fry meatballs in hot olive oil until brown
7. Combine the sauce mixture and the meat balls and simmer over low heat for another four hours

title: moroccan eggplant  aubergine  salad ii
steps:
1. Peel the uncooked eggplants , then cut into 1x3-inch slices
2. Lay on a cookie sheet , sprinkle with the salt , and allow to"sweat" and drain for 30 minutes
3. Rinse well and pat dry with paper towels
4. Heat oil and butter in a skillet and fry the slices until both sides are golden brown , about 15 minutes
5. Set cooked slices on paper towels to drain of excess oil
6. Cut into 1 / 2-inch pieces and mix with the garlic , bell pepper , cayenne , and cumin
7. Return eggplant to the skillet , add 1 tbsp sherry and saut on low until liquids have evaporated , about 5 minutes
8. Transfer to the serving bowl , sprinkle with the dressing ingredients , and let cool
9. When ready to serve , toss the salad , garnish with black olives , golden raisins , currants , and parsley
10. Makes 6-8 servings
11. Adapted from a gail's recipe swap post by dawn / nys

title: potato dumplings ii
steps:
1. On day one cook and rice potatoes and put in the refrigerator
2. On the second day mix thoroughly with the remaining ingredients
3. Mold potato mixture firmly into small balls with croutons as center
4. Molded dumplings are dropped into boiling salt water and cooked for 3 minutes
5. They are done when they rise to the surface

title: jambalaya
steps:
1. Heat butter in tight , fully covered saucepan
2. Add onion and garlic , cook over low heat for 5 minutes
3. Add tomatoes and juice and bring to a boil
4. Sprinkle rice on top of tomatoes
5. Add salt , pepper cayenne and soup mix
6. Cook for 15 minutes
7. Then add green pepper , celery , parsley and basil
8. If necessary , add a little water or tomato juice and cook for another 5 minutes
9. Transfer to a casserole dish and add shrimp , chicken and juices , sliced mushrooms
10. Cover tightly
11. Bake in preheated oven for 15 minutes 350f till shrimp are cooked , but not overdone

title: chubby hubby bars
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f foil line and spray a 9x13" pan with cooking spray
2. In a bowl , whisk the flour , baking soda and salt
3. Using a mixer , beat the butter and both sugars at medium speed until light and fluffy
4. Beat in the eggs and the vanilla extract
5. On low speed , beat in the dry ingredients just until incorporated
6. Stir in the peanut butter chips , chocolate chips and pretzel pieces
7. Spread the batter evenly in the pan and press it down evenly with a spatula
8. Sprinkle extra peanut butter chips and chocolate chips
9. Sprinkle remaining pretzel bits
10. Bake for 30 minutes , until golden brown
11. Cool completely
12. Lift bars out of the pan using foil
13. Place on a cutting board
14. Cut even squares

title: gujarat carrot salad
steps:
1. Shred carrots and place in a bowl , set aside
2. Heat oil in a wok or skillet on medium heat until hot , pour in mustard and cumin seeds
3. Cover wok or skillet because they splutter and might pop into your face !
4. As soon as the spluttering stops and they become fragrant , remove wok or skillet from stove , add sugar , salt , chili pepper and tumeric , stir until you get a smooth paste
5. Cool about 5 minutes
6. Stir warm spice paste into carrots , add lime juice and mix well
7. Chill for about 30 minutes before serving , then mix well again and serve

title: apple sticky buns
steps:
1. In a large mixing bowl , combine 1 1 / 2 cups flour , yeast , sugar and salt
2. In a saucepan , heat the milk , water and butter to 120 to 130
3. Add to dry ingredients
4. Beat just until moistened
5. Add egg
6. Beat until smooth
7. Stir in remaining flour and apples
8. Do not knead
9. Cover and let rise in a warm place for 30 minutes
10. Meanwhile , in a sauce pan , combine the topping ingredients
11. Bring to a boil , stirring until blended
12. Pour into an ungreased 13x9x2 in baking dish
13. Stir dough down
14. Spoon walnut sized pieces of dough over nut mixture
15. Cover and let rise for 30 minutes
16. Bake at 375 for 30-35 minutes or until golden brown
17. Let stand for 1 minute before inverting onto a large serving platter

title: pork blade steak with garlic herb
steps:
