1. Mix spices with garlic and rub on both sides of steaks and let sit 1 hour or more
2. Brown in a small amout of olive oil in oven proof pan
3. Add chicken stock and cover with foil or lid bake for 1 1 / 2 hours at 350 degrees
4. Top with thick peppery country gravy
5. Serve with mashed potatoes of rice and fresh veg

title: state fair lemon orange shakeups
steps:
1. Use a 16-ounce cocktail shaker to blend the shakeup
2. Squeeze the juice from both the lemon and the orange into the shaker
3. Add in the sugar
4. Add the ice cubes and the water , close the shaker and shake the mix
5. Serve in a tall glass and garnish with a couple of orange or lemon slices if desired
6. If you just want a lemon shakeup , simply use a whole lemon and omit the orange

title: freak n good ribs
steps:
1. For best results this should be done at least 1 day in advance
2. Cut ribs into serving size pieces
3. Assemble all ingredients of the marinade in a large bowl and add rib pieces , cover and refrigerate
4. Turn ribs occasionally in bowl to evenly distribute flavor
5. On day 2 , remove from fridge at least 3 hours prior to bbq time
6. Set oven to 300 and place the ribs in a 9 x 12 baking dish cover with marinade
7. Place in the oven for 1 hrs turning the ribs often to ensure even coverage
8. Check often until tender
9. Remove ribs from oven and finish on the bbq over medium heat
10. Cover ribs with the bulls eye bbq sauce liberally and turn often
11. This recipe doubles easily for more ribs
12. Enjoy

title: spicy crispy beef
steps:
1. Combine cornstarch , salt and pepper
2. Add steak and toss
3. Deep fry steak until golden
4. In another bowl combine soy sauce , vinegar , sherry , honey , sugar , chili paste and water
5. In a saucepan heat oil
6. Saute garlic , onion , ginger and green pepper for 30 seconds
7. Add sauce ingredients
8. Cook for 1 minute
9. Add the steak
10. Toss to coat thoroughly
11. Heat through

title: broccoli   cheese soup
steps:
1. Saute onion and celery in butter in saucepan over medium heat until tender
2. Add flour , and salt and pepper , cooking and stirring until mixture is smooth and bubbly
3. Add broth and milk , stirring constantly until mixture comes to a boil and begins to thicken
4. Add cooked broccoli , stirring until all is heated through
5. Remove from heat and stir in cheese until melted and smooth

title: barbecue recipes beef marinade
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients and pour over beef
2. Let marinate for several hours at room temperature

title: beef on a bun
steps:
1. Combine celery , onion , ketchup , bbq sauce , water , vinegar , worcestershire sauce , brown sugar , chili powder , pepper , and garlic powder and mix well
2. Pour into slow cooker
3. Add roast , cover and cook high for 6 - 7 hours
4. Remove roast and shred meat
5. Return meat to sauce and serve over buns with a slotted spoon

title: goodtime beef brisket  diabetic crock pot recipe
steps:
1. Put meat in a slow cooker
2. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over the meat to cover
3. Cook on low heat for 8-10 hours
4. Remove meat and slice thin
5. Serve over couscous

title: my tuna noodle casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven at 425f
2. Cook noodles in boiling salted water till tender
3. Drain
4. Combine cooked noodles , drained tuna , mayonnaise , onion , celery , peas
5. Blend soup and milk in a saucepan over low heat
6. Add cheese and salt and pepper to taste
7. Stir until cheese is melted
8. Add to noodle mixture
9. Spray a casserole dish with pam
10. Put mixture into casserole dish and sprinkle crushed potato chips on top
11. Bake for about 20 minutes or until bubbly on top

title: macadamia macaroons
steps:
1. In 350 degree oven toast coconut and macadamia nuts for 10 minutes
2. Stir often and allow to cool
3. Combine milk and vanilla in large bowl
4. Add in coconut mixture and crushed crackers , blend together well
5. Beat egg whites till stiff then gently fold into coconut mixture
6. Lightly grease baking sheet and drop tablespoon of cookie mixture onto sheet
7. Bake 350f oven for 12- 14 minutes
8. Cool completely
9. When cooled dip in melted chocolate
10. Refrigerate until set enjoy enjoy enjoy

title: panko encrusted tilapia fillets
steps:
1. In 3 pie plate sized dishes , put egg white , flour and crumbs
2. Combine crumbs with seasonings
3. Dredge fish on both sides in flour ,
4. Shaking exess
5. Dip next in egg white on both sides
6. And then place in crumbs
7. Make sure to press firmly on both sides , so the crumbs will stick
8. Heat a large , non stick , pan over medium heat
9. Add 1 tablespoons oil
10. Add both fillets and cook until golden
11. About 5 minutes
12. Flip over and add remaning oil
13. Swirl pan so fish moves and is coated with the oil
14. Continue browning until fish is cooked
15. About another 5 minutes
16. Serve hot

title: three bean chili
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , combine water , beans , tomast sauce , tomatoes , tomato paste & seasonings
2. Bring to a boil , then reduce heat & simmer , uncovered for 10 minutes
3. Add corn & squash , then bring back to a boil , simmering another 10 minutes or until the squash is tender

title: jamaican jerk chicken wings
steps:
1. Arrange the chicken wings in a single layer in a large baking pan
2. Combine remaining ingredients in a blender or a food processor
3. Puree until very smooth
4. Pour sauce over the wings , coating evenly
5. Cover the pan with plastic wrap
6. Refrigerate at least 2 hours
7. Heat oven to 350
8. Bake until the wings are brown and crispy , about 1 hour

title: parmesan focaccia
steps:
1. For the dough: add potato to boiling water and simmer until done , about 25 minutes
2. Drain potato well and cool
3. Once cooled put through fine disk on ricer or grate through large holes on grater box
4. Reserve 1 1 / 3 cup lightly packed potato
5. Meanwhile , in large bowl of electric mixer or work bowl of food processor fitted with steel blade , mix or pulse yeast , 1 / 2 cup flour , and 1 / 2 cup warm water until combined
6. Cover tightly and set aside until bubbly , about 20 minutes
7. Add remaining dough ingredients , including reserved potato
8. If using kitchen aid mixer , fit with paddle attachment and mix on low speed until dough comes together
9. Switch to dough hook attachment and increase speed to medium
10. Continue kneading until dough is smooth and elastic , about 5 minutes
11. If using food processor , process until dough is smooth and elastic , about 40 seconds
12. The dough will be wet
13. Transfer dough to lightly oiled bowl , turn to coat with oil , and cover tightly with plastic wrap
14. Let rise in warm , draft-free area until dough is puffy and doubled in volume , about 1 hour
15. With wet hands , press dough flat into generously oiled 15 1 / 2 by 10 1 / 2 inch jelly roll pan , stretching it so that the dough reaches all sides of the pan and fills all four corners once the dough has been stretched into the pan cover with a lightly oil-sprayed plastic wrap
16. Let rise in warm , draft-free area until dough is puffy and double in volume , 45 minutes to 1 hour
17. Meanwhile , adjust oven rack to lower-middle position and heat to 425f
18. Once doubled in size , with two wet fingers , dimple risen dough
19. Drizzle the dough with the topping oil and sprinkle evenly with parmesan cheese
20. Bake until focaccia bottom is golden brown and crisp , 23 to 25 minutes
21. Transfer to wire rack to cool slightly
22. Cut into squares and serve with olive oil and balsamic vinegar

title: dave s barbecue sauce
steps:
1. Combine all of the ingredients in a bowl and blend thoroughly until the brown sugar has dissolved
2. Place in a saucepan and bring to just a boil
3. Chill and store in the refrigerator

title: seafood fondue
steps:
1. Cut salmon and halibut into 3 / 4" pieces , discarding skin and bones
2. Peel and devein shrimp
3. Rince scallops to remove any grit
4. If large , cut in half
5. Arrange fish and shellfish on a large serving platter
6. Mix the sauces and spoon into small serving bowls
7. Heat oil in a fondue pot over an alcohol burner until it starts to bubble
8. Serve
9. Each guest will spear pieces of seafood unto a fondue fork and cook in the hot oil , then dip in a sauce or sprinkle with lemon juice
10. The salmon and halibut pieces take about 2 minutes , the scallop and shrimp about 3 minutes

title: honey and mustard glazes roast parsnips
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 190c / gas5
2. Put the parsnips in a pan of lightly salted boiling water , bring back to the boil
3. Reduce heat and simmer for 5mins
4. Drain well
5. Meanwhile , heat 4tbsp of the oil in a roasting tin in the oven for 5 minutes
6. Mix the remaining oil with the mustard , honey and orange zest then set aside
7. Remove parsnips from the oven and drizzle the mustard mixture
8. Increase the oven temperature to 200c / gas6
9. Return the parsnips to the oven and roast for a further 10-15 minutes or until golden and sticky

title: pumpkin pie crunch w o nuts
steps:
1. Combine pumpkin , milk , eggs , sugar , spice , salt
2. Pour into greased and floured 13x9 baking pan
3. Sprinkle cake mix over pumpkin mixture
4. Cover with melted margarine
5. Bake at 350 for 50-55 minutes or until golden

title: pop culture   popcorn with 6 mixes
steps:
1. Pop popcorn according to microwave directions
2. Add seasoning immediately
3. Bacon & herb: 1 / 4 cup fresh grated parmesan and 2 tablespoon real bacon bits ground together in a coffee grinder or mini food processor , 1 1 / 2 teaspoons parsley flakes , 3 / 4 teaspoons garlic powder , 3 / 4 teaspoons onion powder , 3 / 4 teaspoon sugar , 1 / 2 teaspoons paprika
4. Makes 10 tablespoons
5. Toss 5 tablespoons mixture with 1 bag popcorn
6. Apple cinnamon: 1 1 / 3 cup freeze dried apples or apple chips , 2 tablespoons confectioners' sugar , 1 / 2 teaspoon cinnamon
7. Grind ingredients in a coffee grinder or mini food processor
8. Makes 12 tablespoons
9. Tos 6 tablespoons mixture with 1 bag popcorn
10. Butterscotch: place 8 butterscotch hard candies in a coffee grinder or mini food processor until finely crushed
11. Toss with 1 bag popcorn
12. Barbecue: 3 3 / 4 teaspoons smoked paprika , 3 1 / 2 teaspoons garlic powder , 2 1 / 2 tablespoons light brown sugar , 1 / 4 teaspoon salt , and 1 1 / 2 tablespoons parsley flakes
13. Makes 12 tablespoons
14. Toss 4 tablespoons mixture with 1 bag popcorn
15. Sweet chili: 3 tablespoons confectioners' sugar , 1 / 2 teaspoon cinnamon , 1 tablespoons chili powder , 1 / 4 teaspoon salt , 1 / 4 teaspoon cayenne pepper or more to taste , and 1 1 / 2 teaspoon paprika
16. Makes 9 tablespoons
17. Toss about 2 1 / 2 tablespoons mixture with 1 bag popcorn
18. Chocolate malt: 6 tablespoons confectioners' sugar , 3 tablespoons unsweetened cocoa , 6 tablespoons malted milk powder
19. Makes 15 tablespoons
20. Toss 5 tablespoons mixture with 1 bag popcorn

title: creamy iced vanilla caramel coffee
steps:
1. Place all ingredients into blender and blend on high until the ice is completely smooth
2. Pour into four glasses and top with a dollop of whipped cream
3. Serve immediately
4. Or save the leftover from your morning pot for an afternoon treat !

title: anti stress antipasto
steps:
1. Place the lettuce mix on large platter
2. Slice salami into quarters
3. Scatter evenly over lettuce
4. Cut cheese into bite-size squares and scatter over lettuce
5. Rinse and drain chickpeas
6. Drain olives
7. Scatter over salad
8. Peel and thinly slice cucumber and arrange on salad
9. Cut each tomato into quarters and place evenly around outer edge of plate
10. Place the pepperoncini at even intervals
11. Juice lemon into bowl
12. Add vinegar , oregano and garlic
13. Whisk until well combined
14. Add olive oil slowly while whisking until thoroughly blended
15. Drizzle vinaigrette over salad , eat !

title: cheesy baked spaghetti
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Cook spaghetti per package directions
3. Meanwhile , in a large skillet , cook beef over medium heat until meat is no longer pink
4. Season with garlic powder , onion powder and salt / pepper to taste
5. Stir in the spaghetti sauce , brown sugar and italian seasoning and heat until warm
6. Drain spaghetti and toss with the sauce
7. Mix the mozzarella and parmesean cheeses together in a bowl
8. Place half of the spaghetti in a greased 9 x 13 inch baking dish
9. Top with half of the cheese mixture
10. Repeat layers
11. Cover and bake at 350 degrees f for 25 minutes
12. Uncover
13. Bake 20-25 minutes longer or until cheese is melted

title: mom s caramel rolls
steps:
1. Mix water and yeast and wait 5 minutes
2. Stir in sugar , salt and 2 cups of flour
3. Add egg and butter and mix
4. Stir in rest of flour by hand , if dough is still sticky add just enough to make it not sticky anymore
5. Let raise until dough is double in size
6. Sprinkle flour on surface and roll dough out until is approx 18 x 12 inches
7. Spread a very thin layer of soft butter on dough and sprinkle cinnamon / sugar mixture on it
8. Roll dough from the long side , it should look like a log
9. Cut into 1 inch pieces
10. Should be 18 pieces
11. Place brown sugar and butter into microwave dish and heat until butter is just melted
12. Stir well
13. Stir in 3 t water
14. Divide mixture into 3 pans
15. Place 6 pieces in each pan
16. Let raise for about 45 minutes
17. Bake for 20 minutes in a 325f oven
18. When you take out of oven , turn each pan of rolls over on a plate , otherwise you will have a hard time getting them out when they cool
19. If you can , let them cool slightly and enjoy them when they are still warm

title: carolina gold barbecue sauce
steps:
1. In a heavy saucepan , combine mustard , and vinegar
2. Then add chili powder , chipotle , black pepper , and cayenne pepper
3. Bring to a simmer over medium high heat
4. Do not boil , as this could cause scorching
5. Reduce heat and simmer for about 20 minutes
6. Mix in the worcestershire sauce , butter , hot sauce , and liquid smoke
7. Then simmer for another 15 minutes
8. Pour into an airtight jar and refrigerate
9. This will keep in fridge for a couple of weeks

title: garlic and mustard roasted brussel sprouts
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Line a rimmed baking sheet with parchment or aluminum foil
3. In a mixing bowl , whisk together olive oil , agave , mustard and garlic
4. Put brussel sprouts in bowl and toss to coat
5. Spread evenly on baking sheet in a single layer
6. Bake , uncovered , for 30 minutes , until tender
7. Place on a platter and squeeze lemon juice over to taste , if desired
8. Enjoy !

title: fresh whiskey sours
steps:
1. Combine the whiskey , lemon juice , lime juice , and sugar syrup
2. Fill a cocktail shaker halfway with ice
3. Pour in the drink mix 2 / 3 full
4. Shake vigorously for 15 seconds and strain into glasses
5. Add a maraschino cherry and serve ice cold

title: blueberry cheesecake baked oatmeal
steps:
1. Spray an 11x17" baking pan with non-stick spray
2. Combine all ingredients
3. Bake in prepared pan at 350 f for 30-40 minutes
4. Serve warm or cold

title: fruity rice meringue
steps:
1. Combine rice , sugar , milk in a saucepan
2. Stir constantly over heat until mixture reaches boiling point
3. Reduce heat to lowest setting
4. Cover and cook for about an hour , or until rice is tender and mixture is thick and creamy , stirring from time to time
5. Stir in vanilla essence
6. Spread rice mixture over base of an ovenproof dish
7. Top evenly with fruit
8. Beat egg whites in bowl with electric mixer until soft peaks form
9. Gradually add extra sugar
10. Continue beating until mixture is thick , shiny and glossy
11. Spoon meringue mixture into dish to completely cover fruit
12. Bake at 180c for about 20-30 mins , or until meringue is evenly browned
13. Serve warm with thin cream , if desired

title: abm raisin  date   nut bread wreath
steps:
1. Heat milk in microwave for 2 minutes
2. Add butter to milk and stir until melted
3. Add egg to milk and stir until mixed
4. Put flour , brown sugar , salt , nutmeg , cinnamon , ginger , vanilla and egg in bread pan
5. Add milk mixture and yeast to bread pan per manufacturer's directions
6. Start bread machine on dough cycle
7. Remove dough and roll out into a 6x24-inch sheet
8. Spread raisins , dates and nuts onto dough leaving about an inch on the edges
9. Add more if needed
10. Peel long edge up and roll up dough , making long roll
11. Pinch edges to seal
12. Lay with edge down into a circle
13. Let rise covered with cloth in a slightly warmed oven for 30 minutes
14. Optional: i use an egg wash to give the bread a more golden shiny look
15. Also i might put slight cuts in the dough to give it texture
16. Bake in 350f oven for 22 minutes

title: mexican iceberg  cocktail
steps:
1. To a blender , add ice and all ingredients except sherbert
2. Blend until ice is fully crushed and liquid is frothy
3. To a cocktail glass , add the sherbert
4. Top with the blender mixture
5. The sherbert will float underneath like an iceberg

title: easy deep dish pizza
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425
2. Grease lasagne pan
3. Cook and stir sausage and onion in skillet til sausage is brown
4. Drain
5. Mix baking mix and water til moist
6. Spread in pan
7. Pour spaghetti sauce carefully over batter
8. Top with sausage , onions , shrooms , and cheese
9. Bake 25-30 minutes
10. Check in the middle to see if crust is cooked

title: fried  cauliflower
steps:
1. In a shallow medium bowl , beat egg lightly
2. Place bread crumbs in a plastic or paper bag
3. Dip cauliflower into egg to coat
4. Place florets in bag with crumbs
5. Seal or close bag and shake well
6. In 10 inch non-stick skillet , heat oil
7. Add coated cauliflower and saute until browned on all sides
8. Season with salt and pepper if desired
9. And if desired garnish with parsley sprigs

title: cajun chicken salad for two
steps:
1. Whisk together first 5 ingredients
2. Set aside
3. Toss together lettuce , tomatoes and onion
4. Divide between 2 plates
5. Liberally coat chicken breast with cajun seasoning
6. Heat 1 tablespoon vegetable oil over medium-high heat
7. Add chicken and fry until cooked through and crusty , about 4 minutes per side
8. Transfer cooked chicken to plate and cut into crosswise thin strips
9. Arrange chicken atop salad
10. Spoon dressing over and serve

title: ww tasty fiesta dip
steps:
1. Mix hidden valley mix into sour cream
2. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour before eating

title: french onion soup with cider
steps:
1. Melt butter in a large saucepan over medium heat
2. Add onions and sea salt and cook , stirring occasionally , for 30 minutes or until onions are deep golden
3. Add cider and simmer until reduced by half , then add stock and simmer for 10 minutes
4. Season with pepper
5. Meanwhile , place bread on a foil-lined tray and cook both sides under a hot grill until dried but not browned
6. Spread with mustard and top with cheese , then grill until cheese bubbles and browns
7. Serve soup topped with the crotons and sprigs of thyme

title: mmmm salt encrusted baked fish
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Line a pan 2 to 3 inches longer than the fish with aluminum foil
3. Pour the eggs whites into a large bowl
4. Add salt--goal is consistency of wet sand
5. Layer 1 to 2 inches in pan
6. Make this layer several inches larger than the fish
7. Rinse fish & pat dry , then lay onto salt
8. Sprinkle 1 / 2 t zest over area fish will rest
9. Stuff fish with herbs & / or diced lemon
10. Lay fish onto salt bed , laying so that abdominal incision is covered
11. Pack wet salt mixture on & around fish
12. Pat down gently
13. Bake 40 minutes
14. Remove from oven & let sit for 10 to 15 minutes
15. Crack the salt shell with a mallet or heavy spoon & peel off chunks of shell to expose the fish
16. Inhale ! admire the color of the fish then lift top fillet from bone & serve
17. Don't forget the cheeks ! mmm !
18. Lift tail to remove back bone to get to the other side
19. Clean up is to lift the foil & throw salt crust , bones & skin away

title: steamer clams in beer and garlic
steps:
1. In a big saucepan , combine the beer , broth , garlic , bay leaf , parsley , and salt / pepper
2. Bring to a boil
3. Decrease heat to medium
4. Simmer 5 minutes to blend flavors
5. Add clams
6. Cover and simmer 4-5 minutes until clam shells open
7. Remove bay leaf and discard
8. Remove any clams that did not open and discard
9. Place clams in 4 large individual bowls and ladle some of the liquid from the saucepan over the clams
10. Serve with individual bowls of melted butter for dipping
11. Serve immediately

title: low fat mongolian beef
steps:
1. Slice the flank steak against the grain and toss in cup of cornstarch
2. Make sauce: heat tsp olive oil , add ginger and garlic
3. Cook but dont burn
4. Add the soy sauce , water and brown sugar bring to a boil for 2-3 minutes
5. Remove from heat and place sauce in a separate bowl
6. Add 1 tsp oil and brown beef
7. Add sauce , green onions and cook through
8. Serve with rice

title: apple cannonballs
steps:
1. Combine brown sugar , raisins , nuts , and cinnamon in a bowl and set aside
2. Core apples and place on individual sheets of heavy-duty aluminum foil
3. Spoon mixture evenly into the center of each apple
4. Place butter on top of each apple and wrap apples tightly in foil
5. Place on a preheated grill and cover
6. Cook for about 1 / 2 hour or until tender

title: easy pan fried fish fillets and tartar sauce
steps:
1. For the tartar sauce
2. In a bowl blend all ingredients until well combined
3. Cover and refrigerate a minimum of 2 hours before using
4. For the fish
5. Place eggs in a shallow bowl
6. In another shallow bowl mix together the crushed saltines with garlic powder and lemon pepper until very well combined
7. Coat the fish fillets firstly in the eggs , then coat into the breading mixture
8. Place fillets on a plate and let stand for about 5-8 minutes
9. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat
10. Add in fillets and fry about 2-3 minutes on each side or until the fish flakes
11. Remove to a plate then lightly sprinkle with seasoned salt
12. Serve fish with tartar sauce , yummmmm !

title: chutney coleslaw
steps:
1. Whisk together chutney , mayonnaise , sour cream , cilantro and lime juice in small bowl
2. Combine onion and coleslaw mix in large bowl
3. Top with chutney mixture
4. Toss to coat
5. Refrigerate for 1 hour before serving

title: ontbijtkoek   dutch spice bread
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 300 degrees fahrenheit
2. Combine all ingredients into a smooth paste
3. Lightly coat a loaf pan with baking spray and flour
4. Bake for a full hour
5. When fully baked , open the oven door a crack , and allow loaf to cool in the turned off oven for 1 / 2 hour before removing from oven and cooling completely
6. Then remove from pan
7. Cool completely and store in plastic bag
8. Keep covered or bread will dry out

title: its the great pumpkin cookies  charlie brown
steps:
1. Cream butter with both sugars until light and fluffy
2. Add in egg , pumpkin , and vanilla and mix
3. Then add flour oats , baking soda , cinnamon , and salt and mix well
4. Then stir in chocolate chips and cinnamon chips
5. Bake at 350 for 18-20 minutes or until firm and lightly brown
6. You can shape these into pumpkins before baking and when done and cooled decorate with frosting or peanut butter
7. I usually eat mine when they are totally cooled

title: chicken cordon bleu burgers   rachael ray
steps:
1. Preheat grill pan , nonstick griddle , large nonstick skillet or table top electric grill to medium high heat
2. Add 2 tablespoons of oil and canadian bacon
3. Warm bacon and caramelize it at edges , 1 to 2 minutes on each side
4. Remove to a piece of foil
5. Fold foil over loosely to keep warm
6. Pour olive oil on plate
7. Finely chop shallot
8. Combine chicken , paprika , poultry seasoning , grill seasoning , shallot
9. Score meat with the side of your hand to separate into 4 equal amounts
10. Make 4 large patties , 3 / 4 to 1 inch thick
11. Drop each patty onto the plate you poured olive oil on and coat with oil and place on hot grill pan , griddle or in skillet
12. Cook 5 minutes on each side , until chicken is cooked through
13. Top patties with reserved cooked canadian bacon and swiss cheese
14. Fold each slice of cheese in half to fit the burger
15. Cover loosely with tin foil
16. Turn off pan and let cheese melt , 2 minutes
17. Combine mayonnaise , mustard , tarragon
18. Slather bun tops or english tops with sauce
19. Place cordon bleu burgers on bun bottoms and top with lettuce and tomato
20. Put bun or muffin tops in place
21. Serve with fries

title: chicken and cheese pie
steps:
1. Line base and sides of 22cm pie dish with one sheet of pastry
2. In a bowl , combine chicken , cheese , cottage cheese , yoghurt and pepper
3. Lightly beat eggs and stir into mixture
4. Spoon filling into lined dish
5. Cover with the remaining pastry sheet
6. Trim edges
7. Bake at 220 degrees for 10 minutes
8. Then 180 degrees for 25-30 minutes
9. Serve hot or cold

title: eggplant  aubergine  and feta mash
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 200c
2. Pierce eggplant all over with a skewer and either rub or spray with oil
3. Place on a baking sheet
4. Roast for 35-40 minutes or until very tender
5. Allow to cool for 10 minutes
6. Cut the eggplants in half and scoop out the flesh with a metal spoon , discarding the skin
7. Place the flesh in a bowl , add the lemon juice , three-quarters of the feta and three-quarters of the parsley
8. Season with salt and pepper
9. Sprinkle with the remaining feta and parsley and serve

title: cafe maple syrup
steps:
1. Bring sugar , coffee and salt to a boil- boil for exactly 1 minute-any longer and you will have crystals when it cools
2. Stir in maple flavoring or vanilla-serve warm or cool

title: irish stinger
steps:
1. Shake the baileys and white creme de menthe vigorously over ice cubes until well frosted
2. Strain into a chilled shot or lowball glass

title: cookies  n cream pudding
steps:
1. Break 1 of the cookies into four pieces
2. Reseve for garnish
3. Crush remaining 7 cookies
4. Set aside
5. Pour milk into medium bowl
6. Add dry pudding mix
7. Beat with wire whisk 2 minutes or until well blended
8. Stir in crushed cookies
9. Gently stir in 1 / 2 cup of the whipped topping
10. Spoon evenly into 4 dessert bowls
11. Top with remaining 1 / 4 cup whipped topping and the reserved cookie pieces
12. Store leftover dessert in refrigerator

title: pomarola sausages   argentinean way
steps:
1. Wash the onions and cut them into fine julienne
2. Remove the seeds from the red and green peppers and slice them thinly
3. Wash and discard the bad parts of green onions
4. Chop it
5. Heat the oil in a large , deep skillet , and cook all the previously cut ingredients until softened , stirring occasionally
6. Put the tomatoes in boiling water until the skin is loose
7. Take them from the water and chop them
8. Incorporate them to the skillet and add salt and pepper
9. Keep cooking at medium temperature
10. I recommend puncturing and boiling the sausages in water for 15 minutes , before adding them to the other ingredients in the skillet
11. This will help to leave the fat on the water and not on the sauce
12. Wash the sausages and puncture with a fork in several places , to prevent them from explosion during cooking
13. Add the sausages to the skillet with the wine and simmer , uncovered , for 20 minutes or only 10 minutes if you previously boiled the sausages in water
14. That's it !

title: egg and tuna salad
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients except eggs in a medium bowl and mix well
2. Peel eggs and place them in a separate bowl
3. Chop eggs using an egg slicer or a pastry blender and fold into mayonnaise mixture
4. Cover and chill
5. Garnish with additional paprika if desired

title: pressure cooker chicken curry
steps:
1. Add oil to a very hot pressure cooker pot
2. Brown the cut up chicken pieces nicely on all sides , remove to rest
3. Add the onions and saut till light golden brown
4. Add garlic and saut until onions are dark golden brown
5. Add the curry powder to the pot and stir until fragrant
6. Add the diced apple , water , salt and pepper
7. Return chicken to the pot
8. Stir once again to distribute evenly
9. Place lid on pressure cooker tightly
10. Heat on high until the weight begins to jiggle
11. Lower heat immediately to a level that keeps the weight just barely moving
12. Cook for 12 minutes
13. Remove pot from heat
14. When the pressure has been reduced , open the pot
15. Stir the ingredients very gently
16. Combine 2 tbsp flour and yogurt together
17. Stir some of the hot liquid from the pot into the yogurt mixture , then pour the mixture into the pot and stir to blend
18. Simmer for 5 minutes on a low heat
19. Serve over hot fluffy rice

title: smokey slow cooker chili
steps:
1. 1
2. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
3. Coat pan with cooking spray
4. Add ground pork to pan
5. Cook 5 minutes or until browned , stirring to slightly crumble
6. Drain well
7. Transfer pork to an electric slow cooker
8. 2
9. Recoat pan with cooking spray
10. Add pork shoulder
11. Cook 5 minutes or until lightly browned , turning occasionally
12. Transfer pork to slow cooker
13. 3
14. Recoat pan with cooking spray
15. Add onion and bell pepper
16. Saut 8 minutes , stirring frequently
17. Add garlic
18. Saut 1 minute
19. Add tomato paste
20. Cook 1 minute , stirring constantly
21. Stir in beer
22. Cook 1 minute
23. Transfer onion mixture to slow cooker
24. Add 1 / 4 teaspoon salt , chili powder , and next 9 ingredients to slow cooker
25. Cover and cook on high 5 hours or until meat is tender
26. Remove bay leaves and ham hock
27. Discard
28. Stir in remaining 1 / 4 teaspoon salt and sugar
29. Ladle about 1 1 / 3 cups chili into each of 8 bowls
30. Top each serving with 1 tablespoon cilantro , 1 tablespoon green onions , and 1 tablespoon cheese
31. Serve each serving with 1 lime wedge
32. For cooking chili on the stovetop , use a total of 12 ounces beer and simmer , covered , for 2 1 / 2 to 3 hours or until the pork shoulder is tender

title: baba au rhum  rum baba  by ina garten  barefoot contessa
steps:
1. Make the rum syrup:
2. Place the sugar , lemon juice and 1 1 / 2 cups water in a small saucepan and cook over high heat until the sugar dissolves
3. Pour into a 4-cup heatproof measuring cup and allow to cool
4. Add the rum and vanilla and set aside
5. Make the whipped cream:
6. Whip the cream in the bowl of an electric mixer fitted with the whisk attachment
7. When it starts to thicken , add the sugar and vanilla and continue to whip until the cream forms stiff peaks
8. Don't overheat , or you'll end up with butter !
9. Make the baba:
10. Combine the currants , lemon zest and rum in a small bowl and set aside
11. Melt 1 tablespoon of the butter and brush a 5-cup tube pan or kugelhopf mold with the melted butter
12. Be sure to coat every crevice of the pan
13. Heat the milk to 115f and then pour it into the bowl of an electric mixer fitted with the paddle attachment
14. Stir in the yeast and sugar and allow to sit for 5 minutes
15. With the mixer on low speed , first add the eggs , then the flour , salt , and remaining 4 tablespoons of butter
16. Raise the speed to medium-high and beat for 5 minutes
17. Scrape down the bowl and beater to form the dough into a ball
18. It will be very soft
19. Cover the bowl with a damp towel and allow it to rise until doubled in size , about 1 hour
20. Drain the currants and zest , fold them into the dough with a spatula , and spoon into the prepared pan
21. Smooth the top , cover the pan with a damp towel , and allow to rise until the dough reaches the top of the pan , 50 minutes to 1 hour
22. Meanwhile , preheat the oven to 375f and make the rum syrup
23. Bake the cake for about 50 minutes , or until a toothpick comes out clean
24. Allow to cool for 10 minutes , then tap it out of the cake pan onto a baking rack set over a sheet pan
25. Pour all of the rum syrup very slowly onto the warm cake , allowing it all to soak in thoroughly
26. Amazingly , the liquid will be absorbed into the cake , so be sure to use all of the syrup
27. Heat the preserves with 1 tablespoon of water until runny , press it through a sieve , and brush it on the cake
28. Serve with whipped cream piped into the middle of the cake plus an extra bowl on the side

title: baked bread stew
steps:
1. The day before serving , cut rye bread into thin slices
2. Lay out slices side by side and let dry overnight
3. The day of serving , peel onions and cut into rings
4. Heat butter , add onions and braise over low heat until translucent
5. Add stock and simmer for 20 minutes
6. In the meantime , cut cheese into small cubes
7. Wash chives and snip them
8. Preheat oven to 350f
9. Arrange one layer of bread on the bottom of a buttered , ovenproof , deep casserole dish
10. Sprinkle with some of the cheese cubes and chives , and season with pepper
11. Add enough onion stock just to cover this layer and continue layering the ingredients as above
12. Finish with a layer of cheese
13. Add enough onion stock just to cover it
14. Bake stew for 50 minutes until a golden brown crust has formed

title: thai basil eggplant
steps:
1. Peel eggplant if desired
2. Cut into irregular shapes but same sizes
3. That makes them easier to turn and keeps them from sticking to the pan
4. Heat wok over med-high heat
5. Add oil , peppers and garlic
6. Cook until garlic becomes lightly browned , 1-2 minutes
7. Add eggplant and stir
8. Add 1 / 2 cup water cover and simmer 5 minutes , until eggplant has soaked up most of the water and becomes translucent
9. You may need to add more water as it cooks
10. Add fish sauce and sugar
11. Stir gently
12. Turn off the heat and add the basil stir gently
13. Serve immediately
14. Really good with jasmine rice :o

title: tomato sandwich
steps:
1. Toast the bread and spread butter on one side of each piece
2. Arrange the tomato slices on one piece of the buttered toast
3. Salt and pepper the tomatoes
4. Top with second piece of buttered toast face down

title: annapolis crab appetizers
steps:
1. Split english muffins in half
2. In a medium bowl , mix together butter , cheese , mayonnaise , garlic powder , and old bay seasoning
3. Carefully add crab meat , being careful not to break it up to much
4. Spread crab mixture on muffins
5. Place muffin halves on cookie sheets and freeze
6. When ready to serve , remove from freezer and cut into quarters
7. Place under broiler until bubbly and lightly browned on top

title: oatmeal raisin cookies w  a kick
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Sift flour , baking soda , cinnamon , cloves , nutmeg , and salt in a bowl
3. Set aside
4. In a large mixing bowl , cream butter , sugar , and brown sugar till well blended
5. Add egg and vanilla
6. Mix well
7. Add flour mixture slowly
8. Mix just until blended
9. Fold in oats and raisins
10. Drop cookies by rounded spoonfuls on ungreased cookie sheets
11. Bake for 10-12 minutes until edges become light brown

title: buffalo chicken pizzas
steps:
1. Heat oven to 425f
2. Lightly coat cookie sheet with olive oil
3. Unroll dough
4. With sharp knife or pizza cutter , cut into 4 rectangles
5. Place rectangles on oiled cookie sheet
6. Press each to form 6x5-inch rectangle
7. Melt butter in large skillet over medium-high heat
8. Add chicken , onion and hot pepper sauce
9. Cook 4 to 6 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink in center , stirring occasionally
10. Remove from heat
11. Stir in tomatoes
12. With slotted spoon , spoon mixture over dough rectangles to within 1 / 4 inch of edges
13. Sprinkle evenly with cheese
14. Bake at 425f
15. For 13 to 16 minutes or until crust is deep golden brown

title: grilled potato salad
steps:
1. Prepare a charcoal or gas grill for direct grilling over medium-high heat
2. Bring a saucepan three-fourths full of water to a boil over high heat
3. Add the potatoes and cook just until they can be pierced with a knife , but are not completely tender , 5 to 7 minutes
4. Do not overcook
5. Drain and pat dry
6. Brush the potatoes with vegetable oil
7. Place the bacon in a cast-iron skillet over the hottest part of the charcoal fire or directly over the heat elements of the gas grill
8. Cook the bacon until crisp , 8 to 10 minutes
9. Transfer to paper towels to drain
10. Oil the grill rack
11. Grill the potatoes over the hottest part of the charcoal fire or directly over the heat elements of the gas grill , turning once or twice , until tender when pierced with the
12. Transfer the potatoes to a cutting board , let cool just until they can be handled , and then slice or cut into chunks , discarding any loose skin
13. To make the mustard vinaigrette , in a small bowl , whisk together the olive oil , vinegar , mustard , pickle , salt and pepper
14. In a large serving bowl , toss the warm potatoes , bell pepper , and onion with the vinaigrette until all the ingredients are evenly coated
15. Let stand for up to 30 minutes to blend the flavors
16. Crumble the bacon and mix it into the salad
17. Garnish with parsley
18. Serve at room temperature

title: chicken in tomato artichoke sauce
steps:
1. In a large skillet , brown chicken breasts in olive oil over medium heat
2. About 2 minutes per side
3. Add tomato sauce , artichokes , rosemary and basil
4. Bring to a boil
5. Reduce heat and simmer , covered , 10-12 minutes or until chicken is done
6. Remove chicken with a slotted spoon and place on a serving platter
7. Return sauce in skillet to a boil
8. Reduce heat and simmer , uncovered until desired consistancy
9. Spoon over chicken and sprinkle with olives
10. Serve

title: smoked ribs on the grill
steps:
1. Combine marinade ingredients and pour over ribs in a non-reactive dish , cover and place in the refrigerator for three hours or over night
2. Wood chips for smoke , oak , hickory , cherry , apple or mesquite , about three cups , soak in water for at least one hour
3. Make three pouches of soaked chips in tin foil , poke small holes with a fork into both sides of pouches , place one pouch on one side of grill with grate removed and heat on high until smoke starts , place ribs on grill over unlit side , lower heat to about 300 degrees , close lid
4. Allow ribs to smoke for 3 hours changing smoke pouch each hour
5. After 3 hours of cooking , check to see if any racks are ready to come off the grill
6. They are done when the meat has shrunk back from most of the bones by 1 / 4 inch or more
7. When you lift a rack by picking it up from one end with tongs , the rack should bend in the middle and the meat should tear easily
8. If the meat does not tear easily , continue to cook the ribs
9. The total cooking time could be anywhere from 3 to 4 1 / 2 hours
10. Remove and tent loosely with foil
11. Allow ribs to rest for 10 minutes
12. Ribs can also be cooked in smoker at 225 degrees for about 4-6 hours

title: emeril s beef chili cheese fries
steps:
1. Season onions with salt and cayenne and saute , stirring , until they begin to wilt , about 2 minutes
2. Add the beef , chili powder , cumin , red pepper , and oregano , season with salt and cayenne , and cook until meat is done
3. Add garlic , tomatoes , tomato paste and 2-1 / 2 cups beef stock , bring to boil and reduce heat to medium-low
4. Simmer uncovered about 1 hour , stirring occasionally and skimming fat that rises to the surface
5. Combine masa harina flour with remaining 1 / 2 cup stock
6. Slowly add to the pot , stirring to blend , which will thicken the mixture
7. Cook for 30 minutes and correct seasoning
8. From here , emeril deep fries his own shoestring french fries , but i use frozen french fries or waffle fries to save time
9. Prepare frozen potatoes as package directs
10. Lower oven heat to 400 degrees f , place fries in bottom of a large glass rectangular baking dish
11. Sprinkle cheeses over the fries and bake for 3 to 4 minutes
12. Remove pan from oven and spoon hot chili over the top of the fries
13. Garnish with sour cream and jalapeos and serve immediately

title: beef and bean chimichangas
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Brown beef in a skillet over medium high heat
3. Drain grease and add the onion , sweet pepper and corn
4. Cook for about 5 more minutes or until vegetables are tender
5. Stir in the taco sauce and seasonings
6. Stir and cook until blended and heated through
7. Set aside
8. Spread a thin layer of beans onto each of the tortillas
9. Spoon the beef mixture down the center and top with shredded cheese
10. Fold sides in and roll up , burrito style , and place seam side down onto a lightly greased jellyroll pan
11. Brush with melted butter
12. Bake for 15- 20 minutes or until golden brown
13. Serve with lettuce , tomato and sour cream

title: instant rice pudding
steps:
1. Combine cooked rice , milk , sugar and salt in a medium saucepan
2. Bring to a boil , then lower the heat to a simmer and stir in the vanilla
3. Cook until just about all of the milk is absorbed , stirring occasionally
4. Stir in cinnamon and nutmeg
5. Serve warm or chilled

title: green tomato preserves
steps:
1. Wash the tomatoes , core and cut into chunks
2. Place in a large canning kettle
3. Add the lemon juice and sugar , bring to a boil and continue boiling until syrup is thick
4. Ladle into hot sterilized jars and process in water bath as recommended in your area

title: mashed favas  broad beans    greens
steps:
1. Shuck the fresh beans , put in boiling water for apprx 10 minutes , dash with cold and remove outer membrane from each bean
2. If using frozen check that they are already cooked , if not follow instructions
3. Canned are ready as is , drained
4. Coursely mash the fava beans
5. I used a fork , you do not want to puree them just mash a bit
6. If using collards for the greens pre boil for 20 minutes , squeeze when cooked to get as much moisture out as possible , coarsely chop
7. With other greens wash them and allow the water to cling to the leaves
8. Coarsely chop
9. Pour half the oil into a skillet using medium heat saute the chopped garlic , stir , cook until it starts to color , apprx 5 minutes
10. Add favas , stir& heat through
11. Add greens , cover , allow the greens to wilt 3 minutes , and serve

title: lime garlic chicken with guacamole noodles
steps:
1. Place chicken in medium bowl and sprinkle with garlic powder
2. Add wine cooler , cover and refrigerate at least 30 minutes
3. Using colander , thoroughly drain marinade from chicken
4. Mix together flour , salt and pepper
5. Add chicken , turning to coat well
6. In large frypan over medium-high heat , place olive oil
7. Add chicken and stir-fry about 4 minutes or until fork can be inserted with ease
8. Drain noodles and mix with guacamole and sour cream
9. Arrange on serving platter and top with chicken
10. Sprinkle with cheese
11. Garnish with lime wedges and thin slices of avocado

title: ralph   kacoo s tartar sauce
steps:
1. Drain the juices from the relish , onions , and celery
2. Combine with mayonnaise

title: how to roast a chicken
steps:
1. Let the chicken and butter stand at room temperature for 30 minutes
2. Preheat oven to 425
3. Remove giblets from chicken , tuck wing
4. Place the palm of your hand on top of lemon and , pressing down , roll it back and forth on a work surface several times
5. Pierce the entire surface of the lemon with a fork
6. Using the side of a large knife , gently press on the garlic cloves to open slightly
7. Insert lemon , garlic , and rosemary into chicken cavity
8. In the center of a heavy-duty roasting pan , arrange the onion slices in two rows , letting the slices and rows touch
9. Place the chicken on top
10. Tie the chicken legs together with kitchen twine
11. Spread the softened butter over the entire surface of the chicken and season generously with salt and pepper
12. Roast until skin is crisp and deep golden brown and juices run clear when chicken is pierced with a fork , about 1 1 / 2 hours
13. Insert an instant-read thermometer into the breast , then the thigh
14. The chicken is ready when the breast or thigh reaches 165 degrees
15. Garnish with rosemary sprigs

title: sir george s apple fritters
steps:
1. Heat the beer to lukewarm
2. Put the yeast in a medium sized bowl and add 1 / 4 cup of the beer
3. Stir and let sit about 10 minutes
4. Mix in the flour , egg yolks or egg if desired , and salt
5. Add extra beer as needed to make this the consistency of pancake batter
6. Beat the mixture and then cover the bowl
7. Leave in a warm place for about an hour
8. It should at least double in bulk
9. Peel the apples , core them and cut into wedges or rings
10. Put the apple slices in the batter and stir to
11. Coat them
12. Fry quickly in oil or deep fat
13. Sprinkle with sugar and serve

title: sweet pickled garden vegetables
steps:
1. Using a glass bowl combine water , vinegar , sugar , sea salt , pickling spice , and peppercorns until well mixed
2. Wash and dry vegetables , than cut into florets
3. In another glass bowl place the vegetables and dill , then pour all the brine over them
4. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 3 to 4 days before serving

title: amish cream pie
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan , stir together the sugar , cornstarch and salt
2. Whisk in the half-and-half or light cream and cook and stir over medium heat until the mixture is thickened and bubbly
3. Remove from heat
4. Stir in butter , brown sugar and vanilla until butter melts
5. Pour into baked pie shell and sprinkle lightly with cinnamon
6. Bake the pie in a 325 oven for 30 minutes- the center of the pie will not be set
7. Cool the pie on a wire rack for 1 hour
8. Chill for 3 to 6 hours before serving- pie will set up upon chilling
9. Cover for longer storage

title: moonbeams
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375
2. In large mixer bowl combine 1 cups powdered sugar and butter
3. Beat at medium speed , scraping bowl often , until creamy , 1 to 2 minutes
4. Add egg and almond extract
5. Continue beating until well mixed , 1 to 2 minutes
6. Reduce speed to low
7. Add flour , cream of tartar and baking soda
8. Continue beating , scraping bowl often , until well mixed , 1 to 2 minutes
9. Shape into 1 inch balls
10. Roll balls into 2 inch ropes
11. Shape into crescents
12. Place 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheets
13. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes or until set
14. Cookies do not brown
15. Cool completely
16. Dip half of each cookie into chocolate
17. Sprinkle remaining half with powdered sugar
18. Refrigerate until set

title: super easy red beans and rice
steps:
1. Cook sausage 5-8 minutes over low heat
2. Add onion , green pepper , and garlic
3. Cook until tender
4. Drain
5. Add beans , tomatoes , and seasonings
6. Simmer uncovered 20 minutes
7. Serve over rice

title: ham and  corn chowder
steps:
1. Boil water
2. Meanwhile peel and dice potatoes
3. Boil for about 10-15 minutes
4. Meanwhile , dice up ham , onion , celery
5. In a large saucepan , saute the onion and celery in butter until softened
6. Stir in the flour and stir until well blended , then gradually add milk
7. Bring to a boil while stirring until thickened , about 2 minutes
8. Stir in remaining ingredients and bring to a boil
9. Reduce heat , cover and simmer about 15 minutes or until heated through

title: sugo di nocci
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f
2. Cook the pasta in lightly salted boiling water according to package directions
3. Spread walnuts on a baking sheet and place in oven for 7-8 minutes
4. Allow them to cool , then rub / shake them in a clean dry towel to remove skins , then leave to cool
5. Blend together the walnuts , butter , oil and garlic until they are reduced to a smoothish paste , transfer to a bowl , stir in half the cheese and season to taste
6. Stir 6 tablespoons of boiling salted water into the walnut paste
7. Drain the pasta , transfer to a warmed dish and mix well with the walnut paste and chopped tomato
8. Serve with the remaining cheese on top

title: sassy barbecued shrimp
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients except cooking spray in a large zip-top plastic bag
2. Seal bag and shake to coat
3. Marinate in the refrigerator for 15 minutes
4. Prepare grill or broiler
5. Remove shrimp from bag
6. Reserve marinade
7. Thread 4 shrimp onto each of 8
8. Place kebabs on grill rack or broiler pan coated with cooking spray
9. Cook 3 minutes on each side or until done
10. Baste frequently with reserved marinade

title: simple sliced tomato and cheese side dish
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 deg f / 180 deg c , or less for a fan / convection oven
2. Line a dish with baking paper to save on the washing up !
3. Slice the tomatoes fairly thickly , and arrange one overlapping layer in the dish
4. Sprinkle with basil , sea salt and coarse black pepper
5. Drizzle over about 2 - 3 tablespoons ketchup
6. Slice the brie
7. Arrange the slices over the tomato slices
8. Add a 2nd layer of sliced tomatoes , and season like the previous layer
9. Add all leftover cheese , and use more if you like , and sprinkle with coarse black pepper to taste
10. Drizzle with olive oil
11. Slice the onion thinly and put rings and slices all over the dish
12. Now arrange the crustless bread slices over the tomato dish so that the top is completely covered
13. You may have to cut the bread slices to fit
14. Sprinkle liberally with olive oil
15. Bake the dish for about 20 - 25 minutes , until the bread topping is crisp and browned
16. Yes , tomato liquid will form in the bottom of the dish -- dip extra bread in it , or drink it with a spoon because it's delicious !

title: chocolate corn flake candy
steps:
1. Melt chocolate in top of double boiler over hot water
2. Mix corn flakes and nuts in a large bowl
3. Pour melted chocolate over this mixture
4. Stir until well coated
5. Drop by teaspoon full onto wax paper
6. Can also be put into candy cups

title: chicken dorito
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Boil and bone one chicken , so you end up with chopped chicken meat
3. Save the broth for another recipe
4. You can also use canned cooked chicken or cooked chicken breasts / thighs
5. In a microwave safe bowl , stir together the velveeta cubes , cheddar cheese , cream of mushroom soup , chopped green chilies , chopped onion , and one can of chopped ro-tel tomatoes
6. Microwave 2 minutes , remove and stir
7. In a large pan , layer: dorito chips , chicken , cheese mixture , doritos , chicken , cheese mixture
8. Bake in a 375f oven for about 30 minutes , until the cheese is brown and bubbly

title: crock pot honey orange chicken
steps:
1. Place frozen thighs in the crock pot
2. Whisk remaining ingredients except broccoli , cornstarch , water and rice together and pour over chicken
3. Cook on low 4 to 5 hours
4. If using broccoli , add to crock pot 1 hour before chicken is done
5. Before serving , remove chicken and broccoli to serving dish and keep warm
6. Turn crock pot on high
7. Stir cornstarch into water and add to crock pot
8. Stir occasionally until it thickens and bubbles
9. Serve over the cooked rice

title: ricotta  lemon and honey fritters
steps:
1. Place the the ricotta , egg , flour , sugar and lemon zest in a medium-sized bowl and , using a hand-held whisk or an electric beater , whisk until almost smooth
2. Cover and place in the fridge for 10 minutes to chill
3. Heat the oil in a medium pan , preferably non-stick , over a medium heat , and spoon tablespoons of the mixture into the hot oil
4. Cook , turning often , for 2-3 minutes or until golden brown
5. Transfer to a plate lined with paper towel , and repeat with the remaining mixture
6. Divide the fritters among the serving plates , drizzle with honey and serve immediately

title: berry truffle pie
steps:
1. Directions
2. 1
3. Prepare and / or bake pastry shell
4. Set aside
5. In a saucepan combine chocolate and butter
6. Heat and stir over medium-low heat until melted
7. Add cream cheese and liqueur
8. Heat and stir until combined
9. Remove from heat
10. Stir in the powdered sugar
11. Spread in baked pastry shell
12. Arrange strawberries and mixed berries on filling , placing strawberries stem ends down
13. Melt jelly
14. Brush over berries
15. Cover
16. Chill for 4 hours
17. 2
18. Let pie stand at room temperature for 30 minutes before serving
19. Beat whipping cream with the 2 tablespoons powdered sugar and the orange peel until soft peaks form
20. Spoon or pipe whipped cream into center of pie
21. Makes 8 servings

title: cheesy tomato chicken or turkey spaghetti casserole
steps:
1. Grease a 13 x 9-inch casserole dish
2. Cook the pasta in a large pot of boiling water until al dente
3. Drain but do not rinse
4. Place the cooked pasta in a bowl then toss with 1-2 tablespoons oil to prevent sticking
5. Set aside
6. Melt the butter in a large dutch oven over medium heat
7. Add in mushrooms with onion , bell pepper and celery
8. Saute stirring for about 7 minutes or until veggies are tender , adding in the garlic and cayenne pepper the last few minutes of cooking
9. Add in chicken , velveeta cheese , diced tomatoes and corn
10. Reduce heat to low and stir until the cheese has melted and ingredients are well combined
11. Season with salt and black pepper
12. Add in the cooked pasta and toss to combine well
13. Transfer and spread into prepared casserole dish
14. In a small bowl combined the dry breadcrumbs with parmesan cheese , then sprinkle over the top of the casserole
15. Drizzle melted butter on top
16. Bake uncovered at 350 degree f for about 20-22 minutes or until bubbly

title: da best guacamole
steps:
1. Cut avocadoes , remove pit and scoop out --place into medium sized bowl
2. Mash avocado well with fork
3. Add remaining ingredients and mix well
4. Serve chilled with tortilla chips
5. Enjoy !

title: lemon shake ups
steps:
1. Pour sugar into glass or jar
2. Pour enough water to cover the top of the sugar
3. Let sugar disintegrate for at least 5 minutes
4. Squeeze juice from 1 / 2 lemon into sugar water
5. Fill glass with water and ice
6. Shake
7. Top with 1 / 2 lemon

title: cream custard cake filling
steps:
1. Mix the sugar , flour and salt together in a double boiler and add the hot milk gradually , stirring constantly
2. Cook until the mixture thickens
3. Pour a small amount over the eggs and mix thoroughly
4. Add back into the first mixture and cook for two more minutes
5. Remove from heat and cool
6. Add vanilla

title: no bake cherry cheesecake for valentine s day
steps:
1. Blend the crumbs and sugar together in a bowl , then add the melted butter
2. Stir until mixed then press into a heart-shaped silicone mold
3. Bake at 375 degrees f for 8-10 minutes , remove from oven and set aside to cool
4. With an electric mixer , the beat cream cheese until fluffy
5. Add the sweetened condensed milk and continue beating until well blended
6. In a separate bowl , beat the whipping cream until stiff
7. Fold the whipped cream into cream cheese mixture until well blended
8. Add cherry filling to the filling mixture
9. This will give your cheesecake that nice , valentine's day pink tint
10. Spread the mixture over the cooled crust and refrigerate for at least 3 hours
11. Garnish with your choice of chocolate shavings , cherries , whipped cream , or berries

title: roasted corn salad
steps:
1. Place corn in a large container
2. Add cold water to cover
3. Let stand for 30 minutes
4. Meanwhile heat grill to medium-high direct heat
5. Remove corn from water
6. Do not remove husks
7. Place corn on grill
8. Grill covered 10 minutes , turning occasionally
9. Remove from grill
10. Do not turn grill off
11. Cool corn slightly
12. Remove husk and silk
13. Blend butter , 1 tbsp olive oil , cumin , chili powder , and salt in a small bowl
14. Place corn on grill
15. Brush with butter mixture
16. Grill 4 to 7 minutes longer , or until lightly charred , turning and basting once
17. Remove from grill
18. Cut corn from the cob
19. Combine corn , olives , onion , cilantro , tomato , remaining 3 tbsp olive oil , and vinegar in a medium bowl
20. Mix well

title: cinnamon candy popcorn
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 250
2. Pop 1 cup of popcorn --
3. Butter a large roasting pan
4. Combine the popped corn in the prepared pan
5. Place in the oven while preparing the glaze
6. Place red hot candies in a 2 cup measure and fill to the top with granulated sugar
7. Boil red hot candy , sugar , butter , corn syrup and salt for 5 minutes
8. Remove from the heat and add baking soda and oil --
9. Stir well and pour over popped corn , tossing quickly to distribute evenly
10. Bake for 1 hour , stirring every 15 minutes
11. Remove from oven , using a metal spatula , free popcorn from the bottom of pan
12. Let cool completely in the pan
13. Break into clumps
14. Store in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 1 week

title: adie s short ribs
steps:
1. Cut ribs into 2 inch lengths
2. Mix flour , salt , pepper and roll ribs until coated
3. Place in a large roasting pan with a lid
4. Arrange in a large casserole and cover with sliced onions
5. Mix together the catsup , vinegar , worcestershire sauce , soy sauce , sugar and water
6. Pour over ribs
7. Cover and bake in a slow oven , 300 degrees , for 3 hours

title: strawberry chocolate nutella pie
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , beat softened cream cheese , powdered sugar and nutella with a mixer on medium speed until creamy
2. Spread mixture evenly in pie crust
3. Refrigerate
4. Slice and mash about 3 / 4 cup of the strawberries
5. In a medium saucepan , mix the mashed berries , granulated sugar , cornstarch and water
6. Heat over high heat until boiling , stirring constantly
7. Continue to boil and stir another minute
8. Remove from heat and cool in the refrigerator for about 10 minutes
9. Meanwhile , slice remaining strawberries
10. When glaze is cool , pour over sliced berries and toss to combine
11. Spoon strawberries into the pie pan
12. Refrigerate until ready to serve , up to 8 hours
13. Slice and serve with whipped cream

title: pierogies in pepper shallot sauce  crock pot
steps:
1. In a 5-6 quart slow cooker , combine the crushed tomatoes , shallots , peppers , oil , vinegar , italian seasoning and black pepper
2. Cover , and cook on low for 5-9 hours , or on high for 4-5 hours
3. Add in the pierogies
4. Cover , and cook for 1 hour

title: rara meat  mutton in  whole  spices
steps:
1. Whisk together the yogurt and salt and marinade the lamb in it for an hour
2. Heat the oil in a pot and crackle bay leaves and both the cardamoms in it
3. Add the onions and saut till light brown
4. Add ginger and garlic pastes and stir for 4 to 5 minutes
5. Stir in coriander , turmeric and red chilli powders
6. Add the lamb with the marinade , bring to boil then reduce flame
7. Let simmer , adding 3 teaspoons water at intervals
8. Cook until tender
9. Add the tomatoes , chopped garlic and ginger and stir
10. Then add the cumin and whole red chillies
11. Cook on low flame till the lamb pieces are coated with the masala and tender

title: baked asparagus with lemon dressing
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Lightly coat asparagus with 2 tablespoons oil and salt and pepper
3. Bake for 10 minutes
4. Whisk together remaining 1 cup oil and the lemon juice
5. Add salt and pepper to taste
6. Remove asparagus from oven , and set on serving platter and drizzle with dressing

title: midori pina colada
steps:
1. In a blender , combine ingredients with ice until well blended
2. Pour into tall glass and garnish with cherry
3. Insert straw and sip

title: harvest sausage soup
steps:
1. Bring stock to a boil in a large pot
2. Add potatoes to stock
3. Boil for 10 minutes
4. Remove sausage meat from casings and form into 1 / 2" meatballs
5. When all meatballs are formed , gently add them and the red bell pepper to the broth
6. Turn down heat to medium and cook for 5 minutes
7. Add tomatoes in their juice , corn , and sugar
8. Stir all ingredients together
9. Simmer on medium-low for 20 minutes , stirring occasionally
10. Enjoy !
11. Optional: for added flair , serve with a french baguette and your favorite zinfandel or merlot

title: californian cinco de mayo rice
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit
2. Grease casserole dish
3. Combine all ingredients and put into a greased casserole dish
4. Bake for 30 minutes

title: romanian bean soup
steps:
1. Soak lima beans in cold water overnight
2. Drain the lima beans and rinse in several changes of water to float away as many loosened shells as possible
3. Place beans in crockpot with 8 cups fresh water , the chopped onion , carrot , garlic and bouillon cube
4. Cover tightly and cook 18 to 24 hours on low until beans are very tender
5. Remove from heat and let cool a little
6. In the meantime , heat the butter in a skillet and saute the finely diced onion until it is very brown
7. Ladle a small amount of soup at a time into blender or bowl of a food processor and puree until all soup is pureed
8. Return to pot and stir in browned onions
9. Taste for seasoning and add salt and pepper to taste

title: layered mexican bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Brown meat with onions and peppers in large skillet on medium-high heat
3. Stir in chili powder
4. Cook 1 minute
5. Add salsa and corn
6. Mix well
7. Simmer 5 minutes
8. Spread 1 cup meat mixture onto bottom of 8 or 9-inch square baking dish
9. Top with layers of 1 tortilla , 1 / 2 cup meat sauce , sour cream and 1 / 4 cup cheese
10. Cover with 1 tortilla , 1 cup of remaining meat sauce and 1 / 4 cup of remaining cheese
11. Top with remaining tortilla and meat sauce
12. Cover with foil
13. Bake 25 minutes or until casserole is heated through
14. Top with remaining cheese
15. Bake , uncovered 5 minutes or until melted
16. May garnish with chopped cilantro or green onions just before serving

title: yeasted potato biscuits
steps:
1. Stir the yeast into 1 / 4 cup warm water in a small bowl and set aside
2. Slowly warm the buttermilk with the butter and sugar in a small pan
3. When the butter has melted , pour the liquid into a bowl and beat in the potatoes , salt , 1 / 4 cup of the flour , and the proofed yeast
4. Cover and let stand until light and foamy , about 30 minutes
5. Stir in the remaining flour until no more can be added easily , then knead the dough until smooth and elastic
6. Cover and let rise until doubled in bulk , 45-60 minutes
7. Turn it out , then roll into a circle about 1 / 3" thick and cut into 2" rounds
8. Place on a lightly greased sheet pan , cover , and let rise again until nearly doubled , 45-60 minutes
9. Preheat the oven to 400f
10. Brush the biscuits with the beaten egg and bake until the biscuits are golden , about 20 minutes
11. Enjoy !

title: majarete   corn pudding dessert
steps:
1. Scrape off the grains from the cobs using a knife
2. Mix all the ingredients and blend
3. Pass the mixture through a strain and reserve
4. Put it in a pot and cook at medium heat , stirring constantly to avoid sticking
5. When it becomes thick turn off the heat
6. Serve immediately in small bowls sprinkling the top with the cinnamon powder
7. Let cool to room temperature , then put it in the refrigerator for 15 minutes before serving

title: horseradish breaded chicken breast
steps:
1. Pound chicken breasts until they are about 1 / 4 of an inch thin
2. Mix together horseradish , mustard , lemon juice , salt , pepper , chives and thyme
3. Coat chicken breasts in the horseradish mix
4. Coat chicken breasts in bread crumbs
5. Heat up vegetable oil in a large pan
6. Add the chicken breasts to the pan
7. Once a nice golden-brown crust forms on the bottom , flip the chicken over and cook the other side
8. By the time the crust browns up , the chicken should be done--maybe 7-10 minutes

title: banana punch
steps:
1. Bring water and sugar to a boil
2. Boil for 3 minutes and let cool
3. Make frozen juices according to can directions
4. Mix bananas and all juices together , then add the sugar water
5. Freeze mixture
6. Let thaw 2 or 3 hours before serving
7. Just before serving , add the 7 up , slowly
8. Serve while still slushy
9. Enjoy ! !

title: beef and beans pasta
steps:
1. Heat olive oil in a large skillet , then brown the beef with chili powder and herbs for about 5 minutes over medium heat
2. Stir in beef stock and pasta sauce and bring mixture to boil
3. Reduce the heat and simmer for 15 minutes , stirring occasionally
4. Add beans , corn and pepper , then cook for another 5 minutes
5. While the sauce is simmering , prepare the pasta according to the package instructions
6. Drain pasta and serve hot with the sauce
7. Sprinkle with grated parmesan and fresh herbs , if desired , just prior to serving

title: crock pot sloppy joes
steps:
1. The reason i say 4 to 6 lbs of hamburger is if you like is open faced and messy then use 4lbs but if you like is firmer so you can hold it in your hand then use 6lbs either way brown the hamburger , drain fat and toss it in the crock pot
2. Add the rest
3. Leave on low for 4 or more hours on low
4. I get one meal that night and freeze two for later

title: glazed chicken kahlua
steps:
1. Blend jelly , barbecue sauce and 2 jiggers of kahlua together throughly
2. Dip chicken breasts into sauce and place into casserole dish
3. I usually pour any extra sauce over chicken
4. Bake on 350 degrees for 1 1 / 2 hours , turning and basting as needed
5. During the last 1 / 2 hour , add 1 jigger of kahlua to the sauce pan

title: ww weight watchers orange cream cheese cookie cups 1 point
steps:
1. Instructions
2. Preheat oven to 350f
3. Coat two 12-cup miniature muffin pans with cooking spray
4. Set aside
5. To prepare cookie dough , in a large mixing bowl combine 2 ounces cream cheese , milk and margarine
6. Beat on low speed until blended
7. In a small bowl , combine flour and 1 tablespoon sugar
8. Beat flour mixture into cream cheese mixture on low speed until blended
9. Transfer cookie dough to a lightly floured surface and knead gently 4 times
10. Divide dough into 24 equal portions and press each portion into bottom and up sides of prepared muffin pans
11. Set aside
12. To prepare filling , in a food processor or large bowl combine remaining 6 ounces cream cheese , 1 / 3 cup sugar , egg , orange juice , zest and vanilla
13. Blend until smooth
14. Spoon 2 teaspoons filling into prepared cookie cups
15. Bake until filling is set and edges are golden , 20 to 25 minutes
16. Cool on wire racks
17. Yields one cookie cup per serving

title: easy oreo ice cream cake
steps:
1. Allow the ice cream to melt in a large bowl till it is just a thick , soupy mixture
2. Crush the entire package of oreos in a food processor
3. Mix the melted ice cream and the cool whip together
4. Take a 9 by 13 pan and layer the oreos and the ice cream mixture
5. Start with the ice cream and then add oreos then the ice cream and so on
6. Put it in the freezer over night or at least 8 hours covered in plastic wrap and then serve with dribbled chocolate sauce on top

title: lemon spaghetti with parmesan
steps:
1. Cook spaghetti according to pkg directions
2. While pasta cooks , in a large frying pan , saute garlic in oil over low heat until golden
3. Drain cooked pasta and add to garlic and oil , increasing heat to medium , tossing until well coated
4. Add lemon juice , lemon zest and fresh basil and remove from heat
5. Toss until well mixed
6. Serve garnished with parmesan cheese

title: butterscotch pie my way
steps:
1. In a large microwave safe bowl , combine the brown sugar , cornstarch , salt , and milk
2. Combine well , then cook on high in the microwave for 8 minutes
3. Remove the bowl from the microwave
4. Pour a small amount of the mixture into a small bowl
5. Add the egg yolks to the smaller bowl , mixing until well-combined
6. Pour the egg mixture back into the large bowl , combining well
7. Return the bowl back to the microwave and cook on high for and additional 1-2 minutes , until the mixture has thickened
8. Remove from the microwave and stir in the butter and vanilla
9. Stir until the butter has melted
10. Pour into the prepared pie shell and chill for at least 2 hours

title: kart wheels
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375
2. Mix flour , butter , powdered sugar , baking powder and just enough milk until dough forms
3. Dive dough into 6 equal parts
4. Shape each part into a ball
5. Place on an ungreased cookie sheet
6. Flatten slightly
7. Make an indentation , 1 3 / 4 inches in diameter and about 3 / 4 inch deep , in center of each flattened ball
8. Fill each indentation with about 2 tablespoons of pie filling
9. Bake until the edges begin to brown , 20 to 25 minutes

title: easy brownie peanut butter bites
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees f
2. Prepare 40-48 mini muffin cups with mini paper liners
3. In a bowl , combine the brownie mix , water , oil and the egg
4. Beat with a wooden spoon
5. Fill the mini muffin tins half full with the chocolate mixture then press one peanut butter cup into the batter into each cup
6. Bake for 15-20 minutes , or until the brownies are set
7. Cool completely

title: braciole  pronounced   brajole
steps:
1. Get butcher to pound the meat thin , or you can have the butcher slice it thin on an electric slicer
2. If you are getting your meat from a store that does not have a butcher to pound the meat slices thin , then place a slice between 2 pieces of waxed paper and pound it yourself with either a heavy skillet or a mallet
3. Combine filling ingredients and the prosciutto di parma and mix together very thoroughly with a spoon or your hands
4. After the ingredients are mixed together , add the pieces of bread and mix again , lightly
5. Cut each slice in half to make 4 pieces and top with 2 slices of mozzarella or fontina cheese and 2 slices of the prosciutto di parma per braciole
6. Then spread ingredients on top
7. Fold in the sides and roll them up longways very tightly , as you would an egg roll , securing the rolls with string or wooden toothpicks
8. Each roll will be about 5 inches long and about 1 1 / 2 inches thick
9. Pour olive oil into a large and very hot skillet
10. Brown beef rolls on all sides in the hot olive oil
11. Transfer the rolls to a pot and cover with the marinara sauce and then cover with lid and simmer for 30 minutes
12. I suggest my marinara sauce , recipe #84217
13. To serve , slice the bracioles crosswise diagonally and also in slightly larger pieces crosswise
14. You can also serve the bracioles without slicing them
15. Serve 1 braciole per person

title: bacon cheese topped chicken
steps:
1. In a bowl , combine the mustard , honey , 1 1 / 2 t
2. Oil and lemon juice
3. Pour 1 / 2 cup into a large resealable plastic bag
4. Add the chicken
5. Seal bag and turn to coat
6. Refrigerate 2 hours
7. Cover and refrigerate the remaining marinade
8. Drain and discard marinade from chicken
9. In a large skillet over medium heat , brown chicken in remaining oil on all sides
10. Sprinkle with salt , pepper and paprika
11. Transfer to a greased 11 x 7 x 2 inch baking dish
12. In the same skillet , saute mushrooms in butter until tender
13. Spoon reserved marinade over chicken
14. Top with cheeses and mushrooms
15. Place bacon stirps in a crisscross pattern over chicken
16. Bake , uncovered , at 375 for 20-25 minutes or until a meat thermometer reads 160
17. Sprinkle with parsley

title: garlic shrimp grill
steps:
1. Thread four shrimp onto each skewer
2. Set aside
3. Melt butter in a small saucepan
4. Add garlic and red pepper
5. Simmer for one minute , and stir in basil
6. Brush each skewer with garlic butter and season both sides with salt and pepper
7. Place on grill over medium heat and cook , brushing with extra garlic butter if desired , for appoximately 4 minutes per side or until pink
8. Enjoy !

title: best cheese biscuits
steps:
1. Measure first 4 ingredients into bowl
2. Add grated cheese
3. Stir
4. Add cooking oil and milk
5. Stir to form a soft ball of dough
6. Add more milk if needed to make dough soft
7. Turn out on lightly floured board and knead gently 8-10 times
8. Roll to 3 / 4 to 1 inch thick
9. Cut with biscuit cutter
10. Place on ungreased cookie sheet close together for moist sides or 1 inch apart for crisp sides
11. Bake in 425 degree oven for 15 minutes or until nicely browned
12. Serve plain or with butter

title: teff muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Oil a 24 mini muffin-cup pan
3. In a medium sized mixing bowl , add the teff flour , tapioca flour , ground flax , baking powder , baking soda , xanthan gum , sea salt , cinnamon , and nutmeg
4. Whisk together well
5. In another mixing bowl , whisk together the orange juice , applesauce , agave nectar , and oil
6. Add the wet ingredients to the dry and whisk together
7. Then add dried fruit , and grated carrots , and diced apples
8. Continue to mix with a large wooden spoon until all of the ingredients are combined
9. Be sure to not over mix the batter !
10. Spoon batter into oiled muffin cups and bake for about 10 to 15 minutes
11. Cool muffins on a wire rack

title: sweet sausages
steps:
1. Cut sausage into 1-inch rounds
2. Place in large skillet and cover with maple syrup
3. Heat until boiling , reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes
4. Sausages can be cooked in crock pot on low for 2 hours

title: mimi s double decker peanut butter   chocolate fudge
steps:
1. In sauce pan , melt peanut butter chips , 1 cup sweetened condensed milk , and 2 tbsp butter
2. Stir until smooth
3. Remove from heat and stir in peanuts , if desired
4. Spread mixture into wax-paper lined 8-inch square pan
5. In same pan , melt chocolate chips , remaining butter , and remaining condensed milk
6. Stir until smooth and spread over the peanut butter layer
7. Cool at room temperature for 15 minutes , then refrigerate until firm
8. To cut into squares , lift fudge out by holding the wax paper
9. Transfer to cutting board
10. Store in a closed tin
11. Can be refrigerated or kept at room temperature

title: kim s midnight brownie recipe as seen on dr  oz
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Lightly spray a 8x8 baking dish with nonstick cooking spray
3. In a food processor , or blender , mix all brownie ingredients together
4. Chop on high , until smooth
5. Clean off sides and blend for another 20 seconds
6. Add the chips in and stir well
7. Spread into the 8x8 baking dish
8. Cook for 20 minutes , until toothpick comes out clean
9. Cool for about 1 hour in dish at room temperature

title: ultimate mud cake
steps:
1. Grease 22 cm round tin , and line with baking paper
2. Make sure paper is extended 5cms above top of tin
3. Cut unsalted butter cut into cubes
4. Melt chocolate , butter , water and coffee over hot water bath
5. Stir to combine and cool
6. Sift plain flour , self raising flour , cocoa powder and bi-carb soda into a bowl
7. Stir in castor sugar
8. Make a well in the centre
9. In a jug mix together eggs , oil and buttermilk
10. Stir egg mixture into flour mixture with large metal spoon do not to overstir
11. Then gradually stir in melted chocolate mixture
12. Pour mixture into prepared tin , and bake at 160 c for 1 hour and 45 minutes
13. If cake still looks wet / raw in middle , bake for 5-10 mins more
14. When cooked , remove from oven
15. Cool in tin until completely cold before turning out
16. Can be refridgerated in an airtight container for up to 3 weeks , or in a cool dry place for 1 week
17. Can be frozen for up to 2 months
18. Decorate cake as desired with your favourite ganache recipe

title: chocolate roses
steps:
1. In a shallow bowl , melt the chocolate in microwave for 2 minutes
2. Stir
3. If chocolate is not completely melted , return to microwave for 30 seconds at a time and stir until smooth
4. Add corn syrup to the chocolate and mix well
5. Using a rubber spatula , stir and fold mixture , scraping the sides and bottom of the bowl well , until no shiny syrup is visible and the mixture forms a thick ball
6. Pour mixture onto a waxed paper sheet and spread with the spatula until it's about 1 / 2-inch thick
7. Let it sit and stiffen , uncovered , for about 2 hours
8. Use at once or store in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 1 month
9. To make chocolate roses: knead a handful of clay at a time on a work surface until it is soft and pliable like play-doh
10. Roll dough into twelve 1 / 2-inch diameter balls of clay
11. Place the balls on waxed paper or plastic wrap about 1-inch apart
12. Using your fingers , press in the center and then on either side , flattening the disk into 1-inch flat disks about the size of a quarter (leave the top edge thinner than and bottom edge
13. Repeat with the remaining disks
14. Remove one disk and curl it into a "teepee" shape , narrow at the top and wider at the bottom , (this will be the center of the rose
15. Wrap the next disk around the opening of the teepee and the third disk at the back of the teepee - this is the rose bud
16. Continue adding disks which will look like petals
17. Continue adding petals , placing them in between slightly lower than previous row
18. For a fuller flower , continue adding petals in this manner
19. As you form petals , you gently roll or curl the right edge of the petal downward
20. Pinch off any excess chocolate clay at the base of the rose to make more balls
21. To periodically cool you hands , grasp a cold glass
22. To make larger roses , make larger chocolate clay balls

title: low carb and fruity cheesecake squares
steps:
1. Take the cream cheese out of the fridge about 1 / 2 an hour before starting the recipe to soften the cheese
2. Sprinkle the gelatin into the boiling water and stir until completely dissolved
3. In a bowl , beat the cream cheese until it gets really creamy
4. With the mixer still running , add the gelatin , 1 / 4 cup at a time , and mix until completely combined
5. Pour the cheese mixture into an 8x8 pan and refrigerate until firm , about two hours

title: mocha frappe
steps:
1. Stir together coffee , sugar , and 1 tbs milk in a small glass measuring cup
2. Pour into ice cube trays and freeze at least 2 hours , or until firm
3. Process coffee ice cubes 1 1 / 4 cups milk , and chocolate syrup into a blender until smooth
4. Dollop evenly with whipped topping and sprinlke with chocolate shavings
5. Serve immediately

title: apple delight canadian 1962
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees f
2. Toss prepared apples with 1 / 4 cup of the white sugar , cinnamon , and nutmeg
3. Spread into a buttered 9 inch baking pan
4. Mix the flour , bread crumbs , remaining 1 / 4 cup white sugar , shredded cheese , almonds and raisins
5. Sprinkle mixture evenly over the apples
6. Bake 40 minutes or until golden and apples are tender
7. Serve warm with whipping cream , or ice cream
8. Apple recommended is gala , granny smith , ida red , pinks , or spartan , an apple that holds its shape when cooked

title: m o m pancakes
steps:
1. Combine dry ingredients and liquid ingredients in separate bowls
2. Add liquid mixture to dry mixture , stirring until combined
3. Let set for 5 minutes
4. Pour 1 / 4 cup batter onto hot non-stick griddle
5. Cook until tops are bubbly and edges look dry
6. Turn and cook until lightly browned

title: state fair mini corn dogs
steps:
1. Heat oil to 375f
2. Get out 4 thawed hot dogs and lay on paper towels to dry
3. Combine all dry ingredients and blend well
4. Stir in milk
5. Add just enough water so that it sticks well to the spoon without running off
6. Finish patting dry the hot dogs
7. I cut my hot dogs into thirds and make bite size corn dogs
8. Take a paper sucker stick , put it into one side of the hot dog , dip it into the bowl of batter and spoon batter over to evenly coat
9. Put it into the deep fryer , using another stick to push it off of the other
10. I suggest holding it up a little bit with the stick if you are using a deep fryer with a basket , this will allow the bottom to begin cooking before it gets caught in the basket
