11. Fry until golden brown , about 5 minutes
12. Let cool on paper towels to remove excess oil
13. Prep time does not include the amount of time it takes individual deep fryers to heat up

title: vodka espresso
steps:
1. Method:
2. Shake coffee , vodka and sugar together with cubed ice , strain into glass ,
3. Layer amarula on top

title: sugared pluots on crisp anise scented phyllo
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f toast anise seeds in a skillet over medum heat , shaking occasionally , until fragant , 3-5 minutes
2. Cool 3 minutes
3. Crush lightly with a mortar and pestle or the side of a chef's knife
4. Trim phyllo sheets into 12 x 10 rectangles
5. Lay 1 rectangle on a baking sheet , and brush lightly with melted butter , coating entire surface
6. Sprinkle with 1 teaspoons sugar and 1 / 4 teaspoons anise seeds , and top with another phyllo sheet , repeat 5 times
7. Arrange pluot slices on phyllo in five rows of five , spacing each row about 1 / 2 inch apart
8. Sprinkle with remaining 2 teaspoons sugar , and brush pluot slices with remaining butter
9. Bake until crisp and golden brown , 15-17 minutes
10. Using a spatula , transfer to a wire rack to cool slightly
11. Cut into squares and serve

title: delux mac and cheese with shrimp and crab
steps:
1. In a pot of salted water , cook macaroni until tender , about 8 - 10 minutes
2. Preheat oven to 350
3. Lightly butter an 8 x 8 baking dish and set aside
4. In a large sauce pot , add the butter over medium heat
5. Add the flour and cook , stirring for 2 minutes
6. Using a whisk , slowly add the milk and cook until it thickens
7. Remove the sauce from heat and mix in the cream , paprika , cayenne , salt and pepper
8. Add 3 / 4 of the cheese
9. When the macaroni is cooked , drain it well
10. Add to it , the shrimp , crab and basil and gently add the white sauce
11. Spoon macaroni mixture into the prepared baking dish
12. Top with the remaining chedar and parmesan cheese
13. Bake for 25 - 30 minutes or until the top is lightly golden

title: the dangerous breakfast sandwich
steps:
1. Timing is of the essence here , so be very careful at preparing this delicate sandwich
2. Preheat oven to 350
3. Place english muffins on a cookie sheet and butter well
4. Just like you would be making toast
5. Don't place them in the oven yet
6. Wait till you finish with the bacon
7. Fry up the bacon , but do not throw out the bacon grease
8. Ok , here we go-- place the english muffins in the oven and start the eggs
9. You'll want to fry your sunny side up eggs inside the bacon grease
10. Do not over cook the eggs
11. Kind of swoop a little grease on top of them to cook on top
12. After the english muffins are finished , place a cooked sunny side up egg on top of one muffin
13. Place four slices of bacon on top of the egg , and thin a slice of cheese on top of the bacon
14. Cover with the the other english muffin
15. Carefully place on a plate
16. Now , serving--this is dangerous:
17. Once you grab a hold of this sandwich and take a bite out of it , it will pop and yolk will go all over the plate
18. Using the bacon grease with the eggs can be dangerous , so please be careful--very greasy but enjoy !

title: lemony poppy seed bread
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees
2. Using solid shortening , grease and flour bottom only of 9 x 5 inch loaf pan
3. In large bowl , blend all ingredients at low speed until moistened
4. Beat 2 minutes at medium speed
5. Pour batter into prepared pan
6. Bake at 350 degrees for 50 to 60 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
7. Cool 15 minutes
8. Remove from pan
9. Wrap tightly and store in refrigerator

title: mediterranean vegetable quiche
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375-degrees f
2. Clean and chop all vegetables to bite size pieces
3. In a large skillet over medium heat saute the onions in half of the olive oil or butter until translucent
4. Stir in mushrooms and saute for 3-5 minutes longer , season with salt and pepper
5. Set aside
6. In a seperate skillet saute the zucchini and asparagus in the remaining oil or butter
7. Cook until tender
8. When vegetables have cooled squeeze out all excess moisture
9. In a mixing bowl beat eggs , nutmeg , salt and pepper and half and half together
10. In a partially baked 9-inch pie crust or crust fitted in a quiche pan , spread onion / mushroom mixture on bottom of crust , then add asparagus / zucchini mixture and then the goat cheese
11. Finally pour in the egg mixture
12. Bake for 25-35 minutes or until cooked and top is set
13. Place quiche under broiler very briefly to brown

title: roasted corn chicken tortilla soup
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat
2. Add onion and cook until translucent , about 3 minutes
3. Add garlic
4. Cook 1 minute , add paprika , cumin , chilies and pepper , cook , stirring , 5 minutes
5. Add corn cobs , chicken , tortilla pieces , tomatoes and broth
6. Heat to boil , lower heat and simmer 1 hour
7. Remove the chicken to a platter
8. Cool briefly
9. Pull the meat from the bones
10. Discard bones and skin , reserve meat
11. Strain the soup into a large bowl
12. Pour back into the pot and add lime juice , cilantro and salt
13. Portion chicken meat and corn kernels into serving bowls
14. Ladle soup over
15. Add optional garnishes at the table
16. Roastears of corn in a 400 oven , turning often until they start to brown , about 10 minutes
17. Toasttortillas in a dry skillet over medium heat until starting to brown , about 30 seconds on each side

title: onion cucumber salad
steps:
1. In a bowl , combine oil , vinegar , sugar , water , sour cream and salt
2. Add cucumber and onion
3. Toss to coat
4. Refrigerate several hours or overnight

title: summertime fruit pancakes with fresh cream
steps:
1. For whipped cream: whip the heavy cream with the vanilla extract and splenda until soft peaks form
2. Refrigerate until ready to use
3. In a large bowl , sift together the flours , baking powder , salt , splenda , and cinnamon
4. Add the milk , egg yolks , melted butter and lemon juice and whisk until smooth
5. In another large bowl , whip the egg whites until soft peaks form , then gently fold them into the batter
6. Gently fold in the pitted cherries and blueberries , lemon zest , and banana
7. Generously grease a large , heavy skillet or griddle and heat to medium
8. For each fruit pancake , drop by 1 / 4 cupfuls onto the griddle and flatten slightly on top with back of spoon
9. Cook , lifting delicately with
10. Repeat until all the batter is used
11. Serve with the freshly-whipped cream and strawberry preserves
12. Syrup is optional , but necessary if you like pancakes really sweet

title: 100 year old pie crust  pastry dough
steps:
1. In a large mixing bowl using a pastry cutter , mix flour , shortening , sugar and salt until crumbly
2. In a separate bowl , mix egg and water
3. Add to flour mixture using the pastry cutter
4. I have also used a food processor and a dough blade on pulse for each step
5. Cover tightly with plastic and chill until ready to roll out

title: baked fish with mustard marinade
steps:
1. Rinse and dry the fish fillets and place them , skin side down , in a lightly oiled baking pan
2. Whisk the marinade ingredients together in a mixing bowl or whirl them in a blender or small food processor
3. Pour the marinade over the fish , turning the fillets to coat both sides
4. Set aside in the refrigerator for 20 to 60 minutes
5. Preheat the oven to 400
6. Place the baking dish , uncovered , in the oven and bake for 10 to 15 minutes , or until the fish is tender and flakes easily with a fork

title: oven asparagus with orange zest and garlic
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Spray a baking dish , or use non-stick
3. Lay asparagus on dish
4. Drizzle olive oil over it all
5. Sprinkle with garlic , orange zest pepper& lite salt
6. Roll the asparagus around to coat
7. Bake@ 400 for about 10-15 minutes
8. Irecently saw bergy's asparagus , oven roasted
9. And will be cutting down the time when i make this next-i may still have been cooking it too long

title: herbed baked   or grilled  chicken  or fish
steps:
1. Mix the butter and spices
2. Drizzle over chicken
3. Bake at 375 until done

title: the real margarita
steps:
1. Rim your marg glass with a lime wedge , then dip in salt
2. Add all ingredients in a shaker , or a mason jar with lid will work , and shake till blended
3. Pour into glass and garnish with lime wedge
4. If you like , you can chill your glass in the freezer for 10 minutes , or add a few cubes of ice to the rest of ingredients while shaking , being sure to strain it when you pour into glass
5. Also , if the marg is to strong for ya , bump it down to 1 shot of tequila

title: all in one quiche
steps:
1. Combine the first four ingredients in a blender and mix well
2. Pour into a 10-inch pie plate
3. Add remaining ingredients
4. Bake at 350 for 45 minutes
5. Let stand 10 minutes before serving

title: steak and mushroom baked potato topping
steps:
1. In a large frying pan over medium-high heat , heat the oil and brown the steak strips and onion
2. Remove the steak and onions from the pan
3. Add the butter and melt over low heat
4. Whisk in the flour and stir with a wooden spoon until smooth
5. Whisk in the beef broth and stir until the mixture thickens slightly , about 2 minutes
6. Return the beef and onions to the pan
7. Add the mushrooms
8. Simmer for 30 minutes until tender
9. Taste , then season with the worcestershire sauce , salt , and pepper
10. The topping can be refrigerated , covered , up to this point
11. Just before serving , reheat gently and stir in the sour cream
12. Do not allow the topping to boil
13. Keep hot in a crockpot or chafing dish over very low heat
14. Serve over baked potatoes

title: chili bacon nachos for two
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees
2. For the chips: cut each tortilla into quarters
3. Heat the oil in a skillet on medium heat
4. The oil should be about 1 / 2 inch deep in the skillet
5. Place about 8 to 10 of the tortilla quarters in the hot oil at a time
6. Turn the tortilla chips as they cook so each side is golden brown
7. When the chips are golden brown on both sides , remove them from the skillet and lay them on a plate over a paper towel to absorb the excess oil
8. Repeat with the remaining tortillas
9. Set aside
10. For the bacon guacamole: in a small bowl , add the avocado , 1 tablespoon of the red onions , 1 tablespoon salsa , 1 tablespoon of the crumbled bacon and the juice from 1 quarter of the lime
11. Mix the guacamole ingredients using a spoon so that the avocado is broken into small chunks
12. Then salt and pepper to taste and top with additional crumbled bacon
13. For the nachos: add the chips to an oven-proof plate or skillet
14. Top the chips with the chili , shredded cheese , sliced jalapeno , remaining diced onions and the remaining crumbled bacon
15. Bake in a preheated oven until the cheese is melted , about 6 - 8 minutes
16. Top the warm nachos with the diced tomatoes and serve them with side dishes of sour cream , the remaining salsa and the bacon guacamole
17. Garnish with the remaining lime wedges

title: crock pot chicken corn soup
steps:
1. Rinse chicken and pat dry with paper towels
2. Set aside
3. In a 4 quart crock pot , combine onion , carrots , celery , potatoe , and 3 tablespoons of the parsley
4. Add chicken , then pour in tomato sauce and broth
5. Cover and cook at low setting for 7 to 8 hours
6. Chicken and potatoes should be tender when pierced with a fork
7. Lift out chicken and place on cutting board to cool to touch
8. Next , skim and sicard fat from broth mixture
9. Stir in corn and turn crock pot to high heat
10. Cover and cook for additional 15 minutes
11. Once chicken is cool , dicard bone and skin
12. Tear chicken into bite size pieces
13. Return chicken to crock pot and sliced zucchini to broth
14. Cover and cook until zucchini is tender
15. Season soup with salt and pepper
16. Before serving , sprinkle the remaining 1 tablespoon of parsley on top of soup

title: vegan italian chicken and pastina
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f
2. Bring a medium pot of salted water to a boil over high heat
3. Add the pasta and cook until just tender , stirring occasionally , about 5 minutes
4. Drain pasta into a large mixing bowl
5. Meanwhile , put the olive oil in a medium saute pan over medium heat
6. Add the chicken and cook for 3 minutes
7. Add the onions and garlic , stirring to combine , and cook until the onions are soft and the chicken is cooked through , about 5 minutes more
8. Put the chicken mixture into the bowl with the cooked pasta
9. Add the canned tomatoes , dairy free mozzarella cheese , parsley , salt and pepper
10. Stir to combine
11. Place the mixture in a buttered 8 by 8 by 2-inch baking dish
12. In a small bowl mix together the bread crumbs and parmesan cheese
13. Sprinkle over the top of the pasta mixture
14. Dot the top with small bits of margarine
15. Bake until top is golden brown , about 30 minutes

title: southern fried potatoes
steps:
1. Fry potato chunks in hot oil in a 9- or 10-inch cast iron skillet over medium-high heat 12 minutes , turning often
2. Add onion , and cook 5 more minutes
3. Remove mixture to a serving bowl , using a slotted spoon
4. Sprinkle with salt and pepper
5. This is rustic cooking at its best
6. Leave the skins on the potatoes , if you'd prefer
7. They'll fry crispy brown and save you a step , too
8. A cast iron skillet is an inexpensive investment
9. Foods cooked in it absorb iron , which will increase the amount of iron you consume

title: basic vinaigrette with variations
steps:
1. Whisk the garlic cloves , mustard , vinegar , kosher salt , and pepper together in a bowl
2. While whisking , slowly drizzle in the olive oil to emulsify
3. Taste for salt and pepper
4. Variations:
5. Use any other vinegar you have , including red wine vinegar and balsamic
6. Leave out the garlic or add herbs as you like
7. Add 1 teaspoon dried oregano and / or substitute lemon juice for the vinegar for a greek-like dressing
8. I would leave out the mustard for this but the dressing will not emulsify as well without it

title: rhubarb mousse
steps:
1. Wash , peel and cut the rhubarb into 1 inch pieces
2. Cook it with half cup water until just tender
3. Blend it with sugar and vanilla extract or orange zest
4. Set aside to cool
5. Melt the gelatin in a small amount of hot water , add to the blended rhubarb
6. Whip the cream , stir together with the blended rhubarb - gently !
7. Refrigerate for several hours until the dessert stiffens into a creamy substance
8. Enjoy !

title: whole wheat mini doughnuts
steps:
1. Mix together both types of flour , baking powder , salt , cinnamon , and nutmeg
2. In another bowl , combine eggs , sugar , and vanilla
3. Beat until thick
4. Combine milk and melted butter
5. Add some of the flour mixture to the egg mixture , then some of the milk mixture , alternating between each until all is incorporated- do not overmix , just blend each addition until ingredinets are combined
6. Cover and chill 2 hours
7. On a lightly floured surface , roll dough out to 1 / 2" thickness
8. Cut using a mini doughnut cutter
9. Prepare oil for deep fat frying to 375 f according to your fryer instructions
10. Fry in small batches , without crowding the pan , about 1 minute per side or until golden , turning with a slotted spoon once
11. Remove and drain on paper towels - cool slightly
12. Roll in a bowl of cinnamon sugar to coat and serve as soon as they cool enough to not burn your tongue
13. If using powdered sugar , you will may to wait until the doughnuts are fairly cool as it tends to melt on contact from the heat

title: lemon granita
steps:
1. Place lemon juice , zest , and sugar in a small saucepan and stir over low heat for 5 minutes , or until the sugar is dissolved
2. Remove from the heat and allow to cool
3. Add 2 cups of water to the juice mixture and mix together well
4. Pour the mixture into a shallow 12x8 inches metal container , and place in freezer until it is beginning to freeze around the edges
5. Scrape the frozen sections back into the mixture with a fork
6. Repeat every 30 minutes until it has evenly-sized crystals
7. Beat the mixture with a fork just before serving
8. Put in chilled glasses

title: salsa and cream cheese dip
steps:
1. Place softened cream cheese in a serving dish
2. Cover cream cheese with salsa of choice
3. Enjoy with favorite brand or homemade tortilla chips
4. You may need to pour more salsa over cream cheese as you munch along

title: slow cooked roast
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in slow-cooker
2. Turn slow-cooker on low and cook for 6 hours

title: spicy picnic chicken
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400 degrees
2. Spray a broiler pan with non-stick cooking spray
3. In a shallow bowl , combine buttermilk and 1 tbsp of taco seasoning mix
4. Mix well in another bowl , combine remaining taco seasoning mix , bread crumbs , flour , salt and pepper
5. Mix well
6. Dip chicken pieces in buttermilk mixture
7. Coat with bread crumb mixture
8. Place on broiler pan
9. Let stand for 10 minutes
10. Drizzle chicken with melted butter
11. Bake for 40-45 minutes , or until juices run clear

title: the ultimate irish feast
steps:
1. 1
2. In 8 quart saucepot , cover corned beef brisket with cold water
3. Over high heat , bring to boiling
4. Reduce heat
5. Simmer 15 minutes
6. Skim and discard particles from surface
7. Add garlic , peppercorns , cloves and bay leaves
8. Simmer , covered 2 1 / 2 - 3 hours or until brisket is almost fork tender
9. 2
10. Add carrots , potatoes and onions
11. Cook 15 minutes
12. Add cabbage , cook 5 minutes longer or just until brisket and vegetables are tender
13. 3
14. Meanwhile make mustard glaze
15. In small bowl with wire whisk , combine dijon mustard and brown sugar to make a paste
16. Whisk in dry mustard , vinegar , oil and water
17. 4
18. Preheat broiler
19. Place brisket , fat side up , on rack over broiler pan
20. Position oven rack so top of brisket is 5 -6 inches from heat
21. Brush top of brisket with some of the glaze
22. Broil about 5- 8 minutes , brushing several times with glaze
23. Meat will be shiny
24. Transfer to cutting board
25. Pour leftover mustard glaze into small bowl
26. 5
27. To serve: slice brisket
28. Arrange on large serving platter
29. With slotted spoon , place cabbage wedges , carrots and onions on platter
30. Drain potatoes in colander , return to saucepot and toss with butter and parsley
31. Serve with mustard glaze
32. Enjoy !
33. Makes 8 servings: 658 calories per serving

title: kishke  stuffed derma
steps:
1. Wash and clean the beef casing inside and out
2. Scrape off fat with dull knife
3. Cut into 8 inches lengths
4. Sew up one end of each section
5. Preheat oven to moderate 350 degrees f
6. In a small skillet melt the chicken fat and saute the onions until lightly browned
7. In a mixing bowl , sift together the flour , salt and pepper
8. Add the bread crumbs and melted chicken fat with the onions
9. Mix well and loosely stuff each section of the beef casing
10. Sew up the other end
11. Shake and rinse off any flour from the surface
12. Immerse in boiling water for 3-5 minutes and drain
13. Arrange derma in a shallow greased baking dish and bake 1 1 / 2- 2 hours or until well browned
14. Baste frequently with the pan drippings
15. Variation: kiske is traditionally served with cholent or carrot tzimmes and is usually cooked in the same pot
16. For this procedure , follow step 1- 5 of the above recipe , then either stew overnight with cholent or bake in casserole dish with tzimmes

title: new zealand meat patties
steps:
1. Combine beef , potato , onions , egg , cream , salt and pepper
2. Mix well and shape into 12 thin patties
3. Melt 4 tablespoons butter in a skillet
4. Saute patties about 7-8 minutes
5. Turn over and saute for 7-8 minutes more
6. Remove and keep warm
7. Melt remaining butter in skillet
8. Whisk in flour
9. Gradually add milk , whisking constantly
10. Bring just to a boil , stirring constantly
11. Reduce heat to low and cook 5 minutes
12. Pour over the meat patties

title: for two small cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180 degrees
2. Cream butter and sugar together - don't bother using a mixer , i just used a teaspoon
3. Add vanilla
4. Mix in flour , muesli and salt
5. If the mixture gets dry , add the water
6. Add the raisins
7. Roll into two small balls and place two inches apart on a piece of baking paper
8. Flatten slightly with fork
9. Bake for 8-10 minutes
10. Leave for two minutes , then cool

title: too easy apple treat
steps:
1. Cut up apple into bite sized chunks
2. Spray lemon juice over apples
3. In bowl mix yogurt and cinnamon
4. Mix apples with cinnamon yogurt
5. Enjoy !

title: flourless flax pancakes
steps:
1. Mix the ingredients together with a fork
2. Spray a pan with cooking spray and warm up
3. Pour dollar size pancakes and cook for a few minutes each side
4. Top with favorite pancake topping
5. Enjoy !

title: asian cabbage salad with fresh peaches and wasabi peas
steps:
1. In a large salad bowl , toss the cabbage , green onion , celery and carrot
2. In a non-reactive bowl combine the vinaigrette ingredients and whisk well
3. Add the wasabi peas and sliced peaches to the salad bowl
4. Toss carefully with the vinaigrette
5. Servings are estimated

title: red cabbage salad with apples  raisins   honey dressing
steps:
1. In a dutch oven , place cabbage , apple juice , and salt
2. Simmer mixture for 15 minutes
3. Add the apples and raisins and continue simmering until cabbage and apples are tender and most of the liquid is absorbed
4. Stir together the vinegar , honey and oil until blended
5. Pour dressing over the cabbage and simmer mixture for 2 minutes or until heated through
6. Refrigerate until serving time
7. Serve warm or cold

title: z tejas  roasted poblano queso fundido
steps:
1. Bring the salsa or wine to a simmer in a double boiler
2. Add the jack cheese and stir until melted
3. Add the remaining ingredients and cook for 5 minutes
4. Place in a fondue pot and serve with flour tortillas and corn chips

title: healthy chicken turkey burgers
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients and shape into patties
2. Grill , broil or saute about 4 to 5 minutes per side

title: grilled wrapped franks
steps:
1. Pat franks dry
2. Mix baking mix and water until soft dough forms
3. Beat vigorously 20 strokes
4. Divide dough into 10 equal parts
5. Pat 1 part dough around each frank with finger floured with baking mix , completely covering frank
6. Brush cooking grill with oil
7. Grill franks about 4" from hot coals , turning frequently , until brown , about 15 minutes
8. Alternative method of cooking: bake wrapped franks
9. Heat oven to 450 degrees
10. Bake uncovered on greased cookie sheet until golden brown , 10 to 12 minutes

title: stewed mangoes with cloves
steps:
1. Spear some of the pieces with a few cloves
2. In a 1-quart saucepan , simmer for 15 minutes or until mangos are tender
3. Cool and serve in compote dishes

title: gingerbread oatmeal bread
steps:
1. In bread machine pan , place all ingredients in order suggested by manufacturer
2. Select basic bread setting
3. Bake according to bread machine directions , but check dough after 5 minutes of mixing and add 1-2 tablespoons of water or flour if needed)

title: evil jungle prince with mixed vegetables
steps:
1. Cut mixed vegetables into thin strips
2. Grind red chili peppers , and lemon grass in a blender or with mortar
3. Heat oil to medium high and saut pepper mixture for 3 minutes
4. Stir in coconut milk and cook for 2 minutes
5. Add vegetables and cook for 5 more minutes
6. Stir in basil
7. Serve on a bed rice or noodles

title: apricot pistachio ice cream
steps:
1. Combine water and sugar in medium saucepan over medium-low heat , stirring constantly until sugar dissolves
2. Increase heat and bring to a boil
3. Remove from heat
4. Beat yolks in a large bowl until thick and forms a ribbon when beaters are lifted
5. Whisk in sugar / water mixture
6. Return mixture to saucepan over low heat , whisking constantly until mixture is thick enough to coat back of spoon
7. Do not boil
8. Transfer mixture to bowl which is set over ice water
9. Cool , stirring occasionally
10. Fold whipped cream into cooled egg mixture using a rubber spatula
11. Fold in apricot puree and pistachios
12. Refrigerate until chilled
13. Transfer mixture to ice cream maker and process per manufacturer's directions
14. Turn into plastic container and freeze

title: grilled cheese in a nest
steps:
1. You start by taking 2 slices of bread and buttering one side each
2. Slap them on the griddle , butter side down , and add cheese to each one
3. I used sharp cheddar on one slice and mozzarella on the other
4. After the bread browns to your liking and the cheese is melted enough , pull them off the griddle and put them to the side
5. Now proceed to make an egg in the nest
6. In case you are unaware what this is , i will explain how to make one
7. Butter the 3rd slice of bread on one or both sides , depending on your preference
8. Then take a small cup and press in down like a cookie cutter in the center of the bread
9. Just a big enough circle so the egg can sit without overflowing over the sides of the bread
10. I used a cup that was about 2 inches in diameter
11. Slap the bread on the griddle and crack an egg in the middle of it
12. Break the yolk , add salt and pepper , just however you like your egg you can do whatever
13. After one side is cooked , flip it over and cook the other side
14. Make sure the heat isn't to high , as it is easy to burn the bread and have an uncooked egg in the middle :(
15. When it's done , place it on top of one of the cheesed bread slices and place the other cheesed bread on top
16. And now you have a "grilled cheese in a nest" you can also microwave it for 10 seconds or so , so the cheese is extra melty :) enjoy and tell me what you think

title: cherry kringle
steps:
1. In a large mixing bowl , dissolve yeast in warm milk
2. In another bowl , combine the flour , sugar and salt
3. Cut in butter and shortening until crumbly
4. Add to yeast mixture
5. Add eggs
6. Beat to form a very soft dough
7. Cover and refrigerate for at least 8 hours
8. Turn dough onto a lightly floured surface
9. Divide into fourths
10. Roll each portion into a 14-in
11. X 11-in
12. Rectangle
13. Spread cherry pie filling down the center third of each rectangle
14. Starting at a long side , fold a third of the dough over filling
15. Fold other third over top
16. Pinch to seal
17. Then pinch the ends and tuck under
18. Place 2 inches apart on greased baking sheets
19. Bake at 350 degrees for 25 minutes or until golden brown
20. Remove from pans to wire racks to cool completely
21. Combine icing ingredients
22. Drizzle over kringles

title: greek chips with egg  patates me avga
steps:
1. Cook chips in deep fryer or pan with oil
2. Put cooked chips into large fry pan pour beaten eggs over top and cook on medium heat , lightly stirring until eggs are set

title: no fuss mandarin orange cake w  vanilla coconut frosting
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease and flour a 9" x 13" pan
3. In a large bowl , beat cake mix , eggs , oranges and juice , and oil until thoroughly mixed- orange segment will break up into batter
4. Pour into pan and bake for 35-40 minutes
5. Cool for at least an hour
6. Frost cake
7. Sprinkle with coconut

title: harissa paste
steps:
1. Soak the dried chillis in tepid water to cover until softened , about 45 minutes to 1 hour
2. Drain and remove the stems and seeds
3. Place in a blender or food processor with the garlic , water , and olive oil and process until smooth , stopping occasionally to scrape down the sides
4. Transfer the mixture to a small bowl and stir in the caraway , coriander , and salt
5. Store in a jar and top off , covering the surface of the paste with a layer of olive oil
6. Whenever the paste is used you must always top off with olive oil making sure no paste is exposed to air otherwise it will spoil
7. Variation: to make a hot harisa , use 4 ounces dried guajillo chillis and 1 / 2 ounce dried de arbol chillis

title: very easy raspberry thumbprint cookies  uses cookie mix
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 375f in large bowl , stir cookie mix , butter , egg and flour until soft dough forms
2. Roll dough into 3 / 4-inch balls
3. Place 2-inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet
4. Using thumb or handle of wooden spoon , make indentation in center of each cookie
5. Spoon about 1 / 4 teaspoon jam into each indentation
6. Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until edges are light golden brown
7. Cool 5 minutes
8. Remove from cookie sheet to wire rack
9. In small microwavable bowl , microwave baking chips on high 1 to 2 minutes or until chips are melted
10. Stir until smooth
11. Spoon melted chips into small resealable plastic bag
12. Cut small hole in corner of bag
13. Squeeze bag gently to drizzle melted chips over cookies
14. Sprinkle with colored sugar

title: golden maple chicken i
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. In a small bowl , mix the melted butter and maple syrup
3. Set aside
4. In another bowl , mix the flour , paprika , nutmeg , and pepper
5. Toss the chicken cubes in flour mixture to well coat
6. Place the kidney beans and corn in a saucepan and heat on stovetop
7. Heat the butter over medium heat in a skillet and saute' the chicken for about 5 minutes or until golden
8. Place chicken in 2 1 / 2 quart
9. Casserole dish
10. Add maple mixture to the chicken and mix well
11. Bake for 10 minutes , then stir mixture , bake an additional 5 minutes and stir then pour the bean and corn mixture on top and continue to cook for and additional 8 minutes or until heated through and bubbling

title: gitty s sesame chicken
steps:
1. Skin chicken
2. Baste with egg and dip in breadcrumbs to coat
3. Place in a greased baking dish , cover with tin foil , and bake 45 minutes at 350
4. Combine remaining ingredients
5. Pour over chicken
6. Reheat chicken with sauce

title: curly potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Using an apple / peeler / corer / slicer , core and slice potatoes to create long spirals
3. Slice cores into rounds
4. Place potatoes in a shallow baking dish that has been lightly sprayed
5. Melt butter with garlic
6. Drizzle mixture over potatoes
7. Sprinkle with what ever seasonings you like
8. Examples: grated parmesan cheese , and finely chopped green onions or garlic salt and pepper or even some of emerils essence
9. I double this recipe for my family
10. Bake for 40 to 45 minutes
11. Potatoes should be tender and slightly crisp

title: banana apple smoothie
steps:
1. Smach the banana's in a mixing bowl
2. Add the apple juice , milk , sugar , and vanilla in the bowl with the banana's
3. Add the ice cubes one at a time till smooth

title: cheesecake factory s  original recipe for pumpkin pie filling
steps:
1. Set oven to 375 degrees
2. Prepare a 9-inch glass pie plate
3. Fit the prepared pastry in a 9-inch glass pie plate and flute edges
4. Prick holes in the bottom of the crust then refrigerate for 1 hour
5. Line , weight and bake the shell for 8 minutes
6. For the filling
7. In a bowl combine brown sugar , white sugar , flour , molasses , cinnamon , ginger , nutmeg , cloves and salt
8. Add in eggs and whipping cream
9. Whisk to combine well
10. Pour the filling into prepared pie plate
11. Place the pie plate on a baking sheet
12. Bake for about 40 minutes or until the filling is set
13. Let cook then serve with whipped cream

title: my family s swedish glogg
steps:
1. In large pot , combine all ingredients except the wine
2. Simmer , covered , for about 1 hour
3. Add the wine , bring to a near boil , and turn off the heat
4. Strain the liquid through the strainer into another large bowl or pitcher
5. From the leftover fruit mixture , take one cinnamon stick and a few almonds and put them into each wine bottle
6. Use the funnel to pour liquid back into wine bottles

title: shrimp po boy salad with remoulade dressing  or chicken
steps:
1. To prepare remoulade dressing:
2. Whisk together all ingredients
3. Cover and chill 30 minutes before serving
4. Store in an airtight container in refrigerator up to 3 days
5. To prepare the shrimp:
6. Toss shrimp with 1 tablespoon olive oil in a medium bowl
7. Thread shrimp on skewers and sprinkle both sides with cajun or creole seasoning
8. Cut romaine lettuce hearts in half lengthwise
9. Brush cut sides of hearts with remaining 1 1 / 2 tablespoons olive oil
10. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
11. Cut baguette into 18 slices
12. Place on a baking sheet
13. Stir together butter and garlic
14. Brush 1 side of bread with butter mixture
15. Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until golden
16. Meanwhile , preheat grill to 350 - 400 degrees heat
17. Grill shrimp , covered with grill lid , 3 to 4 minutes on each side or just until shrimp turn pink
18. Remove shrimp , and cover with aluminum foil to keep warm
19. Place romaine , cut sides down , on cooking grate of grill
20. Grill , covered with grill lid , 2 to 3 minutes or until just wilted and grill marks appear
21. Grilling is optional , otherwise proceed to next step
22. To assemble:
23. Place 1 grilled romaine heart half on each of 6 plates
24. Top with tomato wedges , onion , and shrimp
25. Drizzle with remoulade dressing
26. Serve with toasted french bread slices

title: sesame soy vinaigrette
steps: 1. Whisk all of the ingredients together and pour over salad greens

title: grilled salmon with rosemary
steps:
1. Cut the fish into equal portions
2. Combine olive oil , lemon , garlic and rosemary in a bowl
3. Brush the mixture onto the fish
4. To grill: arrange fish on grill rack or basket sprayed with olive oil cooking spray
5. Grill over medium hot coals until the fish flakes easily
6. If the fish is more than 1 inch thick , gently turn it halfway through grilling
7. To broil: arrange fish on broiler rack sprayed with olive oil cooking spray
8. Broil four inches from heat 4 - 6 minutes per 1 / 2 inch thichkness or until fish flakes easily
9. If the fish is more than 1 inch thick , gently turn it halfway through broiling

title: crescent bacon cheese tartlets
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375f
2. If using crescent rolls: unroll dough into 1 large rectangle on work surface
3. Press into 12x9-inch rectangle , firmly pressing perforations to seal
4. If using dough sheet: unroll dough on work surface
5. Press into 12x9-inch rectangle
6. Cut dough into 12 squares
7. Gently press squares into 12 ungreased mini muffin cups , shaping edges to form rims 1 / 4 inch high
8. Spoon cheese evenly into dough-lined cups
9. Top each with bacon and onion
10. In small bowl , beat egg and whipping cream with wire whisk or fork until blended
11. Spoon slightly less than 1 tablespoon mixture into each cup
12. Bake 15 to 20 minutes or until edges are golden brown and filling is set
13. Cool 5 minutes
14. Remove from muffin cups

title: blueberry corn custard
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325
2. Butter an 8-inch square glass baking dish
3. Put on a kettle of water to boil for the water bath , and have ready a 9 x 12 inch baking pan
4. Bring the milk and zest just to a boil in a medium saucepan over med-high heat
5. Remove the pan from the heat , cover , and steep for 5 minutes
6. Pour the mixture through a fine strainer set over a large glass measure or bowl
7. Whisk in the cream , and let cool to room temperature
8. Pulse the corn in a food processor just until coarsely chopped
9. Beat the butter with an electric mixer on medium speed in a bowl until light and fluffy
10. Add the sugar , flour , and salt and beat , scraping down the sides of the bowl as needed , until smooth
11. Add the eggs one at a time , beating well after each addition
12. Add the milk mixture and whisk until smooth
13. Gently stir in the corn and blueberries
14. Transfer the mixture to the square baking dish and place in the baking pan
15. Place the pan in the oven and pour enough boiling water into the baking pan to come halfway up the sides of the baking dish
16. Bake for 55-60 minutes , or until the top is lightly browned and a knife inserted in the center comes out clean
17. Transfer baking dish to a wire rack to cool slightly , and serve warm

title: apricot and cashew stuffed chicken breast
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 190 degrees celsius
2. Cut a deep pocket towards the
3. Refrigerate until needed
4. In a pan saut the onions and half the cashews in 2 tablespoons of the butter
5. When lightly coloured add parsley , apricots and almond meal , salt and pepper and mix well
6. Fill the chicken pieces , roll and close with toothpicks
7. Season well
8. Wipe out the pan
9. Add oil and brown the chicken breasts on both sides
10. Do this in two batches if need be
11. Transfer to an oven dish and add the remaining 2 tablespoons butter and cashews
12. Bake for 15 minutes until chicken is lightly browned , basting with the pan juices
13. Serve with vegetables or salad

title: please don t feel blue macaroni   cheese
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees and spray an 8 x 8 pan with fat free cooking spray
2. Boil water and cook pasta according to box directions
3. Drain
4. Melt butter in heavy large saucepan over medium to low heat , then add flour and cook 1 minute stirring constantly
5. Gradually whisk in cream and milk and simmer until mixture thickens slightly , whisking occasionally
6. Reduce heat to low and add grated cheddar cheese and only 1 / 2 cup blue cheese
7. Whisk about 2 minutes or when cheese starts to melt , then flavor with pepper if desired
8. Add cooked pasta to sauce , stirring to coat , and transfer mixture to baking dish
9. Sprinkle with remaining blue cheese and bake about 25 minutes or until sauce begins to bubble
10. Sprinkle with chives and serve - enjoy !

title: frosted chocolate cake and cupcakes  gluten  dairy   egg fre
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Spray an 8" square or 9" round cake pan with nonstick spray or line a dozen muffin cups with cupcake liners
3. In a medium size bowl , stir together the brown rice flour , xanthan gum , cocoa , brown sugar , chocolate chips , nuts , baking soda , and salt
4. In a two cup glass measuring cup , measure the 1 / 2 cup oil , add the 1 cup of liquid , then add the vinegar and vanilla extract
5. Stir to combine
6. Stir the liquid ingredients into the dry ingredients until just moistened
7. Pour the batter into the prepared pan and bake for 30-35 minutes for cake or 25 minutes for cupcakes , or until the cake tests done
8. Set aside to cool
9. For frosting , combine the chocolate chips and milk / water in a small saucepan
10. Heat over medium , stirring constantly until the chips are melted and the glaze is smooth
11. Spoon over the cooled cake and refrigerate until set

title: slow cooker sugared pecans   walnuts
steps:
1. Preheat slow cooker / crock pot on high for 15 minutes
2. First , in preheated slow cooker / crock pot stir the walnuts and butter until mixed well
3. Add the powdered sugar , stirring to coat evenly
4. Cover and slow-cook on high for 15 minutes
5. Reduce the heat to low and slow cook , uncovered , stirring occasionally , until the nuts are coated with a crisp glaze transfer the nuts to a bowl
6. In another small bowl , combine the spices and sift them over the nuts , stirring to coat evenly
7. Let cool before serving

title: fresh creamy dill cucumber salad
steps:
1. 1
2. Place cucumbers into a large bowl
3. Combine yogurt , sour cream , dill , salt , pepper , garlic salt and lemon juice into a bowl until combined
4. Pour over cucumbers and stir to coat
5. Serve or refrigerate until serving

title: mushroom orzo risotto with pine nuts
steps:
1. Heat garlic and olive oil in a medium saucepan
2. When garlic "speaks" , add the onion and saute until translucent
3. Add the mushrooms , sprinkle with salt and pepper
4. Cook mushrooms until brown and all the liquid has evaporated
5. In the mean time , toast orzo in a separate pan over medium heat , until light golden
6. When mushrooms are cooked , add sage , thyme , and chicken broth and bring to a boil
7. Add orzo , reduce heat to med-low
8. Cook until broth is absorbed and orzo is al dente , stirring occasionally
9. Add pine nuts , parmesan cheese , and parsley
10. Heat through until parmesan is melted and absorbed into the orzo
11. Season to taste with additional salt and pepper , if necessary
12. Serve immediately , with additional parmesan cheese , if desired

title: wagon wheel slice
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180 degrees celsius grease a 3c deep 16cm x 26cm slice pan
2. Line base and sides with baking papaer , extending paper 2cm from edge on all sides
3. Using an elextric mixer , beat 185gm butter and sugar until light and fluffy
4. Sift flours over butter mixture
5. Stir until dough comes together
6. Press mixture into prepared pan
7. Bake 20 minutes until golden
8. Spread warm base with jam
9. Cover with marshmellows , cut side down
10. Bake for 2 minutes
11. Remove from oven
12. Press down on the marshmellows to level the surface
13. Cool in tin
14. Combine chocolate and remaining butter in small saucepan over a low heat
15. Cook , stirring , for 2 - 3 minutes or until melted
16. Pour over marshmellows
17. Tap pan to level surface
18. Refrigerate for 2 hours or until set
19. Stand at room temperature for 5 minutes before cutting into pieces with a warmed / hot knife
20. This makes the cutting of the choclate icing easier

title: lemon tarragon cream sauce
steps:
1. In a saucepan over medium heat , saute garlic in butter until the garlic begins to brown
2. Add the riesling
3. Mix , add the cream , and , lowering the heat , reduce the sauce for 10 minutes
4. Add the lemon and tarragon and cook for 5 minutes more
5. Add salt and pepper to taste
6. Serve over fettucine

title: cranberry fizz
steps:
1. Place the cranberry juice , grapefruit juice , bacardi and ice in a jug and stir to combine
2. Top up with soda water and serve in tall glasses

title: asian egg drop soup
steps:
1. Reserve 3 / 4 cup of chicken broth and pour the rest into large saucepan
2. Stir in salt , ginger and chives
3. Bring to a boil
4. Combine reserved broth and cornstarch until smooth
5. Add to boiling broth mixture
6. In a separate bowl whisk together eggs
7. Once broth is at a rolling boil , drizzle egg a little at a time into the broth
8. Egg should cook immediately

title: rosalynn carter s eggplant casserole
steps:
1. As the eggplant slices change in circumference , trim so they are all approximately the same size
2. Place in oiled shallow pyrex dish
3. Sprinkle with salt and pepper
4. Broil 5 minutes or longer to make fork-tender
5. Heat the oil and butter in a skillet
6. Add onion and cook until yellow
7. Add garlic , tomatoes and trimmings of eggplant
8. Cook until thick
9. Stir in seasonings , parsley and bread crumbs
10. Spread evenly on top of the broiled eggplant
11. Cover with grated cheese
12. Bake at 350 degrees until cheese is melted , about 15 minutes

title: mrs  c s slow cooker pulled pork bbq
steps:
1. Place pork in slow cooker
2. Pour barbecue sauce and cola over meat
3. Cook on high for 8 hours until meat is tender and shreds easily

title: chicken dish from netherlands antilles   original
steps:
1. Cut the wings at the joints so you have 3 pieces , or simply use drumsticks
2. You can skin the chicken if you want to , we never do
3. Cut the bell peppers and onions in strips
4. Peel the garlic and mash it up
5. Put some oil , butter or even pam in a medium hot skillet add the chicken and cook until the chicken seems to get done some
6. Add the onions , garlic and bell peppers and stir-fry the whole lot for a while to add some color to the vegetables
7. Cut the stewed tomatoes in smaller bits and add to the dish along with the tomato paste , fill the empty cans with water and add also
8. Add some sambal or hot sauce
9. Add stock cubes
10. Let the whole thing simmer for about 15 minutes , which gives you time to cook some rice with it
11. )
12. Taste , add salt and sambal if needed
13. Add a pinch of sugar if the tomatoes taste a bit tangy
14. Serve with rice

title: casserole lasagna
steps:
1. Brown ground beef in a skillet until done , drain
2. Stir in the suace
3. Layer the ground beef , noodles , cottage cheese and mozarella cheese
4. Cover and bake at 350

title: beef with bow tie pasta
steps:
1. Spray 12-inch skillet with nonstick cooking spray
2. Trim fat from beef
3. Cut beef into 2-inch strips
4. Cut strips crosswise into 1 / 8- inch slices
5. Heat skillet over medium heat until hot
6. Cook asparagus , onions and 1 cup of the broth 5 to 7 minutes , stirring occasionally , until liquid has evaporated
7. Remove from skillet
8. Add beef to skillet
9. Cook , stirring frequently , about 2 minutes or until beef is no longer pink
10. Return vegetables to skillet
11. Add remaining broth and ingredients except cheese
12. Cook , stirring frequently , about 2 minutes or until mixture is hot
13. Sprinkle with cheese

title: monterey jack crispy wafers
steps:
1. Cut cheese into l / 4 inch slices
2. Space cheese 3 inches apart on a non-stick cookie sheet
3. Sprinkle with garlic powder , to taste
4. Bake 5-10 minutes at 400 degrees f depending on your oven
5. Remove immediately and let cool
6. Store in an airtight container

title: hawaiian korean kal bi marinade
steps:
1. Blend all ingredients in a large bowl until sugar is completely dissolved
2. Dump over meat placed in a long dish covered tightly with plastic wrap or place into ziplock bag
3. Marinate overnight
4. Turn meat 3-4 times each day
5. Remove from marinade when ready to cook
6. Discard marinade
7. Grill over low to medium coals or bake in the oven at 325f until cooked through
8. Cooking times will vary based on grill / oven heat and type of meat

title: mincemeat with dried fruit
steps:
1. In large mixing bowl , combine both raisins , currants , peaches , apricots & dates
2. Set aside
3. In large nonreactive saucepan , combine cinnamon , nutmeg , allspice & ginger , then stir in corn syrup , rum , brown sugar , apple cider syrup & apple juice
4. Add butter & bring to boil over medium heat
5. Boil 3 minutes
6. Pour hot liquid over dried fruit & stir
7. Cool to room temperature
8. When completely cooled , pour / spoon equal amounts into 3 clean quart glass jars , seal tightly & refrigerate up to 12 months

title: mediterranean greek salad  good for travel and good to eat
steps:
1. In a large salad bowl , toss together the cucumbers , feta cheese , olives , roma tomatoes , sun-dried tomatoes , 2 tablespoons reserved sun-dried tomato oil , and red onion
2. Chill until serving

title: bacon  cabbage  noodles
steps:
1. Cook egg noodles according to package directions
2. Fry bacon , remove from pan , and drain the fat , reserving a few tablespoons
3. After bacon has been removed from the pan , add onion and cabbage
4. Add a few tablespoons of the bacon fat and a few tablespoons of water
5. Cover and cook on high until cabbage and onions are tender
6. Combine all ingredients and add salt and pepper to taste
7. Enjoy !

title: chau har kau  stir fried shrimp with cucumber  black wood fungus
steps:
1. For the marinade: mix together all of the ingrediants in a bowl
2. Marinate the shrimp in the refrigerator for 30 minutes
3. For the sauce: mix all of the ingredients in a bowl and set aside
4. Heat the oil in a wok or skillet and stir-fry the shrimp for 20 seconds
5. Remove , drain , and set aside
6. Reserve the leftover oil
7. Heat 1-2 tablespoons of the reserved oil in the wok and stir-fry the cucumber for 30 seconds
8. Remove , drain , and set aside
9. Heat 1-2 tablespoons of the reserved oil in the wok and add the ginger and garlic
10. Add the shrimp , cucumber , and wood mushrooms to the wok
11. Add the sauce , and stir-fry for 15 seconds
12. Serve

title: crumb top coffee cake
steps:
1. Combine butter , flour , sugar , baking powder , cinnamon , and salt and mix until crumbly
2. Save 1 / 2 cup for topping
3. To the reminaing mixture , add egg and milk
4. Mix well
5. Pour into a greased and floured 8x8 pan
6. Sprinkle saved crumb topping on top
7. Bake 375 degrees for 30-35 minutes

title: makeover ranch ham  n  cheese pasta
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to package directions
2. Drain
3. In a dutch oven , melt butter
4. Whisk in flour until smooth
5. Gradually add milk and seasonings
6. Bring to a boil
7. Cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened
8. Reduce heat
9. Fold in sour cream until blended
10. Add ham and pasta
11. Cook and stir until heated through
12. Remove from the heat
13. Stir in mexican cheese blend until melted
14. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese

title: chow mein hot dish
steps:
1. Brown the ground meat along with the celery and onions
2. Drain and rinse then combine in a casserole dish with the remaining ingredients , add the noodles last
3. Bake at 350 degrees for approximately 20-25 minutes until heated through
4. Serve with sticky white rice and a salad

title: chopped salad with spicy  buttermilk dressing
steps:
1. Whisk together buttermilk , mayonnaise , scallion whites and garlic
2. Combine chile powder , salt and pepper and add to mixture
3. Add romaine , tomatoes , corn , cheese , and scallion greens to the bowl
4. Toss to combine and serve immediately
5. Chop crosswise into bite-size pieces

title: trail mix cookies
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 375f
2. Cream the shortening , brown sugar , honey and eggs together
3. Combine the flour , wheat germ , baking soda and salt
4. Add to the creamed mixture gradually and beat until blended
5. Stir in the oats , fruits , nuts , seeds and chocolate chips
6. Mix well
7. Drop dough by heaping tablespoons about 2 inches apart onto a greased cookie sheet
8. Bake for 10-15 minutes or until golden
9. Cool for 5 minutes on the cookie sheet , then transfer cookies to a rack and cool completely

title: caramel apple martini
steps:
1. Shake all together with ice in a martini shaker & serve in chilled martini glass
2. Garnish with a slice of apple

title: chef rebecca rather s coconut cake
steps:
1. Place an oven rack in the bottom third of the oven and another in the top third of the oven
2. Preheat oven to 350f butter three 9-inch cake pans , then line each with a parchment round
3. Butter the paper and dust the pans with flour
4. Knock out excess
5. Using an electric mixer fitted with the paddle attachment , cream the butter and sugar on medium-high speed until light and fluffy , about 3 minutes
6. Use a rubber spatula to scrape down the sides of the bowl
7. In a medium bowl , stir together the flour , baking powder and salt to blend
8. In a small bowl , stir together the milk , coconut milk and coconut cream until smooth
9. Add the flour mixture in three increments , alternating with the milk mixture in two increments , starting and ending with the flour mixture
10. After each addition , mix at low speed just to combine the ingredients
11. Stir in the vanilla
12. Using an electric mixer fitted with the whisk attachment , beat the egg whites on high speed until stiff peaks form
13. Gently fold the egg whites into the batter until evenly blended
14. Divide the cake batter evenly among the prepared cake pans
15. Set two layers on the top rack and the third on the lower rack
16. Stagger the cake layers on the oven racks so that no layer is directly over another
17. Bake for 35 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the middle of the cakes comes out clean
18. Monitor the layers carefully for doneness
19. Each may be done at a different time
20. Remove from the oven and let cool in the pans for 10 minutes , then unmold onto wire racks to cool completely
21. Make whipped cream filling
22. Set aside
23. Make frosting
24. Set aside
25. To assemble the cake , stack one cake layer on a serving plate and spread the top with half of whipped cream filling
26. Repeat with a second layer
27. Stack the final cake layer on top of the first two and cover the cake's top and sides with the frosting
28. Sprinkle the coconut on the top and sides of the cake
29. Cover the cake loosely with plastic wrap and store for 1 day at room temperature or up to 3 days in the refrigerator
30. Bring to room temperature before serving
31. Makes 8 to 10 servings
32. Whipped cream filling: using an electric mixer fitted with the whisk attachment , beat 1 cup cold heavy whipping cream on high speed until soft peaks form
33. Beat in 2 tablespoons coconut cream and 1 / 2 cup grated fresh coconut
34. Frosting: whisk 2 large egg whites , 11 / 2 cups sugar , 1 / 3 cup cold water , 1 / 4 teaspoon cream of tartar and 1 / 4 teaspoon kosher salt in a large stainless-steel bowl until thoroughly combined
35. Place the bowl over a saucepan filled with 2 inches of barely simmering water
36. Using a hand beater or handheld electric mixer , continue beating the egg white mixture for 4 minutes
37. Add 1 / 2 cup mini marshmallows in 2 increments while continuing to beat
38. Wait until the first batch of marshmallows has melted before adding the second
39. Continue beating for 2 to 3 minutes more , until stiff peaks form
40. Remove from the heat , stir in the vanilla and continue beating until the frosting is thick enough to spread
41. When pressing the coconut in , the icing invariably sticks to my fingers and mars the frosting's finish
42. I've discovered that throwing small handfuls of coconut toward the side of the cake makes it adhere quite well a messy but effective technique for creating a gorgeous cake

title: mediterranean  roasted potatoes and vegetables
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425
2. Spray large shallow metal roasting pan with non-stick spray
3. Cut potatoes into 1 1 / 2-inch chunks
4. Place in pan
5. Toss with 1 tablespoon oil
6. Bake 10 minutes
7. Cut bell peppers into chunks , , cut onion through core and into wedges
8. Add peppers and onion to pan
9. Drizzle remaining 1 1 / 2 teaspoon oil over vegetables
10. Sprinkle with garlic , salt and black pepper
11. Toss well to coat
12. Return to oven
13. Bake 20 minutes longer or until vegetables are brown and tender , stirring once
14. Transfer to large serving bowl
15. Drizzle vinegar over vegetables , toss well to coat
16. Add basil
17. Toss again
18. Serve warm

title: delicious bread stuffing
steps:
1. Heat oven to 325
2. In a large saute pan , heat the butter and oil
3. Add onions , green onions , and celery
4. Saute until tender
5. Add mushrooms and saute 2 minutes more
6. Remove from heat and pour mixture into a large mixing bowl
7. Add remaining ingredients and any optional ingredients at this point
8. Stir well
9. Spoon into shallow baking pan , cover with foil , and bake 45 minutes
10. Remove foil and bake for another 15 minutes , until crusty and golden brown

title: betty crocker blueberry muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 f
2. Sift together flour , sugar , baking powder , and salt
3. In a different bowl combine shortening , egg , and milk
4. Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients
5. Carefully fold in blueberries
6. Don't worry if you crush a couple , the juices make a nice color swirl
7. Bake at 400 f for 20-25 minutes until lightly golden

title: souper supper
steps:
1. Brown ground beef and onion in a large pot , add onion soup mix , tomatoes , water and bring to a boil
2. Stir in uncooked pasta , cover and simmer about 10-12 min until pasta cooks
3. Stir in cheddar cheese and salt and pepper to taste
4. Serve and top with more cheese if you like

title: the best cabbage patch stew
steps:
1. Open all cans and pour into large stew pot on meduim heat
2. In skillet cook up your turkey with a little water to keep moist
3. When its nearly cooked add your minced garlic and sliced onion
4. Cook until meat is done
5. Drain meat and add to pot
6. Add carrots , celery , leeks and napa cabbage
7. Let the pot cook for at least an hours add in salt and pepper to taste
8. Serve hot
9. Healthy and yummy !
10. This also freezes well

title: sicilian meat roll  our way
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Combine egg , crumbs , herbs , salt and pepper in a large bowl
3. Add beef and mix well
4. Place mixture on a large piece of foil or waxed paper and pat into a 10"x8" rectangle
5. Arrange canadian bacon slices over beef mixture , leaving a small margin at edges
6. Set aside 2 slices of cheese
7. Tear remaining cheese into smaller pieces and sprinkle over canadian bacon
8. Starting from short end , roll up meat , using the foil to lift it
9. Press edges and ends to seal
10. Place in a 13"x9" baking pan , seam side down
11. Bake until cooked through , about 1 1 / 4 hours
12. Cut remaining cheese slices in half
13. Place cheese on top of meat
14. Return to oven until cheese melts

title: antipasto grilled cheese sandwich
steps:
1. Blot dry the roasted red pepper
2. Slice the marinated artichoke heart in half , then press it to flatten
3. Set these ingredients aside
4. Melt butter in a non stick skillet over med / low heat
5. Dip one side of each slice of bread in the melted butter and set aside
6. Place one slice of bread , buttered side down , in the skillet
7. Top with mozzerella , salami , roasted red pepper , and artichoke halves
8. Place other piece of bread ontop , buttered side up , and grill for about 2 minutes , pressing down on the sandwich the entire time
9. Check to see that the bottom is browning
10. Then flip the sandwich over and repeat cooking process to brown the other side
11. Slice in half and serve warm
12. Enjoy !

title: school cafeteria peanut butter cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Use a very large mixing bowl and cream together shortening , butter and both sugars
3. Beat in eggs
4. Beat in peanut butter
5. Gradually add in flour and baking soda
6. You may only need the 4 3 / 4 cups of flour and not a full 5 cups
7. You may need to use hands as dough gets very stiff
8. Drop them by tbsp on to ungreased cookie sheets
9. Bake at 350 degrees for about 10-13 minutes or until lightly browned at edges
10. Makes about 100 cookies

title: smoked salmon chowder
steps:
1. Cut potatoes into 1 / 2-inch cubes , leaving skin on
2. Place in bowl and cover with cold water
3. Melt the butter in a large pot over medium heat
4. Dice onion and add to melted butter
5. Saut until onion starts to become translucent
6. Drain water from potatoes
7. Rinse and drain again
8. Add potatoes to onions in pan
9. Cook 5 minutes , stirring occasionally
10. Coarsely chop enough carrots to make 1 1 / 2 cups
11. Add carrots and mushrooms to mixture in pot
12. Continue cooking , stirring occasionally
13. When vegetables are almost tender add flour and stir to mix it in well
14. Let cook 3-5 minutes , stirring often to prevent sticking or burning
15. Gradually add chicken broth
16. Stir well
17. Bring to a low simmer
18. Stir in coconut milk
19. Turn heat to low
20. Stir in smoked salmon
21. Stir in herbs de provence and ground cinnamon
22. Continue cooking over low heat 5-10 minutes , stirring occasionally
23. Add sea salt and fresh ground pepper to taste
24. Important: do not add salt until after you have tasted it
25. The saltiness of the salmon you use will influence how much salt you need to add , i did not add any additional salt

title: chicken souvlaki quesadilla
steps:
1. Spray skillet with cooking spray or lightly coat it with oil and heat to medium high
2. Lightly brown one side of the tortilla and set to the side
3. Re oil or spray pan and place un toasted tortilla in the pan and top with cheeses and chicken , then place toasted tortilla on top
4. Continue cooking until cheese is melted and warmed
5. Slice into wedges and serve with tzatziki sauce
6. Or if you don't like waiting over the stove top , you may bake at 400 for about 10 minutes

title: hearty heatlthy lentil soup
steps:
1. 1
2. Chop onion , carrots , celery and red peppers into 1 / 4 inches pieces
3. Cut jalapenos in half and remove seeds then mince with the garlic
4. 2
5. In a large sauce pan heat olive oil on medium heat
6. Add onion , carrots , celery , red peppers and jalapeno with garlic
7. Stir fry till slightly soft
8. Add the lentils , corn , broth , chili powder , cumin , oregano , salt and pepper
9. Bring to a boil stirring often
10. Cover and reduce heat
11. Simmer till lentils are soft and vegetables tender , approx 40 minutes
12. Season to taste
13. For thicker soup , add a few cups to a blender or food processor
14. 3
15. Serve with french bread or baguette

title: totally bitchin  buttermilk pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven at 350
2. Don't pre-bake the crust !
3. Mix all ingredients together in a big bowl
4. Make sure everything is well blended
5. I found that adding the buttermilk last came out best
6. Pour into pie crust and bake for 10 minutes
7. Lower the heat to 325 and bake for 1 hour
8. If the crust is browning too quickly , cover the pie with foil to keep the crust from burning

title: westglow spa health cocktail with tofu and cantaloupe
steps:
1. Blend well
2. Serve

title: south beach diet sausage veggie breakfast muffins
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350
2. Crumble your italian sauge in a skillet with no oil until nicely browned
3. Drain on paper towels and set aside in bowl
4. Chop your peppers and onion and saute in same skillet until soft
5. Add to your sausages and mix well
6. Spray your muffin tins and fill 1 / 2 way with sausage mix
7. If using whole eggs , beat and pour just to barely cover mix in tins
8. If using egg substitute , just pour to just barely cover
9. Sprinkle parm cheese over top , this will form a nice crust
10. Place muffin tin on top of large cookie sheet incase of dripping
11. Bake for 10 - 15 minuters until slightly puffed
12. There's no seasoning to add because the sausage is pre-seasoned
13. You can also make this with turkey sausage and use whatever veggies you like !

title: pork medallions with herbed spaetzle   emeril
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Pound pork medallions to 1 / 2-inch thickness , if necessary
3. Season pork medallions with about 1 tablespoon bayou blast
4. Season the flour , egg wash and bread crumbs with 1 tablespoon creole seasoning each
5. Dredge pork in seasoned flour , dip in egg mixture , then coat thoroughly with crumbs , shaking off excess after each layer
6. Refrigerate while you prepare herbed spaetzle
7. In an ovenproof saute pan heat oil , add pork and cook until first side is golden
8. Turn medallions and transfer pan to oven to finish cooking
9. Serve pork on top of herbed spaetzle

title: my mom s wilted lettuce
steps:
1. Wash the lettuce several times
2. Drain
3. Clean and cut the onions into the lettuce
4. Sprinkle with salt and pepper to taste
5. Dressing: heat dressing ingredients to boiling
6. Pour over lettuce while boiling hot
7. Stir and mix well
8. Serve immediately

title: cedar planked salmon with maple glaze   mustard mashed potat
steps:
1. Salmon:
2. In a small heavy saucepan simmer maple syrup , ginger root , 3 tablespoons lemon juice , soy sauce , garlic , and salt and pepper to taste until reduced to about 1 cup , about 30 minutes
3. Let cool
4. Preheat oven to 350
5. If using a cedar plank , lightly oil and heat in middle of oven 15 minutes
6. Or lightly oil a shallow baking pan large enough to hold salmon
7. Arrange scallion greens in one layer on plank or in baking pan to form a bed for fish
8. In another small saucepan heat half of glaze over low heat until heated through to use as a sauce
9. Stir in remaining 1 tablespoon lemon juice
10. Remove pan from heat and keep sauce warm , covered
11. Put salmon , skin side down , on scallion greens and brush with remaining glaze
12. Season salmon with salt and pepper and roast in middle of oven until just cooked through , about 20 minutes if using baking pan
13. Bake for about 35 minutes if using plank
14. Cut salmon crosswise into 6 pieces
15. On each of 6 plates arrange salmon and scallion greens on a bed of mashed potatoes
16. Drizzle salmon with warm sauce
17. Mustard mashed potatoes:
18. In a 5 quart kettle cover potatoes with cold salted water by 2-inches and simmer until tender , 35-45 minutes
19. While potatoes are simmering , in a small saucepan heat milk with butter over moderate heat until butter is melted
20. Remove pan from heat and keep milk mixture warm , covered
21. In a colander drain potatoes and cool just until they can be handled
22. Peel potatoes , transferring to a large bowl
23. Add mustard , salt and pepper to taste , and 3 / 4 hot milk mixture and with a potato masher
24. Mash potatoes until smooth , adding more milk mixture if necessary to make them creamy
25. Potatoes may be made 1 day ahead and cooled completely before being chilled in a buttered ovenproof dish , covered
26. Bring potatoes to room temperature before reheating , covered

title: restaurant style french fries
steps:
1. Prepare the potatoes and oil: in a 3-quart saucepan with a deep-fry thermometer attached , heat oil to 350 degrees f
2. Cut potatoes into long sticks -- about 2 inches by 1 / 2 inch
3. Lay potatoes in a single layer on paper towel
4. Let stand for 10 minutes until dry
5. Cook potatoes: toss potatoes with sugar
6. Fry half of the potatoes in the hot oil until they begin to crisp and turn light blond -- about 2 minutes
7. Use a slotted spoon to remove
8. Drain on paper towel
9. Repeat for the second batch and let potatoes stand for 5 minutes
10. Finish the potatoes: raise oil temperature to 375 degrees f
11. Refry potatoes , in 3 batches , until golden brown -- 4 to 6 minutes
12. Use a slotted spoon to remove , drain on a paper towel , and sprinkle with salt

title: tiger tiger cocktail
steps:
1. Fill a short rocks glass or cocktail glass about half full of ice , then add the alcohol , then the milk
2. Swirl with a little grenadine for added sweetness and to make it look pretty ! garnish away --

title: baked 4 cheese spaghetti
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350
2. Lightly butter a 9-by-13-inch baking dish
3. Cook the spaghetti in a large pot of boiling salted water until al dente
4. Drain well and spread the spaghetti on a baking sheet
5. Let cool
6. In a large bowl , toss the fontina with the mozzarella and gruyre
7. Spread one third of the spaghetti in the prepared baking dish in an even layer
8. Sprinkle 1 / 3 of the mixed cheeses and half of the gorgonzola over the spaghetti and season with salt and pepper
9. Repeat with another layer of spaghetti , mixed cheeses , gorgonzola and salt and pepper
10. Top with the remaining spaghetti and mixed cheeses
11. Bake the spaghetti in the center of the oven until the top is golden brown , about 40 minutes
12. Let cool slightly before cutting into squares and serving

title: creole autumn salad
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Sprinkle chicken breasts on both sides with creole seasoning
3. Heat 2 tablespoons of the oil in large skillet over medium-high heat until hot
4. Place chicken in single layer in skillet
5. Cook 3 to 5 minutes on each side or until browned
6. Place chicken in baking dish , cover and bake 15 to 20 minutes or until done
7. Set skillet aside
8. While the chicken bakes , pierce potatoes several times with a fork
9. Cook in microwave on high 4 to 5 minutes or until just tender
10. Cool slightly
11. Peel and dice
12. Place the remaining oil , potatoes , apple , celery and undrained tomatoes in skillet used for chicken
13. Place over medium heat and cook 3 to 4 minutes or until celery is crisp-tender
14. Remove from heat
15. Stir in vinegar , mustard and salt
16. Cut each chicken breast into thin slices
17. For each serving , top 1 cup lettuce with about 1 cup apple-sweet potato mixture , 1 sliced chicken breast and 1 tablespoon pecans

title: carrot  apple   celery soup
steps:
1. Place the carrots , onion and celery in a lare pan and add the vegetable stock
2. Bring to a boil , reduce heat , cover , and let simmer for 10 minutes
3. Meanwhile , peel , core , and dice 2 of the apples
4. Add the diced apples , tomato paste , bay leaf , and sugar to the pan and bring to a boil over medium heat
5. Reduce the heat , partially cover the pan , and let simmer for 20 minutes
6. Remove and discard the bay leaf
7. Meanwhile , wash , core , and cut the remaining apple into thin slices , without peeling
8. Place the apple slices in a small pan and squeeze the lemon juice over apple slices
9. Heat the apple slices gently and let simmer for 1-2 minutes , or until the apple is tender
10. Drain the apple slices and set aside until required
11. Place the carrot and apple mixture in a blender or food processor until smooth
12. Gently reheat the soup if necessary and season to taste with salt and pepper
13. Ladle the soup into 4 warmed bowls , top with the reserved apple slices and shredded celery leaves
14. Serve immediately

title: bruschetta rustica
steps:
1. In a bowl , combine tomatoes , onions , and rosemary
2. Season to taste with salt and pepper
3. Grill or toast both sides of the bread until golden brown
4. Rub each slice with garlic , brush with remaining olive oil , and sprinkle with salt and pepper
5. Arrange the tomatoes evenly on top o the toast and garnish with rosemary

title: lemony snickets
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375
2. Beat butter and sugar together , add eggs and lemon extract
3. Combine flour , oats , cinnamon , soda and salt
4. Add to sugar mixture , mix well , stir in crystallized ginger
5. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls onto cookie sheet
6. For disguise: in small bowl , combine 1 t sugar and 1 t cinnamon
7. Sprinkle the disguise lightly over each cookie
8. Bake 8-10 minutes
9. Do not bake too long , or you may need the aid of the volunteer fire department

title: basil garlic toast
steps:
1. Heat oven to 425 degrees
2. Line baking sheet with aluminum foil
3. Place bread cut sides up on baking sheet
4. Process basil in food processor or blender until finely chopped
5. Add butter , oil , cheese , and garlic
6. Process until smooth
7. Season to taste with salt and pepper
8. Spread basil butter evenly over each bread half
9. Bake until golden , 10-12 minutes
10. Cut bread into 4-inch lengths and serve hot

title: sassy seasoned shrimp
steps:
1. Mix first eight ingredients in a bowl
2. You can reserve 1 / 4 cup of the marinade as a dipping sauce
3. Put the marinade in a large ziploc bag and add shrimp
4. Marinate in the refrigerator at least 2 hours
5. Take shrimp out of bag and thread onto skewers
6. Grill over medium high heat for about 4 minutes each side , or until shrimp are done
7. Serve with reserved marinade as a dipping sauce

title: rosemary balsamic syrup   dairy free
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a medium non-reactive saucepan and simmer until reduced by half
2. Strain out rosemary and peppercorns and discard
3. Funnel the syrup into small jars and seal
4. Keeps well indefinitely when chilled

title: one pot turkey chilli
steps:
1. Saute the onion , pepper and garlic in a little olive oil over medium heat
2. Add the turkey and break up with a wooden spoon , cook until turkey turns white
3. Stir in the tomatoes , tomato sauce and the remainder of the ingredients
4. Bring to a boil then cover and cook on a low heat for 1-1 1 / 2 hours
5. Serve with rice and top with sour cream and cheese if desired

title: baked french toast with blueberries
steps:
1. Grease a 13x9-inch baking dish
2. Diagonally cut break into 1 inch slices , place in baking dish , and set aside
3. In medium bowl light beat eggs , sugar , and vanilla
4. Stir in milk
5. Pour mixture over break in baking dish , turning slices to coat well
6. Cover and refrigerate overnight
7. Heat over to 375f
8. In small bowl combine flour , brown sugar , and cinnamon
9. Cut in butter until mixture resembles course crumbs
10. Turn bread slices over in baking dish
11. Scatter blueberries over bread and sprinkle evenly with crumb mixture
12. Bake about 40 minutes or until golden brown
13. Before serving , top with strawberries , if desired

title: petite lasagna for 2 or 3
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f
2. Spray medium nonstick skillet with nonstick cooking spray
3. Add ground beef , onion , and bell pepper
4. Cook and stir until browned
5. Drain
6. Reduce heat to low
7. Stir in mushrooms and spaghetti sauce
8. Simmer 5 minutes , stirring occasionally
9. In a small bowl , combine ricotta cheese , parmesan cheese , parsley and egg
10. Mix well
11. Cut 1 of the lasagna noodles in half lengthwise
12. Spread 1 / 4 cup meat mixture in bottom of ungreased 95-inch loaf baking dish
13. Top with 1 1 / 2 lasagna noodles , 1 / 2 the ricotta mixture , 1 / 2 the remaining meat mixture and 1 / 2 the mozzarella cheese
14. Repeat layers , starting with noodles and ending with mozzarella cheese
15. Bake at 350f for 30 to 35 minutes or until thoroughtly heated and bubbly

title: yellow rice
steps:
1. Put all the ingredients into a heavy-bottomed pot , stir well , and bring to a boil over medium-high heat
2. Reduce the heat to a simmer , cover , and cook over low heat until the rice has absorbed the water , about 15 to 20 minutes
3. Remove from the heat and let sit , covered , for 5 minutes
4. Discard the garlic and bay leaf , fluff with a fork , and serve

title: tomato  basil  and caper bow tie pasta
steps:
1. Combine first 10 ingredients in a large bowl , and toss well
2. Sprinkle vinegar over each serving , if desired

title: spinach stuffed cucumber cases
steps:
1. Peel and cut cucumber into 3 / 4 to 1 inch thick pieces and scoop out the seeds from one end of each cucumber piece , leaving the other end closed to form a small case or cup
2. Chill and dry the cucumber cases on paper towels , uncovered , in the refrigerator for at least one hour
3. Combine the remaining ingredients and fill the cucumber cases with the mixture
4. The cases can be filled an hour or two before serving

title: mediterranean salsa
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together in a bowl
2. Chill for 1 hour
3. Serve with tortilla or pita chips

title: chocolate sauerkraut cake
steps:
1. Sift together the flour , cocoa , baking powder , baking soda and salt
2. Set aside
3. Cream together the butter and sugar in a bowl until light and fluffy , using an electric mixer set at medium speed
4. Add eggs , one at a time , beating well after each addition
5. Beat in vanilla
6. Add dry ingredients alternately with water to creamed mixture , beating well after each addition
7. Stir in sauerkraut
8. Spread batter in greased 13x9x2-inch baking pan
9. Bake in a preheated 350f oven for 35 minutes or until cake tests done
10. Cool in pan on rack
11. Frost with creamy chocolate frosting
12. Cut into squares
13. Creamy chocolate frosting: melt chocolate in a custard cup in hot water
14. Cool slightly
15. Combine chocolate , cream cheese , milk , confectioners' sugar , salt , and vanilla in a bowl
16. Beat with an electric mixer at high speed until smooth and creamy

title: oven braised onions with ham
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Drop the unpeeled onions into a large pan of boiling water , cook 30 seconds , then drain and rinse with cold water
3. Cut a thin slice off the root end of each onion and peel off the skin
4. Heat oil in an oven proof skillet
5. Add bacon , red pepper , tomato paste , broth , vinegar , bay , thyme , salt and pepper and bring to a boil
6. Add onions , cover and bake 30-40 minutes or until onions are tender

title: super strawberry pie
steps:
1. Dissolve jello in boiling water for 3 minutes
2. Add ice cream by spoonsful , stirring until melted and mixture is smooth
3. Blend in whipped topping
4. Stir in fruit
5. Chill until mixture mounds
6. Spoon into crust
7. Chill 3 hours or freeze until firm

title: blackened shrimp tacos
steps:
1. Combine first 5 ingredients in a small bowl
2. Set aside
3. Combine paprika and next 6 ingredients in a large zip-top plastic bag
4. Add shrimp to bag
5. Seal and shake well to coat
6. Remove shrimp
7. Heat a grill pan over high heat
8. Coat pan with cooking spray
9. Add shrimp
10. Cook 2 minutes per side or until done
11. Working with 1 tortilla at a time , heat tortillas over medium-high heat directly on the eye of a burner for about 15 seconds on each side or until lightly charred
12. Divide shrimp evenly among tortillas
13. Divide tomato , avocado , and sauce evenly among tacos

title: trisha s easy fried rice
steps:
1. Melt butter or margarine in non-stick skillet
2. Add onions and carrots , and fry until onions are transparent and carrots are crisp
3. Add peas and cook for 1 minute more
4. Push veggies to one side and scramble eggs in empty side of skillet
5. Add soy sauce
6. Spoon in rice and mix until well blended
7. Fry until steamy and serve

title: baked pasta with aubergines  eggplants
steps:
1. Slice off both ends from the aubergines and discard
2. Slice the aubergines thinly
3. Arrange the slices in layers on a cutting board , sprinkling each layer with salt
4. Place the cutting board on a draining board , raised and supported on one side so that any liquid resulting from the purging process will drain into the sink
5. Then cover the slices of aubergine with a heavy weight and leave for a couple of hours
6. During this time a somewhat bitter liquid will drain from the aubergines -- this is the purging process , as it's referred to in italy
7. After 2 hours rinse the slices and pat dry
8. Lightly flour the slices to prevent them from absorbing too much oil when they are fried
9. While the aubergines are 'purging' prepare the tomato sauce
10. Heat the oil in a frypan and gently fry the chopped onion and garlic until softened
11. Add the tomatoes with their liquid , sugar , salt , and freshly ground pepper to taste and cook on high , uncovered , for about 20 minutes , stirring frequently
12. When the sauce is reduced and thick , check the seasoning
13. Using a blender or food processor , puree the sauce
14. Start the water boiling for the pasta in a large pot
15. While the water is heating , fry the aubergine slices in hot olive oil , using plenty of oil and frying only a few slices at a time
16. Do not let the slices become too crisp
17. Drain each batch on paper towels and keep warm
18. Add salt and a few drops of oil to the boiling water and cook the pasta
19. Cook the pasta for only half the time stated in the directions as it will continue cooking during the baking process
20. Drain the pasta , toss with some butter , and add the tomato sauce , mixing well
21. Butter a deep ovenproof serving dish and spread a thin layer of pasta on the bottom
22. Cover this with a layer of the aubergine slices , and cover these slices with thin slices of mozzarella
23. Repeat these layers until you have used up all the ingredients , ending with a final layer of mozzarella
24. Dot the top with butter and bake at 425 degrees f for 20 minutes until melted and golden brown

title: winter goat cheese salad served with apricot dressing
steps:
1. Directions for cutting salad are listed next to the ingredients
2. Preheat the oven to 350
3. Spread the sliced almonds on a sheet pan and toast for 10 minutes , or until golden
4. Let cool
5. In a bowl , whisk the shallots , thyme , apricot jam , olive oil , and vinegar
6. In a large bowl , toss the spinach , endives , radicchio and almonds together
7. Pour the dressing over the greens and toss
8. Mound the salad on plates , arrange 2 rounds of goat cheese on top of salad
9. Sprinkle goat cheese with a little salt and peeper and serve

title: california club salad
steps:
1. Combine first 3 ingredients , stirring well
2. Cover and chill thoroughly
3. Place shredded lettuce on a large serving platter
4. Arrange chicken , tomatoes , avacado , bacon and egg over lettuce
5. Spoon chilled dressing over salad just before serving

title: farmhouse potato bread
steps:
1. Peel and boil about 6 small potatoes in salted water in a small saucepan
2. In the meantime , measure the milk , margarine , sugar and salt together
