3. When the potatoes have cooked through , drain them and mash in the milk mixture
4. Transfer into a food processor and pulse until smooth
5. By now , the mixture should have cooled to about 110 degrees
6. Sprinkle in the yeast and let rest for 10 minutes
7. Place the flour in the bowl of a stand mixer and attach the dough hook
8. Pour in the potato mixture and run the mixer for 10 minutes
9. Coat the dough ball with half of the olive oil and roll it around in the bowl
10. Cover the bowl with a moist cloth and let rise in a warm place for about 30 minutes or until doubled
11. Using a floured surface , knead the dough about a dozen times
12. Coat it with the remaining olive oil and return it to the bowl
13. Cover with the moist cloth and let it rise again in a warm place for about 30 minutes or until doubled
14. Use cooking spray to coat two loaf pans
15. Punch the dough down , form it into two separate loaves and set it into the pans
16. Cover it and let it rise one final time in the warm place for about 15 minutes
17. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees
18. Mix the honey and water together and brush it over the surface of the loaves
19. Bake for approximately 30 minutes or until a rich golden brown , and hollow sounding when tapped
20. Cool for 5 minutes , then remove from pans to cool completely

title: minestrone soup  zero points   no pasta    no beans
steps:
1. 1
2. Pour one can of petite-cut tomatoes into soup pan with minced garlic and puree this mixuture until it's difficult to see the garlic pieces
3. 2
4. Mix in tomato paste
5. 3
6. Using a medium ribbon microplane grater or cheese grater , grate onion into soup pan
7. 3
8. Add remaining ingredients , bring to a boil and reduce to a simmer for 45 minutes
9. Enjoy !

title: guam fried rice
steps:
1. Fry bacon until crisp
2. Remove bacon and pour off half the bacon fat , reserve a little to add to pan after cooking your egg
3. Sometimes the egg will absorb every bit of bacon fat and sometimes it leaves behind enough to coat the rice
4. Fry garlic in bacon fat until golden , remove and discard
5. Fry onion in the same bacon fat
6. Remove onion from pan and add to bacon
7. Spread eggs on bottom of pan as if preparing an omelet
8. Fold over
9. Remove to cutting board or plate
10. Cut into strips
11. Add reserved bacon fat and cold rice to pan , stir until all grains are coated with grease and grains are no longer sticking together
12. Add bacon , onion and ham
13. Mix well
14. Always scraping bottom of pan to prevent sticking
15. Turn heat to low and add sliced egg pieces
16. Add cooked shrimp
17. Heat 1-2 minutes , just until shrimp is warmed
18. Remove from heat and serve

title: spinach red pepper crostini
steps:
1. Bake bread slices on baking sheet at 375f for 5 minutes
2. Set aside
3. Lower oven to 350f
4. Toast walnuts or pecans on a baking sheet , stirring occasionally , 5-10 minutes
5. Raise heat back to 375f
6. Drain spinach well , pressing between paper towels
7. Process spinach , parmesan cheese , and next 6 ingredients in a food processor until mixture is smooth
8. Spread mixture evenly over bread slices
9. Bake for 5 minutes
10. Top evenly with roasted pepper strips
11. Serve immediately

title: finger licking vegetables mix
steps:
1. Put all the vegetables in a bowl with 1 / 2 cup water and microwave for 18 minutes
2. Meanwhile , heat oil in a skillet and add fennel seeds
3. Add garlic and all the powdered spices alongwith salt
4. Empty microwaved vegetables , green pepper and onions
5. Saute on medium heat for 10 minutes turning the veggies gently
6. Bet you will not have a speck left in the serving dish

title: deer steak marinade
steps:
1. Mix all the ingredients and place steak in the sauce to marinate over night
2. This works good on tougher pieces of meat

title: pineapple baked chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Arrange chicken in a single layer in a baking dish
3. Mix together pineapple , brown sugar , lime juice , mustard and soy sauce
4. Pour evenly over chicken
5. Cover and bake for 45 to 55 minutes
6. Uncover and bake an additional 10 to 15 minutes or until chicken is done

title: cauliflower and sweet potato balti
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large pan and cook onions , ginger and sugar for 5 minutes
2. Add cumin , tomatoes , turmeric , coriander , chilli , and the water , bring to a simmer
3. Add potatoes , cover and simmer for 5 minutes
4. Add cauliflower , cover and simmer for 15 minutes
5. Add the chickpeas , simmer for a further 5 minutes
6. Add lemon juice and serve

title: homemade fresh salsa
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients
2. Chill until ready to serve
3. Puree all for easy and fast preparation
4. Serve with raw veggies , pita chips or corn chips

title: broccoli and cheddar salmon
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Put the salmon pieces in baking pam , sprayed with pam
3. Set aside in a cool place
4. Cook broccoli in boiling water or in microwave
5. Drain well and sponge them with paper towel
6. Combine broccoli , green onion , yogurt and cheddar in a bowl
7. Add salt and pepper
8. Mix
9. Put this mixture on the salmon , then sprinkle with breadcrumbs
10. Cook in oven 10 to 15 minutes or until the salmon flakes easily with a fork

title: breakfast souffles with chipotle honey  5fix
steps:
1. Microwave the honey in a small container with the pulverized chipotle peppers
2. Allow to sit for a few hours , then strain the larger pieces of chipotle pepper out of the honey
3. Set aside
4. Preheat oven to 350f
5. In a medium-sized bowl , combine eggs and potatoes
6. Blend well with an immersion blender
7. Stir in shredded bacon cheddar and portion out into four greased ramekins
8. Bake 20 minutes , or until egg has set and cheese has melted

title: super fast  low fat layered dip
steps:
1. Spread both cans of refried beans in an 8x8 square baking dish
2. In a medium size bowl , mix the package of ranch dressing with the sour cream
3. Spread the sour cream mixture over the beans
4. Top with black olives , tomato , and green onions
5. Cover with cheese
6. Refrigerate until ready to serve
7. Serve with light or baked tortilla chips

title: oven roasted chicken tikka
steps:
1. Wash and clean the chicken legs with skin off
2. Mix yoghurt and all ingredients in a bowl
3. Marinate the chicken legs
4. Keep overnight in the fridge
5. Take out of the fridge atleast an hour before cooking
6. Preheat the oven at 350 degrees
7. Place the marinated chicken legs in a oven dish lined together leaving the extra marinate
8. Bake it for 1 hour
9. Because it tastes good if it is cooked well
10. Turn it over after first half-an-hour

title: baked donuts
steps:
1. Place 1 / 3 cup of the warm milk in the bowl of an electric mixer
2. Stir in the yeast and set aside for five minutes or so
3. Be sure your milk isn't too hot or it will kill the yeast
4. Stir the butter and sugar into the remaining cup of warm milk and add it to the yeast mixture
5. With a fork , stir in the eggs , flour , nutmeg and salt , just until the flour is incorporated
6. With the dough hook attachment of your mixer beat the dough for a few minutes at medium speed
7. This is where you are going to need to make adjustments - if your dough is overly sticky , add flour a few tablespoons at a time
8. Too dry ? add more milk a bit at a time
9. You want the dough to pull away from the sides of the mixing bowl and eventually become supple and smooth
10. Turn it out onto a floured counter-top , knead a few times , and shape into a ball
11. Transfer the dough to a buttered bowl , cover , put in a warm place , and let rise for an hour or until the dough has roughly doubled in size
12. Punch down the dough and roll it out 1 / 2-inch thick on your floured countertop
13. Most people don't have a doughnut cutter , instead i use a 2-3 inch cookie cutter to stamp out circles
14. Transfer the circles to a parchment-lined baking sheet and stamp out the smaller inner circles using a smaller cutter
15. If you cut the inner holes out any earlier , they become distorted when you attempt to move them
16. Cover with a clean cloth and let rise for another 45 minutes
17. Bake in a 375 oven until the bottoms are just golden , 8-10 minutes - start checking after 8
18. Meanwhile , place the butter in a medium bowl
19. Place the sugar and cinnamon in a separate bowl
20. Remove the doughnuts from the oven and let cool for just a minute or two
21. Dip each one in the melted butter and a quick toss in the sugar bowl
22. Serve immediately

title: sandy s cucumber    tomato pasta salad
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to package directions
2. Rinse pasta under cold water till cool , drain well !
3. Add chopped tomato , cucumber , and green onions
4. Mix in mayo , salt , and pepper
5. Chill for 30 minutes
6. Serve cold
7. My mother mentioned that sometimes she adds 2 tablespoons of flat leaf parsley , 1 teaspoon of lemon juice , and that she doesn't add the pepper till she is ready to eat it
8. I don't do any of that

title: honey mustard chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Spray baking dish with non-stick spray
3. Combine mustard , honey and sauce in a small bowl
4. Lay chicken in baking dish ,
5. Bake for 30-40 minutes or until chicken juices are clear

title: white beans in coconut milk
steps:
1. Finely chop onion and garlic clove
2. Chop tomato
3. Heat oil in a skillet
4. Cook onion and garlic in oil for 3 minutes
5. Add chopped tomato , salt , pepper and turmeric , stir
6. Add beans and coconut milk and let the mixture simmer uncovered for 5-10 minutes
7. Check the taste and add more seasonings if you prefer

title: so easy roasted asparagus
steps:
1. Combine sugar , salt , and pepper in small bowl
2. Set aside
3. Wash , and snap off tough ends of asparagus
4. Arrange asparagus spears in a 15x10" jellyroll pan
5. Drizzle with olive oil
6. Broil about 4 minutes , or until skin of asparagus begins to pucker
7. Sprinkle with the sugar / salt / pepper mixture
8. Serve immediately

title: quick skillet chicken   macaroni parmesan
steps:
1. Combine italian sauce , 3 tablespoons parmesan cheese , chicken and macaroni in skillet
2. Heat to a boil
3. Reduce heat to medium
4. Cover and cook for 10 minutes or until macaroni is done , stirring occasionally
5. Sprinkle with mozzarella cheese and remaining parmesan cheese
6. Let stand for 5 minutes or until cheese melts
7. Kitchen clip: you can use store-bought rotisserie chicken or leftover cooked chicken for this dish

title: pineapple orange colada
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in blender
2. Cover and blend on high speed , stopping blender to scrape sides if necessary , until smooth

title: banana bundt cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease and flour a 10-inch bundt pan
3. Set aside
4. In a large bowl , add the cake mix , water , oil and eggs
5. Mix for about one minute , at medium speed
6. Add the mashed banana , again mix one more minute at medium speed
7. Pour into the bundt pan
8. Bake for 43-45 minutes , or until done
9. Let set for 20 minutes in pan
10. Before inverting onto plate

title: sweet red chili noodles with sesame seeds
steps:
1. Put a large pot of salted water on to boil
2. Meanwhile , mix sweet red chili sauce , oil , lime juice and sesame seeds in small bowl
3. Cook rice noodles according to package directions , drain and rinse briefly
4. Pour noodles into serving bowl and mix with sweet red chili mixture
5. Serve

title: mom s baked cowboy beans
steps:
1. Preheat oven 350 degrees
2. In a saucepan brown the hamburger meat and the onion
3. Drain set aside
4. In a pam sprayed casserole dish add the beans , ketchup , mustard , and brown sugar mixing well
5. Add the browned meat mixture to the bean mixture and stir mixing well
6. Cook beans until throughly hot maybe 15 minutes then add the velveeta cheese on top put back into stove until cheese is melted
7. Take out and stir
8. Enjoy !
9. I had to really guess on measurements and cooking times because with this recipe i never measure exact amount
10. I know that i use way more velveeta cheese
11. I guess you can play with the recipe until you find your personal likings

title: our best lemonade
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients
2. Taste and adjust
3. Enjoy

title: melitzanosalata
steps:
1. Wash the eggplants , prick them with a fork and squeeze them out
2. Bake them in a hot oven until they're soft
3. Remove seeds and peel of the eggplant and puree it
4. Mix with the onion , the pepper and the mayonnaise
5. Serve chilled

title: eine schone melousine
steps:
1. In dutch oven , put 1 stick butter in center
2. Place steamed cauliflower on top of butter
3. In a medium size mixing bowl combine meat with bread , 1 egg , onion , green pepper , spices and ketchup
4. Form meat as a ring around the sides of the cauliflower
5. Top with sauce
6. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese [top with fresh tomatoes cut in wedges]
7. Bake in 400 degree oven for 1 hour -- covered -- or until done
8. Serve with boiled or mashed potatoes , wide egg noodles , or french-garlic bread

title: sumac and chilli oven fries
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 195c
2. Grease an oven tray well with vegetable oil
3. Wash and cut potatoes into wedges
4. Combine egg white and spices into a large bowl
5. Mix well
6. Add potatoes and coat well
7. Bake potatoes skin side down for 40 minutes or until tender and golden brown
8. Serve with a relish or as a side

title: great hamburgers
steps:
1. Blend all ingredients
2. Form into six patties and broil

title: tuna noodle casserole
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees
2. Lightly grease a baking dish
3. Combine the cooked noodles , tuna , red peppers , water chestnuts and onion , and mix to combine
4. In a large pan , melt 2 tablespoons butter and add two tablespoons flour
5. Stir well until a paste forms - do not allow to brown
6. Add the milk , continue stirring , and bring to a boil
7. Add the salt and pepper , lower the heat and cook for another minute
8. Add the cheddar cheese and cook for another minute or until a smooth , creamy sauce develops
9. Stir in a pinch of cayenne
10. Pour the sauce over the noodle mixture and stir well to combine
11. In a small pan , melt the remaining four tablespoons butter , add the breadcrumbs and cook until slightly browned
12. Spread breadcrumbs over the top of the noodle mixture
13. Cook , uncovered , for 20 minutes or until very hot

title: water pie
steps:
1. Pre heat oven to 350 deg
2. Sprinkle flour and sugar into crust in alternating layers
3. Dot with butter
4. Add vanilla
5. Carefully pour in water
6. Do not stir
7. Bake for 60 to 70 minutes til center is like custard and not runny

title: pasta with simple zucchini sauce
steps:
1. Bring a large pot of water to the boil
2. Add the pasta and cook 'al dente
3. Meanwhile , grate the zucchinis and place aside
4. In a large frying pan , heat plenty of olive oil and add the anchovies , crushed garlic and sea salt
5. Fry for about 3 minutes , stirring continuously until the anchovies start to soften
6. Sprinkle in the chili flakes and freshly ground pepper , followed by the grated zucchinis and a dash more olive oil
7. Stir for a further 2 minutes
8. When the pasta is cooked , drain well and add to the sauce
9. To serve , toss the pasta through the sauce and spoon onto plates
10. Grate fresh parmesan over the top and finish with freshly ground pepper

title: tennessee hillbilly chops
steps:
1. Lightly spray a 8-10" pan with spray oil
2. Sear the chops in the pan on each side for approximately 30 seconds , or until medium brown pour can of stokely's bavarian sauerkraut on top of all 4 chops , put lid on pan , and simmer for 4-5 hours

title: white cabbage rolls
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Wash cabbage and cut out core
3. Place into lg pot filled half full of water
4. Cook covered about 20 min , or until cabbage starts to fall apart
5. Remove from water and set aside
6. In a saucepan brown beef and onion
7. Sprinkle with salt and pepper while cooking , drain
8. Mix beef and rice togather
9. Tear leafs off of head of cabbage
10. Fill each with large spoonful of rice mixture
11. Roll up and place into baking dish seal side down
12. Repeat until rice mixture is gone
13. In another sauce pan mix sour cream and about 1 / 2 to 3 / 4 can of beef broth over low heat
14. Cook and stir about 5 minutes
15. Pour sour cream mixture over cabbage rolls
16. Cover with aluminum foil and bake 25-30 minutes
17. Enjoy

title: apricot  coconut and almond bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Butter a 10"x15" cookie sheet
3. Combine water , sugar and apricots in a medium saucepan
4. Bring to a boil , and simmer over moderate heat , stirring occasionally , until the apricots are tender and plump
5. Drain apricots and return to the pan
6. Add butter , brown sugar , honey and salt and cook until butter is just melted
7. Transfer to a bowl
8. Spread the coconut and almonds on separate baking sheets and toast for 6 to 7 minutes , until lightly golden
9. Stir the coconut and almonds into the apricot mixture along with the oats and flour
10. Spread the mixture in the cookie sheet in an even layer
11. Bake for about 25 minutes , until golden
12. Let cool on a rack , then cut into 16 bars
13. The bars can be stored in an airtight container for up to 2 days

title: cheesy red bliss garlic potatoes
steps:
1. Slice potatoes 1 / 4" thick and place in large plastic bag
2. Add seasoning packet , red pepper and parmesan cheese
3. Use enough olive oil to just coat potatoes and toss
4. Refrigerate an hour if possible
5. Place in casserole and bake 350 for 45 minutes
6. Add shredded cheddar or any good meltable cheese and place back in oven for 5-10 minutes

title: lemon chicken piccata
steps:
1. In a shallow bowl put the flour , salt and pepper and dredge your chicken , shaking off excess
2. In a large fry pan over a medium high heat , place 2 tbs
3. Of oil and heat until almost smoking
4. Add the chicken and cook until browned and opaque throughout , about 8-9 minutes total
5. Place chicken on a warm platter and cover while you make the sauce
6. In the same pan over a medium high heat , warm the remaining 1 tbs
7. Of oil
8. Add the shallots and saut until soft and translucent , 1-2 minutes
9. Add the wine and reduce to about half
10. Use a wooden spoon and scrape the bottom of pan to loosen the brown bits
11. Add the lemon juice , stock and capers and cook until thickened , about 5 minutes
12. Whisk in the sage , butter and parsley
13. Spoon the sauce over the chicken and serve

title: yummy deviled eggs
steps:
1. Cut peeled eggs in half lengthwise
2. Slip out yolks
3. Mash with fork
4. Mix in seasonings and dressing
5. Fill whites with yolk mixture heaping it up lightly

title: bacon chicken
steps:
1. Cook bacon in 12" skillet until crisp
2. Crumble bacon and set aside
3. Pour bacon grease out of skillet , but don't wash or wipe it
4. Add butter and olive oil to the same skillet
5. Cook chicken breasts in this mixture over medium heat , turning once , until chicken is done
6. Place chicken in ungreased 12x8" baking dish
7. Cook onion and garlic in drippings remaining in skillet until the onion is softened
8. Stir in the pepper and cooked& crumbled bacon
9. Spoon over chicken breasts and sprinkle with parsley and cheese
10. Bake at 350 degrees for 10-15 minutes until cheese is melted

title: baby food cake
steps:
1. Mix all but pecans
2. When well mixed fold in pecans
3. And pour into greased and sugared bundt pan
4. Bake at 350 for 1 hour

title: ham marinade
steps:
1. Mix all marinade ingredients
2. Put ham and marinade in resealable plastic bag
3. Marinate ham slice a few hours or overnight
4. Fire up the grill or broiler or even heat in a pan on top of the stove
5. Cook ham until done and heated through
6. Baste during cooking

title: apple waldorf salad
steps:
1. Mix mayonnaise , sugar , lemon juice and salt together
2. Stir in apples , celery and walnuts together
3. Serve chilled

title: broccoli slaw salad with apple   brocco slaw
steps:
1. Place brocco slaw and apple in a bowl
2. Whisk together mayonnaise , vinegar , honey and salt and pepper
3. Pour over brocco slaw and apple
4. Mix well , with your hands
5. Serve

title: peppermint latte from b h and g heart healthy living
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan , heat and stir the milk until hot but not boiling
2. Stir in the creme de menthe syrup or peppermint schnapps
3. Whisk to make frothy
4. Divide espresso between 2 large cups
5. Divide milk between the 2 cups
6. If desired , sweeten with sugar or splenda
7. Top individual servings with whipped topping and stir with a peppermint stick
8. Serve immediately

title: scallops marsala
steps:
1. Rinse scallpos very well to insure free & clear of sand
2. Remove small muscle which attached scallop to shell
3. Salt and pepper scallops to taste and start water to boil for pasta or cooking the rice
4. Sear scallops on a high heat in butter and olive oil
5. Approximately 1 minute each side - no longer , or you will end up with rubbery scallops , we will add them back in later for additional cooking
6. Remove scallops and cover
7. Reduce heat to medium and sautee the garlic mushrooms and red onions for 3-4 minutes , adding additional olive oil if needed
8. Add marsala wine and simmer to reduce 3-4 minutes
9. Slowly drizzle half and half or soy creamer , stir well
10. Add cornstarch / water if needed for thickening
11. Add scallops back in , sprinkle with fresh basil and simmer low for 3-4 minutes
12. Serve over angel hair pasta or rice

title: garden stuffed mushrooms
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f
2. In small bowl stir together all ingredients except mushrooms
3. Stuff each mushroom cap with 1 tablespoon filling
4. Place in buttered 13x9 baking pan
5. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until tender
6. Sprinkle with cheese if desired and bring back to oven until cheese melts

title: caribbean chicken with caramelised pineapple
steps:
1. Mix spices and salt together
2. Set aside a little in a small bowl
3. Place doubled-over plastic over chicken and batten out to an even thickness
4. Then dip chicken into spice mix and cook on a lightly oiled ridged grill , together with pineapple
5. At the same time , mix together yoghurt , cucumber , lemon juice , a pinch of the reserved spice mix and coriander
6. To serve , arrange pineapple rings and chicken on individual plates and top with a dollop of the yoghurt

title: alaskan pollack with broccoli in a cream sauce
steps:
1. Put olive oil in a pan , heat
2. Add finely chopped shallots , let them become glassy but beware: do not let burn !
3. Add the cleaned fish
4. Let cook carefully with the lid on top of the pan
5. Cut the broccoli tops up into really little flowers and add to the heating mix
6. Once the fish has turned completely white , add the cream and milk and let come to a slight boil
7. Once boiling , add the parmesan
8. Add spices to your own liking and let sauce boil down and become thicker
9. Ready !
10. Enjoy !

title: a very different pumpkin cake
steps:
1. Heat oven to 180 c
2. Cream butter and sugar in bowl till fluffy
3. Add mashed pumpkin , stir well
4. Add sifted flours , stir well
5. Fold in coconut milk
6. Pour into greased 20 cm cake tin
7. Cook 60 minutes till set - may need longer
8. Slices better on second day !

title: ooey gooey butter cake
steps:
1. Mix first four ingredients
2. Mixture will be thick
3. Spread into greased and floured 13" x 9" pan
4. Beat all topping ingredients together
5. Pour over cake
6. Bake 40 minutes or until done at 350 degrees

title: hatchet chile stuffed chicken
steps:
1. Saute the onion and garlic in olive oil until soft
2. Add salt , chiles , cumin and oregano to onions and garlic
3. On each chicken breast , place 1 / 4 of the chile mixture and 1 / 4 cup cheese
4. Roll up and secure with toothpicks
5. Roll the chicken breasts in the corn meal
6. Bake at 375 for 45-55 minutes
7. Towards the end of cooking --
8. Combine remaining peppers , cheese , and sour cream
9. Cook over low heat until the cheese melts and the sauce is smooth
10. When chicken is done , remove from oven and let rest 5 minutes before serving
11. Serve with the chile cheese sauce poured over the breasts

title: lemon artichoke pesto
steps:
1. Place all the ingredients in food processor and process until pureed
2. Toss with you favorite pasta choice about 30-60 seconds or until heated through

title: biscuit mix pizza dough
steps:
1. In a large bowl , dissolve the yeast in the warm water
2. Add the biscuit mix and mix well
3. Knead the dough until smooth
4. Roll it out to desired thickness and press into a greased pizza or baking pan
5. Let rise in a warm place for 30 minutes
6. Top with your favorite toppings and bake at 400 degrees for about 20 minutes , or until crust is crispy

title: everyday italian balsamic bbq sauce
steps:
1. Combine all the ingredients in a small saucepan and stir until all the ingredients are incorporated and the mixture is smooth
2. Simmer over medium heat until reduced by 1 / 3 , about 15 to 20 minutes

title: fantabulous mango salsa
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in an attractive glass bowl
2. Mix well and refrigerate to allow all the flavors to infuse for at least 1 hour
3. Serve on burritos , fish tacos , with corn chips , on an avocado and sweet corn salad or wrapped in baby gem lettuce leaves

title: hoisin and honey glazed pork chops
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 4oo degrees
2. Cut scallions diagonally into 2-inch pieces
3. Whisk remaining ingredients except pork in a large bowl add scallions and pork , turning pork to coat
4. Arrange pork in 1 layer in shallow baking dish
5. Spoon remaining sauce with scallions over pork and roast 15-20 minutes
6. Turn on broiler and broil pork 5-6 inches from heat until top is slightly caramelized , 2-5 minutes
7. Let stand , uncovered , 5 minutes
8. Serve pork topped with pan juices

title: pizza sticks
steps:
1. Roll out bread sticks on an ungreased cookie sheet , lay two pepperoni on the end , sprinkle with some mozzarella cheese and fold bread stick over and twist , then mix together parmesan , italian seasoning , and garlic powder and sprinkle over top of twisted bread stick
2. Add more mozzarella if desired and bake for 5-8 minutes in a 350f oven or golden brown
3. Dip in heated pizza sauce

title: mock   potato cauliflower   salad
steps:
1. Break cauliflower into bite-size florets , and microwave 3 minutes til crisp-tender
2. Shock in cold water , changing frequently , until cool
3. Blot with paper towels til completely dried
4. Chop boiled eggs
5. Crumble bacon
6. Add all vegetables , garlic , eggs , and bacon to large mixing bowl
7. Stir together sour cream , mayonnaise , and buttermilk til smooth
8. Pour over vegetable mixture and toss well
9. Chill at least 2 hours
10. Keeps 3-4 days in fridge

title: stuffed cucumbers
steps:
1. Scoop pulp from middle of cucumbers , reserve pulp
2. Salt shells lightly and place close together in a buttered pan
3. Mix pulp with tomato , onion , chicken and seasonings
4. Melt butter and add flour , stirring until smooth
5. Add milk and cook , stirring constantly until thickened
6. Add to pulp mixture and fill cucumber shells
7. Bake at 350f for 20 to 25 minutes
8. Sprinkle buttered crumbs evenly over the top and serve

title: southwestern stuffed bell peppers
steps:
1. Combine beef , onion , seasoning mix and egg in a large bowl
2. Add rice and mix well
3. Cut peppers in half lengthwise
4. Remove seeds and membrane
5. Spread tomatoes on the bottom of an ovenproof 12 x 9 inch baking dish
6. The liquid from the tomatoes will reduce during cooking so if you like lots of sauce , add about a cup of water
7. This also helps make the peppers softer
8. Place peppers , cut side up , on top of the tomatoes
9. Spoon beef mixture into peppers , mounding as necessary
10. Top each pepper with salsa
11. Bake in preheated 375f oven for 40-45 minutes or until beef is cooked thoroughly and peppers are soft
12. Cover each pepper with cheese and return to oven , under the broiler , until the cheese melts- less than a minute , so watch carefully !
13. Serve with sour cream and additional salsa

title: ginger baked carrots
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Place carrots in a greased 1-quart casserole
3. Combine lemon juice , salt , ginger and pepper
4. Pour over carrots
5. Dot with butter
6. Bake until carrots are tender , about 1 hour

title: salade nioise  or  salad from nice   france
steps:
1. Scrub the potatoes and cook them in a pot of boiling water for 15 minutes or until tender
2. Drain and let cool
3. Trim the ends off the beans
4. Cook them in boiling water for 5 minutes then rinse with cold water
5. Slice the potatoes
6. Arrange lettuce leaves on the bottom of a large salad bowl
7. Put the potatoes on top of the lettuce
8. Sprinkle the tuna on top of the potatoes & lettuce
9. Sprinkle on the beans , tomatoes and anchovies
10. In a jar with a tight-fitting lid: put olive oil , vinegar , mustard , salt & pepper
11. Shake well to combine
12. Drizzle over salad
13. Slice the hard-cooked eggs into quarters & arrange them and the olives on top of the salad
14. Serve & enjoy !

title: low carb pot roast
steps:
1. Rub seasonings into the roast and chill 30 minutes
2. Puree tomatoes , onions and garlic in processor
3. Place roast and pureed sauce in a large pot and simmer 1-1 / 2 hours
4. Turn roast and simmer an additional 1-1 / 2 hours
5. Slice and serve with sauce

title: eat the bowl rainbow chili
steps:
1. In a saucepan , heat oil over medium-high heat , then cook red and green peppers , carrots , celery , onion and garlic for about five minutes , stirring often , until softened
2. Add the meat and cook until no longer pink
3. Stir in tomatoes , corn , chili powder , salt , cumin , oregano and pepper and bring to a boil
4. Reduce heat , cover and simmer for 30 minutes , stirring every 10 minutes or so
5. Stir in beans and cook uncovered for 15 minutes , stirring every 5 minutes
6. Cut out wedge along the top of each roll and pull out some of the inside to hollow out a"bowl" with side at least 1 / 2" thick
7. Spoon chili in the"bowl" and sprinkle with your choice of cheese

title: roast beef with cucumber corn salsa
steps:
1. Mix the cucumber cubes with the corn and chopped onion
2. Add the chilisauce asian shop , lemon juice , salt , pepper and coriander
3. Serve with roastbeef slices

title: broiled seafood sandwiches
steps:
1. Set oven control to broil
2. Mix all ingredients except buns
3. Top slices with seafood mixture
4. Place on ungreased cookie sheet
5. Broil with tops 4-6" from heat about 2 minutes or until seafood mixture is hot and bubbly

title: oatmeal cocoa macaroons  no bake
steps:
1. In a saucepan over medium heat combine the shortening , milk and white sugar
2. Stirring constantly , bring mixture to a boil and continue to boil and stir for 2 minutes
3. Remove from heat and add cocoa , coconut and oatmeal
4. Stir mixture well
5. Drop tsp sized drops onto a waxed paper lined cookie sheet
6. Place cookies in the refrigerator and allow them to set , then place in an airtight container to store

title: afghan rice pilaf with chicken and yogurt   bor pilau
steps:
1. Fry the sliced onion in the oil until soft and golden brown
2. Add the chicken or lamb pieces and fry until golden brown
3. Add the garlic and fry for a minute or two
4. Now add the yogurt , salt , red pepper and ground cilantro
5. Simmer over a medium heat until the meat is tender
6. Meanwhile wash and soak the rice in plenty of water for about 30 minutes
7. Bring 5 cups water to a boil in a large pan and add the rice
8. Bring back to a boil and cook for 2 to 3 minutes , then strain in a colander
9. Take one half of the rice and put in a large pan
10. Add the chicken and its juices
11. Add the remaining half of the rice and s sprinkle the saffron and cardamom and a little more red pepper over it
12. Cover the pan with a tightly fitting lid and increase the heat for a minute or so to bring back the juices to a boil , then place the pan in a preheated oven at 300f for about 45 minutes

title: pastel de choclo   corn pudding
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Saute onions in butter over low heat for about 10 minutes or until golden brown
3. Meanwhile warm up the milk and dissolve the bouillon cube in it
4. Add the flour to the onions and stir for 2-3 minutes
5. Pour milk over it and keep stirring until it thickens , about 5 minutes
6. Remove pan from the heat and add creamed corn , parmesan cheese , bread crumbs
7. Mix well and let it cool for a few minutes
8. Add the eggs , one at the time , mixing well
9. Season with pepper and nutmeg and pour into a baking dish
10. Bake for 40 minutes or until firm

title: russian mango shake
steps:
1. Peel and cut mango into chunks
2. Combine all ingredients together in blender and mix until smooth
3. Pour into glasses and serve

title: jeweled rice
steps:
1. Roast pistachios at 350 degrees for 4 minutes
2. Let cool and chop coarsely
3. Toast almonds golden brown at 350 degrees for 5-8 minutes
4. Rinse rice in sieve until water runs clear to remove excess starch
5. Cook rice in boiling water 6-7 minutes stirring occasionally until rice has lengthened , but is still firm
6. Rinse rice and let cool
7. Boil 1 cup water & sugar in medium saucepan
8. When sugar is dissolved , add orange zest and carrots
9. Reduce heat and simmer , stirring occasionally until carrots are tender 15-20 minutes
10. Drain carrots & zest , discarding syrup
11. Soak raisins and barberries in hot water for 10 minutes
12. Drain
13. Soak saffron in 1 / 4 cup hot water
14. Heat butter and 1 tbl oil on medium heat in large skillet
15. Add onion and salt & cook 8-10 minutes until onions are soft and just beginning to brown
16. Add cardamom , cumin , tumeric and 1 tbl of saffron mix
17. Cook approximately 1 minute until fragrant
18. Turn heat to low
19. Add barberries and raisins and cook about 3 minutes stirring frequently
20. Stir in nuts , orange / carrot mix and season with salt
21. In a large wide heavy pot , heat 3 tbl oil on medium heat
22. Add half the rice
23. Spread evenly
24. Evenly spread fruit / nut / onion mix on top
25. Evenly spread remaining rice on top of that
26. Poke 4-5 holes with wooden spoon handle to the bottom of the pot
27. This will help steam escape and food cook more evenly
28. Drizzle remaining saffron mix over rice
29. Place a clean linen towel over pot and cover with tight fitting lid
30. Tie loose ends of the towel with a rubber-band , masking tape , or another method to the top of the lid , so it doesn't come near the stove top
31. Cook 5-8 minutes , until steam emerges
32. Reduce heat to low and cook 30-40 minutes without stirring until rice is tender
33. Bottom layer of rice will be brown and crisp
34. Place in large serving bowl , breaking crust into pieces

title: barefoot contessa chicken chili  ina garten
steps:
1. Cook the onions in the oil over medium-low heat for 10 to 15 minutes , until translucent
2. Add the garlic and cook for 1 more minute
3. Add the bell peppers , chili powder , cumin , red pepper flakes , cayenne , and salt
4. Cook for 1 minute
5. Crush the tomatoes by hand or in batches in a food processor fitted with a steel blade
6. Add to the pot with the basil
7. Bring to a boil , then reduce the heat and simmer , uncovered , for 30 minutes , stirring occasionally
8. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
9. Rub the chicken breasts with olive oil and place them on a baking sheet
10. Sprinkle generously with salt and pepper
11. Roast the chicken for 35 to 40 minutes , until just cooked
12. Let cool slightly
13. Separate the meat from the bones and skin and cut it into 3 / 4-inch chunks
14. Add to the chili and simmer , uncovered , for another 20 minutes
15. Serve with the toppings , or refrigerate and reheat gently before serving

title: hearst castle shortbread cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f degrees
2. Sift the flour , baking powder , and salt into a medium bowl and set aside
3. In a mixing bowl beat the butter until light and fluffy
4. Add the powdered sugar and beat again , scraping down the sides of the mixing bowl once or twice as you are mixing
5. Beat in the vanilla extract
6. If you have a vanilla bean slit it open along its entire length , scrape out the vanilla bean paste from the interior of the bean , and add this to the mixer as well
7. Add the flour mixture in two additions
8. Stir until everything comes together into a thick dough
9. Turn the dough out onto a countertop and divide into two pieces , there is quite a bit of dough , so cutting it into two pieces just makes it easier to roll out later on
10. Press each piece of dough out into a flat patty an inch thick
11. Wrap each piece in plastic and chill completely in the refrigerator - about thirty minutes
12. When the dough is chilled , use a rolling pin to roll the dough out 1 / 4-1 / 2-inch thick
13. Cut the dough into desired shapes using cookie cutters or a knife and place on a parchment lined baking sheet
14. Bake for 7 to 10 minutes , or until the bottoms of the cookies are barely golden
15. Makes 3 or 4 dozen tiny cookies - more or less depending on the size of your cutters

title: fragrant indian spiced potatoes and chickpeas  5fix
steps:
1. Heat a large , non-stick skillet over medium heat
2. Add potatoes and garam masala , and cook , stirring frequently , until fragrant , about 2 minutes
3. Add chickpeas and diced tomatoes
4. Scrape up any browned bits that have adhered to the pan
5. Stir and bring to a low boil
6. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer , covered , stirring occasionally , until potatoes are tender , about 25 minutes
7. Sprinkle with chopped cilantro to serve

title: cherry chocolate smoothie
steps:
1. Blend in blneder until smooth
2. Pour into glasses
3. Serve

title: kettle stew
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , saute the onions , garlic and chiles in the oil for about 5 minutes
2. Include the seeds from the chiles if you like a hotter stew , discard them if you don't
3. Add the cinnamon , cloves and potatoes , and cook , covered for another 5 minutes
4. Stir in the tomatoes and green beans , cover and cook 5 more minutes
5. Add the zucchini and corn
6. Simmer , covered , on low heat until all the vegetables are tender
7. If the stew seems too dry , add tomato juice or water
8. Add cilantro and salt to taste
9. Serve topped with grated cheese or sour cream

title: awesome chocolate butterscotch chip cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Combine butter and sugar and beat until fluffy add egg and vanilla and mix very well
3. Gradually add flour , salt and baking soda while mixing until smooth
4. Stir in chips by hand
5. Drop by teaspoonfuls on lightly greased baking sheet
6. Bake until just browned approximately 10-13 minutes
7. Watch them closely near the end to prevent butterscotch chips from burning !

title: custard pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. In a medium-sized mixing bowl , mix the sugar , eggs , and vanilla together
3. Scald the milk
4. Let milk set until it is just barely warm , then add the sugar mixture
5. Pour into the pie shell and bake until custard is firm to the touch , approximately 35 minutes

title: pecan white chocolate chip cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. In a bowl mix together margarine , brown sugar and white sugar until light and fluffy
3. Beat in eggs , one at a time , and vanilla
4. Stir in oatmeal
5. Sift flour , baking powder , baking soda into the mix
6. Stir together until combined
7. Add in pecans and white chocolate chips
8. Bake at 375f for 10-12 minutes or until done to your liking
9. I like a soft chewy cookie so i usually bake 9-10 minutes
10. They will firm up on the tray if you let them cool a few minutes before removing them
11. A longer bake will produce a crisper cookie

title: california style eggs benedict
steps:
1. Melt butter slowly - and keep it warm
2. Barely heat the lime juice
3. Have a small pot of water boiling and a tablespoon with which to measure when ready
4. Place 3 egg yolks in the top of a double boiler over medium heat
5. Beat the yolks with a wire whisk until they begin to thicken
6. Add 1 tablespoon boiling water
7. Beat again until the eggs begin to thicken and add another tablespoon boiling water
8. Repeat this process until you have added two more tablespoons boiling water
9. Then , beat in the warm lime juice
10. Remove double boiler from heat and beat the sauce well with a wire whisk while slowly adding the melted butter , salt and dash of ceyenne pepper
11. Keep the sauce over the hot water - but off the burner and lightly cover it to keep it warm while you prepare the rest of the dish
12. Remove the avocado peel and thinly slice
13. Cook 6 eggs - lightly on both sides - over medium low heat - so that the center is just a bit runny and the whites are fully cooked
14. Try not to break the yolks
15. Slice and toast the english muffin halves
16. Place two toasted muffin halves on each warmed plate , then one egg on each half , then arrange a few slices of avocado on top of each egg
17. Spoon the hollandaise sauce over the top of both - and serve at once

title: pork and chicken roulade
steps:
1. -preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. -slice pork tenderloin along long side down to within 3 / 4 inch of the bottom
3. Open and pound to a 1 / 3 inch thickness
4. Put plastic over to protect yourself from flying pork pieces
5. Should be a rough rectangle shape
6. -pound chicken breasts until same thickness
7. -spread half of the pesto mixture over the pork
8. Layer the chicken over and then spread the remaining pesto mixture over the chicken
9. Layer the bacon on top
10. -roll up as tightly as you can along the long ends and secure with kitchen twine
11. Sprinkle with salt and pepper
12. -heat large skillet on stovetop on high with 1 tablespoon of olive oil
13. Add roulade and brown
14. Total should take 5 minutes
15. -wrap roulade in foil tightly and put in baking sheet with seam side up
16. -bake for 45 minutes
17. -cut string off of roulade and slice
18. Arrange on serving platter

title: slow cooker minestrone
steps:
1. Place all ingredients except corn , beans , pasta and cheese in slow cooker breaking up tomatoes
2. Cover and let cook at high for 4 hours
3. Add corn and beans and pasta and cook until pasta is tender
4. Serve with freshly grated parmesan cheese

title: lucy s turkey sandwich
steps:
1. Trim any fat of turkey
2. Place on bread
3. Top with lettuce
4. Then sliced gherkins
5. Then sliced tomato
6. Then with another piece of bread
7. Voila
8. To really give this sandwich something great , add a dollop of mayonnaise and a slice of cheese

title: 7 can soup
steps:
1. Place all ingredients into a large pot
2. Heat
3. That's it !
4. You may put fritos in the soup or put the fritos in a bowl and add soup to them
5. Top with grated cheese and sour cream

title: grouper daniels
steps:
1. In a heavy skillet , bring cream to a simmer
2. Stir cornstarch and wine together , then whisk into the cream
3. Stir in creole mustard and gouda cheese , adding a little at a time to allow the cheese to melt
4. Continue stirring until smooth
5. In another skillet , saute okra , sausage , crawfish , and tomatoes
6. Then stir into the cream mixture
7. Coat fish filets with 1 / 4 cup blackening seasoning
8. Blacken the grouper filets in an iron skillet
9. Stir the additional 1 tbsp blackening seasoning into the cream sauce
10. Plate with cornbread , soak with cream sauce , then top with the grouper filet
11. Add more sauce over the fish

title: mediterranean goat cheese spread  ww
steps:
1. Combine tomatoes and water in a microwave-safe bowl
2. Microwave on high one minute or until water boils
3. Remove from microwave
4. ' cover with plastic wrap and let stand 10 minutes to soften
5. Meanwhile , place cheese in a microwave-safe bowl
6. Microwave on high 15 seconds or until soft
7. Add sour cream and salt
8. Stir until well blended
9. Fold in olives
10. Drain tomatoes
11. Finely chop , and fold gently into goat cheese mixture
12. Serve immediately , or cover and chill until ready to serve

title: fish for the bbq
steps:
1. Brush fish pieces with lemon juice
2. Mix everything else up for the marianade
3. Place fish in the marinade mixture and place in the fridge for an hour or two
4. Cook the fish on the bbq

title: lemon pigs
steps:
1. Choose the snout end of the pig and decide which will be the bottom
2. Cut the bottom off so the pig will sit flat
3. At the snout end cut two flaps for the ears
4. Pull them out a little so the will stand out but not too much or it will break
5. Use cloves for the eyes

title: tomato treat   2
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to package instructions
2. In a large bowl , stir creamy goat cheese with olive oil
3. Add parmesan cheese , garlic , black pepper and salt
4. Stir in green onions , tomato chunks and basil
5. Toss thoroughly with hot drained pasta shells , adding more olive oil if required
6. Serve hot or at room temperature

title: easy on the budget ramen veggie dish
steps:
1. Put margarine in a large skillet
2. Heat to medium high and toss in carrot and red bell pepper
3. Cook , stirring , for about 5 minutes , to soften
4. Add zucchini and green onion , and cook another 5-7 minutes , till tender
5. Add the frozen spinach and the one cup broth , along with soy sauce
6. Cover and simmer about 5 minutes
7. Meanwhile , heat 2 cups water and cook ramen noodles 2-3 minutes , or until tender
8. You may use seasoning packet if you like
9. Drain
10. Add veggies to noodles , place in bowls
11. Salt and pepper to taste
12. Drizzle a little sesame oil over and sprinkle roasted peanuts on top
13. Serve with extra soy sauce
14. Enjoy !

title: fajita wings
steps:
1. In a large plastic bag , mix honey , lime juice , chili powder , and soy sauce
2. Add wings
3. Seal bag and mix to coat
4. Chill , turning occasionally , at least 1 hour or up to a day
5. Lift out wings and place in a single layer on racks in 2 broiler pans , each about 10 by 15 inches
6. Bake in a 450f oven for 15 minutes
7. Turn the pieces over and continue baking for another 25 to 30 minutes

title: best ever summer strawberry spinach salad
steps:
1. Dressing:
2. Beat together egg and vinegar put in a small pot and simmer , stirring well
3. Continue to simmer , add sugar and onion and cook for 5 minutes
4. Stir occasionally
5. Chill in fridge for 1 hour
6. Wash and drain baby spinach leaves and romaine lettuce well
7. Place in large salad bowl
8. Pour chilled dressing over salad and add strawberries or mandarines on top
9. Mix well
10. Prep time does not include refrigeration
11. If you are low carbing -- use splenda in place of sugar , and strawberries , no oranges

title: guy s righteous ribs
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 275 degrees f
2. Begin by trimming the ribs of any excess fat or sinew
3. Remove the thin membrane from the back of the ribs and discard
4. Make the rub by combining the brown sugar , salt , chili powder , garlic and onion powder , paprika , cumin , white and cayenne pepper and cloves in a mixing bowl
5. Set out large sheets of foil9one set for each slab)
6. Place one rack on each sheet and divide the dry rub between each slab
7. Rub the mixture into the ribs on both sides , and then fold the foil over to form a sealed pouch around each rack
8. At this stage make sure each rack is meat-side down
9. Place each pouch on a roasting tray and bake in the oven for 2 hours
10. After 2 hours , open up the foil and peel back so the ribs are exposed
11. Carefully turn the meat over so the meat side is on top
12. Brush the top and bottom of the racks with a generous amount of root beer bbq sauce or whatever sauce you wish
13. Cook racks for 1 1 / 2 more hours with the foil open
14. When done , the ribs will be tender and the meat will have shrunk back from the bones
15. Remove from oven , cut into portions , serve with extra bbq sauce

title: linguine with curried shrimp   scallops
steps:
1. Rinse shrimp and pat dry with paper towels
2. Set aside
3. Cook pasta according to directions on the package
4. Drain , cover and keep warm
5. In a small bowl , mix well the apricot nectar , soy sauce , corn starch , and ginger
6. In a large wok on medium-high heat , add 1 tbsp of the cooking oil
7. Add mushrooms and carrots and stir-fry 2 minutes
8. Add bok choy and onions and stir-fry 2 minutes more
9. Remove veggies with slotted spoon
10. Toss shrimp and scallops with curry powder
11. Add remaining oil to skillet and stir-fry shrimp and scallops until opaque in color
12. Push to side
13. Blend apricot mixture once more then add to skillet and stir until thickened and bubbly
14. Return veggies to skillet and stir entire ingredients until heated through
15. Spoon mixture over hot pasta and serve !

title: fabulous grilled chicken spiedini
steps:
1. Place chicken breasts between sheets of plastic wrap
2. Pound chicken gently with mallet until very thin
3. On waxed paper , combine bread crumbs , cheese , parsley , lemon peel and garlic
4. In shallow dish , combine olive oil and melted butter
5. Dip chicken into butter mixture
6. Coat with crumb mixture
7. Tightly roll up and secure with wooden toothpicks , if needed
8. Cut into 1-inch-thick pieces
9. Thread onto metal skewer
10. Remove wooden picks
11. Repeat with remaining chicken
12. To grill
13. Place skewers on lightly greased grid over medium hot coals
14. Cover and grill for 5 minutes per side or until chicken is cooked through

title: baked zucchini potato latkes
steps:
1. Shred the potato and zucchini with a cheese grater , chop the onion
2. Mix together with the salt and let sit for 10 min to draw out some of the liquid
3. Drain the veggies well , give them a little squeeze
4. They don't have to be perfectly dry but do the best you can
5. Mix in the remaining ingredients , preheat the oven to 425f and line a baking sheet with parchment paper
6. Just greasing it wont work , they'll stick anyways
7. Form the mix into little cakes about 1 / 2 inch thick by 2-3 inches around
8. Bake for 10-15 min , flip and bake another 10-15 min or until crispy and browned on both sides
9. Serve with sour cream with chopped green onion mixed inches

title: spicy sweet snack mix
steps:
1. In a large bowl combine the popcorn , pretzels , oyster crackers and pecans
2. In a microwaveable safe bowl combine the brown sugar , butter , cinnamon and cayenne pepper
3. Microwave on high for 1 to 1 and 1 / 2 minutes-until butter is well melted and bubbly
4. Remove from microwave , mix well and drizzle over popcorn mixture
5. Toss well to coat snack piece's
6. Allow to cool-pack into jars

title: vegetarian chicken chili with crushed tortilia chips and cheese
steps:
1. In large pot place chick peas , kidney beans , tomatoes , ketchup , sugar , worcestershire sauce , green chili's , water and hot sauce
2. Stir and cook on medium heat
3. Add olive oil to skillet and add onions , green pepper , carrots and heat over medium flame
4. Cook 2 minutes then add garlic , cook until vegetables are tender
5. Be careful not to burn garlic
6. Add chili powder , cumin , greek seasoning and paprika to vegetable mixture
7. Stir and cook about 1-2 minutes being careful not to burn
8. Add onion mixture to beans , stir bring to boil , lower heat and simmer for 30 minutes
9. Add chicken and corn , stir and taste (adjust seasonings as needed
10. Cook 10 more minutes and serve over rice if desired
11. Garnish with crushed tortilla chips , chopped tomatoes , chopped onions
12. Use vegan style grated cheese and sour cream if desired

title: poached chicken breast   crock pot
steps:
1. Place the chicken in the slow cooker and pour over the broth
2. Cover and cook on low for 1-1 / 2 - 2 hours or until cooked
3. Let cool
4. I chop the chicken and lay it flat in small freezer bags
5. By using this method , you can break off any amount of chicken that you need and it thaws out quicker
6. The chicken will keep frozen for 3 months
7. Alot of the timing dedpends on the crockpot and / or size of chicken breast
8. Remember , the timing will change if you add / subtract the amount of chicken breast using
9. The success of this recipe depends on the chicken broth you are using
10. I use major chicken broth concentrate -- campbell chicken broth would work very well
11. Knoor's chicken cubes are way too salty and the color is not very appealing

title: tramper s muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 f
2. Line muffin pans with paper liners
3. Blend wet mix ingredients and mix well
4. Add dry ingredients until just blended
5. Spoon into pans and bake for 15-20 minutes

title: tasha s grilled chicken sandwich
steps:
1. Heat a non stick pan over med
2. High heat
3. Season breast with seasoning salt , and cook until done through
4. Meanwhile brush oil on 1 side of each slice of bread
5. Remove chicken from pan reduce heat to med
6. And place 1 slice of bread oil side down in the pan
7. Top with crumbled feta , sliced avocado and tomato , then chicken and lettuce
8. Spread dijon on the bare side of the 2nd slice of bread and place oil side up
9. Grill until golden brown and then carefully flip the sandwich over and toast the other side
10. Serve warm

title: kottlety pozharskie  chicken burger with coleslaw
steps:
1. Salade de chou: placer le chou dans un bol
2. Set aside
3. In a small saucepan or in a microwave dish in the microwave , bring to boil the vinegar and sugar
4. Pour on the cabbage and add sour cream
5. Add salt and pepper
6. Set aside in the fridge
7. Burgers:
8. Preheat barbecue to high heat
9. In a bowl , soak the bread in milk
10. Add chicken , breadcrumbs , butter and nutmeg
11. Add salt and pepper
12. Mix well until homogeneous
13. Shape in 4 patties and coat with breadcrumbs
14. Grill the patties around 5 minutes each side
15. Grill the kaiser breads
16. Put each patty on the braed and garnish generously with coleslaw

title: dude ranch chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Spray a 2 1 / 2 quart or a 11x7x2 baking dish , set aside
3. In a large bowl , combine chicken , 1 cup fiesta blend mexican cheese , soups , ro-tel , green chilies and blend well
4. Set aside 12 tortilla wedges
5. Mix remaining tortilla wedges into chicken mixture
6. Spoon mixture into baking dish
7. Bake , uncovered for 30 minutes or until heated through
8. Carefully remove from oven , tuck remaining tortilla wedges around inside edge of baking dish , top with 1 cup cheddar cheese
9. Bake 5 minutes longer

title: stir fried sesame asparagus
steps:
1. Stir soy sauce and sugar in small bowl until sugar dissolves
2. Heat oil in heavy large skillet
3. Add garlic and stir 15 seconds
4. Add asparagus and stir-fry until crisp-tender , about 4 minutes
5. Add soy mixture and toss until asparagus is coated , about 1 minute longer
6. Season with salt and pepper
7. Transfer to bowl
8. Sprinkle with sesame seeds and serve

title: vietnamese style steak
steps:
1. Combine first 4 ingredients in a wide shallow dish
2. Add steaks and rub all over with the marinade
3. Cover and let marinate at room temperature for 30 minutes
4. Remove steaks from marinade and scrape off most of garlic
5. Heat a large cast iron skillet over medium heat
6. Add 1 steak and cook until well browned , about 3-4 minutes
7. Flip steak and cook about 2-3 more minutes for medium rare
8. Transfer steak to cutting board and tent with foil
9. Repeat with other steak
10. Thinly slice both steaks across grain
11. Serve with rice and any accumulated juices

title: deep fried guacamole
steps:
1. Peel and pit avocados
2. In a bowl , coarsely mash avocados
3. Fold in onion , jalapenos , cilantro , lime zest and juice , salt , pepper , and garlic
4. Line an 8-inch square baking pan with wax or parchment paper
5. Spoon avocado mixture into pan
6. Spread into an even layer
7. Place another sheet of parchment on top
8. Freeze until solid , 6 to 8 hours
9. At least 30 mins before serving , in a small shallow bowl , beat eggs with 3 tablespoons water
10. Remove avocado mixture to a cutting board
11. Cut into small cubes
12. Dip each cube in flour , then egg wash , breadcrumbs , and again in wash and breadcrumbs
13. Arrange in a large baking pan
14. Cover and return to the freezer until firm , 20 to 30 minutes
15. When you are ready to cook these , in a deep skillet or pot , heat oil to 350f fry frozen guacamole bites in batches until golden
16. Drain on paper towels
17. Serve immediately sprinkled , if desired , with kosher salt
18. :-)

title: bread maker english muffins
steps:
1. Put milk , butter , sugar , salt , mixed egg and yolk , flour and yeast in bread maker and set on dough setting
2. When dough is ready cut into 3 pieces and put cornmeal on a flat surface and roll out dough to 1 / 4 inch thickness , while rolling turn dough over to coat other side with cornmeal
3. Cut out 3 inch circles
4. Lay on ungreased cookie sheet to rise for 30 minutes heat ungreased frying pan between low and medium heat , cook each side 6 to 8 minutes till golden brown

title: czech goulash with bread dumplings
steps:
1. Goulash:
2. Saut onion and garlic in shortening until translucent
3. Add meat with spices and saut till brown
4. Add water
5. Simmer , covered , until meat is tender , about 1 hour
6. Add finely grated potato into the meat and simmer 5 minutes stirring often
7. Serve with dumplings or bread
8. Dumplings:
9. Mix together beaten egg , milk , flour , baking powder and salt until smooth
10. Add bread cubes to batter and mix well
11. Make two small loaves
12. Drop into large pot of vigorously boiling water
13. Cook 10 minutes , then roll dumpling over and cook an additional 10 minutes
14. Remove immediately from water and cut ends off to release steam
15. Cut into 1 / 2 inch slices and serve

title: cajun french toast
steps:
1. Beat eggs , sugar and vanilla until fluffy
2. Add milk and stir
3. Dip slice of bread in mixture and put in hot , oiled skillet
4. Cook two at a time , if possible
5. Brown each side
6. When done , add another batch and add shortening

title: rhubarb cheesecake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. In a medium bowl , combine 1 cup flour , 1 / 4 cup sugar and 1 / 2 cup butter
3. Mix until crumbly and pat into the bottom of a 9 inch springform pan
4. Place foil or another pan under this to bake
5. In a medium bowl , toss together the chopped rhubarb , 1 / 2 cup sugar and 1 tablespoon flour
6. Pour onto crust
7. Bake in preheated oven for 15 minutes
8. Remove from oven and set aside
9. Reduce oven temperature to 350 degrees f
10. In a large bowl , beat the cream cheese and 1 / 2 cup sugar until creamy
11. Beat in the eggs one at a time
12. Pour over hot rhubarb in the pan
13. Bake in the preheated oven for 30-40 minutes , or until filling is set
14. Cover with sour cream topping while still hot
15. To make the sour cream topping: in a small bowl , combine 1 cup sour cream , 2 tablespoons sugar and 1 teaspoon vanilla
16. Mix well and spread on top of cake
17. Chill cheesecake for at least 4 hours before serving
18. It is better after 24 hours
19. I have heard from others that they add chopped pecans to the crust and sprinkled on top when cooled

title: spanish stew with vegetables and olives
steps:
1. In a large soup pot over medium-high heat , warm 1 tablespoon oil
2. Add in the pork cubes and brown for about 5 minutes
3. Add in onion , garlic , bell pepper , and mushrooms
4. Stir / saute for about 5 minutes
5. Add more oil if needed to prevent sticking
6. Add in tomatoes , stock , wine , oregano , thyme , salt , and pepper
7. Lower heat to med-low and simmer , covered , for about 30 minutes or until pork and vegetables are tender
8. Add in olives and green beans
9. Simmer , covered , for about 8-10 minutes or until beans are tender
10. For a thicker stew--mix flour and water together and stir into stew for about 2-3 minutes or until thickened

title: orange salad
steps:
1. Mix all ingedients except parsley together
2. Drizzle with the oil , balsamic vinegar
3. Garnish with parsley and serve

title: chicken marsala with basil and mushrooms
steps:
1. Place chicken between two sheet of wax paper and pound to approximately 1 / 4-inch thickness
2. Combine flour with next 3 ingredients in a large bowl or plastic bag
3. Add chicken to flour mixture , toss to coat
4. Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a large skillet over medium=high heat
5. Saute chicken 3 to 5 minutes per side or until done
6. Remove from skillet
7. Add mushrooms and remaining oil , if needed
8. Saute 2 to 3 minutes
9. Stir in wine and remaining 3 ingredients
10. Stir to loosen any browned particles , bring to boil
11. Return chicken to skillet
12. Simmer , uncovered , for 2 minutes
13. Great served with penne pasta in marinara sauce , tossed salad and italian bread with dipping oil

title: holiday eggnog pie
steps:
1. In medium saucepan combine pudding mix , 1 / 4 teaspoon nutmeg , and eggnog
2. Mix well
3. Over medium heat , cook and stir until thick and bubbly
4. Remove from heat and stir in rum
5. Cool thoroughly
6. Beat until smooth
7. Fold in whipped cream
8. Spoon into pie shell
9. Garnish with additional nutmeg to make it look nice
10. Chill 4 hours

title: apple cranberry coffee cake
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl , cream butter and sugar
2. Beat in egg and vanilla
3. Mix well
4. Combine the dry ingredients in a separate bowl
5. Gradually add to creamed mixture
6. Stir in apples and dried cranberries
7. Add nuts is desired
8. Transfer to lightly greased 8-in
9. Baking dish
10. Bake at 350 degrees for 35-40 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean
11. Cool on a wire rack
12. Dust with powdered sugar when cool if desired

title: greek salad pizza
steps:
1. Lightly coat inside of pizza crust with salad dressing
2. Marinate chicken breast in remaining salad dressing for 1 hour- grill until done- about 10 minutes over medium heat
3. Spread spinach dip over crust
4. Slice chicken into bite sized pieces and spread evenly over pizza
5. Add red pepper , cucumber , and tomatoes
6. Sprinkle with feta
7. Slice into thin wedges
8. May be made several hours ahead and stored in refrigerator

title: gianni s cocktail sauce
steps: 1. Stir together

title: hurry up lasagna
steps:
1. Spread 1 cup sauce in bottom of a 9x13 inch baking pan
2. Carefully place 1 / 3 uncooked spaghetti noodles over sauce , making sure to coat spaghetti with sauce
3. Combine the ricotta cheese and parsley
4. Layer 2 cups ricotta mixture , 1 / 2 the pepperoni , 1 cup sauce and 1 cup cheese
5. Top with remaining spaghetti noodles , 2 cups ricotta mixture , pepperoni , sauce and 1 cup cheese
6. Top with remaining spaghetti and sauce , making sure sauce completely covers noodles
7. Cover with foil
8. Bake 375 degrees for 1 hour
9. Uncover and bake 5 minutes longer
10. Sprinkle with remaining cheese
11. Let stand 10 minutes before serving

title: fonda san miguel s camarones al mojo de ajo
steps:
1. Prepare the fried garlic:
2. In a heavy , 10-inch skillet , heat the oil over high heat until the oil is shimmering but not smoking
3. Add garlic , reduce heat to medium-low , and cook 10 to 15 minutes , or until golden brown , stirring often
4. Remove garlic from the oil with a slotted spoon , strain through a fine strainer , and drain on paper towels
5. Shrimp:
6. In a small saucepan , melt the butter over medium heat
7. Add the sliced garlic , reduce heat to low , and keep warm on top of the stove
8. Do not brown the garlic
9. In a nonreactive skillet or saute pan , heat the olive oil over medium-high heat and saute the shrimp until they curl and turn pink , about 4 to 5 minutes
10. Divide the shrimp among 6 dinner plates and spoon the warm garlic-butter sauce over each serving
11. Sprinkle with fried garlic and chopped parsley
12. Serve with arroz blanco
13. Serves 6
14. Variation: substitute 6 6- to 7-ounce fillets of a firm fish
15. Broil , grill , or saut
16. The fish and proceed as directed

title: chicken on pasta with spicy asian   style sauce
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , heat 2 tablespoons oil over medium-high heat
2. Saute jalapenos and garlic until tender
3. Add coconut milk , peanut butter , soy sauce , lime juice , sesame oil , ginger , honey and hot pepper sauce , and whisk until smooth
4. Bring to a simmer
5. Remove from heat
6. Season with salt and pepper
7. In large skillet , heat 1 tablespoon oil over medium-high heat
8. Saute bell pepper , mushrooms and green onions 2-3 minutes
9. Add chicken and saute until cooked through , about 3 minutes
10. Add sauce
11. Cook linguine until tender , but still firm
12. Drain
13. Bring sauce to a simmer
14. Pour over pasta and toss well

title: copper country pasties
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine flour , butter and salt
2. Blend ingredients until well combined
3. Add water , one tablespoon at a time to form a dough
4. Toss mixture until it forms a ball
5. Knead dough lightly against a smooth surface with heel of the hand to distribute fat evenly
6. Form into a ball , dust with flour , wrap in wax paper and chill for 30 minutes
7. Filling:combine all filling ingredients in a large bowl
8. Divide the dough into 6 pieces
9. Roll each of the pieces into a 10-inch round on a lightly floured surface
10. Put 1-1 / 2 cups of filling on one half of the round
11. Moisten the edges with water
12. Fold the unfilled half over the filling to enclose it
13. Pinch the edges together to seal
14. Crimp edges decorativley with a fork
15. Transfer pasty to lightly buttered baking sheet and cut several slits in the top
16. Repeat with the other dough rounds
17. Bake in a preheated 350 degree fahrenheit oven for 30 minutes
18. Put 1 teaspoon of butter through a slit in each pasty and continue baking for 30 minutes more
19. Remove from oven , cover with a damp tea towel , cool for 15 minutes
20. Serve with additional butter and ketchup , if desired

title: 5 minute chocolate fudge
steps:
1. Place the sugar , cocoa , salt , milk and vanilla in a microwave dish
2. Mix it up , don't worry , it's supposed to look grainy
3. Place the butter on the center
4. Microwave for 2 minutes
5. Blend it , then put it on a buttered square dish
6. When cold place in freezer for 30 minutes
7. Enjoy !

title: hot and saucy tortellini
steps:
1. Cook tortellini and drain
2. Cook ground beef
3. Add sauce , salsa , cilantro simmer 5 minutes then add pasta
4. Serve

title: navy bean   cabbage soup
steps:
1. Cover beans with chicken stock
2. Add ham and onion
3. Simmer 3 hours , or until beans reach mushy stage
4. Add cabbage and carrots and simmer for an additional hour
5. Add water if needed
6. Remove the ham from the soup
7. Let it cool and remove it from the bone
8. Return the ham to the soup
9. Season with salt and pepper to taste
10. Skim off excess fat

title: ham with pineapple orange dijon glaze
steps:
1. Place ham in a roasting pan , bake at 325f for two hours
2. Meanwhile , stir remaining ingredients together in a saucepan
3. Bring to a boil , lower heat and simmer 10 minutes
4. When ham has baked two hours , brush the ham with the glaze , continue doing so every 10 minutes while baking for another 30 minutes

title: 30 minute seasoned sweet potato   yam fries  baked not fried
steps:
1. Scrub the sweet potatoes and leave the skin on
2. I like using a french fry cutter for this but if you don't have one , just use a knife to cut the potatoes into shoestrings
3. Put the raw fries into a mixing bowl , and pour in the olive oil
4. Toss well to coat
5. Add the seasonings and toss well again
6. Arrange the fries on a baking sheet and bake at 400f for 10 minutes
7. Turn the fries with a spatula and bake for another 10 minutes
8. Blot any excess oil with paper towels , serve , and enjoy !

title: anna banana s birthday cake with chocolate fudge icing
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f
2. Butter a 9-inch springform pan cream 1 / 2 cup butter until light
3. Gradually beat in the granulated sugar
4. Add the eggs one at a time and beat after each addition
5. Beat in 1 teaspoon vanilla and the mashed bananas
6. Sift or mix together the dry ingredients and add to the batter alternately with the sour cream
7. Spoon the batter into the prepared pan evenly and bake for 30 to 40 minutes or until the cake springs back when gently pressed in the centre
8. Cool for 10 minutes and invert
9. Cool on a wire rack
10. For the icing , melt the chocolate , cocoa , milk and 1 / 4 cup butter in the top of a double boiler
11. Cook until smooth and cool slightly
12. Beat in the icing sugar and 1 teaspoon vanilla
13. Place the bowl over a larger bowl of ice and water and stir until the icing is spreadable
14. Ice the cake and decorate as you wish
15. The ckfm cookbook

title: whole grain sesame bread
steps:
1. Add ingredients to bread machine in the order recommended by the manufacturer
2. Set cycle: whole wheat , size: 2lb
3. Check the dough after 5 minutes , add a tablespoon at a time of flour if too wet , or a tablespoon of water at a time if too dry
4. Dough should be smooth and slightly sticky to the touch
5. You may also remove the dough after kneading and bake in the oven at 350f until well browned , about 25 minutes

title: spicy orange bran muffins
steps:
1. Combine bran and buttermilk , let stand while assembling other ingredients
2. In bowl , combine remaining dry ingredients
3. In another bowl , combine egg , brown sugar , honey , molasses and oil
4. Mix well
5. Add bran mixture
6. Add dry ingredients
7. Bake in sprayed muffin tin in 375 degree oven for 20 minutes
8. Best served warm

title: southwestern chicken foil packets
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees
2. Rinse chicken breasts and pat dry
3. Place one chicken breast in the middle of each sheet of foil wrap or parchment paper
4. Spoon one fourth of the salsa , black beans and sweetcorn on each of the four chicken breasts
5. Seal each pack by bringing up sides and folding the top edge over twice
6. Seal the edges in the same way , leaving enough room for heat to circulate inside
7. Place packs on a cookie sheet and cook for 20 minutes
8. Unseal packs carefully

title: fruity spritz cookies made with jell o
steps:
1. Sift flour with baking powder
2. Cream butter
3. Gradually add sugar and gelatin , cream well after each addition
4. Add egg and vanilla
5. Beat well
6. Gradually add flour mixture , mixing after each addition until smooth
7. Use cookie press to process dough , droping onto ungreased baking sheets
8. Sprinkle with jell-o or decorate as desired
9. Bake at 400 degrees , about 13 or 14 minutes , or until golden brown at edges
10. This can vary depending on your oven , in mine these will be done in about 6-8 minutes- to be sure keep an eye on the first sheet to go in so they don't burn
11. Store in loosely covered container
12. Makes about 5 dozen cookies

title: chicken with celery and cashews
steps:
1. Cut the chicken into thin slices across the grain
2. Heat the oil in a wok swirling it around till its really hot
3. Add the nuts stirring until they start to brown
4. Add the chicken and stir fry until nearly cooked thru
5. Add the celery and spring onions and continue stirring well in the wok
6. Add the yellow stir fry paste and season with salt and pepper
7. Toss lightly to cover the chicken and vegetables with the paste
8. Serve at once over plain steamed rice
9. Garnish with celery leaves

title: quick n easy baked apples and honey
steps:
1. Core the apples and cut in half to form 4 thick rings
2. Place the rings on microwave safe plate
3. Sprinkle with fruit fresh
4. Microwave on high for about 3 minutes or until the centers start to bubble from juice
5. Sprinkle with a bit of cinnamon and drizzle with honey
6. Fill the centers of the apples with the dried fruit
7. Sprinkle the top with a little brown sugar
8. Cut 2 large marshmellows in half and place one on top of each apple covering the dried ffuit like a hat
9. Microwave on high for 30 seconds to 60 seconds until marshmellows are softened
10. For an added touch , brown the top of the marshmellows to a golden brown with a browning element or a oven broiler
11. Serve quickly but be careful of the hot insides of the apple !
12. For individual servings , you can place the apples into single custard dishes instead of on a plate

title: five minute goober and raisinette fudge wreath   rachael ray
steps:
1. Pour the chips , condensed milk and vanilla into a medium saucepan
2. Put the pan on the stove and turn the heat to low
3. Butter an 8-inch round cake pan with softened butter
4. Cover the empty condensed milk can with plastic wrap and put it in the center of the round cake pan
5. Stir the chips and milk until they melt together , about 3 minutes
6. Stir in peanuts and raisins
7. Scoop the fudge into the cake pan all around the plastic-covered can in the center to form a wreath or ring shape
8. Let it be all bumpy on top
9. If the fudge moves the can off center , move it back in place
10. Cut the red cherries in half with scissors and the green cherries into quarters
11. Use the green pieces to make leaves and the red to make holly berries
12. Decorate the fudge with several groups of holly berry sprigs made from the cherries and garnish with peanuts between the sprigs
13. Put the fudge in the refrigerator and chill until firm
14. Remove the can from the center , then loosen the sides and bottom of the fudge with a spatula
15. Cut the fudge into thin slices to serve

title: beetroot   pomegranate soup  low fat
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a saucepan , then sweat the onion , carrot and parsnip for 5 minutes , until starting to soften
2. Add the cilantro , then cook for a further 2 minutes
3. Add the stock and beetroot
4. Bring to the boil , then simmer for 20 minutes , adding 2 teaspoons dill for the final 2 or 3 minutes
5. Cut the pomegranate in half and extract the juice using a lemon squeezer
6. Blend the soup in a food processor or blender
7. Add pomegranate juice to taste
8. Reheat the soup , then served garnished with the yogurt , walnuts and remaining dill

title: golden brandy bundt fruitcake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300d f
2. Mix together almonds and fruit: set aside
3. Mix together flour , baking powder and salt: set aside
4. Grease bundt pan well and lightly flour it
5. Cream shortening and sugar well
6. Beat in eggs
7. Add vanilla
8. Blend flour mixture alternately with brandy into creamed shortening and sugar
9. Add almond and fruit mixture and mix well
10. Pour into prepared pan
11. Keep a pan of hot water on lowest shelf of oven while cake is baking
12. Bake for about 2 hours until cake tests done
13. Cool in pan 10-15 minutes , then turn out and cool completely on wire rack
14. Wrap cake in brandy soaked cloth and store in airtight container in fridge for several weeks

title: mexican fudge
steps:
1. Preheat electric skillet to 280 degrees f
2. Quickly add first five ingredients
3. Stir constantly until mixture comes to a full boil
4. Continue to stir while it boils for five minutes
5. Unplug the skillet
6. Add marshmallows , chocolate chips , and vanilla
7. Stir until blended and pour into a greased pie pan
8. Cool before cutting

title: smoky orange glazed pork chops
steps:
1. Stir the sauce with the orange juice , orange zest , brown sugar , vinegar , garlic and green onion , until blended
2. Score the fat on the pork chops with sharp knife and sprinkle evenly with salt and pepper
3. Pour the marinade over the pork chops and marinate , covered , in the refrigerator for at least 4 hours or overnight
4. Preheat the grill to medium-high
5. Remove the pork chops from the marinade and reserve on a plate
6. Transfer the marinade to a saucepan
7. Bring the marinade to boil
8. Reduce the heat and simmer , uncovered , for 5 minutes
9. Set pork chops on the grate , close the lid and reduce the temperature to medium
10. Grill for 7 minutes
11. Turn the chops and brush with the cooked marinade
12. Add the orange slices to the grill and brush with more of the marinade
13. Grill meat and fruit , basting occasionally , with remaining marinade , and turning as needed , for about 7 minutes or until chops are just slightly pink in the center
14. Serve chops on a bed of grilled oranges

title: devilish deviled green beans
steps:
1. Saute chopped onions over med heat until tender and golden
2. Add mustard and horseradish and stir well
3. Add green beans and stir well
4. Heat thru and serve

title: chicken with artichokes  black olives   vermicelli
steps:
1. Boil pasta al dente and drain
2. Set aside
3. Combine chicken strips & flour in plastic bag and shake to coat
4. Heat olive oil in lg
5. Skillet over med-high heat
6. Add chicken in single layer and cook 5-6 min or till golden brown
7. Turn over w
8. Tongs and cook 2 minute longer or till juices run clear
9. Transfer to plate and cover w
10. Foil
11. Add remaining coating flour in bag to skillet , toast for 1 min , stirring constantly
12. Whisk in broth & brandy or wine
13. Bring back to boil
14. Stir in artichoke hearts , mustard , pasta & olives (include juice from plate
15. Cook for 3 min or till heated through

title: ziploc bag omelet  eggs in a hurry
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients well , in a sandwich size zip-lock plastic bag and seal
2. Drop bag into a pot of boiling water
3. Boil for 13-15 minutes
4. Remove and enjoy

title: maple baked root vegetables
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 450f
2. Place all veggies in a large bowl and toss with olive oil , maple syrup and salt
3. Transfer veggies to a large lightly oiled roasting pan or baking dish and bake until soft and caramelized on outside , about 1 hour , stirring gently every 20 minutes to ensure even browning
4. Serve hot

title: healthy chopped coleslaw
steps:
1. Mix the green and purple cabbage together in a large colander
2. Salt cabbage generously and put in the sink to drain for about 1 hour
3. Rinse the cabbage under cold water and pat dry
4. Mix the carrot in with the cabbage
5. Toast the celery seeds in a dry skillet over medium heat
6. Cool
7. Whisk the mayonnaise , mustard , brown sugar , pineapple juice , buttermilk , celery seeds , 1 teaspoon salt , pepper , to taste , and cayenne in a large bowl
8. Add the cabbage , tossing to coat
9. Serve immediately or refrigerate until needed
10. Enjoy !

title: awesome lil  smokies
steps:
1. Cut maple bacon in half
2. Wrap each smokey in a piece of bacon and secure with a toothpick
3. Place them in the center of an aluminum pan
4. Sprinkle with the sugar
5. Bake at 400f until bacon is done
6. Dig in !

title: fleischmann s kifle
steps:
1. Mix sour cream and water
2. Heat until warm
3. Stir in yeast
4. Let stand 3 minutes or until yeast is dissolved
5. Set aside
6. In large bowl , combine butter and 1 / 2 cup flour
7. Stir in sour cream mixture
8. Stir in egg yolks and enough remaining flour to make soft dough
9. Divide dough into 3 equal pieces
10. Wrap in airtight plastic wrap
11. Chill at least 2 hours or up to 3 days
12. Lightly dust work surface with sugar
13. Roll each piece of dough to 12-inch circle
14. Cut into 8 pie-shaped wedges
15. Spread each wedge with about 1 tablespoon filling
16. Roll up from wide ends to make crescents
17. Place , with points down , on greased baking sheets
18. Bake at 375f for 20 minutes or until golden brown
19. Remove from baking sheets
20. Cool on wire racks
21. Makes 24 to 30 cookies
22. Filling----------
23. In medium bowl , beat egg whites until soft peaks form
24. Gradually add sugar and vanilla extract
25. Continue beating until very stiff but not dry
26. Stir in ground walnuts and chopped dates or pitted dates or mini chocolate chips

title: arroz central cafe  central cafe rice
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Melt the butter in a medium saute pan , add olive oil
3. When oil is warm , add the rice , onion , pepper , and garlic
4. Saute for 2 to 3 minutes or until rice browns slightly
