5. Pour in chicken stock , stir and pour into a 1 1 / 2 quart baking dish that has been sprayed with non-stick cooking spray
6. Cover and bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until water is absorbed and rice is tender

title: buttered pecan  cranberry and apricot sausage stuffing loaf
steps:
1. For the topping: butter a 1kg loaf tin and line the base with greaseproof paper
2. Lay the four pecan halves and the bay leaves alternately in a line along the bottom of the tin
3. Preheat the oven to 190c / 375f / gas 5
4. For the stuffing: heat 50g of the butter for the stuffing in a large frying pan with the oil until the butter has melted
5. Add the onions and fry for 8-10 minutes until softened and starting to turn golden , stirring occasionally
6. Stir in the ground coriander and the rest of the butter and fry for another 3-4 minutes to soften and to caramelise the onions a bit more
7. Remove the pan from the heat and mix in the breadcrumbs , sausage meat , apricots , cranberries , orange zest , sage leaves , egg and some salt and pepper to season
8. When combined , spoon the stuffing into the tin and pack it down lightly
9. Cover with a piece of buttered greaseproof paper
10. Bake for 30 minutes , then remove the paper and bake for another 5 to 10 minutes
11. Remove from the oven and leave to stand for a few minutes
12. Discard the paper , loosen the sides with a round-bladed knife and turn out the stuffing so the pecans and bay leaves are on the top
13. Slice to serve

title: blueberry french toast  oamc
steps:
1. Spray an 8x8 deep pan with non stick spray
2. Place half the bread cubes in the bottom of pan
3. Dot bread with cubes of cream cheese
4. Spread pie filling over bread and cream cheese
5. Top with remaining bread cubes
6. Mix remaining ingredients and pour over top
7. Let sit overnight in refrigerator or cover and freeze for oamc
8. Bake covered at 350 for 30 minutes , uncover and bake 30 minutes more

title: copycat keebler pecan sandies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Measure flour , cream of tarter , and baking soda together and set aside
3. Cream vegetable shortening and sugars together until fluffy
4. Add vanilla , salt , and egg to sugar mixture and beat until smooth
5. Add flour mixture to sugar mixture 1 / 3 at a time , beating after each addition until completely mixed
6. Dough will seem a little thick
7. Stir pecans into dough with a strong spoon
8. Chill dough for 30- 45 minutes
9. Roll dough into 1- 1 1 / 4 inch balls and place on ungreased cookie sheet
10. Flatten balls to 1 / 4 inch thickness
11. Bake for 12- 15 minutes , until slightly golden
12. Remove to cooling rack
13. When completely cool , store in air-tight container

title: quick burger stroganoff
steps:
1. Crumble ground beef into a 3qt glass casserole
2. Add onion
3. Cover and microwave 5-7 min until cooked
4. Stir once during cooking
5. Drain and crumble
6. Rinse if neccessary
7. Stir in soup , mushrooms , water , and worcestershire sauce
8. Cover and microwave 3-5 minutes or until bubbly
9. Stir once during cooking
10. Stir in sour cream
11. Microwave 1-2 minutes more
12. Stir , cover and let sit 5 minutes before serving
13. Serve over hot , cooked noodles
14. Ground turkey may be substituted - use 1 1 / 2 lbs of ground turkey
15. 1 serving=1 / 4 of recipe
16. Lawl count: 1 protein , 1 veg , 1 starch

title: strawberry 7 up cake
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease a 13 x 9-inch baking pan
3. Mix all cake ingredients together in a bowl
4. Beat well until smooth
5. Transfer cake batter to a prepared baking pan
6. Bake for 30-35 minutes , or until cake tests done
7. Cool , and invert cake onto a tray large enough to hold the cake
8. To make the topping: dissolve the jello powder completely in boiling water , with the sugar , then add in the cold water
9. Mix well
10. Poke holes all over cake with a straw
11. Drizzle the jello over entire top of cake
12. Place the strawberries slices evenly over and covering all the cake
13. Refrigerate cake for 2 or more hours
14. Just before serving , top cake with cool whip topping
15. Delicious !

title: spanish style clams
steps:
1. Heat olive oil in heavy large pot over medium high heat
2. Add sliced sweet onions , green and red bell peppers , minced garlic , and bay leaves and saute until onions are golden about 10 minutes
3. Stir in crushed tomatoes and wine
4. Season to taste with salt and pepper
5. Bring mixture to boil and add claims , cover and cook until clams open about 8 minutes , stir in hot pepper sauce and serve

title: salsa chicken with cheese
steps:
1. Rinse chicken and pat dry
2. Place pieces one at a time , skinned side down , between 2 sheets of plastic wrap and pound with a mallet until about 1 / 4-inch thick
3. Melt butter in oil in a wide frying pan over medium-high heat
4. Add chicken , a portion at a time , without crowding
5. Cook , turning after 2-3 minutes , until golden on the outside and no longer pink when slashed , about 4-6 minutes , total
6. Transfer to an ovenproof platter and keep warm
7. Add onion , garlic and celery to pan
8. Cook , stirring , until onion is soft
9. Add chiles , tomatoes and their liquid , broth , cumin , oregano and sugar
10. Cook , uncovered , stirring frequently , until thickened , about 10 minutes
11. Add any juices that have drained from the chicken , then season to taste with salt and pepper
12. Pour sauce over chicken
13. Sprinkle with cheese and broil 3 inches below heat until cheese is melted

title: classic macaroni and cheese from fine cooking
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375 degrees and butter 9x13" baking dish
2. Cook macaroni according to package directions just until tender and drain well
3. Melt 12 tablespoons of butter in a heavy-based medium saucepan over medium heat
4. Add flour , onion , bay leaf , thyme , and peppercorns
5. Reduce heat to medium low and cook for 2-3 minutes , stirring constantly , to make a roux
6. Slowly whisk the milk into rux until smooth and blended
7. Raise heat to medium-high
8. Whisk constantly until mixture boils
9. Cook for 3-4 minutes , stirring constantly , until thickened
10. Lower heat and continue simmering for about 10 minutes , stirring constantly
11. Strain sauce into a large bowl , removing the onion , herbs , and peppercorns
12. Add salt , pepper , nutmeg , and cheddar cheese , stirring until cheese is melted
13. Toss pasta with cheese sauce and pour mixture into baking dish
14. Melt last 2 tablespoons butter and toss with breadcrumbs
15. Spread the buttered curmbs over casserole
16. Bake until sizzling and lightly browned , about 40 minutes
17. Cover with foil is browns too quickly

title: peanut butter apple treat
steps:
1. Remove the core from the apple using an apple corer
2. Spread the peanut butter along the inner edges of the apple
3. Sprinkle brown sugar and chocolate chips into the hole , making sure it sticks to the peanut buttered walls
4. If desired , you may cut the apple into slices at this time , or just eat it whole

title: iced razzleberry coffee frappe  non alcoholic
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in a blender and blend until smooth
2. If you want a thicker drink , add more ice cubes before blending

title: jon s sugar free french vanilla ice cream
steps:
1. Mix all thoroughly in a sauce pan
2. Cook in a saucepan over low heat , stirring regularly until it thickens
3. Cook 15-20 minutes or until medium thick
4. Transfer custard to a bowl and refrigerate for at least an hour or until it is completely cooled
5. Put custard in your ice cream maker and follow the manufacturer's instructions
6. If you use the packet splenda instead of the pourable splenda be sure to cut back some as they are sweeter than the bulk

title: perfect yorkshire pudding
steps:
1. Whisk together salt & flour
2. Set aside
3. In a medium bowl , whisk together eggs & milk
4. Add flour mixture and whisk until combined
5. Cover with plastic wrap & chill in the refrigerator at least 4 hours or overnight
6. When the roast is done , raise oven temperature to 425f
7. Transfer enough pan drippings to coat pan & heat pan in oven until hot
8. Remove batter from refrigerator & whisk well
9. Remove pan from oven & quickly add batter
10. Bake until crisp & golden 20-35 minutes
11. Serve with prime rib & gravy

title: irish cream cheesecake ultimate
steps:
1. Combine wafer crumbs , 1 / 2 cup cocoa , icing sugar and butter
2. Press over bottom and 2 inches up the sides of a 9-inch springform pan
3. Set aside
4. Beat cream cheese until smooth in a large bowl
5. Gradually beat in granulated sugar , 2 tbsp cocoa and vanilla extract
6. Add eggs , one at a time , beating well after each addition
7. Stir in cream and whiskey
8. Pour into prepared crust
9. Set on baking sheet
10. Bake in preheated 375 f oven 50 to 55 minutes
11. Cool then chill
12. Drizzle melted chocolate over surface of cake before serving

title: lemon and hot  pasta salad with kidney or cannellinni beans
steps:
1. Pasta: follow directions on the package to cook to al dente
2. Drain and cool
3. Place in a large bowl
4. Dressing and vegetables: combine in a bowl and whisk olive oil , lemon juice , mustard , zest , and garlic
5. Season with salt and pepper and add basil , parsley , and scallions
6. Add jalepeno and celery
7. Whisk again
8. Combine dressing and vegetables in a large bowl with pasta
9. Toss in beans
10. Sprinkle with pepper flakes and parmesean
11. Serve cool

title: coriander and goats cheese pesto
steps: 1. Blend all ingredients till smooth -- enjoy

title: simple curried sausages
steps:
1. First boil the sausages and remove the skins
2. Slice them up into chunks
3. Place them in a saucepan with sufficient water to cover ,
4. Add onion , vegies and bring to the boil
5. In a small cup put flour , curry powder and enough cold water to make a paste
6. Remove saucepan from the heat and stir in thickening and replace on element
7. Bring saucepan back to a simmer and cook until vegies are done

title: corn and beans and bacon and tomatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Coat an 11-inch by 7-inch casserole dish with cooking spray
3. Heat oil in a frying pan and add onion & bell pepper
4. Saute till tender
5. Mix the onion / pepper mixture with corn , beans , tomato sauce , tomatoes & worcestershire sauce
6. Taste and add salt & pepper if needed
7. Pour it all in the casserole dish and cover the top with a layer of bacon
8. Cover and bake for 50 minutes , remove cover and bake 10 minutes more or until bacon crisps up
9. To make using fresh vegetables:
10. Cover the bottom of the dish with the bacon then layer with fresh lima beans , fresh sliced tomatoes , chopped onion and green pepper , fresh white corn , another layer of sliced tomatoes and another layer of bacon on top
11. Bake as above

title: brandy tart
steps:
1. To make the tart: preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Place dates in a small bowl
3. Pour in boiling water and add baking soda
4. Let dates stand for 10 minutes or until soft
5. In large bowl , combine butter and sugar and beat with electric mixer until creamy
6. Beat in egg
7. Sift in flour , salt and baking powder
8. Add dates , water and nuts
9. Mix well
10. Line a lightly sprayed or buttered 9-inch aluminum pie plate with parchment paper
11. Pour in batter and bake 45 minutes or until toothpick comes out dry
12. To make brandy sauce: combine sugar with water in a saucepan over medium-high heat
13. Bring to a boil and stir frequently until sugar is dissolved
14. Remove from heat and stir in butter and vanilla , followed by brandy
15. Before serving , remove from pie plate and allow to cool slightly
16. Cut tart into wedges and top with warm brandy sauce

title: fresh green bean salad
steps:
1. Dissolve the chicken stock cube in the water and add the trimmed green beans
2. Boil for about 10 minutes
3. Drain and rinse briefly under cold water
4. Arrange in a shallow bowl and pour over the french dressing while the beans are still warm
5. Leave to cool completely
6. Arrange the sliced tomato and onion around the edge of the bowl and garnish with whole or chopped black olives , if desired

title: non dairy vegan potato corn chowder
steps:
1. Put the potatoes and water into a 3 quart saucepan
2. Bring the water to a boil
3. Cover , reduce heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes
4. While the potatoes are cooking , heat the oil in a small skillet
5. When the oil is hot , add the onion , celery , carrot , bell pepper and thyme or oregano
6. Stir and cook till vegetables or tender , about 5-7 minutes
7. Remove skillet from heat and put on the side
8. When the potatoes are done , remove the pan from the heat
9. Using a slotted spoon , transfer about 1 1 / 2 cups of potatoes to the blender
10. Add enough soymilk to make a smooth mixture
11. I use only about a half cup or less , usually
12. Add the potato mixture back into the saucepan
13. Add the corn and the cooked vegetables
14. Heat the chowder on medium heat for about 5-10 minutes

title: secret marinade
steps:
1. Mix all
2. Pour over meat of choice and let marinade overnight

title: strawberry amaretto alexander
steps:
1. Place amaretto , cream , berries and ice cubes in a blender
2. Whir until berries and ice are pureed
3. Serve immediately
4. Makes 4 servings

title: delicious easy asian grilled drumsticks
steps:
1. In a bowl whisk together the first 8 ingredients
2. Add in green onions
3. Place the chicken drumsticks in a large resealable bag
4. Pour the marinade on top and seal bag
5. Turn to coat evenly with marinade
6. Refrigerate for a minimum of 8 hours , turning occasionally
7. Set grill to medium heat
8. Remove the chicken and discard the marinade
9. Place the chicken on a baking sheet , and pat any excess marinade off with a paper towel
10. Rub the drumsticks with peanut oil on all sides
11. Season chicken with seasoned salt or white salt and pepper
12. Gill turning chicken until crispy and golden brown , or until the chicken is thoroughly cooked

title: toasted gingerbread with grilled pears and caramel
steps:
1. Bread and caramel sauce should be prepared ahead
2. Preheat a grill to medium heat
3. Cut pears in half lengthwise
4. Use a melon baller , remove the seeds and core
5. Brush the pears with orange juice and place on the grill cut side down
6. Let the pears cook until they are lightly caramelized , about 5 minutes
7. As the pears are cooking , place the gingerbread on the grill and lightly toast on each side
8. Remove the pears and the gingerbread from the grill
9. To assemble , place the toasted gingerbread on a plate
10. Slice the pears and arrange them on top of the gingerbread
11. Drizzle with caramel sauce and garnish with a sprig of fresh mint
12. To make gingerbread:
13. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
14. Grease and flour 2 loaf pans
15. Cream butter and sugar together in a large bowl
16. Beat in egg and molasses
17. In a separate bowl , combine dry ingredients and whisk until mixed
18. Add 1 / 3 of the dry ingredients to the creamed mixture and mix
19. Add 1 / 3 of the hot water and mix
20. Continue alternating dry ingredients and water in thirds until all is incorporated
21. Pour the batter into prepared pans and bake for 45 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the middle comes out clean
22. To make caramel sauce:
23. Combine sugar and water in a saucepan over medium heat
24. Cook until the sugar is melted and takes on a dark golden color
25. Add the butter and cream and whisk until smooth
26. Be very careful not to splash yourself , caramel is extremely hot ! let cool about 30 minutes , until thickened

title: flounder with spinach and feta
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees f
2. Lightly coat 2 quart baking dish with nonstick cooking spray
3. Sprinkle fillets with salt and pepper to taste
4. If fillets are thick , place in a single layer in the baking dish , tucking under any thin edges
5. If using thin fillets , arrange evenly in baking dish , overlapping as necessary
6. In a large skillet , cook garlic in hot oil for 15 seconds
7. Add mushrooms and italian seasoning
8. Cook and stir until mushrooms are tender
9. Stir in spinach and cook and stir until just wilted
10. Spoon this spinach mixture down the center of the of the fish in the baking pan
11. Cover with foil
12. Bake until fish flakes with a fork
13. Transfer fish and vegetables to a serving platter and sprinkle with feta cheese
14. Top with tomato if desired

title: homemade rice a roni
steps:
1. Break spaghetti into 1 / 2 to 1" pieces
2. Heat oil in a pot and stir spaghetti in the oil until it begins to brown slightly
3. Add rice , onion and parsley and stir
4. Mix in broth , stir and cover tightly
5. Cook as you would regular rice , simmering for about 20 minutes
6. Fluff with a fork and serve

title: turkey and brown rice casserole
steps:
1. Cook brown rice according to package directions
2. While rice is cooking , pour broth into a large sauce pan
3. Whisk in whole wheat flour
4. Cook and stir with whisk , over medium heat , until mixture thickens and begins to bubble
5. Lower heat to low and stir in poultry seasoning and black pepper
6. Stir in half of the cheddar cheese and mix until cheese melts
7. Stir in red pepper and onion
8. When rice is cooked add to pan with broth mixture along with cooked turkey and cooked peas and carrots
9. Spray a square or round casserole dish with cooking spray
10. Pour contents of pan into casserole dish
11. Sprinkle top with remaining cheddar cheese and then bread crumbs
12. Bake in a pre-heated 350 degree oven for 30-35 minutes

title: peanut butter  jelly   apple roll ups
steps:
1. Microwave tortillas 10 seconds to soften
2. Spread each with a tablespoon of peanut butter and 2 tsp jam
3. Heat oven to 400f
4. Place 2-3 apple wedges down the center of each tortilla
5. Roll up tortillas
6. Transfer rolls to baking sheet
7. Brush with melted butter
8. Combine sugar and cinnamon in a small cup
9. Sprinkle half of mixture on top of each roll
10. Bake 10 minutes or until golden brown
11. Let cool 5 minutes before eating

title: apple oatcakes
steps:
1. Mix together oatmeal , hot water , butter and chopped apples
2. Cook for 20 minutes
3. Beat together the brown sugar and eggs
4. Combine remaining dry ingredients and vanilla and mix well
5. Add apple-oatmeal mixture to dry ingredients then add eggs and sugar and blend thoroughly
6. Cook as you would pancakes on a preheated griddle
7. Serve with chopped walnuts , maple syrup and creme fraich

title: chocolate pistachio meringues
steps:
1. Preheat oven 250f , grease and flour 2 cookie sheets
2. In your blender or food processor combine pistachios and the chocolate , whirl until very finely chopped , reserve
3. Beat egg whites& cream of tartar until soft peaks form
4. Gradually add the sugar , 1 tbsp at a time and beat until very stiff peaks are formed
5. Fold in the chocolate-nut mixture& vanilla
6. Using a tsp drop small mounds of meringue on the prepared cookie sheets leaving about 1" between
7. Bake 30 minutes or until the meringues are firm but not brown
8. Let stand several minutes on the cookie sheets , loosen carefully , transfer to wire rack
9. Store in a tightly covered container

title: double choc delight cake
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 180c
2. Grease and flour a 20 x 7cm round tin
3. I usually use a large bundt tin
4. Sift flour , instant pudding mix , baking powder and cocoa into a bowl
5. Add all remaining cake ingredients except for the chocolate chips and beat with a spoon for 1 minute
6. Add chocolate chips and beat for a further 30 seconds or until choc chips are mixed through evenly
7. Pour batter into the prepared tin and bake for 50-55 minutes or until a skewer when inserted in centre of cake comes out clean
8. Remove cake from oven and allow to cool in tin for 5-8 minutes , then invert onto a wire rack to further cool
9. When cold , spread with icing over top and sides of cake
10. Decorate with extra choc chips or grated chocolate
11. To prepare icing:
12. Place butter and hot water into a mixing bowl
13. Stir with a wooden spoon until butter has melted
14. Add remaining ingredients and beat with spoon until icing is smooth

title: stuffed tilapia sole with low fat parsley sauce
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f
2. Heat oil in medium pan
3. Saut onions and chopped spinach until tender
4. Spoon 2-3 tbsp of onion and spinach mixture into fillet and roll up
5. Put toothpick through to hold together if you like
6. Place down in baking dish of the right size
7. Pour chicken broth over fillets and bake 25 minutes , or until flaky
8. When in the oven make the sauce
9. Heat milk over medium heat in a small saucepan until bubbles occur around the edge
10. Add cornstarch mixture and stir until thickened , add the fine chopped parsley and pepper
11. When fish is done , remove from oven and plate
12. Spoon about 3 tbsp over each fillet
13. Enjoy

title: gluten free peanut butter cookies
steps:
1. Mix together all the dry ingredients
2. Mix together all the wet ingredients
3. Combine the wet and dry ingredients
4. Roll into 2-inch balls
5. Place on cookie sheet about 1 inch apart
6. Flatten slightly
7. Bake in preheated 350f oven for about 12 minutes

title: pork chops with sauerkraut and apple
steps:
1. Salt and pepper the chops and brown them in hot oil or butter , about 3 minutes per side
2. Set aside
3. Add the apple and onions to the same skillet and cook for about 5 minutes , until the onion starts to look golden
4. Add the wine and stir , scraping up all the browned bits , and cook for an additional 3 minutes
5. Stir in the sauerkraut , and place the chops on top , including any juices that have collected
6. Cover the skillet , lower the heat and cook until the chops are done , about 7 minutes , depending on thickness
7. Do not overcook

title: granola clusters
steps:
1. Preheat your oven to 325f in a large bowl , stir together the first 5 ingredients
2. Set aside
3. In a microwave-safe bowl , melt the butter and maple syrup together in the microwave on high
4. Stir the butter mixture into the dry ingredients and pour onto a lined baking sheet
5. Bake for 10 minutes , flip the granola over and bake for about 10 minutes
6. Remove from the oven and toss with the dried fruit while still hot
7. Serve when cool

title: crustacean inspired garlic noodles recipe
steps:
1. Rinse the noodles with cold water and set aside
2. Heat up a pot of water and let it boil
3. Boil the noodles in the hot water until they are done , drain the water , and set aside to cool down the noodles
4. In a pan , saute the garlic with the olive oil in medium heat
5. The purpose is to infuse the olive oil with garlicky flavor
6. Discard the garlic and then add in 4 tablespoons of butter and turn the heat to low
7. Add in the chicken bouillon powder , garlic powder , oyster sauce and blend well
8. Set aside to let it cool
9. Once the garlic mixture is cool and the noodles are cool at room temperature , pour the garlic mixture over the noodles and toss them together to blend well
10. Add in the grated parmesan cheese , toss well , and serve immediately

title: to die for pork spareribs
steps:
1. Place ribs in large pan or cast iron skillet
2. Cover with cold water and bring to the boil
3. Reduce the heat and simmer for 10 minutes
4. Combine the marinade ingredients in a bowl and mix well
5. Place the pork spare ribs in a large shallow glass or ceramic dish and pour over with the well mixed marinade
6. Refrigerate for at least 4 hours or better still , overnight !
7. Place the marinated pork spare ribs on a rack in a large roasting pan and cook in oven pre-heated to 180c for about 40 minutes until browned and tender , or grill on the bbq
8. During the cooking time baste the ribs frequently with the pan juices / marinade

title: blue nana breakfast
steps:
1. Mash the banana in a pretty serving dish
2. Top with yogurt and mix together
3. If preparing the night before and using frozen blueberries , set the blueberries in a separate dish in the fridge to thaw , and then sprinkle them on top the next morning before serving
4. If using fresh blueberries , sprinkle them on top just before serving and sprinkle the dash of nutmeg on top
5. Voila ! if desired you can use strawberries , or top with granola , nuts , or bran cereal

title: golden potato coated baked chicken
steps:
1. Heat oven to 425
2. Spray 12-inch pizza pan or jelly roll pan , 15-1 / 2x10-1 / 2x1 inch , with cooking spray
3. Remove fat from chicken
4. Mix egg white and water in a bowl
5. Mix potato mix , cornstarch , italian seasoning and red pepper in a second bowl
6. Dip chicken into egg white mixture then coat with potato mixture
7. Place chicken in pan so pieces don`t touch
8. Spray chicken lightly with cooking spray
9. Bake uncovered about 25 minutes or until juice of chicken is no longe pink when centers of the thickest pieces are cut

title: turkey and cranberry ravioli
steps:
1. To make the ravioli: in a medium bowl , stir together the turkey , cranberry sauce , cheese , bread crumbs , parsley , egg , salt , and pepper
2. Place 10 won ton wrappers on a work surface
3. Brush lightly with water using a pastry brush
4. Place 1 tablespoon of the turkey mixture on each of the won ton wrappers
5. Top with another won ton wrapper
6. Push out any air bubbles and press the edges tightly to seal
7. To make the gravy: in a medium , heavy skillet , heat the butter over medium heat
8. Add the shallots and cook until tender , about 5 minutes
9. Add the flour and stir until cooked , about 1 minute
10. Slowly add the chicken broth , stirring quickly to avoid lumps
11. Add the cream , parley , salt , and pepper and cook , without boiling , for 2 minutes , stirring often
12. Meanwhile , bring a large pot of salted water to a boil over high heat
13. Add the ravioli and cook until tender but still firm to the bite and the turkey is cooked , stirring occasionally , about 3 minutes
14. Drain the ravioli into the gravy and stir to coat
15. Serve immediately in individual dishes , drizzled with the remaining gravy

title: chickpea stew scented wtih lemon and cumin
steps:
1. Bring water to a boil in a medium saucepan
2. Gradually add polenta , stirring constantly with a whisk
3. Reduce heat , and simmer 3 minutes , stirring frequently
4. Remove from heat
5. Stir in butter
6. Cover and set aside
7. While polenta cooks , heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
8. Add onion and garlic
9. Saut for 3 minutes
10. Add lemon juice , cumin , black pepper , chickpeas , and tomatoes
11. Bring to a boil
12. Reduce heat , and simmer 6 minutes
13. Stir in the green onions
14. Serve stew over polenta
15. Top with sour cream

title: lentil   barley soup
steps:
1. Place all ingredients except salt into a large pot and bring to a simmer
2. Cover and cook , stirring occasionally until lentils are tender , about one hour
3. Add salt

title: simple chicken and rice   another recipe
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Use 1 tb butter to grease 9x9 pyrex square pan
3. Place rice , chicken broth , water , onion soup mix and 2 tb butter into pan
4. Place chicken breasts , which have been cut up into the pan
5. Sprinkle pepper over the chicken
6. Cover the pan tightly wth foil and place into oven
7. Bake for 45 minutes tightly covered then bake an additional 15 minutes uncovered

title: lemongrass steamed chicken
steps:
1. Sprinkle the chicken with salt and pepper
2. Put oil in a deep skillet over medium high heat
3. Spread the lemongrass in the skillet
4. Cover
5. When lemongrass begins to fry and is fragrant , place the chicken , skin side down over the lemongrass
6. Turn the heat to medium , cover
7. Cook , turning and basting with the soy sauce every 10 minutes or so until the chicken is cooked through , about 30 minutes
8. Discard the lemongrass and serve the chicken with lime wedges and cilantro

title: swamp and gator food
steps:
1. Heat the mud , swamp water , crushed bones , fat , grass and squashed mosquitoes in a saucepan
2. Boil for three minutes , stirring constantly
3. Remove from heat and drop by spoonfuls onto waxed paper
4. Let cool until firm
5. Eat while watching the gators play football on t
6. V

title: simple onion pie
steps:
1. --------for pastry base----------
2. Mix together and pat into a medium pie dish
3. Simmer onions in melted butter just until soft , season and leave to cool
4. Place on top of pastry
5. Mix together egg and cream and pour over onions
6. Sprinkle cheese on top
7. Bake in a pre-heated oven 425f for 20-25 minutes
8. I serve it with with a tomato and basil salad with a balsamic vinigar dressing and tiny new potatoes

title: pumpkin pie crunch
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Grease bottom of 13x9x2-inch pan
3. Combine pumpkin , evaporated milk , eggs , sugar , pumpkin pie spice and salt in large bowl
4. Pour into pan
5. Sprinkle dry cake mix evenly over pumpkin mixture
6. Top with pecans
7. Drizzle with melted butter
8. Bake at 350f for 50 to 55 minutes or until golden
9. Cool completely
10. Serve with whipped topping
11. Refrigerate leftovers

title: gastronomic gelato italiano
steps:
1. In a heavy sauce pan , whisk together the cocoa , sugar and salt
2. Whisk in milk , frangelico , and eggs
3. Cook over medium heat , stirring constantly until steaming hot and starting to thicken , about 6-8 minutes
4. Whisk in cream and remove from heat
5. Transfer into your freezing container or into a container with a spout and chill in refrigerator for 4 hours
6. When ready to freeze , if using an ice cream maker , follow your manufacturer's directions
7. Add crushed biscotti during the final 10 minutes of churning in the freezer or ice cream maker
8. Garnish with additional biscotti

title: daube french style
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large heavy pot , with a tight fitting lid , such as a dutch oven over medium heat
2. Trim the large pieces of fat from the roast and apply salt and pepper to taste
3. Brown on all sides in hot oil
4. Turn down the heat to low
5. Add the rest of the ingredients to the pot and mix lightly
6. Turn roast over
7. If the liquid does not cover the roast , add water to cover
8. Cover and cook for 1
9. 5 hours
10. Uncover and check liquid level and turn roast over
11. If liquid is low , add a bit of water , enough to reach 1 / 2 way up the roast
12. Cover and continue to cook for 1
13. 5 hours
14. Uncover and check for doneness
15. The meat should be very tender
16. If not , cover and cook for 1 / 2 hour more

title: easy whole wheat  cauliflower samosa
steps:
1. Filling:
2. Heat oil
3. Add fennel , mustard and ginger
4. When mustard crackles , add garam masala , chili powder and asafetida
5. Stir briefly
6. Add cauliflower and salt and stir
7. Cook for 10 minutes or so
8. Can add few tbsp of water or so if cauliflower is sticking
9. Add peas and cook for a further 10 minutes or so
10. Again a bit of water may be needed
11. Let the filling cool to room temperature
12. Then mix in crumbled feta
13. Pastry
14. Mix salt and flours together
15. Rub ghee into flour till it looks like breadcrumbs
16. Add water with one hand gradually , while mixing in with other hand
17. Add enough water to make it smooth and elastic like roti dough
18. Knead dough well , for 5 minutes or so
19. Sprinkle a few drops of water on the dough and cover with a cloth to prevent it from drying out while rolling the circles
20. Divide dough into 10 circles
21. Roll circles out into a 2mm thick circles
22. Cut each circle into two semi circles
23. Fold each semi circle into half to make a cone , wet the seam of the cone with water and press well
24. Fill the cones with cooled filling leaving at least 1 cm space on top of the cone
25. Wet and press like for previous seam , and then pleat the sealed seam or press with a fork
26. Deep fry samosa on moderate heat till a deep golden brown , turning 2 or 3 times in the oil
27. Drain , and enjoy !
28. Cooks
29. Then place frozen samosas in ziploc bags and keep in freezer
30. To use , leave them to stand till room temperature , or defrost in a microwave , before frying

title: buffalo chip cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Combine the margarine , sugars , eggs and vanilla
3. Stir in the flour baking soda , baking powder , raisin bran , oats , raisins , coconut , chopped nuts and chocolate chips
4. Mix until well combined
5. Drop large tablespoon sized scoops onto a baking sheet
6. Bake until golden approximately 10 minutes

title: creamy peanut popsicles
steps:
1. Boil water and sugar for 3 minutes
2. Remove from heat
3. Stir in peanut butter
4. Then add milk
5. Pour into 8 tupperware popsicle makers
6. Place lids on tightly
7. Freeze for at least three hours

title: steamed mussels in coconut milk
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a large dutch oven
2. Add the onions and fry over medium-high heat until the edges turn light brown
3. Next add the ginger and continue frying for 1 minute , stirring constantly
4. Put in the ground masala and stir for another 1 to 2 minutes
5. Add the salt , coconut milk , and 1 cup water and bring to a boil
6. Now put in the mussels , spooning some of the sauce over them
7. Cover and steam 7 minutes or until all the shells open
8. Remove from the heat
9. Discard any shells that aren't open
10. Sprinkle with the lemon juice and cilantro and stir gently
11. Spoon the mussels into individual bowls along with some of the sauce
12. Serve immediately

title: turkey and cheese panini
steps:
1. Preheat panini-maker till ready
2. Lay out two slices of the bread
3. Spread the avocado on each slice
4. Place one slice provolone on each
5. Place turkey slices on top
6. Place remaining two bread pieces on top
7. Put the two sandwiches in panini-maker , press down and cook for three minutes
8. Remove , slice in half and serve

title: baked pork chops with potatoes
steps:
1. Bring 2 cups water to a boil
2. Add bouillon cubes and bay leaf
3. Remove from heat and set aside to allow to cool
4. Layer potatoes in casserole dish
5. Layer onion slices on top of potatoes
6. Place pork chops on top of onions
7. Remove bay leaf from broth then whisk flour in chicken broth
8. Pour over pork chops and potatoes
9. Salt and pepper to taste
10. Cover dish with aluminum foil
11. Bake in preheated 350f oven for one hour and thirty minutes

title: penne with tomatoes  artichokes and mushrooms
steps:
1. Cook the pasta while making the sauce
2. Gently heat a large saute pan over medium heat for about 1 minute
3. Add 1 tb of the olive oil , the onion , the garlic , the rosemary and the red pepper flakes
4. Sautee until the onions are starting to soften , about 5 minutes
5. Add the mushrooms and cook until the onions are starting to brown and the mushrooms have released their juices and have softened , about 8 minutes
6. Add the chickpeas and break the plum tomatoes into pieces with your hands
7. Add them to the pan along with their juice and the diced tomatoes
8. After the tomatoes have cooked for about 5 minutes add the artichoke hearts
9. Stir and cover until the artichokes are heated through and the tomatoes are just beginning to thicken
10. Add the sugar and salt , stir and cook gently over medium-low heat for about 10 minutes stirring now and then
11. Add the final tb of olive oil after you've turned off the heat and stir it inches
12. Serve over penne sprinkled with the romano

title: mom s stuffed eggplant   by michael chiarello
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Cut the eggplant in half and scoop out the center , leaving enough meat inside the skin so that it holds its shape when baked
3. Boil the scooped-out center part until very soft , about 10 to 12 minutes
4. Meanwhile , in a medium saute pan heat 1 tablespoon olive oil over medium heat
5. Season the beef with salt and pepper
6. Add the seasoned ground beef to the pan and saute until all of its liquid is evaporated and the beef begins to brown slightly
7. Drain the beef , removing the extra , unnecessary fat
8. Let cool briefly and chop the cooked beef so that there are no large chunks of meat
9. In another medium saute pan over medium heat add the remaining 2 tablespoons olive oil and saute the onions , peppers and garlic together
10. In a bowl mix together the cooked eggplant , vegetables , cooked beef , herbs , 1 cup of the cheese , bread crumbs , and the egg
11. Fill the scooped-out eggplant halves with this mixture , dividing it evenly among the 2 halves
12. Top with chopped tomatoes and the remaining 1 / 4 cup of grated cheese , season with salt and pepper , place on an oiled oven tray or baking dish , and bake for 50 minutes in preheated oven
13. Let cool briefly , slice widthwise and serve

title: tasty low cal   green lentils   vegetarian sausages
steps:
1. Heat 2 tbsp of the oil in a pan
2. Add the onion , carrot & celery , then cover & cook over a low heat for 10 minutes
3. Add the garlic & cook uncovered for a few more minutes
4. Add the chopped tomatoes , vegetable stcok cube & sugar & cook until the sauce thickens
5. Meanwhile , heat the rest of the oil in a frying pan & cook the sausages until cooked through & nicely browned
6. Add the lentils to the sauce & simmer for 5 minutes
7. Either serve the sausages on top of the lentil or chop the sausages up into bite sized pieces & mix with the lentils

title: herbed baked scallops
steps:
1. Arrange scallops in shallow baking dish
2. Dot with butter
3. Sprinkle on herbs plus salt and pepper to taste
4. Bake at 350 f for 5 minutes
5. Stir to coat scallops with butter mixture
6. Bake another 20 minutes or until tender

title: easy  healthy and nutritious toddler yogurt cereal bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Combine cereal , 3 / 4 cup flour , sugar and cinnamon in small bowl
3. Cut in butter until coarse crumbs form
4. Press 1 / 2 the mixture firmly into the bottom of a greased 8inch square pan
5. Mix yogurt , egg and 2 tablespoons flour in another small bowl
6. Spread over cereal mixture in pan and then sprinkle the remaining cereal mixture on top
7. Bake for 30 minutes or until golden brown
8. Cut into bars when cooled

title: crustless apple pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Butter pie tin
3. Put apples in pie tin
4. Cover with white sugar
5. Mix flour , brown sugar , butter and salt
6. Put this mixture over apples
7. Bake for 30 minute or until apples are tender and topping is brown

title: turkish walnut lamb
steps:
1. Saute the onions in the butter for a couple minutes
2. Add the lamb and continue lightly frying until the pieces start to brown
3. Add the stock , cover and simmer gently for 1 / 2 hour
4. Meanwhile , prepare the sauce by stirring the water into the ground walnuts
5. Add the pomegranate syrup and sugar and simmer gently over a low heat for 10 minutes
6. Add the walnut sauce to the lamb , along with the seasonings and lemon juice
7. Continue to simmer , covered , over a low heat for another 30 minutes
8. Adjust the seasonings by adding a little sugar if the dish is too sour or more pomegranate syrup if it is too sweet
9. Serve with basmati rice

title: pomegranate pancakes
steps:
1. Combine with oatmeal , flour , baking powder and salt in a bowl
2. In a small jug , beat the eggs , milk and honey together
3. Make a well in the centre of the flour and pour in the egg mixture , beating as you go , until well combined and bubbles form
4. Set aside for 10 to 15 minutes
5. Peel the pomegranate and remove the seeds
6. Beat the batter once more , then add the pomegranate seeds
7. Coat a small omelette pan with olive oil , wipping off any excess
8. Pour a quatre of the batter and cook until bubbles form on the surface of the pancake - it takes between 3 and 5 minutes
9. Turn over and cook on the other side until golden
10. Serve with low-fat natural yoghurt and honey
11. Serves 4

title: libbie s fried potatoes with caraway
steps:
1. Peel and cube potatoes
2. Boil until tender
3. Drain
4. Melt butter in pan
5. Add cooked potatoes
6. Brown
7. Add caraway and cook a little longer

title: no yeast stollen
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 f
2. Into large bowl , sift together flour , sugar , baking powder , cardamom and salt
3. Cut in the butter until coarse crumbs form
4. Mix together cottage cheese , egg and vanilla
5. Add to flour mixture along with raisins
6. Stir until dough forms
7. Turn out onto lightly floured board and knead abut 10 turns , adding more flour if neccessary
8. Dough should be soft , not stiff
9. Roll dough into a 10-inch circle
10. Brush with 1 tablespoon melted butter
11. Fold dough in half , just a little off-center
12. Bake on greased cookie sheet 40-50 minutes , or till golden brown
13. Brush with 2 tablespoons butter while hot
14. Cool on wire rack
15. Wrap in plastic or foil when completely cool
16. Store at room temperature for 2 days before serving
17. Sprinkle with confectioner's sugar just before serving
18. Keeps up to 1 week

title: zucchini meat sauce with pasta
steps:
1. Cook pasta in 8-quart pot according to package directions
2. Drain
3. Keep pasta hot
4. Brown meat in 6-quart pot over medium-high heat
5. Season with salt and pepper , if desired
6. Drain
7. Add onions
8. Cook until tender
9. Stir in spaghetti sauce and undrained tomatoes
10. Cook 5 minutes , stirring occasionally
11. Add zucchini to remaining sauce
12. Cover and cook over medium heat 7 to 10 minutes or until zucchini is tender
13. Serve sauce over hot pasta
14. Sprinkle with grated parmesan cheese and garnish , if desired

title: simple sweet   sour chicken
steps:
1. Lightly cook chicken in a pan with the olive oil
2. Dissolve the corn flour in 2 tb water
3. Add all ingredients to the crock pot , stir well , cover , and cook until the sauce thickens

title: bbq salmon on wet plank  old native indian recipe
steps:
1. Presoak , totally submerged plank for at least 1 hour
2. (we are lucky enough to be beside a lake , otherwise you may have to use bathtub or container large enough to submerge the plank
3. Plank can be cedar , alder , apple , cherry , hickory , maple , oak
4. Can also be soaked in beer or wine , it is the cook's choice
5. Plank must be short enough to accommodate the barbecue , yet big enough to accommodate the fish
6. Preheat barbecue to 350f
7. Place plank in barbecue and allow it to preheat until it starts smoking
8. Baste salmon with butter and salt and pepper
9. Add chives or freen onions
10. Place on plank with skin side down
11. Barbecue with lid closed for 15 to 25 minutes until fish is opaque ,
12. Garnish with fresh lemons sliced thinly
13. Serve and enjoy !

title: easy oven potatoes
steps:
1. Coat a glass baking dish with nonstick foil
2. Dice potatoes in small cubes and place in dish
3. Drizzle with oil
4. Mix with hands to coat potatoes lightly in oil
5. Sprinkle contents of seasoning packet over potatoes and mix to coat
6. Bake 45 minutes at 450 degrees f

title: roasted veggies barley salad
steps:
1. Take the first 6 ingredients and pop them into the oven
2. Roast them for about half an hour at 200c
3. At the same time , put the water to boil
4. Once it is boiling , add the bay leaves and the barley and leave it to simmer until the barley is chewy about 25 minutes
5. When the barley is almost cooked and the roasted veggies almost done , add a tbsp of olive oil to a hot pan and cook the onion until translucent
6. Add the peas and after another couple of minutes add the spinach
7. Stir and cook with the lid on for 2-3 minutes , then add the grated garlic and toss to cover
8. Drain the barley and add it to the pan , together with the roasted veggies and the dressing
9. Toss to cover
10. Optional: add a couple of finely sliced chilies

title: savory roast pork with apples and parsnips
steps:
1. Spray a crock pot with cooking spray or line with a crock pot liner for easy clean up
2. Place prepared apples and parsnips in the bottom of the crock pot and top with onion quarters
3. You can use your fingers to separate the onion quarters into smaller pieces if you like
4. Combine the brown sugar , ground ginger , garlic powder and salt and pepper in a small bowl until thoroughly mixed
5. Rub mixture into the roast making sure to get the mixture on all sides
6. Place roast in crock pot on top of the onion layer
7. Pour apple cider over the roast and sprinkle the crumbled cooked bacon on top
8. Turn crock pot to low and cook for 10 to 12 hours
9. To serve , remove roast and allow to rest for a few minutes
10. Slice into serving sized pieces and place on a platter
11. Place apples , onions and parsnips around the roast
12. Strain the juices remaining in the crock pot into a medium sauce pan and place pan over medium heat
13. Add cornstarch to a bowl or small container with a tight lid and add 1 / 4 cup cold water
14. Stir or shake well until no clumps remain
15. Pour mixture into saucepan containing hot juices and whisk over medium heat until desired consistency is reached
16. Pour thickened juices into a gravy boat or other serving container and serve alongside platter of roast

title: ken hom s stir fried mixed vegetables
steps:
1. Separate the broccoli florets and peel and thinly slice the stems on the diagonal
2. Cut the asparagus into 4cm pieces
3. Cut the chinese leaves into 4cm strips
4. Halve the baby corn lengthways or leave it whole
5. Blanch the broccoli in a large pot of boiling salted water for 3 minutes
6. Drain and plunge them into cold water to stop them from cooking
7. Heat a wok or large frying pan until hot
8. Add the oil and when it is very hot and slightly smoking , add the shallots and chillies and stir fry for 1 minute
9. Then add the baby corn and the asparagus
10. Stir fry for 30 seconds , then add the fish sauce and water , bring the mixture to the boil , cover and cook over high heat for 2 minutes
11. Then add the broccoli and chinese leaves together with the oyster sauce , sugar and salt
12. Continue cooking over high heat for 3 minutes or until the vegetables are cooked
13. Serve immediately

title: blue cheese stampede
steps:
1. Pre heat grill to med-high heat
2. Combine beef , onion , hot sauce , honey , garlic salt , red pepper flakes and pepper in large bowl
3. Mix well
4. Divide into 6 portions
5. Form into patties around the blue cheese
6. Grill 8-10 mins or until done
7. Place patties on buns and top with roasted peppers and mushrooms

title: sourdough  wild yeast   bread
steps:
1. Day one: you will need 2 / 3 cups of active starter so refresh your starter with 2 / 3 cup flour and 2 / 3 cup bottled water
2. Cover and allow to ferment for 6-8 hours
3. Once the starter has been refreshed you can continue with the recipe , or refrigerate the bowl over night
4. Make firm starter:
5. If you have refrigerated the starter , remove it from the refrigerator and measure out 2 / 3 cups and place in a small bowl , cover with towel or plastic wrap and allow to warm up for one hour
6. If the starter is room termperatue then continue as
7. Add one cup flour to the bowl
8. Add the starter and mix together , adding only enough additional water so that you can knead this into a small ball
9. Should be about the texture of french bread dough
10. No need to work very long , just be sure that the flour is hydrated and the starter is evenly distributed
11. Place dough in small bowl sprayed with non-stick cooking oi , turn dough once and cover with plastic
12. Allow to rise until doubled in size , approximately 4 hours
13. Place in the refrigerator overnight
14. Next day:
15. Remove the firm starter from the refrigerator and cut into about 10 small pieces with a pastry scraper
16. Mist with non-stick spray , cover with a towel or plastic wrap and let sit for 1 hour to take off the chill from the dough
17. To a large mixing bowel stir together the flour and salt
18. With a large spoon , stir in the starter pieces and enough water to bring everything together into a ball
19. Hand kneading: sprinkle counter lightly with flour and knead for 12 to 15 minutes
20. Kitchen aid mixer: sprinkle dough lightly and knead with dough hook for 4 minutes on medium-low speed
21. Allow dough to rest for 5-10 minutes , and then mix for another 4 minutes
22. Additions such as garlic , nuts or cheese , should be added during the last two minutes of mixing
23. With both methods , adjust the flour and water as needed
24. The dough should be firm but tacky , like firm french bread dough
25. The temperature of the bread dough should be between 77 and 81 f
26. Lightly oil a large bowl and transfer the dough to the bowl , rolling around to coat with oil
27. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and allow to ferment at room temperature for 3 to 4 hours , or until dough has doubled in size
28. Gently remove the dough from the bowl and divide into 2 equal parts , being careful not to degas the dough
29. Gently shape dough into a boule , baguette , batard or rolls
30. Proof the dough in bannetons or proofing bowls , or on parchment-lined sheet pans that have been dusted with semolina flour or cornmeal
31. Mist the exposed part of the dough with spray oil and loosely cover the dough with a towel or plastic wrap
32. At this point you can either proof the loaves until doubles , or retard overnight in the refrigerator
33. Or you may wish to do as i do , bake one now and retard the other for tomorrow
34. If retarding , remove them from the refrigerator approximately 4 hours before you plan to bake them
35. Baking:
36. Place baking stone on middle shelf
37. Place oven-proof skillet or broiler pan in bottom of oven to use as a steam pan
38. Preheat oven 500 f
39. Ten minutes before baking remove plastic covers
40. Carefully move dough to peel dusted with cornmeal or semolina flour
41. Score the top of the dough
42. Slide the dough onto preheat baking stone
43. Pour 1 cup hot water into the steam pan and close the door
44. After 30 seconds spray the oven walls with water and close the door
45. Repeat twice more at 30 second intervals
46. After the final spray reduce the temperature to 450 f and bake for 20-30 minutes or until the loaves are done
47. The centers should register 200 in the center on an instant read thermometer
48. When done they will be a rich golden brown and sound hollow when thumped on the bottom
49. Remove from oven and transfer to wire rack and cool for 45 minutes before slicing

title: chele d s shrimp creole
steps:
1. In a deep skillet or dutch oven , brown onion and bell pepper in bacon grease over med head for about 10 minutes
2. Add garlic and saute another couple of minutes , you don't want to brown the garlic
3. Add everything else to the pan , except for the shrimp
4. Simmer for 30 minutes or so , until flavors meld
5. Add shrimp and simmer for about 10 more minutes or until shrimp are cooked through
6. Serve over rice

title: canned meatballs
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients , to combine well
2. Form into balls , packing ingredients together tightly
3. Hand-wash jars and jar lids and bands , then run them through dishwasher cycle to sterilize
4. Place meatballs in quart-sized canning jars that have been cleaned and sterilized
5. Wipe rim of jar to remove grease or food bits
6. Place lid on jar
7. Screw on band
8. Place filled jars in pressure canner
9. Add water to canner , to about 2" deep
10. Place lid on canner and make sure lid is securely fastened
11. Open petcock
12. Turn on medium-high heat
13. When steam is rapidly escaping through petcock , close petcock
14. Pressure will start to rise at this point
15. When pressure reaches 10 lb
16. , start lowering heat , till the needle on the pressure gauge stabliizes at 10 lb
17. Start timing: 90 minutes for quarts
18. 70 minutes for pints
19. When timing is done , turn off heat , and leave the canner alone till pressure reaches zero
20. Open petcock to release any remaining steam
21. Remove lid
22. Remove jars , and set in a draft-free place to cool
23. When cool , remove bands , wipe down jars with a clean , damp-warm cloth
24. Label and place in pantry
25. To use: remove lid , and set jar in pan of hot water , to melt the grease , before removing meatballs , one at a time , with an iced-tea spoon
26. Or place in microwave just long enough to melt the grease , then remove one at a time , using an iced tea spoon
27. They are cooked through , and you don't have to worry about the color
28. Now , they're ready to use in your favorite meatball recipe ! also , this recipe may make less or more than 7 quart jars full

title: burgundy mushrooms
steps:
1. Saute onions in butter for 5 minutes
2. Add sliced mushrooms and cook 25 minutes
3. Add wine , pepper , garlic and beef bouillon
4. Simmer 20 minutes
5. Serve over pork , chicken , rice or even as a side

title: barbecued ribs
steps:
1. Place ribs on a rack in a shallow roasting pan
2. Scatter 4 cloves of sliced garlic over ribs
3. Cover , and bake at 300f for 3
4. 5 hours
5. Cool slightly
6. In a small bowl , mix together white sugar , paprika , salt , black pepper , chili powder , and ground cumin
7. Rub spices over cooled ribs
8. Cover and refrigerate overnight
9. Next day , in a small saucepan , mix together brown sugar , cider vinegar , molasses , ketchup and chili sauce , worcestershire sauce , lemon juice , onion , dry mustard and 1 clove of crushed garlic
10. Simmer over medium low heat , uncovered for 1 hour
11. Reserve a small amount for basting and use the remainder for a dipping sauce
12. Preheat grill for medium heat
13. Place ribs on grill
14. Grill , covered for about 12 minutes , basting with the reserved sauce until nicely browned and glazed
15. Serve with remaining sauce for dipping

title: sour cream strawberry surprise
steps:
1. Blend together sour cream , brown sugar and vanilla
2. Combine strawberries into sour cream mixture
3. Refrigerate about half an hour
4. Serve and enjoy

title: cashew chili
steps:
1. In a soup pot , heat the oil
2. Add onions , garlic and bay leaf and saute for about 3 minutes
3. Add the green peppers and celery and cook until the vegetables are tender but still crisp , approximately 3-5 minutes
4. Melt in the butter , then add spices , herbs , pepper , and salt
5. Saute for 1-2 minutes , stirring frequently so nothing burns
6. Add quart of tomatoes plus juice and beans to the mixture and simmer for about 15 minutes for flavor to blend
7. Toast cashews in a 350 oven or toaster oven for about 20 minutes , or until lightly browned
8. Add toasted cashews and vinegar
9. Simmer for another 15 minutes and serve
10. It's even better the second day

title: hot bean thread noodle
steps:
1. Soak the noodles in a large bowl of warm water for 15 minutes
2. When they are soft , drain and discard the water
3. Cut into 3" lengths and set aside
4. Heat 1 tb oil in large skillet or wok
5. Add garlic and scallions , saute a few seconds until fragrant
6. Add beef and carrots , stir fry till beef is cooked
7. Add all remaining ingredients except sesame oil and let cook together gently for about 5 minutes
8. Add the drained noodles and sesame oil and cook 5 more minutes
9. Serve at once

title: roman veal scaloppine
steps:
1. Heat oven to 200 degrees
2. Put 2 tablespoons olive oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat
3. Add garlic and , when it sizzles , tomatoes and salt and pepper
4. Cook , stirring occasionally , until tomatoes break down , about 10 minutes , then add olives , and turn heat to low
5. Put about 3 tablespoons olive oil in a large skillet , preferably nonstick , over medium-high heat
6. Sprinkle veal with salt and pepper , then dredge it in flour
7. Saut as many slices as will comfortably fit in skillet , just until brown on both sides , 5 minutes or less
8. Remove to a plate , and keep warm in oven while sauting remaining slices
9. Taste sauce , and adjust seasoning
10. Spoon it over veal slices , and arrange lemon on top
11. Sprinkle with parsley , and serve

title: chili tofu
steps:
1. To start with , cut tofu into 1 inch diamond shaped pieces
2. Heat oil in a wok
3. Roll tofu pieces in cornflour
4. Now , deep fry them in hot oil on medium flame until the edges start to turn brown
5. Remove from wok , drain onto absorbent paper and keep aside
6. Blend 1 tbsp cornflour in quarter cup of water
7. Keep aside
8. Peel onions and cut'em into thick slices
9. Peel , wash and crush garlic
10. Slice green chillies
11. Wash , halve , de-seed and cut capsicum into thick strips
12. Heat 2 tbsps
13. Oil in a wok
14. Add garlic and stir-fry for a minute
15. Add green chillies , onions and capsicum
16. Saute for a few minutes
17. Add tofu
18. Stir in stock
19. Add salt , pepper powder , soy sauce and chilli sauce
20. Stir well
21. Stir in the blended cornflour
22. Cook on high flame , stirring until the sauce thickens to coat the tofu and vegetables
23. Serve rightaway with hot rotis or naan or parathas or even kulchas !
24. Enjoy your meal !

title: cinnamon loaves
steps:
1. Beat first five ingredients at high speed with an electric mixer for 3 minutes
2. Pour half of batter evenly into 2 greased and floured 8 x 3 loaf pans
3. Stir together sugar and cinnamon
4. Sprinkle half of sugar mixture evenly over batter in loaf pans
5. Pour remaining batter evenly into loaf pans , and sprinkle with remaining sugar mixture
6. Gently swirl with a knife
7. Bake at 350 for 45 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean
8. Cool in pans on wire racks
9. One loaf can be frozen if desired

title: ww lemon chicken  for one
steps:
1. Combine the lemon juice , honey , ginger , garlic , soy sauce , stock powder and half the water in a jug
2. Set aside
3. Combine the remaining water and the cornflour and set aside
4. Heat a small-medium fry pan over medium-hot heat
5. Add chicken and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes
6. Add the vegetables and cook until heated through and tender , about 3-5 minutes
7. Remove from pan
8. Add the contents of the first jug to the same pan
9. Cook , stirring for about 30 seconds
10. Add the water & cornflour mix and stir until mixture thickens
11. Return the chicken and vegetables to pan
12. Cook gently , stirring to coat with sauce , until heated through

title: asparagus leek soup
steps:
1. Steam the asparagus in a covered steamer over boiling water until crisp-tender
2. Melt 1 tablespoon of the butter in a small skillet over medium heat
3. Add the corn and bell pepper
4. Cook , stirring occasionally , until tender , about 5 minutes
5. Add salt to taste
6. Set aside
7. Melt the remaining 3 tablespoons butter in a dutch oven over medium heat
8. Add the mushrooms and leeks
9. Cook , stirring occasionally , until tender but not brown , about 5 minutes
10. Add the curry powder
11. Stir for about 30 seconds
12. Add the vegetable stock , milk , and asparagus
13. Increase the heat to medium-high and stir occasionally as the liquid comes to a simmer , then reduce the heat to medium
14. Stir together the cornstarch and cold water in a small bowl until smooth
15. Stir into the soup
16. Cook , stirring constantly , until the soup is smooth and slightly thickened , about 2 minutes
17. Remove from the heat
18. Season to taste
19. Top each serving with about 2 tablespoons of the corn-bell pepper mixture

title: vegetarian chicken and dumplings
steps:
1. Add broth and cream of mushroom soup to a large soup pot
2. Bring to a simmer , and add chik'n , potatoes and carrots
3. Simmer for 10 minutes or until potatoes are just tender
4. While simmering , put flour , baking powder and salt in a bowl
5. Add shredded basil leaves and soup to flour blend and mix well
6. If dough is too dry add up to 1 / 4 cup more water
7. Add broccoli , kale , and zucchini to soup pot
8. Stir well , then add dumplings by the spoonful
9. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes
10. Buen provecho !

title: easy  creamy  low calorie butternut squash lasagna
steps:
1. Components
2. Butternut squash
3. Put butternut squash in a microwave save bowl
4. Add salt and pepper to taste and stir
5. Cover and microwave 6-10 minutes or until fork tender
6. Squash "marinara"
7. Wilt fresh spinach in the microwave using a covered microwave safe bowl
8. Add thawed squash puree
9. Season with salt , pepper , and garlic powder
10. Ricotta mixture
11. Combine ricotta and 1 tsp shredded asiago in small bowl
12. Add salt , pepper , italian seasoning , dried shallots and dried garlic flakes to taste
13. Cream sauce
14. In a small saucepan , over low heat , combine milk and 2 tbsp shredded asiago
15. Add salt , pepper and garlic powder to taste
16. Assembly and cooking
17. Spread a small amount of squash marinara on bottom of 13 x 9 inch pan
18. Place four sheets of uncooked lasagna noodles on top
19. Cover noodles with approximately 1 / 3 of remaining squash marinara , top with 1 / 2 of ricotta mixture , 1 / 2 of butternut squash , and 1 / 2 cup of shredded mozzarella
20. Place four more uncooked lasagna noodles on top of this
21. Cover with approximately 1 / 2 of remaining squash marinara , all of the remaining ricotta mixture , all of the remaining butternut squash , and 1 / 2 cup of shredded mozzarella
22. Top with remaining four lasagna noodles
23. Cover noodles with remaining squash marinara , all of the cream sauce , 1 cup shredded mozzarella , and 2tbsp of shredded asiago cheese
24. Loosely cover with foil and bake at 350 for 50-60 minutes
25. Uncover and return to oven for 5 minutes of until cheese is bubbly on top
26. Let cool for 5 to 10 minutes then slice and serve

title: poisoned apple
steps:
1. Fill large glass with ice , pour in vodka and schnapps
2. Pour in the lemon-lime soda , top with a splash of grenadine

title: sweetly stewed tomatoes
steps:
1. Bring a saucepan of water to a boil , and blanch the tomatoes in it for 30 seconds
2. Next , plunge them into cold water to stop the cooking
3. Peel , halve , and seed the tomatoes , and cut each half in half
4. Set aside
5. Melt the butter in a medium saucepan , and add the celery , onion , and garlic
6. Cover , and cook over low heat for about 5 minutes
7. Stir in the tomatoes , sugar , and lemon zest
8. Recover the pan and cook , stirring occasionally , until the tomatoes are soft and mixture is thick , about 30 minutes
9. Stir in the dill , salt , and pepper , and serve
10. Enjoy !

title: grilled portobello burgers with creamy dijon sauce
steps:
1. Heat a grill pan on medium-high
2. Lightly brush mushroom caps and onion with oil
3. Grill both for 4 to 5 minutes per side or until mushrooms are tender
4. Set aside on separate plate
5. Grill buns , cut-sides-down , for 1 to 2 minutes per side or until toasted
6. Meanwhile , prepare sauce: combine all sauce ingredients in a small bowl
7. Spread sauce on bottom half of each bun , dividing evenly
8. Top with onion , mushroom caps , cheese and lettuce

title: afro dog
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients
2. Divide beef into 6 portions
3. Shape each portion in the shape of a hot dog
4. Wrap each in plastic wrap and freeze until ready to cook
5. Cook in boiling water until firm
6. Remove and brown in skillet
7. Serve like a hot dog with your favorite condiments

title: sandis sandies
steps:
1. To brown the butter , cut into pieces and heat in a heavy saucepan over medium heat
2. Stir the butter or swirl the pan so that the butter doesn't burn
3. Remove from heat when butter turns light brown and gives off a nutty aroma
4. Pour into a bowl and let cool to room temperature
5. In a bowl , with an electric mixer on medium speed , beat butter and sugar until very smooth
6. Beat in egg yolk until well blended , scraping down sides of bowl as needed
7. In another bowl , mix flour , cardamom , and baking soda
8. Stir or beat into butter mixture until well blended
9. Shape dough into 1-inch balls
10. Place 1 inch apart on buttered or cooking parchment-lined 12- by 15-inch baking sheets
11. I use my wonderful silpat mat !
12. Bake cookies in a 325 oven until golden brown on the bottom , 16 to 18 minutes
13. If baking more than one pan at a time , switch pan positions halfway through baking
14. Using a wide spatula , transfer the cookies to racks to cool completely

title: delicious low fat one dish pasta dinner
steps:
1. Cook pasta in boiling salted water for 1-2 minutes less than the package directions say
2. Drain and return to the pan
3. Toss with about 2 / 3 of the can of spaghetti sauce
4. Set aside to cool
5. Meanwhile , mix together ricotta , cottage cheese , parmesan and pepper
6. Stir til smooth
7. Set aside
8. Next , saute the zucchini , onion , and garlic in the olive oil
9. Add oregano , basil , salt and water
10. Cook until water has evaporated and zucchini is tender-crisp
11. Make sure the onion doesn't burn
12. Set aside
13. Assemble as follows in a 2 quart casserole dish that you've sprayed with pam
14. First , put in about 1 / 2 of the cooled pasta , pat down with the back of your spoon
15. Then spread out the ricotta cheese mixture
16. Next , make a layer with the zucchini mixture
17. Again , pat with the back of your spoon so the zucchini nestles into the ricotta
18. Sprinkle with about 1 / 2 of the reduced fat mozzarella
19. Then put in the rest of the pasta
20. Pour the remaining sauce over the top
21. Sprinkle the top with remaining mozzarella
22. Bake at 350 for about 35 minutes
23. Let cool slightly before serving

title: orange beef and broccoli stir fry
steps:
1. If desired , place the meat in the freezer until partially frozen for easier slicing
2. Trim fat and thinly slice meat across the grain into bite-size strips
3. Toss together meat strips , marmalade , hoisin sauce , teriyaki sauce , soy sauce , and garlic
4. Cook broccoli in a medium saucepan until crispy tender
5. Drain and cool
6. Preheat a wok or large skillet over high heat
7. Add meat mixture to hot wok
8. Stir-fry for 4-6 minutes or to desired doneness
9. Add cooked broccoli and heat through
10. Can be served over steamed rice
11. Freeze ahead: place all ingredients , except broccoli , in a freezer bag and freeze up to 2 months
12. I usually separate it into 2 bags to make 2 meals since it serves 8

title: moist and juicy garlic chicken
steps:
1. In shallow dish , mix butter , garlic , parsley and garlic powder
2. Combine breadcrumbs and cheeses
3. Dip chicken in butter , then in crumb mixture
4. Place in baking dish
5. Cover and bake at350 for 45 minutes

title: chayote salad
steps:
1. Combine chayote , chile pepper , cilantro , lemon juice , oil , and vinegar in large bowl
2. Toss to thoroughly coat
3. Sprinkle with salt and pepper
4. Garnish with cilantro springs

title: spinach mushroom lasagna roll ups with gorgonzola cream sauce
steps:
1. Saut mushrooms , chopped onion and garlic in oil over med heat , until mushrooms give off their juice and onion is tender- 7-8 minutes
2. Season with salt and pepper
3. Add dry chopped spinach to the pan and heat through
4. Add ricotta , adjust salt and pepper and heat through
5. Remove from burner , but leave in warm skillet
6. Heat broth in small sauce pan
7. Add gorgonzola into broth , and bring to a bubble
8. Stir in cream and thicken about 2 minutes
9. Place cooked noodles on work surface
10. Place a dollop of spinach mixture on one end of noodles and roll each one up
11. Arrange rolled packages , seam side down , in shallow casserole dish
12. Pour warm sauce over and top with mozzarella
13. Place casserole under broiler to melt mozzarella and slightly brown

title: cheesy breakfast pie
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400
2. Grease 10 x 1 1 / 2" pie plate
3. Cook sausage and onion in 10-inch skillet , stirring frequently , until sausage is fully cooked
4. Drain fat
5. Mix sausage mixture , potatoes and 1 c cheese in pie plate
6. Beat remaining ingredients except 1 / 4 c cheese with wire whisk or hand beater until smooth
7. Pour over sausage mixture
8. Bake about 40 minutes or until golden brown and knife inserted in center comes out clean
9. Sprinkle with 1 / 4 c cheese
10. Bake about 2 minutes longer or until cheese is melted

title: crusted skillet halibut steaks with chile cilanto aioli
steps:
1. For the aioli
2. Mix all ingredients in a bowl and adjust to taste
3. Chill until ready to use
4. For the fish
5. In a small bowl whisk the milk and egg together
6. Trensfer to a shallow dish
7. In a shallow dish
8. Mix the cornflake crumbs , flour , seasoned salt , black pepper , garlic powder and cayenne
9. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat
10. Dip the halibut steaks into the egg / milk mixture and then coat well in the cornflakes mixture
11. Using you hands pat down the mixture firmly to adhear to the fish
12. Fry the fish for about 4 minutes on each side , or until the fish flakes easily with a fork
13. Serve with the aioli and lemon wedges

title: waffles perfect  vegan
steps:
1. Process all ingredients in a blender until smooth
2. For small blenders , blend with less of the water , then pour into a pitcher and add remaining water
3. Pour onto preheated , nonstick waffle iron , using enough batter to cover grids and edges
4. Bake until steaming stops , from 7 to 14 minutes , depending on the waffle iron style
5. If batter gets too thick , add more water and blend before pouring
6. In my waffle iron i have to make sure to put a generous amount of batter on the iron or it will stick
7. Waffles may be frozen and reheated in toaster or oven
8. For variation , blend in a banana

title: the best lower fat chocolate chip cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit
2. Cream the butter and both sugars in a large bowl
3. Beat with electric mixer until smooth
4. Add the egg , egg whites , salt and the vanilla
5. Beat well
6. In a smaller bowl , combine the dry ingredients
7. Slowly add the dry items into the larger bowl and beat with electric mixer until batter is smooth and creamy
8. Fold in entire bag of chocolate chips , and if you like add the walnuts
9. Drop dough by large teaspoons onto cookie sheet and bake for 11 minutes

title: sesame cold noodles
steps:
1. Cook the noodles in boiling salted water until they are tender but not mushy
2. Drain and rinse in cold water , toss with 1 tbls of the oil
3. Beat together the tahini , sugar , soy sauce , vinegar and remaining oil
4. Add a dash of hot sauce , taste and season as necessary
5. Thin the sauce with hot water until it is the consistency of heavy cream
6. Toss the noodles with the sauce , garnish with scallions and serve

title: spicy pork roast
steps:
1. Combine the first 8 ingredients
2. Rub over entire roast
3. Cover and refrigerate overnight
4. Place roast on a greased rack in a roasting pan
5. Bake , uncovered at 350 degrees for 2 1 / 4 to 2 3 / 4 hours or until a meat thermometer reads 160-170 degrees
6. Let stand 10 minutes before slicing

title: boss worthy chipotle chicken chowder
steps:
1. In a 6-quart heavy pot , cook onions in oil over moderate heat , stirring until softened
2. Add diced potato , garlic , and jalapeo and cook stirring , 1 minute
3. Stir in flour , and cook over moderately low heat , stirring about 2 minutes
4. Whisk in 2 cups broth and half and half and bring to a boil while stirring
5. Add tomatoes , corn , parsley , chipotle , and chicken and simmer , stirring occasionally , about 20 minutes , or until vegetables are tender
6. Add remaining broth , if needed , to get the liquid consistency you want
7. Add salt and pepper , to taste

title: proper scottish oat scones
steps:
1. 1
2. Preheat oven to 425f spray a baking sheet with nonstick cooking spray or line it with parchment paper
3. Melt butter in a small saucepan over low heat and cook until it begins to turn light brown , about 2 minutes
4. Skim foam and pour into a small bowl
5. Stir together oats , flours , sugar , baking powder , baking soda and salt in a large bowl
6. Stir in raisins and make a well in the center of the dry ingredients
7. Combine the browned butter , egg , yogurt and oil in a small bowl
8. Add to the dry ingredients , stirring just until moistened
9. Turn out onto a lightly floured surface and gently knead several times to form a ball
10. Pat the ball into an 8-inch circle and cut into 8 or 12 wedges
11. Place the wedges on the prepared baking sheet and bake until lightly browned and firm to the touch , about 12 minutes
12. Transfer to a rack and let cool slightly
13. Serve warm

title: sous vide flat iron steaks
steps:
1. Set immersion circulator to 125f
2. Whisk together vinegar , olive oil , granulated garlic and ground mustard
3. Place this mixture and steaks into a bowl and marinate for 30 minutes
4. Remove steaks from marinade and individually vacuum seal in a bag
5. Place sealed bags into the water bath and cook for 2-3 hours
6. Heat your grill to high and grill steaks for no more than 1-2 minutes per side
7. Season to taste with salt & pepper

title: jalapeno citrus shrimp kebabs
steps:
1. Preheat grill
2. Soak long wooden skewers in a bowl of water
3. Combine orange juice , lime juice , honey , oil , garlic , jalapeno , cumin , zest , and salt in a large bowl
4. Whisk well
5. Add shrimp to bowl , cover and marinate 30 minutes in the refrigerator
6. Lightly season with salt and pepper the bell pepper and onion pieces
7. Remove shrimp from marinade and thread onto wooden skewers , along with bell peppers and onion
8. Cook on the grill until vegetables are lightly browned and shrimp is no longer pink , 3 to 5 minutes , turning once

title: chilli tomato cheddar bread
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350
2. Coat two 8 1 / 2 x 4 1 / 2 x 2 1 / 2- inch loaf pans with nonstick cooking spray
3. Stir together baking mix and shredded cheese in a large bowl
4. Make well in center of mixture
5. Add eggs , milk , and tomatoes with chillies to well
6. Stir just until the dry ingredients are moistened
7. Divide batter evenly between the prepared loaf pans
8. Bake in 350 oven 45 minutes , until wooden pick inserted in centers tests clean
9. Coll in pans on rack 5 minutes
10. Unmold
11. Serve warm

title: easiest whole wheat bread
steps:
1. Mix together the first three ingredients in mixer with dough hook
2. Add water all at once and mix for one minute
3. Cover and let rest for 10 minutes
4. Add salt , oil honey or sugar and lemon juice and beat for one minute or until combined
5. Add last flour , 1 cup at a time beating between each cup
6. Beat for 6 to 10 minutes until dough pulls away from the sides of the bowl
7. This makes a very soft dough
8. Preheat oven for 1 minute to lukewarm and turn off
9. Turn dough out onto oiled surface
10. Divide and shape into loaves and place in oiled bread pans
11. Let rise in warm oven 10-15 minutes or until dough reaches top of pan
12. Do not remove bread from oven
13. Turn oven to 350 and bake for 30 to 35 minutes
14. Remove from pans and cool on racks

title: easy stuffed cabbage soup
steps:
1. Brown ground beef in skillet , drain and place in soup pot
2. Add water , beef base , dried onion and canned tomatoes
3. Bring to a boil for about 10 minutes
4. Add cabbage , zucchini and brown rice
5. Turn down heat to low , place a lid on soup pot and simmer for about 45 minutes
6. Add salt and pepper to taste

title: pasta with courgette and walnut sauce
steps:
1. Melt butter , add onion , cover and sweat for about 5 minutes
2. Add courgettes , cover and stir occasionally until cooked
3. Meanwhile cook the pasta as per manufacturers instructions
4. To the courgette mixture add the walnuts , parsley , cream , salt and pepper to taste
5. Add the pasta and parmesan cheese
6. Stir well
7. Serve

title: potato potato pot roast
steps:
1. Place meat in roasting pan
2. Surround with potatoes and carrots
3. Parsnips might be good here also
4. Season with salt and pepper and anything else you might admire
5. Garlic ?
6. Mix canned soup and dry onion soup together
7. Top roast with sliced onion and soup mixture
8. Cover tightly with foil and / or lid
9. Bake at 350 degrees fahrenheit for 20 minutes
10. Reduce heat to 225 degrees fahrenheit
11. Bake for 2 to 3 hours or until meat is tender

title: my dad s ice cream sundae  circa 1950 s
steps:
1. Do i really need to tell you how to do this
2. Scoop ice cream in dish
3. Add strawberry jam on top of ice cream
4. Drizzle syrup in a fiure 8 on top
5. Grab a glass of milk , sit down and enjoy !
6. Any and all substitutions accepted if they have sugar in them !

title: black sesame seed peanut butter cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 with racks in lower and upper thirds
2. Beat together peanut butter and sugar in a medium bowl with an electric mixer until combined well , about 2 minutes
3. Beat in egg and baking soda
4. Place sesame seeds in a shallow bowl
5. Roll level teaspoons of dough into balls , then roll in seeds to coat
6. Arrange balls about 1 inch apart on 2 ungreased baking sheets
7. Bake cookies , switching position of sheets halfway through , until puffed and cracked , about 10 minutes
8. Cool on baking sheets 2 minutes , then transfer to racks to cool

title: italian grilled shrimp
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in a large zip-lock bag
2. Seal and refrigerate for 4 to 6 hours
3. Thread shrimp and veggies onto metal skewers , alternating as desired
4. Grill over medium heat about 4 minutes , turn once and grill 4 minutes more
5. Remove from skewers and serve hot
6. This also works as a stir-fry: marinate as above and then saute all ingredients over medium-high heat in a large skillet until shrimp are pink

title: swedish beetroot  horseradish and apple salad  rodbetsallad
steps:
1. Mix all the chopped vegetables and fruit together - making sure that they are cut into a similar size
2. Stir the grated horseradish into the sour cream - bit by bit , checking for taste after each addition
3. Then add the chopped vegetables and fruit to the horseradish and sour cream mixture
4. Put into an attractive serving bowl and sprinkle with chopped dill
5. Serve with the smorgasbord , or with cold cuts , quiches and pickled fish
6. Also wonderful to take on a picnic

title: babychops  bomb diggity cheddar herb biscuits
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450
2. Combine first 6 ingredients
3. Pulse in cold butter bits until coarse meal texture with some pea sized butter bits
4. Add buttermilk & pulse until moistened
5. Mix in 2 cups cheese
6. Turn onto lightly floured surface and knead to combine
7. Roll out to about 3 / 4" and cut into circles , if you don't have a cutter take the top & bottom off a soup can , works just as well
8. Place biscuits onto a nonstick cookie sheet , spoon melted butter onto each & top w / remaining cheese
9. Bake in upper rack so bottoms don't burn for about 20 minutes until golden & cheese is melty
10. Enjoy ! we couldn't get enough of them -- this recipe makes a mess of biscuits and they're even better re-heated

title: penne pasta with asparagus sauce
steps:
1. Cut the asparagus into one inch pieces
2. Reserving the
3. Cook asparagus in 5 quarts of water until very tender 6-8 minutes
4. Reserve the water by using a slotted spoon to remove the asparagus to a colander
5. Put the drained asparagus in a food processor
6. Cook the
7. Remove from water with slotted spoon , reserving the water
8. Puree the stems with the lemon zest and oil and 1 / 2 cup of the asparagus water
9. Cook the pasta in the asparagus water to your liking
10. Drain the pasta saving 2 cups of the water
11. Combine the pasta , asparagus sauce and add asparagus water if the sauce is too thick- a little at a time
12. Stir in
13. Stir until cheese is melted
14. Serve with a light dusting of chopped parsley

title: callaloo  real trini style    caribbean
steps:
1. Separate leaves from stems
2. Thoroughly wash leaves and strip the stems
3. Tear leaves apart with hands into smaller pieces
4. Chop stems into about 2 inches length
5. Add all the ingredients into a medium pot over medium heat
6. Bring to a boil and then allow to simmer for 20 mins or until the okra seeds turn pink
7. Taste and season with salt & pepper if necessary
8. When the callaloo is done the leaves and okras should be tender and there should be enough liquid to blend the ingredients
