9. If not add a little warm water to bring to a soup consistency
10. Remove from heat and allow to cool for 15 minutes
11. Remove the pork tails before blending
12. Using a hand blender , blend the callaloo until all the ingredients are pureed
13. Store in a clean pot with pork tails and reheat before serving
14. Serve with rice , stewed caribbean chicken , potato salad , boiled provisions , cole slaw , pigeon peas and macaroni pie

title: amaretti ice cream dessert
steps:
1. Crumble 4 amaretti cookies into each of 4 desssert cups and douse them with the liqueur
2. Top with ice cream , whipped cream and almonds
3. Easy peasy lemon squeezy =)

title: frozen custard
steps:
1. In medium saucepan , beat together eggs , milk , sugar , honey and salt
2. Cook over low heat , stirring constantly , until mixture is thick enough to coat metal spoon and reaches at least 160 degrees
3. Cool quickly by setting pan in ice or cold water and stirring for few minutes
4. Cover and refrigerate until thoroughly chilled , at least 1 hour
5. When ready to freeze , pour chilled custard , whipping cream and vanilla into 1-gallon ice cream freezer can
6. Freeze according to manufacturer's directions using 6 parts ice to 1 part rock salt
7. Transfer to freezer containers and freeze until firm

title: thai chicken with ginger and mushrooms   gai king
steps:
1. In a small dish , mix together vinegar , fish sauce and brown sugar until brown sugar dissolves
2. Set aside
3. Heat oil in wok and stir-fry onions , garlic and chicken for 2 minutes for 2-3 minutes or until onions are limp
4. Add soy sauce , ginger , mint , mushrooms , green onions , chilies and cook until chicken is cooked through
5. Working fast , add vinegar , brown sugar , and fish sauce mixture to chicken and take off the heat
6. Serve at once with steamed jasmine rice

title: roasted pork tamales with salsa verde filling
steps:
1. For the tamale dough:
2. In a mixer add corn flour , water , baking powder , salt , butter and shortening
3. Mix at medium speed for about 3 minutes until mixture becomes light and fluffy
4. Spread 2 ounces of tamale dough on each corn husk and place 1 1 / 2 ounces of pork filling in the center of each
5. Fold corn husk and place into a steamer for 1 hour
6. Allow time to rest and serve warm
7. For the roast pork with salsa verde filling:
8. Heat medium-sized roasting pan , add vegetable oil , and add pork which has been cut into cubes about 2 inches by 2 inches and seasoned on all sides with salt and pepper
9. Sear pork to a golden brown on all sides
10. Add salsa verde and chicken broth
11. Cover and place in a 300-degree oven for about 1 1 / 2 hours , or until meat is very tender
12. Remove pork from liquid and cool
13. Pull meat , shredding it into small pieces , then brown lightly in a saut pan and add cooking liquid
14. Season to taste
15. For the salsa verde:
16. In a medium pot bring 3 quarts of water to a boil , then add tomatillos , onions , jalapenos and garlic
17. Simmer for 5 minutes and drain
18. Place ingredients in a blender with cilantro , lime juice and salt
19. Puree
20. Return pureed mixture to sauce pot and simmer gently for 15 minutes
21. Adjust seasoning as needed

title: carrot pancake
steps:
1. In a bowl , mix together the dry ingredients [flour , sugar , b
2. Powder , salt
3. ]
4. Mix in the milk , egg , and applesauce
5. Put raw , uncooked carrots in a food processor until very fine
6. Stir the carrots in with the batter
7. Spray your griddle or frying pan with cooking spray , then heat to 375 or medium heat
8. Use 1 / 4 cup to measure out your pancakes
9. Cook pancakes until bubbly on top , then flip over until the other side is also cooked and golden

title: chive and blue  cheese butter
steps:
1. Cut up chives with scissors and add to the blue cheese and butter
2. Mix throughly
3. Refrigerate

title: spicy cauliflower balls
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Combine olive oil , onions and cauliflower in a large skillet
3. Sweat over high heat for 5 minutes
4. Add salt , pepper , garlic and jalapenos
5. Continue cooking for 5 more minutes
6. Add butter and remove from heat
7. Mix eggs , parmesan cheese and stuffing mix
8. Add cauliflower mixture and mix well
9. Shape into 3 / 4 inch balls
10. Bake on a lightly greased cookie sheet for 20-25 minutes

title: munavoi  finnish egg butter
steps:
1. Gently mix the eggs and butter together until spreading consistency
2. Add salt if desired
3. Spread on bread or toast

title: rich and decadent butter pecan bread pudding
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease a 13x9x2 inch pan
3. Dump bread cubes inches
4. Mix together in a bowl sugar , eggs , cream , vanilla , raisins
5. Pour over bread in baking dish , making sure to push bread down into custard so it is soaked
6. In another bowl , mix brown sugar , softened butter and pecans
7. Spread over top of bread pudding evenly
8. Bake 35-40 minutes or until set
9. Remove from oven
10. To make sauce:
11. Mix sugar , butter , egg and vanilla in a saucepan over medium heat and stir until sugar is dissolved
12. Remove from heat and stir in brandy
13. Pour over the bread pudding and let it all soak in and firm up before serving
14. Tastes best warm

title: blueberry cheesecake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees
2. In a small bowl combine graham crackers , 1 / 4 cup sugar and butter
3. Press mixture evenly onto the bottom and halfway up the sides of a 9-inch springform pan
4. In the workbowl of a food processor , combine 2 1 / 2 cups blueberries and 1 tbs cornstarch
5. Process until smooth
6. Pour mixture into a small saucepan and cook over medium heat for 15 minutes or until slightly thickened , stirring constantly
7. Set aside to cool , reserving 1 / 2 cup mixture for glaze
8. Beat cream cheese with mixer until fluffy
9. Gradually beat in 1 cup sugar
10. Add eggs , one at a time , beating well after each addition
11. Stir in remaining 2 tbs cornstarch and salt
12. Pour batter into crust
13. Spoon cooled blueberry mixture over batter and gently swirl with a knife
14. Bake for 1 hour or until set
15. Remove from oven and cool on a wire rack for 20 minutes
16. In a small bowl combine sour cream , 2 tbs sugar , vanilla
17. Stir until blended , and spread over cooled cheesecake
18. Return to oven , bake for 10 minutes
19. Remove from oven
20. Gently run a knife around edges to release sides
21. Cool completely in pan on a wire rack
22. Cover and chill for 8 hours or overnight
23. In a saucepan combine reserved blueberry mixture , 1 / 2 cup water and 1 / 4 cup sugar
24. Cook over medium heat until thickened , stirring constantly
25. Stir in remaining 1 cup blueberries
26. Set aside to cool
27. Remove sides of springform pan to serve
28. Spoon blueberry sauce over cake

title: peanut m m brownies
steps:
1. Oven 350f - combine brownie mix , eggs , oil , water , peanut butter , and 1 cup m&m's till well mixed
2. Spread into 9x13 prepared pan and top with crushed peanut m&ms
3. Bake 27-30 minutes , and cool completely !
4. Cut into squares - should get 24 smallish squares - with 1 square per person as a serving

title: chunky style roasted tomato ketchup
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Place tomatoes , skin side up , on baking rack set on baking sheet
3. Add the green pepper and onion
4. Brush vegetables very lightly with olive oil
5. Place in oven and roast until lightly browned , about 15 minutes
6. Remove from oven and cool slightly
7. Chop the onions and peppers fairly small
8. Place the tomatoes in a food processor and pulse until chunky
9. Add the onions , peppers and additional ingredients
10. Taste for seasoning
11. Let set at room temperature until ready to use
12. Can be made ahead and refrigerated for up to 3 days

title: drunken butter rum cupcakes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees f
2. Line muffin pan with paper liners
3. Toast pecan and coconut over medium heat in a dry skillet for 10 minutes stirring occasionally
4. Combine all cake ingredients in a large stainless steel bowl
5. Beat for 2 minutes on high with electric mixer
6. Stir in pecans and coconut flake mixture reserving about 1 / 3 cup for garnishing later
7. Pour batter into prepared cups
8. Bake for 30 minutes or until toothpick comes out of center completely clean
9. Place on a cooling rack
10. Prick top of cupcakes with toothpick
11. Allow to cool completely
12. For glaze:
13. Melt butter in saucepan
14. Stir in 1 / 4 cup of the rum and sugar
15. Boil 5 minutes , stirring constantly until thickened
16. Remove from heat
17. Stir in remaining 1 / 4 cup of rum
18. For frosting:
19. Before starting , place your stainless steel bowl and the arms for mixer into the freezer , for about 5 minutes
20. The cold bowl and arms form stiffer peaks in your frosting
21. In large bowl , with mixer at medium-low speed , beat sugar , butter , vanilla , and 4 tablespoons rum until blended
22. Increase speed to medium-high
23. Beat until light and fluffy , occasionally scraping bowl with rubber spatula
24. Beat in more rum as needed for desire consistency for frosting
25. To finish cupcakes:
26. Dip tops of cupcakes into butter rum glaze and allow excess to drop off before placing back down
27. This part can get a bit messy
28. Pipe on dollops of frosting , i usually leave some of the cupcake showing cause the glaze is so shiny and pretty
29. Drizzle a small amount of remaining drizzle over top of frosting
30. Sprinkle with remaining pecan and coconut

title: cherry tomato meatballs
steps:
1. In mixing bowl combine egg and milk and stir in bread crumbs , onion , worcestershire sauce , salt , oregano and pepper
2. Add meat and mix well
3. Shape 1 / 4 cup of the meat mixture evenly around each cherry tomato to form round meatballs
4. Place 9x13 baking pan
5. Bake 375f 25-30 minutes

title: cinnamon raisin cream scones
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Grease a baking sheet
3. Topping: mix cinnamon and 1 / 4 cup sugar in a small bowl , set aside
4. Scones: have all ingredients at room temperature
5. Sift flour , then measure out 2 cups into mixing bowl
6. Add baking powder , salt , and sugar and sift again
7. Add shortening , cutting it in until mixture resembles coarse meal
8. In a seperate bowl , beat eggs , add cream
9. Add to flour mixture ,
10. Add raisins and stir just until mixed
11. Turn onto lightly floured board
12. Knead sticky dough for 1 / 2 minute
13. Shape dough into ball , place on greased baking sheet
14. Pat down into circle of dough about 1 1 / 2 inches thick
15. Cut into 8 wedges and move wedges apart on sheet so they are evenly spaced
16. Brush each wedge with reserved egg / cream mixture , and sprinkle cinnamon sugar topping generously over each
17. Bake in 400 degree oven for 11-14 minutes , or until lightly golden
18. Serve warm with butter & jam

title: hsun tan or smoked eggs
steps:
1. Boil the room temperature eggs by place in saucepan with cold water and bring water just to a boil over medium heat
2. Cook for 4 minutes
3. Pour off water
4. Tap all eggs with spoon just enought to crack them
5. Refill pan with cold water and add eggs
6. Carefully crack the eggs and remove shells then set aside soft boiled eggs
7. Combine marinade ingredients and mix well
8. Add eggs and let stand for an hour or more
9. Turn eggs several times to coat evenly
10. Then cut egg in half lenghtwise and serve chilled
11. You may serve a little marinade with the eggs

title: cornmeal rosemary cake with lemon fondant
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f
2. Butter a 9-inch cake pan , line it with a circle of parchment paper , and butter the paper
3. In a bowl , combine the flour , cornmeal , rosemary , zest , baking powder , and salt
4. In a large bowl , briefly whisk the mascarpone to loosen it
5. Add the eggs one at a time , whisking to combine
6. Add the sugar and whisk until smooth
7. Using a rubber spatula , fold the dry ingredients , in two batches , into the wet ingredients , mixing until smooth
8. Stir in the butter
9. Scrape the cake batter into the prepared pan and bake until a skewer comes out clean , about 40 minutes
10. While the cake is baking , make the lemon syrup
11. Combine the lemon juice and the sugar in a small saucepan over medium heat and cook a few minutes , stirring occasionally , until the sugar dissolves
12. Remove from the heat
13. Allow the cake pan to cool on a rack for 5 minutes before unmolding
14. To unmold , run a small knife around the cake
15. Place an inverted plate over the cake pan and , protecting your hands with a kitchen towel , invert the whole thing
16. The cake should slide right out onto the plate
17. Peel off the parchment paper , then place a 9-inch cardboard circle or an inverted plate over the cake and , again , invert the whole thing
18. Remove the top plate and the cake will be right side up
19. With a wooden skewer , poke a few dozen holes all over the top of the cake
20. While the cake is still warm , brush the cake with the lemon syrup
21. Continue brushing for several minutes , giving the syrup time to sink into the cake , until you've used all or most of the syrup
22. Allow the cake to cool
23. To make the lemon fondant , bring a small saucepan of water to a boil
24. Add the rosemary leaves and blanch them for one minute
25. Scoop out the rosemary leaves with a small sieve and drop them immediately into a small bowl of ice water
26. Drain , and spread the rosemary leaves on a paper towel to dry
27. In a bowl , whisk the powdered sugar , cream , and lemon juice until smooth , then whisk in the blanched rosemary and the zest
28. When the cake is completely cool , transfer it to a rack set over a baking sheet
29. Pour the fondant over the top of the cake and allow it to drip off the sides
30. You can gently tilt the cardboard circle or the wire rack back and forth to encourage the glaze to completely flow over the top of the cake
31. While the glaze is still wet , transfer the cake to a cake plate
32. Allow the fondant to dry , an hour or more , before serving the cake
33. Because this cake is quite moist , you can make it one day ahead
34. After the cake is brushed with the syrup , allow it to cool completely , then wrap it tightly in plastic wrap , and leave it at room temperature
35. A few hours before you're ready to serve the cake , make the fondant and glaze the cake

title: deeply chocolate gelato
steps:
1. Heat the milk , cream , and 1 / 2 cup sugar in a 2-quart saucepan , until the sugar dissolves and the milk starts to simmer
2. Add the cocoa powder and chocolate and whisk until smooth
3. Pour into a heat-proof measuring cup
4. Place the egg yolks and the remaining 1 / 4 cup sugar in the bowl of an electric mixer fitted with the paddle attachment and beat on high speed for 3 to 5 minutes , until light yellow and very thick
5. With the mixer on low speed , slowly pour the hot chocolate mixture into the egg mixture
6. Pour the egg and chocolate mixture back into the 2-quart saucepan and cook over medium-low heat , stirring constantly , until thickened
7. A candy thermometer will register about 180f don't allow the mixture to boil !
8. Pour the mixture through a sieve into a bowl and stir in the coffee liqueur , vanilla , and salt
9. Place a piece of plastic wrap directly on top of the custard and chill completely
10. Pour the custard into the bowl of an ice cream maker and process according to the manufacturer's directions
11. Stir in the roughly chopped chocolate , if using , and freeze in covered containers
12. Allow the gelato to thaw slightly before serving

title: slow cooker whole cauliflower
steps:
1. If cauliflower has greens still attached to the bottom , leave them on
2. Place whole cauliflower in the slow cooker
3. In a small bowl , mix together garlic , butter , sage and lemon zest
4. Pour butter mixture over cauliflower
5. Use your fingers to rub into the surface
6. Evenly sprinkle with the salt and pepper , followed by the powdered parmesan cheese
7. Pour the lemon juice around the cauliflower in the slow cooker
8. Cook on low for 5 hours , or on high for 3 hours , 30 minutes
9. Gently remove the cauliflower from the slow cooker
10. Add parsley to the slow cooker and mix with the liquid from cooking
11. Slice the cauliflower and pour the sauce over the top
12. Serve with grilled chicken or fish , or let it stand alone and shine

title: blueberry mango tartlets
steps:
1. Lightly grease 6 deep 10cm flan tins
2. Sift the flour into bowl and rub in the butter
3. Add the egg yolks and enough water to make the ingredients cling together
4. Press the dough into a ball , knead gently on a lightly floured surface until the dough is smooth , then cover , and refrigerate 30 minutes
5. Divide the pastry into 6 portions , roll them in turn on a floured surface until they are large enough to line the prepared tins
6. Lift the pastry into the tins , ease into the sides , and trim the edges
7. Place the tins on an oven tray , line the pastry with paper , fill with dried beans or rice and bake at 190c for 10 minutes
8. Remove the paper and beans , bake for a further 10 minutes or until the pastry is lightly browned
9. Then allow to cool
10. Just before serving , pour the filling into the pastry cases , top with blueberries and serve with strawberry sauce and sliced mangoes
11. Filling: blend or process all of the ingredients until smooth
12. Strawberry sauce: blend or process all of the ingredients until smooth
13. Then strain
14. Storage: pastry cases , in airtight container
15. Filling and sauce , covered , in the refrigerator
16. Freeze: the pastry cases are suitable suitable for freezing

title: spanish rice supper
steps:
1. In a skillet , cook beef , onion and green pepper over medium high heat until beef is browned , 8-10 minutes
2. Drain off excess fat
3. Stir in rice , tomatoes with their liquid , tomato paste , water , cumin and chiles
4. Heat to boiling , stirring occasionally
5. Reduce heat to low
6. Cover pan and simmer over low heat 30 minutes or until rice is tender
7. Stir in salt and pepper

title: down home chicken   noodles
steps:
1. Place chicken in the slow cooker
2. Sprinkle with salt and pepper
3. Top with both cans of soup
4. Cover and cook on low for 6 hours or until the chicken falls apart
5. Remove chicken from slow cooker and shred
6. Return chicken to the slow cooker , add the broth and the noodles
7. Mix well
8. Cover and cook on low setting for an additional 30 min or untill heated through

title: irish blue cheese and tomato soup
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425
2. Rub a bit of olive oil on your hands and coat each of the tomato halves
3. Place them cut side down on a rimmed baking sheet
4. Roast the tomatoes in the oven for 30 to 40 minutes
5. Remove from the oven and chop the tomatoes roughly in a food processor or by hand
6. In the bottom of your soup pot cook the bacon over low heat until it's crisp
7. Remove to a plate and cover with a paper towel
8. Reserve a tablespoon of the bacon fat to cook the vegetables
9. Add the onion , celery and carrots to the soup pot and cook stirring occasionally for 1 - 2 minutes , until the onion is translucent
10. Stir in the flour and mix well until it's completely incorporated with the veggies in the pot
11. Pour in the heated stock and stir well until the stock thickens slightly and the vegetables are soft
12. Crumble the cheese into the pot and add the chopped tomatoes
13. Bring the soup to a boil stirring to help melt the cheese
14. Remove the pot from heat and use an immersion blender to puree the soup until smooth
15. Cook until the soup is hot but not yet at the simmer
16. Roughly chop the bacon
17. Serve the soup in individual bowls , , topped with bacon
18. Sprinkle the black pepper and chopped parsley if desired

title: low fat yellow squash bake
steps:
1. Cook squash and onion in about a tablespoon of butter with seasonings
2. When done lightly mash mixture
3. Combine milk and soup mix well and add squash mixture
4. Put in a baking dish and layer breadcrumbs then cheese
5. Cook in 350 degree oven for 10-15 minutes

title: cran fizzy iced tea
steps:
1. Steep 4 tea bags in 2 cups boiling water according to package directions
2. Discard tea bags
3. Stir in can of frozen cranberry juice concentrate
4. Cover and chill
5. To serve , fill a glass of ice one-quarter full with tea mixture
6. Top off with chilled club soda
7. You may also add fresh berries as a garnish

title: surimi salad
steps:
1. Cut imitation crab legs in half inch pieces at an angle and place in a bowl
2. Add all other ingredients except for salad dressing , dill , salt , and pepper
3. Mix the salad together to combine and add dressing and dill
4. Stir again to combine
5. Last season the salad with salt and pepper to taste and stir once to combine
6. Chill in the refrigerator for 10 minutes up to 20 minutes and serve

title: carrot banana bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees and spray a non-stick 9-inch by 3-inch loaf pan with vegetable spray
2. In a medium size mixing bowl , combine the oil and sugar
3. Add eggs , mixing well
4. Combine the flour , baking soda , salt , cinnamon and nutmeg
5. Gradually add to the creamed mixture alternately with bananas
6. Mix in carrots and pecans
7. Bake for 55 to 65 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near center comes out clean
8. Cool for 10 minutes before removing from pan , then remove from pan and place on a wire rack to cool completely

title: scrumptious butternut squash
steps:
1. Halve the butternut squash lengthwise and scoop out seeds
2. Sprinkle with brown sugar and cinnamon
3. Dot each half with 4 pieces of butter
4. Drizzle with honey
5. Bake in oven at 350 degrees until tender , about 20 minutes

title: potato corn chowder  crock pot
steps:
1. Place everything in a 6 quart crock pot and mix together
2. Cover and cook on low for 8-10 hours

title: quick and easy italian meatballs
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Mix all ingredients together well using your hands
3. Shape into 15-20 balls
4. Place balls in an ungreased pan and bake for 20-25 minutes , until the juices run clear
5. Serve with your favourite pasta sauce , over spaghetti noodles , with a glass of red wine !

title: acadia s lasagna
steps:
1. Boil water and olive oil , then remove from heat
2. Place lasagna noodles in hot water to soften for about 5 minutes , drain and and rinse in cool water
3. Brown ground meat
4. Saute onion , garlic , basil , oregano until onion is tender
5. Then mix with browned ground meat
6. Add tomatoes to meat mixture and simmer 30-minutes
7. Stir occasionally
8. Rub baking dish with butter then arrange three alternate layers of noodles , ricotta cheese , meat mixture and mozzarella
9. Top with parmesan cheese
10. Bake in a 350 oven for 40 mintes
11. Let stand 15 minutes before serving
12. Serves 6

title: garlicky spinach rice
steps:
1. Cook the rice in a rice cooker , or according to the directions on the package
2. Wash the spinach well-- spinach tends to be very gritty
3. Chop off the bottom 1" or so of the stems
4. Tear or chop the remaining leaves and stems into 2"-3" long sections
5. Toss the spinach into a pot , along with 1 / 4 cup of water
6. Heat on high
7. When the water boils , cover the pot
8. Cook for 2-3 minutes , until the spinach is wilted
9. Drain and set aside
10. In a skillet , heat 2 tbsp
11. Olive oil on medium
12. When the oil is hot , add the chopped garlic and saut for 2-3 minutes , until the garlic begins to soften and turn translucent
13. Add the drained spinach and saut for another couple of minutes
14. Season to taste with salt and plenty of pepper
15. Add the cooked rice and stir well to combine
16. Taste , then add more salt and pepper as necessary
17. Serve

title: peanut crunch ice cream topping
steps:
1. Melt butter in a medium saucepot
2. Stir in the brown sugar and half and half and peanut butter
3. Stir over low heat until smooth and beginning to come to a boil
4. Stir in the peanuts and vanilla
5. Serve warm
6. Makes 2 1 / 2 cups topping

title: boiled oatmeal cookies  preacher cookies
steps:
1. Put oats in a large bowl
2. In a small saucepan over medium heat bring to a full boil: butter , milk , sugar , and cocoa
3. Reduce heat and simmer for 3 minutes
4. Remove from heat
5. There is a knack to this
6. Boil them too long , they will be dry and crumbly , too short and they will be runny
7. Quickly add peanut butter , salt , vanilla
8. Mix liquid into oats
9. Add more oats as necessary until it has a moist doughy consistency
10. Quickly put in buttered cake pan or quickly drop by the teaspoonful onto wax paper
11. Let them stand at room temperature for one hour
12. Variations: add 1 / 2 cup coarsely chopped nuts , or coconut
13. Replace 1 / 2 the oats with coconut
14. Use less cocoa and more peanut butter

title: pan toasted garlic bread
steps:
1. In a 10" skillet melt butter until sizzling
2. Stir in cayenne pepper and garlic
3. Dip both sides of each bread slice in melted butter , place in same skillet
4. Cook over medium heat , watching closely , until bread is lightly browned
5. Reduce heat to low , turn bread slices over , sprinkle each slice with about 1 tablespoon cheese
6. Cover continue cooking until cheese is melted
7. Serve immediately

title: pork chop   potato casserole
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees
2. Brown pork chops in oil
3. Mix together , mushroom soup , sour cream , water ,
4. Onion and parsley
5. Put a layer of potatoes in casserole
6. Salt & pepper each layer of potatoes
7. Pour mixture over potatoes
8. Put another layer of potatoes
9. Pour more mixture
10. Put pork chops on top of potatoes , cover and bake for 1 1 / 4 hours or until potatoes are done

title: music parents famous frito pie
steps:
1. Brown beef with onions and garlic
2. Drain off excess fat
3. Add tomatoes , chili powder , sugar , salt and worcestershire sauce
4. Cover and simmer 1 hour
5. Add beans , juice and all
6. Simmer uncovered for 15 minutes or until thick
7. Serve over frito corn chips , rice or use for chili dogs
8. Top with grated cheddar cheese for a special treat

title: chocolate gingerbread drops
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. In large bowl beat shortening on medium to high speed for 30 seconds
3. Add brown sugar , baking soda , ginger , allspice , and salt and continue mixing another two to three minutes
4. Next beat in the egg and molasses until incorporated in to the other wet ingredients
5. Add flour and fully mix in to the batter using as little mixing time as possible
6. Depending on your appliance , you may need to add the last bit of flour in by hand
7. Stir in cherries and chocolate
8. Drop dough by rounded teaspoons onto ungreased cookie sheets
9. Bake about 8 minutes or until bottoms are lightly browned
10. Transfer to wire racks to cool

title: cool chicken salad
steps:
1. I like to throw everything in the food processor or blender and let it do its own work , doing the chicken first and then the veggies
2. Or chop finely and add remaining ingredients
3. Mix well
4. Add ranch and then miracle whip until desired consistency
5. Salt and pepper to taste
6. A sprinkle of dill and parsley also add a good flavor !
7. Serve with wheat crackers or on toast

title: feed bag trail mix
steps:
1. Dump each into a gallon zippered plastic bag
2. Place between driver and passenger in front seat of car
3. No picking out the m & m's !
4. Suggestions for other ingredients: dried apricots , craisins , chocolate-covered raisins , yogurt covered raisins , dried cherries , cheerios
5. Serving suggestion: for children , pour about 1 / 4-1 / 2 cup into a small snack-size zippered baggie
6. This is a "neat" size for a little one to easily handle in the back-seat

title: lobster stuffed beef tenderloin and bearnaise sauce
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400f
2. Set up a large steamer
3. Place the lobster tails in the steamer and steam until just cooked through , about 6 minutes
4. Remove the lobster tails from the steamer
5. Cut along the underside of the shell and remove the tail meat whole
6. Set aside
7. In a large skillet , heat 1 teaspoon of the oil over medium-high heat
8. Add the pancetta and cook , stirring , until crisp and the fat is rendered , about 5 minutes
9. Remove with a slotted spoon
10. Drain off all but 2 teaspoons of fat from the pan
11. Add the shallots and celery and cook , stirring , until soft , about 2 minutes
12. Add the garlic and cook , stirring , for 30 seconds
13. Add the mushrooms and a pinch each of salt and pepper , and cook until the mushrooms give off their liquid , 3 to 4 minutes
14. Add the green onions and stir
15. Add the wine , increase the heat , and cook until it has nearly all evaporated , 1 to 2 minutes
16. Add the parsley and stir
17. Remove from the heat , stir in the cooked pancetta , and let cool
18. Spread the butterflied beef , cut side up , flat on a surface
19. Spread the pancetta-vegetable mixture in a line across the meat , about 2 inches from the top , leaving a 1 / 2-inch border on the sides
20. Lay the lobster tails on top of the mixture , going across the beef
21. Pull the top flap over the lobster tails and roll the meat over the stuffing , jellyroll fashion , and tuck in the ends
22. Tie with kitchen twine every 2 inches
23. Place in a large heavy roasting pan , rub on all sides with the remaining 2 teaspoons olive oil , and season lightly with salt and pepper
24. Place over medium-high heat and sear the meat on all sides , about 6 minutes
25. Place in the oven and roast to desired temperature , 30 to 35 minutes for medium-rare
26. Transfer to a cutting board
27. Tent and let rest for 10 minutes before carving
28. While beef is resting make the bearnaise sauce:
29. In a small saucepan , combine the shallots , tarragon , white wine , and vermouth
30. Bring to a boil and cook until reduced to 2 tablespoons
31. Remove from the heat , strain , and cool
32. In the top of a double boiler , or in a metal bowl fitted over a pot of barely simmering water , whisk the egg yolks and reduced wine until ribbons start to form
33. Whisking constantly , drizzle in the melted butter a bit at a time until all the butter is added and the mixture is thick
34. Remove from the heat
35. Whisk in the lemon juice , chopped tarragon , salt , and pepper
36. Adjust the seasoning , to taste
37. Cover to keep warm until ready to serve
38. To serve , place in a decorative bowl with a small sauce ladle
39. Remove the kitchen twine and slice thickly
40. Place on a platter , and drizzle with the bearnaise sauce
41. Serve immediately

title: blueberries cake pudding
steps:
1. In a bowl , mix flour , 1 / 2 cup sugar and baking powder
2. Add milk and melted butter and stir with a wooden spoon until homogeneous
3. With a spatula , spread the dough in a greased square mold 8 inch side
4. Sprinkle with blueberries and with the remaining sugar
5. Cook in a preheated oven of 350 f 40 to 45 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the middle comes out clean
6. Put the cake-pudding on a grill and let sit 10 minutes
7. Serve hot

title: sourdough bread stuffing
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
2. Grease a 2-quart baking dish and set aside
3. Cut or tear the bread into 1-inch cubes and spread it evenly on 2 baking sheets
4. Toast the bread in the oven until completely dry and beginning to crisp and brown , about 20 minutes
5. Transfer to a large mixing bowl
6. Melt 2 tablespoons of the butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat
7. Add the optional mushrooms and a few pinches of salt and saute , stirring occasionally , until golden brown , about 6 to 8 minutes
8. Add celery , onion , 2 tablespoons butter , and thyme
9. Once the butter has melted , cook , stirring frequently , until the vegetables have softened , about 5 minutes
10. Add sage and remaining 4 tablespoons butter
11. Add chicken broth to skillet and stir to combine
12. Season with salt and pepper , to taste
13. Transfer toasted bread cubes to a large bowl
14. Pour the chicken broth mixture over the bread cubes and toss to combine until the bread cubes absorb the liquid
15. Pour the mixture into the greased baking dish , and sprinkle with parsley
16. Bake in the center of the oven until heated through and the top is golden brown , about 40 minutes
17. Remove the stuffing from the oven and allow to cool about 15 minutes before serving

title: parmesan risotto
steps:
1. Heat stock in saucepan over medium heat
2. Keep at a low simmer
3. Heat olive oil in a heavy-bottomed saucepan over medium heat
4. Add shallots to oil , and cook , stirring , until translucent
5. Add rice , and cook , stirring , until rice begins to make a clicking sound like glass beads , 3 to 4 minutes
6. Add wine to rice mixture
7. Cook , stirring , until wine is absorbed by rice
8. Using a ladle , add 3 / 4 cup hot stock to rice
9. Using a wooden spoon , stir rice constantly , at a moderate speed
10. When rice mixture is just thick enough to leave a clear wake behind the spoon , add another 3 / 4 cup stock
11. Continue adding stock 3 / 4 cup at a time and stirring constantly until rice is mostly translucent but still opaque in the center
12. Rice should be al dente but not crunchy
13. As rice nears doneness , watch carefully and add smaller amounts of liquid to make sure it does not overcook
14. The final mixture should be thick enough that grains of rice are suspended in liquid the consistency of heavy cream
15. It will thicken slightly when removed from heat
16. Remove from heat
17. Stir in butter , parmesan cheese , and parsley
18. Season with salt and pepper
19. Divide the mixture among four shallow bowls , mounding risotto in the center , and grate or shave additional parmesan over risotto
20. Serve immediately

title: simplest korean beef stew
steps:
1. Heat large casserole and saute ginger in oil
2. Add the onions till soft then the garlic
3. Stir well till fragrant ,
4. Dump in the beef spareribs and stir fry till beef changes color
5. In a large bowl , mix soy , sugar , wine , sesame oil , chili garlic sauce and hot water
6. Mix till well blended
7. Pour to beef
8. Let simmer on low fire for 1 hour till 1 1 / 2 hours
9. Add in toasted sesame seeds and chopped leeks last 10 mins of cooking
10. Serve on top of piping hot rice

title: powdered sugar cinnamon spiced butter for toast bagels  pancakes
steps:
1. In mixing bowl add butter , sugar , cinnamon and evaporated milk
2. Stir
3. Add salt and water
4. Mix
5. Add variations if desired
6. Variations: use splenda instead powdered sugar , use cinnamon and nutmeg together
7. If there is any left , refrigerate

title: easy lemon meringue ice cream
steps:
1. In a bowl mix the custard with the single cream
2. Whip the double cream until it forms soft peaks , then stir in the lemon juice and zest
3. Fold this into the custard mixture
4. Pour into the icecream machine with the motor running and churn according to the manufacturer
5. When ready fold in the meringues gently and spoon into a container and freeze
6. Remove from the freezer about 30 minutes before serving and scopp into nice decorative glasses or ice cream cones

title: barbecue salmon
steps:
1. Combine all marinade ingredients , bring to boil for 4 minutes and then allow to cool
2. Cover salmon with as much marinade as you require
3. Cover in foil and marinade for as long as you desire
4. Remove from foil
5. Then cook on a barbeque until done to your liking
6. Heat remaining marinade and pour over cooked salmon

title: yorkshire tea loaf with mixed spice  cherries and raisins
steps:
1. Weigh out the currants and raisins and place into a large bowl
2. Pour on the hot tea , cover the bowl with plastic wrap and leave to steep for 12 hours or overnight
3. The next day , the fruit will be very plump and juicy looking
4. Some tea will still remain in the bowl which is fine
5. Grease a 2 lb
6. Loaf tin and preheat the oven to 150c / 300f
7. Cut the cherries into halves or thirds , depending on size , and add to the soaked raisins along with the sugar and spice
8. Stir until mostly dissolved
9. Add the eggs and mix well until evenly combined
10. Scatter the flour over the surface of the mixture
11. Using a wooden spoon , start at the centre of the bowl and beat the flour into the mixture , working your way out towards the edge until everything is well incorporated
12. Pour the batter into the prepared tin and bake for 1 hour and 30 to 40 minutes until golden brown on top and a skewer inserted in the middle comes out relatively clean
13. Allow to cool for 15-20 minutes in the tin before turning out onto a wire rack to cool completely

title: mirj s ultra rich sweet challah
steps:
1. In the bowl of your mixer , or in large bowl , add the flour , brown sugar , eggs , salt and vanilla
2. Mix it around a bit
3. Melt the margarine , or heat the oil a bit in the microwave
4. Add it to the stuff in the bowl and start mixing
5. Toss in the yeast , keep mixing
6. If you are using an electric mixer , go slowly
7. If you are kneading by hand , you should get a good workout
8. Heat the soy milk until it's warm
9. It should not be boiling hot !
10. Slowly , with the mixer running , add the soy milk a little bit at a time , until the dough has reached the consistency of bread dough
11. It shouldn't be cakey and it shouldn't be too sticky
12. Knead the dough in the mixer for about 7-8 minutes , or by hand for about 15 minutes
13. Place the bowl in a warm spot and let the dough rise until doubled in bulk
14. Hint: if you put the bowl of dough in the microwave and nuke it on high for 10 seconds it will speed up the rising process
15. You can also let it rise overnight in the fridge , just keep it in a knotted plastic bag so it doesn't"escape"
16. When the dough has risen and doubled , punch it down
17. It's a very satisfying step !
18. Knead the dough by hand for another minute or so to work out the air bubbles
19. Cut into three even pieces
20. Each piece is enough for one small loaf of challah
21. Cut each piece into three or four , roll into ropes and braid
22. The best braids are made by starting in the middle and working your way to the end , then turn it around and braid the other end
23. Pinch off the ends
24. After you have shaped your loaf , place it either in a greased loaf pan , cake pan , or just on a greased cookie sheet
25. If you bake your loaf on a sheet it will spread a bit as it rises again
26. If you put your braided loaf into a loaf tin , it will just rise upwards
27. I have also made round challahs by putting them into bundt pans , or fluted round cake pans
28. Let the shaped loaves rise for another half an hour
29. You can brush a little beaten egg on the tops for a glaze , i prefer my challahs"naked"
30. Preheat the oven to 160 degrees c
31. Bake the loaves for about 30-40 minutes
32. Time will vary based on the shape of your loaves and the pans they are in
33. If the tops start to brown too soon , just place a sheet of silver foil over them , resting lightly on the tops
34. The challah is done when you turn out the loaf , give it a knock-knock on the bottom and it sounds hollow
35. Let it cool
36. If this recipe makes too much for you , you can either freeze the dough , or the baked challahs
37. Best eaten with sweet butter , also makes the most amazing french toast

title: fried banana dessert
steps:
1. Peel the two bananas
2. Take two pieces of spring roll sheet and lay it on a flat surface on top of each other
3. Roll the spring roll sheet on the banana
4. Now do the same thing for the next banana
5. Take a big frying pan and pour some oil in it
6. When it is warm enough put the bananas in and fry until golden brown
7. Serve with some honey and other toppings that you like

title: floating chilli soy dipping sauce
steps:
1. Mix all the ingredients together well and serve
2. The chilli flakes ae optional , but look and taste wonderful

title: breaded parmesan pork cutlets
steps:
1. Wisk eggs in a bowl to blend , place bread crumbs in another bowl , and the cheese in another
2. Sprinkle the cutlets with salt and pepper
3. Coat chops generously with the cheese , patting to adhere
4. Dip the cutlets in the egg , then coat with the bread crumbs , patting to adhere
5. Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat
6. Add pork cutlets , reduce heat , flipping occasionally cook until golden and crispy
7. Place the cutlets in a cookie sheet and bake at 400 for 30 minutes , flipping halfway through

title: goat cheese with paprika  garlic  sun dried tomatoes and capers
steps:
1. Remove goat cheese from refrigerator , unwrap and let it to warm to room temperature
2. Heat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit and place the garlic cloves , unpeeled , on a pan and drizzle a small amount of olive oil over the top
3. Place in hot oven and roast until garlic is soft , about 15 minutes
4. Remove and allow to cool
5. Add the paprika to the goat cheese
6. Skin and add roasted garlic to the cheese
7. Add olive oil and mix
8. The cheese will turn a pinkish-orange color
9. Cut baguette into slices about a 1 / 3-inch thick
10. Spread cheese mixture on each slice
11. Place sun-dried tomatoes and a caper or two onto each slice of bread

title: oriental vegetable and pasta salad no  2
steps:
1. Cook pasta , cover and chill
2. In a saucepan , cook asparagus , covered , in a small amount of boiling water 4-6 minutes or until crisp tender and drain
3. Stir together plum sauce , soy sauce , oil and red pepper
4. In a bowl combine pasta , asparagus , sweet pepper , oranges , peas , onion and almonds
5. Add dressing and toss to coat
6. Serve immediately

title: new and different  taco salad
steps:
1. Fry and drain 1 pound of ground beef
2. Put beef back in pan and add taco seasoning and water
3. Cook until no longer watery
4. Chop up lettuce really fine
5. Dice 2 tomatoes
6. Put all ingredients in a big bowl
7. Add a small bag of fritos regular chips
8. Add big bag of shredded cheddar cheese
9. Add one chopped green onion
10. Add one big bottle catalina french dressing
11. Mix well

title: pasta croquettes
steps:
1. Cook noodles according to package directions
2. Drain well
3. Meanwhile , melt butter in medium sauce pan
4. Add green onions and saute until softened
5. Stir in flour , salt and white pepper and cook until bubbly
6. Stir in milk and cook stirring constantly , until thickened and bubbly
7. Stir in parmesan cheese until melted , then stir a little of the mixture into the beaten egg
8. Add egg mixture back to pan annd bring just to the boiling point
9. Add sauce to drained noodles
10. Mix thoroughly
11. Press mixture into a well-greased 9-inch square pan
12. Place a square of aluminumfoil over the top , pressing down on it to pack noodles
13. Chill until cold , several hours or overnight
14. Before serving , place flour egg-water mixture and panko crumbs in separate shallow dishes
15. Heat oil to 375
16. Cut chilled noodle mixture into squares
17. Coat with flour , then with egg mixture , then with panko crumbs , covering all sides thoroughly
18. Fry squares in hot oil , 1 or 2 at a time , until golden brown and heated through , 2-3 minutes
19. Drain on paper towels
20. Serve hot
21. Additional toppings can be used after cooked
22. Add a slice of provolone cheese to top immediately after it is cooked so it melts
23. Add bolognese sauce
24. Or , just eat it plain
25. It awesome all on it's own !

title: sweet potato bread
steps:
1. Peel and dice the potatoes , then boil them for about 15 minutes or until tender
2. Drain , and then mash thoroughly
3. Leave to cool
4. Sift the flour and salt into a bowl , then add the yeast , caraway seeds and black pepper
5. Add the sweet potato and rub it in well
6. Add enough water to make a soft dough , and knead until smooth and elastic
7. Leave the dough in a warm place until doubled in size
8. Knock back the dough on a floured surface and knead again briefly
9. Place in a greased loaf tin and leave to rise again for another 30 minutes
10. Preheat the oven to 200c / 400f / gas mark 6 and bake the loaf for 30-35 minutes until the bread is risen , golden brown and sounds hollow when tapped underneath

title: pepperoni ziti casserole
steps:
1. Cook pasta until just tender
2. Cook ground beef until no longer pink , drain
3. Transfer meat to a large bowl
4. Add 29 oz tomato sauce , 1 c mozzarella cheese , mushrooms , spinach , ricotta cheese , italian seasoning , garlic , garlic powder , red pepper flakes and pepper
5. Fold pasta into meat mixture
6. Pour into crockpot
7. Combine water and remaining tomato sauce and pour over pasta mixture
8. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese and remaining mozzerella cheese
9. Top with pepperoni
10. Cover and bake on low for 5 to 6 hours

title: middle eastern   twice baked potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 200c
2. Wash the potatoes to remove any dirt , pat dry with paper towels
3. Prick the potatoes all over with a fork , brush with olive oil and season to taste with salt and pepper
4. Place the potatoes on a lightly greased baking tray and bake for about an hour or until cooked through
5. Cool for about 10 minutes
6. While the potatoes are roasting , drain the chickpeas , place in a large mixing bowl and mash with a fork
7. Add the ground coriander , the cumin , the crushed garlic and half the fresh coriander
8. Cover the bowl with with plastic wrap , and set aside
9. Once they have cooled , taking care to keep the shells intact , halve the cooked potatoes and scoop out the flesh
10. Mash the potato flesh until smooth and gently mix with the chickpea mixture
11. Fold in the yoghurt and tahini , and add a little more of either of these if the mixture seems too dry , season with the pepper and salt , to taste
12. Place the potato shells on a lightly greased baking tray and fill them with the potato and chickpea mixture
13. Place the filled potato shells in the oven and bake for 10-15 minutes , or until heated through
14. Serve the potatoes with the remaining half of the chopped coriander

title: chicken breasts w mushrooms   caramelized onions
steps:
1. Season chicken breasts with seasoned salt and pepper
2. Heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a skillet then add the breasts
3. Brown the breasts on medium heat on both sides , transfer to a baking dish and put into a 350f oven to finish cooking
4. In the same skillet add another tbsp of oil and add the onions
5. Saut until translucent
6. Add a couple teaspoons of sugar and the red wine and saut until the onions become caramelized
7. Set onions aside
8. Saut the mushrooms in the skillet
9. Remove the breasts from the oven and spoon some of the caramelized onions atop each one , then spoon some sauted mushrooms on each
10. Finally , sprinkle some blue cheese over the mushrooms and place under the broiler for a couple minutes until the cheese becomes slightly browned
11. Serve the breasts on a nest of angel hair pasta or bed of wild rice or couscous

title: pina colada mini muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Spray 24 mini muffin cups with cooking spray
3. Combine first 5 dry ingredients
4. Beat remaining ingredients together in large bowl until smooth
5. Add dry ingredients , mixing just until moistened
6. Fill greased muffin cups
7. Bake at 350f for 18 - 23 minutes , or until golden

title: applesauce bread with apple butter
steps:
1. For the cake: cream the butter until soft anf fluffy
2. Gradually add sugar and beat until it is light
3. In another bowl , combine the flour , baking soda , salt , and spices
4. Slowly add flour mixture and warm applesauce to sugar mixture and blend well if desired , mix in the raisins and nuts
5. Pour into a loaf pan
6. Bake at 350 for 60-75 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean
7. Chill before slicing
8. Serve with apple butter
9. For the apple butter: combine the ingredients in a saucepan
10. Bring to a boil and simmer for 1 hour , stirring occasionally
11. Cool and spread on slices of cake

title: 5 can casserole
steps:
1. Drain canned chicken , then place in 1 1 / 2 quart casserole dish and break apart with a fork
2. Add the rest of the ingredients and mix together well
3. Bake at 350 degrees fahrenheit for 25 minutes or so until lightly browned

title: vanilla buttermilk panna cotta
steps:
1. Sprinkle gelatine over cold water in small bowl or measuring cup until softened
2. Heat on stovetop or in microwave until it dissolves
3. Mix with remaining ingredients
4. Pour into eight dessert bowls
5. Chill until firm

title: rich and creamy chicken or turkey tetrazzini
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. In a skillet melt 2 tablespoons butter and saut the mushrooms and onions until soft
3. Remove from pan and set aside
4. Melt the remaining 3 tablespoons butter and stir in 2 tablespoons flour
5. Cook over medium heat for 1 to 2 minutes to make a roux , stirring constantly
6. Add chicken broth and garlic and cook over low heat for 1 minute
7. Stir in the sherry and 3 / 4 of the parmesan cheese
8. Add the sauted onions / mushrooms and stir until cheese melts , then stir in the cream or half and half
9. Combine the sauce , cooked and cut-up chicken or turkey , and cooked spaghetti noodles in a large bowl , then spread the mixture into a lightly-buttered / oiled large casserole
10. Bake for 30 minutes or until the top begins to brown
11. Combine the remaining parmesan with the bread crumbs , then sprinkle it over the casserole and bake for 5 minutes longer
12. Adapted from a post by peggy at gail's recipe swap , who got it from gourmet magazine
13. Pat-nocals
14. I didnt have pimientos so i sauteed some red bell pepper with the mushrooms
15. Recipe is easily halved
16. Next time i might use slightly less spaghetti for better sauce coverage
17. Nlbs
18. I only tweaked this recipe a teensy bit by putting one smashed clove of garlic in the sauce , using roasted red peppers , and medium egg noodles instead of spaghetti
19. I used the madeira too and it adds a great dimension to this delicious sauce

title: will s guacamole
steps:
1. Remove skins and pits from avocadoes and place into a bowl
2. Smash with back of a fork and add remaining ingredients
3. Combine and season to taste with salt
4. Enjoy with tortilla chips

title: easy frosty sherbet punch
steps:
1. Thoroughly chill juice and ginger ale
2. Empty juices and ale in large punch bowl
3. Add sherbet

title: pickled cucumber dipping sauce
steps:
1. Combine the vinegar , water and sugar in a medium saucepan over low heat
2. Cook , stirring , for 2 minutes or until the sugar dissolves
3. Increase heat to high and bring to the boil
4. Cook for 5 minutes or until the syrup thickens
5. Set aside for 10 minutes to cool
6. Transfer to a bowl
7. Add the cucumber and chili and combine
8. Cover and place in the fridge for 1 hour to chill

title: 3 alarm chili
steps:
1. Brown the meat in a large skillet
2. Once cooked through , add the onions , tomatoes , garlic , and a tablespoon of canola oil
3. Saute until the onions are slightly browned or colored by the tomatoes
4. Add the seasonings
5. Cook two minutes ensuring that everything is coated by the seasonings
6. In a large sauce or soup pot , pour the can of chicken broth inches
7. Carefully remove the browned meat mixture and gently pour into the canned broth
8. Set on medium- high heat
9. Stir in the jalepeno and bay leaves and the two tablespoons of red pepper paste
10. Cover and let boil five to ten minutes
11. Turn down heat and cook for about 30 minutes
12. Side

title: frankenberry oatmeal
steps:
1. Mix all the ingredients together in a microwave-safe bowl
2. Nuke on high for about 1-2 minutes
3. Mix again , let it thicken upon standing , and enjoy !

title: ground beef and texas bean enchiladas
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Combine in large skillet ground beef , onion , garlic , salt and pepper
3. Cook until beef is browned
4. Drain grease
5. Return to skillet and add tomatoes , peppers or canned chilies , and beans
6. Reduce heat , cover and simmer while preparing the sauce , stirring frequently
7. Prepare the sauce by mixing all ingredients in medium bowl with a wire whisk until butter has melted
8. Add salt and pepper to taste
9. Add about 1 / 2 cup sauce to meat mixture
10. Turn off heat
11. Dip each tortilla into the enchilada sauce coating thoroughly
12. Lay the soaked tortilla in your baking pan and add one serving spoon of the meat mixture lengthwise along one end of tortilla then roll it up from there
13. When done rolling each one make sure to place it so that open end of tortilla is on the bottom to avoid spillage
14. Repeat with all tortillas
15. Add remaining meat mixture and remaining sauce evenly on top of enchiladas
16. Cover with aluminum foil and bake 15 minutes
17. Remove from oven , remove foil , cover with grated cheese and return to oven for 5 minutes uncovered , or until all cheese has melted
18. For easiest serving , slice enchiladas in half lengthwise down the pan
19. Serve with rice , sour cream , guacamole , and your favorite corn chips

title: yellow cake light
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Spray bottoms only of 2 round cake pans , dust with flour & set aside
3. Beat sugar , softened butter & vanilla with electric mixer at medium speed until very well blended
4. Add eggs , one at a time , beating well after each addition
5. Mix flour , baking powder and salt together
6. Add flour mixture to sugar mixture alternately with milk , beginning and ending with flour mixture
7. Divide the thick batter into the 2 prepared pans , spreading as evenly as possible
8. Sharply tap pans on counter before placing in 350f oven
9. Bake 30-35 minutes or until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean
10. Cool in pans on wire racks 10 minutes , remove from pans , cool completely on racks
11. Place 1 cake layer on serving plate , frost with about 1 / 2 cup frosting , top with remaining layer , frost sides and top

title: kangaroo steaks with marinated mandarins
steps:
1. Marinate well-drained and patted dry mandarin segments in grand marnier for as long as possible , turning regularly
2. Drain liquid off mandarins and add liquid to all other marinade ingredients
3. Combine well and reduce by 50% if using fresh orange juice , otherwise leave as is
4. Cut kangaroo fillets into 20-25mm thick diagonal slices
5. Pat sliced kangaroo steaks dry and add half the marinade to a shallow dish
6. Add steaks& pour over remaining marinade and refrigerate turning occasionally
7. Remove steaks from refrigerator 2 hours before cooking and turn meat
8. Grill steaks for 10-15 minutes , until medium cooked do not overcook and toughen
9. Meanwhile , reduce leftover marinade in a pan on a low heat , and when reduced add marinated mandarin segments and toss lightly
10. Heat through and serve over steaks with boiled rice and a side salad of 3 or 4 different lettuces
11. Make a dressing of balsamic vinegar , lemon juice and concentrated orange juice , seasoned with freshly crushed pepper and a little grand marnier
12. Serve with a gutsy aussie red

title: spinach enchiladas with cilantro cream sauce
steps:
1. Cilantro cream sauce: puree garlic with salt
2. Combine sour cream , onion , cilantro and sugar
3. Add garlic mixture and stir gently to blend well in a pan saute onions in olive oil until onions are translucent
4. Add spinach and cook 5 to 10 minutes
5. Stir 1 cup of sauce into spinach mixture
6. Reserve 1 / 2 pound cheese for topping and divide remaining cheese into 10 parts
7. Put a portion of cheese on a tortilla , top with about 1 / 2 cup of the spinach mixture and more cheese on top of spinach
8. Roll tortilla , tuck ends underneath and place on a baking pan
9. Continue until all are gone
10. Cover each tortilla with a ladle of sauce and sprinkle reserved cheese on top
11. Bake in a preheated 375 degree oven 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown
12. Serve with extra sauce

title: mexican coffee  caf mexicano
steps:
1. Place kahla , brandy , chocolate syrup and cinnamon in a coffee cup or mug
2. Fill with hot coffee
3. Stir to blend
4. Top with sweetened whipped cream

title: fusilli with asparagus basil and balsamic glaze
steps:
1. Bring 4 qt water to boil adding salt and pasta
2. Cook al dente
3. Drain and return to pot
4. Right before putting pasta in boiling water bring balsamic vinegar to boil in 8 in skillet over med heat
5. Reduce heat to medium and simmer slowly until syrupy and reduced to 1 / 4 c 15-20 minutes
6. While pasta is cooking and balsamic is reducing heat 2 tbsp oil in 12 in skillet over high heat until beginning to smoke
7. Cut asparagus in 1 in lengths discarding the bottom 1 inch
8. Add asparagus onion black and red pepper 1 / 2 tsp salt and stir to combine
9. Cook without stirring until asparagus begins to brown about 1 minute then stir and continue cooking
10. Stir occasionally until asparagus is tender-crisp about 4 min longer
11. Add asparagus , basil , lemon juice , 1 / 2 romano , and remaining 3 tbsp oil to pasta in stockpot toss to combine
12. Serve immediately , drizzling 1-2 tsp balsamic glaze over individual servings and sprinkle cheese accordingly

title: oxtail casserole
steps:
1. Brown meat all over in a little oil , in a large pot
2. Add onion and carrot and stir through oil
3. Add crushed garlic , stock , tomatoes and paste , sugar , bouquet garni and salt and pepper
4. Cook on low for about 2 hours
5. Leave to cool , skim off fat
6. Thicken with cornflour mixed with a little water
7. Meat can be removed from bones , just reheat after you take off the fat , and pick up each bone with tongs , the meat will just fall off
8. If it doesn't , it ain't cooked
9. Serve with mashed potatoes and greens

title: french toast scones
steps:
1. Mix the flour , baking powder , salt , and sugar together
2. Cut in the butter
3. A food processor works best , but doing by hand will work too
4. Just make sure there is no chunks of butter left over after cutting into mixture
5. And then put the flour mixure in a large bowl
6. Mix cinnamon chips into the flour mixture
7. Whisk together the milk , egg , butter flavoring , maple flavoring , and maple syrup in separate bowl then add to flour mixture , mix together
8. If the mixture is to thin add a little flour till it is a consistency you can work with
9. Take out of bowl and make into a ball , flatten to were it is about an inch thick
10. Cut into about 12 or less pie type slices and put onto a lightly greased cookie sheet
11. Cook at 450 for 12-15 minutes

title: hearty maine bread
steps:
1. Load all of the above ingredients in order wet to dry into bread machine
2. Press go

title: hamburger rice casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Boil 3 1 / 2 cups water
3. In a skillet , brown burger
4. Add butter , sugar , mushrooms , and rice to skillet
5. Put hamburger / rice mixture into a casserole dish or 9x13 dish
6. Top with boiled water
7. Cover and bake 30 minutes
8. Uncover and bake 30 more minutes

title: vegetarian mexican breakfast casserole
steps:
1. Saute onion and pepper in oil 2-3 minutes
2. Pour in eggs and cook until well scrambled
3. Stir in sour cream
4. Spread mixture in center of each tortilla , roll and place in a greased 13 x 9 inch baking dish
5. Spoon sauce over top and sprinkle with cheese
6. Bake at 350 degrees for 20-30 minutes
7. Serve with sliced avocados or guacamole , if desired

title: pork san choy bau
steps:
1. Heat oil in a wok and cook ginger , garlic and onions over medium heat for 1 minute
2. Add pork and chestnuts and cook over medium heat for 6-7 minutes
3. Stir in sauces and cook for a further 2 minutes
4. Serve in lettuce cups topped with bean sprouts and carrot

title: empanadas with ham  cheese and olives
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 f and lightly grease two baking trays
2. Combine olives , ham and cheddar in a bowl
3. Cut about five 4-inch rounds from each pastry sheet
4. Spoon a tablespoon of the filling into the center of each round , fold the pastry over and crimp the edges to seal
5. Place the pastries on the trays about 2 cm apart
6. Brush with the egg yolk and bake in the center or top half of oven for 15 minutes , or until well browned and puffed
7. Swap the trays around and cook another 10 minutes , covering loosely with foil if the empanadas start to brown too much
8. Serve hot

title: smoked sausage and cabbage
steps:
1. Cook sausage and onion in pan til brown , do not drain
2. Meanwhile , cover w / water and boil cabbage leaves til soft , 4-5 minutes
3. Cut up and add cabbage to sausage / onion mix and saute to let cabbage soak up everything
4. Stir frequently
5. Add lawry's , salt and pepper to taste

title: jellyfish
steps:
1. Pour amaretto into the bottom of a shooter glass
2. Using spoon , gently ladle creme de cocoa over amaretto
3. Gently ladle bailey's irish cream over the top of the cream de cocoa
4. Using a cocktail straw , release drops of grenadine syrup several inches over drink to splash down and sink , forming"tentacles"
5. Serve

title: chocolate cinnamon parfait
steps:
1. Whip cream until stiff peaks form
2. Transfer 1 / 3 of the whipped cream into another bowl , add cinnamon and stir to combine
3. Beat one egg yolk well
4. Measure sugar and water into a small saucepan and bring the mixture slowly to a boil , stirring
5. As soon as the the mixture begins to boil , remove from heat
6. Slowly pour half of the hot sugar-water mixture on the beaten egg yolk , stirring constantly
7. Allow the mixture to cool
8. Add the cinnamon-flavoured whipped cream to the egg-sugar mixture , stir to combine
9. Spoon the mixture into four small drinking glasses and place in the freezer
10. Melt chocolate in a water bath or microwave
11. Beat the remaining egg yolk well
12. Reheat the remaining sugar-water mixture , and slowly add it to the egg yolk , stirring constantly
13. Allow to cool
14. Add cocoa powder and melted chocolate to the mixture , stir
15. Add the remaining whipped cream , stir to combine
16. Spoon the mixture on top of the cinnamon parfait and return the glasses to the freezer until frozen and ready to serve
17. Bring to room temperature some 10 minutes before digging in

title: edamame dip alton brown
steps:
1. Put the edamame , onion , parsley , garlic , lime juice , miso , salt , chili sauce and pepper into a food processor and process for 15 seconds
2. Stop and scrape down the sides of the bowl and process for another 15-20 seconds
3. With the processor running , slowly drizzle in the extra virgin olive oil
4. Once all of the oil has been added , stop and scrape down the bowl again , then process 5-10 more seconds
5. Taste and adjust seasoning
6. Serve with chips , crackers , or carrots and any other veggies you like
7. Store in an airtight container for up to 5 days

title: authentic chocolate biscotti
steps:
1. Adjust rack to center position and heat the oven to 350 degree
2. Line a cookie sheet with wax or parchment paper
3. Place the flour , sugar , baking powder , salt and white chocolate chips in a large bowl and stir to combine
4. In a small bowl combine the eggs , butter and vanilla and whisk to fully combine
5. Make a well in the center of the dry ingredients and pour in the egg mixture
6. Using a rubber spatula , mix to combine until a rough dough forms
7. Don't be concerned if the dough is crumbly- this is typical of biscotti dough
8. It will come together in the next step
9. Dump the dough onto a work surface and knead a couple of times until the dough comes together , adding extra flour sparingly and only if necessary
10. Start to form the dough into a big , fat cigar and cut it in half
11. Form each half into a cigar about 1 inch thick , 2 inches wide and about 12 inches long
12. Place them onto the cookie sheet and lightly press with fingers to slightly flat cigars
13. Bake for 25 minutes reversing the pan halfway through
14. The bars will be firm to the touch and just slightly browned
15. Remove from the oven and lower the temperature to 300 degrees
16. Let the cookies cool on the cookie sheet for 15 minutes
17. Remove cookies to a cutting board using two spatulas
18. Using a serrated knife , slice the bars on an angle about 1 / 2 inch thick to form the biscotti
19. Lay them back on the cookie sheet with either cut side down and place back in oven for 12 minutes
20. Turn each cookie to expose the other cut side and place in oven for another 12 minutes
21. Let cool on a rack to room temperature
22. Place cookies in an airtight container

title: slow cooker  crock pot  pumpkin apple dessert
steps:
1. Spray 3 1 / 2- to 6-quart slow cooker with cooking spray
2. Spoon pie filling into cooker
3. Spread evenly
4. Beat remaining ingredients except ice cream with electric mixer on low speed 1 minute , scraping bowl constantly
5. Beat on medium speed 2 minutes , scraping bowl occasionally
6. Pour batter over pie filling
7. Cover and cook on high heat setting 1 hour 30 minutes to 2 hours or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
8. Serve with ice cream
9. For slow cookers with just a heated base , follow the manufacturers directions for layering ingredients and choosing a temperature

title: pan haggerty
steps:
1. Melt the fat over low heat in a heavy frying pan and make sure that it covers the entire surface of the pan
2. Fill the pan with alternate layers of potatoes , onions and cheese , beginning and ending with a layer of potatoes
3. Season each layer with a little salt and pepper
4. Fry gently for about 30 minutes , then broil for 5 to 10 minutes until the top is well browned
5. Serve straight from the frying pan

title: carrot and pink grapefruit soup
steps:
1. In a saucepan , melt the butter and add onion
2. Cook until the onions are softened
3. Deglaze with grapefruit juice
4. Add chicken stock , carrots and potatoes
5. Add salt and pepper to taste
6. Bring to boil and cook 20 to 25 minutes
7. Put the soup in the food processor until creamy
8. Incorporate the cream and serve

title: pumpkin cheesecake with bourbon spiked cream
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Combine the crumbs , pecans and butter together
3. Mix well and press into a 12 inch spring form pan
4. In a food processor mix cream cheese until smooth
5. Add brown sugar and blend
6. Add the eggs , one at a time , and thoroughly incorporate
7. Add the heavy cream , flour , salt , cinnamon and vanilla and blend until smooth
8. Add pumpkin and continue mixing until smooth
9. Pour into pan , place pan into a waterbath and bake for 1 hour and 15 minutes
10. While cake is baking , combine whipped cream and bourbon together
11. Allow cake to cool completely before removing spring form
12. Cut and garnish with spiked cream

title: amish sourdough bread starter
steps:
1. For starter , dissolve yeast in warm water
2. Mix with 1 cup flour , 1 cup sugar or honey and 1 cup milk
3. This is day 1 of 10 day prep
4. Use a plastic or glass container
5. Leave starter on the counter covered , and stir daily
6. On the 5th day , add 1 cup flour , 1 cup sugar or honey and 1 cup milk
7. This is called 'feeding' the starter
8. Continue to stir daily
9. On the 10th day , add 1 cup flour , 1 cup sugar or honey and 1 cup milk
10. Starter can now be divided and given away or frozen
11. I usually wait a day to bake after feeding starter
12. If you are not baking the next day , you can refrigerate starter , but bring to room temperature on baking day , or the night before , if frozen
13. If you receive a cup of starter as a gift , feed immediately and wait a day before baking , to give starter a chance to ferment , at room temperature
14. To bake: place 1 cup of starter in bowl of mixer
15. Put mixer on slow speed using a dough hook , and add all ingredients
16. All ingredients should be room temperature
17. Add 2-1 / 4 tsps
18. Yeast , 1 cup water , 1 cup milk , 2 tbls honey , 1 / 4 cup oil , 1 cup whole wheat flour , 2 eggs , 2 tsps
19. Salt , approximately 6-7 cups white flour
20. You can add more whole wheat and less white , as preferred
21. Knead dough for 10 minute in mixer
22. Dough should be slightly sticky , but smooth and shiny and should mostly all be on the dough hook when done
23. Remove dough from mixer bowl to a floured board and knead by hand two minutes , shaping into a large ball
24. Oil inside of mixer bowl
25. Place dough back into bowl , swirl around in oil , and turn over so all sides are oiled
26. Press down , cover with a clean towel and allow to rise in a warm place until doubled
27. Punch down and divide into two loaves
28. At this point , 1 ball can be made into 12-14 rolls
29. Divide into even balls , place on greased cookie sheet , pressing down to a flat disc
30. Brush tops with beaten egg white mixed with 1 tbl water and sprinkle with sesame or poppy seeds , if desired
31. Cover and allow to rise for 1 hour , or until double in size
32. Preheat oven to 375 and bake rolls for 15-20 minutes , until browned
33. For loaf of bread flatten 1 / 2 of dough into a rectangle , to remove bubbles and roll up to a log
34. Roll two sides under and place log seam side down in greased loaf pan
35. Brush top with egg white and sprinkle with seeds
36. Bake at 375 for 25 minutes
37. Remove from pan and thump bottom of loaf
38. It should sound hollow when done
39. You can bake 1 / 2 of dough and shape other half into a loaf , wrap tightly in plastic wrap and freeze
40. When you are ready to bake , remove from wrap and place in greased loaf pan
41. Cover and allow to defrost and rise in a warm spot
42. Brush with egg white and sprinkle with seeds
43. Bake as usual

title: butter chicken   murg makhani
steps:
1. Preparation
2. Place in a bowl 2 tablespoons of yoghurt , the tandoori masala and salt , mix well and add the chicken , ensure the chicken is coated well and evenly
3. Cover and leave in the fridge for 2 days to marinate
4. Preparation
5. Mince the garlic and onion into a paste
6. Liquidise the chopped tomatoes
7. Melt the butter in a large deep saucepan
8. Gently fry the onion paste for about 1 minute , add all the remaining powdered ingredients and the coriander and stir well
9. Add the tomato paste , tomato puree and chicken stock and stir well allow to simmer for 10 minutes
10. Add the marinated chicken and simmer for 5 more minutes
11. Add the cream , yoghurt , powdered almonds and cinnamon stick and stir well
12. Allow to simmer gently stirring regularly for 30 minutes taste check and if required remove the cinnamon stick
13. Remove from heat and place in a ovenproof dish
14. Place in the over at 200c for a further 20-25 minutes stirring regularly
15. Serve on pilau rice
16. This dish is best and usually served at weddings and special events due to the prohibitive cost of making it in india
17. However we are able to enjoy it at anytime
18. The sauce will freeze and keep for up to a month , and this is very fattening ! but delicious

title: snoopy thanksgiving
steps:
1. Toast bread in toaster
2. Butter toast , stack high
3. In large pot , over medium high heat , melt coconut oil
4. Add in popcorn kernels and cover
5. Shake pot virgorously
6. When popping begins , lift cover off just a smidge so steam escapes but popcorn does not
7. When popping slows to 1 kernel per second , remove from heat
8. Add salt and pour into a large bowl
9. Add butter if desired
10. Enjoy !

title: bacardi rum cake
steps:
1. Sprinkle nuts over bottom of greased 10 inch tube pan or 12 cup bundt pan
2. Stir together cake mix , pudding mix , eggs , water , oil and rum
3. Pour batter over nuts
4. Bake at 325 in oven for 1 hour
5. Cool 10 minutes in pan
6. Invert onto serving plate and prick top
7. Glaze-----------------
8. Melt butter in saucepan
9. Stir in water and sugar
10. Boil 5 minutes , stirring constantly
11. Remove from heat
12. Stir in rum
13. Brush glaze evenly over top and sides of cake
14. Allow cake to absorb glaze
15. Repeat until glaze is used up

title: easy cajun chicken caesar salad
steps:
1. Cook bacon over medium high heat in a large skillet until evenly brown
2. Let cool slightly , then crumble and set aside
3. In a preheated skillet , add the chicken strips , seasoning mix and oil
4. Cook over medium heat until chicken is golden brown
5. Remove from heat and set aside
6. In a large salad bowl , combine the romaine , enough salad dressing to lightly coat , parmesan cheese , and the crumbled bacon
7. Toss and place on individual salad plates
8. Top with the sliced chicken and serve

title: cocoa nut bread
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350
2. Grease and flour loaf pan
3. In large bowl combine all ingredients except nuts
4. Beat with spoon 30 seconds , stir in nuts
5. Pour into prepared pan
6. Bake 70 minutes or until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean
7. Cool 10 minutes , remove from pan
8. Wrap tightly in foil
9. Cool completely

title: natalia s lasagna
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees
2. Generously oil a 9x13 baking dish
3. Use a dutch oven to cook the sausage , ground beef , onions and garlic until the meat is browned
4. Once the meat is browned add the crushed tomatoes , paste , sauce along with all the seasonings except the sugar and 1 tablespoon of parsley
5. Add the sugar one tablespoon at at time and at this point taste the sauce to see if the sugar is to your liking and not too sweet
6. Simmer the sauce for about 45 minutes or long enough for all seasonings to combine well
7. While the sauce is simmering , in a small mixing bowl beat the egg with the cottage cheese and add the remaining 1 tablespoon of parsley
8. Noodles can be rinsed with hot water just until softened or cook noodles according to package directions-rinse with cool water and drain well
9. Layer the lasagna as follows: bottom layer meat sauce , 6 noodles , 1 / 2 cottage cheese mixture , 1 / 2 mozzarella cheese , meat sauce and 1 / 2 parmesan cheese
10. Second set of layers: remaining noodles , remaining cottage cheese mixture , more meat sauce , the rest of the parmesan cheese and top with the remaining mozzarella cheese
11. Bake the lasagna for 25 minutes covered
12. After 25 minutes remove the foil and cook an additional 25 minutes or until the cheese on top is completely melted
13. Remove from the oven and allow 15 minutes rest time before serving
14. Enjoy !

title: texas ranch potato salad
steps:
1. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil
2. Add whole potatoes , and cook until tender , 15 to 20 minutes
3. Drain , run under cold water to cool , and chop into 1 inch cubes
4. Transfer to a large serving bowl , and refrigerate until completely chilled , about 2 hours
5. In a small bowl , stir together the ranch dressing mix , mayonnaise and green onion
6. Cover , and refrigerate for about 2 hours to blend flavors
7. Fry bacon until crunchy , drain fat & cool
8. Mix eggs and celery into the bowl of potatoes , then stir the mayonnaise mixture until well distributed
9. Crumble bacon into the bowl , and stir
10. Serve

title: top hat    shooters
steps:
1. Fill each shot glass 2 / 3 full of kahlua
2. Very slowly pour in enough heavy cream to top off the glass
3. Serve immediately

title: green bean salad with radishes and prosciutto
steps:
1. Cook beans in a large pot of salted water until crisp-tender , about 4-5 minutes
2. Drain well and cool
3. Whisk sherry , mustard , and chives , then gradually whisk in the oil
4. Season with salt and pepper
5. Toss beans , radishes , and prosciutto , then toss with enough dresing to coat
6. Using a vegetable peeler , shave parmesan or reggiatto on top of salad

title: yah mon  jerked turkey jerky
steps:
1. Combine marinade ingredients in a plastic zipper bag
2. Add turkey slices and coat thoroughly with marinade
3. Refrigerate overnight
4. If you have a dehydrator , use it
5. I use my oven
6. It only goes down to 170 degrees f
7. Cover oven rack with aluminum foil then preheat to 170 degrees
8. Place marinated turkey breast strips on baking racks and place racks in the oven
9. Prop open oven door slightly with an oven mitt to allow humidity to escape
10. Check turkey after about 4 hours
11. Mine takes between 4 and 4-1 / 2 hours in a 170 degree f oven

title: breakfast taquitos
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees f
2. Add sausage links to a large skillet and cook over medium-high until heated through and browned on all sides , about 8 minutes
3. Set aside
4. Add eggs to a medium bowl and whisk until combined
5. Season with salt and pepper
6. Spray a non-stickpan with cooking spray and add eggs to pan , stirring with a rubber spatula until just about set , 2 minutes
7. Add the chopped cilantro and cook until eggs are just set , about a minute more
8. Transfer to a bowl
9. Warm the tortillas for 10 seconds in the microwave
10. Divide the eggs amongst the tortillas and top with shredded cheese
11. Place sausage link on top
12. Roll up and place seam side down on a parchment-lined sheet tray
13. Spray with cooking spray and bake until golden brown , about 15 minutes
14. Serve with salsa , hot sauce , or sour cream

title: out of milk coffee cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f grease 9-inch-square baking pan
2. For crumb topping:
3. Combine nuts , granulated sugar , brown sugar , flour , cinnamon and butter in medium bowl
4. Mix with fork until mixture resembles coarse crumbs
5. For cake:
6. Whisk together water and coffee-mate in small bowl until smooth
7. Combine flour , granulated sugar , baking powder , salt , cinnamon and butter in large mixer bowl
8. Beat by hand or on low speed with an electric mixer until flour is coated with the butter
9. Stir egg into butter-flour mixture
10. Gradually stir in coffee-mate mixture
11. Spoon half of batter into prepared pan
12. Sprinkle half of crumb topping over batter
13. Spoon remaining batter over crumb topping
14. Sprinkle with remaining crumb topping
15. Bake for 30 minutes or until wooden pick inserted near center comes out clean
16. Cool in pan on wire rack for 15 minutes before cutting
17. Best served warm

title: delicious and spicy  who needs meat  vegetarian taco casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f combine refried beans , black beans , kidney beans , corn , salsa , habanero sauce , chili flakes , and half of grated cheese
2. Chop up half the jalapenos and stir inches transfer mixture to microwave proof oven dish and cover with microwavefoil
3. Microwave on high for about 8-10 minutes until hot and bubbly
4. Put remaining jalapenos on top , sprinkle remaining cheese over dish , sprinkle scallions and olives
5. Transfer to preheated oven until cheese is melted
6. Sprinkle tomatoes and chopped coriander on top
7. Wait 5 minutes and serve with nacho chips

title: famous fudge
steps:
1. Line 8 inch square baking pan with foil
2. Combine sugar , evaporated milk , butter and salt in medium saucepan
3. Bring to a full rolling boil over medium heat , stirring constantly
4. Boil , stirring constantly , for 4 to 5 minutes
5. Remove from heat
6. Stir in marshmallows , morsels , vanilla extract and nuts , if desired
7. Stir vigorously for 1 minute or until marshmallows are melted
8. Pour into prepared baking pan: refrigerate for 2 hours or until firm
9. Lift from pan: remove foil
10. Cut into pieces for milk chocolate fudge: substitute 1 3 / 4 cups milk chocolate morsels for semi-sweet morsels for butterscotch fudge: substitute 1 2 / 3 cups butterscotch-flavored morsels for semi-sweet morsels
11. For peanutty chocolate fudge: substitute 1 2 / 3 cups peanut butter and milk chocolate morsels for semi-sweet morsels and 1 / 2 cup chopped peanuts for pecans or walnuts

title: quick prune bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 f
2. Sift flour
3. Measure
4. Add baking powder , soda , cinnamon , salt and sugar
5. Sift again , add whole wheat flour and mix thoroughly
6. Combine egg , sour milk or buttermilk , prunes , prune juice and melted shortening or butter
7. Pour into flour mixture and stir just enough to moisten the dry ingredients
8. Do not beat
