9. Turn into a greased loaf pan and bake for about an hour , until a knife comes out clean when inserted in the middle
10. Bring to a boil and boil briskly for 45 minutes to 1 hour
11. Sweeten to taste by adding up to 1 / 4 cup of sugar for every 1 cup of prunes in the last 5 minutes of cooking

title: lacy potato kugel
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 500 degrees
2. Saute diced onion until nicely caramelized and golden
3. While onion is caramelizing , grate potatoes using the fine disc in the food processor
4. Squeeze out liquid and place in a large mixing bowl
5. Process onions and pour the onion pulp and juices into the bowl with the potatoes
6. Stir in eggs , 5 tbsp
7. Oil , salt , pepper and caramelized onions
8. Sprinkle starch on top
9. Pour boiling water over starch and stir thoroughly
10. Pour 1 / 4 cup of oil into a 9x13 baking pan and heat in oven for about a minute
11. Do not allow oil to burn
12. Carefully pour mixture into pan and bake for 20 minutes
13. After 20 minutes , reduce heat to 400 degrees and bake for 40 minutes or until the top is a deep golden brown

title: bacon and vegetable pasta bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 200c
2. Grease a 6cm deep , 28cm x 35cm baking dish
3. Cook pasta to packet directions in lots of salted water
4. Meanwhile , cook bacon under grill until brown and almost crispy , chop and set aside
5. Add zucchini , carrot and celery to a microwave safe bowl with a dash of water , cover and microwave on high for 4 - 5 minutes or until carrot is tender
6. Drain pasta and return to the pot
7. Add zucchini , carrot , celery , mushrooms , capsicum , baby spinach , bacon and passata and stir to combine
8. Add to greased baking dish and top with cheese
9. Bake for 25-30 minutes or until golden
10. Serve with salad and garlic bread if you have the time or inclination

title: mustard and herb marinade
steps:
1. Combine all in a bowl and mix well
2. Use to marinate beef or lamb

title: lemon parsley chicken rice
steps:
1. In a skillet , melt butte and oil over medium heat
2. Saut chicken until no pink remains
3. Add rice , water , lemon juice and rosemary
4. Bring to a boil
5. Reduce heat , cover and simmer about 4 minutes
6. Add spinach leaves , recover and simmer 6 minutes
7. Take off the heat , stir in cream and parsley

title: easy cinnamon biscuits
steps:
1. Combine flour , baking powder and salt
2. Cut in shortening
3. Add milk
4. Stir with fork just until dough leaves sides of bowl
5. Roll dough out , on lightly floured surface , into a 1 / 4 inch thick rectangle
6. Brush top with butter
7. Combine cinnamon and sugar
8. Sprinkle evenly over dough
9. Roll up , starting on long side
10. Cut into 1 / 2 inch thick rounds
11. Place rounds , with sides just touching , in greased 9" round pan
12. Bake at 425'f for 18-20 minutes or until golden brown
13. Remove from oven and drizzle with glaze , serve warm
14. Glaze: combine all ingredients and beat until smooth

title: neely s bbq nachos
steps:
1. Pile chips on a platter
2. Cover chips with heated chopped meat , heated barbecue sauce and hot melted nacho cheese sauce
3. Sprinkle with spicy bbq seasoning or sliced chilies or jalapenos if you like

title: kashmiri rogan josh  indian mutton  lamb curry
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large saucepan
2. Add cinnamon stick and cloves
3. After a second , add asafoetida , meat and salt
4. Saute for 5 minutes
5. Add paprika and cayenne pepper
6. Stir
7. Add yoghurt gradually
8. Stir till all the liquid evaporates and the meat turns brown in color
9. Add fennel and ginger powders
10. Stir
11. Add water or broth , cover partly and cook on medium heat for 30 minutes
12. Cover completely and cook on low heat for another 30 minutes or until the meat is tender
13. Stir the meat from time to time as it cooks
14. Uncover and add the garam masala powder
15. If the gravy is too thin , let it boil till it thickens to the desired consistency
16. Serve hot

title: salmon   vegetable loaf
steps:
1. Heat oil in pan and cook onion and peppers 2-3mins till onion softens
2. Combine
3. Salmon , breadcrumbs , chives , parsley and onion mixture in a bowl
4. Season lightly with pepper
5. Fold egg whites in lightly
6. Spoon into lightly greased and lined loaf tin
7. Bake 350f 45 mins or till firm
8. Stand 10 mins before turning out
9. Cut into slices to serve

title: lisa s borscht
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large pot and brown beef in two batches , sprinkling each batch with 1 / 2 teaspoon salt
2. With a slotted spoon , transfer beef to a bowl and set aside
3. In the same pot , melt butter and add onion and 1 / 2 teaspoon salt
4. Cook , stirring , until onions are soft , about 3 minutes
5. Add half of the garlic and cook until fragrant , about 2 minutes
6. Add reserved beef , beef broth , bay leaves and 2 cups water
7. Bring to a boil
8. Lower heat , cover and simmer until beef is tender , about 1 hour
9. Add beets and cook 10 minutes
10. Then add carrots and potatoes and cook until tender , about 10 minutes
11. Add cabbaqe and remaining garlic and cook until cabbage is wilted , about 5 minutes
12. Stir in lemon juice and season with salt and pepper to taste
13. Serve with sour cream to dollop into the borscht

title: to die for dip
steps:
1. Mix cheeses , mayonnaise , and onions
2. Put in a baking dish , top with bacon bits and crumbled ritz crackers
3. Bake in microwave for 5 minutes or in the oven at 350f for about 15 , just to warm through

title: chicken diane
steps:
1. Add half of the butter to hot skillet and brown chicken breasts , do not fully cook
2. Remove chicken to a plate and reserve for later
3. Add the rest of the butter to the skillet and saut onions and parsley till the onions are translucent ,
4. Add sherry , steak sauce , mustard and worcestershire to the onions and parsley
5. Stir together thoroughly
6. Add chicken breasts to the sauce
7. Turn to coat
8. Cover and simmer on med-low heat until chicken is cooked through
9. Serve over white rice , or steamed veggies if you are watching carbs !

title: tailgating beer tini
steps:
1. Let the can of pink lemonade melt down in the fridge
2. Put all the ingredients in a pitcher , stir , and serve over ice !

title: heavenly pie
steps:
1. Whip the egg whites until frothy and then add the cream of tartar , continue beating until the egg whites are very stiff and form peaks
2. Gradually beat in the sugar and continue beating until the whites are stiff and glossy spread into a 9" pie plate and bake in a 250f oven for 1 hour
3. Filling: beat the egg yokes until thick
4. Gradually beat in the sugar , add lemon juice& rind with the bit of salt
5. Cook in a double boiler until thick , stirring constantly
6. Whip the cream add a little sugar to the cream , beat until stiff when the crust is completely cooled spread half the whipped cream in the shell , then half the lemon filling , top with remaining whipped cream put in the fridge for 3-4 hours or overnight
7. Loosely cover the pie in the fridge

title: bellissimo panini
steps:
1. In a small saute pan over medium heat saute pepper and onion in 1 tsp olive oil until onion is translucent and pepper is softened
2. Brush each cut side of the rolls with garlic olive oil and lightly salt and pepper
3. Assemble sandwiches using prosciutto , cheese , arugula , and sauteed vegetables
4. Lightly brush outside of assembled sandwiches with remaining olive oil
5. Cook until done , about 4-8 minutes

title: hurricane
steps:
1. Add ice to a cocktail shaker until 3 / 4 full
2. Add all the ingredients to the shaker
3. Cover
4. Shake vigorously
5. Strain into an ice-filled hurricane or highball glass

title: easier stabilized whipped cream
steps:
1. Put all the ingredients in a large mixing bowl
2. Mix on low speed until ingredients are combined
3. Mix on high speed until soft peaks form , scraping sides of bowl often
4. Store tightly covered in the refrigerator for up to 3 days

title: macadamia nut truffles
steps:
1. In a saucepan , combine chocolate and cream and stir over low heat until combined
2. Remove from heat and stir in butter and brandy
3. Put in the fridge and let the chocolate mixture set until it's mouldable with your hands without being runny
4. Set aside 36 nut halves and roughly chop the remaining nuts
5. Mould about 2 teaspoons of chocolate around each nut half and then roll the ball in chopped nuts
6. Repeat until they are all done and chill

title: frosting for pumpkin spice cake
steps:
1. Cream butter with pumpkin pie spice and lemon zest
2. Blend in cream cheese
3. Add confectioners sugar and beat until smooth
4. Use to frost the pumpkin spice cake

title: cranberry bog turkey burgers
steps:
1. Preheat george foreman grill or grill pan to medium high heat
2. Combine first seven incredients and form into 5 patties
3. If not using george foreman , drizzle grill pan or brush grill with vegetable oil
4. Cook patties 5 to 6 minutes on each side
5. Microwave cranberries for topping with splenda and water in a covered dish for a 2 or 3 minutes on medium heat (until they have popped and the water has reduced
6. Cool mixture and stir into yogurt or mayonnaise
7. Rachel ray suggests serving burgers on sourdough english muffins but they are fine on any kind of bread or just plain !

title: grandma s strawberry cake
steps:
1. Prepare cake mix as directed in 9 x13 pan , let cool
2. While cake is baking , dissolve gelatin in boiling water
3. When completely dissolved , stir in strawberries , sugar , and sour cream
4. Place strawberry mixture in refrigerator until cake is cool
5. When cake is cool to the touch , poke holes all over the top with the end of a wooden spoon or chopstick
6. Pour strawberry mixture all over cake
7. Frost with whipped topping
8. Refrigerat overnight to allow strawberry mixture soak into the cake

title: bacony chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Slash each breast twice
3. Cut bacon strips in half & press 1 / 2 strip into each slash
4. Mix butter and worcestershire
5. Brush mixture over chicken and bacon
6. Bake for 45 to 60 minutes or until done
7. Baste with pan drippings while cooking

title: diabetic shrimp scampi
steps:
1. Directions
2. Heat butter and oil in large non-stick skillet over high heat
3. When butter starts to brown , add garlic
4. Lower heat
5. Cook 1 minute , stirring to prevent garlic from overbrowning
6. Add shrimp
7. Cook 2 minutes , stirring occasionally
8. Add wine , lemon juice , salt and pepper
9. Cook 2 minutes or until shrimp are cooked through
10. Stir in bread crumbs and parsley
11. Serve immediately

title: baked sour cream noodles  low fat
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees farenheit , 175 celsius , or gas mark 4
2. Lightly spray a 2 quart casserole dish with cooking spray
3. Prepare the egg noodles per package directions omitting the oil and salt , drain well
4. While noodles are cooking , in a large bowl stir together the sour cream , cottage cheese , milk , garlic , worcestershire , and pepper
5. Stir in the cooked noodles , and spoon into the casserole dish
6. Bake uncovered , for 15 minutes
7. Sprinkle with the parmesan and poppy seeds and bake for 5 minutes more

title: ravioli with brown butter and sage sauce
steps:
1. Cook ravioli as directed , drain and set aside
2. In medium frying pan over medium high heat , melt the butter
3. Cook until it becomes golden brown , about 2 - 3 minutes
4. Do not let it scorch
5. Add the sage , salt and pepper and mix for a few seconds
6. Add cooked ravioli , toss to coat
7. Serve hot

title: flax seed brownies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees f
2. Take some of the butter and lightly coat a 13 by 9-inch glass baking dish
3. In one large bowl , mix together flax meal , salt , buckwheat flour and walnuts
4. Beat eggs in a separate large bowl
5. Place chopped chocolate in a third glass or metal bowl over boiling water to melt
6. When chocolate is roughly half melted , add honey , cocoa powder , butter , and vanilla and continue to slowly stir until all of the chocolate is melted
7. Remove chocolate from heat and pour half into the beaten eggs while stirring the eggs to temper them
8. Once this is fully mixed , add the rest of the chocolate to the eggs and continue to stir until a smooth consistency
9. Pour the new chocolate mixture into the dry ingredients and mix thoroughly
10. Once the batter is fully mixed you want to have it in the oven within the next 3 minutes
11. Dissolve the baking soda in the 2 tbsp of water and pour over the brownie batter
12. Quickly stir and spread out batter in the prepared baking dish

title: egg plant bruschetta  rsc
steps:
1. Fry chopped bacon in a medium pan until crisp
2. Drain bacon on a paper towel lined plate and set aside
3. Chop basil and tomatoes and set aside
4. To a medium mixing bowl add the cream cheese and microwave on high for 20 seconds to soften
5. Add bacon , tomatoes basil and cheese to cream cheese mixture
6. Add salt and pepper to taste
7. At this point i would add crushed red peppers as we like it spicy
8. You can also add chopped sauted jalapenos if you like also
9. Set this mixture aside
10. Slice eggplant to make circles about inch thick
11. At this point i will cut the skin off mine but if you like the skin you can leave it on
12. Mix egg and ranch is a separate bowl and put panko in another
13. Dip eggplant in egg mixture then in panko and place on a separate dish
14. Once you have dipped all the eggplant you are ready to cook
15. I like to put mine on the grill with a reynolds wrap and parchment lined sheet
16. Spread out a large piece of foil and then a little bit smaller piece of parchment
17. Fold over the edges of foil on the parchment so that it looks like the parchment is on the inside of the foil
18. Place this on your pre heated grill
19. Place your eggplant on the grill and let cook for about 5 minutes or until they start to brown on the bottom
20. Flip over and top with your tomato bacon mixture and leave on the grill until the mixture starts to melt and bubble
21. Serve with a salad and enjoy

title: greek olive oil bread with olives and rosemary
steps:
1. In a food processor , combine the flour , whole wheat flour , yeast and salt
2. Add the warm water and the olive oil
3. Process until it forms somewhat of a dough ball
4. Transfer the dough into a large bowl
5. With floured hands , knead the dough by hand several times
6. Then incorporate the olives and the rosemary
7. This part is a bit messy but keep kneading
8. The olives and the rosemary will be eventually incorporated
9. Form the dough into a ball
10. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap
11. Let the dough rise for up to 2 hours until it doubled in size
12. Punch the risen dough down and knead a few times
13. Form into a ball with the seam on the bottom
14. Place on a well-floured baking sheet
15. Sprinkle flour all over the bread loaf

title: ultimate brine for turkey
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a non-reactive pot , bring mixture to a boil , lower heat and simmer for 15-20 minutes
2. Allow brine to cool completely
3. Rinse turkey under cool running water , inside and out
4. Pat turkey dry with paper towels , then immerse turkey in cooled brine
5. Turkey should be completely submerged in liquid
6. Cover the pot and refrigerate for 8-10 hours or up to 24 hours
7. Remove turkey , rinse , pat dry , and roast as usual
8. Cook's
9. This will dry the skin and result in its being crispy at serving time
10. This resting period has the added advantage of evening the degree of brininess throughout the meat , and resting produces a slightly more tender result
11. Be sure the container used for brining turkey is non-reactive: use enamel , glass or crockery or stainless steel - never cast iron or aluminum
12. The pot should be just large enough to contain the turkey
13. Brining bags are now available from many cookware stores , as well as giant-size ziplock bags that may be used alone , or use within a sturdy pot
14. We have learned that many folks do not have sufficient room in their refrigerators or sometimes a pot big enough for the turkey in its brine
15. Our solution is suggest that the turkey be placed , along with the brine , in a food-safe plastic bag , such as a turkey roasting bag
16. Then , the bag , with turkey and brine inside , can be placed in an insulated cooler , a large stock pot or plastic crate , and surrounded by ice , blue ice or empty plastic bottles that have been filled with water and frozen
17. [the latter suggestions are to keep ice from melting into water which can be messy
18. ] then the cooler is closed , or the sink covered , and the turkey can be brined there for the number of hours required checking to be sure that the temperature of the brine is maintained at below 40 degrees , for safety
19. It is imperative that the temperature never be allowed to rise above 40 degrees add more ice / blue / ice as needed
20. For the desired chemical effect to take place , however , the proportions cannot be less than 2 / 3 to 1 cup of salt per gallon of water or other liquid
21. Types of salt:
22. Kosher salt is the only type of salt to be used in making brine
23. Kosher salt is available in two varieties
24. The most common is flaked salt which has been pressed into flakes by rollers
25. The other type is a four-sided crystal
26. The crystal-shaped salt measures differently because of its shape
27. Use about 25% more crystal salt than flaked salt when measuring for brine or other recipes
28. The formula is: 1 tablespoon of regular table salt is equivalent to 1 tablespoons flaked kosher salt , or 2 tablespoons , diamond crystal kosher salt
29. When a turkey will be deep fried , too much sugar will cause the bird to blacken on the outside
30. It is best , therefore to use water , rather than apple juice or cider , and to greatly reduce the amount of sugar called for in the above listing of brine ingredients
31. Variations:
32. A listener called last year to report that using beer instead of juice resulted in a wonderful flavor - she even used guiness , a more bitter-tasting beer - and loved it !
33. Along the same vein , another listener said that she made the brine as directed , then - after it had cooled - she added an equivalent amount of flat dark beer and another full one cup of brown sugar
34. After stirring the mixture until the sugar dissolved , she proceded to brine her turkey in the mixture - and indicated that the result was just fabulous
35. Brining a goose: this brine works exceptionally well for brining a goose before roasting
36. The meat of the goose benefits greatly from brining for 12 to 24 hours
37. Follow the same directions for goose as you would for brining a turkey

14. Add to fennel
15. Add olives to fennel
16. Add 1 / 4 cup olive oil , rosemary , kosher salt and pepper , mix coating vegs with the oil and spices
17. Mix lemon juice and wine in separate cup add 1 / 2 of the liquid to fennel and mix all together
18. Set remainder of wine / lemon liquid aside until / if required during roasting
19. Pour fennel mixture into an appropriately sized casserole dish if not already there
20. If coming from a bag take a spatula and scrape all the yummy seasonings out of the bag and pour over vegs
21. Roast in oven at 425 degrees for approximately 30-45 min uncovered until nicely golden and softened
22. Stir occasionally to prevent burning
23. Add remaining wine / lemon mix to fennel if necessary while roasting
24. Enjoy

title: mrs  binney s beef   beans
steps:
1. Cook ground beef in a large pot with the chopped onions , garlic and celery until meat is browned well , and vegetables are soft
2. Drain away any fat
3. Dissolve bouillon cubes in the boiling water
4. Stir into beef mixture
5. Add the canned beans , mustard , ketchup , salt and pepper
6. Stir well
7. Cover and bake in oven at 375f for 1 hour
8. To serve i top with the crumbled bacon

title: nana s chocolate cherry cake
steps:
1. Mix cake mix , eggs and flavorings until well-blended
2. Fold in cherry pie filling
3. Spread batter into a 8" x 12" pan that has been greased and floured
4. Bake at 350 degrees until done
5. Frost with dark chocolate frosting

title: bbq cheese fingers
steps:
1. Cut the loaf into 1" slices but do not cut right through just down to the last 1 / 2" turn the loaf and cross cut also into 1" slices , again do not cut right through just down to the last half inch mix cheese whiz& garlic
2. Spread the cheese mix generously between the slices , get it right down into the bread , don't break the fingers wrap the loaf in double aluminium foil and seal
3. Place on upper rack of bbq
4. Close lid& cook on medium heat for apprx 15 minutes
5. Open the foil and start pulling the finger from the outside toward the center the bottom crust is worth fighting for !

title: reba mcentire s beans
steps:
1. Brown onion in same skillet used to cook bacon , over medium-high heat about 5 to 6 minutes
2. Add ground beef and cook until browned
3. Drain off excess grease
4. Add rest of ingredients except bacon
5. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer 15 to 20 minutes until it tastes real gooooooood !
6. Crumble bacon over the top before serving

title: elderflower champagne
steps:
1. Do not wash the flower , but remove any insects and the thick stalks
2. Place the sugar in a very large bowl and cover with 2 pints of boiling water
3. Stir until the sugar has dissolved
4. Then add 6 pints cold water , the rind and juice of the lemons , the vinegar and flowers
5. Stir well
6. Cover and leave , covered , for 48 hours , stirring occasionally
7. Strain through a fine sieve into clean bottles with screw tops
8. Leave an inch gap at the top of each bottle and screw down well
9. Leave in a cool place to mature
10. Nice served with ice
11. Ready to drink in 6 weeks but it tastes better the longer it is left

title: purple people eater salad
steps:
1. In a large bowl , mix jello with 1 cup boiling water and stir until jello is dissolved
2. Add the pie filling and crushed pineapple to the jello mixture and blend well
3. Refrigerate until mixture begins to thicken
4. Add the whipped topping , marshmallows and pecans
5. Pour into a large glass serving dish and chill
6. Serve cold

title: low carb green bean casserole
steps:
1. Melt the butter in a skillet and saute the onions , celery and mushrooms until soft
2. Mix the mayonnaise and cream
3. Mix everything together in a casserole and bake at 350f , covered , for 30 minutes
4. Uncover and brown , if desired

title: my very famous greek village steak seasoning
steps:
1. Put oregano into a bowl
2. Add remaining ingredients
3. Store it in a jar in fridge
4. Then , when you come home from work exhausted , you just sprinkle it on your meat , chicken , fish or potatoes , and grill it
5. You can brush the food with olive oil before you put the seasoning if you want , this makes it moister
6. Enjoy ! opa !

title: maple slow cooker boneless ribs
steps:
1. Sprinkle ribs with pepper and rub into surface
2. Place meat in slow cooker
3. Combine remaining ingredients in a small bowl
4. Pour sauce over meat
5. Cook on low 6-8 hours or high 3-4 hours

title: bacon wrapped burger with fried pickles   slaw
steps:
1. Bacon:
2. Line a microwave-safe plate with paper towels
3. Arrange six of the bacon slices in a single layer
4. Cover with paper towels
5. Microwave on 100 percent power for 1 to 2 minutes or until partially cooked
6. Drain on paper towels
7. Cool
8. Transfer to a large resealable plastic bag
9. In a small bowl stir together brown sugar , coffee , and garlic powder
10. Add mixture to the bag
11. Seal bag
12. Shake to coat bacon
13. Set aside
14. Repeat with remaining bacon and remaining brown sugar mixture
15. Patties:
16. Season beef with salt and pepper to taste , shape beef into six 3 / 4-inch-thick patties
17. Wrap two slices of coated bacon around the each patty
18. Secure bacon ends together with wooden toothpicks
19. Cover and chill for 30 minutes or up to 24 hours
20. Cole slaw:
21. In a medium bowl whisk together vinegar , mayonnaise , sugar , sriracha sauce , and the 1 / 2 teaspoon salt
22. Add cabbage , carrot , onion , and parsley , stirring to coat
23. Season to taste with additional salt and pepper
24. Cover and chill until ready to serve
25. To grill:
26. For a charcoal grill , arrange medium-hot coals around a drip pan
27. Test for medium heat above pan
28. Place patties on grill rack over drip pan
29. Cover and grill for 16 to 18 minutes or until done and bacon is crisp
30. To finish
31. Place burgers on bun bottoms
32. Top each patty with coleslaw and fried pickles
33. Add bun tops

title: jeff s blackened catfish
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Grease a baking dish large enough to hold fish fillets in a single layer with no overlapping
3. Set aside
4. Melt 2 tablespoons butter in a small pan over low heat
5. Meanwhile , measure spices into a shallow dish , stirring well to combine
6. Remove melted butter from heat and brush generously over catfish
7. Dredge each fillet in spice mixture , coating both sides
8. Heat heavy skillet on medium-high
9. When skillet is hot , add fillets , cooking for 2 to 3 minutes per side , until slightly blackened
10. Transfer catfish to prepared baking dish
11. Pour italian dressing evenly over fillets
12. Bake for approximately 30 to 35 minutes , until fish flakes easily when scraped with the tines of a fork

title: glazed pork chops
steps:
1. Heat butter in skillet
2. Cook chops for 10 min , or until browned on both sides
3. Remove from pan
4. Add to pan , water , soup mix , and sugar
5. Stir well
6. Add apple , stir to coat with sauce
7. Heat to boiling , return chops
8. Reduce heat to low
9. Cover and cook on low for 10 minutes
10. Mix cornstarch with 2 t water
11. Remove chops and apples to platter
12. Bring sauce to a boil
13. Stir in cornstarch , until smooth
14. Spoon over pork and apples

title: creamy broccoli soup with cheddar cheese
steps:
1. In medium sauce pot , add 4 tablespoons olive oil , celery , and garlic and cook 5-8 minutes
2. Add flour and cook for 2 minutes , stirring occasionally
3. Add stock and bring to a boil
4. Lower heat and stir with a whisk to break up flour
5. Cook for about 1 / 2 hour
6. Soup should thicken slowly
7. Add broccoli , cream , lime juice , and tabasco
8. Cook 15 minutes
9. Do not let boil
10. Add cheese and salt and pepper to taste

title: baked scallops with garlic sauce
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Wipe scallops with damp paper towel
3. Mash garlic cloves , add to butter , and stir well to blend
4. Keep warm
5. Pour a little of the melted garlic sauce into the bottom of a baking dish , add the mushrooms and season with onion salt and black pepper
6. Place the scallops on top of the mushrooms
7. Reserve 1 tablespoon garlic sauce and drizzle the rest on scallops
8. Sprinkle with bread crumbs , parsley and reserved garlic sauce
9. Bake in preheated 375f oven until the top is nicely browned and bubbly hot , for about 10 minutes
10. Enjoy !

title: crustless potato quiche
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f
2. Grease a 9-inch pie plate
3. In a large bowl combine all ingredients except paprika and bacon
4. Mix well
5. Pour into greased pie dish
6. Sprinkle with paprika
7. Bake for 30 to 40 minutes or until set
8. Sprinkle with bacon
9. Bake additional 5 minutes
10. Let stand 5 minutes before serving

title: white star cookies
steps:
1. Melt the white star candy and peanut butter together
2. Add all other ingredients and mix together
3. Drop by spoonfuls onto wax paper
4. Refrigerate until hardened

title: fennel lemon salad
steps:
1. In a bowl , whisk together the lemon juice 2 tablespoons of water , the oil and salt
2. Cut off the fennel stalks and fronds
3. Finely chop cup of the fronds and add to the bowl of dressing
4. Discard the stalks
5. Cut the bulb in half and slice thinly
6. Add the fennel to the bowl and toss to combine
7. Serve sprinkled with parmesan

title: seared sesame tofu with asian salad
steps:
1. Mix chopped green onions , sliced bell pepper and bean sprouts in a medium bowl
2. Place vegetables on plates
3. Place sesame seeds in a small plate
4. Dredge tofu slices in sesame seeds to coat on all sides
5. Heat 2 tablespoons roasted garlic oil in heavy medium skillet over medium heat
6. Add tofu and cook until rich golden brown for about 3 minutes per side
7. Divide on plates
8. Add remaining garlic oil to skillet
9. Add minced ginger
10. Saut for 1 minute
11. Add rice vinegar and bring to boil
12. Remove from heat
13. Drizzle tofu and vegetables with pan sauce

title: picnic roast beef and pepper jack sandwich
steps:
1. You know what to do
2. The sandwich will taste best if you pack everything separately to transport to the picnic site

title: toasted coconut cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. In a mixing bowl , cream butter , shortening and sugars until fluffy
3. Add eggs and vanilla , beat well
4. Combine flour , baking powder , baking soda and salt
5. Gradually add to creamed mixture
6. Fold in oats , coconut and nuts
7. Drop by tablespoonfuls onto greased baking sheets
8. Bake at 375 degrees for 10-11 minutes or until golden brown
9. Cool 2-3 minutes before removing to a wire rack

title: white trash panini
steps:
1. Heat a panini grill or other griddle to medium heat
2. Use a serrated knife to split the croissant in half lengthwise
3. Spread one half with peanut butter
4. Break the chocolate into small squares and lay atop the peanut butter
5. Spread the marshmallow fluff on the remaining croissant half
6. Press the sandwich together
7. Brush very lightly with melted butter
8. Press the croissant in the panini grill until it is slightly flattened and crisp and the filling is warm and melted , 4-5 minutes
9. Remove your croissant from the panini press and let it cool slightly
10. Sprinkle with powdered sugar
11. Use a serrated knife to cut in half
12. Eat immediately

title: unknownchef86 s coconut surprises
steps:
1. Cream shortening with vanilla
2. Add sugar gradually , beating til fluffy
3. Add egg and beat well
4. Thoroughly blend in 1 3 / 4 cups coconut
5. Combine flour , salt , and baking soda
6. Add 1 / 2 of this mixture to the creamed mixture
7. Mix well
8. Add remainder of mixture
9. Stir til it holds together
10. Shape into 1" balls
11. Roll in remaining coconut
12. Place 3 / 4" apart on lighly greased cookie sheet
13. Bake at 325 for 15-20 minutes
14. Let cool on cookie sheet , then remove

title: cinnamon orange chicken
steps:
1. Flatten breasts to 1 / 4" thickness and sprinkle with salt and pepper
2. Spray a pan large enough to hold chicken with cooking spray
3. Heat pan over medium heat until hot
4. Add chicken
5. Cook 3-4 minutes or until done
6. Add remaining ingredients
7. Cook 3-4 minutes or until heated through
8. Serve sauce over chicken

title: cubed steak
steps:
1. Salt and pepper both sides of steaks and dredge in flour
2. In a large skillet on medium high heat melt butter and olive oil , stir in mushrooms and onion and saut until tender , transfer to plate , brown steaks on both sides and then transfer to plate with onions and mushrooms
3. Pour beef broth into skillet and stir to deglaze then add golden mushroom soup and stir to combine
4. Add steaks , onions and mushrooms , bring to a boil , cover and reduce heat
5. Simmer for about one hour
6. 2 tablespoons each corn starch and water can be stirred in at the last to make thicker gravy
7. Serve with mashed potatoes , rice or egg noodles

title: boeuf bourguignonne  beef burgundy stew
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. In a dutch oven , cook the bacon over medium-high heat for 5 minutes stirring occasionally
3. Remove bacon and set aside
4. Season beef with paprika and marjoram and brown on all sides in dutch oven
5. Remove beef and set aside
6. Reduce heat to medium and cook onion and garlic in butter for 5 minutes , stirring often
7. Mix in flour
8. Add bacon , beef , and all other remaining ingredients except for thyme
9. Bring to a boil over high heat
10. Remove from heat
11. Bake , covered in preheated oven until meat is tender , stirring occasionally and adding more broth if needed
12. Garnish each bowl with a tsp of chopped thyme

title: cajun shrimp casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees
2. In a large skillet , melt butter over medium heat
3. Add celery , green pepper , and scallions
4. Saute about 7 minutes , stirring frequently
5. Add flour , salt , mace , curry powder , hot pepper sauce , and worcestershire sauce , stirring until smooth and well blended
6. Stir in warmed evaporated milk
7. Cook , stirring , until sauce is smooth and thickened
8. Add shrimp
9. Cook about 3 minutes
10. Taste and adjust seasoning to taste
11. Pour into a buttered casserole dish
12. Sprinkle top with parmesan cheese and paprika
13. Bake at 425 degrees for 20 minutes

title: hamburger helper   beef taco   cheese copycat
steps:
1. Brown ground beef and cook with diced onions
2. After the beef is cooked drain and rinse
3. Put back in the pan and add and mix well the seasoning , milk , water and cheese let it come to a slight boil
4. Add the egg noodles , let the pan simmer for about 10 minutes until egg noodles are cooked and sauce has thickened
5. Now enjoy ! i guarantee no one will be able to tell the difference :)

title: ham   bacon quiche
steps:
1. Fit 1 piecrust into a 9" deep dish pieplate according to package directions
2. Trim dough around edges of pieplate
3. Place remaining piecrust on a lightly floured surface , cut desired shapes with a decorative 1" cookie cutter
4. Brush edge of piecrust in pieplate with beaten egg white
5. Gently press dough shapes onto edge of piecrust
6. Pierce bottom and sides with a fork
7. Line piecrust with parchment paper or aluminum foil
8. Fill piecrust with pie weights or dried beans
9. Bake at 400 for 10 minutes
10. Remove weights and parchment paper
11. Bake 5 more minutes , and set aside
12. Reduce oven temperature to 350
13. Cook bacon in a large skillet over medium high heat until crisp
14. Remove bacon , and drain on paper towels , reserving 2 t
15. Drippings in pan
16. Crumble bacon and set aside
17. Saute chopped onion and mushrooms in hot drippings 3 to 4 minutes or until tender
18. Stir together bacon , onion mixture , half and half , and next 4 ingredients in a large bowl
19. Combine cheese and flour
20. Add to bacon mixture , stirring until blended
21. Pour mixture into crust
22. Bake at 350 for 45 to 50 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean
23. Shield edges with aluminum foil to prevent excess browning , if necessary
24. Let stand 10 minutes before serving

title: peanut butter pinwheel cookies
steps:
1. In mixing bowl , cream shortening , peanut butter and sugar
2. Beat in egg and milk
3. In another bowl whisk together flour , baking soda and salt
4. Gradually add to creamed mixture
5. Roll out cookie dough between waxed paper into a 12-inch by 10-inch rectangle
6. Melt chocolate chips
7. Cool slightly
8. When cooled slightly , spread over dough to within 1 / 2 inch of edges
9. Roll up tightly , jelly-roll style , starting with a long side
10. Wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate 20 to 30 minutes or until easy to handle
11. Preheat oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit and grease cookie sheets
12. Unwrap dough and cut into 1 / 2-inch slices
13. Place slices 1 inch apart on prepared cookie sheets
14. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes or until edges are lightly browned
15. Remove to wire racks to cool

title: asian cooked cabbage salad
steps:
1. Mix together well , the ingredients for the sauce and set aside
2. Heat the oil and crushed red pepper over medium high heat
3. When the oil is hot , add the cabbage and stir fry until the cabbage just starts to wilt , about 5 minutes
4. Add the sauce , turn the heat to hi , heat for about 3-5 minutes and then serve
5. How easy was that !

title: rotisserie chicken spaghetti casserole
steps:
1. Remove skin and bones from your rotisserie chicken and dice up all of the meat
2. Melt 1 tsp margarine in a skillet and saute onions until they are very soft , about 5 minutes , seasoning to taste with a small amount of salt , pepper , and garlic powder
3. Place cooked onions in to a very large bowl , then melt the remaining 1 tsp margarine and saute the mushrooms until very soft , also seasoning to taste with salt , pepper and garlic powder , another 5 minutes
4. Add the mushrooms to the bowl with the onions
5. Add the chicken meat , cooked & drained spaghetti , and diced velveeta to the large bowl and toss well to coat
6. Mix together the chicken broth , cream of mushroom and chicken soups and add to the bowl , combining well
7. Pour into a large oval casserole and bake covered in a preheated 350 f oven for 25 minutes
8. Remove cover , sprinkle cheddar cheese on top and bake another 5 minutes

title: lentil sausage gumbo
steps:
1. Brown sliced sausage in stew pot sprayed with cooking spray
2. Remove and make roux using salad oil and flour
3. Cook roux until brown but not burnt
4. Add garlic and saute until soft
5. Add broth , sausages , lentils , and seasonings
6. Bring to a boil
7. Lower heat and simmer 45 minutes to 1 hour or until lentils are soft when pressed
8. Serve with corn bread

title: no marshmallow 7 up salad
steps:
1. Heat pineapple juice
2. Dissolve jello in pineapple juice
3. Add cold 7-up
4. Refrigerate until mixture starts to jell
5. Add remaining ingredients
6. Chill until set

title: red cooking wine
steps:
1. Once you have gotten over the fact that you've had to open up a perfectly good bottle of wine for that incredible sauce and realized you can't finish it right now , pour the remainder into a 20 oz clean water bottle to neck , seal and put on shelf in freezer
2. Depending on how much wine you needed for your recipe , this should give you at least one bottle and enough to start a second
3. This extra bottle gives you room for those "not quite a glass" leftovers from the good bottles
4. Add to your freezer stash as available
5. I keep several of these bottles handy for cooking
6. The wine doesn't go rancid , doesn't freeze , and actually seems to strengthen in taste
7. It also doesn't take away from the drinking stash ! : )

title: orange pineapple jello salad
steps:
1. Drain pineapple juice and reserve
2. Combine pineapple juice with sugar and bring to a boil in the microwave
3. Add orange jello to boiling liquid and let cool
4. After mixture has cooled , stir in cool whip
5. In a separate bowl , soften cream cheese with milk
6. Stir into jello mixture
7. Add crushed pineapple and blend all together
8. Put in mold and refrigerate

title: sloppy bbq joe
steps:
1. Brown your meat and rinse out the grease
2. Add the all the other ingredients and simmer on the stove at least 20 minutes or throw in a crockpot and cook on low till hot and serve on buns

title: indian flat bread
steps:
1. In a large bowl mix together the flour , baking powder , and salt
2. Stir all the ingredients together making sure that the baking powder is well distributed throughout the flour
3. Pour the flour mixture into your mixing bowl and slowly add milk to the flour and melted butter , while kneading the dough
4. You should end up with stiff workable dough that is not sticky
5. If you end up with wet sticky dough you need to add more flour
6. If the dough will not hold together then you need more milk
7. If you have never made dough before you may find the process of kneading a little daunting
8. I would suggest trying this at home a few times until you get the hang of it
9. I have improved upon the recipe as follows: after the dough is ready flatten into rectangular shape and sprinkle some garlic powder and aprox 3 teaspoons herbs de province then rework the dough to incorporate the herbs and spice to the dough
10. Wrap the dough in plastic wrap and let it rest 8 hours or overnight
11. Now that your dough is made you're ready to fry some indian flat bread
12. Take your dough and divide it into small balls
13. The size of the balls is up to you
14. Next take the balls and flatten them out into patties
15. Try to flatten them so that they are about 1 / 8 inch thick or like a thick tortilla
16. This will make the bread cook fast and evenly
17. Heat up some oil in a frying pan and cook them for a few minutes on each side until they turn golden brown and puff up like pancakes
18. Don't try to fry bread with margarine or butter because it will burn in the frying pan
19. I top it with butter while still hot , right out of the pan and sprinkle a little kosher salt and garlic powder on top and eat
20. As rachael ray would say , yummo !

title: empadinhas  brazilian shrimp pies
steps:
1. Make the dough
2. Place the flour in a large mixing bowl and make a well in the center
3. Place the butter , shortening , eggs , salt , and 1 cup water in the well
4. Using one hand to mix , squeeze these ingredients through your fingers to make a paste
5. Gradually work in the flour , squeezing the dough between your fingers to mix it
6. Add water as necessary: the dough should be quite soft
7. Let the dough rest for 30 minutes
8. Prepare the filling
9. Peel and devein the shrimp
10. Heat the oil in a large saucepan
11. Saut the onion and garlic over medium heat for 2-3 minutes , or until soft but not brown
12. Add the shrimp , bay leaf , tomato paste , salt , and pepper , plus water to cover
13. Bring to a boil , reduce heat , and simmer for 10 minutes , or until the shrimp is cooked
14. Strain the shrimp , reserving the broth
15. Finely chop the shrimp by hand or in the food processor
16. Stir in the flour , peas , and olives
17. Stir in 3-4 tablespoons of the reserved broth: the filling should be moist but not runny
18. Add enough cayenne to give the shrimp mixture a little bite
19. Pinch off cherry-sized pieces of dough and use them to line the tartlet molds
20. Push the dough in with your thumb
21. The dough should just reach over the top of the mold
22. Place a spoonful of filling in each crust
23. Roll out the remaining dough and cut out tops for the empadinhas
24. Try to capture an air bubble when you place the top over the filling: this is what makes the pie light
25. Seal the tartlets by pinching together the top and bottom crust
26. Preheat the oven to 375 f
27. Brush the tops of the empadinhas with egg glaze
28. Bake for 30 minutes , or until golden brown
29. Unmold and serve
30. If you're lazy like me , try this big pie version , called empado: make the filling and use pillsbury pie crusts , one for the bottom and one for the top
31. Fantastic dinner stuff !
32. To make chicken empadinhas-------------
33. Cook the chicken and prepare the broth
34. Place the chicken in a small saucepan with the garlic , onion , bay leaf and water to cover
35. Bring to a boil , reduce the heat , and gently simmer for 20 minutes , or until the chicken is tender
36. Drain the chicken , reserving the broth
37. When the chicken is cool enough to handle , remove the skin and bones and finely shred the meat
38. Discard the onion , garlic , and bay leaf
39. Heat the oil in a large saucepan
40. Saut the onion and garlic over medium heat for 2-3 minutes , or until soft but not brown
41. Add the chicken , bay leaf , tomato paste , salt , and pepper , plus water to cover
42. Bring to a boil , reduce heat , and simmer for 5 minutes
43. Procede as in step 3 above , stirring in the flour , peas , and olives
44. And so on

title: sweet potatoes and apple casserole
steps:
1. Alternately layer in a 9 x 13" casserole dish sweet potatoes and apples
2. Between each layer put margarine , spices , and sugar
3. Pour apple juice over everything
4. Cover with foil and bake at 350f for 30 minutes or until apples are tender

title: italian pistachio apple salad
steps:
1. For dressing , whisk together orange juice , balsamic vinegar , mustard , and garlic
2. Gradually whisk in oil until well blended
3. Set aside to mellow flavors
4. For salad , divide greens among four salad plates
5. Top with apple slices
6. Sprinkle with cheese and nuts
7. Whisk dressing
8. Drizzle over salads

title: sole with lemon souffle topping
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425f
2. Season the fish with the seasoned salt and sugar , and dip in flour
3. Brush with garlic butter or oil on both sides
4. Place individually on ovenproof plates or in a baking dish
5. Place the fish in the oven and bake for 5 minutes
6. Mix the mayonnaise , egg yolks , lemon rind , and parsley
7. Beat the egg whites to the soft-peak stage
8. Fold whites into the sauce
9. Open the oven door and spoon the sauce over each fish
10. Bake for 10 to 15 minutes until puffed and golden brown

title: caribbean shrimp and nectarine salad
steps:
1. Process dressing ingredients in blender or food processor until ginger is finely chopped
2. Pour into a large salad bowl
3. Add remaining ingredients except greens and toss to mix and coat
4. Chill in refrigerator for 30 minutes
5. Place greens on chilled plates and top with chilled salad mixture

title: eggplant  aubergine  rollatini
steps:
1. Spoon the ricotta into a fine strainer placed over a bowl in the refrigerator for several hours
2. Discard the excess liquid
3. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
4. Spread thin coating of olive oil on 3-4 baking or cookie sheet pans , or reuse the same pan several times
5. Put the flat end of the eggplant down onto the cutting board
6. Slice the eggplants lengthwise into 1 / 4-inch thick slices , to make about 15 slices
7. Beat 4 of the eggs
8. Add salt and pepper to season eggs
9. Coat each eggplant slice with flour , then dip into the beaten eggs , drain any excess egg mixture , then coat with bread crumbs and lay flat on baking sheet
10. Bake until golden brown , about 15 minutes
11. You may have to bake them in batches
12. Remove from the oven and cool to room temperature
13. Combine ricotta , remaining egg , garlic , basil , parsley , 3 / 4 of the mozzeralla cheese and 1 / 2 cup of the grated romano or parmesan in a bowl
14. Mix well
15. Add salt and pepper , to taste
16. Spoon 1 cup of tomato sauce onto the bottom of a small baking dish
17. Spoon 1 to 2 tablespoons of filling onto the wide end of each piece of eggplant
18. Then , roll up each piece and place into the baking dish
19. Top with remaining tomato sauce , mozzarella , and grated parmesan
20. Cover with foil and bake for 45 minutes , until the tomato sauce is bubbling and the filling is hot
21. Let them rest for 15 minutes before serving

title: brownie pizza  paula deen
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Grease a 15-inch pizza pan
3. Prepare brownie mix according to directions on box
4. Pour onto prepared pan
5. Bake for 20 minutes or until done
6. Remove from oven and cool
7. Beat cream cheese while adding pineapple and sugar together in a bowl
8. Spread mixture over brownie crust
9. Arrange banana , strawberry slices , marshmallows , and cherries over cream cheese mixture
10. Sprinkle with nuts and coconut
11. Drizzle with chocolate syrup
12. Add whipped cream on top and mint for garnish
13. To serve , slice as you would a pizza and enjoy !

title: macayo s baja sauce
steps: 1. Pace all ingredients in a blender and blend until mixed and smooth

title: sublime 3 cheese macaroni
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. In a large saucepan , melt your butter over lowe heat and then whisk in flour and cook 2 minutes
3. Slowly whisk in your milk and cook over low heat , constantly whisking until mixture becomes thinkened
4. Whisk in salt , pepper , allspice , nutmeg , and cayenne pepper
5. Stir in cheeses and remove from heat and cover
6. Cook pasta in required amount of boiling water for 10 mins until slightly undercooked and then drain
7. Stir into cheese sauce
8. Add pasta to a casserole dish and add cheese mixture to it and fold over and over until thoroughly combined
9. Sprinkle with panko and place dish into your preheated oven and bake for 30 minutes or until sauce is bubbling and panko is golden brown

title: coconut chicken tenders with maui wowee dipping sauce
steps:
1. Cut each chicken breast into 4 to 6 strips
2. Whisk together flour and next 4 ingredients in a bowl
3. Combine coconut and breadcrumbs in a large shallow dish
4. Dip chicken pieces in flour mixture , and dredge in coconut mixture
5. Pour oil to a depth of 2 inches in a deep skillet or dutch oven
6. Heat to 350
7. Fry chicken , in batches , 2 to 3 minutes or until golden
8. Drain on paper towels
9. Sprinkle lightly with salt , if desired
10. Serve with wowee maui dipping sauce
11. Maui wowee dipping sauce: mix all ingredients together
12. Serve with coconut chicken tenders

title: outback steakhouse style steak
steps:
1. Mix together seasoning ingredients and rub into each side of steak
2. Grill steaks on a large frying pan over medium-high heat
3. Press down on steak with spatula or tongs to sear the edges

title: 10 minute buffalo shrimp with blue cheese dip
steps:
1. In a bowl , combine first six ingredients to make blue cheese dip
2. Cover and refrigerate
3. In a shallow bowl , combine flour , salt and cayenne pepper
4. Add shrimp , tossing to coat
5. In a large skillet , heat oil , butter and hot sauce
6. Add shrimp and cook , stirring constantly until lightly browned , about 3 to 4 minutes
7. Sprinkle blue cheese dip with parsley
8. Serve with shrimp
9. Serve with carrot and celery sticks on side if desired

title: amy sedaris s vanilla cupcakes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. In a large bowl , cream together butter and sugar
3. Add in the eggs , two teaspoons vanilla , salt and baking powder
4. Add flour and milk in batches , starting and ending with flour
5. Stir until batter is smooth and satiny
6. Fill paper-lined muffin tins with batter
7. Bake at 375 for 18- 20 minutes
8. For frosting , whip together the box of confectioners' sugar , half-and-half , and one teaspoon vanilla until smooth and fluffy
9. Allow cupcakes to cool about 45 minutes and frost
10. Hint i added about one extra teaspoon of vanilla to the batter
11. This recipe didn't specify , but i used all-purpose flour
12. To the frosting , i added a bit more half-and-half to reach a thinner consistency

title: egg replacer
steps:
1. Grind up the flax seeds in the blender until they are pretty fine
2. Mix the seeds and the water and cook on the stove until it gets all jelly-like
3. Remove from heat and let cool before using in cookies , muffins , breads , etc

title: roasted beets n  sweets
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
2. In a bowl , toss the beets with 1 / 2 tablespoon olive oil to coat
3. Spread in a single layer on a baking sheet
4. Mix the remaining 2 tablespoons olive oil , garlic powder , salt , pepper , and sugar in a large resealable plastic bag
5. Place the sweet potatoes and onion in the bag
6. Seal bag , and shake to coat vegetables with the oil mixture
7. Bake beets 30 minutes in the preheated oven
8. Mix sweet potato mixture with the beets on the baking sheet
9. Continue baking 45 minutes , stirring after 20 minutes , until all vegetables are tender

title: mexican rice  easy
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat
2. Add rice and cook , stirring constantly
3. Sprinkle with salt , cumin , and taco seasoning
4. Cook stirring constantly , until slightly translucent
5. Stir in onions and cook until tender
6. Stir in tomato sauce and chicken broth
7. Bring to a boil
8. Reduce heat to low , cover and simmer for 20 to 25 minutes
9. Fluff with a fork

title: lemon drop wafers
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f degrees
2. Line baking sheet with silpat sheet if possible
3. Alternately , a good wipe of cooking oil sothe cookies will release
4. Using an electric mixer , cream butter and 1 cup sugar for 3 to 5 minutes , scraping down the sides of the bowl periodically
5. Your butter will be light and only a wee bit fluffy but the sugar should be fairly disolved
6. Add the egg and contine to beat until combined and the batter is somewhat fluffy
7. Add the finely grated zest of two lemons
8. If you choose , add one or two drops of yellow food coloring
9. Quickly mix together the flour , baking soda and saltin a separate bowl or on a sheet of waxed paper
10. Add the dry ingredients to the wet and mix on medium speed for 20 seconds until they are just mixed together
11. Fold in the crushed lemon drops until distributed in the dough
12. Wrap the prepared dough in waxed paper and place in freezer for 30 minutes until firm
13. Place the remaining 1 / 3 cup of sugar in a smal , shallow bowl
14. Remove dough from freezer
15. Pinch off about a tablespoon and roll into a half inch ball
16. Roll ball in sugar until it is completely covered
17. Place cookies on sheets , spacing about 2 to 2 1 / 2 inches apart
18. Before baking , lightly press and flatten the balls with the bottom of a glass so that the cookies are about 1 / 4 inch thick
19. Bake cookies until they are lightly golden , 9-10 minutes
20. After they comeout of the oven , allowthem to coolabout 2 minutes before transfering to wire rack to cool
21. Slide the spatula under the cookie carefully torelease any candy bits that may cause the cookie to stick to the sheet

title: dirt s best bbq ribs
steps:
1. Rub 3 racks or of ribs with the rub mixture
2. Place in a large covered roaster on rack so you can put an inch or two of water in the roaster without touching the ribs
3. Back at 350 degrees for 1-1 / 2 hours
4. Combine bbq sauce ingredients , and slather on the baked ribs
5. Place ribs on bbq grill or in a stove top smoker for 10 mins or until sauce is set or slightly charred

title: snow topped holiday brownie bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f grease a 13 x 9-inch baking pan
2. Combine flour , cocoa , baking powder and salt in medium bowl
3. Microwave butter in a large , microwave-safe bowl on high power 1 minute
4. Stir until melted
5. Stir in sugar and water
6. Stir in eggs and vanilla extract
7. Gradually stir in flour mixture
8. Stir in 1 cup shapes & morsels
9. Spread into prepared baking pan
10. Bake 18 to 25 minutes or until wooden pick inserted in center comes out slightly sticky
11. Cool completely in pan on wire rack
12. Spread with whipped topping
13. Sprinkle with remaining shapes & morsels
14. Refrigerate until serving time
15. Cut into bars

title: moist   delicious chicken
steps:
1. Mix first 6 ingredients in a ziploc bag & add chicken , let sit in fridge for 1 / 2 hour
2. Preheat oven to 350
3. Put 2 cups italian bread crumbs in a gallon size ziploc bag , add chicken & shake until thoroughly coated
4. Place on greased baking sheet & top each piece of chicken with a small slice of butter
5. Turn chicken after 20 minutes & cook for an additional 25
6. Serve with your favorite side , would go well with sauteed vegetables or mac n cheese !

title: pasta with broccoli onion sauce
steps:
1. Cook fettuccine according to the package directions , adding the broccoli for the last 5 minutes of cooking
2. Drain well , return to pan
3. Meanwhile , spray an unheated large skillet with nonstick spray
4. Preheat over medium-low heat
5. Add onion
6. Cook , covered , for 8 to 10 minutes or until tender , stirring occasionally
7. In a small bowl stir together the milk , cornstarch , bouillon granules , pepper and nutmeg
8. Add to onion in skillet
9. Cook and stir over medium heat until thickened and bubbly
10. Cook and stir for 2 minutes more
11. Stir in cheese and wine until cheese is melted
12. Pour cheese mixture over pasta and broccoli , toss to coat

title: braised pork with green chile sauce of chile verde
steps:
1. Trim and discard fat and cut pork in 1-inch cubes
2. In a large frying pan , heat oil over mediun-high heat
3. Add meat a few cubes at a time and cook until very brown
4. Push meat to side of pan and add onion , garlic and bell peppers
5. Saute until limp
6. Stir in chiles , oregano , cumin , salt , cilantro , vinegar , and water
7. Cover and simmer until meat is fork tender
8. Skim off fat & discard
9. Serve with rice or make burritos or serve in your favorite way

title: stuffed breakfast biscuits
steps:
1. Prepare sausages according to package directions
2. Drain and cut into quarters
3. Partially cook beaten eggs until they are almost all cooked but are still runny
4. I do this in the microwave , 25 seconds at a time , breaking into small pieces that will be easy to spoon into biscuits
5. On a lightly floured surface , roll out each round of biscuit dough into a 5" circle and drape over a lightly greased muffin cup
6. If using non-stick muffin tins , don't pre-grease the pan
7. Equally distribute the ingredients into the biscuits in this order: sausage , cheese , green onions , egg
8. Pinch dough edges together to seal and brush with melted butter
9. Bake in a 400 degree f oven for 10-12 minutes until biscuits are brown

title: penne with chicken  artichokes  and pesto cream
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to package directions
2. Drain and set aside
3. Meanwhile , heat the oil in a large deep skillet over medium-high heat
4. Add the chicken and cook for 3-5 minutes , until golden all over
5. Add artichokes , tomatoes , cream , and pesto
6. Bring to a simmer and stir frequently for 3 minutes , or until the chicken is cooked through
7. Fold in the cooked pasta and parmesan cheese
8. Cook 1 minute longer to heat through
9. Add more cream if neneed to thin out sauce
10. Season to taste with salt and pepper and serve

title: healthy peanut butter
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in a vita-mixer
2. Process for 5 minutes using gentle mixing motion w / mixing stick
3. Stop and scrape down sides of container and loosen any lodged peanuts
4. Process again for 2 minutes or until desired consistency
5. Place into old peanut butter jars and refridgerate

title: padma s lentil salad
steps:
1. Wash the lentils and soak them for 2 hours in tepid water
2. Drain
3. In a deep pot , add 8 cups of water to the lentils , bring to a boil , cover , and cook on low heat for 20 to 25 minutes
4. Rinse the lentils with cold water and drain
5. Make sure the lentils are cooked but firm , not mushy
6. In a large bowl , mix together the lentils , apple , bell pepper , jalapeno , olive oil , vinegar , lemon juice , salt , and parsley
7. Stir and set aside in the fridge
8. Just before serving , heat the sesame oil on medium-high heat
9. When hot , roast the ginger and coconut for a few minutes until golden and toasty
10. Sprinkle this garnish over the lentils and serve immediately

title: garlic stuffed olives
steps:
1. Drain olives
2. Peel garlic , stuff into olives
3. Large cloves may be cut to fit
4. Put stuffed olives into a jar
5. Add enough olive oil to cover
6. Add seasonings and chili
7. Seal , shake to mix
8. Let marinate for a few hours

title: moroccan chicken
steps:
1. Cook chicken in skillet until done
2. Stir in remaining ingredients
3. Simmer 15 minutes
4. Serve over couscous or hot rice

title: kittencal s ranch potato salad or macaroni salad
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine the cooked cubed potatoes or cooked pasta with peas
2. Celery , green onions , cheddar cheese and chopped eggs
3. Toss to combine
4. In a small bowl , combine relish , mayo , ranch salad dressing and mustard and garlic powder mix well then add to macaroni mixture
5. Toss to coat then season with salt and pepper
6. Add in chopped yum yum pickles if using
7. Mix to combine
8. Season with more salt and black pepper to taste
9. Cover and refrigerate for 3 or more hours to blend flavors
10. Delicious !

title: sour cherry cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Grease an 8"x8" square pan
3. In bowl of a mixer fitted with a whisk , beat together the eggs and sugar until light yellow and fluffy
4. Add margarine and vanilla , stir to combine
5. Mix in cocoa , flour , and baking powder
6. Pour batter into prepared pan
7. Press cherries into the top of the batter
8. Bake for 45 minutes or until set

title: grilled sesame chicken and salad
steps:
1. Heat grill to med-hi temp
2. Combine all of the dressing ingredients except the oils and whisk thoroughly (you can also use a blender on low to combine
3. While still whisking , slowly add the sesame oil , then the vegetable oil
4. Measure out about - cup of dressing
5. Make a foil bowl large enough to hold all of the chicken and pour half of the dressing in the bottom
6. Lay in the chicken breast in a single layer and cover with the remaining dressing
7. Close the foil bowl with the edges or additional foil
8. Place on grill and cook for 20 minutes
9. While the chicken cooks , prepare salad
10. After the twenty minutes are up , take chicken out of the foil and place directly on the grill and let cook for 5 minutes on one side , and then 3 minutes on the other side
11. Plate with some salad and cover with dressing

title: roasted potato salad
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425f
2. In large bowl , toss potatoes with 2t olive oil
3. Place potatoes in 2 jelly-roll pans
4. Roast potatoes 45 minutes , switching pans between upper and lower racks halfway through baking
5. Turn them occasionally with a pancake turner , until golden and fork tender
6. When cooked , remove to a large bowl
7. Grate peel from lemon
8. Squeeze enough juice to equal 2 tablespoons
9. Add lemon peel , lemon juice , parsley , salt , rosemary , thyme , sugar , pepper and 2 tablesoon olive oil , toss until potatoes are well coated
10. Serve potatoes warm or at room temperature

title: festival cherry chicken salad
steps:
1. Toss together well and refrigerate until chilled
2. Serve on toasted bread or croissants

title: lemon lime iced tea
steps:
1. Add tea bags to boiling water
2. Steep for 3 minute remove bags , then immediately add frozen lemonade and stir until completely dissolved
3. Sweeten with sugar or honey , if needed
4. Refrigerate at least until cold
5. Then stir in rum to taste
6. To serve , place a few ice cubes in a large pitcher
7. Thinly slice lemon and lime and add
8. Pour tea mixture overtop

title: sauerkraut and sausage in the crock pot
steps:
1. In a skillet , melt butter , saute onions and apples until onions are translucent
2. Meanwhile rinse and drain sauerkraut
3. Place in a large crock pot
4. Stir ketchup , dill and onion-apple mixture into sauerkraut
5. Slice kielbasa into 2-inch rounds
6. Stir kielbasa into sauerkraut
7. Cook on low setting for 7-9 hours

title: thai chicken salad in a spring roll bowl
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Cook chicken breasts by pan searing , poaching , baking , grilling
3. Your choice
4. Can use leftover chicken if available
5. Cut into small dice
6. Meanwhile , spray muffin tin with pam
7. Spray 8 spring roll wrappers on one side with pam
8. Place sprayed side up , one per muffin cup , pressing gently to fit
9. Bake at 350f for eight minutes until browned
10. Cool on wire rack
11. Combine dressing ingredients in large bowl , whisk well
12. To make salad: place salad ingredients in large bowl with dressing and gently toss to combine well
13. Place 3 / 4 to 1 cup salad into each crispy cup and serve immediately

title: southwestern chicken lasagna
steps:
1. Combine first 5 ingredients
2. Let stand 5 minutes
3. Set aside
4. Saute onion and garlic in hot oil in a large skillet over medium high heat 3 to 5 minutes or until tender
5. Add salsa , chili , and green chiles
6. Reduce heat , and simmer 3-4 minutes
7. Line bottom of an 11 x 7 inch baking dish with 3 tortillas
8. Layer with one half chili mixture , one half chicken mixture , and one third cheese
9. Repeat layers
10. Top with remaining tortillas
11. Sprinkle remaining cheese on top
12. Bake at 350 for 5 to 10 minutes before serving

title: easy avocado   feta cheese dip
steps:
1. In a food processor , pulse avocado , feta , onion , garlic , cilantro and jalapeno
2. Scrape down the sides of the bowl , add lemon and olive oil
3. Pulse again until smooth
4. Garnish with chopped cilantro , if desired , and serve with veggies and pita bread or tortilla chips

title: creamy pasta and portabellas
steps:
1. Prepare cavatappi according to package directions
2. Drain and set aside
3. Meanwhile clean stems of portabellas and discard
4. Slice mushrooms in thin slices and drizzle with olive oil
5. Place on parchment lined baking sheet and sprinke with kosher salt or sea salt
6. Broil approximately 4-5 minutes until lightly browned
7. Set aside
8. Place drained cavatappi in a baking dish
9. Add 2 t softened butter
10. Add ricotta and mix until blended
11. Cover with mushrooms
12. Top with mozarella
13. Bake uncovered about 15 minutes on 325f until cheese is melted
14. Remove from oven
15. Place handful of fresh arugula on each plate
16. Cover with pasta and mushrooms
17. Cut basil with sharp knife into chiffonade ribbons right before you use it
18. It will keep its flavor and aroma
19. Sprinkle with fresh basil
20. Squeeze fresh lemon on top , if desired

title: beaches and cream
steps:
1. Grease and flour an angel food cake pan
2. Preheat oven to 325 degrees
3. In a small pot over low heat , melt candy bars with cup of butter
4. Cream sugar with remaining cup of butter of butter until light
5. Add candy and blend well
6. Add egg yolks , one at a time , mixing well after each
7. Dissolve baking soda in buttermilk and add alternately with flour to candy mixture , ending with flour
8. Beat egg whites to stiff peaks and fold into candy mixture and chopped pecans
9. Bake for 1 hour , 10 minutes
10. Cool and frost with melted semi-sweet chocolate
11. Enjoy !

title: sauted grape tomatoes
steps:
1. 1
2. Saut tomatoes and next 3 ingredients in hot oil in a small skillet over medium-high heat 2 to 3 minutes or until thoroughly heated
3. Remove from heat , and stir in basil

title: vodka thyme lemonade
steps:
1. In a small saucepan , combine 2 cups water with the sugar and thyme
2. Bring to a boil over high heat , stirring occasionally , until sugar has dissolved
3. Remove from heat
4. Let cool to room temperature
5. Pour mixture through a fine sieve into a large glass measuring cup
6. Discard thyme
7. You should have 2 cups syrup
8. Cover with plastic
9. Chill
10. In a large serving pitcher , stir together lemon juice , vodka , and chilled syrup
11. Garnish with thyme
12. Divide evenly among eight tumblers filled with ice
13. Serve immediately

title: french dressing for the lazy
steps:
1. Put all the ingredients in a blender and pulse to blend in a smooth paste
2. Season with salt and pepper
3. Fill up in a clean bottle and refrigerate for 1 hour before using

title: sudden quiche lorraine
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
2. Using a fork , prick the inside of the pie shell , then bake for 8 minutes
3. Remove from oven
4. Lower the temperature to 325 degrees f
5. Meanwhile , in large skillet , cook the bacon over medium heat , stirring often , until crisp , about 5 minutes
6. Using a slotted spoon , transfer to paper towels to drain
7. Add the onion and 1 / 2 t each salt and pepper to the bacon fat in the skillet and cook over medium heat , stirring occasionally , until softened , about 5 minutes
8. Increase the heat to medium-high and cook , stirring , until the onion is golden , about 2 minutes
9. Transfer the onion to the pie shell
10. In large bowl , beat the eggs with the half-and-half , stir in the cheese and the cooked bacon
11. Pour the mixture into the pie shell
12. Bake until set , about 40 minutes
13. Let stand for 10 minutes before slicing

title: split pea soup  ww
steps:
1. In a large soup pot over medium heat heat the oil and then add onion and cook , covered for 3-5 minutes
2. Stir in carrots and celery , cook , covered , for another 3-5 minutes
3. Stir in split peas , broth and salt and bring to a boil
4. Reduce heat and simmer covered for 45 minutes
5. Stir in sweet potatoes and cook covered for 20 minutes
6. Stir in swiss chard , cover and cook for 10 more minutes

title: gin rickey
steps:
1. Combine gin and frozen limeade in shaker
2. Pour over ice in a tall glass
3. Top with club soda to your taste , some like more soda
4. Garnish with a twist of lime if desired

title: grilled marinated tri tip
steps:
1. In a marinating dish or large zip lock bag pour in marinating ingredients , stir or shake bag until sugar is dissolved
2. Add beef , covering all sides
3. Chill at least 2 hours , but may be marinated up to one day , turning occassionally
4. Drain beef , discarding marinade
5. Prepare grill using a solid bed of coals - about medium heat
6. Grill beef , turning every 5 minutes until done to desired doneness
7. Transfer to platter or cutting board and let rest 5 minutes before slicing beef into thin slanting slices , cutting across grain

title: friday night chili con carne
steps:
1. Cover beans with water in a large saucepan
2. Bring to the boil over high heat and cook for 10 minutes
3. Set aside for 1 hour to soak
4. Drain
5. Preheat oven to 160c
6. Heat half the oil in a large pan and cook the beef in it over high heat until it's brown all over
7. Set the beef aside in a large casserole dish
8. Heat the remaining oil in the same pan
9. Add the onion and peppers and cook for 5 minutes or until onion is soft
10. Add spices and cook until aromatic
11. Add tomato , jalapenos , and water and bring to the boil
12. Pour tomato mixture into the bowl containing the beef
13. Add the drained red kidney beans
14. Bake the mixture , covered , for about 2 hour or until beef and beans are tender
15. Remove dish from the oven and give it a few minutes to cool
16. Fish out all of the beef pieces and shred them up using two forks
17. Return the beef to the mixture and stir to combine
18. Serve with a dollop of sour cream and fresh coriander leaves , with crusty bread on the side

title: chubby bunnies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. In a large bowl cream margarine and brown sugar
3. Add vanilla , water and eggs and beat
4. In another bowl mix together flour , cocoa and soda and add to creamed mixture
5. Stir in chips
6. Drop by spoonfuls onto greased cookie sheets
7. Bake 7-9 minutes

title: poppy and sesame seed rolls  bread machine
steps:
1. Place the first six ingredients into your machine according to manufacturers instructions
2. Set to dough and start
3. When the dough is ready , turn it out onto a floured surface and knead and shape it into a rough 8" square
4. Brush with the beaten egg and sprinkle with the seeds
5. Take a sharp knife and cut the dough into 16 squares
6. Transfer the rolls to a baking tray and leave them for 30 minutes to rise
7. Preheat the oven to gas 5 / 375f / 190c
8. After the 30 minutes is up , bake the rolls for 25-30 minutes

title: easy crunchy toffee
steps:
1. Place the matzo crackers on a greased jellyroll pan , to cover the entire bottom
2. Bring butter and brown sugar to a boil , boil for three minutes
3. Pour the mixture over the crackers
4. Bake in preheated 350 degree oven for 15 minutes
5. Remove , sprinkle chocolate chips evenly over the top
6. Wait five minutes , then spread the melted chips over the crackers
7. Sprinkle toasted almonds over the crackers , chill
8. Break apart , and enjoy !
9. You can adapt this with saltines , simply cover the pan with them
10. I have to say , i couldn't believe how good they were , and i'm not a sugary treat kind of girl !

title: sweet potato bundt cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Grease and flour a 10- inch bundt pan
3. In a small non-reactive bowl , soak the raisins in the rum for at least 30 min or several hours
4. Meanwhile peel the sweet potatoes , cut them in half and then cut each half into 4-inch slices
5. Place the slices into a pot of cool salted water , cover and bring to a boil
6. Reduce to a gentle simmer and cook until the sweet potatoes are very tender
7. Drain off the water , allow the potatoes to air-dry for a few minutes , then use a pot masher or large fork to roughly mash them
8. Measure out 2 cups and set aside to cool
9. In a large bowl with a whisk or the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the paddle attachment beat the eggs a little just to break them up
10. Add the sugar and beat until the mixture is thick and pale , about 2 minute add the vegetable oil and vanilla , then beat to blend
11. Drain the raisins and set aside , but add cup of the rum macerating liquid to the batter
12. Add the sweet potatoes and mix thoroughly , scraping down the sides and bottom of the bowl
13. Into a separate bowl , sift the flour , baking powder , baking soda , salt cinnamon and nutmeg
14. Add the flour mixture to the batter in 3 additions , alternating with the buttermilk in 2 additions , beginning and ending with the dry
15. Fold in the raisins
16. Pour entire batter in pan
17. Bake1 hour to 1 hour and 20 min or until wooden skewer comes out clean and cake is just beginning to pull away from sides of pan
18. Cool the cake in the pan set on a wire rack for 10 min , then invert onto the rack
19. Set the rack over a baking sheet or large plate to catch the excess glaze
20. This cake must be glazed while still warm , so it absorbs the maximum syrup
21. For the glaze , combine the brown sugar , butter , and cream in a small , heavy bottomed sauced pan
22. Bring to a boil over medium heat , stirring until the sugar dissolves
23. Continue to boil until the mixture thickens somewhat , about 3 minutes , stirring often
24. Remove the glaze form the heat and stir in the rum
25. With a long wooden or metal skewer poke holes all over the cake , concentrating on the top
26. Spoon about half the warm glaze over the cake and let the cake and remaining glaze cool for 10 to 15 minutes , until it has thickened slightly
27. Pour the rest of the glaze over the cake , letting it dribble down the sides , then allow the cake to cool completely before cutting and serving or wrapping and storing

title: mexican morning potato pie
steps:
1. With non-stick spray , coat a 9 inch round glass pie plate then set aside
2. In a large mixing bowl , combine the egg , milk and 1 / 2 teaspoon of the taco seasoning then stir to combine thoroughly
3. Add the simply potatoes shredded hash browns , black beans , red pepper and cup of the cheese
4. Mix well
5. Spread mixture onto the pie plate , gently press down and top with the remaining 1 / 4 cup of cheese
6. Sprinkle the remaining 1 / 4 teaspoon taco seasoning over the cheese
7. Bake for 40-45 minutes just until the cheese melts and the center is hot
8. Remove to a wire rack and cool for 3-5 minutes , cut into wedges and serve

title: deer hunting gourmet sandwich
steps:
1. Spread butter and peanut butter on one slice of the bread
2. On the other slice , spread jam or jelly
3. Carefully place the two slices together
4. Gently slide sandwich into a plastic sandwich baggie
5. Seal baggie
6. Place in back hip pocket of hunting pants
7. Forget about baggie in pants pocket
8. Spend morning hunting and sitting , stalking and sitting , and hiking & sitting
9. Sandwich should be ready to eat--check for doneness
10. Sit down on a nearby stump , fallen log , stone outcropping and enjoy !

title: barbecued bacon and scallop brochettes
steps:
1. Wash and dry the scallops and place in a bowl with the lemon juice , dill seeds , salt and pepper
2. Leave to marinate for 30 minutes , stirring from time to time
3. Preheat the grill
4. Remove the scallops from the bowl and reserve the marinade
5. Cut the bacon rashers in half and roll 8 of the scallops in a piece of bacon
6. Spear alternative plain and bacon-wrapped scallops onto 4 skewers
7. Brush with the reserved marinade and grill for 10 minutes , turning occasionally
8. Serve hot

title: delicious ceylon pork curry
steps:
1. Add oil to pan
2. Add curry leaves and fenugreek seeds to pan , and fire for a moment or two
3. Add onions , garlic and ginger , and fry over medium heat until golden brown
4. Add diced pork , curry powder , chillies , salt , vinegar , sugar
5. Toss until pork is coated in spice mixture and until spices are fragrant
6. Add hot water , and cover pan with lid
7. Simmer for 1
8. 5 to 2 hours until pork is very tender
9. Add coconut milk , and stir
10. Taste and adjust seasoning as necessary
11. Simmer for a further 10 minutes
12. Serve with steamed rice and accompaniments like natural yogurt , cucumber , tomato & onion salad , etc

title: teriyaki beef and broccoli
steps:
1. In a large skillet , heat oil over medium high heat and stir fry the beef together with the onions until beef is just barely pink , but browned on all sides
2. Do not cook all the way through
3. Now add broth , teriyaki sauce and ginger root
4. Bring the meat and sauce to a boil , then reduce to a simmer
5. Cover and simmer until meat is done , about 10-15 minutes
6. During the last 5 minutes of cooking time , add carrots and broccoli , cover skillet again and cook until veggies are done to your liking

title: sausage  bell pepper and onion focaccia sandwiches
steps:
1. In a large skillet , saute peppers and onions , garlic paste and fennel seeds in oil over moderately-high heat , stirring , until vegetables are browned lightly
2. Cook mixture over moderate heat , stirring , for 5 minutes , or until softened
3. Season
4. Grill sausages over moderately-high heat , turning once , 6-10 minutes
5. Halve lengthwise
6. Halve focaccia squares horizontally , leaving 1 edge cut
7. Fill with pepper mixture and sausage

title: pumpkin pie by caitie girkin
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees
2. Combine ingredients , except for pie shell , in large mixing bowl until thoroughly mixed
3. Pour into 9-inch pie shell and bake at 425 degrees for 45 to 55 minutes or when knife comes out clean
4. Cover and cool
5. Serve

title: chicken a l  orange
steps:
1. Mix frozen orange juice with water , set aside
2. Over medium heat , combine butter and mrs
3. Dash garlic & herb seasoning blend
4. In a skillet , cook chicken breasts , for 4-5 minutes on each side until browned
5. Sprinkle each breast with 2 tablespoons mrs
6. Dash extra spicy seasoning blend and top each with an orange slice
7. Lower heat , pour half of orange juice mixture into skillet , cover and simmer for 15-20 minutes or until chicken is cooked
8. Remove chicken
9. Whisk cornstarch into remaining juice mixture
10. Add to pan , cook over low heat 1-2 minutes , stirring constantly until slightly thickened
11. To serve , pour sauce over chicken and garnish with orange slices

title: camembert aux noix
steps:
1. Cream softened butter until light and fluffy
2. Blend in nuts , tabasco and lemon
3. Cut camembert in half , horizontally , while still firm
4. Spread with butter mixture in between cheese halves
5. Cool in refrigerator one hour or until filling is firm
6. Slice into thin wedges and serve on crackers or toast points

title: cherry granola kugel
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Spray 13 x 9 pan with cooking spray
3. After cooking and draining egg noodles , put noodles back in cooking pot over low heat
4. Mix in 1 / 2 cup of butter and cream cheese until melted
5. Beat eggs and milk together and pour into noodle mixture
6. Add cinnamon , cherries and cherry preserves
7. Pour into 13 x 9 pan
8. Mix together granola , butter and 1 teaspoon ground cinnamon
9. Sprinkle over noodles
10. Bake for 1 hour or until golden brown

title: no bake sweetened condensed milk citrus bars
steps:
1. Melt the condensed milk , butter , sugar , lemon rind , citrus juices and vanilla over medium heat
2. Add the dessicated coconut and cookie crumbs
3. Spray a square tin with nonstick spray
4. Press the mixture evenly into the tray and cool
5. Mix the confectioners sugar with just enough lemon juice to make it spreadable
6. Spread over the cookie bar mixture
7. Chill overnight until firm and cut into small blocks

title: iceberg wedges with creamy blue cheese dressing
steps:
1. In medium bowl , whisk together mayo , 1 / 2 cup of the blue cheese , yogurt , buttermilk , and vinegar until nearly smooth
2. Mix in remaining blue cheese
3. Season with black pepper
4. Arrange lettuce wedges on 8 plates
5. Spoon dressing over wedges
