6. Sprinkle with green onions and season with additional black pepper

title: copycat mc donald s hamburgers cheeseburgers
steps:
1. Mix the dried onion with the boiling water and let sit until re hydrated and no longer dry & crunchy
2. Roll ground beef into a ball and press flat on waxed paper until about 1 / 8 inch thick
3. Brown faces of bun in a dry frying pan over medium heat
4. Remove bun and cook burger in the same pan for 2 min per side , salting each side lightly during cooking
5. On the top bun-half spread the ketchup , mustard , and onion , in the order , and top with the pickle slice
6. Put the beef patty on the bottom bun and quickly slap the top and bottom together
7. Microwave the burger on high for 10-15 seconds
8. For cheeseburgers: follow the above recipe , but add a slice of american cheese on top of the beef patty in the final assembly
9. Microwave for 15 seconds on high to help steam the bun and simulate being wrapped in paper

title: dill cucumber salad
steps:
1. In a large bowl combine first 5 ingredients
2. Add the cucumbers and onions and toss
3. Cover and chill for at least 1 hour
4. Enjoy !

title: panko crusted tilapia sticks
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425f
2. Slice tilapia filets into 1-inch wide x 3-inch long "sticks"
3. Into a shallow , wide bowl , place panko , paprika , garlic powder , onion powder , salt and pepper
4. Stir until thoroughly combined
5. In another shallow bowl , whisk egg
6. Then whisk in milk , ketchup , salt and pepper
7. Lightly coat a medium-sized baking pan with cooking spray
8. Dredge tilapia "sticks" in egg mixture , gently shake off excess liquid and drop into panko mixture
9. Pat mixture onto all sides of the fish and gently place onto baking pan , handling carefully as not to loose the coating
10. Bake for 5 minutes , rotate the baking pan and return to the oven for another 2-3 minutes
11. Allow to cool slightly , serve and enjoy !

title: irish breakfast smoothie
steps:
1. Combine everything in a food processor or blender
2. Blend until smooth and serve !

title: bobo s basic vegetable stock
steps:
1. Heat oul in a 3-quart soup pot over high heat until hot
2. Add turnips , celery , onion , leek , and carrot
3. Stir the vegetables around until they begin to cook but don't turn brown
4. Add water to stock pot
5. Bring to boil
6. Reduce heat to simmering and cook until the vegetables are very soft , about 2 hours
7. Remove pot from heat
8. Let cool
9. Strain and discard teh vegetables
10. Keeps in freezer for up to 3 months

title: grandmas brownies
steps:
1. Sift flour , sugar and cocoa together in bowl
2. In saucepan bring water , butter and oil to a boil , let boil till butter is melted
3. Pourboiling mixture over dry ingredients in bowl and beat well
4. Add buttermilk , eggs , soda and vanilla
5. Beat till well blended
6. Bake in greased jelly roll pan for 18 min at 375

title: pavlova
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Grease a 7 inch round baking pan and dust lightly with a little flour
3. Beat the egg whites until soft peaks form and gradually beat in the sugar
4. Beat until the mixture is thick and the sugar is dissolved
5. Carefully fold in the cornflour and vanilla
6. Spoon into the baking pan
7. Reduce the oven heat to 150c and place in oven
8. Bake for 1 hour
9. Let stand for 5 minutes before turning onto a serving plate
10. Allow to cool completely before decorating with the whipped cream and sliced fruit
11. If you cannot find the passionfruit , you can use raspberries or blackberries instead
12. I use both often in this recipe
13. I have also made it with all purpose flour and it turned out okay
14. I usually use it to follow up my shrimp fetucinni
15. Recipezaar
16. Com / 82472

title: mixed greens  salad with apples and maple walnut oil dressing
steps:
1. In small glass bowl , prepare salad dressing first and set aside
2. Use salad spinner to remove excess moisture from the greens
3. In large non-reactive serving bowl place the sliced apples and toss them with a little bit of apple cider to halt oxidizing
4. Next , add the salad greens , a few tablespoons of the salad dressing and toss gently again with tongs to mix
5. Serve remaining salad dressing on side along with the toasted walnuts if using
6. For best results , cut up apples and toss with the vinegar right before serving

title: mustard rubbed pork loin with blackberry mustard sauce
steps:
1. In a dry skillet over med heat , place mustard seed , fennel , coriander , cumin , and peppercorns
2. Keep moving skillet , to keep the seeds from burning
3. Cook until aromatic , about 2 minutes
4. Transfer to a spice grinder , or use a mortar and pestle to finely chop the spices , but do not grind completely to a powder
5. Transfer to a small bowl and add the thyme , dry mustard , ginger , 1 / 2 tsp salt , and sugar
6. Set aside
7. Heat oven to 425f rub pork with 1 tbsp dijon mustard , sprinkle with 1 / 2 tsp salt and 2 tbsp spice mixture
8. Pat with hands to stick
9. Spray a small roasting pan with cooking spray and place pork in pan
10. Bake about 25 minutes , transfer to cutting board and let rest covered loosely with foil
11. Place roasting pan on stove over med-high heat , stir in wine and deglaze the pan
12. Stir in chicken stock
13. Cook , stirring occasionally , until reduced by half , about 5-7 minutes
14. Whisk together flour and 1 / 4 cup water , then whisk into the sauce
15. Whisk in remaining tablespoon dijon mustard
16. Cook until mixture thickens , 2-3 minutes
17. Stir in the berries
18. Cook until they begin to soften , about 2 minutes
19. Slice pork , transfer to a platter , and serve with the sauce
20. Garnish with fresh thyme if desired

title: asian chickpea and coriander dip
steps:
1. In a blender or food processor grind coriander and garlic briefly
2. Add the remaining ingredients and process to a reasonably smooth paste , adding 1 tablespoon of water if too thick or dry
3. Spoon into a bowl and serve with trident rice crackers

title: boiled radishes
steps:
1. Trim ends and bad spots off radishes
2. Boil radishes in water until fork tender
3. Best served with butter and a little parsley

title: rice stuffed bell peppers
steps:
1. Cut off tops of green peppers
2. Remove seeds
3. Cook peppers 5 minutes in boiling salted water
4. Drain and set aside
5. Combine the rice , tomatoes , butter , and onion soup mix
6. Fill peppers with rice mixture
7. Place in a 9-inch square baking dish
8. Pour inch hot water into dish
9. Bake in a preheated 350 oven for 25 minutes
10. Sprinkle cheese over the top
11. Bake 5 more minutes

title: frittata with ham and roasted pepper
steps:
1. In a bowl , with a whisk , whisk eggs , milk and dijon mustard
2. Add croutons , ham and half the cheese , half bell peppers and half green onions
3. Pour the mixture of eggs in a greased pie plate of 9 inches or an 8 inches greased square pan
4. Sprinkle with remaining cheese , bell pepper and green onion
5. Cook in a preheated oven of 350 f for about 20 minutes or until the frittata is golden and the eggs are set
6. Keep cooking under the preheated grill for about 2 minutes or until frittata is golden and is lightly puffed
7. Put the pan on a rack and let cool for 5 minutes
8. Use a spatula to loosen the edges from the pan and cut in wedges

title: calico bean soup recipe from mix
steps:
1. If desired , omit ham and substitute beef , chicken , or vegetable stock for the cooking water
2. Wash beans thoroughly
3. Place in a large kettle , cover with water and soak overnight
4. Next drain beans and add 2 quarts of new water and ham or ham hock
5. Simmer slowly for 2-1 / 2 to 3 hours
6. Then add spice packet , onion , tomatoes , lemon juice and salt to taste
7. Simmer another 30 minutes or until beans are tender
8. Take ham from soup
9. Remove any bits of ham from bone and return to soup
10. If using boneless ham , cut into bite-size pieces and return to soup
11. Serve

title: broccoli and avocado salad
steps:
1. First place cubed avoacdo in bowl and toss with 1 tablespoon of lemon juice to prevent darkening
2. Fill a saucepan with water and bring to a boil
3. Add the broccoli and cook until barely tender , about 3 minutes
4. Drain , cool under cold water , drain again
5. Add broccoli to avocado and add in nuts
6. In a small bowl whisk remaining 1 tablespoon lemon juice , mustard , parsley and oil in a stream until blended
7. Pour dressing over the salad and toss gently
8. Enjoy !

title: red lobster cheese biscuits
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. In a medium bowl , stir cheese into baking mix
3. Add milk
4. Stir just until ingredients are thoroughly combined and evenly moistened
5. Drop by rounded spoonfuls onto a parchment-lined baking sheet
6. Place on asecond baking sheet
7. Place in upper third of oven
8. Bake about 12 minutes or until just beginning to brown
9. Slide parchment with biscuits off pan
10. Melt margarine
11. Stir in garlic salt and parsley flakes
12. Brush over hot biscuits
13. Serve warm
14. Yield: 12 biscuits
15. Spoon into a measuring cup , overfill and level off with back of knife or a spoon handle
16. Do not shake cup to level

title: roast chicken with cumin  paprika and allspice
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Rinse chicken
3. Pat dry
4. Place chicken on rack in large roasting pan
5. Stir oil and next 7 ingredients in small bowl to form paste
6. Rub spice paste all over chicken
7. Roast chicken 1 hour
8. Squeeze juice from lemon halves over chicken , place lemon halves inside main cavity
9. Continue to roast until chicken is cooked through and thermometer inserted into thickest part of thigh registers 175 , about 1 hour longer
10. Transfer to platter , let stand 15 minutes

title: creole sweet potatoes  corn and squash bake
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 190c
2. Add the sweet potatoes to a saucepan of boiling water
3. Simmer uncovered over medium heat for 6 minutes
4. Add the squashes and simmer for 4 minutes , or until both vegetables are nearly tender but not too soft
5. Drain and rinse the vegetables with cold water
6. Cut squashes and sweet potatoes into 2 centimeter dice
7. Heat the oil in a medium saute pan
8. Add the onion , pepper and celery and cook over medium low heat , stirring , until onion begins to brown , about 7 minutes
9. Add garlic and cook for another 1 / 2 minute
10. Add the tomatoes , bay leaf , paprika , salt and pepper and bring to a boil
11. Cook uncovered over medium heat , stirring often , for 10 minutes or until the sauce is thick
12. Discard the bay leaf
13. Add the oregano , thyme and hot sauce to taste
14. Add the squash , corn and sweet potatoes to the sauce
15. Season to taste with salt and pepper
16. Spoon into a 2-liter casserole
17. Cover and bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until the vegetables are tender

title: mushroom gratin
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425
2. Heat butter in a skillet over medium-low heat
3. When butter is foamy , add mushrooms and cook until lightly browned , stirring frequently
4. In a bowl , whisk together the sour cream , egg yolk , and salt and pepper
5. Stir this into the mushrooms
6. Heat through , stirring frequently
7. Pour the mixture into a baking dish and sprinkle with the parsley and shredded cheeses
8. Bake at 425 for about 12 minutes , until cheese is melted

title: sucre la creme
steps:
1. In a large microwave-safe bowl , stir together the white sugar , brown sugar and cream
2. Cook at full power for 10 minutes , stirring twice
3. Let stand for 5 minutes
4. Use an electric mixer on low speed to beat the mixture for 4 minutes
5. Pour into a buttered 8 inch square glass baking dish & refrigerate for 1 hour or until firm
6. Cut into squares when set

title: hare krishna almond salad dressing
steps:
1. Blend all ingredients with half of the water in a blender
2. When almonds are pureed , add remaining water a little bit at a time until desired thickness
3. Dressing should appear thin as it will thicken upon sitting for more than a half hour

title: annie s spinach salad
steps:
1. Combine first five ingredients in blender and mix thoroughly
2. Refrigerate dressing until ready to serve
3. Combine remaining ingredients and toss with dressing
4. Sprinkle with grated parmesan cheese and mix well

title: mini apple strudels
steps:
1. Combine the apples , sugar , walnuts , flour and cinnamon
2. Set aside
3. Spray a baking sheet with cooking spray
4. Set aside
5. Place one sheet of phyllo dough on a work surface
6. Spray with buttered flavored cooking spray
7. Fold in half widethwise
8. Spray with flavored spray
9. Spoon 1 / 3 cup filling onto phyllo dough fold side and edges over filing and roll up
10. Place seam side down on a baking sheet
11. Continue same process with remaining dough and filling
12. Cut diagonal slits in tops of studels
13. Spray strudels with butter-flavored cooking spray
14. Bake at 350 for 20-22 minutes or until golden brown
15. Sprinkle with confectioners' sugar if desired

title: chop lickin chicken casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Cut chicken into bitesize pieces and saute in pam coated skillet until no longer pink and slightly browned
3. In a bowl combine soup , water , mushrooms , rice , broccoli and cooked chicken
4. Pour into an 11x9 inch pan sprayed with pam
5. Sprinkle with cheese and bake for 30 minutes

title: chipotle pork cheeseburger
steps:
1. Gently mix pork , chipotle , garlic , and a teaspoon of salt
2. Form mixture into four 1 / 2-inch thick patties
3. Oil grill rack , cook pork patties to 155 degrees , top each with a slice of cheddar jack
4. Spread buns with mayonnaise and assemble burgers with tomatillo , avocado , and cilantro
5. Please disregard the posted 10 minute cooking time , it was put there just so the recipe would post

title: iced tea  sweet
steps:
1. Place the 6 cups of water and the tea bag in a microwave safe container
2. Push the tea bag down into the water to thoroughly soak the tea bag
3. Microwave in high power for 7 minutes
4. Remove and let rest 5 minutes
5. Heat the 1 cup of water in the microwave on high until it just starts to boil
6. Remove and slowly pour in the 1 cup of sugar , stirring to dissolve
7. When the sugar has completely dissolved , add this mixture into the 6 cups of brewed tea
8. Squeeze the tea bag and discard
9. Add the 4 cups of commercial ice to the brewed tea and dissolved'sugar water' mixture
10. To serve , pour into a glass or mug that has been filled with additional ice
11. Serve with a fresh lemon or lime wedge

title: shrimp and sausage boil
steps:
1. In a 12 to 16 quart pot , bring 2 gallons water to boiling
2. Add shrimp or crab boil and old bay seasoning
3. Reduce heat
4. Simmer , uncovered , 10 minutes
5. Add potatoes , a few at a time , allowing water to continue simmering
6. Simmer 7 to 10 minutes , untl nearly tender
7. Add corn
8. Simmer , uncovered , 5 minutes
9. Add sausage and shrimp
10. Simmer 3 to 5 minutes , until shrimp are almost opaque and sausage is heated through
11. Drain
12. Transfer to large platter
13. Add lemon halves and sprinkle with parsley
14. Serve hot or within 1 hour of cooking
15. Pass garlic mayo and cocktail sauce

title: rice cheesecake pudding
steps:
1. In rice cooker prepare rice as for 2
2. (
3. The cup that comes with your cooker is much smaller than a normal measuring cup
4. So you need to go by your rice cooker for your measurement
5. For instance my cup that came with my rice cooker actually only holds 2 / 3 of a regular measuring cup , so according to the recipe it would actually be 2 / 3 cup of rice)
6. Put in above spices & raisins
7. Let all cook till done
8. While rice is cooking , make up 1 box of cheesecake pudding mix with milk
9. When rice is done add sugar & prepared pudding
10. Eat warm or refrigerate till cold--good either way !

title: bulgarian pepper and cheese casserole
steps:
1. Soak bulghar in boiling water during prep time
2. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
3. Grease small casserole dish with 1 / 2 tablespoons of butter
4. On medium heat , saute remaining butter and chopped onions until soft
5. Stir in mushrooms and peppers , and heat through
6. Add tamari , sherry , marjoram and salt and pepper , then remove from heat
7. In a small bowl , mix cheeses and beaten egg together
8. Put bulghar evenly in casserole pan
9. Cover with pepper mixture , then cheese mixture and dust with paprika
10. Bake 40 minutes , uncovered

title: bitter melon and eggs  mara pad kai
steps:
1. Cut the bitter melon in half lengthwise , remove the seeds and slice each half crosswise in thin pieces
2. Beat the eggs in a bowl with 1 to 2 tsp of light soy sauce and a dash of ground white pepper
3. Heat a wok until its surface begins to smoke
4. Swirl in the oil and let heat 10 to 15 seconds
5. Add the bitter melon and saut in the oil for about one minute
6. Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon of light soy sauce and continue to saut for another 1 to 2 minutes , or until the melon starts to soften
7. Spread the melon pieces thinly over the wok surface
8. Pour the beaten eggs evenly over the melon pieces
9. Let eggs set about half a minute , then flip the mixture over to cook the other side
10. Cook until eggs are set and lightly browned

title: chickpea burger
steps:
1. Peel the carrots , grate them coarsely and set them aside
2. Peel and roughly chop the garlic
3. Drain and rinse the chickpeas and put them into a food processor with the garlic , ground spices , salt and pepper
4. Slightly process to obtain a rough paste then add the carrot , egg , and flour and process briefly until evenly mixed but slightly rugged
5. Heat the oil in a frying pan and divide the mixture into 8
6. Fry in batches for 23 minutes on each side , until golden , then drain on kitchen paper
7. Keep opened chickpea can to cut round shapes in bread slices
8. Toast each slice in toaster or in frying pan
9. Serve with slices of tomato and red onions and mayonnaise

title: latholemono
steps:
1. Combine the olive oil , lemon juice and oregano in a small glass bowl and season to taste with salt and pepper
2. Stir well again , just before serving or using

title: hamburger and rice a roni
steps:
1. Brown hamberger
2. Drain grease
3. Follow the directions on rice-a-roni
4. When you add the water mix in the hamberger
5. Cover continue to cook at simmer 15-20 min or
6. Until rice is tender

title: i love brussels sprouts
steps:
1. Bring the water and salt to a boil
2. While the water comes to a boil remove the sprouts from the stalk and trim them well , cut and 'x' into the stem end and wash
3. Divide them into 2 cup portions and blanch in the boiling water for 4 to 5 minutes making sure not to over-cook them
4. They should still have a crunch to them
5. Drop into very cold water for 30 seconds to set the color and then let them come to room temperature on a tea-tower lined sheet pan
6. You can freeze them once they are cool and then seal them in a food saver , or continue with your recipe
7. Continue with your recipe -or- just before serving , melt the butter in a pan and when the butter almost stops sizzling add 2 cups of the blanched brussels sprouts and toss them in the butter until you can easily pierce them with the
8. Serve piping hot

title: moroccan pasta salad with tuna
steps:
1. Mix the olive oil , mayo , & spices together in a small bowl
2. Mix the other ingredients together in a large bowl
3. Then stir the mayo mixture in with the pasta
4. Serve cold

title: curried chickpeas with cilantro
steps:
1. If you are using dry chickpeas , soak and cook them , according to the package directions
2. If you are using canned chickpeas , drain and rinse them
3. In a 2 quart saucepan , saute onion , garlic , pepper , cardamom , cumin , corriander , curry powder , tumeric , and mustard seeds in oil
4. When the onions are soft , add the cilantro
5. Adding water as necessary , stir constantly to cook the cilantro , about 1-2 minutes
6. Add chickpeas
7. Stir and cook until heated through , about 1-2 minutes
8. Serve over brown rice

title: savoury baked pork chops
steps:
1. Season chops with salt& pepper if you wish
2. Roll in a plastic bag containing all-purpose flour and a little dried sage
3. Let sit 5 minutes then dredge again
4. Brown the chops in a small amount of oil , on top of stove
5. Put chops into a casserole , in a single layer
6. Blend together and pour over the chops: water , brown sugar , bay leaves , sour cream and wine or vinegar
7. Bake in a 325-350f oven for 1 1 / 2 hours or until chops are tender and white inside

title: patty s cake with espresso caramel sauce
steps:
1. Grease and flour 2 81 / 2 by 41 / 2 inch loaf pans
2. Put the chocolate , butter and coffee in a large heavy saucepan
3. Place over low heat , stirring constantly until chocolate is melted , then stir vigorously until mixture is smooth and blended
4. Set aside to cool for 10 mins , then beat in the bourbon eggs and vanilla
5. Sift dry ingredients and beat into the chocolate mixture until well blended
6. Divide batter between pans and bake in a 275 oven for 50 mins , until a wooden skewer comes out clean
7. Cool in pans for 15 mins , then turn out onto racks to cool completely
8. Serve with whipped cream , creme fraiche or expresso caramel sauce
9. "espresso caramel sauce
10. "
11. Whisk the sugar into water and pour into heavy bottom saucepan
12. Stir over med heat until sugar is dissolved , increase heat and bring to a boil
13. Do not stir , but wash down sides of pan frequently with a brush dipped in water
14. Meanwhile heat the cream to a simmer in another pan
15. When sugar begins to caramelize , lift pan carefully and swirl mixture to even caramelization
16. Boil until syrup is a beautiful brown color , about 3-4 mins
17. Remove from heat and set pan in sink
18. Slowly pour cream into the syrup , whisking to combine
19. Be careful as it may splatter
20. !
21. Stir in espresso and stir until smooth
22. If mixture starts to harden , return to low heat and whisk until dissolved

title: rice salad from india
steps:
1. To the cooled rice add the apple , green peas , cauliflower florets , salt and pepper
2. Now add lemon juice and toss well and transfer to serving dish lined with mixed lettuce leaves
3. Garnish rice salad with shredded cabbage and cilantro leaves

title: deluxe dressing for fruit salads
steps:
1. Cook all ingredients except whipped cream in double boiler until thick
2. When consistency of pudding , take off from heat
3. Pour into bowl and chill in refrigerator until ready to serve
4. Whip 1 cup of heavy whipping cream until stiff and fold into chilled mixture until smooth
5. Best served over assorted , cut up fruits

title: pasta with creamy bacon and pea sauce
steps:
1. This is another recipe with a really simple sauce , so before you start any really cooking you want to bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and drop your pasta
2. Make sure to reserve a cup or so of the cooking water
3. We started cooking the sauce as the water began to boil and the timing seemed to work out perfectly
4. In a large , high-sided pan , melt the butter and olive oil together over medium heat
5. Toss the bacon into the pan with some pepper and cook until crispy and golden brown , about five minutes
6. Add the peas to the pan , stirring to combine
7. Give the peas a minute or two to defrost , then add the creme friache and mint
8. Stir until the creme friache has melted and coated everything nicely
9. Season with salt and pepper
10. Drain the pasta and add it directly to the sauce pan
11. Pour the lemon juice over the pasta and stir everything to combine well , making sure the sauce coats each piece of pasta nicely
12. Finally , mix in the parmesan cheese
13. Add some of the cooking liquid to thin out the sauce if desired

title: bananas foster french toast
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 , slice bread
2. For batter , whisk eggs , milk , sugar , vanilla and salt
3. Pour into a shallow dish-one that can hold 4 slices , like a casserole
4. Soak bread in batter 1-1 1 / 2 minutes
5. Then flip slices over and soak 1-1 1 / 2 minutes more
6. Now , heat an ovenproof skillet over medium heat
7. Add oil to the skillet , then add the soaked bread slices
8. Saute on one side until golden brown
9. Flip the bread over , immediately transfer the skillet to the oven , and bake for 10 minutes
10. The toast will puff up-like a souffle
11. While the french toast is in the oven , make the quick bananas foster syrup
12. Bananas foster syrup-----------------
13. In a large saute pan over medium heat , stir together butter , brown sugar , maple syrup , dark rum and cinnamon
14. When mixture is syrupy , toss fruit in syrup just till heated through , 1 minute
15. Spoon over french toast and garnish with pecans

title: apple cranberry pork roast
steps:
1. Brown roast on all sides in skillet in canola oil , and place in slow cooker
2. Add remaining ingredients
3. Cover , and cook on low 6-8 hours

title: country fried steak in paradise
steps:
1. Stir together 1 / 2 cup flour , cornmeal , 1 / 2 teaspoon salt , 1 / 2 teaspoon pepper , red pepper , and garlic powder in a shallow dish
2. Cut steak into 4 pieces , and dredge in flour mixture
3. Heat bacon drippings in a large cast-iron skillet until hot
4. Add steak , and cook 3 to 5 minutes or until browned , turning once
5. Cover , reduce heat , and cook 15 minutes
6. Uncover and cook 10 minutes or until crisp , turning once
7. Drain on paper towels , reserving drippings in skillet
8. Transfer steak to a serving platter
9. Heat reserved drippings in skillet
10. Whisk in 2 tablespoons flour , and cook , whisking constantly , until browned
11. Gradually whisk in milk , and cook , whisking constantly , 3 to 5 minutes or until thickened
12. Stir in remaining 1 / 4 teaspoon salt and remaining 1 / 2 teaspoon pepper
13. Serve gravy with steak

title: jarlsberg cheese dip
steps:
1. Shred cheese in bowl
2. Add mayonnaise , scallions & onion
3. Mix well
4. Put in fridge until ready to serve
5. Serve as a spread with assorted crackers

title: shrimp pasta with a chilli tomato alfredo
steps:
1. Boil pasta as directed on package
2. While pasta cooks , prepare the sauce
3. Place a 12 inches saute or sauce pan on medium-low heat
4. Add the olive oil , and melt the butter
5. While that happens , but the shrimp in a bowl and season with half of the essence , mix well , add a pinch of salt , and put in the pan
6. Turn the heat to medium-high , and saute each side of the shrimp until fully cooked
7. Once cooked , put the shrimp in a bowl and set aside
8. Add a dash more of olive oil , and put in the green chillis and garlic
9. Once garlic is fragrant , add the carrots , zuchinni , and shallots
10. Once all the vegitables start to caramlize , add in all the heavy cream
11. Reduce heat to medium-low
12. Let the cream reduce , until thick
13. Drain the pasta if done
14. Put the shrimp back in the pan followed by the crushed / diced tomatoes
15. Start mildly braking apart the tomatoes
16. Add more salt and pepper
17. Then put the spaggetti in the pan
18. Mix well and let it simmer for 5 minutes
19. Add in the basil and oregano and chilli powder
20. Mix well
21. Remove from heat , and add cilantro and parmesan
22. Serve hot and watch your family attack !

title: reuben meatloaf
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients except last 3 in medium bowl
2. Press 1 / 2 of mixture in bottom of loaf pan
3. Make slight indentation , lengthwise down center of meatloaf
4. Combine all the filling mixture and put in indentation
5. Top with remaining meat mixture , pressing to enclose filling and sealing edges
6. Bake at 350 degrees for approximately 1 hour
7. Let stand for 5 minutes

title: weight watcher easy cheesy eggplant casserole  3 ww points
steps:
1. Grill eggplant on george foreman grill for about 5-10 minutes until soft
2. Spray 8x8 baking pan with nonstick spray
3. Put eggplant on bottom of pan
4. Spread spaghetti sauce over eggplant
5. Mix cottage cheese and mozzarella , and spread it over sauce
6. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese
7. Bake at 350 for 30-35 minutes and serve hot
8. Serving size : 4
9. Per serving: 154 calories
10. 6g fat
11. 15g protein
12. 12g carbohydrate
13. 13mg cholesterol
14. 473mg sodium

title: sugar free berry striped pops
steps:
1. Puree strawberries with 1 tablespoon nutrasweet in blender
2. Divide mixture evenly between 12 cups or popsicle molds
3. Freeze about 30 minutes or until firm
4. Meanwhile , rinse processor
5. Puree kiwi with 1 tablespoon nutrasweet
6. Set aside
7. Repeat process with peaches and remaining 1 tablespoon nutrasweet
8. When strawberry layer is firm , pour kiwi mixture into molds
9. Insert popsicle sticks and freeze for about 30 minutes or until firm
10. Pour peach mixture into molds and freeze until firm
11. When firm they are ready to serve

title: super easy raspberry sauce  made from jam
steps:
1. Pour jam and water into medium-sized saucepan over low-medium heat
2. Stir continuously until jam melts into smooth sauce
3. We drizzled the sauce over white chocolate cake--delicious !

title: coconut crusted key lime pie
steps:
1. Lightly coat a 9-inch tart tin plate with nonstick vegetable spray
2. In a bowl , stir together the flour , sugar , and 1 / 4 cup of the coconut
3. With fingers or a pastry blender , work in the butter until the mixture looks like coarse meal
4. Sprinkle on 2 to 3 tablespoons of the egg water and blend together
5. Form into a disc and wrap in plastic
6. Refrigerate for at least 1 / 2 hour
7. Roll the dough into a 9 1 / 2-inch round and fit into the tart tin
8. Mix together the remaining 2 cups coconut , egg whites , confectioners' sugar and vanilla
9. Lightly press mixture against the sides of the tin
10. Chill for 30 minutes then bake in a preheated 375-degree f oven for 8 minutes , until just set
11. Key lime filling: in a bowl , mix together the yolks , sweetened condensed milk , key lime zest and juice
12. Pour it into the shell and bake in a preheated 325 degree f oven for 18 minutes and just set
13. Set on a rack to cool , refrigerate until chilled

title: the best artichoke dip
steps:
1. Drain all oil and liquid from the artichoke hearts in colander
2. Coarsly chop the artichokes
3. Combine all ingredients in crock pot and place bread slices on top to soak up excess oil
4. Cook on high for 2 hours
5. Can also be done in a casserole dish in the oven at 350 for 1 hour

title: vegetarian okra stew
steps:
1. Saute the chopped onion and garlic in the olive oil just till soft
2. Add the tomato paste and saute for another 30 seconds and then add the diced tomatoes and mix well
3. Season with the nutmeg , cumin , allspice , hot pepper and salt and pepper and stir
4. Add the water to the mixture , mix and bring to a slight boil
5. Add the okra , cover your pan and lower the heat to simmer the stew
6. Let the stew simmer until it has thickened and the okra is nice and soft , continue to mix during the simmering process
7. Taste the stew before serving to make sure your seasoning is right as the flavors should intensify as the stew reduces
8. Add more water if your stew is overwhelming or add more spice if it is not to your liking
9. Serve over rice or just in a bowl with some naan or pita bread

title: pakistani style aloo ka salan tarkari
steps:
1. In a wok , heat oil
2. Then add red chilies , stir them for 10 seconds & add cumin seeds
3. Stir fry them for 10 seconds & add potatoes
4. Mix the potatoes well add tomatoes , salt , red chili powder , turmeric powder and coriander powder
5. Mix again
6. Cover & let them cook on medium low heat till the tomatoes get tenderized & the potatoes get almost 75% done
7. Now add mint leaves & green chilies
8. Mix , cover & cook on low heat for another 15 minutes or till the oil separates & your aloo ka salan gets done
9. Enjoy with hara raita & roti / chapati

title: biker buffalo chili con carne
steps:
1. In a large pot render salt pork
2. Brown meat , salt and pepper to taste
3. Add chili powder , cumin , garlic , and onions
4. Cook 30-45 minutes , stirring often
5. Puree chili pods with a small amount of beer
6. Strain oregano from beer
7. Add chili puree , oregano infused beer , paprika , vinegar , 2 / 3 of beef broth , green chiles , chipotle , tomatoes , and ibarra mexican chocolate
8. Add tabasco to taste
9. Simmer 30-45 minutes
10. Dissolve masa flour in remaining broth
11. Add to mixture
12. Simmer another 30 minutes

title: sweet potato and lentil soup
steps:
1. Heat the olive oil in a pan and add the leek
2. Cook until the leek is soft , stir in the cumin seeds and cook for 1 minute
3. Add the lentils , sweet potato and stock
4. Bring to the boil and cook for 20 mins or until the lentils are soft
5. Ladle into the bowl and top with a spoonful of yogurt
6. Enjoy

title: cool whip frosting
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , combine pudding mix with milk and vanilla
2. Mix until smooth
3. Gently fold in whipped topping until no streaks remain
4. Spread evenly over cake

title: caramelized lemongrass chicken thighs
steps:
1. Remove skins and extra fat from chicken
2. Remove the outer leaves from the lemongrass , cut into 1 inch pieces , and pound until somewhat flattened with a meat tenderizer
3. Crush garlic and blend with lemongrass , fish sauce , sugar , and pepper
4. Add chicken and toss to coat well
5. Marinate 3-4 hours
6. If needed , you can marinate for 15 minutes and cook- the flavor will be less intense , but it will still work if you're in a hurry
7. Remove chicken from marinade
8. Heat oil in a pan with a tight-fitting lid
9. Brown the chicken in the oil
10. Pour the remaining marinade into the pan , and add enough water to just cover the bottom of the pan
11. Bring the liquid to a boil , then cover tightly and simmer until the chicken is tender , turning occassionally
12. Stir lemon juice into sauce , and stir to coat chicken
13. Serve hot

title: three sisters casserole
steps:
1. Topping:
2. Whisk cornmeal , salt and chili powder with 4 1 / 2 cups water in double boiler
3. Cook 40 minutes or until thick and stiff stirring 3 to 4 times
4. Remove from heat
5. Filling:
6. Preheat to 375f heat 2 tbsp oil in saucepan over med
7. Heat
8. Add onion and cook about 7 minutes or until softened
9. Stir often
10. Add the pepper and cook 5 minutes more
11. Stir in squash , tomatoes , garlic , coriander , and cumin
12. Cook 5 minutes , stir occasionally
13. Stir in 1 / 2 cup water and salt
14. Bring to boil
15. Reduce heat to medium low and simmer , partially covered for 10 to 15 minutes or until squash is tender
16. Stir in beans and corn and cook 5 minutes or until slightly thickened , stir occasionally
17. Coat a baking dish with spray
18. Spread 2 cups polenta over bottom of dish
19. Spoon mix inches smooth remaining polenta over the top
20. Score casserole into 6 squares with knife
21. Brush top with remaining oil
22. Bake 30 minutes or until headed through and top is lightly browned

title: mexican lasagna casserole  vegan
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. In a non-stick pan with a little water , saut the pepper , garlic , and onion for about 5-10 minutes , or until softened
3. Place mix in a medium bowl and add diced tomatoes , cilantro and chives
4. Mix well and set aside
5. Spray a 9 x 13-inch baking pan with non-stick spray
6. Line the bottom with a layer of tortillas
7. Cover most of the bottom of the pan
8. For reference: i use four tortillas on the bottom , three for the next layer and three for the final layer
9. Place 1 cans of the refried beans in a small bowl , stir , and spread evenly over the tortillas
10. Cover the refried beans with half of the pepper-onion-tomato mixture
11. Sprinkle entire dish lightly with 1 / 2 tsp cumin
12. Cover with half the can of corn
13. Cover with half the can of beans
14. Cover with 1 / 2 the salsa , add another layer of tortillas and repeat above layers
15. Cover with a final layer of tortillas
16. Sprinkle with black olives
17. Top with the remaining 1 cup salsa
18. Bake for about 30 minutes or until hot throughout
19. If allowed to cool for about 10 minutes , it will be easier to cut

title: peas with chives
steps:
1. In a skillet over medium high heat melt butter
2. Add shallots and saute until tender
3. Stir in peas and broth
4. Cook for 5-10 minutes or until peas are tender
5. Stir in chives and season with salt and pepper

title: chocolate shortbread balls
steps:
1. Method:
2. Cream the buter and castor sugar until light and creamy
3. Add in the water
4. Add in the sifted flour and work into a manageable
5. Dough
6. Cut chocolate into small blocks
7. Shape pieces of dough around the blocks of chocolate
8. And roll into small balls
9. Bake on a greased baking sheet at 180 degrees celius
10. For 15-20 minutes
11. Roll in icing sugar while still warm

title: top secret peanut butter frosting
steps:
1. Stir flour into milk
2. Cook on low heat in a small saucepan until boiling , stirring constantly
3. Transfer to a small bowl
4. Cover with plastic wrap and let cool on the counter-top for 30 minutes
5. Add the rest of the ingredients and beat with a hand-mixer until fluffy
6. Store in the fridge
7. Variations a softened 8-oz
8. Block of philadelphia cream cheese may be beaten in for a richer frosting
9. Hershey's unsweetened cocoa powder can be added a tablespoonful at a time until desired flavor / color has been achieved
10. This produces a rich-tasting chocolate / peanut butter frosting

title: fool medemmas   fava beans
steps:
1. Pour the beans into a pot and bring to a boil
2. Mix them well and add remaining
3. Bring to a boil again , then reduce to medium heat and cook for about 5 minutes
4. This dish is usually eaten with pita bread

title: rice sausage casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325
2. Brown sausage and hamburger in skillet with pepper and cayenne pepper and drain grease
3. In 9x13" pan , combine rice and meats
4. In a bowl , mix soups and water and stir into meat and rice mixture
5. Cover with foil and bake at 325 for 1 hour

title: hummus spread
steps:
1. For the beans: rinse beans and pick over
2. Place in a large pot , cover by at-least 2" with water bring to a boil for 2 minutes , turn off stove and let them sit until cooled to room temperature
3. About 2 hours
4. Drain beans and rinse
5. Rinse out pot and return beans , again , cover with water , add garlic and bay leaf , bring to a boil , reduce to simmer cook until tender , 45 minutes to 1 hour
6. Drain and cool
7. For the tahini: place sesame seeds and sesame oil in the food processor , grind until it's formed a paste
8. If it seems dry add some of the olive oil
9. For the hummus: add garlic to the hummus and pulse until finely chopped
10. Add beans and turn on processor , drizzle olive oil into processor , allow to run until desired consistency is reached
11. Add salt and pepper to taste and pulse until mixed
12. Optional: you can replace some of the olive oil with a bit of reduced fat sour cream to attain the desired creaminess without as much fat

title: country style ribs and potato wedges
steps:
1. Saute onion in 1 tbps oil until softened , add remaining sauce ingredients , and cook until reduced to a thick barbecue sauce consistently , about 20-30 minutes
2. Puree in blender or with stick blender , if desired
3. Allow to cool to room temperature
4. Preheat oven to 400f
5. Meanwhile , sprinkle ribs generously with rub
6. You will probably not use all the rub , leftovers are good on chicken , vegetables , etc
7. Allow to sit while the sauce finishes reducing
8. Toss potatoes with remaining oil and a little more rub
9. Cook ribs on charcoal or indoor grill , on medium heat until cooked through and nicely browned , about 20 minutes
10. Meanwhile , bake potatoes on a large baking sheet , about 20 minutes
11. Toss ribs in sauce , reserving some for dipping , if desired

title: broccoli apple soup
steps:
1. Heat oil in large pot with lid
2. Add broccoli , thyme , onion , apple and celery
3. Cover and cook over low heat 10 minutes
4. Add stock and pepper , cook 30 minutes more
5. Remove from heat and cool slightly
6. Puree 1 cup at a time in blender or food processor
7. Serve hot or chilled , garnished with a dollop of yogurt and sprinkling of minced parsley
8. Makes 5 1 / 2 cups

title: sprout n burger
steps:
1. Brown burger , and drain
2. Add bean sprouts
3. Add rest of ingredients
4. Stir and heat throughly
5. Serve with vegies and salad

title: easy red and white pizza sauce with a kick
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together and spread onto pizza dough or bread
2. Adjust the amounts of the 3 different ingredients to suit your particular liking :~)

title: pork chops   french fried onions
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. In a 12x8 inch baking dish , layer half of potatoes and 1 / 2 can french fried onions
3. Top with mushrooms and remaining potatoes
4. In another pan , melt butter
5. Stir in soy sauce , mustard , cayenne pepper sauce and garlic powder
6. Brush half of soy sauce mixture over potatoes
7. In a large skillet , heat oil
8. Brown pork chops
9. Drain
10. Arrange chops over potatoes and brush with remaining soy sauce mixture
11. Bake , covered , for 1 hour
12. Bake , uncovered , for an additional 15 minutes or until chops and potatoes are done
13. Top chops with remaining onions
14. Bake , uncovered , 5 minutes longer or until onions are golden brown

title: pasta puttanesca
steps:
1. Heat large saucepan over medium heat
2. Add olive oil and allow to heat for a minute
3. Add garlic and saute for 2 minutes making sure not to brown the garlic
4. Add tomatoes , olives , anchovies , capers , oregano , and red pepper flakes
5. Simmer will pasta water boils and pasta cooks

title: carne asado
steps:
1. Sort through the stew meat , trimming off excess fat , gristle
2. Cut into 1" pieces
3. If necessary
4. In medium-sized , heavy pot , place enough bacon drippings or melted lard to cover the bottom
5. Place stew meat , garlic and onion in the pot and saute until the meat is lightly browned
6. Add water to cover and add two or three tablespoons of beef bouillon , cumin , pepper and tomato sauce
7. Cover
8. Simmer on low heat until meat is tender
9. Toward the end of the cooking time , add flour to thicken and continue simmering , stirring from time to time , for an additional 10 minute
10. Remove from heat and serve with rice and refried beans
11. Warm flour tortillas also go well with this dish

title: white chocolate pistachio bark
steps:
1. Toast the pistachios in the oven at 350 degrees or in a dry skillet on the stovetop
2. They go from perfect to burnt quickly , so watch closely
3. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil and set aside
4. Chop the chocolate and melt in the top of a double boiler over simmering water , or in the microwave oven , stirring frequently
5. Stir in the cranberries and pistachios
6. Pour onto the foil-lined sheet , spreading evenly
7. Chill for 1 hour or until set
8. Remove from foil and break into pieces

title: simple roasted tomato and garlic sauce
steps:
1. Slice tomatoes in half
2. Slice top 1 / 2 inch off of garlic to expose cloves
3. Arrange garlic and tomatoes on foil-lined baking dish
4. Drizzle olive oil over garlic
5. Sprinkle with salt and pepper
6. Roast in 350 degree oven for 50-60 minutes
7. Remove from oven and let cool for easier handling
8. Pour juice out of tomatoes
9. Discard juice
10. Squeeze tomato pulp and roasted garlic into blender or food processor
11. Dicard tomato skins and garlic paper
12. Blend or process for 5-10 seconds to obtain a smooth consistency

title: fresh tomato spaghetti
steps:
1. Combine first 8 ingredients in a serving bowl
2. Allow to sit and marinate for 2 to 5 hours at room temperature
3. When ready to serve , cook spaghetti and drain well
4. Toss the hot spaghetti with the marinated sauce until the cream cheese cubes are melted
5. Serve immediately

title: souperior burger sandwiches
steps:
1. Over a medium heat cook beef and onion in skillet until beef is browned ,
2. Drain and return to skillet
3. Add rest of ingredients , except buns
4. Heat through stirring occasionally , about 15 minutes
5. Serve on buns

title: lime glazed coconut snowballs
steps:
1. Cookies:
2. In bowl of standing mixer fitted with flat beater , mix flour , lime zest , sugar , and salt on low speed until combined , about 5 seconds
3. With mixer running on low , add butter 1 piece at a time
4. Continue to mix until mixture looks crumbly and slightly wet , about 1 minute longer
5. Add vanilla and cream cheese and mix on low until dough just begins to form large clumps , about 30 seconds
6. Use hands to roll dough into 1-inch balls
7. Place on parchment-lined baking sheets , spacing about 1 1 / 2 inches apart
8. Bake one batch at a time in 375-degree oven until lightly browned , about 12 minutes
9. Cool to room temperature
10. Glaze:
11. Whisk cream cheese and 2 tablespoons lime juice in medium bowl until combined and no lumps remain
12. Whisk in confectioners' sugar until smooth , adding remaining lime juice as needed until glaze is thin enough to spread easily
13. Dip tops of cookies into glaze and scrape away excess , then dip into coconut
14. Set cookies on parchment-lined baking sheet
15. Let stand until glaze dries and sets , about 20 minutes

title: weinkraut
steps:
1. Drain kraut slightly
2. Cook onion in butter or drippings until transparent
3. Add sauerkraut and stir
4. Cook slowly
5. Wash , peel , and core apples
6. Dice fruit and add to sauerkraut
7. Add wine and enough stock or bouillon to cover
8. Cook slowly , uncovered , for 30 minutes
9. Add sugar and celery seeds
10. Cover and finish cooking in moderate 325 oven 30 minutes longer

title: cheesecake factory carrot cake cheesecake
steps:
1. To make cheesecake ,
2. In large bowl of electric mixer , beat together 2 pkgs cream cheese and 3 / 4 cup sugar until smooth
3. Beat in 1 tablespoon flour , 3 eggs and 2 teaspoons vanilla until smooth
4. Set aside
5. Meanwhile prepare carrot cake: in large bowl , combine oil , 1 cup sugar , 2 eggs and 1 teaspoon vanilla , blending thoroughly
6. Stir in 1 cup flour , baking soda , cinnamon and dash salt , mixing well
7. Stir in drained pineapple , carrots , coconut and walnuts
8. Spread 1 1 / 2 cups carrot cake batter over bottom of greased 9-or 9 1 / 2-inch springform pan
9. Drop large spoonfuls of cream cheese batter over carrot cake batter
10. Top with large spoonfuls of remaining carrot cake batter
11. Repeat with remaining cream cheese batter , spreading evenly with a knife
12. Do not marble with a knife
13. Bake in preheated 350 degree oven 50 to 65 minutes or until cake is set and cooked through
14. Cool to room temperature , then refrigerate
15. When cake is cold , prepare pineapple cream cheese frosting
16. In a bowl of electric mixer , combine 2 oz cream cheese , butter , powdered sugar , 1 / 2 teaspoon vanilla , 1 tablespoon reserved pineapple juice and dash of salt
17. Beat until smooth and of spreading consistency
18. Frost top of cheesecake
19. Refrigerate 3 to 4 hours before serving

title: sesame crusted fish with soy  butter and ginger sauce
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 200 degrees f
2. Preheat a large , heavy skillet over medium heat while you prepare the sesame seeds
3. Put them on a plate and season them with salt and pepper
4. Add the oil to the skillet
5. When the oil shimmers , begin to turn the fillets in the seeds , encouraging them to coat the fillets as fully as possible , and add the fillets to the skillet
6. Brown the fish on one side for a couple of minutes , then turn and brown on the other side , another minute or two
7. Remove the skillet from the heat and transfer the fish to a plate
8. Put the plate of fish in the oven to keep warm
9. When the skillet has cooled slightly , return it to the stove over medium heat
10. Add the butter and when it melts , add the ginger
11. About 30 seconds later , add the soy sauce and 1 / 4 cup water and stir to blend
12. Return the fillets to the skillet , along with any of their accumulated juices
13. Turn the heat to medium and cook the fillets for a total of about 4 minutes , turning 3 or 4 times
14. At this point , the fish should be done serve with the pan juices spooned over the fish

title: friday fish and chips
steps:
1. For the chips
2. Melt butter in a fry pan and fry until golden brown
3. For the fish
4. Place the egg , flour and breadcrumbs in seperate shallow bowls
5. Lightly dip both sides of fish fillets in egg
6. Then gently lightly toss in flour
7. Then gently cover in breadcrumbs
8. Melt butter in frypan and fry until golden brown on both sides
9. Place peas in pot and cover with water , bring to boil then simmer about 3-4 minutes
10. Place fish on plate with chips and peas
11. Place a wedge of lemon with each plate
12. Place tartar sauce , ketchup and salt on the table
13. Call family

title: stuffed veal
steps:
1. Trim excess fat
2. Slice loins open lengthwise so that they can be stuffed
3. Drain mandarins and pour juice into small saucepan
4. Set fruit aside
5. Add honey and cook 15 minutes on high to thicken
6. Remove from stove and let cool
7. Heat butter in second saucepan
8. Cook onions 2 minutes over medium heat
9. Add mushrooms and seasonings , cook 4 minutes over high heat
10. Remove from stove , stir in cheese and breadcrumbs
11. Spread stuffing on both sides of meat
12. Add a row of mandarin segments and close , secure with string
13. Brush loins with mandarin honey mixture
14. Place on hot grill and partially cover
15. Cook 30 minutes turning often , baste occasionally with mandarine mixture
16. Heat reservd mandarine mixture with leftover segments in a small saucepan
17. Pour over loins before serving

title: chilled squash and carrot soup
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , combine squash , broth , carrots , onion & salt , then bring to boil
2. Reduce heat , cover & simmer 15-20 minutes or until vegetables are very tender , then remove from heat & cool
3. In a blender or food processor , puree vegetable mixture in batches , then transfer to a bowl & stir in milk
4. Cover & chill until ready to serve
5. When ready to serve , garnish with a small dollop of sour cream , slightly swirled into the soup

title: maple leaf milk shake
steps:
1. Combine ingredients in blender
2. Cover and blend until smooth

title: bread machine garlic bread
steps:
1. Place ingredients in the pan of the bread machine in the order recommended by the manufacturer
2. Select basic bread cycle
3. Press start

title: christmas morning fruit salad
steps:
1. Drain all the cans of fruit except for the pie filling
2. Mix together , chill and serve

title: pasta skillet with tomatoes and beans
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
2. Add tomato and garlic , and saut 2 minutes
3. Add pasta , basil , salt , pepper , and chickpeas
4. Cook 2 minutes
5. Place mixture in a bowl
6. Stir in cheese and vinegar , and garnish with basil , if desired

title: pepperoni macaroni
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease a 9x13 baking dish
3. Cook macaroni until soft-firm
4. Meanwhile , cook sausage and onion until meat is no longer pink
5. Drain
6. Drain macaroni
7. In a large bowl , combine pizza sauce , tomato sauce and milk
8. Stir in sausage mixture , macaroni , pepperoni , mushrooms and olives
9. Transfer to a greased baking dish
10. Cover , and bake for 30 minutes
11. Uncover
12. Sprinkle with cheese , bake 10-15 minutes longer , or until bubbly and cheese is melted

title: spicy peanut coleslaw like armadillo willy s
steps:
1. Combine all the salad ingredients in a bowl
2. Combine all the coleslaw sauce ingredients in a small bowl
3. Spoon in coleslaw sauce into salad and mix well
4. Taste for more salt and pepper if needed
5. Cover and refrigerate until serving

title: easy   hearty vegan tomato soup chock full o veggies
steps:
1. Rinse and drain all the canned food and put in a large bowl for now
2. Finely chop the celery and put it in the bowl too
3. Cook the ditalini al dente and put it aside for now , still in the water so it doesn't dry out
4. Put the vegetable broth , oil , and tomato paste into a large saucepan , mix together on high heat
5. When this completely melds , lower the heat and add the minced garlic , onion powder , black pepper , and basil
6. Stir
7. Add the whole bowl of veggies and blend in well
8. Drain the ditalini and add to the mix
9. Let simmer for 10-15 minutes or until thick and bubbly

title: reduced fat impossible coconut pie  sugar free
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Spray 9-inch pie plate with butter flavored cooking spray
3. Beat egg beaters with milk and light butter
4. Add flour and splenda and whisk until smooth
5. Stir in coconut and vanilla
6. Pour into pie plate
7. Bake 50 to 55 minutes or until golden brown and knife inserted in the center comes out clean
8. Allow to cool for at least 15 minutes before serving
9. I prefer to let it cool , then refrigerate it overnight before serving
10. Cover and refrigerate any remaining pie
11. If you want this pie to be completely sugar free , you will have to purchase unsweetened coconut or shred your own
12. You might want to add some extra splenda as well--to make up for the sugar that's in regular packaged coconut
13. Also , you can substitute 1 cup egg whites for the egg beaters

title: tunisian lamb with saffron  keleya zaara
steps:
1. Heat the vegetable oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat
2. Add the lamb , and cook until browned on all sides , about 5 minutes
3. Season with saffron , salt and pepper to taste
4. Stir in all but 1 / 4 cup of the onion , and pour in the water
5. Bring to a boil , then cover , reduced heat to medium-low , and simmer until the lamb is tender , about 15 minutes
6. Uncover the skillet , stir in the butter , and allow the sauce reduce 5 to 10 minutes to desired consistency
7. Season to taste with salt and pepper , then pour into a serving dish
8. Sprinkle with the remaining chopped onions and parsley
9. Garnish with lemon wedges to serve

title: bircher muesli
steps:
1. Combine the rolled oats , apple juice , yoghurt , currants , almonds , nutmeg and cinnamon in a large bowl and stir together
2. Chill overnight
3. To serve: stir in the chopped apple and banana , put into a bowl and garnish with seasonal berries and drizzle with honey
4. Suggested additions or substitutions: seasonal berries , p , sultanas , dried cranberries , dried cherries , roughly chopped dried apricots or dried pears , chopped nuts of all kinds

title: chef erin finegan s cherry cola barbecue sauce
steps:
1. Heat oil in a heavy saucepan over medium heat
2. Add onions and sautee until they are golden brown
3. Add garlic and stir for 1 minute
4. Deglaze with the grenadine and quickly add ketchup , jam , cola , brown sugar , and vinegar then bring to a simmer , stirring occasionally
5. Reduce heat to medium-low , simmer uncovered until reduced to about 4 cups stirring often to prevent scorching
6. Stir in 1 teaspoon of siracha
7. Season to taste with sea salt and fresh ground black pepper and more hot sauce , if desired
8. Transfer to bowl and cool completely
9. May be refrigerated for up to 2 weeks

title: hungarian potato soup
steps:
1. Bring broth to a boil and add the potatoes , onion , carrot , celery and green pepper
2. Cover and cook for 20 minutes
3. Discard the onion and green pepper
4. Mix together the flour and water to form a paste
5. With a spatula , slowly stir in the sour cream and this mixture to the hot soup
6. Add dill and paprika
7. Simmer the soup for another 5 minutes , or has slightly thickened
8. Season to taste with salt & pepper

title: bierock casserole
steps:
1. Brown the ground beef and onion together until the meat is no longer pink
2. Drain well
3. Add the shredded cabbage and carrot
4. Steam until they are tender
5. Combine the beef and cabbage mixture , soups and seasonings together and keep warm
6. Lightly spray a 9"x13" pan or casserole with cooking spray
7. Take one package of the crescent rolls and lay out in the bottom of the pan
8. Press lightly to form a "crust" and sealing as well as you can
9. Press gently up the sides of the pan about 1 / 4" - 1 / 2" high
10. Bake crust in a preheated 350 degree oven about 7 minutes to give it a chance to bake thoroughly
11. Take the pan out and pour the hamburger & cabbage mixture over the undercooked crust
12. Sprinkle with cheese
13. Take the 2nd package of crescent rolls and break apart along the seams and lay on top of the pan
14. Bake another 35 - 40 minutes or until the top is golden brown

title: pineapple juice  fruit smoothie
steps:
1. Combine everything in a blender until smooth
2. Either pour into one large cup or two small cups
3. Enjoy

title: my best martini
steps:
1. Chill a martini glass
2. Fill a cocktail shaker 1 / 2 to 2 / 3 full with ice cubes
3. Add the vermouth and shake until the liquid is chilled and then strain leaving the ice cubes and inside of the shaker coated with the remaining vermouth
4. Add the gin or vodka and shake until the mixture is chilled
5. Strain immediately into the chilled martini glass and add several olives / onions on a cocktail skewer
6. Serve immediately

title: wisconsin tuna cake with lemon dill sauce
steps:
1. In a large bowl toss together tuna , bread crumbs
2. Onions , and pimento
3. In a small bowl beat together egg and milk
4. Stir in lemon peel
5. Stir into tuna mixture
6. Toss until moistened
7. With lightly floured hands , shape mixture into eight 4-inch patties
8. In a large nonstick skillet melt butter
9. Fry patties , a few at a time , until golden brown on all sides , about 3 minutes per side
10. Place on an ovenproof platter in a 300 oven until ready to serve
11. For sauce:
12. In a small saucepan heat broth , lemon juice and dill
13. For each serving , spoon shredded carrots and zucchini onto each plate
14. Top with 2 tuna cakes
15. Top each cake with a half-slice lemon
16. Spoon sauce over

title: cheryl matthew s dripless popsicles
steps:
1. Pour boiling water over the first three ingredients
2. Mix well and stir in cold water
3. Pour into popsicle trays and freeze

title: mozzarella  ham  and basil panini
steps:
1. Brush cut side of the bottom bread half with mustard
2. Brush cut side of top half with vinegar
3. Top bottom half with mozzarella , basil , ham , peppers , and tomato
4. Top with remaining bread half
5. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium heat
6. Coat pan with cooking spray
7. Add sandwich to pan
8. Top with another heavy skillet
9. Cook 3 minutes on each side or until golden
10. Cut sandwich into 6 wedges

title: chicken estufao
steps:
1. Combine chicken , garlic , onion , vinegar , salt , and pepper in a bowl and mix well
2. Remove chicken , reserving liquid
3. Heat oil in a large skillet over high heat
4. Add chicken and cook 3 minutes
5. Reduce heat and add soy sauce , water , and reserved liquid
6. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes , or until chicken is falling off the bones

title: cafe au lait bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325
2. Lightly grease a 13 x 9 pan
3. Beat the eggs in a mixing bowl until light-colored and thick
4. Add teh sugar , beating until glossy and thick
5. Add vanilla and butter , beating to combine
6. Stir in the flour and salt
7. Scrape down beater and sides of bowl to incorporate
8. Set aside 1 1 / 2 cups batter
9. Stir together the coffee crystals and cream and add to the remaining batter
10. Spread the coffee batter into prepared pan
11. Spoon the reserved batter over and then run a knife through the two batter to marble them
12. Sprinkle with nuts
13. Bake 20-25 minutes or until the center is set
14. Cool before cutting

title: carrot cake with baby food carrots
steps:
1. Cake method: preheat oven to 350f
2. Grease and flour a 9x13 baking pan
3. Place first 9 ingredients in a large mixing bowl
4. Beat with electric beaters or mixer paddle for 2 minutes on medium speed
5. Pour the batter into the prepared pan
6. Bake in 350f oven for 30 minutes , until a toothpick inserted into the center of the cake comes out clean
7. Allow the cake to cool completely
8. Prepare icing in the meantime
9. -------
10. Icing method: in a medium bowl , combine final three ingredients
11. Beat until smooth and fluffy
12. Ice completely cooled cake
13. Grab your own piece before anyone else knows it's done !

title: zucchini  red pepper and feta frittata
steps:
1. In a large non-stick ovenproof skillet , heat the oil over medium heat
2. Cook the onion , zucchini and garlic , stirring often , for 5 to 8 minutes or until softened
3. Meanwhile , in a large bowl , whisk together the eggs , milk , salt and pepper
4. Stir in the red pepper and dill
5. Pour into the skillet
6. Reduce the heat to medium-low
7. Sprinkle with the feta and olives
8. Cook for 10 minutes or until the bottom and side are firm yet the top is still slightly runny
9. Broil for 3 to 5 minutes or until golden brown and set
10. Cut into wedges

title: salmon and rice phyllo packets
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan melt the butter over medium heat
2. Add the onion and mushrooms , stirring often for 5 minutes
3. Add the stock , water , salt and pepper , bringing to a boil
4. Add the wild rice and return pot to a boil
5. Reduce to a simmer and cover
6. Cook for 35 minutes
7. Add the long grain rice and simmer covered for 25 minutes
8. Remove from heat and let cool
9. Trim spinach and rinse in cold water
10. Add to a medium saucepan and cook over mediun heat for 8 minutes when just cooked drain in a colander and press out all the moisture you can
11. Chop and place in a bowl
12. Toss with lemon juice and nutmeg
13. Cut salmon crosswise into 4 pieces
14. Skin
15. Preheat oven to 425 degrees
16. Lay out 1 sheet of phyllo , brush with butter and lay one more sheet on top of the first
17. Leaving 2 inches from the long side of the pastry , and three inches ont he ends place 1 / 2 cup of the rice mixture in a rectangle 3 inches wide
18. Place 1 / 4 of the spinach over the rice
19. Top with 1 piece of salmon
20. Fold the long side over top the salmon and then fold in the edges
21. Carefully taking the long side"roll / fold' the pasckage over and over until a nice package is formed
22. Place on a greased baking sheet , seam side down and brust with butter
23. Repeat until you have 4 prepared packages
24. Place on the center rack in your preheated oven and bake for 20 minutes or until nice and golden brown
25. While the fish packages are baking~~
26. In a medium saucepan boil the vinegar , wine , onions , salt and pepper for 5 minutes
27. You want it reduced to about 2 t's
28. Whisk in butter , a cube at a time
29. Whisk in half and half and whisk until smooth and thickened
30. Serve with salmon packages

title: chocolate cream cheese squares
steps:
1. In a small mixing bowl , combine cream cheese , 3 eggs , sugar and vanilla
2. Mix well and then press into a greased 9x13 baking pan
3. In a large mixing bowl combine cake mix , 1 egg , margarine
4. Pour mixture from bowl over mix in pan
5. Bake at 300f for 45-55 minutes
6. Cool
7. Cut into squares to serve

title: velveeta hot  n cheesy crab dip
steps:
1. Mix velveeta , crab , onions and bell pepper in large microwaveable bowl
2. Microwave on high 5 minutes or until velveeta is completely melted , stirring after 3 minutes
3. Stir in sour cream and cayenne pepper
4. Serve hot with crackers or vegetables

title: maidrites   sloppy joes
steps:
1. Brown ground beef
2. Combine catsup , worcestershire sauce , vinegar , b
3. Sugar , & tomato sauce
4. Add to ground beef and simmer for 15 minutes
5. This freezes well

title: tangy avocado orange salad
steps:
1. Using a small sharp knife , cut off all the peel and white pith from the oranges
2. Working over a large bowl , cut between membranes to release orange segments
3. Add lettuce , avocado and vinegar to the bowl
4. Toss gently
5. Season with salt and pepper
6. Divide among 4 plates

title: italian love cake  super easy
steps:
1. Preheat over to 350 degrees
2. Prepare cake mix as directed on package with water , oil and eggs
3. Pour batter into a greased and floured 9 x 13 inch pan
4. Blend together ricotta , eggs , vanilla and sugar until smooth
5. Pour evenly over chocolate batter
6. Bake for 1 hour
7. Cool cake completely , but leave in pan
8. Blend together pudding and milk and then fold in cool whip
9. Spread on top of cake and chill before serving

title: nestle toll house checkerboard
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 f
2. Grease 13 x 9-inch baking pan or dish
3. Arrange 12 pieces brownie bar dough and 12 pieces cookie bar dough alternately in prepared baking pan to make a checkerboard design
4. Bake for 23 to 25 minutes or until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean
5. Cool completely in pan on wire rack

title: crisp caraway twists
steps:
1. In a small bowl , beat egg , water , and mustard , and set aside
2. In another bowl , combine the cheese , onion , parsley , caraway seeds , and garlic salt
3. Unfold pastry sheet , brush with egg mixture
4. Sprinkle cheese mixture lengthwise over half the pastry
5. Fold pastry over filling , pressing edges to seal
6. Brush top with remaining egg mixture , and cut widthwise into 1 / 2 inch strips , twisting each strip several times
7. Place 1 inch apart on 2 greased baking sheets pressing ends down
8. Bake at 350 degrees for 15-20 minutes or until golden brown
9. Serve warm

title: slow cooker creamy chicken
steps:
1. Add all ingredients to crockpot
2. Cook on low all day
3. Serve over w / w pasta or brown rice

title: warm potato salad with goat cheese
steps:
1. Make the dressing
2. Whisk together the lemon juice , vinegar , mustard , salt , pepper , and garlic
3. Whisk in the olive oil or the yogurt and olive oil
4. Taste and adjust seasonings , set aside
5. Scrub the potatoes and cut into 3 / 4-inch dice if large
6. If using fingerlings cut in 3 / 4 inch slices
7. Steam above 1 inch of boiling water until tender but not mushy , about 10 to 12 minutes
8. Remove from the heat and toss while hot in a bowl with salt and pepper to taste , the onions , parsley , goat cheese , and the dressing
9. Sprinkle the sage over the top and serve

title: touchdown turkey chili
steps:
1. Heat oil in a heavy , large pot over medium heat
2. Add yellow onions and garlic and cook , stirring , until soft but not brown , about 10 minutes
3. Add turkey and brown it , breaking it apart with a fork as you go
4. Add tomatoes , beer , chili powder , cumin , salt and pepper and simmer for 30 minutes
5. Add beans and simmer for about 15 minutes more to blend flavors
6. Serve chili immediately , or make a day ahead and reheat
7. Garnish with green onions , cheese and sour cream , if you like

title: weight watcher 1 point banana bread  flex points
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. In a mixer , mash bananas , add splenda and mix
3. Mix in rest of indgredients
4. Pour ingredients into a bread pan sprayed with non-stick spray
5. Bake for 50 to 60 minutes
6. Cake tester should come out clean when done
7. Remove from pan and cool on a wire rack
8. If using a dark coated pan , bake at 325 degrees and bake a little longer
9. Cake tester to should come out clean when done

title: hamburger rice hot dish
steps:
1. Brown meat , onions and celery
2. Drain off excess fat
3. Put the rice , soups , mixed vegetables , water , soy sauce , salt , pepper and meat into a 2 quart casserole
4. Bake for 1-1 / 2 hours at 325

title: grandma s vegetable soup
steps:
1. Brown ground beef
2. Add all but rice and macaroni , do not drain
3. Let cook until potatoes are medium soft
4. Add rice and cook 10 minutes
5. Add macaroni and let cook until tender

title: mrs powells cinnamon rolls  copycat
steps:
1. Place first 3 ingredients into mixing bowl and let sit till yeast begins to work
2. Add other ingredients using just as much flour as necessary to make a smooth elastic nor quite sticky dough
3. Knead well
4. Place in a greased bowl and let rise till doubled
5. Punch down , rise till doubled again
6. Knead then let rest 10 minutes
7. Roll out about 1 / 2 inch thick
8. Spread with desired filling butter -- then sugar -- then orange or cinnamon
9. Spreading out evenly and going almost to the edge
10. Roll up jelly roll style and cut into 3 / 4-1 inch thick rolls
11. Place on greased cookie sheet allowing plenty of room for them to expand
12. Let raise 30 minutes
13. Cook at 350f for up to 25 minutes , watch carefully and do not let them brown !
14. Store in an airtight container and only frost when needed
15. To freshen your cinnamon rolls place a pat of butter on top and microwave for 10-20 seconds
16. I have no idea how many this makes -- depends on how big you make them
17. Frosting i use:
18. 8 c powdered sugar
19. 1-1 / 2 t vanilla
20. 1 c butter or margarine
21. Cream or milk
22. For orange rolls add 1 t orange zest and the juice of an orange
23. Mix well with a hand mixer using just enough cream to make a nice spreadable frosting

title: chicken chili verde
steps:
1. Chop all vegetables
2. Add chicken and stock to a large dutch oven / soup pot
3. Bring to a boil and poach until chicken is cooked through , about ten minutes
4. Remove chicken and set aside to cool
5. Divide stock in half
6. Meanwhile , in a small sauce pan , add evoo , onion , jalapeno and bell pepper , cook until softened , five to eight minutes
7. Once peppers and onions are cooked , add garlic , cumin , adobo , salsa verde and white beans and two cups of the reserved stock
8. Bring to a simmer
9. In a food processor , pulse tortilla chips dry until well ground
10. Use a high speed setting , you want the chips as finely ground as possible
11. Once ground , add the remaining 2 cups of stock
12. Combine thoroughly
13. Transfer vegetable and stock mixture from sauce pan to the soup pot
14. Shred cooled chicken by hand directly into soup pot
15. Aim for 1 / 2 inches to 1 inches sized pieces
16. Slowly add tortilla chip / stock mixture while stirring
17. Add salt , pepper and cilantro
18. Allow chili to cook down for at least 30 minutes
19. The longer it cooks , the better the flavors meld and the better it tastes , so this is a great meal to prepare early and leave on the stove
20. Tastes even better the next day too , if you manage to hold on to your leftovers !
21. Serve in bowls topped with your favorite chili toppings with extra tortilla chips alongside for dipping

title: irish cream
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in blender
2. Store in a dark bottle in the refrigerator

title: italian chicken meatball soup with barley
steps:
1. Mix seasonings and dried herbs in a small bowl
2. Rinse barley and drain it
3. Combine barley in a large soup pot with the 9 cups of chicken broth , about half the herb mixture , and 3 of the cloves of crushed garlic
4. Bring to a simmer and cook covered for 30 minutes
5. Meanwhile , mix together the meatball ingredients and form into balls the size of walnuts in the shell
6. When the barley / broth mixture has simmered for 30 minutes , add in the remaining 3 crushed garlic cloves , the rest of the seasonings and dried herb mixture , the meatballs , and the carrots and onion
7. Bring soup back to a low simmer , and cook for another 30 minutes , stirring gently every 10 or 15 minutes so meatballs won't stick to the bottom or break apart
8. Serve soup topped with chopped parsley and a generous handful of grated parmesan cheese

title: spicy dry rub
steps:
1. In a small bowl stir everything together
2. Rub into shrimp , chicken or pork a few minutes before grilling

title: mushroom barley soup  ww
steps:
1. In a pot add barley and 4 cups of water , bring to a boil turn down heat and simmer for 30 minutes until barley is partially cooked
2. In a pot or dutch oven add oil onions and celery: cook until softened
3. Add mushrooms cook until they begin to release liquid , then add broth , carrots , tomato paste and barley bring to a boil
4. Reduce heat and simmer stirring occasionally until barley and carrots are cooked about 30 minutes
5. Stir in salt and pepper garnish with parsley and serve

title: easy fettuccine alfredo with chicken
steps:
1. Cook pasta in boiling water
2. Meanwhile , heat a large skillet on med-hi heat
3. Add chicken to skillet and cook 5-7 minute stirring occasionally
4. Remove chicken from skillet
5. Mix broth and flour in same skillet
6. Stir in cream cheese , 2 t
7. Of parmesan , garlic powder and pepper
8. Cook for 2 minute until mixture boils and thickens
9. Stir in chicken
10. Drain pasta and place in a large bowl
11. Pour chicken mixture over pasta to coat
12. Sprinkle with remaining 1 t
13. Parmesan

title: spicy corned beef
steps:
1. In a large stockpot , combine all of the ingredients except the glaze and cover with warm water
2. Bring to a boil and simmer , covered , over medium-low heat for 40 minutes per pound , approximately 2 1 / 2 hours
3. The meat should be tender , but not falling apart
4. Remove the beef from the broth , cover and cool , then refrigerate overnight
5. When the meat is cold , slice it very thinly and place in a 9x13" serving dish
6. Cover and refrigerate
7. To serve , preheat the oven to 350
8. Make the glaze by combining the chili sauce and water
9. Pour just enough glaze over beef to moisten it well
10. It should not cover the meat entirely
11. Sprinkle the brown sugar over the top and bake the beef , uncovered for 30 minutes -- or untl the meat is heated through and the sugar is a bit crackly
12. You may want to turn up the heat to broil for a minute or two to achieve this effect

title: millet  orange raisin muffins
steps:
1. Combine all dry ingredients in a medium bowl
2. Mix all liquid ingredients together , then add to dry ingredients
3. Put mixture in well-oiled muffin tins
4. Sprinkle with poppy seeds
5. Makes 12 muffins
6. Bake at 375 for 15-20 minutes or until done

title: easy crock pot beef cubes
steps:
1. Place the beef cubes and onion slices in the crock pot
2. Combine tomato sauce , brown sugar , worcestershire , thyme , basil , celery seed , pepper and salt and pour over meat and onions
3. Cover and cook on low for 6-8 hours
4. Turn to high
5. Dissolve the cornstarch in the water and then stir into the crock pot
6. Cover and keep on high for 10 minutes
7. Stir again and serve over mashed potatoes or hot buttered egg noodles

title: caramelised fruit tarte tatin  upside down pastry pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to moderate - 200c
2. Cut pastry to size of baking pan or dish
3. Melt butter in a non stick pan
4. Add sugar and cook over a medium heat until the mixture is a caramel colour and the sugar has dissolved
5. Careful not to burn it
6. Remove from heat
7. Mix in brandy or liqueur
8. Pour into baking dish
9. Put the fruit pieces in the dish , cut side down
10. Place pastry over top of fruit and tuck in the sides
11. Bake for 20 mins or until pastry has risen and is golden and crispy
12. Carefully invert the tarte tatin onto a plate
13. Serve immediately with a dollop of cream or ice cream , sprinkled with toasted almond flakes

title: cream cheese glaze
steps:
1. With an electric mixer , beat cream cheese , butter , and milk
2. Gradually add the powdered sugar
3. Beat in vanilla

title: quick curried vegetable saute
steps:
1. Heat oil in large skillet over medium heat
2. Saut onion , curry powder , salt and cayenne pepper about 5 minutes , or until onion begins to brown
3. Stir in cabbage , acorn squash / sweet potato , chickpeas , carrot , apple , ginger and garlic
4. Saut 2 minutes more
5. Stir in broth , and reduce heat to low
6. Cover and cook vegetables , stirring occasionally , about 10 minutes , or until soft
7. Spoon into shallow bowls
8. Sprinkle with cilantro and serve
9. Optional: serve with diced tomato , raisins and cashews on the side and allow diners to garish to taste

title: southern gulf nachos
steps:
1. Pre heat oven to 350 degrees
2. Clean crawfish under cold water and then soak for 30 minutes in a bowl of salt water
3. Take the crawfish and set aside to dry
4. While the crawfish are drying you need to mix sour cream , rotel , chili powder , creole seasoning , and salt in a bowl and mix well with a whisk
5. Add the crawfish and crab to the mixture
6. Take your 13x9 glass baking dish and pray it with cooking spray
7. Line the bottom of the try with tortilla chips
8. You are making a big dish of nachos so put a good deal of chips in there
9. Slowly pour the mixture over the chips being carful to spread it evently over all the chips
10. Take a spoon a drizzle salsa evenly over the mixture
11. Cover the dish with cheddar cheese , then olives , and finally the green onions
12. Bake for 15 minutes or until cheese is melted
13. Enjoy !

title: italian eggs
steps:
1. Melt butter in frypan , cook onions until soft , then add tomatoes and cheese
2. Stir until well heated
3. Add beaten egg yolks and seasoning
4. Cook this mixture until it becomes creamy , stirring all the time
5. Serve on buttered toast , and sprinkle parsley on top

title: hot mulled wine
steps:
1. Using a sharp knife , peel lemon
2. Do not use a zester because the peel will be too fine
3. Extract juice and set aside
4. Combine peel , cloves , one cinnamon stick , sugar and 2 cups water
5. Boil 5-10 minutes
6. Remove spices with slotted spoon and discard
7. Transfer to a crockpot , and add wine and lemon juice
8. Heat on low
9. Serve hot in mugs with a cinnamon stick as a stir

title: banana muffins low carb
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Prep the muffin pan by inserting foil cupcakes cups or spray with cooking spray
3. Do not use paper cupcake liners , or they will become part of the muffin- inseparable !
4. Beat eggs and add the melted butter slowly while continuing to beat the eggs
5. Then add in the davinci syrup and water and mix
6. In a separate bowl , combine atkins bake mix , flax meal , baking powder , salt and mix to evenly distribute baking powder
7. Stir in the wet ingredients and mix well , divide the batter into 12 muffin cups , and bake for 30 minutes
8. Done when toothpick comes out clean
9. Or you could use a loaf pan
10. They should be stored in the fridge , and they also freeze well
11. You can also use any other flavors
12. I've made cranberry and green apple

title: shake n bake chicken
steps:
1. Shake together first 7 ingredients in a large sealable plastic bag
2. Brush surface of chicken pieces with the olive oil
3. Shake chicken pieces , 1 - 2 piece at a time , in mixture
4. Place coated chicken on an ungreased baking sheet
5. Bake chicken in a 400 degree oven until juices run clear , about 20 minutes for boneless chicken and 45 minutes for bone-in chicken

title: chipotle s spicy corn salsa
steps:
1. Heat barbecue grill
2. Roast corn and chilies on the grill
3. Let cool
4. Cut corn off the cob
5. Dice poblano chilies
6. Combine ingredients in a bowl
7. Stir to incorporate

title: spice rubbed mango glazed pork tenderloin  weight watchers
steps:
1. Spray the grill with nonstick cooking spray
2. Preheat the grill to medium-high or prepare a medium-high fire
3. To make the glaze , stir together the chutney and the rum in a cup
4. To make the rub , combine the cinnamon , allspice and salt in a cup
5. Spread the rub all over the pork , then lightly spray with nonstick spray
6. Place the tenderloin on the grill rack and grill , turning , 10 minutes
7. Continue to grill the pork , turning and brushing with the glaze , until pork reaches 160 f
8. Transfer to a cutting board and let rest for 5 minutes
9. Cut into 12 slices

title: herb crusted pork tenderloins
steps:
1. Combine the brown sugar , herbes de provence , coriander , salt and pepper in a small bowl
2. Rub this mixture evenly onto the tenderloins and place in a zip lock bag
3. Chill for 2-4 hours
4. Preheat oven to 450 degrees
5. Place the tenderloins on a rack in a greased pan
6. Bake for 10 minutes , then reduce the heat to 350 degrees
