7. Bake an additional 20-30 minutes or until a meat thermometer registers 155 degrees
8. Remove from oven and let stand 10 minutes before serving

title: mojita
steps:
1. Place lime wedges and mint leaves in a pint glass
2. Muddle with the handle of a wooden spoon for 30 seconds
3. Add simple syrup and white rum
4. Fill glass with ice and top off with club soda
5. Shake or stir gently
6. To make simple syrup:
7. In a small saucepan , combine 2 parts sugar to 1 part water
8. Heat until sugar is dissolved
9. Cool before using
10. For a fruity twist to your mojito , use flavored rum , such as mango , banana , or pineapple
11. You can buy a muddler , which looks like a tiny baseball bat or billy club , at any good restaurant store

title: zee ultimate greek salad
steps:
1. Prepare the dressing:
2. In a small bowl , combine vinegar , oregano , salt and pepper
3. Slowly add olive oil , whisking to combine
4. Set aside
5. Rinse and drain beans
6. Dice tomatoes , bell pepper , onion , cucumber
7. Remove excess liquid from tomatoes
8. Put vegetables and beans in a large bowl
9. Toss dressing with salad
10. Add feta , lightly toss
11. Best if refrigerated for an hour or two before serving
12. Serve over lettuce leaves if desired

title: simple basil  sauce  for two
steps:
1. In a small dish , add mayo , basil and lemon juice - mix well
2. Serve alongside fish , or on a baked potato , or as dip for vegetables

title: pumpkin stuff
steps:
1. Mix together all the stuff up to the topping
2. Then put it in a greased 9 by 13 inch pan and crumble the cake mix and pecans on top of it
3. Pour melted butter over it all
4. Bake it at 350 degrees for 50 to 60 minutes
5. When cool ! make frosting and smear on top and sprinkle some more pecans
6. Refrigerate until serving time

title: cucumber onion avocado salad
steps: 1. Toss together , serve

title: very berry delight   non dairy
steps:
1. Melt chocolate and sugar in a double boiler over medium heat
2. Place tofu , water and melted chocolate in a blender and blend until smooth
3. Remove to a bowl
4. Chill for one hour
5. Place chocolate pudding in a bowl and top with a generous amount of berries
6. Serve and enjoy !

title: my lower fat martian cookies
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f
2. With a mixer blend the butter and applesauce
3. Add the sugars and the splenda and beat well
4. It will never get fluffy and it might have little specks of butter in with the applesauce
5. This is just fine
6. Add the egg whites and the vanilla and mix well
7. Add the 2 flours , the cinnamon , the baking soda , and the salt
8. Using the low setting on the mixer blend in the flour
9. Using a spoon add the oatmeal , zucchini , and chips
10. Drop onto an ungreased cookie sheet and bake for 12-14 minutes or until they are starting to brown

title: brownies gluten free low glycemic
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Grease 9" square pan
3. Melt butter on the stovetop
4. Do not "cook" the butter , just soften it to a warm liquid and remove from the heat
5. Stir cocoa and butter together in mixing bowl until combined well
6. Stir in all remaining ingredients except almond meal until smooth
7. Stir in almond meal
8. Spread mixture in baking pan
9. Bake 25 minutes
10. Allow to cool at least 1 hour before serving

title: bratwurst and sauerkraut supper
steps:
1. In a large skillet , saut onions in margarine until tender
2. Add the potatoes , sauerkraut , wine , broth , brown sugar , vinegar , mustard , caraway seeds , bay leaf and pepper
3. Cover and simmer for 35-40 minutes or until potatoes are tender
4. Stir in the bratwurst
5. Heat through
6. Discard bay leaf

title: furr s cafeteria mexican corn bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. In mixing bowl , beat eggs lightly with wire
3. Whisk
4. Add corn , sour cream , peppers , cheese , cornmeal and soda
5. Mix all
6. Ingredients
7. Add three tablespoons butter
8. In a nine-by-nine-inch pan or
9. 10-inch cast iron skillet , melt three tablespoons butter
10. While pan is still hot , add batter and bake for
11. 20 to 25 minutes

title: best ever potatoes
steps:
1. In a large saucepan cook potatoes and chopped onion , covered , in a small amount of boiling water for 12 to 15 minutes or until tender
2. Drain well
3. Stir in sour cream , monterey jack cheese , cheddar cheese , salt , and red pepper
4. Stir in chopped tomatoes
5. Spoon into a 2-quart rectangular baking dish
6. Bake , uncovered , in a 350 degree f oven about 30 minutes or until heated through
7. Makes 10 servings
8. To tote:
9. Cover tightly
10. Transport in an insulated carrier
11. For 4 to 5 servings:
12. Prepare using 1 / 2 the amount of ingredients and the method above , except spoon into a 1-quart casserole

title: swiss chard tzatziki
steps:
1. Fill half of a 2 quart saucepan with water and bring to a boil
2. Add chopped chard leaves and cook for about 3-5 minutes or until tender
3. Strain the chard to remove all excess hot water once cooked
4. Place chard in a bowl of ice water
5. In a bowl , grind the garlic and salt into a paste using the back of a sturdy spoon
6. Place the yogurt , chard , garlic / salt paste , olive oil , lemon juice , and a small dash of cayenne pepper into a medium sized bowl
7. Serve with bread , pita , crackers , latkes , or almost anything else

title: crispy cereal bar
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 375 degree farenheit
2. Gather ingredients
3. Crush frosted flakes slightly
4. Mix together peanut butter , chocolate syrup , egg , and vanilla extract
5. Add the frosted flakes to the mixture
6. Add oatmeal
7. Stir until the forsted flakes and oatmeal are evenly covered
8. Add the chocolate chips if you wish
9. Shape the cereal mixture into squares
10. Place the cereal bars onto a pan with baking sheet
11. Bake for about 20-25 minutes depending on size
12. Let the bars cool for about 10 minutes before eating
13. Enjoy !

title: poppy seed plum cake
steps:
1. To make the poppy seed filling place ground poppy seeds in a bowl and add the hot milk and vanilla extract
2. Allow to steep for 15 minutes , then add the butter and sugar
3. Mix well and set aside
4. For the cake batter cream butter and sugar in a big bowl for 6 minutes
5. Add vanilla extract and salt
6. Beat in each egg separately for 30 seconds
7. Then fold in the poppy seed filling mix
8. In a second bowl combine flour and baking powder
9. Add this to the butter mixture and stir to combine using a wooden spoon
10. Spread batter in a paper-lined or greased springform pan
11. Stick the plum quarters into the dough arranging them in circles on the batter
12. Bake in the preheated oven at 180c / 350f for 65 minutes or until tester inserted in the centre comes out clean
13. Allow to cool in the pan for 10 minutes , then remove to a wire rack to cool completely or serve at room temperature
14. Enjoy !

title: mushroom ragu
steps:
1. In a large skillet heat the oil
2. When almost smoking , add the onions and garlic over medium-low heat until the onions have wilted , about 8 minutes
3. Add the mushrooms and season with salt and pepper
4. Raise heat to high and saute until mushrooms are tender and all the liquid has evaporated
5. Remove pan from heat and pour in marsala
6. Return pan to stove and allow wine to evaporate , about 3 minutes
7. Add chicken broth and simmer for 1 / 2 hour until the sauce has reduced by half
8. Add heavy cream and mix well
9. Take the pan off the heat and add the fresh herbs and parmesan and mix thoroughly

title: chunky hawaiian spread
steps:
1. Beat cream cheese , sour cream , pineapple and chutney in medium bowl until blended
2. Spoon cream cheese mixture into medium serving bowl
3. Cover and chill 1 hour or overnight
4. Serve with low fat of fat free crackers
5. Refrigerate any leftover spread in airtight container up to 1 week

title: grandma s dill pickles   taste of home recipe
steps:
1. In a dutch oven bring water , vinegar and salt to a boil
2. Boil for 10 minutes
3. Pack cucumbers into quart jars within 1 / 2 inch of top
4. Place one dill head , two garlic cloves and two peppers in each jar
5. Ladle boiling liquid over cucumbers , leaving 1 / 4 inch head space
6. Place lids and screw on bands finger
7. Process for 10 minutes in a boiling water bath

title: bierrocks with cheese
steps:
1. Mix together the lukewarm milk and oil in a large bowl
2. Add the eggs , yeast , sugar , salt and 5 cups of flour
3. Mix well and add remaining flour as necessary to to form a kneadable dough
4. Knead a few minutes
5. Cover bowl and let dough rise one hour in a warm place
6. Meanwhile , brown beef in a large skillet
7. Do not drain
8. Add onion and cabbage and continue cooking until onion is soft
9. Add salt and pepper to taste
10. Let cool
11. After dough has risen , roll out hunks of dough as thin as possible
12. Place 1 / 2 slice cheese on dough , top with some filling , then the other half slice of cheese
13. Fold over and seal like a turnover
14. Place on a baking sheet , brush with egg wash and sprinkle with sesame seeds and bake at 350 degrees for about 30 minutes or until golden
15. Serve immediately or cool and freeze
16. To reheat frozen , simply bake until hot

title: italian herb muffins
steps:
1. In a bowl combine the biscuit mix , cheese , sugar , italian seasoning , and garlic powder
2. In another bowl whisk the egg , milk and oil
3. Add the egg mixture into the dry ingredients , stir just until moistened
4. Fill greased muffin cups 3 / 4 full
5. Bake at 375 degrees for 15-20 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean
6. Cool for 5 minutes before removing from pan
7. Wonderful served warm

title: philadelphia oreo cheesecake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f line 13x9 inches baking pan with foil , with ends of foil extending over sides of pan
2. Place 30 cookies in food processor
3. Cover
4. Process for 30-45 seconds or until finely ground
5. Add butter , mix well
6. Press oreo and butter mixture firmly onto bottom of pan
7. Bean cream cheese , sugar and vanilla in large bowl with electric mixer on medium speed until well blended
8. Add sour cream
9. Mix well
10. Add eggs , one at a time , beating until blended after each addition
11. Chop the remaining cookies and gently stir 1 1 / 2 cups of chopped cookies into cream cheese batter
12. Pour batter over cookie crust and top with remaining chopped cookies
13. Bake 45 minute or until center is almost set
14. Cool for 4 hours in refrigerator or overnight
15. Gently lift cheesecake from pan using the foil handles
16. Cut into 16 pieces and enjoy
17. Store leftover cheesecake in refrigerator

title: touch of the wild rice
steps:
1. In large covered saucepan , cook wild rice in boiling salted water for about 40 minutes or until rice is tender and most of the liquid is absorbed
2. Meanwhile , in a medium skillet , cook mushrooms , onion and celery in hot oil for 5 minutes or until tender
3. Add the vegetable mixture , peas , cranberries and tamari sauce to rice
4. Cook , uncovered , for 3 to 4 minutes more or until heated through and the remaining liquid is absorbed
5. To serve , transfer rice to serving bowl and top with nuts

title: baked brown sugar bananas
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350
2. Cut bananas cross-wise in half
3. Cut each half lengthwise in half
4. Place cut sides up in ungreased square baking dish , 9x9x2"
5. Mix butter , lemon juice and allspice
6. Brush over bananas
7. Sprinkle with brown sugar
8. Bake uncovered about 15 minutes or until bananas are hot

title: french crullers
steps:
1. Combine sugar , salt , shortening , and boiling water in a saucepan
2. Mix and bring to a rapid boil
3. Add flour all at once and mix and cook until thickened , stirring constantly
4. Remove from heat
5. Add eggs one at a time , beating thoroughly after each addition
6. Add vanilla extract
7. Force mixture through pastry tube onto greased paper , forming circles
8. Heat deep fat to 375 degrees f on frying thermometer
9. Carefully turn paper upside down so crullers will drop into fat
10. Fry and flip over until golden brown

title: best ever sugar cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Beat the butter on med-high for 30 seconds
3. Add sugar , baking powder , and salt
4. Beat till combined
5. Beat in egg and vanilla
6. Beat in flour and mix until dough starts to form into a ball
7. Flatten dough into a disk and wrap in plastic wrap
8. Chill for a couple of hours or until it's easy to handle
9. Lightly flour your rolling surface and the rolling pin
10. Roll dough to 1 / 4" thick
11. Cut with cookie cutters of your choice
12. Bake on parchment-lined cookie sheet at 375 for 7-9 minutes or until set but not browned
13. Makes approximately 100 mini , 36-48 medium , or 20 large cookies

title: citrus sangria
steps:
1. Dissolve sugar in water
2. Combine the sugar mixture with wine , port , orange and lime slices and pineapple cubes in a large glass , ceramic or stainless-steel container
3. Add ice before serving

title: sue s perfect prime rib
steps:
1. Combine garlic and herbs , then rub the mixture evenly over the surface of the meat
2. Roasting:
3. Because rib cuts are more tender , dry heat roasting is preferred
4. Moist heat is used to tenderize tougher cuts of meat , but may also result in greater shrinkage and drier meat
5. Place meat on a cooking rack , fat side up , in a shallow roasting pan
6. Do not place meat in a cooking bag , nor place a cover of any kind over the meat
7. Roast at 350 , for 18-24 minutes per pound
8. Medium-rare , medium , and well-done
9. Over cooking meat will dry it out , and toughen it
10. Internal temperature of meat will continue to raise 5 more degrees during standing time
11. Carving:
12. Allow roast to stand 15-20 minutes before carving
13. Proper carving will make meat more tender
14. Slice across the grain of meat
15. Serve with horseradish and au jus , as desired
16. Au jus:
17. Remove meat from pan , and drain off excess fat
18. Place pan on top of stove , and add onions
19. Cook and stir over medium heat 3-5 minutes
20. Add broth
21. Stir until meat juices attached to pan are dissolved
22. Continue to simmer until liquid is reduced to desired strength

title: the parker s greek edition  tzatziki aka yogurt and gyro sauce
steps:
1. Cut cucumber in half and spoon out the seeds
2. Take a grater , or shredder and grate the cucumber
3. If you don't have either , give it a small dice
4. Squeeze all the excess water out of the cucumber , using paper towels or dish towels
5. Srinkle the salt over the cucumber to further dehydrate it
6. Finally , mix all the ingredients together and refrigerate
7. Can be made several hours ahead , or even a day

title: she crab soup     delicious
steps:
1. Mix both cream of celery and cream of mushroom soups in a pot
2. Add the crab meat , the claws and crab segments and slowly bring to a light boil
3. Add the cream and the rest of the ingredients , except for the paprika and simmer for 15 minutes
4. Add the crab roe to the soup , or if you do not have crab roe , take the hard boiled egg yolks that are sieved and add them to soup
5. Serve and lightly sprinkle paprika on top of each serving

title: orange almond breakfast bake
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400f
2. Spray bottom only of 13x9-inch glass baking dish with non-stick cooking spray
3. In small bowl , beat egg with fork or wire whisk
4. Stir in yogurt until smooth
5. Unroll dough on cutting board
6. Set icing aside
7. Cut each strip in half crosswise
8. Dip each strip completely in egg mixture , then twist 2 or 3 times
9. Place in baking dish
10. Bake 10 to 15 minutes or until golden brown
11. Meanwhile , in 1-quart saucepan , heat icing , butter , orange juice , almond extract and marmalade to boiling over medium heat
12. Reduce heat to medium-low
13. Cook 2 to 3 minutes , stirring occasionally , until slightly thickened and shiny
14. Remove from heat
15. Stir in almonds
16. Loosen rolls from baking dish with spatula
17. Drizzle with sauce
18. Serve immediately

title: simply the best sloppy joes
steps:
1. Brown ground chuck and onions
2. Drain off fat
3. Add remaining ingredients and simmer 15-20 minutes
4. Remove lid and simmer until mixture is at desired consistency

title: jamie easons  turkey meatloaf muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Spray muffin pan with canola or olive oil
3. Mix all your ingredients together in one large bowl
4. Roll the mixture into balls and place in muffin pan
5. Muffins should be about the size of a racquetballs
6. Bake for 40 minutes
7. Feel free to try it with 2 tsp of the spice if you prefer a more smokey flavour

title: pork chops with sage and sweetened apples
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 200 / 180 / gas 6
2. Heat oil in a frying pan and then brown chops for 2 minutes on each side
3. Transfer to a plate
4. Add the butter to the pan , then when melted , add the sage , onion and apple , cut side down
5. Saute for about 5 minutes and then transfer to a roasting tin , turning the apple halves cut side up and sprinkle them with the sugar
6. Roast for about 15 minutes , adding the pork back to them for the last 10 minutes

title: the best taco pizza
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Cook meat with taco seasoning as directed on package
3. Spread beans evenly onto pizza crust
4. Sprinkle with meat and cheese
5. Bake 8 to 10 minute
6. Crush taco shells
7. Sprinkle over pizza
8. Drizzle with salsa
9. Top with lettuce and tomatoes
10. Slice and enjoy

title: muffuletta panini
steps:
1. Brush both sides of bread lightly with butter
2. Layer 4 slices cheese over four of the slices of bread
3. Top with olive salad , ham , mortadella , salami , remaining cheese and bread
4. Cook sandwiches in a preheated panini press until golden brown and cheese is melted , about 3-4 minutes
5. Place a heavy skillet on top of sandwiches to flatten
6. Cook 3 minutes
7. Turn
8. Replace skillet and continue to cook 3 to 4 minutes or until golden brown and cheese is melted

title: oat nut burgers
steps:
1. Mix the ingredients together and season to taste
2. Shape into 6 burgers and fry until brown , turning once
3. I like to throw the dry ingredients into a food processor for a more uniform texture
4. I also fry only what i need and keep the rest waiting for me in a tupperware for later
5. Garlic , salt and pepper are nice seasonings to add
6. If you shape them too large or too thick then they won't cook right

title: fondue
steps:
1. Crush garlic in saucepan and rub on sides of the pan
2. Pour in the white wine
3. Add the cut up pieces of cheese
4. Stir mixture over medium heat until melted
5. Add pepper and nutmeg

title: ww weight watchers chicken and cheese quesadillas
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine chicken , lime juice , cumin and salt
2. Toss well to combine
3. Place 4 tortillas on a flat surface and spread each one with 2 tablespoons of bean dip
4. Top each with about 1 / 3 cup of chicken and then sprinkle each with 2 tablespoons of cheese
5. Divide scallions over top
6. Cover with remaining tortillas and gently press down on each one
7. Coat a very large nonstick skillet with cooking spray
8. Place over medium heat
9. Cook quesadillas in a single layer until golden brown on bottom , about 2 minutes
10. Flip quesadillas and press down on them with a spatula
11. Cook until golden brown on second side , about 2 to 3 minutes more
12. Remove to a serving plate and cover to keep warm
13. Repeat with remaining quesadillas
14. Slice each quesadilla into 4 pieces
15. Serve with salsa and sour cream
16. Yields 1 quesadilla , 2 tablespoons of salsa and 1 tablespoon of sour cream per serving

title: brioche bread pudding
steps:
1. Mix together the milk , creme fraiche , eggs , sugar and vanilla until well blended , then stir in the raisins and orange peel
2. Pull off smallish hunks of brioche and stir into the milk mixture
3. Really mash the brioche around
4. Let it stand for about ten minutes , soaking up liquid , then smoosh it around some more with a wooden spoon
5. It can't be too smooshed up
6. Spoon it into a loaf mold
7. I use the silicone pans because i find them so easy to use
8. If you do use them , remember to let the bread pudding cool in the pan before trying to unmold it
9. Then bake at 200 degrees c for about 35 minutes , or until a knife comes out clean

title: salsa ranchera
steps:
1. Add all ingredients to a blender and blend until very smooth , it should be fairly thin
2. Heat 2 tb oil in a large skillet over high heat until very hot , but not smoking
3. Add the contents of the blender to the skillet and "fry" the sauce , stirring constantly , and scraping the bottom of the skillet to keep from sticking
4. Be careful , it makes a mess in the kitchen , but it is well worth it , be sure to wear your apron ! fry the sauce for 10-15 minutes , until it is reduced and the flavors have blended well
5. Keep warm and use immediately , or store it in the fridge for 2 days , or in the freezer for two months
6. If using frozen , allow to thaw first and reblend quickly as it tends to separate
7. Cut the tomatoes in half and grate them with your cheese grater right down to the skin
8. This retains the pulp , and not the skin , without having to boil them
9. Discard skins
10. You can used canned tomatoes too if you don't have time
11. Use chipotles for a nice smoky flavor
12. Amount of chiles given makes a picante dish
13. Omit if you don't like it spicy , but i recommend at least one to give it some flair

title: grilled fresh figs on rosemary skewers
steps:
1. Strip the leaves from the bottom of the rosemary stems , leaving about 1 1 / 2 inches of leaves at the
2. Finely chop 2 tablespoons of the stripped rosemary leaves and set them aside
3. Place the stems in a bowl and add cold water to cover
4. Soak for at least 30 minutes
5. Drain the stems and pat them dry with paper towelling
6. Skewer 2 fig halves crosswise on each rosemary stem
7. Arrange the skewers on a plate with the cut sides of the figs facing up
8. In a small bowl , mix together honey and lemon juice
9. Brush the honey / lemon mixture over the cut side of the figs
10. Preheat the broiler or grill to medium-high
11. Grill or broil the figs until they are lightly browned and softened , about 1 to 2 minutes per side
12. Sprinkle evenly with the reserved rosemary leaves and some black pepper
13. Serve on the skewers while still hot

title: thai noodle salad
steps:
1. Cook pasta in large pot of boiling salted water until tender but still firm to bite
2. Drain
3. Transfer pasta to large bowl
4. Add 3 tablespoons sesame oil and toss to coat
5. Heat remaining 1 tablespoon oil in heavy large skillet over medium-high heat
6. Add 6 green onions , garlic , and ginger
7. Saut until onions soften , about 2 minutes
8. Add honey , peanut butter , soy sauce , vinegar , and chili-garlic sauce
9. Whisk to blend
10. Simmer sauce 1 minute
11. Cool to room temperature
12. Pour over pasta and toss to coat
13. Add sprouts and carrots
14. Mix well
15. Transfer to platter
16. Sprinkle with remaining green onions

title: peanut butter kiss mini muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Butter 24 mini muffin cups , or line with mini cupcake paper liners
3. Set aside
4. In a large bowl , stir together the flour , brown sugar , baking powder , and salt
5. In another bowl , stir together the peanut butter and oil
6. Blend in the egg until smooth
7. Stir in the milk and vanilla until blended
8. Make a well in the center of the flour mixture
9. Add the milk mixture and stir just to combine--do not overmix
10. Spoon batter into the prepared muffin tins
11. Bake for 10 minutes , or until a toothpick tests out clean
12. Remove pan to a wire rack and cool for 1 minute before inverting
13. Place a hershey's kiss in the center of each hot muffin
14. Cool for 30 minutes
15. Lightly press the melted bottoms of the kisses onto the muffins
16. Refrigerate for 1 hour to cool completely
17. Store in an airtight container at room temperature

title: chili mac casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. In medium saucepan , simmer chili until heated through
3. Cook macaroni according to package directions
4. Drain well and set aside
5. Grease a deep 8-quart or similar casserole dish
6. Spoon 1 cup of chili evenly on bottom of dish
7. Next , layer half of the macaroni , drizzle half of the ketchup , half of the remaining chili and half of the cheeses
8. Repeat layering with remaining macaroni , 1 / 4 cup ketchup , remainder of chili and remaining cheeses
9. Top with jalapeno slices , if desired
10. Cover and bake 30 minutes
11. Remove cover and bake an additional 10 minutes or until heated through and cheese is bubbly
12. Can green chilies , cayenne pepper or whatever i have on hand to "doctor" it up

title: rhode island stuffies
steps:
1. Open quahogs , placing meat and juice in separate bowls
2. Save shells
3. In a large bowl , break bread into small pieces and add enough quahog juice so bread is well moistened , but not soggy
4. Add chopped quahogs
5. In a frying pan , add oil and saut onion , green pepper and garlic until soft , but not brown
6. Add sauted onion , green pepper , garlic , and crushed red pepper to bread mixture
7. Mix well
8. Wash shells and separate
9. Mound shell halves with stuffing
10. Sprinkle top with paprika and parsley
11. Dot tops with a small amount of margarine
12. Set in a pan and bake in preheated 375f oven for about 25 minutes or until heated through
13. Optional: you may add ground chourice to onion while sauting

title: super simple peanut butter cookies
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients in a bowl with spoon or pastry blender
2. Roll dough into balls
3. Place them on a greased cookie sheet
4. Bake at 350 degrees for 10-12 minute

title: lime flavored rice noodles with cashews
steps:
1. Heat water to boiling in 3-quart saucepan
2. Remove from heat
3. Add fresh noodles
4. Soak 30 seconds
5. Drain
6. Rinse with cold water
7. If using dried noodles , cook according to package directions
8. Set aside
9. Heat oil and mustard seeds in wok or 12-inch skillet over medium-high heat
10. Once seeds begin to pop , cover wok and wait until popping stops
11. Add asafetida , if using , yellow split peas and cashews
12. Stir-fry about 1 minute or until peas and cashews are golden brown
13. Add remaining ingredients and cooked rice noodles
14. Toss 1-2 minutes or until noodles are heated

title: coffee walnut muffins
steps:
1. Dissolve coffee in hot water and add milk or cream , beaten egg and oil
2. Stir flour , baking powder , salt and sugar together and stir in the nuts
3. Pour the liquid ingredients into the dry and mix only to moisten
4. Spoon into greased muffin tin and bake 375f degrees for 15-20 minutes

title: banana oatmeal bites
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f line a baking sheet with foil
2. Mash banana in a bowl
3. Add cinnamon and oats , and stir until combined
4. Stir in chocolate chips
5. Form small balls and place on baking sheet
6. Bake for 10-12 minutes , until golden brown

title: flan napolitano  mexican restaurant flan
steps:
1. Process in blender the cheese , dissolved powdered milk , condensed milk and eggs-- set aside
2. On heat-proof glass dish , melt the sugar till dark , over stove top
3. Move dish so bottom and sides are evenly covered with resulting caramel
4. Pour blended ingredients onto pyrex dish
5. Cover and bake with steaming method in medium heat conventional oven or in covered double boiler dutch oven for 60 minutes , or until toothpick comes out clean
6. Let cool and unmold
7. Refrigerate until serving time
8. Would be white cheddar cheese or monterrey jack

title: pomberrytini
steps:
1. Place everything except the orange slices in a cocktail shaker
2. Shake until well mixed and well chilled
3. Pour into martini glasses and float an orange slice in each glass

title: mushroom pita pockets
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine mushrooms , red pepper , cucumber , onion , cheese
2. Add dressing
3. Toss to mix well
4. Open pita halves and place lettuce leaf in each pita half
5. Spon filling evenly into the pita halves
6. Garnish with fresh herbs if desired
7. Variation: spread 1 tablespoons low-fat mayonnaise inside each pita half

title: piyaz
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients in a bowl , stirring very gently with a spoon so as not to chop up the beans
2. Let sit in the refrigerator for at least an hour to allow the flavors to meld

title: kiwifruit chutney
steps:
1. In a saucepan mix all ingredients
2. Boil gently & stir frequently for about 1 hour or until soft & thick
3. Cool , then spoon into sterilized jars & seal

title: bangalore fish curry
steps:
1. Cut halibut into chunks and set aside
2. Slice shallot thinly
3. Gently fry shallot , garlic and ginger for 5 minutes , or untill the shallots are soft
4. Add chilli powder , tumeric , garam marsala and funugreek and cook for a further 2 minutes
5. Add coconut milk and heat till the coconut milk bubbles
6. Add halibut chunks , curry leaves and salt and pepper to taste
7. Cook over a low heat for 15 to 20 minutes
8. Mix cornflour with a little water and add to the dish to thicken

title: sweetie meatballs in apricot sauce
steps:
1. Place the apricots in a dish
2. Pour the 2 cups hot water over them to completely cover
3. Allow them to soak for at least 2 hours or overnight
4. To make meatballs , preheat the oven to 375 degrees
5. In a bowl mix together all the meatball ingredients
6. Shape the mixture into 1 inch balls and put on an ungreased baking sheet
7. Bake for 25-30 minutes , or until meatballs are browned
8. Put the cooked meatballs into a baking dish and hold to the side
9. While the meatballs are cooking place the apricots along with the water they have been soaking in , into a sauce pan
10. Add the two cinnamon sticks and bring to a boil
11. Lower the heat , cover and simmer until the apricots are soft , about 15 minutes
12. Remove the cinnamon sticks
13. Put the mixture into a blender or food processor , add the sugar and ginger and blend until smooth
14. Pour the apricot sauce over the meatballs and bake uncovered for 20 minutes in a 350 degree oven

title: blanca s rich and creamy vanilla pudding
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan , combine the cornstarch and salt
2. Slowly whisk in the whole milk then the sweetened condensed milk until thoroughly combined
3. Heat the mixture over medium heat , whisking constantly and scraping sides and bottom of saucepan
4. When mixture begins to thicken a bit , add about 1 cup of it to the egg yolks
5. Mix well and then add the egg mixture back to saucepan
6. Cook , stirring constantly , until thickened
7. Strain the pudding through a fine-mesh strainer into a bowl , scraping with a rubber spatula to pass the pudding through
8. Stir the butter and vanilla into the pudding until the butter is melted
9. To prevent a skin from forming , press a piece of plastic wrap directly on the surface of the pudding or you can dust it with a little bit of cinnamon and put some raisins on top like my mom does
10. Refrigerate until set , about 3 hours

title: banana toffee blondies
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350
2. Grease and flour a 9" baking pan
3. Sift flour , baking powder and salt into a bowl
4. Set aside
5. In another bowl , beat butter and brown sugar until fluffy
6. Add vanilla extract
7. Beat eggs in one at a time until blended
8. Add flour mixture a little at a time just until blended
9. Stir in 1 cup of toffee bits and the banana by hand
10. Pour into the prepared pan and sprinkle remaining toffee bits on the top
11. Bake 30 minutes
12. Cool , dust with powdered sugar and cut into squares

title: black eyed peas with mustard greens and rice
steps:
1. Melt the butter in a wide soup pot over medium heat and let it brown for several minutes until it smells nutty
2. Add the sesame oil , then the onions , bay leaves , celery , garlic , thyme , chile flakes , smoked paprika , cumin and celery leaves
3. Cook stirring occasionally , until the onions have browned , about 20 minutes
4. Stir in the tomato paste , then add the beans , 2 quarts water , and 1 tsp salt
5. Simmer , covered , until the beans are tender
6. Taste for salt and season with pepper
7. Cut the mustard greens off their stems and wash them
8. Simmer in salted water to cover until tender , a few minutes , then transfer to a strainer , rinse with cool water , and chop
9. Stir them into the beans
10. Taste once more for salt and season with plenty of pepper
11. Add a few spoonfuls of rice to each bowl and serve with tabasco , crystal , or other favorite hot sauce on the side

title: asparagus with fresh tomato yogurt sauce
steps:
1. Cut asparagus in 2 or 3 pieces
2. Cook in boiling salted water until just tender but still bright green drain and rinse with cold water to stop the cooking process
3. Pat dry with paper towels
4. While asparagus is cooking , combine the yogurt , mayonnaise , lemon juice , tomatoes , salt and fresh ground pepper
5. Place the asparagus on a flat plate and spoon the sauce across the center
6. Serve at room temperature

title: mary s zucchini scones
steps:
1. Mix flour , baking powder , salt , sugar , cinnamon and grated zucchini
2. Peels together
3. Cut in the butter until it resembles coarse
4. Cornmeal
5. Mix the egg with milk
6. Add to flour mixture with
7. The grated zucchini
8. Stir until a soft dough forms
9. Turn on to a lightly floured board
10. Roll into a ball
11. Cut in half and pat each half into a 6-7 inch round
12. Dip
13. A knife into flour and cut each round into 5 wedges
14. Place on a cookie sheet sprayed with cooking spray
15. Bake 15 minutes at 425 degrees
16. Makes 12 scones

title: concord grape pie
steps:
1. Squeeze the end of each grape opposite the stem to separate skins from pulp
2. Set skins aside
3. Place pulp in a medium saucepan
4. Bring to a boil
5. Boil and stir for 1 minute
6. Press through a strainer or food mill to remove seeds
7. Combine pulp , skins , sugar , flour , lemon juice and salt
8. Pour into pastry shell
9. Combine oats , brown sugar and flour
10. Cut in butter until crumbly
11. Sprinkle over filling
12. Cover edges of pastry with foil
13. Bake at 425f for 15 minutes
14. Remove foil
15. Bake 20 minutes more or until golden brown
16. Cool on a wire rack

title: kossmans my delight hot dish
steps:
1. Place hamburger in bottom of baking dish
2. Add a layer of sliced onion
3. Add a layer of one inch thick sliced potatoes
4. Put in kidney beans with the juice from the can
5. Add can tomatoes , with juice or 1 can tomato soup
6. With water
7. Salt and pepper to taste
8. Cover with foil bake 1 hour at 425 degrees put on cookie sheet as this is so full
9. Uncover
10. Crush potato chips over top
11. Bake for 30 minutes

title: mrs  gordon s chinese chicken wings
steps:
1. If you are using frozen chicken wings , defrost them first
2. If you prefer , cut off
3. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
4. Mix all the ingredients together in a bowl
5. Spray a 9x11 baking dish with veg
6. Oil spray
7. Place chicken wings in single depth in the pan
8. Pour the mixture over the chicken wings and place in oven
9. Bake for 30 minutes , then turn wings
10. Bake for another 30 minutes , and turn wings again
11. Increase heat to 375 and bake for final 30 minutes , and then they are done
12. Take out of cooking liquid to serve or keep warm till serving

title: pumpkin cookies  gluten free
steps:
1. Mix together the sugar and shortening
2. Add the remaining ingredients and blend until smooth
3. Spoon onto a nonstick baking sheet
4. Bake at 375 degrees f for 10-12 minutes
5. Cool completely before icing

title: baked chicken masala with almond pilaf
steps:
1. Heat oven to 220c / 200c fan / gas 7
2. Put the rice in a saucepan with 600ml water , 1 heaped tsp turmeric , 1 tsp curry powder and some salt
3. Bring to the boil , stir , cover , turn heat to low and cook for 30 mins , or until tender
4. Try not to take the lid off during cooking
5. Remove from heat and leave covered for 5 minutes add the almonds , and fluff with a fork
6. Meanwhile , mix 2 tsp curry powder , the remaining turmeric , 2 tbsp yogurt and seasoning
7. Add chicken and toss to coat
8. Toss the tomatoes and onions in a roasting tray with the rest of the curry powder , then nestle in the chicken pieces
9. Bake for 15-20 mins until the chicken is cooked through and the veg are soft
10. Scatter coriander over the top and serve with the rice and remaining yogurt

title: spinach  poblano enchiladas
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400o
2. Saute onion in 2 t butter in a large saucepan over medium-high heat , 3 minutes
3. Add garlic , salt , and pepper
4. Saute 1 minute
5. Add flour
6. Cook 5 minutes , stirring frequently
7. Gradually add half and half
8. Stirring constantly~ bring to a boil , reduce heat , and simmer 5 minutes
9. Add poblano and spinach
10. Cool 5 minute stir in crumbled cheese and lime juice
11. Assemble enchiladas heating tortillas in a dry skillet over medium heat until flexible
12. Dip in 1 cup chile sauce , fill with 1 / 3 cup filling , roll , and top with 1 cup sauce and shredded cheese
13. Bake enchiladas for 10 minute
14. Garnish with pico de gallo
15. Filling add-ins
16. 1 cup cooked shrimp , chopped
17. 1 cup lump crab meat
18. 1 cup cooked chicken , shredded
19. 1 / 2 cup bacon cooked and crumbled
20. 1 cup peeled jicama , diced

title: potato bread abm
steps: 1. Follow direction given with your bread machine

title: oatmeal and raisin spice cookie bars
steps:
1. Brush a 13 x 9 inch baking dish with oil , then line with parchment paper or foil , pressing paper down firmly so it stays
2. Leave a slight overhang of paper
3. In mixing bowl cream the margarine or butter until light
4. Add the sugars and beat until smooth
5. Add the egg and vanilla and mix in well
6. In a separate bowl mix the flour , baking powder , cinnamon , allspice and ginger
7. Mix into the batter , then stir in the oatmeal and raisins
8. Press dough evenly into the lined baking pan
9. The dough will be a bit sticky and there will seem to be almost not enough to fill the pan
10. Bake in a pre-heated 350 degree oven for 15 to 18 minutes , until golden
11. Bake a bit less for chewier bars , a bit more for crispy bars
12. Let cool for 3 or 4 minutes , then lift gently out of the pan
13. Cool a couple more minutes , cut into squares , then cool fully

title: brinjal chips
steps:
1. Heat oil in a deep frying pan
2. Fry brinjal slices till they turn light brown
3. Remove extra oil with paper towel
4. Sprinkle salt and chilli powder

title: savory meatballs
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease a casserole dish
3. Mix all 11 ingredients together
4. Form into 16 small balls
5. Roll in the flour
6. In a frypan in hot oil , brown meatballs on all sides
7. Place the meatballs in casserole dish
8. Sprinkle lightly with additional 2 tbsp flour
9. Add in the 1-1 / 2 cups tomato juice
10. Bake for 45 minutes

title: tanzanian curried spinach with peanut butter
steps:
1. Wash the spinach leaves , stack and roll leaves together , then coarsely chop
2. Place the tomato carefully into a small pot of boiling water for 30 seconds , peel skin off
3. Slice tomato in half and scoop out runny inside , discard this part , then coarsely chop the fleshy part
4. In small bowl , whisk the peanut butter and coconut milk til smooth
5. Heat the butter over medium low heat in large frying pan
6. Add the onion , tomato , salt and curry powder and saut for about 5 minutes , or until the onion is soft
7. Stir only occasionally so that you don't break up the tomato too much
8. Add the spinach , and continue cooking for about 10 minutes , until the spinach is softened , but not overly cooked
9. Stir in the peanut butter / coconut milk mixture
10. Simmer , over medium-low heat , for about another 5-8 minutes , stirring constantly , to make sure that the mixture doesn't stick to the bottom of the pot
11. Season lightly with a little coarse ground pepper to taste
12. Serve as is as a side dish , or over hot cooked rice for a main dish

title: fresh orange cranberry fig relish
steps:
1. Put cranberries and dried figs in a food processor and blend until coarsely chopped
2. Transfer to a bowl and add mint and basil , if using
3. Stir together marmalade and balsamic vinegar
4. Add to the cranberry mixture
5. Stir well
6. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours or up to 1 week
7. You may freeze up to 6 months
8. Thaw overnight in the refrigerator before serving
9. Enjoy !
10. Makes 4 cups
11. If the cranberries are frozen measure while frozen
12. Let stand at room temperature 15 minutes to thaw slightly before processing

title: mom s refrigerator coconut cake  easy
steps:
1. Prepare cake mix and bake in 9x13 pan
2. Poke holes in cake
3. On stove top , heat sugar , milk , 1 / 2 of the coconut until the sugar is melted
4. Pour over warm cake
5. When the cake is cooled , frost with thawed whipped topping and the remaining coconut
6. Refrigerate
7. It tastes better if it is made 1-2 days ahead of time

title: ground turkey spaghetti sauce
steps:
1. In a 4 1 / 2 quart pot / pan brown the ground turkey over medium heat
2. Add the onion and garlic and cook until softened
3. Add tomato paste and crushed tomatoes , stirring until all is combined
4. Add chicken broth to thin it down a little bit
5. Add spices , butter , and salt and pepper and allow to simmer over low heat for about 15 minutes
6. Taste and adjust seasonings to preference

title: beef and green onion cheese ball
steps:
1. Soften the cream cheese to room temperature
2. Use your food processor to finely mince the dried beef
3. Use your food processor to finely mince the green onions
4. Add the beef , the onions and 1 / 4 cup of pecans to the cream cheese and mix well
5. Form into a ball
6. Roll in remaining chopped pecans
7. Refrigerate for at least one hour
8. That was a hit too !

title: gingered cucumber carrot salad
steps:
1. Combine cucumber , carrots , and parsley in a bowl
2. In a small bowl , whisk together the remaining ingredients
3. Pour over salad and toss to coat
4. Refrigerate until serving
5. Serve with a slottd spoon

title: 3 bean hot dish
steps:
1. Mix all of the ingredients and bake for 1 hour in a 350f oven
2. Or better yet mix in a crock pot and let simmer on low for 8 hours

title: the best tiramisu recipe   really
steps:
1. To start i chill the bowl i will be whipping the cream in
2. Combine egg yolks and sugar in the top of a double boiler
3. I do this over boiling water
4. Reduce heat to low
5. Cook for about 10 minutes and don't go anywhere ! stir it constantly
6. Remove the mixture from heat and whip the yolks until its thick
7. Add the mascarpone to the whipped yolks
8. Beat until combined
9. Pull your chilled bowl out of fridge and whip the cream until the stiff peaks are formed
10. Gently fold into yolk mixture and set aside
11. Split the lady fingers in half
12. Line the bottom and sides of your serving bowl with the ladyfingers
13. Brush the lady fingers with the kahlua or your substitution
14. Spoon half of the cream filling over the lady fingers
15. Now you are going to layer - using ladyfingers , brushed kahlua and filling
16. Keep going till you run out of lady fingers
17. The top layer of filling is finished off with cocoa or chocolate curls
18. Big success hint: "ya gotta refrigerate several hours or overnight to get the flavors to mingle ! "

title: hershey s chocolate french toast
steps:
1. Beat eggs , milk , sugar , hershey's cocoa , vanilla , salt and cinnamon , if desired , in large bowl until smooth
2. Heat griddle or skillet over medium-low heat
3. Grease griddle with margarine , if necessary
4. Dip bread in egg mixture
5. Place on griddle
6. Cook about 2 to 4 minutes on each side
7. Serve immediately with powdered sugar or pancake syrup , if desired

title: beets with walnut garlic sauce
steps:
1. Combine first 7 ingredients in a food processor
2. Process until smooth
3. Combine walnut mixture and beets in a large bowl

title: a b c muffin base mix
steps:
1. Measure all ingredients into a large bowl , blend well and the transfer to a sealable storage container
2. To make 24 regular sized muffins:
3. Preheat oven to 400
4. Combine the following
5. 4 eggs
6. 3 teaspoons vanilla
7. 2 cups water
8. 1 cup oil
9. 5-1 / 2 cups muffin mix
10. The batter should be slightly lumpy
11. Fill muffin tins 3 / 4 full
12. Bake for 18 to 20 minutes , or until muffins are golden brown
13. Muffins freeze well
14. To reheat frozen muffins , microwave on high for 30 seconds per muffin

title: super healthy double chocolate zucchini bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease and flour 2 9x5 inch loaf pans
3. Microwave chocolate squares until melted , set a side
4. In a large bowl , combine eggs , splenda , sugar , brown sugar , and applesauce
5. Mix well
6. Add grated zucchini , vanilla , and chocolate
7. Mix well
8. In another bowl , sift flour , baking soda , and salt
9. Add flour mixture to liquid mixture
10. Mix well
11. Stir in mini chocolate chips
12. Pour in greased loaf pans
13. Bake for 60-70 minutes , or until a toothpick inserted into the center of loaf comes out clean

title: mini drop donuts
steps:
1. Add all ingredients together , remember you need a thick consistancy , add more flour if needed
2. Making sure the eggs are mixed in well
3. Heat oil to 350 degrees
4. Drop donuts into oil and fry until brown
5. Test inside to make sure they cook through
6. Drain
7. Roll in confectionery sugar or cinnamon and sugar

title: sprouting bean burgers
steps:
1. Place the chick-peas , wheat berries , carrots , potatoes , onions , salt substitute , basil , thyme , pepper and rosemary in a food processor
2. Puree
3. Add the soy sauce or tamari to taste transfer to a large bowl
4. Stir in enough bread crumbs to make a mixture that holds together
5. Form into 6 patties
6. Fry in the oil on a non stick griddle over medium heat

title: yummy stuffed chicken breasts
steps:
1. Melt butter in saucepan and add celery , mushrooms , and onion
2. Saute until softened
3. Put desired amount of breadcrumbs in a bowl and add specified amount of chicken broth to moisten crumbs
4. Mix together and then add ingredients from saucepan
5. Mix thoroughly and add seasonings
6. After flattening chicken breasts , place stuffing onto each breast
7. Use toothpicks to close the breast
8. Put in pan or cookie sheet
9. I have baked this in the oven- 350 degrees- approx
10. 30 mins or you can cook it on stovetop
11. Sometimes when i cook on stovetop i put a can of cream of mushrooms soup to give moisture and acts as a sauce
12. Enjoy !

title: pork and vegetable kabobs
steps:
1. Cut all cubed ingredients about 1 inch square
2. In a food processor , pulse the oil , salt and pepper , and basil leaves until just combined
3. Thread the pork and vegetables onto the skewers , alternating each one after the other
4. Brush with the oil basil mixture and grill on a medium fire turning often , and brushing with basil and oil until pork is just done

title: veal chops victor
steps:
1. Season& brown chops in olive oil with onions
2. Add sliced carrots , dry sherry , diced tomatoes
3. Cover& simmer 1 hour
4. Saute sliced mushrooms and green pepper in butter until tender
5. Add to chops with parsley just before serving

title: bailey s irish cream cupcakes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Line 18 muffin cups with liners
3. In bowl , mix cocoa and hot water until dissolved
4. Reserve
5. Melt 6 t butter
6. Reserve
7. In bowl , mix flour with next five ingredients
8. Whisk in buttermilk , eggs , melted butter and cocoa mixture
9. Stir in chips
10. Divide among liners
11. Bake 18-22 minutes or until toothpick inserted comes out clean
12. Cool 10 minutes
13. Transfer from pan to racks
14. Cool
15. On medium-high speed , beat remaining butter until fluffy
16. Gradually beat in confectioners' sugar until blended
17. Add liqueur
18. Beat until light and fluffy , 2 minutes
19. Beat in 1 / 8 t food coloring until blended
20. If desired , fit large star
21. Using paintbrush starting at
22. Place bag in glass
23. Fill with frosting
24. Pipe , or with spoon , spread frosting over cupcakes
25. If desired , decorate with shamrocks

title: bread machine hamburger buns
steps:
1. Add ingredients according to bread machine instructions and set on dough cycle
2. When complete , shape into balls and flatten to about 3 / 4 inch thick
3. Place on a lightly greased cookie sheet
4. Cover with a damp towel and place in a warm place to rise for about an hour
5. Optional: once they have risen , brush tops with melted butter / margarine or egg wash
6. Important place them in a cold oven
7. Set to 300 degrees
8. When the oven indicates that it's up to temperature , turn the oven up to 400 degrees
9. Set the timer for 15 min and watch closely
10. It's done in about 10 min in my oven
11. The buns should be just set

title: rob roy
steps:
1. In a chilled cocktail shaker filled with ice , add all ingredients& stir
2. Strain into a well chilled martini glass& garnish with a twist

title: chickpea salad
steps:
1. In a large bowl , toss together the rinsed and drained chickpeas , onion , peppers , cilantro and parsley
2. In a small bowl , whisk together the crushed garlic , lemon juice , olive oil , salt , pepper and sugar
3. Pour the dressing over the salad mixture and gently toss to coat well

title: gorgonzola and kalamata snack toasts
steps:
1. Preheat oven or toaster oven to 350 degrees
2. Place bread slices on baking sheet
3. Drizzle slices with seasoned oil
4. Sprinkle cheese on bread , then chopped olives
5. Toast until crispy and brown
6. Place on serving plate and sprinkle basil over tops
7. Please don't worry about exact measurements , this is an easy no measure dish , just guestimate !

title: garden primavera fettuccine
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , cook fettuccine according to the package directions
2. Add vegetables during the last 4 minutes of cooking pasta
3. Drain and return all to the pan
4. Add alfredo sauce and basil , tossing to coat
5. Cook over low heat for 1-2 minutes or until heated through
6. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese to your taste right before serving

title: shrimp with sweet toasty garlic  camarones al mojo de ajo
steps:
1. First , prepare the mojo de ajo:
2. Chop the garlic by hand or in the food processor until the garlic bits are about an 1 / 8" in size--about 1 / 2 cup of chopped garlic
3. Place the garlic in small saucepan , measure in the oil and about 1 / 2 teaspoon of salt and set over medium low heat
4. Stir occasionally as the mixture comes barely to a simmer
5. Adjust the heat to the very lowest possible setting and cook , stirring occasionally , until the garlic is a soft , pale golden --about thirty minutes
6. Add the lime and simmer about five minutes , until the juice has evaporated or been absorbed
7. Stir in the chiles , then taste and add additional salt if necessary
8. Keep the pan over the lowest heat so the garlic will be warm when the shrimp are ready
9. Put the lime wedges into a serving bowl and set them out
10. Now , prepare the shrimp:
11. Set a large , heavy skillet over medium-high heat and spoon about one and a half tablespoons of the oil from the mojo
12. Add half the shrimp to the skillet , sprinkle with salt , and stir gently and continuously until the shrimp are just cooked through
13. Add half the cilantro and scoop the shrimp onto a warm , deep serving platter
14. Repeat with another one and a half tablespoons of the oil and the rest of the shrimp and cilantro
15. Now , finish the dish:
16. When all the shrimp are cooked and placed in the serving platter , use a slotted spoon to scoop out the warm bits of garlic and chiles from the mojo pan and scatter them over the shrimp
17. Serve with the lime wedges to , as mr
18. Bayless says , add sparkle

title: meat lover s slow cooker spaghetti sauce
steps:
1. Heat olive oil in skillet over medium heat
2. Cook and stir onions and sausage , until sausage is browned , about 10 minutes
3. Transfer the sausage and onions to a slow cooker
4. In the same skillet , cook and stir the ground beef , italian seasoning , 1 t of garlic powder , and marjoram , breaking the meat up as it cooks , until the meat is browned , about 10 minutes
5. Transfer the ground beef into the slow cooker
6. Stir in the tomato sauce , tomato paste , diced tomatoes , stewed tomatoes , thyme , basil , oregano and 2 t garlic powder
7. Cook on low for about 8 hours
8. About 15 minutes before serving , stir in the sugar
9. Serve hot over pasta

title: peanut butterfinger chunk cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Grease two cookie sheets
3. Blend sugars , butter , egg whites and vanilla in processor until fluffy , stopping to scrape down sides , about 1 minute
4. Add peanut butter and continue processing until combined , about 20 seconds
5. Add flour , baking soda and salt and blend until just combined , pulsing
6. Do not over process
7. Transfer to a large bowl
8. Stir in chopped butterfinger bars
9. Mound dough by 1+1 / 2 tablespoonfuls onto prepared cookie sheets , spacing 2 inches apart
10. Flatten slightly using fingers
11. Bake until dry in appearance and centers are still slightly soft to touch , about 15 minutes
12. Cool on cookie sheets 3 minutes
13. Transfer to rack and cool completely

title: coca cola cake  closest to cracker barrel s
steps:
1. In a saucepan , bring 1 / 2 cup butter , 1 cup coke , and baking chocolate to a boil
2. Remove from heat and stir in marshmallows until dissolved
3. Set aside and allow to cool to room temperature
4. In a bowl , combine flour , 3 / 4 cup cocoa , baking powder , baking soda , and salt
5. Set aside
6. Beat together sugar , shortening , oil , and 2 teaspoons vanilla until fluffy
7. Add eggs and buttermilk and beat until smooth
8. Add 1 / 2 of the dry mixture into the wet mixture and beat until smooth , scraping the sides of the bowl often
9. Add cooled coke mixture and beat
10. Add remaining dry mixture and beat 4 minutes
11. Batter will be thick
12. Pour batter into a greased and floured 13x9 baking pan
13. Bake on top rack of a 350 degree oven for 35-40 minutes , or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
14. Frosting:
15. In a saucepan , combine the butter , cocoa and milk
16. Heat until butter melts
17. Beat in remaining ingredients
18. Spread on hot cake
19. Let it cool and then serve

title: chocolate covered cranberries
steps:
1. Melt chocolate chips and shortening over low heat , stirring frequently until melted
2. Dip cranberries in chocolate with toothpick until coated
3. Place on wax paper
4. Refrigerate until firm
5. Enjoy !

title: mediterranean garlic feta spread
steps:
1. Mix together the feta , garlic , and chopped oregano , until it becomes a somewhat smooth yet lumpy consistency
2. Serve with whatever you like for dipping

title: mrs  mac s pumpkin cookies
steps:
1. Cream together pumpkin , butter , and sugar
2. Add flour and spices
3. Dough will be thick
4. Drop by teaspoons onto ungreased baking sheet
5. Bake for 11 minutes at 375 degrees
6. Remove and cool , then glaze
7. Frosting: melt butter , remove from heat
8. Stir in powdered sugar and vanilla
9. It won't all mix in , but then add enough milk to make a frosting / glaze
10. Casually frost cooled cookies

title: red  white and blue cheesecake with chocolate cookie crust
steps:
1. Make the crust:
2. In a bowl stir together the cookie crumbs and the butter until the mixture is combined well and pat the mixture onto the bottom and 1 / 2 inch up the side of a 9 1 / 2-inch spring form pan
3. Chill the crust for 30 minutes
4. Make the filling:
5. Preheat the oven to 325f in a bowl with an electric mixer beat the cream cheese until it is light and fluffy , add the sugar gradually , beating , and beat the mixture until it is combined well
6. Beat in the flour , add the eggs , 1 at a time , beating well after each addition , and beat in the sour cream , the zests , the salt , and the vanilla , beating the filling until it is combined well
7. Pour the filling into the crust and bake the cheesecake in a foil-lined shallow baking pan in the middle of the oven for 1 hour and 10 minutes
8. Turn the oven off and let the cheesecake stand in the oven with the oven door propped open about 6 inches until it is cooled completely and remove the side of the pan
9. Arrange the raspberries on top of the cheesecake in a star shape and arrange the blueberries around the star to cover the top of the cheesecake

title: tex mex cornbread
steps:
1. Mix corn meal , baking powder , and salt
2. Combine the remaining ingredients
3. Add to dry mix
4. Stir until blended well
5. Pour into greased 9x9 baking pan
6. Bake at 375 for about 40 mnutes , until bread tests done

title: baked pasta with butternut squash and ricotta
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Coat a baking sheet with cooking spray
3. Coat a 2 1 / 2- to 3-quart baking dish with cooking spray
4. Place squash on prepared baking sheet
5. Roast until tender , about 20 to 30 minutes
6. Place in a large bowl and mash
7. Meanwhile , bring a large pot of salted water to a boil
8. After squash has been roasting for about 10 minutes , cook pasta according to package directions
9. Drain and return to pot
10. In a medium saucepan , whisk together milk , flour , garlic , salt and pepper
11. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat , whisking frequently
12. Reduce heat to low and simmer , stirring often , until thickened , about 2 minutes
13. Remove from heat
14. Stir in mashed squash and 2 1 / 2 teaspoons of thyme
15. Add sauce to pasta
16. Toss to mix and coat
17. Transfer pasta mixture to prepared baking dish
18. Dot with spoonfuls of ricotta and then sprinkle with parmesan and walnuts
19. Bake until top is lightly browned in a few spots , about 15 to 20 minutes
20. Remove from oven and sprinkle with remaining 1 / 2 teaspoon of thyme

title: savory eggs
steps:
1. Spread cheese in buttered 9x13 inch baking dish
2. Dot with butter
3. Combine cream , mustard , salt and pepper
4. Pour half of the cream mixture over cheese
5. Pour eggs into baking dish
6. Add rest of cream mixture
7. Bake at 325 degrees for 40 minutes , or until set

title: chicken  black bean and rice soup
steps:
1. Saute onion and garlic in oil until tender
2. Stir in the remaining ingredients and heat through

title: mealie soup
steps:
1. Heat the butter in a pot over moderate heat and saute the onion until tender but not brown , about 5 minutes
2. Add the tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes
3. Add the remaining ingredients and bring to a boil
4. Reduce the heat and simmer for 10 minutes

title: chiles rellenos con carne
steps:
1. For the chiles:
2. Cook ground pork and ground beef in a skillet over medium high heat
3. Add onions and cook until tender
4. Drain fat from the meat and onions
5. Add salt , raisins , almonds , cloves , coriander , and garlic
6. Add enough stock to moisten
7. Cook until thick
8. Reserve remaining stock for sauce
9. Roast chilies and remove outer skin
10. Slit each chile down the center , just enough to remove as many seeds as possible and fill chiles with meat
11. If desired , you can add some shredded monterrey jack cheese
12. Secure with a toothpick if necessary
13. For the batter:
14. Beat egg whites until stiff
15. Beat the yolks until thick and then fold gently into the egg whites
16. Add flour and mix well
17. Add salt
18. Using a large spoon , dip stuffed chiles into batter
19. Drop into 1 / 2 inch hot oil and fry until brown on both sides
20. Remove chiles and drain on paper towels
21. For the sauce:
22. Brown flour in the shortening
23. Add beef stock and tomato sauce and cook 5 minutes
24. Pour sauce over stuffed chiles and serve

title: mincemeat squares
steps:
1. Pastry:
2. Sift flour , sugar and salt into a large bowl
3. Cut in lard with a pastry blender until it resembles coarse meal
4. Put egg yolk in measuring cup , add milk to make 1 / 2 cup
5. Add egg mixture to bowl
6. Stir until dough clings together and forms a ball
7. Roll out half the dough on a floured surface to a 15" x 11" rectangle
8. Transfer to a cookie sheet
9. Roll out pastry directly onto the paper for easy transfer to baking sheet
10. Filling:
11. Spread mincemeat filling evenly over dough to within 3 / 4 inch of edges
12. Dot the top of the mincemeat with the bits of butter
13. Final assembly:
14. Roll out remaining half of dough
15. Cut vents
16. Moisten edges of bottom pastry with cool water using a pastry brush or your fingers
17. Cover filling with the top pastry , sealing edges
18. Pinch edges together and crimp
19. Topping:
20. Beat egg white until stiff
21. Spread on top crust
22. Bake in preheated 400 degree fahrenheit oven for 25 minutes , or until golden brown
23. Remove to wire rack
24. Glaze :
25. Combine icing sugar and lemon juice in a small bowl
26. Drizzle over warm pastry
27. Cool slightly before cutting into squares to serve

title: honey mustard salad dressing iii
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients in bowl
2. Serve
3. Simply add more honey if desired

title: mushroom onion quiche
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees
2. Chop onions and slice mushrooms
3. Melt margarine in skillet
4. Saute onions until transparent
5. Add mushrooms
6. Cover and cook 10 minutes
7. Allow to cool
8. Mix together egg , flour , non-dairy milk and wine
9. Salt and pepper to taste
10. Pour into pie crust
11. Form lattice strips from second crust and place on top of quiche
12. Bake for 2 minutes

title: plaza iii steak soup   copycat
steps:
1. Melt butter in stock pot
2. Blend in flour to make a smooth paste
3. Gradually add hot water a little at a time
4. Whisking it smooth as you go
5. Simmer until smooth
6. Saut beef in a large skillet and drain off fat add meat , bouillon , all vegetables and seasonings to saucepan
7. Bring to a boil , then reduce heat and simmer until vegetables are cooked

title: battered fish
steps:
1. Sift dry ingredients
2. Add water and mix well
3. Use to coat fish or chicken filets
4. Cover the fish completely
5. Deep fry until a nice golden brown

title: warm chicken mu shu wraps
steps:
1. Combine cornstarch , 1 tbs soy sauce , 1 tbs white wine and pour over chicken
2. Toss to coat well and marinate 15-30 minutes
3. When marinating time is finished , wrap tortillas in foil and heat in 350f oven
4. Meanwhile , heat a heavy wok or large skillet over high heat , until a drop of water dropped on surface evaporates immediately
5. Add 1 1 / 2 tbs oil , swirling to coat evenly
6. Add eggs and cook , stirring until just set
7. Remove eggs and transfer to bowl
8. Add 1 1 / 2 tbs oil again , and add green onions and bean sprouts , and stir fry until done
9. Add 1 tbs wine
10. Remove and transfer to bowl with eggs
11. Heat 2 tbs oil again , and add chicken with marinade
12. Stir fry until done
13. Add 2 tbs soy sauce and wine
14. Add back the eggs and vegetables to heat through
15. Divide mixture into the 8 tortillas and roll up each one
16. Top with a spoon of hoisin sauce , if desired

title: peanuty asian cole slaw
steps:
1. In medium bowl - whisk together all dressing ingredients
2. Let sit at least a 1 / 2 hour
3. Add slaw ingredients , one by one , mixing together to dressing before adding in the next one
4. Toss sesame seeds
5. Great as a side , or can be added with grilled chicken & a whole wheat wrap for a filling lunch ! i also love with sliced cucumber too ! the raisins are great for sweetness , rather than using pure sugar !

title: veal or chicken scaloppine with saffron cream sauce
steps:
1. Sprinkle the meat with salt and pepper
2. Melt 1 / 2 t butter and 2 tsp of oil in heavy frying pan over high heat
3. Working in batches , add meat and saute until just cooked through and golden , about 45-60 seconds per side
4. Transfer to a platter and tent with foil to keep warm
5. Repeat with more butter and oil as necessary
6. Melt 1 t butter and add 1 t oil in same pan over high heat
7. Add the mishrooms and shallots , sprinkle with salt and pepper and saute until mushrooms are golden brown , about 8 minutes
8. Add wine , broth and saffron and simmer until the liquid is reduced by half , about 5 minutes
9. Add cream and boil until the sauce thickens slightly , stirring often , about 4 minutes
10. Add peas and return the sauce to a simmer
11. Season sauce with salt & pepper to taste
12. Pour sauce over scaloppini and serve with lemon wedges

title: green olive pesto
steps:
1. Put everything but the oilve oil in a blender and blend for one minute
2. With motor running , slowly add oliv eoil until it forms a thick , smooth paste
3. Allow to stand for 1 / 2 hour before serving

title: usmc sos
steps:
1. Brown the ground beef in a medium skillet over medium-high heat , until meat is no longer pink
2. Drain excess fat and set aside
3. Melt the butter or margarine in a medium saucepan over medium high heat
4. Slowly add the flour , stirring constantly , to form a brown roux
5. Pour in beef broth and milk , mixing well
6. Add ground beef , then season with salt and pepper to taste , onion powder , garlic powder and worcestershire sauce
7. Mix well and simmer for 5-10 mins , until desired thickness is reached
8. Spread over a piece of texas toast

title: strawberry and spinach salad with poppy seed dressing
steps:
1. Combine the spinach , red cabbage and green onion
2. Whisk the cider vinegar , olive oil , sugar , poppy seeds , paprika and worcestershire sauce together in a bowl
3. Season to taste with salt and pepper
4. Toss the salad with the poppy seed dressing and arrange on eight individual plates
5. Top with fresh strawberries , almonds and sesame seeds

title: asian vinaigrette salad dressing
steps:
1. Mix first 5 ingredients in a bowl or food processor
2. If using a bowl: slowly drizzle in the sesame and peanut oil , whisking constantly so that the dressing will emulsify
3. If using a food processor , leave it running while you drizzle in the oil
4. When dressing is well combined , add sesame seeds and scallions
5. Serve immediately or refrigerate and use within a week

title: jamaican callaloo greens
steps:
1. Place first six ingredients in a large stew pot
2. Simmer until the salt pork is tender
3. Add the okra and crab meat
4. Simmer for 5 minutes and season to taste with salt , pepper , and scotch bonnet pepper
5. Serve while still hot

title: ravioli skillet lasagna  florentine
steps:
1. Mix together egg and ricotta
2. Pour spaghetti sauce an water into a deep pan and place over moderate heat
3. Boil the ravioli , drain and add to sauce
4. Fold in ricotta and egg mixture
5. Add thawed spinach and romano and heat
6. Serve hot
7. Cottage cheese has a totally different taste than ricotta and i do not recommend it as a substitution

title: brighton beach sid s famous vegetarian chopped liver  green bean
steps:
1. Lightly toast the walnuts in a heavy based pan
2. Set aside
3. Saute onions in the oil , cooking until golden
4. Add tomato paste to this and cook 1 more minute
5. Remove from heat and cool slightly
6. Add onion mix , toasted walnuts , and remaining ingredients to blender or food processor and grind together well
7. Taste for additional salt and pepper
8. Chill for 4 hours
9. Bring to room temperature for serving

title: country beef stew
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300 degrees
2. Cut meat into bite-size pieces
3. Cut potatoes into pieces a bit larger than meat
4. Peel carrots and onion and cut celery , carrots , and onion into 1 inch pieces
5. In a large dutch oven , combine all ingredients and bake for 5 hours in 300 degree oven without stirring
6. I like to serve this stew with homemade buttermilk biscuits

title: green beans with feta cheese
steps:
1. Saute onion and garlic in olive oil for a minute- be careful not to burn
2. Add tomatoes , olives and oregano and simmer for about 5-8 minutes
3. Add green beans and simmer for another 5 minutes
4. Just before serving sprinkle feta cheese on top
5. These are delicious hot or cold

title: cranberry orange bagels
steps:
1. In bread machine pan , place 1 cup plus 2 tbsp water , cranberries , brown sugar , orange peel , salt , cloves , flour and yeast in order suggested by manufacturer
2. Select dough setting
3. When cycle is completed , turn dough onto a lightly floured surface
4. Shape into nine balls
5. Push thumb through centers to form a 1-in
6. Whole
7. Stretch and shape dough to form an even ring
8. Cover and let rest for 10 inutes
9. Flatten rings slightly
10. Fill a dutch oven two-thirds full with water
11. Add sugar and bring to a boil
12. Drop bagels , two at a time , into boiling water
13. Cook for 45 seconds
14. Turn and cook 45 seconds longer
15. Remove with a slotted spoon
16. Drain on paper towels
17. Whisk egg white and remaining water
18. Brush over bagels
19. Coat a baking sheet with cooking spray and sprinkle with cornmeal
20. Place bagels 2 inches apart on prepared pan
21. Bake 400 degrees for 18-22 minutes or until golden brown
22. Remove to wire racks to cool

title: mom s meatloaf
steps:
1. Combine beef , bread crumbs , eggs , salt , pepper , and 1 / 3 cup tomato sauce
2. In shallow baking pan shape into loaf
3. Bake at 375 for 1 hr
4. Pour off excess fat
5. Pour remaining sauce over loaf
6. Bake 15 minutes more

title: vegan pumpkin pie smoothie
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in a blender and blend for 2-3 minutes
2. Enjoy ! :)

title: dee s  bacon bread
steps:
1. Proof yeast in warm water with honey
2. Add rest of ingredients
3. Knead until smooth
4. Let rise until double
5. Punch down and put in bread pan that has been greased with bacon grease
6. Bake at 375 degrees for 20 minutes or until bread is browned

title: potatoes nicoise  canadian
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Cut garlic clove in half lengthwise and rub the cut surface on inside of a shallow baking dish
3. Cut peeled potatoes into 1 / 4-inch slices
4. Place potatoes in a bowl of cold water and set aside
5. Peel and core tomatoes and cut into 1 / 2-inch slices
6. Chop parsley and in a small bowl combine parsley , 1 / 2 teaspoon of salt , basil , nutmeg , and tarragon
7. Peel and thinly slice the onions
8. Drain the potatoes and pat dry
9. Place half of the potatoes in the prepared baking dish
10. Sprinkle with half the parsley mixture
11. Top with half the onions and half the tomatoes
12. Sprinkle tomatoes with 1 / 4 teaspoon salt
13. Repeat layering with remaining potatoes , parsley mixture , onions , tomatoes and remaining 1 / 4 teaspoon of salt
14. Cut butter into small pieces and dot top of the casserole
15. Cover tightly with aluminum foil and bake for 45 minutes or until potatoes are fork tender
16. Sprinkle top of casserole with cheese
17. Bake uncovered until lightly brown

title: spaghetti with roasted eggplant and cherry tomatoes
steps:
1. Make the tomato sauce:
2. Heat the oil in a large saucepan over medium heat
3. Add the onion and garlic and cook , stirring , for 7-10 minutes until the vegetables are soft but not browned
4. Add the tomatoes , crushing them in your hand to break them up
5. Add the basil and sugar , if using and season with salt and pepper
6. Cook until the sauce is reduced and thickened , about 10 minutes
7. Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f
8. Cut the eggplants crosswise into 1 / 2" thick rounds and put them in a large bowl
9. Add the garlic , salt , and pepper , and drizzle liberally with olive oil
10. Toss to coat , drizzling in more oil if you needed
11. Arrange the slices in a single layer on a baking sheet and roast 20 minutes until eggplants are very tender
12. While the eggplants are roasting , bring a large pot of salted water to a boil for pasta
13. About 5 minutes before the eggplants are done , drop the pasta into the boiling water and cook until al dente , 6-8 minutes
14. Drain
15. Bring the tomato sauce to a simmer and pour it into a large pasta bowl
16. Add the drained spaghetti and stir to coat with the sauce
17. Fold in the eggplants and the cherry tomatoes
18. Add the cheese , basil and red pepper flakes and another drizzle of oil , and toss gently
19. Serve immediately and pass extra cheese at the table
20. Enjoy !

title: greek cornbread with cheese   bobota me tyri
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f
2. Traditionally , this is baked in a 12" round pan
3. You may use a 9"x13" pan
4. Grease the sides and bottom of the pan and set aside
5. Combine the wet ingredients
6. In another bowl , sift together the cornmeal with the flour , baking soda , baking powder , sugar , and salt
7. Add the wet ingredients to the dry and mix until it is a soft , batter-like dough
8. Spread the batter in the pan and smooth with the spatula
9. Sprinkle with the feta cheese and scatter the pieces of butter evenly over the top of the batter
10. Bake for 40 minutes , or until it is a deep golden brown
11. If it gets too brown before the 40 minutes are up , cover with aluminum foil and continue baking
12. Allow to cool 15 minutes before serving

title: raspberry vinegar
steps:
1. In a medium , nonreactive saucepan over low heat , warm the vinegar just until it begins to give off steam
2. Put 1 pint of the raspberries into a fine sieve fitted over a sterilized 1 / 2-gallon clamp jar
3. Pour the warm vinegar over the berries and let it run into the jar , then add the berries to the jar
4. Allow the mixture to cool 20 to 30 minutes to room temperature , then seal and shake the jar gently
5. Set the jar out of direct sunlight and away from heat to steep for 4 days , shaking it every so often
6. While steeping , the vinegar will take on a raspberry hue and the fruit will lose most of its color
7. Strain the mixture through a fine sieve into a large batter bowl with a handle or into a large , nonreactive saucepan
8. Rinse the jar and return the strained vinegar to it
9. Rinse the bowl or saucepan
10. Dump the fruit and rinse the sieve
11. Dampen a flat-bottom coffee filter , then line the sieve with the filter and fit it over the bowl or saucepan
12. Transfer the vinegar to flasks or bottles
13. Discard fruit
14. If you wish , spear 6 to 8 whole raspberries on a wooden skewer and put the skewer into the container before filling
15. The vinegar should be ready to use immediately , with a shelf life of at least 1 year
16. Variation: for raspberry lemon thyme vinegar , place 1 sprig fresh lemon thy me in a flask or bottle before adding the vinegar
17. Fill , seal , and steep out of direct sunlight and away from heat for 1 week before using or shipping
18. Cranberry vinegar follow the recipe for raspberry vinegar , except substitute 4 cups fresh cranberries , coarsely chopped , for the raspberries
19. Decorate , if you wish , with skewers of whole cranberries

title: sunset scallop   potatoes and carrots
steps:
1. Alternate layers of potatoes with carrots in greased casserole
2. Make white sauce of butter , flour , seasonings and milk
3. Pour sauce over veggies
4. Sprinkle with brown sugar
5. (i usually just mix it in with the white sauce ingredients
6. Cover and bake at 350 for 1 hour
7. Uncover for the last 10 minutes

title: raisin crunch cookie mix  recipe in a jar
steps:
1. Sift together flour , baking soda and baking powder , this will be the last layer in the jar
2. Starting with the brown sugar layer ingredients in the jar in order given
3. Press each layer firmly in place before adding next ingredient , this is a very important step because if one ingredient isn't packed before you put the next layer in it will sift through the last layer
4. Recipe to attach to jar:
5. 1 jar of cookie mix
6. 1 cup softened butter
7. 1 egg slightly beaten
8. 1 teaspoons vanilla
9. Empty cookie mix in large mixing bowl
10. Stir to combine
11. Add 1 cup softened butter , 1 egg slightly beaten and 1 teaspoons vanilla
12. Mix until completely blended
13. Roll dough into walnut-sized balls
14. Place 2 inches apart on a lightly greased cookie sheet
15. Bake at 350 for 10 to 12 minutes or until edges are lightly browned
16. Cool 5 minutes on baking sheet
17. Remove to wire racks to cool completely
18. Yield: 3 to 4 dozen

title: sinful snickers cheesecake
steps:
1. Prepare crust: preheat oven to 375f
2. Cover the bottom of a 10-inch spring-form pan tightly with aluminum foil
3. Using a food processor , finely crush all the oreo cookies
4. Add melted butter , water and sugar to the cookie crumbs and continue using processor until the mixture is well blended
5. Turn this cookie mixture out into the spring-form pan and using your fingers , gently work the cookie mixture until the bottom of the pan is covered with about one inch up on the sides
6. Bake for only 6 or 7 minutes , no longer or the crust will be too hard
7. It is okay if the crust rises a little during the baking-- if this occurs , use the flat bottom of a glass to gently press down and set aside to cool
8. Prepare filling: using a large bowl and an electric mixer , beat the cream cheese until it is light and fluffy
9. When cream cheese is fluffy , add in one egg and mix well
10. Add second egg and mix well
11. Add in sour cream and sugar
12. Remove electric mixture to gently fold in the nestle' chocolate chips and chopped snickers candy bars
13. Pour batter onto the crust and spread the mixture out from the middle to all the sides to help it bake evenly
14. Cover a cookie sheet with aluminum foil and place spring-form pan in middle and bake at 375f for about 45 minutes , or until top is light brown
15. It's ok if the middle of the cheesecake is sunk in a little
16. Transfer the cheese cake to a rack and cool while still in the spring-form pan
17. Lay a piece of plastic wrap directly on top of the cheesecake and refrigerate for at least four hours or more- overnight is best
18. Prepare glaze: melt chocolate chips , butter and only 1 / 3 of the heavy whipping cream in a double boiler over medium heat until just at the melting stage
19. Remove from heat and stir mixture until smooth
20. While still warm , stir in remaining heavy whipping cream and mix until well blended
21. Using a sharp paring knife , run is around the edges of the spring-form pan to gently separate the cheesecake from the pan sides
22. Release the spring-form and remove from the cheesecake
23. Place cheesecake on serving dish and pour the chocolate glaze into the shallow crater
24. Sprinkle crushed peanuts or extra snickers shavings on top
25. Refrigerate to allow the glaze to set

title: mom s homemade pumpkin pie
steps:
1. Beat together all ingredients except crust
2. Pour into pie crust
3. Bake 350 1 hours
4. Cool completely !

title: danish rice pudding
steps:
1. In a large saucepan bring the milk and rice to a boil slowly on medium heat
2. Simmer until rice is cooked through and not crunchy
3. Add vanilla and sugar
4. Let cool
5. While cooling , whip the cartons of whipping cream until stiff peaks form
6. When rice has cooled add the whipped cream
7. At this time it is customary in our house to add a piece of an almond as well
8. Garnish with tangerine sections , shredded chocolate or chocolate curls

title: greek feta cheese souffls
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Sprinkle salt over zucchini in a colander and toss lightly
3. Let sit in a bowl 30 minutes
4. Drain
5. Rinse zucchini under cold water and drain
6. Squeeze out excess liquid
7. Set aside
8. Melt butter in a saucepan over medium heat
9. Gradually stir in flour and mustard
10. Gradually stir in milk
11. Increase heat to high , stirring until mixture boils and thickens
12. Transfer mixture to a bowl
13. Cool slightly
14. Gently add 4 beaten egg yolks
15. Stir in cheeses , zucchini mixture in small batches
16. Gently , fold in stiff beaten egg whites
17. Divide mixture into 4 small ovenproof dishes
18. Arrange dishes on oven tray and bake about 25 minutes , or until golden

title: cheese smothered chicken
steps:
1. Brown chicken breast in butter or margarine
2. Add cheese soup , tomatoes , onion , and basil
3. Cover and simmer for 30 minutes

title: brussels sprouts in onion butter
steps:
