1. Melt butter , cook onions until soft
2. Add the lemon juice
3. You can do this and then place in fridge until later
4. Just before serving , cook brussels sprouts in chicken broth
5. 5-8 minutes for frozen
6. 10 minutes for fresh
7. Drain liquid and add onion butter
8. Season to taste

title: stuffed chicken breasts with red pepper and goat cheese sauce
steps:
1. Using a small , sharp knife , cut a slit down the side of each chicken breast to form the breast into a pocket
2. Tuck 2 slices of prosciutto inside each breast
3. Add half of the sliced garlic , the thyme and half the goat cheese , dividing these evenly between the two chicken pockets
4. Fasten the chicken pocket , using either cook's string or wooden skewers
5. In a large frying pan heat 2 tbsp of the olive oil until very hot
6. Add the chicken parcels , skin side-down , and fry for 5 minutes
7. Turn over and fry on the other side for a further 2 minutes
8. Add the remaining garlic and sliced red pepper
9. Add the broth and season with salt and freshly ground pepper
10. Bring to the boil , reduce heat , cover and simmer for 5 minutes until the chicken is cooked through
11. Remove the chicken parcels from the pan and set aside , keeping warm
12. Add the remaining goat cheese to the pepper mixture
13. In a food processor or blender blend the pepper mixture until smooth
14. Heat the sauce through
15. Divide the pepper sauce among two serving plates
16. Top with chicken parcels , sprinkle over torn basil and serve at once

title: lemon cream cheese stuffed french toast
steps:
1. Thoroughly blend together the cream cheese , lemon zest and juice and the sugar
2. Slice the bread about 3 / 4 inch thick
3. Spread the cream cheese over half the bread slices , then top with the remaining bread slices
4. Beat together in a small bowl , the eggs , half and half , sugar , vanilla and nutmeg
5. Preheat a heavy griddle over medium heat
6. Dip each stuffed bread slice in the batter , turning to coat well
7. Remove bread from the egg mixture , letting the excess batter drip off
8. Cook the bread on the hot griddle until browned and crisp , about 2-3 minutes on each side
9. Keep the cooked french toast warm in a 300 degree oven and continue cooking the remaining slices
10. Serve hot with maple syrup or fresh berries

title: fresh strawberry daiquiris
steps:
1. Cut off tops of strawberries
2. Combine ingredients in blender
3. The blender should be about half strawberries and half ice with the concentrates filling in the gaps
4. Add rum to taste
5. Blend !

title: grilled chicken caesar salad a  new way
steps:
1. Combine all dressing ingredients in a medium-size bowl
2. Rub chicken breasts with the 2 tablespoons of olive oil and season them lightly with salt and pepper
3. Grill breasts until browned and cooked through
4. Let chicken rest for 5 minutes
5. Cut chicken cross-wise into 1 / 4" slices
6. Place slices and their juices in the bowl of dressing , mixing gently to coat
7. Serve chicken and dressing over romaine and top with croutons
8. Garnish with more parmesan cheese
9. Pass the pepper mill !
10. Cooking time includes cooked chicken resting time

title: orange sorbet
steps:
1. Combine sugar and water in saucepan
2. Stir and cook over high heat until sugar is dissolved
3. Boil without stirring for 1 minute
4. Remove from heat and set aside
5. Grate the zest and set aside
6. Squeeze oranges into 4 cup glass measure
7. Stir in sugar syrup and zest
8. Add water to make 3 1 / 2 cups total , stirring well
9. Chill in refrigerator about one hour
10. Transfer mixture to ice cream maker and proceed according to manufacturer's directions
11. May serve at once , or place in covered container until desired consistency is reached
12. Garnish with mint leaves

title: canella merlot
steps:
1. Heat merlot in a large saucepan
2. Dissolve sugar in the warm merlot
3. Add peels and spices to merlot
4. Serve warm or cool

title: gullah green beans
steps:
1. Combine ingredients in large saucepan
2. Cover and simmer for about 1 hour

title: cinnamon chip pumpkin muffins
steps:
1. Combine the dry ingredients
2. In another bowl beat the eggs well
3. Add the pumpkin and butter
4. Slowly stir in the dry ingredients just until combined
5. Mix in the cinnamon chips
6. Bake in greased muffin tins at 350 degrees for 20-25 minutes

title: cranberry orange relish
steps:
1. Wash and drain cranberries
2. Wash and quarter one orange and remove any seeds
3. Place everything in a food processor and chop
4. Add sugar
5. Refrigerate overnight

title: kip met kerriesaus  baked chicken with curry sauce
steps:
1. Slice and saute onion in butter until lightly browned
2. Add curry powder and flour and stir for a few minutes to absorb the butter and brown a bit
3. Slowly add stock , stirring constantly to avoid lumps
4. Simmer for approximately ten minutes or until thickened
5. Meanwhile cut chicken into serving pieces and arrange on platter
6. Add creme or milk to the sauce , stir and pour sauce over chicken
7. Serve with rice

title: eskrim pokat  avocado whip dessert
steps:
1. Using a hand-held mixer or immersion blender , add lemon juice & sugar to the mashed avocado flesh & mix well
2. Combine avocado mixture w / ice cream & beat till smooth
3. Place in a freezer to chill for 1 to 1 1 / 2 hrs & stir every 30 min , but do not freeze
4. To serve: divide mixture between 4 sml dessert bowls & serve immediately

title: cake pops
steps:
1. Bake cake according to package and let cool
2. Crumble entire cake in food processor , in batches if necessary , and empty into mixing bowl
3. Mix in 1 / 2 can of store bought frosting or equal amount of homemade frosting until a dough forms
4. Scoop and form into one inch balls , easiest if using a small cookie scooper
5. Melt wilton candy melts according to package
6. For each cake pop , first dip the very end of a lollipop stick into the melted candy coating and insert about half way into cake ball)
7. Chill uncoated cake pops for at least 1 hour
8. Re-melt wilton candy melts , and coat the cake pops one by one , dipping one side and turning to coat completely
9. After coated , stand the cake pop up in the styrofoam block or shirt box and decorate with sprinkles before coating is set
10. For a cute presentation , insert into lollipop treat bags and secure with a twistie tie or ribbon
11. You can also decorate with drizzled chocolate or candy melts , in whatever color you choose
12. Combination ideas:
13. - white cake mix with vanilla frosting , vanilla coating
14. - chocolate cake mix with chocolate frosting , chocolate or peanut butter coating
15. - pumpkin cake mix with vanilla frosting , vanilla or chocolate coating
16. - spice cake mix with vanilla frosting , vanilla or chocolate coating
17. - vanilla cake mix with mint extract , vanilla frosting , chocolate coating
18. - blueberry muffin mix with vanilla frosting , vanilla coating
19. - banana bread mix with vanilla frosting , vanilla coating
20. - cinnamon coffee cake mix with vanilla frosting , vanilla coating with a dash of cinnamon
21. - cheesecake mixed in with graham cracker crust , dipped in chocolate
22. - the possibilities are endless :)

title: christie s baked onion casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Butter a 2 quart casserole dish
3. In a large pot , cover onions with water
4. Bring to a boil and cook until onions are just crisp tender , about 8-10 minutes
5. Remove from heat and drain well
6. Layer onion pieces , potato chips and cheese in prepared dish , beginning with onions & ending with cheese
7. Mix soup and milk together
8. Stir in cayenne pepper
9. Pour soup mixture over the top of the cheese
10. Bake uncovered for 45 minutes or until onions are completely tender

title: italian olive oil dip
steps:
1. Mix all the ingredients together
2. Let sit to allow the flavors to meld for at least an hour or two before serving
3. Serve in a shallow bowl with crusty italian bread cut into thick slices

title: easy peach sherbet
steps:
1. Pour nectar into a shallow container like an ice cube tray and place in freezer
2. When firm , place in a food processor and process until fluffy
3. Refreeze until firm
4. Spoon into dessert dishes and top with fresh sliced peaches and sprigs of mint
5. The mango variation is delicious too especially with juicy ripe fruit on top

title: swiss steak in the crock pot for two
steps:
1. Cut steak in half and season with salt and pepper
2. Place onion in the slow cooker
3. Arrange meat on top of onion
4. Pour tomato sauce over the steak and onion
5. Cover and cook on low 8 to 10 hours

title: decadent pumpkin pie belgian waffles
steps:
1. Preheat a waffle iron
2. If you want to hold the finished waffles until serving time , preheat an oven to 200f
3. Melt the butter , set aside
4. In a large bowl , combine the pumpkin , brown and granulated sugars , cinnamon , ginger , cloves , nutmeg and salt
5. Using a rubber spatula , or handheld electric mixer , mix together well
6. Stir in the flour , baking powder and baking soda
7. The mixture will be thick and a little lumpy
8. Dont try to smooth it out
9. Just mix until the ingredients are incorporated
10. In another bowl , beat together the milk , sour cream , eggs , rum and vanilla
11. Add the liquid ingredients to the pumpkin mixture and stir until combined
12. Fold in the melted butter
13. Whether or not your waffle irons grids are well seasoned or made of a nonstick material , it is best to lightly butter or spray the grids for these waffles because the batter is quite sticky
14. Brush or spray the grids again only if subsequent waffles stick
15. Spoon out 2 / 3 to 3 / 4 cup of batter for a belgian waffle iron onto the hot iron
16. Use a metal spatula or wooden spoon to spread the batter evenly over the grids
17. Close the lid and bake until golden
18. If the waffle is hard to remove from the iron , peel it off gently and carefully
19. Serve immediately or keep the waffles , in a single layer , on a rack in the preheated oven while you make the rest
20. Serving: serve these warm and golden , one to a diner , topped with vanilla ice cream and maple syrup
21. Theyre great with a cup of hot or cold cider

title: movie theater popcorn  seriously
steps:
1. Grind the kosher salt into a fine powder in a spice / coffee grinder
2. In a heavy pot , heat the oil over medium-high heat
3. Place one kernel of corn in the pot , when it pops you are ready to add the other ingredients
4. After the kernel pops , add the popcorn and the finely ground salt into the pot and cover
5. Give the pot a vigorous shake to distribute corn , oil and salt
6. Pop until complete , i usually pop until there is only one or two pops per second
7. Do not burn !
8. One taste and you'll see it's perfect "movie theater popcorn" !

title: lazy man s gravy  gluten free
steps:
1. In a saucepan over medium-high heat , melt the butter
2. Whisk in the cornstarch and continue to cook for one minute
3. Add the stock gradually , whisking the entire time to avoid lumps
4. Reduce heat and cook over medium until thickened , stirring constantly
5. Taste test and add seasonings according to personal taste
6. Salt , pepper and thyme are suggested seasonings

title: crab and artichoke appetizer pizza
steps:
1. Heat oven according to the pizza crust directions and heat the pizza until it is light golden brown , remove pizza and set aside , leaving the oven on
2. Chop the artichoke hearts and combine with the crabmeat , cheese , mayonnaise , garlic , salt and pepper , stirring to mix well
3. Spread over the pizza crust , and sprinkle with the olives
4. Return the pizza to the oven and bake 12 to15 minutes , or until the top is slightly browned and bubbling along the edges
5. Remove and sprinkle with the red bell pepper
6. Slice into small squares and serve with remoulade sauce , if desired

title: sourdough rosemary potato bread
steps:
1. Combine the first four ingredients in a large non-metal bowl and blend well
2. Cover and let stand overnight till light and bubbly
3. Do not skip this step !
4. Add the next 5 ingredients and 3 c flour
5. Mix in enough of the rest of the flour to make a soft but pliable not quite sticky dough
6. Place dough in an oiled bowl turning once to coat both sides , cover and let rise 2 hours
7. Place dough on counter divide in 2 or three equal portions and let rest 10 minutes
8. Form into loaf shape and place on greased baking sheet , do not make to thick or this will never get done in the middle
9. Let rise till doubled
10. Just before baking slash the tops with a sharp knife 4-5 times
11. Spray dough and inside of oven w / water and bake in a 350 oven 1 hour for large loaves and 45 minutes for regular sized
12. Watch carefully to prevent overbrowning
13. May need to increase bake time depending on the area you live

title: watermelon dash
steps:
1. Blend the chilled watermelon cubes
2. Pour in a tall glass
3. Sprinkle black pepper and salt
4. Serve chilled

title: wasabi pineapple cheese ball
steps:
1. In large mixng bowl add cheese , turn beaters on low speed
2. Mix on low speed , until softened and smooth
3. Slowly add sugar a little at a time until mixed
4. Add crushed peas , chopped olives with pimentos and worchestershire sauce
5. Mix
6. Add pineapple and nutmeg and fold in to mixture
7. Do not use beaters for the final step
8. Form into soft ball or mound into a disposable dish
9. Place plastic over the dish
10. Refrigerate overnight or 4-6 hours before presenting
11. Place a bow on the rye loaf and the top of the covered dish
12. Presentation: refrigerate until serving
13. Spread on attached rye cocktail loaf or crackers or celery sticks
14. Card: a gift for you for all you do
15. Love and blessings

title: chicken and spinach florentine
steps:
1. Heat oil in large , deep skillet
2. Add chicken
3. Cook 15-20 minutes , or until chicken is fully cooked through , stirring frequently
4. Add spices , spinach , rice , tomatoes and broth , 4 cups to begin with , add a bit more as you see fit
5. Mix well
6. Bring to a boil
7. Reduce heat to low
8. Cover
9. Simmer 10 minutes
10. Stir in parmesan cheese
11. Let stand 5 mins
12. Serve hot

title: cranberry pecan bark
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325f
2. Place pecan halves on a cookie sheet and toast for 10 minutes
3. Remove to a wire rack to cool
4. When cool pour nuts into a bowl and line your cookie sheet with parchment paper
5. Following package directions melt candy coating in your microwave
6. Stir in toasted pecans , cranberries , and nutmeg
7. Spread mixture on prepared cookie sheet , 1 / 4 inch thick
8. Refrigerate until cool
9. Remove and break into 1 and 1 / 2 inch pieces
10. Store in an airtight container

title: blazing  i mean braising pork and red lentils
steps:
1. Heat dutch oven and oil
2. Brown the onion , garlic and pork for 4 minutes , adding both paprikas half way through
3. Add the rest of the ingredients , bring up to a boil , reduce to a very low simmer and cover
4. Season with salt and pepper to taste
5. Let it cook for about 20 minutes , stirring occasionally
6. This certainly can cook as long as you have the patience for
7. Check the level of liquid
8. If you use a tougher cut let it cook until it is falling apart
9. The lentils should be added the last 20 minutes
10. Uncover pot and cook until thick to your liking
11. It will thicken slightly off the heat -- i let it rest 10 minutes or so before serving
12. Good garnishes include tomato slices , fresh lime , sour cream and fresh parsley

title: stove top grit  casserole
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan , slowly bring the milk just to a boil over medium heat
2. Whisk in the grits and reduce heat to medium low , whisking frequently to prevent lumps from forming , and simmer about 5 minutes
3. Whisk in beaten eggs , one at a time , stirring quickly to keep the eggs from forming lumps
4. Stir in bacon bits and cook 5 more minutes , stirring frequently
5. Add cheese , stirring until it's melted in and the grits look creamy
6. Add onion powder , salt , and pepper
7. Pour into serving bowls and garnish with a dollop of sour cream , green onion , more bacon -- whatever suits your fancy
8. Enjoy !

title: moroccan spiced grilled chicken breasts
steps:
1. Mix the marinade ingredients together in a medium sized bowl
2. Add the chicken pieces to the bowl and thoroughly coat with the marinade
3. Cover with plastic wrap and chill in the refrigerator from 6 to 10 hours
4. Heat your grill on high heat if you are using a gas grill , or prepare coals for direct heat if you are using charcoal
5. If you do not have a grill you can use a cast-iron grill pan on your stove
6. Grill the chicken breasts a few minutes on each side , until cooked through
7. Take care not to overcook , as chicken breasts can easily dry out

title: quick oatmeal egg pancake
steps:
1. Spray a small skillet with vegetable oil and put it on the stove top at medium-high to heat
2. Scramble egg with a fork in a cereal bowl
3. Open instant oatmeal packet and add it to the egg , mixing it in
4. Add enough water to make the consistency right for pancake batter , about 1 tbsp more or less
5. Pour into the skillet to form one large pancake
6. Turn heat down to medium
7. When edges begin to look dry and bubbles start to form on the top , flip with a spatula
8. Cook on the other side for one to two minutes until done
9. Serve with condiments such as butter and maple syrup , or spread with peanut butter or yogurt and top with fresh fruit

title: pear sidecar
steps:
1. Combine the brandy , triple sec and lime juice in a cocktail shaker and fill with ice
2. Shake well and strain into two chilled martini glasses
3. Twist the lime zest into spirals and drop one in each glass

title: roasted carrot salad
steps:
1. Preheat an oven to 400 degrees f
2. Combine the carrots , almonds , and garlic in a mixing bowl
3. Drizzle with the olive oil , then season to taste with salt and pepper
4. Spread out onto an ungreased baking sheet
5. Bake the carrots in the preheated oven until soft and the edges turn brown , about 30 minutes
6. Remove and allow to cool to room temperature
7. Once cool , return the carrots to the mixing bowl , and drizzle with honey and vinegar
8. Toss until coated
9. Add the cranberries and blue cheese
10. Toss again until evenly mixed
11. Combine with the arugula and serve immediately

title: oatmeal custard
steps:
1. Beat the eggs well
2. Mix beaten eggs , milk and cream well , fully incorporating eggs into the mixture
3. Combine the egg mixture with the brown sugar , cinnamon , oatmeal , vanilla , and berries
4. Stir until lightly mixed
5. Spray 8 1-cup ramekins with nonstick cooking spray
6. Fill each to within 1 / 4 inch of the top
7. Set ramekins in a baking pan and fill with water to 3 / 4 inch of the top of the ramekins
8. Bake at 350 degrees , covered , for 1 hour
9. Serve warm , topped with whipped cream and berries

title: chicken   cheese rollups
steps:
1. Boil the chicken breasts for 20 minutes , or until they are completely cooked
2. Remove them from the boiling water and let them cool
3. Once they have cooled , cut them into bite size pieces
4. Combined the cooked chicken , cream of chicken soup , 2 cup of shredded cheddar cheese , salt and black pepper in a large bowl and mix well
5. Remove the crescent rolls from the cans , separate them into the pre-cut triangles and roll them out slightly
6. Put 2 heaping tablespoons of the chicken mixture in the middle of the triangle and fold the crescent rolls up
7. Put the rolls in a baking dish , seam side down
8. Put any remaining chicken mixture around the rolls
9. Bake in a 350 degree oven for 25 minutes or until the tops of the crescent rolls are golden brown , remove , and cover the rolls with the other cup of shredded cheddar cheese
10. Return to the oven for an additional 10 minutes

title: berry bread
steps:
1. In a large bowl , add the 3-1 / 2 lbs
2. Sweetened sliced strawberries
3. Stir in the heavy cream until blended
4. Chill in the refrigerator 30 minutes to 1-2 hours
5. In serving bowls , add torn pieces of homemade , or store bought white bread
6. Pour desired amounts of the berry mixture over each bowl of bread
7. Do this before adding the cream
8. The amount of strawberries and cream added
9. Depends upon you

title: crusty meatball pasta low fat  hi energy
steps:
1. Put the passata , sugar , oregano , garlic powder and chilli flakes in a large pan and heat gently
2. Put the fresh garlic , chilli , parsley and lemon rind into a processor and whizz together until finely chopped
3. Add the bread and whizz to make crumbs , then add the pork mince , egg and seasonings , and pulse briefly until well blended-don't over do it though !
4. Shape the mixture into about 20 small meatballs and drop them into the sauce and simmer about 20 minutes
5. Preheat the oven to 220 degrees
6. Cook the pasta according to packet instructions , then drain and toss with the sauce
7. Transfer to an ovenproof dish and scatter with the parmesan and some freshly ground black pepper
8. Bake for 20 minutes

title: mary s blueberry cake
steps:
1. Mix butter , sugar , eggs and vanilla together
2. Mix flour , baking powder , and salt together
3. Reserve 1 / 2 cup of flour
4. Add the remaining flour to the sugar / egg mixture
5. Stir till mixed
6. Add the remaining 1 / 2 cup flour and the blueberries
7. You want the flour to coat the blueberries so they will not get too mushy
8. Be sure to grease the bundt cake pan very well with shortening and coat with flour so that it will come out of the pan easily
9. Bake at 325f for 1 hour and 10 minutes in a bundt pan
10. According to your oven you may have to cook the cake about five minutes longer
11. Let it sit about 15-20 minutes before you take it out of the pan

title: i cant believe it s gluten free bread
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl , combine dry ingredients and mix well
2. Put eggs in your bread machine , and program to "dough"
3. Let it beat the eggs for you
4. Then add the rest of the wet ingredients
5. Once mixed , stop the machine
6. Add dry ingredients on top of wet , and top with the yeast
7. Turn the bread machine back on to "dough"
8. Using a rubber spatula , scrape down the sides of the dough often
9. I let the machine mix the dough for about 4 minutes , scraping often , then turn the machine off
10. This dough will be very loose and sticky
11. Pour into a greased 9x5 bread pan and smooth over the top
12. Brush with melted butter if desired
13. Top with seeds etc if you like
14. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
15. Place breadpan on top of stove , cover with tea towel and wait half an hour until it has doubled in size
16. Pop it in the oven for 30 minutes until brown and fragrant
17. Remove from pan immediately or it will get soggy
18. I slice it once its cooled and freeze it in a ziplock bag
19. Makes really great french toast and sandwiches

title: simple corn casserole
steps:
1. Combine everything but the cheddar cheese
2. Pour into greased 8-inch casserole
3. Bake at 425 for 45 minutes
4. Top with cheddar and bake and additional 5 min or until cheese is melted
5. Let stand for 10 minutes before serving

title: basic rice pilaf
steps:
1. Melt butter in saucepan and cook onion over medium heat until golden
2. Stir in rice and cook for 1 minute
3. Season with salt and pepper
4. Stir in chicken stock and bring to a boil
5. Cover and turn heat down to low
6. Simmer gently for 20 minutes
7. Fluff rice with a fork and stir in parsley

title: stupid simple sugar cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit
2. Cream butter and sugar in bowl until fluffy
3. Add egg and mix until well blended
4. Mix in baking powder and extract
5. Add flour by 1 / 4 cup at a time
6. This makes mixing a lot easier , and is better if working with children
7. If batter is slightly too thin , add flour by teaspoonfuls until desired texture is attained
8. Drop cookies onto baking sheet by tablespoonfuls
9. These tend to spread out a lot , so it may be best to only put 6-8 on each baking sheet
10. Bake for 14-17 minutes or until lightly golden around the edges

title: this chick s quick chicken chili
steps:
1. Sautee chicken breast pieces and onion in oil until chicken is no longer pink
2. Add undrained tomatoes and spices , then bring to a boil , reduce heat , cover and simmer for 10 minutes to blend flavors
3. Stir in peanut butter until evenly melted then stir in beans and bring back to simmer for 5 minutes to heat through
4. Stir in cilantro and serve topped with sour cream and shredded cheese

title: peanut butter protein snack wrap
steps:
1. In a small bowl , whisk eggs with milk
2. Add a dash of salt
3. Spray frying pan with cooking spray
4. Scramble eggs in heated pan over medium heat
5. Alternatively , eggs can be microwaved in a bowl for 1-2 minutes , stirring every 30 seconds
6. Smear peanut butter down center of tortilla
7. Microwave for 10-15 seconds to slightly melt peanut butter
8. Wrap scrambled eggs in tortilla and enjoy !
9. Creamy works best !

title: three step taco salad
steps:
1. In a nonstick skillet , cook beef over medium heat until no longer pink
2. Drain
3. Add water and taco seasoning
4. Bring to a boil
5. Reduce heat
6. Simmer , uncovered , for 5 minutes , stirring occasionally
7. In a large bowl , layer tortilla chipes , 7 cups lettuce , beans , half of tomatoes , olives , half of cheese and meat mixture
8. Top with remaining tomatoes , cheese , and lettuce
9. In a small bowl , combine sour cream and salsa
10. Serve with salad

title: honey bbq pork  slow cooker
steps:
1. Put pork and carrots in slow cooker
2. Combine remainder of ingredients in small bowl
3. Pour mixture over pork and carrots
4. Cover and cook on low 8-9 hours , or until pork is tender and throughly cooked

title: orange coconut date squares
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f degrees
2. Measure flour , salt and baking powder in bowl and stir to blend , set aside
3. Melt butter in small saucepan over low heat , remove from stove
4. Stir in brown sugar
5. Blend in egg , vanilla and orange zest
6. Add flour mixture to the butter mixture
7. Stir in coconut and dates
8. Spread mixture into a greased 7"x 11" pan
9. Bake for 25 - 30 minutes
10. Remove from oven and cool before cutting in small squares

title: semi instant penne and cheese
steps:
1. Cook pasta
2. Reserve 1 / 2 cup pasta water before draining , then drain and set aside , returning the pan to high heat
3. Melt the butter - you can let it brown a little , if you like , then add the water and the red pepper flakes
4. Reduce by half and then add the cheese , stirring to melt
5. Add the pasta and stir vigorously to coat
6. Taste for salt
7. Season accordingly with salt and pepper , add a little tabasco if desired , and garnish with a little more parmesan

title: broccoli salad  cooking light
steps:
1. Combine the first 5 ingredients in a large bowl
2. Combine mayonnaise and remaining ingredients , stirring with a whisk
3. Pour dressing over broccoli mixture , and toss well
4. Chill for 1 hour

title: fantastic raspberry vinaigrette
steps: 1. Place ingredients in a small bowl and whisk together until well blended

title: amish onion cake
steps:
1. In a large skillet , cook onions in 1 / 2 cup butter over low heat for 10 minutes
2. Stir in the poppy seeds , salt , paprika and pepper
3. Cook until golden brown , stirring occasionally
4. Remove from the heat
5. Set aside
6. In a bowl , combine the flour , cornstarch , baking powder and sugars
7. Cut in 1-1 / 4 cups butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs
8. Melt the remaining butter
9. In a bowl , whisk the eggs , milk , sour cream and melted butter
10. Make a well in dry ingredients
11. Stir in egg mixture just until moistened
12. Spread into a greased 10-inch springform pan
13. Spoon onion mixture over the dough
14. Place pan on a baking sheet
15. Bake at 350 degrees for 35-40 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean
16. Serve warm

title: sundrop pound cake
steps: 1. Mix all together & bake at 325 for 1 hour & 15 minutes in bundt pan

title: creamy cinnamon vanilla coffee
steps:
1. Put milk into the cup
2. Heat gently in the microwave about 30 seconds -- just to take the chill off so the coffee won't get cold too fast
3. Stir cinnamon and vanilla into the milk
4. Add coffee and sugar / splenda
5. Stir well and enjoy

title: frozen sex on the beach
steps: 1. Place all items in a blender and puree until smooth

title: engelsaugen   german angel eye cookies
steps:
1. Mix together the flour , butter , egg yolk , confectioner's sugar , vanilla , pinch of salt and the grated lemon rind to form a dough
2. Leave the dough in a cool place for an hour
3. Out of the dough make small balls and place on a lightly sprayed prepared baking tray
4. Make a small indentation in the middle of each ball , using your little finger and fill the hole , using a teaspoon , with raspberry jam
5. Bake your cookies at 375f for about 15 minutes
6. Leave them to cool and remove to a wire rack
7. Melt the chocolate and shortening together
8. Coat the bottom of each cookie with melted chocolate and leave until firm on waxed paper

title: passover cheese puff
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients
2. Pour into a well-greased casserole dish
3. Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour

title: zippity zingity coleslaw
steps:
1. In a large bowl , toss cabbages and white onion together
2. In a small bowl , whisk remaining ingredients together
3. Pour dressing into cabbage mix and toss together
4. Store in a tupperware or large ziploc bag
5. Tastes good right away but develops more flavor upon sitting

title: broccoli casserole with no  cream of something  soups
steps:
1. Cook broccoli according to directions , or if using fresh broccoli , chop it and cook it
2. Drain well
3. Add minced garlic to the broccoli
4. Place broccoli in a lightly greased 1 quart casserole
5. Set aside
6. Melt 2 tbsp butter in a heavy saucepan over low heat
7. Add flour , stirring until smooth
8. Cook 1 minute , stirring constantly
9. Gradually add milk
10. Cook over medium heat , stirring constantly , until mixture is thickened and bubbly
11. Add salt and pepper
12. Stir well
13. Add cream cheese , stirring until smooth
14. Pour cream cheese sauce over broccoli in casserole
15. Stir gently to combine
16. Sprinkle with cheddar cheese
17. Melt remaining 2 tablespoons butter in a small saucepan over low heat
18. Remove from heat and stir in breadcrumbs or ritz crackers
19. Sprinkle breadcrumb or ritz cracker mixture evenly over casserole
20. Bake at 350 degrees for 40 minutes or until thoroughly heated

title: muxi rou  chinese mushu pork
steps:
1. Soak wood ears in boiling water for 20-60 minutes , then drain and squeeze out excess water , and slice julienne
2. Freeze the pork loin for 20-30 minutes to firm up a little bit , then slice very thin , then stack the slices and julienne
3. Combine 1 / 4 t salt , 1 / 2 t sugar , 2 t soy sauce , 6 turns white pepper mill , 1 t wine , 1 t cornstarch , and 1 t water for the marinade
4. Add to the pork and stir to coat
5. Marinate meat for about 20 minutes , then stir in 1 t oil
6. Beat the eggs lightly with 1 t oil and 1 / 4 t salt
7. Heat a wok over high heat until smoke rises
8. Add 1 t oil and swirl it around
9. Add the wood ears and stir for 30 seconds
10. Season with 1 / 4 t salt , 1 / 4 t sugar , and 1 t soy sauce
11. Transfer to warm dish and set aside
12. Reheat the wok until smoking
13. Add 2 t oil and swirl it around
14. Pour in the egg and scramble lightly
15. Set aside on warm plate
16. Scrape wok clean , washing if necessary
17. Reheat wok until smoke rises
18. Add 3 t oil and swirl around
19. Add the garlic and stir a moment until fragrant
20. Add the white part of the scallions , toss and allow to sizzle for a few moments
21. Add the pork and stir-fry for about a minute until color changes
22. Add 1 t wine around the side of the wok , continuing to stir-fry
23. Add wood ears and eggs to the wok , stirring for another minute until pork and egg are thoroughly cooked and all ingredients are hot
24. Serving option 1: after removing wok from heat , toss in green onion parts and fresh cilantro , drizzle with sesame oil , and serve with rice
25. Serving option 2: after removing wok from heat , drizzle with sesame oil
26. Serve meat on one platter , mandarin pancakes on another , and green onions and cilantro in a third dish
27. At the table people may pick up a pancake , and use their chopsticks to stuff the pancake with meat and top with green onions and cilantro
28. Serves 2 as the main dish , or up to 10 as part of a full chinese meal

title: soft granola
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300 degrees
2. Combine oatmeal , wheat germ , sunflower seeds and nuts in large mixing bowl
3. Combine sugar , water , oil , molasses or honey , salt cinnamon and vanilla in saucepan
4. Heat until sugar is dissolved , but do not boil
5. Pour hot mixture over dry ingredients , stirring until well coated
6. Spread granola on 2 large cookie sheets
7. Bake for 20 minutes , stirring occasionally
8. Remove from oven at this point , if you want a soft granola
9. Bake 15 minutes longer for a crunchy product
10. Cool granola
11. Add fruit
12. Store in air-tight containers
13. Use within 6 months

title: easy cranberry walnut salad
steps:
1. Make the jello according to quick set method on package
2. Pour into a 13 by 9 inch pan
3. Add all other ingredients and mix well
4. Cover and refrigerate until jello has set , or overnight
5. When ready to serve , stir again so that the solid mass breaks up
6. Yummy !

title: chopped salad italiano
steps:
1. Place lettuce on serving platter
2. Arrange remaining ingredients except dressing on lettuce
3. Drizzle with dressing
4. Toss just before serving

title: chocolate rum balls  sugar free  low carb
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f
2. Spread the pecans on a baking sheet and roast in the oven for about 10 minutes , or until they begin to brown
3. Set aside to cool
4. Combine coconut , splenda and cocoa in a large mixing bowl
5. When the pecans have cooled a little , coarsely chop them in a food processor
6. Add the pecans to the coconut mixture
7. Melt the butter
8. Mix the rum with the melted butter and stir into the combined ingredients
9. Place egg white powder in a small bowl and add the warm water
10. Beat with a whisk for 2 minutes , until frothy and dissolved
11. Mix the egg whites into the combined ingredients
12. Form the mixture into little balls
13. Leave the candies on a baking sheet for about an hour to dry
14. Store in an airtight container

title: tuna fish casserole   dairy free
steps:
1. Cook pasta in water until done
2. Preheat oven to 350 and grease a 2 quart baking dish
3. Melt margarine in a small fry pan
4. Saute mushrooms
5. Remove pan from heat and stir in flour , make sure all flour is moistened by the margarine
6. Stir in broth and stir until no lumps
7. Return pan to heat , stirring until mixture has boiled for 2 minutes
8. Stir in tuna , breaking it up as you do
9. Drain pasta and mix into sauce
10. Pour mixture into baking dish and top with crumbled crackers or potato chips
11. Bake until heated through and bubble around the edges , about 30 minutes

title: cream of asparagus soup  vegan
steps:
1. Chop the asparagus , reserving the
2. Put the asparagus , onion , garlic and broth in a large saucepan
3. Bring to a boil , then reduce to medium heat and cook until the vegetables are tender , about 15 minutes
4. Put contents of saucepan into blender
5. Add the flour , soy milk , soy sauce and basil
6. Process until smooth
7. Return the soup to the saucepan and add the asparagus
8. Cook over medium heat until the soup thickens and is heated through
9. Season to taste with salt and fresh cracked pepper and serve

title: chocolate seduction failure
steps:
1. Crust:
2. Mix crust ingredients together with mixer until crumbly and press into oblong baking dish
3. Bake at 350 for 25 minute or until lightly browned
4. Cool
5. Second layer:
6. Mix ingredients together and spread carefully on crust
7. Pudding:
8. Combine sugar , flour , cocoa and salt in a mixing bowl
9. Heat water and milk in a 6-quart pan over medium heat
10. Slowly stir in sugar mixture
11. Stir until completely mixed
12. Add a little of this warm mixture to egg yolks to temper
13. Pour back into pan
14. Bring mixture to a boil stirring constantly
15. Remove from heat
16. Add butter and vanilla and stir
17. Pour over second layer
18. Top with cool whip and shaved chocolate bar
19. Refrigerate 6-8 hours before serving

title: classic english salad cream   oil free salad dressing
steps:
1. To start you will need to hard boil some eggs , i normally do 6 or 8 depending on the size of the egg
2. Boil the eggs for about 10 minutes then place in ice cold water to cool
3. Once cooled remove the shells and slice in half , place the yolks in a bowl and wrap the whites in cling film and place in the fridge , you can do something else with them
4. To the egg yolks add a teaspoon of english or dijon mustard , a pinch of salt and pepper , and a splash of vinegar
5. You can also add a sqeeze of lemon juice too if you want
6. Blend all these together to form a thick paste
7. Now start to add some cream , do it slowly and keep mixing
8. You dont want the sauce too thick or too runny
9. When you think its nearly at the right consistency , stop and do a taste test
10. Now is the time to add more mustard or pepper if your taste buds demand it
11. Finish off by adding a little more vinegar until you acheive the right consistency
12. Of course if you dont want to add more vinegar add a little more cream , as i said earlier this is a flexible recipe so make it how you like it
13. Store in a clean jam jar in the fridge for up to 3 / 4 days
14. Use in sandwiches , salads , dips , dressings etc

title: fluffy pikelets   australia
steps:
1. Sift flour , salt and soda into a small bowl
2. Add sugar , egg and milk
3. Beat on low speed until mixed
4. Beat on high speed for about 1 minute , then fold in melted butter
5. Place spoonfuls onto a hot gridle or frypan

title: apple walnut salad with cranberry vinaigrette
steps:
1. Puree cranberries in processor until smooth
2. Add vinegar , onion , sugar and mustard and process until well blended
3. With processor running , gradually add oil and process until well blended
4. Transfer to medium bowl
5. Season to taste with salt and pepper
6. Dressing can be made one day ahead of time and refrigerated
7. Bring to room temperature and whisk before using
8. Combine greens and apples in a large bowl
9. Toss with enough dressing to coat and sprinkle with walnuts
10. Serve , passing remaining dressing separately
11. I sometimes dice the apples , rather than slicing

title: mussels with chorizo   tomato and wine
steps:
1. In a large saute pan , cook the chorizo until brown over medium-high heat , about 4 minutes
2. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels
3. Drain off all but 1 tablespoon of fat from the pan
4. Add butter and when melted , add the onions , shallot , fennel seeds , and pepper
5. Cook , stirring , until veggies are tender
6. Add the garlic and tomatoes , and cook , stirring , for 2minute
7. Add mussels to pan
8. Add the wine , 1 / 4 cup cream , and parsley , and bring to a boil
9. Stir mussels , cover , and cook until the shells have opened , about 6-8 minutes
10. Remove mussels from pan to serving bowls
11. Discard any shells that do not open
12. In pan with juice , bring to a boil
13. Allow to boil for 3 minutes
14. Add sausage and cream
15. Bring to boil for 1 minute
16. Pour juice over mussels
17. Serve immediately with hot french bread for dipping

title: italian dipping oil  for bread
steps:
1. Pour olive oil into a shallow bowl
2. Add basil , garlic and pepper
3. Stir with a spoon to evenly distribute ingredients
4. Serve with warm bread
5. ~
6. More garlic can be added if desired

title: cherry tomato and bocconcini pizza
steps:
1. To make the dough , place the yeast , sugar and water in a small bowl and mix to combine
2. Set aside in a warm place for 5 minutes or until bubbles appear on the surface
3. Place the flour and salt in a large bowl and make a well in the centre
4. Add the yeast mixture and oil stirring with a butter knife until a dough forms
5. Turn out onto a lightly floured surface and knead for 5 minutes or until smooth and elastic
6. Place the dough in a large bowl , cover with a damp cloth and set aside for 30 minutes or until the dough is doubled in size
7. Preheat the oven to 230oc / 450of / gas 5
8. For the topping , place the tomatoes , oregano , salt and pepper in a bowl and crush with a potato masher
9. Divide the dough into four and roll out each portion to a 14cm / 5
10. 5 inch round
11. Place on greasy baking trays and top each pizza with mozzarella , parmesan , bocconcini and tomato mixture and cook for 10-15 minutes or until golden and crispy
12. Top with rocket to serve

title: o charley s loaded potato soup
steps:
1. Dice unpeeled red potatoes into 1 / 2 inch cubes
2. Place in large saucepan
3. Cover with water and bring to a boil
4. Let boil for 10 minutes or until 3 / 4 cooked
5. In a separate pan , combine melted margarine and flour , mixing until smooth
6. Place over low heat and gradually add half-and-half , stirring constantly
7. Continue to stir until smooth and liquid begins to thicken
8. Add melted velveeta
9. Stir well
10. Drain potatoes and add to cream mixture
11. Stir in pepper , garlic powder and hot pepper sauce
12. Cover and cook over low heat for 30 minutes , stirring occasionally
13. Place soup into individual serving bowls and top with crumbled bacon , shredded cheese , chives and parsley

title: dunkin donuts coffee coolatta
steps:
1. Brew strong coffee by brewing twice the amount required by your coffee maker - chill
2. Combine all ingredients except ice in blender and blend for 2 minutes on low to blend sugar
3. Add ice , blend on high until ice is dissolved and drink is smooth

title: gorgonzola ziti
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to package directions
2. Drain
3. Meanwhile , combine bread crumbs , 4 tablespoons green onions and butter in small bowl
4. Set aside
5. Place remaining green onions , milk , cream cheese and gorgonzola cheese in 12-inch nonstick skillet
6. Cook over medium-high heat , stirring occasionally , until cheese is melted--about 3 minutes
7. Remove from heat
8. Add cooked pasta , salt , pepper , and garlic powder
9. Mix lightly
10. Sprinkle with bread crumb mixture
11. Serve immediately

title: spinach beef biscuit bake
steps:
1. Press and flatten biscuints onto the bottom and up the sides of a greased 11 x 7 x 2-inch baking dish
2. Set aside
3. In a skillet over medium heat , cook beef and onion until meat is no longer pink , drain
4. In a bowl , beat eggs
5. Add spinach and mushrooms
6. Mix well
7. Stir in the cheeses , garlic powder , salt , pepper , and beef mixture
8. Mix well
9. Spoon into prepared crust
10. Drizzle with butter
11. Bake uncovered , at 375 f for 25-30 minutes or until crust is lightly browned

title: chocolate chip sweet potato squares
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Spray a 15x10x1 inch jelly roll pan with cooking spray
3. Mash sweet potatoes with reserved syrup
4. In another bowl , whisk together flour , baking powder , allspice , cinnamon , cloves , and salt
5. Beat together butter and sugars at medium speed for 2 minutes or until smooth and lightened in color
6. Beat in eggs one at a time
7. On low speed , beat in half of the dry ingredients , followed by sweet potatoes , and finally the last of the dry ingredients
8. Fold in chips and half of the pecans
9. Spread batter evenly in pan
10. Sprinkle remaining pecans over top
11. Bake for 35-40 minutes or until lightly browned and the pecans are toasted
12. Cool in pan on a wire rack before cutting into squares

title: lemonade gramma style
steps:
1. To make the syrup , gently boil 4 cups sugar and 4 cups of water for 10 minutes
2. Pour into a clean container and refrigerate
3. To mix lemonade , combine all ingredients , and chill
4. Add freshly sliced lemon rind
5. I have also prepared this recipe using"splenda" instead of sugar--it came out a little too sweet for my tastes , so i add extra lemon juice

title: orange delight salad
steps:
1. Drain and reserve liquid from fruit
2. Add enough water to make two cups of liquid
3. Pour pudding mix & liquid into a pan
4. Cook until thickened , stir in dry jello
5. Mix in pineapple and oranges
6. Chill

title: ricotta pudding     budino di ricotta
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350
2. Butter a 6" spring form pan , and coat it with bread crumbs
3. Set aside
4. Whisk the egg yolks with the sugar , then whisk in the cheese
5. Stir in the almonds , lemon peel , raisins and zest
6. Pour into the pan , smooth the top and bake for 30 minutes , or until firm to the touch
7. Allow to cool
8. Release the sides of the pan

title: bacon wrapped jalapeno poppers
steps:
1. Cut stems off of peppers and cut them all in half longways
2. Remove seeds from peppers
3. Fill each pepper with cream cheese and sprinkle cheddar cheese on top
4. Wrap 1 / 2 slice of bacon around each pepper half
5. Place on baking sheets and place in 450 degree oven for 10 to 15 minutes or until bacon is fully cooked
6. Remove and serve when cooled
7. Enjoy !
8. I always freeze them after they are made for about 20 minutes to a hour before putting them in the oven or on the grill
9. Doing this will keep the cheese from melting out as much

title: creamy asparagus meatloaf
steps:
1. Mix ingredients in order listed
2. Place in large baking pan
3. Bake at 400 degrees 1 hour

title: raisin banana bread
steps:
1. Measure carefully , placing all ingredients in except raisins and glaze in bread machine in order recommended by manufacturer
2. Use sweet or basic / white cycle
3. Add raisins at raisin nut signal or 5 to 10 minutes before last kneading cycle ends
4. Remove baked bread from pan and cool on wire rack
5. Make glaze : mix all glaze ingredients until smooth and thin enough to drizzle
6. Drizzle over loaf

title: healthy creamy kabocha  pumpkin  pasta
steps:
1. Peel kabocha or sweet potatoes and cut into 1cm cubes
2. Microwave 4 to 5 min
3. Puree the cooked kabocha , consumme , and milk in a blender / food processor
4. Cook spaghetti acording to package directions , in boiling water with a pinch of salt
5. Make the topping
6. Slice the onion vertically
7. Remove bottoms of stems of shimeji and cut into 1-cm lengths
8. Heat oil in frying pan and saute the onion over low-medium heat , until it is wilted
9. Add shimeji mushrooms
10. Heat pureed kabocha mixture into pan
11. Add basil
12. Add water if necesssary
13. Salt to taste or
14. Turn off heat and place on mixed spaghetti
15. If desired , make a well in the center of each portion , and place some topping vegetables
16. If doing my variation , just heat pan and heat the pureed sweet potato mixture

title: world s easiest lazy lazagna
steps:
1. Reserve about 2 / 3 cup of shredded mozzarella and 1 cup of pasta sauce
2. Brown ground beef , sausage and onion , adding crushed garlic when almost done
3. Stir in pasta sauce and all dried spices
4. In a separate bowl , combine cottage cheese , mozzarella and 2 raw eggs
5. Spread one-third of meat sauce in a lightly greased 13x9 inch baking dish
6. Follow with a layer of uncooked egg noodles
7. (simply "dump" the noodles on top of the sauce and spread with your hand to create a thin even layer , completely covering the sauce
8. Follow by a layer of the cheese mix , and a layer of meat sauce
9. Repeat procedure until all ingridients are used
10. Mix remaining pasta sauce with hot water , 50 / 50
11. Slowly pour the mixture around inside edge of dish , until the entire top layer of noodles is lightly covered with liquid
12. If necessary , simply pour the mixture straight on top
13. Don't worry - it will cook away
14. Let stand for 5 minutes before putting the dish in the oven
15. Lightly sprinkle with mozzarella
16. Tightly cover baking dish with 2 layers of heavy-duty aluminum foil
17. Bake in a preheated 350 degree f oven for 35-40 minutes
18. Uncover
19. If the egg noodles seem cooked -- top with the remaining mozzarella
20. Bake for an additional 10 minutes , uncovered
21. Remove from oven , and let stand 10 to 15 minutes before serving
22. If you have no sausage on hand , just substitute ground beef
23. I've tried this recipe with ground turkey , and even with a mix of browned ground beef and zucchini , and it came out great
24. If you prefer - you can broil the top mozzarella layer for a couple of minutes for extra sizzle
25. Enjoy !

title: blue cheese butter for steaks
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a bowl
2. Serve on top of the steaks
3. Refrigerate leftover in an airtight container in the fridge

title: bubelah
steps:
1. Beat the egg whites until stiff
2. Slowly fold in the yolks , matzo meal and lemon zest
3. Melt the butter in a heavy based frying pan
4. Carefully drop large spoonfuls of fluffy batter into the pan
5. Fry on one side until done , then gently flip over and continue cooking on the other side
6. Sprinkle with sugar and enjoy

title: the govenor s hot buttered coffee
steps:
1. Cream butter and sugar
2. Blend in spices
3. Refrigerate mixture until ready to use
4. Add a scant tablespoon of butter / spice mixture in a 10-ounce mug
5. Add rum and heavy cream
6. Fill mug with coffee
7. Garnish with whipped cream
8. Butter / spice mixture is enough for about 20 servings

title: baby food prune cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300 degrees fahrenheit
2. Combine flour , sugar , vegetable oil , eggs , prune baby food , and cinnamon
3. Pour batter into a greased and floured 9x13 pan or bundt pan
4. Bake for 1 hour 15 minutes

title: white chili vegetarian
steps:
1. Place navy beans in a soup kettle
2. Add water to cover by 2 inches
3. Bring to a boil
4. Boil for 2 minutes
5. Remove from heat
6. Cover and let stand for 1 hour
7. Drain and discard liquid
8. Return beans to pan
9. Add water to cover by 2 inches
10. Bring to a boil , cover and simmer for 45 minutes
11. Or until beans are tender
12. Drain and discard liquid
13. Set beans aside
14. In the same kettle , saute onions and garlic in oil until tender
15. Add soups , one cup water , potato , chili powder , bouillon and salt
16. Cover and cook over medium-low heat for 10 minutes
17. Add garbanzo beans , half and half and navy beans
18. Cook over medium heat for 10 minutes or until heated through
19. You could eliminate alot of time and just use canned navy beans

title: oats and pumpkin evening cake
steps:
1. Heat oven to 180 c / 350f
2. Cream sugar and soft margarine until fluffy
3. Mix in grated pumpkin and egg whites
4. Combine flour , 1 1 / 4 cups oats and remaining ingredients in a separate bowl & gradually add to pumpkin mixture and mix until well combined
5. Pour into a cake tine & bake for approx 50 mins or until a skewer inserted comes out clean

title: twisted apple cobbler  low fat
steps:
1. Spray a 9x13 baking dish with non-stick cooking spray
2. Add sliced apples evenly
3. Sprinkle cake mix evenly over apples
4. Pour soda gently over cake mix
5. Do not mix- just pour slowly
6. Bake at 350 degrees fahrenheit , covered , for 30 minutes , and uncovered for 30 minutes
7. I halved the recipe using only 3 apples , 1 box of jiffy mix cake mix , 6 oz of diet 7-up and 9" pie pan ! it was still wonderful !

title: pecan crunch cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Cream butter and sugar together
3. Add remaining ingredients
4. Make walnut sized balls with the dough
5. Flatten ball with a glass bottom dipped in sugar
6. Bake for approximately 15 minutes , or until golden
7. Remove and cool on rack

title: pickled carrots
steps:
1. Combine peppers and garlic and set aside
2. Prepare pickling liquid-combine vinegar , sugar , water and salt
3. Bring to a boil and boil for 5 min
4. Add the carrots , return to a boil and boil for 2 min
5. Prepare 6 pint jars
6. Place 5 t's of pepper mix in each jar plus 1 t
7. Each oregano in each jar
8. Pack in carrots and add the liquid leaving 1 / 2 inch head space
9. Process 10 minutes in a boiling water bath

title: sinful carrot cake supreme
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees
2. Combine mincemeat , carrots and nuts and then toss with 1 / 2 cup flour
3. Set aside
4. In mixer combine sugar , oil and lemon beat well
5. Add eggs one at a time beating well
6. Stir together remaining 1 1 / 2 cup flour , baking powder , baking soda and salt
7. Gradually add to batter
8. Beat until smooth
9. Stir in mincemeat mixture , mixing well
10. Put in a greased and floured bundt pan
11. Bake one hour or until pick inserted comes out clean
12. Cool 15 minutes
13. Turn out of pan
14. Serve with cream cheese fluff and warm golden lemon sauce

title: caramel stewed apples
steps:
1. Wash the apples , cut into half and core them , then cut into wedges or slices
2. Do this as you cook the caramel , if you're brave
3. Otherwise deal with the apples in advance so that you can pay full attention to the caramel
4. Put the sugar in a large , heavy-bottomed pan over high heat
5. Heat the pan until the sugar starts to melt
6. Stir if you see clumps
7. The sugar will start to caramelize quickly at some point
8. If it looks like it's going to turn black , take the pan off the heat for a while to cool it down
9. Continue melting the sugar until a thick caramel is formed
10. Stir to combine the apple and caramel as well as you can - the caramel will stick to the bottom of the pan and your stirring spatula quite a lot , but don't worry about it
11. If your spatula gets too caramel-clogged , scrape it off gently with the back of a knife and plop the caramel lump back into the pot
12. It will melt as the apple cooks down and exudes more moisture
13. Lower the heat to low , just high enough so that the pan is barely simmering
14. Put a lid on , and let it cook , stirring occasionally , for about 30 to 40 minutes , until the apple slices are permeated with caramel color , as in the photo above
15. At this point add the optional butter and stir it in , though it's fine to leave it out if you wish
16. Let cool thoroughly before packing into jars or plastic containers
17. Since this doesn't have the large amount of sugar that jams or preserves do , it needs to be stored in the refrigerator , where it will keep for a couple of weeks , or the freezer , where it should keep for a month or more
18. Eat hot or cold
19. It's really nice on pancakes , with or without butter , as well as on oatmeal , yogurt , ice cream , or on its own
20. In the manga they lightly toast some bread , pile the apple on top with a pat of butter , and toast it again in a toaster oven

title: parmesan roasted acorn squash
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400f
2. On a rimmed baking sheet , toss the squash with the oil , thyme , 1 / 2 tsp salt , and 1 / 4 tsp pepper
3. Sprinkle with the parmesan
4. Roast the squash until golden brown and tender , 25-30 minutes

title: baked beets with mustard horseradish dressing
steps:
1. Leave skins , root ends and a bit of the stems on the beets
2. Wrap beets in a single-layer of foil- make sure beets are all about the same size , or wrap same-size beets in separate packages and bake the larger ones a longer time
3. Bake in pre-heated 400f / 200c oven for 1 to 2 hours , or until beets are very tender- test by piercing through foil with knife
4. Open foil packages
5. Let beets cool just until they can be handled , then put on rubber gloves and trim beets by slipping off their skins
6. Slice beets or cut into wedges
7. To make dressing:in a small bowl whisk together mustard , garlic , horseradish , vinegar and pepper
8. Add salt to taste
9. Drizzle dressing over sliced beets
10. Sprinkle with chives
11. Serve at room temperature
12. Ps: as kate from katoomba recommended , have any leftovers the next day with goat's cheese
13. Or in my case a nice bit of bleu crumbled over
14. Delicious !

title: lobster newberg
steps:
1. Saute green onion in butter in a large saucepan until tender
2. Add flour , stirring until smooth
3. Cook 1 minute , stirring constantly
4. Gradually add half and half , cook over medium heat stirring constantly , until thickened and bubbly
5. Stir in red pepper , wine , and lobster
6. Cook 1 minut
7. Spoon lobster mixture into patty shells , sprinkle with parsley
8. I don't know what patty shells are , that is what the recipe calls for
9. I just use ramekins

title: banana gelato
steps:
1. Bring milk and bananas to a simmer in a large saucepan over medium heat
2. Cover , reduce heat to low , and simmer 10 minutes
3. Cool 5 minutes , then pure in a blender or food processor until smooth
4. Return mixture to saucepan
5. Set over very low heat to keep warm
6. Beat yolks and sugar in a large bowl with a mixer at high speed until thick
7. Beat half the milk mixture into yolk mixture in a thin stream , then combine with remaining milk mixture in saucepan
8. Set over low heat and cook until mixture coats back of a spoon , about 2 minutes
9. Stir in vanilla , salt and cream
10. Pour into large container , cover , and refrigerate at least 2 hours or up to 2 days
11. Pour mixture into the canister of an ice-cream freezer
12. Freeze according to manufacturers instructions

title: icelandic curds  skyr
steps:
1. The milk is brought to a boil without burning it , and then cooled to blood heat
2. A cupful of the sour cream is whipped and mixed with some of the milk until thin and smooth , then it is poured into the milk
3. At the same time , one-half rennet tablet is dissolved in a little cold water and poured into the milk , which is stirred to mix the ingredients
4. The mixture is allowed to stand at room temperature for 24 hours
5. Then the skyr is scooped from the pot and strained gradually through a fine linen sieve
6. It is thus separated from the whey
7. The skyr which is left in the sieve should be about as thick as ice cream
8. Four quarts of milk should make about one and a half quarts of skyr
9. When serving , whip skyr well with a spoon or whipper to a smooth ice-cream-like consistency
10. The consistency should not be grainy or like cottage cheese

title: turkey leftover soup
steps:
1. I boil my turkey bones for stock and use that rather than chicken broth
2. Combine broth , rice , and onions
3. Bring to a boil
4. Reduce heat and simmer 40 minutes
5. In a medium sauce pan , melt butter
6. Stir in the flour , salt and pepper
7. Cook 1 minute stirring until smooth and bubbly
8. Slowly stir in the milk and cook until slightly thickened
9. Slowly add the milk mixture into the rice mixture , stirring slowly until well blended
10. Add remaining ingredients and heat gently
11. Do not boil
12. Garnish with crisp bacon bits

title: jalapeno lime coleslaw dressing
steps:
1. Puree all of the dressing ingredients in a blender or processor , except the oil
2. Emulsify slowly with the oil
3. Supposedly you can sub the oil with half buttermilk and half mayo , but i haven't tried this yet
4. Put together the coleslaw of your choice , add dressing and refrigerate for a few hours
5. I usually make half of this- depends on how many you're serving !

title: old fashioned chocolate brownie cake
steps:
1. Cake
2. Preheat oven to 375f
3. Grease and flour a 9x13 pan
4. In a large microwave-safe bowl , combine butter , shortening , cocoa and water
5. Heat in microwave to boiling , stirring occasionally
6. Meanwhile , in mixing bowl , combine sugar and flour
7. Pour hot mixture over sugar and flour and mix to combine
8. Add remaining cake ingredients and beat until well blended
9. Pour into pan and bake for 35-45 minutes or until done
10. Pour icing on cake immediately after taking it out of oven
11. Icing
12. In medium microwave-safe bowl , combine butter , cocoa and buttermilk in bowl and heat in microwave until boiling , stirring to occasionally
13. Pour hot mixture into mixing bowl and add powdered sugar and vanilla
14. Beat until smooth
15. Pour over hot cake right after removing from oven
16. If using nuts , sprinkle over icing while still soft

title: beef and black bean sauce
steps:
1. Heat oil in wok or large frying pan
2. Stir-fry onion until tender
3. Add steak and stir-fry 3-4 minute
4. Stir in beans and mushrooms , stir-fry 2 minutes
5. Add black bean sauce and stock , stirring
6. When sauce boils add sprouts
7. Serve immediately with cooked noodles or rice

title: filipino adobo
steps:
1. Add vinegar , water , garlic , salt , bay leaves and pepper into a large casserole
2. Bring to a boil
3. Add the meat , cover and bring to a boil
4. Simmer and cook for about 30 minutes
5. Sprinkle liberally with soy sauce and cook for an additional 10 minutes
6. Remove meat and reduce sauce
7. Remove sauce to a bowl
8. Put oil into the casserole and brown cooked meat
9. Drain oil from the casserole , and return the reduced sauce back with the meat
10. Serve hot or cold with warm rice

title: crumpets with cheese   bacon
steps:
1. Lightly cook bacon in a non-stick frying pan and set aside
2. Sprinkle cheese evenly over each crumpet followed by pepper and paprika if you are using them
3. Tear up bacon and place over the top , discarding fat and the rind etc
4. Grill for around 5-10 minutes until the cheese has melted into the crumpet

title: valencia chicken breasts
steps:
1. Season chicken breasts w / salt & pepper
2. Heat olive oil in a deep pan , fry chicken breasts on both sides till golden brown , remove from pan & set aside
3. Brown the diced carrot & onion in the oil & meat juices
4. Add orange & lime juice , sugar & white wine
5. Reduce sauce slightly to intensify the flavors
6. Transfer mixture to a blender , puree & season w / salt & pepper to taste
7. Return puree mixture to pan , place chicken breasts in the sauce w / any juice accumulated while set aside & gently simmer for 10 min
8. Serve immediately as per the following
9. To serve: plate ea chicken breast
10. Make 4 diagonally angled cuts from side-to-side to create 5 slightly fanned medallions , but do not cut all the way through the breast
11. Place a halved orange slice in ea of the slits
12. Stir puree sauce , ladle a bit over the length of ea breast & the rest equally along both sides of the chicken breast

title: tropical margarita freeze  pie
steps:
1. Spoon sorbet over crust , spread evenly with metal spatula
2. Freeze for 30 minutes
3. In a food processor or blender , puree strawberries with sugar and margarita mix
4. Pour into a large bowl and fold in whipped topping
5. Carefully pour into over sherbet
6. Place mango slices in a star pattern on top of strawberry mixture and gently press to make horizontally even
7. Place the remaining strawberry in the center
8. Freeze at least 4 hours until firm
9. Parfait variation: use graham cracker crumbs or vanilla wafers and place them amongst 8 freezer-proof margarita glasses
10. Scoop in some sherbet , then the strawberry topping , finally , garnish with a mango slice and 1 / 2 of a fresh strawberry
11. Freeze for 1 hour or till needed

title: coconut pecan bar cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. In a large bowl , combine flour , sugar , cocoa powder and baking powder
3. Cut in the butter until crumbly
4. Press mixture on bottom of ungreased 13x9 inch baking pan
5. Bake for 12 minutes , remove from oven and cool slightly
6. In a medium-sized bowl , combine the eggs , milk , coconut and pecans
7. Pour over the crust
8. Bake for 18 to 20 minutes or until set in center
9. Cool and cut into bars
10. In top of a double boiler over boiling water , melt the chocolate chips and melted butter until smooth , drizzle over the cut bars

title: fast and easy fish soup with garlic aioli
steps:
1. This is a very basic recipe , it encourages experimentation with additional ingredients
2. In large saucepan saute butter , pepper , onion , and garlic until onion is translucent
3. Add chicken broth , tomatoes and clam juice , and potatoes if necessary , bring to boil
4. Reduce heat to simmer
5. Add fresh herbs , splash of wine , salt and pepper to taste and let simmer for 3 minutes stirring occasionally
6. Add fish and cook for 5-7 minutes or until fish is cooked
7. While fish is cooking in soup , make the aioli
8. In small bowl mix , mayo , garlic , lemon juice and cayenne
9. Put on the table
10. Serve soup in large bowls with plenty of sourdough and dollop of aioli

title: bhuna qeema with khara masala  minced meat with whole spices
steps:
1. Heat oil and fry onions till golden brown
2. Add cinnamon , peppercorns , cardamom and cloves
3. Stir fry for 1 minute
4. Add in garlic and ginger paste , fry another minute
5. Throw in the cumin , stir , and then add meat
6. Stir it around on medium high heat till the meat changes color
7. Add salt , red chillies , stir and then lower heat , cover , and let the mince simmer in its own water about 25-30 minutes
8. Remove cover , increase heat and fry well for 1 minute
9. Add 1 / 2 cup yogurt and cook well - constantly stirring - 1-2 more minutes
10. Add coriander leaves and whole green chillies , stir well
11. Then cover and turn off heat
12. Serve hot , garnished with chopped mint leaves

title: easy lemon pepper chicken wings
steps:
1. Deep fry chicken wings until done
2. Place cooked wings in brown paper bag , or glass bowl , sprinkle on lemon pepper
3. Make sure to do this when wings are hot out of deep fryer

title: french coffee  caffe francais
steps:
1. Beat the cream until it's rich and fluffy , with soft peaks
2. Mix in the powdered sugar , and continue to beat until you have stiff peaks
3. Split whipped cream between 2 mugs
4. Add vanilla to the hot coffee , then pour over cream
5. Serve right away , don't stir !

title: moms spinach and ricotta stuffed shells
steps:
1. Bring 4 5 qts of water to a rolling boil , add 2 tbs of salt , gently add pasta , be sure to add extra shells as you will lose a few , cook for approximately 10 minutes , or it tests al dente
2. Drain and rinse in cold water
3. If pasta is starchy , you can toss in olive oil to prevent from sticking , but use sparingly as it will also prevent the cheese from sticking
4. While pasta is cooking start your sauce:
5. In an 6-8 qt pan brown meats over a medium hot burner , work it with a spoon until meat crumbles , add onion , then cook until dark brown , if there is an excessive amount of fat , drain and , optionally , rinse
6. Add garlic and season to taste
7. Cook until garlic is fragrant , use caution not to burn
8. Add sauce & paste , reduce to a simmer
9. Continue to simmer until ready to serve , adjust seasoning as necessary
10. While meat sauce is cooking thaw and rinse and your spinach , i like to use the microwave , but you can rinse it under hot water
11. After draining all the water you can in a colander wrap the spinach in a very clean towel and twist to get the remaining water out , this is a critical step
12. When you get done the spinach will be very dry
13. Crumble the spinach in a large bowl , add ricotta , of the mozzarella , of the parmesan , mix , add egg , mix add seasonings / garlic and mix
14. Be sure to add enough salt here , the spinach really comes alive when seasoned properly
15. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
16. I like to bake the noodles in 8x12 foil pans , but you can use a single sheet pan or a large casserole dish or a pair of 9x13 pans
17. Whatever you decide , lightly grease the pans , ladle in a generous amount of sauce
18. Each shell will take about 2 tablespoons of filling
19. They are very full , but not too top heavy
20. I fit about 20 shells in an 8x12 pan
21. Once the shells are filled and arranged , spoon a small amount of sauce on each one , sprinkle remaining cheeses on the top , cover with greased foil and bake for 25 minutes
22. If you are making the shells ahead of time you will need to adjust your cooking time , bake at 325 for 15 minutes or so , then raise temp to 350 and bake for an additional 20-25 minutes
23. Remove the foil and bake for another 5 minutes , until cheese is melted
24. At this point you can turn on the broiler and brown the cheeses
25. Remove from oven and let sit for 10 minutes while you warm up your garlic bread

title: carolina pulled pork inspired hamburgers
steps:
1. In a small sauce pan , fry half of the bacon pieces and the chopped onion in 1 tablespoon melted butter until the onions are golden , about 5 to 6 minutes
2. Add honey , mustard , vinegar , hot sauce and worcestershire and simmer until the sauce thickens and slightly reduces , about 8-10 minutes
3. Season with salt and pepper , to taste
4. While the sauce is cooking , fry the remaining bacon pieces until crisp then drain on paper towels
5. In a small mixing bowl , combine both paprikas , brown sugar , onion powder , garlic powder and celery seeds with 1 teaspoon each of salt and pepper
6. Lightly knead the ground pork with the bacon and liquid smoke in a bowl
7. Loosely make 4 patties about 3 / 4" thick and place on a plate covered with saran wrap
8. Sprinkle the spice mixture on the top , bottom and sides of burger , patting it into the meat till it sticks
9. Brush the spice covered burgers and both sides of the bread with the remaining 3 tablespoons of butter
10. Light your grill and brush the grate with oil once it is heated
11. Grill the burgers for 12 minutes , turning once , until just cooked through
12. Remove the burgers from direct heat and grill the bread on both sides until toasted and the grill marks appear
13. Set each burger on a toast slice and top with the shredded cabbage and a generous helping of the honey-mustard sauce
14. Cover with the remaining toasted bread and serve immediately , passing the extra sauce separately

title: brigadeiro
steps:
1. For chocolate flavour: put condensed milk , butter and cocoa in a saucepan and cook on medium heat , stirring continually until mixture is thick and sticks to the spoon
2. Grease a plate well and put the mixture on it
3. Refrigerate for 30 minute
4. Take the plate out and butter your hands well
5. Taking a teaspoonful at a time with your hands , roll into a small ball and then roll in chocolate sprinkles
6. For coconut flavour: put condensed milk , coconut , vanilla essence and butter in saucepan
7. Proceed the same as chocolate flavour , only roll in dessicated coconut when done

title: vegetarian rollups
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients except tortillas
2. Spread mixture on tortilla and roll up
3. Refrigerate until serving
4. At serving time , slice on the diagonal
5. Sprinkle tops with paprika , if desired

title: spicy bloody mary mix
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a 2-quart pitcher
2. Store covered in the refrigerator
3. Directions for mixing drink: add 3 parts of the spicy bloody mary mix to 1 part vodka , gin , rum or tequila , over ice
4. This spicy bloody mary mix is also delicious by itself
5. Simply pour over ice and serve

title: red chile lamb stew
steps:
1. In a large saucepan or dutch oven heat oil and add lamb over medium heat
2. Cover and brown meat , stirring occassionally
3. When brown remove from heat and let cool for several minutes
4. Slowly add 4 cups water and bay leaves
5. Return to heat and let simmer over low heat
6. Meanwhile in a cast iron skillet roast rinsed chiles for a few minutes
7. Remove and place in a stainless stell bowl or small pan
8. Add one cup of broth from the simmering lamb
9. Let soak until soft
10. Poke tomatoes once near the stems and place in cast iron skillet and char them lightly by rolling them on their sides
11. Remove from heat and let cool before cutting out the stems
12. Using a blender , puree the chiles with broth , tomatoes , onion , garlic and spices
13. When pureed add mixture and potatoes to simmering lamb
14. Continuing cooking until potatoes are soft about 30-45 minutes

title: grape granola bars
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375
2. Spray 13x9x2 inch baking pan with non stick cooking spray
3. Finely crush 1 1 / 2 cups granola
4. Whisk together 2 1 / 2 cups flour , salt and crushed granola
5. In large bowl , beat butter and sugar until smooth
6. Add egg , then yolk , beating well after each addition
7. Stir in flour mixture
8. Set aside 3 / 4 cup dough
9. Press remaining dough over bottom and 1 / 2 inch up sides of pan
10. Bake crust for 10 minutes
11. Meanwhile stir jelly in small bowl
12. Remove crust from oven and spread with jelly
13. Add remaining 3 / 4 cup granola and 1 / 2 cup flour to reserve dough , stir well , breaking into loose crumbs
14. Sprinkle over jelly layer
15. Bake for another 18 minutes or until jelly is bubbly
16. Cool on wire rack

title: sicilian turkey
steps:
1. Melt the butter in a large saut pan which has a lid , add the onion and garlic and , stirring occasionally , saut for 2 minutes , or until they are just beginning to soften but not brown
2. Add the mushrooms and , stirring occasionally , saut for another 2-3 minutes until they soften
3. Add the flour , ginger and nutmeg , and stirring , cook for another minute
4. Gradually blend in the wine and milk
5. Bring to the boil , stirring , reduce the heat , add the turkey
6. Add salt and freshly ground black pepper , to taste
7. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes
8. Transfer the mixture to a warm serving dish and sprinkle with toasted almonds
9. Serve with noodles or rice and your favourite salad or vegetable side dish
10. Chef's

title: shanghai style noodles with spicy meat sauce
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large skillet or wok
2. Add garlic , ginger root , and pepper flakes and saute about 5 seconds
3. Add onions and stir fry until translucent , about 5 minutes
4. Stir in ground meat , breaking it up with a spoon or spatula
5. Cook until meat has lost pink color
6. Combine 1 / 2 cup chicken broth , hoisin sauce , soy sauce and sherry
7. Stir into meat mixture
8. Cover , reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes , stirring once or twice
9. Meanwhile , dissolve the cornstarch in the remaining 1 / 2 cup of chicken broth
10. Slowly stir into meat mixture and cook and stir until sauce thickens
11. In a big bowl , toss warm cooked vermicelli with sesame oil
12. Pour sauce over top and toss gently to combine
13. Sprinkle with sliced green onions

title: waffled french toast
steps:
1. Preheat waffle maker on medium-high heat
2. In large bowl , whisk the eggs until frothy
3. Add the milk , vanilla , cinnamon , nutmeg and brown sugar and whisk until blended
4. Dip 1 bread slice into the egg mixture and soak , turning once , 20 seconds per side
5. Spray the wells of the waffle maker with nonstick cooking spray or brush with melted butter
6. Place one bread slice in each well of the waffle maker and close the lid
7. Cook the bread until golden brown and crisp , about 7 minutes
8. Transfer the french toast to a wire rack set on a baking sheet and keep warm in the oven
9. Repeat to cook the remaining bread
10. Dust french toast with confectioners' sugar and serve hot with maple syrup

title: stuffed pizza burger
steps:
1. Combine , hamburger salt and pepper in a large bowl
2. In another bowl , combine the coarsely shredded sharp cheddar and pepperonis
3. Let bacon and cheese mixture sit at room temperature for about 20 minutes to get soft
4. Then , shape mixture into balls
5. Form 2 patties of meat and place one cheese / pepperonis balls in between them
6. Pinch the sides together to seal in cheese ball
7. Gently press formed patty , to spread out cheese ball
8. Continue until all patties are formed
9. Cook burgers on grill over medium flame for about 7 minutes on each side
10. While burgers are grilling , flip burgers , and baste the cooked side of the patties with the pizza sauce after about 7 minutes longer , the burger should be done
11. Baste again with the pizza sauce before removing from grill
12. Butter hamburger buns and place on top rack of grill for several minutes , until toasted
13. To build burger , take toasted bun , add patty , you can add tomato or lettuce , if you would like , but the flavors are great without them

title: barley salad with tomatoes and corn
steps:
1. Boil large pot of water , add barley
2. Reduce heat , cover , simmer 50 minutes till tender
3. Drain and rinse under cold running water
4. In food processor , puree basil , cheese , oil and garlic
5. Season to taste
6. In bowl , toss basil mix through barley
7. Add corn and tomatoes
8. Can be made 2 days ahead and refrigerated

title: steak fillet with mushrooms
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 180 degrees celsius
2. Heat oil in a pan , add steaks and sear 2 minutes each side , cook for a further 4-5 min's a side
3. Remove to an oven proof dish and cook for a further 15-20 min's for medium rare-medium
4. Please adjust cooking times for thinner steaks as i said above mine were about 300g a piece and this cooking time gave us a tender steaks , nice and pink in the middle
5. Sauce
6. Melt butter in a pan , add mushrooms , cook , until almost tender , add garlic and cook for a further 2 min's , stirring , so garlic does not burn
7. Add creme fraiche , cream and stock , bring to the boil
8. Reduce heat to a simmer , mix a little water with cornflour , add to sauce and stir until mixture thickens
9. Stir in onions and parsley , serve sauce over steak

title: korean fire pork  toeji kogi kui
steps:
1. It is easiest if you get thinly sliced pork roast in a korean market
2. If you get the whole roast , freeze slightly and slice thinly , about 1 / 8-1 / 4 inch thin , score meat lightly
3. Set aside into mixing bowl
4. Mix rest of ingredients together and pour into bowl with the meat
5. Using hands knead the meat making sure that the marinade covers each piece completely
6. Set meat aside into refrigerator to marinate for at least 1 / 2 hour
7. You can grill or broil the meat
8. I would lay some foil down first and poke holes into the foil
9. Or you can fry it in a hot pan coated with a little oil
10. Cook meat until lightly browned
11. Serve with plenty of steamed rice and your choice of asian vegetables

title: cranberry crisp with autumn fruit
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 375f
2. Grease a 2-quart shallow baking dish
3. In a large bowl , combine the apples , pears , cranberries , sugar , 2 tablespoons of the flour and cinnamon
4. Spread mixture evenly into the baking dish , in small bowl , combine rolled oats , brown sugar and the remaining 1 / 3 cup flour
5. Using pastry blender or fork , cut in butter until crumbly
6. Stir in nuts
7. Sprinkle crumb mixture evenly over fruit
8. Bate for 30 to 40 minutes or until golden brown and apples are tender
9. Serve with whipped cream

title: moroccan salad dressing
steps: 1. Mix together all the ingredients and let sit for a while to allow the flavours to blend

title: macaroni and cheese  4 389
steps:
1. Cook macaroni , rinse and drain
2. Melt butter in heavy bottomed 2 quart sauce pan
3. Add flour , s& p , whisk in and cook until bubbly
4. Slowly whisk in milk
5. Cook until it starts to thicken
6. Add cheeses and mustard and cook until thick
7. Pour sauce over macaroni , stir , heat and serve
8. Freeze any leftovers
9. When thawed , reheat adding extra liquid until it is the consistancy you like

title: honey glazed fried manchego cheese
steps:
1. Place the flour , egg , and panko bread crumbs in 3 separate dishes
2. Dip the cheese cubes into each ingredient to coat , starting with the flour and ending with the panko
3. Preheat the canola oil in a deep fryer to 375 degrees f , if you don't have a thermometer , a cube of bread will brown in about 3 minutes
4. Add the breaded cheese to the hot oil , in batches , and deep fry until the cubes are crisp and golden
5. Remove the cheese from the oil and place on a paper towel-lined baking sheet to absorb the excess oil
6. Transfer the cheese to a serving platter , drizzle with the honey , and dust with the paprika
