title: oven frittata with broccoli and potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. In a large oven-proof nonstick skillet , cook potatoes in oil over medium heat until tender and lightly browned , about 10 minutes
3. Add the broccoli , mushrooms and onion
4. Cook and stir for another 5 minutes
5. Turn off heat
6. In a bowl , beat egg whites and whole eggs with parmesan cheese , parsley , basil , oregano and black pepper
7. Gently pour egg mixture over mixture in skillet
8. Place skillet in oven and bake for 10 minutes or until eggs are almost set on top
9. Turn on broiler and finish cooking for 3 minutes or until lightly browned and set
10. Sprinkle with paprika and serve

title: frozen raspberry delight
steps:
1. To make crust: in medium bowl , combine crushed chocolate wafers , margarine and sugar
2. Mix well
3. Set aside 1 / 4 c of the mixture and press remaining mixture onto bottom of 9x13-inch pan
4. Refrigerate for 15 minutes
5. Carefully spread chocolate fudge sauce over crust , using
6. Cut slightly softened ice cream into slices and place them over the fudge , cutting pieces to fit
7. Place spoonfuls of sherbet randomly over ice cream and gently swirl into the ice cream
8. If the ice cream mixture starts to get too soft , set pan in freezer until it firms up slightly
9. Top with raspberries , gently pressing them into the ice cream mixture , then cover with whipped topping , bringing it to the edges of the pan
10. Garnish with reserved chocolate crumbs , cover , and freeze 6 hours or overnight
11. Let stand at room temperature about 10 minutes before serving
12. Freeze one half to use in other desserts
13. Let the other half soften just enough to cut it into slices
14. If desired , 1 quart of ice cream can be used
15. Soften , then evenly spread over fudge

title: pumpkin pie dessert
steps:
1. Combine cracker crumbs , splenda and butter and press into 13 x 9 x 2 dish
2. Whisk milk and pudding mix for 2 minutes
3. Stir in pumpkin and spices and pour over crust
4. Refrigerate for 3 hours and garnish servings with whipped topping and nuts
5. Cooking time reflects 3 hours of cooling

title: peach heaven smoothie
steps:
1. Mix ingredients together until smooth
2. Pour and enjoy !

title: lemon caper chicken
steps:
1. Warm oil in large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
2. Pat chicken breasts with paper towels to thoroughly dry
3. Season chicken with salt and pepper , then lightly coat with flour , using about 1 tsp for each breast
4. Lay chicken in skillet
5. Cook 2 to 3 minutes , until golden brown , gently pressing down on breast to ensure equal browning
6. Reduce heat to medium
7. Turn breasts
8. Cook 2 to 3 minutes longer , until golden brown and cooked through
9. Remove breasts to a serving platter
10. Reduce heat to low
11. Add shallots and capers to skillet
12. Cook 30 seconds , stirring
13. Add broth and juice , cook 1 minute , until incorporated and thickened , stirring
14. Stir in parsley , pour sauce over chicken
15. Serve immediately

title: round steak supper
steps:
1. Place the potatoes in a slow cooker
2. Cut beef into four pieces
3. Place over potatoes
4. In a bowl , combine the soup , water , soup mix , pepper and garlic powder
5. Pour over the beef
6. Cover and cook on low for 6-8 hours or until meat and potatoes are tender

title: fresh vegetable bake
steps:
1. Slice squash and onions into thin rounds
2. Thinly slice onions and separate rings
3. Slice pepper into thin rings
4. Place layer of tomatoes , topped by a layer each of onion , squash , and zucchini in a large baking dish
5. Sprinkle with feta cheese , basil , oregano , parsley , salt , and pepper
6. Repeat layers
7. Add rings of pepper and more spices to layer
8. Grate white cheese on layers , and top with parmesan
9. Bake at 350 degrees until cheese is bubbly , but not brown
10. About 10-15 minutes

title: yogurt with cucumbers
steps:
1. Blend all ingredients
2. Chill before serving

title: filet mignon en phyllo avec sauce madere
steps:
1. Oil a large heavy skillet and in it sear the fillets over high heat for 1 minute per side
2. Season with salt and pepper and set aside
3. In the same skillet saute the mushrooms , ham and shallots , in 2 tablespoons of butter for about 5 minutes
4. Add the mustard and sherry
5. Cook and stir a few more minutes to form a moist paste
6. Set aside
7. Brush 1 sheet of phyllo dough with butter and place another sheet on top
8. Repeat this three more times , ending up with 4 stacks
9. On each stack of phyllo , place 2 tablespoons of mushroom mixture in the center and top with 1 fillet
10. Wrap the phyllo around the fillets and place seam side down on a greased baking sheet
11. Brush with melted butter and bake at 450f for 12 minutes or until lightly browned
12. Meat will be medium rare
13. For the sauce , blend pan juices from meat with broth , madeira and bovril
14. Bring to a boil , reduce heat , add lemon juice and let simmer for 5 minutes , stirring occasionally
15. Remove skillet from heat and swirl in butter
16. Spoon 2 tablespoons of sauce over each fillet and serve
17. Pour remaining sauce in a sauce boat

title: simple fabulous pork chops
steps:
1. Completely coat pork chops w / old bay seasoning and paprika
2. Sprinkle with garlic powder and a little salt & pepper
3. Start by covering & saute in skillet w / extra virgin olive oil until browned or cooked through , turning occasionally
4. Can uncover part way through
5. Variation: instead of salt , you can use mexican adobo and sazon seasoning
6. Wonderful !

title: chili mushroom sauce
steps:
1. Fry the onion and mushrooms in the oil a couple of minutes
2. Add curry powder and fry gently until softened
3. Add potato flour , stir
4. Add water , cream and sweet chili sauce
5. Stir and cook 5-7 minutes on low heat

title: oat blondies
steps:
1. Position oven rack in the lower third of the oven
2. Preheat oven to 350
3. Butter and flour a 9x13 inch pan
4. Set aside
5. In a bowl , whisk the flour , cinnamon , baking soda , and salt until combined
6. Set aside
7. In a big bowl , cream the butter , sugar , and brown sugar using an electric mixer on medium speed
8. Continue beating until pale brown and thick , about 7 minutes
9. Add the eggs one at a time , allowing the first to be thoroughly incorporated before adding the second
10. Scrape down the sides of bowl as necessary
11. After beating in the second egg for 1 minute , stir in the vanilla
12. Using a wooden spoon or rubber spatula , stir in the oats and chocolate chips until combined
13. Then stir in the flour mixture just until incorporated
14. Spoon batter into prepared pan , pressing it gently into the corners with your fingers
15. Bake for 30 minutes , until the top is lightly browned and a pick comes out clean
16. Set pan on a wire rack to cool for at least 30 minutes
17. Cut blondies into 24 pieces while they are still in the pan
18. Carefully remove with an offset spatula
19. Serve immediately or let cool completely before covering with plastic wrap for storage at room temperature

title: forgotten jambalaya
steps:
1. In a 5 quart slow cooker , combine the tomatoes , broth and tomato paste
2. Stir in the green peppers , onion , celery , garlic and seasonings
3. Stir in chicken and sausage
4. Cover and cook on low for 4 hours or until chicken is tender
5. Stir in shrimp
6. Cover and cook 15-30 minutes longer or until shrimp turn pink
7. Serve with rice

title: french oven stew
steps:
1. Heat oven 300 degrees
2. Mix all ingredients in a heavy 3 quart ovenproof saucepot
3. Cover and bake , stirring once an hour , for 3 hours or until meat is tender and sauce is thickened
4. Discard bay leaves before serving or storing
5. Serve over buttered noodles if desired
6. You can use frozen small white onions instead of fresh but add them to the pot 1 hour before stew is done
7. You can also add frozen peas or frozen beans 20 minutes before stew is done --

title: lina s avocado   lime jalapeno poppers
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Mash the avocado & cream cheese till smooth
3. Mix in the the lime juice , garlic powder and cumin
4. Cut jalapenos in half lengthwise and remove seeds
5. Stir in the cheese
6. Fill each pepper
7. Place on a foil lined cookie sheet
8. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes
9. I filled around 12 medium to small peppers

title: heather s awesome chicken on toast
steps:
1. Pour flour onto a plate or pie plate
2. Add salt and pepper
3. I add a lot of pepper to make the chicken quite spicy
4. Add the chicken pieces to the flour mixture and toss to coat
5. Saute chicken in olive oil over medium high heat until golden brown
6. Once chicken is golden brown , add the mushrooms and green onions
7. Cover and cook an additional 5-8 minutes
8. Uncover
9. Add chicken broth and heavy whipping cream
10. Bring mixture to a boil over medium to medium high heat until mixture reduces
11. Be careful to keep an eye on it or you could reduce it too much
12. If you do reduce it too much , add more chicken broth
13. Slice french bread into 1" or 2" slices and place on a cookie sheet
14. Toast on the top shelf of oven , under the broiler , for 1 to 2 minutes per side
15. Watch closely so they don't burn
16. To serve , pour heaping spoonfuls of the chicken mixture over the toast slices and enjoy ! garnish with parsley - - i take a pinch of parsley and sprinkle lightly over entire plate for a splash of color

title: chocolate peanut butter fudge bars
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350
2. Line a 9-inch quare pan with foil , letting foil extend above pan on opposite sides and coat foil with nonstick cooking spray
3. Prepare brownie mix as package directs for fudgy brownies
4. Stir in peanut butter chips and peanuts , spread evenly in prepared pan
5. Bake 30 minutes , or until wooden pick inserted in center comes out with moist crumbs attached
6. Cool completely in pan on wire rack
7. Filling: beat peanut butter , marshmallow cream and butter in a medium bowl with mixer on high speed until well blended
8. Reduce speed to low , add confectioners sugar and beat until blended
9. Spread evenly over brownie
10. Glaze: microwave chocolate and butter , stirring at 30-second intervals , until melted and smooth
11. Cool slightly
12. Stir in corn syrup
13. Spread evenly over filling layer
14. Refrigerate 1 hour until filling is firm and glaze sets
15. Lift foil by ends onto a cutting board
16. Cut in 6 rows lengthwise and 6 crosswise
17. Refrigerate in a container with wax paper between layers up to 2 weeks or freeze up to 3 months

title: stuffed onions florentine
steps:
1. Cut each onion in half lengthwise and loosen center of each half
2. Remove inner piece to make a 1 / 2" thick shell
3. Finely chop onion centers
4. Saute onion in oil till tender
5. Remove from heat
6. Microwave spinach according to package directions then remove excess moisture
7. Add to onion , and stir in cheese
8. Place onion shells , cut side up , in microwave safe pan with 1 / 4 c water
9. Cover with plastic wrap and microwave on high 5 minutes
10. Drain water and then spoon spinach mix into shells , re-cover , and microwave 7-8 minutes more or till tender
11. Let stand for 3-5 minutes

title: mughlai kheema matar
steps:
1. Heat oil in a pan
2. Add garlic , ginger , onions and salt
3. Stir-fry till the raw smell of ginger and garlic is gone , and the onions are lightly browned
4. Add all the spice powders and green chillies
5. Add mutton , stir and cook for 5 minutes
6. Add hot water
7. Bring to a boil
8. Cover pan with a lid and cook on low flame for 30 minutes
9. Add peas and lime juice
10. Cook until the liquid has been reduced
11. Serve hot with bread , steamed rice or naan

title: whiskey marinated flank steak
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients except steak in a large ziptop bag
2. Add the steak , close bag , and refrigerate until ready to use- either for hours or overnight
3. Pull the steak out of the fridge about 30 minutes before you're ready to cook it
4. Let it reach room-temperature before grilling
5. Shake the meat to remove any excess marinade from it and place on the grill
6. Grill for a few minutes per side , until it reaches your desired level of "doneness
7. " let rest for 5-10 minutes before slicing

title: best cherry preserves
steps:
1. Sterilize your jars and keep them hot while you're cooking the preserves
2. Place cherries in a large , heavy duty dutch oven
3. Combine pectin with 1 / 4 cup sugar
4. Stir into cherries , add butter
5. Bring to a full boil , stirring , over high heat
6. Add 3 more cups sugar and return to a boil , stirring constantly , boil 1 minutes
7. Remove from heat
8. Skim off foam
9. Immediately spoon preserves into 3 one pint sterilized jars , leaving 1 / 4" headspace
10. Wipe the sealing surface of the jars with a clean paper towel , dampened with hot water , to remove any preserves or sugar crystals
11. Place lids and screw on bands finger
12. Process in a boiling water bath for at least ten minutes , depending upon your altitude
13. When the jars have been processed in boiling water for the recommended time , turn off the heat and remove the canner lid
14. Wait 5 minutes
15. Remove jars from canner using a jar lifter and keeping jars upright
16. Carefully place them directly onto a towel or cake cooling rack to protect your countertop , leaving at least one inch of space between the jars during cooling
17. Avoid placing the jars on a cold surface or in a cold draft
18. After jars have cooled undisturbed for 24 hours , remove ring bands from sealed jars
19. Put any unsealed jars in the refrigerator and use first

title: veal or chicken stew with herbs   barley
steps:
1. Melt the butter in a heavy pan and fry the meat with the leeks and garlic till the vegetables are slightly softened and the meat lightly browned
2. Add the barley , water , vinegar , bay leaves and seasoning
3. Bring the pot to the boil , cover it and simmer gently for 1 to 1 hours or until the meat is really tender and ready to fall from the bone
4. Add the sage and continue to cook for several minutes
5. Adjust the seasoning to taste and serve in bowls- the barley will serve as a vegetable

title: zupse bread swiss bread
steps:
1. Add the yeast to one cup of the scalded , cooled milk to proof
2. Mix the butter , sugar , salt and flour together
3. Beat the egg and add to the remaining milk
4. Make a well in the center of the flour mixture and add the milk / egg mixture
5. Mix well
6. Add milk / yeast mixture
7. Mix well
8. Turn out of bowl and knead until no longer sticky
9. Replace in bowl , cover , and let rise until doubled
10. Punch down and let rise again until doubled
11. While dough is rising for the second time , preheat oven to 375f
12. Form into loaves on a greased cookie sheet
13. Bake for approximately 35 minutes or bread sounds hollow when thumped
14. During the last ten minutes of baking , brush with an egg wash for a dark golden crust

title: my favourite  green tomato pickles
steps:
1. Slice tomatoes and onions very thin
2. Layer them in a large bowl , sprinkling salt between the layers
3. Let stand overnight
4. In the morning , drain in a colander , letting cold water run through the vegetables for a few minutes , then drain well again
5. Into a large saucepan measure sugar and vinegar
6. Tie all spices loosely in a cheesecloth and add to vinegar mixture
7. Bring to a boil and add tomatoes , onions and lemon
8. Remove stem and seed cores from peppers , slice thinly and add to mixture
9. Reduce heat and simmer , uncovered , for 30 minutes , stirring occasionally to prevent sticking
10. Remove spice bag
11. Pack pickles in sterilized jars and seal
12. Enjoy

title: cornucopia snacks
steps:
1. Slightly over-stuff each bugle with white icing
2. Place various colors of trix cereal on icing
3. The result should look like a miniature cornucopia of fruit ! :)
4. Make a bunch , because they will disappear quickly !

title: stuffed zuccini boats
steps:
1. Cook rice according to package directions
2. Wash zuccini thoroughly and pat dry
3. Cut in half lenghthwise and scoop out seeds
4. Salt and pepper flesh
5. Fry celery , onions , and green pepper in olive oil until translucent
6. Add minced garlic and ground beef
7. Cook until beef is browned
8. Stir in rest of ingredients except cheeses
9. Divide filling among the zuccini and top with mozzarella and sprinkle parmesan on top
10. Put boats in a roasting pan or on a cookie sheet and tent loosely with foil
11. Bake at 375 for 45 minutes
12. Remove foil and bake an additional 5 to 15 minutes - until zuccini is tender when poked with a fork

title: southern belle cucumber sandwiches
steps:
1. Peel and cut the cucumbers in half lengthwise
2. Remove the seeds and sprinkle the cavities liberally with salt
3. Place the cucumbers on a rack in a glass dish , cover , and let drain overnight
4. The next day rinse the cucumbers to remove excess salt , and press between paper towels to remove any excess moisture
5. Chop the cucumbers and put into a food processor
6. Blend for 10 seconds
7. Chop the cream cheese into cubes , and add to the cucumbers along with the chives and salad dressing powder , and blend until smooth
8. Cut the crusts from the bread and use a cookie cutter to cut shapes out of each slice
9. I use a heart-shaped cutter that is 2 1 / 2 by 2 1 / 2 inches
10. You can usually get two sandwiches out of each slice of bread
11. I freeze the scraps to use for bread crumbs , or i feed them to the birds
12. Spread the cucumber filling on each slice and place into an airtight container separating layers or sandwiches with waxed paper
13. Refrigerate for an hour or more
14. Place on a serving platter and garnish each sandwich with a snippet of fresh parsley

title: orange sparklers
steps: 1. Mix up and serve from a punch bowl

title: zion s gumdrop cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Cream shortening and sugars
3. Blend in eggs , salt , vanilla and soda
4. Slowly stir in flour
5. With wooden spoon stir in chopped gumdrops and nuts
6. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto a greased cookie sheet and bake just until set
7. Do not over bake
8. I found that using a silpat is very helpful with this recipe

title: quick and easy skillet potato halves
steps:
1. Heat a lidded skillet on the stove over medium heat
2. Scrub potatoes and cut in half lengthwise
3. Place butter in skillet until melted
4. Spread butter evenly over the bottom of the skillet
5. Place potato halves cut side down in skillet
6. Cover and reduce heat to medium-low
7. Cook for approximately 30 minutes until potatoes are fork tender and the cut surfaces are golden brown
8. Serve with additional butter and salt as desired

title: healthy peanut butter cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease one or two baking sheets
3. Mix peanut butter and honey until smooth
4. Add egg , baking soda , and the optional ingredients , if you're using them
5. Beat until well-mixed
6. Place teaspoonfuls of dough onto cookie sheets , leaving space in between cookies
7. Bake until pale gold color , about 5-7 minutes
8. Don't overcook ! these can burn easily
9. Transfer to racks to cool

title: incredible cheesy broccoli soup   weight watchers
steps:
1. In a large pot , combine water , potatoes , vegetables , broth , salt and pepper
2. Bring to a boil and simmer until the vegetables are tender
3. In a separate bowl , blend flower and mild
4. Slowly add flower / milk mix to the large pot
5. Stir constantly until soup thickens
6. Add cheese cubes and stir until smooth

title: steal this bbq  recipe
steps:
1. Cut the ribs into sections containing 2-3 bones each
2. Place ribs into a roasting pan and cover
3. Roast low until meat is thouroughly cooked
4. Combine ingredients for sauce in a large bowl
5. Place ribs onto broiling pan or gas grill
6. Brush sauce onto ribs and either broil or grill on high heat , rotating often
7. You want the sauce to carmelize , but not to burn
8. Keep brushing on sauce until it's all gone

title: pretty and pink pound cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees
2. Grease and flour one 9 x 5 x 3 inch loaf pan , and set aside
3. Beat oil and sugar at medium speed with a mixer -- about 2 minutes
4. Combine buttermilk , egg whites , egg , vanilla , and butter-flavor extract , stirring until blended
5. Combine flour , salt , and soda
6. Add to oil mixture alternately with buttermilk mixture , beginning and ending with flour mixture
7. Beat at low speed , beating just until blended after each addition
8. Divide batter into thirds
9. Spread one portion into loaf pan
10. Stir raspberry jam into second portion
11. Spread gently over first layer
12. Spoon remaining batter over top
13. Bake at 325 for 1 hour and 35 minutes or until a wooden stick inserted in center of cake comes out clean
14. Cool in pan on a wire rack 10 to 15 minutes
15. Remove from pan , and cool completely on wire rack

title: bacon appetizer crescents
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. Mix cream cheese , bacon , parmesan cheese , onions , parsley and milk until well blended
3. Set aside
4. Separate each can of dough into four rectangles
5. Firmly press perforations together to seal
6. Spread each rectangle with 2 rounded tablespoonfuls of the cream cheese mixture
7. Cut each rectangle into 12 wedges
8. Roll up wedges , starting at short ends
9. Place , seam-sides down , on greased baking sheet
10. Bake 12 to 15 minute or until golden brown
11. Serve warm

title: oma s chocolate pudding
steps:
1. Scald the milk
2. In a bowl , beat the eggs
3. Add the sugar , the cocoa and the custard powder
4. When milk is scalded , add one cup of it to the egg mixture slowly
5. Then add the egg mixture back into the scalded milk slowly
6. Cook until boiling
7. Stir constantly

title: sauteed asparagus with sesame seeds
steps:
1. Trim any tough ends from the asparagus stalks
2. Cut into 1 inch pieces on the diagonal
3. Heat butter in a skillet and cook the asparagus about 1 minutes , tossing and shaking to cook evenly
4. Sprinkle with sugar and cook , while tossing , about 30 seconds more
5. Sprinkle with soy sauce and continue cooking another 30 seconds being careful not to overcook
6. Meanwhile heat the sesame seeds in a dry skillet also shaking and stirring
7. Remove from heat when they begin to turn golden
8. Sprinkle sesame seeds over asparagus and serve

title: mama s quicker fudge frosting  paula deen
steps:
1. In a saucepan , combine butter , cocoa , and milk
2. Bring to a boil
3. Add sugar and vanilla
4. Beat well until smooth
5. Frost cake and sprinkle on nuts , if desired

title: warm sweet potato salad
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400 degrees
2. Stir together vinegar , maple syrup and mustard
3. Slowly whisk in 2 t of olive oil
4. Set aside
5. Place sweet potatoes and onion in large bowl
6. Drizzle with remaining olive oil , stir until coated
7. Spread on baking sheet
8. Sprinkle with thyme , salt and pepper
9. Roast at 400 for 45 minutes , stirring half way through
10. Remove from oven and place in a large bowl
11. Stir in spinach and nuts
12. Drizzle with maple vinagrette and serve immediately

title: beef carpaccio
steps:
1. Wrap the tenderloin in plastic wrap and place in the freezer for 2 hours
2. After 2 hours , unwrap the tenderloin and thinly slice the beef into approximately into 1 / 8 to 1 / 4-inch pieces
3. Lay out sheets of plastic wrap and place each slice onto the plastic
4. Top with another piece of plastic and gently pound the meat with a meat mallet until paper thin
5. Repeat until all of the meat is sliced and pounded
6. Divide the meat evenly among 4 chilled plates
7. Serve with greens tossed with vinaigrette , salt , pepper and / or parmesan

title: southwestern black bean dip
steps:
1. In a 3-to 4 quart pan over medium-high heat , bring beans , tomatoes , 1 / 4 cup onion and beer to a boil
2. Lower heat and cook , stirring occasionally , until most of the liquid is absorted and remaining liquid is thick , 35 to 45 minutes
3. If smoth consistency is desired whirl in a blender or food procceser until smooth
4. Stir remaining 1 / 4 cup onoin and cilantro , serve

title: roasted root vegetables  1 ww point
steps:
1. Place the potatoes , carrots , turnips and garlic in a 9 x 13 x 2 inch baking dish sprayed with pam
2. Drizzle with oil
3. Sprinkle with rosemary , salt and pepper
4. Stir to coat
5. Bake , uncovered , at 350 degrees for 35 minutes
6. Increase temperature to 450 degrees and bake 10 to 15 minutes longer or until veggies are tender

title: healthy  fast  and delicious macaroni and cheese with vegetables
steps:
1. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil
2. Saute sliced or diced mushrooms until they release their juices and the juices mostly evaporate
3. Turn off heat
4. Add washed and dried cherry tomatoes to the pan to warm through
5. In a food processor , process garlic cloves until minced
6. Add cottage cheese , extra virgin olive oil , and parmesan cheese and process until smooth
7. Cook pasta according to package directions
8. A few minutes before pasta is done cooking , add broccoli to the pot
9. Before draining pasta / broccoli mixture , set aside 1 cup of pasta cooking water
10. Drain pasta / broccoli
11. Add cottage cheese sauce , mushrooms , and tomatoes to pasta / broccoli
12. Stir to combine
13. Taste for seasonings
14. Salt and pepper as necessary
15. Use reserved pasta cooking water to adjust sauce consistency as necessary
16. Make this recipe your way ! substitute your favorite vegetables , substitute your favorite cheese in place of the parmesan , add herbs , or add beans to make a complete protein !

title: lentil stew a la fez
steps:
1. Place lentils , water , tumeric , ginger and nutmeg in a medium saucepan and bring to a boil
2. Reduce to a simmer and cook uncovered for 20 minutes
3. At the end of 20 minutes your lentils will be still firm and
4. You will have very little water left in the pot , the lentils finish cooking with the stew
5. At the point your lentils have been cooking 15 minutes , place olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat
6. Add onions , carrots , celery and fennel
7. Cook for 5 minutes until vegetables begin to soften
8. Add garlic and cook another 30 seconds
9. Mix the lentils into the vegetables in the larger pot and stir well
10. Add the remaining ingredients , stir again and simmer for 20-30 minutes
11. If the stew seems dry , add additional vegetable stock or water
12. When ready to serve , season with salt and pepper to taste
13. Sprinkle chopped fennel fronds on top
14. Serve hot on couscous or rice

title: zucchini lasagna
steps:
1. Prheat the oven to 425f
2. Lightly oil an 8-inch baking dish and set aside
3. In a medium bowl , stir together the cream cheese and ricotta
4. Season with salt and pepper
5. In another medium bowl , combine the zucchini , garlic , and oregano
6. Season with salt and pepper , and toss to combine
7. Spread 1 / 3 of the zucchini mixture in the prepared baking dish
8. Top with 2 lasagna noodles , then 1 / 3 of the ricotta mixture
9. Repeat twice with the remaining zucchini mixture , noodles , and ricotta mixture
10. Finishing with the ricotta mixture
11. Sprinkle with the mozzarella cheese
12. Cover the baking dish with aluminum foil and bake until bubbly and noodles are tender , about 30-35 minute
13. Remove the foil and bake until golden brown , about 15-20 min more
14. Let stand for 10 min before serving

title: betty s salad
steps:
1. Layer salad ingredients in order listed below
2. Half package spinach
3. Six hard boiled eggs , sliced
4. One can bean sprouts , drained
5. 1-2 cans water chestnuts , drained and sliced (optional , depending on the recipe you follow
6. Add crumbled bacon
7. Mix dressing in blender and pour over salad
8. Keep all ingredients refrigerated

title: chicken breasts in ginger lime sauce
steps:
1. Beat the chicken meat with a mallet to tenderise
2. Barbecue the chicken until tender
3. To make lime juice sauce: combine the brown sugar , lime juice , rum , ginger , garlic and hot sauce in a saucepan , heating without boiling until sugar fully dissolves , then bring sauce to a boil
4. Serve on top of chicken

title: chesapeake bay crab scampi
steps:
1. Heat oil and butter in large skillet over medium heat
2. Add garlic and cook until garlic is lightly golden
3. Add red pepper , lemon juice and white wine
4. Bring to a soft boil and simmer for 2-3 minutes
5. Gently stir in crabmeat and parsley
6. Season with salt and pepper to taste
7. Serve over pasta
8. Save about 1 / 2 to 1 cup of pasta water to add to dish if there is not enough liquid to suit you or you could also add additional amount of wine or chicken broth

title: dirt dessert from abc s the view
steps:
1. Put oreo cookies in food processor or large ziploc bag
2. Process or smash until crumbles
3. Stir the cream cheese , cool whip , sugar , pudding mix and milk together until blended
4. Layer the dessert as follows:
5. Begin with a small layer of oreo in the bottom of a flower pot / clear hurricane lamp or children's pail
6. Layer of pudding mixture , layer of cookies , etc until all of mixture is gone
7. You will end with a layer of oreo
8. Top your dessert off with an artificial flower , or for children put gummy worms in the dirt

title: picarones
steps:
1. Fill water in a large pan with cinnamon , clove , and aniseed
2. Boil for 10 min , and strain reserving water
3. Cook sweet potatoes and squash in the reserved water until tender
4. Remove pan and force through a strainer
5. Reserve 2 cups of cooking liquid and allow to cool
6. In a small bowl , combine yeast , sugar and reserved cooking liquid
7. Set aside for 15 minutes
8. Place strained sweet potatoes and squash in a large bowl
9. Add salt , yeast mixture and eggs
10. Stir until combined
11. Fold in flour and continue stirring until soft and smooth and elastic dough is formed
12. Cover with a damp cloth and leave dough to rise for 1 hour
13. Heat oil in a large skillet until hot
14. Take a small quantity of dough and form a ring
15. Fry in hot oil until golden on both sides
16. Repeat until all is used
17. Drain on paper napkins
18. Syrup:
19. Combine sugar , clove , cinnamon , orange peel , allspice and water in a medium saucepan
20. Bring to boil over low heat until mixture thickens to a syrup
21. It will take around 20-25 minutes

title: far breton aux pommes  apple pie
steps:
1. Peel and slice the apples
2. Put the apple - slices in a casserole dish , add the butter and 70gr sugar and bake for 15 minutes at 350f
3. Meanwhile , beat the eggs , with the rest of the sugar
4. Add the milk and the flour to make a soft dough
5. Allow the apples to cool
6. When apples are cooled , put the batter on top of the apples and bake for 60 minutes at 350f

title: lemon lovers bundt cream cheese cake
steps:
1. Make the cake batter as directed on the back of the box you can use the vegetable oil as directed if you like i just don't like hydrogenated oil and prefer using butter in desserts
2. Poor batter into butterd / floured non stick bundth pan
3. In a food processor combine filling mixture until smooth and creamy
4. Poor filling mixture into bundt pan going in a circle to poor out evenly
5. Tap the bowle on the counter several times until the cake batter has covered the filling mix
6. Bake as directed on box depending on your oven and what type of pan you are using
7. Remove and allow to cool
8. After cooling place in fridge so cake can set
9. Serve with wip cream , lemon glaze or cream cheese frosting
10. Enjoy :)

title: roasted eggplant  aubergine  rolls
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees
2. Spray 2 nonstick baking sheets with nonstick cooking spray
3. Set aside
4. Trim ends from eggplants
5. Cut lengthwise into 1 / 4 inch thick slices
6. Discard outside slices that are mostly skin
7. Combine lemon juice and olive oil in small bowl
8. Brush lightly over both sides of eggplant slices
9. Arrange slices in single layer on baking sheets
10. Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until slightly golden brown on bottom
11. Turn slices over and bake 10 to 12 minutes more or until golden on both sides and tender
12. Transfer slices to plate
13. Cool
14. Meanwhile , stlr cream cheese in small bowl until smooth
15. Add sour cream , green onion , tomatoes , garlic , oregano and pepper
16. Stir until blended
17. Place eggplant slices on work surface
18. Spread about 1 teaspoon cream cheese mixture evenly over each slice
19. Arrange spinach leaves on to leavign 1 / 2 inch boarder
20. Roll up , beginning at narrower end
21. Aly rolls seam side down on servign platter
22. Serve with warn spaghetti sauce

title: citrus infused strawberries
steps:
1. Combine strawberries , sugar , grand marnier and lemon juice in a medium bowl
2. Let stand , stirring once or twice , until the strawberries release their juice , about 10 minutes
3. Serve with a dollop of lightly sweetened whipped cream

title: potato soup with green chilies and cheese
steps:
1. Heat oil in 3-quart pan over medim heat
2. Add onion and garlic
3. Cook until onion is tender
4. Stir in potatoes
5. Cook one minute
6. Stir in flour
7. Continue cooking1 minute
8. Stir in broth
9. Bring to boil , stirring constantly
10. Cover
11. Reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes or until potatoes are tender
12. Stir in milk , chilies and celery salt
13. Heat to simmering
14. Add cheeses
15. Stir and heat just until cheese melts
16. Do not boil
17. Add pepper to taste
18. Serve hot
19. Garnish with celery leaves

title: couscous with tomato and garlic
steps:
1. In small pot , melt the butter and saute the garlic until fragrant
2. Add stock and bring to a boil
3. Add couscous and stir
4. Take off the heat and let stand 10 minutes
5. Fluff with fork and then combine with the tomato along with the pine nuts
6. Season with salt and pepper to taste

title: pomegranate   orange ham
steps:
1. Spray crockpot with nonstick spray
2. Place all ingredients in crockpot
3. Cook on low for 4-6 hours

title: leftover mashed potato roll ups
steps:
1. Let your leftover mashed potatoes cool , then roll into small balls about the size of a quarter , sprinkle the outside with seasonings of your choice
2. I like to add cyenne pepper for a little kick !
3. Place on baking sheet sprayed with cooking oil
4. Bake 325 degrees for about 25 minutes or until golden brown
5. I use sides of ranch dressing or sour cream to go with them !
6. You can be as creative as you want- i have molded the potatoes around a small piece of cheese
7. If you like it hot then use a small chunk of jalapano or habanero pepper !

title: chocolate cheese fudge
steps:
1. Spray lightly the bottom of a 9 by 2-inch square pan with a nonstick spray
2. In a saucepan over medium heat , melt the cheese and butter together , stirring constantly until smooth
3. Remove from the heat and add the vanilla and nuts
4. In a large bowl sift together the sugar and cocoa
5. Pour the cheese mixture into the sugar and cocoa mixture and stir until completely mixed
6. The candy will be very stiff
7. Using your hands , remove candy from bowl and press evenly and firmly into pan
8. Because of the amount of butter in this recipe , pat the top of the candy with a paper towel to remove the excess oil
9. Place pan in refrigerator until candy is firm
10. To serve candy , cut into squares
11. Enjoy !

title: panna cotta with fresh berries and chocolate sauce
steps:
1. Place the milk in a small bowl
2. Sprinkle the gelatin over
3. Let stand for 3 to 5 minutes to soften the gelatin
4. Pour milk mixture into a heavy saucepan and stir over medium heat just until the gelatin dissolves but the milk does not boil , about 5 minutes
5. Add the cream , honey , sugar , and salt
6. Stir until the sugar dissolves , 5 to 7 minutes
7. Remove from the heat
8. Pour into 6 wine glasses so that they are 1 / 2 full
9. Cool slightly
10. Refrigerate until set , at least 6 hours
11. For the sauce:
12. Combine the cream and butter in a small heavy-bottomed saucepan over medium heat
13. Heat the mixture until bubbles appear around the sides of the pot , but do not allow the cream to boil
14. Mix in the chocolate and vanilla
15. Remove from the heat and stir until the chocolate melts and the sauce is smooth
16. May be made ahead of time and rewarmed over low heat on the stovetop , or in the microwave on medium power
17. Spoon berries atop the panna cotta , drizzle generously with chocolate sauce
18. Top with more berries and a decorative drizzling of sauce , and serve

title: champion chicken parmesan
steps:
1. To prepare tomato sauce , combine sun-dried tomatoes and water in a bowl
2. Cover and let stand 30 minutes or until soft
3. Drain and finely chop tomatoes
4. Heat 1 teaspoon olive oil in a large saucepan over medium-high heat
5. Add sun-dried tomatoes , bell pepper , and onion
6. Saut 7 minutes
7. Stir in canned tomatoes
8. Bring to a boil
9. Cover , reduce heat , and simmer for 10 minutes
10. Remove from heat
11. Stir in parsley , basil , vinegar , 1 / 4 teaspoon black pepper , and garlic
12. Preheat oven to 350
13. To prepare chicken , lightly spoon flour into a dry measuring cup
14. Level with a knife
15. Combine flour , parmesan , and 1 / 4 teaspoon black pepper in a shallow dish
16. Place each breast half between 2 sheets of heavy-duty plastic wrap
17. Flatten to 1 / 4-inch thickness using a meat mallet or rolling pin
18. Dip each breast half in egg white
19. Dredge in flour mixture
20. Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
21. Add chicken
22. Cook 5 minutes on each side or until golden
23. Arrange in a 13 x 9-inch baking dish coated with cooking spray
24. Pour the tomato sauce over the chicken
25. Sprinkle with mozzarella
26. Bake at 350 for 15 minutes
27. Serve over linguine

title: crock pot orange curry chicken with sweet potato pilaf
steps:
1. Toss together all the pilaf ingredients except the chicken stock
2. Spread the pilaf in the bottom of a 6 qt , oval crock pot
3. Stuff the chicken cavities with 4 orange chunks and 2 onion quarters
4. Place the chickens into the crock pot on top of the pilaf
5. Sprinkle each chicken with a pinch of celery seed , a pinch of cumin , and 1 / 2tsp of curry powder
6. Pour the chicken stock into the pot , being careful to not wash the seasoning off the chicken
7. Since the crock pot will be very full , cook for 3-4 hours on high to get the middle heated quickly then turn down to low for another 4-5 hours

title: cheesy shells with chicken
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees f
2. Butter a 2-quart casserole dish
3. Cook the shells in a pot of boiling salted water until just al dente drain and place in a large bowl , toss with a tablespoon of butter to prevent sticking
4. In a large skillet melt 3 tablespoon butter
5. Add in the green onions , bell pepper and basil , saute for about 7-8 minutes , adding in the garlic the last 2 minutes of cooking
6. Add in the flour and half and half cream , whisking constantly until the mixture is smooth
7. Add in cream cheese
8. Cook over medium heat , whisking constantly for about 5 minutes or until the mixture thickens
9. Add in shredded cheddar and hot sauce
10. Stir until the cheese has melted , then season with salt and pepper
11. Pour the mixture into the bowl with the cooked shells , add in the cooked chicken
12. Toss to combine
13. Transfer to prepared baking dish
14. Sprinkle with crushed crackers
15. Bake for about 30-35 minutes or until hot and bubbly

title: crock pot mexican turkey
steps:
1. Place turkey thighs in crock pot
2. Add tomato sauce , chilies , onion , garlic , worcestershire , chili powder , salt and pepper to taste
3. Cover and cook on low for 10-12 hours
4. Remove turkey from crock pot , shred meat and discard the bones
5. Return the meat to the pot and stir to mix sauce and meat thoroughly
6. Spoon meat and sauce into a tortilla and garnish with the tomatoes , lettuce , lettuce and salsa

title: pumpkin seed   yam pater
steps:
1. Its super simple : just trow all the ingredients in the food processor , except the last two
2. Blend it until smooth
3. Oil a loaf pan or a pie dish
4. Scoop the mixture and spread it evenly
5. Then sprinkle it with the rosemary and sesame seeds
6. Place it in a preheated oven 350 f and cook it for 40 minutes

title: ila s salad with lemon garlic dressing
steps:
1. To make the dressing: mince garlic and mash to a paste with salt
2. In a bowl whisk together garlic paste , lemon juice , vinegar , zest , and pepper and whisk in oil until emulsified
3. To make the salad: cut 1-inch florets from broccoli , reserving remainder for another use
4. Separate romaine into leaves
5. (broccoli and romaine may be prepared 1 day
6. Ahead and chilled in airtight containers
7. )
8. Have ready a large bowl of ice and cold water
9. In a large saucepan of boiling salted water cook broccoli until crisp-tender , about 3 minutes , and drain in a colander
10. Plunge broccoli into ice water to stop cooking and drain well
11. Peel carrots and finely shred with a mandolin or other manual slicer or in a food processor
12. Halve onion lengthwise and slice very thin crosswise
13. Arrange vegetables and anchovies decoratively on platters and in serving bowls sprinkling with swiss cheese and pour dressing into a cruet

title: summer blackberry cobbler
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 375
2. Toss berries with sugar , tapioca , lime juice , and salt in a bowl
3. Spoon into a 2-qt
4. Baking dish
5. Combine flour , coconut , sugar , pecans , baking powder , and salt in a second bowl
6. Using your finger
7. Mixture should look like coarse sand
8. Blend in the egg , then arrange topping over the berries in clumps , covering them evenly
9. Bake the cobbler for 45-50 minutes , or until topping is golden and crisp , and filling is thick and bubbly
10. Cool on a rack for at least 1 hour before serving
11. Serve with crme anglaise
12. Recipe #53511

title: al capone roast
steps:
1. Brown sausage and slice in finger sized pieces
2. Slice 1 pepper , 1 / 2 of onion and cheese into finger sized pieces
3. Place all on top of long end of steak
4. Slice 1 / 2 of mushrooms and mince garlic and place on top of previous items
5. Salt and pepper to taste
6. Heat oil into 13x9 baking dish
7. Roll up jelly roll fashion and secure with toothpicks
8. Slice remaining pepper , onion , mushrooms and place around steak in the pan
9. Sear in 450 oven turning occasionally for 1 / 2 hour
10. Mix paste and water together , and pour over steak
11. Reduce heat to 400 and cook for 45-60 minutes til done
12. Remove toothpicks and slice

title: crab   lemon spaghetti
steps:
1. Bring a large pan of salted water to the boil , feed in the spaghetti and cook for the time it says on the pack , stirring a couple of times to stop it sticking
2. Peel and finely chop the garlic
3. Finely chop the chili
4. Roughly chop the parsley
5. Open the can of crab meat and
6. Drain well
7. Heat 2 tbsp of the oil in a large frying pan , add the garlic and chili and fry for 1 minute
8. Drain the pasta , return it to the pan and
9. Toss everything together and serve

title: better than a candy bar cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Mix cake mix and butter with a fork until crumbly
3. Pat into a greased 9x13 inch baking pan
4. Layer the remaining ingredients in order listed
5. Bake for 20-30 minutes , or until top is lightly browned

title: badami qorma
steps:
1. Heat oil , fry onions till golden brown , remove wtih slotted spoon and set aside
2. Heat oil and add whole masalas except cinnamon
3. Stir fry till fragnant and crackling
4. Add 1 cup water in which you've added all the other masalas and the ginger and garlic
5. Stir fry 1-2 minutes
6. Add in chicken pieces and fry well on high heat till chicken is white
7. Add in the cinnamon stick and fry a little more
8. Lower heat , cover and let the chicken cook in its own water till its begun to soften
9. Meanwhile , blend the yogurt with the fried onions and a tsp of cumin powder
10. Add the yogurt mixture to the chicken , stir well till all the chicken is coated and cover and cook till chicken is completely done
11. Stir in ginger , nutmeg and garam masala
12. Cover and turn off heat after 10 minutes
13. Stir in almonds for garnish before serving
14. Serve hot with naans

title: barb s zucchini pancakes
steps:
1. Grate zucchini
2. Chop onion , add to zucchini
3. Add beaten eggs , bisquick , parmesan cheese , garlic powder , salt and pepper
4. Mix well
5. Fry as pancakes on hot greased griddle or skillet
6. Serve as a side dish

title: orange spiced pork chops
steps:
1. In a large skillet , heat oil on medium heat and brown pork chops briefly on both sides
2. Do not overcook at this point or they will get tough !
3. Pour oranges on top and sprinkle with cloves and some black pepper & salt to taste
4. Cover and simmer over low heat until pork chops are cooked through
5. Cooking time will vary depending upon the size and meatiness of your chops- check early for doneness
6. Variation: you may substitute a different spice & fruit combo such as canned peach slices with allspice , apricots with nutmeg , pineapple with cloves
7. You may also substitute skinless boneless chicken breasts for the pork , but the cooking time may be less as chicken dries out quickly

title: no fail pie crust
steps:
1. In a large bowl , stir together the flour , sugar and salt with a fork
2. Cut in the shortening with a fork until crumbly
3. In a small bowl , beat together the water , vinegar and egg
4. Add to the flour mixture
5. Stir until all ingredients are moistened
6. Divide dough into 5 portions and , with hands , shape each into a flat round patty ready for rolling
7. Wrap each patty in plastic or waxed paper and chill at least 1 / 2 hour
8. When you are ready to use the pie crust , lightly flour both sides of the patty and roll out on a lightly floured board or pastry cloth
9. Keeping the pastry round , roll , from the center , to a 1 / 8-inch thickness into a circle 2 inches larger than the top of the pie pan
10. Fold in halves or quarters , transfer to the pie pan , unfold and fit in loosely
11. Press with fingers to remove air pockets
12. Fill the crust
13. Place the other crust on top
14. Flute edges with a fork and place decorative slits in top of crust to allow steam to escape
15. Bake as directed in the pie recipe you are following
16. Bake pie on the lowest rack in oven to prevent bottom crust becoming soggy
17. For a pre-baked unfilled pie shell:
18. Prick the bottom and sides of a pastry lined pie pan with a fork
19. Bake on the center rack in a preheated 450 degree fahrenheit oven 12 to 15 minutes , or until golden brown
20. Cool on a wire rack
21. Fill as desired

title: bbq bananas
steps:
1. Cut 4 large rectangles of baking foil , peel the bananas and lay one on each piece of foil
2. Stab them carefully in several places with a small toothpick
3. Mix together rum , sugar , orange juice and cinnamon , add to each parcel and place 1 / 4 of the butter on top of the banana in each parcel
4. Carefully join up the long sides of the foil over the banana and fold over several times to seal , then fold up the short ends of the foil so that the liquid can not escape during cooking
5. Place the parcels on the bbq and grill for 15 minutes , turning them over once after 7 minutes
6. Open the parcels carefully and transfer to serving dishes , pour over liquid that is left in the foil , decorate with orange slices and serve with whipped cream or icecream

title: bay scallops with lemon and dill
steps:
1. Melt butter in skillet over medium heat
2. Add scallops and cook until almost opaque , about 2 minutes
3. Remove scallops from skillet with a slotted spoon
4. Leaving liquid in skillet
5. Add vermouth , lemon juice , and lemon peel to skillet and reduce to a thick glaze
6. Return scallops to skillet and stir until coated
7. Add dill and pepper and serve immediately

title: pollo barcelona  barcelona style chicken
steps:
1. Heat oil and butter in a deep skillet and brown chicken
2. Remove chicken and set aside
3. Add flour to the drippings in the pan
4. Blend well
5. Pour in broth and wine
6. Cook , stirring , until mixture boils and thickens
7. Add olives , mushrooms , onions , salt and pepper
8. Return chicken to pan
9. Cover and simmer for 45 minutes , or until chicken is tender , turning meat occasionally

title: favorite vegan chili
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large skillet
2. Add garlic , cook 30 sec
3. Add mince meat substitution and marmite
4. Add remaining ingredients
5. Let simmer 1 - 1-1 / 2 hours , stirring occasionally
6. Add some water , if it gets too dry
7. Taste , add more spices if you like
8. Serve over rice , bulgur wheat , with cornbread or in tortillas with guacamole , vegan sour cream , salad etc

title: stacie s ultimate caesar
steps:
1. Pour celery salt onto a small plate , and put lemon or lime juice around the rim of your glass
2. Dunk the top of the glass into the celery salt to rim it
3. Add ice to glass , along with vodka , worcestershire , frank's , lemon / lime juice , and pickle juice
4. Add clamato juice just below the top of the glass and stir until well combined
5. Garnish with a pickle spear , pickled bean or asparagus , and enjoy !
6. You can add more or less hot sauce as desired
7. To make a pitch , quadruple the recipe

title: melanie s cheese  onion and cornbread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Heat oil in skillet over medium heat
3. Add onions and cook till tender
4. In a large bowl , combine milk , biscuit mix , stirring until moistened
5. Fold in onion , corn and 3 / 4 cup cheese
6. Spoon dough into pie pan or round casserole dish
7. Mix melted butter and onion salt and drizzle over mixture
8. Sprinkle scallions over top
9. Bake for 15 minutes
10. Add remaining 3 / 4 cup cheese to top and bake 5 minute more
11. Cut into wedges and serve

title: sweet  n spicy grilled chicken breasts
steps:
1. Preheat an indoor or outdoor grill to high
2. In a large baggie , combine the grill seasoning , chili powder , paprika and brown sugar
3. Place the chicken breasts in the baggie and give them a good shimmy shake
4. Spray or oil down your grill then place the chicken on it and cook for 6-7 minutes on each side , until cooked through

title: candied walnut salad
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. In a small bowl combine butter and brown sugar
3. Microwave on high 30 seconds or until butter and sugar have dissolved
4. Toss walnuts in the butter / sugar mix
5. Spread on a cookie sheet and bake 15-20 minutes or until beginning to brown
6. In salad bowl , make the dressing by combining vinegar , oil , and mustard
7. Gently toss greens in dressing
8. Allow walnuts to cool 10-15 minutes , then toss with greens
9. Serve and enjoy !

title: chili for frito pie
steps:
1. Brown the ground beef in a large pot over medium heat
2. Drain off the fat
3. Crumble the cooked beef into small pieces add all remaining ingredients , bring to a boil , lower the heat and simmer for 2 to 3 hrs stirring every 15 minutes
4. Serving size 3 / 4 cup

title: crabmeat dewey
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f butter 6 2-cup ramekins
2. In a large skillet , melt the butter over moderate heat , add mushrooms , bell pepper , and scallions
3. Cook , stirring frequently , for 3 minutes
4. Add the sherry and simmer until reduced by half , about 5 minutes
5. Add the pimentos and half and half , season with salt and pepper , and bring to an almost full boil
6. Add the crabmeat , reduce heat to low , and stir until well blended
7. Scrape into ramekins and sprinkle cheese over tops
8. Bake until lightly browned , about 15-20 minutes

title: milk chocolate pound cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Spray a 12 cup bundt pan or a tube pan with non-stick spray containing flour
3. Break milk chocolate bars into pieces
4. Chop chocolate pieces into small bits - some may be large
5. Combine cake mix , pudding mix , sour cream , oil , eggs , and vanilla in a large bowl
6. Beat with mixer on low speed for 1 minute
7. Fold in chocolate bits
8. Pour batter into prepared pan
9. Smooth out with spatula
10. Bake in pre-heated 350 degree oven for 55 to 60 minutes or until cake is lightly browned and cake springs back when lightly pressed
11. Allow cake to cool 20 minutes
12. Place cake on a serving platter and sift powdered sugar over the top

title: indian seer fish fry
steps:
1. Clean the fish and set aside
2. Make a fine paste with the ingredients turmeric powder , red chilli powder , ginger-garlic paste , black pepper powder , lemon juice and salt to taste
3. Rub the paste on both sides of the fish
4. Marinate the same for half an hour
5. Heat oil in frying pan , add the marinated fish pieces to pan and fry for 4 min in simmer
6. Fry both side of fishes pieces until golden brown
7. Serve hot with sprinkled lemon juice and sliced onion

title: lasagna with fresh salmon and mascarpone
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 200c
2. Heat a large fry pan with a lid and add the oil and then add in all the vegetables and cook for a couple of minutes and then push the vegetables to the side of the pan and lightly fry the salmon a a couple of minutes and then pour in the stock and cover the pan with a lid and bring the pan to a light simmer and cook for 3 to 4 minutes or until the salmon is just cooked through
3. Remove the salmon onto a plate and let the vegetables continue cooking until they are very soft and most of the liquid has been absorbed , smash the vegetables with a fork until finely diced
4. Break up all the salmon flesh and mix with the vegetables
5. Whisk the mascarpone cheese with the egg yolks , the egg and season well with salt and pepper and then add the lemon zest and parmesan - this should make a slightly thick paste
6. Before you start layering the lasagna , put one spoon of the fish stock or keep some of the juice that you get from cooking the fish or make extra vegetable juice for this , into the bottom of the dish to make the lasagna moist
7. Layer the lasagna sheets with the vegetables , salmon and mascarpone mix and keep on doing this till all the mixture in used , put some vegetable of fish liquid over the top
8. This lasagna should not be too high , just 3 layers , it should be an elegant not a bulky dish
9. Sprinkle extra parmesan cheese on the top
10. Place dish in the oven and bake lasagna to warm through about 12 to 15 minutes

title: garden turkey sandwich with lemon mayo
steps:
1. Stir lemon peel into mayonaisse
2. Spread on both slices of bread
3. Layer half of spinach leaves , turkey , tomato slices , and remaining spinach leaves on one slice of bread
4. Top with second slice of bread

title: wild mushroom   onion manicotti with an asiago sauce
steps:
1. Filling -- in a large saute pan add the butter and olive oil and add the garlic and onions , and cook 3-4 minutes until they begin to brown
2. Then add the mushrooms and cook until everything is tender and golden brown
3. Season with the rosemary , thyme , salt and pepper and cook about 5 minutes until everything is combined and the vegetables are nice and soft
4. Remove and let cool
5. Pasta -- as the mushrooms cooks , bring a pot of salted water up to a boil and cook the manicotti according to directions
6. Drain and set on a cookie sheet to cool
7. I spray the cookie sheet with pam or any non stick so they don't stick
8. Filling part ii -- now after the mushrooms have cooled , add to the ricotta cheese and the mozarella
9. Mix well and then stuff the manicotti and set to the side as you prepare the sauce
10. Sauce -- in a medium pot , melt the butter on medium heat and add the flour and mix well to combine
11. Slowly whisk in the milk and bring to a medium boil to let the sauce thicken
12. Add a little salt , pepper and a pinch of nutmeg
13. Once thickened , add the cheese and parsley and simmer just until melted
14. Casserole -- add 1 cup of the sauce to the bottom of a casserole dish lightly sprayed with pam or any non stick spray
15. Then add the manicotti
16. Top with the remaining cheese sauce making sure to cover each manicotti
17. Top with the remaining parmesan
18. Bake -- 350 for 20-30 covered for then uncovered for another 10-20 minutes until bubbly and golden brown
19. Make sure to let it set 5 minutes before serving
20. A rich dish deserves a nice fresh crisp salad to go along the side
21. My secret salad
22. You know that jar of marinated vegetables next to the pickles and olives in the condiments aisle
23. Add a jar of that to some fresh romaine , add some fresh grape tomatoes and you have a great quick salad
24. You can even add some extra black or kalamata olive if you want
25. The vinegar and oil in the jar makes a great quick 2 minute salad
26. I usually add all the vegetables and about 1 / 2 of the liquid - nothing else
27. Just toss and enjoy

title: parmesan polenta with eggs and roasted mushrooms
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 475
2. Slice the mushrooms in half
3. Toss mushrooms with oil , pepper flakes , and salt on a baking sheet
4. Spread in single layer and roast until browned for 10 minutes
5. Meanwhile , whisk polenta , milk , water , and salt together in saucepan , cover and bring to a boil over medium heat
6. After reaching a boil , turn heat to low and let sit with lid cracked for 15 minutes
7. While polenta is cooking , heat nonstick skillet over medium heat and crack the eggs carefully into the pan
8. Cook about a minute and then add a few tablespoons of water to the skillet
9. Water will sizzle - cover so the yolks steam and set to your liking
10. We don't like runny eggs , so i cooked them for a full three minutes
11. Stir parmesan into polenta , plate on a dish , spoon mushrooms over and top with egg
12. Sprinkle with freshly ground black pepper and garnish with snipped chives
13. Eat and enjoy !

title: deer mash
steps:
1. Mix creole and slap ya mama seasoning in 1 gallon ziplock
2. Add venison and shake , make sure meat is completely covered
3. Set aside and let meat marinate
4. Chop onion and carrots
5. Add onion , carrots , soup , and rice to pressure cooker
6. Add 2-3 tablespoons of olive oil to large skillet and bring to heat
7. Add venison to skillet and sear , do not cook throughly , brown only
8. Add contents of skillet to pressure cooker
9. Cook on high for 15 minutes

title: green heaven in a pot
steps:
1. Cook artichoke hearts as directed on the label
2. Drain and dice
3. Wash green onions and cut fine , including tops
4. Divide artichokes and onions among 4 small ramekins
5. Break an egg into each
6. Pour cream over eggs , season with salt and pepper to taste , and sprinkle with cheese
7. Bake in preheated 350f
8. Oven for 45 minutes , or until eggs are of desired doneness
9. Makes 4 servings
10. Enjoy !

title: braccioli
steps:
1. Place parsley , garlic , bread crumbs , cheese , onion , hard cooked eggs , bacon , salt , pepper , and oregano in a bowl and mix thoroughly
2. Lay the steak flat on the counter
3. Spread mixed ingredients on top of steak
4. Fold edges in and roll
5. Tie securely with string
6. Dip rolled and tied steak in beaten egg then in flour
7. Heat oil in skillet and saute on all sides until golden brown
8. Place in a roasting pan
9. Add water and roast in a 350 degree oven for 45 minutes
10. Cut into 1& 1 / 2 inch slices and serve as is , or pour spaghetti sauce over the steak , if desired

title: slow cooker peach butter
steps:
1. Add the peaches and water to a blender
2. Process until smooth
3. Transfer mixture to a slow cooker
4. Stir in the brown sugar
5. Cover and cook on low for 4-6 hours
6. Remove the lid and stir in the lemon juice , ginger , and cloves
7. Allow to cool , uncovered
8. Taste to adjust the flavorings
9. Once cool , the peach butter may be stored in the refrigerator in containers with tight fitting lids
10. It will keep for several weeks

title: fried lemon pepper chicken
steps:
1. Put your chicken breasts in a pan and liberally coat with lemon pepper seasoning and put in the refrigerator overnight , or 5-8 hours prior to cooking , depending on how strong you want the flavor to be
2. Remove from refrigerator and coat the chicken in flour
3. Fill large frying pan with enough vegetable oil so that it covers the chicken breasts halfway
4. Put it on medium-high heat
5. Place chicken breasts in the oil and let it fry , uncovered , for 20 minutes
6. After 20 minutes , flip the chicken breasts and let sit for another 20 minutes , or until fully fried
7. Enjoy !

title: baby beans with orange crumble
steps:
1. Cook the frozen baby beans according to the packet directions
2. While the beans are cooking , heat the butter and oil in a pan
3. Stir in the breadcrumbs , orange zest and almonds
4. And cook until the breadcrumbs are golden brown and crunchy
5. Drain the beans well
6. Stir the garlic butter into the breadcrumbs mixture , and allow it to melt
7. And carefully toss the contents of the pan so that the ingredients are all well-combined
8. Serve the beans topped with the breadcrumbs mixture

title: so easy cream cheesy dip
steps:
1. Strain water from salsa
2. Soften cream cheese in bowl
3. Mix in the sour cream with a wooden spoon
4. Spread onto your favorite platter or a 9x13 pan
5. Layer salsa and cheese on top

title: light pecan chicken
steps:
1. Sprinkle chicken with salt and pepper
2. Place in a greased 13x9" baking dish
3. Combine butter and the 4 tablespoons of mustard
4. Stir well
5. Pour over chicken
6. Sprinkle pecans over top
7. Bake , uncovered , at 375 for 35 minutes or until chicken is done
8. Remove chicken to a serving platter , reserving drippings in dish
9. Keep warm
10. Combine remaining 1 tablespoons mustard , pan drippings , and sour cream in a large saucepan
11. Cook over medium heat until thoroughly heated , stirring often
12. To serve , pour sauce over chicken

title: stewed chicken with red wine and olives
steps:
1. In a dutch oven heat oil over medium high heat
2. Add onions and garlic and saute , stirring , until softened , about 3 to 4 minutes
3. Add bell pepper cook 1 minute longer
4. Add chicken and cook , stirring occasionally , about 10 minutes until chicken is no longer pink
5. Add red wine , orange juice , and olives and simmer over low heat about 30 minutes
6. In a small bowl mix about 1 / 2 cup of liquid from the pot into flour , forming a paste
7. Add mixture to pot and simmer 10 minutes
8. Sauce will thicken as it simmers
9. Stir occasionally

title: edmonds scones
steps:
1. Sift flour , baking powder and salt into a bowl
2. Cut butter in until it resembles fine breadcrumbs
3. Add milk and mix quickly with a knife to a soft dough
4. Knead a few times
5. Lightly dust an oven tray with flour
6. Press scone dough out onto this
7. Cut into 12 even-sized pieces
8. Leave a 2 cm space between scones
9. Brush tops with milk
10. Bake at 220c for 10 minutes or until golden brown

title: mini pizzas with prosciutto salad topping
steps:
1. Dough - put flours , yeast and sugar in a medium bowl and stir well and add the lukewarm water and oil and using a flat bladed knife mix until the dough starts to come together to form a ball
2. Turn out dough onto a lightly floured surface and knead for 10 minutes or until dough is smooth and elastic
3. Spray a medium bowl with cooking spray and add dough and cover with plastic wrap and clean , dry tea towel and set aside in a warm , draught free place for 45 minutes
4. Preheat oven to 190c and spray 2 large baking trays with cooking spray
5. Divide dough into 8 equal portions and roll out into thin rounds and then place on the baking tray
6. Combine tomato paste and garlic in a small bowl and spread over pizza bases and then bake for 10 minutes or until crisp around the edges and still soft in the centre
7. Meanwhile , heat oil in a large non stick frying pan on medium and add prosciutto and cook on each side for 1 to 2 minutes or until crisp
8. Transfer to a small plate and set aside to cool and then break into pieces
9. Toss rocket , spinach , tomato , capsicum , cucumber and prosciutto in a large bowl
10. Arrange the salad over each pizza base and top with the bocconcini and sprinkle with pepper to serve

title: 32k caramel cake
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degres f
2. Spray two 8" round pans throughly with cooking spray
3. Sift the flour , baking powder and salt together and set aside
4. Melt the 3 / 4 cup butter and 10 caramels , until liquid and integrated
5. I usually do this in the microwave but it can be done stovetop
6. Do not burn
7. Mix the brown sugar and the caramel butter mixture with an electric mixer until well integrated
8. Add the eggs one at a time and beat well , until smooth and lighter in colour
9. Mix in the flour mixture until blended and then beat at high speed for three or four minutes until batter is smooth and light in colour
10. Mix in the carrots and pecans until well blended and spread evenly between the two cake pans
11. Bake for about 30 minutes until browned and just pulling away from the sides of the pan
12. Cool cakes on racks
13. Melt 1 / 4 cup butter , 3 tablespoons brown sugar and 15 caramels until smooth mix the melted caramels with the icing sugar and 3 tablespoons milk with an electric mixer until smooth
14. If required add an extra tablespoon milk to reach a good consistency for the icing
15. Spread icing on top of one cake layer , top with the other layer and cover sides and top evenly with the remaining icing
16. Melt the butterscotch and chocolate chips together stir well until smooth
17. Spread a thin layer of chocolate mixture over the top of the cake

title: basil baked tilapia
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450
2. Pour wine and butter into glass measuring cup and microwave on high until butter begins to melt , about 1 minute
3. Spread basil leaves over bottom of 9 x 13 glass baking dish , reserving a few large ones for the top of the fish
4. Place fillets over the remaining basil
5. Remove the wine mixture from the microwave and add fresh lemon juice
6. Stir or whisk the wine mixture and pour over the fish
7. Season the fish with the salt and pepper
8. Sprinkle the onion powder and bread crumbs evenly over the fish , then add paprika
9. Cover the pan with aluminum foil , place in lower third of preheated oven , for 12 minutes
10. Uncover fish and continue to cook until fish is opaque and flakes easily with a fork , about 2-3 more minutes
11. Serve at once

title: creamy cucumber dip   weight watchers
steps:
1. In a medicum bowl , stir together yogurt mayonnaise , salt , cumin and cayenne pepper until smooth
2. Add cucumber , onion , mint and dill
3. Stir to mix
4. Refrigerate for about an hour
5. Enjoy

title: oriental chicken oamc
steps:
1. Melt margarine in a medium saucepan over low heat
2. Add flour and continue to stir over medium heat until bubbly
3. Add broth , water , soy sauce , garlic powder , chicken , and pepper
4. Simmer for 5 minutes
5. Cool and freeze in a 1-gallon freezer bag
6. To prepare for serving , thaw chicken
7. Heat in a pan until bubbly
8. Serve over chow mein noodles

title: fast  microwaved  pan  fried  potatoes
steps:
1. Wash and cube potato
2. Place in microwave and microwave for 4 minutes
3. Heat oil and butter over medium high heat
4. Add potatoes and fry until crispy
5. Add optional seasonings
6. Stir to combine
7. Enjoy !

title: lebanese kibbeh in a tray
steps:
1. Select lamb from loin of the animal
2. Pound the cubed meat with a teaspoon of salt in a stone mortar with a wooden mallet
3. Remove meat from mortar when it becomes pasty
4. Now pound onion with a teaspoon of salt and the pepper until it is reduced to a pulp
5. Combine meat and onion and pound together until very smooth
6. Wash bulghur well in running water but do this quickly so that it does not soften
7. Press to remove water
8. Knead bulghur and meat with the hands
9. Pound together in mortar
10. Add salt to taste
11. Dip mallet in ice water occasionally to keep meat moist and smooth
12. Properly prepared kibbeh must be pounded at least an hour
13. Then it is ready to be eaten as it is , or cooked in a variety of ways
14. Preparation time may be shortened considerably by grinding meat several times through fine blade of meat grinder
15. Grind onion twice
16. Grind onions with meat once
17. Combine washed bulghur with meat-onion mixture
18. Knead well , seasoning with salt and pepper
19. Grind this mixture three times adding a tablespoon of ice water to keep it smooth
20. To make stuffing: heat fat
21. Fry chopped onions in it until soft
22. Add meat and fry until lightly browned
23. Add pine nuts and continue frying until they are slightly browned and the meat has lost its pink color entirely
24. Season with salt , pepper and cinnamon
25. Pour off excess fat
26. To make kibbeh in a tray: grease a shallow 12 x 18 inch baking pan
27. Pat a layer of basic kibbeh smoothly and firmly over the bottom of the pan to the depth of one inch
28. Cover this evenly with with a layer of stuffing
29. Top with a second layer of kibbeh slightly thicker than the first
30. Score into diamond shapes with a sharp knife
31. Pour one cup melted samneh or butter over all
32. Bake in moderate oven about 20 minutes , or until well browned
33. Serve hot or cold

title: black beans with mango sauce
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a medium sized skillet
2. Add 1 cups of the onion , and the garlic , chili , ginger , cumin and salt
3. Saut over medium-high heat for about 3 minutes
4. Turn the heat down to medium-low , and add the black beans and about half the lime juice
5. Saut for about 5 more minutes , or until everything has mingled nicely , and the beans are heated through
6. Mash the beans slightly with the back of a spoon , and transfer to a bowl
7. Stir the remaining lime juice and about half of the chopped mangoes directly into the hot beans , mashing the mangoes a little as you stir
8. Add the black pepper , then cover and let stand for about 15 minutes to let the sauce develop
9. Serve warm , at room temperature or even cold , topped with the remaining red onion and mango , and some minced cilantro , if desired

title: kielbasa with sauerkraut  carrots  white beans and dill
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large skillet
2. Add kielbasa and brown over high heat
3. Add carrots and water , bring to a boil , cover , reduce heat to low and simmer for 5 minutes
4. Add sauerkraut , beans and dill
5. Bring to a boil , cover , reduce heat to low and simmer 30 minutes

title: healthy banana milkshake
steps:
1. Blend first 4 ingredients until smooth
2. Sweeten to taste

title: greens and bean with sausage
steps:
1. Clean and separate escarole
2. Gently simmer in water until leaves are wilted
3. Drain
4. Saute garlic in hot oil about 30 seconds
5. Add escarole , turning frequently to coat with garlic and oil
6. Add cannelini beans , sausage , salt and pepper , and red pepper
7. Simmer gently until heated through
8. Serve in soup bowls , and pass the parmesan

title: pierogies  outstanding
steps:
1. Filling:
2. Shred the cheese and set aside
3. Peel , cube and cook until tender the 8 potatoes
4. Drain
5. Place half the potatoes in a mixing bowl add the shredded cheese and top with the remaining potatoes
6. Beat well , tasting if the seasoning seems correct for your taste
7. Let cool
8. The filling may be made the day before
9. Let cool completely before covering otherwise it may sweat and make the potatoes a little watery
10. Dough:
11. In a food processor bowl place all the ingredients starting first with the flour
12. Let process until all the dough comes into a ball and the sides of the processor are clean
13. Shape into a flat disc using flour is a little sticky
14. Wrap in plastic wrap and let rest 30 minutes
15. Flour your working area and roll the dough fairly thin
16. Just to give you an idea , you should get approximately 38 to 40 pierogies out of this recipe
17. Cut the dough into a circle using a top from a wide mouth canning jar or anything which is about that size
18. Wet the one side of each circle and place a walnut sized portion of potato mixture onto the center
19. Fold over and pinch well
20. Set each pierogie on a parchment lined cookie sheet separated from each other
21. Continue to use up all the dough
22. Bring a 5 quart pot to a boil
23. Using a wooden spoon keep stirring the water as you place each pierogi in to cook
24. Cook only about 10 at a time
25. Let them surface and continue to cook for about 2 minutes
26. Have a large bowl of cold water on hand
27. Remove the pierogies and place them in the cold water for several minutes
28. Drain each one well so no water remains on them and roll them in some vegetable or canola oil shaking off the excess oil
29. This is needed so that they won't stick together
30. You may use quart sized ziploc bags to bag about 10
31. Lay them place on a cookie sheet and at this point they may be frozen until ready for use
32. When preparing about 10 or 12:
33. I wouldn't put any more in one fry pan
34. Using a large coated fry pan , melt 1 / 2 to 1 stick butter or margarine
35. Add 1 cup diced onions and saute until soft and golden but not brown
36. Add about 3 tablespoons of water and lay your unfrozen pierogies on top
37. Cover with lid and on low flame allow them to become soft and puffy
38. Be careful not to cook any faster because the bottoms will get browned
39. When ready to serve pour onto a dinner sized plate
40. It's easier to scoop out than from a bowl
41. Really , these are just the best and i've tried many recipes

title: stuffed zucchini mexicali
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Halve the zucchini lengthwise and scoop out the pulp with a small spoon leaving a 3 / 8-inch-thick shell
3. Pour of the tomato sauce in the bottom of an oven-proof baking dish
4. Place zucchini shells cut side up in the baking dish
5. Place olive oil in a large skillet and heat until hot but not smoking
6. Saut garlic , onion and peppers until softened but not brown
7. Crumble sausage into skillet and brown
8. Drain grease from skillet and combine all remaining ingredients with the cooked vegetables and sausage with the exception of the cheese
9. Fill zucchini shells equally with sausage and vegetable combination , topping each with of the grated cheese place baking dish on the center rack of the oven and bake about thirty minutes until the zucchini is tender
10. Let cool for a few minutes before serving

title: potato soup with smoked sausage
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , melt the butter over low heat being careful not to burn it
2. Add potatoes , celery , carrots and onions and saute until softened
3. Add smoked sausage , corn with juice and water and simmer , covered approximately 30 minutes or until vegetables are tender
4. Add evaporated milk , dill , cayenne pepper and salt and pepper and continue to simmer for about 5 minutes

title: linda s incredibly complicated yet  fantabulous antipasta
steps:
1. The day before: make sure all of your produce is very clean
2. Cut half of the scallions , tops and bottoms , lengthwise to form fringes , leaving the very centers uncut and put them in the ice water
3. Slice the carrots into thin ribbons , lengthwise and roll up into a tight 'coil' , being sure not to break them , and secure with tooth picks
4. Put them into the ice water with the scallions
5. Wrap 24 slices of prosciutto around 24 pieces of sharp provolone
6. Stuff the wrapped cheese into a cherry pepper which has been seeded and put the stuffed peppers back into the pickle brine
7. Line the rim of a very large platter with the romaine lettuce leaves letting them come over the edge of the platter
8. Spread the shredded ice berg lettuce on the platter
9. You will need the shredded lettuce to support the tonno cups
10. Make tonno cups: layer a slice of capicola ham on top of a slice of salami on top of a slice of provolone and make a 'pleat' in the slices , forming a cone or cup shape
11. Secure with a frilled toothpick so no one bites into the tonno cup and gets a nasty surprise
12. Put one tablespoon of tuna into the center of the cup
13. Arrange the 24 cups around the edge of the platter , supporting them with the shredded iceberg lettuce
14. If you intend to use anchovies this would be the time to make a hole in the center of your shredded lettuce so you can put a ramekin in the center to hold those fuzzy little things
15. Use the best you can afford
16. Arrange the stuffed peppers around the platter
17. Stuff the black olives with cream cheese and add them and the green olives to the platter
18. Stuff half of the celery with the remaining cream cheese and arrange them around the platter
19. Score the cucumbers with a fork if you don't have a zester or channel knife
20. Arrange them on the platter
21. Scatter the artichoke hearts and mushrooms around
22. Add the anchovies to the ramekin if you are going to use them
23. Dry your scallions - surprise ! don't they look cute ? - and unfurl your carrots and decorate the platter with them and the tomatoes and the rest of the ingredients as you have room for them
24. Please make this recipe your own by adding what you and your family like
25. It is easy to scale down to individual proportions for small gatherings
26. Pass some italian bread red wine vinegar and extra virgin olive oil and maybe some parmesan shavings
27. Or if you desire you can make a vinaigrette

title: chicken tarragon with leeks
steps:
1. Spray a large skillet with nonstick spray
2. Cook chicken breasts over medium heat , turning once , about 6-7 minutes per side , or until juices run clear
3. Remove the chicken and keep it warm
4. Cook the leeks about 3 minutes on medium to medium high , until crisp tender , stirring often
5. Mix the remaining ingredients and stir into leeks
6. Bring to a boil , stirring on occasion
7. Boil and stir about 1 minute until thickened slightly
8. Add the chicken and heat through

title: yam pineapple salad
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 , wrap potaotes in foil , bake 40-60 min
2. , unwrap , when cool , cut into 3 / 4" chucks , check often as salad is best when potatoes are not cooked till soft
3. In a large bowl mix remaining ingredients , gently stir in potatoes , chill covered about 1 hour
4. Fold in cashews and sprinkle with chives -- enjoy !

title: strawberry yum yum cake
steps:
1. Separate eggs and beat whites till stiff
2. Combine rest of ingredients including egg yolk and beat well
3. Fold in egg whites
4. Grease 3 9 inch cake pans and divide mixture between them
5. Bake 20 to 25 minutes
6. Frosting: cream butter and cream cheese
7. Add sugars , blend well
8. Then add vanilla and fold in cool whip
9. Cut strawberries into slices , reserve some for top
10. When cake is cool , layer with frosting then strawberries
11. Refrigerate cake overnight or it will be a total flop !

title: indian rice pudding with fruit
steps:
1. Heat the milk , condensed milk and honey with cardamom over med heat , stirring constantly so as not to scorch the milk
2. When it is just about at the boiling point , add rice and continue cooking , stirring often , about 45 min until rice is tender and about half the liquid has cooked away
3. Cool and refrigerate until cold
4. To serve , top the pudding with the fruit and garnish with a a couple of mint leaves

title: turmeric chicken
steps:
1. Combine turmeric , cayenne , 2 oz lemon juice , garlic and salt into a marinade , and marinate chicken for 3-4 hours
2. Make a basting sauce of the soy , sugar , oil and 1 oz of lemon juice
3. Grill the chicken until done , turning and brushing with the basting sauce every 5 minutes or so

title: ham  broccoli and cheese souffle
steps:
1. Lightly butter a 9x9 baking pan
2. Line pan with 1 / 2 the bread cubes
3. Mix the cheeses together , reserving 1 / 4 cup for topping , and layer 1 / 2 the cheese on top of the bread
4. Sprinkle the ham and broccoli over the cheese
5. Top with the remaining cheese , then the bread cubes
