6. Mix well the eggs , milk , mustard and seasonings and pour over the bread
7. Top with the 1 / 4 cup cheese
8. Cover with foil and refrigerate overnight if desired
9. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
10. Mix cornflakes and melted butter and spread on top of casserole
11. Bake 25 minutes covered , then uncover and bake 10-15 minutes more

title: extra healthy black bean burgers
steps:
1. Combine the first 10 ingredients in a bowl and mash together with a potato masher just until only a few whole black beans are remaining
2. Then stir for another minute with a large spoon to make sure the ingredients are well mixed
3. Let the mixture sit while you heat 2 tbsp olive oil in a large frying pan
4. On a sheet of wax paper , spread out a 1 / 4 cup of the cornmeal evenly
5. Divide the black bean mixture into 4 equal parts and begin flattening them into patty shape
6. Press each patty onto the cornmeal and cover the tops with the remaining 1 / 4 cup of cornmeal
7. Once they are coated with cornmeal , begin placing the patties onto the hot frying pan
8. Cook for around 7 minutes per side
9. When finished cooking , allow them to sit on paper towels for a minute
10. Then place on wheat buns and top with fresh guacamole or pico de gallo

title: nitro
steps:
1. Pour mt
2. Dew into 8oz glass
3. Pour everclear in
4. Mix and serve

title: easy cheesy or  focaccia bread
steps:
1. Lightly grease a pizza pan or large baking sheet
2. Without trying to completely cover pan surface , evenly pat out dough until 1 / 2 inch thick
3. Spread oil over top of dough
4. Evenly sprinkle with cheese , hot red pepper flakes and salt
5. Let rise , uncovered , until doubled , from 15 to 30 minutes
6. Preheat oven to 400f
7. Then , using your index finger , poke holes in bread right down to pan , about 1 inch apart
8. Bake in centre of preheated oven until golden , about 25 minutes
9. Slide bread off pan and onto a cooling rack
10. For focaccia:
11. Replace cheddar with 1 / 2 cup parmesan cheese
12. Omit hot red pepper flakes
13. Sprinkle with 1-1 / 2 tsp rosemary or italian seasonings

title: chili grill salt
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients and store in an old spice jar with a shaker top
2. Sprinkle on everything

title: easy brown rice side dish
steps:
1. Heat up rice cooker by turning it on and weighing it down with the lid or something heavy
2. Add butter and melt
3. Add onion , cook until cooked and look clear
4. Add mushrooms , cook until soften and liquid is released
5. Add rice and tumeric , stir to incorporate into mixture
6. Add broth
7. Restart the rice cooker
8. After rice cooker turns off , wait about 3 minutes and serve
9. If not using a rice cooker , use a heavy bottom pan with a tight fitting lid
10. Cook butter and vegetables on medium high
11. Follow instructions until restart of the rice
12. Then
13. Bring to a boil
14. Reduce heat to low or very low
15. Put lid on tight and steam for about 40 minutes
16. Do not open lid while cooking

title: braciole   courtesy of giada de laurentiis
steps:
1. Stir the the bread crumbs , cheeses , garlic and herbs together with 2 tablespoons of the olive oil
2. Pound the flank steak as thin as possible
3. Add the mixture of herbs and cheese to the flank steak and spread evenly on the work surface
4. Starting at one end , roll up the flank steak like for a jelly roll , and tie off with butcher's twine or toothpick
5. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
6. Heat the remaining 2 tablespoons of oil in a heavy large ovenproof skillet over medium heat
7. Add the flank steak and cook until browned on all sides , about 8 minutes
8. Add the wine to the pan and bring to a boil
9. Stir in the tomato sauce
10. Cover partially with foil and bake until the meat is almost tender , turning the braciole and basting with the sauce every 30 minutes
11. After 1 hour , uncover and continue baking until the meat is tender , about 30 minutes longer
12. Remove the braciole from the sauce
13. Using a large sharp knife , cut the braciole crosswise and diagonally into 1 / 2-inch-thick slices
14. Transfer the slices to plates
15. Spoon the sauce over and serve

title: bird s spaghetti nest
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f in a large bowl , mix cheeses , sour cream , and egg together
2. Set aside
3. Saut beef in a large skillet with the onion , green pepper , italian seasoning , salt , and pepper
4. When beef is cooked thorough , add remaining beef ingredients
5. Cook spaghetti till done , drain in strainer , then pour into cheese mixture while hot
6. Chop the pasta cheese mixture using a spatula or other sharp edged utensil , while stirring and mixing well and place into a lightly greased bundt pan or jumbo muffin tins
7. When beef mixture is done , pour it over the pasta / cheese mixture and bake for 25-30 minutes
8. Allow to cool about 5 minutes , then flip over onto a serving platter for the bundt pan , onto the counter for muffin tins , then use a spatula to transfer to plates
9. I like using the jumbo muffin tins , then putting the extra into a casserole dish for left-overs

title: caribbean curry chicken
steps:
1. Cut up the chicken , trim the fat and skin
2. Wash the chicken with the lemon juice and drain
3. Combine the chicken parts with the onions , garlic , poultry seasoning , salt , and pepper in a bowl and marinate for 2 hours
4. Heat a stew pot on medium heat and then add the oil and curry powder
5. Once the curry has darkened , add the chicken and onions and brown chicken on all sides
6. Add the water then cover and simmer for 10 minutes
7. Add the potatoes
8. Cover and simmer for about 30 to 40 minutes
9. Serve over hot rice

title: grilled  venison burgers
steps:
1. In bowl , mix dry ingredients
2. Add venison and mix well
3. Add liquid ingredients and mix well with a fork , until bread crumbs are barely noticeable
4. On plastic wrap , form into 8 patties , making them round and very flat-- like a fast-food burger
5. They can be cooked immediately , but i prefer to freeze them first
6. Place them on a large cookie sheet and freeze them several hours
7. Remove from freezer and place waxed paper between each burger as you stack them
8. I stack them in 2 1-quart freezer zip-lock bags
9. Preheat cast iron skillet to very hot
10. Cook frozen burgers until they are slightly charred on one side and then turn and cook until the other side is slightly charred and burgers are medium-well
11. Do not overcook
12. Turn burner off and leave burgers in the pan while you put condiments on your hamburger bun
13. If cooking thawed burgers , cook about 2-3 minutes per side

title: korean barbecued hamburgers
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients except the hamburger buns
2. Refrigerate 1 hour or longer to blend flavors
3. Shape meat mixture into 6 to 8 patties
4. Cook on grill or broil 5 to 10 minutes or until meat is done as desired , turning once
5. Serve with toppings of your choice on toasted buns or on pita bread

title: orange dreamsicle mousse
steps:
1. Dissolve the gelatin in 1 c boiling water
2. Add 1 c cold water and let set up for 5 minutes
3. Using an electric mixer , beat dry pudding mix into the jello until well blended
4. May have to set up for 5 minutes in refrigerator
5. Fold in mandarin oranges and cool whip
6. Chill either in a bowl or in individual mousse dishes

title: farmers market shirred eggs
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Generously butter sides and bottom of 4 individual ramekins , preferably ones that hold at least cup
3. Divided the bread crumbs equally among the ramekins and twirl each around so that they stick to the sides and bottom
4. Place a tomato slice in the bottom of each ramekin
5. Break an egg into each ramekin , being careful to keep the yolks unbroken
6. Sprinkle with herb or herbs of choice and add a shot of hot sauce to each , if you wish
7. Then pour the cream over
8. Sprinkle with bacon and then season with salt and pepper
9. Bake the eggs for 8-12 minutes , depending on how firm you like your eggs
10. Serve immediately

title: kittencal s slow cooker eye of round roast with gravy
steps:
1. In a bowl combine the mushroom soup with beef broth , dry onion soup mix , fresh garlic and worcestershire sauce
2. Mix until combined , then transfer into a 5-6-quart crock pot
3. In a small bowl mix together flour with black pepper and garlic powder
4. Dredge the roast in the flour / black pepper mixture
5. Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat
6. Add in the roast and lightly brown on all sides
7. Transfer the roast to the slow cooker and generously spoon the broth mixture on top of the roast
8. Cover and cook on low for 8 hours or until the roast is tender
9. For a thicker gravy , after cooking remove gravy to saucepan and thicken with water / cornstarch mixture

title: flavorful chili
steps:
1. Brown ground beef , onions , and celery in a skillet , drain , and place in slow cooker
2. Add remaining ingredients , and mix well
3. Cover , cook on low 8-10 hours , or high for 4-5 hours

title: carne asada burrito  san diego style
steps:
1. Meat:
2. Lay the meat out flat and season liberally with salt and pepper
3. Cut meat into 1 / 4 inch pieces
4. Place meat in a zip lock bag and add fine diced onions and lemon / lime juices
5. Mix well and refrigerate for at least 30 min
6. , up to 24 hours
7. Pico de gallo:
8. Fine dice all ingredients and mix well
9. Cover and refrigerate , stir occasionally
10. Guacamole:
11. Place avocado meat in a bowl and mash well with a fork , season to taste by adding remaining ingredients
12. Cover with plastic wrap , pressing plastic down on the guacamole to remove any air , and refrigerate
13. Carne asada burritos:
14. Warm the tortillas in a microwave under a wet paper towel , one at a time
15. Or wrap tortillas in foil and place in the oven at 350 for 10-15 minute you want them warm and pliable for wrapping
16. On high heat add a teaspoon of oil to a medium sized skillet
17. When oil begins to smoke add 1 / 4 to 1 / 3 pound of carne asada meat and onions
18. Sear the meat until brown on both sides
19. Place the meat and onions in the center of a warm tortilla
20. Add pico de gallo , guacamole , and fold in the sides to form a burrito
21. Serve hot
22. I cook enough for just one or two burritos at a time

title: baked cranberry acorn squash
steps:
1. Cut squash in half lengthwise
2. Remove seeds
3. Place cut side down in 13 x 9 x 2 inch baking dish
4. Bake in a 350 degree oven for 35 minutes
5. Turn cut side up
6. Combine remaining ingredients
7. Fill squash with fruit mixture
8. Continue baking for 25 minutes , or until squash is tender

title: shrimp with basil garlic butter
steps:
1. Season shrimp with salt and pepper
2. Heat oil in skillet over med high heat and saute shrimp until just turning opaque , remove and keep to one side
3. Add garlic to skillet and cook over med heat for 15 secs , then stir in wine , red pepper , juice and tomatoes
4. Boil stirring occasionally , until liquid is reduced by two thirds
5. Add shrimp and simmer for a couple of mins then swirl in butter and basil
6. Serve over pasta and sprinkle with parmesan cheese

title: wienerollas
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400
2. Combine onion and cheese
3. Set aside
4. Separate dough into 10 biscuits
5. Press or roll out each to 4 inch rectangle
6. Spread 1 teaspoonful of ketchup or chili sauce over each rectangle
7. Cut lengthwise slit in each wiener
8. Place cut side up on each rectangle
9. Fill each slit with about 1 tablespoon of onion mixture
10. Wrap dough around wiener
11. Press edges to seal
12. Brush lightly with milk
13. Roll in crushed chips
14. Bake for 15-20 minutes , watching closely for level of "brown-ness" desired

title: delicious stuffed mushrooms
steps:
1. Clean mushrooms with a clean cloth
2. Remove stems and chop them finely
3. Brush mushroom tops with olive oil with a brush
4. Saute chopped garlic and green onion in the butter
5. Add parsley , oregano , chopped stems , salt and pepper
6. Remove from heat and add bread crumbs , 1 / 4 cup wine and mix well
7. Stir in the 1 / 2 cup parmesan and 1 / 4 cup of the fontina cheese to moist enough to stick together
8. Stuff mushroom caps quite high and top with the rest of 1 / 4 cup of fontina cheese
9. Place them in a 12x14 baking dish slightly oiled
10. Take remaining 1 / 2 cup wine and pour into bottom of baking dish ,
11. Bake in pre-heated 350f oven for about 10 minutes or until cheese melts and mushrooms are cooked through
12. Spoon pan liquid over mushrooms and serve
13. Enjoy
14. My personal updated
15. Hope this helps to improve this recipe

title: soft fried shanghai spicy noodles with shredded pork
steps:
1. Combine ingredients for marinade
2. Add pork and marinate for 30 minutes
3. Mix seasoning liquid and set beside wok
4. Heat wok on high heat for 3 minutes and add oil
5. Immediately add garlic and ginger , then all the vegetables except green onions and bean sprouts
6. Toss and add 1 tbsp
7. Water , cover and cook until vegetables are soft , about 1 minute
8. Remove lid , then push vegetables to side of wok and add pork
9. Cook until no pink remains , then add green onions and bean sprouts , tossing for a few seconds
10. Add cooked noodles , toss to mix then stir seasoning liquid to combine cornstarch
11. Add to noodles
12. Continue tossing for 2 minutes or until completely mixed and sauce is absorbed
13. Serve immediately
14. Serves 2 to 4
15. A basketful of favorites

title: healthy  ish  chewy granola bars
steps:
1. In a large bowl combine the oats , whole wheat flour , wheat germ , brown sugar , cinnamon , salt , cranberries and raisins
2. Mix thoroughly
3. In a separate bowl combine the unsweetened applesauce , water , flax meal , honey and vanilla
4. Add the wet ingredients to the dry
5. Stir until everything is moistened
6. Place mixture into a greased 9x13 pan
7. Bake at 350 for 20 minutes
8. Cut into bars while still warm , but do not remove from pan until they are cooled completely
9. Store in an airtight container

title: homemade dill pickles
steps:
1. Bring water , vinegar and salt to a boil
2. Pour over and seal
3. Let set for 6 weeks

title: fluffy cinnamon chocolate dip
steps:
1. Place chocolate chips and 1 / 4 of the cool whip in a microwave safe bowl
2. Cook on medium power until chocolate is melted
3. Fold in rest of cool whip , cinnamon and vanilla
4. Mix well
5. Chill 30 minutes

title: best gender reveal cupcakes ever
steps:
1. Cupcakes:
2. Bake the cupcakes as per the instructions on the cake mix box
3. I suggest doing this the night before as i did -- being pregnant saps my energy and dividing the work makes it easier for me ! i also cooled the cupcakes and put them in the freezer to make them easier to work with and ice the next day
4. Icing:
5. Set the butter out so it gets to be room temperature
6. Next take the 8 oz of white bakers chocolate and chop it up and put it into a microwaveable bowl
7. Microwave it in 15-20 sec increments , stirring in between , until melted
8. Whip the butter and white chocolate together
9. Add the vanilla and heavy whipping cream and mix well
10. Keep using your mixer and gradually add the 9 cups of powdered sugar
11. Set aside
12. Surprise filling:
13. Take the heavy whipping cream out of the freezer and dump it in your bowl
14. Using cool or cold beaters on your mixer , beat the whipping cream on medium-high until it starts to get thick
15. Add the jello pudding mix and keep mixing until it gets really thick and somewhat stiff
16. Fold in your desired amount of preserves and add food coloring
17. Beat the mixture until it's a even color
18. Filling the cupcakes:
19. Take the cupcakes out of the freezer immediately after finishing the filling
20. Cut a upside down triangular cylinder out of the top of the cupcake
21. Cut the point off the triangular cylinder so it leaves lots of room for filling and it will be like a lid
22. Using a regular spoon , fill the cupcakes with the colored surprise filling and put their "tops" back on carefully
23. Icing the cupcakes:
24. Take your icing and either just slather it on the top , covering any hint of blue or pink filling -- or be all fancy-like and use an icing bag and
25. Add blue and pink sprinkles or whatever you like on top of that
26. Store cupcakes in the refrigerator ! they can last a few days , just make sure to store in the fridge !
27. You may have left over filling -- which my pregnant self and my small children had no problem eating out of the bowl with a spoon !

title: almost famous chimichangas
steps:
1. To make mexi-sauce:
2. Saute onion and garlic in a skillet coated with cooking spray til tender
3. Add pinches of spices , sugar and salt and cook 30 seconds
4. Stir in the canned chiles and cook 2 minutes
5. Add broth and simmer til thickened nicely
6. Puree
7. Stir in 1 / 4 c cilantro
8. To make chimichangas:
9. Preheat oven to 450
10. Melt the butter with 2 t oil in a skillet
11. Transfer to a bowl
12. Heat remaining oil in the skillet
13. Add the onion , garlic , and jalapeno and cook til soft , about 3 minutes
14. Add chili powder , cumin , cinnamon and 1 t kosher salt
15. Toast 30 seconds
16. Add the tomato and cilantro and cook til slightly dry , about 2 minutes
17. Stir in the chicken and sour cream and warm through
18. Remove from heat
19. Brush a rimmed baking sheet with some of the butter-oil mixture
20. Spread about 2 t beans down the center of each tortilla , leaving 2" border on both ends
21. Top with 1 c chicken mixture and 1 / 4 cheese
22. Fold in ends and roll up
23. Put chimichangas seam side down on the baking sheet
24. Brush them with the butter-oil mixture
25. Bake 8-10 min per side , brushing again after you flip
26. Top with sauce , more cheese , lettuce and tomato
27. Great served with mexican rice and more beans

title: pasta athena
steps:
1. In a large pot , boil salted water and cook the pasta as directed on the box
2. Meanwhile , heat a large skillet to medium-high heat
3. Add oil and butter
4. Once melted , add the garlic and shrimp
5. If you like a thick cream sauce , sprinkle the shrimp with 2 tsps
6. Flour before adding them to the skillet
7. Cook about one minute , then add the wine and cream
8. Toss and cook another minute , then add olives and tomatoes
9. Cook another minute or two
10. Finally , mix in the strained pasta and spinach leaves
11. Remove from heat once the spinach wilts
12. Salt and pepper to taste
13. Divide onto plates and top with feta cheese

title: chip and dip cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Combine butter and sugar
3. Beat with a mixer at medium-high speed until light and fluffy
4. Add egg yolk and vanilla
5. Gradually add flour and mix well
6. Stir in potato chips and pretzels
7. Shape level tablespoons of dough into 3-inch logs
8. Place on an ungreased baking sheet , 1 1 / 2 inches apart
9. Bake 14 to 18 minutes or until edges are lightly browned
10. Cool completely on baking sheet
11. Heat semisweet chocolate chips in microwave for 30 seconds
12. Stir
13. Repeat until melted
14. Dip one end of each cookie into chocolate and place on wax paper
15. Refrigerate until firm , about 10 minutes
16. Heat white baking chips in microwave for 30 seconds
17. Stir
18. Repeat until melted
19. Dip other end of cookie into melted chips and place on wax paper
20. Refrigerate until firm , about 10 minutes

title: off the boat  sicilian pasta sauce
steps:
1. Chop your 1 / 2 medium onion
2. Take a medium size pot and simmer together your chopped onions and oil over medium heat until onions are tender
3. Pour in your tomato sauce and stir well
4. Let your sauce come to a boil for at least a half an hour
5. Reduce heat to medium-low
6. Stir in your desired amount of salt and pepper
7. Cook for an additional half an hour
8. After at least an hour of cooking , bring a pot of water to a boil for your pasta
9. Let the sauce cook until pasta is drained and ready
10. Scoop some sauce into your drained pasta to coat
11. Serve with a scoop of pasta sauce ontop and enjoy !
12. You can add anything to this base pasta sauce -- we italians sometimes will throw in cooked tender cauliflower for one dish or asparagas , or drained / fried ground beef for pasta bolognese , etc
13. You get the idea

title: banana macadamia madeleines
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Place banana in a food processor
3. Process until smooth
4. Add butter , rum , vanilla , and egg white and eggs
5. Process until blended
6. Combine 3 / 4 cup plus 2 tablespoons powdered sugar , flour , baking powder , and salt in a bowl , and add to food processor
7. Pulse 2 to 3 times or until combined
8. Add nuts
9. Pulse 2 times or until well-blended
10. Spoon 1 tablespoon batter into each of 12 madeleine molds coated with baking spray
11. Bake at 375 for 15 minutes or until puffy
12. Remove from pan immediately
13. Let cool on a wire rack
14. Repeat procedure with remaining batter
15. Sift 2 tablespoons powdered sugar over madeleines

title: zucchini soup with herbed cream
steps:
1. Stir the sour cream , 1 teaspoons of the basil and 1 teaspoons of the oregano in a small bowl
2. Cover and refrigerate
3. Heat the oil in a 4-qt
4. Saucepan over medium heat
5. Add the onion and garlic and cook until tender
6. Add the zucchini and pepper
7. Cook for 5 minutes or until the zucchini is tender
8. Add the broth , remaining basil and oregano
9. Heat to a boil
10. Reduce the heat to low
11. Cover and cook for 15 minutes
12. Place one-third of the zucchini mixture into a blender or food processor
13. Cover and blend until smooth
14. Pour the mixture into a large bowl
15. Repeat the process twice more with the remaining zucchini mixture
16. Return all of the pureed mixture to the saucepan
17. Cook over medium heat for 5 minutes or until hot
18. Place one tablespoons of the sour cream mixture on top of each bowl of soup

title: puerto rican red beans and rice
steps:
1. Over medium heat , heat oil in a large saucepan
2. Add ham , chorizo , onion and green pepper , garlic and cumin
3. Saut until vegetables are tender
4. Add beans , tomato sauce and tabasco sauce
5. Simmer for 5 minutes
6. Add in remaining ingredients and 4 cups water
7. Bring to boil
8. Reduce heat , cover and simmer until rice is tender

title: yummy grilled roast beef sandwiches
steps:
1. Combine chilies , mayonnaise and mustard
2. Spread about 1 tablespoons on one side of each slice of bread
3. Top half of the bread with one slice of cheese and two slices of beef
4. Cover with remaining bread
5. Butter the outsides of bread
6. Grill sandwiches on a griddle or in a large skillet over medium heat until both sides are golden brown and the cheese is melted
7. Serve with salsa or picante sauce , if desired

title: daddy s chicken and dumplings
steps:
1. Open chicken , put it in large pot
2. Heat to boiling
3. Take out bones when chicken starts to fall off , take out any skin
4. Add broth , lower heat to medium
5. Take biscuits and pull apart dropping pieces of them into pot , use all the biscuits
6. After 5 minute turn to low
7. Stir so it won't stick to bottom
8. Add milk , salt pepper , and butter
9. It is done when most of the dumplings go to the bottom
10. From start to finish it takes about 30 to 45 minutes

title: mexican barbacoa in a crock pot
steps:
1. Rinse the cheeks and place them in a good size crock pot , discarding any chunks that are just fat
2. Add garlic cloves , onion , bay leaves , oregano , black pepper , salt , and squeeze the orange juice from the two oranges over the meat
3. Set the crock pot on high and cook for two hours , then stir the contents with a big spoon
4. Stir every hour after that
5. In six hours it should be starting to fall apart
6. Cook for an extra hour if needed and then remove from the crock pot to a large bowl with a slotted spoon , draining the meat from juices and removing the bay leaves and all the fat
7. Shred the meat with two forks and serve on tacos with the tortillas and the extras
8. The best is to place some meat on a warm tortilla , top with cilantro , squirt on some lime juice and hot salsa , sauce or chopped jalapeo , roll up and enjoy with some charro beans as a side
9. Mmmmmm -- it is so good

title: chocolate coffee mousse cake
steps:
1. To make a crust , take 2 graham crackers and crunch them together with the butter
2. Distribute it evenly throughout a foil pan and bake for 5-10 minutes at 325 degrees
3. While the crust is baking , mix the coffee and chocolate chips in the blender
4. Take the whipped cream and mix it in with the coffee-chocolate chips mixture
5. Pour this on top of the crust
6. If you'd like you can put some more plain whipped cream on top
7. Add sprinkles to make it look pretty
8. ~optional~ refridgerate or freeze for about an hour to make the cake taste a little more like ice cream and so that it will be not mushy

title: mexican shrimp bisque
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , saute onion and garlic in oil until tender
2. Stir in flour until blended
3. Stir in the water , cream , chili powder , bouillon , cumin , and coriander
4. Bring to a boil
5. Reduce heat
6. Cover and simmer for 5 minutes
7. Cut shrimp into bite sized pieces
8. Add to soup
9. Simmer 5 minutes longer or until shrimp turn pink
10. Gradually stir 1 / 2 cup hot soup into sour cream
11. Return all to pan , stirring constantly
12. Heat through
13. Garnish with fresh cilantro and cubed avocado , if desired

title: roasted bread salad
steps:
1. Grill or roast the peppers until the skin is blackened and blistered
2. Place in a plastic bag until cool enough to handle
3. Peel , seed and cut into thin strips and set aside
4. Heat oven to 200c / 400f degrees
5. Peel the onion and slice into rings
6. Thinly slice the cucumber
7. Thickly slice the tomatoes
8. Arrange these ingredients as well as the olives and peppers on a serving platter
9. Brush or spray the bread slices with the olive oil and cut into cubes and bake in the oven until golden and crisp
10. Combine all the dressing ingredients in a screw top jar and shake well
11. Sprinkle the salad with the bread cubes
12. Drizzle with the dressing before serving

title: mexican pork   black beans
steps:
1. Put beans in crockpot
2. Toss pork with chili powder , coriander and salt
3. Lightly brown onion and garlic with pork in ungreased skillet
4. Mix tomatoes into crockpot with their juice
5. Add meat , pepper and 2 cups water
6. Cover and cook 9 hours on low
7. Ladle over rice and garnish with cilantro

title: haitian chicken in sauce
steps:
1. Wash chicken well & pat dry
2. Rub each piece with limes / lemons and sprinkle with salt
3. Heat oil in heavy ovenproof pan
4. Preheat oven to 375f
5. Fry chicken pieces in hot oil
6. Meanwhile , in a bowl , combine garlic , sugar , tomato sauce and salt
7. Mix well
8. After 5 minutes of frying the chicken , add sliced onions and chopped pepper , for 5-7 minutes
9. Remove pan from heat and drain excess oil and add the tomato mixture , stirring well
10. Place the pan in oven & bake uncovered for 20 minutes or until chicken is cooked completely
11. Transfer chicken to serving platter lined with lettuce and onion rounds and with a pile of "picklese" #148276 vegetables
12. Served with diri blanc - pour sauce over rice

title: black pepper onion bread   breadmaker 1 1 2 lb  loaf
steps:
1. Measure carefully , placing all ingredients in bread machine pan in the order recommended by the manufacturer
2. Select basic / white cycle
3. Use medium crust color
4. Delay cycle can be used
5. Remove baked bread from pan and cool on wire rack

title: hellman s country style coleslaw
steps:
1. In medium bowl stir together first 6 ingredients
2. Add remaining ingredients
3. Toss to coat well
4. Cover
5. Chill at least 2 hours

title: donna s lemon cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven 350 degrees
2. Grease & flour bundt pan
3. Dissolve lemon jello in the 3 / 4 water let it cool to room temperature
4. Mix cake mix lemon jell-o , lemon extract , eggs & oil beat for 3 minutes
5. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes
6. Remove from oven let it cool for about 5 minutes and then remove from pan
7. Punch holes all over cake and pour frosting over cake while it is still a little warm

title: chicken flautas
steps:
1. Bring chicken pieces and water to boiling in kettle
2. Lower heat
3. Cover
4. Simmer until fork tender , about 25 minutes
5. Drain
6. Reserve 1 / 2 cup broth
7. Cool chicken until easy to handle
8. Bone and skin chicken
9. Shred meat
10. Heat lard or shortening in a large saucepan until melted
11. Add onion and garlic
12. Saute 1 minute
13. Stir in cornstarch , salt and pepper
14. Add reserved 1 / 2 cup of broth , shredded chicken and chilies
15. Stir and cook until very thick and bubbly
16. Remove from heat
17. Heat about 1 / 4" of oil in a small skillet over medium heat until very hot
18. Saute tortillas one at a time , a few seconds on each side , until limp
19. This will soften tortillas so that they will roll up more easily
20. Do not cook too long or they will become crisp
21. Drain on paper towels
22. Fill each tortilla with a heaping spoonful chicken mixture across center
23. Roll tortilla around filling
24. Be sure filling is 1" from edges or ends of rolled tortilla to avoid splattering during frying
25. Place 2 or 3 flautas , seam side down , in hot oil
26. Saute , turning on all sides until crisp
27. Drain and keep warm while cooking the rest
28. Combine sour cream and milk in small saucepan
29. Heat over very low heat just until lukewarm
30. Spoon over flautas
31. Garnish with fresh coriander or cilantro leaves , if you wish

title: red cabbage with pork and new potatoes
steps:
1. Warm olive oil in heavy dutch oven over medium high heat
2. Add the pork loin chops and brown on all sides
3. Remove meat and set aside
4. In same skillet saute the onion until golden , about 5 to 10 minutes
5. Adding in a touch of wine and scraping up the brown bits from the meat
6. Stir in cabbage , potatoes and sliced apples
7. Sprinkle with brown sugar , salt , pepper and red wine vinegar
8. Place browned chops on top of all and pour 1 cup of white wine over all
9. Cover and bake , stirring once or twice , in a preheated 375 degree oven for 90 minutes or until tender
10. To keep meat moist , submerge into cabbage mixture as it cooks

title: mexican spice mixture
steps: 1. Mix all ingredients together and store in airtight container

title: broccoli with onion cheese sauce
steps:
1. Steam broccoli until crisp-tender
2. Drain well
3. Place broccoli in shallow serving dish
4. While broccoli is cooking , melt butter in medium saucepan over medium heat
5. Add onion and cook until tender , about 8 minutes
6. Stir in flour
7. Add milk
8. Cook and stir until sauce comes to a boil for several minutes
9. Stir in cheese until it melts
10. Add salt , pepper and garlic powder
11. Pour over hot broccoli and serve

title: chutney pork chops or chicken breasts
steps:
1. Slow cooker- mix all of the sauce in the slow cooker
2. Add the meat and cook low 8 hours-high 4 hours
3. Oven- mix all of the sauce together
4. Lightly spray pan
5. Put in meat and top with sauce
6. Cook 350 for 1 hour

title: marie s easy lasagna
steps:
1. Brown meat and drain
2. Add sauce and set aside
3. Combine cheeses , seasonings and eggs
4. Spread 1 cup meat sauce in 9 x 13 pan
5. Layer 4 uncooked noodles
6. Spread on 1 cup cheese mixture , then 1 cup sauce
7. Repeat layers twice
8. Top with 4 noodles , sauce and cheeses
9. Cover tightly with foil and bake for 1 hour at 350 degrees
10. Let cool for 15 minutes

title: tuna noodle casserole   dairy free
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. In large pot of boiling salted water , cook noodles until al dente , approximately 8 minutes
3. Drain and rinse with cold water
4. In a large bowl , combine cooled noodles , tuna , green onions , celery and red pepper
5. In a measuring cup , whisk together chicken stalk , salad dressing , pepper and tarragon until well combined
6. Pour over noodle mixture and combine
7. Spoon into casserole dish
8. Prepare the topping: in a small bowl , toss bread crumbs , almonds and vegetable oil
9. Sprinkle evenly over top of casserole
10. Bake in preheated oven for 30 - 35 minutes or until headed through

title: sweet and salty
steps:
1. Place a slice of cheese on each cracker
2. Split the marshmallow in half and put each half on a cracker with cheese
3. Place in the microwave for about 10 seconds or until the marshmallow starts to expand

title: margaritas en jarra
steps:
1. In blender container , combine the crushed ice , tequila , lime juice , powdered sugar , egg white and triple sec
2. Cover and blend until very frothy
3. Transfer to pitcher
4. Garnish with lime slices
5. Serve in salt-rimmed cocktail glasses
6. To prepare glasses: rub the rim of each cocktail glass with a little lime juice
7. Invert glass in a shallow dish of salt
8. Shake off excess salt

title: scandinavian potato lefse
steps:
1. Mix all but the flour while hot
2. Cool
3. Add 1 cup flour at a time , enough to roll out
4. Divide dough into balls about the size of tennis balls
5. Roll balls out on floured board
6. Fry the lefse in a grill or in an iron skillet at very high heat
7. Serve with a little butter , or anything else you might want to wrap up in it

title: 250 00 chocolate chip cookies
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together just until blended
2. Spoon large tbspfuls onto a baking sheet
3. Bake at 350 for 10-14 minutes

title: luxury splendid eggs
steps:
1. Combine chopped herbs
2. In medium bowl , use fork to combine eggs and cream
3. Stir in cream cheese , herbs , some salt and pepper
4. In 10-inch heavy non-stick pan , melt butter over medium heat
5. Add eggs , stir with spatula for a few seconds
6. Bring heat to low setting
7. Keep stirring
8. Scrape eggs sticking to pan
9. Plate and serve

title: tangy carrot cake
steps:
1. Shred the carrot and squeezed out excess carrot juice
2. Sift flour and salt together
3. Whisk eggs and sugar together until the mixture is light , thick and fluffy and the whisk leaves a marked ribbon-like trail behind
4. Add the sifted dry ingredients and olive oil half at a time
5. Mix well each time
6. Add shredded carrot , dried cranberries and lemon zest
7. Fold gently
8. Pour the mixture in a 20 cm baking tray lined with baking paper
9. Bake in a preheated oven at 150c for 15 minutes , 15 minutes at 125c
10. Let it cool and serve

title: grandma lucy s date squares
steps:
1. Mix oats , flour , and baking soda
2. Add shortening
3. Prepare filling by mixing chopped dates , hot water , brown sugar , and vanilla
4. Put 1 / 2 dry mix in a baking pan
5. Add filling
6. Top with rest of dry mix
7. Bake 20 minutes at 350 , or until well browned

title: new england chop suey
steps:
1. Add hot water to a large pan
2. I like to add to my pasta water heavy salt , dried oregano and a splash of evoo
3. Bring to a boil and add elbows , cook to al dente 9 minutes
4. Drain pasta and return to pan , set aside
5. While pasta is cooking chop up a large cup of onions , a cup of mushrooms and garlic to preference
6. In a large skillet over medium heat , add the onions and half a tbs of evoo
7. Soften onions , then add beef
8. When beef is nearly browned add mushrooms then garlic
9. Simmer for 2 minutes then strain off excess fat
10. Add meat mixture to the pan with your pasta and return to low heat
11. Add the can of crushed tomatoes and 2 cans of condensed soup
12. Add one soup cans worth of water and keep on low heat 10-15 minutes simmering gently but not sticking
13. Spice
14. I salt and pepper generously and add about 1 / 2 teaspoon cayenne pepper
15. I like to add a teaspoon of sugar to neutralize the acidity of tomatoes
16. Serve on a cold day

title: ione s parsley dumplings
steps:
1. Mix ingredients lightly into a soft dough
2. Drop by slightly rounded tablespoonful into boiling soup or stew
3. Simmer 10 minutes uncovered
4. Cover tightly and simmer 10 minutes more

title: crock pot brazilian saffron chicken and rice
steps:
1. Sprinkle chicken with garlic salt
2. Heat oil in 12 inch skillet over medium-high heat
3. Add chicken and cook until brown on all sides
4. Drain
5. Place chicken in 4 quart slow cooker
6. Top with ham , onion , and bell pepper
7. Add broth
8. Cover and cook on low 5 to 6 hours until juice of chicken is no longer pink when centers of thickest pieces are cut
9. Remove chicken from crock pot
10. Stir rice mix into mixture in crock pot , add chicken
11. Cover and cook on high about 1 hour or until rice is tender
12. Serve chicken and rice sprinkled with olives

title: werewolves of lundon
steps:
1. Cut the mushrooms in half and set aside
2. Combine the worcestershire sauce , cayenne , hot sauce , paprika , and salt to taste in a small bowl
3. Mix well and set aside
4. Melt the butter in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat
5. Add the mushrooms and gently toss to coat with butter
6. Add the garlic and saut mushrooms and garlic for 1 minute
7. Add the worcestershire sauce mixture and gently stir to coat mushrooms
8. Raise heat to medium-high , cover , and stir every few minutes until the butter separates from the sauce and the mushrooms are coated with a heavy caramel-like glaze
9. Using a slotted spoon , remove mushrooms to a serving dish
10. Discard remaining sauce and serve immediately

title: super sandwich bread  pain de mie   levain bakery
steps:
1. Put yeast and warm water in a small mixing bowl
2. Whisk until creamy
3. Set aside for 1-2 minutes
4. Using a stand mixer with the dough hook attachment , combine the flour and salt
5. While mixing on low speed , gradually add in the cut-up butter and buttermilk
6. Then add in the cool water as needed to form smooth dough
7. If dough is too wet and sticky , add a bit more flour
8. If dough is too dry and hard , add a bit more cool water
9. Continue mixing for 5 to 8 minutes until dough is elastic
10. Remove mixing bowl from stand
11. Cover with plastic wrap and let rise in the refrigerator for 8 to 24 hours
12. After dough has risen , lightly grease two 8-inch loaf pans
13. Divide risen dough in half and form each piece into a rectangular loaf shape
14. Place shaped loaves into prepared pans
15. Dust the tops of the dough with flour and cover the loaf pans loosely with plastic wrap
16. Let the dough proof for 8-24 hours in the refrigerator
17. When dough has done proofing , preheat the oven to 375f lightly flour the top of each loaf
18. With a razor blade or very sharp knife , score the top of each loaf diagonally 3 times
19. Place the sheet pan in the center of the preheated oven and bake for 50 minutes

title: grilled spicy garlic shrimp
steps:
1. Prepare brining solution and brine shrimp for 20-25 minutes -- remove shrimp feet and devein with shells left on , rinse and dry
2. Using mortar& pestle smash garlic and salt into a smooth paste
3. Add cayenne and paprika and mix well
4. Add olive oil and lemon to form a thin paste
5. Toss shrimp with paste until evenly coated
6. Grill until shells are bright pink- 2-3 minutes per side

title: custard cream filling
steps:
1. Scald milk , being careful not to burn
2. Mix together sugar , flour and salt
3. Add eggs to flour mixture and beat well
4. Add slowly to milk , stirring constantly with whisk until thick
5. Remove from heat and add vanilla , orange rind and butter
6. Stir and cool

title: cream cheese french toast bake
steps:
1. Slice french bread into 24 slices
2. Spray 13x9-inch glass baking dish with cooking spray
3. Spread about 1 tablespoon cream cheese on each of 12 slices of bread
4. Top with remaining bread slices to make 12 sandwiches
5. Place sandwiches in baking dish to cover bottom
6. In medium bowl , beat eggs , milk , 1 / 4 cup of the sugar , the salt and cinnamon with wire whisk until well blended
7. Pour over bread in baking dish
8. Let stand 5 minutes
9. Turn sandwiches over
10. Cover
11. Refrigerate 8 hours or overnight
12. Chop 1 cup of the strawberries
13. Refrigerate remaining berries
14. In nonmetal bowl , gently stir chopped strawberries , remaining 1 / 2 cup sugar and the amaretto to mix
15. Cover , refrigerate 8 hours or overnight
16. Heat oven to 400
17. Drizzle melted butter over bread in dish
18. Bake uncovered 25 to 30 minutes or until golden brown
19. Meanwhile , slice remaining strawberries
20. Stir into chilled strawberry mixture
21. Serve french toast with strawberry topping

title: rhubarb raspberry jam
steps:
1. In a large bowl , add the rhubarb and sugar
2. Stir to coat evenly
3. Cover the bowl , and place it in the refrigerator overnight
4. The next morning , place the rhubarb mixture in a large kettle
5. Cook over medium heat
6. Stirring constantly , until the mixture starts to boil , then lower the heat just a bit , and cook for 12 minutes
7. Remove the kettle from the heat , and add the gelatin powder , and keep stirring for 1 minute
8. Add the can of pie filling , and stir thoroughly until mixed through
9. Return the kettle to the stove
10. Start to cook over medium heat
11. Stirring constantly , until the mixture comes to a boil
12. Remove the kettle from the heat , and carefully ladle the jam into the sterilized glass jars
13. Cover the jars with the lids , then cool the jam to room temperature , before storing the jam in the refrigerator or freezer

title: mexican breakfast for three
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. On stove top , heat the refried beans incorporating the diced onions , the grated cheese and the olive oil
3. Bake tostadas and diced ham in oven -- about 6 minutes -- then remove
4. Dab a teaspoon or so of the beans onto the center of each of three plates , centering a tortilla on each -- this step is very necessary
5. Liberally spread bean mixture onto each tortilla
6. Layer the remaining cheese , the ham , lettuce , and tomato on each
7. Fry eggs according to liking and nest one atop each
8. Top with tomatillo / verde sauce
9. Garnish with onions and jalapenos
10. Hot sauce optional or as desired

title: candied sugared almonds  german gebrannte mandeln
steps:
1. In a large heavy skillet , heat almonds , sugar and butter over medium heat
2. Cook , stirring constantly , until almonds are toasted and sugar is a golden brown , about 15 minutes
3. Watch them carefully , do not scorch
4. Stir in vanilla
5. Spread on buttered aluminum foil
6. Sprinkle with salt and dust lightly with cinnamon , if using
7. Cool and break into clusters
8. Variation: for a nice variation , omit the salt and cinnamon , and replace vanilla extract with 1 tablespoon culinary rose water
9. Store in an airtight container
10. Freezes well
11. Give as gifts , wrapped in small cellophane bags tied with ribbon

title: barbecued pot roast
steps:
1. Combine salt and pepper
2. Rub over the roast
3. Heat oil in a dutch oven
4. Brown roast on all sides
5. Add tomato sauce , water , onions and garlic
6. Cover and simmer for 30 minutes
7. Combine the remaining ingredients
8. Pour over the meat
9. Cover and simmer for 3-4 hours , or until the meat is tender

title: maple cinnamon coffee
steps:
1. Place filter in brew basket of coffee maker
2. Add ground coffee and cinnamon
3. Pour syrup into empty coffee pot
4. Add water to coffee maker
5. Brew
6. After brewing is complete , stir coffee well
7. Pour coffee into 6 coffee mugs
8. Top with a dollop of whipped cream or cool whip
9. Lightly sprinkle ground cinnamon on top

title: ground beef tomato spinach casserole
steps:
1. Cook pasta until al dente and set aside and keep warm
2. Spray a large dutch oven , with cooking spray
3. Brown ground beef , onions and garlic over medium heat until no longer pink
4. Add remaining ingredients and stir well
5. Bring to a boil , reduce heat and cook over medium heat for about 20 minutes
6. Stir in cooked pasta and heat through

title: slow roast leg of lamb with white wine
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 325f
2. Pour the oil into a large , sturdy roasting tin and set it over the stove top
3. Slash the lamb with a sharp knife , use one of the sliced garlic cloves , and stick slivers into the meat
4. Season the lamb with salt and pepper then roll it in the flour
5. Brown the lamb all over in the hot oil for 5-10 minutes
6. Add the onions and cook for a further 5-10 minutes , turning the lamb and stirring the onions until both are nicely browned
7. Add the garlic , white wine , stock , rosemary and redcurrant jelly , bring to a simmer , transfer to the the oven and cook for 2 hours covered , basting now and again with the juices
8. Uncover and cook for another 1 1 / 2-2 hours , basting again at intervals
9. Take the lamb out of the tin and place on a large board to rest in a warm place
10. If needed skim off and reduce the pan juices , mash up the onions a bit
11. Cut the lamb into thick slices - you'll find the meat falls away from the bone so you may end up with more chunks than slices

title: tomato and artichoke torte
steps:
1. Boil artichokes in water to which lemon juice and oil have been added , until tender
2. Drain and cool
3. Bring stock to boil in medium saucepan
4. Add potatoes
5. Cover and cook over medium-high heat until just tender , about 10 minutes
6. Drain
7. Transfer to food processor
8. Melt 2 tblsps butter in large skillet over medium heat
9. Add artichokes and garlic and saute 3 minutes
10. Add to potatoes in processor and coarsely puree
11. Transfer to bowl
12. Mix 1 cup of cheese , egg , thyme , salt and pepper into the puree
13. Preheat oven to 375f
14. Butter 8 inch round or square baking dish
15. Coat with breadcrumbs
16. Transfer artichoke puree to prepared dish
17. Smooth top and arrange tomato slices over in concentric circles
18. Cut remaining 2 tblsps butter into small pieces and dot over surface
19. Sprinkle with remaining cup cheese
20. Bake until set and top is golden , about 35 minutes
21. Serve hot or at room temperature

title: soy glazed tofu and asparagus
steps:
1. Heat sesame oil and red pepper flakes in nonstick skillet or wok
2. Cut asparagus spears into 1 1 / 2 inch pieces
3. Add asparagus and tofu to heated sesame oil and stir-fry for 5 minutes
4. Add mushrooms and cook for 3 minutes
5. Add garlic , saute , stirring constantly , for 30 seconds
6. Mix sugar and soy sauce together in small bowl until combined and add to pan
7. Mix well to coat and stir-fry for 3-4 minutes
8. Asparagus should be crisp-tender at this point
9. Serve

title: apricot congealed salad
steps:
1. Heat crushed pineapple and jello until dissolved
2. Refrigerate until cooled
3. Add buttermilk , cool whip and nuts
4. Refrigerate until set

title: pineapple oatmeal muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 and grease muffin pan
2. In a mixing bowl , combine pineapple w / juice , sour cream , egg , and butter
3. Blend well
4. In another bowl , combine the remaining ingredients
5. Add to pineapple mixture
6. Stir just until moist
7. Spoon batter into prepared muffin pan , dividing batter evenly
8. Bake for 30-35 minutes or until lightly browned

title: strawberry almond horchata mexico
steps:
1. Grind the rice in a coffee mill
2. Add it to a container with almonds , cinnamon stick and hot water
3. Cover and refrigerate overnight
4. In the morning , puree the whole lot in your blender until very smooth
5. Strain in fine strainer , pressing against the sides with spatula to release all liquid
6. Or even easier use a double layer of cheesecloth , squeezing with hands to release all that precious liquid
7. Discard the solids
8. For even smoother results , strain a second time
9. Add as much sugar , milk , and vanilla extract as youd like
10. Whisk thoroughly to dissolve the sugar
11. Garnish with fresh chopped strawberries and shaved ice
12. Stir in and enjoy
13. Optionally , you can return it to the blender with some strawberries then the drink will be pink

title: artichoke crostini
steps:
1. Place all ingredients , except bread , in a blender or food processor
2. Blend to combine , i like to leave it kind of chunky
3. Spread toasted slices with mixture
4. Place on cookie sheet
5. Broil until golden
6. Sprinkle with creole seasoning , or old bay

title: layered italian casserole
steps:
1. 1
2. Cook pasta according to package directions
3. Drain
4. 2
5. Meanwhile , cook sausage in skillet until browned
6. Drain off fat
7. Stir in tomato paste , undrained tomatoes , beans , rosemary and cooked pasta
8. Heat through
9. 3
10. Spread half the mixture in 2-quart casserole
11. Combine ricotta , 1 / 2 cup mozzarella and egg
12. Spoon over sausage mixture
13. Spread remaining sausage mixture on top
14. 4
15. Bake , covered , at 350f , 30 minutes
16. Combine bread crumbs and butter
17. Uncover and sprinkle with remaining mozzarella
18. Top with bread crumbs
19. Bake 5 minutes more to melt cheese
20. Let stand 5 minutes

title: baked baby brie in a puff pastry with chutney and baby spinach
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Thaw pastry dough , i like pepperidge farm
3. Flatten out seams
4. Place brie in center of dough and bring up sides , fold over and keep flat
5. Turn brie over so that folded pieces are on the bottom
6. Place on a non-stick baking sheet and bake in middle of oven for 20 minutes or until dough is brown and puffy
7. Meanwhile , toss spinach w / dressing
8. Place spinach on a serving platter off to one side of the dish
9. When brie is done , place on spinach , spread chutney on top of hot brie
10. Place crackers on opposite side of platter
11. Cut out a wedge and watch the cheese ooze
12. Spread a cracker with cheese , chutney and spinach
13. Enjoy !

title: eggs al pomodoro
steps:
1. Bring a pot of water to a boil
2. Add salt and vinegar
3. Gently crack an egg into the bath and lower the heat
4. Add another and repeat until they're all in the pot
5. Poach for about 2-3 minutes--this really depends on so many factors , from the temperature of the water that day to the specific egg , so i've found that it just takes practice
6. Eventually you'll know how long is right for the kind of egg you like
7. Plate your eggs , salt and pepper them , and drain the water so you can use the same pot , or , if you don't care about dirtying another pan , simultaneously do the next step
8. For a quick breakfast: simply heat up the bolognese in the pot and top your eggs with it
9. For a fancier brunch: brown the sausage in some olive oil , add the sprig of rosemary and tomato sauce , and let it all simmer for a few minutes so the flavors can marry
10. Top your eggs with the sauce , garnish with cheese , and devour ruthlessly

title: minestrone verde
steps:
1. Heat vegetable broth and onion to boiling in large saucepan
2. Add pasta
3. Reduce heat and simmer covered , 5 minutes
4. Add beans and vegetables to saucepan
5. Simmer , covered , until broccoli is tender , 6 to 8 minutes
6. Stir in herbs and garlic
7. If you use salt to season , this is the time , also pepper
8. Serve in bowls with a small plate of shredded parmesan

title: steamed fish with ginger   mushrooms
steps:
1. Put the prepared fish on to a plate slightly larger than itself , which will fit into your steamer
2. Place all the remaining ingredients except the garnish on top of the fish
3. Put in steamer and cook for approximately 20 minutes
4. Remove and garnish with coriander

title: chili cheddar jalapeno soup
steps:
1. In a heavy saucepen heat oil or butter over medium heat
2. Add in onion , garlic , jalapeno pepper and chili powder
3. Saute for about 5 minutes or until softened
4. Add in cubed potatoes and chicken broth
5. Bring to a boil , cover and simmer for about 15-20 minutes or until the potatoes are soft
6. Transfer the mixture to a blender or food processor
7. Puree until smooth , then return the mixture to the saucepan over medium heat
8. Add in 2-1 / 4 cups grated cheddar cheese , milk , half and half , corn niblets , salt and pepper
9. Cook stirring for about 20 minutes , or until the cheese is melted and the mixture is heated through
10. Ladle into bowls and top with chopped green onions and more shredded cheddar cheese
11. Delicious !

title: creamy lemon rice
steps:
1. Melt butter in a saucepan on low heat
2. Stir in rice and lemon zest
3. Cook over medium heat , stirring , until rice is opague , about 5 minutes
4. Add broth and salt
5. Cover and simmer 20 minutes or until liquid is absorbed
6. Stir in lemon juice
7. Slowly stir cream into rice
8. Continue to stir and cook on low heat until cream is absorbed
9. Season to taste

title: shrimp salad with avocado  celery and red onion
steps:
1. Whisk together olive oil and lemon juice , and season with salt and pepper
2. Set aside
3. Whisk again just before using
4. Combine shrimp , avocado , celery , scallion , tomatoes , parsley and red onion
5. Sprinkle with enough dressing to coat lightly
6. Toss shrimp salad gently , and season to taste with salt and pepper

title: spinach  mushroom  and cilantro quesadillas
steps:
1. Drain spinach well , pressing between paper towels
2. Saute spinach and mushrooms in a large skillet 5 min or until tender
3. Stir in cilantro and salt
4. Spread spinach mixture evenly on half of each tortilla
5. Sprinkle with cheese blend
6. Wipe skillet clean
7. Cook , tortilla side down , over med-high heat until lightly browned
8. Fold tortilla over filling and serve immediately

title: cranberry pecan rugelach
steps:
1. With electric mixer , cream together butter and cream cheese
2. With mixer on low , gradually add in flour
3. Form into 3 squat disks
4. Wrap and refrigerate for 2 hours or overnight
5. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
6. In a small saucepan , cover the cranberries with water and bring to a boil
7. Remove from heat and let cool
8. Drain
9. In a small bowl , combine pecans , brown sugar and cinnamon
10. Roll dough into a 10-inch circles
11. Paint with the melted butter
12. Sprinkle with the sugar / nut mixture and cranberries
13. With a pizza wheel , cut into 12 wedges
14. Roll up the wedges and line them up on a parchment lined or nonstick cookie sheet
15. Paint the rugelach with the egg wash
16. Bake for 15 minutes or set and light golden

title: baked ziti  about com
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Prepare pasta according to package directions for "al dente
3. " drain
4. In a large bowl , beat egg
5. Add ricotta cheese garlic powder , basil and 1 cup of the mozzarella
6. Mix well
7. Add cooked pasta and 2 cups of the spaghetti sauce
8. Pour 1 cup of the spaghetti sauce in a 9 x 13 pan
9. Top with the ziti mixture
10. Top with the remaining sauce
11. Sprinkle remaining mozzarella and parmesan cheese over the sauce
12. Cover with foil , and bake 20 minutes
13. Remove foil and bake another 10-20 minutes until golden brown and bubbly
14. Let the baked ziti rest 10 minutes before serving

title: banana stuffed french toast
steps:
1. Combine the butter and maple syrup in the bowl of a food processor fitted with the metal blade
2. Process until very smooth
3. Scrape the maple butter into a serving bowl and set aside
4. Trim and discard the ends from each loaf of bread
5. Using a long , narrow object , pierce a hole through the center of each loaf of bread , pushing out slightly to make the hole large enough to push a banana through
6. Push a banana into the hole until it protrudes out of both ends of the bread
7. Trim off the banana ends to set the banana flush with the bread end
8. Using a sharp knife , cut each loaf of bread into 1-inch-thick slices
9. Place the eggs , chopped bananas , and cream in a blender and process to combine
10. Add the sugar , cinnamon , and nutmeg and process to a smooth batter
11. Add the vanilla and process to incorporate
12. Pour the batter into a large , shallow bowl or pan
13. Preheat the over to 350 degrees f
14. Using a pastry brush , lightly coat a nonstick griddle with some of the oil
15. Place the griddle over medium heat
16. Working with one slice at a time , dip the banana-stuffed bread into the batter , allowing excess batter to drip off
17. Place the battered bread onto the hot griddle and cook for about 2 minutes per side or just until golden
18. Transfer the cooked slices to a cookie sheet
19. When all of the bread has been cooked , place the cookie sheet in the preheated oven and bake for about 5 minutes or until the bread is cooked in the center
20. Serve hot with reserved maple butter
21. Maple butter keeps very well , tightly covered and refrigerated or frozen
22. It can be used on pancakes , waffles , or toast
23. Double
24. Not only is it a perfect way to impress company- but it will impress a finicky child
25. If all else fails- just tell everybody it's a favorite breakfast of kings

title: raspberry   cream squares
steps:
1. Combine wafers and butter , press half of mixture on bottom of 8 inch square pan
2. Sprinkle berries over crust
3. Whisk half-and-half and sugar until sugar dissolves
4. In a separate bowl , whisk sour cream until smooth , and slowly whisk in half-and-half mixture
5. Pour this over berries
6. Sprinkle remaining crumbs on top
7. Cover and freeze for 3 hours or until solid
8. Cut into squares

title: mexicali stewed chicken breast
steps:
1. Slice each chicken breast horizontally through to create two thinner pieces of each breast
2. Then slice each of these into at least two pieces
3. Set these aside
4. In medium sauce pan combine remaining ingredients
5. Add chicken pieces and bring to boil
6. Simmer about 30 minutes or until chicken is tender
7. Remove chicken from sauce
8. Bring sauce back to boil and thicken using 1 tablespoon of cornstarch dissolved in cup of cold water
9. Only use enough of the cornstarch and water mixture to slightly thicken the sauce
10. It should be about the consistency of thin gravy
11. To serve , place chicken piece on rice , biscuit , or corn bread and ladle small amount of sauce , about 1 / 4 , over the chicken

title: citrus cream smoothie
steps:
1. In a small saucepan , bring the sugar and water to a boil over medium-high heat
2. Simmer , stirring occasionally , until the sugar has dissolved , about 5 minutes
3. Cool for 20 minutes
4. Pour the cooled syrup into a blender
5. Add the yogurt , orange juice , bananas , orange zest , vanilla extract , and ice
6. Blend until the mixture is smooth
7. Pour into glasses and serve

title: breakfast egg rolls
steps:
1. Brown and drain sausage , set aside
2. In a bowl , whisk eggs , milk , chiles , green pepper , onion
3. Scramble mixture , and mix into sausage
4. Place mixture into eggroll wrapper , top with cheese , roll , seal the edges of the wrappers with water
5. Heat oil medium-hi heat , fry until golden brown
6. Serve

title: braised venison with chilli and chocolate
steps:
1. Preheat an oven to 190c / gas 5)
2. Cut the venison into 2
3. 5cm cubes , removing large bits of fat or gristle
4. Put these into a double-layered plastic bag , along with all the marinade ingredients
5. Set aside for a day in the fridge , turning every so often so that all of the meat comes into contact with the marinade
6. When you are ready to cook , remove the venison from the marinade , setting the marinade aside for later
7. Heat a large casserole over a high heat until it is smoking hot
8. Pour in a tablespoon of olive oil and when it is very hot add the venison cubes , 6 or 7 at a time , so that you are not overcrowding the pan and thus bringing down the temperature of the oil
9. Brown the meat on all sides for 12 minutes , letting the pan get hot again between each batch and adding more oil if necessary
10. When the meat is all browned , set it aside while you brown the vegetables
11. Add a tablespoon of oil to the casserole and sweat the onions for 5 minutes before adding the carrots , celery and parsnips
12. Cook for a further 10 minutes , allowing the vegetables to start caramelising without letting them burn
13. Add the garlic and cook for another 5 minutes
14. Return the venison to the casserole , along with the reserved marinade and the rest of the ingredients
15. Bring up to a gentle simmer , stirring to melt the chocolate into the sauce
16. Cook in the preheated oven for about 90 minutes or until the meat is tender and falling apart

title: buttered garlic noodles
steps:
1. Combine the garlic powder salt'n spice and melted butter
2. Toss with the drained cooked noodles
3. Add shredded montery jack cheese , stir to mix
4. Serve

title: summer feta burger with gourmet cheese spread
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , combine cream cheese , 1 clove minced garlic , basil , and dill
2. Cover and set aside
3. Heat the olive oil in a medium skillet over medium heat and cook 1 clove minced garlic and onion for 4 to 6 minutes , or until translucent
4. Remove from heat and allow to cool
5. Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat and lightly oil grate
6. While the grill is heating , gently mix together the cooked garlic and onion , ground beef , pork sausage , feta cheese , red wine , egg , salt , and pepper in a large bowl
7. Do not over work the meat mixture
8. Divide into 8 equal parts and form into patties
9. Grill patties on preheated grill for 5 to 10 minutes per side , until well done
10. Toast the split buns on the grill for 1 to 2 minutes
11. Assemble the burgers by spreading 1 1 / 2 tablespoon of the cheese and herb spread to both the top and bottom of each roll
12. Place patties on the bottom half of the rolls and stack a slice of tomato , sliced red onion , and a leaf of lettuce on each burger
13. Add the roll tops and serve

title: one hour whole wheat rolls
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 425f grease a baking sheet and set it aside
2. Mix oil and water and heat until warm
3. I use the microwave for best results but you can also use the stovetop
4. Combine the yeast , salt , sugar , whole wheat flour , and white flour in a large bowl and stir until well-mixed
5. Mix the water and oil into the flour mixture
6. Turn the dough onto a floured countertop and knead
7. As you are kneading , add flour until the dough is no longer sticky
8. Cut the dough into 8 pieces and shape them
9. Brush with water , and sprinkle with any or all of the things in the introduction
10. Bake for 20-25 minutes or until the rolls are browned and the crust has gotten crunchy
11. Enjoy hot with butter or margarine !

title: fresh nectarine cake
steps:
1. Mix the butter and sugar together in a food processor or large bowl until creamy
2. Add the eggs and mix well
3. Mix in the yoghurt , nuts , fruit , lemon juice and rind , flour , baking powder and cinnamon , don't overmix , just mix until ingredients are loosely combined
4. Pour into a well-greased and baking-paper lined 20cm cake pan
5. Bake at 180c for 55-60 minutes
6. Cool on wire rack
7. Serve dusted with icing sugar , and accompanied by ice cream or softly whipped cream

title: chocolate salami
steps:
1. Soak cherries in warm water , about 30 minutes
2. Drain well
3. Place chocolate in bowl with butter , over a pot of simmering water until melted
4. Add sugar , almonds , pistachios , biscotti , drained cherries , orange peel and grand marnier
5. Mix well
6. Remove from heat and add the egg yolk and mix well
7. Cool completely
8. Form salami shape by rolling mixture in a sheet of wax paper
9. Refrigerate 4 hours or overnight
10. Slice and serve

title: hot spiced cheer
steps:
1. Place cloves , cinnamon , and crystallized ginger on a double layer of cheesecloth
2. Gather edges and tie together to make a pouch
3. Combine cheescloth pouch , cider , pineapple juice , orange juice , lemon juice , sugar and salt in large stockpot and bring to a boil
4. Reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes
5. Discard cheesecloth pouch
6. Serve with rum , if desired

title: betsy s meatloaf
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. In a large bowl mix together all of the ingredients
3. Put mixture into a greased loaf pan and form into a loaf shape
4. Cover with foil
5. Bake at 350 for 45-60 minutes
6. For a crispier top , bake uncovered last 15 minutes

title: bacon wrapped stuffed fish
steps:
1. To make the stuffing , melt butter , add onion , saut gently and add all other ingredients except the fish
2. Cut each fillet in half lengthwise
3. Place stuffing on each fillet , roll up and wrap a thin slice of bacon around each roll
4. Place in a buttered ovenproof dish , cover and bake in a moderate oven for 15 minutes
5. Remove cover to brown the dish for last five minutes
6. Garnish with lemon wedges and parsley

title: prosciutto  spinach  and pasta casserole
steps:
1. Cook the pasta according to the package directions
2. Drain pasta
3. Rinse pasta with cold water
4. Drain again
5. In a large saucepan melt margarine or butter
6. Add onions or leeks , bell pepper , mushroms and garlic
7. Cover and cook about 5 minutes or until onions are tender , stirring occasionally
8. Stir in flour and aniseed
9. Add the milk and chicken broth all at once
10. Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly
11. Stir in parmesan cheese
12. Stir in the cooked pasta , spinach , and prosciutto
13. Spoon the mixture into a 2-quart casserole
14. Cover and bake in a 350 degree f oven for 25 to 30 minutes or until heated through
15. Let stand about 5 minutes
16. To serve , stir gently and top with chopped tomato

title: jan s country potatoes
steps:
1. Mix hash browns , sour cream , cheese , soup onion , and butter
2. Put in a 9x13 casserole dish
3. Mix crumbs and butter and sprinkle on top
4. Bake at 350f for 1 hour

title: asparagus tip   prosciutto puffs
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees
2. Wrap each asparagus
3. Set aside until needed
4. Roll out puff pastry sheets on a lightly floured board
5. Brush the rolled out puff pastry with the mustard
6. Cut the prepared pastry into 2" squares
7. Place the reserved prosciutto & asparagus
8. Roll the pastry around the asparagus , leaving the ends of the asparagus uncovered
9. Moisten with water to seal
10. Bake 1" apart
11. Bake 15- 20 minutes- serve hot

title: ligurian farinata  savory italian pancake or flatbread
steps:
1. In a large bowl , add the flour to the water , a little at a time , mixing and seasoning with salt until all of the flour and water has been absorbed
2. Add optional rosemary at this point
3. Let it rest for 4 hours
4. After this time , a layer of foam will have developed on the surface - scrape it off with a spoon
5. Add the olive oil and remove the rosemary - stir until all the oil is absorbed
6. Pour into an olive oil well greased baking pan - the right one is called testo , made of "tinned copper" it should be about an eighth of an inch thick , perhaps a little more - a small deep dish pizza pan will do
7. Preheat the oven to 400f
8. Remove from the oven when one of the corners starts to appear dark and has turned a golden color
9. Sprinkle plenty of pepper and eat immediately
10. It is of paramount importance that the pan is perfectly flat and level when in the oven , otherwise one of the corners will be thicker and will be undercooked when the opposite corner starts to darken
11. It tends to stick if you do not use enough oil
12. Also use parchment paper

title: mangia mangia balsamic vinaigrette on baby greens
steps:
1. Up to 3 days ahead:
2. Place vinegars , water , oregano , basil , pepper and garlic in a large glass jar
3. Shake to mix well
4. Slowly add olive oils , stirring constantly to mix well
5. Refrigerate until needed - bring to room temperature before serving and shake to mix
6. To serve:
7. Place desired amount of mixed baby greens in a large bowl
8. Add dressing to coat and toss to mix well
9. You can use this tangy dressing on any mixed green salad
10. The recipe makes enough dressing for several occasions
11. Try drizzling the vinaigrette on steamed asparagus or toss with julienne zucchini

title: north african lentil soup
steps:
1. Rinse lentils several times in cold water , setting aside to drain
2. Heat garlic in olive oil in large saucepan , being careful not to scorch garlic
3. Add onion and saffron and cook , stirring , until onions are tender
4. Add carrots , celery , and turnip , cooking 10 minutes over low heat
5. Add lentils , broth , tomatoes , and parsley
6. Season to taste with salt and pepper
7. Bring to a boil , then reduce heat and cover
8. Simmer over low heat 1 1 / 2 hours until lentils are tender and broth is slightly thickened
9. Add lemon juice just before serving

title: italian fish portions
steps:
1. Cook onion& garlic in oil in heavy saucepan til onion is tender but not brown
2. Stir in cornstarch , undrained tomatoes , oregano , sugar , salt& pepper
3. Cook& stir until thickened& bubbly
4. Then cook& stir for another 2 minutes
5. Meanwhile , cook or bake fish portions according to package directions
6. To serve , spoon hot tomato mixture over fish& sprinkle with cheese

title: crabzilla s spicy chunky garlicky spaghetti sauce
steps:
1. Heat olive oil in a large , deep pot
2. Saute onion , garlic , and mushrooms until soft and slightly browned
3. Add basil , oregano , black pepper , salt , and crushed red pepper flakes
4. Saute for an additional 10 minutes , stirring frequently , being careful not to burn the herbs
5. Add all the canned tomatoes , tomato paste , stir real well , and bring to a boil
6. Boil for about 10 minutes and use a potato masher to crush the whole tomatoes
7. Add red wine and continue to boil for another 2 minutes
8. Turn down to a low simmer , and simmer for at least 6 hours , stirring now and then
9. I usually put a lid on to partially cover the pot for the first 3 hours and then remove it for the last 3 hours to let the sauce reduce , it should end up a nice deep , rich red color
10. Serve over your favorite pasta and fix up a nice green salad and crusty loaf of bread to make a complete meal
11. Let sauce cool before freezing- can be frozen in whatever size portions you like using zip-lock freezer bags

title: ranch pretzels
steps:
1. Pour pretzels into a 2 gallon re-sealable baggie
2. Mix the first 5 ingredients and pour over pretzels
3. Shake and coat
4. Stand for 12 hours , stirring occasionally
5. Bake at 350 degrees for 15-20 minutes

title: tilapia baked in couscous
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 375
2. In a large bowl , combine the couscous , almonds , sun-dried tomatoes , onion and cumin and season to taste with salt and pepper
3. Stir in the 1 / 4 cup olive oil and the lemon juice
4. Drizzle 1 tablespoon olive oil over the bottom of a 9-by-13-inch baking dish
5. Arrange the tilapia fillets in a single layer in the dish , season with salt and pepper and drizzle with the remaining 1 tablespoon olive oil
6. Cover the fish with the couscous mixture and arrange the lemon slices on top
7. Pour 2 cups water around the fish , cover with foil and bake until tender , about 25 minutes
8. Top with the parsley

title: toasted tuna sandwich
steps:
1. Pre heat broiler
2. In bowl mix tuna , green onions , chipotle peppers , roasted garlic , mayonnaise , and cheese
3. Slice rolls in half-length wise and divide tuna mixture , being sure to spread out evenly
4. Broil 3 to 5 minutes
5. Cheese should be melted and edges of bread toasted
6. Put 1 / 4 cup arugula on two of the halves and top each with remaining two halves
7. Enjoy while still nice and warm

title: pork wontons
steps:
1. Combine the pork , scallions , cornstarch , garlic , hoisin sauce , 1 tsp of the sesame oil , and the soy sauce in a medium bowl
2. Set aside
3. Arrange 6 wonton wrappers on a work surface
4. Place half a teaspoon of the pork mixture in the center of each wrapper
5. Moisten the edge of each wonton wrapper with water and pull one of the top corners diagonally over the filling to make a triangle
6. Press the edges firmly to seal
7. Bring left and right corners together above the filling
8. Overlap the
9. Place completed wontons on baking sheet lightly covered with cornstarch and cover with damp paper towels
10. Repeat with the remaining filling and wrappers , making a total of 40 wontons
11. Bring a large pot of water to a boil
12. Add the wontons , 20 at a time , to the pot
13. Return to a boil , stirring occasionally
14. Cook until the wontons float to the top , about 1 minute
15. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain
16. Toss the wontons with the remaining 1 teaspoon seasame oil to keep them from sticking together

title: vietnamese barbecued chicken wings   canh ga nuong
steps:
1. Mash garlic into a paste , using mortar and pestle
2. Mix honey , soy sauce , hoisin sauce , cilantro , and garlic paste together in a bowl , stirring well
3. Coat chicken wings with sauce
4. Marinate wings at least 2 hours , up to overnight
5. Bbq on grill over medium coals or heat , for 10-15 minutes , basting with remaining sauce

title: italian hot dish
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to package directions and drain
2. Spray a with cooking spray and cook beef , 1 / 2 cup mushrooms , onion and green pepper and drain fat
3. Stir in the tomato sauce , oregano , garlic powder , onion powder and pepper and bring to a boil
4. Reduce heat , cover and simmer for 15 minutes
5. Place pasta in an 8-in
6. Square baking dish coated with cooking spray
7. Top with meat sauce and remaining mushrooms
8. Sprinkle with 1 / 2 cup mozzarella and 4 teaspoons parmesan
9. Cover and bake at 350 for 35 minutes
10. Uncover and sprinkle with remaining cheeses
11. Bake 5-10 minutes longer or until heated through and cheese is melted

title: zydeco green beans
steps:
1. Into each of six sterile pint mason jars , put 1 sliced garlic clove and 1 teaspoon mustard seeds
2. Pack beans vertically into jar , adding 1 to 2 chilies , and , if you like , dill
3. In a nonreactive saucepan , bring vinegar , water and salt to a boil
4. Pour hot liquid over beans , covering them completely
5. Close jars and refrigerate at least one month before eating
6. Keep refrigerated

title: instant hot cocoa mix
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together and store in an airtight container
2. To make , fill cup 1 / 4 to 1 / 2 full with mix and pour in hot water or warm milk

title: grilled turkey breast with mango lime salsa
steps:
1. Slice turkey breast in half crosswise without cutting all the way through
2. Open like a book and set aside
3. In a bowl , whisk together cilantro , marmalade , soy sauce , olive oil , garlic , salt and pepper
4. Place turkey breast in self sealing plastic bag and turn to coat evenly
5. Let marinate in refrigerator for a least an hour and up to 2 days
6. Arrange on a greased preheated grill over medium heat
7. Grill , turning once until browned and cooked all the way through
8. Transfer to a cutting board and let rest for 10 minutes before slicing
9. Serve immediately or serve cold
10. Oven directions: to prepare turkey in the oven , arrange marinated turkey on foil lined rimmed baking sheet and roast in a 400f oven until turkey is cooked through and marinate is thick and bubbling , about 25 minutes
11. Nutrition information: 250 calories , 28 g protein , 15 g carbs , 9 g fat
12. Mango-lime salsa:
13. In a medium bowl , combine mango , onion , lime juice , cilantro jalapeno and salt
14. Let stand for 20 minutes before serving
15. Nutrition information: 55 calories , 15 g carbs , 1 g protein , 2 g fibre , 88 mg sodium

title: mini croissants with frosting
steps:
1. Blend butter , salt and cottage cheese , add flour gradually
2. Divide into 4 balls
3. Refrigerate 4 hrs or over night
4. Roll out each ball into a circle , cut into 8 slices roll each slice tightly
5. Bake 30 min @ 350
6. Frosting: mix all frosting ingredients until light and fluffy and spread over warm rolls
7. Enjoy !

title: siam dipping sauce
steps:
1. In a heavy sauce , bring the water to a boil
2. Add the remaining ingredients and return to a boil
3. Cook for 2 to 3 minutes or until the sugar is dissolved
4. Serve hot
5. Suggested dippers: fried wonton , egg rolls , noodle chips , seafood

title: batter fried fresh tomatoes
steps:
1. Sift together flour , baking powder and salt
2. Add beaten egg and mix well
3. Slice tomatoes into thick slices and sprinkle with salt and pepper
4. Dip tomato slices in batter , and fry in a hot greased skillet until brown on both sides
5. Good for breakfast or lunch , served with bacon

title: my sweet   sour baked beans
steps:
1. Combine all beans in a large bowl
2. Cook bacon and add to beans
3. Saute onions in bacon grease until translucent and soft
4. Drain some of the grease
5. Mix together brown sugar , cider vinegar and dry mustard
6. Pour over onions in frying pan and bring to a boil
7. Pour over bean / bacon mixture and mix well
8. Pour into 9 x 13 baking dish
9. Bake at 350f for 1 1 / 2 - 2 hours or until just thickened up

title: pan fried roasted chicken with rice
steps:
1. First , trim excess fat from thighs
2. Combine flour , oregano , thyme , cayenne pepper , garlic powder , salt , and pepper together and place in a bowl for dipping
3. Heat butter in skillet on stove on medium / high heat
4. Lightly flour each chicken on both sides then place in skillet
5. Combine cream of chicken and water then set aside
6. Cook in skillet for around 8-14 minutes turning a few times
7. When cooked thoroughly , slide chicken all to one side and add the wet mixture
8. Stir the mixture in and slide the chicken back
9. Cover and simmer 5-8 minutes
10. Enjoy

title: you ve got to be kidding me restaurant rolls  or bread
steps:
1. Thaw frozen dough , let rise , and bake dough all according to package directions- either for a loaf or rolls
2. When the bread has baked and while still warm , combine margarine and honey well and spread liberally all over the top of the warm bread
3. It should be glistening
4. You may serve right away , or you may prepare earlier in the day and set the warm , glistening bread inside a resealable plastic bag
5. It will stay very soft this way and can be reheated as desired later the same day
6. Serve warm with real butter or more honey margarine mixture , as desired

title: chocolate crispy peanut butter balls
steps:
1. Combine first 4 ingredients in large bowl and mix well
2. Roll dough into 1-inch balls and chill , covered
3. For chocolate coating , melt german and semisweet chocolates , and paraffin wax in top of double boiler over boiling water , stirring constantly until smooth
4. Use a toothpick to insert in each ball , dipping balls into chocolate mixture , one at a time
5. Set balls on wax paper to harden
6. Store in airtight container in refrigerator

title: sausage florentine bake
steps:
1. In a large saucepan or dutch oven , cook sausage until no longer pink
2. Drain
3. Add tomatoes , bay leaf , garlic , sugar , basil , oregano , salt and pepper
4. Bring to a boil
5. Reduce heat and simmer , uncovered , for 1 hour , stirring occasionally
6. Meanwhile , in a separate bowl combine eggs , 1 / 4 cup parmesan cheese , and nutmeg
7. Stir in spinach , cooked noodles , and onions
8. Discard bay leaf from sausage mixture
9. In each of two greased 9-in square baking pans , layer a fourth of the noodles and a fourth of the sausage mixture
10. Top each with 1 cup mozzarella cheese
11. Repeat layers
12. Top with remaining parmesan cheese
13. Bake , uncovered , at 350 for 30 minutes or unil bubbly
14. Let stand for 10 minutes before serving

title: balsamic honey tenderloin
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine the honey , mustard , vinegar , oil , garlic , salt and pepper
2. Add the pork , turning to coat
3. This can be done up to 24 hours before cooking
4. If not cooking immediately , cover and refrigerate until ready to do so
5. Reserving the marinade , place the pork on a greased grill over medium-high heat
6. Brush with the marinade
7. Close the lid and cook , turning occasionally , for about 18 minutes or until just a hint of pink remains inside
8. Transfer to a cutting board
9. Tent with foil and let stand for 5 minutes
10. Cut into 1 / 2-inch thick slices

title: cheesy kohlrabi
steps:
1. In a 2 quart saucepan over medium heat , in 1 inch of boiling water heat kohlrabi and salt to boiling
2. Reduce heat to low , cover and simmer for 30 minutes
3. Drain
