4. Meanwhile in a 3 quart saucepan over low heat , into hot butter , stir flour until smooth
5. Gradually add undiluted chicken broth and cook , stirring constantly , until mixture is thickened
6. Remove from heat and stir in cheese until melted and smooth
7. Add kohlrabi and cook until heated through
8. Sprinkle with the mixture with allspice , then garnish with the chopped parsley

title: berry breakfast power bar
steps:
1. Bring apples to boil , then simmer for 10 minutes until soft
2. Melt margarine , sugar & syrup in a large saucepan , then remove from heat
3. Add berries to hot mixture to allow time to plump up
4. Add all other ingredients
5. Mix well
6. Pat into 30cm x 20cm pan
7. Bake @ 180c for 25 minutes
8. Allow to cool for 15mins before cutting and removing from pan onto cooling rack

title: grandmother s buttermilk cornbread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. Grease an 8 inch square pan
3. Melt butter in large microwavable bowl
4. Stir in sugar
5. Quickly add eggs and beat until well blended
6. In separate container or large measuring cup , combine buttermilk with baking soda and stir into mixture in bowl
7. Stir in cornmeal , flour , and salt until well blended and few lumps remain
8. Pour batter into the prepared pan
9. Bake in the preheated oven for 30 to 40 minutes , or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean

title: lemon yum yum cake
steps:
1. Bake 1 lemon cake according to pkg
2. Directions in a 9x13 pan
3. Add enough water to pineapple juice to make 2 cups liquid
4. Prepare 1 pkg
5. Lemon pudding according to directions using the 2 cups liquid
6. Cool until warm
7. Fold in the pineapple
8. Spread over the cake
9. Mix topping ingredients together
10. Beat to soft peaks
11. Spread over pineapple mixture
12. Refrigerate till serving time

title: curried broccoli salad with bacon and cashews
steps:
1. Chop broccoli florets finely with a chef knife , or you may pulse"lightly" in a food processor until finely chopped
2. Toss broccoli with onions , raisins , and cashews in a mixing bowl
3. In another small bowl , stir together mayo , sour cream , sugar , vinegar , curry powder and salt
4. Use a whisk to blend well
5. Add dressing to salad and toss until vegetables are evenly coated
6. Cover and refrigerate for 2-3 hours
7. Garnish with crumbled bacon just before serving
8. Can be made up to one day in advance

title: salad with radish and green onions
steps:
1. Put salad greens in a large bowl
2. Arrange radish and onions on top
3. For the dressing mix all ingredients except oil in a small bowl until blended
4. Stirring constantly with a fork or small whisker add oil gradually until emulsified
5. Taste
6. If too sour add a little sugar
7. Pour dressing over salad and toss well
8. If you do so , you should consider reducing the amount of mustard used

title: toast hawaii   open faced sandwich for a snack or dinner
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Lightly butter both sides of the bread and place on cookie sheet
3. Layer ham then pineapple on one slice of bread
4. Sprinkle with marjoram and top with cheese
5. Bake for 7 to 12 minutes or until cheese is melted and sandwich is heated through
6. Serve hot
7. Try this with mayonnaise instead of butter , or 1000 island or ranch dressing
8. Serve with a fried egg for breakfast , or a salad for lunch or dinner

title: white bean soup with bay and pancetta
steps:
1. Heat the oil and butter in a large saucepan over medium heat
2. Add the onion , salt and bay leaves-cook until the onion is softened
3. Add the beans and stock , bring to the boil , then reduce the heat and simmer 10 minutes
4. Remove the bay leaves and puree the soup until smooth
5. Serve in soup bowls drizzled with olive oil and sprinkled with the crispy pancetta

title: fragrant crispy chicken legs
steps:
1. Marinate the drumsticks for 4- 5 hours , refrigerated
2. Improvise a steamer
3. Steam the drumsticks for one hour , covered with aluminum foil that has several small holes pierced in it
4. Air dry the drumsticks for a couple hours
5. When ready to deep fry , dredge the steamed drumsticks with cornstarch
6. Heat oil to 350- 375 and cook the drumsticks a few at a time until golden brown

title: pumpkin spice waffles
steps:
1. Preheat waffle iron
2. Combine flour , sugar , cinnamon , baking powder , ginger , nutmeg and baking soda in a large bowl
3. Mix well and set side
4. Whisk together eggs , milk , pumpkin pure and butter in another large bowl
5. Stir in flour mixture until a slightly lumpy batter forms
6. Spray waffle iron with cooking spray
7. Add batter and cook until waffles are set and golden brown , about 2 minutes
8. Serve sprinkled with chopped pecans and drizzle with maple syrup

title: t g i  friday s jack daniels grill salmon
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325
2. To roast the garlic for the glaze , cut about 1 / 2 inch off the top of the garlic head
3. Cut the roots so that the garlic will sit flat
4. Remove most of the papery skin , but leave enough so that the cloves stay together
5. Place the head in a small casserole dish or baking pan , drizzle the olive oil over it , and cover it with a lid or foil
6. Bake for 1 hour
7. Remove the garlic and let it cool until you can handle it
8. Combine the water , pineapple juice , teriyaki sauce , soy sauce , and brown sugar in a medium saucepan over medium / high heat
9. Stir occasionally until the mixture boils , then reduce heat to simmer
10. Squeeze the sides of the head of garlic until the pasty roasted garlic is squeezed out
11. Measure 2 tsp into the saucepan and whisk to combine
12. Add the remaining glaze ingredients and stir
13. Simmer for 40-50 min or until the glaze has reduced by about 1 / 3 and is thick and syrupy
14. Make sure it doesn't boil over
15. When the glaze is done , cover the saucepan and set it aside until the fish is ready
16. To cook the fish , preheat grill to med / high heat
17. Remove any skin or bones from the fillets
18. Brush the entire surface with a light coating of the butter spray
19. Lightly salt and pepper both sides and place them on the grill at a slight angle so that grill marks will be made
20. Cook for 2-4 minutes and turn them over
21. After 2-4 minutes , turn them over at a different angle so that the grill marks will criss-cross
22. Cook 2-4 minutes more , flip again and cook until done
23. The entire cooking time should be between 8-15 min depending on the thickness of the fillets and the heat of the grill
24. When the fillets are done , remove from grill and spoon a generous portion of glaze over each one
25. Serve hot

title: calamari in tomato sauce
steps:
1. Cut calamari into small strips
2. Place in saucepan and cook over medium heat for 15 minutes drain all but 1 cup of liquid
3. Add oil , garlic , chili pepper , sauce , parsley and salt
4. Cover and simmer for 25 minutes
5. Add wine and cook for an additional 5 minutes
6. Adjust seasonings to taste
7. Serve over cooked rice or noodles

title: cool drink
steps:
1. Place sultanas in a large container
2. Pour sugar over the top
3. Halve the lemons and squeeze the juice over the sultanas
4. Then add the lemon halves to the mix
5. Pour the boiling water over the mix
6. Stir well
7. Cover and stand for 24 hours
8. Strain through a sieve , keeping the fluid
9. Bottle and store in a cool place
10. Serve when wanted

title: ruth s stuffing
steps:
1. Fry onions and celery in olive oil and add to bread in a large bowl
2. Moisten with chicken broth or water until desired consistency is achieved
3. Add remainder of ingredients and mix well
4. Stuff into the turkey and enjoy !

title: grandpa s no nonsense chili
steps:
1. In a large stock pot or dutch oven , heat oil until hot
2. Add onion and garlic , cooking until the onions are opaque
3. Reduce heat to medium
4. Add the ground beef , ground turkey and salt and pepper to taste
5. Using a wooden spoon , work the ground beef and turkey until it is in small pieces
6. Add the celery and green pepper
7. Allow to cook for about four minutes , stirring occassionally
8. Add the chili powder , cayenne pepper and crushed red pepper
9. Add both cans of tomatoes and all of the beans
10. Add the ketchup and the tomatoe juice
11. Reduce heat to low or medium low and allow to simmer for 30 minutes to an hour

title: mochaccino smoothie
steps: 1. Blend all ingredients in a blender to desired consistency and serve

title: asparagus salad with fresh shallots
steps:
1. Place water in the bottom of a steamer pot , and bring to a boil
2. Set asparagus inside the steamer insert and cook , covered , for 4-6 minutes , until asparagus is tender but still maintains its shape
3. Meanwhile , in a small bowl , whisk together mustard and vinegar
4. Add the olive oil in a very thin stream , whisking constantly , until a thick emulsion forms
5. Place asparagus on a platter , drizzzle with dressing , and top with shallots and pepper
6. Enjoy !

title: darlene s cheese ball
steps:
1. Mix together and form into a ball
2. Chill overnight
3. Serve with crackers
4. May roll in finely chopped nuts or finely grated ham before chilling , if desired

title: festive cranberry stuffing
steps:
1. Mix broth , pepper , celery , cranberries and onion in saucepan
2. Heat to boiling
3. Cover and cook over low heat 5 minutes or until vegetables are tender
4. Add stuffing mix and mix lightly
5. Put into a greased 2 1 / 2 quart baking dish and heat in 325f oven for 20 minutes
6. This would probably come out just as good if it were stuffed into the bird

title: wasabi tuna burger with thai style cucumbers
steps:
1. Cucumbers:
2. Combine all cucumber ingredients in a sealable plastic storage container
3. Chill for two hours
4. Tuna burgers:
5. Remove any sinew from the tuna and chop into fine dice
6. Add the scallions , ginger , mustard , soy sauce and pepper and blend thoroughly
7. Do not over mix
8. Form into 4 equal portions and make patties
9. Chill for 1 hour
10. While the tuna patties are chilling , mix the wasabi powder with just enough water to make a paste
11. Allow to sit for 20 minutes
12. Add it to the mayonnaise and lime juice and chill
13. Heat a skillet and add about 2 tablespoons of the peanut oil
14. Cook the tuna burgers until just done , about 4 minutes per side
15. Place a piece of lettuce on the bottom of each bun and top with a few slices of cucumbers
16. Top with tuna burger
17. Then top with the bun top which has been spread liberally with wasabi mayonnaise
18. Serve with the remaining thai style cucumbers on the side
19. The preparation time does not include the chilling time

title: tayglach
steps:
1. Make a well of flour , salt and 1 tbsp sugar in a large bowl
2. Add oil and eggs and mix very well with wooden spoon
3. Dough will be quite elastic
4. Pinch off large egg-size pieces
5. Roll these between your hands until you have a piece as long as a drinking straw
6. Place on floured board and roll flat so it is~ 1 inch wide
7. Cut into 1 inch pieces
8. Place one almond and two raisins on each piece
9. Roll into a ball making sure that it is sealed completely
10. Set aside
11. In large pot bring honey , sugar and ginger to a boil
12. Drop the pieces in and reduce heat to medium
13. Cook for 35 to 40 minutes
14. Stir with wooden spoon as needed
15. Adjust your heat to maintain a slow rolling boil
16. Remove pieces from honey with slotted spoon and set aside
17. Turn heat to low , add hot water and cook down
18. Stir frequently
19. When mixture is 1 / 4 gone , remove from heat and return pieces to honey to coat again
20. Remove with slotted spoon to cookie sheet or flat platter to cool
21. At this time , you could sprinkle with crushed almonds
22. The wine is for your raisins , if you wish , to plump them
23. Make sure they are drained and patted dry before using
24. If you don't use the wine this way , you can do what i do and drink it !
25. The finished tayglach will be sticky and remain this way , as it should
26. You can store them in an air-tight container and they will keep nicely for several weeks
27. If you are creative , you can make a pyramid of them , sticking cut red and green candied cherries among them

title: ground lamb with orzo
steps:
1. Place the first 4 ingredients in a magic bullet and pulse to make fine breadcrumbs
2. In a bowl combine breadcrumbs and ground lamb mix well add egg mix well and shape into balls or sausages
3. Brown meatballs in a large skillet until cook thru remove and drain on paper towels
4. Remove all but about 2 tbl grease from pan
5. Add diced onion , garlic , crushed red pepper and tomatoes cook until onion is soft
6. Add orzo and toss for a few minutes
7. Return lamb meatballs to skillet
8. Add chicken broth
9. Simmer until orzo is cooked add half and half and spinach cover and cook until spinach is tender

title: chicken parmburgers
steps:
1. Mix ground chicken , parmesan cheese , bread crumbs and minced garlic
2. Shape into four 1 / 2 inch thick patties
3. Cook in olive oil in a non-stick skillet , turning as needed , 6 minutes or until cooked through
4. Top with pizza sauce and shredded mozzarella cheese
5. Cover
6. Cook 1 minute to melt cheese
7. Serve on toasted buns or english muffins

title: ham baked with orange glaze for gravy
steps:
1. Score the ham and place the cloves into the scores
2. Place the ham in oven-safe dish
3. Mix the brown sugar , mustard and orange juice and pour over the ham
4. Cook the ham until it is done
5. Drain off all broth and pour into a saucepan
6. Over low heat , thicken the broth with cornstarch and cold water until gravy consistency
7. Serve over mashed potatoes or the ham slices

title: creamy gruyere and shrimp pasta
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Cook pasta according to package directions
3. Drain well
4. Combine the flour and salt in a dutch oven over medium heat
5. Gradually add milk , stirring constantly with a whisk
6. Bring to a boil
7. Cook 1 minute or until slightly thick
8. Remove from heat
9. Stir in 3 / 4 cup cheese , stirring until melted
10. Heat butter in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
11. Add shrimp and garlic
12. Saute 3 minutes
13. Stir in wine and pepper , and cook 1 minute or until shrimp is done
14. Add pasta , shrimp mixture , and peas to cheese mixture , tossing well to combine
15. Spoon the pasta mixture into a 13 x 9 inch baking dish lightly coated with cooking spray
16. Sprinkle with remaining cheese
17. Bake at 375 for 20 minutes until cheese melts and begins to brown
18. Garnish with parsley
19. Serve immediately

title: d do s savory beef shank soup
steps:
1. Gently cook bones and 3 bay leaves in 3 to 4 quarts of water with 1 tbsp of salt for 3 to 4 hours
2. Put in enough water to barely cover bones / meat
3. Skim foam off every so often
4. Add a little water now & then to keep bones covered
5. When meat is falling off the bones remove and reserve
6. Saut the veggies before adding to the soup , to enhance the flavor
7. Saut the onions and celery with salt , pepper and italian seasoning
8. Add to soup
9. Slightly brown cubed squash
10. Add leeks , garlic and 1 / 2 tsp thyme cook until softened and fragrant
11. Add 1 / 2 tsp honey
12. Add to soup
13. Saut carrots and celeriac with salt and pepper , and add 1 / 2 tsp sage moments before adding the vegetables to the soup
14. If using canned tomatoes , break apart into 4 pieces with hands and add ot the pot ,
15. Simmer 30 minutes
16. Remove and break up meat from bones
17. Put small pieces into the pot along with the kale and simmer 10 more minutes

title: all day mushrooms
steps:
1. Wet a paper towel and wipe any dirt from the mushrooms
2. Place the mushrooms in a large stockpot
3. Add the remaining ingredients to the pot
4. The liquid will not cover the mushrooms at first
5. Cook , covered , over very low heat for 4 hours
6. Stir occasionally so that all of the mushrooms are completely coated with the cooking liquid
7. Remove the cover and cook for an additional 4 hours
8. The mushrooms will shrimk by half and become saturated with cooking liquid
9. Remove with a slotted spoon and serve in a bowl

title: teriyaki  dump  chicken oamc
steps:
1. Mix soy sauce , sugar , vinegar , oil , garlic , and ginger to make marinade
2. Freeze chicken in marinade in a 1-gallon freezer bag
3. When preparing to serve , thaw chicken
4. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
5. Pour chicken and marinade into a baking dish that has been coated with nonstick cooking spray
6. Bake for 35 minutes
7. Prepare rice according to package directions
8. Serve chicken over rice

title: pink party squares
steps:
1. Layer 1:
2. In a double boiler add
3. 1 / 2 cup butter , 1 cup brown sugar and 1 egg
4. Stir constantly until smooth and shiny
5. Remove from heat and add 2 cups graham crumbs
6. Pack into 9x9 pan
7. Layer 2:
8. Stir together 3 / 4 of a can of sweetened condensed milk and 8 ounces coconut
9. Spread on graham layer
10. Icing:
11. Combine 1 / 4 cup butter with 2 cups icing sugar and 1 tbsp milk
12. Add a few drops of red food coloring , until a nice pink shade is reached , and stir until smooth
13. Spread on top of coconut layer
14. Refrigerate at least 3 hours

title: alabama chicken
steps:
1. Cook chicken in water with bay leaf and debone
2. Cook spinach noodles in the chicken broth and drain , but reserving the broth
3. Saute' green pepper , celery , and onion in melted margarine / butter until tender
4. Add cubed velvetta and stir until melted
5. Next add green olives , mushrooms , cream of mushroom soup , and chicken
6. Blend sauce in cooked spinach noodles and place in slightly greased casserole
7. You may add more broth if needed
8. Top with cracker crumbs and dot with butter and bake 350 for 45 min

title: shredded chicken pasta with fried basil and feta
steps:
1. Boil salted water in a saucepan for the pasta
2. Cook until done
3. About 4 minutes for fresh , and 8 minutes for dried pasta
4. Drain and set aside
5. While pasta is cooking , rub salt and pepper on the chicken breasts
6. Heat olive oil in a large skillet
7. Cook the chicken in the oil about 3 minutes on each side or until juices run clear
8. Remove the chicken from the pan , and shred
9. Mix chicken and feta with the pasta
10. Add a little more oil to the pan and fry the basil
11. Remove when it is crispy
12. Top pasta with the fried basil and serve with lemon wedges
13. Enjoy !

title: no bake white chocolate cheesecake
steps:
1. Beat cream cheese and 1 / 4 cup of the milk in large bowl with electric mixer until well blended
2. Add remaining 1 cup milk and pudding mix
3. Beat about 1 minute or until mixed throughly
4. Gently stir in whipped topping until well blended
5. Spoon into crust
6. Refrigerate 4 hours or until set

title: bacon cheddar waffles
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , beat 1 egg
2. Add: milk , sour cream , melted butter or margarine
3. Stir in bisquick baking mix , mix well
4. Fold in: cooked and crumbled bacon strips and cheddar cheese
5. Spoon batter onto a hot waffle iron
6. Close waffle iron and cook until golden brown
7. Serve drizzled with: maple syrup or fruit-flavored syrup

title: cheesy potato puff
steps:
1. Place potatoes in a large dutch oven , cover with water
2. Add 1 / 2 teaspoon salt
3. Cook until tender
4. Drain
5. Mash potatoes until smooth
6. In a saucepan , cook and stir butter , cheese , milk , and remaining salt until smooth
7. Stir into potatoes
8. Fold in eggs
9. Pour into a greased 3-quart baking dish
10. Bake , uncovered at 350 degrees for 40 minutes or until puffy and golden brown

title: bacon rosemary frittata
steps:
1. Add the olive oil and 1 / 2 of the butter to a warm , oven-proof skillet
2. Just melt the butter preheat oven to 350 degrees fry the bacon until crispy
3. Do not drain the skillet remove the bacon and drain on paper towels
4. In a seperate bowl combine the eggs and half and half and beat well
5. Add the rosemary , salt and pepper
6. Add the last 1 / 2 tablespoon of butter to the skillet and just melt
7. Add the eggs
8. Cook over medium to medium low heat , tilting skillet until the bottom is coated and just starting to cook
9. Crumble the bacon over the eggs and add the cheese , reserving a bit of the cheese for later
10. Cook until just setting up , about 2 minutes
11. Do not stir the eggs or you will just scramble them
12. Remove from burner and bake for 15 minutes , sprinkling the reserved cheese over the top at the last minute to brown

title: pumpkin crumb cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Spray or grease one 9x13 inch pan
3. Reserve 1 cup cake mix for later
4. Prepare the crust by combining remaining cake mix with 1 egg and 1 / 4 lb
5. Melted butter
6. Mix well , spread in pan
7. Beat together the pumpkin , eggs , white sugar , brown sugar and cinnamon
8. Pour over crust
9. Combine reserved cup cake mix , sugar and butter
10. Crumble over filling
11. Add 1 / 2 cup chopped nuts if desired
12. Bake for 40 to 45 minutes

title: roasted apples with fig   hazelnut stuffing
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 180c
2. Combine the chopped figs , hazelnuts , orange zest and allspice
3. Using an apple corer , remove the apple cores
4. Place the apples in a baking dish and loosely press the fig mixture into the centre of the apples
5. Combine the sugar , butter and orange juice and drizzle it over the apples
6. Bake the apples for 25 minutes or until tender , then set aside for 10 minutes for the sauce to thicken slightly
7. Serve with the sauce spooned over the apples with cream or icecream

title: canned milk frosting
steps:
1. Cream together 1 / 2 cup sugar and margarine
2. Add remaining ingredients and beat till smooth and creamy

title: eight can casserole
steps:
1. Drain mushrooms
2. Mix everything except onion rings
3. Bake 350 for 20 minutes
4. Put onion rings on top
5. Bake 15 minutes longer

title: asparagus in orange sauce
steps:
1. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil
2. Add the asparagus and cook until just tender , 3-4 minutes , depending on the thickness
3. Drain into a colander and immediately refresh under cold running water
4. Drain and return to pot
5. Meanwhile , in a small saucepan , bring the orange juice , wine , and the broth to a boil over meium heat
6. Reduce until 1 / 4 cup remains
7. Whisk in the oil
8. Pour over the asparagus , tossing well to coat
9. Season with the salt and freshly ground pepper
10. Heat over low heat until the asparagus are hot
11. Serve warm

title: halibut with tarragon lemon breadcrumbs
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Melt butter in a small skillet over medium heat , add garlic , and saute 1 minute
3. Add breadcrumbs , tarragon , lemon zest , salt and pepper
4. Stir well
5. Place halibut on a parchment-lined baking sheet
6. Combine mayonnaise and horseradish
7. Spread over each fillet
8. Top with crumbs , patting lightly to help them adhere
9. Bake 10-12 minutes , or until fish is tender and crumbs are golden

title: sweet almond brittle
steps:
1. Combine almonds , margarine , sugar , flour and milk in a skillet
2. Let simmer for a few minutes
3. Pour mixture into 9 x 13 x 2-inch pan , lined with foil
4. Bake at 400f until golden brown , 10 to 15 minutes
5. Let cool on foil
6. When cool , peel off foil
7. Break up brittle and serve as is , or crumble over ice cream and garnish with fruit

title: spinach and bacon quiche
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 375f
2. Combine the eggs , cream , salt and pepper in food processor or blender
3. Layer the spinach , bacon and cheese in the bottom of the pie crust
4. The pour egg mixture on top
5. Bake for 35-40 minutes until the egg mixture is set
6. Cut into 8 wedges and serve

title: ravioli vegetable lasagna   spinach  artichoke  asparagus   yum
steps:
1. Orginal recipe just says 2 packages of frozen spinach - she used the small box size on tv
2. Original recipe stated 2 cans of artichokes
3. Zaar won't let you put in packages or cans without giving an ounces amount
4. Bring a pot of water to boil for ravioli
5. While water comes to a boil , drain defrosted frozen chopped spinach by wringing it dry in a kitchen towel , working over a garbage bowl or your sink
6. Heat a medium skillet over medium heat
7. Add extra-virgin olive oil and saute garlic in oil 1 minute , then sprinkle spinach into the garlic oil
8. Add artichoke heart pieces to the pan and turn to combine and heat through
9. Season vegetables with and remove from heat to a bowl
10. Place skillet back on the heat and melt butter
11. Whisk flour into butter and cook 1 to 2 minutes
12. Whisk stock into flour and butter and let it bubble
13. Whisk in cream and parmesan
14. Season sauce with nutmeg , salt and pepper and thicken 1 to 2 minutes
15. When water boils , salt water , add ravioli and cook 4 to 5 minutes
16. Ravioli should be less than al dente , still a bit chewy -- it will continue cooking when combined with sauce and vegetables
17. Place a colander over ravioli as it cooks and add asparagus to it
18. Cut thin , trimmed asparagus into 2-inch pieces on an angle
19. Steam the chopped asparagus while pasta cooks , 2 to 3 minutes , until just fork-tender , but still green
20. Remove asparagus and add to bowl with spinach and artichokes
21. Place colander in your sink and drain ravioli
22. Drizzle a touch of extra virgin olive oil onto the bottom of a medium oval casserole or a rectangular baking dish and brush pan to coat evenly
23. Arrange a layer using 1 / 2 of cooked ravioli in the dish
24. Layer 1 / 2 of the cooked vegetables over the ravioli
25. Next , add a few ladles of sauce , then vegetables , then top casserole with the last of the ravioli
26. Dot top of "lasagna" with any remaining sauce and cover liberally with gratedprovolone or 4 cheese blend
27. Brown cheese 8 inches from broiler , 5 minutes
28. By the time i assembled the ingredients , they were cold so i ended up having to bake the dish in a 400 degree oven for 15 minutes or so
29. This was supposed to be a 30 minute meal , but i think it took longer
30. Maybe after i've made it a few times , it would only take 30 -- either way it was still an easy recipe to make
31. I think this could be easily made ahead and reheated or frozen
32. I haven't tried freezing it yet , but it is yummy the next day

title: old fashioned oatmeal with bananas and raisins
steps:
1. In small pot bring the water and salt to boil
2. Slowly stir in the oatmeal , using a fork to break up any lumps
3. Once boiling has subsided , cover pan and cook on medium-low for 10-12 minutes
4. Remove pan from heating element and let sit , covered , for an additional 2-3 minutes
5. Transfer oatmeal to serving bowl and top with the sliced bananas , raisins and brown sugar
6. Serve with milk or milk substitute on the side if you wish
7. Yield: 1 large serving or 2 small servings

title: spicy molasses blueberry cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven 350 degrees
2. Grease and flour 8 inch squar pan
3. Mix soda and molasses
4. Cream butter and sugar , then add the egg and molasses mixture
5. Add sifted dry ingredients , alternately with the milk
6. Fold in the blueberries
7. Bake for 40- 45 minutes

title: omelet with smoked bleu cheese and caramelized bacon
steps:
1. Whisk the eggs in a bowl with some cracked black pepper
2. Stir in the blue cheese
3. Heat up the olive oil and / or butter in an omelet pan on medium heat
4. Pour in the eggs and cook gently until just ready to fold
5. Fold the sides in to the center of the omelet and plate
6. The bottom of the omelet should not be brown at all
7. Garnish with a small amount of bleu cheese , the crumbled bacon , chopped hazelnuts and fresh parsley
8. We served our omelet with steamed carrots and roasted small yukon gold potatoes for an easy weeknight meal

title: winter cold chaser chicken stew  slow cooker
steps:
1. 1
2. Put carrots , celery , potatoes , garlic and onion in bottom of slow cooker
3. 2
4. Mix chicken broth with gravy mix and basil
5. 3
6. Add chicken and bay leaf to slow cooker
7. 4
8. Pour chicken broth mixture over everything in slow cooker
9. Salt and pepper to taste
10. 5
11. Cover and cook for 7 hours , or until done
12. 6
13. Break out the crusty bread and enjoy

title: peanut butter and chocolate rolls
steps:
1. Place the yeast and warm water in a large bowl with the 1 / 4 tsp sugar
2. Stir with a fork to dissolve the yeast and allow it to stand for about 3 minutes
3. Whisk the unbleached flour , cocoa powder , the remaining 1 / 3 cup sugar and the salt together in a medium bowl
4. Set them aside
5. Using your hand , stir the coffee , the egg yolk , and the butter into the dissolved yeast
6. Gradually add the flour mixture , stirring until a shaggy mass forms and all of the flour is moistened
7. Move the dough to a lightly floured surface and knead for about 7 to 8 minutes , until it is silky smooth and elastic
8. This dough should be nice and moist , so add flour sparingly as you work
9. Shape the dough into a loose ball cover it with plastic wrap and let it rest for about 10 minutes to relax the gluten strands
10. Flatten the dough and stretch it gently with your fingers to form a rectangle about an inch thick
11. Spread the chips evenly over the rectangle
12. Fold the dough into an envelope and knead gently for 2 to 3 minutes , until the chips are well distributed
13. The dough should be soft , smooth , and springy
14. If the dough resists , let it rest for 5 minutes and then continue kneading it
15. Some of the chips may pop out of the dough , but they can easily be incorporated again after the first rise when the dough has softened
16. Shape the dough into a loose ball and place it in a lightly oiled bowl
17. Turn to coat the top of the dough with oil , and cover the bowl tightly with plastic wrap
18. Let rise at room temperature until the dough has doubled in volume , about 2 hours
19. Line two 12 by 17-inch baking sheets with parchment paper
20. Gently pour the dough onto the floured work surface pressing any loose chips into dough
21. Flour your hands lightly divide the dough into 12 equal pieces
22. Shape the pieces into rolls and place 6 on each prepared baking sheet leaving several inches between the rolls so they won't grow together as they rise
23. Cover them loosely with oiled plastic wrap and let them rise at room temperature until doubled in volume , about 45 minutes to 1 hour
24. While the bread is poofing make a cornstarch wash: put cold water in a small saucepan and whisk in the cornstarch
25. Bring to a boil , stirring frequently until it thickens
26. Remove from the heat and cover to keep a skin from forming
27. Set aside to cool
28. About 15 minutes before you're ready to bake , place one oven rack in the top third of the oven , and another in the bottom third , and preheat the oven to 400 degrees f
29. When the buns have doubled , use a pastry brush to paint them with a thin coating of the cornstarch wash
30. Brush gently so you don't deflate them
31. Place one pan on each oven rack
32. Using a plant sprayer , immediately mist the top and sides of the oven 6 to 8 times and quickly close the oven door
33. Repeat this misting procedure two more times at 1-minute intervals
34. Bake for 10 minutes , then reduce the oven temperature to 350 degrees f and rotate the pans from top to bottom and front to back to ensure even baking
35. Bake for 10 to 15 minutes longer , or until the tops of the buns feel firm but not hard when you press them slightly , and the bottoms are very lightly browned
36. These rolls should have a thin soft covering , not a hard crunchy crust
37. Remove from the oven and use the pastry brush to paint the top of each bun quickly and evenly with the cornstarch wash
38. Transfer the rolls to a rack and allow them to cool before serving

title: turkey moussaka
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Heat oil in skillet , add eggplant , saut 5 minutes per side
3. Remove
4. Add turkey and onion , stirring to break up clumps
5. Cook until browned , drain excess grease
6. Add tomatoes to skillet , add garlic , oregano , basil , tomato paste , cinnamon , salt , pepper
7. Stir until cooked through , 10 minutes
8. Spray a 3 quart baking dish with cooking spray and sprinkle with a thin layer of bread crumbs
9. Add a layer of eggplant , a layer of turkey mixture and sprinkle with parmesan
10. Top with bread crumbs , repeat layers
11. In a medium bowl stir together ricotta , feta , eggs and spread over casserole
12. Cover with aluminum foil
13. Bake for 1 hr 10 minutes
14. Remove from oven and remove tin foil
15. Increase oven temp to broil
16. Broil for 3-4 minutes until top is browned
17. Let this stand 10 minutes before slicing and serving

title: ham with pasta
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to directions
2. Drain
3. In a greased 3 quart baking dish combine pasta and ham
4. Add 1 cup of the cheese and 3 / 4ths of the onions
5. In a different bowl combine broth , soup , milk and seasoning
6. Pour over the pasta misture , mix well
7. Bake , uncovered at 350 degrees f
8. Bake for 30 minutes add remaining cheese and onions
9. Bake 5 more minutes or until heated through

title: uptown collards
steps:
1. Remove stems from collard greens
2. Wash leaves thoroughly
3. Cut leaves into 1-inch strips
4. Set aside
5. Put onion quarters in food processor
6. Process until smooth
7. Combine onion and next 4 ingredients in a large pot
8. Bring to a boil
9. Add collard greens and red pepper
10. Cover and cook on medium for 45 minutes to 1 hour or until greens are tender
11. Add additional water if necessary
12. Season to taste with salt and pepper

title: sara lee pound cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325f
2. Spray loaf pan
3. Mix all ingredients and put in pat at 325f and bake about 1 hour or until inserted knife comes out clean

title: roasted salmon with sweet n hot mustard glaze   robin miller
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400f coat a shollow baking dish with cooking spray
2. Season both sides of salmon with salt and pepper
3. Place salmon in prepared baking dish
4. Combine dijon mustard , honey , water , lemon juice , mustard powder and garlic in a medium bowl
5. Reserve 1 / 2 cup , and pour remaining sauce over the fish in the pan
6. Roast the salmon , uncovered , until fork-tender , about 15 minutes
7. Stir the dill into the reserved sauce and serve with salmon

title: ultimate chocolate chip bars
steps:
1. Mix margarine and sugars in a large bowl
2. Add eggs and vanilla , mixing well
3. Mix in flour , baking soda and salt
4. Stir in chocolate chips and nuts
5. Spread in a greased 9 x 13" baking pan
6. Bake at 350f for 25 minutes
7. Allow to cool before cutting into bars

title: cream spinach stuffed tomatoes
steps:
1. Place the cream in a small pot and reduce by half by gently simmering 20 minutes
2. Heat a medium skillet with olive oil over medium heat , add onions and garlic , season with salt and pepper and saute until translucent , 6 to 7 minutes
3. Drain the spinach by wringing dry in clean kitchen towel
4. Separate the spinach with your hands and add to onions and garlic
5. Season spinach with nutmeg then stir in the reduced cream
6. Adjust flavor with salt and pepper
7. Preheat broiler
8. Trim the tops off tomatoes and scoop out the seeds
9. Stuff tomatoes with creamed spinach and top each with 1 / 4 cup blue cheese
10. Broil to brown the cheese
11. Garnish the tomatoes with chives

title: roasted smoky turkey legs
steps:
1. Mix the salt , brown sugar , liquid smoke and water together until all is dissolved and pour the briny mixture over the turkey legs
2. Store in a covered container in the refrigerator for 24-hours to 72-hours
3. Rinse the brine off the turkey , pat dry with paper towels and roast at 350f for about 45 minutes
4. By this time , the turkey will almost be done , but the skin will still have a pale color , so i crank the oven up to 500f and roast the legs / wings until they are a rich mahogany color , then i flip them over and roast the other side until it is also deep brown

title: vegetable pot pie  vegan
steps:
1. Steam potatoes , carrots , and onion until tender
2. Add vegetable protein and peas
3. Mix lightly
4. Place this mixture in a casserole dish and set aside
5. Combine cream sauce ingredients in a bowl
6. Pour cream sauce ingredients into a saucepan and cook on low to medium heat , stirring constantly until thickened
7. Pour cream sauce over vegetables in casserole dish
8. Start pie crust by mixing whole wheat flour , unbleached white flour and salt together in a bowl
9. Blend together oil and water and then add this liquid mixture to the dry mixture
10. Stir
11. Roll out between two sheets of wax paper
12. Cover vegetables and cream sauce in casserole dish with pie crust
13. Bake in the oven , 424-450 degrees f , for 20 minutes or until nicely browned

title: edna s  fried rice
steps:
1. In a large , deep skillet , cook the bacon over medium heat , stirring occasionally , until crisp , about 15 minutes
2. Drain on a paper towel-lined plate and discard some of the bacon fat
3. Keep 1 tablespoon of bacon drippings
4. Return the skillet to the stove and turn the heat to medium high
5. Add 1 tablespoon of oil to the bacon fat
6. Add the onion , the celery , 1 / 2 of the green onions and cook for 4 minutes
7. Add the garlic , green pepper and mushrooms
8. Cook another 3 minutes
9. Add the cooked rice , soya sauce and stir to coat
10. Stir together
11. Push rice mixture on edge of pan and add beaten egg in the center
12. Let the egg set for 1 to 2 minutes , then scramble them with a fork and cook for 2 minutes more
13. Stir the eggs into the rice , breaking them up into small pieces
14. Turn off the heat
15. Add the bacon
16. Season to taste with salt and pepper
17. Transfer the fried rice to a serving platter and sprinkle with remaining chopped green onions
18. A great way to use leftover rice
19. It can be made ahead of time and frozen

title: crock pot swedish y meatballs
steps:
1. In bowl , combine breadcrumbs , beef , yolks , 2 tablespoons parsley , onion , salt , mustard , ginger , garlic , and pepper
2. With wet hands , roll heaping tablespoons of meat mixture into balls , about 60
3. Place in crock pot
4. In bowl , mix together onion soup mix , cream of mushroom soup , chicken broth , flour , and 2 tablespoons parsley
5. Pour over meatballs
6. Cook on high until cooked through

title: almond salad dressing
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together
2. Shake well

title: cafe joy
steps:
1. Combine the frangelico , malibu and baileys in coffee mug or appropriate glass
2. Pour in coffee
3. Top with whipped cream and toasted coconut

title: baked blintzes with fresh blueberry sauce
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees
2. Butter a 9 x 13 inch cake pan or baking dish
3. For the batter: place all the ingredients in the bowl of a food processor fitted with the steel blade and blend until smooth
4. Pour half of the batter into the prepared dish and bake for 10 minutes , until set
5. Meanwhile , for the filling , whisk together the ricotta , mascarpone , eggs , and sugar in a large bowl
6. Add the lemon zest , lemon juice , vanilla , and salt and mix until thoroughly combined
7. Spread the cheese filling over the baked pancake
8. Carefully spoon the remaining pancake batter to cover the cheese
9. Return the dish to the oven and continue baking 35-40 minutes , until the top is liqhtly golden and the filling is almost set
10. Remove from the oven and allow to stand 10-15 minutes
11. Cut the blintzes in squares and serve warm with the fresh blueberry sauce
12. Blueberry sauce: combine the orange juice , sugar and cornstarch in a medium saucepan and bring to a boil , stirring occasionally
13. When the mixture is translucent and thickened , stir in the blueberries and simmer for 4-5 minutes , just until a few berries have burst but most are still whole
14. Stir in the lemon zest and lemon juice and cool
15. Makes 2 cups

title: lamb stew with pasta
steps:
1. In a large saucepan cook the lamb and onion in hot oil until the meat is brown

4. Reduce heat

8. Reduce heat
9. Simmer , covered , for 15 minutes more or until meat , vegetables , and pasta are tender
10. Stir in tomato sauce
11. Heat through

title: spanish tomato basil soup   hcg phase 2
steps:
1. Pour broth in saucepan and add bay leaf
2. Pure remaining ingredients in a food processor or blender
3. Pour pure in saucepan with broth and bring to a boil
4. Reduce heat , cover and simmer for 30 minutes

title: easy garlic fries
steps:
1. Prepare french fries according to package directions

4. Toss well

title: herbed cheese stuffed salmon
steps:
1. Thaw fish , if frozen
2. Rinse fish
3. Pat dry
4. Preheat oven to 425
5. Finely shred enough peel from lemon to make 2 teaspoons
6. Cut lemon in wedges and set aside
7. In small bowl combine semisoft cheese and lemon peel

title: amazing real pumpkin pie
steps:
1. Cut and cook pumpkin

3. Use a blender , if you don't it will be stringy

8. Pour in and cook 425f for 10 minutes than lower temperature to 350f and cook for 60 minutes

title: great basic tomato sauce
steps:
1. If i want to use this as a the basis for a meat sauce or chilli sauce i don't usually bother to peel the tomatoes , when i want a silky smooth sauce that runs beautifully i do peel them
2. You choose peel tomatoes by covering with boiling water in a bowl for 5 minutes if you want the"smooth" recipe
3. Chop tomotoes into evenly sized pieces
4. Heat olive oil and saut garlic and onion until soft
5. Add tomatoes , tomato pure , basil , salt and pepper
6. Simmer gently got 30-40 until it reduces a little
7. Serve as is , or put in a blender until smooth

9. Adding browned minced meat makes a nice easy sauce for over pasta

title: bread machine amaranth and orange bread
steps:
1. Add ingredients to your bread machine in the order suggested by its manufacturer
2. Process on the bread cycle

title: cantaloupe  sopressata and feta salad
steps:
1. Combine cantaloupe chunks , sporessata and basil in a large salad bowl
2. In a small bowl , whisk lemon juice , olive oil , salt and pepper
3. Pour dressing over cantaloupe mixture , toss to coat
4. Sprinkle with feta cheese and serve

title: ginger glazed ham
steps:
1. Score ham , insert cloves in squares and bake at 170c for 45 minutes basting with the glaze until crisp and golden brown
2. Glaze:
3. Drain syrup from apricots , measure out 125ml and reserve remainder

5. Make reserved apricot syrup up to 250ml , with water if necessary

title: garlic asiago bread  abm
steps:
1. Place ingredients in bread pan of your bread machine in the order given or according to manufacturer's directions
2. Set the machine for the whole wheat cycle
3. Cool before slicing

title: paradise casserole by june
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 150c
2. Soak raisins in 1 / 2 cup reserved pineapple liquid
3. Combine flour and ginger powder
4. Cut steak into cubes and toss in flour mixture
5. Brown in oil
6. Place in oven dish
7. Saute celery and onions
8. Place in oven dish
9. Add stock , vinegar , tomatoes , brown sugar , salt and pepper
10. Cover and cook for about 2 hours or until cooked to your liking
11. During the last 30-40 minutes add carrots , crushed pineapple and soaked raisins

title: chicken breasts with cheese sauce
steps:
1. Lay chicken breasts in a 9 x 13 baking pan
2. Salt + pepper to taste
3. Place thin onion slices over breasts
4. Melt together the remaining ingredients and pour over the chicken
5. Bake at 325 degrees for 1 hour covered
6. Do not let bubble
7. Cook slowly

title: cream cheese butter cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Sift together already sifted flour with salt and cinnamon and set aside
3. Cream butter and cream cheese together
4. Gradually add sugar and mix well
5. Then , beat in egg yolk , vanilla and orange rind
6. Next , slowly blend in flour , salt and cinnamon mixture
7. Using any type of cookie cutter or cookie press , form cookies on ungreased cookie sheet 1 apart
8. Bake 12-15 minutes
9. Let cool-eat-enjoy

title: halloumi cheese balls
steps:
1. Mix the grated halloumi with the mint and the beaten eggs and set aside
2. Mix the flour with salt , combine with the oil and water until it
3. Becomes a soft dough
4. If needed add more water
5. Roll out the dough until it is sufficiently thin , then cut into circles approximately 75mm / 3 in across
6. Brush each piece with beaten egg , and add a spoonful of filling
7. Fold over the dough so as to enclose the filling and press the edges until they are sealed
8. Finally , deep fry them in very hot oil until golden brown

title: ma s egg foo yong
steps:
1. Egg foo yong:
2. Beat eggs , stir in salt , pepper & sherry
3. Heat 1 / 2 to 3 / 4 tbs of oil and stir-fry onion and bamboo shoots for 1
4. 5 minutes , add meat , bean sprouts and soy sauce , stir-fry one minute more
5. Remove from heat and cool
6. When cool stir into egg mixture
7. Heat 1 tsp oil in pan
8. Slowly pour in approx 1 / 4 egg mixture into mold
9. Cook until set & lightly brown , remove mold , turn and cook until other side is browned
10. Add more oil as needed
11. Sauce:
12. Bring all ingredients except water and corn starch to a boil
13. Dissolve corn starch in water , stir into mixture , bring to a boil until thickened
14. Serve over egg foo yong

title: san francisco vegetable soup over angel hair pasta
steps:
1. Combine , in a large sauce pan , the beef broth , all the frozen and fresh vegetables , and spices through the garlic salt
2. Bring to a boil , reduce heat and simmer covered for about 7-8 minutes
3. Add the pureed tomatoes and cook till heated through
4. Cook the pasta while the soup is heating , according to the package directions
5. Place pasta in 6 soup bowls , dividing evenly , and ladle the soup mixture over it
6. Sprinkle the cheese and parsley on top of the soup

title: ranch dressing from scratch
steps:
1. Get out a medium sized bowl
2. Measure the mayonnaise into it
3. Gradually whisk in the buttermilk or yogurt
4. If you use powdered buttermilk , whisk in the powder first , and then slowly add a cup of water
5. Then add the seasonings
6. Whisk again
7. Or you can make it in the blender by putting everything into the blender and whirling until smooth
8. The mixture will be a little thin , but it will thicken on standing
9. Store in a pint size jar , makes 2-cups
10. Keep in the refrigerator for a few weeks
11. Tastes really good with yogurt by the way
12. This is my favorite way of making it
13. It tastes good with powdered buttermilk too , but the consistency is thinner than with yogurt

title: cowboy candy
steps:
1. Slice jalapenos , and place in a small sauce pan
2. Add water and sugar
3. Cook over medium heat until boiling
4. Reduce temperature to low , and simmer until the liquid has reduced , and the sugar water has become syrup-like
5. Let cool and place in clean jelly jar
6. Store in refrigerator

title: apricot wings
steps:
1. Bake drumettes on a foil lined tray for 30 minutes at 350
2. Drain
3. Mix jam , vinegar , soya and spices into a bowl
4. Microwave until warm so it spreads easier
5. Brush over chicken , continue to turn and brush with sauce every 2 minutes for 20 minutesor till tender

title: zesty beef casserole
steps:
1. Heat cooking oil in large frying pan on medium
2. Add next 4 ingredients
3. Scramble-fry for about 10 minutes until beef is no longer pink
4. Drain
5. Add tomatoes with juice
6. Stir
7. Transfer to ungreased 3 quart casserole
8. Add next 7 ingredients
9. Stir
10. Bake , covered , in 350f oven for about 1 hour , stirring once at halftime , until noodles are tender but firm
11. Sprinkle with cheese
12. Bake , uncovered , for another 5 to 10 minutes until cheese is melted
13. Garnish with olives

title: cranberry casserole
steps:
1. Spray a 2-quart casserole with cooking spray
2. Chop the apples
3. Put apples , cranberries and sugar in the casserole and combine
4. In a medium bowl combine oats , brown sugar , flour , pecans and margarine
5. Top fruit mixture with oat mixture
6. Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour , until bubbly and light brown
7. Great warm as a side dish or as dessert with vanilla ice cream !

title: baked chicken thighs
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
2. Melt butter in skillet and remove from heat and mix in mustard
3. On a plate , combine crumbs , cheese , parsley , salt and pepper
4. Dip chicken in butter / mustard and then pat crumbs on the chicken
5. Place the chicken in a 9" x 13" baking dish and bake for 45 minutes-

title: homemade spice mix
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine the 7 ingredients as listed
2. Store in an airtight container for up to 6 months

title: extra cheesy garlic bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to broil
2. In a large bowl combine cheeses , mayonnaise , and garlic powder
3. Spread mixture on both sides of bread and broil for a few minutes until cheese is golden brown and bubbly
4. Slice and serve immediately
5. Feel free to add any extras to this like herbs or spices , tomatoes , pesto --
6. Enjoy !

title: cheese enchiladas in yummy red sauce
steps:
1. Sauce:
2. Place garlic in cold , non-reactive large sauce pan with oil
3. Bring up to a medium heat , stirring so that garlic doesn't scorch
4. Saut for 1 minute , then add onions
5. Add remaining dry spices and saut for 3-4 minutes , to develop oil & spices' flavors
6. Add remaining ingredients , except cilantro
7. Simmer gently on low for 30 minutes
8. Add cilantro at the end
9. Cool , and then chill overnight in fridge to let flavors meld
10. Enchiladas:
11. Preheat oven to 350
12. Spray a 9 x 13 lasagna pan thoroughly with pam
13. Spread 1 cup of enchilada sauce in bottom of baking pan
14. Combine cheeses , chilies , onions , and olives in large mixing bowl , tossing gently to thoroughly mix
15. Stuff and roll enchiladas with 2 / 3 of the cheese mixture
16. Place them , seam-side down in pan in two rows of 4-5
17. Long the long side of the pan
18. When all are in pan , pour remaining enchilada sauce first over the outside edges , then once down the center
19. Spread remaining cheese mixture on the two lanes that remain uncovered by sauce
20. Bake , uncovered for 25-30 minutes , until bubbly and melted
21. Cool for 5 minutes to re-congeal before serving
22. Makes 8-10 enchiladas , serving 4-6 people
23. For vegetarian option use vegetable broth

title: slow cooker moo shu pork
steps:
1. Stir together hoisin , garlic , sesame oil , soy sauce and cornstarch
2. Set aside
3. Place coleslaw mix and carrots into slow cooker
4. Cut the pork into 1 / 8-inch thick slices , then cut each slice in half lengthwise
5. Sprinkle on top of cabbage mixture in slow cooker
6. Drizzle with 1 / 4 cup of hoisin sauce mixture
7. Cover and cook on high for 4 hours or low for 6 hours
8. Remove cover
9. Stir in remaining 1 / 4 cup hoisin sauce mixture
10. Heat tortillas according to package
11. Place 1 / 2 cup pork mixture in center of each tortilla , top with scallion strips , if desired , roll up

title: oreo and peanut butter brownie cupcakes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f degrees and line a 12 muffin cup baker with paper liners
2. Prepare brownie mix according to package directions
3. For each cupcake cup spread 1 / 2 teaspoon of peanut butter over each oreo cookie and stack them on top of each other
4. Place oreo stacks into the cupcake lined muffin cups
5. Spoon 2 tablespoons of brownie batter over each stacked oreos and let it run down the sides of the cookies
6. If you have left over brownie batter , bake separately in a separate baker or muffin tin
7. Bake cookies and brownies for 18 to 20 minutes , until brownies are cooked through
8. Let cool completely then serve
9. Makes 12 servings

title: perfect chicken fried steak with classic brown gravy
steps:
1. Salt and pepper both sides of the meat
2. Mix flour , thyme , garlic powder , onion powder and coat both sides of each steak with flour mixture
3. Now dip each steak in egg wash on both sides
4. Finally put back in flour mixture on both sides again
5. Fry in 350 degree oil browned on each side
6. You can either pan fry with or deep fry
7. It's your choice
8. Both methods turn out fantastic ! fry until deep golden brown
9. Let rest for a few moments on a paper towel
10. For the gravy -
11. Brown onion in butter until caramelized
12. Add flour and whisk for a few minutes until rawness is out of flour
13. Now add beef stock and whisk until it starts to thicken up
14. Simmer for 10 minutes
15. Add cream and mix throughout and pour over chicken fried steaks and enjoy
16. This is an excellent recipe and i think you'll agree
17. If you want to have more of a traditional white pepper gravy , use whole milk instead of beef stock
18. Still add the cream and add more pepper
19. Enjoy !

title: cheddar cheese sauce
steps:
1. In a saucepan mix soup and milk
2. Heat over low heat , stirring often
3. Serve over broccoli , cauliflower , carrots , baked potatoes , french fries , or pasta

title: velvet cakes
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients
2. Add enough milk to make batter the right consistency

title: super easy chicken casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Prepare stuffing mix as directed on package and set aside
3. Warm oil in pan on medium heat
4. Add chicken and cook until no longer pink
5. Add soup and mixed vegetables
6. Cook until vegetables are no longer frozen
7. Spoon into 2-qt
8. Baking dish
9. Sprinkle cheese on top of mixture
10. Layer stuffing on top of cheese , making sure to make it an even layer
11. Bake 30 minute or until heated through

title: raspberry oat muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. In a skillet on stovetop , toast the oats until golden brown
3. Set aside
4. Blend the wet ingredients in a bowl
5. Add the dry ingredients
6. Mixture will be lumpy
7. Fold in the oats and then the berries
8. Spoon into 12 greased muffin cups
9. Bake for 20 minutes and remove from pan immediately

title: avocado b l t burgers with caramelized chipotle onions
steps:
1. For caramelized onions , combine onion , pepper sauce , broth , vinegar , oil , garlic , and brown sugar in a 10-inch nonstick skillet with a lid
2. When coals are ready , place covered pan on grill rack
3. Cook onion mixture for 15 to 20 minutes , stirring occasionally , until onions are caramelized and most of liquid is evaporated
4. Remove pan from grill and set aside
5. For spread , combine spreadable cheese and blue cheese in a saucepan
6. Cover and set aside
7. For burgers , place ground beef in a large bowl
8. Add onion , red wine , herbs , pepper sauce , and seasoned salt
9. Mix gently
10. Shape beef mixture into 6 round patties
11. Brush grill rack with vegetable oil
12. Place patties on grill rack , cover , and cook about 4 minutes
13. Turn and continue cooking until cooked to desired doneness
14. Meanwhile , place saucepan with cheese spread on outer edge of grill rack to warm cheese mixture just until it reaches a very soft , spreading consistency
15. Remove saucepan from grill and set aside
16. During final minutes of grilling patties , brush avocado with balsamic and sprinkle with spicy seasoned salt
17. Arrange avocado slices on a rimmed nonstick perforated grilling pan coated lightly with oil , and grill alongside patties for 1 to 2 minutes , turning as necessary
18. During final 30 seconds , add bacon slices to pan
19. When avocados are nicely grilled and bacon is crisp , remove from grill
20. When patties are cooked , remove from grill , stacking to keep warm
21. Place rolls , cut side down , on outer edges of grill to toast lightly
22. To assemble burgers , spread a generous amount of cheese spread over cut sides of rolls
23. On the bottom of each roll layer lettuce , a tomato slice , beef patty , caramelized onions , grilled avocado , and bacon
24. Add top and serve

title: chickpea and pasta soup
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients , except pasta , lemon juice and salt in a slow cooker
2. Cover and cook on high 3-4 hours , adding pasta during last 20 minutes
3. Season to taste with lemon juice and salt

title: gold rush scramble
steps:
1. Melt butter or margarine in skillet over low heat
2. Add combined eggs , milk , tomato and seasonings
3. Cook slowly stirring only occasionally until eggs are set
4. Add process cheese spread and cook until cheese begins to melt

title: sauerkraut tomato soup
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a slow cooker
2. Cover , and cook 4-6 hours , or until the flavors have blended and the soup is thoroughly heated

title: dole s holiday ambrosia
steps:
1. Drain pineapple
2. Drain oranges
3. Combine pineapple , oranges , grapes , marshmallows , coconut , and nuts
4. Mix sour cream and sugar
5. Stir into fruit mixture
6. Chill well and serve

title: kapernschnitzel  veal cutlets with capers
steps:
1. Sprinkle cutlets with lemon juice and season with salt , pepper , paprika and flour
2. Heat oil in a frying pan and fry cutlets for 3 minutes on the first side
3. Turn cutlets over and add drained capers to pan
4. Fry again for 3 minutes
5. Remove cutlets and arrange on a preheated platter
6. Pour wine into pan , scraping loose any brown particles from bottom of the pan
7. Add bay leaf , simmer liquid 3 minutes
8. Remove bay leaf
9. Blend in evaporated milk or cream and adjust seasonings
10. Pour over cutlets
11. Cut beets into strips and arrange on lettuce leaves as a garnish

title: spicy shrimp and bok choy stir fry  south beach diet phase 1
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine the shrimp , scallion whites , and garlic
2. In a wok or large non-stick skillet , heat oil over medium heat
3. Add shrimp mixture and cook , stirring occasionally , until shrimp turns pink and are cooked through , 3-4 minutes
4. Transfer to a large bowl
5. Return the pan to medium heat
6. Add bok-choy , cover , and cook , stirring occasionally until crisp tender , about 3-4 minutes
7. Drain any liquid from the skillet and add bok choy to bowl with shrimp
8. Return the pan to medium
9. Add soy sauce and chili garlic sauce
10. Stir to combine and bring to a boil
11. Add shrimp mixture and toss until coated
12. Cook briefly just to reheat
13. Still in scallion greens

title: jude s deviled eggs
steps:
1. Cut eggs lengthwise and remove yolks
2. Combine onions , miracle whip and mustard in a bowl with a fork
3. Add salt and pepper as needed
4. Put yolk mixture into a pastry bag and pipe back into the egg halves
5. Sprinkle with paprika or chopped chives

title: roast beef barbecue
steps:
1. In a small saucepan , combine the first nine ingredients
2. Cook over medium-high heat for 4-6 minutes or until heated through
3. Serve on buns , using a slotted spoon

title: goddess chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Place chicken breasts in a large baking pan with sides
3. Add artichoke hearts and sundried tomatoes
4. Whisk together water and dressing
5. Pour over chicken and vegetables
6. Turn the chicken several times to coat
7. Bake the chicken , uncovered , for 25-30 minutes , flipping chicken once and spooning the sauce over it during baking

title: apples with kahlua dip
steps:
1. Whip cream until a soft peak forms
2. Add kahlua and brown sugar
3. Mix just until blended
4. Fold in raisins if desired
5. Core and slice apples into inch slices
6. Serve by arranging apple slices around a large platter , put a bowl of the dip in the middle with pecans sprinkled on top

title: pineapple chicken burritos
steps:
1. Place the chicken in the crock pot and top with the pineapple , beans and salsa
2. Cook on low for 6 to 8 hours
3. Remove the chicken and shred
4. Mix the chicken back into the crock pot mixture
5. Mix in the cooked rice , cumin , garlic salt and onion salt
6. Use half of the mixture to fill 8 of the burrito tortillas
7. Allow the other half to cool
8. Place the 8-ish burritos in a 9x13 pan
9. Pour 1 can of the green enchilada sauce over the burritos
10. Top with 1 cup of the shredded cheese and place under the broiler on the middle rack until the cheese is nice and melted
11. Enjoy !
12. With the remaining cooled filling mixture , place it in a gallon sized freezer bag and freeze for another meal
13. You can also place the remaining tortillas and shredded cheese in separate freezer bags to freeze along with the mixture for a future meal if you would like
14. To use the frozen meal , thaw the filling , tortillas and cheese and reheat the filling mixture
15. Then follow steps 4-6 to complete
16. The cooking time is roughly 6
17. 5 crock pot hours and 10-15 broiler minutes

title: moroccan chickpea salad
steps:
1. Put chickpeas in a large saucepan
2. Add water to cover and stir in 1 tsp of salt
3. Bring to a boil over high heat , then lower heat to medium and simmer until tender , about 1 hour
4. Drain the chickpeas and discard any loose skins
5. In a serving bowl , combine all the remaining ingredients
6. Add the chickpeas and toss well
7. Cover and refrigerate for atleast 4 hours before serving

title: ham and cheese savory dutch baby
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 425f melt the butter in a 12-inch cast iron skillet over low heat
2. Mix the eggs , flour , and milk in a blender on medium speed until just blended , 5 to 10 seconds
3. Pour the batter into a medium bowl and add the cheese and ham , folding them into the mixture
4. Pour into the skillet with the melted butter
5. Placee the skillet in the oven and bake until the top puffs up and is lightly golden , 20 to 25 minutes
6. Cut into six wedges and serve immediately

title: gluten free  low fat  spiced carrot cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Spray 9 inches round cake pans with cooking spray
3. Line bottoms and sides with parchment paper cut to fit pans
4. In a bowl , combine carrots and ginger , and dust with 1 / 2 cup flour
5. Toss with fingers , making sure that all pieces are coated with flour
6. Retain excess flour
7. Do not discard
8. Sift all dry ingredients together
9. On low speed , using hand mixer or stand mixer , mix all wet ingredients together in a large bowl
10. Add dry ingredients to wet ingredients in mixer bowl
11. Mix on medium speed until incorporated
12. Add carrot , ginger and flour mixture to batter
13. Mix on low speed just until incorporated
14. Pour half the batter into each prepared cake pan , and bake in middle of pre-heated oven for 45 minutes , rotating pans half way through baking time
15. Check for doneness by inserting a toothpick
16. Add time if necessary
17. When toothpick comes out dry , remove pans from oven and allow to cool 10 minutes
18. Turn cakes out onto baking racks , and allow to cool completely before frosting
19. Frost cakes if desired
20. For fat-free cream cheese frosting , combine 8 oz
21. Packages fat-free cream cheese with 1 1 / 2 teaspoons pure vanilla extract , 1 cup sifted confectioner's sugar and 2-3 tablespoons milk
22. Mix on medium speed until smooth and fluffy

title: geschnetzeltes
steps:
1. Heat oil in skillet and heat meat in portions for 1-2 minutes
2. Season with salt and pepper
3. Take out all the meat and put to the side
4. Add onions and mushrooms to the pan and saute for 2 minutes
5. Sprinkle on flour and saute for 1-2 minutes
6. Add cream and wine and reduce a little
7. Add the meat and heat through
8. But be careful not to leave the meat in too long or it will become tough
9. Season with salt , pepper , sugar and lemon juice to taste

title: finger lickin  oven barbecue chicken
steps:
1. Pour canola oil into a large frying pan and heat over medium heat
2. Add chicken pieces and brown well
3. Remove chicken and place in a 9x13-inch baking pan
4. Preheat oven to 350f
5. Add onion to the frying pan and stir well
6. Scraping up and brown bits from the chicken
7. Saut about 2 minutes
8. Meanwhile , in a mixing bowl combine remaining sauce ingredients and stir to mix well
9. Pour sauce mixture into frying pan with onion and stir to combine
10. Simmer sauce for 15-20 minutes to allow the flavors to blend
11. Pour over chicken , then flip pieces so that both sides of the chicken get coated with sauce
12. Bake chicken for 30 minutes or until juices run clear
13. The remainder of the sauce can simmer gently while the chicken bakes

title: lemon pecan sunburst coffee cake
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 375f
2. Grease a 9-inch round cake pan
3. Separate the biscuit dough into 8 biscuits
4. Place 1 biscuit in the center of the pan
5. Cut the remaining biscuits in half , forming 14 half-circles
6. Arrange these pieces around the center biscuit in a sunburst pattern , with all the cut sides facing in the same direction
7. I overlapped the circle sides and let the flat sides rest on the bottom of the pan
8. In a small bowl , combine the pecans , granulated sugar , and lemon zest
9. Mix well
10. Brush the tops of the biscuits with the melted butter and sprinkle with the pecan mixture
11. Bake 20-25 min , or until golden brown
12. Meanwhile , in a small bowl , combine the confectioners' sugar , cream cheese , and enough lemon juice to make a pourable glaze
13. Beat until smooth
14. Drizzle the glaze over the warm coffee cake
15. Let stand for 10 min , or just until the glaze is set
16. Serve warm

title: oven baked walla walla sweets  onion
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Peel outer dry skin from onion and wash
3. Cut hole in top of onion large enough to put boullion cube and butter
4. Fill with cube with butter then boullion cube or crystals
5. Place onion on aluminum foil and wrap around onion with slight "vent" in top
6. Bake for 1 hour

title: grilled lamb riblets
steps:
1. To make the glaze: in a saucepan over medium high heat melt butter and oil together
2. Stir in shallots and saut for 4 minutes or until golden brown
3. Stir in garlic and saut for 2 minutes
4. Stir in thyme and cook stirring for 1 minute
5. Stir in honey and lemon juice and bring to a simmer , stirring until honey dissolves
6. Reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes , stirring frequently
7. Stir in mint and simmer stirring frequently for 10 more minutes or until glaze is thick
8. Add salt and pepper to taste
9. Cover and let stand for 3 hours
10. To prepare riblets: rub riblets with cut sides of lemons
11. Season both sides with spices , salt and pepper
12. Cover and let stand for 45 minutes while preparing barbecue grill
13. Prepare grill to medium high heat
14. Brush grill with oil
15. Place ribs on grill and sear for 8 - 10 minutes per side
16. Cover with grill lid or aluminum foil and continue grilling , turning occasionally for 20-30 minutes or until lamb is done
17. Uncover
18. Brush riblets with some of the glaze and continue grilling for 10 minutes or until lightly charred
19. Cut riblets into serving pieces and then arrange them on platter , garnishing with mint and lemon wedges

title: grilled hoisin chicken with mai fun
steps:
1. The night before preparing food , mix together marinade ingredients in a small bowl
2. Place chicken in a ziplock bag and add marinade and seal , removing as much air as possible
3. Refrigerate overnight , turning occasionally
4. The next day , well before preparing food , heat oil to a depth of 2-inches at 375-400f in a large skillet or use a deep fryer
5. Add small amounts of mai fun to hot oil and allow them to cook briefly
6. Remove them and drain as soon as they do this and set aside to use later
7. Whisk together ingredients for sauce in a small saucepan and bring to a boil
8. Lower heat and simmer for 3-4 minutes then remove from heat and allow to cool
9. Bring chicken out of refrigeration and allow to warm to room temp- 30-45 min , then drain from marinade , reserving marinade
10. Bring marinade to a boil in a saucepan , lower heat , and simmer for 2-3 minutes , then allow to cool
11. Use for basting chicken as it cooks
12. Prepare grill , allowing for cooking with indirect heat
13. Grill chicken using an indirect heat method , preferably charcoal , 45 min-75 min , depending on grill temp , or until chicken reaches an internal temp of at least 170f in the thickest part of the breast , basting occasionally
14. As chicken nears doneness , apply sauce mixture to chicken and allow to glaze and cook onto it , then remove chicken from grill
15. Sprinkle chicken with toasted sesame seeds
16. Arrange a bed of puffed mai fun on a serving plate and arrange chicken on top of it
17. Serve at once with other foods as desired

title: italian vegetable pasta salad
steps:
1. In a very large salad bowl , combine all vegetables and pasta
2. Pour dressing over salad and toss to coat
3. Cover and refrigerate overnight or at least 4 hours
4. Before serving , stir in cheese cubes

title: robin s shrimp creole
steps:
1. Saut onion , and bell pepper and margarine , until tender , in a large skillet
2. Stir in flour until thickened
3. Gradually add water and tomato sauce
4. Cook over medium heat until thickened and bubbly
5. Add cajun spice and reduce heat
6. Cook on low heat for about 10 minutes
7. Add shrimp and cover and simmer for 10-15 minutes or until shrimp is cooked , stirring occasionally
8. Serve over hot rice

title: chicken lettuce  tacos  with a sweet chili and peanut sauce
steps:
1. In a mini-processor , whizz together garlic , lime juice , soy sauce , olive oil and ginger until all combined and pureed
2. Put chicken strips into a ziploc bag , pour in marinade
3. Distribute to coat chicken well with marinade
4. Place in refrigerator and forget for 3-5 hours
5. Remove from refrigerator 30 minutes before you are ready to cook it to bring closer to room temperature
6. Drain everything in the ziploc bag directly into a hot teflon saute pan
7. Cook chicken , stirring occasionally , until cooked through , about 8 minutes
8. The marinade will have reduced into a glaze , just coating the chicken
9. Season , carefully
10. Empty the chicken out onto a serving platter
11. To make the sweet chili sauce , combine all the ingredients in a blender / food processor and puree until smooth
12. Pour into a small bowl
13. At table: have chicken on one platter and the lettuce cups with all the other vegetables and rice noodles on another
14. Don't forget the sweet chili sauce and the bowl of chopped peanuts
15. Allow free rein for creativity and great flavor packed into healthful oriental-style 'tacos' !

title: summer corn and cabbage salad
steps:
1. In a dutch oven , bring 2 quarts lightly salted water to a boil over high heat
2. Carefully add fresh ears of corn
3. Return to a boil
4. Lower the heat and simmer , covered , for 6 to 8 minutes or until corn is tender drain corn well
5. When fresh corn is cool enough to handle , cut off corn kernels
6. Hold an ear of corn at an angle so that one end rests on cutting board
7. Using a sharp knife , cut down across
8. Repeat with remaining ears
9. In a large bowl , combine the corn , cabbage , sweet pepper , and celery
10. To prepare the dressing , in a jar with a tight-fitting lid , combine oil , lemon juice , honey , mustard , salt , and black pepper
11. Cover
12. Shake well
13. Pour dressing over corn mixture
14. Toss to coat
15. Cover and refrigerate for 2 to 24 hours
16. To serve , spoon the salad onto leaf lettuce , if desired

title: cauliflower in a coat  dressed
steps:
1. Steam the cauliflower until tender
2. Whisk together the remaining ingredients
3. Pour the dressing over the cauliflower& serve

title: banana nut pineapple bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 , & lightly grease& flour 2 8-inch loaf pans
2. In large bowl , combine flour , sugar , baking soda , cinnamon& the salt
3. Stir in walnuts
4. In separate bowl , mix eggs , oil , banana , vanilla& pineapple until well combined
5. Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients , stir just until moistened
6. Pour equal amounts into pans
7. Bake about 50 to 55 minutes or until toothpick in center comes out clean
8. Cool for 10 minutes on racks
9. Remove from pans and continue cooling

title: daikon radish salad
steps:
1. Mix carrots and daikon
2. Mix everything else but seeds together mix pour over radishs top with seeds

title: menhaden  turkish omelette
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , whisk eggs well
2. Add salt and whisk again
3. In a frying pan , heat butter and saute the vegetables , except parsley , until almost done
4. Add the eggs to the sauteed vegetables
5. Add more salt if required
6. Garnish with more parsley and serve hot

title: mediterranean chicken stew
steps:
1. Lightly spray a covered nonstick pot with cooking spray
2. Add the chicken and brown over high heat for 2 minutes , turning chicken once
3. Lower the heat and transfer the chicken to a plate
4. Set aside
5. Add all remaining ingredients to the pot except the reserved chicken pieces
6. Bring to a simmer and cook for 2 minutes
7. Return the chicken to the pot , cover , and simmer for 30 to 40 minutes , until the chicken is barely falling off the bones
8. Divide the sweet potatoes and chicken between 4 shallow soup plates
9. Raise the heat under the pot and reduce the sauce for 2 minutes , stirring constantly
10. Pour some of the mixture over each serving
11. Serve at once

title: healthy breakfast biscuits
steps:
1. Mix the water , honey or sugar , yeast and 3 / 4 cup each of the whole wheat and golden white flours
2. Together
3. Let stand until light , about 15 minutes
4. Add the other 3 / 4 cup of each type of flour , along with the remaining ingredients and knead lightly
5. Roll or pat out on a lightly oiled counter top to 3 / 4-inch thickness
6. Dust top of dough with flour
7. Cut with biscuit cutter or glass dipped in flour
8. Place cut biscuits on parchment paper lined baking sheets
9. Let rise on pan 15 - 20 minutes , then bake at 350f until light brown , about 15 minutes

title: garden mint jelly with a hint of garlic
steps:
1. Wash mint thoroughly and divide into 2
2. Take the leaves from one bunch , squeeze out the surplus water and chop finely
3. Put vinegar and sugar into a saucepan with the second bunch of mint and stir over a low heat until the sugar has dissolved
4. Bring to the boil for 1 minute
5. Strain syrup through a muslin and return to the saucepan
6. Stir in the certo , bring to the boil and boil for 2 minutes
7. Add the chopped mint , garlic and chilli
8. Allow to cool slightly to prevent the mint from floating
9. Skim , pot and cover in the usual way

title: ww beef stew
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Heat oil in skillet
3. On medium-high heat , sear meat cubes in skillet until browned on all sides
4. In a separate bowl , combine canned tomatoes , tomato sauce , soy sauce , worcestershire sauce , beef stock , basil , salt and pepper
5. Mix thoroughly
6. Pour mixture over meat and vegetables in roasting pan
7. Cover and bake for 45 minutes at 350 degrees
8. Reduce heat to 250 degrees and bake for 2 hours or until meat is very tender to the fork
9. Baste occasionally

title: peanut butter tandy cake
steps:
1. Beat eggs until nice and yellow
2. Add other cake ingredients , except peanut butter and beat well
3. Spread batter onto greased 12x15-inch cookie sheet , and bake at 350 degrees for 12-15 minutes
4. Remove from oven and spread with peanut butter while still hot
5. When cool , frost with icing
6. To prepare icing , combine all icing ingredients and beat with electric mixer until smooth

title: oriental chicken stir fry
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine sherry , soy sauce , vinegar , ginger and cornstarch
2. Stir to blend well
3. In a wok or large frying pan , heat oil over medium-high heat
4. Add chicken and stir-fry 2 minutes until meat turns white
5. Add red pepper , scallions , mushrooms , and water chestnuts
6. Stir-fry 2 minutes
7. Stir sauce and add to wok
8. Stir over heat until sauce thickens
9. Serve over rice

title: macaroni   cheese casserole
steps:
1. Liberally butter a 2 quart casserole dish
2. Alternate layering macaroni and cheese slices in the buttered casserole
3. Beat eggs , milk , salt and pepper
4. Pour mixture over macaroni and cheese
5. Mix cracker crumbs with melted butter
6. Add to top of casserole
7. Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes or until a knife comes out clean when inserted

title: angel hair pasta with spinach  tomatoes and onion
steps:
1. Cook pasta per pkg
2. While it cooks , heat oil in a skillet and saute the onion and garlic over medium heat for 2 minute
3. Add tomatoes to the onion / garlic mixture , along with salt and pepper to taste and cook 3 min more , stirring
4. Then add spinach and toss until wilted
5. Drain pasta and place in a large pasta bowl
6. Add the skillet mixture to the pasta and toss to coat
7. Sprinkle with parmesan and serve

title: indonesian coconut rice
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat , add the onion and garlic , and cook until onion is softened , about 5 minutes
2. Add the scallions , ginger , turmeric , cinnamon , mustard , red pepper flakes , cloves , and sugar , and cook , stirring constantly , for 2 minutes
3. Add the rice and stir to mix evenly
4. Gently stir in the coconut
5. Season to taste with salt and pepper and heat until hot
6. Cover , and set aside for 5 minutes before serving
7. Top with peanuts and / or toasted coconut

title: world s best snickerdoodles
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
2. Cream together butter and sugar
3. Add in eggs , one at a time , along with vanilla , until well-combined
4. Mix dry ingredients in a separate bowl
5. Add dry ingredient mix into the wet mix in 2-3 stages
6. Mix the 2 tablespoons sugar and the cinnamon together in a small bowl
7. Use your hands to roll dough into little balls
8. Roll dough-balls in the cinnamon / sugar mixture so they're covered all the way around
9. Place them on an ungreased cookie sheet , 2 or 3 inches apart
10. Bake 7 or 8 minutes , until they have spread out and have just started to turn brown
11. Remove from cookie sheets and place cookies on cooling rack to cool and set a little
12. If they're not completely cooked when they come out of the oven , let them cook a bit more on the cookie sheets , out of the oven
13. 7-8 minutes will make a nice , chewy cookie with a little crispness on the bottom

title: toffee chunk brownie cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Melt butter and chocolate in large pan over low heat , stir till smooth
3. Remove from heat , cool slightly
4. Stir in sugar and mix till smooth
5. Stir in eggs till well blended
6. Stir in vanilla till smooth
7. Stir in flour and salt just till mixed
8. Fold in chopped toffee
9. Drop heaping tbsp of dough 1 1 / 2" apart on ungreased sheet
10. Bake 12 minutes or till set
11. Let cookies stand on sheet 5 minutes
12. Transfer to rack to cool completely
13. Store in airtight container

title: cranberry walnut banana bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Grease 9x5 loaf pan & set aside
3. Mix flour , salt , and powder well in a large bowl
4. In a food processor or blender , blend the bananas , oil , applesauce , and sugar until smooth
5. Add to flour mixture and mix well
6. Add flax seeds and mix well
7. Fold in cranberries , walnut , and flax seeds
8. Bake for 50-60 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into the center of the loaf comes out clean

title: caramelized onion   bbq
steps:
1. Cook onions on bbq plate until soft , using oil to prevent sticking
2. Just prior to serving mix through brown sugar and balsamic vinegar until sugar dissolves and oniobs are "caramalised"
3. Enjoy !

title: oriental pork   chinese cabbage
steps:
1. Mix first 3 ingredients
2. Set aside
3. Heat oil in wok until hot
4. Add pork
5. Stir-fry 3 minutes or until browned
6. Add pepper and onion
7. Stir-fry 1 minute
8. Add soy sauce mixture , cabbage and water , tossing to combine
9. Cover
10. Cook 1 minute
11. Uncover
12. Stir in cornstarch mixture and add to wok
13. Stir-fry until slightly thickened and meat is done
14. Serve with rice

title: eggless spice cake
steps:
1. Cut the butter into the flour and the sugar
2. Take one cup out and put it aside
3. To the remaining mixture , blend all the dry ingredients , nuts , and raisins
4. Make a well in the mixture
5. Pour in the milk and blend only to moisten the mixture
6. Stir in remaining cup that was put aside
