7. Pour mixture into a 13" x 9" for 25-30 min
8. Test with a toothpick to see if done

title: poverty soup
steps:
1. Place gnocci in a bowl with frozen veggies / beans
2. Pour in tomato paste and mixed herbs
3. Pour on water and mix well
4. Taste for desired consistancy
5. Microwave on med-high , until bubbly and heated through
6. Top with cottage cheese and pepper
7. I needed no salt
8. I also added 1 tbsp of my mum's home-made spicy tomato sauce
9. Its a very flexible recipe

title: beer batter fried veggies n  things
steps:
1. In deep fryer preheat oil to 375 degrees
2. Meanwhile , mix soup mix , flour , baking powder , eggs , beer , and mustard until smooth and well blended
3. Let batter rest for 10-15 minutes
4. Dip veggies or chilled mozzerella cheese carefully drop into hot oil
5. Fry turning once until golden brown
6. Drain on paper towel
7. Serve warm

title: my best ever meatloaf
steps:
1. Thouroughly combine all ingredients except bacon
2. Place meatloaf mixture into a bread / meatloaf pan
3. Cover top of meatloaf with bacon slices from side to side covering the entire meatloaf
4. Bake meatloaf in oven at 350 for 1 1 / 2 hours

title: gratin dauphines
steps:
1. Peel potatoes and slice fairly thin
2. Do not soak in water
3. Combine potatoes slices , garlic , cream , milk , salt and pepper in large heavy saucepan
4. Bring to boil over medium heat , stirring constantly for a few minutes until mixture begins to thicken
5. Butter a 9x13 inch baking dish and pour in potato mixture
6. Sprinkle swiss cheese over top and place on cookie sheet to catch drippings that bubble over
7. Bake at 400
8. After 15 minutes when cheese has slightly browned , cover baking dish with foil and continue baking 45 minutes

title: crock pot arroz con pollo  spanish chicken with rice
steps:
1. In a non-stick skillet , heat oil over medium-high heat
2. Add chicken , in batches , and brown lightly on all sides
3. Transfer to slow cooker stoneware
4. Reduce heat to medium
5. Add onions and cook , stirring , until softened
6. Add garlic , salt and pepper and cook , stirring , for 1 minute
7. Add rice and stir until grains are well coated with mixture
8. Stir in saffron , tomatoes and chicken stock
9. Transfer to slow cooker stoneware and stir to combine with chicken
10. Cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours or on high for 3 to 4 hours , until juice run clear when chicken is pierced with a fork
11. Stir in green pepper and peas , cover and cook on high for 20 minutes , until vegetables are heated through
12. Garnish with olives , if using , and pass hot pepper sauce , if using
13. Just make sure that all the skin is removed
14. Otherwise the dish will be too fatty
15. Saffron is a pungent , bittersweet spice garnered from a particular kind of crocus
16. Buy saffron in threads , not powder , preferably from a reputable purveyor
17. Turmeric can be used to convey the saffron color in a dish , but it will not replicate the unique and haunting flavour of the original
18. Delicious & dependable slow cooker recipes

title: oatmeal pecan pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325
2. Roll dough into an 11-inch circle
3. Fit into a 9-inch pie plate coated with cooking spray
4. Fold edges under
5. Flute
6. Combine all remaining ingredients , stirring well with a whisk
7. Pour into prepared crust
8. Bake for 50 minutes or until center is set
9. Cool completely on a wire rack

title: the one and only lasagne
steps:
1. Sauce:
2. Heat oil in electric frypan over medium heat
3. Add onion , carrots , and garlic saute approximately 12 minutes until soft
4. Add beef and italian sausages to pan breaking up meat with the back of a spoon
5. Cook until brown and add the remainder of the sauce ingredients
6. Cook and simmer over low heat approximately 15 minutes
7. Discard bay leaf
8. Preheat oven to 350
9. Combine cottage cheese and 3 / 4 cup parmesan in medium bowl , mix in spinach , salt and pepper to taste and two eggs
10. Assembling lasagne:
11. Spread 1 / 4 of the meat sauce on bottom of 9x13 lasagne pan
12. Cover with 5 oven ready lasagne noodles
13. Top with half of the cottage cheese mixture
14. Sprinkle 2 cups of mozarella cheese over
15. Spoon sauce over cheese layer 5 more noodles
16. Remainder of cottage cheese mixture and sprinkle with 2 cups of mozzarella
17. Top with remaining noodles and remainder of sauce
18. Sprinkle 3 / 4 cup of mozarella and 1 / 4 cup of parmesan
19. Bake covered with aluminum foil for 40 minutes and uncovered for 40 minutes more
20. Let stand 5 minutes or longer prior to serving
21. Serve with a nice glass of merlot , garlic bread and caesar salad !

title: balsamic glazed oranges
steps:
1. Peel oranges removing all of the pith from the outside
2. Cut across grain into 1 / 4 inch slices , removing seeds
3. Place sugar and vinegar in a small saucepan and bring to boil
4. Stir constantly with a large spoon
5. Allow it to continue with a low boil until volume is halved
6. Divide orange slices evenly between 4 plates
7. Drizzle with glaze

title: ocean perch fritters
steps:
1. Sift together flour , salt , white pepper , paprika , and baking powder
2. Mix egg yolk with milk and add to dry ingredients
3. Beat well
4. Add melted margarine
5. Fold in stiffly beaten egg white and fish flakes
6. Drop by tablespoonfuls into hot deep fat
7. Fry until golden brown on both sides
8. Drain on absorbent paper
9. Serve at once with horseradish and ketchup or chili sauce
10. Mskes 4 servings

title: actual panera bread recipe for hearty cheese soup in a sourdough
steps:
1. In a large , heavy stockpot , melt butter or margarine
2. Add chopped vegetables
3. Add ham or bacon
4. Cook over medium heat until vegetables are slightly tender
5. Stir in flour
6. Stir in cornstarch
7. Cook , stirring constantly
8. Add broth and continue stirring until slightly thickened
9. Add milk
10. Add spices
11. Add cheese gradually , stirring until cheese is melted
12. To avoid curdling , do not allow soup to boil after cheese is added
13. Season to taste with salt and pepper
14. Serve piping hot in the hollowed out sourdough bread bowls

title: cinnamon oatmeal cookies
steps:
1. In a large bowl , cream shortening and sugar until light and fluffy
2. Add eggs , one at a time , beating well after each addition
3. Beat in molasses and vanilla
4. Combine the remaining ingredients
5. Gradually add to creamed mixture and mix well
6. Drop by tablespoonfuls 2 inches apart onto greased baking sheets
7. Bake at 350 for 10-12 minutes or until edges are firm
8. Remove to wire racks to cool yield: about 13 dozen

title: lighten up  chocolate chip cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit
2. Coat baking sheets with cooking spray
3. Combine flour , salt , and baking soda in bowl
4. On medium-high speed beat egg , egg white , oil , corn syrup and vanilla until combined
5. On low speed beat in flour mixture until combined
6. Stir in chocolate chips
7. Drop dough by tablespoonfuls onto baking sheets 2" apart
8. Bake about 10 minutes or until lightly browned
9. Cool on pans 10 minutes and then transfer to racks to cool completely

title: 10 can spaghetti sauce   oamc
steps:
1. Brown sausage in pan , crumbling with spatula , until no pink remains
2. Drain and rinse
3. Put into a 5 quart crockpot
4. Saute onions and garlic in olive oil until translucent and golden but not brown
5. Add all the spices and mix well
6. Turn off the heat and let the spices mingle for about 10 minutes
7. The heat will let the oils release from the dried herbs
8. Add the tomato sauce and spice mixture to the meat in the crockpot and stir to mix
9. Cook on high for 1 hour and then low for 7-8 hours
10. Use over pasta
11. If freezing , cool sauce and pour into quart sized freezer bags
12. Remove all the air and place flat on a cookie sheet and put into freezer
13. When frozen , they will stand up like records in the freezer

title: chakchouka
steps:
1. Saute the onion and garlic in the olive oil until soft
2. Add all the remaining ingredients , except the eggs , and simmer for a minute
3. Make 4 indentations in the mixture and carefully break an egg into each one
4. Cover and cook over a low heat until the eggs are set

title: chocolate marshmallow slices
steps:
1. Combine butter and chocolate chips in a large bowl and microwave 30 seconds at a time , stirring vigorously after each interval , just until the chocolate is completely melted
2. Be careful not to scorch the chocolate by microwaving it too long , or you will have to throw it out and start over
3. Stir in the nuts until well distributed , and then stir in the marshmallows
4. Lay out waxed paper sheets about 12" long , and spoon chocolate mixture down the long side about 2" from the edge
5. Roll wax paper over chocolate mixture and form a log , pinching the sheets together and pulling toward you a bit to eliminate air bubbles in your logs
6. Place logs on a cookie sheet , and refrigerate until solid
7. Remove logs from refrigerator , remove wax paper and place on a cutting board
8. Slice into 1 / 2" slices and store in an airtight container in a cool place , or refrigerate

title: steamed eggs  kai meung
steps:
1. Prepare a steamer over relatively high heat so you are getting plenty of steam
2. If eggs have been refrigerated leave them out a while until they reach room temperature
3. Steam eggs for 12 minutes
4. Allow to cool
5. I left at room temperature for 15 minutes or so and run under a little cold water just before cracking / peeling

title: grandma s mow nade
steps:
1. Put the concentrates into a large pitcher and mash until a slush
2. Add the tea and water and combine stirring
3. Pour into glasses
4. To warm: pour into saucepan and simmer 5 to 10 minutes or until hot
5. Makes about 7 servings at one cup each

title: chicken wraps
steps:
1. In a saucepan or microwave-safe bowl , combine chicken , corn and salsa
2. Cook until heated through
3. Sprinkle cheese over tortillas
4. Place about 1 / 2 cup chicken mixture down the center of each tortilla
5. Roll up
6. Secure with toothpicks
7. Serve with sour cream
8. Variations
9. Add chopped green pepper , red pepper and / or scallions
10. Add hot pepper sauce
11. Add a chopped jalapeno
12. Use mexican style corn
13. Use mexican style cheese

title: tuna melt sliders
steps:
1. Arrange the english muffin halves on a cookie sheet and pop them under a broiler to toast
2. Meanwhile , drain and flake the tuna
3. Add 3 / 4 cup of cheese and the remaining ingredients
4. Mix thoroughly
5. Remove the toasted english muffins from the broiler
6. Spread with tuna mixture
7. Sprinkle remaining 1 / 4 cup of cheese over the tuna
8. Return to the broiler until cheese melts and starts to bubble
9. If you don't have swiss cheese on hand , monterrey jack or mozzarella make good substitutes

title: new england pumpkin bisque
steps:
1. In heavy stock pan heat butter , saute onions and pears about 5 minutes or til soft
2. Add sage , and salt and pepper
3. Add flour , cook few minutes , add stock slowly , whisking to remove lumps
4. Add pumpkin , curry , brown sugar and bring to a simmer
5. Cook 30 minutes
6. Puree
7. Add cream
8. Heat through and serve
9. Tastes richer next day
10. Makes 12 cups

title: garlicky mini muffins florentine
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. Oil mini muffin tins
3. Sift flour , salt , soda , and baking powder together
4. Beat eggs with milk and add to flour mixture
5. Stir in oil and spinach and mix well
6. Fold in herbes , pesto , cheese and garlic
7. Spoon into muffin cups and bake for 12-15 minutes until nicely browned

title: mtuzi wa samaki  east african fish in coconut curry
steps:
1. Heat the oil over medium-high flame in a large skillet or pot
2. Season the fish with salt and pepper
3. Sear the fish fillets on both sides and remove to a plate
4. Do not cook through
5. Reduce the heat to medium and add the onions and peppers
6. Saut until the onion is translucent
7. Add the garlic and saut 1-2 minutes more
8. Add the tomatoes , coconut milk , garam masala or curry powder , tamarind paste or lemon juice , salt and pepper
9. Bring to a boil , then reduce heat to low and simmer for 6-8 minutes
10. Add the fish fillets , cover and continue to simmer until the fish is cooked through , 5-10 minutes
11. Serve with rice , ugali , boiled potatoes , boiled cassava or chapatti
12. Variations: mtuzi wa kamba : substitute shrimp for the fish
13. There is no need to sear the shrimp initially

title: monte cristo sandwich with sweet mustard sauce
steps:
1. To prepare sauce , combine first 4 ingredients in a small saucepan over low heat , stirring well with a whisk
2. Cook until jelly melts
3. To prepare sandwiches , combine egg substitute , milk , salt , and pepper in a shallow dish
4. Place one slice each of the turkey , ham , and cheese on each of 4 bread slices
5. Top with remaining bread slices
6. Dip both sides of each sandwich into the egg substitute mixture
7. Place sandwiches in a large nonstick skillet coated with cooking spray over medium-high heat
8. Reduce heat to medium
9. Cook for 3 minutes on each side or until sandwiches are golden
10. Sandwiches can also be cooked in a pannini press
11. Sprinkle sandwiches with powdered sugar
12. Serve sandwiches with sauce

title: spaghetti sauce made with pork neck bone  italy 1870 1900
steps:
1. In a large pot , add olive oil , smash garlic with clever until flat , add to pot
2. Cook garlic until golden brown , not burnt !
3. Remove garlic
4. Add pork neck bones , brown , put garlic back in the pot
5. Add tomato sauce , tomato paste and all other ingredients
6. Simmer 2 hours with lid on
7. The second 2 hours remove lid stirring occasionally , until desired thickness
8. Remove pork neck bones , let cool a little , remove meat from bones , add back to sauce
9. The last half hour add cheese
10. Freezes very well

title: super nutty cookies  wheat free lactose free
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Combine all ingredient in a medium sized bowl , using a wooden spoon or heavy duty mixer
3. After throughly mixed add any additional optional ingredients--my favorites: cracked nuts , chocolate chips , or carob chips
4. Roll into very small balls and place 2 inches apart on cookie sheet
5. Bake 9 minutes in the oven or until puffed and golden
6. Cookies will be very soft until cooled completely

title: deluxe chocolate pie
steps:
1. Pierce pie shell
2. Bake
3. Cool
4. Scald milk with coffee in it
5. Take off heat & dump in blender
6. Quickly add chocolate chips , salt , rum & eggs
7. Turn on high for about 2 minutes
8. Pour in shell
9. Refrigerate until set
10. Whip cream & top when ready to serve
11. Garnish with chocolate shavings

title: holiday tortillas for dipping
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Cut out tortillas with small holiday themed cookie cutters
3. Place in a single layer on baking sheets and bake 10 minutes or until crisp
4. Sprinkle lightly with salt , if desired
5. Cool , store in an airtight container until ready to serve

title: off the cob  freezer corn
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325f
2. Shuck ears of corn
3. Rinse to remove silks
4. Place on paper towels to drain
5. Using an angel food cake pan and electric knife , stand each ear on tube part of pan and cut corn off cob
6. Your cuttings will fall neatly into the pan
7. As the cake pan fills , empty into large roaster pan
8. Season with salt and pepper to your taste
9. Cube butter and distribute onto corn in roaster pan
10. Pour half and half throughout corn
11. Roast for 1 hour , stirring gently every 15 minutes
12. Allow to cool for half an hour
13. Label freezer bags with contents , quantity and date
14. Ladle into bags at portions suitable for your personal use
15. Stack neatly in freezer for later use

title: oyster stuffing for turkey
steps:
1. In large frying pan , saute sausage meat , stirring to break up , until lightly brown
2. Lift out with slotted spoon into large bowl
3. In drippings , saute celery and onion until tender-- 8 to 10 minutes
4. Add to sausage meat
5. Add next seven ingredients
6. Mix well
7. Add broth and eggs
8. Mix
9. If the stuffing is not moist enough , add a little water , but be careful because you don't want it too wet
10. The turkey will add moisture during the cooking process
11. Use this recipe to stuff a 10- 12 lb turkey
12. Spoon dressing into turkey cavities , but do not pack

title: tomato sauce like my grandmother s
steps:
1. Peel the tomatoes by making a criss cross cut on the bottom and putting them in boiling water for 1 minute
2. Rinse them in cold water and let cool
3. When they are cool remove the skins , squeeze out the seeds , and chop coarsely
4. In a large stockpot or dutch oven heat the oil
5. Add the onion , pepper , and hot pepper and saute for about 10 minutes over medium low heat
6. Add the garlic and cook for 5 minutes
7. Add the tomatoes , wine , water , and seasonings
8. Bring to boil over medium low heat , cover , and reduce heat to low
9. Simmer for about 2 hours , stirring occasionally and adding water if necessary
10. Add sugar if needed and fresh herbs
11. Cook for five more minutes
12. Either let cool and freeze or add meatballs , sausage , pork loin and serve with pasta
13. Also great for lasagne , eggplant parm , etc
14. Enjoy

title: jen sauce
steps:
1. Mix well and to taste
2. It always takes a bit of testing to get the right mixture

title: spicy ginger tea with lemongrass
steps:
1. Bring the water to a boil
2. Reduce heat and add gingerroot and lemongrass
3. Simmer for ten minutes
4. Turn off the heat and add 2 bags or about 2 teaspoonfuls of your favorite herbal tea mixture
5. Taste and if it tastes too weak , continue steeping , if it tastes too strong add more water
6. Strain and sweeten with honey and add lemon to taste

title: ecto nanna pudding
steps:
1. In medium mixing bowl , mix both puddings with milk and stir till thickened
2. Lay sliced bananas on top
3. Gently mix with pudding
4. Here is your choice on where the vanilla wafers go
5. Either put a layer of wafers in the casserole and then pour in the pudding or
6. Pour in the pudding and top with vanilla wafers or do both
7. You choose

title: peanut butter   jelly waffles
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine the flour , sugar , baking powder , baking soda and cinnamon
2. In another bowl , whisk the egg yolks , milk , peanut butter and butter
3. Stir mixture into dry ingredients just until moistened
4. In a small bowl , beat egg whites until stiff peaks form
5. Fold into batter
6. Bake in a preheated waffle iron according to manufacturers directions until golden brown
7. Serve with jelly

title: munchies
steps:
1. Mix together
2. Place in baggies

title: noah bedoahs  chocolate chip shortbread cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 275
2. Line 2 cookie sheets with parchment paper or leave them ungreased
3. Sift the flour , baking powder and salt together into a small bowl and set aside
4. Using an electric mixer on medium speed , cream the butter and sugar together in a medium-sized mixing bowl until light and fluffy , about 1-1 / 2 minutes
5. Stop the mixer to scrape the bowl several times with a rubber spatula
6. Add the dry ingredients on low speed and continue to blend for 10 seconds
7. Increase the speed to medium-high and beat until fluffy , 2 to 2-1 / 2 minutes
8. Scrape the bowl
9. Add the chocolate chips and nuts with several turns of the mixer , then complete the mixing by hand with a wooden spoon
10. Measure out generous rounded tablespoonfuls of dough and roll them into balls with your hands
11. Place the balls 1-1 / 2 inches apart on the cookie sheets and press them down lightly to form a flat bottom
12. Bake the cookies until they are crunchy and golden , about 1 hour
13. To test for doneness , remove one cookie from the sheet and cut it in half
14. There should be no doughy strip in the center
15. Allow the cookies to cool on a rack
16. Makes 15 - 17 cookies

title: grilled roast beef   green chile sandwiches
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine chilies , mayo and mustard
2. Spread about 1 tablespoon on each side of each slice of bread
3. Top five slices of bread with 1 slice of cheese , and 2 slices of beef
4. Cover with remaining bread
5. Butter the outsides of the bread
6. In a skillet over medium heat , toast sandwiches for 4-5 minutes on each side or until bread is slightly browned and cheese is melted
7. Serve with salsa if desired

title: knox blox
steps:
1. Combine knox and jell-o
2. Add water and stir to dissolve
3. Pour into large shallow pan
4. Chill till firm
5. Cut into squares

title: moroccan spiced pastitsio with lamb and feta
steps:
1. Heat oil in large skillet over medium-high heat
2. Add onion and garlic
3. Saute until onion softens , about 5 minutes
4. Add lamb
5. Cook until brown , breaking into small pieces , about 8 minutes
6. Stir in tomatoes with juice , mint , ras-el-hanout , tomato paste , 2 1 / 2 tsp cumin , and cinnamon
7. Bring to boil
8. Reduce heat to medium-low
9. Simmer until lamb mixture is thick , stirring often , 15 to 18 minutes
10. Season with salt and pepper
11. Meanwhile , bring 2 cups milk to simmer in medium saucepan
12. Remove from heat
13. Cover to keep warm
14. Melt 6 tb butter in heavy large saucepan over medium heat
15. Add flour
16. Whisk until smooth
17. Reduce heat to medium-low
18. Cook until roux is pale golden , whisking often , 3 to 4 minutes
19. Gradually add warm milk to roux , whisking until sauce is smooth
20. Whisk 1 cup milk and 3 egg yolks in medium bowl
21. Whisk into sauce
22. Whisk in feta and 1 / 2 tsp cumin
23. Bring sauce to boil , whisking often
24. Reduce heat to medium-low
25. Simmer until slightly thickened , mashing with potato masher to break up cheese , about 5 minutes
26. Season sauce with salt and pepper
27. Do ahead: can be made 1 day ahead
28. Cover
29. Chill
30. Rewarm over low heat , whisking often , before using
31. Preheat oven to 400f butter deep 14-cup baking dish
32. Cook pasta in large pot of boiling salted water until tender but still firm to bite , stirring occasionally
33. Drain pasta
34. Return to same pot
35. Mix 2 tb butter into pasta
36. Add egg whites and 1 / 4 cup parmesan
37. Stir to blend
38. Spread 4 cups pasta in dish
39. Spread lamb mixture over
40. Top with remaining pasta
41. Spoon sauce over
42. Sprinkle with 1 / 4 cup parmesan
43. Place dish on rimmed baking sheet
44. Bake pastitsio until heated through , about 40 minutes
45. Let stand 5-10 minutes

title: grecian tomatoes
steps:
1. Arrange tomato and onion slices on a plate
2. Sprinkle with the feta cheese , parsley , salt and pepper
3. Drizzle with oil
4. Cover and refrigerate for 15 minutes

title: egg   bacon pie
steps:
1. Line base of pie plate with one sheet of the pastry
2. Refrigerate while preparing filling
3. Remove rind and excess fat from bacon , chop roughly
4. Fry in pan 3 minutes until just soft , drain
5. Cool
6. Place half the bacon in the pastry case , break eggs on top , one at a time , careful not to break the yolks
7. Season with pepper , top with remaining bacon , sprinkle with parsley
8. Place remaining pastry on top , trim edges , press pastry together
9. Brush with combined egg yolk and water
10. Bake in a hot oven for 15 minutes
11. Reduce heat to moderate , cook for a further 15 minutes or until browned

title: thai sticky or glutinous rice  cook with microwave
steps:
1. Soak the glutinous rice with cold water for 15 minutes and rub the rice with your hands and wash until the water starts to be clear
2. Put the rice in the microwave safe container and put the water about 2 cup or submerge the rice
3. Cook on high power about 20 minutes

title: sinful chocolate truffle cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300 degrees
2. Remove the bottom of a 9 inch springform pan and cover with tin foil , wrapping foil around to the back
3. Replace bottom of pan in springform
4. Grease and flour bottom and side of pan
5. In heavy 2-quart saucepan , combine semisweet and unsweetened chocolates and butter and melt over very low heat , stirring frequently until smooth
6. Pour into a large bowl and set aside
7. In another bowl with mixer at high speed beat egg yolks and sugar until very thick and lemon colored , about 5 minutes
8. Then add the egg yolk mixture to the chocolate mixture , stirring with rubber spatula until blended
9. In another bowl with clean beaters , beat a high speed the egg whites and cream of tartar until soft peaks form when beaters are lifted
10. With rubber spatula fold beaten egg whites into chocolate mixture , one third at a time , make sure you fold not stir
11. Pour batter into prepared pan , spread evenly
12. Bake for 35 minutes
13. Do not overbake cake will firm up while standing and chilling , it is a truffle cake not a standard cake
14. Cool cake completely in pan on a cake rack
15. When cool refridgerate overnight in pan
16. In the morning to remove the cake from pan , run a hot knife , around edge of cake , and unhook spring latch on side of pan and lift off side of pan
17. Invert cake onto cake plate , unwrap foil from bottom of pan and lift off bottom of pan
18. To decorate top of cake using a fine sieve , sprinkle with confectioners sugar , or i made a heart stencil with paper for valentines day and placed on top of cake to create a heart outline with the sugar
19. Refrigerate cake and remove 15 minutes before serving

title: disney world s strawberry soup
steps:
1. Thaw the frozen berries in their juices
2. Blend all of the ingredients on low until smooth
3. Chill , shake well before serving
4. Add fresh strawberry halves as a garnish

title: spiked fruit cup
steps:
1. Combine first 5 ingredients in a bowl
2. Set aside
3. Combine orange juice and remaining ingredients
4. Pour over fruit
5. Cover and refrigerate 8 hours

title: pink eggs
steps:
1. Spray non-stick skillet with cooking spray
2. Heat skillet on low
3. Add all of the ingredients and just cook like you would scrambled eggs until mixture is no longer runny and cooked through

title: pear and raspberry frangipane tart
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400f
2. Crust: in a large bowl or food processor , combine flour and sugar
3. Cut in butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs
4. Gradually add water until dough forms a ball
5. Knead 2-3 times until smooth
6. Press dough into bottom and up sides of an ungreased 10" tart pan with a removable bottom
7. Spread jam evenly over bottom of dough
8. Filling: place almonds in food processor
9. Process until almonds are finely chopped
10. Add butter , sugar , and flour
11. Process until blended
12. Add egg and almond extract
13. Mix well
14. Drain pears , reserving 1 / 4 cup liquid
15. Add 1 / 4 cup liquid to almond filling mixture
16. Blend until smooth
17. Spread in crust
18. Arrange pear slices over filling
19. Bake 35-45 minutes or until crust is lightly browned and top is a deep golden brown
20. Cool 90 minutes
21. Garnish with fresh raspberries and powdered sugar

title: burger dogs
steps:
1. Separate ground beef into 4 even sections
2. Place each section between waxed paper about 6 x 6-inch
3. Roll or pound to 1 / 4 inch thick
4. Spread each "burger" with mustard
5. Add chopped onion , evenly
6. Add garlic evenly
7. Add cheese evenly
8. Add hot sauce
9. Place one hot dog on one edge of "burger"
10. Roll and seal
11. Either cook over hot coals or pan fry until done to your liking
12. Serve on rolls

title: salmon alfredo casserole
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350
2. In large saucepan , cook noodles to desired doneness as directed on package , adding peas during last minute of cooking time
3. Drain
4. Return to saucepan
5. Stir in alfredo sauce , milk and dill
6. Mix well
7. Gently stir in salmon
8. Pour into ungreased 1-1 / 2 quart casserole
9. In small bowl , combine topping ingredients , mix well
10. Sprinkle over top
11. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until casserole is bubbly and thoroughly heated

title: pumpkin and black bean soup
steps:
1. Heat a soup pot over medium heat
2. Add oil
3. When oil is hot , add onion
4. Saute onions 5 minutes
5. Add broth , tomatoes or tomato sauce , black beans , pumpkin puree and corn
6. Stir to combine ingredients and bring soup to a boil
7. Reduce heat to medium low and stir in cream , curry , cumin , cayenne and salt , to taste
8. Simmer 5 minutes , adjust seasonings and serve garnished with chopped chives
9. For vegan option use soy cream

title: sauteed onions and peppers  barefoot contessa  ina garten
steps:
1. Cut the onions in half and then slice into 1 / 8 " thick half-rounds
2. Heat the olive oil in a large saute pan over medium heat
3. Add onions and mushrooms and saute for 15-20 minutes
4. Add the peppers , garlic , vinegar , tomato puree , pepper flakes , salt and pepper and continue cooking an additional 10 minutes

title: brie  burger
steps:
1. Combine the ground beef , salt and pepper in a bowl
2. Form into 4 patties , 3 / 4-inch thick
3. Heat grill to medium heat
4. Place patties on the grill and cook for 10-15 min , turning two or three times during cooking
5. During the last 2 min of grilling , top each patty with a slice of brie and allow to melt
6. Remove from the grill
7. Place a patty on the bottom half of each roll and top with a slice or two of apple
8. Spread a tbs of honey mustard on the top half of each roll and place on burger
9. Serve

title: warm rice salad with fruits and nuts
steps:
1. Bring water to a boil in a medium saucepan
2. Add rice
3. When water boils again , reduce heat to low , cover , and simmer 45 minutes , until rice is tender and most of the water has been absorbed
4. Remove from heat and let stand covered , 5 minutes
5. Then spoon rice into a large bowl
6. Add raisins , apricots , bell pepper , onion , and pine nuts
7. Toss to combine
8. In a small bowl or custard cup , combine remaining ingredients
9. Add to rice and mix well
10. Serve right away

title: danish breakfast for two
steps:
1. In a pie plate make a crust of the soda crackers and the butter
2. To the beaten eggs add
3. Sour cream , emmenthal , cheddar , bacon , salt& pepper
4. Pour into the cracker crust
5. Bake 375f degrees 25-30 minutes
6. Let it sit for 10 min before cutting

title: springtime shrimp with lemon  thyme   bow  tie pasta toss
steps:
1. Bring a large pot of water to boil for pasta
2. Cook bowtie until al dente
3. Toss with a bit of olive oil and keep warm
4. Heat large skillet over medium heat , adding 1 tbsp olive oil , then butter
5. Add green onion , lemon zest , broccoli , white wine and red pepper flakes
6. Season lightly with salt & pepper , toss together
7. Cover skillet and cook a few minutes and broccoli is bright green
8. Add peas , cook a few minutes , keeping their bright color
9. Add shrimp and toss gently , cooking about 2 minutes until shrimp are heated through
10. Add lemon juice , green onion , sprig of thyme and remaining butter and olive oil
11. Place warm pasta in serving bowl , sprinkle with salt , pepper & 1 / 4 c parmesan cheese
12. Remove sprig of thyme
13. Add shrimp and vegetable mixture
14. Toss lightly , sprinkle with remaining parmesan and serve

title: very berry yogurt
steps: 1. Place all ingredients into a blender and give it a few whirls

title: pasta with brie
steps:
1. Put water on to boil for pasta , then begin preparing other ingredients
2. Cook pasta according to package directions
3. Drain and return to pan
4. Toss pasta with remaining ingredients and serve immediately
5. Season to taste at the table with salt and pepper , if desired

title: daffodil cake  lemon cake supreme
steps:
1. Bake a lemon cake mix according to package directions
2. Use a greased and floured 9x13 inch pan
3. Ten minutes after removing from the oven , poke holes all over the cake with the handle of a wooden spoon
4. Pour crushed pineapple with juice over the cake in the pan
5. Fold 1 package lemon instant pudding into 1 1 / 2 cups milk
6. Fold this into 1 small carton cool whip
7. Spread over cake
8. Top with coconut !

title: sam s brown sugar and raisin cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Line cookie sheets with parchment or grease
3. Cream butter and add sugar , beating until fluffy
4. Add egg and vanilla
5. Beat until just creamy
6. Stir in flour , baking powder , and salt
7. Mix well
8. Stir in raisins and , if you're adding them , walnuts
9. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto prepared sheets
10. Bake in upper third of oven for 10 to 12 minutes until just barely golden
11. Cool for 2 minutes on cookie sheet and move to a wire rack to finish cooling
12. This recipe doubles quite nicely
13. They should look underbaked coming out of the oven

title: ranch dusted shrimp on crisped cheese shells  rsc
steps:
1. In a bowl combine 1 tablespoon of dip mix , greek yogurt , minced chives , minced garlic , lemon juice and lemon zest
2. Refrigerate until ready to use
3. Dry shrimp with paper towels and sprinkle with salt
4. Combine the bread crumbs with the remaining dip mix
5. Put the beaten egg and bread crumbs mixture in separate bowls
6. Dip the shrimp in the egg , then dredge in the bread crumbs
7. Transfer to a baking sheet and refrigerate for 10 minutes
8. Meanwhile lay 2 provolone cheese slices on a piece of parchment paper , overlapping by half
9. Microwave for approximately 55 seconds
10. They will look bubbly and browned when done
11. Remove from microwave and using the parchment paper fold up the cheese to form a flat bottom taco shell
12. Hold this shape for about 5 seconds , set aside , whipe any oil from parchment paper and continue forming 7 more shells using remaining cheese slices
13. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
14. In a large saucepan , heat 1 inch of vegetable oil to 350 degrees f
15. Fry shrimp in batches , until browned and crisp , about 2 minutes
16. Transfer shrimp to baking sheet
17. When all shrimp have been fried , transfer them to the oven and bake until heated through , about 2 minutes
18. To assemble your tacos
19. Place a little dip sauce on bottom of cheese shell
20. Arrange 4 shrimp , 1 / 8 of the avocado slices , some chopped shallots , drizzle with dip sauce and garnish with cilantro and optional taco sauce

title: bryanna s korean bbq sauce
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients in a blender , or add scallions after blending for more color and texture
2. The sauce can be used right away as a marinade for tvp or tofu , or can be simmered over low heat in a small saucepan until it thickens and used later for stirfries or marinades
3. It will keep at least a week
4. I have had great success simmering this sauce in partially rehydrated tvp chunks and tofu
5. Once the sauce coats and absorbs into whatever protein source you choose to use , you can lay the chunks out on a cookie sheet and broil them until slightly charred , or about 5-10 minutes
6. Enjoy !

title: spicy roast pumpkin
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 200 c or 400f
2. Quarter and then carefully peel and seed the pumpkin
3. Cut into chunky 2" cubes
4. Place pumpkin into a large & sturdy roasting tray
5. Add the olive oil , salt , pepper & cumin - mix well , making sure that all the pumpkin pieces are coated in olive oil
6. Bake in the oven for about 30 to 45 minutes or until the pumpkin is soft & also tinged brown at the edges
7. Serve with a main meal as the vegetable dish or freeze for future savoury pumpkin recipes
8. I also make soup from this - as well as pasta dishes too - recipes to be posted for those !

title: a golden chicken
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine mexican oregano , kosher salt garlic powder and black pepper
2. Rinse chicken and pat dry
3. Sprinkle the spice mixture into the breast cavity and add 2 small bay leaves
4. Place the bird on a rack in a roasting pan
5. Brush skin well with annatto oil
6. Roast the chicken in a preheated 375 degree oven for 45-50 minutes or until juices run clear when pricked

title: punkrock chickpea gravy
steps:
1. Mix the flour with 2 cups of water until the flour is mostly dissolved
2. Heat a large skillet over medium heat
3. Add the olive oil , onions and mustard seeds
4. Cook for 10 minutes , stirring occasionally until the onions are browned and the mustard seeds are toasted
5. Add the garlic and saute for 2 minutes more
6. Add the chickpeas
7. Use a potato masher to mash them (they don't have to be mashed into a paste , just make sure each one is broken up slightly
8. A few whole ones left are ok
9. Add the herbs and spices , soy sauce , and lemon juice
10. Scrape the bottom of the pan to loosen any browned bits of onion
11. Lower heat and pour the flour mixture into the pan
12. Stir constantly until a thick gravy forms
13. Stir in the nutritional yeast
14. If it looks too thick and pasty , add a little of the extra water and mix well
15. Keep warm until ready to serve

title: baked eggplant casserole
steps:
1. Cook eggplant , covered , in salted water , until just tender
2. Drain well
3. In saucepan , cook onions and green pepper with butter until just tender
4. Blend in flour
5. Stir in soup and seasonings
6. Heat and stir until bubbly
7. Remove from heat
8. Stir about half the mixture into beaten eggs
9. Return to saucepan
10. Fold in tomatoes , cheese and eggplant
11. Bake in buttered casserole at 350 degrees for 35 minutes

title: nutella chocolate chocolate chip  reduced sugar
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. In a medium bowl , mix butter , sugars , cocoa powder , baking soda , and salt together until fluffy
3. Add the nutella , and mix in well
4. Add egg and vanilla , and mix in thoroughly
5. Slowly add flower while continuing to mix
6. Blend thoroughly
7. Stir in chocolate chips
8. Spoon heaping teaspoons of the dough onto an ungreased cookie sheet
9. Bake for about 12 minutes at 350f
10. Cool cookies on cookie sheet for about 2 minutes before attempting to take cookies off sheet

title: seafood dinner
steps:
1. Heat olive oil and butter over medium heat
2. Cut fish into large chunks and sprinkle with salt and pepper , to taste and brown lightly in oil and butter
3. Remove fish from pan and set aside
4. Add wine and deglaze pan
5. Stir in jar of salsa and chicken broth
6. Let broth simmer over medium heat until liquid begins to bubble
7. Add scallops and shrimp to broth , stir gently , cover , and let simmer for 10 minutes
8. Cut lemon in half , squeeze juice into pan
9. Add fish back to pan and gently stir
10. Replace cover and simmer another 6-7 minutes
11. Serve in large bowls with crunchy bread and enjoy !

title: weight watchers 0 point tortilla soup
steps:
1. Simmer onions , garlic & green onions in a pan until tender
2. Put all ingredients in a pot , simmer until all veggies are tender
3. You can add chicken , divide the points by 9 servings
4. Taste great with a couple toasted taco shells on the side , but count your points --

title: sweet and hot orange wings
steps:
1. Place chicken wings in a shallow dish or zip-top plastic freezer bag
2. Whisk together orange juice and next 6 ingredients
3. Add 1 cup orange juice mixture to wings
4. Reserve remaining mixture for later use
5. Cover or seal , and chill 1 hour
6. Remove chicken from marinade , discarding marinade
7. Grill wings , covered with grill lid , over medium high heat 17 to 20 minutes , turning occasionally
8. Bring reserved orange juice mixture to a boil in a saucepan
9. Reduce heat , and simmer 25 minutes or until mixture is reduced by half
10. Toss warm chicken wings with 1 / 4 cup reduced orange juice mixture
11. Transfer to serving platter and sprinkle with chopped green onions
12. Serve chicken wings warm with remaining orange juice mixture

title: mad dogs serious kick ass barbecue sauce
steps:
1. Melt butter in frying pan and cook onions until soft and translucent
2. In a saucepan combine all ingredients , bring to a boil , reduce temperature and simmer for 30-45 minutes
3. Remove from heat and let cool to room temperature before using

title: wild rice mushroom stuffing
steps:
1. Rinse and cook wild rice to package instructions
2. Set aside
3. Spread cubed french bread in a single layer on a baking sheet
4. Broil 5 to 6 inches from heat for 4 minutes or until lightly toasted , stirring after 2 minutes
5. Set aside
6. Preheat oven to 325f
7. Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat
8. Add onion and garlic
9. Cook and stir for 3 minutes
10. Add mushrooms
11. Cook for 3 more minutes stirring occasionally
12. Add sage , thyme , salt , pepper and cooked rice
13. Cook for 2 minutes stirring occasionally
14. Stir in broth
15. Add pecans and toasted bread cubes
16. Toss lightly
17. Transfer to very large casserole dish
18. Cover with lid or foil
19. Bake for 40 minutes or until hot

title: simple soy   ginger marinade for pork
steps:
1. Mix together and use to marinate pork chops or pork steaks for at least 2 hours or overnight
2. Drain meat before cooking

title: super vegetable pesto pasta with pan seared oven roasted chicken
steps:
1. Place pin nuts in a non-stick skillet and toast over medium heat until slightly browned
2. While pin nuts are toasting , put remaining 9 ingredients in a food processor
3. When pin nuts are toasted add them to the food processor and mix pesto sauce until smooth
4. In a large pot , start boiling water for pasta
5. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
6. While water is coming to a boil , cut up the asparagus , scallions and tomatoes , keeping them all separate from one another
7. Cook spaghetti according to box directions
8. Add asparagus to water 5 minutes before pasta is fully cooked , strain , and replace in pot over lowest heat setting
9. Add pesto sauce to spaghetti and mix
10. Heat oil in oven proof skillet over medium-high heat
11. Fillet chicken breasts in half , sprinkle with grill seasoning , coat with flour and place in skillet and cook 2-3 mins on each side until slightly browned
12. Add tomatoes and scallions to chicken and place skillet into preheated oven
13. Cook chicken for 15-20 minutes
14. When chicken is done , remove from oven
15. Place pesto-asparagus pasta on a plate and place a slice of chicken on top
16. Garnish as desired

title: onion crusted pork chops
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. In small bowl , combine onion soup mix and bread crumbs
3. Brush both sides of chops with mustard , then dip in soup mixture until evenly coated
4. In 13 x 9-inch baking or roasting pan , arrange chops
5. Bake , uncovered , turning once , 30 minutes , or until done
6. Variation: also terrific with lipton recipe secrets onion mushroom soup mix

title: marzipan cookies
steps:
1. Cream together the butter and sugar
2. Add cocoa , egg , oil , and almond , beating well
3. Mix in oats , flakes , coconut , and chips
4. Stir well
5. Blend together flour , baking soda , and salt in separate bowl
6. Add to creamed mixture and stir well
7. Refrigerate for 15 minutes , if desired , to firm up dough
8. Preheat oven to 325-degrees
9. Drop rounded tablespoonfulls onto an ungreased cookie sheet about 2-inches apart
10. Press down with a fork , dipped in cold water
11. Smooth any cracks around the edge with your fingers
12. Bake at 325 for 11- 15 minutes
13. You may wish to keep a careful eye on the time , as it depends on how big you make the cookie
14. Do not overbake , but these are perfect when slightly underbaked

title: poutine rapee
steps:
1. Soak the salted pork in cold water overnight to remove the excess salt
2. Cut into cubes
3. Grate the uncooked potatoes and extract the water from them by squeezing them in a cloth
4. Mix the grated potatoes with the mashed , seasoned potatoes , adding more seasoning if necessary
5. Make a hole in the centre of the potato ball with your thumb and add a tablespoon of the salted pork
6. Close up the hole and roll the poutine in white flour and gently lower the poutine into a large pot of boiling , salted water
7. Keep the water boiling and simmer the poutines for 2-3 hours
8. Serve hot with butter , salt and pepper , or as a dessert with sugar a molasses
9. They are also yummy with mustard

title: pasta sprinkle chicken
steps:
1. Mix oil , vinegar , pasta sprinkle , garlic powder and salt together and pour over chicken
2. Marinate in refrigerator overnight and grill or bake in oven
3. If using oven , bake at 375 for 45 minute for bone in chicken and 20-30 for boneless
4. Serve with a pasta salad tossed with corn and tomatoes and a little more pasta sprinkle

title: rodeo fries
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Wash and slice your potatoes
3. In a saucepan , melt your butter and add in remaining ingredients
4. Stirring constantly
5. Once sauce has warmed up , pour over sliced potatoes and place on a parchment lined
6. Bake at 400 degrees for 45 minutes or until potatoes are tender
7. You just need to keep checking for doneness

title: california guacamole  diabetic diet
steps:
1. Cut the avocados in half and remove the seeds
2. Scoop out the pulp and place in a bowl
3. Drizzle the pulp with lemon juice and mash
4. Combine with the remaining ingredients , mix well and serve

title: iowa pork chops
steps:
1. In a bowl , combine ingredients , except chops , until well mixed
2. Cut a slit in the side of chop and stuff with mixture
3. Combine basting sauce ingredients and blend until smooth
4. In frying pan , brown stuffed chops , then bake at 350 oven for about one hour , basting chops often with sauce

title: favorite squash   cheese
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Boil squash and onion in small amount of salted water until tender
3. Drain
4. While squash in cooking , prepare topping:
5. Melt 1 / 2 c
6. Butter in skillet
7. Saute crushed crackers in butter until crisp and brown , set aside
8. Make a white sauce using 1 / 4 c
9. Butter , cornstarch , and half& half
10. Add cheese
11. Stir until melted and sauce is smooth
12. Arrange squash in 9 x 13 inch glass baking dish
13. Pour sauce over squash
14. Top with cracker topping
15. Bake 25 minutes or until hot& bubbly

title: grilled salmon in champagne sauce
steps:
1. Heat grill to medium heat
2. Paint each fillet on both sides with olive oil
3. Salt and pepper
4. Place on grill and cook for approximately 3-7 minutes on each side , depending on your choice of doneness
5. Remove to heated platter and cover
6. Heat 1 teas
7. Olive oil in saute pan over medim heat
8. Add shallots
9. Saute about 1 1 / 2 minutes to soften
10. Reduce heat to med-low
11. Stir in champagne , mustard , salt and tarragon
12. Blend well
13. Remove from heat , stir in sour cream
14. Place half of sauce on heated serving plate
15. Top with salmon fillet and garnish with very light sprinkle of tarragon
16. Serve

title: morning casserole
steps:
1. Place a layer of frozen potatoes on the bottom of the slow cooker , followed by a layer of bacon then onions , green pepper and cheese
2. Repeat the layering process two or three more times , ending with a layer of cheese
3. Beat the eggs , milk and salt and pepper together
4. Pour over the slow cooker mixture , cover and turn on low
5. Cook for 10-12 hours

title: cinnamon monkey bread
steps:
1. Mix the sugars and cinnamon in a bowl
2. Cut the biscuits into fourths
3. Roll in the sugar / cinnamon mixture
4. Drop in a non-stick bundt pan
5. Melt butter and remaining sugar / cinnamon mixture
6. Pour over the biscuits
7. Bake 30 minutes at 350 degrees
8. Allow to cool 10 minute
9. -turn onto a plate

title: apricot coriander chicken with brie all  wrapped up  in phyllo
steps:
1. Dry roast corriander seeds in a heavy pan , cool completely then grind into a powder
2. Cut chicken into small pieces , about 1 / 2 inch
3. Mix lemon juice and corriander with the chicken and allow to marinate for about 15 minutes
4. Put sliced apricots in a cup and cover with the 1 / 3 cup wine , soak for about 15 minutes
5. Rinse and drain cashews if they are salted
6. In heavy skillet , heat olive oil
7. Add chicken and stirfry about 2 minutes
8. Add cashews and continue cooking on medium heat until chicken begins to lightly brown
9. Add apricots and the wine they have been soaking in and thoroughly mix into the chicken
10. Reduce heat to low and cook until wine has evaporated and apricots are soft
11. Remove from pan , stir in salt and reserve
12. Preheat oven to 350
13. Trim the skin from the brie and cut the cheese into 3 equal pieces
14. Using two sheets at a time , place phyllo dough on a greased baking sheet , overlapping in the middle by about 4 inches to create a large piece - use 6 sheets for this first layer
15. Place the cheese pieces in the middle of the dough and cover with the chicken mixture
16. Quickly fold the edges of the dough over the mixture to form a packet , overlapping as you go
17. Transfer packet carefully to a plate and place the other 6 sheets of dough on the pan to form another large sheet
18. Take the packet from the plate and place it seam side down on the new sheets , then wrap the packet as you did the first time , overlapping the edges
19. Place on a buttered , insulated baking sheet and turn packet over so that seams are on the bottom
20. Smear the top of the packet with the soft butter
21. Bake for about 20 minutes , or until the pastry is golden on top
22. Remove from oven , place on a platter and cut into six wedges

title: 1890 cream cake
steps:
1. On beaten whites of 10 eggs , sift one and a half pulverized sugar and a goblet of flour throught which has been stirred a heaping teaspoon cream of tarter , stir very gently and do not heat it
2. Bake in jelly pans
3. For cream take a half pint of sweet cream , yolks of 3 eggs , tablespoon pulverized sugar , teaspoon cornstarch , dissolve starch smoothly with a little milk , beat yolks and sugar together with this
4. Boil the cream and stir these ingredients in as for any cream cake filling , only make a little thicker
5. Blanch and chop fine a half pound almonds and stir into the cream
6. Put together like jelly cake while icing is soft , and thick and stick in a half pound of almonds , split in two

title: stuffed chicken breast w feta cheese
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Crumble feta cheese into a medium sized bowl
3. Put italian seasoning in palm and crush it as you sprinkle it over the cheese as this releases more flavor
4. Add garlic & onion powder , salt & pepper
5. Mix together with fork
6. Turn the breast so that the thickest part is facing you
7. With a sharp knife cut a pocket in the breast - make sure you don't cut all the way through on any of the three sides
8. You can cut right along the rib which i find is much easier
9. Separate the feta mixture into 6 equal portions
10. Stuff each portion of the feta mixture into the pocket of one breast
11. Flatten the mixture by pressing down on the top part of the pocket then slightly pull the top of the pocket over the cheese
12. As it cooks the meat will contract a little bit and the cheese will 'pop' out
13. If you don't cover it the cheese will spill out all over the place
14. Spray boiler pan with cooking spray & place chicken on pan
15. Cook for no more than 45 minutes or chicken will be tough & dry

title: country vegetable simmer
steps:
1. In a 3 qt saucepan combine beans , potatoes and onions
2. Add enough water to cover
3. Bring to a full boil , and cook over medium heat stirring occasionally until vegetables are crispy tender
4. Drain and return to pan , add remaining ingredients
5. Cook over medium heat stirring occasionally until heated through
6. Stir in parsley and serve

title: herbed lentil casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Combine all ingredients except cheese in an ungrease 1 1 / 2 quart casserole
3. Bake uncovered for 1 1 / 2 - 2 hours
4. Spread cheese on top and bake for additional 5 minutes

title: velveeta nacho bake
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400f prepare dinner as directed on package
2. While macaroni is cooking , cook meat with taco seasoning as directed on package
3. Stir sour cream into prepared dinner
4. Spoon 1 / 2 of dinner mixture into 8-inch square baking dish
5. Top with layers of meat mixture , 1 / 2 of cheddar and remaining dinner mixture
6. Cover
7. Bake 15 min
8. Top with salsa , remaining cheddar and crushed chips
9. Bake , uncovered , 5 minute

title: broccoli rigatoni
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to directions
2. Melt butter together with olive oil in large skillet with cover or dutch oven
3. Cook garlic until no longer raw , but don't allow to brown
4. Add broccoli to the pan , constantly stirring , until broccoli is completely coated in the oil and garlic and pan is very hot
5. Add broth , and immediately cover
6. Steam until broccoli is tender
7. Turn off heat and stir in the fresh basil
8. Combine pasta and broccoli
9. Season with salt and pepper according to taste
10. Serve topped liberally with cheese

title: savory turkey ricotta meatballs
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Combine ground turkey breast with the other ingredients in a bowl and then shape mixture into about 18 meatballs
3. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
4. Coat pan with cooking spray
5. Add meatballs , and brown on all sides
6. Remove from skillet
7. Transfer to a broiler pan coated with cooking spray , and bake for 15 minutes or until done
8. To freeze: follow cooking directions , then allow meatballs to cool to room temperature
9. Place on a baking sheet , making sure they don't touch one another , and place in the freezer for an hour
10. Next , transfer hardened meatballs to an airtight container , and store in the freezer
11. Thaw meatballs in the refrigerator , then bake at 375 degrees for 20 minutes or untinl heated

title: crock pot italian beef
steps:
1. Put all ingredients into crock pot
2. Cook on low for 8 hours or more
3. Break up meat and serve on deli rolls

title: chocolate chippers
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Cream shortening , sugars , eggs and vanilla until light and fluffy
3. Sift flour , baking soda and salt together
4. Beat into creamed mixture and blend well
5. Stir in chocolate chips
6. Drop by the teaspoonful , 2" apart , onto greased cookie sheets
7. Bake 10-12 minutes , until golden brown
8. Cool on wire racks

title: corn  mozzarella and tomato fresca
steps:
1. Chop mozzarella into 1 / 2 inch cubes
2. Tear basil leaves into 1 / 2 inch pieces
3. Chop tomatoes into long slices
4. Mix all ingredients into a large serving dish
5. Salt and pepper to taste
6. Tastes best if chilled in fridge for an hour

title: homemade no color strip cleansing shampoo
steps:
1. Mix baking soda and water in small plastic travel bottle
2. Shake well
3. Use as shampoo , massage through hair , and rinse throughly
4. Ideal to follow with conditioner

title: steve s new england clam chowder
steps:
1. Peel and chop the raw potatoes into small cubes
2. Place the diced potatoes in a dutch oven and fill with just enough water to cover them
3. Bring the water to a boil and cook for 7 minutes or until tender but not soft / mushy
4. Chop the onion into small pieces
5. Cut the bacon into inch pieces , cook until crisp in a large skillet
6. Remove bacon pieces and set aside
7. Drain all but 2 tablespoons of bacon grease
8. Add the chopped onions / celery and minced garlic to the skillet with the bacon grease
9. Saut until the onions are soft
10. Open the cans of clams
11. Drain the liquids into a small container
12. Add of the clam juice to the skillet with the onions , celery , and garlic
13. Set the clams and remainder of clam juice aside
14. Simmer for 5 minutes
15. When the potatoes are done , drain the potatoes and return to the dutch oven
16. Add the onion / celery mixture
17. Stir just enough to mix , not mash
18. In a large sauce pan , melt the butter and add the flour , making a roux
19. Add the half and half cream and the 2% milk
20. Cook on medium heat until thickened , stirring constantly with a whisk
21. Add the cayenne pepper , worcestershire sauce , and ground pepper while sauce thickens
22. Pour the thickened sauce into the dutch oven with the potatoes and onions
23. Add the clams and bacon pieces
24. Stir to mix
25. Cook over medium heat until heated through
26. If the chowder is too thick , add more milk or clam juice until the desired consistency is reached
27. Add salt to taste
28. Spoon into serving bowls , garnish with paprika and parsley , and enjoy

title: buttercream cream cheese decorator frosting
steps:
1. Beat the cream cheese , butter and crisco on medium or high speed for 1 minute or until light and fluffy
2. Add extracts and flavorings and 3 tablespoons of milk , beat on medium speed until combined
3. Gradually add the powdered sugar in about six different intervals and beat until well combined between intervals , using a rubber scraper to make sure all ingredients are incorporated
4. Beat on high speed for approximately 1 minute to increase the volume
5. Frosting will be light and fluffy , you may need to add up to 1 tablespoons of milk for desired consistency
6. I usually add up to 1 teaspoons extra of one of the extracts if i am going to use the frosting for use in a decorating bag
7. I just prefer the flavoring instead of the extra milk
8. If you are going to use this as a colored decorator frosting i've found that adding the gel colors when you add the extracts and milk seems to work the best

title: tamale  chicken
steps:
1. Saute onion and chilies in oil in skillet
2. Combine all ingredients except for 1 / 2 cup shredded cheese and toppings , and pour into slow cooker
3. Top with remaining cheese
4. Cover , cook on high 3-4 hours
5. Serve with your choice of toppings

title: bitsy s vegetarian lasagna
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Undercook lasagna noodles in salted water - should still be slightly rubbery
3. Cool
4. Set aside
5. In 2 tablespoons olive oil , saute finely chopped onion , green bell pepper , mushrooms , minced garlic and ground black pepper until tender
6. Add all but 1 cup tomato sauce to this mixture and heat slightly
7. Set aside
8. In separate bowl , combine ricotta cheese , cottage cheese , eggs , chopped spinach and chopped parsley
9. Set aside
10. Thinly slice mozzarella cheese
11. Set aside
12. Butter oblong baking dish that will accommodate the length of noodles
13. Start at the bottom of pan with a layer of noodles
14. Next a layer of sauce
15. Next the cheeses / eggs / spinach mixture
16. Next mozzarella slices
17. Continue to arrange in layers a-b-c-d-a-b-c-d-a until all ingredients are used up
18. Top layer should be a layer of noodles
19. Pour the last 1 cup of tomato sauce over the top
20. Sprinkle the 1 / 2 cup of fresh grated parmesan cheese over the sauce
21. And sprinkle the 1 / 2 tsp of mrs dash seasoning over the cheese
22. Cover the baking dish with aluminum foil and bake at 350 degrees for 40 minutes
23. Remove the foil and bake uncovered for another 15 minutes
24. Remove from oven and let lasagna "set" for 10 minutes before cutting or serving

title: monte cristo sandwich  the real one
steps:
1. Heat about 5 inches oil in a deep-fryer to 365 degrees
2. While the oil is heating prepare the batter
3. In a medium bowl whisk together the egg and water
4. Combine the flour , baking powder , salt and pepper
5. Whisk into the egg mixture until smooth
6. Set aside and chill
7. To assemble the sandwiches
8. Place one slice of turkey one one slice of bread , then a slice of ham on an other slice of bread , then "sandwich" them with a slice of swiss cheese in the middle
9. Cut the sandwich into quarters then secure with toothpicks
10. Dip each sandwich quarter into the batter so that all the sides are coated
11. Deep-fry in hot oil until golden brown on all sides
12. Remove the toothpicks and arrange on a serving tray
13. Dust with confectioners sugar just before serving
14. Delicious !

title: thai peanut noodles
steps:
1. Bring a large pot of water to a boil
2. Add noodles and cook until tender according to package directions
3. Drain
4. Meanwhile , combine chicken broth , coconut milk , ginger , soy sauce , peanut butter , honey , chili paste , and garlic in a small saucepan
5. Cook over medium heat until peanut butter melts and is heated through
6. Add noodles , carrots and bean sprouts , and toss to coat
7. Garnish with green onions and peanuts

title: baby carrots
steps:
1. Place carrots in saucepan with water and bring to boil for about 10 minutes or until carrots are crisp-tender
2. May need more or less time depending on size and girth of your baby carrots
3. Drain carrots
4. Return to saucepan with remaining ingredients and cook over med-high heat for about 5 more minutes

title: jody s goulash
steps:
1. Boil noodles and drain
2. In large skillet , add ground beef , onions and salt
3. Cook until beef is browned
4. Add the cooked noodles and the rest of the ingredients
5. Cover and cook on low heat for 30 minutes

title: glazed snap peas
steps:
1. Cook peas according to package directions
2. Drain
3. Stir in the honey , butter , salt and pepper flakes
4. Sprinkle with bacon

title: zosia s polish dill pickle soup
steps:
1. In a large saucepan or soup pot with cover , combine chicken broth , bouillon , carrots , potatoes and celery
2. Bring to a boil , reduce heat and cook covered , over low heat , til potatoes start to get soft
3. Do not over cook
4. Add pickles and continue cooking about 15 minutes
5. In a small bowl , beat milk and flour til smooth and stir in a small amount of the hot soup and add to soup
6. Bring to the boil and cook til slightly thickened
7. Remove from heat
8. In a small bowl , beat egg with sour cream till smooth and stir in a small amount of the hot soup
9. Add to soup and stir til smooth
10. Keep soup warm but do not boil
11. Salt and pepper to taste
12. Garnish with parsley and dill

title: banana bread oatmeal
steps:
1. In medium saucepan , bring milk , brown sugar , spices and salt to a gentle boil
2. Stir in oats
3. Return to a boil
4. Reduce heat to medium
5. Cook 1 minute for quick oats , 5 minutes for old fashioned oats , or until most of liquid is absorbed , stirring occasionally
6. Remove oatmeal from heat
7. Stir in mashed bananas and pecans
8. Spoon oatmeal into six cereal bowls
9. Top with yogurt , sliced bananas and pecan halves , if desired
10. Bake at 350f 5 to 7 minutes or until light golden brown
11. Or , spread nuts evenly on microwave-safe plate
12. Microwave on high 1 minute
13. Stir
14. Continue to microwave on high , checking every 30 seconds , until nuts are fragrant and brown

title: shrimp or chicken pad thai
steps:
1. Deep rice noodles in warm water until soft but firm , drain a set aside
2. Heat oil in a wok
3. Add garlic and purple onion , stir fry 3 minutes
4. Add shrimp or chicken , cook for 5 minutes
5. Add noodles
6. Pre-mix fish sauce , brown sugar , lime juice and tamarind concentrate with water , then pour it onto the noodles
7. Cook until almost dry
8. Slowly add the beaten egg
9. Remove from the heat
10. Top with cilantro , bean sprouts and peanuts
11. Serve and enjoy

title: iron mike s sweet tomato pizza sauce   the spirit of cincinnati
steps:
1. In a large pot , heat oil over medium heat
2. Add the tomato puree
3. Watch out for splatterage !
4. Add everything else and simmer uncovered on low , stirring frequently , for 30-60 minutes , until desired consistency
5. Freeze leftover sauce until ready to use
6. When using on pizza dough , thaw to room temperature
7. Thaws nicely in the microwave
8. Don't use too much pepper
9. You can mince a baby carrot in the garlic press after microwaving it for 5-10 seconds- just cut it in half before putting it through the press- and that equals about 1 / 2 tablespoon
10. Either light or dark brown sugar is fine , but the dark brown sugar makes the sauce deep red- almost maroon
11. If you want the sauce even sweeter , just add more honey next time

title: chicken  la king
steps:
1. Heat 1 tbsp of olive oil in a pan and gently fry the mushrooms for 3 minutes until softened
2. Pour in the mushroom soup , water and milk and cook to a simmer
3. Now add in the shredded chicken and peas and continue to heat through until the chicken has warmed through
4. Serve either with pasta or boiled rice

title: neapolitan refrigerator cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit
2. Grease and flour a 13x9 pan
3. Mix cake mix , water , margarine and egg whites together until well blended
4. Pour batter into prepared pan
5. Bake 25-30 minutes until toothpick comes out clean
6. Cool completely
7. When cool poke holes 1 inch apart into cake with the handle of a wooden spoon
8. Puree strawberries in blender until smooth
9. Spoon evenly over top of cake , allowing to soak into holes
10. For topping , mix pudding and milk until smooth in large bowl
11. Fold in cool whip
12. Spread over cake
13. Decorate with fresh berries
14. Refrigerate for at least 4 hours
15. Store refrigerated

title: mustard and chive sauce
steps:
1. Melt the butter in a small pan and stir in the flour
2. Remove from the heat and stir in the mustard
3. Return the pan to the heat and gradually incorporate the milk , beating with a spoon as it comes up to a boil
4. Season with salt and pepper and let simmer gently , uncovered , for 10-15 minutes
5. This cooks the flour and thickens the sauce
6. Stir in the chives , adding a touch of soup stock or water if it seems too thick
7. Spoon over slices of ham

title: eggplant ratatouille
steps:
1. Coat large skillet with nonstick cooking spray
2. Heat over medium heat
3. Add onion , zucchini and red bell pepper , saute 5 to 7 minutes , or until vegetables are tender
4. Add eggplant , tomatoes , italian seasoning , salt and black pepper , bring to boiling
5. Cover and simmer 10 minutes , stirring often , add basil and stir
6. Serve immediately and sprinkle with asiago cheese if desited

title: spaghetti with white crabmeat olive oil  chilli and garlic
steps:
1. Cook spaghetti for 6 - 7 minutes
2. Drain and immediately mix in chilli , garlic and oil
3. Put in crab parsley , pepper and salt
4. Mix thoroughly to allow crabmeat to warm through
5. Serve as soon as possible

title: bacon lettuce salad
steps:
1. Cut bacon in small pieces , fry till crisp
2. Drain and set aside
3. The more bacon the better
4. In large serving bowl layer as follows: plain lettuce or romaine or both , radishes , red onion and cauliflower
5. Layer fried bacon on salad mixture
6. Spread salad dressing on top of bacon like icing
7. Sprinkle a generous amount of parmesan cheese on top of salad dressing
8. Let salad sit on counter till 10 to 15 minutes before serving time
9. Mix well
10. Will seem dry at first but will moisten as you mix

title: cheesy salad  bars
steps:
1. Preheat over to 350f
2. Spray 7x11 pan or 9-inch square baking dish
3. Whisk flour , salt , baking powder in small bowl
4. In medium bowl , mix egg and milk
5. Add to dry ingredients and blend well
6. Stir in cheese and greens
7. Mix until greens are coated in batter
8. Pour batter into a greased baking dish
9. Sprinkle pine nuts around top of batter
10. Press lightly
11. Then , sprinkle parmesan cheese and pepper
12. Bake 20-25 minutes or until lightly browned
13. Cut into bars when cooled
14. Enjoy these healthy snacks !

title: pear crisp with lemon sauce
steps:
1. In a 2-quart baking dish , mix together pears , 1 tablespoon sugar , and 1 / 4 teaspoon lemon peel
2. Toss to mix
3. In a bowl , combine oats , brown sugar , flour , cardamon , and 1 / 4 teaspoon lemon peel
4. Using a pastry blender , cut in 1 / 4 cup butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs
5. Stir in almonds
6. Sprinkle topping over fruit
7. Bake at 375 for 30-35 minutes or until fruit is tender and topping begins to brown
8. Cool slightly on a wire rack
9. In a small sauepan , combine 1 / 4 cup sugar and cornstarch
10. Stir in water until combined
11. Cook and stir over medium heat until thickened and bubbly
12. Cook and stir for 2 more minutes
13. Remove from heat
14. Beat egg yolk in a small bowl
15. Add a little of the hot mixture to the egg yolk and stir
16. Return all egg yolk mixture to saucepan
17. Cook and stir over low heat until nearly bubbly
18. Cook and stir one minute longer
19. Remove from heat
20. Stir in 1 tablespoon butter , lemon juice , and the remaining 1 / 4 teaspoon lemon peel
21. Serve crisp with warm sauce

title: grilled chicken caesar sandwich
steps:
1. Toast the buns
2. Warm the chicken if using the leftovers from a barbeque party
3. Spread the dressing on the buns
4. Add the chicken
5. Top with parmesan and lettuce
6. Serve

title: gluten free chocolate crinkles
steps:
1. Cream butter and sugar together
2. Beat in eggs , one at a time
3. Mix in vanilla and chocolate
4. Stir in flour , baking powder , and salt together
5. Add and mix well
6. Shape into one inch balls and roll in icing sugar
7. Arrange on greased baking sheets and bake in a preheated 350 oven for 8 to 10 minutes
8. Cookies will be quite soft
9. Enjoy !

title: traditional tartiflette a la joel robuchon
steps:
1. Put the potatoes in a saucepan and cover them with 1 quart water and 1 level tablespoon salt
2. Bring to a boil and simmer for 20-40 minutes , depending on the size of the potatoes
3. When they are finished , the
4. Drain
5. While the potatoes cook , melt the butter in another saucepan
6. When it foams , add the onion and cook over low heat for 3 minutes
7. The onion should not brown
8. Add the wine and simmer for 20 minutes
9. When the potatoes are cool enough to handle , peel them and chop them into large chunks
10. Preheat the oven to 480 degrees fahrenheit / 240 degrees celsius
11. In a large bowl , gently mix the potato chunks with the lardons and reduced wine
12. Pour the combination into a baking dish
13. Whip the chilled heavy cream
14. Remove the crust from the reblochon and chop it into pieces
15. Put them in a baking dish and bake for 18 minutes
16. They should get warm but not too hot
17. Put the warmed cheese in a blender or food processor and blend briskly as you add the broth
18. Add the whipped cream to the blended cheese
19. Taste for salt and pepper
20. Spread this creamy cheese over the top of the potatoes
21. Sprinkle the dish on the diagonal with the grated beaufort cheese
22. Bake for 8-12 minutes
23. You want the tartiflette to get a little color
24. Serve very hot

title: creamy mustard sauce  vegan
steps:
1. Pour the wine into a hot pan and reduce by half
2. Whisk in the other ingredients and cook until hot and your desired consistency is acheived

title: chicken macaroni salad
steps:
1. Drain the chicken and reserve the broth
2. Add the chicken broth to the saucepan you will cook the macaroni in
3. Add enough water to just cover the macaroni
4. Cook macaroni al dente , drain and run under cold water
5. Cool completely
6. Break up the chicken and add to a large bowl , add the cooled macaroni , tomato , cheese cubes , celery , cucumber and green onion
7. Mix well
8. In a small bowl whisk together the yogurt , mayonnaise , mustard and pepper
9. Pour over the chicken / macaroni mix and stir lightly until well coated
10. Line platter with crisp lettuce leaves and fill with salad
11. Refrigerate for at least one hour

title: onsted marzetti
steps:
1. Brown ground beef and onion , drain , and season with steak seasoning , salt and pepper to taste
2. Combine all ingredients , pour into greased casserole dish and bake at 325 for one hour

title: five cheese noodle casserole
steps:
1. In a large mixing bowl , blend together the cottage cheese and cooked noodles
2. Pour this blend into a 9" x 13" casserole dish that has been sprayed with cooking spray
3. Using a large saucepan , pour in the soup , half and half , cream cheese , cheddar cheese , salt , pepper , and butter
4. Heat over medium-low heat until melted and blended
5. Pour this over the noddles in the casserole dish
6. Sprinkle the top of the casserole with the croutons and the parmesan cheese
7. Bake at 375-degrees f
8. For 15 minutes

title: mary s one step pound cake
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 325 degrees and grease and flour a 12 bundt or tube pan
2. Combine all ingredients in a large mixing bowl and blend at low speed till mixed then for 3 minutes on medium speed
3. Pour into the prepared pan and bake for 60-70 minutes until the top of the cake springs back with lightly touched in the center
4. Cool the cake upright in pan for 15 minutes then remove from pan and cool completely
5. Pour glaze on once it is completely cooled

title: feta chicken marsala
steps:
1. Marsala:
2. Season chicken with salt and pepper on both sides
3. In skillet on medium-high , add 2 t olive oil
4. Saute chicken for about 2 minutes on each side
5. Transfer to plate and cover with aluminum foil
6. In same skillet , add 1 t oil and mushrooms
7. Season with salt and pepper then saute for 3-4 minutes
8. Add garlic and saute for 1 minute
9. Add marsala and reduce
10. Remove from heat and add sour cream and feta
11. Garnish with parsley
12. Serve over rice
13. Rice:
14. Place all ingredients in pot
15. Bring to boil
16. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes

title: 4 alarm salsa chicken
steps:
1. In a medium sauce pan , add the oil heat at medium-high for two minutes
2. Add onion , garlic , serrano pepper , picante sauce , yogurt , salt , pepper , and turmeric powder
3. Stir constantly and steam until the onions caramelize and it becomes like a sauce
4. Cook on medium uncovered for 5-10 minutes
5. Add the cubes of chicken and 1 / 2 cup water
6. Cover the pot and let it steam for 25 minutes
7. Stir occasionally so that the chicken doesn't stick to the bottom
8. Keep the burner on medium-low
9. Now add the celantro and let it steam covered for another 10 minutes on low heat
10. This chicken is best served wrapped in tortilla's
11. I prefer wheat tortillas but flour is just as good
12. Have some cream cheese and salsa or sour cream on the side as a dip
13. You can also try serving the chicken with rice

title: cranberry bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease a 9 x 5 3- inch loaf pan
3. Place nuts on a baking sheet and toast in oven until very lightly browned , about 5 min
4. Leave oven on
5. Coarsely chop nuts and set aside
6. In a large bowl , using a hand held mixer , beat butter and sugar until light and fluffy
7. Add egg
8. Beat 1 minute
9. Gradually beat in juice
10. Add flour , baking powder , orange zest , and salt
11. Mix until just blended
12. Stir in cranberries and toasted walnuts
13. Spread batter into pan
14. Bake until top of loaf is golden and a toothpick inserted in center comes out clean , 50-55 min
15. Let stand in pan for 10 minutes
16. Unmold onto a wire rack and let cool completely

title: all bran banana bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180 degree c
2. Combine dry ingredients and add egg , water , milk and banana
3. Mix until well combined
4. Spoon into a greased loaf tin
5. Bake in oven for 30-45 minutes or until cooked when tested

title: spicy vegan gingerbread cookies
steps:
1. Mix all of the ingredients
2. Cover and refrigerate for about an hour and a half to two hours
3. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees
4. Roll out to " thick on a lightly floured surface , and use cookie cutters to cut the dough
5. Place the cookies on a greased pan , and bake for ten to twelve minutes , until you can touch the cookies without leaving an indentation

title: sweet potato split pea soup
steps:
1. In large pot over low heat , add oil , onion , celery , carrot , sweet potatoes , garlic , pepper , oregano , thyme , and paprika , stirring to combine
2. Cook 5-10 minutes till onions , and celery start to soften
3. Add split peas , stock , water , bouillon , bay leaves , and bring to a boil
4. Reduce heat to low , cover and simmer 60 minutes
5. At this point you can serve it as is for chunky soup or puree it in batches for a creamer soup

title: easy caribbean peanut punch
steps: 1. Put all ingredients into blender and process until smooth

title: shrimp satay
steps:
1. To make the sauce: in a saucepan , whisk together all the sauce ingredients with 1 / 4 cup water
2. Over medium heat , bring to a simmer
3. Cook 1-2 minutes to thicken
4. Set aside to make the shrimp: in a small mixing bowl , add the cumin , salt , ginger , and curry powder
5. Stir to mix
6. Put shrimp into a medium-size mixing bowl
7. Drizzle with peanut oil and toss to coat
8. Sprinkle spice mixture over the shrimp
9. Toss to coat
10. Cover and refrigerate for 20-30 minutes
11. Thread shrimp on skeweres
12. Grill over direct high heat for 2-4 minutes or until just opaque in the center and firm to touch
13. Serve warm with satay sauce

title: spinach and shrimp soup
steps:
1. Heat veg oil in large soup pot on med-high heat
2. Add onions and saute for 3 mins or til softened slightly
3. Add green onions , garlic , thyme , allspice and hot pepper of choice
4. Saute for 1 more minute
5. Add broth and bring to boil
6. Add spinach and coconut milk
7. Reduce heat and simmer for 10 to 15 mins or til spinach is limp
8. Remove hot pepper and discard
9. Add shrimp and cook for another 2 minutes or til pink and curled
10. Add lime juice , season well with salt and pepper

title: chocolate  cake dripping with chocolate sauce
steps:
1. Cream the butter and caster sugar until white and fluffy
2. Beat each egg individually into the mix
3. Stir in the vanilla extract
4. Sieve the flour and cocoa powder together and fold in gently
5. Line two 9" cake tins with greaseproof paper and evenly pour the mixture into both
6. Pre heat the oven to gas mark 5 / 190c / 375f and cook for 25 minutes
7. Turn the tins after 15 minutes so that the cakes rise evenly
8. Cool on a wire rack
9. For the sauce mix the boiling water and cocoa powder together in a saucepan
10. Add the golden syrup and icing sugar
11. Bring to the boil stirring so as not to burn the sugar
12. Allow to cool , it will thicken as it cools
13. Cover one cake sandwich with the strawberry jam and place the other on top
14. Cover with the chocolate sauce

title: beef and green chili soup  sure to warm you up
steps:
1. Zaar will not let me enter the green chilis amount ! please
2. :-)
3. Heat a large dutch-oven over meduim-high heat
4. Add beef and cook until browned , stirring to crumble
5. Remove beefand set aside
6. Add veggies to pan and cook until tender
7. Add spices and garlic
8. Cook 1 minute to combine
9. Return beef to pan
10. Ad broth and chilis
11. Bring to a boil
12. Add maccaroni and reduce heat to simmer
13. Cook about 8 more minutes until noodles are done
14. Yield 6 1cup servings
15. Hint: i boil my noodles separately and add them to each serving ! that way leftover soup when reheated does not have gummy / loppy noodles in it ! :-)

title: grilled salmon with basil aioli
steps:
1. For the basil aioli: whisk egg yolks , basil , garlic , anchovies , vinegar , and worcestershire sauce in medium bowl
2. Whisk in 2 tb oil a few drops at a time , then gradually whisk in remaining oil in a thin stream
3. Whisk in 1 tb warm water , lemon juice , and hot pepper sauce
4. Season to taste with salt and pepper
5. Cover and chill
6. For salmon: prepare a bbq
7. Brush grill rack with oil
8. Brush salmon with oil
9. Sprinkle with salt and pepper
10. Grill salmon , uncovered , 5 minutes
11. Using 2 large spatulas , carefully turn fish over
12. Grill until fish just begins to flake in center , 4 to 5 minutes longer
13. Transfer salmon to platter
14. Serve with aioli

title: savory chicken   biscuits
steps:
1. Also terrific with lipton recipe secrets golden onion soup mix
2. Preheat oven to 400f degrees
3. In 12-inch skillet , heat oil over medium-high heat and cook chicken , stirring occasionally , 5 minutes or until almost done
4. Stir in onion , carrots and celery
5. Cook , stirring occasionally , 3 minutes
6. Stir in savory herb with garlic soup mix blended with milk
7. Bring to the boiling point over medium-high heat , stirring occasionally
8. Cook 1 minute
9. Turn into lightly greased 2-quart casserole
10. Arrange biscuits on top of chicken mixture with edges touching
11. Bake 10 minutes or until biscuits are golden brown
