title: barbecued cheddar burgers
steps:
1. Mix first 4 ingredients in large bowl until blended
2. Mix in pepper
3. Shape half of meat mixture into eight 1 / 2-inch-thick patties
4. Shape remaining meat mixture into four 1-inch-thick patties
5. Prepare barbecue
6. Grill patties to desired doneness , topping with cheese for last minute of cooking , about 4 minutes per side for medium-rare 1 / 2-inch-thick patties , and about 6 minutes per side for medium-rare 1-inch-thick patties
7. Place burgers on bottom halves of buns
8. Top with lettuce , tomatoes and upper halves of buns

title: thai beef  crock pot
steps:
1. Cut flank steak into strips , on diagonal
2. Place meat and carrots in a crock pot
3. Pour peanut stir-fry sauce over meat and carrots
4. Cover and cook on low for 8 hours or on high for 4 hours
5. Cook thai noodles according to directions
6. Stir in coconut milk to crock pot
7. Serve over noodles , and sprinkle with peanuts

title: jamaican banana bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Melt the chocolate over hot water
3. Sift together flour , sugar , cinnamon , salt , baking powder and soda and set aside
4. Combine the banana and butter and beat till blend
5. Beat in the egg
6. Add , and blend well after each addition , the flour mixture alternately with the milk
7. Stir in melted chocolate and nuts , if using
8. Spread in greased and floured 13" x 9" x 2" pan and bake at 350 f for 25 minutes

title: stuffed bell peppers ala frey
steps:
1. Wash peppers
2. Cut them in half at the stem
3. Clean the seeds and membrane from then and place them in a 9x13 pan
4. Wash the zucchini and cut them into quarters and finely slice them
5. Heat the oil in a large skillet
6. Saute the zucchini , mushrooms , celery , zucchini , onion and garlic until the vegetables are softened
7. Set aside and cool
8. While vegetables are cooling , mix well the ground beef , eggs , bread crumbs , garlic granules , paprika , salt and pepper
9. When veggies are cool , mix into the ground beef mixture
10. Evenly distribute the beef amongst the pepper halves in the pan
11. Pour sauce over all
12. Cover pan with foil
13. Bake for 1 hour at 350 degrees
14. Check to see if peppers are done to your desire tenderness
15. If not continue cooking uncovered until the peppers are done

title: deviled corn
steps:
1. Heat the corn in the butter , add mustard , salt and pepper
2. Add cheese
3. Serve hot

title: braised spinach and onion  with variations
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , combine onions and chicken broth
2. Cook onion until stock has reduced to 1 / 4 cup , about 7 - 9 minutes , stirring constantly
3. Remove onions from heat
4. Set aside
5. In a large skillet spray with pam
6. With some water still clinging to the spinach , add to skillet and cook until just wilted
7. Remove from heat and cool slightly
8. Squeeze out excess liquid and chop
9. Melt butter over low heat or in microwave
10. Add butter , spinach to the braised onions and combine
11. Salt , pepper to suit taste
12. Place in casserole dish
13. Bake in preheated 350 oven for 20 minutes or until heated through

title: honey teriyaki salmon
steps:
1. In a large ziploc bag , marinate salmon in teriyaki at least 4 hours , or overnight
2. Preheat grill on high
3. Place salmon meat side down on grill for 3 minutes
4. Rotate 1 / 4 turn , cook 3 minutes
5. Flip so skin side is now down
6. Brush with honey
7. Cook 6 minutes , or until no longer pink

title: gluten free coconut flour tortillas
steps:
1. Pour egg whites and water into a medium bowl
2. Sift coconut flour and salt into the egg white mixture
3. Heat a frying pan and melt 1 teaspoons of butter or oil to grease the bottom of pan
4. Slowly pour 2-3 tablespoons of the coconut flour mixture onto the pan and quickly spread the batter around into a larger , thin circle by turning the pan
5. Fry for about 1-2 minutes on the first side , or until the edges start to lift and you can easily move your spatula underneath the cooking tortilla without it breaking
6. Flip and cook on the other side
7. Serve

title: southwest beef   pintos
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a slow cooker
2. Cover and cook on low 11 to 12 hours

title: eclair cake  no bake
steps:
1. Lightly butter a 13 x 9" baking pan
2. Layer bottom of baking pan with graham crackers ,
3. Mix the puddings and the milk , when it starts to thicken , fold in the cool whip topping
4. Spread half of the pudding / topping mixture onto the crackers , then add another layer of graham crackers
5. Frost the top layer of crackers using all of the chocolate icing
6. Refrigerate overnight or for 4 hours before serving
7. Cut into squares and enjoy !

title: huevos revueltos   with prawns and baby spinach
steps:
1. Wash the baby spinach leaves , then steam in the water still on the leaves , for about 1 minute or until the leaves are just beginning to wilt
2. Drain the baby spinach leaves well , lightly squeeze dry , then toss in a bowl with a little olive oil , and sea salt and freshly ground pepper to taste
3. Break the eggs into a separate bowl , add the parsley , paprika , oregano , sea salt and freshly ground pepper to taste , then lightly whisk together
4. Heat the oil in a non-stick pan and saut the finely chopped onion and crushed garlic until it begins to soften but not brown
5. Add the prawns for a minute or two , tossing or stirring
6. Add the spinach , and continue to toss the ingredients in the pan
7. Pour the seasoned eggs into the spinach mixture , and stir gently over a medium heat , pausing for several moments at a time to allow the mixture to begin to set
8. If you want to be faithful to the spirit of the original sevillian recipe , remove the pan from the heat while the eggs are still a little runny
9. Or if - like me - you really do prefer your eggs not to be runny , leave them over the heat for just that bit longer
10. Serve immediately with warm crusty rolls
11. Variations: i have not tried these variations , but i think this basic recipe would also taste great with proscuitto , ham or bacon , which most of us are more likely to have on hand at all times
12. Or even with left-over chicken

title: moist baked oatmeal
steps:
1. Set oven to 350f spray with non-stick an 8-in square baking dish
2. Mix oats , dried fruits , baking powder , 1 1 / 2 tsp cinnamon , and salt
3. In a separate bowl , mix applesauce , yogurt , eggs , milk , oil and vanilla
4. Stir into oat mixture and pour in baking dish
5. Smooth surface and sprinkle with cinnamon on top
6. Bake for 40 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean
7. Cool in pan for 20 to 30 minutes , cut into 6 squares and cool completely
8. Park in the fridge
9. When ready to serve them , put a piece on a plate , drizzle with a couple of tablespoons of milk , heat in the microwave for 1 minute
10. Add fresh fruits on top and enjoy

title: pouch potatoes
steps:
1. Slice potatoes inch thick
2. Cut onions in half , then in inch thick slices
3. Cut squash or zucchini in inch thick slices
4. Cut pepper in half , remove seeds , and then cut in inch thick slices
5. Lay two large pieces of aluminum foil on table , set one potato on each
6. Alternate potato with slices of onion , squash or zucchini , and green pepper
7. Top potato and veggies with chopped garlic
8. Sprinkle liberally with worcestershire sauce , italian dressing , and balsamic vinegar
9. Add remaining spices liberally after the liquid has been added
10. Seal foil well
11. Bake over grill , rotating every 15 minutes , for one hour

title: mediterranean skillet
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large skillet over moderate heat
2. Add chicken pieces and season with salt and pepper
3. When the chicken pieces start to brown , add potatoes , garlic , onions and red pepper and season with a bit more salt and pepper
4. Continue browning chicken and vegetables for about 10 minutes , stirring often
5. Add wine and allow to bubble for a couple of minutes
6. Add basil , oregano , thyme , tomatoes and paprika
7. Cover and reduce heat to low
8. Cook for 30 minutes , covered , stirring occasionally , or until potatoes are tender and chicken is fully cooked
9. Remove from heat and add spinach , stirring to combine
10. Serve immediately with crusty baguettes and alioli

title: quick and easy pizza burgers
steps:
1. Preheat your oven to 350 degrees
2. Mix together all ingredients from ground beef through pizza sauce
3. Separate the halves of the hamburger buns , placing each half face-up on a baking sheet
4. Spread the meat mixture on each of the hamburger bun halves
5. Top each with a slice of mozzarella
6. Bake for 20 minutes or until the cheese is golden and bubbly

title: mexican fiesta fish
steps:
1. Lay the fish fillets in a single layer in a greased 8"x12" baking dish
2. Pour the salsa over the top , and then sprinkle evenly with the shredded cheese
3. Top everything with the crushed corn chips
4. Bake , uncovered , at 400f for 15 minutes , or until fish is opaque and flakes with a fork
5. Serve with choice of garnish: sliced avocado , green chiles , olives and sour cream

title: roasted cauliflower with brown butter
steps:
1. Preheat your oven to 425 degrees
2. Cut the stem off the cauliflower as close to the base as possible and remove any leaves
3. Rub oil all over the cauliflower
4. Place the cauliflower in an oven-proof skillet
5. Slide the skillet into the preheated oven and roast the cauliflower for 45 minutes
6. Remove it from the oven and smear the soft butter over the surface
7. Season with a salt and pepper
8. Continue to roast the cauliflower for another 30 - 45 minutes , basting it several times with the butter , which will have browned
9. Its done when you can insert a paring knife into it and feel no resistence and should be completely tender

title: no lemons lemonade
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients except the orange in a one quart container
2. Cut the orange into 4-6 slices
3. Do not peel or squeeze the orange !
4. Drop the orange slices into the lemonade and stir
5. Serve cold
6. I still only use one orange even if i double the recipe

title: freezer manicotti
steps:
1. Place manicotti in a foil pan that has been sprayed with non-stick spray
2. In large bowl , combine marinara sauce , diced tomatoes with juice , garlic and italian seasoning
3. Pour over manicotti
4. Top with mozzarella cheese
5. Cover with foil and freeze up to 2 months

title: lori s tomatillo soup
steps:
1. Combine the chicken , onions , garlic , soy sauce , ginger , tomatillos , cilantro , jalapenos , juice and stock in a crockpot
2. Cover
3. Cook on low for 8 hours
4. Stir in the pea pods and sprouts

title: gordon ramsay s stuffed chicken
steps:
1. Cut a deep slit along one side of each chicken breast , without slicing right through , then open it out like a book
2. On a clean chopping board , finely chop 4 sage leaves , then mix into the ricotta and season with salt and pepper to taste
3. Lay two parma ham slices on the board , overlapping them slightly
4. Put a sage leaf in the middle and lay an open chicken breast on top
5. Spoon a quarter of the ricotta mixture onto the middle of the chicken , then fold the sides together again , to enclose the filling
6. Now wrap the parma ham slices around the stuffed chicken breast
7. Wrap in cling film
8. Repeat with the rest of the chicken breasts and chill for 1-2hrs to firm up slightly
9. Heat the oven to 350f and place a roasting pan in the oven to heat up
10. Heat a heavy-based frying pan and add the olive oil
11. When hot , fry the parma-wrapped chicken , in batches if necessary , for 2 mins on each side until browned
12. Lay a few thyme sprigs on each chicken breast , then place in the hot roasting pan
13. Cook in the oven for 12-15 mins , depending on size , or until the meat feels just firm when lightly pressed
14. Rest the chicken , covered with foil , in a warm place for 5-10 minutes slice each stuffed breast thickly on the diagonal and arrange on warm plates

title: dutch oven campfire cobbler
steps:
1. Place dutch oven over approximately 15 charcoal briquettes or over coals on a flat spot in the fire ring
2. Empty pie filling into dutch oven
3. Spread dry cake mix on top of pie filling and spread evenly
4. Sprinkle with cinnamon to taste
5. Cut butter or margarine into even sized pieces and arrange on top
6. Put lid on dutch oven and arrange 10 hot charcoal briquettes in a checkerboard pattern on top or scatter hot coals over lid
7. Bake until done

title: carrabba s italian dip
steps:
1. Mix together your dry spices
2. Add crushed garlic to the dry spices
3. Place on small saucer
4. Pour olive oil over mixture
5. Dip with your favorite hot french bread

title: mini hamburgers
steps:
1. Divide 1 lb of beef into 9 equal sized balls
2. Form a patty out of each ball about 4 inches in diameter and 1 / 4 inch thick
3. Do this on waxed paper
4. Now freeze the patties at least a hour
5. You need two electric griddles
6. One for meat and one for toasting buns
7. Pre-heat the meat griddle to 375 f to 400 f and bun griddle about 350 f till light brown
8. Place dill slices and dried chopped onion one each hamburger
9. Put on ketchup and mustard with salt and pepper to taste

title: herbed chicken piccata
steps:
1. Combine first 5 ingredients in a plastic bag
2. Flatten the chicken to -inch thickness
3. Lightly coat both sides of chicken with cooking spray
4. Dredge chicken in breadcrumb mixture
5. Melt margarine in a large skillet over medium high heat
6. Cook chicken 4 minutes on each side or until done
7. Meanwhile , saut lemon slices in pan
8. Add lemon juice and chicken broth
9. Bring to a boil
10. Add pepper and garlic to taste
11. Garnish with parsley
12. Lightly spoon sauce over chicken
13. Goes well with pasta

title: festive lemon cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. In a large mixing bowl , cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy
3. Beat in lemon juice until well blended
4. Add eggs , one at a time , beating thoroughly after each addition
5. Sift together flour , baking powder and salt
6. Add dry ingredients to creamed mixture alternately with milk , beginning and ending with flour
7. Pour into a greased 12 cup bundt pan
8. Bake in a 350 degree f oven for 50-60 minutes , or until cake springs back at the touch of a finger and slightly leaves the sides of the pan
9. Cool in the pan five minutes , invert and cool on a rack
10. Lemon glaze: blend confectioner's sugar with lemon juice
11. Drizzle over cake

title: herb roasted sweet potato skins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f pierce potatoes all over with a fork then arrange on a greased foil-lined baking sheet , cut sides down , and bake until tender but not mushy , about 30 minutes
2. Transfer to a plate and set aside until cool enough to handle
3. Reserve foil-lined baking sheet
4. Arrange a rack in the oven about 6 inches from the heating element and preheat broiler
5. Scoop about half of the potato flesh from the skins , leaving a 1 / 2-inch thick wall around the edges and bottom of each half
6. Cut each sweet potato shell lengthwise into 1 / 2-inch strips then arrange on the same foil-lined baking sheet in a single layer
7. In a small bowl , combine oil , parsley , oregano , rosemary , thyme , sage , salt and pepper then brush all over potato skins and broil until browned in parts and piping hot , 4 to 6 minutes total

title: marinated mushrooms
steps:
1. Place mushrooms in a pot large enough to hold them
2. Pour dressing over mushrooms and bring to a boil
3. Let boil for 3 or 4 minutes
4. Cover pot and turn off the burner
5. Let sit until cooled to room temperature
6. Taste and add salt if needed

title: buffalo bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Mix together the dates , baking soda , and boiling water
3. Add the egg and syrup and mix well
4. Beat in remaining ingredients
5. Pour into a greased 9x5-inch bread pan and bake for one hour or until done
6. Cool

title: world s best cheese cake  cheesecake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325f
2. Dry mix graham cracker crumbs and cinnamon and mix in melted butter , until uniform and all crumbs are wetted out
3. Press into the bottom of a spring form pan and up the sides an inch or so
4. Set aside
5. Mix cream cheese in a large bowl with an electric mixer until soft and workable
6. Add eggs , 1 / 2 c sugar and vanilla and mix with electric mixer until smooth
7. Add whipping cream slowly with mixing to avoid lumping
8. Pour batter into prepared crust , and bake for 45 minutes
9. Mix sour cream and 1 / 4 c sugar and spread this evenly over the baked cheese cake
10. Bake for 15 more minutes
11. Cake is done when toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
12. Top with fruit pie filling if desired

title: baked catfish with cormeal crust
steps:
1. Season cornmeal with salt and cayenne
2. Rinse fish , pat dry
3. Dredge in flour , then egg , then cornmeal
4. Bake at 450 on lowest shelf of oven for 10 minutes , turning after 5 minutes
5. Serve with lemon

title: smoked gouda macaroni and cheese
steps:
1. Fry bacon in a large skillet until crisp , remove to paper towels to drain
2. Add panko bread crumbs and toast in skillet until golden
3. Remove from heat and crumble bacon into bread crumbs , toss to combine
4. Using salted water , cook the pasta according to package directions , but do not rinse
5. Set aside
6. Melt butter in a large saucepan over medium-low heat
7. Whisk in flour until smooth
8. Continue whisking and cook for 2 minutes
9. Gradually whisk in the milk
10. Whisking constantly , cook for 5 minutes or until thickened
11. Reduce heat to low and stir in salt , black pepper and most of the cheese
12. In a large bowl combine cooked pasta and cheese sauce
13. The sauce will be thin , but will thicken once baked
14. Pour the pasta mixture into a lightly greased 8 x 11 x 2 baking dish
15. Sprinkle the top with the remaining cup of cheese and sprinkle with the prepared bacon / panko topping
16. Bake at 400 for 20-30 minutes or until bubbly
17. Remove from oven and allow to rest about 10-15 minutes

title: beef  tomato and red wine casserole
steps:
1. Trim excess fat from beef and cut into 3cm pieces
2. Combine flour and paprika
3. Season with salt and pepper
4. Toss beef in flour to coat lightly
5. Heat 1 tbs oil in a large heatproof casserole dish
6. Cook beef in batches , until well browned , adding more oil as required
7. Remove beef from pan and set aside
8. Add onion to pan and cook , stirring occasionally for 4 mins or until tender
9. Stir in tomatoes and wine
10. Bring to the boil
11. Return beef to pan
12. Reduce heat to a gentle simmer , cover and cook for 1 1 / 2 - 2 hours , until meat is very tender
13. Meanwhile , place potatoes into a saucepan and cover with cold water
14. Bring to boil over a high heat
15. Reduce heat and simmer for 20-25 mins or until tender
16. Drain
17. Add butter , milk and shallots then mash until smooth
18. Season with salt and pepper
19. Serve with casserole and sprinkle with parsley

title: cook s country slow cooker white chicken chili
steps:
1. Puree 1 can of beans , hominy , broth , and 3 / 4 tsp salt in blender until completely smooth
2. Pour into slow cooker
3. Brown chicken and pat dry with paper towels and season with salt and pepper
4. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until just smoking
5. Cook thighs , skin-side down , until skin is well-browned and fat has rendered , about 5 minutes
6. Remove and discard skin , then add thighs to slow cooker
7. Pour off all about 2 tablespoons fat from skillet
8. Cook onions , chiles , and 1 / 2 tsp salt until golden brown , stirring occasionally , about 8 minutes
9. Add garlic , cumin , and coriander and cook until fragrant , about 30 seconds
10. Transfer half of onion mixture to slow cooker and reserve remaining mixture in refrigerator
11. Add remaining beans to slow cooker
12. Cover and cook on low until chicken is tender , about 4 hours
13. Transfer chicken to bowl
14. When cool enough to handle , discard bones and shred chicken into bite-sized pieces
15. Stir in cilantro , pickled jalapenos , shredded chicken , and reserved onion mixture into slow cooker and let warm
16. Serve

title: frozen banana pops
steps:
1. In a small heavy saucepan , over low heat , melt chocolate chips and honey , stirring constantly
2. Add peanut butter stirring until smooth
3. Remove from heat and stir in milk
4. Peel bananas and insert wooden sticks into one end
5. Spoon chocolate mixture over bananas to coat
6. Sprinkle with nuts and place on a wax paper lined cookie sheet
7. Freeze for no less than 30 minutes and serve frozen

title: cabbage with wine   hvidkl i vinsauce
steps:
1. Shred the cabbage fine
2. Grate onion and apple into the cabbage
3. Cook in butter melted over low heat until vegetables are limp , shaking the pan now and then to prevent scorching
4. Add the remaining ingredients
5. Mix well and let come to a boil
6. Reduce heat as low as possible and let simmer 15 minutes

title: jackson family rice custard
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees
2. Combine rice , milk , eggs , brown sugar and butter in 1 qt casserole or baking dish
3. Place casserole in baking pan
4. Fill pan with enough water to go halfway up side of casserole
5. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes
6. Remove from oven
7. Stir in raisins and vanilla
8. Sprinkle with nutmeg
9. Return to oven
10. Bake for 30 minutes
11. Serve hot or chilled , topped with whipped cream

title: baked bean soup
steps:
1. In a large soup pot on medium-high heat , saute the onion in the olive oil until translucent and starting to caramelize , about 8-10 minutes
2. Add the carrot and chili powder and continue to cook , stirring frequently , about 3 minutes
3. Add garlic and stir for 1-2 minutes more or until carrots are tender
4. Stir in the mustard , water , tomatoes , beans , vinegar , molasses and soy sauce
5. Bring to a boil then lower heat and simmer for about 15 minutes
6. Add salt and pepper to taste

title: chocolate chip oatmeal bars
steps:
1. 1
2. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
3. 2
4. Spritz a 1 liter / 2
5. 2 quart / 11x7 cooking pan with cooking spray
6. 3
7. Combine all ingredients
8. 4
9. Press down hard into the pan
10. 5
11. Bake 20 minutes
12. 6
13. Let cool 10-20 minutes

title: nat s peanut butter and dill pickle sandwich
steps:
1. Cut bun , and spread peanut butter on each half
2. Crunchy or smooth-your choice
3. Add pickle slices
4. Eat away !
5. Don't be shy to try this with different breads
6. Can also be toasted
7. Also perfect for party snadwiches , just roll around the dill

title: koshie  potato casserole
steps:
1. In skillet , saute onion until tender in bacon drippings
2. Grease a loaf pan
3. Mix all ingredients together
4. Pour into loaf pan
5. Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour or until golden brown
6. All the drippings are used in the recipe but can be less if desired

title: michelle s dad s party meatballs
steps:
1. Put meatballs into crockpot and cover with barbecue sauce and jelly
2. Cook on high for 1-2 hours
3. Stir meatballs and top with drained pineapple
4. Cook on low for 4-6 hours longer before serving

title: south americans
steps:
1. Finely chop all peppers , parsely , celery , spinach and mushrooms
2. Brown beef and pork
3. Add ground pepperoni
4. Add everything else to the pot and simmer 20-30 minutes until it is all cooked through
5. Can or freeze

title: big boy s tartar sauce clone   copycat
steps:
1. Combine all , allow flavors to blend several hours
2. Big boy grills their sandwiches to toast the buns
3. I grill them on the george foreman thing

title: crock roasted summer vegetables
steps:
1. Add all the vegetables to the slow cooker
2. Add in the oil and basil
3. Season with salt and pepper to taste
4. Toss to coat evenly
5. Cover and cook on high 1 to 2 hours or until the vegetables are just tender and still hold their shape
6. Serve sprinkled with the parsley and vinegar

title: chocolate joints
steps:
1. Layer 1: combine 1 stick butter , sugar , cocoa , and vanilla extract in a pot and simmer over low heat
2. Stir in one slightly beaten egg
3. Cook 3 more minutes , stirring constantly and remove from heat
4. Stir in graham cracker crumbs
5. Press into lightly greased 8 x 8" square pan and place in refrigerator
6. Layer 2: cream 1 stick butter and powdered sugar
7. Beat in milk and vanilla pudding mix
8. Spread over first layer and refrigerate overnight
9. The next day - layer 3: melt 1 t butter and chocolate chips
10. Spread over layer 2 and chill until solid
11. Cut into squares
12. Keep refrigerated

title: clay hill farm s seafood scampi
steps:
1. If using a whole lobster , cook it in simmering water for 20 minutes
2. Let cool and pick out meat
3. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil for the pasta
4. When boiling , add pasta , stirring occasionally
5. Heat the olive oil in a large saut pan
6. Add the shrimp and scallops to saut pan
7. Stir immediately to coat the seafood with the oil
8. Let cook a minute or two , until the shrimp turn pink
9. Add the white wine and bring to a simmer
10. Let simmer until the liquid is reduced a little
11. Add the lemon juice , chopped parsley , garlic and lobster meat
12. Turn off the heat on the stove and add the butter to the pan
13. Let it slowly melt into the sauce as you swirl the pan
14. Drain the pasta , add to the saut pan and toss
15. Serve immediately !

title: pecan toffee shortbread
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to gas 4 / 180 / 350 degrees
2. Grease and line a 7x11" pan with silicone paper
3. Put the coffee into a bowl and pour the hot water over
4. Leave to infuse for 4 minutes , then strain
5. Cream the butter , peanut butter , sugar and coffee together until light
6. Sift the cornflour and flour together and mix it in to wet mixture to form a smooth dough
7. Press the dough into the pan and prick all over with a fork
8. Bake for 20 minutes
9. For the topping , put the butter , sugar and syrup into a pan and heat until melted
10. Bring to a boil , allow to simmer for 5 minutes , and then add the nuts

title: south of the border  chili croutons
steps:
1. Combine chili powder , oregano , red pepper flakes if using , and salt in a small bowl
2. Set aside
3. Place bread cubes in a large mixing bowl , and drizzle the oil over cubes
4. Stir until cubes are coated with oil
5. Sprinkle cubes with cheese and the amount of seasoning desired
6. Store unused seasoning mixture in a re-sealable container for future use
7. Spread seasoned croutons in a single layer on a 15 x 11-inch baking sheet
8. Bake in oven for 12-15 minutes until cubes are dried , stirring occasionally
9. Cool on baking sheet
10. Store in plastic , re-sealable bag

title: body nourishing comfort soup
steps:
1. Chop all the vegetables , add a drop of olive oil to the pot and add in the diced onion , add the mushrooms in next
2. Let these sautee for a few moments
3. Then add in all the vegetables , use enough hot water so that its covering the vegetables
4. Then add canned tomoatoes , simmer all vegetable until soft
5. Dissolve the vegetable stock cube in a little boiling water in a glass jug and add to the pot
6. When the veggies are soft , allow to cool
7. Depending on how you like your soup , you can blend the entire pot of veg once cooled or you can take about 1 / 3 of the vegetable away blend 2 / 3 then add back the more solid 1 / 3
8. All depending on your taste
9. Add a little salt and pepper if required
10. Serve with bread
11. Enjoy !

title: easy no bake white chocolate cheesecake
steps:
1. Melt chocolate chips and stir until smooth
2. Remove from heat and stir in cream cheese until smooth
3. Fold in the cool whip until well blended
4. Pour into pie crust
5. Cover and refrigerate until set or overnight
6. Serve with your choice of berries on top , preferably with some berry juice , as on shortcake

title: ranch potato casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Boil potatoes in water , drain , and cool in a bowl of cold water
3. Leaving skins on , cut into small chunks
4. Mix remaining ingredients in a bowl except for 1 / 2 of the cheese
5. Mix in potatoes
6. Transfer to a greased oven bowl or dish and top with remaining cheese
7. Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes

title: s mores bars by anna olson
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 f and grease a 9-inch square pan
2. Line pan with parchment paper so that paper hangs over two sides of the pan
3. Line bottom of pan with a single layer of whole graham crackers
4. In a saucepot , melt butter and stir in brown sugar , milk and vanilla until dissolved
5. Remove from heat and stir in graham cracker crumbs
6. Spread half of the graham mixture over the cracker-lined pan
7. Sprinkle with a third of the chocolate chunks and half of the marshmallows
8. Top marshmallows with another layer of whole graham crackers and spread remaining graham mixture over top
9. Top with another third of chocolate chunks and the remaining marshmallows
10. Finish with a last sprinkle of chocolate chunks and bake for 12 minutes , until marshmallows have browned
11. Cool completely before slicing
12. Smores bars can be stored in an airtight container for 3 days

title: green dragon
steps: 1. Pour into a shot glass in order of recipe

title: raw hot chocolate   ultra healthy believe it or not
steps:
1. Grind cacao beans , sugar and flavourings in a blender till they are as fine as you can get them
2. Heat milk until just about to boil and then add to blender
3. Blitz all the ingredients in the blender until it has a nice foamy head
4. Pour into large mug , add flavourings to taste and serve

title: mom s elegant salad
steps:
1. In large bowl , toss all ingredients
2. Add enough miracle whip to lightly coat all
3. Stir all well , chill at least one hour or overnight
4. Best overnight , though

title: savory beans and rice   crock pot
steps:
1. Combine beans , onion , celery , garlic , bouillon , basil , and bay leaf in crock pot
2. Pour water over all
3. Cover and cook on low for 9 to 10 hours or on high setting for 4 to 5 hours
4. Cook brown rice according to package directions
5. Keep warm
6. Remove bay leaf from bean mixture
7. Discard
8. Stir undrained stewed tomatoes , chili peppers , and hot pepper sauce into cooked beans
9. Cook 30 minutes more
10. Serve bean mixture over hot cooked rice

title: mary s cherry cake
steps:
1. Cream together the sugar and shortening
2. Mix in the egg yolks one at a time
3. Add cherries
4. Add dry ingredients and spices
5. Dissolve baking soda in cherry juice
6. Add cherry juice and buttermilk
7. Pour into 2 greased and floured 8in cake pans
8. Bake at 350 degrees bake 30-35 minute let cool , place on cake platter and frost between the layers with either 7 min frosting or cream cheese frosting and on the sides

title: thai iced coffee   12 hour brew technique
steps:
1. Stir together ground coffee and cold water in a pitcher until well combined
2. Let stand at room temperature for 12 hours
3. Pour coffee mixture through a large , fine wire mesh strainer into a dutch oven or other large container , discarding grounds
4. Clean strainer
5. Place a coffee filter or double layer of cheesecloth in strainer
6. Pour coffee mixture through lined strainer into a pitcher
7. Add vanilla extract
8. Cover and store in refrigerator up to 1 week , if desired
9. Stir together coffee mixture and sweetened condensed milk
10. Serve over ice

title: roasted banana bread
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 325 degrees
2. Place the bananas on a cookie sheet
3. Bake in the oven for 12 minutes , or until the skins are black and they have started to seep
4. Remove from the oven , set aside , and let cool
5. Combine the flour , baking powder , baking soda , and salt into a mixing bowl
6. Set aside
7. Cream the butter and sugar together
8. Add eggs one at a time , stirring after each
9. Squeeze the flesh of the bananas out of the skins and into a small mixing bowl
10. Add the coconut milk and vanilla and mash together
11. Add half of the banana mixture to the butter mixture and blend thoroughly
12. Add half of the flour mixture and mix until combined
13. Add the remaining banana mixture , blend thoroughly , and add the remaining flour mixture
14. Mix just enough to thoroughly blend the ingredients
15. Pour into a lightly greased 9 by 5-inch loaf pan
16. Bake in the oven for 1 to 1 1 / 4 hours , or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean
17. Cool on a rack , slice , and serve warm

title: chocolate chip cannoli pie
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Brush pie shell very lightly with water
3. Generously sprinkle with cinnamon sugar
4. Stir ricotta cheese , sweetened condensed milk , confectioners' sugar and vanilla in medium bowl until blended
5. Stir in chocolate chips
6. Pour into pie crust
7. Bake 45-50 minutes or until crust is golden brown
8. Filling will appear slightly soft
9. Cool completely on wire rack
10. Chill at least 2 hours before serving
11. Garnish with whipped topping , if desired

title: cinnamon saffron coffee
steps:
1. Add the coffee , cinnamon and saffron to your coffee pot or ibrik
2. Stir the three together so that it will all brew together
3. Add the water and start coffee pot or boil and rest the usual 3 times for the ibrik
4. When done pour into your cup , sweeten as or if desired
5. Sit back and enjoy what may be the best cup of coffee ever

title: pesto and mozzarella potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f
2. Boil the potatoes for 10 minutes , drain , splash with cold water and drain again
3. Remove the skins and slice thinly
4. Grease a two-litre casserole dish with a little of the olive oil and spread out one third of the potatoes on the bottom
5. Smear half the pesto over the potatoes , along with half of the mozzarella , capers and anchovies
6. Season with salt and pepper , add another layer of potatoes , followed by the rest of the seasonings
7. Top with the final slices of potato
8. Sprinkle over 3 tablespoons of water and then drizzle over the remaining olive oil
9. Bake for 30 minutes or until the potatoes are cooked through and crusty on top

title: strawberry and cream scones
steps:
1. Preheat your oven to 375f lightly grease two baking sheets , or a full-size or mini-scone pan
2. To make the scones: in a blender or food processor , process 1 / 2 cup of the strawberries with the half and half or cream until the mixture is smooth
3. Set it aside
4. In a large bowl , whisk together the flour , salt , sugar , and baking powder
5. Cut in the butter , using your finger
6. In a separate bowl , whisk together the strawberry / half and half mixture , the egg , and the vanilla extract
7. Stir this mixture into the dry ingredients
8. Add the 2 / 3 cup diced strawberries and stir just until everything is well-combined
9. This is a wet , sticky dough , good for drop scones
10. Drop the dough by heaping tablespoonfuls onto the prepared baking sheets
11. Each scone should be about the size of a golf ball
12. A tablespoon cookie scoop is exactly the right size for this task
13. Or divide the dough among the compartments of the scone pan of your choice
14. Bake the scones until they're golden brown , 15 to 16 minutes , or 18 to 20 minutes
15. Remove the scones from the oven when they're beginning to brown around the edges
16. Break one open , just to be sure
17. They should be moist , but not gummy , at the center
18. To make the topping: as soon as you remove the scones from the oven , make the topping
19. Combine the sugar and water in a very small microwave-safe bowl , stirring until the sugar is moistened
20. Heat in the microwave for 20 to 30 seconds , until the mixture is bubbly
21. Carefully remove from the microwave , and stir in the vanilla
22. Stir until the mixture smoothes out
23. Drizzle or brush the topping over the hot scones
24. Yield: 8 to 18 scones , depending on your choice of pan

title: ambassade d auvergne s seven hour leg of lamb
steps:
1. Layer onions , carrots , garlic , bay leaves and thyme on bottom of nonreactive covered roaster large enough to hold lamb
2. Place lamb on top of onion and carrot mixture
3. Roast , uncovered , at 425 degrees for 30 minutes
4. Remove roaster from oven
5. Generously season lamb to taste with salt and
6. Pepper
7. Return to oven and roast another 30 minutes
8. Remove roaster from oven , leaving oven on
9. Place roaster on top of stove , slowly pour wine over lamb , cover , and bring liquid to a boil
10. Return roaster , covered , to oven
11. Roast 4 to 5 additional hours until lamb is fork tender , but not falling off bone
12. Check on lamb , reducing oven temps if lamb begins to burn or liquid begins to evaporate too much
13. When lamb is fork tender , bury potatoes and tomatoes in liquid
14. Cover and roast until potatoes are cooked through , about 1 hour more
15. Lamb should now be very tender , still juicy and falling off bones

title: grandma s banana pudding
steps:
1. Combine flour , sugar and salt in a heavy sauce pan
2. Beat egg yolks
3. Combine egg yolks and milk , mixing well
4. Stir into dry ingredients
5. Cook over med heat , stirring constantly until smooth and thickened
6. Remove from heat
7. Stir in 1 tsp vanilla
8. Layer one-third of wafers in 3 qt baking dish
9. Slice bananas and layer over wafers
10. Pour 1 / 3 of cusard over bananas
11. Repeat layers twice
12. Beat egg whites until foamy
13. Gradually add 1 / 4 c plus 2 tbsp of sugar , 1 tbsp at a time , beating until stiff peaks form
14. Add 1 tsp vanilla and beat until blended
15. Spread meringue over custard , sealing edges of dish
16. Bake at 425 for 10-12 min or until golden brown

title: another peanut butter cookie   sugar free
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together , then roll into balls and press w / fork
2. Bake at 350 for 10 minutes

title: stuffed poached pears with raspberry sauce
steps:
1. Combine ricotta , blue cheese , pecans and lemon juice , fill center of pears with mixture and sprinkle with nutmeg
2. Heat wine to a boil in a medium skillet , add pears stuffing side up , cover and reduce heat to medium low , simmer 10 minutes or until tender
3. Sauce: mash raspberries and strain juice into a measuring cup adding enough water to measure 3 / 4 cups
4. Whisk cornstarch into juice in a small sauce pan , heat and stir 5 minutes or until juice thickens and begins to bubble
5. To serve , place 3 tbls sauce on a plate and top with a pear half

title: sage spinach pesto
steps:
1. Drop pine nuts and garlic through food chute with food processor on , and process until minced
2. Add next 6 ingredients
3. Process until finely minced
4. With processor on , slowly pour oil through food chute , and process until well blended
5. Spoon into zip-top heavy-duty plastic bag
6. Store in refrigerator
7. For longer storage , put one or two servings each in smaller zip-bags and place smaller bags in a heavy freezer size bag
8. Freeze
9. Take out number of servings needed and thaw

title: chili potato dippers with cheddar jalapeno dip
steps:
1. Heat oven to 450f
2. Line 15x10x1-inch baking pan with foil
3. Spray foil with nonstick cooking spray
4. Cut potatoes into thin wedges
5. In large bowl , combine potatoes , oil , chili powder and garlic powder
6. Toss to coat
7. Place on sprayed foil-lined pan
8. Bake at 450f for 20 to 30 minutes or until tender and golden brown , turning once
9. Meanwhile , in medium bowl , combine all dip ingredients except onions
10. Mix well
11. Sprinkle with onions
12. Ingredient substitution:
13. Purchase prepared salsa for a simple dip for these roasted potatoes or offer a choice of both salsa and cheddar jalapeno dip
14. Make it special:
15. For a colorful presentation , garnish the dip with extra tomatoes and chiles in addition to the green onions
16. Recipe variation:
17. Try baked potatoes topped with cheddar jalapeno dip for a spicy change from the usual sour cream garnish
18. Or serve the potatoes as a tasty side dish without the dip

title: shrimp cocktail with sauce
steps:
1. Make the shrimp cocktail sauce by combining all ingredients up to the shrimp
2. Can be prepared in advance
3. Spoon the cocktail sauce into martini glasses
4. Arrange shrimp around the rim , draping tails over the side for presentation
5. Make a slit in the lemonn slices from peel to centre and place on rim of glasses
6. Add parsley sprigs for garnish

title: stevia black bean brownies
steps:
1. Make sure beans are drained and rinsed , set aside
2. Slice the 2 bananas and set aside
3. Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit
4. If using large flake or quick oats , grind in blender or food processor , then remove and set aside
5. Combine all ingredients , except oats , in blender or food processor and mix
6. Scape the sides as needed
7. Add oats and continue blending
8. Adjust consistency with more oats as needed
9. You can also add more flavoring or stevia if you wish
10. Grease a 8 x 8 inch pan
11. Pour mixture into pan and spread evenly until it is level
12. Bake for approximate 30 minutes or until toothpick comes out cleanly when inserted
13. Allow to cool for a few minutes and then cut into 12 equal squares

title: basil   zucc soup
steps:
1. Heat the butter and oil in a medium saucepan , add the onion and garlic , sir over a medium heat for about 2 minutes or until the onion is soft
2. Stir in all the other ingredients-except the basil- bring to the boil , reduce to a simmer and cook uncovered for about 20 minutes or until the zucchini is tender
3. Stir in the basil
4. Blend or process the mixture until smooth
5. Return to the pan and reheat
6. Serve topped with sour cream , paprika , and extra basil leaves if you wish

title: peachy keen cobbler
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Place peaches in bowl , add 1 cup sugar
3. Stir and set aside for 30 minutes
4. Meanwhile , sift all dry ingredients together in another bowl
5. In separate bowl , add vanilla to milk
6. Stir dry ingredients into milk mixture
7. Melt butter and add to milk / flour mixture
8. Place peach / sugar mixture in 11"x 8" baking dish
9. Pour batter over top
10. Bake at 350f
11. 30 minutes
12. Then turn up to 400f
13. And bake another 15 minutes
14. Enjoy !

title: spinach triangles
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 200c
2. Mix all the ingredients together in a bowl
3. If the mixture is a little bit too runny just add a little more cheese
4. Cut each sheet of puff pastry into 4 squares
5. Place a heaped tbsp full of the mixture in the centre of each of the squares of pastry and fold diagonally to form a triangle
6. Pinch close along one edge then adjust amount of mixture before sealing other edge
7. Don't over fill them or they may leak
8. Brush with milk , water or egg wash
9. Bake in oven for 15-20 minutes or until brown

title: baked chicken that makes its own gravy
steps:
1. Set oven to 425 degrees f
2. Grease a 13 x 9-inch baking pan
3. Coat the chicken lightly and evenly in the flour
4. Melt the butter , and spread evenly in the bottom of the baking dish
5. Arrange the chicken in a single layer with skins down in prepared baking dish in the melted butter
6. Bake uncovered for 30 minutes
7. Remove the chicken from the oven
8. Reduce the temperature to 325 degrees
9. Pour off any excess fat
10. Add in the onions and mushrooms to the chicken in the baking dish
11. In a bowl , combine the soup , evaporated milk , cheese , parmesan cheese salt and pepper , cayenne , and garlic powder or fresh garlic
12. Pour the mixture over the chicken
13. Sprinkle with paprika
14. Continue to bake for 15-20 minutes longer

title: chicken joes
steps:
1. Poach chicken in just enough water to cover in large pot
2. Remove meat and dice into 1 / 2" cubes
3. Add vegetables to liquid and simmer until only two cups broth remain
4. Add remaining ingredients and stir to heat
5. Turn into hot crockpot for serving

title: eggplant and cauliflower curry  ww
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees f
2. Spray cookie sheet with pam
3. Place eggplant and cauliflower on baking sheet and spray with pam and toss
4. Roast , stirring once for 20-30 minutes or until vegetables are browned and tender
5. Heat simmer sauce and chickpeas in large saucepan over medium heat
6. Stir in vegetables and simmer , covered , d stirring occasionally , for 10 mintues
7. Remove from heat and stir in cilantro

title: brandy alfredo sauce
steps:
1. Melt butter in sauce pan
2. Stir in the flour and let cook for 1-2 minutes over medium-low heat
3. Chop garlic and add to roux
4. Whisk in the cream
5. Pin the bay leave to the onion using the clove
6. Place it in the cream and let steep for about 20 minutes
7. Bring to a simmer then immidiatly remove from heat
8. Stir in cheese , the juice of the lemon and the brandy
9. Add salt and pepper to taste , be generous

title: microwave sponge pudding
steps:
1. Grease 1
2. 5 litre heatproof bowl with a small amount of butter
3. Spoon the syrup into the basin
4. Cream the remaining butter with the sugar until light and fluffy
5. Gradually add the eggs , beating well between each addition
6. Sift the flour and baking powder together , then fold into the creamed mixture using a large metal spoon
7. Add enough warm water to give a soft , dropping consistency
8. Spoon into the bowl and level
9. Cover with microwave-safe plastic wrap , leaving a small gap to allow air to escape
10. Microwave on high power for 4 minutes , then remove and let stand for 5 minutes , while it continues to cook
11. Turn the sponge out on to a warm serving plate
12. Serve with custard

title: raisin sour cream pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Beat yolks till light
3. Add sugar , spices and sour cream
4. Dust raisins lightly with flour and add to egg mixture
5. Pour into pie shell and bake until set (approx
6. 45 minutes)
7. Make a meringue using the 3 egg whites and add a dash of cinnamon to it
8. Cover pie and brown
9. Enjoy

title: fancy tasting  green  beans
steps:
1. Open and drain green beans
2. Place green beans in a pot and add water
3. Cook on medium heat
4. Add green pepper , onion , bacon bits , soy sauce and accent
5. Turn heat down to low , cover and simmer for 15 minutes

title: pistachio pudding cake
steps:
1. Mix all the cake ingredients together and pour into two 9 cake pans or one bunt pan
2. Place in oven for 35 -45 minutes at 350 degrees or until a toothpick poked into the center of the cake comes out cleanly
3. Let the cake cool completely before frosting
4. Pistachio icing
5. Place your bowl and beaters from your electric mixer in the fridge for 10-15 minutes
6. Once the bowl and beaters are chilled start to mix the heavy cream and one box of instant pistachio pudding slowly at first then gradully increase to the maximum speed of your mixer till you have soft peaks
7. Don't beat it for too long or you'll have pistachio butter -- lol

title: bacon cocktail weenies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Spray 9x13 inch cake pan with non stick spray
3. Open package of bacon and cut entire slab into thirds
4. Wrap a third of a slice of bacon around each cocktail weenie and secure with toothpicks
5. Place each bacon wrapped weenie in cake pan , making sure to crowd them together
6. Liberally cover weenies with brown sugar , leaving only the toothpicks exposed
7. Place weenies in hot oven
8. Every 10 minutes or so , baste weenies with sugar / bacon grease mixture and break up any lumps of sugar
9. Continue until sugar is completely melted and bacon is thoroughly cooked
10. When serving , be sure to drizzle sugar / bacon grease over weenies and on the platter
11. Some people like to swirl their weenies in the syrup before cramming them in their mouths
12. I've never really timed this recipe , but i'm going to guesstimate the time at@30-40 minutes
13. Servings also depend on the crowd you are feeding
14. My crew will argue that 15-20 weenies qualify as a serving !

title: toasted hazelnuts
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Spread the nuts out on a metal baking pan or a large sheet pan with ridges
3. Bake for 10-12 minutes or until they are very hot and fragrant
4. Carefully dump nuts into a dish towel which youve spread across the counter - a ridged dish towel or one with some sort of embroidery works well because it provides more friction
5. Bring the ends of the dish towel up around the still-hot hazelnuts and wrap them up like a present
6. Using your hands , rub them between the towel and the work surface so that the friction created by the rubbing loosens the skin
7. Discard the skins and enjoy the toasted hazelnuts whole or crush them for your favorite recipe

title: middle eastern macaroni  n garbanzos
steps:
1. In large saucepot , cook pasta according to package directions
2. Meanwhile , in nonstick skillet , heat olive oil and margarine or butter over medium heat until hot and melted
3. Add onion and green pepper and cook 15 min
4. Or until tender , stirring occasionally
5. Stir in garlic , salt , cumin , coriander , allspice , and black pepper and cook 1 min
6. Add tomatoes and garbanzo beans
7. Heat to boiling over medium-high heat
8. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer 5 minutes , stirring occasionally
9. Drain pasta
10. Return to saucepot
11. Toss garbanzo mixture with pasta and heat through
12. Mix in parsley
13. Garnish with additional parsley to serve , if desired

title: chocolate raspberry  or strawberry  tall cake
steps:
1. Prepare the cake according to package directions , using three greased and floured 9 in round cake pans
2. Bake at 350 degrees for 25- 30 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
3. Cool for 10 minutes
4. Remove from pans to wire racks to cool completely
5. In a mixing bowl , beat cream cheese until fluffy
6. Combine milk and pudding mix
7. Add to cream cheese and mix well
8. Fold in whipped topping and raspberries
9. Reserve a large dollop of filling for garnish
10. Place one cake layer on a serving plate
11. Spread with half of the filling
12. Do not cover sides of cake , just the top as this is made to look like a torte , not a frosted cake
13. Repeat layers
14. Top with remaining cake
15. Dust with confectioner's sugar
16. Mound the reserved filling in the center and arrange raspberries in the middle
17. Garnish with fresh mint on top if desired
18. Store in refrigerator
19. This is because the strawberries will"bleed" into the filling and become mushy
20. It will still taste great , it will just look a bit unattractive

title: mango pudding    lactose free  thailand
steps:
1. Scoop out the flesh of the mangoes & puree it in a food processor or blender until smooth
2. Set it aside in the processor / blender
3. In a saucepan , heat water until is reaches a rolling boil , then remove it from the heat
4. While stirring the water with a whisk or fork , sprinkle the gelatin over the surface of the water & stir briskly to remove any lumps
5. Add the sugar to the gelatin mixture & stir to dissolve
6. Add this mixture to the mango in the processor / blender , then add the coconut milk & process briefly until ingredients are combined
7. Pour this finished mixture into 4 dessert bowls & put in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours but not more than 24 hours
8. Serve cold on its own , or with fresh fruit & enjoy !

title: kickin  chicken bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. In a bowl , combine all ingredients , except the crescent rolls and egg wash
3. If making into a wreath: divide crescent rolls into 8 equal triangles
4. Arrange triangles on lightly greased round baking sheet in a circle with the skinny pointed ends facing out
5. Spoon chicken mixture around the ring , mainly on the wider parts of the dough , leaving the points exposed
6. Fold the pointed ends over the chicken mixture , pressing the points down to seal
7. Brush with egg wash then proceed with the baking instructions
8. If making as casserole:
9. Sprread filling into a lightly greased casserole dish , cover with foil
10. To bake either type: bake for 25 minutes until golden brown , removing foil from casserole in the last 5 minutes

title: barley with peppers and potatoes
steps:
1. Saute chilies and onions in olive oil in a large skillet until crispy tender , about 5 minutes
2. Add potatoes , saute until browned about 5 to 8 minutes
3. Add barley to skillet
4. Cook over medium heat until hot through , about 4 to 5 minutes
5. Stir in cilantro and cumin
6. Season to taste with salt and cayenne pepper

title: kumquat mojito
steps:
1. Reserve 4 kumquat slices for garnish
2. Place remaining fruit slices in a large cocktail shaker
3. Add the sugar , 4 of the mint leaves and lime juice
4. Crush the kumquats and mint into the sugar with a bar mallet or large spoon until sugar dissolves
5. Pour in the rum
6. Shake well
7. Fill two tall glasses with crushed ice
8. Strain mojito over ice
9. Fill the glasses with club soda
10. Stir lightly
11. Garnish with remaining mint leaves , kumquat slices and sugar cane

title: buttermilk herb dressing  1 gram of fat
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together well
2. Cover and chill

title: healthy vegan oat and pb pancakes
steps:
1. Put oats in blender and blend until a flour is formed
2. Pour into a big bowl and combine with baking powder and stevia
3. In a seperate bowl , mash the banana and mix with the soy milk and peanut butter
4. Combine wet and dry ingredients
5. Mix well and let the batter set 5 minutes
6. Prepare as you would any vegan pancake ! grease a skillet and pour the batter out , cooking on both sides for about 2 minutes or so
7. Serve with maple syrup or even more peanut butter , if you like
8. I like to chop up a banana and serve over it

title: brownies with a surprise
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees
2. Spray a 9x13-inch pan with nonstick vegetable spray
3. Place the beans in a colander and rinse thoroughly under running water to remove 'slime' and set aside and drain
4. Place the chocolate and light butter in a small microwavable bowl
5. Microwave for 60 to 90 seconds , stirring every 30 seconds until smooth
6. In a food processor blender , add the drained beans and 2 egg whites
7. Blend or process until smooth
8. In a large bowl , combine the beans , sugar , flour , espresso powder and remaining egg whites
9. With an electric mixer , beat until well combined
10. Mix in the melted chocolate
11. Pour the brownie mixture into a prepared pan
12. Sprinkle the walnuts on top of the brownie batter
13. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes until the brownie pulls away from the sides of the pan
14. Cool completely in the pan before cutting into bars-- rows of six by five

5. Add the dry ingredients to the potato mixture
6. Stir with spatula just until incorporated
7. Pour enough peanut oil to come 1 / 8 inch up the sides of a large cast-iron or other heavy skillet and heat over medium heat until the oil is very hot but not bubbling
8. While the oil is heating , line a baking sheet with a brown paper bag or a triple thickness of paper towels
9. For each pancake , drop a rounded tablespoon of batter into the oil and press the cake down with the back of the spoon to create a thin pancake that is about 2 inches across
10. Be careful not to crowd the panleave about 2 inches of space between the pancakes
11. Cook pancakes until they are deep brown and crispy on the undersides , then turn with a wide spatula and a fork and brown the other sides
12. Lift the pancakes out of the oil , letting the excess oil drip back into the pan , and place on the brown paper to drain
13. Pat the tops of the pancakes free of excess oil with paper toweling and serve immediately , or keep , uncovered , in a 200 oven while you make the rest of the batch

title: lemon and mustard seed chutney
steps:
1. Place chopped lemons in bowl and sprinkle with salt
2. Cover the bowl with a clean cloth or kitchen paper towel and set aside for about 10 hours
3. In a large saucepan , combine salted lemons with onions , vinegar , spices , mustard seed , sugar and raisins
4. Place pan over high heat and bring to a boil
5. Reduce heat to low , cover and simmer for 50 minutes
6. , or until lemons are soft
7. Remove pan from heat
8. Ladle chutney into clean , warm jam jars
9. Seal and label , store in cool dark place until ready to use

title: easy chicken tortilla soup    crock pot
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients into crockpot and cook on low for 8-10 hours
2. Right before serving , top with crushed tortilla chips
3. Other toppings can include things like sour cream , shredded cheese , etc

title: chilled spiced yellow squash soup
steps:
1. Combine the squash , olive oil , red pepper , cumin , coriander , turmeric and 1 1 / 2 c water in a pot with a large pinch of salt
2. Bring to a boil , then simmer , covered , until the squash is very tender
3. Once the squash has cooled , puree it in a blender on high for 30 seconds
4. Pass through a fine-mesh seive
5. When completely cool , season to taste with lime juic , salt and pepper
6. Ladle into bowls , and garnish with mint and a few drops of olive oil

title: vegan oatmeal cookies
steps:
1. Blend first 4 ingredients
2. Add dry ingredients
3. Drop onto greased cookie sheet and bake at 350 degrees for 20-30 minutes

title: bbq stuffed jalapenos
steps:
1. Mix cream cheese , cajun spice , and garlic powder together make sure they are well mixed
2. Remove stems from jalapenos and cut lengthwise remove all the seeds and as much of the white veins as possible to allow room for filling
3. Fill each jalapeno half with some cream cheese mixture
4. Wrap a half slice of bacon around the half and secure with a toothpick
5. When coals are ready place jalapenos on the grill filling side up and cook for 10 minutes or until bacon is done
6. These little guys can get real hot if you want them to or they can be as mild as i make them
7. Just be sure to mix the cream cheese mix well or you will get a few hot and the rest mild

title: low fat creamy italian dressing
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a blender or food processor
2. Mix until smooth
3. Chill and serve

title: root soup w blue cheese
steps:
1. In large pot melt butter over medium heat
2. Fry leeks and onion , stirring often , until translucent , about 12 minutes
3. Add rutabaga , carrot , potato , salt , pepper and nutmeg
4. Cook for 5 minutes
5. Stir in stock and water
6. Bring to boil
7. Reduce heat , cover and simmer until vegetables are tender , about 30 minutes
8. In batches , puree soup in blender until smooth , or use hand blender directly in the pot
9. Return to pot
10. Stir in cream / milk and vinegar
11. Bring just to boil over medium heat
12. Ladle into bowls
13. Garnish with cheese and chives

title: thai turkey salad
steps:
1. Brown ground turkey in a nonstick pan
2. Add water , fish sauce and brown sugar and cook , stirring until liquid has almost evaporated
3. Toss with cucumber , cilantro , lime juice and peanuts
4. Serve with lettuce leaves for wrapping

title: grill mates blackened steak
steps:
1. Place large cast iron skillet or other large heavy skillet on high heat at least 5 minutes or until very hot
2. Mix rub , paprika , thyme and red pepper in small bowl
3. Brush each side of steaks with butter or oil
4. Generously season with rub mixture
5. Carefully place steaks in hot skillet
6. Cook 8 to 10 minutes or until desired doneness , turning once
7. Test kitchen
8. Preheat large cast iron or other large heavy skillet on stovetop or in oven and carefully transfer to a hot grill to cook the steaks
9. To use nonstick skillet: prepare steaks as directed above
10. Heat large nonstick skillet on medium heat 5 minutes
11. Cook as directed above
12. Increase cook time as needed for desired doneness
13. To grill: steaks can also be cooked directly on a preheated grill
14. Flavor and appearance will vary from the traditional skillet method
15. Black and blue steak: cut a 4-inch wide pocket in each 2 new york strip steaks being careful not to cut through back or sides of steak
16. Continue as directed in steps 2 and 3
17. Fill pocket of each steak with about 2 tablespoons blue cheese
18. Press steak lightly to seal closed
19. Cook as directed

title: spiced lemonade
steps:
1. Mix spices , cranberry juice , and water in saucepan
2. Bring to a rolling boil
3. Cover , remove from heat , and let stand about 3 minutes
4. Strain and discard spices
5. Add sugar and stir until dissolved
6. Add lemonade
7. Mix well
8. Reheat , and serve hot
9. Garnish each serving with half an orange slice and a sprig of mint or a green cherry

title: french chicken and beef soup
steps:
1. Cut most of the meat off the beef bones
2. Put the bones in a large pan , put the meat on top
3. Boil the water , and pour it on the meat
4. Put in stock cubes , seasoning , onion and parsley
5. Bring to boil
6. Simmer for two hours , remove the foam when needed
7. Cut the chicken in 8-10 pieces , and put them into the pan
8. Let simmer for about an hour
9. Cut the parsnips and the celery root to small pieces , and put them in the pan
10. Simmer for 10 minutes , then put in the leeks
11. Simmer another for 10 minutes
12. Take beef and chicken bones out together with the meat
13. Cut the meat into small pieces and return to pan
14. Serve with bread

title: sbiten  spiced honey drink
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients with 1 quart water in a saucepan with a lid over medium heat
2. Bring almost to a boil
3. Cover and turn off heat
4. Steep for 15 to 20 minutes
5. Strain , then reheat and serve , or refrigerate , covered , and serve cold

title: broiled flank steak
steps:
1. Combine tomatoes , broth , wine , onion , garlic , worcestershire , thyme , and bay leaf in a large resealable plastic bag
2. Poke a few holes into the meat and place into the marinade bag , seal , toss to coat , and let marinade in the fridge overnight
3. When you are ready to start cooking , set the meat bag on your counter and let sit at room temperature 15 minutes , then begin preparing your pan etc
4. Prepare your broiler pan by lining bottom pan with foil and brushing the top with some oil
5. Set meat on prepared pan and leave on the counter while you preheat the broiler to the broil setting - this will take about 10-15 minutes
6. For the sauce: pour the marinade into a small saucepan and bring to a light boil over medium-high heat , and let the liquid reduce until it measures 1 cup
7. Once marinade has reduced , pour it through a strainer set over a bowl -then pour the liquid back into the pan and set aside , off of the heat , until the meat is ready
8. For the meat: once you have started reducing the marinade for a few minutes , begin the meat
9. Set the meat pan under the broiler and cook 6-7 inches from the heat , 5-7 minutes , turn over and cook another 5 minutes for rare , or another 5 minutes for medium , even longer for well
10. When meat has cooked to your liking , remove to a carving board and cover with foil , let sit while you finish the sauce
11. Once meat is under the foil , heat the marinade again , but don't let it boil
12. Stir in butter until it melts and season to taste with salt and pepper
13. Slice the meat against the grain and drizzle with some of the sauce

title: vegetable wellington
steps:
1. 1
2. Heat the oven to 400 degrees and line a large baking sheet with parchment
3. 2
4. In a very large skillet over high heat , melt 2 tablespoons butter
5. Add the squash in a single layer and cook , undisturbed , for 4 minutes
6. Stir and continue to cook until squash is golden , 7 to 10 minutes more
7. Stir in the syrup , thyme , paprika and teaspoon salt
8. Cook one minute
9. Scrape mixture into a bowl
10. 3
11. Turn the heat down to medium and melt the remaining butter in the skillet
12. Stir in garlic and shallot
13. Cook 1 to 2 minutes
14. Add the mushrooms and remaining salt
15. Cook until mushrooms are soft and their juices evaporate , about 10 minutes
16. Stir in the wine and cook until the mixture is dry , about 5 minutes
17. Stir in the pepper and parsley
18. Taste and add more salt if needed
19. 4
20. On a lightly floured surface , unwrap the puff pastry
21. Cut into 2 5-by-15-inch rectangles
22. Spread mushrooms on each pastry rectangle leaving -inch border
23. Spoon the cheese crumbles over the mushrooms
24. Then spoon the squash over the cheese , leaving a 1 -inch border
25. 5
26. Brush the exposed borders of dough on each rectangle with the egg wash
27. Fold the long sides up to meet in the middle and pinch together to seal
28. Pinch the ends , too
29. Transfer the pastries to the baking sheet and turn them over so that the seam is face down
30. Brush the tops with more egg wash
31. Bake until they are puffed golden and firm to the touch , about 30 minutes
32. Let cool for 10 minutes , slice and serve

title: cheesy broccoli pockets
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 drgrees
2. Grease 2 baking sheets
3. Cook broccoli according to package directions
4. Drain well
5. In a medium skillet , heat oil over low heat
6. Add garlic
7. Saute for 2 minutes
8. Add broccoli
9. Cook stirring until moisture has evaporated , about 3 minutes
10. Remove from heat
11. Cool slightly
12. In a medium bowl , combine broccoli mixture , mozzarella , parmesan , roasted peppers , oregano , salt ans pepper
13. Mix well
14. On a lightly floured surface , divide dough into 8 pieces
15. Roll out each piece to form a 6-inch circle
16. Spoon an equal amount of broccoli mixture in the center of each circle
17. Fold dough over filling to form a half circlr
18. Press edges with a fork to seal
19. Prick a few holes in pocket
20. Place pockets on prepared baking sheets
21. Bake until golden , about 25 minutes
22. Serve immediately

title: moroccan rubbed grilled steak and sweet potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat grill to high
2. Combine allspice , cumin , ginger , salt , cinnamon , coriander and cayenne in a small bowl
3. Sprinkle steaks with 4 1 / 2 teaspoons of the spice mixture
4. Toss sweet potatoes and onion with canola oil , orange zest and the remaining spice mixture
5. To make a packet , lay 2 24-inch sheets of foil on top of each other
6. Generously coat the top piece with cooking spray
7. Spread half of the sweet potato mixture in the center of the foil in a thin layer
8. Bring the short ends of foil together , fold over and pinch to seal
9. Pinch the seams together along the sides to seal the packet
10. Repeat with two more sheets of foil and the remaining sweet potato mixture
11. Place the packets on the hottest part of the grill and cook , switching the packets' positions on the grill halfway through cooking , 5 minutes per side
12. Place the steaks in the front or back and cook , turning once , about 3 to 4 minutes per side for medium-rare
13. Transfer the steaks to plates and let rest while the packets finish cooking
14. Open the packets and serve alongside the steaks
15. Make it a meal: sauted greens , such as arugula , kale or spinach , and a glass of zinfandel round out the meal

title: butternut squash and noodles with coconut  lime and cilantro sau
steps:
1. Heat oil in large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
2. Add onions
3. Saut until golden , about 5 minutes
4. Add squash
5. Saut 4 minutes
6. Add broth , jalapeo and garlic
7. Bring to boil
8. Cover
9. Cook until squash is almost tender , about 5 minutes
10. Stir in coconut milk , lime juice and curry paste
11. Simmer uncovered until squash is tender and liquid is slightly reduced , about 4 minutes
12. Season to taste with salt
13. Meanwhile , cook noodles in large pot of boiling salted water until just tender but still firm to bite
14. Drain noodles
15. Return to pot
16. Add squash mixture and cilantro to noodles
17. Toss to blend
18. Serve

title: avocado fries with chipotle ketchup
steps:
1. For ketchup , heat olive oil in saucepan and saute onion and garlic for 6 minutes
2. Add chipotle pepper and tomatoes , cooking over low for 5 minutes
3. Add spices , vinegar and brown sugar , simmer for 8 minutes
4. Puree in food processor , add salt to taste
5. Heat oil to 350 degrees in deep fryer
6. Cut avocado in half , remove seed , quarter each half , gently peel skin away
7. Combine flour , cumin , coriander , salt and pepper in flat bowl
8. Put panko in another flat bowl
9. Lightly beat eggs and milk , and put in yet another flat bowl
10. Dredge avocado slices in flour , then egg mixture , coat with panko
11. Deep fry until golden brown
12. Remove from oil and place on paper towels to drain
13. Serve with chipotle ketchup

title: baked fruited french toast
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f degrees
2. Slice bread in 1-inch slices
3. Set aside
4. Put olive oil in 13x9 inch baking dish
5. Cover with brown sugar
6. Arrange apples , pears and dried cherries over brown sugar
7. Sprinkle with cinnamon & nuts
8. Set aside
9. In a large bowl , beat eggs , then add milk , almond extract & amaretto
10. Dip bread slices in egg mixture and place on top of fruit
11. Pour any extra egg mixture over bread
12. Bake for 25-30 minutes or until bread is lightly golden
13. Serve fruited side up with warm maple syrup or a dusting of powdered sugar , if desired

title: halvah parfait
steps:
1. In a bowl whip the sweet cream until it forms stiff peaks
2. In a small saucepan mix the sugar with 6 tablespoons of water and boil for 5 minutes
3. Remove from the heat and let the mixture cool
4. In the top of a double boiler , over but not in boiling water , place the syrup and add the egg yolks and amaretto
5. Mix with a hand mixer without stopping until the mixture is thick in texture and lighter in color and begins to form a foam on the surface
6. Remove from the heat , transfer to a mixing bowl and add the halvah
7. Mix at a high speed without stopping for 15 minutes and then fold in the whipped cream , mixing gently with a plastic spatula until the mixture is even throughout
8. Transfer the mixture to a loaf pan , cover with plastic wrap or parchment paper and place in the freezer for a minimum of 6-8 hours
9. Serve in thick slices as a dessert
10. Hailing from the middle east , this confection is made from ground sesame seed and honey , sometimes with the addition of chopped dried fruit and pistachio nuts
11. It`s available in most supermarkets in wrapped bars , and in jewish delicatessens in long slabs from which individual slices can be cut

title: buttermilk sherbet
steps:
1. Blend all ingredients together thoroughly and pour into a freezing tray
2. Freeze
3. Serve when mushy-frozen
4. If sherbet freezes too solid before serving time , scrape across the surface with an inverted spoon , taking up thin layers of sherbet and beat to a mushy consistency

title: stuffin  egg muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Prepare stuffing mix as directed on package
3. Press 1 / 4 cup stuffing firmly onto bottom and up sides of 8 muffin cups , forming about 1 / 4 inch rim around top of cup
4. Crack 1 egg into each stuffing cup
5. Sprinkle with bacon bits and cheese
6. Bake 20 minutes or until yolks are set
7. Let stand 5 minutes before serving

title: steeler s game day hoagie
steps:
1. Slice bread in half longwise
2. Layer cheese on bottom of bread
3. Layer meats on top of of cheeses
4. Cut the roasted red pepper in 6 strips , layer on top of meat
5. Slice tomato and red onion very thin and layer on top of the pepper layer
6. Drizzle the oil on top of the vegetables
7. Sprinkle the oregano on top and season lightly with the salt ant pepper
8. Top of with the bread top halve and secure with large tooth picks until ready to serve
9. Slice when ready to serve

title: kahlua fudge sauce
steps:
1. Over a double boiler on low heat , combine chocolate chips , heavy cream , and butter
2. Stir until chips are melted and mixture is smooth
3. Remove from heat , stir in coffee liqueur
4. Serve warm
5. Can also be melted in the microwave on a low temperature , stirring occasionally and being sure not to burn the chocolate

title: pineapple popsicles
steps:
1. Blend in blender until smooth
2. Pour into molds and freeze

title: breaded ranch or ranchero chicken
steps:
1. In bowl , combine cereal , salad dressing mix and cheese
2. Dip chicken into melted butter , then dip into above mixture
3. Bake in a greased , 9x13 dish , uncovered at 350 degrees for about 45 minutes

title: spicy beef  cheese   potato entree dip
steps:
1. In an extra large skillet , brown the ground beef , drain , and place beef back in skillet
2. Add the water , taco seasoning , garlic , onions , cayenne pepper , black pepper , and jalapenos to the beef and allow to simmer over low medium heat
3. In a separate large skillet or deep fryer , begin frying the potatoes
4. When the beef mixture has reduced to the point that most of the water is gone , add the cheese to it
5. Once cheese has melted in beef mixture , mix in the fried potatoes and black olives

title: country yogurt bread
steps:
1. The flour amount is approximate , add more or less to form a nice dough
2. Make the bread dough using your favorite method
3. I just dump it all in my bread machine and set to the dough cycle
4. You can also mix the dough using the traditional method of heating the liquid and adding the yeast , proofing , and then mixing in the dry ingredients
5. If using this method knead about 10 minutes and let the dough rest about 10 minutes
6. When the dough cycle is complete , place dough onto floured surface and divide into 2 equal pieces
7. Form into loaves by rolling each piece into a rectangle about 12x10 inches
8. Starting at short end , roll tightly into a loaf
9. Tuck ends and pinch seams to seal
10. Place on greased baking sheet
11. With a sharp knife , make slashes in the top of the loaves about an inch apart
12. Brush with egg white
13. Let rise until double , about one hour
14. Brush with the egg white again before baking
15. Bake at 400f for 30 minutes

title: lomo saltado with mushrooms and onion
steps:
1. Pound pork chops to 1 / 4-inch thickness
2. Season with salt and pepper , then lightly coat in flour
3. Heat 2 tablespoons of the oil in a large skillet over medium-high
4. Saute chops until nicely browned on each side
5. Set aside
6. Add the remaining tablespoon of oil to the skillet
7. Cook mushrooms and onion , stirring occasionally , in the oil for about 5 minutes or until softened
8. Stir in 3 tablespoons of the flour
9. Lower heat to medium
10. Add soy sauce and vinegar
11. Cook about 1 minute , then add 1 / 2 cup water
12. Stir and cook about 2 minutes until the sauce is thickened
13. Add pork chops back to skillet , cover and cook 3-5 minutes longer
14. Garnish with cilantro if desired

title: robbyn s garlic pizza crust abm
steps:
1. Add ingredients to your bread machine in the order directed in your manual
2. Oil baking sheets
3. Use fingers to press out to edges
4. Makes 2 pizzas , cookie sheet size
5. Makes 8 mini pizzas , pie pan size
6. Bake at 425f till golden
7. Cool completely , stack between layers of waxed paper in a gallon-size ziplock bag and freeze
8. You don't even have to thaw them to make a pizza

title: grammie bea s chocolate no bake cookies
steps:
1. Mix the sugar , cocoa , butter , and milk in a med
2. Saucepan , and heat over med
3. Heat , stirring occasionally , until mixture comes to a boil
4. Let mixture boil for 2 1 / 2 mins
5. , then remove from heat
6. Stir in the peanut butter , vanilla , and oats
7. If you are adding coconut and / or raisins , add at this time too
8. If it looks on the runny side and soft , add another 1 / 2 cup oats gradually , until desired thickness , and mix well
9. You don't want them to spread out too much when you drop them onto the wax paper
10. Working quickly , drop by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper or aluminum foil
11. Let cool
12. The serving size is approximate , as it depends on how big you make them

title: sausage bobbat    a polish russian recipe
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. In medium sauce pan , fry sausages until they are browned
3. Drain the grease
4. Cut in 1 inch or 2 inch pieces , set aside
5. Cream butter , sugar , eggs and milk in a medium bowl
6. In a separate bowl blend flour , baking powder and salt
7. Mix well
8. Add to creamed mixture
9. Spray pam in square 10 inch baking pan
10. Pour half of the batter in the pan
11. Place sausage pieces evenly over the batter
12. Pour remaining batter over the sausages
13. Bake 30-40 minutes
14. Cut in squares and serve hot
15. Serve with toppings if desired
16. Toppings are adapted to this recipe from my german heritage

title: taco dip supreme
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Spray a square baking dish
3. Spread refried beans evenly in the baking dish
4. Brown ground beef with onion and drain
5. Salt and pepper , add to baking dish
6. Pour salsa and tomatoes on top
7. Mix it slightly by "cutting" through the dip with a knife
8. Top with cheddar cheese
9. Bake for about 15 or 20 minutes , or until it is heated through with cheese melted

title: ranch corn salad
steps:
1. Combine all the veggies
2. Add the dressing , just enough to coat the vegetables well
3. Gently stir in the cheese and bacon
4. Refrigerate until serving

title: toffee bits cookies
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees
2. Lightly grease cookie sheet
3. Stir together flour , baking soda and salt
4. Set aside
5. Beat butter , granulated sugar , brown sugar and vanilla in a large bowl until well blended
6. Add eggs
7. Beat well
8. Gradually add flour mixture , beating until well blended
9. Stir in toffee bits
10. Drop by rounded teaspoons onto prepared cookie sheet
11. Bake 9 to 11 minutes or until lightly browned
12. Cool slightly
13. Remove from cookie sheet to wire rack
14. Cool completely

title: manale s bar b que shrimp
steps:
1. Place whole shrimp in a single layer in an oven proof dish
2. Drizzle olive oil on top of shrimp
3. Pepper shrimp until they are black
4. When you think you have enough , add more
5. Add lots of salt , lemon juice , tabasco and worcestershire sauce
6. Remember that you are seasoning through the shells
7. Cut up a good amount of butter on top of shrimp and broil until shrimp are cooked , about 15-20 minutes
8. Be sure and taste to see if they are done
9. Serve these in bowls with lots of napkins
10. Have hot french bread to sop up the sauce

title: bacon mushroom brussels sprouts
steps:
1. Place brussels sprouts in a saucepan and cover with water
2. Bring to a boil and reduce heat
3. Cover and simmer for 8 minutes or until crisp-tender
4. Drain and keep warm
5. In a skillet , cook bacon over medium heat until crisp
6. Remove to paper towels and drain , reserving 2 tablespoons drippings
7. Saute onion and mushrooms in the drippings for 3-5 minutes or until tender
8. Add the broth , salt and pepper and bring to a boil
9. Reduce heat , simmer , uncovered , for 3-4 minutes or until broth is reduced by half
10. Stir in brussels sprouts and bacon

title: pork chops and noodles
steps:
1. Season chops as you would normally season your meat
2. Brown chops under broiler 20 minutes or in non-stick skillet , just until brown
3. Place in crockpot
4. In large bowl , combine all other ingredients except egg noodles
5. The sauce should resemble the thickness of gravy to adhere to the noodles
6. Pour sauce over pork chops in the crockpot
7. Be sure chops are covered by the sauce
8. Cook on low 8-10 hours
9. Serve over bed of egg noodles
10. Originalcooks
11. You can use 4 , but you will be left with a lot of sauce

title: wasabi salmon burgers
steps:
1. With a large chef's knife , chop salmon using quick , even , straight-up-and-down motions
2. Continue chopping , rotating the knife , until you have a mass of roughly 1 / 4-inch pieces
3. Transfer to a large bowl
4. Add scallions , egg , ginger and oil
5. Stir to combine
6. Form the mixture into 4 patties
7. The mixture will be moist and loose , but holds together nicely once the first side is cooked
8. Coat a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray and heat over medium heat for 1 minute
9. Add the patties and cook for 4 minutes
10. Turn and continue to cook until firm and fragrant , about 3 minutes
