11. Spoon the reserved wasabi glaze evenly over the burgers and cook for 15 seconds more
12. Serve immediately
13. Ingredient
14. The powder is available in jars in the asian aisle of most supermarkets or in almost all asian markets
15. Store at room temperature for up to 1 year
16. To skin a salmon fillet: place it on a clean cutting board , skin side down
17. Starting at the tail end , slip the blade of a long , sharp knife between the fish flesh and the skin , holding the skin down firmly with your other hand
18. Gently push the blade along at a 30 degree angle , separating the fillet from the skin without cutting through either
19. Or have your fishmonger do it for you
20. 4 servings 30 minutes

title: quick and easy guacamole
steps:
1. Using a big bowl , cut six avodcadoes and mash them up
2. Add in 1 cup of salsa and mix both ingrediants
3. Once mixed , add in garlic salt and salt
4. Season to taste

title: colcannon soup
steps:
1. Melt butter in a large saucepan over medium heat
2. Stir in cabbage , potatoes , and leeks
3. Cover and cook until barely tender
4. Add stock and bring to a boil
5. Cover , then reduce heat to a simmer , and cook until the vegetables are soft
6. Season with salt , pepper , and nutmeg
7. Transfer mixture to a blender or food processor in batches and process until smooth
8. Return to the same saucepan and whisk in the half and half
9. Serve hot

title: sesame chicken strips
steps:
1. Cut chicken into long 3 / 4 inch wide strips
2. Mix honey , soy sauce , dressing mix , and juice together
3. Place chicken strips in bag and pour over marinade and freeze
4. On cooking day , thaw chicken and thread onto skewers
5. Grill , turning frequently , until cooked through , about 8-10 minutes

title: frozen banana mango smoothie
steps:
1. Cut banana into chunks and freeze
2. In a blender , combine all ingredients and blend until smooth
3. If the smoothie is too thick , thin with a little more orange juice
4. Pour into 4 glasses

title: roasted beet pasta
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. In a large mixing bowl , toss beets with oil and salt to coat
3. Place on lined baking sheet and place in 400 degree oven for 1 hour
4. Remove and allow to cool
5. Peel beets under running water and cut into 1 / 4 inch dice
6. Then puree in food processor
7. To make pasta: make a mound of the flour in the center of a large wooden cutting board
8. Make a well in the middle of the flour and add the eggs , beet puree and any other flavorings you choose
9. Using a fork , beat together the eggs , oil and flavorings and begin to incorporate the flour starting with the inner rim of the well
10. As you expand the well , keep pushing the flour up to retain the well shape
11. Do not worry that this initial phase looks messy
12. The dough will come together when 1 / 2 of the flour is incorporated
13. Start kneading the dough with both hands , using the palms of your hands primarily
14. Once you have a cohesive mass , remove the dough from the board and scrape up any left over crusty bits
15. Lightly flour the board and continue kneading for 3 more minutes
16. The dough should be elastic and a little sticky
17. Continue to knead for another 3 minutes , remembering to dust your board when necessary
18. Wrap the dough in plastic wrap and allow to rest for 30 minutes at room temperature
19. Roll out to four 7 inch by 16 inch sheets and cut in whatever shape you wish

title: ivo s mushroom leek puff pastry triangles
steps:
1. Clean the mushrooms and slice them into slices 1 / 4" thick
2. Heat half the oil and butter in a pan over high heat and add the mushrooms and garlic while the butter is browning
3. Grind some pepper over the mushrooms and salt to taste
4. As the mushrooms lose moisture and shrink , turn the heat down to medium and continue to fry the mushrooms , turning the slices regularly until they are dark brown
5. Drain on paper towels , and then chop into smaller pieces
6. Remove the outer leaves of the leek and cut off the dark green parts and the bottom 1 / 2"
7. You're aiming for the white and light green parts of the leek
8. Halve the leek lengthwise and rinse all layers to clean
9. Slice across the leeks thinly , then roughly chop all pieces coarsely
10. Fry these in more butter in the same pan used for the mushrooms until they are soft , and then drain onto paper towels
11. Packages of puff pastry generally contain two sheets , you'll only need one
12. Take it out and let it defrost
13. In a bowl , mix the mushrooms pieces , the leek , the cheddar and the sour cream
14. Sometimes it helps if you slice the leek into pieces - easier to mix that way
15. Preheat the oven to 400f
16. Roll out the puff pastry slightly on a floured surface
17. Cut out 4 squares , about 4-5" to the side
18. Put a generous dollop of the leek-mushroom mixture onto one half of each square and fold over the corner to make a triangular pocket
19. Use a fork to press the folded seam together
20. Repeat for the other squares until you have 4 triangular turnovers
21. Baste the triangles with the melted butter
22. Bake in the oven on a cookie sheet until golden-brown and puffed
23. Serve warm

title: black eyed pea cakes
steps:
1. Saute onion in 1 t hot oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until tender
2. Process onion , 1 can of peas , and next 4 ingredients in a blender until mixture is smooth , stopping to scrape down sides
3. Pour mixture into a large mixing bowl
4. Stir in hush puppy mix , and gently fold in remaining can of peas
5. Shape mixture by 2 t into 3-inch patties
6. Place patties on a wax paper-lined baking sheet
7. Cover and chill 1 hour
8. Cook patties , in batches , in 3 t hot oil , adding oil as needed , in a large skillet over medium heat for 1 1 / 2 minutes on each side or until patties are golden brown
9. Drain patties on paper towels , and keep warm
10. Serve with desired toppings

title: cuckoo cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Cookies:
3. Cream shortening and sugar
4. Add eggs , mixing well
5. Stir in milk
6. Add soda , salt , vanilla , cocoa , and flour
7. Mix well
8. Just a heads up this dough is very soft
9. Almost sticky even
10. But i didn't add more flour , i left the recipe as it was
11. Drop slightly heaping teaspoonfuls onto a sprayed cookie sheet
12. Bake for 6 minutes
13. Take out of the oven and top each cookie with 1 marshmallow half , cut side down
14. Return to oven , bake an additional 3 minutes
15. Ifyou wanted to add a walnut half , i would do it at this point , stick it right into the soft marshmallow
16. Marshmallow will be puffy , but will fall a bit after being out of the oven awhile
17. Cool on cookie sheet for 1 minute before removing to cookie rack to finish cooling
18. Frosting:
19. Mix all ingredients well
20. Take a small spoon , a teaspoon would be plenty , scoop up some frosting and drizzle over cookies
21. The recipe says to spread cookies with frosting
22. No way !
23. It rips the marshmallow all up and looks awful
24. So , i added a bit more milk than the original recipe called for , to make the frosting more like a glaze so it would look nicer

title: dijon chicken kabobs
steps:
1. Combine mustard and onions in a bowl
2. In another bowl , combine breadcrumbs and parsley
3. Toss chicken chunks in mustard mixture
4. Coat chicken chunks with bread crumb mixture
5. Line a baking sheet with foil and coat the foil with nonstick cooking spray
6. Thread chicken onto metal or soaked wooden skewers , leave a small space between the chunks
7. Place the skewers on the prepared baking sheet
8. Bake uncovered at 450 degrees for 6 - 8 minutes or until the juices run clear

title: mom s cream corn
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in a crock pot
2. We cut up the butter and cream cheese to help it melt down faster
3. Set your crock pot on low and let it cook all day - 6 to 8 hours
4. You can also cook on high for 3 to 4 hours , but make sure to check it more often so the bottom doesn't scorch

title: baked celery
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f degrees
2. Separate celery into stalks , remove leaves and trim , wash well and cut into pieces about 3 / 4-inch thick
3. Place celery in an ungreased casserole dish
4. Dice bacon
5. Add bacon and sliced onion to casserole , atop the celery
6. Sprinkle all with fresh parsley
7. Combine stock and water and pour over dish
8. Don't stir
9. Dot casserole with small bits of butter
10. Cover dish and bake for 30 to 45 minutes , or until celery is cooked but not mushy

title: ww 2 pt  pasta and cauliflower soup
steps:
1. Spray large saucepan with cooking olive oil spray or nonstick spray
2. Saute carrot and onion 3 minutes over medium heat , until just tender , stirring occasionally
3. Do not brown ! add cauliflower and chicken broth
4. Cover and simmer for 10 minutes
5. Stir in shells & basil and bring to a low boil
6. Cook 15 minutes , or until shells are just tender
7. Sprinkle each serving with pepper to taste

title: italian fresh prune plum bread
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f
2. Lightly grease two 9 x 5 inch loaf pans
3. In a large bowl , cream together the butter and sugar until light and fluffy
4. Add the eggs one at a time , and beat well after each addition
5. Add the orange rind and vanilla
6. In a separate bowl , combine the flour , salt , cinnamon , cream of tartar and baking soda
7. Add the dry ingredients and sour cream alternately to the creamed mixture , beginning and ending with the dry ingredients
8. Stir in the nuts and plums
9. Divide the batter between the two loaf pans
10. Bake for 50 to 60 minutes , or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean
11. Let the pans cool on a rack for 10 minutes , then turn the loaves out of the pans and cool completely on the rack
12. Makes 2 loaves
13. Lucy wavermans cooking school cookbook

title: libbies skillet corn bread
steps:
1. Mix flour , cornmeal , sugar , baking soda and salt together
2. Add sour milk , sweet milk , and egg
3. Stir until just combined
4. Put a tablespoon lard in a pan like cast iron skillet and let it get hot
5. Pour the mixture in the skillet
6. Cook for a minute on stove top
7. Bake at 425 degrees fahrenheit for 15 mnutes

title: chicken thigh osso bucco
steps:
1. Salt and pepper thighs and saute in 1t
2. Olive oil
3. Chop onion , carrot , celery and garlic into a fine mince
4. Remove chicken thighs when brown on both sides
5. Add veggies to pan and cook till soft
6. Deglaze pan with red wine and reduce by half
7. Add tomato sauce , diced tomatoes , oregano and rosemary
8. Cook till bubbly then add thighs back to the pan
9. Simmer 40-60 minutes
10. Meanwhile combine chopped parsley , lemon zest and chopped garlic
11. Before serving add the last 3 ingredients

title: split pea burgers
steps:
1. Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat
2. Add the onion and bell pepper along with a generous pinch of salt
3. Sweat for 5 minutes or until the onions are soft
4. Add the garlic and mushrooms and continue to cook for another 4 minutes
5. Add the broth , peas , rice , coriander and cumin
6. Increase the heat to high and bring to a boil
7. Decrease heat to low , cover and cook at a simmer for 1 hour or until the rice and peas are tender
8. Remove from the heat and gently pour the mixture into the bowl of a food processor and process until just combined
9. Do not puree
10. Pour this mixture into a bowl and stir in the 3 / 4 cup of bread crumbs
11. Season , to taste , with salt and freshly ground pepper
12. Refrigerate for 30 minutes
13. Shape the mixture into patties and dredge on each side in the remaining 1 / 4 cup of bread crumbs
14. Heat one tablespoon of olive oil in a medium saute pan over medium heat
15. Add 2 burgers at a time and saute until brown on each side , approximately 3 to 4 minutes per side
16. To grill , cook on high for 3 to 4 minutes per side as well
17. Serve immediately
18. When blending hot liquids: remove liquid from the heat and allow to cool for at least 5 minutes
19. Transfer liquid to a blender or food processor and fill it no more than halfway
20. If using a blender , release one corner of the lid
21. This prevents the vacuum effect that creates heat explosions
22. Place a towel over the top of the machine , pulse a few times then process on high speed until smooth

title: jessie s long island cocktail
steps:
1. Mix liquors together first in a shaker , or large ice filled glass , or a pitcher
2. Then add sour mix and 7-up / sprite to taste
3. I like sour mix so i add more than most people
4. Can garnish with fruit , but not necessary
5. Drink responsibly :) enjoy !

title: saganaki me tyri ke avga  fried cheese with eggs
steps:
1. Heat the olive oil in a frying pan
2. Be careful not to burn or smoke
3. Mix 2 eggs with flour to make a paste
4. Divide the gruyere cheese into portions , immerse each portion into water first , then into the egg and flour mixture , and fry it in heated oil until it becomes on both sides light brown in colour
5. Fry the remaining eggs separately in olive oil and serve them alongside the fried cheese

title: strawberry scones
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425f
2. Combine the flour , brown sugar , baking powder , salt and orange peel in a large bowl and mix well
3. Cut in the butter with a pastry blender or rub together with fingers until crumbly
4. Stir in the strawberries
5. Gradually stir in enough milk to make a soft dough
6. Gather into a loose ball and knead lightly on a lightly floured surface
7. Pat out into a 7 inch round , about 3 / 4 inch thick
8. The dough will be sticky
9. Cut into 8 wedges and place 1 / 2 inch apart on an ungreased baking sheet
10. Bake for 20-25 minutes or until golden brown

title: easy onion meatloaf
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit
2. Mix ground beef , onion soup mix , egg , and evaporated milk together
3. The texture should be very mushy with a lot of moisture
4. Form meat mixure into a loaf and place in a baking pan
5. Bake until meat is done , about 45 minutes
6. Drain off some of the excess juice / grease
7. Top meatloaf with the jar of gravy
8. Put pan back in oven to heat gravy through , about 5 minutes

title: orange  or lemon  broccoli
steps:
1. Wash and cut broccoli into florets
2. Bring about 1 cup of water to boil in a saucepan over high heat
3. Add broccoli florets , reduce heat to medium and cover
4. Cook until broccoli is crisp-tender and still bright green
5. About 5 minutes
6. Drain and return broccoli to pan
7. Add butter , orange juice , orange zest , salt and pepper
8. Toss together and heat through
9. Serve

title: veggie split pea soup
steps:
1. In a large pot add at low-med heat cook onions and garlic until transparent
2. Add a little water as the time passes so the onions wont brown or crisp
3. Add water / broth combo , spices and then add celery , carrots and peas
4. Bring to a boil
5. Reduce heat to a simmer for 1 to 11 / 2 hours - until peas are soft and mushy
6. Remove the bay leaf
7. Cool slightly
8. Puree in a blender for a smooth soup or leave as is

title: blueberry corn muffins ala lee
steps:
1. Prepare the corn muffins according to package directions
2. Add the blueberries using more or less than the listed amount
3. If using frozen berries mix them in gently and use them frozen
4. Bake according to package
5. However , you may have more than the number of muffins stated , so plan accordingly
6. I use texas size muffin tins and cupcake liners
7. It makes 4 or 5 of this size muffin
8. When done , and while still hot , dip tops in mix of melted butter and lemon juice to your taste , then into sugar
9. To fancy them up use decorator sugars colored to the season or your mood !
10. Enjoy !

title: college guy microwave potato skins   easy
steps:
1. Slice potatoes lengthwise
2. Lay out on a microwave plate , skins down
3. Carve a vertical line about halfway through the potato
4. This helps it cook even and is not necessary for smaller or thinner potato strips
5. You could also carve an "x" shape instead
6. Microwave on high for 10 minutes
7. Take out of microwave and if you want to , spread out margarine or butter thinly over the potatoes
8. Top each potato with a good handful of shredded cheddar cheese
9. Sprinkle with bacos
10. Microwave on high an additional 2 minutes or until cheese is completely melted
11. Let potatoes sit for a few minutes
12. They are usually extremely hot
13. Also , be careful handling the plate
14. After they have cooled , salt to taste and enjoy !

title: pierogidilla
steps:
1. Spread mashed potatoes over one half of tortilla
2. Spread sauerkraut and onions over potatoes
3. Top evenly with cheese
4. Sprinkle with spices to taste
5. Fold tortilla over and grill until golden brown in hot skillet
6. Cut into wedges and serve with sour cream for dipping
7. To caramelize onions , heat just enough olive oil or butter to thinly coat the bottom of a medium-size saute pan
8. Add onion slices in one layer and cook until they are golden brown , stirring after they caramelize on the bottom , about 10 minutes

title: almond fudge topped shortbread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. In a large mixer bowl , beat margarine , sugar and salt until fluffy
3. Add flour and mix well
4. With floured hands , press evenly into greased 13x9 inch pan
5. Bake 20-25 minutes or until lightly browned
6. In a heavy saucepan over low heat , melt chips with eagle brand , stirring constantly
7. Remove from heat and stir in extract
8. Spread evenly over shortbread
9. Garnish with almonds , press down firmly
10. Chill 3 hours or until firm
11. Cut into bars

title: barbecue cashew chicken pizza with french fried onions
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400f spray 13x9-inch pan or 12-inch pizza pan with cooking spray
2. Unroll pizza crust dough on pan
3. Press dough to edges of pan
4. Bake 7-8 minutes or until golden brown
5. Meanwhile , in medium bowl , mix barbecue sauce , jelly , pepper and chopped onion
6. Spread evenly over partially baked crust
7. Top with chicken , cashews , chopped cilantro and cheese
8. Bake 7-8 minutes longer or until cheese is melted and crust is deep golden brown
9. Sprinkle french-fried onions over pizza
10. Bake 2-3 minutes longer or until onions are golden
11. Garnish with cilantro sprigs

title: mussels with garlic   white wine
steps:
1. In a pot large enough to hold mussels , heat butter on medium heat
2. Add garlic and mussels , toss and warm for two minutes
3. Add tomatoes , wine , cream , salt& pepper
4. Raise heat to med-high , cover and cook 5 minutes
5. Check during cooking
6. Do not overcook
7. Mussels are done when shells have opened
8. Divide into 4 bowl with broth
9. Garnish with parsley and lemon wedge

title: gluten free coconut milk brussels sprouts meal
steps:
1. Put the ghee or coconut oil in a saucepan , warm up , then add sprouts
2. Once sprouts warmed up , and soaked up some of the butter / oil , add 1 / 4 cup of water , salt and simmer for 10 / 15 minutes or until softer
3. Mash the sprouts mildly , add tarragon , garlic , chili flakes and the coconut milk , stir and bring to boil
4. If meal is not thick enough , add the 1 tsp of coconut flour , stir in well and let it stand on stove for a minute longer
5. Sprinkle with black pepper
6. Voila meal is ready
7. You could serve it with plain yoghurt
8. For coconut milk you could use canned one , if it doesnt have any additional ingredients , but its much better to have own
9. Real easy too
10. Stir in 2 tsps of coconut cream with 2 tbsp of hot water first , then once cream dissolved , add rest of the water and you have the coconut milk ready

title: honey balls
steps:
1. Mix together all ingredients except crushed corn flakes
2. Scoop out by teaspoon full and roll into balls , then roll in crushed corn flakes
3. Chill before serving

title: izzy s snow peas
steps:
1. In large skillet saut snow peas and shallots in the oil for about 3 minutes
2. Add basil and broth and cook for about 2 minutes
3. Serve immediately

title: coronation chicken   deli style but cheaper
steps:
1. Cook the chicken in an oven on gas mark 3 for about 30 mins in a covered roasting tin or cover with foil
2. This keeps them nice and moist and doesnt dry the chicken out
3. Let cool down once cooked
4. Gently fry chopped onion in butter until very soft
5. Stir in the curry powder and cook on a low flame , occasionally stirring for a further 5 minutes , coating the onion with curry powder and bringing out the full flavour
6. This is to take the rawness away from the curry powder
7. Let the mixture cool down
8. When onion mixture is cool , add the mango chutney , apricot jam , yogurt , tomato puree , raisins and lemon juice , mayonnaise and mix
9. Roughly chop the chicken up into bite size pieces
10. Throw chicken into mixture and coat thoroughly
11. Enjoy with jacket potatoes or in a sandwich or just on its own with good old salad !

title: cheddar cheese chicken with bacon
steps:
1. Preheat oven at 350 and spray baking pan with non-stick cooking spray
2. Combine first 5 ingredients
3. Dip chicken first in egg white , then into crumbs
4. Place in baking dish
5. Bake for 30 minutes or until tender
6. About 5 minutes before chicken is done , top with bacon bits and cheese , then place back in oven until cheese melts
7. Enjoy !

title: onion cups
steps:
1. Combine sour cream and horseradish
2. Chill until ready to serve
3. Pre-heat oven to 400f
4. Halve and peel red onion
5. Carefully remove the outer two rings and place into shallow baking dish
6. Upside down
7. Brush with oil and add 1 / 2 of salt and pepper
8. Roast for 15-20 minutes
9. Fry bacon
10. Chop peppers , garlic , and remaining onion
11. Brown in leftover bacon grease for about 5 minutes
12. Place beets , rosemary , and remaining salt / pepper into pan with garlic and peppers
13. Cook another 5 minutes
14. Carefully turn roasted onions right-side up and place veggies into each cup , stuffing until all mixture is used
15. Top with crumbled bacon
16. Return to oven and roast another 5 minutes
17. Serve with horseradish / sour cream sauce

title: oatmeal cookiewiches with kahlua creme
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Sift together the flour , salt , and baking soda
3. Set aside
4. Cream together the shortening , brown sugar , and granulated sugar
5. Add eggs and vanilla , mixing well
6. Stir in the flour mixture
7. Mix in the oats
8. Add in the nuts and apples
9. The dough will be fairly stiff , and may not 'hold together'
10. This is ok
11. As long as there is not dry oatmeal or flour , the mix is not too dry
12. Drop by large tablespoons onto greased cookie sheet
13. I use a double-dip of my small cookie scoop
14. I can fit 6 on a cookie sheet
15. I've found that they 'spread' more on airbake sheets , so i prefer regular dark cookie sheets with silpat liner
16. Using a fork , dipped in sugar , press the cookies down to about a 2 inch round size
17. You will want them to be uniform size and shape for later
18. Bake for 15 minutes
19. Remove from cookie sheet and cool
20. To make the kahlua creme , whip the heavy cream and kahlua to soft peaks
21. Add the vanilla pudding mix and continue to beat until creme is thick
22. Spread a good dollop of creme on the center of one of the cookies
23. Top with another cookie , and press gently until creme squished to edge of the cookies
24. You can either eat them like this , while the creme is soft
25. Or you can freeze them , and thaw partially before eating , giving it more of an ice-cream texture

title: crocked kielbasa
steps:
1. In a medium skillet , saute ground beef
2. When browned , transfer to crock pot
3. Add all other ingredients except pasta& parmesan
4. Simmer on low for 6-8 hours
5. Cook pasta according to directions
6. Ladle
7. Kielbasa over pasta in large bowls
8. Pass the parmesan cheese to garnish

title: killer stuffed jalapenos
steps:
1. Cut tops off jalapenos , cut in half and remove seeds and membranes
2. (i do this in the sink filled with water and work under the water
3. Drain and dry
4. Mix cream cheese with the green onions and cajun seasoning
5. Fill each jalapeno half with the cream cheese mixture
6. Spread apricot jam generously over the filled jalapenos
7. Grill on the bbq for about 15 to 20 minutes over very low or indirect heat
8. I like mine fairly firm but you can cook them longer if you desire
9. I use a small hole vegetable holder on the grill
10. Or you can also bake them in the oven at 350 degrees until done

title: spicy smoked prime rib
steps:
1. Rub entire rib roast with rub mix
2. Smoke roast over indirect heat for 3-4 hours at 200-250 degrees or until meat thermometer reads 140 degrees or longer if you prefer your meat more done
3. 3 / 4 way thru cooking you can sprinkle meat with crushed rosemary leaves if desired

title: butternut squash apple cranberry bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Slice and peel squash and apples
3. Place squash cubes in an ungreased 7 x 11 inch baking dish
4. Plese apples on top and then cranberries
5. Mix the flour , salt , sugar and nutmeg and sprinkle on top
6. Dot with butter
7. Bake 50-60 minutes

title: whisky oranges with honey cream
steps:
1. Stir sugar and water together over low to medium heat until sugar is dissoved
2. Bring to the boil , then decrease heat and simmer for 2 minutes
3. Remove from heat to cool , and add whisky
4. Peel the oranges , ensuring that no white pith remains
5. Cut the oranges into segments , cutting between membranes- if you do this over a bowl you will catch all the juice
6. Place the segmented oranges in a bowl and carefully pour over the cooled syrup
7. Refrigerate , covered , for up to three days before serving
8. For the honey cream: place the honey and whisky together in a small bowl and stir until well combined
9. In a separate bowl , beat the cream softly
10. Gradually add the honey mixture to the cream , beating until thick
11. Refrigerate covered until serving time

title: tamarillo and date chutney  new zealand
steps:
1. Slice tamarillos in half lengthwise and place in microwave dish and cook for five minutes
2. This enables one to remove skins with ease
3. Place all ingredients in a large pot or preserving pan and bring to the boil stirring frquently
4. Simmer covered stirring frequently for approximately 2 hours or until thick
5. Pour into hot sterilised jars and cover when cold

title: strawberry freeze
steps:
1. Place cookies on bottom of 9-inch springform pan
2. Beat cream cheese and sugar in bowl on medium speed until well blended
3. Gradually add juice , beating well after each addition
4. Stir in strawberries
5. Add cool whip
6. Stir with wire whisk until well blended
7. Pour over cookies
8. Freeze several hours to overnight until firm
9. Let stand in fridge 15 minutes before serving

title: comfort food salisbury steak
steps:
1. Mix meat with crackers , milk , parsley flakes , salt , pepper , garlic salt , and egg
2. This is easiest to mix by hand
3. Form into large patties
4. Heat butter or oil in large skillet over medium heat
5. Then add meat and brown on both sides
6. Drain
7. Smear cream of mushroom soup all over the tops and sides of the meat patties until you use it all
8. Cover tightly and simmer on med-low heat for 30 minutes , flipping patties now and then and spooning soup back over , until no longer pink in the center

title: marinated goat cheese rounds with crostini
steps:
1. Goat cheese rounds:
2. Roll the cheese into a 4" long log
3. Slice into 1" thick rounds and place in a shallow dish
4. In a small bowl , whisk together vinegar , garlic , thyme , pepper , olives , and olive oil until well blended
5. Pour over the goat cheese and marinate , refrigerated , for 2 hours to 1 week
6. Before serving , let warm to room temperature , about 30 minutes
7. Crostini:
8. Preheat the broiler or grill
9. Drizzzle the bread with olive oil , and grill or broil until golden brown
10. When the crostini come out of the oven or off the grill , rub them with a bit of the minced garlic
11. Then cut in half on the diagonal
12. Serve the warm crostini with the goat cheese
13. Enjoy !

title: grandma s cheesy potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Combine first seven ingredients in a large bowl
3. Spoon into a 13 x 9 inch baking dish coated with cooking spray
4. Sprinkle with paprika
5. Bake for 1 hour or til bubbly

title: fabulous   easy potato casserole side dish
steps:
1. Preheat oven 350 degrees
2. Combine all ingredients and stir till well mixed
3. Butter a large casserole dish
4. Pour mixture into dish
5. Cover dish and bake for one hour
6. Uncover and bake till top is golden brown approximately 20-25 minutes
7. This dish reheats well either in the microwave or oven

title: cheesy white chicken chili
steps:
1. Heat oil in large heavy pot to med / high
2. Add onions & saute until translucent , about 10 minutes
3. Add garlic , chiles , chicken , cumin , oregano , and hot pepper
4. Saute 2 minutes
5. Add beans and chicken broth
6. Bring to a boil , reduce heat and simmer 2 hours or more
7. Add 1 cup of grated cheese
8. Stir until thick and melted
9. Season with salt & pepper
10. Serve with remaining cheese and sour cream

title: easy cheesy chicken skillet
steps:
1. In a bowl mix together the soup with worcestershire sauce and evaporated milk until well combined
2. Mix in the shredded cheese
3. Set aside
4. Season the chicken breast with seasoned salt and black pepper
5. Heat butter in a large skillet over medium heat
6. Add in the chicken breasts and cook for about 3 minutes on both sides or until nicely browned
7. Remove to a plate
8. To the same skillet add in the onion and saute for about 3 minutes
9. Add in fresh garlic and cook for 2 minutes , then add in the mushrooms
10. Return the chicken to the skillet and pour the mushroom soup mixture over
11. Lift the chicken with a fork to coat in the sauce
12. Simmer uncovered over medium-low heat until the chicken is cooked completely
13. Season the sauce with more salt if desired

title: strawberry julius
steps:
1. Slice up fresh strawberries until you have enough to fill a one cup measure
2. Add to a blender or food processor , or if you only have a stick mixer , just put it in a large pyrex jug
3. Add rest of ingredients
4. Blend until smooth
5. You may want to try this a little bit cooler for summer days , omit the water and add a few ice cubes
6. I only leave out the ice cubes because my food processor can't handle hard ice
7. Also it does tend to separate if you leave it sitting around for a minute , don't let this put you off , just stir it up a bit , it tastes the same , just tends to be more frothy at the top then

title: peanut butter marshmallow rice krispies squares
steps:
1. In a large saucepan melt the butter over medium heat
2. Add in marshmallows and vanilla
3. Stir until melted
4. Mix in the peanut butter until combined
5. Remove from heat and mix in the rice cereal
6. Pat firmly into a 9 x 9-inch or an 11 x 7-inch pan
7. Place the frosting in microwave-safe bowl and microwave until melted drizzle on top of the mixture

title: zucchini bread with pineapple
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. In a mixer , beat eggs
3. Aid oil , sugar , and vanilla
4. Continue beating mixture until thick and foamy
5. With a spoon , stir in zucchini and pineapple
6. In a separate bowl , combine flour , baking soda , salt , baking powder , cinnamon , nutmeg , cardamom , and ginger
7. A third at a time , add dry ingredients into wet and gently stir after each addition
8. Add the walnuts and blend gently
9. Divide the batter equally between 2 greased and flour-dusted 5 by 9 inch loaf pans
10. Bake for 1 hour or until a wooden pick inserted in to the center comes out clean
11. Cool in pans for 10-15 minutes
12. Turn out onto wire racks to cool thoroughly

title: french vanilla toast
steps:
1. Crack eggs and put in a pie plate
2. Add spices and beat with a fork
3. Add flavored creamer and beat again with a fork to make sure all is mixed well
4. Dip bread in mixture and place in a medium high buttered skillet and brown
5. Turn over and brown other side
6. I like mine crispy
7. Serve with butter and syrup , fruit spead or fresh fruit
8. Dust with confectioners sugar if you like
9. Enjoy !

title: crock pot apricot lamb
steps:
1. Lightly coat crock pot with olive oil , or use olive oil spray to prevent sticking
2. Dissolve chicken stock cube in hot water in a bowl
3. Add apricot nectar , orange juice , orange zest , star anise and pepper to bowl and mix well
4. Place lamb in crock pot and cover with mixture
5. Cook for 5-6 hours on low
6. Near end of cooking remove lid , sprinkle flour into sauce and mix well for a few minutes until thickened

title: mimi s american chop suey
steps:
1. Cook the macaroni till done , but not overdone
2. Heat a skillet and fry hamburg and onion will done
3. Add the tomato sauce and tomato soup
4. Mix well
5. Add the marcaroni
6. Heat and serve

title: tommy bahama key lime pie with white chocolate mousse whipped cr
steps:
1. To make the pie:brush egg whites onto uncooked pie shell using a pastry brush , making sure the shell is evenly coated
2. Pour off any excess egg whites
3. Pre-heat oven to 350f place pie shell in oven and bake for 5 minutes
4. Shell should look golden brown
5. Let cool at room temperature
6. While the shell is cooling , mix the egg yolks and condensed milk together using a wire whip until incorporated
7. Pour the key lime juice and zest into the mixture of yolks and condensed milk , slowly mixing with the wire whip until incorporated
8. Add the key lime pie mixture into the cooled pie shell
9. Adjust the oven temperature to 250 f and bake pie for 25-30 minutes
10. The finished pie should have a "jell-o"-like consistency
11. Place on a cooling rack for 30 minutes at room temperature
12. Place in refrigerator for at least 2 hours before serving
13. Cut into 8 even slices when serving
14. To make the whipped cream , instructions:using an electric mixer , combine heavy cream , powdered sugar and vanilla extract in a mixing bowl
15. Using the whisk attachment , beat cream mixture on high speed for 2 minutes
16. Add the white chocolate mousse to the cream mixture and mix until it reaches the consistency of stiff peaks
17. Place the whipped cream into a piping bag with an open star
18. When serving , pipe it onto each piece of key lime pie
19. Cut a slice in your lime "wheels , " twist and place in the center of each piece

title: summer squash and white bean saute
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat
2. Add onion and garlic and cook , stirring , until beginning to soften , about 3 minutes
3. Add zucchini , summer squash , oregano , salt and pepper and stir to combine
4. Reduce heat to low , cover and cook , stirring once , until the vegetables are tender-crisp , 3 to 5 minutes
5. Stir in beans , tomatoes and vinegar
6. Increase heat to medium and cook , stirring , until heated through , about 2 minutes
7. Remove from the heat and stir in parmesan
8. Serve with: brown rice or bulgur
9. Give them a good rinse before adding to a recipe to rid them of some of their sodium or opt for low-sodium or no-salt-added varieties
10. Or , if you have the time , cook your own beans from scratch

title: savory basil zucchini muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. In a small bowl , whisk together the flour , salt , baking soda , baking powder , and the pepper
3. Set aside
4. In a large bowl cream together the shortening [i used olive oil spread instead of shortening]and sugar
5. Beat in the egg and the buttermilk , beating until the mixture is combined well
6. Stir in the zucchini and the basil
7. Add the prepared flour mixture to the zucchini mixture , stirring the batter until it is just combined
8. Spoon mixture into well-greased muffin or mini-muffin tins
9. Bake the muffins on the middle rack of your oven approximately 18 to 20 minutes , or until a tester comes out clean
10. Remove from oven and turn the muffins out on a wire rack and let them cool
11. To serve tea sandwiches: halve the muffins horizontally , spread the cut sides with the butter , and sandwich the radish slices between the muffin halves

title: apple sausage quiche
steps:
1. Fit pastry into 9 inch quiche dish
2. Prick bottom and sides of pastry with fork
3. Bake at 450 for 8-10 minutes
4. Cool on wire rack
5. Combine apple , and next 3 ingredients
6. Toss well
7. Cook apple mixture and onion in butter in large skillet over medium-high heat , stirring constantly , until onion is tender
8. Remove from heat , and cool 20 minutes
9. Brown sausage in large skillet , stirring until it crumbles and is done
10. Drain well
11. Combine eggs and next 3 ingredients in large bowl
12. Add apple mixture and sausage to egg mixture
13. Stir well
14. Pour mixture into prepared pastry shell
15. Gently stir in cheese
16. Bake uncovered at 350 for 35 minutse or until cheese melts and knife inserted in center comes out clean
17. Let stand 10 minutes before serving

title: dad s delicious brownie mounds
steps:
1. Sift flour , baking powder and salt together
2. Mix margarine and sugar , and stir in syrup and eggs
3. Stir in flour mixture , melted chocolate , vanilla and nuts
4. Drop by heaping tablespoonfuls onto greased baking sheets
5. Bake in 350 degree oven 10-12 minutes
6. Do not over bake

title: bacon  kale and leeks
steps:
1. Slice the leeks
2. If you have bought kurly kale that isn't trimmed , trim it now , disposing of any woody stalks
3. Chop the bacon if necessary
4. With buying the mis shapes packs of bacon , sometimes it does need to be chopped , other times it is already in small enough pieces
5. Heat 1 tbsp oil in a large frying pan and another tbsp in a large saucepan
6. Cook the bacon in the frying pan until done to your liking , some people like it crisped , some prefer it just cooked enough
7. Cook the leeks in the saucepan , over a low heat , so that they soften rather than brown
8. About 4 or 5 minutes before you think the bacon is done , put 3 / 4 of the kale into the saucepan with the leeks , stir and pop a lid on until the bacon is finished
9. When the bacon is done ,
10. Stir to mix , the heat will be enough enough to wilt that last addition of kale
11. The bacon usually provides enough saltiness and the kale enough pepperiness , but taste and season if you think it is necessary
12. You could use any other dark green leafy vegetable depending on what is on offer
13. Spinach , spring greens , green cabbage , anything like that
14. And you could substitute onions for the leeks if you wished

title: xtra special celebration cake
steps:
1. Heat the oven to 350f grease 2 round 9-inch pans
2. Dust with flour
3. Mix flour , sugar , cocoa , baking soda , and salt in a large bowl
4. Mix oil , vinegar , and vanilla
5. Stir oil mixture and water into flour mixture until well blended , about one minute
6. Immediately pour batter into pans , dividing evenly
7. Bake about 35 minutes , until toothpick insterted in center comes out clean
8. Let cool 10 minutes
9. Remove from pans , let cool completely , and frost
10. Stack the two rounds together to make a double-layer cake

title: lemon sauce    salsa di limone
steps:
1. Put the lemon segments , sugar or honey , salt and pepper in a food processor or blender , pulse to a coarse consistency
2. Pour the olive oil in and whirl until the mixture is almost smooth
3. Leave a little texture
4. Transfer the sauce to a jar and store in the refrigerator

title: welsh whole chicken stew  ffowlin cymreig
steps:
1. Wash a 4 to 5 pound chicken
2. Twist wing
3. Or if wings
4. Pat dry and rub about 1 / 2 teaspoon salt in body cavity
5. Dice the bacon and fry until crisp and brown in a dutch oven or heavy , deep frying pan
6. Brown the chicken in the hot drippings , turning to brown sides , breast , and back
7. Brown giblets , if desired , or save for another use
8. Sprinkle with another 1 / 2 teaspoon salt while browning
9. Remove chicken from pan
10. Clean and slice leeks very thin , using just a small portion of the green tops
11. Add to bacon bits along with diced carrots
12. Cook until lightly browned
13. Stir in flour and brown lightly
14. Add coarsely chopped cabbage , remaining 1 / 2 to 1 teaspoon salt , and pepper
15. Stir to mix thoroughly and when cabbage is slightly wilted , add chicken stock
16. Cook , stirring frequently , until simmering
17. Add chopped parsley
18. Crush fines herbes and stir into vegetables
19. When stew is simmering gently , arrange chicken on top
20. Cover and simmer very slowly until chicken is tender , 1 to 2 hours depending on its tenderness
21. Turn chicken several times and spoon sauce over it occasionally
22. To serve , cut slices from breast and cut legs , thighs , and wings into pieces
23. Arrange chicken pieces on beds of vegetables
24. Serve with potato cakes and spoon the broth over vegetables , chicken , and potato cakes
25. Makes 4 servings , perhaps with some leftovers
26. Soups and stews the world over

title: almond stuffed dates
steps:
1. Carefully remove the pits from the dates , replacing each one with a whole almond
2. Pour the honey into a heavy saucepan and place it on low heat
3. When the honey is liquid , add the cinnamon and pepper
4. Stir well
5. Put the stuffed dates in the honey and stir gently to coat
6. Leave on very low heat for 5 minutes until the dates are hot
7. Watch the sauce so that it doesn't boil or even simmer
8. Serve warm , or let cool and eat
9. Enjoy !

title: luscious key lime pie martini
steps:
1. Fill martini glass with ice and water to chill , then dump --
2. Rim martini glass with lime juice and dip in graham cracker crumbs
3. Mix vodka , vanilla liqueur , cream and lime juice in a shaker cup
4. Shake , shake , shake !
5. Strain into chilled martini glass and enjoy !

title: bacon roasted chicken with stuffing
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350'
2. Wash and prepare whole chicken , drain excess water off chicken
3. Mix together melted butter and salt , black pepper , paprika , thyme and old bay seasoning and brush over the chicken
4. Place in a roasted pan and set aside
5. In a large sauce pan add bacon pieces and butter , begin to fry pieces and add onion and celery
6. Saute lightly
7. Add minced garlic and stir to combine
8. When onion has turn lightly brown add chicken broth and herb stuffing
9. Stir well
10. Add salt , pepper and poultry seasoning and let simmer til mixture is not completely dry
11. Turn into a bowl and stir in egg and evaporated milk
12. Add stuffing to the cavity of the whole chicken
13. Add 3-4 slices across top of the whole chicken and place in oven and bake 2hrs or until done
14. After a hour cover with foil to reframe from over browning
15. The last 20 minutes uncover chicken and let brown alittle more

title: custard low carb
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f
2. In the saucepan , combine cream , vanilla syrup , vanilla , and splenda
3. Bring to a bare simmer over medium-low heat
4. Separate 3 of the eggs
5. In a mixing bowl , combine the remaining whole eggs and the yolks
6. Whip the eggs with a whisk until slightly thickened and lightened in color
7. While whisking the eggs , drizzle in about a quarter of the hot milk
8. Now whisk the tempered eggs back into the saucepan with the remaining milk mixture
9. Place a fine mesh strainer over a glass or stainless steel bowl with a spout
10. Pour the egg mixture through the strainer in order to catch any curdled egg bits or particles that may be in the mixture
11. Place the custard cups into the roasting pan
12. Place the pan on the middle rack of the oven and pour boiling water into the pan just under the level of the custard
13. Cook the custard for about 40 min , or until they wobble slightly when the pan is wiggled
14. You can also insert a paring knife midway between the edge and the center
15. If it comes out clean , the flans are done
16. Using tongs , remove the cups from the pan to a towel-lined sheet pan
17. Cool , cover and chill

title: gandolfos potato salad
steps:
1. Cook potatoes in boiling , salted water to cover 14 to 15 minutes or until tender
2. Drain potatoes and cool to touch
3. Cut potatoes into quarters or eighths , leaving skins on
4. Place in large bowl
5. Add crumbled bacon to potatoes
6. Combine mayonnaise and next 6 ingredients in a small bowl
7. Add to potato and bacon mixture and toss gently
8. Serve immediately or cover and chill up to 8 hours
9. Garnish if desired

title: ultimate tempura batter
steps:
1. In a large bowl place the egg yolks
2. Add iced water gradually , stirring (preferably with hashi) and blending well
3. Add flour all at once , stir briefly
4. That is well enough to coat but leave the lumps and bumps !
5. To fry vegetables heat a large frying pan with a half-inch oil and heat on high
6. Coat selected large vegetables in batter and fry for a minute or two on each side

title: pork tenderloin with chimichurri
steps:
1. Combine the garlic , jalapeno , vinegar , parsley , oregano & lime juice in a bowl
2. Whisk in the olive oil & season with salt and pepper
3. Mix well & set aside at room temperature to marry
4. Reserve 1 / 2 cup of the chimichurri to serve with the pork & pour the remaining into a ziploc bag with the pork tenderloins
5. Marinate in the refrigerator for 30 minutes
6. Remove pork from marinade & wipe off any excess
7. Season both sides with a generous amount of salt & pepper and drizzle with olive oil
8. Grill for about 4 minutes per side , until well charred
9. Allow the tenderloins to rest for about 5 minutes prior to slicing
10. Spoon some chimichurri over the meat , drizzle with lime juice and serve !

title: peach brandy
steps:
1. Use only fully ripened , unblemished fruit
2. Wash and remove pits
3. Chop and mash fruit
4. Place in a plastic container or large glass bottle
5. Dissolve sugar in the vodka or brandy
6. Pour over the fruit
7. Cover and let sit in a cool dark place for 4 to 6 months
8. Strain out the fruit and bottle
9. Your peach brandy is ready to drink !

title: mimi s shortcake
steps:
1. Shortcake:
2. In a large bowl whisk together the flour , sugar , baking powder , and salt
3. Cube the cold butter and put in the flour bowl
4. With a pastry blender or two knives , cut the butter into small pieces
5. Mixture should look like coarse crumbs
6. In a small bowl mix the egg , vanilla , and cream
7. Whisk well
8. Add to flour mixture mixing just until the dough comes together
9. Don't overmix
10. Put on a lightly floured surface and pat into a 7" circle
11. Cut with a circle cutter to about 1" thick
12. Put on ungreased baking sheet
13. Egg wash:
14. In a small bowl mix the ingredients for the egg wash and brush on the top of each shortcake
15. Bake in a 400 degree oven on a center rack for 15-18 minutes or till a toothpick put in the center comes out clean
16. Transfer to wire rack

title: coconut chicken   potatoes
steps:
1. Cut potatoes into cubes
2. Rinse
3. Place all ingredients in pan
4. Add chili powder , garlic powder and tumeric to taste
5. Cover & simmer over low heat until chicken is cooked through

title: irish whiskey fruitcake
steps:
1. Grease a 9x5x3-inch loaf pan
2. Mix flour , baking powder , cinnamon , mace and cloves
3. Cream butter with brown sugar until fluffy / light in a large bowl
4. Beat in eggs one at a time
5. Stir in apricots and whiskey
6. Stir in flour mixture until blended , then raisins , mixed fruit , pecans and cherries
7. Spoon into prepared pan
8. Spread top evenly
9. Bake at 300 degrees for 2 hours or till wooden pick comes out clean
10. Cool completely in pan on wire rack
11. Loosen cooled cake around the edges with a knife
12. Turn out onto rack
13. Wrap in cheesecloth , pour some irish whiskey over it every few days , and let age for two to four weeks
14. Overwrap the cheesecloth with foil
15. Keep in the refrigerator

title: baked beans  4 ingredients
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients
2. Bake 1 hour at 350 degrees

title: tangy lemon rice with peanuts
steps:
1. Heat oil in a frying pan on medium heat and add mustard seeds and urad dal
2. When mustard starts to splutter , add turmeric powder , chopped chilli , asafoetida , and peanuts
3. Saute for about 2 minutes
4. Then add cooked rice and salt and saute for another 5 minutes
5. Remove from flame , add lemon juice and mix well
6. Garnish with chopped corriander and serve !

title: cheese stuffed steaks
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375
2. Cut steaks in half , making a pouch
3. Mix cheeses and herbs in a bowl
4. Stuff cheese mixture in steaks
5. Wrap steaks in foil and bake for 1 hour and 15 minute or until done
6. Turn once during cook time and let stand for 5 minute after cooking

title: garlicky french fries
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Combine first 3 ingredients in a large zip-top plastic bag , tossing to coat
3. Arrange potatoes in a single layer on a baking sheet coated with cooking spray
4. Bake at 400 for 20 minutes or until potatoes are tender and golden brown , turning after 10 minutes
5. Place butter and garlic in a large nonstick skillet
6. Cook over low heat 2 minutes , stirring constantly
7. Add potatoes , parsley , and cheese to pan
8. Toss to coat
9. Serve immediately

title: snow top meatloaf
steps:
1. Soak bread crumbs in milk
2. Combine ground beef , eggs , onions , salt , pepper and sage
3. Mix crumbs and beef mix well
4. Bake in 8x8 or 9x9 pan at 350 degrees for one hour
5. Drain well
6. Add favorite mashed potato recipe on top of meatloaf
7. Return to oven for 10-15 minutes our until heated good

title: iced hazelnut coffee chiller
steps:
1. In a medium bowl stir in coffee , creamer , sugar water and cinnamon unil coffee is dissolved
2. Pour coffee mixture into 2 ice trays freeze until hardened
3. Transer coffee cubes to a freezer bag
4. For each serving place 2 coffee cubes
5. 2 / 3 cup milk and 4 water ice cubes in a blender
6. Blend unti slushy and top with whipped cream

title: creamy chocolate pudding ii
steps:
1. Combine sugar , cocoa , cornstarch and salt in a medium saucepan
2. Add evaporated milk and water
3. Whisk to blend
4. Cook over medium heat , stirring constantly , for about 7 minutes or until pudding thickens
5. Remove from heat
6. Stir in butter and vanilla extract
7. Serve warm or cold

title: chicken catch a cola
steps:
1. Combine the bread crumbs , paprika , salt , and pepper in a plastic bag
2. Place chicken breasts in the bag , and shake to coat
3. Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat
4. Add chicken breasts , and cook for 4 minutes on each side , or until brown
5. Remove chicken to a plate , and keep warm
6. Pour the cola into the skillet , and stir to remove any browned chicken bits from the pan
7. Add ham , mushrooms , sherry , and balsamic vinegar
8. Reduce heat to medium-low , and simmer , uncovered , until the liquid has reduced by 1 / 2
9. Stir sour cream into the skillet , and return chicken breasts to the pan
10. Cover , and simmer for 5 more minutes , or until chicken is no longer pink , or the internal temperature is 170 degrees f
11. Remove chicken to serving plates , and spoon sauce over

title: steak kew
steps:
1. Cut steak into 1 1 / 2" cubes
2. Toss with minced garlic , ginger , and scallions
3. Let stand 15 minutes
4. Meanwhile , soak black mushrooms in 1 / 3 cup warm water until soft , about 10 minutes
5. Drain , reserving water for sauce
6. Remove and discard stems
7. Bring a medium saucepan of salted water to a boil
8. Add snow peas and cook until bright green , about 2 seconds
9. Drain and rinse under cold running water
10. In a small bowl , combine oyster sauce , soy sauce , sugar , cornstarch , and reserved water from mushrooms
11. Blend thoroughly
12. Set sauce aside
13. In a wok , heat oil over high heat until smoking
14. Add beef cubes and stir fry until lightly browned outside but still rare inside , 2 to 3 minutes
15. Add mushrooms , snow peas , and sauce mixture
16. Return to a boil and cook , tossing to mix well , until sauce thickens , 1-2 minutes
17. Remove from heat and serve

title: venus de milo new england lobster casserole
steps:
1. Heat the milk in a heavy saucepan over a medium heat until the milk just starts to simmer
2. In a separate saucepan melt the butter and saut the onions until they become transparent
3. Add the flour to the butter and onion mixture making a roux and continue to cook for a bout a minute
4. Slowly add the hot milk to the roux while whisking until all the milk is incorporated into the sauce
5. Add the prepared mustard , parsley flakes , lea & perrins , tabasco sauce , and curry powder and simmer over a low fire for about 10 minutes
6. Add the white wine and simmer for an additional 10 minutes
7. Adjust seasoning with salt and pepper and remove from heat
8. Place the lobster chunks in a mixing bowl and add the hot sauce and mix until a nice blend is achieved
9. Place this mixture into an appropriate sized casserole or 4 individual ceramic bakers
10. Top with ritz cracker topping and bake in a 375 oven for approximately 20 minutes or until the sauce begins to bubble at the center of the casserole
11. Remove the casserole from the oven and brown the top under the broiler if desired
12. Serve at once

title: quick chicken wrap up for one
steps:
1. Place deli meat on tortilla
2. Arrange mushrooms on top
3. Sprinkle cheese over all
4. Microwave 30 seconds or until cheese starts to melt and tortilla is warm
5. Roll up and enjoy !

title: thai style warm chicken salad with chilli  mint   lime
steps:
1. Heat the grill
2. Brush the chicken with vegetable oil and grill until cooked through
3. Let it rest for five minutes and then slice thinly
4. For the dressing , whisk the lime juice , fish sauce , sesame oil , and sugar until the sugar dissolves
5. Add the sliced shallots , chilli and spring onions and toss together
6. Tear the mint and coriander leaves and lightly toss with the chicken , salt and pepper
7. At the last minute , add the dressing to the chicken and toss lightly
8. Arrange it on plates , scatter with peanuts and serve with lime wedges

title: favourite meat rub
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in a blender and puree
2. This rub will keep in the fridge for up to 3 weeks
3. Rub over lamb beef , or chicken before cooking
4. It is great on whole legs of lamb or sirlions
5. Although i have put in the yield , i have never measured this , i just use it till it has all gone
6. Sorry- i will try to check next time

title: laurel s kitchen vanilla pudding
steps:
1. Gently heat 1 1 / 2 cup of the milk in a saucepan or double boiler on medium heat
2. Once the milk is very hot but not boiling , stir in the brown sugar and salt
3. Whisk together the arrowroot and the remaining milk
4. Add to the saucepan , cooking and stirring constantly over low to medium-low heat until the mixture starts to thickens
5. Be careful not to burn or scorch the pudding !
6. In a small heatproof bowl , whisk the egg then gently pour in about 1 cup of the pudding mixture
7. Whisk quickly to incorporate and to avoid curdling the egg
8. Add this mixture back to the saucepan and continue stirring constantly until mixture is thickened
9. Once thickened , turn off heat and set the pan aside to cool about 15 minutes
10. Stir in the vanilla extract
11. If desired , top the pudding with toasted nuts for garnish
12. Serve warm or cold

title: crock pot lemon garlic chicken
steps:
1. Skin and cut up chicken
2. Combine with other ingredients in crock pot
3. Cook on low for 6-7 hours
4. Debone chicken before serving
5. Serve over rice
6. And if you start with frozen chicken it doesn't fall apart

title: pot roasted italian chicken  no tomatoes     beginner s directio
steps:
1. Unpackage and prep a roasting chicken or stew hen (take off the plastic , remove the giblets and neck from inside , look over the skin and pluck any feathers with a washed pair of needlenose pliers , singe off any pinfeathers with a grill lighter , drain excess liquid from the cavity)
2. Set it into a small roaster or dutch oven that has a secure lid
3. Sprinkle half the italian seasoning and half the garlic slivers over the chicken
4. Put the other half of the seasonings into the cavity
5. Put half the liquids into the cavity and pour half over the chicken
6. You want to wash some but not all of the seasonings into the pan
7. Cover and roast at 300 for 2-3 hours or at 250 for 3 hours
8. You can remove the lid for the last half hour or so to get better browning
9. The meat will be very tender -- falling off the bones
10. Suggestion -- serve over pasta and pass parmesan at the table
11. Suggestion -- complete the meal with grilled zuccini , breaded and fried zuccini , or flat , italian beans that have been steamed or microwaved and some crusty , italian bread

title: vermicelli and paprika soup  dweda zaara
steps:
1. Heat oil in a saucepan and saute onion over medium heat for 10 minutes
2. Add garlic , paprika , hreesa , turmeric , and bay leaves and saute a few minutes more
3. Stir in remaining ingredients
4. Bring to a boil
5. Cook over medium heat for 5 minutes
6. Then stir in vermicelli
7. Cover and cook for another 15 minutes
8. Then stir in cilantro and serve immediately

title: baked parmesan crusted chicken breast
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400 degrees f
2. Spray baking pan with non-stick cooking spray
3. Combine all dry ingredients minus the butter
4. Dip chicken in butter then coat with combined dry ingredients
5. Place in prepared pan
6. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until tender

title: buttermilk carrot cake with glaze
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Combine first five ingredients in medium bowl
3. Stir together buttermilk , eggs , oil , and vanilla in large bowl
4. Add dry ingredients and stir until well blended
5. Mix in carrots and walnuts
6. Pour batter into 9x13 glass oven proof baking dish
7. I also use 9 inch square cake pans with good luck
8. Bake 45 minutes or until tester inserted in center comes out clean
9. Cool then drizzle with hot buttermilk glaze
10. Buttermilk glaze instructions:
11. Combine first five ingredients in heavy medium sauce pan
12. Bring to boil over medium heat , stirring frequently
13. Boil until slightly thickened , about five minutes
14. Remove from heat
15. Stir in vanilla
16. Pour over cake immediately
17. Cool slightly before serving
18. Makes 1 1 / 4 cups glaze

title: kttbullar  swedish meatballs  ikea style
steps:
1. In a skillet , melt 2 tbsp butter , heating until melted and just starting to brown
2. Add onion to skillet , saute until onion is golden
3. To the bread crumbs , add 2 tbsp milk to moisten
4. In a large bowl , combine beef , pork , egg
5. Add onion , mashed potatoes , and moistened breadcrumbs
6. Add spices
7. Add remaining milk a little at a time
8. Stop before the mixture gets gloppy
9. If the meat mixture gets too gooey to form nice , neat meatballs , add a more breadcrumbs
10. Use a pair of spoons rinsed in water and shape the meat mixture into small round balls
11. In a large skillet , heat remaining butter over medium heat
12. Add meatballs to skillet , being careful not to crowd the pan
13. Shake periodically so that the meatballs don't develop flat spots
14. Cook until meatballs are done through

title: mango and port chutney
steps:
1. Combine ingredients in a large heavy-base saucepan
2. Stir over heat without boiling
3. Until sugar dissolves
4. Simmer uncovered , stirring occasionally , about 1-1 / 2 hours , or until mixture thickens
5. Spoon hot chutney into hot sterilised hars
6. Seal while hot
7. Storage- in cool , dark place for about 6 months , refrigerate after opening

title: fresh apple and parsley dressing with greens
steps:
1. Combine apple , vinegar , hot sauce , scallion , parsley , salt , and pepper in blender
2. Pulse , scraping down blender jar and adding water as needed , until very finely chopped
3. With machine running , gradually add oil , scraping down blender jar as needed
4. To serve four , toss greens with 4 tablespoons dressing
5. Serve imediately

title: kicked up pimento cheese
steps:
1. Grate the cheddar cheese
2. Break up cream cheese in to small pieces
3. Drain the pimentos and chop
4. Chop the chipolte pepper
5. Put all these ingredients and add 1 / 2 cup of mayonnaise to a food processor and process until mixture is smooth and of consistent texture
6. Add additional 1 / 4 cup of mayonnaise if necessary
7. Remove from processor and store in an airtight container in the refrigerator

title: paleo chocolate chip coconut cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Cream butter , stevia , and vanilla
3. Add almond flour , baking soda , salt , and cocoa
4. Carefully mix
5. Mix in chocolate chips and coconut
6. Drop by rounded tablespoons and flatten or shape as you wish , these cookies do not spread
7. Bake for 10-12 minutes and allow to cool on sheet for 2 minutes

title: harbour tunnel
steps: 1. Mix in a tumbler and enjoy !

title: salmon on the grill
steps:
1. Take a piece of tin foil , 2 times the size of the fish , and flatten it out on the table
2. Put the salmon on it , skin side down
3. Dot with butter
4. Sprinkle with parsley
5. Fold up tin foil the long way first , so it has a straight edge , 1 / 2" overlap at the center top
6. Then roll up the short sides to keep the butter in
7. This allows air to escape , and turns the tin foil into a little oven
8. Place wrapped fish on very low flames on grill for 22-25 minutes per pound
9. After proper amount of cooking time has passed , place wrapped fish on platter
10. Unwrap foil
11. Salmon skin will stick to the tin foil , serve with a spatula , leaving the skin on the foil
12. Toss foil , and enjoy !

title: pickled lemon slices
steps:
1. Mix the lemon juice , pickling spices , salt and sugar in a pot
2. Bring to a boil , and let cook to about body temp
3. Add the lemon slices to a largish tupperware container , and pour the brine over them
4. Refrigerate one week

title: banana oatmeal mini muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Spray mini muffin tins with non-stick spray
3. Combine all dry ingredients in a large bowl
4. In a smaller bowl , combine banana , yogurt , oil , vanilla , and egg , and stir well
5. Add wet ingredients to dry , stirring gently just until fully moistened
6. Fill each muffin tin with an ever-so-slightly heaping tablespoon of batter
7. Bake 10-12 minutes
8. Alternatives: 8x8 square pan bake 30-35 minutes until toothpick in the center comes out clean
9. Loaf pan bake 50-55 minutes until toothpick in the center comes out clean
10. Cool thoroughly
11. Read more about www
12. Azcentral
13. Com white whole wheat flour

title: chickpeas with spinach  garbanzos con espinacas
steps:
1. Cook the spinach in a dry skillet over moderate heat with just the water that clings to the leaves until the spinach is tender and dry
2. Set aside
3. In the same skillet , heat half the oil and fry the garlic and bread until both are golden brown
4. Transfer to an electric blender or food processor , add the spices , salt , and pepper , and process until smooth
5. Heat the remaining oil in the skillet and saute the garlic mixture until it forms a thick sauce - add a little water if necessary
6. Stir in the reserved spinach and chickpeas and heat through
7. Serve hot or at room temperature

title: i want candy
steps:
1. In a large shaker filled with ice add ingredients shake till icy cold
2. Pour into shot glasses to have as shooter or into a tall glass filled with ice garnished with a lime slice
3. Top with a touch of grenadine for color
4. Enjoy !

title: thai style burgers
steps:
1. 1
2. Prepare a medium hot fire on your grill
3. 2
4. Combine beef , peanut butter , sour cream , soy sauce , lime juice , cilantro , ginger , brown sugar , red pepper , salt and black pepper in a large bowl , blending well with your hands
5. Shape into 6 patties 1 / 2 inch to 3 / 4 inch thick
6. 3
7. Place directly over coals , cover and grill to your desired degree of doneness , 5-7 minutes for medium rare
8. 4
9. Place burgers on buns and top with lettuce tomatoes and onions and bbq sauce
10. Chef
11. Enjoy !

title: roasted onion wedges
steps:
1. Place onions in a baking dish coated with cooking spray
2. Combine remaining ingredients and drizzle over onions , coating evenly
3. Cover dish with foil or lid and bake at 450 for 25 minute uncover dish , baste onions , and bake uncovered for 25 min more or til tender and browned

title: old dominion spoon bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Spray 9x9-inch baking dish with non-stick cooking spray
3. Place cornmeal in pot
4. Pour boiling water over cornmeal , stirring to moisten
5. Cook cornmeal over low heat for 5 minutes stirring frequently , to form a "mush"
6. Add salt , baking powder , baking soda , eggs , and buttermilk
7. Stir to mix well
8. When you add baking soda and baking powder , this mixture will foam up , so be sure to use a larger pot than you think you'll need
9. Immediately pour batter into prepared 1-1 / 2 quart casserole casserole
10. Bake 50-60 minutes or until set in the middle and lightly browned on top

title: indiana style meatloaf
steps:
1. Preheat over to 375 degrees
2. Set the 1 / 3 cup of ketchup , potatoes and water to the side
3. Throw everything else into a bowl and mix
4. Form into a loaf in a 13 x 9 baking dish
5. Cut up the potatoes into large pieces and add around the loaf
6. Add water to pan
7. Slather 1 / 3 cup ketchup on top of loaf
8. Bake for 1 - 1 1 / 2 hours

title: steak with parmesan butter  balsamic glaze  and arugula
steps:
1. Mix grated cheese and butter in small bowl
2. Season generously with salt and pepper
3. Set aside
4. Sprinkle steak generously with salt and pepper
5. Heat oil in medium skillet over medium-high heat
6. Add steak
7. Cook to desired doneness , about 4 minutes per side for medium-rare
8. Transfer to plate
9. Add vinegar , shallots , and sugar to skillet
10. Boil until reduced to glaze , stirring constantly , about 1 minute
11. Divide arugula and parmesan shavings between 2 plates
12. Squeeze lemon over
13. Slice steak
14. Place atop arugula
15. Top steak with parmesan butter
16. Drizzle lightly with glaze

title: cod and veggies casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f degrees
2. Spray medium size casserole with veggie spray
3. Sprinkle both sides of cod with half of the salt and pepper and place in casserole
4. Place tomato slices on top of cod and sprinkle with peppers and onion
5. Sprinkle cajun spice mix over if using
6. Top with asparagus spears
7. Sprinkle chopped leek over
8. Sprinkle with the other half of the salt and pepper
9. Spray well with veggies spray
10. Cover and bake on middle rack of oven for approximately 25 minutes or until fish flakes easily with fork
11. Garnish with fresh parsley

title: mushroom green bean casserole
steps:
1. In a skillet , saute mushrooms and onions in butter until tender
2. Stir in flour until well blended
3. Gradually stir in cream
4. Bring to a boil , then cook and stir for 2 minutes
5. Stir in the cheese sauce , soy sauce , pepper , and hot pepper sauce until the cheese is melted
6. Stir in green beans
7. Pour into an ungreased 13 x 9 baking dish
8. Bake uncovered at 375 degrees for 25-30 minutes or until bubbly

title: rooibos smoothy
steps: 1. Combine in blender until smooth

title: slow cooker picnic ham
steps:
1. Trim thick skin , and fat off ham
2. Spread about 1 1 / 2 cups of brown sugar on the bottom off the slow cooker crock
3. Place the ham flat side down into slow cooker
4. Rub remaining brown sugar onto top of ham
5. Cover , and cook on low for 6-8 hours

title: plokkfiskur from iceland
steps:
1. Skin , bone & break up the fish into flakes
2. Roughly chop potatoes & finely chop onion
3. Slowly heat milk in a saucepan almost to a boiling point
4. In a med to lrg sized non-stick saucepan , melt butter & saute onion over med-heat till soft
5. Do not allow it to brown
6. Sprinkle flour over onion , stir well & cook for 1-2 minutes
7. Gradually add warmed milk , stirring continuously
8. Simmer for 3-4 min , stirring often
9. Add flaked fish & stir briskly to break up the fish flakes completely
10. Season liberally w / salt & pepper
11. Add potatoes & stir gently
12. Cook over low-heat till heated through
13. Spoon into 4 bowls & sprinkle ea serving with 1 / 2 tbsp chives
14. Serve hot w / dark rye bread & butter
15. Update: i have made this recipe now & it actually comes together faster than the time stated , esp w / the fish & potatoes cooked well-ahead & just heated in the cream sauce
16. Pls take season liberally to heart
17. I used mccormick lemon pepper & seasoning salt liberally in the prep , we added more at the table & it was perfect w / this !

title: igor s cholent  a guy version that even a woman likes
steps:
1. Soak all beans and barley overnight
2. Drain well
3. Layer 1 / 2 of the bean barley mixture at the bottom of an 18 quart electric roaster
4. Top with 1 / 2 of the meat , then 1 / 2 of the onions
5. Sprinkle 1 / 2 of the spice mixture on top
6. Top with 1 / 2 of the potatoes
7. Repeat with the second half of each of those components
8. Top with ketchup
9. Add kishke , if using it , and chili powder
10. Add water to cover , and cook at 270f from thursday night to saturday noon , or at 300f from friday afternoon to saturday noon

title: honey orange cornish game hens
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. Mix together salt , basil and allspice
3. Sprinkle mixture inside and outside of cornish hens
4. Place 1 / 4 orange in each hen and place them in a roasting pan
5. Add water to pan
6. Over low heat , simmer together honey , butter and orange juice concentrate until thickened
7. Drizzle about half the mixture over cornish hens and roast uncovered for about 25 minutes
8. Roast for another 25 minutes or until juices run clear and hens are not pink inside , basting with the rest of the honey-orange sauce after 10 minutes

title: julie s creamed spinach
steps:
1. Thaw spinach and squeeze water out
2. Over medium-high heat , melt butter and sautee onion until translucent
3. Add flour and stir for a minute or two until just slightly browned
4. Add cream , a little at a time , continually stirring
5. When thickened , turn heat down to low
6. In a coffee cup , add boiling water to chicken bouillon to dissolve it
7. Then add that to the white sauce along with the salt , pepper and nutmeg
8. Add spinach , cover and heat a few more minutes until spinach is hot

title: my favorite french onion soup
steps:
1. To prepare the soup and toast:
2. Place a heavy based large pot over a moderate heat
3. Drizzle the olive oil into the hot pot and add the onions
4. Cook the onions for 1 hour or until they are golden , stirring often
5. Once the onions become very soft they will begin to stick to the bottom of the pot and turn a caramel brown color
6. As this occurs , scrape the browned onions from the bottom of the pot and stir them into the remaining onion mixture
7. Add the garlic , thyme and bay leaf to the onions and cook for 5 minutes or until the garlic softens
8. Add the red wine and sherry and stir to scrape up any browned bits on the bottom of the pan
9. Simmer for 5 minutes or until the liquids reduce by half
10. Add the stock and bring the soup to a gentle simmer , skimming any foam that rises to the top , if necessary
11. Season the soup lightly with salt and pepper
12. Add just a bit of salt and pepper here , but not too much since the soup will reduce as it simmers and the flavors will become more concentrated
13. Allow the soup to simmer uncovered for 25 minutes
14. Season the soup to taste with salt and pepper
15. Meanwhile , preheat the broiler on high
16. Arrange the sourdough bread slices on a baking sheet and broil for 2 minutes or until golden brown on top
17. Divide the soup among 6 high sided ovenproof serving bowls
18. Place the bowls of soup on a heavy baking sheet
19. Place one bread slice , toasted side down , on top of each bowl of soup
20. Divide the cheese among the soup bowls and sprinkle with parsley
21. Place the soup bowls under the broiler for about 3 minutes or until the cheese melts and is golden brown
22. Remove from the broiler and serve

title: perfect christmas turkey
steps:
1. Bring salt , water , thyme and berries to a simmer in a large pot , then set aside to cool
2. Put turkey in a large basin , at least twice as large as the bird
3. Pour the brine over the turkey , cover , and rset aside in a cool dark place for 12 hours
4. Preheat oven to 150c put the turkey in a large baking dish , on a rack , drizzle with oil and bake for 40 minutes
5. Bring stock , sage , butter , and peppercorns to the boil and baste the turkey
6. Bake for 45 minutes , basting every 20 minutes
7. Turn the oven up to 220c and bake for a further 10 minutes
8. Remove turkey from oven , cover with foil and a towel , and rest for 15 minutes

title: diet low cal low fat super salad dressing
steps:
1. Put the 2 tablespoons of fat free mayo and the mustard into a container and blend with a fork
2. Add 2 tablespoons of water and blend again
3. It may seem runny at first , but just stir a little more -- the mayo , since it is fat-free , will emulsify with water instead of oil ! add more or less mustard , water or mayo until you get a consistency and flavor you like
4. You can certainly also make a bigger batch
5. I use more like 6t of mayo , 3 tsp of mustard and add water in increments until it is runny enough

title: kabocha spinach soup
steps:
1. Bring kabocha squash , onion , and garlic to a boil in 4 cups of water or stock
2. Simmer at a low boil until squash is completely soft , about 15 minutes
3. Mash the squash , onion , and garlic with a potato masher in the soup pot
4. Add the spinach and cook for just a couple more minutes
5. Season to taste with sea salt and pepper
6. Garnish with organic sour cream , mozzarella cheese , or crumbled feta
7. Serve with a thick slice of crusty bread for a warm , satisfying meal

title: mandarin martini
steps:
1. Fill a cocktail shaker with ice
2. Pour in the orange juice , vodka and liqueur and shake well until chilled
3. Serve in a large martini glass
4. Float 1 or 2 edible flowers in the drink for garnish , if using

title: guatemala   rellenitos de platano
steps:
1. Place the plantains in a large pot and cover with water
2. Bring to a boil , then reduce heat and simmer until tender , 15 minutes , then drain and mash
3. In a small saucepan over low heat , heat the refried beans and stir in the sugar and salt , mix well then remove from heat
4. To make the rellenitos , form a palm-sized amount of mashed plantains into a ball
5. Flatten and place about a teaspoon of the bean mixture in the middle
6. Then mold the sides of the plantain around the beans , making an egg-shaped ball
7. Heat oil in a deep-fryer or large skillet to 375 degrees f or until a small amount of batter sizzles and browns in the oil
8. Fry rellenitos in oil until browned and drain on paper towels
9. Enjoy plain , with sugar or with sour cream

title: raspberry streusel bars  cookie mix
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f
2. Spray bottom of 8-inch square pan with cooking spray
3. In large bowl , stir cookie mix , butter , flour , almond extract and egg until soft dough forms
4. Press half of dough into bottom of pan
5. Bake 15 minutes
6. Spread jam over base
7. Crumble remaining dough over jam
8. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown
9. Cool completely , about 2 hours
10. For bars , cut into 5 rows by 5 rows

title: citrusy meat marinade
steps:
1. In a large resealable bag or "marinade container" combine all the ingredients well
2. Add meat to marinade , seal bag or container and refrigerate a minimum of 4 hours or overnight - turn over a few times to coat
3. Coat your grilling rack or pan with non-stick cooking spray before grilling
4. Drain and discard marinade from meat - do not use as a baste !

title: asian roasted asparagus
steps:
1. Pre heat oven to 425 degrees f
2. Lay trimmed asparagus in a rimmed baking sheet
3. Spread out
4. Drizzle other ingredients evenly over asparagus ,
5. Roast in oven for approximately 20 minutes until asparagus are hot , slightly browned , but still somewhat crisp
6. Check periodically

title: chicken fried steak for two
steps:
1. On a plate , mix bread crumbs with salt and pepper
2. Dip steak in beaten egg , then bread crumbs
3. Heat oil in heavy skillet and add meat
4. Brown over low heat until done
5. Place on warm platter and keep hot
6. Make a gravy by adding flour to pan drippings
7. Stir over mediun heat until light brown
8. With a whisk , stirring constantly , stir in milk until desired thickness
9. Add salt and pepper to taste
10. You can return steak to pan and simmer or you can spoon the gravy over the steak when served

title: absolutely easy apple cake
steps:
1. Mix together first seven ingredients in mixer
2. Mix 2 minutes at medium speed
3. Fold in chopped nuts
4. Coat bundt pan with cooking spray and flour
5. Bake at 350 degrees 35-40 minutes
6. Insert toothpick to check for doneness
7. Cool 5 mins in pan , invert to plate
8. Cool , dust with powered sugar

title: savory cheese   herb biscuits
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 f degrees
2. Lightly grease an oven baking sheet with olive oil
3. In a large mixing bowl , add both flours , baking powder , italian herb seasoning mix , salt , baking soda and pepper
4. Stir with a fork until well mixed
5. Cut in butter using a pastry blender or a fork until pastry resembles coarse crumbs
6. Stir in parmesan cheese and cheddar cheese
7. Gently fold in buttermilk until well blended
8. Gather dough into a ball
9. On a lightly floured surface , gently knead dough 8 to 10 times
10. Dough will be slightly sticky
11. Roll out dough into a circle about 1 / 2 inch thick
12. Using a 1 1 / 2 inch cookie cutter , punch out dough
13. Place on greased cookie sheet about 1 / 2 inch apart
14. Gather up scraps of dough and re-roll and cut out remaining biscuits
15. Place on prepared baking sheet
16. Bake in preheated 425 f oven for 12 to 15 minutes or until golden brown
17. Serve biscuits hot with butter
18. If you prefer bite-size biscuits , then use a 1 1 / 4 inch cutter or make your own using the top of a spray can , there are many varieties of sprays to choose from
19. Just cut part of the top off so that you can clean easier
20. When cutting , dip the cutter into flour each time

title: elegant sweet potato skins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Roast potatoes in the oven for 30-45 minutes until they are fully cooked , but not very soft
3. Cool
4. Halve potatoes and scoop out as much flesh as you can without tearing outer skin
5. Reserve the inside flesh for another use
6. Brush cavities of the potato skins with butter , and season to taste with salt and pepper
7. Heat oven to broil
8. Broil the seasoned skins for 5-10 minutes , until they crisp up , being careful not to burn
9. Top hot skins with 1 ounce of brie and some of the chopped nuts
10. Return to broiler for a few minutes to allow cheese to soften and get hot
11. Garnish with fresh chives if desired , and serve

title: keg s mushroom neptune
steps:
1. Combine all 8 ingredients
2. Mix well until blended and fill mushroom caps
3. Bake at 375f for 15 minutes or until slightly browned

title: four ingredients chicken pot pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 f
2. Roll out dough and divide in half
3. Press half the dough into a buttered 9"pie plate
4. Combine remaining ingredients in a bowl and pour into crust
5. Cover with remaining dough , crimping edges under to seal
6. Cut several slits in top of pie
7. Bake about 30 minutes or until top is well browned

title: crockpot mexican chicken
steps:
1. Put some salsa on the bottom of the crockpot , put 2 chicken breasts down and sprinkle the taco seasoning on them
2. Soften the cream cheese and stir it with the remaining salsa and pour over the chicken
3. Then put the chili beans on top
