4. Cook on low for 8 hours or cook on high for 3-4 hours
5. You can stir as you like
6. Serve over rice

title: french silk chocolate pie
steps:
1. Crust
2. Sift together flour , sugar , and salt
3. Mix milk into oil
4. Add oil / milk to flour mixture with fork
5. Press into 9 in pie tin
6. Bake at 475 deg for 7-10 minutes
7. Set aside to cool
8. Filling
9. Melt chocolate chips
10. Cream butter , sugar , salt , and vanilla
11. Beat to fluffy
12. Add chocolate
13. Add eggs one at a time
14. Beat mixture well
15. Pour into cool pie crust
16. Cool pie in refrigerator for at least 2 hours , or until filling is firm
17. Top pie with layer of cool whip

title: crispy asiago zucchini bites
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 f
2. Slice zucchini into 1 / 4 slices
3. Toss with olive oil
4. In another bowl , combine cheese , breadcrumbs and salt
5. Pat each slice on both sides to coat with mixture
6. Bake until golden brown - 10 min

title: quick fruit salad
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a bowl
2. Refrigerate until serving

title: wasko protein bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 165
2. Mix in a large bowl
3. Then spread out in pan that has been sprayed with some sort of nonstick and bake 25-30 minutes
4. Then take out and cut into 5 bars

title: fig preserves cake
steps:
1. Combine first 8 ingredients in a large mixing bowl
2. Add oil and eggs , beating at medium speed with an electric mixer until blended
3. Add buttermilk and vanilla , beating well
4. Stir in preserves and pecans
5. Pour batter into a greased and floured 10-inch tube pan
6. Bake at 350 for 1 hour and 10 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean
7. Cool in a pan on a wire rack 10 minutes
8. Remove from pan and place on a serving plate
9. Pour buttermilk glaze over cake while both are still warm
10. For buttermilk glaze: bring sugar , baking soda , buttermilk , butter and corn syrup to a boil in a dutch oven over medium heat
11. Boil 4 minutes , stirring constantly until glaze is golden
12. Remove from heat , stir in vanilla
13. Cool slightly
14. Yield: 1 / 2 cups

title: beef bolognese   delish
steps:
1. In a food processor , pulse the onions , garlic , celery and carrots until finely chopped
2. In a dutch oven , heat the oil over medium heat
3. Add the onion mixture with a pinch each of salt and pepper
4. Cook , stirring occasionally , until softened , about 5 minutes
5. Add the ground beef and cook , stirring occasionally , until cooked through , about 8 to 10 minutes
6. Add the broth and the red and white wines and simmer for 10 minutes
7. Add the tomato sauce , ketchup , bay leaves , thyme , oregano , 1 t
8. Salt and 1 / 2 t
9. Black pepper
10. Bring to a boil , then reduce the heat to low and simmer , covered , for about 30 minutes
11. Check on it occasionally during the cooking time and add more broth or tomato sauce if a saucier consitency is desired
12. Remove and discard the bay leaves and thyme sprigs
13. Serve the beef bolognese over any pasta and enjoy !

title: polish style cabbage and noodles
steps:
1. Parboil cabbage in water to cover for 10 minutes drain
2. Cook and drain noodles according to package directions
3. Add the drained noodles and onion to cabbage
4. Cook until cabbage is tender
5. Season to taste with salt and pepper
6. Stir in cottage cheese and heat until the cheese melts and mixture is creamy
7. Serve
8. This is a meatless main dish or side dish

title: pine nut and sesame pilaf  armenia
steps:
1. Melt butter in a large saut pan and saut the onion until it softens and starts to color , about 10 minutes , then add the fenugreek and the roasted seeds and nuts and mix well
2. Cook over medium until the onions have wilted completely , about 10 more minutes
3. Add salt and pepper to the onions along with the stock and water and bring the mixture to a boil
4. When the water is hot , add the rice and return to a boil
5. Then lower heat and cook covered 15-20 minutes or until the rice is done

title: egg stuffed mushrooms
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450f
2. Remove stems from mushrooms and set aside for another use
3. In medium bowl , stir together eggs , crumbs , cheese , onion , wine , butter , parsley , and garlic salt until well combined
4. Fill each mushroom cap with 1 rounded tablespoon of egg mixture
5. Place filled caps on lightly greased baking sheet
6. Bake until heated through , about 8 to 10 minutes
7. Sprinkle with paprika

title: babs chocolate birthday cake with buttercream icing
steps:
1. For cake: put oven on to 350f grease and flour two 8-inch cake pans
2. In a large bowl , mix together first five ingredients
3. Make well in bowl for wet ingredients
4. In a separate medium bowl , mix together oil , milk and eggs
5. Pour into the well in dry ingredients
6. As you begin to beat the batter , add the cup of hot coffee
7. Beat until well mixed then for two minutes on high
8. Pour into prepared pans
9. Bake for 30 minutes or until toothpick placed in center comes out dry
10. Cool for 10 minutes
11. Remove from pans and continue to cool on racks until completely cooled
12. Finish by icing with buttercream that follows:
13. For icing: cream butter and shortening with mixer
14. Add vanilla extract
15. Gradually add confectioners' sugar while continually beating with mixer
16. Icing will seem dry
17. Add milk continually , mixing and scraping sides of bowl , until icing appears light and right consistency for icing cake
18. Cover until you are ready to icing
19. May be stored in refrigerator for 2 weeks if not used completely
20. Makes about 3 cups

title: best guacamole ever
steps:
1. Combine avocado , garlic cloves , and onion
2. Add lime juice , but taste as you add it -- the one thing that could potentially kill this recipe is too much lime
3. Add salt and pepper to taste

title: famous walper spinach salad
steps:
1. Whisk together the cream , vinegar , onion , mustard , salt pepper& sugar
2. Just add enough sugar to give the dressing a light sweet sour taste
3. Just before serving the salad chop the spinach into bit size pieces
4. Fry the bacon until crisp , drain off fat and put the bacon on a paper towel pour the dressing over the spinach top with the bacob& serve immediately

title: new mexican back ribs
steps:
1. In a small bowl mix together all seasonigs
2. Rub seasoning on all surfaces of the ribs
3. Place ribs on a medium-hot grill over indirect heat
4. Close grill hood and grill until ribs are tender , about 1 1 / 2 to 2 hours
5. Add charcoal as needed
6. You want the grill temperature around 325-350 degrees

title: smoky hoisin glazed chicken
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees
2. Combine the butter , paprika , and pepper and rub on the chicken
3. Combine the hoisin sauce and italian dressing and set aside
4. Rig a wire cooling rack on top of a 9x13 pan if you don't have a rack that comes with your roasting pan
5. Roast until the meat registers 180 degrees , about 1 hr
6. , depending on the chicken
7. Baste generously with the sauce twice with the hoisin mix twice during the last 20 minutes of roasting
8. Let stand 10 minutes before serving

title: hawaiian strawberry pie
steps:
1. Place strawberries in the pie crust , either fresh or frozen , that have been drained
2. In a medium saucepan combine the dry gelatin pudding and mix
3. Add enough water to the pineapple juice to make 1 1 / 2 cups liquid
4. Add to dry pudding mixture
5. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until mixture thickens and comes to a boil
6. Pour hot mixture over the strawberries
7. Refrigerate 2 hours
8. In a small bowl combine the drained pineapple , coconut extract and cool whip
9. Mix gently to combine
10. Both layers can be cooled at the same time
11. Spread the drained pineapple , coconut extract and cool whip mixture over the set strawberry filling
12. Sprinkle flaked coconut over the top
13. Refrigerate at least 5 minutes but no more than 24 hours
14. Cut into 8 pieces

title: easy  easy fruitcake
steps:
1. Line a deep square or round tin with baking paper
2. Bring paper 5 cm above edge of tin
3. Pre heat oven to 150 c
4. Place fruit and water in pot , bring to boil
5. Simmer oncovered for 2 minutes
6. Cover and cool to room temperature
7. Stir in condensed milk then flour and rum if using
8. Add lightly beaten egg and stir thoroughly
9. Spoon into prepared tin
10. Bake for 2 hours or till cooked when tested

title: black bean and cheese tortilla pie
steps:
1. Chop the onion and green pepper
2. Seed and mince the jalapeno peppers
3. Drain and rinse the black beans
4. Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat
5. Add onions and bell pepper and cook for 5 minutes , stirring , until tender
6. Add beans , salsa , jalapenos , chili powder , and cayenne
7. Simmer 7-10 minutes
8. Line a 9 or 10 inch pie pan with one of the crusts
9. Spoon about 1 / 2 cup bean mixture into crust
10. Sprinkle with 1 / 2 cup shredded cheddar
11. Top with 1 tortilla
12. Repeat layers twice
13. Top with remaining 1 / 2 cup cheese
14. Top with second pie crust
15. Seal and flute edges
16. Cut 2 or 3 slits in the top crust to vent steam
17. Bake at 350 degrees for 40-50 minutes , or until golden brown
18. Let stand 10 minutes before serving
19. Serve with sour cream

title: almond bark popcorn
steps:
1. Melt the peanut butter and almond bark together in the microwave or on low on the stove
2. Dump the popped popcorn , peanuts , rice krispies and peanuts together in a large bowl
3. Pour the almond bark / peanut butter mixture over and mix well
4. Lay out on a grease cookie sheet
5. Let harden
6. Put in zip lock bags
7. I'm guessing on servings
8. I'd say 16-20

title: coconut milk pudding rolls
steps:
1. Dissolve yeast in 1 cup warm water in a large bowl
2. Stir in 1 1 / 2 cups flour , 1 / 4 cup sugar , melted butter , salt , and egg until smooth
3. Stir in 1 1 / 2 cups flour and knead into soft dough , adding up to 1 / 4 cup flour as needed
4. Put dough in a large buttered bowl
5. Cover and allow to rise until doubled in bulk , about 1 hour
6. Punch down and allow to double again , about 30 minutes
7. Whisk together coconut milk , remaining 3 / 4 cup sugar , and 1 tablespoons flour until smooth
8. Set aside
9. Divide dough into 24 small balls
10. Put them in a 9- by 13-in
11. Baking pan , cover , and allow to double , about 30 minutes
12. Preheat oven to 350f pour reserved coconut-milk mixture over raised rolls
13. Bake until golden brown , about 25 minutes
14. Yield
15. Makes 24 rolls

title: homemade sweet and sour mix
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients well
2. Enjoy !

title: thisclose to east side mario s salad dressing
steps:
1. Combine all in a measuring cup , and mix with an immersion blender
2. Pour into a container and refrigerate
3. The longer it sits , the better it gets
4. Prep time is cooking time
5. To make this truly authentic , make the salad with iceberg lettuce , rounds of red onion , hot pickled peppers , croutons and oodles of grated parm cheese- the fresh stuff , not out of a can

title: baked stuffed broccoli taters
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Put tater tots , onion and broccoli in casserole
3. Mix together soup and sour cream and pour over top of tater tots and vegetables
4. Bake for 40 minutes
5. Remove from oven
6. Add cheese and bake an additional 5 minutes , until cheese is melted
7. Sprinkle bacon over top and serve

title: wonderful slow cooker lentils
steps:
1. Place all ingredients , except the cheese , in the crockpot , stir
2. Cook on high setting for 2-1 / 2 hours , or until the lentils are tender
3. Stir in the cheese until it is melted and serve

title: spicy grilled tofu
steps:
1. Place the tofu slices on several layers of paper towels and cover with additional paper towels
2. Let stand 20 minutes , pressing down occasionally with your hands to squeeze out the water
3. Place the tofu in a single layer in the bottom of a 13x9 glass baking dish
4. In a small bowl , whisk together the lime juice , maple syrup , tamari , chile paste , garlic , and pepper
5. Pour mixture over the tofu , stirring to coat all the slices
6. Cover the baking dish with plastic wrap and place in the refrigerator for at least 4 hours or overnight
7. When the tofu is marinated and ready to cook: spray grill rack or pan with nonstick cooking spray
8. Heat grill or grill pan to medium heat
9. Place tofu slices on the grill
10. Reserve the marinade
11. Grill tofu 3 or 4 minutes on each side , or until the outside is browned and crisp
12. Return tofu to the baking dish and toss the slices with the reserved marinade
13. Serve immediately

title: butterfinger creme brulee
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300f sprinkle 1 tablespoon butterfinger pieces into bottom of four ovenproof 6-oz custard cups
2. In medium saucepan , add cream , 7 tablespoons sugar and salt
3. Cook over medium heat , stirring occasionally , for 5 to 6 minutes or until sugar is dissolved
4. In medium bowl , beat egg yolks
5. Gradually whisk cream mixture into egg yolks
6. Stir in vanilla
7. Pour the cream mixture through a fine sieve into prepared cups
8. Place cups in 9-inch square baking pan
9. Fill pan with hot water to 1-inch depth
10. Loosely cover with foil
11. Bake in preheated oven for about 1 hour and 30 minutes or until knife inserted in centers comes out clean
12. Remove to wire rack to cool slightly
13. Refrigerate for several hours or overnight
14. Sprinkle each crme brle evenly with remaining sugar
15. Place under broiler until sugar is melted and caramelized
16. Refrigerate for 10 to 15 minutes or until caramel hardens
17. The cooking time allows for the creme bulees to sit overnight

title: puntas de filete a la nortena
steps:
1. Prepare sauce: heat large heavy skillet over medium-high heat for 6 minutes
2. Add butter and oil
3. Stir in onions and chiles
4. Cook , stirring frequently , until onions are golden , about 15 minutes
5. Add tomatoes and sprinkle lightly with salt and pepper
6. Heat , stirring occasionally , to boiling
7. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered , stirring occasionally , until sauce thickens and fat rises to surface , about 30 minutes
8. Skim off fat
9. Prepare beef: heat large heavy skillet over medium-high heat 15 minutes
10. Add bacon and fry until crisp
11. Remove to paper towels to drain
12. Add oil to skillet
13. Stir in onion and saute until light brown , about 5 minutes
14. Add beef and brown on all sides , about 8 minutes
15. Sprinkle lightly with salt and pepper
16. Remove beef and keep warm
17. Add sauce to onion in skillet
18. Stir in bacon
19. Cook over medium heat about 5 minutes
20. To serve , divide beef among serving plates or place on platter , top with sauce , and sprinkle with jalapenos and cilantro
21. Serve with ot flour or corn tortillas

title: lime chicken linguine w cilantro cream sauce   roasted zucch
steps:
1. Whisk together 1 / 4 cup lime juice , garlic powder , cumin , salt , and pepper in a large bowl
2. Add the chicken breasts
3. Cover and refrigerate 1 to 2 hours , turning the chicken occasionally
4. Melt the butter in a saucepan over medium heat
5. Add the cilantro and garlic , cook and stir 1 minute
6. Pour in the wine , chicken broth , and 2 tablespoons lime juice , and return to a simmer
7. Transfer the mixture to a blender and blend until smooth
8. Return the mixture to the sauce pan and stir in the cream and green onions
9. Bring to a boil and remove from heat
10. Preheat an oven to 425 degrees
11. Fill a large pot with lightly salted water and bring to a rolling boil over high heat
12. Once the water is boiling , stir in the linguine , and return to a boil
13. Cook the pasta uncovered , stirring occasionally , until the pasta has cooked through , but is still firm to the bite , about 11 minutes
14. Drain well and transfer linguine to a large mixing bowl
15. Add 2 tablespoons olive oil , the parmesan cheese , and the quartered cherry tomatoes
16. Toss until the pasta is evenly coated in oil
17. Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in a skillet over medium heat
18. Cook the chicken breasts , turning once , until no longer pink in the center and the juices run clear , about 20 minutes
19. An instant-read thermometer inserted into the center should read at least 165 degrees f
20. Meanwhile , lie the zucchini on a baking sheet and coat with 1 tablespoon olive oil with a pastry brush
21. Place zucchini on middle rack in the oven , and bake , turning every 5 minutes , until nicely browned , 15 to 20 minutes
22. Return cilantro cream sauce to the stovetop and re-heat
23. Lie the zucchini pieces side by side on a serving platter
24. Lie the chicken breasts on the zucchini
25. Pour the cilantro cream sauce over the chicken
26. Serve with the pasta on the side
27. If there is some extra sauce , toss it into the pasta -- it's delicious ! i found i had pasta left over , so i just re-heated it for lunch the next day :)

title: hum muds  ginger cookies from girard college
steps:
1. Cream the sugar , lard , salt and spices together and beat them until light
2. Add the molasses and beat 3 minutes
3. Add 3 / 4 cup cool water and beat for 1 minute
4. Fold in the flour
5. Dissolve baking soda in 1 / 4 cup cool water and add to the other ingredients , mixing until smooth
6. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
7. Grease and lightly flour a baking sheet
8. Wet hands with cold water and make patties of batter , then placing them onto the baking sheet and pat them down
9. Dip a knife into cold water and use the knife to score the gingers
10. Bake for 20 minutes

title: very easy tomato basil mozzarella pasta
steps:
1. Start to boil water and while doing so cut up 4-5 cups of tomatoes into 1 / 2 inch cubes
2. Cut finely 3 / 4 cup of basil and 1 / 4 cup of parsley
3. Take tomatoes basil parsley and 4 cups of mozzarella and put in a large bowl , add desired amount of salt and pepper , pour in olive oil until the mixture is submerged and can marinate
4. By now the water should be boiled , so cook the 1lb of pasta while the mixture marinates
5. Drain pasta , put back in the pot , add the tomato basil mozzarella etc mixture , mix it around and let it sit so the cheese melts -- serve
6. Easy !

title: spicy red lentil stew
steps:
1. In a large pot , heat oil over medium heat
2. Saute chili pepper , onion , garlic , celery and carrots for 3-5 minutes
3. Add remaining ingredients
4. Bring to a boil
5. Reduce heat
6. Simmer uncovered for 40 minutes , or until lentils are tender
7. Season with additional spices if desired
8. Serve and enjoy !

title: green beans with butternut squash  tofu and maple syrup glaze
steps:
1. Top and tail green beans
2. Cut tofu into about 16 cubes
3. Chop almonds into slivers
4. Remove seeds from squash and cut into strips
5. Pre-heat oven highest setting
6. Mix 1 table spoon of olive oil , tabasco , salt and pepper
7. Put squash , garlic and onion into roasting tin
8. Baste squash , garlic , and onion with olive oil mixture
9. Tuck garlic cloves and almonds into and among the squash
10. Roast for 25 minutes and steam beans
11. Heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil in smal pan , add tofu and fry for a minute on high heat
12. Add tamari , reduce heat and fry until well browned and crisp in places
13. After the squash , garlic and onions have been in for 25 minutes , glaze with maple syrup and mix
14. Place tofu on top of roast mixture , and put it back into the oven for another 2 minutes

title: white chocolate banana coconut stuff
steps:
1. Melt the chocolate in a small bowl in the microwave
2. Mix in the banana and coconut
3. Throw in a few sliced almonds if you feel like a bit of crunchiness
4. Eat it and enjoy !

title: potato garlic dip
steps:
1. Place the potatoes and enough water to cover in a 2 quart saucepan over high heat and bring to a boil
2. Reduce the heat to low
3. Cover and simmer until potatoes are tender - about 15-20 minutes
4. In a food processor or blender , blend the garbanzo beans , olive oil , garlic cloves , and salt
5. Drain the potatoes , reserving 1 / 2 cup of potato water
6. In a large bowl , mash the potatoes , add the garbanzo mix , the reserved 1 / 2 cut potato water , and the chopped parsley , and combine until well mixed
7. Serve

title: cheesy corn dog bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Prepare corn muffin mix as directed on package
3. Pour into greased 8-inch square baking pan
4. Arrange wieners on top of batter
5. Bake 20 to 25 minute or until cornbread is golden brown
6. Remove from oven
7. Immediately top with cheese pieces
8. Cover with foil
9. Let stand 5 minute or until cheese is melted

title: overnight breakfast roll
steps:
1. Cut frozen rolls in half and place in greased bundt pan
2. Mix together pudding , brown sugar , cinnamon , and nuts
3. Sprinkle mixture over rolls in pan
4. Add remaining rolls and sprinkle remaining mixture over top
5. Drizzle melted butter over top
6. Let stand overnight , covered with a towel
7. Cook at 350 degrees f for 25 minutes

title: cheddar bacon bread   bread machine
steps:
1. Place the ingredients in your bread machine according to the manufacturer's instructions
2. Set to basic cycle , light or medium crust

title: marsha s special baked beans
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350'
2. In a frying pan fry hamburger and italian sausage together
3. Fry til no longer pink in color
4. Drain
5. In a large bowl combine remaining ingredients together and add the meat
6. Stir all together
7. Spray a 2 quart baking dish with cooking spray
8. Add mixture into baking dish
9. Sprinkle with more brown sugar over top and bake 20 to 30 minutes
10. Until bubbly
11. Remove from oven and let cool down before serving

title: crispy baked cod
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f in a small skillet over medium-low heat , melt butter
2. Add garlic and cook , stirring , until fragrant , 30 seconds
3. Add bread crumbs , stir to coat with butter , then cook , stirring frequently , until light golden brown , about 5 minutes
4. Remove from heat and stir in parsley and lemon zest
5. Let cool
6. Combine mustard and mayonnaise in a small bowl
7. Rinse fish and pat dry
8. Sprinkle each fillet lightly with salt , then place on a rimmed , foil-lined baking sheet and brush with mustard mixture
9. Press 1 / 4 of crumbs onto each fillet
10. Transfer baking sheet to oen and bake until fish is no longer translucent and flakes easily , 10 to 15 minutes
11. If crumbs aren't sufficiently browned , broil fish 2 inches from heating element until crumbs are crisp and dark golden brown , 2 minutes longer
12. Serve immediately

title: mussels with curry cream sauce
steps:
1. Place a thin coat of olive oil in a pan over high heat
2. Add shallots , garlic , and curry powder and cook~~without browning~~
3. Add white wine
4. Bring to a boil
5. Add mussels and cover
6. Cook until the mussels have opened
7. Then add creme fraiche and stir to incorporate

title: pumpkin banana cranberry bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Grease 2 loaf pans
3. In a large bowl stir together mashed bananas , pumpkin , applesauce , eggs , and vanilla until fully combined
4. In a medium bowl combine flour , splenda , baking powder , baking soda cinnamon , ginger , allspice , flax and salt
5. Add flour mixture to wet ingredients along with cranberries and stir just until combined
6. Pour into loaf pans
7. Bake 70-80 minutes until well browned

title: easy bake oven children s flavored or white cake mix
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , combine sugar , flour , baking soda , salt , and drink powder
2. Stir with a wire wisk until blended
3. With a pastry blender , cut in shortening until evenly distributed and mixture resembles corn meal
4. Spoon about 1 / 3 cup of mix into each of 10 small containers or ziploc bags
5. Seal containers tightly and label with date and contents
6. Store in a cool , dry place
7. Use within 12 weeks
8. Makes 10 packages children's lemon cake mix
9. To use: if using child's play oven , follow manufacturer's directions for baking cakes or preheat mom's oven to 375
10. Grease and flour a 4-inch miniature cake pan
11. In a small bowl , combine 1 package cake mix and 4 teaspoons water
12. Stir with a fork or spoon until blended and smooth
13. Pour mixture into prepared pan
14. Bake 12 to 13 minutes in mom's oven or as directed in play oven
15. Remove from oven
16. Cool in pan on rack for 5 minutes
17. Invert cake onto a small plate
18. Remove pan
19. When cool frost with children's white frosting if desired
20. Serves 2 children

title: pan fried tofu with spicy peanut sauce
steps:
1. Drain tofu
2. Cut into bite-sized cubes
3. Toss with cornstarch , coating the cubes
4. Sprinkle a little salt and pepper
5. Heat some oil
6. Fry the tofu cubes in batches , making sure all sides are lightly browned
7. Drain on paper towels , then sprinkle with salt and pepper if desired
8. Sauce: heat the milk in small saucepan
9. Add peanut butter , stirring well
10. Add other seasonings , according to personal taste
11. If you use coconut milk , add 1 / 2 - 1 tsp of lime juice too - it will be great !
12. Serve hot , as a snack or appetizer
13. Sometimes i serve them with a sweet chinese dessert: green bean soup

title: beef provencal casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 170c
2. Heat 2 teaspoons of the oil in a large , heavy-based frying pan over high heat
3. Add onion , mushrooms and garlic and saute for 5 minutes , or until soft
4. Transfer to a large , ovenproof dish
5. Toss meat in flour
6. Heat remaining oil in frying pan and cook beef , in 2 batches , until well-browned
7. Transfer to onion and mushroom mixture
8. Add tomato , wine , stock and capsicum to frying pan and bring to a gentle boil , scraping up any bits of beef stuck to the bottom of the pan
9. Add to casserole dish
10. Cover and transfer to oven to 1 1 / 2-3 hours
11. Remove lid and cook for a further 30 minutes , or until meat is tender
12. Serve by itself or with mash potatoes

title: dad s oatmeal coconut cookies
steps:
1. Mix shortening and sugars add eggs and vanilla
2. Mix flour and spices then add to sugar mixture add in oatmeal and coconut
3. 350 degrees for 10 minutes
4. These will be a flat chewy cookie

title: cauliflower and broccoli flan with spinach bechamel sauce
steps:
1. Cook cauliflower and broccoli in large pot of boiling water until crisp-tender , about 5 minutes
2. Drain , reserving 2 / 3 cup cooking liquid
3. Transfer vegetables to large bowl
4. Cool
5. Rinse spinach , then toss in large skillet over medium high heat until just wilted
6. Drain and cool
7. Squeeze spinach dry
8. Finely chop
9. Melt butter in heavy medium saucepan over medium heat
10. Add flour and whisk until smooth , about 2 minutes
11. Gradually whisk in milk and reserved 2 / 3 cup vegetable cooking liquid
12. Whisk constantly over medium heat until sauce thickens and boils , about 3 minutes
13. Stir in spinach , cheese and pepper flakes
14. Season with salt , pepper and a good pinch of nutmeg
15. Using fingers , coarsely crumble cauliflower and broccoli in bowl
16. Add spinach bechamel sauce
17. Stir to blend
18. Season with salt and pepper
19. Butter 1-1 / 2 quart baking dish
20. Spread vegetable mixture in prepared dish
21. Preheat oven to 350f
22. Bake flan until puffed and heated through , about 25 minutes if at room temperature and 35 minutes if chilled
23. I tend to add more milk to thin it out so that it is a light coating on the veggies

title: meaty slow cooker chili
steps:
1. Brown ground beef and pork sausage with the onion and garlic
2. Drain well
3. Add all the ingredients to a slow cooker
4. Stir and let simmer on low for 6-8hrs or on high for 3-4hrs
5. Top with fixins - sourcream , cheese , green onion , corn chips , or rice
6. You choose
7. Mix it up for a new flavor combo everytime

title: brie appetizer to travel
steps:
1. Cut off top rind of brie
2. Center cheese on a plate
3. Cover with caramel apple dip
4. Sprinkle with dried fruit , then the cashews
5. Surround with crackers and serve

title: pasta with chicken and broccoli
steps:
1. In a large pot with boiling salted water cook pasta according to directions until al dente
2. Drain
3. Meanwhile , blanch broccoli florets in a medium size saucepan for 2 minutes
4. Drain and rinse with cold water to stop the cooking
5. In large saute pan add the minced garlic and pesto sauce and olive oil , cooking over medium high heat for for 2 minutes
6. Add the chopped tomatoes , broccoli , cooked chicken , salt and pepper and red pepper flakes
7. Stir to mix well and until heated
8. Add cooked pasta to saute pan and stir to blend
9. Add parmesan cheese , fresh chopped basil and serve warm

title: georgian egg salad  azelila   low carb
steps:
1. In a small bowl , mash the eggs with the butter
2. Stir in the remaining ingredients and mix well

title: turkey tenderloin scalloppine
steps:
1. Cut turkey into 1 / 2 inch thick slices
2. Place between 2 sheets of plastic wrap
3. Flatten to 1 / 8 inch thickness , using a meat mallet or rolling pin
4. Combine flour , salt , and pepper
5. Dredge turkey slices in mixture
6. Melt 2 tbsp butter with oil in a large skillet over medium high heat
7. Add turkey
8. Cook , in batches , 1 1 / 2 minutes on each side or until golden
9. Remove from skillet , and keep warm
10. Add remaining 1 tbsp butter , wine , and juice to the skillet , stirring to loosen bits from bottom of skillet
11. Cook 2 minutes or just until thoroughly heated
12. Stir in parsley , garlic , and capers
13. Spoon over turkey
14. Garnish with lemon wedges and extra parsley , if desired

title: marinated cod fillets w potato scales
steps:
1. Combine all marinade ingredients in a bowl , mix well & set aside
2. Remove any skin from fish fillets
3. Place fillets in a shallow dish & pour the marinade over them
4. Cover & refrigerate at least 4-6 hrs or overnight
5. When ready to assemble dish , preheat oven to 400f
6. Drain marinade from fish fillets & reserve
7. Pat top side of fish fillets dry w / paper towels & place them in 9x13 in baking dish sprayed w / pam
8. Using the slicing blade of a food processor , a mandoline or a very sharp knife slice the potatoes into uniformly thin slices no thicker than 1 / 8-inch
9. Overlap potato slices on the surface of the fish fillets & drizzle reserved marinade over the "potato scales"
10. Bake fish fillets for 20-25 minutes or till tender

title: strawberry tofu spread
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a food processor and blend until smooth
2. Scoop mixture into a container for storage in the refrigerator
3. Use within 2 weeks

title: fresh coconut milk
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Use a metal skewer or ice pick to pierce two of the soft spots at the top , where the "eyes" are
3. Drain the liquid and save for use in other recipes
4. Place the coconut on a cookie sheet and bake for 15 minutes
5. Remove from oven and let it cool until it can be handled
6. If it is not already cracked open , place the coconut on a hard surface and tap with a hammer until the shell breaks
7. Remove the white flesh with a spoon or table knife
8. Peel off the thin , brown inner skin with a vegetable peeler
9. Grate the coconut pieces on the fine side of a manual grater or cut into coarse pieces and grind in a food processor
10. In a blender , process the coconut and hot water for about 2 minutes
11. Let cool for 5 minutes
12. Strain the mixture through a coffee filter into a small bowl , pressing down hard on the solid grated coconut flesh to squeeze out all the liquid
13. For thinner milk , add a little more water
14. Use in any recipe calling for coconut milk

title: grilled ham  pineapple and swiss sandwich
steps:
1. Prepare a large skillet or cast-iron skillet
2. Place two slices of bread on a work surface
3. Cover / sprinkle each of the two slices with one portion of cheese , then one slice of ham , then one portion of pineapple
4. Finish with the second portion of cheese
5. Top each sandwich with a slice of bread
6. Melt butter in a hot skillet
7. Add the two sandwiches to the skillet
8. Cook until cheese is beginning to melt and the undersides are golden
9. Butter the tops of the sandwiches , using a spatula carefully turn them over
10. Cook until the cheese is fully melted and the undersides are golden
11. Let stand for about 2 minutes before slicing

title: green beans with honey and almonds
steps:
1. Clean green beans and remove ends
2. Steam until crispy-tender--about 8-10 minutes
3. Mix together vegetable oil and honey
4. Toss green beans until coated with honey mixture and almonds

title: melting biscuits
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. Grease cookie sheets
3. Cream the butter and sugar until light and fluffy
4. Beat in the egg yolk and vanilla extract
5. Sift together the flour , baking powder , cornstarch , and salt
6. Stir into the butter mixture
7. Shape dough into 20 to 24 small balls , about 1 / 2 inch in diameter
8. Roll each ball in the oats and place about 2 inches apart on cookie sheets
9. Bake 15 to 20 minutes until golden brown
10. Let cool on wire rack
11. Store in an airtight tin

title: peppered grilled basil chicken
steps:
1. Press 3 / 4 tsp coarse ground pepper into meaty sides of chicken breast halves , then sprinkle them with salt
2. Combine melted butter , basil , parmesan cheese , and garlic to use as a basting mixture for chicken
3. Make mixture ahead and let it steep for at least 30 minutes to let flavors develop
4. Grill chicken over medium coals 8 - 10 min on each side , basting frequently with basting mixture

title: pumpkin ginger pancakes with ginger butter
steps:
1. Combine flour , brown sugar , soda , cinnamon , powdered ginger , nutmeg and salt in a large mixing bowl
2. In a separate bowl , combine egg , milk pumpkin , yogurt and butter until well blended
3. Add wet to dry , stirring just until evenly moistened
4. Cook on nonstick griddle over medium heat until edges look dry about 2 to 3 minutes per side
5. Serve with ginger butter and real maple syrup
6. To make the ginger butter , simply cream the chopped candied ginger into the butter , then chill before serving

title: lamb shanks with oregano and feta
steps:
1. Trim any excess fat from shanks , then season with salt and pepper
2. Heat the oil in a stockpot over high heat
3. Add shanks , turning requently to brown all sides
4. Remove from the pot and reserve
5. Lower the heat to medium and add the onions , stirring until golden brown , about 7 to 10 minues
6. Add the stock , oregano leaves , cayenne , and tomatoes with juice
7. Scrape the bits off the bottom of the pan to release the flavor
8. Add the shanks back to the pan
9. Bring to boil , then lower the heat and simmer for about 2
10. 5 hours
11. The shanks are done when the meat is practically falling off the bone
12. To serve , arrange 1 shank per person in your favorite bowls
13. Sprinkle with feta cheese and top with the onions and the sauce
14. Serve immediately

title: forevermama s chicken or turkey cutlets with balsamic vinegar
steps:
1. Rinse chicken or turkey breasts in a colander , let drain
2. Mix vinegar and honey until honey dissolves
3. Set aside
4. Season bread crumbs with salt and pepper
5. Dredge chicken or turkey breasts in the italian seasoned bread crumbs , pressing well to make them adhere
6. Heat a skillet over medium heat
7. Add 1 - 2 tablespoons olive oil until it is hot
8. Saute the chicken cutlets for 1 minute per side
9. Transfer them to a platter
10. Add the remaining oil and garlic to the pan and cook just until garlic is golden
11. Add the white wine and vermouth
12. Boil the mixture until sauce is reduced by half
13. Add reserved honey and vinegar mixture and cook until syrupy
14. Taste for seasoning
15. Place the cutlets back in the pan and simmer for 3 - 4 minutes more or until completely cooked
16. Garnish with parsley
17. A little bit of a
18. This sauce is scrumptious over rice

title: chocolate oatmeal no bake cookies
steps:
1. Combine the first 5 ingredients , in a large saucepan
2. Bring the mixture to a rolling boil
3. After 1 1 / 2 minutes , remove from heat and stir in the remaining 3 ingredients
4. Spoon mixture onto wax paper and allow to cool

title: pasta with crabmeat sauce
steps:
1. Before boiling the pasta , start the sauce
2. Combine cream and butter in a saucepan , and gently boil for 8 minutes
3. Add tomato and cook for 2 minutes longer , or until mixture has reduced and thickened slightly
4. Add mustard , cheese , and crabmeat , and cook 1 minute longer
5. Serve immediately

title: grilled tuna salad santorini
steps:
1. Combine the lemon and orange juice and sugar and grated rind and stir to dissolve sugar
2. Chop the garlic clove and then , with a fork mash the coarse salt and the garlic into a paste and add paste to citrus mixture
3. Whisk in olive oil
4. In a serving bowl , combine tuna , basil leaves , red pepper olives , tomato and crumbled feta
5. Grind in pepper to taste
6. Pour the dressing over the salad and toss

title: blueberry oat yogurt muffins
steps:
1. Mix oats with yogurt and cottage cheese
2. Mix flour , baking powder and soda
3. Add beaten egg , sugar and butter to oat mixture
4. Add flour and mix well
5. Fold in berries
6. Bake 400 degrees for 18 minutes

title: octopus and seaweed   ramen noodles and hot dogs
steps:
1. In saucepan , bring 1 - 1 1 / 2 cups water to boil
2. Add noodles and contents of package
3. Boil 3-4 minutes
4. Meanwhile , add 4 inches of water to a learge saucepan , bring to boli
5. Cut each hotdog into 8 strips to within 2 inches of one end
6. Drop into boiling water
7. Cook till heated through
8. Add food coloring to noodless and drain if neccessary
9. Place noodles on serving plate
10. Top with hotdog , standing up
11. Add eyes and mouth with ketchup and mustard

title: asopao de pollo
steps:
1. Rub the chicken thighs with salt , pepper , and half of the garlic
2. In a large dutch oven heat half of the oil
3. Add the chicken and cook over medium high heat for about five minutes on each side , or until slightly browned
4. Remove chicken from the pot
5. Add the remaining oil to the pot and begin to saute the onion , pepper , celery , and ham over low heat
6. Once the onion is soft add the garlic and half the cilantro
7. Cook for about 10 minutes
8. Add tomatoes , tomato paste , water or stock , and seasonings
9. Cook for about 15 minutes , or until bubbling
10. Add chicken , cover , and simmer for about 30 minutes , or until chicken is tender
11. Add rice , peas , and remaining cilantro
12. Make sure there is plenty of liquid
13. You want this to be a bit soupy
14. Stir well , bring to a boil again , then cover and simmer for 20 minutes , or until the rice is done
15. Add the cheese and serve

title: chardonnay chicken   wild mushroom stew
steps:
1. In a dutch oven or stockpot , heat 1 / 2 tablespoon olive oil over med-high heat
2. Saut chicken with dijon mustard , 1 / 4 teaspoon salt , and 1 / 8 teaspoon pepper , until golden brown
3. In a small bowl , soak dried porcinis in boiling water until soft
4. Remove chicken to a plate
5. Pour in the wine and bring to a boil , scraping up any bits of chicken left in the pan
6. Return the chicken and add the stock , 1 / 4 teaspoon each tarragon , salt , and pepper
7. Cover pan , and let simmer over med-low heat until chicken is tender
8. Remove the porcini from their soaking liquid , and squeeze them out over the bowl to remove excess liquid
9. Strain soaking liquid and reserve
10. Rinse porcini to remove any sand or grit
11. Then chop
12. In a large skillet , melt butter with 1 / 2 tablespoon olive oil
13. Saut the shiitake mushrooms , over med-high heat , for 2 minutes
14. Add the shallots , the cremini , and the portobello
15. Cook , tossing often , until lightly browned
16. Season with remaining 1 / 2 teaspoon tarragon , 1 / 4 teaspoon salt , and 1 / 8 teaspoon pepper , the lemon juice , and the cayenne pepper
17. Add the porcini and reserved liquid , and let boil , stirring constantly , until liquid is reduced by half
18. Scrape the contents of the skillet into the dutch oven and simmer for 10 minutes
19. Blend the cornstarch into the cream until smooth
20. Stir mixture into the stew
21. Let simmer for 2 minutes
22. Garnish with parsley and serve over rice

title: nacho chicken and rice wraps  4 ww points
steps:
1. Mix soup , water , salsa , rice and chicken in slow cooker
2. Cover and cook on low 6 to 7 hours or until rice is done
3. Spoon 1 / 2 cup rice mixture down center of each tortilla
4. Fold tortilla around filling
5. Serves: 15
6. Per serving: 210 calories
7. 3g fat
8. 11g protein
9. 36g carbohydrate
10. 3g dietary fiber
11. 17mg cholesterol
12. 704mg sodium
13. Exchanges: 1 grain
14. 1 / 2 lean meat
15. 1 / 2 vegetable
16. Wwp: 4

title: venison sausage creole
steps:
1. Cook sausage in skillet or dutch oven over med
2. Heat , turning often until brown , about 10 minutes remove
3. Saute onion , garlic and green pepper in olive oil until tender and browned
4. Add tomatoes , seasonings and sauces
5. Blend well
6. Return sausage to skillet and bring mixture to a boil
7. Lower temperature
8. Simmer , covered , stirring occasionally for 15-18 or until mixture has reduced
9. Stir in cooked noodles , and serve

title: texas cheese fries
steps:
1. Place french fries into oven and prepare according to directions
2. Combine ranch dressing and half of the taco seasoning
3. Set aside
4. In a small sprinkle container , such as an old emptly seasoning container , place remaining taco seasoning , black pepper , garlic salt , and season salt
5. Place hot french fries into paper bag and sprinkle remaining taco seasoning mixture onto fries
6. Place fries onto a serving dish that you can place into the oven
7. Sprinkle cheese and bacon evenly over fries on the baking sheet
8. Return fries to hot oven until cheese has melted
9. Sprinkle with green onions
10. Serve fries with prepared sauce for dipping

title: heavenly twinkie dessert
steps:
1. Cut twinkies in half lengthwise
2. Layer in a 13 x 9 inch pan
3. Pour thawed raspberries over twinkies
4. Sprinkle evenly with coconut
5. Prepare the pudding
6. Cover with pudding and frost with whipped topping
7. Refrigerate for several hours before serving

title: chocolate cherry coconut slice
steps:
1. Make base first by combining butter & sugar in a bowl
2. Sift the flour and baking powder over the butter mixture and stir to combine
3. Using a large spoon , press the mixture into the base of the pan
4. Bake for 15 minutes or until light golden brown colour
5. To make the filling combine the coconut , condensed milk and eggs in a bowl
6. Mix well
7. Stir in the glace cherries and spoon the mixture over the warm base
8. Bake another approx 20 minutes or until golden brown in colour and firm to touch
9. Allow this to cool completely before adding the topping
10. To make the topping combine the chopped chocolate and butter in a heatproof bowl and microwave on high for 2-3 minutes , stirring after each minute with a metal spoon until the mix has almost melted
11. Stir until smooth and pour the topping over the filling and refrigerate for 20 minutes or until set
12. N
13. B
14. Slice can be sprinkled with extra coconut if desired sprinkle on just before the topping sets completely

title: easy toastie
steps:
1. On a baking tray place 1 slice of bread
2. Top with tuna , pineapple and cheese
3. Put another slice of bread on top
4. Bake in oven until cheese is melted

title: caramel walnut upside down banana cake
steps:
1. Topping
2. Spray 8 inch round cake pan with 2 inch high sides with nonstick spray
3. Bring butter , sugar and corn syrup to boil in medium saucepan , stirring constantly until butter melts:boil for 1 minute
4. Stir in nuts
5. Spread topping in prepared pan and let cool completely
6. Cake
7. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
8. Sift first four ingredients into medium bowl
9. Using electric mixer , beat butter and both sugars in large bowl until blended
10. Beat in eggs 1 at a time , then mashed bananas , sour cream , rum and vanilla
11. Beat in dry ingredients just until combined
12. Spoon batter into pan
13. Bake cake until tester inserted into center comes out clean , about 55 minutes
14. Cool 15 minutes
15. Cut around cake and place platter over pan
16. Holding pan and platter together , turn over
17. Let stand 5 minutes then gently lift off pan
18. Cool at least 15 minutes for topping to set
19. Serve warm or at room temperature with whipped cream or vanilla ice cream

title: manhattan meatballs
steps:
1. Combine meat , crumbs , onion , eggs , parsley and salt
2. Mix lightly
3. Shape into approimately 18 meatballs
4. Brown in margarine
5. Drain
6. Place in casserole dish
7. Combine preserves and barbecue sauce
8. Pour over meatballs
9. Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes

title: beef  barley and dried mushroom soup
steps:
1. Soak mushrooms in hot water to cover set aside
2. In a large heavy bottom pot heat oil and saute onions , garlic , celery and carrots to slightly wilted
3. Season beef cubes generously with salt and pepper then add to onion mixture to brown
4. Remove mushrooms and rough cut reserve the strained liquid
5. Add ground meat , chipotle pepper , and chopped mushrooms to pot and brown
6. Add to the 6 cups of water strained liquid from mushrooms , worcestershire sauce , beef base , and tomato paste stir to blend and add to pot along with the oregano and bay leaves
7. Bring to a boil and simmer for 30 minutes
8. Add barley and simmer an hour
9. Taste and season with salt and pepper if needed

title: chicken spread
steps:
1. Add all ingredients except baguette slices to a food processor
2. Process until smooth
3. Season to taste with salt and pepper
4. Spread on toasted baguette slices

title: decadent iced coffee
steps:
1. Combine the coffee and chocolate liqueur in a tall glass
2. Add the sugar and stir for a minute or so , or until it dissolves
3. Sugar dissolves more slowly in chilled coffee than hot
4. Top the glass with whipped cream , then drizzle chocolate sauce over it

title: triple cheese macaroni
steps:
1. Cook macaroni according to package directions
2. Meanwhile , in a large bowl , whisk the eggs , milk , butter , mustard , seasoned salt and pepper until combined
3. Stir in the process cheese and 1-1 / 2 cups of each cheddar cheese
4. Drain macaroni
5. Stir into cheese mixture
6. Pour into a greased 3-qt
7. Baking dish
8. Top with remaining cheeses
9. Bake , uncovered , at 350 for 25-30 minutes or until cheese is melted and edges are bubbly

title: peanut butter icing   frosting for cookies
steps:
1. Measure everything into mixing bowl
2. You want a thick pasty frosting , so start with just a little milk , and add enough to get a spreadable consistency
3. Beat well with a fork
4. Add additional corn syrup or milk if needed
5. You can separate the icing into bowls and add different colors if desired
6. Spread on cookies with butter knife
7. Allow to dry for about an hour , longer if you used a heavy layer

title: portuguese spiced rice
steps:
1. Combine all of the ingredients in a large microwavable casserole dish with a lid
2. Cook in the microwave on high for 18 minutes , or until the rice is tender and the water is absorbed
3. Fluff with a fork and serve

title: kalamari salad
steps:
1. Whisk together vinegar , basil , oregano , parsley , garlic , sugar and salt and pepper to taste
2. Add oil in a thin stream , whisking until the dressing becomes emulsified
3. In a saucepan of boiling salted water , cook squid for exactly 45 seconds
4. Drain and refresh under cold water
5. Place the squid in a bowl along with the vegetables and olives and pour dressing over
6. Toss to coat
7. Let the salad marinate , covered and chilled , for at least 3 hours and up to 24 before serving

title: lemon herb fish fillets
steps:
1. Combine flour , half the herbs , and half the salt
2. Season the fish with additional salt and pepper , then dredge in flour mixture to coat , shaking off the excess
3. Heat 1 tbs butter in a large skillet over moderately high heat and cook fish 3 minutes on each side
4. Remove from pan
5. Reduce heat to moderately low and add butter pieces and simmer until a light golden brown , about 5 minutes
6. Remove skillet from heat and stir in lemon juice , remaining herbs , salt and pepper to taste
7. Pour over fish fillets

title: mediterranean chicken and pasta
steps:
1. Drain the artichokes reserving the marinade
2. Cut any large pieces in half and set aside
3. In a large skillet heat the oil over med-high heat
4. Add the chicken and cook until no longer pink then add the garlic and cook till the chicken has browned to desired doneness
5. Add the reserved marinade , broth and wine
6. And if using the dried oregano
7. Bring to a boil , reduce heat and simmer , covered for 10 minutes
8. Stir in the artichokes and olives
9. Simmer for 5 to 10 minutes
10. Add the hot cooked pasta and simmer for 10 minutes or until sauce is absorbed
11. Serve with the crumbled feta cheese
12. Great with a salad

title: e z doughnuts
steps:
1. Separate biscuits and stretch slightly to enlarge them
2. Poke your finger through center of each one to form doughnut hole
3. Heat oil in small size skillet to about 350f
4. There should be enough oil to float the doughnuts when cooking , so the amount of oil used will depend on the pan size
5. Place several doughnuts in the oil and fry until golden brown on first side then turn over to finish !
6. Place cooked doughnuts on paper towel to drain slightly
7. In a bowl to which you have added a mixture of the sugar and cinnamon , place one or two doughnuts at at a time and coat both sides

title: shrimp fusilli
steps:
1. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in large skillet over high heat
2. Add shrimp , red pepper flakes and salt , cook stirring for only 1 minute until shrimp is opaque
3. Add wine , boil for 30 seconds
4. Transfer shrimp and wine to bowl
5. Reduce heat to medium-high , heat remaining 2 tbsp oil in same skillet
6. Add onions , cook for 6-7 minutes until lightly browned
7. Stir in garlic
8. Cook 30 seconds
9. Add tomatoes , breaking up with spoon
10. Bring to a boil , boil 5 minutes , stirring occasionally
11. Stir in shrimp , cook for 1 minute
12. Toss with fusilli and parsley in large bowl

title: bryanna s yeasted pastry dough  no fat
steps:
1. The potatoes need to be just potatoes , no milk if using "real" mashed potatoes
2. If using instant mix with the boiling water
3. Mix the warm milk , mashed potatoes , syrup and yeast in a medium bowl or food processor
4. Let stand 5 minutes
5. Add the flour and salt
6. Knead for 5 minutes or process in food processor for 30 seconds
7. Place the dough in an oiled bowl , spray the top of the dough with a little oil , cover with plastic wrap and let rise in a warm place until doubled or in the refrigerator for up to 24 hours
8. To make a double crust pie , preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
9. Divide the dough in half and roll out one half to fit the bottom of a lightly oiled 9 pie pan
10. Dont use much flour when rolling out
11. Fill the pie and cover with the rolled-out second half of the dough
12. Crimp the edges together and cut some slits for the steam to escape
13. Bake immediately for 25-30 minutes or until golden
14. The pie may be glazes before baking with soymilk and maybe sprinkled with coarse unbleached sugar , or after baking with maple syrup or juice concentrate
15. To make a freeform pie , preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
16. Roll the dough out to a 16 circle and place it carefully on a lightly oiled or good nonstick cookie sheet or 14 round pizza pan
17. Make sure there are no holes or excessively thin spots in the dough
18. Pile the filling in the center and drape the edges over the filling , leaving about a 5 uncovered hole in the center , and pleating the dough to make it fit over the filling
19. This doesnt have to look fancyafter all , its a rustic pie !
20. Bake immediately as instructed for the double crust pie above
21. Glaze as above , too , if you like
22. Bryanna:its impossible to make a flaky pastry without fat , but this is a really tender yeasted pastry for pies and quicheseven fruit pies ! you can make a conventional double crust pie , or a freeform or rustic pie
23. This last is rolled into one large circle with the edges folded up over the filling and baked free-standing on a cookie sheet rather than in a pie pan
24. A food processor makes this easy !

title: soft raisin bread
steps:
1. Dissolve dry yeast in warm water
2. Drain raisins and dry with paper towel
3. Set aside
4. Add flour , sugar , salt to food processor and pulse a few times
5. Add yeast solution and covered with the flour
6. Start food processor and run for 90 seconds
7. Within 30 seconds add egg and water solution with the same speed
8. Stop machine and add butter and mix well by hand
9. Start machine again and run for 40 seconds
10. Take out dough to a bowl , and add raisins , mix well by hand
11. Roll and put in the bowl
12. Cover with prastic wrap , let rise in a warm place until doubled in size
13. Punch dough and rolled again
14. Cover dough and rest for 20 minutes
15. Make dough 15cmx25cm size and roll up
16. Grease a loaf tin and put dough
17. Put loaf tin into a prastic bag and rise in a warm place for 40 mins or until the top of dough is just above the loaf tin
18. Bake for 30-40 minutes at 375f

title: chicken in a cloud
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Butter a 13 by 9 inch shallow baking dish
3. Spread hot mashed potatoes evenly across the bottom of the baking dish , coming up the sides somewhat to create a shell
4. In a large bowl , stir together the chicken , vegetables , soup , sour cream , onion or chives , mustard , garlic , and pepper
5. Spread the chicken mixture on top of the mashed potatoes , and sprinkle evenly with the shredded cheese
6. Bake uncovered for 45 minutes , until cheese is melted and casserole is hot and bubbly
7. Remove casserole from the oven , let stand for 10 minutes before serving
8. Good served with warm buttered biscuits
9. Assemble the casserole as directed , reserving the grated cheese
10. During the last 30 minutes of baking , top casserole with 1-2 cups freshly torn soft breadcrumbs , seasoned with a pinch of poultry seasoning and a few dashes of celery seeds
11. Drizzle with 2-3 tablespoons of melted butter , and then top with the grated cheese
12. Bake until topping is lightly browned and casserole is hot and bubbling
13. Extra yummy !

title: chocolate confetti squares
steps:
1. Melt butter and peanut butter
2. Stir in chocolate chips
3. Cool
4. Add marshmallows
5. Press in a 9 x 9 pan and refrigerate
6. Cut into squares

title: fruity shake up
steps:
1. Process raisins and first amount of apple juice in blender for about 1 minute , scraping down sides if necessary , until almost smooth
2. Add remaining 4 ingredients
3. Process until smooth

title: marmalade pork tenderloin
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees f
2. Sprinkle the pork with 1 / 2 teaspoon salt and pepper
3. Place on a rack in a shallow roasting pan
4. Bake , uncovered , for 15 minutes
5. Combine marmalade , water , ginger and remaining salt
6. Spoon over pork bake 10-15 minutes longer or until a meat thermometer reads 145 degrees f
7. Let stand for 10 minutes before slicing

title: bisquick apple crunch
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400f
2. Prepare caramel sauce
3. Blend baking mix , sugar and salt in saucepan
4. Stir in vinegar and water
5. Cook , stirring constantly , over medium heat until mixture thickens and boils
6. Boil and stir 1 minute
7. Remove from heat
8. Stir in vanilla and butter
9. Cool
10. Place apples in ungreased square pan , 8 x 8 x 2 inches
11. Sprinkle with 1 / 2 teaspoon cinnamon and the nutmeg
12. Stir 1 1 / 2 cups baking mix and milk to a soft dough
13. Scatter dropped dough over apples and spread dough over apples as best you can
14. Sprinkle with 1 / 8 teaspoon cinnamon
15. Pour caramel sauce over top
16. Bake 35 to 40 minutes or until apples are tender
17. 6 servings
18. Betty crockers bisquick cookbook

title: southern comfort
steps: 1. In mixing glass with ice add all ingredients and serve chilled

title: boscoe cooks          herb crusted chicken pot pie
steps:
1. For the herb crust:
2. Blend first 5 ingredients in food processor until herbs are finely chopped
3. Add the butter and shortening and blend until mixture resembles a coarse meal
4. Transfer mixture to a large bowl , and using a fork , mix in ice water a little at a time , until dough forms moist clumps
5. Gather dough into ball and flatten it into a disk
6. Wrap in plastic wrap and chill it for 30 minutes
7. For the chicken sauce and vegetables:
8. In a large skillet , melt 2 tablespoons of butter and add the garlic
9. Saute for 2 minutes
10. Add the carrots , onions , mushrooms , green beans , celery and potatoes
11. Saute for 5 minutes
12. Set aside with chicken
13. Wipe skillet clean
14. Add 6 tablespoons of butter , melt till slightly sizzling and stir in the flour to create your roux
15. Stir constantly until cooked and lightly browned , about 5 minutes
16. Stir in the chicken stock and cream , bring to a boil
17. Reduce heat to simmer , and stirring frequently , cook for another 10-15 minutes or until sauce reaches the consistency of very heavy cream
18. Stir in the poultry seasoning
19. Season to taste with salt and pepper
20. Add white wine and stir thoroughly
21. Set aside and let cool to room temperature
22. To assemble:
23. Preheat oven to 400'
24. Place chicken , sauteed veggies and peas into a 13"x9" baking dish
25. Pour cooled sauce over chicken and veggie mixture , and stir to incorporate
26. Remove dough from refrigerator and allow to sit at room temperature for a few minutes
27. Roll out on lightly floured surface into a rectangle 15"x11"
28. Use rolling pin to wind up the dough for transfer to the baking dish
29. Unwind the dough across the top of the pot pie filling
30. Fold overhanging dough back underneath itself so that the folded edge is flush with the lip of the baking dish
31. Flute the dough if desired
32. Combine the beaten egg yolk with the cream and brush liberally over the crust
33. Cut 6 - 1 inch slits in the pastry dough , starting at the left side and moving to the right , so that you have 2 on the far left , 2 in the middle and 2 on the far right side
34. Place pie on a foil lined baking pan and put into center of the oven
35. Bake for 30-35 minutes , until hot and bubbling
36. If crust should start to brown too quickly , place a sheet of foil over it for protection

title: cheddar squares
steps:
1. Combine the dry ingredients , then cut the butter into the dry mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs
2. Add the cheddar , onion , and pimento , mixing well
3. Add the milk , mixing until just moistened
4. Spread the dough in a 9-inch square baking pan and bake at 450 degrees f
5. For 25 to 30 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in the center comes out clean
6. Cool slightly and cut into squares
7. Serve warm

title: cinnamon caramel swirl bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f mix flour , baking powder , cinnamon and salt in medium bowl
2. Set aside
3. Mix brown sugar , butter , eggs , vanilla and pecans in large bowl until well blended
4. Add flour mixture
5. Mix well
6. Reserve 1 cup of the batter
7. Spread remaining batter into lightly greased foil-lined 13x9-inch baking pan
8. Bake 15 minutes or until firm
9. Microwave caramels and milk in microwavable bowl on high 2 to 3 minutes or until caramels are completely melted , stirring every minute
10. Pour over baked layer in pan , spreading to within 1 / 2 inch of edges
11. Drop reserved 1 cup batter by spoonfuls over caramel layer
12. Cut through batter with knife several times for marble effect
13. Bake 15 to 20 minutes longer or until center is set
14. Cool in pan on wire rack
15. Lift from pan
16. Remove foil
17. Cut into 24 bars

title: low fat apple and cinnamon muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180 degrees celsius
2. Lightly grease 12-hole muffin pan
3. Sift flour and cinnamon into a bowl
4. Stir in brown sugar , sultanas and apple
5. Make a well in centre
6. Whisk together margarine , milk , egg and vanilla
7. Pour into flour and mix with a fork
8. Stir until just combined don't overbeat
9. Spoon mixture into prepared pan and bake for 20 minutes
10. Leave in pan for a few minutes to cool and then remove onto wire rack

title: crock pot hot whole grain cereal
steps:
1. Spray the inside of the crock pot with nonstick cooking spray
2. Combine all the grains , the dried fruit and cinnamon in crock pot and mix well
3. Stir in water and vanilla
4. Cover crock pot and cook for 6 to 8 hours on low
5. Check occasionally , and stir to prevent sticking
6. Stir the cereal before serving
7. You can add more water to change the texture

title: yoghurt drink  lassi
steps:
1. Combine the yoghurt , cumin and salt in a deep bowl and beat vigorously with a whisk or spoon until the mixture is smooth
2. Beating constantly , pour in the ice water in a slow , thin stream and continue to beat until all the ingredients are well blended
3. Taste for seasoning
4. Pour the lassi into a chilled pitcher and serve it from chilled tumblers
5. If you like , you may prepare the drink ahead of time and keep it chilled in the refrigerator until ready to serve

title: bacon turkey bravo sandwich
steps:
1. Dressing:
2. Combine all the ingredients in a small bowl and stir well
3. Refrigerate
4. This makes 1 3 / 4 cups , and will keep a long time in the fridge
5. Sandwich:
6. Spread 2 tbsp of the dressing on one of the bread slices
7. On top of one slice of bread , layer lettuce , tomato , turkey , gouda , and bacon
8. Top with the second slice of bread and serve

title: spinach and ricotta pasta bake
steps:
1. Tomato sauce - combine the tomatoes , garlic salt , chili flakes , basil , oregano and rosemary
2. Combine the cooked pasta with spinach , ricotta and nutmeg
3. Place the pasta in a dish and top with tomato sauce
4. Bake in oven at 350f for 15-20 minutes
5. Serve with fresh ground black pepper and parmasan

title: mom s famous graham cracker cake
steps:
1. Cream butter and sugar
2. Add eggs , one at a time
3. Add rest of ingredients , mix well
4. Bake in tube pan -or-
5. Bake in prepared loaf pans to give away as gifts
6. Bake at 350 degrees till done

title: golden raisin breakfast buns
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 375
2. Grease cookie sheets , or spray with non-stick spray
3. Plump the raisins by covering them with very hot water and letting them sit for 5 minutes
4. Then drain them and put them on a paper towel to dry
5. Combine the water , butter , sugar and salt in a saucepan
6. Bring to a boil , then add the flour all at once
7. Stir with a wooden spoon over low heat until you have a smooth , thick dough
8. Remove from the heat and beat for 2 minutes on low speed or by hand to cool it slightly
9. Add the eggs one at a time , beating after each addition , until the mixture has a satiny sheen
10. Stir in the raisins
11. Drop by heaping tablespoonfuls about 2 inches apart on greased cookie sheet
12. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes
13. The buns should pretty much double in size , and be golden and firm
14. While the buns are baking , prepare the icing by combining all the ingredients in a bowl and blending until smooth and of spreading consistency
15. Add more cream if necessary
16. When the buns are done , place on a wire rack to cool and frost while still warm
17. This makes about 8-12 buns depending on the size you make them

title: herbed mustard
steps:
1. Heat mustards , wine and vinegar in a saucepan on low heat
2. Cover and cook for 7 mins , stirring occasionally
3. Blend with an imersion blender until smooth
4. Add sugar , simmer for 7 minutes more
5. Stir in herbs
6. Cool and pour into sterilized jars
7. Keep refrigerated up to 3-4 weeks

title: banana ghouls
steps:
1. Cut the bananas in half crosswise
2. Insert a pop cycle stick about 2 inches into cut end of one half
3. Repeat with remaining halves
4. Place on waxed paper and freeze for about one hour
5. Microwave white-chocolate chips on high for about 2 minutes , or until completely melted
6. Spoon over bananas covering them completely
7. While chocolate is still soft , press in 2 fruit loops for eyes and 1 for the mouth
8. Freeze banana again until chocolate is hard

title: ginger cinnamon fruit dip
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine the yogurt , cream cheese , ginger and cinnamon until blended
2. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour
3. Serve with fruit

title: aunt ida s passover sponge cake
steps:
1. Sift cake meal and potato starch together and set aside
2. Add oil and vanilla to egg yolks
3. Add sugar and salt while beating
4. Continuing to beat , add orange juice alternately with sifted dry ingredients
5. Beat some more until creamy
6. Beat egg whites until stiff , and fold into egg yolk mixture
7. Pour batter to about 1 1 / 2" from the top of an ungreased 10" tube pan bake at 325 degrees f
8. For 50-60 minutes
9. Invert to cool

title: egyptian molokheya  green spinach like soup
steps:
1. Fill large stock pot with water , bring to a boil , add add sliced onions , carrot and celery
2. Add 2 chicken bouillon cubes and whole chicken or hen , sprinkle with salt and pepper
3. Cover and cook until chicken tender approximately 1-2 hours
4. Skim fats from water , strain out vegetables , remove chicken and reserve about 4 cups of the broth in pot
5. While broth is simmering on real low , add bag of molokheya and a teaspoon of ground coriander , salt & pepper and a dash of cumin to the broth
6. Do not cover
7. Add the chopped tomato and onion into the pot , just a little , as stated , 1 slice tomato , 1 slice onion , both chopped
8. Preparing the "tasha" : put 2 tablespoons oil into small frying pan
9. Add crushed garlic , stir until a golden brown , add teaspoon ground coriander and the few smashed coriander seeds , stir until all dry and formed together
10. Drop this into pot of molokheya while hot , you should hear a "tsshhh" sound , if so you did it- congratulations !
11. Continue cooking on low heat for approximately 10 minutes , its ready to serve
12. To serve: brown the chicken in a pan full of melted butter and serve with white steamed rice with lightly fried vermicelli pieces
13. Spoon the molokheya into bowls and let your guests spoon onto rice or dip their warm pita breads into their bowls !
14. Sometimes i prepare a red sauce to spoon into each individual bowl , or serve next to the molokheya bowls- its tangy and a good complement to this dish
15. Just take 3 slices onions , brown in butter , add two tablespoons of tomato paste , salt & pepper , a dash of cumin , add some red chili sauce and water , cook for 20 minutes , tastes should be tangy , not too thick , with a bit of tanginess and heat

title: grilled beer steak
steps:
1. Marinade steaks in beer for two hours
2. Drain beer
3. Rub rest of spices on the steaks
4. Grill on medium heat until they are done to your liking

title: light pot roast
steps:
1. Trim fat from roast
2. Spray a dutch oven with cooking spray and preheat to medium
3. Brown roast on all sides
4. Drain fat
5. In a small bowl mix the 1 / 2 cup water , worcestershire sauce , bouillon granules , and basil
6. Pour over the meat and bring to a boil
7. Reduce heat , cover and simmer 1 hour
8. Add potatoes , carrots , celery , and onion to the dutch oven
9. Cover and simmer for another 45 to 60 minutes or until meat and vegetables are tender
10. Add more water if needed
11. Remove meat and vegetables to a platter and keep warm
12. Pour the pan juices into a metal bowl and place the metal bowl in ice water to solidify the fat
13. Skim off the fat
14. You need 1 cup of pan juices , so add water if necessary to make the full cup
15. Whisk together the 1 / 4 cup water and flour until smooth
16. Stir in the pan juices and return to the dutch oven
17. Cook , stirring constantly , until thickened and bubbly
18. Cook another minute and serve the gravy with the meat and veggies

title: italian tuna salad
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients
2. The way it is pictured served in the recipe is stuffed in a round loaf cut into 6 wedges

title: pineapple steaks
steps:
1. Remove top and bottom of pineapple
2. Peel
3. It is not possible to get all the eyes off without wasting a good deal of the pineapple so compromise on how many eyes you can stand to pick out at the table
4. Some pineapples have seeds in their eyes , just pop them out with the
5. Slice crosswise into rounds about 3 / 4" thick
6. Brush pineapple slices with soy sauce
7. Heat grill medium hot , brush grill with oil if necessary to prevent sticking
8. Or , heat lightly-greased skillet medium hot
9. Cook pineapple steaks about 5 minutes on each side or until lightly browned , brushing with soy sauce before turning
10. Some people eat the core , some do not

title: risotto with red wine and sausages
steps:
1. Take the skin off the sausages , and pinch the meat into a non-stick frying pan
2. Fry meat until crusty and golden , then drain off the oil , and set the meat aside
3. Heat the olive oil and half the butter in a pan
4. Fry the onion gently until softened but not brown
5. Add the rice , and using a wooden spoon , toss well until the rice is coated in the buttery onions
6. Pour in red wine and bring to a boil , stirring
7. Add a ladle full of the hot stock to the rice
8. Stir carefully over medium heat until the stock has been absorbed
9. Continue to add the stock a ladle full at a time
10. This should take about 20 minutes
11. Add the sausage meat , and stir for another 10 minutes until the rice is cooked but not soft
12. Turn off the heat and add the parmesan , remaining butter , and salt and pepper to taste
13. Stir through
14. Cover and leave to rest for 3-4 minutes before serving

title: tomato crouton casserole
steps:
1. Arrange tomatoes in a greased dish
2. Top with bread cubes
3. Combine butter , salt , basil& thyme
4. Drizzle over bread
5. Sprinkle with cheese
6. Bake at 350 for 30-35 minutes or until light brown

title: ww 9 points   yankee pot roast
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Coat a dutch oven with cooking spray
3. Heat over medium-high heat
4. Sprinkle roast with pepper and salt
5. Place in pot and scatter onions around roast
6. Cook , turning roast and stirring onions occasionally , until roast and onions are browned , about 8 minutes
7. Pour water into pot
8. Stir in soup mix , vinegar and thyme and bring to a boil
9. Cover and cook 1 1 / 2 hours
10. Place potatoes and carrots around roast
11. Cover and bake until roast and vegetables are tender , about 2 hours more
12. Remove one potato from pot and puree in a blender
13. Stir into gravy to thicken
14. Transfer roast to a cutting board and slice against grain into 16 slices
15. Serve with vegetables and gravy
16. Yields about 2 slices of meat , 1 cup of vegetables and 1 / 4 cup of gravy per serving

title: crock pot curried turkey
steps:
1. Sideboys grated hard boiled eggs , some seperate the whites and yolks , some do not
2. Crumbled crisp bacon , chutneys , hot and tart or mild and sweet , as with most things home made is best
3. Scallions , finely chopped , mostly whites plus a little green
4. Chopped nuts , peanuts , cashews , almonds , what have you
5. Mix amd match
6. Very small pineapple pieces , toasted coconut , sliced banana , sauted in olive oil with a bit of garlic , pickled jalapenos , finely minced , remove the seeds to reduce the heat if you chose
7. I must constantly nibble on them or i suffer badly
8. You can flush your eyes with this mixture if you inadvertently get juice in them
9. Flush with cold water when through
10. Put everything except the turkey and the side boys in the crock pot , mix well
11. Submerge the thighs in the pot
12. Cover and cook on low heat for 4 hours
13. Carefully lift out the thighs , cool to handling temperature , debone , and cut into bite size pieces , return to the pot for 30 minutes to rewarm
14. Serve over white basmati rice
15. Top with your favorite side boys

title: the unbelievable brownie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325
2. Grease an 8 or 9-inch square baking pan
3. In a medium bowl , beat together butter , sugar , eggs and vanilla until light and fluffy
4. Beat in melted chocolate
5. Add flour , beating until well blended
6. Stir in walnuts
7. Spread evenly in greased baking pan bake 25-30 minutes
8. Do not overbake
9. Cool in minutes and then frost
10. Frosting: place 1 cup chocolate chips in blender
11. In a small saucepan , heat 1 / 2 cup of whipping cream until hot
12. Quickly pour cream into blender
13. Add 1 tsp vanilla extract
14. Blend until chocolate melts and mixture is smooth and glossy
15. Refrigerate until set before cutting into squares

title: outback steakhouse caesar salad dressing
steps:
1. Blend all ingredients 20 seconds on high and then 20 seconds on low
2. Makes 1 quart

title: baked mushroom omelette
steps:
1. Mix together eggs , cheese , basil & oregano
2. Add tomato , onion and mushrooms
3. Season to taste
4. Spoon mixture into buttered baking dish
5. Bake at 180 degrees celcius for 25 - 30 minutes

title: herbed cheese stuffed mushrooms
steps:
1. Remove stems from mushrooms , and discard stems or reserve for another use
2. Combine softened cream cheese and next 8 ingredients in a small bowl
3. Spoon or pipe cream cheese mixture evenly into mushroom caps , and place in a lightly greased 13x9-inch pan
4. Bake mushrooms at 350 for 20 minutes
5. Yield: about 1 1 / 2 dozen enjoy !

title: breakfast frittata
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f
2. Scramble the sausage , onions and peppers
3. Cook until the sausage is no longer pink and the vegetables are soft
4. Drain off all the grease and place in a 9x9 oven-safe casserole
5. Beat the eggs and pepper and stir in the cheese
6. Spread the meat mixture evenly and pour the egg mixture over the meat
7. Bake 25-30 minutes or until the eggs are mostly firm , but still soft in the center

title: grey cup  sourdough
steps:
1. Carefully slice top off bread loaf
2. Using a sharp knife , slice around rim leaving 1 / 2 inch sides
3. Pull out bread and cut into 1 inch cubes
4. Toast bread cubes on a cookie sheet for 15 min at 350
5. Set aside
6. Combine remaining ingredients
7. Fill hollowed loaf and wrap in foil
8. Bake 1 1 / 2 to 2 hrs at 325
9. Serve warm with toasted bread , tortilla chips , or crackers for dipping
10. Break up the crust from the bread bowl and eat that too !
11. Enjoy

title: ben s garlic cheddar mashed potatoes
steps:
1. Peel potatoes and boil whole until tender , approximately 45 minutes
2. Drain and mash
3. Melt butter over very low heat in a medium saucepan
4. Add crushed garlic and continue cooking while stirring for 1 minute
5. Do not allow garlic to brown
6. Stir in milk
7. Add salt and pepper and graualy add grated cheese , stirring , constantly
8. Allow cheese to melt and pour over mashed potatoes
9. Beat potatoes to desired consistency

title: alabama bbq chicken and white sauce  grilled
steps:
1. For the sauce , mix all ingredients in blender until smooth , about 1 minute
2. Refrigerate sauce in airtight container for at least 1 hour or up to 2 days
3. For the chicken , mix salt , black pepper , and cayenne in small bowl
4. Rub spice mixture all over chicken
5. Soak wood chips in bowl of water to cover for 15 minutes
6. Meanwhile open bottom grill vents completely
7. Light large chimney starter filled with charcoal briquettes and burn until charcoal is covered with fine gray ash
8. Place 13 by 9 inch disposable aluminum roasting pan in center of grill
9. Pour half of coals into pile on each side of grill , leaving pan in the center
10. Scatter wood chips over coals and set cooking grate in place
11. Cover with lid vents positioned over center of grill and opened halfway
12. Let grill heat for 5 minutes
13. Dip wad of paper towels in oil and oil grate , holding paper towels with long-handled tongs
14. Place chicken skin side down on center of grill
15. Cover with half opened lid vents over chicken
16. Grill chickens until skin is well browned , 35 to 45 minutes
17. Flip chickens skin side up and grill , covered , until breast meat registers 165 on instant-read thermometer , 15 to 20 minutes longer
18. Transfer chickens to cutting board , brush with 2 tablespoons sauce , tent with foil , and let rest 10 minutes
19. Remove foil and brush chicken with 1 tablespoon sauce
20. Carve and serve , passing remaining sauce at table

title: german tomato salad
steps:
1. Slice the tomatoes , add some sliced onions and put it in an oil / vinegar sauce
2. Add some garlic , parsley , salt and pepper
3. Serve chilled

title: creamy baked macaroni
steps:
1. Cook macaroni according to package directions , drain
2. In a large bowl , combine the soup , milk , chives , mustard and hot pepper sauce
3. Stir in macaroni and cheese
4. Spoon into a greased shallow 2-quart baking dish
5. Bake in oven at 400 degrees for 30 minutes
6. After 15 minutes bake time , i stirred the macaroni and cheese , and topped it off with the bread crumbs , cooking for the remaining 15 minutes

title: guacamole dip  appetizer
steps:
1. In a small bowl , mash the avocados with the back of a fork until the avocados are somewhat mashed , but still chunky
2. Add all the other ingredients and combine well
3. Transfer to an airtight container and refrigerate until ready to use

title: goat macaroni and cheese
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Boil macaroni , drain , and set aside in a 8"x8" pan
3. Melt hard goat cheese and butter in a pan
4. Add goat milk , garlic , salt , pepper , and dill
5. Fold in chunks of soft goat cheese until creamy
6. Pour sauce over macaroni
7. Bake uncovered for 25-30 minutes until top is lightly golden

title: sweet potato peanut soup
steps:
1. Heat two tbl oil in a large saucepan over medium heat
2. Add chopped onion
3. Season with pepper and salt
4. Cook onion until tender
5. Stir in garlic and ginger
6. Cook one more minute
7. Add cumin , cayenne , and cinnamon
8. Stir until blended
9. Add the sweet potatoes into the pot
10. Stir in the crushed tomatoes , creamy peanut butter , and water
11. Add cilantro and crushed peanuts
12. Bring to a boil , then reduce and simmer , covered , until sweet potatoes are tender
13. Add more salt or pepper , to taste

title: cheese and pickle sandwiches
steps:
1. Spread mayonnaise and mustard on bread
2. Trim cheese slices to fit bread and place on one slice
3. Lay pickles over cheese and top with second slice of bread
4. This is a little easier to eat if cut in half , since the pickle slices tend to want to escape

title: the ultimate patty melt burger
steps:
1. Cut the bacon strips in half
2. Fry to preferred doneness
3. Fry onions in a little butter over medium to medium-high heat until cooked and browned
4. Fry mushrooms in butter or bacon grease until nicely cooked and a little browned
5. Form ground sirloin into 6 , slightly oval patties
6. Fry or grill to preferred doneness
7. While patties are cooking , make 6 sandwiches of rye bread and cheese
8. Butter the outsides and cook like a normal grilled-cheese sandwich -- in restaurant-speak this is a "set-up"
9. When set-ups are ready them pry them open and set them on the individual plates
10. Put cooked patties on one side of the set-up
11. Top with bacon strips , onions , and mushrooms
12. Close sandwiches , pin with frilly toothpicks , and cut in half
13. Offer mayonnaise and / or mustard , at the table
14. I prefer to offer coleslaw , or a green salad but really crisp french fries and a pickle on the side are customary

title: spicy beer infused skewers   5
steps:
1. Mix marinade and pour into a a small cookie sheet pan to fit the wooden skewers
2. Soak the skewers in liquid for one hour
3. Skewer your choice of beef
4. Cook on the grill or indoors if you prefer
5. A little trick so that the skewers don`t burn is to hang them over the edge of the grill or wrap them in foil
