title: lemon chess gooey butter cake
steps:
1. Place a rack in the center of the oven and preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
2. Set aside an ungreased 9- by 13-inch pan
3. For the crust , place the cake mix , melted butter , and egg in a large mixing bowl
4. Blend with an electric mixer on low speed for two minutes
5. Stop the machine and scrape down the sides of the bowl with a rubber spatula
6. The batter should come together in a ball
7. With your finger
8. Set the pan aside
9. For the filling , rinse and dry the lemons well
10. Grate the zest from the lemons and set aside
11. You should have about 2 teaspoons
12. Cut the lemons in half , and squeeze into a small bowl
13. You should have about 6 tablespoons
14. Set the juice aside
15. Place the cream cheese in the same mixing bowl that was used to make the crust , and with the same beaters blend with an electric mixer on low speed until fluffy , 30 seconds
16. Stop the machine and add the lemon juice , lemon zest , eggs , melted butter , and cornmeal and beat on medium speed for 1 minute
17. Stop the machine and add the confectioners' sugar
18. Beat on medium speed until the sugar is well incorporated , 1 minute more
19. Stop the machine and scrape down the sides of the bowl with the rubber spatula so that the filling covers the entire surface and reaches the sides of the pan
20. Place the pan in the oven
21. Bake the cake until it is well browned but the center still jiggles when you shake the pan , 45 to 47 minutes
22. Remove the pan from the oven and place it on a wire rack to cool , 30 minutes
23. Cut into squares and serve
24. Store this cake , covered in aluminum foil , at room temperature for up to 4 days , or in the refrigerator for up to 1 week
25. Or freeze it , wrapped in foil , for up to 6months
26. Thaw the cake overnight in the refrigerator before serving

title: eggless semolina pasta dough  from bob s red mill
steps:
1. On a flat work surface combine flours and salt in a mound
2. From a little well in the middle for your wet ingredients
3. Add 1 / 2 cup water and 1 tbs oil , pouring into the well formed by your dry ingredients
4. Mix to make a stiff dough
5. Add one tablespoon of water at a time while combining mixture , until desired consistency is achieved
6. Knead 10 minutes or until dough is elastic
7. Wrap dough in towel or place in plastic bag and let rest for 20 minutes
8. On a lightly floured surface roll out to desired thickness and cut as desired
9. To cook: bring a large pot of water containing 1 / 2 teaspoon olive oil to a boil
10. Add pasta and cook until tender
11. When making lasagna , no need to boil noodles
12. Add directly to your recipe

title: cool cucumber salad
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine the cucumbers , tomatoes , green pepper and the onions
2. In a small bowl , combine lime juice , vinegar , dill , salt and pepper
3. Pour over cucumber mixture
4. Toss to coat
5. Cover and refrigerate for 15 minutes
6. Serve with a slotted spoon

title: morton s steakhouse dijon vinaigrette
steps:
1. Place vinegar and water in mixing bowl
2. Add dijon mustard and italian dressing mix to the bowl and mix with wire whip , mix well
3. Add olive oil and mix well again
4. Place vinaigrette into a plastic storage container , label , date , and refrigerate

title: revolutionary burritos
steps:
1. In skillet , heat olive oil over medium heat and cook the sweet potatoes until golden on all sides , about 8-10 minutes
2. Remove from pan and drain on paper towel
3. In same pan , cook the plantains on both sides until golden
4. Drain on paper towel
5. Divide remaining ingredients among the tortillas
6. Roll up the burrito by first rolling only 1 / 4 of the way , stop , fold in sides , then roll the rest of the way up
7. Serve seam side down
8. Raise your fist , shout "hail , burrito" ! and take a big bite

title: easy baked cajun pork chops
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Arrange chops in baking dish
3. Sprinkle spice blend evenly over meat
4. Drizzle with butter
5. Combine remaining ingredients and spoon evenly over meat
6. Cover with foil and bake approximately 15 minutes or until almost done
7. Bake uncovered for another 10 minutes or until done

title: mini lemon meringue pies
steps:
1. To make the lemon filling , combine water , lemon juice , sugar and flours in a saucepan until smooth
2. Bring to the boil , stirring constantly until mixture thickens
3. Reduce heat and simmer for 3 minutes
4. Stir yolks , butter and zest into the mixture until butter is completely melted and then remove from heat and allow to cool slightly
5. Preheat oven to 200c lightly grease three 12-hole , mini muffin pans
6. Using a 6
7. 5cm round cutter , cut 9 rounds from each pastry sheet
8. Use pastry to line muffin holes until you have 36
9. Place pans in freezer for 10 minutes or until pastry is firm
10. Bake pastry cases for 10 to 12 minutes or until light golden
11. Remove from oven
12. Spoon 1 teaspoon of lemon filling into each pastry case
13. Using an electric mixer , beat eggwhites and cream of tartar to soft peaks
14. Add sugar , 1 tablespoon at a time , beating until meringue is thick and glossy
15. Spoon the meringue into a piping bag and pipe meringue over top of lemon filling in a swirl that comes to a peak
16. Bake for 5 minutes or until meringue is set and just starting to brown at the top
17. Cool completely in pans before serving

title: oatmeal banana bread cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Cream the butter and brown sugar until creamed
3. Add the eggs , vanilla and mashed banana and beat again until well combined
4. Combine the flour , baking soda , cinnamon and salt in a separate bowl
5. Add flour mixture to the beaten mixture and mix well
6. Stir in oats and chopped walnuts
7. Drop by rounded tablespoons onto cookie sheet
8. Bake for about about ten minutes or until golden brown
9. Allow to cool for a couple minutes before moving to a wire rack

title: mollie s american fried rice
steps:
1. To make the omelet: in a 10" non-stick skillet , add about a teaspoon of oil , allow the pan to heat for about 30 seconds , then add the 2 beaten eggs
2. Swirl the beaten eggs around until one side is evenly cooked , then flip the omelet over to cook the other side
3. Transfer omelet to a plate and cut omelet into strips , set aside
4. In a wok , add oil and allow pan to heat up
5. Add onion and ginger and saut for 5 minutes , or until onion is translucent
6. Stir in broccoli , green beans , carrot and garlic
7. Add salt , if using , and stir-fry over medium heat 8 to 10 minutes , until vegetables are tender-crisp
8. Stir in chopped leafy greens and sugar snap peas , cook until they turn bright green
9. Fluff the cooked rice , and add to wok , along with the soy sauce , green onion and omelet strips
10. Serve hot , topped with the almonds

title: nectarines  honey and vanilla baked in parcels   france
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f
2. Cut out 6 pieces of aluminum foil for the fruit
3. Wash and dry the nectarines
4. Cut them in two , and take out the nuts
5. Cut the three vanilla beans in half length-wise
6. Put 2 nectarine halves and one half-stick of vanilla in the center of each piece of aluminum foil
7. Drizzle 1 tbs of lavender honey over each of the 6 parcels
8. Fold the foil inwards to form parcels , squeezing the ends to keep the steam and juices inside
9. Cook 20 minutes
10. Serve with creme fraiche or any low fat thickened cream
11. If you have any edible lavender , you could sprinkle on 1 / 2 tsp per parcel

title: strawberry   cream pinwheel appetizers
steps:
1. In a large bowl , mix the cream cheese and goat cheese together , blending well , next add the milk , honey and key lime rind
2. Once the cheese mixture is creamy add the coarsely chopped pecans and place in the fridge to chill for 30 minutes
3. Thinly slice the strawberries and set a side until needed
4. Remove the crusts from the bread
5. With a rolling pin flatten the bread slices , horizontally and vertically
6. Spread 1 tablespoon of the cream cheese mixture on the prepared bread slices
7. Place a piece of plastic wrap on table and place the bread on top of the plastic wrap
8. In the middle of the bread place two rows of of the thinly sliced strawberries
9. Gently roll the bread into a log , cover the log with the plastic wrap , do this for each slice
10. Chill the covered , cream cheese logs in the fridge for 3 hours or overnight , for the flavors to blend
11. Remove the logs from fridge , take off the plastic and gently slice the logs with a bread knife
12. You should get four slices from each bread log
13. Enjoy , enjoy , enjoy

title: artichoke tart
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Spray muffin pan with non stick spray
3. Gently press 1 wonton wrapper into each muffin hole , allowing ends to extend above cups
4. Coat edges of wrappers with cooking spray and set aside
5. Combine cheeses , cayenne pepper and mustard in a medium bowl , stir in red pepper , onions and artichoke hearts
6. Spoon about 1 tbsp of cheese mixture into each muffin cup
7. Bake until cheese mixture is set and edges of wrappers are lightly browned , about 15 minutes

title: sudanese tomato salad  salata tomatim bel daqua
steps:
1. Combine tomatoes , green onions , chili pepper and parsley in large bowl
2. Whisk oil into peanut butter until smooth
3. Dressing:
4. Stir in lime juice to peanut butter and season with salt
5. Additional oil or water may be added if dressing is too thick
6. Using a wooden spoon , gently stir dressing into tomato mixture until lightly coated

title: dr  bird cake
steps:
1. Stir together in bowl , flour , cinnamon , salt , baking soda , and sugar
2. Make a well in center and add oil , vanilla , pineapple , and eggs
3. Stir to blend , do not beat
4. Add bananas and nuts , then stir mixture only
5. Pour into greased bundt pan
6. Bake at 350f for 1 hour and 20 minutes
7. Cool before serving
8. You can dust cake lightly with powdered sugar if desired

title: the devil s beef tub
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425f
2. Rub the beef with oil and season with salt and pepper
3. Place it in a roasting pan and roast for 30 to 40 minutes or until meat reaches desired doneness , for example 130f for rare , 140f for medium-rare
4. Remove the meat from the oven when the temperature is 10 degrees shy of desired doneness since roast will finish cooking as it rests
5. Add the shallot to roasting pan
6. Heat the drambuie in a small saucepan over low heat until warmed
7. Pour the drambuie over the beef and quickly ignite , using a long match
8. When the flame goes out , remove the beef to a serving platter and hold , loosely covered
9. Add the flour to the roasting pan and cook over medium heat , stirring constantly , for 1 minute
10. Whisk in the beef broth , mustard and worcestershire sauce
11. Bring to a boil and whisk until smooth
12. Season to taste with salt and pepper
13. Transfer to gravy boat
14. Slice the beef and serve with sauce
15. Quit drooling and eat it

title: new england lamb bake
steps:
1. In a large dutch oven , heat oil
2. Brown lamb and onion
3. Stir in flour
4. Mix well
5. Gradually add broth
6. Bring to a boil , stirring to remove browned bits from pan
7. Add carrots , leeks , 1 tablespoon parsley , bay leaf , rosemary , salt , pepper and thyme
8. Spoon into a greased 3-quart baking dish
9. Cover with potatoes and dot with butter
10. Bake uncovered , at 375 for 1-1 / 2 to 2 hours , or until the meat and potatoes are tender
11. Discard bay leaf
12. Garnish with remaining parsley

title: okinawan purple sweet potato pie with haupia topping
steps:
1. To make the shortbread crust
2. Preheat oven to 300 degrees f
3. Cream the butter and sugar together
4. Add the eggs one at a time , making sure that the eggs are well incorporated after each addition
5. Add flour slowly
6. Add vanilla and chopped macadamia nuts
7. Press the dough down onto an ungreased 9 x 13 pan
8. Bake for 30 minutes
9. Shortbread will not brown
10. Do not overcook !
11. Let cool
12. Start on the okinawan sweet potato pie filling:
13. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
14. Peel and dice the okinawan sweet potato and steam until tender and dark purple
15. Whip the potatoes until fluffy
16. If you prefer a chunkier style of pie , mash the potatoes to your preference
17. Set aside to allow to cool
18. In a large mixing bowl , cream together butter and sugar until very fluffy
19. Add in eggs one at a time and mix until well incorporated
20. Mix in milk , vanilla and salt
21. Fold the potatoes into the butter mixture
22. It should have the consistency of pancake batter
23. Pour onto the baked crust and bake for 30 minutes
24. Remove from oven and let it cool down to room temperature
25. To make the haupia topping
26. In a thick-bottomed pot , heat the coconut milk until it is warm
27. In a large mixing bowl , combine sugar and cornstarch
28. Add water to the bowl
29. Slowly add the cornstarch mixture to the pot , whisking constantly until the mixture has thickened
30. Let the mixture cool slightly , and pour it over the baked sweet potato pie layer
31. Refrigerate overnight

title: pop s roast turkey sandwich
steps:
1. Lightly toast the bread and spread with butter to taste
2. Roll up the turkey into logs and place on one piece of bread
3. Top with cheese , apple slices , and lettuce
4. Spread apricot jam and mayo onto the other slice of bread and place on top of the other slice
5. Poke a toothpick on each side of the sandwich to hold it together , then cut through the center , on a slight diagonal

title: candy bar cupcakes
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f combine sugar , sour cream , butter and eggs in large bowl
2. Beat at medium speed , scraping bowl often , until smooth
3. Continue beating , gradually adding flour , water , baking soda , baking powder , salt and vanilla until smooth
4. Stir in chocolate chips , peanuts and unsweetened chocolate by hand until well mixed
5. Spoon 2 tablespoons batter into paper-lined muffin cups
6. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until top springs back when touched lightly
7. Remove cupcakes from pans
8. Cool 10 to 15 minutes
9. Drizzle 1 teaspoon caramel topping onto each cupcake
10. Sprinkle with chopped peanuts

title: date filled cookies
steps:
1. Mix the pastry ingredients well to form a nice soft smooth dough
2. Form ball and wrap in the paper left from margarine and refrigerate for an hour
3. Divide into three parts
4. On a clean , floured surface roll to a large rectangle , around 2-3mm thick , with the long end parallel to you
5. With a long spatula spread a third of the date spread evenly over the pastry , leaving a 5-10mm margin all around
6. Optional additions before rolling:
7. Cut up the date "block" into small pieces and distribute a third over the date spread
8. Sprinkle with around a teaspoon of cinnamon-and some sugar if desired
9. This is a delicious touch: crumble 2-3 tablespoons of plain vanilla halva over the date spread
10. Repeat with the other 2 parts of pastry
11. Now roll up tightly , place on baking paper lined cookie sheet and bake for about 10-20 minutes -depends on your oven-until golden
12. Remove tray from oven and leave to cool slightly
13. With a sharp serated edge knife cut diagonaly into 2-3 cm slices and leve to cool completely
14. You can sprinkle with powdered suger if desired
15. Store in airtight cookie containers

title: kahlua chicken wings
steps:
1. In 2 quart saucepan , melt butter
2. Add onions and garlic and saute over medium heat for three minutes
3. Add chili powder and cumin
4. Cook , stirring constantly , for 2 minutes
5. Blend in kahlua and cook to reduce liquid by one-half
6. Stir in hot sauce , worcestershire sauce , bbq sauce and salt
7. Simmer for 5 minutes
8. Remove from heat and stir in clover honey
9. Cool
10. Remove and discard the
11. Divide the wings in half at the remaining joint
12. Marinate the wings in the cooked , cooled sauce for 1 hour at room temperature or overnight in the refrigerator
13. Arrange marinated wings on a broiler pan
14. Sprinkle with salt and pepper to taste
15. Broil for 5 minutes , turn and brush with remaining sauce
16. Remove the wings from the broiler and reduce oven temp to 350
17. Bake for 15 minutes

title: grilled corn with mint butter
steps:
1. Prepare the grill
2. Combine the first 6 ingredients
3. Stir well
4. Place corn on grill rack coated with cooking spray
5. Grill 10 minutes or until done , turning frequently
6. Place corn on a platter and brush with butter mixture

title: poinsettia  cocktail
steps:
1. Pour cointreau and cranberry juice in a champagne flute
2. Top off with champagne
3. Enjoy in moderation !

title: shrimp and mushroom linguini with creamy cheese herb sauce
steps:
1. 1
2. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil
3. Add linguini , and cook until tender , about 7 minutes
4. Drain
5. 2
6. Meanwhile , heat 2 tablespoons butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat
7. Add mushrooms
8. Cook and stir until tender
9. Transfer to a plate
10. 3
11. In the same pan , melt 1 / 2 cup butter with the minced garlic
12. Stir in the cream cheese , breaking it up with a spoon as it melts
13. Stir in the parsley and basil
14. Simmer for 5 minutes
15. Mix in boiling water until sauce is smooth
16. Stir in cooked shrimp and mushrooms , and heat through
17. 4
18. Toss linguini with shrimp sauce , and serve

title: fred s posole rojo
steps:
1. Trim fat from ribs
2. Add ribs , shanks , celery , 2-onions quartered mint , cilantro , 20 cloves garlic , peppercorns , oregano , both cans chicken broth , cumin , 1-tbsp and enough water to cover all ingredients
3. Bring to a boil
4. Cover and simmer for 2-hours
5. Remove meat , and allow to cool thoroughly before removing from bones
6. Skim fat from broth
7. Stem and seed chiles
8. Roast chilies in dry cast iron skillet for approximately 2-minutes
9. Place chilies into bowl and cover with hot water and cover bowl
10. Let steep for approximately 30-minutes
11. In food processor , place 1-chopped onion and 10-cloves garlic
12. Process until minced
13. When chiles are done , put them and 1-1 / 2 cups of liquid from chiles in the processor , salt and pepper to taste
14. Process until puree is smooth
15. Heat cast iron skillet with 2 tbsp vegetable oil , and add chile puree
16. Cook for approximately 5 minutes or until puree has thickened
17. Turn off and remove heat
18. Once shanks and pork have cooled , shred meat
19. Add remaining ingredients: stock , meat , hominy and chile puree back into pot and bring to a boil
20. Turn down heat and simmer for 1-hour
21. Serve with condiments: sliced green onions , cabbage , radishes , dried oregano and tortilla chips
22. Enjoy !

title: boston bun   pink icing
steps:
1. Beat together potato & sugar
2. Add mixed fruit , milk & flour and mix thoroughly
3. Pour into 2 buttered 20cm round sandwich tins and bake in oven at 180 c for 20-25 minutes
4. Allow to cool
5. Ice with pink glace icing , sprinkle with coconut and serve buttered
6. Pink glace icing:
7. Place the sugar in a bowl and stirring constantly , add enough liquid to make a creamy consistency
8. Add a drop of coloring at a time until the desired color is achieved

title: guinness pork chops in gravy
steps:
1. Season the pork with salt and pepper
2. Dredge them in flour and shake off excess
3. Melt the butter with 1 tablespoon oil in heavy large deep skillet over medium-high heat
4. Add the pork in batches and brown well , about 6 minutes per side
5. Transfer the pork to plate and set aside
6. Dredge the onions in flour
7. Shake off excess
8. Heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of oil in the same skillet over medium heat
9. Add the onions and garlic
10. Season with salt
11. Cover and cook for 5 minutes , stirring once
12. Uncover and cook for 4 more minutes , stirring occasionally
13. Add 2 fluid ounces of guinness 6 fluid ounces of the stock and bring to a boil , scraping up any browned bits
14. Return the pork to the skillet
15. Spoon some of the onions over the pork
16. Add enough additional guinness and stock to bring liquid halfway up sides of pork
17. Cover the skillet with foil , and then the lid
18. Reduce the heat and simmer for 20 minutes
19. Turn the pork over and cook until very tender , about 25 more minutes
20. Transfer the pork and onions to a platter using a slotted spoon
21. Degrease the pan juices
22. Boil the juices until thickened slightly , about 10 minutes
23. Whisk in 1 tablespoon of mustard
24. Add chopped parsley and 1 teaspoons of balsamic vinegar
25. Taste and add more mustard or vinegar if desired
26. Pour the gravy over the pork
27. Garnish with parsley and serve

title: stuffed mushroom dip
steps:
1. Place the crackers in resealable plastic bag
2. Use rolling pin to crush crackers
3. Set aside
4. Melt butter in large nonstick skillet on medium-high heat
5. Add mushrooms , peppers and garlic
6. Cook 8 min , or until peppers are tender and liquid is evaporated , stirring occasionally
7. Remove from heat
8. Stir in cracker crumbs , cheese and sour cream until well blended
9. Serve warm with additional crackers

title: raspberry banana yogurt smoothie
steps:
1. Place sliced banana , washed raspberries , yogurt , orange juice , and ice cubes in blender or food processor
2. Combine until smooth
3. Enjoy !

title: baked potatoes with corn and crema mexicana
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Pierce potatoes with a fork , and bake at for 1 hour or until tender
3. Cool slightly
4. Toast the cumin seeds in a small skillet over medium heat about 1 minute
5. Combine with next six ingredients in a medium bowl
6. Stir well
7. Split potatoes lengthwise
8. Spoon about 1 / 4 cup corn mixture into each potato and top with 1 tablespoon crema mexicana

title: magic crock pot meatloaf
steps:
1. Reserve 2 t
2. Ketchup
3. Combine ground beef , eggs , oats , soup mix and remaining ketchup
4. Shape into loaf and put into crock pot
5. Top with remaining ketchup
6. Cover , cook on low 8 - 10 hours

title: craze e turkey meatballs in sauce
steps:
1. Combine all the meatball ingredients in a bowl and mix gently using your hands so that everything is evenly distributed
2. Shape mixture into 1-inch meatballs
3. Set aside
4. In a saucepan over medium heat , saute mushrooms in olive oil for 5 minutes
5. Add onion and garlic and cook until softened , 2-3 minutes longer
6. Add pureed tomatoes , broth or water , herbs and seasoning and bring to boil
7. Drop in meatballs and cook for 30 minutes , or until meatballs are cooked through and sauce has thickened
8. Remove bay leaf
9. Serve over brown rice or egg noodles or pasta , with extra parmesan cheese

title: judi s chicken gumbo
steps:
1. In a large pot , fry the bacon
2. Remove the bacon and set aside
3. Add the oil to the bacon drippings that are in the pot
4. Dredge the chicken in flour and brown them in the pot
5. This may have to be done in several batches
6. Pour the chicken broth over browned chicken and boil
7. Add all remaining ingredients and simmer for 30 minutes
8. Taste and season before serving
9. You may add the bacon to the soup , if desired-- i do and it's great

title: roasted rabbit with garlic and olives
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. In a shallow bowl , stir flour , salt , and pepper together
3. Dredge rabbit pieces in flour mixture , completely coating meat on all sides
4. In a large cast-iron skillet , heat 3 tb olive oil over medium heat
5. Put rabbit in the skillet and cook for 4-5 minutes on each side , until nicely browned
6. In a small bowl , toss the garlic with 1 tb olive oil to coat completely
7. Transfer rabbit to a baking dish and sprinkle with garlic , olives , and thyme
8. Bake , uncovered , for about an hour , or until the garlic cloves are golden brown and the rabbit is browned on the outside and opaque throughout
9. Drizzle the remaining 1 tb olive oil in an abstract pattern on a serving platter and arrange rabbit on top
10. Scoop the garlic cloves and olives from the baking dish and sprinkle over the rabbit
11. Serve immediately

title: simple savoy cabbage
steps:
1. In a large skillet or wok , heat the oil on med high
2. Add the garlic and peppers and saute for 1 minute
3. Add the shredded cabbage and stir fry for 5 mins , until starting to wilt
4. Remove from heat and add salt to taste
5. Serve

title: cherries jubilee
steps:
1. Drain the juice of the cherries into a saucepan
2. Whisk in the cornstarch and brown sugar
3. Bring mixture to a boil over high heat
4. Add cherries and stir to coat
5. Remove from heat and add carefully the brandy or kirsch
6. Return to heat and cook 1 minute
7. Scoop frozen yogurt into 4 bowls and spoon warm mixture on top

title: pomander bread  citrus spice bread
steps:
1. Dissolve yeast in 1 / 2 cup warm milk in a large bowl
2. Stir in the rest of the milk , orange juice , apple juice , salt , vegetable oil , honey , and egg
3. Mix orange rind , cinnamon , coriander , cloves , and ginger into whole wheat flour , and add mixture to liquid ingredients
4. Stir
5. Stir in white flour gradually , until dough becomes difficult to stir
6. Turn out onto lightly floured surface and knead 10 minutes , adding only as much flour as needed to produce a dough that is smooth , elastic and just past the point of being sticky
7. Put in a large oiled bowl , and cover with plastic wrap
8. Allow to rise in a warm place until doubled in bulk
9. Punch down , and divide in half to make 2 loaves
10. Place loaves in well-greased 9"x5"x3" pans , cover with a kitchen towel and let rise until doubled in volume
11. Pre-heat oven to 350f
12. Bake bread in the center of the oven for 30-40 minutes , or until browned and hollow sounding when tapped
13. Remove from pans and place on rack to cool

title: blue cheese pineapple cole slaw
steps:
1. Mix all except cabbage and pour over cabbage
2. Toss / chill until served

title: tropical banana bread muffins
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
2. Spray giant muffin tin with non-stick spary
3. Whisk together the flour , salt and baking soda
4. Mash the bananas with the sour cream / yogurt
5. In a large bowl beat together the butter and sugar until light and fluffy
6. Beat in the eggs , one at a time
7. Add the vanilla extract , rum and spices and beat until blended
8. Alternately add the dry ingredients and the banana mixture to the batter , beating until fluffy
9. Fold the remaining ingredients into the batter
10. Spoon the batter into the pan
11. Bake for 25 -30 minutes
12. Until the bread pulls away slightly from the sides of the pan and a toothpick inserted comes away clean

title: curried lentil patties
steps:
1. Heat 1 tablespoon of the oil in a medium saucepan on medium and add the carrat , celery , zucchini , cauliflower and garlic and cook stirring occasionally for 4 to5 minutes or until the vegetables soften slightly and then add curry powder and cook stirring for 1 minut and then stir int he lentils
2. Add the milk and stock to the pan and cover and bring to a simmer and then reduce heat to low and cook covered stirring occasionally for 15 minutes
3. Remove lid and cook stirring often for 10 minutes or until the lentils are soft and the mixture has thickened
4. Transfer to a large bowl and set aside for 30 minutes to cool and then add the breadcrumbs and egg to the lentil mix and mix until well combined
5. Shape mixture into 8 patties and put on a large plate and cover and put in the fridge for 1 hour to chill
6. Heat the remaining oil in a large non stick frying pan on medium high and add the patties and cook in batches for 3 to 4 minutes on each side or until cooked through and light golden
7. Divide the salad leaves and tomato between plates and add patties and top with the yoghurt and chutney to serve

title: szechuan green beans with ground pork
steps:
1. Steam beans 5 minutes
2. Combine the first 4 ingredients in a medium bowl
3. Heat oil in a large non-stick skillet over med high heat
4. Saute pork mixture until pork loses it's pink color - stirring to a crumble
5. Add steamed green beans and garlic - saute for 3-5 minutes more
6. Combine hoisin sauce , sugar , pepper flakes and soy sauce in a small bowl - stirring with a whisk to incorporate ingredients
7. Pour mixture into pan with pork and green beans
8. Cook another 3-5 minutes or until heated through , stirring frequently
9. Serve over hot rice - enjoy !

title: cooking light crock pot chili
steps:
1. Cook ground round in large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat until borwn , stirring to crumble
2. Add next 7 ingredients , and cook for 7 minutes or until onion is tender
3. Place mixture in an electric slow cooker and stir in beans and tomatoes
4. Cover with lid and cook on low heat setting for 4 hours
5. Spoon into bowls and sprinkle with cheese
6. This can also be done on the stove top: after adding beans and tomatoes , bring to a boil
7. Reduce heat and simmer , partialy covered , 1 1 / 2 hours
8. I leave mine in the crockpot about 8 hours while i'm at work and it comes out fine

title: black bean and corn dip with cilantro and lime
steps:
1. - simply mix the ingredients as described
2. Tweak the spices / sugar / olive oil ratio to suit your taste
3. This stuff is increeeeeeeeeedible !

title: pineapple cookies with browned butter frosting
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Place crisco and sugar in large bowl , beat on low speed until creamed , about 30 seconds
3. Add the eggs , one at a time , beating well after each--about 1 minute
4. Add the pineapple and beat 15 seconds to mix in , turn off the machine
5. In small bowl , combine the flour , baking soda and baking powder and salt
6. Stir in the dry ingredients to batter with wooden spoon
7. Fold in walnuts
8. Drop the batter on baking sheets , bake until set and beginning to brown , about 8 minutes
9. Remove the cookies from oven and cool on wire rack
10. To prepare frosting
11. Sift powdered sugar into a large bowl
12. Place butter in pan over medium heat and stir and cook until butter melts and browns
13. Remove the pan from heat , stir in pineapple juice and vanilla and pour the liquid mix over sugar , whisking till smooth
14. Frost cookies

title: stilton scones
steps:
1. Sift the flour , salt , mustard and cayenne pepper into a bowl
2. Rub the butter into the flour until the mixture resembles fine breadcrumbs
3. Mix in the grated cheese
4. Add the milk all at once
5. Mix to a soft , but not sticky , dough with a knife
6. Turn onto a lightly floured surface
7. Knead quickly until smooth
8. Roll out to about -inch thickness
9. Cut into 7 or 8 rounds with a 2-inch round cutter
10. Transfer to a baking sheet
11. Brush the tops with milk
12. Bake at 450f for 7-10 minutes or until well risen and golden
13. Cool on a wire cooling rack

title: tennessee mountains stack cake
steps:
1. Cream butter and sugar well
2. Add molasses , scraping cup to get it all out
3. Add eggs , one at a time , beating well after each addition
4. Sift dry ingredients together and add alternately with milk
5. Spoon batter into six greased and floured round cake pans , spreading batter about 1 / 3 inch thick in each pan
6. Bake about 15 mintues in 350 oven
7. When cool , put thick applesauce between the layers , and stack them up and sprinkle the top with powdered sugar

title: savannah cheesecake cookies  paula deen
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Combine flour , brown sugar , pecans , and butter in bowl
3. Press dough into an ungreased 13 by 9 by 2-inch pan
4. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes or until lightly browned
5. For filling , beat cream cheese and granulated sugar together in a bowl until smooth , using a handheld electric mixer
6. Add eggs and extract
7. Beat well
8. Pour over crust
9. Bake for 20 minutes
10. Cool completely
11. Cut into squares before serving
12. Decorate tops with berries and mint leaves

title: spinach and artichoke stuffed portabellas
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high heat
3. Add about 2 teaspoons of oil and the portobello caps
4. Season caps with salt and pepper , to taste , and cook 3 minutes on each side
5. Add balsamic vinegar to the pan and allow the vinegar to cook away as it coats the caps
6. Transfer balsamic glazed caps to a cookie sheet
7. Return pan to the stove and add oil , garlic and onion
8. Saute onions and garlic 3 minutes , add spinach to the pan and let it wilt
9. Coarsely chop artichoke hearts in the food processor and add to the spinach
10. Season veggies with salt and pepper and thyme
11. Add chopped toast and dampen stuffing with chicken or vegetable stock
12. Combine stuffing and sprinkle in a little grated cheese
13. Top each mushroom with 1 / 5 of the filling
14. Set mushrooms in oven for 5 minutes to set the filling
15. Cut each mushroom into 4 pieces and transfer to a serving dish
16. Enjoy !

title: soy ginger grilled  steak
steps:
1. Put all ingredients except beer and steak into mixing bowl
2. Mix well and add beer , stirring just to mix
3. Punch holes in steaks on both sides
4. Add steaks to marinade container
5. Pour marinade over steaks and cover with lid or plastic wrap
6. Marinade 4-24 hours
7. Cook steaks over high heat on barbecue or under broiler until done

title: chicken and noodle casserole
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 350f
2. Cook egg noodles acording to instructions on package
3. Heat broccoli in microwave until done
4. Drain
5. Mix the 2 cans of cream of chicken soup , broccoli , chicken , cooked hot egg noodles , salt , and pepper
6. Put into casserole dish
7. Cover top with shredded cheddar cheese
8. Put in 350f oven for about 15 minutes or until throughly heated and cheese is melted

title: applesauce streusel muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f spray a 12-cup muffin pan with pam
2. Make topping: in a bowl , stir together brown sugar , cereal , flour , cinnamon , oil and water just until crumbly
3. Set aside
4. Make muffins: in a large bowl and using a whisk or electric beaters , combine sugar , brown sugar , milk , applesauce , oil and egg
5. In another bowl , stir together 1 cup flour , baking powder , baking soda and cinnamon
6. With a wooden spoon , stir the mixture into the applesauce mixture just until everything is combined
7. In a small bowl , stir together apples and 2 tsp flour
8. Stir the mixture into the batter
9. Divide the batter among the prepared muffin cups
10. Sprinkle the topping evenly over top
11. Bake for 18 to 20 minutes or until a tester inserted into the middle of a muffin comes out dry

title: chicken quesadillas and fiesta rice
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425f
2. In medium nonstick skillet over medium-high heat , cook chicken 5 minutes or until no longer pink and juices evaporate , stirring often
3. Add soup and salsa
4. Heat to a boil , stirring occasionally
5. Place tortillas on 2 baking sheets
6. Top on half of each tortilla with about 1 / 3 cup soup mixture
7. Spread to within 1 / 2 inch of edge
8. Moisten edges of tortilla with water
9. Fold over and press edges together
10. Bake 5 minutes until hot
11. Campbell's fiesta rice: in saucepan heat chicken broth , water and salsa or picante sauce to a boil
12. Stir in uncooked instant rice
13. Cover and remove from heat
14. Let stand 5 minutes
15. Serve with tortillas

title: fresh fruit pudding milk mixer
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in blender container
2. Cover
3. Blend 1 minute or until smooth
4. Serve immediately

title: ciabatta  an italian bread
steps:
1. Sponge: in a mixer bowl , add the yeast to the water , allow to stand for 3-4 minutes , stirring gently
2. Sift the flour and add to the yeast
3. Combine ingredients well , cover and let stand at room temperature for 12 hours
4. Dough: add the yeast to the milk , stir and let it stand 3-4 minutes to be sure the yeast is working
5. Add the yeast mixture , water and oil to the sponge and mix with a dough hook
6. Add 2 cups of flour and the salt and knead for 2 minutes at low speed
7. Add the remaining flour slowly and knead for 3 more minutes , adding more water , until the dough begins to pull from the sides of the bowl
8. The dough should be quite soft and wet - a lot like a thick mud - this is why it cannot be kneaded by hand
9. Add the last of the flour slowly
10. Add a little more water , if necessary
11. Cover or place in a large , oiled bowl and let rise in a warm place for about 1 to 1 1 / 2 hours or until tripled in size and bubbly
12. Get three baking sheets and sprinkle them with flour
13. Take a spatula and carefully spoon out a third of the still very sticky dough onto each
14. Try not to deflate the dough too much , although it will deflate some , you can't really help it
15. Since ciabatta means slipper in italian , try to make each loaf the length of a man's shoe
16. If you spoon the dough out to one edge , and sort of use your spatula to guide it in a ribbon down the baking sheet you can preserve the light strands or striations in the dough , which will look nice when it's proofed and baked
17. The loaves will probably be about an inch thick
18. If you want to give them a nicer shape , flour your hands lightly and neaten up the edges into an oblong
19. Think shoe , not loaf ! think rustic - don't make the loaves overly neat and perfect , you want a rustic look
20. Flour your hands again and very gently pat the tops of the loaves to flour them , or sprinkle them with flour if you're afraid of smushing them
21. The dough will still be like glue at this point , so don't even try to handle it much
22. It's a mess , and that's the way it needs to be
23. Let them proof for 30-40 minutes , or until a little less than double
24. Preheat oven to 220c / 425f
25. Bake the bread for 25-30 minutes or until bread just begins to turn light golden-brown
26. During the first 10 minutes , brush or spray the bread lightly with water twice
27. Enjoy !

title: easy summer cucumbers
steps:
1. Seed the cucumbers if you desire , and slice them , no thicker than 1 / 4"
2. Place in tupperware bowl or other container with a tight-fitting lid
3. Add the sliced onions
4. Sprinkle generously with salt and pepper , and add remaining ingredients
5. Tightly seal the bowl and give it several good shakes to combine all ingredients
6. Refrigerate , minimum one hour , to overnight
7. Enjoy !

title: holiday crustless crab quiche
steps:
1. In a medium skiller saut mushrooms and onions in the butter till tender
2. Drain on paper towel
3. In a bowl combine the sour cream , cottage cheese , parmesan cheese and crabmeat
4. Toss the shredded monterey jack cheese with the flour in a plastic bag and then add to the crabmeat mixture
5. Beat the eggs and combine the rest of the ingredients in a bowl
6. Pour into a 10 inch greased quiche dish or a deep dish pie plate
7. Bake at 350 degrees for 40 minutes or until a knife inserted in comes out clean
8. Quiche should be puffed and golden brown
9. Let stand 5 min before cutting

title: incredible boneless pork roast with vegetables
steps:
1. 1
2. Place pork loin fat side down in a 9 x 13 pan and arrange vegetables around it
3. 2
4. In a small bowl mix garlic powder , onion powder , seasoned salt and black pepper until combined and rub it onto the pork
5. 3
6. Sprinkle the parsley on top , and then the garlic
7. Drizzle the olive oil over top of the pork
8. You can season the vegetables as well , i recommend to
9. Just sprinkle all of the same dry seasonings over top
10. 4
11. Add beef broth from one of the corners of the pan , do not pour over pork
12. Place foil , slightly vented , over the pork , and fitting the pan
13. Cook it on 325 for 2 1 / 2 hours
14. Midway through rotate the pork so it it fat side up and replace the foil so it is covered again
15. 5
16. After its done take the foil off and put the broiler on high
17. Flip the pork again to meat side up and broil for 10 minutes
18. You will do this twice for a total of 30 minutes you may need a few mins longer depending on your oven
19. Just look to see how browned its getting
20. 6
21. Let meat rest for 30 minutes
22. 7
23. Enjoy ! the vegetables will have an incredible flavor and so will the meat
24. You may add more veggies but you'll probably have to go with a bigger pan size
25. If you'd really like to kick it up , make a roux and add pan juices and some red wine and let it reduce , stirring often to make a nice gravy !

title: pork cutlet parmigiana  can sub chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. Lightly grease a 13x9x2-inch baking dish
3. In a shallow dish , combine the flour , salt , and pepper and optional lemon zest if using
4. Set aside
5. In a separate bowl , beat together the eggs
6. Set aside
7. In a third dish , combine the breadcrumbs , parmesan and basil
8. Stir well
9. Lightly season cutlets with salt and pepper
10. Remember there's additional salt in the flour mixture
11. Dredge both sides of each steak in the flour mixture , then dip into the eggs and finish by coating each cutlet in the breadcrumbs , gently patting the coating onto the meat
12. Heat a large skillet over medium high heat , add the oil and butter
13. Saute the coated cutlets until browned , about 3-4 minutes per side
14. Place the browned steaks in the prepared baking dish and bake uncovered at 375 degrees f for 25 minutes
15. In the meantiime , combine the tomato sauce , brown sugar , onion , half of the oregano , remaining basil and garlic
16. Spoon tomato mixture over the steaks and return them to the oven to bake for an additional 10 minutes
17. Top each steak with a generous slice of mozzarella or provolone , sprinkle with the freshly grated parmesan and sprinkle with the remaining oregano
18. Bake for about 3-5 minutes until cheese is melted

title: wild strawberry salad w  pepper toasted parmesan crisps   bl
steps:
1. Cut cheese into 12 rounds , each 2 1 / 2 inches wide
2. Give each cheese round a generous twist of freshly ground pepper and bake at 400 for 5-6 minutes or until golden brown
3. Let cheese crisps cool
4. Place 1 / 2 teaspoon cream cheese on each parmesan crisp
5. Layer each one with strawberries and greens
6. Top off with more greens set in cream cheese
7. Garnish with 2 fresh chives and edible flowers , of desires
8. Place wedges of strawberries around the plate and drizzle with dressing
9. For dressing
10. Blend all ingredients except the oil
11. Add oil slowly while mixing the dressing is best when made a day ahead of time
12. Mix well before serving

title: sore throat tea
steps:
1. Place all the ingredients except the honey in a small pot
2. Add about 1 1 / 2 to 2 cups water and bring to a boil over high heat
3. When it comes to a rolling boil , turn off heat and cover
4. Let it infuse for 5-10 minutes
5. Serve and sweeten with honey to taste

title: sweet chunk pickles
steps:
1. Drain pickles and cut into chunks or thick slices
2. Combine sugar , vinegar and spices in small saucepan
3. Bring to a boil , stirring until sugar dissolves
4. Put pickles and garlic in jar and add sugar mixture
5. Cover , cool and refrigerate
6. Flavor develops over a week , but they get better and better after a couple of hours cooling time

title: carrot rolls
steps:
1. Mix flour , water or milk , carrots , salt and yeast thoroughly
2. First mix yeast with sugar and little of the warm water and wait until it's frothy
3. Then what i do is put all the flour on the work surface and mix it with other dry incredients - then making a well in the centre of the heap where all the liquid goes
4. Kneading for gluten
5. By hand , or course - and i find that using a work surface instead of a bowl works better for me
6. At first it may be difficult to figure out what the dough should feel like , so use your watch - this should take 7 to 8 minutes
7. At this time it's also important to observe the dough to make sure you're not putting too much flour in it - it's quite normal that you need more or less than in the recipe
8. Dough is good to go when you can spread little out between your hands and it streches to a very thin skin without breaking
9. The dough should be a little sticky at all times , as well as smooth and elastic
10. Leave the dough to rise
11. Put in into an oiled bowl and cover with a cloth - if you put it into a warm place it will rise more quickly , but you can put it into the fridge too
12. This can actually be quite useful too - you can put your dough into the fridge , then go out and take it only out when you're ready to bake it
13. The dough has risen enough when it's doubled in size
14. Knocking the dough out again
15. This is done so that the bubbles that have formed are broken and can be distributed evenly
16. At this point you want to shape your dough - loafs or rolls , whatever you want
17. Second rising
18. Again , leave for about half an hour in a warm place - this is also one of those things you need to practice with
19. Remember that bread doesn't rise in the oven anymore like cakes that use baking powder - so you need to let them rise enough to get nice and puffy bread
20. Bake in 225 c for 10 - 15 minutes as a guideline but as always nothing beats experience
21. Generally bread is cooked when you tap the bottom of it with your finger and it sounds hollow - this can be difficult to judge in the beginning though , so use the recipe's guidelines and learn to judge what a good bread sounds like
22. Cooling
23. Warm bread is delicious , but hot bread is disgusting - it's not set yet properly
24. So put it on a cooling rack for 10-20 minutes and be patient !

title: mama t s crock pot or stove top chili
steps:
1. Put all ingredients into pot and cook on high until bubbling , reduce heat and simmer for 1 hour
2. You can also put this in the crock pot on low for 10 hours or high for 6

title: my p e i  potato pancakes
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients until blended
2. Spoon dollops onto hot griddle coated with olive oil and fry until golden brown on each side

title: burgers   onion gravy
steps:
1. Spray skillet with pam
2. Place over low heat to warm
3. Form patties with the hamburger meat and place warm skillet
4. Sprinkle salt& pepper over patties
5. Turn burner to medium-high and brown patties for 1-2 minutes
6. Turn patties over and reduce heat
7. Add onions to skillet and cover
8. Cook for 10-15 minutes or until meat is done and onions are translucent
9. Remove patties and onions from the skillet
10. Ifthere isn't enough"goodies" in the skillet , add oil
11. There should be about 1-2 tbsp
12. Of oil altogether
13. Add flour and salt and pepper to taste
14. Stir to mix flour and oil
15. Continue stiring into flour is a deep golden brown
16. Add milk and combine with flour mixture
17. Return meat and onions to the gravy
18. Remove from heat as the gravy thickens
19. Serve with mashed potatoes or rice

title: gluten   dairy free miracle sandwich bread
steps:
1. In a small mixing bowl , combine the honey and the warm water
2. Mix until the honey is dissolved
3. Sprinkle in the yeast and give it a quick stir to combine
4. Allow to proof for 10 minutes - no more , no less time
5. Make sure you have the other wet and dry ingredients mixed and ready to go when the 10 minutes are up !
6. Using a heavy duty mixer , combine the dry ingredients
7. In a separate mixing bowl , whisk together the eggs , oil , and vinegar
8. When the yeast is done proofing , add the wet ingredients to the dry
9. Stir until it's a little paste-like , then add the yeast mixture
10. Using your mixer's low speed setting , mix for about 30 seconds
11. Scrape the sides of the bowl then mix on medium for about 2 minutes or until the dough is smooth
12. Pour dough into a parchment lined and well greased 9 x 5" bread pan and cover with plastic wrap
13. Allow to rise for 45-60 minutes when the dough is just starting to crest the top of the pan , bake for 30 minutes in a preheated 375 degrees oven
14. Remove loaf from pan and allow it to cool on a wire rack
15. Enjoy it !

title: butternut squash soup with bacon and cheddar
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan with a lid , melt butter and cook onion over low low heat until translucent and sweet
2. About 30 minutes
3. Add chopped bacon , butternut squash and stock
4. Cook 30 minutes or until squash is tender
5. Add sage and salt and pepper to taste
6. Using an immersion blender , blend soup until smooth
7. Add cream , sour cream and cheese and heat through , stirring to melt cheese
8. Serve with toasted bread croutons , or crostini

title: veggie burgers
steps:
1. In a food processor , combine chickpeas and eggs and process until pureed
2. Turn out the puree into a bowl and add the cheddar , pecans , breadcrumbs , carrots , onion , garlic , spices , salt , black pepper , soy sauce , scallions , and coriander
3. Chill , covered , 2-3 hours
4. When youre ready to cook the burgers , form the mixture into 6 4-inch patties
5. If youre baking the burgers , preheat the oven to 350f and lightly oil a baking sheet
6. Place the patties on the sheet , brush with a little olive oil , and bake 20 minutes
7. If youre sauting the burgers , heat a little oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat
8. When hot , place the patties in the frying pan and saut 3-4 minutes on each side , or until a browned crust has formed
9. Serve with toasted buns , tomato slices , crisp lettuce , and pickle strips

title: quick paella
steps:
1. Saute the first 5 ingredients in a large skillet over medium-high heat 6 minutes or until just cooked
2. Add the next 5 ingredients and bring to a boil
3. Stir in rice and shrimp and return to a boil
4. Cover , remove from heat and let stand 5 to 10 minutes until rice is tender
5. Stir in lemon juice just before serving
6. Enjoy

title: very simple strawberry sauce
steps:
1. Hull & rinse berries , then drain them well
2. Cut berries into 1 / 2-inch pieces & place in a large bowl
3. Toss with sugar
4. Add lemon juice & toss gently , then let stand at room temperature 2 to 3 hours so the juices will form
5. Cover & refrigerate ~ best if used within a 24-hour period !

title: low fat black forest like cake
steps:
1. You may make this in either in individual dishes or in a larger container , depending on how much you want to make
2. Line the bottom of your dish with chocolate wafers
3. On top of those put a layer of cool whip
4. Then place wafers on top
5. Place layer of pie filling on wafers
6. More cool whip
7. More wafers
8. I think you get the idea
9. When finished , place in the refrigerator for at least 4 hours
10. This will ensure the wafers soften and turn into a cake-like substance
11. Enjoy !

title: steph s blueberry muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Line muffin cups with paper cups or grease
3. In a large bowl , combine oats and orange juice
4. Stir well
5. Combine flour , 1 / 2 cup sugar , baking powder , baking soda and salt , oil& egg
6. Mix well with oats and oj
7. Stir in blueberries
8. Fill cups 2 / 3 full
9. Blend 2 tbsp sugar and cinnamon
10. Sprinkle on muffins
11. Bake at 400f for 18-22 minutes or till golden brown
12. Easily frozen
13. I imagine you could use other berries , as well

title: southwest corn   green chili dip
steps:
1. Combine ingredients , do a taste test , if it needs more spice , add 1 teaspoons of the jalapeno juice or if you really like it hot , add 1 / 4 teaspoons cayenne pepper or more jalapenos
2. Flavor is better if allowed to set overnight or up to two days
3. Serve with corn chips

title: lasagne rolls
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to package directions
2. Drain and rinse under cold water until completely cool
3. Drain thoroughly
4. Preheat oven to 350f
5. Squeeze as much water as possible from the thawed spinach
6. In a large bowl , stir together the spinach , 8 oz mozzarella , ricotta , hamburger , and 1 / 2 cup of spaghetti sauce until thoroughly blended
7. Salt and pepper to taste
8. Line the bottom of an 11x7-inch baking dish with 1 / 2 cup tomato sauce
9. Divide the mixture among the pasta , spooning the mixture down the center of each noodle
10. Roll each noodle arranging the rolls side by side in a baking dish
11. Coat the shells with an even layer of the remaining tomato sauce
12. Sprinkle with remaining mozzarella and parmesan cheese , if desired
13. Bake until the center of the rolls are heated through and the sauce is bubbling , about 40 minutes
14. Let stand 10 minutes before serving

title: creamy parmesan dressing
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients and shake well
2. Refrigerate

title: swiss potato and cheese soup
steps:
1. In a kettle or large saucepan , combine broth , water , onions , potatoes , celery and mushrooms
2. Cover and simmer 30 minutes or until potatoes are tender
3. In a small skillet , melt butter and stir in flour
4. Stir constantly over medium heat until mixture becomes golden brown
5. Add to simmering soup
6. Stir until soup bubbles and thickens
7. Season to tase with salt and pepper
8. Spoon into bowls and sprinkle with cheese and parsley

title: eggnog
steps:
1. Seperate the egg yolks from 2 dozen eggs , save and chill egg whites
2. Whip egg yolks until blended stirring constantly to prevent curdling
3. Add the fifth of brandy , myers rum , barcardi , apple brandy , and peach brandy , stir gently mixing in 2 lbs of sugar , milk , and whipping cream chill for 6 hour or overnight
4. Before serving beat the egg whites until a smooth consistency gently fold into egg nog serve with a dash of nutmeg and
5. Give your car keys to to someone not having the egg nog

title: kickin  chili
steps:
1. In a large , heavy pan brown meat well
2. Add garlic , celery , and onions and saut for 10 minutes
3. Add tomatoes , tomato sauce , spices , seasonings , chili peppers , sugar , and the beans
4. Bring to a boil , then reduce heat and simmer , uncovered for 1 1 / 2 hours
5. Stir often to prevent sticking

title: milk toast
steps:
1. Heat milk , vanilla , cinnamon , butter and sugar to a simmer
2. Tear up toast into pieces and add to the milk
3. Mix until toast is softened

title: nutella and banana bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180c grease and line a 11cm x 21cm loaf pan
2. Sift the flour , baking powder and cinnamon into a large bowl
3. Stir in the sugars
4. In a separate bowl , combine the eggs , oil and vanilla
5. Add to the dry ingredients with mashed banana and fold until just combined
6. Pour the mixture into the loaf pan
7. Using a teaspoon , drop the nutella across the top of the mixture , then mix it into the cake mix by inserting a cake skewer or a knife into the cake batter and swirling it around a couple of time
8. Cook for 50 minutes or until a skewer comes out clean
9. Turn out onto a rack and allow to cool for 10 minutes before slicing and serving

title: smoked salmon carpaccio with extra virgin olive oil and lemon
steps:
1. To make dressing , combine the oil , lemon juice , onion and capers in a bowl and whisk
2. Arrange smoke salmon on serving plates
3. Drizzle the dressing over the smoked salmon , sprinkle with parsley ground black pepper and capers
4. Serve

title: turkey and stuffing pie
steps:
1. In large bowl , combine egg , broth , and butter
2. Add stuffing and mix well
3. Pat on the bottom and up the sides of a greased 9-inch pie plate
4. Set aside
5. In a skillet saut the mushrooms and onion in butter until tender
6. Sprinkle with the flour and mix well
7. Add turkey , peas , parsley , worcestershire sauce , and thyme
8. Mix well and stir in the gravy
9. Bring to a boil
10. Boil and stir for 2 minutes
11. Spoon into the crust
12. Bake at 375f for 20 minutes
13. Arrange cheese strips in lattice pattern over filling
14. Bake 5 to 10 minutes longer or until the cheese is melted

title: spicy chicken thighs
steps:
1. Place the chicken in a glass dish
2. In a small bowl , combine the yogurt , salsa , curry and cumin
3. Pour over chicken , turning to coat
4. Cover and refrigerate at least 6-hours or up to 24 hours
5. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
6. Transfer the chicken and sauce to an oven proof dish , sprayed with nonstick pan spray
7. Bake uncovered , 40 to 45 minutes , or until chicken is tender and cooked through

title: seasoned orange roughy
steps:
1. In a 9 x 13-inch pan , melt butter in oven
2. In a separate pan , combine bread crumbs , cheese , basil , oregano , salt and garlic powder
3. Dip fish in melted butter , then in crumb mixture
4. Arrange coated fish in 9 x 13-inch pan
5. Sprinkle with wine and lemon juice being careful to sprinkle evenly over fish
6. Sprinkle mushrooms and almonds on top
7. Bake covered at 350 for 25 minutes

title: tacos dorado
steps:
1. Place all sauce ingredients in a large saucepan over medium-high heat and bring to a boil
2. Remove from heat and strain mixture through a sieve placed over a large bowl to reserve liquid
3. Place tomato mixture in blender and blend until smooth , adding enough of the reserved cooking liquid to thin sauce to desired consistency
4. Combine filling ingredients
5. Place 1-2 tablespoons of filling on the lower third of the tortilla and roll up
6. Place rolled tortillas seam side down on a baking sheet
7. Prepare remaining tortillas
8. Heat 1 / 2 inch oil in frying pan over medium-high heat
9. Place tacos in pan , seam side down and fry until golden and crispy , approximately 5 to 8 minutes
10. Keep prepared tacos in warm oven
11. Suggested accompaniments: remaining pitillel tomato sauce , sour cream , feta cheese , tomatoes , diced sweet onion , shredded lettuce

title: vegan omelet
steps:
1. Crumble tofu
2. Add red and green peppers , mushrooms , tomato and onion to tofu in skillet
3. Add water and lemon pepper seasoning
4. Cover with medium high heat for 10 minutes
5. Stir and add braggs and nutritional yeast and turmeric
6. Stir again and add grated soy cheese
7. Turn off heat , cover for 2 minutes or until cheese melts and enjoy !

title: lidia s spaghetti and meatballs
steps:
1. Pass the tomatoes and their liquid through a food mill fitted with the fine disc
2. Heat 1 / 4 cup olive oil in a 4- to 5-quart pot over medium high heat
3. Stir in the onion and cook , stirring , until wilted , about 4 minutes
4. Pour in the tomatoes , crushed red pepper and bay leaves , and season lightly with salt and pepper
5. Bring to a boil , then lower the heat so the sauce is at a lively simmer
6. Cook , stirring occasionally , 30 minutes
7. Meanwhile , crumble the pork and beef into a mixing bowl
8. Sprinkle the bread crumbs , 1 / 3 cup grated cheese , the parsley , and garlic over the meat
9. Beat the egg with 1 teaspoon salt and 1 / 4 teaspoon salt and 1 / 2 teaspoon black pepper in a small bowl until blended
10. Pour over the meat mixture
11. Mix the ingredients with clean hands just until evenly blended
12. Don't overmix
13. Shape the meat mixture into 1-1 / 2 inch balls
14. Dredge the meatballs in the flour until lightly but evenly coated
15. Heat 1 / 4 cup olive oil and the vegetable oil in a large , heavy skillet over medium-high heat
16. Slip as many meatballs into the skillet as will fit without crowding
17. Fry , turning as necessary , until golden brown on all sides , about 6 minutes
18. Adjust the heat as the meatballs cook to prevent them from overbrowning
19. Remove the meatballs , and repeat if necessary with the remaining meatballs
20. Add the browned meatballs to the tomato sauce and cook , stirring gently with a wooden spoon , until no trace of pink remains at the center of the meatballs , about 30 minutes
21. Stir the spaghetti into the boiling water
22. Return to a boil , stirring frequently
23. Cook the pasta , semi-covered , stirring occasionally , until done , about 8 minutes
24. Drain the pasta and return it to the pot
25. Spoon in about 2 cups of the tomato sauce , tossing well until the pasta is coated with sauce
26. Remove from the heat and toss in 2 / 3 cup grated cheese
27. Check the seasoning , and add salt and pepper if necessary
28. Serve the pasta in warm bowls or piled high on a large warm platter
29. Spoon a little more of the sauce over the pasta , and pass the remaining sauce separately
30. Pass the meatballs family-style in a bowl , or top the bowls or platter of spaghetti with them

title: rustic cranberry pear galette
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees f
2. Coat pizza pan or baking sheet with nontstick cooking spray , then set aside
3. Set aside 1 teaspoon sugar , then , in a medium bowl , combine remaining sugar , cornstarch & cinnamon , blending well
4. Add pears , cranberries & vanilla extract & toss to coat
5. Remove crust from pouch , then unfold it , remove plastic sheets & place it on the prepared baking sheet
6. Spoon pear mixture in center of crust to within 2 inches of the edge
7. Fold edge of crust 2 inches over pear mixture & crimp slightly
8. In a small bowl , combine egg white & water & whisk until well blended
9. Brush egg wash onto outer edges of pie crust & sprinkle with remaining 1 teaspoon of sugar
10. Bake 25 minutes or until pears are tender & crust is golden brown
11. If edges brown too quickly , covere with foil after 15 minutes of baking
12. Cool on wire rack at least 30 minutes

title: sweet potato  spinach and chickpea bake
steps:
1. Peel two of the onions and cut each into eight wedges
2. Pour 4 tbsp of the oil in a large roasting tin
3. Add the onion , cubed sweet potatoes and peppers and mix well with the oil
4. Turn the oven to 200c / 400f / gas 6 , put the tin in the oven and roast the vegetables for about 35 minutes , turning them half way through
5. Meanwhile peel and roughly chop the other onion
6. Heat the remaining 2 tbsp of the oil in a large frying pan and fry the onion until it begins to soften
7. Add the garlic and spice mix and stir well
8. Add the tinned tomatoes and their juice , breaking them up if necessary with a wooden spoon
9. Cook for about 5 minutes
10. Stir in the stock , then check the seasoning adding salt and a little sugar to taste
11. Stir in the chickpeas
12. When the vegetables have been cooking for 35 minutes , pour over the spiced tomatoes and chickpeas and mix well
13. Turn the oven temperature down to 190c / 375f / gas5 and cook for another 20 to 30 minutes until vegetables are well cooked , turning them half way through
14. Just before the end of the cooking time , wash the spinach , remove any rough stalks , slice them finely and stir them into the bake
15. Return the tin to the oven for another 5 minutes
16. Serve with sour cream or yoghurt

title: mushroom and almond rice pilaf
steps:
1. Brown onions in margarine
2. Mix together with remaining ingredients in a shallow baking dish
3. Bake for 1 hour at 375 degrees

title: gluten free fried onion topping  for green bean casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 475
2. Slice onions in half and then into 1 / 8 inch slices and toss in a bowl with the flours and salt
3. Generously grease a baking sheet with about half the oil and evenly spread the onions in the pan
4. Drizzle the rest of the oil evenly on top of the onions
5. Place in middle rack and bake until golden brown , about 30 minutes
6. Toss the onions 2 to 3 times during cooking
7. Keep a good eye on them towards the end , they can go from a little brown to burnt very fast , and you want to pull them out at the right time !
8. Use just like the canned onions- add half to your green bean casserole and put the other half on top , or according to your casserole recipe

title: cooked cabbage
steps:
1. Shred cabbage like for slaw
2. Soak in cold water until all is shredded
3. Take 1 1 / 2 quart pot , heat up bacon drippings
4. Add cabbage , shaking off excess water
5. Pot will be full
6. Salt and pepper to your taste
7. Cover with lid
8. Stir a couple of times
9. Cook 5-10 minutes

title: orange pineapple banana smoothie
steps:
1. Place ingredients in blender in listed order
2. Blend for about 30 seconds
3. Drink immediately
4. Important: use fresh sweet organic fruit
5. Optional: you can add a couple ice cubes if you want it cold , but i prefer it room temperature - it feels very tropical and authentic that way

title: two layered birthday cake
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 f
2. Grease bottom and sides of two 9-inch round pans with butter
3. In a large bowl beat all ingredients except frosting and strawberries with electric mixer
4. Bake pans for 30-35 minutes , or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
5. Cool pans for 10 minutes
6. Remove from pans to wire rack and cool completely
7. Cover first cake with frosting then add some sliced strawberries , cover the bottom of the second cake with frosting and place on top of the first cake
8. Then cover both cakes completely with frosting , grate chocolate on top and add strawberries for decoration

title: hearty leek   potato soup
steps:
1. Peel and chop the potatoes into half inch cubes
2. Wash and chop the leeks , celery and scallions
3. They don't have to be chopped finely but not too chunky
4. Mince or finely chop the garlic
5. In a large saucepan , melt the butter and add all of the vegetables
6. Over a medium heat , stir until the veg is coated in butter , then put the lid on and leave to sweat for ten minutes , stirring occasionally , until the butter is absorbed
7. Add the stock , season , and simmer for 20 minutes or until the potatoes are good and soft
8. Remove from the heat and blend thoroughly
9. Add the cream and stir well
10. You can either then put back onto the heat until steaming hot and serve , or cool and reheat later , or freeze

title: cajun salmon cakes with lemon  garlic aioli
steps:
1. Combine ingredients for aioli and set aside
2. For salmon cakes , combine the first 6 ingredients
3. Shape into 8 patties
4. Dredge in the 1 / 2 cup of breadcrumbs
5. Cook over medium high heat in pan coated with cooking spray
6. Allow 3-4 minutes cook time per side
7. Serve with aioli on top !

title: potted cheddar cheese spread
steps:
1. In a large bowl combine the cheese and beer
2. Give it a good stir and let stand for 30 minutes
3. Blend in the remaining ingredients-mix very well
4. Pack into airtight containers and store in the fridge for 1 month or the freezer for 3 months

title: pumpkin seeds with worcestershire and garlic
steps:
1. Remove pumpkin seeds from pumpkin and pat dry with a paper towel
2. It is not necessary to rinse the seeds
3. They will be more flavorful without being rinsed
4. Combine all the ingredients in a bowl and toss well to mix
5. Spread seeds in a single layer on a nonstick baking sheet
6. Bake at 250 degrees for 1 1 / 2 hours

title: gingery peach cooler
steps:
1. In a pitcher , combine the ginger ale , nectar , peaches , and ginger
2. Serve over ice

title: kashmiri chicken
steps:
1. 1
2. Saute onion in oil until lightly golden
3. 2
4. Add garlic and ginger and cook until all is light brown
5. 3
6. Add chicken and cardamom and cook 15-20 minutes over med-high heat
7. 4
8. Add yogurt , tomatores and red chile powder
9. Cook 20-30 minutes , stirring constantly , over med heat until chicken is cooked through
10. Remove cardamom pods
11. 5
12. Add ground cashews and cook 3 minutes
13. 6
14. Put in serving bowl and sprinkle with sliced almonds to serve

title: asian sesame salmon
steps:
1. In small bowl , combine honey , green onions , soy sauce and spices , except red pepper , until well blended
2. Stir in red pepper to taste , if desired
3. Place salmon in 13x9 in baking dish
4. Spoon honey mixture evenly over salmon
5. Bake salmon in preheated 375f oven for 30 minutes or until fish flakes easily with a fork , basting occasionally with honey mixture

title: country style curry with ground beef and green beans
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat
2. Add the garlic , and toss well
3. Add the curry paste and cook , mashing and stirring to dissolve it , until fragrant and softened , 2 to 3 minutes
4. Crumble the ground beef and then add the nushrooms
5. Cook , tossing often , untl the meat and mushrooms are browned and seasoned with the curry pasted , 2 to 3 minutes
6. Add the chicken broth , green beans , zucchini , lime leaves , fish sauce , sugar , and salt and bring to a gentle boil
7. Cook 3 to 5 minutes , until the vegetables are tender and the meat is cooked
8. Stir in the basil leaves and remove from heat

title: mediterranean style chicken breast
steps:
1. Cook garlic , jalapeno and diced chicken in oil
2. Add maple syrup and cook another 2 to 3 minutes stirring constantly
3. Add zucchini , olives , tomatoes and simmer 8 to 10 minutes
4. Add parsley , pesto , salt and pepper
5. Finish cooking another 2 minutes
6. Serve on your choice of fresh pasta

title: reggae pork
steps:
1. Whisk the lime juice , 1 / 4 cup rum , and pineapple juice together
2. Add pork and marinate for 1 hour
3. While pork is marinating , warm the jelly and remaining rum together in a small saucepan
4. Remove from heat and set aside
5. Remove pork from marinade and pat dry
6. Sprinkle with salt and pepper
7. Warm oil in a large saute pan , use just enough to cover the bottom of the pan
8. Cook pork for 3 minutes on each side , or until cooked through and lightly browned
9. Drizzle pork with jelly mixture and serve

title: aztec indian omelette
steps:
1. In skillet , fry onion in bacon grease until tender , add diced hot dogs
2. Continue frying until browned
3. Add more bacon grease if needed
4. Tear up tortillas into bite size pieces and add to skillet
5. Continue frying until tortillas are pliable
6. Add more bacon grease if needed
7. Break eggs over entire mixture and stir everything together until eggs are fried
8. This is a delicacy that originated in the refrigerator , better known as left overs
9. Pay day was still a ways off

title: easy snickers bar pie
steps:
1. In a large mixing bowl , beat cream cheese , sugar and peanut butter until creamy
2. Stir in chopped candy bars
3. Gently fold in the cool whip just until mixed
4. Pour into crusts and refrigerate overnight

title: frank s black olive dip
steps:
1. Mix mayonnaise and sour cream in medium bowl to blend
2. Add olives , onions , cilantro , lime juice , garlic and 1 / 4 tsp hot pepper sauce
3. Season with salt and pepper
4. Taste , adding more hop pepper sauce if desired
5. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until well chilled , at least 1 and up to 8 hours
6. Serve dip with tortilla chips

title: yucatan style shrimp   3 ww points
steps:
1. Fill a large pot halfway with water and bring to a boil
2. Add the shrimp and cook until just opaque in the center , about 2 minutes
3. Drain in a colander
4. Rinse the shrimp under cold running water
5. Drain
6. Do not let the shrimp fully cook as the lime juice in the marinade will continue to "cook" it
7. Peel and devein the shrimp
8. Transfer to a large bowl
9. Stir in the tomatoes , onion , lime juice , cilantro or parsley , oil , cumin , salt and pepper
10. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours or up to 6 hours
11. Place a romaine leaf on each of 4 plates
12. Top with onr-fourth of the shrimp mixture and the radishes
13. Serve with lime slices

title: meatball stuffed shells
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to package directions
2. Drain and rinse in cold water
3. Place 1 / 2 cup sauce in a greased 13 x 9 inch baking dish
4. Place a meatball in each shell
5. Transfer to baking dish
6. Top with remaining sauce and sprinkle with cheese
7. Cover and bake at 350 degrees for 35 minutes
8. Uncover
9. And bake 5-10 more minutes or until bubbly and cheese is melted

title: grammie bea s lazy daisy oatmeal cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Cake:
3. In a shallow bowl , combine rolled oats and boiling water
4. Let stand for 20 minutes
5. Using a mixer , cream butter until creamy
6. Gradually beat in sugars , and beat until light
7. Blend in eggs and vanilla
8. Mix flour , baking soda , salt , and spices
9. Remove beaters from creamed mixture
10. Stir in rolled oat mixture
11. Fold in flour mixture
12. Blend well
13. Pour batter into a greased and floured 9" square cake pan
14. Bake for 45-55 minutes remove from oven , but do not remove cake from pan
15. Topping:
16. Combine all melted butter
17. Brown sugar , canned milk and nuts
18. Spread over the hot cake
19. Return the cake to the oven , under the broiler
20. Broil until the topping is bubbly and tinged with gold
21. Watch it as it will burn easily

title: beer and brown sugar marinade for flank steak
steps:
1. Mix ingredients in a freezer or storage bag - add steak and allow to marinade for several hours
2. Can also be stored in freezer for a later meal
3. Broil or grill as preferred

title: basically the best bruschetta ever
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients above and refrigerate for several hours , check for taste and season accordingly
2. Serve on garlic bread with some parm cheese or bake on the bread with a little feta or assagio cheese for a change of pace
3. Enjoy

title: black bean soup
steps:
1. In a 4-quart saucepan simmer beans , ham hock , yellow onion , garlic , cumin , water , and broth , partially covered , until beans are tender , about 1 hour
2. Transfer ham hock to a work surface and cool until it can be handled
3. Cut away ham and chop fine , discarding bone and fat
4. Transfer 1 1 / 2 cups each beans and cooking liquid to a blender and let cool slightly
5. Pure mixture and return to pan
6. Stir in ham , vinegar , sugar , and salt and pepper to taste and heat until hot
7. Serve soup sprinkled with red onion

title: cream cheese corn
steps:
1. In medium saucepan , warm corn slightly covered in water to about room temperature
2. Do not over cook
3. Drain corn , place back in pan
4. Add butter and cream cheese
5. Cook , stirring over medium heat only until melted , add salt and pepper
6. Pour into serving bowl and sprinkle slight amount of parsley for color

title: szechuan peanut noodle salad
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , cook linguine as directed on package , using 2 teaspoons salt
2. Meanwhile , in another saucepan , combine 1 inch water and snow peas
3. Heat to boiling over high heat
4. Reduce heat and simmer 2 minutes
5. Drain
6. Rinse with cold running water
7. Drain
8. Cut snow peas lengthwise into 1 / 4-inch wide matchstick strips and set aside
9. Drain linguine , reserving 1 cup of the pasta water
10. To prepare dressing: in large bowl , with wire whisk , mix peanut butter , ginger , reserved pasta water , soy sauce , vinegar , sesame oil , remaining 1 / 2 teaspoon salt , and hot pepper sauce until smooth
11. Add linguine to dressing in bowl and toss to coat
12. Add snow peas and cucumber
13. Toss to combine
14. To serve , sprinkle with peanuts and green onions

title: easy vegetable rice medley
steps:
1. Heat oil in a skillet
2. Add onion , carrot , celery , and red pepper
3. Cook 5 minutes or until tender
4. Add broth
5. Bring to a boil
6. Stir in rice and peas
7. Cover
8. Simmer 5 minutes
9. Remove from heat
10. Let stand 5 minutes before serving
11. To save time , replace all the veggies with 3 cups frozen mixed vegetables or frozen broccoli florets and add them when you would have added the peas

title: carrot potato tarte  flourless
steps:
1. For the dough wash and peel your potatoes
2. Grate them finely and add 1 ts salt and the dried herbs
3. Then stirr in one egg and the polenta
4. Set aside
5. Clean and peel your carrots and slice them
6. Blanch for 2 minutes in boiling salted water
7. In a bowl combine two eggs , sour cream / yoghurt , curry powder , a pinch of salt and the sugar
8. Mix in carrot slices
9. Place potato-mixture in a greased 10 inch in diameter tarte dish
10. Pat down and up the sides
11. Fill in carrot mixture and distribute evenly
12. Bake at 180 c / 350f in the preheated oven for about 45 minutes or until filling has set and tarte is nicely browned on top
13. Serve with a green salad of your choice

title: split pea and winter squash soup
steps:
1. Spray a large soup pot with cooking spray and heat over medium-high heat
2. Add onion and celery and saute 7-8 minutes
3. Lower the heat , then stir in the garlic and saute for 30 more seconds
4. Add the oil , then stir in the curry powder and gently saute for 30 seconds
5. Add the water , squash , split peas , bay leaf , and salt
6. Bring to a near boil , then lower the heat
7. Partially cover the pot , then simmer for about 1 hour
8. Cook until the split peas are completely tender and falling apart
9. Remove from heat and discard bay leaf
10. Puree soup in batches using a food processor , blender , or immersion blender
11. Put pureed soup back on the stove over low heat and stir in the sugar and tomato paste
12. Add salt if necessary
13. Simmer five minutes more , then serve with lemon wedges if desired

title: baba ghanoush
steps:
1. Start by heating your oven to 425 degrees
2. Once the oven is up to temperature , place both eggplants on a baking sheet
3. Roast for 30-40 minutes , or until very soft
4. The skin may actually look a little burned , but this is perfectly normal
5. Allow the eggplant to cool for about 30 minutes before handling
6. Once cool , remove the skin from the eggplant and discard
7. You will use the gooey insides as a base for your dip
8. Trust me , this will get a little bit slippery and messy , but it's all going to be good eats in the end
9. Place the eggplant into a food processor along with all of the other ingredients
10. Process until very smooth stopping every 10 seconds or so to scrape down the sides of the food processor
11. Season well with a good amount of salt and black pepper , and serve with chips
12. I chose to use little mini pretzel chips , and they tasted great
13. Baba ganoush is traditionally served with pita chips , but hey no one says you have to be authentic every time
14. Enjoy !

title: oma dutch pancakes
steps:
1. Mix dry ingredients together
2. Add oil and eggs to this mixture
3. Slowly add the milk to a very thin consistency
4. Whisk well til very few lumps remain
5. Fry about 1 / 2 cup of this mixture at a time in a quite hot frying pan sprayed with pam , you only need to grease the pan intermittantly after that
6. Spread thinly in the hot pan by
7. The thinner the pancake the better:) fry them til the top of the pancake appears dry then flip over until it is quite brown on the bottom
8. These take some practice but are worth the effort !

title: my mom s pie crust
steps:
1. Sift together flour and salt
2. Cut shortening into flour with a pastry cutter until it has the texture of coarse crumbs
3. Combine egg , water , and vinegar
4. Pour into flour mixture all at once
5. Blend with a spoon just until flour is all moistened
6. Refrigerate at least 30 minutes
7. Gather into a ball and roll out on waxed paper
8. To place in pie plate , lift waxed paper and peel off when crust is in place
9. Refrigerate at least 30 minutes before baking
10. To pre-bake , prick shell at 1 / 2-inch intervals before refrigerating
11. Press a doubled 12-inch square of aluminum foil into pie shell
12. Adjust oven rack to lowest position , heat oven to 400 degrees
13. Weight crust with pie weights
14. Bake , until crust is firmly set , about 15 minutes
15. Reduce oven temperature to 350 degrees , remove weights and foil , and continue to bake until crust is crisp and rich brown in color , about 8-10 minutes longer
16. Makes one double crust or two single crusts
17. Some of the secrets to light , flaky , tender pie crusts are: 1) have the ingredients cool or chilled when you start
18. Chill the dough when you aren't working with it
19. 2) handle the dough as little as possible
20. Avoid over-blending or re-rolling it
21. You want to have unblended bits of shortening in the mixture , to create the flakey texture

title: diabetic popovers
steps:
1. Sift flour and salt together
2. Set aside
3. Beat eggs and skim milk
4. Add to flour
5. Beat until smooth
6. Pour into heated greased muffin tins , filling half full or less
7. Bake 375 degrees for 50 minutes , or until popovers are golden brown and sound hollow
8. Do not open oven for first 40 minutes

title: beef merlot crock pot
steps:
1. Heat frying pan on high
