2. Add 2 t bacon fat- melt
3. Add chopped onion and garlic
4. Turn down heat to medium low- saut for 5 minutes
5. Remove and set aside
6. Turn up heat to high- get pan really hot
7. Add more bacon fat or olive oil if pan is dry
8. Quickly brown meat- let each side get browned
9. Place browned meat into crock pot
10. Add 1 cup water to pan to make a beef stock
11. Add 2 bouillon cubes- stir and break up into stock
12. Add 1 / 4 merlot optional
13. Pour over meat in crock pot
14. Spoon onion mixture over meat
15. Cover and cook 10 hours on low
16. Serve with mashed potatoes , cooked / buttered broccoli and crusty rolls

title: 3 minute bread pudding in a mug
steps:
1. Crack egg into the mug , add milk and blend well with a fork
2. Add the cubed bread & stir gently to coat
3. Let it soak in and then stir gently again
4. Gently stir coating all bread
5. Sprinkle with brown sugar
6. Place the mug in the microwave and cover well with a paper towel
7. Tuck the paper towel edges underneath the mug
8. Cook for exactly 2 minutes
9. Drizzle with syrup if desired & chow down !

title: strawberry banana smoothie with apple cider
steps:
1. Just blend everything together ! add more or less of anything to get it to just the right consistency / taste
2. I added chocolate syrup to the glass to make it look nice
3. A good variation also is to add maple syrup instead of honey !

title: sherried chicken and fettucini casserole
steps:
1. Cook fettucini in boiling water for 8 to 10 minutes , until still quite firm , then drain well
2. Cook onion , bell pepper and mushrooms in butter until soft
3. Add the flour , cook for 1 minute , then add the stock , sherry , salt and pepper
4. Bring to a boil , stirring constantly , then cook for 2 to 3 minutes
5. Mix together the pasta , chicken , cream and vegetable sauce
6. Pour into a shallow ovenproof casserole , sprinkle with the cheese
7. Cook in a preheated oven at 375 degrees for 30 to 35 minutes , or microwave 8 to 10 minutes on high
8. Use the chicken carcass to make the stock
9. If cooking this dish in the microwave , finish off under the broiler to brown the cheese

title: margarita balls
steps:
1. Mix the crushed vanilla wafers with the ground almonds
2. In a blender process the tequila , orange marmalade , lime juice and corn syrup'til smooth
3. Stir melted white chocolate and tequila mixture into crumb mixture
4. Shape into 1" balls and roll in granulated sugar
5. Store in refrigerator

title: pineberry smoothie
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in blender or food processor
2. Process or blend until thick and smooth

title: lightened up lebanese garlic sauce
steps:
1. Mix it all up
2. Refrigerate 1 hour
3. If left longer it will become stronger in flavour
4. Serve as you wish or as stated in introduction for a great meal masha allah

title: delicious drop sugar cookies
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees
2. Combine dry ingredients and set aside
3. Cream butter , oil , and both sugars together
4. Add the egg and vanilla
5. Gradually add the dry ingredients
6. Form dough into small balls and smash with the bottom of a sugared glass , or use a fork and dip it in sugar than press onto cookie
7. Add sprinkles
8. Bake for 10-15 minutes at 350 degrees

title: muffin pan sweet potato   leek quiches
steps:
1. Steam the sweet potato until just tender
2. Transfer to a bowl
3. Heat the oil in a pan , preferably non-stick , over a medium heat
4. Add the leek , onion and garlic and saute , stirring , until they have softened
5. Remove the pan from the heat and add the sweet potato and the parsley and combine well
6. Preheat the oven to 180c
7. Grease 6 x 1 large muffin pan
8. Spray a sheet of phyllo with the oil
9. Top with the remaining sheets , spraying between each layer
10. Cut the sheets into three portions , then cut each strip in half
11. Line each muffin recess with the phyllo pastry
12. Divide the sweet potato mixture among the pastry cases
13. Whisk the eggs , milk and nutmeg together
14. Season with salt and freshly ground black pepper
15. Divide evenly between the six muffin pan recesses by pouring the milk / egg mixture over the top of the sweet potato mixture
16. Bake for 20-25 minutes or until set
17. Serve with your choice of salad greens

title: autumn romance vegetable stew provencale
steps:
1. Sprinkle eggplant with salt and allow to drain in colander for 30 minutes
2. Thoroughly rinse before adding to other vegetables
3. Sear all veggies first in a large pan on top of stove over high heat until they wilt
4. Place veggies in large crock pot with other ingredients and cover , cooking on low for 5-6 hours or until vegetables are tender
5. Serve with crusty bread and wine , if desired

title: dream cookies
steps:
1. Oven: 180 deg c / 350 deg f
2. Grease baking tins , but bake only one tin at a time , in the centre of the oven
3. Before starting , break up the chocolates and chop roughly in a blender
4. Do the same , separately , with the macadamias
5. In an electric mixer , mix the butter , sugars , eggs and vanilla until light and creamy
6. Turn speed to low and add flour and salt slowly
7. Increase mixer speed , and mix well
8. Add the chopped chocolates , nuts and desiccated coconut to the mixture , and stir or mix in well -- low speed
9. Roll teaspoonsful in balls , and pack on the greased tins
10. Bake about 15 - 20 minutes or until edges start browning and cookies are dry on top
11. Cool and pack in airtight tins

title: chinese barbecue sauce
steps:
1. Combine ingredients
2. Cook over low heat 10 minutes
3. Brush onto ribs or chicken and barbecue

title: cinnamon chocolate chip cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Grease a 9x 13 inch rectangular baking pan
3. In a small bowl , combine topping ingredients and set aside
4. In another bowl , cram oil , sugar and eggs
5. Add yogurt and vanilla , beat well
6. Add flour , baking powder and baking soda and beat until combined
7. Pour half of the batter into prepared pan
8. Sprinkle half of combined topping ingredients over batter in pan
9. Spoon remaining batter in pan , followed b remaining topping mixture
10. Bake in over for 25-30 minutes or until toothpick inserted into center of cake comes out clean
11. Enjoy !

title: german kasekuchen
steps:
1. Crust: in a large mixing bowl , blend all the ingredients , cutting in the butter and working the mixture with your hands until it is well mixed and workable
2. Divide the dough into 2 equal portions
3. Use one half to line the bottom of a greased 9-inch springform pan , the other half to line the sides of the pan
4. Either roll out the dough or press it in with your fingers
5. Chill before filling
6. Cheesecake: preheat the oven to 375 degrees f
7. Press the cottage cheese through a sieve
8. Combine the cornstarch and the baking soda and set aside
9. In a large mixing bowl , combine the cottage cheese with the sugar , eggs , lemon rind and vanilla
10. Beat until very smooth
11. Add the dry mixture to the cheese and blend well
12. Stir in the sour cream and raisins
13. Pour the cheese mixture into the prepared crust and bake for one hour , or until done
14. The center will remain soft
15. Turn off the oven and prop the door open
16. Allow the cake to cool to room temperature
17. Serve at room temperature as well

title: fettuccine hungry girlfredo    ww points   1
steps:
1. Rinse fettuccine noodles very well
2. Microwave them for one minute , then drain them and pat dry
3. Add cheeses and sour cream
4. Mix thoroughly
5. Microwave to help melt cheese further , and mix some more
6. Add salt and pepper to taste
7. Enjoy

title: two potato mash
steps:
1. Peel and quarter regular potatoes
2. Peel and cut sweet potatoes into eighths
3. In a large saucepan , cover regular potatoes with cold water
4. Bring to a boil and cook 5 minutes
5. Add sweet potatoes and cook another 15 minutes or until fork tender
6. Drain potatoes , and return to low heat for 3 minutes to dry , shaking occasionally
7. Mash potatoes until smooth
8. Continue mashing while gradually adding milk
9. Stir in remaining ingredients

title: roasted tomato and basil salsa
steps:
1. Heat oven to 325f degrees
2. Combine all ingredients in large ovenproof skillet
3. Bake until tomatoes and garlic are very soft , 1 hour
4. Cool 10 minutes
5. Coarsley chop tomatoes and garlic mixture
6. Transfer to a serving bowl
7. Serve with tostitos or foccacia

title: cheddar ale pub spread
steps:
1. Place cheeses in food processor or blender , process until smooth
2. Gradually add ale , mustard and cayenne pepper
3. If mixture is soft , refrigerate until firm enough to hold shape
4. Mould into a disc shape
5. Combine pecans and parsley
6. Pat the mixture onto the ball or roll the ball in the mixture until the cheese mixture is covered completely
7. Place on a serving plate or board and surround with crackers or flatbreads
8. Slices of apple are nice with this too

title: peanutty caramel bars
steps:
1. In a large bowl , heat caramels , water and 1 / 2 cup peanut butter on high for 1 minute , stir
2. Microwave 1-2 minutes longer or until melted
3. Add cereal and peanuts
4. Stir until coated
5. Spread into a greased 13x9x2-in pan
6. Set aside
7. In another bowl , heat chips , butter and remaining peanut butter on high for 30-60 seconds or until melted
8. Spread over cereal mixture
9. Chill before cutting

title: brownie bowls cups
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees
2. Melt butter
3. In a medium bowl mix melted butter with beaten eggs
4. In a separate small bowl mix dry ingredients
5. Add dry ingredients to butter and eggs and mix well
6. Use 5 small glass baking bowls or coffee mugs that are safe in the oven , grease them with cooking spray or shortening
7. Add batter to each evenly
8. Take a 9x13 pan and add one inch of hot water
9. Add cups to pan and place in oven
10. Bake for 45 minute or until set on top
11. Eat right out of the bowl or cup and enjoy !
12. May top with whipped cream or ice cream
13. Enjoy !

title: crock pot cheesy hash browns
steps:
1. Put hashbrowns , onion , and peas in crock
2. Then put in seasonings next and cheese and milk
3. Cover and cook on low 6-8 hours , or high 3-4 hours

title: black and blue mojito
steps:
1. In a shaker , muddle mint leaves , blackberries , lime juice and sugar
2. Add rum , blue curacao and mix well
3. Add ice shake 4-5 times and quickly strain over ice
4. Add club soda and stir well
5. Garnish with blackberries , lime or mint sprig
6. Drink up and enjoy !

title: roasted italian sausage and potatoes with mushrooms and peppers
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Combine herbs , olive oil , salt , pepper and potatoes and toss to mix
3. Place sausages and potatoes in large baking or roasting pan
4. Roast at 400 for 30 minutes , or until just beginning to brown , turning several times
5. Add a little more oil if the potatoes appear to be drying out
6. Add remaining vegetables and roast 45 minutes more , turning occasionally , until potatoes are brown on the outside and tender on the inside
7. Sprinkle with mozzarella and return to oven just until cheese is melted

title: english beef soup  beef   split pea
steps:
1. Combine cold water , top round cut in small pieces and salt in a 4-quart soup pot
2. Bring to a boil slowly , skim thorougly and add barley , split peas and peppercorns
3. Cover and simmer gently for 1 1 / 2 hours
4. Add chopped onions , carrots and celery and simmer 1 / 2 hour longer , stirring frequently
5. To serve , sprinkle with chopped parsley

title: yelllow squash casserole
steps:
1. Line 8x8 baking dish with half of pepperidge farm dressing
2. Cook squash , carrots and onion in just enough water to cover until tender
3. Drain well
4. Mix sour cream and soup and add drained veggies
5. Pour on top of dressing and top with more dressing
6. Bake at 350 degrees for 1 / 2 hour

title: bounty balls  just like eating a bounty  copycat
steps:
1. Mix the condensed milk and coconut together
2. Add enough icing sugar to form a stiff dough which will form into balls
3. Form small balls and leave to set on a tray until all the mixture is used
4. Place the tray into the refrigerator to set
5. Coat the ball in melted chocolate and leave to set
6. This is just like eating bounty bars
7. Time is setting time
8. Minimum would be 4 hours

title: italian scalloped potatoes
steps:
1. In greased cassarole arrange half the potatoes , onions , mozzerella and parmesean cheese
2. Repeat the layers
3. In a small bowl , combine soup , milk , seasoning and garlic
4. Pour over the layered potatoes and cheese
5. Cover and bake at 400 f or 200 c for 1 hour
6. Uncover and bake 10 more minutes or until potatoes are tender

title: banana  split
steps:
1. Bread: grease and flour 1 loaf pan
2. Mix together dry ingredients
3. Cream butter and sugar until fluffy
4. Add eggs one at time
5. Scrape bowl
6. Add dry ingredients , then fold in mashed banana
7. Bake at 350 degrees for about 40 minutes
8. The outside of the bread will get quite dark , but test with a toothpick for doneness in the center
9. Let cool in pan for 15 minutes then turn out of pan
10. Ganach: while bread is baking
11. Put chocolate chips in a small bowl
12. Heat cream and sugar until just about to boil
13. Pour over the chips and let set for 1 minutes
14. Whisk together until all chocolate is melted
15. If the chocolate doesn't melt completely , microwave for 20 seconds and stir again
16. Repeat until all is melted
17. Set aside at room temperature
18. Pineapple: while bread is baking
19. Mix together , pineapple , vanilla and zest in a small bowl
20. Set aside at room temperature
21. Walnuts: at the end of the bread baking
22. Bring the sugar and water to a boil
23. Add the walnuts and let simmer for 5 minutes
24. Drain the nuts and spread evenly on a cookie sheet
25. Once bread is done , roast in the oven at 325 degrees , for about 20 minutes
26. Stir one or twice
27. Check often , to make sure they are not burning
28. The are done when they "snap" in the center
29. Crunchy all the way through
30. Assembly: peel bananas , and slice in half length ways
31. Slice banana bread to desired thickness and place one plate or in bowl
32. Lay a banana half over or next to bread
33. Top with two or three small scoops of ice cream
34. Top each scoop if ice cream with chocolate ganach , crushed pineapple , chopped candied walnuts , and whipped cream
35. Enjoy !
36. All the toppings can be made up to 5 days in advance
37. The pineapple can be used cold or warm
38. To reheat ganach either place in a sauce pan over very low heat and stir constantly until just hot enough to pour or microwave at 30 second intervals stirring after each one
39. Do not over heat ! the walnuts can be stored in an airtight container at room temperature you will have left over banana bread

title: honey bun cake
steps:
1. Combine all the cake ingredients and set aside
2. Thoroughly combine the filling ingredients
3. Pour half of the cake mix batter into baking pan and top with the filling ingredients
4. Pour the rest of the cake batter on top
5. Bake at 350 degrees f
6. For 38-40 minutes in a 13x9" greased baking pan or bundt cake pan
7. Meanwhile prepare the sugar glaze
8. Cool cake on wire rack
9. Make sure you have something under the rack to catch the glaze though
10. While still warm , poke holes in the cake and pour the glaze over it
11. Enjoy !

title: fillet of pork with mustard cream
steps:
1. Melt butter in a large frypan over medium-low heat and cook onions for 3-4 minutes or until softened
2. Remove from pan and set aside
3. Add pork to pan and cook in batches over high heat until lightly browned
4. Return onions to pan and stir in the flour and cook for 1 minute
5. Gradually stir in wine and chicken stock mixing until well blended
6. Add mustards and cook over medium heat , stirring constantly , for 3-4 minutes until sauce boils and thickens
7. Stir in cream , mushrooms and tarragon , season with salt and pepper and cook for 4-5 minutes or until heated through
8. Toss sauce through cooked pasta and serve immediately

title: spiced and candied vegetarian bacon
steps:
1. Set your oven at 300f
2. Mix the chili powder and brown sugar in a bowl , stirring to mix completely
3. Place parchment paper on a baking sheet or spray sheet pan with cooking spray
4. Coat both sides of the bacon well with spice mix
5. I patted it on
6. Lay the coated bacon on the parchment paper
7. Bake 10-15 minutes
8. Remove immediately to a plate
9. My bacon stuck to the paper when i left it to cool and i had to heat it up to unstick it from the paper
10. The bacon will crisp up as it cools
11. Enjoy !

title: mushrooms stuffed with spinach and cheese
steps:
1. Wipe clean mushrooms
2. Remove stems and dice them
3. Heat a pan place oil in it and when hot add stems , onions , garlic and cook 5 minutes
4. Add spinach , salt , pepper , pepper flakes , rosemary cook 3 minutes stirring till wilted
5. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
6. Add ricotta cheese to spinach and toss till combined
7. Fill mushrooms with spinach / cheese mixture
8. Place caps on a greased pan and top with shredded cheese
9. Bake mushrooms 20 minutes
10. Place mushroom on a platter and serve

title: pool mix
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together
2. Store in airtight containers

title: roasted red pepper bisque  soup
steps:
1. In large pot , heat clarified butter and sweat celery , onion , leeks and garlic until tender
2. Add roasted red peppers and tomato paste
3. Cook briefly then add roux and cook until roux is softened and hot
4. Add chicken stock and mix well with wire whip to avoid lumps
5. Continue to stir until soup comes to a boil
6. Reduce to a simmer and let simmer until roasted red peppers break down
7. Add heavy cream and crumbled chevre cheese and again bring to a boil
8. Place soup in blender and puree until smooth
9. Adjust seasoning with salt and white pepper
10. Strain soup through china cap

title: goat cheese in olive oil
steps:
1. Place garlic and shallots in bottom of a wide necked glass preserving jar
2. Layer goat cheeses alternating with sprigs of herbs
3. Push juniper berries and bay leaves down sides in decorative pattern and cover completely with olive oil
4. Cover and let marinate 1 week to 1 month in the refrigerator
5. Enjoy !

title: my easy irish stew
steps:
1. First mix the lamb with the seasoned flour and fry in a little oil until well browned
2. Then add the veggies and stir until well mixed with the lamb , add the stock and baylef and bring to the boil
3. Turn the heat down very low , cover with a lid and simmer quietly for 1 1 / 2 hours
4. Add some of the chopped parsley just before serving
5. Serve sprinkling some more of the chopped parsley on top

title: lite multiberry muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Place paper liners in muffin tins or spray with pam
3. In a large bowl combine the flour , sugar , baking powder , baking soda , salt and cinnamon
4. Mix together the milk and egg substitute
5. Make a well in the center of the flour mixture and pour the milk and egg mixture into the well along with the applesauce and vegetable oil
6. Stir quickly just to combine
7. Gently fold in berries
8. Spoon the batter into the cups , filling each one almost to the top
9. Bake about 20 minutes , until brown and crusty

title: saskatoon pie filling
steps:
1. Boil together the water and lemon juice
2. Add the saskatoons , and bring to a boil again
3. Mix the sugar with the cornstarch thoroughly
4. Add the sugar / cornstarch mixture to the saskatoons
5. Stir and cook until juice is thickened and clear
6. Pour in sterilized quart or pint jars
7. Seal
8. Process in hot water bath for 20 minutes for quarts or 15 minutes for pints

title: fritos dip recipe
steps:
1. Mix and chill
2. Serve with frito scoops

title: black beans and brown rice
steps:
1. Cook the brown rice in salted water or broth for 40 minutes
2. You will have two and a half cups of cooked rice
3. Transfer the rice to a microwave proof dish
4. Add the chopped onion , lime juice and drained beans to the rice
5. Crush the clove of garlic into the mixture , then salt and pepper to taste
6. Combine ingredients well , and reheat in the microwave for about 6-8 minutes , then garnish with reserved cilantro to serve

title: black bean and corn salad   ww core
steps:
1. In a small bowl , mix together vinaigrette , seasoned pepper , cilantro , cayenne pepper , and cumin
2. Set dressing aside
3. In a large bowl , stir together beans , corn , onion , green onions , and red bell pepper
4. Toss with dressing
5. Cover , and refrigerate overnight
6. Toss again before serving

title: chocolate cranberry bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. In a medium mixing bowl , combine wafer crumbs , cocoa and sugar
3. Cut in butter until crumbly
4. Press mixture evenly on bottom and 1 / 2 inch up sides of ungreased 13x9 inch baking pan
5. Pour sweetened condensed milk over crumb mixture
6. Sprinkle evenly with dried cranberries , chips and nuts
7. Press down firmly
8. Bake 25-30 minutes or until lightly browned
9. Cool completely in pan on wire rack
10. Cover with foil
11. Let stand fro several hours
12. Cut into bars
13. Store covered at room temperature

title: toffee coffee cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Grease a 9 x 13 pan
3. In a large bowl , mix together the cake mix , oil , coffee , chocolate chips and eggs
4. Press half the mixture into the bottom of prepared pan
5. Bake 8 minutes
6. In the top of a double boiler , heat the butter , caramels , coffee , and condensed milk until caramels are melted
7. Pour over partially baked crust
8. Sprinkle with 1 / 2 cup pecans
9. Drop the remaining cookie dough by small spoonfuls over the caramel layer
10. Sprinkle with chopped toffee bars and remaining 1 / 2 cup pecans
11. Bake an additional 25-30 minutes
12. Coll and cut into squares

title: fragrant sesame dressing for orzo salad
steps:
1. Cook orzo according to directions on box
2. Mix all other ingredients and blend over pasta and chill
3. Add raisins , shredded carrots , and pine nuts , and mix gently

title: wanda s cut out christmas cookies
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl , cream sugar and butter until fluffy
2. Add oil , vanilla and eggs
3. Mix well
4. Stir in dry ingredients
5. Mix well
6. Cover and chill for at least 2 hours
7. Preheat oven to 375
8. Roll out dough on a lightly floured surface to about 1 / 4 inch thickness
9. Cut out dough with cookie cutters and place on an ungreased cookie sheet
10. Bake 5-8 minutes or until lightly browned
11. Cool on wire racks
12. Decorate with frosting or sprinkles of your choice

title: pecan cheesecake cookies
steps:
1. Cream the butter and cream cheese
2. Add the egg yolk , lemon rind , and vanilla , beating well at medium speed of an electric mixer
3. Combine the flour sugar , and salt
4. Add to the creamed mixture , beating well
5. Cover and chill thoroughly
6. Shape the dough into 1 inch balls
7. Beat the egg white until foamy
8. Dip each ball of dough into the egg white
9. Roll in the chopped pecans
10. Place 2 inches apart on an ungreased cookie sheet
11. Press your thumb into each ball of dough , leaving an indention
12. Bake at 325 degrees for 12 to 15 minutes or until lightly browned
13. Transfer cookies to a wire rack and fill each cookie with jam
14. Let cool completely

title: lime grilled corn  not for sissies
steps:
1. Peel back husks
2. Scrub and rinse corn removing silk
3. Place in sink or large pot
4. Cover with water and soak 2-4 hours
5. Drain well
6. Peel back husks
7. Mix sea salt and lime peel
8. Rub butter on corn
9. Sprinkle with lime salt
10. Dice jalapenos--seeds and all
11. Sprinkle each ear with jalapenos
12. Wrap up with husks
13. Secure husks with foil
14. Grill 12-15 minutes
15. Remove husks carefully
16. Mix chili powder and remaining butter
17. Add to corn
18. Squeeze lime juice , if desired

title: sopapillas rudd
steps:
1. Mix flour , baking powder and salt
2. Cut in shortening until coarse
3. Mix in water until smooth
4. Knead lightly
5. Roll out and cut into squares
6. Fry until golden in hot oil

title: individual pecan tartlets
steps:
1. To prepare crust , cream butter and sugar , then add remaining ingredients
2. Divide mixture evenly into each compartment of a miniature muffin tin , press into place , and bake at 350 degrees for 5 minutes
3. To prepare filling , place butter , corn syrup and powdered sugar into pot and bring to a boil
4. Remove from heat and stir in chopped pecans
5. Spoon filling into baked shells , topping each tartlet with pecan half
6. Bake at 400 degrees for 8 to 10 minutes

title: chicken tortilla bake
steps:
1. In a bowl , combine chicken , chilies , broth , soups& onion
2. Set aside
3. Cut or tear tortillas into 3-4 inch pieces and layer half on the bottom of a greased 13x9 inch pan
4. Top with half the chicken mixture and half the cheese
5. Repeat layers
6. Bake , uncovered 30-40 minutes at 350 degrees

title: tikka marinade
steps:
1. Mix all the ingredients
2. In a glass bowl or shallow dish add marinade to 4 servings of food
3. Cover and refrigerate for 4 hours
4. Makes about 1 / 3 cup

title: saffron salt
steps:
1. In clean spice or coffee grinder , pulse together salt , saffron and 1 / 2 tsp water until vibrant yellow with a few saffron threads intact
2. Store in dark glass or nonreactive airtight container in cool dark place for up to 1 month

title: bbq porcupine meatballs
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 350
2. Mix together ground beef , rice , onion and salt in a bowl
3. Shape into 10-12 balls and place into a baking dish
4. In a saucepan , heat bbq sauce , tomato soup , water and brown sugar to a boil so the sugar dissolves
5. Pour sauce over the meatballs
6. Bake for 1 1 / 2 hours

title: asparagus finger salad
steps:
1. Snap off and discard woody bases from the asparagus
2. Cook asparagus , covered , in a small amount of boiling water for 2-4 minutes , till crisp tender
3. Move asparagus to a bowl filled with ice water
4. Set aside
5. For dipping sauce , combine sour cream , lemon juice , chives , tarragon , salt and pepper in a bowl
6. To serve , cut center vein from each lettuce leaf , keeping the leaf in one piece
7. Place lettuce leaves on a serving plat
8. Pat asparagus dry with paper towels
9. Cut each carrot half into 4 equal lenghtwise strips
10. Divide asparagus and carrot strips evenly across middle of lettuce
11. Sprinkle each serving with finely shedded lemon peel
12. Wrap lettuce around asparagus and carrots
13. Put each asparagus salad upright in a small cup
14. Serve or drizzle with dipping sauce
15. Makes 4 servings

title: german kielbasa and potatoes
steps:
1. Peel potatoes and place in lightly salted water to cover in a saucepan
2. Cook at a medium boil till barely tender , 15 to 18 minutes
3. Meanwhile , in a large heavy skillet , cook the bacon strips to desired crispness and remove bacon to absorbent paper
4. You should have at least 3 tbs
5. Of drippings in the skillet
6. Saute the onions in the dripping over medium-low heat until golden
7. Heat the remaining ingredients to boiling
8. Drain and thickly slice the potatoes while still warm
9. Add to the onions in the skillet and turn gently to coat with drippings
10. Reduce heat to low and pour the hot dressing over all and again , turn gently to coat evenly
11. Cut sausage into 1-2 inch slices and briefly saut in a bit oil , till browned slightly
12. Add sausage slices to skillet and turn gently to coat evenly
13. Chop bacon to desired size and add to skillet
14. Sprinkle with fresh parsley and serve hot or warm

title: turkey breakfast sausage
steps:
1. Place meat in a medium sized bowl
2. Add spices to water and blend well
3. Pour spice blend over meat and mix well
4. Make into patties of desired shape
5. Cook until center is no longer pink

title: crunchy sweet and sour salad
steps:
1. Melt butter in skillet and brown walnuts & ramen noodles
2. Cool on paper towels
3. Combine browned noodles and walnuts with broccoli , lettuce , and onions in large serving bowl
4. Whisk remaining four ingredients together in mixing bowl
5. Dress salad when ready to serve

title: melon salad with orange lime dressing
steps:
1. Combine lime zest , lime juice , orange juice concentrate , and vanilla in small bowl
2. Set aside
3. Cut melon in half
4. Slice each half into 1-inch wedges
5. Trim away rind
6. Cut melon into 3 / 4-inch pieces
7. Combine fruit and dressing

title: pot pie cupcakes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Saute onion , celery , carrots in margarine for 10 minutes
3. Add flour to sauteed mixture , stirring well , cook one minute stirring constantly
4. Combine broth and milk and gradually stir into vegetable mixture
5. Add canned / frozen veggies to mixture
6. Cook over medium heat stirring constantly until thickened and bubbly
7. Remove from heat
8. Stir in salt , pepper and chicken
9. Once filling of your choice is prepared , grease a cupcake pan and push wrappers down , fill with mixture and swipe all edges with egg
10. Close them up the best you can !
11. Bake for about 20-25 minutes

title: delicious taco soup
steps:
1. Brown ground beef & drain grease if necessary
2. Add all canned ingredients and salsa
3. Simmer for 10 minutes
4. Optional: serve topped with cheese & tortilla chips to scoop it up !

title: ancient egyptian melokhia soup
steps:
1. Put all the ingredients in a pan with a thick bottom for two hours and let it become broth
2. Cut the little pieces of chicken and / or lamb and put them in the soup
3. Cut the spinach or melokhia in little rips and put them also in the soup
4. Put a little sunflower or olive oil in the baking pan
5. Squeeze the strings garlic in the pan and bake them until they are gold-brown of color
6. Then put the harissa and coriander in it
7. Now put the spicy paste in the soup
8. Always keep mixing
9. Make sure the melokhia or spinach doesn't become overdone
10. Serve it with turkish bread

title: raspberry stuffed french toast
steps:
1. Cut the bread into 12 slices and put 6 plates in the oven to warm at 200
2. Whisk the eggs until foamy
3. Add the milk , cream , salt , vanilla and sugar and whisk to blend
4. Pour into a sheet pan with sides
5. Arrange the bread slices in the pan in a single layer and let soak
6. Meanwhile , using a sharp knife , slice the cream cheese into 12 thin slices
7. Heat a large skillet or griddle over medium-high heat
8. Add about 1 tablespoon of butter and heat until melted and foamy
9. Working in two batches , if necessary , arrange half the soaked bread slices in the skillet
10. Cook until golden brown , 3-5 minutes
11. Lay 2 slices of cream cheese on each slice of bread , then place 1 / 6 of the raspberries on top of the cheese
12. Cover each with another slice of soaked bread and press firmly with a spatula
13. Turn the'sandwich' over and brown on the other side , about 3 minutes more
14. Transfer to warmed plates , sprinkle lightly with confectioners' sugar and serve

title: crab cocktail salad
steps:
1. Pick over the crabmeat and discard any bits of shell
2. Mix the mayonnaise with the ketchup , tabasco , mustard , lemon juice , and tarragon
3. Stir in the crab and spring onions
4. Taste and play around with the balance of flavourings until you get a perfect balance
5. This can be mixed together an hour or two before serving , but bring back to room temperature before assembling the finished cocktail and serving
6. Remove the outer leaves of the little gem lettuces and shred the rest thinly
7. Place in a plastic bag and leave in the fridge until almost ready to serve
8. Take 4-6 sundae glasses or old-fashioned champagne glasses
9. Divide the lettuce between the glasses and top with the crab cocktail
10. Serve straight away

title: bacon potato bundles
steps:
1. Place the potatoes on four pieces of greased heavy duty aluminum foil
2. Place onion and green pepper between potatoes to quarters
3. Top with bacon
4. Sprinkle with salt and pepper
5. Wrap in foil
6. Grill , covered
7. Over med-high heat for 40-50 minutes or until potatoes are tender , turning once

title: chicken salad deluxe
steps:
1. Combine salad dressing , mayonnaise , half and half , seasoning , salt and pepper in a small bowl , blend , cover , refrigerate overnight to blend flavors
2. Place chicken , onion slices , carrot & celery in dutch oven , add enough cold water to cover
3. Cover , bring to boil , reduce heat to low , simmer 7 minutes until chicken is no longer pink
4. Drain chicken , discarding vegetables and liquid , refrigerate chicken until cool , cut chicken into 1 / 2" pieces
5. Cook shells until al dente' , drain , cover and refrigerate until chilled
6. Combine chicken , shells , dicedcelery , grapes , almonds , water chestnuts & chopped onion in a large bowl , pour dressing over , toss gently to coat
7. Serve on lettuce-lined plates , garnish if desired
8. Serve with cantaloupe slices

title: cocamocha rum cafe   regular and diabetic directions given
steps:
1. Add the milk to a 2 cup glass measuring cup
2. Stir in the cocoa
3. If using sugar stir that in at this time
4. Place in the microwave and heat while stirring every 30 seconds until steaming and beginning to bubble , cocoa should be well incorporated
5. Remove from microwave
6. Add the hot coffee
7. If using splenda add it now
8. Add the run extract and stir to mix well
9. Top with whipped cream if desired and serve

title: harissa spaghettini recipe
steps:
1. Bring a big pot of water to a boil
2. In the meantime , place the cloves of garlic on a cutting board and sprinkle then with a big pinch of salt
3. Crush with the flat side of a knife
4. Now crush and chop , crush and chop until you have a garlic paste
5. Alternately , you can use a mortar and pestle
6. In a small bowl whisk together the garlic paste , harissa , and olive oil
7. Set aside
8. Generously salt the boiling water , add the pasta , and cook per package instructions
9. Just before the pasta is done add the kale to the pasta water , count to six , drain and set aside
10. Heat half of the harissa dressing in the now empty pasta pot add the pasta and kale , black olives , pine nuts , and lemon zest
11. Stir over the heat for a minute or so , then turn everything out onto a platter and drizzle with the remaining harissa olive oil

title: bill s roasted vegetables
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees
2. Toss together garlic and next 9 ingredients
3. Place in lightly greased 15x10 inch jellyroll pan or casserole dish
4. Bake for 15 minutes , then stir in green beans
5. Bake 15 more minutes

title: sauerkraut dip
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients until moist
2. Refrigerate overnight
3. Serve with crackers

title: stuffed celery
steps:
1. Put cream cheese and mayonnaise in a small bowl
2. Mix until well blended , i use a fork
3. Stir in onions and pecans
4. Fill celery with mixture
5. This makes filling the celery easier and it looks pretty
6. The

title: toddler curried veggies
steps:
1. Peel carrots and dice very small
2. Dice zucchini very small
3. Peel apple and dice very small
4. The younger they are the smaller you dice
5. Put these in a pot and cover with water
6. Add the curry powder and chicken stock powder
7. Cook for at least 20 minutes until carrot is soft / tender
8. I usually serve drained in a madagascar bowl with a glass of water and cheese sandwich :)

title: honey hoisin bbq salmon
steps:
1. Rub the marinade all over salmon and marinate for 2 hours
2. Preheat grill to medium high
3. Place marinated salmon skin side down on grill and cook for 5 to 6 minutes until skin is crisp and easy to lift from grill
4. Turn fillets over and baste liberally with honey hoisin bbq glaze
5. Continue to cook for another 4 to 5 minutes for medium doneness
6. Turn fillets over and baste meat side liberally with the glaze before removing from grill
7. You may cook this in the oven if you so desire

title: chicken and black bean chili  crock pot
steps:
1. Heat oil in skillet over medium heat
2. Cook chicken until no longer pink
3. Using slotted spoon , remove chicken from pan , and transfer to crock pot
4. Add all remaining ingredients , and cook on low for 4-6 hours , or high for 2-3 hours

title: salmon steaks poached in lemon broth
steps:
1. Place lemon juice and chicken broth in medium saucepan with cover
2. Add raw salmon steaks
3. Bring liquid to slow boil over medium-low heat
4. Reduce heat slightly , cover , and simmer 5 minutes
5. Flip salmon over , cover , and continue to simmer 5 more minutes or until salmon is cooked through

title: leftover ham stuff
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to package directions
2. When pasta is almost done , add frozen peas
3. Let pasta and peas return to boiling point
4. Cook until peas are heated through
5. Drain pasta and peas , return to pan
6. Add contents of cheese packet and margarine , mixing well
7. Then add ham , milk and shredded cheddar cheese , stirring well
8. Serve and enjoy

title: texas rockets  jalapeno
steps:
1. In a medium bowl combine the cheeses , cilantro , sundried tomatoes and corn kernels together
2. Cut jalapeno peppers lengthwise down 1 side , leaving the other side intact
3. Leave the top and stem on
4. Using the handle of a spoon scrape the seeds and membranes out of the pepper
5. Spoon 2 tablespoons of the cheese mixture into the cavity of each pepper
6. Wrap each pepper in bacon and secure it in place with a wooden toothpick
7. Prepare your barbecue
8. Place a drip pan under barbeque grates to prevent flare ups
9. Place a grill screen over the drip pan directly on top of the grill grate
10. Preheat barbeque to medium heat 325f
11. Oil the grill grate to help prevent sticking
12. Place the stuffed peppers onto the grill plate and cook with the lid up for 15-20 minutes or until the bacon is crispy
13. Turn the peppers frequently for even cooking

title: breaded baked pork chops
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Rinse chops & pat dry with paper towels
3. Sprinkle both sides of chops with garlic powder , onion powder and salt & pepper
4. For easy clean-up , spread a long sheet of waxed paper across work surface
5. Place flour on a paper plate , beaten egg in a shallow bowl , & seasoned bread crumbs on another paper plate
6. Line 'em up on the waxed paper
7. Pre-heat a large skillet over medium high heat
8. When skillet is hot , add 1 / 2 the olive oil
9. Lightly dredge the chops in flour , dusting off excess
10. Dip chops into beaten eggs
11. Coat heavily with bread crumbs , turning & pressing to get a good , heavy crumb crust
12. In skillet , brown chops well over medium high heat , using extra olive oil if necessary
13. Transfer browned chops , in a single layer , to a 9 x 13" baking dish
14. Cover tightly with foil and bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour
15. While chops are baking , whisk together the soup , milk , and either wine or chicken stock
16. We prefer the chicken stock
17. After 1 hour , remove foil from pan being careful to avoid burns from steam
18. Pour soup mixture evenly over chops
19. Re-cover tightly with foil and return to oven for 30 minutes
20. I serve this with lots of mashed potatoes for soaking up the "gravy" , and tiny sweet green peas

title: tarragon shrimp scampi
steps:
1. Heat butter and oil in a skillet , add garlic
2. Add shrimp and cook until pink , about 2 minutes
3. Add wine and half of tarragon , simmer until shrimp are pink
4. Stir in remaining tarragon , salt and pepper to taste

title: lemon chicken spaghetti
steps:
1. In a large skillet , saute the chicken , onions and garlic in oil until chicken is no longer pink
2. Remove the chicken with a slotted spoon
3. Keep warm
4. Add the broth to the skillet
5. Bring to a boil and cook until reduce by half
6. Reduce heat
7. Add cream
8. Cook and stir for 5 minutes
9. Cook spaghetti according to pkg
10. Directions
11. Add peas , tomatoes , parmesan cheese and chicken to the cream mixture
12. Heat through
13. Drain spaghetti
14. Toss with chicken mixture
15. Sprinkle with lemon peel and lemon-pepper

title: no fuss brown rice   crock pot
steps:
1. Coat slow cooker with vegetable oil spray
2. Add rice , butter and salt to prepared slow cooker then stir in boiling water
3. Cover and cook unil rice is tender , about 2 hours on high
4. Fluff rice with fork and season with salt and pepper to taste
5. Drape towel over the top of slow cooker , cover with lid and let sit for 5 minutes before serving

title: seared scallops and spinach salad
steps:
1. Rinse the scallops and pat them dry
2. Mix the flour and seasoning of your choice in a plastic bag
3. Add the scallops and toss to coat
4. Heat the oil in a skillet to medium heat
5. Sear the scallops until browned and opaque , about 5 minutes , turning once
6. Remove the scallops from the skillet and keep them warm
7. Add the spinach and carrots to the skillet
8. Sprinkle with water
9. Cover the skillet and cook on medium-high until the spinach starts to wilt , about 2 minutes
10. Add the balsamic vinegar and toss to coat evenly
11. Spoon the spinach and carrots onto four plates and top with the seared scallops

title: citrus muffins
steps:
1. In mixer or food processor , mix the peels of grapefruit and orange with the buttermilk until the peels are finely chopped
2. Add sugar , salt and butter and beat well
3. In a bowl , mix flour , baking powder and baking soda
4. Add the mixture of buttermilk and mix until the mixture is wet , but do not mix too much
5. Spread the mixture in 12 greased muffins tins
6. Cook in a preheated oven of 375 f 20 to 25 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the muffins comes out clean
7. Let cool on a rack for about 5 minutes
8. Remove from the pan and let cool completely

title: mango avocado soup
steps:
1. In a blender , process all ingredients till combined but still slightly chunky
2. Chill and serve , garnished with chopped chives or green onion tops

title: maryland cream of crab soup
steps:
1. In a saucepan over medium heat melt the butter , add old bay , minced onion , lemon juice , and stir thoroughly
2. Add the flour , stirring constantly , and then gradually add the light cream , continuing to stir
3. Add the crabmeat and let simmer for about 15 minutes
4. Do not allow the soup to boil
5. Serve garnished with a dash of old bay and parsley flakes

title: linda s lime jello salad
steps:
1. Pour lime jello in a 9x13 pyrex dish
2. Add 3 cups boiling water and stir until dissolved
3. While jello is still hot , stir in marshmallows and cream cheese pieces
4. Chill for one hour
5. Whip cream until stiff
6. Drain pineapple
7. Remove jello from fridge , fold in pineapple , walnuts and whipped cream until well blended
8. Chill for 3-6 hours or overnight

title: frozen fruit and veggie smoothie
steps:
1. Using an immersion blender , or regular blender , blend frozen fruits , banana , and ice until smooth
2. Add in spinach a little at a time , blending thoroughly after each addition
3. Sweeten to taste
4. Serve immediately

title: ultimate steak house pizza
steps:
1. Grill steak to rare to medium / rare
2. Cover , set aside
3. Hopefully , you have some left over caramelized onions and mushrooms
4. If not , make some 8-)
5. Preheat oven to 425
6. Sprinkle some cornmeal on a heavy sheet pan or clay pizza baking pan
7. Place 3 pieces of naan on sheet pan
8. On each , place 1 / 3 of the jack and gorgonzola cheeses
9. Divide the onions , mushrooms , and of the basil , and all of the parmesan
10. Bake for 15-20 minutes , until bubbly and caramelized
11. Slice steak thinly , and cut into bite-sized pieces
12. Add to top of pizza
13. Sprinkle with chopped red pepper and remaining fresh basil , and add a little more pepper
14. Cut into 6 pieces and enjoy !

title: hot german potato salad
steps:
1. Dice and fry bacon
2. In a small bowl , add eggs , salt , mustard , sugar , vinegar and cayenne pepper
3. Beat well and pour into hot pan with bacon and bacon grease stirring till thickened
4. Add diced cooked potatoes and sliced onion
5. Serve hot

title: limoncello tira mi su  tiramisu
steps:
1. Whip whites and cup sugar until stiff peaks form
2. Mix yolks with remaining sugar , add mascarpone cheese , lemon oil and lemon zest
3. Mix well making sure that there are no lumps
4. Fold in whites
5. Combine the four cups of limoncello liquor with the 2 cups of simple syrup
6. After dipping the lady fingers in the mixture form one layer of lady fingers at bottom spread a layer of the lemon mascarpone on top repeat once
7. Reserve leftover limoncello mixture
8. You should let the tira mi su set for at least 2 hours before serving , overnight is ideal
9. Candied lemon chips:
10. Slice lemon into very thin slices dip into 3 cups simple syrup lay flat on silk pad lined sheet tray and bake at 200f until crisp , about 2 hours
11. Candied kumquats:
12. Cut kumquats in half and remove pits
13. Place in pot with 3 cups simple syrup and let simmer slowly , cook the kumquats until they become translucent
14. Take left over limoncello and simple syrup mixture and add 1 teaspoons of cornstarch for a sauce to garnish the plate

title: 5 minute bread  pizza
steps:
1. 1
2. Cover the top of your pizza stone or , if you dont have one , the inside of a cookie sheet with a good dusting of flour
3. 2
4. Pre-heat your oven to 425 degrees f
5. 3
6. Pour 3 tablespoons of evoo into a small bowl
7. 4
8. Cut out a chunk of your 5-minute bread dough , big enough to be the size somewhere in between a baseball and a softball
9. 5
10. With your fingers flatten the dough to fit on top of your pizza stone or cookie sheet
11. From this point on , the crust will remain on the stone or cookie sheet until the pizza is done
12. 6
13. With a pastry brush , cover the top of the flattened dough with a thin layer of the olive oil
14. 7
15. Turn the dough over and brush the other side with olive oil
16. 8
17. Partially bake the dough for about 7 minutes and take it out of the oven
18. 9
19. Using a large spoon or a ladle , spread the pizza sauce on top of the partially-baked crust and cover it as evenly as possible to within one inch of the edges
20. 10
21. Distribute the rest of the ingredients all over the top of the pizza sauce
22. Be creative , my grandchildren like it when i make smiling faces with the pepperoni , black olives and the peppers
23. 11
24. Cover the top of the pizza completely with the mozzarella all the way to the edge
25. 12
26. Place the pizza stone or cookie sheet in the 425 degree oven and bake for approximately 20 minutes or until the cheese is bubbly and the edges of the crust have turned a dark , golden brown
27. If the edges are very light , this may mean that the center of the crust is still raw
28. 13
29. Take the pizza out of the oven and place it on a fire-resistant surface
30. Let it rest for approximately 10 minutes , slice and enjoy !

title: kachman s sour cabbage rolls
steps:
1. In a small pot heat oil
2. Add bacon and onion
3. Cook , stirring over med heat until onions are opaque and bacon is soft
4. Add dill and salt
5. Remove from heat and add to cooked rice
6. Let cool , this is the filling
7. Remove and separate cabbage leaves from head
8. Cut out hard core
9. Grease casserole dish
10. Place 1 tbsp of filling on widest end of leaf
11. Fold sides in and roll up
12. Filling should not be hanging out
13. Place in casserole dish creating layers
14. Combine water and oil and pour over cabbage rolls
15. Cover with lid or tinfoil
16. Bake in a 325f oven 2 - 21 / 2 hours
17. You'll have to keep an eye on them to check that they don't dry out or turn brown
18. If they are turning color add more liquid
19. And bake till tender
20. Freezes well before cooking
21. I like to place a couple of pieces of raw bacon on the top of the cabbage rolls before cooking
22. Also i have made 1 / 2 a head of cabbage into rolls and froze the other 1 / 2 of head whole , with no problems

title: snow crab dip
steps: 1. Mix all ingredients together , let it set in refridgerator overnight and serve with ritz crackers

title: coffee and vinegar pot roast
steps:
1. Refrigerate and marinate roast in plastic bag with vinegar , 24-48 hours
2. Remove meat and set marinade aside
3. Pat dry with paper towels
4. Brown the roast in a heavy pot until nearly burned on both sides
5. Add the coffee and water and scrape up any browned bits
6. Add bay leaves , peppercorns and salt
7. Simmer until tender , about 3 1 / 2 hours , turning several times
8. Remove meat from pot
9. Add reserved marinade and reduce to about 3 cups
10. Season with salt and pepper to taste
11. Thinly slice the roast and return it to the pot
12. Reduce heat to low and cook another 30 minutes

title: penne russo a la vodka with basil cream sauce
steps:
1. Cook pasta in a large pot of boiling lightly salted water for about 8-10 minutes or until al dente and then drain
2. Heat oil in large skillet or wok over medium heat
3. Saute garlic , prosciutto , and red pepper flakes for 1 minute
4. Stir in tomatoes and tomato paste and cook for 3 minutes
5. Stir in vodka and cream and simmer for 15 minutes
6. Stir in parmesan and chopped basil
7. Add pasta and toss until evenly coated
8. Serve with additional parmesan cheese if desired

title: creamy cranberry coffee cake
steps:
1. In a big mixing bowl , mix together the first four ingredients
2. In another smaller bowl , mix together the egg , orange juice , butter and vanilla
3. Add to the dry ingredients and stir until combined
4. Fold in the cranberries and orange peel
5. Pour mixture into a greased 9-inch springform pan
6. In a mixing bowl , add the cream cheese and sugar
7. Beat until smooth and creamy
8. Add the egg and vanilla
9. Stir to mix well
10. Spread cream cheese mixture over the batter
11. Mix together the flour and sugar
12. Using a pastry blender , cut in the cold butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs
13. Sprinkle over the top
14. Place springform pan on top of a baking sheet
15. Bake at 350 for 70-75 minutes or until golden brown
16. Let cool on a wire rack 15 minutes before removing the sides of the pan

title: weight watchers wild mushroom stew
steps:
1. In a large skillet , heat oil
2. Add chicken
3. Cook over medium-high heat for 2 minutes on each side , until golden brown
4. Remove chicken from the skillet
5. Set aside
6. To same skillet , add ham , mushrooms and onion
7. Cook , stirring frequently , 4-5 minutes , until onion is golden
8. Add garlic
9. Cook , stirring constantly , 2 minutes longer
10. Stir in beef and chicken broths , wine , tomato paste , rosemary and pepper
11. Bring to a boil
12. Add reserved chicken
13. Cook , stirring occasionally , 3 minutes
14. Sprinkle parsley on top before serving

title: poireaux braises  braised leeks
steps:
1. Cut leeks diagonally into thirds and then diagonally in half to form 6 triangular pieces from each leek
2. Rinse under cold water
3. Drain
4. Melt margarine in a heavy skillet
5. Add leeks
6. Cook until lightly browned , stirring gently , approx 15 minutes
7. Stir in the broth cover and simmer for 30 minutes or until golden and the broth has mostly evaporated

title: mom s dragon soup
steps:
1. In a large saucepan or stock pot , boil water and split peas until desired consistency
2. The question to ask is , "is it soup yet ?
3. "place pre-cooked ham pieces and hambone , cayenne pepper and salt to taste in the pea soup and simmer for 1 hour , or until desired consistency
4. Serve piping hot with french bread and butter !
5. Delicious !

title: chorizo  bean and butternut squash chilli
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a large pot and cook the onion and garlic for a few minutes
2. Add the chorizo and red chilli and cook for another 1-2 minutes
3. Add the tomatoes , sugar , pepper and 150ml cold water
4. Cover and simmer for 10 minutes
5. Stir in the squash , cover and simmer for 45 minutes , stirring occasionally
6. Add the beans last and cook for a final 5 minutes
7. Stir in the parsley and serve

title: hazel s vegetable salad
steps:
1. Mix dressing ingredients and set aside
2. Drain all the canned vegetables , then add everything together with the dressing
3. Let set overnight to blend flavors

title: mexican hot pepper sauce
steps:
1. Put ingredients through blender and put in sterilized bottles
2. Refrigerate

title: edna s fruit loaf
steps:
1. Place first 4 ingredients in a bowl and sprinkle a small amount of flour over the fruit
2. Toss
3. Set aside
4. In a large bowl combine flour , baking powder , salt and sugar
5. Mix
6. Beat together the egg , milk and oil
7. Add wet mixture along with fruit to dry ingrefients and blend until all is moistened
8. Turn into a greased loaf pan
9. Bake in pre-heated 325 degree oven for 1 hour
10. You might want to check after 45 minute it depends on your oven

title: spaghetti with edamame  parsley  garlic and olive oil
steps:
1. 1
2. Begin heating a large pot of water for the pasta
3. Meanwhile , turn on a food processor fitted with the steel blade , and drop in the garlic
4. When its chopped and adhering to the sides of the bowl , stop the machine and scrape down the bowl with a spatula
5. Add the parsley to the bowl , and process until finely chopped
6. With the machine running , drizzle in the olive oil
7. Transfer the mixture to a large pasta bowl
8. 2
9. When the water in the pot comes to a boil , salt generously , add the edamame or peas and cook five minutes
10. Remove from the pot with a strainer or a slotted spoon , and place in the bowl with the parsley
11. 3
12. Add the spaghetti to the boiling water , and cook al dente following the timing instructions on the package
13. Checking for doneness about a minute before the stated cooking time
14. When the pasta is cooked , remove 1 / 2 cup of the cooking water and add to the bowl with the herbs and edamame or peas
15. Drain the pasta , and toss with the mixture in the bowl
16. Add parmesan if desired , and serve

title: old school cheese ball
steps:
1. Let all three cheeses get to room temperature
2. With a blender , mix together all ingredients except the nuts
3. Shape into 1 or 2 balls
4. Roll each cheese ball in nuts , place on a piece of waxed paper and put in the fridge to set up
5. Serve with buttery crackers on the side

title: new mexican black beans
steps:
1. Wash beans in cool water and pick out any debris
2. For quick soak method , put beans large pot and cover with warm water , about 2 - 3 inches over the top of the beans
3. Bring to a boil for 2 minutes , then remove from heat , cover and let stand for one hour
4. Alternately , cover in cool water and let stand overnight
5. Meanwhile , in a large pot , saute onions and garlic in olive oil over medium heat until soft and clear in color
6. Drain beans
7. Add beans to onion mixture and add chicken stock , water , spices and vinegar
8. Bring to a boil , then cover and simmer for 2 1 / 2 to 3 hours , or until beans are soft
9. If beans are too soupy , uncover and bring to a low boil to reduce
10. Serve as a side with mexican dishes , or use in dips , refried , or with rice

title: spinach and ricotta pie
steps:
1. Thaw spinach and drain thoroughly , do not cook it
2. Preheat oven to 350f
3. In a large bowl , combine spinach with remaining ingredients mixing well
4. Spoon mixture into pie crust
5. Bake at 350f for about 30 minutes , or until set in center
6. Can be served hot or cold
7. For a variation , add some diced ham , prosciutto or cooked crumbled bacon to the spinach / cheese mixture before baking

title: peanut butter  macaroons
steps:
1. Heat but dont boil the syrup and sugar
2. Add peanut butter
3. Mixture will be thick and it scorches easily
4. Add corn flakes
5. Will be a little hard to mix in flakes but when cool sets up great
6. Drop on greased wax paper
7. Do not bake

title: cajun  bean and pasta stew
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients in a 2 quart saucepan
2. Heat to boiling , stirring occasionally
3. Reduce heat
4. Cover and simmer 15 minutes , until macaroni is tender

title: pepper steak with potatoes
steps:
1. Place potatoes in a glass bowl and cover with water
2. Microwave for 10-15 minutes or until tender
3. Meanwhile , in skillet , saute beef and garlic in oil until no longer pink
4. Remove and keep warm
5. Drain drippings
6. In the same skillet , saute green pepper and onion until crisp tender
7. Return beef to the pan
8. Add potatoes and pepper , heat through
9. In a small saucepan , combine cornstarch and broth until smooth
10. Bring to a boil
11. Cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened
12. Drizzle over meat mixture and toss to coat

title: simple salmon pasta salad
steps:
1. Broil salmon until cooked through and set aside
2. Cook pasta according to package directions
3. During the last three minutes of cooking , add veggies to the pot
4. Drain all together
5. Once salmon has cooled , cut into bite-sized pieces and place in a large bowl
6. Add veggie / pasta mix , then add remaining ingredients
7. Chill before serving

title: apple strawberry rhubarb crisp
steps:
1. Mix all the topping ingredients together in medium bowl , mix till crumbly
2. Preheat oven to 400f
3. Combine all filling ingredients in large bowl and toss well to coat
4. Transfer to 8x8 dish
5. Crumble topping evenly on top
6. Bake till fruit is tender when pierced with fork and top is crisp , 30-35 minutes
7. At 20 minutes , cover with foil if needed to keep top from over-browning
8. Cool 20 minutes , serve

title: parmesan pepper crackers
steps:
1. In a food processor whirl butter , pepper , flour , and cheese till very fine crumbs form
2. Add egg and whirl till dough holds together , pat dough into a ball
3. Divide dough into 2 halves
4. Pat each portion into a 1 / 2 inch thick oval and place between 2 sheets of parchment paper12-14 inches wide and 17 inches long
5. Roll each dough piece about 1 / 16 inch thick
6. Peel top paper off , and set each piece of dough w / paper beneath it on a 14 by 17 baking sheet
7. Bake 350 till evenly light brown turn pan around in oven after 7 minutes to help brown evenly
8. Place pans on cooling racks
9. Carefully peel off bottom paper and break cracker up into whatever size and shape you'd like
10. Can be served warm or cooled

title: chicken bastilla  pie
steps:
1. In large skillet or 5-quart dutch oven , heat 1 tablespoon olive oil over medium-high heat
2. Add chicken breasts and cook until golden brown on all sides-about 5 minutes
3. Remove chicken from skillet and set aside
4. In same large skillet , add onions , garlic , ginger , and remaining 1 tablespoon oil
5. Saute , stirring constantly , just until onions are translucent
6. Stir in cinnamon , cumin , ground coriander , red pepper , turmeric , and saffron
7. Reduce heat to low and cook , stirring constantly , until onions are completely coated with spices-about 3 minutes
8. Increase heat to high
9. Add broth , fresh coriander , and parsley to skillet with onion mixture
10. Heat to boiling , stirring to combine
11. Return chicken to skillet , cover , reduce heat to low , and simmer until chicken is tender , approximately 30 minutes
12. Remove chicken from skillet to plate and set aside to cool
13. Continue to cook onion mixture , covered , until almost dry , about 15 minutes
14. Add eggs , salt , and pepper to onion mixture
15. Cook until soft curds form , about 3 minutes
16. Remove skillet from heat and set onion-egg mixture aside to cool
17. Topping:
18. Heat oven to 375 degrees f
19. Spread almonds on ungreased baking sheet and place in oven for 7 minutes or until lightly toasted
20. In food processor with chopping blade , process almonds with sugar and cinnamon until coarsely ground
21. When chicken is cool enough to handle , remove and discard skin and bones
22. Tear chicken into 2-inch-long strips
23. To assemble bastilla , place phyllo between 2 sheets of waxed paper , then cover with damp towel
24. Brush 12-inch pizza pan with some melted butter
25. Remove 1 sheet of phyllo and place on pan , letting the edges hang over the rim
26. Brush phyllo sheet with butter
27. Working quickly , stack and butter 11 more sheets , arranging them in the pan in an overlapping , circular fashion
28. On center of phyllo , in even layers , arrange half the topping , half of onion-egg mixture , all of chicken strips , the remaining onion-egg mixture , and the remaining topping , fold overhanging phyllo over top of bastilla and brush top with butter
29. Continue to butter and arrange 12 phyllo sheets in the same pinwheel fashion over top of bastilla
30. Carefully tuck the overhanging ends underneath it
31. Brush top and side of bastills with butter
32. Cover loosely with foil
33. Heat oven to 350 degrees f
34. Bake bastilla 20 minutes or until golden
35. Place a baking sheet or another 12-inch pizza pan over the bastilla and invert so that the underside is now on top
36. Return to oven on the new pan and bake 25 minutes longer or until crisp and golden
37. If desired , sprinkle confectioners' sugar and ground cinnamon on top of bastilla
38. If you can't find it , crumble the commonly found saffron threads before measuring

title: streusel yam casserole
steps:
1. Casserole: mix ingredients till creamy pour in casserole dish
2. Topping: blend until crumbly and sprinkle on top
3. Bake 350f for 25 minutes or until golden brown
4. Let sit 10 minutes to let top caramelize
5. So good !

title: greek chicken on the grill
steps:
1. Combine marinade ingredients and pour over chicken in ziplock bag or non-metal pan
2. Cover pan with plastic wrap
3. Lay whole lemon slices on top of chicken
4. Marinate overnight in refrigerator , if possible
5. Otherwise 3 hours or more
6. If possible , turn every so often to marinate on both sides
7. Remove chicken from marinade , reserving whole lemon slices
8. Grill checken on grates oiled with cooking oil spray over medium-hot coals , or on gas grill set on medium to medium-high
9. Grill approximately 20-30 minutes for bonless , slightly longer for bone-in chicken breasts , turning occasionally
10. Check for doneness with meat thermometer or if juices run clean when pierced
11. Place chicken on serving platter , tenting with foil
12. Plase lemon slices on grill and grill until light brown
13. Place grilled lemon slices around chicken pieces on platter and serve with rice or greek potato wedges

title: japanese noodle soup
steps:
1. In a large pot mix all the ingredients except the wakame and noodle
2. Cook for approximately 30 minute
3. Add noodles and wakame and cook for an additional 10 minute

title: devil s food peanut butter chip cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Beat together eggs , vanilla , and shortening with of cake mix until fluffy
3. Stir in remaining cake mix and peanut butter chips
4. Drop rounded teaspoonfuls of dough 2 inches apart onto ungreased cookie sheet
5. Bake 10-12 minutes
6. Remove from cookie sheets and cool on wire racks

title: chicken and lemon pepper sauce
steps:
1. Dip chicken in eggs and coat in flour , paprika , salt and pepper mix
2. Heat 4 t butter and saut chicken
3. Cook until golden brown on both sides
4. Remove chicken and place on serving platter
5. After chicken is removed , stir in remaining flour mixture
6. Be sure to get all the bits and pieces up from the bottom of the pan
7. Add chicken broth , wine , mushrooms , parsley and lemon juice
8. Add lemon zest for extra flavor and salt and pepper to taste
9. Let mushrooms cook until tender
10. Pour sauce over chicken and serve with rice
11. Enjoy !

title: garlic potato chip chicken for 2
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400 degrees
2. In oven , melt shortening with garlic salt and pepper in baking pan , 9x9x2 inches
3. Dip chicken into shortening to coat al sides , then roll in potato chips
4. Place skin side down in pan
5. Bake uncovered 30 minutes
6. Turn , bake until thickest pieces are tender , about 30 minutes

title: taiwanese walnut cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 320 f
2. Line a layer of baking sheet on a baking pan
3. In a mixing bowl , combine butter , powdered sugar , all-purpose flour and baking powder with a fork first
4. Use fingers to mix well and form dough
5. Cover and refrigerate for 20 minutes
6. Add walnut and peanut into the mixing bowl
7. Gently fold nuts into dough
8. Divide into 9 pieces and roll each into a ball
9. Press each dough to make it a little flat , about 2 / 3 inch thick
10. Transfer dough to baking pan
11. Leave about 2 inches between each piece
12. Apply beaten egg on dough surface
13. Bake until golden brown , about 15 minutes
14. Let cookies set on the baking pan for 5 minutes
15. Transfer cookies to a wire rack and cool
16. Enjoy !

title: stuffed and glazed tenderloin of pork
steps:
1. Prepare the stuffing first:
2. Mix the bread crumbs , the cut up dried fruits , parsley , onion , crushed garlic , and tarragon in a bowl
3. Stir in the melted butter
4. Grate the rind of the orange and add as well as the cut up orange flesh
5. Beat the egg lightly and use it to bind the mixture together
6. Season to taste with the salt and pepper
7. Trim away the fat from the tenderloin and remove the transparent skin
8. Slit the meat lengthwise through half its thickness and open it out and flatten the meat out , by pounding it
9. Spread the stuffing over the tenderloin and roll up tightly from the bottom and tie with string
10. Melt the butter in a heavy frying pan
11. Peel and slice the garlic and saut until brown
12. Cook the pork for a few minutes in the butter until evenly browned on all sides
13. Cover the pan with a lid and roast on the center shelf of a preheated oven at 325f for 1 1 / 2 hours or
14. Remove the lid and let the meat brown for the last 10 minutes
15. To make the sauce , put the apricot preserves in a saucepan and add the remaining ingredients
16. Heat over medium heat for 10 minutes or until preserves have melted and the sugar and spices are blended by stirring
17. Before serving , remove the string and carve the meat into slices , spooning glaze over the pork

title: mixed vegetable manchurian
steps:
1. Reserve the chopped greens of the spring onions for garnishing
2. Mix cabbage , carrot and french beans in a bowl and thoroughly rub in one teaspoon of salt
3. Add spring onion , green capsicum , refined flour and one-fourth cup of cornflour
4. Mix thoroughly
5. Shape into lemon sized balls
6. Heat sufficient oil in a wok and deep-fry vegetable balls in small batches for three to four minutes on medium heat or until golden brown
7. Drain and place on an absorbent paper
8. Heat two tablespoons of oil in a wok or a pan and stir-fry ginger and garlic briefly
9. Add green chillies
10. Stir-fry briefly
11. Add soy sauce , sugar , msg and salt to taste
12. Stir in vegetable stock and bring to a boil
13. Stir in cornflour blended in a cup of water and cook for a couple of minutes or till the sauce starts to thicken , stirring continuously
14. Add fried vegetable balls , vinegar and mix well
15. Serve hot , garnished with spring onion greens

title: kimchi pancakes  kimchi jun
steps:
1. Mix flour , water and salt together and combine with the rest of the ingredients to create a thick "pancake" batter
2. Heat 2 tablespoons oil
3. Place 1 / 4 of the batter in the pan to form a pancake
4. Fry until both sides are golden
5. Reduce heat to low and cook all the way through
6. Repeat with remaining portions

title: curried spinach and lentil bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit
2. Cook chopped onion and garlic in olive oil in heatproof skillet over medium-low heat until trnaslucent
3. Stir in basmati rice , curry powder , salt and pepper and cook two more minutes
4. Add thawed and drained spinach , cooked lentils and coconut milk
5. Cover and bake 30-40 minutes

title: hot tourtire nibbles
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Very thinly slice crusts from bread
3. Reserve for filling
4. Move a rolling pin over each slice to flatten
5. Lightly brush both sides with butter
6. Cut each into 4 triangles
7. Working in batches , press each triangle down into a mini muffin pan cup and shape as needed
8. Bake in centre of preheated oven for 8 to 10 minutes or until
9. Cool on a rack
10. Store in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 2 days , or freeze
11. To make filling , whirl reserved bread crusts in a food processor until crumbs form
12. Set aside cup
13. Freeze remaining bread crumbs in a rigid-sided container to use for another purpose
14. Heat oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat
15. When hot , crumble in pork
16. Saut 5 to 8 minutes or until lightly browned
17. Stir in onion , garlic , celery and carrot
18. Cook 2 to 3 minutes
19. Stir in thyme , salt , cloves , savoury , black pepper and stock
20. Cover , reduce heat to low and simmer 20 minutes
21. Then stir in bread crumbs and parsley
22. Remove from heat
23. Cool until able to handle
24. When ready to serve , press cooled tourtire mixture into toast cups , heaping slightly
25. This can be done even a day ahead if covered and kept chilled
26. Preheat oven to 350f
27. Arrange filled cup on an ungreased baking sheet
28. Bake 10 minutes or until hot
29. Top with a dab of mustard and garnish with a tiny piece of thyme
30. Serve immediately

title: buttermilk pecan waffles
steps:
1. In a bowl , stir together the flour , baking soda , baking powder , sugar and salt , in another bowl , beat the egg whites until they hold soft peaks
2. In a third bowl , beat the egg yolks with the buttermilk and butter
3. Mix the dry ingredients into the egg yolk mixture just until smooth
4. Fold in the beaten egg whites and pecans just until blended
5. Heat your waffle iron and bake the waffles according to the manufacturer instructions , browning and crisping on both sides

title: lemon apricot chicken
steps:
1. Heat oven to 425-degrees
2. Flatten each chicken breast half to 1 / 2-inch thickness between waxed paper or plastic wrap
3. Spread 1 tablespoon of the melted butter in jelly roll pan or edged cookie sheet
4. Beat egg and water together slightly
5. Mix bisquick , lemon peel , and garlic powder
6. Dip chicken into egg mixture , then coat with bisquick mixture
7. Place in pan
8. Drizzle with remaining melted butter
9. Bake uncovered for 20 minutes , then turn chicken
10. Bake about 10 minutes longer or until juice of the chicken is no longer pink when centers of thickest pieces are cut
11. Assemble lemon-apricot sauce and heat in a 1-quart saucepan over medium heat until warm
12. Cut chicken crosswise into slices , and top with sauce
13. Enjoy ! tastes great served with rice

title: candy cane cake
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f
2. Generously grease and flour 12-cup fluted tube pan
3. In large bowl , beat cake mix , water , oil and egg whites with electric mixer on low speed 30 seconds
4. Beat on medium speed 2 minutes , scraping bowl occasionally
5. Pour about 2 cups batter into pan
6. Pour about 3 / 4 cup batter into small bowl
7. Stir in food color and peppermint extract
8. Carefully pour pink batter over white batter in pan
9. Carefully pour remaining white batter over pink batter
10. Bake 45 to 50 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
11. Cool 10 minutes
12. Turn pan upside down onto wire rack or heatproof serving plate
13. Remove pan
14. Cool cake completely , about 1 hour
15. In small bowl , mix all icing ingredients
16. Stir in additional milk , 1 teaspoon at a time , until smooth and spreadable
17. Spread icing over cake
18. Sprinkle top with crushed candy

title: smoothest southern pound cake
steps:
1. Beat butter at medium speed with an electric mixer about 2 minutes or until creamy
2. Gradually add sugar , beating at medium speed 5 to 7 minutes
3. Combine cake flour and baking soda , and add to butter mixture 1 cup at a time
4. Separate eggs
5. Add yolks to batter , and mix well
6. Stir in sour cream and vanilla
7. Beat egg whites until stiff , and fold into batter
8. Spoon into a greased and floured 12-cup bundt or 10-inch tube pan
9. Bake at 300f for 2 hours or until a wooden pick inserted in the center comes out clean
10. Cool in pan on wire rack 10 to 15 minutes
11. Remove from pan
12. Cool completely on wire rack
13. Beat butter at medium speed with an electric mixer about 2 minutes or until creamy
14. Gradually add 3 cups sugar , beating at medium speed 5 to 7 minutes
15. Add eggs , one at a time , beating just until yellow disappears
16. Combine cake flour and baking soda
17. Add to butter mixture alternately with sour cream , beginning and ending with flour mixture
18. Mix at lowest speed just until mixture is blended after each addition
19. Stir in vanilla
20. Bake as directed

title: holiday spiced fruit punch
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients except ginger ale and captain morgan's rum
2. Let chill overnight or at least 3 hours
3. Strain
4. Add ginger ale and the rum
5. Pour into punchbowl
6. Add frozen ring or ice cubes
7. Garnish with slices of orange and lemon

title: angel hair pasta with squash
steps:
1. Put the water on to boil
2. In a large skillet , heat the oil over medium high heat
3. Peel the garlic cloves and smash lightly with the side of a knife to release some of the oils
4. Add the garlic to the oil
5. Wash and dry the zucchini
6. Cut off the ends and use a peeler to make zebra stripes down the length of the zucchini
7. Cut the zucchini crosswise into rounds a little less than 1 / 4-inch in thickness
8. When the garlic has browned lightly remove it from the pan and carefully add in the zucchini slices in one layer
9. Fry until a nice dark brown on one side
10. Use tongs or two forks to turn them over
11. When they are brown on the second side remove them to your serving bowl
12. Continue frying the zucchini in batches
13. By now the water should be boiling
14. Add the salt and then stir in the pasta
15. Once the water comes back to the boil the pasta will be done in a minute or so
16. Do not overcook
17. Drain the pasta
18. Empty the oil from the skillet and pour in the drained pasta
19. Stir the pasta to coat with the oil and to pick up flavors from the bottom of the pan
20. Put the zucchini slices on top and then slide the whole thing back into your serving bowl
21. Serve with lots of grated romano cheese

title: spoon cookies
steps:
1. Make dough:
2. Fill kitchen sink with about 2 inches of cold water
3. Melt butter over moderate heat in a 2-to 3- quart saucepan and cook , stirring , until butter is golden with a nut-like fragrance and flecks on bottom of pan turn a rich caramel brown , 10 to 12 minutes
4. Place pan in sink to stop cooking , then cool , stirring frequently , until butter starts to look opaque , about 4 minutes
5. Remove pan from sink and stir in sugar and vanilla
6. Whisk together flour , baking soda , and salt in a small bowl and stir into butter mixture until a dough forms
7. Shape into a ball , wrap in plastic wrap , and let stand at cool room temperature 1 to 2 hours
8. Form and bake cookies:
9. Put oven rack in middle position and preheat oven to 325
10. Press a piece of dough into bowl of teaspoon , then slide out and place , flat side down , onto ungreased baking sheet
11. Continue forming cookies and arranging on sheet
12. Bake cookies until just pale golden , 8 to 15 minutes , cool cookies on the sheet on a rack 5 minutes , then transfer cookies to rack and cool completely , about 30 minutes
13. Assemble cookies:
14. Heat preserves in a small saucepan over low heat until just runny , then pour through a sieve into a small bowl , pressing hard on solids , and cool completely
15. Spread the flat side of a cookie with a thin layer of preserves
16. Sandwich with the flat side of another cookie
17. Continue with remaining cookies , then let stand until set , about 45 minutes
18. Transfer cookies to an airtight container and wait 2 days before eating
19. Cooks
20. Dough can be made 12 hours before baking and chilled , covered
21. Bring to room temperature to soften slightly before forming cookies , about 30 minutes
22. Cookies keep in an airtight comntainer at room temperature for about 2 weeks

title: lily kwok s chicken curry
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a heavy-based pan and cook the chopped onion for a few minutes over a high heat
2. Add the ginger , garlic and red chilli
3. Stir for 30 seconds then reduce the heat to very low
4. Cook for 15 minutes , stirring from time to time , making sure nothing browns or burns
5. Add the turmeric , cumin , coriander , curry powder and chilli powder and cook very gently for a further 5 minutes
6. Don't burn the spices or the sauce will taste acrid
7. Sprinkle on a few drops of water if you're worried
8. Remove from the heat and cool a little
9. Put the water in a food processor or blender and add the contents of the pan
10. Whiz until very smooth
11. Add the two flours and blend again
12. Put the pured mixture back into the pan and cook for 20-30 minutes over a very low heat , stirring occasionally
13. You can add a little hot water if it starts to catch on the pan , but the idea is to gently "fry" the sauce so that it darkens in colour to an orangey brown
14. Once you've achieved a thick paste , gradually stir in the stock and simmer until the sauce has cooked down
15. For the chicken: season the cornstarch with salt and pepper
16. Toss the chicken strips in the cornstarch to coat
17. Heat the oil in a frying pan and cook the chicken for a few minutes until it turns white
18. Add the onions and peas and stir-fry for a few minutes
19. Add the curry sauce and heat until piping hot
20. Serve with boiled white rice

title: mock tuna salad  chickpea salad
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , combine mashed chickpeas , mayonnaise , mustard , relish , chopped green onions , salt , pepper , and yellow onion
2. Mix well

title: honey   mustard lamb cutlets with baby chats
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 220d celsius
2. Toss together potatoes and garlic with a little olive oil , rosemary and seasoning in an oven tray
3. Cook in oven for 15 mins , tossing regularly
4. Mix together mustard , lemon and honey
5. Then move the potatoes to one side and add chops
6. Pour the mustard mixture over the top of the lamb chops and cook for about 8-10 mins , till done to your liking , turning once
7. Serve with steamed beans or asparagus or perhaps a green salad

title: the palm s monday night salad
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 250f in a roasting pan , toss the peppers with the garlic and olive oil
2. Season with salt and pepper
3. Then roast for about 2 hours , until completely tender
4. Remove from the oven , cover the pan tightly with foil , and let stand for 20 minutes
5. Peel the peppers
6. Cut into quarters lengthwise , and set aside
7. Discard the garlic
8. Wash and thoroughly dry the greens in a salad spinner or with clean kitchen towels
9. Chop the greens coarsely and toss in a large bowl with the radishes , tomatoes , salt , anchovies , and onion
10. Coarsely chop the roasted peppers and add them to the bowl , tossing gently
11. Add a generous amount of vinaigrette , and toss again until all the ingredients are evenly coated
12. Using a slotted spoon , transfer to chilled salad plates , spreading the salad fairly flat
13. Sprinkle with the blue cheese , if desired , and serve at once

title: lemon cream dessert cake
steps:
1. Grease and flour a 10-inch tube pan
2. In large mixing bowl , beat cake mix , water , oil and egg whites with an electric mixer on low speed until moistened
3. Beat for 2 minutes on high speed
4. Set aside 2 cups of the batter
5. In a small bowl , beat egg yolks on high speed for 2 minutes
6. Stir in the 2-cups reserved batter , the lemon peel , lemon juice and food coloring
7. Layer batters alternately in prepared pan , beginning and ending with yellow batter
8. Using a narrow spatula , gently swirl through batters to marble
9. Bake in a 350f oven about 45 minutes or until it tests done with toothpick
10. Cool on wire rack for 15 minutes
11. Remove from pan and cool completely on wire racks
