12. For frosting: in large mixing bowl , beat powdered sugar and cream cheese until smooth
13. Fold in the frozen whipped dessert topping
14. In a small bowl , mix vanilla pudding mix and milk with electric mixer on ow speed for 2 minutes
15. Stir in 1 tablespoon shredded lemon peel
16. Fold the pudding into the cream cheese mixture
17. To assemble cake: cut cake horizontally into three layers
18. Spread some of the frosting between layers
19. Frost entire cake with remaining frosting
20. Garnish with blueberries , sliced strawberries and small pieces of lemon peel

title: cranberry mincemeat pie
steps:
1. Place rack in lower half of oven & preheat the oven to 425 degrees f
2. In a large bowl , stir together the mincemeat & cranberries , then set aside
3. Line a 9-inch pie plate with one pastry crust , then add the filling
4. Cover with a top crust , then seal & flute the edges before cutting several vent slits near the center
5. Whisk the egg yolk & water together , then brush the surface of the pie with the egg wash
6. Bake for 30 minutes , then cool to room temperature on a wire rack
7. Cover & refrigerate

title: lemon curd marbled muffins
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f line 12 muffin cups with cupcake liners
2. Put the flour , baking powder , salt , and sugar in a large bowl and whisk lightly to aerate and combine
3. Mix the egg , yogurt , milk , and melted butter together in a pitcher
4. Pour them into the dry ingredients and mix lightly , stopping as soon as everything is combined it's essential not to overmix or you'll get dense , cakey muffins
5. Add 2 / 3 of the lemon curd in 6 or 7 dollops and quickly "marble" it lightly through the mixture
6. If your lemon curd is a bit stiff , just add it in little blobs
7. Spoon the mixture into the muffin cups , to three-quarters fill them
8. Bake for about 30 minutes , until golden brown
9. Transfer to a wire rack to cool
10. Eat on the day you bake them , ideally while still slightly warm , topped with another dollop of lemon curd

title: chicken paprika  crock pot
steps:
1. In a 5 quart slow cooker , combine onions and mushrooms
2. Season chicken thighs with salt , pepper and one tsp paprika
3. Place in slow cooker on top of the vegetables
4. In a small bowl , stir together the cream of mushroom soup and remaining 1 tablespoon of paprika
5. Pour over chicken
6. Cover and cook on low setting for 3 1 / 2 - 4 1 / 2 hours
7. Remove chicken from slow cooker and keep warm
8. Strain and defat cooking liquid
9. Stir sour cream into liquid and serve hot over chicken

title: must try bbq bacon   banana rolls
steps:
1. Skin the bananas , cut the ends off and slice into approximately 4 pieces
2. Wrap each slice of banana in one piece of streaky bacon
3. Hold in place with a cocktail stick
4. Bbq until bacon is cooked through
5. Serve !

title: quinoa   butternut squash gratin
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Spray a 2-quart dish with nonstick cooking spray
3. Peel and cube the butternut squash , then put in a microwave safe bowl
4. Microwave on high for 3-5 minutes until squash is soft and tender
5. Wash the quinoa in a fine sieve thoroughly until water runs clear
6. This is very important , as quinoa has a bitter protective coating that can linger even after processing
7. Transfer squash and quinoa to a large pot
8. Add water and salt to pot and bring to a boil , then reduce heat to low and allow to simmer for 15 minutes or until liquid is absorbed and the quinoa blooms into little spirals
9. Remove from heat and let rest
10. Meanwhile , heat 1 tablespoons olive oil over medium heat in a small frying pan
11. Add shallots and cook 3 minutes
12. Add garlic and cook a minute or two longer , being careful not to let garlic burn
13. Pour over quinoa and squash mixture , mixing thoroughly
14. Add eggs , 3 / 4 cup of the cheese , and salt and pepper to taste
15. Transfer to prepared baking dish
16. Sprinkle remaining cheese and bread crumbs over gratin
17. Drizzle remaining 1 tablespoons of olive oil on top and bake for 35-45 minutes or until top is golden brown

title: buttermilk ranch dressing
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a blender
2. Blend until smooth

title: bamya   meat and okra stew
steps:
1. Okra must be cooked so that its slimy texture is eliminated
2. The greeks have the best technique for achieving this
3. Trim the conical tops with a sharp knife then soak the okra in red wine vinegar for 30 minutes allowing 1 / 2 cup of vinegar per pound
4. Drain , rinse and dry the okra and proceed with the recipe
5. This dish is popular throughout the middle east and can be prepared with lamb or beef
6. Serve with rice
7. Preheat an oven to 325f / 165c in a large frying pan over medium-high heat , warm 1 tbsp butter or oil per serving
8. Working in batches , add the meat and fry , turning , until browned on all sides - about 10 minutes
9. Using a slotted spoon transfer to a baking dish or stew pot
10. Add the onions to the fat remaining in the frying pan and saute over medium heat until tender and translucent - 8-10 minutes
11. Add the garlic , cumin , coriander , tomatoes , tomato paste , stock and mint
12. Stir well
13. Pour over the meat and season to taste with salt and pepper
14. Cover and bake until all the liquid is absorbed - about 1
15. 5 hours
16. Taste and adjust the seasoning
17. Meanwhile prepare the okra as directed in the
18. In a saute pan over medium heat warm 1 / 2 tbsp butter or oil
19. Add the okra and saute for 3 minutes , stirring gently
20. Remove the stew from the oven and arrange the okra on top in a spoked pattern
21. Sprinkle the lemon juice evenly over the surface
22. Recover the dish and return it to the oven
23. Bake for 35 minutes longer
24. Add stock or water if the mixture seems too dry
25. Serve the bamia stew piping hot

title: mustard baked eggs
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Lightly butter or oil two 4" ovenproof ramekins or bowls
3. Mix together the cheese , cream , mustard , salt , and pepper
4. Crack two eggs into each ramekin
5. Pierce yolks with a toothpick
6. Bake eggs for 10 minutes
7. Remove from oven and spoon the cheese-mustard mixture over each egg
8. Return to oven and bake another 5-6 minutes until the eggs are done and the cheese has melted
9. Variation: microwaved
10. Cover ramekins with waxed paper
11. Cook eggs for 2 minutes in microwave on high
12. Add cheese-mustard mixture
13. Cook for about 1 minute longer on high

title: vodka punch
steps:
1. Combine first 3 ingredients in punch bowl
2. Slowly add 7-up
3. Add ice and serve
4. Makes 28 drinks

title: frozen strawberry banana salad
steps:
1. Stir together pie filling& ice cream
2. Sprinkle bananas with lemon juice
3. Add bananas& nuts to ice cream mixture
4. Turn into 8 individual molds- freeze until firm
5. Move to the refrigerator 15 minutes before serving
6. Unmold onto lettuce lined plates

title: chipotle cream sauce
steps:
1. Melt the butter in a skillet over medium-high heat and saut the shallot and garlic for 2 to 3 minutes
2. Add the broth and wine and saut another 3 minutes
3. Reduce heat to medium-low and whisk in the sour cream , then the pureed chipotle
4. Simmer for a couple of minutes to heat through and season to taste with salt and white pepper
5. Serve over chicken and / or pasta
6. Makes about 2 servings
7. For an interesting twist , substitute vodka for the wine

title: pork  beef and bean chili
steps:
1. Brown ground pork and ground beef
2. Drain
3. Add garlic to ground meat and saut 1 minute
4. Add water and beer to meat and garlic
5. Bring to boil
6. Add cumin , chili powder , oregano , and cayenne pepper
7. Reduce heat , cover , and simmer 10 minutes
8. Add tomato paste , sugar , diced tomatoes , peppers , beans and beef broth and simmer 30 minutes
9. If chili is too thick for you , add some additional water

title: szechuan shrimp noodle salad
steps:
1. Boil noodles in water for about 10 minutes
2. Rinse , add 1 tablespoons oil
3. Set aside to cool thoroughly
4. To 2 cups of boiling water , immerse snow peas , sprouts and carrots
5. Cook for 1 minute
6. Rinse vegetables immediately in cold water
7. Place in refrigerator to cool
8. Pour beaten egg in a small oiled skillet
9. Roll the egg to cover the bottom of pan
10. Cook , then shred into slices
11. Place noodles , shrimp , cooled vegetables and shredded egg into a bowl
12. Toss with prepared sauce and toss lightly before serving

title: rhubecued beef ribs
steps:
1. Place ribs in a 9x13-inch pan
2. Add 3 / 4 cup water , sprinkle with seasoned salt and cover with foil
3. Bake at 350 degrees for two hours
4. Combine rhubarb , soup mix , honey , chili sauce , wine , 1 / 3 cup water , basil and pepper in a saucepan
5. Simmer 30 minutes
6. Pour over ribs
7. Bake , uncovered , another 30 minutes , basting several times

title: grilled chili chicken
steps:
1. Combine the chili powder , 2 tbsp balsamic vinegar , and 2 tbsp olive oil
2. Stir well
3. Brush the chili mixture on both sides of the chicken breasts
4. Place in a shallow dish
5. Cover and marinate in the refrigerator for 1 hour
6. Grill the chicken over hot coals for 5-6 minutes on each side or until the chicken is done
7. Arrange the chicken on a serving platter
8. Set aside , and keep warm
9. Brush the skin of the red bell peppers with 1 tbsp olive oil
10. Grill the peppers , cut side up , over medium coals for 6 to 8 minutes or until charred
11. Cut the peppers into thin strips
12. Set aside
13. Saute onion , jalapeno pepper , and garlic in the remaining 1 1 / 2 tsp olive oil in a large skillet until the onion is tender
14. Add the reserved sweet red pepper strips
15. Stir well
16. Add the cilantro and the remaining 1 tbsp balsamic vinegar
17. Stir well
18. Remove from heat
19. Spoon the pepper mixture over the hot chicken
20. Enjoy !

title: firecracker pork  crock pot
steps:
1. For the salsa:
2. Combine all ingredients , cover and refrigerate 2-24 hours
3. For the pork:
4. Combine the first 5 ingredients and rub over pork
5. Place is a 6 quart crock pot
6. Combine water , chiles and onion in a food processor , pour over pork
7. Cook on high for 1 hour
8. Switch to low heat and cook for 9 hours until pork is tender
9. Remove pork and let it cool for 10 minutes
10. Shred meat with 2 forks , set aside
11. Skim fat from cooking liquid
12. Return pork and cook on high for 15 minutes until warmed through
13. Serve on tortillas with fruit salsa

title: english bun loaf 1975
steps:
1. Soak fruit sugar and tea together overnight , covered
2. Drain the fruit , and reserve liquid
3. Mix drained fruit with the beaten egg into the flour using a little of the liquid to make a firm dropping consistency
4. Grease a one pound loaf tin and line with greased paper
5. Tin should hold 1 1 / 2 pints
6. Bake gas mark 4 or 350 degrees f
7. Bake about one hour , or until firm
8. Leave in the pan about 6 minutes
9. Then turn out onto wire tray to cool

title: tenderloin birds
steps:
1. Tenderize meat by pounding out to 3" squares
2. Skewer on 1 / 2 slice of bacon to each slice of tenderloin
3. Shake in breading mixture
4. Bake in 350 degree oven for 35-45 minutes
5. Do not overcook
6. This will save you lots of time

title: german beef roll ups rouladen
steps:
1. Flatten out the flank steaks with a meat pounder and spread mustard on the "inside" of the meat
2. Dice 1 onion , the bacon and the pickles and distribute even amounts onto your roll up meat
3. Season well with salt , pepper and paprika powder
4. Roll up meat from the short side up and secure edge with either tooth picks or some yarn / thread
5. Spread more mustard on the outside of roll ups and season some more
6. Heat oil in a heavy broiler pan and brown roll ups from all sides
7. Ad 1 1 / 2 cups of broth to the broiler as well as the left over 3 onions cut into quarters including the brown skins
8. Cover your boiler pan and broil in the oven at 350 f for 2-3 hours or until meat is tender
9. Ad broth if needed
10. Take rouladen out of pan and set aside
11. Strain the liquid into sauce pan and reduce until thickened
12. Serve with potato dumplings and red cabbage

title: cinnamon spiced peaches  1 pt
steps:
1. Mix all the ingredients in a medium sized pan , stirring well
2. Put the top on the pan and turn the heat to medium
3. Let it cook for 10 minutes or until the peaches are tender
4. 1 / 4 cup of the mixture is 1 ww point

title: baileys cheesecake
steps:
1. Melt butter and mix with biscuit crumbs to make base
2. Line bottom and sides of a springform pan with biscuit butter mixture and leave to one side
3. Beat with an electric mixer the ricotta and cream cheese , adding one egg at a time beating in between until well mixed
4. Add the sugar , vanilla and baileys to the cheese mixture and pour into springform pan
5. Bake in a 180oc oven until mixture is firm and top is just starting to crack
6. Cool in tin and keep in the fridge until ready to serve

title: stuart anderson s black angus coleslaw
steps:
1. Combine water , vinegar and sugar until sugar is dissolved
2. Add cabbage to the mixture
3. Toss thoroughly
4. Marinate for at least an hour
5. Drain thoroughly in a colander but save marinade to use in one more batch of coleslaw , if desired
6. To make the dressing: in a bowl , combine the mayonnaise , vinegar , sugar , sour cream , horseradish and paprika
7. Toss drained cabbage with some of the dressing
8. Serve on plates lined with lettuce leaves

title: zucchini and portabella spaghetti
steps:
1. Cook the pasta as directed on the package
2. In a large skillet , saute the onion and garlic for 2 minutes
3. Add the mushrooms and olive oil to the skillet and saute for 2 more minutes
4. Add the squash and basil and saute for 5 minutes
5. When the pasta is finished , add it and the parmesan to the veggies and stir
6. It's ready !
7. If wanted , you can add meatballs to this for some extra protein

title: chicken curry with coconut milk
steps:
1. In a small blender , like a magic bullet , process the green chilis , the ginger and the garlic cloves until a smooth paste forms
2. Set aside
3. In a large bowl , combine yogurt , coriander , cumin , turmeric , lemon juice and half of the ground ginger-garlic-green chili paste
4. Add chicken and let marinate for 10 minutes
5. Heat oil in a large frying pan , add the star anise , cinnamon stick and chopped onions and fry for 4 minutes
6. Add the remaining ground ginger-garlic-green chili paste and saute for 4 minutes
7. Add red chili powder and mix
8. Add the marinated chicken and cook on high heat for 4 minutes , stirring occasionally
9. Reduce to medium heat , add salt and poppy seed paste and mix well
10. Let the chicken cook in this paste for 8-10 minutes , uncovered
11. Cook till oil separates
12. Add 1 1 / 2 cups water and mix
13. Bring to a boil , reduce flame and cook for 13-14 minutes
14. Add garam masala , mix well
15. Add thick coconut milk and cook on medium flame for 3-4 minutes
16. Turn off heat and garnish with fresh coriander leaves
17. Serve hot with white steamed rice , coconut rice , or rotis

title: quick caesar salad
steps:
1. Whisk all ingredients except lettuce together
2. Toss with lettuce in a salad bowl
3. Add croutons , if desired

title: poached apricots with greek yogurt
steps:
1. Wash the apricots and soak in the water overnight
2. Remove the apricots from the water and set aside
3. Preheat oven to 300 f
4. Take the apricot water and put in a saucepan with the sugar , honey , rosewater , cardamom and lemon juice and heat
5. Add the apricots once it comes to a boil
6. Cover the apricots with wet parchment paper , put the lid on the pan and place in oven
7. Cook for 1 and a half hours
8. Remove from oven and allow to cool in the syrup
9. Spoon over the greek yogurt and serve with flaked almonds and pomegranate seeds , if desired

title: chicken wings with thai sweet   hot chili glaze
steps:
1. Make the glaze , in a small bowl , whisk the sauces , sesame oil and ginger together
2. Trim excess skin from the edges of the wings
3. Lightly brush or spray with the oil , and season with salt and pepper to taste
4. Grill the chicken wings over direct medium heat until the skin begins to crisp , about 10 minutes , turning once or twice
5. Brush the wings with the glaze and continue to grill until the meat is no longer pink at the bone , 8 to 10 minutes , turning and brushing with the glaze 2 or 3 times
6. Serve warm

title: creamy apple squares
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Combine cake mix and butter until crumbly
3. Reserve 2 / 3 cup for topping
4. Add brown sugar and cinnamon to the reserved topping mixture , mixing well
5. Set aside
6. Press remaining mixture onto bottom of ungreased 9x13 pan
7. Arrange apple slices over crust
8. Blend sour cream and egg
9. Spread evenly over apples
10. Sprinkle the reserved topping mix over all
11. Bake at 350 degrees for 25 to 30 minutes or until topping is golden brown and bubbly
12. Serve warm or cold
13. Refrigerate lefters

title: hot mushroom dip
steps:
1. Fry bacon in a large skillet over medium heat until crisp
2. Drain
3. Reserving 2 tblsps of dripping in skillet
4. Crumble bacon and set aside
5. Add mushrooms , onion and garlic to dripping and cook over medium heat until tender and the liquid given off by the mushrooms has evaporated , about 6-8 minutes
6. Mix in flour and salt and pepper
7. Add cream cheese , worcestershire sauce and soy sauce
8. Reduce heat to low and simmer until cheese is melted
9. Remove from heat
10. Stir in sour cream and bacon
11. Serve warm

title: chicken olivia
steps:
1. Steam chicken and cut into small pieces
2. Place in a 2 quart baking dish
3. Mix soup , sour cream , chiles , olives , and green onions
4. Pour over the chicken
5. Cover with the cheese and bake at 350 degrees farenheit for 20-30 minutes

title: shallot sauteed green beans
steps:
1. Bring 6-7 quarts of water to a boil in a large , deep pot
2. When at a rolling boil , add two pinches of salt
3. Carefully add the washed and trimmed green beans
4. Stir gently for 30-45 seconds , or until the beans turn a bright green color
5. The ideas is not only to blanch them , but to partially cook them
6. After 30-45 seconds have passed , drain beans into colander
7. Toss beans to remove any excess water and leave to drain
8. Melt butter over low heat
9. When foaming subsides , add olive oil
10. Add the shallots in handfuls , separating the layers while sprinkling into the pan
11. Allow the shallot to cook over medium heat until it becomes slightly translucent
12. Add beans , boost heat to medium high
13. Toss the beans with the butter and oil until all are coated
14. Continue to toss the beans every few minutes , or until they are cooked through and a little browned
15. Add salt and pepper to taste

title: quick and easy chicken curry for 2
steps:
1. Saute the onion in the oil for 2-3 minutes
2. Add chicken breast and fry for 2-3 minutes
3. Add all other ingredients except the spinach and simmer for 10 minutes
4. Add a little water if it is too dry
5. Stir in the spinach , cook for 2 minutes

title: steak and kidney pie iii
steps:
1. Core and dice the kidneys , cut the steak into 2 1 / 2cm cubes
2. Put in a saucepan
3. Add stock and chopped onions , simmer , covered , 1 - 1 / 2 hours or until meat is tender
4. Season with salt and pepper
5. Blend the flour with extra water , add to steak , stir until the mixture boils and thickens
6. Cool
7. Pour into a pie dish
8. Roll out pastry to an oblong , or circle , slightly larger the d ish
9. Cut thin strips from the ends and fit round moistened edge of the dish
10. Brush pastry rim with water and place the top on
11. Press edges together , trim off excess pastry , using a sharp knife
12. Make 2 slits in centre to allow the steam to escape
13. Glaze with beaten egg yolk
14. Bake in a hot oven 20 - 25 minutes
15. Reduce heat to moderately hot , bake a further 25 - 30 minutes or until pastry is golden brown

title: five star mexican bean dip or casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Crush tortilla chips and sprinkle into a greased 13x9x2" baking dish
3. In a large bowl , combine pinto beans , corn , tomatoes , tomato sauce , and taco seasoning
4. Mix well and pour over tortilla chips
5. Sprinkle with shredded cheese evenly over top
6. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes
7. Serve with your choice of optional garnishes

title: chinese chicken noodle salad
steps:
1. Cook spaghetti in boiling water for 9 minutes
2. Add sliced snow peas and cook for 1 more minute
3. Drain and rinse under cold , running water
4. Drain well
5. Combine pasta mixture , chicken , green onions and bell pepper in a very large mixing bowl
6. Set aside
7. In a separate bowl combine teriyaki sauce , sesame seeds , sesame oil
8. Also salt , pepper and chili oil
9. Pour over pasta mixture and toss well
10. Serve at room temperature or chilled
11. Keeps well in the fridge for up to a week

title: kerry apple cake
steps:
1. Cream the butter and sugar
2. Add eggs , one at a time , beating well after each addition
3. Add vanilla fold in flour
4. Grease and add parchment paper to a 9 x 13 pan
5. Peel and slice the apples
6. Place apples in rows on the batter
7. Bake at 350 degrees for 25-30 minutes
8. When cool , sprinkle with powdered sugar
9. Serve with whipped cream

title: shortbread sampler
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 mix flour , butter and icing sugar together~blend well
2. Form into balls a bit smaller than golf balls
3. Place on cookie sheet about 2 inches apart
4. Slightly flatten-- very slightly
5. Bake for 15-17 mins
6. Until golden
7. Watch to not overbake
8. Cool on wire rack
9. Melt chocolate on low heat
10. Cool
11. Dip about 1 / 3 of the cookie in chocolate
12. Let excess drip off
13. Dip into crushed pistachios
14. Do the same with next 12 cookies but dip in skor bits
15. Put some melted chocolate in ziploc baggie snip off one corner or use a icing bag and drizzle over some plain cookies
16. You will end up with 3 types 12 each kind:chocolate dipped with pistachios , chocolate dipped with skor bits and chocolate drizzle

title: sammy s grilled chicken salad with balsamic dressing
steps:
1. Place chopped lettuce in bowl
2. Add cheese , walnuts and basil and toss
3. Serve with chicken on top
4. For dressing , add all ingredients to blender and blend
5. Refrigerate until ready to serve salad
6. Makes 3 cups , so there will be some to save

title: dutch moorkoppen
steps:
1. Filling: 500 ml double cream , whipped with 60 gr sugar and 15 g vanilla sugar icing: 100 gr icing sugar 10 gr cacao 1
2. 5 tablespoon warm water about 8 pieces of fruit (e
3. G
4. Pineapple chunks , strawberries) sift the flour and the salt
5. Bring the water to the boil , together with the butter
6. Add the flour and salt and mix
7. Remove from heat
8. Beat well with a wooden spoon until there are no lumps left
9. Now add one of the eggs , stir with a wooden spoon , then beat very thoroughly until it has been absorbed
10. Add the second egg , stir , beat again very thoroughly until it has been absorbed
11. Beat the remaining egg in a little bowl , and add this spoon by spoon until the pastry mixture has a velvety consistency that keeps its shape when pulled into points with the spoon
12. Then beat the pastry mixture till it is fluffy and shining
13. Make with 2 spoons dipped in water , about 8 ball shaped heaps on a well-greased baking tin
14. Bake in the middle of a preheated oven in 30-40 minutes golden and puffy
15. Do not open the oven door the first 20 minutes ! leave them for about 5 minutes in the oven with the door opened , and then remove the choux puffs from the tin
16. Put them on a wire rack to cool down
17. Make the icing just before filling the choux puffs
18. Make a cut in the puffs sides and pipe in the cream
19. Keep some of the cream to decorate the top
20. Mix the icing sugar and the cacao , and add drip by drip the water
21. Stir with a metal spoon , until thick and slightly fluid
22. Stir this till it shines and stick to the back of the spoon
23. Dip the tops of the filled choux puffs with a twisting move in the icing , so that the top is covered
24. Put the moorkoppen on a wire rack with a plate under it
25. Leave them for about
26. 30 minutes until the icing is hard
27. Pipe a puff of the remaining cream on it , and decorate this with a piece of fruit

title: pan fried apples
steps:
1. Melt butter in skillet and add sliced apples
2. Sprinkle with sugar , syrup and spices
3. Cover and saute until tender

title: hg s 10 alarm turkey chili   ww points   3
steps:
1. Bring a large pan sprayed with nonstick spray to medium heat on the stove
2. Add turkey and spread it around in the pan to break it up a bit
3. Cook and crumble until meat is brown and cooked through , about 6 minutes
4. Drain any fat or liquid , and then transfer turkey to the crock pot
5. Add all other ingredients except for the chocolate to the crock pot
6. Add 1 tablespoon adobo sauce
7. Mix well to combine
8. Cover and cook on high for 2 hours , and then reduce heat to low and cook for an additional 3 hours
9. Add chocolate and stir until pieces melt and disappear into chili
10. Cover and cook for 1 hour longer on low
11. Add salt to taste
12. If you like , top each serving with a little sour cream
13. Mmmmm !

title: red bean and horseradish relish
steps:
1. With a fork , mash most of the red beans keeping some aside to set on top
2. Combine mashed red beans with remaining igredients , mixing well
3. Top with saved whole red beans and chill
4. Cooking time is chilling only

title: broiled blueberry dessert
steps:
1. Divide blueberries among four ovenproof 8-ounce custard cups
2. Spread with sour cream
3. Sprinkle with brown sugar
4. Place on a baking sheet and broil 4-6 inches from the heat for 3-4 minutes or until bubbly and sugar melts

title: cheese and spinach roulade bruschetta
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 200c
2. Cut bread into thin slices
3. Brush slices lightly on each side with oil
4. Place in a single layer on an oven tray
5. Bake for 10 minutes or until lightly brown , turning once
6. Remove stalks from spinach leaves , place leaves into bowl and cover with boiling water
7. Stand for about 3 minutes or until leaves have softened
8. Drain and cool
9. Squeeze out excess liquid
10. Drain on sheets of paper towel
11. Lay spinach leaves flat , overlapping each other on a piece of plastic wrap , to form a 25 x 20cm rectangle
12. Beat cheeses together until smooth
13. Spread cheese mixture evenly over the spinach
14. Top cheese evenly with pimiento / red pepper
15. Using the plastic wrap as a guide , carefully roll up spinach to enclose the cheese
16. Remove plastic wrap and cut log into thin slices
17. Serve on the slices of baked bread
18. Refrigerating also makes cutting the cheese easier
19. Herbs could be added to or sprinkled over the cheese mix to taste , or substitute caviar or shredded smoked salmon for the pimiento

title: hellmann s classic macaroni salad
steps:
1. Cook macaroni according to package directions
2. Drain and rinse with cold water until completely cool
3. In large bowl , combine hellmann's or best foods real mayonnaise , vinegar , mustard , sugar , salt and pepper
4. Stir in macaroni , celery , green pepper and onion
5. Serve chilled or at room temperature

title: burmese beef curry
steps:
1. Place the onions , ginger and garlic in a food processor and process until smooth
2. Add the chili powder , and turmeric and paprika until combined
3. Heat the oil until smoking point is reached , then add the contents of the processor or blender
4. Be very careful as this mix will splutter as it hits the very hot oil
5. Stir into the oil , reduce the heat of your burner to low , cover , and cook for about 30 minutes
6. You will need to stir fairly regularly , and be patient
7. The mix will begin to evaporate , start to smell sweeter and eventually turn a redish brown , with the oil seperating to the edges
8. It may take more than 30 minutes , like i said , be patient !
9. Mix the cumin , coriander and salt together and massage through the steak pieces
10. Add the steak and potatoes to the onion mix , fry for a couple of minutes , then add the water
11. Bring to the boil , stirring , then reduce the heat and cover
12. Cook for about 30 minutes or until the potatoes are tender
13. Remove the lid , increase the heat and cook for a further 15 minutes or until the sauce is thickened and reduced
14. Serve over plain rice

title: spinach cheese ranch delight  rsc
steps:
1. Cook macaroni according to package directions until al dente , and drain well in a sieve or colander
2. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
3. Butter the bottom and sides of a 9x13-inch baking pan
4. Melt butter in a small pan , and saute shallots over medium heat until softened but not browned , about 8-10 minutes
5. Lightly beat eggs in a large bowl , and stir in yogurt and hidden valley original ranch dressing until well blended
6. Stir in 3 tablespoons parmesan cheese and the shredded mozzarella or italian blend cheese
7. Stir in spinach and shallots , and then the noodles , and combine thoroughly
8. Spread the mixture in the buttered baking pan and smooth the top
9. Sprinkle 3 tablespoons parmesan cheese on top
10. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes

title: deviled scrambled eggs
steps:
1. Beat eggs , mayonnaise , mustard and pickles together
2. Melt butter in fry pan , add eggs and stir to desired doneness
3. Serve with toast or muffins

title: low calorie whole wheat bread
steps:
1. Dissolve the yeast in a small amount of water or , if you are using dry yeast , bloom the yeast as the package instructs
2. Using the 1 or 2 setting on your stand mixer with the dough hook attachment in place , add the water and yeast to the bowl of your mixer
3. Add the rest of the ingredients
4. Once the dough is formed to a smooth dough , turn it out onto your work surface
5. Place the dough into an oiled bowl and cover and place in a warm draft free location
6. When the dough has doubled in size , punch the dough down by pushing your fist into the center of the dough
7. Let it rise again and take it out of the bowl
8. Separate into 3 1-pound loaves
9. You can place the loaves into loaf pans if you like
10. Let the bread proof until doubled in size again
11. Putting them in an oven that has not been turned on is a good place for this
12. Take the proofed loaves out of the oven and preheat the oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit
13. I like to egg wash the bread and then slash it , but you can skip the wash if you like
14. Bake until golden brown

title: easy  tasty barley casserole
steps:
1. Add all ingredients in an ovenproof container , cover and cook at 350 for up to 2 hrs- until water is all absorbed
2. Suprisingly good !
3. Update 4 / 9 / 11~~~i have found that i like my barley a lot better when it is more 'al dente' , so i now use 1 cup barley and 2 cups water and cook for about an hour~~~much better~~~
4. ~))

title: three fruit smoothie
steps:
1. Combine ingredients
2. Blend in blender until smooth
3. Pour into glasses and enjoy !
4. You may garnish with a strawberry , if desired

title: gingerbread muffins with lemon glaze
steps:
1. For gingerbread muffins: preheat oven to 350f
2. Lightly butter 16 standard muffin cups
3. Whisk flour , baking soda , ginger , cinnamon , cloves and salt in medium bowl to blend
4. Using electric mixer , beat unsalted butter and sugar in large bowl to blend
5. Add large eggs and beat to blend
6. Beat in light molasses
7. Add half of dry ingredients , beating until blended
8. Beat in remaining dry ingredients
9. Gradually add 1 1 / 3 cups cold water and beat until incorporated
10. Divide batter equally among 16 prepared muffin cups
11. Bake gingerbread until tester inserted into center comes out clean , about 25 minutes
12. Transfer to rack and cool 10 minutes
13. Remove muffins from pan and place on rack over sheet of foil
14. For lemon glaze: whisk powdered sugar and lemon juice in small bowl until smooth
15. Spoon lemon glaze over tops of warm muffins , using about 1 tablespoon glaze for each
16. Serve muffins warm with whipped cream , if desired , or at room temperature

title: fruit punch non alcoholic
steps:
1. Mix together all the liquid ingredients and pour over the sliced fresh fruit
2. Refrigerate for a few hours
3. Just before serving , add the 3 bottles of ginger ale

title: vegetable puda  indian vegetable pancake
steps:
1. To semolina flour , add 2 tablespoons of gram flour and enough water to make a smooth batter
2. Mix well ensuring that there are no lumps in the batter
3. Add all the vegetables and the chopped coriander as well as salt and pepper
4. In a non- stick frying pan , add a teaspoon of oil and pour the batter
5. Use a spoon to spread it out
6. Cook on both sides

title: decadent cream cheese coconut pie
steps:
1. Place powdered sugar , cool whip , cream cheese and extract in mixing bowl and beat until smooth and creamy
2. Spread in pie shell , covering sides as well as the bottom
3. Beat until well blended and then pour on top of cream cheese layer
4. Sit aside to firm up
5. Spread coconut on cookie sheet and toast lightly in oven let cool
6. Mix extract into cool whip
7. Layer over pie filling
8. Add toasted coconut to top
9. Refrigerate and enjoy a most decadent dessert

title: crescent caramel cinnamon swirls
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f
2. In 1-quart saucepan , melt butter
3. Coat bottom and sides of a bundt pan with 2 tablespoons of the melted butter
4. Sprinkle pan with 3 tablespoons of the npecans
5. Add remaining nuts , brown sugar , cinnamon and water to remaining melted butter
6. Heat to boiling , stirring occasionally
7. Boil 1 minute , stirring constantly
8. Remove dough from cans
9. Do not unroll
10. Cut each long roll into 8 slices
11. Arrange 8 slices , cut side down , in nut-lined pan
12. Separate layers of each pinwheel slightly
13. Spoon half of brown sugar mixture over dough
14. Place remaining 8 dough slices alternately over bottom layer
15. Spoon remaining brown sugar mixture over slices
16. Bake 23 to 33 minutes or until deep golden brown
17. Cool 3 minutes
18. Turn upside down onto serving platter or waxed paper
19. Serve warm
20. Enjoy !

title: nanny s 5 cup fruit salad
steps: 1. Mix and chill for 24 hours

title: delicious peach cake
steps:
1. Sift dry ingredients together
2. Set aside
3. In mixer , beat together sugar and butter until creamy
4. Blend in buttermilk , egg and vanilla
5. Combine wet and dry ingredients , mixing until just combined
6. Gently stir in peaches
7. Pour batter into greased and floured 11 x 7 inch pan
8. In small bowl , combine nut topping ingredients and sprinkle over the cake
9. Bake in 350 degree oven for 40 minutes
10. Cool

title: whipped carrots
steps:
1. Wash the carrots and peel and trim ends
2. Cut the carrots in half and place in a large saucepan with enough water to cover them
3. Add salt and bring to a boil
4. Cook until tender
5. Drain the carrots and place them in a mixing bowl
6. Add milk , butter and nutmeg
7. Beat with an electric beater until smooth

title: peppered potato salad
steps:
1. Scrub potatoes
2. Do not peel
3. Cube potatoes and boil in salted water until fork tender , about 15 minutes
4. Drain and cool
5. Finely chop yellow onion and all peppers
6. Combine in a bowl
7. Add cooled potatoes
8. Sprinkle salt to taste
9. Add mayonnaise and mix thoroughly
10. Spoon and press into a small bowl
11. Level top with spoon
12. Sprinkle with cayenne pepper
13. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour to blend flavors

title: cheese straws with rice krispies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 250f
2. Mix margarine and grated cheese with a fork
3. Add flour , paprika , red pepper , garlic salt and tabasco
4. Add rice krispies cereal
5. Roll each piece to marble size , put on ungreased cookie sheet , mash with fork
6. Bake for 40 to 45 minutes

title: chicken   broccoli casserole    all time fav
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Combine soup , mayo and broth in a large sauce pan , heat until warm
3. Add cheese , stir until melted
4. Add chicken , rice and broccoli , stir until well blended
5. Sometimes i just layer the ingredients: rice , chicken , brocolli , sauce , french fried onions , sprinkle with cheese
6. Same results
7. Top with a thin layer of french fried onions and a sprinkle of shredded cheese
8. Bake @ 350 until bubbly , about 20-25 minutes

title: sweet potato  apple and onion gratin
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Butter 13x6 inch oval baking dish
3. Melt butter in heavy large skillet over medium heat
4. Add onions and saute until tender , about 10 minutes
5. Toss apples with flour in medium bowl
6. Arrange half of sweet potatoes in bottom of prepared dish
7. Top with half of apple slices
8. Arrange remaining potatoes and then remaining apples
9. Cover with sauteed onions
10. Pour stock over all
11. Bake until sweet potatoes are tender , about 45 minutes
12. Mix breadcrumbs , cheese and bacon in small bowl , then sprinkle mixture over potatoes
13. Bake an additional 20 minutes
14. Broil until topping browns , if needed
15. Let cool 5 minutes before serving

title: garlic and herb cheese spread
steps:
1. Soften the cream cheese and butter , and when soft blend it together with all the other ingredients
2. This tastes better if it is left to set overnight in the refrigerator so the flavors blend together
3. Makes about 2 cups

title: mashed cauliflower with cream cheese
steps:
1. Wash the cauliflower and break into florets
2. Boil the florets in salted water until tender
3. Drain well
4. In the food processor put the butter , cream cheese , milk and black pepper
5. Put the hot cauliflower on top
6. Puree
7. Check to see if you need more milk
8. Check for salt
9. Put the mixture into a serving bowl
10. The cauliflower will look just like mashed potatoes
11. You can garnish this with fresh chives if desired to add some color
12. Variations: add a little parmesan cheese with the cream cheese

title: xihongshi jiang   stir fried shrimp in tomato sauce
steps:
1. Blend the shrimp with a pinch of the salt , the egg white , and about half the cornstarch paste
2. Heat some peanut oil in a preheated wok or pan
3. Stir-fry the shrimp for about 1-1 / 2 minutes , remove with a strainer and drain
4. Pour off the excess oil , leaving about 1 tablespoon in the wok or pan
5. Stir-fry the garlic , the tomatoes and white parts of the scallions for about 30 seconds , then add the remaining salt together with the tomato paste , sugar , soy sauce , rice wine and stock
6. Blend well and bring to the boil
7. Add the shrimp with the green parts of the scallions
8. Blend well and thicken the sauce with the remaining cornstarch paste
9. Sprinkle the sesame oil and serve hot , garnished with cilantro leaves

title: peanut butter   chocolate chips banana bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Butter and flour a 9"x5" loaf pan
3. Sift together first 4 ingredients in a bowl
4. Combine next 3 ingredients and another bowl and beat with an electric mixer until light and fluffy
5. Add eggs , one at a time , beating well after each addition
6. Stir in flour mixture until just combined
7. Combine bananas with lemon juice , & vanilla extract and fold into batter
8. Fold chocolate chips into batter , as well
9. Transfer batter to loaf pan and bake in the middle of the oven
10. Bake for 1 hour and 10 minutes , or until tester comes out clean
11. Cool bread in pan on rack 10 minutes and invert onto rack to cool completely

title: pretzel knots  rolls    cut restaurant  las vegas
steps:
1. Dough:
2. Place 1 / 2 cup warm water in medium bowl
3. Stir in yeast
4. Let stand until dissolved , about 5 minutes
5. Add buttermilk , both sugars , and vegetable oil
6. Mix well
7. Mix flour and salt in processor
8. With motor running , add yeast mixture and process 2 minutes
9. Spray large bowl with nonstick spray
10. Scrape dough into bowl
11. Spray sheet of plastic wrap with nonstick spray
12. Cover bowl with plastic , sprayed side down
13. Refrigerate dough until slightly puffed and light , about 1 hour
14. Line 2 large rimmed baking sheets with parchment paper , then spray parchment with nonstick spray
15. Transfer dough to lightly floured surface
16. Spray hands with nonstick spray
17. Divide dough into 8 equal portions
18. Working with 1 portion at a time , roll into 8- to 9-inch ling rope
19. Tie in knot , leaving 1 / 2 inch of 1 end sticking up through center
20. Tuck other end under , if needed
21. Transfer pretzels to prepared baking sheets , knob side up
22. Cover pretzels with plastic wrap sprayed with nonstick spray
23. Refrigerate until puffed and light , 45 minutes to 1 hour
24. Poaching liquid:
25. Meanwhile , place 1 rack in top third and 1 rack in bottom third of oven
26. Preheat to 450f bring 8 cups water , beer , baking soda , and brown sugar to simmer in large wide pot
27. Spray 2 baking sheets with nonstick spray
28. Cut parchment paper between pretzels so each rests on its own square
29. Using paper to lift pretzels from baking sheet and working with 2 pretzels at a time , carefully invert each pretzel into liquid in pot , allowing to slide off paper
30. Poach 10 seconds
31. Using skimmer or slotted spoon , turn pretzels over
32. Poach 10 seconds longer
33. Lift from poaching liquid , allowing pretzel to drain well
34. Transfer to prepared sheets
35. Brush with vegetable oil and sprinkle with pretzel salt
36. Bake pretzels 15 minutes , until pretzels are deep brown
37. Transfer pretzels to rack
38. Let cool to room temperature
39. Can be made 8 hours ahead
40. Let stand at room temperature

title: grilled garlic tomatoes
steps:
1. Preheat grill to high
2. Layer 2 sheets of foil to form double thickness
3. Place foil sheets on cookie sheet , spray foil with nonstick cooking spray and set aside
4. Combine mayonnaise , parmesan cheese , bread crumbs , garlic and lemon juice
5. Season the cut-side of each tomato half with salt and pepper then top with the mayonnaise mixture
6. Arrange tomatoes on foil sheets and slide foil sheets onto grill
7. Grill 12 to 15 minutes in covered grill or until tops of tomatoes are browned
8. Slide foil sheets from grill onto cookie sheet

title: sweet potato and goats cheese mash
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f / 180c
2. Place the potato , garlic and oil in a small oven proof dish and toss well
3. Cover and roast for 25 minutes
4. Squeeze the garlic into the potato and add the goats cheese
5. Mash everything together well
6. Add lemon juice and black pepper if desired

title: apricot oatmeal bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees
2. Lightly oil an 8x12 baking dish with nonstick cooking spray
3. Set aside
4. In a large bowl , work together oats , flour , brown sugar , salt and baking soda with your finger
5. Drizzle oil and fruit juice over the oats and mix in with your finger
6. Set aside 1 / 2 cup for the topping
7. Press the remainder evenly in the bottom of the prepared baking dish
8. Spread apricot preserves over the top
9. Sprinkle with reserved oat topping
10. Bake 30 to 40 minutes , or until golden
11. Let cool in the baking dish on a rack
12. Cut into 15 bars

title: almond torte with mocha whipped cream frosting
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 f
2. Prepare 2 8 inch round cake pans by greasing them and lining them with waxed paper cut to fit
3. In a blender combine the eggs and sugar at high speed until smooth
4. Add almonds and blend until they are very finely ground
5. Add flour and baking powder and blend until combined
6. Pour the batter into the prepared cake pans and bake at 350f (180c0 for about 15 minutes or until lightly browned
7. Let cakes cool before removing from the pans
8. Let cool completely before icing
9. Optional to pour 1-2 t amaretto liqueur on bottom layer for decadence

title: bob s hearty breakfast
steps:
1. To prepare:
2. Render ground sausage over low-medium heat until well cooked
3. Remove sausage from pan and set aside , leaving grease in the pan
4. Add green peppers and onion to the pan , cooking until tender
5. Remove peppers and onions from pan , leaving the grease
6. Add butter and optional truffle oil to pan
7. Add flour mixture to pan over low-medium heat and stir to make a roux
8. Cook for 1-2 minutes being careful not to burn the roux
9. Stir milk into the pan over medium heat , stirring constantly
10. Bring mixture to a boil and reduce heat to simmer
11. Continue to stir until sauce is of a thick consistancy
12. Add sausage , peppers and onions to sauce and stir well
13. Salt and pepper to taste
14. Remove from heat
15. To serve:
16. Plate 3 / 4 cups of steamed rice , 1 hamburger patty , and 1 egg
17. Cover with 1 / 3 cup of gravy
18. Salt and pepper to taste
19. Serve with toast

title: strawberry pancakes from rachael ray
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , whisk together the flour , sugar , baking powder and salt
2. In a small bowl , whisk together the egg , milk and vanilla
3. Preheat a nonstick griddle over medium heat
4. Whisk the wet ingredients into the dry
5. Stir in the melted butter
6. The batter should be thick and smooth
7. Fold in the strawberries
8. Spoon the batter onto the griddle 1 / 4 cup at a time
9. Cook the pancakes until set and thoroughly bubbly , about 3 minutes
10. Flip them with a spatula and cook until golden brown , about 2 minutes more
11. Serve with butter and maple syrup

title: cherry ripe chocolate slice
steps:
1. Melt half the chocolate and press into a slice tray that is layered with aluminium foil
2. Refrigerate this till set
3. Combine coconut , cherries , melted copha and condensed milk into a semi-solid sticky mess
4. Add drops of food coloring till the mixture is pinkish
5. Press this on top of the chocolate , pressing into the corners and flattening out using a cold spoon
6. Refrigerate till set
7. Melt the rest of the chocolate and cover the mixture , then refrigerate again till chocolate hard
8. Remove the slice , foil and all , from the tray
9. Remove the foil and cut into small squares
10. Make sure you get all of the foil or your teeth will feel it !
11. Keep refrigerated

title: impossibly easy italian chicken pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Grease 9-inch pie plate
3. Sprinkle parmesan cheese in pie plate
4. Mix chicken , 1 / 2 cup of mozzarella cheese , the oregano , basil , garlic powder and tomato paste
5. Spoon over parmesan cheese
6. Stir bisquick mix , milk , pepper and eggs until blended , pour over chicken mixture
7. Bake 35 minutes
8. Sprinkle with remaining mozzarella cheese
9. Bake 5 to 8 minutes or longer or until knife inserted in center comes out clean
10. Cool 5 minutes
11. To freeze: freeze serving size in a rigid container
12. Label and freeze
13. To reheat: remove it from container , put it in a proper fitting dish , leave it uncovered , bake at 425 degrees for 35 minutes

title: turnips gratines
steps:
1. Blend together mashed turnips , egg , butter , savory , salt and pepper
2. Stir well
3. Place in buttered baking dish
4. Sauce:
5. Melt butter , stir in flour
6. Add milk , and stir til it forms a thick sauce
7. Pour sauce onto vegetables
8. Sprinkle with grated cheese and bake 400f 25 mins or til cheese is melted

title: turnip  n  peas  n  shrooms
steps:
1. Peel rutabaga and cut into cubes about 1-inch square
2. Cook in boiling salted water until tender but not mushy
3. Add peas and cook for 2 minutes longer
4. Drain well
5. Meanwhile , saute mushrooms in butter
6. Season with the thyme and black pepper
7. Combine all ingredients in a serving bowl and toss lightly

title: chicken  broccoli and brie pasta
steps:
1. Cook pasta in a large pot of salted , boiling water and cook until al dente
2. Reserve 1 / 3 cup cooking liquid
3. Drain pasta and return to pot with reserved liquid
4. While pasta is cooking , in a large skillet heat oil until moderate heat , but not smoking
5. Add chicken and cook until brown and juices run clear , about 3- 4 minutes
6. Transfer chicken to another plate
7. To the same pan add more olive oil if necessary
8. Add the broccoli florets , with salt to taste
9. Stir until crisp tender , about 5 minutes
10. Add garlic , stirring , until golden , about 30 seconds
11. To pasta add chicken , broccoli mixture , brie and walnuts , tossing until cheese is melted
12. Season with salt and pepper

title: roasted vegetable cheese pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Combine first three ingredients
3. Press evenly into a 9-inch pie plate coated with cooking spray
4. Bake at 400 for 10 minutes
5. Remove from oven
6. Increase oven temperature to 450
7. Combine zucchini and next 8 ingredients in a medium bowl
8. Stir to coat
9. Place vegetable mixture on a baking sheet coated with cooking spray
10. Bake for 15 minutes or until vegetables are tender
11. Remove vegetable mixture from oven
12. Add olives and tomato
13. Toss gently
14. Reduce oven temperature to 375
15. Sprinkle 1 / 4 cup fontina cheese over rice crust
16. Top with vegetable mixture
17. Sprinkle with 1 / 4 cup fontina cheese
18. Bake for 30 minutes

title: spaghetti and meatball casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Cook spaghetti according to package directions
3. Drain
4. Add egg and parmesan cheese to spaghetti and stir to combine
5. Press spaghetti mixture into the bottom of a sprayed 8x8 glass baking dish
6. Cover spaghetti mixture with a layer of sliced pepperoni
7. Cover pepperoni with 1 / 2 c shredded mozzarella cheese
8. Cook precooked , frozen meatballs according to package directions
9. Cut them in half
10. Layer the meatball halves over the cheese mixture
11. Combine spaghetti sauce , garlic powder and dehydrated onion flakes in a bowl
12. Spoon over meatball layer
13. Sprinkle 1 / 2 c mozzarella cheese over the spaghetti sauce mixture
14. Cover with foil and bake for 20 minutes
15. Remove the foil and bake approximately another 20 minutes or until bubbly
16. Again , the measurements for this recipe are approximately
17. Please adjust to your own tastes
18. And i didn't have any on hand but i would've like to have added cooked green peppers to the sauce
19. So get creative ! i'm anxious to hear what combinations everyone comes up with !

title: lean homemade sausage patties
steps:
1. Place water and seasonings in a bowl
2. Add pork and mix well
3. Shape into 8 patties
4. In skillet on med heat cook 6 minutes per side , or until done

title: zesty italian crescent casserole
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit
2. In large skillet , brown beef and onion then drain
3. Return meat to pan
4. Add spaghetti sauce
5. Meanwhile , in a medium bowl combine mozzarella cheese and sour cream
6. Pour hot meat into an ungreased 12 x 8 inch dish
7. Spoon cheese mixture over meat
8. Unroll crescent roll dough over the top of the mixture
9. Mix parmesan cheese and butter together , then spread over the top of the dough
10. Bake 18-25 minutes or until golden brown

title: extra easy lazy day lasagna
steps:
1. Brown meat in skillet , add spaghetti sauce and heat through
2. In 3 quart oblong pan spread 1 / 3 of meat mixture to cover bottom , top with 4-5 uncooked noodles , half the cottage cheese and one cup of the mozzarella
3. Spread on 1 / 3 of meat mixture , remaining noodles , remaining cottage cheese , remaining cup of mozzarella , then top with the final 1 / 3 of the meat mixture
4. Right before baking pour 1 / 2 cup of water around inside edges of the pan , cover and bake 45 minutes at 375 degrees
5. Remove cover , sprinkle with desired amount of parmesan , and bake 10 more minutes
6. Let stand 10 minutes before cutting and serving

title: cream of jalapeno soup
steps:
1. Melt the butter in a large saucepan on medium heat
2. Saute onion , jalapenos , and garlic for 5 minutes
3. Remove from the heat and stir in tomato , avocado , and cream
4. Bring the mixture slowly to a simmer on low , making sure the cream doesn't separate
5. Cook for 1 / 2 hour to reduce by 1 / 3 , stirring to prevent scorching
6. Add salt and pepper to taste
7. Before serving , stir in cilantro , saving some for garnish

title: crab cakes with sassy tartar sauce    sandra lee
steps:
1. Mix crabcakes ingredients , except crackers and oil
2. Form six crab cakes , about 2
3. 5 in diameter
4. Crush saltine crackers in a plastic bag and place in shallow dish
5. Cover crab cakes with the crumbs
6. In large skillet over medium heat , ad enough oil to cover the bottom of the pan
7. Fry in batches in hot oil , about 3 minute per side or until just golden rbown
8. Transfer to a plate lined with a paper towel
9. Mis sauce ingredients and serve

title: chinese sweet peanut soup  fa sung woo
steps:
1. Heat a wok over high heat until hot but not smoking
2. Add peanuts and stir for 30 seconds
3. Reduce heat to medium and continue roasting for 3-5 minutes , stirring frequently , until golden
4. Remove from heat to cool
5. Gring the peanuts in a food processor until the consistency of peanut butter
6. Add the sugar and process again
7. Mix the rice flour and 1 cup of cold water , whisking until smooth
8. Add the peanuts and 1 cup of water and whisk again
9. Add the remaining water and bring to a boil stirring constantly until the soup thickens
10. Serve hot , 1 cup per person

title: huey s peanut butter bars
steps:
1. Place the honey , golden syrup , sugar and peanut butter in a microwave-proof bowl
2. Stir and cook in the microwave , uncovered , for 2-3 minutes until the sugar has dissolved
3. Gently stir the cornflakes and the peanuts into the honey mixture , taking care not to crush the cornflakes
4. Transfer the mixture to a lightly oiled swiss roll pan , and spread it out to the edges of the pan and allow it to cool before cutting it into squares

title: kittencal s baked acorn squash
steps:
1. Set oven to 400 degrees f
2. Grease a small baking dish with high sides
3. Place each half of squash cut-side up into the baking dish
4. Add in about 1 / 2 inch water into the bottom of the baking dish so that the skins will not burn and the squash won't get dried out
5. In a small bowl combine the cinnamon with soft butter
6. Coat the inside of each half with 2 teaspoons soft butter , mixture then add in 2 tablespoons of brown sugar to the cavity of each half
7. Drizzle 1-2 teaspoons maple syrup over the brown sugar
8. Bake uncovered for about 1 hour and 10-15 minutes or until the squash is very soft and the tops are browned
9. Remove from oven and allow to cool for about 20-30 minutes
10. Using a spoon drizzle the buttery sugar mixture over any exposed area of the baked squash
11. Serve and enjoy !

title: buca di beppo beef pizzaiola
steps:
1. In a large saute pan medium heat , heat the olive oil , red onion , garlic and capers
2. Saute until the onions are translucent
3. Add beef and cook until brown
4. Add wine and cook until reduced by half
5. Break up tomatoes and add to pan with the oregano , salt and pepper
6. Cook for about 20 minutes
7. Reduce heat to low and keep warm
8. Meanwhile , make the garlic mashed potatoes
9. Cover the bottom of a large serving platter with the potatoes
10. Spoon the sauce over the potatoes and enjoy !

title: banana split cappuccino
steps:
1. In a 12-ounce cup , combine syrups and espresso
2. Fill cup with steamed milk and top with whipped cream
3. Garnish with cherry and sprinkle with nuts
4. Serve immediately

title: magic carpet cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f mix butter , sugar , egg and flavoring until creamy
2. Measure flour by sifting
3. Mix dry ingredients
4. Blend into butter mixture
5. Divide dough in half , reserve for trim
6. Roll remaining dough in 2 rectangles on a well-floured or cloth covered board
7. Cut each rectangle lengthwise in 3 equal strips
8. With a spatula , carefully lift each strip to a parchment lined baking sheet , placing 1 inch apart
9. Spoon reserved dough into a cookie press
10. Work in 2 teaspoons cream if it is too dry
11. Using the smallest star design , press out long ropes on each side of strip , and also 1 down center , pressing down slightly to seal
12. If you do not have a cookie press , you can roll long , thin ropes instead
13. Bake about 10 minutes , or until edges are delicately browned
14. Cool
15. Fill in the rows of trim with jelly or icing
16. Carefully cut 1-inch diagonal pieces with a sharp knife

title: overnight honey almond multigrain cereal
steps:
1. Combine oats , barley , and water in microwave-safe 4-cup bowl
2. Cover and refrigerate 4 hours or overnight
3. Uncover bowl , stir in salt
4. Microwave , uncovered , 6 minutes or until most of liquid is absorbed , stirring well after 3 minutes
5. Stir in cinnamon and nutmeg
6. Top with almonds and honey

title: thai style  peanut chicken
steps:
1. Brown chicken in oil
2. Add salt if desired
3. Combine all other ingredients: peanut butter , soy sauce , fish sauce , vingear , chili sauce and garlic
4. Adjust ingredients to taste
5. You can add more or less of the chili sauce or soy sauce to give it a sweeter or saltier flavor
6. Add sauce to chicken once the chicken is fully cooked
7. Sautee for a few minutes until all of the sauce and chicken is combined well
8. Garnish with chopped cilantro or mint
9. Enjoy !

title: ken schrader s chicken spaghetti
steps:
1. Place chicken in large stockpot & cover with water
2. Salt & pepper to taste
3. Bring to a boil and cook until tender
4. Cool chicken , save broth
5. Cut chicken into chunks
6. Cook vermicelli in broth
7. When done , add cheese , cut into chunks
8. Stir until melted
9. Add tomatoes , worcestershire , mushrooms , and chicken
10. Saut onions and peppers in butter
11. Add to pot
12. Stir well
13. Pour into casserole dishes
14. To serve , bake at 350f for 45 minutes
15. Yield: 16+ servings

title: beef macaroni skillet supper
steps:
1. Cook macaroni according to package directions
2. Drain and set aside
3. Add oil to large frying pan over medium heat
4. Saut beef , onion , and garlic until beef is browned and onions are limp
5. Drain excess fat
6. Add tomato sauce , catsup , mushrooms , worcestershire sauce , salt , and italian seasonings
7. Bring mixture to a boil
8. Add cooked macaroni and simmer uncovered about 5 minutes or until heated through

title: quick and easy pizza crust
steps:
1. 1
2. Preheat oven to 450 degrees f
3. In a medium bowl , dissolve yeast and sugar in warm water
4. Let stand until creamy , about 10 minutes
5. 2
6. Stir in flour , salt and oil
7. Beat until smooth
8. Let rest for 5 minutes
9. 3
10. Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface and pat or roll into a round
11. Transfer crust to a lightly greased pizza pan or baker's peel dusted with cornmeal
12. Spread with desired toppings and bake in preheated oven for 15 to 20 minutes , or until golden brown
13. Let baked pizza cool for 5 minutes before serving

title: roasted pork loin with mustard garlic and herbs
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f degrees
2. Slice small slits all over the pork loin
3. Insert the garlic slivers into the holes
4. Spread the dijon mustard evenly over the entire loin , using your hands or a spatula
5. Sprinkle loin with the herbes de provence , the salt and the pepper
6. Place on a roasting rack set in a roasting pan and bake for about 1 hour , or until meat thermometer reaches 155 degrees
7. Remove from the oven , and let rest for 5-10 minutes before slicing

title: fresh tomato jam
steps:
1. To peel tomatoes , add to boiling water for about 1 minute , rinse in cold water , then remove the skins
2. Quarter the tomatoes
3. Over medium low heat , simmer with remaining ingredients , stirring frequently , until liquid is mostly reduced , around 1 hour
4. If using right away , refrigerate
5. If canning , place in sterilized jars and seal

title: cauliflower  chickpea and pesto salad
steps:
1. Cut cauliflower into florets
2. Add them to the food processor and process until finely ground
3. Dice one tomato and slice another tomato for garnishing
4. In a large bowl , place the processed cauliflower , diced tomato , green onion , and garbanzo beans and mix
5. Add 1 / 2 cup pesto and mix
6. Taste and add more pesto if needed
7. Season with black pepper
8. Arrange the salad on a plate with tomato slices
9. Infuse love and serve !

title: crock pot sauce wars bbq pork sandwiches
steps:
1. Place loin in crock pot
2. Open ginger ale can and pour over loin
3. Dash liquid smoke to taste over loin
4. Fashion an aluminum foil "cover" over loin
5. Place crock lid on and cook on low , 6-8 hours
6. Open crock and shred loin with two forks
7. Let sit in juices , taste
8. Add more liquid smoke , now , if needed
9. Portion onto buns
10. Add sauce of choice
11. Add slaw
12. Enjoy !

title: 40 clove garlic chicken
steps:
1. Boil garlic cloves for 60 seconds
2. Drain & peel
3. Season chicken liberally with salt and pepper
4. Heat butter and olive oil in large pan over med-high heat
5. Saute chicken skin side down first until brown , about 4 minute turn over with tongs and brown on other side , another 4-5 minute
6. When chicken is brown , transfer to plate
7. Add garlic cloves to pan and saute 5-10 minute until evenly browned
8. Add wine and 2 tbs
9. Cognac , bring to a simmer and scrape bottom of pan
10. Return chicken to pan and spirinkle with thyme
11. Cover and simmer about 30 minute or until chicken is cooked through
12. Remove chicken to platter and keep warm
13. In a small bowl , whisk together flour and 1 / 2 cup sauce from pan then whisk it back into pan
14. Add cream and last tbs
15. Of cognac
16. Cook 3 minute and add salt and pepper to taste
17. Pour sauce and garlic over chicken and serve hot

title: blueberry sour cream pancakes
steps:
1. Stir flour , baking soda , salt , brown sugar , nutmeg and cinnamon together thoroughly
2. In a separate bowl , combine egg , sour cream , milk
3. Add to the dry ingredients , stirring just enough to moisten
4. Carefully add blueberries , stirring gently to mix
5. Drop batter by the 1 / 4 cupfuls onto a hot greased griddle
6. Cook until the surface is covered with bubbles
7. Flip and cook until done

title: chocolate blender pie
steps:
1. Mix eggs , sugar , milk , and cocoa in blender for 1 minute
2. Add 1 / 2 stick melted butter , pinch of salt , and 1 teaspoons vanilla
3. Blend
4. Pour into unbaked pie shell
5. Bake at 350 degrees for 40-45 minutes

title: pasta salad supreme
steps:
1. Cook pasta , rinse under cold water and drain well
2. Place pasta in large salad bowl , add dressing and seasoning , and toss gently to coat
3. Cut vegetables to bite size pieces , add veggies to pasta and mix gently
4. Cover and refrigerate at least 4 hours

title: sweet and sour pork chicken
steps:
1. Combine 2 tbs soy sauce , 1 tbs rice wine , and meat in a bowl
2. Stir to coat & let marinate for at least 10 minutes
3. Mix in a small bowl , vinegar , brown sugar , ketchup , water , 1 tbs cornstarch , 2 tsp soy sauce , and chili garlic sauce
4. Set aside
5. Remove meat from marinade
6. Dip meat in egg wash , drain excess , then dredge in cornstarch and shake off the excess
7. In a wok or deep fryer , heat oil to 360 degrees
8. Fry meat a few pieces at a time to not drop temperature , turning occasionally until golden brown , about 3 minutes
9. Remove and drain on paper towel
10. Repeat process for remaining meat pieces
11. Sautee onions and bell peppers until onions are translucent , add sauce , cook sauce over medium-high heat , stirring , until boils and thickens then stir in pineapples and meat
12. Reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes
13. Place meat on a bed of rice & top with sauce

title: bacon  gruyre  and ham strata
steps:
1. Combine milk , green onions , egg substitute , mustard , and pepper in a large bowl , stirring with a whisk
2. Add bread cubes and ham
3. Stir well to combine
4. Pour into a 2-quart baking pan coated with cooking spray
5. Sprinkle with shredded cheese
6. Cover and chill 8 hours or overnight
7. Preheat oven to 350
8. Uncover dish , and bake at 350 for 20 minutes
9. Sprinkle with bacon
10. Bake an additional 15 minutes or until bread mixture is set and cheese is bubbly

title: apricot almond shortbread bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Beat butter and sugar in mixer bowl until fluffy
3. Beat in egg yolks and vanilla and almond extracts
4. Mix in flour and toasted almonds until the mixture forms a soft dough
5. Divide dough in half
6. Press one half into 15x10-inch jellyroll pan
7. Spread evenly with preserves
8. Cover completely with remaining dough
9. Bake 45 minutes , or until golden brown
10. Cut into 3x1-inch bars
11. Can be made ahead
12. Wrap and freeze up to 1 month
13. Thaw wrapped at room temperature

title: malt fruit bread
steps:
1. Grease a 9x5 loaf tin
2. Sift the flour , baking soda and baking powder and add the sugar
3. Warm the syrup , malt and milk
4. Stir till well blended
5. Then allow to cool
6. Add the fruit to the flour , stir to cover , then stir in the cooled syrup mixture and the eggs
7. Stir to blend all ingredients
8. Turn into prepared tin and bake on centre rack of the oven at 300f for about 1 and 1 / 2 hours
9. Turn out on rack to cool
10. Store
11. Wrapped in foil
12. To enjoy--slice , butter and munch away !

title: classic sponge cake with raspberries and cream filling
steps:
1. You will need 2 8-inch sponge tins , lightly greased and lined with parchment paper
2. Pre-heat the oven to gas mark 3 / 325f / 170c
3. In a large mixing bowl , sift in the flour and baking powder
4. Add all the other 'sponge' ingredients to the bowl and whisk everything together until you have a smooth , well-combined mixture which will take about a minute
5. The mixture should drop easily off a spoon when you give it a tap
6. Now divide the mixture between the 2 prepared tins and level it
7. Place on the centre shelf of the oven and bake for about 30-35 minutes
8. To test if they are cooked , touch the centre lightly with your finger - if it leaves no impression and springs back , the cake is cooked
9. Remove them from the oven and let it cool in the tin for 5 minutes before turning them out on to a wire rack
10. Carefully peel off the base papers and leave the sponges to get completely cold
11. For the filling , beat the double cream till soft peak
12. Now on the base layer , first spread half of the jam then spread half of the double cream and then scatter the raspberries all over
13. Spread the remaining cream and drizzle the rest of the jam
14. Place the second layer on top , press very lightly to sandwich everything together
15. Lightly dust the top of the cake with icing sugar before serving

title: buttermilk skillet cornbread
steps:
1. Mix all together and pour in skillet after oil has gotten pretty hot on top of stove
2. Bake 10 minutes in oven at 450 degrees
3. Turn over and bake another 10 minutes

title: caramel sauce with white sugar
steps:
1. Add the sugar and 1 / 4 cup of the water to a small saucepan
2. Place the saucepan over medium-low flame and cook , stirring , until the sugar just starts to turn dark brown , around 10 to 15 minutes
3. The color should be roughly that of black coffee , and the sugar will start to lightly smoke
4. Remove from heat and immediately and carefully pour the remaining 1 / 2 cup water into the caramelized sugar
5. Be prepared for a lot of noise and boiling
6. Stir until the sugar is completely dissolved
7. Use immediately or store in the refrigerator for several weeks

title: microwave tomato risotto
steps:
1. Place stock in a saucepan and bring to boil on stove
2. You can use the stock cold if you can't be bothered doing this but the risotto will take longer to cook
3. In a large microwave casserole dish , with a lid , cook onion in the oil for 2 mins on high
4. Add rice and cook a further 2 minutes in microwave oven
5. Add chicken stock and tomatoes and cook , covered , on high for about 15- 20 mins until liquid is almost absorbed
6. Allow to stand for 5 mins then fold in the romano and butter
7. Sprinkle extra romano on top to serve

title: italian sausage rice balls with marinara sauce  ragu
steps:
1. Saut onion over medium heat with olive oil in a large sauce pan for 2 to 3 minutes
2. Add sweet potatoes , tomato paste , garlic , basil and oregano
3. Cover and cook 15 to 20 minutes on low heat until sweet potatoes are tender
4. Stir occasionally
5. Place mixture in a large mixing bowl to let cool
6. When cool , add sausage , cup of the breadcrumbs , cheese , rice , and egg
7. Mix very well with hands
8. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f and lightly oil a baking sheet
9. With hands , form into golf ball size pieces and coat them in the remaining breadcrumbs
10. Place rice balls on baking sheet
11. Bake at 400 degrees f for 20 minutes
12. Warm marinara sauce and drizzle over rice balls
13. Garnish with grated parmesan cheese

title: grandma s cheesy broccoli   chicken casserole
steps:
1. Chop onions , green peppers , and celery into small pieces
2. Fry chopped vegetables in half of the vegetable oil
3. Cube chicken
4. Flour and salt the chicken cubes and brown in remaining oil--add more if needed
5. Add mushroom soup and milk and stir until mixed
6. Butter a large baking dish
7. Add chicken mixture , cooked rice , broccoli , and remaining vegetables
8. Stir , cover , and cook 45min in 350 degree oven
9. Uncover , top with cheese whiz , return to over for 5 to 10 minutes--until cheese is completely melted

title: chilli prawn and  bean thread noodle salad
steps:
1. Shell and devein the prawns leaving the tails intact
2. Combine the prawns with the lemon juice , sauce , chillies and sugar in a large bowl
3. Place noodles in large heatproof bowl and cover with boiling water , stand until tender
4. Drain
5. Combine noodles and mint with prawn mixture

title: frozen oranges
steps:
1. Wash and dry orange
2. Slice off the top third of the orange and replace it
3. Put the orange in the freezer until frozen
4. Take it out of the freezer at the start of your meal and it will be ready to eat with a spoon by the end of the meal
5. Garnish with a dollop of whipped cream or a sprig of fresh mint if desired

title: white chocolate rice krispie treats with candied peanuts
steps:
1. Spray or lightly-oil a 13 x 9 inch rectangular pan
2. In a large saucepan , melt the butter over low heat
3. Add white chocolate and stir until melted
4. Add the marshmallows and stir constantly over the heat until completely melted
5. Remove from the heat and add the candied peanuts and rice krispies until well combined
6. A rubber spatula or flexible pastry scraper works best
7. Scrape into the prepared pan and smooth the top , let cool
8. Serving and storage: cut into neat bars or squares with a sharp knife
9. These are best enjoyed the day they're made , although they can be covered snugly with a sheet of aluminum foil and stored at room temperature for 2 to 3 days longer

title: the ospidillo cafe chicken cacciatore
steps:
1. In a large skillet , or in a large electric frying pan , brown the chicken parts in the olive oil
2. When the chicken is browned , remove the pieces from the skillet and saute the onions in the oil until tender
3. Drain the oil
4. Deglaze the pan with the wine , whisking over medium heat for about a minute
5. Add the chicken pieces and onions to this sauce , then add in all other ingredients , adding the seasonings and herbs to the top
6. Cover and allow to cook at a very low boil for one hour and ten minutes , turning the chicken only once
7. If you want more liquid , add canned chicken stock
8. Serve over cooked spaghetti

title: herbed onion potatoes
steps:
1. Cook potatoes in boiling salted water for 10 to 15 minutes or until slightly tender
2. Let cool , cut into 1 / 4 inch pieces
3. In extra large fry pan or dutch oven , heat oil over medium heat
4. Add onion , red pepper and garlic
5. Saute 2 minutes
6. Stir in potatoes and dried or fresh herbs
7. Cook , stirring often for 10 to 15 minutes or until potatoes are fully cooked
8. Stir in parsley
9. Season with salt and pepper to taste
10. Cook 30 seconds longer
11. Serve hot

title: smoky wind lamb kebab
steps:
1. Combine marinade ingredients and marinate lamb cubes overnight
2. Cut peppers and onions into slices the same size as the lamb cubes
3. Arrange on skewers , alternating peppers , lamb , and onion
4. Using charcoal briquettes and hard wood , grill over direct heat for 30 to 45 minutes , turning 4 times
5. Do not overcook

title: ground beef curry  kima curry
steps:
1. In a skillet , heat oil over medium high heat
2. Saute onion and beef until browned
3. Drain fat
4. Add in curry powder , garlic , ginger , and tomatoes and fry briefly
5. Stir in the rest of the ingredients
6. Turn down heat to medium and cook for 20 minutes to blend the flavors
7. Serve over rice or with chapatis

title: zack s sweet sweet chocolate smoothie
steps:
1. Mix all in blender until smooth
2. Enjoy !

title: bread machine butter rolls
steps:
1. Add ingredients to bread machine in the order listed and select the dough setting
2. Remove dough and shape into 12 rolls and let rise 1 hour
3. Bake at 375 degrees for 15 minutes

title: spanish potato salad
steps:
1. Combine the vinegar , honey and saffron in a small pot
2. Bring to a boil over high heat
3. Immediately remove from the heat and let sit until cool to room temperature
4. Combine the mayonnaise and garlic with the saffron mixture in a medium mixing bowl and season to taste with salt and pepper
5. Cook the potatoes in a large pot of boiling , salted water until tender
6. Drain and slice 1 / 2-inch thick
7. Place in a large serving bowl
8. Immediately fold in the mayonnaise mixture , red bell peppers , onion , thyme and parsley
9. Season to taste with salt and pepper
10. Enjoy !

title: kiwi peach smoothie
steps:
1. Combine in the food processor and blend till creamy
2. Serve immediately
3. If you prefer a thinner smoothie , add some peach juice
4. To let it thicken a bit with extra freeziness , put it in the freezer for 10-15 minutes or so
5. I like it sprinkled with ground flaxseed !

title: warm blue cheese dip with garlic and bacon
steps:
1. Cook bacon in heavy large skillet over medium-high heat until almost crisp , about 7 minutes
2. Drain excess fat from skillet
3. Add garlic and cook until bacon is crisp , about 3 minutes
4. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
5. Using electric mixer , beat cream cheese until smooth
6. Add half and half and beat until combined
7. Stir in bacon mixture , blue cheese and chives
8. Transfer to 2-cup ovenproof baking dish
9. Cover with foil
10. Bake until heated through , about 30 minutes
11. Sprinkle with chopped almonds and serve

title: carolyn s easy cheesy macaroni   cheese
steps:
1. Prepare the macaroni according to package directions
2. While the macaroni is cooking melt the butter in a large saucepan on low to medium heat
3. Cut the velvetta in cubes and add to the butter and stir constantly
4. When the cheese starts to melt add the milk and stir to combine until smooth
5. Drain the macaroni and add to the cheese mixture
6. Pepper can be used at the table , but i would not use too much if a child is eating this
7. If putting in a crockpot to keep warm , you might need to add a little milk to it right before serving
8. Just use your judgement and how your family likes their mac & cheese

title: ataulfo mango jam
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in a small saucepan
2. Simmer over low heat until liquid is almost evaporated
3. Remove vanilla and puree in food processor

title: pumpkin pie   simply the best
steps:
1. Beat egg lightly
2. Add and mix next 8 ingredients in order given
3. Pour into unbaked pie shell
4. Sprinkle top with more cinnamon if desired
5. Bake on bottom shelf in 450 oven for 10 minutes
6. Reduce heat to 350 and bake about 30 min or until inserted knife comes out clean
7. Serve with whipped cream

title: city chicken  or pork
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Combine flour , salt , and pepper on a plate
3. Roll meat in mixture until coated
4. Heat butter and oil in frying pan
5. Brown meat on both sides
6. Drain off excess grease , place meat in baking dish
7. Mix onion soup mix , chicken broth , and water , then add to dish with meat
8. Bake 1 hour , meat should be tender
9. You can thicken juices for gravy and serve with mashed potatoes , yum !

title: my amazingly soft   moist chocolate sponge cake
steps:
1. Preheat your oven to 180c & grease a 10" round springform cake tin
2. Warm the margarine up in the microwave for about 20-30 seconds , it needs to be extremely soft but not liquid
3. In a fairly large bowl , beat the sugar & the warmed margarine together
4. Unlike a regular sponge , you don't need to do this for more than a couple of minutes - creaming to get it fluffy is not required here !
5. Next beat in the eggs , once they are fully incorporated add the baking powder & cocoa powder
6. Carefully mix them in then quickly beat the mix for a minute
7. Mix in the flour , being sure to get it well mixed & break up any lumps that may be lurking
8. Finally , mix in the water little by little
9. Pour the cake batter into the tin , level off & place in the centre of the oven to bake for 40 minutes
10. As soon as 40 minutes have passed , turn the oven off & leave the cake in there for 10-15 minutes before removing
11. Leave the cake in it's tin for 10 mins then pop out & leave to cool on the serving plate
12. Once the cake has cooled , give it a generous dusting of confectioners sugar

title: stuffed zucchini with potatoes and peas
steps:
1. Cut each zucchini in half lengthwise
2. Scoop out pulp , leaving a 1 / 4-inch-thick shell
3. Place zucchini halves , cut sides up , in a shallow roasting pan
4. Sprinkle with 1 / 2 teaspoon salt
5. Preheat oven to 375
6. Cook potato in boiling water 2 minutes or until crisp-tender
7. Drain
8. Heat butter and oil in a nonstick skillet over medium-high heat until butter melts
9. Add onion , ginger , garlic , and chile , and saut 3 minutes
10. Stir in flour and next 4 ingredients
11. Cook over medium-low heat 5 minutes , stirring frequently
12. Stir in 3 / 4 teaspoon salt , potato , peas , and cilantro
13. Pat zucchini dry with paper towels
14. Spoon about 1 / 3 cup potato mixture into each zucchini half
15. Cover and bake at 375 for 20 minutes or until zucchini is tender

title: roasted brussel sprouts
steps:
1. Heat oven to 450- degrees f
2. Line cookie sheet with foil
3. Spread sprouts on prepared pan and toss with oil
4. Roast for 10-15 minutes
5. Add onions to pan , toss and roast for another 10 minutes
6. Drizzle with the vinegar , toss and roast another 2 minutes
7. Transfer to serving dish and toss with salt and pepper

title: green bean casserole  slow cooker
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a slow cooker
2. Cover
3. Cook on low for 3 to 4 hours
4. Sprinkle with almonds before serving

title: steak  n  fries salad
steps:
1. For dressing , in a jar with a tight fitting lid , combine the sugar , oil , vinegar and water
2. Shake well and refrigerate
3. Prepare french fries according to package directions
4. In a small skillet coated with non stick cooking spray , cook steak over meduim heat 8 to 10 minutes or until meat reached desired doneness
5. On two salad plates , arrange the lettuce , tomato and onion
6. Top with french fries , steak and cheese
7. Shake dressing and drizzle over salads
8. Serve immediately

title: the haven s special    queen uh cuisine s   version
steps:
1. Bbq your filet's to your liking
2. Just before your filets are done , top each one with 1 / 2 avocado and then top with one slice of jack cheese
3. When cheese is melted -- you are ready for an incredible treat
4. Serve with green salad and onion rings

title: crab and penne casserole
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to package directions
2. Meanwhile , in a large bowl , combine the alfredo sauce , crab , yellow squash , zucchini , parsley and pepper flakes
3. Drain pasta
4. Add to sauce mixture and toss to coat
5. Transfer to a greased 9 x 13 inch baking dish
