6. Sprinkle with cheese
7. Cover and bake at 325 for 35 minutes
8. Toss bread crumbs and butter
9. Sprinkle over casserole
10. Bake uncovered , 5-6 minutes longer or until browned

title: avgolemono soup  chicken soup
steps:
1. Place the chicken in a large stock pot and fill with enough water to cover it
2. Bring to a boil and remove the foam
3. At this point add the onion and salt and pepper to taste
4. Once the chicken is boiled remove it and the onion from the pot
5. Now add the rice or orzo to the broth and let it boil
6. When the rice or orzo is ready , add the avgolemono sauce

title: ellie s elbow pasta salad
steps:
1. Rough cut the first 4 ingredients place in a fod processor and pulse with metal blade till finely chopped
2. Or chop by hand
3. Mix all the ingredients together adding more mayo if needed
4. Chill and serve

title: coco quette  pink
steps:
1. To a shaker of ice , add rum , fusion , juices , tonic and shake
2. Pour into a chilled , sugar-rimmed martini glass
3. Sprinkle with coconut flakes and garnish with 2 cherries
4. Enjoy !
5. )

title: chili pineapple steaks
steps:
1. Combine pineapple with juice , chili sauce and garlic powder in small saucepan
2. Simmer for 15 minutes
3. Brown steak on both sides
4. Cut in strips put in frying pan
5. Pour pineapple chili sauce over steak
6. Simmer for 10 minutes
7. Serve with favorite side dish

title: dandelion casserole
steps:
1. Blanch greens for 3 minutes and set aside
2. Brown meats , onion and garlic , add bread crumbs , parsley , dried herbs , salt , pepper , egg , and milk
3. Squeeze dandelion greens of all moisture
4. In a buttered casserole alternate layers of dandelions , pasta , crumbled browned meat mixture and tomato sauce
5. Top with cheese and bake 350 degrees for 20-30 minutes
6. Garnish with hot pepper flakes and parmesan cheese and serve with crisp fresh bread

title: tamago sushi
steps:
1. In a bowl beat eggs , flour , sugar and salt together
2. Heat a non stick or lightly oiled pan on a medium heat
3. I normally use a small frying pan to give me a 1 / 4 inch thick omelette
4. Cook egg mix until golden on both sides
5. Allow to cool and slice into 1 / 2 inch thick slices
6. Slice the spring onions lengthways into long thin strips
7. Depending on preference you can use the white only or all parts of the onion
8. In a small dry frying pan place the sesame seeds and heat over a medium heat until they turn golden brown and become aromatic
9. Watch carefully they burn very easily
10. Assembling the sushi
11. There are two ways to assemble this sushi you can either make fat rolls or layered sushi i will describe both
12. Rolls :
13. Lay a sheet of nori down on a sushi rolling mat
14. Spread 1 / 3 of the rice over the nori pressing down well
15. Leave a 1 inch gap at the side nearest to you
16. Leave a 1 inch gap on the rice at your side and place 1 / 3 of the onion , sesame seeds and omelet
17. Top with a line of the mayonnaise
18. Take the inch of seaweed that is showing and fold over the rice , continue rolling up the seaweed using the mat if needed as an aid
19. You should end up with a cigar shaped roll
20. Remove the roll to a plate and place in the fridge , make the other rolls in the same way
21. When the sushi is cool , use a sharp knife dipped in salted water to slice into 1 / 2 inch slices
22. The end sections will look untidy so eat them and arrange the rest of the pieces on a plate
23. Layered :
24. Line 9 x 13 inch pan with cling film
25. Place 1 / 3 of the sushi rice in a layer on the bottom
26. Place one of the nori sheets on the rice adding more around the sides if needed
27. Place the sliced omelet on top of the nori leaving 1 / 2 inch gaps between the slices
28. Place the spring onions in the gaps and top each one with a thin line of the mayonnaise
29. Sprinkle with sesame seeds and top with another sheet of nori
30. Add another 1 / 3 of the rice
31. Add the other nori sheet
32. Add the rest of the rice
33. Press down the top of the sushi with another pan covered in cling film
34. Turn the sushi out onto a board and using a sharp wet knife cut into squares

title: mediterranean eggplant  aubergine  casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Prepare onion , celery , green bell pepper , fresh tomato & black olives in stated quantity as directed & set aside
3. Slice unpeeled eggplant into 1 / 4" thick slices
4. Put olive oil in a saute pan & cook eggplant slices till just slightly tender
5. Remove from pan & set aside
6. In the same pan , add onion , celery & bell pepper
7. Saute till crisp-tender
8. Remove from heat & stir in chopped tomato , black olives , herbs & spices
9. Place 1 / 3 of eggplant slices in a 9x13" baking dish
10. Top with 1 / 3 of veggie / spice mixture & repeat layering 2 more times
11. Bake 15 minutes
12. While casserole is baking , beat eggs & set aside
13. In a separate bowl , combine breadcrumbs , 2 tbsp olive oil & parmesan cheese
14. Mix well & set aside
15. At 15 minutes , remove casserole from oven
16. Drizzle beaten eggs over surface , let them seep into the veggie mixture & move veggies around gently using a fork to aid this process as required
17. Sprinkle breadcrumb , olive oil & parmesan cheese mixture evenly over surface & return to oven for 15 min or till breadcrumbs are golden brown
18. Serve immediately

title: curried spinach balls
steps:
1. Chop the spinach
2. Melt butter in a large saucepan
3. Saute garlic and onions until light brown
4. Add chopped spinach , salt and pepper
5. Cover and cook over medium heat for 5 min
6. Remove from heat and drain the spinach well
7. Squeeze it slightly
8. Stir in breadcrumbs , parmesan cheese and the eggs
9. Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours
10. Preheat oven to 350f degrees
11. Pour sauce into a 9" baking dish
12. Mix in curry powder
13. Shape spinach mixture into 2" balls
14. Arrange the balls in a single layer
15. Bake uncovered for 30 minutes
16. Half way through cooking gently turn the balls so the balls are rotated in the sauce

title: hot spiced fruit
steps:
1. Combine the pineapple juice , marmalade and spices in a saucepan
2. Boil for 2-3 minutes
3. Reduce the heat and add the margarine and fruit
4. Simmer for 20 minutes
5. Remove the cinnamon stick before serving

title: rich chocolate loaf cake
steps:
1. Set oven to 350f
2. Set oven rack to second-lowest position
3. Generously grease two 9 x 5-inch loaf pans or 6 mini loaf pans
4. In a large bowl cream butter , shortening , sugar and vanilla until fluffy
5. Add in eggs one at a time beating well after each addition scraping the bowl frequently
6. Dissolve the coffee granules in hot water
7. Sift together the flour , cocoa , salt and baking powder
8. Add alternately with coffee and buttermilk to the creamed mixture , beating until well blended
9. Mix in the chocolate chips
10. Divide the batter equally between well-greased prepared baking pans
11. Bake for 1 hour or 40 minutes
12. Cool 10 minutes before removing to a wire rack

title: chocolate peppermint bundt cake
steps:
1. Heavily grease and flour a 12 cup bundt pan
2. Set aside
3. Combine 1st seven ingredients in a large mixing bowl
4. Beat at low speed till just combined
5. Beat at high speed for 2 minutes
6. Pour batter into prepared bundt pan
7. Bake at 350 degrees for 50 minutes or till toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
8. Cool in pan on a wire rack for 15 minutes
9. Remove from pan and cool entirely on wire rack
10. Place on a serving platter when cool
11. Stir together powdered sugar and enough milk to make a dribbling glaze consistency
12. Drizzle glaze over cake and sprinkle with peppermint candies

title: sweet corn cakes
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine the corn , flour , and baking powder
2. Mix with mixer on medium speed until flour begins to bind with the corn
3. Add the minced red peppers , sugar , scallion , cilantro , seasoning sauce and egg
4. Continue mixing until mixture becomes thick and spreadable
5. In a nonstick skillet , heat about one tablespoon of oil
6. Drop large spoonfuls of batter into skillet and let spread
7. Brown cake on both sides , approximately 3 minutes per side
8. Continue doing this until batter is gone , adding oil as needed
9. Serve with spicy malt seasoning sauce
10. Spicy malt seasoning sauce for dipping:
11. Combine all dipping sauce ingredients
12. Mix well

title: caramelized onion and asiago beer batter bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Heat olive oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat
3. Add onion and 1 t sugar , and saut 15 minutes or until tender and caramelized
4. Cool to room temperature
5. Combine flour , 2 t sugar , baking powder , and salt in a bowl
6. Make a well in center of mixture
7. Add onion , cheese , and beer
8. Stir just until moist
9. Spoon batter into a 9 x 5-inch loaf pan coated with cooking spray
10. Drizzle evenly with butter
11. Bake for 55-60 minutes , or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean
12. Cool 5 minutes in pan on a wire rack
13. Remove from pan
14. Cool completely on wire rack

title: easy fast yummy broccoli   corn casserole
steps:
1. Mix corn , creamed corn , frozen broccoli , 1 cup of crushed crackers , and salt and pepper in a small casserole dish
2. Spread the remaining crackers on top
3. Pour the melted butter evenly over the crackers
4. Bake uncovered at 350f for 30 minutes
5. Baking longer than 30 minutes may burn the crackers so watch carefully at the end

title: cornstarch cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Butter and flour a 10 cup loaf pan or a 12 cup bundt pan
3. Sift the flour with the cornstarch , baking powder , and salt
4. Set aside
5. Beat the butter until smooth
6. Gradually beat in all but 1 / 4 cup of the sugar
7. Beat in the extract
8. Continue to beat for 5 minutes , until butter is very light and fluffy
9. Stir in the flour / cornstarch mixture in 3 additions , alternating with the half and half
10. In a clean bowl , beat the egg whites until it forms a soft peak
11. Beat in the remaining 1 / 4 cup of sugar , and continue beating until stiff , glossy peaks form when the beater is raised
12. Gently fold the beaten whites into the batter in 3 additions
13. Scrape the batter into the prepared pans
14. Bake for 1 hour and 10 minutes , or until the cake is well browned and springs back when lightly pressed in the center

title: cake mix doctor  banana pudding cake
steps:
1. Place a rack in the center of the oven and preheat oven to 350f degrees
2. Lightly mist a 13 by 9-inch baking pan with vegetable oil spray
3. Set the pan aside
4. Place the cake mix , butter , milk , eggs , and vanilla in a large mixing bowl
5. Blend with an electric mixer on low speed for 1 minute
6. Stop the machine and scrape down the sides of the bowl with a rubber spatula
7. Increase the mixer speed to medium and beat 2 minutes more , scraping the sides down again if needed
8. The batter should look thick and well blended
9. Pour the batter into the prepared pan , smoothing it out with the rubber spatula
10. Place the pan in the oven
11. Bake the cake until it is golden brown and springs back when lightly pressed with your fingers
12. 30 to 33 minutes
13. Remove the pan from the oven and place it on a wire rack to cool
14. Meanwhile , prepare the pudding
15. Place the pudding mix and milk in a medium saucepan
16. Fold in the butter and vanilla
17. Cook over low heat , stirring , until the butter melts , 3 to 4 minutes
18. Remove the pan from the heat and let it cool for about 5 minutes
19. Fold in the banana slices
20. To assemble the cake , spoon the pudding and banana mixture on top of the cooled cake , spreading the mixture out to all edges of the cake with the rubber spatula
21. Cover the pudding with the whipped topping , spreading it out to the edges of the cake with the rubber spatula
22. Scatter the crushed vanilla wafer cookies over the top
23. Serve at room temperature

title: choc crackles   without copha
steps:
1. Melt the chocolate and butter together in a bowl placed over a pan of simmering water , stirring until melted
2. Remove chocolate from heat , and stir in the syrup and cereal
3. Drop spoonfuls of mixture into 12 muffin or cupcake cases
4. Refrigerate for at least one hour
5. They will keep in an airtight container for up to 5 days

title: broiled shrimp scampi
steps:
1. Do not shell the shrimp , but to cut shrimp in half lengthwise through the shell , leaving them attached at the tail
2. In a non-reactive suacepan , combine the butter , lemon juice , parsley , garlic , black pepper and crushed red pepper
3. Cook on low just until butter is melted stir in shrimp to coat and let marinate for 15 minutes
4. Remove shrimp and arrange them in a shallow , oval casserole dish or i use the bottom of a broiler pan
5. They should have the tails sticking up
6. They will be floppy but will firm as they cook
7. Pour the sauce over the shrimp
8. Put your pan under a hot broiler and cook until the shrimp are done
9. Arrange cooked shrimp in bowls and pour sauce over from your pan
10. Sprinkle with additional parsley

title: cream cheese chicken cordon bleu
steps:
1. Place chicken between two pieces of wax paper or plastic wrap and pound till 1 / 4" thick
2. Place one slice ham and one slice cheese on each breast
3. Evenly distribute cream cheese between chicken breasts , spreading on top of the ham
4. Roll up carefully , securing with toothpicks
5. It is important to secure the ends so the cream cheese doesn't leak out !
6. Just close the ends by securing them with toothpicks
7. Lightly sprinkle each piece with salt , then dip in the egg
8. Roll chicken in cracker crumbs
9. Cook rolls in hot oil in skillet until light brown , turning occasionally when brown , add water , cover and simmer until chicken is done , about ten minutes
10. Remove toothpicks and serve

title: skordalia  a garlic sauce condiment
steps:
1. Soak bread in water
2. Squeeze dry between hands
3. Put in food processor along with garlic , pine nuts or walnuts
4. Process for 20 seconds
5. Slowly drop in olive oil and vinegar , alternately , until mixture binds into a thick mayonnaise-like sauce

title: sarasota s speedy chicken cacciatore soup
steps:
1. Bacon -- in a large pot , saute your bacon in 1 teaspoon olive oil on medium heat until crisp
2. Vegetables -- to the bacon and drippings , add your onions , mushrooms , garlic and cook until slightly softened , just a couple of minutes
3. Add in the roasted red pepper , optional green pepper , red pepper flakes and cook another minute
4. Broth -- add the red wine and vinegar and cook just a minute scraping up any bits off the bottom of the pan
5. Add in the broth , tomatoes , and chicken
6. Check for seasoning
7. Lower to medium low heat and continue to simmer for about 15 minutes
8. Finish with the fresh basil the last couple of minutes
9. Garnish -- as your soup is simmering , make your garnish and polenta
10. For the olives -- in a small bowl , fine chop and mix the two olives together and drizzle with a bit of olive oil
11. I like a mix of black and green , but use what you like best - and let people help themselves
12. And for the polenta , simply make your favorite kind
13. I used a quick cooking which was
14. Two cups chicken broth and 1 / 2 cup polenta , and stir in 1 / 2 cup parmesan right at the end , salt and pepper
15. I used quick cooking so 5 minutes and it was done
16. Use your favorite
17. Serve -- a couple of ladles per bowl , top with a scoop of the cheesy polenta and garnish with the olives

title: berry dump cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325f quickly rinse the berries and dump them into a 13x9 baking pan , spreading them out evenly on the bottom of pan
2. Sprinkle the sugar over the berries , and then sprinkle on the cake mix , followed by the chopped nuts
3. Pour the melted butter over the nuts
4. Bake until the berries bubble and the topping is brown , about 1 hour

title: reese s puffs sticky balls
steps:
1. Cut 18x12-inch sheet of waxed paper
2. Place on work surface
3. In 4-quart dutch oven , melt butter and marshmallows over low heat , stirring frequently , until smooth
4. Stir in cereal , spread cereal mixture on waxed paper
5. Cool 5 minutes
6. Cut 34x12-inch sheet of waxed paper
7. Place on work surface
8. Lightly spray hands with cooking spray
9. With hands , shape cereal mixture into 2 1 / 2-inch balls
10. In small microwavable dish , microwave chocolate chips and shortening on high 1 to 1 1 / 2 minutes , stirring until smooth
11. Drizzle chocolate over cereal balls
12. Let stand at least 30 minutes until chocolate is set before serving

title: broccoli  leek and snow pea stir fry
steps:
1. Steam the broccoli over boiling water until tender but still bright green , about 4 minutes
2. Set aside
3. Heat a large skillet or wok over medium-high heat
4. Add the oil and when it is warm , add the garlic and 5-spice powder and cook for 30 seconds or until aromatic
5. Add the leek and carrot and stir-fry for 2 minutes , or until they soften
6. Add the bok choy and stir-fry for 2 minutes , or until crisp tender
7. Add the snow peas and stir-fry for 2 minutes , or until crisp tender
8. Stir in the broccoli , soy sauce and five-spice powder and stir-fry for 2 minutes more or until heated through
9. Serve immediately

title: kona mango dressing
steps:
1. In a food processor or blender , pulse peppercorns until coarsely cracked
2. Add mango , basil , thyme , mint , chives , vinegar and honey
3. Blend well
4. Add oil , 1 teaspoon at a time until the mixture thickens and emulsifies
5. Season with salt and pepper

title: brecken s peanut butter roll ups
steps:
1. Cut crust from bread
2. Roll to 1 / 8 in thickness
3. Spread some peanut butter on each slice
4. Combine sugar and cinnamon and sprinkle evenly over each slice
5. Roll up each slice jellyroll style
6. Place seam side down in a lightly greased pan
7. Brush melted butter over rolls
8. Bake at 350 for 7min on each side

title: moist pumpkin oatmeal muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Into a large bowl measure and mix the oats , pumpkin purree , brown sugar , oil , buttermilk , eggs and water
3. Let this mixture sit while you measure the dry ingredients
4. Into a medium bowl measure the flour , spices , baking powder and salt
5. Mix together with a wire whisk
6. Pour dry ingredients into the pumpkin mixtue and stir together just until dry ingredients are moistened
7. Spray muffin cups with spray realease
8. Fill muffin cups a little more than half full
9. Bake regular sized muffins for 18 - 20 minutes , smaller muffins for 15 - 16 minutes
10. Let muffins sit in pans for 3 or 4 minutes then gently turn out onto baking rack to cool completely

title: okra medley  great as a side or a main dish
steps:
1. Cook the onions in the oil until tender
2. Add the tomatoes , garlic and spice mix
3. Simmer about 5-8 minutes to blend the flavors
4. Wait till the last minute to first wash , then dry and cut the okra to help prevent bleeding
5. Add the okra and peppers to the pot , cover and simmer until the okra is tender
6. For a main dish , add smoked sausage , or cubed , cooked chicken or pork and serve over rice
7. This is also excellent with black beans mixed in !

title: vegetable party bouquet
steps:
1. Cut the ends off each radish
2. Slice half way down on four sides to make petals , leaving the biggest part intact in the center
3. Place in a bowl of ice water
4. Core bell peppers
5. Cut into vertical leaf-shaped slices
6. Make carrot tulips by slicing toward the pointed end of the carrot with the
7. Form two more petals around the carrot
8. Angle knife
9. Place in ice water
10. Cut off the bottom of the green onion stalks leaving about 3 inches of the onion and part of the top
11. Reserve the upper part of the tops
12. Cut close vertical slits from the cut end down to an inch from the base
13. Place in ice water to frill
14. Trim skewers to various lengths
15. Place reserved onion tops over some of the skewers like a sheath
16. Insert top of covered skewers into bottoms of all florets , bell peppers , cucumber slices , radish and carrot flowers , tomatoes , prepared green onion frills , celery stalks , endive leaves and chicory leaves , creating a"stem" on each piece
17. Insert uncovered skewers into asparagus spears and breadsticks
18. Cut cabbage in half
19. Place in the bottom of the basket , cut side down , as a base
20. Create a bouquet by inserting ends of skewers into cabbage , balancing shapes and colors of the vegetables
21. Place vegetables on shorter skewers along the outer rim of the basket
22. Insert breadsticks just before serving to prevent them from getting soggy

title: easy mini muffulettas
steps:
1. Spread 1 tablespoon olive salad evenly over each cut side of roll bottoms
2. Top each with 1 swiss cheese slice , 1 ham slice , 1 tablespoons olive salad , 1 provolone cheese slice , 1 salami slice and 1 tablespoon olive salad
3. Cover with roll tops and wrap sandwiches together in a large piece of aluminum foil
4. Place on a baking sheet
5. Bake at 350 for 14 to 16 minutes or until cheeses are melted

title: lacquered chinese chicken wings
steps:
1. Mix marinade ingredients together
2. Pour over wings
3. Refrigerate for 24 hours , turning container or bag several times to distribute the marinade evenly
4. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
5. Line a baking sheet with heavy-duty foil and fold up a rim around the edges
6. Place marinaded wings on foil close together , but not touching
7. Bake for 1 hour and 15 minutes
8. Remove wings with tongs to paper towel lined plate , drain
9. Serve at room temperate or cold

title: chicken   basil roll ups with mustard sauce
steps:
1. First make your sauce and set aside at room-temp while the chicken is cooking
2. Pre-heat the oven to 400 degrees
3. Mix chopped basil and garlic and place 1 tablespoon on each chicken breast
4. In shallow bowl mix yogurt& mustard
5. In dish mix bread crumbs& cheese
6. Roll-up chicken to enclose basil& secure with tooth-pic
7. Dip in yogurt then bread / cheese mixture
8. Place on sprayed baking dish and drizzle with melted butter
9. Bake for 30 minutes and serve with a dollop of sauce

title: diabetic blueberry fizz
steps:
1. In a blender , whirl all ingredients until smooth
2. Serve in a tall glass

title: deannas southern sipper punch
steps:
1. Dissolve the sugar in the water ,
2. Then add the juices and the mashed
3. Bananas
4. Then you mix all together except the soda
5. Divide it into 6 equal portions into freezable containers
6. Freeze ahead
7. 2 hours ahead , shave frozen mixture into a punch bowl
8. One portion = 2 liter bottle
9. Makes 72 punch cupsif you are a true southern belle7 tumblers ! ha ha !

title: chelo  persian steamed rice
steps:
1. If you are using iranian rice , start at least 6 hours ahead
2. Spread it on a clean surface and pick out and discard any dark or discolored grains
3. Then wash it in a fine sieve or colander set under warm running water until the draining water runs clear
4. Finally place the rice in a large bowl or pot , add 1 / 4 cup of salt and enough cold water to cover it by about 1 inch and soak overnight , or for at least 6 hours
5. If you are using other long-grain rice , wash it in the same way , but soak it in the salt water for about 2 hours
6. In a heavy 3 to 4 quart saucepan equipped with a tightly fitting lid , bring 6 cups of fresh water to a boil over high heat
7. Drain the rice thoroughly and pour it into the boiling water
8. In a slow , thin stream so the water does not stop boiling
9. Stir once or twice , then boil briskly , uncovered for 5 minutes
10. Drain in a sieve
11. Pour 1 cup fresh water and the melted butter in the saucepan and pour in the parboiled rice , mounding it slightly in the middle of the pan
12. Cover the pan tightly with a strip of aluminum foil and set the lid in place
13. Simmer the rice over moderate heat to 15 to 20 minutes , or until the grains are tender and have absorbed all the liquid in the pan
14. Serve at once
15. Traditionally , when served with skewered broiled meat or chicken , the rice is served mounded into individual portions with a well in the center of each
16. A pat of butter is placed on top , a raw egg yolk is dropped in , and the top is sprinkled with salt , a grindings of pepper and if desired a little dried sumak

title: avocado  orange and purple onion salad
steps:
1. With a sharp knife , cut the skin and all the white pith off the oranges
2. Working over a small bowl to catch the juice , segment the orange slices , cutting on either side of each segment to release it from the membrane
3. Arrange for great presentation in a salad bowl
4. Halve , pit , and peel the avocado and cut crosswise into thin slices
5. Add the salad bowl
6. Separate the onion slices into rings
7. Arrange in the bowl with tor orange segments and avocado slices
8. In a small bowl , whisk together the salt , 1 tablespoon the reserved orange juice , the oil and the bergs ,
9. Immediately pour over the salad and serve at once

title: maple pecan pie
steps:
1. Sift the flour and salt into a mixing bowl
2. Rub the fats into it until the mixture resembles fine crumbs
3. Add just enough cold water to mix to a dough that leaves the bowl clean
4. Leave the pastry to rest in a polythene bag in the refrigerator for 20-30 minutes
5. Turn the oven to 400f
6. Whilst the oven is heating up toast the pecans for 10 minutes stirring occasionally
7. Roll the pastry out and place in a pie dish that has been dusted with cornflour
8. Blind bake for 10 minutes
9. Melt the butter and mix together with the maple syrup , sugar , eggs and vanilla essence
10. Fold in the pecans , you can chop them in half if desired
11. Pour the filling into the pie crust and bake for 1 hour at 275f
12. The pie is ready if it does not wobble at the outer edges when you twist the dish

title: spicy tofu bento bowl
steps:
1. To make spicy tofu: whisk together soy sauce , chili sauce and sesame oil in bowl
2. Heat nonstick skillet over medium heat
3. Dip tofu in chili mixture
4. Cook 10 minutes or until browned , turning occasionally
5. Add green onions , yogurt and lemon juice to remaining chili mixture
6. Toss with tofu
7. To make salad:
8. Whisk together soy sauce , lemon juice , ginger and chili sauce in bowl
9. Mound rice in the bowls
10. Top with greens
11. Shave strips of carrots over top with vegetable peeler
12. Top with tofu , cucumber and avocado
13. Sprinkle with sesame seeds and serve with sauce

title: vegetarian tamale casserole for meat lovers
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients except cilantro and cornbread
2. If mixture appears too loose , mix 1 tbls of cornstarch or arrowroot with saved kidney bean water until smooth
3. Stir into mixture
4. Spray a 2 1 / 2 to 3 quart baking dish
5. Pour mixture in and smooth out
6. Make cornbread as directed on package
7. Add cilantro into cornbread mix
8. Top casserole with mixture , sealing to edges
9. Bake at 350 degrees for 40 to 50 minutes or until top is golden brown

title: olive garden fettuccini alfredo  copycat
steps:
1. Depending on how thick or thin of a sauce you like will depend on how much heavy cream you use add garlic to your taste i love garlic so i use 2 heaping tablespoons
2. Over medium heat in a saucepan melt 1 stick of butter and add the entire container of parmesan cheese and begin to whisk
3. Add garlic slowly
4. Add heavy cream , again whisking until no longer lumpy
5. At this temp it should come to a boil on its own
6. When it does , slowly add more heavy cream until the consistency you desire , and then remove from heat
7. Immediately pour over pasta and enjoy !

title: stewed tomatoes and garbanzo beans
steps:
1. Heat oil in a medium sauce pan
2. Saut the onion and garlic for 5 to 7 minutes , stirring frequently , until the onions start to brown
3. Add all remaining ingredients
4. Cover and simmer 8 to 10 minutes , stirring occasionally
5. Remove cover
6. Serve

title: mom pat s pancakes
steps:
1. Mix ingredients together
2. Pour enough batter for one pancake into a hot buttered pan
3. Swirl like a crepe in the pan
4. Cook until browned on one side and flip

title: candy cane cocktail
steps:
1. Put the peppermint schnapps , creme de cacao , vanilla ice cream , and one candy cane in a blender and blend until thick and smooth
2. Add milk if the mixture is too thick to blend
3. Garnish each glass with a mini candy cane , or the straight end of a full sized candy cane

title: sicilian chocolate gelato
steps:
1. In medium saucepan bring 2 cups of the milk to a simmer
2. Meanwhile , whisk the remaining cup of milk with the sugar , cocoa , and cornstarch
3. Scrape the cocoa mixture into the hot milk
4. Cook , stirring constantly until the mixture thickens and bubbles a little at the edges
5. Stir and cook for a minute longer
6. Strain through a fine wire-mesh strainer into a clean bowl and cool
7. Cover the surface of the mixture with plastic wrap and chill overnight
8. To make gelato: freeze according to the instructions with your ice cream maker
9. The mixture is thick to begin with and may take less time than average in the ice cream maker
10. Makes one scant quart ice cream
11. To make fudge pops: divide the chilled gelato base between the ice pop molds and place in the freezer overnight to set
12. These will have a slightly icy texture
13. To make granita: pour the chilled gelato base into a large , shallow baking dish and place in the freezer
14. In about an hour , the liquid will begin to freeze along the sides of the pan
15. Using a fork , scrape the ice towards the center of the pan
16. Repeat this process every 20 minutes or so until all of the mixture is frozen and flaked

title: grandma s dip
steps:
1. Blend together until smooth
2. Allow to stand at least 15 minutes before serving
3. Serve with your favorite raw vegetables

title: coconut ice slice
steps:
1. Blend the 1 / 2 cup sugar , 1 / 2 cup butter
2. Add 1 egg mix well
3. Blend 1 cup flour and 1 teaspoon baking powder
4. When well blended press into a cookie sheet
5. Bake at 350' for 25 30 minutes
6. Blend together 1 cup coconut , 1 cup icing sugar , 3 tablespoons melted butter and the food colouring
7. When well blended add just enough hot water to make it spreadable
8. Ice while still warm

title: schezwan  or szechuan spicy hot chicken
steps:
1. Heat oil on high in a skillet or wok
2. Add chicken and stir-fry for 5 minutes
3. Add yellow onion and red chili peppers
4. Continue to cook on high for additional 5 minutes , stirring continuously
5. Add tsang schezuan spicy stir-fry sauce and heavenly chef hunan red chili sauce and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes
6. Add scallions and ground black pepper
7. Cook for an additional 2 minutes
8. Serve over white or brown rice

title: japanese grilled eggplant   aubergine   yaki nasu
steps:
1. Bring seasoning ingredients to a boil in a small saucepan and let cool
2. Bring sauce to a boil in a small saucepan and let cool
3. Grill eggplants whole on a wire rack on grill until they are soft and feel tender
4. Test with your finger or a toothpick to see how soft it is
5. Place in cold water to cool
6. Then peel and pat dry
7. Put eggplant in seasoning liquid
8. Allow to sit for at least 10 minutes
9. Remove eggplant and cut into bite-size pieces
10. Place eggplant into serving dish
11. Top with some sauce and a few bonito flakes
12. Serve at room temperature or chilled

title: rice noodles with tofu and bok choy
steps:
1. Cook noodles in boiling water 6 minutes
2. Drain
3. Combine soy sauce , vinegar , sugar , oil , and crushed red pepper , stirring well with a whisk
4. Heat a large nonstick skillet coated with cooking spray over medium-high heat
5. Add bell pepper strips
6. Saut 2 minutes
7. Add bok choy
8. Saut 1 minute
9. Add tofu and garlic
10. Saut 2 minutes
11. Add noodles and soy sauce mixture
12. Cook 2 minutes or until thoroughly heated , tossing well to coat
13. Sprinkle with green onions and cilantro

title: mom s chicken wiggle
steps:
1. Prepare the cheese sauce per recipe
2. While the sauce is still hot stir in the chicken and the peas
3. Heat long enough so the chicken and peas are heated through
4. Serve hot over your choice of optional beds

title: apple brown betty crepes
steps:
1. Crepes:
2. Combine flour , sugar and salt in small bowl
3. Add milk , eggs and oil , stirring until smooth
4. Cover and refrigerate 1 hour
5. Spray a 6-inch nonstick skillet lightly with no-stick cooking spray
6. Heat skillet
7. Add 2 tablespoons batter , tilting skillet to make 6-inch crepe
8. Cook over moderate heat 30 to 60 seconds , or until bottom is light brown
9. Turn crepe over
10. Cook 30 to 45 seconds longer or until bottom is light brown
11. Cool on wire rack
12. Lightly spray skillet , if necessary
13. Repeat with remaining batter , spraying as needed
14. I always cover the crepes with a tea towel while cooking the others
15. Filling:
16. Mix apples , brown sugar , water , honey , lemon juice , cinnamon , salt and nutmeg in medium saucepan
17. Heat to boiling
18. Reduce heat to medium
19. Cover
20. Simmer , stirring occasionally , about 10 minutes , or until apples are tender
21. Combine flour and granulated sugar in small bowl
22. Stir into apple mixture
23. Cook , stirring constantly , 1 to 2 minutes longer , or until mixture thickens
24. Remove from heat
25. Add walnuts and butter , stirring until butter melts
26. Heat oven to 400f
27. Spray a 13 x 9-inch baking pan with no-stick cooking spray
28. Spread about 2 tablespoons filling down center of each crepe
29. Fold opposite edges of crepe over apple mixture
30. Arrange crepes in prepared pan
31. Spread remaining apple mixture over crepes
32. Topping:
33. Combine all topping ingredients in small bowl
34. Sprinkle over crepes
35. Bake 10 minutes , or until hot
36. Top with whipped cream , if desired

title: carol p s six can chicken tortilla soup
steps:
1. Pour all ingredients into a small dutch oven
2. Mix thoroughly and simmer on medium heat until chicken is heated through
3. Ladle into bowls and top with shredded cheddar cheese and sour cream
4. Serve with tortilla chips

title: easy egg roll
steps:
1. Heat oil in skillet
2. Saut garlic and onions until tender
3. Add pork and saut until browned
4. Add coleslaw blend and stir-fry on high heat about 5 minutes
5. Remove from heat and add seasonings , and salt and pepper to taste
6. To assemble , place 2 tbs filling near corner towards you
7. Then fold over left and right sides
8. Dampen edges of the corner that is away from you , and finish rolling
9. Deep fry at 350f , until golden brown
10. Drain on paper towels and enjoy !
11. These can also be frozen and fried later
12. Some people like a dipping sauce for egg rolls
13. But these are so tasty , they really don't need one

title: caramelized pecan pumpkin tart
steps:
1. For crust: sprinkle of pecans onto lightly-floured surface
2. Place pie crust disk atop pecans and sprinkle with remaining pecans
3. Roll out to 1 / 8 inch thick round
4. Transfer to 9 inch in diameter tart pan with removable bottom
5. Gently press into place
6. Trim and finish edges
7. Refrigerate 30 minutes
8. For filling: preheat oven to 400f whisk pumpkin , eggs , both sugars and spices in bowl to blend
9. Stir in cream and vanilla extract
10. Place tart pan on rimmed cookie sheet
11. Pour filling into pan
12. Bake 45 minutes , or until filling is set
13. Cool on rack
14. Refrigerate until cold , about 2 hours
15. For topping: combine sugar and pecans
16. Cut in butter until mixture resembles coarse meal
17. Preheat broiler
18. Sprinkle topping evenly over tart
19. Broil until sugar melts and bubbles , watching carefully , about 1 minute
20. Cool 15 minutes
21. Serve with whipped cream

title: refrigerator pineapple cheesecake
steps:
1. Mix crumbs , margarine and oil
2. Press into bottom of 8" spring form pan or 8"x10-1 / 2" pan and chill
3. Dissolve gelatin in boiling water and cool until lukewarm
4. Mix cheese , sugar and vanilla in blender
5. Slowly add gelatin and blend well
6. Pour cheese mixture into crust and chill until firm
7. Put pineapple , pineapple juice , water and cornstarch in saucepan and bring to a boil
8. Stir constantly
9. Cool 15 minutes
10. Spread over cheese cake and chill 1 hour or more

title: broccoli in herbed butter
steps:
1. Cut broccoli into spears and cook until crisp tender
2. Melt butter and add remaining ingredients
3. Drain broccoli and toss with butter mixture

title: moo shu beef lettuce cups   4 points
steps:
1. Brown ground beef , onion , ginger and garlic in a skillet on medium heat
2. Break meat up as it cooks
3. When beef is browned , add bok choy , pepper , mushrooms and soy sauce and cook until bok choy is wilted , about 3-5 minutes
4. Clean and dry bibb lettuce leaves
5. When beef mixture is done , spoon 1 / 2 cup of beef mixture into each lettuce leaf
6. Yields 2 filled leaves per serving
7. Serve with extra soy sauce if desired

title: pizza breadsticks
steps:
1. Heat oven to 300f , place bread sticks about an inch apart on a baking sheet , foil lined and lightly sprayed with veggie oil in a bowl mix tomatoe paste , water , oil , chili & pepper , mix well brush the tops of the bread sticks with this mixture
2. Sprinkle the sticks with the oregano , basil and mozzarella cheese
3. Bake bread sticks until heated through 3-5 minutes and the cheese has melted cool 1 minute& serve warm

title: butternut squash curry
steps:
1. Puree onion , garlic and 1 tbls vegetable broth in blender until smooth
2. Heat oil in 4 qt pot over med heat , add mustard seeds , fennel seeds and coriander , cook until fragrant
3. Stir in onion paste and ginger
4. Cook , stirring often , until caramelized , 6 to 8 minutes
5. Add tomato paste , scraping bottom of pot if needed
6. Stir in remaining 3 cups of broth , salt and chili pepper flakes
7. Add squash , and cover partially
8. Bring to a boil
9. Reduce heat , and simmer gently until squash is tender , 12 to 15 minutes
10. Serve over brown rice and garnish with cilantro and lime wedges
11. To thicken curry a bit , mash up some of the squash

title: plum and nectarine pie
steps:
1. For filling , in a large mixing bowl stir together sugar , the 3 tablespoons flour , vanilla , cinnamon , and nutmeg
2. Add the plum and nectarine slices
3. Gently toss plums and nectarines until coated
4. Set filling aside
5. For pastry , in a large mixing bowl stir together the 2 cups flour and salt
6. Using a pastry blender , cut in the shortening or lard until pieces are the size of small peas
7. Sprinkle 1 tablespoon of the water over part of the flour mixture , then gently toss with a fork
8. Push moistened dough to the side of the bowl
9. Repeat , using 1 tablespoon of water at a time , until all is moistened
10. Divide dough in half
11. Form each half into a ball
12. On a lightly floured surface , use your hands to slightly flatten one ball of dough
13. Roll dough from center to edges , forming a 12-inch circle
14. Wrap the pastry around the rolling pin
15. Unroll onto a 9-inch pie plate
16. Ease pastry into the pie plate , being careful not to stretch it
17. For top crust , repeat rolling with remaining dough
18. Transfer the filling to the pastry-lined pie plate
19. Trim the bottom pastry even with rim of pie plate
20. Cut slits in top crust to allow steam to escape
21. Place top crust on filling
22. Trim top crust 1 / 2-inch beyond edge of plate
23. Fold top crust under bottom crust
24. Flute edge
25. Brush with milk and sprinkle with cinnamon-sugar
26. To prevent overbrowning , cover the edge of pie with foil
27. Bake in a 375 degree f oven for 25 minutes
28. Remove the foil
29. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes more or until top is golden
30. Cool pie on a wire rack

title: amalgamation cake  using a cake mix
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Lightly spray bottom of 2 8 inch round baking pans
3. Combine cake mix , water and egg whites
4. Mix on low speed for 1 minute
5. Beat on low speed for 2 minutes
6. Pour batter into prepared pans
7. Bake for 32-36 minutes
8. Cool in pans on cooling rack for 15 minutes
9. Remove from pans
10. Filling:
11. In a double boiler combine egg yolks , flour 2 cups sugar and butter
12. Cook over low heat until thick
13. I used a large bowl and cooked it in the microwave on 50% until thickened
14. Add walnuts , pecans , raisins and coconut
15. Mix well
16. Spread filling between cooled layers and on side of cake
17. Frost top with any white frosting

title: cheddar breadsticks
steps:
1. Place ingredients , in the order recommended by your manufacturer , into the bread pan
2. Press the menu button to select the dough program
3. When cycle is completed , remove dough from machine and transfer to a lightly floured surface and punch down to deflate
4. Preheat oven to 375f and line baking sheets with parchment paper
5. Roll the dough out into a rectangle , about 1 / 4-inch thick , 10 inches long and 22 inches wide
6. Roll the rectangle so that its width runs from left to right
7. With a pizza cutter or sharp knife , cut strips that are each - inch wide
8. Twist each strip so it resembles a cheese straw
9. Place on parchment lined baking sheet and cover with plastic and allow to rest for about 30 minutes
10. Once breadsticks have rested brush with olive oil and bake until golden about 15 to 20 minutes
11. Allow to cool slightly and serve

title: chai tea blend
steps:
1. To make heat milk and water together in equal proportions and add 1 tablespoon per cup of mixture
2. Let stand for 10 minutes strain and serve

title: heavenly chicken
steps:
1. In a saucepan , saut the scallions in butter until tender
2. Whisk in flour
3. Whisk in milk all at once
4. Bring to a boil and cook and stir until the sauce is thickened and bubbly
5. Meanwhile , combine the cracker crumbs and cheese
6. Dip chicken breast halves in the crumb mixture to coat lightly
7. Retain remaining crumb mixture
8. Arrange the breast halves in a greased 13 x 9-inch baking dish
9. Stir the spinach and ham into the white sauce
10. Spoon the spinach mixture over the chicken
11. Bake , covered , at 350f for 60 to 75 minutes
12. Uncover and sprinkle with crumbs
13. Bake 10 minutes more

title: beef   pork chile rellenos
steps:
1. Brown the ground pork and ground beef
2. Add , diced tomatoes , raisins , almonds , onions , cumin , garlic , cloves , rice , and coriander
3. Mix well , cover and simmer for 15 minutes
4. The water should be all absorbed , if not remove lid and cook until only moist , not watery
5. This can be done earlier than the rest of the steps , refridgerate if using within a day or freeze if longer
6. Thaw before using
7. The following steps must be done just prior to serving:
8. Because you are using fresh chiles , they must be peeled , as the batter will not adhere to the slick skins of the chiles / peppers
9. Do this by charring the chiles either over an open flame or under the broiler
10. Then steam them in a hot towel or a closed paper sack , and when they are cool enough to touch , remove the skins
11. Slit the chiles lengthwise and remove seeds and veins using a teaspoon , leaving the stem intact
12. Dredge the chiles in 1 / 4 cup of flour and shake off extra flour
13. Prepare the batter by separating the whites from the yolks
14. Beat the whites very stiff
15. Beat the yolks and fold into beaten whites
16. Fold in the 6 tbs of flour
17. To complete the rellenos , spoon the meat mixture into the chiles
18. Add some cheese
19. Dip the chiles into the batter and fry , at medium heat , in 1 inch cooking oil in frying pan at medium high , until light browned on both sides
20. Use slotted spoon to place chile in oil and to turn and remove
21. Serve with mild picante sauce on top of rellenos
22. (this can be purchased in any grocery store
23. Side dishes that go well with this are refried beans , mexican rice and tortillas

title: creamy chicken or turkey noodle soup
steps:
1. Melt the butter in a large pot then add the broth , milk , spices , & bay leaves
2. Cut the cream cheese into small squares then add them to the pot along with the parmesan & chicken
3. Stir in the noodles & simmer for 10-12 minutes
4. Mix the cornstarch with a little water then stir into the pot
5. Simmer for 5 minutes or until the soup thickens
6. Add the cheese then stir until melted

title: copycat franks red hot sauce
steps:
1. Using fresh cayenne peppers
2. There are two different ways to prepare this sauce
3. You can use fresh cayenne peppers , or you can use cayenne peppers from your garden that you have canned
4. If you're using fresh cayenne peppers , simply remove the ends and measure all of the ingredients into a small saucepan
5. Heat over medium heat until boiling
6. Reduce the heat slightly , but so the mixture continues to boil
7. Simmer about 20-25 minutes
8. Remove the mixture from heat , carefully pour it into a blender & puree until thick and smooth
9. Transfer the mixture back into the saucepan and simmer another 15 minutes
10. Using canned cayenne peppers
11. If you're using canned cayenne peppers , which is what we used in this particular recipe --
12. In a blender add 18 peppers , 1 cup of vinegar , garlic , salt , and garlic powder
13. Cover and puree until smooth
14. Transfer to a saucepan and bring to a boil
15. Reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes
16. The sauce is much better if you allow the flavors to marry overnight in the fridge , but if you don't have enough time to let it marinate overnight it will still turn out great wings !

title: swiss vegetable medley
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl , combine veggies , soup , 1 / 2 cup of cheese , sour cream , pimento and 1 / 2 cup of onions
2. Pour into a 1 quart baking dish and bake covered at 350 for 30 minutes
3. Top with remaining cheese and onions
4. Bake uncovered for 5 minutes

title: portuguese tomato rice
steps:
1. Heat olive oil and butter in saucepan until butter is melted
2. Add onion and garlic and saut until onion is soft
3. Add chopped tomatoes , cover and simmer for 15 minutes
4. Add broth and bring to a boil , then add rice , cover and simmer for about 20 minutes
5. Salt and pepper to taste

title: tomato stuffed red bell peppers
steps:
1. Place a few teaspoons of oil into a shallow rasting dish
2. Cut peppers in half lengthwise and lay them cutside up
3. Add a small whole or half tomato to each pepper
4. Sprinkle chopped basil leaves , spring onions , chopped garlic and salt and pepper over
5. Drizzle with the olive oil
6. Bake 25 minutes

title: herbal salt substitute
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine all ingredients
2. Store in an airtight container in a cool , dry place for up to 1 year

title: carrot   pineapple bundt cake with cream cheese frosting
steps:
1. Cake: grease and lightly flour bundt pan
2. In a large bowl mix together flour , sugars , cinnamon , baking powder , baking soda , and salt
3. Drain crushed pineapple reserve the drained juice
4. In medium sized bowl separate bowl mix the pineapple juice , eggs , vegetable oil , vanilla and mix well
5. Add wet ingredients into the dry ingredients
6. Mix for 3 minutes or until well incorporated
7. Stir in carrots , crushed pineapple and chopped pecans
8. Pour into pan and bake at 325f for 1 1 / 4 hours
9. Let the cake cool for 20 mins in the pan and then turn out onto cooling rack
10. Do not frost till completely cool
11. Icing / frosting: mix sugar , cream cheese , butter , milk and vanilla
12. Fold in chopped pecans and spread onto cool cake

title: southwestern cocktail sauce
steps:
1. Stir all ingredients together
2. Cover and chill at least 3 hours for the flavors to mingle

title: lemon buttermilk sorbet
steps:
1. Stir sugar , lemon juice and peel in medium bowl
2. Add buttermilk
3. Stir until sugar dissolves
4. Chill until cold , about 4 hours
5. Process mixture in ice cream maker according to manufacturer's instructions
6. Transfer to container with lid
7. Freeze
8. I estimated the freezer time , after it is made in the ice cream maker , at 3 hours
9. It just depends on you frig and how frozen you want the sorbet
10. I did not include the actual time to make in the ice cream maker , as each one is different

title: stock from roasted beef marrow bones
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
2. Place bones , stew meat , onions , and carrots in a roasting pan
3. Rum everything with a little olive oil
4. Roast about 45 minutes , flipping bones , meat , and vegetables halfway through
5. Bones should be browned , not charred
6. Remove everything and place in a large stockpot
7. Place roasting pan over two burners , add about a cup of hot water and scrape browned bits from bottom of pan
8. Pour into stockpot , then add enough water to cover bones by 2 to 3 inches
9. Add celery , garlic , parsley , bay leaf , and peppercorns
10. Heat stock to a low simmer , then reduce heat and almost simmer for at least 3 hours , 6-8 is better
11. Do not stir as this will combine the fat with the stock and cause it to become cloudy
12. During cooking you can skim off any fat and scum from the top
13. Use tongs to remove bones and vegetables
14. Strain stock through cheesecloth to remove all solids
15. Let cool to room temperature
16. Store in the refrigerator with the fat layer intact
17. Remove fat if storing in the freezer
18. Remember to leave an inch of headspace so your container does not burst in the freezer since it will expand

title: honey cinaberry cheese smoothie
steps:
1. Blend together !
2. Drink !

title: vegan lemon cupcakes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 , line pans with paper liners
2. W
3. Hisk together soy milk and vinegar in large bowl and set aside to curdle
4. Beat together soy milk mixture , oil , sugar , vanilla , almond and lemon extracts
5. In a separate bowl , sift together dry ingredients
6. Mix wet and dry ingredients until no large lumps remain
7. Mix in lemon zest
8. Fill cupcake liners 2 / 3 full and bake 20-22 minutes

title: festive tuna salad
steps:
1. Flake the tuna with a fork
2. Add mayo , , lemon juice
3. Mix well
4. Add salt and pepper to taste
5. Fold in mushrooms and peas
6. If you add the peas frozen they will thaw quite quickly
7. If using toast bread - toast bread and add a generous scoop of tuna salad on top
8. Garnish with tomatoes and fresh herbs
9. If using baquette - add tuna salad to plate and garnish with tomates and fresh herbs , serving bread on the side

title: dragged penne with meat sauce
steps:
1. Pour the oil into a skillet large enough to hold all of the cooked pasta
2. Add the onion , carrot , celery , garlic , and basil
3. Cook over medium heat until the vegetables are tender , about 10 minutes
4. Add the beef and cook , stirring frequently to break up any lumps , about 10 minutes
5. Add the wine and bring to a simmer
6. Cook 1 minute
7. Stir in the tomatoes , broth , and salt and pepper to taste
8. Simmer on low heat 45 minutes , stirring occasionally
9. Bring 4 quarts of water to a boil in a large pot
10. Add 2 tbsp of salt , then the pasta
11. Stir well
12. Cook over high heat , stirring frequently , until the pasta is almost tender but slightly underdone
13. Set aside some cooking water
14. Drain the pasta
15. Add the pasta to the skillet and raise the heat to medium
16. Cook , stirring the pasta well , for 2 minutes , adding some of the water if necessary
17. Stir in the cheeses and serve immediately

title: grilled caesar chicken breasts
steps:
1. In a large resealable plastic bag , combine the dressing , oil , mustard and garlic
2. Add the chicken
3. Seal bag and turn to coat
4. Refrigerate for 8 hours or overnight
5. Drain and discard marinade
6. Grill chicken , covered , over medium heat or broil 4 inches from the heat for 6-8 minutes on each side or until a meat thermometer reads 170

title: cheesy beef stuffed pasta shells
steps:
1. Prepare macaroni shells according to package directions
2. Drain and set aside
3. Cook ground beef , onion , and garlic in a large skillet until beef is browned
4. Drain excess fat
5. Stir in next 6 ingredients
6. Set aside
7. Combine spaghetti sauce and wine
8. Spoon one-fourth of sauce into a lightly greased oblong baking pan
9. Set aside remaining sauce
10. Stuff macaroni shells with beef mixture , and place in baking dish
11. Spoon remaining sauce over shells
12. Sprinkle parmesan cheese over shells
13. Bake , uncovered , at 400 degrees for 20 minutes

title: flax oatmeal raisin cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. In a large bowl , cream together butter , brown sugar , vanilla and cinnamon until smooth
3. Add the two kinds of oats , one at a time mixing well after each addition
4. Add whole wheat flour , ground flax , baking soda and raisins and mix well to incorporate into the stiff dough
5. Take the dough out of the bowl and place on a cutting board or a flat surface
6. Roll the dough out with your hands into a 1 1 / 2 inch diameter cylinder
7. With a serrated edged knife , cut the roll into 1 / 2 inch thick discs
8. Place the discs on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper
9. In a preheated 375 oven bake for 12 minutes or until golden brown
10. Cool cookies on the baking sheet for 30 minutes
11. Remove to a wire rack and let cool completely

title: chicken pecan quiche
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Combine flour , 1c cheese , pecans & paprika in a bowl and mix throughly
3. Add oil and stir until mix is crumbly
4. Reserve 1 / 4 c of the crumb mix
5. Press the remaining crumbs into the sides and bottom of a pie plate
6. Pick the bottom with a fork and bake 10 minute
7. Remove and reduce oven to 325
8. Whisk sour cream , mayonnaise , broth and eggs in a bowl until blended
9. Stir in chicken and 1 / 2 c cheese and onion
10. Spoon mix into the baked crust
11. Sprinkle the top with reserved crumb mix
12. Top with pecans and bake 45 minutes

title: orange ginger cookies
steps:
1. Cream together butter and sugar
2. Add egg and mix well
3. Add grated peel and molasses and mix again
4. Stir together dry ingredients and add to butter mixture , stirring well
5. Wrap up dough and chill for several hours or overnight
6. Roll dough very thin and cut out cookies with cookie cutters
7. Bake on greased cookie sheets at 375f for 8 to 10 minutes

title: delicious almost instant chai
steps:
1. Place milk and spices into a very clean jar , shake to mix and chill
2. Let set for 24 hours for optimum flavor , though i have used it immediately because i was impatient
3. The longer it sits , the stronger the flavors get , and it will last for a few weeks in the fridge
4. Use 2-3 tablespoons per cup with your favorite tea and sweeten with your favorite sweetener
5. I'm partial to green tea and honey myself

title: chicken in coconut milk from madagascar
steps:
1. Marinate the chicken in the lemon juice , lemon rind , salt and pepper for about an hour
2. Heat oil in dutch oven or large covered pot
3. Saute the onion and garlic for a few minutes
4. Add the chicken and continue to cook and stir until the chicken is nearly done
5. Reduce heat , add tomatoes and ginger and stir for a few minutes
6. Add coconut milk and simmer over low heat until chicken is fully cooked and sauce is thickened
7. Serve over rice

title: incredible chocolate chip cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. In a large mixing bowl , cream together the first 5 ingrediets
3. They won't blend perfectly , but do what you can
4. In another bowl , add all the dry ingredients including the choc chips
5. Blend well
6. Add dry ingredients to the butter mixture
7. Now this part is important
8. Make sure you add the dry to the butter and not the other way around
9. Mix well together
10. I use a cookie scoop to measure out onto a cookie sheet
11. Keep an eye on the first batch as every oven is different
12. Bake for approx 8 - 10 minute
13. Let sit on cookie sheet for a couple minute thenplace on a cooling rack
14. They will be slightly puffed up , but will flatten out quickly

title: annie s pandan waffle
steps:
1. Turn on your waffle iron
2. In one bowl , mix together all the dry ingredients
3. In a separate bowl , combine the coconut milk , melted butter , egg yolk , and pandan extract
4. Add the wet ingredients to the dry and gently stir it inches switch to a folding motion towards the end to incorporate all the flour
5. The batter will be a little lumpy and thick , but the important thing is not to overmix it
6. Whisk the egg white until it forms stiff peaks
7. Gently fold the egg white into the batter
8. Now here comes the easy part
9. When the iron is hot , ladle some of the pandan waffle batter onto the grid
10. Close the lid and go get a plate and a fork
11. Breathe in that wonderful pandan aroma tell your tummy to stop growling already , because in a couple of minutes it's going to be mighty happy
12. When the waffle maker signals that your pandan waffle is ready , lift it out with a fork onto your waiting plate
13. Put the fork down
14. Resist the urge to pick up the waffle and jam it into your mouth
15. Wait for it to cool a little
16. If you don't , you'll give yourself first-degree burns on your finger
17. Resist !
18. Go back to step 4 and prep another waffle
19. There , that ought to be enough time now
20. Go for it
21. Forget the fork
22. Forget syrup
23. Just pick it up and devour to your heart's content

title: curried banana dip
steps:
1. In saucepan , melt butter over medium heat
2. Cook onion for 3 minutes , or until softened but not browned
3. Push to side of pan
4. Add banana slices to pan and cook for 1 minute
5. Add curry powder and cook for 1 minute , stirring banana and onion together
6. Add water and bring to boil
7. Reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes or until thickened and liquid is reduced by half
8. Remove from heat
9. Stir in jam
10. Transfer to food processor or blender
11. Process until smooth
12. Add sour cream , mayonnaise , salt , and pepper to taste
13. Process just until combined

title: grilled polenta
steps:
1. Grease a 9 inch square pan
2. In a large saucepan , cook onion in 6 tablespoons butter until tender
3. Add milk and bring to a boil over medium high heat
4. Meanwhile in a small bowl , combine the cornmeal and water , mixing well
5. With a fork , stir cornmeal mixture into boiling milk mixture
6. Reduce heat to medium and cook stirring constantly until mixture is very thick , about 15 minutes
7. Remove from heat
8. Stir in parmesan and salt
9. Spread mixture in greased pan
10. Let stand until cool
11. Refrigerate 1 to 2 hours or freeze 30 minutes until firm
12. Heat grill
13. Cut polenta into 9 squares
14. Gently remove from pan
15. Brush tops and bottoms with melted butter or oil
16. Place over medium heat 4-6 inches from coals
17. Cook 10 to 15 minutes until hot and brown , turning once
18. Serve immediately

title: chestnut and cranberry dressing
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit
2. Butter a 2 1 / 2 - 3 quart backing dish
3. In a small saucepan over medium heat , warm the stock until steam starts to rise , 3-5 minutes
4. Remove from heat and add dried cranberries
5. Set aside
6. In a large frying pan over medium heat , melt the butter and add onion , celery and carrots and saute , stirring occasionally , until tender and translucent , about 2-3 minutes
7. Using a slotted spoon , transfer to a bowl
8. If using , in same pan , saute the sausage , stirring and crumbling with a fork , until lightly browned and cooked through , about 10 minutes
9. Using a slotted spoon , transfer to the bowl with vegetables
10. In a large bowl , stir the egg while slowly pouring in the stock and cranberries
11. Add the bread and toss until well blended
12. Let standing , stirring occasionally , until the stock is absorbed , 6-8 minutes
13. Add the vegetable mixture , chestnuts , sage , thyme and parsley
14. Season with salt and pepper and stir well to mix
15. Transfer to prepared baking dish and bake until browned and crispy , about 45-50 minutes

title: baked lemon   ricotta tart with strawberries
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 200c , place the flour , butter , sugar and salt in the bowl of the food processor and , using the chopping blade , process until the mixture resembles fine breadcrumbs
2. Add the egg yolks and water and process until the dough starts to come together , turn onto a lightly floured surface and knead lightly until smooth
3. Shape into a disc and cover with plastic wrap
4. And place in the fridge for 20 minutes to rest
5. Roll out the pastry on a lightly floured surface to a 3mm-thick disc , and line a lightly greased 25cm-base fluted tart tin , with a removable base , with pastry and trim any excess
6. Place in the fridge for 30 minutes to rest
7. Cover the pastry base with baking powder and fill with pastry weights , rice or dried beans
8. And bake in the oven for 15 minutes
9. Remove the paper and weights , rice or dried beans and bake for a further 10-12 minutes or until golden , remove from the oven and reduce the oven temperature to 190c
10. Place the ricotta , sugar , egg , extra egg yolks and lemon rind and juice in the bowl of the food processor and , using the chopping blade , process the mixture until it is smooth
11. Pour it into the pastry case and bake the tart in the oven for 30 minutes or until the filling is just set
12. Set aside for 30 minutes to cool
13. Dust the tart with icing sugar , cut into wedges and serve with strawberries

title: tsr version of girl scout shortbread cookies by todd wilbur
steps:
1. In a large mixing bowl , cream together the shortening , sugar , vanilla , and salt with an electric mixer
2. Add the egg and beat mixture until it's fluffy
3. Add the baking soda and mix for about 20 seconds , then add the buttermilk and mix for an additional 30 seconds
4. In another bowl , combine the flour and baking powder
5. Pour dry ingredients into wet ingredients and mix well with an electric mixer until flour is incorporated
6. Roll the dough into a ball , cover it with plastic wrap and then chill it for 1 hour
7. Preheat oven to 325
8. Roll dough out on a well floured surface to 1 / 8 inch thick and punch out cookies with a 1 1 / 2 to 2 inch cutter
9. Arrange cookies on an ungreased cookie sheet
10. Bake for 12 / 15 minutes or until golden brown

title: mini frittatas with ham   cheese
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Heat a large nonstick skillet coated with cooking spray over medium-high heat
3. Add onion
4. Saute 2 minutes or until crisp-tender
5. Add ham
6. Saute 3 minutes
7. Remove from heat
8. Cool 5 minutes
9. Combine remaining ingredients in a large bowl
10. Stir with a whisk
11. Add ham mixture , stirring with a whisk
12. Spoon mixture into 24 miniature muffin cups coated with cooking spray
13. Bake at 350 degrees for 20 minutes or until set

title: jack daniel s pecan pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Combine eggs , sugar , butter , syrup , vanilla and jack daniel's
3. Mix well
4. Sprinkle chocolate chips over the bottom of the pie shell
5. Add the pie mixture and pecans
6. Bake at 375 degrees for 35-40 minutes

title: hot and sweet drumsticks
steps:
1. For sauce~ in a small saucepan , combine preserves , ketchup , soy sauce , garlic and hot pepper sauce
2. Cook and stir over medium heat until preserves are melted
3. Arrange drumsticks in a single layer in 13x9 baking pan
4. Pour sauce over drumsticks , turning to coat
5. Bake uncovered in a 350 oven for 40 to 45 minutes or until chicken is done , spooning sauce over drumsticks once during baking
6. Serve drumsticks over rice
7. If desired , spoon sauce from baking pan over chicken and rice

title: cinnamon roll with vanilla frosting
steps:
1. Add the warm water to the yeast and soak 10 minutes
2. Scald milk
3. Pour over the shortening
4. Add sugar and salt and cool to tepid
5. Add the dissolved yeast and beaten egg
6. Add 4 cups flour adding one at a time beating after each addition
7. Dough should be soft yet firm enough to handle
8. Knead on floured board until elastic and smooth
9. Avoid too much flour
10. Turn dough into well oiled bowl
11. Let rise for 1-1 / 2 hours
12. Press dough down and divide into workable size
13. Roll dough out into a rectangle
14. Cover with melted butter
15. Layer with a generous thick layer of brown sugar
16. Sprinkle on cinnamon as desired
17. If you like raisins , layer on a layer of raisins
18. Roll up jellyroll fashion
19. Using a scissors or a piece of string , cut off slices about 1 to 1-1 / 2 inches thick
20. Place slices in an 8 or 9 inch round greased cake pan
21. Place one slice in the middle and other slices around it
22. Press rolls down to even out and fill pan
23. Let rise until rolls fill the pan generously -- about another hour
24. Bake in a 350f
25. Oven about 15 - 20 minutes
26. If rolls get too brown , cover with a piece of tine foil until the end of baking
27. Do not over bake rolls
28. Remove immediately from pan by inverting onto a plate and then
29. For the frosting:
30. In a medium bowl , place sugar , butter and vanilla
31. Then stir in enough milk or cream to reach a thick , hardly-able to stir consistency
32. Spread over warm rolls as soon as they are placed on a plate to let the frosting melt and run into the rolls
33. My
34. I ended up with about a 1 / 2 inch layer of brown sugar completely covered with cinnamon
35. I made a few changes to the recipe for personal preference: i used 3 / 4 silk almond milk and 1 / 4 sweetened condensed milk
36. I used 4 cups of bread flour and i kneaded the dough for about 45 mins by hand
37. I let the dough rise in the sunlight with plastic wrap tightly covering the bowl
38. This extra heat helped the dough rise much faster
39. Then i punched it down and prepared the rolls by using 1 / 2 stick of room temp butter and smeared it over the dough by hand
40. I pat down the brown sugar / cinnamon mix and then began to roll it tightly
41. I placed the cut up rolls into a baking dish and placed it in the sunlight for an hour to let rise
42. Baked in the oven for 20 mins at 350f and as soon as they came out , i brushed melted butter on top
43. I also used store bought pillsbury cream cheese icing and melted it in the microwave before putting it on top of the baked rolls
44. This recipe is well worth the time and effort required to make this dessert
45. You'll be glad you did
46. I am a seasoned baker and have been making cinnamon rolls for at least 25 years
47. Thought i had a great recipe for my bread machine but it always was a little on the light and dry side
48. I have been looking for a dense gooey recipe where the dough has some substance to it
49. Found it ! these were wonderful ! i made them in the bread machine and it took just 4 cups of flour
50. As a matter of fact i added an extra 1 / 4 cup scalded milk as it seemed a little stiff to me once it started mixing
51. Rolled them out and cut into 8 large rolls
52. Let rise again
53. Baked in a 9x13 for 26 minutes @ 350f
54. Frosted lightly immediately and then a little heavier when they cooled off with cream cheese frosting
55. They were gone before dinner ! dangerously good warm or cold
56. With one batch i added apples , raisins , and nuts -- the other batch i did plain with just the brown sugar
57. I also did a cream cheese frosting for both batches instead of the plain sugar frosting suggested
58. I think this has to be the easiest , tastiest recipe for cinnamon rolls i have ever had the pleasure of baking !

title: italian pizza soup
steps:
1. Heat olive oil in a large saucepan
2. Saute the onion and green pepper until softened
3. Stir in the garlic and cook for a minute
4. Add the oregano , basil , rice , tomatoes and broth , and bring to a boil
5. Turn down heat and place cover on saucepan
6. Simmer for 20 minutes or until rice is tender
7. Stir in the pepperoni , and sprinkle with the cheese
8. Continue cooking for another minute or two
9. Serve , and add an extra sprinkling of parmesan cheese , if desired

title: pregnant honey ginger chicken
steps:
1. Whisk together honey and soy sauce , stirring in the garlic and ginger until blended
2. Pour over thighs in a 9x13 pan , or if you prefer white meat , chicken breast tenders and marinate , one hour for lighter flavour , more for a stronger flavour
3. Pop into a preheated oven at 400f for 20 minutes , flipping over halfway and continuing for another 20 minutes
4. Cooking times are approximate , so make sure you use a thermometer !
5. Serve with brown rice , and california blend veggies

title: 1 gram fat chocolate banana freezer pops
steps:
1. In a small bowl combine 2 cups cold milk with the vanilla pudding mix
2. Blend until very smooth
3. In another small bowl combine the remaining 2 cups milk with the chocolate pudding mix
4. Spoon and divide half of the mashed banana into each bottom of the mold , then divide / layer all of the chocolate pudding mixture between the cups over the banana
5. Spoon / divide the remaining banana over the chocolate pudding
6. Divide the vanilla pudding mixture on top of the banana
7. Stir gently with a long knife to create a marbled effect
8. Freeze for about 20 minutes
9. Insert a stick in each , then return to the freezer to freeze completely

title: chinese black rice orange and avocado salad
steps:
1. In a bowl , combine the cooked rice , oranges , orange juice , pumpkin seeds , orange zest , salt , and chipotle
2. Gently mix in the avocado
3. Add more salt , if needed
4. Place a lettuce cup on each plate and spoon the salad into the lettuce cups
5. Garnish with orange wedges , if desired

title: mama s french butter cookies from virginia willis
steps:
1. In a bowl , sift together first four ingredients
2. Set aside
3. In large bowl , cream butter and shortening on medium speed until light and fluffy
4. Add confectioners sugar and beat on low speed until smooth
5. Add egg and vanilla extract and beat on low until well combined
6. On low speed , slowly add dry ingredients
7. Beat until well combined
8. Cover with plastic wrap
9. Refrigerate until very firm and cool , at least 2 hours
10. Preheat oven to 350
11. Take some of the dough and shape it into 1-inch balls
12. Place balls on ungreased cookie sheet and press with the tines of a fork to flatten
13. Bake until golden , but not brown , 10 to 12 minutes
14. Cool slightly on the baking sheet on a rack
15. Then using a spatula , transfer the cookies to a rack to cool completely

title: caramelized corn with onions and red bell peppers
steps:
1. Heat large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
2. Add corn
3. Stir until beginning to dry and brown , about 8 minutes
4. Transfer to small bowl
5. Add oil to skillet
6. Heat over medium-high heat
7. Add bell peppers , onion , and garlic
8. Saut until peppers are tender , about 8 minutes
9. Mix in cilantro and chili powder , then corn
10. Stir until heated through , about 2 minutes
11. Season with salt and pepper

title: bold and tasty caesar salad dressing
steps:
1. Boil egg for 1 minute exactly
2. Remove from water with a slotted spoon and cool until you can handle it
3. Crack directly into food processor , blender , or tall jar
4. Add garlic , anchovy paste , worcestershire sauce , lemon juice , salt and pepper
5. Pulse to combine
6. With blender or food processor running , begin adding the olive oil a few drops at a time
7. It should take about 3 minutes to add all of the olive oil
8. Begin adding the vegetable oil in a thin stream
9. When all oil is incorporated , continue blending until dressing is at the thickness you prefer
10. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour to blend flavors
11. Serve over romaine lettuce with shredded parmesan on top

title: cream cheese sandwich  variation no 4
steps: 1. Spread the bread with the cream cheese and top with the cucumber and salad cress , if using

title: tortellini salad with asparagus and fresh basil vinaigrette
steps:
1. Whisk the olive oil , basil , lemon juice , shallot , garlic , 1 / 2 teaspoon salt , and 1 / 2 teaspoon pepper together in a bowl large enough to hold the salad
2. Cook the asparagus in 4 quarts boiling water seasoned with 1 tablespoon salt until tender , about 3 minutes
3. Transfer the asparagus to a colander using a slotted spoon
4. Shake out any excess water and toss with the vinaigrette
5. Return the water to a boil , add the tortellini , and cook until tender , following the package directions
6. Drain the tortellini thoroughly , then toss while hot with the asparagus and dressing
7. Refrigerate until chilled , about 30 minutes
8. Toast the pine nuts in a small skillet over medium heat until golden and fragrant , about 5 minutes
9. Just before serving , stir the toasted pine nuts , tomatoes , and parmesan into the salad and season with salt and pepper

title: chef boy i be illinois  easy cauliflower gratin
steps:
1. Microwave cauliflower according to your brand's directions and until desired tenderness
2. We like ours without any crunch
3. Bring 1 1 / 4 cups milk and salt to a boil in a large sauce pan over medium-high heat
4. Reduce heat
5. Meanwhile , whisk flour and the remaining 1 / 4 cup milk in another small bowl until smooth
6. Stir the mixture into the pan and cook , stirring , until thickened , about 1 minute
7. Stir in the cheese , chives , mustard and pepper
8. Stir microwaved cauliflower into cheese sauce and serve
9. Optional: sprinkle with breadcrumb mixture
10. Broil until the top is crispy and beginning to brown , 1 to 2 minutes

title: if you like pina coladas  protein smoothie
steps:
1. Pour water into blender
2. Add protein powder and oat flour
3. Blend on medium for 15 seconds
4. Add pineapple and coconut extract
5. Blend for 30 seconds
6. Add ice and blend on high for 30 seconds
7. Pour into tall glass and serve

title: cherry cream cheese dessert
steps:
1. In a large bowl , beat cream cheese until fluffy
2. Beat in sweetened condensed milk , lemon juice , and vanilla
3. Lightly swirl pie filling into cream cheese mixture
4. Spoon into serving dishes
5. Cover and chill
6. Garnish with almonds
7. Prep time includes refrigeration time

title: mexican chicken stew
steps:
1. Bring the chicken stock to a boil in a deep skillet
2. Sprinkle the chicken breasts with salt and pepper and add to the broth
3. Cover and cook 8 to 10 minutes , or until cooked through
4. Then lift out the chicken , reserving the stock , wrap in a damp towel and set aside to cool
5. Heat 2 tablespoons oil in a stockpot over medium heat
6. Saute the half of the onions with 1 teaspoon salt and 1 / 2 teaspoon pepper until soft
7. Add the garlic and cook 2 or 3 minutes , until the aroma is released
8. Add the tomatoes and salsa and bring to a boil
9. Add the reserved chicken stock and simmer 10 minutes
10. When the chicken is cool enough to handle , shred it into long strips
11. To finish , add the shredded chicken to the salsa pot and bring to a boil
12. Taste for salt and pepper and stir in the cilantro and tortilla strips or chips
13. 6-7 per bowl
14. Ladle into 4 bowls , sprinkle with the grated cheese and the remaining onion and top with a dollop of sour cream
15. Serve hot

title: beacon drive in pimento cheese
steps:
1. Grind up the cheese and pimentos in a food processor until almost smooth , but with some small pieces of pimento visible
2. Scrape into a bowl and stir in the mayonnaise

title: burger queen s zesty dippin  sauce
steps:
1. Mix everything together
2. Chill
3. Serve

title: caramelized onion   sun dried tomato pizza
steps:
1. In medium bowl , cover dried tomatoes with boiling water and soak until soft , about 45 minutes
2. Remove from bowl , squeeze out excess liquid
3. If desired , reserve liquid for another use
4. Now , heat 2 tablespoons oil in large skillet over medium-high heat
5. Add onions and reduce heat to medium-low
6. Saut until slightly softened , a bout 5 minutes
7. Sprinkle salt and pepper
8. Continue to saut until a rich golden brown color , about 20 minutes
9. Add whole garlic cloves during last 10 minutes so they caramelize , keeping separate from onions when stirring
10. Heat oven as needed to bake pizza for crust
11. Place tomatoes , caramelized garlic , 1 tablespoon oil and some salt & pepper in a processor
12. Pulse just until mixture is pureed but has texture
13. Spread cooled onions on crust and press down with hand
14. Spread tomato mixture on top
15. Press lightly and sprinkle with oregano
16. Spread mozzarella all around , then parmesan and some extra pepper
17. Bake 10-15 minutes or until the crust is golden and topping is hot
18. Remove from oven and place on cutting board
19. Let rest 5 minutes before slicing

title: pms chicken pot pie
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees
2. If you use a rotisserie chicken , cut chicken from the carcass and chop to bite sized pieces
3. If there is cooking juice at the bottom of the chicken container , set this aside for later
4. Place tater tots on bottom of a deep dish pie pan , enough to roughly cover the bottom
5. Bake the tater tots until crispy and well done
6. While tater tots are cooking , start a small pot of water to boil , and chop carrots , celery , onion and garlic
7. When water starts to boil , drop in carrots to blanch or half cook , then drain and set aside
8. Zap frozen peas in microwave to thaw , set aside
9. Take the pan with tater tots out of the oven when well done , and mash them down until they completely cover the bottom of the pie pan
10. Set aside
11. Combine broth , milk and rotisserie chicken juices in a pouring container and zap in the microwave to take off the chill
12. Set butter inside a medium sized saucepan to melt
13. Add garlic and onions and saute until soft
14. Add flour to this mixture and cook for about 3 minutes on medium high heat
15. Gradually add milk / broth mixture , making a thickened sauce
16. Season sauce with salt and pepper
17. Combine chicken , carrots , peas and celery in a bowl and then fill pie pan with this mixture
18. Carefully pour over this with milk / broth sauce
19. Remove pre-made pie crust from wrapper and lay over pie pan
20. Pinch to close , and pierce the top three times on top to release steam while baking
21. Bake in oven until top crust is golden

title: roasted garlic and balsamic marinade
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a non-aluminum mixing bowl
2. Pour into a zip-lock bag
3. Add meat
4. When ready to cook , discard marinade

title: lemon garlic chicken thighs
steps:
1. Soak the chicken pieces in salted water for 20 minutes , then pat the pieces dry and lay them in a baking dish
2. They should be a bit crowded , touching each other
3. Mix up the rest of the ingredients and pour over the chicken , then let stand for 20 minutes
4. Bake at 400 degrees for 45 minutes or until until done

title: shortbread almond cookie crust
steps:
1. Place crumbs and almonds into bowl and mix with melted butter
2. Stir until mixed well
3. Press into bottom and side of an 8 inch springform pan
4. Refrigerate 15 minutes before filling

title: crock pot coconut spice country pork ribs
steps:
1. Combine everything except the corn starch , water& ribs
2. Mix well
3. Place the ribs into your crock pot and pour in the liquid , cover and turn to low
4. Cook on low 7-8 hours
5. 1 hour before serving mix the cornstarch and water , add to the crock pot
6. Stir well and allow to thicken
7. You may have to turn the pot to high for a short period to get the sauce to thicken
8. Serve with rice or noodles

title: ethiopian tomato salad
steps:
1. Combine jalapeno pepper , onions , lemon juice , and black pepper in a bowl
2. Stir in the tomatoes
3. Add a little salt to taste
4. Chill and serve cold

title: pat s chicken mole
steps:
1. Mash up the mole paste in the chicken broth until it is mostly dissolved
2. Place all ingredients in a large crock pot and set on high setting for 1 hour , then reduce to the low setting for six more hours
3. Serve chicken and sauce over cooked rice or cooked egg noodles

title: quick and easy beef pizza
steps:
