1. Place olive oil in a large nonstick skillet and heat
2. Put in the green pepper and onion and cook until tender , about 8 minutes
3. Set aside
4. Place pizza crust on a lightly greased baking sheet
5. Top with the beef , onion and green pepper mixture , and cherry tomatoes
6. Sprinkle with swiss cheese , parmesan cheese and italian seasoning
7. Bake in a 400f
8. Oven about 8 minutes or until cheese melts and pizza is heated through

title: lorraine wallace soup
steps:
1. Place a large , heavy soup pot or dutch oven over medium-high heat and add the oil
2. Add the sausage , onion , and celery , and cook , stirring frequently , until the onion is softened and slightly golden and the sausage no longer pink , about 15 minutes
3. Add the black-eyed peas , broth , tomatoes , chiles , and chili powder
4. Stir to blend and add the salt and pepper to taste
5. Bring to a boil , then reduce the heat to low , cover , and simmer for about 45 minutes
6. Taste for seasoning
7. Ladle into warm bowls and serve

title: baklava syrup
steps:
1. In medium saucepan , combine sugar , water , cloves , and cinnamon
2. Simmer 2 minutes
3. Add honey , lemon and orange
4. Simmer 5 minutes
5. Stir in vanilla and remove from heat
6. Discard cinnamon , cloves and oranges
7. Spoon over warm baklava and cool completely before serving
8. Cover an store up to 5 days

title: ski slope soup
steps:
1. Brown sausage and drain well
2. Combine all ingredients in a 4 quart saucepan or dutch oven
3. Cover and simmer for 1 hour
4. Add potatoes and cook another 20 minutes
5. Remove and discard bay leaves
6. Beat soup with an electric mixer until all ingredients are well shredded , about 3 minutes
7. Serve

title: tempura fondue batter
steps:
1. Sift together the dry ingredients
2. Beat egg slightly and mix with the water
3. Add the dry ingredients
4. Stir only until mixed
5. Mixture will be slightly lumpy
6. Dip shrimp , chunky-cut chicken and vegetables , etc
7. Into the batter and deep fry until golden brown
8. Drain on paper towels

title: grilled chipotle shrimp cocktail
steps:
1. If using wooden skewers , soak in cold water while shrimp marinates
2. To marinate the shrimp: put the cilanto , garlic and chipotle with sauce in to a glass or plastic bowl
3. Stir in the olive oil and lime juice
4. Season with salt and pepper
5. Add the shrimp and toss to coat with marinade
6. Place in the refrigerator for 30 minutes
7. For the sauce: whisk together in a glass bowl the ketchup , orange juice , lime juice , worcestershire sauce and chipotles with sauce
8. Add salt and pepper to taste
9. Set aside
10. To cook shrimp: remove shrimp from marinade
11. Discard marinade
12. The original recipe called for threading one shrimp on each skewer
13. This makes a nice presentation but takes a little longer to prepare !
14. I thread several shrimp , about 4 or 5 depending on the size of the shrimp , on each skewer
15. Place on an oiled grill that has been preheated to medium high
16. Cook for about 2 minutes per side
17. They will turn pink when done
18. Do not overcook !
19. I have also done these on my george foreman grill without using the skewers
20. Just throw the shrimp on and cook a couple of minutes
21. Place bowl of sauce in the center of a round platter and arrange shrimp around the sauce
22. Sprinkle with additional chopped cilantro if desired
23. Enjoy !

title: grizzlenuckles
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients except icing sugar
2. Mix well
3. Pat into a greased 13x9-inch pan
4. Bake at 350f for 20-25 minutes
5. Do not overbake
6. Sprinkle with icing sugar
7. Cool and cut into squares

title: strawberry cider
steps:
1. Combine ingredients and simmer for 10 to 15 minutes
2. Strain through sieve

title: artichokes a la polita
steps:
1. Slice the stem of the artichokes and remove the outer leaves
2. Carefully remove core including fuzzy / prickly stuff of artichoke rub each artichoke with a lemon and put all of them in bowl full of water
3. You will be left with just the 'heart'
4. Cut the potatoes and the spring onions in medium sized slices
5. Slice the carrots and saute them together briefly with the spring onions in a saucepan with the oil
6. Add the artichokes and the potatoes , the dill , the lemon juice , salt , pepper and enough water to cover them
7. Allow to cook , stirring occasionally , for 1 / 2 hour or until tender
8. Remove from pan with slotted to spoon to serving platter
9. Discarding dill
10. Sprinkle with fresh dill , salt & pepper

title: smoky bacon and chipotle sweet potatoes
steps:
1. Cover potatoes in a saucepan and cover with water
2. Bring to a boil
3. Cook until tender and then drain
4. Mash potatoes , add butter , sour cream , sugar , cheese , chipotle pepper and bacon
5. Mix well
6. Adjust seasoning with salt and black pepper
7. Top with toasted pecans just before serving

title: pielogen
steps:
1. For the chocolate caramel yule log:
2. Preheat the oven to 325
3. Line one jelly roll pans with parchment paper cut exactly to fit the bottom of the pan , spraying the sides and bottom with nonstick spray before lining
4. In a medium bowl , whisk the warm water with the cocoa powder until smooth
5. In a kitchenaid mixer fitted with the paddle attachment , beat the sugar , oil , vanilla and eggs on medium speed until combined
6. Turn the machine to lowest speed and add the flour , baking soda and salt
7. Stir until just incorporated , but do not over mix ! stream in the cocoa power and water mixture and scrape the sides and bottom of the bowl
8. Stir in the buttermilk , the batter will be very liquid
9. Spread the batter into an even layer making sure to get into the corners of the pan
10. Bake at 325 for 12 to 18 minutes until the cake is springy to the touch and baked through
11. Let cool while you make the buttercream
12. For the salted caramel buttercream:
13. Make the caramel sauce:
14. Place the sugar in a heavy bottomed sauce pan
15. Add enough water to make a wet sand consistency , about 1 / 4 to 1 / 2 cup
16. Cook the sugar until it is dark amber and almost smoking , turn off the heat
17. Carefully add the cream , it will bubble and spatter , stand back ! once the caramel has calmed down , add the salt and whisk smooth
18. Transfer to a heatproof bowl to cool
19. Make the buttercream:
20. Find a pot that will fit the bottom of the bowl of a kitchenaid , fill it with three inches of water and bring to a simmer
21. Place the egg whites and the sugar in the mixer bowl and place over the simmering pot of water
22. Stir the mixture until the sugar has dissolved and the mixture is warm , about 4 minutes
23. Place the bowl on the mixer fitted with the whisk attachment and beat on medium high until cool
24. Cut the butter into 1 inch cubes and gradually add to the mixer
25. Mix until the butter has incorporated and the frosting is light and fluffy
26. Add the room temperature caramel sauce and whisk until combined
27. Divide the frosting in half
28. Place one half in the fridge in a storage container or tightly wrapped in a bowl
29. Spread the other half in an even layer on top of the cooled cake using an offset spatula
30. Using a sharp knife , cut the frosted cake into three even strips going the long way across the pan
31. Make sure you cut through the parchment as well
32. If you are worried about scratching your sheet pan , transfer the cake to a cutting board before slicing
33. Starting with the short end of one of the strips , start rolling the cake on itself to make a pinwheel , peeling the parchment as you go
34. When you reach the end of the first strip , gently pick put the roll and place a few inches away from the short edge of the next strip
35. Continue rolling the second strip around the first wheel
36. Repeat with the 3rd strip until you have a giant chocolate caramel pinwheel
37. Place the wheel in the freezer for 4 hours , or overnight or for up to a week
38. For the eggnog cheesecake:
39. Preheat oven to 325 degrees
40. Cut a round of parchment to fit the bottom of an 8 inch spring form pan , if you do not have a spring form pan , you can use an 8 inch cake pan
41. Lightly spray the pan with nonstick spray and place the round of parchment in the bottom
42. Wrap the exterior bottom and sides of the pan with aluminum foil
43. In a kitchenaid mixer fitted with a paddle attachment , beat the cream cheese , crme fraiche and sugar until smooth
44. Add the eggs one at a time on medium low speed , scraping the bowl after each addition
45. Stir in the vanilla , whisky , nutmeg and salt
46. You want the batter to be smooth but not overbeaten
47. Scrape the batter into the prepared pan
48. Place the pan in a larger baking dish and pour in hot water until it comes half way up the sides of the cheesecake pan
49. Bake for 30 to 45 minutes until the center is still slightly giggly
50. Do not overbake or the cheesecake will be grainy
51. Let cool , refrigerate until ready to assemble
52. For the toffee pecan pie:
53. Line a 9 inch pie plate with the crust and chill until the filling is ready
54. Preheat oven to 400
55. In a small heavy bottom sauce pan , cook the butter until it foams and starts to brown , remove from the heat
56. In a medium bowl , whisk together the sugar , flour and eggs until smooth
57. Add the corn syrup and then slowly stream the butter while whisking , if you do this too fast it will curdle the eggs
58. Whisk in the vanilla extract and salt
59. Evenly spread the pecans and heath bar pieces in the bottom of the prepared pie shell
60. Pour the filling over , the pecans will rise to the top
61. Bake at 400 degrees for 20 minutes
62. Drop the temperature to 325 and bake for another 20 to 30 minutes until the pie is browned and the center is only slightly giggly
63. Remove from the oven and let cool
64. Assembly:
65. Remove the reserved frosting from the fridge
66. Transfer to the bowl of a kitchenaid mixer fitted with the whisk attachment
67. Whisk the frosting on medium high speed
68. The frosting will look broken for a bit , but will come together once it whisks for a while and comes to room temperature
69. Once the frosting is smooth , add the cocoa powder and beat until fluffy
70. Using a sharp knife , cut the side crusts off the toffee pecan pie
71. Remove the chocolate caramel roll from the freezer
72. Using a sharp knife run under hot water , trim off one end of the roll , exposing a beautiful cross section of the swirl
73. On an 8 inch cake board or serving plate place a small dollop of frosting to secure the pie
74. Place the trimmed , chilled pie on top of the frosting dollop
75. Spread a thin layer of frosting on top of the pie
76. Place the cheesecake on top and coat with another thin layer of frosting
77. Place the roll on top with the cut side facing up , you may have to fill in the bottom side of the roll with extra frosting so there are not air gaps
78. Spread the remaining frosting around the sides of the cake
79. Using a cake comb or the edge of a serrated knife , texturize the sides of the log to give a bark effect
80. Press the chopped heath bar around the bottom edge of the cake to mask any imperfections at the base of the log
81. Refrigerate until ready to serve

title: yummy chili con carne
steps:
1. Brown 2 clove garlic
2. 1 chopped yellow onion
3. 1 lb ground beef or turkey
4. Stir & saute until well done
5. Add: 1 14 oz can stewed tomatoes
6. 1 32 oz
7. Kidney beans
8. 1 tsp salt
9. 1 bay leaf
10. 2 tbsp chili powder
11. 1 tablespoon cumin
12. 1 teaspoon cayenne
13. 1 teaspoon coriander
14. 1 teaspoon oregano
15. 1 / 2 tsp pepper
16. 1- 7 oz
17. Can chopped green chilis
18. 1 tsp worcestershire sauce
19. Cover & simmer for 1 hour

title: maz s taco casserole
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375 deg
2. Spray 12 x 8 casserole with pam
3. Brown beef and onions , then add the garlic , tomatoes , olives , chilies , beans , corn , salsa and taco flavoring
4. Let simmer for 5 min
5. Crush about 1 cup or so of tortilla chips and sprinkle over bottom of baking dish
6. Add half of meat mixture
7. Sprinkle half of cheese over all
8. Repeat process
9. Bake for 20-25 min

title: greek chicken with lemon   garlic
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Arrange the chicken pieces in a roasting pan
3. In a large skillet over medium heat , fry the potatoes in batches in the canola oil until golden brown , add them to the pan with the chicken
4. In a bowl combine the olive oil , vinegar , lemon juice , garlic , oregano , parsley , onion , coarse sea salt & pepper to taste
5. Stir until well mixed pour this mixture over the chicken and the potatoes
6. Bake in the preheated oven for 40 to 45 minutes , basting the chicken and potatoes with the sauce mixture
7. Let stand for 5 minutes and serve hot

title: baked haddock or cod
steps:
1. In an ungreased 11-in
2. X 7-in
3. X 2-in
4. Baking dish , combine the melted butter , lemon juice , green onion , water , dill and garlic salt
5. Add fish and turn to coat
6. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour
7. Cover and bake at 350 degrees fahrenheit for 25 to 30 minutes or until fish flakes easily with a fork
8. Sprinkle with lemon-pepper

title: slow cooker vegetable fettuccine alfredo
steps:
1. Rub the walls of the slow cooker with the butter
2. Place zucchini , carrots , broccoli , mushroons , green onions , garlic , seasonings and parmesan cheese into the slow cooker
3. Cover and cook on high for 2 hours
4. Just prior to serving time , cook the fettucine to "al dente"
5. Drain
6. Add cooked fettucine , mozerella , cream and eggs yolks to the slow cooker
7. Stir gently to blend all ingredients
8. Replace cover on the slow cooker and continue to heat for 10 to 15 minutes
9. Serve

title: raw oyster shooters
steps:
1. Combine juice through horseradish , mixing thoroughly
2. Pour 1 jigger of mixture into each of 6 small glasses
3. Add 2 jiggers vodka to each
4. Put 1 raw oyster in each glass and garnish with a lemon wedge

title: ravioli or tortellini with pesto and spinach
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to package directions
2. Spray a skillet with cooking spray and saute minced garlic until fragrant
3. Add chopped fresh spinach
4. If using frozen defrost and add to pan
5. Cook until wilted
6. Add pesto and broth to pan and cook until heated through
7. Plate pasta and top with sauce
8. Top with fresh grated parmesan
9. Add red pepper flakes if desired

title: italian wedding cookies ii
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. In a large bowl break up the almond paste
3. Add the softened butter , sugar , eggs and almond extract
4. Beat batter until light and fluffy
5. Beat in the flour and the salt
6. Split the batter into thirds and add enough of the three different food colorings to each third to color the batter nicely
7. Spread the batters into three 9 x 13 and 1 / 4-inch deep aluminum baking pans
8. Be sure the batter is only about 1 / 8-inch thick or it will rise to high
9. Bake at 350f for 12 minutes
10. Cool
11. Remove baked and cooled cakes from pans and place on a cookie sheet or cutting board
12. Heat the jam and spread between the layers as you stack them
13. Spread the melted chocolate over the top layer and refrigerate
14. When stiff remove cookies from the refrigerator and let chocolate soften slightly before cutting into small rectangles

title: chianti braised short ribs  olive garden
steps:
1. Pat the short ribs dry and season with salt and pepper
2. Coat a large , nonstick pan with olive oil
3. Saut the short rib pieces over medium-high heat for about two to three minutes on each side or until brown
4. When finished , transfer the short ribs to a bowl
5. Next , add the onions to the pan and cook over medium heat for approximately three minutes
6. Once the onions are translucent , add the garlic and cook for one minute
7. Add the chianti , rosemary , beef broth and tomatoes to the pan one at a time , allowing the liquid to evaporate partially before each addition
8. Return the short ribs to the pan , including any juices that might have accumulated in the bowl
9. Cover and let simmer for three hours on low heat to complete the braising process
10. Remove the short ribs from the pan and boil the liquid until its reduced by half , about 10 minutes
11. Return the short ribs to the pan and heat thoroughly

title: mrs  kocevar s black joe cake
steps:
1. Boil water
2. Remove from heat and add butter and chocolate
3. Stir
4. In a separate bowl , stir together flour , sugar , salt , and baking soda
5. Add eggs
6. Stir
7. Stir in chocolate mixture , mixing well
8. Add sour milk
9. Mix well
10. Pour into 2 greased and floured 8" round cake pans
11. Bake at 350 degrees f for 30-35 minutes

title: german pfeffernusse cookies   gluten free
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 190c line baking trays with greaseproof or baking paper
2. Mix all ingredients in an electric mixer on a medium speed , until roughly mixed
3. Do not overbeat
4. Using a spatula then , scrape down the sides of the bowl and mix until well combined
5. Leaving the mixture in the bowl , knead with your hands until all of the ingredients are well mixed
6. Roll mixture into balls , about the size of walnuts
7. Place on baking sheets about 1 / 2 inch / 1 cm apart
8. Bake for about 10 minutes at 190c
9. Allow the biscuits to cool completely on the trays
10. Store in an airtight container

title: health nut s demise cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375^
2. In a medium bowl beat smart balance , tahini , and sunflower butter and sugar
3. Add the egg and vanilla and beat again
4. Add flours , oatmeal , baking soda , and salt and stir to combine
5. Add the chocolate chips and stir again
6. Drop by even tablespoons onto an ungreased cookie sheet
7. Bake 9 minutes or until golden and puffy
8. Betcha can't eat just one !

title: lemony drunk chicken marinade
steps:
1. Combine butter , lemon juice , beer , garlic salt , and lemon pepper and whisk
2. Pour over the chicken and marinate for 4-6 hours in refrigerator
3. Turning occasionally
4. Grill the chicken and brush with some marinade as you go along , but don't brush when nearly done since the marinade isn't "safe" unless thoroughly cooked
5. Discard left over marinade
6. Chicken is cooked when juices run clear
7. Enjoy !

title: refreshing citrus salad
steps:
1. Combine vinaigrette ingredients together with a whisk and chill
2. Mix together greens with mushrooms and place on salad plates
3. Top with sections of grapefruit
4. Just prior to serving , shake all vinaigrette to mix , or stir briskly and drizzle over greens
5. Serve

title: cheesy hamburger skillet  or helper  goulash  cowboy stuff
steps:
1. Cook the elbow macaroni according to package directions
2. Meanwhile , in a large skillet , cook the ground beef and onions
3. Drain the meat mixture
4. Add tomato products and beans , undrained
5. Add water if needed and chili powder and simmer for 15 minutes
6. Add the cooked macaroni and reheat to a simmer
7. Taste and adjust salt and pepper
8. Stir in 1 cup of cheese and melt
9. Add remainder of cheese to top and remove from heat

title: roasted brussels sprouts and garlic
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. In a small bowl , combine olive oil , balsamic vinegar , sugar , salt and pepper and mix well
3. Set aside
4. Place brussels sprouts , chopped garlic , and fresh thyme leaves in a shallow baking dish
5. Evenly pour the reserved oil / vinegar mixture over top
6. Toss a little to evenly coat
7. Bake for 30 - 40 minutes or just until tender and the edges begin to brown

title: amiira s crack brownies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. In heavy saucepan , combine caramels and 1 / 3 cup evaporated milk
3. Cook over low heat , stirring constantly , until caramels are melted
4. Grease and flour a 9x13-inch baking dish
5. In a large mining bowl , combine dry cake mix , melted butter , and the other 1 / 3 cup evaporated milk
6. Stir by hand until the dough holds together
7. Divide dough in half and press first half of dough into prepared baking dish
8. Bake at 350f for 8 to 9 minutes
9. Remove from oven and sprinkle chocolate chips over baked crust
10. Pour caramel mixture over the chocolate chips
11. Crumble the other half of the dough over caramel layer
12. Return to oven and bake for 20 minutes
13. Remove and cool for 15 minutes , then cut into squares
14. Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes before serving
15. Return to refrigerator when no eating , as they get goopy at room temperature

title: honey oat bran bread
steps: 1. Add the ingredients to your bread machine in the order recommended by the manufacturer , which is usually in the order given , being careful that the yeast doesn't come in contact with the salt

title: crock pot chicken and stuffing  5 ww points
steps:
1. Place chicken on bottom of crockpot
2. Pour broth over the chicken

4. Cook on low for 7 hours

title: bailey s irish cream   coffee chip ice cream
steps:
1. Whisk eggs for 2 minutes until light
2. Using a hand mixer , add the sugar a little at a time blending on a low-setting until combined in between each addition
3. Blend in the cream , irish cream , milk , and instant coffee until combined
4. Place the mixture in an ice cream machine and freeze until your cream begins to stiffen
5. Add the chocolate pieces and freeze until the ice cream is stiff and ready
6. Do not remove too early or the ice cream will become icy when it finishes freezing in the freezer
7. But the ice cream should be pliable
8. Tightly pack in a tubberware container and freeze
9. Makes about 8 half cup servings

title: pumpkin tiramisu
steps:
1. Line a 9x5x3-inch loaf pan with plastic wrap
2. Set aside
3. For syrup , in a small bowl , combine maple syrup and bourbon
4. Set aside
5. For filling , in a small bowl , combine pumpkin , cinnamon , ginger , and salt
6. In a small mixing bowl , combine 1 / 2 cup whipping cream and granulated sugar
7. Beat with an electric mixer on medium speed until soft peaks form
8. Gently fold whipped cream into pumpkin mixture
9. For topping , in another small mixing bowl , combine mascarpone cheese and powdered sugar
10. Beat on low speed until combined
11. Gradually beat in 1 / 2 cup whipping cream just until thickened
12. To assemble , arrange half of the ladyfingers in a single layer in the bottom of the prepared pan
13. Drizzle evenly with half of the syrup
14. Top with half of the filling , spreading evenly
15. Arrange remaining ladyfingers in a single layer over filling
16. Drizzle with remaining syrup and top with remaining filling
17. Dollop topping over filling
18. Using the back of a spoon , carefully spread topping evenly over filling
19. Cover and chill for 8 to 24 hours
20. Use the plastic wrap to lift tiramisu out of pan
21. Place tiramisu on a serving platter
22. Sprinkle with nutmeg
23. Carefully cut the dessert crosswise into slices
24. Makes 6 servings

title: jazzy pineapple pecan butter
steps:
1. Whip butter until creamy
2. Add whipping cream and whip until fluffy and light colored
3. Add brown sugar and cinnamon
4. Beat on low speed until incorporated
5. Fold in raisins , pineapple , and pecans
6. For sweet potatoes: use a melon baller or small portioning scoop to form small balls
7. Place on wax paper lined baking sheet and freeze
8. After freezing the balls can be stored in a zip top bag
9. Place ball in sweet potato at time of serving
10. For breads: spoon butter into a sealable container
11. Store in fridge

title: road trip snack mix
steps:
1. In a very large bowl , combine the pretzels , ritz bits , cashews , and crackers
2. Sprinkle evenly with dressing mix , then drizzle with oil
3. Stir gently but thoroughly until all pieces are well coated
4. Store in an airtight container

title: ghirardelli s award winning double chocolate brownies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Using a spoon , stir eggs with sugar and vanilla
3. Add butter
4. Sift ghirardelli ground chocolate with flour , baking powder and salt
5. Stir into egg mixture
6. Add nuts
7. Spread into greased 8 inch square pan
8. Bake 20 minutes

title: real italian calzones
steps:
1. In a small bowl dissolve yeast in the warm water
2. Add 1 tablespoons of the oil , sugar and salt , and mix in 1 cup of the flour until smooth
3. Gradually stir in the rest of the flour until the dough is smooth and workable
4. Knead dough on a lightly floured surface for about 5 minutes or until it is elastic
5. Lay dough in a bowl containing the other teaspoon of olive oil , flipping to coat dough in the oil
6. Cover and let rise from 40 minutes or until almost doubled
7. While dough is rising combine all remaining ingredients except for the egg in a large bowl , cover and refrigerate to chill
8. Preheat the oven to 375f
9. When the dough is ready , punch it down and separate it into two equal parts
10. Roll the halves individually out into thin circles on a lightly floured surface
11. Fill one half of each circle with half of the filling mixture and fold over
12. Seal the edges by pressing with a fork
13. Brush the top of each calzone with the egg wash and place on a greased cookie sheet
14. Bake at 375f for 30 minutes or until golden brown and heated through
15. Serve with warmed tomato sauce if desired !

title: lemon pickle  moroccan style
steps:
1. Wash lemons very well
2. Put in a bowl and pour over boiling water
3. Leave for 30 seconds or so
4. Remove , cool , and cut into quarters , lengthwise
5. Put a 1 / 4 - 1 / 2 inch layer of coarse salt in the bottom of your jar
6. Pack in the lemon quarters
7. To each jar add the cinnamon sticks , coriander seeds and cloves , decoratively , and add a red chilli pepper to each bottle
8. Layer with another 1 / 4 inch of coarse salt
9. Fill the jar with oil -- you could use sunflower or any oil which has a neutral flavour
10. Close jars tightly , and leave to stand in a cool place -- but not in the fridge -- for about 3 weeks
11. Rinse off the salt before using
12. Uses:
13. Chop finely to use in chicken dishes , especially if there are olives in the dish
14. Stuff a chicken with pickled lemon quarters before roasting
15. Put a roast for the oven on a layer of lemons
16. Slice and chop very finely , add fresh chopped coriander leaves , parsley or fresh basil and add some virgin olive oil , as a sauce for fish fillets

title: parsley rice
steps:
1. Rinse rice under the faucet to remove excess starch
2. Bring rice and water to a rapid boil in a 2 quart saucepan
3. Cover rice and reduce heat to low
4. Cook on low 20 minutes
5. Cut butter into 4 pieces
6. When rice had doubled in volume , add the butter and replace lid
7. Once butter has melted , sprinkle parsley even over ther the rice
8. Stir to fully mix rice , butter and parsley
9. Serve with any meat dish
10. Pairs up exceptionally with chicken breasts

title: sesame ginger brussels sprouts
steps:
1. Trim stems and any yellow leaves from brussels sprouts
2. Cut each sprout lengthwise into quarters
3. In a cup , stir together soy sauce , grated ginger and sesame oil
4. Meanwhile , in nonstick 12-inch skillet heat olive oil over medium heat until hot
5. Add onion and cook about 5 minutes or until it begins to soften , stirring occasionally
6. Increase heat to medium high , add brussels sprouts and water
7. Cover and cook about 5 minutes or until sprouts are beginning to soften and brown , stirring once
8. Remove cover from skillet and cook about 5 minutes longer or until sprouts are tender-crisp , stirring frequently
9. Remove skillet from heat
10. Stir in soy sauce mixture

title: grilled steak
steps:
1. Place all ingredients except for steak in storage bag and give a shake to mix marinade
2. Add steak and marinade 6-8 hours or even overnight
3. Remove steak from marinade
4. Bring steak to room temperature
5. Place marinade in a small saucepan add 2 tablespoons port and simmer 5-10 minutes
6. Grill steak on a medium high heat for 4-6 minutes each side
7. Let steak sit for 10 minutes before slicing and serve along with the hot sauce

title: west indian sweet potato soup
steps:
1. Saut celery , carrot and onion in a little vegetable oil until reasonably soft
2. Then add curry paste , chillies , garlic , sweet potatoes , bay leaves , thyme and parsley
3. Mix really well to coat with oil and add stock to cover
4. Bring to the boil and cook until vegies are tender
5. Remove bay leaves and blend , adding a little cream
6. Taste for seasoning

title: crystal light sunshine punch
steps:
1. Dissolve drink mix in cold water and orange juice
2. Add cold club soda and frozen cranberries , just before serving

title: tsubushi an   sweet bean paste for japanese sweets
steps:
1. Rinse azuki and soak in plenty of water for 7 to 8 hours
2. Discard the soaking water
3. Place the beans in a saucepan with water reaching 3 cm above the surface of the beans
4. Bring to a boil , then add about 300 ml water , and bring to a boil again
5. Drain beans of all water , return beans to saucepan , cover with plenty of water , just bring to a boil , then lower heat , and cook until tender , stirring occasionally
6. The beans with burn if the heat is too high , or they are not stirred a little
7. It should take between 1 and 2 hours for the beans to become tender
8. When the beans are tender enough to mash easily between your fingers , turn off the heat
9. Cover , and let stand 20 minutes
10. Add enough room temperature water to the beans in the saucepan to cool them
11. Wait until the beans have sunk to the bottom of the pan , then pour off the clearer liquid on top without disturbing the darker liquid below
12. Add more water , wait for the beans to sink , and remove the water on top again
13. After adding and pouring off the top part of the water three times , drain the beans by pouring the contents of the saucepan into a colander or sieve that has been lined with cloth
14. Return about one half of the cooked beans to the saucepan
15. Add the smaller amount of sugar , and cook , stirring constantly , over high heat , until the sugar has been incorporated
16. This burns easily , so lower the heat if necessary
17. Add the remaining cooked beans and continue to cook , while stirring and adding more sugar if necessary , until you have a shiny bean paste
18. This will thicken as it cools , so it is not necessary to cook the bean paste for a long time at this stage
19. You can mash some of the beans while you are cooking them with the sugar if necessary , but this type of bean paste should have some beans retaining their original shape
20. Add the salt at the very last stage of cooking and stirring
21. Taste to make sure the flavor is right
22. Remove from heat , spread out on a large plate to cool

title: bubble up pizza  from  the pampered chef
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. In a large bowl mix quartered biscuits , garlic , l cup of sauce & 2 cups of cheese
3. Add toppings and save some for the top layer
4. Spread mixture into a 9x13 pan
5. Pour remaining sauce & cheese on top followed by the toppings
6. Bake for 30 minutes or until golden brown

title: chocolate mice  aussie style
steps:
1. Melt the chocolate and the copha together
2. With a large knife , cut the licorice into 12 long slivers
3. Line a tray with baking paper and lay the "tails" 2 inches apart
4. Dip your marshmallows into the chocolate , position each one on a tail
5. Refrigerate for 15 minutes
6. Meanwhile , on another sheet of baking paper , arrange your almond flakes into 12 "sets" of ears
7. Or for nut free , cut and arrange triangles of the ice cream wafer
8. By now the chocolate will have thickened up a little , so give it a stir , but don't re-melt
9. Using about 1 / 4 teaspoon of the chocolate , glue the melts onto the "ears"
10. Make sure the little "drippy" bit of the melt is pointing down
11. Put in the fridge for about 10 minutes
12. You may have to warm your chocolate slightly , but don't have it too runny
13. Put a dab of chocolate onto the back of the mouse "face" and glue to the body
14. Using tweezers , dip your preferred "eyes" into the chocolate , and position
15. Wipe the tweezers between uses
16. With a toothpick , put a tiny dab of chocolate on the eye

title: al fresco bread
steps:
1. Begin preparations the day before
2. Heat oven to 350 deg f / 180 deg celsius
3. Carefully cut off the top of the bread , in the shape of a lid
4. Hollow out the bread until you have a crust left which is about 1" / 2 cm thick
5. Spread the lid and inside with the butter: use a barbecue brush for ease
6. Bake the bread , open , for about 10 minutes or until crisp but not too brown or brittle
7. Scorch the peppers under a grill or over a flame , steam in a bowl , and remove the thin skins
8. Cut into strips , removing seeds and ribs
9. Dry well between kitchen paper
10. Shave off enough parmesan to make about 3 / 4 cup
11. Remove the stones from the olives and chop roughly
12. If the feta is in brine , dry well
13. Slice
14. Don't worry if it breaks up
15. Keep in a bowl
16. Peel the onions , cut into fairly thick rings , and boil for a few minutes in water until they are limp
17. Drain
18. Dry on kitchen paper
19. Peel , crush and chop the garlic with a pinch of salt , chop the parsley until you have about a cupful , and chop the basil
20. Thinly peel the tomatoes , slice off the tops and press out the liquid firmly
21. Slice , and leave on kitchen paper to drain well
22. Boil the shrimps very briefly in a little salted water , just until the curl up and go pinkish
23. They must be juicy still
24. Also drain them well , and pat dry with kitchen paper
25. By now the bread has cooled: try and judge the capacity , and simply use as much of each ingredient as the bread will hold
26. It must eventually be full to overflowing !
27. Lay the pepper strips on the bottom , 1 - 2 layers
28. Layer with the parmesan shavings
29. Sprinkle with half the parsley
30. Top with the chopped olives
31. Add half the prepared garlic
32. Sprinkle or layer the feta over that
33. Layer the drained and dried onion rings over the cheese
34. Pack the shrimps neatly over the onions , and salt lightly
35. Sprinkle over the rest of the garlic
36. Press flat again
37. Layer this with the tomato slices and sprinkle about 1 / 3 teaspoon sugar and a pinch of salt over the tomatoes
38. Sprinkle over the rest of the parsley as well as the chopped basil
39. Whisk together the ingredients for the dressing until emulsified
40. Keep covered in fridge: you'll need to shake or whisk it again before use
41. Now you need a weight about the size of the filling , to weigh it down
42. I use an ordinary , washed brick , covered in a double thickness of foil
43. Put the filled bread on a suitable dish , and put the brick on top of the filling
44. If you have any other suitable weight , use that
45. Cover lightly with plastic and refrigerate overnight
46. To serve:
47. Remove brick and carefully put the filled bread on a platter
48. Whisk the dressing , and taste for seasoning ! adjust
49. The filling should now be firm and flattened
50. Top with the bread lid
51. Slice thickly , and serve each slice on its side
52. Drizzle a little of the dressing over each serving
53. Serve as a starter , with chilled white wine , or as a light meal

title: easy pudding tiramis
steps:
1. Prepare pudding according to box direction
2. Add cheese and coffee liqueur and beat until smooth
3. Cover with plastic wrap and chill 1 hour
4. Fold in whipped topping
5. In a small shallow dish , stir sugar into coffee and dip each ladyfinger in for only 4-5 seconds
6. Line bottom of 8 cup trifle bowl with 1 / 2 of the lady fingers , spread 1 / 2 of pudding mixture over cookies and sprinkle with 1 / 2 of the chocolate
7. Repeat layers
8. Cover tightly and chill for 4 hours or overnight

title: spinach and rice appetizers
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients
2. Shape into 1 inch balls
3. Grease a cookie sheet and place balls on cookie sheet
4. Preheat oven to 375
5. Bake at 375 for about 20 minutes or till golden brown

title: oven barbecued chicken breasts
steps:
1. Crumb topping : combine the 8th , 9th , 10th , 11th , and 12th ingredients to make the crumb topping
2. Barbecue sauce:
3. 1
4. Combine the ketchup , chili sauce , brown sugar , vinegar and garlic in a small saucepan
5. Bring to boil over the medium low heat
6. Cook uncovered , stirring frequently , until thickened , about 5 minutes
7. Remove from heat
8. Add a grinding of black pepper
9. 2
10. Heat the oven to 400 degrees f
11. Place a sheet of heavy-duty alumiunum foil on a baking sheet and crimp the edges up slightly so the juices won't drip over
12. 3
13. Coat the undersides of the chicken breasts lightly with the barbecue sauce
14. Place the breasts sauce side down , on the foil lined baking sheet
15. Coat the tops of the chicken breasts with the remaining barbecue sauce , dividing it evenly
16. 4
17. Meanwhile , heat the olive oil in a medium skillet add the garlic and saute over medium heat for 1 minute
18. Add the crumbs , thyme and a pinch of salt and a grinding of black pepper
19. Saute the crumbs , stirring frequently , until lightly toasted , about 5 minutes
20. Spoon the crumbs evenly on top of the chicken breasts
21. 5
22. Bake the chicken for 15 minutes
23. Let stand until slightly cooled
24. Cut each breast into 1 / 2 inch slices

title: bbq parmesan wings
steps:
1. Preheat bbq on medium high heat
2. Toss chicken wings in medium sized bowl with all ingredients
3. Cook wings turning frequently for 30 to 40 minutes until fully cooked and golden brown

title: nan s chili
steps:
1. Brown ground beef
2. Add tomato sauce , tomatoes and water
3. Stir in the onion , garlic and seasonings
4. Add beans and simmer 30- 45 minutes
5. Serve with saltine crackers to crush into the chili

title: warm potato salad by biltmore
steps:
1. Combine vinegar , brown sugar , water , salt in a 2 gallon suacepan and bring to a boil
2. Add the potatoes and cook for 25 minutes or just tender
3. In the meantime , slice bacon into small pieces
4. Brown in a skillet until crispy
5. Remove from skillet
6. Reserve the bacon drippings
7. Add the olive oil to the bacon drippings
8. Warm over medium heat and add onion and celery
9. Sautee until slightly wilted
10. Add the bacon back to the skillet
11. When potatoes are tender , drain off the liquid
12. Add the bacon mixture to the hot potatoes , toss and serve
13. The recipe suggests this serves 10 side portions
14. In my opinion , it serves less but then i loved it
15. I say 6-10 depending on the serving size

title: colombian empanadas
steps:
1. Prepare the vegetables:
2. Heat 3 tablespoons of olive oil in a large stock pot
3. Add 3 minced cloves of garlic , chopped tomato , chopped green onions , chopped onion , chopped red bell pepper , chopped cilantro leaves , teaspoon of ground cumin , 1 package sazn goya con azafran
4. Sautee over medium heat , stirring until onion is very soft
5. Season with salt and pepper to taste
6. When done remove all contents from pot and set aside in a separate bowl
7. Prepare steak and potatoes:
8. In the large stock pot add 1 whole head of garlic , 1 whole onion peeled and cut in half , 1 whole tomato cut in half , 3 beef bouillon cubes , flank steak and cover with water
9. Bring to a boil , lower heat and simmer the steak until very tender
10. Peel and quarter potatoes and add to the pot , adding more water if necessary to cover the potatoes
11. Simmer until potatoes are very tender
12. Remove pot from heat and let the meat and potatoes cool in the broth
13. Remove the meat from the broth and slice into 1 cubes , then put cut up steak into a food processor and pulse it until it looks like ground beef do not over process , you do not want to make baby food out of the steak
14. Remove potatoes from the broth and set aside in a separate bowl , strain the broth and reserve it
15. Add the potatoes , the meat and vegetables into the same bowl
16. Add a little of the beef broth to the mixture and mix well , mashing the potatoes in the process
17. Prepare the dough:
18. Place 3 cups yellow masarepa into a large bowl , add 2 teaspoons of sugar and salt and pepper to taste , incorporate the dry ingredients well before adding the liquid
19. Combine 1 cup of reserved broth , 2 cups of hot water and 1 tablespoon of softened butter
20. Slowly add the cornmeal to the water and stir with a big spoon
21. When all of the corn meal has been added , work the dough with your hands until it becomes soft
22. Let rest for 20 minutes
23. Making the empanadas:
24. To make the empanadas , put a small ball of dough in the center of a tortilla press covered with plastic and press to flatten it
25. You can also put the small ball of dough between two pieces of plastic and flatten it with a small saucepan
26. Add a tablespoon or so of the filling
27. Fold the circle of dough in half to form a half moon
28. Cut off the edge of the half moon with a cup or drinking glass
29. This will shape your empanada and seal it at the same time
30. Another way to make them is pressing the edge with your fingers and folding the extra dough inwards , this will prevent the filling from coming out during frying
31. You can fry them in a deep frier at 350f
32. You can also fry them on the stove at medium high temperature
33. Fry the empanadas for 5-7 minutes or until golden brown
34. Then put them on a paper towels to drain them
35. Once empanadas are cooked , keep them warm in a 200 degree oven until ready to serve

title: warm goat cheese toasts with honey rosemary and walnuts
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f cut eighteen 1 / 4-inch diagonal slices from baguette
2. Spread goat cheese on each slice
3. Arrange in single layer on rimmed baking sheet
4. Bake until edges are slightly golden and cheese softens , about 10 minutes
5. Set aside on sheet
6. Heat honey in small saucepan over medium heat until warm , about 2 minutes
7. Sprinkle toasts with walnuts , then rosemary
8. Drizzle with honey and serve

title: juicy apple chicken
steps:
1. Season chicken with salt and ground black pepper , if desired
2. Dust with flour
3. Melt butter in large , nonstick skillet over medium heat
4. Add chicken and cook on one side until golden brown
5. Turn chicken over and push to side of skillet , stirring in onion , apple juice and garlic
6. Bring to a boil
7. Reduce heat to medium-low , cover and cook for 7 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink in center
8. Remove chicken from skillet and place on serving platter
9. Increase heat to high , cook onion , stirring frequently , for an additional 1 to 2 minutes or until lightly browned and juice has reduced
10. Serve over chicken
11. Garnish with apple slices and sprinkle with thyme leaves

title: way too easy cajun potatoes
steps:
1. Pre heat oven to about 375-400
2. With a fork score all over the potatoes , this will make them more crisp
3. Chop the potatoes into 1 1 / 2-2 inch chunks
4. Put the oil in the pan , add potatoes , sprinkle all seasonings over and toss and stir potatoes with two forks until all chunks are coated
5. Bake for 15 mins , stir well , bake a further 10-15 minutes
6. Watch them towards the last few minutes

title: cheesy spaghetti casserole
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease a 2-qt casserole dish
3. Brown ground beef with 2 tbsp parmesan cheese ,
4. Drain off any fat
5. Add tomato sauce , salt and pepper , cook and simmer over med-low heat for 25-30 mins
6. Remove from heat
7. In a separate bowl , combine cottage cheese , cream cheese , sour cream , onions and green pepper
8. Spread half of the cooked and drained spaghetti in prepared casserole dish
9. Cover with the cheese mixture
10. Add remaining spaghetti , and drizzle the melted butter on top
11. Spread the tomato / meat sauce over the top of the spaghetti
12. Chill in the fridge for 2 hours , or overnight , to blend the flavors
13. Remove from the fridge 20 mins before baking
14. Bake for 45 mins , or until hot and bubbly
15. If desired top with 1-2 cups grated mozzeralla cheese the last 15 mins of baking

title: kittencal s onion patties latkes
steps:
1. Chop the onions finely then place into a bowl
2. In another large bowl mix together the flour , sugar , baking powder , seasoning salt , cayenne , garlic powder and a small amount of black pepper
3. Mix to combine well
4. Add in the milk and whisk until thoroughly combined
5. Add in the chopped onions and green onions and mix with a wooden spoon until combined
6. In a large non-stick frypan , heat a small amount of oil to medium-hot , adding in more oil as needed as the patties will absorb too much oil if you add in a large amount of oil at one time
7. Drop the batter from a tablespoon into about 1 / 2-inch of hot oil
8. Flatten slightly with the spoon or spatula
9. Sprinkle with a little salt
10. Fry until crispy and brown on both sides

title: garden vegetable latkes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325
2. Shred the potatoes , carrots and parsnips
3. Roll the vegetables up in a clean kitchen dish towel and squeeze all the moisture out
4. In a medium bowl , blend the flour , dill , onions , salt and pepper
5. Add the vegetables and toss to coat well
6. Mix in the eggs
7. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat
8. Working in batches , drop 2 tablespoons of batter per pancake into hot oil
9. Using a spoon , spread to 4 inch rounds
10. Cook until brown , about 3 minutes per side
11. Transfer cooked latkes to a baking sheet to keep warm in the oven
12. Repeat with remaining batter , adding more oil to skillet as needed
13. Serve hot with some sour cream mixed with additional dill and green onions

title: jello daiquiri pie
steps:
1. Combine pudding mix , gelatin and sugar in a saucepan
2. Stir in 1 / 2 cup of the water and the eggs
3. Blend well
4. Add remaining water and cook , stirring frequently , over medium heat until mixture comes to a full boil
5. Remove from heat
6. Stir in rum
7. Chill
8. Thoroughly blend whipped topping into chilled mixture
9. Spoon into pie crust and chill until firm , about 2 hours
10. Garnish with additional whipped topping and very thin lime slices , if desired

title: cream of anything soup    souper easy
steps:
1. In a soup pot , melt 1 1 / 2 tbs of butter
2. Add 1 1 / 2 tbs of flour
3. Add a dash of salt and pepper
4. Stir it together , it should look like a thin dough
5. If it looks too thin you can add a little more flour , but be careful not to add too much or your soup will taste bland no matter what you do to it
6. Stir around for about 5 minutes if you accidentally burn it , throw it away and start over
7. Add 4 cups of milk , blend well
8. Add 4 cubes or 4 tsp granulated chicken stock , dissolve and blend well
9. Add 2-3 cups of vegetables , cooked chicken , etc
10. Simmer for 30 minutes stirring frequently , soup will thicken , do not allow it to boil and do not burn it

title: baked polenta with garlic
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Butter a 2 quart souffl dish
3. Bring first 6 ingredients to boil in a large , heavy saucepan
4. Gradually add cornmeal , whisking until smooth
5. Reduce heat to low
6. Cook until cornmeal is very soft and mixture is thick and creamy , stirring occasionally , about 12 minutes
7. Remove from heat and stir in 6 tablespoons parmesan cheese , season with pepper , if desired
8. Transfer to prepared baking dish
9. Sprinkle 2 tablespoons parmesan cheese over polenta
10. Cool , cover and chill
11. Bake polenta until heated through and golden on top , about 30 minutes
12. Serve polenta warm

title: krassnaya kapusta  red cabbage
steps:
1. Wash and shred the cabbage finely
2. Discard the core and coarse leaves
3. Fry the onion in the oil in a heavy casserole pan , then add the cabbage
4. Stir for a few minites , add the cup of water , the vinegar , sugar , salt and pepper , and the apples
5. Bring to a boil
6. Reduce heat and simmer for 1 1 / 2-2 hours

title: gluten free pecan tassies
steps:
1. Mini pie crust instructions
2. Using a whisk combine the gf flour , xanthan gum& 2 tbl spoon sugar in a in a bowl , mix and set aside
3. Using a mixer combine the cream cheese , butter and sugar until it is creamy
4. Then slowly ad the gf flour mix you had set aside to the cream cheese mixture , continue to mix until well blended
5. Cover and refrigerate for atleast 30 minute
6. Pecan filling instructions
7. Using a mixer combine the pecans , brown sugar , vanilla , butter and egg until well blended
8. Set aside
9. Pie assembly
10. Preheat oven to 325 degrees
11. Seperate the refrigerated pie crust into 24 equal amounts
12. Press the seperated batter into a mini muffin pan , making sure that you press it all the way up the sides
13. Fill each crust with a heaping mound of the filling
14. Bake for approximately 30 min or until the crust is lightly browned
15. Let cool and remove your mini pies from the pan

title: beef and portabella stew
steps:
1. In shallow bowl , combine flour , salt thyme , pepper , and rosemary
2. Coat beef cubes lightly with flour mixture , reserving any remaining flour mixture to thicken stew
3. In dutch oven or stock pot , heat margarine over medium heat
4. Brown beef cubes on all sides in batches
5. Add leeks , garlic and mushrooms to browned beef
6. Cook until leeks are soft , about 5 minutes
7. Gradually stir in broth , scraping up brown bits from bottom of pan
8. Stir in tomato paste
9. Mix well
10. Bring to a boil
11. Reduce heat , cover and simmer for 1 1 / 2 hours or until meat is tender
12. To thicken , whisk 2-3 tablespoons cold water into reserved flour mixture until smooth
13. Gradually whisk into bubbling stew
14. Cook and stir until sauce thickens
15. Variance:
16. Beef and portobello pot pie: spoon cooled stew into shallow 6 cup casserole
17. Brush top edge of casserole with slightly beaten egg white
18. Roll out half a package , defrosted purchased puff pastry to a size that is 1-inch larger than casserole diameter
19. Place pastry over stew , sealing pastry to edge of casserole
20. Cut steam vents into pasty
21. Bake in 400f oven for 30-35 minutes , or until filling bubbles , and pastry is puffed and golden

title: garlicky beef with peppers
steps:
1. Trim fat from the beef
2. Cut with grain into 2-inch strips
3. Cut strips diagonally across the grain into 1 / 4-inch slices
4. Heat the olive oil in nonstick skillet
5. Add onion , garlic , thyme , salt and pepper
6. Cook and stir over medium-high heat about 3 minutes or until onion is tender
7. Stir in the meat and bell peppers , cook and stir about 4 minutes or until beef is no longer pink
8. Stir in wine
9. Reduce heat , cover and simmer for 5 minutes
10. Stir cornstarch into beef broth until disolved
11. Add to beef mixture
12. Cook and stir over medium high heat until thickened
13. Serve over noodles

title: easy  oven baked cod
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f line your pan with aluminum foil and lightly brush with olive oil , or use a bit of cooking spray
2. Combine parsley , garlic , lemon zest , and coarse salt on the cutting board
3. Finely chop , then combine with the breadcrumbs in a shallow plate
4. Brush top of each fillet with olive oil
5. Press fillet into the crumb mixture
6. Place fillets in baking dish , crust-side up
7. Bake until firm , about 12-15 minutes , depending on the thickness of the fish
8. Serve with lemon wedges

title: aviyal
steps:
1. Grind coconut , green chillies and cumin seeds to a fine paste
2. Whisk in yogurt and keep aside
3. Boil all the vegetables with 1 drumstick and curry leaves in 2 cups of water to which salt and turmeric is added
4. When the vegetables are almost done , add yogurt mixture and boil thoroughly
5. Simmer for about 10 minutes
6. Lace with coconut oil and serve with rice
7. You can also add raw mango to aviyal
8. If you do so , reduce the yogurt to 1 cup only

title: japanese calpis yogurt flavored drink
steps:
1. Mix in a double boiler the yogurt and the sugar
2. Heat the mixture while constantly stirring for about 15 minutes at 160 degrees f to 175 degrees f
3. Never let it boil !
4. When the syrup is at room temperature , add the citric acid powder and vanilla extract
5. For serving , dilute the syrup with 3 or 4 times more of water or club soda to your taste
6. Serve with ice

title: bacon wrapped swai
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Liberally grease a baking sheet or line with foil
3. I lined mine with foil and it didn't stick to the foil at all
4. Lightly sprinkle the fillets with the italian seasoning
5. Lay out 3-4 strips of uncooked bacon depending on how long your fillets are
6. Lay a fillet on top of the bacon
7. Wrap the bacon around the fillet so that there are few gaps between the slices
8. I overlapped some of my slices-it was fine
9. Repeat the process for the other fillet
10. Bake at 400 for 30 minuets
11. After the 30 minutes are up , broil on high for 1-3 minutes to crisp up the bacon
12. Watch it carefully so the bacon doesn't burn

title: potato and sausage stove top dinner
steps:
1. Mix the honey , cider vinegar and mustard in a bowl until well blended
2. In a large skillet , brown the pork , removed from the casings , on medium heat , separating ground meat while cooking
3. Add adobo seasoning while cooking
4. Add salt and pepper , to taste
5. Add sliced potatoes and cover with the honey mixture
6. Cover and simmer until potatoes are tender , stirring occasionally
7. You may get a caramelized bottom that you can scrape up and distribute within the dish
8. Yummy !

title: garlic ranch dressing
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients and whisk until thoroughly blended and then chill
2. Serve on green salads , enjoy

title: ipanema grilled chicken salad
steps:
1. Combine all the marinade ingredients in a bowl
2. Place the chicken in the bowl and marinate for one hour
3. Preheat the grill to medium high
4. Grill the chicken for 10-15 minutes , turning once
5. Cool slightly , cut into cubes and set aside
6. Melt the margarine in a saucepan on medium high heat
7. Add the mushrooms and saute until tender
8. Season with salt and pepper to taste
9. Set aside
10. Combine all the ingredients for the dressing
11. Shake well in a jar or use a whisk to thoroughly combine
12. Shred the lettuce
13. Combine the lettuce with the chicken , mushrooms , apricots , raisins and the dressing
14. Toss gently to combine , and then sprinkle with the cashews

title: grilled ginger sesame chicken salad
steps:
1. Marinade: in a medium bowl , whisk soy sauce , ginger , canola oil , hoisin sauce , sesame oil , sriracha and salt to blend
2. Transfer 3 tablespoons of the marinade to a baking dish , add chicken and turn to coat
3. Cover and refrigerate at least 30 minutes , turning after 15 minutes
4. Dressing: whisk vinegar and green onions into the remaining marinade
5. Set aside
6. Heat a grill pan over medium-high heat
7. Remove chicken from marinade , add to grill pan , and cook about 4 minutes per side or until chicken shows no sign of pink when pierced in the thickest part with the
8. Transfer to a cutting board and let rest 15 minutes
9. Cut chicken crosswise into 1 / 4-inch-thick slices
10. For the salad: in a large bowl , toss chicken , cabbage , carrots , green onions , cilantro and half of the almonds with enough dressing to coat lightly
11. Mound salad in center of 4 plates
12. Re-whisk dressing and drizzle a little over and around salad
13. Sprinkle with the remaining almonds and sesame seeds

title: lucky sweet and sour sauce
steps:
1. Mix juice and cornstarch
2. Heat oil in a small saucepan and add remaining ingredients and cornstarch mixture
3. Cook over medium to medium high heat , stirring until sauce thickens

title: simple green beans
steps:
1. Steam the green beans
2. Saute bacon and crumble it to make bits
3. Drain most of the fat out of the bacon pan , then saute the onion until almost soft
4. Add sugar , vinegar , salt and pepper
5. Once fully liquified , pour over steamed beans , top with bacon bits and toss !

title: barbecued polish sausage or kielbasa
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan , put catsup , brown sugar , onion , liquid smoke and garlic powder
2. Cook for 5 minutes
3. Put sausage in a casserole dish sprayed with cooking spray
4. Pour sauce over meat
5. Bake at 350f for 30-40 minutes , or until sausage is completely heated through and barbecue sauce thickens up

title: x rated french kiss
steps:
1. Combine in a shaker of ice and shake
2. Pour in martini glass
3. Drizzle chambord down sides of glass
4. Enjoy !
5. )

title: easy scrapple
steps:
1. Pour 2 cups of water in a sauce pan and bring to a boil
2. Cut sausage into pieces and add to boiling water mixing throughly
3. Once sausage is done take pan off heat and add red pepper flakes and sage
4. Add cornmeal and mix throughly and pour into loaf pan
5. Refrigerate until completely cooled
6. Slice and fry in frying pan with cooking spray

title: sweet bbq chicken kabobs
steps:
1. Preheat grill to medium-high heat
2. Using 8 long wooden skewers , thread chicken alternately with pineapple and peppers onto skewers to create 4 kabobs
3. Mix barbecue sauce and juice
4. Brush on kabobs
5. Grill kabobs 8-10 minute or until chicken is cooked through , brushing occasionally with remaining sauce
6. Substitute: if using metal skewers , use just one skewer when assembling the kabob

title: cheese and rosemary breadsticks
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
2. Line 2 heavy large baking sheets with silicone baking sheets or parchment paper
3. In a food processor , chop the parmesan , gruyere and rosemary together until coarsely chopped
4. Set the cheese mixture aside
5. Separate the dough strips
6. Using a pizza cutter or a large sharp knife , cut each dough strip in half lengthwise to form thin strips
7. Working with dough strip at a time , coat each strip with the olive oil and then the cheese mixture , pressing very gently
8. Twist each cheese covered dough strip and place onto prepared baking sheets
9. Sprinkle with the salt , if you wish
10. Bake until the breadsticks are golden brown , about 10 to 15 minutes
11. Transfer the warm breadsticks to a basket and serve

title: mum s miracle green salad
steps:
1. Break lettuce in pieces & line bottom of a round serving dish with them
2. Layer celery , green onions , peas , and water chestnuts
3. In a small bowl , mix mayo and sour cream & spread over veggies
4. Sprinkle shredded parmesan and bacon on top
5. Cover and refrigerate overnight
6. Fyi
7. Cooking time includes refrigerated overnight

title: indonsesian pork satay
steps:
1. Blend peanut butter , onion , garlic , lemon juice , soy sauce , brown sugar , hot sauce and canola oil together
2. Marinate pork cubes in mixture for 10 minutes at least or up to a couple hours in the fridge
3. Push pork on skewers
4. Grill or broil for 10-12 minutes turning occasionally until done
5. Serve over plain brown or white rice or add snowpeas and baby corn to rice

title: moros y cristianos  black beans and rice
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a large pot over moderate heat and saute the onion , bell pepper , and garlic until tender but not brown , about 5 minutes
2. Add the beans , tomatoes , stock , salt , pepper , and optional cayenne and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes
3. Serve over rice and garnish with fresh herbs

title: roasted eggplant and tomato pizza
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450
2. Arrange eggplant slices in single layer on greased baking tray
3. Sprinkle eggplant slices with salt , bake until soft and golden
4. Turn heat up to 515 and place pizza stone in oven
5. Roll out pizza dough on cornmeal coated paddle , lightly coat with oil
6. Sprinkle dough with mozzarella and arrange eggplant in a spoke pattern
7. Sprinkle with tomatoes and dot with pesto
8. Bake 8-10 minutes

title: saltine candy   toffee
steps:
1. Line jelly roll pan with foil and spray with non-stick spray
2. Lay crackers out flat on foil
3. Melt sugar and butter until foamy
4. Pour over crackers and spread to coat
5. Bake 10 minutes in 350f oven
6. Remove from oven
7. While hot , sprinkle with chocolate chips , let soften and melt , then spread
8. Sprinkle with nuts
9. Let cool
10. Refrigerate until hardened
11. Break into pieces like peanut brittle
12. Serves one , hee hee , two if you share !

title: kookoo  kuku  ye sabzi
steps:
1. In a large bowl , toss chopped herbs , scallions , half of the walnuts , spinach , half of the barberries , and flour
2. In another bowl , whisk eggs with saffron and season with salt and pepper
3. Heat oil in a large , nonstick frying pan over medium heat
4. When oil is hot , slowly pour in egg mixture , stirring in herb mixture into the center of the egg mixture
5. Shake to loosen base , reduce heat to medium-low , cover loosely , and leave to cook very gently for 5-6 minutes as omelet cooks , shake to loosen base , and neaten sides with a spatula to build up a deep , straight edge
6. When the top looks set , invert a large plate over the pan and flip the whole pan over so the omelet ends up on the plate , cooked side up
7. Slip omelet back in pan for another 2-3 to cook other side
8. When it feels firm , slide it out onto its plate or flip it again as done in step #6
9. It will set a little more as it cools
10. Serve warm or "at the temperature of a spring evening in the desert
11. "
12. I garnished the omelet with sprigs of parsley , the remaining barberries and walnuts
13. A side of strained yogurt was also served as a garnish
14. To complete the menu i made a pot of simple persian steamed rice and recipe #496880

title: lemonade chex mix
steps:
1. In a large microwave bowl , mix cereals and almonds
2. Microwave butter , sugar and lemonade concentrate uncovered on high 30 seconds then stir
3. Pour over cereal mixture , stirring until evenly coated
4. Microwave uncovered on high about 5 minutes , stirring every 2 minutes , until mixture begins to brown
5. Spread on waxed paper to cool then store in airtight container
6. Pump up the flavor by mixing in 1 / 2 to 1 cup dried cranberries , yogurt-covered raisins , dried tropical fruit bits or flaked coconut after microwave time , just before spreading to cool

title: littlemafia s transylvanian cabbage   noodles
steps:
1. Mix cabbage with salt and allow to stand 1 / 2 hour
2. Squeeze dry
3. Heat oil in skillet and saute cabbage onion , stirring occasionally until cabbage is lightly browned and tender
4. Season with salt and pepper
5. Cook noodles
6. Drain
7. Mix noodles with cabbage , season with salt and pepper , heat and serve
8. Optional:sprinkle with carraway seeds

title: fresh strawberries with yogurt  easy moroccan dessert
steps:
1. Wash and slice the strawberries
2. Gently mix the sliced strawberries with the yogurt , sugar and vanilla
3. Cover , and leave in the fridge for an hour or longer
4. If desired , bring back to room temperature before serving

title: chicken salad with grapes and apples
steps:
1. I cooked two boneless chicken breasts in a covered fry pan with about a 1 / 4 inch of white wine , salt , pepper and a chicken seasoning
2. When done i cut them up in small pieces
3. You could use leftover chicken or cook it anyway you like
4. Even canned chunk chicken might work
5. Just cut everything up and mix it all together
6. Just before serving add the cool whip and mix
7. It should look like mayonnaise
8. I used a granny smith apple and red seedless grapes , but any type would do

title: cincinnati chili 3  4  or 5 way
steps:
1. In a large pan brown ground beef along with onion , celery , bell pepper , and garlic , breaking up meat as it cooks
2. Drain any accumulated fat
3. Add rest of ingredients to pan , mixing well
4. Bring to a boil , then lower heat , cover , and simmer for 1 1 / 2-2 hours , stirring occasionally
5. Adjust consistency with water as needed
6. Serve your chili as follows
7. 3-way: chili , spaghetti , and cheese
8. 4-way: a 3-way plus onions or beans
9. 5-way: spaghetti , chili , onions , beans and cheese
10. Chili spaghetti: spaghetti with chili
11. Cheese coney: hot dog , bun , mustard , chili , and cheese
12. Chili cheese sandwich: a coney minus the hot dog
13. Cincinnati burrito: chili beans wrapped in a tortilla , topped with chili , onions , tomatoes , lettuce , cheese , sour cream , and black olives
14. Cincinnati potato: baked jacket potato topped with chili , diced onions , beans and shredded cheddar cheese
15. Chili-cheese fries: french fries topped with chili and shredded cheddar cheese
16. Low-carb coney: 3 small hot dogs in a bowl covered with chili and cheese
17. Serve oyster crackers and hot sauce on the side or as a topping , if desired

title: sauteed mushrooms and herbs
steps:
1. Wash and wipe mushrooms dry
2. Heat olive oil and butter until very hot and add mushrooms
3. Toss quickly in hot oil
4. Reduce heat , cover and cook 6-7 minutes
5. Remove lid and continue cooking until all liquid evaporates
6. Set aside until meal is ready
7. When your meal is ready to serve , reheat the mushrooms and sprinkle with chopped herbs and garlic
8. Toss to mix
9. Season with salt and pepper

title: grilled chicken salad for two
steps:
1. Grill chicken , covered , over medium heat for 8-10 minutes on each side or until no longer pink
2. Divide salad greens between two serving plates and top with next six ingredients
3. Slice chicken , arrange over salads , and serve with italian dressing

title: grandma s cheese ball
steps:
1. Bring cheeses to room temperature
2. Place cheeses , onion and worcestershire sauce in a bowl
3. Mix well
4. Chill
5. Shape into 2 balls
6. Roll in walnuts and parsley
7. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate
8. Serve with crackers , fruits and veggies

title: moist crock pot lemon cake
steps:
1. Spray a 4 quart crock pot with non-stick cooking spray and set aside
2. In a large bowl , combine the cake mix and pudding mix
3. In a medium bowl , beat the eggs with the water , then add the sour cream and oil and beat until smooth
4. Add to the dry ingredients and beat well
5. Stir in the white chocolate chips and almonds
6. Pour into crock pot
7. Cover slow cooker and cook on low for 6-8 hours , until top springs back when touched very lightly with finger

title: kangaroo and beer pie with damper pastry
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 190c
2. To make the damper pastry , combine flour baking powder and salt , then rub in the butter by hand
3. Or place flour , baking powder and salt in your food processor and pulse to sift , then add the butter , and process until the mixture resembles breadcrumbs
4. Add milk and mix until the dough leaves the side of the bowl
5. Cover with plastic wrap and chill for 20 minutes
6. Meanwhile season the flour with salt and pepper and toss the kangaroo cubes gently to coat with the flour
7. Heat a little olive oil in a frying pan and brown the meat in batches , remove and set aside
8. Add the mushrooms and garlic and cook for 2 minutes
9. Add the meat , beer and stock and bring to the boil
10. Reduce heat , half cover pan and simmer for 90 minutes
11. Set aside to cool
12. Adjust seasoning , stir in the marjoram and transfer mixture to a pie dish or tin
13. Roll out damper pastry until 4mm thick and place over meat to form a secure lid
14. Press pastry edges down with finger
15. Pierce pastry with a knife four times then bake pie for 25-30 minutes until damper crust is golden brown

title: texas christmas cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven 325f or 350f beat eggs well
2. Gradually add sugar , cinnamon , cloves , nuts , butter , raisins , dates , baking soda and flour , in order
3. Mix thoroughly
4. Drop by teaspoons onto ungreased baking sheet
5. Bake in slow oven: 12 minutes at 350f or 15 minutes at 325f for a softer cookie

title: gluten free zucchini bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Grease 9x5 loaf pan
3. Combine oil , sugar
4. Add eggs , vanilla applesauce & beat
5. Add flours , baking powder , xantham gum , salt , and cinnamon
6. Stir in zucchini , nuts and raisins
7. Bake for 1 hour

title: orange icing glaze
steps:
1. Beat all ingredients together , adding more or less juice to make icing proper consistency
2. Ice or dip cookies into icing
3. Enjoy !

title: baby spinach omelet
steps:
1. In a bowl , beat the eggs , and stir in the baby spinach and parmesan cheese
2. Season with onion powder , nutmeg , salt , and pepper
3. In a small skillet coated with cooking spray over medium heat , cook the egg mixture about 3 minutes , until partially set
4. Flip with a spatula , and continue cooking 2 to 3 minutes
5. Reduce heat to low , and continue cooking 2 to 3 minutes , or to desired doneness

title: ligurian lemon cake
steps:
1. Butter a 10-inch round cake or springform pan , dust with flour , and tap out any excess
2. In a large bowl , sift flour and baking powder
3. Set aside
4. Place sugar and lemon zest in the bowl of an electric mixer
5. Rub the ingredients together between your fingers until the sugar is moist , grainy , and has absorbed as much of the zest as possible
6. Return bowl to mixer
7. Using the whisk attachment , beat in eggs on medium high until the mixture is pale and thick , about 3 minutes
8. With the mixer on lowest speed , beat in milk
9. Add reserved flour mixture
10. Beat until incorporated
11. Add lemon juice , melted butter , and olive oil
12. Beat until blended
13. Pour about one third of the batter into the prepared pan
14. There should be just enough batter to form a thin , even layer
15. Arrange the raspberries on top of the batter
16. Pour the remaining batter over the raspberries , and use a rubber spatula to gently spread batter so that it runs down between the berries and just covers them
17. Bake cake until it's golden and pulling away from the sides of the pan , and a cake tester inserted into the center comes out clean , about 35 minutes
18. Let cool for about 15 minutes before removing the cake ring

title: zucchini banana pumpkin bread
steps:
1. Prepare bread pan by spraying with cooking spray
2. Put aside
3. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
4. Mix flour , baking powder , 1 / 2 tsp cinnamon , salt , sugar , and evaporated milk together in a large mixing bowl
5. Mix pumpkin , mashed banana , zucchini , butter , egg , vanilla extract and water , in a bowl
6. When incorporated add all at once to the flour mixture
7. Pour into pan and top with mixture of brown sugar and 1 / 2 tsp cinnamon
8. Put in oven and cook for 40-45 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean from middle

title: salmon with pesto crust
steps:
1. Mix the breadcrumbs , lemon rind , oil and pesto
2. Add the lemon juice
3. Remove the skin from the salmon , press on the crumbs and put on a greased baking tray and bake in a 400 oven for 15 mins or until salmon is cooked through
4. Sauce --
5. Melt butter and whisk in the lemon juice , rind and creme fraiche
6. Pour the sauce on to plates and top with fish

title: lone star tomato pie
steps:
1. Mix mayonnaise , cheese and onion and season salt and pepper to taste
2. Grease a 9"x12" casserole dish
3. Layer the bottom evenly with 7 slices of the bread cut into medium sized cubes
4. Over this , layer the tomatoes , overlapping the length of the casserole - usually 4 rows using about 5 of the tomatoes
5. Season this layer liberally with salt and pepper
6. Trim the crusts away from the remaining 8 slices of bread and arrange them on top of the tomato layer so they cover the surface completely
7. Spread about a third of the mayonnaise , cheese and onion mixture on top of the bread layer
8. Arrage the remaining tomatoes in the same overlapping manner
9. Season with salt and pepper
10. Spoon the rest of the mayonnaise , cheese and onion mix on the tomatoes
11. Bake uncovered in a 375f oven for about 25 minutes until the cheese on top becomes golden brown
12. Serve hot as a side dish

title: low carb orange fluff
steps:
1. Combine the boiling water with the jello powder , add the diet soda and chill until partially set
2. Beat the cream cheese until fluffy and then gradually add the partially set jello to the cream cheese
3. Beat the whipping cream with the sweetener to soft peaks and then fold into the gelatin mixture
4. Cover and chill until firm

title: red pepper jelly
steps:
1. Place red peppers , sugar and vinegar in kettle
2. Heat rapidly to boiling , stirring continuously
3. Remove from heat , let stand 15 minutes
4. Reheat to boiling , add lemon juice
5. Let it come to a boil , then add the pectin
6. Boil for 5 minutes , stirring constantly
7. Bottle as any jelly

title: zucchini and cheese casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. In a medium bowl , pour the melted butter over the bread
3. Add the zucchini , onion , garlic salt and egg
4. Mix well
5. Put the mixture in a 9 x 13 baking dish and top with the cheese
6. Bake , covered , for 30 minutes , then another 30 minutes uncovered

title: home baked bagels
steps:
1. Mix yeast , sugar and warm water together and let stand 3 minutes
2. Mix 2 cups of flour with the salt in a large bowl and add the yeast mixture
3. Stir until combined and slowly mix in the rest of the flour
4. Knead on a floured surface for 5 minutes , adding additional flour if needed , dough should be firm
5. Place dough in a greased bowl , cover and let rise until double
6. After rising punch down and divide dough into 12 balls
7. Allow to rest for 4 minutes
8. Bring 2 quarts of water to boil
9. With your thumb , make a hole in each ball of dough and pull open about 2 inches , making a bagel shape
10. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
11. Place the shaped dough onto a cookie sheet and cover for 10 minutes
12. Lower heat under water for it to be simmering
13. Drop 2 or 3 bagels at a time into the water for about 45 seconds , turning each once
14. Drain and place on greased baking sheets
15. Brush tops with beaten egg white and top with optional toppings
16. Bake for 35 minutes , turning once for even browning
17. Bagels are done when they are golden brown and shiny

title: ham   cheese ramen noodles     cheap budget meal
steps:
1. Pour 1 cup water in a pan
2. Put noodles in water
3. Set noodles and water to boiling
4. Once noodles have broken up rip the ham in little bite size pieces and place over the noodles
5. Just before too much water evaporates remove from stove
6. I like just about a tablespoon of water leftover
7. Add seasoning packet and stir around well
8. Top with cheese , let melt and enjoy !
9. Important ! make sure you keep a close eye on this recipe as it cooks very fast

title: hummus in a hurry
steps:
1. Mince garlic in blender or food processor
2. Add drained chickpeas , salt , cumin , and cayenne and blend until minced
3. Scrape sides of blender / food processor with a rubber spatula
4. Add lemon juice , olive oil , and 2 tbs
5. Of reserved chickpea liquid , processing until thick and smooth
6. Taste and adjust seasonings as desired

title: solar starninja s twisted green bean casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Add butter to pan and cook about 1-1 1 / 2 cups diced onions
3. Add the minced garlic
4. Cook thoroughly
5. Mix the cream of chicken and green beans into a casserole dish
6. Add the onions and garlic mix
7. Add the cheese whiz and lightly whip into the green beans / cream of chicken / onion and garlic mix
8. Sprinkle french fried onion mix on top
9. Bake in a preheated 350 degrees f oven until bubbly and the onions just begin to brown
10. Typically about 25 minutes

title: tickled pink tropical island  iced tea
steps:
1. Pour all the ingredients into a large , tall 10-14 oz ice-filled collins style glass
2. Top with the club soda and gently stir
3. Garnish with as many fresh lime wedges as you like , and a pink straw for sipping
4. Variations:
5. Long island iced tea: replace the spiced rum with white rum and the guava juice with orange juice and the club soda with cola
6. Miami iced tea: replace the spiced rum with white rum and the guava juice with orange juice and the club soda with cola and the cointreau with blue curaao
7. New england iced tea: replace the spiced rum with white rum and the guava juice with orange juice and the club soda with cranberry juice

title: grilled hanger steak
steps:
1. Soak porcini mushrooms in enough very hot water to just cover
2. Soak at least 20 minutes
3. Melt butter in skillet
4. Add onion and garlic and saute until tender
5. Remove mushrooms from liquid and dice
6. Add to skillet with red wine and port wine
7. Bring to a boil and reduce volume by half
8. Strain mushroom liquid through a coffee filter to remove grit
9. Pour sauce through a sieve
10. Discard solids and return sauce to pan
11. Add mushroom liquid
12. Whisk in demi-glace
13. Adjust seasoning with salt and pepper , if needed
14. Keep warm over low heat
15. Sprinkle steak with salt and pepper on both sides
16. Broil 4 minutes on each side for medium-rare
17. Let stand 5 minutes
18. Slice thinly across the grain and serve with sauce

title: eggplant  aubergine  hush puppies
steps:
1. Put the eggplant cubes into a colander and steam , covered , over boiling water until tender , about 25 minutes
2. Sprinkle with salt and set aside
3. Meanwhile , combine the corn meal , flour , baking powder and 1 1 / 2 teaspoons salt in a bowl
4. Push the eggplant through the colander into the bowl in small amounts , mixing in enough eggplant to make a medium stiff dough
5. Stir in the onions
6. Set the mixture aside for 15 to 30 minutes
7. Drop the mixture by teaspoonfuls into deep oil heated to 365 degrees and fry until golden
8. Drain on paper towels
9. Enjoy !

title: make ahead omelet
steps:
1. Grease a 9x13 inch pan
2. Add cubed bread
3. Spread cheese over bread
4. Beat eggs , add milk and salt
5. Beat
6. Add melted margarine and pour over bread
7. Refrigerate overnight
8. Top with mushrooms , onion , green peppers , olives , etc
9. Bake at 350 degrees fahreneheit for 45 to 55 minutes
10. Enjoy !

title: incredibly hot buffalo wing sauce
steps:
1. Saute onion and garlic in a small amount of butter just till aromatic
2. Remove from heat
3. Add remaining butter and melt over low heat
4. Add remaining ingredients and simmer 5-10 minutes
5. This sauce can stay over very low heat for a long time
6. The longer it sits , the hotter it will be

title: balsamic chicken with baby spinach
steps:
1. Heat a large saute pan over medium-high heat
2. Add the olive oil and heat
3. Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute
4. Add the chicken and cook about 4 minutes per side , or until cooked through and juices run clear
5. Remove the chicken and set aside
6. To the same pan , add the spinach and cook just until wilted , about 1 to 2 minutes
7. Remove from the pan and set aside
8. Lower the heat to medium and add the balsamic vinegar and chicken broth to the pan and stir , scraping the bottom of the pan to remove any browned bits
9. Add the tomatoes , bring to a simmer and cook 3 to 5 minutes
10. Place the couscous in a serving bowl
11. Top with the spinach , chicken and balsamic-tomato sauce

title: braised salmon
steps:
1. Combine and heat vegetable broth and fish stock in a large saucepan on medium high heat
2. Meanwhile season the fish with rosemary , dill , parsley , salt and pepper
3. Add the green onions , napa cabbage and carrots to the pot , and place the fish on top
4. Lower the heat to medium low , and cook for 20-25 minutes
5. Never serve fish that is undercooked , so make sure it is cooked completely before serving
6. Serve warm with rice or couscous

title: homemade yeast rolls
steps:
1. Mix together first 3 ingredients
2. Crumble into mixture 2 packages or 2 cakes yeast
3. Stir until yeast is dissolved
4. Stir in beaten eggs , shortening & sifted flour
5. Turn mixture onto floured board
6. Knead until smooth and elastic
7. Place in greased bowl , cover and let rise in warm place until double in bulk
8. Knead again and let rise again until double in bulk
9. Shape into rolls and let rise until almost double in bulk
10. Bake at 425 degrees until golden brown
11. Watch temperature , as may be too hot in some ovens

title: creme de menthe cake
steps:
