1. Follow directions on package using green creme de menthe for water
2. Bake as required for cake
3. Cool completely
4. Spread heated hot fudge topping over cooled cake
5. Freeze
6. Add clear creme de menthe to cool whip , spread over cake

title: venetian inn baked haddock
steps:
1. Rinse haddock well under cold water while still frozen
2. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
3. Mix flour with salt and pepper
4. Lightly dust each fillet with mixture
5. Lay fish in baking dish and brush top of each piece with olive oil
6. Mix hot water , bay leaves and lemon juice and spritz fillets with mixture
7. Sprinkle fillets with paprika for color
8. Bake for 30 minutes or until fish is firm
9. Remove from oven and transfer to serving platter
10. Pour melted butter over each piece before serving

title: chili and cornbread casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Heat boca crumbles in microwave for one minute heat the oil in a skillet
3. Saute onion in oil until translucent
4. Add boca crumbles or ground beef , tomatoes and beans to the skillet
5. Add chili powder and cayenne
6. Cook until heated through
7. Pour chili into a 2
8. 5 liter casserole dish
9. Spread cornbread batter over chili
10. Bake 20 minutes or until cornbread is lightly browned and a toothpick inserted into the cornbread comes out clean

title: tuna pasta bake with corn chip crunchy topping
steps:
1. Cook pasta in plenty of boiling salted water for 10 minutes or until al dente
2. Drain and rinse through cold water
3. Stir condensed cream of celery soup through pasta
4. Carefully fold in tuna chunks , cheese and parsley
5. Pour into oven proof dish
6. Sprinkle topping on top
7. Bake at 190 degrees celsius on fan bake for 20-25 minutes or until heated through and topping is golden
8. Serve with grilled tomatoes and tossed salad
9. Enjoy !

title: smothered pork chops with gravy and rice
steps:
1. Sprinkle pork chops with seasoning salt , salt and black pepper
2. Place in a baking dish
3. In a medium bowl mix cream of mushroom soup , sour cream , worcestershire sauce and milk
4. Pour over pork chops
5. Bake covered in a 350 degree oven for 1 hour
6. Remove from oven and sprinkle onion rings on top
7. Bake uncovered for 8 to 10 minutes
8. Serve pork chops and gravy over cooked rice
9. Enjoy !

title: wicked excellent granola
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300f
2. Combine in a very large roasting pan the oats through nutmeg
3. Drizzle oil , honey , maple syrup & vanilla over all & stir well to combine
4. Bake for 1 - 1
5. 5 hrs , stirring every 20 minutes until it looks dry-ish & toasty
6. When cooled , stir in fruit

title: vegetarian breakfast smoothie
steps:
1. In a blender mix the pumpkin , peanut butter , cheese , cinnamon , honey , milk , vanilla and sugar together until well blended
2. Top with optional whip cream

title: roasted broccoli  parmesan   lemon
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Trim approximately 1 inch off the ends of the broccoli stalks and cut broccoli lengthwise into spears
3. Arrange broccoli on nonstick cookie sheet , drizzle with the olive oil , season with salt and a generous amount of freshly ground black pepper
4. Toss to coat evenly
5. Transfer to the oven and roast for 10 minutes
6. Remove from oven and sprinkle the cheese evenly over the top and bake until the cheese melts and forms a crip shell over the broccoli , approximately 8-10 minutes
7. Remove from oven , drizzle with the juice from the lemon

title: czech pork soup
steps:
1. Put the pork cubes , onion , carrot & garlic in a lrg pan
2. Add water
3. Simmer for 1 to 1 1 / 2 hrs till meat is tender
4. Skim b4 adding marjoram
5. Season w / salt & pepper to taste pref & simmer for a further 5-10 minutes
6. To serve: place rice in serving bowls & ladle the soup over it
7. In true czech tradition , garnish w / a dollop of sour cream as desired
8. Just too easy , isn't it ?
9. "

title: roasted garlic  herb  butter
steps: 1. Mix all ingredients together for flavors to meld and chill or freeze till ready to serve

title: barbeque ham
steps:
1. In a skillet with a small amount of oil , fry onions until brown
2. In a bowl blend together ketchup , water , vinegar , mustard , brown sugar and worcestershire sauce
3. Combine this mixture in skillet with onions and ham and simmer until hot , about 5 to 10 minutes

title: garlic cheese french bread
steps:
1. Cut bread into 1-1 / 2 inch slices , but not all the way through
2. Combine remaining ingredients and mix well
3. Pat between slices
4. Wrap loaf tightly in foil and bake at 400 f until cheese is melted and bread is heated through , about 20 minutes

title: low fat mushroom and red wine pate
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a large , deep frying pan and gently cook the onion and garlic until soft
2. Add the mushrooms , season with black pepper , and cook until they start releasing liquid
3. Add the wine , dried and fresh herbs and bring to the boil
4. Reduce the heat and simmer uncovered , stirring occasionally until all the liquid is absorbed
5. Remove from the heat and chill for at least 30minutes until cold or overnight if preparing in advance
6. When completely chilled , add balsamic vinegar to taste and beat in the soft cream cheese until evenly mixed
7. Chill until needed

title: herb chevre fig spread
steps:
1. In a small bowl pour boiling water over figs to cover
2. Let stand 15 minutes
3. Drain well
4. Meanwhile , in a medium bowl stir together chevre , sour cream , basil , and thyme
5. Season to taste with salt and pepper
6. Stir in drained figs and 1 / 4 cup almonds
7. Thin with milk if needed
8. Cover and chill in refrigerator up to 24 hours
9. To serve , transfer spread to a serving bowl
10. Sprinkle with remaining almonds and fresh thyme
11. Serve with toasted baguette slices or crackers

title: ginger macadamia apple crisp
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400
2. In a food processor pulse the flour and brown sugar , ginger , cinnamon , and salt
3. Add the butter and pulse until it's the size of small peas
4. Add macadamias and pulse once or twice until well mixed , set aside
5. This can also be mixed by hand
6. In a large bowl mix apples , crystallized ginger , sugar , zest and lime juice
7. Spread mixture into a 3 quart baking dish
8. Cover with topping , bake for 50 minutes until bubbling , and top is golden
9. Let it cool for 30 minutes
10. Enjoy !

title: garlic rosemary focaccia for the bread machine
steps:
1. Crush two of the garlic cloves and place it in your breadmachine pan along with the flours , milk , salt , water , 3 tbsp
2. Olive oil , honey , and yeast place the bread pan inside the machine and close the lid
3. Program bread maker for the whole wheat dough mode turn dough onto floured surface divide dough into two pieces and cover and let rest 10 minutes+
4. Crush the remaining garlic
5. In a small bowl combine garlic with herbs and remaining 1 / 4 cup oil
6. Add salt if desired
7. Oil two round cake pans
8. Place in dough
9. Brush dough with garlic oil
10. Bake in bottom third of preheated 400 oven for 18-24 minutes
11. Until golden brown

title: pineapple  coconut   banana rum delight
steps:
1. Place milk and pineapple chunks in blender and blend to mix the milk into the pineapples
2. This will have a slight chunky texture
3. Place in a very large bowl or pot with all the rest of the ingredients except for the optional seltzer
4. Mix and pour into 3 gallon freezer ziplock storage bags
5. Freeze overnight
6. Place into a punch bowl the icy mixture
7. You can add the optional seltzer if it`s to strong or to sweet for you
8. I kept it on the side for my guests to have an option to add if they want

title: mississippi cornbread
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together and pour into greased pan or baking dish
2. Bake at 375 for 45 minutes or until done

title: lemon and artichoke chicken stew
steps:
1. In a bowl , combine flour , salt , and pepper
2. Toss chicken in the seasoned flour
3. Heat oil in a dutch oven over medium high heat
4. Add chicken and cook until browned on all sides , about 6 minutes
5. Reduce heat to medium
6. Add lemon juice and zest and 1 / 2 cup of the chicken broth
7. Cook while stirring , until liquid is slightly thickened about 1 or 2 minutes
8. Add remaining broth , potato , and capers
9. Cover pot and simmer until potato is tender , about 10 minutes
10. Add artichokes and cook another 5 minutes and serve

title: caramelized onion stuffed baked potato
steps:
1. Pierce potatoes with a fork
2. Arroange on paper towels in microwave
3. Microwave on high for 10 minutes or until done
4. Cut each potato in half lengthwise
5. Scoop out pulp , leaving a 1 / 4 inch thick shell
6. Combine potato pulp , 1 / 4 cup cheese , sour cream , salt& pepper
7. Spoon potato mixture evenly into shells
8. Melt butter in a nonstick skillet over medium heat
9. Add onion and sugar
10. Saute 8 minutes or until browned
11. Stir in sherry , worcestershire sauce , thyme , & garlic
12. Cook 1 minute or until liquid evaporates scraping pan to loosen browned bits
13. Top each potato half with about 2 tablespoons onion mixture and 1 tablespoon of cheese
14. Microwave on high 1 minute or until thoroughly heated

title: basquadillas
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees
2. Slice peppers in half and removing seeds and membrane
3. Place peppers in a foil lined roasting pan cut side down
4. Cook for 10 to 15 minutes until the flesh is tender and the skin has begun to char
5. When done , the peppers will have difficulty retaining their shape
6. Remove peppers from oven and fold foil into a tent covering the peppers
7. Don't worry if the peppers side together in the center
8. Let sit for 10 minutes to steam the skins
9. Open foil and use your finger or a paring knife to slip the skins off the peppers
10. Cut into 1 inch strips
11. Combine olive oil , vinegar , thyme , basil and garlic powder in a medium bowl
12. Add peppers and let marinade for 30 to 60 minutes
13. Turn on broiler
14. Place tortillas on a baking sheet and place under broiler for 3 to 4 minutes or until tortillas begin to crisp
15. Turn tortilla and allow second side to cook a bit
16. Remove from broiler
17. Spread the goat cheese onto each hot tortilla
18. Drain peppers from marinade and top the basquadilla
19. Cut into wedges and serve topped with additional sprigs of basil

title: ham and cheese buttermilk muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 and spray a 12 cup muffin pan
2. Whisk together dry ingredients and spices
3. Make a well and whisk together eggs , buttermilk , oil , and butter
4. Stir in scallions , ham , cheese , and bell pepper
5. Mix the dry ingredients with the wet gently until just moistened
6. Scoop the batter into the pan
7. Bake 20-25 minutes and allow to cool 15 minutes before transferring to a cooling rack
8. Will keep in the fridge for 3 days or frozen for one month

title: pretzel nut squares
steps:
1. Using a 15x10 cookie sheet covered with wax paper , line all pieces up in rows
2. Melt chocolate chips in microwave or in a double boiler on stovetop
3. Using a spoon , drizzle melted chips over pretzel snaps
4. Sprinkle with chopped nuts and lightly press with hand to adhere to chocolate
5. Let cool until set and chocolate is hard
6. May put in refrigerator for quick setting
7. Store in airtight container

title: m m s christmas story
steps:
1. Share and place m&m's each of the gift bags
2. Attach ribbons and card with this story written on it to each bag:
3. As you hold these candies in your hand & turn them you will see: the "m" becomes a "w" and an "e" and then a "3" they tell the christmas story , one i'm sure you know - it took place in a stable a long , long time ago "e" is for the east where the star shone so bright "m" is for the manger where baby jesus slept "3" is for the wisemen bearing gifts when they came "w" is for worship , hallelujah - praise his name so as you eat these candies , or share them with a friend remember the meaning of christmas it's a love story that never ends
4. Hang on tree or hand out as token gifts

title: cuban black bean patties with pineapple rice
steps:
1. To prepare rice , cook rice according to package directions , omitting salt and fat
2. Drain
3. Place rice in a large bowl
4. Melt butter in a nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
5. Add pineapple
6. Saut 4 minutes or just until pineapple begins to brown
7. Add pineapple mixture , cilantro , and 1 / 4 teaspoon salt to rice in bowl
8. Cover and keep warm
9. Wipe pan clean with paper towels
10. To prepare patties , place 1 1 / 2 cups beans , garlic , cumin , and 1 / 8 teaspoon salt in a bowl
11. Partially mash with a fork
12. Place 1 / 2 cup remaining beans and egg white in a food processor
13. Process 30 seconds or until well combined
14. Add bean puree to mashed beans in bowl , and stir until combined
15. Add cheese and onion to bean mixture
16. Stir until combined
17. Divide bean mixture into 4 equal portions , shaping each into a 1 / 2-inch-thick patty
18. Place cornmeal in a shallow dish
19. Dredge both sides of each patty in cornmeal
20. Heat pan over medium-high heat
21. Coat pan with cooking spray
22. Add patties
23. Cook 3 minutes on each side or until browned
24. Spoon about 1 / 2 cup rice onto each of 4 plates
25. Top each serving with 1 patty and 1 tablespoon sour cream

title: tofu peach whip
steps:
1. Blanch 3 peaches for 45 seconds in boiling water
2. Transfer the peaches to a bowl of ice water to cool , then peel , using a small paring knife
3. Cut the peaches into slices and place in a blender or food processor
4. Add the tofu and honey , then blend on high speed until the mixture is smooth , scraping down the bowl as needed
5. Divide the peach whip among 6 dessert bowls and chill for 2 hours
6. Slice the remaining peach and use as garnish , along with a mint sprig , for each bowl

title: dijon grilled swordfish
steps:
1. Pat fish dry and brush with lemon juice
2. Spread one side of fish with mustard and add a slice of butter
3. Grill fish , marinade side up until just opaque-about 12-15 minutes
4. Do not turn the fish

title: cassis splashed melon with french vanilla ice cream   blackb
steps:
1. Cut off a sliver of each melon wedge bottom , so that they will sit nicely on a plate
2. Pour 2 tablespoons of cassis liqueur or syrup across each melon wedge
3. Scoop 1 ball of ice cream onto each wedge of melon
4. Garnish each with blackberries and serve
5. Simple as that !

title: texas tumbleweeds
steps:
1. In a large stockpot , slowly melt candy coating over low heat
2. When melted add peanut butter , stirring to mix well
3. Add rice cereal and peanuts
4. Stir to mix well
5. Add marshmallows last
6. Once they get warm , the mixture gets very gooey
7. Quickly drop by tablespoons onto wax paper or into muffin cups
8. Refrigerate until hardened
9. Enjoy !

title: chicken nuggets with chili sauce
steps:
1. In blender , combine broth and chilies
2. Cover and process until pureed
3. Set aside
4. In a large skillet , saute onions in butter until tender
5. Stir in the chili powder , cumin , garlic and pureed mixture
6. Bring to a boil
7. Reduce heat to low
8. Simmer , uncovered , for 20 minutes , stirring occasionally
9. Add the brown sugar , orange juice , ketchup , and lemon juice
10. Cook and stir over low heat for 15 minutes or until thickened
11. Keep warm
12. For nuggets , combine the cornmeal , chili powder , cumin and salt in a large resealable plastic bag
13. Add chicken cubes , a few at a time , and shake to coat
14. Heat oil in a large skillet
15. Cook chicken for 6-8 minutes of until juices run clear , turning frequently
16. Serve with sauce

title: baby s jalapeo cheese cornbread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f with cast iron skillet inside
2. Meanwhile , mix dry ingredients in a medium bowl
3. Add remaining ingredients , except cheese
4. Remove skillet from oven and rub cooking oil on bottom and sides
5. Pour half of batter mixture into hot greased iron skillet
6. Top with 1 / 2 of cheese
7. Pour remaining batter over this and top with remaining cheese
8. Bake at 375f for 45 minutes
9. Turn off oven and leave in for 15 additional minutes

title: uncle bill s creamy  savory tomato soup
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , heat olive oil and butter over medium-high heat
2. Add onion and saute' until translucent , about 2 minutes , stirring often
3. Add garlic and thyme and saute' for 2 minutes
4. Add crushed tomatoes , sun-dried tomatoes and balsamic vinegar
5. Bring to simmer , about 3 minutes , stirring frequently
6. Reduce to low and stir in baking soda
7. Add half and half , stir well and bring to a simmer
8. Do not boil
9. Use an immersion blender to puree' soup in the saucepan or puree' soup in batches in a food processor or blender
10. Season with salt and pepper
11. Serve hot

title: egg replacer  only for cakes
steps: 1. Mix them and use

title: tofu chips
steps:
1. Cut the tofu into thin squares , about 1 1 / 2 inch sides and 1 / 4 inch thick
2. Place the tofu in a single layer on a clean dishtowel and cover with another clean dishtowel
3. Place a board on top of the tofu and then place a heavy weight on top of the board
4. Let sit for at least two hours
5. Coat the pressed tofu with the nutritional yeast
6. Heat the oil in a large skillet
7. On medium-low heat , fry the tofu in the oil for about five minutes per side , or until crisp
8. Drain on paper towels

title: double chocolate cookie bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Combine crumbs and butter
3. Press firmly on bottom of 13x9 inch baking pan
4. In medium saucepan , over medium heat , melt 1 cup chips with sweetened condensed milk and vanilla
5. Pour evenly over prepared crust
6. Top with nuts and remaining chips
7. Bake 20 minutes or until set
8. Cool completely
9. Chill if desired
10. Cut into bars
11. Store tightly covered at room temperature

title: seasoned spinach with garlic
steps:
1. Bring a large pot of water to a boil
2. Add spinach and cook , stirring , just until it turns bright green , about 30 seconds
3. Drain and rinse immediately with cold water
4. Squeeze out excess water
5. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat
6. Add garlic and cook , stirring , until fragrant
7. Remove from heat , add the spinach , green onion , sesame seeds , and salt
8. Stir to combine
9. Let stand for about 10 minutes to allow the flavors to seep into the spinach
10. Erve warm or cold

title: grilled asparagus with barbecue butter   the neelys
steps:
1. Break off ends of asparagus
2. For the butter:
3. Mix rub into butter
4. Spread the butter mixture lengthwise across a piece of plastic wrap
5. Roll the butter up tightly into a log and twist the ends
6. Refrigerate
7. Preheat grill
8. If using a stovetop grill , use medium-high heat
9. Gently toss asparagus with seasoning , oil and salt and pepper , to taste
10. Grill asparagus until tender , turning once , about 6 minutes
11. Serve with barbecue butter

title: sachertorte cookies
steps:
1. Heat oven to 325
2. In large bowl combine 1 cup margarine and pudding mix
3. Beat until light and fluffy
4. Add egg
5. Blend well
6. Gradually add flour
7. Mix well
8. Shape dough into 1-inch balls
9. Roll in sugar
10. Place 2 inches apart on ungreased cookies sheets
11. With thumb , make indentation in center of each cookie
12. Bake at 325 for 15-18 minutes or until firm to the touch
13. Immediately remove from cookie sheets
14. Cool 15 minutes or until completely cooled
15. Fill each indentation with 1 / 2 teaspoon preserves
16. In small saucepan , melt chocolate chips and 3 tablespoons margarine over low heat , stirring until smooth
17. Drizzle glaze evenly over cookies

title: crescent asparagus squares
steps:
1. Unroll crescent rolls and press dough into ungreased 15x10 jelly roll pan , pressing to seal perforations
2. Bake on lower oven rack at 375 for 6 to 8 minutes or until lightly browned
3. Melt butter in skillet over medium-high heat , add onion and saute 5 minutes
4. Add minced garlic and saute 2 minutes
5. Break off tough ends of asparagus and cut into 1" pieces and reserve
6. Add asparagus to skillet , saute 4 to 6 minutes or until crisp tender
7. Add pepper and asparagus
8. Spoon asparagus mixture onto prepared baked crust
9. Sprinkle with cheeses and bake on lower oven rack at 375 for 6 to 8 minutes or until cheese melts
10. Cut into squares

title: bokke pootjes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Cream butter and sugar together
3. Add egg yolks and vanilla
4. Beat until smooth
5. To egg whites in a shallow bowl , add water and beat with a fork
6. Shape dough into 1 1 / 2 - 2-inch long fingers with stubby ends
7. My mom used to make them into little horseshoe shapes after she shaped them into the fingers
8. It gave them a neat appearance
9. Drop into egg whites
10. Roll in nuts
11. Bake for 14 - 16 minutes
12. Cool
13. While the cookies cool , melt the chocolate squares using whichever method you prefer
14. I usually use the microwave and stir every 15 seconds
15. You could melt it with a double boiler if you wish
16. Dip ends in melted chocolate
17. Set on waxed paper to allow chocolate to set up

title: ginger orange sauce or marinade
steps:
1. In a small saucepan , stir together marmalade , soy sauce , lemon juice , garlic , gingerroot , and salt and pepper to taste , bring to boil
2. Remove from heat and stir well
3. Let cool to room temperature if using as marinade

title: tay s hot and spicy salsa
steps:
1. Put everything but the tomatoes in a food processor
2. Chop until diced
3. Add the tomatoes
4. Serve with chips
5. Cook's
6. House seasoning:
7. 1 cup salt , 1 / 4 cup black pepper , 1 / 4 cup garlic powder
8. Mix ingredients together and store in an airtight container for up to 6 months

title: moonbeam cookies
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350
2. In large bowl , break up cookie dough , stir in coconut
3. Shape dough into 1 inch balls
4. Place two inches apart on ungreased cookie sheets
5. With thumb or handle of wooden spoon , make indentation in center of each cookie
6. Spoon 1 / 2 t
7. Lemon curd into each indentation
8. Bake 10-13 minutes or until edges are light golden brown
9. Immediately remove from cookie sheet to wire rack
10. Cool 5 minutes
11. In small microwave bowl , microwave chips on medium 2 minutes
12. Stir until smooth
13. Drizzle over cookies

title: my cardiologist s chili
steps:
1. Cook beef , onion and green peppers over medium heat until beef is well done and onion and peppers are soft
2. Strain all and run under hot water until beef loses oily feel when touched
3. Add remaining ingredients and bring to a boil
4. Reduce heat and simmer
5. Adjust seasonings to taste

title: orange crush pound cake
steps:
1. Cream shortening , margarine and sugar
2. Add eggs , 1 at a time , mixing well after each
3. Add orange crush , alternately with sifted flour
4. Add add flavorings
5. Put into greased and floured tube pan
6. Bake at 325 degrees for 1 hour and 10 minutes
7. Frosting: cream margarine and cream cheese add powdered sugar and flavorings
8. Spread over warm cake

title: spicy grilled pineapple
steps:
1. Heat the grill to high , brushing the grates with oil
2. Prepare pineapple by removing the tops and the skin
3. Slice into rounds , about 3 / 4 inch thick and remove the cores
4. In a small bowl , combine the olive oil , salt , and cayenne pepper
5. Brush pineapple slices with oil mixture
6. Place on grill , cover and cook 8-10 until charred and tender , turning once

title: stuffed eggplant
steps:
1. Cut the eggplant in half lengthwise and scoop out the flesh in the center until you have just a shell about 1 / 2-inch thick
2. Set the shells aside
3. Chop up the eggplant you scooped out into small pieces
4. Heat the oil in a frying pan , then add the chopped eggplant , onion , garlic , and pepper
5. Saute until the onion is clear and soft and the eggplant is cooked through
6. Add the tomato and basil or fresh herbs saute a few minutes longer
7. Add the breadcrumbs and about 1 / 2 cup of the cheese and stir well
8. The mixture should hold together well
9. If not , add a few more breadcrumbs and / or cheese
10. Scoop the stuffing mixture into the eggplant shells
11. Sprinkle with cheese
12. Bake at 350 degrees for about 15 - 25 minutes or until the cheese on top is melted
13. Enjoy !

title: dried apricot chipotle sandwich spread
steps:
1. Stir together the dried apricots , hot water , & lime juice
2. Let soak a full 15 minutes
3. Drain
4. Pat the apricots dry & chop finely
5. Stir in mayo , chipotle pepper , adobo sauce , & green onion
6. Cover & chill until time to serve
7. The next day i ended up whizzing everything in a mini chopper to make a fairly smooth spread to use on a turkey , swiss , & bacon wrap

title: egg tomato leftover rice
steps:
1. Heat oil , then scramble eggs until set
2. Add tomatoes and mix with eggs for 1 minute to steam
3. Add soy sauce
4. Cover and let steam for 1 minute
5. Mix in leftover rice
6. Add salt , pepper , chili sauce to taste

title: chicken asparagus soup
steps:
1. Pour broth or stock and wine in a large saucepan and bring to boiling
2. Wash herbs and tie in a bundle
3. Add to the saucepan
4. Add the whole garlic clove as well as asparagus and noodles
5. Cover and simmer 5 minutes
6. Stir in the chicken , salt , and white pepper
7. Remove the herbs and garlic from the pan and throw away
8. Ladel the soup into bowls and sprinkle leeks on top
9. Serve

title: healthy oatmeal raisin cookies  a k a  meag s perfect cookie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Cream together butter , applesauce and brown sugar
3. Add flax seed meal and vanilla
4. Mix in eggs , one at a time
5. Add flour , oats , salt , baking soda and cinnamon
6. Mix until fully incorporated then mix in raisins
7. Place spoonfuls onto cookie sheet and bake for 10-12 minutes

title: hungry girl carrot cake cupcakes  ww 2 points
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. In a medium bowl , combine all dry cupcake ingredients except for the carrots and raisins
3. Mix well and set aside
4. In a large bowl , mix together pumpkin , egg substitute , and 1 / 4 cup water until blended
5. Add the contents of the medium bowl to the large bowl
6. Using a wire whisk or fork , blend until just mixed
7. Then , stir in the carrots , pineapple , and raisins
8. Spray a 12-cup muffin pan with nonstick spray
9. Evenly distribute cake mixture among the cups , and place in the oven to cook for 20 - 25 minutes
10. While the cupcakes cook , combine all the frosting ingredients in a small bowl
11. Using a whisk or fork , blend until smooth
12. Place frosting in the fridge to chill
13. Once cupcakes are fully cooked , remove the pan from the oven and allow to cool completely
14. Then plate cupcakes , and spread frosting evenly over tops
15. Refrigerate until frosting has set and you're ready to serve

title: russian walnut cherry latkes with cherry applesauce
steps:
1. Place cherries in a bowl with enough hot water to cover
2. Soak until plump
3. Drain and set aside
4. Blend cheese , egg yolks and vanilla in a processor just until smooth - about 30 seconds
5. Add the flour , sugar and salt and mix in using on / off turns , just until blended
6. Transfer to a large bowl , and mix in the walnuts and reserved cherries
7. Using an electric mixer , beat the egg whites until stiff , but not dry
8. Gradually fold beaten eggs into batter , in three additions
9. Melt 1 tbs butter with 1 tbs oil in heavy large nonstick pan , until hot , but not smoking
10. Working in batches , drop batter by heaping tbs into skillet , and spread to 2 1 / 2-inch rounds
11. Cook until bottoms are golden
12. Then turn and cook until golden on other side
13. Using slotted spoon , transfer latkes to hot plates
14. Add more butter and oil as necessary , and allow to get hot before adding more batter
15. Serve with the applesauce
16. To make the sauce , combine apples and juice in saucepan
17. Bring to boil , stirring occasionally
18. Cover and reduce heat to low
19. Simmer for about 15 minutes until apples are tender
20. Remove from heat , and stir in cherry preserves
21. Mash with a fork to a chunky mixture
22. Can be made up to 2 days ahead

title: apricot wedgies
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , combine sugar cookie mix , melted butter , and egg
2. Stir until smooth
3. Cover and chill for 1 hour
4. Press into bottom of two lightly greased 8 inch round pans or one 9x13 inch pan
5. Combine apricot jam and lemon juice in a small bowl and microwave for 20-30 seconds to warm slightly
6. Stir well
7. Pour over crust and smooth to the edges
8. Chop walnuts and sprinkle over apricot mixture
9. Bake at 375 degrees for 25 minutes for 8" rounds and 35 minutes for 9x13" pan
10. (mixture will be bubbly all the way to the center and edges will look caramelized
11. Cool in pan on wire rack until completely cool
12. Run a knife around edge carefully to loosen the edges
13. If doing 2 rounds , cut each round into pie shaped wedges
14. For 9x13 pan , cut into bars or diamond shapes
15. Cover any leftover bars with plastic wrap so they don't dry out

title: saucy round steak for a crowd
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Cut steaks to serving sizes
3. Roll steak in flour , salt and pepper mixture
4. Brown steak in a fry pan with small amount of oil
5. Layer a large baking pan with meat then vegetables
6. Repeat until meat and vegetables are gone
7. Cover with the cans of soup
8. Bake several hours or until meat falls apart

title: classic fettuccine alfredo
steps:
1. Cook noodles in salted water according to package directions , approx 10-15 minutes
2. Drain well and place in a container large enough to allow enough room to toss slippery noodles without accident
3. Place over low heat or sterno
4. Add butter in several hunks to the noodles and stir gently until it melts and coats them well
5. Add the cream and stir in a generous amount of black pepper
6. Add the cheese , saving a small amount for later use on top of portions
7. Stir as mixture thickens and clings to noodles
8. Serve immediately
9. Pass the remaining cheese

title: almost no fat harvest pumpkin cinnamon rolls
steps:
1. Roll out dough to approximately 12 x 16
2. Spread with pumpkin butter , then applesauce
3. Sprinkle with flax seed , then with dried cranberries
4. Roll up as with regular cinnamon rolls
5. Slice into 12 slices and place in a round pan sprayed with nonstick spray
6. Bake in 400 degree oven for approximately 20 minutes
7. Take out of oven and let sit for about 5 minutes
8. In the meantime , mix together powdered sugar , pumpkin butter & orange juice in a bowl
9. Drizzle or spread over rolls
10. It will seem like there is too much , but let it sit for a few minutes and soak into the rolls
11. Serve warm

title: penne with sausage and broccoli
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to package directions , adding broccoli during last 5 minutes of cooking time
2. Drain , reserving 1 cup cooking water
3. Meanwhile , heat 12-inch nonstick skillet over meidum-high heat
4. Add sausage , cook , turning occasionally , until no longer pink , 20 minutes
5. Remove sausage
6. Discard all but 1 t fat from skillet
7. In same skillet over medium heat , cook garlic , stirring 1 minute
8. Add pasta mixture , sausage , reserved water , 1 / 2 t salt and pepper flakes , heat through , 2 minutes
9. Remove from heat
10. Stir in cheese

title: chickpea and vegetable curry
steps:
1. Heat a non-stick pan and fry onions in a little bit of stock or water until soft
2. Add garlic and curry powder
3. Cook for 1 minute then add the remaining stock , chickpeas , cauliflower and broccoli
4. Cover and simmer for 10-15 minutes , until tender
5. Add spinach leaves , tomatoes , tofu and miso
6. Heat through until spinach is wilted and tofu is warmed through
7. Serve !

title: tomato jelly
steps:
1. Boil toomato juice if making spicy
2. You can add the spices in a boil bag or use ground
3. Add lemon juice and fine zest
4. Stir in pectin
5. Bring to a boil
6. Stir in sugar until dissolve
7. Bring to a rolling boil
8. Boil 4 minutes
9. If making hot jelly add tabasco now
10. Let stand a minute
11. Skim
12. Pour into jars

title: cane s special sauce
steps:
1. Mix mayonnaise , ketchup , garlic salt , worcestershire sauce , pepper , and paprika together
2. Refrigerate before using

title: peas amandine
steps:
1. Cook peas according to package directions and drain , set aside and keep hot
2. Saute almonds in butter until lightly browned and add to peas
3. Saute mushrooms , onions , salt and pepper in same pan until onions are tender and add to peas
4. Mix to combine

title: cherry cordial hot chocolate
steps:
1. Heat the milk , half-and-half , chocolate syrup , and 7 tablespoons cherry juice in a large pan over medium-low heat , stirring frequently
2. Beat whipping cream using an electric mixer on medium speed until foamy
3. Gradually add powdered sugar and remaining cherry juice
4. Beat until soft peaks form
5. Pour hot chocolate into mugs and serve with whipped cream on top
6. Garnish with a cherry

title: my kickin  pasta fagioli soup
steps:
1. You will need a big soup pot for this recipe , i often end up with my pot to full and have to divide it up mid way -- be smart choose a big pot
2. Chop fresh vegetables into soup sized chunks , this will vary depending on how you like your soup
3. I cut carrot dollars and big chunks of onion
4. Heat oil in the soup pot over medium / high heat
5. Brown sausage with onions , garlic , celery , and carrots
6. When the sausage is evenly browned and the vegetables are slightly softened add the chicken bullion , tomato paste and spices
7. Stir in and let the pastiness of the tomato paste cook out for a couple minutes
8. Add the beans , corn and tomatoes , don't drain the juices from the tomatoes just add it
9. Add liquid
10. Add as much liquid as you desire to your soup depending on the heartiness desired
11. Bring to a boil
12. Reduce heat and allow to simmer for awhile
13. You can serve immediately
14. Add cooked macaroni noodles and parmesan cheese to serve

title: cheesy potato corn chowder
steps:
1. In 5- quart dutch oven , place potatoes
2. Add just enough water to cover
3. Heat to boiling
4. Reduce heat
5. Cover and simmer 10-15 minutes or until potatoes are very tender
6. Drain
7. Reserve 1 cup potatoes
8. Return remaining potatoes to saucepan
9. In small bowl , mash reserved potatoes with fork
10. Return to saucepan
11. Stir in broth , garlic , salt and pepper
12. Heat to boiling
13. Reduce heat to medium
14. Cook uncovered 2 minutes
15. In small bowl , stir flour into milk with wire whisk until well mixed
16. Add milk mixture to potato mixture , stirring constantly
17. Cook over medium heat , stirring frequently , until mixture thickens and boils
18. Stir in cheese and corn until cheese is melted
19. To serve , ladle chowder into bowls
20. Top with scallions

title: bergy s pork tenderloin with black beans
steps:
1. Heat oil in wok
2. Stir fry the pork with the garlic until the pork is cooked and nicely browned , remove from wok you may need to spray the wok with a little oil
3. Add carrots ans saut until ala dente remove and put them with the pork
4. Saut the mushrooms& onion until the onion is translucent
5. Add tomatoes and black beans
6. Combine hot sauce , hoisin and ginger
7. Add to the wok
8. Return the pork and carrots to the wok
9. Add enough beer so there is some sauce but not swimming
10. Add broccoli
11. Cover and steam for 3 minutes
12. Meanwhile cook the ramen noodles
13. Serve pork mixture over the noodles

title: new potatoes with lemon butter
steps:
1. Scrub potatoes
2. Pare a thin strip of skin about 1 / 2" wide around centre of each potato
3. Add boiling water to a depth of 2 inches , and 1 / 2 tsp salt
4. Bring to a boil
5. Cover and boil gently for about 20 minutes or until potatoes are tender
6. Drain off water
7. Return to heat for a short time to dry them off
8. Melt butter
9. Stir in lemon juice , chives , and 1 / 4 teaspoons salt
10. Pour over potatoes , turning them to coat with the butter

title: vegan sun dried tomato sauce  for pizza or pasta
steps:
1. Place first three ingredients into food processor and "chop" roughly
2. Set aside
3. Boil tomatoes in water in a shallow pan
4. When tomatoes have softened , add them and any remaining liquid to the food processor and puree
5. Add remaining 5 ingredients to tomato puree and stir
6. Pour garlic-onion mixture into processor with tomato and puree to desired consistancy
7. This makes a thick , rich and slightly spicy sauce !

title: honey pineapple glazed ham
steps:
1. Bake ham in a roasting pan at 350 for 1-1 / 2 hours
2. In small saucepan , mix brown sugar , cornstarch and salt
3. Stir in pineapple , honey and mustard
4. Cook over medium heat , stirring constantly , until mixture thickens and boils
5. Boil and stir 1 minute
6. Brush sauce over ham and bake 30 minutes , basting once or twice during cooking time
7. Brush sauce over ham before serving
8. Yield: 12 servings

title: coconut macaroons for pesach or any time
steps:
1. Beat egg whites& lemon juice till frothy
2. Gradually add sugar& vanilla sugar& beat till stiff
3. Carefully fold in honey , potato starch& coconut
4. Drop from tablespoon onto greased baking sheet
5. Bake in 325 oven for 20 minutes till edges are light brown

title: chicken satay with spicy peanut sauce
steps:
1. Cut chicken into chunks if thighs strips if breasts
2. Combine with remaining ingredients and leave to marinate in refrigerator anywhere from 1-12 hours
3. Satay sauce- heat oils in small saucepan , add onion , garlic , ginger and saute over med heat until softened
4. Add vinegar , sugar and continue to cook until sugar dissolves
5. Remove from heat and stir in remaining ingredients
6. Adjust seasoning to your taste
7. Can also be put in a food processor for a completely smooth sauce
8. To serve- preheat oven to 375
9. Thread chicken onto skewers and arrange on baking sheets
10. Bake for 5- 10 minutes or until just cooked
11. Serve with satay sauce
12. Substitute beef , lamb , shrimp , pork or scallops
13. If sauce gets to thick if made in advance thin with hot water

title: swedish ginger cookies
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f
2. Melt the butter or margarine in a small saucepan
3. Turn the heat off when melted and add lemon juice and syrup
4. Whip the cream in a small bowl
5. In a large bowl , sift flour , baking soda and ginger powder
6. Mix in sugar
7. Add butter / syrup and whipped cream to the sifted flour
8. Mix well with a wooden spoon
9. Place a piece of parchment paper on a baking sheet
10. Make , with your hands , little round balls , about one inch in diameter
11. Place the balls on the baking sheet flattening slightly
12. Do not place them too close to each other as they spread
13. Bake for about 12 minutes , they should still be a bit soft in the center as they harden when they cool

title: red claw biloela style
steps:
1. With a sharp small knife , cut almost right thru the red claw tail and then crack the tail open
2. If the claws are big enough , hit them lightly with a mallet to break the shell
3. Combine the rest of the ingredients and heat till the butter has melted , stir well
4. Put the claws in a container ,
5. Pour a teaspoon of the mix into each cut in your red claw tails , and put on top of the claws
6. Continue until all the claws are coated
7. Pour the rest of the marinade over the top , and leave for 2 or 3 hours
8. Heat a heavy pan and spray with oil
9. When hot , place tails , shell side down , in the pan
10. Move them around , and after 5 mins , turn them over
11. Put the claws on top , and pour over the leftover marinade
12. Swirl the container with cup water , and add to the pan
13. Cover and turn down the heat
14. Check every few minutes
15. Serve with any leftover sauce poured over , serve with bread to mop it up !

title: fruit salad  ww
steps:
1. In a saucepan over medium heat combine first six ingredients and bring to a boil
2. Cook 5 minutes until syrup is reduced to about 1 / 2 cup , whisking constantly
3. Remove from heat
4. Cool
5. Stir in lime and orange zest
6. In a large bowl combine the fruit
7. Pour syrup over fruit and toss
8. Cover and chill for at least 1 hour

title: pudgy fudgy squares
steps:
1. Put peanut butter , chocolate chips , and butter in a 3-quart microwave safe bowl
2. Microwave uncovered on med-high 2 minutes or until butter melts and chips look soft and glossy , but still retain their shape
3. Stir until smooth , and then stir in marshmallows
4. Micro on med-high 30 seconds , marshmallows will be slightly melted
5. Stir to mix , then stir in cereal until well blended
6. Scrape into greased 8 or 9 inch pan , spread evenly
7. Refrigerate 2-3 hours until firm
8. Cut into squares

title: healthy  whole wheat carrot applesauce muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Line muffin pan with paper , foil , or silicone liners , and set aside
3. In a medium bowl , whisk together flour , baking soda , cinnamon , ginger , and salt
4. In a large bowl fitted with an electric whisk , mix the butter , honey , egg , and vanilla together on medium speed
5. Turn down the speed and slowly add in the flour mixture until well-combined
6. The batter will be fairly thick
7. 4
8. Using a spatula , carefully fold in applesauce and carrots
9. Divide batter evenly among the muffin cups
10. Bake for 22 to 24 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean and muffins are beginning to turn golden brown on top

title: tuna  red onion  and parsley salad
steps:
1. Using a fork first four ingredients in medium bowl to blend
2. Mix in celery , onion , and chopped parsley
3. Stir in tuna
4. Season salad with salt and pepper
5. Cover and refrigerate
6. Chill for a minimum of 30 minutes to let the flavors blend
7. Can be prepared up to 6 hours ahead

title: ambrosia fruit salad
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine sweetened condensed milk , sour cream & lime juice
2. Mix well
3. Stir in the remaining ingredients
4. Cover & chill at least 3 hours or overnight
5. To prevent cherries from "bleeding" , fold them gently into the salad just before serving , and top with chopped nuts if desired
6. Salad may also be frozen and served like ice cream

title: beans and biscuits
steps:
1. In a skillet , cook ground beef , onions , garlic and green pepper over medium heat until meat is no longer pink
2. Drain
3. Add the beans , barbecue sauce , brown sugar , ketchup and mustard
4. Simmer for 5 minutes or until heated through
5. Transfer to a greased 11-in
6. X 7-in
7. X 2-in
8. Baking dish
9. Separate biscuits and cut in half
10. Arrange over beef mixture
11. Bake , uncovered , at 400 for 18 minutes or until biscuits are golden
12. Sprinkle with cheese
13. Bake 2-3 minutes longer or until cheese is melted

title: summer vegetable pasta salad
steps:
1. Boil dried pasta under a rapid boil for approximately 10 minutes , or until pasta is just tender
2. Chop up your vegetables and mix with olive oil , vinegar , and seasonings
3. Other vegetables can be used in addition to or instead of the ones listed , though those are my favorites
4. Some other ideas include yellow or red bell pepper , zucchini , cucumber , fennel etc
5. Once pasta is done drain and rinse with cool water
6. Mix pasta with vegetables and mayonnaise if using
7. The pasta is great with or without
8. Taste and adjust seasonings to your liking
9. Add parsley and avocado on top if you like
10. The longer this sits in the refrigerator the better it is , but it's great fresh as well
11. It's great to make extra of this and leave out mayo and avocado
12. If i feel like eating my pasta with mayo or avocado , i just add it to my serving
13. This way the pasta will keep in the refrigerator for a few days no problem
14. It makes great left overs to bring to work for lunch

title: venison   kabobs
steps:
1. Cut venison into 2" cubes and place in heavy duty plastic bag
2. Add a generous helping of cleaned whole mushrooms to the bag
3. Mix first 6 ingredients and pour over venison and mushrooms
4. Refrigerate for several hours
5. Place meat on skewers , alternate with mushrooms and quarters of bell peppers , onions and cherry tomatoes
6. Cook over a grill at low heat--be careful not to overcook
7. Serve on a bed of wild rice

title: heavenly chocolate chip cookies
steps:
1. Add all ingredients
2. If you don't want oatmeal , do 6 cups flour
3. Beat for 5 minutes
4. Add chocolate chips
5. Mix
6. Drop by spoonfuls onto cookie sheet
7. Bake at 350f for 10 minutes
8. - if sticky add more flour

title: peanut butter macaroons
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325
2. In saucepan , melt peanut butter over very low heat and cool slightly
3. Beat egg whites , vanilla , and salt till soft peaks form
4. Gradually add sugar , beating to stiff peaks
5. Fold in coconut and melted peanut butter
6. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheet
7. Bake in 325 oven for 20 minutes
8. Let stand 1 minute , then remove to wire rack to cool

title: ultimate turtle cookie bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Using electric mixer , in a medium bowl , cream butter , brown and white sugars , then egg and vanilla
3. In another bowl , stir together , flour , baking soda and salt
4. Mix well
5. Add dry ingredients to wet ingredients and mix well until a soft dough forms
6. Stir in 3 / 4 cup of chocolate chips and 1 / 2 cup of coarsely chopped pecans
7. Mix until chocolate chips and chopped pecans are evenly distributed in cookie dough
8. Press cookie dough evenly into bottom of an ungreased , 8-inch square baking pan
9. Bake 28 to 33 minutes or until golden brown
10. Remove from oven
11. Meanwhile , in a 1-quart saucepan on stove top , heat 24 caramels and 1 tbs milk over low heat , stirring frequently , until melted and smooth
12. Remove from heat
13. Carefully spread melted caramels evenly over warm cookie bars and sprinkle with pecan halves
14. Cool completely on cooling rack , about 1 hour
15. In small microwavable bowl , microwave 1 / 4 cup of semisweet chocolate chips and 1 tsp shortening uncovered on high 30 to 60 seconds , stirring every 15 seconds , until melted and smooth
16. Drizzle over cookie bars
17. Let stand about 30 minutes or until chocolate is set
18. For bars , cut into 4 rows by 4 rows

title: sweet cornbread shrimp cakes with mango salsa
steps:
1. Bake cornbread mix according to package directions , using milk and 1 egg
2. Cool and crumble
3. Stir together salsa ingredients
4. Allow to sit for 30 minutes
5. Serve or refrigerate until serving time
6. Heat 2 tablespoons butter over medium heat in 12-inch cast iron skillet
7. Cook celery and 1 / 2 cup chopped red onion until tender , about 6 to 8 minutes , stirring occasionally
8. Transfer celery and onion to large bowl
9. Stir in shrimp , seafood seasoning , 2 eggs , mayonnaise , 1 / 3 cup cilantro , salt and pepper
10. Stir in crumbled cornbread until well blended
11. Using about 1 / 3 cup , form mixture into 12 shrimp cakes about 2 1 / 2-inches diameter
12. Place on a parchment or wax paper-lined baking sheet
13. Heat 1 to 2 tablespoons butter in skillet over medium heat
14. Cook shrimp cakes until lightly browned and shrimp turn pink , about 4 minutes on each side
15. Cook remaining shrimp cakes , adding additional butter as needed
16. Place cakes on a serving platter
17. Garnish with lemon wedges and parsley
18. Serve with mango salsa

title: english cottage pie
steps:
1. Cook potatoes in boiling salted water
2. Preheat oven to 375 thinly slice onions
3. Heat dripping in a fry pan and fry onions until transparent
4. Add beef and fry until browned
5. Sprinkle in the flour and cook , stirring for 1 minute
6. Slowly add stock and bring to a boil stirring constantly
7. Add tomatoes with juice , s& p and frozen veg
8. Simmer for 5 min
9. Spoon cooked mixture into a casserole dish and spread on the mashed spuds
10. Bake for 30 min

title: volcano shrimp
steps:
1. Wash broccoli , remove and discard the stems
2. Cut the florets into small bite-sized pieces , about 2 inches in length
3. Place on a plate and set aside
4. Beat the egg whites and water together in a small bowl
5. Combine the cornstarch and flour in another bowl
6. Season to taste with salt and white pepper
7. Heat a deep pan or fryer with 3 inches of vegetable oil to a temperature of 375 degrees
8. Meanwhile , dip the shrimp into the egg whites and then coat completely with the cornstarch flour mixture
9. Lay the shrimp out in a single layer on a sheet lined with waxed paper
10. Test oil by dropping in a few drops of cold water
11. If it quickly sizzles and pops , you're ready
12. Deep fry the shrimp , no more than 8 at a time , in the hot oil
13. When crisp and golden , transfer to absorbent paper to drain
14. It is important that the oil maintain a constant temperature of 350 degrees
15. Place the garlic , ginger , pepper flakes , and chopped garlic on a tray with the cup of wine
16. Place the hoisin sauce , honey , tomato paste , oyster sauce , chicken stock , vinegar and cornstarch in a small bowl
17. Have all these ingredients ready and near the stove for the quick action that will be required after stir-frying the broccoli
18. Heat a wok or large frying pan over a high flame
19. Add the peanut oil and swirl to coat the bottom
20. Quickly stir-fry the broccoli
21. In stir frying , keep the contents of the wok in constant motion , using a metal spatula or wooden spoon
22. This prevents browning and provides fast cooking
23. When the broccoli is bright green , after 1 minute , add 1 / 4 cup water and cover for 30 seconds
24. Make a ring of the broccoli around the edge of a platter and keep warm
25. Return the wok to the high flame
26. Add an additional tablespoon of peanut oil and cook the ginger , red pepper , and garlic
27. After 30 seconds add the white wine and reduce
28. Add the remaining sauce ingredients and bring to a boil
29. Taste and adjust seasonings , if necessary
30. You may also want to balance the flavors with additional honey or vinegar
31. When sauce becomes clear and thickens slightly , stir in the shrimp
32. Toss gently to coat
33. Add the scallions and pile the volcano shrimp in a mound in the center of the round platter with the broccoli
34. Serve immediately with steaming white or brown rice

title: tex mex rice and two bean pilaf
steps:
1. In a medium deep-sided skillet with a lid , heat the oil over medium heat
2. Add the onion and cook , stirring until softened , about 3 minutes
3. Add the rice and garlic and cook , stirring , about 2 minutes
4. Add the water , lentils , pinto beans , corn , salsa , chili powder , cumin , salt and pepper
5. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat stirring occasionally
6. Reduce the heat , cover , and simmer until the rice has absorbed most of the liquid , about 20 minutes
7. Serve immediately

title: best mini m m cookies
steps:
1. Cream the butter , shortening , sugar and brown sugar together
2. When light in color add the eggs and vanilla mix well
3. Next slowly add the dry ingredients
4. Once mixed stir in the nuts and m&ms
5. Drop by teaspoons onto baking sheets
6. Bake at 375 degrees for 8 - 10 minutes
7. Let cool slightly then transfer to cooling racks

title: grilled pork tenderloin with spicy peach glaze
steps:
1. Heat the grill to medium hot
2. In a medium mixing bowl , combine the preserves , garlic , olive oil , soy sauce , dry mustard , cayenne pepper , salt and black pepper , and mix well to combine
3. Sprinkle the tenderloins with additional salt and pepper and place on the grill
4. Cook about 10 minutes on each side before brushing the upturned side with the glaze
5. Continue cooking for another 10 to 12 minutes , turning every 3 to 5 minutes and brushing each upturned side with glaze every time , until the meat is cooked through
6. Move the pork to a cooler part of the grill if it starts to get too dark before it is cooked through
7. Place the peach halves on the grill , cut-side down , and grill 2 minutes
8. Turn , and brush the tops with the glaze
9. Grill 3 ro 5 minutes more , until the peaches are soft and the cavities fill with juices
10. Transfer the cooked pork and peaches to a serving plate & serve immediately

title: oatmeal blueberry cookies
steps:
1. Mix dry ingredients together and set aside
2. Cream butter and sugars
3. Add egg and honey , mix well
4. Stir in dry ingredients
5. Stir in blueberries
6. Drop by rounded teaspoons on parchment lined cookie sheets
7. Bake at 350 for about 8-10 minutes , until golden on the edges and just set
8. Cook them too long and they will be hard and they are better chewy
9. Cool on racks , store airtight

title: easy double layer pumpkin spice pie
steps:
1. Beat cream cheese , 1 tablespoon milk and the sugar in a large bowl with wire whisk until well blended
2. Gently stir in 1 cup of the cool whip
3. Spread onto bottom of crust
4. Pour milk into large bowl
5. Add dry pudding mixes
6. Beat with wire whisk 2 minutes or until well blended
7. Mixture will be thick
8. Spread over cream cheese layer in crust and refrigerate for 4 hours or until set
9. Top with the rest of the cool whip before serving

title: peanut butter haystacks
steps:
1. Melt butterscotch chips and peanut butter on top of a double boiler , or in a microwave
2. Blend together
3. Stir peanuts and noodles gently into the melted peanut butter mixture
4. Drop dough by forkfuls onto waxed paper
5. Cool until set

title: caramelized onion soup with pear and stilton
steps:
1. Melt butter and olive oil in large pot
2. Add diced onion and cook over medium heat until well browned and caramelized
3. Core , peel and dice pear
4. Add to onions , stirring until lightly browned
5. Add potatoes and chicken broth
6. Simmer , covered , until potatoes are tender
7. Puree with an immersion blender
8. Add milk and 1 1 / 2 ounces of stilton
9. Heat through
10. Serve garnished with remaining stilton crumbled on top

title: banana split  layered shot
steps:
1. Layer ingredients in the order listed
2. Layering is achieved by slowly pouring the liquid over the back of a spoon so that it sits on top of the next ingredient
3. There is more information and video how-to links in the beverage forum in this thread:

title: crock pot oatmeal apple crisp recipe
steps:
1. Mix apples and pineapple tidbits in buttered crock pot
2. To the reserved pineapple juice , add orange marmalade , maple syrup , apple cider and curry powder
3. Stir and pour over apple mixture
4. Cover and cook on high for 1 hour
5. To make topping: combine flour , oats , brown sugar and cinnamon in bowl
6. Cut in butter until mixture is crumbly
7. Spread topping over apples
8. Cook on low 2 1 / 2 to 3 hours until done
9. Let cool 10 minutes before serving

title: scalloped spiced apples
steps:
1. Toss apples with sugar and spices
2. In skillet , melt butter
3. Add bread crumbs , stirring until crispy and slightly brown
4. Place the apple mixture in a greased 8" pan , then put the crumbs evenly on top
5. Bake , uncovered , for 45 minutes or until apples are tender
6. Check after 20 minutes
7. If crumbs are getting too brown , cover with foil

title: apricot  mango and blueberry smoothie
steps:
1. Place ingredients in a blender & use the on / off pulse function to mix until mostly blended
2. Gradually increase the speed & continue mixing until smooth
3. Pour into 2 glasses & enjoy !

title: fruit salad with pudding
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine peaches , pineapples , and vanilla pudding mix
2. This includes the juices from the cans
3. Mix well until pudding is dissolved
4. Stir in strawberries , banana , blueberries , grapes , and sugar if desired
5. Chill

title: chicken cordon bleu crepes
steps:
1. In a bowl , whisk flour , eggs and milk until smooth
2. Cover and refrigerate 1 hour
3. Heat a lightly greased 7" skillet
4. Pour 2-2
5. 5 tbs batter in center of skillet
6. Tilt to coat bottom of pan
7. Cook until top appears dry
8. Turn and cook 15-20 seconds longer
9. Remove to a plate and repeat
10. Sprinkle chicken , ham and swiss cheese over crepes
11. Roll up tightly and place seam side down in greased 9x13" baking dish
12. For sauce: in a small sauce pan , melt butter
13. Stir in flour until blended
14. Gradually whisk in both broth & milk and bring to a boil
15. Cook and stir 1-2 minutes until thickened
16. Remove from heat
17. Stir in swiss cheese and ham and stir until cheese is melted
18. Pour 1 cup sauce over the crepes
19. Bake uncovered at 350 degrees for 15-20 minutes
20. Serve with remaining sauce

title: raspberry lemon streusel coffee cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Beat egg in large bowl
3. Add 1 / 2 cup sugar , milk , apple sauce , lemon juice , 2 tsp lemon zest , and almond extract
4. Mix thoroughly
5. Add 1 cup flour , baking powder and salt
6. Stir , being careful not to overmix
7. Pour into greased 8x8 pan
8. Add berries over batter
9. Mix remaining 1 / 2 cup flour , 3 tbs sugar , 1 tsp lemon zest
10. Cut in butter
11. Sprinkle mixture over berries
12. Bake 25 to 30 minutes
13. Enjoy !

title: baked cheeseburger casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180c
2. Spread the butter on both sides of the toasted bread , cut the slices in half diagonally , and set aside
3. Heat a medium sized , heavy frying pan over a moderate heat
4. Add the beef , onion , celery , prepared mustard and 1 / 2 tsp of the salt
5. Cook , stirring occasionally , until the beef has browned - around 5 minutes
6. In a greased shallow casserole dish , place alternate layers of toast , beef mixture , then cheese
7. In a small bowl , beat the egg , then stir in the milk , dry mustard and the remaining salt
8. Pour this mix over the casserole
9. Sprinkle with the paprika , bake for 25 minutes , and serve

title: ruby tuesday s waldorf salad
steps:
1. Combine sour cream , mayonnaise , sugar , and lemon juice in a medium bowl and whisk until sugar is dissolved
2. Add remaining ingredients and stir
3. Store the salad in a sealed container in your refrigerator for 3 to 4 hours
4. Serve cold

title: cream cheese dainties
steps:
1. In a large mixing bowl , cream the butter and cream cheese
2. Gradually add flour to the creamed mixture
3. Divide dough into four portions
4. Cover and refrigerate until easy to handle
5. On a lightly floured surface , roll one portion of dough at a time into a 10-in
6. X 7-1 / 2-in
7. Rectangle
8. Trim edges if necessary
9. Cut into 2-1 / 2-in
10. Squares
11. Place 1 / 4 teaspoon spreadable fruit or preserves near each end of two diagonal corners
12. Moisten the remaining two corners with water
13. Fold over and press lightly
14. Place on ungreased baking sheets
15. Bake at 350 for 12-15 minutes or until corners are lightly browned
16. Cool 2-3 minutes before removing to wire racks to cool
17. Yield: 4 dozen

title: sweet and sour jelly meatballs aka jelly meatballs
steps:
1. Put all the ingredients but meatballs into the crockpot and mix well
2. Add the meatballs and stir to coat well
3. Put the crockpot on low and let cook for 4 hours on low
4. Serve , standing back so you don't get trampled by the rush of the crowd
5. Also , you can use lil smokies or sliced smoked sausage instead of the meatballs - a lot of folks use the same sauce for either and both ways are tasty ! :)
6. I've found that having a lot of sauce is of real benefit when making meatballs in the crockpot - the meat remains nice and moist

title: mom s thanksgiving sweet potato pineapple balls
steps:
1. Drain the yams and the pineapple very well
2. Mash the yams and pineapple in a large bowl with your hands or a masher
3. Roll into baseball size balls and cover in the corn flakes
4. They look nice with the flakes sticking up
5. For those who like marshmallows , place a marshmallow or use some mini marshmallows , placed in the center of the ball and then cover with the corn flakes
6. Or indent and add marshmallows
7. Chill balls in the refrigerator to firm up
8. Place balls on a foil lined cookie sheet and bake , at 350 , to heat through and until cereal starts to brown
9. About 25 minutes
10. Easy to serve with a spatula
11. Since a "ball" is a portion and you can adjust the size of the balls based on how many guests you have !

title: scalloped potatoes extraordinaire  crock pot
steps:
1. Spray a slow cooker with nonstick cooking spray
2. Place potatoes , onion , mushroom soup and vaporated skim milk into slow cooker
3. Stir in cheddar cheese , pimiento and black pepper
4. Cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours
5. Mix gently before serving

title: piquant crab and eggplant  aubergine   dressing
steps:
1. Melt the butter in a dutch oven or other large heavy pot
2. Add onions , peppers and celery
3. Cook until the vegetables are very soft , stirring occasionally , about 30 minutes
4. Meanwhile , peel the eggplants and cut into 1-inch cubes
5. Place them in a pot and cover with water
6. Bring to boil and boil slowly for a few minutes , just until they are tender
7. Drain well and puree until smooth in a food processor or blender
8. Add the eggplant puree , seasonings , herbs and the juice from the canned crab to the vegetable mixture , return to simmer and cook over medium heat for 10 minutes , stirring occasionally
9. Add the crab meat and cook just long enough to heat through
10. Remove from heat
11. Stir in the green onions and the parsley
12. Spoon the hot mixture into a casserole or individual ramekins , if desired
13. Sprinkle generously with parmesan cheese and bread crumbs
14. Place under broiler just long enough for cheese to melt , and serve immediately

title: super moist fresh apple cake
steps:
1. Cream together the eggs , oil and sugar
2. In a separate bowl , sift the flour , salt and baking soda
3. Combine all
4. Now add your nuts , vanilla and apples
5. When the apples cook they add plenty of moisture to the cake to make it moist
6. Plus , your going to add more moisture when your glaze soaks inches
7. Pour into a greased and floured 9 x 13 cake pan
8. Bake at 350 for 45 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean from the center of the cake
9. In a sauce pan , combine your glaze ingredients and boil for a few minutes
10. Set aside
11. When cake is done , puncture the top of cake with a fork , quite a bit
12. Pour on your glaze

title: batter fried chicken wings
steps:
1. Cut wings at first joint and discard the
2. Cut remaining wings in half
3. Wash and dry on paper towels and sprinkle lightly with garlic salt
4. Mix cornstarch , eggs , hot sauce and water , stirring to form a smooth batter
5. Dip wings in batter and deep fry in 1 1 / 2" of oil heated to 350 for about 15 minutes , turning once or twice
6. Serve with small bowl of mild , medium or hot wing sauce for dipping

title: autumn chicken and butternut squash stew
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large dutch oven
2. Add chicken and brown about 15 to 20 minutes
3. Remove chicken and add onion , garlic and celery to pan
4. Saut on medium heat about 5 minutes
5. Return chicken to the pan with vegetables
6. Add tomatoes , chicken broth , wine , salt , pepper , sage , thyme and bring to a boil
7. Simmer about 45 minutes to 1 hour
8. Add squash , bring to boil and simmer 30 minutes or until squash is tender
9. Stir in frozen peas and reheat for a minute or two
10. As a short cut , you can use boneless , skinless breasts , or if you like dark meat , substitute chicken thighs for some or all of the chicken breasts

title: mushroom paprikas or paprikas gomba
steps:
1. Heat oil in a skillet
2. Add onion and cook until soft
3. Add mushrooms and season with salt , pepper and paprika
4. Cook 10 to 15 minutes over medium heat until mushrooms are soft
5. Combine broth , flour and sour cream
6. Pour into mushroom mixture in pan and cook gently until slightly thickened
7. Serve over egg noodles

title: pretzel fried chicken
steps:
1. Dry the chicken pieces with paper towel
2. Mix the eggs and milk well
3. Place the pretzel crumbs in a bag
4. Dip each piece of chicken in egg-milk mixture
5. Then place in bag and coat well
6. Drop into 350f vegetable oil and fry till golden brown
7. Place the chicken pieces on foil in a large baking pan and bake in 300f oven for 35 minutes
8. Serve hot

title: roasted shrimp and broccoli
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425f
2. Microwave broccoli florets for 1-2 minutes
3. Immediately arrange broccoli florets in a single layer on a jelly-roll pan coated with cooking spray
4. Combine 1 1 / 2 teaspoons lemon rind , juice , 1 / 4 teaspoon salt , 1 / 4 teaspoon black pepper , and minced garlic in a medium bowl
5. Add shrimp
6. Toss to combine
7. Arrange shrimp among the broccoli florets already in a single layer on the jelly-roll pan
8. Roast at 425 for 8 minutes , or until shrimp is done
9. Combine oil , remaining 1 1 / 2 teaspoons rind , remaining 1 / 4 teaspoon salt , remaining 1 / 4 teaspoon black pepper , and crushed red pepper in a large bowl
10. Add roasted broccoli and shrimp
11. Toss to combine
12. Serve immediately with optional lemon wedges

title: mapled pork chops
steps:
1. Preheat your oven to 350 degrees
2. Lightly brown the pork chops in a skillet
3. Arrange the chops in an even layer in a baking dish
4. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over the chops
5. Cover and bake for 1 hour , basting occasionally
6. Remove the covering and continue baking for 15 minutes more
7. You may thicken the sauce if you desire with a little cornstarch / water mixture

title: kale and parsnips
steps:
1. Saute the onions and parsnips in oil for about 5 minutes , stirring occasionally to prevent burning
2. Add the water and ginger
3. Cover and simer for 4 to 5 minutes
4. Add the kale and continue cooking 4 to 5 minutes longer
5. Stir occasionally but keep the saucepan covered otherwise
6. Serve hot

title: pork chops and stuffing
steps:
1. Brown pork chops
2. While pork chops are browning , mix together bread crumbs , poultry seasoning , melted butter , diced onion , and 1 / 4 cup water in large bowl
3. Mix well and set aside
4. In another bowl , mix cream of mushroom soup and 1 / 3 cup water
5. Mix well
6. Place browned pork chops in baking dish
7. Cover pork chops and stuffing mix with topping
8. Cover with foil
9. Bake at 350f for 1 hour

title: easy wilted spinach salad
steps:
1. Cook the onions untill translucent in the olive oil
2. Add garlic and cook for an additional 2 minutes
3. Add the baslamic vinegar
4. Bring to a boil and reduce to 1 / 2 origional
5. Add spinach leaves and cook untill wilted
6. Move spinach to serving bowl
7. Roast pine nuts over medium heat
8. Add pine nuts and dried crainberries to spinach and mix
9. Serve warm

title: french toast with caramelized pecans  strawberries and cream
steps:
1. In a food processor , blend together heavy cream , cream cheese and 1 tablespoon sugar until thick and creamy
2. In a baking dish , whisk together eggs , milk , cinnamon and remaining 2 tablespoons sugar
3. Place bread slices in pan and soak on each side until well coated and soaked through
4. In a large skillet or griddle over medium heat , melt 1 tablespoon butter
5. Remove and drain the bread slices and cook until golden turning once , about 5 to 7 minutes
6. Meanwhile , in a skillet over medium heat , add the pecans , brown sugar and 2 tablespoons butter
7. Stir until sugar has melted and pecans are coated and sticky
8. Serve french toast with dollop of cream , sticky pecans and strawberries

title: grilled chicken w andouille pumpkin relish
steps:
1. Sautee' andoulle sausage to expell oils
2. Add pumpkin , red pepper , zucchini , corn , just under being tender
3. Add cumin , sliced ginger' and brown sugar
4. Sautee 3 minutes
5. Set aside warm
6. Grill or bake chicken breasts until done
7. Place mound of relish on plate
8. Place more relish on top
9. Garnish with oriental snack peas

title: low carb cauliflower hash browns
steps:
1. Chop the cauliflower into tiny pieces
2. Grating it is also a good idea but a bit messier
3. Once the cauliflower is chopped , scramble the egg into a separate container and beat well
4. Combine the egg , cauliflower , salt and pepper forming into several patties
5. Depending on the size of your cauliflower you will be able to make different numbers of patties
6. Heat the griddle or pan to med high heat as to properly sear the "hash browns"
7. Cook for about 5 min or until dark brown
8. Serve with ketchup or plain and enjoy !

title: good  n easy macaroni salad
steps:
1. Follow the directions for cooking the macaroni on the package
2. Drain pasta and rinse with cold water
3. While the pasta is cooking , cut up the onions , celery and carrot
4. In a large bowl , add pasta , tuna and vegetables and add one cup of mayonnaise , adding more if needed
5. Season the salad with salt and pepper to taste
6. Cover bowl and place in the refrigerator until completely chilled
7. The longer it is refrigerated the more the flavors will marry

title: green beans with almonds
steps:
1. Clean and trim green beans
2. Simmer in lightly salted water until just tender , about 10 minutes
3. Drain and rinse in cold water to keep the color bright
4. Set aside
5. Put remaining ingredients in a saucepan over medium heat and cook for two minutes , stirring constantly
6. Add green beans and almonds and stir briefly to coat

title: lower carb lemon caper chicken
steps:
1. Warm olive oil in skillet
2. Cook chicken in skillet approximately 4 minutes on each side until browned
3. Remove chicken from skillet
4. Add wine , lemon juice , lemon zest , and capers to skillet
5. Bring to boil , and then simmer for 2 minutes
6. Whisk in butter 1 piece at a time
7. Once butter is completely mixed in , pour sauce over chicken

title: parsnip casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Lightly grease / spray a 1 1 / 2 qt casserole dish
3. Cook sliced parsnips and carrots in boiling , salted water until tender
4. Drain and place in prepared casserole dish
5. Meanwhile , in a small saucepan over medium heat , melt butter
6. Saute the onions in butter for 3-5 minutes or until soft
7. Reduce heat to med-low and add flour to saucepan
8. Stirring constantly
9. Add cream , tarragon , salt , pepper , paprika and ground mustard
10. Add parmesan cheese and continue to heat over med-low heat , stirring frequently , until cheese is melted and mixture thickens
11. Evenly pour sauce over parsnip / carrot mixture in casserole dish
12. In a small bowl , mix together bread crumbs with melted butter
13. Evenly sprinkle over casserole
14. Bake , uncovered , at 400 for about 20 minutes

title: a m f  adios mother   censored
steps:
1. Fill a pint with ice
2. Add vodka , gin , rum , tequila , curacao , sour and 7up
3. Stir with a straw , garnish with lemon , lime and cherry
4. Serve

title: fantastic frozen lime pie dessert
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine thawed limeade and sweetened condensed milk
2. Add sour cream and whipped topping
3. Stir until smooth
4. Pour half the mixture into each pie crust
5. Top with grated lime zest , if desired
6. Place in freezer and freeze pies overnight

title: chopped salad with nut sauce
steps:
1. In a blender , combine the nut butter , dates , orange juice and soy sauce until smooth and creamy
2. Taste and add more juice if sauce is too thick
3. Toss chopped veggies , coconut and almonds in a large bowl and add nut sauce , using the amount that pleases you
4. Mix well and serve immediately

title: swiss beer fondue
steps:
1. Combine cheeses and cornstarch in a bag
2. Shake to make sure cheese is coated with cornstarch
3. Rub inside of pot with garlic clove cut in half
4. Discard garlic
5. Pour in beer
6. Warm until bubbles rise to the surface
7. Do not cover or boil
8. Remember to stir constantly from now one
9. Add a handful of cheeses , keeping the heat medium , when melted add another handful
10. After all the cheese is melted and bubbling add a dash of pepper sauce
11. Transfer to fondue pot and keep warm over fondue burner
12. If it separates combine 1 t cornstarch and 2 t wine and stir into fondue

title: gingered shrimp with corn and broccoli
steps:
1. Place broccoli in a steamer , and gently steam over low heat until crisp-tender , about 4 minutes
2. Transfer to a clean tea towel , and lightly pat the broccoli to absorb excess water
3. Whisk the soy sauce , vinegar , brown sugar , ginger , and chile-garlic paste until the sugar has dissolved
4. Just before serving , heat a wok or large non-stick skillet over high heat
5. Add the oil
6. When it ripples , add the scallions , corn and shrimp
7. Stir fry for 2-3 minutes , or until the shrimp are opaque
8. Add the broccoli and soy mixture , and stir-fry until all the ingredients are coated with the sauce and heated through

title: after school butterscotch brownies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Combine flour , baking powder and salt in medium bowl
3. Beat butter , splenda brown sugar blend and vanilla extract in large mixer bowl until creamy
4. Beat in eggs
5. Gradually beat in flour mixture
6. Stir in 1 cup morsels and nuts
7. Spread into ungreased 13 x 9-inch baking pan
8. Sprinkle with remaining morsels
9. Bake for 30 to 40 minutes or until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean
10. Cool in pan on wire rack
11. Cut into bars

title: thai meatballs with sateh
steps:
1. Mix half of the coriander , half of the garlic and 2 tbsp fish sauce into the meat , using hands to mix well
2. Form little balls , with wet hands
3. Saute the balls in oil for about 5 minutes
4. When cooked lay them on paper towels to drain
5. Keep them warm
6. Put the rest of the garlic , pepper and ginger root in the same pan and saute for 1 minute
7. Add coconut milk , peanut butter , sugar , 2 tbsp fish sauce and the rest of the coriander
8. Let it simmer while stirring , till the sauce thickens
9. Add basil , and serve with meat balls
10. Nice with rice noodles

title: chicken ragout with onions and red wine
steps:
1. Brown chicken in large skillet on both sides in butter and oil
2. Remove chicken from pan and set aside , leaving the liquid in the pan
3. Add onions to the pan and saute till tender on moderate heat
4. Drain liquid over sieve into small bowl
5. Remove any unwanted fat
6. Set liquid aside
7. Season the chicken parts with salt / pepper and return to pan
8. Add tomato sauce , garlic , bay leaves , and thyme
9. Add enough wine and chicken stock to cover chicken parts
10. Simmer for at least 20 minutes uncovered
11. Remove chicken and place on platter
12. Pour juices and onions into saucepan and adjust seasonings
13. You may add more garlic , thyme , salt and pepper
14. In small bowl whisk together flour and butter
15. Add to the sauce and simmer until the sauce coats the back of a spoon
16. You may need to double the thickening agents if you have lots of juice
17. Pour sauce over chicken on platter and garnish with parsley
18. Serve with rice and crusty bread

title: graham cracker chewies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Mix crumbs , butter and flour till moist and crumbly
3. Press mixture evenly in bottom of 9' square pan
4. Bake till lightly browned
5. About 18-20 minutes --
6. To prepare topping:
7. Stir all ingredients till blended
8. Spread topping over baked crust and bake an additional 20 minutes
9. Let cool completely
10. It may take 14-15 minutes to cool completely

title: apricot balsamic skillet chicken
steps:
1. Saute onion and thyme in olive oil until onion is soft
2. Remove from skillet
3. Season chicken with salt and pepper , add chicken to pan and saute 4 minutes on each side
4. Remove chicken from skillet
5. Mix preserves , vinegar and chicken broth in skillet , stirring until preserves melt , and mixture boils
6. 4 add sauteed onion
7. Return chicken to pan and turn to coat with sauce
8. Simmer until chicken is cooked through
9. Serve over rice or pasta

title: caramel nut pound cake
steps:
1. Important: all ingredients must be at room temperature
2. Mix butter and crisco
3. Add brown sugar , a little at a time , and beat well
4. Add white sugar and beat until fluffy
5. Add eggs one at a time
6. Add vanilla
7. Sift flour , salt and baking powder together
8. Add flour mixture alternately with milk
9. Fold in pecans
10. Pour into a greased tube cake pan
11. Bake at 325f for 1 1 / 2 hours
12. When cake comes out of oven , begin making frosting
13. While cake is warm , pour frosting over cake
14. Frosting: combine butter , brown sugar and milk in saucepan and cook 2 1 / 2 minutes after coming to a boil
15. Remove from heat
16. Add pecans and pour immediately over warm cake

title: roast pork with piri piri
steps:
1. Place all ingredients except pork in food processor and process to a paste
2. Rub meat with paste and marinate overnight
3. Place pork in 350 degree oven for 45 minutes per pound
4. Serve

title: one dish italian chicken with rice
steps:
1. In a skillet over medium high heat with melted butter , cook chicken and onions till chicken is done and onions are opaque
2. Stir in broth , undrained tomatoes , and spices
3. Bring to a boil
4. Stir in rice and beans
5. Reduce heat to low and simmer , covered for 5 minutes
6. Remove from heat , cover , let stand 3 minutes
7. Add in
8. I have also sprinkled 1 cup of shredded mozzarella cheese on the top , then covered it and let the cheese melt
9. Both are good variations

title: beetroot with orange sauce
steps:
1. Cook beetroot in boiling salted water for about 1 hour or until tender
2. Drain and peel
3. Slice , or , using a melon baller , make small balls
4. Heat the sugar , vinegar , strained orange juice and butter in pan
5. Mix cornflour with water and stir into the orange juice mixture
6. Stir until mixture boils and thickens
7. Add beetroot and heat through
8. Transfer beetroot onto serving dish and pour over the orange sauce
9. Garnish with some of the orange peel very thinly sliced and arranged on top

title: omg    raspberry dream bars
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine the graham cracker crumbs , butter and sugar and stir with a fork
2. Press crumb mixture into a 9x13 pan
3. Flatten out with the bottom of a cup measure
4. Drizzle and spread condensed milk over the bread crumbs
5. Place in the freezer for 10 minutes to firm up a little
6. Spoon and gently spread raspberry jam over the top
7. Sprinkle coconut cashews and white chocolate chips over the top
8. Press down gently with your hands
9. Bake at 350 for 35 minutes until coconut gets goldden brown

title: margo s sweet potato waffles
steps:
1. Combine flour , baking powder , salt and cinnamon
2. Set aside
3. Beat egg yolks in a medium bowl
4. Add milk and oil , mixing well
5. Stir in sweet potato
6. Add to flour mixture , stirring until well blended
7. Beat room temperature egg whites until stiff peaks form
8. Fold into batter
9. Pour into waffle iron and sprinkle with a few walnuts

title: sauteed broccoli with toasted bread crumbs
steps:
1. Heat butter and 1 tablespoon oil in large skillet over medium-high heat
2. When hot , add crumbs
3. Toast crumbs , stirring often , until golden
4. Scrape crumbs out of pan
5. Set aside
6. Spread broccoli on a paper-towel-lined plate
7. Pat with paper towels to remove excess moisture
8. Reheat skillet on medium heat , adding remaining 2 tablespoons olive oil
9. Add garlic
10. Saute 30 seconds
11. Add broccoli
12. Saute until heated through , about 5 minutes
13. Season with salt and pepper
14. Sprinkle with toasted crumbs and serve

title: detweiler stroganoff
steps:
1. Sautee onion in butter
2. Add meat , brown , and breakup into small bits
3. Add mushrooms and cook until juice released
4. Add garlic
5. Add cream of mushroom
6. Add salt and pepper
7. Serve over rice

title: yummy stuffed eggplant with meat and rice
steps:
1. Cut the stem ends from the eggplants
2. Halve the eggplants lengthwise
3. Peel if desired
4. If the eggplant is fresh , there is no need to peel it
5. Use a spoon to scoop out the centers , leaving boat-shaped shells
6. Keep the flesh you scooped out to add to the stuffing
7. Sprinkle the shells with salt
