8. Put them in a colander upside down and leave to drain for 1 / 2 hour
9. Preheat oven to 425 degrees c
10. Prepare the stuffing: add the rice to 3 cups boiling salted water and boil for 10 minutes until not quite tender
11. Rinse under cold running water and drain well
12. Heat 1 tablespoon of the oil in a frying pan , add the onion and cook over low heat until soft but not brown
13. Leave to cool
14. Mix with the beef , parsley , cumin , turmeric and almonds
15. Chop the flesh removed from the eggplant
16. Heat 2 tablespoons oil , add the chopped eggplant and sprinkle with salt
17. Saute over medium-low heat , stirring often , until tender , about 10 minutes
18. Leave to cool and mix with the stuffing
19. Taste for seasoning
20. If you prefer not to taste a mixture that contains raw beef , broil or microwave a teaspoon of the mixture and taste it for seasoning
21. Rinse the eggplant shells , pat them dry and put them in a baking dish
22. Fill them with the stuffing
23. Mix the tomato paste with 1 / 4 cup water and spoon the mixture over the eggplant
24. Add enough water to the dish to cover the eggplant by one third
25. Add the garlic to the dish
26. Spoon 1 tablespoon oil over the eggplant
27. Cover and bake 15 minutes
28. Reduce the heat to 350 f and continue baking , covered , 15 more minutes
29. Uncover and bake , basting occasionally , 30 minutes or until the eggplant is very tender

title: german potatoes
steps:
1. Heat oil in iron skillet
2. When hot , add potatoes , turning until light brown
3. Add onion and cook 5 minutes longer
4. Season with salt and pepper
5. Pour in water or broth and cover with lid
6. Reduce heat , stirring occasionally
7. Cook until tender

title: double chocolate apricot muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Grease or put paper liners in 12-cup muffin pan
3. In a small bowl , mix together flour , cocoa powder , baking powder and salt
4. In a large bowl , mix together sugar , eggs , milk , oil and vanilla
5. Mix in dry ingredients just until combined
6. Fold in chocolate and apricots
7. Scoop batter into prepared muffin cups
8. Topping: sprinkle with sugar
9. Bake in preheated oven for 22 minutes or until a tester inserted into center comes out clean
10. Let muffins cool in pan on a wire rack for 5 minutes
11. Transfer to rack and let cool completely

title: betty s key lime pie
steps:
1. Put sweetened condensed milk into a bowl and slowly add the key lime juice
2. Mix until creamy
3. When creamy add the container of cool whip
4. Put into graham cracker crust and refrigerate
5. If desired , garnish with additional cool whip and chocolate curls
6. For the graham cracker crust , in a bowl mix the graham cracker crumbs and powdered sugar
7. Melt the butter and add to the cracker crumbs and sugar
8. Mix until blended
9. Reserve 1 / 2 cup of the crumbs for the top
10. Pat the balance of the crumbs in bottom and sides of the pie tin
11. Put in the refrigerator to set and get cold
12. You can use this graham cracker crust recipe as with your favorite filling or bake , as with cheesecake

title: tim horton s style boston creme doughnuts
steps:
1. In a saucepan , combine the sugar , 1 1 / 2 cups of the milk , and the vanilla bean
2. Cook over low heat , stirring constantly with a wooden spoon , until the sugar is dissolved
3. Raise the heat and scald the mixture
4. Meanwhile , place the cornstarch in a medium bowl
5. Using a wire whisk , gradually whisk in the remaining 1 / 2 cup milk until smooth
6. Add the egg yolks and whisk until well blended
7. Slowly pour 1 / 3 cup of the hot milk mixture into the yolk mixture , whisking constantly
8. Gradually whisk in the rest of the hot milk
9. Return the milk-yolk mixture to the saucepan and bring to a boil over medium heat
10. Boil gently for 1 minute , stirring constantly
11. Remove the pan from the heat and whisk in the butter
12. Pass the mixture through a fine-mesh sieve into a bowl
13. Cover with plastic wrap , pressing it directly onto the surface , and refrigerate until chilled
14. Place the warm milk , yeast , and 1 teaspoon of the sugar in the bowl of an electric mixer
15. Stir the yeast into the mixture and let stand for 10 minutes , or until foamy
16. Add 1 cup of the flour and , using the paddle attachment or beaters , beat on low speed for 2 minutes to form the sponge
17. Remove the bowl from the stand , cover with plastic wrap , and let the sponge stand at room temperature until well risen , about 30 minutes
18. In a medium bowl , whisk together the remaining 1 3 / 4 cups flour with the cardamom , nutmeg , and salt
19. Set aside
20. Return the bowl containing the sponge to the mixer stand
21. Using the paddle attachment on medium speed , add the egg yolks and mix until incorporated , then beat in the remaining sugar
22. Add the butter , 1 tablespoon at a time , beating until each tablespoon is absorbed before adding the next
23. Add the flour-spice mixture and beat on medium speed for 5 minutes
24. The dough will not form a ball
25. It will be soft and part of it will wrap itself around the paddle
26. Scrape the dough into a well-buttered bowl and turn as needed to coat all sides with the butter
27. Cover the bowl with buttered plastic wrap , buttered side down , and let the dough rise in a warm , draft-free place for about i hour , or until it has slightly more than doubled in volume
28. Turn out the dough onto a lightly oiled work surface
29. Using your hands , gently press down on it to deflate it and flatten it evenly to no less then 1 / 2 inch thick
30. Cover loosely with plastic wrap and let the dough rest for 5 minutes
31. Line a baking sheet with parchment or waxed paper
32. Using a floured 2 1 / 2-inch biscuit cutter , cut out 14 dough rounds
33. Gently transfer the rounds to the lined baking sheet , reshaping them if necessary
34. Space the rounds at least 1-inch apart to allow for expansion
35. Let rise for about 30 minutes , or until almost doubled in size
36. While the doughnuts are rising , pour the oil into a deep-fat fryer or large straight-sided saucepan to a depth of 2 to 3 inches
37. Heat the oil to 360 degrees f
38. Line a baking sheet with paper towels
39. Fry the doughnuts , 3 or 4 at a time , for about 1 minute , or until golden brown on the first side
40. Turn and fry on the second side until golden brown
41. It may take slightly less time for the second side to cook than the first
42. The midline of the doughnut will be lighter than the rest of it , which is characteristic
43. Using a slotted spoon , transfer the doughnuts to the paper towels to drain , then place on a wire rack to cool
44. As soon as the doughnuts are cool enough to handle , use a long , thin , plain pastry
45. Let cool completely before filling
46. Remove the vanilla cream filling from the refrigerator and beat with the electric mixer on medium speed until smooth
47. Scrape the cream filling into a large pastry bag fitted with a medium plain
48. Pipe the filling into the hole in the middle of each doughnut until the doughnut feels full
49. Wipe off any excess cream
50. Return the filled doughnuts to the rack as they are filled
51. Place the chopped chocolate in a medium heatproof bowl
52. Set aside
53. Combine the water , corn syrup , and sugar in a heavy-bottomed , medium saucepan
54. Place over low heat and cook , stirring constantly with a wooden spoon , until the sugar is dissolved
55. Raise the heat and bring to a full boil
56. Pour the hot syrup over the chopped chocolate
57. Let stand for 3 minutes to melt the chocolate , then whisk gently until smooth
58. Whisk in the butter
59. Let the glaze cool until it starts to thicken slightly , stirring occasionally
60. Spread a scant tablespoon of chocolate glaze over the top of each doughnut
61. Place the glazed doughnuts back on the rack and let stand until set
62. The doughnuts are best served within a few hours

title: slow cooker vegetable soup
steps:
1. In a slow cooker , combine the first 12 ingredients
2. Cover and cook on high for 6 hours
3. Add frozen vegetables or cans of veg-all
4. Cover and cook on high for 2 hours longer or until meat and vegetables are tender

title: caramelized onions with apples and carrots
steps:
1. Place the oil and onions in a medium skillet
2. Cook slowly , stirring occasionally , over medium-low heat until brown , 15 minutes
3. Add the apples carrots , and water
4. Cover and continue to cook slowly until the carrots are tender , 5 to 7 minutes
5. Puree some of the onion mixture in a blender or food processor for the baby and serve the rest as is to your family
6. Makes 2 cups

title: hamburger   steaks  with onion gravy
steps:
1. In a large bowl mix together beef , egg , bread crumbs , 1 package soup mix , and worcestershire sauce
2. Form into 8 balls and flatten into patties
3. Mix flour salt and pepper
4. Dredge patties in flour mixture
5. Heat large skillet over med-high heat
6. Fry the patties 4 minutes each side , then remove patties to a platter
7. Heat oil and saut onions until translucent , about 10 minutes
8. Add the rest of the flour mixture to onions and stir to coat
9. Mix broth and last package of onion soup and add to the onions
10. Stir well
11. Return the patties to the pan , cover and reduce heat to low
12. Simmer 15-20 minutes until beef is cooked through
13. Stir occasionally to make sure gravy is not sticking to bottom of the pan or clumping

title: dirty rice
steps:
1. Cook the rice according to the package instructions , but use chicken broth for one third of the cooking liquid
2. So , for example , if the package says to use 3 cups of water for 1 1 / 2 cups of rice , use 2 cups of water and 1 cup of chicken broth
3. Once the rice has finished cooking , remove from heat and let sit for 5 minutes
4. Turn the rice out onto a sheet pan and drizzle 1 tablespoon of olive oil over it
5. Mix to combine and let cool
6. While the rice is cooking , mash and finely chop the chicken livers , or pure briefly in a blender
7. In a large pan that can eventually hold the rice plus everything else , put 1 tablespoon of oil plus the bacon in and cook over medium-low heat until the bacon is crispy
8. Add the ground pork and increase the heat to high
9. Allow the meat to brown before stirring
10. As soon as the pork starts to brown , add the final tablespoon of oil and add the celery , jalapeos , and onions
11. Brown them all over medium-high heat
12. You may notice the bottom of the pan getting crusty
13. Keep it from burning by lowering the heat if needed
14. Add the minced liver and cook for a few minutes more
15. Add the remaining cup of chicken broth and deglaze the pan by scraping the bottom of the pan with a wooden spoon
16. Add the cajun seasoning and turn the heat to high
17. Boil away most of the chicken stock and then add the cooked rice
18. Toss to combine
19. Turn off the heat and add the green onions
20. Toss once more to combine and serve hot

title: roast vegetables with pine nut crumble
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 200c
2. Cct potatoes , sweet potatoes and pumpkin into 5cm pieces
3. Place all vegetables in a roasting dish in a single layer , drizzle with olive oil and season with salt and pepper , toss to coat
4. Roast for 45 minutes or until golden and just tender
5. Place bread and pine nuts in a food processor and pulse until crumbs form
6. Transfer to a bowl and add the parmesan , parsley , garlic and butter
7. Season with salt and pepper
8. Mix well
9. Remove vegetables from the oven , sprinkle the crum mix over them then return to the oven and roast a further 10 minutes or until golden

title: north georgia brunswick stew
steps:
1. Bring 2 quarts water and chicken to a boil in a dutch
2. Reduce heat and simmer 40 minutes or until tender
3. Remove chicken and set aside
4. Reserve 3 cups broth in dutch oven
5. Pour lima beans and liquid through a wire-mesh strainer into dutch oven
6. Reserve beans
7. Add tomato to dutch oven
8. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat
9. Cook stirring often , 40 minutes or until liquid is reduced by one-third
10. Skin , bone , and shred chicken
11. Mash reserved beans with a potato masher
12. Add chicken , mashed and frozen beans , potato , and onion to dutch oven
13. Cook over low heat , stirring often , 3 hours and 30 minutes
14. Stir in corn and remaining ingredients
15. Cook over low heat , stirring often , 1 hour
16. 30 minutes before it is done i whisk the stew with an electric mixer for a more traditional smooth texture
17. I like to leave some chunks

title: raspberry and brown sugar coffee cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325f
2. Butter and flour a 9- x 13-inch baking pan
3. Roughly chop the almonds
4. Set aside
5. In the bowl of an electric mixer , cream the butter and brown sugar until light and fluffy , about 8 minutes on high speed
6. In a separate bowl , combine the eggs , milk , vanilla and almond extracts , and whisk until blended
7. Slowly beat this mixture into the creamed butter
8. Don't be alarmed if the butter separates somewhat
9. It will come together when you stir in the dry ingredients
10. In another bowl , combine the flour , baking powder , baking soda and salt , and mix well
11. Using a wooden spoon , stir the dry ingredients into the wet mixture in thirds , alternating with the buttermilk
12. Mix until just combined
13. Add the raspberries and stir gently to incorporate without smashing the fruit
14. Transfer the batter to the prepared pan , evening it out to the edges
15. Top with the chopped almonds
16. Bake for approximately 1 hour , or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean and the cake springs back to the touch
17. Remove from the oven and cool completely before serving
18. The cake also makes a delicious dessert
19. You can substitute other berries , such as blueberries or blackberries , for the raspberries

title: family favorite lime cake
steps:
1. Mix together cake mix , gelatin , oil , eggs , and orange juice
2. Pour into three 8 inch greased and floured cake pans
3. Bake according to instructions on box
4. Allow to cool , then frost
5. To make frosting: in a large bowl , beat the butter and cream cheese until fluffy and light
6. Add lime juice and confectioners sugar beating well

title: corn pancakes with cheese or cachapas de carabobo
steps:
1. Puree corn & press through sieve to yield about 3 cups
2. To the corn add cream , egg , flour , sugar & salt , & mix well before letting batter rest 15 minutes
3. Onto hot griddle or cast iron skillet , pour 1 tablespoon oil , then pour 1 / 4 cup batter for each pancake
4. Fry , turning once until lightly browned & firm on both sides
5. Remove from griddle & serve wrapped around a slice of cheese

title: crock pot short ribs and cabbage stew
steps:
1. Add oil to a nonstick skillet and heat on high
2. Place flour in a plastic bag , add one rib at a time , and shake to coat
3. Brown ribs on both sides , reduce heat to medium high , brown all edges remove from pan and drain on paper towels
4. Add broth to skillet , stir , scraping up browned bits
5. Add tomatoes , garlic , sugar , vinegar , dill , salt , and cayenne , stir to combine and set aside
6. Layer potatoes , carrots , onion , and cabbage , and top with tomato mixture in the crock pot
7. Place ribs on top , meat side down , cover and cook 4 hours on high or 7-8 hours on low
8. To serve place a rib in the bottom of 6 soup plates and top with stew

title: chicken   dumplings      crock pot
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients , except biscuits , in slow cooker
2. Cover and cook on low 5-6 hours
3. 30 minutes before serving , tear biscuit dough into 1" pieces
4. Add to the slow cooker
5. Stir gently
6. Cover and cook on high for an additional 30 minutes or until biscuits are fluffed up and cooked through

title: easy potato candy bonbons
steps:
1. Peel and boil potato
2. Drain water , mash with fork , and add milk
3. Use beaters on high speed to make as fluffy and lump-free as possible
4. Add almond flavoring , still beating
5. Either use beaters or a spoon and add confectioner's sugar , a little at a time
6. Sugar and potato have a chemical reaction that makes the potatoes look like they are melting
7. Keep adding sugar until the melting effect is almost completely gone and the mixture is forming a stiff dough
8. Knead in chocolate chips
9. Immediately form into little balls , walnut-sized or smaller
10. I like to put them into mini cupcake papers or whatever works best with the season , and to leave them in mini cupcake pans to dry and finish hardening

title: tangy flank steak sandwiches
steps:
1. In a small pan , combine the ketchup , water , lemon juice , worcestershire , celery seed , bay leaves , pepper , and basil
2. Simmer , uncovered , stirring occassionally , for 10 minutes
3. Let marinade cool
4. Meanwhile , use a sharp knife to lightly score both sides of the steak , making diagonal cuts across the steak about 1 inch apart to form a diamond pattern
5. Place meat in a dish and pour cooled marinade over the meat
6. Cover and refrigerate about 24 hours
7. Remove meat to bbq but save the marinade
8. Bbq meat until done to your liking
9. Pour marinade into a small pan and heat on the stove until hot and simmering
10. Cut meat across the grain in thin slanting slices
11. Serve with sauce and french bread

title: roasted pepper and sausage radiatore
steps:
1. Roast bell peppers in oven [400 degrees , coat whole peppers in oil , bake 20 min , turning occasionally , until skins are browned
2. To easily peel , put in ziploc bag for 15-30min before peeling]
3. Peel and seed peppers
4. Puree in food processor or blender until creamy
5. Set aside
6. Cook the pasta while you are doing the steps below
7. Heat oil over medium-high heat , add garlic and saute a couple of minutes
8. Add italian sausage and heat until thoroughly cooked
9. Drain on paper towels , drain off excess grease
10. Add sausage back to pan , and mix in evaporated milk , pureed pepper , red pepper flakes , salt and pepper
11. Stir in parmesan cheese
12. Fold pasta into mixture
13. Divide into 6 servings , top with additional parmesan if desired

title: burgundy barley beef stew
steps:
1. Combine flour , salt , pepper and beef in large ziploc bag
2. Shake to coat beef
3. Heat oil in large skillet
4. Add beef , onion , celery and garlic
5. Cook 6-7 minutes , until beef is no longer pink and vegetables are a little tender
6. Place beef mixture in crockpot
7. Add remaining ingredients
8. Cook on high for 5-6 hours , or low for 10-12 hours

title: my french onion soup
steps:
1. In large dutch oven , melt butter
2. Saute onions until golden brown
3. Add flour and blend
4. Add broth , and remaining ingredients
5. Cover and simmer cook on low at least 3 hours
6. Serve in ovenproof bowls , with garlic croutons floating on top
7. Cover croutons with mozzaarella or swiss cheese and broil until the cheese melts
8. This also works very well in the crockpot all day on low and freezes well

title: taffy apple salad
steps:
1. Cut apples into bite sized pieces
2. Toss apples in reserved pineapple juice and drain
3. In separate bowl mix drained pineapples , sugar , flour , eggs , apple cider vinegar and cool whip
4. Add 2 / 3 cup of peanuts
5. Add apples to mixture
6. Mix
7. Sprinkle remaining peanuts on top

title: zippy steak
steps:
1. Place flour mixed with black pepper in a plastic or paper bag
2. Drop steaks in one at time and shake to coat evenly with flour
3. Pour just enough oil to cover bottom of a nonstick skillet and heat over medium heat
4. Lightly brown steaks on each side
5. Top each steak with rotel tomatoes
6. Cover and simmer 10 minutes or until done
7. Serve over rice or noodles

title: zucchini with sour cream topping
steps:
1. Wash and trim ends from zucchini
2. Cook whole zucchini in boiling salted water until tender , about 10 minutes
3. Brush with melted butter and place in a baking dish in one layer
4. Blend salt and pepper into sour cream and spread over zucchini
5. Sprinkle over with cheese
6. Broil just until cheese melts and begins to brown
7. Serve immediately

title: strawberry smoothie with hint of chocolate
steps: 1. Blend all ingredients in blender just until smooth and creamy

title: sausage cheese balls
steps:
1. Oven directions: preheat to 375f
2. Mix items into a large bowl to blend
3. It is best to use your hands and just mix until the dry ingredients are incorporated together
4. Lightly grease baking pan
5. Shape mixture into 36 1-inch balls and place on the greased baking sheet and bake on the middle rack , baking 12 / 14 minutes - flipping / rolling at 6 minutes
6. Remove from oven and serve w / toothpicks
7. If you want to cook on the stove top , mixed items in large bowl and shape into 1 inch balls
8. Cook half at a time at medium heat for about 15 / 17 minutes turning often
9. Remove from the pan and serve w / toothpicks
10. Start next batch
11. If you want to wait to serve all at the same time , place in cake pan in oven to keep warm while you cook the remaining sausage balls
12. You can also make this ahead of time and freeze the sausage balls
13. When you are ready to cook , place frozen balls on lightly greased cookie sheet and bake 16 / 18 minutes flipping at 8mins

title: thai coconut pudding  custard
steps:
1. Grease one baking dish or 3 individual ramekins with butter
2. Preheat oven to 260c
3. Beat eggs and sugar well till it thickens
4. Add essence and coconut milk
5. Beat again
6. Mix in grated coconut
7. I have to add here that i think you should use only fresh coconut for the best result
8. Mix well
9. Pour into baking dish
10. Place dish in a baking tray filled halfway with hot water
11. Bake for 35 mins or till the top is brown and a tester comes out clean
12. Chill and serve overturned in a plate or in the ramekins
13. Dusted with icing sugar
14. Served with any fruit and garnish with the mint

title: basil fries
steps:
1. In bowl , combine parmesan cheese , oil , basil , and garlic powder
2. Cut potatoes into 1 / 4-inch sticks
3. Add to cheese mixture and toss to coat
4. Place in 15 x 10-inch pan coated with nonstick cooking spray
5. Bake at 425f for 15 minutes
6. Turn potatoes
7. Bake 20 minutes or until crisp and tender

title: guinness beef stew
steps:
1. Pre heat your oven to 180c
2. Heat the oil in a frying pan and brown the beef all over
3. Remove the beef to an oven proof casserole dish
4. Add the garlic and onions to the frypan and cook'til the onion is soft
5. Add the sugar and stir until caramelised
6. Remove to the casserole dish
7. Add the carrots and bay leaf to the casserole too
8. Dissolve the stock cubes and flour in the water and add to the frypan with the guinness
9. Heat until the mixture boils and thickens
10. Pour over the meat in the casserole and stir to combine
11. Cover the casserole , and cook in the oven for 1 hour
12. Add the prunes and cook for a further 30 minutes

title: pesto chicken pasta with asparagus
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to package directions , rinse and drain
2. Steam or microwave asparagus until tender crisp
3. Drain
4. Combine cooked pasta and asparagus in a large bowl
5. Stir in chicken , tomatoes , onion and olives
6. Gently toss with pesto sauce
7. Serve warm , garnished with cheese
8. Refrigerate leftovers
9. They make a great lunch

title: won ton soup
steps:
1. For the won tons:
2. Mix all won ton filling ingredients together in a medium bowl
3. Spoon about a teaspoon of filling onto each won ton skin and , wetting the edges , fold in half to seal , or into whatever dumpling shape you prefer
4. Repeat until all filling is used
5. Heat 3 quarts lightly salted water to a boil in a large soup pot
6. Boil won tons about 5-7 minutes , or until cooked through
7. Test by cutting one in half with a knife , if unsure , to ensure filling is cooked through
8. For the broth:
9. In a medium sauce pot heat broth , soy sauce , sesame oil , green onion and garlic to a boil
10. Add spinach and cook until wilted
11. In a shallow , pasta-style bowl place 4-5 dumplings and ladle spinach and broth over top

title: bastani akbar mashti   iranian ice cream
steps:
1. The cream used to prepare the ice cream should be very thick
2. Leave the cream in a tray in the freezer until it is frozen
3. Ice-cream should not be very hard
4. Cut frozen cream into small pieces and mix with ice-cream
5. Add rose-water and mix well
6. Place the mix in the freezer for at least one hour

title: honey garlic pork
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large heavy-bottomed skillet over medium-high heat
2. When oil is hot , add pork pieces , being careful not to crowd
3. While cooking , season pork with red pepper flakes , salt and pepper
4. Saute pork , turning occasionally , until pork pieces are nicely browned and turning crisp on all sides
5. Add garlic and continue to stir until fragrant , approximately one or two minutes
6. Turn heat down to medium
7. Add honey to pork
8. Stir well , continue to cook for two to three more minues until honey has coated pork well and has slightly thickened
9. Enjoy !

title: candy cane bark
steps:
1. Line 11 x 17 inch baking sheet with parchment paper& set aside
2. Melt dark chocolate in a heavy pot over low heat , stirring constantly
3. Stir in 4 drops of peppermint oil
4. Spread chocolate evenly onto the prepared sheet& refrigerate until set , about 1 hour
5. Melt white chocolate in a heavy pot over low heat , stirring constantly
6. Stir in 4 drops of peppermint oil followed by candy cane pieces
7. Spread white chocolate mixture over chilled dark chocolate , spreading to the edge of the pan
8. Refrigerate until set , about 4 hours or overnight- up to 3 weeks
9. Break into pieces and serve or package as gifts

title: carrot marmalade
steps:
1. Wash the lemon and orange and shred them finely
2. Keep all the seeds from both , and put them in a clean new tea ball , or sew them into a scrap of cheesecloth
3. Put the canning jars in a large kettle with enough water to come to an inch above the rims
4. Turn the heat on just after you add the sugar and carrots to the marmalade- jars must be boiled 10 minutes to be sterilized
5. Put the lemon and orange shreds and juice in a large , broad pot with the water and the seeds , and boil for ten minutes
6. Wash , peel and grate the carrots
7. Add the carrots and sugar to the peels
8. Continue boiling until the marmalade is thick and forms a sheet when poured from the spoon , about 30 minutes longer
9. Fish out the seeds , draining them well
10. Seal the marmalade in sterilized jars and process in boiling water for 5 minutes

title: cauliflower and  peas curry
steps:
1. Cut cauliflower into 3" florets , wash and drain thoroughly
2. Heat oil or ghee on high
3. Add whole cumin , stir until it sizzles for a few seconds
4. Add onions , garlic and giner
5. Stir fry until golden brown
6. Add tomatoes and continue frying for 5 minutes or until you have a reddish paste
7. Add the ground coriander , turmeric , cumin , pepper , cardamom and salt
8. Continue stir frying until all spices are well blended in the paste
9. Add cauliflower and fry well
10. This should take about 8 minutes on high heat
11. Stir off and on to prevent mixture from ticking to bottom of pan
12. Add peas , stir , lower heat to medium , cover and cook until cauliflower is tender
13. Before serving , sprinkle with fresh coriander on top

title: creamy carrot and scallion baked potato topping
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients except
2. 5 tbs carrot and spoon over hot split baked potato
3. Garnish with remaining carrot

title: crockpot beef stew
steps:
1. In a large bowl add flour and cubed beef , cover meat with flour until well coated and set aside
2. In a large skillet heat oil until hot but not smoking , then add beef
3. When meat starts to brown , sprinkle with seasonings and stir until meat is coated
4. While the meat is browning , place vegetables in the bottom of the crockpot
5. Place browned meat over vegetables , add water , soup and place bay leaves on top of soup
6. Check after 6 hours and remove bay leaves , stir once or twice until veggies are well blended

title: creamy wild mushroom soup
steps:
1. Soak porcinis in 1 c warm water for 30 minutes , strain and reserve the liquid heat the oil and butter until foaming , then add onion , shallots and garlic and saute for about 5 minutes add fresh mushrooms to the pan and stir until softened
2. Add stock and bring to a boil
3. Add the porcinis , liquid , thyme and salt and pepper
4. Lower the heat and simmer for 30 minutes , stirring occasionally
5. Process 3 / 4 of the soup in a blender
6. Add cream and heat through
7. Correct seasonings if necessary and garnish with fresh thyme and cracked black pepper

title: st louis noodle parlor chop suey
steps:
1. In wok or non-stick skillet heat oil and stir-fry chicken until done
2. Add sprouts and stir then add bamboo shoots , mushrooms , onion and celery
3. Stir thoroughly
4. Add 1 cup of the water or broth
5. Cover and let simmer for about 5 mins or until celery is crisp tender
6. Dissolve cornstarch in the 1 / 2 cup water and add to chicken mixture , stirring until mixture thickens
7. Season to taste with soy sauce and serve with rice

title: tuna   artichoke melts
steps:
1. In food processor , add the artichokes , mayonnaise , tuna water , relish , pepper and garlic salt
2. Blend until artichokes are finely shredded
3. Gently fold in flaked tuna and spread mixture over the english muffin halves
4. Turn oven to broil and place muffin halves on a baking sheet under the broiler for 6-8 minutes or until heated
5. Remove from oven and place a slice of cheese on each muffin half
6. Return to oven and broil for another 3 minutes or until cheese is melted

title: california avocado monte cristo
steps:
1. Beat together eggs , milk , and salt
2. Reserve
3. Mix mayonnaise with garlic
4. Spread 1 / 2 tablespoon on one side of each slice of bread
5. Cover 4 slices of bread with avocado slices
6. Top each with 2 slices chicken or turkey and 1 slice of cheese
7. Cover each with remaining slice of bread , spread side down
8. Diagonally cut each in half
9. Reserve
10. In a large frying pan , melt 2 tablespoons butter
11. Meanwhile , dip 4 sandwich halves in egg , coating well
12. Brown in hot butter , about 2 minutes per side
13. Repeat with remaining sandwich halves
14. Serve each sandwich with 1 / 4 cup salsa
15. Garnish with cilantro sprig

title: al roker s spicy beef chili
steps:
1. In a large enameled cast-iron casserole or soup pot , heat the oil
2. Season the chuck with salt and pepper
3. Add half of the chuck and cook over moderately high heat until browned , about 5 minutes
4. Using a slotted spoon , transfer the meat to a plate
5. Repeat with the remaining chuck
6. Add the sausage and cook until browned , breaking it up with a spoon , about 4 minutes
7. Add the sausage to the diced chuck
8. Add the chopped onion to the casserole and cook over moderate heat until tender , about 4 minutes
9. Add the garlic and cook for 2 minutes
10. Stir in the chili powder , paprika , cumin and the chuck , sausage and any accumulated juices
11. Cook , stirring until fragrant , about 1 minute
12. Add the tomatoes and their juices and the water
13. Cover and simmer over moderately low heat for 1 hour
14. Stir in the beans and simmer uncovered until thickened , about 15 minutes
15. Season with salt if desired
16. Serve the chili in deep bowls , passing the cheese , scallions , sour cream and cilantro on the side

title: sugar free pineapple pie
steps:
1. Combine graham cracker crumbs and margarine
2. Press into bottom and upsides of 8-inch pie pan
3. Bake at 350 for 8 to 10 minutes
4. Set aside to cool
5. In a large bowl , combine pudding mix and sour cream
6. Mix well
7. Stir in pineapple and splenda
8. Spread into cool crust
9. Chill at least 3 hours before serving
10. Try this with sugar free pistachio pudding for a lovely green pie for st
11. Paddy's day

title: holiday leftovers pot pie
steps:
1. Line a deep dish pie plate with pie pastry and set aside
2. Preheat oven to 425f have ready a cookie sheet lined with foil
3. In a medium saucepan , melt the butter over medium heat
4. Whisk in the flour until combined
5. Slowly add some of the chicken stock , whisking to blend well , then adding a bit more , repeating until all is added
6. Next whisk in the milk , also whisking in and blending well slowly
7. Cook , whisking occasionally until somewhat thickened , raising heat slightly if needed , approximately 10-15 minutes
8. Add the cooked meat , vegetables , salt , peppers , cooking about 3 minutes until heated through , stirring , test for seasonings , adding more salt or pepper if needed
9. Pour into the pie pastry lined pan
10. Now you have a choice on how to top this:
11. Choice #1: roll out the second piece of pie pastry and top the pie , sealing edges , and use a knife to cut out a hole the size of a small coin in the center of the pastry , as well as five vent slits around the pastry
12. Choice #2: the original recipe suggested using a cookie cutter to cut out 12 leaf shapes out of the top crust and then placing the leaf shapes on top of the pie -- up to you if you wish to make it look "fancy" or not
13. Bake uncovered for 12-15 minutes or until crust is golden and the filling has begun to bubble
14. Let cool a bit before serving
15. This will be served scooped out with a spoon
16. Don't expect to be able to cut this into neat , firm pieces
17. The filling is very saucy

title: beef noodle bake
steps:
1. In a skillet , cook beef and onion until meat is no longer pink
2. Drain
3. Remove from the heat
4. Stir in tomato sauce , sour cream , cream cheese , sugar and garlic salt
5. Mix until blended
6. Place half of the noodles in a greased 13-in
7. X9-in
8. X2-in
9. Baking dish
10. Top with half of the beef mixture
11. Repeat layers
12. Cover and bake at 350 degrees for 30-35 minutes or until heated through
13. Sprinkle with cheese
14. Bake 3-5 minutes longer or until cheese is melted

title: broccoli  bacon   cheese salad
steps:
1. Mix dressing ingredients together
2. Stir into broccoli mixture
3. Stir once in a while if not served immediately
4. May be made 1 day ahead of time and kept in the refridgerator

title: pumpkin pie cheesecake
steps:
1. Make sure the bottom of your oven is clean before you start
2. Preheat your oven to 450f
3. Beat cheese and sugars together for 4 minutes on med high speed , scraping down the inside of the bowl a few times
4. Add the eggs 2 at a time mixing for 30 seconds between additions
5. Scrap down the inside of the bowl a few times while adding the eggs
6. Now add the spices and the pumpkin
7. Cover the spices with the pumpkin so when you start the mixer they don't fly out !
8. Mix on low speed for 1 minute scraping down the inside of the bowl half way through
9. Pour into pie shells then put in the oven and bake for 5 minutes
10. After baking for 5 minutes turn down the oven without opening the door to 235f
11. Bake for 60 minutes more then turn off oven and open door leaving the pies inside for 30 minutes to cool
12. Remove from oven to cool completely
13. Enjoy

title: sheila s banana bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease and flour a 9x5x3-inch loaf pan
3. Combine flour , baking powder , baking soda , and salt in a medium bowl
4. Beat together butter and sugar in another medium bowl until light in color
5. Beat in eggs , one at a time
6. Stir in vanilla
7. Stir in flour mixture alternately with bananas and milk
8. Stir in 3 / 4 cup of nuts
9. Pour in prepared pan
10. Bake for 1 hour and 10 minutes or until wooden pick inserted comes out clean
11. Cool on rack for about 10 minutes
12. Run thin knife around edges
13. Remove bread from pan to rack to cool
14. Bread is better next day
15. Wrap tightly and store at room temperature

title: double chocolate zucchini bread
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350
2. Butter and flour 2 loaf pans
3. Whisk the flour with the cocoa , baking soda , cinnamon and cloves in a medium size bowl
4. Beat butter and sugar in a medium bowl with a mixer on med high until light and fluffy , about 4 minutes
5. While you're mixing , drizzle in the oil , then the eggs , one at a time , beating well after each addition
6. Stir the vanilla into the buttermilk
7. Mix the flour mixture into the butter mixture in 3 additions , alternating with the buttermilk , beginning and ending with the flour
8. Scrape the sides of the bowl when needed
9. Fold in the zucchini and chocolate
10. Divide batter into the 2 pans
11. Bake until tester comes out clean , about 55 minutes
12. Cool in pans on rack before removing and slicing

title: gluten free and vegan sesame truffles
steps:
1. Place cashews in food processor and pulse until the texture of coarse sand
2. Add tahini , agave and vanilla and pulse until smooth
3. Transfer mixture from food processor to a bowl and refrigerate 2 hours
4. Roll into 1 inch balls and coat with sesame seeds
5. Serve

title: half the sodium  seasoned salt
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a small bowl and mix well
2. Pour the blend into an empty spice bottle to store

title: egg cakes
steps:
1. Beat eggs in medium sized bowl until "frothy"
2. Add remaining ingredients and stir well
3. Heat olive oil in frying pan
4. Drop batter by spoonful into oil and fry on both sides about 3 minutes , until golden
5. Once you turn the egg cakes over , they will start to puff up a little
6. Serve with pasta and tomato sauce

title: bay scallop gratin   ina garten  back to basics
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f
2. Place 6 gratin dishes on a sheet pan
3. To make the topping , place the butter in the bowl of an electric mixer fitted with the paddle attachment
4. With the mixer on low speed , add the garlic , shallot , prosciutto , parsley , lemon juice , pernod , salt , and pepper and mix until combined
5. With the mixer still on low , add the olive oil slowly as though making mayonnaise , until combined
6. Fold the panko in with a rubber spatula and set aside
7. Preheat the broiler , if it's separate from your oven
8. Place 1 tablespoon of the wine in the bottom of each gratin dish
9. With a small sharp knife , remove the white muscle and membrane from the side of each scallop and discard
10. Pat the scallops dry with paper towels and distribute them among the 6 dishes
11. Spoon the garlic butter evenly over the top of the scallops
12. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes , until the topping is golden and sizzling and the scallops are barely done
13. If you want the top crustier , place the dishes under the broiler for 2 minutes , until browned
14. Finish with a squeeze of fresh lemon juice and a sprinkling of chopped parsley and serve immediately with crusty french bread

title: italian sausage rigatoni and peppers
steps:
1. Cook rigatoni according to package directions
2. Drain , keep warm and set aside
3. Heat olive oil in large skillet
4. Remove casing from sausage links and cut in coin-like slices
5. Add to skillet and cook until no longer pink
6. Add garlic and saute lightly for about 30 seconds
7. Add peppers and cook until crisp-tender
8. Add pasta sauce with peppers and heat until warm
9. Add the rigatoni or serve separately
10. Top with fresh parsley and parmesan cheese

title: pasticcio casserole  omac
steps:
1. Botton layer: combine macaroni , eggs and cheese
2. Spread over bottom of greased 13 x 9 ~ or ~ two 8 x 8 casserole dishes
3. Set aside
4. Filling: in a large skillet , cook beef , mushrooms and onion until tender and browned
5. Drain fat
6. Stir in tomato sauce and seasonings
7. Simmer , uncovered while preparing topping
8. Top layer: in a large saucepan , melt butter
9. Stir in flour , salt and nutmeg
10. Add milk
11. Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly
12. Add a bit of the milk mixture to the eggs , stir quickly , then return to the saucepan
13. Cook over low heat for 1 minute longer
14. To assemble: spread meat filling over macaroni
15. Spread top layer over the filling
16. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese
17. Preheat oven to 350
18. Cook the casserole for 35 - 40 minutes or until heated through

title: waunita ranch chicken
steps:
1. Mix first 7 ingredients together , and pour into greased casserole
2. Top with crushed crackers
3. Pour melted butter evenly over crackers
4. Bake at 350f for 30 minutes

title: easy peppie pizza
steps:
1. Real easy , just layout your tortilla on a flat baking sheet
2. Brush one side with olive oil
3. Spoon out the spaghetti sauce
4. Top with pepperoni and shredded cheese
5. Preheat oven and bake 375 degrees , approx 5 minutes
6. Parental supervision is advised with young cooks
7. The results should be a crispy , yummy , and healthy snack
8. Try it vegetarian ! enjoy !

title: tomato   cucumber salad with mint
steps:
1. Cut cucumbers in half lengthwise
2. Scrape out seeds
3. Cut halves diagonally into 1 / 2-inch-wide pieces
4. Place in large bowl with red onions
5. Add vinegar , sugar and salt
6. Let stand at room temperature 1 hour
7. Toss occasionally
8. Add tomatoes , mint and oil to cucumber mix and toss to blend
9. Season with salt and pepper

title: sloppy jose s
steps:
1. At medium to medium high heat brown the meat with the onions , green pepper , and garlic
2. Drain off the fat
3. Pour in tomato sauce , chipotle sauce , cumin powder and grated cheese
4. Stir until cheese is completely melted
5. Allow sauce to thicken
6. Reduce heat to low and stir in salt and pepper if desired
7. You may now add olives or chiles if you desire
8. Put thickened meat mixture on hamburger buns-- or if you can find the little bollo or bonito rolls at your grocery store use those if you like

title: mom s delicious cookies
steps:
1. Cream butter and sugars
2. Add eggs and vanilla , mixing well
3. Stir in dry ingrdients
4. Add cornflakes , oats and coconut
5. Drop by spoonfuls on cookie sheet
6. Makes about 5-6 doz
7. 2 1 / 2" cookies
8. Bake at 325 degrees for 8-12 min

title: matcha berry swirl smoothie
steps:
1. Blend the first 6 ingredients together to make a green smoothie
2. When finished blending , pour into a separate cup
3. Rinse out the blender
4. Blend the last 4 ingredients to make a berry smoothie
5. Pour into a separate cup
6. Get out four serving glasses , and pour in both smoothies at the same time from opposite sides
7. Enjoy !

title: ketchup toast
steps:
1. Toast bread
2. Spread with ketchup
3. Eat

title: spinach and chickpea curry
steps:
1. In a large heavy-based saucepan , heat the oil over medium heat and then add the garlic and onion
2. Cook , stirring frequently , for about 5 minutes or until the onion begins to soften
3. Add the curry paste and mustard seeds , stir to mix , and cook a further minute
4. Add the potatoes with 2 cups water , bring to the boil , then reduce heat and simmer gently , uncovered , for around 20 minutes or until the potatoes are almost tender and most of the water has evaporated - it is a good idea to stir occasionally
5. While the potatoes are cooking , press as much liquid as possible out of the spinach through a sieve , then chop roughly
6. Add the chickpeas and spinach to the potato mixture
7. Cook for a further five minutes , until the potatoes are tender , stirring frequently to prevent the mixture from sticking to the bottom of the pan
8. It may be necessary to add a splash more water , but take care the mixture does not become too wet
9. Stir in the paneer cheese and lime juice , and heat through gently
10. Season with salt and pepper to taste , and serve garnished with chopped cilantro

title: vanilla butter for pancakes  diabetic
steps:
1. Allow the butter to soften at room temperature for 30 minutes
2. Slice the vanilla bean lengthwise and scrape the meat from inside the bean
3. Combine the butter with the vanilla meat , splenda , and cinnamon
4. Mix well
5. Shape the butter into a small stick and wrap tightly in plastic wrap
6. Chill in refrigerator

title: greens and apples
steps:
1. In large saucepan , melt margarine over medium heat
2. Add apples and cook , stirring , until lightly browned
3. Add remaining ingredients
4. Cover and cook , stirring occasionally , until greens are tender
5. Serve immediately

title: lemon sorbet w kiwi   orange fruit sauce
steps:
1. Drain oranges , reserving juice
2. Set oranges aside
3. Combine juice and cornstarch in a small saucepan over med high heat
4. Bring to boil
5. Reduce heat to med , and cook 1 minute or until thickened
6. Place saucepan in a bowl of ice
7. Let stand 5 minutes or until cool , stirring often
8. Stir in oranges and kiwi
9. Spoon 1 / 2 cup sorbet into each of 6 dessert bowls
10. Spoon fruit sauce evenly over sorbet

title: cherry tomato soup  gary rhodes
steps:
1. Heat up the olive oil in a frying pan
2. Add the red onions to the pan over medium heat until the start to colour and become softened
3. About 3-4 minutes
4. When the onions begin to soften add the garlic and slowly cook both together until softened about a minute or so
5. Add the red wine vinegar to the pan and bring to a boil
6. Cook until only a bit of liquid is left
7. Add the cherry tomato halves to the pan and fry for 10 minutes , making sure to stir occasionally so they don't burn
8. Stir in the passata and vegetable stock to the tomato mixture , bring to a low boil , reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes more
9. Taste the broth then sprinkle sea salt and pepper over soup to your taste
10. Serving: you can serve with torn fresh basil leaves over top

title: parmesan crusted chicken with arugula salad
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 475 degrees
2. In a small bowl , whisk 2 teaspoons of the mustard with 2 teaspoons of the olive oil and the thyme
3. Season the chicken breasts , on both sides , with salt and pepper - then brush them all over with the mustard mixture
4. Pat about 2 t
5. Of the parmesan on each chicken breast - it should take about 1 / 2 cup total for all 4 breasts
6. Transfer the chicken breasts to a rimmed baking sheet
7. Bake the chicken on the top shelf of the oven for about 15 minutes , or until just cooked through and nicely browned
8. Meanwhile , in a salad bowl , combine the remaining 1 teaspoon each of mustard and oil
9. Then stir in the water
10. Add the arugula and tomatoes
11. Season with salt and pepper and toss well
12. Spoon the salad onto plates , top with the chicken and serve !

title: carrots with grape and port glaze
steps:
1. Peel or scrub and trim carrot tops , leaving about 1 1 / 2 inch of carrot top
2. Halve any thick carrots lengthwise
3. Place in a 4 quart dutch oven along with the rosemary sprigs
4. Add water to cover
5. Season with salt
6. Bring to boiling
7. Reduce heat
8. Simmer , covered for 8-10 minutes or until crisp-tender
9. Do not over cook
10. Drain carefully in a colander
11. Remove and discard rosemary sprigs
12. Add butter to the dutch oven
13. Heat just until butter melts
14. Return carrots to dutch oven and toss to coat
15. Arrange carrots on serving platter , top with some jelly

title: fran s very easy cherry crisp
steps:
1. Mix with pasty cutter the cake mix and butter , until crumbly
2. Add chopped nuts
3. Save out 1 / 3 cup
4. Press the mix into a greased 9 x 13 pan
5. Pour the pie filling over this crust and then sprinkle the 1 / 3 cup of nuts over the top of the cherries
6. Bake at 350 for 25 min serve warm with whip cream or ice cream

title: loaded potato casserole
steps:
1. Peel potatoes and cut into eighths
2. Place in large saucepan
3. Cover with water and bring to a boil over high heat
4. Reduce heat to low , cover and simmer 15 minute or until tender
5. Drain
6. Return potatoes to saucepan
7. Using potato masher , mash potatoes with milk
8. Blend in dip , salt and pepper
9. Place potato mixture into a shallow 2-quart baking dish
10. Sprinkle with cheese and bacon
11. Heat in a preheated 350 oven 20 minutes or until hot
12. If these are made ahead of time , the warming time will increase to about 45-60 minutes , depending on how cold the dish is when placed in the oven

title: world s easiest haddock
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a heavy saute pan at medium-high heat
2. Throw in the garlic
3. Sprinkle the fish with the italian dressing and seasoned salt
4. Put the fish in the pan , cover it and walk away for about three minutes
5. Come back , flip the fish over and cook for about another two minutes

title: luscious cream cheese pound cake
steps:
1. Heat oven to 325
2. Sift flour and baking powder together
3. Set aside
4. Combine the butter and cream cheese in a large bowl of an electric mixer
5. Mix until fluffy on medium speed
6. Beat in the sugar until mixture is light and creamy , about 4 minutes
7. Add 2 of the eggs , beating until combined
8. Beat in 1 cup of the flour mixture
9. Repeat twice with more eggs and flour , beating after each addition
10. Pour batter into a greased 10-inch tube pan
11. Bake until golden and a tester comes out clean , about 1 hour , 25 minutes

title: creamy ravioli florentine
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to directions , during last minute of cooking add spinach to pasta
2. Drain
3. Position oven rack so that top of 8-cup baking dish is about 2" from heat source
4. Preheat broiler
5. In a pot over med heat combine sauce and 1 cup cheese and stir until melted
6. In a bowl combine tomatoes , pasta , spinach and the sauce
7. Toss to coat
8. Transfer to baking dish and sprinkle with remaining cheese
9. Broil until cheese is lightly browned

title: thai chicken   cashews
steps:
1. Prepare all of your ingredients before starting this dish
2. Once started , it goes fast , and you won't have time to chop the veggies or find the oyster sauce in the back of the fridge !
3. Start rice cooking , if necessary
4. Using a wok , heat oil on a medium high heat
5. Being careful not to burn the garlic or chili peppers , add combined with the chicken
6. Stir-fry for two minutes , constantly stirring and flipping
7. Add onion , stir-fry for another minute or two
8. Turn heat down to medium
9. Add sugar , fish sauce , and oyster sauce
10. After another minute , add veggies and stock / water
11. Stir-fry until chicken is cooked
12. Add cashews , stir-fry for one more minute
13. Done ! as is the rice
14. Serve on a bed of rice

title: fast candied sweet potatoes
steps:
1. Drain off all but 1 / 4 cup liquid from potatoes
2. In medium saucepan melt butter
3. Add sugar and reserved liquid
4. Add potatoes
5. Stir to coat
6. Pour into medium casserole
7. Sprinkle with marshmallows
8. Add pecans if using
9. Put in oven and bake at 350 degrees till brown

title: algerian rice salad
steps:
1. Mix together all vinaigrette ingredients with wire whisk
2. Add pepper , pimento and onion to chilled rice
3. Mix well
4. Pour vinaigrette over rice
5. Add salt and pepper to taste
6. Place in 8 or 9-inch pan
7. Press firmly
8. Chill
9. Invert on serving plate
10. Decorate with hard-cooked eggs , mushrooms or olives

title: mixed berry jam
steps:
1. In a large saucepan over medium high heat , combine all the ingredients
2. Bring to a boil and simmer until jam is of desired thickness
3. Cool and place in plastic containers and freeze
4. Defrost in refrigerator before serving

title: cheesy fiesta chicken and rice bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees
2. Grease an oven safe dish with butter
3. Mix both soups , broth , milk , water and onion in a mixing bowl and set aside
4. Season chicken with salt , pepper and garlic powder to taste
5. Evenly spread rice into baking dish
6. Pour soup mixture over rice as evenly as possible
7. Place chicken into pan and cover
8. Bake in oven for 45 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink in the thickest part
9. Let dish stand for 3 minutes to allow sauce to thicken
10. While dish is standing , top each chicken piece with shredded cheese and salsa
11. Enjoy !

title: new york city knish
steps:
1. Peel , halve and boil potatoes until tender , 15-20 minutes
2. Mash in a large bowl
3. Saut onion in 1 1 / 2 tablespoons butter until translucent but not brown
4. Add to mashed potatoes with broth , salt , pepper and spices
5. Stir well
6. Melt remaining tablespoon of butter
7. Pre-heat oven to 375 degrees
8. Layer 3 sheets of phyllo dough and cut in half
9. Repeat with remaining 3 sheets
10. Spoon 1 cup of potato mixture on each section of phyllo , mold into a large ball and position off-center at one end of strip of dough
11. Roll ball along the length of phyllo , folding dough over bottom of filling and leaving some filling poking through the top
12. Brush melted butter over edges of knish to seal the seams and press down onto an ungreased baking sheet
13. Repeat with other knishes
14. Bake 30-40 minutes , until golden brown
15. Makes four knishes

title: easy mexican style chocolate cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Butter and flour a 12" x 18" inch pan
3. In a large bowl , stir together the flour , mexican chocolate , both sugars , baking soda and spices
4. In a separate bowl beat the butter or margarine , oil , water , buttermilk , eggs and vanilla , until smooth
5. Stir the dry ingredients into the butter / egg mixture just until moistened
6. Pour the batter evenly into the greased pan
7. Bake for 25-30 minutes , or until a toothpick inserted into the center of cake comes out clean
8. Allow to cool
9. Dust with powdered sugar and garnish with toasted slivered almonds if desired
10. Yield: one large 12" x18" cake , but i usually cut the recipe in half to make an 8" x 8" cake

title: nestle cookies   cream fudge
steps:
1. Line 9 inch square baking pan with foil
2. Combine sugar , butter and evaporated milk in medium saucepan
3. Bring to a full rolling boil , stirring constantly
4. Boil stirring constantly for 3 minute
5. Remove from heat
6. Stir in morsels , marshmallow creme , crushed cookies and vanilla extract
7. Pour into prepared pan
8. Sprinkle crumbled cookies on top
9. Gently swirl cookies into fudge using a knife without touching bottom of pan
10. Refrigerate for 1 hour or until firm
11. Lift from pan
12. Remove foil
13. Cut into pieces

title: bisquick cinnamon raisin biscuits
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425f
2. Stir all ingredients until soft dough forms
3. Drop by spoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet
4. Sprinkle with additional sugar , if desired
5. Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until golden

title: italian chocolate cookies
steps:
1. Cream butter , then cream shortening
2. Add sugar and mix
3. Add remaining ingredients and mix well until smooth consistency
4. Roll a golf-ball size amount of batter into a ball
5. Place on greased cookie sheet
6. Bake at 325 degrees about 25 minutes
7. Keep checking to see if they are not too doughy , or too done
8. Frost with white frosting
9. Italian white frosting: beat egg whites until stiff
10. Add sugar and juice
11. Stir until completely mixed
12. Dip chocolate cookies into frosting mixture upside down , holding onto bottom
13. Place on waxed paper until frosting dries
14. When dried , put into covered containers
15. Makes enough frosting for approximately 10 dozen cookies

title: zizania chicken salad
steps:
1. To cook wild rice , rinse 1 cup wild rice
2. Bring wild rice and 4 cups water to a boil over high heat
3. Stir
4. Reduce heat , cover and simmer about 50 minutes or until kernels puff and open
5. Makes about 3 cups cooked rice
6. Prepare orange-herb dressing
7. Set aside
8. Mix warm , cooked wild rice with 2 tablespoons orange-herb dressing
9. Mix well and cool
10. Add remaining ingredients including remaining dressing
11. Serve immediately or cover and refrigerate until serving

title: core spicy sweet potatoes with tangy lime and cilantro
steps:
1. Put oven rack in lower third of oven and preheat oven to 425f
2. Toss sweet potatoes with 2 tablespoons oil and 1 / 4 teaspoon salt in a shallow baking pan
3. Arrange potatoes in 1 layer and roast , stirring halfway through roasting , until tender , about 25 minutes total
4. Stir together cayenne , zest , and remaining 1 / 2 teaspoon salt in a small bowl
5. Whisk together lime juice and remaining tablespoon oil in a medium bowl , then add potatoes
6. Sprinkle with cayenne mixture and cilantro , stirring gently to combine
7. Makes 4 servings

title: chicken noodle   dumpling soup
steps:
1. In a large soup pot , put chicken pieces , broth , parsnips , carrots , celery , onions and salt and pepper
2. Add water to cover chicken , if necessary
3. Bring to a boil , then reduce heat and simmer for 1 hour
4. Add frozen peas
5. Mix bisquick and cream together
6. Drop by spoonfuls onto boiling soup
7. Reduce heat , cook for 10 minutes , uncovered
8. Cover and cook 10 minutes more or until dumplings are done
9. Meanwhile , cook 2 cups egg noodles in boiling , salted water 8-10 minutes or to desired doneness
10. Drain
11. Remove dumplings to a plate with a slotted spoon
12. In each soup bowl , place some of the noodles
13. Top with 2 pieces of the chicken and some of the soup
14. Add 2 dumplings to each bowl and garnish with parsley , if desired

title: eastern north carolina cole slaw
steps:
1. Remove outer leaves and core from cabbage
2. Cut head in half and grate fine
3. Combine all ingredients in a large bowl , add cabbage , and mix thoroughly
4. Chill for one hour before serving

title: cube steak with onion gravy
steps:
1. Salt and pepper steak and dredge in flour
2. Using a skillet , fry steak in oil only until just light brown on each side
3. In same skillet add water , ketchup and worcestershire sauce and let simmer on low heat for 15 to 20 minutes
4. Add onion rings and simmer 10 minutes
5. Push steak and onions to one side in skillet
6. Using pillsbury gravy flour , whisk in vigorously while gravy is bubbling and simmer 5 more minutes

title: mustard barbecue sauce
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a sauce pan and mix well
2. Bring to a simmer , and continue to simmer for 30 minutes , stirring often

title: sugar free pistachio jello salad
steps:
1. In a large bowl , empty the pudding mixes into a bowl
2. Add the entire tub of cool whip to the pudding and stir and mix in well
3. Add the marshmallows and shredded coconut and stir them in as well
4. You could add the bananas now , but they do brown some , so to keep them looking fresh i will add them just before the jello will be served
5. Put saran wrap over the bowl and put in the fridge and chill for at least 3 hours
6. You may want to stir the jello again before you serve it , just to incorperate the ingredients again

title: southwest stroganoff
steps:
1. Brown hamburger
2. Stir water , salsa and pasta into meat
3. Heat to boiling , reduce heat
4. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes
5. Peek after 10 mins to make sure you don't need to add more water
6. Stir in sour cream

title: coconut macaroon brownies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Spray pan with pan spray
3. Top layer:
4. Mix egg whites till foamy
5. Slowly add sugar
6. Beat till soft peaks
7. Mix in flour , coconut , and chips
8. Set aside
9. Bottom layer:
10. Mix all remaining ingredients
11. Put bottom layer in pan
12. Put top layer on top
13. Bake for 35 minutes

title: rochelle s chocolate chip cookies  betty crocker
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Mix shortening and butter in medium bowl
3. Add sugars
4. Cream together
5. Add eggs and vanilla
6. In separate bowl , mix flour , soda , and salt
7. Add flour mixture to sugar mixture
8. Stir in chocolate chips when partially mixed
9. Drop by rounded spoonfuls 8-10 minutes
10. Let cool on cookie sheet about 1 minute , then transfer to cooling rack to cool completely

title: muenster cheese pie
steps:
1. Beat egg and add flour and milk
2. Add remaining inredients , except for garnishes , and beat with a whisk
3. Grease 9 inch pie plate and pour mixture into pie pate
4. Bake at 450 degrees for 30 minutes
5. Let cool and add garnish if desired
6. Slice into wedges

title: simply seared opah
steps:
1. Sqeeze lemon all over both sides of fish
2. Salt and pepper both sides of fish
3. Heat olive oil in frying pan
4. Sear fish over high heat for about 3-4 minutes per side
5. Serve

title: fresh lemon basil salad dressing
steps: 1. Mix together and chill until serving

title: szechuan lychee smoked duck
steps:
1. Clean duck , rub inside and out with lots of pepper powder and a bit of salt
2. Put half the ginger and spring onion inside
3. Pour shao hsing wine on top and rest of ginger and spring onion
4. Leave to marinate for at least 45 minutes
5. Once marinated , boil enough water to cover the duck and boil for 15 minutes
6. Drain water and pat dry the duck
7. Put sugar , tea and spices into the wok and heat over low heat until fragrant , constantly stirring
8. Put a metal frame type thing so the duck won't touch the spices
9. Put the duck on top and cover the wok
10. Smoke on very low heat for 45 minutes
11. There will be lots of oil and the sugar will burn and stick , so use a wok that has already sustained a lot of damage
12. Once done , take out the duck
13. Traditionally , the duck is deep fried to make the skin crispy , but duck is already really fatty , so we roasted it in a very hot oven on a roasting rack so the fat drains out
14. Roast until skin is crispy enough , but make sure you don't overcook it
15. Enjoy with peking duck pancakes , hoisin sauce and sliced cucumber

title: brazilian churrasco  brazilian barbecued beef
steps:
1. Preheat grill
2. Cut tenderloin into about six pieces
3. Reduce heat and place tenderloin pieces on the grill
4. As the meat started to cook dissolve the salt in the water and add the garlic
5. When the meat is browned on the outside baste
6. Keep basting throughout until the meat is done

title: juicy crock pot garlic chicken with wild rice
steps:
1. Stir together chicken broth and wild rice seasoning packet in crock pot
2. Stir in onion , bell pepper , garlic , oil , and rice
3. Arrange chicken on top
4. Cover and cook on low for 5 to 6 hours

title: brie soup
steps:
1. Saut onions , shallots , and mushrooms in margarine for 5 minutes in a non stick skillet
2. Add 3 tbsp sherry and chicken stock and simmer for 10 minutes
3. Add milk and cheese and stir until cheese is melted and soup begins to thicken
4. Combine cornstarch and remaining 3 tbsp of sherry and stir into soup
5. Continue cooking until soup is thickened
6. Season with pepper and nutmeg
7. Taste
8. Add salt if needed

title: slow cooker corned beef and cabbage chowder
steps:
1. In a 4 to 6-quart slow cooker , combine the corned beef , potatoes , cabbage , carrots , onions , chicken broth , and cream of potato soup
2. Cover and cook on low for 4 to 5 hours , stirring about halfway through cooking
3. Add 1 cup of half-and-half and salt and pepper , to taste
4. Cover and cook for 25 minutes longer
5. Add more milk or more half-and-half to thin slightly , if desired

title: movie night pretzel dogs with sweet curry mayo
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Prick hot dogs with a fork , then twist dough around each one
3. Brush with egg , and sprinkle with salt
4. Bake until golden brown , about 12-15 minutes
5. In a small bowl , mix mayo , curry powder , and honey , for dipping

title: baked seasoned beet crisps
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Peel beets and slice into very thin slices
3. Mix the remaining ingredients together in a small bowl
4. In a large ziploc bag place the beets and contents of bowl
5. Shake well to make sure beets are completely coated with liquid
6. Place beets on a baking sheet coated with nonstick cooking spray and bake for 45 minutes to an hour turning beets halfway through
7. Keep an eye on them to make sure they dont burn

title: easy buffalo chicken pizza
steps:
1. Boil chicken in water till done
2. Remove chicken from water , either can diced it or shred it , however you like
3. In a small / medium bowl , dump chicken in bowl , pour sauce , to cover the chicken , toss it well
4. Pour half of the packet of sauce , spread on crust
5. Sprinkle and spread shredded cheese on
6. Sprinkle hot sauce on top of cheese
7. Spread buffalo chicken onto crust
8. Bake in oven at 400 for 15 minutes

title: peach and cucumber salsa
steps: 1. Toss all ingredients together in a large bowl then serve

title: turkey glazed with chamomile  sage and honey
steps:
1. Turn oven to 375degrees f
2. Remove turkey giblets and neck from turkey cavity and place in a pot with 3 cups water
3. Boil on low for hour and save for turkey gravy
4. Wash and pat turkey dry
5. Mix pepper , salt and sage in a bowl
6. Place turkey in roasting pan
7. Rub turkey with salt , pepper , and sage
8. Cover with foil and refrigerate for an hour at least
9. Brew one chamomile tea bag in 1 / 2 cup hot water for 5 minutes
10. In a small pot mix honey , oil or butter and chopped sage contents of the other tea bag together over a low flame
11. Brush mixture all over the turkey
12. Sprinkle fresh pepper over turkey
13. Place turkey bacon in strips over the turkey
14. Roast turkey for one hour , basting with pan juices
15. Reduce heat to 350 for 1 hour
16. Pour 1 / 2 cup of chamomile tea over turkey
17. Roast for another hour and a half
18. Transfer turkey onto your serving platter
19. Cover loosely with foil and leave for hour before serving

title: cherry currant  sweet and sour sauce
steps:
1. In a small saucepan , combine the maraschino cherry juice , vinegar , and jelly
2. Stir over moderate heat , stirring until jelly has melted
3. Dissolve the cornstarch in the 1 / 4 cup water
4. Stir into sauce
5. Cook until thickened , stirring constantly
6. Add water , little by little if it is too thick

title: leftover meatloaf chili
steps:
1. In a medium sized saucepan , combine beans , tomatoes , and chili seasoning
2. Heat and stir until seasonings are well blended
3. Add meatloaf and stir until meat is heated , about 15 minutes
4. Divide into two serving bowls , and if desired top with equal amount of cheese

title: lemony garlic butter chicken breasts
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees
2. Butter an 11 x 7 or a 13 x 9-inch baking dish
3. In a shallow dish combine the breadcrumbs with parmesan cheese , seasoned salt , black pepper , garlic powder and dried parsley until well combined
4. Place the milk in a bowl ,
5. In the small bowl whisk together the melted butter with 1 tablespoon fresh minced garlic and lemon juice
6. Coat the chicken breast in milk then coat into the breadcrumb mixture
7. Place the breasts into baking dish , then drizzle with the melted butter mixture
8. Bake uncovered for 25-30 minutes or until the chicken is cooked

title: slow cooker corned beef and cabbage
steps:
1. Place corned beef brisket and any seasonings included in your slow cooker
2. Top with onion
3. Whisk together the vinegar , brown sugar , mustard , pepper and cloves and pour over top
4. Add the cabbage wedges and apple slices and caraway seeds if using them
5. Pour beer over top
6. Cover and cook on low for about 7 hours or high for about 4-5 hours

title: dutch apple fritters  apelbeignets
steps:
1. Peel and core apples and cut into lengthwise slices between 1 / 3 and 1 / 2 inch thick
2. Mix beer with flour and salt until smooth and free of lumps
3. Dip apple slices into batter and let excess drip off
4. Fry a few slices at a time in fat heated to 370 f
5. Turn once so they become golden brown on both sides--about 4 minutes in all
6. Drain one a paper towel and serve warm sprinkled with sugar
7. Makes 6 to 10 servings
8. Vanillasugar: place 1 pound confectioners' or granulated sugar in a jar with 2 or 3 vanilla beans
9. Close jar tightly and let stand for 48 hours before using
10. Replenish sugar as it is used up
11. Use as called for in individual recipes
12. Beans need replacing only after 4 or 5 months
13. Visions of sugarplums

title: fruit cocktail pudding
steps:
1. Mix all batter ingredients well with wooden spoon
2. Pour into large greased pie dish
3. Bake at 350f for 40 50 minutes
4. Boil together topping ingredients for 5 minutes
5. As pudding comes out of oven stab it all over with a knife and pour topping over

title: hamburger or sandwich buns or hot dog buns
steps:
1. Dissolve yeast in water with a pinch of sugar
2. Mix in with other ingredients
3. Knead for 10 minutes on a floured surface
4. Let rise until doubled in bulk
5. Punch down and let rise again
6. Punch down and form into bun shapes
7. Make them on the small side as they do raise a little more when you bake them
8. Let rise until double
9. Bake at 375 degrees for 20 minutes
10. Let cool until just warm to the touch
11. Place in a sealed bag to soften crust
12. Makes 16-20 hamburger rolls
13. Double wrap and freeze any remaining ones

title: grilled herbed salmon
steps:
1. Melt the butter or place the olive oil in a bowl
2. Add the remaining ingredients , except for salmon , and mix well
3. Grill salmon skin side down at medium low temperature
4. Use tinfoil shaped into a pan to protect grille and hold sauce
5. Pour butter sauce over fish , close grille and cook just until fish begins to flake , approximately 10-12 minutes
6. Slip spatula between fish and skin and remove salmon to serving platter
7. Pour any remaining sauce over fish

title: apricot  cranberry   almond stuffed brie
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine apricots , preserves , cranberries , and almonds
2. Using a sharp knife , cut the brie horizontally creating two equals thick slices
3. Spread fruit mixture onto the cut center of brie
4. Top with other half of brie
5. Heat at 300 degrees until just warm

title: peachy strawberry smoothie
steps:
1. Place ingredients in a blender & mix until smooth
2. Pour into 2 glasses & enjoy !

title: old time chicken and biscuits
steps:
1. Make biscuits:
2. Put oven rack in middle position and preheat oven to 450f
3. Blend together flour and butter in a bowl with a pastry blender or your finger
4. Stir in milk with a fork just until a sticky dough forms
5. Turn dough out onto a floured surface and gently knead 7 or 8 times ,
6. Pat dough into a 9- by 6-inch rectangle on a lightly floured surface , then cut into 6 squares
7. Arrange squares 1 inch apart on an ungreased baking sheet and bake until golden brown , 15 to 18 minutes
8. Cool to warm on baking sheet on a rack
9. Make chicken in gravy while biscuits bake:
10. Cook onion , carrot , celery , salt , and pepper in butter in a 10-inch heavy skillet over moderate heat , stirring occasionally , until vegetables are softened , 8 to 10 minutes
11. Sprinkle flour over vegetables and cook , stirring , 1 minute
12. Stir in broth and thyme and bring to a boil , stirring , then boil over moderate heat , stirring occasionally , 2 minutes
13. Add half-and-half and chicken to gravy and gently simmer until chicken is heated through , about 3 minutes
14. Stir in lemon juice
15. To serve:
16. Halve biscuits and put each bottom half in a shallow bowl
17. Spoon chicken in gravy over biscuit bottoms and cover with biscuit tops

title: white chocolate and raspberry cheesecake
steps:
1. For crust------------
2. Preheat oven to 350f degrees
3. Place large piece of foil on heavy large baking sheet
4. Set 8x2-inch bottomless heart-shaped cake pan atop foil
5. Wrap foil around outside and 1 inch up sides of pan
6. Butter foil and pan
7. Finely grind cookies and almonds in processor
8. Add butter and blend until mixture forms very moist crumbs
9. Using plastic wrap as aid , press crumbs firmly onto bottom and 2 inches up sides of pan
10. Bake until golden , about 10 minutes
11. Cool
12. Maintain oven temperature
13. For filling--------------
14. Melt white chocolate in top of double boiler over simmering water until smooth , stirring often
15. Remove from over water
16. Using electric mixer , beat cream cheese , sugar , vanilla and peel in large bowl until smooth
17. Add eggs 1 at a time , beating just until combined
18. Beat in white chocolate
19. Spoon half of batter into crust
20. Top with 3 / 4 cup berries
21. Spoon remaining batter over
22. Bake until edges of cake are set but center 3 inches still moves when cake is shaken , about 45 minutes
23. Let cool for 20 minutes
24. Using finger
25. For topping------------------
26. Whisk sour cream , sugar and vanilla in bowl
27. Spoon over cake , spreading to edge of pan
28. Bake 5 minutes
29. Transfer cake in pan to rack
30. Run small knife around sides of cake
31. Cool completely and chill cake overnight
32. Fold down foil along sides of pan
33. Lift cake pan off cheesecake
34. Transfer cheesecake to platter , discarding foil
35. Cover cake with berries
36. Bring jam to simmer in small saucepan , stirring often
37. Gently brush jam over berries

title: crispy squid with garlic mayonnaise
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a smallish saucepan and while it's left to heat up cut the thawed squid into 1 / 2-inch rings
2. Put the cornstarch , semolina and seasoning into a plastic freezer bag
3. Add the squid rings and tentacles and then toss to coat
4. When the oil is hot enough , which is when it sizzles up fiercely when you drop in a small cube of bread , fry the squid in batches to get the most golden crunchiness
5. A couple of minutes per batch is all you should need
6. Mince the garlic into the mayonnaise to serve alongside the fried squid

title: the lady and sons pecan chicken   paula deen
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Melt butter in a 10 x 15-inch baking pan
3. In a shallow dish , combine buttermilk and egg
4. In another dish combine flour , pecans , salt , paprika , pepper , and sesame seeds
5. Dip chicken in buttermilk , then in flour
6. Place skin side down in melted butter
7. Turn to coat and leave skin side up
8. Sprinkle with pecan halves
9. Bake for 1 1 / 4 hours

title: spinach salad with warm maple dressing
steps:
1. Toast pecans in a small dry skillet over low heat , stirring often , until fragrant , 2 to 3 minutes
2. Transfer to a small bowl and let cool
3. Toss spinach and cucumber in a salad bowl
4. Heat oil in a small skillet over medium-low heat
5. Add shallot and cook , stirring , until softened , about 4 minutes
6. Add vinegar and maple syrup and bring to a boil
7. Season with salt and pepper
8. Immediately pour dressing over the spinach and cucumber
9. Toss well and sprinkle with cheese and toasted pecans

title: chicken cheddary fajitas
steps:
1. Pour dressing into shallow nonmetallic dish
2. Add chicken and turn to coat
3. Cover and refrigerate 30 minutes , turning occasionally
4. Remove chicken from marinade
5. Discard marinade
6. Grill or broil chicken 15 minutes or until done , turning once
7. Mix soup and salsa in saucepan
8. Heat through
9. Slice chicken and red pepper into thin strips and place down center of each tortilla
10. Top with onions , avocado and soup mixture
11. Fold tortilla around filling

title: instant pot lemon chicken orzo soup
steps:
1. 1
2. Start the instant pot in saute mode and heat it
3. Add oil , onions and garlic
4. Stir and saut for 2 minutes
5. 2
6. Add chicken and mix with the onions
7. Spread them in the pot and let them saut for 3 minutes
8. 3
9. Add carrots , celery , orzo , salt , pepper and broth
10. Stir well
11. Press cancel and close the lid with vent in sealing position
12. 4
13. Set the instant pot on pressure cook mode at high pressure for 6 minutes
14. 5
15. When the instant pot beeps , quick release the pressure manually
16. Open lid and stir the soup
17. Remove bay leaf and rosemary sprig
18. 6
19. Stir in spinach lemon juice until spinach is mixed in the soup
20. Press saut and let the soup come to a quick boil in about a minute
21. Stir in the cream
22. 7
23. Soup is ready to be served
24. Offer shredded parmesan when serving this creamy lemony soup
25. If you are making this soup ahead
26. Do not add cream
27. Do this only after you have reheated your soup and are ready to serve it
28. Cooking time does not include the time needs to reheat and cool down the instant pot

title: refried beans from scratch
steps:
1. Rinse beans under cold running water , picking out any debris or bad beans
2. Place beans , water , 1 t shortening and sliced onion to a 3 quart saucepan
3. Bring to boil over high heat then reduce heat to low , cover and simmer for 1
4. 5 hours , or just until beans are tender , not soft
5. Stir in salt , cover and simmer over very low heat for 30-45 min until beans are very soft
6. Do not drain
7. Heat remaining 1 / 3 c shortening in heavy large skillet over high heat until very hot
8. Add chopped onion and garlic
9. Reduce heat to medium
10. Cook and stir 4 min until onion is softened
11. Increase heat to high
12. Add 1 cup undrained beans
13. Cook and stir , mashing the beans with a a potato masher
14. As beans begin to dry , add another 1 cup undrained beans
15. Cook and stir mashing beans
16. Repeat until all the beans and cooking liquid have been added and the mixture is a coarse puree
17. Adjust heat as needed to prevent burning
18. Total smashing time is about 20 minute

title: greeninger onion kichel  sweet onion crackers
steps:
1. Put onions in a large bowl and beat in eggs and oil
2. Add flour , baking powder , pepper , salt , and water
3. Use a ladle and take some dough and roll it out on a floured board and cut into square pieces
4. Bake on a cookie sheet about 45 minutes , until done , at 350 degrees
5. Watch so they don't burn

title: homer s traditional pico de gallo
steps:
1. In a good sized bowl , place tomatoes , onion and peppers and stir well , then add cilantro
2. Place kosher salt in a mound in center of tomato mix , and dissolve with juice squeezed directly from the limes
3. Mix well and serve directly , or chill

title: crustless cheesecake st  pierre
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Place cottage cheese and milk in blender
3. Liquify until smooth and shiny
4. Remove to large mixing bowl or standing mixer and cream with the cream cheese
5. When well creamed , gradually add sugar 1 / 2 cup at a time , mixing well after each addition
6. In a separate bowl , combine flour and cornstarch and mix well
7. Slowly add into batter
8. Add eggs one at a time , beating well after each addition
9. Add lemon juice and vanilla to batter and beat well
10. Supposedly , one cannot "over-beat" this cake
11. Add softened , not melted , butter , beat well
12. Add sour cream , beat well
13. Pour into a well greased 9-inch spring-form pan
14. Bake one hour at 325 degrees f
15. Turn oven off and allow cake to remain inside over one hour more
16. Do not open the oven door
17. Cake may rise above pan sides during first hour , but will settle during second hour
18. Cool on a wire rack before removing cake from pan
19. Add topping as desired
20. Refrigerate before slicing , or , top each slice with fresh or prepared fruit

title: sausage apple   dried cranberry stuffing
steps:
1. Discard the end pieces of bread
2. Then remove the crust off bread and cut into even sized cubes
3. In a 350 degree , oven bake the bread cubes until slightly dry , about 15 minutes
4. Cool completely
5. Set aside
6. Saute & break up sausages in a large , heavy pan until cooked through
7. Remove and drain sausage
8. Pour off drippings from pan and add butter , melt , then add leeks , apples , celery and poultry seasoning , saute until leeks are soft , about 8 minutes
9. Mix in dried cranberries and rosemary
10. Transfer the onion mixture to a large mixing bowl , add sausage , then bread , season with salt and pepper
11. Or if completing the same day add the beaten eggs , mix well , wait 15 mins and add the turkey broth
12. Transfer to buttered baking dish and cover with buttered foil , bake for 45 mins , remove foil for last 15 mins until golden brown
13. Add in the sausage to the portion that won't be vegetarian

title: mexican pork with escabeche spice rub
steps:
1. Make the escabeche sauce by mixing the all the ingredients
2. Spread evenly over the pork tenderloins
3. Place tenderloins on a rack in a 9x 13 pan
4. Roast in a 450f degrees oven
