5. Internal temperature should read 155f , check after 15 minutes and then every 5 minutes
6. Do not over cook or it will be dry
7. Slice thinly across the grain , arrange on a platter and place orange sliced all around the meat

title: corn  n spaghetti
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f degrees
2. Mix all the ingredients together in a buttered cassarole dish
3. Bake covered for 30 minutes
4. Uncover and bake for another 30 minutes
5. Serve

title: moroccan olive flatbread
steps:
1. Make the spice mixture by mixing all of the seasonings in a small bowl
2. Set aside
3. Place the flour , sugar , salt , pepper and olives in a large mixing bowl and stir to combine
4. Add the olive oil and stir well with a fork
5. Add the water and continue to stir until a ball forms
6. Sprinkle a work surface generously with flour and turn the dough out onto the surface
7. Knead until the dough is velvety smooth , about 2 minutes
8. Wrap the dough in plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 1 hour
9. Preheat the oven to 400f
10. Take the dough from the refrigerator and flatten into a disk on a floured surface
11. Using a rolling pin , roll the dough out as thinly as possible into an oval
12. Roll the dough onto the pin and transfer it to a baking sheet that has been brushed with olive oil
13. Brush the dough with olive oil and sprinkle with the spice mixture
14. Place the pan in the oven until the bread is crisp and deep golden brown , about 20 minutes
15. Remove from the oven , let cool , and break into pieces
16. The flatbread can be made up to 2 days in advance , wrapped in plastic wrap , and kept in a dry place
17. Enjoy !

title: enchilada stuffed shells
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to package directions
2. Drain
3. In a nonstick skillet , cook turkey over medium heat until no longer pink
4. Drain
5. Stir in enchilada sauce and seasonings
6. Set aside
7. Place a rounded teaspoonful of refried beans in each pasta shell , then fill with turkey mixture
8. Place in an 11-in
9. X 7-in
10. X 2-in
11. Baking dish coated with nonstick cooking spray
12. Cover and bake at 350 for 25 minutes
13. Uncover
14. Sprinkle with cheese
15. Bake 5 minutes longer or until cheese is melted

title: herbed spaghetti with butter
steps:
1. In a large pot of boiling salted water , cook pasta until al dente according to package instructions
2. Drain , reserving 1 / 2 cup pasta water
3. Return pasta to pot
4. Stir in butter , lemon zest , juice , and herbs
5. Season with salt and pepper
6. Add some of the reserved pasta water to adjust consistency , if needed
7. Serve

title: roasted asparagus sprinkled with feta  olive oil and dill
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 220c
2. Toss the asparagus with 2 tablespoons olive oil , salt , and pepper
3. Place in a large shallow baking pan in one layer and roast until tender , abut 10-15 minutes
4. Shake the pan once about halfway through roasting , to keep the asparagus from burning
5. Remove and transfer to a serving plate
6. Whisk together the remaining olive oil and lemon juice
7. Pour over the asparagus , sprinkle the pink peppercorns , feta , and dill on top , and serve , garnished if desired with a wedge of lemon

title: blt ranch salad pizza   pampered chef
steps:
1. Bake crust according to instructions
2. Cool completely
3. Combine cream cheese , 1 / 4 cup ranch dressing & garlic
4. Spread evenly over crust
5. Top with lettuce , tomatoes , cheese , olives , onion & bacon
6. Drizzle with remaining dressing
7. Serve !

title: amaretto almond sauce
steps:
1. Combine sugar and cornstarch in a small saucepan
2. Stir in water
3. Place over medium heat
4. Bring to a boil , stirring constantly
5. Cook 2 minutes of until thickened , stirring constantly
6. Stir in amaretto and lemon juice
7. Heat just until mixture comes to a boil
8. Remove from heat
9. Stir in almonds and extract
10. Serve warm or chilled

title: skinnygirl lower fat pasta carbonara
steps:
1. Cook the spaghetti according to the package directions
2. Meanwhile , in a large bowl , whisk together the soy milk , eggs , parmesan , half the garlic salt , and half the pepper
3. When the pasta is done , drain it and quickly put it directly into the bowl with the egg mixture
4. Toss to coat
5. The hot pasta will cook the eggs
6. When the pasta is coated with the egg mixture , mix in the butter , turkey bacon , red pepper flakes , and the remaining garlic salt and pepper
7. Serve immediately

title: meatloaf   the way i remember it
steps:
1. In a small skillet , heat olive oil to saute onions until slightly golden
2. Then add the garlic and continue to saute for 1 to 2 minutes longer
3. Cool slightly
4. In a bowl combine the milk , eggs , salt , pepper , and ketchup mix well
5. Add the bread crumbs , mix , add the beef , pork , and onions mix well
6. Place into a loaf baking dish removing any air pockets
7. In a small bowl mix the glaze ingredients and pour over the meatloaf
8. Bake in a 350 degree oven for 60 to 75 minutes
9. Remove when internal temperature is 155 degrees
10. Let stand 15 minutes prior to serving

title: jacob s salad
steps:
1. For dressing , blend everything in blender and slowly add 1 / 2 c oil
2. Add celery seed
3. Pour dressing over salad ingredients and toss gently
4. Cooked chopped chicken breast can be added to make a complete meal

title: sesame tofu
steps:
1. Wrap tofu with paper towels and place on a cutting board
2. Put a heavy plate on top to press out liquid for approximately 20 minutes
3. Stir sauce ingredients together in a saucepan
4. Simmer sauce while you cook the tofu
5. Dry drained tofu with paper towels and cube
6. Dust very lightly with cornstarch
7. Heat 1" oil in deep frying pan
8. Fry tofu in 350 degree f oil until golden brown
9. Place fried tofu in a large bowl and toss with 2 / 3 cup sauce , sprinkle liberally with sesame seeds and scallions
10. Toss gently
11. Serve remaining sauce for dipping or drizzled over vegetables

title: instant chocolate pudding mix
steps:
1. Dry mix
2. In a large bowl or plastic container with a lid , combine the cocoa , cornstarch , sugar , instant non-fat dry milk , and salt
3. Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 1 month
4. Pudding
5. Place 1 3 / 4 cups of dry pudding mix into a medium saucepan
6. Add milk and heavy cream and whisk to combine
7. Over medium heat , bring mixture to a boil , continuously whisking gently
8. Reduce heat to low and cook for 4 minutes while continuing to whisk
9. Remove from heat and stir in vanilla
10. Pour the mixture through a sieve and into individual dishes or a 1 1 / 2-quart serving dish
11. Cover the surface of the pudding with plastic wrap
12. Place in the refrigerator to chill completely before serving , approximately 4 hours

title: yogurt with tropical fruit
steps:
1. Mix the the fruit , honey and ginger in a bowl
2. Spoon 1 / 2 cup yogurt into each serving bowl and top each with 1 / 2 cup graola , and 3 / 4 cup fruit mixture , top with 1 / 2 cup yogurt over the fruit
3. Garnish with more chopped ginger , if desired
4. Repeat with remaining bowls

title: vine ripened tomatoes with garlic and basil
steps:
1. Blanch tomatoes in boiling water until skins split
2. If you make a little cross on the bottom end they will split faster
3. You don't want to cook the tomatoes
4. As soon as you see that they will peel easily , plunge into ice water to cool
5. Peel the tomatoes , and dice
6. Put in bowl
7. Mince the garlic and add to the bowl
8. Toss in the chopped basil and drizzle with olive oil until lightly coated
9. Add salt and pepper to taste
10. Place covered bowl into refrigerator and chill
11. They are now ready to eat

title: katia s apple pie
steps:
1. Peel the apples and cut them into pieces
2. Put in a saucepan the apples , one glass of water , the glass of sugar and the cinnamon stick
3. Let them boil until the apples are more like applesauce , approximately 50 minutes
4. In mixer bowl , blend the shortening with the rest of the sugar for 3-4 minutes and then add the egg
5. Continue for 2 minutes more
6. Then add slowly the flour using hand to make a dough
7. In a baking pan put at the bottom foil
8. Divide the dough in half
9. Place by fingers half of the dough at the bottom of the pan
10. Remove the cinnamon stick and layer the apples
11. The rest of the dough shape it into a disk on a foil and then turn it over the apples
12. Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour

title: brownie swirl cheesecake
steps:
1. Grease bottom of 9-inch springform pan
2. Prepare basic brownie mix as directed on package
3. Pour batter evenly into springform pan
4. Bake at 350f 15 minutes
5. Beat cream cheese , sugar and vanilla , mixing at medium speed on electric mixer until well blended
6. Add eggs , one at a time , mixing well after each addition
7. Pour over brownie layer
8. Spoon melted chocolate over cream cheese mixture
9. Cut through batter with knife several times for marble effect
10. Bake at 350f for 35 minutes
11. Loosen cake from rim of pan
12. Cool before removing rim of pan
13. Chill
14. Decorate with whipped cream and chocolate flakes

title: tomato barley stew
steps:
1. In a soup pot , bring water to a boil
2. Add barley , lower heat to a simmer , cover and cook until barley is tender
3. Add oil to frying pan and set over medium heat
4. When the oil is hot , add the onions , garlic , carrot , basil and tarragon
5. When the onions are lightly browned , add the veggies , with the canned tomatoes to the broccoli
6. Add the tomato juice
7. Cook 30 min more , covered , stirring occasionally
8. Add salt and pepper to taste
9. Serve hot

title: sunny s avenue j pizza
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f
2. Put the mushrooms in a saucepan with the white wine vinegar and cook until theyre just about tender and drain the vinegar out
3. Slice the bread to create 2 pizzas and put them crust side up on an oiled baking sheet
4. In a bowl , squeeze the tomatoes and break them up by hand then place on the pizza halves
5. Pull the pieces of buffalo mozzarella from the ball and place on the pizzas
6. Top with the mushrooms , shredded mozarella , garlic and pepperoni
7. Bake until the cheese is melted and crust is crispy , about 15-20 minutes
8. Remove from the oven and sprinkle with the fresh basil and parmesan

title: cheddar barbecued burgers
steps:
1. Mix first four ingredients together
2. Shape into 12 hamburger patties
3. Grill on each side for 3 to 5 minutes or until no longer pink
4. The last few seconds of cooking top with cheddar cheese
5. When done place on toasted sesame-seed hamburger buns

title: cranberry walnut cheesecake pie
steps:
1. In large bowl beat milk , pudding mix and lemon peel with wire whisk for 1 minute
2. Whisk in half of the whipped topping
3. Carefully spread half of pudding mixture in crust
4. Spoon half of cranberry sauce over pudding mixture
5. Sprinkle with half of the walnuts
6. Top with remaining pudding mixture
7. Refrigerate at least 4 hours or until set
8. Top with remaining cranberry sauce , whipped topping and walnuts
9. Garnish as desired
10. Store in refrigerator
11. Bake at 350f for 5 to 7 minutes or until light golden brown , stirring once or twice

title: savory chicken cheesecake with cranberry orange relish
steps:
1. Heat oven to 300f
2. Lightly grease an 8-inch springform pan
3. In a mixing bowl , beat cream cheese until fluffy
4. Beat in onion dip , flour and dill weed
5. Beat in eggs , one at a time , untli well blended
6. Fold in chicken
7. Spread in pan
8. Bake about 1 1 / 4 hours or until edge is golden brown and center is firm
9. Cool 15 minutes
10. Run metal spatula along side of cheesecake to loosen
11. Cover tightly and refrigerate at least 4 hours
12. Remove side of pan
13. Spoon relish onto top of cheesecake
14. Sprinkle with walnuts
15. Cut into thin wedges and serve with crackers or veggies for dipping

title: cheesy spinach pasta with scallops
steps:
1. In large skillet over medium heat , melt butter with oil
2. Add scallops and saut 2-3 minutes or until opaque
3. Stir in vegetables
4. Saut for 4 minutes
5. Add cream and parmesan cheese and stir until well blended
6. Reduce heat and simmer until sauce thickens , about 8-10 minutes
7. Add boursin cheese and stir until well blended
8. In heated serving dish , toss warm fettuccine with scallop mixture
9. Add salt & pepper to taste
10. Serve immediately

title: oven style scotch eggs
steps:
1. Shell hard-boiled eggs
2. In a small bowl combine sausage meat with sage , garlic powder , onion powder , cayenne pepper and black pepper
3. Divide sausage into 8 equal portions , flatten each portion to about 1 / 8-inch thickness
4. Roll each egg in flour and place on top of each sausage patty
5. Use each sausage patty to wrap around each egg until it is completely encased , pressing edges together to seal
6. Beat the egg in a shallow dish and place breadcrumbs on a flat plate
7. Dip each sausage-coated eggs in beaten egg and roll in crumbs
8. Place on baking tray lined with aluminum foil and bake in oven at 375f for 25 to 30 minutes until golden brown
9. For a crispy crust spray very lightly with pam baking spray before baking
10. When ready to serve , line platter with lettuce and arrange scotch eggs , cut in half , among the lettuce

title: lemony iced tea
steps:
1. In a large pitcher , combine water , sugar , lemon juice , grape juice & tea mix
2. Stir well to dissolve the sugar
3. Chill before serving , or if using ice cubes , add ice to a glass & then add the tea

title: beef tenderloin with mustard sauce
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Coat steaks with pepper on both sides
3. Heat a cast-iron skillet over medium heat until very hot
4. Sear steaks for 5 minutes on each side , then transfer to oven to finish cooking , about 8 minutes for medium rare
5. Transfer to a plate to rest while you make the sauce
6. In the same skillet that steaks were cooked in , cook shallots in oil over medium heat until translucent , 6 minutes
7. Add brandy , and cook , stirring constantly , until reduced to 1 tablespoon , 1 minute
8. Stir in mustard and cream
9. Bring to a simmer and season to taste with salt and pepper
10. Serve sauce alongside the steaks

title: quick fix beef burrito skillet
steps:
1. Brown meat in a large skillet on medium-high heat
2. Drain
3. Add seasoning mix , beans , salsa and water
4. Stir
5. Bring to boil
6. Reduce heat to medium-low
7. Simmer 5 minutes
8. Stir in tortillas
9. Top with cheese
10. Cover
11. Let stand 5 minutes or until cheese is melted
12. Top with sour cream and onions

title: roasted asparagus  the best i ve ever tried
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f
2. In large bowl combine asparagus , oil , salt and pepper and toss well
3. Place on baking sheet and roast 13-15 minutes

title: cherry vanilla oatmeal
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients
2. Microwave for 90 seconds
3. Serve with more milk

title: saffron buns  lussekatter
steps:
1. The ingredients are the same as for cinnamon rolls , follow the same directions
2. Add the saffron to the liquid and mix
3. Add the egg as the dough is kneaded
4. Take a piece of dough , roll it out into a long string , thick as your finger and about 4-5 in long
5. Roll up both ends in opposite circles until they meet about midway
6. Place a raisin into the center of each circle
7. This is called a"lussekatt"
8. Let the"lussekatt"'s rise about 30-40 min in a nondrafty environment
9. Baste with whipped egg and bake in 420-440 f , or until golden

title: griddled trout with herbs  medieval recipe
steps:
1. Put one sprig or generous shake of rosemary down the middle of each fish
2. Chop all the other herbs and seasonings and mash them into the soft butter
3. Use this to coat the fish generously on each side
4. Griddle , barbeque or grill it for 4-5 minutes on each side or till the skin is well browned and the flesh flaking off the bone
5. Baste frequently with the butter that runs off
6. Serve at once with fresh peasant bread and a salad or a simple green vegetable

title: andrew s chicken enchilada soup
steps:
1. Saute onion in butter until soft
2. Chop cooked chicken into small pieces
3. I used leftovers from a roasted chicken
4. Use either spicy v8 juice , regular v8 juice , or tomato juice
5. I used canned beans which had jalapeno pieces
6. Usually , i drain canned beans , but in this recipe i added the beans undrained with their liquid as a thickener
7. Any canned beans will do: white , pinto , black , etc
8. I used green and black olive barilla puttanesca sauce , but any jar of pasta sauce would do
9. Family members did comment , however , that they liked the olive taste of the barilla sauce
10. I used canned fire roasted , crushed tomatoes
11. Again , any type of tomatoes would do
12. I have used tomato puree also
13. I estimated all the amounts of the spices that i added
14. I would guess that i added a teaspoon of salt and a teaspoon of pepper
15. You might start with less and then add more depending on how spicy you like your food
16. Using an eight quart stock pot , add all the ingredients at once: chicken broth , v8 juice , creamed corn , canned beans , spaghetti sauce , canned tomatoes , chopped chicken , onion , spices , and salt and pepper
17. Stir
18. Simmer on the stove top on a low heat setting
19. Could be made in the crock pot as well
20. Cooking time is variable , but 30 minutes to an hour would be good if cooked on top of the stove
21. If i have time , i let the soup simmer on the lowest setting for 2-4 hours to let the flavors meld
22. You could serve grated cheese on top , but we did not because some family members have food allergies

title: neelys bbq dry rub
steps:
1. In small bowl combine all ingredients
2. Stir to combine
3. Store in an airtight container

title: north croatian roasted duck
steps:
1. Clean the duck and salt only from inside 2-3 hours before roasting
2. Add one tablespoon of marjoram inside the duck to cover inside meat
3. Heat oven to 250c if there is enough fat inside duck , remove this fat and melt it separately in small pot
4. Add lard
5. Heat lard and pour over ducks skin
6. Immediately put the duck into hot oven , roast 20 minutes on 250c and than reduce heat to 180c last 20 minutes roast again on 200c
7. Duck weight 2500 g need about 120 minutes roasting
8. Start cutting the duck after 15 minutes resting outside
9. Use this time to remove fat drippings you will need for mlinci

title: scrambled eggs and orange zest
steps:
1. Whisk all ingredients except butter together , then add the butter in small knobs at the end of whisking
2. Melt a knob of butter in a frying pan when it becomes a light brown colour add the egg mixture , cooking it at a high heat for the first few seconds while the curds firm
3. Then turn the heat down low and cook gently and very slowly , folding the egg mixture over until it starts to set but is still very slippery
4. Take off the heat and allow to set in the pan and serve while hot
5. Serve immediately with a sprig of parsley

title: midwest living s bouja   burgoo
steps:
1. In a large cooking pot , cook the chicken in 1 tablespoon hot cooking oil until no pink remains
2. Remove the chicken from the pot , cover and chill but reserve the drippings in the pot
3. Brown the cubed beef chuck in the remaining drippings in the pot , adding more oil if needed
4. Add the water , chopped onion , instant bouillon granules and the dried thyme to the pot
5. Bring the mixture to a boil , reduce heat and simmer , covered , for 1 hour
6. Add the remaining ingredients to the cooking pot and stir to combine
7. Return the mixture to boiling , reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes more , or until vegetables and meat are tender
8. Stir in the cooked chicken and heat through
9. Season to taste with some salt and some additional pepper , if you like

title: super shortcake
steps:
1. Stir dry ingredients together
2. Cut in butter until crumbly
3. Beat egg , stir into sour cream
4. Stir the wet into the dry just until combined
5. Turn onto heavily floured surface , knead about 25 times
6. For a shortcake: roll into a 7 1 / 2" circle , cut a 2" circle from the center
7. Bake at 425 for 12-14 minutes
8. For individual servings: roll 1" thick , cut into 3 inch rounds
9. Try to re-roll the dough as few times as possible
10. Bake at 425 for 8-12 minutes

title: crisp roasted broccoli
steps:
1. Preheat oven and a baking sheet to 375
2. Cut broccoli into florets , the smaller the size the quicker it will cook and crispier it will be
3. Toss florets with olive oil to coat
4. Add remaining ingredients and toss well
5. Spread into a single layer on the hot baking sheet
6. If desired sprinkle additional parmesan cheese and black pepper on top
7. Bake for 10-12 minutes for small florets or 15-20 for larger pieces

title: almost fat free fudge brownies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f lightly grease an 8x8-inch pan
2. Melt the chocolate chips in a large microwave-safe bowl
3. Melt in increments of 15-20 seconds , stirring after each increment
4. Be careful not to burn ! once the chocolate is smooth when stirred , allow to sit for a minute or two
5. Add yogurt and sugar to the melted chocolate and mix until combined
6. Sift flour , cocoa powder , and baking soda
7. Add this flour mixture and nuts to the chocolate mixture
8. Stir until just combined
9. Add the water and stir carefully until the batter comes together
10. Pour the batter into the prepared pan
11. Bake for 20-30 minutes , until baked through
12. Allow the brownies to cool completely before removing from the pan and slicing

title: savannah  tiramisu
steps:
1. Soak chocolate covered macaroons in bourbon or rum
2. With an electric mixer , cream the butter and sugar together until fluffy
3. Beat in 6 lightly beaten egg yolks
4. Add the melted chocolate , vanilla , nut and soaked macaroons
5. In a separate clean mixing bowl , beat 6 egg whites until stiff and then fold into chocolate mixture
6. Grease springform pan and then line it with separated ladyfingers
7. Alternate layer of the chocolate mixture with the remaining ladyfingers
8. Chill overnight
9. Remove from pan and decorate with whipped cream

title: roast pork with artichoke mustard sauce
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f
2. Place pork loin in shallow roasting pan
3. Rub roast with 1 / 2 cup white wine
4. Cut random slits in roast
5. Insert garlic slivers into slits
6. Sprinkle roast with thyme , salt and pepper
7. Rub to adhere
8. Roast pork loin 20-25 minutes per pound
9. Baste pork with pan juices every 15-20 minutes
10. After one hour , cover meat with loose foil tent
11. It may be necessary to add 1 / 2 - 1 cup of white wine to pan if pan juices have dried up
12. When roast is done , transfer to a platter , let sit for 10 minutes
13. Carve into 3 / 4 inch slices
14. Pour pan juces over all
15. Serve with artichoke-mustard sauce
16. Artichoke-mustard sauce:
17. Place the mustard in a bowl
18. Gradually add the water , whisking constantly , until all the water has been incorporated
19. In a slow , stead stream , add the oil , whisking constantly until all the oil has been added and the sauce is creamy
20. Stir in pepper and lemon juice
21. Drain and chop the artichokes
22. Stir into the sauce
23. Serve sauce at room temperature

title: southwest salsa
steps:
1. Mix ingredients in large bowl
2. Cover & chill 1-2 hours

title: strawberry glazed cream cheesecake
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f
2. In medium bowl , thoroughly combine crust ingredients
3. Press firmly on bottom of lightly buttered 10" springform pan
4. In large mixer bowl , beat cream cheese until smooth
5. Add remaining filling ingredients , beat thoroughly
6. Spoon over crust
7. Place pan on cookie sheet to catch any butter that might drip out
8. Bake 40-45 minutes
9. Remove from oven and let stand at room temperature for 15 minutes
10. Keep oven on at 350f
11. In medium bowl , combine topping ingredients until well blended
12. Spoon topping over cheesecake , starting at center and extending to within 1 / 2 inch of edge
13. Return to oven and bake 5 minutes longer
14. Cool
15. Refrigerate cheesecake for at least 24 hours , preferably 2-3 days
16. Several hours before serving , wash , hull and completely dry strawberries on paper towels
17. In small saucepan , combine a little jelly with cornstarch
18. Mix well
19. Add remaining jelly , liqueur and water
20. Cook and stir over medium heat until mixture thickens and is clear
21. Cool to lukewarm , stirring occasionally
22. Using knife , loosen cheesecake from pan
23. Remove springform
24. Arrange berries , pointed sides up , over top of cake
25. Spoon glaze over berries , allowing some to drip down sides of cake
26. Refrigerate until glaze is set

title: dee s quick and easy strawberry meringues  4 ingredients  5 min
steps:
1. Wash and top strawberries
2. In a blender mix all of the cream and about half of the strawberries , add a dash of vanilla to the cream if using
3. Spoon into meringue nests and decorate with remaining strawberries
4. You can use different fruits for this dessert , i find berries best

title: cheese cutout sandwiches
steps:
1. Cut cheese slices with cookie cutter
2. Place american cheese bones into swiss cheese cutouts and swiss cheese bones into american cheese cutouts
3. Set aside
4. Spread butter on both sides of bread
5. Brown both sides in a large skillet
6. Remove
7. Heat ham in the same skillet
8. Place on bread
9. Top with cheese slices
10. Serve immediately

title: baked tomatoes rockefeller
steps:
1. Cook spinach according to package directions and set aside
2. Saute all onions and garlic in olive oil
3. Remove from heat and set aside
4. To spinach , add eggs , 1 cup breadcrumbs , sauteed onions , tabasco , worcestershire sauce , seasonings , and cheese
5. Arrange tomato slices in a buttered baking dish
6. Scoop spinach mixture on top of each tomato slice
7. Sprinkle with remaining breadcrumbs
8. Bake at 350 degrees for 15 minutes

title: hungarian cabbage noodles  kaposztas taszta
steps:
1. Bring 4 quarts of water to a boil in a large pot for the noodles
2. Meanwhile , heat 1 tablespoon of the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering
3. Add half of the cabbage , season with 1 / 4 teaspoon of salt , and cook , tossing frequently , until golden brown , 5 - 8 minutes
4. Transfer the cooked cabbage to a place
5. Repeat with the remaining cabbage
6. Add 1 tablespoon of salt and the noodles to the boiling water and cook until al dente
7. L drain the noodles and transfer back to the pot
8. Add the reserved cabbage and butter , toss to combine , and season to taste with salt and pepper
9. Serve

title: basic fish cure  bbq rub
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a small bowl with your fingers
2. If using as a seasoning , just sprinkle on the fish before grilling
3. If using as a true rub , sprinkle on the fish and rub with your fingers
4. Let sit for 2 hours up to a day in advance prior to grilling

title: wheat thins style crackers
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. In a large mixing bowl thoroughly combine both flours
3. In a separate bowl whisk together the oil , salt and water
4. Add liquid mixture to the dry mixture , mixing only enough to completely incorporate
5. Do not over mix !
6. On a length of parchment paper that will fit your cookie sheet roll mixture to a rectangle no more than 1 / 8 thick the thinner the better as uniform as possible
7. Work fairly quickly but dont overwork
8. Dust rolling pin lightly with flour as needed to keep from sticking if necessary during the rolling process
9. Carefully slide parchment paper and contents onto cookie sheet
10. Gently score mixture with a sharp knife at the desired cracker size but do not cut through !
11. Prick each cracker section two or three times with a fork to allow steam to escape
12. Sprinkle lightly with salt or other favorite cracker seasoning mix , if desired
13. Bake at 350 degrees for about 30 minutes or until crackers are crisp and light brown
14. Cool completely
15. Separate into individual crackers
16. Store in air-tight containers in a cool , dry place

title: siga wot
steps:
1. In dry pan over moderate heat , stir fry the onions for 4 mins to reduce the bulk , stirring constantly
2. Add the oil and stir fry for about 1 minute longer
3. Add the chow and tomato paste and contine to fry
4. Then add the salt and 1 / 4 of the water
5. Stir well
6. Add the beef cubes and the remaining water
7. Cover the pan and cook for 45 mins , or until the beef is tender
8. There should be a moderate amount of sauce
9. Serve warm with injeera

title: priscilla s grilled chicken skewers
steps:
1. First , lemme say that you need skewers and a grilling machine
2. If you haven't got those you might need to bake it , but i have no guarentees how it will come out ! ok
3. You need to soak maybe six to eight skewers for like 20 minutes
4. You get the chicken thighs and you take off the skin , and cut the meat off the bone
5. Cut them into bite sized pieces , about the size of an eraser
6. Mix all of those stuff up
7. Yep , everything
8. But make sure first that the garlic is chopped up real nice and not like a chunk
9. Do not think that hoisin sauce is some random un necessary sauce and skip out on it
10. If you dont have that , use oyster sauce
11. Marinate for 30 minutes to one hour
12. You can even stick it in the fridge and put it overnight , it'll taste even better
13. Skewer the chicken onto the sticks evenly , so it's for sure to be cooked
14. Grill for 5 minutes on each side
15. :) all done ! it'll taste good with rice i think , and some veggies

title: powdered sugar cookies
steps:
1. Mix margarine , egg , vanilla , almond , and powdered sugar
2. Beat until creamy
3. Slowly stir in sifted flour , baking soda , and cream of tartar
4. Cover and put in the refrigerator for atleast 3 hours
5. Preheat oven to 375
6. Get dough into the size of a baseball , flour an area to roll out the dough
7. Cut into desired shapes
8. Bake until edges are light brown , 7 to 8 minutes

title: cinnamon pumpkin banana bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Coat 2 standard loaf pans with cooking spray
3. In a food processor , combine the pumpkin puree , bananas , vanilla and eggs
4. Process until smooth , scraping down the sides as needed
5. Add the flour , rolled oats , flax meal , sugar , baking powder , baking soda , salt and pumpkin pie spice
6. Process until thoroughly blended , about 30 seconds , stopping to scrape the sides as needed
7. Transfer the batter to the prepared loaf pans
8. Bake for 45-50 minutes
9. Upon removal from pans , let cool completely before slicing

title: peach chutney
steps:
1. Coursley chop peaches , mix with next 5 ingredients in saucepan
2. Tie cloves and cinnamon in cheesecloth bag
3. Add to peaches
4. Simmer , 30 minutes , stirring ocasionaly
5. Remove spice bag
6. Pour chutney into glass bowl
7. Cover and chill

title: orange chili dipping sauce
steps:
1. Whisk the ingredients together in a small bowl
2. Let stand for at least 30 minutes to infuse the flavours& serve at room temperataure

title: roast carrots with a twist
steps:
1. Peel and chop the carrots into bite size pieces
2. Place carrots in a saucepan and cover with water
3. Add the stock , garlic powder and cumin and boil until tender
4. Reserve 3 tablespoons of stock water then drain the carrots
5. Place carrots in a roasting pan and coat with olive oil
6. Sprinkle with the reserved stock water
7. Cook at 450 fahrenheit / 230 celsius for 30 minutes or until cooked to your liking

title: chuck wagon burgers
steps:
1. Brown the ground beef in a large skillet
2. Drain fat
3. Stir in ketchup , brown sugar , chili powder , cumin , salt , and pepper
4. Combine liquid smoke and water in a bowl
5. Then add to the beef mixture
6. Simmer for 10 minutes to blend all the flavors
7. Meanwhile butter and broiler toast the buns
8. Spoon the beef mixture onto the toasted buns

title: salt roasted potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425
2. Stir together oil and salt in a small shallow baking dish
3. Add potatoes and rub with oil mixture to coat
4. Bake in middle of oven until tender when pierced with a sharp paring knife , about 30 to 35 minutes

title: canadian cream
steps:
1. Combine all well
2. Bottle
3. Refrigerate
4. Keeps up to one month in the refrigerator

title: posole  mexican pork stew
steps:
1. Trim fat from pork , cut into 1 / 2 inch cubes , brown in oil over medium hot heat
2. Remove from pan and set aside
3. In remaining oil , saute onion until tender , about 4 minutes
4. Add garlic , cooking for just a minute more
5. Put the cooked meat , onions and garlic in a stew pot
6. Add the tomatoes and chilies , 1 1 / 2 cans chicken broth , and seasonings
7. Stir , bring to a boil , cover , and simmer for 30 minutes or until the meat is tender
8. Puree one can of drained hominy in a blender with the remaining can chicken broth
9. The pureed hominy adds thickness to the stew
10. Add the pureed hominy , whole hominy , and cilantro and simmer an additional 15 minutes

title: poseidon potato stew  sp5
steps:

2. In a large skillet on medium / high heat , cook potatoes until slightly tender or just golden brown

title: herb grilled chicken salad with strawberries and feta cheese
steps:
1. Place chicken breasts in ziplock bag and pour marinade over
2. Let sit in fridge for 30 mins or longer
3. Heat grill to high
4. Cook chicken breast about 4 mins per side or till reads 150
5. Take off grill and place in foil and let sit 10 minutes
6. Meanwhile , place about 1 / 2 cup strawberries in blender and puree
7. Then pour in the dressing and blend well
8. Set aside
9. To serve: divide lettuce , remaining strawberries , red onion , and cucumbers among 4 plates
10. Slice chicken in thin strips and divide among plates
11. Top with dressing , feta , walnuts and wonton strips
12. Enjoy

title: tuscan style grilled tuna
steps:
1. Rinse and pat tuna steaks dry
2. Place zest on top of cutting board
3. Pile rosemary and parsley leaves on top of zest
4. Pile garlic and some coarse salt and black pepper or grill seasoning on top of herbs
5. Finely chop the garlic , herbs , and spices
6. Drizzle the olive oil over the tuna steaks just enough to coat each side
7. Rub herb and garlic mixture into fish , coating pieces evenly on each side
8. Let stand 10 minutes
9. Grill tuna steaks 6 minutes on each side or 4 minutes on each side , if you prefer pink tuna at the center
10. Cook steaks over: high setting on indoor electric grill , medium high heat on outdoor gas grill or , 6 inches from hot , prepared charcoal

title: macaroni and cheese chowder
steps:
1. Cook macaroni according to directions , drain and set aside
2. In a large saucepan , melt butter , add onion , carrots and celery
3. Cook over medium heat , stirring occasionally until vegetables are crisp tender
4. Stir in flour , mustard and salt , continue cooking until bubbly
5. Stir in milk and broth
6. Continue cooking , stirring occasionally , until mixture comes to a full boil boil 1 minute
7. Stir in macaroni and then cheese , continue stirring occasionally until cheese melts

title: spicy red snapper
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Sprinkle the fillets with lemon juice
3. Heat oil in a skillet over med-low heat
4. Stir in the bell peppers and onions and cook until softened , about 5 minutes
5. Add the fillets and cook 1 minute per side
6. Leaving fillets in the skillet , add the wine , parsley , basil , cayenne and pepper
7. Cover and simmer 2 minutes
8. Transfer to an ovenproof glass baking dish
9. Spoon tomatoes over the fish
10. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese and hot pepper sauce
11. Bake in oven until fish is opaque , about 8 minutes
12. Serve immediately with rice

title: chicken wrap with dijon dill relish
steps:
1. Mix together the mayo , mustard , yogurt , dill , tomato , onion , and bell pepper
2. Season with salt & pepper
3. Assemble 2 oz
4. Chicken on one end of the tortilla
5. Top with 1 / 2 cup lettuce and 1 / 4 of the relish
6. Roll the tortilla
7. Use a toothpick to hold together if necessary
8. Cut in half
9. Repeat with 3 remaining tortillas
10. Enjoy !

title: chicken  broccoli  and lemon stir fry
steps:
1. In a large , shallow bowl , whisk together soy sauce , 3 tablespoons water , vinegar , honey , garlic , and crushed red pepper
2. Pour half of the mixture into another bowl
3. Reserve
4. Place chicken in remaining mixture
5. Marinate for 15 minutes
6. In a 12-inch nonstick skillet , heat 1 / 2 tablespoon oil over high heat
7. Add half the chicken
8. Cook , tossing often , until brown and cooked through , 2 to 3 minutes
9. Transfer chicken to a plate
10. Repeat with another 1 / 2 tablespoon oil and remaining chicken
11. Wipe skillet with a paper towel
12. Heat remaining tablespoon oil in skillet over medium-high heat
13. Cook broccoli and lemon , tossing often , until broccoli is bright green , about 3 minutes
14. Add 1 / 2 cup water
15. Cook until broccoli is tender and lemon is translucent , about 6 minutes
16. Add reserved marinade , cornstarch mixture , chicken , and any accumulated juices from plate
17. Bring to a boil
18. Cook , stirring until thickened , 1 minute
19. Sprinkle with sesame seeds

title: salt free taco seasoning
steps:
1. Put all ingredients in a labeled sandwich size zip lock plastic bag
2. Seal and shake
3. I keep my baggies of seasonings i make in an old bread tin , labeling the lip with a smudge free marker

title: pecan blue cheese spread
steps:
1. Place nuts in food processor and process until finely chopped
2. It takes about 10 seconds
3. Add both cheeses
4. Process until very smooth
5. Again , it should only take about 10 seconds
6. Pack into a bowl and refrigerate until serving
7. This is best if allowed to chill for a few hours
8. A dribble of brandy or port added when you add the cheeses doesn't hurt

title: southwestern black bean spread
steps:
1. In food processor or blender , process beans , peppers , chilies , lime juice , garlic , cumin and onion powder for 15-20 seconds
2. Spread mixture evenly in a serving plate or shallow bowl
3. Drop sour cream by spoonfuls and spread over surface
4. Top with diced tomato
5. Serve with celery sticks or other fresh veggies of baked pita chips

title: chocolate angel pie
steps:
1. Shell:
2. Preheat oven to 250f
3. In a small bowl beat egg whites and cream of tarter until soft peaks form
4. Gradually sprinkle in sugar 2 tbsp at a time
5. Beat two minutes after each addition or until sugar is completely dissolved
6. Add vanilla and continue to beat at high speed until mixture stands in stiff , glossy peaks
7. Spoon into a greased nine inch pie plate , smooth till evenly distributed
8. Using the back of a spoon pile meringue up at the sides to form a shell
9. Bake 1 hour at 275f turn off oven and let stand in oven 1 hour
10. Filling:
11. Combine chocolate , water , egg yolks , sugar , and salt in double boiler over hot , not boiling water
12. Cook until chocolate is melted and mixture is very thick and mounds when dropped from a spoon
13. Remove from heat and set aside
14. In large bowl at medium speed beat cream with vanilla until soft peaks form
15. Gently fold into chocolate mixture
16. Spoon mixture into meringue shell
17. Refrigerate 4 hours or until filling is set

title: season s easy jam bars
steps:
1. Grease 13x9 inch pan
2. Mix butter or margarine , sugar , vanilla , egg in medium bowl with hand mixer
3. Dont over mix
4. Stir in flour and baking powder until dough forms
5. Pat evenly into pan
6. Spread jam or jelly on top of dough
7. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes at 350 degrees fahrenheit
8. Top with powder sugar glaze

title: shazam  shrimp with mediterranean orzo
steps:
1. Give your date a peck on the cheek
2. Repeat as often as necessary
3. In a bowl toss shrimp , olive oil , italian seasoning , and garlic and let marinade for thirty minutes
4. In a sauce pan- bring six cups of water and chicken bouillon powder to a boil
5. Add chopped yellow bell pepper and one cup of orzo and cook according to package directions until tender then drain
6. Return drained orzo back to sauce pan and fold in capers , olives , and cut tomatoes
7. Cover with lid to keep warm
8. In a heavy , lightly oiled hot skillet , cook shrimp 2 minutes per side and remove shrimp immediately to a plate tented with foil to keep warm
9. Deglaze pan with chicken stock and sherry and boil until alcohol has evaporated pour this into 2 small ramekins to use as a dipping sauce for some hot buttered crusty french bread
10. Divide orzo between 2 plates and top with each with half of the shrimp
11. Sprinkle with one lime wedge apiece and place another lime wedge on each plate as garnish
12. Eat until you explode and be prepared for grateful kisses from your date

title: strawberry and hazelnut lassi
steps:
1. Put all ingredients in a blender with a crushed ice until it's creamy
2. Serve in a tall glass and garnish with a mint leaf

title: amazing chocolate chunk cookies
steps:
1. Melt 3 squares or 3 ounces of white chocolate according to package directions
2. Set aside
3. Cream together the butter and shortening by hand
4. Add the sugars and cream together
5. Add the eggs , one at a time , beating after each addition
6. Stir in the melted white chocolate and vanilla
7. In a separate bowl , whisk together flour , baking soda , and salt
8. Gradually add to creamed mixture
9. Dough will be stiff
10. Stir in chocolate chunks
11. Preheat oven to 350
12. Shape dough into tablespoonfuls and place on greased cookie sheets
13. Bake 8-10 minutes
14. Don't overbake !
15. Let cool on sheet 2-4 minutes before removing to wire racks
16. Melt remaining white chocolate
17. Drizzle over cookies using a fork
18. Cookies may be frozen up to 3 months after completely cooled

title: roasted broccoli with shrimp
steps:
1. 1
2. Preheat oven to 425 degrees
3. In a large bowl , toss broccoli with 2 tablespoons oil , coriander , cumin , 1 teaspoon salt , 1 / 2 teaspoon pepper and chili powder
4. In a separate bowl , combine shrimp , remaining 2 tablespoons oil , lemon zest , remaining 1 / 2 teaspoon salt and remaining 1 / 2 teaspoon pepper
5. 2
6. Spread broccoli in a single layer on a baking sheet

10. Serve with lemon wedges , or squeeze lemon juice all over shrimp and broccoli just before serving

title: chocolate mischief goddess heaven milkshakes of choice
steps:

2. You can add a handful of ice cubes if trying to keep the calories down
3. Top with whipped cream and a swiss lindt chocolate shavings
4. Topping with optional cherry

title: bourbon and praline ham
steps:
1. Score ham
2. Place ham in a large sealable plastic bag and pour bourbon over ham
3. Marinate for 2 to 3 hours
4. Pour off bourbon , reserving for later , and bake ham at 325 degrees for 2 hours
5. Melt butter
6. Stir in reserved bourbon marinade , maple syrup , brown sugar and chopped pecans
7. Bring to a boil
8. Pour glaze over ham and brush with a pastry brush
9. Decorate with pecan halves and bake for an additional 15 to 20 minutes

title: corned beef prairie potatoes
steps:
1. Prick the potato skins , wrap each one in kitchen paper and cook on high for 10 minutes
2. Turn the potatoes over and cook for 7 minutes
3. Leave to stand for 5 minutes
4. Cut the potatoes in half and scoop out the flesh into a bowl
5. Add the butter and milk and mash well
6. Stir in the corned beef , sweetcorn , chutney , half of the cheese and pepper
7. Spoon the filling into the potato skins and top with the remaining cheese
8. Cook on high for 4 minutes
9. Serve immediately , with a green salad

title: banana soy breakfast smoothie
steps:
1. Get all the ingredients out and put them in your blender
2. I like to use my single-serving blender for convenience
3. Blend thoroughly
4. Keep it going a little longer than you think you need to -- it will get creamier and you'll get rid of any banana chunks left over
5. Enjoy ! you could use frozen bananas for a colder drink , but i don't think it's necessary

title: frosty cranberry and almond pie
steps:
1. In a bowl , beat cream cheese and sugar until light
2. Stir in cranberry sauce
3. Fold in whipped topping
4. Spoon into crusts
5. Cover and freeze for up to 3 months
6. Remove from the freezer 10-15 minutes before serving
7. Garnish with toasted almonds and additional whipped topping if desired

title: thai dessert soup
steps:
1. Boil the tapioca stirring constantly until the pearls are translucent
2. Remove from heat and stir in sugar
3. Bring back to the boil
4. Remove from heat immediately
5. Let the tapioca cool
6. Prepare your fruit
7. Slice strawberries but leave other berries whole
8. Dice other fruits
9. Stir sugar into the milk of your choice and make sure it is dissolved
10. Add extract
11. Select 4 attractive chilled bowls for your desserts
12. Put several tablespoons of tapioca pearls in each bowl
13. Divide the fruit into each bowl
14. Pour the sweetened milk over the fruit / tapioca and chill the desserts until ready to serve
15. Garnish your dessert with one of the above
16. If using flowers be sure they are pesticide free
17. If you are appealing to children , you can snip coloured marshmallows into flower shapes

title: whole wheat banana pancakes   low fat
steps:
1. Mix dry ingredients in a bowl
2. Combine wet ingredients
3. Whisk in dry ingredients
4. Using a 1 / 4 cup measure drop batter onto a hot frying pan
5. When pancakes begin to bubble flip them
6. Finished when golden on both sides

title: fish tagine with tomatoes  capers  and cinnamon
steps:
1. Heat cumin in oil in a 12-inch heavy skillet over medium heat , stirring occasionally , until fragrant , about 1 minute
2. Stir in tomatoes , capers , cinnamon , and 1 / 4 teaspoon each of salt and pepper and simmer , uncovered , stirring occasionally , until thickened , about 10 minutes
3. Pat fish dry and sprinkle with 1 / 4 teaspoon each of salt and pepper , then add to skillet
4. Cover and simmer until fish is just cooked through , 7 to 10 minutes

title: crostini al mascarpone
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Mix cheeses and add marjoram
3. Salt and pepper to taste
4. Slice baguette in thin slices
5. Spread cheese mixture on slices
6. Place prepared slices on a baking sheet and put sheet into preheated oven
7. Bake for a few minutes until hot an bubbly
8. Watch closely--don't let the bread get too brown
9. Bon apptit !

title: four cheese manicotti in cream sauce
steps:
1. Saute onion and mushrooms in butter 5 minutes
2. Stir in flour
3. Gradually stir in milk
4. Stir over low heat until sauce bubbles and thickens
5. Stir in 1 cup parmesan cheese and salt and pepper to taste
6. Set aside
7. Cook manicotti shells according to package directions
8. Drain and cover with cold water
9. Mix together ricotta , mozzarella , romano and remaining parmesan cheese
10. Add walnuts , parsley and eggs
11. Season to taste with salt , pepper and nutmeg
12. Drain manicotti shells
13. Stuff with cheese mixture
14. Place shells side by side in a greased shallow baking pan
15. Spoon sauce over all
16. Bake in preheated 400f oven 20 to 25 minutes or until bubbly and golden

title: julia childs candied citrus peel
steps:
1. With a vegetable peeler , carefully remove the zest from the lemons without getting any of the white pith included
2. Cut them into julienne strips 1 1 / 2 inches long and less than 1 / 8 inch wide
3. In 1 quart of water , simmer the zests for 6 minutes , then drain and rinse in cold water
4. Set aside
5. Bring the 1 / 3 cup water to a simmer in a saucepan and add the sugar , stirring until completely dissolved
6. Cover the pan tightly and , as julia says , boil for a moment or two , until the last drops of syrup to fall from the end of a metal spoon form a thread
7. Remove saucepan from the heat , stir in the peel and let steep for an hour
8. Use in the fresh lemon sherbet recipe or store in the refrigerator in a covered jar where it will keep for weeks
9. Makes one batch of candied zests for the 12 servings of sherbet

title: dead sea babaganoush
steps:
1. 1
2. Preheat oven to 425 degrees
3. 2
4. Place eggplant and garlic in a large baking pan
5. Toss with oil and salt
6. 3
7. Bake , uncovered for 40-50 minutes or until eggplant is golden brown and the smaller pieces around the edges begin to blacken
8. Halfway through the baking process use a metal spatula to stir and turn the eggplant , scraping stuck pieces from the bottom of the pan
9. 4
10. Remove from oven
11. While eggplant is still warm , add mayonnaise
12. Stir gently until incorporated
13. 5
14. Chill thoroughly

title: pineapple and cheddar cheese casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. In a large bowl combine flour and sugar , then add 6 tablespoons of reserved pineapple juice
3. Add butter , cheese and pineapple
4. Mix until combined
5. Pour into 13x9 casserole dish
6. Bake 20 minutes at 350
7. Top with crackers
8. Reduce heat to 250 degrees and bake an additional 20-30 minutes

title: mango papaya smoothie
steps:
1. Place all the smoothie ingredients in a blender and process for 2 minutes
2. Pour into tall glasses and serve each with a scoop of vanilla ice cream , chunks of mango and papaya , and a spoon

title: cranberry   sweet potato buns
steps:
1. In a bowl , mix sweet potato , water , buttermilk , butter and egg until well blended
2. In a stand mixer or large mixing bowl , whisk together yeast , flours , sugar , salt and rosemary
3. Add the sweet potato mixture and mix to form a shaggy dough
4. Let stand 10 minutes
5. Add cranberries and begin kneading , by hand or dough hook , for 10-12 minutes
6. Dough should pull away from the sides of the bowl but stick to the bottom
7. Place the dough into a greased bowl , cover and let rise for 40 minutes
8. Punch dough down , knead briefly and divide into 10 even buns
9. Place on two parchment-lined sheets
10. Cover and let rise for another 45 minutes
11. Preheat the oven to 375f
12. Bake for 20-25 minutes , rotatng pans halfway through

title: malibu frozen lemonade  coconut rum
steps:
1. Throw everything in the blender
2. Use enough crushed ice reach desired consistency
3. Blend until slushy
4. If you are worried about overworking your blender , work in batches

title: irmgard s stuffed bell peppers
steps:
1. Cut the tops off of the peppers
2. Remove the seeds and membranes
3. Parboil 5 minutes
4. Drain
5. Saute the beef , onion and garlic in a large skillet until lightly browned
6. Add a little oil if the beef is very lean
7. Add the italian seasoning , salt , pepper , stewed tomatoes , 1 / 2 can tomato sauce , water and rice
8. Stir well
9. Bring to a boil
10. Reduce the heat to low
11. Cook , covered , for 15 minutes
12. Place the peppers in a 2-quart casserole
13. Stuff with the meat mixture
14. Spoon any remaining meat mixture around the peppers
15. Top with the remaining 1 / 2 can tomato sauce
16. Cover
17. Bake 30 minutes in a preheated 350 degree f oven
18. Uncover
19. Top with shredded mozzarella
20. Cook for 10 minutes to melt the cheese

title: napa fusion slaw
steps:
1. Place jicama , cabbage , pepper and carrots in a large bowl
2. Whisk together the lime juice , vinegar , ancho powder , honey , and oils in a medium bowl
3. Season with salt and pepper , to taste
4. Pour the dressing over the salad mixture and toss to coat well
5. Fold in the cilantro
6. Let salad sit in fridge for 20 minutes and serve

title: pretzel tailed turkey treats
steps:
1. In large saucepan melt butter over low heat
2. Add marshmallows and stir until completely melted
3. Remove from heat
4. Add 6 cups kellogg's cocoa krispies cereal
5. Stir until well coated
6. Cool slightly
7. Cut warm cereal mixture into two different sized circles using two sizes of circle cookie cutters for the turkey bodies
8. Cool
9. Spread peanut butter on bottom of the smaller circular pieces
10. Attach this to a larger circular piece to form the turkey body
11. Insert pretzel twists into body for tail feathers
12. Insert pretzel sticks for legs
13. Use frosting to attach candies for eyes and beak
14. Best if served the same day
15. Microwave directions: in microwave-safe bowl heat butter and marshmallows on high for 3 minutes , stirring after 2 minutes
16. Stir until smooth
17. Follow steps 2 and 3 above
18. Microwave cooking times may vary
19. For best results , use fresh marshmallows
20. 1 jar marshmallow crme can be substituted for marshmallows
21. Diet , reduced calorie or tub margarine is not recommended
22. Store no more than two days at room temperature in airtight container
23. To freeze , place in single layer on wax paper in airtight container
24. Freeze for up to 6 weeks
25. Let stand at room temperature for 15 minutes before serving

title: potato   corn chowder
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients in crock pot
2. Cover and cook on low heat setting 6-8 hours to develop flavors

title: garlic cheese herb butter
steps:
1. Blend in food processor or with mixer until it is fluffy
2. Place on plastic wrap and roll into a log
3. Twist ends of plastic wrap to seal butter inches best if left in refrigerator at least overnight before using to let flavors meld
4. Store in refrigerator , and cut off discs of butter as needed

title: creamed cucumber
steps:
1. Place cucumber & carrot in a saucepan and heat slowly , simmer for 3 minutes
2. Drain & retain liquid and make up to 1 / 2 cup milk
3. Saute onion in butter and add flour , stir until smooth
4. Add liquid slowly , stir until boiling
5. Add cucumber mixture , cheese & season with pepper to taste
6. Garnish with parsley to serve

title: the trellis  apricot almond bread
steps:
1. In a 350-degree oven , toast almonds on baking sheet for 10 minutes
2. In mixing bowl , cream together butter and sugar until fluffy
3. Add eggs 1 at a time , beating well
4. Add baking powder , salt , cinnamon , and extract
5. Beat until smooth and add flour 1 / 2 cup at a time alternately with sour cream
6. Beat until smooth , then add almonds and apricots
7. Place in buttered and floured 12" loaf pan
8. Bake for 1 hour
9. Allow to cool before removing from pans

title: wrecked golf cart
steps:
1. Pour all three over ice
2. Mix well
3. Garnish with a lime wedge
4. If it is too strong , add 2 ounces of sprite

title: aussie spiced nuts
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to moderate
2. And line an oven tray with baking paper
3. In a large pan , combine the olive oil , paprika , maple syrup , garlic , salt flakes , chilli and pepper
4. Stir over a low heat until the syrup has melted and the mixture is well-combined
5. Add the nuts and stir until they are evenly coated with the spice mixture
6. Spread on the prepared baking tray
7. Bake for 10-15 minutes , turning occasionally
8. Remove and set aside to cool before serving
9. I cannot advise as to how they'd last beyond the two days as i cannot even imagine them lasting that long !

title: crunchie bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f place crackers in a single layer on a foil-lined 15x10x1-inch baking pan
2. Heat butter and sugar in saucepan on medium-high heat until butter is melted and mixture is well blended
3. Bring to boil
4. Boil 3 minute without stirring
5. Spread over crackers
6. Bake 7 minute immediately sprinkle with chopped chocolate
7. Let stand 5 minute spread melted chocolate over top
8. Sprinkle with walnuts
9. Cool
10. Cut or break into pieces

title: crock pot chocolate cake
steps:
1. Stir together 1 cup brown sugar , flour , 3 tbl
2. Cocoa , baking powder and salt
3. Stir in the milk , butter and vanilla
4. Spread over the bottom of the slower cooker
5. Mix 3 / 4 cup brown sugar and 1 / 4 cup cocoa
6. Sprinkle over mixture in crock pot
7. Do not stir
8. Pour in boiling water
9. Do not stir
10. Cover , cook on high for 2-3 hours
11. Let cool 30 minutes
12. Serve with ice cream

title: bay baked potato
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Cut potato almost in half length wise
3. Place bay leaf between halves
4. Add salt and pepper to taste
5. Add butter if using
6. Place potato on a square of foil and close tightly
7. Place in a 400 f oven for about 40 minutes

title: quick   simple pesto  classic pesto recipe  sauce
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in blender or food processor & cover
2. Blend on medium speed about 3 minutes , stopping occasionally to scrape sides , until smooth

title: chicken fried steak with white gravy
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 250 degrees f
2. Cut the steak into 4 equal portions
3. Place the buttermilk in a medium baking dish and season with salt and pepper
4. Combine the flour , garlic powder , onion powder , paprika , cayenne and 2 teaspoons kosher salt and 1 / 2 teaspoon freshly ground black pepper in a bowl and divide between 2 baking dishes
5. Dredge the pieces a few at a time in the flour mixture and pat off excess , then dip in the buttermilk and allow excess to drain off
6. Dredge in the second dish of flour and pat off the excess
7. Put the chicken pieces on a baking rack set over a baking sheet while the oil heats
8. Place 1-inch of oil in a large cast iron skillet until it reaches 350 degrees f on a thermometer
9. Add the steak , 2 pieces at a time and cook until golden brown on both sides
10. Remove to a plate lined with paper towels and season with salt
11. Repeat with the remaining meat
12. Transfer the meat to a rack set on a baking sheet and place in the oven to keep warm while you make the gravy
13. Remove all but 2 tablespoons of the fat from the pan , leaving the crunchy pieces from the breading
14. Add the bacon and cook until golden brown and crisp
15. Remove with a slotted spoon to a plate lined with paper towels
16. Return the pan to the stove over medium heat
17. Whisk the flour into the pan and let cook for 1 minute
18. Slowly whisk in the warm milk and continue to cook , whisking occasionally until thickened
19. Stir in the heavy cream and thyme and season with salt and lots of freshly ground black pepper
20. Serve 1 piece per person ladled with some of the sauce and garnished with a few pieces of bacon
21. Garnish with thyme sprigs

title: peanut butter   chocolate cookies
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 180c / gas 4
2. Line two trays with baking paper
3. In a bowl mix the butter , brown sugar , and peanut butter
4. Add the beaten egg and beat well
5. Melt the chocolate
6. Either in the microwave or in a large bowl over a simmering pan of water
7. Add the chocolate to the mixture and stir till even
8. Slowly add the flour , being sure the dough is evenly mixed
9. I generally use my hand to roll the dough into one inch balls which i then press onto the tray
10. Bake for 12 minutes , then leave to cool another 5
11. Transfer to a wire rack and leave to harden

title: buffalo style baked potatoes
steps:
1. Combine cheese , dressing and wing sauce in a bowl beat till well blended and garlic powder
2. Slice the potatoes in a fan effect 3 / 4 through , put in the microwave for 10 minutes
3. In a pie plate or cookie sheet , put partially arrange potatoes on the baking sheet
4. Pour melted butter on each one
5. Pour sauce over each potatoes getting into the crevices of the slices
6. Bake for about 45 minutes or till brown and crispy looking
7. Serve immediately --
8. Optional serve with sour cream on top

title: white whole wheat bread
steps:
1. Put all ingredients in bread pan
2. May add an optional 1 / 4 c of seeds
3. Sometimes i also add 1 / 4 c of wheat germ , oat bran or wheat bran instead of flax seeds
4. Program for basic white bread
5. Press start
6. 3 hours cooking time is based on a 1 1 / 2 pound white loaf with a light crust in my bread machine
7. Baking time will vary according to settings you choose on your machine

title: fresh fruit with various toppings for 2
steps:
1. Divide fruit between two dessert dishes , sprinkle snipped fresh mint on fruit if desired
2. Serve with one of the toppings below:
3. Honey-yogurt topping
4. Mix 1 tablespoon lemon juice , 1 tablespoon honey and 1 / 2 cup unflavored yogurt or dairy sour cream
5. Brown sugar-yogurt topping
6. Mix 1 / 4 cup unflavored yogurt or sour cream and 2 tablespoons brown sugar
7. Limeade-yogurt topping
8. Mix 2 tablespoons frozen limeade concentrate and 1 / 4 cup pineapple yogurt
9. Spice-yogurt topping
10. Mix 1 / 2 cup unflavored yogurt or sour cream , 1 tablespoon sugar , 1 / 4 teaspoon cinnamon and dash nutmeg

title: the best soft ginger cookies
steps:
1. Combine shortening , sugar , molasses and egg and beat throughly
2. Add baking soda , cinnamon , ginger , and cloves to flour and mix together
3. Gradually add flour mixture to shortening mixture
4. Cover and chill for 1 hour
5. Roll into 1 inch bals and roll in granulated sugar
6. Place on cookie sheet
7. Bake at 325 for 8 minutes very important not to over bake or else they won't be soft !

title: black beans   salsa
steps:
1. Mix salsa ingredients at least six hours in advance
2. Saute onions in olive oil
3. Add garlic just before onions are done
4. Add the remaining ingredients & simmer until the liquid is reduced
5. Serve immediately

title: oven fried chicken your way
steps:
1. This recipe is called your way because you can use any spice blend you want for seasoning
2. Mccormicks greek seasoning is excellent , as is emeril's essence
3. Make your own up if you want
4. In a flat dish like a pie plate , combine buttermilk and spice blend
5. Or , if making this up early in the day , combine in a large ziploc bag instead , so chicken can marinate for a few hours in the fridge
6. Combine breadcrumbs , salt and parmesan in another flat dish
7. Set aside if you want chicken to marinate in fridge for a few hours
8. Cut chicken breasts into large chunks
9. If you are making this up early in the day , place chicken pieces into the ziploc bag along with the buttermilk mixture and close bag tightly
10. Make sure all pieces of chicken are coated with buttermilk mixture
11. Let sit in fridge until ready to coat
12. If you don't have time for this , just dip chicken chunks into buttermilk mixture , making sure pieces are thoroughly coated
13. Preheat oven to 400f
14. Have ready a baking sheet sprayed with nonstick cooking spray or lined with parchment paper
15. After chicken is coated with buttermilk mixture , dredge in breadcrumb mixture thoroughly , then place on prepared baking sheet
16. Bake for approximately 20 to 25 minutes , or until chicken is just cooked through

title: purple waldorf salad
steps:
1. Combine in a bowl
2. Adjust seasonings to taste

title: bosnian vegetarian meatballs in yogurt sauce
steps:
1. Saute the onions and garlic in oil until they begin to turn golden , about 6 minutes
2. Add the carrots , salt and black pepper and continue to cook for 4 minutes , stirring occasionally
3. Ste aside to cool
4. Mix together eggs , bread crumbs , almonds , mustard , sesame oil , and soy sauce
5. Stir in herbs and spices into bread-crumb mixture
6. Crumble the tofu into the mixture and knead it with your hands until combined
7. Drain the sauteed vegetables and stir them into the mix
8. Form about 24 balls , place them on an oiled baking sheet and bake at 350f for 30 minutes until nicely browned
9. For yogurt sauce , just mix together the ingredients
10. Heat the sauce for about 15 minutes , stirring constantly until it thickens
11. Be patient , and do not overheat or eggs may curdle

title: clementine poppy seed loaf
steps:
1. Line an 8 in x 4 in loaf pan with foil and lightly oil foil
2. In a large bowl , cream butter , sugar and margarine
3. Stir in egg and yogurt
4. Then milk
5. In another bowl , combine flour and baking powder
6. Add dry ingredients to liquid mixture , beating until smooth
7. Add clementine zest and poppy seeds
8. Pour batter into the loaf pan and bake to 350f for 1 hour or until a toothpick inserted in the centre comes out clean
9. Take loaf out of the oven and cool 3 minutes in the pan
10. Remove foil
11. Cool loaf on a cake rack
12. Serve with clementine supremes
13. Glaze : in a small bowl , mix clementine juice and sugar together
14. Spoon over hot cake

title: healthy mandarin orange dessert
steps:
1. In square 8x8 dish , combine gelatin and boiling water and stir until gelatin is dissolved
2. Add cold water , pineapple and mandarin oranges
3. Chill until almost set
4. Combine whipped topping and yogurt
5. Fold into gelatin mixture
6. Chill for at least three hours , cut into 8 equal squares and serve

title: vegan speedy alfredo style sauce  no tofu
steps:
1. Add all the ingredients to a blender and blend until smooth
2. I used my "magic bullet" and it worked just fine
3. Depending on your blender or processor , you might have some cashew lumps , which you can always strain out if you want to
4. Heat gently and toss with steamed broccoli or cooked pasta -- or anything you like !

title: hot  apple pie
steps:
1. Fill a shot glass half full with the bailey's and the rest of the way with the goldschlager
2. Mix with toothpick
3. Then sprinkle a bit of cinnamon on the top and light it with a match
4. Let it burn for a few seconds and gently blow out the flame being careful not to splash the drink out of the glass
5. Then , drink !

title: drago s potato salad
steps:
1. Dice and boil potatoes until fork tender
2. While boiling potatoes , hard boil your eggs
3. Let eggs and potatoes cool
4. Then peel and dice eggs
5. Mix potatoes , eggs , mayo , mustard , relish , onion , celery , cajun seasoning , salt and pepper
6. Make sure to mix lightly so not to mash the potatoes
7. Chill for no less than 3 hours

title: texas potatoes
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together while potatoes are slightly frozen
2. Pour into 9x13 pan
3. Melt 2 tbsp of butter and mix / 4 cup cornflakes
4. Put on top of potatoes
5. Bake at 350 degrees for 45-50 minutes

title: easiest venison
steps:
1. Brown venison steaks on the stove
2. When the steaks are brown , place in a crock pot or oven safe dish and add the condensed soup-do not add water !
3. Place in the oven to cook at 350 degrees for about 10 minutes , or until the steaks are done and the soup is hot
4. Or set the crock pot on low and leave for 6 to 8 hours
5. Enjoy !

title: sweet red pepper soup
steps:
1. Melt butter in a large saucepan over medium heat
2. Add the onion and garlic
3. Cook for 5-8 minutes or until onions are tender
4. Add the red peppers
5. Continue cooking for 5 minutes
6. Add the stock , freshly ground pepper and salt
7. Bring to a boil
8. Reduce heat , cover and simmer for 25 minutes
9. Put soup through a food mill to remove the pepper skins
10. Return to saucepan
11. Add cream and heat through without boiling

title: new york bakery style chinese cookies
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , cream together the sugar and shortening
2. Stir in the egg and vanilla , then beat until light and fluffy
3. Combine the cake flour , baking soda and salt
4. Stir into the creamed mixture until well-blended
5. The dough will be stiff , so you may need to use your hands to mix depending on the strength of your mixer
6. Roll dough into a log about 15 inches long
7. If you find the dough falling apart too much , knead one teaspoon of milk at a time into the dough until it will hold up to shaping
8. If desired , you can coat the log with ground nuts or colored or chocolate sprinkles before chilling and slicing
9. Beat the egg , egg white or yolk with a tablespoon of water , brush over the log , then roll the log in your choice of coating , pressing them in a bit
10. Red and green sprinkles mixed together and used to edge the vanilla cookies is really nice around the holidays
11. Instructions for marble cookies are given below
12. Wrap the dough tightly in plastic wrap or wax paper and refrigerate for about 1 / 2 hour
13. If you chill them longer , let the log sit out for a bit before slicing or the dough will be too hard and may crumble
14. To bake , preheat oven to 350 degrees
15. Grease cookie sheets
16. Unwrap dough and using a very thin , sharp knife , cut into 1 / 2 inch slices
17. This dough is a bit difficult to work with , and may tend to crumble
18. If it does , let it warm up a bit more before slicing
19. Place cookies 1 1 / 2 inches apart on the prepared cookie sheets
20. If you prefer , gently adjust the edges of the cookies to make them as close to a circle as possible
21. Lightly press a chocolate star , walnut half , or any other similar addition in the center of each cookie
22. Bake for 10 to 15 minutes , or until just barely browned around the edges and the middle has set
23. If making the smaller cookies , bake for 9-12 minutes
24. Allow cookies to cool on the baking sheets for a few minutes before removing to a cooling rack
25. One possible variation is melting some chocolae chips with a small bit of vegetable shortening and then piping a star onto the center of each baked and cooled cookie , then putting them in the refrigerator until the chocolate is set
26. To make marble cookies::
27. Divide the finished dough in half , and add 1 / 3 to 1 / 2 cup unsweetened cocoa powder and 1-2 tablespoons of milk to one of the halves and blend well
28. Roll both flavors out to separate logs , then put one on top of the other and press lightly together
29. Twist in a few places and and fold the dough over on itself once or twice to marble the dough , but not too much because you want a nice distinct marble with a bit of thin , delicate swirls here and there and look really nice once they're baked
30. Then roll into one or two logs , chill , slice and bake as directed above
31. For christmas , try separating the dough into 3 or 4 parts , coloring one red , one green , and one chocolate , leaving a 4th section plain , and then marbleing
32. For halloween , use orange coloring instead of plain marbled with chocolate dough
33. These look great with a chocolate star placed or piped onto the center of the cookie
34. These cookies are nice and crisp without being hard , and will keep well kept in a covered plastic container or plastic bag

title: blueberry raspberry crunch
steps:
1. In a bowl , mix together the blueberry and raspberry pie filling
2. Pour into a greased 13x9 inch baking dish
3. In another bowl , mix together the cake mix , walnuts , and butter until crumbly
4. Sprinkle mixture over pie filling
5. Bake at 375 degrees for 25-20 minutes or until filling is bubbly and topping is golden brown
6. Best served warm
7. We spoon a little ice cream on top

title: chicken avocado salad
steps:
1. Mix everything together in a large bowl
2. Gently stir to mix evenly

title: kevin s mint yogurt sauce
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients thoroughly using milk to thin to taste
2. Place in refrigerator for one hour to cool
3. Serve over kebabs , pakora , samosas , tikkas , or with any other indian starter

title: cookies by design   cookies on a stick
steps:
1. Place melted butter in a large mixing bowl and add each remaining ingredient as listed , beating well after each addition to achieve a smooth dough
2. Let dough stand uncovered 10 minutes
3. Make golf-ball-sized shapes of the dough and insert a flat , wooden popsicle stick into one side of each ball
4. Carefully flatten each ball of dough to a 1 / 2 inch thick patty
5. Place 3 inches apart on greased baking sheets
6. Bake at 400f for 6-8 minutes or til just browned around the edges , but still white on tops of cookies
7. Remove from the oven and smear the top of each cookie generously with heated , canned , ready-to-spread frosting
8. Frostings may be tinted with few drops food coloring once it has been heated
9. Let cookies cool on baking sheet 10 minutes before carefully removing to paper towels

title: wonderful sugar cookies
steps:
1. Cream butter and sugars together
2. Add egg , vanilla and almond extract
3. Combine flour , baking soda , cream of tartar and add dry mixture , mix all together
4. Bake at 350 for about 6-9 minutes

title: onion bhaji  indian onion fritters
steps:
1. In a bowl , combine the flour , turmeric , cumin , coriander , parsley and water
2. Season with salt and pepper
3. Add the remaining ingredients and stir to blend
4. Preheat the fryer to high heat
5. Preheat the oven to 75 c
6. With two teaspoons , place 15 ml of batter and fry in the hot oil , a few at a time , for 3 to 4 minutes , turning occasionally
7. Drain on paper towel and keep warm in the oven
8. Fry the remaining fritters
9. Serve warm as a starter

title: taco pickup sticks snack mix
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine the potato sticks , onions , and peanuts
2. Combine butter and taco seasoning
3. Mix well
4. Pour over potato stick mixture and toss to coat
5. Place in three ungreased 15x10x1-inch baking pans
6. Bake uncovered at 250f for 45 minutes , stirring every 15 minutes
7. Store in airtight containers

title: favorite fish casserole
steps:
1. Arrange fish fillets in a shallow baking dish and sprinkle with lemon juice
2. Pour melted butter over the top
3. Bake in a preheated 400 f oven for 15 minutes
4. Heat soup , add sherry , and pour over over fish
5. Sprinkle with cheese and continue baking at the lower temp of 300 f for another 15 minutes
6. Sprinkle with parsley and garnish with paprika

title: whole roasted chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Chop apple and one onion into large chunks
3. Stuff into cavity of chicken along with the garlic
4. Save any apple chunks that won't fit
5. Spray 9x13 baking dish with nonstick cooking spray
6. Place chicken back-up into baking dish
7. Baste chicken liberally with olive oil , then sprinkle with dried seasoning of your choice
8. Chop the carrots into 1-1
9. 5" pieces
10. Chop the potatoes and remaining onion into similar-sized pieces and place into baking dish around the chicken
11. Add any leftover apple
12. Pour half of the can of chicken broth over vegetables in the dish
13. Season vegetables with sea salt and freshly ground pepper to taste
14. Bake in preheated oven for 60-80 minutes , or 20 minutes per pound of chicken
15. Halfway through baking , add the remaining half can of chicken broth to the pan
16. Cool for 5 minutes , covered with aluminum foil , before serving

title: chocolate chip cookie dough ball  or dip
steps:
1. In a saucepan , melt butter over low heat
2. Add brown sugar and stir until sugar melts
3. Remove from heat and whisk in vanilla
4. Let cool
5. In a separate bowl , beat cream cheese and confectioner's sugar for 1 minute
6. Slowly beat in cooled butter mixture and beat again for 1 minute
7. Stir in chocolate chips
8. Scoop into serving bowl and refrigerate for 1 hour
9. Or place the mixture onto a piece of plastic wrap and form into a ball
10. Refrigerate for 1 hour and then roll ball in pecans and serve

title: seafood cocktail  sauce
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients
2. Keep in refrigerator till ready to serve

title: mexican low fat citrus salad dressing
steps:
1. In a non metal bowl whisk all the ingedients
2. Cover& chill for up to 4 hours

title: best red pesto sauce
steps:
1. In a food processor or blender , blend the tomatoes , basil and garlic
2. Add the grated cheese , nuts and 1 / 4 cup olive oil
3. Blend well
4. Add the remaining 1 / 4 cup olive oil , salt and pepper
5. Blend well
6. Store in the fridge , or separate evenly in icecube containers and freeze
7. Use in pasta dishes

title: peanut butter and chocolate chip muffins
steps:
1. Preheat over at 200 degrees celcius
2. Cream peanut butter , butter and sugar till light and fluffy
3. Beat in the eggs
4. Mix in flour , baking powder , salt , both milks and vanilla
5. If batter is too thick / stiff keep adding milk until it seems like the right consistency
6. Mix well
7. Fill muffin cups with batter till quarter full , then drop in chocolate chips to make center choc filling
8. Cover / fill with batter til 3 / 4 full
9. Sprinkle some choc chips on top
10. Bake for about 25 mins or till muffin tops crack

title: cherry o cheesecake pie
steps:
1. With mixer
2. Beat cheese until fluffy
3. Gradually beat in sweetened condensed milk until smooth
4. Stir in lemon juice and vanilla pour into crust
5. Chill at least 4 hours or more
6. Spoon pie filling on top and serve
7. Refrigerate leftovers

title: african chicken in spicy red sauce
steps:
1. Berbere:
2. Combine all ingredients in a small bowl
3. Yields 1 / 4 cup
4. Serving size is 1 teaspoons
5. Chicken:
6. Place chicken in a shallow dish
7. Drizzle with juice , and sprinkle with 1 / 2 tsp salt
8. Cover and marinate in refrigerator for 30 minutes
9. Heat a large pot over medium heat
10. Add olive oil
11. Add onion and garlic
12. Cook 5 minutes , stirring frequently
13. Add 2 tsp berbere , remaining 1 / 4 tsp salt , butter , ginger , nutmeg , and cardamom , cook 1 minute
14. Add wine , broth , and tomato paste
15. Stir until well blended
16. Add chicken mixture
17. Bring to a boil
18. Cover , reduce heat , and simmer 50 minutes or until chicken is tender , turning chicken occasionally
19. Stir in cilantro
20. Serve with lemon wedges

title: audrey s banana milkshakes
steps:
1. Place first three ingredients in blender , and blend for 15 seconds on medium speed or until banana is smooth
2. Add ice cream , cinnamon and mint extract and blend for another 20-30 seconds
3. Pour into tall glass , drink and enjoy !

title: amazing fast rise challah bread   one small loaf
steps:
1. Mix warm water , oil and egg together into a stand mixer bowl
2. Mix , with kneading hook , until blended
3. Add salt , sugar , and yeast and flour
4. Mix with hook until a soft dough is formed
5. You may need to add a bit more warm water
6. Check the dough , it should be soft and slightly sticky
7. It should easily form into a smooth ball
8. When the right consistency is reached , knead with hook for 6 minutes
9. Take dough ball out and place into oiled bowl-turn it over so that the oil in on all sides
10. Cover with saran wrap and let rise until doubled
11. Punch down dough and divide into thirds
12. Roll each piece into a strand
13. Prepare cookie sheet with parchment paper
14. Place all three strands onto sheet and braid
15. Cover with saran wrap and let rise again until doubled
16. In the mean time preheat oven to 375f
17. Brush top of braid with beaten egg yolk and bake for 15-20 minutes or until golden brown

title: chocolate coconut peaks
steps:
1. Melt butter in heavy 1 1 / 2 quart saucepan
2. Heat until a deep golden brown
3. Remove from heat
4. Stir in sugar , milk and vanilla
5. Add coconut
6. Drop by teaspoon onto wax paper
7. Cool and shape into cones
8. Melt chocolate over hot water
9. Twirl the bottoms of candies in the chocolate and set on waxed paper
10. Chill until firm
11. If you know these will have to set out where it is extra warm , you can mix some paraffin in the chocolate to help it stay set
12. The mix should not be more than one to one

title: it s hot stuff  honey
steps:
1. Combine honey and pepper flakes in a heavy saucepan
2. Warm over low heat for 10 minutes
3. Cover and turn off heat
4. Let stand 1 or 2 hours
5. Strain through fine sieve , and pour into sterilized jars with tightly fitting lids
6. Store at room temperature
7. This recipe is easily doubled or tripled , or four-tupled or more-- just keep the ratio of 1 teaspoon pepper for each cup of honey

title: creamy chicken dip
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl beat cream cheese , sour cream , and worcestershire sauce until creamy
2. Fold in parmesan cheese and chicken
3. Pour into pie plate sprayed with pam
4. Liberally sprinkle more parmesan on top
5. Bake at 375 degrees for 30 minutes
6. Serve hot with crackers

title: amy s special raspberry jam bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Spray a 9x13 baking dish and set aside
3. Combine cookie mix , oil , egg , and water
4. Fold in the white chocolate chips and press into the bottom of the pan
5. Bake until edges are golden brown , about 10 minutes , and cool completely
6. Microwave the frosting for about 10 seconds to soften and stir in the milk
7. Spread on the cooled bars
8. Drop the jam by spoonfuls onto the frosting and swirl with a knife
