9. Allow frosting to firm before cutting

title: poppy seed pasta
steps:
1. Cook the fettuccine according to the package directions
2. Meanwhile , heat the butter in a large skillet
3. Saute the garlic in the butter until soft but not brown
4. Drain the cooked pasta and immediately toss with the garlic butter
5. Toss in the poppy seeds and salt to taste
6. Place into a serving bowl
7. Sprinkle with chopped parsley and parmesan and serve

title: crockpot brazilian chicken curry  paleo
steps:
1. Cut chicken pieces in half or quarters
2. Combine coconut milk , tomato paste , garlic , ginger , curry powder , salt and pepper , and red pepper flakes in the crockpot and whisk together
3. Add in peppers , chicken , and broth
4. Mix all ingredients together to completely cover the chicken in the curry mixture
5. Cover and cook at low for 6-8 hours or high for 4-5 hours

title: southern crab cakes with remoulade dipping sauce
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 200f
2. Combine crabmeat , 3 / 4 cup bread crumbs and green onions in a medium bowl and then add 1 / 4 cup mayonnaise , egg white , 1 tablespoon mustard and 1 / 2 teaspoon pepper sauce , mix well
3. Using 1 / 4 cup of mixture per cake , shape 8 1 / 2 inch thick cakes and then roll crab cakes lightly in remaining 3 / 4 cup bread crumbs
4. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium heat until hot
5. Add 1 teaspoon oil and add 4 crab cakes , dook for 4 to 5 minutes per side or until golden brown and transfer to a serving platter , keep warm in oven and repeat with remaining teaspoon oil and crab cakes
6. To prepare dipping sauce , combine remaining 1 / 4 cup mayonnaise , 1 tablespoon mustard and 1 / 4 teaspoon hot pepper sauce in small bowl , mix well
7. Serve crab cakes warm with lemon wedges and dipping sauce

title: rhubarb custard dessert
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f degrees
2. In small bowl , combine all crust ingredients
3. Mix until crumbly
4. Press onto bottom of a 13 by 9 inch baking dish
5. Bake for 15 minutes
6. Meanwhile , in large bowl , combine all filling ingredients , except the rhubarb
7. Beat at medium speed until smooth , about 2 minutes
8. With spoon , stir in rhubarb
9. Pour over hot crust and continue baking for 45-50 minutes or until filling is firm to the touch
10. Remove from oven and increase temperature to 400f degrees
11. In large bowl , beat egg whites until soft peaks form , about 2 minutes
12. Add salt and vanilla
13. Continue beating while gradually adding sugar
14. Beat until stiff peaks form
15. Spread over hot filling
16. Continue baking for 6-8 minutes or until meringue is golden brown
17. Cool completely
18. Store refrigerated

title: olga s kitchen bread
steps:
1. Scald milk
2. Place scalded milk in a large bowl with honey , margarine , salt
3. Stir until margarine is melted
4. Let cool
5. In a small bowl , combine: sugar , dry yeast and warm water
6. The yeast should bubble
7. Add 1-1 / 2 cup flour to milk mixture , add eggs , and mix well
8. Add yeast mixture and 2-1 / 2 cups flour
9. Mix until dough is sticky
10. Knead on a floured board
11. Place dough in a bowl and cover
12. Let rise until double in size
13. Punch down dough and cut into 16 pieces
14. Form ball with each of the 16 pieces
15. Roll to 1 / 8-inch thickness , 8-10-inches round
16. In a large skillet cook for 15 seconds , flip and cook the other side

title: chocolate blender pudding
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in a blender except butter and vanilla and process on high until smooth
2. Cook and stir constantly over medium heat until boil stage
3. Reduce heat to simmer and cook two more minutes while continuing to stir
4. Remove from heat and stir in butter and vanilla
5. Chill until firm

title: anti dracula garlic cheese dip
steps:
1. Allow cream cheese to stand at room temperature for 20-30 minutes before making
2. Combine all ingredients and enjoy
3. Serve w / veggies , crackers , bread , etc
4. The flavours intensify as it sits so prepare this ahead of time and chill if you want a very intense flavour

title: banana split sundae cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Beat margarine and sugar in bowl until creamy
3. Add bananas , eggs and vanilla
4. Beat well
5. In another bowl , combine oats , flour , baking soda , salt and chocolate chips
6. Add to banana mix
7. Mix well
8. Drop by 1 / 4 cupfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet , 3 inches apart
9. Spread dough into 3 inch circles
10. Bake at 350f 14 to 16 minutes , until edges are light golden color
11. Cool 1 min on sheet
12. Remove to wire rack and cool completely
13. Store loosely covered at room temperature
14. Top with ice cream and topping

title: fruited nut peach cake
steps:
1. Spray interior of slow cooker with non stick cooking spray
2. Place pie filling in slow cooker
3. In a mixing bowl , combine dry cake mix , and butter , and spoon over filling
4. Drop walnuts on top
5. Cover , and cook on low 3-5 hours or until a toothpick inserted in center of topping comes out clean

title: rhubarb mead
steps:
1. I have not made this recipe , and i do not know what champagne yeast is-- i hope that anyone trying this recipe will be able to find it !
2. Prepare yeast as instructed on package
3. Dissolve honey in water
4. Squeeze juice from lemon and add to honey / water mixture
5. Stir in rhubarb
6. Combine this mixture with yeast and place in sterilized carboy
7. Let sit for 4 to 6 weeks in a dark place with even temperature
8. Rack to remove solids
9. Repeat if necessary
10. Bottle into sterilized wine bottles

title: beefy cheese   hash browns  pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Mix hash browns , parmesan cheese and eggs together and press into a pie plate or 9x13 pan
3. Brown ground meat with onion
4. Drain meat and return to heat
5. Add tomato sauce and vegetables to meat and stir to combine
6. Layer meat over the hash browns and bake for 15 minutes
7. Remove from oven and sprinkle cheddar cheese on top
8. Return to oven for another 15 minutes

title: oatmeal pie shell
steps:
1. In a large bowl mix together the flour , oatmeal , salt , sugar , baking powder and herbs of choice
2. Cut in shortening and butter to coarse
3. Add 3 t
4. Of the ice water and mix with a fork
5. Add more water , 1 t
6. At a time until mixture holds together
7. Roll out on a lightly floured board to 1 / 4 inch thick
8. Line a pie plate , prick the surface and bake at 375 for 20 to 25 minutes for a partially done crust , 30 to 35 for a fully baked one

title: tuna pasta w  garlic   lemon sauce
steps:
1. Boil pasta until just tender
2. Heat oil , garlic and red pepper flakes over medium heat for 3 minutes
3. Remove from heat
4. Add tuna , lemon juice , lemon zest , salt , pepper , 2 tbsp parsley and pasta cooking water
5. Return to low heat for 2- 3 minutes
6. Remove from heat
7. Pour sauce over drained pasta
8. Add remaining parsley
9. Cook over medium heat for 3 minutes
10. Remove from heat and add parmesan
11. Toss well and serve immediately

title: cheesy chicken and broccoli casserole
steps:
1. Mix oil , garlic pwdr , salt and pepper , with chicken ,
2. Cook chicken until brown on outside
3. Drain juices , add cheese and broccoli and put into a 2 quart casserole
4. Cook stuffing mix according to pkg on stove
5. Layer stuffing on top of chicken
6. Bake at 400 for 40 minute
7. Remove from oven and enjoy !

title: roasted mushroom  onion  and garlic soup
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees
2. In a large bowl , toss the onions and garlic with 1 tbs olive oil , half the salt , and half the pepper
3. Spread onto a baking sheet
4. Then toss the mushrooms with the remaining olive oil , salt , pepper , 8 of the thyme stems , and the sage leaves
5. Spread onto another baking sheet
6. Roast the vegetables for 20-30 minutes - stirring every 8 minutes and remove and set aside any pieces that are browning nicely
7. In a blender , add 1 cup of broth , 1 can of beans , the onions , garlic , sage leaves , about 1 / 2 cup mushrooms
8. Blend until pureed
9. Pour into a pot on the stove , and add the remaining chicken broth , mushroom pieces , and leaves from two remaining thyme stems
10. Heat and simmer 15 minutes

title: tuna cheese casserole
steps:
1. Preheat over to 350 degrees
2. Melt butter in sauce pan over medium heat
3. Cook onion for a few minutes and whisk in flour
4. Cook for a few minutes
5. Gradually whisk in milk until smooth , whisking often
6. Cook for about 15 minutes or until thickened
7. Turn off heat and add salt , pepper , oregano , garlic powder , hot pepper flakes , 2 cups of cheddar and 1 / 2 cup of parmesan
8. Meanwhile cook penne or rotini noodles until cooked
9. Don't overcook as they cook more while baking
10. Rinse with cold water and return to pot
11. Add sauce and tuna to the noodles and divide between 2 greased 2 liter baking dishes
12. Top with remaining 1 cup cheddar and 1 / 2 cup parmesan cheese
13. Cover with foil and bake in 350 degree oven for 20 minutes
14. Uncover and bake for 25 minutes
15. Yum yum !

title: elimination diet hummus
steps:
1. Night before- if using dried peas bring the peas to a boil in 5 cups of water
2. Boil for three minutes , then remove from heat and cover
3. Leave overnight
4. Drain and rinse the peas in batches place on a papertowel
5. Run each batch over with a rolling pin
6. Then remove any loose skins
7. Once the skins are removed , place in pressure cooker with 5 cups of water
8. Bring to pressure and cook for 25 minutes and let pressure drop naturally
9. Drain the chickpeas , but make sure to retain a 1 / 2 cup of cooking water
10. Pour all the chickpeas in the food processor and add all the other ingredients
11. You want to blend them for about 2 minutes
12. The longer you blend it the smoother it is
13. It goes very creamy when you've got it right
14. The mixture will be a bit runny , it firms up as it cools
15. Optional: remove about half the houmous and add the spinach and parsley
16. Blend again until even
17. Houmous is fine in the freezer just freeze in convenient portions
18. Then just let it thaw a couple of days in the fridge , but in a pinch the microwave can help speed things along
19. Just make sure to stir frequently
20. I'd advise using a glass container in the microwave as plastic might go funny due to the oil

title: chocolate pudding french toast
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients except bread
2. Whisk until well blended
3. Dunk bread in mixture , coating both sides
4. Cook on griddle until done
5. Serve with whip cream , strawberries and buttermilk syrup recipe #136751

title: medianoche bread
steps:
1. In a large bowl , mix yeast and three tablespoons sugar in one cup warm water
2. Place in a warm place and wait for the yeast to begin bubbling
3. Beat the eggs until foamy
4. Mix the eggs with the rest of the water and the melted lard
5. Put the flour , sugar and salt in a food processor
6. Turn on and add the liquids all at once
7. Process until it forms a ball knead for 3-5 minutes until the dough gets stiff and pliable
8. Grease a large bowl and place the dough in it , then turn the dough so that the greased side is up
9. Cover with a slightly damp , clean towel
10. Let rise in a warm place for about one hour or until the dough ball doubles in volume
11. Place the dough on your work surface and punch it down
12. Divide the dough into good-sized handfuls
13. Roll each handful on a lightly floured surface to make cylinders about five inches long and about 2 1 / 4 inches in diameter
14. Arrange rolls on a lightly greased baking sheet
15. Cover with a slightly damp , clean towel
16. Let rise in a warm place for about one hour or until the rolls double in volume
17. Preheat oven to 350 f
18. Brush the tops of the rolls liberally with the egg glaze
19. Bake until golden brown -- about 25 to 35 minutes
20. Remove the rolls from the oven , take them off the baking sheet and let cool on a wire rack
21. While they are still warm , brush the tops with a little melted butter
22. Use for medianoche sandwiches , or serve warm as a side dish

title: vanilla cream with coconut and lime
steps:
1. Boil milk with the opened vanilla bean
2. During this time stir egg yolks , sugar and cornstarch together in a pan until incorporated
3. Add hot milk , lime zest and coconut milk to the egg mixture and stir continuously by medium heat until thick and creamy
4. Add rum and stir well
5. Fill this delicious cream in serving cups and decorate with lime zest strips
6. Cool at least 2 hours and serve chilled

title: patron pineapple
steps:
1. Fill glass with ice
2. Pour in tequila and citronge
3. Top off glass with pineapple juice and give it a squeeze of lime
4. Stir and serve with a lime wheel as garnish

title: sugar cookie cups
steps:
1. Mix flour and salt in large bowl
2. Set aside
3. Beat butter and sugar in large bowl with electric mixer on medium speed until light and fluffy
4. Add egg and vanilla
5. Mix well
6. Gradually beat in flour mixture on low speed until well mixed
7. Roll dough on generously floured surface to 1 / 4-inch thickness
8. Cut out circles with 3-inch round cookie cutter
9. Place a standard muffin pan , upside down , on work surface
10. Press a dough circle around each ungreased muffin cup
11. Bake in preheated 325f oven 10 minutes or until edges are just beginning to turn golden brown
12. Cool on muffin pans 5 minutes or until cool enough to remove
13. Remove to wire racks
14. Cool completely
15. Fill as desired

title: mexican chef s salad
steps:
1. Brown ground beef , together with beans & salt for about 10 minutes
2. Drain and cool completely
3. Toss together lettuce , onion , cheese , catalina dressing , hot sauce , and tomato wedges , reserving some tomato for garnish
4. Just prior to serving , lightly toss the meat mixture in with the lettuce mix , along with the fritos and avocados , reserving a few avocado slices for garnish
5. Serve with fresh french garlic bread--yum !

title: aunt dina s one dish meal
steps:
1. While browning chopped meat , onions , salt and pepper
2. Peel and chunk potatoes , chop cabbage into small pieces
3. When meat is browned add tomato sauce , mix bring to boil
4. On top of meat , layer potatoes then cabbage
5. Cover
6. Simmer until potatoes and cabbage are tender stirring occationally after cabbage wilts

title: bengan bharta indian eggplant
steps:
1. First , roast the eggplant
2. Put the oven at 450 degrees
3. Pierce the eggplants with a fork about ten times each
4. Cover lightly in oil and a pinch of salt
5. Roast for 30 min to an hour- however long it takes for the skin to wrinkle but not burn , and make crackling sounds as it bakes
6. Allow eggplant to cool enough to handle
7. Remove the outer skin and either mash completely , or use one of those dicer machines and dice fine
8. In a large sauce pan , heat the vegetable oil , put in the cumin / mustard seeds and asefoitida , or if using my weird mix mentioned in the description , do not add the spice yet
9. Either way , add the onion' / garlic and saute until golden
10. If using my spice mix , add to diced tomatoes and ketchup and mix in a cup
11. Add tomato spice mix and cook 2 min on medium-low
12. Add chopped / mashed eggplant and a teaspoon of water if needed
13. Add green onions and 1 / 2 the cilantro
14. Cook on medium low for 10 min , stir occasionally
15. Taste , and if needed , cook on low an additional 5 - 10 minutes , stirring and adding water if needed
16. Add remaining cilantro and if desired , about 1 / 8 tsp lemon juice to brighten the flavor
17. Serve over basmati rice or with naan bread

title: cranberry pecan mayonnaise
steps:
1. Mix and use on your favorite sandwich of leftover turkey or any sandwich you wish
2. In the issue , one loaf of focaccia bread , lettuce , thin sliced turkey , gouda cheese , tomato and bacon were the ingredients in the sandwich associated with this mayonnaise
3. Slice the loaf in half horizontally , layer ingredients and cut into four wedges and serve

title: quick and easy chicken cordon bleu rolls
steps:
1. On each chicken breast , place one piece of prosciutto and cheese
2. Roll up each chicken breast and secure with a toothpick
3. Season each roll with salt and pepper
4. Place in the crock-pot slow cooker
5. In a small bowl , whisk together the soup , milk and white wine
6. Pour half of this mixture over the chicken breast rolls , placing the other half in the refrigerator for later
7. Cover and cook on low for 4 to 6 hours or on high for 3 to 4 hours
8. Before serving heat up the remainder of your sauce and put over the chicken breast when serving

title: phoulourie
steps:
1. If using already ground split peas omit step 2 , 3 and 4
2. Place split peas in a pot with 6 cups water and bring to a boil
3. Lower the heat to simmer and cook until soft
4. Drain and place in a food processor
5. Grind to a coarse , meal , resembling couscous
6. Add the garlic , turmeric , cumin , baking powder , flour salt and pepper to the ground split peas
7. Gradually add one cup water to the split pea mixture , stirring to form a thick batter
8. Heat oil in a deep frying pan and drop the batter into the oil by the tablespoonful
9. Fry until golden brown , turning often
10. Remove from oil and drain on a plate with paper towels
11. Serve with your favourite chutney

title: delicious chops of pork
steps:
1. Make the bowl of soak first which is fill a large bowl 2 / 3 full with cold water , add in sugar and salt and stir
2. Add in the chops and set for 1 hour
3. When 1 hour is almost up , set up 3 bowl station
4. The first bowl with 1 / 4 cup flour
5. 2nd bowl with the eggs and milk
6. Blended
7. 3rd bowl with the remaining flour mixed with the salt , pepper , and garlic powder
8. Drain the pork chops
9. Dip the pork chops in the first bowl , completely cover , then the 2nd bowl , completely cover , and the 3rd bowl same thing and sit on a baking pan
10. Place the pork chops in the freezer for about 10 minutes
11. In a large skillet on the stove add the oil and heat on medium
12. When the oil is hot , remove the chops from the freezer and cook , 5 minutes or so on each side until browned
13. Serve with gravy

title: indian snack mix
steps:
1. In a large bowl , mix cereals together
2. Do not mix in noodles
3. Heat oil in a large skillet
4. Fry mustard seeds and cumin seeds well
5. Add noodles and heat for approximately 2 minutes
6. Add other spices and mix well
7. Mix in peanuts
8. Add two handfuls of the cereal mix and mix well
9. Add oil mix to remaining cereal mix in bowl and stir well
10. Place in baking dish and cook in 250 degree oven for 25- 30 minutes
11. Serve in individual bowls
12. For each serving , stir in 1 tablespoon chopped onions and 1 tablespoon lemon juice , more or less to taste
13. You can also add more red pepper if you like foods that are extremely hot
14. Serve with something cold to drink

title: chou fleur persill  cauliflower with egg and parsley
steps:
1. Cut cauliflower into flowerets and discard core
2. Heat water in a saucepan and season with salt
3. Add milk and cauliflower and boil and simmer 10 minutes until tender
4. Drain
5. Prepare egg and set aside
6. In a skillet heat 1 tablespoon butter and add cauliflower
7. Toss briefly until cauliflower begins to change color
8. Remove to a serving dish
9. Heat the remaining 4 tablespoons butter and add sieved egg , salt and pepper to taste
10. Pour over cauliflower , then garnish with parsley
11. Serve immediately

title: potato  sausage and kale frittata
steps:
1. Preheat the broiler and position the rack 8 inches from the heat
2. Crack the eggs into a large bowl
3. Add 2 tablespoons of grated parmesan , season generously with salt and pepper and beat the eggs until blended
4. In a large nonstick ovenproof skillet , heat 1 teaspoon of the olive oil
5. Add the sausage meat and onion and cook over moderately high heat , breaking the sausage up into small pieces , until browned and cooked through , about 5 minutes
6. Transfer to a plate
7. Add 2 tablespoons of the olive oil to the skillet and heat until shimmering
8. Add the potatoes and cook over moderately high heat , stirring occasionally , until crisp and cooked through , about 5 minutes
9. Add the kale , season with salt and cook , tossing , until softened , about 2 minutes longer
10. Add the remaining 1 tablespoon of olive oil to the skillet and tilt the skillet to swirl the oil around the sides
11. Scatter the sausage and onion in the skillet
12. Stir the eggs and add them to the skillet
13. Cook over moderate heat for 1 minute
14. Gently lift the edge of the frittata and tilt the pan , allowing some of the uncooked egg to seep underneath
15. Cook until the bottom and sides are barely set , about 3 minutes
16. Sprinkle the remaining 2 tablespoons of grated parmesan on top and broil until the eggs are set and the top of the frittata is lightly browned , 1 to 2 minutes longer
17. Slide the frittata onto a large plate , cut into wedges and serve hot or warm

title: brie omelet
steps:
1. Add oil to a skillet over high heat
2. Remove the rind from 3 slices of brie
3. Whisk eggs for 1 minute
4. While moving the skillet in a circular motion , pour the eggs in continuing motion , cook until the outside edges are firm
5. Then flip the omelet to finish cooking
6. Place the cheese slices in the center and fold the omelet
7. Salt and pepper to taste
8. Try this recipe with camembert as well

title: slow cooker black eyed peas
steps:
1. Rinse black eyed peas , and follow package directions for quick soak
2. Rinse again , drain and place in slow cooker
3. Dissolve 3 chicken bullion cubes in a cup of hot water
4. Pour into the slow cooker
5. Add additional water if needed so that there is about 3 / 4 inch of liquid covering the peas
6. Add the remaining ingredients and stir just to get them wet
7. I use dried because they are already minced very finely and my family doesn't even notice it's in there that way
8. I also use refrigerated minced garlic and crumbled bacon from costco
9. That way i always have the ingredients on hand
10. Add a little salt and pepper
11. Cover and cook on low for about 7 hours
12. Taste and add additional garlic , salt and pepper if needed according to your preference
13. Serve with corn bread

title: pizza rolls
steps:
1. Thaw bread for 2 hours
2. Roll out to 12x9 rectangle
3. Spread with sauce
4. Top with remaining ingredients
5. Roll up jelly-roll fashion from long side
6. Seal the edges well
7. Place on greased baking sheet , seam side down
8. Brush with water , sprinkle with a little salt
9. Let rise until almost double in size-about 1 hour
10. Make 3 slashes across top
11. Bake at 375 degrees for 30 minutes
12. Slice to serve

title: macaroni coleslaw
steps:
1. Cook macaroni as directed on box and cool
2. Add shredded cabbage and rings together
3. Mix mayonnaise , sugar and vinegar together
4. Pour over cabbage mixture
5. Refrigerate until serving
6. You may leave out the green peppers if you don't like that flavor

title: mexican style chicken soup
steps:
1. Cut chicken into bite sized pieces
2. Lightly coat a large saucepan with oil and set over med-high heat
3. Add about 1 / 2 the chicken without crowding
4. Saute the chicken until no longer pink , about 3 minutes , remove to a very large stock / soup pot
5. Repeat with remaining chicken
6. Once all chicken has been removed , add onions , add more oil if needed
7. Stir until slightly softened , about 2 minutes
8. Stir in peppers , tomatoes , celery , jalapenos and seasoning , cook 3 more minutes
9. Add to stock pot , add broth
10. Bring to a boil , then reduce heat to med-low
11. Simmer , covered and stirring occasionally until all vegetables are tender , from 10-15 minutes
12. Add corn during last 2 minutes of simmering
13. Stir in lime juice
14. Just before serving , top with cilantro
15. Soup will keep well in the fridge for 3 days or in the freezer for 3 mths

title: greg s reunion dressing
steps:
1. Mix oil and vinegar
2. Gently stir in blue cheese and pear
3. Pepper as desired

title: creamy mushroom chops and rice
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. In a skillet over medium heat , brown pork chops in oil
3. Set aside
4. In an ungreased 8-inch baking dish , combine soup , rice , milk , and seasonings
5. Mix well
6. Top with pork chops
7. Cover and bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes or until meat is tender
8. Uncover and bake 5 minutes more
9. Let stand for 10 minutes before serving

title: beefy white rice   parmesan cheese
steps:
1. Melt butter over medium high heat , add chopped onion and stir until onion is soft , about 3-4 minutes
2. Add sirloin and stir until mostly cooked through , about 7-8 minutes
3. Do not drain , if using sirloin there will not be much fat
4. Add one can of beef consomme , then fill the can with water and add to pan
5. The water may froth in the can , so i added a little extra water to compensate
6. Stir through and add the rice , nutmeg , cayenne pepper , garlic powder , salt and black pepper
7. Cover and simmer for 25 minutes
8. Add parmesan cheese and stir through before serving

title: deluxe caramel corn
steps:
1. Place popcorn and pretzels in a large bowl , set aside
2. In a large heavy saucepan , combine the brown sugar , butter , corn syrup and salt , cook over medium heat , stirring occasionally , until mixture comes to a rolling boil
3. Cook and stir until candy thermometer reads 238f
4. Remove from heat , stir in baking soda
5. Quickly pour over popcorn and mix thoroughly , stir in peanuts
6. Turn into two greased 9x13 inch baking pans
7. Bake at 200f for 20 minutes
8. Stir
9. Bake 25 minutes longer
10. Remove from oven , add candy and mix well
11. Remove from pans and place on waxed paper to cool
12. Break into clusters
13. Store in airtight containers or plastic bags

title: finger fajitas with beef or buffalo
steps:
1. Cut each tortilla into 6 wedges and paint on sour cream with a pastry brush
2. Place 1 or 2 strips of meat a tablespoon guac across the wide end of each wedge
3. Roll up wedges and serve with salsa cruda
4. Great with assembly line making

title: old fashion sugar pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees f
2. Line a 9-inch pie pan with rolled out dough , prick all over with a fork , then press a piece of heavy-duty foil snugly into the pie shell
3. Bake for about 6 minutes , remove the foil and bake about 4 minutes more until just beginning to brown
4. Remove from oven and reduce heat to 350 degrees
5. Sift the sugar , flour and salt into a bowl , and stir with a fork
6. Mix well
7. Pour the sugar mixture into the pie shell and spread evenly over the bottom
8. Pour cream over the sugar mixture , completely covering
9. Dab the softened butter in bits over the cream
10. Sprinkle the nutmeg evenly over the top
11. Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes or until golden spots form on top
12. This may take as long as an hour
13. The filling will seem liquid but will become more firm as it cools

title: fat blasting baked egg casserole
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees
2. Line a 7-by-11-inch baking dish with parchment
3. Heat a large skillet over medium heat
4. Add 2 tablespoons of vegetable broth or water , the mushrooms , red bell pepper , simply organic seasoning , and optional jalapeos
5. Cook , stirring occasionally , until the vegetables are nearly tender , about 3 minutes
6. Add the spinach
7. Cook until the spinach is cooked down and bright green , about 1 minute
8. Remove the pan from the heat
9. Stir in the turkey bacon , and season to taste with salt and pepper
10. Spread the spinach mixture evenly on the bottom of the prepared baking dish
11. Whisk the egg whites , then pour them over the spinach mixture
12. Scatter the green onions on top
13. Bake until the egg whites are set , about 25 minutes
14. Test by poking a small sharp knife into the middle of the casserole and taking a peek it should be moist inside , but not liquidy
15. Let the casserole sit for about 5 minutes , and then cut into pieces and serve

title: raisin filled oatmeal bars
steps:
1. Stir together flour , oats , brown sugar and soda
2. Cut in butter until mixture is crumbly
3. Pat 2 / 3 of crumbs in the bottom of an ungreased 13x9x2-inch baking pan
4. For filling:
5. In a saucepan combine sugar and cornstarch
6. Stir in 2 cups raisins and 1 cup water
7. Cook and stir till bubbly
8. Spread atop crumb mixture
9. Sprinkle with remaining crumb mixture
10. Bake in a 375f oven for 25-30 minutes
11. Cool on wire rack
12. Cut into bars

title: pineapple fried rice from cooked  leftover  rice and chicken
steps:
1. Put oil in a wok
2. Add garlic
3. When it turns slightly brown , add eggs or vegetables , rice , chicken or vegetables , spring onions , salt , soy sauce , white pepper powder and sugar
4. Mix well
5. Add in raisins and pineapples
6. Mix well
7. Garnish with fried cashews and serve

title: pizza stromboli
steps:
1. I make this dough in my bread machine instead of doing it by hand but i'm posting it as it was published
2. You decide how you want to do it
3. In a large bowl , dissolve yeast in warm water
4. Stir in honey and milk powder until well blended
5. In a small bowl , combine 1 cup bread flour , whole wheat flour and seasonings
6. Add to yeast mixture
7. Beat until smooth
8. Stir in pizza sauce
9. Stir in enough remaining bread flour to form a soft dough
10. Turn onto a floured surface
11. Knead until smooth and elastic
12. About 6-8 minutes
13. Place in a greased bowl , turning once to grease top
14. Cover
15. Let rise in a warm place until doubled , about 1 hour
16. Punch dough down
17. Turn onto a lightly floured surface
18. Roll into a 14-in
19. X 12-in
20. Rectangle
21. Sprinkle pepperoni , 1 / 4 cup cheddar cheese , parmesan cheese , 2 tablespoons mozzarella cheese , onion , olives and mushrooms to within 1 / 2 inches of edges
22. Roll up jelly-roll style , starting with a long side
23. Pinch seam to seal and tuck ends under
24. Place seam side down on a greased baking sheet
25. Cover and let rise for 45 minutes
26. Sprinkle with remaining cheese
27. Bake at 350 for 25-30 minutes or until golden brown
28. Remove from pan to a wire rack
29. Serve warm
30. Refrigerate leftovers

title: ziti  spinach  and mushroom casserole
steps:
1. In a skillet over medium heat , melt butter
2. Saute and stir mushrooms for about 5 minutes or until tender
3. Stir in spinach and remove from heat
4. In a mixing bowl , combine mushroom-spinach mixture , cottage cheese , monterey jack cheese , seasonings , and ziti
5. Transfer to a lightly greased 2 1 / 2 quart baking dish
6. Place tomato slices on top and sprinkle with parmesan cheese
7. Bake , uncovered , in a 350 oven for about 40 minutes or until heated through

title: crock pot stuffing barbaja w
steps:
1. Saute butter onion parsley mushroom celery combine with other ingredients
2. Cook in covered crock pot on high for one hour and on low for 4 hours
3. Stays moist on low while guest come and go on no schedule , like for an open house or something
4. Taste good
5. May use cornbread or plain stuffing

title: cucumber   dill sauce
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients well
2. Keep refrigerated

title: b s taco dip  meatless
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , microwave cream cheese just to soften
2. Add sour cream and taco seasoning mix to softened cream cheese
3. Blend the mixture well and try to get out all the lumps
4. Using an electric mixer makes it a much easier task , but i usually just stir it manually
5. Spread mixture into the bottom of an inch-deep baking sheet
6. Pour taco sauce over the top , spreading it lightly with the bottom of a spoon to cover entire mixture
7. Top with remaining ingredients
8. The order i use is: lettuce , tomato , onion , then cheese
9. Of course , you can do what you want but it looks really nice when the cheese is on the very top

title: all american cheeseburger pizza
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 500 degrees f
2. Place pizza dough into 12" circle or retangle
3. Distribute beef over dough then squeeze bottle of ketchup in light spirals - about 2 tbs
4. Repeat using mustard the same way
5. Distribute caramelized onions over pizza
6. Top with both cheeses
7. Arrange tomato slices over cheeses
8. Spread pickle quarters evenly around pizza
9. Bake in oven for 5 minutes
10. Turn pizza 180 degrees and bake until golden brown
11. Cut into slices and serve topped with lettuce and drizzled with thousand island dressing
12. To make caramelized onions: place onions , salt , vegetable oil , pepper and sugar into pan and cook all ingredients together on stovetop until golden brown

title: onion  bacon  and spinach frittata
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees f
2. Cook bacon slices in a 10-inch nonstick skillet over medium heat until crisp
3. Combine bacon slices and next 4 ingredients in a bowl , and stir well
4. Set aside
5. Add onion to skillet
6. Cover and cook 5 minutes or until crisp-tender , stirring occasionally
7. Add water and sugar
8. Saute 5 minutes or until onion is tender and golden brown
9. Add spinach
10. Cover and cook for 2 minutes or until spinach wilts
11. Stir in bacon mixture
12. Spread evenly in bottom of skillet
13. Cook over medium-low heat 5 minutes or until almost set
14. Wrap handle of skillet with foil
15. Place skillet in oven , and bake at 450 degrees f for 5 minutes or until set
16. Sprinkle with cheese
17. Bake an additional minute or until cheese melts

title: swiss chicken and ham casserole
steps:
1. In a bowl , combine chicken , soup , onion , ham , sour cream and milk
2. Place rice in a 9x13 pan
3. Spread evenly
4. Spread meat mixture over rice
5. Bake in a 350 degree oven for 30 minutes
6. Sprinkle with grated swiss and place back in oven until cheese melts
7. Let rest 5 minutes and then serve

title: gooey coconut bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Spray a 13 x 9 pan with cooking spray or butter generously
3. Mix cake mix , melted butter and 2 eggs until crumbly
4. Press into bottom of pan and up about 1 inch around the edge
5. In a large bowl mix: cream cheese , the other 2 egtgs , vanilla and almond extracts , confectioners sugar and coconut
6. Pour over crust
7. Bake for 45 minutes or until top is golden brown
8. Cool completely in pan
9. Cut into small squares

title: cook s fried corn
steps:
1. Fry bacon in a large frying pan until bacon is browned
2. Reduce heat , add onion and peppers
3. Cook 3-5 minutes , until onions are translucent
4. Pour off bacon grease
5. Meanwhile , cook and drain corn in separate pan
6. At medium heat , add corn to bacon and onions in frying pan and stir-fry until corn starts to brown
7. Season with sea salt and black pepper to taste

title: verenika with ham gravy
steps:
1. In a blender , combine cottage cheese , 2 eggs and ground black pepper to taste
2. Cover and blend until smooth , or beat with an electric mixer until smooth
3. Set aside
4. In a large bowl , stir together flour , milk powder , baking powder and 1 / 2 teaspoon salt
5. In a small bowl , beat together 2 eggs , water and oil
6. Combine with flour mixture
7. On a floured surface , knead dough about 10 times or until smooth
8. Divide dough in half and roll out each portion to a 1 / 8 inch thickness
9. Using a 4 inch round cutter , cut out rounds of dough
10. Place 1 tablespoon of filling in the center of each circle
11. Moisten the edge and fold over to form a half moon shape
12. Pinch to seal
13. Bring a large pot of water to a boil
14. Add half of the dumplings and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until tender
15. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain
16. Repeat with remaining dumplings
17. While the dumplings are cooking , prepare the gravy
18. In a medium saucepan , melt the butter over medium-low heat
19. Stir in ham , and cook until ham is light brown
20. Add 3 tablespoons flour , 1 / 2 teaspoon salt , and 1 / 8 teaspoon ground black pepper
21. Stir
22. Pour in milk all at once , stirring constantly
23. Cook and stir until thick and bubbly
24. Serve over the dumplings

title: gruyere squash casserole
steps:
1. Cook the onions until lightly brown
2. Add the squash , seasoning with salt and pepper to taste and cook until tender , about 8 minutes
3. Remove from heat and stir in mayo , 1 cup of the cheese , and 1 cup of the crumbled crackers
4. Pour into a 1 and 1 / 2 quart baking dish and sprinkle with remaining cheese , then remaining crackers
5. Bake for 25 minutes at 350 degrees

title: cinnamon roll monkey bread
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 350f
2. Lightly grease 12 cup fluted tube pan or bunt pan
3. In a plastic food-storage bag , mix sugar and 1 teaspoon cinnamon
4. Separate cinnamon rolls
5. Cut each into quarters
6. Shake in bag to coat
7. Arrange in pan
8. Mix brown sugar , 1 teaspoon of cinnamon , and the butter
9. Pour over the cinnamon rolls pieces
10. Bake 28- 32 minutes or until golden brown and no longer doughy in the center
11. Cool in pan 10 minutes
12. Turn upside down onto serving plate
13. Drizzle the icing that came with cinnamon rolls over the bread
14. Pull apart to eat
15. Serve warm
16. Be prepared to make another right away
17. This goes fast

title: sarasota s easy mojito freeze
steps:
1. Pretzels -- i just crushed mine in a mini food processor , but using a baggie and a mallet or rolling pin works just as well
2. Just make sure to end up with a fine texture
3. Crust -- use a 9" round pan for this recipe and line with plastic wrap
4. Then in a small bowl , mix the pretzel crumbs and butter
5. Press onto the bottom of the pan
6. I like to use the bottom of a glass to press the crust down good
7. Freeze until ready to use
8. Filling -- beat the cream cheese , sugar , zest , juice and mint with a mixer until well blended
9. Then fold in 1 1 / 2 cups of the whipped topping
10. Spread it over the pretzel crust and use a spatula to smooth out the top
11. Freeze -- at least 4 hours
12. Serve -- the plastic wrap makes it easy to lift right out of the pan and slide on to a plate
13. Let it set 10-15 minutes to soften a little and then top with the remaining whipped topping in the center , a fresh lime slice and a sprig of mint for the perfect summertime dessert
14. Enjoy !

title: asparagus parmesan pita rounds
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450f
2. Steam asparagus , covered , 2 minutes or until crisp tender
3. Rinse with cold water
4. Drain
5. Combine oil and garlic
6. Brush over pitas
7. Arrange tomato slices and asparagus on pitas
8. Sprinkle with basil , pepper , and salt
9. Top evenly with parmesan cheese
10. Bake for 7 to 8 minutes or until edges are golden

title: petersons corners patricks ruby red salad dressing  copycat
steps:
1. Whisk all ingredients togeather until sugar is dissolved and oil well emulsified with other ingredients
2. Put into 2 pint jars
3. Refrigerate overnight allowing ingredients to marry
4. Take jar of dressing out of refrigerator and allow it to sit for at least 15 to 30 minutes
5. Shake jar well prior to serving over a nice green salad

title: ham and noodles
steps:
1. Combine the flour and a small amount of milk to make a smooth paste
2. When smooth , add remaining milk and the mustard
3. Set aside
4. Melt butter in a large pan on medium heat
5. Add carrots and garlic and cook until crispy-tender , stirring often
6. Next take the set-aside milk mixture and stir into carrots
7. Bring to a boil , stirring constantly
8. When mixture thickens , cook for one minute stirring constantly
9. Stir in ham , cooked noodles and thawed peas
10. Heat through till good and hot , stirring constantly , but gently
11. Serve immediately

title: fluffy tea biscuits
steps:
1. Put flour , baking powder and salt in a bowl
2. Cut in the margarine
3. Pour in the 7 up all at once and stir with a fork until moist
4. Knead 8--10 times
5. Roll the biscuit dough 3 / 4 of a inch , rest a few minutes
6. Cut out biscuits and place on a cookie sheet
7. Brush top with butter bake at425 for 12 minutes

title: cranberry waldorf  a healthier version
steps:
1. Combine all tossing to coat
2. Cover and chill 2 hours
3. Can garnish with sugar-dipped cranberries

title: cornbread  low fat
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Beat egg whites until soft peaks form
3. Mix dry ingredients together in bowl
4. Stir in yogurt
5. Fold in the egg whites
6. Mix well
7. Bake at 400 degrees in 8" square or round pan
8. For about 20 minutes

title: cranberry cooler cocktail
steps:
1. Mix rum and cranberry juice
2. Pour into stem glasses
3. Top with small scoop of sherbet

title: oven fried buttermilk chicken breasts
steps:
1. Place chicken pieces in a large , shallow pan / dish
2. Pour buttermilk over and turn chicken pieces to coat evenly
3. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours
4. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
5. Place the oil and butter in another shallow pan and put in a heated 375 degree oven to melt
6. Set aside
7. Drain chicken in colander to remove excess liquid
8. Pat chicken dry with paper towels
9. In a large plastic bag , combine the flour and seasonings
10. Roll the chicken in the melted butter / oil mixture , then drop into the bag and shape to cover
11. Put chicken in a baking pan
12. Bake for 20 minutes
13. With a spatula , turn the chicken over and bake 5-10 minutes longer or until the top crust begins to bubble
14. The total weight of boneless , skinless meat should equal 1 1 / 4 to 1 1 / 2 pounds
15. You will want to reduce the cooking time for chicken tenders since they are a thinner piece of meat and will cook much quicker then a chicken breast
16. ____i listed cayenne pepper as an optional ingredient in this recipe
17. I like a spicy kick to fried chicken
18. I probably wouldn't add the cayenne pepper if i was serving it to children
19. _____for the buttermilk: i've used both regular and the low-fat versions
20. Both work well in this recipe
21. _____for night before prepping: mix seasoning and flour and put in plastic bag
22. Put chicken to marinate in buttermilk
23. Measure out butter and vegetable oil--combine in small covered bowl

title: rice pudding with raisins
steps:
1. Combine rice , water , butter and raisins
2. Bring to a boil then reduce heat to low
3. Cover and cook for 15 minutes
4. After rice is cooked add 1 c sugar and all of the half & half
5. Bring to a boil
6. Reduce heat to low to med
7. Low and stir constantly for 15 minutes till thickened
8. Beat egg yolk in separate bowl till creamy
9. Add 2 t milk and then 2-3 t of the hot rice milk
10. Pour into pot of rice and stir for 1 minute
11. Remove from heat
12. Add vanilla and let cool 1 hour
13. After rice is cooled if the mixture is too thick add 1 / 4 to 1 / 2 cup heavy cream
14. Beat egg whites till stiff
15. Add 2 t sugar and beat a little longer till combined
16. Fold egg whites into cooled rice pudding
17. Pour into serving bowl and sprinkle with cinammon to taste
18. Chill for several hours or you can eat it warm
19. Enjoy !

title: apple chicken quesadillas
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine the first seven ingredients
2. Place about 3 / 4 cup on half of each tortilla
3. Fold tortilla in half over filling and secure with toothpicks
4. Place on a baking sheet coated with cooking spray
5. Bake at 400 for 8-10 minutes or until golden brown
6. Carefully turn quesadillas over
7. Bake 5-8 minutes longer or until golden brown
8. Discard toothpicks
9. Cut each quesadilla into three wedges
10. Serve with lettuce , salsa and sour cream

title: roasted tarragon chicken and gravy
steps:
1. Leave chicken whole
2. Wash chicken , drain and pat dry
3. Mix tarragon and garlic together
4. Sprinkle mixed seasonings inside cavity of chicken and over the outside
5. Place chicken in crock pot , breast side up
6. Pour broth into crock pot
7. Sprinkle rest of seasoning mix over the chicken
8. Cover and cook on low for 8 hours
9. To make gravy:
10. Remove chicken from crock and keep warm
11. Add thickening to thicken gravy to desired thickness
12. To bake in oven:
13. Put chicken in roasting pan
14. Bake at 350f for 1 hour or until chicken is golden and juices run clear
15. Use broth to make gravy

title: smoky maple barbecued chicken breasts
steps:
1. Soak the chicken breasts in cold , salted water for at least 30 minutes , to eliminate the"game-y" taste
2. Drain and pat dry
3. While the chicken is soaking , fire up the grill
4. Sprinkle the chicken with salt and pepper to taste
5. Sprinkle with lemon juice
6. Stir together the maple syrup , barbecue sauce , mustard , and liquid smoke
7. Grill the chicken , turning and basting with the sauce , for 12-15 minutes , or until the juices run clear and centers are no longer pink
8. Serve hot

title: grecian salad dressing
steps:
1. In a very large container , mix together the olive oil , garlic powder , oregano , basil , pepper , salt , onion powder , and dijon-style mustard
2. Pour in the vinegar , and mix vigorously until well blended
3. Store tightly covered at room temperature

title: hawaiian chicken and pineapple casserole
steps:
1. In a large skillet , heat oil over medium heat
2. Add the chicken
3. Brown lightly on all sides
4. Transfer chicken to a plate
5. Add the onion , bell peppers , and mushrooms to the skillet
6. Season with salt and pepper
7. Stir / saute for 5 minutes or until softened
8. Remove pan from heat
9. Layer half the vegetables and half the pineapple chunks over the bottom of a 2 to 2 1 / 2 quart lightly greased casserole dish
10. Arrange chicken pieces over the vegetables and pineapple
11. In a small bowl , mix together the soy sauce and honey
12. Brush the chicken with this mixture
13. Layer the remaining vegetables and pineapple over the chicken
14. Mix the pineapple juice and wine together
15. Pour evenly over the top
16. Cover and bake in a 350 oven for about 1 hour or until the chicken is tender

title: yellow butter cake
steps:
1. Mix cake mix , melted butter and one egg
2. Pat into 13x9 inch pan
3. In a separate bowl beat cheese until fluffy
4. Add 2 remaining eggs to cheese and mix well
5. Add powdered sugar and beat until lumps are gone
6. Pour this mixture over cake in pan
7. Bake at 350 for 30-45 minutes or until topping is golden
8. Allow to cool somewhat to set topping
9. For the white chocolate icing
10. Melt chocolate in top of double boiler
11. Stir flour into chocolate
12. Add milk a little at a time and blend well
13. Cook over medium heat , stirring constantly , until very thick
14. It should have the texture and consistency of thick pudding
15. Cool completely
16. In a large bowl , beat sugar , butter and vanilla until light and fluffy
17. Gradually add cooled chocolate mixture and beat until icing is the consistency of whipped cream

title: pumpkin oatmeal butterscotch cookies
steps:
1. Cream butter and sugars
2. Beat in egg and vanilla
3. Combine flour , salt , oats , baking soda , cinnamon , ginger , cloves , and nutmeg in a separate , large mixing bowl
4. Stir in creamed mixture alternately with pumpkin
5. Fold in chips
6. Drop by tbsp onto greased cookie sheets
7. Bake at 350 degrees for 15 minutes or until lightly browned

title: potato  green bean and bacon chowder
steps:
1. Fry bacon until crisp in large dutch oven or stock pot
2. Add onion and saute for 2 or 3 minutes
3. Pour off fat
4. Add potatoes and water
5. Bring to boil , cover and simmer 10 to 15 minutes , or until potatoes are tender
6. Stir in soup and sour cream
7. Gradually add milk
8. Add green beans
9. Add pepper and parsley
10. Heat to serving temperature
11. Do not boil

title: christmas jello
steps:
1. Dissolve red hots in hot water
2. Add jello and let cool
3. Stir in apple sauce , lemon juice , and salt
4. Chill until partially set
5. While chilling , form cream cheese into small balls and roll in nuts
6. Fold into jello-o mixture
7. Chill until set

title: ww 5 points   spicy orange beef with vegetables
steps:
1. Combine beef , 1 tbsp cornstarch , and orange rind in medium bowl
2. Toss well to coat and set aside
3. Combine remaining 1 tbsp cornstarch , broth , orange juice , soy sauce , and chili-garlic sauce in small bowl
4. Set aside
5. Heat nonstick skillet over med-high heat until a drop of water sizzles
6. Add 2 tsp oil , then add beef
7. Stir-fry until cooked through
8. Transfer to a plate
9. Add remaining 2 tsp oil , then add the ginger
10. Stir-fry until fragrant
11. Add the green beans , bell pepper , and carrot
12. Stirfry until crisp-tender
13. Add the broth mixture and cook , stirring constantly , until the mixture boils and thickens , about 1 minute
14. Add the beef and cook until hot
15. 5 points for 1 cup

title: steel cut oatmeal with maple sauteed apples
steps:
1. Oats:
2. Bring the water and milk to a simmer in a large saucepan over medium heat
3. Meanwhile , heat the butter in a medium skillet over medium heat until just beginning to foam
4. Add the oats and toast , stirring constantly with a wooden spoon , until golden and fragrant with a butterscotch-like aroma , 1 12 to 2 minutes
5. Stir the toasted oats into the simmering liquid , reduce the heat to medium-low
6. Simmer gently , until the mixture thickens and resembles gravy , about 20-25 minutes
7. Add the salt , stir to combine and continue simmering , stirring occasionally with a wooden spoon until the oats absorb almost all of the liquid and the oatmeal is thick and creamy , with a pudding-like consistency , about 7 to 10 minutes
8. Off the heat , let the oatmeal stand uncovered for 5 minutes
9. Serve immediately with maple sauted apples
10. Garnish with toasted pecans if desired
11. Maple sauted apples:
12. Melt the butter in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
13. Add the apples and 1 tablespoon maple syrup
14. Saut until the apples are tender , about 6 minutes
15. Mix in the remaining 12 cup maple syrup and cinnamon
16. Simmer until slightly reduced , about 2 minute
17. Makes about four servings of oatmeal topped with sauteed apples , and garnished with toasted pecans if desired

title: after dinner milky way cappuccino  adult
steps:
1. Steam and froth milk , set aside
2. Brew one shot of espresso and pour into 8 ounce cup / glass
3. Add caramel sauce , liqueurs and bailey's , stir well
4. Fill glass rest of way with steamed milk almost to rim
5. Stir
6. Fold in 2 tbl
7. Froth
8. Top with whipped cream and sprinkle with cocoa powder
9. Enjoy ! :)

title: vinegar chicken
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 425 degrees
2. Lightly grease a 13 x 9-inch pan
3. Place the chicken in the pan
4. In a small bowl , combine the vinegar , soy sauce , and worcestershire sauce
5. Sprinkle 1 / 3 of this mixture over the chicken
6. Season with the salt , pepper , garlic powder , and onion powder
7. Bake for 30 minutes
8. Remove the chicken from the oven , and baste with another 1 / 3 of the vinegar mixture
9. Bake 15 minutes longer
10. Baste again with the remaining vinegar mixture
11. Return to the oven , and continued baking for 15 minutes , until the skin is golden brown and crispy

title: chicken sekuwa  classic nepali chicken skewers
steps:
1. In a blender , process all marinating ingredients into a smooth paste
2. Marinate chicken cubes in marinade for overnight in the refrigerator
3. Pat dry marinated chicken pieces and thread on with soaked bamboo skewers
4. Grill to the desired doneness , frequently turning and basting with the melted butter
5. Serve hot with rice pilaf and stir-fried vegetables , accompanied by tomato achar

title: mediterranean tuna
steps:
1. In a large skillet heat olive oil
2. Add peppers , zucchini , eggplant , garlic , saute about 5-10 minutes until softened season with salt , pepper , red pepper
3. In a heavy pot add onion , top with tuna , add salt& pepper
4. Pour sauteed vegetables over , add in olives and capers , cover
5. Simmer over low heat20 minutes until tuna is cooked through

title: strawberry lime slush
steps:
1. Remove and discard caps from strawberries
2. Place ice and half of strawberries in blender or food processor
3. Cover and blend on high speed about 30 seconds , stopping blender occasionally to scrap sides , until almost smooth
4. Pour into 2 quart pitcher
5. Place remaining stgrawberries , powdered sugar , and lime juice in blender or food processor
6. Cover and blend on high speed about 30 seconds or until almost smooth
7. Pour mixture into pitcher
8. Stir
9. Pour into glasses
10. Serve immediately

title: so simple mexican rice
steps:
1. Heat the oil and butter in a pan on medium heat
2. Add the rice and stir until all the grains are coated with the oil / butter mixture and lightly toasted
3. Add water and tomato bouillon
4. Stir to combine throughly
5. Allow to come to a boil
6. Reduce heat to low and cover
7. No peeking !
8. Simmer for 15-20 minutes or until all water is absorbed
9. Allow rice to rest for 5 minutes after cooking
10. Fluff with a fork and serve !
11. Garnish with parsley if desired

title: cheesy ham bake
steps:
1. If using raw potatoes cook first
2. Put them into the bottom of a 9x13 casserole dish
3. Top with ham chunks , frozen veggies , and can of soup
4. Sprinkle cheese over the top
5. Cover with foil and bake at 450 for about 45 minuets , until heated through

title: santa fe pinwheel wraps for a crowd
steps:
1. Mix together grated cheeses , basil , black olives , green onion , garlic and mayonnaise
2. Thinly spread mixture all over open tortilla
3. Then at the one end of the tortilla , lay 3 or 4 strips of roasted pepper as well as about 1 / 2 cup of slivered lettuce
4. Roll up the tortilla tightly
5. Wrap the tortillas tightly in plastic wrap and refrigerate until ready to use
6. Remove from refrigerator
7. Slice each tortilla in about 8 slices
8. Then display the slices on a platter with a little parsley or other garnish

title: praline cinnamon muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven
2. Grease muffin cups and place the in the freezer until use
3. Cut from the praline paste 12 cubes of about 1 inch
4. If there is praline paste left , cut it into very small pieces
5. Put the 12 cubes into the fridge
6. Chop hazelnuts and roast them in preheated oven for about 5 to 10 minutes or until desired roasting is achieved
7. In a bowl mix flour , baking powder and baking soda
8. Set aside
9. Open the cardamom pods and put the cardamom seeds into a mortar
10. Add peppercorns , cloves and salt
11. Crush them very finely using a pestle
12. Add cinnamon and set aside
13. In a bowl mix butter and brown sugar until creamy
14. Add egg and mix well
15. Add milk and mix well
16. The sugar must be dissolved completely
17. Add the finely cut nougat and mix well
18. Add the roasted almonds and the cinnamon mixture and mix again
19. Add the flour mixture and mix only until blended
20. Do not overmix it
21. Divide batter equally among the prepared muffin cups
22. Place a nougat cube on each muffin
23. Bake for about 20 minutes until golden brown and a toothpick comes out clean
24. The nougat cube will sink into the batter during baking
25. Take muffins out of the oven and let cool for 5 minutes in the muffin cups
26. Then remove muffins from the cups and let them cool completely on a cooling rack
27. After the muffins are cooled out completely dust them with caster sugar
28. At room temperature this is firm and can be cut
29. It is very difficult to make this on your own
30. If you can't get it , you could replace it by chocolate or some other nut / almond bars
31. The consistency should be that of chocolate at room temperature

title: healthy fat free glazed baked sweet potatoes  or yams
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 400
2. Dice yam into slices less than 1 inch thick , no wider than 1 1 / 2 inches
3. Place in bowl and pour brown sugar and cinnamon over top
4. Toss to coat
5. Get 4 sheets of tinfoil and a pan
6. Divide yams in four , and pour each quarter onto a sheet of tinfoil , scraping out any leftover juices from the bottom of the bowl and pouring over top the four bunches
7. Pull the corners of the tinfoil up , scrunching the tinfoil packages into bundles so no yam shows through , and place each bundle onto the pan , then in the oven
8. Bake for 25-35 minutes , taking yams from oven at 15-20 minutes , and retossing them with a spoon so all the yams get done
9. Serve warm , and refrigerate leftovers when cool

title: crock pot breakfast casserole
steps:
1. Place a layer of frozen hash browns on the bottom of the crock pot , followed by a layer of bacon , then onions , bell pepper and cheese
2. Repeat the layering process two more times , ending with a layer of cheese
3. Beat the eggs , milk , salt and pepper together
4. Pour over the crock pot mixture
5. Cover and cook on low 8-10 hours
6. I have made this many times at the stated time with great results - best between 8-9 hours , well done at 10 , but not burnt

title: african sweet potato and peanut stew
steps:
1. 1
2. Heat olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat
3. Add the onion , cover and cook until softened , about 5 minutes
4. Add the bell pepper and garlic , cover , and cook until softened , about 5 minutes
5. Stir in the brown sugar , ginger , cumin , cinnamon and cayenne and cook , stirring , for 30 seconds
6. Add the sweet potatoes and stir to coat
7. Stir in the tomatoes , stock and salt to taste
8. Bring to a boil , then reduce the heat to low and simmer until the vegetables are soft , about 30 minutes
9. 2
10. About 10 minutes before the end of the cooking time , stir in the kidney beans and simmer until heated through
11. 3
12. Place the peanut butter in a small bowl and blend in about 1 / 4 cup of the broth , stirring until smooth , then stir it into the stew
13. If a thicker consistency is desired , puree 1 cup of the stew in a blender or food processor and stir back into pot
14. 4
15. Taste and adjust seasonings
16. Sprinkle with chopped peanuts and serve

title: edabroccamole  aka edamame  broccoli    avocado guacamole
steps:
1. Simmer the peeled edamame in boiling water for 2 minutes or until soft
2. Drain
3. Blanch the broccoli in rolling boiling water 30 seconds to 1 minute
4. Drain
5. In a food processor bowl fitted with the steel blade , place the scallion , red onion , garlic , jalapeno , lime juice , tomato , and cilantro
6. Pulse until all ingredients are finely minced
7. Now add the broccoli and edamame
8. Pulse on and off until well incorporated
9. Last , add the roughly chopped avocado to the above mixture and pulse until combined but not completely pureed
10. Preserve some of the chunky avocado texture
11. Taste for seasonings , adding salt and pepper , and perhaps more lime juice
12. I also like to fold in the cumin and oregano , although these were not included in the original version
13. Chef's

title: peanut butter and jelly chicken for oamc
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients except chicken in a bowl and mix until smooth
2. Add chicken and mix
3. Pour into 1 gallon freezer bag and lay flat to freeze
4. To reheat preheat oven to 350f pour thawed chicken mixture into a 2 quart casserole dish , and bake , uncovered for 20 to 30 minutes
5. Serve over hot rice

title: polish sausage stew
steps:
1. Combine soup , sugar , and sauerkraut
2. Stir in sausage , potatoes , and onions
3. Cover
4. Cook on low 8 hours , or on high 4 hours
5. Stir in cheese and serve

title: grilled cheesy apple sandwiches
steps:
1. Set oven broiler at 500 degrees and line cookie sheet with foil
2. Butter one piece of bread and lay it , buttered side down , on foil
3. Top with layer of apple butter and half the cheddar cheese
4. Repeat with other slice of bread
5. Place in oven , under broiler , until cheese is bubbly
6. Remove from oven and close sandwich , then return to oven until top of sandwich is golden brown
7. Remove from oven and turn sandwich , then return to oven until second side is golden brown

title: creamy crock pot chicken   potato
steps:
1. Place 1 / 2 cubed red potatoes in crock pot , layer chicken breast on top , add rest of ingredients , and rest of cubed potatoes on top
2. Cook for about 6-7 hours on low , stir in cheese about an hour before serving
3. Serve in bowl with your favorite dinner rolls

title: bacon and egg salad
steps:
1. Combine first 4 ingredients in a large bowl
2. Set aside
3. Combine mayonnaise and next 3 ingredients
4. Fold into egg mixture sprinkle with parsley and serve
5. Salad can be chilled up to 24 hours
6. Bacon will soften slightly
7. Serve this as a salad or as a sandwich filling

title: frugal gourmet s focaccia
steps:
1. In a large bowl , mix water , yeast , and sugar
2. Stir in oils and 1 t salt
3. Add 2 3 / 4 c flour , mixing well til spongy
4. Add enough remaining flour to make stiff dough
5. Turn onto floured surface and knead until elastic
6. Cover with bowl and let rise til doubled
7. Divide dough in half , spread on cookie sheets using your fingers
8. Toppings:
9. Mix crushed garlic with olive oil
10. Brush over bread
11. Sprinkle w / dried rosemary and kosher salt
12. Cover and let rise
13. Bake at 375 for 1 / 2 hour
14. Cut into squares and serve

title: mike s hot toddy
steps:
1. Squeeze a piece of lemon into a microwave-safe mug
2. Add the spoonful of honey , whiskey and hot water
3. Microwave until piping hot
4. Add spices to taste
5. Chase that cold away !

title: minted broad   fava bean puree
steps:
1. Remove beans from pods
2. Put into pot of boiling water , return to the boil & cook until tender
3. Drain & run under cold water
4. Remove the skins
5. Put the beans , lemon juice & salt to taste in a blender / food processor
6. Pulse until smooth , then add the olive oil , mint & pepper
7. Pulse again , then put into a serving bowl
8. If it seems too stiff add a bit more oil
9. Cover and refrigerate until used

title: amy s apple cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Mix apples and sugar
3. Add oil , eggs and vanilla
4. Stir
5. Add flour , soda , cinnamon and salt and stir
6. Bake in a greased 9x13 pan at 350 for 50-60 minutes

title: delicious horseradish coleslaw
steps:
1. In a large bowl combine the first 5 ingredients
2. Add in the shredded cabbage , carrots and green onions toss well to combine
3. Season with seasoning salt and black pepper
4. Cover and chill for a minimum of 8 hours or overnight

title: marion s michigan sauce for hot dogs
steps:
1. Finely chop onions and saute in a little olive oil until tender
2. Add ground beef and cook until browned
3. Separate meat so it is broken into very fine pieces of meat
4. Add rest of ingredients , mix , and cook over low heat on the stove 1 hour or more
5. This could be cooked in a crockpot on low for six hours
6. Serve as a topping on hot dogs

title: double chocolate sour cream scones
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
2. Line baking sheet with parchment paper
3. In a large bowl , combine the flours , sugar , baking soda , baking powder and cocoa
4. Mix well
5. Cut in the cold butter pieces with a pastry blender or two knifes until the butter is in tiny chunks the size of pennies
6. In another bowl beat egg lightly with a fork , add sour cream and mix well
7. Add wet mixture to middle of dry mixture
8. Add chocolate chips and mix until flour mix is just moistened and forms a ball
9. You may need to add 1-2 tbsp milk if dough is too dry
10. Knead a few times and turn dough ball out onto prepared pan
11. Press into a flat circle that is 2" thick
12. With a sharp knife , cut in four pie sections , then cut each section in half again
13. Bake in 400f oven for 15 minutes
14. Cool on pan

title: raw food  brownies or chocolate bars
steps:
1. Chop nuts in a food processor until finely chopped
2. Add dates and process again
3. Add the rest of the ingredients in order and process until they are mixed
4. The mixture should be dark brown and crumbly , but it should hold together when pressed
5. If it doesn't hold together well enough for you , add 1-2 more dates at the end
6. Press into a small pan or a bowl , or roll into balls
7. Refrigerate to harden , then cut into squares , if desired
8. Keep refrigerated

title: grilled bacon onion appetizers
steps:
1. Cut each onion into 12 wedges
2. Cut bacon strips in half widthwise
3. Wrap a piece of bacon around each onion wedge and secure with toothpicks
4. Place in an ungreased 13-in x 9-in
5. X 2-in dish
6. Combine the brown sugar , vinegar , molasses , fresh ground pepper and barbecue sauce
7. Pour 1 / 2 cup over onions
8. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour , turning once
9. Cover and refrigerate remaining marinade for basting
10. Drain and discard marinade
11. Grill appetizers , covered , over medium heat for 10-15 minutes , turning and basting frequently with reserved marinade
12. Enjoy

title: breakfast casserole   easy   sausage cream cheese
steps:
1. 1
2. Fry sausage until brown and completely done
3. 2
4. Chop green onions
5. 3
6. Mix sausage and green onions into softend cream cheese
7. 4
8. Add just a pinch of lowery's season salt
9. 5
10. Mix well
11. 6
12. Spread 1 pack crescent rolls out in a baking dish
13. 7
14. Spread cream cheese mixture ontop
15. 8
16. Spread second pack crescent rolls ontop of mixture
17. 9
18. Bake at 375 degrees for 15 - 20 minutes
19. The crescent rolls should be golden brown and flaky

title: cricketbirds clam chowder
steps:
1. Put onions , celery and potatoes in large saucepan and pour clam juice over top until barely covered
2. This usually takes me 2 bottles
3. Simmer , covered , over medium heat until barely tender
4. Meanwhile , melt butter
5. Add flour and blend , stirring contantly
6. Add half and half slowly , cook and stir with wire whisk until smooth and thick
7. Add undrained vegetables and clams , and heat through

title: chicken sour cream enchiladas
steps:
1. Combine chicken and 2 cups cheese
2. For the sauce , mix sour cream , soup and chiles in a saucepan and warm over medium heat
3. Put 1 / 3 cup chicken mixture on a tortilla
4. Spoon a large spoonful of sauce over chicken and roll the enchilada
5. Repeat for rest of tortillas
6. Pour remaining sauce over casserole
7. Top with remaining 1 cup cheese
8. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes uncovered

title: 20 minute egg drop chili
steps:
1. Heat a saucepan over medium to medium-high heat
2. Add oil to cover the bottom of the pan scantily
3. Saut garlic and onions in hot oil until they begin to be done
4. Onions should be becoming clear and soft
5. Add can of beans and its liquid , can of tomatoes and its liquid , and spices
6. Stir
7. Cover and heat through until not quite boiling
8. While heating , break the eggs into a bowl and , with a fork , break the yolks and lightly beat until the yolks and eggs are thoroughly mixed
9. The eggs should be just slightly frothy
10. When chili is hot , remove from heat and reduce the heat to low
11. While off the heat , slowly pour in eggs , stirring as you pour
12. Egg should cook instantly , giving the soup a creamy look and texture
13. Return to low heat and heat through , perhaps another 2-3 minutes
14. Serve topped with any or all garnishes you choose
15. Or without , your choice

title: butterflied grilled chicken with curry and cumin
steps:
1. Rinse split chicken and pat dry , lay on cutting board skin side up and push on breastbone to flatten
2. Combine the curry , cumin and salt and rub half of it over both sides of the chicken
3. Start at the neck and insert you finger to separate skin from flesh , then season the flesh under the skin with the rest of the mixture
4. Let chicken absorb flavors for 45 minutes before cooking
5. Grill chicken until internal temperature reaches 165
6. Chicken can alternatively be broiled or baked

title: peanut butter schmier
steps:
1. Boil together for 5 minutes---cool
2. Mix in peanut butter , just enough until right spreading consistency

title: beet blue cheese salad
steps:
1. Open cans of beets and place them in a bowl
2. Add oil , vinegar , salt , pepper to taste
3. Add cumpled blue cheese on top
4. Refridgerate for 1 hour before serving

title: best banana bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Cream margarine , sugar and eggs
3. Add vanilla
4. In separate bowl , mix flour , soda and salt
5. Add to margarine / sugar combo , mix till smooth
6. Add sour cream and bananas
7. Bake in greased loaf pan at 350f for 1 hour
8. Bread is done when a toothpick or knife comes out clean from the thickest part
9. Top will be dark brown , not golden

title: tuna pockets
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , stir together first three ingredients
2. Mix with mayonnaise and orange juice
3. Stuff pita with lettuce and tuna mix

title: the mystery chef s swiss steak
steps:
1. Coat the steak with as much flour as will adhere
2. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over high heat and brown the steak on both sides
3. Place the steak in a large baking dish or pan with a lid
4. Add the cup of water to the skillet you browned the steak in and dissolve all the brown bits in the skillet
5. Add this liquid to the baking dish with the steak , along with the other ingredients
6. Cover and cook on top of the stove over low heat for 2 hours , or bake in a 325f oven for 2 hours

title: sweet tomato cucumber salad
steps:
1. Thinly slice vegetables into large bowl
2. Mix together oil , sugar and vinegar aqnd pour over vegetables

title: brussels sprouts vinaigrette
steps:
1. Wash and cut an x into the bottom of all the brussels sprouts
2. Fill a large saucepan 1 / 4 full of water
3. Bring to boiling
4. Steam sprouts in a steamer basket until tender , but still firm , about 5-8 minutes
5. For the vinaigrette:
6. In a small bowl whisk vinegar , mustard , maple syrup , walnut oil , nutmeg and salt and pepper together
7. Taste and adjust as necessary
8. Set aside
9. Drain the warm brussels sprouts and place in a serving bowl
10. Toss with the vinaigrette
11. Serve garnished with the toasted chopped walnuts
12. You don't have to toast the walnuts if you don't want to :)

title: pork chops braised in white wine
steps:
1. Trim all visible fat from chops
2. Combine first 5 ingredients and press into both sides of the pork chops
3. Melt margarine with olive oil in a skillet over moderate heat
4. Brown chops for 2 or 3 minutes on each side
5. When chops are golden brown , remove from the pan
6. Pour off all but a thin film of fat from the pan and add 1 / 2 cup of the wine and bring to a boil
7. Replace pork chops in the pan and cover reducing heat to the barest of simmers
8. Baste chops occasionally with pan juices and cook for 25 to 30 minutes or until tender
9. Transfer pork chops to a heated serving platter and keep warm
10. Pour remaining wine into pan and boil briskly scraping browned bits from the bottom of the pan until sauce has reduced to a few tablespoons of syrupy glaze
11. Remove pan from heat and stir in parsley
12. Pour sauce over the pork chops and serve

title: chocolate amaretto mousse pie
steps:
1. Beat the egg whites until peaks form
2. Beat in 1 / 4 cup sugar until the mixture is stiff and glossy
3. Mix yolks , milk , gelatin , the remaining sugar , and salt
4. Combine over low heat with the chopped chocolate
5. Heat , stirring constantly , until the mixture has combined , smoothed , and thickened
6. Remove from heat and add vanilla and amaretto
7. Whip the cream
8. Pour the chocolate mixture over the egg whites , folding to combine
9. Cool mixture
10. When cooled , fold in the whipped cream
11. Pour into the crust and refrigerate at least 4 hours before serving

title: toasted  millet salad
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan , bring 2 1 / 2 cups water to a boil
2. Meanwhile , coat bottom of a large saute pan with 1 teaspoons of the olive oil
3. Add millet and cook , stirring , over medium low heat until it gives off a toasted aroma , about 10 minutes
4. Add boiling hot water
5. Cover and cook over medium low heat until water is absorbed and millet is tender , about 25 minutes
6. Uncover and cool
7. Meanwhile , coat salmon with 1 teaspoons of the soy sauce
8. Heat a large skillet over high heat
9. When hot , add fillets , reduce heat to medium and cook until browned , about 3 minutes
10. Turn over and cook until the salmon is cooked through , 3-5 minutes longer
11. Remove from heat
12. Cool in pan
13. Break into 1" pieces
14. Heat a small saucepan of water to a boil
15. Add snow peas and cook 1 minute
16. Drain , rinse , and blot dry
17. In a large bowl , whisk vinegar , 2 tbsp water , sesame oil , ginger , garlic , salt , and remaining olive oil and soy sauce
18. Reserve 1 tbsp of the mixture
19. Toss millet with the dressing
20. In a small bowl , toss scallions , pepper , snow peas , and reserved dressing
21. Add half the vegetables and the salmon to the millet
22. Spoon millet salad onto a platter
23. Top with remaining vegetables
24. Serve and enjoy !

title: seaside salad
steps:
1. Cook macaroni according to package directions , adding a little vegetable oil to keep separated
2. Drain and chill
3. Mix with tuna , egg , onion , celery , green pepper and olives
4. With a whisk or fork , beat together dressing ingredients
5. Toss with macaroni-tuna mixture
6. Cover and chill until serving time
7. Garnish with salad greens

title: polka dot dessert
steps:
1. Place pudding mix in large bowl
2. Add milk and beat on medium speed for 2 minutes
3. Fold softened ice cream into pudding mixture
4. Pour into an 8 inch square pan or dish
5. Sprinkle marshmallows on top
6. Freeze until firm
7. Let stand for 15 minutes before serving

title: pineapple paradise cake with coconut cream frosting
steps:
1. For cake: preheat oven to 350f
2. Using a slotted spoon , set aside 1 / 4 cup pineapple for frosting
3. In mixing bowl , combine remaining pineapple and juice with flour , sugar , eggs , baking soda , vegetable oil and coconut flavoring
4. Beat at medium speed 2 minutes
5. Pour into greased and floured 10-1 / 2 x 15-1 / 2 x 1 inch baking pan
6. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until toothpick inserted into center comes out clean
7. Let cool completely
8. To make frosting: beat cream cheese , butter , sour cream , vanilla and coconut flavoring until smooth and creamy
9. Add powdered sugar
10. Beat until frosting is a spreadable consistency
11. Stir in coconut and reserved 1 / 4 cup pineapple
12. Use to frost cake

title: golden roasted duckling
steps:
1. Thaw duck overnight in refrigerator
2. Remove giblets
3. Wash and drain duck
4. Pat dry inside and out with paper towels
5. Sprinkle cavity with salt
6. Quarter onion , coarsely chop celery and loosely stuff cavity
7. Sprinkle skin with seasoned salt and pepper
8. Pleace in preheated 325 oven for for 2 1 / 2 - 3 hours
9. No need to baste
10. Roast until skin is crisp and golden brown
11. Leg should move freely

title: pork chop   hash browns bake
steps:
1. Brown chops in skillet and sprinkle with seasoned salt and set aside
2. Combine milk , soup , sour cream , pepper and salt
3. Stir in potatoes , 1 / 2 cup cheese , 1 / 2 can of onion rings and the dried onion flakes
4. Spoon mixture into 9x13 baking dish
5. Arrange pork chops cover potato mixture
6. Bake covered with foil at 350 degrees for 40 minutes
7. Remove foil and top with remaining cheese and onions
8. Bake uncovered 5 minutes longer

title: the market fare s cheese soup
steps:
1. In covered saucepan , saute carrot , onion and celery in butter , over low heat , stirring occasionally , till tender
2. Add flour , broth , and salt
3. Mix well
4. Increase heat to medium
5. Stir in milk , mix well
6. Stir in beer
7. Stirring constantly , cook till cheese melts and soup is heated through
8. Do not boil !

title: dream bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300f
2. Cookie layer: in a large mixing bowl , cream butter and sugar until smooth
3. Stir in flour and salt
4. Mixture will be crumbly
5. Pat the mixture into a lightly greased 9x13 pan
6. Bake for 10 mins , while you prepare the topping
7. Increase the oven temperature to 325f
8. Topping: combine sugar , flour and baking powder in a medium mixing bowl
9. Stir in the eggs , mixing until smooth
10. Add coconut and nuts , mix until well-combined
11. Spread the topping onto the cookie layer , as evenly as possible
12. Bake the bars for 30 mins , until golden brown
13. Remove from oven and let them cool
14. Sprinkle with confectioners' sugar , if desired
15. Or spread melted chocolate chips over the bars
16. Cut them into 2 1 / 4 inch bars when completely cooled

title: apple mango crisp
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Grease a 13x9 cake pan
3. In a medium bowl , stir together first five ingredients
4. Stir in butter--distributing evenly
5. Set aside
6. Place apples in large bowl , sprinkle with lime juice , then remaining flour
7. Stir to mix , then fold in mango chunks
8. Pour apple-mango mixture into prepared pan
9. Top with oat-sugar mixture
10. Bake for 30 minutes
11. Sprinkle with pecans , bake another 10-15 minutes
12. Cool slightly , serve warm with whipped cream or vanilla ice cream

title: buddah s breakfast sausage
steps:
1. Place the 5 pounds ground pork in large mixing bowl
2. Measure out each spice , place in a dixie cup or small glass
3. Mix together thoroughly
4. Sprinkle spices evenly over ground pork , a little at a time , and mix into the meat , with your hands , until incorporated
5. Keep adding spices , in small amounts , working them into the ground pork , until all is used up , and worked into the meat
6. Cover bowl with a tight lid , or , plastic wrap , and let set in the fridge , overnight
7. This helps the spices blend into the meat
8. Next morning , remove bowl from fridge , let set on the counter for about 20-30 minutes
9. Form meat into 1 pound shapes , and place each pound in a freezer bag , label , and place in freezer
10. Pull a package out of the freezer , allow to thaw , fry it up , and enjoy !

title: ham and swiss with caramelized onion on rye pizza
steps:
1. Begin by making the caramelized onions: melt the butter over low heat in a heavy-bottomed mid-sized saucepan
2. Put onions in the pot , sprinkle the pinch each of salt and sugar over the onions and toss to coat with the butter
3. Stir occasionally until onions begin to become soft and start giving up their juices
4. Continue cooking over low for about 35 minutes , adding a splash of balsamic vinegar any time the onions begin to look as if theyre drying out
5. The onions are done when they are so tender it seems theyre melting
6. They should be moist , but not sitting in pools of liquid
7. Remove from the heat
8. Preheat oven to 500f
9. Make 2 small rounds or 1 bigger one with the dough
10. Place leftover dough in the fridge
11. I make it directly on silpat
12. Sprinkle caraway seeds about 1 / 2 inch around the edge
13. Maybe a little coarse salt , too
14. Divide the caramelized onions evenly between the two crusts , spreading near the edges
15. Fold the ham slices gently onto the crust , covering most of the onions
16. Arrange the swiss cheese slices evenly over the top
17. If not on silpat , use a peel or your hands to slide the parchment and crust onto the pizza stone
18. Bake for 6-9 minutes , depending on how crispy you prefer your crust
19. Six minutes will give you a softer , lighter colored crust
20. Let cool 5 minutes before slicing
21. If desired , serve with the dijon mayonnaise for dipping

title: queeny tini
steps:
1. Shake ingredients in a cocktail shaker with ice
2. Strain into glass
3. Garnish with slice of apple

title: creamy yellow summer squash soup
steps:
1. In a saucepan , over medium heat , melt the butter
2. Add the leeks and saute about 5 minutes or until softened and transulucent
3. Stir in 1 cup of the broth along with the squash
4. Bring to a boil , reduce heat and simmer until just tender
5. Transfer the squash mixture to a blender or food processor and puree until smooth
6. Return puree to the saucepan and add the remaining broth and milk
7. Add poultry seasoning , salt and pepper to taste
8. Heat through and serve

title: awesome chicken
steps:
1. Sprinkle garlic and onion powder onto both sides of each breast
2. Take a fork and poke holes randomly over each breast and cover with thousand island dressing
3. Chill covered for 30 minutes
