4. Cook on an electric skillet heated to 350 degrees

title: quick lemon broccoli rice
steps:
1. Heat broth to a boil in a medium saucepan
2. Add the broccoli and carrots , cover and simmer about 5 minutes or until vegetables are tender
3. Stir in lemon juice , pepper and rice
4. Cover and remove from heat
5. Let stand for 5 minutes
6. Fluff with fork before serving

title: cherry tomatoes in garlic
steps:
1. Rinse tomatoes and shake off excess water
2. Place in a plastic bag with the garlic and the salt
3. Let stand at room temperature for 2 hours or overnight in the refrigerator
4. Turn occasionally to blend flavours
5. Rinse tomatoes briefly before serving

title: spanish tuna salad
steps:
1. Combine tuna , oil , sherry , onion , and parsley
2. Toss lightly to mix
3. Chill several hours and serve on a bed of greens

title: chicken marakesh
steps:
1. Place chicken and the next 11 ingredients in 2 large bowls , refrigerate overnight remove 1 hour prior to cooking
2. Preheat oven to 350
3. Arrange chicken in 2 baking pans , sprinkle with sugar , pecans and pour the wine over both pans cover with foil and cook for 20 minutes
4. Uncover pans and cook 50 minutes more
5. Remove to a platter , serve

title: cheesy taco macaroni bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Prepare macaroni and cheese as directed
3. Brown ground beef , prepare with taco seasoning and water as directed on packet
4. Stir sour cream into macaroni and cheese
5. Place 1 / 2 macaroni and cheese mixture in greased 9x9 baking dish
6. Layer 1 / 2 of meat and half of cheese
7. Top with remaining macaroni mixture
8. Bake 15 minutes
9. Remove from oven , top with salsa and remaining cheese
10. Bake additional 5 minutes
11. Serve

title: miso tahini dip
steps:
1. Mix the miso and water until smooth
2. Add the tahini and mix until smooth
3. Add the ginger and scallions
4. Serve with vegetables for dipping

title: shelly s healthy tuna  lime and veggie salad
steps:
1. Whisk together first 3 ingredients in large bowl
2. Add tuna , green beans , radishes and cucumber to bowl and toss
3. Sprinkle mixture with cilantro , salt and pepper and mix well
4. Enjoy

title: nif s easy crock pot smothered roast beef
steps:
1. Place roast in crock pot
2. Mix other ingredients in a separate bowl and pour over the roast
3. Cook roast on low for 6-7 hours or on high for 3-4 hours
4. Add more seasoning if desired after tasting the completed dish

title: crock pot baked beans in tomato sauce
steps:
1. Soak beans overnight in large bowl
2. Drain , put in large pot and cover with 5 cups of water
3. Simmer over medium low heat until tender , about 1 hour
4. Drain beans reserving 2 cups of liquid
5. Add beans to slow cooker
6. In a skillet over medium high heat fry bacon until browned , chop and stir into beans
7. Combine juice , chopped onion , ketchup , molasses , brown sugar , dry mustard , salt , pepper and chili , add to beans and stir well
8. Cover and cook on low for 7 to 9 hours
9. Until beans are tender and flavourful
10. Check and add a little of the reserved liquid as necessary
11. Or high 4-5 hours

title: stuffed chicken breast pate slices
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Butter a medium roasting pan
3. Combine the ham and cheese in a food processor and process , using the steel knife , until mixture is smooth , like a pate
4. Divide into 8 equal portions , each the size of an italian sausage to match the length of the chicken breast , crosswise
5. Put 1 ham and cheese roll onto the center of a whole chicken breast
6. Wrap each side of the breast around the roll and place in a buttered roasting pan , seam side down
7. Assemble all the breasts the same way
8. Place the stuffed breasts side by side , so that they fit snugly together
9. Season with salt , pepper and paprika
10. Bake for about 45 minutes until golden brown on top
11. Remove from the oven and cool completely
12. Drain and discard fat and juices
13. Cover pan and refrigerate overnight
14. Skin the breasts
15. Cut each breast , crosswise , into thin slices , about 10 per breast
16. Arrange in layers on a serving platter

title: bird s chicken stew with dumplings  or chicken noodle soup
steps:
1. Rub chicken with poultry seasoning and place in large dutch oven
2. Add the chicken broth , water , oregano , basil , garlic powder , and salt and pepper
3. Bring to a boil , then reduce heat to low and cover and simmer for 2 hours or until chicken is about falling off the bone , stirring occasionally
4. Carefully remove the chicken from the pot into a colander placed inside a pot to catch the dripping and return it back to the broth
5. Add remaining stew ingredients and continue simmering the broth , but uncovered
6. Once the chicken is cool enough to handle , remove the skin and de-bone the chicken
7. Add chicken back to the pot
8. Raise temperature up to medium and let simmer 10 minutes
9. Taste broth and re-season with salt and pepper if needed
10. For dumpling stew variation: bring temperature up to medium-high and stir in the heavy cream to the broth
11. Mix bisquick , sage , and milk to form a dough
12. Drop dough by heaping teaspoons into hot broth
13. Don't crowd as they will fluff up , so do in batches if necessary
14. Let simmer for 20 minutes , carefully turning the dumplings with a slotted spoon after 10 minutes and about every 5 minutes after that until dough is cooked through
15. If necessary , remove 1st batch of dumplings to a large bowl and repeat by dropping the 2nd batch of dumplings
16. Add 1st batch of dumplings back into pot , and its ready to eat

title: duchess potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450f and butter a baking dish
2. Combine the mashed potatoes , butter and salt with the beaten egg yolks
3. Pipe into balls , hearts , or other shapes using a pastry bag
4. Place in dish and brush with slightly beaten egg whites
5. Brown in oven

title: totally healthy granola brownies
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350
2. Beat sugars and butter together until creamy
3. Next add honey , vanilla , and egg whites
4. Combined dry ingredients and add to the butter and sugar mixture
5. Using a large spoon to stir , add the fruit , nuts , and coconut
6. Press mixture firmly into a greased or sprayed 9x13 cake pan
7. Bake for 25 minutes or until golden brown
8. Using a sharp knife slice brownies while they are still warm
9. Let cool and enjoy !

title: lemon and onion marinated beef
steps:
1. Preparation: cut beef into 1 inch cubes
2. Grate onion inside gallon size zip-lock bag to save onion juice
3. Place beef chunks into bag with grated onion , pour lemon juice over beef
4. Seal bag and mix together to ensure even coverage
5. Place bag inside a large bowl and refrigerate overnight or up to 3 days
6. Cooking: drain juice from beef and onion and thread beef chunks onto metal or water soaked bamboo skewers
7. Place under broiler for 10-20 minutes or until edges are dark brown and crispy , turning every 5 minutes or so
8. Meat can also be cooked on a hibachi or regular grill
9. Meat does not need to be cooked to 160 degrees as the lemon juice cooks the meat with enzymes while it marinates

title: diabetic  low fat jalapeno pepper spread
steps: 1. In small bowl , stir cream cheese and jalapeno pepper jelly until blended

title: cheesy flat bread
steps:
1. Pat dough onto the bottom and up the sides of a greased 14-inch pizza pan or 15 x 10 x 1 inch jelly roll pan
2. Brush olive oil over bread
3. Sprinkle with paprika , basil and garlic
4. Sprinkle with cheese
5. Cover and let rise for 30 minutes
6. Bake at 375 for 20-25 minutes or until golden

title: boeuf flamande
steps:
1. Pick over the stewing beef and cut it into smallish cubes
2. Sear in the oil , browning it well
3. Chop the onion and smash the garlic
4. Turn down the heat and cook the onion and garlic gently with the meat
5. Check the oil
6. Stir in the flour and mix to a paste , then add the beer , stir rapidly as it thickens and adjust the liquid with water so that the meat is covered
7. Season with salt and grounf black pepper and add the bouquet garni
8. Cover with the lid and simmer gently for at least one hour , stirring and checking the liquid level occasionally so that it does not dry out and stick
9. Serve with filling vegetables such as potatoes

title: bavarian lentil soup
steps:
1. Add bacon to heavy stock pot and render down untill fat is released add fennel to pot

3. Cook untill onions are transparent then add vinegar
4. Add both stocks and bring to a simmer
5. Add lentils and seasonings , then simmer for 1 1 / 2 hours
6. Add hotdogs and cook til they are heated through

title: sri lankan pineapple curry
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a pan and fry the onions and green peppers till just soft
2. Now add all of the ingredients except for the coconut milk and sugar
3. Stir well to blend and coat the pineapple with the spices

8. Serve hot or cold as a side dish for your curry

title: lisa s 2 3 chili
steps:

title: nutmeg sugar cookies
steps:

2. Add oil , egg , and vanilla and beat until well blended
3. In a medium bowl , mix 2 cups flour , baking soda , nutmeg , and salt
4. Stir into butter mixture , then beat until well blended
5. Cover bowl with plastic wrap and freeze until dough is firm , about 1 hour
6. Shape dough into 1-inch balls and place about 2 inches apart on buttered 12- by 15-inch baking sheets
7. Press each cookie with the lightly floured tines of a fork to flatten slightly
8. Bake cookies in a 350 regular or convection oven until edges are lightly browned , 8 to 10 minutes
9. If baking two sheets at once in one oven , switch their positions halfway through baking
10. Let cookies cool on sheets for 5 minutes , then use a wide spatula to transfer to racks to cool completely

title: lowcountry smothered pork chops
steps:
1. Trim the excess fat from the chops and season well with salt , pepper , and cayenne
2. Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat
3. Lightly roll the chops in flour , shake off the excess , and slip them into the pan
4. Brown well , about 3 minutes per side , and remove them to a plate
5. Add the bell peppers and onions to the skillet and saute until softened , about 3 minutes
6. Stir in the garlic and cook until fragrant , about half a minute longer
7. Push the vegetables to the side of the skillet
8. Add chops to pan and place vegetables on top of pork chops
9. Pour in the broth and sprinkle with worcestershire sauce
10. Cover pan with foil and allow to simmer for 45 minutes or until chops are tender

title: original  philly  cheesecake
steps:
1. Combine crumbs and margarine
2. Press onto bottom of 9-inch springform pan
3. Bake at 325 degrees f
4. , 10minutes

10. Bake at 300 degrees f

13. Cool before removing rim of pan

15. Top with cherry pie filling or fresh fruit , if desired

title: walnut quickies
steps:
1. Warm the butter , condensed milk , sugar and vanilla in a large saucepan
2. Take off heat

4. Spread into a greased cookie sheet type pan and bake 15 minutes at 170 deg
5. Celsius

7. Warm the butter , icing sugar , condensed milk and salt in a large saucepan , and spread it over the warm cake

title: artichoke   cheese strudel
steps:
1. Melt 1 / 4 cup butter in a skillet and saute the onions until soft do not brown
2. Add garlic , stir
3. Beat cream cheese and the cottage cheese until well mixed
4. Beat in eggs one at a time
5. Add garlic salt , parsley , tarragon & pepper
6. Beat to mix well
7. Add onions and any left over butter drippings
8. Add artichokes , parmesan & cracker crumbs , stir
9. Lay out the filo sheets & brush with melted butter , stack 5 sheets
10. Put 1 / 3 mix on one end of each stack & roll up tucking edges of sheets around the filling
11. Using a very sharp knife cut each roll into 10 pieces
12. If you are going to freeze the rolls leave the cut pieces together still forming the roll , wrap in plastic wrap and then foil & freeze
13. Defrost before baking
14. When you are ready to bake them preheat oven to 350f separate the rolls into the pieces , lay cut side up on a lightly gresed cookie sheet bake for 20-30 minutes or until nicely browned serve warm

title: the best teriyaki beef jerky
steps:
1. Flash freeze beef for 20 minutes on cookie sheet during ingredient mixture
2. Mix ingredients in extra large bowl with whisk until completely blended
3. If beef is more than one inch thick , slice across to create equal thickness
4. Cut beef between 1 / 8 - 1 / 4 inch thick slices , in addition to trimming as much fat off the meat as possible
5. Incorporate beef into ingredients to cover
6. Marinate beef overnight
7. Pat dry beef slices and skewer beef onto bamboo , ensuring small space between slices for thorough dryness and leaving one inch on each end
8. Hang beef skewers across oven rack so beef hangs freely
9. Cover entire oven rack with skewers of meat
10. Place aluminum foil on oven rack #2 at very bottom of oven to help catch drippings
11. Set oven to lowest temperature and leave door ajar on hinge , letting beef sit for approximately 5-6 hours or until dry
12. Check beef a few times throughout to ensure it is not actually baking , but simply drying out
13. Once finished ,
14. Let beef skewers rest for 10 minutes after drying , and then remove skewers from oven rack and let sit on tray until cool
15. Remove beef strips from skewers and store them in an airtight container

title: pour la france chocolate decadence
steps:
1. Melt butter and chocolate together over very low heat , stirring constantly
2. Add sugar and stir to melt
3. Set aside to cool
4. Whip eggs with electric mixer until they reach full volume , approximately 7 minutes
5. Carefully fold in chocolate mixture and flour
6. Pour batter in 10 inch cake pan that has been greased and lined with wax paper or parchment paper
7. Bake in preheated 325 degree oven 30 minutes
8. Be careful not to overbake
9. Cool completely to room temperature before removing from pan
10. To serve , spoon sweetened whipped cream on top of sliced chocolate decadence
11. Then top with a spoonful of raspberry sauce
12. Raspberry sauce:
13. Mix with sugar and liqueur in small saucepan
14. Put all ingredients in small saucepan
15. Bring to boil
16. Refrigerate until serving time

title: lemon drop muffins
steps:
1. To make the muffins:
2. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
3. Grease the bottoms of 12 standard muffin pan cups or line pan with paper liners
4. In a large bowl , combine flour , brown sugar , baking powder , baking soda , and salt
5. In a small bowl , combine yogurt , butter , egg , and lemon peel
6. Blend until well mixed
7. Add to the dry ingredients and stir until just moistened
8. Using a spoon , measuring cup , or ladle , fill greased cups three-quarters full
9. Bake until a toothpick inserted in center of muffin comes out clean , about 20 minutes
10. Place pan on wire rack
11. Cool for 1 minute
12. Remove muffins from pan and place on wire rack
13. Cool completely
14. Making the glaze:
15. In a small bowl , combine powdered sugar and lemon juice
16. Mix until smooth
17. Drizzle glaze over each muffin
18. Sprinkle with lemon peel

title: seven layer tortilla pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. In a large bowl , mash pinto beans
3. Stir in 3 / 4 cup salsa and garlic
4. In a separate bowl , mix together 1 / 4 cup salsa , cilantro , black beans and tomatoes
5. Place 1 tortilla in a pie plate or tart dish
6. Spread 3 / 4 cup pinto bean mixture over tortilla to within 1 / 2 inch of edge
7. Top with 1 / 4 cup cheese , and cover with another tortilla
8. Spread with 2 / 3 cup black bean mixture , and top with 1 / 4 cup cheese
9. Repeat layering twice
10. Cover with remaining tortilla , and spread with remaining pinto bean mixture and cheese
11. Cover with foil , and bake in preheated oven for about 40 minutes
12. Cut into wedges , and serve with salsa and sour cream

title: avocado  mango and lentil salad
steps:
1. In large pot of boiling water , cook lentils 20 minutes or until tender but not mushy

3. Meanwhile , in large bowl , whisk together vinegar , oil , salt , and pepper

steps:

title: parmesan breadsticks
steps:

3. Separate dough into individual breadsticks
4. Dip in butter , then in cheese mixture
5. Twist two to three times and place on an ungreased baking sheet
6. Bake at 375 degrees for 10-12 minutes or until golden brown
7. Serve immediately

title: oven roasted dungeness crab
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 500f melt butter with oil in heavy large ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat
2. Stir in garlic , shallot , and dried crushed red pepper
3. Add crabs
4. Sprinkle with salt and pepper
5. Sprinkle 1 tablespoon chopped thyme and 1 tablespoon chopped parsley over crabs
6. Stir to combine
7. Place skillet in oven and roast crabs until heated through , stirring once , about 12 minutes
8. Using tongs , transfer crabs to platter
9. Add orange juice and peel to same skillet
10. Boil until sauce is reduced by about half , about 5 minutes
11. Spoon sauce over crabs
12. Sprinkle with remaining 1 tablespoon thyme and 1 tablespoon parsley and serve

title: apple bbq pork ribs
steps:
1. Mix rub ingredients and store in air tight container
2. Recommend making a triple batch so you'll have some for later
3. Remove membrane from bone side of ribs
4. Rub ribs generously with rub , wrap in plastic wrap , and refrigerate over night
5. Remove wrap from ribs and bring to room temperature
6. Re-season with rub
7. Bring grill / smoker up to around 200 degrees f
8. Using indirect heat , smoke ribs for 5-7 hours
9. Turn and baste with mop every hour
10. For the finishing sauce , combine all ingredients in a sauce pan and bring to a boil , reduce heat and simmer for one hour
11. For the smoke , use apple wood chips soaked in water
12. Keep the temperature as close to 200 as possible
13. Apply finishing sauce during the last hour--careful not to burn
14. Ribs are done when about 3 / 8 inch of bones are exposed and the rib bones come loose from the meat when twisted
15. Remove from heat , re-season with rub mixture , and let sit for at least 30 min prior to cutting into 2-rib portions

title: corn syrup for the diabetic   splenda simple syrup
steps:
1. In a heavy pot , boil ingredients , covered , for 3 minutes
2. Uncover and simmer to the soft-ball stage
3. Cool and store , covered at room temperature

title: banana cream cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven 190c
2. Grease a deep 20cm cake tin , line base with paper
3. Place the eggs and sugar in a bowl and whisk until thick and holds shape when
4. Fold in the flour

title: rosie s spiked wedding punch
steps:

title: pork chop  onion  and rice casserole
steps:

2. Spread rice in rectangular baking dish
3. Add frozen vegetables
4. Reserve one tablespoon of dry soup mix
5. Sprinkle remaining soup mix over rice

8. Cover tightly with foil and bake in moderate oven until tender , depending on thickness of chops
9. Remove foil and continue cooking for 10 minutes or until any excess liquid has evaporated

title: sweet glazed cherry pie
steps:
1. Combine sugar , cornstarch , frozen dark cherries and vanilla in large bowl
2. Allow cherries to thaw and stir
3. Line pie plate with pastry
4. Distribute sliced almonds evenly on top of the crust
5. Pour can of pie filling on top of almonds
6. Next pour dark cherry mixture on top of filling
7. Cover with second pastry
8. Poke small slits on top crust
9. Bake at 350 until crust is golden brown
10. Mix powdered sugar and milk to create a glaze
11. Distrubute over top and you are done

title: homemade hot dog
steps:
1. Prepare the casings
2. In a blender or food processor , make a puree of the onion , garlic , coriander , marjoram , mace , mustard seed , and paprika
3. Add the pepper , egg white , sugar , salt , and milk and mix thoroughly
4. Grind the pork , beef , and fat cubes through the fine blade separately
5. Mix together and grind again
6. Mix the seasonings into the meat mixture with your hands
7. This tends to be a sticky procedure , so wet your hands with cold water first
8. Chill the mixture for half an hour then put the mixture thorough the fine blade of the grinder once more
9. Stuff the casings and twist them off into six-inch links
10. Parboil the links in gently simmering water for 20 minutes
11. Place the franks in a bowl of ice water and chill thoroughly
12. Remove , pat dry , and refrigerate
13. Because they are precooked , they can be refrigerated for up to a week or they can be frozen
14. Preparing the casing
15. Snip off about four feet of casing
16. Rinse the casing under cool running water to remove any salt clinging to it
17. Place it in a bowl of cool water and let it soak for about half an hour
18. While you're waiting for the casing to soak , you can begin preparing the meat as detailed above
19. After soaking , rinse the casing under cool running water
20. Slip one end of the casing over the faucet nozzle
21. Hold the casing firmly on the nozzle , and then turn on the cold water , gently at first , and then more forcefully
22. This procedure will flush out any salt in the casing and pinpoint any breaks
23. Should you find a break , simply snip out a small section of the casing
24. Place the casing in a bowl of water and add a splash of white vinegar
25. A tablespoon of vinegar per cup of water is sufficient
26. The vinegar softens the casing a bit more and makes it more transparent , which in turn makes your sausage more pleasing to the eye
27. Leave the casing in the water / vinegar solution until you are ready to use it
28. Rinse it well and drain before stuffing

title: all bran muffins or bread
steps:
1. Mix milk , brown sugar , all-bran and fruitbits in large bowl
2. Let sit for 2 hours
3. After 2 hours , mix in self-rising flour
4. Grease a 9x5x3 loaf pan or put paper liners in muffin tin

7. For muffins bake 20-25 minutes

title: honey challah rolls
steps:
1. Many of the better machines have that option specifically so you can make rolls instead of a whole bread loaf
2. If so add the above ingredients to your bread machine , remembering to separate one egg and reserve it's egg white for later as explained in step 3
3. Set the bread machine to the manual cycle so it will mix but not bake

5. In electric mixer , combine 3 1 / 2 cups flour , yeast , and salt , blending well

title: baked cake donuts  doughnuts
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees and grease a 12 hole donut pan
2. In a large mixing bowl stir together flour , sugar , baking powder , nutmeg , and salt
3. Add buttermilk , eggs , and butter , stir until just combined
4. Divide batter between prepared donut pan
5. Bake until toothpick comes out clean , 7 to 9 minutes
6. Let donuts cool in pans for 5 minutes then take them out of pan and let cool on a cooling rack

title: chicken with mustard mascarpone marsala sauce
steps:
1. Sprinkle the chicken with salt and pepper
2. Heat the oil in a heavy large skillet over high heat
3. Add the chicken and cook just until brown , about 4 minutes per side
4. Transfer the chicken to a plate and cool slightly
5. While the chicken cools , melt 2 tablespoons of butter to the same skillet over medium-high heat , then add the onion and saute until tender , about 2 minutes

7. Add the wine and simmer until it is reduced by half , about 4 minutes
8. Stir in the mascarpone and mustard
9. Cut the chicken breasts crosswise into 1 / 3-inch-thick slices
10. Return the chicken and any accumulated juices to the skillet
11. Simmer , uncovered , over medium-low heat until the chicken is just cooked through and the sauce thickens slightly , about 2 minutes
12. Stir in the chopped parsley
13. Season the sauce , to taste , with salt and pepper
14. Meanwhile , bring a large pot of salted water to a boil
15. Add the fettuccine and cook until al dente , stirring occasionally , about 8 minutes
16. Drain
17. Toss the fettuccine with 3 tablespoons of butter and season , to taste , with salt and pepper
18. Swirl the fettuccine onto serving plates
19. Spoon the chicken mixture over top
20. Garnish with parsley sprigs and serve

title: veggie medley salad
steps:
1. Blanch frozen veggies for 1 minute
2. Drain well
3. Combine first seven ingredients in a medium bowl and set aside
4. In a small saucepan , combine the next six ingredients and boil for one minute to dissolve the sugar
5. This step may be omitted if you use sugar substitute
6. Pour the marinade over the veggies and stir to coat
7. Refrigerate the salad overnight
8. Stir salad before serving

title: mini loaded red potatoes vegetarian
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 375f
2. Slice off the small portion from one side of each potato to create a flat base
3. Toss the potatoes in a bowl with the oil and salt
4. Arrange potatoes , cut side down on a baking sheet
5. Bake 20-30 minutes , or until soft
6. Meanwhile , cook the bacon till done , then chop or crumble
7. Allow potatoes to cool slightly

title: microwave   spaghetti squash  small hubbard squash
steps:
1. Wash the squash
2. Poke holes in the top and sides with a tined fork
3. About 6 times
4. Set microwave on 70% power
5. Cook 15 minutes
6. Moisture and steam will seep from the vent holes
7. The skin should start to be soft and pliable
8. Since this recipe was written and i have no way of knowing the wattage of each microwave , do not cook on high power
9. Continue to cook at 5 minute intervals at 70% power
10. The skin should be very soft and pliable
11. The whole squash should be soft and pliable
12. If not , cook a few minutes more
13. Take out of microwave , let set for a few minutes
14. This step is very important
15. On cutting board , cut in half
16. Clean out the seeds
17. Clean out all of the flesh
18. Add the salt and butter
19. All of the flesh is considered to be spaghetti strands in spaghetti squash
20. Ready for both types of squash to be baked , mashed or served
21. Ready to add more butter , sauces , sour cream , pasta sauces or garlic and onion , or brown sugar for hubbard squash
22. The kids love to scrape the squash and pop a few strands in their mouths in the process

title: meringue cookies or cloud cookies
steps:
1. Beat egg whites , cream of tartar and salt until soft peaks form
2. Add vanilla
3. Gradually add sugar , beat until stiff
4. Fold in chocolate chips and nuts
5. Drop by teaspoonful on a cookie sheet covered with parchment paper
6. Bake until dry at 300 degrees , about 20-25 minutes

title: strawberry granola squares
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine the granola , flour , brown sugar and cinnamon
2. Cut in butter until crumbly
3. Set aside a third of the mixture for topping
4. Press remaining mixture into a well greased 9 inch square baking dish
5. Bake at 375 for 10 minutes
6. Spread preserves over crust
7. Sprinkle with reserved granola mixture
8. Bake 15 minutes longer or until filling is bubbly around the edges
9. Cool on a wire rack
10. Cut into squares
11. Store in the refrigerator

title: chocolate cherry brownies
steps:
1. Cut 12 cherries in half , and set aside
2. Chop the remaining cherries , and set aside
3. Combine butter and 1 / 2 cup chocolate morsels in top of a double boiler
4. Bring water to a boil
5. Reduce heat to low
6. Cook until the butter and chocolate melt , stirring occasionally
7. Remove from heat , and let cool slightly
8. Combine the flour and next 3 ingredients in a large mixing bowl
9. Stir well and set aside
10. Add sugar , eggs , and vanilla to reserved chocolate mixture , stirring with a wire whisk until blended
11. Add to the reserved flour mixture , beating at low speed of an electric mixer until blended
12. Stir in reserved chopped cherries and pecans
13. Spread mixture in a greased 13x9x2 inch pan
14. Bake at 350 degrees for 25 to 28 minutes , or until a wooden toothpick inserted in the middle comes out clean
15. Cool in the pan on a wire rack
16. Cut into squares , and top each square with a reserved cherry half
17. Combine 1 / 2 cup chocolate morsels and shortening in the top of a double boiler
18. Bring water to a boiil
19. Reduce heat to low
20. Cook until chocolate and shortening melt , stirring occasionally
21. Drizzle over the brownies

title: sauted spinach and peppers
steps:
1. In a large non-stick skillet , saute red pepper in oil for 1 minute
2. Add onion , and garlic , saute for 1-2 minutes , or until tender
3. Stir in spinach , salt , pepper , and sugar , saute for 1-2 minutes or until spinach is wilted , and tender
4. Serve with slotted spoon

title: dukkah chicken
steps:
1. First , combine all of the marinade ingredients in a medium sized bowl
2. Marinate the chicken strips in this mixture for at least one hour
3. Preheat oven to 180c , and line a baking tray with waxed paper
4. Put all of the breadcrumb ingredients in a food processor , and give it a few quick pulses , to mix the cheese through evenly
5. Dip each piece of marinated chicken in the breadcrumb mixture , being sure to coat it thoroughly and evenly
6. Place the chicken pieces on the baking tray , and give them a quick spray of olive oil
7. Bake at 180c for 25 minutes , then turn them all over , and give them another 15 minutes
8. Serve with mediterranean fried cous cous , and herb , lemon , and garlic dressing

title: no ketchup meatloaf
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together and place into a bread loaf pan
2. Half way through cooking drain fat
3. Cook for 1 hour at 350

title: sweet potato casserole   no nuts
steps:
1. Mix first 5 ingredients in a large bowl and spread into a large baking dish
2. Mix together the topping ingredients and sprinkle on top
3. Bake for 1 / 2 hour to 45 min in 350 degree oven

title: mocha cheesecake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325
2. Crust:
3. Stir together graham crumbs , sugar , and butter
4. Press into 9 inch springform pan
5. Filling:
6. Combine cream cheese and sugar until smooth
7. Add eggs in one at a time on low speed until combined
8. Dissolve coffee granules with whipping cream
9. Melt chocolate with whipping cream on top of double boiler or in microwave
10. Be careful not to scorch
11. Cool slightly
12. Add chocolate mixture to cream cheese and blend well
13. Stir in sour cream and vanilla
14. Beat until smooth
15. Pour mixture into prepared pan
16. Bake in oven for 45 minutes - 1 hour or until set
17. Do not overbake
18. Leave cake in oven and door ajar with heat turned off for 45 minutes
19. Remove cake from oven
20. Chill overnight
21. Flavored whipping cream:
22. Just before serving , dissolve coffee into whipping cream and whip
23. Add in powdered sugar after soft peaks form and beat until stiffer peaks form
24. Garnish cake with flavored whipping cream
25. You may also garnish with chocolate curls , chocolate covered coffee beans , etc
26. :)
27. Enjoy !

title: drew s homemade pimiento cheese   spicy or mild
steps:
1. Chop pimientos into small pieces , or pulse in a food processor
2. In small bowl , stir all ingredients until well mixed
3. Or put all ingredients into a food processor , and pulse until well-blended and pimientos are in small pieces
4. Serve on crackers , with celery , or make pimiento cheese sandwiches !
5. You may prefer to add up to 1 / 2 cup mayonnaise to get the spreading consistency you like

title: ton yuk kui  korean pork or beef
steps:
1. Combine the meat with the marinade and allow the mixture to soak for about 2 hours at room temperature
2. Stirring occasionally to make sure all of the meat gets well coated
3. Take the meat from the marinade and pat dry
4. Set aside
5. Be sure to save the marinade
6. Coat the sides and bottom of a baking dish with the sesame oil and add the meat
7. Bake in a preheated oven for 50 minutes until the meat is tender
8. While the meat is baking , bring the marinade to boil
9. Reduce the heat to low and cook for approx 15 minutes
10. The amount should be a little reduced
11. When the meat is finished baking pour its cooking juices into the reduced marinade and bring it to a boil again
12. Put the meat on a serving dish and pour some of the juice over the pork
13. The remainder of the juice can be served separately for those who wish to have more their meat or as a gravy on their rice

title: low fat cinnamon scone
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f lightly grease two baking sheets
2. In a large bowl , combine flour , cream of tartar , baking soda , salt and sugar
3. Add the applesauce , water and milk
4. Mix well
5. Drop large rounded spoonfuls of batter onto prepared baking sheets
6. Bake at 400 degrees f for 15 minutes
7. Let cool before serving

title: easy brussels sprouts au gratin
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400f
2. Bring water to a boil in a large saucepan
3. Add the brussels sprouts , nutmeg and salt
4. Bring back to the boil , lower the heat , cover and cook gently for 10-15 minutes
5. Drain brussels sprouts and arrange in an ovenproof dish
6. While the sprouts are cooking melt half the butter in a frying pan , add the onion and saute for 4-5 minutes
7. Stir in the ham
8. Sprinkle onions and ham mixture over the brussels sprouts , then sprinkle with the parmesan cheese
9. Dot with the remaining butter and cook in the oven for 20 minutes until the top is golden brown

title: super simple pantry tilapia
steps:
1. Take one glass baking dish large enough to lay your fillets side by side , without overlapping , and lighty coat the inside with evoo
2. It doesn't need to be heavy , just enough to give a light nonstick barrier
3. Beat eggs to make an egg coating
4. Mix your italian seasoning mix with your breadcrumbs
5. Rinse off fillets with water to get rid of any residue from the store and shake off excess water
6. Dip the fillets on your egg mix , then into the breadcrumb mix
7. Be sure to lightly press the fillets into the mix to help the crumbs stick
8. Lay each fillet in your dish when done
9. Drizzle a very light amount of evoo on top of your fillets
10. Bake at 350f
11. For approximately 20-25 minutes
12. Time will vary depending on how many fillets you have adjusted to , and their thickness , and your oven
13. About halfway through flip your fillets and add a sprinkle of breadcrumbs on the side that is now facing up
14. Continue baking until complete
15. Your fish will be done when it has a firm yet flakey texture
16. Enjoy !

title: grilled honey lime chicken
steps:
1. Combine marinade ingredients
2. Mix well and pour over chicken
3. Allow the chicken to marinate for between 2 and 4 hours
4. Grill the chicken tighs , turning over often and basting frequently with the marinade , until chicken is moderately firm on both sides
5. Remove from grill
6. Serve whole or sliced

title: mangocado pudding  raw recipe
steps:
1. Blend fruit until smooth in food processor
2. Garnish with coconut if you like
3. Refrigerate until ready to serve

title: the best angel food cake
steps:
1. Heat oven to 325 degrees
2. Have ready an ungreased 9 3 / 4-inch angelfood cake pan , preferably with a removable bottom , or use parchment or wax paper to line bottom of pan with nonremovable bottom
3. In a small bowl , combine flour with 3 / 4 cup sugar
4. Place remaining 3 / 4 cup sugar next to the mixer
5. Use a whisk to completely combine and aerate flour / sugar mixture
6. In a large , grease-free mixing bowl , beat egg whites at low speed until just broken up and beginning to froth
7. Add cream of tartar and salt and beat at medium speed until whites form very soft , billowy mounds
8. With the mixer still at medium speed , beat in 3 / 4 cup sugar , 1 tablespoon at a time , until all sugar is added and whites are shiny and form soft peaks
9. Add vanilla , lemon juice , and almond extract and beat until just blended
10. Place flour / sugar mixture in a sifter set over waxed paper
11. Sift flour mixture over egg whites about 3 tablespoons at a time , and gently fold it in , using a large rubber spatula , a large flat whisk , or your hand
12. Gently scrape batter into pan , smooth the top , and give pan a couple of raps on the counter to release any large air bubbles
13. Bake in lower third of oven for 50 to 60 minutes until cake is golden brown and the top springs back when pressed firmly
14. If cake pan has feet , invert pan onto them
15. If not , invert pan over the neck of a bottle so that air can circulate all around it
16. Allow to cool completely for 2 to 3 hours before removing from pan
17. To unmold , run a knife or thin spatula around edges , being careful not to dislodge the golden crust
18. Pull cake out of pan and cut the same way around removable bottom under the cake to release , or peel off parchment or wax paper , if used
19. Cool cake completely , bottom side up
20. When completely cold , cut slices by sawing gently with a serrated knife or pulling with a taut thread through the cake
21. Serve cake the same day or freeze overnight if serving the next day

title: saltgrass style baked potato soup
steps:
1. Chop raw bacon into small pieces
2. Place in medium size skillet and cook over medium heat until well done
3. While bacon is cooking , chop onion , celery , and carrot
4. You will want a very fine chop on this
5. If available , place in electric food chopper or processor
6. Once bacon has finished cooking , transfer bacon and grease to a large stovetop stockpot or electric crockpot
7. Then add chopped onion , celery and carrot
8. Thoroughly combine mixture
9. Finely chop green onion and then mince garlic
10. Add to pot and stir
11. Measure out black pepper , seasoned salt and white pepper
12. Add to pot and stir
13. Allow mixture to cook & flavors to meld while peeling and dicing potatoes
14. Roughly 15 minutes
15. Add potatoes , chicken stock and heavy cream to pot
16. Mix thoroughly and allow to cook for 1-1 / 2 to 2 hours , or until potatoes are very soft
17. Once potatoes are done cooking , use immersion blender to thoroughly pure soup
18. Alternatively , divide soup mixture into two batches and pure in a countertop blender
19. With pured soup in pot , add shredded cheese and whisk until melted and thoroughly mixed
20. Prepare optional garnish and serve !

title: chicken provolone and swiss roulades
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Pound chicken breasts between 2 pieces of waxed paper or plastic wrap until nearly double in size and fairly thin
3. Lay one slice of prosciutto on top of each breast
4. Top with one slice of provolone and 1 slice of swiss cheese
5. Starting at short end , roll up each breast and secure with toothpicks
6. Melt 2 tablespoons butter in a large nonstick skillet
7. Saute the chicken rolls for 2-3 minutes over medium-high heat , turning frequently
8. Remove the chicken rolls from the skillet , place in a 9x12-inch baking dish that has been coated with the remaining 1 teaspoon butter
9. Sprinkle rolls with tarragon and pepper
10. Bake for 20-25 minutes

title: ww 6 points   spanish omelet
steps:
1. Whisk together egg , egg white , salt and pepper in a small bowl until just blended
2. Set aside
3. In a large , nonstick omelet pan , heat oil over medium heat
4. Add egg and tilt pan so eggs cover entire pan bottom
5. Cook , without stirring , until bottom of eggs begins to set , about 30 seconds
6. Sprinkle scallion , tomatoes , olives , chili peppers and cheese evenly across eggs
7. Tilt pan upward at a slight angle and jerk handle sharply toward you to slide eggs toward the far side of pan
8. Free any stuck egg with spatula
9. Cook , moving pan back and forth over heat , until eggs are cooked through , about 3 to 4 minutes
10. Fold in half to serve

title: homemade wendy s frosty
steps:
1. All you have to do is combine all the ingredients into your ice cream maker and blend them together well
2. Add your ice and salt , turn it on and enjoy when it's done

title: coconut sticky rice
steps:
1. Bring rice and coconut milk to a boil , simmer for 15 minutes
2. Take some tin foil and crumple it up so it is bumpy and not flat
3. In steamer over boiling water , add tin foil , add rice mixture and steam for 20 minutes bring sugar , water , salt , and vanilla to slow boil cook for 10 minutes until syrup forms remove rice from steamer , toss with coconut , drizzle with syrup

title: 7 up chicken
steps:
1. Marinate 6-8 hours
2. Works very well with boneless chicken breasts
3. Grill chicken for 5 minutes , or until done

title: ron s rum cake
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 325 f
2. And grease and flour a bundt cake pan
3. Spread the pecans over the bottom of the pan and set aside
4. With an electric mixer , beat the eggs until they are a light lemon color
5. Add the cake mix , pudding mix , water , vegetable oil , and rum
6. Beat until thoroughly combined
7. Pour into the prepared pan and bake in the middle of the preheated oven for 55 to 60 minutes , until a toothpick inserted in the cake comes out clean
8. Remove the cake from the oven and let it cool for 5 minutes before removing it from the pan
9. Toward the end of the cakes baking , make the glaze
10. In a medium saucepan , bring the butter , sugar , water and rum to a boil
11. Reduce the heat to low and let the mixture continue to simmer for 3 minutes
12. Remove from the heat
13. While the cake is still warm , poke small holes in the top with a carving fork and pour the hot glaze over the cake
14. Let the cake sit for an hour before serving to absorb the glaze
15. Variation:
16. Glaze the cake a second time
17. An hour after applying the first glaze , melt 4 tablespoons unsalted butter in a medium saucepan
18. Stir in 1 cup light brown sugar , 1 tablespoon cornstarch , 1 / 2 cup water and 1 / 2 cup light rum
19. Bring this to a boil and stir until it has thickened
20. Pour the hot glaze over the cake and let it sit for another hour before serving

title: friday night veggie pizza
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Spread sheet pan with pizza dough
3. Prebake for 8 minutes
4. Take crust out , and let cool a little
5. Cover with sauce
6. Spread half of the cheese evenly over the sauce and add vegetables
7. Sprinkle on remaining cheese and bake for 8 to 10 minutes , or until cheese melts

title: harry potter potion
steps:
1. Put water and jello into blender and blend to mix
2. Add the ice half at a time and blend on high till ice is crushed and mixture is frothy
3. Add banana and blend about 30 seconds till banana is incorporated
4. Pour into mugs and serve to your harry potter fan

title: healthy strawberry  orange  banana smoothie
steps:
1. Pour milk and orange juice in blender
2. Slice strawberries & banana and add to blender
3. Add yogurt
4. Add 8-10 ice cubes
5. Blend on high for 1-2 minutes
6. Enjoy !

title: gluten free klaicha   date filled cookies
steps:
1. Sift flours and xanthan into a mixing bowl and combine well
2. Add in the sugar and mix evenly
3. Cut room temperature butter into small pieces and rub into flour with finger
4. I do this in a food processor and just keep pulsing until the butter is evenly distributed and there are no clumps
5. Dont walk away and leave the machine on or you will end up with a butter ball
6. Mix the rose water with the filtered water and sprinkle onto flour mixture
7. Pulse again to form a firm dough and then knead lightly until smooth
8. Cover the dough with cling film and rest for about 30 minutes
9. Meanwhile make the filling chop the dates and then gently heat them on low with the butter , stirring until the dates have softened about 5 10 minutes , depending on your dates
10. Remove from the heat and set aside
11. Roll the dough into small round balls about the size of a large walnut or tablespoon
12. Flatten each ball like a pancake in the palm of your hand and place a teaspoonful of the date filling in the centre
13. Fold over the edges of the dough to close over and cover the date filling
14. Roll the dough back into a ball with your hands
15. This can be a bit tricky if you fill the balls with too much filling
16. If you want to be really traditional you can press each ball into a special middle eastern carved mould similar to a tabi
17. Alternatively , press each side of the ball with a fork to indent , slightly flatten , and then press the sides of the balls to round up , before placing on a baking sheet
18. Bake in the oven at about 160 c / 325 f oven for 30 minutes until lightly browned
19. Allow the cookies to cool on the tray as they will firm up and get a little bit more crispy
20. Store in a sealed container for use later if they last that long

title: 2 minute eggless microwave chocolate cake
steps:
1. Mix all dry ingredients in a microwave safe mug with a fork , add all wet ingredients and mix thoroughly until its a smooth and running liquid
2. Place mug in microwave and set on full power for 2 minutes after the timer has gone off , let cake sit in microwave for 30 seconds
3. Serve plain , dusted with sugar , with vanilla ice cream or whipped cream -- whatever catches your fancy
4. Happy microwaving !

title: just like cool whip   copycat
steps:
1. Chill a small bowl
2. Soften gelatin with 2 tsp cold water , then add the boiling water , stirring until gelatin is completely dissolved
3. Cool until tepid
4. Place ice water and dry milk powder in the chilled bowl
5. Beat at high speed , until mixture forms stiff peaks
6. Add sugar and vanilla , still beating , then oil and gelatin
7. Place in freezer for about 15 minutes , then transfer to refrigerator until ready to use
8. Stir just before using , to retain creamy texture
9. Also , 1 tsp pure vanilla may be added if desired

title: mushroom chops and gravy
steps:
1. Combine flour , paprika , salt and pepper in a bag
2. Add chops and shake to coat
3. Brown chops in butter in lg skillet
4. Put chops in greased baking dish
5. In same skillet , saute the onion , green pepper and mushrooms for 1 minute
6. Slowly add milk and blend well
7. Bring to a boil , boil 1 minute
8. Add lemon juice
9. Pour over the chops
10. Cover and bake at 350 for 1 hour or until chops are done

title: simply delicious new york style cheesecake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Combine graham cracker crumbs , melted butter & 2 tbsp sugar , mixing well
3. Press onto bottom of a 10 inch springform pan , pressing up sides slightly
4. Bake in preheated oven about 8-10 minutes
5. Set aside to cool
6. In large mixing bowl using an electric mixer combine cream cheese , 1 3 / 4 cup sugar , zests and vanilla extract beating until light and creamy
7. Add the flour , eggs , yolks , sour cream , vanilla bean seeds and bourbon and mix just until smooth
8. Pour mixture into the prepared springform pan
9. Wrap the pan with heavy duty foil and place in a roasting pan
10. Fill the roasting pan with enough hot water to come half way up the sides of the pan
11. Bake for 1 1 / 2 hours
12. Remove from oven and remove from water bath
13. Remove foil and place on counter until it comes to room temperature
14. Place in refrigerator overnight or at least 6 hours

title: cheesy tater puffs
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 425
2. Mix mashed potatoes with shredded cheese
3. You can also add shredded onions , garlic , carrots and your choice of herbs to make it look and taste different !
4. Let mashed potatoes and additions get cold before you continue ! if you don't then they will spread out more , if they are cold then the inside will be warm and the outside will crisp
5. Line cookie sheet with foil or parchment paper , and spray with non-stick cooking spray
6. Fit pasrty bag with the largest star
7. Squeeze potato mixture through bag onto prepared cookie sheet , in small mounds
8. Season with salt and pepper , or seasonings of choice
9. Place in oven for 20-25 minutes
10. If you want a crispier outside place under broiler for a few minutes watching closely
11. You can freeze any extra , you will need to leave them separate on the cookie sheet until frozen then you can bag them and reheat like you were cooking them fresh

title: pork  tenderloin with herb sauce
steps:
1. Cut each tenderloin into 12 slices
2. Sprinkle with salt , pepper and garlic powder or some fresh garlic
3. In a large nonstick skillet coated with cooking spray , brown pork in butter in batches over medium heat for 3-4 minutes on each side
4. Return all pork to the skillet
5. Combine remaining ingredients
6. Pour over pork
7. Cook and stir over low heat for 2-3 minutes or until sauce is thickened

title: cheesy chicken  n spinach pinwheels
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375f
2. Spray cookie sheet with cooking spray
3. Cook spinach in microwave as directed
4. Drain spinach in strainer
5. Cool 5 minutes then carefully squeeze out all the water
6. Heat oil over medium heat in skillet
7. Add onion and garlic
8. Cook 2 to 3 minutes , stirring occasionally , until crisp-tender
9. Remove from heat and stir in spinach , bacon , chicken , cheese and mayonnaise
10. Unroll dough on work surface
11. Spread spinach mixture on rectangle to within 1 / 2 inch of edges
12. Starting at long side of rectangle , roll up
13. Seal long edge
14. With serrated knife , cut into 20 slices
15. Place cut side down on cookie sheet
16. Beat water into egg mixture and brush the tops
17. Bake 10 to 15 minutes or until golden brown
18. Remove from cookie sheet
19. Serve warm

title: banana oatmeal chocolate chip cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Combine first 5 ingredients in a large bowl
3. Beat with a mixer at medium speed until smooth
4. Add egg
5. Beat well
6. Weigh or lightly spoon flour into dry measuring cups
7. Level with a knife
8. Combine flour , oats , baking soda , and salt in a medium bowl , stirring with a whisk
9. Add flour mixture to banana mixture in bowl
10. Beat with a mixer at medium speed until well blended
11. Stir in chocolate chips
12. Drop batter by heaping tablespoonfuls 2 inches apart onto baking sheets coated with cooking spray
13. Bake at 350 for 18 minutes or until golden
14. Cool on pans 2 minutes
15. Remove cookies from pans
16. Cool completely on wire racks

title: kim s pizza crust
steps:
1. Mix and knead by the method of your choice
2. Let rise until doubled
3. Roll / spread it out into pizza pan
4. Spread a thin coat of olive oil over the crust to keep it from rising too much while you add the sauce and other toppings
5. Bake at 425 degrees for 15 minutes or until done

title: cream cheese fingers
steps:
1. Slice bread crosswise into 1 inch fingers , leaving attached
2. Mix cream cheese and salad dressing mix together
3. Spread on bread
4. Pile on toppings
5. Broil until brown and bubbly
6. Makes just about 4 1 / 2 dozen fingers
7. Enjoy !

title: cibola
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together
2. Pour over ice
3. Stir
4. Enjoy

title: sarasota s simple quick   easy favorite frozen corn
steps:
1. Foil pouch -- use a large sheet of foil about 18" long and spray the inside with pam or any non stick spray
2. Pour the corn in the center and top with the scallions and lightly toss
3. Cut the butter into small pieces and top on the corn and finish with the broth and the cheese
4. Fold up your foil pouch really well
5. Grill -- either outside grill or in the oven 375 degrees or medium high heat on the grill
6. It takes about 10-15 minutes
7. I flip usually once during cooking
8. Enjoy this no fuss , inexpensive , easy , quick side dish

title: easy uncooked tomato sauce for pasta
steps:
1. Lightly drain the tomatoes
2. Place tomatoes in a bowl , large jar , or sealable container
3. If the tomatoes are whole you should crush them up with a fork or dice them
4. You can also use diced tomatoes
5. Add the remaining ingredients except pasta
6. I use either fresh basil or dried oregano , alot of it
7. By crushing the garlic rather than chopping you will get more garlic flavor so don't be tempted to use too much more than what i have listed unless it is from a jar or diced
8. Cover container and place in the fridge for at least 3-6 hours
9. The longer it sits the better it is
10. Remove the garlic clove from the sauce and take out of the fridge just b4 cooking the pasta you want it to be someplace between cold and room temperature if it is too warm you will not have as big a flavor burts when the hot pasta meets the sauce if too cold it will cool the pasta too much
11. Cook pasta until al dente , drain and toss with the cold sauce
12. Eat and enjoy , serve with hot crusty bread and a tossed green salad

title: cranberry pineapple gelatin salad
steps:
1. Spray a 4-cup gelatin mold or a 9-inch square pan with vegetable oil cooking spray
2. In a medium glass mixing bowl , combine the raspberry gelatin and unflavored gelatin
3. Add 1 cup boiling water and stir with a metal spoon continuously for 2 minutes , until the gelatin is completely dissolved
4. Stir in 1 / 2 cup cold water
5. Add the pineapple and juice , cranberry sauce , and walnuts
6. Stir with a metal spoon until all ingredients are completely incorporated
7. Pour the mixture into the prepared mold , cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until firm
8. About 1 hour before serving , invert the mold onto a serving platter and allow to sit at room temperature
9. The salad will release itself and come clean from the mold
10. Combine cream cheese , powdered sugar , whipped cream and walnuts in bowl
11. Spoon into the center of the mold

title: fried eggplant  with powdered sugar
steps:
1. In a large skillet , preheat oil
2. Season the eggplant with salt
3. In a mixing bowl , whisk the eggs until frothy
4. Whisk in the sugar and a pinch of salt
5. Add flour to make a light batter
6. Soak the eggplant slice in the light batter
7. Remove the eggplant from the batter and gently lay in the hot oil
8. Pan-fry the eggplant for 2 to 3 minutes on each side or until golden brown
9. Remove from the oil and drain on a paper-lined plate
10. Serve the eggplant immediately with powdered sugar

title: mom s haluski
steps:
1. Put a large pot of water on the stove to boil
2. Fry the cabbage in a large skillet , season with salt and pepper , fry until brown and cooked , cover to keep warm
3. In a food processor , blend potatoes until liquid
4. Add the eggs then
5. Add flour until stiff
6. Place a small amount of the potatoes on a plate and push spoonfulls off the edge of the plate into a pot of boiling water
7. Allow dumplings to boil until the float
8. Cook the margarine in a saucepan until dark brown careful not to burn it , you will smell it if you do
9. Mix cooked cabbage and dumplings together and drizzle with the brown butter

title: jade hummus with pita crisps
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Arrange pita halves in a single layer on oven rack
3. Bake at 350 degrees for 15 minutes or until crisp
4. Cool completely on wire rack
5. Break each pita half into about 6 chips
6. Prepare edamame according to package instructions , omitting salt
7. Place 1 tablespoon oil , along with salt , cumin , coriander , and garlic in a food processor
8. Pulse 2 to 3 times or until coarsely chopped
9. Add edamame , parsley tahini , water , and lemon juice
10. Process 1 minute or until smooth
11. Spoon hummus into serving bowl
12. Drizzle hummus with 1 teaspoon oil
13. Sprinkle with paprika

title: chipotle stuffed chicken breasts
steps:
1. Using a sharp , thin knife , cut a parallel slit in the side of each chicken breast , forming a pocket , taking care not to cut through top or bottom of chicken
2. Combine 1 cup cheese , pimientos and cilantro
3. Stuff into pockets of chicken
4. Place chicken on a foil-lined baking sheet
5. Combine chili powder , cumin and garlic salt
6. Rub mixture over both sides of chicken
7. Coat chicken lightly with cooking spray or brush with canola oil
8. Bake in a preheated 400f oven 20 minutes or until chicken is cooked through
9. Sprinkle remaining cheese over chicken
10. Continue baking 2 to 3 minutes or until cheese has melted

title: apple cinnamon waffles
steps:
1. Sift together flour , sugar , baking powder , and salt
2. Set aside
3. In a small bowl , beat egg whites until stiff
4. Set aside
5. In a meduim bowl , beat egg yolks well
6. Stir in milk
7. Add sifted dry ingredients to egg yolks and mix until moistened
8. Add vegetable oil
9. Fold in egg whites
10. Stir cinnamon into mixture
11. Add apples
12. Blend lightly into mixture
13. Bake in preheated waffle maker for at least 4-5 minutes , until crisp and brown

title: champignons a la grecque
steps:
1. Clean and slice mushrooms
2. Combine remaining ingredients into a saucepan and cook until alcohol smell is gone
3. Combine all ingredients into a dish to marinate and leave in the refrigerator overnight

title: maast o khiar   persian cucumber sauce
steps:
1. Beat yogurt well until smooth
2. If yogurt is too thick , add a bit of water while beating
3. If fresh mint is used , it should be finely chopped
4. Add mint , grated onion and cucumber , salt and pepper to yogurt and mix well
5. Leave in the refrigerator for two hours , then serve

title: succulent roasted game hens in a jiffy
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425
2. Cut backbone from each hen with a knife or kitchen shears
3. Open the hen until it lies flat , with a leg on each side
4. Rub hens all over with olive oil
5. Season with paprika , salt , black pepper
6. Heat an ovenproof skillet over high heat
7. Brown hens , skin side up , 3 minutes
8. Turn
9. Brown 2 minutes more
10. Transfer pan to oven
11. Place a heavy cast iron pan or a brick wrapped with foil on top of hens
12. Roast 12 minutes
13. Remove top pan or brick and turn hens skin side up
14. Cook until firm and evenly browned , but still moist , about 7 minutes
15. Garnish with 2 tbsp fresh chopped parsley

title: kuska biryani   a treat at parties
steps:
1. Heat oil in a heavy bottomed vessel
2. Then add bay leaves , cardamoms , cloves and the piece of cinnamon
3. Mix well in the oil
4. Add ginger-garlic paste and continue to mix well
5. Allow it to fry till the smell of ginger and garlic leaves the oil
6. Add the slit green chillies and diced tomatoes
7. Mix well
8. Once the tomatoes turn mushy , add salt to taste and chilli powder
9. Then add half the corriander leaves and water to cook the rice
10. Increase heat and add rice only once the water starts boiling
11. Reduce heat now and cook on low flame , adding a little of the corriander leaves each time you stir the rice
12. Once the rice is more than three-fourth cooked , pressure cook the rice till you hear 2 whistles
13. Garnish with the remaining corriander leaves and serve immediately with onion raita

title: fried mashed potato balls with bacon  5fix
steps:
1. Fry bacon pieces until crispy but not burned
2. Drain well and blot carefully
3. Try to remove as much excess fat as possible
4. Mix bacon with chives and simply potatoes , traditional mashed potatoes
5. Scoop enough potato mixture to make a ball that is one or two bites
6. Roll into a ball , then push a cube or two of the cheese in the center and roll into a ball so that the cheese is all the way in the middle
7. The balls should not be very large or the cheese won't melt
8. Roll finished ball in panko until well covered
9. Fry in oil until browned all over
10. Drain and serve as is or with condiments such as sour cream

title: garden biscuits
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine the flour , sugar , yeast , baking powder , baking soda , and salt
2. Cut in the shortening until mixture resembles coarse crumbs
3. In a small saucepan , heat the buttermilk and water to 110 degrees
4. Add the buttermilk mixture , carrot , parsley , and onion to the yeast mixture
5. Stir until just moistened
6. Turn onto a lightly floured surface
7. Knead until a soft dough forms , about 6-8 minutes
8. Pat or roll out into a 1 / 2-inch thickness
9. Cut with a floured biscuit cutter
10. Place one inch apart on an ungreased baking sheet
11. Bake at 450 degrees for 8-10 minutes or until golden brown
12. Serve warm

title: mustard baked salmon
steps:
1. Mix in bowl: lemon juice , lemon rind and both mustards
2. Slowly pour in oil and blend until medium-thick sauce forms
3. Add breadcrumbs
4. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
5. Lightly grease 9x13-inch baking dish
6. Arrange salmon in prepared dish , skin side down
7. Press breadcrumb mixture onto fish
8. Bake salmon until cooked through and golden brown , about 18 minutes
9. Using large spatula as aid , transfer salmon fillets to platter
10. Serve , passing the following mustard sauce separately
11. Mustard sauce:
12. Combine mustard sauce ingredients , mix with whisk in bowl and serve with prepared salmon

title: macaroni and cheese with roasted veggies   pork sausage
steps:
1. Place pork sausage in a large dutch oven , brown on all sides , drain fat and poke each sausage several times with a sharp knife
2. Return to dutch oven , cover with water , add hot red pepper flakes , bay leaves , salt and pepper
3. Bring to boil , simmer for 1 hour , remove to drain on paper towel
4. Discard water and bay leaves
5. Slice sausage into bite size pieces , set aside
6. Place veggies in a large bowl , drizzle veggie oil over all , toss until all veggies are well coated
7. Spread coated veggies , in one layer , on lightly greased baking sheet
8. Roast for 25 minutes at 450f degrees , turning once
9. Whisk 1 / 4 cup of the milk with flour
10. In a saucepan , heat remaining milk over medium heat until bubbles appear around edge
11. Whisk in flour mixture and bring to boil , whisking constantly
12. Reduce heat to medium low
13. Cook , stirring , for 10 minutes or until thickened
14. Remove from heat , whisk in cheddar and cream cheese , mustard , thyme , salt and pepper
15. Meanwhile , in large pot of boiling salted water
16. Cook pasta until barely tender
17. Drain well and return to pot
18. Stir in sauce
19. Add bite size pieces pork sausage
20. Remove corn kernels from husks , discard husks , add all roasted veggies to pasta / sausage / sauce mixture , stir gently to coat
21. Spoon mixture into greased 10 cup casserole
22. Topping: mix bread crumbs with melted butter and parmesan cheese
23. Sprinkle topping mixture over top of casserole
24. Bake at 450f degrees for 10 to 15 minutes , until bubbly and golden

title: tomato and mushroom omelette
steps:
1. Whisk eggs in a bowl and stir in potato , cheese and chives
2. Pour mixture into a small frypan that has been lightly sprayed with cooking oil
3. Evenly spread tomato and mushroom pieces over the top and season generously with black pepper
4. Cook over low-medium heat for 10-15 minutes until egg has set
5. You can set under a grill but i find this isn't necessary at a fairly low temperature especially if you cover the frypan during cooking

title: american garlic bread
steps:
1. Adjust oven rack to middle position and heat oven to 500 degrees
2. Meanwhile , toast garlic cloves in small skillet over medium heat , shaking pan occasionally , until fragrant and color of cloves deepens slightly , about 8 minutes
3. When cool enough to handle , skin and mince cloves
4. Using dinner fork , mash garlic , butter , cheese , and salt in small bowl until thoroughly combined
5. Spread cut sides of loaf evenly with butter mixture
6. Season to taste with pepper
7. Transfer loaf halves , buttered side up , onto rimmed baking sheet
8. Bake , reversing position of baking sheet in oven from front to back halfway through baking time , until surface of bread is golden brown and toasted , 5 to 10 minutes
9. Cut each half into 2-inch slices
10. Serve immediately

title: bea s favorite homemade bread or buns
steps:
1. If mixing by hand:pour all ingredients , in order listed in large bowl
2. Mix together with a wooden spoon
3. Knead on a floured surface until smooth and elastic adding flour if necessary , about 10 minutes
4. If using stand mixer:pour all ingredients in stand mixer bowl , in order listed
5. Using dough hook , on setting number 2 , let knead 10 minutes
6. Next steps are the same for both methods:
7. Place dough in a greased bowl and let rise in a warm draft free spot until doubled , about 1 hours
8. Remove dough from bowl and punch out on a floured surface
9. If making loaves , cut dough in half and place in 2 greased bread pans
10. If making buns , cut into 16 equal portions and place on 2 greased cookie sheets
11. Make sure to leave enough room for rising
12. Let rise again until doubled , about 2 hour
13. If making loaves: bake in a preheated 400 degrees fahrenheit oven for 20 to 25 minutes , until golden brown
14. If making buns: bake in a preheated 400 degrees fahrenheit oven for 10 to 12 minutes , until golden brown

title: sweet soy dipping sauce
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together thoroughly
2. Serve with your favorite meal

title: big sandwich spread
steps:
1. Mix all the spread ingredients together
2. Slice a loaf of french bread lengthwise
3. Spread mixture on the inside of both halves
4. Top bottom half with any combination of sandwich meats that you desire
5. Can also be topped with pickles if you wish
6. Place top half of bread on the sandwich and slice into individual servings

title: spicy chicken tikka masala  grilled version
steps:
1. Marinade:
2. Combine yogurt , lemon juice , cumin , red pepper , black pepper , cinnamon , salt and ginger in a medium bowl or zip lock bag
3. Stir in chicken
4. Marinate for one hour
5. Soak wooden skewers in water for at least 30 minutes prior to grilling
6. Thread chicken on skewers and discard marinade
7. For sauce:
8. Melt butter in a large deep skillet over med / low heat
9. Add garlic and jalapeno , cook 1 minute
10. Stir in: coriander , cumin , paprika , garam masala and salt
11. Stir in tomato sauce , simmer 15 minutes
12. Remove from heat until 5 minutes before chicken is done grilling
13. Stir in whipping cream , simmer until sauce thickens , about 5 minutes
14. Meanwhile: heat grill to medium high or heat broiler
15. Grill or broil chicken , turning until done and no longer pink , about 8 minutes
16. Remove chicken from skewers and set aside
17. Add to sauce , simmer 5 minutes , and serve over basmati rice

title: butter pecan tea bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Grease and flour a 9x5x3" loaf pan
3. Sift together the flour , baking powder , baking soda , salt , cinnamon , nutmeg , and brown sugar
4. Stir in the pecans
5. In another bowl , combine the egg , buttermilk , and melted butter
6. Blend well
7. Add to the flour mixture gradually
8. Stir just until moistened
9. Do not overmix
10. Pour the batter into the prepared pan
11. Bake at 350f
12. For 45 minutes , or until a toothpick tests out done
13. Cool 10 minutes in pan before inverting
14. Cool completely

title: low fat low carb 7 layer tex mex dip
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , stir together the refried beans and salsa
2. Spread the bean mixture on a 9" platter or in a pie plate
3. Spread the yogurt cheese or sour cream on top of the bean layer
4. Then layer the shreadded cheese , tomatoes , avocados , green onions and olives on top
5. If desired , cover and refrigerate for up to 4 hours
6. Serve with tortilla chips

title: baked pasta with spinach  lemon and cheese
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Cook pasta in boiling water for 8 minutes or until almost al dente , omitting salt and fat
3. Remove from heat
4. Stir in spinach
5. Let stand for 2 minutes or until spinach wilts
6. Drain pasta mixture well
7. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium heat
8. Add olive oil to pan
9. Swirl to coat
10. Add onion
11. Cook 15 minutes or until golden brown , stirring frequently
12. Weigh or lightly spoon flour into a dry measuring cup
13. Level with a knife
14. Add flour and garlic
15. Cook 1 minute , stirring constantly with a whisk
16. Gradually add milk and wine
17. Cook 8 minutes or until sauce boils and thickens , stirring constantly
18. Stir in 3 / 4 cup of cheese , salt and rind
19. Remove from heat
20. Stir in pepper
21. Add pasta mixture , and toss gently to coat
22. Spoon pasta mixture into a 13x9 inch-glass or ceramic baking dish coated with cooking spray
23. Sprinkle half of panko breadcrumbs over pasta , and top evenly with remaining 1 / 4 cup cheese
24. Sprinkle the remaining half of panko breadcrumbs over cheese
25. Bake at 350 for 50 minutes

title: tommy mai tai
steps:
1. Fill cocktail shaker with crushed ice
2. Add rums , almond liqueur and triple sec to shaker
3. Shake and pour into a tiki cup
4. Fill with juices
5. Float grenadine on top
6. Garnish with a cherry and pineapple slice

title: juicy peach crisp
steps:
1. Oven@ 375
2. Combine peaches with almond extract and place in a greased 8-inch pan
3. Combine the rest of the ingredients until you have a crumbly consistency
4. Sprinkle the crumb mixture over the peaches
5. Bake for 45 minutes
6. Serve hot with a puddle of melting ice cream !

title: savory   spicy turkey meatloaf
steps:
1. Combine dry oatmeal , egg , onions , peppers , and salt in a bowl
2. Add gound meat , and mix it lightly with your hands
3. Gradually add the hot sauce and half of the vegetable juice
4. Mix together lightly , but well
5. Shape into loaf in a shallow baking dish
6. Pour remaining juice on top
7. Bake at 350 for 40-50 minutes

title: tomato ham soup
steps:
1. Cook cabbage , onions , shallots in olive oil , till limp
2. Add juice , tomatoes , water , sugar , lemon juice , salt and pepper
3. Add chili sauce
4. Simmer 1 hour
5. Add ham in last 15 minutes of cooking

title: awesome beer can chicken
steps:
1. Clean out chicken and pat dry with a paper towel
2. Then cut oranges in half and squeeze all over chicken , inside and out
3. Then mix all other ingredients together and rub all over chicken
4. ( i also rub in between the skin and meat
5. Then take a few gulps of the beer and then stick the beer can in the chicken's rear and set up on grill
6. I use a gas grill so you want to place it in the middle of the burners so it doesn't get direct heat
7. I also use a tin pan to put under the grill on top of the rocks to catch any drippings
8. You then shut grill for about 1 hour and 45 minutes , until the chicken is 180 degrees in the thigh
9. Take off grill and let stand for 5 to 10 minute
10. It should just pretty much fall off the bone !
11. Enjoy !

title: baked globetrotter fries
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f cut potatoes into long thin strips and place on a large baking sheet
2. Drizzle with oil , then sprinkle with seasonings
3. Toss well to coat
4. Bake for 45 minutes , stirring 3 or 4 times during cooking , until potatoes are golden brown and crisp
5. Serve with a few of the sauces or pick a favorite !
6. Makes 4 servings

title: coffee cake  vegan
steps:
1. Make the streusel topping: mix together the 2 tbsp flour , brown sugar , cinnamon , margarine in a small bowl
2. Add nuts and set aside
3. Sift or stir together the flour , sugar , baking soda , baking powder , and salt in a medium bowl
4. Stir the egg replacer into the water until mixed , then add the soy yogurt
5. Add dry ingredients to the yogurt mixture and beat with a spoon just until smooth
6. Scrape into an 8" or 9" pan , either nonstick or lightly oiled / sprayed
7. Sprinkle the streusel topping evenly over the batter
8. Bake in preheated 350 degrees f oven , for about 30-35 minutes or until done

title: coconut tequila
steps:
1. Mix in a blender on low speed for 15 seconds
2. Strain into a cocktail glass

title: lemon pudding dessert
steps:
1. Cruch crackers and mix with oleo
2. Press in a large cake pan
3. Bake 350 for 5 minutes
4. Mix cream cheese , powered sugar and 2 / 3 cup cool whip
5. Spread over graham cracker crust
6. Prepare pudding using 3 cups milk
7. Place over cream cheese mixture
8. Put rest of cool whip over pudding garnish with nuts
9. Chill

title: homemade apple pie liquor
steps:
1. Put the cider , juice , sugar and cinnamon sticks into a large kettle
2. Bring to almost a boil and then let cool
3. Pour in the everclear and mix

title: lamb shank and barley soup
steps:
1. Trim any excess fat from the lamb shanks
2. Place into a large saucepan or boiler
3. Along with the water / stock and salt
4. Bring slowly to the boil and simmer gentley for 1 1 / 2 hours
5. Skim / remove any excess fat from the top of the stock with a spoon and / pr paper towel
6. Return the stock to the stove and add all remaining ingredients
7. Simmer for another 1 1 / 2 hours
8. Remove the meat from the bones and chop into chunky pieces
9. Return meat to the stock and discard the bones
10. Reheat to serve
11. Serve sprinkled with chopped parsley or a sprig of parsley as garnish
12. This can be finely processed for babies and frozen in serving sizes

title: savory grilled t bones
steps:
1. In a large resealable plastic bag , combine the first 11 ingredients
2. Add steaks
3. Seal bag and turn to coat
4. Refrigerate for 2-4 hours
5. Drain and discard marinade
6. Grill steaks , covered , over medium heat for 6-10 minutes on each side or until meat reaches desired doneness

title: fresh orange bread pudding with meringue topping
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325
2. Place the oranges and bread cubes in a 1-quart casserole dish
3. Set aside
4. To make the custard , combine the sugar , cornstarch , and salt in a saucepan
5. Blend in egg yolks and 1 / 4 cup of the milk
6. Mix in remaining milk stir and cook over very low heat until the custard coats metal spoon and is slightly thick
7. Add butter , orange peel , and vanilla
8. Pour into casserole over the oranges and bread cubes
9. Place pan in hot water going 1 / 2 way up outside of casserole dish and bake at 325f for 1 1 / 2 hours or until the pudding is firm in the center
10. Cover with meringue
11. For meringue , beat egg whites until they stand at soft peaks
12. Gradually beat in the sugar
13. Add the vanilla and spread over the cooked bread pudding
14. Return the pan to the oven and back into the pan of hot water
15. Bake 20 minutes or until the meringue is brown
16. Serve warm

title: walnut rye bread
steps:
1. Add ingredients to your bread machine in this order
2. Set loaf size , crust and bake on whole wheat or fruit / nut cycle
3. After 5 minutes check to see that dough is in a smooth ball
4. If too dry add water 1 tsp at a time , if too wet add flour 1 tsp at a time
5. Add nuts when machine beeps , or at the end of the cycle
6. Cool on a rack before slicing

title: teriyaki grilled chicken kabobs
steps:
1. In a 2-quart baking dish , combine all marinade ingredients
2. Cut chicken thighs in half
3. Add to marinade and cover
4. Refrigerating at least 2 hours , turning chicken once
5. Heat grill
6. Drain chicken , reserving marinade , alternately thread chicken , bell pepper , zucchini , and pineapple into four 12-inch metal or wooden skewers
7. When ready to grill , place kabobs on gas grill over medium heat or on charcoal grill 4-6 inches from med-high coals
8. Cook 15-20 minutes , or until chicken is no longer pink , turning often and brushing frequently with reserved marinade
9. Discard any remaining marinade

title: 1 2 3 healthy soup
steps:
1. Cook the soy beans as directed on package in the chicken stock
2. Once beans are cooked add all other ingredients to the borth and cook 15-20 minutes or until potatoes are cooked through
3. Once soup has cooled to room temperature puree the broth in a blender
4. Bon apetite

title: tasty avocado corn salsa
steps:
1. In medium bowl , mix first 5 ingredients of the salsa mixture
2. Mix dressing ingredients in blender or food processor
3. Pour dressing mixture over salsa mixture and toss lightly
4. Just before serving , add in avocado & toss again
5. Serve with "scoops" chips

title: pizza macaroni bake
steps:
1. In a skillet cook sausage , green pepper and onion over medium heat until meat is no longer pink , drain
2. Stir in the cooked macaroni , tomato sauce , 2 t parmesan cheese , water , oregano , and pepper
3. Transfer to a lightly greased 1-qt
4. Baking dish
5. Sprinkle with remaining cheese
6. Cover and bake for 25-30 minutes or until liquyid is absorbed and casserole is heated through
7. Use larger casserole dish for 4 servings , etc

title: frozen fudgesicles
steps:
1. Mix pudding mix , milk and syrup until blended
2. Add ice cream and mix well
3. Pour into ice cube trays / popsicle molds and freeze

title: quick and easy  chocolaty   creamy  hot cocoa
steps:
1. Mix all dry ingredients together in small , separate bowl
2. Fill milk in coffee-mug
3. Add cinnamon to milk , and heat to taste
4. After heated , stir until cinnamon is dissolved
5. After that , add dry ingredients , and stir
6. Finally , after all dry ingredients are stirred , add vanilla extract
7. To top it off , add some marshmallows !

title: slow cooker green beans and petite reds
steps:
1. Coat a 3 1 / 2 -4 quart slow cooker with cooking spray
2. In the prepared cooker combine green beans , quartered new potatoes , onion , water , 1 / 4 teaspoons salt and 1 / 4 teaspoons pepper
3. Cover and cook on low heat setting for 4 hours or on high high setting for 2 hours
4. Meanwhile , prepare sauce
5. In a small bowl , whisk together mayonnaise , sour cream , milk , mustard , lemon juice , tarragon , and 1 / 4 teaspoons salt
6. Cover and chill until needed
7. To serve , stir the sauce into mixture in slow cooker tossing until vegetables are coated
8. Sprinkle with additional pepper

title: basic green smoothie  raw food
steps: 1. Throw ingredients in blender and process until smooth

title: creamed potatoes as taught to me by my uncle
steps:
1. In large pot , boil peeled , and rinsed potatoes , diced with salt added to water
2. 15 to 20 minutes later , drain well and place in same pot
3. Beat on medium speed mixer until all lumps are gone from potatoes
4. Add butter and mix for a minute
5. Finally , add warmed milk slowly , over low fire , adding a little at a time until right consistency
6. Stir well over low fire just until hot once more

title: vegetarian mexican stuffed peppers
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400
2. Parboil halved bell peppers for 5 minutes
3. Saut onions and green peppers in skillet until heated thoroughly
4. Add cooked rice , drained black beans , and tomato sauce and cook for an additional 5 minutes
5. Remove from heat and stir in cup of cheese
6. Spoon mixture into pepper halves and then place in 9 x 13 glass baking dish
7. Pour hot water in the bottom of the dish and cover with aluminum foil
8. Bake for 30 minutes
9. Sprinkle with remaining cheese and bake uncovered for an additional 10 minutes

title: easy ravioli with bacon
steps:
1. Cook ravioli as directed on package
2. Meanwhile , cook milk , cream cheese , parmesan cheese and seasoning in large saucepan on medium heat 3 to 4 minutes or until cream cheese is melted and mixture is well blended , stirring frequently
3. Drain ravioli
4. Add to ingredients in saucepan along with the broccoli
5. Toss to coat
6. Cover
7. Reduce heat to medium-low
8. Cook 5 minutes or until heated through , stirring occasionally
9. Add onions and bacon
10. Stir
11. Cook an additional 2 minutes or until heated through , stirring occasionally

title: chicken and dumplings like cracker barrel s
steps:
1. Place chicken in a dutch oven
2. Add water and 2 teaspoons salt
3. Bring to a boil
4. Cover , reduce the heat , and simmer for 1 hour or until tender
5. Remove the chicken from the broth and cool
6. Bone the chicken and cut meat into bite-sized pieces
7. Bring the broth to a boil and add pepper
8. Combine the flour , baking soda , and salt
9. Cut in the shortening
10. Add the buttermilk , stirring with a fork until moistened
11. Knead the dough 4 to 5 times , and pat to 1 / 2-inch pieces and drop into boiling broth
12. Reduce the heat to medium-low , and cook for about 8 to 10 minutes , stirring occasionally
13. Stir in the chicken and serve
14. I make it in the pressure cooker , much quicker and easier
15. I pressure it for only 30 minutes
16. It can also be done in the crockpot with 3-4 cups water but someone has that book so at this time i cannot give cooking times
17. Good luck ! hope you enjoy

title: chicken hash with butternut squash
steps:
1. Heat potatoes and squash in saucepan with salted water , covered , to boiling
2. Simmer 4 minutes and drain
3. Heat 1 tbs butter in a skillet over med-high heat
4. Add onion and cook 5 minutes
