5. Add remaining butter and oil to skillet
6. Add potatoes , squash , chicken , tarragon , salt and pepper and cook 8-10 minutes , tossing frequently until nicely browned
7. Slowly pour cream around edge of skillet
8. Cook 6-8 minutes turning hash until crusty

title: hot jezebel
steps:
1. Mix first 5 ingredients together and pour over block of cream cheese
2. Serve with crackers
3. The flavors mellow if it is made the night before

title: cheesy garden casserole
steps:
1. Cook veggies in salted water until tender , 5-7 minutes
2. Drain
3. Put cooked rice in bottom of 9x13 baking dish
4. Place veggies over rice
5. Cover with marinara sauce
6. Cover with foil and bake 375f 30 minutes
7. Combine cheeses , spread over top
8. Place back in oven for 5 minutes or so , until cheese has melted

title: florentine rolls
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Grease 12 muffin cups and set aside
3. In a large skillet , heat 1 tablespoons oil and cook green onions and garlic until tender
4. Add spinach and basil
5. Cook and stir over medium heat until just wilted
6. Drain off excess liquid
7. Stir in salt and pepper
8. Set aside to cool
9. On a well-floured surface , unroll pizza dough and shape into a 12x8 rectangle
10. Brush surface of dough with remaining olive oil
11. Spread spinach mixture to within one inch of the edges of the dough
12. Sprinkle with feta and pine nuts
13. Starting with a long side , roll into a spiral
14. Slice roll into 12 pieces and place cut-side up in prepared muffin cups
15. Brush with butter and sprinkle with parmesan cheese
16. Bake for 18-20 minutes or until golden brown
17. Let stand in muffin cups for 2 minutes
18. Remove carefully and serve warm

title: hash brown quiche
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450
2. Gently press the drained hash browns between paper towels to dry them as best as possible
3. In a 9-inch pie plate , toss the hash browns with them melted butter into the plate
4. Press them into the bottom and up the sides to form a crust
5. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes until golden brown and starting to crisp
6. Meanwhile , in a large mixing bowl , combine the remaining ingredients
7. When the hash brown crust is ready pour the egg mixture over it and return to the oven
8. Lower the oven temperatures to 350 and bake for 30 minutes until the quiche is light golden brown on top and puffed

title: april s healthy snack mix
steps: 1. Combine and stir

title: lancashire potato cakes with chives garlic and cheese
steps:
1. Boil the potatoes until half cooked then add the onion and garlic into the pot
2. Mash together once potatoes are fully cooked
3. Stir in the rest of the ingredients to make a soft dough
4. It should not be sticky
5. Roll out onto a floured board until it is 1 / 2 inch thick and cut into round or triangle shapes
6. Cook 5-7 minutes on each side in a heavy based fry pan until golden brown
7. Serve immediately with plenty of butter

title: easy gingerbread
steps:
1. Set oeven to 350 degrees f
2. Set oven rack to second-lowest position
3. Grease and flour a 9-inch baking dish
4. In a bowl sift together flour , baking soda , spices and salt
5. In another bowl using an electric mixer beat oil and sugar until well combined
6. Beat in egg and molasses until well combined
7. Gradually add in flour mixture until combined
8. Add in hot water , beating until smooth
9. Transfer batter to prepared baking dish
10. Bake for about 40 minutes , or until cake tests done
11. Cool on pan for 10 minutes , then invert to a rack to cool
12. Serve with whipped cream

title: exhibition carrot cake
steps:
1. In bowl: combine and whisk together flour , baking soda , baking powder , salt , nutmeg , cinnamon and set aside
2. With electric mixer on low beat oil , sugar and eggs until combined , then beat on medium for two minutes
3. Stir in dry ingredients
4. Fold in grated carrots and raisins
5. Pour into greased 9 x 13 pan or two greased round cake pans
6. Bake 325 for 50 - 60 minutes
7. Cool 10 minutes and turn out on wire rack
8. When completely cooled ice with cream cheese icing: beat the cream cheese , butter , cream and vanilla until smooth
9. Add in icing sugar , more if necessary for desired consistency

title: pasta with zucchini ricotta sauce
steps:
1. Bring a large pot of water to a boil and salt it
2. Put olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat
3. When hot add zucchini , along with a large pinch of salt and a sprinkling of pepper
4. Cook , stirring occasionally , until zucchini begins to brown , then lower heat and cook until it is quite tender , about 15 minutes total
5. About 5 minutes before it is done , stir in garlic and begin to cook pasta
6. While pasta cooks , warm a serving bowl and put ricotta in it , along with about half the basil
7. When pasta is tender but not mushy , remove and drain it , reserving about a cup of its cooking liquid
8. Use as much of this liquid as necessary , a bit at a time , to thin ricotta until it reaches a saucy consistency
9. Toss with pasta , zucchini , remaining basil and parmesan , if you are using it , then taste and adjust seasoning
10. Serve

title: fahdreiteh chicken
steps:
1. Clean the chicken well and wipe dry
2. Prepare a marinade with the crushed garlic , paprika , sea salt , salt , oil and soy sauce
3. Let the mixture rest of 20 minutes
4. Place the chicken pieces in the marinade and turn to cover well
5. Cover the dish and place in the refrigerator for 24 hours
6. Bake uncovered for approximately one hour at 250 degrees celsius

title: cherry tomatoes with ginger dressing
steps:
1. Peel rind thinly from lemon using a vegetable peeler
2. Cut rind into thin strips
3. Combine rind and juice in small pan
4. Boil , covered for 2 minutes
5. Peel and cut ginger into wafer thin slices
6. Cut slices into thin strips
7. Combine rind mixture , ginger and remaining ingredients in a bowl
8. Mix well
9. Serve

title: grannydragon s pot roast in peach juice
steps:
1. Set the beef roast out to climatize to room temperature , at least 30 minute
2. Heat the oil in the pressure cooker , until it starts to smoke
3. Season the roast
4. Gently and carefully put the roast in to brown
5. Do not be in a hurry , let it brown really dark , but do not burn , this will bring out the best flavor
6. When the roast is browned nicely on both sides , throw in the onion and garlic
7. Put in enough peach juice to cover the roast
8. Put on the pressure cooker lid
9. When pressure begins to escape is the time to start your timer
10. 45 minutes should make the meat fork-tender
11. At the end of 45 minutes , remove the pressure cooker from the stove
12. Allow it to rest about 15 minutes
13. Then remove the valve , when all pressure is released , remove the lid
14. Place your roast on a platter and allow it to rest , before carving
15. Gravy:
16. While the cooked roast is resting , it is time to make the gravy
17. Make a slurry of the corn starch and cold water
18. Bring the pot liquid to the boil , stir the slurry once more and pour into the pot liquid , using a whip , lash it gently until it thickens , to an obedient gravy
19. This being a very simple step
20. Carve the meat
21. Serve with mashed potatoes

title: turkey tater tot casserole
steps:
1. Cook and drain the ground turkey and place it into a 2-quart casserole dish
2. Layer the green beans on top of the ground turkey
3. Spread the cream of mushroom soup on top of the green beans
4. Place the sliced cheese in a layer over the top of the soup
5. Scatter the tater tots over the top of the casserole , making sure to cover the surface
6. Cover with a lid and cook at 400f for 45 minutes or until the tater tots are browned

title: fried bread cookies
steps:
1. Cut crusts off of the bread and cut into 1 inch wide strips
2. Beat egg
3. Add egg to milk , salt , and sugar
4. Dip the bread strips into batter
5. Roll in chopped nuts
6. Deep fry until brown or bake in oven 15 minutes

title: teddy graham dip
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together and serve with teddy graham cookies for dipping- is delicious either chilled or room temperature !
2. I like to mix up three of the teddy flavors for variety- my choices being honey , chocolate , and chocolate chip
3. Yum !

title: the realtor s creamy dill salad dressing
steps: 1. Place the dressing ingredients in a container that has a tight-fitting lid and shake until well mixed

title: barley risotto with roasted vegetables
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Heat 1 teaspoon olive oil in a large saucepan over medium-high heat
3. Add onion and garlic
4. Saut 4 minutes or until browned
5. Add 3 cups broth and barley
6. Bring to a boil
7. Cover , reduce heat , and simmer 30 minutes or until liquid is absorbed and barley is al dente
8. Meanwhile , combine parsnip , carrots , cauliflower , broccoli , bell pepper , remaining 2 teaspoons olive oil , black pepper , seasoned salt , and chili powder on a jelly-roll pan coated with cooking spray , and toss well to coat
9. Bake at 400 for 20 minutes or until lightly browned , stirring after 10 minutes
10. Add the remaining 1 cup broth to the barley , 1 / 2 cup at a time , stirring constantly until each portion of broth is absorbed before adding the next
11. Stir in parsnip mixture and 1 / 3 cup cheese
12. Sprinkle with the remaining 1 / 3 cup cheese , pecans , and parsley

title: bean soup with sausage
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a large saucepan and add sausage
2. Cook over medium heat for 5 minutes until golden
3. Remove from sauce pan and set a side
4. Add leak , garlic , carrot and celery to the saucepan and cook for 5 minutes
5. Add flour and cook for 2 minutes
6. Add stock cubes and 1 1 / 2 liters of water
7. Bring to the boil reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes
8. Add pasta and beans and cook for 8 to 10 minutes until pasta is al dente
9. Return the sausage to the soup and season with salt and pepper to your taste

title: vegetarian borscht
steps:
1. Soak the dried mushrooms in 1 cup hot water for 15 minutes
2. Drain , reserving the liquid , and squeeze out the excess liquid
3. Strain all the soaking liquid through a fine-mesh sieve
4. Reserve the liquid and the mushrooms separately
5. In a tall narrow stockpot , heat the oil over medium heat
6. Stir in the fresh mushrooms and cook , stirring occasionally , for 4 minutes
7. Stir in the onion and cook , stirring occasionally , for 8 minutes
8. Add the beets , carrots , parsnip , celery root , 8 cups water , and the mushroom soaking liquid
9. Bring to a boil
10. Lower the heat and simmer for 5 minutes
11. Stir in the potatoes , cabbage , garlic , and , if using , the beet greens
12. Dissolve the tomato paste in 1 / 2 cup of the liquid and stir back into soup
13. Return to a boil
14. Lower the heat and simmer for 5 minutes
15. Stir in the reconstituted mushrooms and simmer for 5 minutes , or until all the vegetables are tender
16. Remove from the heat
17. Stir in the dill , sugar , vinegar , salt and pepper
18. Pass bowls of chopped dill and sour cream at the table and enjoy !

title: banana coffee cake with strawberry glaze
steps:
1. Cake
2. Preheat oven to 350
3. Spray an 8x8 inch cake pan with butter-flavored cooking spray
4. In a large bowl , combine baking mix , sugar , and nutmeg
5. Stir well to combine
6. In a smaller bowl , beat the egg slightly , stir in the sour cream , milk & vanilla
7. Make a well in the center of the dry ingredients
8. Pour in the liquid
9. Stir well to combine
10. Fold in mashed banana
11. Spread batter evenly into prepared cake pan
12. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
13. Cut into squares & serve warm or cold -- or with strawberry glaze and dust with powdered sugar , if you wish
14. Glaze: in small saucepan , combine mashed strawberries , powdered sugar
15. Cook over low heat , stirring constantly , until clear and slightly thickened
16. Cool
17. Pour glaze over cake
18. Chill

title: cabbage strudel
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. In a large skillet , melt 2 tablespoons butter
3. Add sugar and lemon juice and stir until sugar dissolves
4. Add cabbage , apple , onion , raisins and salt
5. Cook over medium high heat 7 to 10 minutes or until vegetables are tender , stirring occasionally
6. Drain
7. Add sour cream , mixing well
8. Lightly grease a cookie sheet
9. Place 1 phyllo sheet on that sheet
10. Brush with melted butter , sprinkle with about 2 teaspoons bread crumbs
11. Continue layering with 4 more sheets of phyllo , brushing each with butter and sprinkling with crumbs
12. Place cabbage mixture in a 2 inch wide strip 4 inches from the short side of phyllo shets , and 1 1 / 2 inches from long sides of phyllo
13. Fold 1 1 / 2 inch sides over cabage
14. Fold 4 inch side over cabbage and continue rolling up in jelly-roll fashion
15. Place cabbage roll seam side down
16. Brush with remaining butter
17. Bake for 30-35 minutes or until golden brown and crisp
18. Allow to stand 5 minutes before slicing

title: dilled carrots
steps:
1. In a small sauce pan combine chicken broth , sugar and salt
2. Bring to a boil
3. Add carrots and cover
4. Reducing heat to medium
5. Simmer until carrots are tender
6. Drain
7. Return carrots to pan and add the dill and butter
8. Toss until butter melts

title: lemon chive roasted vegetables
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees
2. Combine first 5 ingredients in a large bowl
3. Toss well to coat
4. Arrange vegetables in a single layer on 2 jelly roll pans coated with cooking spray
5. Bake for 30 minutes , turning after 15 minutes or until tender and lightly browned
6. Combine vegetables , chives and remaining ingredients in a large bowl
7. Toss gently to coat

title: gluten free buckwheat bread  machine
steps:
1. Place ingredients in bread machine in order , depending on manufacturer's recommendation
2. Choose basic cycle
3. Scrape down sides of bread bowl after kneading begins if the flour is sticking to the sides to incorporate all ingredients
4. Makes one large loaf

title: 20 minute mini meat loaves
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees
2. Line a rimmed baking sheet with foil
3. Whisk 2 / 3 cup salsa , 2 large eggs and 1 / 2 teaspoons salt in a large bowl to blend
4. Add onion , crushed tortilla chips , cheese , cilantro , chili powder and ground beef
5. Mix well using hands
6. Form into 5 inch long , 2 1 / 2 inch wide loaves on lined pan
7. Bake 20 minutes or until cooked through
8. Serve with sauce

title: chinese minced pork in lettuce cups
steps:
1. Cut lettuce ahead of time into cup shapes to have it ready
2. Choose leaves towards the center of the head of lettuce
3. Use kitchen shears to cut any shapes needed , if necessary
4. Set aside to chill
5. Saute pork in a large skillet until it is browned
6. Remove meat from skillet and drain off any fat
7. Add onions to skillet and cook for 5 minutes or until tender , then stir in garlic and ginger
8. Add wine and pork to the skillet and stir until wine reduces
9. Add hoisin , oyster and soy sauces , stirring to mix well
10. Stir in water chestnuts and cilantro and heat through
11. Place on platter and garnish with toasted pine nuts
12. Serve meat with lettuce cups

title: corn   sausage chowder
steps:
1. In a large sauce pan melt butter , stir in the flour and blend thoroughly
2. Cut the sausage into 1 / 4" slices and add to the sauce pan
3. Cook over medium heat for 5 minutes
4. Add the corn and potato soup
5. Stir in the milk and cheese
6. Turn back to a low heat and simmer for 35 minutes
7. Stir occasionally

title: homemade watermelon jelly
steps:
1. Prepare jars and lids by boiling in water for about 10 minutes
2. Using the red part of the watermelon , remove the seeds and cube
3. Place in a blender or food processor and blend well
4. The four cups of cubed watermelon should yield 2 cups of juice / puree , add or remove juice to equal 2 cups
5. At this point the juice can be strained , i don't strain my juice
6. Juice lemons to get 3 tablespoons , fresh squeezed is best
7. Bottled is not as good tasting but will work
8. Add the zest of one lemon to the lemon juice , the amount of zest is approximate for a lemon , set aside
9. The zest can be optional , so don't worry about it if you are using bottled lemon juice
10. In a separate container mix 1 / 2 cup of white granulated sugar with the package of dry no sugar pectin , i use 100% natural sure jell premium fruit pectin
11. Open another box , measure and add 1 tablespoon additional , mix sugar and pectin well , set aside
12. Measure out the other 3 cups of sugar in a separate container , and set it aside , close to the cooking area
13. Pour the 2 cups of watermelon juice / puree into a large stainless steel pot
14. Add 3 tablespoons of lemon juice and zest to the watermelon juice
15. Stir in the sugar pectin mixture and bring to a hard boil
16. The heat will be on medium high to high at this point
17. I like to use a whisk to constantly stir the mixture until it boils
18. Reaching the boiling stage should take between 5-10 minutes , keep stirring
19. Add the remaining 3 cups of sugar and bring back to a hard boil , stirring or whisking constantly for about 1-2 minutes
20. Remove from heat
21. Fill prepared jars about 1 / 4 inch from the top
22. Wipe the rim of jars and place lids and rings to the jars
23. Seal in prepared jars , approximately 1 / 2 pint jars , 1 / 4 pint jars , or pint jars
24. Place filled jars in a boiling hot water bath with about 1 inch of water covering the top of the jars
25. If you do not have a canner use a large stock pot with a towel in the bottom
26. Do not let the jars touch
27. Boil gently for about 10 minutes
28. Remove jars and set away from draft to cool
29. I place towel lined cookie sheet in the cold oven and let the jars cool in the oven with the door closed
30. Make sure that the jars have sealed before storing
31. The jelly is good for about 12 months , but is best the first 6 months
32. The color and consistency may change the longer it is stored
33. Use as you would with any other jelly , this is a great icing for a yellow cake
34. Optional: if you are making several batches and you want them a little different , add whole spices

title: kathy  1   chicken corn soup  zwt   asia
steps:
1. Finely chop chicken breast
2. Mix w / 1 egg white & 1 / 2 cup water
3. Set aside
4. Heat stock & next 5 ingredients
5. Add chicken mixture & bring to a boil
6. Add cornstarch mixed with 1 / 4 cup water
7. Slowly add beaten egg whites while stirring soup constantly
8. Add ham if desired & serve

title: easy cheddar walnut bread
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees
2. Lightly butter a 9" x 5" x 3" pan
3. In a food processor , combine the flours , mustard , salt , baking powder , baking soda and sugar
4. Pulse 2-3 times to blend
5. Add the butter and process for 10-15 seconds , or until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs
6. Set aside one tablespoon of the cheese and one tablespoon of the walnuts for the topping and add the rest to the food processor , pulsing 8-10 times to blend
7. Add the eggs and buttermilk and process for 10-20 seconds , or until a soft dough forms
8. Spoon into the prepared pan , smooth the top with a rubber spatula that has been dipped in buttermilk , and sprinkle the remaining cheese and walnuts over the top
9. Bake for 35-40 minutes or until a skewer inserted into the center comes out clean
10. Remove from the oven and let cool on a wire rack before slicing

title: overnight ice cream french toast with cinnamon banana syrup
steps:
1. Spread melted butter on baking sheet until well coated
2. Set aside
3. Whisk together ice cream , eggs , and 2 teaspoons cinnamon in large shallow bowl until well combined
4. Dip bread slices in mixture , allow to soak for a few seconds , then place on baking sheet
5. Cover bread and set in refrigerator overnight
6. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
7. Remove french toast from refrigerator and remove cover
8. Bake at 400 degrees f for about 10-15 minutes per side or until golden brown and slightly crispy
9. Meanwhile , place maple syrup , vanilla , 1 teaspoon cinnamon , and banana in microwave safe bowl
10. Microwave on high in 1 minute increments , stirring after each , until bananas are soft , about 3-5 minutes
11. Serve over french toast

title: linda s bean and mayonnaise sandwich  sandwiches
steps:
1. Put a generous amount of mayonnaise on both slices of bread
2. Add salt and pepper to taste , onto the mayonnaise
3. Put a generous amount of beans onto one slice of bread
4. Put top slice of bread onto sandwich , cut and eat
5. This is truly delicious
6. Try it !
7. You just might like it

title: pineapple spoon bread
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients until well blended
2. Put batter in a greased 8x8 or 9x9 baking dish
3. Bake at 350 degrees for 45-60 minutes

title: brown rice breakfast
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan , add the rice and tofy to a splash of oil and saute on medium-high heat until reasonably crisp
2. Toast bread and spread 1 tbsp of the mayonnaise on each slice
3. Spoon the rice and tofu on top of toast and then garnigh the way you like it
4. Eat and be happy

title: napa valley basil smoked burgers
steps:
1. Prepare a med-hot fire in a charcoal grill with a cover or preheat a gas grill to med-high
2. Make the mayonnaise: combine the mayo and pesto in a small bowl
3. Mix well
4. Cover and chill until needed
5. Make the burgers: in a large mixing bowl , combine the sirloin , zinfandel , basil , onion , bread crumbs , sun-dried tomatoes , and garlic salt
6. Handling the meat as little as possible to avoid compacting it , mix well
7. Divide the mixture into 6 equal portions and form the portions into patties to fit the rolls
8. When the grill is ready , brush the grill rack with vegetable oil
9. Toss the moistened basil sprigs directly onto the fire
10. Place the patties on the rack , cover , and cook 5-7 minutes on each side for medium
11. During the last few minutes of cooking , place the rolls , cut side down , on the outer edges of the grill to toast lightly
12. During the last minute of cooking , top each patty with a cheese slice
13. To assemble: spread the mayonnaise over the cut sides of the rolls
14. On each bottom roll , place a lettuce leaf , a patty , a tomato slice , an onion slice , and a basil sprig
15. Add roll tops and serve

title: sausage pineapple upside down bake
steps:
1. Pan fry sausage to desired doneness
2. Drain grease
3. Use a small amount of the grease to grease the bottom of a 9x13 baking dish
4. Spoon sausage over bottom to the dish and arrange the drained pineapple over it
5. Sprinkle brown sugar over all
6. Prepare corn bread or muffin mix as directed on box and spread over ingredients in dish
7. Bake at 400f for 25 to 30 minutes
8. Let stand for 5 minutes
9. Cut into serving pieces and drench with syrup

title: virginia crab imperial
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Beat eggs with mustard and pepper
3. Add crabmeat , pimento and 2 cups mayonnaise
4. Spoon the mixture into a 2 qt casserole and spread 1 / 4 cup mayonnaise over the top
5. Sprinkle with cheese
6. Bake for about 20 minutes or until brown and bubbly

title: mantini
steps:
1. Add all ingredients to a cocktail shaker filled with ice
2. Shake vigorously
3. Strain into a highball glass filled with ice

title: beer batter fried chicken
steps:
1. Rinse chicken
2. In a large saucepan , cover chicken with lightly salted water
3. Bring to boiling
4. Reduce heat
5. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes
6. Drain
7. Pat dry with paper towels
8. For batter , in a bowl combine bisquick mix , onion salt , garlic powder , and cayenne pepper
9. In another bowl stir together egg and beer
10. Add to bisquick mixture
11. Beat until smooth
12. Meanwhile , in a heavy 3 quart saucepan or deep fat fryer heat 1 1 / 4 inches of oil or shortening to 365 degrees
13. Dip chicken pieces , one at a time , into batter , gently shaking off excess batter
14. Carefully lower into the hot oil
15. Fry , two or three pieces at a time , for 2 to 3 minutes or until golden brown , turning once
16. Drain well on paper towels
17. Keep warm

title: holiday apple coffee cake
steps:
1. Cream crisco , sugar and vanilla thoroughly
2. Add eggs , one at a time , beating well after each addition
3. Sift flour with baking powder and soda
4. Add to cream mixture , alternately with sour cream , blending after each addition
5. Spread half of the batter in a 10-inch tube pan that has been greased and lined on the bottom with waxed paper
6. Cream butter , brown sugar and cinnamon together
7. Add apples and nuts
8. Mix well
9. Dot batter in pan evenly with half of the apple mixture
10. Cover with remaining batter
11. Then dot with remaining apple mixture
12. Bake in preheated-oven , 350 about 50 minutes
13. Cool cake 10 minutes before removing from pan

title: gnocchi  mark s recipe
steps:
1. Bring a large pot of water to the boil to poach your gnocchi
2. Choose potatoes of a similar size , and a pot just big enough to hold them so they don't bump around
3. Boil in salted water until just cooked through , then mash very well with the butter
4. Gradually add the flour , parmesan cheese and herbs , mixing very well
5. Add the eggs one at a time mixing well with each addition
6. Take about 1 / 4 th of the mixture , place on your well floured counter and gradually work and roll it out to a long sausage
7. It's very soft , so you'll be pushing rather than rolling
8. When your sausage is about 3 / 4 inch diameter , cut it into 1 inch lengths
9. Poach these pieces in the large pot of boiling water until the gnocchi all float to the top-about 2 minutes
10. Remove with a slotted spoon or spider , and plunge into the bowl of cold water
11. Drain
12. Repeat with the remaining mixture
13. Serve gently reheated in the sauce of your choice for a few minutes
14. These will keep for a few days , or freeze in a single layer and reheat really well after defrosting

title: the best low calorie cheesecake bites
steps:
1. In a small mixing bowl , beat together the cream cheese , sugar , and lemon juice until smooth and creamy , set aside
2. Using a paring knife , hollow out the top of each strawberry to a depth of approximately 3 / 4 an inch
3. Gently fill each with cream cheese mixture using a pastry bag just slightly above the tops
4. Place them on a cookie sheet as you do this
5. Once all of the strawberries are filled , dip each top into the graham cracker crumbs and place back onto the cookie sheet
6. Place the cookie sheet into the refrigerator and leave them for a few hours or over night to completely chill
7. Enjoy !

title: baked trout
steps:
1. Clean trout
2. Sprinkle inside with salt pepper
3. Place 6 strips of bacon on bottom of pan
4. Place fish on top of bacon
5. Lay 6 strips of bacon over the fish
6. Put a cover on the dish and bake at 250 degrees fahrenheit for 6 hours
7. At the end the bones will be soft like canned salmon
8. A 2 lb
9. Fish requires only 3 hours baking

title: zucchini and feta with penne
steps:
1. Cook the pasta according to the package directions , omitting salt or fat
2. While the pasta cooks , heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat
3. Add the oregano , zucchini and crushed garlic
4. Saute 3 minutes
5. Stir in the broth , rind , juice and pepper
6. Add the pasta and cheese
7. Toss well
8. Serve immediately

title: easy  guacamole dip
steps:
1. Peel and mash avocados in a flat bottom bowl
2. Add chopped tomatoes , chopped onions , and lime juice
3. Place garlic on a cutting board , add salt and blend together with a spoon , then add to rest of ingredients
4. Mix completely , cover and chill at least 1 hour
5. Serve with tortilla chips or fajitas

title: butterscotch white chocolate coconut muesli clusters
steps:
1. In a microwave safe bowl combine white chocolate chips and butterscotch chips
2. Melt them and stir until smooth
3. You can also do this over a warm water bath
4. Stir in muesli and coconut until everything is well coated
5. If you find that the mixture is too wet , simply add some more muesli by the tbs until it reaches a nice thick consistency
6. Drop by tabelspoonfuls onto a paper-lined baking sheet
7. Allow to dry for about 1 1 / 2 hours or until set
8. Enjoy

title: applesauce date nut bread
steps:
1. Mix the walnuts , dates , baking soda and salt in a medium bowl
2. Microwave the applesauce in a microswave safe bowl until heated through
3. Add shortening to the applesauce and stir until melted
4. Add applesauce mixture to walnut mixture and mix well
5. Let stand , loosely covered , for 20 minutes
6. Beat the eggs in a large mixing bowl using a fork
7. Add the vanilla , sugar and flour and mix well
8. The mixture will be very dry
9. Add the walnut mixture 1
10. 4 at a time , mixing gently after each addition
11. Do not overbeat
12. Spoon into a greased 9x5 loaf pan
13. Bake at 350 for 65 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean
14. Cool in the pan for 10 minutes
15. Invert onto a wire rack to cool completely
16. Wrap in foil and store for 8 to 12 hours before slicing

title: crunchy baby potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400f
2. Use a small sharp knife to cut thin slices into the potato , ensuring you don't cut all the way through
3. Place the potatoes in a bowl with the oil , salt and pepper and toss to coat
4. Place in a baking dish and roast for 35-40 minutes or until golden and crunchy

title: easiest cinnamon rolls ever
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Unroll pizza crust
3. Spread evenly with softened butter leaving 1 / 2 inch unbuttered at one end of long side
4. Sprinkle evenly with sugar and cinnamon
5. Sprinkle with nuts or raisins
6. Roll up dough long ways and pinch unbuttered edge to seal
7. Slice into 9 sections
8. Place in greased 9x9 inch pan
9. Bake for 15 minutes or until lightly browned and dough is no longer gooey

title: cherry teriyaki chicken
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients , except chicken breasts , and heat to simmering
2. Add chicken breasts and cook approximately 10 minutes on each side , or until cooked
3. Remove breasts and ginger slices
4. Thicken remaining sauce with cornstarch and pour over chicken

title: julgrot swedish rice pudding
steps:
1. In a heavy saucepan combine rice , butter and water and salt
2. Bring to boil and cook covered for 10 minutes , or until water is just absorbed
3. Add half-and-half and cinnamon stick to above
4. Bring to boil , stirring continuously
5. Let simmer , covered , for about 45 minutes
6. The half-and-half should be almost absorbed
7. The results should be creamy and tender , not mushy
8. Add the extra butter , and some cream for extra richness
9. Before serving , hide the almond in the porridge
10. Serve the porridge hot , with warm cream , cinnamon , and sugar
11. Whoever gets the almond will be married within the year !

title: custard yoghurt cake
steps:
1. Pre heat oven 180c
2. Grease standard cake tin
3. Beat butter , sugar and vanilla together with electric mixer
4. When pale and creamy add eggs and beat well
5. Fold in flour and custard powder alternately with yoghurt
6. Stir till smooth
7. Pour into tin , bake 25 - 35 minutes till golden
8. Allow to cool in pan

title: panzanella  italian bread salad
steps:
1. Heat broiler
2. Arrange bread on baking sheet lined with aluminum foil
3. Toast 4-6 inches from heat , turning once , until light golden
4. Tear into large pieces and drop into mixing bowl
5. Place half the bread in large salad bowl
6. Scatter half the cucumbers , peppers , and chives , then half the onions and olives over bread
7. Combine 1 / 4 cup oil , both vinegars , tomaotes , capers , garlic , salt , and pepper and spoon half over salad
8. Repeat layers with remaining ingredients
9. Stir once or twice but do not combine thoroughly
10. If bread seems dry , add oil
11. Refrigerate covered 1 hour to allow flavors to blend
12. About 20 minutes before serving , let panzanella warm to room temperature
13. Taste and adjust seasonings
14. Garnish salad with basil and serve with cruets of oil and vinegar

title: sweetcorn bake
steps:
1. Mix all the ingredients
2. Pour into a greased oven dish
3. Bake at 180 c for 1 hour

title: cheese popovers
steps:
1. Beat eggs , add milk , flour , salt and butter
2. Spoon 1 / 2 mix in muffin tin , add cheese to each cup then spoon the rest of the mixture over the cheese
3. Bake in a 400 degree oven for 50 minutes

title: regency ginger crisps
steps:
1. Do not preheat oven yet , dough must chill before baking
2. Melt butter and mix in sugar
3. Let mixture cool
4. Add egg
5. Add soda , molasses , salt and ginger
6. Stir thoroughly
7. Add flour and mix inches
8. Chill the dough for at least 1 hour
9. Once dough has chilled , preheat oven to 375 degrees , rack in middle position
10. Roll dough into walnut-sized balls ,
11. Roll dough in white sugar
12. Place cookie balls on greased cookie sheets , 12 to a standard sheet
13. Flatten them with a spatula
14. Bake at 375 degrees for 10-12 minutes or until nicely browned
15. Cool on cookie sheets for no more than 1 minute
16. Remove to wire rack to finish cooling
17. (if you leave these on the cookie sheets for too long , they will stick

title: edam cheese fritters
steps:
1. Bring the milk to almost boiling point with onion , bay leaf and cloves
2. Cover and allow to cool
3. Remove onion , bay leaf and cloves
4. Bring back to boiling point
5. Add semolina and stir over a medium / gentle heat until the mixture becomes stiff and difficult to stir
6. Remove from heat and stir in cheese and mustard
7. Pour into a greased dish and spread out to a thickness of about 1 - 1 and 1 / 2 cm
8. Allow to cool
9. Cut into squares
10. I find that it makes 12 squares
11. Dip into beaten egg and then roll in breadcrumbs
12. Fry gently in a good quality oil
13. I prefer virgin olive oil
14. Serve with a fresh green salad and mashed potatoes and tomato sauce or ketchup
15. Nb: the quantity of cheese can be adjusted
16. Reducing the amount of cheese and adding a couple of tbsps of parmesan works well

title: fiddlehead ferns with escargot butter
steps:
1. Wash fiddleheads and remove skins
2. Trim off the ends
3. If using fresh fiddleheads , cook in 4 quart rapidly
4. Boiling , salted water for 20 seconds
5. Refresh under
6. Cold water and drain
7. To prepare escargot butter , cream butter and gradually
8. Whisk in remaining ingredients
9. (recipe can be
10. Prepared ahead to this stage
11. ) just before serving ,
12. Melt escargot butter in a large frying pan over high
13. Heat
14. Add ferns , either cooked or canned (drained , if
15. Canned) and saute for 1 to 2 minutes , or until
16. Thoroughly heated

title: stuffed baked potatoes with horseradish cream
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Pierce potatoes with fork and bake 1 hour
3. Remove and cool , place on baking sheet
4. Slice skin away from top of each potato and carefully scoop out pulp , leaving 1 / 4 pulp in shell
5. Be care not to tear shells
6. Spoon pulp into mixing bowl and mash with 6 t sour cream , 6 t butter , 2 t horseradish , salt and pepper
7. Spoon into potato shells , return to oven and bake for 50 minutes
8. Combine topping ingredients , cover and chill until potatoes are done
9. When potatoes are done , remove from the oven , spoon topping on each and serve

title: strawberry pizza
steps:
1. Spray 15 x 11 pan with non stick cooking spray
2. Mix together margarine , flour , and sugar
3. Press flour mixture onto pan
4. Bake 10-15 minutes @ 350f , watching to see crust doesn't brown too much
5. Let cool
6. Cream cream cheese and sugar together
7. Fold in cool whip
8. Spread on crust
9. Clean berries and cut in half
10. Put berries on top of cream cheese layer
11. Cut into squares

title: farmer s chop suey  salad
steps:
1. Assemble dressing in a bowl by mixing cottage cheese , sour cream and salt
2. Wash the cucumber well and slice it
3. Salt the cucumber slices and place in a small bowl
4. Chill the dressing and cucumbers for 1 hour in the refrigerator
5. After chopping and slicing the veggies , drain any liquid from the cucumbers
6. Toss all veggies with the dressing , mixing well

title: hot artichoke seafood dip
steps:
1. Combine first 4 ingredients , mixing well
2. Spoon into a lightly greased 1 1 / 2 quart casserole
3. Top with breadcrumbs
4. Bake at 325 for 15 to 20 minutes
5. Serve with crackers

title: crab tartlettes
steps:
1. Heat olive oil in a pan
2. Add onion & cook for 5 minutes , or until softened but not brown , followed by garlic for another 30 seconds
3. Add a splash of wine & cook for 1 2 minutes , or until most of the wine has evaporated
4. Lightly whisk the eggs in a large bowl followed by the milk or cream
5. Add the crabmeat , cheese , parsley & the onion mixture
6. Season with nutmeg and salt & pepper to taste
7. Mix well
8. Carefully spoon the mixture into the tart shells , taking care not to overfill them
9. Bake in a preheated 375f oven for 25 30 minutes
10. Serve hot or at room temperature , garnished with fresh dill sprigs

title: 5 minute mug chocolate cake
steps:
1. Add dry ingredients to a coffee mug and mix well
2. Add the egg and mix thoroughly
3. Pour in the milk and oil and mix well
4. Add the chocolate chips and vanilla essence , mix again
5. Put your mug in the microwave and cook for 3 minuter at 1000 watts
6. The cake will rise over the top of the mug , but don't be alarmed !
7. Allow to cool a little and you can

title: egg cups
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f lightly oil a muffin tin with the olive oil
2. Line each cup in the muffin tin with two slices of ham , pressing to the sides
3. In a mixing bowl , beat the eggs and mix with the salt , garlic powder , pepper and onion powder
4. Sprinkle a little cheese in the bottom of each cup , then pour in a little egg
5. Do not fill the cup yet
6. Add a spoonfull of salsa to the egg cup , and layer more cheese and egg until each cup is full
7. Top with a little more cheese
8. Bake in the oven for 20 minutes , or until egg is firm

title: yummy oatmeal raisin cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Mix together margirane , sugar and egg
3. Add combined flour , cocoa , baking soda and cinnamon , mix well
4. Mix in raisins and and oats
5. Drop by tablespoons on greased cookie sheet
6. Then put in oven for 10-14 minutes
7. Cool on cooling rack for 5 minutes

title: chewy coconut squares
steps:
1. Preheat in 350 degree oven
2. Cream butter and 1 / 4 cup sugar till light and fluffy
3. Stir in 1 / 2 cup flour
4. Put in greased 8 x 8"pan and bake at 350 degrees for 10 minutes
5. Meanwhile , mix remaining 1 / 2 cup sugar , 2 tbsps
6. Flour , salt , vanilla , egg , nuts and coconut
7. Spread evenly over baked dough
8. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or till golden
9. While warm , cut into squares

title: moo goo gai pan iii
steps:
1. Combine the sauce ingredients
2. Hot wok , add 2 tablespoons oil , swirl
3. Add the chicken , stirfry 3 minutes
4. Add green onions and garlic
5. Cook 1 / 2 minutes
6. Remove and set aside
7. Scrap wok clean and reheat
8. Add 2 tablespoons oil
9. Swirl
10. Add vegetables and stir fry 2 minutes
11. Add 2 tablespoons water , cover and steam 2 minutes
12. Push the vegetables to the sides of the wok
13. Stir sauce and pour into the center of the wok
14. Stir sauce until it's thick and bubbly
15. Return the chicken and mix with the vegetables and sauce
16. Stir a bit until hot
17. Serve with rice

title: sand tarts
steps:
1. Cream butter until soft
2. Add sugar , pecans , and flour , mixing well
3. Shape into balls and bake at 300 degrees on ungreased cookie sheet for 45 minutes
4. While hot , roll balls in powdered sugar
5. Roll in sugar again after all have been rolled once

title: zucchini bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Mix all ingredients
3. Place in a 9-by-13-inch pan
4. Bake for 25 to 35 minutes

title: banana pops   a healthy  fun  kid snack
steps:
1. Peel banana and cut in half
2. Stick on popsicle sticks
3. Spread peanut butter on each half of the banana , and then roll in whatever your fourth igredient was
4. Freeze for 3 hours , and then enjoy !

title: antipasticks
steps:
1. Skewer tomatoes , basil and cheese
2. Drizzle lightly with oil and add salt and pepper to taste

title: marinated broccoli florets
steps:
1. Cut fresh broccoli florets until they are small bite sized pieces
2. Toss with onion slices , raisins , sunflower seeds and bacon crumbles
3. Combine mayonnaise and cream with sugar and lemon juice
4. Pour over broccoli mixture
5. Cover in refrigerator for at least 24 hours
6. Delicious !

title: seafood pizza
steps:
1. Mussels: scrub and debeard
2. Sun dried tomatoes: not packed in oil
3. Garlic and shallots: mince
4. Canned crushed tomatoes: with puree added

6. Peel
7. Devein
8. Cut in half lengthwise

14. Throw out unopened ones

17. Stir over med high heat until sauce is thick
18. Remove mussels from shells and discard shells
19. Place mussels in small bowl

21. Add shrimp and scallops and cook until almost cooked through

26. Place crust on large baking sheet
27. Brush with garlic oil
28. Bake until golden brown and crust edges begin to crisp

31. Spoon over crust

33. Bake until shrimp and scallops are cooked through and mozzarella melt
34. Transfer to cutting board

36. Cut

title: carrot potato pancakes
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine all the ingredients
2. Lightly spray a nonstick skillet with nonstick cooking spray
3. Turn on the heat
4. Drop potato mixture by 1 / 4 cup measures into the skillet , flattening the pancakes with a spoon , if necessary
5. Fry until lightly browned on one side , about 3 minutes
6. Turn over and fry on the other side another 3 minutes
7. Drain on paper towels
8. Serve warm

title: chocolate sorbet
steps:
1. To make the syrup
2. Run the paring knife down the center of the vanilla bean
3. Split it open with your fingers and use the knife to scrape out the tiny black seeds into a heavy-bottomed sauce pan
4. Add 2 1 / 4 cup water , the sugar , the corn syrup and the vanilla pod and bring it to a rolling boil over medium high heat
5. Remove from heat and allow the bean to steep for 15 minutes
6. Remove the pod , dry it , and save it for another use
7. If you are using vanilla extract , add it after the syrup has been removed from the heat
8. Prepare the chocolate
9. Combine the chopped chocolate and cocoa powder in a medium-sized bowl
10. Gently whisk in 1 / 3 of the hot vanilla syrup
11. Whisk in the remaining syrup , in two more parts , and continue to whisk until the sauce is shiny , thick , and smooth , about 4 minutes
12. Pass the chocolate sorbet base through a fine-mesh strainer to remove any lumps of cocoa powder
13. Place the sorbet in an ice bath to cool completely
14. Transfer to the refrigerator for a minimum of 4 hours or up to 1 week
15. Churn the sorbet
16. Churn the sorbet in an ice cream machine according to the machine manufacturers directions
17. The sorbet is finished once it has increased in volume and it holds whisk lines from the stirring mechanism and mounds like softly whipped cream
18. Transfer to the freezer for 4 hours to attain scoopable consistency

title: dutch oven pork chops and potatoes
steps:
1. Trim some fat from chops
2. Place fat in dutch-oven
3. Over medium heat
4. Cook fat until light brown
5. Using spoon press and rub fat over bottom of dutch oven
6. Discard extra fat
7. Add chops and cook until browned on both sides
8. Remove chops and set aside
9. In remaining fat cook potatoes , carrots and onions until lightly browned
10. Stirring occasionally
11. Adding salad oil if necessary
12. Return chops to dutch oven
13. Arranging vegetables over and around chops
14. Stir in tomatoes with there liquid and remaining ingredients except peas
15. Heat to boiling
16. Reduce heat to low
17. Cover and simmer 45 minutes or until chops and potatoes are tender
18. Add peas and heat threw

title: sheep dip  sheep dip
steps:
1. In the bowl of a food processor combine the cheeses and process until smooth
2. Add the brandy and puree
3. Fold in the green onions , pine nuts , and dill and continue to fold until the mixture is well blended
4. Spoon into a 2-cup decorative serving bowl
5. Cover and chill at least 2 hours
6. Serve with french bread , crackers or crisp breads

title: vanilla custard sauce
steps:
1. Place half and half in heavy medium saucepan
2. Scrape in seeds from vanilla bean
3. Add bean
4. Bring to simmer
5. Remove from heat , cover , and let steep 30 minutes
6. Whisk yolks and sugar in medium bowl until thick
7. Whisk half and half with vanilla bean into yolk mixture 1 tbls at a time until the eggs warm up to prevent cooking
8. Return mixture to same saucepan
9. Stir custard over low heat until thickened enough to leave path on back of spoon when finger is drawn across , about 6 minutes
10. Pour into bowl
11. Chill uncovered until cold , about 2 hours
12. Then cover and chill until you use it , can be made 1 day ahead
13. Cover
14. Chill
15. Remove vanilla bean before using - you can rinse dry it and add it to a jar of sugar for vanilla sugar

title: pasta with mushroom tomato sauce
steps:
1. Wash and chop mushrooms
2. Heat oil in a skillet , add scallions and mushrooms and cook 5 minutes , stirring occasionally
3. Add flour and cook for 2 minutes , stirring constantly
4. Slowly stir in milk and tomatoes and cook until it makes a smooth sauce
5. Stir in parsley , salt , and pepper
6. Cook the pasta and drain
7. Toss pasta and sauce

title: apple   carrot casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Cook carrots in boiling water 5 minutes or until tender
3. Drain
4. Layer carrots and apples in lge casserole
5. Mix flour , brown sugar and nutmeg in small bowl
6. Sprinkle over carrots and apples
7. Dot with margarine and add orange juice and sprinkle with salt
8. Bake 30 minutes or until apples are tender

title: the u bomb burger
steps:
1. Mix the fish sauce , sugar , pepper and garlic in with the ground beef and let it sit for about half an hour
2. Meanwhile , preheat the bbq to medium high
3. Form the ground meat into patties and put them on the grill
4. Grill until the burgers are cooked through
5. Layer your burger with your various umami ingredients: mushrooms , cheese , burger , bacon and veggies and enjoy
6. This is a very tasty recipe
7. Fast , easy and everyone loved the burgers
8. 'just like umami used to make
9. '
10. Trust me on this: you cannot taste the fish sauce
11. The burger just tastes -- 'better'
12. Not fishy , not vietnamese , just better
13. Try it - you'll like it

title: cod with peppercorns and leeks  ww 5 points plus
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375f
2. Rub peppercorns and fennel seeds onto both sides of the fillets and set aside
3. Heat oil in large ovenproof skillet over medium heat
4. Add leeks , scallions , and garlic and saut 4 minutes or until tender
5. Stir in the flour and cook for 1 minute
6. Stir in the wine , broth , and milk and bring to a boil
7. Remove from heat
8. Top leek mixture in the skillet with cod fillets and bake for 10 minutes , or until the fish flakes easily
9. Serve the fish topped with the leek mixture

title: honey garlic meatballs
steps:
1. In a bowl , whisk together the egg , onion , red pepper , bread crumbs , soy sauce , worcestershire sauce and pepper , then mix in the beef
2. Roll by rounded tablespoonfuls into balls and place on a greased rimmed baking sheet
3. Bake in a 450 degree f oven until no longer pink inside , about 20 minutes
4. Meanwhile , in a large skillet , whisk the beef stock , garlic , honey , diluted flour and hot pepper sauce
5. Cook , whisking , over medium heat until thickened , 2 minutes
6. Add the meatballs and any accumulated juices to the pan , stirring to coat

title: campbell s creamy mushroom chicken
steps:
1. In large skillet , melt 1 tbsp butter and brown the chicken pieces
2. Season to taste with garlic salt and paprika
3. Remove from pan and keep warm
4. Add remaining 1 tbsp butter to pan and saute onion , garlic and mushrooms until golden
5. Add soup , milk and pepper
6. Bring to a boil
7. Return chicken to the pan , reduce heat to low and simmer 5 minutes or til chicken is heated through and no longer pink inside
8. Serve over egg noodles

title: heston blumenthal s chips  french fries
steps:
1. Cut the potatoes into chips / french fries about 1 / 2 inch thick , and when finished , put them in a bowl of cold water for 10 minutes
2. Even before you've finished the cutting , put a large pot of water on to boil
3. Add the potato chips and bring to the boil again , simmering until just , just cooked through
4. You'll have to test - you don't want them falling apart
5. With a slotted spoon , lift them out and put the chips on a rack or grid on a baking tray or flat-bottomed oven dish which will fit into your fridge
6. They're supposed to dry off , not lie in some leftover water
7. Cool in the fridge
8. Heat the oil to 250 deg
9. F , and plunge in the cold chips
10. Fry , but don't let them colour
11. Drain and cool again in the fridge
12. When completely cooled , fry them for the final time , until golden brown , in oil measuring 375 deg f
13. Drain and season when serving
14. Heston , being very scientific , first tested various types of potatoes
15. The one he prefers is not easily available , so he suggested maris piper in britain
16. It seems it should be the kind of potato which tends to "flake" when cooked , as they make the crispiest french fries and roast potatoes

title: raspberry streusel bars
steps:
1. Adjust oven rack to middle position
2. Heat oven to 375 degrees
3. Cut 18-inch length foil and fold lengthwise to 8-inch width
4. Fit foil into length of 13 by 9-inch baking dish , pushing it into corners and up sides of pan
5. Allow excess to overhang pan edges
6. Cut 14-inch length foil and fit into width of baking pan in same manner , perpendicular to first sheet
7. Spray foil-lined pan with nonstick cooking spray
8. In bowl of standing mixer fitted with flat beater , mix flour , granulated sugar , and salt at low speed until combined , about 5 seconds
9. With machine on low , add 16 tablespoons butter one piece at a time
10. Then continue mixing on low until mixture resembles damp sand , 1 to 1 1 / 2 minutes
11. Measure 1 1 / 4 cups flour mixture into medium bowl and set aside
12. Distribute remaining flour mixture evenly in bottom of prepared baking pan
13. Using hands or flat-bottomed measuring cup , firmly press mixture into even layer to form bottom crust
14. Bake until edges begin to brown , 14 to 18 minutes
15. While crust is baking , add brown sugar , oats , and nuts to reserved flour mixture
16. Toss to combine
17. Work in remaining 2 tablespoons butter by rubbing mixture between fingers until butter is fully incorporated
18. Pinch mixture with fingers to create hazelnut-sized clumps
19. Set streusel aside
20. Combine preserves , raspberries , and lemon juice in small bowl
21. Mash with fork until combined but some berry pieces remain
22. Spread filling evenly over hot crust
23. Sprinkle streusel topping evenly over filling
24. Return pan to oven and bake until topping is deep golden brown and filling is bubbling , 22 to 25 minutes
25. Cool to room temperature on wire rack , 1 to 2 hours
26. Remove from baking pan by lifting foil extensions
27. Using chef's knife , cut into squares and serve

title: green beans with mushroom cream
steps:
1. Place a large covered pot of lightly salted water on the stove and bring it to a boil
2. In the meantime , melt butter in a small skillet , increase heat to high , add mushrooms and stir fry until golden brown
3. Reduce heat to low , add garlic and cook 1 minute
4. Add cream , salt and pepper and heat through on low
5. Add beans to boiling water and cook until just tender , drain
6. Place beans on a serving plate , spoon the mushroom cream across the middle of the beans , sprinkle with parmesan and parsley and serve

title: banana bread  egg free
steps:
1. Mash the bananas , sugar and vanilla together
2. Sift the flour , baking powder and soda together
3. Mix the liquid with the dry and pour into a 7
4. 5 x 3
5. 5 x 2 inch loaf pan
6. Put into a preheated oven at 350f for one hour

title: margarita   on the rocks
steps:
1. Shake above on ice and strain over tumbler filled with fresh ice
2. If you want salted rims: rub the rim of the glass with triple sec or the cut lemon and dip into margarita salt
3. If i am making more than two in the shaker , i reduce the lemon juice slightly

title: lemon spaghetti from giada
steps:
1. Cook the pasta in a large pot of boiling salted water until tender , about 8 minutes
2. Meanwhile , whisk the oil , parmesan , and lemon juice in a large bowl to blend
3. Drain the pasta , reserving 1 cup of the cooking liquid
4. Toss the pasta with the lemon sauce , and the reserved cooking liquid , adding 1 / 4 cup at a time as needed to moisten
5. Season with salt and pepper
6. Garnish with lemon zest and chopped basil

title: amazing overnight french toast
steps:
1. Over medium heat , bring corn syrup , brown sugar and butter to a boil
2. Boil 5 minutes and pour into a greased 13 x 9 baking pan
3. Cut or tear all of the bread and place in the pan , set aside
4. Beat eggs , milk and vanilla and pour over bread
5. Cover and refrigerate overnight
6. Uncover and bake at 350 for 45 minutes

title: bacon and brown sugar braised collard greens
steps:
1. Cook bacon in a dutch oven over medium-high heat until crisp
2. Remove bacon from pan , reserving drippings in pan
3. Crumble bacon
4. Set aside
5. Add onion and garlic to drippings in pan
6. Cook over medium heat 5 minutes or until tender , stirring occasionally
7. Stir in crumbled bacon , 2 cups water , and next 4 ingredients
8. Gradually add greens
9. Cover , reduce heat , and simmer 1 hour or until tender

title: zucchini soup
steps:
1. In a large saucepan or stockpot , cook zucchini , carrots , onions in chicken broth about 20 minutes or until vegetables are tender
2. Transfer to a blender or food processor in small batches
3. Blend well
4. Add cream cheese a little at a time and continue blending until cream cheese is melted
5. Adjust seasonings to taste and serve hot or cold
6. Garnish with shredded zucchini and caramelized onions

title: italian sausage   noodle stew
steps:
1. In a dutch over , cook sausage over medium heat until no longer pink
2. Add tomatoes , beef broth , beans , water , tomato paste , rosermary and garlic salt
3. Bring to a boil , reduce heat and cook 15 minutes
4. Add frozen vegetables , cook according to package directions or until tender
5. Add noodles and cook until heated through
6. Serve in soup bowls topped with parmesan cheese

title: wild and white rice with cherries  apricots  and pecans
steps:
1. In a 3 1 / 2- or 4-quart electric slow cooker , mix together the white rice , wild rice , broth , water , sherry , onion , garlic powder , and garlic pepper
2. Cover and cook on the low heat setting about 5 hours , or until the rices are tender but not mushy
3. Stir in the apricots , cherries , pecans , and parsley
4. Serve immediately

title: raisin farfel kugel  passover friendly
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Grease an 8x8 inch baking dish
3. Soak farfel in water 10 minutes
4. Drain
5. Add beaten eggs into the bowl of farfel , and let stand 10 minutes
6. Stir in raisins , salt , sugar , cinnamon , and butter
7. Transfer mixture to prepared dish
8. Bake at 350 degrees f for 50 to 60 minutes

title: comfort able kamikaze
steps:
1. Shake for 15 seconds
2. Serve straight up or on the rocks , whichever you prefer

title: macaroni and cheese stir fry
steps:
1. Cook the macaroni according to package directions
2. Drain well and set aside
3. Cook the peas according to package directions
4. Drain well and set aside
5. Melt 2 tbsp butter in a large dutch oven or wok
6. Add the chicken , garlic , and bouillon granules
7. Stir fry for 5 to 7 minutes , or until the chicken is lightly browned
8. Remove the chicken and set aside
9. Add the remaining 2 tbsp butter , broccoli , onion , red bell pepper , carrots , tarragon , and lemon-pepper
10. Stir fry for 1 minute
11. Cover and cook until the broccoli is tender
12. Stir in reserved macaroni , peas , chicken , and cook until thoroughly heated
13. Combine flour and 1 tbsp milk
14. Stir until it is smooth
15. Gradually add the remaining milk , stirring until blended
16. Add the milk mixture to the macaroni mixture
17. Cook 1 minute , stirring constantly
18. Add the cheese
19. Cook , stirring constantly , until the cheese melts
20. Serve immediately

title: very easy peach cobbler
steps:
1. Flour mixture will cook through the fruit making its own crust
2. If using blueberries and there isn't enough juice , put berries in pan and add 1 / 4 cup to 1 / 2 cup of water and cook slowly
3. In baking dish put peaches in juices first spreading evenly across dish
4. Put flour , sugar and milk in a bowl but do not mix
5. Pour over top of peaches
6. Slice butter and put butter slices all over the top
7. Bake at 350 for 25 to 30 minutes

title: vanilla coffee flan
steps:
1. Boil coffee grounds in 1 1 / 2 cups of water
2. Remove from heat and let sit for 10 minutes
3. Bring milk and half& half to a heat where whisps of steam is just rising from the top
4. Strain coffee liquid through a coffee filter into a cup and then add 3 / 4 of a cup to the milk mixture and heat through
5. In a separate bowl whisk together eggs , sugar , and salt
6. Slowly add milk mixture to the bowl with the eggs , while whisking steadily
7. Pour 1 tbsp of caramel into 6 buttered 6 oz
8. Ramekins , then pour mixture into the ramekins , and put into a large high-walled pan
9. Fill pan with water and bake at 325 for 1 hour , then increase heat to 375 for an additional 20 minutes
10. Remove ramekins from oven and pan and refrigerate for at least 4 hours
11. Use a flexible knife to remove from ramekins and flip over onto small plates for serving

title: d s asian coleslaw
steps:
1. Whisk the mayonnaise , lime juice , vinegar , and sesame oil togethrt until smooth
2. Mix the slaw , cilantro , green onions and cuke together and toss with dressing and refrigerate
3. Toss again before serving

title: irish potato brown bread  bread machine
steps:
1. Add the ingredients to the pan according to the order in the manufacturer's instructions

3. Press start

5. Let cool to room temperature before slicing

3. In a heavy-bottomed saucepan combine the cranberries , the honey , the brown sugar , the cinnamon sticks , the cloves , the nutmeg , fresh grated ginger , orange zest and orange juice

title: chicken salad   barb koffman
steps:
1. In a bowl combine all ingredients except tomatoes and lettuce
2. Cover with plastice wrap & put into fridge for at least 1 hour
3. Cut tomatoes into wedges & place on top of lettuce
4. Fill each with chicken salad

steps:
1. Cook brown rice according to package directions and set aside
2. Chop , onion , celery , carrot and mince garlic
3. Place olive oil in a large skillet and heat over medium-high
4. Add the onion , garlic , carrot , and celery and stir to combine
5. Continue to stir until vegetables are tender and aromatic
6. About 5 minutes
7. Add the cooked brown rice to the skillet and stir well to combine all ingredients
8. Continue to heat until rice is hot
9. Add the grated cheese and sunflower seeds and stir until cheese is melted and everything is well mixed

title: ginger chicken soup
steps:
1. Take the onion , garlic , scallions , shallots , p lemon juice
2. Sweat in the butter and olive oil
3. Place in chicken pieces and stock and bring to a boil
4. Reduce heat and add salt and pepper

2. Allow them to steep for awhile
3. Remove tea bags and add 4 cups of apple juice to the tea
4. Chill and serve with ice if desired
5. Garnish with lemon slices for an extra touch

1. You can always use frozen potatoes , canned beef gravy , and canned cheese sauce but it will be much better if you don't go that route and actually use the home-made stuff
2. To assemble: place steak fries on an oblong plate , cover with beef gravy and cheese sauce
3. Give everyone a fork and knife and let them eat right off the platter
4. It's great fun ! (:

title: couscous with pine nuts
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan over high heat , bring broth and oil to a boil
2. Stir in couscous in a stream
3. Add in green onion
4. Remove pan from heat , cover
5. Let stand 5 minutes
6. Add pine nuts , parsley , mint , lemon juice , and butter
7. Season to taste with salt and pepper
8. Fluff with a fork
9. Serve immediately

title: baked cheesy eggs with leeks and tarragon
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 375
2. Lightly grease / spray a 13x9-inch baking dish
3. In a skillet over medium heat , melt the butter
4. Saut the chopped leeks until they are tender
5. Place sauted leeks into the bottom of the prepared baking dish
6. Evenly sprinkle 1 cup only of havarti and the parmesan cheese over the leeks
7. In a mixing bowl , combine the eggs , cream , tarragon , salt , pepper and paprika
8. Whisk until well beaten
9. Pour the egg mixture into the baking dish over the cheese layer
10. Bake at 375 for 30 minutes or until set and lightly browned
11. Sprinkle with remaining 1 / 2 cup havarti and bake an additional 5 minutes or until cheese is melted

title: apple pie fudge
steps:
1. Combine the first four ingredients , bring to a boil
2. Stir constantly because the mixture burns easily
3. Remove from heat
4. Add: marshmallow cream , vanilla and powdered sugar and apple pie spice , blend well
5. Pour into greased pan
6. Use an 8 or 9 inch square pan for a thick fudge or a 13x9 inch pan if you like it a little thinner
7. Add nuts if desired
8. Cool , cut into squares

title: penne with sausage  mushrooms and red wine
steps:
1. Remove casing from sausage and crumble it
2. Cook in a medium skillet until browned and no trace of pink remains , 6-7 minutes
3. Transfer to plate lined with paper towels to drain
4. Cook penne as directed
5. Wipe skillet clean , return to medium heat and add oil
6. Saute the onions and garlic until the onions are translucent , about 5 minutes
7. Add the mushrooms , herbs if desired , salt and pepper and cook , stirring occasionally , until the mushrooms are lightly brown
8. Add the wine and bring to a boil
9. Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer , uncovered , until reduced by a little more than half , about 10 minutes
10. Add tomatoes and some of their juice or the pasta sauce and simmer for 8-10 minutes
11. Add the reserved sausage and heat through
12. Taste and adjust seasoning accordingly
13. Drain the pasta and , if desired , return it to the pot , add the sauce and return to low heat for 2-3 minutes
14. Pass the cheese on the side

title: coppertone  rum   coke        sort of
steps:
1. Pour 1 part rum into glass with ice
2. Add 3 parts cherry coke
3. Squeeze the lime and drop into as garnish

title: nigella lawson pea  mint and avocado salad
steps:
1. First make the dressing: put the oil and vinegar and a pinch of sugar into a large bowl and then put in a decent handful of chopped mint
2. Stir well so all is amalgamated
3. Cook the podded peas for a short time in salted boiling water , just so they are ready , but not soft
4. Taste after 2 minutes and then keep tasting
5. Pour peas in colander and then straight away into the bowl of dressing and let steep for an hour or up to a day
6. Just before serving , stir in about a packetful of mixed salad , the chicory which has been separated into it leaves and the avocado , which should be cut into bite size chunky slices
7. You may need to drizzle a bit more oil after tossing
8. Serve this on a big plate
9. Sprinkle with more mint

title: salata pataton   greek potato salad
steps:
1. Wash the potatoes well and drop them in boiling water in their jackets for about 15-20 minutes
2. When done , remove with a slotted spoon and allow to cool
3. Peel , cut into wedges in bowl , add the parsley and mint and mix well
4. In another bowl , mix the olive oil , lemon juice and zest , liqueur , pepper and a little salt , beating with a whisk
5. Pour over the potatoes

title: mango pineapple ice cream    no machine needed
steps:
1. Cut and smash up mango until its in a coarse pulp
2. In a bowl combine the milks and add a few drops of the food coloring to give it a very light orange color
3. One to two drops should be enough
4. Drain pineapple well , add pineapple and mango to bowl with milks and stir well with a large spoon
5. Fold in whipped cream until well incorporated , the whip cream will dissolve some in the mixture
6. Pour into a large plastic container and freeze for at least 6 hours but more may be needed depending on temperature of freezer

title: garlic   parsley new potatoes
steps:
1. Scrub the potatoes well
2. Pare a 3 / 4" strip around the middle of each potato
3. Place potatoes in a saucepan , cover with water and bring to a boil
4. Simmer covered for about 20 minutes or until tender
5. Drain potatoes and place them in a bowl add two teaspoons of oil& toss
6. In a non stick frypan add the remaining oil over medium heat
7. Add garlic , cook approximately 1 minute
8. Add parsley , salt& pepper , mix well
9. Add potatoes , reduce heat to low and cook stirring constantly for 1 or 2 minutes
10. Serve

title: lighter chocolate covered strawberries
steps:
1. Insert toothpicks into the tops of the strawberries
2. In a double boiler , melt the chocolate and oil , stirring occasionally until smooth
3. Holding them by the toothpicks , dip the strawberries halfway into the chocolate mixture
4. Do not completely cover strawberries
5. Place on a cookie sheet and let strawberries chill and set in refrigerator until ready to serve

title: new york gazpacho
steps:
1. Add all the vegetable ingredients together in a large bowl
2. Sprinkle the salt and black pepper atop
3. Add the red wine vinegar and olive oil
4. Mix about so that all the liquids on the bottom get to the top
5. Chill in fridge for 15 to 30 minutes

title: chicken style seitan
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Line a 8 inch square pan with parchment paper making sure the sides are 2 inches high
3. Heat 1 tbsp oil in heavy skillet over med
4. Add onion and garlic and saute until tender
5. Set aside
6. Stir flours , yeast and salt in large bowl
7. Puree the beans with 1 / 2 cup canola oil , tamari and onions in blender until smooth adding water to make a smooth creamy bean puree then whisk remaining water into puree in bowl
8. Quickly stir bean into flour until you have a wet dough
9. Transfer to pan and smooth
10. Cover with foil
11. Place this in a water bath
12. Put pan in larger pan and add enough water to come up halfway on sides
13. This is to ensure even cooking
14. Bake for 2 hours or until seitan is firm on top
15. Add water to pan if needed to maintain half level
16. Cool seitan to room temperature quarter
17. You should have four 1 pound squares
18. Keep covered and refrigerated for up to two days
19. Frozen: wrap separately in plastic and place in resealable bag
20. Keeps one week

title: flourless apple caramel cake  5   hour cook time
steps:
1. Slice all peeled and cored apples thinly
2. Keep each apples quantity separated for assembly
3. In a heavy saucepan over medium heat , bring 1 cup of sugar and the water to a simmer , scraping the sides down to dissolve all sugar granules
4. Simmer the syrup for 8 minutes , swirling the pan and wiping down the sides to ensure even browning
5. Pour caramel into a 2-quart ceramic souffl pan , swirling the caramel around the bottom and up the sides of the dish
6. Allow the caramel to cool , and harden , in the dish for 10 minutes
7. Preheat oven to 250
8. Arrange a layer of apples on the caramel in overlapping circles , using one apples quantity
9. Sprinkle this layer with 1 teaspoon of sugar and some orange zest
10. Repeat apple , sugar / zest layering for all 10 layers
11. They will overflow the pan
12. This is okay
13. Place the foil covered pan into a bano maria
14. Bake 5 hours
15. A skewer inserted should come out clean
16. Allow the cake to cool completely , then refrigerate for 2 hours
17. Loosen the cake from the pan by warming it in hot water before placing the serving plate over the top and inverting the cake
18. Serve by cutting into 6-8 wedges and plating each with orange segments and whipped cream , if desired

title: eve s addiction   a warm fall and winter cocktail
steps:
1. Place allspice , peppercorns , cloves , coriander , and cinnamon in a medium saucepan
2. Cook , stirring , over medium heat until fragrant , about 2 minutes
3. Stir in apple cider , orange rind and juice , and applejack and bring to simmer over medium heat , stirring occasionally
4. Reduce heat to lowest setting and allow cider to simmer for 15 minutes
5. Strain mixture through a fine-mesh sieve into a bowl and discard solids
6. Return cider to saucepan and add apple pieces , clementine slices and cranberries
7. Simmer on medium-low heat until apples are fork tender but still retain their shape and cranberries are plump , about 10 minutes
8. Serve hot

title: roasted garlic dipping sauce
steps:
1. Cut off top of garlic bulb to expose most of the garlic cloves
2. Put the bulb in an oven-safe small dish or on top of a sheet of foil
3. Drizzle olive oil on the tops of the garlic cloves , add more if needed to drench the tops and sides of the whole bulb
4. Sprinkle some salt on the top of the bulb on the oil
5. Wrap or seal up the garlic bulb with foil
6. Roast in oven at 400f for 30-40 minutes , until tops and sides are browned and roasted
7. Take out of the oven and cool for 10 minutes
8. When cooled enough to handle , squeeze out the garlic cloves from the root or the bottom of the bulb , into a small bowl
9. Add mayonnaise and sour cream , using a fork , stir until blended
10. Add pepper to taste , and salt if needed

title: peruvian flan
steps:
1. To prepare sauce , put medium size heavy skillet over medium heat for 40 seconds
2. Keep burner at medium , add sugar to the pan and stir with the back of a wooden spoon , keep sugar moving constantly until sugar is completely melted and a rich medium brown color --between 9 and 10 minutes
3. Immediately - and carefully - pour hot sauce into ovenproof pie plate or 9 inch round baking pan , gently moving dish so sauce covers bottom and sides
4. It is unnecessary to grease the pie dish
5. Let cool completely-about 40 minutes
6. To prepare the custard for the flan
7. Preheat oven to 350 degrees and notice that for step 11 you will need to have boiling water
8. Stir eggs in a medium sized bowl
9. Slowly add condensed milk , then evaporated milk
10. Add vanilla , blending well
11. Pour flan mixture into ovenproof dish that you have already coated with caramel
12. Carefully place filled dish into a larger baking pan
13. Pour in enough hot water to reach about halfway up dish
14. (this water bath process is called bano mara in spanish and bain-marie in french
15. )
16. Bake about 40 minutes
17. Flan is cooked when a knife inserted in center comes out clean
18. Remove from oven , let cool in water bath , then refrigerate to chill thoroughly
19. Carefully separate flan from dish with a thin knife
20. Invert on a flat dish and garnish with sliced strawberries , maraschino cherries or other fruit
21. Use boiling water to clean up the hardened caramel on your utensils and pan
22. :)

title: my potato soup
steps:
1. Peel potatoes and cut them into big bite-sized chunks
2. Add the 4 cups of water to a big pot , then add all of the potatoes
3. Add parsley at the same time -- usually half of a 1
4. 25 oz bottle , about 6 tbs of parsley
5. Bring to a boil then turn stove down to medium high , let boil for 15 minutes , or until potatoes are "cooked"
6. Immediately add the can of cream of chicken and the can of evaporated milk , all of the onions , and 2-3 more tbs of parsley
7. Don't use the entire 1
8. 25 oz bottle , should be about a tbs left in the bottle
9. While potatoes are cooking , dice the onions , can have big pieces of onions and slices as well -- the onions don't have to be diced into tiny little bits
10. It is better if the diced onions are bigger dices
11. Let all ingredients cook for about 20-30 minutes on medium or medium low
12. Halfway through turn down to low-medium
13. Add salt and pepper , and more butter if needed
14. The next day this is even better
15. I have even thought about cooking it and not eating it till the next day -- but this soup is too irresistable for me to be able to do this ! :)

title: most chocolatey chocolate cake
steps:
1. 1
2. Preheat oven to 350 degrees celcius and grease and flour 2 nine inch pans
3. 2
4. Mix together sugar , flour , cocoa , baking powder , baking soda , and salt in large bowl
5. 3
6. Add eggs , milk , oil and vanilla
7. Beat on medium speed of mixer for 2 minutes
8. 4
9. Stir in boiling water , then pour batter into prepared pans
10. 5
11. Bake for 30-35 minutes or until wooden pick inserted in the middle comes out clean
12. 6
13. Cool for 10 minutes , then take out of pan and cool completely
14. 7
15. Ffor the icing - melt the butter , then stir in the cocoa
16. Add sugar and milk
17. 8
18. Spread icing on top of the bottom layer
19. Then put the top layer on and ice the top and sides

title: wonton crisps
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Take a pastry brush and lightly brush the pan with some of the oil
3. Brush each wonton skin very lightly with with some oil as well
4. Sprinkle wontons with s pinch of salt , pepper and garlic powder to taste
5. Bake 6-8 minutes or until crisp and browned
6. Let cool on paper towels
7. Crumble over salad or asian style stir fry dishes

title: liquid caramel
steps:
1. Pour the bailey's irish cream , kahlua coffee liqueur and butterscotch schnapps into a cocktail shaker half-filled with ice cubes
2. Shake quickly , and strain into a highball glass
3. Top with milk , stir well and serve

title: fried calamari with remoulade sauce drizzled with balsamic syrup
steps:
1. Heat balsamic till reduced to a syrup
2. Set aside
3. Combine the flour , cumin , chili powder , garlic powder , paprika , pepper and salt in a shallow bowl
4. Heat the oil in a large skillet
5. When it is very hot , dredge the calamari in the flour mixture , shake off any excess then dip into egg then flour again and fry in the oil in batches until light-brown and crispy
6. Drain on paper towels
7. Season with salt
8. Place on a platter and drizzle with balsamic syrup
9. Serve with remoulade sauce

title: greek fried eggplant   aubergine   melitzanes tiganites
steps:
1. For fritter batter: sift 1 cup plain flour and a pinch of salt into a bowl
2. Add 1 egg yolk , 1 tablespoon oil and 3 / 4 cup lukewarm water
3. Beat until smooth
4. Let stand for 10 minutes then fold in stiffly beaten egg white
5. Use immediately
6. Wash and dry eggplant
7. I place paper towels over and under the eggplant to soak up all the liquid
8. Just keep changing them for a while until they quit getting really wet
9. Cut into 1 / 4 inch slices and spread out on trays
10. Sprinkle with salt and leave for 1 hour
11. Pat dry with paper towels and coat with flour or fritter batter
12. I like the fritter batter
13. Shallow fry in hot oil until golden brown and crisp on each side - 10 minutes in all
14. Drain on paper towel and serve hot with garlic sauce

title: fragrant salmon and sesame corn salad
steps:
1. Toast sesame seeds
2. Boil corn cobs for 3 minutes
3. After they have finished cooking , plunge them into cold water to stop the cooking
4. Slice off the kernels
5. Combine the corn , peppers , and red onion in a bowl
6. In a separate bowl , combine the sesame oil , cilantro , lime juice , fish sauce , chili pepper , and black pepper
7. Pour this mixture over the corn mixture and toss
8. Season the salmon with salt and pepper
9. Grill the salmon to taste
10. Arrange the rucola or watercress on two plates
11. Spoon the corn mixture over top
12. Place the grilled salmon on top
13. Garnish with a sprig of cilantro and some tiny cubed bits of red and orange pepper for color
14. Sprinkle the whole thing with the toasted sesame seeds

title: too easy smoothy
steps:
1. Roughly chop strawberries
2. Combine all ingredients in blender , and blend until smooth
3. I like a slightly sweeter smoothy , and so i add 1 packet of sweet "n" low
4. Then i put it in the freezer for about 5 mins to make it really cold :)

title: roasted smashed potatoes
steps:
1. Place potatoes in one layer in a large saucepan
2. Add cold water to cover by at least an inch
3. Add 1 t
4. Salt and bring water to boil
5. Reduce heat and simmer until potatoes are cooked , about 25-30 minutes
6. Drain thoroughly , then wrap loosely in a tea towel to draw out excess moisture
7. Remove tea towel and place potatoes in one layer on parchment paper covered baking sheet
8. Cover your hand with a tea towel and press down on each potato to "smash" it lightly
9. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate to cool completely
10. Dish can be prepared to this point
11. Cover and refrigerate
12. Preheat oven to 450f if chilled , bring potatoes to room temp
13. Pour olive oil generously over potatoes and sprinkle with remaining 2 t
14. Salt
15. Lift potatoes slightly to ensure they're well coated with oil underneath
16. Roast potatoes until brown and crispy , about 30 minutes
17. Serve immediately

title: toasted breakfast wraps
steps:
1. In a small bowl mix the honey with the fruit
2. Heat a non-stick frying pan , preferably griddle pan over medium heat
3. Divide the fruit between the tortillas , spooning it into the middle of each
4. Roll up the tortillas and fold over the ends to make a wrap
5. Place the wraps seam side down into the pan and cook for two minutes on each side , until nicely toasted
6. Serve immidiately

title: simple tomato   avocado crostini
steps:
1. Rub garlic clove on each slice of hot baguette
2. This will add a perfect light garlic essence without being "in your face" or oily
3. This technique is actually one of my favorites to use with crostinis or toasted sandwiches
4. Mix together tomato , avocado , cilantro , lime juice , and olive oil
5. Season to taste with salt and pepper
6. Scoop spoonfuls of the tomato / avocado mixture onto the garlic rubbed crostinis
7. Serve and enjoy !

title: lemon lava cake
steps:
1. Prepare cake mix as directed on box
2. Pour cake mixture into greased 9x13 baking dish
3. Combine dry pudding , milk , sugar , water , and lemon juice in bowl
4. Whisk together for 2 minutes until well combined and slightly thickened
5. Pour pudding mixture over cake mixture in pan
6. Do not spread it
7. Place baking dish onto a cookie sheet to catch any drips while baking
8. Bake at 350 for 55 minutes to an hour
9. Allow to cool 20 minutes while sauce thickens slightly
10. Dust with powdered sugar

title: grilled spiced white mushrooms
steps:
1. Prepare grill for cooking over medium-hot charcoal
2. (if using a charcoal grill , open vents on bottom of grill , then light charcoal
3. When charcoal turns grayish white , hold your hand 5 inches above grill rack to determine heat for charcoal as follows: hot: when you can hold your hand there for 1 to 2 seconds
4. Medium-hot: 3 to 4 seconds
5. Low: 5 to 6 seconds
6. If using a gas grill , preheat burners on high , covered , 10 minutes , then , if necessary , reduce to heat specified in recipe
7. )
8. While coals are lighting , heat a dry small heavy skillet over moderately low heat until hot , then toast coriander and cumin seeds , shaking skillet frequently , until a shade darker , 2 to 3 minutes
9. Transfer seeds to mortar or grinder and cool completely , about 3 minutes , then finely grind
10. Transfer ground-spice mixture to a large bowl , then mash into softened butter along with parsley , red pepper flakes , and garlic until combined well
