11. Toss mushrooms with oil , salt , and pepper in a bowl , then grill on lightly oiled grill rack , covered only if using a gas grill , turning over occasionally , until lightly browned and tender , 12 to 14 minutes total
12. Quarter mushrooms while still hot , then toss with butter mixture and salt and pepper to taste
13. Cooks'
14. If you aren't able to find medium mushrooms , you can use small ones but will need to grill them on a lightly oiled perforated grill sheet or slide them onto soaked wooden skewers to prevent them from falling through the grill rack

title: haupia  coconut pudding
steps:
1. Pour one cup of coconut milk into a saucepan lover low heat
2. Combine sugar and cornstarch stirring into coconut milk , continuing on low heat stirring consistently until thickened
3. Add remaining coconut milk and whole milk and continue to heat until thickened
4. Pour into 8 inch square pan and chill until firm
5. Slice to desired size just before serving

title: door county style fish boil
steps:
1. In a stockpot , combine the water , onion , celery , vinegar , bay leaf , tarragon , dill , and fennel
2. The pot should be not more than half full
3. Bring to a rolling boil , then lower the heat and simmer for 30 minutes or more
4. Place serving plates and plates in a warm oven or near the fire , if outdoors
5. Scrub the potatoes but do not peel them
6. Add to the pot along with the carrots
7. Cook at a rolling boil for 15 minutes
8. Divide the fish in 4 portions
9. Wrap 2 portions in well-washed cheesecloth
10. Repeat with the other two portions
11. Add to the pot
12. When the stock returns to a boil , lower heat to simmer and cook fish for 10 minutes
13. Remove the fish and vegetables to the warm platter and keep warm while you prepare the sauce
14. Bring the cooking liquid to a full boil and cook for 2 minutes to reduce it to 2 cups
15. Strain 2 cups of the liquid into a measuring cup
16. In a blender , grind the oats , dill and paprika to a fine powder
17. Add theoil and strained liquid
18. Process for 30 seconds
19. Transfer to a small saucepan
20. Bring to a boil , stirring constantly
21. When the sauce has thickened , taste and season as needed
22. Either pour the sauce over each individual serving of fish and vegetables or place it in a gravy boat and pass it separately
23. Garnish with lemon wedges
24. Variation: use about a 2 lb whole , cleaned whitefish and cook it 15 minute

title: cinderella s royal table breakfast potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit
2. Dice and cook the potatoes
3. Dice onions
4. In a large skillet , melt butter
5. Add diced onion and saute
6. Add bacon and cook for 2 minutes
7. Add flour and stir to make a paste
8. Cook for 5 minutes
9. Add 3 cups milk
10. Stir until lumps are gone
11. Cook mixture 10 minutes and continue stirring
12. Add potatoes , cheese , garlic salt , white pepper and salt
13. Mix until cheese is melted
14. Put mixture into a baking dish and bake at 350 degrees fahrenheit for 10 minutes or until hot and top is lightly browned

title: grilled pumpkin with rosemary and sea salt
steps:
1. Heat grill to medium-high
2. Cut the pumpkins vertically into 3 / 4 inch slices
3. Remove the seeds and stringy parts
4. Brush both sides of each slice liberally with olive oil
5. Sprinkle with sea salt and rosemary
6. Place the slices on the grill for about 5 minutes a side or until dark grill marks appear
7. Turn and grill the other side until you can easily pierce the pumpkin slice with a fork
8. Make sure that the pumpkin is tender
9. Since some of the salt tends to fall off during the grilling process , serve with a small dish of additional sea salt

title: aunt virgie s stuffed green bell peppers
steps:
1. Place ground chuck in large mixing bowl
2. Add next 8 ingredients
3. With clean , damp hands mix meat mixture together until well combined
4. Rinse green peppers and slice top offs
5. Cut peppers in half and remove seeds
6. Make meatballs with approximately 2 tablespoons of ground chuck mixture and place in half sections of green peppers
7. In large dutch oven , place meat stuffed pepper halves in bottom of pan
8. With remaining meat make more meatballs and arrange on top of peppers
9. Pour v-8 juice over all the meatballs
10. Add tomato sauce and crushed tomatoes
11. With spoon spread tomato paste over top
12. Sprinkle with red pepper flakes , onion and garlic flakes
13. Cook on medium low heat for approximately one hour or until meatballs are cooked through
14. Serve with mashed potatoes

title: super simple pumpkin ginger barley pilaf  vegan
steps:
1. Rinse and sort through your barley to pick out any rocks , twigs , etc
2. And while you're doing so , salt 2 1 / 2 cups water with the celery salt , and bring it to a boil
3. Turn the heat off once it's boiling
4. Make your sauce by first whisking the pumpkin and olive oil into the water , then adding the ginger , white pepper , and a little nutmeg and whisk until the pot is totally orange with no dry spices floating at the top
5. Turn the heat back on low to medium-low , and add the barley
6. Loosely cover and let cook for about 20-30 minutes if using quick-cooking barley , about 40-45 minutes if using traditional barley , stir a few times throughout the cooking to make sure it's not sticking to the bottom of the pot or if it takes less time to fully cook
7. I used normal storebrand traditional barley pearls and it only took 25 minutes to fully absorb

title: ginger chicken with mint
steps:
1. In a large frying pan , heat oil on medium heat
2. Add sliced onions and saute'until translucent , about 5 minutes
3. Add garlic and saute' for 1 more minute
4. Remove onion and garlic into a dish and set aside
5. Cut chicken into bite size pieces and add to frying pan
6. Stir-fry for 2 minutes
7. Add soy sauce , ginger , mint and basil leaves and cook for 1 minute
8. Add mushrooms , green onions and sambal oelek
9. Return onions and garlic to the pan and continue cooking until chicken is tender , about 3 minutes
10. Stirring occasionally
11. When chicken is just cooked , add rice vinegar , sugar and fish sauce
12. Stir well and cook for 2 minutes
13. Remove from heat
14. Serve immediately over cooked rice of your choice

title: banana carrot muffins
steps:
1. Heat oven to 325f
2. Generously grease muffin tins
3. Beat eggs , sugar , oil
4. Add honey
5. Add bananas and carrots mix until combined
6. Add dry ingredients and raisins
7. Use 1 / 4 cup measure to divi out batter into tins
8. Bake 20-25 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean

title: kiwi quick bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease and flour a 9 x 5 x 3 loaf pan
3. Sift together flour , baking powder baking soda and salt and set aside
4. In large bowl cream butter and sugar together until light and fluffy
5. Add eggs one at a time to creamed mixture beating well after each one
6. Stir in kiwis
7. Fold in dry ingredients gently , stirring only until batter is completely moistened
8. Spoon batter into pan and bake for 55-65 minutes or until toothpick inserted comes out clean
9. Cool for 10 minutes on wire rack
10. Remove from pan and continue cooling on rack

title: deviled eggs   bacon and cheese with a kick
steps:
1. Peel the eggs and cut in half
2. Place all of the yokes into a bowl and mash with a fork
3. Add the mayonnaise , brown mustard , worcestershire sauce , and tabasco sauce
4. Mix well until the mixture is smooth
5. Add the cheese and bacon
6. Mix lightly until just combined
7. Taste the filling and adjust the salt and pepper
8. Fill the egg halves with the filling
9. Sprinkle with paprika as garnish

title: furr s cafeteria pineapple millionaire pie
steps:
1. Cream 2 cups powdered sugar and butter with electric mixer until fluffy
2. Add eggs , salt and vanilla
3. Beat until light and fluffy
4. Spread mixture evenly into baked pie crusts
5. Chill
6. Whip cream until stiff
7. Blend in powdered sugar
8. Fold in pineapple and pecans
9. Spread mixture on top of filling and chill thoroughly

title: alsatian brined turkey with riesling gravy
steps:
1. In a large pot , bring 4 cups of the water to a boil
2. Add 1 1 / 4 cups of kosher salt , the sugar , mustard seeds , dried onion , caraway seeds , peppercorns , juniper berries and bay leaves
3. Stir until salt and sugar are completely dissolved
4. Remove pot from heat
5. Line a container large enough to hold the turkey with two sturdy plastic bags
6. Put the turkey into the bags , neck first
7. Pour the warm brine over the turkey
8. Add 1 1 / 2 cups of the riesling and 4 quarts of the cold water
9. Seal the bags
10. Press out as much air as possible
11. Refrigerate for 2 days
12. On thanksgiving morning , preheat the oven to 350
13. Drain the turkey , scraping off the spices , then transfer it to a large roasting pan and let it return to room temperature
14. If your family or guests are salt sensitive be sure to wash the turkey very well under cold water and dry completely with paper towels
15. Discard brine
16. Add the quartered onion , garlic and 1 cup of water to the pan and roast the turkey for 1 1 / 2 hours
17. Add the remaining 1 cup of water to the pan and roast for about 1 1 / 2 hours longer , or until an instant-read thermometer inserted into an inner thigh registers 165
18. Cover the breast loosely with foil during the last hour of roasting to prevent it from browning too quickly
19. Transfer the turkey to a cutting board
20. Strain the pan juices into a measuring cup and skim off the fat
21. Reserve 3 tablespoons of the fat
22. In a bowl , mix the reserved fat with the flour until a paste forms
23. Place roasting pan over 2 burners and heat until sizzling
24. Add 1 cup of riesling and bring to a simmer over moderately high heat , scraping up any browned bits from the bottom and sides of the pan
25. Strain the wine into a medium saucepan and boil until reduced to 1 / 4 cup , about 5 minutes
26. Add the stock and the reserved pan juices and bring to a boil
27. Whisk in the flour paste and simmer over moderate heat until the gravy thickens slightly and no floury taste remains , about 10 minutes
28. Season with salt and pepper
29. Carve and serve with the riesling gravy on the side

title: cabbage borscht
steps:
1. Put all ingredients in water , in large pot
2. Bring to a boil , lower heat and simmer 1 hour , or until vegetables are tender
3. Season well with salt and pepper
4. Let sit overnight in refrigerator , this improves the flavor
5. Remove bay leaf and then reheat
6. This freezes well

title: mushroom stuffed potato
steps:
1. Bake potatoes in a 350f oven for about 2 hours or until cooked
2. Cool potatoes until cool enough not to burn yourself
3. Slice a thin layer off the top of potato and scoop out potatoes leaving a thin layer of potato in shell
4. Mix the rest of ingredients together using granulated garlic amount to taste and over stuff the potato filling into each shell
5. Sprinkle shredded cheese on top and bake around 30 minutes until cheese is melted on top

title: unbeatable pasta salad
steps:
1. Cook pasta as directed on box
2. Make sure everything is well drained
3. Make sure onion and green pepper are diced very small
4. Mix everything together in large bowl
5. Refridgerate for 24 hours before serving

title: diabetic friendly cashew chicken
steps:
1. Combine chicken strips , orange juice , and 1 teaspoon cornstarch in a medium bowl
2. Cover and chill 1 hour
3. Heat oil in a nonstick skillet over medium heat
4. Add cashews
5. Cook , stirring constantly , 30 seconds
6. Remove from skillet
7. Set aside
8. Add chicken mixture to skillet
9. Cook , uncovered , over medium-high heat 8 minutes or until chicken is lightly browned , stirring constantly
10. Add water chestnuts and next 3 ingredients
11. Cook 5 minutes
12. Combine broth , soy sauce , and 1 tablespoon cornstarch
13. Add to chicken mixture
14. Bring to a boil
15. Reduce heat , and cook , stirring constantly , until thickened
16. Remove from heat
17. Stir in oranges
18. Spoon chicken mixture over rice , and sprinkle with cashews
19. Serve immediately

title: winter comfort sandwich
steps:
1. On barbecue , under broiler , or in a toaster oven , grill chicken over medium heat for 6 to 12 minutes
2. Turn once halfway through cooking
3. Cut chicken in thin slices
4. Spread pesto on each half of panini
5. Fill each panini with chicken , 3 basil leaves , mushrooms , sliced pepper and mozzarella
6. Heat on grill , or in a frying pan , flattening with a spatula

title: frozen pink lemonade
steps: 1. Blend all ingredients with ice , then garnish with a lemon slice

title: curried chicken with apricots
steps:
1. Place apricots& craisins in small bowl and pour the oj over them--let sit 15 min or longer
2. Put butter and next 6 ingredients in a small dish and mix to a paste
3. In a greased 2-quart shallow baking dish , arrange chicken in a single layer
4. Spread curry paste evenly over chicken
5. Add the fruits and oj they were soaked in
6. Sprinkle the broken bay leaf , making sure it gets submerged
7. Pour milk over it all
8. Cover and bake@ 350 45 minutes
9. Uncover and bake 25 minutes more

title: dorothy s cranberry bread
steps:
1. Sift together the dry ingredients in a large bowl
2. In a 3 / 4 measuring cup , add the juice from one orange , vegetable oil and reserved juice from the can of crushed pineapple to equal 3 / 4 cup
3. In a small bowl , add liquid with grated orange rind and beaten egg
4. Stir to combine well , then add to dry ingredients , stirring just enough to dampen dough mixture
5. Fold in chopped nuts , cranberries and crushed pineapple
6. Bake in a large greased loaf pan at 350 degrees for 50 to 60 minutes , or until a knife inserted in the middle comes out clean
7. Makes 1 loaf
8. Suggestion: to save time , you can coarsely chop the cranberries in a food processor , if you want
9. But be careful not to over pulse !
10. It goes fast !

title: catalan cheese  walnut and honey dessert
steps:
1. Toast the walnuts and cool
2. You can leave the walnuts whole or chop coarsely when cool
3. Mix the goat cheese and ricotta cheese together well with a whisk
4. Put the cheese mixture into small ramekins and refrigerate at least 15 minutes , or you can just mound on a dessert plate
5. Unmold the cheese
6. Top with 2 tbsp walnuts and drizzle each with 2 tbsp honey
7. Serve

title: low calorie tomato herb salad dressing
steps:
1. Combine ingredients in a glass jar
2. Cover and shake well
3. Chill
4. Shake before serving

title: herb salad with chive vinaigrette
steps:
1. Whisk all ingredientstogether in a small bowl until blended
2. Toss salad mix with chive vinaigrette to coat

title: rosemary tomato chicken with rice
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees
2. Wash and tenderize the chicken and set aside
3. Place the olive oil , and half the rosemary , salt and pepper in a bowl or deep plate
4. Fresh rosemary can come out very strong in this recipe , so use discretion
5. Dip each chicken breast into the olive oil mixture and place in a baking pan
6. Give it an extra couple sprinkles of the salt , pepper and rosemary
7. Add the stewed tomatoes into the baking pan
8. Pour the remains of the olive oil mixture , plus any leftover rosemary , salt and pepper on top
9. Cover the pan with aluminum foil and bake for 20 minutes
10. At 20 minutes , remove the cover and flip the chicken breasts
11. Bake uncovered another 20 minutes , for a total of 40 minutes
12. Serve over the rice and enjoy !

title: basil fettucini
steps:
1. Using a food processor , process basil leaves until chopped very fine
2. Add 1 1 / 2 cups of flour and pulse two or three times , or until combined
3. Add egg , 1 teaspoon oil , and the water until dough forms a ball shape , if dough seems dry , add a bit more water
4. Wrap dough in a piece of plastic wrap which has been coated in a few drops of olive oil
5. Refrigerate dough for 2 hours
6. Remove dough from refrigerator , and cut into 6 equal size portions
7. Run pasta though pasta machine , or roll with rolling pin to desired thickness
8. Use the additional flour to coat pasta while rolling
9. Allow pasta to dry for one hour prior to cooking
10. Cook in a large pot of boiling water until al dente
11. This should take only a 3 to 5 minutes , depending on the thickness of the pasta

title: avgolemono  egg lemon soup
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , bring the stock , with the dill added , to a boil
2. Add rice
3. Reduce heat and simmer , covered , for about 15 to 20 minutes-- just until the rice is tender but still firm
4. In the bowl with the beaten eggs , slowly stir about 2 cups of the soup in , beating constantly
5. Once combined , slowly pour this mixture back into the soup-pot
6. Increase the heat to medium and cook , stirring constantly , for about 5 minutes or until the soup has slightly thickened
7. Remove from heat and stir in lemon juice
8. Taste and add salt and pepper
9. Serve immediately

title: chocolate melting cake
steps:
1. Melt chocolate and butter in microwave at 50% power
2. Sift flour into pitcher , add sugar , add eggs , mix together
3. Fold in melted chocolate and butter mix
4. Pour into small glass ramekins
5. Preheat oven to 300
6. Bake at 300 for 12 - 15 minutes in serving dish
7. Dessert should be firm around edges and wiggly in the center
8. Place heart stencil on top of dessert and sift powdered sugar
9. Serve warm
10. This may be accompanied by ice cream , and / or coffee with a shot of bailey's irish cream

title: celery with almond butter and dates
steps:
1. Choose celery ribs that are fresh and bright green
2. Cut the celery ribs into 2-inch lengths
3. Stir the almond butter well , and pour some into a small bowl
4. If desired , add a light sprinkling of salt to the almond butter and stir to combine
5. Spread a layer of almond butter into the cavity of each piece of celery
6. Top each celery piece with date pieces
7. Arrange on a serving plate

title: barb s fried apples  diabetic low fat
steps:
1. Melt butter in skillet , add the sliced apples
2. I add a little water , cover and cook for about 10 minutes
3. Add brown sugar splenda , cinnamon , nutmeg if using , stir & cover , cook about 5 minutes

title: berry summer pudding from woman s world 6 22 09
steps:
1. Coat 2-1 / 2 quart souffle dish with cooking spray
2. Line with plastic wrap leaving 6" overhang
3. Cut the angel food cake into 16 pieces
4. Reserve
5. Stir 2 pkgs jello into 1 1 / 2 cups boiling water until dissolved
6. Stir in 1 1 / 2 cups white grape juice
7. Toss 8 cups assorted berries with jello
8. In a blender , puree 1 / 4 of berry mixture
9. Stir back into jello mixture
10. With slotted spoon transfer 1 / 2 the berry mixture to dish
11. Top with 1 / 2 the cake slices in even layer
12. Press down
13. Repeat with remaining berry mixture and cake
14. Pour any remaining liquid over pudding
15. Fold over plastic wrap
16. Place 7" plate over pudding
17. Top with heavy can
18. Refrigerate at least 6 hours or overnight
19. Open plastic wrap and invert pudding onto plate
20. Remove plastic wrap
21. If desired , garnish with whipped topping , berries and mint

title: horse meat  tripe and spinach stew from kazakhstan
steps:
1. Cut the horse meat into serving sized pieces sautee until brown
2. Halfway through frying , add chopped onion , liver , heart , and continue frying
3. When done , pour 2 cups broth into the pot
4. Add washed tripe , bay leaves ,
5. Spinach , salt , pepper , paprika , dill , and cumin
6. Bring to a boil , then lower heat and cover
7. Let simmer for 1 hour
8. Stew should be thick
9. Remove bay leaves and serve over fresh kale

title: sakina s banana cake with with semolina
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180c
2. Grease a 9x13-inch baking dish
3. Beat butter and sugar until light and fluffy
4. Beat in eggs one at time
5. Add semolina and let mixture stand for one and half hours
6. This step is very important
7. After standing stir rest of ingredients in until well blended
8. Pour into you baking dish , sprinkle with seeds and bake for 20-30 min or until a skewer comes out clean

title: mozzarella filled steak rolls
steps:
1. Heat oven to 450f
2. Season steaks , place a few basil leaves on each and split the mozzarella between them
3. Bring the sides of the steaks together to make an open parcel , securing the edges with a toothpick
4. If making up to a day ahead , cover and chill
5. Heat a heavy-based roasting tin on a high heat , add the oil and brown the beef on all sides - this should take about 1 min in total and the meat will still be rare in the middle
6. Add the peppers , their oil and the olives to the tin , pour over the vinegar , then roast for 2-3 mins for medium rare , longer for well done
7. Cover with foil and leave to rest for up to 5 minutes scatter over remaining basil before serving

title: spicy potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425f peel and roughly dice the potatoes about 5 / 8 inch in size
2. Place in bowl and toss with the 2 tbsp olive oil , place on a baking tray and cook for 50 minutes or until golden brown and crispy
3. Remove from the oven
4. Combine tomato paste , the extra olive oil , vinegar , paprika , tabasco and salt in a bowl and stir to combine
5. Add the roasted potatoes and toss to combine
6. Serve immediately

title: crispy open faced quesadillas
steps:
1. Preheat the broiler
2. Brush the tortillas on both sides with oil and lightly salt
3. Heat a large saute pan over medium heat and cook the tortillas , 1 at a time , until slightly golden on both sides
4. Meanwhile , in a small bowl , mix together the sour cream , lime zest and juice , cumin , and salt and pepper , to taste , until smooth
5. Pour into a plastic squeeze bottle or sturdy resealable plastic bag and cut small
6. Arrange the browned tortillas on a baking sheet and sprinkle evenly with cheese
7. Broil until the cheese bubbles and begins to brown , about for 1 to 2 minutes , being careful not to burn
8. Slice each quesadilla into 8 wedges and drizzle sour cream decoratively over the top
9. Sprinkle with cilantro and serve

title: roasted green pepper pesto
steps:
1. Cut peppers into quarters and spray lightly with olive oil
2. Roast under a high broiler for 8 minutes , or until blackened
3. Place in a paper bag and leave for 5 minutes
4. Peel
5. Meanwhile , seed and roughly chop hot peppers
6. Roughly chop garlic
7. Place roasted peppers , hot peppers , garlic and lemon juice in food processor and blend
8. Slowly pour in olive oil while the processor is running , until pesto is desired consistancy
9. Salt and pepper to taste and slather onto crackers with goat cheese

title: over the top enchiladas
steps:
1. Fry and drain hamburger then add taco seasoning and follow directions on packet for preparing adding as much water as specified on seasoning packet
2. Add cup of cooked rice , beans , and 1 / 2 cup of cheddar cheese
3. Simmer until cheese melts
4. Let cool to room temperature
5. Take flour tortillas and fill down the middle with meat mixture being careful not to overfill
6. If using corn tortillas warm them first or they will break
7. Fold tortillas over mixture and roll rather tightly until overlapping and place seam side down in a casserole dish
8. Stir soup mixture , sour cream , and green chilis together and spread evenly over tortillas
9. Bake at 350 for 45 minutes
10. Remove from oven and sprinkle with shredded monterey jack and cheddar
11. Return to oven for 5 minutes or until cheese melts
12. Garnish with green onions if desired
13. Serve with salsa on the side

title: your favorite pie filling  dessert
steps:
1. Grease 9x9 inch pan , mix first three ings
2. And press in pan
3. Beat eggs , add sugar and cream cheese , mix well and place on cracker crust-bake 20 minutes in 350 degree oven-let cool
4. Mix 1 can pie filling and 1 teaspoon lemon juice-spread on top of cooled mixture
5. Top with 1 / 2 pint whipped cream
6. Chill

title: easy fruit cobbler with a unique topping
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f spray an 8x8 baking dish with nonstick cooking spray and set aside
2. In a large saucepan , combine all fruit mixture ingredients
3. Bring to a boil , stirring constantly
4. Reduce heat and simmer until sauce is thickened pour fruit mixture into sprayed baking dish
5. Separate dough into 5 biscuits
6. Cut each one into quarters and place into a bowl
7. Sprinkle with brown sugar , cinnamon , and orange peel and toss gently to coat
8. Arrange biscuit pieces over hot fruit mixture and bake for about 15 minutes or until biscuits are deep golden brown
9. Cool slightly before serving

title: chicken breast piccata so good so easy
steps:
1. Cut each half of chicken breast in half , horizontally , so that you have 4 quarters of the chicken breast
2. Place one of the quarters into a ziplock freezer bag , and seal
3. Pound with a wooden mallet till 1 / 8 to 1 / 4 in thick
4. Remove from bag and repeat process with remaining chicken breast quarters
5. Sprinkle pounded breasts with salt and pepper and very lightly with garlic powder on each side
6. Lightly dredge in the flour , shaking off all excess , there should be a very light coating of flour
7. Heat olive oil and butter over medium high heat , in non stick skillet till butter just starts to foam
8. Add chicken breasts
9. Saute very quickly , approximately 5 minutes on each side
10. Lower heat to low
11. Add lemon juice and capers to pan
12. Toss all together , still over heat
13. Let cook 2 more minutes
14. Remove chicken breast to platter and pour any remaining juices with capers over the chicken
15. I serve this with fettuccini alfredo and fresh cooked spinach with lemon

title: lemony flank steak skewers with lemon dipping sauce
steps:
1. For the flank steak
2. In a bowl combine the oil , zest , lemon juice , garlic , tabasco and black pepper
3. Transfer to a large heavy-duty ziploc plastic bag
4. Add in the sliced beef and seal bag tightly
5. Turn to coat the beef with marinade
6. Refrigerate for 8 hours
7. For the dipping sauce
8. Combine all ingredients in a glass bowl
9. Cover and chill a for about 3-24 hours before using
10. Soak the wooden skewers in water for 30 minutes
11. Remove the beef from marinade and discard the marinade
12. Thread each slice of marinated steak onto 1 skewer and place onto a large baking sheet
13. Season each beef skewer with seasoned salt and more black pepper
14. Place on a medium grill
15. Grill until desired doneness
16. Serve with lemon dipping sauce
17. Delicious !

title: best bbq sauce you ll ever taste  southwest
steps:
1. Saut onions , bell peppers , and garlic in butter , just until onions are translucent
2. Add chili powder , and dry mustard
3. Stir to incorporate
4. Lower heat and add remaining ingredients
5. Simmer on low for at least one hour
6. Let cool then blend smooth in food processor or use a hand held mixer
7. Put up in mason jars
8. If you actually "can" the sauce it will keep for a month or so
9. If not , use what you need , it will keep in the fridg for a couple of weeks , and you can always give the rest away--your family and friends will love you for it
10. Use gloves or put a plastic baggie over the hand you use to hold the pepper while you slice it up
11. Use one for medium-hot bbq sauce , use two for down right hot
12. If even one is too hot for your taste , substitute a couple of jalapeno peppers

title: simple au jus gravy
steps:
1. Place the water in a medium sauce pan and bring to a boil
2. Reduce heat to low
3. Whisk in the beef bouillon
4. Whisk in the soy sauce , garlic powder and salt and pepper to taste
5. If you like a thicker au jus gravy , you can also whisk in a little flour to thicken it

title: marinated peppers and mozzarella
steps:
1. Preheat broiler to high
2. Arrange the baby peppers in a single layer on a foil-lined jelly roll pan , and broil peppers for 4 minutes on each side or until blackened and tender
3. Cool , combine peppers , olive oil , garlic cloves , lemon rind , red pepper , salt , and mozzarella balls , and toss
4. Cover , and refrigerate overnight , tossing after 6 hours
5. Let stand at room temperature for 30 minutes
6. Stir in basil leaves , and lemon juice before serving
7. Serve with a slotted spoon

title: smoked bacon with onions and apple rings   appel flask
steps:
1. In a heavy skillet , melt butter
2. When foam subsides , add the bacon and fry for 5 to 10 minutes or until the bacon is lightly browned
3. Remove bacon from skillet and set on paper towel lined plate to drain
4. In same skillet used for bacon , fry the onion slices for 6 to 8 minutes adding more butter as necessary
5. When the onions are soft and transparent , add the apple rings
6. Put lid on skillet and simmer apples over low heat for 5 to 10 minutes
7. Carefully stir apples to keep them from sticking
8. When the apple rings are done , they should offer little or no resistence when pierced with the
9. Cover skillet and simmer an additional 3 to 5 minutes or until the bacon is heated through
10. Liberally grind fresh black pepper over the top and serve immediately

title: lentils and bacon
steps:
1. Combine lentils , water and bacon in a large heavy saucepan
2. Bring to a boil , then reduce heat
3. Cover and simmer for 45 minutes
4. Add potatoes and continue to cook until lentils are tender about 15 minutes
5. Stir in vinegar and sugar
6. Taste and add salt if needed
7. Place in serving dish and keep warm
8. Melt butter in skillet
9. Saute onions and parsley over medium heat until onions are transparent
10. Spoon over lentils
11. Serve hot

title: mushroom chicken  for the grill
steps:
1. In skillet cook mushrooms , garlic , and oregano in hot olive oil over medium heat for 6 minutes or until tender , stirring occasionally
2. Remove from heat
3. Stir in marsala , soy sauce , salt , and pepper
4. Return to heat
5. Cook and stir 2 minutes more
6. Remove from heat
7. Cool
8. Loosen skin on each piece of chicken on one side
9. Stuff mushroom mixture under skin
10. Sprinkle lightly with salt and pepper
11. For charcoal grill , arrange medium-hot coals around drip pan
12. Place chicken , bone side down on grill rack over drip pan
13. Cover and grill 50-60 minutes or until chicken no longer pink
14. For gas grill , preheat grill
15. Reduce heat to medium
16. Adjust for indirect cooking
17. Place chicken on grill rack
18. Grill as above
19. Serve with fresh lemon and oregano sprigs

title: mom s easy hash browns casserole
steps:
1. Melt the butter and mix with the milk , half and half , and salt in a measuring cup
2. Spread out the hash browns in a greased 9 x 13 pan
3. Pour the liquid mixture even over the hash browns
4. Sprinkle the parmesan cheese on the top
5. Add more cheese if you want , i do !
6. Bake at 350 for 60 minutes
7. Cover with foil if it gets too brown
8. Add more milk if it gets too dry
9. The number of servings depends on how much you serve , they get pretty big at our house

title: white nile martini
steps:
1. Shake all the ingredients together in a cocktail shaker with ice
2. Strain into a martini glass garnished with chocolate powder around the rim
3. Garnish with maltesers and orange zest if desired

title: balsamic glazed baby onions
steps:
1. Place onions in large heavy saucepan and add water to cover
2. Heat to boiling
3. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered until barely tender , 7-10 minutes
4. Drain and let cool slightly
5. Slip off skins and trim root ends
6. Melt butter in same saucepan over medium heat
7. Stir in sugar and increase heat to medium-high
8. Add onions and cook , stirring occasionally , until onions are glazed and golden brown , 5-8 minutes
9. Stir in vinegar and thyme
10. Cook 1 minute longer
11. Serve hot

title: crock pot  applesauce chicken
steps:
1. Put the frozen chicken pieces into your crockpot
2. Add the onion
3. In a bowl , mix the applesauce , vinegar , garlic , and spices together
4. Pour on top of the chicken
5. Cover and cook on low for 5-7 hours , or on high for 3-4
6. Serve with rice or noodles

title: vietnamese grilled jumbo shrimp on sugarcane sticks
steps:
1. Using a food processor , puree garlic , sugar , shallots , fish sauce , lime juice and pepper
2. Add lemongrass and the 1 / 4 cup of oil
3. Process to a puree
4. Place shrimp in a large shallow container with lid and pour marinade over shrimp to cover
5. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 1 / 2 hours
6. Light a grill
7. Cut each sugarcane stick in half on a sharp diagonal so each piece has a sharp point
8. Scrape off marinade
9. Make a slit near the shrimp's tail and one near the head with a sharp knife
10. Thread a sugarcane stick through the slits
11. The shrimp should lie flat
12. Grill the shrimp over a hot fire , brushing them once or twice with oil , until lightly charred and just cooked through , about 3 minutes per side
13. Place shrimp on a serving platter and sprinkle with peanuts and cilantro
14. Serve the shrimp with the vietnamese dipping sauce

title: peanut butter graham squares with dark chocolate drizzle
steps:
1. Arrange whole graham crackers in the bottom of an 8x8" square baking dish
2. In a medium mixing bowl , beat together graham cracker crumbs , butter , sugar , peanut butter , vanilla and salt until smooth
3. Scoop this mixture into the baking dish and gently spread over the graham crackers
4. Cover and place in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour
5. Cut into squares and drizzle with melted dark chocolate

title: firehouse tex mex casserole
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f degrees
2. Place rice in a greased 3-quart casserole dish
3. Add hot water
4. Cover and let stand for 5 minutes
5. Meanwhile , brown the meat in a large frying pan
6. Add barbecue sauce , tomatoes , beans , and chili powder
7. Mix well and then bring to a boil
8. Spoon the meat mixture over the rice
9. Sprinkle with cheddar cheese
10. Cover and bake for 30 minutes
11. Garnish with green onions

title: banana popsicles
steps:
1. Mix pudding mix and milk together
2. Add cut up banana to pudding and blend evenly
3. Spoon enough pudding / bananas into popsicle cups to cover bottom
4. Periodically tap the cups to get any air pockets out
5. Freeze till set

title: savory scallops
steps:
1. Thaw the scallops
2. Heat your saute pan to medium high with a bit of butter and sear the scallops quickly for perhaps 90 seconds on a side
3. Remove the cooked scallops and set aside
4. Turn the heat down to medium and add the minced garlic
5. When it browns and starts to smell nutty , deglaze the pan with the wine and reduce by half
6. Remove from heat and salt and pepper to your liking
7. Add the parsley , and swirl in the butter
8. Pool the sauce on a plate , set the scallops on top of it , and serve with good crusty bread for soaking it up

title: aromatic parsnips and carrots
steps:
1. Cut any long parsnips or carrots in half crosswise
2. In a very large skillet , cook parsnips , covered , in a small amount of boiling salted water for 2 minutes
3. Add carrots , return to boiling
4. Cook 4 more minutes
5. Drain , set aside
6. Carefully , wipe skillet dry
7. Heat the 3 tbls
8. Oil in the same skillet over medium heat
9. Add the fennel seeds , coriander , and cinnamon
10. Cook about 1 minute or until fragrant , stirring occasionally
11. Add the parsnips , carrots and garlic
12. Cook 10 to 12 minutes , or until tender , turning occasionally
13. Remove from the heat
14. Stir in cilantro , lemon peel and juice , salt , and pepper
15. Drizzle with the olive oil
16. Enjoy !
17. Make ahead
18. Prepare through wiping the skillet dry
19. Transfer to a 2 1 / 2-3 quart microwave safe casserole dish
20. Cover , and refrigerate up to 24 hours
21. To serve , microwave , covered with plastic wrap on high 7-8 minutes

title: maple pecan butter
steps:
1. Saut shallots in one tablespoon of the butter until caramelized and almost crisp , and allow to cool
2. Fold all ingredients together and chill
3. When almost firm , place flavored butter onto wax paper and roll into a log
4. Seal in plastic wrap and refrigerate or freeze until needed
5. Let butter soften before using for best flavor

title: dot s cheese bacon puffs
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180c / 350f
2. Combine egg and milk , and stir into remaining ingredients
3. Drop by rounded teaspoon onto a lightly greased cookie sheet
4. Bake until golden
5. Cool on wire racks

title: huckleberry streusel bars
steps:
1. Line the bottom and sides of a straight-sided 13-by-9-inch metal baking pan with foil
2. In a medium bowl , stir together the butter , 3 / 4 cup of the sugar and the salt
3. Whisk in the egg yolks
4. Stir in the flour to make a stiff dough
5. Transfer about 2 cups of the dough to the prepared pan and press evenly into the bottom
6. Prick the dough all over with a fork
7. Refrigerate the pan for 30 minutes
8. Preheat the oven to 325 degrees fahrenheit
9. Bake the dough until crust begins to set but does not brown on the edges , about 20 minutes
10. While crust bakes , prepare the streusel
11. With your fingers , combine the remaining sugar with the reserved dough until crumbly
12. Mixture should hold together when pressed , but readily break into smaller pieces
13. Spread the huckleberry preserves evenly over the hot crust
14. Scatter the streusel over the preserves , careful not to break it up too much
15. Set oven temperature to 350 degrees fahrenheit and bake bars near top of oven until top is golden , about 25 minutes
16. Once cooled , cut bars into 1 3 / 4 inch squares

title: beer steamed shrimp with garlic butter
steps:
1. Heat butter and garlic in dutch oven over medium heat until sizzling and fragrant , about 4 minutes
2. Pour garlic butter into serving bowl and stir in lemon juice and hot sauce
3. Cover and keep warm
4. Fit dutch oven with steamer basket , add beer , and bring to boil over medium-high heat
5. Sprinkle old bay seasoning evenly over shrimp and transfer to steamer basket
6. Cover and steam until shrimp are cooked through , 4 to 6 minutes
7. Transfer to serving platter
8. Serve with warm garlic butter for dipping

title: potato soup with two cheeses
steps:
1. Add olive oil to a large pot
2. Heat on medium and cook celery , onion , and carrot until tender
3. Add potatoes and broth
4. Bring to a boil , then simmer on low about 1 / 2 hour or until potatoes are tender
5. Add cream cheese and mix until blended , then add ham and stir until heated through
6. Mix in 3 / 4 cup cheddar cheese
7. Ladle into bowls and top with remaining cheddar

title: chinese  ramen  noodle salad
steps:
1. Wisk together the sugar , oil , vinegar , and seasoning packets from the ramen noodles , dissolving throughly for the dressing
2. Mix together the almonds , noodles , slaw mix , and onions
3. Pour the dressing over the top of the slaw mixture
4. Refrigerate for at least 4-6 hours before serving
5. Serve !

title: cream cheese filling for cakes
steps:
1. In a bowl beat all ingredients until smooth
2. Layer half of the cake batter in pan
3. Top / spoon with the cream cheese mixture , then top with remaining cake batter
4. Bake as directed

title: new mexico green chili stew
steps:
1. In large pot brown meat with onion , drain
2. Add all other ingredients and stir well
3. Bring to a boil then simmer for 45 minutes to 1 hour
4. You must keep tasting this to get the salt and pepper right
5. Fabulous with cornbread !

title: chinese sticky ribs
steps:
1. For the ribs: adjust oven rach to middle position and heat oven to 250 degrees
2. With
3. Grab membrane with paper towel and pull it off slowly in a single piece
4. Combine remaining ingredients in a large roasting pan
5. Add ribs to pan , turning to coat both sides , and arrange meaty side down
6. Cover pan tightly with foil and cook until just tender , 2
7. 5-3 hours transfer ribs to a large plate
8. For the glaze: strain 3 cups cooking liquid from roasting pan into large nonstick skillet , and discard solids and remaining liquid
9. Do not wash roasting pan
10. Using wide spoon , skim fat from liquid
11. Stir in jelly and vinegar
12. Bring to simmer over medium high heat and cook until syrupy and reduced to 2 cups , about 15-20 minutes
13. Off heat , stir in cilantro and cayenne
14. Heat broiler
15. Pour enough water into roasting pan to cover bottom and fit pan with a flat roasting rack
16. Reserve 1 / 2 cup glaze for serving
17. Arrange ribs on rack meaty side down and brush with glaze
18. Place roasting pan back on middle rack in oven and broil until beginning to brown , 2-4 minutes
19. Flip ribs over , brush with more glaze , then broil , brusing ribs with glaze every 2-4 minutes until ribs are deep mahogany color , 9-12 minutes
20. Transfer ribs to cutting board , tent with foil and let rest 10 minutes
21. Slice between bones , transfer ribs to platter , brush with reserved glaze
22. Sprinkle with scallions
23. Serve

title: spinach salad with salmon
steps:
1. Heat broiler , with rack set 4 inches from heat
2. Place salmon on a foil-lined rimmed baking sheet
3. Season with salt and pepper
4. Broil , without turning , until opaque throughout , 7 to 9 minutes
5. Let cool briefly , then flake
6. Divide spinach and tomatoes among serving plates
7. Top with salmon , goat cheese , and pecans , and drizzle with vinaigrette

title: filet mignon marinated
steps:
1. Combine first 5 ingredients in a large shallow container
2. Add steaks
3. Cover and marinate 3 hours in refrigerater turning occasionally
4. Remove steaks from marinade
5. Grill over hot coals 5 to 7 minutes on each side or until desired doneness

title: 100  whole wheat bread  abm
steps:
1. Microwave buttermilk for 30secs to a minute so it's lukewarm
2. Add all ingredients to breadmachine in the order listed
3. Select 1
4. 5 lbs loaf
5. If the mixture is too dry add one tablespoon of buttermilk and a time & if it's too wet add a tablespoon of flour at a time
6. Make sure the buttermilk or flour is completely incorporated before adjusting again

title: german french toast
steps:
1. Melt butter in a skillet on medium heat
2. In a small bowl , beat together eggs , milk and salt
3. Dip bread slices one at a time in egg mixture , and fry in butter until bolden brown
4. After turning once , top each slice of bread with a slice of muenster cheese
5. Cover skillet until the cheese is melted
6. Serve and enjoy

title: spelt  wheat free   popovers
steps:
1. In a large bowl , whisk in the yeast to the warm water and stir well
2. Let it sit for about 3 minutes
3. Add the sugar and with an electric beater , mix well
4. Add the softened butter and egg and using the mixer continue to stir
5. Add the flours and xanthum gum
6. Stir in the flour well with a spatula
7. The dough should be a little bit thicker than a muffin batter , but not as stiff as a bread dough
8. If it is too dry , add a little more water so thin it out some
9. Grease a muffin pan with some buttered flavor pan spray
10. With a ice cream scooper , scoop out into individual muffin cups
11. Bake for about 15-18 minutes at 350 degrees
12. Allow to cool for a few minutes before serving
13. Serve warm

title: mustard roasted red potatoes
steps:
1. Pre heat oven to 425f
2. Combine all ingredients except for potatoes
3. The toss the potatoes in with the mustard mixture until thoroughly coated
4. Bake on large greesed pan for 25 minutes
5. Toss the potatoes around , then bake for another 20 minutes

title: angel asiago crab cakes
steps:
1. Set a large pot of water on the stove with 2 teaspoons salt , bring to a boil , and cook the angel hair pasta until al dente
2. Drain , do not rinse as you need this starchiness to help combine the cakes
3. Place butter or oil in a skillet on medium heat , add the garlic , shallots and reduce heat , do not burn garlic or it will turn bitter and ruin your whole dish
4. Carmelize till golden
5. Remove from heat
6. Place mixture in a large mixing bowl add in the eggs , parsley , and mustard , combine well
7. Add in the drained pasta and toss with your clean hands coating all well
8. Chop the pasta into smaller lengths if desired , into thirds is a nice size
9. Add the grated cheese flour diced peppers crab meat , and spices again tossing to combine
10. Heat oil just to cover the bottom of a large shallow skillet
11. Heat on medium high
12. Form patties , and fry until golden on each side about 3 minutes , until brown and crispy
13. Do not overcrowd your skillet this will allow crispiness to occur
14. Drain on paper towels , until serving
15. These are good warm or room temperature
16. I serve these with a tossed mixed salad , and also make a roasted red pepper and balsamic dip for the cakes and a toasted french bread bruschetta
17. Balsamic dip is usually 2 roasted red peppers with 1 tablespoon balsamic vinegar dash salt , placed in a blender until pureed or constistency you desire
18. You may add 1 tablespoon of a light olive oil also in the puree if desired
19. The oil will give a slight shine

title: john and yoko s double fantasy bars
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f
2. In a bowl combine the butter and cookie crumbs
3. Then press the mixture into the bottom of a 13x9 inch baking pan
4. I normally do not grease the pan , but line with with parchment paper
5. When it's ready and baked , i just lift the whole thing out of the pan and let it cool , and there is practically no pan cleanup !
6. Pour the sweetened condensed milk evenly over the crumbs
7. Scrape out the can with a spatula , you want to get every precious drop of the stuff
8. Combine the m&m's baking bits , coconut , and nuts
9. Sprinkle mixture evenly over the condensed milk
10. Press the sprinkled stuff in lightly with your hands , be gentle
11. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until set
12. Cool completely before cutting
13. Store in a tightly covered container , hidden away from the rest of the member of your family

title: almost like ginger s enchiladas
steps:
1. Boil diced carrots and potatoes in water until tender
2. Drain
3. In a large bowl , mix together ground beef , potatoes , carrots and 2 cups of cheese
4. Salt to taste
5. Place the tortillas in between two damp paper towels
6. Place in the microwave for 15-30 seconds until soft
7. With a large serving spoon , place one heaping spoonful of meat / veggie / cheese mixture in the center of each tortilla
8. Roll each tortilla up tightly and place in a 9 x 13 casserole dish
9. This will be a tight fit , but squeeze them together so they all fit
10. Pour both cans of enchilada sauce over the enchiladas , making certain each tortilla is covered in sauce
11. Place in a pre heated 350 degree oven for 25 minutes
12. Pull from the oven and top with remaining shredded cheese
13. Place back in the oven and bake an additional 5 minutes , or until cheese is melted
14. These freeze very well and are great to pull out and reheat for a quick and easy lunch

title: utterly deadly southern pecan pie
steps:
1. In saucepan boil sugar and corn syrup together for 2 to 3 minutes
2. Set aside to cool slightly
3. In large bowl beat eggs lightly and very slowly pour the syrup mixture into the eggs , stirring constantly
4. At this point i like to strain the mixture to make sure it's smooth and lump free
5. Stir in butter , vanilla , and pecans and pour into crust
6. Bake in a 350f oven for about 45 to 60 minutes or until set

title: holiday popcorn
steps:
1. Toss popcorn , nuts , apricots and raisins
2. Blend corn syrup , brown sugar , vanilla and salt
3. Pour over popcorn mixture
4. Toss until evenly coated
5. Put on buttered jelly roll pan
6. Bake at 250 for 30 minutes , stirring occasionally

title: cheesy buttery puff
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375f
2. Spread cracker crumbs onto bottom of 9-inch square baking dish sprayed with cooking spray
3. Microwave milk , velveeta and cream cheese in large microwaveable bowl on high 1-1 / 2 minute or until smooth , stirring after each minute
4. Whisk egg yolks and chives until well blended
5. Stir into velveeta mixture
6. Beat egg whites in small bowl with mixer on high speed until stiff peaks form
7. Gently stir into velveeta mixture
8. Pour into prepared dish
9. Bake 20 to 25 minute or until puffed and golden
10. Serve immediately
11. Healthy living:
12. Save 30 calories and 4 g of fat per serving by preparing with 2% milk velveeta and philadelphia neufchatel cheese
13. Substitute:
14. Prepare using 1 / 2 teaspoons freeze-dried chopped chives
15. Nutrition information per serving : 200 calories , 15g total fat , 8g saturated fat , 180mg cholesterol , 450mg sodium , 7g carbohydrate , 0g dietary fiber , 4g sugars , 10g protein , 15%dv vitamin a , 0%dv vitamin c , 20%dv calcium , 6%dv iron
16. Nutrition information per serving : 170 calories , 11g total fat , 5g saturated fat , 165mg cholesterol , 470mg sodium , 8g carbohydrate , 0g dietary fiber , 4g sugars , 10g protein , 15%dv vitamin a , 0%dv vitamin c , 15%dv calcium , 4%dv iron

title: ultimate grilled cheese   gotta try this
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl , beat cream cheese and mayonnaise until smooth
2. Stir in cheddar cheese , mozzarella cheese , garlic powder and season-all
3. Butter one side of all pieces of bread
4. Place half of the buttered breads butter-side down into frying pan
5. Top with 1 / 3 cup of the cheese mixture
6. Top with the remaining bread , butter side up
7. Cook on medium heat until golden brown on both sides

title: steamed cauliflower in spicy tomato sauce
steps:
1. Place cut cauliflower in saucepan with water and 1 / 2 tsp salt
2. Cover and simmer till cauliflower is crisp-tender , about 10 minute set aside and cover to keep warm
3. Heat small skillet over low heat and roast cumin seeds until dark and fragrant
4. Remove cumin from pan and set aside to cool
5. Add coriander seeds to pan and slowly roast them till dark brown
6. Do not burn spices
7. When coriander seeds have cooled , use clean coffee grinder to grind them with the cumin seeds and set aside
8. Heat oil in large saucepan and add ginger , garlic , and turmeric
9. Stir constantly over medium heat until mixture turns golden brown
10. This will happen quickly , so be careful not to burn it
11. Crush tomatoes with hands and add them to pan along with juices
12. When tomatoes come to a boil , stir in chile , cayenne , cumin , coriander , and remaining 1 / 2 tsp salt
13. Lower heat and simmer sauce about 8 minutes or till tomatoes are well cooked
14. The oil will start to separate from sauce
15. Add cilantro and simmer 1-2 more minutes
16. Place warm cauliflower on platter , pour sauce over it , and serve dish immediately

title: lemony lemon brownies
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease an 88 inch baking dish with butter and set aside
3. Zest and juice two lemons and set aside
4. In the bowl of an electric mixture fitted with the paddle attachment , beat the flour , sugar , salt , and softened butter until combined
5. In a separate bowl , whisk together the eggs , lemon zest , and lemon juice until combined
6. Pour it into the flour mixture and beat for 2 mins at medium speed until smooth and creamy
7. Pour into baking dish and bake for 23-25 mins , should turn golden around the edges
8. Allow to cool completely before glazing
9. Do not overbake , or the bars will dry
10. Filter the powdered sugar and whisk with lemon zest and juice
11. Spread the glaze over the brownies with a rubber spatula and let glaze set
12. Cut into bars and serve

title: texas rancher chicken  n  dumplings
steps:
1. Place the washed whole raw chicken in a large pot , if you are using a whole chicken cover it with water
2. If you are using a package of chicken breast meat , cut into cubes raw , and pour about 6-8 cups of water over it
3. I don't really measure this out , but the liquid should be about halfway in your pot
4. Chop up one leek , white part only
5. Add to the pot along with the chicken stock cubes and all of the dry spices , i really use about a pinch of each spice , but you should add to suit your own taste
6. On a medium heat , boil the chicken and leek with spices until the chicken is totally cooked through
7. If you are using a whole chicken this will be around 1 hour , adding more water when necessary
8. If using cut up pieces it will be about 30 minutes
9. If using a whole chicken remove it from the broth and place in a separate bowl at this stage
10. You will now remove all the skin and bones from the chicken and disgard them , and put only the meat of the chicken back into the broth , you may want to let it cool a bit before handling it
11. If i am using a whole chicken i usually just put the breast and wing meat back into my dumplings , and save all of the dark meat for chicken salad sandwiches
12. If you are using already cut up chicken for this recipe , you can simply proceed to the next step
13. Add fresh chopped celery and carrots and continue boiling with chicken
14. If you are using frozen vegetables , add them now and boil for about 10 minutes in the broth
15. Add cream of chicken soup and stir well , you may need to add more water , if it has boiled down a great deal
16. You may add as many or as few vegetables as you like
17. For me it depends on what i have on hand , the onion or leek is very important , but you can add any other vegies to suit your own taste
18. I have found that using the frozen mixed vegetables and frozen green beans turns out really yummy , and is much easier than cutting up all the celery and carrots
19. Either way it turns out nicely even without any extra vegies
20. Check the consistancy of your broth
21. It should be thick and soupy , but you want enough liquid in there to cook your dumplings properly , so add more water to suit , i usually don't need to at this stage
22. Dumplings:
23. Combine all dry ingredients in bowl , mix together well with a whisk
24. Add margarine spread and mix well with the whisk until it is combined well with the dry mixture and is crumbly
25. Add milk a little bit at a time pressing with a fork on the side until well mixed
26. You should now be able to handle the dough with your hands , you may need a little more or less milk
27. Quickly press the dough together with your hands creating a nice ball if it is too sticky dust with a bit of flour
28. Don't handle the dough very long , the less you handle it the lighter and fluffier your dumplings will be
29. Pinch off balls of the dough , loosely squeeze with your fingers and plop into the boiling soup
30. Your dumplings should be a bit smaller than a ping pong ball
31. Dumplings should completely dive into the soup getting totally covered with liquid then pop back up sitting on the top of the soup while cooking
32. Boil the dumplings uncovered for 15 minutes in the chicken vegie broth
33. I repeat -- do not cover the pot while cooking the dumplings or they will end up soggy in the middle
34. Dumplings should be biscuit like in the center when done
35. Enjoy !

title: homemade condensed cream of chicken or mushroom or celery soup
steps:
1. In medium-sized saucepan , boil chicken broth , 1 / 2 cup of the milk , and the seasonings for a minute or two
2. In a bowl , whisk together the remaining 1 cup of milk and flour
3. Add to boiling mixture and continue whisking briskly until mixture boils and thickens
4. Add the ingredient that forms the basis of the soup
5. Chop mushrooms , saute in a bit of olive oil and add for cream of mushroom soup
6. Add chicken for cream of chicken soup
7. Don't have poultry seasoning ? make your own like i did -- try the recipezaar recipe #23966 - homemade poultry seasoning
8. This is awesome in my posted recipe "easy chicken & noodles -- the best" recipe #359244
9. It makes that recipe not quite as easy , but less salty and more delicious
10. I would double this recipe and freeze extra if using it for that purpose

title: laurie s guacamole
steps:
1. Coarsely mash the avocados in a bowl with the lime juice
2. Stir in remaining ingredients

title: masters black eyed peas
steps:
1. Rinse peas , place in pot with seasonings
2. Cover with water
3. Cook uncovered till done
4. Serve over rice with jalapeo corn bread

title: eggs   chicken soup
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine eggs and soup
2. Whip mixture until thoroughly smooth
3. Pour into heated and greased skillet
4. Heat until firm and fluffy , constantly folding egg and soup mixture
5. Serve and enjoy !

title: cajun lamb skewers   sour cream dressing
steps:
1. Brush lamb strips with a little oil then roll in cajun seasoning and thread onto oiled bamboo skewers
2. Cook skewers on a heated , oiled bbq plate until browned on all sides and cooked to your liking
3. While lamb is cooking , combine all remaining ingredients adding a little water to thin if needed
4. Serve lamb skewers with dressing

title: fresh garden relish
steps:
1. Grind the cabbages , carrots , onions and peppers in a food chopper , then add salt and let stand 2 hours
2. Place in a colander and drain
3. Wash if mixture is too salty
4. Add the vinegar , sugar , celery seed and mustard seed and stir well
5. Heat and pour into sterilized jars and seal
6. Variation: instead of carrots , i used grated summer squash , green tomatoes and added 6-8 hot jalapeno peppers

title: sopaipilla cheese cake
steps:
1. In a 9x13-inch glass dish roll out one can of crescent rolls , pinch together seams
2. In a large bowl blend the cream cheese , powder sugar and vanilla with a beater until creamy
3. Spread the cream cheese mixture over the rolls
4. Top the cream cheese with the second can of crescent rolls
5. Pinch the seams to form the crust
6. Pour the melted butter over the rolls , mix the sugar and cinnamon and sprinkle over the top of rolls
7. Cook for 30 minutes at 350f

title: crock pot baked apples
steps:
1. Core apples , combine brown sugar and dried fruit and fill the centres of the apples with the sugar / fruit mixture
2. Place the apples in a 5- to 6-quart crock pot
3. Combine the wine or apple juice with the melted butter and pour it over the apples
4. Sprinkle the apples with cinnamon and nutmeg
5. Cover the crock pot and cook on low for 2 to 3 hours or until the apples are tender
6. To serve , spoon the apples into individual dessert dishes , spoon the wine / apple juices over the apples , sprinkle with chopped nuts and cream or ice cream
7. How ironic my introductory words: "looks after itself"
8. True , but it seems crock pots sometimes have minds of their own and produce something other than what we had planned for them to make ! from reading many reviews on zaar , i've come to the conclusion that the results from crock pot recipes are sometimes more unpredictable than recipes made in other ways
9. Ive not had anything like ritas experience on this occasion , but rather the opposite , which is of course easier to deal with: ive several times had to continue cooking on low or to raise the setting to high with other crock pot recipes
10. And i've at times cooked crock pot recipes for hours longer than was specified , which has left me wondering how similar or different the low setting is on different brands of crock pot
11. Ritas experience suggests that the cooking time needs to be seriously adjusted so until i have a chance to check out this recipe and report back , which i will do very soon , im changing the cooking time from the four to six hours suggested in the original recipe to two to three hours , or until the apples are tender
12. I thank rita for so graciously accepting the unforeseen fate of her beautiful apples
13. Such an enticing before picture ! and when she looked into her crock pot - her second picture - after three hours cooking: what a shock ! im just so glad that she hadnt gone off for six hours and left her apples and the crock pot to do their own thing - and i'm so pleased that at least the cooked apple sauce was delicious

title: it s a mild chili
steps:
1. Brown beef and onions
2. Add rest of ingredients
3. Simmer 20 minutes
4. The ingredients have time to meld together

title: german lemon poppy seed cake
steps:
1. In a medium bowl mix butter and sugar until creamy
2. Blend in each egg separately
3. Mix at least 2 minutes
4. Add lemon juice , lemon zest , sour cream and poppy seeds
5. Mix another 2 minutes
6. Into a separate bowl sift flour , baking powder , and salt
7. Gently blend flour mixture a little at a time into the batter mixture
8. Blend well
9. Pour into a greased loaf pan or bundt cake pan
10. Bake at 350 degrees f or 180 degrees celsius
11. Takes 60 minutes in loaf pan
12. If using bundt cake pan check for doneness at 45 minutes

title: soft pork tacos with spicy black beans
steps:
1. Prepare the beans: in a large saucepan , cover the beans with 2 inches of water and bring to a boil
2. Simmer over low heat for 1 hour , stirring occasionally
3. In a medium skillet , heat the vegetable oil
4. Add the onion , garlic and jalapeo and cook over moderate heat until softened , about 7 minutes
5. Add to the beans , along with the tomato , oregano and enough water to cover
6. Season with salt and pepper and simmer until the beans are tender , about 2 hours longer , replenishing the water if necessary
7. Meanwhile , cook the pork: preheat the oven to 300
8. In a small enameled cast-iron casserole , combine the broth with the garlic , onion , habanero and serrano chiles , bay leaf , cumin and teaspoon each of salt and pepper and bring to a simmer
9. Season the pork loin with salt and pepper and add it to the casserole
10. Cover with foil and bake for about 1 hour , turning the pork once , until tender
11. Transfer the pork to a plate and cover with plastic wrap until cool enough to handle
12. Remove the bay leaf
13. Shred the pork into strips and stir into the broth
14. Season with salt
15. Fill the tortillas with pork and serve with the black beans and salsa

title: super easy candied walnuts
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. On a cookie sheet "with sides" place a piece of parchment paper in the bottom of the pan
3. Add walnuts and spread out into one layer
4. Drizzle honey over all of the nuts
5. Add slices of butter and spread equally over top of the honey & nuts
6. Bake for 5 minutes or until butter and honey melts
7. Remove from oven and stir nut mixture , then flatten uniformly coated nuts
8. Bake for 5 more minutes
9. Remove from oven and stir nut mixture , then flatten uniformly coated nuts
10. Remove from oven and flatten nuts letting them cool
11. When cooled , about 10-15 minutes later , break them up
12. Enjoy !

title: honey ponzu salmon
steps:
1. Place salmon in a large plastic bag
2. Mix together marinade ingredients in a small bowl and pour over salmon
3. Let marinade for at least 2 hours and up to 5 hours
4. Move oven rack to highest position
5. Heat broiler on high for about 4-5 minutes
6. Dry off salmon fillets with paper towels and place on baking sheet
7. Broil for 6-9 minutes depending on how well you like your salmon cooked
8. Sprinkle with sesame seeds , serve with you desired side , and enjoy !

title: california crab salad
steps:
1. Flake crab with 1 t lemon juice in large bowl
2. Add onion , celery , vinegar , soy sauce , worcestershire , and 1 t dill
3. Stir until mixed
4. Stir in mayonnaise
5. Add salt and pepper to taste
6. Slice avocado into bitesize pieces and sprinkle with remaining 1 t lemon juice and 1 / 2 t dill
7. Gently stir avocados and olives into the salad
8. Taste and adjust seasonings as needed
9. Serve or refrigerate for several hours

title: edinburgh squares
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees farenheit
2. Lightly grease a 10 x 15-inch jelly-roll pan
3. To prepare crust , combine oats , flour , sugar , cinnamon , ginger and salt in a large bowl
4. Use a pastry blender or two knives to cut in butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs
5. Stir in eggs
6. Turn dough into prepared pan and use a rubber spatula to spread evenly over bottom
7. Bake crust for 15 minutes
8. Remove from the oven
9. Cool on a rack for 10 minutes
10. To prepare filling , combine currants , cherries , coconut , nuts and ginger in a large bowl
11. Set aside
12. In a medium bowl , stir together butter , golden syrup and eggs
13. Add to fruit-nut mixture and stir to combine
14. Spread evenly over baked crust
15. Bake 22 to 27 minutes , or until golden brown
16. Cook on rack
17. To prepare glaze , combine sugar and golden syrup in a medium bowl
18. Stir in enough orange juice or milk to make a smooth , creamy glaze of medium consistency
19. Drizzle glaze over cooled cookies
20. Let glaze set before cutting into 70 squares , cutting 7 strips one way and 10 strips the other way
21. Store in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 1 week or freeze for longer storage

title: curried lamb casserole with sweet potatoes
steps:
1. Heat oil in large nonstick dutch oven
2. Dust lamb with flour
3. Add to hot oil
4. Saute lamb for 2 minutes or just until seared all over
5. Remove lamb from the dutch oven
6. Set aside
7. Add garlic , onion , carrots , green pepper , and sweet potatoes to dutch oven
8. Cook , stirring often , for 8 to 10 minutes or until tender
9. Add mushrooms
10. Cook until softened , about 3 minutes
11. Add stock , wine , tomato paste , and curry powder
12. Return lamb to pan
13. Cover and simmer for 1 1 / 2 hours , stirring occasionally

title: japanese steakhouse ginger dipping sauce
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in blender
2. Process until smooth

title: sugar free caramel corn
steps:
1. Melt butter in large sauce pan , add xylitol and cook over med heat for 2-3 minutes
2. Working very quickly , add baking soda stirring as it foams
3. As foaming subsides , drizzle over popped corn
4. Bake at 275 for 1 hour , gently stirring every 15 m inutes

title: garlic confit
steps:
1. In a small saucepan heat all ingredients and cook over low heat for 1 hour
2. Remove from heat , cool
3. Store refrigerated in container with tight lid

title: low fat  sugar free cornbread
steps:
1. Combine ingredients in a large bowl , then mix by hand until batter is just moistened
2. Pour into 9 large muffin cups or a 9x9 cake pan sprayed with pam
3. Bake for 25-30 minutes at 350 degrees f

title: chocolate kahlua parfaits
steps:
1. You will also need: 8 champagne flutes
2. In a large , microwave-safe glass bowl , mix the marshmallows with the milk and the coffee powder
3. Cover the bowl with a glass plate and microwave the mixture for 2 minutes on high or until there are no lumps remaining when it is stirred
4. Put the bowl in the refrigerator and allow the mixture to cool completely
5. It could take up to an hour
6. Remove the marshmallow mixture from the refrigerator and beat in the kahlua using the whisk attachment of an electric mixer
7. Then add 1 cup of the whipped topping and whisk it inches next fold in another cup of the whipped topping using a spatula
8. Spoon approximately 1 tablespoon of the crumbs into one of the flutes
9. Then spoon enough pie mixture into the flute so that it is approximately half-full
10. Top that will another tablespoon of crumbs
11. Then add enough additional pie filling to almost fill the flute
12. Top it with a dollop of remaining whipped topping and lightly sprinkle the top with additional crumbs
13. Repeat the procedure until all 8 flutes are filled
14. Refrigerate them until the filling sets , approximately 2 hours

title: black forest gateau   cake
steps:
1. Cherry filling: stir together the drained cherries , 1 / 4 cup reserved syrup and the kirsch
2. Set aside while preparing cakes
3. To make the sponge cakes: preheat oven to 350f and butter 8-inch round cake pans
4. Line bottoms of pans with parchment paper and then butter the paper also
5. Put yolks and sugar into the bowl of your stand mixer and beat on medium speed until the mixture has at least doubled in volume , is very thick and mousse-like and a wide ribbon trail slowly falls back into the bowl when beaters are lifted
6. This could take 5 minutes or more
7. Don't short the time here !
8. Sift in the cocoa and gently fold with a large spoon
9. In another large bowl , beat the egg whites until stiff peaks form
10. Carefully fold egg whites into chocolate mixture , 1 / 3 at a time
11. Divide the batter into the 3 prepared pans and bake for 20-25 minutes , until cakes spring back when touched and have pulled away from sides of pans
12. Let cakes cool in the pans for 10 minutes
13. Invert onto a wire rack & peel off the paper
14. Now go back to your cherries - drain them but hold onto the syrup ! place the cherries on paper towels to dry
15. Set aside 12 or so for garnish
16. Cream filling:
17. In the clean bowl of your stand mixer , or with an electric mixer , beat the cream until soft peaks form
18. Sprinkle in the sugar and whip until slightly thicker
19. Assembly: place 1 cake layer on a large serving platter
20. Sprinkle with 2 tablespoons reserved syrup
21. Spread with 1 / 4 of the cream filling
22. Press 1 / 2 of the cherries into the cream
23. Stack on the second cake layer
24. Sprinkle it with reserved kirsch syrup as before
25. Spread with 1 / 4 of the cream & the rest of the cherries
26. Top with final cake layer & sprinkle with remaining syrup
27. Cover the top and sides with all the remaining whipped cream - you can either pipe it or spread it on - then garnish with the reserved cherries & grated chocolate
28. Refrigerate until serving time
29. Best eaten within 48 hours

title: rocky road zucchini brownies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325f
2. Mix first eight ingredients together
3. Fold in nuts and marshmallows
4. Spray a 8x12-inch pan pour in mixed ingredients
5. Place the entire pan into another shallow pan full of water
6. Bake at 325 for 30-40 min or until desired doneness
7. Enjoy !

title: guinness stew  pressure cooker
steps:
1. Cook bacon , drain and chop coarsely , set aside
2. Heat oil in bottom of cooker and brown beef in batches , set aside
3. Melt butter in cooker , add onions and mushrooms
4. Cook until liquid is evaporated stir in tomato paste , whisk in guinness , mustard and salt and pepper
5. One tablespoon at a time , add flour until desired consistency
6. Add beef and bacon back to cooker , on med - high heat , get the rocker rocking loudly , reduce heat to med - low and let rock gently for 30 - 40 minutes
7. If you don't want your beef to absolutely fall apart in your mouth , reduce the cooking time by about 10 to 15 minutes
8. Run pressure cooker under cold water to release pressure quickly and enjoy !

title: grilled chicken with cherry chipotle barbecue sauce
steps:
1. Stir cherries , broth , preserves , ketchup , vinegar , chipotle peppers , thyme and allspice in a small deep bowl
2. Transfer to a shallow non-reactive dish or sealable bag , large enough to hold chicken
3. Add the chicken and turn to coat well
4. Cover and marinate in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours , overnight is better
5. Preheat grill to high
6. Oil the grill by placing folded paper towel in tongs and rub it over the racks
7. Remover chicken from the marinade
8. Transfer the narinade to a medium skillet
9. Reduce the grill heat to medium and grill the chicken until cooked through and no longer pink in the middle , 7 to 9 minutes per side
10. Meanwhile , bring the marinade to a boil
11. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook until the sauce is reduced by about half , 12 to 15 minutes
12. Let the chicken cool slightly
13. Serve with the sauce

title: peanut thai shrimp and noodles
steps:
1. Thoroughly combine soy sauce , rice vinegar , garlic and peanut butter
2. Bring a large pot of water to a boil
3. Cook spaghette for 9 minutes , add broccoli and cook for 2 more minutes , add shrimp and cook for 2 more minutes
4. Drain
5. Mix in peanut butter mixture and red pepper flakes and serve hot

title: apple black currant cider
steps:
1. In a saucepan , combine all ingredients
2. Simmer over medium heat for 10 to 15 minutes
3. Strain hot cider and serve in mugs with cinnamon sticks and orange peel for garnish

title: traditional king cake
steps:
1. Cook the first 4 ingredients in a medium saucepan over low heat , stirring often , until butter melts
2. Set aside and cool mixture to 100-110
3. Stir the yeast , cup warm water , and 1 tablespoons sugar in a 1 cup glass measuring cup
4. Let mixture stand 5 minutes
5. Beat sour cream mixture , yeast mixture , eggs , and 2 cups flour at medium speed with a heavy-duty stand mixer until smooth
6. Decrease speed to low , and gradually add enough remaining flour until a soft dough forms
7. Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface
8. Knead until smooth and elastic
9. Place in a well-greased bowl , turning to grease the top
10. Cover and let rise in a warm place , free from drafts , 1 hour or until dough is doubled in bulk
11. Punch down dough , and divide in half
12. Roll each portion into a 22x12 inch rectangle
13. Spread 1 / 3 cup softened butter evenly on each rectangle , leaving a 1-inch border
14. Stir cup sugar and cinnamon together
15. Sprinkle evenly over butter on each rectangle
16. Roll up each dough rectangle , jelly-roll fashion , starting at 1 long side
17. Place 1 dough roll seam side down , on a lightly greased baking sheet
18. Bring ends of roll together to form an oval ring , moistening and pinching edges together to seal
19. Repeat with second dough roll
20. Cover and let rise in a warm place free from drafts , 20-30 minutes or until doubled in bulk
21. Bake in a 375 oven for 14-16 minutes or until golden
22. Make glaze: stir together the first 4 glaze ingredients
23. Stir in 2 tablespoons milk , adding more milk , 1 teaspoon at a time , until spreading consistency
24. Slightly cool cakes on pans on wire racks
25. Drizzle creamy glaze evenly over warm cakes , sprinkle with colored sugars , alternating colors and forming bands
26. Let cool completely

title: easy buffalo chicken bake
steps:
1. Pour brown rice into medium size casserole dish
2. Trim and rinse chicken breasts
3. Lay on top of rice
4. Drizzle chicken with hot sauce then ranch dressing
5. Top with shredded cheese
6. Cover and bake at 375 for about 1 hour
7. Remove cover for last 15 minutes for crispier topping
8. Let cool and serve celery stalks on side with some dip

title: pancakes on the go
steps:
1. Combine all the dry ingredients in a mixing bowl
2. In another bowl beat egg , buttermilk , and oil
3. Stir into dry ingredients and mix well
4. Pour batter by 1 / 3 cupfulls onto a lightly greased , hot griddle
5. Turn when bubbles form on the tops of the pancakes
6. Cook until other side is golden brown
7. Serve lightly buttered , or with syrup , or just plain !

title: fruited apple nut cake
steps:
1. Spray interior of slow cooker with non stick cooking spray
2. Place pie filling in slow cooker
3. In a mixing bowl , combine dry cake mix , and butter , and spoon over filling
4. Drop walnuts over top
5. Cover , and cook on low for 3-5 hours , or until a toothpick inserted into center comes out clean

title: very best bread  bread machine
steps:
1. Add to bread machine in order given
2. Bake on light crust setting

title: scampi skewers
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425f
2. In a small bowl , combine the panko , butter , egg , garlic , lemon zest , lemon juice , wine , basil , parsley and salt
3. Place 2 shrimp on a cutting board , nestled tail to body , forming a yin-yang design , and thread onto a skewer
4. Repeat with two more pairs of shrimp , 6 shrimp per skewer
5. Trim the skewers with scissors if necessary and if wooden to fit on the serving plates
6. Put the shrimp in a baking dish
7. Cover with the butter mixture , dotting it on top
8. Bake until the shrimp are pink and just cooked through , 10 to 12 minutes

title: coffee beef roast
steps:
1. In a large nonstick skillet , brown roast over medium-high heat on all sides in oil
2. Transfer roast to slow cooker
3. In the same skillet , saute mushrooms , onions , and garlic until tender
4. Stir the coffee , liquid smoke , salt , chili powder , and pepper into the vegetables
5. Pour over the roast
6. Cook on low 8-10 hoursor until meat is tender
7. Remove roast and keep warm
8. Pour cooking juices into a 2 cup measuring cup
9. Skim fat
10. Combine cornstarch and water into a saucepan until smooth
11. Gradually stir in the 2 cups of cooking juices
12. Bring to a boil
13. Cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened
14. Serve

title: excessively simple cream of tomato soup
steps:
1. Pour the tomatoes into the pot you're cooking with and set the stove on high
2. Heat until the tomatoes are bubbling
3. This will take less than five minutes so keep your eye on it
4. Once the tomatoes are bubbling , add the other ingredients and turn the heat to medium
5. Cook until it's bubbling again or until it's as hot as you want it
6. Pour into a mug and enjoy !

title: philly bacon wrapped chicken with fried green beans
steps:
1. Mix cream cheese , chives and lemon juice in a bowl
2. Preheat oven to 350
3. Slice a slit in the chicken breast and use your fingers to create a pocket
4. Fill chicken with 1 / 4 of your cream cheese mixture and secure closed with toothpicks
5. Wrap chicken in bacon and bake in oven for 45 min or until chicken is cooked throughout
6. Green beans
7. Slice bacon into 1 / 2 inch strips
8. Pan fry bacon and onions until bacon is crispy
9. Turn frying pan to low and mix in green beans
10. Pan fry beans on low for 10 min or until cooked

title: peach salsa
steps:
1. Sterilize 8 , 1 / 2 pint jars , then place upside down in a 325 f oven for about 15 minutes
2. Blanch peaches , cool in cold water , peel , pit and chop to measure 6 cups
3. Blanch tomatoes and cool with cold water , peel , remove seeds and cut into chunks
4. In a large stainless or enamel cooking pot , combine peaches , tomatoes , onion , jalapeno peppers , sweet red pepper , cilantro , vinegar , honey , garlic , cumin and cayenne pepper
5. Bring to a boil , and cook for about 5 minutes , stirring frequently
6. If the mixture is too sloppy or soupy , boil for a few minutes longer so that some of the liquid evaporates and the mixture thickens
7. Adjust seasonings to taste
8. Add more cayenne pepper if you desire a spicier taste
9. Ladle salsa into hot jars to within 1 / 4 inch of top for headspace
10. Remove air bubbles by sliding a rubber spatula between the glass and salsa
11. Re-adjust the headspace to 1 / 4 inch
12. Wipe jar rim to remove any stickiness
13. Center lid on top of jar
14. Apply screw band just until finger tight
15. Place jars in a hot bath in a canner and process for 10 minutes
16. Remove jars and place on a towel , then cover with another towel to cool slowly
17. Jars are sealed when the lids pop and are curved down ,
18. Label jars and store in a cool , dark place

title: candy bar parfaits
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine the peanuts , pretzels , and chopped candy bar
2. Spoon 2 tablespoons into each of 4 parfait glasses , and top each with 1 / 4 cup ice cream , 2 tablespoons peanut mixture , and another 1 / 4 cup ice cream
3. Combine chocolate syrup , and peanut butter , and drizzle over ice cream
4. Sprinkle with remaining peanut mixture

title: pistachio cake and frosting
steps:
1. Blend cake mix , eggs , oil , sprite and one box of pudding mix
2. Beat with a mixer for 2 minutes
3. Pour into a 9x13-inch pan
4. Bake 350 for 35-45 minutes
5. Cool completely
6. For frosting , stir one box of pudding mix with milk , then fold in cool whip
7. Spread on cooled cake
8. Keep refrigerated

title: sugared bacon appetizers
steps:
1. Cut each slice of bacon into two short pieces
2. Mix sugar and cinnamon together and thoroughly coat each piece of bacon
3. Twist slices and place on pan or a jellyroll pan in a 350f oven
4. Bake until bacon is crisp and sugar is bubbly , 15 to 20 minutes
5. The sugar can burn quickly , so watch closely
6. Let cool and serve at room temperature

title: moist buttermilk pancakes with pumpkin puree
steps:
1. Sift all dry ingredients together into a large bowl
2. Make a small pit in the middle of the dry mix
