3. In a small bowl or large measuring cup stir together all the wet ingredients , then pour into the small pit in the dry mixture
4. Slowly and thoroughly , using wood spoon , blend all together until all large lumps are dissolved leaving mostly small lumps
5. Heat iron griddle to medium heat and using 1 / 4th cup batter per pancake , flipping as soon as bubbles appear and just before they are all popped
6. These are so moist you will not need butter on top
7. Recipe should make 6-8 four inch pancakes
8. Two pancakes per person

title: stuffed green bell peppers with clamato
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Remove the tops and seeds of the peppers
3. Rinse & dry and place upright in a baking dish
4. In a bowl , combine ground beef , rice , onion , oregano , 1 / 2 cup clamato juice , salt and pepper
5. Fill each pepper with the meat mixture , dividing evenly
6. Combine the remaining 2 cups of clamato juice with the ketchup and pour over the peppers
7. Cover with foil and bake for 1 1 / 2 hours

title: oatmeal master recipe with variations
steps:
1. Mix the oatmeal , milk , and 4 cups water in a large , deep saucepan and bring to a boil over medium high heat
2. When it boils , quickly turn the heat down to very low
3. Stir in brown sugar , dried fruits , and salt and cook at a low simmer for 15-20 minutes , or until very thick and creamy
4. Stir often to prevent bottom of pan from burning
5. Serve with additional milk , or cool and chill to reheat later in the week
6. Variations:
7. Apple cinnamon oatmeal:
8. Swap 2 granny smith apples , peeled , cored , and chopped for the dried fruit add 2 teaspoons ground cinnamon , plus more for serving
9. Banana nut oatmeal:
10. Swap 1 / 2 cup pure maple syrup for the brown sugar and 2 bananas , chopped , for the dried fruit

title: shrimp and rice casserole
steps:
1. Place rice , cream , and seasonings in pan and bring to boil
2. Add shrimp and cool
3. Refrigerate overnight
4. Turn into greased casserole and bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes or until nearly firm

title: paprika oven fries
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450f
2. Cut potatoes into 1-inch-wide wedges
3. Transfer to a rimmed baking sheet
4. Toss potatoes with canola oil and paprika
5. Season with salt and pepper
6. Bake potatoes in a single layer , cut sides down , until they loosen easily from the sheet , about 25 minutes
7. Turn the potatoes
8. Continue to bake them until fork-tender and crisp , 25-30 minutes more

title: quince jelly
steps:
1. Wash quinces well to remove the fuzz
2. Peel and core
3. Slice quinces into preserving pan
4. And add 2 cups water
5. Set aside and do not be concerned if quince discolours
6. Place peels and cores into a pan with remaining water and boil for 30 minutes
7. Strain and make liquid up to 2 cups with water
8. Add liquid from peels to sliced quinces in pan
9. Bring to the boil and simmer gently for 1 hour until quince flesh is very tender
10. Scald a large piece of cheese cloth or doubled butter muslin , wring out and drape over a deep bowl
11. Pour quince and liquid into clean cloth and gather up ends
12. Tie with string and suspend over bowl
13. And secure to a fixed object so that juice can drip slowly into bowl
14. Leave for 24 hours- do not squeeze bag to hasten dripping as this will make jelly cloudy
15. Measure juice into clean preserving pan
16. For each cup of juice add 1 cup sugar
17. Stir over heat till sugar dissolves , add lemon juice and washed geranium leaves and bring to a boil
18. Boil rapidly for 25 minutes , skimming frequently
19. Test a teaspoonful on a cold saucer and leave to cool
20. Run finger across jelly in saucer- setting point is reached when surface wrinkles
21. Remove leaves and ladle hot jelly into hot sterilized jars
22. Seal when cold

title: oven fried cajun potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Peel potatoes
3. Cut each potato lengthwise into 8 wedges
4. Place on ungreased jelly-roll pan
5. Toss potatoes with parsley , oil , garlic powder , onion powder , red pepper , thyme and black pepper until evenly coated
6. Bake 50 minutes , turning wedges halfway through cooking time
7. Serve immediately

title: puffy pancake with nutty banana butterscotch
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425f
2. Place 1 / 2 stick of butter into a 9-inch square baking dish and put it into the oven to melt , about 5 minutes
3. You could toast the chopped walnuts in a separate pan , in the oven at the same time or toast them in a pan on the stove top
4. Keep an eye on them so they do not burn and toast until fragrant
5. In a large bowl
6. Whisk the milk and eggs together
7. In another bowl , whisk the flour and granulated sugar together until blended , then whisk in the egg-milk mixture
8. Pour the batter into the prepared baking dish , bake until the pancake starts to rise and becomes puffy , about 15 - 20 minutes
9. Meanwhile , in a medium sized saucepan
10. Cook the brown sugar , salt , and 2 tablespoons of water over medium heat , stirring until bubbling , about 5 minutes
11. Stir in the other 1 / 2 stick of butter , the sour cream , and the sliced bananas
12. Heat through
13. Drizzle the pancake with half of the butterscotch-banana sauce and sprinkle with the toasted walnuts
14. Slice and serve with the rest of the sauce on the side

title: joan and john s corn pudding
steps:
1. Thaw the corn , rinse and let drain in a colander
2. Chop onion , garlic , and fresh thyme
3. Cook the bacon and drain on paper towels to remove as much grease as possible -crumble
4. Preheat oven to 350f butter a 2-quart baking dish and set aside
5. In a large skillet or saucepan , melt the four tablespoons of butter over medium - high heat
6. Add the onions and cook stirring for two minutes
7. Add the garlic and cook , stirring , for an additional minute
8. Add the flour and cook , stirring , until the mixture begins to turn golden , about five minutes
9. Add two teaspoons of the thyme , all but one cup of the corn , salt and stir to warm the corn , about four minutes
10. Set aside and let cool
11. In a large bowl , whisk the eggs , cream , and sugar until frothy
12. Add the remaining one teaspoon of thyme and black pepper
13. Put one cup of the custard mixture and one cup of corn in a food processor or blender and blend until smooth
14. Combine the corn mixture from the skillet / saucepan and the blended corn mixture into the bowl with the custard mixture
15. Add the crumbled bacon and sliced green onions and stir until thoroughly blended
16. Pour into the prepared two quart casserole dish and put into the heated oven
17. Bake until the custard is set and a knife inserted into the center of the dish comes out clean about 60 minutes
18. Remove from oven and let rest at least ten minutes before serving

title: double chocolate chip breakfast cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Mix together all dry ingredients in a large mixing bowl , cocoa through raisins
3. Mix with whisk and set aside
4. Mix together all wet ingredients in a medium bowl until fluffy
5. Make a well in the dry ingrendients , pour wet into the dry
6. Mix well
7. With sprayed hands , form about 6 large cookies , place on greased cookie sheets
8. Bake for 7-8 minutes for soft , chewy cookies or 10 minutes for dry cookies
9. Remove from pan and let cool on cookie racks
10. Store in tupperware , wax paper between cookies

title: cajun butter sauce
steps:
1. In a small bowl , mix together the cornstarch and broth until well combined
2. Set aside
3. In a saucepan , mix together spices and cook in hot butter for one minute
4. Add broth mixture , and bring to a boil
5. Whisk over high heat until mixture begins to thicken slightly
6. Remove from heat
7. Serve hot over vegetables

title: tapenade tomatoes
steps:
1. Cut tops off cherry tomatoes
2. Seed and turn tomatoes upside down on a plate to drain
3. Coarsely chop olives and set aside
4. Rinse anchovies in cold water and pat dry
5. In a blender or food processor fitted with steel blade , combine olives , anchovies , garlic , capers , basil , parsley , and lemon juice
6. Process until finely minced
7. Turn food processor or blender on and drizzle in olive oil
8. Remove mixture to a bowl and stir well
9. Pack each cherry tomato with about 1 1 / 2 teaspoons olive mixture
10. Set on parsley or lettuce-lined plate
11. Serve tepid

title: maritime gingersnaps
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Combine molasses and shortening in a small pan
3. Heat , stirring constantly , just to boiling over medium heat
4. Remove immediately from heat and allow to cool
5. Meanwhile , measure remaining ingredients into a large bowl
6. When molasses mixture has cooled , pour over flour mixture and mix well to combine
7. Chill dough for 10 minutes
8. Shape into small balls and arrange 2 inches apart on baking sheets
9. Flatten with bottom of a drinking glass or with fingers
10. Bake until dry and crisp , about 8-10 minutes
11. Watch carefully as they may easily burn
12. When done , place pan on cooling rack and cool cookies on baking sheet for 5 minutes
13. Remove from baking sheet to cooling rack and cool completely
14. Once completely cooled , store in an airtight container

title: taco bean dinner
steps:
1. Brown beef and drain
2. Add taco seasoning , tomato sauce and beans
3. Simmer 10 minutes
4. Place tortillas on a plate top with meat mixture then add cheese and sour cream

title: chicken keema  ground chicken
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large skillet , while oil heats , thinly slice both the green and yellow onions
2. Add to the pan and stir fry until light golden brown
3. Add ground chicken , pullao biryani malala and chicken tikka masala to the skillet and stir fry for around 10 minutes until the chicken is cooked through
4. Pour into serving plate and top with diced tomato and ginger
5. Enjoy !

title: mini meatloaf   low carb
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f spray a baking dish with cooking spray
2. Cut the 4 oz of cheese into 4 equal parts , longways
3. Mix together the ingredients for the sauce
4. Set both aside for later
5. Using your hands , mix the remaining ingredients together in a large bowl
6. Divide the mixture into 4 equal parts
7. Take the divided amount & shape it around 1 chunk of cheese , making it into a loaf shape
8. Place into the baking dish then repeat with the other 3
9. Brush the sauce over all 4 meatloaves
10. Bake in the oven for 35-40 minutes then drain off any excess grease
11. Serve immediately or let cool then freeze in individual containers for later use

title: turkish leeks
steps:
1. Trim the leeks
2. Remove a few of the outer layers
3. Slice 3 / 4 inch thich
4. Discard the tough green leaves
5. Wash several times in plenty of water and drain
6. In a heavy pan heat the olive oil
7. Stir in the leeks and carrots
8. Cover and cook 30 minutes over low heat , shaking the pan occasionally
9. Stir in the rice , sugar , salt , juice of 1 / 2 lemon and water
10. Cover and simmer 30 minutes or until leeks are tender
11. Check the liquid level and add hot water in very small quantities if necessary
12. When cooked it should be very moist but not watery
13. Serve cold sprinkled with lemon juice to taste
14. Like all cold olive oil dishes it is very good with crusty bread

title: absolutely apricot bread
steps:
1. Prepare as manufacturer suggests
2. This is from electric bread

title: portuguese poached meringue   pudim molokov
steps:
1. Apricot sauce: heat apricots , water , sugar and cinnamon in sauce pan
2. Cover and simmer 15 minutes
3. Place apricot mixture and lemon juice in blender , cover and blend on medium speed , until smooth , scraping sides for about 15 seconds
4. Stir in 1-2 tbsp water , and refrigerate 3 hours
5. Meringue: grease bundt pan and sprinkle with sugar
6. Heat oven to 350 degrees
7. Beat egg whites and cream of tartar until foamy
8. Beat in sugar , 1 tbsp at a time until soft peaks form
9. Pour into bundt pan and cut gently through the mixture with a butter knife
10. Pour about 1" of very hot water into a 9x13 pan , place the bundt pan in the water and bake until the top is golden brown and the meringue is set - about 45 minutes
11. Immediately loosen meringue from the edges of the pan , invert onto a plate
12. Cool 30 minutes uncovered
13. Cut meringue into wedges and serve with apricot sauce or cranberry sauce

title: holiday classic wassail
steps:
1. Place the cinnamon sticks , cloves , and allspice in the center of a large paper coffee filter
2. Fold the ends over and roll up burrito-style
3. Tie closed with dental floss or thread , leaving long ends
4. Mix apple juice concentrate with water as directed on can
5. In a saucepan combine apple juice , cranberry juice , sugar , and bitters
6. Bring to a boil
7. Tie the ends of the "spice bag" string to the middle of a wooden spoon and lay the spoon over the top of the pot so that the "spice bag" hangs in the juice without touching the bottom of the pot
8. Reduce heat and simmer at least 10 minutes
9. Remove from heat and add rum
10. Once i've made the wassail and added the rum , i pour this into a crock pot on low temp so that the warm wassail can be served up throughout the evening !

title: spicy kickin biscuits
steps:
1. Combine baking mix and taco seasoning in a large bowl
2. Add tomatoes , cheese and milk , stirring until soft dough forms
3. Drop dough by two tablespoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheets 2-3 inches apart
4. Bake at 425f for 12-15 minutes or until biscuits begin to brown
5. Serve warm with butter , if desired

title: bolitas de jamon  aruba
steps:
1. Mix the ground ham together with the egg , breadcrumbs , onion , parsley , seasoned salt and mustard
2. Shape the mixture into one or two inch balls and place on a lightly greased baking sheet
3. Bake at 350 degrees for 12 to 15 minutes
4. When the balls are done , let them cool for a few minutes
5. While they are cooling , put the apricot-pineapple jam into a small saucepan and heat to simmering
6. Then drop the balls into the jam and roll them around until they are coated and heated through
7. Serve immediately

title: creamy chicken tortilla soup
steps:
1. Combine tomatoes , broth , beans and corn in medium saucepan
2. Stir together and bring to a boil
3. Reduce and bring to a simmer , add chicken and heat through
4. Turn off heat and stir in cilantro
5. Top each bowl of soup with cheese and crushed tortilla chips

title: basque lemonade
steps:
1. Soak the lemon peel in the water for 24 hours
2. Add the sugar and both types of wine to the water
3. Add in the sliced lemons and chill before serving

title: simple microwave risotto
steps:
1. In a 3 quart , microwave safe casserole dish combine butter , garlic and onion
2. Place dish in microwave and cook on high for 3 minutes
3. Place vegetable broth in a second microwave safe dish
4. Heat on microwave until the broth is hot but not boiling
5. Stir the rice and broth into the casserole dish with the onion , butter and garlic mixture
6. Cover the dish tightly and cook on high for 6 minutes
7. Stir wine into the rice
8. Cook on high for 10 minutes more
9. Most of the liquid should boil off
10. Stir the cheese into the rice and serve

title: tuna macaroni salad with cheese
steps:
1. Cook macaroni
2. Drain
3. Rinse with cold water
4. Combine macaroni , cheese , tuna , pickles and onion in a large bowl
5. Stir together salad dressing , salt , pepper and garlic
6. Pour over macaroni mixture and toss
7. Cover
8. Chill at least 3 hours

title: citrus and cumin roasted chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Remove the zest from 2 orange wedges and 2 lime wedges and set aside
3. Rub chicken with juice of those wedges
4. Season the entire chicken , including the cavity , with the cumin , salt and pepper to taste
5. Inside the cavity , place the used orange and lime wedges , plus 3 orange wedges , 3 lime wedges , 2 cloves of garlic and 3 sprigs of oregano
6. Place a small roasting pan over high heat and add the oil
7. When the oil smokes , place the chicken , breast-side down in the pan
8. Sear , rolling slightly for even browning , until the breast is golden brown , about 4 to 5 minutes
9. Remove the chicken from the pan , slip a flat rack on bottom of pan , then place the chicken on the rack , breast-side up
10. Add the stock , remaining garlic cloves and a couple more sprigs of oregano to the pan
11. Squeeze the juice of the 7 orange wedges and remaining lime wedges into the pan , adding the juiced wedges to the pan as well
12. Roast until the chicken juices run clear when the leg is pieced near the joint , about 1 hour and 30 minutes
13. Check the moisture in the pan a few times while cooking , adding chicken broth if the pan juices are drying up
14. Transfer chicken to a warm platter , and allow it to rest for 20 minutes before carving
15. Remove the fruit wedges , oregano and garlic from the pan , then place the pan juices in a small saucepan
16. Bring to a simmer over medium heat , taste and adjust seasoning , adding more orange juice from the remaining wedges if desired
17. Remove from heat and add the reserved zest
18. Carve the chicken and serve with the sauce

title: chocolate coated macaroons
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Combine coconut , 1 teaspoon vanilla extract and salt in a medium bowl
3. Mix in sweetened condensed milk to form a thick paste and coat all coconut
4. Beat egg whites with 1 teaspoon cream of tartar until stiff
5. Fold egg whites into coconut mixture
6. Drop by rounded teaspoons onto parchment paper on cookie sheet , about 2 inches apart
7. Flatten slightly
8. Bake 8-10 minutes or until tops begin to turn light brown
9. Remove from oven and let cool on pan about 2 minutes
10. Remove from pan onto wire rack and let cool completely
11. Meanwhile , prepare glaze by melting chocolate chips
12. Add vanilla extract and powdered sugar to melted chocolate
13. Add water until chocolate mixture becomes a good consistency to dip the macaroons in
14. To coat macaroons , let cool completely
15. Dip the flat bottoms of macaroons into chocolate mixture then place them upside down on wire rack
16. Let the bottom coating cool either at room temperature , or you can stick em in the fridge to speed up the process
17. Once the coating has set on the bottoms , coat the tops and place back on wire rack with set bottom on the bottom
18. Allow chocolate to set

title: chicken   broccoli curry casserole
steps:
1. Bring chicken to a boil with salt , pepper and garlic
2. Turn to low , cover and simmer for about 40 minutes
3. Rinse and shred chicken into large pieces and set aside
4. Cut broccoli into bite size pieces and steam till cooked but slightly firm -- will continue to cook a bit in the oven
5. Put broccoli in the bottom of a 9x13 glass baking dish
6. In large pot combine soup , mayo , chicken broth , curry powder
7. I usually like about 4 t
8. Add a couple dashes of pepper
9. Heat over medium till warm
10. Add shredded chicken
11. Pour soup & chicken mixture over broccoli
12. Cover with shredded cheese
13. Top with crushed potato chips
14. Bake in 375 degree oven for about 30 minutes till bubbly and chips are golden brown
15. Serve over white rice and serve with garlic bread
16. Enjoy !

title: easy almond bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Line a 9x13" pan with foil and grease with butter
3. Blend together the flour , sugar , margarine , eggs , baking powder , almond extract and salt
4. Pour into pan , and spread evenly
5. Sprinkle with almonds and remaining tbsp of sugar
6. Bake for 30-35 minutes , until golden

title: cranberry   toasted almond brie en croute
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f spread almonds in one layer on ungreased shallow baking pan
2. Bake for 10-15 minutes , stirring occasionally , until golden
3. Set aside
4. Reheat oven to 400f
5. In small bowl whisk egg and water
6. Set aside
7. Unfold pastry sheet on lightly floured surface into a 12-inch square
8. Cut off corners to make a circle
9. Spread cranberry sauce in center of circle the same size as brie round
10. Top with 2 tablespoons each of cranberries and toasted almonds
11. Place brie over mixture
12. Repeat layering with remaining cranberry sauce , cranberries and 2 tablespoons almonds
13. Brush edge of the circle with egg mixture
14. Fold pastry up over cheese to cover
15. Trim any excess pastry
16. Press to seal
17. Brush seam with egg mixture
18. Place seam side up onto baking sheet
19. Brush with egg mixture
20. Sprinkle with cup almonds that have been coarsely chopped
21. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until cheese is soft and just begins to melt
22. Allow pastry to cool 30 minutes before serving
23. Serve with assorted crackers

title: smooth kahlua
steps:
1. Bring water to boil , add brown sugar , lower heat , stir til sugar is dissolved
2. Remove from heat add coffee and brandy , pour into bottle , drop in vanilla bean and cinnamon stick , seal
3. Let stand 30-90 days

title: sour cream cream cheese marshmallow fruit dip
steps:
1. For easy mixing use a large bowl
2. Stir the cream cheese with a fork , then mix in the marshmallow creme
3. After mixing well , stir in sour cream and blend well
4. Place in a covered container in the refrigerator until serving time
5. The mixture will thicken after being refrigerated for several hours

title: green and gold peas with pasta
steps:
1. Cook pasta in plenty of boiling salted water until tender but still firm to bite , stirring often
2. Drain , reserving 1 cup cooking liquid
3. Transfer to large bowl
4. Brown bacon in deep large frying pan over medium - high heat until crispy
5. Transfer bacon to paper towel to drain
6. Add onion to bacon fat in pan sautee until just beginning to brown , about 5 minutes
7. Add frozen peas stir two minutes then add the chick peas and continue to cook until both are just heated through and peas are bright green about 1 minute longer
8. Return bacon to pan and add mint and pasta and enough cooking liquid to moisten pasta
9. Stir in 1 cup cheese and place on serving platter or bowl
10. Drizzle with olive oil and garnish with reserved mint serve , passing additional cheese alongside

title: shrimp and tomato remoulade
steps:
1. Before you chop or start preparing the vegetables
2. Mix cornstarch and water and bring to a boil
3. Cooking until slightly thickened
4. Set aside to cool
5. Season tomato cavities with salt and pepper , set aside
6. Mix shrimp , celery , green onions , and pimiento together
7. Set aside
8. Mix horseradish , mustard and parsley together in a separate bowl , whisk in vinegar
9. Add cooled thickened water in a thin stream , mixing constantly with the whisk
10. Pour dressing over shrimp mixture and mix well
11. Add lemon juice and stuff tomatoes with mixture

title: chicken with garlic  chilli  bay leaves and rosemary
steps:
1. Cut chicken breasts into 3 or 4 even sized pieces
2. Season the flour with salt and pepper and dust the sections in it
3. Heat a heavy large frypan / skillet to medium hot and add oil and butter
4. Add chicken pieces and cook until golden brown and cooked through
5. If you frypan / skillet is small you may have to do this in 2 batches
6. Add rosemary , chillies , garlic and bay leaves to the pan and cook until garlic starts to colour
7. Pour over lemon juice and serve with greens and lemon wedges

title: carrot souffle with crunchy topping
steps:
1. Boil carrots until they are very soft and can easily be mashed
2. Process carrots in food processor or blender with butter , eggs , and sugar
3. Blend well until smooth
4. Separate a small amount of this mixture in a bowl and add flour and baking powder
5. Stir this
6. Add this mixture to the carrot blend and mix well
7. Add spices and almond or vanilla extract
8. Pour into lightly greased casserole or souffle dish
9. Crush graham crackers or use graham cracker crumbs and chop walnuts
10. Mix together
11. Add brown sugar
12. Add small bits of butter , rolling it around with your fingers in the crumbly mix to make small lumps of crumble
13. Add crumble topping to the casserole dish
14. Bake in the oven at 350 degrees for 45 minutes

title: blue cheese asparagus rollups
steps:
1. Flatten each slice of bread with a rolling pin so it is less than 1 / 4" thick
2. Mix blue cheese , worcestershire sauce , beaten egg , cream cheese and seasonings
3. Spread the mix on each slice of bread
4. Put an asparagus spear at the edge of each slice and roll up like a jelly roll
5. Coat the outside of each roll with butter
6. Cut each roll into 3 pieces
7. Place , seam side down , on a cookie sheet and bake for about 20 minutes , 375f
8. Turn over to the other side after about 10 minutes
9. The rolls should be nice and golden

title: sopa seca  mexican noodle casserole
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f
2. Brush a 9-inch square baking dish with oil
3. Heat the extra-virgin olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat
4. Add the fideos and cook , turning them with tongs , until golden brown on both sides , about 5 minutes
5. Transfer the bundles and any broken pieces to a plate
6. Add the onion to the skillet and cook over medium heat , stirring occasionally , until golden brown , about 8 minutes
7. Stir in the garlic , coriander , oregano , chili powder , and bay leaf , and cook until fragrant , about 30 seconds
8. Add the diced tomatoes with their juices
9. Add the chipotles , increase the heat to high , and cook until thickened , about 2 minutes
10. Stir in the broth , the toasted fideos , salt , and pepper , to taste
11. Bring mixture to a boil , reduce heat , and simmer gently , uncovered , breaking up the fideos with a spoon , for about 5 minutes
12. Stir in the chicken
13. Remove the bay leaf
14. Transfer the mixture to the prepared baking dish , sprinkle the grated cheese over the top , and cover loosely with foil
15. Bake until the cheese melts and the casserole is hot through and through , about 20 minutes
16. If desired , serve with some crema drizzled over the top

title: seasoned couscous
steps:
1. In a sauce pan , combine first 8 ingredients
2. Bring to a boil
3. Remove from heat
4. Stir in couscous
5. Cover and let stand for 5 minues or until the liquid is absorbed
6. Fluff with fork

title: low carb chipotle barbecue sauce
steps:
1. Saute garlic and scallions in olive oil until just beginning to brown
2. Stir in splenda , salt , mustard , paprika , chili powder , water , vinegar , worcestershire sauce , chipotle chilies , and molasses , if using
3. Simmer for 10 minutes over low heat , stirring occasionally
4. Whisk tomato paste and liquid smoke into the mixture
5. Simmer another 10 minutes
6. Cool and store in refrigerator for up to one week

title: crustless individual spinach   bacon quiche   low carb
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Spray muffin pan with nonstick cooking spray
3. Cook bacon in large skillet on medium-high heat until crisp
4. Drain , cool and crumble
5. In same skillet , cook and stir onion in remaining bacon fat 5 minutes or until tender
6. Ad spinach , pepper , nutmeg and salt
7. Cook and stir over medium heat about 3 minutes or until liquid evaporates
8. Return bacon to skillet and remove from heat
9. Combine ricotta , mozzarella and parmesan cheeses in large bowl
10. Mix in eggs
11. Add cooked spinach mixture and combine well
12. Divide mixture evenly to fill 10 muffin cps
13. Bake 40 minutes or until filling is set
14. Let stand 10 minutes
15. Run thin knife around edges to release
16. Serve hot or refrigerate and serve cold

title: campbell s cheesy chicken bake
steps:
1. Put the rice , water , vegetables , and spices in a 9x13 casserole dish
2. Mix well
3. The spices i like to use are just a little minced onion and some garlic powder
4. Cut the chicken breasts in half and place on top of the rice mixture
5. Dump the soup on top of the chicken breasts
6. Cover with tin foil
7. Bake at 375f for 45 minutes to an hour
8. Take out of the oven and sprinkle a half cup of cheese on top
9. Let cool
10. Eat whenever the cheese melts

title: sandy s snowballs
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 f
2. Cream butter until smooth and creamy , using an electric mixer
3. Using a wooden spoon , stir in cake flour , vanilla , egg , & salt until mixed well
4. Stir in the ground nuts
5. Shape into 30 small balls and bake on parchment lined baking sheets at 350 f for 10 minutes , then rotate your trays in the oven and continue baking another 5-10 minutes , or until they just start to turn golden
6. Roll in powdered sugar while hot
7. Let cool
8. When cool , roll again in more powdered sugar to coat
9. Store in wax paper lined cookie tins

title: good buffalo wing sauce
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan combine all the ingredients
2. Stir constantly over low heat until butter is melted and all is mixed well
3. Sauce will stay in the refrigerator for a month
4. Fry chicken wings
5. Pour sauce over wings and toss about until all are well-coated with sauce
6. Serve with cold carrot and celery sticks with blue cheese dip

title: christiana campbell s tavern s sweet potato muffins
steps:
1. Have all ingredients at room temperature
2. Cream butter , sugar and sweet potatoes until smooth
3. Add eggs
4. Blend all four ingredients well
5. Sift flour , baking powder and spices and add alternately with milk to egg batter
6. Do not over mix
7. Fold in nuts and raisins last
8. Sprinkle a little cinnamon-sugar on top before baking
9. Bake in greased muffin tins at 400 for 25 minute
10. Or until done
11. 2 dozen regular muffins

title: mediterranean spaghetti
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Heat large nonstick skillet over medium high heat
3. Brown beef until no longer pink
4. Drain
5. Saute onions , oregano and garlic for 5 minutes
6. Add wine through tomatoes , and bring to a boil
7. Reduce heat , and simmer 10 minutes or until thick
8. Combine flour , milk , and 1 / 4 tsp
9. Nutmeg in medium saucepan and bring to boil
10. Reduce heat , and cook for 7 minutes or until thick , stirring constantly
11. Remove milk mixture from heat
12. Stir in feta cheese , half of parmesan cheese and eggs
13. Sprinkle half the bread crumbs into a 2 large professional-size baking pans coated with cooking spray
14. Place half of the cooked spaghetti into the 2 pans , top with half th e beef mixture and then half of the cheese sauce
15. Repeat layers
16. Combine other half of parmesan cheese and bread crumbs and sprinkle over the top of pans
17. Bake at 375 for 30 minutes or until golden brown
18. Let stand for 10 minutes before serving
19. I found it cuts well into squares for serving
20. Wonderful aroma , very tasty
21. This recipe was used successfully by a church group

title: lazy sunday chuck roast
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Mix 1 pkg
3. Of dry onion soup mix , celery salt and 1 cup of water
4. Add mixture to pan and add chuck roast !
5. Next add vegetables around roast
6. Additional water maybe needed
7. After adding vegetables add another package of dry onion soup mix
8. Spread evenly on top without stirring
9. Then place in oven !
10. Gravy: after roast is done use the sauce that's in the bottom of the pan for gravy
11. Place it in a pan
12. Turn the stove to med-high
13. Then keep adding flour till gravy becomes the right consistancy

title: blue ribbon meatloaf
steps:
1. Combine onion soup mix with sour cream in a bowl
2. Add eggs
3. Mix in ground beef
4. Add bread crumbs
5. Mix well
6. Shape into a loaf
7. Place in loaf pan
8. Lay bacon over top
9. Place in preheated 500f oven
10. Reduce heat
11. Bake at 375f for 1 hour

title: phyllis cake with phyllis icing  an awesome pound cake
steps:
1. Cream together sugar , butter and shortening until light and fluffy
2. Add eggs , one at a time
3. Add flour and salt mixture alternating with milk and vanilla
4. Bake in greased and floured tube pan for 1 1 / 2 hours at 325
5. Do not preheat oven before putting the cake in !
6. Icing:
7. Cream the butter until fluffy
8. Add sugar alternating with the milk and vanilla until it is spreading consistency

title: tomato vegetable potato topper
steps:
1. Mix pasta sauce , vegetables and parmesan cheese in a large saucepan over medium-high heat
2. Bring to a boil
3. Cover and cook over low heat 15 minutes or until vegetables are crisp-tender , stirring occasionally
4. Spoon sauce mixture over potatoes
5. Top with mozzarella cheese

title: craze e sourdough rye bread
steps:
1. In a large bowl , put 1 1 / 2 cups warm water
2. Sprinkle yeast over water and stir until dissolved
3. Add rye flour , sourdough starter , sugar , butter , caraway seeds , and salt
4. Beat well
5. Combine 1 cup white flour and soda
6. Stir into rye flour and yeast mixture
7. Add enough remaining flour to make a moderately stiff dough
8. Turn out onto lightly floured board
9. Add rosemary , dried cranberries , pimientoes , and green onions to dough and knead for 5 minutes
10. Place in greased bowl , turning once
11. Cover
12. Let rise 1 1 / 2 hours or until doubled in bulk
13. Punch down , divide in half
14. Cover and let rise 10 minutes
15. Shape into two rounds
16. Place rounds on two greased baking sheets
17. If desired , lightly sprinkle with cornmeal
18. Cover with dry towel and let rise 45 minutes or until doubled in bulk
19. Bake in a preheated oven set at 375 for 35-40 minutes or until bread sounds hollow when tapped on bottom
20. Remove from baking sheets and cool on a rack

title: easy microwave szechuan green beans
steps:
1. Finely chop garlic , ginger and scallions together
2. Place in 14 x 11 x 2 dish , cover with vegetable oil
3. Cook on high for 3 minutes
4. Removed dish from microwave oven , stir in soy sauce and rice wine vinegar
5. Add green beans , stirring to distribute sauce
6. Cook , uncovered for 15 minutes , stirring 3-4 times during cooking
7. Serve hot or cold
8. Can be made ahead and reheated for serving

title: martha s salsa verde
steps:
1. Add tomatillos to boiling water
2. Cook 3 to 5 minutes , until just soft
3. Drain
4. Let cool
5. Chop into 1 / 2 inch pieces
6. Toss in bowl with remaining ingredients
7. Refrigerate several hours before serving

title: chicken smothered in garlic
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Saute chicken in pan with olive oil spray til golden outside
3. Lay chicken breasts in roasting pan in a single layer
4. Lay blanched garlic over chicken breasts
5. Whisk together tomatoes , wine , broth , tarragon and marjoram and pour over top of chicken and garlic
6. Season with salt and pepper
7. Bake for 45-50 minutes
8. Served with garlic roasted potatoes , green beans and a loaf of crusty homemade herb bread

title: decadent fudgy nut bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f , & lightly grease 8" square baking dish
2. Microwave chocolate & 1 / 4 cup butter in large microwaveable bowl on high 1 minute or until butter is melted
3. Stir until chocolate is completely melted
4. Add 3 / 4 cup sugar , & mix well
5. Blend in eggs & vanilla
6. Stir in flour until well blended
7. Stir in pecans , then set aside
8. In a bowl , mix graham cracker crumbs , 1 tablespoon sugar & 2 tablespoons butter
9. Press firmly onto bottom & 1 / 2" up sides of prepared baking dish
10. Spread chocolate mixture over crust
11. Bake 15-20 minutes , or until center is set
12. Cool completely before cutting into bars

title: teppanyaki mustard dipping sauce
steps: 1. Whisk all ingredients together in medium bowl

title: starbucks chantico copycat
steps:
1. In a saucepan over low heat , melt the chocolate chips
2. When melted , pour in the milk and whisk constantly until smooth
3. Add whipping cream and vanilla
4. Remember: no need to bring it to a boil
5. Only to steaming hot
6. At starbucks , it was served at around 170-180 degrees

title: potato soup with ham and cheese
steps:
1. Boil potatoes until tender enough to eat but not to soft
2. Drain potatoes and reserve the liquid
3. In a large pot melt butter
4. When the butter is melted add the flour and whisk to combine until smooth
5. Add the milk whisking to combine until smooth
6. Add 2 cups of the potato cooking water
7. Add the ham and cook for 5 minutes
8. Add the cheese and stir till melted
9. Add the potatoes , salt , pepper , and red pepper
10. Place on the lowest heat and let set for 5 to 10 minutes for the flavors to blend
11. Serve with crusty bread and maybe a salad

title: triple chocolate biscotti
steps:
1. Line large baking sheet with double thickness of foil
2. Sift in salt , baking powder , cocoa and flour into a large bowl to blend
3. Beat in eggs one at a time and then vanilla
4. Beat in flour mixture
5. Stir in chocolate and white chocolate chips by hand
6. Heap dough into two long strips
7. Refrigerate for 30 minutes
8. Bake at 350 for about 25 minutes
9. Let cool for 10 minutes
10. Reduce heat to 300
11. Using foil as an aide , lift logs onto work surface
12. Cut logs into 3 / 4 in pieces
13. Arrange half of slices on each prepare baking sheet
14. Bake biscotti until just dry to touch
15. Turn biscotti and bake again for another 8 minutes

title: the tomato plate
steps:
1. Boil linguini until almost al-dente
2. Strain and let sit
3. In large skillet , heat tomatoes on med-high heat in 1tsp
4. Oil with plenty of garlic
5. Salt to taste
6. Meanwhile , heat 1 cup whole milk in sauce pan until sides begin to bubble
7. Add the sharp cheese , stirring frequently to prevent separation
8. Gradually add asiago cheese to allow it to melt properly
9. Add parmesean cheese , and add the black pepper last
10. Cover and simmer on "low" or "warm" if you have that option until pasta is finished
11. [this will take 6-8] minutes
12. Lower head to medium in skillet
13. Throw linguini on top of tomatoes , tossing through to dispurse tomatoes evenly
14. Cook , covered , for 3 minutes
15. Turn heat back up to med high
16. Add pine nuts , cover , & cook for 3 minutes , untouched
17. Add chopped spinach [it should be chopped very fine , it should almost be able to pass for basil or oregano] and toss pasta
18. Let cook for 2 minutes or until warmed through , and transfer to large bowl
19. Stir sauce before spooning in over linguini

title: double coconut cream pie
steps:
1. For filling , in a saucepan , combine the 1 cup sugar and cornstarch
2. Gradually stir in the milk
3. Cook and stir over medium-high heat till mixture is thickened and bubbly
4. Remove the saucepan from heat
5. In a bowl , beat the egg yolks with a fork
6. Gradually stir about 1 cup of the hot filling into yolks
7. Return all to saucepan
8. Bring to a gentle boil
9. Cook and stir for 2 minutes more
10. Remove mixture from the heat
11. Stir in the 3 / 4 cup coconut , the butter and vanilla
12. Pour filling into baked piecrust
13. For meringue , in a mixing bowl , beat egg whites with an electric mixer till soft peaks form
14. Gradually add the 1 / 4 cup sugar , beating till stiff peaks form and sugar dissolves
15. Immediately spread meringue over hot filling
16. In piecrust , carefully sealing to edge of pastry to prevent shrinkage
17. Sprinkle the 1 / 4 cup coconut over the top
18. Bake the pie in a 350 oven for 15 minutes or till golden
19. Cool the pie completely on a wire rack
20. Store in the refrigerator
21. Makes 8 servings

title: smoked haddock  leek and potato soup
steps:
1. Fry the leeks gently in the butter for 5 minutes then stir in the potatoes
2. Add the milk and stock and season with black pepper
3. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes or till the potatoes are tender
4. Squash the potatoes a bit with the back of a spoon if you'd like your soup slightly thicker
5. Gently lower the haddock chunks into the pan and simmer gently for five minutes
6. Ladle into bowls and serve with crusty bread

title: baked rutabaga  fries
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 475
2. Peel rutabaga and cut into fries as you would with potatoes
3. Place into large bowl
4. Coat them with the oil
5. Add seasonings and combine
6. Place on large baking sheet , lined with non stick foil
7. Should be one layer
8. Bake 30-40 minute
9. Serve hot

title: high protein diet waffles
steps:
1. Whisk ingredients into bowl and pour into a waffle maker
2. Pour batter so that it is contained within the grids
3. Top off with jam or other suggested topping

title: chili s black beans
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in a heavy saucepan and mix well
2. Simmer for about 20-25 minutes
3. Serve
4. So easy !

title: snickers pie with fudge sauce
steps:
1. In a large bowl mix the soft ice cream and the snickers bars together
2. Pour into the graham cracker pie shell
3. Cover with plastic wrap and freeze at least 4 hours
4. Let stand at room temperature for about 15 minutes before serving
5. I like to serve it with hot fudge sauce and a little whipped cream and maybe a sprinkle of chopped honey peanuts

title: pumpkin gnocchi with leek and basil butter
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 200c line baking tray with non-stick baking paper
2. Place washed potatoes and deseeded and quartered squash on the tray and bake for 1 hour or until tender
3. Let cool for 20 minutes
4. Peel potatoes and pumpkin and place in large bowl
5. Add salt and pepper to taste then mash until smooth
6. Stir flour into potato mixture then turn onto lightly floured surface and knead until smooth
7. Divide dough into 4 portions and roll each into a 2cm log
8. Use a lightly floured knife and cut each log into 2cm long pieces
9. Place pieces onto a baking paper lined tray
10. Roll each piece of dough into a ball and then roll each ball over the back of a lightly floured fork to create a slightly oval shaped ball with shallow grooves and place back on the tray
11. Leek and basil butter
12. Heat oil over medium high heat in a frying pan
13. Cut the pale part of the leek into thin matchsticks and add to the oil
14. Cook 1 - 2 minutes
15. Transfer leeks to a papertowel lined plate using a slotted spoon
16. Add basil and chilli to the pan and cook for 1 - 2 minutes then transfer to the plate
17. Add butter to the pan and heat until melted
18. Cover pan to keep butter warm
19. Cook the gnocchi in 3 or 4 batches in a large saucepan of boiling water until it rises to the surface
20. Drain well and serve onto plates
21. Drizzle each plate with melted butter and top with leek / basil / chilli

title: charquican   chilean beef stew
steps:
1. Toss the cubes of beef with the flour and season with salt and pepper
2. Melt the 2 tablespoons of butter in a heavy skillet over medium high heat
3. Saut the cubes of beef until browned
4. Add the beef stock to the skillet and bring to a simmer over low heat
5. Chop the beef jerky into small pieces and add to the beef stock and beef cubes
6. Simmer gently for about 5 minutes
7. Transfer beef and beef stock to a large stockpot or slow cooker
8. Do not clean skillet
9. Add 2 tablespoons vegetable oil , the chopped onion and garlic , and the aji chile pepper paste to the skillet
10. Saut until the onion and garlic are soft and fragrant
11. Add the chopped squash , carrots , and potatoes and saut for 2-3 minutes
12. Add sauted vegetables to the stockpot or crockpot with the beef
13. Simmer over low heat until beef and beef jerky are tender , about a hour and a half on the stove
14. If simmering the stew on the stove , you may need to add more liquid from time to time , but stew should finish up very thick , without much broth
15. Add the lima beans and corn and simmer for 10-15 minutes more
16. Season with salt and pepper to taste , and serve over rice

title: cranberry brie bites
steps:
1. Cut each sheet of puff pastry into 12 squares and place inside mini muffins cups
2. Try not to leave any part of the muffin cup uncovered by dough or the cheese and cranberry will stick
3. Place a 1-inch square of cheese inside each cup
4. Then add about 1 t cranberry sauce on top of the cheese
5. Bake in a preheated 375f oven till edges are a light brown , 10-15 minutes
6. Cool a few minutes before removing from muffin tins

title: donnalee s special roasted potatoes
steps:
1. Set out a 9x13" glass casserole pan and grease lightly with some of the olive oil
2. Dice raw potatoes and place in the pan- you want to have enough pototoes to fill the bottom of the casserole
3. Sprinkle cooked peas& carrots over the potatoes
4. Press the garlic over the pan , crushing the garlic over the veggies
5. Liberally coat veggies with a few spoonfuls of olive oil and toss to mix everything together- the veggies should be well coated , but there shouldn't be a lot of loose oil in the pan
6. Sprinkle with oregano , basil , parsley to taste- you want to see little speckles of herbs on every piece of veggie
7. Salt and pepper to taste
8. Crumble bacon over the top and drizzle with a small amount of reserved bacon fat , if desired
9. Bake in a preheated 350 f oven for about 1 hour , uncovered , until vegetables are fork tender

title: sweet   spicy asian dipping sauce
steps: 1. Wisk together ingredients in a bowl , making sure sugar is completely disolved

title: memphis style popcorn
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a large , heavy bottomed pot set over medium heat , just enough oil to coat the bottom of the pot
2. Drop a few kernels of corn in the oil to test the heat
3. When they begin to pop , pour in the rest of the corn , and cover with a tight fitting lid
4. Shake the pan while the corn pops to keep it from burning , about 5-8 minutes
5. Whisk together the parmesan cheese , smoked paprika , garlic powder , salt , sugar , pepper and cayenne in a small bowl
6. Pour the popcorn into a large bowl , and drizzle with butter
7. Sprinkle with the seasoning mix to taste , and toss thoroughly
8. You can use all the seasoning in one batch or start with half and work your way up , depending on how much flavor you want
9. Enjoy !

title: boston approved pupcicles
steps:
1. Wisk all together until well blended
2. Pour into ice cube trays
3. Freeze until set , about 3 hours
4. If your dogs don't like them , you can always eat them yourself !

title: deb s yummy chocolate frosting
steps:
1. Stir together the cocoa , butter , milk , and sugar in a pot on the stove till smooth
2. Remove from the heat
3. Add powdered sugar a little at a time until the frosting is at the consistency you'd like
4. Enjoy !

title: grandma harter s pumpkin pie
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients
2. Pour into unbaked pie crusts
3. Bake at 400 degrees for 15 minutes then reduce to 350 degrees and bake for 45 minutes longer , or until middle of pie is firm

title: sausage corn skillet
steps:
1. Cook egg noodles according to directions on package
2. While noodles are cooking , fry pork sausage in a skillet , drain grease , add onions to pork and cook about 5 mins
3. Or until tender
4. Add the creamed corn let simmer until heated through
5. Add egg noodles , mix well but gently
6. Serve
7. This is the basic recipe
8. Add as you like --
9. Mushrooms , green or red pepper , anything you feel like
10. Also you can double the creamed corn or sausage to fit your family's preference

title: stoofvlees  belgian beef stew
steps:
1. Glaze the onion in margarine in a large skillet
2. Add the beef and cook until it has browned
3. Add all of the beer , the beef , the chocolate and the bay leaf
4. Spread the mustard onto the slices of peperkoek or bread and place in top of the meat
5. Add salt and pepper to your taste
6. Leave to cook on low heat for at least 1 1 / 2 hours , but the longer it cooks the better it tastes , stir from time to time preventing it to burn
7. The sauce should have a pretty thick consistency
8. The leftovers of this recipe can be frozen or the recipe can easily be doubled
9. Enjoy !

title: banana raisin trail mix
steps:
1. In a storage container combine raisins , banana chips , peanuts , and fruit
2. Store in a cool , dry place for up to 1 week
3. Makes about 7 cups
4. Make-ahead
5. Store , covered , in a cool , dry place up to 1 week

title: taco bell cheesy fiesta potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 475 degrees f
2. In a ziplock bag , mix the garlic powder and cumin together
3. Add the cubed potatoes , seal the ziplock , and toss it all together until potatoes are coated evenly
4. In a large , heavy skillet over medium heat melt the oil and butter together
5. Add the seasoned potatoes and cook , stirring frequently , until they're a nice , golden brown , about 10 minutes
6. Cover and cook an additional 10 minutes or until potatoes are tender then season to taste with salt and pepper
7. Transfer the sauted potatoes to a non-stick baking sheet and bake at 475 degrees f for 10 minutes , stirring occasionally , until potatoes are nice and crisp
8. When potatoes are almost done baking , place the cubed velveeta , salsa , and tabasco into a microwave-safe bowl and microwave for 1 minute
9. Stir and microwave another minute
10. Stir again and microwave for 1 more minute , then stir until smooth
11. For each serving , place some potatoes in a bowl , then pour over 1 / 4 of the melted velveeta cheese sauce , top with some sour cream , then sprinkle with chopped green onion

title: bill blass s meatloaf
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f degrees
2. Oil a 8x4 loaf pan and set aside
3. In a large , heavy skillet over medium heat , saute the celery and onion in the butter until soft
4. Remove from heat and set aside to cool for 5 minutes
5. Add the meats , parsley , sour cream , bread crumbs and spices to the skillet
6. Whisk the egg with the worcestershire sauce and add to mixture
7. Using a wooden spoon or your hands , combine the mixture and mold into a loaf shape
8. Place the meat loaf in the prepared pan
9. Top with the chili sauce , then the bacon slices
10. Place on a cookie sheet-- to catch any drips-- and bake until cooked through and browned , at least 1 hour

title: apricot glazed roasted brussels sprouts
steps:
1. Sprouts -- heat your oven to 425 and line a baking or cookie sheet with parchment paper
2. To prepare the sprouts , i peel the first outside layers of leaves off if brown or wilted , then cut in half lengthwise , keeping the stem in tact
3. This will keep the sprouts from falling apart
4. You can trim the stem a little if it is brown , but usually buying them today either at markets or in a grocery store they are very well cleaned
5. In a small bowl add the sprout halves , olive oil , dill , salt and pepper and lightly toss
6. Put on the baking sheet with parchment paper and put in the oven
7. Baking -- cook 12-15 minutes and then check
8. At that point , i like to flip them over so they brown equally on both sides and cook another 10 minutes until tender but still have a little bite to them
9. I don't like them too soft
10. But please cook them to the texture you like
11. Sauce -- as the sprouts are roasting add all the ingredients for the sauce in a small pot and heat on medium low and let it simmer for about 5-10 minutes
12. Finish -- after the sprouts are done place in a large serving bowl and drizzle with the apricot glaze
13. Enjoy ! this is great served with some roasted chicken or a pork roast , mashed potatoes , etc
14. It reminds me of fall food and comforting meals
15. Growing up fall and weekend dinners always seem to have braised meats , slow cooked vegetables from our summer garden , and sprouts were always a part of it and always a favorite

title: mashed yukon golds with roasted garlic
steps:
1. You first need to make the roasted garlic
2. Four heads are enough for this recipe , but i suggest you do more , as the roasted garlic keeps in the fridge for at least a week , or it can be frozen and then you can just break off what you need
3. To prepare roasted garlic , preheat oven to 375f
4. Using a sharp knife , cut off the top third or so of each garlic bulb , exposing the cloves
5. Remove all the papery white skin that you can , but leave the bulb intact
6. Place cut garlic heads on a piece of foil that is big enough to just come up around the heads and cover them
7. Drizzle about 1 tsp of olive oil over the exposed top of each head
8. Bring foil up around the heads to seal , then place this foil package on a pie plate and slide into preheated oven for about 40 to 50 minutes
9. When done , garlic will be very soft
10. As soon as it is cool enough to handle , squeeze garlic into a small bowl and set aside
11. If you are ambitious , keep the roasted skins that are left behind and use them in a stock
12. You can't get around it , your fingers are going to get garlicky and sticky--but it really is a fun task !
13. Now , to make the potatoes : put chopped potato chunks in a large pot and cover with cold water , lightly salt , and bring it to a boil over high heat
14. When potatoes are cooked through , about 20 minutes after the potatoes boil , drain well and then return to pot
15. With heat on high , shake potatoes around in pot for about 20 to 30 seconds to dry them out a bit
16. Then remove pot from burner
17. Using a potato masher , mash potatoes , adding soft butter and the roasted garlic
18. When all chunks have been mashed , add half of the warm milk and keep mashing
19. Add more milk if needed until potatoes are the consistency you want
20. Try the potatoes
21. Add salt and pepper to taste

title: vegetarian  lacto ovo  sweet potato taquitos
steps:
1. Combine refried beans , mashed sweet potatoes , shredded cheese , minced onion , minced chiles and spices and mix well
2. Heat tortillas one at a time very briefly in frying pan with no oil to soften and then move to a basket or tortilla keeper lined with a damp towel to keep soft until you are ready to use
3. Place a large tablespoon or so of mixture in center of each small tortilla
4. Roll up tortilla around bean / sweet potato mixture and secure with a wooden toothpick
5. Fry in canola oil one or two at a time for 3 to 5 minutes each until golden brown and crisp
6. Drain on paper toweling for a few moments before serving
7. Serve with your favorite salsa and sour cream or guacamole
8. These can be frozen and reheated on a baking sheet in 350 degree fahrenheit oven for 10-15 minutes

title: double dredge fried chicken
steps:
1. Rinse chicken
2. Place chicken and salt in a bowl and add water to cover
3. Soak 30 minutes
4. In a separate bowl , stir flour , seasoned salt and pepper together
5. Beat eggs in another bowl
6. Drain the chicken
7. Dip each piece in beaten eggs and then in the flour mixture
8. Set aside on a floured baking sheet
9. Fill a dutch oven half full of peanut oil
10. Heat oil to 325 to 350 degrees
11. Dredge each piece of chicken in the eggs and then the flour mixture again
12. Place carefully into the hot oil
13. Fry the chicken in batches until golden , turning to brown evenly
14. Cooking time is approximate
15. Remove the chicken from the oil and drain on paper towels
16. Sprinkle chicken with seasoned salt

title: spiced avocado soup
steps:
1. Chop and saut onion in oil , until caramelization starts
2. Add chili and coriander , and saut for a minute longer
3. Add chicken broth and bring to boil
4. While waiting for boil , finely dice tomato and cilantro , for garnish
5. Remove from heat , and add sour cream
6. Cut avocados in half , and remove pit
7. Scoop out flesh with spoon into soup
8. Using hand blender , pure ingredients
9. Add salt to taste
10. If serving hot , put in bowl and top with garnish
11. If serving cold , put soup in refrigerator for at least two hours , then when ready to serve , top with garnish

title: weight watchers 2 smart pt  peanut butter cookies
steps:
1. Combine flour , baking soda and salt in a small bowl
2. Mix well and set aside
3. Combine margarine and peanut butter in a mixing bowl
4. Beat on medium speed until blended and smooth
5. Gradually add both sugars and beat until blended
6. Add egg white and vanilla and beat until smooth
7. While beating on low speed , gradually add flour mixture and mix until just blended
8. Transfer dough to a large piece of plastic wrap and roll into an 8-inch log
9. Wrap log in plastic wrap and freeze for 2 hours
10. Preheat oven to 350f
11. Coat 2 large baking sheets with cooking spray
12. Remove cookie dough from freezer and slice crosswise into about twenty-four 1 / 3-inch-thick slices
13. Place slices 1 inch apart on prepared baking sheets
14. Bake until golden around edges , about 8 to 10 minutes
15. Transfer cookies to wire racks to cool completely
16. Yields 1 cookie per serving
17. Flavor booster: browned margarine has a nutty flavor that enhances a peanut butter cookie
18. Melt the margarine in a small skillet until it sizzles and just begins to brown
19. Remove from heat and freeze for 20 minutes , or until firm , before using in recipe

title: quick pan fried chicken livers with apple  onion and sage
steps:
1. In a large non-stick skillet or wok , saute chicken livers and onions on medium-high heat for 10 minutes
2. Add chopped apples and seasonings
3. Reduce heat to medium
4. Cook for 10-15 minutes more or until done , stirring occasionally
5. Sprinkle with chopped fresh parsley , and serve immediately
6. Goes great with sides of real home-made mashed potatoes and green beans !

title: kymartin6 s jalapeno poppers
steps:
1. Arrange the jalapeo halves on a large cookie sheet
2. Mix the remaining ingredients thoroughly
3. This is best done with a food processor but if , like me , you don't have one a fork and plenty of elbow grease will do the job
4. Pack the cheese mixture into the jalapeo halves so that it rounds up a bit
5. If you're lucky the size of the jalapeos and the amount of the cheese will work out right
6. If not you either have some jalapeos to use for something else , or you have bacon-cheese mix to spread on crackers
7. Bake at 350f for 30-35 minutes
8. Enjoy hot , lukewarm , cold , or briefly rewarmed in the microwave
9. Reputedly , they are excellent with beer
10. I don't like beer so i can't say
11. However , if you like beer you can consider that expert advice
12. ) :d lol
13. Variations include substituting mozzarella for the sharp cheddar , substituting cracker crumbs or crushed potato chips for the bread crumbs , and drastically reducing the amount of bread crumbs for a lower-carb option

title: fabulous thumbprint cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Cream sugar , butter and crisco
3. Add egg yolks one at a time until well blended
4. Add vanilla , mixing well
5. In separate bowl , combine flour and salt
6. Add flour to wet ingredients to form a dough that will hold its shape when rolled into a ball
7. Roll dough into balls about 1 teaspoons size
8. I know this seems small , but once they are rolled in the nuts , they are much larger
9. Beat egg whites with water until frothy
10. Dip each ball into the egg whites and immediately roll into nuts
11. Place 1 inch apart on ungreased baking sheet
12. Press thumb into center to make a well
13. Bake 5 -7 minutes , remove and press thumb into cookie again to hold the well
14. Bake an additional 3-5 minutes to brown the bottoms
15. When cool , frost with thumbprint cookie icing

title: thai mango chicken
steps:
1. To make the mango sauce , simply place all sauce ingredients in a food processor
2. Process well
3. Do a taste test for salt , spice , and sweetness
4. Add more sugar if you find the sauce too sour
5. If too sweet , add a little more vinegar
6. If not spicy enough , add more chilli sauce
7. If not salty enough , add more fish sauce
8. If too salty , add more lime juice
9. Remember , the goal for this sauce is to reach a balance of sweet , sour , spicy , and salty
10. Add the sauce , chicken and red pepper slices to a wok
11. Stir well and bring to a boil
12. Reduce to a simmer , and cover
13. Stirring occasionally to keep from sticking , continue cooking for 30 minutes
14. Finish the dish with a sprinkling of cashews and fresh coriander

title: healthy zucchini carrot spice bread
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease and flour two 8x4 inch loaf pans
3. Clean the zucchini , cut off the ends , and shred using a grater
4. Peel the carrots , trim off the ends and shred with a grater
5. Mix the zucchini and the carrot with 1 / 2 teaspoon of salt
6. Place in a colander with a heavy pot on top
7. Allow to sit for 20 minutes
8. This will help rid the vegetables of excess water
9. Sift together the flour , baking soda , baking powder and spices
10. Mix thoroughly
11. Set aside
12. Beat the eggs until frothy
13. Add the applesauce a little at a time and beat well
14. Then , add the sugar
15. While still beating , add the pumpkin
16. Mix in the vanilla and the lemon peel
17. When thoroughly mixed , add the carrot and zucchini
18. Add the dry ingredients a little at a time
19. Be careful not to over mix
20. Slowly mix in the nut and raisins
21. Pour into prepared pans
22. Bake at 350 for 1 hour or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean
23. Place on a rack to cool for 10 minutes , then remove from the pans and cool completely
24. Store in a refrigerator wrapped in waxed paper , then in foil

title: grilled herbed mushroom vegetable medley
steps:
1. Clean and prepare mushrooms by slicing a thin slice off the bottom of each stem
2. Thinly slice mushroom stems and caps
3. Combine mushrooms , bell pepper , zucchini and squash in a large bowl
4. Combine melted butter , thyme , basil , chives , garlic , salt and pepper in a small bowl
5. Pour over vegetables and toss to coat well
6. Transfer to a 20x14 inch sheet of heavy duty foil
7. Wrap into a packet sealing edges well , leaving space for heat to circulate
8. Grill on covered grill over medium coals 20 to 25 minutes or until vegetables are fork tender

title: nutty whole wheat bread
steps:
1. Combine 1 cup white flour and wheat flour , walnuts , sugar , yeast and salt
2. Heat water , yogurt , and butter to 120 degrees
3. Add to dry ingredients
4. Beat until smooth
5. Stir in more flour to form a soft dough
6. Turn on a floured surface and knead until smooth and elastic-4 minutes
7. Shape into ball , cover for 20 minutes
8. Bake 400 degrees for 25-30 minutes

title: orange date muffins
steps:
1. Process dates with 1 / 2 c flour in a food processor until dates are uniformly chopped
2. Add the orange sections and process again
3. Add the orange juice , eggs , and butter
4. Pulse until well blended
5. Mix the dry ingredients and add , all at once , to the other ingredients
6. Pulse until just moist
7. Don't overmix
8. Drop mixture into greased muffin tins
9. Fill 3 / 4 full
10. Bake at 400 degree f oven for 15-20 minutes

title: creamy corn or pea salad
steps:
1. Place the corn or peas on a plate and pat dry using paper towel / s then place in a bowl with onions , cucumbers and celery toss to combine
2. Mix all the dressing ingredients together until well combined
3. Pour over the veggies
4. Mix well to combine
5. Season with black pepper and more salt if needed
6. Cover and chill for a few hours to blend the flavors
7. Just before serving add in the chopped tomatoes

title: easy 10 minute graham brittle
steps:
1. First , preheat the oven to 350
2. Then place graham crackers in a single layer on the baking sheet
3. Line them up so that they're touching on all sides , like a grid
4. Bring brown sugar and butter to a boil in a saucepan
5. Pour the brown sugar and butter mixture evenly over the graham crackers , coating each one evenly
6. Put the baking sheet in the oven for 5 minutes
7. Take the baking sheet out of the oven and evenly sprinkle the milk chocolate chips on top of the graham crackers
8. Let them melt for 30 sec-1 minute
9. Then spread them around to coat the graham crackers with chocolate
10. Sprinkle on your desired topping or leave it plain ! crushed cereal not only tastes amazing but also uses up the crumbs in the bottom of the bag :)
11. Chill in the refrigerator until chocolate has hardened
12. To save time , you can also pop it in the freezer
13. To serve , use your muscles and a metal flipper or pizza cutter to break it up into pieces

title: mediterranean vegetable pie
steps:
1. Place eggplant slices between several thickness of paper toweling
2. Sprinkle with 1 teaspoons salt
3. Weigh down with something flat and heavy
4. Let stand 30 minutes
5. Cut into 1 / 4 inch cubes
6. Heat 1 / 4 cup oil in a large skillet
7. Add eggplant all at once
8. Quickly toss to coat
9. Cook , stirring constantly until tender
10. Remove to large bowl
11. Pour remaining oil into skillet , add onion , green pepper , zucchini , and garlic
12. Cook , stirring constantly , until tender
13. Set aside
14. Combine oregano , basil , remaining salt , and pepper in measuring cup
15. Set aside
16. Prepare crust according to directions for a 2 crust pie
17. Divide dough into 2 balls , 1 slightly larger than the other
18. Roll out larger into 12 inch circle
19. Fit into 10 inch pie plate
20. Trim overhang to 1 / 2 inch
21. Sprinkle with 3 tablespoons of parmesan
22. Spoon half eggplant into pie plate
23. Then half vegetables
24. Sprinkle with half of herbs mixture , 1 tablespoons parmesan and half mozzarella
25. Repeat , reserving 1 tablespoons parmesan
26. Roll out remaining pastry
27. Cut into 1 / 2 inch strips
28. Arrange lattice fashion over pie
29. Trim to within 1 / 2 inch of plate
30. Turn edges under
31. Flute
32. Brush lattice strips with water
33. Sprinkle with remaining parmesan
34. Bake at 425 degrees f
35. For 25 minutes or until pastry is golden brown and pie just begins to bubble
36. Let stand 15 minutes before serving

title: smoked paprika chicken
steps:
1. Heat oil in large skillet
2. Add chicken and lightly brown for 5 minutes
3. Add onions and garlic and cook 5 more minutes
4. Season with smoked paprika , salt , and pepper
5. Stir in chicken broth and simmer on low for 10 minutes
6. Remove from heat and stir in sour cream
7. Serve with buttered wide egg noodles

title: italian stuffed chicken breast with a marsala sauce
steps:
1. Pound chicken with a meat mallet until it is close to the same thickness all over about 1 / 4 inch
2. Lay a slice of prosciutto over breast , 2 if they are thin , top with two sage leaves , laying them top to bottom down the centre of the breast
3. Distribute cheese equally among the breasts again lay it top to bottom down the centre of the breast
4. Fold breast over to join , secure with kitchen string at close intervals , tying as tightly as you can , to prevent cheese from melting out of the chicken breast during cooking
5. Heat a small amount of olive oil in a pan , add chicken breasts and brown on both sides to give the breast a nice rich colour
6. Transfer breasts to an ovenproof dish and finish cooking in a pre-heated oven 180c
7. It will take about 30-40 mins depending in the size of the breasts
8. Sauce
9. Add 1 cup of marsala , 2 teaspoons chicken stock , heat through , add 1 / 2 cup reduced fat cream and the double cream , mix a little water with the cornflour add a little at a time , to thicken , add pepper to taste and stir in tarragon
10. To serve: place a couple of spoonfuls of mash on a plate , slice chicken , and arrange over the top drizzle sauce over

title: vegetable garbanzo chili
steps:
1. Put beans in a large soup pot
2. Add water to cover by 2 inches
3. Let soak overnight
4. Drain beans
5. Return beans to pot
6. Add water to cover by 2 inches
7. Bring to a boil over high heat
8. Reduce heat to low and simmer for about 1 hour or until the beans are tender
9. Drain well
10. In a big skillet , let the oil get heated over medium heat
11. Add in the onion and jalapeno pepper
12. Stir / saute until veggies are soft
13. Add in the garlic , chili powder , oregano , and cumin
14. Stir for 30 seconds
15. Add in the tomatoes with puree
16. Bring to a simmer and break up the tomatoes with a spoon
17. Transfer mixture to a 4 quart slow-cooker
18. Add in carrots , celery , zucchini , the bell peppers and garbanzos
19. Stir to combine
20. Cover and cook on low 6-7 hours or until the garbanzos are tender
21. Season to taste with salt

title: fudgy chocolate chip muffins
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350
2. Spray muffin tins with non stick cooking spray
3. Stir together applesauce and oats and set aside
4. Beat butter , sugars , egg and vanilla
5. Add oat mixture and blend well
6. Combine flour , baking soda and cocoa and add to wet mixture , mixing till just combined
7. Fold in chocolate chips
8. Fill muffin tins 3 / 4 full
9. Bake 20-24 mins or until a toothpick comes out almost clean
10. Cool in pan 5 mins and remove to wire rack
11. Serve warm and enjoy !

title: cinnamon chip scone
steps:
1. Mix flour , brown sugar , baking powder , cinnamon , and baking soda together
2. Cut in the butter
3. I only used 1 stick of butter myself
4. The first time i made this i used 3 different kinds of measuring cups
5. Don't do that , lol , it didn't work , lol
6. Mix in egg and buttermilk
7. Mix together
8. Add cinnamon baking chips
9. Pat out on bench flour
10. Make round
11. Pat down
12. Brush with melted butter
13. Sprinkle with sugar and cinnamon
14. Cut into 6 wedges
15. Separate and bake 15 or 20 minutes in a 425 degree fahrenheit oven until done
16. The scones that i didn't seperate completely didn't cook as fast

title: ground beef cannelloni
steps:
1. For salsa de pomodori: heat oil in a large pot
2. Add onion and cook 7-8 minutes or until soft
3. All all remaining ingredients for sauce
4. Cover and cook over low heat for 40 minutes
5. Press through a sieve
6. Set aside
7. For filling: heat oil in large frying pan
8. Add onion and garlic , cook until soft
9. Stir in spinach
10. Cook 3-4 minutes or until all moisture is boiled away and mixture begins to stick
11. Move mixture to a large bowl
12. Melt 1 t butter and cook livers 3-4 minutes until firm and lightly browned , but pink inside
13. Chop coarsly and add to spinach mixture
14. Melt remaining butter and brown beef
15. Add to spinach mixture
16. Add cheese , cream , eggs and oregano to mixture
17. Mix and season to taste
18. For besciamella: melt butter in large saucepan over high heat
19. Reduct heat to medium and add flour
20. Stir constantly to form a roux
21. Stir for 1 minute
22. Pour in milk and cream stirring constantly
23. Return to high heat and cook , stirring constantly
24. When sauce boils , reduce heat and cook 2-3 minutes , until sauce is thick
25. Season to taste
26. To assemble: place one cup of salsa di pomodori in bottom of a sprayed 9x13 baking dish
27. Stuff each shell with 2-4 tablespoons of filling
28. Place in pan
29. Cover with remaining salsa de pomodori
30. Pour evenly besciamella over the red sauce
31. Bake at covered with foil in a 350 oven for 45 minutes or until bubbly

title: nutmeg feathercake
steps:
1. Mix dry ingredients
2. In a separate bowl cream butter , shortening vanilla and eggs
3. Beat for 1 minute
4. Add dry ingredients , alternating with buttermilk
5. Grease and flour a 13 x 9" pan
6. Pour in mixture and bake at 350f for 30 minutes
7. Meanwhile to make frosting mix all frosting ingredients together and set aside
8. After the cake has baked for 30 minutes , remove and cover the cake with frosting , spreading to all sides
9. Return to oven and turn onto broil
10. Stand by for 1-2 minutes till the frosting in brown

title: norwegian cucumber salad    epcot
steps: 1. Mix ingredients and serve chilled

title: indian style carrot salad
steps:
1. Soak the sultanas in water for 2-3 hours
2. Grate the carrots and put them in a bowl
3. Mix in the salt
4. Heat the oil and when hot , put in the mustard seeds
5. When the mustard seeds begin to pop , pour the oil and seeds over the carrots
6. Add lemon juice and sultanas and toss

title: italian baked zucchini
steps:
1. Heat oven to 450
2. Trim zucchini and slice into 1 / 2 inch disks
3. Sprinkle 1 t olive oil onto bottom of 9 by 13 pan
4. Add zucchini and sprinkle it w / salt and pepper
5. Drizzle 1 t olive oil over this
6. Bake for 10 minute
7. While it is baking mix cheese , bread crumbs , capers , and oregano together
8. Add remaining oil and stir till crumbs are moistened
9. Remove zucchini from oven and sprinkle w / vinegar then stir
10. Sprinkle bread crumbs on top
11. Return to a 400 degree oven for 20 to 30 minutes
12. Serve hot

title: banana sour cream coffee cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f and grease a bundt pan
2. Mix all of the topping ingredients together and set aside
3. Combine melted butter , sugar , eggs and bananas and mix well
4. In a separate bowl , combine the sour cream and baking soda , then set aside
5. In another bowl , combine the flour , salt , and baking powder
6. To the butter mixture , alternately add the flour mixture and the sour cream mixture , beginning and ending with the dry mixture
7. Stir in the vanilla extract
8. In the prepared bundt pan , spread half of the batter , sprinkle the batter with half of the topping mix
9. Repeat with the remaining batter and topping
10. Bake for 55 - 60 minutes , or until a cake tester comes out clean
11. Cool completely on rack before removing from the baking pan
12. Dust with icing sugar prior to serving

title: slow cooked lamb chops with white wine
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 300f
2. Melt 2 tablespoons of the butter and the oil together in an ovenproof frying pan
3. Add the garlic cloves and rosemary
4. Season the lamb with salt and freshly ground black pepper and fry on both sides until brown , before transferring to a baking dish
5. Add the halved garlic heads
6. Heat the wine in a small saucepan and pour over the lamb
7. Cover with foil and cook in the oven to for 1 hours
8. Remove the lamb and garlic halves from the pan and keep warm
9. Strain the wine into a saucepan , squeezing the juices from the rosemary and garlic skins
10. Combine the flour with the remaining butter
11. Heat the wine and juices and stir in the flour and butter mixture , a little at a time
12. Cook until the sauce is smooth and thick
13. Adjust the seasoning as necessary and serve the lamb chops straight away with the sauce poured over

title: olive balls
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. In a medium bowl stir together the cheese , butter and worcestershire sauce
3. Stir in bisquick mix or clone recipe
4. Pat olives dry
5. Wrap 1 teaspoon of dough around 1 olive
6. Place on cookie sheet
7. Repeat
8. Bake for 10 minutes
9. Serve warm

title: gingersnaps with orange ginger cream filling
steps:
1. To make the cookies:
2. In a medium bowl , combine flour , baking soda , cinnamon , ginger , cloves , and salt
3. Set aside
4. In the bowl of an electric mixer , cream butter , brown sugar , and 1 / 2 cup granulated sugar until fluffy , about 2 minutes
5. Add molasses , egg , and vanilla , and beat at medium-high until incorporated , about 30 seconds
6. Reduce speed to low
7. Add flour mixture and mix until well combined
8. Cover and chill at least 30 minutes or up to 1 day
9. Preheat oven to 350f
10. Place remaining 1 / 2 cup granulated sugar in a shallow bowl
11. Shape dough into 1-inch balls
12. Roll in sugar to coat
13. Arrange about 2 inches apart on 2 ungreased baking sheets
14. Using the bottom of a glass that has been lightly greased , then dipped in sugar , flatten dough into 1 / 4-inch-thick disks
15. Bake 13 to 15 minutes , or until firm
16. Remove from oven and immediately transfer cookies to a cooling rack
17. To make the filling:
18. In a medium bowl , combine all ingredients
19. Mix until smooth , adding more powdered sugar as needed
20. With a small spatula , frost bottoms of half the cookies
21. Top with remaining cookies to make sandwich cookies
22. The fresh ginger should be peeled unless otherwise
23. To grate fresh ginger , use a microplane grater or a triangular ginger grater , which will catch unwanted ginger fibers in its teeth , leaving behind a juicy , concentrated pulp

title: jamin s tilapia with spicy dark sauce
steps:
1. Directions
2. In a large frying pan , heat the oil and butter
3. Pat dry the fish on a paper tower then season it with pepper and salt on one side only
4. On a medium heat setting , put the fish on the pan and fry for about 4-5 mins then turn it over , season again and fry for another 3-4 minutes
5. When the fish is about flaky and the outside is golden dark brown , take it out of the pan and set aside
6. Keep warm
7. Meanwhile on the same pan , saute garlic and ginger for about 30 secs
8. Then put and combine the two sauces , lime juice , pepper flakes and brown sugar on the pan
9. Simmer for about 2-3 minutes
10. At this time , you can taste the sauce and suite it according to your liking
11. Turn the heat to high and put the tilapia back and simmer for < 1 minute
12. When the sauce is thick and bubbly , turn off the heat and put the tilapia first on a plate then drizzle it with the sauce
13. Garnish with scallions , cilantro , and tomato
14. Serve immediately on top of jasmine rice
15. Delicious !

title: crab cakes reid
steps:
1. Mix the above ingredients well
2. Shape into cakes and fry in butter until brown
3. May be prepared a day in advance and fried just before serving
4. Makes 6-10
5. I usually made these for my mom and i , and froze them
6. They freeze beautifully

title: low fat chocolate banana parfaits
steps:
1. Into medium bowl , pour milk and add pudding mix
2. With wire whisk beat for 2 minutes or until well blended
3. Evenly spoon half the pudding mix into 4 dessert glasses
4. Make layers of banana slices , 1 / 2 cup of the whipped topping and remaining pudding in each dessert glass
5. With remaining whipped topping , place a dollop on top
6. Refrigerate until ready to serve

title: linzer torte cookies
steps:
1. 1
2. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
3. 2
4. In a medium bowl , cream together the butter and sugar
5. Beat in the egg and lemon peel
6. In another bowl , stir together the flour , nut flour , cinnamon and cloves
7. Gradually stir the dry ingredients into the creamed mixture
8. The dough will be stiff , so you may need to knead it by hand to get it to come together
9. 3
10. Roll the dough out to 1 / 8 inch thickness and cut into rounds using a cookie cutter
11. Place cookies onto a cookie sheet spaced 2 inches apart
12. Count your rounds and use a small cookie cutter to cut the center out of half of the cookies
13. This can be done while the other half of the cookies bakes
14. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes in the preheated oven , until firm and lightly browned at the edges
15. Allow cookies to cool completely
16. Spread jam on the tops of the solid cookies and top with the cookies that have shapes cut out

title: where s the beef      vegetarian black bean chili
steps:
1. Soak beans in water to cover by 2 inches , refrigerated , for at least 8 hours
2. Drain
3. Garnish:
4. Mix sour cream with lime juice and refrigerate
5. Chili:
6. Toast cumin , paprika , cayenne and oregano in dry small heavy skillet over moderate heat , stirring constantly , until fragrant and a shade or two darker , about 2 minutes
7. Transfer to a small bowl
8. Finely grind pasilla in spice / coffee grinder , then stir in spices
9. Heat oil in a 6 quart pot over moderately high heat until hot , but not smoking
10. Add onion and pepper and cook , stirring occasionally until onion is golden , 6 to 8 minutes
11. Add garlic , chipotles and spice mixture , reduce heat to moderate and cook , stirring occasionally for 5 minutes
12. Add beans , bay leaf , cocoa , beer and broth , bring to a simmer , covered , until beans are tender , 1 1 / 2 - 2 hours
13. Add tomatoes , with their juice , and salt to taste and simmer , uncovered for 20-30 minutes , or until chili is slightly thickened
14. Discard bay leaf
15. Just before serving stir in cilantro
16. Serve with lime sour cream
17. Put the beans in a saucepan and cover with cold water by 2 inches
18. Bring to a boil and boil for 2 minutes , then remove from the heat and let the beans soak , covered , for 1 hour
19. Drain

title: puerto rican rice and beans  arroz con habichuelas
steps:
1. Place the water and ham hock in a pressure cooker , check to make sure the steam release holes are clear and cook for 5 minutes
2. Add the pinto beans and cook 20 minutes more
