3. Add the rice , and when the pressure cooker"hisses , " cook for another 5 minutes
4. While the rice and beans cook , heat the oil in a large skillet and saute the onion and garlic until the onion becomes translucent
5. Add the red pepper , jalapeno peppers , oregano and tomatoes , stirring and chopping as you go
6. Add 1 / 4 cup of the reserved tomato juice , half of the salt and half of the pepper
7. Lower the heat and simmer 15 minutes
8. After the rice and beans have cooked , remove the ham hock , slice off 2 ounces of lean meat and reserve
9. Add the cooked rice and beans to the pepper-tomato mixture in the skillet
10. Stir in the reserved ham hock meat , 2 tbs of the cilantro , the capers and the remaining salt and pepper
11. To serve: spoon into bowls and garnish with the remaining cilantro

title: cardamom sour cream waffles
steps:
1. Preheat a waffle iron until hot
2. Whisk together flour , baking powder , baking soda , salt , and cardamom
3. Whisk together remaining ingredients in another bowl , then whisk into flour mixture until just combined
4. Lightly brush waffle iron with oil and cook waffles according to manufacturer's instructions
5. Sprinkle with powdered sugar if desired

title: wolfgang puck s no cook gazpacho
steps:
1. ---prepare gazpacho:
2. In a large bowl , combine all ingredients
3. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour
4. Transfer to food processor , pulse until almost pureed , leaving a little texture
5. Season with salt and pepper
6. Return to bowl , cover and refrigerate another hour before serving
7. ---prepare topping:
8. In a medium bowl , combine all the topping ingredients until well blended
9. Season with salt and pepper
10. Cover and refrigerate until needed
11. ---to serve:
12. Ladle 10 to 12 ounces into chilled soup plates
13. Top with 1 / 4 cup of the topping mixture , 2 shrimp and a sprig of cilantro
14. Place a wedge of lime on the rim of the plate

title: 7 up bread
steps:
1. Mix ingredients together and form into a loaf
2. Place in greased bread pan
3. Bake at 350 for 25 minutes

title: snow capped cinnamon hot cocoa
steps:
1. Combine milk and syrup in 1-quart microwave-safe bowl
2. Microwave on high power for 5 minutes or until hot
3. Stir in ground cinnamon
4. Pour into 4 large mugs
5. Garnish with whipped cream , morsels and cinnamon sticks

title: marmite melt
steps:
1. Lightly toast bread
2. Butter if taste is to strong for you
3. Spread evenly with marmite
4. Top with cheese
5. Place under the grill until cheese starts to bubble

title: canned chicken
steps:
1. Wash 9 pint jars
2. Run them through dishwasher , to sterilize
3. Sterilize lids in the same manner
4. In each pint jar , place 1 / 2 t
5. Salt , and 2 boneless , skinless chicken breasts
6. Fill jar to within 1 / 2" of top with water
7. Run knife down inside of jar to remove air bubbles
8. Wipe off rim of jar with clean , damp cloth
9. Place lid on jar
10. Screw on band
11. Fill pressure canner 1" deep with cold water
12. Place jars in pressure canner
13. Open petcock
14. Turn on fire to medium-high , till steam is rapidly escaping through petcock
15. Close petcock
16. Pressure will start to rise
17. When the needle reaches 10 lb
18. Pressure , start reducing heat till the needle stabilizes at 10 lb
19. Set timer for 70 minutes
20. When 70 minutes are up , turn off fire and leave the pressure canner alone till the needle goes back to zero !
21. Open canner: using a jar lifter , remove jars and set in draft-free place to cool completely
22. Wipe down outside of jars , remove bands , label and place in pantry

title: baked chicken with lemon  potato and olives
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180 degrees celsius
2. Place potatoes , onion , olives , lemon , pancetta and bay leaves in roasting tin
3. Pour over stock
4. Place chicken pieces on top and drizzle with olive oil
5. Season
6. Roast for 50 minutes unil chicken is golden
7. Remove chicken , place on warm plate and cover with foil
8. Increase oven temperature to 220 degrees celsius
9. Return roating tin to oven and cook for approx 10 more minutes until potatoes are golden
10. Place chicken back on top , heat through , sprinkle with parsley and serve

title: ww onion soup dip
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a food processor or blender
2. Process to desired consistency
3. Yields about 3 tablespoons per serving

title: balsamic glazed brussels sprouts
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425
2. Combine brussels sprouts and onion in medium bowl with 3 tablespoons of the olive oil , salt and pepper , tossing gently
3. Spread on lightly greased baking sheet
4. Roast 25 to 30 minutes or until vegetables are tender and caramelized
5. Meanwhile , saute shallot in remaining olive oil in small skillet over medium high heat 5 minutes or until tender
6. Add balsamic vinegar and cook 5 minutes more
7. Stir in rosemary and pour over sprouts

title: reduced fat chicken  spinach   tomato pasta
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to package directions
2. Drain and store to the side
3. Spray with hot water before serving , if needed , to loosen pasta
4. Add 2-3 tbsp of chicken broth to heated pan , add onion , mushrooms , garlic and nutmeg
5. Saute on mid high heat until onion is soft and mushrooms cooked , add more broth if needed to prevent sticking
6. When onions and mushrooms are cooked , add chicken and remainder of chicken broth , cook until broth is almost completely reduced , leaving barely enough liquid to allow spinach to steam
7. Add chopped tomatos to the top of chicken mixture , then layer the chopped spinach , cover and cook until spinach is steamed
8. Add the cheeses & stir , then remove from heat
9. Add the sour cream and mix well
10. Salt and pepper to taste
11. Pour over cooked pasta and serve immediately

title: apricot biscotti
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Spread hazelnuts on a baking sheet and toast in oven 8 to 10 minutes , until fragrant
3. Let cool slightly
4. Place nuts in a dishtowel and rub together to remove some of the skin
5. Coarsely chop and set aside
6. Place butter in the bowl of a stand mixer
7. Beat on medium speed until soft and creamy
8. Gradually add sugar and beat until light and fluffy , about 2 minutes
9. Add lemon rind and eggs , one at a time , beating well after each addition
10. Add vanilla and beat well
11. Combine flour , baking powder and salt in a bowl
12. Stir to blend
13. Gradually add flour mixture to butter mixture , beating on low until a smooth dough forms
14. Stir in hazelnuts and apricots
15. Divide dough in half
16. With lightly floured hands , form dough into two 10 x 2-inch logs
17. Place on an ungreased baking sheet , at least 2 inches apart
18. Bake 30 minutes , or until golden brown
19. Let cool on the baking sheet 15 minutes
20. Transfer logs to a cutting board
21. Using a sharp knife , cut straight down through the log to make 1-inch-thick slices
22. Discard end pieces
23. Arrange on a baking sheet
24. Bake 9 minutes or until lightly browned
25. Turn biscotti over and continue baking until lightly browned on the other side , about 9 minutes
26. Let cool completely on the baking sheets before serving or storing
27. The biscotti store well for one week and freeze well
28. Makes about 20

title: gourmet oatmeal cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees , and line cookie sheet with parchment paper
2. Mix all the chunky stuff up in a medium bowl
3. Whisk together the flour , baking soda , baking powder , and salt in another medium bowl
4. In a large bowl , cream butter and sugar , till there arent too many lumps
5. Then add the eggs and the vanilla and blend
6. Add the flour mixture bit by bit , blending as you go
7. Then , fold in the chunky stuff
8. Dont worry , itll look like theres more chunky stuff that cookie dough , but it will work
9. Drop dough onto parchment lined cookie sheets , i like to portion out a bit less than 1 / 4 cup per cookie
10. Bake for 10 minutes , but if you like them chewy , take them out when the edges look done , but the middles dont
11. Theyll firm up as they cool

title: linguine with red clam sauce
steps:
1. Heat butter and olive oil in pan over medium high heat
2. Add garlic and cook till garlic is golden , about 3 minutes
3. Add parsley , oregano , basil , tomatoes , and salt to pan , mixing well
4. Add undrained clams
5. Bring mixture to a boil
6. Simmer for 5 minutes
7. Cook pasta according to directions
8. Drain
9. Add lemon juice to sauce , cook for 1 minute
10. Put pasta in platter and toss with sauce

title: spicy white cheese dip
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in a 6 quart slow cooker
2. Cover and cook on low for 3 hours , stirring gently every hour
3. Stir before serving
4. Serve with assorted tortilla and corn chips
5. Make ahead and freeze: spoon into quart size freezer containers , and freeze for up to 1 month
6. Thaw overnight in the refrigerator
7. Microwave on high , stirring every 60 seconds until thoroughly heated

title: creamy pasta with rosemary chicken
steps:
1. Chicken:
2. Heat the rosemary in 1 / 8 cup water by microwave or stove to draw out the taste
3. Mix rosemary with 1 / 4 cup olive oil , and add salt and pepper
4. Marinate the chicken slices in this rosemary-olive oil mixture for at least 1 hour , up to 24 hours
5. Do not rinse or drain the marinade - it's not much liquid to begin with
6. When you're ready to prepare the meal , begin heating 1 / 3 inch of olive oil in a large skillet or pot
7. Meanwhile , combine the flour , salt , pepper , and italian seasoning , and mix this in with the marinated chicken so that the pieces become slightly coated with flour
8. They do not need to be dry or perfectly dredged
9. When the oil is hot , add all of the chicken pieces
10. They do not need to be in a single layer
11. Saut them on high heat , stirring them once the bottom layer becomes golden
12. They will not become totally golden or browned , but each piece should have golden edges and be fully cooked
13. Sauce:
14. Heat 1 tbs
15. Butter and 2 tbs
16. Olive oil in a saucepan
17. Saut the minced garlic until golden , not browned
18. Stir in the flour and mix well
19. Add in the rest of the sauce ingredients
20. Let the sauce bubble and thicken for a short time , then turn down the heat
21. Season to taste with salt and black pepper , and garlic powder if desired
22. If desired , you can thin and increase the sauce by adding in more cream
23. Pasta: cook fully , according to package directions - as firm or soft as you like
24. Then drain the cooked pasta
25. Serving: when the chicken , sauce , and pasta are all cooked , mix the pasta with the sauce so that it's coated
26. Stir in the chicken
27. Serve with plain steamed broccoli and carrots , or any other vegetables you enjoy

title: emerald fried rice
steps:
1. Sprinkle the finely shredded greens with 1 teaspoon salt and leave for 10 minutes , then squeeze out the liquid and chop finely
2. Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a frying-pan or crepe pan
3. Pur in the beaten egg and allow to spread thinly over with a palette knife and cook the other side gently
4. Remove the omelette and cut into fine shreds
5. Heat another tablespoon of oil in the frying-pan and add the finely chopped greens
6. Stir-fry for about 30 seconds , then remove from the pan
7. Heat the remaining oil in a wok until it is smoking
8. Add the spring onions , then the rice , and toss well together until the rice is heated through
9. Add the remaining salt with the msg , greens , omelette shreds and ham
10. Toss all together and serve hot on a serving dish

title: ginger pear jello
steps:
1. Dissolve the gelatin in the hot water in a large bowl
2. Add the lemon juice and ginger ale
3. Chill until slightly thickened
4. Fold in pears
5. Chill until firm

title: sweet chocolate wedges   crepes cake
steps:
1. For the filling: combine chocolate and water in saucepan over low heat
2. Stir until chocolate melts
3. Add egg yolks , one at a time , beating well after each is added
4. Remove from heat
5. Cool:
6. Fold in whipped cream
7. Spread chocolate mixture over each crepe
8. Stack crepes on top of each other
9. Chill several hours
10. Cut into six wedges
11. Garnish with slivered almonds , if desired
12. Makes 6 servings
13. For the crepes: mixer or whisk method: in medium mixing bowl , beat eggs
14. Gradually add flour and sugar alternately with milk and water , beating with electric mixer or whisk until smooth
15. Beat in melted butter
16. Blender method: combine ingredients in blender jar
17. Blend for about 1 minute
18. Scrape down sides with rubber spatula and blend for another 15 seconds or until smooth
19. Both methods: refrigerate batter at least 1 hour
20. Cook on upside-down crepe griddle or in traditional pan
21. Brush pan lightly with oil or melted butter
22. Use about 2 to 3 tablespoons of batter per crepe
23. Immediately tilt pan in all directions , swirling the batter so it covers the bottom of the pan in a very thin layer
24. Work quickly before batter cooks too much to swirl
25. Return to heating unit and cook over medium-high heat
26. Cook crepe until bottom is browned
27. Then carefully turn with spatula
28. Use a teflon coated or plastic spatula for coated pans
29. Brown other side for a few seconds
30. Remove from pan with spatula
31. Stack on plate or tray
32. Makes about 20 to 25 crepes
33. Crepe cookery

title: moo shu sloppy joes
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine cornstarch , water , barbecue sauce , hoisin sauce , soy sauce , ginger , garlic and salt
2. In a large skillet saute onion and red pepper in oil until crisp-tender
3. Remove from pan and set aside
4. In same skillet cook ground beef until no longer pink and then drain
5. Stir sauce mixture over meat bring to a boil and cook two minutes until thickened
6. Add coleslaw mix and stir
7. Spoon into tortillas and top with onions and peppers

title: vanilla apple cake with cream cheese frosting
steps:
1. Cake:
2. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
3. Line the bottom of a 10-inch springform cake pan with parchment lined bottom and set aside
4. Placed prepared apples in a bowl and pour brandy over the apples
5. Sift the flour , cinnamon , cloves and baking powder , and set aside
6. Strip the vanilla seeds from the bean , then place the seeds , pod and butter into a small saucepan
7. Cook over low heat until the butter turns brown it will take on a nutty smell and will have an intense vanilla flavor
8. Remove the vanilla bean and let cool to room temperature
9. Separate the eggs and whip the yolks with the vanilla extract and salt
10. When the egg yolks start to change color and start to get fluffy , add 3 / 4 cup of the sugar and continue to whip until light in color
11. Fold in the butter mixture , then fold in the sifted flour mixture
12. Fold in apples and brandy
13. Whip the egg whites until fluffy , then add the remaining 1 / 2 cup of sugar and continue to whip until stiff
14. Fold the whites into the cake batter in thirds
15. When well mixed , pour into the cake pan and bake for 45 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean
16. Let the cake cool on a wire rack
17. When cool , run a butter knife around the edge to loosen then turn out onto a plate and top with vanilla cream cheese frosting
18. Frosting:
19. Place the unsalted butter , vanilla seeds and the powdered sugar in the mixer with the paddle attachment
20. Beat until soft and well creamed
21. Add the cream cheese and continue to mix until well combined
22. Spread on top of the cooled cake
23. Refrigerate the cake until the frosting is firm , about 30 minutes

title: low fat chicken and dumplings
steps:
1. In large saucepan , bring water to a boil over high heat
2. Add chicken , return to a boil , lower heat
3. Cover chicken and simmer for 30 minutes or until it is fork tender
4. Remove chicken and defat the stock
5. Return chicken and stock to pan adding cream of chicken soup and return to a boil while you mix the dumplings
6. In a medium bowl , mix the egg substitute and milk into the flour to form a soft batter-like dough
7. Drop by teaspoonfuls into the boiling broth
8. Let boil 15 minutes without stirring to thicken
9. Do not stir

title: chicken  roasted capsicum  feta and walnut pasta salad
steps:
1. Cook pasta in large saucepan of boiling water until just tender , drain and rinse under cold running water , drain again
2. Drain capsicum , reserving 1 / 3 cup of the capsicum oil , chop capsicum coarsely
3. Combine capsicum and pasta in large bowl with feta cheese , chicken , walnuts and basil
4. Combine reserved oil with vinegar , garlic and mustard , mixing well
5. Drizzle dressing over chicken mixture , toss gently to combine

title: skillet scramble surprise
steps:
1. Saute sausage , onions and apples in large skillet until onions and apples are tender
2. Stir occasionally
3. Lower fat alternative: substitute turkey smoked sausage

title: rich cinnamon cookies
steps:
1. Cream shortening , sugar and vanilla together
2. Beat eggs well
3. Sift dry ingredients together and add to creamed mixture alternatively with beaten eggs
4. Chill one hour
5. Mold with cookie press or drop from teaspoon and flatten with a glass covered with a damp towel
6. Bake 425f for 7 minutes

title: sausages in sauce
steps:
1. Cut sausage into small pieces
2. Lightly brown in frying pan
3. Place sausage in a casserole dish
4. Combine sauce ingredients and place over sausages
5. Bake covered at 325f for 1 1 / 2 hours

title: bronzed alaska salmon in a butter wine sauce
steps:
1. Pat salmon dry with paper towel
2. Heat nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
3. Brush salmon with oil and place in heated skillet and cook , uncovered , about 3 to 4 minutes , until browned
4. Shake pan occasionally to keep salmon from sticking
5. Turn salmon over and sprinkle with the seafood seasoning
6. Cover pan tightly and reduce heat to medium
7. Cook for 2 minutes
8. Add the wine and butter
9. Continue to cook , uncovered , an additional 1 to 2 minutes , or just until fish is opaque throughout and sauce is reduced
10. Drizzle sauce over salmon when serving

title: the bag lady s favorite chocolate pound cake   paula deen
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees f
2. Grease and flour a 10-inch bundt pan
3. Sift together flour , baking soda , baking powder , salt , and cocoa and set aside
4. Using an electric mixer , cream together butter , shortening , and sugar until fluffy
5. Add eggs one at a time and mix well after each addition
6. Add flour and buttermilk alternately to butter mixture , beginning and ending with flour
7. Add vanilla and mix well
8. Pour batter into prepared pan
9. Bake for 1 3 / 4 hours , or until cake is done
10. Remove from oven and allow cake to cool in pan for 10 minutes
11. Invert onto cake plate and serve

title: marie s coleslaw
steps:
1. Heat vinegar and sugar over low heat until the sugar is dissolved
2. Cool , then add the rest of the ingredients
3. Place in a large jar with a tight fitting lid
4. Refrigerate for several days , turning twice a day , before serving
5. Very good keeper
6. To serve drain amount needed for meal and dress with a little mayonnaise if desired

title: don strange ranch   cranberry chutney
steps:
1. In heavy saucepan over med-low heat add jalapeno jelly with vinegar , honey and sugar stir until sugar is dissolved
2. Remove from stove
3. Add everything else mixing thoroughly
4. Let mixture sit for 1 hour to meld flavors
5. Can be made several days ahead and refrigerated
6. Raisins will plump up
7. Allow to come to room temperature or heat to serve

title: scacchi  passover lasagna
steps:
1. In a skillet , heat the olive oil over medium heat until it shimmers
2. Add the meat and onions with a pinch of salt , and saute until onions are translucent and meat has lost most of its pink color
3. Drain any excess fat
4. Add garlic , cinnamon , allspice and raisins with their soaking liquid
5. Continue to cook until soaking liquid is absorbed
6. Transfer to a bowl and set aside
7. When slightly cooled , 15-20 minutes , stir in beaten eggs
8. In same skillet , heat olive oil over medium heat until it shimmers
9. Add onions and saute until the edges begin to brown
10. Add mushrooms and pine nuts
11. Cook until mushrooms give up their water and become limp
12. Add spinach
13. If using fresh spinach , add 1 tbsp water
14. Add nutmeg and cook until spinach is completely limp and mixture is fairly dry
15. Transfer to a bowl and set aside
16. When slightly cooled , 15-20 minutes , stir in beaten eggs
17. Preheat oven to 350f grease a 13x9x2 baking dish with oil or spray
18. Soak matzo in hot chicken broth until softened and flexible
19. Place two soaked matzos in the bottom of the dish
20. Cover with 2 / 3 of meat mixture
21. Top with two more soaked matzos
22. Cover with 2 / 3 of spinach mixture
23. Top with two more soaked matzos
24. Stir remaining meat and spinach mixtures together and spread over matzos
25. Top with remaining two soaked matzos
26. Beat eggs with 1 / 4-1 / 2 c cool chicken broth and pour over everything
27. Bake in preheated oven 30-40 minutes until heated through and golden brown

title: caramelized carnitas
steps:
1. Place pork cubes in single layer in 10-inch skillet
2. Top with remaining ingredients except green onion
3. Heat to boiling
4. Reduce heat
5. Simmer uncovered , stirring occasionally until the water has evaproated and the pork is slightly caramelized , about 35 minutes
6. Sprinkle with green onion and serve with wooden picks

title: top secret version of buffalo wild wings asian zing sauce
steps:
1. Dissolve corn starch in rice wine vinegar in a small bowl and set aside
2. In a small sauce pan combine remaining ingredients
3. Add corn starch and rice wine vinegar mixture and stir well
4. Heat mixture on low / medium heat , stirring often until sauce reaches a boil and thickens
5. Remove from heat , allow it to cool then cover it and chill it until ready to use

title: my not so quick and easy chicken noodle soup
steps:
1. Heat chicken and water to boiling , skimming fat as it accumulates
2. Add the onion , celery , carrots , seasonings , and bouillon
3. Bring back up to a boil , cover and simmer over low heat for approximately 45 minutes to an hour
4. When chicken is tender , remove to a plate till cool enough to handle
5. Remove skin and pull off meat into bite-size pieces
6. Place chicken back in the pot , and add noodles , and fresh parsley if desired
7. Reheat and serve

title: food processor orange date muffins
steps:
1. Toss the dates with 1 / 2 cup of the all-purpose flour
2. In a food processor fitted with a metal blade , process the mixture until evenly chopped
3. Add the orange and process until finely chopped
4. Add the orange juice , eggs and butter and process until blended
5. Stir together the whole wheat flour , remaining all-purpose flour , sugar , baking powder , baking soda and salt
6. Add the date mixture and process just until moistened but not overmixed
7. Spoon into large greased for paper-lined muffin cups , filling three-quarters full
8. Bake in a 400 degree f oven for 15 to 20 minutes or until the tops are firm to the touch

title: tracey s tasty tuna patties
steps:
1. Take can of corn , flaked tuna , mashed potato , cooked rice , 1 egg , garlic , salt , pepper , herbs , onion and cheese and mix them together in a large bowl
2. Heat cooking oil in a frying pan on stove top
3. Take mixture and roll into golf ball sized balls
4. Put plain flour into a bowl , mix beaten egg , 1 / 4 cup of milk , 1 / 4 teaspoon of salt and 1 / 4 teaspoon of pepper together , then put into a bowl , put breadcrumbs into a bowl
5. Take balls of mixture and drop them into the bowl of plain flour , then put them into the bowl of egg mixture , then coat them in the the bowl of breadcrumbs
6. Do about 6-7 balls at a time
7. Put them in the heated oil pan , pressing them down to make into patties at the same time
8. Cook for about 10 - 12 minutes or until they are golden brown , then turn them over and cook the other side until they are golden brown
9. Take them out and place them on paper towels to drain the excess oil off of them
10. Repeat steps until all of the mixture is used up
11. You can serve them hot or cold with salad or with chips or even steamed vegetables
12. If you are not into really fried crispy patties , you could skip instructions 4-6 and just take the plain mixture and make them into balls
13. Spray your frying pan with cooking spray and then put mixture balls into the pan
14. Press them down to make them patties
15. Cook until they are golden brown
16. I have cooked these patties both ways and they are so delicious

title: spicy maple walnuts
steps:
1. Preheat the over to 300f
2. Combine all ingredients but walnuts in a saucepan and simmer over low heat for 2-3 minutes
3. Put the walnuts in a large bowl , pour on the glaze , and toss to coat
4. Line a rimmed baking sheet with foil and spread the walnuts in a single layer
5. Bake 30-40 minutes , stirring and scooping up the glaze to cover the walnuts at least every 10 minutes
6. When walnuts look almost dry , they're done
7. Slide the walnuts , still on the foil , onto a wire rack and let them cool completely
8. You may want to pull out the ginger pieces

title: the most delicious maple glazed pork loin
steps:
1. Rub pork loin with mixture of ginger and salt
2. Insert meat thermometer in the thickest part of the pork loin
3. Arrange hot coals around drip pan in covered grill
4. Place the pork loin fat side up on grill rack over drip pan
5. Grill with the lid down for 2-2 1 / 2 hours or to 170 degrees on meat thermometer
6. Baste frequently with mixture of barbeque sauce , maple syrup and orange rind during the last hour of cooking
7. Remove to serving platter and cut into thin slices
8. Garnish with red grapes , green grapes and parsley sprigs

title: impossibly easy pecan pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Grease a 9-inch pie plate
3. Sprinkle pecans in pie plate
4. Beat remaining ingredients with fork until blended
5. Pour carefullly into pie plate
6. Bake 45 to 50 minutes in preheated oven or until golden brown and knife inserted in center comes out clean
7. Let stand 5 minutes before cutting
8. Refrigerate any remaining pie
9. To serve: you may wish to top off pie slices with whipped topping and a sprinkling of chopped pecans
10. Or serve it a la mode

title: old  south  pumpkin  pie  with  apple butter
steps:
1. In large bowl , mix all ingredients , stirring after each one
2. Pour into pie shell and bake at 425f for about 45 minutes

title: drew boy s real chocolate banana muffins
steps:
1. Pre heat oven to 400f
2. Mash the 3 over ripe bananas well
3. Chop remain banana fairly fine
4. Sift flour , baking powder and cocoa twice into a large bowl
5. Beat eggs , cooled melted butter and sugar in separate bowl until light and fluffy
6. Beat in milk and bananas to the egg mixture until just combined
7. Stir chocolate into egg mixture
8. Pour egg mixture into the dry ingredients and mix by hand until just combined -- it will be lumpy
9. Spoon into buttered muffin pans or paper liners
10. Bake for 20-25 minutes
11. If you've used liners remove the muffins from the pan immediately you take them out of the oven

title: tokay cookies
steps:
1. Bring first four ingredients to a rolling boil
2. Remove from the heat
3. Stir in the last ingredients
4. Spoon onto wax paper and let cool
5. Enjoy !

title: chicken cakes parmigiana
steps:
1. In medium bowl , mix bread crumbs , egg , milk , parmesan cheese and garlic salt
2. Stir in chicken
3. Shape chicken mixture by about 1 / 4 cupfuls into 8 cakes
4. In 12-inch nonstick skillet , heat oil over medium-high heat
5. Cook cakes in oil 4 to 5 minutes , turning once , until golden brown
6. Drain on paper towels
7. Serve cakes topped with pasta sauce and mozzarella cheese

title: chicken and black bean taquitos with adobo sour cream   3 ww poi
steps:
1. To prepare taquitos , heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat
2. Add chicken , and saut 5 minutes or until done
3. Place chicken in a food processor
4. Add cheese , beans , and green chiles
5. Pulse 15 times or until beans are coarsely chopped
6. Spoon about 3 tablespoons chicken mixture across the lower third of each tortilla
7. Roll up
8. Cut each tortilla in half
9. Secure with wooden picks
10. Place taquitos in a large zip-top plastic bag
11. Freeze up to 3 months
12. Preheat oven to 400
13. Place frozen taquitos on a large baking sheet coated with cooking spray
14. Bake at 400 for 10 minutes
15. Turn taquitos , and coat with cooking spray
16. Bake an additional 10 minutes or until golden
17. To prepare adobo sour cream , combine sour cream , cilantro , and chipotle chile
18. Stir well
19. Yield: 20 servings
20. Calories 125 fat 4
21. 1g fiber 1
22. 1g

title: rachael ray s meatza pizza burgers
steps:
1. Combine ground beef , tomato paste , chorizo or pepperoni , oregano , garlic , and pepper
2. Form into 4 patties
3. Now it's time to cook the burgers
4. Ray's directions are for grilling: cook burgers for 5 minutes on each side over medium-high gas heat or charcoal
5. But i bet you can just pan fry them or pop them on an indoor grill
6. In the last minute , melt a slice of provolone on each burger
7. Serve with romaine lettuce and slice tomato on crusty rolls

title: pop pop s turkey chili
steps:
1. Heat oil and saute onion , celery , and garlic until onion is golden
2. Add turkey , saute until turkey is no longer pink , breaking it up into small pieces as it cooks
3. Add tomato sauce , chili powder , and cumin and stir
4. Bring to a boil , reduce to low , cover and simmer 20 minutes , stirring occasionally
5. Mix in beans , salt , and pepper
6. Cover and simmer 30 minutes

title: tea twister
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , bring water to boil , then remove from heat & add tea bags
2. Cover & set aside to brew for 5 minutes , before removing tea bags & squeezing them over the saucepan
3. Stir in remaining ingredients , then chill at least 2 hours , before serving in ice-filled glasses

title: tomato tortilla soup
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large dutch oven over medium high heat
2. Add onions and celery and saute about 15 minutes until onions are tender and golden
3. Add garlic and jalepenos and saute 2 more minutes
4. Add cumin and saute 1 more minute
5. Add chicken stock , tomato and 1 cup cilantro
6. Simmer 20 minutes
7. Stir in chips and simmer until chips are very soft about 10 minutes
8. Cool slightly
9. Working in batches , puree soup in blender until smooth
10. Return to pot and bring to simmer
11. Season with salt and pepper , garnish with cheese and remaining cilantro , and serve with a lime wedge

title: peanut butter cup cookies   wowzers
steps:
1. Cream butter , sugars , egg , peanut butter and vanilla until smooth
2. Mix the flour , baking soda and salt , then add to mixture and mix well
3. Cover dough & refrigerate at least one hour
4. Remove from refrigerator and roll into small walnut-sized balls
5. Place balls into greased miniature muffin pans
6. Bake at 350 for 8-9 minutes
7. Remove from the oven
8. Press a peanut butter cup into center of each cookie
9. Let cool before removing from pan
10. Variation: place balls of dough onto ungreased cookie sheets
11. Press 1 hershey's kiss into the center of the unbaked cookie dough
12. Bake at 350 for 10 minutes--candy won't melt
13. Let cookies cool slightly before removing from the cookie sheets

title: linda s butter cream easter eggs
steps:
1. Mix the butter and cream cheese together
2. Add the confectionary sugar about 1 cup at a time , along with vanilla , and mix well
3. Place the mixture in the freezer to chill for at least 20 minutes
4. Form the mixture into egg shapes with your hands
5. When you are done making the eggs , put them in freezer again for at least 25 minutes
6. Melt the chocolate in a a double boiler
7. Dip the bottom of the egg into the chocolate , then place it on a small flat dish
8. Take a spoon , and spoon some melted chocolate on top , spreading around with a butter knife
9. Arrange the chocolate coated eggs on an aluminum foil paper lined tray
10. When done making eggs , put in the freezer for a few minutes to harden eggs
11. Place each egg in a pastel colored paper cupcake cup
12. Store in the refrigerator , covered with aluminum foil

title: fresh lemon vinaigrette dressing  zitronenvinaigrette
steps:
1. In a small shallow bowl , whisk together the oil , garlic , salt , pepper , and sugar with a fork
2. Add the dijon mustard and whisk vigorously
3. Add the tablespoon of white balsamic vinegar and the 2 tablespoons fresh lemon juice , and whisk again
4. Use immediately
5. Drizzle over fresh salad greens or wafer thin cucumber slices
6. Also great drizzled over grilled halibut or sea bass

title: low fat and low cholesterol chocolate cupcakes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Grease or paper-line muffin cups
3. In a mixing bowl , combine water , salad dressing and vanilla
4. Combine flour , sugar , cocoa and baking soda
5. Add to the salad dressing mixture and beat until well mixed
6. Fill muffin cups two-thirds full
7. Bake for 20 minutes , or until cupcakes test done

title: my favorite cookie icing frosting
steps:
1. Cream together butter and sugar
2. Slowly mix in milk , then vanilla and almond
3. Whisk until fluffy
4. Can be spread or piped onto cookies
5. Icing will begin to harden in less than 30 minutes
6. Wait a few hours before stacking iced cookies

title: mexican chicken corn chowder
steps:
1. In a dutch oven , brown chicken , onion and garlic in butter until chicken is no longer pink
2. Dissolve the bouillon in hot water
3. Add to pan along with cumin
4. Bring to a boil
5. Reduce heat
6. Cover and simmer for 5 minutes
7. Add the cream , cheese , corn , chilies and hot pepper sauce
8. Cook and stir over low heat until the cheese is melted
9. Stir in tomato
10. Serve immediately
11. Sprinkle with cilantro if desired
12. Yield: 6-8 servings

title: mediterranean lima beans
steps:
1. Heat oil in skillet over medium-high heat
2. Cook onions until soft , 3- 5 minutes
3. Add garlic and cook for 1 minute
4. Stir in spices , tomatoes , and lima beans and cook for 10- 15 minutes , stirring occasionally

title: spiced quince jam
steps:
1. To make the quince juice , wash & wipe off fuzz from quinces , cut off stem & anything remaining at blossom end and cut into eighths
2. Do not discard the cores or the seeds as they contain a lot of natural pectin
3. Place in a large pan and cover with water so the pieces float
4. Bring to a boil and stir
5. Reduce heat to a low simmer , cover and simmer for 2 to 3 hours , stirring occasionally
6. Using a fine sieve , strain the "juice" from the pulp
7. The "juice" can vary from an actual juice to a thin puree - it depends on if the fruit breaks down or not
8. Press on the fruit with the back of a large spoon to extract all the juice
9. If some of the pulp squeezes through the sieve and into the juice that's fine
10. If you get more than the 6 cups needed for this recipe you can freeze it to use later
11. Place two or three small saucers in the freezer
12. You will use these later to check the set of the jam
13. In a preserving pan , combine the 6 cups quince juice , juice and zest of the orange and the lemon , spices , & sugar
14. If you don't have a preserving pan , use the widest pan you have
15. The wider the pan , the more quickly moisture will evaporate from the mixture , and this is what you want when making jelly or jam
16. Bring to a boil and continue cooking on medium-high heat for about 20 minutes , stirring gently
17. Check the set - it may take up to 40 minutes of simmering over medium high heat for the jelly / jam to reach the set stage - use the cold plate test to check set: take the pot of jam off the heat place a drop of the jam mixture on one of the saucers you've kept in the freezer , & place the plate back in the freezer for 1 minute
18. After 1 minute , take the saucer out of the freezer and nudge the drop of jam with your finger
19. If it "wrinkles" when you nudge it with your finger it is done
20. If the jam is not set , continue cooking over medium-high heat , checking the set again every 5 minutes
21. Once the set point is reached , put the jam into jars , leaving 1 / 4 inch headspace
22. Place flat lids and rings on and process in a boiling water bath for 10 minutes

title: lemon garlic marinated shrimp  ice cold and refreshing
steps:
1. Place garlic and oil in a small skillet and cook over medium heat until fragrant , about 1 minute
2. Add lemon juice , parsley , salt and pepper
3. Toss with shrimp in a large bowl
4. Chill until ready to serve

title: oreo ice cream delight
steps:
1. Crush enough oreos for a layer in a casserole dish
2. Slice ice cream and layer over oreos
3. Next spread a layer of fudge topping
4. Spread layer of cool whip
5. Sprinkle more crushed oreos over the top
6. Freeze for 15 minutes
7. Serve and watch it dissappear !

title: asian slaw with red pears
steps: 1. Whisk dressing ingredients together in a large bowl , toss in remaining ingredients and add salt to taste just before serving

title: aztec casserole
steps:
1. Ahead of time:
2. Prepare dried beans in a slow cooker
3. Cook on high until tender ,
4. Prepare grains in rice cooker following directions for 2 cups of grain
5. When beans and grains are cooked:
6. In a very large skillet or sautee pan , heat half of the olive oil and brown the meat
7. Remove the meat to drain
8. Add the remaining oil and then cooking over medium heat , add chopped onions , peppers and garlic
9. Cook these until crisp-tender
10. Stir in corn and red chile paste
11. Add the cooked beans and the cooked grains
12. Add the drained meat
13. Salt to taste and stir well
14. Simmer the mixture to slightly reduce the liquid and meld the flavors

title: sweet potato  parsnip and turnip bisque
steps:
1. In a 6-8 quart soup pot saute the onion and garlic in the olive oil until the onion is softened
2. Add the sweet potato , parsnip and turnip and cook until softened , about 8 minutes , stirring occasionally
3. Add the chicken stock and bring to a boil
4. Boil uncovered for 15 minutes or until vegetables are tender
5. Puree using either a stick / immersion blender or by transferring to a blender and then back to the pot
6. Slowly add the heavy cream into the puree
7. Ladle into bowls and garnish with a dollop of sour cream and a sprinkle of chopped flat leaf parsley

title: broccoli cheese soup
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in greased 4 to 6 quart slow cooker
2. Cover and cook on high hear 2-3 hours or on low heat 4-5 hours
3. Spoon over baked potato or simply garnish with bacon

title: caramel thumbprint cookies
steps:
1. Remove wrappers from chocolates
2. Lightly grease cookie sheets
3. Beat brownie mix , pouch of syrup , cocoa , eggs , oil and water in medium bowl until well blended
4. Cover
5. Refrigerate about 1 hour or until thoroughly chilled
6. Heat oven to 350f shape dough into 48 1-inch balls
7. Roll balls in pecans , if desired
8. Place on prepared cookie sheet
9. Press thumb gently in center of each cookie
10. Bake 9 to 11 minutes or until set
11. Cool slightly
12. Remove from cookie sheet to wire rack
13. Cool completely
14. Place 18 caramel filled chocolates and milk in small microwave-safe bowl
15. Microwave at medium 30 seconds
16. Stir
17. If necessary microwave at medium an additional 10 seconds at a time , stirring after each heating , until chocolates are melted and smooth when stirred
18. Spoon slightly rounded 1 / 4 teaspoon caramel filling in each indentation
19. Lightly press chocolate in center of each cookie

title: deviled egg spread
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 450
2. In a large saucepan , cover the eggs with water , add the vinegar and bring to a rapid boil
3. Cover the saucepan and remove it from the heat
4. Let stand for 15 minutes
5. Drain the eggs and cool them under cold running water , shaking the pan vigorously to crack the shells
6. Let the eggs cool in the water
7. Meanwhile , quarter the bread slices on the diagonal and arrange them in a single layer on a large cookie sheet
8. Toast the bread in the oven for about 6 minutes , turning once , until barely browned
9. Shell the eggs and halve them lengthwise
10. Coarsely chop half of the egg whites and transfer them to a large bowl
11. Add the remaining whites and all of the yolks to a food processor along with the mayonnaise and mustard and process until smooth
12. Scrape the mixture into the bowl and blend with the chopped egg whites
13. Season with salt and pepper
14. Top the toast points with the egg spread and dust lightly with paprika
15. Arrange the toasts on a platter and serve
16. Alternatively , serve the egg spread in a bowl with the toast points alongside

title: marshall field s lemon pasta salad
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to package directions
2. Meanwhile , combine the lemon zest , olive oil , lemon juice , salt and pepper in a bowl
3. Set aside
4. Drain pasta and transfer to a large bowl
5. Pour lemon oil mixture over warm pasta
6. Toss cover and refrigerate for at least one hour
7. Stir in the tomatoes , fresh basil , cheese and dried basil
8. Cover and refrigerate for an additional hour

title: herb and asiago crescent strips
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375
2. Separate dough into 2 long rectangles
3. Unroll 1 rectangle onto ungreased cookie sheet
4. Sprinkle with 2 tablespoons cheese , basil and oregano
5. Unroll second rectangle and place over cheese and herbs
6. Roll with a rolling pin to flatten slightly
7. Brush with egg and sprinkle with 1 tablespoon of cheese
8. Bake at 375 for 8 to 12 minutes or until golden brown
9. To serve , cut into strips or wedges

title: nuoc mam cham   dipping fish sauce
steps:
1. Boil water with vinegar and sugar
2. Allow it to cool
3. Combine garlic , peppers , and add mixture
4. Stir in the fish sauce

title: asian chicken pasta salad
steps:
1. In a small bowl , blend soy sauce , rice vinegar , water , mustard , seseame oil , garlic , and hot pepper flakes , set aside
2. Blanch snow peas in a pot of boiling hot water for 1 minute
3. Drain immediately and put into ice cold water
4. Drain again
5. Pat dry
6. Cook pasta or noodle according to package directions
7. Rinse with cold water and drain well
8. In large bowl , stir together pasta , chicken , snow peas , red pepper , green onions , and reserved dressing
9. Refridgerate for no less then 30 minutes before eating
10. Just before serving , top with bean sprouts if using
11. If well chilled , this salad will keep for up to 2 days
12. P
13. S
14. I have used shrimp instead of chicken , it's just as yummy !

title: easy roasted potato crisps
steps:
1. Use a roasting pan with a drip rack
2. Spray the pan , line it with tin foil , insert rack , spray the rack and interior tinfoil
3. Wash potatoes , then slice thinly lengthwise
4. Place potatoes flat on drip rack , spray lightly with butter flavored fat-free cooking spray , then sprinkle generously with mccormick grill mates salt-free steak seasoning
5. Roast in 400 degree oven for 1 hour until wedges are tender and crispy
6. Serve with grilled turkey-burgers on wheat buns , and no salt added ketchup on the side if desired
7. You can also wrap these in tinfoil and cook on your grill if desired

title: summer cucuzza salad
steps:
1. Steam the cucuza or zucchini over boiling water until soft but not mushy
2. This will depend on the denseness of the veggie , so keep your eye on it after about 3 minutes , keep checking
3. Transfer to a bowl and while still warm add the rest of the ingredients and toss
4. Allow to come to room temperature carefully tossing ingredients occasionally to evenly distribute the flavors
5. Serve at room temperature or slightly cool

title: aunt miggies pear cake
steps:
1. Mix pears , sugar and oil- let stand 1 hour
2. Mix the rest of the ingredients then add to the pear mixture
3. This makes a thin batter
4. Do not use a mixer , do this all by hand
5. Pour into a greased-floured tube pan
6. Bake 1 hour 15 minutes at 325 degress
7. Serve w / or w / out cream cheese icing
8. Cream cheese icing :
9. 1 / 2 c butter softened , 8 oz
10. Cream cheese softend , 1 t vanilla & 1 pound powdered sugar
11. If it is to thick add a little milk
12. Spread over top of cake adn top w / nuts if you want

title: strawberry ginger smoothie
steps:
1. Blend the liquids , honey , ginger and almonds together until smooth
2. Add the strawberries
3. Puree
4. Add a little extra juice , if necessary

title: sauteed spinach and butter beans
steps:
1. In saucepan , heat butter , saut celery and sun dried tomatoes
2. About 1 minute
3. Add beans , thyme and cup broth or water
4. Cover pan
5. Heat through over low heat
6. Meanwhile , heat oil in skillet over medium-high heat
7. Add onion
8. Cook until golden
9. Continue cooking until onion becomes crisp
10. Remove onion and set aside
11. Add spinach and remaining cup broth to skillet
12. Sprinkle with salt and cayenne pepper
13. Cover and cook until leaves wilt , about 1 to 3 minutes
14. Season with splash of vinegar , if desired
15. To serve , mound spinach on plate
16. Top with bean mixture
17. Add onion rings and garnishes of choice

title: grilled portabella and brie burgers
steps:
1. Prepare grill or preheat grill pan
2. Brush salad dressing on both sides of the portobello caps and onion slices
3. Grill portobellos and onions on both sides until mushrooms soften and onions are lightly browned
4. Drain portobellos well on paper towels
5. Combine pesto and mayonnaise in a small bowl
6. To assemble burgers: spread pesto mayonnaise on bottom halves of rolls
7. Top with spinach , tomato , grilled onions , and portobellos
8. Spread top halves of rolls with brie and place on burgers

title: kolokithakia feta   zucchini with feta
steps:
1. Preheat broiler
2. Wash zucchini , pat dry and slice lengthwise into slices about 1 / 4 inch thick
3. Brush both sides lightly with olive oil , arrange on baking sheet and broil until golden
4. Set aside
5. Lightly oil an 8 x 12 inch casserole
6. Alternately layer zucchini , onion slices , tomato , feta , parsley , salt and pepper , ending with zucchini
7. Top with crumbled feta
8. Add wine , dot with butter and bake , uncovered , in a preheated 375f oven for 30 minutes or until ingredients are bubbling and topping is slightly browned

title: accidental hearty nacho soup
steps:
1. Brown meat in a skillet over medium heat
2. Once brown , add taco seasoning and water
3. Stir and let simmer for five minutes
4. Drain meat slightly , but not completely
5. Stack slices of american cheese and cut into thin strips , then cut those strips into little squares
6. Into a large pot , add the cheese squares , soup , salsa , milk and bell pepper
7. Add the taco meat
8. Stir to combine and cook over medium heat until cheese squares have melted and incorporated and the mixture is almost boiling
9. Top with avocado and sour cream if you choose
10. Serve hot with plenty of tortilla chips for dipping or crushing on top
11. Yum !

title: robin s salsa
steps:
1. In blender grind chilis , cumin and salt to a powder
2. Drain the juice from tomatoes and add to blender
3. Add garlic and blend
4. Chop green onion and add to blender
5. Add tomatoes
6. Blend till mixed

title: oven roasted tomatoes with garlic and anchovies
steps:
1. Set oven to 400f
2. Grease a 13x9-inch baking dish
3. Slice the tomatoes in half lengthwise and then cut each half into three wedges , then arrange the tomatoes in a single layer in the baking dish
4. Sprinkle with chopped anchovies , parsley , chopped or sliced garlic , crushed red pepper flakes salt and pepper
5. Drizzle with olive oil
6. Bake the tomatoes uncovered until tender , wrinkled and starting to brown around the edges
7. Serve with more olive oil on the side

title: potato gnocchi with parsley sauce
steps:
1. Heat the potatoes and enough water to cover to boiling
2. Cover and boil about 30 minutes or until tender
3. Drain and cool slightly
4. Peel potatoes and mash in large bowl until smooth
5. Cool
6. Stir 1 teaspoon of salt , the eggs and enough of the flour into mashed potatoes to make a stiff dough
7. Shape into 1-inch oval balls
8. Place remaining ingredients except water and 1 tablespoon salt in blender
9. Cover and blend on medium-speed until smooth
10. Heat 4 quarts water and 1 tablespoon slat to boiling in a large dutch oven or stockpot
11. Add about one-fourth of the gnocchi
12. After gnocchi rise to surface , boil uncovered 4 minutes
13. Remove with slotted spoon
14. Drain
15. Repeat with remaining gnocchi
16. Gently toss gnocchi and parsley sauce until gnocchi is coated
17. Serve as 6 side servings , or 3 main course servings

title: molten chocolate cake
steps:
1. Grease six 3 / 4 cup ramekins with the 2 tsp of buttr
2. Coat bottom and sides of each ramekin with cocoa , discarding the excess
3. Heat the 2 / 3 cup butter and chocolate in a small heavy saucepan on lowest heat , stirring often , until almost melted
4. Do not overheat
5. Remove from heat
6. Stir until smooth
7. Cool slightly
8. Beat egg yolks and whole eggs in medium bowl for about 2 minutes until frothy
9. Beat in icing sugar on low
10. Add chocolate mixture and flour
11. Beat well until thick and glossy
12. Divide batter among prepared ramekins
13. Place on baking sheet
14. Bake in 450f oven for about 12 minutes until evenly risen and edges appear set , but middle is still wobbly
15. Let stand for 3-5 minutes
16. Run knife around side of cakes to loosen
17. Cover with individual plate and invert to remove
18. At this point cakes can sit inverted without removing ramekins for up to 20 minutes without getting cold
19. Serve with ice cream

title: crab and avocado salad
steps:
1. Mix picked crabmeat with aioli , chives , salt and pepper
2. Cut avocados in half
3. Scoop out meat
4. Mash slightly with a fork with lime juice , brunoise vegetables , salt and pepper
5. On a plate , fan sliced cucumbers
6. Place avocados in center
7. Place crab on the avocado
8. Sesame cracker on top
9. With herbs or baby lettuce garnish
10. Around the outside of the plate , dot aioli alternating with cherry tomatoes
11. Sprinkle black sesame seeds
12. And serve

title: hg s tropical treat sorbet
steps:
1. Dissolve drink mix into four ounces of cold water , stir well
2. If using frozen mango , run under cool water for several minutes to thaw , so it blends more easily
3. In a blender , puree mango and drink mix mixture until just blended
4. Pour into a dish , cover , and place in freezer until nearly solid
5. If freezing overnight , thaw slightly by microwaving for 40 seconds or allowing it to sit out for about 10 minutes

title: mixed baby greens with creamy dressing
steps:
1. Place greens in a salad bowl and cover with plastic wrap
2. Chill until serving time
3. For dressing , in a jar with a tight-fitting lid , combine remaining ingredients except sour cream
4. Cover and shake vigorously until well combined
5. Add sour cream
6. Cover and shake well
7. Dressing can be chilled , covered , until serving time or used immediately
8. Before serving , drizzle dressing over greens
9. Toss gently until well coated
10. Serve immediately

title: spicy low fat  new potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450f degrees
2. Cut the potatoes into quarters , or smaller pieces if the potatoes are larger than usual
3. Place the cut up pieces in a baking dish
4. Sprinkle potatoes with olive oil
5. Sprinkle potatoes with garlic powder
6. Sprinkle potatoes with chili powder
7. Sprinkle generously with mrs dash original blend spice
8. Bake for 45 minutes

title: troy s onion shortcake
steps:
1. Cube onion and sautee in butter
2. Set aside
3. Combine corn muffin mix , egg , milk , creamed corn and pepper sauce
4. Pour into buttered 8" square pan
5. Combine onion with sour cream , salt , dill weed and 1 / 2 cup cheese
6. Spread onion mixture over batter and sprinkle with remaining cheese
7. Bake at 425 for 25-30 minutes

title: maple sweet dumpling squash
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Cut the squash in half and remove seeds with a spoon
3. Use a fork to poke several holes in the outside skin of each half of the squash
4. Place squash in baking pan with hollow side up
5. Add 1" of water to bottom of pan
6. Place 1 tablespoon of butter , 1 / 8 teaspoon of nutmeg and 1 / 2 teaspoon of cinnamon in the hollow of each squash half
7. Pour 1 / 4 cup of maple syrup on each
8. Bake uncovered on middle rack for 30-45 minutes or until the flesh is soft
9. Serve hot
10. If using sweet dumpling squash , each half will serve one person and can be served with dinner "as is
11. " alternately , you may allow the squash halves to cool partially , remove the skins , and mash or puree the squash

title: spiced rice with fresh ginger
steps:
1. Boil water , ginger , spices , and salt in a saucepan over high heat
2. Reduce heat to low , add rice , cover , and simmer until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed , 15 minutes
3. Let stand 5 minutes
4. Remove spices before serving

title: piedmont style sauce for pulled pork sandwiches
steps:
1. Place the onions and garlic in a medium sauce pan , cook 2-3 minutes
2. Add all other ingredients and simmer 20 minutes
3. Add to your pork meat after it has been shredded and stir till all meat is coated
4. Servings are approx as it depends how much it cooks down

title: festive cheese spread
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , combine cheeses , apricots , cranberries , and scallions
2. Mix well
3. If making as a log or ball , shape cheese mixture using wax paper or parchment paper , and roll log / ball in almonds until completely coated
4. Transfer to a pretty dish
5. Serve with crackers
6. Leftovers are also great on bagels !

title: panang curry barbecue chicken with lemon grass
steps:
1. Place chicken quarters in a large zip-top freezer bag
2. Process lemon grass , garlic , red curry paste , olive oil , lime juice , splenda granular and salt in a food processor until smooth , stopping to scrape down sides
3. Add coconut milk and pulse until blended
4. Pour over chicken
5. Seal bag and chill 4 to 6 hours , turning occasionally
6. Remove chicken from marinade , discarding marinade
7. Grill over indirect heat for 40-60 minutes or until done

title: easy baked donuts
steps:
1. Mix cinnamon and sugar together to make cinnamon / sugar mixture
2. Cut a hole in the center of each biscuit , set center portions aside
3. Dip biscuits into butter and then into the cinnamon / sugar mixture , place on non-greased baking sheet
4. Dip holes into butter and into sugar / cinnamon mixture , place on non-greased baking sheet
5. Bake at 375 degrees for 10-12 minutes or until donuts are golden brown

title: chicken   vegetable pasta bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 200 degrees
2. Cook pasta in a saucepan of salted boiling water following packet directions or until al dente
3. Drain
4. Cut down the length of the corn cobs , close to the core , to remove the kernels
5. Remove the chicken meat from bones
6. Discard bones , skin and seasoning
7. Shred the chicken and place in a bowl
8. Place the milk and stock in a saucepan over medium heat and bring to a simmer
9. Remove from heat
10. Heat the oil in a large saucepan over medium heat
11. Add the corn , capsicum and mushroom and cook , stirring , for 5 minutes or until the mushroom softens
12. Transfer to a plate
13. Melt the butter in the pan
14. Add flour and cook , stirring , for 1 minute
15. Remove from heat
16. Gradually whisk in milk mixture
17. Place over medium heat and cook , stirring , for 2 minutes or until sauce thickens
18. Add the pasta , corn mixture , chicken , shallots and 40g of cheddar to the sauce
19. Spoon pasta mixture into a 3l capacity freezer proof ovenproof dish
20. Combine breadcrumbs parsley and remaining cheddar in a bowl
21. Sprinkle over pasta mixture
22. To freeze , set aside for 10 minutes to cool
23. Cover with plastic wrap and place in fridge for 30 minutes
24. Cover with several layers of plastic wrap , label , date and freeze for up to 3 months
25. To cook , place in fridge for 8 hours or until thawed
26. Then follow step below
27. Bake for 40 minutes or until golden

title: japanese cafeteria spaghetti sauce
steps:
1. Brown hamburger
2. Prepare sloppy joe mix according to directions
3. Add remaining ingredients
4. Simmer 30 minutes
5. Serve over spaghetti topped with parmesan

title: renal friendly homemade sausage patties
steps:
1. Cook onion in the olive oil over moderately low heat
2. Stir occasionally until onions begin to soften and brown
3. 8-10 minutes
4. Cool for 10 minutes
5. In a small bowl , combine the sage , pepper , sugar , cloves and thyme
6. Place the egg yolk , pork , and reserved onion in a large bowl and then add the mixed spices
7. Mix well
8. Form into 16 patties , 2 ounces each
9. Pan fry the patties in a large skillet over medium high heat for 5 minutes on each side or until the internal temperature reaches 160 degrees

title: penne with cucumbers  tomatoes and feta  cheese salad
steps:
1. Wash , core , and chop the tomatoes into 1 / 2 inch cubes
2. Peel the cucumbers , quarter lengthwise and into slivers , i have also cut them into cubes
3. Put the slivers or cubes in a bowl of cold water
4. Peel , trim and mince the garlic
5. Rinse the mint leaves , pat them dry and coarsely chop them
6. In a small skillet , cook the garlic in the olive oil over low heat , stirring until softened , but do not let it brown
7. Add the pepper flakes , anc cook for 1-2 minutes
8. Remove from the heat and let cool to room temperature
9. Then blend in vinegar
10. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil
11. Add pasta and cook according to directions for an al dente pasta
12. Drain the pasta
13. To prevent the pasta from sticking you can spread it out on a large baking sheet and let it cool for about 15 minutes
14. Drain the cucumbers
15. In a large ceramic bowl add pasta , the tomatoes , cucumbers , mint , olives and seasoned olive oil
16. Toss well until past is uniformly shiny
17. Crumble the feta cheese into the salad and toss to combine
18. Best served within an hour of finishing

title: ginger pear marmalade
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a large saucepan
2. Stir
3. Let stand about 1 hour until pears release their juice
4. Heat and stir until it comes to a boil
5. Cook uncovered , stirring often until pears are mushy
6. Cook rapidly , stirring constantly until jam stage is reached
7. This will take about 55 minutes
8. Discard spice bag , skim if needed
9. Pour into hot sterilized half pint jars to within 1 / 4 inch of top
10. Place sterilized metal lids on jars and screw metal bands on securely
11. For added assurance against spoilage , you may choose to process in a boiling water bath for 5 minutes

title: rice pancakes
steps:
1. Measure 1 1 / 2 cups cooked cold rice into a big bowl
2. Use a fork or potato masher to mash the rice for a minute or two
3. This is a tiny bit of a nuisance , but it is what gives the pancakes their special texture
4. After the rice has been mashed a little , then add the rest of the ingredients
5. Use a whisk to stir everything up until it makes a light and creamy batter
6. If you want to use yogurt as your milk product , the batter may be very thick , depending on the thickness of your yogurt
7. Water may be added , to thin the batter
8. Use your best judgment if the batter seems very thick to you
9. Fry these in a hot skillet or griddle , turning them whenever they are brown on the bottom
10. Use about 1 / 4 cup batter per pancake , to keep them small and manageable
11. They are so tender , that frying big ones is a little tricky , so keep them on the smallish side

title: cedric  s  adams  casserole
steps:
1. Saute onion in butter but do not brown
2. Add hamburger , salt and pepper
3. In a two quart baking dish add 3 cups cabbage
4. Cover with meat mixture
5. Top with rest of cabbage
6. Top with tomato soup
7. Cover and bake at 350 degrees fahrenheit for 1 hour

title: salmon with mozzarella
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 225c
2. Remove skin and bones from the salmon
3. Season with salt and pepper on both sides and cut into four pieces
4. Thinly slice tomato and mozzarelle cheese
5. Cut sun-dried tomatoes into strips
6. Heat butter in a non-stick coated frying pan and cook salmon pieces , 2-3 minutes per side
7. Place cooked salmon in an oven-proof dish
8. Layer tomato slices , sun-dried tomato strips and finally mozzarella slices over the salmon
9. Sprinkle some black pepper on top
10. Bake in the preheated oven for about 5 minutes , or until mozzarella has melted

title: zesty mexican soup
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , mix all ingredients except cilantro
2. Heat to boiling over medium-high heat
3. Reduce heat to low
4. Simmer 10 minutes or until thoroughly heated , stirring occasionally
5. Stir in cilantro
6. This makes about 6 -1 cup servings

title: israeli couscous pepper salad
steps:
1. Bring water to a boil
2. Add couscous , olive oil and salt
3. Simmer for about 10 to 12 minutes or until tender to the bite
4. Drain and cool couscous
5. Combine couscous with kidney beans , peppers , onion , green onion , cilantro , parsley and hot pepper flakes
6. Whisk together honey , lime juice , olive oil and combine with couscous mixture
7. Season with additional salt and pepper
8. Enjoy !

title: dot s butterscotch brownies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees , or 325 degrees if using pyrex or glass
2. Melt brown sugar and butter together
3. Cool mixture for about 5 minutes
4. Add eggs
5. Mix flour , baking powder , salt , vanilla and nuts together
6. Add to other mixture
7. Mix well
8. Bake in greased 9 x 13 pan at 350 degrees for 30 minutes ~ if using pyrex or glass , reduce temperature to 325 degrees for 30 minutes
9. Top with chocolate frosting , if desired ~ i usually don't !

title: tomato and basil couscous salad
steps:
1. In a food processor pulse garlic , salt , gorgonzola cheese , mustard
2. Feed in through feed tube oil and balsamic vinegar
3. In a bowl mix couscous and tomatoes add dressing
4. Season with basil and pepper
5. Serve on a bed of fresh herbs mixed with fresh greens and onion

title: homemade cheese and pepperoni bread  bread machine
steps:
1. In bread machine pan , place the first seven ingredients in order suggested by manufacturer
2. Select basic bread setting
3. Choose medium crust color
4. Just before final kneading , add the pepperoni
5. Make a 1 1 / 2 lb loaf
6. Do not use delay timer feature for this recipe

title: salmon and snow pea stir fry
steps:
1. Cut salmon into 1 1 / 2 inch cubes and place in a resealable plastic bag
2. In a small bowl , combine soy sauce , juice , garlic and sesame oil
3. Pour half the marinade into the plastic bag with salmon
4. Marinate the fish for 30 minutes in the fridge
5. Coat a nonstick frying pan or wok with nonstick spray
6. Remove salmon from bag
7. Discard leftover marinade
8. Stir-fry salmon over medium-high heat , about five minutes
9. Turn salmon over gently so that all sides cook evenly
10. Be very careful with the salmon pieces so they stay intact - this was the hardest part for me
11. I didn't realize i'm quite the aggressive mad-woman stir-fryer !
12. Remove salmon from wok and add sliced onion
13. Stir-fry onion until brown , about five minutes
14. Add snow peas and stir-fry until they turn bright green , about three minutes
15. Return salmon to pan and pour reserved marinade over fish and vegetables
16. Cook for 2-3 minutes or until sauce has thickened
17. Serve with 1 / 2 cup of brown rice for each plate , if desired

title: the great british eccles cake
steps:
1. Sift the flour and salt together in a large bowl
2. Dice 1 / 2 of the chilled butter
3. Rub it into the flour using your hands
4. Add just enough cold water to bring it together into a soft dough
5. Cover with cling film and chill for 30 minutes
6. On a lightly floured surface , roll the dough into an oblong approx 20cm x 10cm
7. Cut the remaining chilled butter into thin slices
8. Cover the middle third of the dough with 1 / 3 of the slices
9. Fold the unbuttered thirds of dough over the buttered third
10. First one , then the other , making a square
11. Cover and chill for 15 minutes
12. Repeat two more times , turning the block of dough 90 degrees each time and chilling between each rolling
13. Repeat two more times without the butter
14. Chill for 30 minutes
15. Preheat oven to 240c / 465f / gas mark 8
16. Line a sheet with parchment paper
17. Cream together 1 oz soft butter and caster sugar
18. Add currants , candied peel and nutmeg
19. Roll out the pastry until 1 / 4" thick
20. Cut out 12 x 7cm discs
21. Spoon the filling into the centre of each disc
22. Brush the edges with water , then pull the edges into the centre and pinch them together to seal
23. Turn cakes over
24. Place on the baking tray
25. Push cakes down lightly to slightly flatten them
26. With a sharp knife make three short incisions in the top of each cake
27. Brush tops with a little milk
28. Sprinkle liberally with granulated sugar
29. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes or until edges turn golden brown

title: mixed vegetables a la greque
steps:
1. Wash and trim vegetables
2. Put water , vinegar , olive oil , lemon juice , thyme and coriander seeds and salt into a large saucepan
3. Bring to the boil
4. Continue to boil until liquid emulsifies
5. Meanwhile bring a separate pot of water to boil and add the beetroot
6. Cook until tender
7. Drop the remaining vegetables into the boiling emulsion adding leeks and asparagus last
8. Cook for about 10 minutes
9. Drain all vegetables and reserve emulsified liquid
10. To serve: combine all vegetables on a platter and pour reserved liquid over
11. Delicious served hot or cold

title: apple pie in a glass
steps: 1. Shake all ingredients in a container with a tight fitting lid , or stir in a glass until well blended

title: grand marnier cranberry orange relish
steps:
1. Wash cranberries and combine in heavy saucepan with sugar , water and orange juice
2. Bring to a boil over high heat
3. Reduce heat and cook at gentle boil until cranberries begin to pop
4. Remove from heat and stir in cherries and grand marnier
5. Chill for up to a week
6. When ready to serve , stir in pecans

title: open faced chicken pot pie
steps:
1. Pour the broth into a crock pot
2. Add the chicken then sprinkle with salt & pepper
3. Cover with lid & cook on low for 6 hours
4. Shred chicken then place back into pot along with the rest of the ingredients
5. Stir until well blended
6. Cover & continue to cook for 40 minutes on low
7. Meanwhile , bake the biscuits according to package directions
8. Cut the biscuits in half then place 4 halves on each plate
9. Pour the chicken mixture over the biscuits & serve immediately

title: chicken  spinach and dried cranberry phyllo pie
steps:
1. Whisk milk with flour in a small saucepan and bring to a simmer over medium-high heat , stirring , until thickened
2. Stir in salt , pepper and nutmeg
3. Let cool slightly
4. Drain spinach and squeeze out water
5. Using a nonstick skillet , melt 1 tbsp of the butter over medium-high heat and cook the spinach , garlic , pine nuts & cranberries , stirring , until garlic begins to colour
6. Stir egg into milk mixture then stir into spinach mixture along with the chicken
7. Melt remaining butter
8. Spray pie plate with nonstick spray
9. Cut phyllo in half crosswise and drape across pie plate so 1 / 3 overhangs the plate
10. Brush lightly with butter and press into plate
11. Repeat with each sheet , layering and fanning sheets to overlap slightly and evenly cover pie plate
12. Spoon filling into pastry then fold edges over filling to form 2 1 / 2 inch border
13. Place pie on baking sheet , cover lightly with foil and bake in 375f oven for 35 to 40 minutes or until pastry is golden
14. Let stand 5 minutes before serving

title: green goddess hummus
steps:
1. Drain chickpeas , reserving liquid
2. Add all ingredients to food processor and process until smooth
3. Add reserved chickpea liquid as needed to obtain desired consistency

title: spaghetti topped with crispy bacon and breadcrumbs
steps:
1. Heat 2 t of oil in a large skillet over medium heat
2. Add onions and sugar and cook until onions just start to colour
3. Add tomatoes breaking them up with a fork
4. Season with salt and pepper , turn heat to low and leave to simmer for about 1 hour or until reduced to a thick sauce
5. Cook spaghetti in rapidly boiling water , drain
6. While the spaghetti is boiling grill the bacon until crisp , then crumble
7. Fry the breadcrumbs in the remaining oil until golden and then drain well
8. Toss the cooked spaghetti with the sauce in a large bowl , sprinkle with nutmeg and add the bacon , breadcrumbs and parmesan
9. Serve with your favourite glass of aussie red !

title: quick red beans and rice
steps:
1. Cook ham in oil
2. Add onion and saute for 3 minutes
3. Add beans and seasonings
4. Simmer for 15 minutes
5. Serve over rice

title: sausage gravy
steps:
1. Cook sausage in skillet
2. Drain fat
3. Sprinkle flour over sausage and stir well
4. Cook flour and sausage together for about 5 - 7 minutes
5. Add milk
6. Cook over medium heat until thickened
7. Add pepper
8. Serve over biscuits

title: arnold palmer company casserole
steps:
1. Bown beef and mushrooms and 1 / 2 chopped onions
2. Add tomato sause salt , pepper , and garlic salt and simmer for 1 / 2 hour
3. Cook noodles
4. Combine cottage cheese , sour cream , remaining chopped onions and green peppers
5. Buttered casserole
6. Layer meat , noodles and cheese mixture , ending with meat on top
7. Bake at 300 degrees for 45 minutes
8. First 1 / 2 of cooking time with lid on casserole , remaining with lid off

title: three cheese cupcakes
steps:
1. For the cupcakes:
2. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
3. Mix the dry ingredients together in a large bowl
4. Flour , baking powder , salt
5. In another bowl , mix wet ingredients together until well-incorporated
6. Butter , sugar , egg and orange extract
7. Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients , then add condensed milk , cheddar cheese mixing until incorporated
8. Using a scoop , fill lined muffin tins half-way
9. Then place a cube of velveeta cheese into each muffin
10. Cover with batter , so the muffin tins are 3 / 4 of the way full
11. Sprinkle grated mozzarella cheese on top of each muffin
12. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes
13. Remove from oven and let cool before frosting
14. For the frosting:
15. In a medium bowl , mix cream cheese , honey and hot sauce with a hand mixer until smooth
16. Pipe onto cupcakes using a pastry bag and

title: black eyed peas and tomatoes with sauteed plantains or bananas
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large high-sided skillet over medium heat
2. Add onion and cook about 10 minutes or until golden and tender , stirring frequently
3. Stir in garlic , ginger and cayenne and cook for 1 minute , stirring constantly
4. Add tomatoes and peas and bring to a simmer
5. Cook 15 minutes or until peas are tender and flavors blended
6. Stir in salt
7. Meanwhile , melt butter in a separate skillet over medium-high heat
8. Reduce heat to medium , add plantains or bananas and cook about 5-8 minutes or until browned on both sides , gently flipping halfway through cooking
9. Serve alongside black-eyed peas in a shallow bowl

title: vanilla creme    starbucks
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in a medium pot , except for whip cream
2. Stir well
3. Allow to come to a boil , keeping a ever so watchful eye on it
4. Once boil is acheive
5. Pour into your favorite mugs
6. Top off with whip cream
7. Enjoy !

title: fast and easy garlic lime butterfly chops
steps:
1. Place the pork in a shallow dish , add the lime juice and garlic , turn several times to coat
2. Well
3. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate 30 minutes
4. Sprinkle both sides of the pork evenly with salt and pepper
5. Heat half of the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat
6. Add two of the pork chops , cook 2 minutes to brown on side
7. Set aside on separate plate , browned side up
8. Repeat with remaining oil and chops
9. Turn pork chops , add the reserved pork chops , reduce heat to medium-low
10. Cover and cook 9 minutes or until pork is no longer pink in center
11. Remove pork and set aside on separate plate
12. Add dressing to liquid in skillet , stir until completely blended
13. Place pork on top of sauce , sprinkle cheese evenly over pork , cover and cook 2 minutes to melt cheese

title: yakhni puloa
steps:
1. In a large pot heat 2 tablespoons of oil over medium heat
2. Add the cardamom , cinnamon , bay leaf , anise and saffron
3. Stir for to release the flavors and add the onions
4. Saut for 2-3 minutes , then add the ginger and garlic and saut another 2 minutes
5. Add the chicken to the pot
6. Salt liberally and cook for 1-2 minutes
7. Next add the rice and stir to coat it in oil
8. Add the stock and bring to a boil
9. Once boiling pour the sultanas on top , cover , and reduce the heat to low
10. Steam the rice for 15 minutes
11. Then remove from heat
12. Stir in the chopped apricots and nuts and cover again
13. Allow the puloa to sit another 5 minutes , covered
14. Serve with cilantro sprinkled on top ! serves 4

title: spinach and mango substitute salad
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients for salad in a large bowl
2. Whisk together dressing ingredients and add to salad

title: brioche muffins or loaf
steps:
1. Warm the bowl of your mixer with hot water , then dump it out
2. Mix the yeast , warm water , and sugar in the warmed bowl with a rubber spatula
3. Let sit for 5 minutes , until it is foamy and the sugar has dissolved
4. Add the eggs one at a time and using the paddle attachment , beat on medium speed for 1 minute , until mixed
5. With the mixer on low speed , add 2 cups of the flour , the salt , and mix for 5 minutes
6. With the mixer still on low , add 2 more cups of flour and mix for 5 minutes more
7. Still on low , add the soft butter in chunks and mix , occasionally scraping the paddle , for 2 minutes longer
8. Switch to the dough hook attachment , and set on low speed again
9. While the mixer is running , sprinkle in the last quarter cup of flour
10. Mix on low speed for 3-4 minutes , until well combined and elastic , but still sticky
11. This is a soft , sticky dough
12. Scrape the dough into a large buttered bowl and cover tightly with plastic wrap
13. Refrigerate overnight
14. The next day , allow the dough to sit at room temperature for an hour--it should have risen substantially in the fridge
15. Grease a 12-muffin tin , if you are making muffins , or two loaf pans
16. Turn the dough onto a floured surface and cut in half
17. For muffins: pat each half into a rectangle with the dough about a half inch thick
18. Spread the raisins and dried cherries evenly over the rectangle , using more if desired
19. Starting on one of the rectangle's wide ends , roll up into a tight cylinder
20. The dough may stick , use a pastry scraper or a sharp knife to help loosen it
21. Pinch the seam closed
22. Cut each cylinder into 6 equal portions
23. Stick each dough portion seam side down into the muffin tin
24. Cover and let rise in a warm spot for 2 hours , until doubled in size
25. For loaves: pat each half into a 6x8 rectangle , and roll on the wider side , as instructed above
26. Place each cylinder , seam side down , in a loaf pan
27. Cover and let rise in a warm spot for 2 hours , until doubled in size
28. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees
29. Beat the egg with the milk and brush the tops of the risen muffins
30. Bake the muffins for 25-30 minutes , until they are a deep golden brown
31. Bake loaves for 30-35 minutes
32. Let cool briefly in their pans before transferring to a wire rack to cool completely

title: round steak crock pot casserole
steps:
1. Sprinkle round steak pieces with garlic powder and ground pepper to taste
2. Place in crock pot
3. Place potatoes , onions , and green beans on top of beef
4. Put tomatoes and tomato soup on top
5. Cover and cook on low for 8-10 hours
6. For last 1 / 2 hour remove cover and turn to high

title: thai country style fish  pla nai suan rot det
steps:
1. 500gr fish slices fried to crispy golden color , let rest
2. Fry to golden color 5 shallots and 5 large garlic cloves , let rest
3. Chop 2 shallots , 2 large garlic cloves , 2 coriander springs and 2 green onions
4. Mix 2 tbls fish sauce , 2 tbls lime juice , 1 tbls sugar , 1 tsp chilli powder , 1 tbsl roasted & pounded rice
5. Mix 3 and 4
6. 2 boiled eggs , cut into quarters
7. On a plate arrange fish , boiled eggs , add fried onions , garlic , pour the herbs
8. Garnish with mint and roasted dry chilli

title: linda s apple brownies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Soften margarine
3. Mix all ingredients together in a lg
4. Bowl
5. Bake in a buttered 8x8" baking dish , for 30-40 minutes
6. Let cool , cut , and then store in a plastic container

title: crisp flatbread
steps:
1. To roll out: 1 1 / 4 cups plain white flour crumble the yeast in a mixing bowl
2. Pour on the water
3. Stir to dissolve the yeast
4. Add salt and bread flour
5. Knead to an elastic dough
6. Turn out the dough onto a floured work surface
7. Cut into 3 parts
8. Form each part into a sausage and cut it into 8 pieces
9. Form each piece into a round ball
10. Cover and let rise for about 30 minutes
11. Roll out each ball into a very thin circle
12. N
13. B
14. Do not knead ! roll and turn the cake several times
15. When it is very thin , about 2 mm , prick very closely with a fork
16. Make a hole in the middle of each cake
17. Place two cakes on each baking sheet
18. Bake at once at 275m-0c / 525m-0f oven for 3 - 4 minutes
19. Cool on a rack

title: greek yogurt cake
steps:
1. Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy
2. Add yogurt and beat well
3. Add egg yolks and lemon rind
4. Mix well
5. Blend in flour sifted with baking soda
6. Beat egg whites until stiff and fold gently into cake batter
7. Pour into a greased and floured , 10 cup mold or a 9 x 13" pan
8. Bake at 350 for 30 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean when inserted into center of cake
9. No frosting is needed

title: bolludagur buns   icelandic cream filled buns
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. In a large saucepan over a medium-high burner , stir together water , butter , salt and sugar until butter is melted
3. Add flour and beat quickly until mixture thickens and pulls away from the side of the pan
4. Remove pan from heat
5. Vigorously whisk in one egg at a time until batter is the consistency of thick pudding
6. Drop heaping tablespoons of the batter on a parchment-lined or lightly greased baking sheet
7. Bake in preheated oven for 30 minutes , until golden brown
8. Transfer buns to racks to cool
9. Whip together the cream and vanilla sugar until stiff peaks form
10. When buns have cooled , slice each one in half and spread lower half with raspberry jam
11. Top with a dollop of whipped cream , place the remaining half on top , and ice with melted chocolate
12. Yield: 20 bolludagur buns

title: dad s cold bean salad
steps:
1. Whisk together or shake in shaker: salad oil , water , paprika , salt , sugar and vinegar
2. Add dressing to remaining ingredients
3. Refrigerate overnight before serving

title: spaghetti squash with red sauce
steps:
1. Cut squash in half lengthwise
2. Discard seeds
3. Place squash , cut side down , on a microwave-safe plate
4. Microwave , uncovered , on high for 14-16 minutes or until tender
5. Meanwhile , in a large skillet , saut tomatoes , mushrooms , green pepper , carrot , onion , garlic , italian seasoning and pepper in oil for 6-8 minutes or until tender
6. Add tomato sauce
7. Heat through
8. When squash is cool enough to handle , use a fork to separate strands
9. Place squash on a serving platter and top with sauce
