10. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese if desired

title: valentine rich rolled cookies
steps:
1. Cream butter and sugar
2. Beat in egg and flavoring
3. Combine and add flour and salt
4. Chill dough 3-4 hours
5. Preheat oven to 350f
6. Roll thinly and cut
7. Bake 5-7 minutes ,
8. Ice with either almond or royal icing
9. The almond icing is a thin icing that you can "paint" on the cookies
10. I actually use paint brushes , and have fun coloring the icing
11. The royal icing dries hard
12. It can be used to "glue" tails back on kittens and trunks on elephants
13. It also holds the cookies together better for shipping
14. I use a small metal spatula for spreading this , and use a lot of sprinkles and other adornments with this icing
15. The amounts of sugar and liquid are flexible to your own preferred consistency

title: parmesan rice pilaf
steps:
1. Melt butter in a medium sauce pan on medium heat
2. Add rice , cook and stir three minutes
3. Stir in chicken broth , garlic powder , parsley flakes and pepper
4. Bring to a boil , reduce to low , cover and simmer 20 minutes or until rice in tender
5. Stir in parmesan cheese and sliced almonds

title: teresa s italian green beans
steps:
1. Cook beans in large pan of boiling water until done
2. Heat olive oil in medium sized skillet over medium heat
3. Add drained beans , mushrooms , onions , garlic , oregano , salt and pepper
4. Heat to desired temperature

title: georgia barbecue sauce
steps: 1. In a bowl , whisk together vinegar , mustard , ketchup , sugar , salt , pepper , cayenne , and garlic

title: sweet potato and goat cheese tortilla
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 425f put the potato in a large roasting tin , season and drizzle over half the oil
2. Toss well
3. Put the peppers , fennel , garlic and onion in a second tin
4. Season , drizzle over the remaining oil and toss well
5. Put both tins in the oven and roast for 30-35min or until the vegetables are tender
6. Whisk together the eggs , cream and cheeses and season with plenty of coarsely ground black pepper
7. Line the base and sides of a 8in round , 3in deep cake tin with non-stick baking parchment
8. Reduce the oven temperature to 325f layer the roasted vegetables in the tin with the spinach , adding a little egg mix as you go
9. Pour in any remaining egg mix and cook the tortilla in the centre of the oven for about 1hr 15min or until the egg is set and the top golden
10. Serve warm or cold

title: chicken and beer mustard with pasta
steps:
1. Melt oil and butter in frypan
2. Add diced garlic , onions , carrots , mushrooms and bacon and fry for a few mins 'til soft
3. Add diced chicken and fry 'til brown
4. Add beer mustard and salt and pepper
5. Deglaze pan with the white wine
6. Add 300 ml cream and parsley
7. Simmer to reduce liquid to a sauce
8. Serve over pasta of your choice
9. I like to put pasta on the plate and cover with baby spinach and then cover with the chicken mustard sauce and top with freshly grated parmesan cheese

title: curry naan grilled chicken sandwich
steps:
1. Put garlic , shallot and cilantro in food processor , chop all
2. Add butter and salt , process well to mix well
3. Preheat oven 350 ? f , spread garlic herb butter on naan then toast lightly
4. Cut on half
5. Season chicken with salt and pepper then grill , bake bacon to be crisp
6. Heat medium sauce pan , stir simply mushed potatoes and milk until smooth
7. Spoon over cumin and alfredo sauce and seasoning salt and pepper mixture
8. Bake until edges are bubbly
9. Place swiss cheese , tomato sauce , sliced avocado , chicken , mushed potato , american cheese and bacon on naan then bake in the oven 3-4 minutes until cheese is melt
10. Place another half piece of naan on it , put on serving plate

title: broccoli brain power salad
steps:
1. For dressing , in a small bowl stir together mayonnaise dressing , sugar , and vinegar
2. In a medium bowl combine broccoli , carrot , cheese , if desired , onion and water chestnuts
3. Pour dressing over broccoli mixture
4. Toss to coat
5. Sprinkle with bacon
6. Cover and chill for 1 to 5 hours
7. Makes 4 side-dish servings

title: antipasti di tonno e fagioli
steps:
1. Mix the vinegar , oil , oregano , mustard , , salt and pepper together in a bowl until combined and fairly viscous
2. If the dressing is too thick , thin it out with some of the reserved bean liquid
3. Mix the tuna , beans , red onion , celery and garlic into the dressing , breaking the tuna up
4. Refrigerate for at least an hour before serving , but serve at room temperature

title: cucumber mojito  camelback inn s recipe
steps:
1. Muddle cucumber with lime wedges , mint , rum and sugar
2. Fill glass with ice
3. Splash with sierra mist
4. Serve in a 12oz hurricane glass
5. Garnish with mint and cucumber slice

title: just peachy french toast
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine egg white , milk , and vanilla
2. Mix well with a fork or wire whisk
3. Pour into a shallow pan
4. Make 2 sandwiches from the bread and jam , putting 2 tsp of jam inside each sandwich
5. Dip sandwiches in milk mixture , coating both sides
6. Melt 1 tsp of the margarine in a preheated nonstick skillet or griddle over medium heat
7. Place sandwiches in skillet and brown lightly
8. Turn , add remaining margarine , and brown the other sides
9. Serve hot

title: homemade curry powder
steps:
1. Dump everything into a blender or coffee grinder
2. Process into very fine powder
3. Store in an air-tight container
4. Serving size is approximate -- use as per recipe

title: pizzatizers
steps:
1. Separate each pita into two
2. Spread 1 garlic clove onto each pita round
3. Arrange 4-6 basil leaves over garlic
4. Top with 3 slices of tomatoes
5. Sprinkle about 2 tablespoons of shredded cheese on each and drizzle 2 teaspoons of olive oil on each
6. Bake on cookie sheet in 400-degree oven for about 15 minutes or until cheese melts and pizzas are bubbly
7. Serve immediately

title: apple a la mode smoothie
steps:
1. Combine the frozen yogurt , applesauce , and apple juice in a blender
2. Add the apple , cinnamon , and nutmeg
3. Blend until smooth

title: green bean chowder
steps:
1. In a 3-quart saucepan cook bacon until crisp
2. Add green beans , carrot , potato , onion , salt and pepper
3. Mix together and add water
4. Bring to a boil , reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes
5. Add beans and cook 5 minutes more or until vegetables are tender
6. Blend sour cream and flour together in a medium-sized bowl
7. Pour 1 cup of the hot vegetable mixture into the sour cream mixture and combine
8. Return to saucepan
9. Stir in milk and heat until slightly thickened , being careful not to boil
10. Serve

title: pork chop   rice casserole
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees
2. In a skillet with a small amount of oil , brown the chops seasoned with salt& pepper
3. Spray a 9x13 baking dish with non-stick spray , or coat lightly with oil and sprinkle the rice evenly over the bottom of the dish
4. Sprinkle the boullion granules and the seasoning mix from the packet over rice
5. Top rice with mushrooms and greenbeans , if desired , followed by browned chops
6. Add water and spoon undiluted soup over all
7. Cover with aluminum foil and bake for 1 - 1 1 / 2 hours untill rice and chops are tender

title: salpicon  spicy mexican beef salad
steps:
1. Prepare brisket: in a dutch oven or a small stockpot , combine meat with onion , stock , bay leaves , garlic , chipotles , salt and peppercorns
2. Bring mixture to a boil over high heat , skimming off any foam
3. Reduce heat to low , cover and simmer 3 1 / 2 to 4 hours or until the meat is falling-apart tender
4. Let cool 30 minutes in cooking liquid
5. Reserve 2 tablespoons cooking liquid for salad dressing and save remainder , refrigerated , for a southweswtern soup or stew
6. Pull meat apart into shreds
7. To make dressing: in a blender or food processor , combine reserved brisket liquid , chipotles , olive oil , lime juice , vinegar , ketchup , onion , garlic , salt and pepper and pure
8. To complete salad: in a bowl , mix brisket with about 3 / 4 of the dressing
9. Transfer brisket to a serving platter or bowl and toss it lightly with tomatoes , avocados , onion , cheese and cilantro
10. Drizzle additional dressing over top , enough to make the mixture moist
11. Garnish with radish roses if desired
12. Serve warm with fresh hot tortillas , or chilled with tortilla chips for dipping

title: onion salisbury steak
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine the ground beef , salt and pepper
2. Shape into four oval patties
3. In a large skillet , brown patties on one side
4. Turn and add onions
5. Cook until meat is no longer pink
6. Place toast on serving plates
7. Top each with onions and a beef patty
8. Keep warm
9. Stir flour into skillet until blended
10. Gradually add water
11. Stir in bouillon
12. Bring to a boil
13. Cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened and bubbly
14. Serve with meat and onions

title: lemony glazed sweet potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. In a large pot place potatoes with enough water to cover
3. Bring to boiling
4. Reduce heat simmer 10-12 minutes or just until tender but not soft
5. Drain potatoes: cool
6. Meanwhile in a nonreactive pan the 3 / 4 cup of water , the sugars , and salt
7. Bring to boiling , stirring just until sugared are dissolved
8. Simmer 8 minutes
9. Remove from heat
10. Stir in lemon juice , nutmeg , and 2 tbs
11. Butter
12. Butter a large shallow glass or ceramic baking dish with remaining butter
13. Peel potatoes
14. Cut crosswise into 3 / 4 inch- thick slices
15. Arrange slices in a single layer in baking dish
16. Pour lemon syrup over potatoes
17. Bake in preheated oven 40-50 minutes , basting occasionally , until potatoes are well-glazed and begin to caramelize on edges
18. Remove from oven cool slightly before serving garnish with lemon peel

title: tortellini and sausage soup
steps:
1. In a fry pan , add olive oil and saut onion , celery and garlic , until onion is soft
2. Set aside
3. Brown italian sausage in pan
4. Drain grease , and set aside
5. In a large pot , add chicken stock , parsley , basil , salt and pepper , sausage and the sauted onion , garlic and celery
6. Bring to a boil , and reduce heat
7. Add tortellini and let simmer for 6-10 minutes
8. Sprinkle with parmesan and serve with warm , crusty bread !

title: four grain flapjacks
steps:
1. Whisk dry ingredients together
2. Whisk wet ingredients together
3. Add wet mix to dry mix , stir until just combined
4. Cook on griddle until puffy and nicely browned
5. Serve piping hot with maple syrup , or your favorite topping !
6. You may also substitute buttermilk for the regular milk , but then you need also to increase the amount of baking soda to 1 teaspoon instead of 1 / 2 teaspoon

title: caribbean chicken fingers
steps:
1. Mix brown sugar , seasoned salt , onion , cinnamon and red pepper in shallow dish
2. Coat chicken strips with spice mixture , and place on greased baking pan
3. Broil 5 minutes per side or until chicken is cooked through

title: polish  sausage patties
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine dry ingredients
2. Pinch and rub ingredients together , allowing marjoram oil to blend with other spices
3. In a medium bowl , mix ground pork and spices until well mixed with seasonings throughout the pork
4. Add the beer or liquid and mix until all liquid is absorbed
5. Make the mixture into 10 balls , press into patties
6. When freezing place a wax paper separator between patties

title: lemon layer cake with lemon curd and mascarpone
steps:
1. You'll need a pastry bag fitted with a 1 / 2-inch star
2. Begin making this cake two days before you plan to serve it
3. For lemon curd: whisk first 4 ingredients in medium metal bowl
4. Set bowl over saucepan of simmering water
5. Whisk constantly until thickened and instant-read thermometer inserted into mixture registers 160f , about 10 minutes
6. Remove bowl from over water
7. Add butter
8. Whisk until melted
9. Transfer 2 cups curd to small bowl for spreading on cake layers
10. Reserve remaining curd for filling
11. Press plastic wrap directly onto surface of both curds
12. Chill overnight
13. For cake: position rack in center of oven and preheat to 375f
14. Line bottom of two 9-inch-diameter cake pans with 1 1 / 2-inch-high sides with parchment paper
15. Using electric mixer , beat egg yolks and 7 tablespoons sugar in large bowl until mixture is very thick and slowly dissolving ribbons form when beaters are lifted , about 4 minutes
16. Using clean dry beaters , beat whites in another large bowl until soft peaks form
17. Add remaining 7 tablespoons sugar , 1 tablespoon at a time , beating until stiff and glossy
18. Fold half of whites into yolk mixture , then sift half of flour and 1 / 2 teaspoon salt over and gently fold in until incorporated
19. Fold in remaining whites , then sift remaining flour over and fold in just until combined , being careful not to deflate batter
20. Divide batter between pans
21. Smooth tops
22. Bake until tester inserted into center of cakes comes out clean , about 15 minutes
23. Cool in pans on racks
24. Run knife around edge of pans to loosen cakes
25. Invert cakes onto 9-inch-diameter cardboard rounds , tapping on work surface if necessary to release cakes
26. Cut each cake horizontally in half
27. Peel off parchment
28. For syrup: place sugar in small metal bowl
29. Add 1 / 2 cup boiling water
30. Stir to dissolve sugar
31. Stir in lemon juice
32. For filling and frosting: beat whipping cream and sugar in large bowl until peaks form
33. Add mascarpone to lemon curd in medium bowl
34. Whisk until blended
35. Fold whipped cream into lemon-mascarpone mixture
36. Place 1 cake layer , flat side up , on platter
37. Brush with 1 / 2 of syrup
38. Spread 1 / 2 cup lemon curd over , then 1 cup lemon-mascarpone filling
39. Top with second cake layer
40. Brush with 1 / 2 of syrup and spread with 1 / 2 cup lemon curd and 1 cup lemon-mascarpone filling
41. Repeat with third cake layer , syrup , lemon curd , and filling
42. Top with fourth cake layer
43. Brush with remaining syrup , then spread remaining lemon curd over
44. Spoon 2 cups lemon-mascarpone filling into pastry bag fitted with 1 / 2-inch star
45. Spread remaining lemon-mascarpone filling as a frosting over sides of cake
46. Pipe small rosettes of frosting over top of cake , covering completely
47. Cover cake with cake dome
48. Refrigerate at least 6 hours and up to 1 day

title: tilapia bake
steps:
1. Place fillets skin side down in single layer in a greased shallow baking dish
2. Mix together remaining ingredients
3. Spoon over fillets
4. Bake at 400 degrees for 15 to 20 minutes or until fish flakes easily

title: chicken and broccoli with noodles
steps:
1. Cut the chicken breasts into bite-sized pieces and the spring onions into 1" lengths
2. Finely slice half the ginger and grate the rest
3. Press the garlic cloves and finely dice the chilli
4. Sweat all these ingredients in the olive oil until the chicken changes colour
5. Add the coconut milk , stock , lemon juice , tamari or fish sauce and the kaffir lime leaves
6. Cut the red pepper and courgette into slices and break the broccoli into florets
7. Add these to the pan with the noodles
8. Bring to the boil and simmer for approximately 10 minutes or until the chicken , vegetables and noodles are cooked
9. Remove the kaffir lime leaves and season to taste with salt and pepper
10. Serve in large bowls , garnished iwth the coriander

title: meatballs with sweet sour sauce
steps:
1. Mix and shape into 20 1" balls
2. Place in round casserole and bake at 350 stirring occasionally until done
3. Drain
4. Meanwhile make sauce:
5. Brown onion in butter
6. Stir in remaining sauce ingredients
7. Bring to a boil
8. Pour over meatballs as soon as mixture reaches boiling point
9. Return to oven for about 10 minutes
10. Serve over hot cooked rice

title: very easy hamburger stroganoff
steps:
1. Brown hamburger with pepper , paprika , salt and minced onion
2. Add soup and milk and simmer until heated through
3. Taste a bit
4. If it needs more seasonings , add it by 1 / 4 or 1 / 2 teaspoons
5. Serve on rice , noodles or a sandwich (we always do rice , but the original recipe says you can make it into a sandwich or put it on noodles

title: laura s family secret creamy italian dressing
steps:
1. Put all ingredients in a blender and blend well
2. Serve with a chopped salad with your choice of ingredients
3. Suggestions for chopped salad: chopped mixed lettuces & baby spinach , carrots , tomatoes , artichoke hearts or garbanzo beans , cucumbers , red / green / yellow bell peppers , jicama , fresh basil or herbs of choice
4. Chop all ingredients in a uniform size and toss
5. You can do this ahead and assemble the salad at the last minute , having stored the ingredients in ziplock bags in the fridge
6. Toss with dressing immediately before serving

title: scandinavian coffee
steps:
1. Add coffee and aquavit to an irish coffee cup and sweeten to taste
2. Gently float cream on top
3. Sprinkle with nutmeg , and serve

title: napa s sourdough  bread dip
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 350
2. Cut off the top of the sourdough round
3. Hollow out the bread to form a bowl shape
4. Combine onions , cream cheese , sour cream , ham and cheese
5. Mix until completely blended
6. Fill the bread shell with the cream cheese mixture and replace the top of the bread
7. Bake for 25 minutes
8. Cut up the left over bread into bite size pieces and use for dipping
9. I cut up extra sourdough bread or serve crackers with this dip
10. Enjoy !

title: lemon garlic chicken  thighs  low fat
steps:
1. Combine first 4 ingredients
2. Add chicken
3. Preheat oven to 425
4. Remove chicked from marinade
5. Reserve
6. Arrange chicken in shallow roasting pan coated with cooking spray
7. Pour reserved marinade over chicken
8. Sprinkle with salt and pepper
9. Bake at 425 for 20 minutes
10. Baste chicken with marinade
11. Bake an additional 20 minutes or until chicken is done

title: yummy mock pumpkin pie
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together
2. Microwave for 1 minute on high power
3. Mix well
4. Microwave for another 20 seconds

title: jeff s yorkshire pudding
steps:
1. One half hour before standing rib roast is done , prepare yorkshire pudding batter
2. Heat 9x9" pan in oven with roast
3. Remove roast from oven
4. Spoon off drippings and add melted shortening to measure 1 / 2 cup
5. Increase oven temperature to 425 degrees
6. Return roast to oven
7. Place hot drippings in heated square pan
8. Pour in batter
9. Bake for 10 minutes
10. Remove roast
11. Continue baking pudding 25-30 minutes longer
12. Cut pudding into squares and serve
13. To bake in a large 6 muffin pan: preheat oven to 375f
14. Place pan in oven and heat for 10 minutes
15. Place equal amounts of the drippings into each muffin mold and continue heating in oven for 10 to 15 minutes
16. Pour equal amounts of prepared batter into each muffin mold and bake for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown
17. Serve immediately

title: one dish chicken   stuffing
steps:
1. Spray skillet with non-stick spray
2. Add chicken and cook 12 to 15 min
3. Or until done
4. Remove chicken
5. Prepare stuffing in skillet according to package directions except let stand 2 min
6. Place chicken on top of stuffing
7. Combine soup and milk throughly and pour over chicken
8. Sprinkle with favorite cheese
9. Cover and heat thru

title: cheddar cheesy meat pie
steps:
1. Brown ground beef with onion and garlic , drain fat off well
2. Stir flour , salt and pepper over browned beef
3. Spread mixture in pie shell
4. Spread cheeses over this
5. Whisk milk , eggs and worcestershire sauce together and carefully pour over ground beef and cheddar
6. Bake at 400 degrees f for 35-40 minutes

title: margaret s hush puppies
steps:
1. Combine first three ingredients
2. Add egg
3. Gradually beat in milk
4. Drop by spoonful into hot fat
5. Remove when golden brown
6. Drain on paper towels

title: edamame bean salad
steps:
1. Use unsalted ingredients when possible , otherwise , rinse well to get rid of excess salt
2. Put edamame in microwave-safe covered dish , add a few tablespoons of water , cook for 4 mins or as per directions
3. Cut up red pepper into small cubes , set aside
4. Pour cooked edamame and can of corn into colander , rinse with cold water to chill , shake off excess water , and pour into serving dish
5. Empty cans of beans into colander , rinse well with cold water until it runs clear and shake off excess water
6. Pour beans into dish with edamame and corn
7. Add cut red pepper to dish
8. Add fresh dill to taste
9. Add lime juice and italian dressing , reduce dressing to cut back on salt , fat
10. Season to taste with ground pepper
11. Optional: add a chopped avocado for a richer-tasting dish
12. Serve immediately or even better , chill before serving

title: vegetarian avocado sandwich
steps:
1. Combine avocado , tomato and onion in a small mixing bowl
2. Place the muffin-halves close together and open-faced on a cookie sheet
3. Top each half with avocado mixture , dressing , cheese and salt and pepper
4. Place under broiler for about 5 minutes , or until cheese is melted and bubbly

title: aunt ruth s rhubarb torte
steps:
1. Combine sugar& cornstarch
2. Stir in rhubarb& water
3. Cook& stir over medium heat until thickened
4. Reduce heat , cook 2-3 minutes longer
5. Add food coloring
6. Spread on graham wafer crust and let cool
7. Fold marshmallows into whipped cream and spoon over rhubarb mixture
8. Prepare pudding according to package instructions and spread over all
9. Sprinkle with graham wafer crumbs
10. Chill

title: easy salsa beef pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Press crescent rolls into a greased 9 x 13" pan
3. Press the perforated edges together to create "crust
4. "
5. Cook beef , onions , salt , pepper , and chili powder in skillet over medium heat until meat is browned
6. Drain any excess fat
7. Remove from heat and stir in the salsa
8. Spoon over crust
9. Top with cheese
10. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes

title: southwestern cheese and pasta
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients except for cheese and macaroni in a skillet , stirring occasionally
2. Reduce heat to simmer / low for 5 minutes
3. Cook macaroni seperate and add to sauce
4. Add cheese and cover for 10 minutes
5. Stirring occasionally

title: tyler florence s ultimate spaghetti and meatballs
steps:
1. Bring a big pot of salted water to a boil for the spaghetti
2. Heat 3 tablespoons oil in an ovenproof skillet over medium heat
3. Add the onion , garlic , and parsley and cook until the vegetables are soft but still translucent , about 10 minutes
4. Take the pan off the heat and let cool
5. Pour enough milk over the bread in a bowl to moisten and let it soak while the onions are cooling
6. Combine the meats in a large bowl
7. Add the egg and parmigiano and season generously with salt and pepper
8. Use your hands to squeeze the excess milk out of the bread and add that to the bowl along with the cooled onion mixture
9. Gently combine all the ingredients with your hands or with a spoon until just mixed together
10. Don't overwork or the meatballs will be tough
11. Divide into 10 equal pieces and shape them into 10 nice looking meatballs
12. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
13. Heat a 3-count of oil in the frying pan over medium heat and brown the meatballs on all sides , about 10 minutes
14. Put them into a baking dish and spoon about half of the tomato sauce over
15. Shower with the mozzarella and drizzle with olive oil
16. Put the meatballs in the oven and bake until the meatballs are cooked through , about 15 minutes
17. Meanwhile , cook the spaghetti in the boiling water until al dente , about 8 minutes
18. Drain and put it onto a large serving platter
19. Pour on the rest of the sauce and mix well
20. Spoon the meatballs on top of the spaghetti and garnish with basil leaves
21. Serve immediately along with extra cheese

title: west coast cauliflower
steps:
1. Cook cauliflower and peas in 1" boiling water until just tender
2. Drain
3. In a large saucepan , heat soup , milk , salt , and pepper over low heat , stirring constantly
4. Stir in the cauliflower , peas , and shrimp and heat through
5. Serve sprinkled with toasted almonds

title: chicken   coconut in banana leaves
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Whisk together soy sauce , barbecue sauce , ginger and coconut milk
3. Place chicken drumsticks , thighs , plantain , and sweet potato in a bowl and pour over the marinade
4. Marinate 30 minutes
5. Gently warm the whole banana leaf over a fire or gas burner until the leaf is pliable but not burnt , 3 to 4 minutes
6. Cut the leaf into four large squares , measuring at least 30 x 30 cm
7. Carefully cut four long , thin strips from the rib of the leaf , these will be used as 'string' to tie the packets later
8. Place a piece of chicken onto each banana leaf square and evenly divide the vegetables on top
9. Pour in any remaining marinade and fold the leaves around the chicken like you are wrapping a present
10. Securely tie with the rib strips and place the packets onto a baking sheet
11. Bake in preheated oven until the chicken is tender and no longer pink in the center , about 1 hour
12. Check the packets occasionally to make sure they do not burn

title: shrimp stuffed eggs
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , mix shrimp , mayonnaise , celery seed , salt and chives
2. Halve eggs lengthwise
3. Scoop out yolks
4. Fill whites with shrimp mixture
5. Refrigerate before serving

title: ranch roasted potatoes with cheese
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450f
2. In a gallon zip-top storage bag , combine potatoes , onion , pepper , and oil
3. Toss to coat vegetables with oil
4. Add paprika and ranch dressing mix , toss again until coated with seasonings
5. Bake in an ungreased baking pan 30-35 minutes until potatoes are browned , or cook longer for crispier potatoes
6. Remove from oven and top with cheeses , return to oven for 2-3 minutes to let cheese melt
7. Remove from oven and serve

title: wheat berries with swiss chard and pomegranate molasses
steps:
1. Separate the chard's white stalks from the leaves , and slice the stalks into 3 / 8 inch slices
2. Heat the oil and butter in a large , heavy bottomed pot
3. When the butter has melted add the leeks and cook , stirring for 3-4 minutes
4. Add the chard stalks and cook for another 3 minutes
5. , then add the leaves and cook for 3 more minutes
6. Add the sugar , pomegranate molasses and wheat berries , mixing well
7. Add the stock , 3 / 4 teaspoon salt and black pepper for taste
8. Cook on low heat for 60-70 minutes , or until the wheat berries are al dente
9. The base of the liquid should have evaporated , and there should be a caramelizing on the pan
10. Remove from heat , and do a taste test to check whether more salt , pepper and molasses is neede

title: classic pumpkin pie for expats
steps:
1. This recipe is involved and could take a good portion of the morning or evening to do well
2. Plan to dedicate several hours to the joys of making pumpkin pie
3. It will be worth it !
4. Step 1--- making no-roll pie crust: as you will most likely not find frozen pie crust in the stores in china , we must begin by making the no roll pie crust
5. > put 1 1 / 2 cups all purpose flour , salt and sugarin a mixing bowl
6. > mix the 2 tbsp cold milk with the 1 / 2 cup sunflower oil , until the milk has dirtied the oil and there are thousands of milk beads floating in the oil
7. > add milky oil to the bowl and using your hands , mix together until all the flour is dampened by the milky oil mixture
8. Form it into a ball , and place in the center of your 9" pie pan
9. Spread the dough over the pie plate , patting down the dough to cover the bowl
10. Do not let the crust go over the edge of the pan
11. > although if we were not making pumpkin pie , and were just using this as a shell , the next step would be using a fork to poke holes liberally to avoid having the dough bubble under the filling as it bakes
12. But with pumpkin pie , that only makes the crust weak , so don't do that
13. > pat the fork on the crust portion lightly
14. It will give texture to the crust , but don't make the grooves too definite or they may burn unless covered with foil
15. Also , don't let any portion of the crust be too thin or it will burn
16. The crust should be even all the way around , and lightly patted with a fork
17. >place this in the fridge to chill the pie crust , as long as you want
18. Step 2--- making pumpkin puree: as it is rare to find pumpkin puree on the shelves in china , we must begin the pumpkin filling by making our own home-made pumpkin puree
19. There are two ways to do this:
20. ~ method 1 for pumpkin puree if you have an oven:
21. >preheat oven to 175 celsius
22. Be careful with your oven settings
23. The little ovens in china tend to run hotter than those in america
24. > wash your pumpkin
25. >cut the pumpkin in half
26. Leave the skin of the pumpkin on the pumpkin
27. > take a spoon and scrape out the stringy mess inside the pumpkin
28. > prepare cookie sheet by coating a flat cookie sheet with 1 / 4 cup sunflower oil or vegetable oil , using a tissue to spread the oil around the pan
29. (it's best to use a sheet with a lip around the side because this will be juicy and that avoids the juice spilling over later
30. > sprinkle the 1 / 3 cup loose sugar over the oil
31. > place both halves of pumpkin face down in the oil on the cooking sheet
32. Avoid doing this if possible but , if both do not fit , cut the halves it into the fewest pieces necessary to fit it all in the pan
33. > place pumpkin in preheated oven and let bake for 30 or 40 minutes
34. Check to make sure it is not burning periodically
35. It will bubble at the edges and smell good and squashy
36. > when finished baking , leave the oven door open and let the pumpkin cool
37. The middle will probably sink in and it will look entirely unappetizing
38. Fear not
39. Looks do not matter here
40. > once it has cooled to a warm easy to hand temp , turn each halve over , and scrape the pumpkin meat in a bowl , leaving the skin in the pan and finally throwing away the skin
41. > water removal process: now , we must cut down on the liquid in this pumpkin puree
42. This is a critical step- don't leave it out
43. Get a good amount of paper towel ready
44. Place two bowls on the counter and paper towels in bottom of the bowls
45. Transfer pumpkin between bowls , and replacing paper towels until the paper towels have soaked up a good majority of the water in the pumpkin meat
46. About 5 minutes later , and many paper towels later , you will arrive at the desired consistency
47. > place this pumpkin goodness into a blender , and blend to cut up all the strings and make it uniform in texture in the pie
48. ~method 2 for making pumpkin puree if you do not have an oven:
49. > wash pumpkin
50. > cut pumpkin in half
51. > taking a potato peeler , peel the skin from a the pumpkin the same way you would peel a potato
52. Keep doing it until the peel or outer part of the pumpkin is gone
53. > cut the pumpkin into chunks as you would for mashed potatoes
54. The chunks can be a few inches big , not too small , not too big
55. > place chunks into pot of water on stove
56. Heat water to boiling , then reduce heat and cook for about 20 or 30 minutes
57. > drain well , and begin water removal process
58. > water removal process: now , we must cut down on the liquid in this pumpkin puree
59. This is a critical step- don't leave it out
60. Get a good amount of paper towels ready
61. Place two bowls on the counter and paper towels in bottom of the bowls
62. Don't worry if the cubes of pumpkin fall apart as you do this ,
63. It will eventually all go into a blender
64. The goal is to remove as much moisture as possible
65. Transfer cooked pumpkin between bowls , replacing paper towels until the paper towels have soaked up a good majority of the water in the pumpkin meat
66. About 5 minutes later , and many paper towels later , you will arrive at the desired consistency
67. > place this pumpkin goodness into a blender , and blend well to cut up all the strings and make it uniform in texture in the pie
68. Step 3--- creating pumpkin filling: i used a blender and the pie came out better , so i'm showing publishing these instructions , but i've made the pie without the blender and it was great too !
69. > keeping pumpkin puree in blender add the rest of the filling ingredients , i begin with the can of nestle sweetened and condensed milk , so there is more of a thick liquid texture for blending
70. Next , 1 tbsp flour , 1 tsp ground cinnamon , 1 / 2 tsp fine salt , 1 / 2 tsp ground nutmeg , 1 / 4 tsp ground allspice
71. Add brown sugar to taste after all the spices as the sugar will thicken the filling , making it difficult to blend properly
72. I used 1 cup tightly packed , but the filling was very sweet
73. If you don't like pies too sweet , add brown sugar to taste
74. The brown sugar also adds color that looks good once baked
75. I once used white sugar , and the appearance wasn't as traditional
76. The taste that you have in your blender at this point is the taste you will have in your pie , so keep playing with it until you find a good combination
77. Finally , once you are satisfied with the taste , add the eggs to the blender
78. Last step--- adding filling to crust and baking pie
79. > take crust from fridge and pour the filling into the crust in a circular motion until the pan is filled
80. Do not over fill
81. Just a bit below the crust edge is perfect , even if it means wasting some of the filling
82. Though the filling shouldn't be very runny , it is still a very thick liquid , so avoid letting the filling slosh onto the crust as you place the unbaked pie into the oven
83. Put the rack on the lowest level to avoid burning the pie and heat the pie from the top and bottom burners
84. Leave it to cook for about 40 minutes , checking on it to make sure it is not burning
85. If crust begins to get too dark , foil the crust next time
86. As it heats , toward the end , the filling will puff up
87. Fear not
88. It will settle down again as it cools and transform into the worlds best pumpkin pie after refrigeration for a few hours

title: deviled corn and tomato pudding
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees
2. Spray six 8-ounce custard cups with cooking spray
3. Combine the corn , milk , cornstarch , eggs , sugar or honey , salt , and pepper in a food processor or blender and buzz to a textured puree
4. Heat the butter over medium-high heat in a large skillet
5. Add the onion and saute for 4 minutes
6. Add the tomato , raise the heat , and cook until most of the liquid has evaporated , 1 to 3 minutes
7. Remove from the heat
8. Stir in the basil
9. Divide the tomato mixture among the custard cups
10. Top with the corn mixture
11. Place the filled custard cups in a large pan , place in the oven , and pour hot water into the large pan , around the custard cups
12. Bake for 40 to 50 minutes , or until golden and firmed up
13. Let stand for 5 minutes , then serve

title: fresh mushroom casserole
steps:
1. Wash mushrooms and cut off stems
2. Place in buttered 1 qt
3. Casserole
4. Melt butter and bouillon cubes in hot water in small pan over medium heat , stirring to dissolve well
5. Blend in flour , cream , salt and pepper
6. Pour over mushrooms
7. Mix bread crumbs and parmesan cheese and add to mushrooms
8. Bake uncovered at 350 degrees for 30 minutes

title: buttermilk pound cake
steps:
1. Cream together sugar and butter- add eggs and beat well
2. Alternately add milk , soda and flour to above mixture- adding flour last
3. Add in flavorings , and mix well
4. Grease tube pan
5. Do not flour
6. Spread chopped nuts evenly on bottom of pan and pour batter over nuts
7. Bake at 310 to 325 degrees for 1 1 / 2 hours
8. Let cool slightly before removing from pan

title: revised whole grain bread
steps:
1. Gather all your ingredients together and tools: large mixing bowl , sturdy wooden spoon , small clean towel , clean surface to roll the dough , knife to cut it into two equal parts , rolling pin , two clean bread pans
2. Wash your hands and rinse well before beginning , and after handling the eggs
3. Combline first eleven ingredients in a large mixing bowl
4. Carefully mix with a sturdy wooden spoon
5. (i have snapped a couple spoons with this recipe , so use caution
6. Once the ingredients are mixed , add some of the all purpose flour
7. Mix slightly with the spoon until it is too stiff , and then knead with your hands adding more all purpose flour as necessary until it forms a smooth , elastic ball that is not too sticky , about 10 minutes
8. Cover the bowl of dough with a small towel and let it sit for about 20 minutes
9. A few more is not a problem
10. While it is resting make sure you have a clean space to roll the dough
11. Oil the clean surface with some olive oil , and dump the dough onto it
12. Cut it into equal halves
13. Roll each half separately in triangular shapes
14. Roll into loaves from small end to base
15. Fold under the ends and place in greased & floured bread pans
16. Cover with plastic wrap or something simular and refrigerate for at least 2 hours , but don't leave it alone for more than 24 hours , or it will become overgrown --
17. Begin preheating the oven to about 350
18. Puncture any obvious air bubbles that formed with an oiled toothpick
19. Bake for about an hour , or a little more if necessary

title: chicken long rice 2
steps:
1. Soak long rice for about 15 minutes before preparing meal
2. Ok if its longer , won't hurt it
3. I use nice brand this brand is pre-cut at about 7-inches
4. In large pot , saute round onion and ginger until onion is semi-transluscent
5. Add chicken and stir fry until almost done
6. Add long rice and chicken broth
7. Cook at low simmer until noodles are transparent
8. Then add shoyu to taste
9. Make sure you don't run out of liquid or the noodles will stick together
10. Doesn't have to be soupy just have some liquid on the bottom -- the noodles soak up liquid quickly
11. If you need to , you can add more broth or water
12. Optional: slivered carrots , bamboo shoot slices , or chinese peas
13. Please
14. You can also substitute the chicken with pork or beef slices

title: breaded orange glazed chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Spread chicken breasts with 2 tbls of the marmalade
3. Empty coating mix into shallow dish and add chicken , turning to evenly coat both sides
4. Place chicken in a 13x9" baking dish
5. Bake for 25 minutes or until chicken is cooked through
6. Mix dressing and remaining marmalade and add to spinach
7. Tossing to coat
8. Place spinach evenly on 4 serving plates
9. Place one chicken breast on each plate and add mandarin oranges around the edges of the plate , if desired

title: parmesan lemon herb brown rice
steps:
1. Adjust an oven rack to the middle position
2. Preheat oven to 375f
3. Spread rice in a 8x8 glass baking dish
4. Combine the onion , oil , and salt in a medium saucepan
5. Cover and cook over medium-low heat , stirring occasionally , until the onion is softened , 8-10 minutes
6. Stir in the broth and bring to a boil
7. Once broth is boiling immediately pour it over the rice
8. Cover the baking dish tightly with a double layer of foil
9. Bake until rice is tender , about 1 hour 10 minutes
10. Remove baking dish from oven , uncover , and fluff the rice with a fork
11. Stir in the parmesan , parsley , basil , lemon juice , lemon zest and pepper
12. Cover the dish with a clean kitchen towel and let stand for 5 minutes
13. Uncover and let the rice stand for 5 minutes longer before serving

title: hearty black bean chowder   crock pot
steps:
1. Combine everything except cilantro and sour cream in crock-pot
2. Cook on low for 8-9 hours
3. I like to turn crock-pot to high the last 20-30 minutes to allow soup to thicken
4. If using , top with 1 tablespoon of sour cream and sprinkle with cilantro

title: spicy sausage stuffed onions
steps:
1. Select very large onions , 4 inches or so in diamater
2. Prepare onions by peeling off the papery skin , then slicing off about 1 / 2 inch from the top of the onions
3. Trim the root end , taking off the very least amount of flesh possible
4. Take a very thin slice from the root , just barely enough to help the onion remain standing on that end without toppling over
5. Using a small , sharp knife and a spoon , hollow out the onions
6. Leave a wall of onion that is two layers thick at the top
7. Use the knife to cut into the top of the onion down into the center , leaving the outer 2 layers intact
8. Use the spoon to scoop the interior flesh out
9. Use care when you approach the bottom of the onion , the layers are thiner there and you may need to leave a bit more flesh
10. Finely chop the onion trimmings from one onion
11. Discard the remaining onion trimmings , or reserve for another use
12. Set asidethe onion shells
13. Heat oven to 350 degrees
14. Prepare a 9x9 baking dish by spraying with non-stick cooking spray
15. Fry the sausage , crumbling into small bits as it cooks
16. When the meat is about halfway done , add the chopped onion and continue cooking until the meat is done and the onion tender
17. Add the can of tomatoes , with their juice
18. Simmer a few minutes , until the tomatoes are heated through and the juice has blended into the meat
19. Remove from heat and add the cheese , stir through
20. Spoon the sausage mixture into the onion shells , packing down tightly
21. Place the filled onions in the prepared baking dish and place in oven
22. Bake for 60 minutes , or until the onions are tender and beginning to brown
23. Sometimes i fill the onions , then refrigerate for another day
24. The cooking time is about the same
25. I have also used the same stuffing to fill bell peppers
26. The peppers bake for a slightly shorter time , about 45 minutes is usually long enough for them to be tender

title: gambas al ajillo
steps:
1. Begin by sweating the onion in the oil
2. When onion is soft , add the shrimp and garlic and saute for 1-2 minutes
3. Remove the shrimp and add the rest of the ingredients
4. Cook / reduce for about 2 minutes
5. Stir in shrimp and toss to coat
6. Garnish with parsley and lime wedges

title: light as a feather pancakes
steps:
1. Put the cottage cheese , eggs , oil and vanilla into a blender or food processor and spin until smoothly mixed
2. Add the flour and blend again
3. Let the batter rest for 10 minutes then add the baking powder
4. Heat a griddle on medium heat , then add a pat of butter
5. When the butter is sizzing , spoon the batter onto the griddle , leaving plenty of room for them to spread
6. Cook until bubbles appear on the tops of the pancakes , then turn and briefly cook the other side
7. Serve immediately with maple syrup or strawberry sauce

title: classic barbecue ribs
steps:
1. Cut ribs apart , if necessary , and trim excess fat
2. Sprinkle 1 teaspoons salt evenly over ribs
3. Stir together remaining 1 teaspoons salt , onion , and next 9 ingredients until blended
4. Pour half of onion mixture into a 5-qt
5. Slow cooker
6. Place ribs in slow cooker , and pour remaining mixture over ribs
7. Cover and cook on high 6 to 7 hours or until ribs are tender
8. Garnish , if desired

title: bacon cheddar bread
steps:
1. Place ingredients in bread pan in order listed or according to manufacturer' s directions
2. The cheddar cheese and bacon are added at the fruit and nut signal
3. Depending on your machine this could be anywhere from 30 to 40 minutes into the cycle
4. Remember , when adding the yeast last , make a small well with your finger to place the yeast
5. This will insure the proper timing of the yeast reaction
6. This bread is processed at the basic or rapid cycle , or according to manufacturer' s directions

title: shrimp melts
steps:
1. Split bread in half lengthwise
2. Shell and clean shrimp then coarsely dice
3. Saute shrimp in medium-size skillet with salsa for about 4 minutes
4. Slice avocados and layer on bread halves
5. Spoon shrimp on avocado
6. Top with cheese
7. Broil 2 to 3 minutes or until cheese melts
8. Cut each half in half

title: my favorite omelet
steps:
1. Heat pan on medium with about a teaspoon of oil
2. Crack both eggs into bowl , then add salt , pepper and milk
3. Whisk until well-blended
4. Pour egg into hot pan and immediately tilt pan so that egg mixture covers entire bottom
5. Scatter / layer most of each of the remaining ingredients over the omelet and allow to cook until youre able to flip the empty half over onto the half with goodies
6. A fish spatula works better than a regular one here because it lifts more of the omelet , reducing the chance of tearing it
7. Cook to your desired doneness
8. I like mine very dry with some color to it and that takes just a couple of minutes , so be careful you dont burn your omelet
9. Garnish with remaining ingredients and the last bacon slice , then gobble-gobble !

title: extreme cream liqueur
steps:
1. Combine first 5 ingredients in blender
2. Blend until coffee crystals dissolve , about one minute
3. Add whipping cream & cream of coconut to mixture and blend 10 seconds
4. Transfer to pitcher , cover & refrigerate until cold , about 2 hours
5. Serve over ice , add to coffee or serve over chocolate or coffee ice cream
6. Can be made up to 2 weeks ahead
7. Keep refrigerated

title: salmon  pesto focaccia sandwiches
steps:
1. Place salmon in a medium bowl
2. Add pesto , onion , tomatoes , mayonnaise , lemon zest and salt , mix well
3. Split bread in half , layer lettuce leaves on bottom half of bread , top with salmon mixture and top of the bread
4. Cut into 4 and serve immediatly or wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate up to 6 hours before serving

title: tiki shake
steps:
1. Combine first 3 ingredients in a blender and process until smooth
2. Garnish with lime slices if desired
3. Serve immediately

title: gourmet chicken salad
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , whip cream to soft peaks
2. Combine meat , celery , grapes , dried fruit and nuts , parsley , salt and mayonnaise with whipped cream
3. Chill
4. For this salad i like to use the cherry cranberry pecano , the orange cranberry almondine or the raspberry cranberry walnut frisco

title: cheesy bratwurst and sauerkraut  5 ingredients
steps:
1. Heat your skillet to medium
2. Add 1 / 2 cup of beer and 5 bratwurst
3. Cover and cook for 10 minutes
4. Turn the brats over and cook 10 minutes more
5. When brats are finished , add sauerkraut and mustard stir until blended and heated through
6. Top with grated swiss cheese while warm
7. Serve with fried potatoes for a delicious meal

title: cod with crawfish bayou sauce
steps:
1. Preheat a grill or grill pan and spray with cooking spray
2. Season fish with salt and pepper and place fish on grill
3. Cook for 5 to 6 minutes on each side or until flakey
4. Sauce:
5. Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat
6. Stir in garlic and creole seasoning
7. Add 1 / 2 & 1 / 2
8. Stir until mixture is reduced by half , about 5 minutes
9. Add crawfish and shrimp stirring until just heated through
10. Season with salt and pepper , to taste
11. To serve , spoon crawfish bayou sauce over center of fish and garnish with parsley and green onions

title: hashbrown breakfast skillet
steps:
1. In a large skillet add the sausage and cook until most of it is brown
2. Drain and return to pan
3. Add the grated potatoes , onion , and salt to the skillet
4. Cook on medium heat until the hashbrowns are golden brown
5. Push the mixture to one side of the pan and scramble the eggs in the empty space
6. Once cooked , stir them into the hashbrowns
7. Add the hot sauce , tomatoes , and cheese
8. Stir well and serve immediately

title: zucchini sauerkraut loaf
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Mix all ingredients together in large bowl
3. Prepare large casserole dish with non-stick cooking spray
4. Pour mixture into dish
5. Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour
6. Remove from oven
7. Sprinkle cheese over top
8. Bake 10-15 minutes more , or until cheese is melted and top is slightly golden
9. Serve

title: creme brulee pancake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
2. Place the butter in a 9-inch glass pie plate and place the dish in the oven for a few minutes to allow the butter to melt
3. In a blender , combine the creamer , flour , eggs , and salt , and blend until smooth
4. Remove the baking dish from the oven and increase the oven temperature to 425 deg f
5. Spread the melted butter around the dish , pour in the batter , and return the dish to the oven
6. Bake for 20 minutes
7. Reduce the oven temperature to 325 deg f and bake for 8 to 10 minutes more
8. Remove from the oven , and let the pancake cool slightly
9. Cut the pancake into wedges , place each wedge on a serving plate , and garnish with fresh berries
10. Serve with warm maple syrup or powdered sugar if desired

title: zingy tuna salad
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together and serve over lettuce or on your favorite bread , toasted kaiser roll , bun , crackers , etc
2. Its wonderful !

title: cranberry orange wings
steps:
1. Arrange chicken wings in a shallow nonreactive container
2. In medium size bowl , combine orange juice , soy sauce , brown sugar , cranberry sauce and tabasco sauce
3. Mix well
4. Pour sauce over chicken wings
5. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for several hours or overnight
6. Turn wings occasionally to marinate evenly
7. Place wings in shallow baking pan
8. Bake in preheated 350 degree fahrenheit oven for 50 to 60 minutes , or until tender
9. Baste frequently with reserved marinade during baking

title: deluxe chicken enchiladas
steps:
1. Place chicken breasts in large pot , add water to cover add bay leaf , peppercorns and salt to taste
2. Cover and simmer for 45 minutes or until tender
3. Cool and drain
4. Shred chicken and mix with chopped onion parmesan cheese and monterey jack and set aside
5. In a blender combine the green chilies , tomatillos , cilantro , cream and egg
6. Blend
7. Preheat oven to 350f heat oil in fry pan and cook tortillas one at a time
8. Place chicken on top of a tortilla , pressing to make it compact
9. Roll tightly and place seam side down in baking dish
10. Pour the chili cream mixture over each one and top with cheddar
11. Bake for 20 minutes
12. To serve top with sour cream , guacamole and shredded lettuce and onion

title: crock pot thai chicken thighs
steps:
1. Put all ingredients in crock pot on low for 6-8 hours
2. Garnish with cilantro , scallions , and peanuts
3. Serve with jasmine rice made with half coconut milk and half water

title: roasted red pepper cream soup
steps:
1. Roast peppers: turn burner to high
2. Impale a red pepper on a long-handled fork and hold over high heat , turning to char skin evenly
3. When skin is brown and crackly , immediately plunge pepper in a bowl of ice water
4. The skin will fall away
5. Repeat with remaining peppers
6. Seed peppers and chop coarsely
7. Alternatively , broil peppers in a preheated broiler 4 inches from element , turning to char all sides evenly
8. Combine oil , onions , garlic , basil , salt , cayenne , 3 turns of pepper and roasted peppers in a medium saucepan
9. Cook 3 minutes over high heat
10. Stir in stock and 1 / 4 cup cream and bring to a boil
11. Reduce heat to medium and simmer , stirring occasionally , about 8 minutes
12. Pure red pepper mixture in food processor or with a hand blender until smooth , about 2 minutes
13. Return red pepper soup to pan with remaining cream and heat on medium-low heat before serving , garnished with basil chiffonade

title: a pinch of soul barbecue sauce  microwave
steps:
1. In 1 quart measuring glass combine garlic , onion and butter
2. Cook on high 3-4 minutes or until tender
3. Stir in remaining ingredients and cook on high for 7 minutes , stirring once
4. Serve at table , warm or room temperature

title: blueberry miracle muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Line a muffin pan with lightly sprayed paper liners
3. In a large bowl combine flour , sugar , salt , baking powder , and baking soda
4. In another bowl combine the rest of ingredients except for the blueberries
5. Toss blueberries into the flour mixture and then pour the wet ingredients in
6. Spoon batter into muffin cups , filling to almost the top
7. Bake for about 20 minutes
8. The muffins should be lightly brown and toothpick tested clean
9. You can also make streusel muffins with 1 / 3 cup sugar , 3 tbsp flour and 1 1 / 2 tbsp light butter rub together with fingers
10. Add to tops of batter right before baking

title: cauliflower cheese
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180c / 375f
2. Break cauliflower into florets and soak in warm salted water for 3-4 minutes
3. Drain , place in pan with hot water , cover and bring to boil
4. Reduce heat to simmer until florets are tender
5. While cauliflower is cooking , melt butter in a pan , add flour , stir over heat heat until flour starts to bubble , remove from heat
6. Stir in milk , return to heat and stir until mixture boils and thickens
7. Remove from heat and add cheese - let it melt into sauce
8. Drain cooked cauliflower , place on serving plate and spoon cheese sauce over it
9. Sprinkle with parsley
10. If you want you can place cauliflower in dish , top with cheese sauce and broil for a minute until sauce browns

title: frankfurter corn chowder
steps:
1. Saute onion and celery in margarine
2. Add potato , water , salt , frankfurters , bay leaf and thyme
3. Cover and simmer until potatoes are almost tender
4. Add corn
5. Blend flour and cold milk into a smooth paste
6. Add a little of the vegetable mixture to this and stir slowly into vegetable-frankfurter mixture
7. Simmer 5 minutes
8. Add hot milk and blend
9. Garnish with peas
10. Serves 6

title: steak grillades over cheese noodles
steps:
1. Season steak strips with cajun spice , then dredge in flour
2. Saute bacon in skillet over med-high heat until crisp
3. Remove and set aside
4. Add onion and bell pepper to skillet
5. Saute 3 minutes
6. Add steak and saute 5 minutes , stirring occasionally
7. Return bacon to pan , deglaze with broth , and bring to boil
8. Simmer 3 minutes or until thick
9. Boil noodles in unsalted water for 5-8 minutes , and drain well
10. Toss hot noodles with cheese and butter in large bowl , salt to taste , and serve immediately with steak

title: roasted beets    carrots
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Lightly spray your prepared carrots with veggie oil and place in a casserole dish large enough to accommodate the beets as well
3. Mix catalina dressing with the ginger
4. Add beets to the carrots along with the dressing
5. Toss
6. Place in heated oven for approx 20-25 minutes or until heated through and lightly glazed
7. If you want them well browned place under broiler for the last 10 minute
8. Turn them over a couple of times as they are baking
9. Wonderful served with pork or chicken

title: dr pepper chicken marinade
steps:
1. Add onions , worcestershire sauce , allspice , salt , and peppers
2. Bring to a boil , then simmer for 5 minutes , stirring occasionally
3. Remove from heat and stir in dr
4. Pepper
5. Use to marinate chicken
6. Makes about 4 cups of marinade

title: shrimp campechana  cocktail
steps:
1. Combine shrimp , avocados , tomatoes , cilantro , green onions , jalapeos and lime juice in a bowl and mix gently
2. Stir in seafood sauce , ketchup and salt
3. Chill , cover , until serving time
4. Serve with tortilla chips
5. Garnish with a whole jalapeo

title: baked rotini with chicken and mushrooms
steps:
1. First you cook the pasta
2. Unless you buy chicken breasts then you need to cook those first
3. Once the pasta is cooked drain it and pour it into a 9 x 13 baking pan
4. Then melt your butter in a bowl and mix in garlic salt to taste
5. Mix about 2 / 3 of the mushroom sauce in with the butter and garlic salt
6. Pour over the pasta
7. Drain your mushrooms and mix them and your chicken into your pasta
8. Smother the whole concoction in cheeses and pour the rest of the mushroom sauce over the top
9. Bake at 375 degrees for about 20 minutes or until the cheese is nicely melted
10. Serve

title: chocolate coconut crispies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f beat softened butter in a bowl , then add both sugars and beat for two minutes
2. Add egg and beat until creamy
3. Pour in melted chocolate
4. Stir in flour , baking powder and baking soda until just combined
5. Add oats and coconut
6. Drop slightly rounded teaspoonfuls of dough onto cookie sheets
7. Bake for 10 minutes and let cool briefly on the pans before removing to a storage container

title: quick glazed onions
steps:
1. Stir together margaine , corn syrup and water in 2 qt pan
2. Bring to a boil over medium heat , stirring frequently
3. Add onions and cover
4. Simmer 20 minutes
5. Uncover
6. Stirring constantly , cook another 5 minutes
7. Serve with your favorite meat dish

title: miso pate
steps:
1. Combine bread and water , mashing well with fingers
2. Mix in the remaining ingredients , and allow to stand for at least 1 hour , preferably 1 full day
3. Serve as a spread on crackers , or for a sandwich with sprouts , onions and tomatoes

title: black bean  butternut and chipotle chili
steps:
1. Apply a coating of cooking spray to a large soup pot
2. Add onions and begin to cook for 2-3 minutes until softened
3. If needed , add a little water to keep the pot moist
4. Stir in garlic and cook an additional minute
5. Add in the cumin , chili powder and cinnamon and cook 30 seconds , until fragrant
6. Add the diced tomatoes , black beans , 2 cups of vegetable broth , tomato paste chipotles , adobo sauce , and barley malt syrup and bring to a boil
7. Reduce to a simmer , cover and cook for 35 minutes
8. You can let this simmer for up to an hour if you like
9. Chili is one of those things that just gets better with time
10. Mix in the butternut squash
11. Add in additional broth if desired
12. Cook for 20 minutes
13. Mix in the frozen corn and cook 5 minutes until warmed through
14. Ladle into bowls , with or without rice , and garnish with cilantro
15. Should you substitute canned black beans , they will most likely need less vegetable broth

title: david venable s holiday party mix
steps:
1. In a large bowl , mix together the cereals , peanuts , almonds , brittle , candy-coated peanut butter pieces , and pretzels
2. Set aside
3. In a microwave-safe bowl , heat the white chocolate chips and oil for 45 seconds to 1 minute
4. Stir and place back in the microwave for 5 - 10 seconds
5. Remove and stir until smooth
6. Pour into cereal mixture and toss well to combine
7. Spread on 2 large wax or parchment paper-covered baking sheets
8. Allow mix to cool for 1 hour
9. Break apart and store in an airtight 3-qt
10. Container

title: simple low fat turkey meatballs
steps:
1. Beat egg in large bowl
2. Add all remaining ingredients
3. Mush together well using your hands
4. Form into 1 / 2 inch balls
5. Heat small amount of olive oil in skillet
6. Put half the balls into the skillet and cook until browned evenly on outside
7. Remove and add remaining balls

title: easy banana muffins
steps:
1. Mash bananas , add sugar and the slightly beaten egg
2. Stir in melted butter
3. Stir in dry ingredients
4. Spoon into medium size muffin pan
5. Bake 20 minutes at 350f degrees - 375f degrees

title: easy apple syrup
steps:
1. In small saucepan , combine sugar , cornstarch and allspice
2. Mix well
3. Stir in apple juice
4. Cook over medium heat for 6-8 minutes or until mixture comes to a boil and thickens , stirring frequently
5. Remove from heat
6. Set aside
7. Serve warm

title: michigan dutch barley soup   gerstenbrij
steps:
1. Rinse barley in cold water
2. Drain
3. Add salt to boiling water , followed by the barley
4. Cook until tender , about two hours
5. Add soup stock and vegetables
6. Cook until vegetables are tender
7. Serve hot

title: white wine grilled salmon
steps:
1. Pour white wine into a non-metallic dish and add remaining ingredients
2. Marinate fish for at least one hour , turning occasionally
3. Grill on bbq flesh side down for 5-6 mins , flip and finish cooking with skin side down , 5-6 mins or until fish flakes
4. Do not overcook or it will be dry !

title: creole hollandaise sauce
steps:
1. Beat yolks in the top of a double boiler
2. Add butter by the tablespoon & whisk in completely before adding the next tablespoon
3. Keep whisking
4. Add remaining ingredients
5. Whisk more
6. Serve warm
7. Good on eggs benedict , crab cakes , in a bowl --

title: chocolate coconut pie
steps:
1. Mix sugar , salt and cocoa together
2. Add eggs and milk
3. Stir in vanilla , coconut and nuts , add melted margarine
4. Bake at 350 for 40 minutes or until firm

title: super simple luscious grilled vegetables
steps:
1. Cut all of the vegetables into bite-size pieces
2. Coarsely chop the fresh basil
3. Mix all of the ingredients , except the cheese and dry seasonings , in a bowl or plastic bag to coat evenly with oil
4. Tear off two pieces of heavy-duty aluminum foil about 15 to 18 inches square
5. Mound all of the vegetables in the center of one of the foil squares , sprinkle with salt , pepper , and tarragon
6. Place the second foil over top and fold all sides together to form a sealed packet
7. Place on hot barbeque grill and cook for 12- 15 minutes
8. No need to turn
9. Remove from grill with hot pads or bbq mit to counter
10. Slit open packet and remove to serving bowl
11. Sprinkle cut up cheese over top and serve

title: veggie pita pizzas
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. On oven rack or in toaster oven , toast pita bread for 1 minute
3. Remove and allow to cool
4. Spread 1 / 4 cup pasta sauce on each pita round
5. In medium bowl , combine red pepper , zucchini , yellow squash and mushrooms
6. Spoon evenly onto pita rounds
7. Sprinkle 1 / 4 teaspoon oregano and basil on each round
8. Divide mozzarella among pitas
9. Top each with 2 teaspoons of parmesan cheese
10. If desired , sprinkle with a bit of crushed red pepper flakes
11. Broil , watching carefully , until cheese is melted and bubbly , and pita is hot
12. Serve immediately

title: apple cake shooter
steps:
1. Shake all ingredients with ice in a cocktail shaker
2. Strain into a shot glass

title: kotopoulo makaronada  chicken pasta
steps:
1. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat
2. Add garlic and onion , and saute for 2 minutes
3. Stir in the chicken
4. Cook , stirring occasionally , until chicken is no longer pink and the juices run clear , about 5 to 6 minutes
5. Meanwhile bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil
6. Cook pasta in boiling water for 8 to 10 minutes , or until al dente
7. Drain
8. Reduce heat of sauce to medium-low , and add the tomato , feta cheese , parsley , lemon juice and oregano
9. Add pasta stir until heated through , about 2 to 3 minutes
10. Remove from heat , season to taste with salt and pepper , and garnish with lemon wedges

title: cheesy chicken shortcake
steps:
1. In a skillet over medium heat , cook bacon until crisp
2. Remove with slotted spoon and save for later
3. In same skillet , add oil and fry onion , mushrooms , green and red pepper until soft
4. Add flour , stock cube , nutmeg , and black pepper , then milk and water all at once
5. Cook and stir until sauce thickens
6. Turn heat down to low , add chicken and cheese , stirring until chicken is heated through

title: chicken asparagus stir fry
steps:
1. Heat 1 t
2. Sesame oil and 1 t
3. Cooking oil in wok
4. Add chicken
5. Sprinkle with ginger
6. Stir-fry
7. Remove and keep warm
8. Heat 1 t
9. Sesame oil in wok
10. Add black bean sauce and garlic
11. Stir-fry 1 minute
12. Add asparagus and onions
13. Stir-fry 3-4 minutes
14. Add broth
15. Cover and steam 5 minutes , until tender
16. Return chicken to wok
17. Mix soy sauce with cornstarch
18. Pour into wok and stir to thicken mixture

title: crabby shrimp dip
steps:
1. Spread softened cream cheese on pie plate
2. Spread shrimp cocktail sauce over the cream cheese
3. Add layer of crab meat and shrimp
4. Best to eat with crackers or rippled chips
5. Serve at room temperature

title: orange dream cookies
steps:
1. Beat butter and sugars until creamy
2. Then add in egg and peel and mix
3. Then add in dry ingredients
4. Stir in chips and drop onto a ungreased cookie sheet
5. Bake at 350f for 10-12 minutes or until edges are browned
6. Let stand for a couple minutes then transfer onto a wire rack to cool completely

title: cool n creamy fruit salad
steps:
1. Drain pineapple and oranges reserving juice in small bowl
2. In large bowl combine fruit
3. Sprinkle pudding mix into reserved juice
4. Mix until combined and slightly thickened
5. Fold into fruit until well combined
6. Edited based on reviews: the sauce will be somewhat thin , kind of like a glaze
7. If you would like it thicker and creamier , mix less of the reserved juice into the pudding mix

title: apple pie apple cider
steps:
1. Boil half of a 1 / 2 gallon of apple cider
2. Add 4 tablespoons of honey , and some cinnamon
3. Put 1 tablespoon of honey on the bottom of each cup
4. Pour in the hot apple cider
5. Top with whip cream
6. Sprinkle cinnamon on top of whip cream
7. Enjoy !

title: tiffany cellar cafe s egg salad
steps:
1. With a hand mixer beat together the first 5 ingredients
2. By hand stir in the relish and celery , then fold in eggs
3. Keep refrigerated till time to use

title: sour cream pancakes  livanecky z kysele smetany
steps:
1. Beat egg yolks with sugar , sour cream , and salt in a medium mixing bowl
2. Sift flour with baking powder , then mix into egg / sour cream mixture
3. Fold in beaten egg whites
4. Heat oil in frying pan over medium heat , then spoon in batter , and fry about 3-5 minutes on each side or until nice and golden brown on both sides
5. Sprinkle finished pancakes with a little powdered sugar

title: janette s mexican dip
steps:
1. Brown hamburger and drain
2. Mix in taco mix and stir
3. Add salsa and enchilada sauce
4. Simmer 5 minute
5. Spread refried beans in the bottom of a large square pan
6. Pour meat mixture over beans
7. Sprinkle cheese on top
8. Bake at 400 until cheese melts and is bubbly

title: luscious applesauce bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit
2. Grease and flour a 13x9-inch pan
3. In a large bowl , cream brown sugar and butter until light and fluffy
4. Add applesauce and egg
5. Blend well
6. Stir in flour , baking soda , cinnamon , salt , cloves and nutmeg until well mixed
7. Stir in cereal
8. Spread mixture into prepared pan
9. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
10. Prepare glaze:
11. Melt butter over low heat and stir in brown sugar
12. Cook about 1 minute or until mixture bubbles , stirring constantly
13. Remove from heat and stir in powdered sugar
14. While glaze is still hot , drizzle it over warm bars
15. Cool completely
16. Cut into squares

title: pork roast with goat cheese and maple sauce from quebec
steps:
1. Preparation of the roast : in a bowl , mix goat cheese and pecans
2. Add salt and pepper
3. Remove the string that is around the roast if needed , then do an incision on all the length in the center
4. With a spatula , spread the mixture of cheese in the cavity of the roast
5. Add salt and pepper if wanted
6. Tie up again the roast on all the length with a roast string
7. Put pork roast in an oven dish
8. In a bowl , mix maple syrup and water and sprinkle on the roast
9. Cook in a preheated oven of 350 f for about 1 hour or until pork is lightly pink inside and have an internal temperature of 158f sprinkle the roast with liquid every 15 minutes
10. Preparation of the sauce : in a casserole , melt 1 tablespoon of butter
11. Add shallots and cook about 3 minutes or until tender
12. Add the veal stock , port wine and maple syrup
13. Bring to boil and let simmer for about 3 minutes
14. In a small casserole , melt the remaining butter
15. Incorporate the flour
16. Add the mixture of butter to the sauce and whip 2 to 3 minutes or until thick
17. When ready to serve , cut the roast in slices and sprinkle with maple sauce

title: potato salad w lemon
steps:
1. Boil potatoes for 20-25 mins until cooked
2. Cool and slice
3. Place in a large bowl
4. Whisk together olive oil , lemon juice , zest , 1 tsp salt and pepper to taste
5. Pour over potatoes
6. Toss gently , add basil and scallions , toss again
7. Serve warm

title: copycat boiling crab recipe
steps:
1. Pour live crawfish into a washtub or ice chest
2. Cover with water
3. Drain
4. Repeat 3 to 4 times until crawfish are clean
5. Drain
6. Discard any dead crawfish and debris
7. Cook crawfish by boiling in hot water with the louisiana crawfish boil , quartered lemon , potatoes , corn and sausage
8. While they are cooking make the sauce:
9. Melt the margarine over low heat in a large saucepan
10. Add garlic and saute until translucent
11. Add cajun seasoning , old bay , cayenne pepper , lemon pepper , paprika , and liberally add louisiana hot sauce
12. When you have the mixture right , add a tiny bit of lemon juice
13. Simmer for 10 minutes and check for flavor
14. Add more cayenne , paprika , or hot sauce as desired
15. Drain the boiling water and mix the sauce in with them
16. Serve with hot crusty french bread

title: blue eye cod with curry sauce
steps:
1. Heat the 2 tablespoons of oil in a wok or saute pan until hot
2. Add the fish and cook for 2 to 3 minutes , or until opaque
3. Transfer fish to a plate and cover with foil to keep warm
4. Set aside
5. Wipe the pan or wok with paper towel
6. Heat the remaining 2 tablespoons of oil until hot
7. Add the garlic and curry paste and fry for 30 seconds
8. Pour in the cocnut milk and mix
9. Add the fish sauce , sugar and lemon juice
10. Heat through
11. Stir in the shredded lime leaves and chopped coriander / cilantro
12. Spoon the curry sauce over the fish and garnish with coriander / cilantro leaves
13. Serve with rice

title: chilled italian style mushrooms  very simple  very delicious
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients , except mushrooms and parsley , in a large zip top plastic bag
2. Seal bag and shake well
3. Add the mushrooms to the marinade
4. Seal bag and turn over several times
5. Refrigerate no longer than 2 hours
6. Drain mushrooms and sprinkle with snipped parsley

title: my favorite pancakes
steps:
1. In large bowl , stir together flour , sugar , baking powder and salt
2. In another bowl , whisk eggs , oil , milk and vanilla
3. Add liquid to dry mixture and whisk
4. Don't overmix
5. Batter should be lumpy
6. Heat a heavy griddle or fry pan which is greased with a little butter or oil
7. The pan is hot enough when a drop of water breaks into several smaller balls which 'dance' around the pan
8. Pour a small amount of batter into pan
9. When bubbles appear on surface and begin to break , turn over and cook the other side
10. Enjoy !

title: spaghetti with red wine sauce
steps:
1. Bring a large pot of water to a boil and salt it
2. Put the oil , garlic and hot pepper in a large , deep skillet
3. When the water boils , add the pasta
4. Turn the heat under the skillet to high
5. Cook the pasta as usual , stirring
6. As soon as the garlic begins to brown , sprinkle it with salt and pepper to taste and add three-quarters of the bottle of wine
7. Bring to a boil and keep it there
8. When the pasta beings to bend--after less than five minutes of cooking--drain it and add it to the wine mixture
9. Cook , stirring occasionally , adding wine a little at a time if the mixture threatens to dry out completely
10. Taste the pasta frequently
11. When it is done--tender but with a little bite--stir in the butter and turn off the heat
12. When the butter glazes the pasta , serve it immediately

title: pumpkin chocolate loaf
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Butter and flour a 9x5 inch nonstick loaf pan
3. In a bowl , combine the flour , baking powder , baking soda , pumpkin pie spice , and salt
4. Whisk together
5. In another bowl , using an electric mixer , beat the butter until creamy
6. Add in sugar and continue beating until light and fluffy
7. Add in eggs one at a time and beat until well blended
8. Add in pumpkin puree and vanilla , then add the flour mixture , beating just until well blended
9. In the top of a double boiler , melt the chocolate over med-high heat , stirring occasionally until smooth , about 5 minutes
10. Spoon half the batter into the loaf pan
11. Spoon half the melted chocolate on top of the batter and swirl it into the batter with a wooden skewer
12. Repeat with the remaining batter and chocolate , making sure to swirl the chocolate into the batter well
13. Bake for about 1 hour or until a pick comes out clean
14. Let loaf cool for 15 minutes on a wire rack , then invert onto the rack and turn right-side up
15. Serve warm or at room temperature , cut into slices

title: squash brownies with chocolate swirl topping
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Brownies:
3. In a large bowl , stir together squash , brown sugar , buttermilk , oil , eggs , and vanilla
4. In a separate bowl , stir or sift together flour , baking powder , cinnamon , ginger , baking soda , nutmeg , and salt
5. Stir into squash mixture until combined
6. Stir in nuts
7. Spread into greased 13x9 inch pan
8. Chocolate swirl topping:
9. In a small bowl , cream together cream cheese , sugar , egg and vanilla
10. Stir in chocolate chips
11. Set aside
12. Drop topping by heaping 1 tablespoons onto batter
13. Swirl into batter with knife
14. Bake in preheated oven for 35 minutes or until tester comes out clean
15. Let cool
16. Cut into desired size

title: jt s pickled eggs
steps:
1. Place eggs in pan and cover with water
2. Bring to rapid boil and remove from heat
3. Place lid on it that does not release the steam and set your timer for 15 minutes
4. Perfect boiled eggs every time !
5. While waiting for eggs to get done , dump the 2 cans of sliced beets into jar
6. Then fill each can with vinegar and pour them into jar
7. Put remaining items in and stir gently
8. When eggs are done crack and peel them
9. Drop them into jar
10. When all eggs are in , fill the rest of the jar up with water
11. Stir gently and refrigerate for at least 24 hours
12. Enjoy !

title: apricot glazed chicken
steps:
1. Preheat your oven to 350f
2. In a saucepan , melt 3 tablespoons of butter
3. When the butter is melted , add most of the preserves reserving about 2 tablespoons for later
4. Stir the preserves / fruit into the melted butter until it's well blended
5. Lay the chicken breasts flat into a 9x13 pyrex pan
6. Spread the preserve&butter mixture over the chicken , coating the top surface well , let it slide down about the chicken if it goes that way
7. Dot the chicken with the leftover butter , and place the pan into the oven
8. Cook for 30 minutes at the timer buzz , check the chicken
9. Chicken should be mostly cooked , but not yet done
10. The edges will appear "crisp" , but the liquids may not be completely clear
11. Set the timer for another 15-20 , depending on how done the chicken looks and start making your stuffing / dressing according to the package instructions
12. It should be wet not dry
13. At about 5 - 10 minutes before the chicken is done pull the pan out of the oven
14. Pick up the cooked chicken , and stir the juices and the butter / preserve mixture together in the pan
15. Gently layer the stuffing into the bottom of the pan , and lay the chicken back on top of the stuffing
16. Sprinkle the reserved preserves on top of the stuffing and put the pan back into the oven

title: crock pot cheesy corn and ham chowder
steps:
1. Spray a 3 or 4 quart slow cooker with non-stick cooking spray , and add all ingredients except cheeses and hot pepper sauce to the crock pot
2. Cover and cook on low setting for 3-4 hours
3. Check potatoes to be sure they are tender , and then stir in the cheeses and the hot pepper sauce to taste
4. Adjust salt and pepper to taste also
5. Once the cheeses are completely melted , it's ready to eat !

title: curry broccoli salad
steps:
1. Place bacon in a large , deep skillet
2. Cook over medium high heat until evenly brown
3. Drain , crumble and set aside
4. In a large bowl , combine the bacon , broccoli , onion , dried fruit and sunflower seeds
5. Whisk together the mayonnaise , curry powder , vinegar and sugar
6. Pour dressing over salad
7. Toss to coat , and marinate over night

title: creamy tomato basil soup  oamc
steps:
1. Combine onions , celery , basil , bay leaf and tomatoes in a stock pot
2. Simmer until vegetables are tender , about 45-60 minutes
3. Remove bay leaf
4. Pure tomato mixture in a blender and then strain through a fine sieve or colander
5. Return tomato mixture to stockpot
6. In a small mixing bowl , blend flour and melted butter into a smooth paste , then add a small amount of the tomato mixture
7. Stir until smooth
8. Gradually add the flour mixture to the stockpot , stirring continuously to avoid scorching and lumps
9. Add sugar , salt , and pepper
10. If freezing ahead: cool completely
11. Freeze in a gallon size freezer bag
12. Serving day: thaw completely
13. Reheat soup in stockpot , adding milk and baking soda
14. Heat through but do not boil
15. If serving immediately: add 2 cups nonfat milk and 1 t baking soda
16. Stir until well mixed then serve

title: chocolate bliss cookies
steps:
1. Microwave chocolate squares in large microwavable bowl on high 2 minutes
2. Stir until chocolate is melted and smooth
3. Stir in sugar , butter , eggs and vanilla with wooden spoon until well blended
4. Stir in flour and baking powder
5. Stir in chopped chocolate and nuts
6. Drop by scant 1 / 4 cupfuls onto ungreased cookie sheets
7. Bake at 350 for 13-14 minutes or until cookies are puffed and feel set to the touch
8. Cool 1 minute , remove from cookie sheet
9. Cool completely on wire racks
10. Makes about 18 large cookies

title: crunchy yoghurt and raspberry pears
steps:
1. Place the pears in a pan , cover with water and simmer for 20 minutes or until soft
2. Divide the pear halves among four bowls , top with muesli , yoghurt and raspberries and drizzle with maple syrup

title: grilled garlic artichokes
steps:
1. Prepare a medium-hot charcoal fire , or preheat a gas grill on the medium-low setting for 15 minutes
2. Trim off the top inch and stem of each artichoke
3. Whisk together the olive oil , garlic , parsley , salt and pepper
4. Spread the leaves of the artichokes apart with your fingers and pour the sauce over the top , making sure it drips into the spaces between the leaves
5. Or , you can split the artichokes in half and coat the cut sides with the dressing
6. Cook the artichokes on the grill , turning , until the bottoms are easily pierced with a skewer , about 45 minutes for medium artichokes , 25 minutes for halves or baby artichokes
7. Remove from the grill , drizzle with lemon juice mixed with oregano , if desired , and serve

title: pear carrot slaw with ginger mint dressing
steps:
1. In a large bowl , whisk together the vinegar and peanut oil
2. Add the pears , carrots , ginger , and shallots
3. Mix gently
4. Season with salt and pepper
5. The salad can be prepared to this point and refrigerated for up to 3 hours
6. Just before serving add the mint and mix gently
7. Serve immediately , garnished with the peanuts

title: healthy blueberry smoothie
steps: 1. In a food processor or blender , combine all ingredients and puree

title: chicken and spinach dip pizza
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Sprinkle cornmeal on a 12 inch pizza pan
3. Unroll dough , and place on pizza pan
4. Starting at the center , press out dough into a 12 inch round , forming to edge of pan , forming a 1 / 2 inch rim
