5. Bake for 8 minutes
6. Spread spinach dip over partially baked pizza crust
7. Top with chicken , tomato , and mushrooms
8. Sprinkle with cheese
9. Bake 12-15 minutes longer , or until crust is golden brown , and cheese is melted

title: shrimp norfolk
steps:
1. Norfolk butter: combine ingredients and beat until smooth
2. Makes enough for 1 lb of shrimp or 2 to 3 servings
3. Shrimp: melt the 1 t butter in skillet over medium heat
4. Add shrimp and stir-fry until just pink
5. Transfer to serving plate and keep warm
6. Add wine to skillet and reduce to 1 t
7. Remove from heat and gradually whisk in norfolk butter until just incorporated and sauce is slightly thickened
8. Pour over shrimp , sprinkle with fresh chopped parsley and garnish with lemon slices
9. Serve over linguine or rice

title: french style grilled potato salad ala bobby flay
steps:
1. Cover potatoes with water in a medium saucepan
2. Add 2 tablespoons salt
3. Bring to a boil
4. Reduce heat and simmer until potatoes are tender , about 8 minutes
5. Drain potatoes , let cool then slice each in half
6. Heat the grill to medium
7. Brush the potatoes with 1 / 4 cup of the oil and season with salt and pepper
8. Place the potatoes on the grill , cut-side down and grill until lightly golden brown , about 4 minutes
9. Turn potatoes over and continue grilling until just cooked through , about 4 minutes
10. While the potatoes are grilling , whisk together the vinegar , mustard and oil in a large bowl , add the red onion , cornichon , and capers and stir to combine
11. Remove the potatoes from the grill and immediately add to the bowl with the other ingredients and gently stir to combine
12. Season with salt and pepper
13. Let sit at room temperature at least 15 minutes before serving
14. Garnish with chopped chervil

title: scallops gremolata
steps:
1. Heat oil in large nonstick skillet coated with cooking spray over medium-high heat
2. Place breadcrumbs in large zip-top plastic bag
3. Add scallops
4. Seal bag
5. Shake to coat
6. Add scallops to pan
7. Cook 4 minutes
8. Turn scallops
9. Cook 3 minutes or until done
10. Remove from heat
11. Add parsley and remaining ingredients
12. Stir gently to coat

title: white sangria with fresh strawberries  mango and mint
steps:
1. Crush mint to bring out its flavor
2. Combine all ingredients in large pitcher and serve

title: pork chops with gingersnap gravy
steps:
1. In a skillet , brown chops in hot oil on both sides
2. Drain on paper towels
3. Place chops in a baking dish
4. Drain excess fat from skillet
5. Add onion and 1 1 / 4 cups water
6. Cover and simmer 2 minutes or until onions are tender
7. Add remaining ingredients
8. Cook and stir just until bubbly
9. Gravy will thicken with the gingersnaps
10. Spoon over chops
11. Bake , covered , in 375 degree oven for 50-55 minutes or until hot-- or-- cover skillet and allow to simmer on low for 40 minutes

title: vegetable orzo
steps:
1. Cook orzo in chicken broth until tender
2. Saut the the vegetables in butter until tender adding the garlic near the end to prevent burning
3. This is where i usually add a little salt and fresh cracked pepper
4. Drain the orzo and combine with the cooked vegetables and add the chopped parsley
5. The heat of the other ingredients will wilt the parsley
6. Stir in the juice of the 1 / 2 lemon and olive oil if desired
7. Serve with grated parmesan
8. Enjoy

title: dried cranberry walnut oatmeal cookies
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375f
2. Combine 3 / 4 cup shortening and sugars in large bowl
3. Beat at medium speed with electric mixer until well blended
4. Beat in eggs and vanilla until well blended
5. Combine flour , baking soda and salt in small bowl
6. Stir into creamed mixture
7. Mix well
8. Add oats , dried cranberries and walnuts
9. Drop dough by teaspoonfuls about 2 inches apart onto non-stick cookie sheets
10. Bake at 375f for 8 minutes or until firm and light brown
11. Cool on cookie sheets 4 minutes
12. Transfer to cooling rack

title: almond joy macaroons
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Line two baking sheets with parchment paper
3. Mince 1 1 / 2 cups of coconut in a food processor and transfer to a bowl
4. Add remaining ingredients , except kisses
5. Mix gently with your hands until combined
6. Chill dough at least 1 hour
7. Shape a heaping tablespoon of dough around a kiss
8. Make sure it is enclosed completely
9. Place 1 inch apart on lined baking sheet
10. Bake until firm and deep golden on the bottom and light golden on the top--about 16-18 minutes
11. Cool on pan for 5 minutes and transfer to cooling rack
12. These are a little sticky so i keep them in mini muffin papers or paper bonbon cups

title: failsafe chips
steps:
1. Peel potatoes , and cut into desired shape , i usually do wedges
2. In a bowl cover potato with oil and then add garlic salt
3. Coat evenly
4. Place in a 200c oven and cook for 20 30 minutes , depends on cut of chip

title: kielbasa and lentil soup
steps:
1. Heat oil in 4 quart saucepan over moderate heat
2. Brown meat for 5 minutes , remove and drain on paper towels
3. Remove all but 1 tablespoons of fat from pan
4. Saute carrots , onion , celery , garlic and parsley in same pan until onion and celery is tender
5. Add lentils , tomatoes , bay leaf , stock , water and meat
6. Bring to a simmer
7. Reduce heat to low , partially cover and cook for 40 minutes or until lentils are tender
8. Season with salt and pepper
9. Discard bay leaf
10. Serve with crusty bread and butter

title: asian ground beef  pepper and onion saute
steps:
1. Spray a large skillet with cooking spray
2. Over over medium heat , cook and stir the ground beef until evenly browned
3. Drain and set aside
4. Add the peppers , onion , garlic and ginger
5. Season with parsley , red pepper , and salt
6. Cook and stir until tender
7. Return the beef to the skillet
8. In a small bowl , mix together the beef stock , soy sauce , molasses , chile paste , and worcestershire sauce
9. Cook until heated through and sauce comes to a boil
10. Combine water and cornstarch and add to skillet
11. Stir constantly until sauce is thickened
12. Serve over the cooked rice

title: camarones borracho
steps:
1. Place marinade into a blender , puree till smooth , adjust seasonings and puree again if needed place raw shrimp in a glass bowl , pour marinade over shrimp , stirring to coat cover bowl and refrigerate mixture 4 hours
2. Heat a large skillet on high heat till hot , add shrimp and marinade , tossing till shrimp are pink and cooked through , about 2 minutes serve on rice

title: strawberries with tequila   black pepper
steps:
1. Combine first 5 ingredients in a bowl
2. Toss well
3. Cover and chill 3 hours , stirring occasionally
4. Spoon into compote dishes or marguarita glasses
5. Garnish with mint sprigs

title: trdelnik   slovak czech sweet pastry
steps:
1. Please read the description part first , as it's essential for this recipe
2. Thak you
3. First stiff into large mixing bowl flour and powdered sugar
4. Make a small hole in the middle and place into it crumbled fresh yeast
5. Pour lukewarm milk over the yeast
6. Let it rise for about 10 minutes
7. Meanwhile melt the butter
8. Add egg yolks into the bowl , pour in melted , but not hot butter , add pinch of salt
9. Mix together to make fairly firm dough , well worked
10. Let the dough rise for 20 minutes in warm place
11. Divide into five equal parts , make loafs
12. You can let it rise for another 20 minutes
13. Roll out each loaf into 2 / 3 inch diameter / caster ? / - you know what i mean , thin , cylindrical shape , like a small snake :-))
14. Lol
15. Wrap the dough tighty around the buttered "trdlo" wooden stick
16. Let it stand for ten more minutes
17. Glair with the last egg , cover all around with chopped walnuts and granulated sugar
18. Bake as described above over hot coals on the grill
19. Results may be achieved with oven , but
20. The pastry need to be turned pretty often during baking , and baked until golden red color
21. Baking time is not determined , since baking over hot coals and on open air , but from my experience about 20 to 40 minutes , also depends on size you making
22. When cooled down a little ,
23. Slide the baked pastry of the wooden stick , cut into individual servings , sprinkle with powdered sugar , enjoy
24. Also you can cover it in various nuts , coconut and such
25. Makes five , baked on two feet long , three inch diameter wooden stick
26. I tried to have your reading bit more enjoyable , if there is something not so clear , feel free to ask
27. Tomas sedlacek

title: neo neapolitan pizza dough
steps:
1. With a big metal spoon , stir together all the ingredients in a 4-quart bowl or the bowl of an electric stand mixer until combined
2. Fit mixer with dough hook
3. Mix on low speed for about 4 minutes , or until all the flour gathers to form a coarse ball
4. Let dough rest for 5 minutes , then mix again on med-low speed for 2 more minutes , or until the dough clears the sides of the bowl and sticks just a little to the bottom
5. If the dough is too soft and sticky to hold its shape , mix in more flour by the tablespoonful
6. If it is too stiff or dry , mix in more water by the tablespoonful
7. The dough should pass the windowpane testsnip off a piece of dough and gently tugging and turning it , stretching it out until it forms a paper-thin , translucent membrane somewhere near the center
8. If dough does not form this membrane , it probably needs another minute or two of mixing)
9. Immediately divided the dough into 4-equal portions
10. Round each piece into a ball and brush or rub each ball with olive oil
11. Place each ball inside its own zip-lock freezer bag
12. Let the balls sit at room temperature for 15 minutes , then put them in the refrigerator overnight or freeze any pieces you will not be using the next day
13. The next day , remove the balls from the refrigerator 2 hours before you plan to roll them out to take the chill off
14. Makes four 10 ounce dough balls

title: pretzel crusted dijonnaise chicken breasts
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Line baking sheet with foil
3. Sprinkle chicken breasts with salt and pepper
4. Mix dijon mustard and mayonnaise in a bowl
5. Coat chicken with dijon mayo mixture
6. Mix thyme and crushed pretzels in a sealable bag
7. Roll chicken breasts in crushed pretzels and place on baking sheet
8. Bake in a 350 degree oven for 20-25 minutes or until chicken juices run clear

title: low carb cheesecake nut crust
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Place nuts in bowl of a food processor
3. Pulse until ground into a meal
4. Add splenda , butter and cocoa powder pulse to combine
5. Transfer nut mixture to a 9" springform pan and gently press to form a crust on bottom of pan
6. Bake at 350 degrees for 10 minutes remove from oven and cool
7. Fill with your favorite lowcarb cheesecake batter and bake according to cheesecake recipe directions

title: moscow hot chocolate
steps:
1. Pour vanilla vodka , amaretto , and hot chocolate mix into a coffee mug
2. Pour in the hot milk and stir to blend

title: chipotle steak chili
steps:
1. Cut beef into cubes
2. In a 4-quart dutch oven , brown meat , half at a time , in 1 tablespoon hot cooking oil
3. Remove meat , reserving drippings in pan
4. Cook onion , sweet pepper and garlic in drippings until tender
5. Drain fat
6. Return meat to dutch oven
7. Stir in chipotle chili peppers in adobo sauce
8. Stir in beans , tomatoes , tomato sauce , water , chili powder , basil and black pepper
9. Bring to boiling
10. Reduce heat
11. Simmer , covered , about 1 hour or until the meat is tender

title: delicious easy shepherd s pie
steps:
1. Unwrap frozen peas & carrots and place box on paper towel in microwave oven , cook for 5 minutes to thaw and drain on the towel
2. In nice sized pan over medium heat , add the oil to coat the pan
3. Add meat , garlic , onions & bay leaves
4. Season with a little salt & pepper
5. When the meat is browned , sprinkle with flour and stir while cooking for 3-4 more minutes
6. Stir in beef broth and cook for 2 minutes until mixture starts to thicken
7. Add peas & carrots , parsley & tomatoes
8. If needed you may want to cook down a little uncovered if it seems "too juicy"
9. Remove the bay leaves
10. Spoon evenly in sprayed 9 x 13 pan and cover with mashed potatoes & dot with butter
11. Bake 350f oven for 30 minutes or until potatoes are nice and golden
12. A

title: snickers fudge  microwave
steps:
1. In a microwavable bowl , combine the sugar , cocoa , butter and milk
2. Microwave on high for 3 minutes or until boiling
3. Stir in confectioner's sugar and vanilla
4. Pour into a foil lined greased 8 inch square pan
5. In another microwavable bowl , heat caramels and water on high for 2 minutes or until caramels are melted
6. Stir in peanuts and spread carefully over chocolate layer in pan
7. In a small microwavable bowl , melt chips on high in the microwave for 1 minute or so
8. Carefully spread over caramel nut layer
9. Chill until firm
10. Cut into 1 inch squares
11. Enjoy !

title: easy mini no crust eggplant pizzas
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Cover shallow metal pan with reynolds non stick aluminum paper
3. Spray non stick paper with oil
4. Slice eggplants on the bias about 1 / 4" thick
5. Place slices on pan , sides not touching
6. Top with red sauce
7. Top with shredded cheese
8. Bake about 10-15 minutes until bubbly and eggplant slices are cooked
9. Serve hot or cold

title: chili with beans and beer   crock pot
steps:
1. Cook ground beef in lightly greased large skillet over medium heat until browned , about 8 minutes , crumbling with a fork
2. Combine ground beef and remaining ingredients , except salt and pepper in slow cooker
3. Cover and cok on low for 6-8 hours
4. Season to taste with salt and pepper

title: classic egyptian omelette
steps:
1. Skin and slice the tomatoes
2. Finely chop the onion and lightly fry in the butter in a large frying pan
3. Crush the garlic and add to the onion
4. When lightly browned , add the tomatoes and salt and pepper
5. Cook gently , turning several times , until tomatoes are soft
6. Beat the eggs lightly , add cheese and pour into the frying pan
7. Cook over low heat , periodically loosening egg from sides of pan , until set on one side
8. Turn and cook on reverse side

title: orange pecan tea bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Spray a loaf pan with cooking spray
3. Combine flour and the next 5 ingredients in a large bowl
4. Make a well in center
5. Combine sugar and the next 7 ingredients and whisk into the dry ingredients
6. Pour into the loaf pan
7. Bake 45 minutes until a toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
8. Cool on a wire rack
9. Mix oj and powdered sugar and drizzle over loaf , garnish with toasted pecans

title: one and only coney sauce
steps:
1. Brown meat very well in 10-inch skillet
2. Drain fat
3. Add remaining ingredients , except flour and 1 / 4 cup water , to meat
4. Gently simmer 1 / 2 hour
5. Pour into blender
6. Blend until semi-smooth
7. Return to pan
8. If thicker sauce is desired , mix 2 tablespoons flour with 1 / 4 cup water
9. Add to meat mixture , or leave out for thinner sauce
10. Cook until desired consistency is achieved
11. Pour over steamed hot dogs or loose , cooked ground round heaped into hot dog buns

title: quingombos guisados
steps:
1. Saute okra in the oil over med heat until it turns light brown
2. Turn several times
3. Remove okra with a slotted spoon and set aside on paper towels to drain excess oil
4. Now to the oil add the garlic , onions and peppers
5. Cook over med low for 10 minutes
6. Stir in okra and the remaining ingredients
7. Cook for 15 more minutes
8. Okra should be tender
9. Add water if needed
10. Serve with hot cooked rice
11. From the vegetarian journal

title: butterscotch cookies with burnt butter icing
steps:
1. Cookies
2. Cream butter
3. Add sugar and eggs , cream together
4. Sift flour , baking powder , baking soda , and salt together
5. Add to sugar mixture with sour cream and vanilla
6. Blend in nuts
7. Chill until firm enough to drop onto cookie sheet
8. Bake 10-15 minutes at 400
9. When cool , ice with
10. Burnt butter icing
11. Melt butter until golden brown
12. Blend in confedtioner's sugar and vanilla
13. Stir in 1-2 t hot water until icing spreads smoothly
14. This amount of icing is enough to frost about 30 cookies

title: frozen raspberry margarita
steps:
1. Pour tequila , sting's sour raspberry schnapps , limeade into blender
2. Add ice cubes until about 2 inches from top and blend all together
3. Serve in an unsalted glass

title: beef and bacon casserole
steps:
1. Cut steak into 2
2. 5cm cubes
3. Wrap the bacon in absorbent paper & cook in the microwave for 2 minutes

8. Simmer , covered for 45 minutes

12. Serve

title: chipotle mashed sweet potatoes
steps:
1. Put sweet potatoes in a saucepan
2. Add water to cover
3. Bring to a boil
4. Lower heat and simmer 15 minutes or until tender
5. Drain and return potatoes to pan
6. Add in half-and-half , butter , and juice
7. Mash to desired consistency
8. Cook 2 minutes or until thoroughly heated , stirring constantly
9. Take 2 chilies out of the can and chop them
10. Reserve remaining chiles and sauce for something else
11. Stir chopped chilies , brown sugar , salt , and 1 / 2 teaspoon cinnamon into potato mixture
12. Transfer mixture to a serving bowl and sprinkle remaining cinnamon over the top
13. Serve immediately

title: green beans with bacon and onion
steps:
1. Fry the bacon and onion in skillet
2. When onion is clear add the green beans , juice and all , and pepper
3. Cook until juice is almost gone

title: mango veggie wrap roll up
steps:
1. Spread cream cheese over tortilla and place mango , green onion , carrot , jicama , & bell pepper over 2 / 3 of the tortilla
2. Roll up tightly
3. Gently squeeze rolls to secure the ingredients then cut into 1 / 2 thick slices , or cut in half for a healthy lunch or snack

title: breakfast brunch pigs in a blanket
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 250f
2. Heat pre-cooked sausage links per box directions
3. Microwave the pure maple syrup while preparing the sausage links
4. Thoroughly mix the bisquick mix , milk , egg and blueberries
5. Spray a large non-stick skillet with cooking spray
6. Heat skillet over medium heat
7. Use 2 heaping tablespoons of batter to make each mini pancake
8. Do not over crowd the pan , work in small batches
9. When pancake starts to dry around the edges and bubble , flip and cook on the other side
10. Place cooked pancakes on an oven safe platter and keep warm in the oven while finishing the rest of the pancakes
11. When all pancakes are made , lay 1 cooked , warmed , breakfast sausage link across the middle of each mini pancakes , fold over , and run a toothpick through the pancake and sausage to keep folded
12. Serve with warmed pure maple syrup for dunking and enjoy !

title: caesar green beans
steps:
1. Heat water to boiling in 2-quart saucepan
2. Add beans
3. Heat to boiling
4. Boil uncovered 5 minutes
5. Cover and boil 2 to 5 minutes longer or until crisp tender
6. Drain
7. Toss with dressing
8. Place beans in serving bowl
9. Sprinkle with cranberries

title: grilled fish sandwiches
steps:
1. Brush fillets with lemon or lime juice
2. Rub with desired seasoning evenly on all sides of fish
3. Place the seasoned fillets in a well-greased wire grill basket
4. Grill in the basket over medium heat for 4 to 6 minutes for each 1 / 2-inch thickness of fish or until fish begins to flake easily with a fork
5. Meanwhile , make spread by combining mayo , mustard and honey in a small bowl
6. To serve , spread cut sides of focaccia with the spread
7. On bottom half of focaccia slices , put watercress , tomato , fish , and top slice
8. Serve

title: tuscan style coffeecake
steps:
1. Combine the dough ingredients , mixing and kneading to form a smooth supple dough
2. Place the dough in a bowl , cover , and let it rise abouit 1 hour
3. For the nut and dried fruit fillling: mix 1 cup toasted walnuts , coarsely chopped
4. 3 / 4 cup raisins , 3 / 4 cup golden raisins

6. Shape the dough into a flat ball , and place it in a 9-ionch round pan
7. Cover the pan and allow the loaf to rise for 30 minutes or till it barely crests over the top of the pan
8. Combine the sugar , vanilla , and water
9. Drizzle over the top of the risen bread
10. Bake the bread in a preheated 350-degree over for 35-45 minutes , until it's golden brown and the internal temperature registers 190 degrees
11. Remove it from the oven , wait 5 minutes , then carefully turn it out of the pan
12. Allow it to cool before cutting

title: easy chicken and cheese burger patties  ground chicken or turkey
steps:
1. Take the 1 / 3 of small onion chopped & put in microwave safe bowl with a dash of olive oil & microwave for 1 minute
2. Combine onion with all remaining ingredients in large bowl then shape into 6 patties
3. Grill on bbq or pan fry with 1 tablespoon vegetable oil ) you could also bake these in oven

title: tomato and garlic salad  salat iz pomidorov s chesnokom
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine the vinegar and the garlic and let stand for 30 minutes
2. Place the tomatoes and onion in a salad bowl and sprinkle with the vinegar and garlic mixture
3. Toss with the olive oil and season with salt and pepper
4. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes
5. Sprinkle the salad with the basil and serve

title: graham cracker crumb crust mix
steps:
1. Process 6 or 7 graham crackers in blender or food processor fitted with the metal blade to make fine crumbs
2. You can use a plastic bag and rolling pin just be sure to crush fine
3. Repeat the remaining crackers
4. Stir sugar and cinnamon into cracker crumbs
5. Pour into a 10 cup contatiner with a tight fitting lid
6. Use within 6 months
7. Graham cracker crust:
8. Mix 1 1 / 2 cups cracker crumbs and 1 / 3 cup mellted butter
9. Press mixture over bottom and sided of an 8 or 9 inch pie plate or springform pan
10. Refrigerate 45 minutes before filling

12. Bake for 6 to 8 minutes
13. Cool completely before adding filling
14. Fill as desired

title: meatloaf with fried onions and ranch seasoning
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. In a large bowl , combine meat , eggs , ketchup , heinz 57 , worcestershire sauce , stuffing mix , ranch dressing mix , salt , pepper and fried onions
3. Shape into loaf and fit into 9 x 5 inch loaf pan
4. Bake , covered loosely with foil , at 350f for 50 to 60 minutes , or until meat is thoroughly cooked

4. When done , remove from pan with lightly floured hands and let rest on a lightly floured surface , covered
5. Meanwhile , pour melted butter into ungreased 13x9-inch baking dish
6. Stir in 1 cup brown sugar and corn syrup
7. Spread evenly in pan
8. Sprinkle with pecan halves
9. Roll or pat out dough into a 15x10-inch rectangle on a lightly floured surface
10. Spread 2 tbs
11. Butter over dough
12. In a small bowl , mix all of the chocolate chip filling ingredients and sprinkle over the butter
13. Roll up dough tightly , beginning at the long side
14. Pinch edge of dough into roll to seal
15. Stretch and shape roll to make it as even as possible
16. Cut roll into 15 1 inch slices
17. Place slightly apaprt in pan
18. Cover and let rise in warm place about 30 min or until doubled
19. Heat oven to 350f
20. Bake 30-35 min or until dark brown
21. Immediately turn pan upside down onto heatproof serving platter
22. Let pan remain over buns 1 min
23. Remove pan
24. Let cool and enjoy !

title: rosemary pesto
steps:

title: baked cinnamon bread custard
steps:
1. Arrange bread in a double layer in a lightly greased 9-by-13-inch baking pan
2. Whisk togather eggs , egg yolks and sugar
3. Gradually add milk , half and half and vanilla
4. Pour mixture over bread
5. Bake in a 375-degree oven for 25 to 30 minutes , or until a knife inserted in the center comes out clean
6. Dust with powdered sugar while warm and serve

title: ginger pear crisp
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. In a small bowl , combine pears , cranberries , orange juice or water , the 2 teaspoons finely chopped crystallized ginger , the cinnamon , and vanilla
3. Divide mixture between two 8- to 10-ounce individual baking dishes
4. In another small bowl , stir together oats , brown sugar , and flour
5. Stir in melted butter
6. Sprinkle oat mixture and almonds over pear mixture in baking dishes
7. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until pears are tender and almonds are golden brown

title: berry blue salad
steps:
1. Place greens , blueberries , blue cheese and red onion in a serving bowl
2. In a smaller bowl , whisk together olive oil , orange juice , lemon thyme leaves , shallot if desired , and salt and pepper to taste
3. Toss salad with the dressing and garnish with roasted , sliced almonds

title: flat bread with goat cheese  arugula  and balsamic glaze
steps:
1. In a sauce pan , pour in the vinegar , stir in the brown sugar and simmer until it is thick and reduced to about 1 / 3 , about 10-15 minutes , stirring occasionally
2. Remove from the heat

5. Enjoy !

title: pork vindaloo   pressure cooker
steps:
1. Over medium heat , heat 1 tablespoon oil in pressure cooker
2. Cook onion , stirring often , for 2 minutes
3. Add pork and cumin seeds and cook until pork is lightly browned - 2 to 3 minutes
4. Add water and stir well , making sure to scrape up all fond
5. Add coconut milk and blend in mustard , salt , turmeric , and cayenne
6. Add frozen blocks of spinach and set potatoes on top
7. Lock pressure cooker lid in place and bring to high pressure
8. Lower heat and cook for 15 minutes
9. Slow-release pressure
10. Cut potatoes into smaller pieces and adjust sauce for taste - adding salt , cayenne or mustard as needed

title: italian herbed grilled chicken
steps:
1. Mix mayo and seasonings
2. One hour before grill time , brush both sides of each breast with about half of mixture & return to refrigerator
3. Grill for 6-9 minutes each side generously coating each side with mixture
4. We usually grill 4 minutes , brush & flip then 4 minutes two times each side -- if that makes any sense
5. Great on ciabatta bread as a sammie , try over rice and even the left overs are great sliced up on a salad

title: minute steak gyros
steps:
1. Combine garlic , oregano , coriander , salt and allspice in small bowl

3. Add steaks to spice mixture
4. Cook steaks in oil skillet over medium heat until desired doneness

7. Garnish with onion& chopped tomato
8. Serve with yogurt sauce of 1 / 2 c

11. Chopped onion , and 1 / 4 tsp
12. Salt

title: sans rival
steps:
1. Grease and flour three inverted 18" x 15" cookie sheets and set aside
2. To make the meringue , beat egg whites until soft peaks are formed
3. Gradually add the sugar , beating well after each addition
4. Continue beating until egg whites are very stiff
5. Fold in cashew nuts and vanilla
6. Spread thinly in prepared pans
7. Bake at 300 degrees fahrenheit for 20 minutes or until golden brown
8. Cut wafers down the center if desired
9. Loosen and slide wafers to a flat surface and cool
10. To make the frosting , boil sugar and water until it spins a thread
11. Meanwhile , beat egg yolks until thick
12. Pour syrup into eggyolks in thin streams while beating
13. Cool the eggyolk mixture
14. Cream in the butter
15. Blend in the rum
16. To assemble the sans rival , layer the wafers on top of eachother with frosting in between each layer
17. Cover the top and sides with frosting and sprinkle the top with cashew nuts is desired
18. Served chilled

title: macaroons with corn flakes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Beat the egg whites until stiff
3. Beat in gradually , the salt and sugar
4. Slowly fold in the corn flakes and coconut

7. Bake for 15-20 minutes

title: polenta mini pizzas
steps:
1. Preheat broiler
2. Heat olive oil on griddle or in frying pan on medium / medium high
3. Slice polenta into six 1 / 2 inch rounds
4. Fry polenta according to package directions
5. If there are no directions for frying , fry 5 minutes per side
6. Remove from griddle / pan , and place on a baking sheet
7. Prepare each slice like you would a pizza , layering 1 tablespoon pasta sauce , a basil leaf , 1 tablespoon ricotta , then 1 teaspoon parmesan
8. Broil 2-4 minutes until lightly browned
9. The polenta likes to slide around ! serve

title: baked macaroni and cheese with tomatoes
steps:
1. Cook the macaroni according to the package directions and drain
2. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
3. Spray a large casserole with nonstick cooking spray
4. In a large microwave-safe bowl , combine the macaroni with the butter , beaten egg , and 1 3 / 4 cups of cheese
5. Stir it thoroughly
6. Place the macaroni mixture in the microwave oven on high for about 2 minutes to melt the cheese more thoroughly
7. Mix it well
8. Add the milk , salt , mustard and tomatoes to the macaroni and toss
9. Pour the mixture into the casserole and smooth the top with a spatula
10. Sprinkle it with the remaining cheese and bread crumbs and bake it , uncovered , for 40-45 minutes , or until it is set
11. Serve it immediately , refrigerate it for up to 24 hours , or freeze it for up to 3 months

title: carrot ginger cupcakes with spiced cream cheese frosting
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Prepare cake batter as directed on package using water / milk and 2 eggs
3. Stir in carrots , ginger , 3 / 4 t
4. Cinnamon and walnuts
5. Spoon batter into 24 paper lined muffin cups
6. Bake 15 minutes or until toothpick comes clean
7. Beat cream cheese in medium bowl with wire whisk until smooth
8. Gently stir in whipped topping
9. Spread with reserved 1 / 4 t
10. Cinnamon
11. Refrigerate until ready to serve

title: apple cider vinegar health tonic
steps:

title: coconut pineapple ice cream
steps:
1. Mix coconut milk and pineapple preserves in a bowl with a stick blender
2. This breaks up pineapple pieces in the preserves into a finer texture so they are not so lumpy in the final dish
3. You can do this in the blender if necessary , or if you like chunky bits of pineapple just melt the preserves in the microwave for 30 seconds
4. Mix in the cream of coconut
5. Cover the bowl and place in the refrigerator overnight
6. Freeze the mixture in an ice-cream maker according to the manufacturer's instructions
7. Once the mixture has finished churning , spoon into a container with a tight lid and put it in the freezer for at least an hour to harden before serving

title: steamed new potatoes with parsley and dill
steps:
1. In a steamer set over boiling water , steam the potatoes , covered , for 10 to 12 minutes , or until they are just tender
2. While the potatoes are steaming , in a bowl , stir together the dill , the parsley , butter , sour cream , and the salt and pepper to taste
3. Add the potatoes to the herb mixture and toss them well

title: blackberry and almond bruchetta
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 and bake bread as directed on can and cool 5 minutes
2. Cut ends off loaf and cut crosswise into 24 slices
3. Arrange slices on an ungreased cookie sheet
4. Spray each slice lightly with cooking spray
5. Sprinkle with granulated sugar
6. Return to oven and bake 8 minutes
7. Meanwhile in a small bowl beat cream cheese , almond extractand 1 / 4 cup powdered sugar until well combined
8. Spread cheese mixture on bread top each with 4 blackberries
9. Sprinkle with almonds

title: creamy new orleans pralines
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan , combine the brown sugar , granulated sugar , cream , milk , butter , and salt
2. Cook over medium heat , stirring constantly , to 230f lower heat slightly if the mixture threatens to boil over
3. Add the pecans and continue cooking , stirring constantly , to 236f the mixture should form a soft ball when a little is dropped in cold water
4. Remove from the heat and add vanilla
5. Let stand for about 5 minutes
6. Stir with a wooden spoon until the mixture is thickened and slightly creamy , about 1 to 1 1 / 2 minutes
7. Using a tablespoon or small cookie scoop , spoon the pralines onto a sheet of parchment paper or waxed paper
8. If the mixture becomes grainy , heat and stir over medium heat for a few seconds , or until it can be easily scooped and dropped
9. Optional toasted pecans:
10. Heat oven to 350
11. Spread chopped pecans out on a large baking sheet
12. Bake for about 5 minutes , or until the chopped pecans are lightly browned and aromatic
13. This can also be achieved by microwaving pecans on a microwave-safe plate in 30 second increments

title: basil mojito
steps:
1. Place limon , 5 basil leaves , lime juice , lemon juice and sugar in glass and muddle
2. Add crushed ice and add soda to your taste
3. Garnish with basil leaf

title: mesa grill s spicy bloody mary
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients , except celery spears , in a small pitcher
2. Pour into large glasses filled with ice and garnish with celery spears

title: ww 3 points   impossibly easy breakfast casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. In a non stick skillet sprayed with cooking spray saute chopped onions & peppers
3. Add chopped ham half way through cooking
4. In a 9x13 baking dish pour in frozen hash browns , spread out evenly
5. Sprinkle with salt and pepper or any other seasonings you like
6. Mix in the sauteed veggies & ham
7. Add 1 cup of cheese
8. In a bowl combine the milk , bisquick and eggs
9. Whisk together
10. Pour over the top of the ham , hash brown , cheese mixture
11. Bake uncovered for 40 minutes or until knife inserted in the center comes out clean
12. Sprinkle the rest of the cheese over the top and bake until melted
13. Remove casserole and let stand 5 minutes
14. 3 points per serving
15. Serves 12

title: lime refresher
steps:
1. For each serving , combine lime juice , grenadine , sugar and vanilla in a small glass
2. Stir to partially dissolve sugar
3. Fill glass with ice
4. Pour in club soda
5. Stir , garnish with mint , and serve immediately

title: caramelised pear and rocket  arugula  salad with blue cheese
steps:
1. Place the butter , vinegar and sugar in a frying pan over medium heat
2. When butter is melted add the pear and walnuts and cook for 4-6 minutes until the pear is just soft
3. Place the rocket on serving plates and top with the pear and walnuts
4. Spoon over the pan juices and top with the blue cheese

title: sam s doughnut me sue
steps:
1. Blend cheese , powdered sugar and cream until smooth
2. Put 1 t
3. Hershey's syrup in bottom of a martini glass
4. Dip cut side of each doughnut in kahlua
5. On top of chocolate , place 1 doughnut half , then a big tablespoon of cheese mix , then another doughnut half , then more cheese mix
6. Dust with cocoa powder
7. Refrigerate about an hour before serving
8. Add a squirt of whipped cream on top if it makes you happy
9. Smile !

title: scrambled eggs   indian style
steps:
1. Heat the butter in a skillet , over medium heat , until hot
2. Turn the heat down to med-low , then add the onion and ginger and cook for approximately 5 minute
3. Add the chile , cumin and turmeric and then cook for approximately 1 minute , while stirring
4. Beat the eggs with the yogurt and 1 / 2 t salt , lightly
5. Turn the heat to low and add the eggs to the onion mixture
6. Cook this all , stirring , until the eggs are just set , approximately 12 minutes
7. Stir in the tomatoes , cilantro and salt and pepper , to taste
8. Serve !

title: slow cooker sweet and tangy chicken
steps:
1. In a large bowl , mix together barbecue sauce , pineapple with juice , green bell pepper , onion , and garlic
2. Arrange 4 of the chicken breasts in the bottom of a slow cooker
3. Pour half of the barbecue sauce over the chicken
4. Place remaining chicken in slow cooker , and pour remaining sauce over the top
5. Cover , and cook on low for 8 to 9 hours

title: shortcut nutter butter banana pudding trifle
steps:
1. Place 3 cups milk and vanilla in large bowl
2. Add vanilla instant pudding mix
3. Beat with an electric mixer at medium speed 2 minutes or until thickened
4. Let stand 5 minutes
5. Stir in sour cream
6. Fill a large bowl with ice
7. Place bowl in ice , and let stand , stirring occasionally , 30 minutes or until mixture is thoroughly chilled
8. Meanwhile , cut bananas into 1 / 4-inch slices
9. Break cookies into thirds
10. Spoon half of pudding mixture into a 3-qt
11. Bowl or pitcher
12. Top with bananas and cookies
13. Spoon remaining pudding mixture over bananas and cookies
14. Top with whipped topping
15. Cover and chill 2 to 24 hours

title: curried potato  chicken and avocado salad
steps:
1. Cook potatoes in boiling water until tender , drain and cool
2. Combine with chicken and avocado
3. Dry fry curry paste in a frying pan stirring for 1 minute
4. Combine curry paste , mayonnaise , yoghurt , orange juice and rind
5. Drizzle mayonnaise dressing over potato salad
6. Scatter over orange , mint , coriander and cashews

title: roasted chicken with apricots
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425f
2. Combine first 5 ingredients
3. Rub chicken inside and out with mixture
4. Roast in a 425 oven until golden , turning occasionally to brown all sides
5. Lower heat to 350 , add apricots and sugar to pan juices
6. Baste chicken and apricots with juices and continue roasting 20 minutes or until tender
7. Remove to heated plate , pour juices over and sprinkle with almonds or pistachios

title: yellow squash patties
steps:
1. In a bowl , add the squash , onion , egg and seasonings
2. Mix in the flour alittle at a time , stir until thick enough to drop by spoonfuls
3. In a fry pan , heat oil till hot about 350

5. Serve warm

title: african pearl barley pumpkin pot
steps:
1. Clean the hokkaido squash , remove the seeds and cut into dices

steps:
1. Measure & mix the first 4 ingredients
2. Blend lard by "cutting" it into the flour mixture with a fork
3. Mix until the dough has an oatmeal like quality
4. Add water and mix with fork

6. Roll out on floured surface , making sure to keep surface & rolling pin floured
7. Bake according to directions for your favorite pie

steps:
1. Put a heaped teaspoon of brown sugar into 6 individual ramekins
2. In a large bowl , beat sugar and eggs together until yellow and frothy
3. Bring milk to boil , gradually add it to the egg mixture , beating constantly

5. Pour this mixture into ramekins , place in roasting pan
6. Add enough water to come half way up the sides of the ramekins
7. Bake in a moderate oven , 350 degrees until just set , about 45 minutes
8. To test , stick a skewer into the custard , if it comes out clean , the custard is done
9. Remove from oven and allow to cool

title: lamb with pear tagine
steps:
1. In a large sauce pan gently fry the onion in the olive oil until soft
2. Add lamb , ginger , and coriander to the pan and cook until it changes color
3. Add cumin , black pepper , cinnamon , and water to just cover the meat

steps:
1. Rinse ham in water
2. I find some brands of ham are saltier than others so ham can be soaked in water for one hour to prevent saltiness
3. Pat ham dry and place flat side down in roasting pan

3. Allow to cool
4. Transfer the cooled cauliflower to a salad bowl and add the grape tomatoes , olives , parmesan , and onion
5. Toss well
6. In a small bowl , whisk together the olive oil , pesto , vinegar , salt and pepper
7. Pour the dressing over the cauliflower mixture and toss
8. Allow salad to sit for 1 hour to allow flavors to blend

title: tiramisu with starbucks coffee liqueur
steps:
1. Separate egg whites and yolks into two large bowls
2. Beat egg yolks while gradually adding sugar until smooth and pale in color
3. Fold mascarpone cheese into egg yolks gently
4. In the other bowl , beat egg whites into stiff peaks
5. Fold egg whites into mascarpone cheese mixture gently
6. Refrigerate until ready to assemble tiramisu
7. I brew the espresso like coffee in my coffee machine to save time
8. I use 4 tablespoons of freshly ground espresso beans to 6 oz
9. Water and i usually have to make it in 2-3 batches because the basket in my machine won't hold enough of the grounds to make it all at once
10. I suggest adding the grounds first , then matching that amount with water
11. Combine room temperature espresso with coffee liqueur and set aside
12. To assemble tiramisu:
13. Dip ladyfingers two at a time into coffee mixture for one second on each side , then place immediately into pan
14. Continue until pan is covered in one layer of ladyfingers
15. Spoon half of mascarpone cheese mixture onto ladyfingers in the pan , carefully spreading evenly to sides of pan
16. Repeat with another layer of ladyfingers dipped in coffee mixture , then the remaining mascarpone cheese mixture , making sure to smooth top out evenly
17. Put the unsweetened cocoa powder in to a fine sieve or strainer and tap gently over the tiramisu , covering it with a thin layer of cocoa powder
18. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least one hour , overnight is preferred
19. Just add lots of ice , cream and sugar , then sprinkle cinnamon on top !

title: cool and creamy banana split shakes
steps:
1. Place the first five ingredients in a blender
2. Cover and process until smooth
3. Add ice cream
4. Cover and process until blended
5. Pour into chilled glasses
6. Serve immediately

title: bratwurst chowder
steps:
1. In a large saucepan combine:
2. Brats cut into 1 / 2 inch pieces , potatoes , onions , and salt and pepper
3. Add water , bring to a boil , and then reduce the heat
4. Cover and simmer for an additional 20 minutes until the potatoes are nearly done
5. Now stir in the cabbage and carrots , and cook until they are tender
6. Stir in 2 1 / 2 cups of milk
7. Combine the remaining 1 / 2 cup of milk with the flour
8. Now gradually stir it into the soup to thicken it
9. When the soup has thickened and is bubbly , stir in the cheese until it is melted
10. Enjoy !

title: spicy red eye baked beans
steps:
1. Sort through the beans to make sure there are no little stones and then put them in a large bowl or pot
2. Add enough cold water to cover the beans by 2 inches and let soak overnight
3. Drain the beans well , tilting the colander instead of shaking it to gently extract the water and protect the beans' skins
4. Position a rack in the center of the oven and heat the oven to 300f
5. Melt the butter in a 5- to 6-quart dutch oven over medium heat
6. Add the onion and garlic and cook , stirring occasionally , until softened , 5 to 7 minutes
7. Add the chile powders , cumin , allspice , and 1 / 2 teaspoons pepper
8. Cook , stirring , until aromatic , about 30 seconds
9. Add the broth and ham hock
10. Stir to combine
11. Add the beans and bring just to a simmer
12. Cover and bake until the beans are easy to bite into but still a little mealy in texture , 45 to 60 minutes
13. Stir in the coffee , molasses , ketchup , worcestershire , and oregano
14. Bake , uncovered , until the beans are fully tender , 30 to 60 minutes more
15. Cool to room temperature
16. Discard the oregano stems and the skin from the ham hock
17. Cut the meat off the bone and chop
18. Add the meat to the beans and discard the bone
19. Cover and refrigerate overnight
20. To finish , bring to a simmer , uncovered , over medium heat
21. Reduce the heat to low and continue to simmer until the sauce is reduced to the consistency of thin gravy , stirring occasionally so the bottom doesn't burn , 40 to 60 minutes
22. Stir in the bourbon and season the beans to taste with salt and pepper

title: orange date loaves
steps:
1. In a large mixing bowl stir together flour , sugar , baking powder , orange peel , baking soda , and salt
2. In another mixing bowl stir together eggs , 1 / 2 cup of the thawed orange juice concentrate , the oil , and 1-1 / 2 cups water
3. Add to flour mixture
4. Stir by hand just until combined
5. Fold in dates and nuts
6. Divide mixture evenly between two greased 8"x4"x2" loaf pans
7. Bake in a 350 degree oven for 50 to 55 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near the centers comes out clean
8. Cool in pans for 10 minutes
9. Remove from pans
10. Generously brush tops and sides of loaves with remaining orange juice concentrate
11. Cool thoroughly on wire racks
12. Wrap and store overnight before slicing

title: c hudson s ham   potato casserole
steps:
1. Saute the onion and green pepper in the butter
2. Gradually add flour , milk and mustard
3. Cook until thickened , stirring constantly
4. Put the ham and potatoes in a casserole dish
5. Pour sauce over
6. Season with salt and pepper to taste
7. Top with cheese
8. Bake uncovered in a 350 degree fahrenheit oven for 25 to 30 minutes

title: white chocolate cookies
steps:
1. Combine all wet ingredients
2. Sift all dry ingredients and graduall add to wet mixture
3. Drop tbsp on baking sheet
4. Bake at 325 degrees for 15- 20 minute let cool

title: smoked brisket
steps:
1. Mix / blend all rub ingredients in small food processor or spice grinder
2. Reserve about 1 / 2 cup of the rub
3. Trim brisket of any discolored fat , hard fat , or fat between flat and flap
4. Leave most of the fat cap on one side
5. Apply 1-1 / 2 cups of the rub liberally to both sides of brisket
6. Wrap with plastic wrap or cover on sheet pan
7. Place in refrigerator at least 8 hours or overnight
8. Combine all steam pan ingredients
9. Whisk to combine
10. Reserve 2 cups of sauce
11. Combine this with reserved rub
12. Whisk
13. Use this as the mop sauce
14. Add hardwood chips to smoker box
15. Fill steam pan with preheat smoker to about 200 deg farenheit
16. Place brisket in smoker , fat side up , when smoke is good and thick
17. Mop every 30 to 45 minutes or as needed
18. Maintain smoker box and steam pan
19. If you need more liquid that recipe makes , use apple juice and beer
20. When brisket reaches internal temp of about 145-150 degrees , wrap in double thickness of tin foil
21. Put brisket back in smoker or in an oven
22. Maintain cooking temp between 200 and 225 degrees until internal temp reaches 190-195 degrees
23. Allow brisket to rest in foil pouch on cutting board for 15-20 minutes
24. The meat will stay warm
25. Be careful when unwrapping brisket as there will be a large amount of liquid in the foil pouch
26. This can be discarded or poured over sliced meat

title: chicken spinach lasagna casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. In a large bowl , combine spinach , chicken , cheddar cheese , onion , cornstarch , salt , pepper , soy sauce , soup , sour cream , mushrooms and mayonnaise
3. Put a layer of noodles in the bottom of a greased lasagna pan
4. Spread half of the spinach mixture over noodles
5. Place another layer of noodles on top and cover with remaining spinach mixture
6. Sprinkle parmesan cheese , then pecans on top
7. Bake for 1 hour

title: thai whole grilled fish with sweet   sour glaze
steps:
1. Score each side of the fish with 3-4 small shallow cuts
2. Combine all marinade ingredients and marinate the fish for at least an hour or up to overnight
3. Prepare the glaze: place the oil and garlic in a small saucepan , place on medium heat
4. Simmer until garlic begins to turn golden
5. Strain and let cool
6. In another small pot , combine sugar and vinegar , bring to a boil , and simmer for one minute
7. Add fish sauce , ginger , bell pepper , chili paste , and 3 tbsp of the garlic oil
8. Cook together for 3-5 minutes until sauce reduces slightly
9. Making sure your grill is clean and well-lubricated with plenty of vegetable oil , grill fish over medium heat , approximately 7 minutes per side or until flesh is just opaque at the bone
10. Plate fish and spoon sauce over each fish
11. One small fish is a perfect entre for one person , share larger fish between two people
12. Serves 4

title: double chocolate mint chip cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Melt over hot water , 3 / 4 cup of the mint-chocolate chips
3. Stir until smooth
4. Remove from heat
5. Cool to room temperature
6. In a small bowl , combine flour , baking soda and salt
7. Set aside
8. In a large bowl , combine butter , brown sugar , sugar , and vanilla extract
9. Beat until creamy
10. Add melted chips and egg
11. Beat well
12. Gradually blend in the flour mixture
13. Stir in remaining 3 / 4 cup of mint-chocolate chips and nuts
14. Drop by rounded tablespoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheets
15. Bake at 375 for 8-10 minutes
16. Allow to stand 2-3 minutes
17. Remove from cookie sheets
18. Cool completely on wire racks

title: cornbread and cheese muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Lightly spray muffin cups with nonstick cooking spray
3. In a large bowl , combine cornmeal , flour , baking powder , sugar , and salt
4. Mix well
5. In a separate bowl , combine egg substitute , creamer , and cottage cheese
6. Blend until smooth
7. Using electric mixer , add egg mixture to flour mixture and blend until smooth
8. Fold in shredded cheese and let stand 5 minutes at room temperature
9. Fill muffin cups 3 / 4 full and bake 25 to 30 minutes , until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean

title: chile con queso for the crock pot
steps:
1. Cube cheese , put cheese into crock-pot w / 2 cans of soup and 2 cans of tomatoes
2. Heat on low to melt cheese
3. Brown meat , add meat to cheese mixture
4. Cover and cook on low to keep warm
5. Serve w / tortilla chips

title: buko salad  filipino young coconut   fruit salad
steps:
1. Combine and toss together all ingredients
2. Freeze in the freezer
3. Take it out and enjoy the cold desert

title: maple orange cornish hens
steps:
1. In small saucepan , whisk together maple syrup , orange juice , wine and rosemary
2. Bring to boil
3. Boil for 3 to 5 minutes or until glaze is slightly thickened
4. Let cool slightly
5. Meanwhile , cut wing
6. Using kitchen shears or sharp knife , cut along each side of back bone
7. Discard backbone
8. Cut through breastbone to separate into halves
9. Trim off excess fat and skin
10. Gently loosen skin from each half of hens , leaving skin attached at back side
11. Startinng at breast , ease in orange rind over flesh under skin
12. Place hens , skin side up , on foil-lined baking sheet
13. Sprinkle with salt and pepper
14. Brush with 1 / 3 of glaze
15. Roast in 375 f oven , brushing with glaze twice , for 45 minutes or until browned and juices run clear when hen is pierced
16. Arrange hens on serving platter
17. Garnish with fresh rosemary sprigs and orange slices , if desired

title: reduced sticky chinese chicken
steps:
1. In large bowl , whisk crouton crumbs , garlic powder , and cornstarch
2. Stir in the soy sauce
3. Add chicken and toss until completely coated
4. Cover , refrigerate for at least 30 minutes
5. Heat the oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat
6. Add chicken and cook , covered for 20-25 minutes until nice and crispy and cooked through
7. Turn about 4 / 5 times during cooking to avoid burning
8. Drain on paper towels
9. Serve immediately and enjoy !

title: mars bar cheesecake
steps:
1. Process biscuits in a food processor until the mixture resembles fine breadcrumbs , then add the melted butter and process until combined
2. Press biscuit mixture firmly over the base and side of a round springform cake pan
3. Chill for 30mins or until firm
4. Meanwhile , combine 2 tablespoons cream , brown sugar and extra butter in a small saucepan
5. Stir on low heat for 3-4 minutes , until the sugar dissolves
6. Set aside
7. In a separate saucepan melt the chocolate with 2 tablespoons cream on low heat stirring until smooth
8. Set aside
9. Dissolve gelatin by whisking into water with a fork until dissolved
10. Cool slightly set aside
11. Using an electric mixer , beat the cream cheese and caster sugar together in a bowl until smooth
12. In another bowl whisk remaining cream until soft peaks form
13. Stir gelatin mixture into cheese mixture with mars bars
14. Fold in cream
15. Pour half of cheese mixture into prepared pan and drizzle with half of the caramel and chocolate sauces
16. Pull a skewer backwards and forwards through the mixture several times to create a marbled effect
17. Repeat process with remaining cheese mixture and sauces
18. Cover and chill for 3 hours until set
19. Slice to serve

title: ras el hanout couscous
steps:
1. Place the couscous in a bowl , pour in the sesame seed oil and ras el hanout
2. Stir well by hand until all grains are coated in oil this will help prevent the couscous from clumping
3. If you have the time , steam the couscous as this will further reduce clumping and improve the consistency of the grains
4. Towards the end of the steaming , add the raisins to the boiling water to soak
5. If cooking the couscous by boiling , then pour boiled chicken stock into the bowl , sufficient to cover the grains + 1cm
6. Add the raisins at this stage and stir
7. Cover the bowl to keep the steam inches wait 5 minutes and stir with a fork to loosen the grains
8. Once the couscous is cooked and cooled , stir in the remaining ingredients except the sumac and enough of the coriander to garnish
9. Garnish with sprinkled sumac and finely chopped coriander

title: potato fennel gratin
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Butter inside of a 10x15x2-inch baking dish
3. Remove stalks and core of fennel , slice thinly crosswise
4. Saute fennel and onions in the olive oil and butter on medium heat for about 15 minutes or until tender
5. Peel potatoes , slice thinly
6. Mix potatoes in a bowl with 2 cups cream and 2 cups gruyere , salt , pepper and the sauteed onion / fennel mixture
7. Pour into baking dish , press down to smooth
8. Combine remaining 2 tbl cream and 1 / 2 cup gruyere and sprinkle on top
9. Bake for 1 1 / 2 hours until potatoes are very tender , the top is browned and bubbly
10. Let set for 10-15 minutes before serving

title: chris jericho s  rubbed flat iron steak
steps:
1. Place steak in a shallow baking dish and season with salt
2. Combine all other ingredients and pour over steak , turn to coat , and cover with plastic wrap
3. Let stand at room temperature for 10 minutes
4. Preheat grill for medium / high heat
5. Remove steak from dish , reserving marinade
6. Place meat on grill and cook for 13-15 minutes
7. Brush often with reserved marinade during cooking process
8. When meat reaches desired doneness , remove from heat and allow to sit for a few minutes before slicing

title: za atar focaccia by penzeys
steps:
1. Stir sugar and warm water together in a small bowl
2. Sprinkle yeast over the top
3. Let stand for ten minutes
4. Stir to dissolve yeast
5. Measure flour and salt into large bowl
6. Stir
7. Make a well in the center
8. Add yeast mixture to well
9. Stir with spoon until mixed
10. Make a well once more and add olive oil and water to well
11. Stir
12. Turn out onto floured surface
13. Knead for 9-10 minutes until smooth and elastic
14. Place in greased bowl , turning once to greased top
15. Cover with clean towel
16. Let stand in oven with light on and door closed for 1 to 1 1 / 2 hours until doubled in bulk
17. Punch dough down
18. Place on greased baking sheet
19. Press or roll out into 12 inch circle
20. Makes 1 round flat bread
21. Topping:
22. Make dents with finger in surface
23. Drizzle with olive oil
24. Sprinkle with zatar and sea salt
25. Let stand uncovered for 30 minutes
26. Bake at 400 degrees for about 25 minutes
27. Serve warm or cold , cut in wedges

title: simple horseradish sauce
steps: 1. Blend ingredients , adding more or less horseradish and salt to taste

title: barefoot contessa s creamy cheddar grits
steps:
1. Bring 4 cups of water to a boil in a medium saucepan
2. Add the salt , then slowly add the grits in a thin steady stream
3. Stir constantly with a wooden spoon
4. Reduce heat to low and simmer , stirring occasionally , until grits thicken , 5-7 minutes
5. Add the half and half and butter to the grits and stir
6. Bring to a simmer , stirring occasionally
7. Cover the pot , reduce the heat to low , and cook , stirring occasionally for 45 minutes , until very smooth and creamy
8. Off the heat , stir in the cheddar cheese , green onions , and pepper
9. Season to taste and serve hot

title: another chicken wings recipe
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f degrees
2. Season wings with salt , pepper and garlic powder
3. Place in a shallow baking dish and bake for 15 minutes
4. In a small saucepan , combine ketchup , vinegar , sugar and water
5. Heat , stirring until well blended
6. Brush sauce over wings and continue baking for 20 to 30 minutes , or until wings are tender
7. Remove from oven , and serve

title: asian marinated flank steak
steps:
1. Place all ingredients except for steak in a gallon size zip top bag , and mix well to combine
2. Add steak to bag , remove all of the air , and seal
3. Marinate for up to 24 hours , turning bag occasionally
4. Remove meat from marinade , and grill or broil to desired degree of doneness
5. Thinly slice steak against the grain and serve
6. To oamc , freeze bag for up to 6 months , and pull from freezer at least 24 hours before using
7. You can substitute garlic for the ginger
8. If you like it spicy , add more chili flakes !

title: ham griddle cakes
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine flour and baking powder
2. In another bowl , beat the eggs and milk
3. Stir into dry ingredients just until moistened
4. Fold in ham
5. Pour batter by 1 / 4 cupfuls onto a greased hot griddle
6. Flip when edges begin to brown and cook flipside until golden brown
7. Serve with maple syrup

title: leftover chili recipe
steps:
1. Open your tamales and take the paper off place in the bottom of a basic casserole dish
2. Cut up some cream cheese which i like best , and scatter around on top of tamales -- or spread sour cream
3. Add chopped green onions , corn whatever you like or neither
4. Cover with chili , then top with cheese
5. Then sprinkle crushed corn chips , french fryed onions , or nacho doritos on top -- lightly cover with tin-foil , bake at 350 for about 20 mins or until hot and bubbly uncover for the last 3-5 minutes

title: cloverbloom praline cookies
steps:
1. Cream butter well and add sugar and egg
2. Add flour , vanilla and nuts
3. Mix well
4. Shape into balls the size of a nut and place on buttered cookie sheets
5. Flatten to about 1 / 8-inch thick
6. Bake at 375 for about 12 minutes

title: salsicce al crema   sausage cream sauce
steps:
1. Heat a very large skillet
2. Melt butter and oil , saute onion and garlic until translucent
3. Add sausage meat and spices to the onion mixture and cook on moderate heat for 10-15 minutes , or until the sausage is completely cooked
4. Drain fat
5. Add the cream and reduce by 1 / 3 , this should take about 5 minutes on moderate heat
6. Stir very frequently to ensure that it doesnt stick or burn
7. Taste , adjust seasoning with pepper and whatever you want to add , pour over hot pasta

title: herb marinated pork chops
steps:
1. Brush chops with lemon juice
2. In a small bowl combine oil , herbs and pepper , mix well
3. Rub herb mixture on both sides of chops
4. Arrange in a baking dish , cover and refrigerate 4 hours to overnight
5. Place pork chops on grill about 5 inches over coals , grill 12-15 minutes , turning once
6. Garnish with fresh herbs

title: mom s hungarian goulash
steps:
1. Cut beef into 1-inch pieces and brown in oil
2. Add onions and garlic
3. Mix catsup , worcestershire , vinegar , sugar and seasonings
4. Add to beef
5. Add water and stir
6. Cover and simmer 2 - 2 1 / 2 hours
7. Thicken with flour and water
8. Cook noodles according to package directions
9. Add to beef mixture

title: pineapple marinade       poultry marinades   pork marinades
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together and use immediately or store in airtight container for up to 7 days
2. The longer i kept my chicken in the better -- i also use brown sugar in this recipe which really enhances these flavors together
3. I added some chile pepper flakes that gives it a perfect kick
4. On pork tenderloi
5. I added one teaspoon of cayenne pepper and gave it a little kick
6. Tasted great
7. I boiled the marinade and served it warm alongside the chicken as a sauce
8. Too good to waste ! you will be definitely make this again
9. Very good , cant wait to make it again i let it marinade for 30 minutes next time will let marinade for at least an hour but all in all made my families tummy very satisfied !

title: croatian chicken paprikas
steps:
1. Melt the lard in a pot
2. Add 2 large onions finely minced and saut it until the onion is soft and transparent
3. Chop the chicken into small pieces
4. Than , add chicken pieces and saut it until the meat is white
5. Add wine and saut it for 5 more minutes
6. Than add 3 teaspoons of paprika , salt pepper and caraway seeds
7. Add water to cover the chicken
8. Saut for 50 minutes or until chicken is soft
9. At the end add 2-3 teaspoons of sour cream and cook for 2-5 more minutes
10. Serve with noodles or mashed potatoes , and inevitably white wine
11. As a salad with it i would recommend red beet

title: sorbet de fraises et de framboises   strawberry   raspberry
steps:
1. Hull the fruit , save a dozen whole berries for garnish
2. Liquidize or mash them and pass them through a fine sieve to remove pips
3. Beat in the sugar until dissolved , add water and strained lemon juice and pour into a freezing container
4. Freeze for 40 minutes
5. Remove and beat with a "silver" or "wooden" spoon and freeze again for 4 hours
6. Serve in tall glasses
7. Garnish with whole berries

title: ummy nummy marbled chocolate cheesecake
steps:
1. Combine cookie crumbs and melted butter and press firmly into a 9" springform pan , forming a crust
2. Preheat oven to 300f
3. Using an electric mixer , beat cream cheese until very soft
4. Add sugar and eggs and beat on low to combine , then on medium until very smooth and fluffy
5. Spoon half of the cream cheese mixture into the crust
6. Stir the 2 oz of melted chocolate into the remaining cream cheese mixture and combine well
7. Drizzle the chocolate mixture over the plain cream cheese mixture to create a swirling pattern
8. Do not stir !
9. Bake for 50-55 minutes- watch carefully -when ready , it should no longer be loose & watery looking , but will jiggle only slightly in the center - also , when cooked , the surface will be dull , not shiny - if you need a little extra baking time based on your oven , cook it a little longer , but be careful - if you over bake , it will dry out and start to crack
10. Once cooled completely , cover with plastic and chill at least 2 hours
11. Optional topping: melt a bit of sweetened chocolate , whip some heavy cream and swirl together , adding sugar to taste , and spread over cooled cheesecake just before serving

title: shredded beef enchiladas
steps:
1. Grill or sear the steak , then braise it with the liquid and spices at 300 degrees until it falls apart , about two hours
2. Saut the onions and garlic , add the meat and chiles , mix well
3. Heat the oil over medium heat , heat the tortillas in the oil , about 5 seconds on each side , but not until they are crisp
4. Roll some of the filling in each tortilla
5. Place in a greased pan , seam side down
6. Top with sauce and cheese , and bake at 375 degress until bubbly
7. Enchilada sauce:
8. 5 tbs
9. White flour
10. 5 tbs
11. Cold water
12. 1 / 3 teaspoons sugar
13. 1 pinch ground cinnamon
14. 3 / 4 teaspoons salt
15. 2 heaping teaspoons garlic powder
16. 1 teaspoons ground cumin
17. 4 tbs chili powder
18. 2 cups chicken broth
19. Makes about 2 cups
20. In a 2 quart sauce pan add the chicken broth , chili powder , cumin , garlic powder , salt , cinnamon and sugar (the sugar is a little secret to eliminate
21. Any bitter taste from the chili powder)
22. Use a whisk to mix everything well
23. Heat to a boil , reduce heat to a low boil and cook for 3 minutes
24. Whisk frequently to make sure all spices dissolve
25. This is important for flavor and a nice smooth sauce
26. While the sauce is on a slow simmer / boil , add 5 tablespoons of cold water in a small bowl
27. With another whisk mix 1 tablespoon at a time of flour
28. Whisk vigorously to avoid lumps
29. If you have lumps here , you will definitely have lumps in your sauce
30. After 3 minutes of cooking sauce , turn the heat up to high
31. Very slowly , pour the flour mixture into the boiling sauce
32. Here you must whisk the sauce vigorously while adding the flour to avoid lumps
33. After all the flour is added , continue to whisk for one minute
34. You can turn the heat down to medium during this time
35. Just make sure the sauce is boiling
36. Turn off the heat , this enchilada sauce recipe is done
37. If you do not use the sauce right away , you will notice that as this sauce sits it will form a "skin" on the surface
38. This is normal and in fact the longer the sauce sits the thicker this skin becomes
39. All you have to do is peel the skin off and throw it away

title: pear chutney
steps:
1. Rinse and drain the pears
2. Pat dry with toweling
3. Peel the fruit , core and then chop coarsely , into about 1 / 2-inch pieces
4. Place the fruit in a heavy medium-size saucepan , along with the onions , raisins , ginger , orange or lemon peel , garlic , cinnamon , clove or allspice , red pepper flakes or jalapeno pepper and sugar
5. Stir in the cider vinegar , salt and black pepper and mix well
6. Place the saucepan on medium high heat and bring to a boil , stirring well
7. Then , lower the heat to simmer and continue cooking and stirring the sauce for 1 - 1 1 / 2 hours , or until it is the consistency of thick jam and almost all of the liquid is absorbed
8. Make sure to stir often from the bottom of the pan to prevent it from scorching
9. The chutney is ready when the pears are translucent and the mixture is thick , dark and syrupy
10. Pack the hot chutney into jars , cover with lids and let cool before storing in the refrigerator

title: southern pecan fondant
steps:
1. In a heavy saucepan , combine the sugar and water and cook until mixture registers 234 degrees f on candy thermometer
2. Remove pan from heat and let cool to lukewarm
3. Then beat mixture until it loses its glossiness and becomes stiff
4. Add butter , vanilla , salt and nuts
5. Mix thoroughly
6. Pour into a buttered pan about 1 / 2 inch deep
7. When cool , cut into squares

title: zesty chicken and garlic white pizza
steps:
1. Cook chicken in small saute pan , using enough water to cover and cook until no longer pink inside , approximately 20 minutes
2. Drain and cool slightly , then cut into strips
3. In a separate skillet over medium heat , melt the butter with garlic , onion and basil
4. Pour into a chilled dish to cool , and refrigerate to set
5. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees
6. Roll out the pizza dough , place onto a pizza pan / stone or other appropriate baking sheet and spread the herb-butter mix over the surface using the back of a spoon
7. Arrange chicken on top , then dot with ricotta cheese
8. Top with tomato slices , cilantro , then parmesan cheese
9. Bake for 15-20 minutes in the preheated oven , until crust is browned and center is thoroughly cooked

title: no bake decadent chocolate cheesecake
steps:
1. Make sure all ingredients are at room temperature before you start
2. Melt the butter over a low heat
3. Crush the ginger nut biscuits while the butter is melting
4. Stir crushed biscuits into the melted butter
5. Pour mixture into a 9-inch springform tin and press down evenly to form base for cheesecake
6. Place in fridge to chill
7. Melt chocolate gently in bowl suspended over simmering water
8. Whip double cream til it forms peaks
9. In another bowl mix half the mascarpone and half the yogurt
10. Pour half the melted chocolate into the whipped cream and mix immediately (it is important that the whipped cream is not chilled at this point or the chocolate will set too quickly
11. If this does happen pop into the microwave for 20 seconds the)
12. Pour the rest of the melted chocolate into the mascarpone / yogurt mix and mix immediately
13. Spread the chocolately mascarpone / yogurt mix over the biscuit base
14. Spread the chocolately double cream over the mascarpone / yogurt mix
15. Mix the remainder of the yogurt and mascarpone together and spread over the top of the double cream
16. Chill overnight
17. Decorate with grated chocolate if you wish

title: quick and easy pumpkin pie bars
steps:
1. Combine cake mix from box , melted butter and one of the eggs
2. Beat until combined
3. Set aside one cup of the cake-mix mixture
4. Spread remaining cake mix mixture in an ungreased 13x9-inch baking pan
5. Press to form an even crust
6. In medium mixing bowl , beat together the remaining eggs , the pumpkin , evaporated milk , brown sugar and the 2 1 / 2 teaspoons pumpkin pie spice
7. Pour the pumpkin mixture over crust in prepared pan
8. Combine the reserved cake-mix mixture , the sugar , the 2 tablespoons softened butter and the cinnamon
9. Dot evenly over the pumpkin mixture
10. Bake in a 350 oven for 45 to 50 minutes or until done when tested with toothpick
11. Cool in pan on wire rack
12. Cut into 16 squares and then into triangles
13. Serve with whipped cream with additional pumpkin pie spice sprinkled on top

title: lemon rosemary marinade for lamb
steps:
1. Whisk together garlic , shallots , rosemary , oregano , oil and lemon juice , in a medium non-reactive bowl
2. Use marinade immediately
3. If desired , turn marinade into finishing sauce
4. After removing meat , pour marinade into a non-reactive saucepan , and boil for 3 minutes
5. Brush on cooked meat just before serving
6. Makes enough for 2 pounds of lamb

title: marks awesome strawberry milkshake
steps:
1. Put ice , milk and sugar in blender
2. Cut ends off strawberries
3. Put strawberries in blender
4. Blend for 3 to 5 minutes
5. Enjoy !

title: orange five spice dressing
steps:
1. In a small container combne the juice , pectin , vinegar , soy sauce , sugar and five-spice powder
2. Cover and refrigerator until well chilled
3. Shake and serve over fresh salad greens or mixed fruit

title: jalapeno pepper appetizers
steps:
1. Cut jalapeno peppers in half lengthwise
2. Remove seeds and membranes
3. Rinse
4. Place one heaping teaspoon of cream cheese on each pepper half
5. Place peppers on baking sheet
6. Lined with alumninum foil
7. Sprinkle with bacon and cheddar cheese
8. Bake at 350 degrees for 20-25 minutes
9. Serve immediately

title: the grouper club sandwich
steps:
1. Season the grouper with salt , pepper , and paprika
2. In a medium skillet , heat butter and olive oil over medium heat
3. Sear grouper fillet on both sides , cooking until fish is done throughout
4. Be careful not to overcook
5. Remove from heat and set aside
6. Slice the avocado and squeeze lemon juice over avocado to keep from browning
7. To assemble club , spread mayonnaise on first slice of toast , face up
8. Now place 1 slice tomato , sprouts , and grouper on top
9. Spread mayonnaise on second slice of bread and put on top of grouper , mayonnaise side down
10. Spread mayonnaise on top of second slice
11. Top that with avocado slices , 1 tomato slice , more sprouts , and the turkey or veggie bacon
12. Spread mayonnaise onto third slice of bread and top the sandwich
13. Cut into fourths and place a toothpick in each piece

title: rancher s breakfast pie
steps:
1. Combine eggs and milk in a large bowl
2. Stir in cheese , onion , pepper and bacon
3. Pour into a greased 9-in pie plate
4. Toss potatoes with salt and pepper
5. Sprinkle over egg mixture
6. Drizzle butter over the potatoes
7. Sprinkle with paprika
8. Bake at 325 degrees for 40 minuites or until a knife inserted in center comes out clean

title: skillet steaks with onion gravy
steps:
1. Measure broth in a large measuring cup , whisk in ketchup , worcestershire sauce , mustard and pepper
2. Set aside
3. Heat a large skillet over medium high heat
4. Add steaks
5. Cook for about 4 - 6 minutes on each side remove from skillet cover and keep warm
6. Drain off fat from pan
7. Thinly slice onions
8. Add butter to skillet and melt , then add onions
9. Cook about 3 minutes stirring occasionally
10. Cover and reduce heat to medium low and cook about 5 more minutes
11. Stir in broth mixture and cook until heated through about 2 minutes
12. Pour over steaks and serve immediately

title: little beer
steps:
1. Pour 43 into shot glass and top with cream
2. There's a mini beer head and all the better flavor !

title: paula deen s turtle trifle
steps:
1. Bake brownies according to package
2. Let cool and crumble brownies , set aside
3. In a large saucepan , combine sugar , corn syrup , melted butter and eggs
4. Stir in salt , vanilla and chopped pecans
5. Bring to a boil over medium heat
6. Reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes , stirring frequently
7. Cool completely
8. In a trifle dish layer brownies , pecan mixture , whipped topping , caramel and toasted whole pecans as desired
9. Chill for two hours before serving
10. Can also make mini trifles by using small clear dessert dishes to make individual servings

title: scrambled eggs benedict
steps:
1. Mix sauce as directed on package in 2-cup glass measure
2. Microwave uncovered on high , 1 minute
3. Stir
4. Microwave until mixture boils and thickens , 1 to 1 1 / 2 minutes , stirring every 30 seconds
5. Cover and microwave bacon on high on high until hot , 1 1 / 2 to 2 minutes
6. Beat eggs in 1-quart casserole
7. Beat in milk , green pepper , salt and pepper
8. Cover and microwave on high 2 minutes
9. Stir
10. Cover and microwave until eggs are set but still moist , 1 to 1 1 / 2 minutes
11. Place muffins , cut sides up on serving plate
12. Top each with bacon slices and large spoonful of eggs
13. Spoon sauce over eggs
14. Microwave uncovered on high until hot , 1 to 1 1 / 2 minutes

title: baked fish with mushrooms and cream
steps:
1. Preheat broiler
2. Melt 2 tablespoons butter in heavy large skillet over medium-high heat
3. Add mushrooms
4. Saut until golden , about 7 minutes
5. Add cognac
6. Simmer until liquid reduces to glaze
7. Reduce heat to medium
8. Add tomatoes , cream and thyme
9. Simmer until sauce thickens , stirring occasionally , about 7 minutes
10. Season with salt and pepper
11. Melt remaining 2 tablespoons butter in another heavy large skillet over medium-high heat
12. Season fish with salt and pepper
13. Add fish to skillet
14. Saut until just cooked through , about 3 minutes per side
15. Transfer fish to broiler-proof baking dish
16. Spoon sauce over
17. Sprinkle cheese over
18. Broil until cheese melts , about 2 minutes

title: mixed asparagus peppers saute
steps:
1. Prepare asparagus by peeling , cutting off end and then slice each spear into three
2. Seed and devein peppers and julienne
3. Skin and rough chop clove of garlic
4. Heat non-stick saute or fry pan on medium high heat with oil and butter added
5. When oil butter mixture is hot , put in garlic and saute until just before browned
6. Discard garlic
7. Add asparagus pieces and saute until just cooked
8. They should be heated through , but still with some crunch , about 5 minutes
9. Remove and then add peppers
10. Saute for no more than 2 minutes
11. Serve together , salt and pepper to taste
12. Recipe can be increased easily and add more garlic as you desire !

title: super slow sloppy joes
steps:
1. Brown ground beef , onion and garlic in large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat in two batches , stirring to break up clumps of meat
2. Drain and discard fat
3. In slow cooker , combine ketchup , bell pepper , worcestershire sauce , brown sugar , vinegar , mustard and chili powder
4. Stir in beef mixture
5. Cover
6. Cook on low 6 to 8 hours
7. Spoon onto hamburger buns

title: coriander chicken with tomato corn salad
steps:
1. To prepare the chicken:
2. Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
3. Combine coriander and the next 5 ingredients
4. Rub evenly over both sides of chicken
5. Add chicken to pan
6. Cook 5 minutes on each side or until done
7. To prepare salad:
8. Combine tomatoes and remaining ingredients , tossing well
9. Slice chicken
10. Serve over salad

title: three fruit marmalade
steps:
1. Remove seeds from fruits
2. Put through food grinder
3. Measure and put into large saucepan
4. For each 1 cup pulp , add 3 cups water
5. Bring to a boil , stirring occasionally
6. Simmer for 20 minutes
7. Boil rapidly , stirring 2 or 3 times , for 20 minutes
8. Measure quantity
9. To each 1 cup pulp , add 1 1 / 2 cups sugar
10. Return to a boil , stirring
11. Boil rapidly until thickened and a small amount cooled on a chilled saucer jells
12. This will take about 20 minutes
13. Pour into hot sterilized half pint jars to within 1 / 4 inch of the top
14. Place sterilized metal lids on jars and screw metal bands on securely
15. For added assurance against spoilage , you may choose to process in boiling water bath for 5 minutes

title: red wine braised beef brisket w  horseradish sauce  sara moulton
steps:
1. If using a slow cooker , skip this step entirely: place your oven shelf so your casserole or dutch oven will be in the bottom third of the oven and preheat the oven to 325 degrees f
2. Fill a small saucepan with water , and bring to a boil over high heat
3. Add the garlic cloves , bring back to a boil , and cook rapidly until slightly softened , about 1 minute
4. Use a slotted spoon to transfer the garlic to a bowl of ice water and peel when cool enough to handle
5. Combine the flour , salt , and pepper in a large shallow dish or large platter
6. Coat the brisket on all sides with the seasoned flour and shake off any excess
7. Heat the oil in a large covered casserole or dutch oven over medium-high heat until almost smoking
8. Add the brisket and sear , turning often , until well browned , about 6 to 8 minutes per side
9. Transfer to a plate or platter and pour off all but 2 tablespoons of the fat
10. Add the onions and the peeled garlic
11. Reduce the heat to medium and saute , stirring often , until golden , about 10 minutes
12. Pour in the wine and stir to pick up any browned bits on the bottom of the casserole
13. Stir in the tomato paste and add the bay leaves and thyme
14. Increase the heat to high and bring to a boil
15. Cook rapidly , stirring often , until almost all the liquid has evaporated
16. At this point , if you're using a slow cooker , transfer the contents of the casserole into the slow cooker , set the cooker for time and temperature , add the chicken stock and the brisket , cover tightly with foil and then your cooker's lid , test for doneness with a fork and meanwhile continue to make the sauce
17. If not using a slow cooker , pour in the chicken stock and bring back to a boil
18. Reduce the heat to medium and add the brisket
19. Cover tightly with a piece of foil , then cover the pot with the lid
20. Transfer to the lower third of the oven and cook until a fork comes out easily when pierced , 3 to 4 hours
21. To make the horseradish sauce: mix the horseradish , vinegar , mayonnaise , chives , and lemon juice in a small bowl
22. Stir well to blend and season with salt and pepper
23. You should have about 1 cup -- keep refrigerated until ready to serve
24. Transfer the brisket from the casserole to a cutting surface and cover loosely with foil
25. Let rest for 15 minutes
26. Gently skim the surface of the liquid in the casserole with a spoon to remove as much fat as possible
27. Remove and discard the bay leaves
28. Thinly slice the brisket on an angle , cutting against the grain
29. Arrange the slices on a warmed serving platter or plate and spoon on some of the horseradish cream
30. Serve warm and enjoy the complements !

title: salisbury ground pork meatloaf with apple and sage
steps:
1. Peel and core apple and cut as finely as possible
2. Peel and finely chop the onion
3. In a large bowl place ground pork , apple , onion , breadcrumbs , sage , salt and pepper
4. Mix well
5. Add beaten eggs
6. Hand mix all toghether and shape into loaf
7. Place in pan
