8. Bake for 1 1 / 2 hours at 350f
9. Carefully drain off any fat
10. Serve in thick slices with mustard / cheese sauce

title: portabella and zucchini tacos
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425f on a large rimmed baking sheet , combine mushrooms , water , 1 teaspoon oregano , 1 tablespoon oil , and salt & pepper to taste
2. On another rimmed baking sheet , toss the zucchini & onions with the remaining oregano & oil
3. Season with salt & pepper
4. Roast , tossing occasionally , until veggies are browned and fork-tender , 25-30 minutes
5. Keep an eye on them - the zucchini & onions will be done sooner than the mushrooms
6. When roasting is almost finished , heat a small skillet over medium high heat and warm tortillas briefly on each side
7. This goes very quickly - you want them a bit browned but still nice and soft
8. Wrap warm tortillas in a clean kitchen towel until serving time
9. To serve , pile on the filling and toppings as you wish !

title: classic vinaigrette salad dressing
steps:
1. Whisk all ingredients together
2. Toss with greens , pasta or potato salad

title: perfect butter tarts
steps:
1. Roll out pastry on floured workspace 1 / 8-inch thick and cut into 3 75-inch rounds
2. Use these rounds to line 14 muffin cups
3. Melt butter in small saucepan
4. Remove from heat and stir in corn syrup , brown sugar , raisins , rum and salt
5. Lightly beat the egg and add to raisin mixture
6. Use mixture to fill pastry lined cups 3 / 4 full
7. Bake in 425f oven for 20 minutes or until pastry is golden
8. Remove from oven , run

title: chocolate chip peanut butter cheesecake
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees
2. Prepare a springform pan
3. To make the crust: combine crumbs with melted butter
4. Press into bottom of the prepared pan
5. For the filling: with an electric mixer , combine all ingrediemts
6. Beat for about 5-6 minutes until smooth and creamy
7. Add in chocolate chips
8. Mix to combine
9. Pour into crust
10. Bake until set , about 55-60 minutes
11. Let stand at room temperature for about 15 minutes
12. Meanwhile prepare the topping: blend all topping ingredients together , and spread over cheesecake
13. Bake for another 10 minutes more
14. Let cake cool at room temperature , then refrigerate for 5 or more hours

title: spaghetti on toast
steps:
1. Heat spaghetti in a pan
2. Toast your bread , butter if you like butter
3. Cut toast into diagonal triangles
4. Pour hot spaghetti over your toast
5. Serve

title: triple layer chocolate mousse
steps:
1. Soft mousse: melt chocolate over simmering water of a water bath
2. Whip egg yolks with 1 / 3 cup powdered sugar until pale and airy , place whipped yolks in medium sized bowl
3. Add warm melted chocolate and fold until just mixed
4. Wash bowl and wipe thoroughly
5. Dissolve 1 / 3 cup granulated sugar and 1 / 4 cup water in small pot , bring to a boil , cook to 230 degrees on a candy thermometer
6. While sugar is boiling slowly whip whites to soft peak
7. When sugar is ready , slowly pour into whites while beating at a medium speed in a steady stream
8. Continue to whip until stiff peaks form
9. Spoon whites on top of yolks but do not fold
10. Whip cream and 1 / 3 cup powdered sugar until medium stiff peak , now fold in whites until just mixed
11. Add cream and fold until incorporated
12. Do not over fold
13. Store in refrigerator until ready to use
14. Solid chocolate mousse: melt chocolate hot , over double broiler , heat until it is warm to the touch
15. Whip cream until very soft peaks form
16. Very , very quickly add chocolate to cream and fold in , mixture may look broken but keep folding until everything is smooth , but do not overmix
17. Place in bowl , cover and refrigerate until set
18. To serve: place the two mousses in composition to contrast each other
19. Garnish with chocolate cool whip

title: white chicken chili with cheddar hushpuppy crust
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400f heat oil over medium heat in 10 1 / 2-inch cast iron skillet
2. Add 1 cup onion , garlic , green pepper , cumin and chili powder
3. Saut about 3 to 5 minutes or until vegetables are tender
4. Add remaining filling ingredients
5. Simmer about 10 minutes
6. Beat egg in medium bowl
7. Add milk , butter and cornbread mix
8. Mix well
9. Stir in 1 / 4 cup onion and cheese
10. Pour over chicken chili in skillet
11. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until cornbread is golden brown
12. Top with sour cream , salsa , and / or cilantro , if desired

title: basic vinaigrette
steps:
1. In a small glass bowl whisk together lemon juice , honey , and shallots
2. Still whisking , slowly add the oil in a thin stream
3. Whisk constantly until the dressing is emulsified and season with salt and pepper

title: vanillatini
steps:
1. Dip frozen martini glasses in water and then in vanilla sugar
2. Measure 4 ounces vanilla vodka that has been kept in the freezer into a cocktail shaker that is half full of ice and shake 10 times
3. Add triple sec and swirl a few times then strain into prepared glass
4. Squeeze orange slice to release juice and drop into glass
5. Serve

title: greek feta burgers  light
steps:
1. Preheat grill or grill pan
2. Spray with cooking spray
3. In a nonstick frying pan sprayed with cooking spray , cook mushrooms and onions over medium-high heat for 4 minutes , or until softened and browned
4. Remove from heat
5. Stir in feta
6. In a bowl , stir together beef , chives , oregano , barbecue sauce , breadcrumbs , garlic , and egg
7. Stir in onion mixture
8. Form into 5 patties
9. Grill patties over medium-high heat for 3 to 5 minutes per side , or until cooked through
10. Patties can also be placed on a baking sheet sprayed with cooking spray and baked in centre of preheated 450f / 230c oven for 10 to 15 minutes , or until cooked through , turning once

title: hamburger and yorkshire pudding
steps:
1. ----------yorkshirepudding----------
2. Sift flour and salt together
3. Beat eggs and milk together
4. Gradually add liquid to the flour
5. Beat for two minutes and refrigerate
6. Leave it in the fridge for at least an hour so it is ice cold when you pour it into baking dish
7. -------meatballs-------------
8. Mix all the ingredients together and shape into walnut sized balls
9. In a skillet brown the balls but so not cook through
10. Putting it together: heat oven to 400f degrees
11. Heat the cassorole dish & grease it
12. Pour half of the yorkshire pudding into a 10x6x2 greased casserole dish
13. Scatter the meat balls evenly in the batter
14. Pour over the remaining batter
15. Bake uncovered for about 25-30 minutes
16. The pudding should be puffed up around the meatballs and golden

title: shish tawook grilled chicken
steps:
1. Whisk together the lemon juice , vegetable oil , plain yogurt , garlic , tomato paste , salt , oregano , pepper , allspice , cinnamon , and cardamom in a large bowl
2. Add the chicken and toss to coat
3. Transfer the chicken mixture into a large plastic bag
4. Refrigerate at least 4 hours
5. Preheat an outdoor grill for medium-high heat and lightly oil grate
6. Thread the chicken , onions , and pepper onto metal skewers
7. Cook on preheated grill until the chicken is golden and no longer pink in the center , about 5 minutes each side
8. Sprinkle the parsley over the skewers

title: basil lemon pasta
steps:
1. Cook spaghetti until al dente mix lemon juice , olive oil , and basil in separate jar
2. Strain noodles and place in a large bowl
3. Mix with lemon mixture
4. While still hot , mix in butter in order for it to melt with the pasta
5. Top with cheese
6. To make it more moist , you can add as much of the lemon-oil dressing as you'd like ! just be sure to add an even amount of both to make the sauce :)

title: sesame pork salad
steps:
1. Combine rice , pork , snow peas , cucumber , onion , sesame seeds and red pepper in large bowl
2. Combine broth , vinegar , soy sauce , brown sugar and oils in a small jar with lid
3. Shake well to blend
4. Pour over rice mixture
5. Toss lightly and serve either chilled or at room temperature

title: barley with mushrooms  scotland
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 375 f
2. Cook and stir mushrooms and onions in butter 5 minutes
3. Place in ungreased 1 1 / 2-quart casserole
4. Stir in remaining ingredients
5. Cover and bake at 375 f , stirring once , until barley is tender , about 1 1 / 4 hours

title: chocolate swiss roll
steps:
1. Preheat oven to moderately hot
2. Lightly grease a swiss roll tin & line the base with baking paper , extending the edges over the two long sides
3. Beat the eggs & 1 / 3 cup of the caster sugar with electric beaters until thick & creamy
4. Using a metal spoon , gently fold in the combined sifted flour & cocoa
5. Spread the mixture into the tin & smooth the surface
6. Bake for 10 -12 mins , or until the cake is just set
7. Meanwhile , place a clean tea towel on a work surface , cover with baking paper & sprinkle with the remaining caster sugar
8. When the cake is cooked , turn it out immediately onto the sugar
9. Roll the cake up from the short side - rolling the paper inside the cake
10. Stand the rolled cake on a wire rack for 5 mins , then carefully unroll & allow the cake to cool to room temperature
11. Beat the cream , icing sugar & vanilla essence until stiff peaks form
12. Spread the cream over the cake , leaving a 1 / 2 inch border all the way around
13. Re-roll the cake
14. Place the cake seam-side down onto serving tray
15. Refrigerate until serving - dust with extra icing sugar before serving
16. Cut into slices to serve

title: orange wings
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients , except the chicken wings , in a bowl
2. Add the chicken wings and marinate for several hours
3. Preheat oven to 350f
4. Remove the wings from the marinade
5. I discard the marinade and do not baste the wings during cooking
6. Roast in the oven for 30 to 40 minutes in a , shallow and parchment paper lined , baking tray

title: pink banana bread
steps:
1. Mix yogurt , sugar , crushed pineapple , eggs , flour , baking soda , baking powder , salt , grenadine , bananas , and pecans together
2. Grease bread pan
3. Bake at 375 degrees fahrenheit for 60 minutes or until done

title: french quarter bean soup
steps:
1. Rinse the beans
2. In a dutch oven , combine the beans and enough water to cover
3. Bring to a boil , reduce the heat and simmer for 2 minutes
4. Remove from the heat
5. Cover and let stand 1 hour
6. Drain
7. Add 6 cups fresh water and the ham hocks
8. Bring to a boil and reduce heat
9. Cover and simmer for 1 hour
10. Remove the ham hocks
11. When cool enough to handle , cut off the meat and chop
12. Discard the bones
13. Return the meat to the bean mixture
14. Add the undrained tomatoes , celery , onion , garlic , bay leaves and red pepper , then add the sliced sausage and chicken thighs
15. Bring to a boil
16. Reduce the heat , cover and simmer about 1 hour or until the chicken and beans are tender
17. Remove the chicken thighs and cool slightly
18. Remove the meat from the bones and chop
19. Discard the bones and return the meat to the soup
20. Add the parsley and remove the bay leaves

title: fat free chewy chocolate cookies
steps:
1. Spray cookie sheets with cooking spray
2. In large bowl , combine flour , sugar , cocoa , baking soda and salt
3. Stir in corn syrup and egg white until blended
4. Drop by rounded teaspoon onto prepared cookie sheets
5. Bake at 350 degrees for 7 to 9 minutes or just until set
6. Do not overbake
7. Cool on wire rack

title: sweet potato gravy
steps:
1. Make a dark brown roux , about 3 minutes
2. Add the onions and saute for 5 minutes , or until wilted
3. Stir in the garlic , pecans and water
4. Season with salt and cayenne
5. Bring the liquid to a boil
6. Add the sweet potatoes and blend to make the sauce smooth
7. Stir in the cane syrup and green onions

title: pork stew   thai style
steps:
1. Trim all fat from pork
2. Mix together: teriyaki sauce , rice vinegar and chinese chili sauce , set aside
3. Heat a little oil in a non stick frying pan and sear the meat briefly on both sides
4. Place pork , onions and garlic at the bottom of a crockpot
5. Next , add red bell pepper strips and pour sauce mixture over all
6. Cook in crockpot on low setting 6 to 8 hours
7. Remove meat from crockpot and coarsely chop or slice and place on a heated platter
8. Add peanut butter to liquid in crockpot and stir well
9. Pour over meat on platter and garnish with cilantro , peanuts , green onions and lime wedges
10. Serve over sticky thai rice

title: cheesy turkey and feta stroganoff
steps:
1. Preheat your oven to 375
2. Boil your egg noodles as directed on the package
3. In a medium size pot , add the jar of alfredo sauce , 1 / 2 cup of milk , 8 oz of sour cream , garlic and pepper
4. Heat on low until warm
5. While the sauce is heating up , take your ground turkey and brown it in a frying pan
6. Add the tbsp of season all to the meat while it's browning
7. If you've chosen to add onion , chop up a fresh onion and add it to the ground turkey just before the turkey is fully cooked
8. Add the turkey to your alfredo sauce and stir well
9. Drain your egg noodles and combine with the sauce / meat mix
10. Pour everything into a small casserole dish and top with the shredded mozzarella , then evenly sprinkle on the feta cheese
11. Cook in your oven for about 10 minutes until the top of the cheese is just starting to turn golden brown

title: chicken fried steak with cracked pepper gravy
steps:
1. Prepare the flour spice by blending the flour , salt , pepper , and cayenne
2. Set aside on a plate or wax paper
3. Prepare the batter by mixing the eggs with a whisk , in a large bowl
4. Add the cream , and beer
5. Whisk to blend
6. Set aside
7. In a deep , heavy skillet , heat the oil to 350 degrees
8. While the oil is heating , prepare the round steaks by dredging them in the flour spice , taking care to evenly coat the meat
9. Shake off any excess
10. Dip the meat into the batter , and then again in the flour spice , evenly coating the batter so it is dry on the outside
11. When the oil temperature reaches 350 degrees , gently slide one steak into the hot oil
12. Cook the steak about 5 minutes
13. Turn in , taking care not to break the coating , and cook the meat 5 more minutes , or until the batter is nicely browned
14. Drain the cooked steak on paper towels
15. Repeat with the other steaks
16. Hold the cooked steaks in a 225 degree oven until all four are done
17. Pour cracker-pepper gravy over the steaks and serve
18. Yield: 4 servings
19. Cream gravy melt the butter in a heavy saucepan
20. When the foam goes down , whisk in the flour
21. Continually whisk until the flour cooks , becoming a fragrant light brown
22. Slowly add the milk , continuing to whisk to keep lumps from forming
23. Season with salt and pepper
24. Simmer gravy for 10 minutes to cook and reduce
25. Serve hot

title: fruit salad  the healthy summer dessert
steps:
1. The main idea is to use at least 6 kinds of fruit
2. The quantity you use does not matter
3. The usual base fruit is papaya
4. Don't add anything except fruits ! halve the recipe if you like , and remember that leftovers are great for breakfast ! or process into smoothies !
5. A can of litchies , drained and halved , was one of the ingredients , but the zaar robot slapped me for that so i had to leave it out
6. Litchies are delicious in fruit salad
7. Hard fruits like apple are not really suitable
8. Grapes can be added , or any other soft fuits
9. If granadillas are unobtainable , leave out , but they do lend an exotic flavour
10. We also use ripe guavas or canned guavas , chopped
11. Peel and chop the fresh fruits , but not into small pieces: they should be roughly a small bite each
12. If you added slightly sour fruits you will have to add some sugar
13. Drain any canned fruits , but keep the syrup
14. In a large bowl gently mix the fruits
15. Here you have to eyeball the fruit salad and guess how much juice or syrup you want to add
16. Let's say you decide on 1 1 / 2 cups
17. Add the vanilla to the juice / syrup
18. I'm mentioning "juice" because there are fantastic pure fruit juices available , which can be used instead of the syrup from cans
19. Beware fruits like blueberries , which will stain the entire salad
20. You can , if you like , add a sweet citrussy liqueur like cointreau or van der hum , but usually kids love this dessert so keep that in mind
21. I didn't mention oranges: unless very carefully cleaned and every scrap of white pith removed , they will eventually lend a bitter taste to the fruit salad
22. Berries like strawberries can be used , but tend to go too soft
23. The salad usually stands a few hours or overnight before serving
24. And no , it will not last forever because the soft fruits might go mushy and / or discolour
25. This is ideal for a hot summer's day , after a rich lunch
26. As kids we never ate it with anything , but of course it can be served with ice cream , cream or custard

title: easy layered lasagna casserole
steps:
1. Cook beef , onion , green pepper and garlic in frying pan over medium heat
2. Stir in tomato sauce and bring to a boil
3. Reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes
4. Spread a thin layer of sauce on the bottom of a 9x13 pan
5. Then pour on pasta , then the rest of the sauce , then parmesan , and then top with mozzarella
6. Bake at 350 covered for 15 minutes
7. Then uncovered for another 15 minutes or until bubbly

title: juicer pulp bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Grease a loaf pan or small cake pan
3. Set aside
4. In a medium bowl , whisk together the sugar , milk , egg , oil , honey , vanilla extract) , cinnamon , and cloves
5. In a large bowl , stir together the flour , baking powder , baking soda , and salt
6. Add the milk mixture , then the pulp from juicing
7. Stir with a wooden spoon until combined , but do not overmix
8. Spoon the batter into the prepared pan
9. Bake for 35 to 45 minutes or until a knife inserted into the center comes out clean
10. Cool in the pan for 10 minutes
11. Remove the bread from the pan and cool on a wire rack or cut your cake into pieces
12. The cake is especially nice with cream cheese frosting ! enjoy !

title: roasted chicken with lemon and fresh herbs
steps:
1. Please
2. Preheat oven to 400f , have ready a shallow roasting pan
3. Cut the potatoes , sweet potatoes and parsnips into chunks about one-inch square
4. Place the potatoes , sweet potatoes , parsnips , two onions and 4 of the garlic cloves in the shallow roasting pan
5. Sprinkle generously with coarse salt and freshly ground black pepper , then drizzle with a few teaspoons of olive oil
6. Toss with your hands to coat all the veggies
7. Nestle one sprig of fresh rosemary and one sprig of thyme into the veggies , then set pan aside
8. On a cutting board , quarter one of the lemons into wedges , slice the remaining 2 garlic cloves in half , then place the remaining onion quarters beside them , along with several sprigs of fresh rosemary and fresh thyme
9. Sprinkle these items generously with salt and pepper
10. Traditionally , you salt and pepper the inside of a chicken to be roasted
11. I find this very awkward to do so i salt and pepper what i'm going to stuff inside the bird , instead
12. Now stuff all into the cavity of the chicken and then truss the bird , if desired
13. My grocery store sells birds already trussed so i just have to slip the
14. Place chicken atop the vegetables in the roasting pan
15. Juice the remaining lemon
16. Chop up some fresh rosemary and fresh thyme
17. Rub the juice all over the chicken , then drizzle a couple of tablespoons of olive oil over the bird
18. Sprinkle with the fresh herbs , then the paprika , then the salt and pepper
19. Roast in preheated oven for 40 minutes , then reduce the heat to 375f and continue to roast another 30 minutes or so , until the juices around the thigh run clear
20. A smaller bird may only take another 20 minutes , while a larger bird could require another 40 minutes
21. When chicken is done , remove it to a cutting board and cover with a tent of foil to keep warm
22. Let chicken sit for 15 minutes before carving
23. While chicken is resting , give the veggies a good stir in the roasting pan and return to oven
24. After chicken has rested , carve bird , place on platter , remove veggies from oven , and serve
25. This smells incredible as it roasts , so expect the folks at your dinner table to be extremely eager to dig in !

title: buttermilk coconut cake
steps:
1. Grease and flour two 8-inch or 9-inch round baking pans
2. Preheat oven to 375
3. In medium bowl , stir together flour , baking powder and baking soda
4. In another bowl , beat the shortening and butter with mixer for about 30 seconds , or until softened
5. Add the sugar and vanilla
6. Beat until fluffy
7. Add sugar and vanilla
8. Beat until fluffy
9. Add the egg whites and beat until smooth
10. Add flour mixture and buttermilk alternately , beating on low speed after each addition just until mixture is combined
11. Put in prepared pans and bake at 375 for 25 to 30 minutes or until done when tested with toothpick
12. Cool on wire racks for 10 minutes
13. Remove from pans to cool completely on wire racks
14. For frosting: in small bowl , beat 1 / 2 cup butter until light
15. Gradually add powdered sugar , beating well
16. Beat in milk and vanilla
17. Gradually beat in 3 3 / 4 to 4 cups more powdered sugar until frosting is right consistency for spreading spread frosting between layers and over top and sides
18. Sprinkle top and sides with coconut
19. Let stand for 5 minutes

title: chocolate snowflake cookies  chocolate crinkles   crackles
steps:
1. Combine sugar , oil , and melted chocolate in a large mixing bowl
2. Beat at medium speed of an electric mixer until blended
3. Add eggs and vanilla , mixing well
4. Combine flour , baking powder and salt in a medium bowl
5. Add about one-fourth of dry mixture at a time to chocolate mixture , mixing after each addition
6. Cover and let chill at least 2 hours
7. Shape dough into 1-inch balls , and roll in powdered sugar
8. Place cookies 2 inches apart on lightly greased cookie sheets
9. Bake at 350 degrees f
10. For 10 to 12 minutes
11. Cool on wire racks

title: cheddar cheese apple crisp
steps:
1. Spoon the apple filling into a shallow baking dish
2. Combine the flour , sugar , baking powder , salt and cheese in a bowl
3. Add the melted butter and milk
4. Stir to blend
5. Spoon the"dough"over the filling
6. Bake at 375f for about 30 minutes or until golden brown
7. This will make 6 servings
8. But because it is so good , i usually double the recipe !

title: pan roasted chicken breasts with mushrooms and leeks for two
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Heat 1 tablespoon of oil in a nonstick skillet over medium-low heat
3. Add mushrooms and leeks
4. Stir and cook for 4 minutes or until tender
5. Remove from heat
6. Sprinkle with half the thyme , salt , and pepper
7. Cut a small pocket in the top edge of the side of each chicken breast , but don't cut all the way through the breast
8. Fill pocket with 2-3 tablespoons of the mushroom mixture
9. Season chicken with the remaining thyme , salt , and pepper
10. Heat 1 tablespoon oil in an ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat
11. Brown chicken on both sides
12. Transfer skillet to the oven and roast for 10 minutes or until cooked through
13. Serve with the remaining mushroom-leek mixture

title: lavender mint tea  single serving
steps:
1. If you have a tea ball , place the herbs in it
2. If not , you can brew this in the tea and strain it in a fine strainer after it has brewed
3. Pour the boiling water over the herbs
4. Let steep for 5 minutes
5. Strain , if needed , and serve hot
6. Sweeten , if desired
7. This can also be made as iced tea- double the herbs and let steep in 1 qt of water overnight in the fridge
8. You can add more water , to taste , if it is too strong
9. Again , sweeten , if desired

title: slow cooked cherry pork chops
steps:
1. In a skillet coated with nonstick cooking spray , brown the pork chops over medium heat on both sides
2. Season with salt and pepper
3. In a slow cooker , combine pie filling , lemon juice , bouillion and mace
4. Add pork chops
5. Cover and cook on low for 3-4 hours or until meat is no longer pink

title: family favorite pizza sauce
steps:
1. Mix all together in bowl
2. Let sit at least half an hour before using
3. Doubles great , freezes great too

title: crock pot chicken and herb dumplings
steps:
1. Sprinkle chicken with salt and pepper , place in a crock pot
2. Put all onions into pot
3. Add garlic , marjoram , thyme , bay leaf and wine
4. Cover and cook on low 5 to 6 hours
5. Remove bay leaf
6. Increase heat to high , and stir in sour cream
7. Combine biscuit mix with parsley
8. Add milk to biscuit mix and mix until well moistened
9. Drop dumplings from teaspoon around edge of pot
10. Cover and cook on high for 30 minutes , or until dumplings are done

title: burger rollups
steps:
1. Mix beef and milk
2. Shape into flat , round patties
3. Prepare stuffing per pkg directions
4. Wrap beef patties around 3 t stuffing each
5. Place in baking dish
6. Mix remaining ingredients
7. Pour over beef rolls
8. Bake at 350 for 40 minutes

title: herbed chicken and pasta
steps:
1. Mix oil with basil , parsley , and pepper in a small bowl
2. Heat seasoned oil in a large nonstick skillet over med-high heat
3. Add chicken
4. Saute until chicken is done
5. Pour over cooked pasta and sprinkle with cheese
6. Toss to mix

title: almond coconut joy
steps:
1. In a blender combine coconut milk and sorbet
2. Add the frozen bananas , coconut , coconut and almond extract
3. Blend until smooth and serve

title: zesty herbed carrots
steps:
1. Pour dressing over carrots in a large , nonstick skillet
2. Stir to coat
3. Cover and cook on medium heat for 10-15 minutes , stirring after 5 minutes
4. Remove from heat
5. Stir in parsley and nuts

title: chocolate orange cupcakes
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f
2. Line 12 standard muffin cups with paper liners
3. In a small bowl , stir the cocoa powder into the hot water until it dissolves
4. Set aside
5. Sift the flour , baking powder , baking soda , and salt together into a bowl
6. Using the finest rasps of a hand held grater , grate the zest from the orange into the bowl
7. Set aside
8. In a large bowl , whisk together the eggs and granulated sugar until well combined
9. Whisk in the buttermilk and vanilla , then the dissolved cocoa
10. Whisk in the melted butter , then the dry ingredients
11. Using a tablespoon , divide the batter among the muffin cups filling each about half full
12. Bake until the cupcakes are puffed and a skewer inserted into the center of one comes out clean 15-20 minutes
13. Let cool completely on a wire rack
14. Remove the cupcakes from the pan
15. To make the frosting , melt the chocolate in a double-boiler or in the microwave and let cool to room temperature
16. Meanwhile , using a stand mixer , beat the butter and confectioners' sugar with the paddle on medium speed until creamy and smooth , about 3 minutes
17. Beat in the melted chocolate until combined
18. Fill a pastry bag fitted with a 1 / 2-inch star
19. Refrigerate the cupcakes until 30 minutes before serving to set the frosting

title: butter spritz cookies
steps:
1. Cream butter
2. Add sugar and beat until fluffy
3. Beat in egg and almond extract
4. Blend in flour
5. Divide dough into thirds
6. Add a few drops red food coloring to 1 / 3 , green coloring to 1 / 3 and leave 1 / 3 plain
7. Fill cookie press with each color or combine colors for a rainbow effect
8. Form into desired shapes and decorate
9. Bake at 350 for 8-10 minutes
10. Makes about 4 dozen

title: texas souper pintos
steps:
1. Place beans in dutch oven
2. Cover with water 2 inches above beans
3. Bring to a boil
4. Boil 2 minutes
5. Remove from heat , and let stand for 1 hour
6. Drain and return to dutch oven
7. Add 5 cups water and next 8 ingredients to dutch oven
8. Bring mixture to a boil
9. Add ground chuck , stirring to crumble
10. Cover , reduce heat and simmer , stirring occasionally , 1 hour and 30 minutes
11. Uncover and simmer 30 minutes or until beans are tender and mixture has thickened

title: potato salad with olives and jalapenos
steps:
1. In a large pot combine potatoes , water and 1 / 2 teaspoon salt and bring to a boil
2. Reduce heat and simmer covered for 30 minutes or until potatoes are tender
3. Drain and cool completely
4. Cut potatoes into cubes
5. In a large bowl combine remaining 1 / 4 teaspoon salt the next 3 ingredients
6. Stir in olives , celery and onions
7. Stir in potatoes , eggs and pepper

title: lemon teriyaki chicken  quick and easy
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients , except the chicken , in a skillet
2. Cook on high for 3-4 minutes on the stove
3. Add the chicken
4. Simmer for 30 minutes
5. Serve over rice

title: blue margarita
steps:
1. Rub rim of a margarita or martini glass with lime wedge
2. Dip rim into a shallow dish of coarse salt or sugar
3. Shake off excess and set aside
4. Fill a cocktail shaker with ice cubes
5. Add tequila , blue curacao , lime juice and the 1 / 2 tsp sugar
6. Cover and shake vigorously
7. Strain into the prepared glass
8. Garnish with a citrus twist

title: african orange spice salad
steps: 1. Combine all ingredients in a bowl and serve on lettuce leaves if desired

title: spiced chai tea pudding
steps:
1. In large saucepan , combine water , cloves , cardamom , star anise and ginger
2. Bring to a boil
3. Add tea bags
4. Remove from heat
5. Let steep 10 minutes
6. Remove tea bags
7. In large bowl , combine 1 / 4 cup of the sweetened condensed milk and cornstarch
8. Whisk until well blended
9. Stir in remaining sweetened condensed milk
10. With fine strainer , strain hot tea mixture into milk mixture
11. Stir to mix
12. Discard spices
13. Return tea mixture to same saucepan
14. Cook over medium heat , stirring , until mixture comes to a boil
15. Boil 1 to 2 minutes or until slightly thickened
16. Beat egg yolks in medium bowl
17. Slowly whisk hot pudding into yolks
18. Return mixture to saucepan
19. Bring to a boil over medium heat
20. Boil 30 to 60 seconds , stirring gently
21. Spoon into 6 individual serving dishes
22. Cover
23. Refrigerate 1 to 2 hours
24. Garnish with almonds
25. Store in refrigerator

title: lighter beef stroganoff
steps:
1. Spray a large nonstick skillet with pam
2. Heat over medium-heat
3. Add beef and onion powder
4. Cook until beef is browned and crumbled
5. Drain
6. Remove from skillet and set aside
7. Respray skillet and add broth
8. Saute mushrooms over med-high heat until tender
9. Stir beef back into pan
10. Combine starch and water together
11. Add to skillet and cook until thickened
12. Reduce heat and slowly add sour cream , stirring well
13. Serve over hot noodles

title: capital stew
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300-degrees f
2. In an oven-safe saucepan , brown meat and then season with salt and pepper
3. Stir in wine and consomme
4. Cover tightly and cook in oven for 2 1 / 2 hours
5. On top of stove in seperate pans cook vegetables until done
6. Drain , but save juices
7. When meat is done , transfer meat to an oven-proof serving dish or casserole dish
8. Stir in vegetables
9. Add vegetable juices to meat juices to equal 1 - 1 / 2 cups of liquid and thicken with flour
10. Pour over meat and vegetables and return dish to oven for 15 minutes
11. Sprinkle with parsley , cheese and garlic
12. Reheat meat in serving dish then add vegetables and fnally the parsley / cheese mixture following directions as above

title: peach melba
steps:
1. Reserve 4 peach slices for garnish
2. In a blender or food processor , pure remaining peaches along with the reserved peach syrup and lemon juice
3. Spoon the pure into each of 4 dessert dishes
4. Add scoops of ice cream or sherbet
5. Garnish each dish with cup of the raspberries and a peach slice

title: crystallized candied ginger
steps:
1. Peel the ginger using a sharp-edged teaspoon -- yep that is the easiest way , just scrape it toward you and all comes off
2. In the joints just break apart the pieces to get all the peeling
3. Now slice it in 1 / 4-inch-thick slices -- i used the cuisinart since i was doing so much but you can use a mandoline or sharp knife
4. Place the slices in a large nonreactive saucepan with cold water to cover , bring to a boil and cook for 15 minutes
5. Drain , cover with fresh cold water , boil , and again cook 15 minutes
6. Repeat this blanching process 2 more times , for a total of 4 blanchings in all
7. After the last blanching , drain and cover with 6 cups of fresh cold water and 3 cups of sugar
8. Slowly bring the syrup to a boil , stirring often , then reduce heat and simmer , stirring occasionally , until the ginger is translucent and the syrup is thickened , about 20-30 minutes
9. Watch carefully
10. Remove from heat
11. You now have canton candied ginger and can store it this way for practically forever
12. Or , for crystallized ginger , let stand for about 30 minutes , for the ginger to absorb more syrup
13. Then you can take the pieces of ginger from the syrup and toss it in granulated sugar and put it on a rack to dry , uncovered at room temperature , for at least 8 hours or overnight , until the sugar coating is firm and the slices are no longer sticky
14. This also keeps for at least a year , stored in a cool dry place in an airtight container

title: arabic almond milk
steps:
1. Dissolve the milk powder in the water
2. Allow to come to the boil on low heat
3. Add sugar , almonds and rice powder
4. Stir continusly for 10 minutes
5. Add the cardamom
6. Pour into cups sprinkle ginger if desired
7. Serve hot

title: steak dinner in a crock pot
steps:
1. Place steaks on bottom of crock pot
2. Pour steak sauce over top
3. Take a layer of foil , spray it with canola oil and set oil-side down on steaks
4. Wrap potatoes in foil , set them on top of steaks
5. If using frozen corn , wrap individually in foil , set along side of potatoes
6. Set on low for 6 hours

title: rachael ray s herb roasted turkey breast with pan gravy
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f
2. Oil a roasting pan and set it aside
3. Put the onion into the bowl of a mini food processor
4. Using a vegetable peeler , peel the zest from the lemon in thin strips , being careful not to cut into the bitter white pith
5. Add the lemon zest to the food processor and reserve the whole lemon for another use
6. Chop the onion and lemon zest until fine
7. Add the sage , parsley , olive oil , and 1 teaspoon salt and pulse until it forms a coarse paste
8. Put 2 of the bay leaves and the butter into a small pan and heat over medium-low heat until the butter is bubbling
9. Remove from the heat and set aside
10. Put the turkey breasts on a work surface
11. Carefully run your fingers between the skin and the flesh from 1 end , being careful not to pull it completely off , creating a pocket
12. Season the turkey breasts generously with salt and pepper
13. Stuff half of the herb paste under the skin of each breast , and spread it evenly under the skin
14. Transfer the breasts to the roasting pan , and slide 2 bay leaves underneath each one
15. Using a pastry brush , baste the breasts with half of the bay butter
16. Place the turkey in the oven and immediately decrease the temperature to 400 degrees f
17. After 20 minutes , baste the turkey breasts with the remaining butter , and roast for an additional 20 to 25 minutes , until cooked through , and a thermometer placed in the thickest part of the breast registers 170 degrees f
18. Remove from the oven , transfer to a platter , cover , and let rest for 10 minutes before carving while you make the gravy
19. Put the roasting pan over the burner on medium heat
20. Sprinkle the flour over the pan juices , and cook , stirring , for a few minutes
21. Add the apple brandy , and scrape the pan to lift the bits that are stuck to the bottom
22. Cook for a minute to burn off the alcohol , then , while stirring , pour in the apple cider
23. Bring to a simmer , and stir until thickened
24. Season with salt and pepper
25. Slice the turkey breast on the diagonal , and serve with warm gravy

title: 4 h applesauce nut bread
steps:
1. Preheat over to 350 and grease 1 pound loaf pan
2. Mix dry ingredients
3. Beat egg , add melted butter , and applesauce
4. Add to dry ingredients
5. Fold in nuts
6. Pour into loaf pan and bake 1 hour

title: crock pot curried beef
steps:
1. Combine first 7 ingredients in a crock pot
2. Stir well
3. Stir remaining 4 ingredients in a small bowl and pour over top
4. Cover and cook on low for 8-10 hours or high for 4-5 hours
5. Serve with rice

title: grilled meat skewers with bay leaves
steps:
1. Prepare the grill for a moderately hot fire and place rack about 4 inches from heat
2. If using wood skewers , soak in water while you prepare the meat
3. Toss meat with oil , salt , pepper and garlic
4. Skewer meat alternately with bay leaves
5. If leaves break , secure by pressing between meat chunks
6. Grill meat 2- 5 minutes per side , depending on heat and how well done you like your meat
7. Remove and serve

title: smothered veal
steps:
1. Saute onions in oil till golden
2. Add in garlic and saute an additional minute
3. Add tomatoes with their juices , and spices to onion / garlic mixture
4. Cook approximately 30 minutes on low simer till thickened
5. In a separate saute pan , brown veal in oil till done and drain on paper toweling
6. Top each veal scallop with tomato mixture and use the remainder of the sauce over cooked pasta of your choice

title: taste of india
steps:
1. Blend bananas and ice cubes in a blender until chunky mixture forms
2. Add remaining ingredients and blend until smooth

title: asparagus oregenato
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Place asparagus in 13x9 dish
3. Cover with breadcrumbs , salt , pepper , garlic and parmesan cheese
4. Layer butter on top or sprinkle with olive oil
5. Bake covered for 30 minutes
6. Remove cover and bake 5 more minutes
7. Top should be brown-eat and enjoy !

title: sweet pickle dip for veggies
steps: 1. But all of the above in a blender or food processor until smooth and chill

title: spaghetti sauce with bacon
steps:
1. In a skillet , cook bacon on low heat until done
2. Remove bacon from skillet to a paper-towel covered plate to drain
3. Cook onion in skillet with bacon grease until onion is soft
4. Drain onion
5. Combine bacon , onion , spaghetti sauce , garlic , and cayenne pepper in skillet
6. Simmer for 15 minutes
7. Serve over spaghetti

title: creamy chipotle chicken salad
steps:
1. Cook chicken breasts in water with salt & pepper until very tender
2. Shred chicken & put in medium sized bowl
3. Put the diced onion in with chicken
4. Set aside
5. In a blender or food processor mix mayonnaise , sour cream , and between 3 / 4 to the whole can of chipotle peppers until well blended & smooth
6. The amount of peppers depend , of course , on taste
7. Add mayonnaise mixture to shredded chicken & onion
8. Mix well
9. If you like more moisture in a "salad" type dish add more mayo and sour cream in equal parts to get the consistency you like
10. Serve with low-carb bread , pork rinds , or by itself
11. This will surely help you drink a healthier amount of water ! but don't be afraid , not super hot

title: maquechoux
steps:
1. Shuck the corn and cut the kernels into a bowl
2. Scrape cobs into the same bowl to get all the "milk
3. "
4. Melt the butter in a heavy saucepan over medium -high heat
5. Add all vegetables and saute until onions are transparent
6. Stir in salt and the peppers
7. Add corn and corn "milk" , the sugar and evaporated milk
8. Reduce heat to low , cover and cook until corn is tender , about 15 minutes
9. Adjust seasoning to taste

title: ranch cheese puffs
steps:
1. Mix the first three ingredients
2. Spread mixture on bread slices
3. Broil until puffed and golden

title: orange sour puss
steps:
1. In a shaker with ice , shake the sour puss with the orange juice
2. Serve in a highball with ice and garnish with an orange slice

title: camping   meal in one packages
steps:
1. Lay out 4 sets of double foil approx 12x2-inches or a bit larger
2. Distribute the sausage and veggies evenly between the 4 squares
3. Season to taste and dot with the margarine
4. Start to raise the foil around the filling and add 1 / 4 cup of water to each pkg bring the foil up and around the contents making sure the top and edges are sealed bbq on low for approx 1 / 2 hour

title: butterfinger dip to die for
steps:
1. Mix cream cheese , brown sugar , vanilla extract , and powdered sugar in bowl
2. Eliminate any lumps
3. Slowly fold in chopped candy bar
4. Slice apples and set to side for dipping into your yummy dip
5. If you don't like really sour apples , use a red apple instead of green granny smith apples
6. But the sour and sweet mix is really good

title: taco potatoes
steps:
1. Cut cooked potatoes into bite sized pieces and place in large baking dish
2. Cut butter into small pieces and sprinkle over potatoes
3. Combine all other ingredients except sour cream and parsley and sprinkle over potatoes
4. Heat in 350 degree oven until heated and butter is melted
5. Serve with sour cream and parsley as a garnish

title: spanish style pizza
steps:
1. Place oven rack in lower third of oven
2. Heat oven to 450f
3. In medium bowl , stir together flour , yeast and garlic salt
4. In measuring cup , combine water , olive oil and honey
5. Stir to dissolve honey
6. Stir water mixture into flour mixture until ball forms
7. On floured surface , knead dough 3 to 4 minutes or until resilient and no longer sticky , working in flour from counter as necessary to prevent sticking
8. Cover dough with inverted mixing bowl
9. Let stand 10 minutes
10. Meanwhile , lightly grease 14-inch pizza pan
11. Dust with cornmeal
12. On lightly floured surface , roll dough into 15-inch round
13. Place on pizza pan
14. Spread with sauce
15. Top with bell pepper and onion
16. Bake 8 minutes
17. Sprinkle with cheese
18. Top with chorizo and green olives
19. Bake an additional 4 to 6 minutes or until cheese is melted and crust is golden brown around edges
20. Chorizo is a highly seasoned pork sausage
21. For this recipe , use the smoked links
22. Chorizo can be found in the meat department of the grocery store
23. If you can't find it , substitute any spicy or garlicky smoked sausage

title: stuffed calzones
steps:
1. Heat oven to 425f
2. Lightly grease 2 jellyroll pans
3. Place dough onto lightly floured surface
4. Divide into 4 equal pieces
5. Shape each into ball into a 7-inch circle
6. Divide and spread pizza sauce evenly over each circle
7. Evenly disburse the cheese and ham between the circles leaving a 1 / 2" around the edge
8. Fold circles in half and press edges with tines of a fork
9. Arrange 2 calzones on each prepared pan
10. Prick top with fork
11. Bake 18-20 minutes switching pans halfway through , until lightly browned

title: uncle bill s special cranberry sauce
steps:
1. Wash the cranberries thoroughly in cold water
2. If using frozen cranberries , thaw first
3. In a medium size saucepan , add cranberries , orange juice , water , sugar , orange-pineapple marmalade , cinnamon stick , nutmeg , lemon zest and orange zest
4. Bring mixture to boil
5. Reduce heat and simmer for about 10 minutes or until most of the cranberries pop , stirring occasionally
6. When cooked , discard cinnamon stick
7. Let cool and then store in a glass container with lid or a dish covered with plastic wrap
8. Keep refrigerated
9. Use as required
10. This is for adults only who accept liquor
11. This gives the cranberry sauce a whole new taste
12. This is yum , yummy good

title: ww 4 pt  chicken with peanut dipping sauce
steps:
1. Preheat broiler
2. Place chicken in small broiler pan and broil 4 inches from heat until lightly browned , about 3 minutes
3. Turn and broil until other side is browned and chicken in cooked through
4. About 2 minutes longer depending on the thickness of the breast
5. Set aside to cool
6. Cut into 1 / 2 inch diagonal slices
7. To prepare sauce , in small bowl , whisk together remaining ingredients , except tomatoes and snow peas
8. And 1 teaspoon water
9. Pour into small serving dish
10. To serve , fan chicken and snow peas alternately on serving plate
11. Add cherry tomatoes and sauce

title: dr  oz s tangerine weight orade
steps:
1. Place brewed green tea and remaning ingredients into a pitcher and refrigerate overnight
2. Drink 1 pitcher daily for maximum metabolism-boosting results

title: heart healthy cinnamon rice pudding
steps:
1. In a large , heavy bottomed saucepan , stir together the 2 1 / 2 cups milk and the rice
2. Bring to a boil over high heat , stirring occasionally
3. Reduce heat to medium high and boil for 5-6 minutes or until the mixture begins to thicken , stirring occasionally
4. Stir in the other 1 cup of milk , the cinnamon stick , sugar and lemon zest
5. Increase the heat to high and return to a boil , stirring occasionally
6. Reduce the heat to medium high and boil for 4-5 minutes or until creamy and soupy
7. Remove from the heat
8. Stir in the vanilla and let the mixture stand for 30 minutes to thicken somewhat
9. Before serving , remove the cinnamon stick
10. Sprinkle the individual dishes of pudding with ground cinnamon to your tastes

title: beef pockets  steaks stuffed with mushrooms filling
steps:
1. Using a sharp , pointed knife , make a horizontal cut in each steak without cutting all the way through
2. Season to taste
3. Melt the butter in a medium saucepan and lightly cook the mushrooms , garlic and onion for 5 minutes , until softened
4. Remove from the heat
5. Add the parsley , red wine , breadcrumbs and cream
6. Mix together well
7. Generously fill each pocket of the steaks with the stuffing and use some toothpicks to help keep stuffing in the steaks
8. Grill the steaks for 5 - 15 minutes , until the meat is cooked to taste
9. Serve with potatoes and salad for a wonderful meal !

title: red white and blue trifle
steps:
1. In medium bowl , combine milk and pudding , mix and whisk for 1-2 minutes until smooth
2. Fold in the thawed whipped topping
3. Cut the thawed pound cake into 1 / 2-inch cubes
4. In a large glass bowl , layer 1 / 2 of of the cake cubes , 1 / 2 of the fruit , and 1 / 2 of the pudding mixture
5. Repeat layers
6. Chill at least 2 hours before serving
7. Sprinkle with toasted almonds

title: grilled polenta veggie sandwich
steps:
1. In a nonstick skillet over medium heat warm 3 tablespoons of olive oil
2. Add the eggplant and saute until very soft
3. Season with salt and pepper and transfer to a bowl
4. In the same pan add the onion and saute for 2 minutes
5. Add the bell pepper , zucchini and sun dried tomatoes
6. Season with salt and pepper and saute for 5 minutes
7. Warm a grill pan over medium heat and brush with remaining olive oil and add the polenta slices
8. Grill for 2-3 minutes on each side
9. Serve the eggplant mixture in between two slices of grilled polenta

title: burnt sugar angel food cake
steps:
1. Over med
2. High heat , melt the sugar in a saucepan , stirring constantly
3. Warning: the hot sugar will be overheated at this point and will almost explode when you add the water
4. Be very careful , keeping your face back , and adding the water carefully
5. Add the water , and boil for 7 min's , remove from heat and set aside
6. Prepare the cake according to directions on the box , but substitute 1 / 4 cup of the water with 1 / 4 cup of the prepared sugar syrup
7. Fold the toasted pecans into the batter
8. Without spraying or greasing the pan , pour the cake batter directly into the angel food pan
9. Bake for about 35-40 min's , then remove from pan to cool
10. For icing , beat the icing sugar , butter , cream and remaining syrup together , sprad over the cake
11. You can add more icing sugar or cream to make a nice consistency to spread over the cake

title: diane s roasted pepper salsa
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients , and simmer until reaches desired consistency
2. Ladle into hot pint jars
3. Cap with two piece caps , and process in boiling water bath for 15 minutes
4. Cool and store in cool , dark place

title: cucumber  feta  and mint salad
steps:
1. Peel half the skin of the cucumbers in lengthwise strips and cut them into very thin slices
2. Arrange the slices on a serving platter or individual serving dishes
3. Sprinkle the feta cheese on top , followed by the mint
4. Whisk together the olive oil , lemon juice , salt , and pepper and pour over the salad , or allow diners to serve themselves at the table

title: kentucky deep fryer fried chicken recipe
steps:
1. Pre heat oil in deep fryer to 350f
2. Mix all the ingredients except the oil , breadcrumbs , eggs , and chicken in a large bowl
3. Dip the chicken pieces in the egg and then turn them over in the breadcrumbs
4. Roll them in the spicy flour mixture
5. Heat the oil to 350 degrees f in a deep fryer and drop the chicken pieces in , one at a time with tongs careful not to splash hot oil
6. Fry the chicken for 12 to 15 minutes , until it is golden brown and cooked through
7. Drain on racks for 5 minutes

title: crackers  cream cheese  and pepper jelly
steps:
1. If using brick cream cheese , you can spread the pepper jelly over the entire brick and refrigerate then place on serving plate with wheat crackers
2. Otherwise , just spread desired amount of cream cheese on a cracker , then top with desired amount of pepper jelly
3. Enjoy ! :)

title: bob s mexican rice
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , heat oil over medium-high heat with cover
2. Add rice , fry , stirring until rice is lightly browned , 3-5 minutes
3. Stir in the minced onion , garlic , cumin and salt , fry another minute
4. Add tomatoes with liquid plus the water
5. Bring to a boil , reduce heat to low , cook another 15 minutes , until rice is fluffy and dry

title: old fashioned homemade noodles
steps:
1. Measure flour into bowl and make a "well" in the flour
2. Drop the remaining ingredients into that "well
3. "
4. Work dough until it is stiff
5. Roll very thin
6. Let dry a minimum of two hours then cut into strips
7. You may dry longer
8. Bring boullion to a boil
9. If you are cooking the noodles with meat , you will want to bring the cooked meat to a boil with the broth
10. Add noodles and bring back to full boil
11. Lower heat to low-medium and cover pan
12. Cook covered for 18 - 20 minutes

title: uptown tuna casserole recipe  rachael ray
steps:
1. Bring a large pot of water to a boil for noodles
2. Salt boiling water and cook noodles to al dente
3. While water comes to a boil , place oven rack in center of oven and turn on broiler
4. Heat a large skillet over medium heat with evoo , a turn of the pan , and butter
5. When butter melts into oil , add mushrooms and saut 5 minutes
6. Then add leeks and garlic and allow leeks to wilt , 5-6 minutes
7. Sprinkle flour over leeks and mushrooms and stir 1 minute
8. Then whisk in wine for half a minute , then whisk in milk and half and half or cream and simmer a couple of minute to thicken and reduce sauce
9. Then stir in dijon mustard and season sauce with salt and pepper , to taste
10. Stir in peas , tarragon and tuna , then return sauce to bubble and turn off heat
11. Add cooked noodles to sauce , transfer to a casserole and top with gruyere cheese
12. Pop casserole in oven and broil until bubbly and brown , 3-4 minutes
13. Garnish with chives or parsley and serve immediately

title: kofta
steps:
1. Soak bread with enough water to saturate the whole slice
2. In a food processor add beef , onions , salt , pepper , and bread until it reaches a paste like consistency
3. Form a small amount on wooden skewers that have been soaked in water for at least an hour
4. Cook over a hot grill until cooked

title: tomato and fresh basil soup
steps:
1. Heat the oil and butter in a large saucepan until foaming
2. Add the onion and cook gently for about 5 minutes , stirring , until the onion is softened but not brown
3. Stir in the chopped tomatoes and garlic , then add the stock , white wine and sun-dred tomato paste , with salt and pepper to taste
4. Bring to a boil , then lower the heat , half cover the pan , and simmer gently for 20 minutes , shirring occcasionally to keep the tomatoes from sticking to the bottom of the pan
5. Process the soup with the shredded basil in a blender or food processor , then press through a sieve into a clean pan
6. Add the cream and heat through , stirring
7. Do not allow the soup to approach the boiling point
8. Check the consistency and add more stock if necessary , then season with salt and pepper
9. Pour into heated bowls and garnish with basil
10. Serve at once

title: died   went to pimento cheese heaven  pimiento
steps:
1. Using a hand held mixer , beat cream cheese until soft
2. Add the remaining ingredients and beat until creamy and combined
3. Cover and refrigerate for about an hour

title: oven o rings  onion rings
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 425f
2. Combine the cornmeal and chipotle powder in a shallow bowl
3. Set up two more shallow bowls , filling one with the flour and the other with the buttermilk
4. Dip the onion rings in the buttermilk , then dredge the rings in the flour , tossing them lightly in your hands to remove the excess
5. Dip them once again in the buttermilk , and finally coat them fully with the cornmeal mixture
6. Place the dredged rings on a cookie sheet and bake until crispy , 15 to 18 minutes

title: mango papaya salad
steps:
1. Mix fruits well
2. Sprinkle with the coconut and slivered almonds
3. Chill
4. In a small bowl , blend the mayonnaise and lemon juice
5. Top the salad with the dressing just before serving

title: cream pie  chocolate  coconut  and banana variations
steps:
1. In a microwavable bowl , mix sugar , flour , and salt
2. In a separate bowl , whisk milk and eggs or egg whites
3. Add to dry ingredients
4. Microwave for two minutes and stir
5. Return to microwave for one minute intervals , stirring in between , until custard starts to cook
6. Remove from microwave and add margarine and vanilla
7. Cool slightly and pour into pie crust
8. Cover with wax paper and refrigerate 2 hours before serving
9. Chocolate cream pie: add 1 / 2 cup semi-sweet chocolate chips with margarine and vanilla and mix until chips are completely melted
10. Pour into crust
11. Banana cream pie: slice 2 or 3 bananas into bottom of pie crust before pouring pie filling over top
12. Coconut cream pie: add 1 / 2 cup coconut with margarine and vanilla and pour into pie crust
13. Serve with whipping cream and garnishes of your choice

title: deviled ham sandwich
steps: 1. Grind all the ingredients together

title: better than a can  homemade sloppy joes
steps:
1. To start the sauce: heat a 2 1 / 2-quart nonreactive saucepan over medium heat and , when hot , add the oil
2. When the oil is hot , stir in the onion , green and red pepper , celery and garlic
3. Cook until the vegetables are softened and fragrant , 4 to 5 minutes
4. Stir in the tomato puree , tomato paste , ketchup , vinegar , molasses and worcestershire sauce
5. Bring the mixture to a simmer , reduce heat to very low and simmer with the cover ajar for 1 hour
6. To saut the mushrooms: heat an 8 - 10 inch skillet over high heat and , when hot , add the olive oil
7. When the oil is hot , add the chopped mushrooms and cook , stirring frequently , until the mushrooms are golden , 2 to 3 minutes
8. Remove from the heat and set aside
9. To finish the sauce: after the sauce has simmered 1 hour , add the sauted mushrooms , chopped plum tomatoes , oregano , better than bouillon seasoning and some freshly ground black pepper
10. Return to a simmer and cook with the cover ajar for 30 minutes more
11. To brown ground meat: heat a 10-inch non-reactive deep-sided skillet over medium heat
12. When hot , add the ground meat and break it up with a wooden spatula
13. Cook the meat until separated and no longer pink , about 4 minutes
14. Then remove from the stove and drain out any excess fat from skillet
15. Return skillet to the stove , over low heat
16. Stir in the sauce and bring the mixture to a gentle simmer , uncovered
17. Cook gently until the flavors mingle and the mixture is piping hot throughout , about 10 minutes
18. Add some more freshly ground black pepper and serve immediately
19. To assemble sloppy joes and serve: while the sauce is simmering , open the hamburger buns and spread both opened sides lightly with butter
20. Lay the buns , buttered sides up , on a shallow baking sheet
21. Broil the buns until the buttered sides are nicely toasted
22. Spoon the ground beef mixture lavishly over buns and serve hot
23. If serving 4 , you will need 1 cup of sauce and 1 lb
24. Of ground beef
25. The remaining sauce can be frozen for later use and ease
26. Freeze cooled sauce in tightly sealed containers

title: grinch martini
steps:
1. Pour the ingredients into a martini shaker with ice
2. Shake well
3. Strain into a chilled martini glass
4. Garnish with a maraschino cherry

title: tuna olive mousse
steps:
1. Sprinkle gelatin over lemon juice and 1 / 4 cup cold water in a small bowl
2. Let stand 5 minutes to soften
3. Set bowl in pan of boiling water and stir to dissolve gelatin
4. Combine tuna with gelatin , vinegar , mayonnaise , sour cream , chopped olives
5. Mix very well and turn into a 4 or 4 1 / 2cup mold
6. Refrigerate overnight
7. Unmold on salad greens and garnish with whole olives and tomato wedges

title: sophisticated grilled cheese
steps:
1. Heat a sprayed nonstick skillet over medium-high
2. Saut onion
3. Add spices to taste
4. When softened , dump onions out of skillet and set aside
5. Spray pan again
6. Put both slices of bread on skillet
7. Place one cheese slice on one and one on the other
8. Let cheese melt
9. Place spinach evenly on one slice and pile onions on other
10. Sandwich the two slices together and continue cooking to desired doneness
11. Munch away !
12. I suggest heating a little tomato sauce and using as a dip or use tomato soup

title: salsa cheeseburgers
steps:
1. In a bowl beat eggs and mix in all ingredients except beef
2. Mix in beef and shape into six 1 / 2-inch patties
3. Cook over medium heat , about 5 minutes per side
4. Add cheese during the last 3 minutes of cooking

title: the wedge salad
steps:
1. Cut a chilled head of lettuce into 4 or 6 wedges , depending on the size of the head
2. Put each wedge on it own individual plate
3. Drizzle bleu cheese dressing over the wedge
4. Decorate the wedge with tomato chunks and bacon pieces and serve
5. Keep the wedges on their own plates in the fridge to keep chilled
6. On the table , place a pitcher of dressing
7. In bowls with serving spoons , put the bacon and tomatoes
8. At the proper time , deliver the wedges to your guests and l4et them dress their own wedge
9. They'll really enjoy this !
10. Another
11. I like to add shredded sharp cheddar cheese , for example
12. Other possibilities include sliced black olives , or sliced green onions
13. You'll think of other possibilities

title: tagalongs
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. In a large mixing bowl , cream together butter and sugar
3. Mix in flour , baking powder and salt at a low speed , followed by the vanilla and milk
4. The dough should come together into a soft ball but it will be crumbly
5. Take a tablespoon full of dough and flatten it into a disc about 1 / 4-inch thick
6. I found it was easiest doing this in the palm of my hand
7. Place on a parchment-lined baking sheet and repeat with remaining dough
8. Cookies will not spread too much , so you can squeeze them in more than you would for chocolate chip cookies
9. Bake cookies for 9 minutes , until bottoms and the edges are lightly browned and cookies are set
10. Immediately after removing cookies from the oven , use your thumb or a small spoon to make a depression in the center of each cookie
11. Cool for a few minutes on the baking sheet then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely
12. In a small bowl , whisk together peanut butter , confectioners sugar , salt and vanilla
13. When the mixture has come together , heat it in the microwave for 30 to 45 seconds at a time , then stir
14. Heat until it is very , very soft
15. Let cool slightly and spoon a generous dome of the filling into each cookies thumbprint
16. Alternately you could use a piping bag but i did not find this necessary
17. Chill cookies with filling for 20-30 minutes , or until the peanut butter is firm
18. Melt the chocolate and butter in a small double boiler until melted
19. Dip chilled cookies into chocolate with a fork , allowing theexcess to drip off , and place on a sheet of parchment paper to let the cookies set

title: tuna and sweet corn melts
steps:
1. Preheat grill on high
2. Grill bread for 2 minutes each side or until lightly browned
3. Combine tuna , corn , cheese , mayonnaise and parsley in a bowl
4. Top toast with tuna mixture
5. Season with pepper
6. Grill for 3 minutes or until cheese is melted
7. Serve

title: spicy tempeh crepes with a savoury carrot cream sauce
steps:
1. Slice tempeh thinly across the cake
2. Combine all marinade ingredients in a big bowl and add tempeh to the marinade
3. Cover and refrigerate for 20 minutes
4. While the tempeh is marinating , prepare the crepes: whisk the crepe ingredients together in big bowl
5. Heat a 8-inch non-stick skiller over high heat and coat it with nonstick cooking spray
6. Pour 1 / 2 cup of crepe batter into the pan
7. Tilt the pan to coat the surface evenly with batter
8. Cook for 1 minute , or until bottom is lightly browned and the edges start to slightly pull away from the pan
9. Flip crepe with a large spatula and cook 20 seconds on the other side
10. Repeat procedure until crepe batter is consumed
11. Recipe should yield 12 crepes from an 8 inch skillet
12. Crepes can be stacked and covered with a kitchen towel until ready to use
13. Begin the carrot sauce and the tempeh at the same time so the components will be ready to assemble at the same time
14. Prepare the carrot sauce: heat oil in heavy saucepan over medium high heat
15. Add carrot , onion and garlic and saute for 5 minutes
16. Add heavy cream and bring to a boil
17. Add salt and pepper and simmer 15 minutes or until mixture is slightly reduced and thickened
18. Remove from heat and whiz the mixture using either a stick blender or a stand blender until the sauce is smooth
19. Cook tempeh and vegetables: heat 1 / 3 cup vegetable oil in large saute pan
20. Add tempeh with marinade , asparagus , shiitake mushrooms and minced garlic
21. Simmer for 20 minutes
22. Add salt and pepper to taste
23. Assemble crepes: lay crepes out on your clean work surface , divide tempeh mixture equally among crepes , spooning mixture onto center of crepes and folding edges over the filling
24. Transfer crepes to serving plates
25. Spoon the hot carrot sauce around filled crepes
26. Sprinkle the chopped peanuts over the finished crepes and garnish each plate with a wedge of lime
27. For vegetarian do not use the chicken broth

title: mushroom antipasto salad
steps:
1. Place mushrooms in a large bowl
2. Combine oil , vinegar , mustard , sugar and salt and pepper in a screw-top jar
3. Shake well to combine
4. Pour dressing over mushrooms and toss well to coat mushrooms in mixture
5. Cover and set aside for 30 minutes , stirring every 10 minutes
6. Just before serving add remaining ingredients and toss gently to combine

title: supu ya kuku  chicken soup of zanzibar
steps:
1. Sautee first 5 ingredients
2. Add remaining ingredients
3. Simmer gently for 1 hour or until meat is tender
4. Remove the fowl
5. Cut 1 cup of the meat in 1 / 2 inch cubes and add to the soup
6. Correct the seasonings to your taste

title: shrimp and chorizo in adobo
steps:
1. For the adobo sauce: combine the ingredients in a bowl
2. Adjust the sugar taste to your liking
3. For the shrimp and chorizo: coat the shrimp with cornstarch
4. Heat the oil in a pan over medium heatand saute the onions and chorizo
5. Add shrimp
6. When the shrimp are opaque and form a c shape , add the adobo sauce
7. Continue cooking on low until the sauce is heated through
8. Serve over rice and garnish with cilantro and sliced roma tomatoes

title: white chocolate cheesecake with cocoa almond crust
steps:
1. Combine first 6 ingredients
2. Stir well
3. Firmly press crumb mixture on bottom and 2 inches up sides of a 9 inch springform pan
4. Bake at 350 degrees for 8 minutes
5. Cool in pan on a wire rack
6. Combine white chocolate and 1 / 2 cup whipping cream in top of a double boiler
7. Bring water to a boil
8. Reduce heat to low
9. Cook until white chocolate melts , stirring occasionally
10. Let cool
11. Beat cream chees at medium speed of an electric mixer until fluffy
12. Gradually add 3 / 4 cup plus 2 tablespoons sugaar , beating well
13. Add remaining 1 / 4 cup whipping cream , beating well
14. Add egg yolks , one at a time , beating after each addition
15. Stir in white chocolate mixture and 1 teaspoon vanilla
16. Beat egg whites at high speed until stiff peaks form
17. Fold into cream cheese mixture
18. Pour batter into prepared crust
19. Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes
20. Remove from oven and let cool 15 minutes in pan on a wire rack
21. Increase oven temperature to 475 degrees
22. Combine sour cream , 1 / 4 cup sugar and 1 teaspoon vanilla
23. Stir well
24. Pour over cheesecake , leaving a 3 / 4 inch border on edge of cheesecake
25. Return to oven and bank an additional 7 minutes
26. Cool to room temperature in pan on a wire rack
27. Chill at least 8 hours
28. Garnish with chocolate curls if desired

title: meat fondue sauces
steps:
1. Melt butter in skillet
2. Add water and heat to boiling
3. Add past of soy sauce and cornstarch and cook til thick and clear
4. Serve warm
5. Auroe sauce:combine ingredients and refrigerate til serving
6. Dill sauce:combine ingredients
7. Refrigerate til serving

title: minty peas   onions
steps:
1. In a large skillet , melt butter or margarine over medium or medium-low heat
2. Cook butter until nut brown in color-about 7 minutes
3. Add peas , onion slivers , salt , pepper , sugar , and mint leaves
4. Cook until onion is wilted and transparent and peas are tender , approximately 10 minutes
5. Serve immediately
6. Variation: you may substitute some fresh tarragon and orange zest for the mint- measure to taste

title: strawberry jam coffee cake
steps:
1. Beat cream cheese and butter at medium speed of an electric mixer until creamy
2. Gradually add 3 / 4 cup sugar , beating well
3. Combine eggs , milk , and vanilla
4. Add to the cream cheese mixture
5. Beat well
6. Combine the flour and next 3 ingredients
7. Add to the cream cheese mixture , mixing at low speed until blended
8. Spoon half of the batter into a greased and floured 13x9x2 inch pan
9. Combine the strawberry preserves and lemon juice
10. Spread over the batter in the pan
11. Dollop the remaining batter over the strawberry mixture
12. Combine the pecans and brown sugar
13. Sprinkle over the batter in the pan
14. Bake at 350 degrees for 35 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in the center comes out clean
15. Let cool for 15 minutes before serving
16. Cut into squares to serve

title: no bake lemon cheese cake
steps:
1. Line a 25cm deep pie plate with alfoil overlapping around the edges
2. Crush biscuits into fine crumbs
3. Mix in melted butter and combine well
4. Reserve 2 tablespoons of crumbs for decoration if wanted
5. Press rest or all of crumbs into pie plate , pressing down firmly
6. Refrigerate for 30 minutes to help set
7. Into a mixing bowl put in cream cheese , condensed milk , lemon juice and lemon rind if using and mix thoroughly until well blended
8. Mix water and gelatine until gelatine is dissolved and add to cream cheese mixture
9. Pour into prepared chilled shell
10. Decorate with reserved crumbs or nutmeg
11. Chill for 4 hours to fully set
12. Variation -
13. For a chocolate version omit lemon juice and rind and add 125 grams of melted chocolate to cheese mix and use plain chocolate biscuits for base and decorate with grated chocolate or curls
14. To remove from pie plate lift out by edges of alfoil and transfer to serving plate

title: latin black bean soup
steps:
1. Sort and wash black beans
2. Boil in water for 2 minutes
3. Let rest 45 minutes
4. Add onion , garlic , green pepper , oregano , and cumin
5. Cover and cook on low for 1 and 1 / 2 hours
6. Add tomato pate , vinegar and tamari
7. Cook 30 minutes
8. Add chillis , rice , tabasco , and cilantro
9. Cook 10 minutes more

title: pioneer point potatoes
steps:
1. Mix potatoes , sour cream , green onions , 1 1 / 2 cups cheese and salt and pepper
2. Spread in large baking pan and top with remaining cheese
3. Cover and refridgerate overnight
4. To cook , uncover and bake in a 350 degree oven until top is melted and starting to brown

title: crock pot peanut clusters
steps:
1. Put all ingredients in crock pot
2. Cover and cook on high for 1 hour
3. Do not stir
4. Turn crock pot to low and stir every 15 minutes for 1 hour longer
5. Drop on waxed paper and let cool
6. Store candy in a tightly covered container

title: quick oat bran and banana muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Grease 12 muffin cups or use muffin liners
3. Combine first 6 ingredients in a large bowl
4. Put milk , oil , egg and vanilla in medium bowl and whisk to blend
5. Add milk mixture to dry ingredients , stirring just until combined
6. Mix in banana , being careful not to overmix
7. Divide batter evenly among muffin cups
8. Bake about 20 minutes , or until toothpick inserted into centers of muffins comes out clean
9. Transfer to rack to cool

title: spinach salad in parmesan frico cups  giada de laurentiis
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f
2. Citrus vinaigrette: combine all the ingredients in a jar or a tight-sealing plastic container
3. Shake to blend
4. Frico cups: place a sheet of parchment paper on a baking sheet
5. Place 4 mounds of parmesan cheese on the mat and gently tap down until each mound is flat and about 5 inches in diameter
6. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes , until golden and bubbly
7. Meanwhile , invert a muffin pan onto the counter
8. Working quickly , use a thin spatula to transfer each of the frico onto the inverted muffin tin
9. Let cool until firm , about 5 minutes
10. Salad & assembly: in a large bowl , combine all the spinach salad ingredients
11. Drizzle with the vinaigrette and toss to combine
12. Divide the salad among the parmesan frico cups
13. Serve immediately

title: turkey buns
steps:
1. Mix together first 6 ingredients
2. Season with salt and pepper to taste
3. Moisten with more mayo if necessary
4. Fill rolls or buns , wrap in foil and bake at 400 for 15- 20 minutes
5. Orpile on french bread and broil til hot and bubbly

title: baked tomato
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f and spray a baking pan with cooking spray
2. Place the tomatoes cut side up on the pan and sprinkle evenly with the black pepper , garlic powder , parmesan and then the oregano
3. Bake until the tomatoes are tender but not squishy
4. Approximately 8-10 minutes depending on the size and ripeness of the tomatoes

title: salmon a la king casserole
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375f
2. Spray 12 x 8 inch glass baking dish with nonstick cooking spray
3. In medium saucepan , combine alfredo sauce , peas and mushrooms
4. Cook over medium heat until bubbly
5. Remove from heat
6. Gently sir in salmon and pimientos
7. Pour into sprayed baking dish
8. Unroll crescent roll dough into 2 long rectangles
9. Press edges and perforations to form 1 rectangle
10. Place over salmon mixture in baking dish
11. Bake at for 12 to 18 minutes or until crust is golden brown

title: scrambled egg muffins
steps:
1. Brown sausage
2. Drain well
3. Preheat oven to 350
4. In a bowl , beat eggs , then add onion , green peppers , salt , pepper and garlic powder
5. Stir in sausage and cheese
6. Spoon 1 / 3 cupfuls into greased muffin cups
7. Bake at 350 for 20-25 minutes or until a knife inserted comes out clean

title: shames popeye s red beans   rice
steps:
1. Start rice in a rice cooker
2. Saute onion and garlic in a pot in olive oil
3. Add smoke and ground / diced meats , give a spin around the pot to release juices and add beans , spices and water
4. Cover and cook on low 40 minutes when you next view their should be a broth in with the beans
5. Turn off burner and get out a hand masher
6. Mash the beans and meat mixture down and then grind the trapped beans around in a circle
7. When 2 / 3 of the mix is smooth spoon over rice and serve

title: garlic rosemary roasted chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450f
2. Remove and discard giblets and neck from chicken
3. Rinse chicken under cold water
4. Pat dry
5. Trim excess fat
6. Starting at neck cavity , loosen skin from breast and drumsticks by inserting fingers and gently pushing fingers between skin and meat
7. Place rosemary and crushed garlic beneath skin of breast and drumsticks
8. Lift wing
9. Place chicken , breast side up , on a broiler pan
10. Cut a thin slice from end of each onion
11. Remove white papery skins from garlic heads
12. Cut tops off garlic heads , leaving root end intact
13. Insert meat thermometer into meaty part of thigh , making sure not to touch bone
14. Bake at 450f for 30 minutes
15. Brush onions and garlic heads with olive oil
16. Arrange onions and garlic heads around chicken
17. Reduce oven temperature to 350f , bake an additional 1 hour 15 minutes or until meat thermometer registers 180f
18. Cover chicken loosely with foil
19. Let stand 10 minutes
20. Discard skin from chicken
21. Squeeze roasted heads of garlic to extract pulp
22. Serve as a spread on french bread , if desired

title: thoroughbread pie
steps:
1. Beat the eggs
2. Add to them the sugars , vanilla , bourbon , corn syrup , butter and flour
3. Mix well
4. Distribute nuts and chips in the bottom of the pie shell
5. Pour the filling on top
6. Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes

title: quinoa pilaf  upma   pressure cooker
steps:
1. Put all the ingredients into a pressure cooker
2. Stir once
3. Cook on medium to medium-high heat
4. After three whistles , remove from heat
5. After the pressure reduces , open
6. Garnish with chopped coriander leaves
7. Serve hot with chutney

title: lighter cheesecake  cream cheese  fruit dip  ww core
steps:
1. Mix two ingredients together using an electric mixer
2. Refrigerate
3. Serve with desired fruit

title: berry nachos
steps:
1. Cut flour tortillas into quarters and deep fry until crispy mix cinnamon and sugar in plastic bag and shake hot chips until evenly coated
2. Decorate 4 small plates with caramel and chocolate syrup
3. Place 4 chips on each plate
4. Slightly warm hot fudge sauce and spread a heaping spoonful on each chip
5. Place sliced strawberries evenly over chips
6. Sprinkle blueberries and raspberries over all , saving 16 raspberries for garnish
7. Using the can of whipped cream , put a nice decorative squirt of whipped cream on each chip
8. Put a reserved raspberry on top of each
9. Drizzle a small amount of chocolate and caramel syrup over all

title: ginger honey chicken
steps:
1. Set oven to 425 degrees
2. Grease a large cookie sheet with cooking spray
3. To prepare the ginger-honey sauce: in a med-large saucepan mix the water , soy sauce , ginger , brown sugar and honey
4. Bring to a boil and simmer for 10 minutes
5. Remove from heat , and set aside
6. Salt and pepper the chicken pieces , and place on the cookie sheet
7. Bake chicken for 40 minutes at 425 degrees
8. Remove from oven
9. Bring the ginger-honey sauce back to a simmer on top of the stove
10. Mix the cornstarch with the cold water to make a paste
11. Add to the sauce , and simmer , stirring until thickened
12. Transfer the chicken to a large casserole dish
13. Pour the sauce over the chicken
14. Mix with a wooden spoon to coat the chicken
15. Bake in the oven for about 20 minutes , or until the chicken is very tender -- delicious !
16. Serve with rice

title: chocolate cheesecake no bake pie
steps:
1. Beat the first five ingredients together until combined and fluffy
2. Spoon into pie shell and refrigerate for 1 hour

title: zero points value roasted green beans and fresh tomato
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450f
2. Coat a large roasting pan with cooking spray
3. Place green beans in a single layer in prepared pan and coat with cooking spray
4. Roast until desired doneness , stirring once or twice , about 10 to 15 minutes , 25 minutes if using frozen
5. Meanwhile , in a medium bowl , combine tomatoes , basil , garlic , salt and pepper
6. Set aside
7. When green beans are finished , remove from oven and spoon tomato mixture into pan
8. Toss thoroughly
9. Serve hot , room temperature or chilled
10. Yields about 1 cup per serving

title: great garlic bread
steps:
1. Blend together all ingredients and spread evenly on cut sides of bread
2. Put the bread sides back toghether in the original shape , and slice through both making slices about 1 inch thick
3. Keeping the shape together , wrap in foil and bake at 375 degrees for about 20 minutes

title: baked carrots  turnips   rutabagas
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Arrange carrots , turnip , and rutabaga in 2-quart casserole dish
3. In small bowl , combine remaining ingredients
4. Drizzle over vegetables
5. Cover vegetables with aluminum foil
6. Bake 40 to 50 minutes
7. Serve over brown rice

title: karithopeta  greek walnut cake   t r l
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. 9x13 inch buttered pan
3. Make syrup first by combining syrup ingredients in a saucepan
4. Boil 10 minutes
5. Stir every few minutes
6. Set aside to cool
7. Cream butter and sugar until light , add eggs , one at a time , beating constantly
8. Add flour , farina , baking powder , cinnamon , and orange peel and beat well
9. Then add walnuts
10. Bake for 30 minutes
11. Pour cooled syrup over cake while cake is hot
12. Allow to cool , cut into diamond shapes

title: creme brulee martini
steps:
1. Combine ingredients in a shaker with ice
2. Stir gently and strain into a chilled cocktail glass
3. A dash of cream can be added to this cocktail , but it's sweet enough on its own
4. Try adding the cream if the martini is a substitute for dessert
5. If it's for cocktail hour skip the cream
6. Try rimming the edge of the martini glasses in brown sugar

title: southwestern vegetarian lentil soup
steps:
1. In a large pot , heat oil , saut onion , carrot , and jalapeno , until soft , about 10 minutes
2. Add garlic and spices and saut 2 minutes
3. Stir in water or broth and scrape any spices that stuck to the pan
4. Stir in green chilies and lentils
5. Bring to a boil , reduce heat , and simmer , covered , for about 40 minutes until lentils are tender
6. Uncover and stir in bouillon cubes , if using , and sugar
7. Stir in spinach , zucchini , corn and olives
8. Bring to a boil and cook until zucchini is tender about 5 minutes
9. Remove from heat , stir in tomatoes , lime or lemon juice and salt to taste
10. Serve with desired toppings

title: buttermilk pecan chicken strips
steps:
1. Cut each breast half into 4 strips
2. Combine flour , ground pecans , sesame seeds , paprika , salt and pepper and set aside
3. Combine egg and buttermilk
4. Dip chicken in buttermilk and then dredge in the flour mixture
5. Pour butter into 15x10x1 jelly roll pan
6. Add chicken , turning to coat
7. Bake at 375' for 30 minutes or until done
8. Drain on paper towels

title: south african inspired potato salad
steps:
1. Mix the sour cream , vegenaise or miracle whip and all the seasonings together
2. Add the rest of the ingredients and mix gently until well blended
3. Garnish with parsley and grape tomatoes
4. Chill in refrigerator until serving time
