title: italian barbecued shrimp
steps:
1. In a large , heavy non-stick skillet , combine the oil , italian dressing , garlic , hot pepper sauce , worcestershire sauce , bay leaves , paprika , oregano , rosemary , thyme , pepper and salt
2. Cook over medium heat until the sauce begins to boil
3. Add the shrimp
4. Cook approximately 10 minutes
5. Add the wine , and cook another 5-7 minutes , or until the shrimp are done
6. Serve the shrimp with the sauce

title: hamburger soup  real comfort food
steps:
1. Dice the onion , carrot and potatoes and place in the pot of water
2. Add a little salt and pepper
3. Bring to a boil , then reduce heat and simmer until the potatoes and carrot are tender
4. Bring to a slow boil again , and sprinkle the uncooked beef into the soup
5. Let cook for a few minutes to be sure the beef is done
6. Salt and pepper to taste
7. Enjoy !
8. I find that the more i make this , the more veggies i add
9. I now add celery with the carrot , onion and potato , and after it's done , i'll add corn or peas , or leftover spinach / kale / greens whatever , even leftover rice or barley pilaf~~~since being laid off 2 years ago , there's not an awful lot that i waste ! and it still comes out great , and i still love the original one !

title: shredded beets with thick yogurt
steps:
1. Drain the yogurt to 1 cups: line a strainer w / a coffee filter , add yogurt & set aside about 1 hour
2. Cut off all but 1 inch of the beet stalks and leave the roots intact
3. Rinse the beets well but do not peel
4. Cook the beets in boiling salted water until tender , 25 to 35 minutes
5. Drain , slip off the skins under cold running water , and cut away the root ends and stalks
6. Coarsely grate the beets , using the shredding disk of a food processor or the large holes of a hand grater
7. Combine the garlic , lemon juice , salt and pepper in a medium bowl
8. Add the beets and yogurt and blend well
9. Taste and add a pinch of sugar if desired
10. Transfer to a serving dish , cover and refrigerate until well chilled , about 1 hour
11. Garnish with sprigs of fresh mint just before serving

title: hamentashen
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 325
2. Pour the dry ingredients into a mixing bowl and pulse twice in a food processor or run for 20 seconds on low in a kitchenaid
3. Slice the butter into the dry mixture
4. Mix until the lumps are smaller than a quarter of an inch in diameter
5. Add the egg yolk
6. Gradually sprinkle water over the mixture
7. Mix with a wooden spoon or rubber spatula until the mixture clumps together
8. Make the dough into a ball , trying to handle it as little as possible
9. Wrap the dough ball in plastic wrap
10. Flatten the dough ball in the plastic wrap until it is approximately 2 inches thick
11. Put the dough ball in the freezer for 10 minutes
12. Remove the dough ball from the freezer and cut it in half
13. Take out two pieces of wax paper approximately 18 long
14. Roll half of the dough ball between the two pieces of wax paper until each side of the dough is inch thick
15. Make sure it is even ! the dough will be sticky so sprinkle extra flour on top as needed
16. Cut out the dough using the cookie cutter
17. Repeat steps 14 and 15 with the other half of the dough ball
18. Place about 1 tbs of jam in the center of each circle and fold it into a triangle
19. Put the triangles in the freezer for 5 minutes or the refrigerator for 10 minutes
20. Remove the triangles from the refrigerator or freezer and place them on the cookie pans
21. Bake for 45 minutes at 325 or until golden brown

title: old fashioned onion rings
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a deep-fryer to 365 degrees f
2. Separate the onion slices into rings , and set aside
3. In a small bowl , stir together the flour , baking powder and salt
4. Dip the onion slices into the flour mixture until they are all coated
5. Set aside
6. Whisk the egg and milk into the flour mixture using a fork
7. Dip the floured fings into the batter to coat , then place on a wire rack to drain until the batter stops dripping
8. The wire rack may be placed over a sheet of aluminum foil for easier clean up
9. Spread the bread crumbs out on a plate or shallow dish
10. Place rings one at a time into the crumbs , and scoop the crumbs up over the rings to coat
11. The coating should cling very well
12. Repeat with remaining rings
13. Deep fry the rings a few at time for 2 to 3 minutes , or until golden brown
14. Remove to paper towels to drain
15. Seasoning with season salt , and serve

title: zesty salmon patties
steps:
1. Combine ingredients: mix well
2. Shape into four patties
3. In a skillet over medium heat , cook patties in butter until browned , about 6 minutes on each side

title: raisin bar sheet cake
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375 degrees
2. Grease a 17 x 11 x 2 pan
3. In a mixing bowl , combine the first 9 ingredients
4. Pour into baking pan
5. Bake 20 minutes
6. If you are using a dark baking pan , check for doneness at 15 minutes
7. Cool slightly
8. Make icing: put powdered sugar into a bowl
9. In a small bowl , combine water and butter , than add vanilla and syrup
10. Add to sugar and beat until creamy , adding water to obtain correct consistency
11. Drizzle over slightly warm cake

title: fresh asian chicken salad wraps
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine the chicken , onions , cabbage , and carrot
2. For the dressing , in a small food processor , combine all the dressing ingredients listed
3. Cover and process until chopped and well mixed
4. Pour the dressing over the chicken and vegetables and toss to coat well
5. Place a tortilla on a plate , place a lettuce leaf on each tortilla and top with the chicken mixture
6. Roll up tightly and slice in half for serving

title: sugar free pineapple or strawberry dessert 2 ww points per cup
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients and refrigerate
2. That's all there is to it !
3. Can be frozen !

title: molten french camembert potato gratin with bacon and onions
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 210c , 425f
2. Grease an ovenproof dish , i use a french poele , a small pan like earthenware dish with a handle , but any oven proof dish which is fairly deep will be okay !
3. Peel and boil the potatoes whole
4. Cook for about 20-25 mins or until just tender but still holding their shape well
5. Plunge them into cold water to stop them cooking and set them to one side
6. Meanwhile , heat up a frying pan and cook the lardons or bacon cubes together with the diced onions
7. Cook them over a medium heat , pouring away any excess fat
8. Fry them until the bacon is crispy but not too brown and the onions are tender
9. Mix together the creme fraiche and glass of wine
10. Season the mixture very well with black pepper and just a touch of salt , as the bacon will be salty
11. Take your camembert cheese and very carefully slice it into two pieces horizontally
12. Drain the cooled potatoes and cut them into 1 / 4" thick slices
13. Layer half of them in to the greased oven proof dish and then cover with half of the onion and bacon mixture
14. Pour over half of the wine and creme fraiche mixture
15. Place one half of the whole camembert on top
16. Repeat the layer in the same order: potatoes , bacon and onion mixture , wine and creme fraiche mixture and end the layers by placing the last half a camembert cheese on top
17. Season with black pepper again and just a pinch of salt if you wish
18. Bake in a pre-heated oven for about 45 minutes or until the gratin is brown and bubbling
19. Set to one side for about 3-5 minutes , it firms up a bit and is easier to serve then !
20. Serve with a big bowl of crisp green salad , assorted charcuterie such as cold meats , salami , terrine and sausage and not forgetting crusty bread to mop all those juices up with !
21. Great with a well chilled and dry white wine such as chablis or chardonnay

title: runza
steps:
1. Thaw two loaves of frozen bread dough or make the equivalent amount using your favorite bread recipe
2. While dough thaws , make the filling
3. Brown the hamburger and drain , then return to pan
4. Add cabbage and onion and cook down
5. Salt and pepper to taste
6. Let dough rise , then punch down and roll a portion to 1 / 4" thickness
7. Cut into 4" x 8" pieces and add about 1 / 2 cup meat mixture to each
8. Fold dough pieces over and seal the edges , then place seam-side-down on a greased cookie sheet
9. Let rise 20-30 minutes , then bake in pre-heated 375 degree oven for 20 minutes or until brown
10. Call nebraska natives not in attendance and gloat

title: beef ragout on polenta
steps:
1. In 4 to 6 quart slow cooker , layer onion , bell pepper , carrots , beef , pepper and pasta sauce
2. Cover
3. Cook on low setting for 8 to 10 hours

title: eggplant  aubergine    green pepper kugel
steps:
1. Peel eggplant
2. Dice into 2" cubes
3. Simmer with salt in water to cover in medium-size saucepan 20 minutes to tender
4. Drain
5. Mash in large bowl
6. Meanwhile , heat oil in medium-size skillet over medium heat
7. Add onion , pepper and pine nuts
8. Cook until tender , about 8 minutes
9. Add to eggplant in bowl
10. Stir in basil , eggs , matzoh , salt and pepper
11. Scrape into greased small casserole
12. Dot with butter
13. Bake in preheated moderate oven for 35 minutes to heat through

title: scallops wrapped in bacon in a maple cream sauce
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Place bacon slices individually onto a baking sheet
3. Bake until a pale golden brown , about 8 minutes
4. It should still be flexible , not crisp
5. Cut slices in half crosswise and let cool
6. Wrap one slice of bacon around the sides of each scallop and secure it with a toothpick
7. Preheat oven to 400 degrees place the scallops on a baking sheet and bake until cooked through , about 8 minutes
8. While the scallops are cooking , boil the cream in a large skillet until it is reduced to about 3 / 4 of a cup , approximately 3 minutes
9. Keep an eye on the heat and lower to medium maintaining a steady reduction
10. Add mustard and maple syrup then boil for approximately another 4 minutes
11. Season with salt and pepper to taste
12. Spoon sauce on a serving platter
13. Arrange scallops on the platter , sprinkle with chives and serve

title: tofu curry
steps:
1. Place the onions , garlic , tomatoes , and ginger together in a saucepan and cook for 3-4 minutes , until the onion has softened
2. Add the dried spices , thyme , jalapeno peppers and water and simmer over a low heat for about 7 minutes
3. Stir in the tofu and cook for a further 8 minutes
4. Serve with boiled rice

title: hrudka  easter cheese
steps:
1. Pour milk into saucepan and bring to a boil
2. Beat eggs slightly and add gradually to milk
3. Cook over low heat for about seven minutes
4. Add salt , pepper , and vanilla , stir continually so mixture will not scorch
5. Pour mixture into a linen towel or cheesecloth , squeeze and tie tightly
6. Hang and let dry for two hours
7. Cover with a wet napkin and place in refrigerator

title: fast thin gluten free pizza
steps:
1. Move shelf in oven near the top then place oven on broil
2. Grease a cookie sheet
3. Sprinkle some almond flour onto greased cookie sheet in the form of a circle
4. Sprinkle italian seasoning , salt , and onion powder over almond flour
5. Grate cheese over the almond flour
6. Cut a slice or two of tomato into pieces and scatter over the cheese
7. Cook for 2 minutes or just until cheese has melted and the edges are brown
8. Remove from oven and let cool 1-2 minutes
9. Use a spatula to remove pizza to a plate
10. If you want you can quadruple the ingredients and make a larger pizza , this size is perfect for one person

title: lemon strawberry smoothie
steps:
1. Place the fruit in a blender or food processor and puree
2. Add the rest of the ingredients and blend or process until the mixture is smooth
3. Pour into glasses and serve

title: refreshing cooler
steps:
1. Blend the water and yoghurt till thick and frothy
2. Make a paste of the chillies , ginger , and salt
3. Mix the paste into the yoghurt
4. Top with the powdered cumin and garnish with coriander and lemon leaves
5. Add ice cubes and keep for 10 minutes to allow time for the flavors of the spices and lemon leaves to infuse
6. Best served chilled by making a couple of hours in advance
7. Enjoy !

title: budget salad suppers
steps:
1. Put ingredients in a 1-quart jar with a tight-fitting lid
2. Cover , shake to mix and refrigerate
3. Shake well before using
4. Use all variations below to make your budget salad supper
5. Just serve over your favorite combination of crisp lettuce
6. My favorite is romaine lettuce
7. Bacon and egg: whisk: 1 / 4 cup basic dressing , 1 / 4 cup mayonnaise , 2 tablespoons ketchup
8. Add: 4 strips crumbled cooked bacon , 4 sliced hard-cooked eggs
9. Toss with: 1 1 / 2 cups chopped celery , 1 cup sliced radishes , and 1 / 2 cup sliced onion
10. Wagon train bean: whisk: 1 / 2 cup basic dressing , 2 tablespoons bottled barbecue sauce , 1 teaspoon ground cumin
11. Add: 1 can baked beans
12. Toss with: 1 pt cherry tomatoes , halved , 1 can corn , drained , 1 1 / 2 cups chopped raw zucchini , 1 / 2 cup chopped onion
13. Vegetable garden: whisk: 1 / 4 cup basic dressing , 1 / 4 cup mayonnaise , 1 / 4 cup chopped dill pickle
14. Add: 2 cups thawed frozen green peas , 4 oz
15. Cheddar cheese , shredded
16. Toss with: 3 cups blanched broccoli florets , 1 cup shredded carrots , and 1 / 2 cup chopped red onion
17. Sesame chicken: whisk: 1 / 2 cup basic dressing , 2 tablespoons light soy sauce , 1 tablespoon dark oriental sesame oil
18. Add: 2 cups shredded cooked chicken
19. Toss with: 4 cups shredded red cabbage , 2 cups sliced cucumber , and 1 / 2 cup sliced scallions
20. Tuscan tuna and bean: whisk: 1 / 3 cup basic dressing , 1 / 2 teaspoon each dried basil , parsley , and freshly ground pepper
21. Add: 1 can tuna , drained , 1 can white kidney beans , rinsed
22. Toss with: 3 cups tomato chunks , 1 1 / 2 cups bell pepper strips , 1 / 2 cup thinly sliced onion

title: papa d s seasoning rub for ribs
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together
2. Store in a covered container

title: old school house yeast rolls
steps:
1. Either put in machine in proper order for your machine or throw it in the mixer with a dough hook
2. Let it mix and knead for 10 minutes or so while you find something else to do
3. It should be soft , but not run out of your hand when you lift it from the bowl
4. Cover with cloth and let double
5. Place on floured board
6. I just cut it into 4 "equal" pieces and the cut those into another 4 each
7. Spray or grease a large jelly roll pan or whatever you have about that size
8. Put the big ones on one end and the little ones on the other
9. Leave about 3 / 4" or so between the rolls
10. Beware , your environment and oven could change these times
11. Let raise again
12. Bake at 400 degrees about 9 minutes
13. Then i personally flip them onto another pan and bake upside down for another 3 minutes so the bottom is nice and crunchy also
14. Store after cooling in a plastic bag or something , but make sure they are truly cool first
15. I put them in the freezer and then reheat them in the oven as we need them
16. These things are truly one of a kind -- every time

title: asian style salmon or tofu
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400
2. Tear off four 15-inch squares of parchment paper
3. Arrange them evenly on baking sheets
4. Divide the bok choy and bell pepper evenly on the squares
5. Place the salmon on top of the vegetables and sprinkle with pepper
6. Top each square with scallions
7. In a small bowl , combine soy sauce , rice vinegar , sesame oil , and ginger
8. Spoon the mixture over the salmon or tofu
9. Top with another 4 squares of parchment paper and fold the edges over several times to seal
10. Bake for 15 minutes
11. When done baking , slit the parchment paper to open and serve , being cautious of the hot steam
12. For vegetarian use only the tofu

title: cauliflower and cucumber salad with sour cream
steps:
1. Slice the first four ingredients as thinly as you can
2. Use a sharp knife
3. Combine the sliced vegetables and the salt
4. I usually put them all in a clean ice cream container and shake the dickens out of 'em
5. Then i put the container in the fridge for a couple of hours
6. Remove the container from the fridge and drain off any liquid that has accumulated
7. In another bowl , combine the last three ingredients
8. Then stir this mixture through the vegetables
9. Put the lid back on the container and give everything some more good shakes to combine
10. You can serve immediately , but this recipe keeps well for several days , and usually tastes better the second day onwards

title: caramelized carrots
steps:
1. Heat olive oil in large skillet , then add carrots , cut side down
2. Sprinkle with salt and cook , covered , for 10 minutes
3. Turn carrots , add garlic , cover and continue cooking for 10 minutes , or until tender and golden brown
4. Remove carrots to serving plate and cover to keep warm
5. Add whipping cream and cayenne pepper to the same skillet and bring to a boil
6. Reduce heat and gently boil for 2 to 4 minutes , until cream is slightly thickened
7. Pour over carrots and serve immediately

title: harvey wallbanger cake
steps:
1. Combine all cake ingredients in lg bowl
2. Mix on med for 3 minutes , or until smooth
3. Pour into greased and floured tube pan
4. Bake at 350 for 45 minutes or until done
5. Cool 10 minutes , remove from pan
6. Glaze: place all ingredients in blender container
7. Process until smooth
8. Pour over warm cake

title: indian chickpea ragout with vegetables
steps:
1. Combine the cilantro , cucumber , red onion and yogurt and mix well
2. Place in serving bowl and refrigerate until needed
3. In a large saut pan , heat the oil over medium high heat , and add the cumin , fennel , pepper flakes , coriander and onion and saut until the onions are lightly browned , about 8 minutes
4. Add ginger , zucchini and bell pepper and mix well
5. Pour 1 / 3 cup of water over the vegetables , cover and reduce heat to low and simmer about five minutes
6. Fold in the chickpeas and the tomatoes and increase heat to medium high and cook uncovered until the ragout is heated through and the sauce is thick , about five minutes
7. Season with salt to taste and generous sprinkle of freshly ground pepper
8. Serve ragout garnished with the cilantro yogurt mixture

title: yummy cream cheese dip
steps:
1. Soften cream cheese first
2. When soft enough , cut into sections and place into bowl
3. Combine with garlic powder
4. In separate bowl mix boiling water with beef bouillon cube until dissolved
5. Combine with cream cheese and garlic and mix until smooth
6. Can be eaten warm or refrigerated

title: pistachio and almond cake with orange salad
steps:
1. To make the cake , preheat the oven to 300f
2. Butter a 4-by-8-inch loaf pan
3. Then , using a sifter or a fine-mesh strainer , dust it with flour , tapping out the excess
4. In a food process , combine the pistachios and almonds and pulse until finely ground
5. Set aside
6. Combine the butter and sugar in the bowl of a stand mixer
7. Grate the zest from the lemons directly into the bowl
8. Fit the mixer with the paddle attachment and beat on medium speed for about 2 minutes , or until smooth and creamy
9. Mix in the vanilla just until incorporated
10. On low speed , gradually add the nuts and mix just until incorporated
11. Then add the eggs , one at a time , mixing after each addition just until incorporated
12. Stir in the flour and salt and mix just until incorporated
13. Spoon the batter into the prepared loaf pan
14. Bake until a skewer inserted into the middle of the cake comes out clean , about 45 minutes
15. Let cool in the pan on a wire rack for 10 minutes
16. Then , run a paring knife around the inside of the pan to loosen the cake sides , invert the cake onto a plate , and lift off the pan
17. At this point , the cake can be served warm or allowed to cool completely before being sliced and reheated
18. To make the orange salad , cut a slice off the top and bottom of 1 orange , stand the orange upright , and cut downward to remove the rind and pith in thick strips
19. Cut the orange crosswise into 1 / 4-inch-thick slices , capturing any juice
20. Repeat with all of the remaining oranges
21. Set the oranges slices aside until needed
22. Gently heat the marmalade in a pot over low heat for about 3 minutes , or until syrupy
23. Add any captured orange juice along with the lemon juice to the marmalade
24. Remove the pot from the heat and add 1 to 2 tablespoons water to think the marmalade to the consistency of a vinaigrette
25. Let cool
26. To serve , preheat the oven to 400f
27. Cut the cake into generous slices and place on a baking sheet
28. Bake the slices , turning them over once , for about 5 minutes , or until warm and slightly toasted on both sides
29. Place 4 or 5 orange slices on each plate and drizzle generously with the marmalade syrup
30. Place the warm pieces of cake next to the orange slices and top with a dollop of yogurt and a few pistachios
31. Serve immediately

title: raw broccoli   cauliflower salad
steps:
1. Chop broccoli and cauliflower , discarding most of the stem sections
2. Mix broccoli , cauliflower , onion , apple , raisins , bacon bits , walnuts , and cheese in large bowl
3. Combine mayo , sugar , and vinegar in medium bowl
4. Mix together mayo mixture and broccoli mixture
5. Cover and chill over night
6. Serve cold

title: homemade nilla wafers
steps:
1. In the mixer bowl , combine the butter , sugar and salt
2. Beat on medium speed until smooth
3. Reduce the speed to low , add the egg yolks and vanilla and beat until blended
4. Add the flour and beat until incorporated and a smooth dough forms
5. Divide the dough into 4 equal portions
6. Roll out each portion into a log 7 inches long and about 1 1 / 2 inches in diameter
7. Wrap the logs in plastic wrap and refrigerate until firm , at least 2 hours
8. Preheat an oven to 350f
9. Line 3 baking sheets with parchment paper or a silicone baking mat
10. Using a sharp knife , cut each unwrapped log crosswise into slices 1 / 4 inch thick
11. Place the cookies 1 inch apart on the prepared baking sheets
12. Bake the cookies , 1 sheet at a time , until the edges and bottoms are golden , 12 to 15 minutes
13. Let the cookies cool on the baking sheets for 5 minutes , then transfer them to wire racks and let cool completely
14. Store in an airtight container at room temperature for up to 5 days
15. Makes about 65 cookies

title: sea bass on spinach with raisins and pine nuts
steps:
1. Put the raisins in a small bowl , cover with hot water and set aside
2. Put pine nuts in a dry skillet over medium high heat and dry fry for 1-2 minutes , shaking frequently
3. Heat oil in large skillet over medium heat , fry the garlic until golden , remove with a slotted spoon and save
4. Add the spinach to the oil with only the rinsing water clinging to it's leaves
5. Cover and cook 4-5 minutes until wilted
6. Uncover , stir in the drained raisins , pine nuts and garlic chips , continue cooking until all liquid evaporates
7. Season to taste and keep warm
8. Brush the fish with oil , sprinkle with paprika and rub it in , season with salt and pepper
9. Heat 2 tbs oil in a large non-stick skillet , add fish filets and fry over high heat ca 2-3 minutes , turn heat down to medium , turn fish filets and finish cooking until flesh is opaque and flakes easily
10. Divide spinach between 4 plates , place fish on top and garnish with lemon and tomato wedges

title: pomegranate cake
steps:
1. Grease and flour an 8-inch cake pan
2. In a mixing bowl , beat eggs until foamy and gradually add sugar
3. Continue beating until mixture is stiff and full of air
4. Sift flour and baking powder , divide in three parts and fold into the egg-sugar mixture , alternate with the pomegranate juice
5. Transfer the batter to the cake pan and bake at 350 degrees f for 35-40 minutes
6. Cool for 10-15 minutes and turn out on a cake plate
7. Dust with powdered sugar or frost with a butter cream frosting

title: brown rice and cheese casserole
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a mixing bowl
2. Pour into lightly oiled casserole
3. Bake at 350 degrees f for 15 to 20 minutes

title: dark chocolate cake with double fudge icing
steps:
1. Cake: mix mayonnaise , water , sugar and vanilla together until well blended
2. Sift cocoa , flour salt and baking soda together
3. Stir into liquid ingredients and mix just until blended
4. Pour batter into 2 greased and floured sandwich cake tins[8-9 inch size]
5. Bake in a preheated 375 deg f oven for 20-25 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the centre comes out clean
6. Cool and then ice
7. Icing: bring sugar and cream to a boil
8. Reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes
9. Stir occasinaly to stop cream from boiling over
10. Remove from heat
11. Finely chop or grate the chocolate
12. Sir into the cream until completely melted
13. Stir in butter and vanilla
14. Once butter is melted , refrigerate icing until cold
15. Once cold beat the icing with an electric mixer or a wooden spoon until thick and of a good spreading consistency

title: michelle s special  secret  recipe chili
steps:
1. Cook all about 2 hours
2. Parmesean , american or cheddar to delight your taste buds
3. Serve with crackers and peanut butter sandwich or over spaghetti , add fresh diced onion to add zing

title: bonfire burgers
steps:
1. Combine first 6 ingredients
2. Mix well
3. Shape into 8 patties
4. Wrap a slice of bacon around each patty , securing with a toothpick
5. Grill patties over medium coals 8 to 10 minutes on each side or until desired degree of doneness
6. Place patties on bottom of buns
7. Top each with lettuce leaf , onion , and tomato slices
8. Cover with bun tops

title: drunken mexibird
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. Season chicken with salt , pepper , and oregano
3. In an ovenproof skillet , heat the olive oil and brown the chicken pieces on all sides
4. Remove the chicken from pan and set aside
5. Reduce the heat , add the onion and garlic , and cook for 5 minutes
6. Add the bay leaves , wine , tequila , and olives
7. Return the chicken to the pan , cover , and cook in the oven until tender and browned , about 40 to 45 minutes
8. Remove and serve with spanish rice or mexican rice and other sides of your choosing

title: apple bran muffins with apple butter
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Grease a large muffin tin
3. In a medium bowl combine flour , baking soda , baking powder , salt , sugar , and cinnamon and mix to blend
4. In another bowl add wheat bran and milk and blend well
5. Then to the bran mixture add eggs , apple butter and 2 tbsp oil and mix to blend
6. Let bran mixture sit 5-10 minutes
7. Meanwhile , peel , core and shred the apples
8. Squeeze out any excess moisture from apples with your hands
9. Add shredded apples to the bran mixture and mix well to blend
10. Add wheat bran mixture to flour mixture and stir to blend
11. Spoon batter into muffin cups evenly
12. Bake at 375 for 25-30 minutes or until they just begin to brown and test done with a toothpick
13. Cool muffins in pan on a wire rack 5-10 minutes
14. Remove muffins from muffin pan and cool completely
15. Preparation time includes preparing the apples
16. You can make 12 standard size muffins instead of six large but you'll need to reduce baking time to approximately 15-20 minutes or until they test done

title: covered bridge potato salad
steps:
1. Cook potatoes ib jackets until tender
2. Peel and dice
3. Combine potatoes , onions carrots celery olives and egg , set aside
4. Add flour to grease from fried bacon and stir until it makes a smooth paste
5. Combine sugar , eggs mustard , water vinegar , salt and pepper , mix well
6. Add to flour paste
7. Place over low heat
8. Cook until thick , stirring constantly
9. Pour over potatoe mixture , mix lightly
10. Let stand in cold place for several hours

title: golden onion bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350-degrees
2. Butter casserole dish
3. Melt butter in large skillet and add onions
4. Cook until tender and translucent
5. Stir often
6. Transfer onions to prepared dish
7. Combine milk , soup , salt and pepper in a bowl
8. Pour over onions
9. Sprinkle cut cheese over top
10. Brown bread slices in skillet
11. Add butter as needed
12. Placed on top of casserole with browned side up
13. Bake until bread browns even more
14. About 30 minutes
15. Serve hot

title: lime and thyme blueberry pound cake
steps:
1. Position oven rack in the middle of oven
2. Preheat oven to 300
3. Generously butter and flour a 10-inch bundt pan
4. Bring the milk and thyme just to a boil in a small saucepan over medium heat
5. Remove from heat , cover , and steep for 7 minutes
6. Pour through a fine strainer set over a bowl and let the milk cool to room temperature
7. In a mixing bowl , whisk the flour , baking powder , and salt together
8. Set aside
9. Using an electric mixer on med-high speed , beat the butter in a large bowl until light and fluffy
10. Decrease speed to medium and gradually add 1 cup sugar
11. Increase speed to med-high and beat until the mixture is light and fluffy
12. Beat in the eggs one at a time , beating well after each addition
13. Decrease speed to low and add the flour mixture alternately the milk in 3 batches , beginning and ending with the flour mixture and beating just until blended
14. Beat in 2 teaspoons zest and the vanilla
15. Gently stir in berries
16. Transfer batter to the prepared pan
17. Smooth the top with a rubber spatula
18. Bake for 1 hour and 30 minutes to 40 minutes , or until the cake begins to pull away from the sides of the pan and a pick inserted in the center comes out clean
19. Let cake cool in pan on a wire rack for 20 minutes
20. Then turn it out onto the rack and set it right side up
21. Meanwhile , bring the remaining cup sugar , 2 teaspoons zest , and lime juice to a boil in a small pan over medium heat
22. Remove from heat and let stand for 5 minutes
23. Brush the lime juice mixture over the warm cake and let cool completely
24. Serve , cut into wedges

title: sugar free peanut butter cookies
steps:
1. Set oven to 375 degrees
2. Grease a cookie sheet
3. In a bowl combine flour , splenda or sugar twin and baking powder
4. Add in peanut butter , oil , egg , water and vanilla
5. Mix well to combine
6. Shape into 1-inch balls and place on the cookie sheet
7. Flatten each cookie with a fork
8. Bake for about 10-12 minutes , or until lightly browned

title: chocolate peanut butter cup oatmeal
steps:
1. Bring milk just to a simmer and add oats
2. Stir until oats get creamy
3. Add peanut butter and chocolate chips and stir until they melt
4. Add unsweetend cocoa and sugar
5. Feel free to add more milk depending on your desired consistency

title: lighter crab dip
steps:
1. Grease an oven proof dish and preheat oven to 180c or moderate temperature
2. Mix together all ingredients apart from panko crumbs and extra parmesan
3. Pour into baking dish , sprinkle the top with panko and extra parmesan , then bak in the oven about 30 minutes or until bubbling , and golden

title: budino di ricotta  cream cheese custard
steps:
1. Cream the ricotta , add the chocolateand nuts and blend thoroughly , add cream as needed for desire consistency
2. Serve in small glasses
3. I would be tempted to try a darker chocolate and to add a little amaretto or walnut liquor

title: paper cup frozen salad
steps:
1. Combine sour cream , lemon juice , sugar , salt , pineapple , banana and food color
2. Fold in nuts and cherries
3. Spoon into paper-lined muffin cups
4. Cover with plastic wrap and freeze until firm--about 12 hours or overnight
5. Remove from freezer 15 minutes before serving

title: vegan lemon buttercream
steps:
1. In a small bowl cream shortening and margarine together until well mixed
2. Add the icing sugar in 1 / 2 cup additions
3. After each addition add a splash of lemon juice and beat well
4. Add vanilla and beat for another 3-5 minutes until you have a smooth creamy and fluffy frosting
5. Wrap tightly in plastic and refrigerate until needed
6. Pipe or spread over cakes and refrigerate to set

title: crunch topped french toast
steps:
1. Lightly coat a 2-quart rectangular baking dish with cooking spray
2. Set asde
3. In a medium bowl beat together the evaported milk , egg product , 3 tablespoons sugar or splenda , vanilla , 1 / 2 teaspoon cinnamon , and nutmeg
4. Arrange the bread slices in a single layer in prepared baking dish
5. Pour egg mixture evenly over bread slices
6. Cover and chill for 2 to 24 hours , turning bread slices once with a wide spatula
7. Combine crushed wheat buscuit and melted butter
8. Sprinkle evenly over the bread slices
9. Bake , uncovered , in a 375 degree oven about 30 minutes or until light brown
10. Meanwhile , in a small bowl toss together strawberries , 3 tablespoons sugar or splenda and 1 / 2 teaspoon cinnamon , serve with french toast , also good served with maple syrup

title: cherry angel
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl , fix pudding as directed on packages
2. Mix with mixer on medium speed till slightly thicken , add sour cream , mix well
3. Set aside
4. Cut up cake in 1 1 / 2 cubes
5. In large bowl layer cake , pudding , and cherry pie filling
6. Refrigerate over night

title: applesauce graham muffins
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400f grease bottom only of 12 medium muffins cups , 2 1 / 2 x 1 1 / 4-inches , or line with paper baking cups
2. Beat applesauce , brown sugar , margarine and egg in large bowl
3. Stir in remaining ingredients except raisins just until flour is moistened
4. Fold in raisins
5. Divide batter evenly among muffin cups
6. Bake 18 to 20 minutes or until golden brown
7. Immediately remove from pan
8. Mini applesauce-graham muffins: grease bottom only of 24-small muffin cups , 1 3 / 4 x 1 inch
9. Divide batter evenly among muffin cups
10. Bake 11 to 13 minutes or until golden brown
11. 24 mini muffins

title: fresh strawberry pound cake
steps:
1. Combine cake ingredients together in large mixing bowl
2. Mix for 3 minutes
3. Pour in well greased and floured tube pan
4. Bake at 325 for 45-55 minutes or until cake tests done
5. Cool in pan on rack for 10 minutes
6. Remove to serving plate
7. Combine glaze ingredients until smooth and spread over cake

title: gail s rosemary chicken
steps:
1. Cut a clove of garlic in half and rub chicken all over , inside and out with both halves
2. Rub chicken with butter , then rosemary , salt , and pepper
3. Place the remaining 2 cloves of garlic and the onion in the cavity of the chicken
4. Bake , covered , at 350f for 1 hour
5. Remove foil for the last 10 mins of baking to brown skin

title: naxos island salad
steps:
1. Cook couscous , rice , or pasta according to package directions
2. Fluff couscous with fork , if using
3. If using rice , make sure all liquid is absorbed so the rice is dry , not sticky
4. If using orzo , rinse hot pasta in cool water and drain well
5. In a medium mixing bowl , combine cucumber , tomato , pepper , onion , olives , chickpeas , and parsley
6. In a small mixing bowl , whisk olive oil , lemon juice , and garlic
7. Season to taste with salt and freshly-ground black pepper
8. Add dressing to vegetable mixture and toss well
9. On a serving dish , arrange lettuce leaves , mound the couscous , rice , or pasta in center and cover with mixed vegetables
10. Sprinkle with feta , if using , and serve

title: salted caramel butter sauce
steps:
1. Place the sugar in a heavy saucepan over medium-low heat
2. Cook the sugar until it melts and begins to turn a caramel colour
3. Give the caramel a stir to blend in any uncooked sugar
4. Once all the sugar has turned to liquid caramel , remove the pan from the heat and dip the base of the pan into cold water very briefly to stop the caramel from cooking further
5. Carefully stir in the cream , add the butter , and place the pan over low heat , stirring until all the caramel is dissolved
6. Let cool slightly before servinng
7. Enjoy !

title: cheddar cabbage
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. Heat 1 tbs olive oil in a small skillet over medium heat
3. Add cabbage , celery , onion and saute 7 to 8 minutes , or until tender
4. Coat a 10 by 6 inch baking dish with remaining 1 tbs of olive oil and add cabbage mixture
5. In a medium bowl , combine milk , cheese , salt , eggs , and egg white , stirring well
6. Pour over cabbage mixture
7. Combine parsley and parmesan cheese and sprinkle over cabbage mixture
8. Bake for 40 to 45 minutes
9. Let stand 5 minutes before serving

title: microwave meatloaf
steps:
1. Combine all the meatloaf ingredients
2. Pat into a microwave safe loaf pan
3. Cook for 7 minutes on full power in the microwave
4. Blot the grease
5. Whisk together the sauce ingredients , and spread over the top of the loaf
6. Microwave on high another 5 minutes

title: sloppy josephine sliders  vegetarian
steps:
1. Heat olive oil in a wide , heavy skillet
2. Add the onions , 1 / 8 tsp salt and a few grinds of pepper
3. Cook , stirring often , over medium-heigh heat , until onions are browned and sticky / crispy , about 15 minutes
4. Remove pan from heat
5. Meanwhile , in a second wide , heavy skillet , melt butter
6. Add all the mushrooms , garlic , 1 / 8 tsp salt and a few grinds pepper
7. Cook over medium-high heat , stirring frequently , until mushrooms are richly browned , about 15 minutes
8. Increase heat to high , pour in cognac and cook until liquid disappears , 1 minutes
9. Remove pan from heat
10. Split buns
11. Lay them open-faced on a broiler rack
12. Cover both halves with cheese
13. Slide under the broiler just until cheese has melted , 1 to 2 minutes
14. Set buns on serving platter
15. Heap mushrooms onto each bottom bun
16. Top with onions
17. Cover with top bun
18. Enjoy

title: fettuccine with ricotta and dill sauce
steps:
1. Cook fettuccine in boiling water until al dente
2. In blender or food processor , blend garlic , ricotta , milk , salt
3. Stir in the chopped pepper and dill
4. When pasta is al dente , mix 1-2 tbs cooking water through the sauce , then drain pasta
5. Add sauce to pasta and mix to coat before serving
6. Top with parmesan cheese if desired

title: spicy apple pancake fritters
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together well
2. Use a 1 / 4 cup to scoop up mix and fry in butter , soy butter , oil , non-stick spray , etc
3. Just like you would a pancake
4. I used avocado butter , but i live in new zealand now where everything is avocado
5. Keep finished cakes warm in oven on low till all mix is used
6. Top with whatever you want
7. Eat
8. They go down best when you eat them with someone you love

title: sausage and mushroom sauce for fettuccine
steps:
1. Heat the butter in a large skillet , and cook the garlic until it is soft
2. Stir in the mushrooms , and cook them until softened
3. Transfer mushrooms to a bowl , and set aside
4. Brown the pork sausage in the same skillet , breaking it up with a fork
5. Season with salt and pepper
6. Return the mushrooms to the pan , and mix ingredients well
7. Stir the cooked fettucine into the skillet with the sausage mixture
8. Stir in the cream and cheese , and mix everything quickly over med-high heat to blend
9. Serve immediately

title: heavenly angel hair pasta salad
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to package directions
2. Drain well and set aside to cool
3. Mix salad oil , steak seasoning and lemon juice and pour over pasta along with olives
4. Cover and refrigerate overnight
5. Just before serving , add mayonnaise , water and onions
6. Toss and serve with parmesan on side

title: awesome pasta sauce
steps:
1. Put chuck roast in crock pot , pour both jars of pasta sauce over meat and turn on low
2. Cook for minimum 8-10 hours
3. Serve over cooked egg noodles or pasta
4. Yum !

title: bisquick sausage breakfast pie   lower fat version
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Spray 9 x 1 1 / 4 inch pie plate , or 8x8x2 inch casserole dish with cooking spray
3. Brown sausage , green pepper and onion in a 10-inch skillet over medium heat , 8 to 10 minutes , stirring occasionally , until sausage is no longer pink
4. Drain
5. Mix sausage mixture , potatoes , and 1 / 2 cup of the cheese
6. Spread in pie plate
7. Stir remaining ingredients in medium bowl with wire whisk or fork , until blended
8. Pour into pie plate
9. Bake 30 to 35 minutes , or until knife inserted in center comes out clean
10. Sprinkle with remaining 1 / 2 cup cheese
11. Bake 1 to 2 minutes longer , or just until the cheese is melted
12. Let stand 5 minutes before serving
13. Top with salsa and / or sour cream

title: rosemary scented pork loin
steps:
1. Adjust oven rack to upper-middle position and heat oven to 250 degrees
2. Heat oil in a small skillet over medium-low heat
3. Add whole garlic cloves and cook , stirring occasionally , until soft and golden , about 5 minutes
4. Remove with a slotted spoon
5. Reserve oil
6. Turn pork loin fat-side down
7. Slit lengthwise , almost but not quite all the way through , to form a long pocket , leaving a 1 / 2-inch border of un-slit meat at each end
8. Brush cavity with some of the reserved garlic cooking oil , and sprinkle generously with salt and pepper and 1 tb
9. Of the rosemary
10. Line cavity with sauteed garlic and apricots
11. Sprinkle in cranberries
12. Tie loin together with kitchen twine or heavy-duty string at 1 1 / 2-inch intervals
13. Brush with remaining oil , and sprinkle generously with salt and pepper
14. Set roast , fat-side up , diagonally or curved on a large , lipped cookie sheet or jellyroll pan
15. Warm 1 / 4 cup apple jelly along with the minced garlic and remaining rosemary
16. Brush mixture onto meat
17. Roast until a meat thermometer stuck into the center registers 125 to 130 degrees
18. Remove from oven
19. Raise oven temperature to 400 degrees
20. Brush loin with pan drippings , return to oven , and continue to roast until the loin is golden brown and a meat thermometer stuck into the center registers 145 degrees f , about 20 minutes longer
21. For even more attractive coloring , broil until spotty brown , 3 to 5 minutes
22. Let roast rest 15 to 20 minutes
23. Transfer to a carving board
24. Stir juices around pan to loosen brown bits
25. Pour through a strainer into a small pan , and stir in port , chicken broth and remaining 2 tbs
26. Of jelly
27. Bring to a simmer
28. Mix cornstarch with a couple of tablespoons of cold water
29. Whisk into sauce
30. Simmer until lightly thickened
31. Slice pork and serve with a little sauce

title: molasses whipped sweet potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f
2. Place sweet potatoes on a baking sheet and roast until easily pierced with a fork , about 1 hour
3. Peel the skin off of the sweet potatoes while still hot
4. By hand or mixer , smash potatoes until all large chunks are gone
5. Combine the potatoes , butter , salt , orange juice , brown sugar , ground cumin , molasses and maple syrup in a large bowl
6. Continue to mix all together until all lumps are gone
7. Adjust any of the seasonings to your specific tastes
8. Can be made the day before

title: thai shrimp chicken soup
steps:
1. Remove skin from chicken breasts
2. Carefully cut meat from bones and pull out the pieces of cartilage
3. Cut meat into strips and set aside
4. Put bones in large saucepan
5. Add water , onion , bay leaf , parsley , thyme , salt , and pepper
6. Bring to a boil
7. Lower heat and cook slowly , covered , 1 hour
8. Strain broth into a saucepan
9. Combine garlic , coriander , chili powder , and soy sauce
10. Stir into broth
11. Bring to a boil
12. Add chicken , shrimp , and mushrooms
13. Cook slowly , covered , about 5 minutes , until the shrimp turns pink , and the chicken is tender
14. Stir in scallions and fresh coriander or parsley
15. Remove and discard bay leaf
16. Serve in bowls over or with rice

title: bread machine herbed onion bread
steps:
1. In bread machine put ingredients in , in order given
2. Select basic bread setting
3. Check dough after 5 minutes of mixing: add 1 to 2 tbl
4. Of water or flour if needed
5. Timer feature not recomended for this recipe
6. Recipe makes a 1-1 / 2lb
7. Loaf

title: bacon and cheese quesadillas for two
steps:
1. Cook the bacon in a small non-stick skilled over medium heat until crisp
2. Remove bacon and transfer to a pper towel to drain
3. Pour out all but 1 tablespoon of bacon fat , then return to medium heat
4. Add the minced shallots , pinch of salt and cook , stirring occasionally until softened , about 2 minutes
5. Transfer shallots to small bowl and set aside
6. Wipe out skillet with paper towels and return to medium-low heat and lightly toast each tortilla on one side
7. Slide the tortillas to a cutting board
8. Divide the cheese , bacon and shallots equally between the four tortillas
9. Spreading the filling over half of each toritilla , leaving a 1 / 2-inch border around the edge
10. Top with jalapenos and / or adobo sauce
11. Fold the tortillas in half and press to flatten
12. Brush tops generously with oil and sprinkle lightly with salt
13. Place quesadillas in skillet , oiled side down and cook over medium-low heat until crisp and well browned , 1 or 2 minutes
14. Before flipping , brush tops of each with oil and sprinkle salt
15. Flip the quesadillas and continue to cook until the second sides are crsip and well browned , 1 to 2 minutes longer
16. Tranfer to cutting board and cool slightly before cutting in half
17. Serve with salsa and / or guacamole

title: cookies  n  cream brownies
steps:
1. In a small mixing bowl , beat the cream cheese , sugar , egg and vanilla until smooth
2. Set aside
3. For brownie layer , combine butter , sugars and cocoa in a large mixing bowl
4. Blend well
5. Add eggs , one at a time , beating well after each addition
6. Combine flour and baking powder
7. Stir into the cocoa mixture
8. Stir in vanilla and cookie crumbs
9. Pour into a greased 11 x 7 x 2 inch baking pan
10. Spoon cream cheese mixture over batter
11. Cut through batter with a knife to swirl
12. Bake at 350 for 25-30 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out with moist crumbs
13. Cool completely

title: reduced calorie thanksgiving waldorf salad
steps:
1. In a serving bowl , combine the apple , celery and cranberries
2. In a small bowl , combine the mayonnaise , splenda and lemon juice
3. Pour over apple mixture and toss gently to combine

title: the very best whipped chocolate frosting carrie sheridan
steps:
1. Melt chocolate chips and butter in a metal bowl placed over hot water in a saucepan over medium heat on the stove
2. Stir constantly until chips and butter are fully melted
3. Add light cream and stir until fully mixed and very warm
4. Remove from heat and whisk in powdered sugar [i use much less and find this is sweet enough]
5. Refrigerate until thoroughly chilled
6. Remove from refrigerator and beat for 5 minutes or more , until the volume has increased and the color is much lighter
7. Frost any cake
8. This is very good on crazy lazy cake

title: chocolate coconut almond sprinkles
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Toast almonds on a baking sheet in middle of oven until golden , 5 to 10 minutes , then transfer to a bowl
3. Toast coconut on baking sheet in middle of oven , stirring occasionally , until golden , 8 to 12 minutes , then remove from oven and sprinkle almonds , chocolate , and a large pinch of salt over coconut
4. Let stand until chocolate is melted , about 5 minutes , then toss until coconut and almonds are coated
5. Transfer with a rubber spatula to wax paper and cool until hardened , about 1 1 / 2 hours
6. Break into sprinkles

title: cranberry coconut cookies
steps:
1. Combine flour , baking powder and cinnamon , set aside
2. Cream butter and sugars until light and fluffy
3. Beat in egg and vanilla
4. Gradually beat in flour mixture
5. Stir in coconut , nuts and cranberries
6. Drop by the tablespoonful 2 inches apart on a greased sheet
7. Bake at 350 for 12-15 minutes until golden
8. Cool 5 minutes before removing from cookie sheet

title: creamy garlic ginger chicken
steps:
1. Melt coconut oil in large saute pan
2. Saute chopped onion in coconut oil , adding garlic powder and lemon juice to the saute
3. When onions are softened , add the cubed chicken , and saute chicken until cooked almost through
4. Do not drain
5. Add bouillon , ginger paste , grated parmesan , and flour , stirring thoroughly until flour is evenly combined
6. Add half and half , stir until combined
7. Put the noodles on in boiling water per package directions
8. They cook for 10-12 minutes
9. Lower heat on chicken mixture to medium-low , let it cook down while the noodles are boiling
10. With 1 minute left on noodles , add 1 tbsp of butter to the chicken mixture to finish the sauce
11. Stir gently
12. Drain noodles , serve the chicken and sauce mixture over the noodles and enjoy !

title: bum beans
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together , pour into crockpot
2. Cook on low for 4-6 hours
3. Goes well with a green salad and cornbread

title: sun drenched pasta salad
steps:
1. Cook bow-tie pasta according to package direction in a large pot of boiling , salted water
2. Add the brocolli to the pot for the final two minutes of cooking
3. Drain well
4. In a very large bowl , combine all the other ingredients , gently combining to thoroughly coat salad with the dressing and seasonings
5. Taste and adjust salt , pepper , parmesan , red pepper flakes , or additional oil and vinegar
6. Refrigerate for a few hours before serving

title: biscuits to freeze  johnny cash s mother s recipe
steps:
1. Mix ingredients
2. Cut out biscuits , put on cookie sheet and freeze
3. When frozen , take off pan and place in plastic bag
4. When ready to bake , place frozen biscuits in a cold oven and turn to 450 degrees
5. They will be ready by the time other breakfast items are prepared
6. It takes 18-20 minutes for biscuits to bake

title: ranch chicken burgers
steps:
1. In a large bowl , mix the first 5 ingredients together
2. Form into 4 patties
3. Spread additional bread crumbs on burgers if they are sticky
4. Grill until juices run clear
5. Serve on hamburger buns with your favorite burger toppings

title: angel biscuits
steps:
1. Into a large bowl , sift together flour , baking powder , salt , baking powder , baking soda and 2 tablespoons of sugar
2. In a small glass bowl add 1 tablespoons sugar , yeast and 1 / 4 cup of warm water
3. Make sure water is very warm but not too hot to touch
4. Allow yeast to bloom for about 5 minutes
5. Work shortening into flour mixture until it resembles coarse crumbs
6. I like to use my hands but you can use a pastry blender or two knives
7. Add yeast / water / sugar mixture and 2 cups of buttermilk
8. Blend together with a wooden spoon until all wet ingredients are incorporated
9. The dough will be very sticky
10. Place dough onto cutting board dusted with flour and knead lightly about 5 or 6 times by folding dough back onto itself
11. Roll out to about 1 / 2 inch thickness
12. Using 2 inch round biscuit cutter , cut out biscuits and place on cookie sheet lined with parchment paper
13. Brush tops with milk and bake in 425 degree oven for 13-15 minutes

title: my mama s meat sauce
steps:
1. Saut onions in oil
2. Add beef and brown before stirring in all seasonings
3. Add tomatoes , paste , and cloves
4. Stir and add alcohol if using
5. Cover and let cook on a low fire for 2 hours or more

title: massaged kale salad  aarti sequeira
steps:
1. In large serving bowl , add the kale , half of lemon juice , a drizzle of oil and a little kosher salt
2. Massage until the kale starts to soften and wilt , 2 to 3 minutes
3. Set aside while you make the dressing
4. In a small bowl , whisk remaining lemon juice with the honey and lots of freshly ground black pepper
5. Stream in the 1 / 4 cup of oil while whisking until a dressing forms , and you like how it tastes
6. Pour the dressing over the kale , and add the mango and pepitas
7. Toss and serve

title: quick na   m e inspired yogurt dressing
steps:
1. Important for best flavor that the dressing sit in the refrigerator for at least one hour but preferably three hours or longer
2. Combine the dressing ingredients in a non-reactive bowl and whisk
3. Thin to desired consistency with half and half or similar
4. I think i added about two tablespoons of half and half
5. Taste and adjust after the dressing has refrigerated the required time
6. Yield is estimated

title: pie iron pizza  girl scout campout
steps:
1. Take two slices of bread and butter on one side on each slice
2. Put each slice into the individual pie-irons , buttered-side down
3. On the non-buttered side of one of the bread slices , take a spoonful of the pizza sauce and spread over the bread
4. Be careful not to put too much sauce on , or you'll end up with huge mess
5. Sprinkle mozeralla cheese over the sauce and take a slice or two of pepperoni and put those on top of the the cheese
6. Close up the pie-iron tightly and stick it into the fire pit
7. Make sure you have the iron in a hot part of the fire and keep the grip handle out far enough that it won't get too hot and burn your hands when you have to remove it
8. Cook the pie-iron pizza for two minutes
9. Depending on circumstances , you may have to cook them longer or not , but two minutes usually does the trick
10. Then you're done and you can remove the pie-iron
11. Make sure to check that the pizza bread is a golden brown on the outside , like it's been toasted
12. Then let it sit for a few minutes to cool off

title: easy low fat free tuna salad or dip
steps:
1. Put 1 / 2 an onion in the food processor
2. Add about 2-3 tablespoons of mustard
3. Add relish to taste
4. Empty can of tuna
5. Process for about 2 minutes or until completly combined
6. Sprinkle pepper and spread eat it with bread or use it as a dip

title: marble cream cheese brownies
steps:
1. Melt chocolate and 3 of the tablespoons of butter in a small sauce pan over very low heat , stirring constantly
2. Cool and set aside
3. Blend remaining butter with cream cheese until softened
4. Gradually add 1 / 4 cup of sugar , beating well
5. Blend in 1 egg , 1 tbs flour , and 1 / 2 tsp vanilla
6. Set aside
7. Beat 2 eggs until thick and light in color
8. Gradually add 3 / 4 cup of sugar , beating until thickened
9. Add baking powder , salt , and 1 / 2 cup of flour
10. Blend in cooled chocolate mixture and nuts , 1 tsp vanilla and 1 / 4 tsp almond extract
11. Spread 1 / 2 the chocolate batter in a greased 8 or 9-inch square pan
12. Add cheese mixture , spreading evenly over the chocolate batter
13. Top with tablespoons of the remaining chocolate batter dotted all over the top of the cream cheese layer
14. Zigzag a wide knife through the batter to marble swirl it
15. Bake at 350f for 35 to 40 minutes , or until top springs back when lightly pressed in the center
16. Cool cut in bars or squares
17. Makes 16 to 20

title: weight watchers basic skillet cornbread
steps:
1. Preheat oven 450 degrees
2. Combine first 5 ingredients in a large bowl
3. Make a well in center of mixture
4. Combine buttermilk , oil , egg and egg whites
5. Add to dry ingredients , stirring just until moist
6. Place a 10-inch cast-iron skillet in a 450 degree oven
7. For 5 minutes or until hot
8. Remove skillet from oven
9. Coat with cooking spray , and immediately pour batter into hot skillet
10. Bake at 450 degrees for 20 minutes or until lightly browned
11. Remove cornbread from skillet immediately
12. Yield 10 servings
13. Serving size 1 wedge @ 3 ww pts

title: carrot and cinnamon muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 200c - grease twelve cup capacity muffins holes
2. Chop carrot and grate
3. Sift flour into a bowl
4. Combine butter , egg and milk in a jug (heat butter
5. First) mix well
6. Pour onto flour
7. Stir gently until almost combined
8. Fold in
9. Carrot and cinnamon , spoon mixture into muffin holes
10. Bake for about 15 minutes or until a skewer inserted into the centre comes out clean

title: sourdough sausage stuffing
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Remove casings from sausage
3. Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat , add sausage and cook for 5 minutes until browned , stirring to crumble
4. Add onion and celery , and cook for a couple more minutes
5. Stir in parsley and next 5 ingredients
6. Place sausage mixture in a large bowl , stir in the bread and broth
7. Spoon stuffing into an 11 x 7-inch baking dish coated with cooking spray
8. Cover and bake for 15 minutes , then uncover and bake an additional 20 minutes or until golden brown

title: my mom s chiles rellenos
steps:
1. Roast chiles on an open flame on the stove top
2. When skin becomes charred , put them in a plastic bag for about 15 minutes
3. Take them out and peel them
4. Cut a slit open and deseed them
5. Cut the cheese in strips , and stuff the chiles with them
6. Close slit with a toothpick
7. Beat the egg whites until stiff and stir in yolks
8. Heat the oil in a non-stick pan
9. Coat the chiles with flour and then dip them in the egg batter
10. Fry in hot oil until batter is golden
11. Place chiles in a serving dish
12. Sauce:
13. Boil tomatoes in 1 / 2 water
14. Blend tomatoes , water and the clove of garlic in a food processor to make a sauce
15. Strain sauce
16. In a saucepan , heat olive oil and fry onions until soft
17. Add oregano and tomato sauce
18. Add sugar
19. Season with salt and pepper
20. Simmer for 5 minutes
21. Pour sauce over chiles and serve
22. They're lovely with rice and refried beans

title: possibly the easiest shrimp curry ever
steps:
1. Saute the scallions and tomatoes in the oil for a few minutes until soft , add garlic and curry powder , sate for 30 second longer
2. Add chicken broth , cook down a bit
3. Throw in the peas , and sour cream
4. Stir until combined
5. Add the cooked shrimp
6. Heat through
7. Serve over hot rice

title: coconut pie w  pecan graham crust
steps:
1. Crust: preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Place graham cracker crumbs , pecans and coconut flakes on a cookie sheet
3. Place in oven for 15 minutes , stirring every 5 minutes
4. Remove the crumb mixture and let cool
5. In medium bowl , melt butter in microwave , about 30 seconds depending on your microwave
6. Add crumb mixture to butter and mix together well making sure butter is well incorporated
7. Pat down into a 9" pie pan
8. Filling: beat egg whites until frothy
9. Add salt and vinegar , and beat until stiff
10. Gradually add 1 cup sugar , 2 tablespoons at a time , beating thoroughly after each addition
11. Spread in crumb lined pie pan
12. Bake in slow oven for 1 1 / 2 hours
13. Cool
14. Toast 1 / 2 cup coconut
15. Whip cream
16. Fold in remaining 1 / 2 cup coconut , 2 tablespoons sugar and vanilla
17. Arrange fruit slices on cooled meringue
18. Spread with whipped cream
19. Sprinkle with toasted coconut
20. Chill

title: romano beans
steps:
1. Clean and string beans , then break into bite sized pieces
2. Slice onion
3. Saut onions and beans in olive oil over medium high heat until golden brown
4. Add chicken broth , reduce heat , cover , and simmer until most of liquid is gone
5. Serve

title: outstanding burgers italiano
steps:
1. This recipe uses bubba's frozen all-beef 1 / 3 lb hamburger patties made from u
2. S
3. D
4. A
5. Choice beef chuck cooked on an indoor electric grill
6. You can use smaller patties , but you will need to adjust your cooking time accordingly
7. Burgers with fillers or lesser quality beef are not recommended
8. You'll be rewarded for spending a bit extra for quality hamburger patties
9. Spray your electric grill with garlic flavored cooking spray
10. Close and heat for 5 minutes
11. After 5 minutes , place your frozen patties on your grill
12. Close and cook for 3 minutes
13. While your burgers are cooking , cover the insides of each bun with butter and garlic
14. Place your buns buttered sides up in an un-greased non-stick baking pan and set them aside for the moment
15. If you prefer , you can use sliced italian bread instead of hamburger buns
16. When your burgers have cooked for 3 minutes , open your grill , season both sides of each pattie with italian seasoning
17. Close your grill and cook 3 more minutes
18. After the additional 3 minutes have passed , open your grill and place a whole onion slice over each burger
19. Sprinkle a bit more italian seasoning over each onion slice
20. Close your burger and cook for a final 2 minutes
21. While your burger is finishing off , heat your sauce in a glass cooking bowl in your microwave for about 2 1 / 2 minutes
22. Any good quality sauce will work
23. I used classico four cheese sauce
24. Take the baking sheet your hamburger buns are on and insert it into your oven
25. Toast the buns with the broiler for a few minutes until the butter melts
26. When your burgers are done and your sauce is heated , remove your patties from your grill and place them in your sauce
27. Top each pattie liberally with shredded italian cheese
28. Spoon sauce over the patties until they are covered , then place the bowl in the microwave and heat on high for about 1 minute
29. When your cheese is melted , lift each burger from your sauce , allow excess sauce to drip off , then place each on the bottom portions of your buns and sprinkle with grated parmesan cheese
30. Lightly spoon about a teaspoon of sauce on the inside top portion of your bun
31. Serve your sandwiches open-faced with a few celery sticks , fresh spring onions , and / or roma tomato slices on the side
32. Your guests can put their sandwiches together as they marvel about the savory aroma and your artful presentation
33. Have extra patties available
34. Your guests will want more

title: chicken enchiladas  dutch oven
steps:
1. In a medium sized bowl combine all sauce ing
2. And mix well
3. Heat a 12" dutch oven using 16-18 briquettes on bottom until hot
4. To hot oven add olive oil , onion , garlic and olives
5. Cook unitl onions are soft
6. Remove to a large mixing bowl
7. To mixture add chicken , chili powder , cumin , s & p and 3 / 4 cup prepared sauce , mix
8. Wipe dutch oven clean then re-oil generously
9. Spoon 3 / 4 c sauce into the bottom of the dutch oven and spread evenly
10. If camping place tortillas in a sealed bag under the sun to warm slightly until they become soft and flexible
11. If not just pop in microwave for a few seconds
12. Spoon 1 / 2 c of the chicken filling down the center of each tortilla
13. Fold in the ends and roll up the tortillas
14. Place seam side down in the dutch oven
15. Spoon remaining sauce over the top
16. Top with cheese and green onions
17. Cover and bake using 10 briquettes on bottom and 16-18 on top for 20 minute

title: red lentil curry
steps:
1. Wash lentils several times
2. Heat oil in a pot and add chopped onion
3. When onion is light brown in colour , add the lentils and about half of the water
4. Stir
5. Now add curry powder , chilli powder , mustard and salt
6. Simmer until lentils are cooked , adding more water of needed
7. Add milk about 5 minutes before removeing pot from the stove
8. Split peas can be used instead of lentils

title: german meatballs with sauerkraut
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl , combine ground beef and pork , onion , breadcrumbs , parsley , salt , pepper , garlic , worcestershire , egg , and milk
2. Shape into 1" to 2" meatballs , and chill until set
3. Heat the oil in a large skillet , and brown the meatballs on all sides
4. Remove meatballs , and drain fat from pan , leaving browned bits in bottom
5. Add sauerkraut and juice to skillet , and top with meatballs
6. Cover and simmer for 15-20 minutes or until meatballs are done
7. Add water or wine if necessary to keep sauerkraut moist
8. Sprinkle with parsley for garnish
9. Serve with buttered boiled potatoes

title: ginger glazed nuts
steps:
1. Set oven to 300 degrees
2. In a large skillet over medium heat melt butter
3. Add in the brown sugar , fresh ginger , 3 tablespoons water , salt and ginger powder
4. Cook until the brown suagr is dissolved
5. Remove from heat and add in nuts
6. Stir until coated
7. Spread the nuts in a lightly oiled baking sheet
8. Bake , stirring occasionally for about 25 minutes until golden
9. Cool completely

title: linguine alla vongole
steps:
1. Heat olive oil in saucepan and simmer on low for about 2 minutes
2. Add butter
3. When butter is melted , add garlic and let simmer for another 2 minutes
4. Add remaining ingredients and heat thoroughly , but do not allow to boil , because clams will get tough
5. Serve over hot linguine with freshly ground black pepper
6. I also like a little grated parmesan cheese on top
7. Enjoy !

title: crispy bacon and mushroom salad
steps:
1. Preheat the grill and cook the bacon until crisp and golden
2. Cool and break each rasher into three pieces
3. Meanwhile make the dressing by whisking the olive oil , a little at a time , into the mustard
4. If the dressing is very thick , loosen it with a few drops of hot water
5. Stir in the garlic and season with salt and freshly ground black pepper
6. Just before serving , toss the salad leaves , bacon and mushrooms together and drizzle with the dressing

title: gun club punch
steps:
1. Blend cherries , cherry juice in a blender
2. Add all ingredients together included blended cherries and cherry juice ,
3. Now , add soda slowly , and top with cinnamon

title: screwdriver chicken
steps:
1. In a plastic bag , combine flour with salt , pepper , and enough paprika to slightly make the flour pink
2. Add the chicken breast to the flour and toss to coat completely
3. Put oil , butter , and garlic in a 10 inch skillet and heat until hot
4. Add the chicken and cook until browned on both sides , about 3 to 5 minutes
5. Remove the chicken to a platter with paper towel to drain oil
6. Reduce the heat and add orange juice , vodka , parsley , and cayenne to the pan and stir to scrape up the pan drippings - sprinkle in some flour to thicken up the sauce if you would like
7. Immediately add the chicken , return heat to high , and cook for 1 more minute

title: mushroom tempeh burgers
steps:
1. In a large nonstick skillet , heat the oil and water over medium heat
2. Add the mushrooms and cook , stirring frequently , until the mushrooms are very tender , about 5 minutes
3. In a large bowl , combine the pinto beans , soy sauce , and worcestershire sauce , and mash with a potato masher
4. Stir in the mushrooms
5. Grate the tempeh on the large holes of a box grater
6. Stir the tempeh into the mushroom mixture until well combined
7. Shape the mixture into 4 patties
8. Spray the broiler pan with nonstick cooking spray
9. Preheat the broiler
10. Broil the burgers 4 to 6 inches from the heat for 5 minutes
11. Turn the burgers over and brush the tops with the chili sauce
12. Broil for 3 to 5 minutes , or until the burgers are heated through
13. Makes 4 servings

title: easy chocolate peanut butter cluster candy
steps:
1. Place peanuts in crockpot
2. Place remaining ingredients in crockpot
3. Set temperature to medium / high
4. Allow to cook in crock for one hour or until all chocolate is melted
5. Stir occasionally
6. Drop from tablespoons onto wax paper to cool

title: potato salad with feta cheese and olives
steps:
1. Wash , peel and cook the potatoes
2. Chop the dill
3. In a small bowl mix lemon juice , yogurt , a pinch of salt , olive oil and vinegar
4. Add chopped dill and the capers
5. Season with pepper to taste
6. When the potatoes are done , drain them and cut them into thin slices
7. Put into a salad dish
8. Pour the dressing on top and mix to coat all the potatoes with it
9. Using your fingers crumble the feta cheese over the salad
10. Cut the green onions / scallions into thin slices , chop the olives and add as well
11. Serve with bread or meat

title: mid summer madness slush or punch  alcoholic
steps:
1. Mix all together in a 1 gallon freezable container or ice cream bucket and freeze until slushy
2. To serve: scoop 2 parts slush to one part 7 up , gingerale or soda water or scoop slush into a large punch bowl and add 7 up , gingerale or soda water
3. Garnish with lemons , limes and oranges
4. Try putting half the slush into the punch bowl and add one bottle of pop to test your alcohol / mix taste requirements
5. As a warning , it does not have a strong alcohol taste !
6. I prefer using the scoop in the glass method to making it in a punch bowl because like all punches with pop , the pop eventually goes flat
7. This stays in the freezer well and if your guests don't guzzle it all , you can easily serve it again in the near future
8. Enjoy !

title: peppermint mocha liquid coffee creamer
steps:
1. Pour the half and half into a medium saucepan
2. Stir chocolate chips into the pan
3. Turn the heat onto medium-low and melt the chocolate into the half and half
4. Do not let this boil
5. Once the chocolate is melted turn the heat off
6. Give it a good stir and mix in the peppermint syrup
7. Store in a container in the fridge for up to 2 weeks :)

title: arroz mexicana   mexican rice
steps:
1. Saute onion in oil until soft
2. Add garlic and carrot , cook for 3 minutes
3. Stir in rice , cook until light golden , sprinkle with chili powder and cumin
4. Cook for 5 minutes
5. Add remaining ingredients and bring to a boil
6. Cover , reduce heat , simmer over low for 20 minutes or until rice is tender

title: homemade salsa and fried tortilla chips with seasoning   deen
steps:
1. Salsa:
2. Combine all ingredients , and any extra ingredients you may want to add , in a large glass bowl
3. Stir well with a spoon
4. Cover with plastic wrap and chill until serving time
5. Tortilla chips:
6. Arrange the tortillas in a stack and cut into 6 equal wedges
7. Pour about 1-inch of oil in a large frying pan over medium-high heat to 350 degrees f on a deep-fat frying thermometer
8. Fry just a few at a time , turning occasionally , until crisp and lightly browned , about 1 minute
9. Drain on paper towels
10. Sprinkle lightly with salt , if desired
11. Store in an airtight container
12. House seasoning:
13. Mix ingredients together and flavor chips to taste
14. Store leftover seasoning in an airtight container for up to 6 months

title: slam dunk crab dip
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl , beat cream cheese and milk until smooth
2. Stir in the crab , onions , red peppers , curry powder , and garlic salt
3. Refrigerate until serving
4. Serve with crackers

title: cheesy fish potato casserole
steps: 1. Put all ingredients except mozzarella in a large covered cassarole stir sprinkle mozzarella on top cover 375 oven for 40 minutes

title: alfajor de maicena  cornstarch alfajor
steps:
1. Combine first 7 ingredients until forming a smooth dough
2. Roll the dough in 1 / 4 inch
3. Cut in 2 inches diameter circles
4. Bake them a 350 degrees for 15 minutes
5. Do not brown them
6. Let cool and spread dulce de leche

title: ginger lime sweet potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees
2. Lightly spoon flour into dry measuring cup
3. Level with a knife
4. Combine flour and potato in a large bowl
5. Toss well
6. Melt butter in a small saucepan over low heat
7. Add sugar and next 7 ingredients
8. Cook 4 minutes or until sugar dissolves
9. Pour over potato mixture
10. Toss well
11. Spoon mixture into a shallow 2-quart casserole dish coated with cooking spray
12. Cover and bake at 425 for 55 minutes or until tender
13. Let stand 10 minutes

title: baked alpine noodles and cheese
steps:
1. In large pot of boiling salted water , cook noodles according to package instructions until just tender
2. Drain and chill under cold water
3. Drain well
4. Meanwhile , in skillet , heat oil and butter over medium-high heat
5. Add pancetta and caraway seeds
6. Saute until pancetta starts to render some fat
7. Add onions and sa< cook , stirring often , until golden brown , about 12 minutes
8. Remove from heat
9. In large bowl , whisk together eggs , milk , pepper and nutmeg
10. Stir in noodles to coat
11. Stir in onion mixture and half of the cheese
12. Place in buttered 13- x 9-inch baking dish
13. Sprinkle with remaining cheese
14. Bake , uncovered , in 375f oven until lightly browned , about 30 minutes

title: cilantro canapes
steps:
1. To toast bread slices: lightly brush both sides of bread slices with olive oil
2. Arrange in a single layer on a large baking sheet
3. Broil 4 to 5 inches from heat for 1 or 2 minutes or until lightly browned
4. Turn over bread slices
5. Broil 1 to 2 minutes more or until lightly browned
6. Transfer to a wire rack to cool
7. In a food processor combine cilantro , mint , pepper , lime juice , sugar , and ginger
8. Cover , process until nearly smooth
9. Add peanuts
10. Cover and process until combined
11. Add water until spreading consistency
12. Spread one side of each toasted baguette slice with some of the mixture
13. Top with the cucumber , tomato , and mint

title: salsa omelet pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. Spray a 9" deep dish pie plate , or a 10" pie plate with non-stick spray
3. Pour salsa into the prepared pie plate
4. Blend cheeses and layer over the salsa
5. Blend the eggs and sour cream until smooth and pour over the cheese
6. Bake 20-25 minutes or until a knife inseted in the center comes out clean
7. Let stand for 5 minutes before cutting

title: avga gemista or greek stuffed eggs
steps:
1. Cut the eggs into halves crosswise
2. Remove the yolks
3. Cut a thin slice from the bottom of each egg-white so it can stand upright
4. Add next 7 ingredients to the yolks
5. Beat smooth
6. Spoon into the egg-white shells , forming a small mound on each
7. Decorate each with a caper
8. Enjoy !
9. Makes 12 servings

title: crabby carm s corny crab cakes
steps:
1. Saut the bell peppers in 1 tablespoon butter
2. Grate the lemon rind for 1 heaping teaspoon of zest
3. Mix zest , 2 tablespoons of lemon juice , mayo , mustard , worcestershire sauce , egg , parsley , salt , pepper , cayenne pepper , one tablespoon flour , sauted peppers , breadcrumbs , and cooked corn in a large bowl
4. Gently fold in the crab meat
5. Mix well and shape into 3 inch wide patties
6. Wrap and refrigerate the patties for about an hour
7. When ready to cook , heat a large skillet with remaining butter and olive oil
8. Dip each crab cake very lightly in flour so that it is lightly coated all around
9. Tap off excess flour
10. Fry cakes on both sides until just browned
11. If you'd rather skip the extra flour , butter , and oil -- spray a skillet with pam and fry un-dredged cakes until browned
12. Serve on a bed of garden greens garnished with lemon wedges , sprigs of fresh parsley , and some tartar sauce for dipping
13. Goes great with a big ol' salad with buttercream dressing and crumbled hard boiled egg !

title: mcdonald s chocolate  strawberry or vanilla shake
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients for the shake flavor of your choice in a blender and mix on high speed until smooth
2. Stop blender , stir if necessary , and blend again to help combine the ingredients
3. Pour into two 12-ounce cups

title: salad of lentils and coriander
steps:
1. Toast the pine nuts
2. Slice the spring onion finely
3. Rinse and chop the gherkins finely
4. Rinse lentils and cook in plenty of water until "al dente"
5. Drain and allow to cool until lukewarm
6. Mix with the other ingredients and season to taste

title: sweet onion and swiss phyllo roll ups
steps:
1. Preparation:
2. In medium bowl , mix cream cheese and swiss cheese
3. Set aside
4. In heavy skillet , saut onions , thyme , and pepper in 1 / 4 cup butter until very soft and beginning to brown , 10-15 minutes
5. Stir in garlic and cook another 1 minute
6. Cool 20 minutes
7. Mix together onion mixture and cheese mixture and refrigerate for 30 minutes
8. Place one sheet filo dough on work surface
9. Brush with melted butter
10. Lay another sheet on top , brush with butter , and put one more sheet on top
11. Take the onion mixture and form a roll about 1 inch in diameter down one long edge of the stacked filo
12. Roll up carefully and place on cookie sheet
13. Brush thoroughly with more butter
14. Repeat with remaining filo and filling , making six rolls total
15. I place three rolls on each cookie sheet
16. Cover well with plastic wrap and chill overnight
17. When ready to bake , preheat oven to 375 degrees f and remove the rolls from the refrigerator
18. Bake for 10-17 minutes or until rolls begin to brown and cheese filling melts
19. Let stand 5 minutes , then , using a very sharp knife , cut rolls into 1" pieces
20. Let cool for 5-10 minutes , then serve
21. The onion filling right out of the oven is super-hot
22. Serves 8-10 - or 4-6 , at my parties !
23. You can also freeze these rolls
24. Wrap well in freezer wrap , label , and freeze up to 3 months
25. To bake frozen rolls , place rolls on cookie sheets and bake at 375 degrees f for 15-23 minutes or until the rolls are beginning to brown and crisp and cheese melts
26. Proceed as directed above

title: cheesy creamed mushrooms
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Arrange the mushroom slices in a shallow casserole dish
3. In a small frying pan , saute the shallots in 1 tablespoon butter over medium heat until soft
4. At the same time melt 1 / 2 cup butter over low heat in a small saucepan
5. Once the butter is melted add the flour and mix well
6. While stirring constantly , increase the heat to medium high
7. Cook the flour mixture for 3 minutes , then add the half and half and bring to a boil
8. Add the chicken stock , salt , and white pepper and return to a boil
9. Add the shallots
10. Pour the sauce evenly over the mushroom slices
11. Sprinkle with the bread crumbs
12. Bake for 20 minutes
13. Remove from the oven and sprinkle with the parmesan
14. Return to the oven right before serving and bake for about 5 minutes , or until the cheese melts

title: vietnamese pork and eggs   tit ko
steps:
1. For the colored sauce , boil 3 tablespoon of water and the sugar
2. Set aside remaining water
3. Wait until the mixture boils until there is almost no liquid left and the mixture turns a dark almost black liquid
4. Remove from fire immediately and add a little of the water that was set aside
5. After the bubbles settle down , add the rest of the water
6. Mix salt , sugar , fish sauce and pepper with pork and place in a medium saucepan
7. Add boiled eggs
8. Add colored water
9. Add water until it covers the pork and eggs completely
10. Cook on medium or medium high for about 45 minutes or until there is only about 1 inch of water left

title: apple granola bread
steps:
1. In medium mixing bowl , combine flours , baking soda , cinnamon and salt
2. Set aside
3. In large mixing bowl , combine granola cereal , buttermilk , brown sugar , honey and orange juice concentrate
4. Let stand 5 minutes or until cereal is slightly softened
5. Add egg whites and oil
6. Mix well
7. Stir in flour mixture only until combined
8. Stir in chopped apple
9. Spread evenly in 9 x 5 x 3-inch pan coated with cooking spray
10. Sprinkle top of batter with 1 tablespoon granulated sugar
11. Bake at 350 50 minutes or until wooden pick inserted near center comes out clean
12. Let cool 10 minutes
13. Remove from pan
14. Cool completely before slicing

title: romantic pear dessert
steps:
1. Boil the pears with the wine , 4 tbsps of sugar , vanilla extract and lemon slice in 1 l of water for about 30 minutes
2. Leave to cool , then keep in the fridge for about 8 hours
3. Then , peel the pears and gently remove the seeds , starting from the bottom
4. You need pears that still have their stem for best visual results
5. Serve on a white plate , with caramelised sugar and / or black currant sauce
