6. To make black currant sauce , heat black currants with sugar in an amount equal to half or all of the currants , according to preference , over medium heat , stirring constantly to mash the fruit , for about 10 mins , or until they reach the consistency of a thick sauce
7. To make caramelised sugar , heat sugar over low heat until it melts and becomes golden brown

title: artichokes  how to cook
steps:
1. Trim stem of artichokes at the base
2. Remove any tough or discolored bottom leaves
3. Cut off approximately 1-inch of the top leaves , and trim remaining
4. Rub the base and all cut parts with lemon juice
5. Using fingers , open up the center of artichokes
6. With a sturdy spoon remove and discard the fuzzy choke
7. Combine all ingredients , except artichokes , and bring to a boil
8. Add artichokes , and partially cover and return to a boil
9. Cook until the stem end is easily pierced with a fork
10. Allow about 30 minutes for medium and 40 minutes for large artichokes
11. Remove from liquid and drain upside down
12. Serve with melted butter or horseradish sauce , or they may be stuffed
13. They will keep several days in the refrigerator
14. Do not use aluminum utensils

title: easy cheesy red beans and rice
steps:
1. In large skillet heat oil on medium heat
2. Add green peppers , onions and garlic
3. Cook until tender
4. Add salt , pepper , bayleaf , diced tomatoes and beans
5. Simmer 20 minutes on low
6. Remove bay leaf , mash about 1 / 2 of the beans and tomatoes
7. Add rice , stir until combined
8. Sprinkle on cheddar cheese , cover and allow to cook on low until cheese is melted

title: double cherry pie
steps:
1. For the crust , melt the 1 / 2 cup of chocolate pieces and 5 tablespoons of butter
2. Remove from heat and stir in the 3 / 4 cup oats , 3 / 4 cup flour , and 1 / 4 cup brown sugar
3. Press firmly onto the bottom and sides of a greased 10 inch pie place
4. Bake at 350 degrees for 10 minutes
5. Combine pie filling , cherries and almond extract
6. Pour into the baked crust
7. Mix the 1 / 2 cup flour , 2 tablespoons brown sugar and 2 tablespoons oats
8. Cut in the 3 tablespoons butter to form coarse crumbs
9. Stir in the 1 / 4 cup chocolate pieces
10. Sprinkle over filling
11. Bake at 350 degrees for 35 minutes
12. Cool on a wire rack

title: bayou chicken
steps:
1. Coat a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray
2. Add oil and place over medium high heat until hot
3. Add onion and garlic
4. Saute until tender
5. Add chicken
6. Saute 3 minutes or until chicken looses it's pink color , stirring constantly
7. Add eggplant and next 9 ingredients
8. Bring to a boil
9. Cover
10. Reduce heat , and simmer 10 minutes
11. Combine cornstarch and water , add to skillet , stirring well
12. Cover and cook 5 minutes or until zucchini is tender
13. Remove from heat
14. Let stand 5 minutes
15. Serve over rice

title: seven spice chai
steps:
1. Combine spices and water in small saucepan
2. Bring to boil and simmer three minutes
3. Add tea leaves and simmer for another three minutes
4. Strain into teapot or cups and stir in condensed milk

title: venetian panino
steps:
1. Add the cheese , butter , mustard , and garlic to food processor
2. Blend until thick , smooth and spreadable
3. Spread the cheese mixture over 1 side of each bread slice
4. Arrange the turkey slices over the cheese mixture on half of the bread slices
5. Top with the remaining bread slices and press gently
6. Cut the sandwiches in half
7. Heat 3 tablespoons of oil in a heavy skillet over medium-low heat
8. Cook half of the sandwiches until golden brown , about 4 minutes per side
9. Transfer to serving platter and tent with foil to keep them warm
10. Repeat with remaining 3 tablespoons of oil and sandwiches
11. Serve immediately

title: koulourakia  authentic
steps:
1. Beat together vanilla , oil and eggs
2. Add sugar , salt and baking powder and mix
3. Add about half of the flour and mix
4. Gradually add the remaining flour until mixture comes away from the bowl
5. Do not over-add flour
6. Pinch off pieces of dough and roll into pencil-thin strips about 6 inches long
7. Fold in half and twist into a rope
8. Place 1 inch apart on ungreased cookie sheets
9. Brush with beaten egg and sprinkle with poppy seeds
10. Bake 350 about 15 minutes

title: mediterranean baked potato topper
steps:
1. Combine red pepper , cheese , sour cream , garlic , basil , salt and pepper in small bowl
2. Mix well
3. Add tomatoes
4. Toss gently
5. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours
6. To serve , divide and spoon on top of potatoes

title: broccoli and cauliflower saute
steps:
1. Bring large pot of water to boil
2. Add broccoli & cauliflower , & cook until just tender , about 3 minutes , then drain & set aside
3. In large skillet , melt butter over medium heat
4. Add garlic , minced onion , salt & pepper , & cook until garlic is softened , about 1 minute
5. Add 2 tablespoons of water & the broccoli & cauliflower
6. Cover & cook , stirring occasionally until heated through , about 5-6 minutes
7. Sprinkle with parsley & serve

title: lime and cilantro salad dressing
steps:
1. Whisk all ingredients to in a medium bowl
2. More olive may be used if desired , i like it low fat
3. The longer it sets the better the flavors blend

title: gretchens boyfriend s orange cookies
steps:
1. Mix the shortening , sugar and eggs until light and fluffy
2. Add the remaining wet ingredients
3. Mix all the dry ingredients and add them
4. Drop by spoonful cookie sheet and bake at 350f fors 8-10 minutes
5. Should be cake like
6. Add a light glaze of powered sugar oj and orange rind on these after they are cool
7. Mix the juice and rind together , adding the powdered sugar until you get the consistency your looking for
8. Can sub regular milk plus 1 tbsp vinegar for buttermilk if don't have any

title: anytime crepes
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients in a blender , or mix really well with a whisk
2. You don't want any lumps
3. Spread thinly in hot skillet
4. Use a cast iron or stainless steel frying pan that is really hot
5. Then it won't stick and you won't need teflon
6. In fact , get rid of the teflon ! it's so dangerous !
7. Cover with lid
8. Flip
9. Cover with lid
10. Makes 3 pancakes - enough for one person
11. Mul
12. Roll pancake with various fillings: butter , icing sugar , lemon juice / nutella and manderine orange or blueberries / sausage and applesauce / spinach , cherry toms , goat's milk feta , bit of shredded edam , pepper / syrup / ham & cheese / strawberries and sugar -- and the list goes on -----

title: easy cheesy chicken enchiladas with yogurt sauce
steps:
1. Combine yogurt , cilantro , and cumin
2. Chill until needed
3. Preheat oven to 350f
4. Heat cream cheese in a large skillet until soft
5. Stir in chicken and 1 / 2 cup of the salsa
6. Mix well
7. Add 1 / 2 cup shredded cheese
8. Stir until melted
9. Spoon about 1 / 3 cup of the chicken mixture onto each tortilla
10. Roll up
11. Place seam side down in 12x8" baking dish
12. Top with remaining salsa and cheese
13. Bake about 15 minutes , or until heated through
14. Serve with yogurt sauce

title: salisbury steak my way
steps:
1. In a large bowl , beat eggs
2. Stir in soup / dip mix , bread crumbs , salt , pepper , garlic powder and worcestershire sauce
3. Add beef
4. Mix gently with wet hands
5. Press into thin oval shaped patties
6. Fry in a large skillet over medium heat until done , turning occasionally
7. Remove steaks and set aside
8. If gravy is desired then add 4 tablespoons of flour to the drippings in the pan
9. Stirring until all the drippings are soaked into the flour
10. Add 4 cups of beef broth all at once
11. Stirring constantly until thickened into gravy
12. Season to taste
13. Add meat back to the pan of gravy
14. Simmer until hot
15. Serve with mashed potatoes or cooked egg noodles

title: three forks salad
steps:
1. 1) combine dressing ingredients in a small bowl and whisk till smooth
2. Refrigerate
3. 2) place salad greens and apple slivers in a large bowl
4. Drizzle a scant tablespoon per serving over greens and toss to coat
5. Plate greens and top with pecans and blue cheese

title: vegetarian minestrone soup
steps:
1. Heat olive oil in pan and add onions , celery , zucchini , carrots until onion is translucent
2. Add the garlic and cook 1 minute
3. Add the 4 cups of water and dried spices and bring to boil and simmer for about 10 minutes
4. Add tomatoes and beans and ditalini and simmer for another 10 minutes
5. Check seasoning and add salt to taste

title: pesto focaccia sandwich
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450
2. Cut bread in half horizontally using a serrated knife
3. Spread pesto evenly over the cut sides
4. Layer ham , turkey , cheese and onion evenly over the bottom half of the loaf , the top with the other half
5. Wrap in aluminum foil and bake for 10 minute
6. Cut into wedges and enjoy !

title: eggnog martini
steps:
1. Mix egg nog and rum in shaker with ice
2. Shake well
3. Strain into a martini glass
4. Sprinkle with ground nutmeg , or do a nutmeg rim

title: sweet and sour chicken soup
steps:
1. Combine first 8 ingredients in a large dutch oven
2. Bring to a boil
3. Cover , reduce heat , and simmer 30 minutes
4. Stir in chicken , spinach and noodles
5. Cook 5 minutes

title: corned beef hash tater cups  5fix
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Place the hash browns in a large bowl and sprinkle half of the cornstarch on top
3. Toss until well-coated
4. Repeat with the remaining cornstarch
5. Mix in the beaten egg
6. Divide the mixture evenly among 9 standard muffin tin cups that have been greased
7. Press the mixture to the bottom and sides of the cup
8. Bake 20-23 minutes or until golden brown
9. Fill the baked hash brown cups with equally divided amounts of the corned beef strips
10. Top with equal amounts of the shredded cheese
11. Bake an additional 7-9 minutes
12. Let cool 5 minutes
13. Carefully loosen the edges of cups using a knife
14. Use a fork to remove each tater cup

title: indian omelet
steps:
1. Mix eggs , milk , cilantro , salt and pepper in a bowl
2. Into a hot pan that has butter you can cook the green chilies , little ones like jalapenos , onion and then add turmeric right before you add eggs
3. Pour in egg mixture and cook until set
4. Garnish with tomato

title: confetti veggie slaw  rainforest cafe
steps:
1. Combine all the veggies in a large bowl
2. I use my mandolin to cut everything since there is so much julienning to do
3. In a small bowl , mix vinegar , sugar , oil , salt & pepper
4. Pour over veggies
5. Cover & marinate in the refrigerator
6. We will eat it right away , but as it sits the veggies soak up the flavors

title: uncle bill s blueberry spinach salad
steps:
1. Wash spinach well
2. Remove stems from spinach and discard
3. Divide spinach leaves onto 4 plates
4. Divide and sprinkle blueberries over
5. Divide and sprinkle toasted pecans over
6. Cut goat cheese into small balls and roll in poppy seeds to coat
7. Divide cheese and place on plates
8. In a food processor or blender , process olive oil , blueberries , white vinegar , sugar , salt and pepper
9. Blend until smooth
10. Drizzle dressing over salad in amounts to your liking

title: scandanavian apple salad
steps:
1. Combine apples , celery and cabbage
2. Combine remaining ingredients except grapes
3. Add to apple mixture
4. Toss to mix
5. Garnish with grapes

title: roasted arnold farm beet salad with arugula and goat cheese
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350&#9702
2. F
3. Toss whole beets together with olive oil , chopped garlic , thyme and bay leaf on a sheet pan
4. Season with salt and pepper
5. Cover tightly with foil and roast for 1-1 / 2 hours
6. Let cool slightly
7. Peel and cut the beets into 1 / 2-inch dice
8. Toss with 1 tablespoon olive oil , parsley , marjoram , salt and pepper
9. In a separate bowl , marinate the goat cheese in 1 / 2 tablespoon olive oil
10. Allow beets and goat cheese to rest at room temperature
11. When ready to serve , season arugula with 1 tablespoon olive oil , salt and pepper
12. Top with beets and garnish with marinated goat cheese

title: banana and mango bread
steps:
1. In a bowl , cream the butter with sugar until fluffy
2. Beat in eggs , one at a time , until incorporated
3. In another bowl , combine self-rising flour with salt , cinnamon and nutmeg
4. Combine mashed bananas with mango puree
5. Mix the dry ingredients and banana mixture , alternately , into the creamed mixture until batter is just combined
6. Fold in raisins and nuts
7. Pour batter into 2 greased 8 1 / 2 by 4 1 / 2 inch loaf pans
8. Bake at 350 degrees for 50 - 60 minutes or until cake tester inserted in the center tests done
9. Leave in pan for 10 minutes
10. Remove from loaf pans and let cool on racks

title: orange teriyaki chicken breasts  oamc
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients except the chicken in a bowl and mix
2. Place the chicken breasts in a freezer bag pour the marinade over the chicken , freeze
3. Serving day: thaw completely
4. Grill 4-6 inches from the heat source for 35-40 minutes
5. Or bake in a 375f oven for 40 minutes , turning once

title: louisiana oyster casserole
steps:
1. Pour the oysters into a shallow 9" pie plate
2. Sprinkle with parsley and onions
3. Scatter the cracker crumbs on top
4. Melt butter and add lemon juice , mustard and worcestershire sauce
5. Pour mixture over the crumbs and bake 450f until oysters curl slightly and crumbs are brown appro 10-15 minutes

title: organic soy vanilla pudding
steps:
1. Combine first three ingredients in a saucepan
2. Combine milk and egg in a bowl
3. Gradually add milk mixture to sugar mixture , stirring constantly
4. Cook over medium heat until thick and bubbly , stirring constantly
5. Cook for one additional minute after bubbling starts , stirring constantly
6. Serve warm , place plastic wrap on surface and cool to room temperature or chill thoroughly

title: alsatian rub
steps: 1. Combine all ingredients

title: jumbo shrimp rolls with a sweet soy sauce
steps:
1. To make the dip , finely chop the chili , then mix with the honey and soy and stir well: set aside
2. To make the shrimp rolls , finely chop the cilantro and garlic and mix with the curry paste
3. Brush each wonton wrapper with egg whites and place a small dab of the cilantro mixture in the center
4. Place a shrimp on top and fold over , enclosing the shrimp and leaving the tail exposed
5. Repeat with the other shrimp
6. Heat the oil in a deep heavy bottomed pot or pan to 350 degrees f
7. Fry shrimp in small batches for 1-2 minutes each until are golden brown and crisp
8. Drain on paper towels
9. Serve with the dip

title: bloody caesar
steps:
1. Rim a 20 oz pint glass with the wedge of lime , and rim it with celery salt
2. Fill the glass 3 / 4 full with ice
3. Over the ice , put about 5 dashes salt and about 10 turns of freshly ground black pepper
4. Pour one good long pour of worcestershire sauce over the ice , salt& pepper , along with about 3-5 dashes of tabasco , or other hot pepper sauce
5. Pour 2 oz vodka into glass& top with clamato juice
6. Serve with a wedge of fresh lime squeezed into the drink , and a slice of cucumber , , on the edge of glass for nibbling

title: pineapple cake with cream cheese frosting
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Butter and flour a 13x9x2 inch baking pan
3. In medium bowl , combine flour , baking soda and salt
4. In large bowl , beat sugar , eggs and 1 / 4 cup butter until fluffy
5. Mix in pineapple with syrup , then dry ingredients
6. Transfer into prepared pan
7. Bake until cake tester inserted in center comes out clean , about 40 minutes
8. Transfer pan to wire rack , cool
9. Beat cream cheese , remaining 1 / 4 cup butter and powdered sugar in medium bowl until fluffy and blended
10. Spread frosting over cake and refrigerate until ready to serve

title: roasted garlic mashed potatoes with basil and sun dried tomatoes
steps:
1. Boil the potatoes in lightly salted water until they are tender
2. When cooked , drain the potatoes and transfer to a mixing bowl
3. Add the tomatoes , drained , the butter , basil and garlic
4. Beat to mix together
5. Add 4 tbs of the half and half , the salt and pepper
6. Add the additional half and half if the potatoes seem dry
7. Serve immediately

title: aubby gobby nana muffins
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a bowl
2. Drop by heaping spoonfuls into muffin tins
3. Bake at 350 f for 10-15 minutes , until muffins begin to brown on top
4. Serve warm with butter

title: ouzo long drink
steps:
1. Put sugar into bottom of a tall glass , add the vodka , ouzo and water
2. Stir
3. Add 3 ice cubes and fill glass with orange juice

title: ginger pancakes with maple pecan syrup
steps:
1. For the syrup , mix all ingredients in a saucepan
2. Heat to boiling
3. Keep warm over low heat
4. For the pancakes
5. Mix the first 7 ingredients in a large bowl
6. In another bowl mix the eggs , water , buttermilk , melted butter and brown sugar
7. Add to the dry ingredients
8. Mix well to combine
9. Grease a griddle with butter
10. Drop about 1 / 3 cup pancake batter onto the griddle
11. Cook the pancakes turing once until done
12. Serve with warm syrup

title: navy bean gravy
steps:
1. Saute the onion and garlic in the olive oil in a saucepan over medium heat for 5 minutes
2. Add the thyme and pepper , and cook for 3 minutes more
3. While this cooks , mix the flour into the broth thoroughly
4. Pour this into a blender with the beans and soy sauce and blend until smooth
5. Add the onion and garlic mixture to the blender and blend until the onion no longer has any big chunks visible
6. Once smooth , pour the mixture back into the saucepan and cook over medium heat until thickened
7. Reduce heat to low
8. Make the gravy thinner , if you like , by adding water and stirring until evenly mixed
9. Add salt to taste

title: grilled ham   pineapple kabobs
steps:
1. Place ham and pineapple on skewers
2. Mix together crushed pineapple and brown sugar
3. If to chunky place in blender until smooth
4. Make sure your grill is nice and hot
5. Baste kabobs with pineapple and brown sugar mix
6. Grill until heated and has nice grill marks
7. Enjoy !

title: petite filet with gorgonzola and porcini mushroom sauce
steps:
1. For the beef:
2. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
3. Sprinkle both sides of the beef with salt and pepper
4. Heat the olive oil in an oven-safe medium skillet over high heat
5. When the oil is hot , carefully place the filet in the pan
6. Cook until browned on both sides , about 3 to 4 minutes a side
7. Transfer the steak to the oven and bake until a meat thermometer reads 130 degrees f
8. For medium-rare , about 5 to 6 minutes
9. Remove the beef from the oven and let rest for 5 minutes
10. Another option is to cook the filets on the grill
11. For the sauce:
12. Heat the olive oil in a medium skillet over medium heat
13. Add the mushrooms and the shallots and cook until golden brown and tender , about 5 minutes
14. Add the thyme , white wine , salt , and pepper and continue to cook until all of the liquid has evaporated , about 5 more minutes
15. Meanwhile , put the gorgonzola , mayonnaise , and mustard in a food processor and combine until smooth
16. Transfer the gorgonzola mixture to the skillet with mushrooms and shallots
17. Gently stir the cheese mixture into the mushroom mixture
18. Slice the beef and serve topped with a dollop of the cheese sauce
19. Reserve leftover sauce for another use

title: 2 alarm chili
steps:
1. Brown beef in a dutch oven
2. Drain
3. Add tomato sauce , 2 cups water , paprika , cumin , onion flakes , garlic salt , chili powder , and ground red pepper
4. Cover and simmer for 30 minutes , stirring occasionally
5. Dissolve 2 tablespoons masa into 1 / 4 cup hot water to make a thick , but flowable mixture
6. Add masa mixture to chili
7. Cover and simmer another 15-20 minutes

title: cherry limeade for one
steps:
1. Mix together sprite , grenadine , lime juice in a glass
2. Add crushed ice , lime wedges and cherries in glass
3. Enjoy !

title: healthy for them  yogurt popsicles
steps:
1. Mix all the ingredients using a blender
2. Pour into popsicle molds
3. Freeze and enjoy !

title: gingernut biscuits
steps:
1. Pre heat oven to 350f
2. Cream the butter and the sugar
3. Add the golden syrup and the dry ingredients
4. Mix everything together and roll into little balls
5. Put onto a greased baking tray , pressing the balls down very slightly with a fork
6. Bake at 350f and 180c for 15 minutes
7. Cool on a wire rack and keep in an airtight container once cold

title: garlic chicken tomato fry
steps:
1. In a frying pan on medium high heat , fry chicken with oil and garlic for 10 minutes
2. Once done , diced chicken and place back into frying pan
3. Adding remaining ingredients , fry for 7 minutes on medium heat

title: the ultimate champagne punch
steps:
1. Fill punch bowl with ice
2. Add pineapple juice and about 10 scoops of sherbet
3. Add champagne and ginger ale
4. Stir and serve !

title: pork and bok choy stir fry
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl , combine cornstarch and sugar
2. Stir in white wine and soy sauce until smooth
3. Set aside
4. In a large nonstick skillet or wok , stir fry pork in canola oil until lightly browned
5. Add carrots , garlic and ginger
6. Stir-fry for 2 minutes
7. Add bok choy to skillet and stir-fry until bok choy is wilted
8. Stir soy sauce mixture and add to skillet
9. Bring to a boil
10. Cook and stir 2 minutes or until sauce is thickened
11. Serve with rice or noodles

title: cranberried monte cristo strata
steps:
1. Spray 13 x 9-inch baking dish with cooking spray
2. Using serrated knife , cut baguette into 1 / 2-inch slices
3. Toast both sides until crisp and golden brown around edges
4. Mix 1 / 2 cup cranberry sauce and the mustard in small bowl
5. Spread over 1 side toasted baguette slices
6. Arrange half of slices , cranberry side up , in bottom of dish , overlapping if necessary
7. Sprinkle evenly with turkey , ham and cheese
8. Top with remaining toast , cranberry side down
9. Combine eggs , milk , salt , pepper and pepper sauce in large bowl
10. Whisk until well blended and slightly frothy
11. Pour egg mixture carefully into baking dish , making sure bread is soaked with liquid
12. Cover
13. Refrigerate at least 4 hours or overnight
14. Preheat oven to 350f
15. Uncover baking dish
16. Bake for 60 to 70 minutes or until puffed and top is slightly golden and toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
17. Let cool for 10 minutes
18. Meanwhile , blend remaining cranberry sauce and the vinegar in small bowl
19. Just before serving , sift powdered sugar over strata
20. Top each serving with dollop of cranberry mixture

title: grilled skirt steak vietnamese style
steps:
1. Start a charcoal or wood fire , or heat a gas grill
2. Fire should be moderately hot
3. Grill rack should be no more than 4 inches from heat source
4. Combine first 7 ingredients in a blender or food processor and pure
5. Add herbs and pulse to chop finely , but not quite pure
6. Taste and adjust seasonings as you like
7. Sprinkle steak with salt and pepper and grill 4 minutes a side
8. Cut into 4 steaks , arrange over lettuce , and serve with sauce
9. Or cut into strips , wrap each strip in a lettuce leaf , top with a bit of sauce and roll up

title: basic guacamole
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , scoop the flesh of the avocados and mash lightly
2. Add the remaining ingredients and stir gently
3. The mixture should be a mix of chunky and smooth
4. Taste and adjust seasoning as necessary
5. Serve with tortilla chips

title: bacon curry coleslaw
steps:
1. Combine mayonnaise , vinegar , sugar and curry powder
2. Cover and chill
3. Combine cabbage , raisins and green onions: cover and chill
4. Just before serving , combine cabbage mixture , bacon and peanuts in a bowl
5. Add the mayonnaise mixture to this and toss well to coat

title: army chili  1896
steps:
1. In a very large skillet , briefly fry the steak in the bacon drippings
2. Add 1 cup of hot water and the rice
3. Cover and allow to simmer over very low heat until the rice is tender
4. Put the chilies into a bowl and pour in the second cup of boiling water over them and allow to stand until cool
5. Then , hand-squeeze the chilies until the water is red
6. Add the flour to the chili water and blend which should make it thicken
7. Discard the chili hulls
8. Add the chili water to the beef in the skillet and also add the salt and onions
9. Allow to simmer for about 10 more minutes and serve

title: poached chicken
steps:
1. Place chicken in a large saucepan
2. Add water and remaining ingredients , and bring to a boil
3. Reduce heat , and simmer , uncovered , for 5 minutes or until chicken is done
4. Remove from heat , let stand , uncovered , 20 minutes
5. Place chicken and poaching liquid in a large bowl
6. Cover and chill , or , put just the chicken in freezer bags and freeze for another time

title: smoked sausage soup
steps:
1. Heat oil in a dutch oven over medium-high heat
2. Add sausage , onion , celery , carrot , and garlic
3. Saute for 5 minutes or until vegetables are tender
4. Add chicken broth , tomatoes and rice , and bring to a boil
5. Cover , reduce heat , and simmer 15 minutes or until rice is done
6. Salt and black pepper to taste
7. Remove from heat and add spinach
8. Stir until spinach wilts
9. Grab a big bowl and enjoy !

title: buffalo french fries
steps:
1. Bake fries as directed on the package
2. Should be somewhere around 450 for 15 minutes
3. Put margarine , hot sauce , and garlic in a small bowl
4. Microwave on high for 30 seconds , until margarine is melted
5. Put fries in a large , sealable bowl
6. Pour sauce over fries , seal bowl and shake very , very gently until fries are coated
7. Sprinkle desired amount of salt over fries

title: french walnut oil vinaigrette
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients
2. Shake and enjoy ! a little goes a long way

title: awesome spinach quiche
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. In a medium skillet , melt butter over medium heat
3. Saute garlic and onion in butter until lightly browned , about 7 minutes
4. Stir in spinach , mushrooms , feta and 1 / 2 cup cheddar cheese
5. Season with salt and pepper
6. Spoon mixture into pie crust
7. In a medium bowl , whisk together eggs and milk
8. Season with salt and pepper
9. Pour into the pastry shell , allowing egg mixture to thoroughly combine with spinach mixture
10. Bake in preheated oven for 15 minutes
11. Sprinkle top with remaining cheddar cheese , and bake an additional 35 to 40 minutes , until set in center
12. Allow to stand 10 minutes before serving

title: grilled onion with rosemary
steps:
1. Combine oil , honey , rosemary and dijon mustard
2. Brush on onion slices
3. Grill onion slices for 3-5 minutes until tender and marked with grill marks

title: pork wellington
steps:
1. Trim off all silverskin
2. Butterfly making a 1" deep incision down the length of each and stuff each one with half of the cheese
3. Roll prosciutto around each tenderloin
4. Sear in oil in a large skillet over med-high heat until prosciutto is brown and crisp on all sides
5. Chill thoroughly
6. Wrap each tenderloin in puff pastry and transfer to a parchment-line baking sheet
7. Brush wellingtons with egg wash and decorate with pastry cutouts if desired
8. Cover with plastic and chill 1 hr
9. Bake at 400f in lower third of oven for 30-35 minutes until golden brown
10. Let rest 5 minutes before slicing

title: magical moroccan chicken and chickpeas
steps:
1. Day before , pick over chickpeas and turn into a large bowl
2. Cover with cold water
3. Refrigerate , covered , overnight
4. Next day , drain chickpeas
5. Turn into a large kettle
6. Add 2 quarts cold water , 2 t
7. Salt , the quartered onion and bay leaf
8. Bring to boiling and reduce heat
9. Simmer , covered , 1-1 / 2 to 2 hours , or until tender
10. Drain
11. Set aside
12. Remove and discard onion and bay leaf
13. Meanwhile , rinse chicken well
14. Dry with paper towels
15. Sprinkle inside with 1 t
16. Salt
17. Tuck w ings under body
18. Then tie legs together at ends with twine
19. If necessary , fasten skin at neck with a skewer
20. In a small bowl , combine garlic , ginger , 1 / 2 t
21. Salt , the pepper and 1 t
22. Water
23. Mix well
24. Brush mixture over entire surface of chicken
25. Refrigerate chicken in large bowl , covered with plastic wrap or foil , one hour
26. In 6-quart dutch oven , combine chopped onion , turmeric , chopped parsley , cinnamon stick , butter and chicken broth
27. Over medium heat , bring to boiling , stirring constantly
28. Lower heat
29. Then add chicken , breast side down , and any juices left in bottom of the bowl
30. Simmer , covered , 1 hour , or until chicken is tender
31. Remove cooked chicken to warm serving platter
32. Discard cinnamon stick
33. To liquid left in dutch oven , add slice onion , raisins and drained chickpeas
34. Bring to boiling
35. Cook , stirring frequently with wooden spoon , until onion is soft and flavors have blended - about 15 minutes
36. Before serving , remove twine
37. Reheat chicken in chickpea mixture for 5 minutes
38. Serve chicken and chickpeas together

title: just like thanksgiving chicken  oamc dump
steps:
1. To make in a pan:
2. Place the chicken breasts on the bottom of the pan
3. Layer the apples , sweet potatoes , and onion on top
4. Sprinkle on the nuts and craisins
5. Place one pat of butter on each breast
6. Mix the maple syrup and poultry seasoning together and drizzle on top
7. To make in a bag:
8. Put everything except the maple syrup , poultry seasoning , and butter into a ziplock bag
9. Melt the butter and combine with poultry seasoning and maple syrup
10. Put these in a little bowl and freeze separately
11. When ready to cook , dump the bag out and then pour the syrup butter mix on top
12. To cook: thaw
13. Cook covered in a 350 oven for 30-45 minutes
14. I confess i normally skip the thaw step and put it in the oven

title: amaretto apricot cookies
steps:
1. Beat butter at medium speed of an electric mixer until creamy
2. Gradually add the brown sugar and 1 / 2 cup sugar , beating well
3. Add the egg and 1 tbsp of the amaretto , beating well
4. Combine flour and baking soda
5. Add to the butter mixture , beating well
6. Stir in the oats , apricots , and almonds
7. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheets
8. Bake at 375 for 7 to 8 minutes or until lightly browned
9. Cool 1 minute on cookie sheets before removing to wire racks
10. Let cool completely
11. Combine the powdered sugar and 3 to 4 tbsp amaretto , stirring until smooth
12. Drizzle the amaretto glaze over the cookies

title: amazing asparagus bundles
steps:
1. Cut off the crust of each piece of bread
2. Roll with rolling pin until flat
3. Spread a thin layer of cream cheese on each piece of bread and top with asparagus
4. Roll the bread around the asparagus and seal edges
5. With a pastry brush brush each bundle with butter and sprinkle with cheese
6. You can also roll the bundles in cheese
7. Bake at 375 for 10-15 minutes or until golden brown

title: kittencal s roasted brussels brussels sprouts
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees f
2. Grease a 13 x 9-inch baking dish
3. Slice off a small piece of the bottom core off of each brussels sprout then remove the outer layer of leaves and discard then place the sprouts in a large bowl
4. In a small bowl whisk together the oil with melted butter , garlic powder and salt
5. Pour over the sprouts and toss well to coat
6. Transfer to baking pan
7. Bake for about 35-40 minutes or until golden brown tossing a few times during cooking
8. Transfer to a bowl then sprinkle with parmesan cheese

title: club chicken casserole better homes and gardens 1977
steps:
1. In a saucepan bring chicken broth and rice to boiling
2. Reduce heat
3. Cook , covered , for 15 minutes
4. Remove from heat
5. Let stand , covered , for 10 minutes
6. Meanwhile , cook broccoli according to package directions
7. Drain well
8. In a saucepan melt butter or margarine
9. Stir in flour , salt , and pepper
10. Add milk all at once
11. Cook and stir till thickened an bubbly
12. Stir in chicken , cooked rice , drained broccoli , and mushrooms
13. Turn into a 2-quart casserole
14. Bake , covered at 350 degrees till heated through , 30 to 35 munutes
15. Sprinkle with almonds and garnish with parsley on top

title: luby s cafeteria sweet potato crunch casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f and grease or spray a casserole dish with cooking spray
2. In a beater bowl , mash cooked sweet potatoes until smooth
3. Add milk , eggs , sugar , nutmeg , cinnamon and margarine
4. Whip until smooth and well blended
5. Put into baking dish , cover with foil and bake for 25 minutes
6. Remove foil
7. Mix all topping ingredients together and spread over top of sweet potatoes
8. Bake uncovered for eight to 10 more minutes
9. Serve while hot

title: yeast free garlic rolls
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit and grease 24-count muffin tin
2. Mix the dry ingredients until homogeneous
3. Add wet ingredients
4. Knead dough for 2-3 minutes
5. Fill each section of the muffin tin so that the top part of the dough comes just above the rim and the majority of the section is filled
6. Bake at 375 degrees for 10 minutes or until the dough is a slightly darker brown and has a hard outer shell but still gives
7. Garlic sauce: put all of the ingredients into a small bowl and whisk with a fork until the mixture looks creamy and you cannot see any large lumps of butter
8. Brush the rolls with liberal amounts of the garlic sauce right when they come out of the oven before you take them out of the tin
9. Add 1-1 / 2 cups of water to begin with and then add small amounts as you mix until a very slightly sticky dough forms and there is no more flour
10. Should look kind of like the garlic sauce from a "fast-food" pizza chain

title: smash cake
steps:
1. Mix the first three ingredients together
2. Press into the bottom of an ungreased 9 x 13 pan
3. Press pecans into batter
4. Beat cream cheese , 2 eggs , and powdered sugar till smooth and pour over batter
5. Place pan on a cookie sheet and place in a 350 oven for 35-45 minutes
6. Do not cut till cool

title: barbecue ranch dip
steps:
1. Whisk together first 3 ingredients
2. Cover and chill 30 minutes
3. I put chill time as cook time for planning purposes

title: crispy roasted chickpeas with moroccan spices
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Drain garbanzo beans into a colander and rinse well with cold water until no more foam appears
3. Let beans drain for 5 to 10 minutes , then pat dry with a cloth or paper towel if they still look wet
4. While beans drain , make spice mix
5. When beans are well drained and dried , toss with olive oil , spice mix , and salt
6. Arrange in a single layer on a baking sheet
7. Roast 40 to 50 minutes or until they are slightly browned and make a rattling sound when you shake the baking sheet
8. Serve warm or let cool

title: creamy mexican crab dip
steps:
1. Place cheeses in a microwave-safe bowl , and cover with wax paper
2. Microwave at medium 2 to 3 minutes or until softened , stirring with a wire whisk until smooth
3. Drain crabmeat through a sieve into a bowl , reserving 1 tablespoon liquid
4. Add reserved liquid , crabmeat , and salsa to cheese
5. Stir well
6. Serve warm or at room temperature with baked tortilla chips , raw vegetables , or breadsticks

title: chinese plum sauce
steps:
1. In large heavy saucepan , bring plums , onions , water , ginger and garlic to boil over medium heat
2. Cover , reduce heat to low and simmer , stirring occasionally , until plums and onions are very tender , about 30 minutes
3. Press through food mill or sieve and return to clean pan
4. Stir in sugar , vinegar , coriander , salt , cinnamon , pepper and cloves
5. Bring to boil , stirring
6. Reduce heat to low and simmer until mixture reaches consistency of applesauce , about 45 minutes
7. Fill and seal jars
8. Process in boiling water bath for 30 minutes
9. Makes about 4 cups

title: toasted nori with sesame seeds
steps:
1. Toast the nori by passing each sheet repeatedly over a hot burner untli it becomes crisp and the color dulls
2. Put the sheets together and using scissors , slice them into thin strips , then into squares
3. Toast the seeds and salt in a dry skillet over medium heat until the seeds begin to color
4. Grind them just enough for the salt to adhere
5. You can use a coffee grinder or a mortar and pestle

steps:

title: amazingly good eggnog
steps:
1. Combine milk , cloves , 1 / 2 teaspoons vanilla and cinnamon in a saucepan
2. Heat over lowest setting for 12 minutes
3. Slowly bring milk mixture to boil
4. In a large bowl combine egg yolks and sugar
5. Whisk together until fluffy
6. Whisk hot milk mixture slowly into the eggs
7. Pour mixture back into saucepan
8. Cook over medium heat , stirring constantly , for 3 minutes , or until slightly thickened

10. Strain to remove cloves and let cool for about an hour

13. Sprinkle more nutmeg on individual servings , if desired

title: sauteed escarole
steps:
1. Discard or trim any tough outer leaves

5. Heat the olive oil and saute the garlic until it turns pale brown , about 2 minutes
6. Add in beans , it's ok if they get mashed while stirring
7. Stir in the escarole until it wilts
8. Stir in all of the other ingredients and saute for about a minute
9. Serve hot topped with grated cheese

title: vegan  cream  of mushroom soup
steps:
1. In a 4 quart pot , saute the mushrooms in soy butter till they get soft
2. Add the garlic , continue to stir occassionally
3. Saute on low heat for 10 minutes
4. In a blender , puree the cashews with the water
5. The smoother the better
6. Pour pureed cashews into the pot with the mushrooms
7. Add the chili powder , nutmeg , salt and italian seasonings
8. Stir frequently until it begins to thicken
9. You may add corn starch to help thicken the soup , depending on how thick you want it

11. Serve

6. Place chicken on an oven sheet and bake in preheated oven for 20 minutes
7. To make sauce: melt butter in a large saucepan over medium heat
8. Stir in 1 tbsp garam masala
9. When masala begins to puff and bubble , mix in ginger , garlic paste and green chile peppers
10. Saute 5 minutes , then stir in tomato puree , tomato paste , chili powder , salt , 1 / 2 tbsp garam masala and a couple more drops of liquid smoke
11. Bring to a boil
12. Reduce heat to low and simmer , stirring in honey , fenugreek and cream

steps:

6. Stir in wine , tomatoes , kidney beans , and pinto beans

4. Add flour and almonds and mix until combined well
5. Set aside until ready to use
6. Assembly:
7. Roll out pastry into a 15 x 9-inch rectangle
8. Set aside

4. Transfer chicken legs to large stockpot
5. Pour off all the fat from the roasting pan
6. Pour 1 / 2 cup of the water into the roasting pan and scrape up any browned bits clinging to the pan
7. Add these juices to stock pot along with chicken
8. Add remaining 2 quarts of water , carrot juice , and mixed vegetable juice
9. Bring to a boil over high heat , skimming off foam as it rises to the surface
10. Continue skimming until no foam remains
11. Add onions , carrots , leek , celery , garlic , rosemary , thyme , parsley , and bay leaves
12. Return to a boil , continuing to skim any foam that rises
13. Reduce heat to low and simmer until broth is rich and flavorful , about 2 hours
14. Strain broth and discard solids
15. Refrigerate broth
16. Remove fat that solidifies on the surface
17. Can be refrigerated up to 3 days or frozen for longer storage

title: greek casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Brown beef and onions in butter
3. Slowly , add tomato paste , wine , spices and diced tomatoes
4. Simmer 10 minutes
5. Let cool
6. Mix in the egg and fine bread crumbs
7. Mix together parmesan and romano cheeses
8. Set aside
9. Butter a large casserole dish
10. Cover the bottom with coarse bread crumbs
11. Layer half the macaroni on top of the bread crumbs and cover with 1 / 4 cup of the cheese mixture
12. Top this layer with the beef mixture
13. Top with half of the remaining cheese mixture then layer the remaining macaroni
14. Top with tomato sauce and remaining cheese mixture
15. Top it all with remaining bread crumbs
16. Pour melted butter evenly over all
17. Bake 30 minutes in 400f degree oven

title: kid friendly  budget friendly  simple mock pizza
steps:
1. Lightly toast the english muffin or bread
2. Top with the sauce , then cheese , and then toppings of your choice
3. Microwave for 30 seconds or place in toaster oven for a few minutes- long enough for the cheese to melt

title: blood regenerator  juicer
steps:
1. Place in juicer 1-2 carrots at a time
2. Then spinach and lettuce leaves
3. Then juice 1 / 2 beet and parsley together
4. Stir and serve

title: double chocolate chunk biscotti
steps:
1. Grease a large cookie sheet
2. Set aside
3. In a large mixing bowl beat butter with an electric mixer on medium speed for 30 seconds
4. Add sugar , cocoa powder , and baking powder
5. Beat until combined
6. Beat in eggs
7. Beat in as much flour as you can
8. Stir in any remaining flour
9. Stir in the 4 ounces white baking bar and the 3 ounces semisweet chocolate
10. Divide dough in half
11. Shape each half into a 9-inch-long roll
12. Place rolls 4 inches apart on prepared cookie sheet
13. Flatten rolls slightly to 2 inches wide
14. Bake in a 375 degree f oven for 20 to 25 minutes or until a wooden toothpick inserted near the centers comes out clean
15. Cool on cookie sheet on a wire rack for 1 hour
16. Using a serrated knife , cut each roll diagonally into 1 / 2-inch-thick slices
17. Lay slice , one cut side down , on an ungreased cookie sheet
18. Bake slices in a 325 degree f oven for 8 minutes
19. Turn slices over and bake 7 to 9 minutes more or until slices are dry and crisp
20. Transfer to a wire rack
21. Cool
22. If desired , in a heavy small saucepan combine the shortening and the 2 ounces semisweet chocolate or white baking bar
23. Cook and stir over low heat until melted and smooth
24. Drizzle over tops of biscotti
25. Let stand until set
26. Store in an airtight container up to 1 week
27. Makes 32 biscotti

title: belgian hare a la maryland
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325f
2. Place butter in an uncovered roasting pan and place in oven to melt
3. Sprinkle meat with salt and pepper
4. Roll in flour , then beaten eggs , then cracker crumbs
5. Place meat in roaster and add onion and bay leaf
6. Bake for 1 1 / 2 to 2 hours or until tender , basting frequently

title: ham potato scallop
steps:
1. 1- saut onion in butter until tender
2. Stir in flour , salt , pepper , & mustard
3. Gradually pour in milk , & stirring constantly , cook until sauce is thickened
4. Add cheese & stir until blended
5. 2- in a greased 2- quart casserole , alternate layers of sliced raw potato , diced ham , & celery
6. Pour over part of the cheese sauce , & continue to arrange ingredients in layers until all are used
7. Pour remaining cheese sauce over all & sprinkle w / more cheese
8. 3- bake , covered , in 350 over for 1 hour
9. Remove cover & continue baking 35-45 minutes longer , or until potatoes are tender & lightly browned on top

title: couscous salad with avocado   prawns
steps:
1. Place the couscous in a heatproof bowl
2. Place the stock and water in a saucepan over medium heat
3. Bring to the boil
4. Stir in the oil
5. Pour the stock mixture over the couscous
6. Stir to combine
7. Set aside , covered , for 3 minutes or until the liquid is absorbed
8. Use a fork to separate grains
9. Set aside for 5 minutes to cool
10. Meanwhile , to make the dressing , whisk together the lemon rind , lemon juice and oil in a small bowl
11. Season with salt and pepper
12. Add the cucumber , carrot , avocado , prawns and mint to the couscous , and toss to combine
13. Add the dressing and toss to combine
14. Divide among serving bowls and serve

title: chicken fettuccine alfredo
steps:
1. Cream the butter in a bowl with a wooden spoon until it is light and fluffy
2. Beat in the cream a little at a time , and then beat in 1 / 2 cup grated parmesan cheese , a few tbsp at a time
3. Cover the bowl and set it aside
4. Prepare the chicken and keep it warm
5. You can use leftover chopped cooked chicken , or dice skinless , boneless chicken meat and saute in olive oil or butter a few minutes until cooked but still tender
6. Season as you like
7. Set a large pasta bowl or casserole in a 250 oven to heat while you cook the fettucine
8. Bring the water and salt to a rolling boil in a large stock pot
9. Drop in the fettuccine and stir gently with a wooden spoon or fork for a few moments to prevent strands from sticking
10. Boil , stirring occasionally until the pasta is tender
11. Immediately drain the pasta into a colander
12. Make sure it's completely drained before transferring to the hot pasta bowl
13. Add the chicken and the creamed butter and cheese mixture and toss with the fettuccine and chicken until every strand is well coated
14. Season with salt and freshly grated pepper
15. Serve at once and pass grated parmesan cheese

title: double chocolate lava babies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
2. Toast chopped pecans in heavy skillet over med-hi heat until lightly toasted
3. Remove and toast pecan halves
4. Remove and set aside
5. Lightly grease and flour six 10-oz custard cups or 12 regular-sized cup muffin pan
6. Place custard cups in a shallow baking pan and set pan aside
7. Prepare brownie mix as indicated for cake-like brownies
8. Divide batter evenly into prepared cups
9. Bake 10 minutes only
10. Meanwhile prepare praline sauce
11. In a heavy saucepan over low-heat caramel ice cream topping
12. Or make recipe:77540 by rital
13. Stir in whipping cream
14. Cook about 1-3 minutes stirring constantly
15. Add chopped pecans
16. Blend
17. Remove brownies from oven
18. Using a small knife , puncture top of each partially-baked cake and gently enlarge to make a dime-sized hole
19. Slowly spoon about 1 / 2-1 tablespoon praline sauce into center of each cake
20. Return cakes to oven
21. Bake 5-8 minutes more or until cakes feel firm at edges
22. Cool in baking pan on a wire rack for 5 minutes
23. Using a small thin knife , loosen edges from sides of cup and slip cake out upright onto individual dessert plates
24. Stir toasted pecan halves into the remaining praline sauce
25. If necessary , stir add 1 / 2-1 tablespoons hot water to remaining sauce to thin
26. Split cakes partially open
27. Spoon warm praline sauce on top
28. Top with sweetened whipped cream and pecan halves
29. Serve immediately

title: roast chicken with lemon and figs
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400
2. Spray a 9 x 13-inch baking dish with nonstick spray
3. Trim the ends from 1 lemon: cut into very thin , round slices
4. Place the lemon slices and the figs in the baking dish
5. You may want extra lemon slices
6. They are really good to eat after they have been cooking under the chicken
7. Arrange the chicken breast or pieces
8. Sprinkle with salt and pepper
9. Squeeze enough juice from the remaining 2 lemons to equal 3 tablespoons
10. Transfer to a small bowl
11. Stir in the brown sugar , vinegar and water
12. Pour the lemon mixture over the chicken
13. Cover the baking dish loosely with foil
14. Roast the chicken 35 minutes
15. Remove the foil and roast , uncovered , basting the chicken twice , until cooked through , 15 minutes more
16. With a slotted spoon transfer the chicken , figs and lemon slices with a slotted spooon to a serving platter
17. Discard the fat from the pan drippings
18. Spoon over the chicken

title: sweet potato pork stew for 2
steps:
1. In a small bowl toss pork with mustard
2. In a large resealable plastic bag , combine flour and sugar
3. Add pork and shake to coat
4. In a large sauce pan pour oil and cook pork , onions and garlic until pork is browned in all sides
5. Stir in broth
6. Bring to boil
7. Reduce heat
8. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes
9. Stir in sweet potatoes
10. Return to a boil
11. Reduce heat
12. Cover and simmer 20 minutes or until meat and vegetables are tender
13. Season to taste with salt and pepper and serve

title: italian sun dried tomato  provolone and pesto torte
steps:
1. Bring a small saucepan of water to a boil
2. Turn off the heat
3. Place sun-dried tomatoes in the water , and cover for 5 minutes
4. Drain , and finely chop
5. In a medium bowl , mix cream cheese and garlic
6. Line a medium bowl or loaf pan with a large piece of dampened cheese cloth
7. Layer with 1 / 3 of the provolone cheese
8. Spread with 1 / 2 of the cream cheese mixture
9. Pour in 1 / 2 of the pesto
10. Layer with 1 / 2 of the sun-dried tomatoes
11. Layer with 1 / 3 of the provolone cheese , remaining cream cheese mixture , remaining pesto , and remaining sun-dried tomatoes
12. Top with remaining provolone cheese
13. Pull cheese cloth around the layered mixture and gently press into a bowl to mold and remove excess oil
14. Chill in the refrigerator for 3-4 hours
15. Remove cheese cloth and invert onto serving platter
16. Garnish as desired with basil , sun-dried tomatoes , pine nuts , lemon wedges , olive oil , etc
17. Enjoy !

title: wine and cheese omelet
steps:
1. Butter 2 shallow 3-quart baking dishes
2. Spread bread over bottom of baking dishes and drizzle with melted butter
3. Sprinkle with swiss and montery jack cheeses and salami
4. Beat together eggs , milk , wine , green onions , mustard , pepper and red pepper until foamy
5. Pour over cheese
6. Cover dishes with foil and refrigerate overnight
7. Remove from refrigerator about 30 minutes before baking
8. Preheat oven to 325 degrees
9. Bake casseroles , covered , until set , about 1 hour
10. Uncover
11. Spread with sour cream and sprinkle with parmesan cheese
12. Bake uncovered until crusty and lightly browned , about 10 minutes

title: gerri s no peek chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees farenheit
2. In a large bowl mix first 5 ingredients together
3. Place chicken in 9x13 baking dish and pour mixture over top of chicken
4. Cover with foil and bake for 1 1 / 2 hours in preheated oven

title: yummy banana strawberry cheesecake pudding
steps:
1. Slice pound cake and layer on the bottom of a cake pan
2. Slice bananas and strawberries and layer slices on top of cake
3. Mix pudding mix & milk then pour over cake and fruit
4. Top with cool whip
5. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour and enjoy

title: fruits afire
steps:
1. Drain pears , aprictos and cherries , reserving syrup
2. Combine syrups in a saucepan with lemon juice , cinnamon stick , apricot preserves and 2 tablespoons of the rum
3. Bring to a boil and cook until reduced by half
4. Remove cinnamon stick and pour syrup over fruits
5. Refrigerate until about 30 minutes before serving
6. Place fruit and syrup in an oven proof casserole
7. Cover casserole and heat in a 350 degrees fahrenheit oven just until fruit is hot , about 5 minutes
8. Warm remaining 4 tablespoons rum
9. At the table , ignite the rum and pour flaming over the fruit
10. Serve when flames have died out

title: lamb and chickpea stew
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a heavy based saucepan , and cook the onion and garlic over medium heat until the onion is tender
2. Stir in the spices and cook for 1 minute or until aroma is released
3. Add the lamb and brown well , stirring constantly
4. Stir in the tomatoes , stock and juice
5. Bring to the boil , stirring , then reduce the heat and cook for 1 hour or until the lamb is tender
6. Add the chickpeas and cook for a further 15 minutes
7. Sprinkle with the herbs and pepper and serve

title: apple crumble in a jar
steps:
1. Tag instructions:
2. You will need:
3. 1 / 3 cup softened butter or margarine
4. 4 sliced tart apples
5. Preheat oven to 375
6. Butter an baking dish / pan
7. Place the apple slices in the baking dish
8. Pour the contents of the jar into a bowl
9. Add the butter to the jar mix and mix until crumbly
10. Sprinkle over top of the apples
11. Bake for 30 minutes
12. Serve warm with ice cream or whipped cream
13. Makes 8 servings

title: creamed peas
steps:
1. In a saucepan , melt the butter in the oil over low heat
2. Add the onion
3. Cook for about 15 minutes or until tender and golden
4. Stir occasionally
5. Add peas and just enough water to reach the top of the peas
6. Bring to a simmer
7. Cover and cook for 15 minutes or until peas are very tender
8. Add cream and cook until the liquid thickens into a sauce--about 5 or 6 minutes
9. Season to taste with salt and pepper

title: chana ko tarkari
steps:
1. Heat oil in wok or large pot
2. Fry red chills for a few seconds until almost black
3. Add onion and stir for about 3 minutes
4. Add garlic and ginger , stir for about 1 minute
5. Then add curry powder and turmeric and stir for another minute
6. Add garbanzo beans , stir , and add in water
7. Cover and cook for 10-15 minutes over medium heat
8. Add tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes
9. Garnish with cilantro and red onion and serve

title: stir fried cucumbers
steps:
1. Peel the cucumbers , cut them in half lengthways and remove the seeds using a teaspoon
2. Cut the cucumber in 1 inch cubes , put them in a colander , sprinkle with the salt , mix and let them stand for about 20 minutes to drain excess liquid
3. Then rinse them in water and dry them with kitchen paper
4. Heat a wok , then add the oil , when the oil is hot adding the bean sauce , garlic and black beans , stir-fry for 30 seconds
5. Now add the cucumbers , fry them until coated with the spices , add the water and go on stir-frying for several minutes on a high heat until most of the water has evaporated
6. Add the sesame oil , mix and serve

title: double apple walnut scones
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f spray a baking sheet with non-stick cooking spray
2. Place apple juice in a small bowl and microwave on high for 3 minutes or until juice boils
3. Remove from microwave and add the raisins and dried chopped apples and let stand 15 minutes
4. Combine buttermilk , sugar , butter and the apple juice mixture in a large bowl
5. In a separate bowl , mix flour , walnuts , baking powder , baking soda and salt
6. Add flour mixture to the buttermilk mixture , stirring just until moist
7. Drop the dough into 12 rounds onto the baking sheet coated with non-stick spray
8. Bake at 350f for 15-17 minutes or until golden in color
9. Let cool on a wire rack

title: chocolate shoofly pie   lancaster county pa recipe
steps:
1. For topping - mix molasses , hot water & vanilla
2. Set aside
3. Cream eggs , sugar & shortening
4. Add remaining ingredients , adding molasses mixture last
5. For 'pudding' - bring water to a boil
6. Add remaining ingredients and stir / cook until thick
7. Pour pudding into 6 unbaked pie shells
8. Put topping on top of each of the six pies
9. Bake @ 350 for 1 hour
10. Cool completely
11. Add frosting , if desired
12. For chocolate frosting - in saucepan , combine first 4 ingredients
13. Slowly add water
14. Stir over high heat constantly until thickened
15. Remove from heat , and add vanilla and butter
16. Spread on cooled pies

title: mexican pork roast  crock pot
steps:
1. Place onions and carrots in crock pot
2. Rub pork roast with seasonings
3. Place on top of vegetables
4. Add water
5. Cover and cook on low for 10-12 hours
6. To serve: shred and serve on hot tortillas with taco sauce

title: tomato   mozzarella bites
steps:
1. Usining a toothpick , spear a half of a tomato , a piece of basil , a mozzarella ball , and another half of a tomato
2. Repeat with remaining ingredients
3. Place on a service dish and sprinkle with salt and pepper
4. Mix the vinegar and oil together in a small bowl to serve as a dipping sauce , or you can marinate appetizers in a bowl with marinade poured over

title: the realtor s dijon fried onions for burgers and steaks
steps:
1. Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat
2. Add onions and garlic and cook until onions are soft and browned , about 15 to 20 minutes
3. Add mustard and stir , add 1 to 2 tablespoons water to deglaze pan
4. Cook another 2 or 3 minutes until the water is gone

title: saucy chicken skillet
steps:
1. Saute chicken and peppers in a sprayed or lightly oiled skillet until browned on both sides
2. Add garlic and cook , stirring constantly for about 30 seconds
3. Stir in cream cheese , broth , dressing , onions and basil
4. Cook stirring often until sauce begins to thicken and chicken is cooked through
5. Stir in tomatoes and cook for 2 minutes
6. Serve over pasta or rice

title: bruschetta  16
steps:
1. Place diced tomatoes in a bowl with oil , garlic , pepper and salt
2. Mix well and set aside
3. Slice bread and toast until browned
4. Cut bread into slices and top with tomato mixture

title: peabody cookies
steps:
1. Cream together margarine and butter
2. Slightly beat the egg and add to creme mixture
3. Add the sugar to mixture
4. Add flour slowly and beat until thouroughly blended
5. Add vanilla
6. Dough will be stiff
7. Prepare dough into long rolls and refrigerate overnite
8. Slice and bake for 12-15 minutes in 350f oven

title: sarah s  m   m cookies
steps:
1. Cream together shortening and sugars
2. Add vanilla and eggs , then dry ingredients
3. Add the flour as the recipe states , in those increments , mixing at each addition
4. Bake for 8 min at 375 on an ungreased cookie sheet
5. Do not over bake
6. I know the flour looks weired but thats the way sharon did it and hers all ways turned out great-- i tried doing it differently and they were not as good

title: rice casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Spray 12x8 glass pan with cooking spray
3. In large skillet , saute the butter and onion until golden , about 5 min
4. Remove from heat
5. Stir in the hot cooked rice , sour cream , cottage cheese , bay leaf , and salt and pepper
6. Toss lightly to mix well
7. Layer half the rice mixture in the bottom of the baking dish
8. Next , layer one can of the chiles on top , then half of the cheese
9. Repeat the rice , chiles , cheese layers once more
10. Bake uncovered , 25 minutes or until bubbly and hot

title: sizzling steak   chinese
steps:
1. Peel onions and cut into wedges
2. Beat the thinly sliced meat slightly with a meat mallet
3. Mix the water and baking soda , pour over steak and leave to stand 1 hour
4. This helps to tenderise the meat , but not an essential step
5. Heat 2 tbsp oil in a pan or wok
6. Cook onions until nice and caramelised
7. Remove the onions from pan and arrange on a plate
8. Add 2 tbsp oil to the pan , add the drained steak and cook over high heat to dry the water and brown the meat
9. Add the sauces , wine and sugar to the pan with the steak
10. Return to the boil , reduce heat and simmer for 10-15 minutes or until tender
11. Spoon the meat over the onions and serve

title: easy   delicious apple crumble  gluten free
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Cut each apple into thin wedges
3. Place the apples wedges in a deep baking dish
4. Make sure that the dish is not too big so you will have more than one layer of apple wedges in the bottom of the dish
5. Sprinkle the apple wedges evenly with cinnamon and 2 tablespoons of brown sugar
6. To prepare the crumble crust , combine nuts , flour mix and 4 tablespoons of sugar in a bowl
7. Add in the butter and knead with your hands until the dough resembles breadcrumbs
8. Spread the crumble mixture all over the apples
9. Bake in the oven until the apples are tender and the topping mixture is golden
10. Serve warm with vanilla ice cream on the side if desired
11. Enjoy !

title: kittencal s beef and  bell pepper sandwich
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat
2. Add in sliced bell peppers and onions with cayenne pepper
3. Saute stirring until softened
4. Add in garlic and cook stirring for 2-3 minutes
5. Season with black pepper and salt
6. Pile / divide the sliced beef onto the toasted buns then sprinkle the beef with freshly ground black pepper
7. Place the cheese onto the beef then place the bell pepper mixture and sauteed mushrooms on top of the cheese
8. Cover with the remaining toasted half of the roll
9. Wrap each roll in a paper towel and microwave until just heated through

title: chocolate heart  adult beverage
steps:
1. Add a few ice cubes to a highball glass
2. Pour in liqueurs and drop in a couple maraschino cherries
3. Pour the cream down the sides of the glass and stir lightly before serving
4. You can also hold the cherries out , top with whipped cream and cherries

title: mom s most requested chocolate pie
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients except butter in a saucepan
2. Cook over medium heat until thick like pudding , stirring constantly to prevent scorching and lumping
3. When mixture becomes thick , remove from heat and add butter
4. Stir to combine
5. If lumping does occur , beat filling with a whip
6. Pour into pie shell
7. Make meringue according to your favorite recipe and top pie , sealing the edges with the meringue
8. Bake to brown meringue
9. Best if allowed to cool to lukewarm or room temperature

title: strawberry cream cheese cobbler
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Pour melted butter into a 9-by-13-inch glass baking dish
3. In a small bowl , mix together the egg , milk , flour , sugar , baking powder , and salt
4. Pour directly over the butter in the baking dish , but do not stir
5. Add the strawberries , arranging in a single layer as much as possible
6. Sprinkle cream cheese pieces and optional walnuts over strawberries
7. Place in preheated oven and bake for 45 minutes , or until top is golden brown and edges are bubbling
8. Serve hot out of the oven with choice of topping , if desired

title: mixed greens salad with grilled halloumi and anaheim chilis
steps:
1. Whisk dressing ingredients together in a small non-reactive bowl
2. Seed and stem the anaheim chilies
3. Toss chilies in olive oil with salt and pepper and set aside
4. Cover a small plate with a thin layer of olive oil and dip the slices of the halloumi cheese
5. Preheat grill or stove top grill pan until it is very hot
6. Grill tomatoes and prepared chilies , then cheese just until it shows grill marks
7. Remove cheese before it melts
8. Place the spring mix on a plate and add grilled tomatoes and chilies
9. Finally , garnish salad with halloumi cheese squares on top and pass the dressing

title: strawberry preserves bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees
2. Grease two 9x5 loaf pans
3. Cream butter , sugar , salt , baking powder , baking soda and cream of tarter until light and fluffy
4. Add strawberry preserves , strawberry extract , eggs and sour cream , mixing well
5. Add chopped pecans and slowly add 3 cups flour , mixing well
6. Pour batter into loaf pans and bake for approximatley 1 hour and 10 minutes or until toothpick inserted into the middle comes out clean

title: classic chocolate chip cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. In a medium mixing bowl stir together flour , baking soda , and salt
3. Set aside
4. In a large mixing bowl with an electric mixer on medium speed cream butter and sugars until fluffy
5. Beat in eggs , one at a time , then vanilla
6. On low speed gradually add flour mixture and mix just until blended
7. Stir in chocolate chips and walnuts
8. Drop dough by rounded tablespoonfuls 2 inches apart on ungreased baking sheets
9. Bake for 9 to 12 minutes
10. Transfer cookies to cooling racks to cool

title: pork chops hongroise
steps:
1. 1
2. Sprinkle chops with salt & pepper
3. Saute in butter until browned on both sides
4. Add onion and garlic and cook until almost tender
5. 2
6. Sprinkle chops with thyme , add bay leaf and broth / wine
7. Cover and simmer about 30 minutes
8. When chops are done , remove and keep warm
9. 3
10. Increase heat
11. Reduce liquid in skillet by half
12. Remove bay leaf
13. Reduce heat and stirring constanly add paprika and sour cream
14. Do not let boil or it may curdle
15. Pour sauce over chops and serve

title: absolute best holiday meatballs  crock pot  or not
steps:
1. Place ketchup , jelly , hot sauce , garlic powder and onion flakes in a small saucepan , and stir over medium heat until jelly melts and everything is well mixed
2. Place meatballs in a crock pot or large sauce pan and cover with sauce , stirring to mix everything up
3. Heat on low setting for 20 minutes on the stove or several hours in the crock pot , until meatballs are hot and sauce sticks to them well
4. Serve hot

title: white chocolate lace cups
steps:
1. Line a muffin tin with a piece of aluminum foil for each cup
2. Place in freezer for 5 minute
3. Microwave chips in a small microwaveable bowl until chips are melted
4. In prepared muffin cups , place a heaping teaspoon of melted chocolate and coat the bottoms and up the sides
5. Freeze 5-10 minutes
6. Carefully remove chocolate foil cups from pan
7. Peel off and discard foil
8. Spoon whipped topping into chocolate cups and top with fruit

title: cornflake energy bites
steps:
1. Place prunes , apricots and water in medium saucepan , bring to boil , reduce heat , simmer for 5 minutes or until fruit is soft and water has been absorbed
2. Add peanuts , peanut butter and cornflakes to fruit mixture , mix to combine
3. Roll 2 teaspoons of mixture into balls , then roll in coconut
4. Refrigerate until required

title: ginger chicken chowder
steps:
1. Melt butter in a large dutch oven , add onions and saute until softened
2. Add chicken broth , grated zucchini , sweet corn , sweet red pepper , finely grated ginger , salt and cayenne pepper
3. Bring to boil , simmer covered 10 minutes
4. Add fresh milk , evaporated milk , cream , thyme leaves and finely grated potatoes , bring to boil , simmer uncovered 15 minutes or until thickened
5. Add cooked chicken strips , heat through
6. Serve garnished with parsley and a pinch of fresh grated ginger

title: curried vegetable soup
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in a large pot and bring to a boil over med-high heat
2. Reduce heat , cover , and simmer , for 50-60 minutes , or until vegetables are tender to your liking
3. Serve garnished with a sprinkling of ground red pepper , if desired

title: buffalo chicken strips
steps:
1. In a small saucepan , melt butter over medium heat
2. Stir in ketchup and hot sauce
3. Remove from heat
4. Cover and reserve sauce
5. In a medium bowl , whisk together flour , 1 1 / 2 tsp of salt and 3 / 4 pepper
6. Sprinkle 1 / 2 cup flour mixture evenly on a rimmed baking sheet
7. Set aside
8. In a shallow bowl , whisk together eggs and 2 teaspoons water
9. In small batches , coat chicken in the flour mixture dip chicken in egg mixture to coat , shaking off excess
10. Dredge chicken in flour again
11. Place on floured sheet
12. In a large saucepan heat your oil to 350f add chicken only when oil has reached a hot enough temperature
13. Add half the chicken
14. Cook until golden brown , 3 to 6 minutes
15. Transfer to a paper-towel-lined plate
16. Return oil to 350f repeat with remaining chicken
17. Toss chicken with your reserved sauce and coat strips
18. Serves well with carrots and celery with blue cheese dip enjoy !

title: falafel pitas
steps:
1. Turn the grill / broiler to medium
2. Whizz briefly so that you retain some of the chunky texture to the chickpeas
3. Using your hands , shape the mixture into six burgers
4. Brush both sides of each burger with a little oil
5. Carefully place the burgers on to a grill / broiler pan lined with foil and grill / broil for 5 minutes on each side
6. Meanwhile , toast the pita breads and tear the lettuce into strips
7. Stuff the hot burgers into the pita breads
8. Add a small handful of torn lettuce and a few slices of cucumber
9. Serve drizzled with a spoonful of yogurt , if you wish

title: spicy hoisin marinade for chicken
steps:
1. Whisk all ingredients together
2. Place the chicken in a large bowl or dish
3. Pour the sauce over the chicken and toss to completely coat with the sauce
4. Cover and refrigerate for a minimum of 6 hours or overnight

title: vegetables and dumplings
steps:
1. Combine the water , bouillon , and poultry seasoning in a large stock pot and heat until boiling
2. Add the onion , tvp , carrots , celery , and potatoes
3. Let cook covered for 10 minute

steps:

3. Meanwhile , cut squash lengthwise into halves
4. With spoon , scoop out pulp , leaving at least 1 / 2 inch shell
5. Set aside

8. Add onion and celery
9. Cook and stir 2 minutes

title: samson steak sandwich
steps:
1. Whisk the pineapple juice , soy sauce , sesame oil , brown sugar , garlic , and black pepper in a baking dish until the sugar dissolves
2. Put the meat in a large zip-top bag , pour the marinade over the meat , seal the bag and knead a bit with your hands to work the marinade into the beefl refrigerate overnight

steps:

title: banana layer cake with cream cheese frosting
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Coat 2- round cake pans with cooking spray
3. Line bottoms with wax paper
4. Coat wax paper with cooking spray
5. Lightly spoon flour into dry measuring cups
6. Level with a knife
7. Combine flour , baking powder , baking soda , and salt in a small mixing bowl , stirring well with a whisk

11. Beat well

28. Cake is lovely as is !
29. Store cake loosley covered in refrigerator

title: garbanzo raisin cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Lightly oil an 8 inch square baking pan or spray with a nonstick cooking spray
3. In a blender container , combine beans , one of the egg whites , milk , vanilla , sugar , baking powder , cinnamon , and lemon peel

12. Combine sugar and cinnamon and sprinkle evenly over cake

14. Cool in pan on a wire rack

16. Refrigerate leftovers

title: watermelon chiller
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients except the watermelon cubes
2. Chill this mixture
3. In a tall glass put half of the cubed watermelon , and pour half of the chilled mixture on top
4. Repeat the same for the balance
5. Decorate with a slice of lemon and mint sprigs
6. Serve immediately

steps:

9. Add the scallops and stir fry 1 minute

steps:

title: make ahead fruit pie filling
steps:
1. Trim fruit of peels , stems , leaves and seeds
2. Cut into 1 / 2" wedges or chunks and place in a large skillet
3. Add butter , sugar lemon juice , and cinnamon
4. Cook over medium heat until fruit starts to soften and release it juices , about 4 minutes
5. Add more sugar if necessary
6. Do not overcook
7. Cool the filling
8. Mix in cornstarch
9. Spoon into a zipper-lock plastic bag and refrigerate up to 2 weeks or freeze up to 4 months

title: garlic pepper chicken   mix bowl thai  gai tod kratiem prik tai
steps:
1. Combine chicken , minced garlic , ground white pepper , soy sauce , salt , oyster sauce , and sugar in a bowl and mix thoroughly

6. Drain left over oil from chicken on paper towels

steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees f

title: iced pumpkin latte
steps:

title: pan fried rib eye steaks
steps:
1. In a small cup or bowl mix oregano , cumin and paprika together
2. Sprinkle steaks with salt and pepper
3. Then sprinkle each side of steaks with spice mixture , reserving some for the sauce
4. Heat oil in large skillet over medium-high heat
5. Add steaks and cook to desired doneness

steps:

title: sausage   egg casserole
steps:
1. Spray a 9x13 glass pan with cooking spray
2. Line bottom of dish with the bread cubes
3. Sprinkle 2 cups of the grated cheese over the bread
4. Next , sprinkle the chilies if you are using them
5. Crumble the sausage over this
6. Mix the eggs , milk and spices- pour over the casserole
7. Sprinkle remaining 1 / 2 cup of cheese on top
8. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate over night
9. Bake uncovered at 300f for 1 hour and 15 minutes

title: watermelon curry  matira
steps:
1. Cut up the watermelon , remove the rind and seeds and chop the flesh into 1-inch cubes pure 1 cup of flesh to make juice

7. Cook 1 minute

title: catalina salad dressing
steps:
1. Place all the ingredients in a blender and blend briefly
2. Can add water if onion is particularly strong
3. They can be just shaken in a jar for a less emulsified dressing
4. Both ways are great
5. Lasts for a couple weeks in the fridge

title: katie joel s meatloaf recipe
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350
2. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper
3. Spray lightly with oil
4. Heat the olive oil in a medium skillet over medium heat
5. Saut the onions , garlic and bay leaf until the onions are tender , about 3 minutes
6. Add the red pepper and cook until the red pepper is tender , about 5 minutes
7. Stir in the parsley and thyme and cook for another 2 minutes
8. Remove pan from the heat and let the onion mixture cool
9. Discard the bay leaf
10. In a large bowl , combine the beef , eggs , bread crumbs , 1 / 2 cup of ketchup , the worcestershire sauce , salt , pepper and the cooled vegetables
11. Use your hands to mix everything together
12. Transfer the mixture to the center of the baking sheet and form into a loaf
13. Coat the meat loaf with the remaining 1 / 2 cup ketchup
14. Bake for 1 to 1 1 / 2 hours , until the meat loaf is firm

title: salad with honey and oranges
steps:

7. Return to pot
8. Add cream or milk
9. Heat briefly and serve hot

title: stewed tomato casserole
steps:

steps:

title: any kind casserole
steps:
1. Mix all the ingredients together in a bowl
2. If the casserole seems dry add 1 / 2 cup milk or stock
3. Place into a buttered casserole dish
4. Bake at 350 for 30 to 45 minutes

steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f

3. Cook the ground beef in a skillet until done
4. In a large bowl mix together the mushroom soup , salsa , sour cream , and parsley flakes

title: chicken in coconut sauce
steps:
1. Pour the boiling water over the coconut
2. Set aside
3. In a large skillet brown the chicken pieces on both sides in 2 tbsp hot usli ghee or cooking oil for 15 minutes
4. Remove from the skillet
5. Set chicken aside , reserving the drippings

13. Transfer the chicken to a heated serving platter
14. Keep warm
15. Skim the fat from the juices in the skillet

17. Stirring constantly
18. For the sauce , combine the yogurt , sour cream , and flour

title: crock pot marie s chicken in wine
steps:
1. Cut up 4 boneless , skinless chicken breasts in about 1 inch pieces

5. Mix
6. Do not add water as it makes its own gravy
7. Cook on low for 7-8 hours or high for 4-5 hours
8. Serve over egg noodles or anything else you want

1. Preheat oven to 350f grease two medium loaf pans
2. In large bowl , mix first six ingredients , and beat on high speed for 5 minutes
3. Fold in flour , baking powder and salt , alternately with the milk
4. Pour into pans , and sprinkle almonds on top of each loaf
5. Bake for 50-55 minutes , or until lightly browned and done
6. When loaves have cooled slightly , loosen edges , and turn out onto wire rack
7. Drizzle glaze over loaves
8. To make glaze , beat powdered sugar , water and extract together in a small bowl until smooth
9. If glaze is too thick , add an extra 1 / 2 teaspoon of water
10. Decorate with cherries

1. Begin with the german meatballs: combine all ingredients in a large mixing bowl and shape into about 24 meatballs
2. Brown the meatballs in a large skillet over medium heat , making sure to drain well as you cook the meaty mixture
3. Add beef broth , mushrooms , and onion
4. Simmer , covered , for about 30 minutes
5. In a small mixing bowl , blend sour cream , flour , and caraway seed
6. Add to the simmering broth and meatballs
7. Cook , stirring occasionally , for about 8 minutes , or until the sauce has thickened
8. Meanwhile , prepare the spaetzle by sifting together the flour and salt in a large mixing bowl
9. Add the eggs and milk and beat well
10. Place in a coarse-sieved colander and sieve directly over a rapidly boiling pot of lightly salted water
11. Cook for about 5 minutes , drain
12. Sprinkle spaetzle with a mixture of fine breadcrumbs , garlic powder and melted butter
13. Place a large portion of the spaetzle on a serving platter and hollow out a well in the center

7. Then stir in carrot , onion , mint leaves and parsley

9. Spoon barley filling into salad bowl

title: trout without a doubt
steps:
1. Heat oil in large pan with high heat
2. Wash fish in cold water and blot dry with paper towel
3. Brown fish on both sides
4. Remove fish and drain oil
5. Reduce to medium heat and saute onions until clear , but not brown
6. Add garlic and stir

1. Set a large pot of salted water to boil

3. Dredge cutlets , shaking off excess

6. Transfer to a dish

7. Serve

4. Heat over medium-low heat until the cheese is melted then salt & pepper to taste

3. Meanwhile , assemble panini

steps:
1. Place roast in a large saucepan with a tight-fitting lid
2. Cover roast with water and simmer on low for 30 minutes
3. Increase heat to medium / high and brown roast on all sides
4. Once the water has boiled away and the roast is browned , add beef broth , vinegar , chili powder and cumin
5. Cover tightly , reduce heat to low and simmer for 1 1 / 2 to 2 hours or until beef falls apart
6. Shred the beef
7. Place shredded beef back into saucepan with all the juices and cool to room temperature
8. In a large skillet , saute onion util soft
9. Mix in flour and green chilies
10. Stir for 2 minutes to cook off the flour taste
11. Stir in sour cream and 2 cups of the monterey jack cheese
12. Cook on low for 10 minutes , stirring often , until the cheese is melted and mixed thoroughly
13. Set aside and let cool
14. In a large heavy skillet , heat the olive oil
15. Fry the tortillas in the hot oil for 30 seconds on each side
16. Drain on paper towels
17. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
18. Spread 4 tablespoons of sour cream mixture down the center of the tortilla
19. Top with the same amount of the beef mixture
20. Roll up and place seam side down in baking dish
21. Repeat for each tortilla , until you are out of filling
22. Sprinkle with remaining monterey jack cheese
23. Bake in pre-heated oven for 30 minutes or until cheese is melted and bubbling
24. I serve each enchilada on a bed of shredded lettuce sprinkled with diced tomatoes
25. I top each enchilada with a dollup of sour cream and serve with a side of salsa

title: mmmm skinny meatballs
steps:
1. Mix together first 8 ingredients
2. Roll into balls about 1 inch in diameter , and place on a broiler pan
3. Bake at 350 for 15 minutes
4. Turn meatballs over , and bake for an additional 10-15 minutes , or until meatballs are no longer pink in the center
5. In a large pot , mix together soup , milk , mushroom , and heat
6. Remove any excess fat from meatballs and soak in the soup gravy until ready to serve

title: snowflake angel cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Grease cookie sheet well
3. Mix all four ingredients
4. Drop on cookie sheet with plenty of space between each "snowflake"
5. Bake 6-8 minutes
6. Watch close as these can burn very quickly !
7. Let cool completely and enjoy !

title: the frugal gourmet s  southern barbecue sauce
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a large saucepan
2. Simmer slowly uncovered , stirring occasionally , until thickened

title: supreme pizza casserole
steps:
1. Cook pasta per box instruction
2. Cook hamburger and onion in skillet until done , and drain
3. Stir in mushrooms , pizza sauce , tomato sauce , tomato paste , and seasonings
4. Mix
5. Stir in drained pasta and mix
6. Put in 9 x 13 casserole dish
7. Top with pepperoni and cheeses
8. Cover and bake at 350 for 20 minutes
9. Uncover and bake 10-15 minutes or until hot and bubbly

title: crock pot chicken enchiladas
steps:
1. Mix chicken , soup , sour cream and rotel together
2. Spray your crock pot with non-stick spray or use crock pot liner and lay 3 tortillas on the bottom
3. Then layer 1 / 3 of the chicken mixture and 1 / 3 of the cheese
4. Repeat the layers two more times starting with tortillas and ending with cheese
5. Cook on low for 6 hours
6. Serve with chips or cornbread and a salad

title: sun dried tomato quiche
