steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Butter a pie pan
3. Arrange potato slices on bottom of pan
4. Brush potatoes with melted butter
5. Bake for 10 minutes
6. For the filling: layer sun-dried tomatoes , green onion , garlic , ham and cheese on top of potato crust
7. Whisk together eggs , cream , italian seasoning , salt and pepper
8. Pour egg mixture over ingredients in pie pan
9. Bake for 40 to 50 minutes , or until a toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
10. Let stand for a few minutes , then slice and serve

title: prosciutto butternut squash soup
steps:
1. Cook squash , garlic , tomato , and onion in a saucepan for 1-2 minutes , or until moderately tender
2. Sprinkle with oregano and cook for and additional minute
3. Pour in chicken broth , reduce heat , and simmer for 8-10 minutes
4. Puree in blender until smooth
5. Stir in basil and proscuitto
6. Enjoy !

title: new year s day chili
steps:
1. Brown sausage in skillet
2. Drain and set aside
3. In sausage drippings , lightly brown onion and green pepper
4. Combine sausage , onion and pepper , tomtatoes , black-eyed peas , and seasonings in crock pot
5. Cook in crock pot on low for 6-8 hours or high for 3-4

title: garlic breath greek dip
steps:
1. Combine the feta cheese , sour cream , yogurt and garlic in the container of a food processor or blender
2. Pulse briefly until garlic is minced
3. Spoon into a serving dish , and season with salt and pepper

title: cheese tortellini with squash puree
steps:
1. Cook tortellini according to package directions , drain and set aside
2. Combine remaining ingredients , except parsley , salt and pepper , in a saucepan
3. Cook over medium heat until heated through and combined
4. If it is too thick , add a bit of water
5. Combine sauce with cooked tortellini , sprinkle with parsely and serve

title: ice cream sandwich torte
steps:
1. Combine milk and pudding mix , whisk until smooth and beginning to thicken
2. Fold in half of the whipped topping
3. Set aside
4. Quickly , arranges six of the ice cream sandwiches side by side on a large platter
5. Spread the filling evenly over the sandwiches , then place remaining sandwiches on top - creating a rectangular "torte" shape
6. Smooth the sides
7. Spread remaining whipped topping over the top and the sides of the torte
8. Grate the chocolate morsels over everything
9. Freeze until firm , but not hard
10. If freezing it over night , remove about 30-45 minutes before serving

title: italian cream cheese pinwheels
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. In a bowl , combine first 5 ingredients
3. Mix until smooth
4. Unroll crescent dough into rectangle onto a smooth surface
5. Gently press together perforations
6. Spread cream cheese mixture over dough to within 1 / 4 inch of the edge
7. Starting with the short end , roll into a log
8. Cut into 12 slices and place on ungreased baking sheet
9. Bake at 375 degrees f for 12-15 minutes
10. Sprinkle with extra parmesan cheese , if desired

title: rainbow salad
steps:
1. Combine vegetables in a bowl
2. In a separate bowl , mix rest of ingredients
3. Drizzle dressing over veggies , toss to mix

title: rosemary and carrot meatloaf
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Heat oil
3. Saute onions , celery , carrots , and garlic until soft
4. Mix remaining ingredients well
5. It works best if you use your hands
6. Add sauteed veggies and mix again
7. Try not to mix too much or the loaf will become hard and dense once your cook it
8. Shape into a loaf in nonstick loaf pan
9. Bake for about 1 hour or until 160 degrees
10. Loaf should be firm but not dry
11. Pour off excess fat
12. Cover with foil and let sit for 10-15 minutes before serving

title: banana cake with cream cheese icing
steps:
1. Cake: combine first 4 ingredients
2. Add sugar , margarine and 1 / 4 cup buttermilk , and bananas
3. Beat for 2 minutes on med speed
4. Add eggs , vanilla and 1 / 4 cup buttermilk
5. Beat 1 minute on med speed
6. Spread evenly in 2 greased round cake pans
7. Bake at 350 for 30-40 minutes
8. Cool 10 minutes
9. Then remove from pan and cool completely
10. Frosting: beat cream cheese and margarine together on med speed
11. Add icing sugar , beating til smooth
12. Fill and frost cake
13. Decorate as desired

title: junior league christmas cosmopolitan
steps:
1. Place 2 martini glasses in the freezer for 10 minutes or longer
2. Fill a cocktail shaker halfway with ice
3. Add 3 ounces lemon-scented vodka , 2 tablespoons fresh lime juice , 2 ounces cointreau and 1 tablespoon fresh cranberry juice
4. Cover
5. Shake vigorously for 30 seconds
6. Strain evenly into the chilled glasses
7. Top with lime zest

title: tiny spicy chicken
steps:
1. Place all cut up chicken into a 9x13-inch pan and sprinkle with garlic salt
2. Let sit at least one hour
3. Mix the eggs in a bowl and pour the box of cornstarch on a large plate
4. The pieces get dipped in the egg and then the cornstarch
5. Fry them in a pan over medium heat in batches with a little olive oil
6. After frying them , place them in a 9x13-inch pan
7. Mix all of the ingredients in the sauce in a sauce pan and heat until sugar dissolves only
8. Pour this over the breaded chicken in the pan
9. Cook at 325f stirring every 15 minutes for 1 hour

title: creamy baked spinach
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f
2. Melt the butter in a heavy-bottomed saute pan over medium heat
3. Add the onions and saute until translucent , about 15 minutes
4. Add the flour and nutmeg and cook , stirring , for 2 more minutes
5. Add the cream and milk and cook until thickened
6. Cool 10 minutes then quickly beat in the eggs
7. Squeeze as much liquid as possible from the spinach and add the spinach to the sauce
8. Add 1 / 2 cup each of the parmesan , gruyere and cheddar cheeses and all of the feta and mix well
9. Season , to taste , with salt and pepper
10. Transfer the spinach to a buttered 13 x 9 inch glass baking dish
11. Toss the remaining cheeses with the breadcrumbs and sprinkle on top
12. Bake for 20-25 minutes , until hot and bubbly
13. Serve hot

title: broccoli with sun dried tomatoes and roasted garlic
steps:
1. In microwave proof bowl cook broccoli till heated through about 4 minutes
2. Mix remaining ingredients and toss to coat broccoli heat 1 minute in microwave

title: ryan s sandwich
steps:
1. Slice bread
2. Cook bacon
3. Place bacon on bread
4. Place ham on bread
5. Place turkey on bread
6. Place cheese on bread
7. Eat and enjoy

title: mahi mahi fish tacos
steps:
1. Heat oil , add jalepeno , chopped red onion and cook for 4 minutes
2. In a small bowl , mash black beans with the cumin and season with salt & pepper
3. In large bowl , combine honey , 2 tbsp oil , hot sauce and lime juice
4. Season with salt & pepper
5. Add sliced onion , cabbage and cilantro
6. Toss
7. Coat fish with remaining 1 tbsp oil and the lime peel , and grill over medium for 8 minutes , turning once
8. Warm taco shells and tortillas on the grill
9. Spread a few tbsp of the mashed beans on the outside of the taco , and wrap a tortilla around each one , pressing to ahere
10. Flake half a piece of fish into each taco shell and top with some cabbage slaw
11. Top with creme fraiche or sour cream

title: southwestern chicken tostadas
steps:
1. In skillet , heat a small amount of oil
2. Add corn tortillas , one at a time and fry until crisp
3. Drain tortillas on paper towels
4. Place tortillas on a baking sheet and keep warm
5. Meanwhile , heat chicken strips until warmed through
6. Spread refried beans on each tortilla and top with chicken strips , shredded lettuce , and cheese
7. Serve with: salsa , sour cream and guacamole as garnishes , if desired

title: carrot raisin nut muffins
steps:
1. Prepare -- grate the carrots , chop or crush your walnuts , let your butter soften
2. Stir together all dry muffin ingredients
3. Add all of the rest of the muffin ingredients and stir well
4. In a separate bowl , mix together the topping ingredients with a spoon
5. Spoon the muffin batter into a muffin pan , about 2 / 3rds of the way full
6. Distribute topping mix on top of muffin batter
7. Bake at 350 degrees for 20 minutes
8. Let cool , then remove from pan and eat !

title: quick asian broccoli stir fry
steps:
1. Thaw broccoli florets in microwave
2. Heat the oil on medium high in a non-stick skillet
3. Brown the ginger slices
4. Add drained broccoli
5. Stir-fry one minute
6. Add sugar and salt
7. Continue frying until degree of doneness you prefer and all liquid is absorbed
8. Remove from heat and toss with sesame oil

title: janosch marzipan cookies
steps:
1. Mix everything until soft and shiny
2. Put the dough between plastic foil and flaten out
3. Cut out shapes
4. Bake at 180c for 10 minutes
5. Melt the chocolate on the stove over steaming water
6. Decorate the cookies with melted chocolate

title: shrimp with orzo  olives and feta
steps:
1. Cook orzo according to directions , drain well
2. In a large serving bowl , combine shrimp , tomatoes , cheese , vinegar , lemon juice , scallions , oregano , salt and pepper
3. Toss well
4. Add orzo and stir to mix
5. Garnish with kalamata olives , if desired

title: taco spaghetti
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to package directions
2. Drain pasta
3. Rinse with cold water
4. Drain again
5. In a 12-inch skillet cook ground beef or turkey and onion until meat is brown
6. Drain fat
7. Stir in water and taco seasoning
8. Bring to boiling
9. Reduce heat
10. Simmer , uncovered , for 2 minutes , stirring occasionally
11. Stir in cooked pasta , corn , olives , half of the shredded cheese , the salsa , and chilies
12. Transfer mixture to a lightly greased 2-quart round casserole
13. Cover and bake in a 350 degree f oven for 15 to 20 minutes or until heated through
14. Sprinkle with remaining cheese
15. Serve with shredded lettuce , tortilla chips , and tomato wedges
16. If desired , top with sour cream

title: chimichurri  from eating well
steps:
1. Chop parsley and garlic together on a cutting board until the parsley is finely minced
2. Transfer to a medium bowl , add vinegar , oil , salt and chipotle pepper
3. Stir to combine

title: gilded  zucchini
steps:
1. Wash and peel the zucchini and cut into long strips
2. Season with salt and pepper
3. Mix the eggs , milk and salt , dip the zucchini strips into the mixture and then roll in the breadcrumbs
4. Saute until crisp on the outside but not overcooked , about 2-3 minutes
5. Serve

title: hidden valley layered mexican dip
steps:
1. Combine sour cream and ranch dip
2. Spread refried beans in the bottom of a glass pie pan
3. Spread ranch dip over top of refried beans
4. Top with the other ingredients: cheese , olives , onions , tomato
5. Serve with tortilla chips

title: copper penny salad
steps:
1. Cook carrots 5 minutes
2. Drain and cool
3. Add everything else and mix well
4. Serve chilled

title: low fat  easy  eggless lasagna
steps:
1. Cook noodles in boiling water until flexible but firm
2. Meanwhile brown burger till done and drain
3. Then add spaghetti sauce
4. If you like , 1 / 2 c scallions , 2 cloves of garlic and a pinch of sea salt are a nice touch to add when browning , but not needed
5. Mix cottage cheese with parmesan
6. Layer a bread pan with tin foil
7. I like to add quite a bit on sides to make the pan skinnier
8. Divide sauce mix into 3 equal parts , the cottage mixture into 2 and the mozzarella into 2
9. Layer in this order
10. Sauce and burger mixture a noodle cottage mixture mozzarella sauce noodle cottage sauce mozzarella
11. Cover and bake at 350 for 20 min uncover and bake for 10
12. Savor every bite !
13. Serve with warm dinner rolls with melted butter and sprinkle with garlic salt

title: tomato and lentil soup
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a large saucepan over medium heat
2. Add the leek , carrot , onion and garlic , cover and cook for 4-5 minutes or stirring frequently until the leek and onion are a little softened
3. Rinse and drain the lentils , picking them over for any foreign matter
4. Add the lentils to the pan and stir in the waster , juice and tomatoes , add the cumin , coriander , bayleaf and a large pinch of salt
5. Bring to the boil and reduce the heat to a simmer and cook for about 45 minutes , or until the vegetables are tender
6. You can now puree the soup if you prefer it smoother or leave it as it is
7. Season well with salt and pepper before serving
8. Garnish each serving with a sprinkling of fresh parsley

title: thai style chicken stuffed bell peppers
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Cut the tops off of the peppers and scrape out the insides
3. Once cleaned out , place peppers in a casserole dish
4. Brown the chicken
5. Drain off excess fat
6. In a bowl , combine the salsa , peanut butter , soy sauce , ginger , lime juice and peanuts
7. Fold into the chicken
8. Spoon the mixture into the peppers
9. Add 4 tablespoons of hot water to bottom of baking dish
10. Cover the baking dish and bake for approximately 30 minutes or until peppers are tender

title: rev  larking s world s greatest potato salad
steps:
1. Stir
2. Eat

title: carrie s grilled cheese sammich
steps:
1. Butter each piece of bread on one side and stick the butter side together and set aside
2. Heat a skillet on hi and spray with non-stick spray
3. Add sliced onion and sautee until carmelized
4. Remove from pan and set aside
5. Wipe pan clean and set on medium heat
6. Place 4 pieces of the bread butter side down in your pan
7. Add 1 / 4 of the onions , 1 slice of cheese , 2 slices of ham , then 1 slice of cheese and the last piece of bread , butter side out
8. Leave for about 3-4 minutes and peek , if golden brown turn over and cook until golden brown on that side
9. Slice in half and serve with a dill pickle

title: delicious pizza crust
steps:
1. Add ingredients in order listed to bread machine on dough cycle
2. Divide dough and smooth out onto well oiled pizza stone or heavy pan
3. Prebake for 10 mins at 400 degrees , then cool and add sauce and your favorite toppings
4. An alternative to 2 pizzas is a pizza and breadsticks
5. Just spread the crust out the same and cut into strips before baking
6. Bake until done

title: acorns cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. In a large bowl , beat together butter , brown sugar , 3 / 4 cup chopped pecans and vanilla on medium speed until well blended
3. Add flour and baking powder and mix well , using low speed
4. Shape dough into 1-inch balls
5. Slightly flatten by pressing balls onto ungreased cookie sheets
6. Pinch tops to point to resemble acorns
7. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes at 375 degrees
8. Remove from oven and cool on wire racks
9. In top of a double boiler over simmering water , melt chocolate chips , stirring until smooth
10. Remove from heat
11. Keep double boiler over water
12. Dip large ends of cooled cookies into melted chocolate , then roll in chopped pecans
13. Cool to set chocolate

title: easy peach lemonade
steps:
1. Remove 1 tub of lemonade from container , reserving remaining tubs for other uses
2. Combine lemonade mix , water , and peach nectar in a pitcher
3. Cover and chill at least 1 hour
4. Serve over ice

title: broccoli with garlic sauce
steps:
1. Combine broth , sake , soy sauce , oyster sauce , cornstarch and sugar in a bowl & set aside
2. Heat a large nonstick wok or skillet over medium heat
3. Add oil
4. Once the oil is warm , add garlic and stir-fry until fragrant
5. Add the broccoli and stir-fry for 3 minutes or so , until slightly tender
6. Add the sauce mixture and stir constantly until sauce boils and thickens
7. Serve once sauce and broccoli reach desired thickness and tenderness

title: alegra s six week muffins
steps:
1. In a very large bowl mix raisin bran , sugar , flour , soda , and salt
2. Add eggs , buttermilk , and oil
3. This batter will keep 6 weeks in your refrigerator
4. Bake as you need them
5. I bake them all and freeze them and when i want one i place in the microwave for about 3 minutes taste like you pulled out of the oven
6. As you're ready to use fill muffin tins 2 / 3 full and bake at 400f for 15-20 minutes depending on tin size

title: all seasons potatoes
steps:
1. Boil the potatoes
2. Drain , cool , cut into 1" cubes
3. Set aside
4. In small skillet , saute the chopped onions in the butter until the onions are about half way done
5. Add in the garlic and cook with the potatoes , being careful not to burn
6. Toss with the potatoes and other ingredients
7. Spoon into a greased baking dish
8. Bake at 350 for 30 minutes or until bubbling

title: tropical dump cake
steps:
1. Drain 1 can crushed pineapple , and spread all of pineapple on bottom of lightly greased 13-x 9-inch pan
2. Sprinkle cake mix over fruit
3. Dot evenly with butter
4. Sprinkle with pecans
5. Bake at 350 for 45 to 50 minutes or until golden and bubbly
6. Serve with ice cream

title: peanut butter n apple cookies
steps:
1. Prehet oven to 350 degrees f
2. Lightly grease cookie sheet
3. Beat margarine , sugars , and peanut butter until creamy
4. Add egg and vanilla
5. Beat well
6. Combine flour , cinnamon and baking soda
7. Add to margarine mixture
8. Mix well
9. Stir in cereal
10. Using 1 level tablespoon , shape dough into 1 inch balls
11. Place 2 in apart on prepared cookie sheet
12. Flatten slightly
13. Bake 9-11 min or until lightly browned
14. Let stand 1 min before removing to racks to cool

title: potato oat cake
steps:
1. Grate potatoes and onion using shredding disk of food processor or hand-held grater
2. Squeeze out excess liquid
3. Combine potatoes , onion , and remaining ingredients except oil in medium mixing bowl
4. Heat oil in 10-inch nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
5. Spread potato mixture evenly in skillet
6. Reduce heat to medium
7. Cook covered until top is nearly set and bottom lightly browned , 6-8 minutes
8. Invert cake onto platter and slide back into skillet
9. Cook until bottom is golden brown , about 4 minutes
10. Cut into 8 wedges
11. Transfer to serving plate and serve hot

title: clay oven roasted chicken
steps:
1. Soak clay oven in water to cover for 10 to 15 minutes
2. Place lemon in chicken cavity
3. Tuck wings under , and tie legs together with string , if desired
4. Place chicken in clay pot , breast side up , and sprinkle with tarragon
5. Cover with lid
6. Place in a cold oven
7. Turn oven to 450 degrees fahrenheit , and bake 1 hour
8. Uncover and bake 15 more minutes or until meat thermometer inserted into chicken thigh registers 180 degrees

title: cold mango and rum soup  sopa fria de mango y ron
steps:
1. Puree the mango in a blender or food processor , then pass through a sieve
2. Combine the mango puree with the remaining ingredients , except the nutmeg
3. Garnish with the nutmeg

title: chocolate nut revel
steps:
1. Melt chocolate chips , stir in chopped nuts
2. Set aside and let cool
3. Cream butter , sugar , salt and vanilla
4. Blend in flour
5. Add chocolate nut mixture
6. Stir with a fork just enough to revel chocolate into white mixture
7. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto an ungreased cookie sheet
8. Flatten to 1 / 4 inch with the bottom of a glass greased with butter and dipped into sugar
9. Bake at 350 10-12 minutes , do not overbrown
10. White part should be just very lightly browned

title: mean chef s maple brine
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in large stainless steel pot
2. Bring to simmer , remove from heat and cool completely remove turkey neck and giblets
3. Rinse turkey well
4. Put turkey in cold brine
5. Use a stainless , plastic or other non-reactive container
6. Add water if brine doesn't cover bird
7. Refrigerate 2- 4 days , turning bird twice a day
8. To cook: remove turkey from brine , pat dry , brush with olive oil
9. Either grill or cook in oven
10. It is also advantageous to leave the dry turkey in the refrigerator for at least 4 hour or overnight , uncovered
11. This completely dries out the skin to insure a crisp finish
12. Do not stuff turkey

title: two meat pizza with wheat crust
steps:
1. In a bowl , dissolve the yeast in water and add oil
2. Combine whole wheat flour , sugar , and salt
3. Add to yeast mixture and stir until smooth
4. Stir in enough all-purpose flour to form a soft dough
5. Turn onto a floured surface and knead until smooth , about 8 minutes
6. Place in a greased bowl
7. Turn once to grease top
8. Cover and let rise in a warm place for 20 minutes
9. Punch dough down
10. Pat dough into bottom and 1-inch up the sides of a greased 14-inch pizza pan
11. Combine pizza sauce and sugar
12. Spread over crust
13. Sprinkle with mushrooms , onion , and olives
14. Layer with sausage , canadian bacon , and cheese
15. Bake at 350 degrees for 25-30 minutes or until crust is golden and cheese is melted

title: peanut butter panini with raisins and apples
steps:
1. Combine raisins , peanut butter and honey in small bowl
2. Stir to blend
3. Divide and spread over 4 waffles to cover and top each with about 5 apple slices
4. Spread 1 teaspoons jam on each four remaining waffles
5. Place jam side down on peanut butter topped waffles
6. Heat 1 tsp butter in large skillet over medium-high heat
7. Add waffle sandwiches and reduce heat to medium-low heat
8. Place another skillet over evenly on waffles
9. Cook for 1 1 / 2 minutes
10. Flip panini
11. Add remaining 1 teaspoons butter to skillet and slide panini around skillet to coat with butter
12. Replace skillet on top and cook one more minute or until lightly browned
13. Cut and serve with remaining apple slices

title: breakfast apple and blueberry gratin
steps:
1. Combine apples and blueberries in a heatproof bowl and microwave on high for 1 - 2 minutes or until heated through
2. Divide evenly between 4 x 1 cup heatproof serving dishes
3. Combine philly , sour cream and caster sugar and spread over the dishes
4. Sprinkle with brown sugar and cinnamon
5. Place dishes under a preheated grill for about 2 - 5 minutes or until sugar has caramelised
6. Serve immediately

title: chicken  stuffing  and broccoli casserole
steps:
1. Cook chicken breasts in enough water to cover plus poultry seasoning until chicken is very tender and comes away from bones
2. When done , take chicken off bones , discard bones and skin
3. Save the broth
4. Mix together cooked chicken , broccoli , croutettes , and cream of celery soup
5. Add chicken broth to mixture until well moistened
6. Mix in cheddar cheese
7. Bake in 350 oven for 45 minutes until very hot

title: greek oregano and lemon  abm
steps:
1. Add first nine ingredients to bread machine in the order recommended by its manufacturer
2. Process on the basic bread cycle
3. When the bread cycle completes , brush the lemon juice on top of the bread while its still in the machine

title: caribbean pumpkin curry colombo de giraumon
steps:
1. Heat oil and butter in a heavy large saucepan
2. Add the bacon , onion and green pepper and cook stirring from time to time until onion is tender but not browned
3. Add the curry powder and cook , stirring for a minute or two
4. Add the cloves , tomatoes , pumpkin , salt and pepper
5. Stir to mix
6. Cover and cook on the lowest possible heat , stirring occasionally to prevent from burning
7. When the pumpkin is very tender and almost reduced to a puree , stir in garlic and cook uncovered for a minute or 2 longer
8. There should be barely any liquid left at end of cooking
9. If after adding garlic & cooking remaining minute or so and there is still a lot of liquid turn heat up , watch carefully and boil away most of the liquid
10. Turn off heat and enjoy

title: rosemary scalloped potatoes
steps:
1. Sauce: in saucepan , melt butter over medium heat
2. Cook flour , salt , rosemary and pepper , stirring , for 1 minute
3. Gradually whisk in milk
4. Cook , whisking constantly , until boiling and thickened , 12 to 15 minutes
5. Set aside
6. Peel and thinly slice yukon gold and sweet potatoes
7. Layer half of the yukon gold potatoes in greased 13- x 9-inch glass baking dish
8. Spread with half of the onion
9. Layer with sweet potatoes then remaining onion and yukon gold potatoes
10. Pour sauce over top
11. Cover with greased foil
12. Bake in 350f oven for 1 hour
13. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese
14. Bake , uncovered , until lightly browned and tender , about 30 minutes
15. Let stand for 10 minutes before serving

title: squash quinoa soup
steps:
1. In saucepan cook chicken and shallot in hot oil over medium heat 2 to 3 minutes or until shallots are tender , stirring occasionally
2. Add broth , apricot nectar , squash , quinoa , and cumin
3. Bring to boiling
4. Reduce heat
5. Simmer , covered , 5 minutes
6. Add zucchini
7. Cover and cook 10 minutes more or until squash and quinoa are tender
8. Season to taste with salt and ground black pepper
9. Makes 6 servings

title: drunken dogs
steps:
1. Combine ketchup , brown sugar , bourbon and water in electric skillet or crock-pot
2. Add wieners and onion , stirring well
3. Cover and cook on low heat for 1 hour

title: chocolate toffee crunch ice cream cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Combine cake mix , eggs , butter , and water
3. Pour into a well greased 13x9 pan
4. Bake for 35-40 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean
5. Allow cake to cool completely
6. When cake is fully cooled , using a serrated knife , cut cake in half lengthwise
7. Place the bottom half of the cake back in the pan
8. Top with the softened ice cream , and spread it evenly over the cake
9. Sprinkle the toffee chips in an even layer over the ice cream
10. Place the top layer of the cake on the toffee chips / ice cream
11. Spread the softened cool whip over the top of the cake
12. Freeze 2 or more hours before serving

title: greek chicken roulades w white wine reduction
steps:
1. Dice 6 olives , set aside
2. Process remaining 6 olives , bread crumbs , tomatoes , zest , garlic & oregano in a food processor until minced
3. Using a meat mallet , pound chicken between plastic wrap to a thickness of 1 / 4"
4. Spread olive-tomato filling on chicken
5. Roll chicken & secure with toothpicks
6. Saute roulades in oil in a large nonstick skillet over mediium-high heat until browned , about 4 minutes per side
7. Remove roulades to a plate
8. Add onion to skillet , saute 2 minutes
9. Add wine , cook until liquid is reduced by half , 1 to 2 minutes
10. Add broth and bring mixture to a boil , add diced olives and roulades
11. Cover skillet and reduce heat
12. Simmer for 10 minutes then remove roulades to a plate
13. Whisk together lemon juice & cornstarch and stir into sauce in skillet , simmer 1 minute
14. Slice roulades and serve with sauce

title: 1 2 3 banana split ice cream cake
steps:
1. Cream together sherbet , bananas , and eggs
2. Mix in the cake mix and beat for approximately two minutes
3. Pour batter into bundt pan sprayed with nonstick cooking spray
4. Bake at 350f for 45-60 minutes until toothpick comes clean when inserted
5. Other great combinations include:
6. Spice cake mix and butter pecan ice cream
7. Chocolate cake mix and cookies & cream ice cream
8. Vanilla cake mix and orange sherbet

title: beer and bacon mancakes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Line cookie sheet with foil
3. Place wire rack on top of cookie sheet
4. Arrange bacon in single layer on top of rack
5. Bake 10 minutes
6. Sprinkle bacon with half the brown sugar
7. Bake 10 minutes longer
8. Turn bacon over
9. Sprinkle with remaining brown sugar
10. Bake 10 to 15 minutes longer or until golden brown
11. Remove from rack
12. Cool completely , about 15 minutes
13. Crumble bacon into small pieces
14. Set aside
15. Preheat griddle or skillet over medium-high heat or electric griddle to 375 degrees f
16. Grease with vegetable oil or shortening
17. In medium bowl , beat bisquick mix , beer and eggs with whisk until blended
18. If batter is too thick , add additional beer until desired consistency
19. Stir in bacon
20. Pour by 1 / 2 cupfuls onto hot griddle
21. Cook until edges are dry
22. Turn
23. Cook until golden brown

title: panzanella bruschetta
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees
2. For toasts
3. Lightly brush both sides of bread slices with the 2 tablespoons olive oil
4. Place slices on an ungreased baking sheet
5. Bake in preheated oven about 5 minutes or until toasts are crisp and edges are lightly browned , turning once
6. If desired , place the cooled toasts in an airtight container and store at room temperature up to 24 hours
7. For salad: in a salad bowl , combine greens , tomatoes , parmesan cheese , cucumber , red onion , basil , capers , and garlic
8. Sprinkle the vinegar , the 2 teaspoons olive oil , salt and black pepper over the greens mixture , tossing to coat well
9. Let set for 15 to 30 minutes to allow flavors to blend
10. To serve , top each toast with some of the salad and enjoy

title: curried apple and zucchini soup
steps:
1. Spray a large non-stick pot with cooking spray
2. Over medium heat , add garlic , onion and apple , sauteing until they start to soften , about 8 minutes
3. Sprinkle in curry powder and salt and cook , stirring for one minute
4. Add zucchini and chicken stock
5. Bring to a boil , reduce heat , cover , and simmer until all vegetables are soft
6. Remove from heat
7. With an immersion blender , puree soup until smooth
8. Heat the soup again over low , stirring in the milk
9. Serve hot

title: professional decorators  icing
steps:
1. Combine the shortening , water and vanilla
2. This will take some time to mix up but it will eventually
3. Add the meringue powder and powdered sugar
4. Mix well - beat for about 3 minutes
5. If this is way too stiff you can add a little water at a time
6. Just remember you want this to be a little thick so you can spread it

title: thyme roasted salmon with horseradish dijon sour cream
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Line a baking sheet with foil
3. Arrange fillets on foil , sprinkle evenly with oil , thyme and lemon pepper seasoning salt
4. Bake 12 to 14 minutes or until opaque in center
5. Meanwhile , combine remaining ingredients in a small bowl
6. Stir to blend well
7. Serve sauce along side fillets

title: yogurtlu biber  bell pepper with yogurt
steps:
1. Grill the bell peppers until the skin blisters and turns black -- you can use the oven or a gas flame , the results will be the same
2. Put them into a plastic bag and let them rest until they are cool enough to be touched
3. Peel the peppers , make sure all kernels are removed
4. Cut the peppers into stripes
5. Carefully mix bell peppers , yogurt , crushed garlic and salt
6. Place the dish on a plate and sprinkle with olive oil
7. Enjoy :)

title: mixed berry fruit shake
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in blender container
2. Cover and blend until smooth
3. Serve immediately garnished with fresh mint leaves and additional strawberries

title: swissed ham and noodles casserole
steps:
1. In 1-quart saucepan , melt butter
2. Saute onion and green pepper
3. Remove from heat
4. Stir in soup and sour cream
5. In buttered 2-quart casserole , layer 1 / 3 of the noodles , 1 / 3 of the swiss cheese , 1 / 3 of the ham and 1 / 2 soup mixture
6. Repeat layers , ending with final 1 / 3 layer of noodles , cheese and ham
7. Bake in preheated 350 degree oven 30 to 45 minutes or until heated through

title: kittencal s simple and delicious salmon salad sandwich
steps:
1. In a bowl using a fork mash the salmon with mayonnaise and lemon juice
2. Add in green onions , celery , lemon pepper and seasoned salt
3. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or more
4. Toast bread slices , then lightly butter 1 side of each slice or you may leave the bread dry
5. Place a lettuce leaf over 3 slices of buttered toast
6. Scoop the salmon mixture onto the lettuce then spread
7. Top with 2 thinly sliced tomatoes
8. Cover each with a bread slice
9. Slice in half and enjoy !

title: mussels  clams and shrimp in spicy broth
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large heavy pot over medium heat
2. Add garlic , bay leaf and crushed red pepper
3. Saute until garlic is tender
4. Add wine and bring to a boil
5. Add tomatoes and simmer until the tomatoes begin to break down and flavors blend
6. Turn up to medium and cook until sauce is good and warm
7. Add clams , cover and cook for 5 minutes
8. Stir in mussels , cover and cook until clams and mussels open , about 5 mins or so
9. When clams and mussels are almost all opened throw in the shrimp
10. Cover and cook about 1 1 / 2 min or until shrimp is done
11. Stir in torn basil leaves and serve

title: the best raisin bread for bread maker   machine
steps:
1. Firstly , mix the flour , milk powder , sugar , salt and cinnamon together thoroughly in a mixing bowl making sure there are no lumps
2. Now add the luke warm water and butter into the bread machine
3. Then add the dry mixed ingredients into the pan
4. Make a small well in the centre of the dry mixture and add the yeast
5. Set the bread maker / machine to 'sweet bread' setting and wait for it to 'beep' before adding the raisins
6. Wait until cooked and enjoy fresh or toasted with butter -- yum !
7. If the mixture is too dry while mixing you can add a tablespoon of water
8. Alternatively if its too moist , a tablespoon of flour should sort it out nicely

title: heavenly turtle cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Mix cake mix per box directions
3. Pour 1 / 2 of cake batter into a well greased 13 x 9 pan
4. Bake until cake begins to pull away from sides of pan
5. In a non stick heavy sauce pan , melt butter , caramels and condensed milk until creamy and there are no lumps from candies
6. Add one bag of chocolate chips to the layer of cake in pan , add nuts , then pour on caramel sauce , then top with 2nd bag of chocolate chips and remaining cake batter
7. Return to oven and cook until top layer of cake springs back at touch
8. Cool , cut and serve
9. This always taste better if made a day ahead

title: moroccan sizzling shrimp
steps:
1. Heat the olive oil and butter in a large frying pan
2. When the butter begins to sizzle , add the garlic and cook for about 30 seconds
3. Add the spices to the pan
4. Cook , stirring , for a few seconds
5. Add the shrimp
6. Cook shrimp for 2-3 minutes over high heat , stirring to avoid burning the spices
7. As soon as all the shrimp have turned pink , they're done
8. Avoid cooking for much longer past this point , because shrimp very easily become overcooked
9. Transfer shrimp to warmed serving dishes
10. Pour the spicy butter mixture over each serving
11. Garnish with lemon wedges and some chopped cilantro
12. Serve immediately

title: super meal breakfast salad
steps:
1. Slice strawberries , cantaloupe , and kiwi
2. Place all fruits in a bowl and add cottage cheese and nectar
3. Stir
4. Enjoy !

title: cheesy seafood muffies
steps:
1. Mix butter , cheese , mayonniase , and garlic salt
2. Stir in crabmeat
3. Spread on muffins
4. Freeze at least 10 minutes
5. Broil 5- 10 minutes until hot and bubbly
6. Serve warm

title: deviled pork tenderloins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325f
2. In a blender , combine garlic , onion , brown sugar , ketchup , lemon juice , mustard and worcestershire sauce
3. Blend on high speed till smooth
4. Set aside
5. In a frying pan , over medium-high heat , quickly brown tenderloins in a bit of oil
6. Place in a 3-quart baking pan and spoon sauce over meat
7. Bake for 45 to 60 minutes , basting occasionally
8. To serve , cut in 1 / 2" slices and either drizzle sauce over the top or serve in a separate dish

title: curried butternut squash soup
steps:
1. 1
2. Heat olive oil over medium heat in a 6-quart stockpot
3. 2
4. Add onions and garlic and saute until soft , about 10 minutes
5. 3
6. Add the butternut squash , vegetable stock , curry powder and salt
7. 4
8. Bring to a boil and then simmer until the squash is tender , about 15 minutes
9. 5
10. Once the squash is cooked , turn off the heat and while stirring add the coconut milk
11. 6
12. Puree the soup with an immersion blender
13. Or in batches in a blender until smooth
14. 7
15. Ladle into soup bowls and garnish with dollops of yogurt and toasted butternut squash seeds

title: brittany s favorite cookies
steps:
1. Cream the butter , eggs , molasses , vanilla , and water with a kitchen mixer in a glass mixing bowl
2. In a large bowl , sift together the sugars , baking powder , baking soda , salt , and flour
3. Combine the moist mixture with the dry mixture
4. Stir in the chocolate chips
5. Shape the dough into 1-inch balls , and place them 1 inch apart on an ungreased cookie sheet
6. Bake at 350 for 8 minutes , or until light brown around edges
7. Make sure not to overbake
8. Cool on a wire rack
9. Makes about 4 dozen cookies

title: banana pudding bites
steps:
1. Remove the ends from the peeled bananas and discard
2. Cut each banana into ten to twelve 1 / 2 inch slices
3. Place vanilla wafer cookies on platter , top each cookie with a banana piece
4. Dollop a heaping teaspoon of pudding over each banana piece
5. Sprinkle with crumbled cookies to garnish

title: caramelized onion   mustard tart
steps:
1. Melt the butter with the oil in a large frying pan over medium-low heat
2. Add the onions and garlic
3. Season to taste with salt & pepper and cook for 30 minutes , stirring often , until golden
4. Take off heat and set aside
5. Preheat the oven to 200c line a pie pan or loose bottomed tart tin with the pastry / pie crust
6. Line with greaseproof paper and fill with beans and bake for 15 minutes
7. Remove the paper and beans and cook for another 10 minutes until golden
8. Lower the oven temperature to 180c in a bowl , whisk together the eggs , yolks , mustard and cream
9. Stir in the onions and the chopped mint
10. Spoon the mixture into the pie / pastry crust and bake for 20 minutes or until just set
11. Cool slightly before serving

title: spicy moroccan chicken with apricots and prunes  low fat
steps:
1. In the morning , combine first 13 ingredients in ungreased 2 quart shallow casserole
2. Add chicken
3. Turn to coat
4. Cover
5. Chill for at least 8 hours or overnight
6. Stir
7. Bake chicken , uncovered , in 400 degree f oven for about 30 minutes , stirring occasionally , until chicken is no longer pink

title: creamed ground beef sos
steps:
1. In a large skillet over medium heat , brown the ground beef and onion
2. Stir in the flour , granulated bouillon , salt , pepper , and garlic and onion powders
3. Saute all together until flour is absorbed , about 5 minutes
4. Gradually stir in the worcestershire sauce and milk
5. Bring it all to a simmer , stirring , and cook until thickened , about 5 to 10 minutes
6. Serve over toast , biscuits , noodles , rice , or potatoes
7. Delicious !

title: dixie stampede homestyle cream of vegetable soup   authentic
steps:
1. In a 3-quart sauce pot , melt margarine
2. Add onion , garlic , and corn syrup
3. Simmer 1 minute
4. Do not brown
5. Add flour , white pepper , salt , chicken broth , water , and vegetables
6. Simmer 3 minutes
7. Add half-and-half
8. Simmer until desired consistency
9. Stir constantly - do not bring to boil
10. Garnish with chopped parsley and serve

title: lee ann s chicken and rice
steps:
1. In a large skillet , heat oil
2. Add chicken , and saute until slightly browned , about 5 minutes or so
3. Add 3 cups water , bring to a boil
4. Stir in rice mixes , cover tightly , and reduce heat to simmer
5. Cook 25 minutes
6. After 25 minutes , stir in remaining ingredients , just until they are heated through
7. This takes only a couple of minutes
8. Then serve !

title: cappuccino delight
steps:
1. In a blender , combine coffee , ice cream , and chocolate syrup
2. Blend until smooth
3. Pour over crushed ice
4. Add whip cream on top and surround your scenes with chocolate and coffee

title: berries with pepper sauce
steps:
1. Finely grate peel from lemon and put into a saucepan
2. Squeeze juice from lemon and reserve
3. Add sugar and water to lemon peel and heat gently , stirring until sugar dissolves
4. Bring to a boil and boil until syrup turns a light caramel color
5. Remove from heat and hold pan handle with a cloth as mixture will splatter
6. Stir in lemon and orange juices
7. Heat gently , stirring to dissolve caramel
8. Stir in peppercorns and boil 3-4 minutes or until slightly thickened and syrupy
9. Allow to cool 2 minutes , then spoon hot syrup over strawberries
10. Garnish with mint , if desired , and serve at once with half-and-half , if desired

title: zesty confetti slaw
steps:
1. Chop and slice all vegetables
2. Mix in bowl
3. Make the dressing using everything except the oil
4. Stream the oil into the mixture & whip to emulsify
5. Pour over the vegetables & mix
6. Stir in the sesame seeds
7. Cover with plastic wrap & chill at least 30 minutes before serving

title: old fashioned pea salad
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl , add the first 4 ingredients
2. Stir to combine
3. In a smaller bowl , add the mayonnaise and sour cream
4. Stir to blend
5. Spoon the mayo mixture over the pea mixture
6. Gently stir to coat
7. Season to taste with salt and pepper
8. This tastes better to me chilled so i let it refrigerate 4-6 hours before serving

title: mark bittman s banana bread
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
2. Grease a 9x5 loaf pan
3. In a medium bowl , mix together the flours , salt , and baking powder
4. Set aside
5. With an electric mixer , cream the butter with the sugar , then slowly beat in the eggs , bananas , and vanilla
6. Slowly add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and beat just until combined , being sure to scrape down the edges of the bowl a few times
7. Gently fold in the chocolate chips
8. Pour the batter into the loaf pan and bake for 45 to 60 minutes , until nicely browned
9. A toothpick inserted into the center of the bread will come out fairly clean when it is done , but because of the bananas this bread will remain moister than most
10. Cool on a rack for 15 minutes before removing from the pan

title: easy ice cream  maple or honey sweetened
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients , mixing well
2. Start ice cream freezer and pour mixture into it
3. Freeze according to manufacturer's instructions until desired consistency

title: eggplant minestrone
steps:
1. Peel and dice the onion , eggplant , carrots , and tomatoes
2. Peel and mince the garlic
3. Dice the zucchini and celery
4. Heat the oil in a large soup kettle
5. Add the onions and garlic and saute until tender
6. Add ground beef and cook until no longer pink
7. Add the eggplant and saute 3 minutes , stirring
8. Add the carrots , tomatoes , zucchini , celery , stock , basil , oregano , and salt
9. Stir well
10. Simmer , uncovered , 1 1 / 2 hours
11. Add the macaroni and cook 15 minutes more
12. Add pepper to taste
13. Serve topped with parmesan cheese

title: derek s slow cooker chili
steps:
1. Brown meat in a large skillet
2. Add remaining ingredients to a 5-6 quart slow cooker
3. Drain grease from meat and add to slow cooker
4. Stir to combine
5. Cook on low for 6-8 hours

title: rachael ray s cracked corn and pepper squares
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Grease and 8x9 square baking pan
3. In medium sized bowl , combine corn muffin mix , egg and milk till just combined
4. Add cheese , corn and scallion till just combined
5. Pour into greased pan and bake till golden , about 15 to 18 minutes

title: cinnamon blueberry crumble
steps:
1. Remove rolls from pan
2. Spray pan with non-stick cooking spray and replace rolls
3. Spread blueberry pie filling evenly over and between rolls
4. Combine butter , flour , brown sugar and pecans and sprinkle over pie filling
5. Bake at 350f 45-50 minutes
6. Drizzle with cream cheese frosting while still warm

title: dad s favorite snickerdoodles
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400 degrees
2. In small bowl , combine 2 tablespoons of sugar and 1 tablespoon cinnamon for topping mix
3. Set aside
4. In large mixing bowl , combine 1 1 / 2 cups sugar , the margarine , shortening , vanilla and eggs
5. I find the texture of the cookies best if i stick to this margarine / shortening ratio
6. Sift together flour , cream of tartar , baking soda and salt
7. Mix thoroughly into wet mixture
8. Shape into balls- i usually make a heaping teaspoonful-depends on your preference
9. Roll tops of balls into sugar / cinnamon mixture to coat
10. Place approximately 2 inches apart on an ungreased cookie sheet and bake 8-10 minutes until set
11. Remove cookies immediately from sheet to rack to cool
12. This keeps them from spreading out as much
13. Enjoy !
14. )

title: instant mashed potatoes that are better than homemade
steps:
1. In saucepan , combine chicken broth and butter
2. Heat to a boil
3. Remove from heat
4. Add heavy whipping cream and then gently stir in potato flakes
5. That's it !

title: classic two crust apple pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425f
2. Peel , core and thinly and thickly slice the apples
3. Toss with lemon juice if using
4. Combine and mix apples , sugar , flour , cinnamon and nutmeg
5. Pour into crust-lined pie plate
6. Dot with butter
7. Place top crust , seal and vent
8. Cover edges of crust with narrow band of aluminum foil , shiny side out
9. Bake at 425f for 20 minutes
10. Reduce temperature to 375f and bake another 30-40 minutes until filling is bubbling and crust is nicely browned
11. If necessary remove foil last 10 minutes to brown edges

title: olive garden apple carmelina
steps:
1. Mix apples , 1 / 2 cup sugar , apple pie spice , 1 / 4 cup brown sugar , salt , and flour together , stir well
2. Pour into a lightly buttered 8" x 8" baking dish
3. Place the topping ingredients together in a bowl
4. Mix the flour , salt , sugars and blend well
5. Add and work in the softened butter to the topping ingredients
6. Mixture should look like coarse meal
7. Sprinkle over apples and place in a preheated oven at 350f for 30 - 35 minutes
8. Serve topped with your favorite vanilla ice cream and a drizzle of caramel sauce

title: low carb roasted red pepper soup
steps:
1. Heat oil in medium saucepan over medium heat
2. Add celery , onions , and garlic
3. Until vegetables are softened
4. Add roasted peppers and stock
5. Bring to boil: lower heat and simmer 5 minutes
6. Puree soup in batches until smooth
7. Return to heat , and stir in cream
8. Add salt and pepper to taste and garnish with parmesan

title: bourbon fog
steps: 1. Mix thoroughly in a punch bowl and serve with a little ice in old fashioned or collins glasses

title: indonesian corn patties
steps:
1. In bowl mix corn , fish sauce , pepper , chilli and shallots
2. Mix in egg and cornflour
3. Heat oil in pan , drop large spoonfuls of mixture into pan and cook approx 2 minutes or until underside is nice and golden , turn and cook other side
4. Place in warm oven while cooking remainder
5. Serve with chilli sauce or a vietnamese dipping sauce

title: oat and nut granola with sunflower seeds the lodge at red river
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300f
2. Combine old-fashioned oats , flour , golden brown sugar , almonds , walnuts , milk powder , sunflower seeds and salt in 13x9x2-inch metal baking pan
3. In medium bowl , whisk vegetable oil , 1 / 2 cup water , honey , vanilla extract and maple extract to blend
4. Add to dry ingredients in pan and stir to coat well
5. Bake until granola is golden and crunchy , stirring frequently , about 45 minutes
6. Cool completely

title: mediterranean skillet cod  south beach diet phase 1
steps:
1. In a large skillet , heat oil over medium heat
2. Add zucchini , onion , garlic , and a pinch of salt and pepper
3. Cook , stirring occasionally , 10 minutes
4. Stir in tomatoes and peppers and simmer over medium heat 10 minutes longer
5. Nestle fish fillets into the sauce , spooning some of the mixture on top of the fillets
6. Cover the pan and continue to simmer until fish is opaque and cooked through , about 10 minutes
7. Sprinkle with parsley and serve warm

title: little piece of healthy heaven baked french fries
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425
2. Wash potatoes and peel them if you like cut potatoes in half lengthwise , and then in half lengthwise again
3. Cut into strips , as thin as possible
4. It's ok if some are a little thicker
5. Place cut up fries in a big ziploc bag and add olive oil
6. Shake to coat
7. In a small bowl , mix all spices , and then dump into bag
8. Shake to coat
9. Line 2 cookie sheets with foil
10. Spray lightly with cooking spray
11. Arrange fries in a single layer on sheets and sprinkle grated parmesan all over potatoes
12. Put in preheated oven and bake for 30-45 minutes
13. You want them to turn golden brown with some crispy edges
14. 4-5 of them on the outside may turn darker but they are still extremely tasty and just cook faster than the ones in the middle
15. Watch them closely for desired texture ! just make sure the parm cheese starts to become a golden brown color and potatoes are cooked through !

title: sweet potato buns
steps:
1. Peel the sweet potato and cut into chunks
2. Place in a pan and cover with cold water
3. Boil until soft
4. Drain and mash
5. Reserve 1 cup for this recipe and put the rest away for another time
6. Put the warm water in a large bowl
7. Mix in the sucanat
8. Float the yeast on top of the water and let it sit until bubbly and foamy
9. To the yeast mixture add the sweet potatoes , oil , and salt
10. Use a mixer to beat this stuff together
11. Then beat in the oats and the 1 cup of white flour
12. Add the whole wheat pastry flour a little at a time , kneading until a smooth dough is formed
13. Spray a metal bowl with cooking spray and place the dough inside
14. Cover with a towel and let rise in a warm place until about doubled
15. Punch down and divide into 8 balls
16. Spray 2 cooking sheets with spray
17. Form the balls and them pat them flat
18. Put them on the cookie sheets , cover with a towel , and let rise in a warm place until about doubled
19. Bake at 350 degrees for about 20 minutes or until just starting to brown

title: sweet potato   black bean burgers
steps:
1. In a large bowl , mash beans and potato together with a potato masher
2. Stir in egg , tahini , syrup , seasonings and flour
3. Mix well form mixture into eight same-sized patties
4. If mixture is too moist to handle , add a tad more flour
5. Coat patties in panko
6. You want them to be well-coated
7. Heat sunflower oil in a skillet over medium-high heat
8. Add the patties in batches and cook until browned on both sides , about 10 minutes
9. Transfer to a plate lined with paper towels until all patties are cooked
10. Serve inside hamburger buns or pitas
11. Top with sliced avocados and smears of dijon mustard , or any topping you like

title: braised leeks with mustard cream
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 200c
2. Spread the chopped butter and oil over the base of a roasting pan large enough to hold the leeks in one layer
3. Add the leeks and roast for 10 minutes
4. Remove the leeks from the oven and turn them over in the pan
5. Roast for a further 10 minutes
6. Remove the leeks from the oven and add the stock
7. Roast for another 10 minutes or until the leeks have started to brown slightly and the stock has reduced
8. Remove the leeks from the oven and keep warm on the serving dish by covering them with aluminium foil
9. Making the mustard cream: melt the remaining 50g of butter in a small saut pan over a medium heat
10. Add the shallots and saut for 5 minutes or until softened
11. Increase the heat a little , add the wine and slowly bring to the boil
12. Simmer until the liquid has reduced by half
13. Stir in the cream and simmer gently until the sauce begins to thicken
14. Stir in the mustard
15. Add half the chives and season to taste with salt and pepper
16. Drizzle the leeks with the mustard cream and garnish with the remaining chives
17. Serve

title: chicken   sausage al forno
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Coat 2 1 / 2 quart baking dish with cooking spray
3. Cook pasta
4. Drain
5. Rinse with cold water
6. In bowl , combine marinara , 1 1 / 2 cups of mozzarella , spinach , ricotta , parmesan , garlic , basil , salt and pepper
7. Stir in pasta , sausage and chicken
8. Transfer to baking dish
9. Sprinkle remaining 1 / 2 cup of mozzarella over pasta
10. Bake until hot , 25-30 minutes
11. Serve with focaccia bread

title: tex mex bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Lightly brown beef , drain
3. In bowl combine beef , onion , pepper , salsa , corn& seasoning
4. Spread in a 9x9 dish , cover and bake for 30 minutes
5. Meanwhile , prepare cornbread according to package
6. After beef mixture has baked , top with cornbread batter , spreading evenly , and immediatly return to oven , uncovered , and bake until golden brown
7. After cooling slightly , serve with taco like garnishes to top

title: chicken casserole with broccoli
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 , grease 2 quart casserole dish
2. In prepared casserole dish , place chicken , broccoli and cheese
3. In a separate mixing bowl , blend baking mix , milk , eggs , salt and pepper on high speed until well mixed
4. Pour into dish over chicken , broccoli and cheese
5. Bake for 35-40 minutes until knife inserted in center comes out clean
6. Let cool 5 minutes before serving

title: eggplant parmesan chips
steps:
1. Preheat about 2 inches of oil in a large pot over medium heat
2. Cut off
3. Using a sharp knife slice eggplant into 1 / 8 inch circles
4. Then slice in half
5. You want them to be about the width of two fingers
6. Pat dry with paper towels
7. Combine flour , salt and pepper in a resealable bag
8. In a bowl , beat together eggs
9. Set aside
10. On a plate mix together italian seasoning , parmesan cheese and breadcrumbs
11. In batches , place eggplant slices in flour and shake to coat
12. Then dip slices in egg and press into the parmesan-breadcrumb mixture to lightly coat
13. Once oil reaches 350 degrees , begin frying the chips in batches
14. Fry 3-5 minutes or until golden brown and crispy
15. Transfer to paper towels
16. Repeat with remaining eggplant
17. Sprinkle with more parmesan cheese if desired
18. Serve hot
19. To get even more of the taste of eggplant parmesan , dip these in your favorite marinara sauce

title: cheese and mushroom stuffed meatloaf
steps:
1. Heat oil in skillet over medium heat
2. Add onion and saut until translucent , about 4 minutes
3. Add garlic and mushrooms
4. Cook until mushrooms are golden-brown and liquid evaporates , about 8-9 minutes
5. Cool
6. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
7. Mix beef and everything else but cheese
8. Turn out onto large square of plastic wrap
9. Pat into 9 x 12 inch rectangle
10. Spread mushroom filling over rectangle , leaving a inch border on all sides
11. Cover mushrooms with cheese
12. Starting at one short end , roll up jelly roll fashion
13. Take time and lovingly pat it into a compact shape to fit into your loaf pan - this will ensure that it doesn't crack as it bakes
14. Arrange seam side down in 9 x 5 inch loaf pan
15. Bake until loaf shrinks from sides of pan and browns , about 1 hour
16. Pour off any drippings
17. Gently turn out loaf and let stand 10 minutes before slicing

title: basic italian bread
steps:
1. Biga: mix the yeast and water together , and then slowly start adding the flour , mixing well
2. Cover with plastic wrap and let sit at room temperature for up to 6 hours , or refrigerate overnight
3. Bread: place the water in a large bowl , sprinkle the yeast over top and mix well
4. Let sit 10 minutes until bubbly
5. Add the biga , flour , and salt and stir with a wooden spoon until everything is mixed
6. The dough will be fairly wet and sticky at this point
7. Cover and let stand in a warm spot for about 1 to 1 1 / 2 hours until doubled in volume
8. Punch down the dough , folding it over on itself two or three times , cover and let rise once more until doubled , about 1 hour
9. To bake the following day , refrigerate the dough at this time and leave it overnight
10. Turn out your dough onto a floured baking sheet , and without overworking it too much , shape into one large or two smaller round or oval shaped loaves , using as much extra flour as needed to keep it from sticking
11. Slash across the tops of the loaves with a serrated knife or razor just prior to baking
12. Preheat the oven to 350 f and place a casserole dish with boiling water on the lower oven rack
13. Bake for 30 minutes , turn the baking sheet around , and reduce the heat to 300f and bake for another 30-45 minutes
14. Bread should be golden brown and should sound hollow when you tap the bottom
15. Allow the bread to cool to room temperature and serve
16. Baking
17. Variations:roasted garlic & basil bread: coarsely chop 1-2 heads roasted garlic and add to flour along with about 1 teaspoon crushed dried basil
18. Rosemary bread: add 4 tablespoons finely chopped fresh rosemary to the flour
19. Brush the loaves with water and sprinkle with coarse sea salt just prior to baking
20. Olive bread: add 12 ounces flavorful , pitted olives , coarsely chopped to the flour
21. To roast garlic: heat oven to 350f peel away paper like skin from around the garlic bulbs leaving just enough to hold bulb intact
22. Trim tops of garlic bulbs about 1 / 2 inch to expose cloves
23. Place bulbs stem ends down on 12 inch square of foil
24. Drizzle each bulb with 2 teaspoons olive or vegetable oil
25. Wrap securely in foil and place in pie plate or shallow baking pan
26. Bake 45 to 50 minutes or until garlic is tender when pierced with toothpick or fork
27. Cool slightly
28. Gently squeeze garlic out of cloves

title: cheesy beef taco skillet
steps:
1. Brown beef in skillet , drain fat
2. Add in soup , salsa , water , tortillas , and half of cheese
3. Heat to a boil
4. Cover and let cook for 5 minutes or until hot
5. Add remaining cheese before serving !

title: apple tree shanty barbecue sauce
steps:
1. In a food processor , grind onion , garlic and raisins very fine
2. In a saucepan , combine ground ingredients with ketchup , vinegar , mustard , butter , basil , tarragon , rosemary , thyme , marjoram , monosodium glutamate , brown sugar , salt , pepper and lemon juice
3. Bring contents to a boil , stirring often
4. Simmer for 45 minutes , stirring frequently
5. Add wine , if using , and simmer for 15-20 minutes more

title: cucumber bruschetta  no bread
steps:
1. Prepare your avocado by cutting in half , removing the pit , peeling and cubing it
2. Mix together the avocado , lime juice , cilantro , and onion
3. Salt and pepper to taste
4. Spoon small avocado mix onto cucumber slices and serve

title: hawaiian coleslaw
steps:
1. Combine cabbage and pineapple in a medium bowl
2. Set aside
3. Combine mayo and remaining ingredients in a small bowl
4. Add to cabbage mixture , tossing to combine
5. Cover and chill

title: merlene s sweet potato casserole
steps:
1. Beat together sweet potatoes , mashed , with remaining ingredients except for topping
2. Spoon into a 2-1 / 2 quart baking dish
3. Spread topping over potatoe mixture
4. Bake at 350f for 35 to 40 minutes or until top is lightly browned
5. Topping:
6. Mix all ingredients together into a crumbly texture
7. Use as directed above

title: eggplant chiles rellenos
steps:
1. Add water to a large pot
2. Bring to a boil
3. Add in eggplant and onion
4. Cook for 10 minutes or until vegetables are tender
5. Drain well
6. Set aside
7. In a bowl , mix together eggs , green chiles , hot sauce , cheddar cheese , and monterey jack cheese
8. Add in eggplant mixture
9. Beat using an electric mixer on medium speed until mixture is smooth
10. Spoon mixture into a 1-quart casserole that has been sprayed with non-stick cooking spray
11. Mix together the cracker crumbs and melted butter
12. Sprinkle over the casserole
13. Bake in a 375 oven for 45 minutes or until pick comes out clean
14. Serve with picante or salsa

title: best shrimp creole ever
steps:
1. Pour oil in heavy pot
2. Add onion , celery , bell pepper , garlic , all tomatoes , salt , sugar , and bay leaves
3. Bring to boil , then turn to medium heat
4. Cook for 1 hour
5. Stirring occasionally at first
6. Increase frequency of stirring as hour progresses and liquid reduces
7. After one hour the mixture goes from soupy to thick paste
8. Careful not to scorch as thickens
9. Dissolve flour in chicken broth and add to tomato sauce mixture
10. Bring to boil
11. Add shrimp and bring back to boil
12. Boil 10 minutes
13. Turn heat off , cover pot and let set for 20 minutes
14. Serve over rice and enjoy !

title: dilled mashed potatoes
steps:
1. Place the potatoes in a large saucepan with kosher salt and enough water to cover
2. Bring to a boil , reduce to a simmer , cover and cook until tender
3. Rinse pot and potatoes in hot water and place back onto warm stove to dry up water
4. Meanwhile , warm the butter and milk in a second saucepan
5. Mash potatoes with the sour cream and dill , slowly stirring in the warm milk mixture as needed
6. Season to taste with sea salt and pepper and serve immediately

title: easy crispy sesame chicken
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees
2. In a large bowl , coat the chicken well with mayonnaise all over
3. Mix the crushed honeynut cornflakes , sesame seeds , salt and pepper in a shallow dish
4. Roll / coat the chicken pieces in the mixture until well coated
5. Place in an baking dish
6. Bake for about 50-60 minutes , or until chicken is done

title: low fat pizza style minute steaks
steps:
1. Brown steaks in a large oiled skillet over medium high heat about 1 to 2 minutes per side
2. Remove from skillet and set aside
3. Reduce heat to medium and add 2 tbsps
4. Water , green pepper , onion and garlic to skillet
5. Cook and stir 2 to 3 minutes
6. Stir in pizza sauce and simmer 3 to 5 minutes to blend flavours
7. Return steaks and any accumulated juices to skillet and spoon sauce over top
8. Sprinkle cheese on top of steaks
9. Cover and heat 2 to 3 minutes or until cheese melts
10. Serve with pasta and salad or spread slices of toasted italian bread with sauce and top with steaks for an open-faced sandwich

title: coconut almond crusted chicken fingers
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 475f spray a baking sheet with olive oil
2. Place almond flour , coconut , crackers , paprika , garlic powder , dry mustard , salt and pepper in a food processor
3. Process until the crackers are finely chopped and the paprika is mixed throughout , about 1 minute
4. Transfer the mixture to a shallow dish
5. Melt butter in a second shallow dish
6. Add chicken tenders and turn to coat
7. Transfer each tender to the crumb mixture
8. Turn to coat evenly
9. Place the tenders on the prepared tray
10. Bake the chicken tenders until golden brown , crispy and no longer pink in the center , about 30 minutes , carefully turning once

title: cold peanut soba noodles
steps:
1. Combine sauce ingredients thoroughly
2. Toss cooked soba noodles with vegetables
3. Add sauce and combine to coat everything
4. Add peanuts , adjust seasoning , and chill in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes

title: light wheat hamburger buns
steps:
1. Heat water to 110 degrees f
2. Mix dry ingredients
3. Add oil and water
4. Mix until the dough is formed
5. Let rest 5 minutes
6. Knead in a stand mixer using the dough hook for 3 minutes
7. Let rest for 5 minutes
8. Knead an additional 3 minutes
9. Place dough in a lightly oiled bowl , cover and let rise until dough is doubled
10. Divide dough into 8 pieces , roll out to flatten each piece and then bring 2 opposite ends together and then bring the other 2 ends together , shaping into a ball
11. Place seam side down on a oiled baking sheet
12. Cover with plastic wrap and let buns rise until quite puffy
13. Bake in pre-heated 375 f oven for about 15 minutes
14. Cool on wire rack

title: spinach  rice and feta pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Spray a 9 inch pie plate with the cooking spray
3. Squeeze all moisture out of spinach
4. In a large saucepan , over medium heat , melt butter and saute onion 3 minutes
5. Stir in flour , salt and pepper
6. Gradually add in milk stirring with a whisk , until smooth
7. Bring mixture to a boil , reduce heat and simmer until slightly thickened , stirring constantly
8. Remove from heat
9. Stir in rice , feta , egg , egg white and spinach
10. Pour mixture into prepared pie plate , sprinkle top with parmesan and b ake for 35 minutes
11. Turn broiler on and broil until top is golden brown , about 2 minutes

title: minty asian chicken noodle salad
steps:
1. Soak the noodles for 5 mins in boiling water or according to pack instructions , until softened
2. Drain , then cool under a running tap
3. Drain again well , then
4. Mix together the soy sauce , lime zest and juice and sugar , then pour over the noodles
5. Toss through the mint leaves and serve

title: cordon bleu stromboli
steps:
1. On a lightly floured surface , roll dough into a 10-in x 8-in rectangle
2. Spread with butter
3. Top with ham , cheese and chicken
4. Roll up jelly-roll style
5. Starting with a long side
6. Pinch seam to seal and tuck ends under
7. Place seam side down on a greased baking sheet
8. Cover and let rise for 20 minute
9. Bake at 375 for 25-30 minutes or until golden brown
10. Refrigerate leftovers

title: pineapple sunrise
steps:
1. Add crushed ice to your glass
2. Then add tequila and pineapple juice
3. Stir lightly
4. Add a splash of grenadine syrup and serve

title: stuffed chicken breasts wrapped in phyllo
steps:
1. Sprinkle chicken with salt and pepper
2. Mix feta and mozzarella cheese , sun dried tomatoes , and white wine together in a bowl
3. Spread each breast with cheese mixture and add small amount of spinach
4. Roll in jelly roll fashion - tuck ends lightly to seal
5. Set aside
6. Cut sheets of phyllo dough in half making two sets of squares
7. Using four sheets separate each sheet and spread with butter , stacking together
8. Place a stuffed chicken breast on the phyllo and roll up folding sides in to secure the chicken
9. Arrange in a buttered baking dish and butter the top of the phyllo again
10. Sprinkle with cracked black pepper
11. Cover tightly with foil and bake 1 hour at 300f remove foil and bake an additional 15 minutes or until phyllo is flakey on top

title: cheddar broccoli strudel
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 f , and oil a baking sheet
2. Melt butter or olive oil in a large pan
3. Add onion and saute for about 5 minutes over medium heat
4. Add broccoli , salt and pepper , and cook for about 5 more minutes
5. Add garlic , and saute until broccoli is tender , about 5 more minutes , then remove from heat
6. Stir in bread crumbs , cheddar cheese , and lemon juice
7. To assemble: place one sheet of phyllo on a clean , dry countertop
8. Brush the top lightly with olive oil , then add a second sheet
9. Continue this process until there is a pile of five sheets
10. Add half the filling in the shape of a log to the short end of the phyllo pastry
11. Fold in the sides , then gently roll up so you have a neat little log
12. Repeat the procedure to make a second roll
13. Carefully lift the pastries onto the baking sheet 4 inches apart
14. Bake for 25-30 minutes , until golden brown
15. Cut slices with a serated edge knife in a gentle sawing motion

title: curried chicken salad with raisins and honey
steps:
1. Adjust oven rack to middle position and heat oven to 400 degrees
2. Set breasts on small , foil-lined jelly roll pan
3. Brush with oil and sprinkle generously with salt
4. Roast until meat thermometer inserted into thickest part of breast registers 160 degrees , 35 to 40 minutes
5. Cool to room temperature , remove skin and bones , and shread meat into bite-sized pieces
6. Mix all salad ingredients together in large bowl , including salt and pepper to taste
7. Serve

title: amaretto cookies
steps:
1. Combine almonds , oil , sugars , and lightly beaten egg whites in medium bowl
2. Knead mixture until dough is firm
3. Moisten hands and form dough into 1" balls
4. Place balls on parchment covered baking sheet and bake at 250 for about 60 minutes , on bottom rack in oven
5. Place cookies on cooling rack and dust with powdered sugar while still warm

title: penne with black olive sauce
steps:
1. Saute the onions with the olive oil in a medium-sized saucepan until they soften and begin to turn brown , about 5 minutes
2. Add the garlic and cook for another minute
3. Add the tomatoes , olives and bay leaves and season with salt and pepper
4. Simmer until slightly thickened , about 10 minutes
5. Taste the sauce and season with salt if needed
6. Meanwhile , bring a large pot of water to a boil
7. Add lots of salt and then the pasta
8. Stir well and cook the pasta until it's just tender , about 9 minutes
9. Drain the pasta but don't rinse it , then toss immediately with the sauce

title: red lentil soup gluten free
steps:
1. Fry onions and garlic in olive oil for 10 minutes
2. Add washed red lentils and keep stirring and turning till the red lentils turn yellow
3. Add tomatoes , stock cubes , salt and one litre hot waterdepending on how thick or thin you want it
4. Cook on low to medium till red lentils break up into a soup

title: blue ribbon barbecue ribs
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients except for ribs in a small saucepan
2. Bring to a boil
3. Place ribs in a greased 13 x 9 baking pan
4. Pour sauce over ribs
5. Bake in a 375 degree oven for 1 1 / 2 hours or until done

title: chocolaty caramel layer bars
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f
2. Into greased 13x9 pan , break up cookie dough
3. With floured fingers , press dough evenly in bottom of pan to form crust
4. Bake 15-18 minutes , till light brown
5. Cool 15 minutes
6. Meanwhile , in 2 qt pan , place 1 cup of the chips and 1 cup of the dip
7. Cook over medium heat , stir constantly , till melted and smooth
8. Remove from heat
9. Stir in cereal and peanuts
10. Spread cereal mixture over cooled crust
11. In 1 qt pan , place remaining chips and dip
12. Cook over medium heat , stir constantly , till melted and smooth
13. Spread over cereal mixture
14. Refrigerate till chocolate is set
15. Cut in bars

title: cranberry walnut scones
steps:
1. Heat oven to 425f , spray a baking sheet with veggie spray or lin it with parchment paper stir together the flour , sugar , baking powder& salt
2. Cut in the butter with a pastry blender , two knives or your finger
3. Stir in the cranberries& walnuts
4. Make a well and gradually stir in the buttermilk to form a ball the ball will be sticky and a bit difficult to work with
5. Divide the dough in half on a lightly floured board and pat each half into an 8" circle about a 1 / 2" thick
6. Cut each round into 8 triangles
7. Place scones on the prepared baking sheet
8. Brush tops with milk and sprinkle with the tbsp of sugar
9. Bake for 15 minutes until golden
10. Serve warm

title: stevia coconut peanut butter cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. In a medium mixing bowl beat together oil , peanut butter , eggs , vanilla extract , and butterscotch flavoring
3. Stir in water
4. Sift flour , stevia , and baking powder together
5. Mix half of the dry ingredients into the peanut butter mixture
6. Stir in the rest of the dry ingredients
7. Briefly chop coconut in a blender , if the pieces are large
8. Fold into cookie dough- mixture will be stiff
9. Drop by rounded teaspoons onto ungreased cookie sheets
10. Flatten with a fork in an "x" pattern
11. Bake 9-10 minutes or until golden
12. Leave cookies on baking sheet 2 minutes to cool and remove to racks to finish cooling
13. Store in an airtight container

title: bulghur feta salad
steps:
1. Stir boiling water and bughur in a heatproof bowl or sauce pan , cover and let cool , about 1 / 2 hour
2. While the grain cools , prepare the remaining ingredients
3. Combine cooled bulghur with the chopped vegetables and cheese
4. Toss entire mixture with the lemon juice and olive oil
5. Pepper to taste

title: snap beans gremolata
steps:
1. Bring large pot of water to a boil , add beans and cook 7 to 8 miutes until just tender , drain well
2. Meanwhile put remaining ingredients in a serving bowl , and stir until well blended
3. Add hot beans
4. Toss to mix and coat

title: roasted red pepper and sun dried tomato soup
steps:
1. Soak the sun-dried tomatoes in warm water for about an hour to rehydrate them
2. Place your olive oil in a pan and add onions and cook for about 7- 10 minutes until soft but do not let them brown or turn color
3. Add in your chicken broth , drained rehydrated tomatoes , roasted red peppers , fresh tomatoes and salt and pepper and let simmer for about 10 minutes
4. Pour the soup in a blender and process until blended very well and you have a smooth consistency
5. Pass soup through a strainer to remove all the vegetable skins
6. Add more salt and pepper if needed
7. Enjoy !

title: ww 4 points   crispy chipotle potato skins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425f
2. Scoop out flesh of potatoes , leaving about an 1 / 8th of potato flesh in potato
3. In a small bowl , combine oil , chili powder and hot pepper sauce
4. Using a pastry brush , brush the inside of the potato wedges with the oil mixture
5. Place potato wedges in a single layer on a large nonstick baking sheet
6. Sprinkle with bacon and cheese
7. Bake until cheese melts and potatoes are heated through , about 15 minutes
8. Sprinkle with tomatoes and scallions
9. Serve with sour cream on the side
10. Yields 2 potato skins and about 1 1 / 2 tablespoons of sour cream per serving

title: fudgy raspberry brownies
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f place butter and unsweetened chocolate in medium microwave-safe bowl
2. Microwave on high for 1 minute
3. Stir
4. Microwave 30 seconds
5. Stir until smooth
6. Set aside
7. Combine sugar , eggs and vanilla extract in large bowl
8. Beat at medium speed , until well mixed
9. Add melted chocolate mixture
10. Continue beating until well mixed
11. Reduce speed to low
12. Add flour and salt
13. Beat just until mixed
14. Spread batter into greased 13x9-inch baking pan
15. Stir jam until smooth
16. Drop tablespoonfuls of jam evenly over batter
17. Swirl jam through batter using knife
18. Bake for 40 to 45 minutes or until set and brownies begin to pull away from sides of pan
19. Cool completely
20. Place whipping cream in 1-quart saucepan
21. Cook over medium heat just until cream begins to boil
22. Add semi-sweet chocolate
23. Remove from heat
24. Stir with wire whisk until smooth
25. Spread over brownies
26. Recipe
27. For easy pan removal and cutting , line baking pan with aluminum foil , leaving 1-inch overhang on ends
28. Lightly grease foil
29. Once brownies are cooled and frosted , remove brownies by lifting foil at edges
30. Cut into bars

title: nana s hachapuri  or georgian cheese bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425f
2. Place flour in bowl then in a separate bowl mix the yogurt and egg then mix in softened oil [or butter] using a fork or mixer
3. Add the baking soda and salt
4. Add the flour , a little at a time , until you have a very soft dough
5. If dough is too soft , add a little more flour
6. Place into a floured bowl , cover and let rest for at least 20 minute
7. To make filling:
8. Crumble feta then add ricotta , grated mozzarella into bowl and mix
9. Now add egg and mix again
10. Set aside
11. On a heavily floured surface , take half the dough and roll it out to fit a 13-15 inch pizza pan
12. Place it onto pan
13. Spread cheese mixture onto it , leaving a small border around the entire edge
14. Roll out the other half of dough to fit on top
15. Place it over the cheese mixture
16. Fold in the edges to seal the cheese mixture inside , rolling to form an edge
17. Press all around with fork to seal
18. Bake for approximately 20 minutes or until golden brown
19. Cool until warm before you cut it
20. Dough:
21. 350 g flour
22. 250 g low fat yogurt
23. 1 egg
24. 25 g extra virgin olive oil
25. 1 / 2 teaspoon salt
26. 1 teaspoon baking soda
27. Filling:
28. 200 g feta cheese
29. 200 g ricotta
30. 125 g mozzarella
31. Use whole egg

title: godiva biscotti
steps:
1. Sift together the flour , baking powder , and salt
2. Set aside
3. Beat the eggs until light , add the sugar gradually and beat until the mixture is ribbony , about 10 minutes
4. Stir in the orange rind and godiva liqueur
5. Add the sifted ingredients and blend on low speed until incorporated
6. Fold in the almonds , hazelnuts , and pine nuts until blended
7. With lightly floured hands , form 3 loaves , each 12 inches long and 2 inches wide
8. Place on a buttered baking sheet and brush with egg wash
9. Bake in a preheated 350-degree oven for 20 minutes until lightly golden
10. Remove from the oven , and using a serrated knife , immediately cut diagonally into 3 / 4 inch slices
11. Lay the slices on their sides on a sheet pan , return to the oven and bake for 6 minutes on each side or until golden brown
12. Remove from the oven , cool and store in a tightly covered container
13. Serve drizzled with additional godiva liqueur

title: mi casa salsa  from costa mesa restraunt
steps:
1. In a blender or food processor place jalepenos and 1 / 2 cup onions
2. Blend for a few seconds
3. Add 2 cans of the tomatoes , cumin , sugar , garlic salt , lime juice , pepper
4. Process until ingredients are mixed well
5. Add cilantro a bit at a time until the desired taste is achieved
6. I always end up adding a bit more of garlic salt , pepper or lime juice , depending on my tastes for the day
7. Pour from blender into a bowl and add the other can of tomatoes and the rest of the onion
8. You can add more onion or even some green peppers if you like
9. Chill for a few hours
10. As the original recipe states: " fat free enjoy with baked tortilla chips" thanks my dear friend esther !
11. Place in blender or food processor

title: damson plum pudding
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f and grease an 8 x 8 baking pan
2. Cream butter and sugar together until light and fluffy
3. Add eggs and plum pulp
4. Mix well
5. Sift dry ingredients together and add alternately with milk
6. Pour into prepared pan and bake for 20 or 30 minutes
7. Cut into suares and serve with sauce
8. Sauce: heat plum juice and water
9. Mix cornstarch with sugar , pour in a little liquid and stir well
10. Stir into hot juice and cook until thickened
11. Add butter

title: vodka gilligan s island
steps:
1. Shake ingredients in a shaker
2. Add a few ice cubes to a glass , pour cocktail over
3. Garnish with a slice of orange if desired
4. Enjoy

title: low fat carrot salad
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients except nuts together , sprinkle with nuts
2. Serve immediately , because it turns brown within an hour

title: nutty rice
steps:
1. Bring 2 cups water to a boil in a medium saucepan
2. Add brown rice and wheat berries and return to a boil
3. Reduce heat to low , cover and simmer 40-45 minutes or until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed

title: tyler florence s berry scones with orange honey butter
steps:
1. You can do this the old fashioned way and add ingredients to a mason jar , cover with the lid and shake vigorously for 10 minutes , or you can use the food processor
2. In a food processor bowl add all the ingredients and turn on high
3. The liquid will slosh , whip and then separate after about 4 minutes
4. When the mixture separates , , stop processing and strain out the buttermilk - there will be just under a cup
5. Reserve the buttermilk to make the scones
6. Strain out the butter and squeeze dry
7. Work the butter a couple of times to bring it together to form a nice ball
8. Refrigerate butter until ready to use
9. For the scones: preheat oven to 400f
10. In a food processor bowl add flour , sugar , baking powder , baking soda and salt
11. Add cold butter cubes and pulse until you have the texture of coarse bread crumbs
12. Transfer to a large mixing bowl , then add 3 / 4 cup of buttermilk and stir to combine
13. As it comes together add berries and fold dough to incorporate berries but not break them up too much
14. Drop spoonfuls of dough onto a parchment lined sheet pan
