15. Using a pastry brush , paint the tops of each scone lightly with buttermilk and sprinkle with sugar
16. Bake until golden brown , and nice and puffy , about 17 to 20 minutes
17. Remove from the oven and transfer to a wire rack
18. Serve warm with the orange honey butter

title: garlic lemon green bean casserole
steps:
1. Boil green beans until crisp tender and drain
2. Add oil , lemon juice , garlic , salt and pepper and toss to coat
3. Place in ungreased 2 qt baking dish
4. Mix crumbs , cheese and butter together and sprinkle over bean mixture
5. Bake uncovered at 350 degrees for 20 minutes or until golden brown

title: best vegetarian pot stickers
steps:
1. In a wok or large saute pan , add a little oil and saute onions and ginger
2. Add the mushrooms and stir
3. Add the cabbage , carrots and chives
4. Season
5. When mixture is soft , place in colander to drain
6. Add the sesame oil and cilantro when mixture is cooled
7. Check for seasoning
8. Using the gyoza skins , make half moon dumplings keeping the bottom flat
9. In a hot non-stick pan , coat with oil and place dumplings
10. When bottom gets brown , add 1 / 4 cup of water and immediately cover
11. This will steam the dumplings
12. Carefully watch the dumplings and completely evaporate the water so that the bottom gets crispy again and sticks to the pot
13. Serve hot with soy sauce and vinegar for dipping

title: walnut raisin whole  wheat bread
steps:
1. Combine yeast , warm water , and milk in a large bowl
2. Let the mixture stand until the yeast has dissolved , about 5 minutes
3. Add the sugar , 1 / 2 cup cornmeal , butter , walnuts , raisins , salt , pepper , whole wheat flour , and 2 cups of the white flour
4. Beat well
5. Move the dough to a lightly floured surface and knead for 2-3 minutes , adding the remaining white flour as necessary to make it workable
6. Let the dough rest , covered loosley with a towel , for 10-15 minutes
7. Knead the dough again , until it is smooth and elastic , 8-10 minutes
8. Sprinkle with extra flour if you need to keep it from sticking
9. Oil a large bowl and turn the dough in it to coat with the oil
10. Cover the bowl and let dough rise in a warm place till doubled in bulk , about 1 1 / 2 hours
11. Punch dough down and divide in half
12. Shape the halves into round loaves
13. Sprinkle a baking sheet with the remaining 2 tbls
14. Cornmeal , and put the loaves on it , seam side down
15. Cover with the towel , and let them rise until doubled in bulk , about 45 minutes
16. Preheat the oven to 350f
17. Place the baking sheet on the center rack of the oven , and bake until the bread is well browned and sounds hollow when the bottom is tapped with your finger , 45 minutes
18. Cool bread on a wire rack
19. Enjoy !

title: iced tea concentrate
steps:
1. Bring water to a boil , remove from heat and add tea bags
2. Steep for 10 to 15 minutes
3. Remove tea bags , add sugar and bring to a boil again
4. Refrigerate
5. To serve: add 3 to 4 parts water to 1 part concentrate

title: contemporary duck
steps:
1. Place duckling quarters on rack in shallow roasting pan
2. Roast at 425f for about 30 minutes , or until browned
3. Remove from oven
4. Remove ducks and rack
5. Drain fat from bottom of pan
6. Place duck quarters skin side up in pan
7. Sprinkle onion soup mix evenly over ducklings and baste with wine
8. Cover pan tightly with heavy foil
9. And bake at 325f for 1 hour 15 minutes
10. Remove foil and bake for an additional 20 minutes

title: killer bread
steps:
1. Preheat broiler
2. Mix mayo , cheese and garlic in large bowl and blend
3. Arrange bread cut side up on lg
4. Cookie sheet
5. Butter bread
6. Broil till just crisp & lightly browned
7. Spread mayo / cheese mixture over cut sides of bread
8. Broil only till top is puffed & golden brown
9. Cut bread into wedges and serve
10. Serve with a nice an

title: eat more bars
steps:
1. Melt peanut butter and honey over med low heat
2. Add chocolate chips to peanut butter and honey
3. Stir until melted
4. Remove from heat
5. Add vanilla
6. Add oatmeal and peanuts
7. Press into lightly buttered 8x8 pan
8. Set in fridge until firm enough to cut into bars
9. Freeze very well
10. Enjoy !

title: solo chicken breast and pink rice pilaf
steps:
1. Make several long cuts through the husk of a pomegranate , hold it under water in a large bowl , and break it apart
2. Skim off the parts that float , then drain in a colander
3. Put the red pomegranate seeds in a food blender and grind on high for a minute
4. Strain the liquid through a sieve into a measuring cup
5. Add the lime juice and enough additional water to make a total of 2 / 3 cup liquid
6. Put the olive oil into a frying pan , add the butter and once melted , add the onion
7. Stir the onion until the flesh is nearly clear , then add the chicken and continue to stir until the meat starts to look white
8. Add the rice , stir until all the grains are covered in the oil / butter and then add the liquid
9. Turn the heat down to the lowest setting , cover with a tight fitting lid and cook for 15 minutes
10. At the end of the 15 minutes , turn off the heat
11. Do not remove the lid , and let it sit for another 15 minutes

title: tinola
steps:
1. Boil the chicken in water until cooked through
2. Take the chicken off the bone and set aside the broth
3. In a saucepan , heat oil over medium heat
4. Saute garlic , onion and garlic for about 2 minutes
5. Add the chicken and saute for another 2 to 3 minutes
6. You may add more oil to help prevent the chicken from sticking to the bottom of the pan if you wish
7. Season with fish sauce and salt
8. Add chicken stock and papaya , then bring to a boil
9. Add spinach
10. If it seems a bit bland , add more salt or fish sauce to taste
11. Cover and remove from heat
12. Let it stand 5 minutes to let the spinach cook from the soup's heat
13. Serve with rice

title: easy chicken and asparagus
steps:
1. Heat olive oil in a large pan
2. Season chicken with salt and pepper , and brown on both sides , about 4 minutes each side
3. Pour white wine over chicken and add asparagus
4. Season vegitables with more salt and pepper if desired
5. Reduce heat to simmer and cover
6. Cook until chicken juices run clear , and vegitables are tender-crisp , about 20 minutes depending on the thickness of the chicken

title: black eyed peas and hot sausage stew
steps:
1. Using a large soup pot heat up the pan on a medium heat
2. Add the sliced sausage and start browning , after about 5 minutes add the onions and stir and cook until they start to get lightly golden lifting any meat bit stuck to the bottom
3. Add sliced carrots , celery , garlic and saute a further 5-10 min until they start to soften
4. Add the broth and bring to a hard simmer and cook until carrots and celery are al dente , just barely tender
5. Do not boil hard
6. Add tomatoes one at a time reserving any liquid and breaking them up as you add them
7. I only used 2 / 3 of my can and most of the juice you'll have to judge how much tomato you prefer
8. Cook 10-15 min gently then add the garlic powder , thyme , marjoram and the smoked paprika and the beans
9. Let the pot come to a hard simmer for cook another 20-30 minutes

title: grilled fish
steps:
1. In a large bowl , marinate fillets in salad dressing in refrigerator fo 30 minutes
2. Preheat bbq grill
3. Place fillets in a hinged grill basket that has been coated with cooking spray , or oil the grill grates and place fish right on grill
4. Grill for about 10 minutes per inch-thickness of fish or until fish flakes easily with a fork
5. To broil
6. Preheat the broiler and brush the broiler pan with oil
7. Place fish about 4 inches from the broiler unit and broil for 10 minutes per inch-thickness of fish or until fish flakes easily with a fork

title: asparagus in creamy orange maltaise butter sauce
steps:
1. Wash the asparagus and snap off the ends to remove the tough part of the stalks
2. Tie the asparagus into bundles of 6-7 stalks and boil them for 10-15 minutes standing upright in a pan of hot water
3. Drain well
4. To make the sauce , in a small metal bowl or pot beat the butter , egg yolks , salt , pepper and orange rind together
5. Place over a larger pan of hot water and whisk in the orange and lemon juice cooking over a gentle heat while adding the butter a little at a time , so that it thickens , don't rush this , becuase if the previous amount of butter has not emulsified before the next lot is added , the sauce will split
6. Once it begins to thicken , remove from the heat and continue beating for a full minute , then stir in the cream
7. Mix together well , the orange juice should have turned the sauce a soft shade of pink
8. Pour the sauce into a sauce boat and serve with the bundles of asparagus immediately
9. Decorate the asparagus bundles with orange twists

title: baked beans supreme  aka gene brown beans
steps:
1. In a large pot on the stove , cook onions , garlic and meat
2. Stir in remaining ingredients and simmer on medium for a good 20 minutes or so , so that the flavors can meld
3. Serve over rice

title: grandma s peanut butter icing
steps:
1. Add together margarine , peanut butter and salt and stir until well mixed
2. Add in powdered sugar and coffee , blend well
3. Frost over cake or cupcakes
4. Enjoy !

title: crepe
steps:
1. Measure all ingredients into blender jar
2. Blend for 30 seconds
3. Scrape down sides
4. Blend for 15 seconds more
5. Cover and let sit for 1 hour not included in preparation time
6. Makes 12-14 crepes
7. For stuffing mix all ingrediants and roll in crepes
8. Variations:
9. For a sweeter crepe:
10. Add 2 teaspoons sugar and 1 teaspoon vanilla
11. For a chocolate crepe:
12. Add 2 tablespoons chocolate sauce to sweet crepe recipe

title: blackberry pudding tarts
steps:
1. Bake the tart shells according to the package directions and cool completely
2. Combine the berries and water in a saucepan and bring to a boil
3. Reduce the heat and simmer for 5 minutes , or until the berries are soft
4. Mash the berries and strain 2 cups of juice
5. Discard the pulp and seeds
6. Combine the sugar and flour in a saucepan
7. Add the blackberry juice , whisking constantly until smooth
8. Bring to a boil , whisking
9. Reduce heat and simmer for 3 min or until thickened
10. Remove from heat and add butter and 2 t vanilla
11. Spoon the filling into the cooled tart shells
12. Cool completely
13. Beat the whipping cream on medium heat until foamy
14. Gradually add in 1 / 4 c sugar
15. Beat until stiff peaks form
16. Stir in 1 / 8 t vanilla
17. Put a dollop or two of whipped cream on top of the tarts
18. Garnish as desired with fresh blackberries and mint sprigs

title: blueberry crisp
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Place blueberries in a 9x13 baking pan
3. Sprinkle with lemon juice and vanilla extract
4. Combine sugar , flour , cinnamon , and nutmeg and sprinkle over berries and toss lightly
5. Combine topping ingredients and crumble evenly over berries
6. Bake at 350 for 45 minutes
7. Serve warm with vanilla ice cream
8. Recipe may be halved and baked in a 9 x 9 square pan

title: pumpkin cheesecake topped chocolate bundt cake w  dulce de leche
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Spray a 12 cup bundt pan with flour-added cooking spray
3. In a small mixing bowl , beat softened cream cheese and both sugars until smooth
4. Thoroughly stir in eggs , pumpkin , cornstarch , vanilla and pumpkin pie spice or spice combo
5. Pour into bundt pan and bake for 15 minutes
6. While pumpkin mixture bakes , combine cocoa and chocolate in a small saucepan
7. Pour hot coffee over chocolate and whisk until smooth if coffee is not hot enough to melt chocolate , turn heat to medium and heat just enough so that chocolate melts
8. Remove from heat and whisk in sour cream
9. In a second bowl , whisk together flour , salt , and baking soda
10. Using electric mixer , beat butter , brown sugar , and vanilla on medium-high speed until pale and fluffy , about 3 minutes
11. Add eggs and continue beating for another minute
12. By hand , stir 1 / 3 of the flour mixture into batter
13. Add half of the chocolate / sour cream mixture and stir until incorporated
14. Scrape bowl and add remaining flour mixture and all of remaining chocolate mixture
15. Stir in chocolate mini chips
16. Remove bundt cake pan from oven and quickly pour chocolate mixture over pumpkin
17. Return to oven and bake for 42 minutes or until wooden skewer inserted into center comes out with few crumbs attached
18. Cool in pan 30 minutes , then invert cake onto parchment paper or cake plate
19. Let cool at room temperature for 1 hour , then transfer to refrigerator to chill
20. Before serving , drizzle with dulce de leche or caramel sauce
21. Store cake in refrigerator

title: strawberry rhubarb crisp
steps:
1. In large bowl combine rhubarb , strawberries , sugar , 1 / 3 cup flour and cinnamon
2. Put into to greased 9 x 13 inch baking dish
3. In another bowl combine remaining 1 cup flour with brown sugar , oats and nutmeg
4. Add butter and blend well
5. Sprinkle over rhubarb / strawberry mixture pat gently
6. Bake at 350 degrees for 35-40 minutes in preheated oven

title: german chocolate coconut pecan cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Grease several baking sheets or use nonstick spray
3. Spread the coconut and pecand on a rimmed baking sheet and toast in the oven , stirring occasionally for 7-9 minutes , or until lightly browned , be careful not to burn
4. Let stand unti cool
5. Set aside
6. In a medium bowl , thoroughly stir together the flour , baking powder , and salt
7. Set aside
8. In a large bowl , with electric mixer on medium speed , beat together the brown sugar and butter until very well blended and light
9. Beat in the egg , corn syrup , vanilla and coconut or almond extract until well blended
10. Beat or stir in the flour mixture , then the pecans , coconut and chocolate until evenly incorporated
11. Drop the dough onto the baking sheets by heaping measuring tbls , spacing about 3" apart
12. Using the
13. Bake the cookies , one sheet at a time , in the upper third of the oven for 6-9 minutes , or until lightly browned all over and slightly darker at the edges
14. Reverse cookie sheets halfway through baking from front to back to ensure even browning
15. Transfer the sheet to a rack and let stand until the cookies firm up slightly
16. 1-2 minutes
17. Using a spatula , transfer the cookies to wire racks and cool completely
18. Store in an airtight container for up to 10 days or freeze for up to 2 months

title: whipping cream biscuits
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine flour , sugar , salt and baking powder
2. Work butter into dry ingredients , using either fingers or slicing motion with 2 butter knives
3. Pour in half of the cream and work dough with hands
4. Add remaining cream and knead mixture 9 or 10 times
5. Dough will not be smooth
6. On floured surface , roll out dough with rolling pin , until about 1 / 2 inch thick
7. Using rim of clean glass or a cookie cutter , cut out about 24 circles of dough
8. Place on ungreased baking sheet
9. Bake in preheated 425 degree oven until golden brown , about 15 minutes

title: lime cilantro butter shallot butter
steps:
1. When butter is softened beat in all ingredients
2. Form a log by wrapping it in saran wrap
3. Twist both ends and freeze
4. Cut medalions when needed

title: sweet and salties
steps:
1. Allow cream cheese to soften at room temp or microwave for 30 seconds until it is easily spreadable
2. Place chips in a single layer on a serving platter to cover the entire surface
3. You do not have to use them all
4. Using a small spoon spread desired amount of cream cheese on each chip
5. Refrigerate any cream cheese not used
6. Using a separate spoon add a dollop of jelly on top of cream cheese reserving any unused jelly for another purpose
7. Serve immediately
8. Try other types of jam or jelly but i try to use unusual varieties for maximum 'wow' factor like mint-pear , orange-onion , tarragon-tomato etc -- excellent with pvt amy's #101956 white zinfandel jelly
9. I have even used crackers instead of chips-even plain old saltines work !
10. Have fun and experiment !

title: gringos beef and bean tacos
steps:
1. In a large skillet completely cook the ground beef , no need to drain
2. Add in the taco seasoning and the 2 cans of pinto beans with the juice
3. Mix and then let it simmer for about 10-15 minutes or until it is heated all the way through
4. In a small or medium skillet add enough oil to fry the shells
5. Wait until oil is hot and start frying your tortillas to desired donness
6. Place tortillas on a paper towel to drain off excess oil
7. To serve place everything on the family table and let everyone make their own tacos ! have fun !

title: roasted carrots   asparagus with sesame   ginger
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 475 degrees
2. Cut asparagus tops and place with carrots in a large bowl and cover with olive oil , toss to coat
3. Next sprinkle vegetables with ginger , sesame seeds and salt
4. Place veggies in a single layer in a shallow baking dish and place in oven
5. Roast for 45 minutes or until veggies or brown and tender

title: best  applesauce  ever
steps:
1. Peel , core and quarter apples
2. Place in crockpot add juice- cook on high 4-5 hours or low overnight
3. Add vanilla extract cook on low 2-3 hours
4. Thats it !
5. Serve hot w / vanilla ice cream for a treat or cold as a side dish
6. I mix it with unflavored yogurt or oatmeal

title: violet jam
steps:
1. Rinse violet blossoms well and place in a blender or food processor
2. Add 3 / 4 cups water and the lime juice
3. Blend well
4. Gradually add sugar , blending until a smooth paste is formed
5. In a saucepan , mix the pectin and remaining water
6. Bring to a boil and boil for 1 minute
7. Add to blender and blend for 1 minute
8. Quickly pour into prepared jars and seal
9. This turns a beautiful purple color

title: zraziki po krakowsku   beef roll ups
steps:
1. Cut steak into thin pieces , about 4 1 / 2 by 2 inches
2. Score , sprinkle with salt and pepper
3. Combine bread crumbs , egg , onion
4. Saute garlic in 5 tbl of the butter add to bread crumbs add salt and pepper to taste
5. Spread on each piece of meat , roll up and fasten with a skewer or a toothpick
6. Roll in flour and brown in remaining butter
7. Add 2 cups of water and simmer 1 1 / 2 hours
8. Remove toothpicks
9. Pour gravy over meat
10. Garnish with chopped parsley and serve

title: jamaican pineapple punch
steps:
1. Wash the peel of the pineapple & orange & place in a large bowl with spices & sugar
2. Add boiling water , stir , cover & leave overnight
3. Add juices & serve either hot or cold

title: celebration burgers
steps:
1. Light a charcoal fire
2. Mix eggs with cream and milk , then add torn-up bread onion , salt , horseradish , pepper , thyme , and dry mustard
3. Stir well , let stand for 10 minutes , and then stir well again , until all is well moistened and the bread is no longer in pieces
4. Add ground beef and mix well
5. Melt butter with ketchup and keep warm
6. Measure out beef in -cup increments and form patties
7. Grill over hot coals on one side
8. Turn and brush with butter-ketchup mixture
9. Grill other side
10. Serve hot

title: batata merhiya  algerian mashed potatoes layered with beef
steps:
1. Mash potatoes with butter and salt
2. Heat oil in skillet , add onion , beef and pepper
3. Saute for 5 minutes
4. Drain beef mixture
5. Butter a 1 quart casserole
6. Put half of the potatoes in the bottom of the dish
7. Add the meat mixture and cover with the remaining mashed potatoes
8. Smooth the surface
9. Cover with the beaten egg and sprinkle with cheese
10. Bake in 350 degree oven until the surface is golden about 30 minutes

title: venus de milo baked stuffed lobster
steps:
1. Prepare the lobsters for broiling and set aside
2. After the lobsters have been prepared for broiling , slowly melt 1 / 2 lb
3. Of butter taking care not to let the butter boil
4. The clear portion of the melted butter is the drawn butter
5. Slowly pour the drawn butter into a measuring cup , measuring off 2 / 3 cups
6. In a food processor , grind enough ritz crackers to make about 4 cups ,
7. Combine the crushed ritz crackers with the drawn butter a little at a time until the crackers are liberally and evenly coated
8. Fill the bottom of the lobster bodies and the lobster tails with about 1 / 2 the amount of cracker mixture
9. Next , divide the seafood into equal parts and fill the lobster body
10. Cover the lobster meat with the remaining crumbs and place the lobster on a sheet pan along with the claws
11. Pre-heat the oven to 375 degrees f
12. Cook the lobsters for approximately 30-40 minutes or until the tail meat becomes white and firm to the touch
13. Serve at once with lemon wedges and drawn butter

title: thousand island dressing ala slim
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients
2. Serve immediately

title: caesar croutons
steps:
1. Add lemon zest , garlic powder , pepper , oreagno , parmesan cheese , parsley season salt , olive oil , fresh lemon juice mix with stick blender or whisk together well
2. In large bowl mix bread cubes with caeser dressing and mix well
3. Bake on two large cookie sheets 350 for about 15-20 minutes or until toasted
4. Stirring every 5 minutes
5. Ovens may vary a bit so watch closely
6. Cool compelety and store in air tight container
7. I buy day old bread and put in freezer then when im ready to make crutons i take the bread out for about an hour then cube it , makes it a little easier , but make sure they are to room temp and soft before adding the ceasar mix
8. Save the crusts and toast in oven and make bread crumbs
9. When im making caesar salad i use this recipe and add 2-3 anchovy fillets
10. A nice change from creamy dressings

title: lemonade cookies
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400f
2. In a large bowl , cream together the butter and 1 cup sugar
3. Beat in the eggs
4. In another large bowl , combine the flour and baking soda and add to the egg mixture alternately with 1 / 2 cup lemonade concentrate
5. Stir in the lemon peel
6. Drop by teaspoonfuls 2-inches apart onto ungreased cookie sheets
7. Bake for 8-9 minutes , or until the edges are golden
8. Remove the cookies from the oven
9. Brush lightly with the remaining lemonade concentrate then sprinkle with the remaining 2 tablespoons sugar

title: choose a colour popcorn treat
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300f degrees
2. Line large shallow roasting pan with heavy-duty aluminum foil , extending foil over edges of pan
3. Grease foil with butter
4. Remove all unpopped kernels from popped popcorn
5. Pour popcorn into prepared pan
6. Keep warm in oven
7. In medium saucepan , combine sweetened condensed milk and dry gelatin
8. Heat and stir over medium heat until mixture is slightly thickened and bubbly , 4-5 minutes
9. Pour eagle brand mixture over popcorn
10. Using a long-handled wooden spoon , stir gently to coat
11. Bake 20 minutes , stirring every 5 minutes
12. Carefully turn out onto large piece of lightly buttered foil
13. Cool
14. Break into pieces or clusters

title: ivy house indiana sugar cream pie
steps:
1. In a saucepan , combine the sugar , cornstarch , milk , butter , and salt
2. Place pan over medium heat and cook , stirring or whisking continuously for 5-7 minutes or until the mixture starts to boil
3. Lower heat slightly and continue to cook , rapidly whisking for about 2 minutes
4. Remove pan from heat and stir in vanilla
5. Pour the filling into the cooled pie shell , smooth the top
6. Place the pie on a wire rack
7. Let cool completely , then refrigerate at least 2 hours or overnight
8. Serve with a dollop of whipped cream

title: champignons a la monegasque
steps:
1. Trim stalks of mushrooms and if small leave whole , otherwise cut in half or quarters according to size
2. Heat oil in heavy pan and gently cook the mushrooms
3. After 5 mins season with pepper and add the anchovy fillets , mint and lemon juice
4. Cook until liquid is reduced
5. Sprinkle with parsley and serve at once

title: fruit filled muffins
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400f
2. Grease bottoms only of 12 regular-size muffin cups with shortening or cooking spray , or line with paper baking cups
3. Stir milk , oil and egg until blended
4. Stir in bisquick mix and sugar
5. Divide batter evenly among muffin cups
6. Drop 1 level teaspoon fruit preserves onto center of batter in each cup
7. Bake 13 to 18 minutes or until golden brown
8. Mix powdered sugar and water until smooth
9. Allow muffins to cool slightly before drizzling icing over warm muffins

title: feta cheese and bacon stuffed chicken breasts
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. In a small bowl combine olive oil , lemon juice , garlic , oregano , salt and pepper
3. Butterfly cut the chicken
4. Mix together feta and bacon
5. Stuff each breast with feta and bacon mixture
6. Secure sides of chicken with toothpicks
7. Pour oil mixture over top of breasts
8. Bake uncovered for 30 - 35 minutes

title: peppercorn crusted salmon with white wine butter sauce
steps:
1. For salmon:
2. Mix first 7 ingredients in heavy medium saucepan
3. Stir over medium heat until sugar dissolves
4. Simmer 10 minutes
5. Cool
6. Place salmon in large glass baking dish
7. Pour brine over
8. Cover and refrigerate 6 to 8 hours , stirring occasionally
9. Preheat oven to 350f
10. Remove salmon from brine
11. Pat dry
12. Arrange salmon on large baking sheet
13. Strain brine into heavy medium saucepan
14. Place all peppercorns in plastic bag
15. Using rolling pin , coarsely crush peppercorns
16. Add peppercorns to brine
17. Simmer over medium heat 15 minutes
18. Strain , reserving peppercorns
19. Discard brine
20. Spread top of each salmon fillet with 2 teaspoons honey
21. Divide peppercorn mixture over honey , pressing gently to adhere
22. Bake salmon until cooked through , about 25 minutes
23. Meanwhile , prepare sauce
24. Combine wine , shallot , and vinegar in heavy small saucepan
25. Boil until liquid is reduced to 2 tablespoons , about 10 minutes
26. Add cream and boil until liquid is reduced to 1 / 4 cup , about 8 minutes
27. Strain sauce and return to same saucepan
28. Bring to simmer
29. Remove from heat
30. Gradually add butter , whisking just until melted
31. Season sauce to taste with salt and pepper
32. Transfer salmon to plates
33. Pour sauce around salmon
34. Sprinkle with dill

title: french oriental salmon grill
steps:
1. Whisk together everything but the salmon
2. Brush over salmon
3. Grill on barbecue 5 minutes per side , basting occasionally

title: uncle bill s bulgarian stew
steps:
1. Add olive oil , pork , peppers and onions in a large pot and stir fry until pork is done , stirring frequently
2. Add tomato sauce and 2 cans of water
3. Add all spices , lemon juice , and bouillon cube and stir
4. Bring to a boil
5. Add green beans and northern beans and stir
6. Lower heat to low , cover with lid and simmer for 2 hours stirring often in between

title: simply delicious crock pot pork loin
steps:
1. Place raw pork in the crockpot / slowcooker
2. Sprinkle with all remaining ingredients
3. Turn pork to coat well
4. Cover and cook on high for 4-6 hours or on low for 6-8 hours

title: coconut rice dessert
steps:
1. Rinse rice and cook in rice cooker
2. In a saucepan , combine coconut milk and 1 1 / 4 cups of the brown sugar
3. Cook over medium heat , stirring constantly , until thickened , about 20 minutes
4. Wilt banana leaves over low heat on electric stove
5. Line a 13 x 9 x 2 inch baking pan
6. Preheat electric oven to 350 degrees f
7. Put cooked rice into a large bowl
8. Reserving 1 / 2 cup of the coconut milk mixture , stir remainder and remaining brown sugar evenly into the hot rice
9. Put into prepared pan
10. Top with the reserved 1 / 2 cup coconut milk mixture
11. Bake for 20 minutes , then broil for five minutes to set topping
12. Cut into small pieces

title: weiners on a stick
steps:
1. Heat oil to 375 degrees f on a deep fry thermometer
2. In a small saucepan , heat bbq sauce
3. Keep warm
4. Combine pancake mix , cornmeal , sugar , and water
5. Beat until just smooth
6. Let stand 10 minutes
7. Dip weiners in the batter so they are coated all over
8. Fry coated weiners , a few at a time , until crisp and golden brown all over
9. Lift out carefully with a slotted spoon and drain well on paper towels
10. Insert a skewer in one end of each weiner
11. Serve immediately with warmed bbq sauce for dipping

title: best chicken tagine
steps:
1. Heat oil in heavy large pot over medium heat
2. Brown chicken and remove
3. Add onion , garlic , and ginger to the pot
4. Cover and cook until onion is tender , stirring often , about 5 minutes
5. Add paprika , turmeric , ground coriander , ground cumin , cayenne pepper and cinnamon and stir 1 minute to lightly 'toast' the spices
6. Stir in 2 cups water , chickpeas , tomatoes with juices , honey and coriander roots
7. Bring to boil
8. Reduce heat , cover , and simmer 10 minutes
9. Sprinkle chicken with salt and pepper
10. Add to pot
11. Cover and simmer for about 50 minutes - or until the chicken is cooked and tender
12. Add more water to cover the chicken if liquid has evaporated
13. When the chicken is almost ready , begin to prepare the cous-cous as per packet instructions
14. Add the chicken stock powder to the cous cous
15. When the cous cous has absorbed the liquid , add the almonds and stir through
16. If using drumsticks , remove the drumsticks and strip the meat from the bones
17. Return the meat back to the mixture and mix through
18. Stir sesame seeds through
19. Serve on a bed of cous cous , garnished with coriander leaves

title: bills fruit pie
steps:
1. Mix all dry products in a small container then put blueberrys in a small container and the rest of the fruit in a larger one
2. Add honey and maple syrup to other fruit
3. Mix 2 tablespoons of dry mix with the blueberrys and the rest with the other fruit
4. Let rest for 30 min
5. Line pie plate with pillsbury crust and put the blueberry mix in the bottom and the rest of the pruit on top
6. Put crust on top and pierce 8 or 9 times
7. Bake at 400 for 15 min then reduce to 350 for 45 minute

title: crab   spinach casserole
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees
2. Spray 1 1 / 2-quart casserole or square baking dish , 8x8x2 inches , with cooking spray
3. Cook and drain pasta as directed on package
4. While pasta is cooking , mix soup mix and milk in 1-quart saucepan
5. Heat to boiling , stirring constantly
6. Cut up garlic clove and place in a medium size bowl
7. Wash and drain spinach and place in same bowl
8. Mix pasta and crab claw meat with items in bowl
9. Pour soup mixture over pasta mixture
10. Stir gently to mix
11. Pour entire mixture in casserole and spread evenly
12. Sprinkle with cheese
13. Bake uncovered about 25-30 minutes or until bubbly and light golden brown

title: rotisserie chicken pasta
steps:
1. Heat oil in pan
2. Add chicken , garlic , peppers , onion , rosemary , salt& pepper
3. Saute until hot on high heat , then add lemon butter , pasta and adjust with salt and pepper
4. Heat until hot , then finish with whole butter--add and combine--ready to serve

title: easy ice cream sandwich cake  dairy free
steps:
1. Layer a 8x10 pan with rows of cookies
2. Beat topping with pudding mix until stiff like whipped cream
3. Pour over layer of cookies
4. Put on second layer of cookies
5. Freeze
6. Cut into portions when ready to serve

title: double lemon pudding sprite bundt cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Grease bundt pan
3. Mix all ingredients together well
4. Bake for 45-55 minutes
5. Serve plain with whipped cream or ice cream

title: spinach  avocado   mango salad
steps:
1. Wash , pick over and dry the spinach
2. Wash , dry and tear up the radicchio
3. Wash and slice the radishes
4. Peel and slice the mango and avocado
5. Mix the spinach , radicchio , sliced radishes , peeled and sliced avocado , and peeled and sliced mango
6. Whisk together , or shake in a jar , the orange juice , mustard , salt , pepper and oil
7. Toss gently into the salad

title: the best cranberry salad
steps:
1. Mince cranberries with a hand-blender , food-processor , or some kind of chopper
2. I use my braun hand-blender , and the little cup it came with , which is used to chop things really small
3. But you only fill it a 1 / 4 to a 1 / 2 full each time , or they won't be minced properly
4. In a bowl , mix the first four ingredients , and refrigerate for at least one hour , best if overnight
5. In the morning , or shortly before serving , whip the whipping cream until it peaks
6. Set aside
7. Add the marshmallows to the cranberry mixture , until thoroughly incorporated into the mix
8. Then slowly fold in the whipped cream , until it's completely mixed
9. Refrigerate until serving

title: roast pork calypso
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f with a sharp knife , lightly score the pork loin by making diagonal cuts 1 / 4 inch deep at 1-inch intervals on the fat side
2. Place the pork scored side up in a shallow roasting pan just large enough to hold it comfortably
3. If you prefer to use a meat thermometer , insert it into the loin after you have scored the fat side
4. Be sure the
5. Roast the loin in the middle of the oven for 1 hour , or until the pork is golden brown
6. Remove the pan from the heat and transfer the loin to a cutting board or platter
7. Skim the fat from the juices in the pan , pour in the stock , and set the pan and its liquid aside
8. With a large mortar and pestle or in a small bowl with the back of a spoon , mash the brown sugar , 2 tablespoons of dark rum , garlic , ginger , cloves , bay leaf , salt and pepper to a smooth paste
9. With a metal spatula or your finger
10. Return the loin to the pan scored side up and roast in the middle of the oven for another 30 minutes , or until the surface is crusty and brown
11. Transfer the loin to a heated platter and let it rest for 10 minutes for easier carving
12. Meanwhile , slowly warm the light rum in a small skillet over low heat
13. Off the heat , ignite the rum with a match , then slide the skillet gently back and forth until the flames completely die out
14. Bring the liquid remaining in the baking pan to a boil over high heat
15. Give the arrowroot-and-water mixture a quick stir to recombine it , and add it to the pan
16. Stirring constantly , cook briskly until the sauce thickens enough to coat the spoon heavily
17. Remove the pan from the heat and stir in the flamed rum and the lime juice
18. Taste for seasoning and pour the sauce into a heated bowl or sauceboat

title: pumpkin   pecan pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. In mixing bowl combine pumpkin , brown and granulated sugar , cinnamon , ginger , allspice cloves , salt vanilla , eggs and milk
3. Mix until blended
4. Pour into unbaked pie shell
5. Bake at 350f for 40 minutes
6. While baking prepare topping
7. For the topping , mix 1 / 4 cup butter , 1 / 2 cup brown sugar and 3 / 4 cups chopped pecans until crumbly
8. Sprinkle the topping on the pie and bake an additional 25 minutes
9. Cool and refrigerate for a few hours to make slicing easier
10. Can be prepared the day before

title: pimientos
steps:
1. Wash peppers and remove inner seeds and membranes
2. Cut into strips or small 1 / 2-inch pieces
3. Cover the peppers with boiling water and let soak for five minutes
4. Drain water
5. Combine vinegar , water and sugar in a glass or enamel pan
6. Bring to a boil
7. Simmer five minutes , removed from heat and add garlic , oil and salt
8. Place peppers in a sterlized quart canning jar and pour the vinegar mixture over them to cover
9. Store for two weeks in refrigerator before using
10. This will keep for several months in the refrigerator

title: vegetarian chicken salad
steps:
1. Microwave the chick'n strips in a bowl until heated through
2. Shred the carrots , celery , onion , apple , and chick'n strips in a food processor
3. Transfer above items to a bowl and add the raisins and miracle whip
4. If your other items were already refrigerated and cold , you can go ahead and enjoy
5. Otherwise , chill for an hour or two
6. Then serve on bread , in a pita , or my favorite--in a tortilla

title: like cafe rio coata vida cilantro lime dressing
steps: 1. Put all into a blender until slightly thickened

title: stuckey s pecan log rolls
steps:
1. Line a 9x5 inch loaf pan with buttered wax paper
2. Set aside
3. Combine corn syrup , water and sugar in small heavy saucepan
4. Cook over medium heat , stirring constantly , until sugar dissolves and mixture comes to a boil
5. Wash down side of pan with pastry brush dipped in hot water frequently , to remove sugar crystals
6. Add candy thermometer
7. Continue to cook until mixture reaches the hard-ball stage
8. Meanwhile , beat egg white and cream of tarter with heavy duty electric mixer , until stiff but not dry
9. Slowly pour hot syrup into egg white , beating constantly
10. Add vanilla extract
11. Beat until candy forms soft peaks and starts to lose its gloss
12. Spoon fondant into the prepared pan
13. Cut into three strips lengthwise , then crosswise in center
14. Freeze until firm
15. Roll into logs
16. Place back in freezer
17. Line another baking sheet with wax paper , set aside
18. Melt caramels with water in small but heavy saucepan over low heat
19. Stir occasionally
20. Arrange pecans on wax paper
21. Working quickly , drop 1 piece of the frozen fondant into melted caramels to coat
22. While still warm , roll in pecans to completely coat the outside
23. Place on prepared baking sheet to set
24. Repeat with remaining fondant pieces
25. Reheat the caramel mixture if it becomes too thick
26. Cut finished logs into 1 / 2 inch slices
27. Store in the refrigerator in an airtight container between layers of wax paper or freeze for up to three months

title: poppy seed crescents
steps:
1. To make dough: combine eggs in a 1-cup measuring cup with enough warm water to equal 3 / 4 cup and transfer egg / water to large bowl and then stir in the yeast
2. Let stand until mixture bubbles
3. Whisk in 3 / 4 cup flour , milk , sugar and vanilla , stirring until smooth
4. Cover with plastic wrap and let stand in warm area 1 1 / 2 to 2 hours
5. Combine remaining flour with salt in a large bowl
6. Add butter and mix , working butter into flour with finger
7. Pour yeast batter into flour / butter mixture , folding in using a rubber spatula , moistening the flour but not breaking up the butter
8. Dough will be crumbly
9. Turn dough onto floured board , patting dough into a 12 x18 inch rectangle
10. With a metal spatula fold right 1 / 3 of dough towards center , then left 1 / 3 over to cover
11. Lift folded dough up from board and sprinkle with flour
12. Repeat 3 more times
13. Cover dough with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 45 minutes or up to 24 hours before proceeding
14. To make filling: using a food processor , combine poppy seeds , hazel nuts and raisins , mincing using of / off turns
15. Do not form a paste
16. Heat milk with sugar in a saucepan over medium heat
17. Add poppy seed mixture and cook until thickened , stirring constantly
18. Stir in lemon juice and lemon peel
19. Let cool
20. To make glaze: in a small bowl beat almond glaze until softened
21. Beat in almond extract
22. Gradually add egg white , mixing constantly until smooth
23. To assemble pastries: line two baking sheets with parchment paper
24. Divide dough in half
25. On a floured board roll dough out to form a 7 x 30-inch rectangle
26. Trim dough to make dough exactly 7 x 30 and have edges even
27. Mark dough at 3-inch intervals on both long sides
28. Cut dough diagonally into triangles going in a zig-zag pattern from one side to the next
29. At the base of each triangle , cut 1 / 2 inch long slit in dough
30. Place one teaspoon filling on each triangle one inch from base , spread dough out slightly on each side of slit , lifting dough over filling and rolling up completely towards the point
31. Transfer to pastry sheet , point side down
32. Curve slightly o form crescents
33. Repeat with remaining dough and filling
34. Cover pastries with plastic wrap
35. Repeat with second half of dough and remaining filling
36. Let pastries rest for 30 minutes
37. Preheat oven to 400f
38. Brush pastries with glaze , avoiding cut edges
39. Bake 10 minutes , reduce oven temp to 350f and bake 10 more minutes or until golden brown
40. Cool on wire rack

title: spiced up boring old baked beans
steps:
1. Cook on in a pan for a couple of minutes until soft
2. Add the remaining ingredients and bring to the boil
3. Simmer to thicken the sauce to your liking
4. Serve with toast

title: minister s delight
steps:
1. Place one can of cherry pie filling in the bottom or a 9 x 13 cake pan
2. In a large bowl , combine one yellow cake mix , and the melted margarine ,
3. Mix well , will be a little dry and crumbly
4. Dot cake mixture on top of pie filling as evenly as possible
5. Place in oven and bake at 350 for 20-30 minutes
6. This recipe can also be made in a crock pot on low for 2-3 hours

title: flourless chewy oatmeal cookies
steps:
1. Melt the butter and set aside to cool
2. Place oats in a medium-sized bowl
3. Stir in both sugars and the salt and blend to break up any lumps
4. In a separate bowl , whisk together the melted butter , vanilla and egg
5. Stir this into the oat mixture , mixing with your hands or a large wooden spoon to work in the ingredients
6. Form into a large ball of dough
7. Chill the dough 20 minutes
8. Preheat oven to 350f
9. Meanwhile , prepare a baking sheet by lining with parchment paper
10. Form the chilled dough into 1-inch balls and flatten down very slightly on the baking sheet
11. Bake for 13 to 17 minutes or until the edges are nicely browned and the tops of the cookies are medium golden in color
12. Cool well on the baking sheet before attempting to remove , using a metal spatula or icing knife
13. The dough can also be brought to room temperature and flattened more when placed on the baking sheet to make a large , crisp and lace-like cookie
14. Keep the cookies refrigerated

title: hot tamale  burgers
steps:
1. Bring rice and 3 cups water to a boil in medium sauce pan
2. Reduce heat to low , cover and simmer 40 minutes or until water is absorbed by rice
3. Meanwhile , heat oil in large skillet over medium heat
4. Add onion , bell pepper , corn , chipotle , adobo sauce , garlic , cumin and salt
5. Saut 2 minutes , then reduce heat to low
6. Cover and cook 15 minutes or until vegetables are tender , stirring once or twice
7. Whisk 1 / 2 cup cornmeal in bowl add to skillet mixture and cover and cook on low for 10 minutes more
8. Stirring once or twice
9. Remove from heat , and stir in hot rice , cilantro , lime juice and zest
10. Cool 20 minutes
11. Wet hands and shape mixture into 8 burgers
12. Refrigerate 30 minutes
13. Prepare grill to medium heat
14. Brush burgers and grill rack with olive oil
15. Grill 7 minutes per side or until crusty on the outside

title: sour cream apple pie
steps:
1. Combine first 8 ingredients
2. Pour into prebaked 9 inch pie shell
3. Bake in 375f oven for 30 minutes
4. In the meantime , combine the topping ingredients
5. Crumble over pie
6. Bake for another 10-15 minutes

title: easy microwave cake
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a batter bowl
2. Pour into a small microwave safe baking dish such as the pampered chef mini baker
3. Cover baker with a plate
4. "bake" on high in the microwave for 13 minutes
5. Let stand for 5 minutes , then invert on to plate

title: maple pumpkin spice popcorn
steps:
1. In a large saucepan or pot , heat brown sugar , maple syrup and pumpkin pie spice mix over medium heat
2. Cook , stirring , 3 minutes or until sugar is dissolved and mixture is bubbling
3. Stir in butter until melted and well blended
4. Add pecans , if desired , and popcorn and stir until well coated
5. Allow mixture to cool before serving
6. Serve immediately or store in an airtight container

title: brandy pecan chocolate indulgence
steps:
1. Preheat oven 350f
2. Grease or spray with non-stick cooking spray a 9 x 9 baking pan
3. Cream sugar and butter until fluffy
4. Combine eggs , vanilla , brandy and add to butter mixture
5. Combine flour , baking powder , salt and cocoa powder and add to butter mixture one addition at a time
6. Add milk
7. Batter will be thick
8. Stir in pecans and chocolate chips
9. Spread batter evenly into prepared pan
10. Bake 40 - 45 minutes
11. Two ways to top it:
12. While hot , pour 1 / 2 cup semi-sweet chocolate chips on top , spread after a minute to make a thin chocolate topping , add additional pecans if desired
13. Or glaze:
14. Heat butter in medium saucepan over medium heat until melted
15. Cool for 2 minutes , add powdered sugar , brandy and milk and beat until smooth
16. Drizzle top of cooled cake

title: quick tomato alphabet soup
steps:
1. Melt the butter in a saucepan over medium high heat
2. Add onion , carrot and celery , saute 4 minutes or until tender
3. Add broth , basil , pepper and tomatoes , bring to boil , reduce heat , simmer 15 minutes
4. Stir in 1 / 2 cup pasta
5. Remove from heat , let stand 5 minutes
6. Place half of the tomato mixture in a blender and process until smooth
7. Pour pureed soup into a large bowl , repeat procedure with remaining tomato mixture
8. Return pureed soup to pan
9. Stir in remaining pasta and milk
10. Cook over medium high heat 2 minutes or until thoroughly heated , stirring frequently , do not boil

title: homemade ketchup with carrot  deceptively delicious
steps:
1. Stir all the ingredients together in a big saucepan and bring to a boil over medium-high heat
2. Reduce the heat and simmer until the mixture has reduced by about half , 10-20 minutes
3. Let cool before serving
4. Refrigerate in an airtight container for up to five days or freeze in -cup amounts in zipper-lock snack bags for up to three months

title: tequila fried rice
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large skillet
2. Saute the onions and garlic until just golden , about 7 minute
3. Add the tequila and lime juice
4. Increase the heat to high
5. Add the rice
6. Stir the rice frequently to coat the rice with oil
7. Fry until rice is golden brown and all of the grains are coated , about 5 minute
8. Stir in the parsley

title: indian spiced chickpea and fire roasted tomato soup
steps:
1. Heat olive oil over medium heat in a large pot
2. Add garlic and cook 2-3 minutes
3. Grind the chickpeas and onion in a food processor
4. Add to pot and cook 5 minutes to sweeten onion
5. Season the chickpeas with cumin , cardamom , turmeric , salt and pepper
6. Stir in stock , then tomatoes
7. Simmer soup for 5-10 minutes to combine the flavors
8. Serve with a dollop of yogurt and warm pita for dipping

title: hot basil chicken   cha kdao sach maon
steps:
1. Add cooking oil to a wok and heat
2. Add garlic , chicken , chillies , fish sauce and water
3. Cook for 10 minute
4. Add peanuts oyster & sweet soy sauce and basil
5. Stir and cook until basil is slightly wilted

title: crab and avocado quesadilla
steps:
1. If you're cooking this in panni press or toaster oven , put the ingredients on one half of the tortilla
2. If you're using a microwave or oven , spread them out over the whole tortilla
3. Sprinkle the cheese on the tortilla
4. Put the crab on
5. Put the avocado slices on
6. Snip small circles of the green part of the green onion onto the tortilla
7. Season , to taste , with salt and pepper
8. Put on a dash of nutmeg or chilli powder , if you like

title: easy russian salad dressing
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients in a covered container
2. Shake well
3. Let flavors meld and store in refrigerator at least 1 hour ahead of when you need it
4. Mix with green salad ingredients

title: chicken thighs with artichokes
steps:
1. In large skillet cook prosciutto in the 2 teaspoons hot oil over medium-high heat 2 minutes or until crisp
2. Remove
3. Sprinkle chicken with salt and pepper
4. Cook in same skillet 8-10 minutes or until browned , turning once
5. Transfer to a bowl
6. Set aside
7. Add remaining olive oil and artichokes to skillet
8. Cook and stir 3 minutes until golden brown
9. Transfer to the bowl with chicken
10. Add mushrooms to skillet
11. Cook 3 minutes , stirring up browned bits , until golden
12. Stir in garlic and tarragon
13. Cook 1 minute
14. In second bowl whisk together flour , broth , and vinegar
15. Remove skillet from heat
16. Add broth mixture
17. Add chicken and artichokes
18. Return to heat
19. Bring to boiling
20. Reduce heat
21. Simmer , uncovered , until thickened
22. Top with prosciutto and tarragon

title: cochon sauce piquant
steps:
1. Heat oil in a heavy sauce pot
2. Add flour , cook stirring constantly until the color of copper
3. Stir in onions and bell pepper , cook until tender
4. Add roast , water , ro-tel , crushed tomatoes , cayenne , salt and pepper
5. Stir to combine
6. Cook on medium-low heat for 1 hour
7. Serve over cooked rice

title: chicken soup with rice from scratch
steps:
1. Combine chicken and water in large pot
2. Bring to a boil
3. Skimm off any scum that rises to the top
4. Reduce heat to med / low
5. Cover and simmer 15 minutes
6. Add onion , salt , thyme , bay leaf , garlic and peppercorns
7. Simmer covered for additional 35 to 45 minutes or until chicken falls off the bone
8. Remove chicken , bay leaf and peppercorns from broth
9. Cool
10. Remove chicken from bones
11. Cut into bite size pieces
12. Skim fat from broth
13. You may want to put broth into the fridge for several hours or overnight
14. It is easier to remove the fat
15. Bring broth to a boil
16. Stir in chicken pieces , celery , carrots and rice - i add a little more onion too
17. Reduce heat
18. Cover and simmer for 30 minutes or until veggies / rice are tender
19. I add the peas for the last 10 minutes
20. If you are using noodles instead of rice , add uncooked noodles at this stage
21. Add parsley or green onion if desired

title: peach bellini
steps:
1. Combine peach chunks , sugar , and lemon juice
2. Allow to sit 30 minutes
3. Bring to a boil , stirring in sugar until dissolved
4. Reduce heat to low , cover and cook 15 minutes
5. Remove from heat and allow to cool
6. Pour through a strainer , pressing solids to extract flavor and juices
7. Chill and discard solids
8. Place about 1 tbsp of the peach syrup in a flute and fill with champagne
9. Garnish with a peach slice and mint sprig

title: versatile bacon cheese spread
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients thoroughly
2. From into a ball or pack into a serving dish and chill 1 hour
3. Serve as suggested in the description

title: hg s spinach  tomato  feta  n egg wrap attack
steps:
1. Spray a small pan with nonstick spray , and bring to medium heat
2. Add egg substitute , and cook to form an egg patty
3. Remove egg patty and set aside
4. Remove the pan from heat , re-spray , and then return to medium heat
5. Add chopped spinach and both types of tomatoes
6. Stirring occasionally , cook for about 1 minute
7. Add the cheese to the pan and cook for an a dditional 30 seconds
8. Remove from heat , and allow to cool slightly
9. Meanwhile , heat tortilla in the microwave until slightly warm
10. Place veggie / cheese mixture in the center of the tortilla
11. Place egg patty on top , and wrap the tortilla up envelope style
12. Place wrap in the toaster oven and bake for 1 - 2 minutes
13. Enjoy !

title: creamy raspberry dessert
steps:
1. Combine crumbs , 3 tablespoons sugar and butter
2. Press into the bottom of an 8-in
3. Or 9-in
4. Springform pan
5. Bake at 350 for 10 minutes
6. Cool
7. Meanwhile , for filling , drain raspberries and reserve juice
8. Set berries aside
9. In a small saucepan , combine juice , cold water and gelatin
10. Let stand for 5 minutes
11. Cook and stir over low heat until gelatin dissolves
12. Remove from the heat
13. Cool for 10 minutes
14. In a mixing bowl , beat cream cheese and sugar until blended
15. Add berries and gelatin mixture
16. Beat on low until thoroughly blended
17. Chill until partially set
18. Watch carefully , as mixture will set up quickly
19. By hand , gently fold in whipped cream
20. Spoon into the crust
21. Chill for 6 hours or overnight
22. Just before serving , run knife around edge of pan to loosen
23. Remove sides of pan
24. Top with fresh raspberries and whipped cream

title: tamarind chicken wings
steps:
1. Chop the shallots
2. Throw all the marinade ingredients into a food processor and whiz till you get a nice smooth paste
3. Taste the marinade
4. It should have a pronounced tamarind-y and sweet flavour
5. Don't worry about the saltiness yet
6. Take the chicken wings and cut each wing into two at the joint
7. In a large bowl , add the chicken wings and marinade and mix well with your hands
8. Cover and leave it to marinate overnight in the refrigerator , even 24 hours if you can
9. After the marinating time is over , you'll find that some of the marinade has pooled in your bowl
10. Transfer the chicken wings to another bowl , gently shaking off any excess marinade
11. Now you'll have marinated wings in one bowl and excess marinade in the other
12. We're about to deep-fry the chicken wings and the excess marinade will form our dipping sauce
13. The wings must be fried only when required so they stay hot
14. To make the sauce , take a pan , heat it , and pour the extra marinade into it
15. Add about 1 / 2 cup of water or chicken stock and cook over medium heat for about 15-20 minutes till you have a sweet and fruity-sour sauce the consistency of tomato ketchup
16. At this point , taste the sauce for saltiness and flavour balance
17. Adjust if required
18. Turn off the heat
19. For the wings: in a frying pan , heat about 300 ml oil for deep-frying
20. Fry as many wings on medium-high heat at one time as you can without crowding them too much
21. This should take about 5 minutes or till it turns a nice brown
22. Remove the first batch to a platter and dry the extra oil off with paper towels
23. Repeat this till you've fried the entire batch of wings
24. Resist the temptation to eat them after they're fried
25. Actually , go ahead , try one piece
26. )
27. Now you have deep-fried wings and a dipping sauce
28. How you want to take it from here is up to you
29. You can serve the wings with the sauce on the side , or you can pour the sauce on top of the wings with a spoon to coat them
30. The second option is messier to eat , but more fun

title: pizza spirals
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Unroll dough into 4 long rectangles
3. Press diagonal perforations firmly to seal
4. Spread warmed cream cheese evenly on dough
5. Spread pizza sauce evenly on top of cream cheese
6. Add oregano and garlic spreading evenly over all
7. Sprinkle chopped pepperoni over all
8. Sprinkle cheese over all and then roll up and slice in 1" slices
9. Bake for 15 minutes

title: barbecued pork sandwiches   crockpot
steps:
1. Trim fat from meat
2. In a bowl combine dry spices and rub into all sides of meat
3. Add 1 cup water to large crockpot then place the meat into the crockpot
4. Cook on low for 6 - 8 hours until done
5. When meat is done remove from crockpot and transfer to a plate cover with foil and let sit
6. In the mean time make the sauce by mixing the tomato sauce , ketchup , onion , green pepper , vinegar , brown sugar , worchestershire sauce , mustard , chili powder , garlic in a medium saucepan and simmer for 15 minutes
7. Pull the pork and shred it with forks and combine the sauce and meat and serve

title: tyler florence s ultimate roast chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees f
2. Rinse the chicken with cool water , inside and out
3. Pat it dry with paper towels
4. Divide the herbs , keeping 1 / 2 of them whole
5. Finely chop the other half
6. In a small bowl , mash the softened butter with the chopped herbs , until combined
7. Rub the herbed butter under the skin , as well as all over the outside of the chicken
8. Season the bird all over with salt and pepper
9. Stuff the cavity with the orange , garlic , 1 onion , and the remaining herbs
10. Tie the legs together with kitchen twine to help hold its shape
11. Place the chicken , breast-side up , in a roasting pan
12. Put the remaining onion into the pan , which will help color and flavor the sauce
13. Lay the strips of bacon across the breast of the chicken and roast for 25 minutes
14. Remove the bacon and baste the chicken with the drippings and cook for another 25 minutes to brown the skin
15. The chicken is done when an instant-read thermometer reads 165 degrees f when inserted into the thickest part of the thigh remove the chicken to a platter and let stand for 10 minutes , so the juices settle back into the meat before carving
16. Meanwhile , remove the softened onion from the roasting pan
17. Tilt the pan so the drippings collect in 1 corner , skimming off as much fat as possible , and leaving the drippings
18. Place the roasting pan on top of the stove over medium heat and take a wooden spoon to scrape up the flavor from the bottom of the pan
19. Stir the flour into the drippings to make a roux-like paste
20. Pour in the chicken broth in stages
21. Continue to stir to dissolve the flour evenly to prevent lumps
22. Stir in the sherry and season with salt and pepper
23. To serve , carve the chicken tableside and squeeze the oranges from the cavity over the meat

title: sauteed kale with smoked paprika
steps:
1. Cook kale in large pot of boiling salted water until wilted , about 5 minutes
2. Transfer to colander
3. Drain
4. Heat 1 tablespoon oil in heavy large skillet over medium heat
5. Add onion and saut until soft , about 5 minutes
6. Stir in 1 / 4 teaspoon smoked paprika and crushed red pepper
7. Sprinkle with salt
8. Add kale and saut until heated through , about 4 minutes
9. Season to taste with salt and pepper and more smoked paprika , if desired
10. Transfer to serving bowl
11. Drizzle with remaining 1 tablespoon oil and serve

title: croquetas de atn  tuna fish balls
steps:
1. First of all make all the ingredients ready
2. In a big bowl combine potatoes , tuna fish , parsley , spices and salt
3. Work with a fork
4. If it doesnt stick together add 1 egg and about 2 tablespoon of flour
5. Form walnuts sized balls , coat first with egg and then with the breadcrumbs
6. Flat them slightly and place them on a dish
7. Preheat a non sticky pan with about 2 tablespoon oil to medium temperature
8. Fry the meatball on the first size when golden brown , turn , add 2 tablespoon oil and brown the second size
9. For the serving suggestion combine all the vegetable in a bowls toss , eventually add some salt
10. Serve with lemon and olive oil
11. If you prefer serve this with a fresh salsa
12. Enjoy !

title: radish butter
steps:
1. In food processor , cream the butter
2. Add the radishes and the lemon juice
3. Using the pulsing action , chop the radishes
4. Transfer the mixture to a bowl and serve

title: brie and cheddar savory crackers
steps:
1. Cream butter and cheeses
2. Mix in remaining ingredients
3. Shape into a log , 1 1 / 2 inch in diameter
4. Wrap in plastic wrap
5. Chill
6. Slice thinly
7. Place on greased baking sheet
8. Bake at 375 f for 7 to 10 minutes

title: not your average pot roast
steps:
1. Combine ingredients in crock pot and cook on low for at least 12 hours or until meat is tender
2. Make sure that the meat is completely covered by the sauce
3. If it isn't , add more tomato juice and balsamic vinegar
4. When serving , pour some of the sauce on top of the roast and make sure to get soem of the onions and raisins

title: big papa ed s quick and tasty frijoles
steps:
1. 1) in large skillet cook bacon until crispy , then remove and sit aside for later
2. 2)place at meduim high heat and saute onions for about 2 mins
3. 3) add garlic and jalapeno and saute with onions until onion are clear , about another 2 minute reduce heat if needed so not to burn
4. 4)add 40oz can of pinto beans with liquid , water , salt , and bacon
5. Bring to full boil for 1min
6. Then reduce heat to high simmer to reduce liquid
7. Stir every so often
8. Do not cover
9. 5)after about 10 min mash and stir the beans with a wire potato masher to a chunky consistesy
10. Simmer for another 6 min stirring every so often
11. Add a little water if needed , salt and pepper to taste

title: cinnamon roll cocktail
steps:
1. In a measuring cup , add boiling water to instant coffee
2. Stir until completely dissolved
3. Combine remaining ingredients into a large pitcher , stirring thoroughly as you add each ingredient
4. Stir in hot coffee mixture
5. Pour into individual mugs and top each with a dollop of non-dairy whipped topping , piped through a decorative
6. Garnish each mug with a whole cinnamon stick and a generous sprinkle of cinnamon sugar
7. Serve warm

title: bacon in the oven
steps:
1. First all you need to do is take the bacon and lay it down on any of the following , cookie sheet , parchment paper , or aluminum foil
2. We do this for an easy clean up but if you want just lay down on your baking pan
3. Then sprinkle the bacon with black pepper
4. Next turn on your oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit
5. Put your bacon in and wait about 15 min to check on it then as soon as the bacon is crispy brown or golden brown take it out and you're done !

title: french bread pizza  vegetarian
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450f degrees
2. Cut bread loaf in half widthwise , then each half again lengthwise to create 4 roughly equal pieces
3. Place the bread , cut side up , on a dry baking sheet
4. Place remaining ingredients in a food processor or blender , blend until they form a smooth paste
5. Spread the mixture evenly over the bread
6. Bake until tofu mixture is hot and bread toasted , about 10 to 15 minutes
7. Cut each pizza into individual slices

title: broccoli soup with sharp cheddar
steps:
1. Peel and chop potatoes and onions
2. Remove broccoli stalks from florets
3. Peel and chop
4. Set florets aside
5. Bring broth to boil in a large pot
6. Add potatoes , onion and broccoli stalks , bring to a boil
7. Reduce heat , cover and simmer 20 minute add florets and simmer 5 min more
8. Add orange rind , thyme , salt and pepper
9. Blend in batches with the milk
10. Reheat slightly before serving
11. Pour into bowls and sprinkle with 1 / 3 cup cheese for each bowl

title: fabulously easy white bread
steps:
1. Mix shortening , salt , and sugar in a large bowl for about 2 minutes
2. Do not worry if the shortening does not completely melt , but make a good attempt
3. Add the hot milk and water
4. Let cool to lukewarm
5. In a small bowl , mix yeast with 1 / 4 cup water
6. Let stand 5 minutes
7. Add 3 cups flour and yeast all at once and mix until well blended
8. Add 2 more cups of flour , one cup at a time , mixing until blended well
9. Pour dough onto lightly floured board
10. Knead for two minutes with floured hands
11. Let rest for ten minutes
12. Dough will be very sticky
13. Adding enough of the remaining flour to keep the dough from sticking , knead the dough until smooth , elastic , and pliable place the dough in a large , greased bowl , turning once to grease
14. Cover and allow to rise in a warm spot for about an hour or until doubled in bulk
15. Punch dough down and let rise to previous size and perhaps a little bigger split dough into two halves
16. Place each half in a loaf pan and cover
17. Allow to rise until doubled in bulk bake in 425 degree oven for 15 minutes
18. Remove from oven and cover in a cloth
19. Change oven heat to 375 and bake for 15 minutes
20. Remove pan from oven and immediately remove from pan
21. Knock lightly on the bottom of the loaf
22. If a hollow sound is made , bread is done
23. If not , return to the pan and bake 5-15 minutes
24. Allow to cool for 30 minutes before slicing
25. For a soft crust , brush with cold milk or melted butter before baking
26. For a shiny crust , brush a mixture of egg yolk and one tbsp milk on bread before baking

title: easy fish florentine
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Thaw fish , if frozen
3. Place fish fillets in a single layer in a 12 x 7 1 / 2 x 2-inch baking dish
4. Spoon souffle on top
5. Combine crushed crackers , wheat germ , and parmesan cheese
6. Sprinkle over all
7. Bake , uncovered , for 15-20 minutes or until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork
8. Garnish with lemon wedges , if desired

title: light german chocolate cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Coat 3 round cake pans with cooking spray , and dust with 1 tbs flour
3. Combine cocoa and chocolate in a small bowl
4. Add boiling water , stirring until chocolate melts
5. Set aside
6. Combine sugars , butter , and oil in a large bowl , and beat at medium speed of a mixer until well-blended
7. Add yogurt , extracts , and egg whites
8. Beat well
9. Lightly spoon sifted flour into dry measuring cups , and level with a knife
10. Combine sifted flour through salt
11. Add flour mixture to creamed mixture alternately with buttermilk , beginning and ending with flour mixture
12. Beat in cocoa mixture
13. Pour cake batter into prepared pans and sharply tap pans once on counter to remove air bubbles
14. Bake at 350 for 25 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean
15. Cool in pans 10 minutes , and remove from pans
16. Cool completely on wire racks
17. Place 1 cake layer on a plate
18. Spread with 1 / 3 cup coconut-pecan frosting , and top with another cake layer
19. Spread with 1 / 3 cup frosting , and top with remaining cake layer
20. Spread remaining frosting over top and sides of cake
21. Store cake loosely covered in refrigerator
22. Frosting:
23. Melt butter in a medium saucepan over medium-high heat
24. Add chopped pecans , and saut until the pecans are browned
25. Remove mixture from heat , and stir in sugar , cornstarch , and salt
26. Add milk , syrup , and egg yolks , and stir well
27. Cook 2 minutes over medium-high heat or until thick , stirring constantly
28. Remove from heat , and stir in flaked coconut and extracts
29. Pour mixture into a bowl
30. Cover and chill until slightly stiff

title: southern pimento cheese from harold cohen s ultimate burger
steps:
1. In a medium mixing bowl , combine cheddar and jack cheeses , mayonnaise , cream cheese , pimento peppers , pickle juice , horseradish sauce , and mustard
2. Mix until well combined
3. Store in refrigerator until needed
4. It can be frozen
5. Bring to room temperature for serving for best taste and easy melting on hamburgers

title: red bananas
steps:
1. In skillet over medium heat reduce preserves to liquid
2. Add brandy and honey , stirring to combine
3. Add oranges and strawberries , allowing to heat through
4. Add bananas , coating bananas and allowing to heat
5. Serve over vanilla ice

title: walkaway turkey drumsticks
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees
2. In a small bowl , combine all the ingredients except the turkey legs
3. Mix well
4. Place the turkey legs on a rack in a roasting pan and brush evenly with the oil mixture
5. Bake for 1 1 / 4 to 1 1 / 2 hours , or until the skin is golden brown and no pink remains , basting occasionally

title: banana pecan loaf
steps:
1. In a large bowl , cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy
2. Add eggs , one at a time , beating well after each addition
3. Beat in mashed bananas
4. Combine the flour , baking powder , baking soda and salt
5. Add to creamed mixture
6. Fold in pecans
7. Transfer batter to a greased 9-in
8. X 5-in
9. Loaf pan
10. Bake at 350 degrees fahrenheit for 50-60 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near the center of the loaf comes out clean
11. Cool for 10 minutes before removing loaf from pan to a wire rack
12. For an equally delicious spread: combine 1 pkg
13. Cream cheese , softened , and 1 cup canned crushed pineapple , well drained
14. It's delicious as a spread for your banana bread

title: pear and walnut cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Butter and flour a 9x13 inch baking pan
3. Sift first 5 ingredients into medium bowl
4. Using electric mixer , beat brown sugar , oil , eggs , sugar , water and vanilla in large bowl until very smooth
5. Blend in dry ingredients
6. Stir in pears and walnuts
7. Pour batter into prepared pan and bake about 55 mins

title: white chocolate raspberry tart
steps:
1. Bring cream to boil in large pot over medium heat
2. Remove from heat and stir in white chocolate until melted and smooth
3. Stir in mascarpone cheese until mixture is smooth and uniform
4. Pack raspberries in a tight layer over base of your favourite tart shell
5. Pour over chocolate mixture covering berries evenly
6. Some rapsberries may poke out
7. Shave dark chocolate over tart if desired

title: gluten free vegan focaccia  my favorite gluten free bread
steps:
1. Grease and flour a 8-8'' pan , use rice flour for this
2. I also put parchment paper on the bottom
3. Mix dry ingredients together
4. Put the yeast in warm water with a pinch of sugar and let sit for 5 minutes or so
5. Then add the oil and add the wet ingredients to the dry , mix just until blended
6. Then mix with mixer on high for 2 minutes
7. Spoon dough into pan
8. Cover and let double in size , about 40-60 minutes
9. Preheat oven to 400 with rack in lower third of oven
10. When dough has doubled in size , sprinkle with olive oil and brush across dough
11. Sprinkle with rosemerry and sea salt
12. Bake 20 minutes , should be light brown
13. Cool in pan 15 minutes and then enjoy

title: bbq sambal sting ray fish
steps:
1. Stir and strain the tamarind water and discard any solids
2. Grind spice paste ingredients until fine
3. Heat oil in skillet , saute the paste until fragrant
4. Add salt and tamarind water , cook for another 2 minutes
5. Add coconut cream and cook for 1 minute over low heat
6. When the mixture is thickened , remove from heat and cool
7. Coat sting ray pieces with the paste
8. Place each piece on a large banana leaf / foil
9. Spread remaining spice mixture over fish
10. Roll up leaf / foil , then grill / barbecue the parcels for 8-10 minutes
11. The length of time required depends on thickness of fish
12. Serve hot with wedges of lemon / lime and cincaluk

title: d liteful salad or dessert
steps:
1. Place cottage cheese in a bowl
2. Place dry gelatin on cottage cheese , along with the coolwhip , crushed pineapple , and mandarin orange segments
3. Mix well
4. Garnish with crushed nuts and cherries
5. Refrigerate 3 hours
6. Serve

title: 30 minute chicken and rice dinner by accident
steps:
1. In a saucepan , add oil and 2 tablespoons of butter
2. Let melt and then add chicken breasts
3. Cook until golden brown and juices run clear
4. While chicken is cooking , follow package directions for rice
5. In saucepan deglaze pan with wine
6. Don't get rid of those yummy brown bits--it gives this sauce flavor
7. Add garlic , cream of mushroom soup and milk
8. Stir until creamy
9. Add cheese
10. When rice is cooked , pour into mushroom mixture
11. Add chicken and season with salt and pepper
12. Let cook for another 5 minutes
13. Serve with salad and garlic bread
14. Serves 4
15. You can also leave the rice separate and just put the chicken in the sauce--either way , it's your choice

title: crock pot swedish cabbage rolls  the best
steps:
1. Immerse cabbage leaves in large kettle of boiling water for about 3 minutes or until limp
2. Drain
3. Combine egg , 1 / 4 cup of sauce , onion , salt , pepper , beef , and cooked rice
4. Place about 1 / 4 cup meat mixture in center of each leaf
5. Fold in sides and roll ends over meat
6. Place in slow-cooking pot
7. Combine tomato sauce with brown sugar , lemon juice and worcestershire sauce
8. Pour over cabbage rolls
9. Cover and cook on low 7-9 hours

title: slow cooker beef stew
steps:
1. Cut beef steak into 1-inch cubes
2. Cut carrots into 1 inch pieces
3. Cut red potatoes into quarters
4. In a large skillet , brown beef on all sides
5. In a 5-quart slow cooker , combine the vegetables and pour tomatoes over top
6. In a small bowl , whisk the flour , tomato paste , and broth until smooth
7. Stir in salt , garlic , and pepper
8. Pour into the slow cooker
9. Top with beef
10. Cover and cook on low for 6-8 hours or until meat is tender

title: restaurant style sweet   sour mix
steps:
1. Combine the hot water with the sugar and stir until the sugar dissolves
2. Add lime juice and lemon juice and food coloring
3. Chill

title: coffee and cream oatmeal cookies
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 325f
2. Melt the butter in a glass bowl
3. Let the melted butter sit for 10 minutes to cool
4. In another bowl , whisk the oats , flour , coffee , baking soda , and salt together and set aside
5. Add the sugars to the melted and cooled butter and mix by hand until well blended
6. Add the egg , egg yolk and vanilla and mix well
7. Add the egg / flour mixture and stir until incorporated
8. It will be tough but not to tough to complete by hand
9. Add the chocolate chips and stir
10. The dough will be stiff but still easy enough to mix by hand
11. Chill the cookie dough at least 30 minutes , preferably 1 hour , or up to 24 hours
12. To make jumbo cookies , use a large cookie scoop to scoop the batter
13. Roll into a ball and repeat with the other dough
14. For smaller cookies , just use a regular size cookie scoop , or portion into 1 inch balls
15. Bake for 11-12 minutes or 10-11 minutes
16. Allow the cookies to cool on the baking sheet
17. They will continue to cook a bit , so don't leave them in the oven too long
18. Remove and cool completely on a wire rack

title: venezuelan spiced hot chocolate
steps:
1. Combine milk with spices and sugar in a large heavy saucepan
2. Cook over medium heat , stirring to dissolve sugar , until milk just starts to bubble around the edges
3. Lower heat and cook 10 minutes
4. Remove from heat and allow to steep 10 additional minutes , then strain into another large heavy pot
5. Heat gently , then add chocolate and rum
6. Whisk briskly 5 minutes over low flame until chocolate is completely melted

title: camarao mozambique  portuguese style shrimp
steps:
1. Saute onion in the butter until almost browned
2. Reduce heat slightly and add garlic , parsley , and turmeric
3. Saute another 5 minutes then add water and saffron water
4. Cover and simmer for 5 more minutes
5. Stir in wine and lemon juice
6. Bring mixture to a boil , then reduce heat and simmer about 5 minutes to cook off some of the alcohol
7. Add shrimp , salt , black pepper to taste and crushed red peppers
8. Cook about 5 minutes or until shrimp have just turned pink and are still juicy and tender
9. This is normally served in small bowls with crusty bread for dipping , or it could be served over rice

title: iced green tea with jasmine
steps:
1. Steep tea for 7 minutes
2. Chill for 4 hours
3. Add lemon and fresh mint

title: chocolate peanut butter pinwheels
steps:
1. Sift flour with soda and salt
2. Set aside
3. Beat butter until fluffy
4. Beat in sugar
5. Beat in peanut butter , egg , and vanilla
6. At low speed , add half flour mixture
7. Mix in the rest by hand to form a stiff dough
8. Refrigerate 30 minutes
9. Meanwhile , make the filling melt chocolate over hot water , add butter
10. Cool
11. Divide dough in half
12. Roll each half into a 8x10 inch rectangle on a lightly floured surface
13. Spread each with half the filling
14. From the long side , roll each rectangle tightly like a jelly roll
15. Gently press edge to seal
16. Wrap separately , seam side down , in saran wrap or foil
17. Refrigerate until firm , about 8 hours or overnight before slicing and baking
18. Preheat oven to 375 , and place 1 / 2 inch slices 1 1 / 2 inches apart on a greased cookie sheet
19. Bake 6-8 minutes or until lightly browned
20. Let cool for a few minutes on sheet , then cool on wire rack
21. Makes 40 cookies all together

title: vegan caramel sauce
steps:
1. Mix arrowroot and water together , blending until smooth then set aside
2. Mix all other ingredients in heavy saucepan and bring to boil
3. Lower heat and simmer , stirring constantly , for 2-3 minutes
4. Add arrowroot and water mixture to sauce and simmer 2-3 more minutes

title: crustless cranberry pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Grease one 9 inch pie pan
3. Combine the flour , sugar , and salt
4. Stir in the cranberries and the walnuts , and toss to coat
5. Stir in the butter , beaten eggs , and almond extract
6. If you are using frozen cranberries , the mixture will be very thick
7. Spread the batter into the prepared pan
8. Bake at 350 degrees f for 40 minutes , or until a wooden pick inserted near the center comes out clean
9. Serve warm with whipped cream or ice cream

title: paula deen s lemon salad dressing
steps:
1. In a glass jar with a tight lid , combine lemon juice , oil , sugar , garlic , and dijon mustard
2. Season with salt and pepper
3. Shake well and drizzle dressing over the salad just before serving

title: cooking light s citrus chicken cutlets
steps:
1. Combine first 8 ingredients in a small bowl , stirring well with a whisk
2. Pour 1 / 4 cup juice mixture into a large zip-top plastic bag
3. Add chicken to bag
4. Seal
5. Let stand 5 minutes
6. Add oil to remaining juice mixture
7. Stir well with a whisk
8. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
9. Coat pan with cooking spray
10. Remove chicken from bag
11. Discard marinade
12. Add chicken to pan
13. Cook 4 minutes on each side or until done
14. Place 1 1 / 2 cups spinach on each of 4 plates
15. Divide chicken evenly among servings
16. Top each serving with 1 tablespoon juice mixture

title: old fashioned green beans
steps:
1. In a large skillet , cook bacon over medium heat until crisp-tender , about 5 minutes
2. Add beans , brown sugar and water
3. Stir gently
4. Bring to a boil
5. Reduce heat
6. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes or until beans are crisp-tender
7. Remove to a serving bowl with a slotted spoon

title: bean salad   pantry friendly   healthy
steps:
1. Blend first 3 ingredients in a big serving bowl
2. Add remaining ingredients & blend all together
3. Marinate for at least 2 hours preferable in fridge or also good at room temperature
4. Serve & enjoy
5. I use "low sodium" vegetables when possible
6. Cut out spices & use plain tomatoes if you want a more mild flavored bean salad
7. Variations: make into complete meals
8. Taco salad: add 26 ounces chicken breast , 1 tb cumin , 1 ts black pepper , put on tortilla chips
9. Baked potato bar: use as a topping
10. Casserole style: use the drained vegetable juices to cook long grain white rice in & serve bean salad on top with a cheese sauce

title: sauteed baby potatoes with lemon butter and parsley
steps:
1. Cook the potatoes whole in a large pot of boiling salted water until tender drain and cool slightly
2. In a large heavy skillet over medium heat , melt the butter
3. Add in cooked potatoes with about 1 / 4 cup fresh chopped parsley , lemon peel , lemon juice , salt and pepper , cook until potatoes are beginning to brown tossing them often
4. Transfer to a large serving bowl
5. Sprinkle with about 2-3 tablespoons more of fresh parsley

title: homemade polenta
steps:
1. Bring the water to a boil in a medium pan
2. Add salt reduce heat to medium low
3. As soon as the water begins to simmer , start pouring in the cornmeal in a thin stream , very slowly while stirring constantly with a wooden spoon to prevent lumps
4. Once all the cornmeal has been added , keep the water at a simmer , and stir frequently
5. Should take between 25-30 minutes to fully cook once it is cooked , it should pull away from the sides of the pot easily
6. Variations:
7. Soft polenta: use polenta directly out of the pot , topped with sauce or vegetables as desired
8. Scoop a good portion on a plate , let it sit for a minute or two
9. Next top the polenta with a scoop of your favorite sauce
