10. Add grated parmesan cheese to the polenta and sauce
11. Firm polenta: after it is completely cooked , place on wooden board or a greased baking sheet 2 inches thick and allow to set
12. Cut into squares
13. Baked polenta: cut firm polenta into slices , place in a buttered baking dish
14. Add favorite topping , bake at 375f till golden
15. Grilled polenta: cut firm polenta into squares , brush with oil and grill lightly on both sides
16. Fried polenta: cut the firm polenta into slices and fry in a few inches of hot oil till golden brown and crispy

title: gold miner s chili
steps:
1. In a large pot simmer onion and minced garlic in 2 cups of chicken broth for 10 minutes
2. Add tomato sauce and all dry spices , except the sugar
3. Mix well
4. Brown the meat in oil using a separate pan and drain well
5. Add the meat to the onion / spice mixture
6. Add remaining broth and simmer for 2 1 / 2 hours
7. Mix in brown sugar and hot sauce just before serving

title: the spaniard  grilled sandwich
steps:
1. In a small bowl , mix the butter and pimenton together
2. Spread the pimenton-butter mixture on one side of each of the bread slices
3. Place 4 slices of bread , buttered side down , on your work surface
4. Place 2 slices of ham on the bread
5. Distribute the cheeses over the ham
6. Lay the chiles over the cheese and top with the remaining bread slices , buttered side up
7. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium heat for 2 minutes
8. Put the sandwiches into the pan , cover and cook for 3 to 4 minutes , until the undersides are golden brown
9. Remove the cover and turn the sandwiches , pressing each one firmly with a spatula to compress the filling slightly
10. Cover and cook for 2 to 3 minutes , until the undersides are well-browned
11. Turn the sandwiches once more , press firmly with the spatula again , cook for 1 minute , and remove from the pan
12. Let cool for 2 to 3 minutes
13. Cut in half and serve

title: ww 6 points crock pot teriyaki chicken
steps:
1. Add chicken to crock pot along with soy sauce , honey , garlic cloves and hot sauce
2. Set crock pot to low and cover
3. Stir once 2 hours into cooking and then cook addition 2 hours
4. Remove garlic cloves

title: cliff s bean dip
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in blender and process until smooth
2. Serve with tortilla chips , carrots and bell peppers for dipping

title: anzac
steps:
1. Mix all the ingredients but the water in a food processor
2. Pour in the water , little at the time to see how the dough is doing
3. You might need more or less water
4. The dough should not be sticky
5. Roll it out , about 3mm thick
6. Cut out shapes , i made hearts but anything not too small or delicate will work
7. Bake at 180c for about 15 minutes

title: corn and coriander soup
steps:
1. Preheat a bbq or grill
2. Remove the husks and silk from the corn cobs and cook on the bbq or grill for about 10 minutes , turning frequently , until roasted and slightly blackened
3. Cool , then cut the kernels from the cobs with a small sharp knife
4. Cut the capsicum into quarters
5. Discard the seeds and membrane and cook under the grill or on the bbq until the skin has blackened and blistered
6. Remove from the heat and place in a plastic bag to cool
7. Peel away the skin and finely chop the flesh
8. Heat the oil in a large pan and cook the onion for 5 minutes , or until very soft and lightly golden
9. Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute
10. Add the corn kernels , capsicum and chicken stock to the pan , bring to the boil , reduce the heat and simmer , partially covered , for about 20 minutes
11. Cool the soup slightly then puree half of it in a blender or food processor until the mixture is fairly smooth
12. Transfer all the soup to a clean pan to heat through
13. Just before serving , stir through the lime juice and the coriander leaves

title: prawn pasta with a kick from jack
steps:
1. Shell the prawns
2. Melt butter in the saucepan
3. Saut garlic and onion till it is nice and fragrant , slightly browned
4. Add oregano , the tomatoes and basil , continue to saut
5. Add the prawn heads and shell into saucepan , saut till the shell turns pink
6. Add the hot water , jack daniels and chicken powder stock
7. Cover the saucepan , and let this simmer for 20 minutes
8. After 20 minutes , add the shelled prawns into the broth and let it simmer till the prawns turn pink
9. Add garlic salt to taste
10. Turn off heat , and add the chopped cilantro into the broth / sauce
11. Divide the cooked angel hair pasta into three plates
12. Pour the sauce equally into the three plates of pasta , and toss
13. Place 3 prawns at the top of each plate
14. Serve immediately

title: corn and crab salad
steps:
1. Chop boiled eggs and crab sticks
2. Add corn and salt
3. Stir mayonnaise into the salad
4. Mix the salad and refrigerate for 30 minutes

title: funky chicken with sesame noodles
steps:
1. First make the sesame noodles: cook the spaghetti according to package directions
2. Drain
3. In a jar , add the soy sauce , sesame oil and the sugar
4. Shake until well blended and the sugar has dissolved
5. Pour this over the pasta
6. Toss with scallions and sprinkle with the sesame seeds
7. Set aside while you marinate and then cook the chicken
8. Funkying the chicken: in a bowl mix the soy sauce , teriyaki sauce , garlic , brown sugar and the ginger
9. Make sure the sugar has pretty much dissolved
10. Add the chicken , making sure it's all coated with the sauce
11. Cover and stick in the fridge for 2-3 hours
12. Remove the chicken from the marinade , and toss out the marinade left at the bottom of the bowl
13. Heat the sesame oil in a large non-stick pan
14. Add the chicken in batches and saute for about 10 minutes , or until done , adding more sesame oil as needed
15. Remove the chicken from the pan and let cool slightly
16. Slice the chicken diagonally into thin strips
17. Serve the chicken over the sesame noodles
18. Stand back and watch your guests / children / loved ones inhale this dish

title: rustic melted onion and cheese picnic pie
steps:
1. Use a glass or other ovenproof pie dish for this dish
2. Peel and slice the onions very thinly
3. If you have a mandoline , use that to slice the onions
4. Fry the onions in a pot
5. Use only a low-to-medium heat
6. You can put the lid on the pot
7. Stir occasionally , and cook the onions for 40 minutes , or until they are very soft and "melting"
8. Sweet onions are nicest , but red onions are also great , and will just cause more eye-watering !
9. Add the balsamic vinegar and the sugar , and stir well
10. Cook a little longer
11. Please do not leave out the anchovy fillets if you dislike them
12. Anchovies have the unique ability to disappear into a dish and only add a subtle completely non-fishy flavour -- honestly ! chop or break up those anchovies finely , , and stir
13. They will dissolve and disappear into the onion mixture
14. Sprinkle over the nutmeg , add the thyme or rosemary , and the parsley , and stir into the onions
15. If liquid has formed at the bottom , turn heat higher , stir , and cook off the excess liquid
16. Pull off the heat and leave
17. While the onions are cooking , beat the eggs and roll out the pastry
18. Roll the pastry thinner
19. Use flour or cornflour on your counter or wherever you roll out the pastry , and if necessary flour your rolling pin
20. In south africa shop-bought puff pastry comes in 400 g rolls , so all of it has to be defrosted: keep the cuttings for another purpose or chuck away
21. Heat oven to 400 deg f or 200 deg celsius
22. Line the tart plate with the pastry , and crimp the edges neatly
23. Paint the pastry with some of the beaten egg , concentrating on the edges
24. If this job is finished long before the onions are ready , put the prepared plate in the fridge to keep cool
25. When the onions are ready , scrape them into another bowl and stir to cool them
26. If using brie or camembert , cut it up into bite-sized chunks and spread on the bottom of the pastry
27. Add the rest of the beaten eggs to the onion mixture , then spread it over the cheese
28. Sprinkle with the pepper and the breadcrumbs
29. If using feta cheese , put the onion-egg mixture in first , then crumble the feta over the top , and top with pepper and breadcrumbs
30. Bake in the preheated oven for 30 minutes
31. Lower the heat to 350f / 180c after the first 15 minutes
32. Don't add extra salt unless the final mixture tastes too bland
33. The anchovies and feta are both salty
34. Do remember that brie or camembert is preferable if you can serve this pie soon after it is ready , because if these cheeses cool down completely , they can become rubbery

title: chorizo dip
steps:
1. Fry the sausage in a heavy skillet-stirring to make sure the sausage crumbles into small pieces
2. When cooked all the way , drain and put in a microwavable dish along with cheese
3. Microwave on medium high until cheese is completely melted
4. Stir a few times while microwaving

title: wild rice soup
steps:
1. Wash wild rice
2. Boil for 15 minute drain
3. Cook the bacon , reserving 3 tablespoons drippings
4. Saute celery , onion and green pin drippings until transparent
5. Put in a large pot with the diced bacon , rice , broth , soup and mushrooms
6. Cook on low for one hour or more
7. Do not add salt !
8. Enjoy !

title: super easy semi homemade blueberry breakfast rolls
steps:
1. Lightly grease 16 - 2 1 / 2 inch muffin cups
2. Remove cinnamon rolls from pkg
3. Set icing aside
4. Cut each cinnamon roll in half crosswise
5. Press a roll half in bottom and about 1 / 2 inch up the side of each muffin cup
6. In a small bowl stir together blueberries , preserves and lemon peel
7. Spoon filling into muffin cups
8. Sprinkle with pecans
9. Bake in a 375 degree oven for about 12 mins or until golden brown
10. Cool in muffin cups on wire rack for 5 minutes remove from muffin cups and place on wire rack to cool for 5 minutes
11. Place icing from the package in a small bowl
12. If necessary , stir in a little milk to make icing of drizzling consistency
13. Drizzle icing over rolls
14. Serve rolls warm

title: dorito chicken taco fingers
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Spray a baking sheet with no stick cooking spray
3. Cut chicken into 1 / 2 inch strips
4. Combine mayo , milk in a large bowl
5. Place tortilla chips and taco seasoning in zip lock baggie , crush chips into medium size crumbs
6. Pour chip mix into a medium size bowl
7. Coat chicken strips in mayo mixture , then in the crushed tortilla chips
8. Place on baking sheet , be sure to not overlap
9. Bake until just browned and chicken is cooked through about 10-12 minutes
10. Serve with sour cream and salsa

title: aunt ava s buttermilk spice cake
steps:
1. Preheat your oven to 350degrees
2. Grease and flour a 9 x 13 pan or 2 8in
3. Round cake pans
4. Measure all ingredients into a large mixing bowl
5. Blend for 30 seconds on low speed
6. Scrape sides of bowl down
7. Blend on high speed for 60 seconds , scraping bowl occassionally
8. Pour into prepared pans
9. Smack pans gently on counter to get rid of any air bubbles
10. Bake 9 x 13 for 45 minutes
11. 8 inch rounds for 30-40 minutes or until wooden toothpick or cake tester comes out clean
12. Frost cake with your favorite frosting
13. Buying an oven thermometer at your local discount store will cost you about $3 and guarantee you will have great success in your cake & other baking endeavors
14. Preheat your oven to 350 degrees and place the thermometer in the back of oven
15. After 5 minutes , check the thermometer and move it to the left side then the right side and then the front of your oven
16. Adjust your oven settings accordingly to how far off 350 degrees the temps are in your oven
17. Many of you will be surprised at just how far off a brand new oven can be
18. $3 is a small price to pay for successful baking
19. When baking this cake in 8 inch rounds , i spread a thin layer of my cream cheese frosting on top of the first layer and then slice a couple of bananas on top of the frosting and then place the second layer on top and finish frosting the cake with the rest of the cream cheese frosting
20. When i bake it in x 13 pan , i like to toast coconut on a cookie sheet and after frosting the cooled cake with either my cream cheese frosting or my butter pecan frosting , i sprinkle the toasted coconut on top of the frosted cake
21. Either variation pleases my family and friends
22. Using your imagination you can customize this into your own family favorite

title: 15 minute shrimp carbonara fettuccine
steps:
1. Prepare pasta noodles according to package directions , adding peas for the last 5 minutes of cooking
2. Drain
3. Immediately return pasta and peas to pan
4. Add remaining ingredients , tossing well until cheese is melted

title: poached eggs
steps:
1. Use an egg poacher and follow manufacturers directions
2. ~~~~~~or fill a small skillet with water
3. Bring water to a full boil
4. Reduce heat to just below simmering
5. Add 1 teaspoon vinegar
6. Break egg carefully into water
7. If white spreads , push it toward center with a spoon
8. Cook for approximately 4 minutes , depending on desired doneness
9. Remove egg with a slotted spoon
10. Serve on english muffin or toast

title: empanadas de calabasa sefardicas  sephardic pumpkin turnovers
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Lightly oil an aluminum baking sheet or line the baking sheet with parchment paper
3. To make the dough , combine the flour , baking powder , sugar , and salt in a mixing bowl
4. Make a well in the center of the flour and pour in the oil and water
5. With your hands , work the mixture to form a soft dough , adding more dough if necessary so that it loses its stickiness
6. Cover dough , set aside and let rest
7. Meanwhile , combine the filling ingredients and mix well
8. Now on a floured surface roll out the prepared dough to 1 / 16" thickness
9. Use a 3" round cookie cutter to cut out the dough
10. Place one heaping teaspoon of the pumpkin filling on one side of each circle , fold over , slightly dampen edges with water , and pinch edges shut
11. I use my dim sum maker to seal the turnovers
12. Arrange the turnovers singly on the prepared baking sheet , brush lightly with egg wash and bake about 20 minutes or until golden brown
13. Cool on rack
14. The uncooked , filled turnovers can be frozen

title: flank steak with garlic sauce
steps:
1. Prepare grill or turn on broiler
2. Using a sharp knife , cut 1 / 4 inch deep crosshatch pattern in steaks
3. Place steak in a shallow nonreactive dish
4. Combine ginger , 1-1 / 2 tbs
5. Soy sauce , 2 tsp
6. Sesame oil , 1 tbs
7. Rice wine vinegar and pepper in a bowl and pour over steak , rubbing into cuts
8. Cover and marinate at least 45 minutes in refrigerator
9. Combine remaining soy sauce , sesame oil and rice vinegar with parsley , water , sugar and garlic in a jar with a tight-fitting lid
10. Shake vigorously and refrigerate until ready to use
11. Grill or broil steak 4-5 minutes per side for medium-rare meat
12. Cook longer if desired
13. Let stand 10 minutes before cutting across the grain into thin slices
14. Serve sauce over steak

title: safari snack sack  nut free
steps:
1. Combine into a large bowl
2. Serve or keep in an air tight container or portion into single serve ziploc bags and attach label if desired
3. Enjoy !

title: roasted garbanzo beans chickpeas
steps:
1. Drain garbanzo's in a strainer and rinse well with cool water
2. Shake to help remove water
3. Let sit to drain while proceeding
4. Cover a rimmed cookie sheet or shallow casserole dish with cooking spray
5. Pour garbanzos on the foil and spread them into a single layer
6. Take a few sheets of paper towel and gently press over the top of the beans just to remove any extra liquid- speeds cooking time too
7. Spray top of beans with cooking spray and sprinkle seasonings over the beans
8. Shake pan to help distribute the seasoning and make sure the beans are all in a single layer
9. Place pan in an oven and set to 350 f- no need to preheat
10. Use lowest rack on oven and return every 15-20 minutes or so to shake the pan so nothing burns
11. Be gentle or they may spill over the sides
12. Cook until beans are browned and crispy
13. About 45 minutes
14. Remove from oven and pour into a plastic bowl with tight fitting lid to cool
15. Careful they are hot to the touch !
16. Snack away ! keep these stored in the bowl for best freshness or in a ziploc bag

title: mushroom stuffed hamburger steaks
steps:
1. Melt butter in a large skillet
2. Add onion and mushrooms , and saute over medium heat 2 to 3 minutes or until tender
3. Remove from skillet
4. Combine ground beef and next 7 ingredients in a large bowl
5. Shape into 8 patties
6. Top 4 patties evenly with onion mixture
7. Cover with remaining patties , pressing edges to seal
8. Wrap each with 2 bacon slices , securing with wooden picks
9. Place on a rack in a broiler pan
10. Broil 5 1 / 2 inches from heat 10 minutes on each side or until beef is no longer pink

title: pancake muffin surprises
steps:
1. In a large mixing bowl , add the bisquick , milk , eggs , and 1 / 2 cup maple syrup
2. Stir to combine
3. Pour approximately 1 / 4 cup of batter into 12 muffin cups that have been sprayed with non-stick cooking spray
4. Put a piece of banana in the center of each
5. Bake in a 350 oven for 20-25 minutes or until pick comes out clean
6. Serve warm with a little maple syrup drizzled on top

title: chicken n broccoli pot pies
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375 degrees
2. Separate dough into 10 biscuits
3. Place 1 biscuit in each ungreased muffin cup
4. Firmly press in bottom and up sides , forming 1 / 2" rim over edge of muffin cup
5. Spoon about 1 t each of cheese and cereal into each cup
6. Press mixture into bottom of each cup
7. Cut large pieces of broccoli in half
8. In medium bowl , combine broccoli , chicken and soup
9. Mix well
10. Spoon about 1 / 3 c chicken mixture over cereal
11. Cups will be full
12. Sprinkle with almonds
13. Bake at 375 degrees for 20 to 25 minutes or until edges of biscuits are deep golden brown
14. To reheat , wrap loosely in foil
15. Heat at 375 degrees for 18 to 20 minutes

title: seared mahi mahi with zesty basil butter
steps:
1. Zesty basil butter:
2. Combine the butter , lemon juice , garlic , salt , pepper , and basil in a medium saucepan and cook over low heat , stirring until the butter melts
3. Cover and keep warm over low heat
4. Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat
5. Season the fish with salt and pepper , to taste
6. Cook the fish for 3 minutes
7. Then turn and cook until just opaque , about 3 to 4 minutes more
8. Transfer the fillets to individual plates
9. Spoon the warm basil butter over the fish and serve

title: strawberry cookies  czechoslovakian
steps:
1. Grease an 8 x 8-inch pan
2. Cream butter & sugar
3. Add eggs & blend well
4. Gradually add flour
5. Spread evenly one-half of the butter mixture in bottom of pan
6. Spread evenly with the jam & sprinkle with chopped nuts
7. Spread the second half of the butter mixture on top of the jam
8. Bake at 325f for about 45 minutes or until brown
9. Cut into bars when cool

title: hot herbed tomatoes
steps:
1. Place cherry tomato halves in a lightly greased 11x7 baking dish
2. Combine breadcrumbs and next 7 ingredients in a medium bowl , stirring well
3. Sprinkle breadcrumbs mixture evely over cherry tomatoes
4. Drizzle with olive oil
5. Bake , uncovered , at 400 degrees for 7-9 minutes , or until thoroughly heated
6. Serve immediately

title: del monte  fruit cocktail cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Sift flour with sugar , soda and salt
3. Beat eggs until thich and lemon colored
4. Add undrained fruit cocktail to egg mix
5. Stir in dry ingredients , mix thoroughly
6. Pour into greased and floured 9" square
7. Pan
8. Combine nuts and brown sugar
9. Sprinkle nuts / sugar over batter
10. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until tests
11. Done

title: mini chip butter cookies  eggless
steps:
1. Sift together flour and salt
2. Cream butter , gradually beat in sugar and vanilla
3. Add dry ingredients a little at a time
4. Blend until smooth
5. Add chocolate chips
6. Form dough into 1" balls
7. Place on cookie sheet and flatten in to 2" rounds with bottom of glass dipped in flour
8. Bake at 325 for 9-11 minutes

title: rosemary garlic braid or bread
steps:
1. Remove outer papery skin from garlic
2. Cut top off garlic heads , leaving root end intact
3. Brush with oil
4. Sprinkle with rosemary
5. Cover and bake at 425' for 30 - 35 minutes or until softened
6. Cool for 10 minutes , squeeze softened garlic into bowl
7. Add broth , lightly mash
8. In a large mixing bowl , combine 2 1 / 4 c flour , sugar , yeast and salt
9. Heat milk , water & 1 / 4 c butter to 120 - 130 degrees
10. Add to dry ingredients
11. Beat just until moistened
12. Beat in garlic past until smooth
13. Stir in remaining flour to form a soft dough , and knead 10 minutes
14. Cover with damp towel and let rise until double in size
15. Punch dough down , turn onto lightly floured surface
16. Divide in two
17. Divide each portion into 3 pieces
18. Shape each into an 15-inch rope
19. Place 3 ropes on a greased baking sheet and braid
20. Pinch ends to seal and tuck under
21. Repeat with remaining dough
22. Cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled
23. Bake at 350' for 15 minutes
24. Melt remaining butter
25. Add garlic salt
26. Brush over bread
27. Bake 10 - 15 minutes longer or until golden brown
28. Remove from pans to wire racks to cool
29. Prep time includes rising time

title: meyer lemon and fresh cranberry muffins
steps:
1. Preheat over to 400 degrees
2. Oil a muffin tin or used paper liners
3. Mix together the first five ingredients in a large bowl
4. In a smaller bowl , combine the remaining ingredients until the cranberries are coated in the flour mixture
5. Add the dry ingredients into the wet and combine until just blended
6. Drop by spoonful into muffin tim until each tin is 3 / 4 full of batter
7. Bake for 20-25 minutes

title: smoked salmon burger  tomato  red onion and avocado
steps:
1. Slice the cherry tomatoes & thinly slice the red onion
2. Halve the avocado , peel & remove the stone
3. Using a hand blender , puree 1 avocado half w / the larger measure of lemon juice , crme frache & mayo
4. Season to taste w / salt & pepper
5. Slice the other avocado half & sprinkle w / the smaller measure of lemon juice
6. Thinly slice the smoked salmon
7. Assembly: cut the rolls in half & spread each w / an equal amt of the pureed avocado mixture
8. Arrange equal amts of the lettuce leaves , cherry tomatoes , red onion & smoked salmon on each roll
9. Top w / the other half of the rolls & serve

title: overnight raspberry  or strawberry  meringue torte
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450f
2. Beat egg whites in a large bowl with mixer at medium speed until foamy
3. Add the cream of tartar and beat for 1 minute
4. Gradually add the sugar , 1 tablespoon at a time , beating until well blended
5. Add vanilla extract
6. Increase mixer speed to high and beat for 5 minutes or until soft peaks form
7. Coat the inside of a 10-inch springform pan with butter , and add meringue , spreading evenly
8. Break air pockets by cutting through meringue with a knife
9. Place pan in 450f oven
10. Turn the oven off , and cool in closed oven for at least 24 hours
11. Drain the raspberries , reserving 1 / 4 cup liquid
12. Place raspberries in a food processor , and process until smooth
13. Press raspberry mixture through a fine sieve into a bowl to measure 1 1 / 4 cups
14. Discard solids
15. Stir in the reserved raspberry liquid
16. Spoon cooled meringue into bowls
17. Drizzle with raspberry mixture , and top with whipped topping

title: cold  weather salsa
steps:
1. In large heavy saucepan , combine tomatoes , tomato sauce , celery , onions , garlic and jalapeo peppers
2. Bring to a boil
3. Cook for 5 minutes or just until onions are translucent
4. Stir in sugar , vinegar , lime juice , coriander and salt
5. Reduce heat and boil gently , stirring frequently , for 45 minutes or until slightly thickened

title: banana pecan muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. Grease or line muffin tins with paper cups
3. Spread nuts on a tray and toast in oven 8-10 minutes set aside
4. In a bowl combine flour , baking pwdr & salt
5. In another bowl cream butter , sugar and vanilla until smooth and creamy
6. Beat in eggs one at a time
7. Add mashed bananas and beat until combined
8. Stir dry ingredients into banana mixture just until flour disappears
9. Lightly stir in nuts , choc chips or a mix of both
10. Spoon batter into muffins cups to the top
11. Bake 20 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean
12. These double and freeze well

title: awesome spicy thai boneless pork loin
steps:
1. Mix soya sauce , lime juice , honey , oil , ginger , garlic and chilies
2. Blend well
3. Put pork roast in a zip lock bag and add marinate
4. Refrigerate overnight and turn occasioally
5. 400 oven
6. Grease a shallow roasting pan roast pork uncovered for 15 mins
7. Reduce to 350
8. Interior temperature should reach 170 f

title: pumpkin roll  gluten free
steps:
1. Beat eggs on high for 5 minutes
2. Gradually beat in granulated sugar
3. Stir in pumpkin and lemon juice
4. Stir together corn starch , soy flour , tapioca flour , rice flour
5. Stir in xantham , baking powder , cinnamon , ginger , nutmeg , and salt
6. Fold this combination into the pumpkin mixture
7. Spread into a greased and floured 15"x10"x1" pan
8. Bake at 375 f for 15 minutes
9. Turn out on a towel dusted with powdered sugar
10. At narrow end , roll towel and cake into a roll
11. Cool completely
12. Filling: mix 1 cup powdered sugar , 8 oz neufechtal cheese , 4 tsp butter , and 1 / 2 tsp vanilla
13. Beat until smooth
14. Unroll cake , remove towel , and spread filling evenly on the cake
15. Re-roll the cake and filling into a long log
16. Wrap in saran wrap or place on a plate and chill
17. Serve by slicing ends of the log

title: 007  martini
steps:
1. Rinse martini glass with extra dry vermouth
2. Add vodka , gin , and lillet blanc to a cocktail shaker filled with crushed ice
3. Shake vigorously
4. Pour into prepared martini glass

title: banana orange muffins
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400f line twelve medium muffin cups with paper baking cups or lightly spray bottoms only with cooking spray
2. In large bowl , combine oats , flour , brown sugar , baking powder , baking soda , cinnamon , salt and dates
3. Mix well
4. In medium bowl , combine yogurt , banana , egg whites , oil and orange peel
5. Blend well
6. Add to dry ingredients all at once
7. Stir just until dry ingredients are moistened
8. Fill muffin cups almost full
9. Bake 20 to 22 minutes or until golden brown
10. Cool muffins in pan on wire rack 5 minutes
11. Remove from pan

title: bakinbaby s bread and butter pickles
steps:
1. Combine veggies in a large bowl , sprinkle with kosher salt then ice cubes , allow to cool in frigerator at least 3hours , 6-8 hours is even better
2. Drain and rinse veggies , set aside
3. Heat vinegar , sugar , mustard seed , marmalade , celery seedturmeric and dry mustard in a medium saucepan for aboout 5-6 min
4. , just till heated
5. Pack drained veggies is quart jars , cover with heated vinegar solution , top with rings and lids , and keep in frig
6. For at least 3 days before eating
7. Or , process in hot water bath for 15 minute
8. We prefer the frig
9. Process as the cukes will keep crispy and fresh for up to one year

title: turkey veggie meatballs
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Combine all ingredients except cooking spray in a bowl
3. Stir well
4. Shape mixture into 30 meatballs
5. Place on a broiler pan coated with cooking spray
6. Bake at 400 for 15 minutes or until done
7. Yield: 30 meatballs

title: scallop rumaki
steps:
1. Microwave bacon on high for 2-2 1 / 2 minutes , or until partially cooked but still flexible
2. Top each scallop with some of the onion and ginger
3. Drizzle evenly with lemon juice
4. Wrap a bacon piece around each scallop , and secure with wooden toothpicks
5. Grill scallops on grill tray 2-3 minutes on each side , or until done
6. Or broil 3 inches from heat for 2-3 minutes on each side , or until bacon is crisp and scallops are cooked
7. Drain on paper towels
8. Garnish with chives , if desired

title: ginger molasses cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees with the rack in the center
2. Line 2 baking sheets with parchment paper
3. Set aside
4. Sift flour , baking soda , salt , cinnamon and ginger into a medium bowl
5. Set aside
6. Cream the butter and brown sugar in a large mixing bowl with mixer on high speed until light and fluffy , about 1 minute
7. With mixer on medium speed , beat in the egg and molasses , then increase the speed to high and beat about 1 minute longer , until the mixture no longer looks curdled
8. Scrape the sides with a rubber spatula several times while mixing
9. Mix in the flour mixture on low speed
10. The batter will be rather stiff
11. Place some granulated sugar on a small plate or saucer
12. Use a 1 / 4-cup ice cream scoop or a measuring cup to form 1 / 4-cup portions of dough
13. Transfer the dough to your hands and roll each portion into a rough ball , then roll each ball into the sugar
14. Place six sugared balls on each baking sheet , spacing them evenly , because they will spread during baking
15. Dampen your fingers with water and press down lightly on each cookie to flatten it a little and dampen the top
16. Refrigerate one filled baking sheet while the other bakes
17. Bake for 12 minutes , or until the cookies have spread and are firm to the touch
18. Rotate the sheet 180 degrees halfway through the baking time
19. Remove from the oven and let the cookies cool on the baking sheet
20. Bake cookies
21. Just roll into a log 2 1 / 2 inches thick
22. Wrap in plastic wrap and then in foil
23. Can be stored in the freezer up to 6 months

title: italian potato salad  insalata di potate
steps:
1. Toss lightly together the first five ingredients
2. Blend together the dressing and oregano and gently coat the potato mixture completely
3. Cover and chill 1 hour

title: kelly s creamy cheddar pea salad
steps:
1. In large bowl , combine mayo , relish , sugar , seas
2. Salt and mustard
3. Gently fold in rest of ingredients adding peas last so they don't get broken up and mushy
4. Chill
5. If you like it extra creamy , double the sauce

title: linguine with white clam sauce
steps:
1. Prepare linguine according to package directions
2. Set aside
3. Heat oil in saucepan over medium heat
4. Add garlic and leeks , and cook until soft , 3-5 minutes
5. Add wine , pepper , and oregano
6. Cook over high heat until reduced by half
7. Watch it carefully , stir it and make sure it does not burn
8. Reduce heat to medium and stir in clams with juice
9. Heat through and add pasta
10. Cover tightly and cook over low heat 2-3 minutes so pasta begins to absorb some of the broth
11. Serve immediately

title: crock pot lemon garlic chicken with wild rice
steps:
1. Season the chicken breasts with salt and pepper
2. Place the chicken breasts in the bottom of a slow cooker
3. Add the garlic and rice
4. Add the lemon juice to the water and stir
5. Pour this mixture over the rice and chicken
6. Stir once to coat
7. Place the lid on the slow cooker and set on low for 8 hours

title: fettuccine and feta salad
steps:
1. Cook fettuccine to al dente stage , drain well
2. Combine with cheese , vegetables and walnuts shake olive oil , vinegar , oregano , mint , salt and pepper in a small jar until well combined
3. Pour a quarter cup of the dressing at a time over the salad , mixing well after each addition
4. You may not need the entire amount
5. Adjust seasoning
6. Serve at room temperature

title: green rice and chicken salad
steps:
1. In a large salad bowl combine first 5 ingredients and half of the salad dressing , toss
2. Combine chicken , avocados and remaining salad dressing , toss
3. Add to salad
4. Toss well

title: peas with lemon and tarragon
steps:
1. Place peas , sugar and salt in a medium saucepan
2. Add just enough water to cover
3. Bring to a boil
4. Reduce heat and simmer about 6 minutes
5. Drain
6. Return the drained peas to the saucepan and add all remaining ingredients
7. Toss well to coat
8. Serve

title: peas  n  cheese squash spaghetti
steps:
1. Halve the squash and place cut side up on a damp paper towel in a microwavable dish
2. Microwave on high until tender , about 15 minutes
3. Meanwhile , in a large saucepan , stir together the marinara and peas and warm over medium heat for about 5 minutes
4. Using a fork , scrape the strands of squash into the marinara and peas
5. Bring to a simmer and cook until the sauce is no longer watery , 5 to 7 minutes
6. Remove from the heat
7. Stir in the ricotta and season with salt and pepper
8. Divide among 4 bowls and top each portion with some of the parmesan

title: freezer chicken broccoli fettuccini
steps:
1. Assembly directions:
2. Cook fettuccini aldente , drain , and set aside
3. Wash , drain and chop fresh broccoli
4. Cut chicken breasts into bite-sized pieces or cut crosswise into 1 / 2 inch wide slices
5. Heat butter , garlic and ground black pepper in a large skillet over medium heat
6. When the skillet is hot , add the chicken and broccoli to the skillet
7. Cook and stir until the meat is no longer pink in the center
8. Sprinkle the seasoning salt over the chicken and broccoli and toss to mix
9. Remove the skillet from heat and allow to cool
10. When cooled , sprinkle the grated cheeses over the chicken and broccoli and toss to mix well
11. Combine the sour cream , whipping cream , and half and half together in a separate bowl
12. Freezing directions:
13. Place the chicken mixture in a freezer bag or container
14. Remove excess air and seal
15. Place the cream mixture in another freezer bag or container
16. Remove excess air and seal
17. Place the aldente pasta in a freezer bag or container
18. Remove excess air and seal
19. If the 3 components of this recipe are in freezer bags , place all 3 bags inside of one larger bag to keep them together
20. Serving directions:
21. Thaw all three bags completely
22. Place pasta in the bottom of a spray coated casserole or baking pan
23. Spread chicken mixture over pasta and toss gently to mix
24. Pour sauce over all
25. Cover the pan tightly and heat until very hot
26. Do not bring to a boil or the sauce will curdle
27. This can be heated in the microwave on 50% power for 5 minutes , stir gently and repeat until hot , or heated in the oven at 350 degrees for about 30 minutes or until hot
28. Remove the dish from heat and allow to sit a few minutes so the pasta will absorb some of the sauce

title: pacific island fish in coconut sauce
steps:
1. To make the sauce: in a small saucepan mix coconut cream , onion , salt , chilli , lemon juice , and the cornstarch
2. Bring the mixture to a boiling point , stirring all the time
3. Do not allow sauce to boil hard as it will become lumpy
4. Simmer for 3 minutes , then remove from the heat
5. Dip pieces of fish in flour seasoned with salt and pepper
6. Brown lightly in hot oil
7. Place the fish in a casserole dish and pour the sauce over the top
8. Garnish with slices of tomato
9. Bake at 300f degrees for 20 minutes

title: tootsie roll jello shots
steps:
1. Mix boiling water and jello
2. I like to put in a pitcher
3. After well disolved add cold water and creme decocoa
4. Pour into shot containers and chill for 4 hours
5. Enjoy

title: summer vegetables  spain
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large heavy skillet & saute the onion , bell peppers & garlic for about 5 minutes , then add the aubergine & continue frying over low heat for another 5 minutes
2. Add tomatoes & courgette , season with salt & pepper , then add the oregano & cover , continuing to fry over medium to low heat for another 15 minutes
3. Remove from heat when vegetables are well-cooked & serve either hot or cold

title: chilled sesame ramen
steps:
1. Cook the ramen for three minutes
2. Drain
3. Dry toast sesame seeds until light brown
4. Mix all sauce ingredients til smooth
5. Top the noodles with the sauce , garnish with chopped chives or scallions
6. Traditionally served chilled but it's great hot or even at room temperature

title: light   tasty tomato basil soup
steps:
1. Bring tomato and juice to a boil in a large saucepan
2. Reduce heat
3. Simmer , uncovered , 30 minutes
4. Place tomato mixture and basil in a blender or food processor
5. Process until smooth
6. Return pureed mixture to pan
7. Stir in milk , salt , and pepper
8. Add cream cheese , stirring well with a whisk , and cook over medium heat until thick
9. Ladle soup into individual bowls
10. Garnish with sliced basil , if desired
11. Serve with bread

title: honey orange chicken with sesame sauce
steps:
1. Combine juice , honey , ginger , garlic , zest , salt and pepper in a bowl
2. Add chicken , stir to coat
3. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes minimum
4. Heat a large skillet over med
5. Heat until hot
6. Add vegetable oil and swirl to coat
7. Lift chicken from marinade and let excess drip back into the bowl
8. When oil is hot , add chicken and cook over med heat 3 min per side , or until golden brown
9. Add reserved marinade to skillet and boil over med-high heat , turning chicken once or twice , 3-5 min , or until chicken is cooked through and sauce is reduced by half
10. Transfer chicken to a cutting board , cut into diagonal slices , and arrange on a platter
11. Stir sesame iol into thickened sauce and spoon it over chicken
12. Sprinkle with sesame seeds

title: wheat belly tortillas
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Prepare a large baking sheet by lining with parchment paper
3. Add flaxseeds , almond meal / flour , and salt to a medium bowl and whisk together
4. Whisk in the eggs just until combined
5. Divide the dough into 4 equal balls
6. Using 2 pieces of parchment paper , roll each ball between pieces until 6 round
7. Place on the prepared baking sheet
8. Bake for 5 minutes , or until golden

title: ginger cookies
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 190oc or 375of gas 5
2. Grease a baking sheet
3. Cream together the sugar , margarine , salt and vanilla essence until very soft and light
4. Work in the flour , cocoa and ginger , adding a little milk , if necessary , to bind the mixture
5. Knead lightly on a floured surface until smooth
6. Roll out the dough to about 5 mm or 1 / 4 inch thick
7. Stamp out shapes using floured biscuit cutters and place on the prepared baking sheet
8. Bake the cookies for 10 - 15 minutes
9. Leave to cool on the baking sheets until firm , then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely
10. Decorate with glace icing and pieces of glace cherries

title: alaska salmon w  tomatillo sauce  fresh corn   poblano chile
steps:
1. For the sauce:
2. Combine the tomatillos , serrano chilies , cilantro , and lime juice in the blender and puree until very smooth
3. Season with salt and pepper and keep chilled until ready to serve
4. For the corn:
5. Husk the corn and shave the kernels off the cob
6. Place the cream in a pot , cooking down to reduce by 1 / 2
7. Roast the poblanos under a broiler and place in a bowl to steam , covered , ten minutes
8. When the chilies are cool to handle , peel , seed , and roughly chop
9. Combine the corn , poblanos , and cream and set aside
10. Keep warm until ready to serve
11. When ready to serve:
12. Saute alaska salmon until desired doneness , about four minutes on each side
13. Place about two ounces of the tomatillo sauce in the center of a serving plate
14. Ladle some of the warm corn mixture in the center and place the salmon fillets on top
15. Serve with slices of grilled zucchini

title: broiled pink grapefruit
steps:
1. Cut grapefruit in half through the centre widthwise
2. Slice between the pith and fruit to loosen from peel
3. Make slice between the segments be careful not to cut through the peel
4. Sprinkle with sugar
5. Place in oven under broiler on high and broil until sugar is lightly carmelized 10-25 minutes
6. Serve

title: taco bell mild taco sauce  copycat
steps:
1. Whisk all ingredients together rigorously in a medium saucepan
2. Bring mixture to boil over high heat
3. Whisk as needed
4. Boil one full minute
5. Remove from heat and cool
6. Whisk sauce occasionally as it cools
7. Pour cooled sauce into a sealable container or a squeeze bottle for convenience
8. Serve and enjoy with your favorite tacos or burritos , or use as a starter-base for chili
9. Refrigerate any unused portion for up to 2 weeks
10. Shake well before serving again

title: iced banana slab cake
steps:
1. Place the eggs , brown sugar , and banana into a mixing bowl
2. Using a stick belnder or food processor , blend until smooth and fluffy
3. Toss in the flour and fold gently , just until combined
4. Spray a baking tray with canola oil and line with baking paper
5. Grease the top of paper with the butter and then pour in the banana mixture
6. Sprinkle with brown sugar and bake in a preheated oven at 190c for 30-45 minutes , depending on your oven
7. Remove cake and allow to completely cool
8. Spread the icing over the top and refrigerate for 15 minutes to set
9. Slice and serve
10. To make icing: mix all ingredients together until thick and smooth

title: savory pecans
steps:
1. Heat oven to 300
2. Mix all ingredients
3. Spread pecan mixture in ungreased jelly roll pan
4. Bake for about 10 minutes or until pecans are toasted
5. I like to serve them warm , but they are good cold as well

title: snow peas with toasted almonds
steps:
1. Melt butter in medium skillet over medium heat
2. Add almonds and cook until golden and fragrant and butter begins to brown , stirring frequently , about 1 1 / 2 minutes
3. Add snow peas and shallot
4. Saut until snow peas are crisp-tender , 1 1 / 2 to 2 minutes
5. Remove skillet from heat
6. Add lemon juice
7. Season to taste with salt and serve

title: whoops  double post
steps:
1. Pour two ounce premuim vodka in a glass filled 2 / 3 with ice
2. Squeeze in the juice of lime to taste
3. Fill glass with club soda and stir
4. Garnish glass with lime wheel

title: deliciously tart lemon ice cream
steps:
1. In a saucepan whisk together the zest , the lemon juice , the sugar , and the eggs
2. Whisk in 1 cup of the half-and-half and the vanilla , and cook the mixture over moderately high heat , whisking constantly , until it just comes to a simmer
3. Strain the custard through a fine sieve into a bowl , pressing hard on the zest , and chill it , covered with plastic wrap , until it is cold
4. Whisk in the remaining 1 cup half-and-half and freeze the mixture in an ice-cream freezer according to the manufacturer's instructions

title: viennese spiced espresso
steps: 1. Mix all of the ingredients together with your fresh espresso , and then top with whipped cream to serve

title: firehouse mexican bean dip
steps:
1. Cook ground beef , onion , and garlic in medium skillet until meat is browned , stirring to break up pieces
2. Drain well
3. Return to skillet and stir in refried beans , cumin , and oregano
4. Spread bean mixture in a 9 inches quiche dish or pie plate
5. Top with layer of chopped peppers
6. Pour taco sauce over top and spread evenly
7. Atthis point , dip may be covered with plastic wrap& chilled for up to 24 hrs if desired
8. Bake the bean mixture , uncovered , in a 350-degree oven for 10 minutes
9. Sprinkle with cheeses and bake 5-10 minutes more or until heated through
10. Sprinkle olives and green onion over dip
11. Serve hot with warm tortilla chips

title: rathu isso curry  sri lankan red prawn curry
steps:
1. Wash prawns and remove heads but leave shells on
2. Put all ingredients , except lemon juice , into a saucepan and bring slowly to simmering point
3. Simmer uncovered for 20 minutes or until onions are soft
4. Add lemon juice and stir
5. Taste and add more salt or lemon if required

title: polish sausage lima bean stew   crock pot
steps:
1. Pour stock into crock pot , set on high
2. Add beans
3. Heat a heavy frying pan over medium-high heat
4. Add oil
5. Add onions , garlic , bell peppers , celery , red potatoes , and baby carrots
6. Saute 'til onions are translucent
7. Add crushed red chiles and tomato paste , mix well
8. Add vegetables to crock pot
9. Reduce heat to low , cook 3 hours
10. Add sausage , cook 3 / 4 hour
11. Add enough potato flakes to thicken as desired
12. Cook 15 minutes more
13. Serve with a peasant loaf or maybe cornbread or cornsticks

title: barefoot contessa s hummus
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in the bowl of a food processor fitted with a steel blade and process until hummus is coarsely pureed
2. Serve chilled or at room temperature

title: hoppin  john jambalaya
steps:
1. Heat oil in dutch oven or other large pot over medium heat
2. Add onion , green pepper , parsley , and garlic and saute about 10 minutes
3. Add sausage , salt pork , peas and chicken broth and bring to a boil
4. Add rice and return to a boil
5. Reduce heat , cover tightly and simmer about 45 minutes
6. Do not lift lid
7. Season with salt and pepper to taste and add green onions , mixing well
8. Let stand about 10 minutes before serving with hot sauce , if desired

title: spicy baked spaghetti
steps:
1. In large frying pan , brown meat with herbs and pepper and onion
2. Slow boil noodles for 30 minutes
3. Cook grease out of meat , don't drain
4. Add sauce to meat mixture and let simmer for 10 minutes
5. Drain water from noodles and mix in meat well
6. Dump into casserolle dish
7. Pre-heat oven to 350 degrees
8. Cover with cheese
9. Bake for 25 minutes or until cheese is golden brown
10. Serve
11. Enjoy

title: yum yum no bake 3 layer bars
steps:
1. Line a 15x10x1-inch baking pan with foil , extending the foil over the edges of the pan
2. Set aside
3. Base layer:
4. In a large saucepan , combine granulated sugar and corn syrup
5. Heat and stir just until mixture boils around edges
6. Heat and stir for 1 minute more
7. Remove from heat and stir in peanut butter until melted
8. Stir in rice cereal and cornflakes until coated
9. Press mixture into the bottom of prepared pan
10. Pudding layer:
11. In a medium saucepan , melt the 3 / 4 cup butter
12. Stir in powdered sugar , dry vanilla pudding mixes , and milk
13. Spread pudding mixture over cereal layer
14. Set aside
15. Frosting:
16. In a small saucepan , combine chocolate pieces and the 1 / 2 cup butter
17. Heat and stir over low heat until melted
18. Spread frosting over pudding layer
19. Cover and chill about 1 hour or until set
20. Serving:
21. Remove set mixture from pan by lifting foil
22. Place on a cutting board
23. Cut into 64 bars
24. To store: layer bars between waxed paper in an airtight storage container
25. Cover
26. Store in the refrigerator for up to 2 days

title: basil shrimp with feta and orzo
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees
2. Spray the inside of the foil bag with cooking spray and place on a large shallow baking pan
3. Cook the pasta in boiling water for 5 minutes
4. Drain
5. Place the pasta in a large bowl and stir in 1 teaspoon of the oil and the next 7 ingredients
6. Place the orzo mixture in teh foil bag
7. Combine the shrimp and basil
8. Arrange shrimp mixture on the orzo
9. Fold edges of bag to seal
10. Bake at 450 degrees for 25 minutes
11. Cut open the bag with a sharp knife and peel the foil back
12. Drizzle with remaining 1 teaspoon of oil
13. Serve

title: blueberry oat bran
steps:
1. Cook oats according to directions
2. Thaw blueberries in microwave by heating for about 45 seconds-1 minute
3. Pour blueberries and the resulting juice over the oatmeal and stir
4. Add your favorite toppings - i like vanilla soymilk and a little brown sugar

title: hawaiian pork skillet
steps:
1. Toss pork in juice and soy sauce , then in cornstarch
2. Stir fry ginger and garlic in oil
3. Add pork and cook until almost cooked through
4. Add pineapple , green onions , red pepper , sesame oil , and black pepper and cook until vegetables are tender
5. Serve over steamed rice

title: breaded turkey cutlets
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Place turkey cutlets in a medium bowl and cover with water
3. Add 2 tablespoons of the lemon juice
4. Set aside
5. In a shallow bowl , combine egg whites , cornstarch and 1 tablespoon of lemon juice
6. In a separate shallow bowl , place the bread crumbs and grated parmesan cheese
7. One at a time , take the cutlets from the water , dip into the egg white mixture and then into the bread crumbs , turning once to coat both sides
8. Spray a shallow baking pan with nonstick spray
9. Place cutlets into pan
10. Drizzle oil over breaded cutlets
11. Bake 30 minutes or until lightly browned

title: avocado ranch light version
steps: 1. Mix all ingredients together and chill overnight before serving

title: easy cheesy lentil   rice casserole
steps:
1. Use a big pot and cook onion in margarine until soft
2. In a bowl , stir together bouillon and hot water
3. Add lentils , rice , bouillon-water mixture and cold water
4. Bring to a boil
5. Lower heat , cover and simmer 25 minutes , stirring occasionally
6. Meanwhile , fry both sides of a slice of bread in oil and sprinkle with italian seasoning blend
7. Cool on rack
8. After 25 minutes , rice should be cooked and lentils should be cooked but still firm and there should still be some moisture in the mixture
9. Turn stove off and stir 1 cup of the cheese into the mixture until cheese is melted
10. Pour mixture into a 9 by 13 pan that has been sprayed with pam and smooth the top with the back of your spoon
11. Sprinkle remaining 1 / 2 cup of shredded cheese over top
12. Crunch up the cooled fried bread with a knife and sprinkle over casserole
13. Sprinkle parmesan over casserole
14. Bake in preheated 350 oven for 15 minutes or so until cheese is melted
15. Let cool slightly before serving

title: bruschetta with pesto  tomatoes and thingies
steps:
1. (i find it best to slice up the entire baguette because if you use only what you need , the rest of the loaf goes stale
2. Bake the bread , cool the slices you don't use , and keep in a plastic bag to use again -- can be heated up again)
3. Heat oven to 400 deg f / 200 deg celsius
4. Slice the baguette at a slight diagonal slant
5. Pour some fruity virgin olive oil in a bowl , dip each slice just lightly into the oil
6. It does not have to be covered in oil -- just "anointed": it will have patches the oil didn't reach
7. Pack on any cookie tin , and when oven has reached its heat , bake the slices until the edges start to go golden , and the slices are hard in the centre
8. While they bake , peel the tomato , cut into 2 halves , and chop up finely
9. Do the same with the 1 / 2 onion , and add to the tomato
10. Season with salt and black pepper , and trust me , a pure flaky sea salt is better tasting than ordinary kitchen salt
11. Use as many baked bread slices as you need -- at least 3 per person
12. As you add the topping , put them back on the baking tin , or transfer to another , smaller dish -- depending on how many you are making
13. Spread the hot , hard baguette slices thinly with pesto , and top each with a teaspoon or more of the tomato-onion mix
14. Slice the brie or camembert quite thinly and drape a small slice over each bread slice
15. Put the prepared slices back into the oven for about 2 - 3 minutes , remove , and serve
16. Cool the slices you did not use , and keep in an airtight container
17. Looks quite pretty on a heated plate
18. Nice with a cold glass of wine , or even a cup of tea

title: chicken something casserole
steps:
1. In a 9x13-inch baking dish melt butter or margarine
2. Place chicken breast in and season with pepper
3. Sprinkle onion soup mix over breasts , spread mushroom soup over breasts and sprinkle the rice evenly over all
4. Pour 2 cups of water over the dish and seal with foil
5. Bake at 350f for 1 hour

title: twice cooked baby potatoes
steps:
1. Wash potatoes
2. Boil potatoes about 15 minutes or until just tender , and drain
3. Coat with olive oil and let cool until cool enough to handle
4. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
5. Place potatoes on a large rimmed baking sheet
6. Using the flat bottom of a small saucepan gently press down on each potato until it flattens slightly and the skin splits
7. Sprinkle with salt and pepper
8. I prefer kosher salt
9. Bake for 20 - 30 minutes until the potatoes are browned to your taste

title: mini shortbread tart shells
steps:
1. Set oven to 300 degrees
2. Prepare mini muffin tins
3. In a bowl mix all ingredients with an electric hand mixer until well blended
4. Pinch off small pieces of dough using your fingers pat into the muffin tins to form a "shell"
5. Prick the bottoms with a fork
6. Bake for about 20 minutes (during the baking time prick bottoms again if the shells puff up
7. Cool and fill as desired

title: plum kuchen
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Mix flour , 1 tablespoon sugar and baking powder together
3. Cut in butter until mixture looks like coarse crumbs
4. Add 2 tablespoons heavy cream and 1 egg
5. Press in bottom of 9-inch square pan or pie pan and arrange plums on top
6. Bake for 25-30 minutes
7. While this is baking , in a bowl combine heavy cream , sugar , egg and vanilla , using a whisk to beat together well
8. Pour mixture over plums and bake an additional 20-30 minutes , until custard is set
9. Serve warm or cool
10. Store in refrigerator

title: bagna cauda with cream  dip
steps:
1. Brown garlic in oil in a deep skillet
2. Add anchovies and butter , stirring until hot
3. Reduce heat
4. Stir in cream and heat just til warm
5. Serve immediately , with any raw veggies or italian bread for dipping

title: vegetable no cheese lasagna
steps:
1. In a large skillet add all of your vegetables with 2 tsps extra virgin olive oil and saut for approximately 5 minutes add salt , pepper , italian seasonings and sauce
2. Cook for 10 minutes
3. Cook noodles to instructions on box
4. Arrange noodles in a 9x9-inch pan top with 1 / 3 of the veggie mixture repeat 2 more times
5. Garnish with 2 cups diced cooked chicken meat
6. Bake at 375f for 60-75 minutes check for veggie doneness

title: classic french bread for breadmaker
steps:
1. Add 1 1 / 4 cups water , salt , bread flour , and yeast to bread machine in the order suggested by the manufacturer
2. Select dough / manual cycle
3. When cycle is complete , remove dough from machine to lightly floured surface
4. Divide dough in half
5. Roll each half into a 10 x 8-inch rectangle
6. Beginning at the long end , roll up tightly as for jelly roll
7. Pinch seams and ends to seal
8. Taper ends by gently rolling back and forth
9. Place each loaf , seam side down , on a greased baking sheet sprinkled with cornmeal
10. Lightly brush each loaf with vegetable oil
11. Cover and let rise in a warm , draft-free place until almost doubled in size , 10-15 minutes
12. With a sharp knife , make 3 or 4 diagonal cuts about 1 / 4 inch deep across the top of each loaf
13. Lightly beat egg white and 1 tablespoon of water
14. Brush some of egg white mixture over top of each loaf
15. Bake at 375 degrees for 20 minutes
16. Brush again with remaining egg white mixture
17. Bake 5 to 10 minutes more or until done - bread should sound hollow when tapped
18. Remove the bread from the baking sheet
19. Cool on a wire rack

title: curried sausages
steps:
1. Cover the sausages with cold water
2. Bring to the boil and simmer about 5 minutes
3. Drain , cool , remove skins and cut each into 4 or 5 pieces
4. Heat the oil in a large saucepan and fry the onion , garlic and ginger , carrots and potatoes , stirring until the onions are soft
5. Add the curry powder and cook a minute or two
6. Add the tomato paste , chutney , apple sauce , stock and coconut milk
7. Stir well , then return the sausage chunks to the saucepan
8. Bring too the boil then cover and simmer about 45 minutes
9. Remove the lid and allow to cook about 15 minutes more to reduce the sauce a bit
10. If you cant be bothered , mix two tablespoon cornflour with 2 tablespoons water and stir this through to thicken
11. 1 cup of peas can be added in the last 15 minutes as well
12. Season with salt and pepper and serve garnished with copped fresh coriander

title: apricots with honey and rosemary   france
steps:
1. Cut the apricots in two and take out the seeds
2. Wash and dry the rosemary , and pull off the rosemary needles
3. Melt the butter in a pan , put the apricot halves in , and cook at a high heat about 1 minute on each side
4. Lower the heat , add the honey and the rosemary needles , cover and let cook over low heat for 10 minutes
5. Stir with a wooden spoon to avoid any scorching
6. Share out the cooked apricots in 6 small dishes , and drizzle the warm honey-rosemary sauce over each one
7. Serve warm

title: pasta salad with sun dried tomato pesto
steps:
1. Pesto: lightly toast the pine nuts and set aside
2. In a food processor or blender add the basil , garlic , and parsley
3. Process until finely chopped
4. Add the pine nuts , parmesan cheese , and salt
5. Process using the pulse setting until just blended
6. With the appliance running , gradually add the olive oil through the feed tube , processing until a smooth paste is formed
7. Add the sun-dried tomatoes and vinegar of choice , processing until the tomatoes are finely chopped but flecks are still visible
8. Yield: 1 1 / 2 cups pesto
9. Pasta salad: transfer the cooked , chilled pasta to a pretty salad bowl and stir in the pesto sauce , making sure the pasta is generously coated
10. Cover salad bowl and chill the salad up to 6 hours
11. Yield is estimated

title: country mushroom soup
steps:
1. In a 2-quart saucepan , melt butter
2. Stir in flour until smooth
3. Gradually stir in broth until smooth
4. Add salt , pepper and bay leaves
5. Simmer , uncovered , for 15 minutes , stirring occasionally
6. Meanwhile , in another saucepan , saute the celery and onion in oil until tender
7. Add mushrooms , cook and stir until tender
8. Add to broth mixture
9. Bring to a boil
10. Reduce heat
11. Simmer , uncovered for 15 minutes , stirring occasionally
12. Add cream , heat through
13. Discard bay leaves

title: chicken   rice chili
steps:
1. Spray a large pot with cooking spray then cook the chicken until no longer pink
2. Meanwhile , blend the tomatoes & chilies in a food processor until no longer chunky
3. Mix all the ingredients except the rice , sour cream , & cheese into the pot
4. Simmer over low heat for 20 minutes
5. Add in the rice , stir & let sit for 10 minutes
6. Spoon into bowls then top with sour cream & cheese

title: quick and easy tuna casserole
steps:
1. Bring a large pot of water to a boil
2. Add noodles and frozen peas
3. Cook until noodles are al dente , drain well
4. Return noodles and peas to the pot
5. Mix soup , tuna fish , onions , processed cheese and pepper into the pot
6. Stir constantly until all of the ingredients are well mixed and the cheese has melted
7. Serve

title: sundried tomato and olive polenta   ancient renaissance recipe
steps:
1. Boil the vegetable broth
2. Once boiling , stir in the polenta - let it simmer on low heat while stirring frequently for 15 minutes
3. Remove from the heating element
4. Stir in the crumbled feta , shredded parmesan , chopped sundried tomatoes , chopped up basil , and sliced olives
5. Once stirred in evenly , put the mixture in a greased cake pan and spread / press down evenly
6. Let the mixture firm up in the refrigerator for a minimum of 2 hours
7. Once firm , cut the firm polenta mixtures into slices
8. Coat in flour , shaking off excess
9. Fry the floured polenta in olive oil until nicely browned
10. Then drain on paper towel

title: mango lassi  india
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a blender
2. Process about 1 minute or until smooth

title: scallops  black tiger shrimp with chorizo chili
steps:
1. In a saute' pan cook chorizo until it begins to get firm
2. Add remaining vegetables and black beans
3. Use some of the bean liquid to thin out the mixture
4. You want to have a pourable consistency
5. This should take about 5 minutes
6. Add mango puree and asian chili paste
7. In a separate pan , melt butter , then add scallops
8. Do not shake pan
9. The scallops must develop a crust before turning over
10. About 2-3 minutes
11. Add shrimp
12. When it's time to turn the scallops over , it'll be time for the shrimp to be turned as well
13. You want the shrimp to be orange with slight charring
14. Carefully add the wine
15. It should sizzle , then bubble and mix with the flavors of the scallops and shrimp
16. Press on scallops to check doneness
17. It should be slightly resistant
18. Take a tablespoon and scoop out about 3 ounces of the chili mixture onto each plate
19. Top with micro mint greens
20. Add 3 scallops in a triangle pattern
21. Intermix with 3 shrimp
22. Drizzle juices from seafood pan over the diah

title: strawberry caipirinha
steps:
1. Add the strawberries , 3 lime wedges , and simple syrup to a rocks glass
2. Muddle the ingredients in the glass
3. Fill the glass halfway with crushed ice
4. Add the cachaca and stir the mixture vigorously
5. Fill the rest of the glass with crushed ice
6. Garnish with remaining lime wedge

title: vegetable fried brown rice
steps:
1. In saucepan , bring water & rice to boil
2. Stir frequently so it doesn't stick
3. Reduce heat , cover & simmer 20 minutes or until all liquid is absorbed
4. In large skillet , heat peanut oil over medium heat
5. Add cooked rice & saut until lightly golden
6. Add onions , salt , carrots , & sprouts
7. Stir-fry 5 minutes until vegetables are tender yet crisp
8. Hollow out a circle in center of skillet
9. Pour egg whites into hollow & cook , lightly scrambling
10. Stir egg into rice mixture
11. Sprinkle with light soy sauce , sesame oil , & chopped parsley

title: corn and potato chowder
steps:
1. In a 2-quart microwave safe casserole , place onion in the centre with bacon around the edges
2. Cover and cook at 100% power for 3 minutes , until onion is tender , stirring once
3. Arrange potatoes on top of bacon and onions
4. Cover and cook at 100% power for 6 minutes , stirring twice , until potatoes are tender
5. Let stand , still covered , for 3 minutes
6. Stir in corn kernels , cream-style corn , and the milk
7. Add salt and pepper , to taste
8. Heat at 100% power for 3-4 minutes , or until hot , stirring occasionally

title: silky summer tomato soup with spinach coulis
steps:
1. For the tomato soup:
2. Cut the tomatoes into 2- to 3-inch chunks
3. Finely puree the tomatoes , onion , garlic , jalapeno , salt , and olive oil in a blender or food processor
4. Push the puree through a food mill fitted with the fine screen , then add enough tabasco to the soup to suit your taste
5. Refrigerate until cool
6. For the spinach coulis:
7. Pick out and discard any damaged leaves and seal the leaves in a plastic bag
8. Place the bag in a microwave onion and microwave the spinach on high for 1 1 / 2 minutes
9. Transfer the spinach to a blender
10. Add the oil , salt , and water and process for about 1 minute , stopping the machine once or twice to push any pieces of spinach clinging to the sides down into the mixture
11. When it's smooth , transfer the spinach puree to a bottle or jar , cover tightly , and refrigerate
12. To serve , ladle out about 1 1 / 2 cups soup per person
13. Garnish each bowl with 1 to 2 tablespoons of spinach coulis

title: tuna cucumber pasta salad
steps:
1. Prepare macaroni or pasta as directed on package
2. Combine mayonnaise , italian dressing , mustard , and dill
3. Add pasta to dressing and mix well
4. Place vegetables and tuna in salad bowl
5. Sprinkle with salt and pepper
6. Add pasta and dressing mixture and toss all ingredients gently
7. Refrigerate , covered , at least 4 hours before serving
8. Place chicken pieces in ziploc bag with cup salad dressing for at least one hour
9. Be careful , remembering that the dressing is made with salad oil and will flare up at first as the oil ignites
10. It can also be used dry as a rub
11. Good seasons salad dressing is becoming harder to find as kraft foods moves toward higher end premium dressings

title: strawberry blossom
steps:
1. Remove stems from strawberries to form a flat base
2. Place berries on cutting surface , pointed end facing up
3. With a sharp knife , carefully slice each berry in half vertically to within a 1 / 4 inch of base
4. Cut each half into three wedges to form 6 petals
5. Pull petals apart slightly
6. In a small bowl , combine cream cheese , powdered sugar and sour cream
7. Beat until light and fluffy
8. With a pastry bag and star

title: cherry walnut cookies
steps:
1. In bowl , beat butter with sugar until fluffy
2. Beat in egg and vanilla
3. Then add flour and salt
4. Stir until blended
5. Stir in cherries and walnuts
6. Divide dough into thirds
7. Shape each into 10" long log
8. Wrap and chill until firm , at least 3 hours
9. Cut logs into 1 / 8th" or 3 mm thick rounds and place about 1 inch apart , on parchment lined baking sheets
10. Bake in top and bottom thirds of 325 deg f oven , rotating and switching pans halfway through , just until edges begin to colour , 8-10 minutes
11. These cookies brown even faster than shortbreads , so keep a close eye on them ! i start checking early , and they're usually done around the 8 minute mark
12. Let cool on pan for 5 minutes , then transfer to wire rack and let cool completely before storing
13. Store layered with waxed paper in airtight container for up to 2 weeks , or freeze for up to one month
14. Makes about 12 dozen cookies
15. These are really delicious cookies , well worth the time it takes to make them !
16. Hint: if you want to use red and green cherries do not mix the cherries in same batch , they look better if made separately !

title: not so sweet passionfruit curd for passover
steps:
1. Melt butter and sugar together in a pan
2. Add eggs and passionfriut and very gently heat until thickened stirring all the time
3. When thick enough for you - this may take up to 10 minutes - then pot into clean dry jars and store in the fridge ready for use
4. Be careful you don't get scrambled eggs with passionfruit sauce !
5. Not sure how much this gives as it is different each time due to the juiciness of the fruit

title: veal and olive rag with pappardelle
steps:
1. Bring a large pot of water to a boil , salt it , add the pasta and cook until al dente
2. Drain
3. While the pasta is working , in a large , deep skillet , heat the oil , 2 turns of the pan , over medium-high heat
4. Add the butter to melt , then add the veal and season with salt and a little pepper
5. Cook , breaking up the meat with a wooden spoon , until no longer pink , about 5 minutes
6. Add the onion and garlic and cook , stirring occasionally , until softened , about 5 minutes
7. Stir in the rosemary and tomato paste and cook for 2 minutes , then stir in the olives and heat through for 1 minute
8. Stir in the wine , scraping up the browned bits from the bottom of the pan , for 1 minute
9. Stir in the beef broth and parsley and simmer for 2 minutes
10. Stir in the lemon peel
11. Add the pasta to the sauce and stir in 1 / 2 cup cheese
12. Serve hot with extra cheese

title: blackberry jelly
steps:
1. Crush berries and strain through a jelly bag to get 4 cups of juice
2. If you are slightly short of juice , add small amounts of water to the pulp in the jelly bag , to squeeze out more juice
3. Combine blackberry juice with lemon juice and sugar in a large saucepan , mixing well
4. Bring to a boil over high heat , stirring constantly
5. Immediately stir in pectin and return to a full rolling boil , stirring constantly
6. Remove from heat and skim off foam with a slotted metal spoon
7. Pour into sterilized half-pint jars , leaving 1 / 2" headspace
8. Remove air bubbles
9. Adjust caps
10. Process in in water bath canner for 10 minutes
11. When cool , check seals , and refrigerate promptly any that have not properly sealed

title: maui scones
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400f
2. Combine flour , brown sugar and baking powder in medium bowl
3. Cut in butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs
4. Stir in 1 / 2 cup coconut and macadamia cashew mix
5. Beat pineapple , reserved pineapple juice and eggs in small bowl until well mixed
6. Stir pineapple mixture into flour mixture
7. Knead about 10 times or until mixture forms a dough , adding small amount of flour , if necessary
8. Divide dough in half
9. Pat each half into 6-inch circle
10. Place onto large ungreased baking sheet
11. Cut each circle into 6 wedges
12. -or- use 3" biscuit cutter to cut out round scones
13. Sprinkle scones with coconut
14. Bake for 13 to 15 minutes or until scones are cooked through
15. Depending on your oven , you may need to bake longer
16. If scones turn golden brown , cover with foil and continue to bake until cooked through

title: slow cooker vegetable chickpea curry
steps:
1. In a 3 / 5 or 4 quart slow cooker , combine cauliflower , chickpeas , green beans , carrots and onion
2. Stir in broth and curry powder
3. Cover and cook on low-heat setting for 5-6 hours or on high-heat for 2
4. 5 to 3 hours
5. Stir in coconut milk and shredded basil leaves
6. Spoon rice , if using , into bowls , and ladle curry over the top

title: delicious oat bran cereal
steps:
1. Bring all ingredients except oat bran to a simmer
2. Simmer for one minute
3. Add oat bran
4. Simmer for two minutes

title: vanilla  cream puffs or any kind
steps:
1. Preheat over to 400 degrees f
2. In a medium saucepan , heat water and butter to a rolling boil
3. Reduce heat to low and rapidly stir in flour until it forms a ball , about 1 minute
4. Remove from heat
5. Add eggs one at a time , and beat until smooth
6. Using a medium ice cream scoop , drop 3 inches apart onto a lightly greased baking sheet
7. Bake 35 - 40 minutes or until puffed and golden
8. Cool
9. To serve , split and fill with the above recipe or anything
10. Then put the tops back on
11. They look so impressive
12. You can make the puffs larger or smaller depending on what you want to use them for -- shrimp salad , tuna salad , fruit etc
13. The possibilities are endless for these little "containers
14. "
15. I usually make "minis" and get about 24

title: dee s panko breaded pecan salmon
steps:
1. Crush pecans until fine
2. Add pecans to panko bread crumbs
3. Heat pan with oil
4. You may need more oil
5. Beat egg in another bowl
6. In another bowl have flour , salt if using , and pepper
7. I buy the frozen indivudual salmon fillets and microwave them a touch so they are not cooked but not frozen either
8. Dredge fish in the flour to which salt and pepper have been added
9. Shake off excess flour
10. Dip into egg and then into pecan bread crumb mixture
11. Put in hot skillet skin side down
12. Fry until golden
13. Do not move fillets around a lot
14. Flip over
15. Fry on other side until golden and fish in center is cooked to your liking
16. Touch it lightly like steak
17. Be careful not to burn yourself
18. You can also check doneness with a knife

title: good eats chicken stock  from alton brown
steps:
1. Place chicken , vegetables , and herbs and spices in 12-quart stockpot
2. Set opened steamer basket directly on ingredients in pot and pour over water
3. Cook on high heat until you begin to see bubbles break through the surface of the liquid
4. Turn heat down to medium low so that stock maintains low , gentle simmer
5. Skim the scum from the stock with a spoon or fine mesh strainer every 10 to 15 minutes for the first hour of cooking and twice each hour for the next 2 hours
6. Add hot water as needed to keep bones and vegetables submerged
7. Simmer uncovered for 6 to 8 hours
8. Strain stock through a fine mesh strainer into another large stockpot or heatproof container discarding the solids
9. Cool immediately in large cooler of ice or a sink full of ice water to below 40 degrees
10. Place in refrigerator overnight
11. Remove solidified fat from surface of liquid and store in container with lid in refrigerator for 2 to 3 days or in freezer for up to 3 months
12. Prior to use , bring to boil for 2 minutes
13. Use as a base for soups and sauces

title: roasted eggplant dip from bahrain uukkous al badinjan
steps:
1. Using a fork , poke eggplants all over
2. Roast eggplants at 350f for about 1 hour or until soft
3. Remove from oven and let cool until you can handle the eggplants
4. With a knife , split eggplants open and scoop out all the flesh into a food processor or blender
5. Add remaining ingredients and puree
6. Taste and adjust seasonings if necessary
7. Chill and serve with flatbread or as an accompaniment to main meal

title: brown gravy mix
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients and store in an airtight container
2. To make gravy , measure 3 tablespoons mix into a saucepan
3. Add 1 1 / 2 cups water
4. Bring to a boil and simmer 1 minute

title: banana salad dressing
steps:
1. Mix first five ingredients together in a sauce pan , adding the milk last
2. Cook over low heat until slightly thickened
3. Cool and store in fridge
4. Just before serving , quarter or slice bananas into individuals serving dishes
5. Spoon dressing over bananas
6. Can sprinkle ground peanuts over if desired

title: spinach salad with creamy raspberry dressing
steps:
1. Reserve 1 / 2 cup raspberries for dressing
2. Arrange spinach on individual plates
3. Sprinkle on raspberries , onions , mushrooms , and walnuts
4. Place dressing ingredients in a blender or food processor
5. Process until well blended
6. You can also add the juice drained from the frozen raspberries
7. Serve with dressing at the table as it's a bit heavy

title: grandma knorberg s pork chops casserole
steps:
1. Place pork chops in 9x13 pan
2. Sprinkle with salt , pepper and sage
3. Mix all the remaining ingredients
4. Pour over the chops
5. Bake 1 hour at 350f

title: pasta with roasted butternut squash and sage
steps:
1. Dice the squash into half-inch cubes , and toss with olive oil and a dash of salt and pepper
2. Place on a greased baking sheet
3. Heat the oven to 350 , and roast the squash until soft
4. Roasting time will vary from 15 to 25 minutes , depending on the age of the squash
5. Remove from the oven and toss the squash with the chopped sage to infuse the flavor
6. Let cool
7. In a hot skillet , toast the breadcrumbs
8. In a large pot , bring water to a boil and add the pasta
9. Cook until the pasta is al dente
10. Drain the pasta , then toss with the squash , breadcrumbs , parmesan cheese , and salt and pepper to taste
11. Garnish with fried sage leaves and parmesan cheese shavings

title: authentic eggplant parmesan
steps:
1. For sauce :
2. In a dutch oven or large size sauce pan , add oil , on medium heat
3. Add garlic and onions , saut' until tender
4. Add tomato sauce , tomato paste , and wine , if using , and italian seasoning
5. Mix well , and bring to a boil , then reduce heat to a simmer
6. Cover and simmer for 4 4 1 / 2 hours , stirring occasionally
7. For eggplant:
8. In a large size skillet , add olive oil
9. Heat on medium
10. Peel eggplant , then slice them into 1 / 4" round disks
11. In two small bowls or pie plates , add bread crumbs to one , and eggs and milk to the other , beat egg mixture well
12. Dip each eggplant disk into egg mixture then into bread crumbs , coat completely
13. Place gently into hot oil
14. Fry to a golden brown on both sides , drain on paper towels
15. Repeat until all the eggplant are breaded and fried to a golden brown
16. Set aside
17. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
18. Assemble:
19. In a 13x9x2 ungreased baking dish , add about 1 to1 cups sauce to bottom of pan , spread sauce evenly in baking dish
20. Cover sauce with one even layer of breaded eggplant , spread 1 cup mozzarella cheese evenly over eggplant , sprinkle with 1 / 3 cup parmesan cheese
21. Repeat two more times , ending with parmesan cheese
22. Bake uncovered for 45 minutes
23. Let set for 10 minutes before cutting
24. Cut into 8 pieces
25. Serve hot

title: mint chocolate milkshake
steps:
1. Mix all ingredient except the garnish in a blender
2. Pour into tall glasses
3. Serve with shaved chocolate and crushed peppermint candy on top

title: maple glazed chicken thighs
steps:
1. Mix together all ingredients save the thighs in a resealable bag or non reactive container
2. Add thighs and seal
3. Marinade in the fridge for 2 to 24 hours
4. When ready to cook , prepare the cooking surface with a light coating of cooking spray or oil
5. Remove the thighs from the marinade removing any excess
6. Place thighs on the grill and cook for 4 to 6 minutes per side or until a thermometer registers 165 degrees
7. Actual cooking time will vary depending on the type of grill chosen
8. Remove chicken to a serving plate
9. Place the marinade in a small sauce pan over medium heat and bring to a boil
10. Reduce temperature to a low simmer and cook for 3 to 5 minutes
11. Generously brush the chicken with the sauce and serve

title: blackberry basil iced tea
steps:
1. Combine tea bags , blackberries , and basil in a tea pot
2. Mash the blackberries a little
3. Fill with boiling hot water and steep for 5 minutes
4. Pour and strain into ice-filled pitcher
5. Add lemonade and honey as desired
6. Fill individual glasses with ice and serve

title: easy cheesy potato bake
steps:
1. Microwave potatoes
2. Remove skin
3. Mash potatoes
4. Add butter , milk , parmesean and 2 / 3 of cheddar
5. Mash , mix in green onion , and put in a casserole dish
6. Top with remaining cheddar
7. Bake at 375 for 1 / 2 hour , then turn to broil until browned
8. Let sit for at least 5-10 minutes before serving

title: outback steakhouse copycat bread  gluten free
steps:
1. Whisk together dry ingredients in a medium bowl
2. Mix together the wet ingredients in a mixer , then slowly add the dry while leaving the mix on low
3. Then mix on high for 4 minutes
4. Grease and flour two loaf pans
5. Using a spatula , distribute the dough between the two pans
6. Loosely cover with plastic wrap and let rise in a warm moist place for 90 minutes
7. Loaves should just about double in height
8. Bake at 350 degrees for 20-25 minutes

title: honey dijon caesar sandwich
steps:
1. In a small bowl mix the salad dressing and mustard
2. Set aside
3. Lay 6 slices of bread on platter and layer lettuce , tomato , turkey , and bacon on each slice of bread
4. Drizzle top of layers with about 2 tablespoons of dressing mixture
5. Sprinkle 1 tablespoon of cheese over each sandwich
6. Cover using the other 6 slices of bread and press down firmly
7. Serve immediately

title: elegant steak dionne
steps:
1. Cooking day:
2. Place the meat in a large freezer bag
3. In a separate bowl , mix together remaining ingredients and pour over meat
4. If freezing , place freezer bag into freezer , keeping as flat as possible
5. Serving day:
6. Thaw steak
7. Place meat and marinade into crockpot
8. Simmer on low for about 5-6 hours or until tender
9. Remove meat and thinly slice
10. Place meat on a serving platter
11. Pour juices from crockpot over meat and serve
12. This is great served over noodles , rice , or garlic mashed potatoes
13. The wine dissipates while cooking but tenderizes the meat and gives it a wonderful , rich flavor

title: swedish limpa bread
steps:
1. Soften yeast in 1 / 4 cup lukewarm water
2. Add sugar , remaining water and milk
3. Add white flour and beat well
4. Set aside to rise until double in bulk
5. Mix syrup , seeds and molasses in a saucepan
6. Let come to a boil one minute and strain out seeds
7. Add butter and let cool
8. When lukewarm , add yeast mixture with rye flour and salt
9. Add grated orange rind or chopped orange peel and knead well on a floured board
