10. Cover and let rise until doubled
11. Shape into round loaves and place in greased pans
12. Let rise until doubled
13. Bake in a 400f oven for 15 minutes
14. Reduce heat to 350f and bake for an additional 45 minutes
15. Remove from pans to a cooling rack and brush with butter while still hot

title: cowboy ranch dressing
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , combine all ingredients
2. Cover and refrigerate until ready to use

title: meatballs stew
steps:
1. Blend pork , breadcrumbs , eggs , water , mustard , salt , pepper , cloves , cinnamon , nutmeg in a bowl
2. Shape into meatballs of 1 inch of diameter
3. Heat the butter or olive oil to high heat in a casserole and seal the meatballs on all their sides
4. Lower the heat to medium
5. Add the onions and garlic
6. Stir and keep on cooking 3 minutes
7. Incorporate flour and keep on cooking 2 minutes , stirring constantly
8. Pour the beef stock
9. Stir well
10. Cover and let simmer 45 minutes
11. Add the potatoes and keep on cooking 15 minutes , covered partially

title: indian chickpeas
steps:
1. Soak chickpeas overnight then rinse and cook in water till tender
2. Drain and keep the cooking liquid
3. Heat oil in frying pan and cook onion until golden
4. Add cinnamon and cloves and cook for a few seconds
5. Add garlic , ginger , chili pepper , and coriander and cook 5 minutes stirring
6. Add tomatoes with juice and cook till all liquid is absorbed
7. Add the chickpeas to pan , mix , and cook for 5 minutes
8. Pour in the cooking liquid from the chickpeas and simmer for 25 minutes or until all the liquid is gone
9. Sprinkle with garam massala and cilantro
10. Can be served hot or cold
11. Time to make does not include soaking the chickpeas overnight

title: celery cream soup
steps:
1. In a large sauce pan , melt butter , add celery , onions , and garlic
2. Cook over medium low heat until soft
3. Add flour and cook 1-2 minutes over low heat
4. Add chicken broth and bay leaf , bring to a boil reduce heat , cover and simmer 30 minutes
5. Remove bay leaf , puree in a blender or processor
6. Add cream , lemon juice , hot sauce , salt and pepper
7. Reheat and simmer 5 minutes
8. Garnish with celery leaves

title: panini oil
steps:
1. Warm the canola in a small , heavy-bottomed sauce pan over medium-low heat
2. Smash the garlic cloves with the flat of a wide , heavy knife , the flat side of a tenderizing mallet , or any sturdy flat tool that you feel comfortable with
3. You want to flatten them somewhat
4. When the oil shows signs of slow movement , drop the garlic into the warm oil
5. Watch and when the garlic shows signs of beginning to brown , pull off the heat and cover
6. Let stand at room temperature until cooled completely
7. Strain to remove the solids
8. Store the oil in an air-tight container in the refrigerator
9. It should keep for a couple of months if you don't use it all before then
10. When using , brush the outside surfaces of your bread when preparing paninis for grilling
11. You may wish to salt the outside after cooking depending on the type of panini or your personal taste

title: calypso burgers
steps:
1. Brown ground beef and pour off excess fat
2. Add remaining ingredients , and cook over low heat for 15 minutes
3. Serve over sliced french bread or hamburger buns

title: easy cheesy potatoes for the barbecue
steps:
1. Preheat an outdoor grill for medium high heat and lightly oil grate
2. Take a piece of aluminum foil big enough to hold all the potatoes and vegetables and spray with the vegetable cooking spray
3. Place the potatoes , onion and green bell pepper in the middle of the foil and season with salt and pepper to taste , then place small pats of the butter or margarine over the vegetables
4. Carefully seal all the edges of the foil around the vegetables to form an enclosed packet grill over medium high heat for 20 minutes , then flip over and grill for 10 more minutes
5. Carefully open packet , check for tenderness with a fork
6. If tender , sprinkle the cheese over the vegetables and allow it to melt
7. Transfer to a platter and serve with your main entree

title: raspberry mousse cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180c
2. Brush a 20cm round spring form tin with melted butter
3. Sift flours and cornflour 3 times onto greaseproof paper
4. Beat eggs until thick and pale
5. Add sugar gradually , beating constantly until dissolved and mixture is pale yellow and glossy
6. Transfer mixture to a large mixing bowl
7. Using a metal spoon , fold in dry ingredients quickly and lightly
8. Spread mixture into prepared tin
9. Bake 15 minutes or until sponge is lightly golden and shrinks from the side of tin
10. Leave sponge in tin for 3 minutes before turning onto wire rack to cool
11. To make mousse: process 315g of the raspberries to a smooth texture in blender or processor , pass through a fine sieve
12. Reserve half of the puree for serving
13. Beat egg and sugar together until creamy
14. Add cream cheese , beat until smooth
15. In a separate bowl beat cream until soft peaks form
16. Combine gelatin with water in a small bowl , stand bowl in hot water , stir until gelatin dissolves
17. Using a metal spoon , fold gelatin , half of the puree and reserved whole raspberries into cream cheese mixture , then fold in cream
18. Cover with plastic wrap and put in the refrigerator 10 minutes or until the mixture has thickened , stirring occasionally
19. To assemble: cut cake in half horizontally
20. Place first cake layer on a board
21. Spread cake evenly with mousse
22. Top with remaining cake layer , refrigerate until mousse is set
23. For serving , sift icing sugar over top of the cake
24. Cut cake into wedges , place on individual serving plates and spoon reserved puree around cake

title: mint brownies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Mix together melted butter , sugar , cocoa , vanilla , and baking powder
3. Add an egg , it helps to beat at it with the spatula and break it up some , before you actually stir it in
4. Stir in 1 / 3 c flour
5. Repeat egg and flour process until you have added it all
6. Stir in chopped mints and chocolate chips
7. Mix well
8. Pour into a greased 9 x 13 inch pan and bake for 30 minutes
9. Do not over-bake !
10. It's better to err on the side of slightly under-baked than over-baked with these
11. Cut into 16 to 24 squares , depending on how big you like your brownies
12. For plain brownies , replace andes mints with 1 c pecans and increase chocolate chips to 1 c

title: brussels sprouts and carrots
steps:
1. Pam a skillet
2. Cook the onions and garlic in a skillet over medium heat until softened
3. Add the sprouts , carrot , thyme and water to this and cook until water has evaporated
4. Then add the bell pepper , salt , and pepper , and saute an additional minute

title: lemon buttercream
steps:
1. In a small bowl , cream the shortening and margarine until well combined
2. Add the sugar in 1 / 2 cup additions
3. After each addition add a splash of lemon juice and beat well with a handheld mixer
4. Add vanilla and beat for another 3-5 minutes until smooth , creamy and fluffy

title: cranberry ginger  cider
steps:
1. Put ginger in a pot with the water and bring to a boil
2. Lower heat and simmer 20 minutes
3. Add cranberry juice and heat just to a boil
4. Pour through a fine sieve into a heat-proof pitcher
5. Discard ginger
6. Serve steaming hot in mugs

title: geelrys  yellow rice
steps:
1. Place rice , water , brown sugar , salt , turmeric and cinnamon stick in a pot
2. Boil over high heat 20 minutes
3. Drain excess water
4. Add remaining ingredients and steam rice until soft and fluffy
5. Remove cinnamon stick before serving

title: halibut  grilled  with red currant garlic sauce
steps:
1. Prepare bbq
2. Preheat if using a gas bbq
3. Or prepare charcoal with some mesquite chunks
4. Place jelly , garlic slices , and jalapino if desired , into a microwave safe cup
5. Microwave 30 sec , leave in microwave
6. Rinse and completely dry fish fillets , brush with evoo on both sides
7. Place the fish on your grill
8. It should cook about 5-7 minutes on each side
9. Halibut and orange roughy won't exactly "flake" , but if you can pull the grain apart with a fork , it is done
10. If using cod , it will flake easily when done
11. Place fish on plates , remove your sauce from microwave , remove the garlic slices , and drizzle sauce over and around fish

title: white sauce  cheesy or not  medium sauce
steps:
1. Melt butter over low heat in sauce pan
2. Blend in flour and seasoning over low heat , stirring constantly , until mixture is smooth and bubbly
3. Allow to cook for at least 1 minute to eliminate raw flour flavor
4. Remove from heat , slowly add milk , stirring constantly to make a smooth paste
5. Stir in remaining milk
6. Return to heat , stirring constantly
7. Bring to a boil again and keep stirring until thickened
8. If you want cheesy white sauce , add 1 / 2 cup shredded cheese
9. Cover pan with tight fitting lid to prevent film formation until sauce is to be used
10. Use on creamed and scalloped foods , sauces , gravies and in vegetable dips

title: no kraut open faced reuben
steps:
1. Mix dressing ingredients and set aside
2. Place rye bread on a baking sheet
3. Spread with the very lightest amount of butter or margerine
4. Place sliced corned beef on bread , and top with sliced swiss cheese
5. Spread dressing over the top , stopping about 1 / 2 inch from the edge of the sandwich
6. Broil until cheese melts and dressing bubbles

title: spicy olive spread
steps:
1. Combine cream cheese , mayonnaise , black pepper and tabasco in food processor or by hand
2. When smooth add remaining ingredients
3. Pulse if using processor
4. Do not overprocess !
5. The olives and pecans should still be identifiable
6. Refrigerate till ready to use

title: pizza sauce     spoon lickin  good
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan , saut garlic in oil until it just starts to turn golden
2. Add remaining ingredients
3. Simmer for 10 minutes over medium low heat

title: scrambled eggs with coriander and ginger  ekuri parsri
steps:
1. Break eggs into a deep bowl and mix them lightly with a whisk or fork
2. Add the milk , salt and black pepper , stir until all of the ingredients are well combined
3. Do not overbeat or allow the egg-and-milk mixture to foam or become frothy
4. In a 10 inch skillet , heat the ghee over moderate heat until a drop of water flicked into it splutters instantly
5. Add the ginger and fry for 10 seconds , then add the onions and fry about 1 minute , until they are soft but not brown
6. Pour in the beaten egg mixture and sprinkle the top with the fresh chili
7. Reduce the heat to the lowest possible point and , stirring constantly with the flat of a table fork or a rubber spatula , cook the eggs until they begin to form soft , creamy curds
8. Immediately spread the eggs on a heated serving plate , sprinkle the top with cumin and serve
9. Ekuri is traditionally garnished with slices or wedges of fresh tomato and may be further embellished with sprigs or leaves of coriander
10. It is usually accompanied by plain parathas

title: banana ice cream that really tastes like banana
steps:
1. At least 6 hours or night before making ice cream , peel and cut the bananas into about thirds and freeze
2. Add whipping cream and milk in a pan cook over low heat for 15 minutes until fully heated and almost breaking bubbles
3. Mix the eggs and sugar in a bowl
4. Add 1 c of the hot milk mixture to the egg mixture and mix quickly
5. Add another 1 c of the hot milk mixture and again , mix completely
6. Combine the egg mixture into the pan containing remaining milk mixture
7. Stir thoroughly and simmer for about 3-5 minutes until slightly thickened
8. Remove from heat , stir in vanilla , and cover with saran wrap on the surface and place it in the refrigerator until it is completely chilled
9. Remove bananas from the freezer and using third of the bananas and third of the milk egg mixture into a blender and blend on high for several minutes until frothy
10. Repeat with the remaining bananas and the milk egg mixture
11. Put the mixture into the ice cream machine and follow the machine's instructions
12. I use gelato pro and it takes about 45-50 minutes churning
13. This makes about 2 quart ice cream

title: roasted corn and black bean salad
steps:
1. In a large skillet coated with olive oil , cook the corn kernels on medium high until slightly charred , about 8 to 9 minutes
2. Transfer corn to large bowl and stir in remaining ingredients

title: impossibly easy taco pie
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400f
2. Grease 9 inch pie plate
3. Cook ground beef and onion in skillet over medium heat stirring occasionally until beef is brown
4. Drain
5. Stir in seasoning mix
6. Spoon into pie plate
7. Top with chilies
8. Stir milk eggs and bisquick mix until blended
9. Pour into pie plate
10. Bake about 25 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean
11. Sprinkle with cheese
12. Bake 8 to 10 minutes longer
13. Cool 5 minutes
14. Serve with salsa and sour cream

title: raisin clusters
steps:
1. Line baking sheet with buttered wax paper
2. Set aside
3. Melt chocolate with condensed milk and vanilla in heavy small saucepan over low heat , stirring occasionally
4. Remove from heat
5. Stir in raisins
6. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto prepared baking sheet
7. Refrigerate until firm

title: strawberry and  chocolate pie  no bake      taste of home
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , melt 2 oz chocolate and butter over low heat , stirring constantly
2. Spread or brush over the bottom and up the sides of the pie crust
3. Chill
4. Meanwhile , in a large mixing bowl , beat the cream cheese , sour cream , sugar and vanilla until smooth
5. Spread over chocolate layer
6. Cover and chill for two hours
7. Arrange strawberries over the filling
8. For great presentation , cut off the tops and place the cut end down into the cream cheese mixture and have the little ends poking up
9. Go around the pie in a circle until it is filled in with strawberries
10. Brush the strawberries with the melted jam
11. Then melt the remaining chocolate and drizzle it over the strawberries

title: pan bagna
steps:
1. Blend all vinegrette items in blender , blend ,
2. Adjust seasonings as needed
3. Pull some of the bread out to make a"shell" to hold the fillings
4. Blend the beans and the basil pesto until smooth , spread on both halves of bread
5. Layer artichokes , red peppers , tomatoes , olives and feta if using
6. Drizzle with vinegrette
7. Sprinkle with italian seasonings , parsley and oregano if desired
8. Wrap , place on a plate and weight down to press for a few hours in the fridge
9. Enjoy
10. Btw , you don't have to press the sandwich

title: better than mayonnaise
steps:
1. Process the chickpeas in a mini-chopper or food processor
2. Combine with all other ingredients
3. Taste and adjust the seasonings
4. Cover and put in the fridge for up to a week

title: garden spinach angel hair pasta
steps:
1. Heat olive oil in large kettle or wok over medium heat
2. Add garlic and saut until golden
3. Immediately add anchovies
4. Using wooden spoon , simultaneously stir and mash them until they "dissolve" into the garlic and oil
5. Add capers and cook one minute longer , stirring constantly
6. Immediately add spinach , tossing continuously until it wilts
7. If necessary , add a little wine or water to prevent sticking
8. Reduce heat to low and keep warm
9. Meanwhile , cook pasta in 6-8 quarts of rapidly boiling salted water until al dente
10. Drain and add directly to spinach mixture
11. Toss gently to thoroughly coat the spinach with the pasta
12. Serve straight from the pan , sprinkling parmesan at the table
13. If you're hesitant about the anchovies - relax ! while they're integral to the dish , they do n't make it taste "fishy"

title: bow tie pasta with chicken and vegetables
steps:
1. In a 2 quart saucepan stir together flour , salt , pepper , milk and chicken broth
2. Cook on medium heat , stirring often , until mixture is thick and bubbly
3. Add 1 / 4 cup parmesan cheese
4. Cook and stir 2 minutes more
5. Cook pasta according to package directions
6. After approximately 6 minutes , add vegetables and allow to cook for 3 minutes longer
7. Drain
8. While sauce and pasta are cooking , cook garlic and seasoned chicken in skillet on medium heat for 5-6 minutes
9. Combine chicken and sauce with pasta and veggies
10. Garnish with remaining parmesan cheese

title: tastier than  heck oil and vinegar coleslaw dressing
steps:
1. In food processor or with grater , chop the onion so fine it is almost liquefied
2. Mix in other ingredients with the ground up onion and using a food processor emulsify the dressing
3. Dressing , can , however , simply be mixed using a wire whisk in the traditional way
4. Add to your favorite cole slaw recipe

title: orange bbq chicken with grilled vegetables
steps:
1. Preheat grill to medium heat
2. Mix barbecue sauce , orange zest and juice until well blended
3. Set aside
4. Grill chicken 6 min
5. , turning over after 3 minute brush with barbecue sauce mixture
6. Add vegetables to grill
7. Continue grilling chicken and vegetables 9 to 12 minutes or until chicken is cooked through and vegetables are tender , turning occasionally and brushing chicken with the remaining barbecue sauce mixture and vegetables with the dressing

title: white christmas dream
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients with ice in a shaker
2. Strain into a chilled cocktail glass
3. Option: garnish with nutmeg

title: deviled eggs with bacon
steps:
1. Slice the eggs in half lengthwise and remove the yolks
2. In a mixing bowl mash the yolks with a fork
3. Add the mayonnaise and mustard and keep mashing with the fork until a smooth paste forms
4. Stir in the bacon , green onion , salt and ground black pepper
5. Stuff the filling into the egg white shells
6. Sprinkle the eggs with paprika
7. Cover and chill until serving time

title: crispy rosemary chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f combine coating mix , garlic powder , rosemary and pepper in shaker bag
2. Brush chicken lightly with egg
3. Add one chicken piece to bag and shake until evenly coated
4. Repeat with remaining chicken pieces
5. Place chicken pieces in a foil-lined 15x10x1 baking pan
6. Discard any remaining mixture in shaker bag
7. Bake 40-45 minutes or until chicken is cooked through

title: soft and chewy snickerdoodle cookies
steps:
1. Beat butter and shortening in a large bowl until creamy and smooth
2. Add in eggs one at a time beating after each addition
3. In a separate medium sized bowl combine the flour , cream of tartar , baking soda , sugar and salt
4. Beat 1 / 2 of the dry mixture into the wet mixture
5. Beat the remaining 1 / 2 of the dry mixture into the wet mixture
6. Dough should be workable and not too soft
7. Refrigerate dough uncovered for 30 minutes
8. Preheat oven to 375
9. Combine sugar and cinnamon in a small bowl
10. Roll 1 inch balls of dough into the cinnamon mixture and place 2 inches apart on an ungreased cookie sheet
11. Bake for 10 minutes
12. Remove immediately from the cookie sheet onto a wire rack and let cool for 10 minutes before transporting them

title: hungarian borscht
steps:
1. In a large frying pan , add kraft catalina dressing , beets , carrots , onion , rutabaga and cook on medium-high heat until vegetables are tender , about 15 minutes
2. In a large cooking pot , add beef consomme' , water , cooked vegetables , tomatoes including liquid , potatoes , caraway seeds , red and green shredded cabbage , celery , cauliflower florets , black pepper and bring to boil
3. Reduce heat and simmer until all vegetables are tender , about 10 minutes
4. Add soy sauce and dill weed and simmer for another 3 minutes
5. Adjust seasonings to taste
6. Serve hot with dollops of sour cream or plain yogurt if desired

title: sweet n sour smoothie
steps:
1. Cut the peel and pith off the grapefruit , remove any seeds , and chop coarsely
2. Peel the orange , remove any seeds or interior stringy stuff , and chop coarsely
3. Peel the bananas
4. Throw it all in the blender and puree

title: zesty tomato garlic fish
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees
2. In a 13x9x2-inch baking dish , combine tomatoes , lemon juice , garlic salt , olive oil and pepper
3. Mix well
4. Top with fish fillets in a single layer
5. Spoon some tomato mixture over fish
6. Bake 15 minutes or until sauce is bubbling and fish flakes easily with a fork
7. Garnish with pine nuts

title: chicken pepperoni burgers
steps:
1. In a bowl place the chicken , pepperoni , half the garlic , sage , salt and pepper
2. Mix together and form into 4 equal sized patties
3. In large skillet , over medium heat , fry patties until desired doneness
4. Meanwhile , combine the mayo , lemon zest , herb mixture , the other half of garlic , salt and pepper
5. Place cheese on top of each burger and let melt
6. Divide the mayo dressing among the 4 bun bottoms
7. Place a patty on top , along with the lettuce and tomato , if using
8. Serve

title: baked flounder with lemon  parsley and bread crumbs
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Spray baking dish with nonstick cooking spray
3. Place the fillets , skin-side down , in the baking dish
4. Sprinkle evenly with lemon juice
5. Brush each fillet with 1 teaspoon oil
6. In a small bowl , combine the bread crumbs , cheese and pepper
7. Sprinkle evenly over the fillets
8. Bake for 15 minutes , or until done
9. Sprinkle with minced cilantro and serve

title: cracker barrel chocolate pecan pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. In a medium sized bowl , beat together eggs , add in sugar and mix well
3. Mix in corn syrup , salt , vanilla , and margarine
4. Place pecans and chocolate chips in pie shell
5. Pour mixture over nuts and chips
6. The pecans will rise up to the top when baking
7. Bake for 50 to 60 minutes
8. Chill before serving and between servings

title: spooky calzone snake
steps:
1. Dissolve the sugar in the warm water in the bowl of a stand mixer fitter with a dough hook
2. Sprinkle the yeast over the water , and let stand for 5 minutes until the yeast softens and begins to form a creamy foam
3. Stir in the oil , salt , and 2 cups of flour , and mix on low until the mixture forms a wet dough
4. With the machine running add 1 cup of flour , 1 / 4 cup at a time , and knead until the dough pulls away from the sides of the bowl into a ball
5. Knead for 3 to 5 more minutes , until the dough is smooth and elastic
6. Lightly oil a large bowl , then place the dough in the bowl and turn to coat with oil
7. Cover with a light cloth and let rise in a warm place (80 to 95f ) until doubled in volume , about 1 hour
8. Combine the ricotta , mozzarella , and parmesan cheeses , pepperoni , parsley , italian seasoning , olives , green peppers , and mushrooms in a large bowl , and set aside
9. Preheat oven to 375f
10. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper
11. Punch down the dough , and roll it out into a long , flat strip about 9 inches wide by 30 inches long
12. Spoon the filling mixture down the center of the dough strips , leaving about 1 inch on all sides for sealing
13. Pull edges of the dough together
14. Pinch to seal and form a long , filled roll
15. Place the roll , seam side down , onto the parchment paper in a snakey "s" shape , and tuck the ends underneath to seal
16. Beat the egg in a bowl with 1 tablespoon water , and brush the egg wash over the calzone
17. Bake in preheated oven for 30 to 35 minutes , until the calzone is golden brown
18. Let cool for 5 minutes before cutting into individual slices

title: ultimate butternut squash soup
steps:
1. Lightly brown veggies in butter
2. Add chicken broth to cover the veggies
3. Bring pot to a boil
4. Lower heat , cover , simmer 40 minute
5. Stir in cream cheese , brown sugar
6. This is where i taste , and add salt , pepper , cayenne , and nutmeg
7. Pour into food processor or blender and blend until it reaches the consistency you prefer !

title: oven roasted hot pecans
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients except salt
2. Mix well
3. Spread in a baking sheet
4. Bake at 250f for 30 minutes , stir frequently
5. Drain on paper towels
6. Sprinkle with salt

title: catalina dressing
steps:
1. Put everything in the container of your blender and whiz
2. Or , let the kids put in a big jar and shake
3. Chill at least 2 hours before using
4. You may have to re-shake

title: strawberry daiquiri cake
steps:
1. Bake cake mix per box instructons and let cool
2. Punch holes throughout the cake using a straw and pour the strawberry colada mix throughout the cake
3. Put cake in the refrigerator until it gets cold
4. Once cake is cold or you are ready to serve , spread the strawberries over the top of the cake
5. Spread the cool whip over the strawberries and serve
6. You can substitute frozen strawberries for fresh it you like
7. Fresh strawberries also can be used to add finishing touches to the top of the cake

title: spring asparagus angel hair pasta
steps:
1. Rinse the asparagus and remove the bottom inch of the stem
2. Cut the
3. Cut the remaining piece julienned
4. Set the asparagus aside
5. Bring a large pot of water to a boil , add salt
6. In a large nonstick skillet , saute the garlic , shallots and red pepper flakes in olive oil , until tender but not browned
7. Add the lemon juice and reduce by half
8. Drop the pasta and the asparagus
9. Cook until the pasta is ala dente , about 3 - 4 minutes
10. Drain for a few minutes and add to the pan
11. While the pasta is cooking add the remaining asparagus to the pan with the shallots and saute until they begin to wilt
12. Toss in the chives , the pasta and cook until the remaining water has evaporated
13. Season with salt and freshly ground pepper
14. Remove from heat and add the parmesan cheese
15. Serve immediately

title: authentic pad thai
steps:
1. Soak the dry noodles in lukewarm water while preparing the other ingredients , for 10-15 minutes
2. Julienne tofu and cut into pieces 1 inch long
3. Cut up chinese chives into 1 inch long pieces
4. Set aside a few fresh chives for a garnish
5. Rinse the bean sprouts and save half for serving fresh
6. Mince shallot and garlic together
7. Heat the oil in a wok on high
8. Fry the peanuts until toasted and remove them from the wok
9. Add shallot , garlic and tofu and stir them until they start to brown
10. The noodles should be flexible but not expanded at this point
11. Drain the noodles and add to the wok
12. Stir quickly to keep things from sticking
13. Add tamarind , sugar , fish sauce , chili pepper and preserved turnip
14. Stir
15. The heat should remain high
16. If your wok is not hot enough , you will see a lot of juice in the wok at this point
17. Turn up the heat , if it is the case
18. Make room for the egg by pushing all noodles to the side of the wok
19. Crack the egg onto the wok and scramble it until it is almost all cooked
20. Fold the egg into the noodles
21. Add shrimp and stir for a minute
22. Add bean sprouts , chives
23. Stir a few more times
24. The noodles should be soft and very tangled
25. Pour onto the serving plate and sprinkle with the fried peanuts
26. Serve hot with banana flower , a wedge of lime , raw chinese chives and raw bean sprouts

title: buffalo style chicken nachos
steps:
1. In bowl , toss chicken with red hot sauce and butter
2. Layer chips , chicken mixture and cheese in baking dish
3. Bake nachos at 350f for 5 minutes until cheese is melted
4. Mix sour cream and ranch dressing dollop on nachos
5. Enjoy !

title: chocolate chip bread
steps:
1. Cream together first three ingredients
2. Sift together flour , soda and salt
3. Gradually add to cream mixture
4. Fold in chips
5. Put in greased loaf pan
6. Bake 350 for 1 hour

title: corn dish
steps: 1. Put all ingredients together bake 325 until spaghetti well done

title: vegan maple cinnamon roasted cashews
steps:
1. First , roast the cashews on a cookie tray at 350 degrees fahrenheit , for about 15 minutes , or until golden brown
2. Test one of the nuts if you're not sure
3. While you're roasting the nuts , mix the maple syrup , cinnamon , margarine , and salt in a microwave-safe cup or bowl
4. Microwave the mixture until it boils , which should be around a minute
5. When the nuts are ready , take them out of the oven and pour them into the bowl containing the syrup mixture
6. Mix them around until they're moderately coated with syrup
7. At this point , you'll need to spray the tray with the non-stick spray
8. Pour the nuts back onto the tray
9. It's a good idea to spoon them back on the tray , as there may be leftover syrup in the bottom of the bowl , and you don't want that to end up in a pile on the tray
10. Continue roasting the nuts for 15 minutes more
11. You can turn the temperature down to 300 or 325 degrees at this point
12. Be sure to check them every once and a while- i use a toaster oven for this , and your cooking time may vary
13. Remove the tray from the oven and place on a cooling rack
14. Wait for the nuts to cool and the syrup to harden , and then remove them with a spatula

title: basic cooked lima beans
steps:
1. Soak lima beans according to package directions
2. Place beans , ham hock and onion in pot
3. Cook beans according to package directions
4. Taste a bean to make sure cooked through
5. Cook until tender
6. You can also add a small chopped potatoe to the pot when you cook beans
7. This will help thicken liquid and all you need is a pan of cornbread and a salad with this

title: macaroni and cauliflower cheese bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 200c / 390f cook pasta in large saucepan of boiling salted water following packet directions
2. Add cauliflower half way through cooking time
3. Drain well and return to pan
4. In separate pan , melt butter on medium heat , saute onion 3-4 minutes until tender , add flour and cook stirring for one minute
5. Remove pan from heat and gradually add milk and thyme and whisk until combined
6. Return pan to medium heat , stirring constantly until mixture boils and thickens
7. Remove from heat , stir in 1 1 / 2 cups of parmesan and the mustard
8. Season to taste
9. Add cheese sauce to pasta mixture , stirring to combine
10. Transfer to shallow oven proof dish
11. Top with bacon , bocconcini and remaining parmesan
12. Bake for 25-30 minutes

title: ale braised corned beef with horseradish gravy  swedish style
steps:
1. Heat nonstick dutch oven over high heat
2. Sprinkle meat with pepper and brown in oil on all sides , about 6 minutes
3. Remove meat & set aside
4. Lower heat to medium and add diced onion , diced carrots , celery , brown sugar and thyme to pot drippings
5. Cook stirring until soft , about 7 minutes
6. Lower heat , add ale and mustard and cook 1-2 minutes , scraping up browned bits from bottom of pot
7. Return meat to pot , cover and cook over low heat about 3-1 / 2 hours
8. Keep heat just below simmer
9. Don't let it boil
10. Add cabbage , remaining sliced carrots , quartered onions and continue cooking covered until vegetables and meat are tender , about 40 minutes
11. Remove meat and let stand 15 minutes before slicing
12. Remove cabbage and large vegetable pieces with a slotted spoon and place on serving platter and keep warm
13. Reserve pan juices for gravy
14. Horseradish gravy:
15. Strain and skim fat from pan juices
16. In pot over medium heat , combine 1 cup strained pan juices with milk , horseradish , mustard , thyme and pepper
17. Dissolve cornstarch in 2 t
18. Reserved horseradish liquid
19. Stir cornstarch slurry into pan mixture and cook , stirring until mixture boils and thickens slightly , 2-3 minutes
20. Remove from heat and stir in chopped parsley or chives
21. Serve gravy with sliced meat and vegetables
22. Kiss me , i'm swedish & happy "svenskarnas dag"

title: cheesy tuna casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Cook noodles and drain
3. Mix sour cream and cottage cheese into cooked noodles
4. Stir in tuna and chopped onion
5. Season with salt and pepper
6. Pour into greased casserole and top with cheese
7. Cook at 350 degrees for 30 minutes

title: tender stem broccoli with sesame
steps:
1. Steam the broccoli until tender
2. Pound or blend together the garlic , ginger and coriander
3. Heat the oil into the pan and add the paste sizzle for 1 minute
4. Add the broccoli
5. Toss to coat and sprinkle over the sesame seeds
6. Stir in the basil and coriander leaves and serve

title: bernard clayton s potato bread  adaptation
steps:
1. Boil the peeled potatoes in the 2 cups of water in a saucepan until fork tender
2. Place 3 cups of flour with yeast , salt , and sugar into a mixing bowl and blend
3. After potatoes are tender , reserve liquid , and rice the potatoes
4. Add riced potatoes back into pan with the 1 3 / 4 cups reserved liquid , and add the butter , heating until butter is just melted
5. Pour the butter / potato mixture into the mixing bowl with the flour mixture
6. Mix with paddle until blended and then change to dough hook to incorporate more flour by 1 / 4 cupfulls
7. Knead with the dough hook for 10 minutes
8. Place dough into a large greased bowl and cover with plastic wrap allowing to double in volume
9. About 1 hour
10. When fully risen , punch dough down and move to a floured surface
11. Slice into 2 equal pieces
12. Flatten one piece into a long oval , fold in half lengthwise , pinch that seam , fold under the outer ends , and place into a loaf pan
13. With other piece , cut into 3 equal parts , rolling each piece into a long cylindrical piece with your hands
14. Braid these 3 pieces together , pinching and tucking in ends and place on a greased cookie sheet
15. Cover both loaves with waxed paper and allow to rise for an additional 40 minutes
16. During the last 20 minutes of rising time , preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit
17. When fully risen , place both loaves in preheated oven and bake for 15 minutes
18. After those 15 minutes , lower heat to 350 degrees fahrenheit and continue baking for an additional 25-30 minutes until slightly golden and hollow sounding when tapped
19. Remove from oven and immediately and carefully place on racks to cool

title: blue cheese  port and walnut spread
steps:
1. In a food processor , blend together all ingredients except walnuts , until smooth
2. Taste and adjust quantity of port you want to use in your spread
3. I usually use the 1 / 3 cup
4. Stir in walnuts
5. Transfer to crocks or ramekins
6. Keeps , covered and chilled , for 3 weeks

title: nova scotia fish cakes
steps:
1. In a large bowl mix together flaked fish , mashed potatoes , onion , 1 / 4 cup flour , eggs and parsley
2. Season to taste with salt and pepper
3. Form the mixture into 12 small patties
4. Place the remaining 1 / 2 cup flour in a shallow dish and season with salt and pepper
5. Stir to mix well
6. Heat about a 1 / 4-inch of vegetable oil in a heavy-bottomed skillet over moderately high heat
7. Dredge the fish patties in the seasoned flour , shaking off any excess and add them to the hot oil
8. Cook untill browned on both sides
9. About 8 minutes total , turning once
10. As the patties are cooked , transfer them to paper towels to drain
11. Serve hot

title: sheila s best salmon
steps:
1. Pour butter in a 9"x13" pan
2. Arrange onion evenly in bottom of dish
3. Place salmon in a single layer on top of onions
4. Combine mayo , cheese , worc
5. Sauce , paprika and salt
6. Spread over top of salmon
7. Sprinkle with oregano and parsley
8. Bake at 350 degrees for app
9. 35 minute depending on thickness of salmon

title: vegetable beef soup deluxe
steps:
1. Cut beef into cubes , add water
2. Peel onions , slice and add to water
3. Boil until done
4. Drain water , add tomatoes , can of juice , all the veggies and meat cubes
5. Simmer until done
6. Season to taste

title: baby baked potatoes with bleu cheese topping
steps:
1. Wash and dry potatoes
2. Pour oil into bowl , add potatoes
3. Toss to coat
4. Dip each potato in salt to coat lightly
5. Place potatoes on baking sheet
6. Bake at 350 for 50 minutes or until tender
7. Combine sour cream and bleu cheese
8. Cut a cross in top of each potato
9. Open
10. Top each potatoe with a spoonful of cheese ,
11. Sprinkle with chives

title: orange apricot flavored butter
steps: 1. Place all ingredients in a small bowl and mix to combine

title: cheap beef stroganoff
steps:
1. Cook the noodles following the package directions and drain
2. Saute the onions slightly , add hamburger and cook thoroughly
3. Drain the hamburger
4. Add the soup , garlic powder , salt and pepper and heat thoroughly on low heat
5. Fold in sour cream and optional peas and heat for another 5 minutes
6. Serve over pasta noodles and enjoy !

title: citrus rubbed skirt steak
steps:
1. Combine first 5 ingredients in a bowl , stirring well
2. Lightly coat steak with cooking spray
3. Rub rind mixture evenly over steak
4. Heat a grill pan over medium-high heat
5. Coat pan with cooking spray
6. Add steak to pan
7. Cook 5 minutes on each side or until desired degree of doneness
8. Let stand for 5 minutes
9. Cut steak diagonally across grain into thin slices

title: totally easy totally yummy jeera rice and  daal fry
steps:
1. Wash toor daal in 4 changes of water , then set to cook
2. Put enough water in the toor daal to be about 1 1 / 2 inches above the daal
3. If you don't have a pressure cooker , it should take somewhere around 45 minutes for the daal to become soft
4. Set the rice to cook at the same time
5. The rice will cook a little faster and it will be perfect timing for you to add the spices to the rice and have it all prepared as the daal is becoming ready to have the spices added to it
6. The ratio of water to rice is two to one
7. Add the salt to the water before cooking as it will be difficult to mix in later
8. The water should taste nice and salty
9. When the rice is almost done , take half of the ghee or butter in a large saut pan
10. Add the cumin seeds , cilantro leaves and chopped green chillies
11. Saut for about 3 minutes on med heat , then add the cooked rice and mix
12. Add the rest of the ghee or butter to the rice and mix until consistent
13. Set aside and cover to keep warm
14. Wash out the saut pan and begin the spices for the daal by adding the oil , cumin , finely chopped onion and green chillies
15. Saut until the onions are transparent
16. Add diced tomatoes and saut for 2 more minutes
17. Check the daal to make sure it is soft , then mash with a potato masher until you have a porridge-like consistency
18. If you need to retrieve water from the pan , then do it beforehand
19. Just remember , you can always put the water back in if there isn't enough , but you can't take it out once the lentils are mashed
20. After the daal is mashed add the saut mixture
21. Add red chili powder for more heat if necessary
22. Add garam masala , salt and sugar
23. Stir over heat for 2 minute and it is ready
24. Serve over jeera rice with papad and mango pickle

title: cuban pan fried steak  bistec de palomilla
steps:
1. Cut steaks into six equal portions
2. Season steaks with garlic , lime juice , salt , and pepper
3. Allow to marinate at least 1 hour , refrigerated
4. Remove the steaks from the marinade and pat dry
5. Reserve marinade
6. In a large skillet , heat the oil over medium heat until very hot , and brown each steak for 2 to 3 minutes on each side
7. Transfer the steaks to a serving platter and keep warm
8. Add the reserved marinade and onion to the pan and cook until the onion is slightly wilted , 3 to 4 minutes
9. Garnish the steaks with the onion and parsley and serve immediately

title: tropical fruit salad strata
steps:
1. In a large salad bowl place half of the lettuce
2. Layer fruits atop lettuce
3. Top with remaining lettuce
4. Spread yogurt over top
5. Sprinkle with swiss cheese
6. Cover and chill 2-3 hours
7. Toss gently to serve

title: apple and spice porridge
steps:
1. Place the apple , oats , cinnamon , mixed spice , milk and 2 cups of water in a large microwave-proof dish
2. Cook on high for 8 minutes , stirring every minute , until thick
3. Set aside for 5 minutes
4. Serve drizzled with the honey and slivered almonds

title: blueberry crunch cobbler
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees
2. In a large mixing bowl combine all the crust ingredients
3. Beat at medium speed on mixer , scraping bowl often , until crumbly
4. Press 2 cups of the crumb mixture on bottom of ungreased 13x9 inch baking pan
5. Place blueberries over the crumb crust
6. In 2-qt saucepan combine remaining filling ingredients except vanilla
7. Cook over medium heat , stirring the mixture occasionally , until it thickens and comes to a full boil
8. Continue boiling for 1 minute
9. Mix in vanilla
10. Pour over blueberries
11. Sprinkle with the remaining crumb mixture
12. Bake for 50 to 60 minutes or until lightly browned

title: rainbow summer rolls with peanut sauce
steps:
1. For peanut sauce , chop peanuts into tiny bits and mix with vinegar , honey and salt
2. Slice and chop all the vegetables into thin pieces
3. Dip rice paper into warm water quickly then place on a hard surface
4. Sprinkle white sesame seeds on top of the rice paper
5. Place vegetables on the middle of the rice paper
6. For a better presentation , arrange it so the thai basil and micro shiso leaves are layer one , then place the thinly sliced beets and radishes , add avocado , and stack the carrots last
7. Roll the rice paper into a snug spring roll shape
8. Slice in half and serve with peanut sauce

title: lime salad
steps:
1. Dissolve jello in water
2. In a mixing bowl , beat cream cheese until fluffy
3. Add jello mixture
4. Beat until smooth
5. Stir in vanilla , fruit , soda , and pecans
6. Chill until mixture mounds slightly when dropped from a spoon
7. Fold in three-fourths of the cool whip
8. Pour into a 13x9 inch pan
9. Chill for 4 hours or until firm
10. Cut into squares
11. Garnish with remaining cool whip

title: cinnamon sugar snack mix
steps:
1. In a very large bowl , combine the cereal and pretzels
2. Combine sugar and cinnamon in a small bowl
3. Drizzle the cereal mixture with butter
4. Toss
5. Sprinkle with cinnamon sugar mixture
6. Toss well
7. Put in a large roasting pan and bake at 250 degrees for 1 hour , stirring every 15 minutes
8. Remove from oven , stir in dried fruits
9. Cool and store in an airtight container

title: how to toast pecans
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Lightly spritz baking sheet with cooking spray
3. To toast pecans , put them on a baking sheet and toast them just until they become aromatic , about 5 minutes
4. You have to watch them carefully as they are easily scorched

title: buckwheat yogurt banana bread  guilt free
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. In a bowl , cream the applesauce and the margarine with the sugar
3. Add eggs , one at a time , mixing between each addition
4. Add bananas
5. In another bowl , sift flours with baking soda , baking powder , and salt
6. Add to previous preparation , alternating with the yogurt
7. Stir just to to mix
8. Pour into a greased 9 x 13 cake pan and bake 40 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean
9. If you have a stand mixer , set it on a high speed and let it run while you do the next step

title: so easy fall off the bone ribs
steps:
1. Place the ribs in a large pot
2. Cover with water , the add in the powdered meat tenderizer and whole onion
3. Cover and bring to a boil
4. Reduce heat and simmer for 40 minutes
5. Prepare a baking dish or a medium size roasting pan
6. In a bowl mix together chopped onion , garlic bbq sauce , ketchup , mustard , honey , brown sugar and black pepper or cayenne
7. Place the ribs into the baking dish
8. Pour the sauce over the ribs
9. Bake uncovered in a 425 degree oven for about 30-35 minutes , or until the ribs are desired tenderness

title: fresh strawberry frosting
steps:
1. In mixer , combine butter , sugar and vanilla
2. Add strawberries , one at a time , until you reach the desired consistency
3. I wouldn't use frozen strawberries for this recipe
4. For a smaller cake , the zaar conversion isn't quite right
5. Here is what i do:
6. 10x13 or two layer cake: 2 cups powdered sugar to just under 1 / 4 c butter
7. 9x9 or one layer cake: 1 cup powdered sugar to just under 2 t butter

title: marshmallows  french laundry
steps:
1. In a large mixing bowl , sprinkle gelatin over 1 / 2 cup cold water
2. Soak 10 minutes
3. Meanwhile: combine sugar , corn syrup , 1 / 4 cup water in a small saucepan
4. Bring to a boil
5. Boil hard for 1 minute
6. Pour the boiling syrup into gelatin and mix at high speed
7. Add the salt and beat for about 10 - 12 minutes
8. Add the vanilla and incorporate into mixture
9. Scrape into a 9 x 9 inch pan lined with oiled plastic wrap and spread evenly
10. Don't skip the plastic wrap step or the marshmallow mixture will stick and you'll have a very delicious mess !
11. After pouring marshmallow mixture into pan , take another piece of plastic wrap lightly oiled on the side which you will be placing on top of the marshmallow mixture and lightly press marshmallow mixture till flat and even into the pan
12. Let marshmallows sit up for about 2 hours
13. Remove from pan , dredge whole slab with confectioners sugar and cut into squares
14. Each time you cut or slice you will need to keep using the confectioners sugar and dredging each piece so they will not stick to each other and your knife
15. Enjoy !

title: quickie strawberry jello sundaes
steps:
1. Divide the ice cream into dishes , depending on how many you want to serve
2. Dissolve jello in boiling water in a bowl and stir until dissolved
3. Pour a little hot jello mix over each dish of ice cream
4. The sauce thickens as it touches the cold ice cream

title: chili relleno bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. In a large skillet , crumble together the beef and sausage
3. Cook over medium heat , stirring until meat is browned
4. Add onion and garlic , cook until onion is soft
5. Drain
6. Line a 9 x 9 x 2 inch greased baking dish with half of the chilies , top with 1 1 / 2 cups of the cheese
7. Add the meat mixture and top with remaining chilies , set aside
8. Beat together eggs and flour until smooth , add milk , salt and hot pepper sauce
9. Blend well
10. Pour egg mixture over casserole
11. Bake , uncovered , for 40 minutes or until knife inserted off center comes out clean
12. Sprinkle with remaining cheese on top
13. Let stand 5 minutes before serving

title: taco bell style green sauce
steps:
1. Husk tomatillos and cut in half
2. Stem and half peppers
3. Boil tomatillos and peppers in chicken broth for 10 minutes
4. Strain , reserving broth
5. Combine tomatillos , peppers and remaining ingredients , except for the oil , in a blender and mix until almost smooth
6. Heat oil in frying pan until very hot
7. Carefully add the tomatillo mixture and cook for 5 minutes , stirring constantly until dark and thick
8. Add reserved broth to mixture and bring to a boil
9. Reduce heat and cook until thickened , about 10 minutes , stirring occasionally
10. Chill

title: vegetable salad tea sandwiches
steps:
1. Chop cucumer and scallions and transfer to bowl
2. Half and seed peppers , then chop and add to cucumber / scallion mixture
3. Add mayonnaise , creme fraiche , parsley , salt and pepper to filling and mix well to combine
4. Spread bread with butter and then divide filling between 4 of the slices of bread , adding watercress , top with remiaing bread
5. Cut sandwiches into triangles

title: crock pot cream cheese chicken
steps:
1. Brush chicken with butter and layer in crock pot with dry italian seasoning mix sprinkled on each layer
2. Cover and cook on low for 6-7 hours
3. About 45 minutes before done , brown the onion in the chicken broth and then add the cream cheese , soup , salt& pepper and remaining chicken broth to the saucepan
4. Add the minced garlic and mushrooms , and stir all ingredients until smooth
5. Pour sauce mixture over chicken in crockpot and cook an additional 30-45 minutes
6. Remove chicken to platter and stir sauce before putting in gravy bowl or pouring over chicken

title: veronica s chili
steps:
1. Chop onions into 1 / 2" dice
2. Mince the garlic
3. Heat oil in a large , heavy non-aluminum pot over medium-high heat until hot but not smoking
4. Saute the chopped onions for about 3 minutes , stirring until the onions are translucent
5. Add the garlic and saute for about 2 minutes , being careful not to scorch the garlic
6. In a small bowl , mix together the sugar , chili powder , cayenne , cumin , oregano , salt , pepper , and cornflour , set aside
7. To your pot , add the ground beef and sear , breaking up any large chunks of beef with a spoon
8. Sprinkle the seasoning mixture over the meat , reduce the heat to medium , and stir to help release flavor of the spices
9. Add the chopped chilies , kidney beans , canned tomatoes with their liquid , tomato paste , and beef broth
10. Stir well , breaking up tomatoes with a spoon , or with your hands
11. If breaking them up with your hands , be sure to immerse the tomatoes into the juice when breaking them up so you won't squirt yourself with the tomato juice
12. Bring the chili to a boil , raising the heat if necessary
13. Reduce the heat to low and simmer the chili for 2 - 3 hours , stirring every so often , until reduced to the consistency of your choice
14. Serve with grated cheese , diced red onions , sour cream , and chopped green chilies to top , if desired
15. Serve with nachos if desired to scoop up the chili
16. Yum

title: vanilla coffee
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together and place in cellaphane bags
2. When ready to use , put 2-4 t
3. In a mug of boiling water and enjoy

title: masquerade cocktail
steps:
1. Half fill a cocktail shaker full of ice , add the vodka , schnapps & juices
2. Shake vigorously & strain into a chilled martini glass

title: mozzarella bites
steps:
1. Whisk vinegar in a small bowl with oil , pepper and salt
2. Cut cheese in twenty-four 1 / 2 inch cubes
3. To assemble , slide a tomato onto a skewer , followed by a basil leaf , folded in half , and a cheese cube
4. Repeat with remaining skewers
5. Arrange on a serving platter and brush or sprinkle with vinaigrette
6. Cover and let sit at room temperature up to 2 hours before serving

title: pork chops in onion sauce  schweinekotelett in zwiebelsosse
steps:
1. Season chops with salt and pepper
2. Coat with flour
3. Heat oil , add chops , fry each side 3 minutes
4. Add onions , cook 5 minutes turning chops once
5. Pour in beer and broth
6. Cover and simmer 15 minutes
7. Remove chops to a 350 degree preheated oven
8. Season sauce to taste
9. Blend cornstarch with small amount of water , stir into sauce , cook until thick and bubbly
10. Pour over pork chops and serve

title: lemon basil chicken
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a pan on medium heat
2. Add minced garlic and onion and sautee
3. Slice the chicken into strips , about 1 / 2 inch across
4. Once the onion is soft , add the pepper and basil
5. Squeeze the lemon juice from the end pieces of the lemon into the onion mixture , then add the chicken strips
6. Allow chicken to brown and then flip them over
7. Add the lemon slices on top while the other side cooks
8. Cook until chicken is brown on all sides and there is no pink left inside

title: cranberry orange quick bread  five roses flour   1967
steps:
1. Stir flour , sugar , baking powder , baking soda and salt together
2. Cut in butter until mixture resembles coarse cornmeal
3. Combine orange juice and grated rind with well beaten eggs
4. Pour all at once into dry ingredients , mixing just enough to dampen
5. Dust chopped cranberries and cherries with a tablespoon of flour , carefully fold into batter spoon into a well buttered 1 1 / 2 quart casserole
6. Sprinkle a few floured whole cranberries over top of batter
7. Bake in a moderate oven , 350 degrees about 1 hour or until toothpick inserted in centre comes out clean
8. Cool in casserole 10 minutes , then remove
9. Store overnight for easy slicing
10. Frost with confectioner's frosting ,
11. Also delicious sliced with butter or toasted under broiler , spread with butter and sprinkled with cheddar

title: janet s vegetable soup
steps:
1. Heat olive oil in a large pot or dutch oven
2. Add chopped onions , sautee until soft
3. Add broth and equal amount of water
4. Add squished canned tomatoes and their juice
5. Add carrots , potatoes , cabbage , and bring to a simmer
6. After these veggies have had time to cook , add zucchini , string beans , mushrooms , garlic , and drained rinsed beans
7. Simmer until all veggies are tender
8. Salt and pepper to taste

title: romanian baked white fish
steps:
1. To poach to fish , fill a large sauce pan with plenty of water with plenty of salt
2. Drop all the chopped carrots , parsley , 1 / 3 celery root , 1 green pepper into the water
3. Cook the vegetables ingredients for about 15 minutes , and then add fish to the water
4. Continue poaching the fish until veggies are done , and the carrot is very soft
5. Keep about 1 cup of the cooking water , and allow the vegetables to cool
6. Remove the fish with a slotted spoon and place in a large pan
7. Baste with lemon juice
8. Remove the cooked veggies , chop , and sprinkle over the fish
9. Prepare mushroom sauce: in a large skillet over medium heat , melt butter , and cook the mushrooms until slightly cooked , add mushroom soup powder while stirring
10. Gradually add the liquids while whisking constantly , and cook until slightly thickened
11. While stirring add the grated cheese , and the sour cream
12. Remove from heat and add the dill
13. Pour the sauce evenly over the fish
14. Bake in oven at 350 until cheese is melted , and slightly browned , about 20 minutes

title: white knight rub
steps:
1. Combine in a bowl and mix well
2. Sprinkle on whatever you want to grill and allow to dry marinate 4 hours or overnight
3. Store unused portion in airtight container

title: my favorite son in law s favorite coconut cream pie
steps:
1. Heat the 1 1 / 2 cups of milk in a saucepan on low-medium heat until hot , but do not let it come to a boil
2. In a small bowl , blend together the sugar , flour , cornstarch , salt , and the 1 / 4 cup cold milk
3. Add to the hot milk in the saucepan , stirring constantly
4. Cook over low heat until thickened
5. Add some of the hot mixture to the 3 beaten egg yolks in a small bowl
6. Stir well to blend and then add to the saucepan , stirring constantly
7. Cook over low heat for a minute or two longer
8. Remove from the stove and stir in the vanilla , butter , almond extract and coconut
9. Let cool
10. Pour into the pie crust
11. Top with the cool whip
12. Use a spoon to make a pretty shape
13. Keep refrigerated until serving

title: ungamabunga surf   turf medley
steps:
1. Prepare basmati rice according to package directions
2. Bring a large pot of water to boil , add shrimp to boiling water and boil for 2 to 3 minutes or until shrimp turn pink
3. Stir fry the flank steak in the olive oil with garlic , mushrooms , onion and chili peppers until done
4. Add the shrimp and tomatoes and warm through
5. Add the balsamic vinegar , salt and pepper
6. Serve over the basmati rice

title: strawberries with cheesecake cream
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 f
2. Place vanilla wafers in blender container
3. Process until finely crushed
4. In small bowl , combine crumbs and butter
5. Mix well
6. Spread on ungreased cookie sheet
7. Bake at 350 f
8. For about 5 minutes or until golden brown
9. In large bowl , combine all remaining ingredients except strawberries
10. Beat until smooth
11. To serve , divide strawberries into large wine glasses or individual dessert dishes
12. Top each with about 1 / 4 cup cream cheese mixture
13. Sprinkle each with 2 tbsp crumbs

title: my favorite spinach salad
steps:
1. Mix first 4 ingredients together in a large bowl
2. To prepare dressing , warm wine vinegar slightly
3. Add sugar and stir to dissolve
4. If you don't warm the vinegar , you will have trouble getting the sugar to dissolve
5. Allow to cool
6. Add onion , paprika and salt
7. Stir well
8. Add olive oil and blend
9. I prefer to put it in a bottle and shake it
10. Pour over salad and enjoy !

title: skillet macaroni and beef
steps:
1. Cook beef in large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat until no longer pink , about 7 minutes
2. Drain beef , leaving 2 tablespoons fat in skillet , and reserve
3. Add onion , red pepper , and garlic to fat in skillet and cook , covered , until softened , about 3 minutes
4. Add macaroni , tomato sauce , broth , oregano , and reserved beef to skillet and bring to boil
5. Cover , reduce heat to low , and simmer , stirring occasionally , until pasta is tender , 8 to 10 minutes
6. Season with salt and pepper
7. Sprinkle with cheese
8. Serve

title: english toffee candy
steps:
1. Heat butter , sugar and water in a 3 quart sauce-pan to a rolling boil
2. When mix reaches 305 degrees pour onto a greased large cookie sheet
3. Sprinkle chocolate chips over the candy
4. As chocolate melts spread with a butter knife
5. Spread nuts evenly over the pan , shaking lightly until all nuts stick
6. Cool until hard
7. Break into pieces
8. Enjoy

title: the road burger
steps:
1. Form a hamburger patty as normal and began frying as normal , do not add salt or pepper to the meat
2. While the patty is frying , peel the russet potato and grate
3. With your hand gather up the grated potato and squeeze as much liquid out as humanly possible
4. Salt and pepper grated potato to taste while still raw
5. When the hamburger patty is fully cooked flip over and quickly place one slice of cheese on top of patty and half of the grated potatoes
6. Flip patty with cheese and grated potato back over to the frying surface
7. It takes practice , any lose potato should be scraped back against the side of the patty
8. Again quickly add the other slice of cheese and remainder of grated potato to the new side of the patty
9. Scrape any lose potato against the side of the patty
10. Allow the potatoes underneath the first side to cook to desired doneness , they are perfect when the cheese almost melts through the potatoes
11. Flip patty once more , scraping any loose potato back to the burger tightly
12. Cook this side to desired doneness , again its perfect when the potatoes are not over cooked
13. The burger should now be completely encased with the potato and cheese
14. Remove and place on warm plate and high shake salt over the burger and plate for sopping
15. Enjoy

title: rib eye roast and oven browned vegetables with easy savory sauce
steps:
1. Combine rosemary , garlic , dry mustard , salt , and pepper
2. Rub 1 / 2 of the mixture evenly over surface of beef roast
3. Add oil to the remaining herb mixture
4. Toss with the vegetables to coat evenly
5. Place roast , fat side up , on rack in shallow roasting pan
6. Insert meat thermometer in center of thickest part of roast
7. Arrange coated vegetables around roast
8. Do not add water and do not cover
9. Roast at 350 to desired degree of doneness
10. Cook vegetables 1 to 1 1 / 2 hours or until tender
11. Meanwhile prepare sauce
12. Combine dry mustard and water in a small saucepan , stirring to dissolve mustard
13. Stir in brown gravy and currant jelly
14. Cook over medium heat about 5 minute or until bubbly and jelly is melted , stirring occasionally
15. This recipe provides 8 servings of vegetables athough a boneless rib eye roast will yield three 3 ounce servings of cooked meat so increase vegetables if serving more than eight

title: broccoli elegant
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f grease a 13x9 inch baking dish
2. Combine water and 3 tablespoons butter in a large saucepan
3. Bring to a boil
4. Remove from heat
5. Stir in stuffing mix and let stand 5 minutes
6. Spoon stuffing around the edge of baking dish , leaving a well in the center
7. Arrange broccoli spears in well
8. Melt remaining 2 tablespoons butter in a saucepan over medium-low heat
9. Add flour , stirring until smooth
10. Cook for 1 minute , stirring constantly
11. Add bouillon
12. Add milk gradually , stirring constantly
13. Whisk in cream cheese and salt , mixing until smooth
14. Stir in onion
15. Pour sauce over broccoli
16. Sprinkle with cheddar and paprika
17. Cover with foil and bake 35 minutes
18. Remove foil and bake 10 minutes longer

title: angel hair pasta with asian style cod   edamame
steps:
1. Heat a stockpot with water and cook pasta as directed
2. While pasta is cooking , cut fish or chicken in 1 inch cubes
3. Beat eggs and water together
4. Pour in a flat bottom dish
5. Mix paprika with flour
6. Pour in flat bottom dish
7. Dip the fish or chicken in the egg mixture , then in seasoned flour
8. Heat the olive oil in large frying pan , saute the fish or chicken until brown on all sides
9. Place on paper towels
10. About 5 minutes
11. While pasta and fish or chicken are cooking , mix hot water chicken base or chicken broth , garlic , rice vinegar , soy sauce together
12. Put in a microwave steamer dish or microwave dish with cover
13. Add mushrooms and edamame
14. Stir
15. Cook 70% power for 10 minutes
16. Set aside
17. Do not uncover
18. Drain pasta
19. Keep warm with towel
20. To serve: place pasta in large serving pasta dish around the edge
21. Put fried fish chunks or chicken chunks in the middle and the steamed sauce veggies over the fish or chicken
22. Sprinkle pimento slices on top if desired
23. Serve hot

title: shrimp  green bean and feta pasta salad
steps:
1. Have ready a large bowl of ice water
2. In pot of boiling salted water , cook green beans until they turn bright green and start to soften
3. Transfer beans to ice water immediately
4. When cool , drain them and pat them dry with a clean towel
5. Meanwhile , prepare pasta according to package directions
6. Drain pasta and rinse with cold water until pasta is completely cool and drain again until free of excess water
7. Set aside
8. In large bowl , combine cooked green beans , pasta , shrimp , dill to taste , vinegar , lemon juice , olive oil , feta cheese , salt and pepper to taste
9. Serve immediately , or cover tightly and refrigerate up to 2 days

title: stroopwafels
steps:
1. Preheat a pizzelle iron
2. To make waffles: dissolve the yeast in the warm water
3. Cut butter into the flour
4. Mix in the sugar , cinnamon , eggs and yeast mixture
5. Mix well and set aside to rise for 30 to 60 minutes
6. Roll dough into 12 small balls
7. Squeeze each ball into the preheated pizzelle iron and bake for about 30 seconds
8. Cut the waffles into two thin waffles and spread with filling
9. To make filling: in a saucepan boil the brown sugar , the remaining one cup of the butter , cinnamon , and dark corn syrup until it reaches the soft ball stage , stirring constantly
10. To assemble: cut each waffle into 2 thin waffles and spread with filling
11. Repeat this process until all the filling is used
12. If using store bought , simply spread about 1 tablespoon of filling on one waffle cookie , let it cool about 1 minute , and squeeze a second cookie on top
13. Makes 12 servings
14. Best if eaten after they've cooled , less messy that way !

title: bruschetta brie pasta
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together and let stand for 2 hours
2. Pour over hot pasta and toss to coat
3. Enjoy !

title: creamy mexican dip
steps:
1. Mix everything together well , except the avocado
2. Then fold in the avocado gently
3. Enjoy this right away or cover and refrigerate
4. This is great with tortilla chips

title: pasta and zucchini
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to package directions
2. Place zucchini in colander , and drain pasta over zucchini
3. Toss with other ingredients and top with parsley

title: mexican scramble  diabetic
steps:
1. In a large skillet over medium heat , brown and drain ground chuck
2. Add onion , green pepper , corn , tomatoes and green chilies , tomato sauce , salt , pepper , and chili powder
3. Mix well
4. Cook uncovered over medium heat for 15 minutes
5. Stir periodically
6. Add macaroni and cornstarch dissolved in water
7. Stir well
8. Continue cooking and stirring over medium heat until mixture thickens , about 2 to 3 minutes
9. Serving size: 1 cup
10. Exchanges per serving: 3 lean meat , 1 1 / 2 starch , 1 vegetable , 1 / 2 fat
11. Nutrition facts: calories 329
12. Calories from fat 117
13. Total fat 13g
14. Saturated fat 5g
15. Cholesterol 75mg
16. Sodium 548mg
17. Carbohydrate 27g
18. Dietary fiber 3g
19. Sugars 5g
20. Protein 26g

title: cream of celeriac soup
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , melt butter over low hear
2. Cook leeks , covered in this for 5 minutes
3. Add celeriac and cook , covered for 5 minutes
4. Stir in stock and bring to a boil
5. Reduce heat to low
6. Cook , covered for about 35 minutes , or until celeriac is very tender
7. Transfer to a blender or food processor and puree in batches
8. Pass through a food mill or sieve for an even smoother soup
9. Return to saucepan , stir in cream and maple syrup
10. Season to taste with salt and pepper
11. Gently heat through
12. Serve in warmed soup bowls
13. Garnish with chives or spring onions

title: sweet sour kraut and chops
steps:
1. In a 12x7 inch baking dish combine potato slices and onion
2. Add 1 / 4 cup water
3. Bake , covered , at 350 till nearly tender , about 45 minutes
4. Meanwhile , in a skillet brown pork chops on both sides in hot oil
5. In bowl combine sauerkraut , undrained pineapple , and brown sugar
6. Spoon over potato mixture
7. Place chops atop
8. Season with salt and pepper
9. Bake , covered , 45 minutes longer

title: walnut thumbprints
steps:
1. In mixing bowl , cream the butter and brown sugar
2. Beat in egg & vanilla
3. Combine dry ingredients
4. Gradually add to the creamed mixture
5. Refrigerate for 30 minutes
6. Roll into 1-inch balls
7. Place 2-inches apart on greased baking sheets
8. Using the end of a wooden spoon handle , make an indentation in the center of each ball
9. Combine filling ingredients
10. Spoon about 1 teaspoonful into each cookie
11. Bake at 350 degrees for 11 to 13 minutes or until lightly browned
12. Cool for 5 minutes before removing to wire racks

title: strawberry colada
steps: 1. Blend all in a blender till smooth adding ice cubes as needed

title: strawberries and bananas
steps:
1. Place sugar , water and corn starch in sauce pan
2. Let come to a boil and stirring constantly boil until it becomes almost clear
3. Add jello and let cool
4. Slice strawberries and bananas and add the syrup
5. A tsp of vanilla or almond flavoraing can be added

title: rustic cabbage soup
steps:
1. Warm the olive oil in a large thick-bottomed pot over medium-high heat
2. Stir in the salt and potatoes
3. Cover and cook until they are a bit tender and starting to brown a little bit for about 5 minutes
4. It's ok to uncover to stir a couple of times
5. Stir in the garlic and onion and cook for a few minutes until the cabbage softens up a little bit
6. Add the stock and the beans and bring the pot to simmer
7. Stir in the cabbage and cook for another couple of minutes , or until the cabbage softens up a bit
8. Now , adjust the seasonings
9. Getting the seasonings right is important or your soup will taste flat
10. Taste and see if you need more salt
11. Canned broths will sometimes vary between brands and homemade stocks will vary from canned

title: chicken fricassee and dumplings  lighter version
steps:
1. Combine 1 cup bisquick , salt , pepper , and paprika in a gallon-size ziplock bag
2. Add chicken pieces , seal , and shake to coat
3. In a very large , deep skillet or saute pan , heat about 1 / 4-inch oil over medium-high heat
4. Add chicken pieces and cook until golden brown , turning at least once
5. Remove chicken to a paper-towel lined dish
6. Drain fat from skillet
7. Add soup to skillet and gradually stir in 1 1 / 2 cups milk until smooth
8. Replace chicken , cover skillet , and bring just to boiling
9. Reduce heat and simmer gently over low heat for 45 minutes or until chicken is tender
10. Blend together 2 cups bisquick , 2 / 3 cup milk , parsley , and poultry seasoning
11. Remove lid and drop dough by spoonfuls onto hot gravy
12. Cook uncovered for about 10 minutes , or until top of dumplings looks set
13. Replace lid and cook an additional 10 minutes or until dumplings are cooked through

title: easy bbq sauce
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients& mix very well
2. Store in refrigerator

title: poached eggs in catsup
steps:
1. Melt butter and catsup in skillet till hot
2. Break eggs into catsup mixture separately
3. Cover with tight fitting lid and cook on low heat till desired doneness is reached
4. Remove with slotted turner and place on buttered toast
5. 2 servings

title: the realtor s easy chocolate ice cream
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , stir everything but the chocolate syrup together until the sugar is dissolved
2. Turn your ice cream machine on and add the milk mixture
3. Add chocolate syrup and freeze according to your machine's directions

title: spinach stuffed crescent rolls
steps:
1. Spray medium skillet with nonstick cooking spray
2. Saute onion , mushrooms and garlic until onion is transparent
3. Remove from heat
4. Stir in spinach , ricotta , mozzarella , sour cream , salt , cayenne and nutmeg until throughly combined
5. Seperate crescent rolls
6. Place 3 tablespoons spinach mixture on wide end of each piece of dough
7. Roll up to form crescent
8. Place on nonstick baking sheet
9. Bake 20 minutes at 350

title: mom s apple bars
steps:
1. Sift together flour , wheat germ , soda , cinnamon , salt and nutmeg
2. Set aside
3. In large bowl combine apples , sugars , oil , walnuts , eggs and vanilla
4. Add flour mixture and stir gently with wooden spoon to blend well
5. Bake n 13x9x2 inch baking pan at 350 degrees for 45-50 minutes or until cake pulls away from sides of pan
6. Cool in pan on rack
7. Sprinkle with sifted confectionary sugar

title: seafood and artichoke heart ecstasy
steps:
1. Melt butter with olive oil in a deep skillet
2. Add garlic , shallots and mushrooms
3. Cook on med high for several minutes , until the mushrooms get darker
4. Add both broths , crushed red pepper and wine
5. Let boil for several minutes until reduced by at least 1 / 4
6. Add artichoke hearts and juice
7. Return heat to high , add shrimp and scallops
8. Lower heat and cover
9. When shrimp turns opaque , it is ready !
10. Add the parsley and zest
11. Serve over pasta and sprinkle individual dishes with cheese
12. Salt and pepper as desired

title: hard rock cafe famous baby back watermelon ribs by todd wilbur
steps:
1. For the pureed watermelon rind , you want to cut off the green skin and about 1 / 2 inch of the hard white part
2. Keep the part that is lighter red to white
3. Put the rind inside the food processor and pure for only about 10 seconds
4. Strain the liquid from the pulp and use 1 cup
5. Combine the 1 cup watermelon pulp with the remaining ingredients in medium saucepan over high heat
6. Bring to a boil , and then reduce the heat and simmer , covered , for about 1 hour or until your desired thickness
7. Cut the racks of ribs into plate-size portions , about 6 to 7 ribs each
8. Brush each rib with the sauce and wrap each rack individually in aluminum foil
9. Be sure to save some sauce for later
10. Let the ribs marinate in the refrigerator for a couple of hours
11. Preheat the oven to 300f to cook the ribs
12. Set them with the seam of the foil facing up in the oven
13. Bake for 2 to 2 1 / 2 hours or until the rib meat has pulled back from the cut end of the bones by about 1 / 2 inch
14. They should be very tender
15. Remove the ribs form the foil and brush with additional sauce
16. Grill on a hot barbecue for 2 to 4 minutes per side or until you see several spots of charred sauce
17. Serve with reserved sauce on the side

title: eggs carbonara with basil and parmesan
steps:
1. Fry bacon in large nonstick skillet over medium heat , turning occasionally until crisp
2. When crisp remove from skillet and place on paper towels to absorb grease and let cool
3. Reserve 2 tablespoons bacon grease in small bowl and discard remainder
4. Wipe skillet clean with paper towels and set aside
5. Finely crumble bacon when cool
6. Vigorously whisk together eggs , parmesean cheese , cream , basil , salt and pepper in a bowl until foamy
7. Pour reserved bacon grease back into skillet and cook garlic and parsley over medium heat for 1 minute but do not brown garlic
8. Add scallions and cook stirring occasionally until soft about 3 minutes
9. Add egg mixture to skillet and cook , stirring occasionally to scramble eggs and form large curds , lifting up cooked egg around edges to let raw egg flow underneath
10. Cook until eggs are just set
11. Top with crumbled bacon and serve immediately

title: raisin oatmeal bran muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Sift flours , splenda / equal , baking powder , cinnamon and salt together mixing well
3. Add in the bran and oatmeal
4. In a second bowl , use a mixer to blend the buttermilk , apple juice concentrate , egg whites , honey about 2 minutes
5. Pour dry ingredients into wet stirring until just moist
6. Gently mix in golden raisins and hot water
7. Spoon batter into muffin tins with cups or lightly sprayed with cooking spray
8. Bake 20 minutes until just browned and firm

title: three milk cake  pastel de tres leches
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease and flour a 13-by-9-by-2-inch baking pan
3. Sift flour with baking powder
4. In large bowl with clean beaters , beat egg whites until frothy
5. Add sugar gradually , beating to form stiff peaks
6. Add yolks , 1 at a time
7. Slowly add flour and milk
8. Pour batter into prepared pan and bake until edges are golden brown , about 40 to 45 minutes , remove from oven and let cool on a rack
9. Prepare topping
10. Pour topping over cake and let sit until all the mixture is absorbed , 20 to 30 minutes
11. Prepare meringue and refrigerate
12. Before serving , cut cake into squares and spread meringue over each
13. Garnish as desired with fresh berries and mint leaves
14. Topping-------------------------h
15. Combine milks and sour cream
16. Use as directed
17. Heat water in a saucepan
18. Add sugar and turn off heat
19. Let sit until sugar is dissolved
20. In clean electric mixer bowl with clean beaters , beat egg whites
21. Slowly pour sugar syrup over egg whites , beating constantly until meringue holds stiff peaks
22. Store in refrigerator
23. This can be served immediately but is best made 24 hours ahead and chilled
24. The meringue will keep , covered , 2 days in the refrigerator

title: gumdrop salad
steps:
1. Mix the gumdrops , grape halves , marshmallows , pineapple , and nuts in a large bowl
2. Measure lemon juice and add an equal amount of water
3. Blend with the pineapple juice , sugar and vinegar in a pan
4. Bring to a boil
5. Stir in flour
6. Cook until thickened , stirring or whisking constantly
7. Cool
8. Pour over the gumdrop mixture and mix well

title: barbecued grilled vegetables
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine first 6 ingredients and mix well using a wire whisk
2. Spread onion slices on a baking sheet and cover with next 3 ingredients
3. Brushing vegetables with half the broth mixture
4. Coat grill rack with cooking spray and spread vegetables on grill rack over medium-hot heat and close lid , cooking for 5 minutes
5. Baste with remaining broth mixture and turn vegetables , grilling an additional 7 minutes or until tender
6. Serve immediately

title: quick mashed sweet potatoes
steps:
1. Cook sweet potatoes and liquid in medium size saucepan until heated through approximately 10 minutes
2. Drain off liquid
3. Add butter and half and half to pan
4. Beat or mash to desired consistency
5. Serve with butter , salt and pepper

title: decadent honey sponge cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 f
2. Combine coffee and baking soda well and set aside
3. Using a mixed on high speed , beat egg whites until soft peaks form
4. Gradually add just 1 / 2 cup of the sugar , 2 tbsp at a time , beating well after each addition , until well combined and whites are in stiff peaks
5. Set aside
6. Using a clean bowl , beat egg yolks with the remaining 1 / 2 cup sugar until thick and lemony in color
7. Switch to low speed and mix in honey until well combined
8. Add flour , amaretto baking powder , and the coffee mixture on very low speed , mixing just until blended , scraping down sides as needed
9. Raise the speed to medium , then beat well for 2 minutes , scraping down bowl as needed
10. Using a spatula , fold in the egg whites gently , just to blend- do not overmix
11. Fold in raisins and nuts gently
12. Pour into a 10 inch tube pan with removable bottom
13. Bake 1 hour and 10 minutes , or until top is springy and golden , and the cracks appear dry , not wet
14. Have ready a bottle or funnel set upside down on the counter
15. Invert the cake onto the bottle and let cool completely in the pan
16. Once cooled , use a knife or spatula to loosen edges , then remvoe cake from pan
17. Dust with powdered sugar before serving

title: tofu   potato stuffed bell peppers in a spicy indian sauce
steps:
1. Wash the bell peppers
2. Remove their stems and cut off the top portion a little so that you can remove the seeds and fill in the stuffing
3. For the stuffing , fry onion , green chillies , ginger-garlic paste , chilli powder and garam masala powder
4. Add paneer
5. Fry well for sometime
6. Add the boiled and mashed potatoes and greenpeas
7. Mix well
8. Add salt
9. Stuff the mixture inside the bell peppers
10. Bake them in an oven or shallow fry till fried and tender
11. Grind the fried onion , tomato , ginger paste , garlic paste , cardamom , chilli powder , cumin , cashewnuts , tomato sauce and whole garam masala to a fine paste
12. Add ghee
13. Fry the ground masala on low flame for 10 minutes till the ghee leaves the sides
14. Add salt and baked bell peppers
15. Boil well for 5 minutes
16. Top with cream and corriander leaves and serve immediately

title: dinner grains
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients and bring to a boil
2. Boil for 5 minutes
3. Reduce heat and cover and simmer for 40 minutes or until all water is absorbed
4. Serve with a healthy fish or legume curry

title: cha cha bowl
steps:
1. Pineapple and zucchini salsa:
2. Mix all ingredients together in a bowl
3. Season with salt , to taste
4. Refrigerate , covered , until ready to use
5. Bring to room temperature just before serving
6. Black beans:
7. Place beans in a saucepot
8. Cover with water and cook at a low simmer until tender but not mushy
9. Add garlic and salt , to taste
10. White rice:
11. Heat oil in a 4-quart pot
12. Add rice and cook approximately 3 minutes or until rice starts turning light brown
13. Then add water , garlic , and salt
14. Simmer until the water is absorbed , then cover and let stand for 20 minutes
15. Fluff just before serving
16. Al pastor adobo marinade:
17. Place chiles in a pan and cover with water
18. Bring to a boil and cook until softened
19. Transfer softened chiles to a food processor
20. Add all remaining ingredients , except pork or chicken , and puree until smooth
21. Cover pork tenderloin in marinade for 30 minutes
22. Preheat a grill
23. Grill pork tenderloin , turning as needed , until it reaches 150 degrees f when measured with an instant-read meat thermometer
24. Let rest for 10 minutes before dicing into cubes
25. To serve:
26. In 4 or 6 serving bowls , layer rice , beans , and pork
27. Top with pineapple and zucchini salsa

title: chicken ave maria
steps:
1. Toast the pine nuts by quickly frying in a small amount of olive oil , just until they start to turn golden , and set aside
2. Coarsely chop shallots
3. In a large skillet or frying pan saut the shallots in olive oil until they become clear and translucent
