4. Remove shallots from heat and set aside in a bowl for later use
5. Lightly flour the chicken cutlets
6. The purpose is not to create any coating on the chicken , simply to prevent splashing when frying
7. Cut the chicken cutlets into bite size pieces about 1 to 2 inch free form pieces , using a kitchen shears
8. Add more olive oil as needed to the pan and stir fry the chicken pieces until just cooked through , about 5 minutes or so
9. Do not over cook
10. Pour 1 / 2 cup of the heavy cream into a cup or saucer
11. Add the 2 tablespoons of cornstarch to the 1 / 2 cup of cream and stir until dissolved and free of lumps
12. Add the sauted shallots back into the pan with the chicken
13. Next add the 1 / 2 cup of white wine to the pan , drain the can of artichokes very well and add them to the chicken and wine mixture
14. If the artichoke pieces look too big you can cut them smaller before adding if you wish
15. Add the remaining cream in the pint and the asiago cheese , and stir to blend all ingredients , season with salt and pepper to taste
16. After cheese has completely melted into the mixture , add the 1 / 2 cup of reserved cream with the cornstarch in it to the mixture and heat through until the mixture thickens
17. Remove from heat to large serving bowl or serving platter
18. Sprinkle the toasted pine nuts over the top

title: choco scotch clusters
steps:
1. Melt chocolate chips and peanut butter together
2. Add rice krispies
3. Drop by spoonful onto wax paper
4. Can be made into bars
5. Let stand until firm

title: lemon risotto with garlic crab
steps:
1. Place crabmeat in a medium bowl
2. Pick through for any shells and discard
3. Add garlic and toss very well
4. Refrigerate , for at least 20 minutes
5. In a large saucepan , bring broth to a boil
6. Reduce to simmer
7. Add lemon juice and keep warm on back burner
8. In a large , heavy-bottomed saucepan over medium heat , add 1 tablespoon olive oil
9. When just smoking , add shallots and stir quickly with a wooden spoon until lightly golden and tender
10. Add rice and stir 1 minute to coat
11. Add 1 / 2 cup hot broth , stirring constantly
12. Continue cooking until almost all liquid is absorbed , and then add another 1 / 2 cup of broth
13. Repeat until rice is tender and almost all broth has been used , 25-30 minutes
14. Remove from heat and add crab
15. Stir until blended
16. Add 1 / 4 cup broth , remaining tablespoon olive oil
17. Lemon zest , thyme and toasted almond slivers
18. Stir to combine
19. Season with salt and pepper
20. Serve with a nice salad of sliced tomatoes with a nice vinagrette , and white wine

title: angelinas hot chocolate
steps:
1. In a double boiler over low heat , combine chocolate and 1 / 4 cup water until melted , stir until smooth
2. Remove top of double boiler pan from
3. Whisk in 3 tablespoons hot water
4. Pour into pitcher or divide among individual 4 mugs
5. Either stir 3 / 4 cup hot milk into each mug or serve milk in a separate pitcher
6. Pass sugar and whipped cream in separate bowls
7. Add to taste

title: russ s ranch potato salad
steps:
1. Dice the potato into about 1 inch pieces
2. Bring a large saucepan of water to the boil , and cook the potato cubes for about 12 minutes or until just tender
3. Drain and allow to cool
4. Meanwhile , heat the oil , and cook the bacon and onion about 5 minutes or until softened
5. Cool
6. Mix the ranch dressing mix , mayonaisse , cream , mustard and parsley together
7. Gently fold the cooked potatoes , bacon and onion mix and chopped eggs through the dressing and serve
8. We like to serve this either warm or just at room temperature

title: easy jello salad
steps:
1. Mix 1 large box of strawberry-banana jello according to package directions
2. Let set in the icebox until almost set , but not quite
3. Drain can of mixed fruit and add to your jello
4. Now , peel and slice your banana in your jello and mix
5. Add about 3 / 4 container of cool whip to your jello and fold
6. Return jello mixture to your icebox and let it finish setting up
7. If you mess up and your jello sets up all the way , just microwave for about 1 minute or leave at room temperature until it begins to soften and then add your mixed fruit , etc
8. You cannot mess this up !

title: white bean dip with oregano and parmesan cheese
steps:
1. Combine first 6 ingredients in processor
2. Blend well until almost smooth
3. Transfer to bowl
4. Season dip with salt and pepper , to taste
5. Place bowl with dip on platter
6. Serve with breadsticks and vegetables
7. Makes about 1 1 / 2 cups

title: magical leek soup
steps:
1. Clean the leeks and rinse well to get rid of sand and soil
2. Cut off the ends of the dark green parts , leaving all the white parts plus a suggestion of pale green
3. Put the leeks in a large pot and cover with water
4. Bring to a boil , reduce the heat , and simmer uncovered for 20 to 30 minutes
5. Pour off the liquid and reserve
6. Place the leeks in a bowl
7. The juice is to be drunk every 2 to 3 hours , 1 cup at a time
8. For meals , or whenever hungry , have some of the leeks themselves , 1 / 2 cup at a time
9. Drizzle with a few drops of extra-virgin olive oil and lemon juice
10. Season sparingly with salt and pepper
11. Sprinkle with chopped parsley if you wish
12. This will be your nourishment for both days , until sunday dinner , when you can have a small piece of meat or fish , with 2 vegetables , steamed with a bit of butter or olive oil , and a piece of fruit

title: cold green bean salad
steps:
1. Blanch the beans for about 3-4 mins , and put into cold water to stop the cooking process
2. In a bowl mash the garlic with the salt to make a paste
3. Add the vinegar and then slowly whisk in the olive oil
4. In a bowl toss the dressing with the walnuts and beans
5. Season to taste with more salt and freshly ground pepper ! ! enjoy !

title: thousand island dressing on the fly
steps:
1. Measure mayonnaise , chili sauce and pickle relish into a small bowl
2. Stir together well
3. If too thick , add a splash of milk

title: garlic serrano pepper marinade
steps:
1. Cover or bag chicken , fish or steak and marinate for a minimum of 30 minutes
2. 6 servings

title: spaghetti with four cheeses
steps:
1. Cook spaghettie according to pkg directions , drain and keep hot
2. In a 3 qt saucepan over medium heat , melt butter
3. Stir in flour until blended , cook 30 seconds
4. Gradually stir in half and half
5. Cook , stirring until mixture boils and slightly thickens
6. Stir in cheeses and seasonings until cheeses are melted and smooth
7. Pour hot pasta into warm large bowl
8. Pour sauce over the top , sprinkle with parsley
9. Toss until spaghetti is well coated

title: rachael ray s steakhouse shepherd s pie   30 minute meal
steps:
1. Following the directions will allow everything to come together at the end
2. Place potatoes in a pot , cover with cold water and bring up to a boil
3. Season water with salt and boil potatoes until tender , 12 to15 minutes
4. Heat a skillet with high sides over medium high heat
5. Add extra-virgin olive oil
6. Add bacon
7. Crisp bacon and remove to paper towel lined plate
8. Add sirloin to the pan and caramelize the meat , 7 to 8 minutes
9. Add in the mushrooms and onions and cook until tender , 8 to 10 minutes more
10. Then season with salt and pepper
11. While meat cooks heat a small sauce pot over medium heat and melt butter , whisk the flour into butter , cook 2 minutes then whisk beef stock into flour , add worcestershire and season sauce with salt and pepper , to taste
12. Thicken 6 to 7 minutes
13. Turn on broiler and have top rack 6 inches away from broiler flame
14. Pour gravy over meat and cook until the gravy thickens
15. Put meat / mushroom / onion mixture into a 9 x 13 inch oven safe dish
16. Place drained potatoes back into the pot you cooked them in to dry them out a little
17. Mash potatoes with egg yolk and sour cream
18. Stir egg yolk into the potatoes
19. Stir ranch dressing into the potatoes
20. Stir shredded cheese into the potatoes
21. Season the potatoes with salt and pepper and spread across the top of the meat in an even layer
22. Garnish the potatoes with paprika
23. Place under broiler to crisp and brown the potatoes , 2 to 3 minutes
24. Serve immediately

title: beef mushroom barley soup
steps:
1. In a large stock pot , add olive oil , sliced mushrooms , chopped onions and chopped garlic
2. On a low heat , saute for about 5 minutes , turning and stirring occasionally , until tender
3. Add beef broth and water , soup bone , thyme , marjoram , and bay leaves
4. Stir and simmer on low
5. While this is simmering , trim all fat off of the sirloin steak and cut into small pieces
6. Add beef to soup and bring to a low boil for about 20 minutes
7. Remove soup bone and any debris from bone
8. Add barley now and carrots
9. Continue simmering for another 30 minutes or until carrots are tender
10. If by chance the soup starts getting too thick , you can add a little more water

title: rice pilaf  african
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , heat the oil and saute the onions until soft
2. Stir in the rice and cook , stirring frequently , for 4 minutes
3. Add the raisins , chili , lime zest , cinnamon sticks , cardamon , salt and 4 cups of water and stir well
4. Cover the pan and simmer for 15-18 minutes or until the rice has absorbed all the liquid
5. Meanwhile , lightly toast the slivered almonds in a dry frying pan
6. Remove the saucepan from the heat and fluff up the rice with a fork
7. Stir in the almonds , parsley and season to taste before serving

title: black olive appetizers
steps:
1. Cut thin slice off bottom of each olive , forming a flat base
2. Roll up slice of pepperoni and place inside pitted end of each olive
3. Fill center of each pepperoni slice with desired combination of cheese , vegetables and herbs
4. Stand olives on serving plate

title: potato topped  beef casserole
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees
2. Butter a 2-1 / 2 quart baking dish
3. In a heavy skillet , brown the ground beef in 2 tbsp butter , then add in onion , garlic , red and green bell pepper
4. Saute until soft , spoon off excess fat
5. Add in parmesan cheese , salt , black pepper , sherry , parsley
6. Saute another 5 minutes
7. Spread the mixture into the prepared casserole dish
8. To the cooked potatoes , add the remaining butter and milk , beat or mix until smooth
9. Season with salt to taste and black pepper if desired
10. Spread the potatoes over meat mixture evenly , making sure corners are covered well
11. Sprinkle top with grated cheddar cheese bake , uncovered for approximately 25-30 minutes , or until potatoes and cheese are lightly browned

title: mince and tatties
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a pan and saut the onion until it is brown
2. Add in the mince and cook until well browned
3. Drain off the liquid
4. Add the carrots and oatmeal , mix well and pour in enough water to just cover
5. Crumble in the stock cubes , season and stir
6. Cover the pan and simmer the mince for about 20 minutes
7. Once the mince is cooked thicken the mince with about 3 teaspoons of gravy powder or cornstarch mixed with a little cold water
8. Serve the mince with boiled potatoes

title: peanut butter banana bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Combine flour , powder , salt and soda and set aside
3. Cream shortening and peanut butter
4. Add sugar gradually , continuing to cream until light and fluffy
5. Add eggs and beat until well combined
6. Stir in dry ingredients alternately with mashed bananas
7. Mix well , but do not beat
8. Spoon batter into a well greased 8 x 4 loaf pan
9. Bake for 1 hour or until thin knife inserted into center comes out clean

title: chicken breast stuffed with goats cheese and basil
steps:
1. Wash and dry the chicken breasts
2. Cut a pocket in the side of each breast
3. Pick and roughly chop the basil leaves
4. Mix with the goat cheese and season with salt and pepper
5. Stuff the chicken breasts with the mixture and secure with toothpicks
6. Season with salt and pepper , heat the oil and brown on both sides
7. Reduce the heat and cook over a low heat for 20 minutes turning every so often
8. Salad
9. Tear and wash the lettuce
10. Mix the honey and lemon juice and oil with a little water
11. Season with salt and pepper
12. Toss with the lettuce
13. Serve the chicken breasts over the tossed lettuce

title: orange beet cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Bring raisins and orange juice to a boil in a non-reactive sauce pan , reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes , strain , retaining liguid , set aside raisins and return liquid to sauce pan simmer and reduce to about 3 tbls
3. Grease a 9" springform pan , line with parchment , grease and dust with flour
4. Stir together dry ingredients except sugars , set aside
5. Whisk the yolks slightly then whisk in oil 1 tbls at a time , continuing till yolks are emulsified
6. Stir in zest , brown sugar , beets and raisins
7. Fold in flour mixture
8. In a seperate bowl beat whites until soft peaks form , sprinke in white sugar a little and then beat for 1 minute more
9. Stir 1 / 4 whites into the cake batter to lighten , then fold in the the rest of the whites , pour into springform pan and level
10. Bake just until a knife inserted in center comes out clean , 45-55 minutes
11. Cool for 10 minutes
12. Carefully remove cake from pan and place on serving plate , reheat orange juice then brush over the top of the warm cake
13. Store in an airtight container

title: horsey cocktail sauce
steps:
1. Mix ingredients together
2. Chill
3. Great with shrimp , oysters , crackers , etc

title: tea smoked chicken
steps:
1. Toast the salt and peppercorns together in a skillet over a low flame until it starts to smoke
2. Let cool and grind in a mortar and pestle
3. Rub the mixture all over the chicken , inside and out
4. Refrigerate overnight
5. Steam the chicken in a large pot for about 45 minutes , until juices run clear when thigh is pricked
6. I use one of those collapsible steamer inserts in a soup pot
7. Do save the resulting broth , it's quite flavorful
8. Line a wok and its lid with heavy-duty foil
9. Combine the tea and sugar in the bottom of the wok and place a rack over the mixture
10. Heat the wok until the mixture begins to smoke
11. Pat the chicken dry and place on the rack
12. Cover the wok tightly and smoke the chicken for about 15 minutes
13. Remove from the heat and let the covered wok stand for another 30 minutes
14. Cut the chicken into serving pieces and brush with the sesame oil

title: crab salad sandwiches
steps:
1. Add the crabmeat , mayonnaise , green onions , and celery to a large mixing bowl
2. Stir to combine
3. Add the cheese , and salt / pepper to taste
4. Stir to combine
5. Spread the crab mixture over the bottom of the bread
6. Replace top of bread
7. Wrap sandwich in a big piece of heavy foil
8. Bake at 400 for 20 minutes or until heated
9. Cut into slices and serve

title: ginger rum pork roast
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Combine salt , pepper , garlic pwdr and paprika and rub all over the pork
3. Place pork in roasting pan and bake for 1 hr 15 minutes
4. In small saucepan heat brown sugar , rum or o
5. J
6. , butter , mustard , vinegar and ginger
7. Simmer whisking until consistency of jam and reduced to 1 / 4 cup
8. Brush glaze over roast during last 15 minutes of cooking time
9. Let stand about 10 minutes before you slice it

title: vegan tempeh bacon
steps:
1. To make the marinade combine the soy sauce , cider , tomato paste and liquid smoke in a wide , shallow bowl or pan and mix with a fork until the tomato paste is fully dissolved
2. Cut the tempeh into thin strips lengthwise
3. You should be able to get about 12 strips
4. Rub the strips with the hing
5. Submerge the tempeh strips in the marinade and let sit , for at least an hour and up to overnight
6. Heat the oil in an 11 or 12 inch skillet over medium heat
7. Add the tempeh strips and cook for 4 minutes on one side
8. The bottom should be nicely browned
9. Flip the strips over and pour the remainder of the marinade over them
10. If there isnt much marinade left add a splash of water
11. Cover and let cook for 3 more minutes , or until the liquid is absorbed
12. Uncover and check for doneness
13. If necessary keep cooking uncovered until all sides are nicely browned
14. Remove from heat and serve

title: smothered potatoes
steps:
1. Peel and slice potatoes to a quarter inch thin
2. Place in large dish with and inch of water above potatoes
3. Microwave for 10 minutes , checking after 5
4. Heat oil in a non-stick skillet , which will allow better browning on medium-high
5. Dry off potato slices , add to pan , turning over gently and letting them brown and get crispy
6. After most are brown , turn heat down to low-medium , cover with lid and steam 5-10 minutes checking and continuing to turn
7. Slice 12-14 slices of medium cheddar cheese are what ever you prefer and place on top of potatoes , turn heat down to low add salt and pepper

title: hearty italian sausage and meatball stew  ragu
steps:
1. Place a 4-5 quart dutch oven over medium high heat
2. Add the olive oil , onion , green pepper , zucchini and salt
3. Mix well
4. Cook for 6-8 minutes , stirring often , until just heated through
5. Add the garlic and italian seasoning
6. Mix well
7. Add the ragu sauce , beef broth , garbanzo beans , black beans and diced tomatoes
8. Mix well and bring to a simmer
9. Add the pasta and cook until pasta is al dente
10. Add the sausage and meatballs
11. Mix well and bring to a simmer to heat through
12. Top each individual serving with grated parmesan cheese , if desired

title: vegan dlt  dulse  lettuce  and tomato  sandwiches
steps:
1. Dry fry the dulse in a skillet over medium heat for a few minutes , until the leaves turn greenish
2. Let cool
3. Meanwhile , toast bread and slice tomato
4. Spread bread with vegenaise
5. Top with dulse , lettuce , and tomato
6. If desired , season with salt and pepper

title: onion teriyaki burgers
steps:
1. Preheat a grill for high heat
2. In a medium bowl , mix together the ground beef , teriyaki marinade and french-fried onions
3. Form the mixture into 4 patties
4. Lightly oil the grilling surface , and place patties on the preheated grill
5. Grill for 4 to 5 minutes per side , or until well done
6. Top with cheese , and serve on hamburger buns

title: jello pinwheels
steps:
1. Lightly spray an 8 or 9 inch square pan with cooking spray
2. Mix gelatin and water in 1 1 / 2-2 qt microwavable bowl
3. Cook on high 1 1 / 2 minutes
4. Stir to dissolve completely
5. Add marshmallows to gelatin
6. Microwave one minute or until marshmallows are almost melted
7. Stir until completely melted and mixture is smooth
8. Pour into prepared pan
9. Refrigerate 45 minutes or until set
10. Loosen edges with knife dipped in warm water
11. Starting at one end , roll up tightly
12. With seam side down , cut into 10-12 1 / 2 inch slices
13. Serve immediately or refrigerate until ready to serve

title: fuss free biryani chicken
steps:
1. In a large frying pan set over medium high heat , melt butter
2. Lightly sprinkle chicken with salt and pepper
3. Add chicken to pan and cook until lightly browned , about 2 minutes per side
4. Whisk curry paste with wine until fairly well blended
5. Pour over chicken
6. Reduce heat to medium-low
7. Cover and simmer until chicken feels springy , about 4 minutes per side
8. Remove chicken to a platter
9. Loosely cover to keep warm
10. Then increase heat to high and boil sauce until reduced to approximately 3 tablespoons , about 3 minutes
11. Stir in sour cream , if using
12. Drizzle sauce over chicken and serve with basmati rice and stir-fried crunchy vegetables

title: sweet potato chili  crock pot
steps:
1. In a large skillet over medium heat , toast cumin seeds , stirring for about 2 minutes or until fragrant and they start to brown
2. Transfer to a mortar and pestle and grind
3. Set aside
4. In the same skillet , heat oil over medium heat for 30 seconds or so
5. Add onions and cook , stirring until softened
6. Stir in garlic , oregano , salt , pepper , and reserved cumin
7. Stir for one minute
8. Stir in barley
9. Add tomatoes and tomato juice and bring to a boil
10. Transfer mixture to crock pot and add vegetable broth , sweet potatoes and beans
11. Cover and cook on low for 6-8 hours
12. Mix chili powder and lime juice together in a cup and add to crockpot along with the jalapeno
13. Cover and cook on high for 30 minutes
14. Serve in bowls garnished with cilantro and i added non-fat sour cream to mine

title: texas shrimp and rice salad
steps:
1. Bring water to boil in large pot
2. Add shrimp and return to boil
3. Reduce heat and simmer 3-5 minutes
4. Drain shrimp well and rinse with cold water
5. Cool shrimp
6. Peel and devein
7. Combine shrimp , rice , beans , olives and onions
8. Toss well
9. Combine salad dressing with seasonings
10. Mix well
11. Pour over rice mix and chill
12. Serve over salad greens

title: golden spice mix
steps:
1. In a blender or food processor blend till powdery
2. Use with in 1 year

title: turkish apple tea
steps:
1. Place all the ingredients except the honey into a saucepan
2. Bring to a boil then reduce heat & simmer for 15 minutes
3. Strain the hot tea into a teapot
4. Make sure to gently push on the apples to remove all the liquid
5. Sweeten with honey then pour into tea glasses

title: michael symon s drunken cabbage
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , cook the bacon over low heat
2. Add the onions and sweat for 2 minutes
3. Add remaining ingredients and season
4. Cook until cabbage is tender , about 30 minutes

title: amazing pineapple bread
steps:
1. Mix together butter and sugar
2. Add egg substitute and pineapple , mix well
3. Add in flours , soda , and salt , blend together
4. Add vanilla
5. Pour into greased & floured loaf pan
6. Bake at 350 degrees for 50-60 minutes

title: perfect no fail basmati rice
steps:
1. Rinse rice till water runs clear , drain well
2. In saucepan place water and rice , cover and cook over low-med flame till water looks evaporated and steam holes appear
3. Turn of flame -- do not lift lid !
4. Leave for 5 minutes then fluff with a fork -- your result will be perfecly cooked rice

title: farfalle with hot italian sausage  tomatoes and basil
steps:
1. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook pasta until al dente
2. Drain and toss in olive oil
3. Set aside
4. Meanwhile , preheat a large skillet
5. Squeeze sausage from casing into pan , crumbling it into small pieces
6. Add garlic and cook until sausage is browned and cooked through , 7 to 10 minutes
7. Toss cooked sausage with pasta , basil , tomatoes , cheese , lemon juice , salt and pepper
8. Serve warm or at room temperature

title: ruby tuesday sonora chicken pasta copycat by todd wilbur
steps:
1. Prepare the barbecue or preheat your stovetop grill
2. Combine the cheese spread with the cream in a small saucepan
3. Saute' the red chili pepper and 2 tablespoons green chili pepper , 2 tablespoons onion , and 1 / 2 clove garlic in the olive oil for a couple minutes then add the water to the pan so that the peppers do not scorch
4. Simmer another 2 minutes or until the water has cooked off
5. When the cheese is smooth , add the sauteed vegetables , 1 / 4 teaspoon salt , sugar , vinegar , and cumin
6. Leave on low heat , stirring occasionally , until the other ingredients are ready
7. Pour the entire can of beans with the liquid into a small saucepan over medium heat
8. Add the remaining green chili pepper , onions , garlic , a pinch of salt , and a dash of paprika
9. Bring the beans to a boil , stirring often , then reduce the heat to low and simmer until everything else is ready
10. By this time the beans will have thickened and the onions will have become transparent
11. Rub the chicken breasts lightly with oil , then season with salt , thyme , and savory
12. Cook the breasts on a hot grill for 5 minutes per side or until done
13. When they have cooked thoroughly , remove them from the grill and use a sharp knife to slice each breast into 1 / 2-inch slices , so that they are easier to eat
14. Retain the shape of the chicken breast by keeping the slices in order with one hand as you slice
15. As the chicken cooks , prepare the pasta in a large pot filled with 3 to 4 quarts of boiling water
16. Cook the pasta for 12 to 14 minutes or until tender
17. Drain the pasta in a colander , and toss with the butter
18. When everything is ready , spoon one-fourth of the pasta onto each plate
19. Pour about 1 / 3 cup of the black beans over the pasta
20. Carefully add a sliced breast of chicken , being sure to maintain its shape as you lay the slices on the bed of pasta
21. Spread 1 / 3 cup of black beans over the chicken
22. Sprinkle 1 / 4 cup of chopped tomatoes on the beans
23. Sprinkle about 1 tablespoon of green onions on the tomatoes and serve immediately
24. Salt to taste

title: cheese krispies
steps:
1. Cream margarine and cheese
2. Add flour , salt and pepper
3. Stir cereal in by hand
4. Shape into small balls and place on ungreased cookie sheet
5. Flatten each ball with a fork
6. Top with pecan half if desired
7. Bake at 300f for 20 minutes
8. Store tightly covered
9. Freezes well
10. Yield: 6 dozen
11. Louisiana entertains

title: roasted caraway potatoes
steps:
1. Combine first 2 ingredients in a large heavy duty zip-top plastic bag
2. Mix together remaining ingredients and pour into plastic bag
3. Shake well to coat
4. Place potato mixture in an ungreased 13x9 inch pan
5. Bake at 400 degrees for 1 hour or until potatoes are tender , stirring occasionally

title: veggie pizza squares  makeover   light
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Unroll both tubes of crescent dough and pat into an ungreased 15x10x1-inch baking pan
3. Seal seams and perforations
4. Bake for 10-12 minutes or until golden brown
5. Cool completely on a wire rack
6. Meanwhile , in a small mixing bowl , beat the cream cheeses , yogurt , mayo , milk , dill and garlic until smooth
7. Spread over crust
8. Sprinkle with carrots , cauliflower , broccoli , green pepper , mushrooms , olives and onion
9. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour
10. Cut into 24 squares and serve
11. Refrigerate leftovers

title: shrimp alla aglio
steps:
1. Cook pasta in rapidly boiling salted water
2. While pasta is boiling , heat the oil in a saut pan , add onion , and saut 2 minutes
3. Add garlic , saut 1 minute
4. Add shrimp
5. Cook 1-2 minutes
6. Add butter , wine , red pepper , salt , and pepper
7. When pasta is done , drain and place on plate and pour shrimp mixture over it

title: country style scrambled eggs
steps:
1. In a large skillet , cook bacon over medium heat until crisp
2. Using a slotted spoon , remove to paper towels to drain
3. Cook and stir potatoes in drippings over medium heat for 12 minutes or until tender
4. Add onion and green pepper
5. Cook and stir for 3 or 4 minutes or until crisp-tender
6. Drain
7. Stir in the reserved bacon
8. In a large bowl , whisk the eggs , milk , salt and pepper
9. Add to skillet
10. Cook and stir until eggs are completely set
11. Sprinkle with cheese and let stand until cheese has melted

title: breakfast brownies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Combine dry ingredients and then wet ingredients
3. Mix together well with a mixer or food processor until very smooth
4. If too thick , add a tb of water
5. Spread batter in an 8" square pan sprayed lightly with cooking spray
6. Bake 20-25 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean
7. Don't overbake !
8. Let cool in pan about 10 minutes and then cut

title: chewy chocolate chip pizookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Melt the butter in a saucepan over low heat
3. Sift together the flour , salt , and baking soda
4. Set aside
5. Pour the melted butter in a large bowl
6. Add the sugar and brown sugar
7. Cream the butter and sugars on medium speed
8. Add the egg , egg yolk , 2 tablespoons milk , and vanilla extract to the sugar-butter mixture
9. Mix
10. Slowly incorporate the flour mixture until thoroughly combined
11. Stir in the chocolate chips
12. Scoop onto baking sheets , 6 cookies per sheet , or spread dough on the bottom of 4 9-inch pie tins
13. Bake for 15 minutes or until golden brown
14. Serve cookies or cool and store
15. Pizookies are topped with vanilla ice cream and served warm

title: taco in a bowl
steps:
1. In a skillet , cook beef over medium heat until no longer pink
2. Drain
3. Add the tomatoes , taco seasoning and water
4. Mix well
5. Add pork and beans
6. Bring to a boil
7. Reduce heat
8. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes
9. To serve , place corn chips in four soup bowls
10. Top with beef mixture and toppings of your choice

title: chicken parmesan bundles
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Mix cream cheese , spinach , 1 cup of the mozzarella and 3 tablespoons of the parmesan until well blended
3. Spread evenly onto chicken breasts
4. Starting at one of the short ends of each breast , roll up chicken tightly
5. Secure with wooden toothpicks , if desired
6. Set aside
7. Beat egg in shallow bowl or pie plate
8. Mix remaining 3 tablespoons of the parmesan and the breadcrumbs in a separate shallow bowl or pie plate
9. Dip chicken bundles in egg , then roll in breadcrumbs
10. Place , seam-side down , in a 13x9-inch baking dish sprayed with cooking spray
11. Bake 30 minute or until chicken is cooked through
12. Remove and discard toothpicks if using
13. Serve topped with the heated spagetti sauce and remaining 1 / 4 cup mozzarella cheese

title: cauliflower pie
steps:
1. Melt butter in a large saucepan , cook onions until softened
2. Add cauliflower pieces , season with salt and pepper
3. Cover with water
4. Boil until just tender
5. Drain well
6. Arrange crescent rolls in pie pan , pressing into the bottom and up the sides
7. Place cauliflower in shell , with stem ends facing down
8. Sprinkle cheese over pie
9. Mix eggs and milk together , season to taste again
10. Pour over cauliflower
11. Bake at 350 degrees for about 45 minutes or until set

title: sugar free and vegan carrot cake
steps:
1. In a small bowl , mix together the flour , baking powder , baking soda , and salt and set aside
2. Combine the water , dates , raisins , cinnamon , ginger , cloves , and nutmeg in a small saucepan
3. Bring to a boil , reduce heat , and gently simmer for 5 minutes
4. Place the shredded carrots in a large bowl and pour the hot water mixture over them , and allow to cool completely
5. Add the orange juice concentrate to the carrot mixture and mix well
6. Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and stir well to combine
7. Pour the batter into a lightly greased cake pan
8. Bake at 375 degrees for 45 minutes , or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean

title: bacon wrapped grilled halibut steaks
steps:
1. In ziplock bag combine lime juice , green onions , oil , cilantro , jalapeno , salt and pepper
2. Add haliut steaks , seal , and turn to coat
3. Refrigerate for 15 minutes , turning once
4. Meanwhile , fry bacon until cooked but not crisp
5. Drain on paper towels
6. Remove halibut when marinated , discarding marinade
7. Wrap two slices of bacon over top and sides of each steak and secure with soaked wooden toothpicks
8. Spray nonstick cooking spray on grill racks before heating
9. Place halibut , bacon side down , on grill rack with drip pan underneath rack to catch any bacon drippings
10. Grill covered over medium heat for 4-5 minutes on each side or until fish flakes easily with a fork
11. Discard toothpicks , serve and enjoy !

title: pecan stuffed waffles
steps:
1. In a small mixing bowl , beat the cream cheese , brown sugar , cinnamon and vanilla until smooth
2. Stir in pecans
3. Toast waffles according to package directions
4. Spread cream cheese mixture over four waffles
5. Top with remaining waffles
6. Drizzle with syrup
7. Sprinkle with confectioners' sugar
8. Garnish with fresh fruit

title: joe s special  ground beef  spinach   eggs
steps:
1. Beat the eggs and set aside for step 7
2. Heat the oil and butter in a large heavy skillet over medium heat
3. When the butter has melted , add the ground beef and cook , stirring occasionally , until browned and crumbly
4. Add the onion and garlic and cook until the onion is tender but not browned
5. Stir in the spinach , basil , oregano and nutmeg
6. If using fresh spinach , cook until the spinach wilts
7. Add the beaten eggs to the beef / spinach mixture and cook until the eggs are set , about 3 minutes
8. Add salt and pepper to taste

title: mock sauerbraten
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine italian dressing , 1 cup water , bay leaves , cloves , peppers and ginger
2. Add meat , turning to coat , cover and marinate in refrigerator about 24 hours turning occasionally or put marinade and meat into a large zip bag , push air out and seal
3. In a large dutch oven , brown meat , add marinade
4. Simmer covered 2 hours or until tender
5. Strain liquid from meat into medium saucepan and combine with 1 / 2 cup water and gingersnaps , cook stirring constantly until smooth
6. Drizzle over meat slices or serve separately

title: steamed cranberry brown bread  crock pot
steps:
1. Coat the inside of a 13-oz coffee can with cooking spray
2. Combine first 6 ingredients in a large bowl
3. In a small bowl , combine buttermilk and molasses
4. Stir well
5. Add to flour mixture , stirring just until moistened
6. Fold in dried cranberries and walnuts
7. Spoon mixture into coffee can
8. Cover with foil coated with cooking spray
9. Secure with a rubber band
10. Place can in a crockpot
11. Add enough hot water to crockpot to come halfway up sides of can
12. Cover with lid and cook on high-heat setting for 2 1 / 2-3 hours , or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean
13. Remove can from crockpot
14. Let bread cool , covered , in can on a wire rack for 5 minutes
15. Remove bread from can and let cool completely on wire rack

title: tea room tuna salad
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a bowl and chill for at least 30 minutes
2. For tuna melt: grill tuna salad on rye bread with a slice of swiss cheese

title: crock pot sausage and mushroom bake
steps:
1. Heat oil in large skillet and saute onion and potatoes gently for 5 minutes
2. Add the remaining ingredients , season with salt and pepper and bring to the boil
3. Transfer to crock pot
4. Cook on low for 6- 10 hours until sausages and potatoes are cooked through

title: mozambique prawns
steps:
1. Prepare hot spice blend
2. In a small bowl mix together the ingredients
3. If not using immediately , store the blend in a small spice jar away from light and heat
4. Prepare sauce
5. In a medium saucepan , combine the prawn shells , tomato juice , coconut milk and peanut butter
6. Bring the mixture to a boil , stirring often
7. Season with some hot spice blend to taste
8. Bring the mixture back to a boil and then pass it through a sieve
9. Discard the shells
10. Prepare rice
11. In a large 2-quart saucepan , bring the rice , coconut milk and water to a boil
12. Reduce the heat and simmer , covered , for 25 minutes
13. Take an occasional peek to make sure the rice isn't sticking to the bottom of the pan
14. Prepare plantains
15. Season the plantains with salt and white pepper
16. In a large skillet heat the oil over medium-high heat and sautthe plantains on both sides until brown and soft , about 3 to 4 minutes
17. Prepare prawns
18. Season the prawns with some hot spice blend and cook them on an oiled grill or grill pan until heated through , about 7 to 10 minutes
19. To serve , mound the rice in the middle of six warm plates and ladle the sauce around
20. Lay the shrimp against the rice mounds , place a plantain in between each shrimp and garnish with the peanuts and cilantro

title: bub s amazing mandelbroit  jewish biscotti
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees beat eggs and sugar till well blended add oil and vanilla add flour , salt , and baking powder mix well add grape nuts , almonds and pecans form into rolls that are 2 inches in diameter bake 15-20 mins
2. Until brown and dry cool , then slice dust with cinnamon and sugar then bake again at 325 until brown

title: fantastic shrimp cocktail spread
steps:
1. Prepare about one 12-inch dish or a glass pie or a fancy quiche plate
2. In a bowl , combine / whisk together the softened cream cheese , sour cream garlic and mayonnaise
3. Spread into bottom of prepared dish
4. Scatter the shrimp over the sour cream mixture
5. Top with the cocktail sauce then the mozzarella cheese , green peppers , chopped tomatoes , and last the chopped green peppers on the top
6. Cover , and refrigerate until ready to serve
7. Serve with crackers

title: yellow pea soup with cherry tomatoes and parsley  artsoppa
steps:
1. In a medium pot , combine olive oil , onion , carrot and celery
2. Cook over medium heat , stirring occasionally , until the veggies are tender , about 5-8 minutes
3. Add peas , broth , water , pork shank and bay leaves
4. Bring to a boil , reduce to simmer , and cook until peas are tender , about 1 hour
5. Add more water if needed
6. Season with salt and pepper
7. Remove shank and take meat off the bone , discard the bone
8. Cut or shred the meat and set aside
9. Using an immersion blender , blend the soup until smooth
10. You can also use a regular blender , but work in batches and don't overfill
11. The soup will be very thick - add more water to thin as necessary
12. Adjust seasoning
13. Return the meat to the soup
14. While the peas are cooking , combine the finely chopped tomatoes , the garlic and the olive oil in a small bowl
15. Let marinade while peas are cooking , about one hour
16. When ready to serve , ladle soup into wide soup bowls and add a generous tablespoon of marinated tomatoes in the center

title: mexican shepherds pie
steps:
1. Coarsely chop the onion and peppers
2. Peel the potatoes and cut into small pieces and put to one side
3. Warm a pan on medium heat , add a little olive oil
4. Cook the onions for 5 minutes
5. Add the peppers and cook for a further 5 minutes
6. Remove the veg from the pan and put to one side
7. In the same pan , turn the heat up high and brown the mince
8. When the mince is browned through , stir in the onion and peppers and season with salt and pepper
9. Bring a large pan of water to the boil
10. Stir in the fajita spice mix to the mince
11. Add the lamb stock a little at a time until it is completely incorporated
12. Stir in the tomato puree
13. Turn the heat down low , cover with lid and leave for 30 mins stirring occasionally
14. Add the potatoes to the pan of boiling water for 25 minutes
15. Preheat oven to 200c
16. Drain the potatoes , return to the pan and cover with a clean teatowel
17. Add the butter to the potatoes and mash
18. Spread the mince evenly into an ovenproof dish , then cover evenly with the mash
19. Grate some cheese and lightly sprinkle on top of the mash
20. Cook in the oven for 15 minutes
21. Remove from the oven and sprinkle tacos , salsa and more grated cheese and return to the oven for 10 minutes

title: japanese curry rice
steps:
1. If making the garam masala combined 1 tsp ground cloves , 1 tsp ground ginger , 1 tsp ground cinnamon , and 1 tsp black pepper in a small bowl
2. Place in an air tight container and put aside
3. Start by cutting your choice of meat , the potatoes , carrots , and onion into bite-sized pieces
4. Heat a deep pan on medium
5. Add the cooking oil and the meat
6. Saute until the meat is fully cooked
7. Add vegetables and saute together
8. Add the 1 cup of water to the pan and bring to a boil
9. Turn the heat down to low and cook for 40-50 minutes
10. In a separate pan heat the 3 cups of water and add the two types of bouillon to make soup
11. Slice the remaining two onions very thinly
12. Heat butter in another pan and saute onion slices until they are brown for 15-20 minutes
13. Add the garlic and the ginger to the pan and saute well
14. Add flour and curry powder and saute over low heat
15. Slowly pour the soup into the pan , little by little , stirring quickly
16. Simmer the curry roux until thickened
17. Once the curry roux is thickened , add the garam masala
18. After the meat and vegetables have been cooking for 40-50 minutes add the curry roux to them
19. Stir and let simmer for ten minutes
20. Sprinkle with salt
21. Serve the curry over japanese rice

title: lemon snowflake cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Mix all ingredients
3. Drop by balls in powdered sugar
4. Bake on greased cookie sheet at 350 degrees for 10 minutes

title: slow cooked praline apple crisp
steps:
1. Spray 3- to 4-quart slow cooker with cooking spray
2. In large bowl , mix apples and cinnamon to coat
3. Place in slow cooker
4. In medium bowl , mix oats , brown sugar , flour and butter with pastry blender or fork until crumbly
5. Stir in pecans and toffee bits
6. Sprinkle crumb mixture evenly over apples
7. Cover
8. Cook on low heat setting 4 to 6 hours
9. Serve apple crisp with ice cream

title: eight peppercorn blend
steps:
1. In a small skillet over medium heat , add the szechuan peppercorns and toast , stirring occastionally , about 2 - 4 minutes
2. Transfer the peppercorns to a measuring cup and cool
3. Combine rest of ingredients and grind the pepper mixture , working in small batches
4. Using a mini food processor , i will coarsely grind these first then add them to the rest of the ingredients and coarsely grind them again

title: quick taco bake and rise casserole
steps:
1. Brown meat in a skillet and drain off fat
2. Add taco seasoning , stir well and set aside
3. Coat an 8-inch square baking dish with cooking spray
4. Mix all the batter ingredients together and stir until smooth
5. Pour into baking pan
6. Top batter with meat mixture then pour salsa evenly over the meat
7. Sprinkle with cheese and corn chips
8. Place in a cold oven
9. Set temperature to 350f
10. Bake for 30 minutes

title: the only texas caviar you should ever eat
steps:
1. Mix marinade ingredients together and boil for five minutes
2. Cool
3. Mix all veggies and beans together
4. Pour the marinade over your beans and veggies
5. Refrigerate at least 24 hours
6. Serve tortilla chips

title: hearty turkey tortilla soup
steps:
1. Mix broth , rice and cumin in saucepan
2. Heat to a boil
3. Cover and cook over low heat 20 minutes
4. Stir in turkey , corn , salsa , cilantro and lime juice and heat through
5. Top with crisp tortilla strips
6. Crisp tortilla strips: preheat oven to 425 f
7. Cut 4 corn tortillas into thin strips and place on baking sheet
8. Spray with vegetable cooking spray
9. Bake 10 minutes or until golden

title: green beans with ginger and cashews
steps:
1. In large pot boiling salted water , cook beans until crisp-tender , about 4 minutes
2. Drain and rinse in colander under cold water then pat dry
3. In 12-inch heavy skillet over moderate heat , heat butter until hot but not smoking
4. Add ginger and saut until softened and fragrant , about 30 seconds
5. Stir in green beans and stock and cook , stirring often , until liquid is almost completely evaporated , about 3 to 6 minutes
6. Before serving stir in cashews to distribute then transfer to serving dish and serve immediately

title: double chocolate skor squares
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Spray a 9" square pan with cooking spray
3. Mix 2 tablespoons of the butter with the condensed milk in a large microwaveable bowl
4. Mix the remaining butter with the oreo crumbs and press into the prepared pan
5. Microwave the condensed milk for 5 minutes , stirring every 30 seconds
6. Warning: make sure your bowl has enough room for this to expand 5-6 times the original volume as it boils up
7. Stir in the skor bits and spread over the oreo base
8. Bake for 12 minutes
9. Sprinkle chocolate chips evenly over top of squares and return to the turned off oven for 1-2 minutes until just melted
10. Spread the chocolate to make a smooth topping
11. Cool and cut into 25 squares while still slightly warm
12. Cool completely before removing from pan

title: the lady and sons okra and tomatoes   paula deen
steps:
1. Cook bacon slightly
2. Saute onion and garlic with bacon until tender
3. Add tomatoes , chicken base , sugar and pepper
4. Stir well and let simmer for about 20 minutes
5. Adjust seasoning if needed
6. Meanwhile wash okra and remove fuzz , if using fresh okra , cut into pieces
7. Add okra and simmer until okra is done , about 20 more minutes , serve

title: green bean  zucchini  and potato soup
steps:
1. In a large non-stick skillet , over medium-high heat , saute onion in oil for 5 minutes
2. Add green beans and cayenne pepper
3. Saute for 3 minutes or until onion is translucent
4. Add zucchini , potatoes , and parsley
5. Add tomatoes and mix together
6. Bring to a boil , reduce heat , cover and simmer for 45 minutes or until potatoes are tender
7. Season with salt and pepper
8. Remove from heat and serve

title: old fashioned fudge pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. In a saucepan melt the stick of butter and the chocolate
3. Add a cup of sugar
4. Beat two eggs in a separate bowl
5. Take the chocolate mixture off of the stove and mix two tablespoons or so of the chocolate to the eggs to temper them
6. Now you can add the eggs to the chocolate without fear of them scrambling !
7. Pour into a pie shell and bake at 375 for 20-25 minutes

title: ww mashed potatoes with cauliflower
steps:
1. Combine potatoes , garlic , and enough cold water to cover by 1 inch in a large pot
2. Add 1 / 2 teaspoons salt
3. Cover and bring to boil
4. Uncover , reduce heat , and cook until potatoes are tender when pierced with
5. With slotted spoon , transfer potatoes to colander
6. Drain and let stand until cool enough to handle
7. Meanwhile , discard all but 1 inch cooking liquid from pot and return to boil
8. Put cauliflower in steamer basket
9. Set over boiling cooking liquid
10. Cover tightly and steam cauliflower until very tender , about 10 minutes
11. Remove steamer basket from pot
12. Discard cooking liquid
13. Remove potato skins
14. Working batches , press potatoes and cauliflower through potato ricer into warm pot
15. Stir in buttermilk , remaining 1 / 2 teaspoons salt , and pepper
16. Set pot over low heat and cook , stirring frequently , until mixture is heated through , about 3 minutes
17. If making ahead , let mixture cool completely
18. Transfer to large microwavable bowl
19. Cover with plastic wrap and chill up to one day
20. To serve , turn back one section of plastic wrap to vent
21. Microwave on high until hot , 4 - 5 minutes , stirring once halfway through microwaving time
22. Before serving , stir in chives

title: green treasure fruit salad
steps:
1. Core and seed the apple , and cut into pieces
2. Mix together apple , grapes , marshmallows , yogurt , and almonds

title: shiitake saut
steps:
1. Pour the oil and butter in a medium skillet and heat
2. Add mushrooms and cook over medium high for about 15 minutes , then add onions , garlic and tomatoes and cook about 5 more minutes , until onions are soft
3. Add the herbs at this point , stir and remove from heat
4. You may add the brown rice and mix all together or serve the mushrooms over the heated up brown rice
5. Salt and pepper to taste
6. Add the 1 tbsp butter , if you wish
7. This is also good with a splash of soy sauce
8. Feel free to substitute other mushrooms !
9. Enjoy !

title: jan s irish soda bread
steps:
1. Combine the flours , baking powder , salt , baking soda , and brown sugar in a large bowl
2. Mix the egg with the buttermilk and stir into the dry ingredients just to blend
3. Dust the counter with oatmeal flakes
4. Turn out dough and knead about 10 times to cover with flakes and form a round ball
5. Place on buttered cookie sheet , cut a cross lightly on top of loaf and bake at 375 for 45-50 minutes or until it sounds hollow when tapped on the bottom
6. If you don't want to use rye flour , use whole wheat
7. It works just as well

title: apple bread pudding
steps:
1. Variation
2. Try adding some dried fruit , such as apricots , cherries or dates to the pudding with the apples
3. Butter a 5-cup ovenproof dish with butter
4. Place apples in bottom of dish , then sprinkle half of the sugar over them
5. Pour wine or apple juice over the apples
6. Add the bread slices , pushing down with your hands to flatten them slightly
7. Mix the cream with eggs , the remaining sugar , and pour over the bread
8. Add zest to the top , over bread and egg mixture
9. Set aside and to soak for a minimum of 30 minutes
10. Bake in preheated 350-degree oven for about 25 minutes , until golden and set

title: cucumber carrot salad
steps:
1. Whisk together vinegar , sesame oil , sesame seeds , salt and pepper in a small bowl
2. Combine carrots , cucumber and onion in a medium bowl
3. Add the vinegar dressing and mix thoroughly
4. This travels well and tastes great at room temperature

title: red cherry pie
steps:
1. Drain cherries , reserving 1 cup juice
2. Set cherries aside
3. Combine 3 / 4 cup sugar , cornstarch , and cinnamon in a medium saucepan
4. Stir mixture to remove lumps
5. Stir cherry juice into sugar mixture
6. Cook over medium heat , stirring constantly , until smooth and thickened
7. Remove from heat
8. Stir in cherries , 1 / 2 cup sugar , butter , and almond extract
9. Stir in food coloring , if desired
10. Line a 9" pieplate with half of pastry
11. Pour cherry mixture into the pastry shell
12. Cover with top crust
13. Trim edges of pastry
14. Seal and crimp edges
15. Cut slits in top of crust for steam to escape
16. Bake at 425 for 45-55 minutes or until golden
17. Yield: one 9" pie

title: gotham rib steak
steps:
1. Bring a 32-oz
2. Rib steak to room temperature for 2 hours before cooking
3. Pre-heat oven to 350&deg
4. F
5. Brush both sides of steak with extra-virgin olive oil
6. Sprinkle both sides generously with kosher salt
7. Place steak in a broiling pan
8. Switch oven to broiler setting at high heat
9. Sear one side of the steak for 3 minutes to achieve a char that will seal in juices
10. Use tongs to flip steak to sear the other side for 3 minutes
11. After searing both sides , continue broiling an additional 15 minutes on high heat for a medium rare finish
12. Remove from oven and transfer to a platter
13. Before serving , let steak rest 15 minutes , allowing the juices to circulate internally

title: cherry lifesaver
steps:
1. Shake with ice
2. Strain into shot glass
3. Enjoy !

title: dreamy peanut butter frozen yogurt
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , combine peanut butter , brown sugar and vanilla
2. Set aside
3. In a small bowl , gradually add milk to dry whipped topping mix
4. Stir or whisk until well mixed
5. Gradually whisk into peanut butter mixture
6. Then add yogurt
7. Freeze:
8. (pour and freeze prepared yogurt in an 8 inch square baking pan , cover with foil
9. Freeze until solid break frozen mixture into pieces and process in food processor just until soft
10. Optional- repeat freezing and beating 1-2 more times)
11. Or
12. Or use your ice cream maker
13. Yield 1 quart

title: cauliflower tagine
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large dutch oven over medium heat
2. Add onion and saut 6 minutes , or until soft and translucent
3. Stir in garlic , cumin , ginger , lemon slices , bay leaves , salt and pepper and cook , stirring , until fragrant
4. Pour in broth
5. Add cauliflower , carrots , tomatoes with their juice , chickpeas , raisins and cinnamon stick
6. Bring to a boil , breaking up tomatoes into large chunks with a spoon
7. Reduce heat to low , cover pot and simmer 15 minutes , stirring several times
8. Add zucchini chunks
9. Cover pot and continue to simmer 10 minutes longer or until tender
10. To serve , spoon couscous into serving bowls
11. Top with the cauliflower tagine and juices from pot
12. Sprinkle almonds and cilantro over each serving

title: turkey a l orange
steps:
1. From 1 or 2 oranges , squeeze 1 / 3 cup of juice
2. Cut remaining orange into 1 / 4" thick slices
3. In a small bowl , combine orange juice , broth , brandy , marmalade and cornstarch
4. Stir until blended , set aside
5. In a non-stick skillet , heat oil over medium heat until hot
6. Add turkey cutlets , sprinkle with salt and pepper
7. Cook cutlets , 5-8 minutes on each side or until lightly browned on the outside and no longer pink on the inside
8. Transfer to a platter and keep warm
9. Add orange slices to skillet , cook 2 minutes
10. Transfer orange slices to platter with chicken
11. Stir juice mix to blend and add to skillet
12. Heat to boil , and boil for 1 minute , add cutlets and orange slices back into pan
13. Keep warm until ready to servce

title: shrimp and snow peas in black beans sauce
steps:
1. Combine egg white , one third of the vinegar , and 1 t of the cornstarch
2. Add the shrimp and refrigerate
3. For the sauce , mix the soy sauce , sugar , vinegar , and cornstarch
4. Quarter the onions and separate the layers
5. Stir-fry the shrimp in 3 oz of oil , remove and set aside
6. Add the remaining oil and stir-fry the garlic and ginger for 30 seconds add the onions and bean sauce for another 30 seconds
7. Add the snowpeas , shrimp and sauce until sauce has thickened
8. Serve over white rice

title: blt sandwich
steps:
1. Fry the bacon crisp and drain
2. Toast the bread
3. Spread the mayo on both slices of toast
4. You can put a little avocado on one side if you wish
5. My boys always liked this
6. Put the tomatoes , lettuce and bacon on top , with mayo side down
7. Cut diagonally

title: dee s italian green bean salad
steps:
1. Mix up dressing
2. Toss salad items
3. Add dressing
4. Chill

title: chicken a la  king
steps:
1. Bake the biscuits as directed as you prepare the main dish
2. Saute mushrooms , onions , and celery in butter until tender
3. Stir in flour and salt until blended
4. Gradually add broth and milk bring to a boil
5. Cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened
6. Add chicken and pimientos
7. Reduce heat to simmer , uncovered for 4-6 min until heated through
8. Serve with the hot biscuits

title: greggie s hotdish
steps:
1. Cook egg noodles and rinse in cold water , set aside
2. Brown ground beef and drain
3. Add salt , pepper , and garlic powder to ground beef
4. Add tomato sauce and simmer 5 minutes
5. Take 1 cup sour cream and 1 cup cottage cheese and combine with noodles
6. Layer noodles on bottom , then layer of meat , then layer of noodle
7. End with meat on top
8. Cover with shredded cheese
9. Bake in oven at 350 degrees for 45 minutes , or until bubbly
10. Covered with foil

title: delicious menudo  without tripe
steps:
1. Brown onions about 5 minutes
2. Add meat and garlic
3. Add rest of ingredients and simmer about an hour

title: lemon pepper seasoning mix
steps:
1. Stir all the ingredients together and store in airtight jars
2. Lemon pepper adds a piquant flavor when used on grilled meats
3. Attach this to the jar

title: pork tenderloin napoli
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Heat the oil in an ovenproof skillet over medium high heat
3. Season the meat with salt and pepper and brown the pork on all sides in the skillet
4. Mix together the tomatoes , olives , wine , rosemary and garlic in a bowl and pour over the pork
5. Place skillet in the oven and bake for 30 minutes or until it reaches an internal temperature of 160
6. Remove pork from skillet and cover with foil to keep warm
7. Place skillet with remaining tomato mixture over medium heat and gradually mix in the cream
8. Bring to a boil , stirring constantly , then reduce heat to low and continue cooking for 5 minutes until thickened
9. Slice pork and drizzle with the cream sauce to serve

title: blueberry sour cream pie  easy
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl , combine first 6 ingredients
2. Mix well
3. Pour into unbaked pie shell
4. Bake in 350 oven for 30 minutes or until center is set
5. Top hot pie with blueberry pie filling
6. Chill for several hours
7. When ready to serve top with whipped cream or cool whip

title: lava puffs
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients except for jam in a bowl
2. Mix well
3. Place mixture between 2 sheets of waxed paper and roll out to 1 / 8 - 1 / 4 inch thickness
4. Cut out 24 circles with 3-inch round cookie or biscuit cutter , rerolling scraps as necessary
5. Place 12 circles into a muffin tin , pressing down slightly to form a cup
6. Drop 1 tablespoon jam into each cup
7. Place remaining 12 circles on top of jam and press down edges gently to seal
8. Poke a hole in the top of each cup with a toothpick
9. Bake at 400 f for 15 minutes or until golden brown
10. Remove from muffin tin and sprinkle with powdered sugar , if desired
11. Filling will be very hot !

title: high fiber oat bar
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Take oats , wheat germ , sunflower seeds and place on baking tray
3. Put in oven for 15 minutes , stirring every 5 minutes
4. Take honey , brown sugar , vanilla , butter and place in saucepan on medium heat
5. Once dissolved , scoop oats mixture into melted sugar and stir
6. Add in fiber one cereal and stir until incorporated
7. In a separate 9 x 13 baking pan , oil the interior , then add the entire honey oat fiber one mixture
8. Use the bottom of another pan which has been oiled to flattened and even the top of the baking pan
9. Sprinkle the chocolate chips over the entire baking pan
10. Put into the oven and bake at 300 degrees for about 25 minutes
11. Cut into squares and enjoy !

title: marinated and grilled zucchini and summer squash
steps:
1. Whisk together the vinegar , lemon juice , garlic and thyme in a large bowl
2. Season with salt and pepper and gradually whisk in the olive oil
3. Slice both of the squash diagonally into 1 / 4" thick slices
4. Spoon 3 tablespoons of the marinade into a small bowl , cover and set aside
5. Add all the squash to the remaining marinade in the large bowl and toss to coat
6. Transfer the mixture to a 13x9 glass baking dish , cover and marinate at room temperature for at least 3 hours
7. Can also be refrigerated for up to one day to marinate
8. Season squash with a little additional salt and pepper and grill on the barbecue or on an indoor grill pan until they are crisp tender and brown , turning occasionally for about 8 minutes
9. Transfer squash to a serving platter and drizzle with the reserved 3 tablespoons of marinade
10. Serve hot or at room temperature

title: apple squares snack
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 deg f
2. Cream butter and sugar and beat in egg
3. Combine flour , baking powder , salt , cinnamon , and nutmeg and gradually add to butter and sugar mixture
4. Gently stir in apples and nuts , and spread in buttered 8"x8" pan
5. Bake 35 minutes

title: nif s chicken caprese
steps:
1. Heat olive oil over medium-high heat in a nonstick pan
2. Season both sides of chicken breasts with salt and pepper
3. Add chicken to pan and brown , about 2 minutes per side
4. Cut 1 / 2 of the tomatoes in half and add all tomatoes to the pan
5. Cover pan , turn to medium and cook for approximately 3 minutes per side
6. Remove lid and add basil
7. Cook until chicken has reached an internal temperature of 180f
8. Slide chicken and tomato mixture into an oven proof dish
9. Add 1 slice of mozzarella to the top of each breast
10. Place under broiler and heat until cheese has just started to melt
11. The time really depends on the heat of your broiler
12. Remove chicken from oven and drizzle with balsamic vinegar

title: shot and a beer pork stew  or tacos
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Wipe chiles clean with a damp cloth
3. In a dry , heavy saucepan over medium heat , toast chiles until fragrant and puffy , turning occasionally to keep them from burning , 3 to 5 minutes
4. Let cool slightly , then remove stems , seeds , and membranes
5. Pour beer and tequila over chiles to soften
6. Meanwhile , season pork with salt
7. Heat oil in a heavy , large ovenproof pot such as a dutch oven over medium-high heat
8. Brown half the pork at a time , turning as needed , 8 to 10 minutes per batch
9. Transfer browned pork to a bowl
10. Add onion and garlic to pot
11. Cook until soft , stirring often , 5 minutes
12. Stir in beer mixture , tomatoes , oregano , cumin , and pork
13. Add water if needed to barely cover pork
14. Bring to a boil over high heat
15. Cover
16. Bake stew until pork is falling-apart tender , 3 hours
17. Skim fat
18. Ladle stew into bowls and serve with accompaniments

title: italian sausage and pepper rotini
steps:
1. Prepare pasta according to package directions
2. Drain and set aside
3. Brown sausage in a large skillet over medium-high heat
4. Drain off grease and set aside
5. Saute peppers and onions in 2 tablespoons hot oil over medium-high heat 2 to 3 minutes or until crisp-tender
6. Stir in tomatoes , broth , and sausage
7. Cook 3 minutes or until tomatoes are tender and mixture thickens slightly
8. Remove from heat
9. Add cooked pasta to tomato mixture and stir
10. Sprinkle with cheese and parsley
11. Serve

title: portuguese favas
steps:
1. Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat , then add onion & garlic & saute until golden brown
2. Add red pepper flakes , tomato sauce , hot water , parsley , salt , pepper & paprika & bring to a boil
3. Reduce heat & simmer for 30 minutes
4. Gently stir in fava beans , then remove from heat & let stand several minutes to allow flavors to meld before serving

title: onion roll appetizers
steps:
1. Chop onions
2. Place in frying pan with butter
3. Fry for 20 minutes or until onions are limp
4. Stir in cream cheese and grated swiss cheese
5. Stir until melts
6. Spread on tortillas
7. Roll and refrigerate overnight
8. To cook: grease baking sheet
9. Cut into 1" pieces
10. Bake , upright , at 375 degrees for 10 minutes or until lightly brown

title: crunchy green salad
steps:
1. After preparing all vegetables , place in large bowl
2. Dressing- blend the yoghurt , vinegar and salt and pepper in blender
3. Stir in cheese
4. Pour over vegetables and toss well
5. Marinate 1 hour before serving

title: rosemary sweet potato soup
steps:
1. In dutch oven over medium high heat , combine chicken broth , sweet potatoes , carrots and 2 tsp
2. Rosemary
3. Bring to boil
4. Reduce heat to low , cover and simmer 20 minutes or until vegetables are tender
5. In medium skillet , combine butter , onion and garlic over medium heat
6. Stirring constantly , cook 8 minutes or until onions are translucent , transfer to large food processor
7. Reserving liquid , transfer sweet potato mixture to food processor , process until smooth
8. Stir pureed mixture into liquid
9. Stir in orange juice , salt and peppers
10. Return to low heat , cook 10 minutes or until heated through
11. Garnish each serving with fresh rosemary

title: apricot poppy chicken with dill potatoes
steps:
1. In a medium pot , add the potatoes and enough cold water to cover by 1 inch
2. Cover the pot and bring to a boil
3. Salt the water , lower the heat and simmer the potatoes , uncovered , until fork-tender , 12 to 15 minutes
4. While the potatoes are working , in a large skillet , heat the oil , 2 turns of the pan , over medium-high heat
5. Season the chicken with salt and pepper and cook in the skillet , turning once , until browned , 2 minutes total
6. Add the shallots and cook for 3 minutes
7. Add the vinegar and cook until slightly reduced , 1 minute
8. Add the chicken broth , apricot preserves , honey and poppy seeds and simmer over medium-low heat , stirring
9. Stir in 1 tablespoon butter
10. Drain the potatoes , return to their pot and add the remaining 2 tablespoons butter , the dill and salt and pepper to taste
11. Serve with the chicken

title: potato chip breadsticks
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Unroll breadstick dough
3. Seperate into 12 breadsticks and twist each stick 3 times and place ungreased baking sheets
4. Carefully brush with beaten egg
5. Sprinkle with crushed potato chips
6. Bake at 350 for 16-18 minutes until golden brown
7. Serve warm

title: spinach artichoke dip  slow cooker
steps:
1. Cube cheese and add to slow cooker
2. Chop artichoke hearts and spinach and add to cheese
3. Place in a slow cooker on high setting
4. Add garlic and pepper
5. Heat until melted , stirring occasionally
6. Takes about 1-2 hours

title: champurrado with honey  mexican hot chocolate
steps:
1. Add cinnamon , mexican chocolate and two cups of water to a stock pot
2. Bring to a simmer , stirring constantly until chocolate melts
3. In a separate bowl mix the corn dough with a cup of water until smooth
4. Pour corn mixture into the hot chocolate , stirring constantly
5. Add the milk and honey to the pot , let it simmer over low heat , stirring frequently until the milk thickens , being careful not to let milk burn
6. Champurrado should be the consistency of heavy cream , if yours it too thick , just add more milk
7. For authenticity
8. Froth the mixture with a mexican molinillo prior to serving

title: italian chicken rollups
steps:
1. Place each chicken breast half between 2 slices of heavy-duty plastic wrap , pound to inch thickness , using a meat mallet or rolling pin
2. Combine basil , salt , and pepper
3. Sprinkle half of mixture evenly over both sides of chicken
4. Place 1 string cheese stick across the center of each flattened chicken brest
5. Roll up chicken jelly roll fashion , starting with short end
6. Place chicken rollup , seam side down , in an 11x7-inch baking dish
7. Sprinkle with remaining half of spice mixture , and coat with cooking spray
8. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 and up to 8 hours
9. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
10. Pour marinara sauce over chicken
11. Bake uncovered for 35 minutes or until chicken is done and tomato sauce is thoroughly heated

title: most delicious egg white omelette ever
steps:
1. Whip the egg whites in a blender or with an immersion blender until they are fluffy
2. Add in the feta , pepper and oregano and whip again
3. Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat and spray lightly with pure olive oil cooking spray
4. Pour in the egg mixture and cook for 2 minutes
5. Cover and cook for 2 more minutes
6. Uncover and flip the eggs over
7. Cook for 1 more minute
8. If you want to add veggies , you can put them on 1 / 2 of the egg mixture and fold the other half over them
9. Then slide the eggs onto a plate
10. My favorite veggie combo is spinach , green onion and roasted red pepper
11. Enjoy !

title: italian inspired potatoes
steps:
1. Place potato halves cut side up in a single layer in a microwavable dish that has a lid
2. Put 1 tablespoon of water in the bottom of the dish
3. Sprinkle potato halves with garlic salt
4. Cover and microwave on high 8-15 minutes until tender
5. Meanwhile , mix together the cheese , oregano , salami and sundried tomatoes
6. When potatoes are done top them evenly with the cheese mixture
7. Place one red bell pepper strip on each potato and arrange green olive rings around them
8. Microwave for 1-2 minutes until the cheese is melted
9. Serve with sour cream if desired

title: armenian pizza   lahmajoun
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients except tortillas together in a large bowl
2. Adjust seasonings to taste
3. Spread meat mixture thinly on each tortilla
4. Bake on large cookie sheets at 375 degrees for 15 minutes

title: darlene s italian herb crock pot chicken
steps:
1. Put chicken breasts in crock pot
2. Pour can of tomatoes and tomato sauce over chicken
3. Sprinkle italian seasoning over top
4. Pour orzo on top and add water
5. Give a good stir and cook on low till done to your satisfaction

title: little caesars style crazy bread
steps:
1. Divide breadsticks according to package directions
2. Melt butter and then stir in garlic powder
3. Dip each piece of dough into butter and then place on cookie sheets
4. Cook on 375 for 7 minutes then add more garlic butter to bread
5. Bake for 7 more minutes
6. Shake parmesean cheese over bread liberally

title: strawberry buttercream
steps:
1. Directions
2. In a saucepan , place the sugar and carefully pour the water around the edge
3. Using your finger , make an x in the pan to help the water gently mix with the sugar
4. Bring to a boil and cook to softball stage meanwhile , whip the egg whites in a mixer with a whip attachment until light and fluffy
5. When sugar is at the softball stage , slowly pour it into the bowl down the side and continue whipping , adding vanilla , butter , and strawberries until incorporated and then cooled

title: lentils with chorizo   red wine
steps:
1. Fry the onion and garlic in a little oil then add the lentils , red wine , stock , vinegar and thyme
2. Simmer gently for 30 minutes until tender , add the chorizo for the last 5 minutes of cooking time
3. Season with salt and pepper
4. Stir through the parsley
5. Serve with lots of crusty bread

title: omelet brunch
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325
2. In a large mixing bowl , beat the eggs , sour cream , milk , and salt and pepper
3. Fold in the green onions
4. Pour mixture into a greased 13x9 inch baking dish
5. Bake for 45-55 minutes or until eggs are set
6. Immediately sprinkle cheese over the top
7. Let set a few minutes then cut into squares and serve

title: chicken noodle soup and dumplings
steps:
1. Begin heating your soup combined with the water in a large pot with a tight fitting lid
2. Combine your dry ingredients in a medium sized mixing bowl
3. Stir lightly to mix , being careful not to lose any over the side
4. Create a hollow in the middle of your dry ingredients
5. Add your milk to the hollow
6. Add your oil to the milk
7. Using a fork , mix the ingredients until a sticky dough is formed
8. Do not overmix
9. When your soup is boiling , quickly add spoonfuls of the dough until the entire bowlful is in the pot
10. Make sure to move quickly - the faster you get them in , the fluffier they'll be
11. Quickly cover the pot with the tight fitting lid
12. Reduce the heat to medium and cook for 10 minutes
13. Never lift the lid before 10 minutes has passed or you will have dense dumplings instead of light , fluffy ones
14. After 10 minutes , remove from heat and serve
15. Dumplings will be very hot

title: muenster mushroom chipotle cream soup
steps:
1. In a large skillet over medium heat , heat oil and butter
2. When butter is melted , add potatoes , onion and white mushrooms
3. Season with salt and pepper
4. Saute until onions are translucent , add broth , cheese and chipotle
5. Stir to combine and allow to simmer until potatoes are very soft , stirring frequently- do not worry if cheese seems to clump
6. Puree soup in a blender or food processor , strain through a sieve back into a saucepan and add cream and portabellas
7. Heat gently until just simmering
8. Serve hot

title: crunchy romaine toss
steps:
1. Make the sweet and sour dressing and set aside
2. Brown walnuts and noodles in butter
3. Cool on paper towels
4. Combine noodles and walnuts with broccoli , romaine and onions
5. Pour sweet and sour dressing over salad and toss to coat well

title: cherry jello cookies  gift mix in a jar
steps:
1. Creating the gift in a jar:
2. Wash and thoroughly dry a 1-quart wide-mouth canning jar
3. Loosely layer the ingredients in the jar as listed above starting with the flour , salt , baking powder , gelatin and then the sugar - making the layers as level as possible without pressing it down
4. Secure the lid and decorate as desired
5. Attach the instructions for making these cookies found below
6. Cherry jello cookies gift tag:
7. Additional ingredients to be added by the recipient: 3 / 4 cup butter , softened , 2 eggs and 1 tsp vanilla extract
8. Cookie instructions:
9. Preheat oven to 375
10. In a large bowl , blend the butter , eggs and vanilla extract
11. Add the contents of the jar , and stir until well mixed
12. Drop the dough by heaping teaspoonfuls onto an ungreased baking sheet , spacing the cookies about 2 inches apart
13. Bake for 10-12 minutes , or until the edges are light brown in color
14. Allow to cool for 5 minutes on the baking sheet , then transfer to wire racks and cool completely
15. Serve immediately or store in an airtight container for up to 2 weeks

title: sloppy joe sliders
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large pot
2. Saute onions 3 minutes until tender
3. Add ground beef to pot
4. Cook until brown , stirring to separate meat
5. Drain well
6. Stir in bbq sauce , mustard and worcestershire
7. Simmer about 5 minutes until flavors are blended
8. Spoon onto slider rolls

title: tesco cornish pasties
steps:
1. Place butter in the freezer for 3 hours to freeze hard , then coarsely grate it
2. Stir flour and salt together in large bowl
3. Stir in grated butter and 13 tablespoons of ice cold water and mix to a firm dough
4. Wrap in plastic wrap and leave to rest
5. Mix veggies and meat with seasonings
6. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
7. Cut pastry into 4 and roll each out into an 8" circle
8. Cut round a plate to get the size
9. Brush edges with milk and then pile 1 / 4 of the filling into the center
10. Draw edges up to meet in the middle , seal and flute the seam of the pastry
11. Repeat with other 3
12. Place on a baking sheet and brush with milk
13. Make airholes in each with a skewer
14. Cook towards the top of the oven for 20 minutes
15. Reduce heat to 350 and cook for another 40 minutes , until crisp and golden
16. Serve warm

title: traditional supper stuffing
steps:
1. Preheat oven the 325f
2. Scatter bread on a baking sheet and season with poultry seasoning
3. Toast in the oven until golden , 10 to 12 minutes
4. Set aside
5. In a large skillet , melt 3 tablespoons butter over medium heat
6. Add apples , onions , celery , bay leaf , salt , and pepper , and cook until tender , 7 to 8 minutes
7. Stir in the chicken , parsley , and 2 cups chicken broth , and cook until heated through , 3 to 4 minutes
8. Stir in bread cubes
9. In a small saucepan , melt the remaining 2 tablespoons butter over medium heat
10. Whisk in the flour for 1 minute
11. Whisk in the remaining 2 cups chicken broth
12. Season the gravy with salt and pepper
13. Discard the bay leaf
14. Serve the stuffing in bowls topped with the gravy

title: grilled chicken brazilian style
steps:
1. Clean chicken and rub with salt
2. Combine olive oil and garlic and marinate chicken for at least 2 hours
3. Place chicken on the grill and roast slowly
4. Delicious !

title: monster mashed potatoes
steps:
1. Place each vegetable in a separate bowl
2. Add 2 tablespoons butter , 2 tablespoons cream , salt , pepper , and nutmeg to taste to each bowl
3. In a large bowl , gently swirl the 4 vegetable mixtures together , making sure each color remains distinct in areas
4. Serve hot

title: fish with sage and garlic sauce
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f
2. Separate and peel the garlic , and simmer in water til they are soft , about 20 minutes
3. Reserve several whole cloves , and let the rest simmer for 10 minutes more
4. Then push through a fine strainer , so you have about 1 / 4 cup of puree
5. Season the fish with salt and pepper and roll in flour , then saute fillets in the olive oil with the whole garlic cloves til just browned on high heat
6. Then place in oven to bake til firm
7. Meanwhile , heat the sage , broth , garlic puree and cream , and whisk until just thickened , ~5 min
8. Pour the sauce over the fish a few minutes before it is done
9. Serve with a couple of spoonfuls of sauce over the fish

title: chicken roulades with roasted red peppers
steps:
1. Pound chicken breasts with a mallet or between wax paper with a rolling pin , pound chicken to about 1 / 4 thick
2. Place one long piece of roasted red pepper , 1 teaspoons pesto , & 1 tablespoon cream cheese along one long side of the breast , roll jellyroll fashion and secure with toothpicks , sprinkle with salt and pepper
3. Chill in refrigerator for 1-2 hours ,
4. Lightly cover the bottom of a baking pan with olive oil , place chicken rolls in pan and spray tops with baking spray and sprinkle tops with seasoned breadcrumbs
5. Bake covered about 20 minutes until juices run clear , then cook another 5 minutes to brown tops
6. Serve with juices from baking pan

title: fresh bouquet garni by toula patsalis
steps:
1. Tie together with cotton twine
2. Add to the ingredients while cooking your favorite dish

title: taco bell quesadillas
steps:
1. Combine sauce ingredients and stir until smooth
2. Grill chicken in vegetable oil and cut into thin slices
3. Preheat skillet over medium heat
4. One at a time , lay tortilla into hot skillet and sprinkle with 1 / 4 cup of each shredded cheese and 1 / 2 cheese slice on one side of the tortilla
5. Arrange about 1 / 4 cup chicken slices over tortilla on the same half covered with cheese
6. On the empty side , spread about one tablespoon of sauce
7. Fold over , and press gently with spatula
8. Cook until cheese is melted and slice each into 4 pieces

title: slow simmered spaghetti sauce
steps:
1. In a large stockpot cook the sausage , yellow bell pepper , orange bell pepper , garlic , onion , and celery
2. Cook until sausage is no longer pink
3. Drain into a large colander to drain grease
4. To the large saucepot , add the mushrooms , tomato sauce , tomatoes , tomato paste , bouillon cubes , bay leaves , thyme , oregano , basil , crushed red pepper , black pepper , sugar , and beef broth and stir well
5. Pour the meat mixture into the pot
6. Bring to a boil , reduce heat and cover
7. Simmer for 2 hours
8. Salt and pepper to taste to pull flavors together toward end of cooking time
9. Serve with spaghetti or favorite pasta

title: easy nilla tiramisu
steps:
1. Whip the cream cheese and then add the liquer and whip some more
2. Next , add the sugar and mix really well
3. Gently stir in the whipped topping
4. Line an 8" dish with nilla wafers and spoon over them some of the cream cheese mixture
5. Keep layering until you've used all the cream cheese mixture
6. Lastly , dust with the cocoa and refrigerate for several hours

title: sweet potato chicken salad
steps:
1. Combine chicken , potatoes and green beans in large bowl
2. To make dressing , combine mayonnaise , yogurt , milk , dill weed , salt and pepper in small bowl
3. Pour dressing over chicken mixture
4. Stir gently to coat evenly
5. To allow flavors to develop , cover salad and refrigerate at least 30 minutes before serving
6. Garnish salad with chopped toasted pecans
7. Serve with warm pita bread , cut in triangles
8. Refrigerate leftovers

title: baked spicy fries
steps:
1. Cut potatoes into wedges or slices and lightly spray a baking sheet with fat-free oil
2. Place potato wedges or slices in a plastic bag with spices and half of the oil , then toss to cover all
3. Bake at 350 for about 45 minutes turning and brushing often with the remaining oil
4. Broil about 5 minutes turning after 3 minutes

title: smothered taters
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Scrub potatoes and clean then up
3. Stab them all over with a fork
4. If you want soft skins than you need to rub the outside with butter and then wrap in foil
5. Place potatoes in a metal bake sheet and bake at 350 degrees for 70 to 80 minutes or until tender
6. Hint some microwaves have settings that make baked potatoes but do not cover them in foil
7. Start preparing the next part of the meal when the potatoes have about 30 minutes left
8. In a bowl you need to add 8 ounces of sour cream and 1 / 2 cup of flour
9. Place the bouillon granules on the chopping board
10. Use a clever turned side ways to press the granules flat
11. This should make them like a powder
12. Add the bouillon powder , 1 / 2 cup of water , and some pepper in to the bowl and stir
13. Once you have the mixture stirred you can set it aside
14. In a skillet put two tablespoon of butter , one tablespoon of minced garlic , mushrooms , and your desired amount of onions
