15. Cook over medium heat until the mushrooms cook down to your liking
16. Add the flour mixture to the skillet
17. Add the desired amount of salt pepper and italian seasoning
18. Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly
19. Cut the cooked potatoes in half , mash the insides up a little , pour the sauce over the top , and enjoy !

title: snapper livornese
steps: 1. Score snapper skins in 1 inch crosshatch season both sides of fish with salt and pepper add olive oil to pan and cook skin side down for 4 to 5 minutes until skin is crisp turn fillets and cook on reverse side 3 minutes transfer to serving dish , keep covered reduce heat to medium add olive oil and garlic , saute 2 minutes add wine and reduce by half , about 2 minutes add tomatoes and parsley and simmer 2 minutes pour over fish and serve

title: acadia s super easy caesar dill sauce
steps:
1. Mix dill weed with caesar dressing
2. Spread on fish 1-minute before you remove it from the heat
3. Enjoy !

title: eggs fairlee
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f and butter a casserole dish
2. Melt butter and saute the onions until translucent
3. Cover bottom of prepared casserole with half the onions
4. Add eggs , season to taste , and cover with remaining onions
5. Pour white sauce over all , sprinkle top with buttered crumbs and bake until golden , about 20 minutes

title: whole wheat cottage cheese rolls
steps:
1. In large bowl , combine 1 / 3 cup all-purpose flour , 3 / 4 cup whole-wheat flour , yeast , brown sugar , salt , and baking soda
2. Mix well
3. In saucepan , heat water , cottage cheese , and butter until warm
4. Remove from heat and add eggs to the liquid mixture
5. Combine dry and wet ingredients , blend at low speed until moistened , beat 3 minutes at medium speed
6. By hand , gradually add all of the whole-wheat flour and enough of the all purpose to make a firm , non-sticky dough
7. Knead until smooth and elastic - 5 minutes or so
8. Place in greased bowl , flipping to grease top
9. Cover and let rise in warm place until doubled
10. This takes roughly an hour
11. Punch down dough and divide into 24 pieces
12. Form these into balls and place in greased muffin cups
13. Cover and let rise until doubled , another 45 minutes
14. Bake in an oven preheated to 375 for 12-15 minutes

title: texas longhorn touchdown brownies
steps:
1. In a 3-4 quart pan over low heat , stir butter with cocoa until melted
2. Off the heat , beat in sugar
3. Add eggs and vanilla
4. Beat well
5. Add flour , pecans , and chocolate
6. Mix well
7. Spread batter in buttered 9x13" pan
8. Bake in a 325 degree oven until top feels dry in center , about 35 minutes
9. Cool in pan
10. If baking ahead , wrap airtight when cool and hold up to a day
11. Cut into 12 to 16 pieces

title: orange sugared walnuts
steps:
1. Sift confectioner's sugar , cornstarch , cinnamon , cloves , allspice and salt into a medium size bowl
2. Stir in orange rind
3. Beat egg whites and orange juice until slightly foamy
4. Stir in walnuts
5. Toss to coat well
6. Drain thoroughly
7. Roll walnuts in sugar mixture , a third at a time , until evenly coated
8. Spread out on two parchment paper lined jelly-roll pans so the nuts do not touch
9. Bake at 250 for about 1 hour or until dry
10. Cool completely before storing in a tightly covered container
11. Walnuts may be stored for up to 1 month

title: tropicolada   non alcoholic
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in blender
2. Mix on high speed until ice is crushed and drink is frothy
3. Pour into a tall glass and enjoy
4. Amounts can be varied to taste

title: spinach arancini  rice balls
steps:
1. In large , deep saucepan over medium-high heat , add the olive oil
2. Add the onions and saute for about 1 minute
3. Add the garlic stir
4. After another 5 minutes , add the rice and white wine and a pinch of salt stir and allow to cook down for about 5 to 10 minutes
5. Add 2 ladles of broth
6. Allow to absorb into rice for about 10 minutes , stirring , then add another 2 of broth and allow that to absorb for about 10 minutes
7. Season with freshly ground black pepper , to taste
8. Add spinach to broth and rice and stir in with sweet butter
9. Add 1 cup of the parmigiano
10. When all ingredients are hot and mixed , pour and spread onto a parchment lined cookie sheet to cool
11. Once cool , cover with a layer of plastic wrap to avoid skin forming and refrigerate until completely cooled and firm
12. Refrigerate overnight if necessary
13. When completely cooled , cover rice and spinach with remaining 1 / 2 cup parmigiano
14. With hands , roll into 1 1 / 2-inch balls
15. With fingers , make a small hole in the rice ball's center and insert 1 small cube of mozzarella , and cover with more rice
16. Place flour , beaten eggs , and seasoned bread crumbs in separate bowls
17. Coat each ball with flour , then with whisked egg , then with seasoned breadcrumbs
18. Repeat with all rice balls and lay the coated balls on a cookie tray and refrigerate until ready to fry
19. In a heavy large pan , heat vegetable oil to 350 degrees f
20. Fry the balls , in batches , until golden brown
21. Remove each ball with a slotted spoon and place on parchment paper or paper towel lined cookie sheet to dry
22. Serve hot

title: peanut butter salad dressing
steps:
1. Whisk together first 7 ingredients in a bowl until blended and smooth
2. Serve over mixed salad greens

title: ethiopian beef in pepper sauce
steps:
1. Trim fat from beef
2. Cut into 1 inch strips
3. Place chopped peppers , jalapenos , garlic , wine , gingerroot , salt , turmeric and cardamom in blender , cover and blend on medium high 45 seconds
4. Heat margarine and oil in skillet , brown beef
5. Saute and onion and pepper strips til tender ,
6. Add blender mixture
7. Heat to boiling , reduce heat , simmer uncovered until beef is hot and sauce is slightly thickened

title: teriyaki fish kabobs
steps:
1. Cut fish , red or green pepper , and onions into 1 inch pieces
2. Alternately thread fish , red or green pepper , onions , and pineapple chunks , if using , onto 4 large skewers
3. Set aside
4. Prepare rice a roni mix as package directs
5. While rice is simmering , combine soy sauce , sherry , oil and garlic
6. Brush kabobs with soy sauce mixture
7. Grill over medium coals 14 minutes or broil 5 to 6 inches from heat 10 minutes , or until seafood is opaque , turning once and brushing with remaining soy sauce mixture
8. Serve rice topped with kabobs
9. Enjoy !

title: spicy banana soup
steps:
1. Peel and dice onion
2. Clean and dice the chili pepper
3. Heat 1 tbsp oil in a meium sauce pan and saut onion and pepper until soft but dont brown
4. Add orange juice , zest , and 2 cups vegetable broth
5. Stir in the ketchup
6. Cover pot bring to boil , low heat to medium and cook for 5 minutes
7. Add two of the bananas to the soup and puree
8. In a dry frying pan roast the grated coconut , until lightly browned , then let cool slightly on a plate
9. Peel and slice the last banana , coat with the coconut by pressing the banana slices slightly and turning then pressing again
10. In a frying pan heat 1 tbsp oil , then fry the coated banana slices on both sides
11. To serve laddle the soup into bowls then float the fried banana slices on top , sprinkle any left over coconut on top
12. Can garnish with finely sliced chili pepper rings and fine herbs
13. Enjoy

title: lighter  lamb moussaka
steps:
1. Prepare the sauce: melt margarine in a medium saucepan over medium heat
2. Add flour , cook stirring for about 3 minutes
3. Add milk and broth , stirring until the mixture thickens , about 5 minutes
4. Spray a medium baking dish with veggie spray
5. Spray a large skillet with veggie spray add eggplant and the beef broth
6. Cook over medium heat stirring until tender about 8 minutes
7. Remove eggplant and broth
8. Spray the pan again and add the onions and garlic
9. Cook until golden , add lamb
10. Cook stirring until no longer pink about 10 minutes
11. Drain off any fat and add feta , parsley and mint
12. Preheat oven to 350f
13. Spoon half the eggplant into the prepared dish
14. Top with the lamb mixture
15. Then add remaining eggplant
16. Pour sauce over top
17. Bake for 30 minutes and serve

title: cheesecake  no bake
steps:
1. Melt white chocolate chips in saucepan
2. Mix in cream cheese
3. Mix in cool whip
4. Pour into crust
5. Cover and refrigerate overnight

title: coffee martini
steps:
1. Pour your vodka into a shaker 1 / 2 full with cracked ice and shake a few times
2. Pour in kahlua and stir gently to mix and while stirring slowly pour in your espresso
3. Strain into two frozen martini glasses
4. Add three coffee beans to each glass for garnish
5. Serve

title: adult root beer floats
steps:
1. Fill glass with ice
2. Pour in root beer
3. Add vanilla ice cream
4. Top with bourbon
5. Stir and enjoy !

title: lentil and roasted vegetable wraps
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees
2. In a small pot bring the lentils and water to a boil , then lower the heat and simmer for about 25 minutes , adidng water if neccessary
3. While lentils are coming to a boil , spray a baking sheet lightly with cooking oil and space pepper , eggplant halves , scallions , tomatoes , and wrapped garlic in a single layer
4. Bake until tender
5. Once lentils are done drain them and combine them in a bowl with oil , vinegar , honey , oregano , and cumin
6. Add veggies to bowl as they become tender
7. The first done should be the green onions and the tomatoes
8. Next should be the garlic , cut the cloves in half and squeeze the pulp into the bowl
9. Peel the pepper , halve , seed it , chop it roughly and add it to the bowl
10. Lastly scrap the eggplant from it's skin with a fork , it should take about 40 minutes to roast
11. Toss everything in the dressing and scoop it into the warm tortillas
12. Serve with cottage or fetta cheese if desired

title: yeast rolls in a flash
steps:
1. Combine milk , shortening and yeast
2. Add sugar , salt and flour
3. Roll out and cut with biscuit cutter
4. Place on greased baking pan , let rise in warm draft free place for 30 minutes
5. Bake at 350' degrees f
6. For 15-20 minutes

title: 1950 s brownies
steps:
1. Melt in microwave or in double boiler baking chocolate and shortening
2. Beat in sugar in eggs
3. Mix together sifted flour , baking powder salt and then mix with wet ingredients
4. Stir in nuts
5. Bake in a 8x8x2" well greased pan at 350 degrees for 20 to 35 minutes until top is dry and only slightly wet crumbs come out on test knife
6. Amout: 16 2" squares

title: chicken biscuit stew
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375 degrees
2. Melt margarine in 10-inch oven-proof skillet
3. Stir in flour and pepper
4. Cook , stirring constantly , for 1 minute , or until smooth and bubbly
5. Gradually stir in broth and milk
6. Cook until mixture boils and thickens , stirring constantly
7. Add chicken , peas , carrots and onion
8. Cook until hot and bubbly , stirring occasionally
9. Separate dough into 10 biscuits
10. Arrange biscuits over hot chicken mixture in skillet
11. Sprinkle with poppy seed
12. Bake for 20-25 minutes , or until biscuits are golden brown
13. Makes 5 servings

title: cheesy lasagna for leftover meatloaf
steps:
1. Put olive oil in a large saucepan over med-high heat
2. Add onions , carrots , fennel , garlic , chopped red pepper and fry until onions and carrots are starting to soften and brown , approx 7-8 minutes
3. Add pasta sauce to pan along with ground red pepper
4. Reduce to a low heat and cover , cooking for approximately 15 minutes until veggies are tender
5. Be sure to stir occasionally
6. While that is cooking , mix your cheesesin a bowl , and add basil and italian seasoning and stir
7. Preheat your oven to 350 degrees f degrees
8. Then you will want to lightly grease a 3 qt baking dish
9. Proceed by lining the bottom of your dish with a single layer of lasgane noodles
10. Spread 1 / 3 of your sauce over the noodles and cover this with 1 / 2 of the crumbled meatloaf
11. Then top with 1 / 4 of the cheese mixture
12. Repeat exact layering 2 more times-- while alternating the directions of noodles at each level
13. Cover your dish with foil and bake 35-40 minutes
14. Proceed by taking the foil off and sprinkling the rest of the cheese mixture on top and bake 8 minutes or until lasgana is cooked through and top is bubbling
15. Let stand for a few minutes before serving
16. Enjoy !

title: mother s cabbage relish
steps:
1. Combine first four ingredients in saucepan , boil 1 minute
2. Pour hot mixture over slaw
3. Chill
4. In a covered dish relish will keep for up to one week

title: vegetarian cheeseburger casserole
steps:
1. Mix all but kraft singles and tater tots in a casserole dish , top with cheese slices and tater tots
2. Bake at 375 for 30 min , then turn heat up to 425 for 10 min
3. Let cool 10 min before serving with salad

title: traditional aussie lamb
steps:
1. Preheat oven 350f
2. Cut small slits all over the skin of the leg of lamb
3. Insert garlic pieces and rosemary sprigs
4. Brush lamb with oil and sprinkle with salt and pepper
5. Fill a baking dish halfway with water and place a wire rack on top and then put the lamb on the dish
6. Roast for about 1 hours or until cooked as desired , basting often with the pan juices
7. Peel potatoes , cut in half and score them with a fork
8. Combine butter , oil , salt and thyme
9. Toss potatoes in the mixture
10. Take potatoes out and keep mixture for later
11. Place potatoes around the leg of lamb after the lamb has been cooking for about 40 minutes
12. Roast for 50 minutes , brushing halfway through with a little of the butter mixture
13. Toss pumpkin pieces in the mixture and place next to the roast after it has been cooking for 50 minutes
14. Wrap 1 bacon rasher around each half of leek
15. Place leeks next to pumpkins after roast has been baking for 70 minutes
16. When everything is done , take the rack off the baking dish and place the rack on an oven proof tray
17. Return to oven to keep warm
18. To make gravy , place the baking dish with the juices from the meat on the stove top
19. Discard all but 3 tablespoons of the juices
20. Heat the dish , stir in the flour and cook until brown
21. Gradually add beef stock , worcestershire sauce and wine
22. Stir until the mixture boils and thickens , then simmer for 2 minutes
23. Slice the meat and arrange everything on plates
24. Pour the gravy over the meat

title: pumpkin and orange soup
steps:
1. Saute onion g ently in butter in a large saucepan until transparent
2. Add chunks of pumpkin , stock , juice , zest and sugar
3. Simmer 20-25 minutes until cooked
4. Puree in a food processor or blender or push through a sieve
5. Return to saucepan , add sliced orange and reheat gently for 10 minutes
6. Freezes well

title: minted citrus salad  ww core
steps:
1. Serve immediately or transfer to a container and refrigerate up to 2 days
2. Top each portion with 1 tablespoon of yogurt before serving
3. Garnish with slivered mint leaves if desired
4. Yields about 1 cup per serving
5. Add fruit segments to bowl , stir in mint , cover and chill

title: chilled strawberry soup
steps:
1. Puree strawberries , milk , cream and sour cream in a blender of food processor until smooth
2. Stir in sugar to taste
3. Chill 8 hours or overnight in refrigerator before serving

title: crab meat au gratin
steps:
1. In a heavy saucepan , over moderate heat , melt butter , add onions and celery
2. Cook , stirring occasionally until onions are soft and transparent but not brown
3. Stir in the flour , blend well
4. Add milk , stirring constantly until smooth
5. Add pepper , nutmeg , mustard and cheese
6. Take pot away from heat
7. Beat egg yolk and lemon juice
8. Then add crabmeat , mix well
9. Butter baking pan or individual baking dishes
10. Add onion / cheese mixture to baking pan
11. Pour egg mixture over all
12. Combine cheese and breadcrumbs , sprinkle over top of mixture , then add dash of paprika
13. Bake at 350 degrees f for 15 to 20 minutes until top is au gratin , brown and crusty

title: chicken cacciatore with a moroccan twist
steps:
1. Heat olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat
2. Add pepper , onion , celery , and garlic
3. Saute , stirring occasionally , for 5-10 minutes , or until vegetables soften
4. Add mushrooms
5. Cook 1 minute
6. Add tomatoes , spices , and lemon juice
7. Simmer for 15 minutes , stirring occasionally
8. Add chicken
9. Cover and cook for 45 minutes over low heat , or until chicken is no longer pink

title: shrimp a la fong
steps:
1. In large skillet cook pork sausage , garlic , black bean till meat is browned
2. Add curry powder , shrimp
3. Cook till shrimp turns pink
4. Add gin , green pepper , onion and chicken broth
5. Bring to the boil , cover and simmer 3 minutes
6. Stir in catsup , salt , sugar and accent
7. Blend 2 tablespoons cornstarch and 2 tablespoons water
8. Add to shrimp mixture
9. Cook and stir till mixture thickens and boils
10. Add tomatoes
11. Cover and cook 1 minute more
12. Serve with rice

title: sweet and smoky barbecue beans
steps:
1. Cook bacon in large nonstick skillet over medium heat until crisp
2. Drain bacon on paper towels
3. Chop bacon
4. Reserve
5. Pour off all but 2 teaspoons drippings from skillet
6. Heat drippings in same skillet over medium heat
7. Add onion and saut until golden , about 5 minutes
8. Add garlic
9. Stir 1 minute
10. Add tomato sauce , 1 cup water , sugar , molasses , vinegar and mustard and bring to boil
11. Reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes , stirring often
12. Stir in all beans and bacon and bring to boil
13. Reduce heat
14. Cover and simmer 5 minutes to blend flavors
15. Uncover and simmer until mixture thickens slightly , about 5 minutes
16. Season with salt and pepper

title: tandoori chicken thighs ww  marinade   oamc
steps:
1. Combine the yogurt , paprika , ginger , garlic , curry powder , cinnamon , and saffron in a zip-top plastic bag
2. Zip closed and squish with your hands to mix the ingredients inside the bag
3. Open and add chicken
4. Refrigerate
5. Turning the back occasionally , at least 8 hours or overnight
6. This is the point where i put this in the freezer
7. Preheat oven to 450 degrees
8. Place a rack inside a roasting pan
9. Spray the rack with non-stick spray
10. Remove the chicken from the marinade and discard marinade
11. Transfer chicken to the pan rack and sprinkle with salt and pepper
12. Roast chicken until cooked through , 22 - 25 minutes
13. According to ww book: 1 thigh has 169 calories , 9 g fat , 2 g sat fat , 0 g trans fat , 75 mg cholesterol , 364 mg sodium , 1 g carbs , 0 g fiber , 12 g protein , 21 mg of calcium
14. Each thigh is 4 pts

title: 14 day pickles
steps:
1. Combine cucumbers , water and walt in a large pan
2. Heat to boiling , to dissolve salt
3. Pour over cucumbers and let set on counter for 7 days
4. On the eighth day drain and cover with plain water in same container
5. On ninth day drain and cover with alum and boiling water
6. On the tenth day drain and cover with boiling water
7. Cool and drain
8. Cover with vinegar , sugar , and pickling spice that has been heated to boiling
9. Let set on counter
10. For next four days drain syrup into pan and add 1 cup more sugar
11. On the 14th day you can process pickles by canning or keep in the refrigerator indefinitely

title: lemon eclair dessert
steps:
1. Cover the bottom of a 11 by 7 pan with graham crackers
2. Cover these with half of the lemon filling
3. Cover filling with half of the whipped topping
4. Repeat layers one more time
5. Cover pan and put into the frig until time to serve
6. I use a glass pan because the layers look so pretty

title: ranch style beans
steps:
1. Wash beans and place in a large pot or kettle
2. Add water and remaining ingredients
3. Cover and simmer for 5 to 6 hours
4. Check liquid level occasionally and add more water as needed to keep beans covered
5. If cooked in a crock pot , and cook them on the low setting
6. It also may take a little longer than the 5 to 6 hours
7. Add cup of tomato puree with additional 1 tsp brown sugar in the last hour
8. Adjust salt and sugar to your liking

title: savory feta and spinach filled shells
steps:
1. Mix spinach , ricotta cheese , 3 / 4 of the feta cheese and garlic powder
2. Fill shells with spinach mixture
3. Place in 10x6-inch baking dish
4. Pour sauce over shells
5. Top with remaining feta cheese
6. Bake at 350f for 20-25 minutes or until thoroughly heated
7. Garnish with chopped parsley

title: lolly cake  one bowl  no cook
steps:
1. Crush biscuits
2. Mix with all ingredients except coconut
3. Form a long roll
4. Roll in coconut
5. Wrap in greaseproof paper
6. Refridgerate 12 hours

title: the best spinach dip with chipotle and lime
steps:
1. Bundle spinach in a clean dishtowel and squeeze very tightly to remove all excess moisture
2. In a food processor , blend together all ingredients except spinach until very smooth , about 90 seconds
3. Pulse in spinach until just combined
4. Taste and adjust seasoning , if necessary
5. Serve with tortilla chips

title: fish with lemon butter
steps:
1. Spray fish with oil
2. Heat a large frying pan over moderate heat and cook fish for 2 to 3 minutes each side or until cooked
3. Meanwhile place couscous in a medium heatproof bowl and stir in hot stock and cover with plastic food wrap and set aside for 5 minutes or until al the liquid is absorbed and then using a fork , fluff and separatge grains
4. Combine butter , zest and half the juice in a small bowl
5. Combine parsley , tomato , onion , capers and remaining juice in a medium bowl
6. Spoon couscous onto serving plates and top with fish , with lemon butter and serve with parsley salad
7. Parsley salad - combine parsley , tomatoes and onion

title: pizza hut eggs
steps:
1. Call pizza hut and order your favorite pizza
2. Eat until you explode but save at least one slice
3. Refrigerate remaining slices
4. Next morning remove from fridge and scrape off topping from pizza
5. Microwave pizza crust for 5 seconds or so until crust is just about room temperature and remove to a plate
6. Scramble eggs and pizza topping together
7. Spoon over pizza crust and eat with a fork

title: low fat pear muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Coat a 12-cup muffin pan with nonstick cooking spray or line with paper muffin cups
3. Combine flour , sugar , baking powder and spices in a large bowl
4. In a medium bowl , combine milk , egg and canola oil
5. Make a well in the center of the dry ingredients and add milk mixture
6. Stir until just moist
7. Fold in chopped pear
8. Spoon batter into muffin cups , filling them 2 / 3 full , and bake for 20 minutes

title: red candied apples
steps:
1. Butter cookie sheet generously
2. Wash and dry waxed apples thoroughly
3. Insert wooden skewer in stem end of each apple
4. Mix sugar , water , corn syrup and food color in 2-quart heavy saucepan
5. Heat to boiling over high heat
6. Reduce heat
7. Boil gently , without stirring , to 290 on candy thermometer or until small amount of mixture dropped into very cold water separates into threads that are hard but not brittle
8. Stir in clove oil
9. Dip apples quickly into syrup , twirling until completely coated
10. Stand on cookie sheet
11. Cool
12. Microwave directions: mix sugar , water , corn syrup and food color in 1 1 / 2-quart glass casserole
13. Microwave uncovered on high 19 to 23 minutes , stirring once after 5 minutes , to 290 on microwave candy thermometer or until small amount of mixture dropped into very cold water separates into threads that are hard but not brittle
14. Stir in clove oil
15. Dip apples quickly into syrup
16. Continue as directed
17. Cool
18. Break into small pieces for a treat

title: curried beef with potatoes and peas
steps:
1. Add ground beef and onion to a heated large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat
2. Stir / saute until meat is browned and crumbled
3. Add in peas
4. Stir to combine
5. While the meat is cooking: in another large nonstick skillet , heat the oil over medium-high heat
6. Add in potato
7. Stir / saute for 8 minutes or until lightly browned
8. Add in broth and curry to the potatoes
9. Cook 2 minutes
10. Add potato mixture , chutney , salt , and pepper to meat mixture
11. Simmer for 1 minute
12. Sprinkle fresh chopped cilantro on top if desired

title: carolyn   nate s  caramel apple cheesecake
steps:
1. Crust:
2. Combine flour , margarine , sugar and egg yolk
3. Press into the bottom and slightly up the side of a greases 9-inch spring form pan
4. Set aside
5. Cheesecake:
6. Preheat oven to 325f
7. Melt butter in a skillet and saute apples until
8. Slightly golden
9. Arrange apples on crust
10. Combine caramels and milk and melt over low heat or microwave on low power 4
11. Minutes
12. Drizzle over apples
13. In a large bowl cream cheese and sugar until
14. Mixture is light and fluffy
15. Beat in eggs , one at a time , add vanilla
16. Pour mixture over apple-caramel mixture and bake for 35-38 minutes
17. Cool on
18. A wire rack , then chill
19. Garnish with additional caramel sauce and whipped
20. Cream , if desired
21. Serves 12

title: cranberry chicken
steps:
1. In a shallow dish , combine flour and pepper
2. Dredge chicken
3. In a skillet , melt margarine over medium heat
4. Brown the chicken on both sides
5. Remove and keep warm
6. In the same skillet , combine water , cranberries , brown sugar and vinegar if desired
7. Cook and stir until the berries burst , about 5 minutes
8. Return chicken to skillet
9. Cover and simmer for 20-30 minutes or until chicken is tender , basting occasionally with the sauce
10. Serve over rice if desired

title: green sauce
steps:
1. Remove husks and stems from tomatillos
2. Place whole tomatillos in a sauce pan , cover with water and bring to a boil
3. Boil 5 minutes or until easily pierced with a fork
4. Drain the water and allow to cool
5. Place tomatillos , onion , cilantro , jalapeno , and salt in a food processor or blender
6. Blend until smooth
7. Stir in sour cream and avocado and blend again until smooth

title: eggplant  aubergine  on the grill
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients except eggplant in the container in which you intend to marinate the eggplant
2. Add the eggplant slices , turning to coat with the marinade
3. Marinate at least 30 minutes , turning once
4. Leave at room temp if you are going to be cooking this right away
5. Throw on a preheated grill and cook about 5 minutes per side , basting with marinade if the eggplant hasn't soaked it all up
6. Alternatively you can broil under a preheated broiler about the same amoount of time

title: easy shortcakes
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees
2. Combine the dry ingredients and mix well
3. Make a well in the center , and then add each wet ingredient
4. Mix all together gently
5. Dough should be light and airy
6. There will be enough dough for five or six shortcakes
7. Use a spoon to drop dollops of the dough onto a small nonstick or lightly oiled cookie sheet
8. Press the center of each shortcake to flatten it a bit and create an indentation for filling
9. I like to leave them irregularly shaped instead of perfectly round
10. Bake for 12-13 minutes , or until the tops are just starting to turn golden
11. After they've cooled for a bit , slice them in half horizontally
12. Use a combination of any of your favorite fillings: lightly mashed fresh fruit , vanilla pudding , mascarpone cheese , chocolate sauce
13. My son likes to put a fruit layer and a whipped cream or pudding layer in the center , then add the top half , and then top with a fruit layer and lots of whipped cream
14. You can also make a savory version of these shortcakes by omitting the sugar and vanilla , and adding parmesan cheese and a dash of garlic or onion powder
15. Top with olives , refried beans , sour cram , and salsa or greek salad

title: banana  carrot   pineapple cake aka sunshine cake
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 180c
2. For the cake , line a 20cm cake tin , or for a loaf , line a large loaf tin
3. In a large bowl beat the eggs , sugar and lemon zest together until creamy
4. Slowly add the oil while beating continuously
5. Sift the flour , salt , and baking powder together and stir into the creamed mixture
6. Fold in the banana , carrot , pineapple and chopped nuts until incorporated
7. Spoon mix into prepared tin and bake for 55-60 minutes or until firm to the touch
8. Remove from the oven and allow to sit for 10 minutes before turning out onto a cooling rack
9. Allow to cool and if a cake , ice and keep in an airtight container , or , if a loaf , wrap in plastic wrap to store , or place in an airtight container
10. Serve the loaf either plain or buttered
11. Icing:
12. In a medium bowl beat the cream cheese , icing sugar , lemon zest and juice until smooth
13. Spread over the cooled cake and decorate with pecan or walnut pieces

title: rice krispies waffles  cook s country
steps:
1. Preheat traditional waffle iron to medium
2. Meanwhile , stir flour , rice krispies , cornstarch , sugar , baking powder , baking soda , and salt together in large bowl
3. Whisk egg yolks , milk , vanilla , and oil together in medium bowl
4. With electric mixer or balloon whisk , beat egg whites in bowl to soft peaks
5. Pour milk mixture over dry ingredients and whisk until combined
6. Whisk in beaten whites until just combined
7. Do not overmix
8. A few streaks of whites should be visible
9. Pour 2 / 3 cup batter into center of preheated waffle iron and use back of dinner spoon to spread batter toward outer edges
10. Make sure to fill the waffle iron as directed
11. If you don't use enough batter , the rice krispies can scorch
12. Close lid and cook until deep golden brown , 3 to 4 minutes
13. Serve immediately
14. Keeping them warm: waffles are best served right off the waffle iron , but they can be reheated so everyone can eat at once
15. Transfer the cooked waffles to a wire rack set on top of a baking sheet in a 400-degree oven and bake until crisp and hot , 3 to 5 minutes
16. Keeping them frozen: waffles freeze beautifully
17. After cooling the waffles , wrap each in plastic , then freeze in a zipper-lock bag for up to one month
18. To serve , place the waffles on a wire rack set on a baking sheet and bake in a 400-degree oven until crisp and hot , about 5 minutes

title: southwestern pizza con queso
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees
2. Place pizza crust top side down on a baking sheet , bake 4-5 minutes or until crust is golden brown and crisp
3. Remove from oven , and turn crust top side up
4. Shred chicken , and add oil to heat over medium heat 1-3 minutes or until shimmering
5. Cut bell peppers and onion into thin slices
6. Add bell peppers , onion , and seasoning mix to a mixing bowl , toss to coat
7. Add vegetable mixture to skillet , cook 2-3 minutes or until tender
8. Add chicken , cook 1 minute , or until heated through
9. Remove skillet from heat
10. Spread salsa con queso dip over crust to within 1 inch of edges
11. Top evenly with chicken mixture , sprinkle with cheese
12. Bake 7-8 minutes or until cheese is melted
13. Remove from oven , and cut into wedges

title: stuffed cheeseburger aka  juicy lucy
steps:
1. 1
2. Mix ground beef with salt , pepper , worcestershire , bread crumbs and steak seasoning
3. 2
4. Form a hamburger patty and place a slice of velveeta in the center , top with another patty
5. Seal the edges of the two paties together so they form one single burger with the velveeta sealed inside
6. Repeat until meat is used up
7. 3
8. Grill burgers and serve to your liking
9. Try not to flip more than twice
10. 4
11. Top with bacon and avocado or serve to your liking
12. Careful when you bite into them , the cheese is hot !

title: beef braised in red wine
steps:
1. Put oven rack in middle position and preheat oven to 275f
2. Heat oil in pot over moderately high heat until hot but not smoking
3. Meanwhile , pat meat dry and sprinkle with salt and pepper
4. Sometimes i add some montreal seasoning as well
5. Brown meat in hot oil on all sides , about 10 minutes total
6. Transfer to a plate using a fork and tongs
7. Add bacon to oil in pot and saut over moderately high heat , stirring frequently , until browned and fat is rendered , about 4 minutes
8. Add onion , carrot , celery and mushrooms , saut , stirring occasionally , until vegetables are softened and golden brown , 10 to 12 minutes
9. Tie the thyme and rosemary with kitchen twine , then add garlic , thyme , and rosemary and saut , stirring , until garlic begins to soften and turn golden , about 2 minutes
10. Stir in tomato paste and cook , stirring , 1 minute
11. Add wine and boil until liquid is reduced by about half , about 5 minutes
12. Add broth and water and bring to a simmer , then return meat along with any juices accumulated on plate to pot
13. Cover pot with lid and transfer to oven
14. Braise until meat is very tender , about 5 hours
15. Turn the meat every hour or so
16. Transfer meat to a cutting board
17. Skim fat from surface of sauce and discard along with herb stems
18. Boil sauce until reduced by about one third , about 5 minutes , then season with salt
19. Cut meat across the grain into 1 / 2-inch-thick slices and return to sauce
20. Cool completely in sauce , uncovered , then refrigerate in sauce , covered
21. Remove some of the fat from the surface
22. Reheat , covered , in a preheated 350f oven until hot , 25 to 30 minutes , then slice meat

title: 10 grain bread
steps:
1. Mix together the cereal and first amount of water in a saucepan and cook for about 10 minutes to soften the cereal
2. If you want you can set it aside to cool or mix together with cool water and ice cubes to cool it faster
3. Put all ingredients into a kitchenaid mixer
4. Mix together using the dough hook , once everything is mixed together knead for 2 minutes
5. Place dough in a greased bowl and let sit for 1 hour or until doubled in size
6. I have also rushed this recipe and let it sit for as little as 15 minutes
7. Punch down and divide into 4 equal pieces
8. I use a scale to ensure they are the same size
9. Shape dough and place into greased bread pans
10. Let rise for 1 hour or until double in size
11. Bake at 400 f for 15 minutes or until golden brown and the sound hollow when tapped on the bottom
12. Remove from pans and cool on wire racks

title: tequila adobo bbq shrimp
steps:
1. Shrimp marinade and grilling: in a glass bowl , stir together tequila , lime juice , garlic and pepper
2. Marinate shrimp for 30 minutes , stirring once or twice
3. Over marinating will result in a very strong flavor !
4. Remove shrimp from marinade , and wrap shrimp in bacon pieces
5. Thread shrimp on skewers and lightly sprinkle with seasoning salt
6. Grill shrimp over medium hot charcoal fire , basting with adobo bbq sauce
7. Turn shrimp every 2 minutes and continue to baste
8. The shrimp should cook for about 10 minutes
9. Bacon will be cooked , but not crisped
10. Serve immediately and drizzle with additional sauce
11. Bbq adobo sauce: add dried chilies to 1 1 / 2 cups of boiling water
12. Let sit for 15 minutes
13. Remove chilies and reserve 1 / 2 cup of chile water
14. Add chile , reserved water , onion , garlic , oregano , cinnamon , and cumin to a blender and puree
15. Heat vegetable oil in a frying pan
16. Sautee puree in pan and add vinegar and sugar , bring to a boil
17. Reduce heat and simmer until thick
18. This should yield 2 cups of adobo sauce
19. I freeze the extra sauce
20. Mix 1 / 2 cup of adobo sauce with 1 / 2 cup of prepared bbq sauce
21. Differing the proportions of the mixture will give you varying degrees of spice
22. Use this mixture to baste shrimp and drizzle remaining on shrimp

title: chocolate chip pan cookies
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients until well blended
2. Spread into greased or non-stick 9x13 inch pan
3. Bake at 350 f for 25-30 minutes
4. Consistency will be soft like a chocolate chip cookie and will firm up after cooling
5. Cool in pan
6. Cut into bars

title: kiwi mint lemonade
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan , heat with with sugar over medium-high heat , stirring occasionally until sugar is dissolved
2. Simmer , uncovered , 5 minutes
3. Remove from heat and stir in mint leaves
4. Let stand 20 minutes
5. Meanwhile , peel kiwifruit and cut into chunks
6. Puree in food processor
7. Place puree in a pitcher
8. Strain cooled syrup into pitcher , pressing on mint , then discard leaves
9. Refrigerate until cold
10. Squeeze juice from 2 lemons
11. Stir into kiwifruit mixture
12. Taste , squeeze in juice from remaining lemon for a tarter lemonade
13. Pour into glasses
14. Top with sparkling water
15. Serve garnished with a slice of kiwifruit
16. Makes 2 1 / 4 cups without sparkling water - 4 glasses

title: chicken sorrento
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Mix first four ingredients in a zip-top plastic bag , then add chicken and shake to coat
3. Brown chicken breasts in hot shortening , approximately 8 minutes per side
4. Remove from pan and keep warm
5. Add mushrooms , soup and oregano to pan , stir until smooth , and cook 5 minutes over medium heat
6. Remove from heat
7. Stir in sour cream
8. Pour macaroni in the bottom of a 9x13 glass pan , mix in peas and half of the soup mixture
9. Place chicken breasts on top of macaroni , pour the rest of the soup mixture over
10. Sprinkle with paprika
11. Cover and bake for 40 minutes
12. Remove cover and bake an additional 20 minutes

title: turkish chicken thighs   400  winner
steps:
1. Snip any large pieces of chutney
2. In a small bowl combine chutney , honey , lime juice , mustard , ginger , and five-spice powder
3. Set aside
4. Trim fat from chicken thighs
5. Grill over medium heat 12-15 minutes or until chicken is done turning once and brushing with the chutney mixture during the last 4-5 minutes of grilling
6. If using a gas grill , preheat the grill and cover and do the same as above
7. You may want to broil this by placing the chicken on a rack and broiling 4-5 inches from the heat for 12-15 minutes or until chicken is done , turning once and brushing with chutney mixture during last 4-5 minutes of broiling
8. In a small bowl combine sesame seeds , parsley and orange peel
9. To serve , place chicken on a serving platter
10. Sprinkle with parsley mixture

title: oil and vinegar salad dressing
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients in a jar or bowl
2. Refrigerate before serving for about an hour
3. Shake well before serving

title: jack wax
steps:
1. Fill up a 9x13 cake pan with clean snow , and pack it down
2. Heat maple syrup to 230 degrees f
3. This is the soft ball stage if using a candy thermometer
4. If you don't have a candy thermometer , let the syrup gently boil for about 20 minutes
5. (if you don't get the syrup heated to the softball stage , you will end up with jack wax that is more like a slushy
6. While syrup is hot , slowly pour over snow in a back-and-forth motion
7. The syrup will turn in to a taffy-like candy , and you can eat it with your fingers

title: crock pot spicy boneless bbq chicken   easy
steps:
1. Unwrap and put all 5 pieces of chicken breasts on the bottom of the crock pot
2. Take the bottle of big kevin's seasoning and cover the top of each chicken breast
3. Take pack of red onions and green peppers and dump on top of chicken
4. Take liquid smoke , hot sauce , and jalapeo and dump on top of chicken
5. Take barbecue sauce and make sure you put enough in to cover all the chicken breasts with (you will not need all of the 2nd bottle
6. Set crock pot on low for 7 to 8 hours
7. Once you get to the 7th hour you can check the chicken which should be tearing off when you pick it up
8. You can make kick ass shredded chicken sandwiches or pick it out for a really good meal
9. As a bonus you should have enough sauce left to put in a plastic container and enjoy later

title: kang kong stir fry
steps:
1. Wash , trim and dry kangkong
2. In a wok or skillet , heat oon sesame oil over medium-high heat
3. Add chopped onion , chopped garlic cloves and a peeled and minced ginger
4. Stir-fry for a minute or so until the onion begins to turn translucent
5. Add the kangkong , finely chopped bird chili pepper , water and soy sauce
6. Continue to stir-fry just until the kangkong wilts , about another minute
7. Plate with a garnish of toasted sesame seeds or ripped thai basil leaves

title: vegan chocolate bran muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Put the bran and warm water in a bowl together , let sit 2-3 minutes
3. Simmer the flaxseed in the 3 tablespoons water until thickened , 1-2 minutes
4. Blend all ingredients together until well blended
5. Pour into muffin tins and bake 18-20 minutes

title: birtanem s mcver
steps:
1. Grate zucchini and mix with about 1 tablespoon salt
2. Let stand for about 30 minutes , then rinse and squeeze out as much liquid as possible
3. Mix together with the other ingredients
4. Adding some crumbled feta tastes also very good !
5. Heat the oil and drop one tablespoon of the mix at a time in the oil , pressing a little with a fork to flatten the patties
6. Drain well on kitchen paper

title: spinach soup
steps:
1. Add onions and oil to stockpot on medium-low
2. Cook , stirring , 10 min or longer , until onions are soft and translucent , but not browned
3. Add stock and spinach , season with salt and pepper
4. Bring to simmer , cook about 3 min or until spinach is wilted and tender
5. Remove pot from heat
6. Puree soup carefully with handheld blender until smooth
7. Season to taste with herb seasoning salt
8. Ladle into warm bowls
9. Top with poached egg

title: lee lee s famous chocolate sauce for ice cream
steps:
1. Combine sugar , cocoa , and salt in small saucepan
2. Add enough water to make stirable consistency
3. Add butter to cocoa mixture
4. Bring to a boil over medium high heat , stirring constantly
5. Allow to boil for 1 minute , stirring
6. Remove from heat
7. Add vanilla
8. Serve warm over ice cream
9. Add sliced bananas and chopped walnuts if you really want a treat !

title: miracle hamburger stroganoff
steps:
1. Brown ground beef
2. Add onions and cook until the onions are clear
3. Add mushrooms , continue cooking
4. After the mushrooms are warm add the minced garlic and continue cooking on low
5. Add soup and water , mix and simmer for about 10 minutes
6. Add miracle whip and salt and pepper to taste
7. Serve over noodles

title: saute of chicken with soy sauce
steps:
1. Heat olive oil in frying pan over med heat
2. Add chicken , season with salt and pepper and cook for 3 minutes
3. Add green onions , celery , and red peppers , continue cooking for 4 minutes
4. Stir in soy sauce and cook for 2 minutes
5. Incorporate chicken stock and simmer 2 minutes over low heat
6. Dissolve cornstarch in cold water , stir into mixture and bring to a boil for 1 minute
7. Pour sauce over hot pasta , sprinkle with cheese
8. Serve while hot

title: hot chile paste
steps:
1. In a heatproof bowl cover chiles with the boiling water
2. Place a small plate on chiles to keep them submerged and soak til pliable , at least 20 min or up to 2 hours
3. Transfer chiles and soaking liquid to a blender and puree
4. Blend in salt and sugar
5. Heat a wok or large skillet over moderately high heat and add oil
6. Stir fry shallots til softened , about 2 minute add chile puree and stir fry about 20 seconds
7. Remove from heat and stir in vinegar
8. Transfer to resealabe glass bowl and let cool
9. Store covered in the fridge

title: sweet coconut sauce
steps:
1. In heavy saucepan , combine sweetened condensed milk , egg yolks and margarine
2. Over medium heat , cook and stir until thickened and bubbly , about 8 minutes
3. Stir in remaining ingredients
4. Serve warm
5. Bottle and refrigerate leftovers

title: grilled blackened sea bass
steps:
1. Preheat barbecue grill
2. Combine all seasonings in small bowl and mix well
3. Melt butter in small saucepan over medium heat and pour into pie plate
4. Dip sea bass into melted butter , evenly coating both sides
5. Sprinkle both sides of sea bass with seasoning mixture
6. Place on grill and cook covered for approximately 6 to 8 minutes or until it is blackened and flakes easily
7. Turn halfway through grilling time
8. Serve with lemon and garnish with dill sprigs

title: bearnaise sauce
steps:
1. In a small saucepan , bring vinegar , wine , shallots , tarragon , salt and pepper to a boil and reduce to about 2 tablespoons
2. Cool slightly
3. Beat in yolks until smooth
4. Put mixture into a small stainless steel bowl and place in a skillet with about 1 inch of simmering water in it
5. Whisk sauce until it begins to thicken
6. Beat in butter , bit by bit
7. Before serving , add a few drops of lemon juice and parsley

title: alton brown s lentil soup
steps:
1. With salt , sweat the onion , carrot , and celery in hot olive oil
2. Add the broth , tomatoes , lentils and seasonings
3. Bring to a boil
4. Reduce heat and cover , cooking about 35-45 minutes
5. Blend if desired

title: triple lemon ripple cake
steps:
1. Prepare the filling by beating the cream cheese and sugar in a bowl
2. Beat in the egg until the mixture is fluffy
3. Add the flour until well blended and stir in the lemon juice
4. Set aside
5. Preheat the oven to 350 and spray a 12-cup tube or bundt pan with the non-stick spray
6. Cream the butter and sugar , then beat in the eggs until the mixture is very light and fluffy
7. Add the lemon juice and beat just until blended in
8. Combine the dry ingredients& add to creamed mixture alternately with the milk
9. Pour half of batter into the prepared pan
10. Cover the batter in the pan with the cream cheese filling and pour in the remaining batter
11. Gently swirl a knife through the batter a few times to make a swirl
12. Bake for 50-60 minutes until cake pulls away from the side of the pan
13. Cool in the pan for 10 minutes , then turn out and cool completely
14. Prepare the glaze by stirring the 2 tbs
15. Of lemon juice into the confectioner's sugar and blending until smooth
16. Drizzle over the cooled cake

title: fresh cucumber mix
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients & mix well
2. Place in refrigerator and let stand overnight

title: the best baked vidalia onion dip
steps:
1. Set oven to 375f
2. Butter a 1 or 2-quart round or oval casserole dish
3. In a bowl combine all ingredients together together
4. Mix well to combine
5. Adjust tabasco and garlic to taste
6. Transfer to casserole dish
7. Bake for about 25 minutes or until browned on top
8. Sprinkle with grated swiss cheese , then return to oven for another 4-5 minutes or until the cheese has melted
9. Serve hot or warm with assorted crackers

title: rocky road brownies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325f degrees
2. Grease and flour an 8-inch square pan and set aside
3. In a mixing bowl , combine baking powder , cocoa , salt , and flour
4. In another mixing bowl , combine beaten egg , egg whites , sugar , vanilla , and marshmallow creme
5. Mix dry ingredients with wet ingredients
6. Do not overmix or brownies will be too tough
7. Pour into prepared pan
8. Sprinkle nuts on top , if using
9. Bake for 18-20 minutes
10. Ice with your favourite chocolate or vanilla icing if you wish

title: jamaican pumpkin coconut soup
steps:
1. Peel and chop onion
2. Remove the seeds of jalapeno pepper and cut into slices
3. Peel and chop pumpkin
4. Stew onion , jalapeno pepper and pumpkin in olive oil
5. Add potato , ginger and lemongrass
6. Add vegetable stock , boil up the soup and let it simmer until pumpkin is done
7. Remove lemongrass and mash the soup to puree
8. Reheat the soup with coconut milk and green curry , taste soup with salt and pepper

title: filet mignon with stroganov sauce
steps:
1. Cook noodles in a 6- to 8-quart pot of boiling salted water until just tender
2. Drain in a colander
3. Meanwhile , thinly slice onion using slicer
4. Heat oil in a 12-inch heavy skillet over high heat until hot but not smoking
5. While oil heats , pat steaks dry
6. Sprinkle 3 / 4 teaspoon salt and 1 / 4 teaspoon pepper on steaks , then add to skillet and saut , turning over once with tongs , about 6 minutes total for medium-rare
7. Transfer to a plate with tongs
8. Add onion , garlic , and remaining 1 / 2 teaspoon salt and 1 / 2 teaspoon pepper to oil in skillet and saut , scraping up any brown bits with a wooden spoon , until onion begins to brown , about 3 minutes
9. Add mushrooms and saut , stirring occasionally , until liquid given off by mushrooms is evaporated , about 4 minutes
10. Add brandy and boil until evaporated , about 1 minute
11. Add broth and worcestershire sauce , then cover and cook until onion is softened , about 4 minutes
12. Remove from heat and stir in sour cream
13. Toss noodles with some of sauce and serve remaining sauce over steaks

title: haupia  hawaiian coconut pudding
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in saucepan
2. Stir over medium heat until thickened
3. Lower heat and cook for ten minutes , stirring constantly to avoid lumping or burning
4. Pour into 8x8 inch dish and chill until set
5. Cut haupia into squares

title: sauerkraut chicken bake
steps:
1. Melt the butter in a skillet& brown the breasts on both sides , remove& place in an oven proof dish add to skillet onion , celery , carrot& garlic
2. Cook until tender
3. Stir in the kraut , tomatoe sauce , brown sugar& parsley , mix well
4. Spoon mixture over the chicken and bake 375f , uncovered for apprx 45 minutes

title: hawaiian chicken cordon bleu pizza
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450
2. Grill or bake chicken breasts , seasoning with salt and pepper to taste
3. Time is approximately 20 minutes , depending on breast size
4. Allow to cool , then chop chicken in a very large dice
5. Set aside
6. Mix pineapple and honey
7. Broil for 10 minutes , stirring frequently
8. Remove from oven
9. Set aside
10. Drop oven temperature to 375
11. Roll out crescent dough into rectangle
12. Pinch seams to seal and form an edge
13. Bake crust for 6 minutes
14. Remove
15. Remove 4 cheese wedges from foil and spread on crust , using an offset spatula
16. Top cheese-spread crust with chicken , ham and pineapple
17. Remove foil from remaining cheese wedges and crumble over other ingredients
18. Cook at 375 for 10 minutes
19. Remove from oven
20. Slice into squares or strips

title: roasted potato wedges with cheddar cheese
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees
2. In a resealable plastic bag , toss potatoes with oil , salt and pepper
3. Spread evenly onto baking pan and cover with foil
4. Bake for 30 minutes , remove cover and turn potatoes
5. Bake for 10 additional minutes or until lightly browned
6. Heat oil in medium saucepan
7. Add flour and stir over medium heat for 30 seconds
8. Add milk and stir until thickened
9. Reduce heat to low
10. Stir in cheese , green onions , bacon bits and pepper
11. Serve potato wedges with warm cheese sauce

title: zucchine al forno con parmigiano reggiano e prosciutto
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f and spread butter in an 8x8-inch baking pan
2. In a large saucepan of boiling water cook zucchini until crisp-tender , about 5 minutes
3. Drain zucchini and cool until they can be handled
4. Trim ends of zucchini and quarter lengthwise to form spears
5. Wrap each zucchini spear in a slice of prosciutto and arrange side by side in pan
6. Sprinkle zucchini with parmesan cheese and pepper and bake until lightly browned , 10 to 15 minutes
7. Serve zucchini warm

title: smoked southern baby back ribs
steps:
1. Take the olive oil with a basting brush and go over all sides of the ribs
2. After you fo this , sprinkle the rub on both sides of the pork
3. If you run out , just mix some more
4. I am a heavy rub girl so i like a lot ! the sauce is last portion of the ingredients
5. Start with the bbq sauce and work your way down
6. Now its time to prepare your smoker
7. If you do not have a smoker , you can do this with a regular grill to get the same smoke flavor
8. If you do not have a smoker , just go to the end of the directions for smoking and you will see how to do it with a grill
9. I have an upright , cylinder shaped , 2 tier smoker made by brinkman
10. I buy hickory wood chunks from home depot or walmart
11. I will put 4 or 5 in a pan of water to soak for about an hour
12. I light my coals and let them burn until the coals turn ashy of the sides
13. I add my soaked wood and water pan / drip pan ontop of that
14. I close the lid so it can get up to temperature
15. After about half an hour , i place the ribs in the smoker and leave them alone for atleast 2 hours
16. You want to maintain a constant temperature in the smoker of about 200 to 220 degrees
17. The secret to fall-off-the-bone ribs is cooking them low and slow
18. Do not even take the top off for 2 hours
19. After 2 hours , take them off and wrap in aluminum foil
20. Add more wet or dry wood chunks to the bottom bowl
21. Close the lid and let them cook another hour and a half
22. If you choose to add sauce , this is the time to do it
23. Open the aluminum foil and pour my sauce over them
24. After about 30 more minutes , you have the finest ribs that you have ever had !
25. Now , if you do not have a smoker i recommend you get one
26. It's only $39 at home depot
27. Prepare your grill with coals and place wet hickory wood chunks all around ontop of the coals
28. Place ribs on the grill and let them cook about 30 minutes , turning them over after 15 minutes
29. Afterwards , wrap in aluminum foil and place back onto grill
30. Let them cook an additional 30 minutes
31. Pour my sticky sauce over them in the foil and let cook additional 15 minutes
32. Remove and enjoy !

title: steak au poivre vert
steps:
1. For the steak
2. Place the green peppercorns in a mortar and pestle and lightly crush them
3. Place steaks on a plate and pat dry with paper towels
4. Press the crushed green peppercorns into the meat with your fingers
5. Generously grind black pepper over steaks
6. Cover with cling wrap and let stand in the refrigerator for half an hour or longer so that the pepper flavour will penetrate into the meat
7. Heat a saut pan on high flame , then place steaks into hot pan
8. Lower heat to medium-high
9. Sear the steaks on one side for 3-4 minutes , constantly checking the heat , then turn the steaks over and sear for another 3-4 minutes for medium-rare
10. Or cook to desired doneness
11. Remove steaks from saut pan onto a warm platter and cover with foil to keep warm while making the sauce
12. For the sauce
13. Add butter and olive oil to the saut pan and once the foam has subsided , add shallots and cook on medium high heat for one minute
14. Pour in beef stock and boil down rapidly over high heat until it is reduced by half
15. Pull pan off the heat
16. Pour brandy or cognac into the pan , ignite it with a lit match tilting the pan away from you and averting your face
17. Expect a flame burst once you light it
18. Shake the saut pan for a few seconds until the alcohol cooks off and the flames have subsided
19. Or simply simmer to burn off the alcohol if you don't want to flamb
20. Once alcohol cooks off , add the cream and bring to a full
21. Rolling boil
22. The cream will puff up as it boils and then it will reduce down and thicken
23. Lower heat to a simmer as the sauce reduces by half
24. This should take at least 10 minutes
25. Pour the sauce over the steaks and serve

title: italian mango salad
steps:
1. Peel and cut mango into 24 or more or less little pieces
2. Cut mozzarella into the same amount of little pieces
3. Put the mozzarella pieces on top of the mango pieces
4. Put a basil leave on every mozzarella-mango-tower
5. Combine oil and lemon juice and sprinkle over the pieces ,
6. Add freshly ground pepper and very little salt
7. Serve soon

title: luchow hamburgers
steps:
1. Mix the meat and the fat
2. Squeeze as much water as you can out of the bread
3. Add to the meat and mix smoothly
4. Add the seasoning and eggs
5. Combine well
6. Shape into large patties
7. Broil or cook in a little hot fat in a pan until brown and done
8. There should be no pink showing in the burger

title: cheddar cheese potato broccoli soup
steps:
1. In a 3 quart saucepan , melt butter and saute onions
2. Add potatoes , water , and bouillon cubes
3. Cover and bring to a boil then reduce heat to medium
4. Cook just until potatoes are tender
5. Meanwhile , place frozen broccoli and cheddar cheese in crock pot on low to start melting and thawing
6. Once the potatoes are done , using a hand blender , blend contents of saucepan to desired consistency and then pour into the crock pot
7. Heat on low until warmed

title: best fried egg sandwich
steps:
1. Place a small pan on a burner
2. Add the butter and heat on medium high heat
3. After the butter has melted , crack the egg in the pan
4. Let sit for about a minute
5. Pop the yolk
6. Sprinkle with salt and pepper
7. When egg is set , flip over and cook other side
8. Cook egg to your liking
9. Meanwhile , spread mayonaise on bread and place cheese
10. Place the cooked egg on top of the cheese , so it will melt
11. Top with other slice of bread
12. Enjoy !

title: buttermilk dinner rolls
steps:
1. Dissolve yeast , honey and buttermilk by stirring together
2. Stir in melted butter
3. Mix in 2 cups flour , baking soda and salt
4. Beat well , cover
5. Place near warm area such as heated oven and let rise 2 inches up the bowl
6. Stir down , then add enough flour to make soft dough , attempting to get in the remaining 3 cups
7. Start by stirring the flour in , then try kneading as much of the remaining flour in as possible
8. Lightly oil a clean bowl and place dough into it
9. Cover , place in warm place and let rise until doubled
10. Punch down
11. Divide into 24 pieces
12. Form into well-rounded smooth balls
13. Place 1 inch apart in oiled pan
14. Cover , place in warm place and let rise until doubled
15. Bake for 20 minutes in pre-heated 400 degree oven
16. For softer , even better rolls , butter top of rolls after removing from oven

title: bacon double cheeseburger dip
steps:
1. Cook the ground beef in a pan over medium heat , set it aside and drain the grease from the pan
2. Cook the bacon in the pan until crispy , about 6-10 minutes , set aside and drain all but a tablespoon of the grease
3. Add the onion and saute until tender , about 5-7 minutes
4. Add the garlic and saute until fragrant , about a minute
5. Mix the ground beef , bacon , onions and garlic , cream cheese , sour cream , mayonnaise , mozzarella , cheddar , worcestershire sauce and ketchup and pour it into a baking dish
6. Bake in a preheated 350f oven until the top starts turning a light golden brown and then sides are bubbling , about 20-30 minutes
7. Serve with baguette slices and shredded lettuce , diced fresh tomatoes and chopped dill pickles

title: chocolate dessert crepes
steps:
1. Put all the ingredients in your blender , blend 1 minute
2. Scrape down the sides , blend a few seconds or until smooth
3. Refrigerate 1 hour
4. To cook:
5. A- use upside down crepe pan and follow instructions or
6. B-use a non stick skillet-you do not need oil or other fat on the pan
7. Pour a small amount of batter in the pan then tilt and turn the pan so you spread the batter evenly over the bottom of the pan cook over medium heat until the bottom is lightly browned , flip and cook for a few seconds remove from the pan and stack with a piece of wax paper between the crepes

title: 4 pt  weight watcher quiche
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Toss cheese , bacon , and flour to coat
3. Mix beaten eggs and milk and add to dry mixture , mix well
4. Pour ingredients into pie shell
5. Bake for 50 to 60 minute or until set

title: honey whole grain bread
steps:
1. Using a 1 quart casserole , souffle dish , or any other high sided baking pan that will fit into your slow cooker , coat with nonstick cooking spray
2. Set aside
3. In a large mixing bowl combine together 1 1 / 2 cups whole wheat flour , milk , 1 / 2 cup all purpose flour , honey , oil , yeast and salt
4. Beat at medium speed with an electric mixer for 2 minutes
5. Add the remaining whole wheat flour and up to 1 / 2 cup all purpose flour until dough is no longer sticky
6. If the electric mixer is have a difficult time mixing the dough use a wooden spoon to mix in the remaining flour
7. Transfer dough to the prepared baking dish
8. Place dish in slow cooker and cook on high for 3 hours or until the edges of the bread have browned
9. Carefully lift the baking dish out of the slow cooker using oven mitts or pot holders
10. Let bread stand for 5 minutes and than unmold on a wire rack to cool

title: blueberry pomegranate smoothie with honey   orange
steps:
1. Place evaporated milk , blueberries , juice , concentrate , honey and ice in blender
2. Cover
3. Blend until smooth
4. Pour into tall glasses and serve immediately

title: chocolate chip zucchini bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Place first 3 ingredients in a large bowl
3. Mix at low speed until well blended
4. Stir in applesauce
5. Combine flour , cocoa , baking soda , cinnamon and salt , stir well with whisk
6. Add flour mixture to sugar mixture , beating until just moist
7. Stir in zucchini and chocolate chips
8. Spoon batter into a 9 x 5 inch loaf pan that has been coated with cooking spray
9. Bake at 350 for 1 hour or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out almost clean
10. Cool in pan 10 minutes and remove to wire rack
11. Cool completely

title: bev s own tomato sauce
steps:
1. In a heavy sauce pan heat olive oil , over medium high heat
2. Add onion and cook until soft
3. Add garlic and carrot and continue cooking until garlic just begins to turn color
4. Add crushed tomato and tomato paste , bring to a boil
5. Add bay leaves , basil , oregano , salt and pepper
6. Add marsala wine and water , return to boil
7. Stir in sun-dried tomato
8. After returing to a boil , turn down heat to simmer
9. Allow to simmer while stirring every now and then for about 30 minutes or until thickened
10. Adjust spices to suit your taste
11. Serves 4-6

title: smoked salmon and egg salad tea sandwiches
steps:
1. Place eggs in a small saucepan with a tight-fitting lid
2. Add cold water to cover by 1 inch
3. Bring to a boil on med-high , then turn off the heat , cover pan with lid
4. Let stand 10 minutes
5. Remove eggs and place them in a bowl of ice water
6. When cool , peel the eggs and finely chop in a bowl
7. To the bowl , add salmon , chives , mayo , and sour cream
8. Mix well and season to taste w / salt and pepper
9. Spread 1 / 3 of the egg salad on each of 3 slices of bread
10. Cover with remaining bread slices
11. Trim crusts and cut each sandwich into 4 triangles

title: black bottom coconut bars
steps:
1. For chocolate base: preheat oven to 375
2. Line a 9-inch square baking pan with aluminum foil , leaving a slight overhang
3. Butter bottom and sides of foil
4. Place butter in a large microwave-safe bowl
5. Melt in microwave
6. Add sugar and salt
7. Whisk to combine
8. Whisk in egg , then cocoa and flour until smooth
9. Spread batter in prepared pan
10. Bake just until sides begin to pull away from edges of pan , 10 to 15 minutes
11. Let cool slightly while preparing coconut topping
12. Keep oven on for topping
13. For coconut topping: in a medium bowl , whisk eggs with sugar and vanilla
14. Gently mix in flour and coconut
15. Drop mounds of mixture over chocolate base
16. Spread and pat in gently and evenly with moistened fingers
17. Sprinkle with reserved cup coconut
18. Bake until golden and a toothpick inserted in center comes out with moist crumbs attached , 25 to 30 minutes
19. Cool completely in pan
20. Lift cake from pan , peel off foil , and cut into 16 bars
21. Store in an airtight container 3 to 4 days

title: spicy broccoli bruschetta spread
steps:
1. Cook broccoli in boiling water , salted , for about 12 minutes or until tender and drain
2. In a small skillet cook onion , garlic and red pepper in hot oil until onion is cooked
3. In a food processor , combine broccoli , onion mixture and cheese
4. Process until smooth
5. Season with salt to taste
6. Serve at room temperature , spread on italian toasted bread rounds
7. Delicious !
8. And good for you too !

title: skillet tomatoes
steps:
1. Remove stems from tomatoes , then cut each into 6 to 8 wedges and set aside
2. Melt butter in a large skillet , add onion and garlic and cook over medium-high heat 2 minutes
3. Stir in salt , basil and black pepper
4. Add reserved tomatoes to skillet , reduce heat to medium and stir just until hot , 2 to 3 minutes

title: spring pea salad
steps:
1. Place vegetables and ham into a bowl
2. Combine the oil / lemon juice , salt and sugar in a jar with tight fitting lid and shake until you have a somewhat thick sauce
3. Taste and adjust seasonings
4. Pour over peas mixture and toss
5. Let stand for 1 / 2 hour before serving

title: ozark pudding
steps:
1. Beat eggs and sugar until smooth
2. Add flour , baking powders and salt
3. Add nuts , apple and vanilla
4. Bake in a buttered 8" pie pa 35 minutes @ 350 degrees f

title: magick mushrooms   stuffed italian style
steps:
1. Remove stems from mushrooms and chop finely
2. Melt butter in frying pan over medium heat
3. Add onion and mushroom stems
4. Cook 5 minutes or until soft
5. Add garlic& breadcrumbs
6. Cook for further 2 to 3 minutes
7. Season with salt and pepper
8. Stir in herbs
9. Spread 1 / 2 to 1 tsp of tomato paste over inside of each mushroom
10. Fill with stuffing mixture
11. Top with tasty cheese
12. Bake at 190 degrees c for approx 25 minutes , or until cheese has melted and browned slightly on top

title: beach shack shrimp tacos
steps:
1. Coat a large nonstick skillet with nonstick cooking spray heat over medium heat
2. Add tortillas in a single layer 2 or 3 at a time and cook over medium-high heat 2 minutes , or until light golden brown in spots and softened
3. Remove to a plate and cover with foil to keep tortillas warm and pliable
4. Sprinkle shrimp with jerk seasoning
5. Coat same skillet with nonstick spray
6. Heat over medium heat
7. Add shrimp
8. Saute 3 minutes or until cooked through
9. Remove to a plate
10. To assemble tacos: top each corn tortilla with about 1 / 2 cup cabbage mixture and 3 shrimp
11. Fold in half to eat

title: hungarian chocolate cream bars
steps:
1. To make cake: preheat oven to 350f
2. Grease a 9 x 13-inch pan
3. Line pan with wax paper and grease the wax paper
4. Beat the egg whites lightly , add cream of tartar and beat at a high speed
5. When shiny , gradually add 1 / 3 cup of sugar , continuing to beat until stiff
6. In a separate mixing bowl , place the egg yolks , remaining sugar and butter and beat until light and fluffy
7. Add the cocoa and mix thoroughly
8. Add a large dollop of egg whites to chocolate mixture and whip until blended
9. Then pour the rest of the egg whites over the chocolate mixture and sprinkle the flour over the egg whites
10. Fold gently with a spatula until the egg whites and flour are incorporated
11. Immediately spread the batter in the prepared pan
12. Smooth out to edges and corners
13. Bake 10-15 minutes at 350f until cake is done
14. Run a knife around edges and invert cake on a wire rack to cool
15. To make filling: in a saucepan , combine cream , chocolate chips and instant coffee
16. Cook over low heat until mixture is smooth and slightly thickened
17. Cover saucepan and refrigerate until very cold
18. When chilled , add rum and whip in a chilled bowl at medium speed until firm
19. Be careful not to over beat or the filling may separate
20. To make glaze : in a small saucepan , melt all ingredients over a low flame
21. Mix until very smooth
22. Cool for 15 minutes and mix again
23. Use immediately , as the sauce thickens as it cools
24. To assemble: cut cake horizontally into halves
25. Lightly sprinkle bottom half with rum
26. Spread filling over bottom layer
27. Place top layer on bottom half and spread filling over top
28. Refrigerate or freeze until very firm
29. When very cold , set the cake on a wire rack
30. Pour the warm glaze over the cake
31. Refrigerate again until firm
32. Cut with a sharp knife , wiping the blade after each cut
33. You can freeze cut squares

title: beef and vegetables in red wine sauce
steps:
1. In a large non stick pan , brown the steak in batches and place in crock pot or casserole dish
2. Then add the carrots , celery , mushrooms and onion
3. Combine the tomatoes , water , stock cubes , wine , herbs , salt and pepper
4. Pour into the crock pot and cook on low for 8 hours or high for 5 hours approximately if you are not using a crock pot , cover the casserole and place in a moderate oven for 1 1 / 2-2 hours or until beef is tender
5. Dumplings
6. Sieve the flour into a bowl
7. Add suet , parsley , salt and pepper
8. Add about 3 tbsp water to make a soft but not sticky dough
9. With floured hands roll dough into 8 balls
10. Add the dumplings 30-40 minutes before the end of cooking time and cook on a high setting
11. On completion of cooking , thicken the sauce with gravy granules if desired for a rich beefy flavour

title: yogurt curry with noodles
steps:
1. Melt butter in the pan , over medium heat , and add flour , stir in broth
2. Cook until it thickens , stirring constantly
3. Slowly add the yogurt , curry powder , lemon juice , salt and pepper
4. Once finished , keep sauce warm while preparing the noodles
5. Boil the noodles until they are tender
6. Drain water , and reserve
7. Using a saut pan , over medium-high heat , saut minced garlic in olive oil until golden brown
8. Add summer squash , snow peas , and cook until vegetables are tender
9. Add pasta and mix with vegetables
10. Then toss in yogurt curry sauce before serving

title: tasty turkey appetizer balls
steps:
1. Simple:
2. Before you begin preparations , preheat your oven to 400f
3. First , pour everything into a bowl
4. Second , mix everything together really well
5. Use your hands , it's the best way to knead it all together and really spread in the bisquick
6. Third , roll the resulting "dough" into balls about 1-inch diameter
7. Fourth , place the 1-inch balls on a cookie sheet and place into the oven
8. Last , cook them for 12- 15 minutes , until golden brown
9. Serve your turkey balls almost immediately , hot

title: mexicali dressing
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients
2. Serve as a dipping sauce or as a salad dressing

title: smokin  spicy vegetarian chili
steps:
1. Remove stems , seeds and veins from inside of ancho chiles
2. Combine water and chiles in a small saucepan and bring to a boil
3. Remove pan from heat
4. Cover and let stand 20 minutes or until softened
5. Drain off water , chop chiles and set aside
6. Heat oil in a large pot over medium-high heat
7. Add onion and carrot and saute for 3 minutes
8. Add bell pepper and saute for 3 more minutes
9. Add garlic and jalapeno and saute for 1 minute
10. Stir in cumin , oregano , paprika and crushed red pepper and cook for 1 minute
11. Stir in chopped chile , tomatoes and broth or beer then bring to a boil
12. Cover and reduce heat to low and simmer for 15 minutes
13. Stir in beans and tomato paste , bring back to a boil , reduce heat back to low and simmer for 15 more minutes
14. Stir in sugar , salt and pepper
15. Serve with sour cream and shredded cheese

title: veg head three bean chili
steps:
1. Over moderate heat , add oil to a deep pot and combine onion , peppers , and garlic
2. Saute for 3 to 5 minutes to soften vegetables
3. Deglaze pan with beer or broth , add tomatoes , black beans , red kidney beans , and stirring to combine
4. Season chili with cumin , chili powder , hot sauce , and salt
5. Thicken chili by stirring in refried beans
6. Simmer over low heat about 5 to 10 minutes longer , then serve up bowls of chili and top with shredded cheese , scallions , and tomatoes
7. Place bowls on charger plates piled with assorted tortilla chips

title: bread pudding thanksgiving
steps:
1. Grease 9x9 pan with butter and preheat oven to 350 f
2. Mix in a mixer or beat thoroughly : milk , cream , eggs , sugar , vanilla , salt to form thin custard
3. Add and mix by hand the remaining ingredients into the liquid custard
4. Press lightly to encourage bread to absorb custard
5. Let sit in refrigerator for 1 / 2 hour to 6 hours , depending on how stale the bread is
6. Pour into lightly buttered / greased 9x9 pan
7. Bake in oven for 1 / 2 - 1 hour or until golden brown on top but of bread pudding consistency inside

title: cheddar mash
steps:
1. Boil the potatoes for 10 minutes or until soft , and drain
2. Mash with the cheese , parsley and cream

title: ravioli  dough and choice of 4 fillings
steps:
1. Making the filling: ricotta filling#1: in a large bowl , blend all filling ingredients together until smooth , set aside filling until needed
2. Ricotta filling#2: in a large bowl , blend all filling ingredients together until smooth , set aside filling until needed
3. Beef and spinach filling: brown beef and veal in butter with the whole clove of garlic
4. Remove garlic and let meat mixture cool
5. Mix spinach , parsley , eggs , cheese and nutmeg into cooled meat until well blended , set aside filling until needed
6. Sausage filling: brown sausage in frying pan , drain fat and allow sausage to cool
7. When sausage has cooled , mix in eggs and cheese , set aside filling until needed
8. Making the ravioli dough: sift flour and salt together
9. Place flour mixture on a board , making a well in the center of the flour
10. Drop eggs into the flour well , using your hand or a fork , break the yolks and beat eggs slightly
11. Combine the eggs and flour together , gradually adding enough warm water to make a stiff dough
12. Knead dough well , until smooth
13. Cover the dough and let it rest for 15 minutes
14. Cut dough in half and roll each half of the dough out on a floured board , into a very thin sheet
15. Filling the ravioli: drop about 1 to 1 1 / 2 teaspoonfuls of filling about 1 1 / 2 inches apart all along the dough
16. When the sheet of dough is fully dotted with dabs of filling mixture , cover filling with other sheet of dough
17. Using your fingers , gently press dough between each dab of filling to seal it
18. Cut ravioli into squares with a pastry cutter , or very sharp knife
19. Drying the ravioli: allow ravioli to dry for one hour before cooking
20. Cooking the ravioli: drop ravioli into 6 to 8 quarts of boiling , salted water and cook for about 10 to 15 minutes , or until dough is tender
21. Remove cooked ravioli from pot carefully with a skimmer or a large slotted spoon , and drain well
22. Place drained ravioli on a serving platter in layers , alternating layers with your favorite sauce and a sprinkling of grated cheese between each ravioli layer
23. Serve hot

title: yeast risen pancakes
steps:
1. In large bowl combine flour , sugar , salt , c innamon and yeast
2. Mix well
3. Add vanilla , milk , butter and egg till well blended
4. Cover and place in fridge overnight
5. Heat a lightly oiled griddle or frying pan over med high heat
6. Stir batter with a whisk and pour or scoop batter onto griddle , using approximately 1 / 4 c for each pancakes
7. Brown on both sides , serve hot

title: classic yule log
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Grease a 15 x 10" jelly roll pan
3. Line with a sheet of waxed paper
4. Grease paper as well
5. Sift together the flour , cocoa , baking powder and salt
6. In separte bowl , beat together sugar and egg yolks
7. Alternate adding the milk and the flour mixture into the egg and sugar mix
8. In another separtate bowl , using clean mixer blades , beat egg whites until stiff but not dried out
9. Fold one third of the egg whites into the other mixture
10. Then carefully fold in remaining egg whites
11. Spread batter into pan , smooth out the top
12. Bake for 12 minutes , or until set
13. While waiting for cake to cook , prepare whipping cream
14. Beat whipping cream with 1 tablespoon sugar until thick
15. Set aside in the fridge
16. When cake is done , remove from oven
17. Dust a clean tea towel with icing sugar
18. Turn cake out onto this
19. Remove waxed paper
20. Cut edges of cake to make a nice even looking rectangle
21. Starting with the short side , roll the cake up jelly-roll style
22. Transfer seam side down to a rack for cooling
23. While cake is cooling , prepare icing:
24. In a small pot , bring cream , melted chocolate and butter to a low boil over medium low heat
25. Stir vigorously until blended
26. Remove from heat and let stand
27. On a flat surface dusted with remaining icing sugar , knead food colouring into each piece of marzipan , until well blended
28. Unroll the now cooled cake and spread the whipped cream over it to with 1 inch of all sides
29. Re-roll cake
30. Place seam side down on serving dish
31. Spread icing over top and sides and ends of cake
32. Roll out marzipam with a rolling pin and cut into various shapes with cookie cutters or a knife
33. Arrange on cake
34. Sift a small amount of icing sugar on completed cake to make it looked like a light dusting of snow

title: southwest turkey burgers
steps:
1. Chop your garlic and veggies
2. I throw all mine in my food processor and it makes easy work of this step
3. Combine all ingredients through grill seasoning
4. Divide mixture into 4 equal patties
5. Drizzle patties with olive oil to coat
6. Cook on grill or in skillet over med-high heat until done
7. Place sliced cheese over the patties the last two minutes of cooking
8. Optional : slather with black bean spread / dip with lime and cilantro
9. Enjoy the rest of the dip with tortilla chips with your burger

title: chicken stir fry with snow peas and cashew nuts
steps:
1. Mix together the cornflour , sherry , stock , and soy sauce
2. Set aside
3. Place oil and garlic in a wok or large fry pan , heat over medium heat until the garlic sizzles
4. Add the chicken and stir fry until lightly brown
5. Reduce heat , add ginger , onions and continue to stir fry for 2 minutes
6. Add snow peas and cashew nuts and cook 1 minute more
7. Stir the cornflour and sherry mixture and pour into the wok , continue to stir over heat until sauce thickens
8. Pile onto serving dish and serve with rice

title: vicki s chex mix
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 250f 2 rimmed sheet pans
2. Place cereals , crackers , pretzels , and peanuts in a large microwave proof bowl
3. Melt butter , add spices , worcestershire sauce , and hot sauce if using
4. Mix well and pour over cereal mix
5. Stir to mix
6. Microwave on high for 2 minute stir well
7. Microwave 2 minute stir well
8. Divide onto sheet pans , bake 20 minute
9. Stir and rotate pans
10. Bake 20 min , cool and enjoy !

title: crisp pickled silver skin onions
steps:
1. In a large pot , add onions , cover with boiling water and let cool
2. Peel and discard skins and water
3. Rinse onions and return to pot
4. Sprinkle onions with pickling salt
5. Cover onions again with boiling water and let stand for 24 hours
6. Drain and reserve salted water
7. Rinse onions with cold water and return to cooking pot
8. In a separate pot , bring reserved salted water to a boil
9. Pour over onions
10. Repeat this same process for another 2 full days
11. At the beginning of the 4th day , drain and discard water
12. Rinse onions thoroughly
13. In a cooking pot , add sugar , vinegar and spices that are wrapped in a cheese cloth and bring to boil
14. Boil for 2 minutes
15. Pour this liquid over the onions
16. Cover and let sit for 24 hours
17. Drain off liquid , save and reheat
18. Pour this liquid over the onions again
19. Repeat this process for a total of 3 days , which is now the 6th day
20. On the 7th day , which is the last day , drain and reserve the liquid
21. Wash onions thoroughly
22. Reheat the reserved liquid
23. Prepare and sterilize jars
