24. Fill jars with onions and pour the hot liquid over the onions in the jars to within 1 / 4 inch of the top
25. Wipe tops of rims very clean
26. Place prepared lids on top and screw on screw lids just finger tight
27. Place jars in a hot bath in a canner and boil for 5 minutes
28. Remove from bath and place on a towel
29. Cover with another towel to cool
30. Jars are sealed when the tops"pop" and are concave ,
31. Wipe jars clean , lable and store in a cool , dry place

title: cabbage and bacon
steps:
1. Cook bacon over medium-high heat in a wok until bacon is thoroughly crisped
2. Remove and drain on paper towels
3. Crumble when cool
4. Set aside
5. Stir bell pepper and onion into bacon grease in wok and cook until softened
6. Stir in cabbage , mix all together and then increase heat to high
7. Stir-fry until crisp tender
8. Season with black pepper
9. Remove from wok and sprinkle with bacon

title: multi purpose marinade
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a jar& shake well
2. Pour over meat or poultry
3. Cover& place in refrigerator for at least 2 hours but best if left overnight
4. Stir or turn occasionally

title: parmesan monkey bread
steps:
1. Preheat ove to 400 degrees
2. Combine butter , garlic and mustard
3. Coat bottom of 8 or 9 inch pan with 2 tablespoons of mixture
4. Separate dough and cut each biscuit in 4 pieces
5. Arrange in pan
6. Drizzle reserved butter over biscuits
7. Sprinkle with cheese
8. Bake 12 - 17 minutes

title: toasted vegan avocado and tomato sandwich
steps:
1. Separate the bagel halves if using a bagel
2. Spread evenly with vegan margarine or hummus
3. Arrange the tomato and avocado slices on one side
4. I usually put the tomato on the bottom , it seems to stay together better
5. Put the other side on top of the bottom half and place in the toaster oven until margarine melts or it's nice and crispy

title: zucchini and potato frittata
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. In a large saute pan , saute the zucchini , potatoes , mushrooms , and onions , and peppers in the butter till not raw anymore , about 3 minutes on medium flame
3. Set aside to cool slightly
4. Butter the bottom and sides of a glass 13x9 baking dish
5. In a bowl , crack in the eggs and beat well to totally unify the yolks and whites
6. Add the fresh parsley and dill to the egg mixture and stir well
7. Add the shredded cheese to the egg mix and stir well
8. Now add the vegetable mixture and fold into the egg mixture softly , but thoroughly
9. Add salt and pepper to taste
10. Pour the entire egg mixture into the buttered baking dish and place in the oven on center rack for 35-40 minutes
11. Start to watch the frittata after about 30 minutes to make sure it doesn't overcook in your oven
12. You want it to be slightly golden on top , springy to touch and no evidence of runniness

title: mahi mahi hawaiian style
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Cut fish fillets into serving size portions allowing 4 to 6 ounces per serving
3. In bowl , mix pineapple , cloves and nutmeg
4. Spray an oven proof baking dish with non-stick cooking spray
5. Place fish in prepared dish , top with pineapple mixture and drizzle a half to one full tablespoon of pineapple juice over each serving
6. Cover with foil and bake 10 to 12 minutes , uncover and top with coconut
7. Bake 5 minutes more or until fish flakes easily

title: creamy mocha berry parfait
steps:
1. Mix cream cheese , sugar , brandy extract and dissolved coffee in small bowl with wire whisk until well blended
2. Gently stir in whipped topping and half of the chocolate
3. Place 1 / 2 cup berries in each dessert dish
4. Top evenly with cream cheese mixture
5. Sprinkle with remaining chocolate
6. Serve immediately or refrigerate until ready to serve

title: schuler s bbq sauce
steps:
1. In large , heavy pot combine all ingredients and simmer , uncovered , for 2 hours
2. Stir often

title: cioccolato paradiso  italian chocolate paradise biscotti
steps:
1. Place nuts in a shallow pan and bake in a preheated 350 degree oven for 5 to 10 minutes , or until golden brown
2. Let cool
3. In a mixing bowl , cream butter and 1 / 2 cup sugar until light and fluffy
4. Beat in egg yolks , vanilla and orange zest
5. In a bowl combine the flour , baking powder and salt
6. Add to the creamed mixture , mixing just until crumbly
7. In a separate bowl , beat egg whites until stiff soft peaks form and beat in remaining sugar , beating until stiff but not dry
8. Fold meringue into the crumbly dough , mixing until it clings together
9. Cut nuts into halves or thirds and fold in along with chocolate
10. Divide dough in half
11. Form into two logs on a greased and floured baking sheet making them about 1 / 2 inch thick , 1 1 / 2 inches wide and 16 inches long , sppacing them at least 2 inches apart
12. Bake in the middle of a preheated 325 degree f oven for 25 minutes or until set and golden brown
13. Transfer from the baking sheet to a rack
14. Let cool 5 minutes
15. Place on a cutting board
16. With a serrated knife , slice diagonally at a 45 degree angle about 1 / 2 inch thick
17. Place the slices upright on a baking sheet and return to the oven at 300 degrees for 10 to 15 minutes to dry slightly
18. Let cool on a rack
19. Store in a tightly covered container
20. Makes about 4 dozen biscotti

title: beef chimichangas
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Wrap stacked tortillas in aluminum foil , and heat in oven 15 minutes or until hot
3. To microwave , wrap a stack of tortillas lightly in paper towels and warm on high for 6 or 7 seconds per tortilla
4. In a large frying pan over medium-high heat , brown beef
5. Drain , leaving beef in the pan
6. Add onion , chile or enchilada sauce , salt , and pepper
7. Cook 2 to 3 minutes or until onions are transparent
8. In the center of each warm tortilla , spoon 1 / 6 of meat filling
9. Fold tortilla , tucking in the ends to make a secure fat tube , and fasten with wooden toothpicks
10. In a large pot or deep fryer over medium heat , add at least 4 inches of vegetable oil
11. Heat oil to 375 - 400f fry the chimichangas , 1 or 2 at a time , 3 minutes or until golden brown
12. Remove from oil , drain and place on serving plates
13. Top with cheddar cheese , lettuce , green onions , and any optional ingredients that you prefer

title: cranberry cinnamon bread  bread machine
steps:
1. Add to your bread maker according to instructions
2. Add the cranberries and cinnamon at the proper time called for with your machine
3. Use light crust setting

title: mozzarella sticks
steps:
1. Cut cheese in half if desired
2. Beat egg and milk together
3. Dip each cheese in egg mixture , then flour , then egg mixture again , then roll in the breadcrumbs
4. Refrigerate uncovered for 45 minutes
5. Fry for 2 minutes in the oil

title: singapore mai fun
steps:
1. Cook rice noodles according to package directions , leaving out any fat or salt that may be called for
2. Combine broth , soy sauce , sugar and salt , and stir together till sugar dissolves
3. Heat large nonstick skillet over med-high heat
4. Coat pan with cooking spray
5. Add 1 tsp oil
6. Add egg
7. Stir-fry 30 seconds or until soft-scrambled , stirring constantly
8. Remove from pan , and set aside
9. Wipe down pan with cloth or paper towel
10. Heat remaining oil in pan over med-high heat
11. Add bell pepper , ginger , red pepper , and garlic
12. Stir-fry 15 seconds
13. Add snow peas , bean sprouts , curry , and shrimp
14. Stir fry two or three minutes , until shrimp is nearly done
15. Stir in egg , noodles and broth mixture
16. Cook 1 minute or until thoroughly heated
17. Sprinkle with green onions

title: warm cheese and glazed pecan dip
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Put pecans , butter , brown sugar , 1 teaspoons salt , and 1 / 4 teaspoons cayenne pepper into a medium bowl
3. Toss to combine
4. Spread in a single layer on a rimmed baking sheet
5. Bake until fragrant and sugar has melted , about 5 minutes
6. Let cool completely
7. Process cream cheese , cheddar , and cream in food processor until well combined
8. Transfer to medium bowl
9. Stir in scallions , remaining 1 / 2 teaspoons salt , and remaining pinch cayenne pepper
10. Spoon cheese mixture into 2 round baking dishes
11. Arrange glazed pecans on top
12. Bake until dip is just heated through , about 10 minutes

title: shrimp with green curry
steps:
1. To make curry paste: place all ingredients in blender , food processor , or mortar and process until the mixture is smooth
2. Pour coconut milk and green curry paste into large sauce pan
3. Heat to boiling , add fish sauce and sugar
4. Cook for 5 minutes at a low boil
5. Add bamboo shoots and any other vegetables , creabmeat , or mushrooms as desired
6. Add coconut cream and simmer 3-5 minutes until shrimp is cooked through
7. Add lime leaves and basil , adjust seasoning to taste
8. Serve in individual bowls , garnished with slivers of red chiles

title: sweet potato ham puffs
steps:
1. Combine ham and potatoes and egg
2. Sift flour , baking powder and salt
3. Add to ham mixture
4. Drop by tbsp onto hot griddle and brown on each side

title: our favorite italian meat pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Brown ground beef and onions , seasoning with salt and pepper
3. Drain well
4. Put meat back into pan and add enough spaghetti sauce to coat the meat well but not make it soupy
5. I like ragu old world style , mushroom flavor
6. Stir in the mushrooms if your family will eat them !
7. Line an 8x8 pan with about 6 of the crescent rolls , sealing the seams by smooshing them together and making the rolls go about an inch up the sides of the pan
8. Mix the beaten egg with one cup of shredded mozzarella , then spread it evenly over the top of the crescent rolls
9. Top egg and cheese layer with ground beef mixture
10. Sprinkle remaining cup of cheese over the top of the meat layer
11. Bake for 25-30 minutes , or until cheese is nicely melted and lightly browned and crescent rolls crust is done
12. Roll up remaining crescent rolls and bake along side the meat pie
13. Let meat pie rest on the counter or table for about 5 minutes or so to make it easier to serve
14. Serve the meat pie with the crescent rolls and a great salad
15. Enjoy !

title: watercress soup  julia child
steps:
1. When measuring the watercress leaves and stems , pack them down in the measuring cup
2. Simmer leeks , potatoes , water and salt together , partially covered , 40-50 minutes until vegetables are tender
3. Stir in watercress and simmer 5 minutes
4. While the watercress is simmering , you can prepare the following optional garnish if you wish: a small handful of watercress leaves boiled 30 seconds , rinsed in cold water and drained
5. Mash the vegetables in the soup with a fork , or puree in blender
6. Correct seasoning
7. Off heat and just before serving , stir in cream or butter by spoonfuls
8. Decorate with the optional watercress leaves

title: elegant chicken zucchini skewers
steps:
1. Thinly slice the chicken lengthwise so you end up with thin strips , about an inch wide and 5 inches long , depending on the size of the chicken breasts
2. If the slices are more than a quarter-inch thick , lay out a piece of clingfilm , lay the slices of chicken on top and cover with another piece of clingfilm
3. Bash with a rolling pin until each slice is a quarter-inch thick
4. Place the chicken in a bowl with the spices , stir and cover
5. Leave in the fridge for 30 minutes to marinate
6. Meanwhile , prepare and preheat the grill
7. Using a vegetable peeler , slice the zucchini into thin strips the length of the zucchini
8. Thread alternate strips of chicken and zucchini onto the skewers in an "s" shape
9. Drizzle with olive oil and grill for about 15 minutes , turning regularly , until the chicken is cooked through

title: healthier lasagna lasagne
steps:
1. Preheat your oven to 190c / 375f / gas 5
2. In a non stick frying pan , brown the meat for about 7 minutes
3. Season with salt
4. Drain any excess fat from the pan by placing the meat into a sieve , keep aside
5. In the same pan , fry the onion , garlic , celery , carrot and mushrooms in a little olive oil for about five minutes
6. Add the meat back to the pan and add the tomato paste and chopped tomatoes at the same time
7. Season using the oregano , basil and sugar
8. Add salt and black pepper to taste
9. Simmer for about 15 minutes
10. In the meantime add the spinach , zucchini , cottage cheese and egg whites together in a bowl
11. Using a hand blender of food processor , blitz the ingredients until you achieve a sauce
12. Spread 1 / 4 of the tomato sauce in the bottom of a large lasagne dish
13. Cover with three lasange sheets
14. Next add another layer , using another 1 / 4 of the tomato sauce and then cover with half the cottage cheese sauce
15. Place the remaining three lasagne sheets over the top and cover with the remaining cottage cheese sauce
16. Cover with tin foil and bake for 45 minutes
17. After that time , remove the foil and top with the grated mozzarella cheese
18. Then return to the oven for a further 15 minutes
19. Serve with a green side salad
20. Squeeze out any excess water before adding with the other ingredients
21. This is optional

title: eggnog latte
steps:
1. For 1 serving:
2. Place instant coffee in cup
3. Slowly pour boiling water over coffee while stirring
4. Stir in eggnog , heated until hot
5. Sprinkle with nutmeg and serve at once
6. For 4 servings:
7. 1 / 4 cup instant coffee
8. 2 cups boiling water
9. 2 cups warm eggnog
10. For 4 servings:
11. Place instant coffee in heatproof pitcher
12. Slowly pour boiling water while stirring
13. Stir in eggnog

title: best ever hot cocoa mix
steps:
1. Combine ingredients in large bowl
2. Working in two batches , pulse ingredients in food processor until chocolate is finely ground
3. Store in airtight container for up to 3 months
4. Too make hot cocoa , stir 1 / 3 cup of the mix into 1 cup of hot milk
5. Top with whipped cream or mini marshmallows and a little chocolate powder
6. I sometimes use cinnamon or nutmeg powder , instead
7. A little brandy and a crackling fire make for a real treat !

title: red lion inn pumpkin bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Grease two loaf pans , 24 muffin cups , or 6 mini loaf pans
3. Combine eggs , sugar , oil and pumpkin in a large bowl
4. Stir until smooth
5. Sift together dry ingredients and spices
6. Add to egg mixture along with nuts and raisins
7. Mix thoroughly and fill pans
8. Bake large loaves for 1 hour , 10 minutes
9. Muffins for 35-40 minutes
10. And mini loaves for 45 minutes
11. Toothpick inserted in middle should come out clean

title: healthy walnut chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees and spray baking pan with pam
2. Place chicken in large ziplock bag and pour buttermilk in bag
3. Squish bag a bit to make sure chicken is evenly covered by the buttermilk
4. Place in fridge to marinate for several hours
5. Combine breading ingredients
6. Taste and adjust seasoning to your liking
7. Take chicken breasts , one at a time and dip both sides in breading , then place in pan
8. Liberally spray top of chicken with pam , until they are golden in color
9. Bake for 30-35 minutes or until done
10. Baking time will depend on the size of the chicken breasts
11. When serving , to help the bottom breading stay on the chicken , use a spatula and a table knife
12. Carefully slide the spatula under the chicken , then use the knife to push the chicken off the spatula
13. That will help the breading stay in place rather than sticking to the pan or to the spatula

title: chewy ginger cookies
steps:
1. Position a rack in the middle of the oven
2. Preheat the oven to 350f
3. Line two baking sheets with parchment paper
4. Sift the flour , baking soda , salt , cinnamon , ginger and cloves into a medium bowl and set aside
5. In a large bowl , using an electric mixer on medium speed , beat the butter and brown sugar until smoothly blended , about 1 minute
6. Stop the mixer and scrape the sides of the bowl as needed during mixing
7. Add the egg and molasses and mix until blended and an even light brown color , about 1 minute
8. On low speed , add the flour mixture , mixing just to incorporate
9. Spread the granulated sugar on a large piece of wax or parchment paper
10. Roll cup of dough between the palms of your hands into a 2 inch ball , roll the ball in the sugar and place on one of the prepared baking sheets
11. Continue making cookies , spacing them 2 inches apart
12. Bake the cookies one sheet at a time until the tops feel firm , but they are still soft in the center and there are several large cracks on top , about 14 minutes
13. Cool the cookies on the baking sheets for 5 minutes , then use a wide metal spatula to transfer the cookies to a wire rack to cool completely
14. These make big cookies !

title: fried ice cream
steps:
1. Place 4 scoops of ice cream in a small pan
2. Freeze for 1 hour or till firm
3. In a small mixing bowl stir together egg and vanilla
4. In a pie plate carefully stir together cereal and cinnamon
5. Dip each frozen ice cream ball in the egg mixture , and then roll them in the cereal mixture
6. Return coated ice cream balls to freezer and freeze for 1 hour or till firm
7. Reserve the remaining cereal mixture
8. In a small mixing bowl stir together egg and vanilla
9. Remove coated ice cream balls from the freezer
10. Dip balls in egg mixture , and then roll them in the remaining cereal mixture and return to pan
11. Cover and freeze for several hours or till firm
12. In a deep fat fryer or a heavy saucepan , fry frozen coated ice cream balls one or 2 at a time , in deep hot oil for 15 seconds or till golden brown
13. Drain on paper towels
14. Return the fried ice cream balls to freezer while frying the remaining balls
15. Serve immediately with whipped cream

title: vegan heart attack chocolate doughnuts
steps:
1. Beat the egg replacer and sugar together until creamy in consistency
2. Melt the margarine and chocolate together in a small saucepan over low heat
3. Beat into the sugar mixture until well combined
4. Combine the soy milk , vinegar and vanilla
5. Stir this into the sugar / chocolate mixture
6. In another bowl , combine the flour , baking powder , baking soda and salt
7. Stir this into the liquid mixture until it forms a dough
8. Chill this for about 1 / 2 hour to make it easier to handle
9. Roll 1 / 2 the dough out onto a lightly floured board to a 1 / 2" thickness
10. Cut out the doughnuts with a 3" diameter doughnut cutter
11. Let them rest for about 10 minutes before frying
12. Repeat with the rest of the dough
13. Deep fry in hot oil for about 90 seconds each , turning every 15 seconds
14. Remove from the hot oil and allow them to drain on paper towels
15. Cool , and ice , glaze or sprinkle with powdered sugar as per your desires

title: mom s refrigerator bran muffins
steps:
1. Mix the dry ingredients together in a large bowl
2. Add the eggs , oil , buttermilk , and pineapple and stir until mixed
3. Mix in the additional raisins
4. Pour into greased muffin tins
5. Bake at 400 for 18-20 minutes or until golden brown
6. The batter may be stored in a sealed container in the refrigerator for up to three months
7. I think this recipe improves with age as the raisin bran flakes have time to soak up the liquids more

title: fettuccine with chicken  cajun style
steps:
1. Make cajun seasoning and cajun sauce
2. Set aside
3. Rub chicken pieces with cajun seasoning
4. Heat butter in a saute pan over medium heat
5. Add seasoned chicken and saute until just done and browned on the exterior
6. Add pasta and sauce
7. Toss ingredients to coat and cook for a couple of minutes or until sauce clings to pasta
8. Transfer to serving plate and sprinkle top with shredded parmesan cheese , green onion and confetti mix
9. Cajun seasoning mix
10. Combine and blend all ingredients
11. Store at room temperature
12. Cajun sauce
13. Melt butter in a heavy gauge stock pot or saucepan over medium heat
14. Add onions and garlic
15. Saute for 5 minutes
16. Add peppers , thyme and basil
17. Continue to saute until onions are brown and caramelized but not burned , approximately 15 to 20 minutes
18. Add chicken broth , worcestershire and tabasco
19. Bring to a fast simmer and cook for 20 minutes
20. Add tomato sauce and bring back to a simmer
21. Add sugar and green onion
22. Simmer for an hour
23. Cool and store in refrigerator until needed
24. Confetti mix
25. Equal parts red bell pepper and carrots cut into 1 / 16-inch dice

title: foil packet country potatoes on the grill
steps:
1. Preheat grill to medium heat
2. Cut two sheets of aluminum foil to 20 inches in length and arrange them cross-wise on a flat surface
3. Place 2 tbs
4. Butter in center of foil
5. Arrange potatoes , onion and garlic atop butter in center of foil
6. Sprinkle with seasonings and place remaining 2 tbs
7. Butter on top
8. Bring ends of top layer of foil together and fold downward 3-4 times toward the potato mixture , leaving enough slack so that the mixture doesn't spill too much out the sides
9. Repeat with bottom layer of foil until tightly sealed
10. Place packet on top rack of grill and cook , covered , for 30-35 minutes
11. Do not turn
12. Remove packet from grill with oven mitts , being careful not to tear the bottom of the packet
13. Carefully open foil and serve directly from packet

title: dried plum ravioli with sage butter
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , combine ricotta cheese , dried plums , parmesan cheese , garlic and pepper
2. Set aside
3. For each ravioli , brush edges of 1 wrapper with egg white
4. Place 2 teaspoons plum mixture onto center
5. Fold diagonally in half to form a triangle
6. Seal edges , pressing to remove any air pockets
7. Repeat with remaining filling and wrappers
8. Refrigerate on wax paper lined baking sheet until ready to cook
9. Meanwhile , in small saucepan , cook butter and sage over medium high heat until butter begins to turn brown
10. Remove from heat and keep warm
11. In large saucepan , add half of the ravioli to boiling water
12. Cook 3 to 4 minutes or until tender
13. Using a slotted spoon , remove ravioli to individual serving bowls
14. Repeat with remaining ravioli
15. Drizzle each serving with sage butter

title: blackberry cobbler for 2
steps:
1. Melt oleo in a loaf pan
2. Mix flour , cinnamon and sugar
3. Add milk
4. Pour over melted oleo in loaf pan
5. Stir sugar into berries and pour over mixture in loaf pan
6. Bake at 350 for 45 minutes

title: crispy ginger cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180 celsius
2. Use an electric beater to beat the butter and sugar together
3. Beat until the mixture is combined and has become creamy
4. Add the egg and continue to beat well
5. Add the flour , crystallised ginger and half of the cornflakes
6. Mix together with either a spoon or your hands
7. On a tray , crush the rest of the cornflakes with a rolling pin until the cornflakes are fine
8. Scoop a teaspoonfull of the mixture and use your hands to shape into balls which you then roll in the cornflakes you crushed earlier
9. Grease a baking tray with cooking spray / butter or cover with baking paper
10. Put the cornflake covered balls on the tray about 5cm apart from each other
11. Flatten the top of the ball with a fork gently
12. Bake for 10-20 minutes until the cookies are firm and have a light , golden color
13. Leave cookies on the baking tray for a couple of minutes before transferring to a wire rack to cool
14. The cookies start to really crispen once cooled

title: yummy chicken salad for sandwiches
steps:
1. Preheat oven broiler
2. Spray the chicken breasts with olive oil spray and sprinkle with salt and pepper
3. Broil the chicken breasts for 7 minutes on each side or until cooked through
4. Chop chicken breasts and put in refrigerator to cool
5. While oven is still hot , spread your almond flakes on a cookie sheet and toast on the broiling rack
6. Please keep an eye on them because they toast quickly , and you dont want burnt almonds
7. Once the chicken is cooled , mix in the almonds , celery , onion , mustard and mayo
8. You can either put the salad straight onto your choice of bread and add whatever you like on your sandwiches or can be eaten out of iceburg lettuce leaves for a no carb version

title: quinoa tabouli
steps:
1. Place quinoa in a colander and rinse several times rubbing the grains together to remove the bitter outer layer
2. Place water and quinoa into a 2-quart saucepan
3. Bring to a boil
4. Reduce heat to a simmer and cover
5. Cook for 10 to 15 minutes or until all water has been absorbed
6. While the quinoa is cooking , finely chop the tomatoes , parsley , and scallions
7. Add lemon juice , olive oil and fresh mint to the tomato mixture
8. Stir in cooked quinoa and salt
9. Mix well
10. Let tabouli sit in the refrigerator for a day to blend flavors
11. Tabouli is traditionally served at room temperature so remove from fridge 30 to 60 minutes before serving

title: chicken and asparagus strata  brunch casserole
steps:
1. Spray baking dish with pam
2. Pick rotisserie chicken from the bone and set aside
3. Let cool
4. Finely chop 3 shallots and saut in olive oil
5. Add shallots to chicken and let cool
6. Boil a small pot of water - cut the fresh asparagus up into 1 inch pieces
7. Add the asparagus pieces to the boiling water and cook for 2 minutes
8. Strain and put asparagus pieces in an ice water bath to stop cooking
9. Remove asparagus and dry on a paper towel
10. Add to the chicken
11. Mix eggs and milk in separate dish
12. Add cubed bread , shredded cheese , chicken , shallots and asparagus to the egg and milk mixture
13. Make sure chicken , asparagus and shallots are all cooled before adding them to the egg mixture
14. Pour all ingredients into your baking dish
15. Bake on 350 degrees for 45 minutes
16. It will puff up slightly , like a quiche
17. Let is set for about 15 minutes before serving
18. It will settle and fall a bit

title: strawberry shortcake cupcakes
steps:
1. Cupcakes: heat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Line 12 standard muffin cups with paper liners
3. In a medium bowl , whisk flour , baking powder , baking soda , and salt
4. In large bowl with mixer on medium , beat butter and sugar until light and creamy
5. Beat in eggs , 1 at a time , then vanilla
6. With mixer on low , alternately beat in flour mixture and sour cream until combined
7. Continue to beat on medium until batter is thick and smooth
8. Spoon batter into a ziploc bag
9. Snip a 1 / 2 inch corner from the bag and fill the liners slightly less than two-thirds full
10. Bake 24-26 minutes , or until lightly golden and a pick inserted in the center of a cupcake comes out clean
11. Cool in pan on a wire rack 5 minutes
12. Remove cupcakes from pan and cool completely
13. Topping: toss strawberries several times in a bowl with sugar and lemon juice until very syrupy
14. In a large bowl , beat cream , confectioners' sugar and vanilla until soft peaks form
15. Use a skewer to poke several holes into the top of each cupcake
16. Spoon some syrup from bowl over top , allowing it to absorb into cupcakes
17. Top with sliced berries and a dollop of cream
18. Arrange a few sliced berries in cream and drizzle with remaining strawberry syrup

title: thru the garden and orchard waldorf salad
steps:
1. Make the dressing by whisking ingredients together
2. Refrigerate
3. Place the chopped apples in a large non-metallic mixing bowl and add the lemon juice
4. Toss lightly
5. Add all other ingredients and toss lightly
6. Add dressing and toss lightly for a final time
7. Refrigerate , covered , for one hour before serving
8. Also , other types of lettuce may be used instead of iceberg
9. Also , servings are based upon serving the salad as a light main dish

title: quick chicken and dumplings
steps:
1. In a heavy bottomed dutch oven or large wide pot , over medium heat , add chicken broth , water , butter and all seasonings
2. Cover and bring to a boil
3. Meanwhile , cut chicken breast into bite sized pieces
4. Add to the pot
5. Stir to combine and cover
6. In a sealable container combine flour and milk
7. Seal tightly and shake vigorously to combine well
8. You will create a smooth flour mixture for thickening your sauce called a slurry
9. Slowly pour the slurry into the pot , stirring constantly
10. Add frozen vegetables and cover
11. Meanwhile combine dumpling ingredients in a medium bowl
12. Mix well with a fork
13. Remove cover from the soup pot and stir well
14. Drop dumplings into the soup one tablespoon at a time , use a 1 tablespoon scoop to make it even easier
15. Reduce heat to simmer , cover and cook until soup is thick enough to coat the back of a spoon , about 10 minutes

title: swedish angel food
steps:
1. Melt sugar in a pan together with lingonberries , and simmer until mixed together , about 5 minutes
2. Allow to cool
3. Whip cream until fairly stiff , fold into lingonberry mix and fill cones , just before serving

title: chocolate chip banana snack cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease and flour a 13x9" pan
3. Stir together the flour , baking powder , baking soda and salt in a medium bowl
4. Set aside
5. Beat the sugar and butter together until creamy
6. Add eggs , one at a time , until well blended
7. Add sour cream , banana and vanilla
8. Mix well
9. On low speed , blend in flour mixture gradually until well incorporated
10. Stir in 1 cup of the mini chocolate chips
11. Pour batter into pan and sprinkle the remaining 1 / 2c
12. Chocolate chips over top
13. Bake at 350 degrees for 40-45 minutes , or until toothpick comes out clean

title: sausage and sauerkraut
steps:
1. Drain sauerkraut really well and put in a large saucepan
2. Add 2 cups of water , bullion cube , caraway seeds , chablis , apple , onion and sausage
3. Bring to a boil
4. Turn down the heat and allow to simmer , covered for at least 30 minutes stirring occasionally

title: white chocolate ganache frosting
steps:
1. In a small , heavy saucepan , heat the cream just until it starts to simmer
2. Add the white chocolate , shaking the pan gently to immerse it into the cream , then add the butter
3. Let the mixture stand for 1 minute , then beat with a wire whisk until the chocolate and butter dissolve and the mixture is smooth
4. Refrigerate until mixture is cold , then whip with a wire whisk again until fluffy
5. Use frosting as desired
6. Refrigerate your frosted goodies to firm up the frosting

title: greek lamb wraps
steps:
1. Combine first 6 ingredients in a small bowl
2. Stir well
3. Cover and chill
4. Coat a large nonstick skillet with cooking spray or a little olive oil
5. Add lamb and onion
6. Cook over medium-high heat , stirring occasionally , 6-7 minutes or until lamb is done
7. Remove from heat
8. Stir in greek seasoning
9. Divide lamb mixture evenly among 4 tortilla
10. Topp with cucumber sauce , tomato , and spinach
11. Roll up tortillas

title: chicken gravy
steps:
1. Bring chicken stock to a boil
2. Add seasonings
3. Set aside
4. In a deep pan , add butter until it starts to melt then add flour
5. Whisk in chicken stock and cook until thickened
6. Add whipping cream
7. Don't let it come to a heavy boil , or cream will curd ! serve !
8. If you like a clear gravy omit the cream !

title: chocolate chip lemon muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Grease muffin pan or line with paper liners
3. In a medium bowl , combine flour , 1 cup of the sugar and baking powder
4. In a large bowl , whisk together eggs , milk , butter , lemon zest and lemon juice
5. Stir in flour mixture , mixing just until combined
6. Fold in the chocolate chips
7. Do not overmix
8. Scoop batter into prepared muffin cups
9. Sprinkle remaining sugar evenly over tops
10. Bake in preheated oven for 20 to 24 minutes or until puffed , light golden and a skewer inserted into center comes out clean
11. Let cool in pan on rack for 5 minutes
12. Remove from pan and let cool completely on rack

title: carrot cupcakes with orange icing
steps:
1. Make cupcakes:
2. Preheat oven to 350f with rack in middle
3. Line muffin cups with paper liners
4. Coarsely grate enough carrots to measure 2 cups using large teardrop holes of a box grater
5. Whisk together flour , baking powder , baking soda , salt , cinnamon , ginger , and nutmeg in a bowl
6. Whisk together oil , eggs , brown sugar , grated carrots , and vanilla in a large bowl , then stir in flour mixture until just combined
7. Divide batter among muffin cups and bake until golden and a wooden pick inserted into center of a cupcake comes out clean , 20 to 25 minutes
8. Cool in pan on a rack 10 minutes
9. Remove cupcakes from pan and cool completely on rack , about 1 hour more
10. To make the icing: sift confectioners sugar into a bowl
11. Whisk in zest and 2 tablespoons juice until smooth
12. If icing is too thick , add more juice , 1 teaspoon at a time
13. Dip top of each cupcake into icing , letting excess drip off
14. Let icing set , about 15 minutes

title: khachapuri  georgian cheese bread
steps:
1. Dissolve yeast and 1 tsp sugar in 1 / 4 cup water and let stand 5-10 minutes to proof until foamy
2. Add milk , 2 tbs sugar , butter , salt , and enough flour to make a soft dough
3. Knead until soft and smooth
4. Grease a bowl with oil
5. Place dough in oiled bowl and turn to coat all sides
6. Cover and let rise until double in bulk , 60-90 minutes
7. Grease a 9 spring form pan very well
8. Mix together filling ingredients until well-combined
9. Punch down dough , shape into a ball , and roll to a 20 circle
10. Ease dough into pan , letting excess hang over the edge
11. Mound cheese filling onto dough in pan and bring dough up over the filling , folding to make 8-12 evenly spaced pleats
12. Twist and pinch ends together in the center to make a rough knob
13. Cover with a buttered 12 square of waxed paper and let rise until double in bulk , 30-45 minutes
14. Remove and discard waxed paper
15. Beat together egg white and water with a fork
16. Brush top of dough with glaze
17. Bake in a preheated 375f oven 40-50 minutes , or until deep golden brown
18. Remove bread from pan , place directly on oven rack , and bake for an additional 5 minutes to brown bottom crust
19. Cool on rack at least 45 minutes before cutting into wedges

title: mom mom s rice pudding
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients and pour into a 2 quart buttered baking dish
2. Sprinkle nutmeg on top
3. Set pan in a pan of water before placing in oven
4. Bake at 350 for 1 hour and 15 minutes

title: italian baked chicken   pastina
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f
2. Bring a medium pot of salted water to a boil over high heat
3. Add the pasta and cook until just tender , stirring occasionally , about 5 minutes
4. Drain pasta into a large mixing bowl
5. Meanwhile , put the olive oil in a medium saute pan over medium heat
6. Add the chicken and cook for 3 minutes
7. Add the onions and garlic , stirring to combine , and cook until the onions are soft and the chicken is cooked through , about 5 minutes more
8. Put the chicken mixture into the bowl with the cooked pasta
9. Add the canned tomatoes , mozzarella cheese , parsley , salt , and pepper
10. Stir to combine
11. Place the mixture in a buttered 8 by 8 by 2-inch baking dish
12. In a small bowl mix together the bread crumbs and the parmesan cheese
13. Sprinkle over the top of the pasta mixture
14. Dot the top with small bits of butter
15. Bake until the top is golden brown , about 30 minutes

title: bruschetta  1 ww point
steps:
1. Combine garlic , balsamic vinegartte in a bowl and whisk , then add tomatoes
2. Let sit at room temp for at least thirty minutes
3. Mean while , preheat the oven to 450f
4. Slice the bread into 12 slices about 1 / 2 inch thick
5. Spray tops lightly with the olive oil cooking spray
6. On a cookie sheet bake in the oven 5-10 minutes until lightly toasted
7. While the bread toasts , tear the basil into small pieces
8. Once the bread is toasted , remove from the oven and divide the tomato mixture evenly among the bread slices
9. Top with salt and pepper as desired
10. Top with basil
11. Top with cheese
12. Put back in the oven on broil for 30 seconds to a minute to lightly toast / melt the cheese
13. Enjoy !

title: phall  the hottest curry of all
steps:
1. Fry the meat in a pan in half the ghee or oil , until sealed
2. Set aside
3. Fry the onion , garlic and ginger until golden in remaining ghee or oil
4. Mix the spices with a little water to make a paste
5. Add to the onion mixture and cook for 10 minutes
6. Add the tomato and chilies
7. Cook for a further 10 minutes
8. Combine the meat and all ingredients in a casserole dish and cook in a pre-heated oven at 400 deg f , gas 6 for 45 to 60 minutes

title: mad hatter meatballs
steps:
1. Melt butter in skillet
2. Add green pepper and onion and cook until tender
3. Stir in soups and water
4. Heat to boiling
5. Then turn down heat and simmer sauce , stirring occasionally
6. While this sauce cooks , make meatballs
7. Beat egg slightly in bowl
8. Add ground beef , bread , evaporated milk and salt and mix well
9. Shape meat into balls about the size of ping-pong balls
10. Drop balls into simmering sauce and cook slowly about 1 hour , or until sauce has thickened

title: parsnip and bacon cake served with a honey mustard sauce
steps:
1. Bring a pan to the boil , add the parsnips , reduce the heat and simmer for 15 minutes or until they are cooked through and tender when prodded with a fork
2. Drain them really thoroughly
3. Melt 1 tablespoon of the butter in a non-stick pan , add the bacon and cook until it starts to brown but is still soft
4. Add the chilli , garlic and shallots , and saut for 2 minutes , or until the garlic and shallots are softening
5. Stir in the garam masala , and remove the pan from the heat
6. Mash the well-drained parsnips and add the bacon mixture and the lightly beaten egg to the mashed parsnips , stirring until well-combined
7. Put the pan back over the heat and add the second tablespoon of butter
8. Pile the parsnip mixture into the pan so that it forms a single 'cake' , and flatten it with a spatula or egg slide
9. Cook it for a few minutes
10. Carefully loosen the 'cake' and slide it onto a plate
11. Invert the plate back over the pan and ease the 'cake' back into the pan to cook the other side
12. While the 'cake' is cooking , mix the mustard , honey and cream together in a small saucepan over a low heat , until the mixture begins to form bubbles
13. When both sides of the 'cake' are browned , transfer the 'cake' to a serving plate , cut into wedges , garnish with a sprig of parsley and serve with the honey-mustard sauce and a green salad

title: fluffy cherry salad
steps:
1. Fold all ingredients together
2. Pour into glass serving bowl
3. Chill
4. 6-8 servings

title: penne with artichokes   feta
steps:
1. Bring a large pot of water to a full boil and add the pasta and 1 tbs
2. Coarse salt
3. Cook until just tender , about 10 minutes
4. Drain and reserve while pasta is cooking , cook bacon until browned and crisp about 5 min
5. And drain bacon on paper towel to help reduce the grease
6. When cool , crumble into small pieces add the sliced onion to the bacon drippings in the pan and cook over med heat stirring often until wilted , about 3 min
7. Add the artichokes and cook , stirring occasionally , until the vegetables are tender and lightly browned on the edges , about another 4 min
8. Pour in the broth
9. Increase the heat to high and bring to a boil , scraping up all the browned bits in the pan
10. Boil for 30 seconds to reduce the liquid slightly
11. Reduce the heat to med
12. And add the drained pasta , olives , and red pepper
13. Toss until well blended and warmed
14. Remove the pan from the heat
15. Add the feta and salt and pepper to taste and stir a couple of times
16. Cover and set aside , stirring occasionally , until the cheese melts a bit but not completely and the pasta is coated in creamy , clingy sauce , about 2 min
17. Taste and adjust the seasonings
18. Serve immediately with crumble bacon and chopped parsley

title: fish baked in coconut milk
steps:
1. Cut fillets crosswise into strips 2-inches wide
2. Rub fish with mixture of lemon juice and oil , cover and refrigerate for 1 hour
3. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
4. In medium frying pan , over medium high heat , fry onion in oil until edges are nicely browned
5. Add garlic , ginger , and green chile , and stir over medium heat for 2 minutes
6. Add tomatoes , spice mixture , fennel seeds , and salt , and fry , stirring constantly until tomato pieces break down to form a lumpy paste
7. Add coconut milk and simmer about 5 minutes until a thick , rich sauce is formed
8. Arrange fish in an oiled baking / serving dish large enough to hold fish in a single layer
9. Bake , uncovered , for 10 minutes in the preheated oven
10. Pour sauce over fish , cover tightly with aluminum foil , and return to oven for 15 to 20 minutes until fish is opaque
11. Garnish with chopped cilantro

title: baked artichoke spinach dip
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f grease 8 x 8-in glass baking dish
2. In a large bowl beat cream cheese until smooth
3. Add milk , roasted garlic , nutmeg , parsley , salt and pepper and mix until combined
4. Mix in 1 cup each of mozzarella and parmesan cheese along with chopped spinach
5. Gently fold in artichoke heats
6. Pour mixture into greased baking dish , top with remaining cheese , and bake for 25 - 30 min or until cheese is bubbly and top is golden brown
7. Remove from oven and serve with sliced baguette or assorted veggie sticks
8. Enjoy !

title: grammom s beef stroganoff
steps:
1. Brown onion in 1 tablespoon of butter , remove to a dish
2. Brown beef in 1 tablespoon of butter and add to onion
3. Cook mushrooms in remaining butter , then remove to beef mixture , leaving liquid in skillet
4. Stir flour into 1 / 2 cup of water until smooth , add beef bouillon then combine in skillet with mushroom liquid
5. Cook and stir constantly over low heat until sauce thickens
6. Remove from heat , stir in sour cream , worcestershire sauce and sherry and dill weed , if using
7. Stir in meat mixture
8. Serve with wide egg noodles

title: salmon confetti
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425f
2. Brown diced bacon 3 to 4 minutes on medium-high heat
3. Rinse the salmon and pat dry
4. Place the salmon skin-side down in a baking pan
5. Spread mayonnaise evenly over the entire salmon
6. Place the diced onion , tomato , mushroom and bacon on the fish , then spoon the capers over the filling
7. Squeeze the juice from half a lemon over the entire fish
8. You may want to use less juice since capers are also added
9. Finally , sprinkle some salt and pepper over the fish and stuffing
10. Cover the salmon tightly with foil and bake in oven for about 35 to 45 minutes , or until the vegetables are slightly cooked and the fish is tender
11. When the fish is done , it will look as if a handful of confetti was thrown on top of it

title: greeny s peanut butter banana bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. To prepare bread , combine first 5 ingredients in a large bowl
3. Beat with a mixer at medium speed
4. Add granulated sugar , splenda , and brown sugar
5. Beat until blended
6. Weigh or lightly spoon flour into dry measuring cups
7. Level with a knife
8. Combine flours and remaining ingredients in a small bowl
9. Add flour mixture to banana mixture
10. Beat just until blended
11. Add chocolate chips , if desired
12. Pour batter into a 9 x 5-inch loaf pan coated with cooking spray
13. Bake at 350 for 1 hour and 5 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean
14. Remove from oven
15. Cool 10 minutes in pan on a wire rack
16. Remove bread from pan
17. Cool

title: low fat chocolate chip banana muffins
steps:
1. Mash bananas
2. Add remaining ingredients except chocolate chips and mix
3. Add chocolate chips and stir
4. Pour into grased muffin tins and bake at 350 for approx 15-20 minutes

title: crock pot chicken and vegetable alfredo
steps:
1. Put chicken in crock pot
2. In a bowl , combine the alfredo sauce , corn , peas , mushrooms , onion , water , garlic salt and pepper
3. Pour over chicken
4. Cover and cook on low for 6-8 hours
5. Serve over linguine

title: strawberry sauce
steps:
1. Boil sugar and water together about 12 minutes
2. Add strawberries , cook another minute and chill

title: lasagna with italian sausage and spinach
steps:
1. Rinse cooked lasagna noodles and set aside
2. Be sure that you don't use more than 12 oz
3. Or the lasagna will be too dry
4. Meanwhile , in a dutch oven or other large vessel , put the oil , onion and green bell pepper
5. Saute over medium heat until the onion is tender
6. Add the sausage and garlic and stir-fry until well browned , chopping up the meat as you stir , to make sure all of the pieces are small
7. Add the diced tomatoes , tomato paste , parsley , oregano , basil and 1 teaspoons salt
8. Reduce heat to low and simmer for about 15 minutes , stirring occasionally
9. Meanwhile , press out the water from the thawed spinach so that it is very dry
10. Put the spinach into a medium-size mixing bowl
11. Add the cottage cheese , egg , 1 / 4 cup parmesan cheese , 1 teaspoons salt and black pepper to the spinach
12. Stir until well mixed
13. In another medium-size bowl put the grated mozzarella cheese
14. In a lasagna pan that you have oiled , put down 1 / 3 of the tomato-meat sauce
15. Cover with 1 / 2 of the lasagna noodles
16. Top with 1 / 2 of the spinach-cottage cheese filling
17. Top with half of the mozzarella cheese
18. Repeat using 1 / 3 of the tomato-meat sauce , remaining noodles , remaining spinach filling and mozzarella cheese
19. Top with the remaining 1 / 3 of the tomato-meat sauce and sprinkle 1 / 4 cup parmesan cheese over the very top
20. Bake in a 350 degrees oven for 45 minutes
21. You might wonder whether or not there is enough tomato sauce , but once the lasagna heats up and the cheese gets gooey , there is enough sauce
22. I don't like a a lasagna with lots of runny heavy tomato sauce that covers the taste of everything else in the lasagna
23. If you feel like you need a bit more , add an 8 oz
24. Can of tomato sauce to the tomato-meat sauce

title: grilled tuna with lemon anchovy butter
steps:
1. Light the grill or heat the broiler
2. In a small bowl , combine the butter , anchovy paste , lemon juice , parsley , and a pinch each of salt and pepper
3. Coat the tuna with the oil
4. Sprinkle with 1 / 2 teaspoon salt and 1 / 4 teaspoon pepper
5. Cook the tuna for 4 minutes
6. Turn and cook until done to your taste , 3 to 4 minutes longer for medium rare
7. Top the hot fish with the flavored butter

title: lisa s jean bars
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f
2. Cut margarine into flour and sugar until crumbly
3. Press into bottom of 9x13 pan
4. Bake for 10 minutes
5. Cool on wire rack for 10 minutes
6. In large bowl , combine all filling ingredients
7. Mix well
8. Spread over partially baked crust
9. Return to oven and bake 15-20 minutes or until golden brown
10. Cool completely
11. In small bowl , blend all frosting ingredients until creamy and spread over bars

title: cheesy bread pudding
steps:
1. Grease a 15x15 cm casserole dish with the butter
2. Half bread slices diagonally and layer into the dish
3. In a bowl beat eggs with milk and cream
4. Season with nutmeg and paprike as well as salt and pepper to taste
5. Pour the egg mixture over the bread slices and top with shredded cheese
6. Bake in the preheated oven at 200c / 400f for 20 minutes or until set and nicely browned
7. Enjoy ! :)

title: three can bean salad
steps:
1. In medium-sized bowl , combine oil , lemon juice , and rosemary
2. Add drained corn and beans
3. Break ham into chunks with fork
4. Add to bowl
5. Toss all ingredients together
6. Refrigerate until ready to serve

title: mexican chocolate cheesecake
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees
2. Wrap outside bottom and side of 8 or 9 inch springform pan with heavy duty foil
3. Spray inside of pan with cooking spray
4. Grind and mix wafers with 3 / 4 tsp cinnamon mix in melted butter
5. Press into bottom of pan
6. Bake crust 8 to 10 minutes or until set
7. Reduce oven temperature to 300 degrees
8. Cool crust 10 minutes before filling
9. In 2 quart saucepan , melt chocolate chips and cream over medium - low heat
10. Stir until smooth
11. In large bowl , beat cream cheese , sugar , pepper , 1 / 2 tsp cinnamon and vanilla with mixer on medium speed until fluffy
12. Beat in eggs , one at a time , just until blended
13. Stir in chocolate mixture
14. Pour over crust
15. Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour or until edge of cheesecake is set 2 inches from edge of pan but center still jiggles slightly
16. Turn oven off
17. Open oven door 4 inches
18. Leave cheesecake in oven 30 minutes
19. After removing cake from oven run a metal spatula around the edge of pan
20. Cool on rack for 30 minutes
21. Refrigerate 6 hours or overnight
22. Run spatula around edge of pan again
23. Remove side of pan
24. Top with whipped cream and sprinkle remaining 1 / 2 tsp cinnamon if desired
25. You can also put some chocolate shavings on top to fancy it up
26. Store in refridgerator

title: mellow mushroom esperanza dressing
steps:
1. Put all ingredients except oil and parsley in the bowl of a food processor and process until smooth
2. With motor running , drizzle in oil through feed tube
3. Stir in parsley by hand

title: ham n cheese muffins
steps:
1. In a nonstick skillet , saute onion in butter until tender
2. Set aside
3. In a bowl , combine cheese and biscuit mix
4. Stir in milk and egg just until moistened
5. Fold in ham and onion mixture
6. Coat muffin cups with cooking spray or use paper liners
7. Fill three-fourths full
8. Bake at 425 for 13-15 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean
9. Cool for 5 minutes before removing from pan to a wire rack
10. Serve warm

title: chinese broccoli with ginger sauce
steps:
1. Cut the broccoli stalks in half lengthwise if more than 1 / 2 inch in diameter
2. Cut the stalks and leaves into 2-inch-long pieces , keeping the stalk ends separate from the leaves
3. In a small bowl combine the broth , rice wine , ginger juice , cornstarch , salt , and sugar
4. Heat a 14-inch flat-bottomed wok over high heat until a bead of water vaporizes within 1 to 2 seconds of contact
5. Swirl in the oil , add the ginger , and stir-fry 10 seconds or until the ginger is fragrant
6. Add only the broccoli stalks and stir-fry 1 to 1-1 / 2 minutes until the stalks are bright green
7. Add the leaves and stir-fry 1 minute until the leaves are just limp
8. Stir the broth mixture and swirl it into the wok
9. Stir-fry 1 minute or until the sauce has thickened slightly and lightly coats the vegetables

title: easy chicken satay peanut curry
steps:
1. Chop the garlic and onion
2. Place butter , garlic and onion in microwave proof dish and cook on high for 1 minute
3. Add peanut butter , curry powder , something spicy and chicken stock and cook on high for 4 minutes
4. Stopping after 2 minutes and stirring
5. Cut chicken into pieces and add to peanut sauce mixture
6. Cook on high a further 2 minutes
7. Serve with steamed rice

title: cold lo mein with ham and cucumber
steps:
1. Cook noodles in boiling water for about 3 minutes or until done
2. Rinse with cold water and drain well
3. Place in a large bowl
4. Sprinkle with the sesame oil and mix well
5. Add the cucumber and ham to the cool noodles
6. In a small bowl combine and whisk together the soy sauce , vinegar , sugar and tabasco
7. Pour the above mixture over the noodles and mix again before serving

title: crispy cayenne cocktail catfish
steps:
1. Combine the catfish with the zest of one lime , the juice of both limes , the cayenne flakes , and the vermouth
2. Let marinate about 1 hour
3. Drain catfish well
4. Heat 1 / 2 an inch of oil , half olive and half canola , in a skillet on medium to medium high
5. Beat egg into milk in a shallow bowl
6. Combine 1 / 4 cup flour with salt and pepper to taste
7. Combine remaining dry ingredients in a plastic bag
8. Dip each piece of fish into the flour then into the egg / milk mixture
9. Shake in breading bag until well coated
10. Fry pieces in the hot oil until the first side is browned
11. Do not crowd the pieces in the pan
12. Turn and brown the other side
13. Repeat until all batches are done
14. Serve with hot sauce , additional cayenne pepper flakes , lime wedges , and lemon wedges available at the table
15. I suggest completing the meal with baked sweet potatoes and cole slaw

title: chinese cold celery slices
steps:
1. Mix together soy sauce , salt , sesame oil , sugar and hot sauce
2. Set aside
3. Slice celery on a slight diagonal and scald in a pot of boiling water for 2 minutes
4. Drain and put celery in ice cold water for 1 minute
5. Drain again and pour the sauce over the celery

title: shrimp in tomato cream sauce
steps:
1. Bring a pot of water to a boil and drop the tomatoes in one at a time
2. Let them sit in water 30 seconds
3. This should let the skins peel right off
4. Once all the tomatoes are skinned , de-seed them and chop up finely
5. Now use the boiling water for the pasta
6. Follow the box directions for the pasta
7. Now in a large sauce pan , heat the olive oil over med-hi heat and saute the garlic for 15-20 seconds
8. Just enough to release the flavor
9. Then add the tomatoes and saute for 5 mins to make the tomatoes break down
10. Now add the wine if you're going to use it
11. Stir constantly until the wine evaporates and the tomatoes resemble mush
12. Now add the cream and shrimp , turn the heat down to med and continue stirring until thickened and shrimp have cooked through - about 15-20 minutes
13. Serve over pasta

title: rich roll cookies
steps:
1. Cream together butter and sugar
2. Beat in egg and extract
3. Combine and add flour and salt
4. Wrap dough well and chill or freeze until you are able to handle it easily
5. Can also make day ahead and place in fridge wrapped in plastic wrap
6. To bake: preheat oven to 350
7. Roll out and cut with cookie cutters
8. Place on either a greased cookie sheet or one lined with a silpat liner or parchment paper
9. Bake 8-10 minutes for thin cookies or 15 minutes+ for thick cookies or cookies on a stick
10. When they are lightly browned , they are ready
11. Cool on pan for 1-2 minutes , transfer to a cooling rack to cool completely before decorating
12. Use your favorite icing recipe

title: cinnamon cappuccino   weight watchers
steps:
1. In a medium nonstick pan , bring the milk , vanilla and cinnamon just to a boil
2. Remove from the heat and whisk until frothy , about 1 minute
3. In a large mug , combine the coffee and the milk mixture
4. Sprinkle with the cocoa and garnish with the cinnamon stick
5. Serve
6. 2 pts
7. Each

title: chicken and potato florentine soup  olive garden
steps:
1. Simmer first 6 ingredients until chicken breasts are tender
2. Remove meat and let cool
3. Drain the solids from the broth and put clear liquid back into the soup pot
4. Chop up chicken into bite size chunks and put back into the broth
5. Add next 10 ingredients to the soup pot and simmer for 45-60 minutes
6. The potatoes should be fork tender but not mushy
7. Add the fresh spinach and stir
8. Let it wilt into the soup for about 5 minutes
9. Add the cream cheese and the grated mozzarella to the soup pot
10. Stir frequently until the cheese melts
11. Be careful that it does not stick to the bottom
12. Ladle into bowls
13. Serve with crusty bread

title: roasted veggie orzo
steps:
1. Place vegetables in a 15-in
2. X 10-in
3. X 1-in
4. Baking pan coated with cooking spray
5. Drizzle with oil and sprinkle with seasonings
6. Toss to coat
7. Bake at 400 for 20-25 minutes or until tender , stirring occasionally
8. Meanwhile , cook orzo according to package directions
9. Drain
10. Transfer to a serving bowl
11. Stir in roasted vegetables
12. Sprinkle with cheese

title: clams casino venus de milo
steps:
1. Sautee the bacon over a medium fire until it begins to brown
2. Add the garlic and the vegetables and saut until the vegetables begin to wilt
3. Remove from the fire
4. In a double boiler melt the butter
5. Skim the clear butter off of the top with a ladle and place in a measuring cup discarding the milky portion that remains
6. Crush 1-1 sleeves of ritz crackers and measure off 2 cups
7. Combine cup of drawn butter with 2 cups of ritz crackers
8. Adjust the seasoning if needed
9. Combine the ritz cracker and butter mixture with the vegetable mixture
10. To make clams casino: wash and open little neck clams being careful to retain as much of the juices as you can
11. This is accomplished by not
12. Stuff the clams with casino topping and place a small square of raw bacon on top
13. Broil in a 375 f oven until the crumbs are brown and the bacon is crispy
14. Serve with cocktail sauce

title: easy asian dipping sauce for dim sum
steps: 1. Mix all ingredients to combine and serve

title: creole pork roast
steps:
1. Make slits in the top of the roast
2. Add 1 tbsp creole seasoning to the vegetable mixture and stuff into slits
3. Rub seasoning over the outside of the roast
4. Place on roaster uncovered at 350f until roast is browned
5. Reduce heat to 300f cover and continue to cook for 1 1 / 2 to 2 hours

title: grilled turkey burgers with monterey jack
steps:
1. Heat your grill to high
2. Shape the ground turkey into 4 round patties about 1 1 / 2 inch thick
3. Brush each burger on both sides with the oil and season with the salt and pepper
4. Grill until cooked completely through , about 4 minutes per side
5. Place a slice of cheese on each burger , close the lid of the grill , and cook for 1 minute longer to melt the cheese
6. Let rest for 5 minutes
7. Top each burger with 1 tablespoon of avocado mayonnaise and a few tablespoons of poblano pickle relish
8. Serve the remaining avocado mayonnaise on the side if desired

title: crazy good cream of broccoli soup
steps:
1. In med
2. Size saucepan cook the broccoli , broth , onion and spices until broccoli stems are tender
3. Remove bay leaf
4. Puree this mixture in several small batches in your blender
5. Be careful ! this stuff is hot
6. Only fill your blender half way so you don't hurt yourself and make a mess !
7. Put pureed mix in a bowl , rinse out saucepan and melt the butter on
8. Med
9. Heat
10. Once melted , add the flour and whisk together
11. Then add the milk
12. Once this mixture has thickened a bit , add the puree
13. Mix well and then serve and enjoy !

title: australian shepherd s pie
steps:
1. In large saucepan , cook mince , onion and carrot till mince is cooked through
2. Drain fat
3. Add remaining ingredients and simmer for 10 minutes
4. If mixture is wetter than you light , add tablespoon of flour and stir
5. Place meat mixture in casserole dish
6. Top with mashed potatoes
7. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes

title: diet key lime cheesecake
steps:
1. Heat water in microwave
2. Stir jello into water and set aside
3. In a mixing bowl , blend splenda , cream cheese , and heavy cream until completely mixed
4. Add lime juice and dissolved jello and mix well
5. Pour into empty pie pan and chill 4 hours
6. Alternately , pour right into parfait glasses
7. This is nice with whipped cream

title: peaches and cream pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Combine first 7 ingredients in a bowl and beat 2 minutes with electric mixer
3. Pour into buttered 9 inch pie plate
4. Arrange peaches over batter
5. Combine cream cheese , 1 / 2 cup sugar and 3 tbsp reserved peach juice in a mixing bowl
6. Beat 2 minutes
7. Pour over peaches and smooth out to cover pie , leaving 1 / 2 inch around outside edge
8. Combine 1 tbsp sugar and cinnamon in a bowl and sprinkle over pie
9. Bake 35 minutes until golden

title: fisherman s seafood stew
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large dutch oven over medium heat
2. Add shallots and bell pepper
3. Cook 5 minutes
4. Add wine and next 6 ingredients
5. Bring to a boil
6. Reduce heat
7. Simmer 5 minutes , stirring occasionally
8. Nestle fish into tomato mixture
9. Top with mussels
10. Cover and cook 8 minutes
11. Gently shake pan twice to stir mussels
12. Discard any unopened shells and bay leaf
13. Sprinkle with parsley

title: herbed garlic lentils
steps:
1. Place lentils in a strainer and discard any stones that you find
2. Rinse and drain
3. Place a medium saucepan over medium-high heat and add chicken broth
4. Bring to a rolling boil
5. Pour lentils into the pot slowly so that the water does not stop boiling
6. Add the onion and garlic
7. Reduce heat to medium , cover , and simmer 20 minutes
8. Check after 15 minutes to see if the pan is dry
9. Add 1 / 4 cup water if needed
10. If there is too much liquid , remove lid and boil to evaporate
11. Remove from heat and add vinegar , oil , salt , and pepper
12. Toss well
13. Place on individual plates with the sliced tomatoes on the sides

title: mi  dana s cream cheese mints
steps:
1. Combine cream cheese , powdered sugar , and peppermint flavoring in large bowl , and stir until well-mixed
2. If you wish to make different colored mints , divide dough into however many colors you desire
3. 1 drop of food coloring per 1 / 4 portion of mixture
4. Knead until color is evenly distributed
5. Knead in more powdered sugar if dough is sticky
6. Roll dough into small balls , 1 / 2 inch
7. Roll balls into granulated sugar
8. Press into small molds or press down with bottom of a glass , thumb , or fork
9. Immediately remove to waxed paper or non-stick aluminum foil to dry
10. Chill , and then store in an airtight container

title: pork  veal  or chicken schnitzel
steps:
1. Also requires: 2 large pieces of wax paper for each breast used 1 large baking pan or cooky sheet in a 200-250 degree oven for keeping meat hot while cooking successive pieces
2. 1 piece of paper towel to put between layers of meat in the low hot oven to keep pieces from sticking together
3. Place a piece of breast in between 2 large pieces of wax paper
4. Using the smooth side of a meat tenderizer , pound until very thin
5. The breast will become very large and you will actually be able to get at least 2 large servings from each breast
6. After pounding each piece of meat , place on a large serving plate without removing the wax paper and chill well in the refrigerator
7. When ready to cook do the following-- place the eggs in a glass pie pan with the water , salt , and pepper and mix well
8. Place the flour in another container next to the seasoned eggs
9. Place the bread crumbs in another container on the other side of the seasoned eggs
10. Start heating up the cooking oil in a large frying pan on medium high heat
11. Do not get oil too hot-- but hot enough so that it will cook the meat quickly without burning either the meat or the oil
12. After removing the wax paper from each side of the meat , dip each piece of meat in the eggs , then the flour , then the eggs again , then the breadcrumbs
13. Fry until golden brown on each side
14. Place each piece of cooked meat in the oven using paper towel pieces to separate the pieces from each other
15. When finished cooking serve with slices or wedges of fresh lemon
16. I find it is good with most side dishes
17. It is such a favorite in our home that family members fight over the leftover pieces eating them cold right from the refrigerator

title: corn and tomato salad with cilantro dressing
steps:
1. In a large bowl combine corn , tomatoes and red onion
2. In a blender combine oil , cilantro , mint , vinegar , lime juice , brown sugar , garlic and salt and pepper
3. Puree until smooth
4. Just before serving , pour dressing over corn mixture and toss
5. Try serving with recipe#369273

title: portabella mushroom  onion and sage spread
steps:
1. Chop mushrooms , onion and garlic
2. Set aside
3. Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat
4. Stir in the mushrooms , onions and garlic
5. Stirring occasionally , cook for about 2 minutes
6. Reduce the heat to medium low heat
7. Add cooking sherry
8. Simmer about 25-30 minutes , until the mushrooms are very soft and most of the liquid is gone
9. Put into a food processor
10. Add the sage , salt and corn syrup
11. Pulse until coarsely chopped , not pureed
12. If there is too much liquid , you can return it to the skillet , over medium low until it reaches desired consistency
13. Cover & refreigerate serve at room temperature with crackers

title: roast beef sandwiches with caramelized onion
steps:
1. Cook the onion in the oil in a large skillet over medium heat for about 8 minutes , until it's soft , stirring occasionally
2. Reduce the heat to low and cook until the onion is golden brown , about 20 minutes more
3. Spread 1 / 3 of the mustard on 3 slices of bread
4. Add the onion mixture and beef

title: christmas butter
steps:
1. Chop almonds and hazelnuts in a blender or food processor until very fine
2. Add honey , butter and lemon juice and mix until smooth

title: penne san remo  inspired by buca di beppo
steps:
1. Cook penne pasta according to packaging instructions drain and set aside
2. Use a meat tenderizer to pound the meat to an even thickness cut the chicken breast in half , length wise
3. For breading the chicken breasts , combine flour , italian seasoning , salt , black pepper
4. Dredge chicken breasts on both sides with the flour mixture
5. In a large skillet , over medium heat , heat olive oil and butter then saut the chicken on both sides , 3-5 minutes per side or until it turns golden brown
6. Remove the chicken from the pan and slice chicken into thin , bite-sized pieces about set aside
7. Remove as much of the cooked oil from the skillet and replace with fresh olive oil reserved for the sauce
8. Add minced garlic , sun-dried tomatoes , and artichokes
9. Stir for about 2 minutes
10. Sprinkle the pan with the flour reserved for thickening the sauce
11. Stir until all ingredients are covered with flour , about 30 seconds
12. Add the white wine and bring it to a boil
13. Once boiling , lower the heat to low medium and simmer for 2-3 minutes
14. When much of the wine has evaporated or the sauce starts to thicken , raise the heat to medium and add the cream and stir for 30-45 seconds until well incorporated
15. Add the parmesan cheese and stir to incorporate all the ingredients
16. Add the green peas and stir for about three minutes
17. Add the sliced chicken and the pasta to the pan and mix with the sauce
18. Make sure the pasta is thoroughly coated with the sauce
19. Enjoy

title: a little piece of heaven on a plate
steps:
1. On a cookie sheet put 2 tbsp mounds of cookie dough- 1 mound per serving
2. Begin baking cookies according to directions on package or recipe
3. In a saucepan combine 1oz grand marnier for every 1 / 4 cup of caramel sauce
4. Simmer on low
5. Stir constantly
6. When the cookies have only 2 to 3 minutes remaining to bake , put the pecans in the oven to toast
7. I always just use the same baking sheet
8. When cookies have finished baking assemble the dessert in the following manner: place one cookie on one dessert plate
9. Put one scoop of ice cream on top of the cookie
10. Spoon caramel / grand marnier mixture over the ice cream
11. Sprinkle pecans over entire dessert
12. Repeat for each serving

title: salad olivier   russian potato salad
steps:
1. Cut up the chicken and set aside
2. Boil potatoes and carrots until they are soft in the middle and let cool to room temperature
3. Dice potatoes and carrots and combine in bowl
4. Add diced eggs , pickles , green onions , dill and sweet peas
5. Add the chicken
6. Mix all ingredients well while adding salt and pepper
7. Add mayonnaise and mix all ingredients well again
8. Sprinkle with some dill and refrigerate for 2-3 hours)

title: chicken and rice 1 pot meal
steps:
1. In a skillet with a lid , saute onions with oil and soy sauce
2. When they begin to brown , push them to the center and add the chicken pieces to the outside of the pan , brown them on the first side
3. When you flip them over push them to the center and add the rice to the outside of the pan , cover with the water and push the carrot pieces into the rice so that they are at least partially covered by the water
4. Bring to boil , cover and simmer for 40 minutes

title: borsch
steps:
1. Scrub well beets put in large pot with 8 cups water
2. Bring to boil and then reduce to simmer and cook until tender
3. When tender take slotted spoon and put beets immediately into cold water
4. Slip skins off with your hands
5. If you have a cuisinart , chop beets into tiny pieces
6. If no cuisinart , then you will have to chop the beets up by hand
7. Put chopped beets into pot , add fresh dill , chopped , 1 can campbell's tomato zest soup and 6 cups of the cooking beet water
8. If you want a thinner borscht use a little more of the beet water
9. Stir well
10. Serve with 1 tbsp
11. Sour cream per individual serving
12. Add salt to your own taste
13. I don't use any salt
14. Enjoy !

title: chinese style spicy pickled cucumbers
steps:
1. Toss the cucumber wedges with the salt and let them stand in a bowl for 20 minutes
2. Drain the cucumbers in a colander , rinse them under cold water , and pat them dry on paper towels
3. In a bowl dissolve the sugar in the vinegar , stirring , add the cucumbers , and toss them to coat them with the mixture
4. In a small skillet heat the sesame oil and the vegetable oil over moderately high heat until the oil is just smoking , add the gingerroot and the redpepper flakes , and stir fry the mixture for 5 - 10 seconds , or until the red pepper flakes are several shades darker
5. Remove the skillet from the heat and let the oil cool to room termperature
6. Pour the spiced oil over the cucumbers , toss the mixture well and let it marinate at room temperature for 1 hour
7. Refrigerate and cover , stirring occasionally
8. Use within 5 days

title: only veggies broccoli cauliflower salad
steps:
1. Cut vegetables into bite size pieces and add peas
2. Finely slice onions
3. Mix sour cream and mayonnaise together with seasonings
4. Mix well and add to vegetables
5. Best if made 24 hours ahead to marinate
6. Keeps quite well

title: paul bunyan burgers
steps:
1. Brown ground beef in skillet
2. Pour off drippings
3. Add next 6 ingredients , mix well
4. Bring to a boil , stirring constantly
5. Reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes
6. Cut french bread lengthwise
7. Place half of mozzarella cheese on bottom
8. Fill with beef mixture
9. Cover with remaining cheese slices and top slice of bread
10. Wrap in foil and bake at 400 degrees for 8 to 10 minutes
11. Cut into sandwiches

title: eyeball cookies halloween
steps:
1. In a microwave safe bowl , melt 4 squares of white chocolate and stir until smooth
2. Dip the vanilla wafers , one at a time in the melted chocolate and place on a waxed paper lined cookie sheet
3. Chill in the fridge until it is set
4. Melt the remaining white chocolate and add some of the blue food coloring in until you get a nice blue that you like for eye color
5. Can be pale blue or dark
6. Spread a small amount of the blue onto the center of the chilled cookie then place a chocolate chip in the middle of the blue to look like the pupil
7. For bloodshot eyes , using a toothpick or fine paintbrush draw in lines from the blue of the eye outward to the edges of the cookie
8. Chill until set
9. Store in an airtight container

title: egg drop chicken soup
steps:
1. Pour chicken stock into saucepan and bring to boil
2. Meanwhile place eggs in small bowl
3. Add parsley , pepper and worcestershire sauce , beat well
4. Reduce heat under soup to medium
5. Pour egg mixture into liquid and stir quickly
6. Cook for 30 seconds
7. Remove from heat and serve at once

title: zippy beans and rice
steps:
1. In a skillet , combine the beans , tomatoes , corn , water , jalapeno and salt if desired
2. Bring to a boil
3. Stir in rice
4. Cover and remove from the heat
5. Let stand for 5 minutes or until liquid is absorbed
6. Sprinkle with onion
7. Yield: 6 servings

title: chicken stuffing bake
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine soup and milk until blended
2. Add the stuffing mix with contents of seasoning packet , chicken , broccoli , mushrooms , and 1 c cheese
3. Transfer to a greased 9 x 13 baking dish
4. Bake , uncovered , at 375 for 20 minutes or until heated through
5. Sprinkle with remaining cheese , bake 5 minutes longer or until cheese is melted

title: tropical paradise
steps:
1. Blend with ice and pour into a 5oz cocktial or martini glass and serve
2. Garnish with an orchid , or slice of fresh mango
3. Enjoy !
4. )

title: el chico fried ice cream
steps:
1. At least 5 hours in advance: combine crumbs , sugar , and cinnamon in a shallow pan
2. Let ice cream soften slightly for 5 minutes
3. Make 6 balls of ice cream
4. Roll in crumb mixture until well-coated , pressing coating into ice cream
5. Wrap in aluminum foil and freeze for 5 hours
6. Heat oil to 450f
7. Unwrap each ball and fry in hot oil very briefly , about 2 seconds
8. Place in dessert dish
9. Decorate with toppings , whipped cream , and a cherry
10. Serve immediately

title: afghani nan khatai cardamom spiced cookies topped with pistacios
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees
2. Mix the white flour with the sugar , and crushed cardamon
3. Next , add the oil and mix well
4. Make the dough into two inch round balls and put them on a cookie sheet and bake for 15min , or until lightly browned
5. Sprinkle finely ground pistachios on top of the cookies while they are still hot
6. Let cool before eating
7. Enjoy

title: virginia s baked spaghetti
steps:
1. Combine spaghetti noodles , spaghetti sauce and ground beef in a large bowl
2. Set aside
3. Melt butter in a saucepan over medium heat
4. Add flour , parmesan cheese , salt and garlic powder , stirring constantly until smooth and bubbly
5. Add evaporated milk and one cup cheddar cheese
6. Stir until thickened
7. Pour half of spaghetti noodle mixture into a greased 13x9" casserole dish and pour cheese mixture over top
8. Pour remaining noodle mixture into dish
9. Top with remaining 2 cups cheddar cheese
10. Bake at 350 for 25-30 minutes

title: whole grain pancakes    make ahead mix
steps:
1. Place oats in a spice grinder or mini processor and process to the consistency of flour
2. Transfer to a large bowl
3. Mix in pastry flour , sugar , baking powder , baking soda , and salt
4. Place 1 1 / 3 cups of the mix into each of three zipper-top plastic bags
5. Refrigerate or freeze up to three months
6. When ready to make pancakes , lightly beat eggs in a large bowl
7. Blend in buttermilk , butter , and vanilla
8. Add one package of pancake mix and stir just until the mixture forms a lumpy batter
9. Avoid overmixing
10. Heat a large griddle or skillet over medium heat and use a silicone brush or paper towel to coat it lightly with oil
11. When a drop of water thrown on the griddle sizzles , pour on 1 / 4 cup of batter for each pancake , leaving space between them for the pancakes to spread
12. When the pancakes become slightly dry around the edges and little bubbles appear on the surface , flip them
13. Cook until brown on the second side
14. Serve immediately or keep warm in a single layer on a rack in a 200f oven

title: ma amoul   nut cookies
steps:
1. Mix flout and sugar
2. Cut in the butter
3. Add 1 tablespoon rose water and just enough milk to bind mixture
4. Nut filling: mix and set aside- 1 1 / 2 cups nuts , 4 - 5 tablespoons sugar , 1 teaspoon cinnamon , and 2 tablespoons rose water
5. Take a walnut size lump of dough and make a hole in the center to make a hollow container
6. Fill with the nut mix
7. Cover opening by folding and pinching
8. Prick with fork
9. Bake at t325 for 20 to 30 minutes
10. Do not brown !
11. Cool before removing from pan
12. Dust with powdered sugar

title: ham asparagus strata
steps:
1. In a greased 2-quart square baking dish spread half of the english muffin pieces
2. Top with ham , asparagus , and cheese
3. Top with the remaining english muffins pieces
4. In a bowl whisk together eggs and sour cream , stir in milk onion , mustard , and 1 / 8 teaspoon black pepper
5. Pour evenly over layers in dish
6. Cover and chill 2 to 24 hours
7. Bake , uncovered , in a 325 degree oven for 60 to 65 minutes or until internal temperature registers 170 degrees on an instant thermometer
8. Let stand for 10 minutes before serving

title: oatmeal porridge with raisins  apricots  and figs
steps:
1. Add water to a saucepan
2. Bring to a boil
3. Stir in the oats , raisins , apricots , figs , sugar , vanilla , cinnamon , cardamom , and salt
4. Bring to a boil
5. Lower heat to med-low
6. Simmer , uncovered , for about 5-10 minutes or until the liquid is absorbed and the fruit softened

title: easy carrot cake with cream cheese icing
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Grease and flour a 9x11 pan or 2 8 inch round pans
3. In a large bowl beat together eggs , oil , sugar and vanilla
4. Mix in flour , baking soda , salt , baking powder and cinnamon
5. Stir in carrots
6. Fold in nuts , if desired
7. Pour into prepared pan
8. Bake in preheated oven for 30 to 50 minutes
9. Check after 30 minutes with a toothpick
10. If toothpick is clean , cake is done
11. Let cool in pan for an additional 10 minutes
12. Turn out onto a wire cooling rack and cool completely
13. To make icing , use a medium bowl and mix butter , cream cheese , confectioner's sugar and vanilla until smooth
14. You may add chopped nuts to icing now or sprinkle later over the top of the cake
15. After the cake is completely cooled , ice the cake
16. If the chopped nuts were not added to the icing earlier sprinkle them over the iced cake

title: ahi jicama salad
steps:
1. Have all ingredients chilled
2. Use an immersion blender to make dressing
3. Set aside two tablespoons , then toss veggies with remaining 1 / 4 cup
4. Arrange veggies on two plates , then top with the ahi
5. Drizzle with dressing , and , if desired , arrange avocado on top , sprinkle with chilis and cilantro

title: beef barbecue biscuits
steps:
1. In a skillet , brown beef , drain
2. Add bbq sauce , onion , and brown sugar
3. Set aside
4. Separate dough into 10 biscuites , flatten into 5" circles
5. Press firmly into bottom and up sides of greased muffin cups
6. Spoon 2 tablespoon of beef mixture into each cup sprinkle with cheese
7. Bake at 400

title: spiced chicken with pineapple salsa
steps:
1. Heat a dry skillet , add the first four ingredients and toast stirring continuously for about 30 seconds
2. Take of the heat and set aside to cool , crush using a pestle and mortar
3. Add juice of 1 lime and olive oil and mix well
4. Place the chicken breast side down onto a chopping board and cut along both sides of the backbone to remove it
5. Remove the wishbone
6. Turn the chicken over and flatten it out by pressing down the breast bone firmly
7. If you don't want to do this you can either ask your butcher to do it for you or use chicken pieces
8. Insert a long metal skewer diagonally through the leg and wing on either side to keep the chicken flat
9. Slash the thickest part of the chickens thigh with a sharp knife and place it into a roasting tin
10. Pour the marinade over the chicken and the turn it over
11. Cover the tin with aluminium foil and keep refrigerated overnight
12. Grill under a preheated grill for approx 45 minutes or until juices run clear and chicken turns golden brown
13. Salsa
14. Just before placing the chicken under the grill , mix the juice of the second lime with the pineapple , onion , chilie and cilantro
15. Season to taste with salt and pepper
16. Refrigerate for 30 minutes , and the remove from fridge to allow it to reach room temperature before serving
17. Serve with the grilled chicken
