title: caramelized onion  sometimes bacon  and pecan brussels sprouts
steps:
1. Cut onion in half , and thinly slice
2. Cut brussels sprouts in half , then cut each half into thin pieces
3. Chill the onion and brussels sprouts in separate bags for 8 hours
4. Melt butter in large skillet over medium heat
5. Add pecans , and saute 5 minutes or until toasted
6. Remove pecans
7. Add onion , and cook , stirring often , 15 minutes or until caramel colored
8. Add pecans and brussels sprouts , and cook about 3 minutes or until heated
9. Salt and pepper and serve

title: grandma s secret wiener schnitzel recipe
steps:
1. Pound meat until it is less than 1 / 4 inch thick
2. Into a large skillet , pour oil approximately 1 / 4-inch deep
3. Heat until oil bubbles when you drop in a pinch of breadcrumbs
4. Beat egg , add:
5. 1 teaspoons lemon juice
6. Add parsley to breadcrumbs
7. Dredge meat in egg , then breadcrumb mixture
8. Fry until golden brown on each side
9. Sprinkle with remaining lemon juice

title: oven roasted earl grey tea  lemon   rosemary brined turkey
steps:
1. Bring 6 1 / 2 quarts water to a boil
2. Remove from heat and add tea , lemon peel and rosemary
3. Cover and let steep for 20 minutes
4. If using tea bags , remove them
5. If using bulk tea , remove lemon peel and rosemary , set aside and strain the mixture and discard the tea leaves
6. Pour the mixture back in the pot and stir in salt , sugar and the set-aside lemon peel and rosemary
7. Stir until salt and sugar are dissolved
8. Stir in the ice , cool to below 50 degrees f
9. Line a large pot with two 30-gallon plastic garbage bags , one inside the other
10. Place turkey in the bag-lined pot , breast-side down
11. Pour brine over turkey
12. Press to submerge
13. Twist off bags to eliminate air pockets and tie
14. Refrigerate turkey in brine for 2 days
15. Drain turkey , discard brine
16. Pat turkey dry
17. Stuff cavity with rosemary , punctured lemons , celery and onion
18. Fold wing
19. Rub olive oil all over the turkey
20. Place oven rack in the lowest third of the oven and preheat to 350 degrees f
21. Place turkey on a rack in large roasting pan
22. Place bird in oven and roast for 2 hours , then baste with 1 / 2 cup broth
23. Continue to roast until turkey is brown and thermometer inserted into the thickest part of the thigh registers 165 degrees f
24. Basting frequently with the remaining 1 1 / 2 cups broth and pan juices
25. Cover loosely with foil if browning too quickly
26. Transfer turkey to a large platter or carving board
27. Tent loosely with foil
28. Let stand at least 30 minutes or up to 45 minutes prior to carving

title: pumpkin spice cake with orange buttercream frosting
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Place cake mix , pudding mix , pumpkin , oil , water , eggs and spice in large bowl
3. Beat with electric mixer on low speed just until moistened
4. Beat on medium speed 2 minutes
5. Pour into greased and floured 13x9-inch baking pan
6. Bake 32 to 35 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
7. Cool cake in pan on wire rack for at least 20 minutes
8. To make frosting , place the butter in a large mixing bowl
9. Blend with an electric mixer on low speed about 30 seconds
10. Add the confectioner's sugar and 3 tablespoons of the orange juice
11. Blend with the mixer on low speed approximately 1 minute
12. Increase the speed to medium and mix approximately 1 more minute , until the frosting is light and fluffy
13. If needed , blend in 1 more tablespoon of orange juice to obtain proper consistency
14. Frost the top of the cake
15. If desired , sprinkle with chopped nuts
16. Store leftovers in the refrigerator

title: easy red lentil soup
steps:
1. Pick over lentils and remove any stones
2. Rinse well
3. Heat butter in saut pan and saut onion for 2-3 minutes
4. Add diced celery and carrots and let sweat for 10 minutes
5. Stir in lentils , add lemon rind , vegetable broth and salt and pepper to taste
6. Bring to a boil , reduce heat and simmer for 15-20 minutes until vegetables are tender
7. Roughly blend the soup with stick blender or mash with potato masher , it should not be too smooth
8. Check the seasoning and reheat gently

title: smoked pork  white bean and vegetable soup
steps:
1. Heat olive oil in a heavy soup pot and add bacon until it's crisp , not burned
2. Remove bacon with slotted spoon and set aside
3. Add onion , carrot and celery to pot and cook over medium heat to soften , not brown about 5 minutes or more
4. Add garlic , rosemary , thyme , ground pepper and stir for about a minute until garlic is fragrant
5. Add potato , cabbage , beans and pork , stir and cook for a minute or two and then add water -i add a lot but if you want it to be more stewy than soupy , don't add as much
6. Turn heat to high and bring to boil , turn down to low and simmer for 15 minutes or until your vegetables are cooked
7. Take off heat and add salt 1 / 4 teaspoon at a time , stirring after adding and tasting until it's seasoned

title: green chile mashed potatoes
steps:
1. Boil potatoes until tender but don't overcook !
2. Drain well
3. Mash the rest of the ingredients into the potatoes right in the pot with a potato masher
4. You can use an electric mixer but be careful not to over beat

title: carrot  potato and jerusalem artichoke soup
steps:
1. Melt the butter with a dash of olive oil in a large pot and soften the onion for a few minutes , before adding the garlic
2. After a few minutes add spices and herbs , the carrots , potatoes and artichokes , and let them sweat for 10 minutes on a low heat with the lid on
3. Pour in the stock , stir well , put the lid back on and simmer for a further 20 minutes or until the vegetables are soft
4. You can the blend all or half of the soup
5. I personally prefer to leave some veggie chunks in mine !
6. Taste to check the seasoning , re-heat and serve

title: south american cheese sauce
steps:
1. In a heavy skillet heat oil then add garlic , onion and fresh pepper over medium heat
2. Saute onion until translucent and soft
3. Stir in tomatoes
4. Reduce heat to low and simmer for approximately 15 minutes or until mixture has slightly thickened
5. Stir in cream and velveeta
6. Cook over medium heat until velveeta has melted , stirring until smooth
7. Stir in cilantro then season with salt and pepper , to taste
8. If too thick , thin with a few tablespoons chicken broth
9. Serve immediately
10. See serving suggestions in recipe description

title: chocolate covered caramel peanut bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Spray the bottom and sides of a 9x13 pan
3. Combine cake mix , egg , water and melted butter or margarine
4. Press evenly into the bottom of the greased pan
5. Bake for 12-14 minutes or until golden
6. Cool
7. Whip together the marshmallow cream and peanut butter
8. Stir in chopped peanuts
9. Spread over cooled cake
10. Caramel:
11. In a saucepan , melt butter
12. Add brown sugar , water and corn syrup and bring to a boil
13. Cook for several minutes until the mixture is no longer grainy
14. Remove from heat and stir in vanilla and condensed milk
15. Cool slightly
16. Pour caramel over marshmallow mixture and spread evenly
17. Melt chocolate in the microwave or double broiler , stirring frequently until melted
18. Pour melted chocolate over caramel and spread evenly
19. Allow to set 4 hours , or overnight

title: vegan worcestershire sauce
steps:
1. In a small saucepan , combine all of the ingredients over medium high heat , whisking briskly
2. Bring to a boil , reduce heat , and simmer for 1 minute , stirring constantly
3. Set aside to cool
4. Store in the refrigerator in a clean container with a tight fitting lid
5. Makes about 3 / 4 cup
6. Enjoy !

title: moroccan stuffed eggplant  aubergine
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 200c
2. Using a small knife and a spoon , carefully remove the flesh from the eggplant halves without breaking the skin , and chop the flesh coarsely
3. Place the eggplant halves onto a baking tray , cut side up , drizzle with 1 tablespoon of oil and bake for 10-15 minutes , until tender
4. Meanwhile , heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a large pan , over a medium heat , and saut the eggplant flesh for 3-5 minutes , until it is golden and tender
5. Remove from the pan and set aside
6. In the same pan , heat the remaining oil over a high heat and saut the onion and garlic for 1 minute , then add the ground meat and cook for 4-5 minutes , until it is well browned , breaking up the lumps as it browns with the back of a spoon
7. Return the eggplant to the pan , add the moroccan seasoning and cook , stirring , for 1 minute , until fragrant
8. Stir in the tomato , pine nuts and sugar and season to taste
9. Fill the eggplant halves with the meat mixture and sprinkle with breadcrumbs and parmesan
10. Bake for 25-30 minutes , until golden and tender
11. Serve with the tomato and cucumber salad and fresh crusty bread
12. Tomato and cucumber salad: chop the cucumber and toss the cucumber pieces and halved cherry tomatoes with the olive oil and red wine vinegar and season to taste

title: special marshmallow cream pumpkin dessert
steps:
1. In a bowl , combine gingersnaps , butter and sugar
2. Mix well
3. Press into a 9" x 13" baking dish
4. Refrigerate while preparing filling
5. For filling: combine marshmallows and cream in a double boiler over hot water , and stir until melted and combined
6. Combine pumpkin puree , sugar , spices and salt
7. Blend in marshmallow mixture
8. Chill in the refrigerator for 30 minutes
9. Remove from fridge , fold in 1 cup of the whipped topping or whipped cream
10. Pour into prepared crust
11. Chill in refrigerator until set
12. Spread top with 1 cup of the remaining whipped topping
13. Sprinkle with chopped nuts
14. Chill at least 3 hours or overnight
15. Cut into serving-size squares , enjoy !

title: the farmers vegetarian pizza
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees , and position an oven rack in the next to lowest setting
2. Place a 16 inch pizza pan on the rack
3. Heat a nonstick skillet over medium-high heat , and add olive oil to pan and swirl to coat
4. Add 2 cups onion and thyme to pan , cook 3 minutes or until onion is tender , stirring occasionally
5. Add bell pepper , and garlic to pan , cook 1 minute or until thoroughly heated
6. Roll dough into a 16 inch circle on a lightly floured surface
7. Remove pan from oven , and coat with cooking spray
8. Place dough in pan , and arrange mozzerella slices evenly over dough
9. Spread corn mixture evenly over cheese , and top with parmigiano-reggiano cheese
10. Bake at 425 degrees for 23 minutes
11. Arrange tomatoes evenly over pizza , and bake an additional 5 minutes or until crust is browned
12. Remove from oven , and sprinkle with basil
13. Cut into 6 slices

title: spinach with two cheeses
steps:
1. Cook and drain spinach
2. If you're using fresh spinach , be sure to wash thoroughly , chop fine , and drain
3. Melt 6 tablespoons butter and cool
4. Mix well 2 cups ricotta , 2 beaten eggs , salt , pepper , and nutmeg
5. Add spinach and melted butter
6. Place in buttered baking dish
7. Dot with 4 tablespoons butter and sprinkle with 1 / 2 cup parmesan
8. Bake at 425 degrees for 10 minutes

title: watermelon mountain dew punch
steps:
1. Blend everything , except the crushed ice , in a blender
2. Pour it into a jug
3. Top it with crushed ice
4. Serve at once
5. Chill out baby !
6. Pepper or coco cola , etc

title: dijon crusted tilapia
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine the mayonnaise , 1 tablespoon parmesan cheese , lemon juice , mustard and horseradish
2. Place fillets on a baking sheet coated with nonstick cooking spray
3. Spread mayonnaise mixture evenly over the fillets
4. In a small bowl , combine the bread crumbs , butter and remaining parmesan cheese
5. Sprinkle over fillets
6. Bake at 425 degrees for 13-18 minutes or until fish flakes easily with a fork

title: blueberry stuffed french toast
steps:
1. Cut french bread loaf into cubes
2. Grease a 9x13-inch baking dish
3. Place 1 / 2 of the cubes in a baking dish
4. Top with cream cheese cubes and blueberries , and then top with remaining cubes of bread
5. In large mixing bowl with a wire whisk , mix together eggs , milk , melted butter , cinnamon and vanilla until well combined
6. Pour over bread evenly over top
7. Using a spatula , lightly press down to moisten
8. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 2 to 24 hours
9. Preheat oven to 325f and remove the plastic wrap from baking dish
10. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes until center is set and edges are slightly golden
11. Let stand about 10 minutes before serving
12. Serve with maple syrup

title: simple last minute dessert
steps:
1. Spread the coconut on a non-stick baking sheet and bake at 350 degrees until browned
2. Don't let it burn
3. Let coconut cool for at least 5 minutes
4. Meanwhile , place two small scoops of ice cream in each dessert bowl
5. Top each serving with 1 tbsp of amaretto
6. Sprinkle with toasted coconut and serve immediately

title: simple apple cake
steps:
1. Peel , core , and thinly slice the apples
2. Cream butter , vanilla , eggs , and sugar
3. Add cinnamon and baking powder
4. Beat in flour
5. Stir in apples to combine
6. Spoon batter into a greased 9x13 pan
7. Smooth top with knife or rubber scraper
8. Bake at 350 degrees for 50-60 minutes until golden brown on top
9. Let cool for 10 minutes
10. Sprinkle with powdered sugar if desired

title: creamy bratwurst and potato soup
steps:
1. Melt butter in dutch oven
2. On medium low heat , sweat onion , garlic , and potatoes
3. Season with white pepper and salt
4. Potatoes will begin to form a slurry from their starch
5. This is normal
6. Continue to sweat until potatoes begin to soften , adding liquid if necessary
7. When potatoes have softened , add milk , cream and nutmeg and bring to slow simmer
8. From this point on , do not allow to boil
9. Only allow a slow simmer
10. After returning to simmer , slowly add grated cheese and melt into mixture
11. Add bratwurst , return to simmer , and simmer 30 minutes
12. Salt and pepper to taste
13. If soup is too thin , or if soup has accidentally come to a boil and broken make a slurry made of 3 parts milk or water to 1 part flour and add a little at a time to the simmering soup allowing it to thicken before adding more
14. Stir in parsley
15. Serve with your favorite salad and / or fresh garlic toast

title: apple sauced pork chops
steps:
1. Brown chops
2. Drain off fat and place in casserole
3. Mix minced garic clove , meat tenderizer , flour and salt and pepper
4. Pour boiling water in pan and add flour mixture
5. Mix well and add applesauce and lemon juice
6. Pour over chops
7. Cover and bake one hour at 375 degrees

title: pumpkin smoothie
steps:
1. Place pumpkin , evaporated milk , orange juice , banana and sugar in blender
2. Cover
3. Blend until smooth
4. Pour over ice
5. Sprinkle with cinnamon , if desired

title: tabbouleh with sorrel   mint
steps:
1. Place bulgur in medium bowl
2. Stir in boiling water , cover and let stand 35-45 minutes
3. Squeeze out & discard remaining liquid
4. Transfer bulgur large bowl and toss with sorrel , mint , tomatoes , radish slices , cucumbers , scallions , lemon juice and olive oil
5. Season to taste with salt and pepper
6. Top with crumbled feta

title: mocha espresso flavored creamer
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in a food processor or blender and whirl until mixed , or place in a jar and shake well
2. Store in an airtight container
3. To serve: add 1 to 2 teaspoons mix to coffee and stir

title: martha s perfect roast turkey
steps:
1. Rinse turkey with cool water , and dry with paper towels
2. Let stand for hours at room temperature
3. Place rack on lowest level in oven
4. Heat oven to 450 degrees
5. Combine melted butter and white wine in a bowl
6. Fold a large piece of cheesecloth into quarters and cut it into a 17-inch , four-layer square
7. Immerse cheesecloth in the butter and wine
8. Let soak
9. Place turkey , breast side up , on a roasting rack in a heavy metal roasting pan
10. If the turkey comes with a pop-up timer , remove it
11. An instant-read thermometer is a much more accurate indication of doneness
12. Fold wing
13. Sprinkle 1 / 2 teaspoon each salt and pepper inside turkey
14. Fill large cavity and neck cavity loosely with as much stuffing as they hold comfortably
15. Do not pack tightly
16. Tie legs together loosely with kitchen string
17. Fold neck flap under , and secure with toothpicks
18. Rub turkey with the softened butter , and sprinkle with remaining 1 1 / 2 teaspoons salt and pepper
19. Lift cheesecloth out of liquid , and squeeze it slightly , leaving it very damp
20. Spread it evenly over the breast and about halfway down the sides of the turkey
21. It can cover some of the leg area
22. Place turkey , legs first , in oven
23. Cook for 30 minutes
24. Using a pastry brush , baste cheesecloth and exposed parts of turkey with butter and wine
25. Reduce oven temperature to 350 degrees
26. And continue to cook for 2 1 / 2 more hours , basting every 30 minutes and watching pan juices
27. If the pan gets too full , spoon out juices , reserving them for gravy
28. After this third hour of cooking , carefully remove and discard cheesecloth
29. Turn roasting pan so that the breast is facing the back of the oven
30. Baste turkey with pan juices
31. If there are not enough juices , continue to use butter and wine
32. The skin gets fragile as it browns , so baste carefully
33. Cook 1 more hour , basting after 30 minutes
34. After this fourth hour of cooking , insert an instant-read thermometer into the thickest part of the thigh
35. Do not poke into a bone
36. The temperature should reach 180 degrees
37. (stuffing should be between 140 degrees
38. And 160 degrees
39. And the turkey should be golden brown
40. The breast does not need to be checked for temperature
41. If legs are not yet fully cooked , baste turkey , return to oven , and cook another 20 to 30 minutes
42. When fully cooked , transfer turkey to a serving platter , and let rest for about 30 minutes
43. Meanwhile , make the gravy
44. Pour all the pan juices into a glass measuring cup
45. Let stand until grease rises to the surface , about 10 minutes , then skim it off
46. Meanwhile , place roasting pan over medium-high heat
47. Add 1 cup dry red or white wine , or water , to the pan
48. Using a wooden spoon , scrape the pan until liquid boils and all the crisp bits are unstuck from pan
49. Add giblet stock to pan
50. Stir well , and bring back to a boil
51. Cook until liquid has reduced by half , about 10 minutes
52. Add the defatted pan juices , and cook over medium-high heat 10 minutes more
53. You will have about 2 1 / 2 cups of gravy
54. Season to taste , strain into a warm gravy boat , and serve with turkey

title: leasa s delicious crab cakes
steps:
1. Mix everything but lump crabmeat together good
2. Then gently fold in lump crab meat
3. Form into balls and flatten
4. Heat oil and butter
5. Cook cakes until golden brown
6. Serve

title: kittencal s greek spinach and feta puff pastry triangles
steps:
1. Thaw the puff pastry at room temperature for 40 minutes
2. Set oven to 400 degrees f
3. Lightly grease a baking sheet
4. In a small cup or bowl whisk together 1 egg with water
5. Set aside
6. In another bowl mix together 2 eggs , feta cheese , spinach , onion , parsley and black pepper
7. Unfold the pastry sheets on a lightly floured surface
8. Roll each sheet into a 12-inch square
9. Cut each into 16 squares
10. Place about 1 tablespoon spinach / cheese mixture in the middle of each square
11. Brush the edges with egg mixture
12. Fold squares over the filling to form triangles
13. Crimp edges to seal
14. Place on a baking sheet , and brush tops with remaining egg mixture
15. Bake for about 20 minutes or until golden
16. Best served warm or at room temperature

title: watermelon sherbet
steps:
1. Cut the watermelon into wedges , then cut it away from the rind , cubing the flesh and picking out all the seeds
2. Puree three quarters of the flesh in a food processor , but mash the last quarter on a plate , this will give the sherbet more texture
3. Stir the sugar with the lemon juice and 1 / 2 cup of cold water in a saucepan over very low heat until the sugar dissolves and syrup clears
4. Mix all the watermelon and the syrup in a large bowl and transfer to a freezer container
5. Free for 1-1 1 / 2 hours , until the edges begin to set
6. Beat the mixture , return to the freezer for another hour
7. When the hour is up , whisk the egg whites to soft peaks
8. Beat the ice mixture again and fold in egg whites
9. Return to the freezer for another , then beat once more and freeze firm
10. Transfer the sherbet from the freezer to the fridge for 20-30 minutes before it is to be served

title: creamy lemony green beans
steps:
1. Steam the green beans to their desired consistency
2. Drain them and rinse with cold water to shock them into a vibrant hue
3. Pat the greenbeans dry then put them in a mixing bowl
4. In a small bowl , make the sauce by blending the lemon curd , lemon juice olive oil , mustard , and garlic
5. Microwave for about 30-40 seconds , just enough to heat it but make sure your microwave doesn't totally kill it
6. Pour the sauce over the greenbeans , and toss well to coat
7. Top with walnuts for crunch and pizazz

title: brown sugar boiled frosting
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in top of double boiler over hot water
2. Beat with a rotary beater or hand-held electric mixer until mixture holds its shape
3. Spread while still warm over cooled cake

title: lasagna with turkey sausage and spinach
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees
2. Brown the sausage on the stovetop
3. Drain off the fat
4. Mix the eggs , the ricotta , and the parmesean cheese together until very blended
5. Coat an 8x12 inch pan with spray
6. Layer 4 noodles on the bottom of the pan
7. Add 1 / 2 the cheese mix , 1 / 2 the spinach , 1 / 2 the sausage , 1 / 2 the shredded mozzarella , and 1 / 2 the pasta sauce in that order
8. Add the next 4 noodles and repeat the layering process
9. Cover with foil and bake for 45 minutes or until cooked through and bubbly

title: honey and fig cake
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 300f
2. Grease and flour 2 loaf pans
3. In a large bowl , mix eggs , sugar , honey and apple sauce
4. Sieve flour , baking powder , baking soda and spices
5. Stir in flour mix to egg mix
6. Fold in figs and nuts
7. Pour batter into the prepared pans
8. Bake for 1 hour or until a skewer inserted comes out clean
9. Let cool completely before slicing

title: running creek barbecue sauce
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients and simmer all day or until onions and peppers are tender stirring frequently
2. The longer the better

title: southwest georgia pound cake
steps:
1. Generously grease and flour a 10-inch bundt pan: do not preheat oven
2. Using an electric mixer , cream the butter and sugar together until fluffy
3. Add the eggs one at a time , beating well after each addition
4. Sift together the flour , baking powder , and salt
5. Alternately add flour mixture and heavy cream to the butter-sugar mixture , beginning and ending with flour
6. Stir in flavoring
7. Pour batter into prepared pan
8. Put into cold oven and set the temperature to 325f bake for 1 hour and 15 minutes without opening the door
9. Bake an additional 15 minutes if necessary
10. Remove from the oven and cool in pan for 15 minutes , invert cake onto cake plate

title: whipped cream pie
steps:
1. Combine cream cheese , sugar , and lemon juice
2. Beat until smooth and creamy
3. Fold cheese mixture into whipped cream
4. Pour into pie crust
5. Refrigerate until firm
6. Garnish with fruit-- peaches , strawberries , blueberries , raspberries , would all be good with this
7. As would some shaved chocolate !

title: chipped beef with english muffins
steps:
1. Split english muffins and butter them lightly
2. Toast in the oven under the broiler
3. Combine all remaining ingredients in a bowl
4. Spread mixture over toasted muffins
5. Place muffins back into the oven until the cheese bubbles

title: clams in butter garlic herb
steps:
1. Puree the garlic
2. Melt the butter in a large skillet
3. Wash the clams
4. Place the clams into the skillet until they open cover with lid on medium flame
5. Add the rest of the ingredients reducing flame cover for 5 mins
6. Eat alone or with linguini

title: buttery apricot cookies
steps:
1. Place butter , powdered sugar and vanilla in a large bowl
2. Mix together with mixer on medium speed thoroughly -- add beaten egg
3. Sift flour and salt over creamed mixture and blend in gradually
4. Working dough by hand
5. Add chopped apricots and mix well
6. Shape dough into roll about 1 1 / 2" in diameter
7. Wrap in plastic wrap and chill overnight
8. Preheat oven to 400
9. Lightly grease baking sheet
10. Cut roll into 1 / 8"slices --
11. Arrange on cookie sheet --
12. Bake 7-8 minutes or edges are starting to brown --
13. Let cool on racks

title: egg salad for sandwiches and more
steps:
1. Follow recipe #259573 for the perfect hard boiled eggs
2. In a medium size bowl , add the peeled eggs & and chop then to the desired size
3. Dust the chopped eggs with salt
4. In a small bowl , combine the remaining ingredients
5. Gently spread and fold the mayo mixture into the eggs
6. I would suggest covering and placing int he fridge and checking for additional seasonings once it has had a chance to all come together
7. Serving suggestions:
8. Sliced rye or sourdough bread or your favorite bread with sliced tomatoes and sliced pickles
9. Serve on top a halved tomato or tomato slices for a perfect lunch

title: braised garlic chicken and spinach
steps:
1. In large nonstick frypan , place oil and heat to medium temperature
2. Add chicken and cook , turning , about 10 minutes , or until brown on all sides
3. Add carrots and garlic
4. Cover and reduce heat to low temperature
5. Cook , turning chicken once , about 20 minutes , or until carrots are tender and fork can be inserted in chicken with ease
6. Remove chicken and carrots from frypan
7. Set aside and keep warm
8. Cook garlic an additional 3 minutes
9. Add salt , pepper and broth
10. Bring to a boil
11. Cook , uncovered , about 3 minutes or until liquid is reduced to 1 / 4 cup
12. In blender container , place broth mixture and blend about 30 seconds or until smooth
13. Set aside
14. In large saucepan , place spinach
15. Cover and cook over medium heat 3 minutes
16. Drain well
17. Place spinach on serving platter and arrange chicken and carrots on top
18. Drizzle with garlic mixture

title: 2 minute pizza  or pastry crust
steps:
1. Put the ingredients in the specified order into a large bowl or other container with lid that can be sealed
2. Close the lid then shake hard from side to side 5 or 6 times , then up and down 5 or 6 6 times
3. That's it
4. It's ready !
5. Use your fingers to pat the pastry into a pie plate or pizza pan
6. Add the rest of your ingredients and bake

title: best ever three bean chili
steps:
1. Saute onions and garlic in olive oil over medium heat until softened
2. Add cumin and chili powder to pan to toast
3. Add the rest of the ingredients and stir well
4. Simmer on low for at least 30 minutes
5. Serve in bowls and top with shredded cheddar cheese

title: cumin carrots
steps:
1. Steam the carrots in the apple juice in a covered saucepan , on med-low heat until crisp-tender
2. Toss with remaining ingredients

title: asparagus apple salad with blue cheese vinaigrette
steps:
1. Combine first 9 ingredients , stirring with a whisk
2. Cook asparagus in boiling water 1 minute
3. Drain and rinse under cold running water
4. Drain
5. Combine the asparagus , lettuce , and apple in a large bowl
6. Drizzle with vinaigrette
7. Toss gently to coat

title: brown sugar pecan coffee cake
steps:
1. Stir together flour and brown sugar in a large bowl
2. Cut 3 / 4 cup butter into flour mixture with a pastry blender or 2 forks until crumbly
3. Press 2 3 / 4 cups crumb mixture evenly on the bottom of a lightly greased 13- x 9-inch pan
4. Stir together sour cream , egg , and baking soda
5. Add to remaining crumb mixture , stirring just until dry ingredients are moistened
6. Stir together granulated sugar and cinnamon
7. Pour sour cream mixture over crumb crust in pan
8. Sprinkle evenly with cinnamon mixture and pecans
9. Bake at 350 for 25 to 30 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted into center comes out clean

title: vegetarian bollywood lentil burgers and nuggets
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients and 2 / 3 of the cooked lentils in a food processor and puree
2. Reserve 1 / 3 of the lentils whole
3. Remove puree and add whole lentils
4. Add flour , adjust consistency with more flour if too wet
5. Chill batter at least 20 30 minutes until firm
6. Can sit for a day no problem
7. Cook on a hot well oiled teflon or cast iron pan or griddle buy dropping like biscuit batter and then forming into burger patties with a spatula
8. Make them as big or small as you like
9. When its time to turn them over , turn and press sides back into burger
10. Cook until done
11. Cool
12. Eat or freeze
13. To serve:
14. Microwave or let stand until defrosted if you froze them
15. Grill or microwave until hot through
16. Top with cheese if desired
17. Finish like a meat burger and garnish with veggies , lettuce , tomato and onion
18. Serve with coleslaw , french fries and pickles

title: alton brown s bananas foster
steps:
1. Melt butter in a 10-inch heavy skillet over low heat
2. Add brown sugar , allspice and nutmeg and stir until sugar dissolves
3. Add banana liqueur and bring sauce to simmer
4. Add bananas and cook for 1 minute on each side , carefully spooning sauce over bananas as they are cooking
5. Remove bananas from pan to a serving dish
6. Bring sauce to a simmer and carefully add the rum
7. If the sauce is very hot , the alcohol will flame on its own
8. If not , using stick flame , carefully ignite and continue cooking until flame dies out , approximately 1 to 2 minutes
9. If sauce is too thin , cook for 1 to 2 minutes until it is syrupy in consistency
10. Immediately spoon the sauce over bananas and serve
11. Serve with waffles , crepes , or ice cream

title: groovy banana blitz smoothie
steps:
1. Place all ingredients , except food colors , in blender , cover and blend on high speed until smooth
2. Divide between 4 glasses and stir 6 drops of a different food color into each portion
3. Layer the different colors alternately into each of 3 tall , clear glasses to serve
4. Repeat after me -- groovy man !

title: white russian bundt cake
steps:
1. Spray a 12 cup bundt pan
2. Combine all cake ingredients and beat until well mixed
3. Pour batter into prepared pan
4. Bake at 350 for 50-60 minutes or until done via toothpick test
5. Cool 15 minutes , remove from pan and cool completely
6. Combine glaze ingredients and beat on low speed until powdered sugar is moistened
7. Increase speed to medium and beat until creamy
8. Drizzle glaze over cooled cake

title: fabulous oregano bread  or pizza dough
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in order in your bread machine using the regular bread cycle
2. If you want pizza dough , use the"dough" setting and roll out flat on a floured surface
3. Preheat your oven to 400
4. Spray your cooking pan with pam
5. You can also sprinkle a little cornmeal on the pan if you wish
6. Lay dough out on your pan and cover with cling film or apply a little extra olive oil over the surface of the dough
7. Let rise for 1 / 2 hour
8. Bake for 15-20 minutes
9. Remove from oven , apply toppings and continue baking until toppings are done
10. If you wish to make a freeform loaf: preheat oven to 350f
11. Form loaf on a prepared baking sheet , cover with cling and let rise until doubled
12. Bake until golden brown and sounds hollow when thumped
13. Remove to a cooling rack and lightly coat with butter while still hot for a tender crust

title: art smith s goat cheese drop biscuits
steps:
1. Preheat your oven to 425f place one 10-inch cast iron pan into the oven while it is preheating
2. Place flour , salt , baking soda and baking powder into a medium-sized bowl
3. Cut in the butter and goat cheese
4. Make a well in the middle of the ingredients and pour in the milk
5. Stir until the mix is moistened , adding an extra tablespoon of milk if needed
6. Remove the hot skillet from the oven and place a tablespoon of butter into it
7. When the butter has melted , drop 1 / 4 cupfuls of batter into the pan ,
8. Brush the tops of the biscuits with melted butter
9. Bake from 1416 minutes until browned on the top and bottom
10. Remove from the oven and sprinkle with the grated cheese
11. Enjoy warm !

title: deli roll
steps:
1. Defrost philo dough until workable but still somewhat stiff
2. Unroll philo dough and spread light mayo evenly over a 4-inch long area of the roll
3. Place 6 slices of deli in a row and roll up the dough
4. Cut slots in the top to vent
5. Repeat for second roll
6. Bake until dough is golden brown

title: chicken caribbean for two
steps:
1. Combine lime juice and black pepper in glass or ceramic dish , add chicken
2. Marinate in the refrigerator for 30 minutes , turning after 15 minutes
3. Discard the marinade
4. Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat
5. Add chicken to the skillet and brown until lightly golden
6. Stir in onions , tomatoes , raisins , pepper and garlic
7. Combine the pineapple juice and chicken broth
8. Pour into skillet
9. Cover and cook over medium heat for 45 minutes , turning chicken several times
10. Remove chicken from skillet and keep warm
11. Add pineapple to skillet
12. Raise heat and boil to reduce the sauce
13. When the sauce has thickened slightly and pineapple is heated , spoon over chicken and serve
14. Serving suggestion -- serve with or over rice

title: america s test kitchen thin crust pizza
steps:
1. In food processor fitted with metal blade , process flour , sugar and yeast until combined , about 2 seconds
2. With machine running , slowly add water through feed tube
3. Process until dough is just combined and no dry flour remains , about 10 seconds
4. Let dough stand for 10 minutes
5. Add oil and salt to dough and process until dough forms a satiny , sticky ball that clears sides of workbowl , 30-60 seconds
6. Remove dough and knead briefly on lightly oiled countertop until smooth , about 1 minutes
7. Shape dough into tight ball and place in large lightly oiled bowl
8. Cover tightly with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 24 hours and up to 3 days
9. Process tomatoes , oil , vinegar , garlic , salt , oregano and pepper in food processor until smooth , about 30 seconds
10. Transfer to medium bowl and refrigerate until ready to use
11. One hour before baking pizza , adjust rack in oven to second highest position , about 4-5 inches below broiler
12. Set pizza stone on rack and heat oven to 500 degrees
13. Remove dough from refrigerator and divide in half
14. Shape each half into smooth , tight ball
15. Place on lightly oiled baking sheet , spacing them at least 3" apart
16. Cover loosely with plastic wrap coated with non-stick spray
17. Let stand for 1 hour
18. Coat 1 ball of dough generously with flour and place on well floured countertop
19. Using fingers gently flatten into 8" disk , leaving 1" of outer edge slightly thicker than center
20. Using hands , gently stretch dough disk into 12" round , working along edges and giving disk quarter turns as you stretch
21. Transfer dough to a well floured peel and stretch into 13" round
22. Using back of spoon or ladle , spread 1 / 2 c tomato sauce in a thin layer over the surface of dough , leaving 1 / 4" border around edge
23. Sprinkle 1 / 4 c parmesan evenly over sauce , followed by 1 c mozzarella
24. Slide pizza carefully onto stone and bake until crust is well browned and cheese is bubbly and beginning to brown , 10-12 minutes , rotating pizza halfway through
25. Remove pizza and place on wire rack for 5 minutes before slicing and serving
26. Repeat this with second ball of dough

title: linguini with sun dried tomato and arugula  rocket
steps:
1. Put the oil over a medium heat , and add the porcini mushrooms , the clove of garlic and cook until lightly browned
2. Add mixed herbs , then add the rocket and wilt slightly
3. Cook the pasta until al dente , add the tomatoes and the mushrooms , toss
4. Season with salt and pepper
5. Pile on 4 serving plates and garnish with shavings of parmesan

title: black eyes of texas casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Saute ground beef and onions and until ground beef is lightly brown and onions are translucent
3. Stir in remaining ingredients except tortillas and cheese
4. Spread 1 / 3 of meat mixture in 9x13 baking dish
5. Alternate layers between tortillas and meat mixture beginning and ending with meat mixture
6. Sprinkle top with cheese and bake for 35 minutes or until bubbly

title: chez s apricot and mango chicken
steps:
1. Cut the chicken into large chunks-about 6 per fillet
2. Brown the chicken in the oil , then remove
3. Add the onion to the oil and cook until softened , about 5 minutes
4. Mix the remaining ingredients together , and pour over the onions
5. Return the chicken to the sauce , and cook in a moderate oven for about 45 minutes
6. Ilike to bake this uncovered and stir it once or twice
7. I find that it gets a nice browned finish

title: common crackers
steps:
1. Sift together flour , salt and sugar
2. Cut in butter until mixture has the consistency of corm meal
3. Stir in enough milk to make a stiff dough
4. Roll to 1 / 4 inch thick on a lightly floured board
5. Cut into 3-4 inch rounds
6. Prick surface with a fork
7. Brush surface with milk
8. Place on an ungreased baking sheet and bake in a 425f oven for 15 to 18 minutes or until light golden brown
9. Store in an airtight container
10. Split crackers and serve with chowder

title: crepes with blueberry stuffing and rhubarb compote
steps:
1. Crepes: whisk the eggs and milk together in a bowl
2. Whisk in the salt , sugar , and flour
3. Set aside for 30 minutes
4. Melt about 1 / 2-teaspoon butter in a nonstick 8 to 10-inch skillet over medium heat
5. When it foams , pour or ladle in about 2 tablespoons of batter
6. Lift and swirl the pan so the batter coats the bottom
7. Set pan on the burner and cook just until set and the underside is lightly browned
8. Using a spatula or your fingers , flip and cook until the other side is lightly browned
9. Transfer to a plate and continue with remaining batter
10. Blueberry stuffing: in a bowl , gently fold together the blueberries , maple sugar and sour cream
11. Rhubarb compote: place the rhubarb , orange juice concentrate , sugar , and cornstarch in a saucepan and cook until the fruit falls apart and the mixture thickens
12. To serve: place the crepes on a platter and smear with marmalade
13. Place a spoonful of the blueberry filling down the center and roll up the crepe
14. Repeat with remaining crepes
15. Top off with some rhubarb compote and mint

title: grilled sandwiches  cuban style
steps:
1. Preheat the griddle
2. Add mustard to one side and mayonnaise to to the other cut side of the rolls
3. Build each sandwich with the roasted turkey , pork , cheese , and pickles
4. Spread outside of roll with butter
5. Place the sandwich on the hot griddle , cover with a cookie sheet , and place heavy iron skillet or sandwich press to flatten
6. Grill the sandwich for a few minutes on each side
7. Slice in half diagonally and serve

title: wild ranch chicken wraps
steps:
1. Place chicken in the oven to cook while the rice is cooking
2. Prepare rice to the box instructions
3. When everything is finished , cube chicken and add to the rice
4. Stir in dressing
5. Line a warm tortilla with rice mixture
6. Top with lettuce
7. Roll & enjoy !

title: reese s peanut butter cup cake   use up that halloween candy
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Spray the pan that you plan to use with nonstick spray
3. Mix cake ingredients as per directions on the box plus the 1 / 4 cup of the extra water
4. Add in the peanut butter cup chunks
5. Bake at 350 degrees for 45-50 minutes
6. Cool
7. Blend icing ingredients together and spread on cake
8. Sprinkle reese's pieces on top

title: quick and easy raita
steps:
1. Dice the cucumbers , onion and tomato and toss them all together in a large bowl
2. Mix in the yogurt , starting with half a cup , and add more if necessary
3. Salt it to your liking and let it sit in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes to get the best flavour out of your raita

title: banana fudge pie
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350
2. Prepare pie crust for filling
3. In sauce pan , melt 1 / 2 cup of chocolate chips over medium heat
4. Remove from heat and add 1 cup cool whip , eggs & sugar
5. Mix well and pour into pie crust
6. Bake for 30 min
7. Cool for 10 min
8. Chill for 1 hour
9. Layer bananas over chocolate
10. Smooth remaining cool whip on top
11. Sprinkle with remaining chocolate chips
12. Enjoy !

title: marinade for meat  poultry or fish
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients and whisk well
2. Add item to be marinated and turn to cover each side
3. Refrigerate , covered , for several hours , turning item to be marinated several times
4. Broil or grill marinated item to your taste !

title: dromtarta   swedish chocolate dream cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Cake:
3. Sift together the flour , cocoa , baking powder , salt and baking soda
4. Combine eggs , water and vanilla and beat until thick and lemon-colored
5. Add granulated sugar gradually and beat thoroughly after each addition
6. Slowly sift flour mixture into egg mixture and fold in carefully , but thoroughly
7. Grease a 15x10 in jelly-roll pan and line w / waxed paper
8. Spread batter evenly in pan and bake 30 minutes or till cake tests done
9. Touch cake lightly w / finger
10. If the dough springs back quickly , the cake is done
11. Sprinkle a kitchen towel heavily with confectioner's sugar
12. Turn cake onto kitchen towel and peel off waxed paper
13. Trim off any crisp edges
14. Roll warm cake lengthwise in towel into a roll
15. Cool on rack , seam side down
16. Filling - cream butter with egg yolk and cocoa
17. Beat in sugar gradually , alternating w / rum
18. Keep at room temp for spreading
19. Cake assembly - unroll cake and spread with filling
20. Reroll and refrigerate till serving time

title: maddy s meringue cookies
steps:
1. Beat egg whites , salt , cream of tartar and vanilla until soft peaks form
2. Add sugar gradually , beating well until sugar is dissolved and meringue peaks are stiff
3. Fold in chocolate chips
4. Line cookie sheets with cooking parchment
5. Drop mix by spoonful on to parchment , leaving a space of 1 inch between cookies
6. Place in preheated 400f oven
7. Immediately reduce oven temperature to 275f
8. Bake for 10 minutes , then turn oven off
9. Leave cookies in oven without opening door for several hours or until oven is cool

title: banana coconut cookie bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 and grease 13 by 9" pan mix cookie crumbs , butter and sugar until thoroughly blended& reserve 1 / 3 of mixture
2. Press the remaining mixture into bottom of baking dish
3. Bake for 8- 10 minutes until lightly browned
4. Remove pan from oven and sprinkle cookie base with chocolate chips and return pan to oven until chocolate chips are shiny , spread evenly and set aside
5. In medium saucepan combine condensed milk , banana , coconut and butter
6. Cook over low heat , stirring constantly until thickened
7. Remove from heat and stir in vanilla extract and salt
8. Spread over cookie crumb base in pan
9. Sprinkle reserved cookie crumb mixture over filling
10. Return to oven for 8-10 minutes until topping is slightly browned
11. Cool thoroughly and cut into bars

title: croatian buzara shrimps
steps:
1. Take a large pot and put olive oil and heat it , but not too much
2. Add garlic and fry just 30 seconds and than add all shrimps
3. Using wooden ladle mix the shrimps to cover them with oil
4. Add wine and cook for 5 minutes until alcohol evaporates
5. Add tomato , salt , raisins , pepper , bread crumbs
6. Mix gently with the ladle , or shake the whole pot to mix all ingredients
7. Cover and cook for 10-20 minutes
8. At the and add parsley leaves and serve

title: mixed berry winter jam
steps:
1. I used raspberries , blackberries , strawberries and blueberries
2. You can change the amount and type of berries you use as long as you keep the 1 to 1 ratio of fruit to sugar
3. Place thawed berries in the food processor
4. Using the stirring attachment instead of the blade , pulse to crush most of the fruit
5. Measure fruit and juice into an enamel or stainless steel pot and bring to a boil , stirring well
6. Add sugar and continue stirring to dissolve
7. Cook at a gentle boil
8. As mixture thickens you can crush the fruit if desired
9. Test for doneness by putting a bit on an icy cold saucer
10. Put the saucer back in the freezer for a minute
11. When you push at the side of the bit of jam and it wrinkles then it's ready
12. Remove from heat
13. Skim
14. Stir for a couple of minutes
15. Ladle into clean , hot , 1 / 2 pint jars
16. Leave 1 / 4 inch headroom cap with canning lids and process in hjot water bath for 5 minutes boiling time

title: easy bacalao   puerto rican fish stew
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large high-sided skillet or dutch oven over medium heat
2. Add onion and cook , stirring occasionally , until softened , about 2 minutes
3. Add garlic and cook , stirring , for 1 minute
4. Add fish , tomatoes and their juices , chile pepper , cilantro , olives , capers , oregano and salt
5. Stir to combine
6. Add up to 1 / 2 cup water if the mixture seems dry
7. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes
8. Remove from the heat
9. Serve warm or at room temperature , garnished with avocado if desired

title: lemon meringue pie milkshake
steps:
1. In blender , combine milk , lemon zest , lemon juice , and lemon curd
2. Blend 5 seconds
3. Add vanilla ice cream and blend until smooth , about 10 seconds
4. Pour into serving glasses
5. Top with whipped cream and additional lemon zest
6. Serve immediately

title: fish plaki
steps:
1. Rinse fish
2. Brush baking pan with olive oil
3. Place fish in pan
4. Saute onions , garlic , herbs , salt , and pepper
5. Add stewed tomatoes , crushed
6. Cook 20 minutes
7. Pour over fish
8. Pour a little olive oil over all
9. Add slices of lemon
10. Bake 325 degrees for 25 to 30 minutes until fish flakes with fork

title: nigerian groundnut stew
steps:
1. In a large saucepan or dutch oven brown chicken pieces in hot oil abut 15 minutes
2. Remove from pan
3. Set aside , reserving drippings
4. Add beef , onion , and green pepper to drippings
5. Cook till beef is brown and onion is tender
6. Drain off fat
7. Stir in undrianed tomatoes , salt , and red pepper
8. Bring to boiling
9. Reduce heat
10. Cover
11. Simmer 30 minutes
12. Add chicken pieces: simmer 20 minutes more
13. In small sauce pan melt peanut butter over low heat
14. Stir into chicken mixture
15. Return mixture to boiling
16. Reduce heat
17. Cover simmer 20 minutes more
18. Skim off fat
19. Serve with mashed sweet potatoes or hot cooked rice

title: dr pepper baked beans
steps:
1. Set oven to 375 degrees
2. Butter a 3-qt baking dish
3. Heat a skillet over med heat with 1 tbsp oil
4. Add sausage , and 3 / 4 cup dr pepper drink
5. Bring to boil
6. Cover
7. And lower the heat
8. Continue cooking about 30 mins , until dr pepper becomes syrupy
9. Drain the pinto beans
10. Place in a large saucepan , add 1 cup dr pepper , ketchup , wine vinegar , worcestershire sauce , tabasco sauce , soy sauce , garlic , onion and salt
11. Bring to simmer , stirring occasionally
12. Season with black pepper
13. Pour into a 3-qt buttered baking dish
14. Stir in sausage mixture
15. Top with cheese and bread crumbs
16. Bake , covered for 40 mins , or until cheese is melted , and mixture is bubbling

title: weight watchers  ww  roasted squash risotto
steps:
1. Place the squash on a tray and spray with the oil
2. Strip the leaves from the rosemary and finely chop
3. Sprinkle over the squash and roast at 200 deg c for 20 minutes
4. Heat a heavy based pan and spray with oil
5. Saute the onion until soft
6. Add the rice and coat with the onion mix
7. Add a ladleful of stock and stir until it is absorbed
8. Repeat this process until all the stock is used
9. Stir the garlic , cheese , vinegar and roasted squash and serve

title: creamy caramel apple dip
steps:
1. Place both the cream cheese and caramel ice cream topping into your mixer and blend on high until smooth and fluffy
2. Serve with sliced apples

title: quick almond cinnamon rolls
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f or temperature
2. Lightly grease a cookie sheet
3. Grate almond paste on large hole side of a box grater
4. Add almond paste , butter , sugar , cinnamon and flour to food processor
5. Mix until well blended
6. Unroll crescent dough
7. Divide each package into 4 rectangles
8. Pinch center seams together securing the rectangle shape
9. With a spatula , spread equal amounts of cinnamon almond filling over each rectangle
10. Starting at the short end of each rectangle , roll dough into a roll and pinch seam closed
11. Cut each roll into 3 equal pieces and slightly flatten with fingers
12. Place each piece , side by side , on baking sheet
13. Bake 12-14 minutes or until golden brown
14. Cool on wire rack
15. While rolls are cooling , whisk powdered sugar with orange juice or milk mixed with almond extract
16. Spread onto cooled rolls and sprinkle with toasted almonds while icing is still wet

title: four grain tomato soup with greens
steps:
1. Spray a soup pot with oil spry and add the onion-- saut over medium heat for 5 to 8 minutes , until translucent
2. Add water as needed to keep from sticking
3. Add the celery , carrots , sweet potato , tomatoes , the four grains and seasoning
4. Stir in 6 cups stock and bring to a simmer
5. Simmer gently , covered , for one hour , stirring every 15 minutes or so
6. If the soup is too dense , adjust with additional water and return to a gentle simmer
7. Season to taste with salt and pepper
8. Simmer gently for another 15 to 20 minutes , or until the grains and vegetables are tender
9. If time allows , let the soup stand off the heat for an hour or two before serving , then heat through as needed
10. Just before serving , stem , wash , and coarsely chop the chard or spinach
11. Steam in a large saucepan with just the water clinging to the leaves , just until the leaves wilt , then stir into the soup
12. This soup thickens quite a bit as it stands
13. Add water as needed and adjust the seasonings

title: dark chocolate creme brulee
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300 degrees f
2. Bring cream and half and half to boil in heavy sauce pan
3. Reduce heat to low
4. Add chocolate and whisk until melted and smooth
5. Remove from heat
6. Whisk yolks and 1 / 3 cup sugar in large bowl to blend
7. Gradually whisk in hot chocolate mixture
8. Strain
9. Divide custard among eight 3 / 4-cup custard cups
10. Place cups in large baking pan
11. Add enough hot water to pan to come halfway up sides of cups
12. Bake until custards are set , about 50 minutes
13. Remove from water
14. Chill 2 hours
15. Cover and refrigerate overnight
16. Preheat broiler
17. Sprinkle each custard with 1 tbs sugar
18. Broil until sugar turns golden , watching carefully to avoid burning , about 3 minutes
19. Refrigerate until custards are set , 1-2 hours

title: swedish meatballs with lingonberry  or cranberry  sauce
steps:
1. To make the sauce , put the lingonberries or cranberries into a heavy bottomed saucepan with about 100 to 120 mls of water , the lemon juice and zest & bring to the boil
2. Then turn the heat down to a gentle simmer and cook for 10 to 15 minutes
3. As soon as the berries have started to burst - add the caster sugar and cook until the sugar has completely dissolved
4. Take off the heat and allow to cool
5. Check for sweetness , if it is too sour , add more sugar to taste and cook until dissolved
6. To make the meatballs , first melt a little of the butter in a frying pan and add the finely chopped onion - saut until soft & then add the allspice
7. Soak the breadcrumbs in the milk - until the milk has been absorbed , about 30 to 45 minutes
8. Mix the fried onion in with the soaked bread and then add the meat and beaten egg , season and mix well
9. Dampen your hands and form the mixture into balls about the size of large walnuts
10. Heat half of the remaining butter with half of the oil and fry the meatballs in batches - until they are golden brown in colour and hold their shape
11. Allow to meatballs to cool slightly
12. Heat up the remaining butter and oil in the pan and add the flour - cooking over a low heat until the flour is golden and sandy in appearance
13. Take the pan off the heat and gradually add the beef stock , stirring and blending well after each addition
14. Put the pan back on the heat and bring to the boil - then add the sour cream
15. Turn the heat down and add the meatballs - cover and cook over a low heat for about 15 to 20 minutes , until the sauce has thickened
16. Check and adjust the seasoning before adding the chopped dill to the meatball and sauce mixture
17. Serve with the lingonberry or cranberry sauce , and mashed potatoes or broad ribbon noodles

title: quick pierogies  potato filled pasta pockets  casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350boil pierogies for about 5-8 minutes
2. Then drain
3. In a small skillet , melt margarine
4. Saute onion and green pepper for about 5 minutes
5. In a 2 quart casserole , combine drained pierogies with onion and green peppers
6. Blend milk and soup and pour over casserole
7. Top with cheese
8. Bake in 350 oven for 35 minutes

title: peanut butter chicken wings
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees f
2. Remove and discard
3. Combine remaining ingredients except parsley and lemon slices in a large saucepan
4. Cook over low heat for about 15 minutes , until reduced and thickened to the consistency of thick gravy
5. Place wings in a large roasting pan and cover with sauce
6. Turn until each wing is well coated
7. Bake for 15-20 minutes
8. Serve on large platter
9. Garnish with parsley and lemon slices

title: carrot  apple   raisin salad
steps:
1. Whisk lemon juice and jelly in large bowl to blend
2. Add carrots , apple , cashews and raisins
3. Season to taste with salt and pepper
4. Toss thoroughly

title: hazelnut ice cream
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f
2. Place hazelnuts in a baking pan and bake for about 10 minutes , until lightly toasted
3. Place nuts on a cloth towel , wrap the nuts up , and rub them together until their papery skins come off
4. Cool nuts
5. In blender or food processor , grind nuts until are finely ground and start to release their oil but still have texture
6. In a double boiler combine half-and-half and the nuts
7. Cook over simmering water for 15 minutes
8. Whisk sugar into the egg yolks
9. Whisk some of the hot half-and-half mixture with the egg yolks return the egg yolk mixture to the pan and cook , stirring constantly , until the custard coats the spoon
10. When done , place the pan in a pan of very cold water and stir until cool
11. Stir the cream and frangelico or extract into the mixture
12. Cover and refrigerate overnight , or til thoroughly chilled
13. Freeze in an ice cream maker following the manufactuer's directions
14. Enjoy !

title: pink dandelion wine
steps:
1. Take the blossoms , remove stem and leaves , and boil in water
2. Remove from heat and let stand overnight , then strain
3. Then add lemon , raspberries , cinnamon and sugar
4. Warm mixture over low flame until the sugar is dissolved
5. Next , when the mixture is lukewarm , add active yeast which as been suspended in warm water
6. Cover the pan with a towel and let it set for three days undisturbed
7. As you check it , visualize the energy in your wine increasing even as the bubbles are forming
8. Finally , strain the mixture again and bottle in loosely corked bottles
9. Once the corks no longer pop out , tasted to see if the wine needs any additional sugar
10. If so , return it to the stove and sweeten to taste , but bring it to a boil so as to kill the yeast
11. Cork tightly and let age for one year in a cool , dark area for best results
12. Enjoy this liquid of the earth and sky or if you wish , you can use this as a offering for spells or spirits of your garden !

title: fried quail with spicy salt
steps:
1. To make the spicy salt and pepper , combine the ingredients and dry fry over a low heat for 2-3 minutes or until aromatic
2. Split each quail in half down the middle and clean well
3. Marinate with the teaspoon of spicy salt and pepper , sugar , soy and rice wine for 2-3 hours , turning frequently
4. Coat each quail piece in flour , dustin off the excess
5. Fill a wok to 1 / 4 full with oil and heat the oil to 190c
6. Fry the quail for 2-3 minutes each side then remove from the wok and drain on kitchen paper
7. Serve with the lemon wedges on the side

title: chicken pesto penne
steps:
1. Season and saute the chicken breast
2. Remove from the pan and keep warm
3. Meanwhile , cook the penne in salted boiling water
4. In the same pan as the chicken breast , saute mushrooms and onion
5. When almost done , add garlic and saute until fragrant
6. Add cream and pesto and bring to a boil
7. Put the chicken back in the pan and add the sun-dried tomatoes simmer gently for 5 to 10 minutes to thicken
8. Add most of the parmesan
9. Drain the penne saving some of the water
10. Add the penne to the sauce and stir
11. Add reserved water if needed to thin the sauce
12. Serve penne topped with the saved parmesan and basil if using
13. Serve

title: low fat cherry almond cookies
steps:
1. Combine flour , baking soda and salt
2. Set aside
3. In large mixing bowl , beat margarine and brown sugar until light and fluffy
4. Add egg whites and almond flavoring
5. Beat well
6. Stir in flour mixture , mixing until well-combined
7. Add cherries and kellogg's low fat granola cereal
8. Drop by level measuring tablespoons onto baking sheet lightly coated with cooking spray
9. Bake at 375 degrees for about 10 minutes or until edges start to turn brown
10. Cool on wire racks
11. Store in airtight container

title: creamy raspberry tarts
steps:
1. Combine 1 tablespoon brown sugar , cinnamon , and nutmeg , stir and set aside
2. Cut rounds from each tortilla , using a 3 1 / 2 inch biscuit cutter , discard excess
3. Brush both sides or tortillas with warm water
4. Coat top side of each round with cooking spray , sprinkle with brown sugar mixture
5. Press each tortilla into a muffin cup
6. Bake at 350 degrees for 14 minutes
7. Cool in pan on a wire rack
8. Remove from pan , and set aside
9. Rinse berries , drain and set aside
10. Combine cream cheese , almond extract and remaining 2 teaspoons brown sugar in a small bowl , stir well
11. Spoon cream cheese mixture evenly into each taret shell , and top with raspberries

title: easy won ton soup
steps:
1. Bring large kettle of water to boil for won ton
2. Put chicken broth in another large pot on low heat to simmer
3. Do not place cooked won ton in boiling or bubbling broth as it will tear them up
4. Mix together pork , seafood , salt , pepper , sesame oil , egg and sugar in a food processor until well mixed
5. Place 8- 10 wrappers on counter
6. Spoon 1 tsp of won ton mixture on each wrapper
7. To help seal , baste 2 edges of wrapper with milk
8. Fold into triangle and seal with finger
9. Place the 8- 10 filled wrappers in boiling water in kettle for 3 minutes
10. Remove gently with sieve and place in chicken broth
11. Continue batches until won ton filling is used up
12. If you have extra filling , it can be formed in a ball , boiled and placed in broth as a meatball
13. To increase recipe i use approximately
14. 2 to 1 pork to seafood
15. If you like vegetables in your broth , you can add to your personal liking
16. Total time to prepare and cook is about 30-40 minutes as you are preparing one batch as you are cooking the other batch

title: nutty peanut butter cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Whisk together first 4 ingredients in a medium bowl until smooth
3. Stir in peanuts and vanilla
4. Drop by rounded tablespoonfuls 2-inches apart on lightly greased baking sheets
5. Bake at 350 for 10 minutes or until puffed and lightly browned
6. Cool on pan on a wire rack 5 minutes
7. Remove from pan to wire rack , and cool 5 minutes
8. Serve warm or cool completely

title: malayan pork with satay sauce
steps:
1. For pork:
2. Cut the pork into bite-size cubes
3. Season with salt and pepper to taste
4. Thread on skewers and marinate in one cup of coconut milk for at least 1 hour
5. Preheat grill to medium high heat
6. Grill pork for 15 to 20 minutes
7. Baste meat often with the remaining cup of coconut milk while grilling
8. Serve with satay sauce
9. Satay sauce:
10. Put all sauce ingredients in the blender or food processor
11. Process / blend for 30 seconds
12. Pour sauce into the top of a double boiler
13. Place top of double boiler over direct heat and bring to a boil , stirring frequently
14. Move top of double boiler from heat into the bottom of the double boiler containing the boiling water
15. Cook sauce for 30 minutes , stirring occasionally
16. Thin to desired consistency with water or additional coconut milk
17. Serve over grilled meat

title: paul s zippy tuna salad
steps:
1. Drain tuna and use fork to break in smaller chunks
2. Mix well with mayonnaise and hot sauce
3. Fold in cheese and serve
4. Great on toast !
5. Makes 4 to 5 sandwiches or enough for 1 sleeve of crackers

title: nutmeg and ginger tea
steps:
1. Boil water with nutmeg powder and ginger piece for a good 2-3 minutes
2. Add tea leaves , turn off the heat and let the same stand for a minute or so
3. Add sugar and enjoy
4. U can add a dash of milk if you want

title: incomparable beef stew
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Put oil in oven proof casserole dish or dutch oven
3. Brown meat in dish
4. Add onion , garlic , potato and carrots
5. Sprinkle with salt , pepper , nutmeg and flour and bay leaf
6. Stir to combine
7. Pour in beef broth
8. Bring to a boil
9. Cover tightly and place in oven
10. Meat should be tender in an hour , but that depends on what size you cut your beef chunks to
11. If it is not tender enough , recover and continue to bake another 20-30 minutes longer
12. Once meat is tender , stir in sour cream and serve

title: long island lemonade
steps:
1. Fill a cocktail shaker 2 / 3 full with ice
2. Shake up the alcohol , lemon juice , ice , and sugar in a cocktail shaker
3. Strain into a tall glass filled with ice
4. Top with sprite
5. Add lemon twist to garnish if you wish

title: ham  cheese and broccoli stuffed meatloaf
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Combine first 5 ingredients
3. Spread the meatloaf mixture onto a piece of aluminum foil
4. Spread into a 16x10 inch rectangle
5. Drain the thawed broccoli well and spread onto top of meatloaf mixture
6. Spread the thin ham on top of the broccoli
7. Arrange the cheese on top of the ham
8. Roll the meatloaf using the foil to help
9. Pinch the edges to seal
10. Place in baking dish
11. Bake at 350 for 90 minutes

title: roast salmon with lime salsa
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 425
2. Using a sharp knife , carefully peel the limes
3. Be sure to remove all of the bitter white pith
4. Working over a bowl , cut in between the membranes to release the lime sections into the bowl
5. Cut each section crosswise into quarters
6. Return the limes to the bowl and stir in the onion , cilantro and jalapeo
7. Add 1 tablespoon of the oil , the sugar and a pinch of salt and toss well
8. Heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of oil in an ovenproof skillet until shimmering
9. Season the fillets on both sides with salt and pepper and add to the skillet , skinned side up
10. Cook over moderately high heat until golden brown on the bottom , about 2 minutes
11. Transfer the skillet to the oven and roast the salmon for 5 minutes , or until just cooked through
12. Transfer to 4 dinner plates , spoon the salsa on top and serve

title: bananas foster shortcake
steps:
1. Simmer brown sugar , butter , rum , liqueur , cinnamon and salt in a large saute pan over medium heat
2. Cook until thickened , about 8 minutes , whisking occasionally
3. Add bananas and simmer until warmed through , about 1 minute
4. Take off of the heat and stir in pineapple
5. To assemble:
6. Cut shortcakes in half horizontally
7. Coat cut sides of each shortcake with foster sauce
8. Place bottoms on serving dishes , cut side up , then top with fruit mixture , ice cream , nuts and remaining shortcake halves

title: souped up lentils
steps:
1. Put all but the last three ingredients in a large saucepan , stir well and bring to a boil
2. After 3-4 minutes on the boil , lower heat to a fast simmer
3. Cook for 20-25 minutes , stirring occasionally
4. Spoon off and discard any scum on the surface
5. Add the vermicelli and cook for a further 10 minutes
6. Stir frequently
7. If you like , you can buzz this up in the food processor , but it's really not necessary
8. Ladle into bowls and top with sour cream , cilantro and more black pepper

title: rainbow sherbet cake
steps:
1. Slice angel food cake crosswise to make four layers
2. Wash and dry the angel food cake pan , then line it with wax paper
3. Working quickly so the sherbet doesn't melt all over your kitchen , place the top layer of the cut cake back into the bottom of the pan and spread raspberry sherbet evenly on the cake
4. Repeat with remaining cake layers and lime and orange sherbets
5. Place cake and sherbet layers into the freezer for at least 30 minutes to allow it to firm up
6. When firm , run a knife heated in hot water between the pan and wax paper , then carefully
7. Serve and enjoy !
8. You can use whatever flavors of sherbet or sorbet you like - contrasting colors are nice - i've used lemon and mango , as well

title: boreal forest cranberry brownies
steps:
1. Drain and reserve liquid and use berries in brownies
2. Preheat oven to 350f coat a 9 x 13 inch baking pan with non-stick cooking spray
3. Combine flour , baking powder and salt
4. Set aside
5. Melt 1 cup butter in large saucepan
6. Remove from heat
7. Stir in 1 cup cocoa powder
8. Add 2 cups sugar , eggs , vanilla extract , and 1 teaspoons almond extract
9. Stir until well blended
10. Stir chocolate mixture into flour mixture
11. Add cranberries and nuts and mix just until blended
12. Pour batter into baking pan
13. Bake 30 to 35 minutes
14. Cool completely and frost
15. Frosting: melt 3 tbls
16. Butter in small saucepan
17. Remove from heat
18. Stir in 1 / 3 cup cocoa powder , 1 / 4 teaspoons almond extract , cranberry sauce and juice
19. Stir well
20. Add confectioners' sugar
21. Mix until well blended

title: spiced sirloin rice  teta rice
steps:
1. Mix all the spices together in a small bowl
2. Using a fine mesh strainer , rinse the basmati rice under cold water for a minute , set aside to drain
3. Combine the chicken stock mix in 1 cup of the chicken broth , set aside
4. In a large pot , heat the oil over med-high heat
5. Add the sirloin and mix with oil
6. Immediately sprinkle 1 / 3 of spice mixture on the sirloin and stir in , repeat this 2 more times and stir until the meat is brown all over and you have added all the spice
7. Add rice to the meat and mix it together 15 20 seconds
8. Add both the chicken broth and the chicken broth and stock mixture at this time , this should cover the rice and meat by a to inch
9. Add butter and stir occasionally
10. Once butter has melted and the liquid is just starting to boil reduce heat to just above low and cover the pot
11. Cook for 17 minutes
12. Do not lift the cover to check
13. During this time you can toast the pine nuts either in a nonstick pan on the stove or on a cookie sheet in the oven on broil
14. Either way you need to stir them continuously until they are nicely browned
15. After 17 minutes remove the pot from heat and let stand for 10 minutes
16. Do not lift the cover
17. After 10 minutes you can lift the cover and fluff up the rice with an fork
18. Scoop rice out onto a platter for presentation or directly onto a plate
19. If using pine nuts sprinkle them on top of the rice
20. If you are using the yogurt , it is served in individual bowls and a little is scooped on and mixed into the rice as you eat it
21. Enjoy

title: big thick buttery roast beef  n cheddar sammies   sandwiches
steps:
1. For each sandwich:
2. Spread 1 / 2 teaspoon horseradish on each slice of bread
3. Melt 1 tablespoon butter in a skillet on medium-low heat
4. Add a slice of bread to skillet and pile on 1 / 4 lb
5. Warm roast beef
6. Top with second bread slice
7. Cook for 4 or 5 minutes until bread is golden
8. Carefully flip sandwich over
9. Lift top bread slice and insert a thick slice of cheddar cheese
10. Cook another 5 minutes until cheese begins to melt and bread is golden
11. Repeat with each sandwich
12. Makes 4 sandwiches
13. Serve warm , with a pickle spear and chips , add a cup of soup or side salad for a more substantial meal
14. Avocado horseradish spread recipe #284084 makes a lovely sandwich dip

title: walnut and raisin oatmeal cookies
steps:
1. Cream sugar and shortening thoroughly
2. Add eggs and mix well
3. Add ground raisins and nuts
4. Mix well
5. Sift together dry ingredients and add to shortening mixture
6. Add vanilla and mix all together
7. Roll in 1-inch balls
8. Place on greased cookie sheet 2 inches apart and flatten with a fork
9. Bake at 350 for 10 to 12 minutes

title: old chicago sicilian pizza rolls
steps:
1. Unroll pizza dough
2. Spread ranch dressing over dough
3. Spread pepperoni , green onions and cheese over ranch
4. Roll up tightly and slice into rolls
5. Place on cookie sheet and bake at 425 degrees for 15 minutes

title: fettuccine alfredo with chicken
steps:
1. Cook pasta as directed on package
2. Meanwhile , heat large nonstick skillet sprayed with cooking spray on medium-high heat
3. Add chicken
4. Cook 5 to 7 minutes or until chicken is cooked through , stirring occasionally
5. Remove from skillet
6. Mix broth and flour in same skillet
7. Stir in neufchatel cheese , 2 tablespoons parmesan cheese , garlic powder and pepper
8. Cook 2 minutes , stirring constantly until mixture boils and thickens
9. Stir in chicken
10. Drain pasta
11. Place in large bowl
12. Pour chicken mixture over pasta
13. Toss to coat
14. Sprinkle with remaining 1 tablespoon parmesan cheese and the chopped fresh parsley

title: screaming banana banshee
steps:
1. Shake all ingredients with ice and strain into a chilled cocktail glass
2. Add the cherry and serve

title: m m rice krispies treats
steps:
1. Measure out cereal into a large bowl and set aside
2. Coat a 13x9-inch pan with cooking spray or butter and set aside
3. In large saucepan melt butter over low heat
4. Add marshmallows and stir until completely melted
5. Stir in vanilla
6. Remove from heat
7. Add cereal
8. Stir until well coated
9. Let cool for several minutes
10. Stir in m&m's , very gently ! they will have a tendency to melt
11. Pour them over the mixture as spread out as possible so you don't have to stir much
12. Using wax paper press mixture evenly into prepared pan
13. Let cool for 15 minutes or until set

title: spinach rockefeller stuffed portabellas
steps:
1. In a small saucepan , heat 3 tablespoons butter , add all ingredients but breadcrumbs
2. Cook uncovered on medium heat so that the liquid is reduced slightly
3. Reduce heat , and cover , stirring occasionally , till onions are tender
4. Add crumbs and mix
5. To prepare mushrooms , add remaining butter to a cleaned non stick skillet , and saute garlic briefly
6. Add mushroom caps , saute until lightly brown
7. Spoon an even amount of the mixture into each cap , and top with parmesan cheese , if using
8. Place in an ovenproof glass dish , and heat in a preheated 350 oven until heated through , about 15-20 minutes
9. Serve hot , with a garnish of lemon slice atop each cap

title: green chile sausage quiche
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Split and seed green chilies and place in piecrust
3. Sprinkle cooked , crumbled sausage over chilies
4. In bowl combine eggs , cream , both cheeses , salt and pepper and pour over sausage
5. Bake for 35 minutes or until top is golden brown
6. Let stand for 5 minutes before serving

title: alpine vegetable soup
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a large saucepan on medium-high
2. When the oil is heated , add the chopped onion and saute until the onion starts turning light brown
3. Pay attention that it doesn't burnt
4. Turn the temperature down to medium or low , and let the onions carmelize to a darker brown
5. Turn the heat back to medium high , then stir in the garlic , celery , salt and pepper
6. Stir together to blend the flavors
7. Add the potatoes and carrots and stir-fry for a few more minutes
8. Add the broth , zucchini , and dillweed
9. Bring to a boil , then reduce heat and simmer for 15-20 minutes , until the vegetables are soft
10. Make sure that the cornstarch is dissolved in the cold water , then add to the soup
11. Raise the heat to medium-high and heat through to thicken the broth a little
12. Serve topped with grated cheese

title: hoisin crumbed chicken strips
steps:
1. Cut chicken crossways into 1cm-thick strips
2. Place flour on a plate
3. Lightly beat eggs and 1 / 2 cup hoisin sauce together in a shallow dish
4. Place breadcrumbs in a shallow dish
5. Coat chicken strips , 1 at a time in flour , shaking off excess
6. Dip in egg mixture , allowing excess to drain
7. Coat in breadcrumbs
8. Place , in a single layer , on a tray
9. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes
10. Preheat oven to 180c pour oil into a large , non-stick frying pan until 1cm deep
11. Heat over medium heat
12. Cook chicken , in batches , for 2 minutes each side or until golden
13. Place on a wire rack over a baking tray
14. Keep warm in the oven while cooking remaining chicken
15. Serve with fries , beans and remaining hoisin sauce , for dipping

title: wasabi popcorn
steps:
1. Place popcorn in a large bowl
2. Microwave butter 20 seconds or until melted
3. Stir in wasabi until well blended
4. Drizzle wasabi butter over popcorn and stir to distribute
5. Sprinkle with salt and sugar , if desired , and stir again

title: best pancakes ever
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together except flour
2. Add aproximately 2 cups of flour gradually , enough to make batter able to spread well on griddle
3. Using 1 / 4 or 1 / 3 measuring cup pour onto hot griddle
4. Wait until edges set up and flip

title: houlihan s herb roasted chicken
steps:
1. For marinade base , place the onions , garlic and 1 / 2 cup cider vinegar in a blender and puree
2. Place puree in mixing bowl
3. Add the mustard , white pepper , garlic power , sugar & salt
4. Beat in oil with mixer at medium speed , then gradually add the additional 3 / 4 cup vinegar , mixing thoroughly
5. To the base add the marinade spices and water
6. Blend thoroughly
7. Makes about 1 quart , enough for 2-2 pound chickens
8. To cook , immerse split chicken or chicken parts briefly in the marinade place chicken on sheet pan and bake in 350 degree oven
9. 1 chicken split will take 1 to 1 1 / 2 hours
10. Chicken parts will take 45 minutes to 1 hour

title: nanny s molasses cookies
steps:
1. Mix ingredients together
2. Let stand in cool place for 1 hour
3. Roll into 1-inch balls and flatten with fork
4. Bake at 350 degrees for 8 to 10 minutes

title: ohrarieska  finnish barley flatbread
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 500f mix all ingredients until smooth
2. Generously grease a baking sheet
3. Pour the batter onto the sheet - bread should be 12 inches in diameter
4. Bake for 15 minutes , until bread is firm and golden brown
5. Cut into wedges , and serve hot with butter or cheese
6. This is definitely at its best shortly after it has been baked

title: yummy mex skillet dinner
steps:
1. In a pot cook the noodles according to package , or you can throw them with the meat and sauce if you'd like
2. In a large skillet , brown meat and onion til done
3. Strain and return to skillet
4. Add broth , chicken broth , taco seasoning and noodles
5. Cook on medium low heat for 10 minutes for flavors to incorporate
6. If sauce seems to thick , add a little more broth or water
7. Season with salt and pepper
8. Serve with a dallop of sour cream
9. Enjoy !
10. Options for a twist , throw in some frozen corn and black beans
11. Yum !

title: ina garten s shrimp salad  barefoot contessa
steps:
1. In a large bowl , whisk together the mayonnaise , mustard , vinegar , salt , pepper and dill
2. Combine with the shrimp
3. Add the red onion and celery and check the seasonings
4. Serve or cover and refrigerate for a few hours

title: bobby flay s roasted vegetable meatloaf with balsamic glaze
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees f
2. Heat the oil in a large saute pan over high heat
3. Add the zucchini , peppers , onion and salt and pepper , to taste , and cook until almost soft , 5 minutes
4. Stir in the garlic and 1 / 4 teaspoon the red pepper flakes and cook for 30 seconds
5. Set aside to cool
6. Whisk together the eggs and herbs in a large bowl
7. Add the meat , bread crumbs , cheese , 1 / 2 cup of the ketchup and 2 tablespoons of the balsamic vinegar , the vegetables and mix until just combined
8. Mold the meatloaf on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper
9. Whisk together the remaining ketchup and balsamic vinegar in a small bowl then brush the mixture over the entire loaf
10. Bake the meatloaf for approximately 1 to 1 1 / 4 hours
11. Remove from the oven and let rest 10 minutes before slicing

title: blackberry brandy
steps:
1. Divide the blackberries between 3 sterilised 500ml kilner jars
2. Pour in the sugar , dividing it equally between the jars
3. Divide and pour in the brandy
4. Seal the jars tightly and shake them well
5. Store in a cool , dark cupboard and shake every other day for a week , then shake once a week for two months
6. The brandy be then be ready to drink , but will keep improving if you can manage to leave it for longer !
7. When the brandy has steeped for at least two months , strain it off into a 1 litre bottle
8. It is now ready to serve

title: blue ribbon kielbasa
steps:
1. Slice the kielbasa in 1 / 4 inch pieces
2. Cut the peppers and onion into 1 / 4 strips
3. Mix ingrediants , place everything in dutch oven or crock pot and pour pineapple chucks and juice over the top
4. Cook at 35 - 40 minutes 350 degrees or for 4 hours on low in crock pot

title: marinade for all meats
steps:
1. All i can tell you is this is one of those recipies that you have to use your own judgement everyones taste for certain things are diffrent
2. Always add vinegar first then add in everything , what i do is pour half the bottles of all the liquids in the bottom of a long plastic dish and add garlic"except vinegar only use about 1 cap full" its used to take the salty taste of the soy out then add ur meat i use a rack of ribs then pour the rest of the liquids in on top of the meat and then take a fork and stab the meat so the liquds soak in the meat and bone yummy then put a lid on it and shove it in the fridge and let it marinade for a good 12 hours no thats not a typeo i did say 12 hrs you will thank me later its well worth the wait then get the bbq going

title: steel cut  oatmeal and fruit   for two
steps:
1. To small sauce pan melt the butter and add the oats
2. Stir for 2 minutes to toast
3. Carefully add the boiling water and reduce heat and simmer for 20 minutes
4. Stir in apple juice and simmer for additional 10 minutes
