5. Sprinkle cinnamon on fruit and stir into mixture together with the brown sugar , and craisins and sinmmer 5 additional minutes
6. Remove from heat and allow to sit for a few minutes
7. Spoon into bowls and top with nuts and addtional brown sugar

title: mocha layer cake with chocolate rum cream filling
steps:
1. For filling and topping: stir first 3 ingredients in heavy large saucepan over medium-high heat until sugar dissolves and cream comes to simmer
2. Remove from heat
3. Add 20 ounces chocolate
4. Whisk until melted and smooth
5. Whisk in rum and vanilla
6. Transfer 1 cup warm chocolate mixture to small bowl
7. Whisk remaining 2 ounces chocolate into mixture in bowl and set aside for topping
8. Cover
9. Let stand at room temperature
10. Transfer remaining chocolate mixture to large bowl to use as filling
11. Chill until cold and thick , at least 6 hours and up to 1 day
12. For syrup: stir water and sugar in small saucepan over low heat just until sugar dissolves
13. Remove from heat
14. Mix in rum
15. Cover and let stand up to 1 day
16. For cake: preheat oven to 350f
17. Butter 9x9x2-inch metal baking pan
18. Line bottom with waxed paper
19. Butter paper
20. Combine vanilla and coffee powder in cup
21. Swirl to dissolve coffee
22. Sift flour , cocoa , and baking soda into small bowl
23. Using electric mixer , beat egg yolks and 1 / 2 cup sugar in medium bowl until very thick and light in color , about 3 minutes
24. Beat in vanilla-coffee mixture
25. Using clean dry beaters , beat egg whites , cream of tartar , and salt in large bowl until soft peaks form
26. Gradually add remaining 1 / 4 cup sugar , beating until stiff but not dry
27. Fold 1 / 3 of whites into yolk mixture
28. Fold in half of flour mixture
29. Fold in half of remaining whites , then remaining flour mixture , then remaining whites
30. Transfer batter to prepared pan
31. Gently spread to even thickness
32. Bake cake until puffed and tester inserted into center comes out clean , about 18 minutes
33. Cool in pan on rack
34. Cut around pan to loosen cake
35. Turn out onto work surface
36. Peel off paper
37. Using long serrated knife , cut cake horizontally in half
38. Place 1 half , cut side up , on platter
39. Drizzle half of syrup over cake
40. Using electric mixer , beat cold chocolate filling until thick and lighter in color , less than 1 minute
41. Spread all of filling evenly over cake layer , aligning with sides of cake
42. Drizzle remaining syrup over cut side of second cake layer
43. Place second layer , syrup side down , atop filling
44. Press to adhere
45. Rewarm topping over low heat just until pourable
46. Pour topping onto top center of cake
47. Using small spatula , spread topping to edges , being careful to keep it from spilling over
48. Chill cake up to 1 day , covering loosely with foil or with cake dome after 2 hours of chilling
49. Cut cake into 16 squares and serve

title: rachael rays croque monsieur
steps:
1. Heat a large pan or griddle over med-low to medium heat
2. Heat a small saucepan over medium heat
3. Add in 2 tablespoons butter and melt
4. Whisk flour into butter and cook 1 minute
5. Then whisk in the half-and-half
6. Add in dijon mustard , nutmeg , salt , and pepper
7. Cook for 2 minutes to thicken
8. Remove from heat
9. Spread bread slices with the sauce and make sandwiches , using a couple of folded slices of ham per sandwich
10. Spread the remaining 2 tablespoons butter lightly across the outside faces of each sandwich
11. Spread the shredded cheese across a plate and gently press each side of the sandwiches into the cheese , then place on the hot pan or griddle
12. The cheese will brown and form a crisp coating as the sandwich cooks and heats through
13. Cook for 3 minutes on each side , or until evenly golden

title: little bit of spice pizza sauce
steps:
1. Stir all ingredients together in a small sauce pan
2. Cook over low heat for 20 minutes , stirring frequently

title: nestle toll house mocha biscotti
steps:
1. Combine flour , cocoa , coffee granules , baking powder and baking soda in medium bowl
2. Beat sugar and butter in large mixer bowl until creamy
3. Add eggs and almond extract
4. Beat until mixture is slightly thickened
5. Gradually beat in flour mixture
6. Stir in almonds
7. Divide dough in half
8. With floured hands , shape into two 12-inch long rolls
9. Flatten slightly
10. Place on one large or two small baking sheets
11. Bake in preheated 350f oven for 25 minutes or until firm
12. Cool on baking sheet on wire rack for 5 minutes
13. Cut into 1 / 2-inch thick slices
14. Arrange cut side down on baking sheets
15. Return to oven
16. Bake for additional 15 to 20 minutes
17. Remove to wire rack to cool completely
18. Melt morsels according to package directions
19. Drizzle over cooled cookies

title: pumpkin pecan butter
steps:
1. Measure pumpkin , pecans and pumpkin pie spice into 6- or 8-quart sauce pan
2. Prepare jars
3. Keep lids hot until ready to fill jars
4. Measure sugar into separate bowl
5. Stir fruit pectin into pumpkin mixture
6. Add butter
7. Bring mixture to a rolling boil on high heat , stirring constantly
8. Quickly stir in sugar
9. Return to rolling boil and boil exactly 1 minute , stirring constantly
10. Remove from heat
11. Skim off any foam with metal spoon
12. Ladle quickly into prepared jars , filling to within 1 / 8 inch of tops
13. Wipe jar rims and threads
14. Cover with two-piece lids
15. Screw bands tightly
16. Place jars in hot water
17. Boil in water bath for 5 minutes for 8-oz jars

title: make ahead sausage  cheese  and potato egg  bake
steps:
1. Grease a 13x9" pan ,
2. In a skillet , cook sliced sausage until it starts to brown- about 5-7 minutes
3. Drain sausage if necessary
4. Add chopped onion , cook 2 minutes
5. Add chopped green and red peppers , cook 1 minute
6. Add three cloves finely chopped garlic and cook for about 30 more seconds
7. Spread half of the potatoes onto the bottom of your cake pan , salt and pepper to taste
8. Spread on half of your sausage mixture
9. Spread on 1 cup of cheddar cheese and 1 / 2 cup mozzarella cheese
10. Repeat layers
11. In another bowl , mix together to eggs and milk , salt and pepper
12. Pour the eggs onto the layers and let sit in the refridgerator for 8 hours
13. Cook in the oven on 350 for 1 hour and 30-40 minutes
14. Let stand 5 minutes before cutting

title: mexican gumbo
steps:
1. In a large sauce pan , brown the ground beef
2. Drain beef
3. Add onion and garlic
4. Cook until the onion has softened
5. Add the remaining ingredients , bring to a boil , and reduce heat
6. Cover and simmer
7. Prepare the rice
8. Combine the rice and contents of the sauce pan
9. Enjoy !

title: diabetic fruitcake
steps:
1. Mix raisins , dates , shortening , hot water , salt , cinnamon , cloves and prunes
2. Boil 5 minutes
3. Cool and add vanilla , flour , baking soda and baking powder
4. Line pans with paper
5. Bake 350 30 minutes
6. Reduce heat to 325 and bake until tests come clear 25-30 minute more

title: cream cheese spirals
steps:
1. Take off crusts from white bread
2. Take 2 slices , and lay one above the other overlapping the edge by about half an inch
3. Roll out well with a rolling pin to seal and flatten
4. You should have a long piece now
5. Spread with flavoured cream cheese right to the edges , and lay on a spinach / shard leaf roll up tightly and leave in the fridge overnight
6. Remove from fridge- cut the roll into inch slices , push a pick through and lay decoratively on a platter

title: frozen pumpkin squares
steps:
1. Mix crumbs , walnuts and butter in small bowl
2. Reserve 2 tablespoons for garnish
3. Press onto bottom of foil-lined 8-inch square pan and refrigerate
4. Pour milk into large bowl
5. Add pudding mixes , pumpkin and spice
6. Beat with wire whisk 2 minutes or until well blended
7. Gently stir in 2-1 / 4 cups of the whipped topping and spread over crust
8. Freeze 4 hours or until firm
9. Let stand at room temperature 10 minutes or until dessert can be easily cut
10. Cut into squares and garnish with remaining whipped topping and sprinkle with reserved crumbs
11. For easy snacking , wrap frozen squares individually and freeze
12. Take out as desired for quick snacks

title: chicken lollipops
steps:
1. Break each chicken wing into two parts at the joint
2. Take each part and pull back the meat from one end of the bone to the other carefully , making sure that you do not pull the meat completely out
3. Put all the chicken lollipops in a bowl
4. Add ginger and garlic to the chicken
5. Mix well
6. Add green chillies , parsley and curry leaves to the same
7. Mix well
8. Add half a cup of all purpose flour and quarter cup of cornflour to the same
9. Mix well
10. Break one egg into the bowl
11. Add red food colour and salt to taste
12. Mix well
13. Keep aside for 1 hour to marinate
14. After an hour is up , heat oil in a wok
15. Deep fry the chicken lollipops in the hot oil by holding the
16. Drain on clean kitchen paper napkins
17. Serve hot

title: barbados pork roast
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit
2. Make a spice rub by mixing salt and all the spices
3. Dry the surface of the pork with paper towels
4. Rub the spices all over the pork
5. Place pork in a roasting pan and put in the oven
6. Cook for about 1 hour or until the pork achieves an internal temperature of 155 degrees fahrenheit
7. Remove pork from the oven and let rest for 10 minutes
8. Slice and serve

title: three grain bread  bread machine
steps:
1. Add all ingredients to the pan according to the order in the manufacturers directions
2. Set crust on medium and program for the whole wheat cycle
3. Press start
4. When the baking cycle ends , immediately remove the bread from the pan and place on a rack
5. Let cool to room temperature before slicing

title: philadelphia rice pudding
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300 degrees f
2. Mix all of the ingredients together and place in a 3-quart covered saucepan
3. Bring to a simmer on the top of the stove and then place , covered , in the preheated oven
4. Bake without disturbing or stirring for 2 hours and 45 minutes
5. The pudding will almost caramelize and become a pale golden color

title: cheese   chive dumplings
steps:
1. Mix together flour , butter , baking powder & salt
2. Use your hands to mix them and form large breadcrumbs
3. Add grated cheese & the chopped chives and stir through with a fork
4. Add the milk , little by little , mixing with a fork all the while
5. You might need a little less or a little more , depending on the flour
6. Be sure the mixture doesn't get too wet and sticky
7. Now you need to roll the mix into a ball shape
8. Place it in your stew & cook for 30 minutes
9. In general , a temperature of 150-190 / 320-360 or gas mark 4 / 5 should be used

title: lemon herbed chicken
steps:
1. Place chicken on broiler pan , skin side down
2. Mix dry ingredients together
3. Sprinkle with 1 / 2 of dry ingredients
4. Broil 4 to 6 inches from heat , for 20 to 25 minutes
5. Turn and sprinkle with other half of dry ingredients
6. Top with lemon slices , broil until brown- 15 to 20 minutes
7. We also use this recipe on our grill

title: apple ginger muffins
steps:
1. Combine raisins , orange juice , crystallized ginger , cinnamon , apple , banana , orange juice concentrate , and lemon juice in a large bowl
2. Let sit at least 1 hour
3. Add milk and egg
4. Combine whole wheat and soy flours and baking powder
5. Add to liquid mixture
6. Fill muffin tins 2 / 3 full
7. Bake at 375 degrees for 15-18 minutes

title: sauted zucchini with lemon
steps:
1. In a large skillet , heat the butter and oil over medium heat
2. Cut each zucchini half lengthwise into 4 pieces
3. Season the flour with salt & pepper , then coat with the zucchini with flour
4. Saut zucchini in oil and butter until cooked through but not mushy , turning to brown on all sides
5. When done , turn heat to low , and add soy sauce and lemon juice
6. Serve promptly

title: mom s oyster dressing stuffing
steps:
1. Heat milk , butter , and oyster liquid in small pan
2. Combine bread cubes , celery , onion , spices , and oysters
3. Add liquid and stir
4. Stuff poultry or place in greased foil lined baking dish
5. Bake 350 degrees for 1 hour , or until poultry is done

title: peach sunrise
steps:
1. Pour boiling water over tea bag and allow to steep for 5 minutes , discard bag and allow tea to cool
2. Blend peaches , syrup , tea and yoghurt until smooth
3. Swirl grenadine into 2 glasses and pour in peach mixture

title: tender bruschetta
steps:
1. Combine the first six ingredients
2. Let them blend for an hour at room temperature
3. Preheat the oven broiler on medium or low , just high enough to brown cheese and warm the tomato mixture
4. Slice up the french bread into 1
5. 5" thick slices
6. Drizzle olive oil in a hot nonstick pan and place french bread in the pan
7. Sautee until brown and crisped and then turn over
8. Add more olive oil as needed
9. When bread is browned evenly on both sides , remove to a baking sheet
10. Top each slice of bread with a mound of the tomato mixture
11. Top with a small scattering of mozzarella cheese and put under the broiler until cheese is browned and bubbly
12. Serve immediately

title: v8 roasted red pepper soup
steps:
1. In a saucepot over medium heat , cook first 5 ingredients for 15 minutes
2. Assuming potatoes are soft , puree the mixture in a blender
3. Add red peppers and puree again til smooth
4. Return the pureed mixture to the saucepot and stir in the juice
5. Cook for 5 minutes til warm
6. Serve with a triangle of garlic toast on top !

title: almond vodka
steps:
1. Place ice in cup
2. Pour rest of ingredients over ice
3. Mix and enjoy

title: easy  easy glazed onions
steps:
1. Put onions in a 1 quart casserole
2. Mix honey with catsup and pour over onions
3. Bake at 350f 15 minutes

title: oatmeal banana choc chip bars
steps:
1. Set your oven to 180c
2. Grease an 8" suqare baking pan
3. Cream brown sugar and butter
4. Mix in eggs , vanilla and cinnamon
5. Mix in oats , flour , banana and chocolate chips
6. Pour mix into baking pan
7. Bake 35 minutes
8. Cool in pan 5 minutes and turn onto a baking rack to cool 15 further minutes
9. Cut to required size and shape

title: sangria punch
steps:
1. Combine nectars , wine and rum in a large pitcher
2. Stir in the apples and oranges
3. Salud !

title: parmesan thyme potato wedges
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Cut potatoes lengthwise into fourths , then cut pieces lengthwise again
3. Coat bottom of a large casserole dish or baking sheet with olive oil
4. Add potato wedges to baking dish and toss to coat in oil
5. Sprinkle potatoes with thyme , garlic powder , onion powder , seasoned salt and pepper , and toss potatoes again to coat with seasonings
6. Bake for about 1 hour , until potatoes are cooked and beginning to brown
7. Remove from oven and top with parmesan , return to oven for about 2 minutes to melt cheese
8. Remove from oven and serve

title: hattie jo s homemade macaroni
steps:
1. Melt butter in pan , mix flour , salt and pepper
2. Add to melted butter , pour in milk
3. Cook and stir until thick and bubbly
4. Add 1 c cheese until melted
5. Put mac in casserole dish
6. Pour cheese sauce and repeat layers , top with remaining cheese
7. Bake uncovered at 350 for 30 minutes

title: hunt s creamy tomato tortellini
steps:
1. Cook bacon in large saucepan or dutch oven over medium-low heat until crisp
2. Remove bacon from pan , drain and discard all but 1 tablespoon drippings
3. Add garlic to drippings
4. Cook 30 seconds or until fragrant
5. Add undrained tomatoes , tomato sauce and water
6. Stir
7. Bring to a boil over high heat
8. Stir in tortellini
9. Return to a boil
10. Cover and simmer over medium-low heat 6 minutes or until tortellini is tender , stirring gently after 3 minutes
11. Add cream cheese
12. Stir until completely melted
13. Stir in bacon and peas
14. Return to a boil
15. Simmer 2 minutes
16. Sprinkle liberally with pepper , if desired

title: italian chicken and artichokes
steps:
1. Chop and measure all ingredient out first cooks up quickly !
2. Drain artichokes pouring liquid into a large non-stick skillet and bring to a boil over medium high heat
3. Add chicken to skillet , cook 10 minutes on each side turning once
4. Remove chicken
5. Combine soup , sour cream , mozzarella cheese , wine , salt and pepper into skillet , cook until bubbly
6. Return chicken to skillet , cover and continue cooking over medium heat 5-10 minutes , until chicken is tender
7. Add artichokes , cover and cook 2 minutes more until thoroughly heated , then sprinkle with parmesan cheese and serve over angel hair pasta or flat noodles !

title: basic bulgur
steps:
1. Bring the water to a boil
2. Add the salt and the bulgur
3. Cover
4. Turn the heat to low , so that it's simmering
5. Let simmer for 15 minutes , until all the water is absorbed
6. Enjoy !

title: crazy mixed up mile high leftover turkey sandwich
steps:
1. Put mayonnaise on both slices of bread
2. Arrange pieces of cold turkey on top of one slice of bread
3. Place stuffing on top of the turkey
4. Add the boiled onions
5. Add the cranberry-orange relish on top of onions
6. Spread the turnip evenly on the other slice of bread
7. Sprinkle with salt and pepper
8. Put the slice of bread with the turnip on top of the other piled-high goodies
9. Cut in half and place on a plate
10. Enjoy !

title: david s hamburgers
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients and form into patties
2. Cook to desired doneness

title: tabbouleh a la paula wolfert
steps:
1. Pick over the bulgur and place in a fine sieve
2. Shake to remove any dust and place in cold water to soak briefly
3. In a good sized mixing bowl , combine the scallions , herbs , cucumber , spices , oil and lemon juice
4. Drain the bulgur and squeeze by hand to remove any moisture
5. Immediately add to the bowl and mix well
6. Add salt to taste , cover , and refrigerate overnight
7. Before serving , mix in tomatoes and additional salt if needed

title: maple parsnips
steps:
1. Peel and slice parsnips
2. Steam about 8 minutes or just till tender
3. Drain and return to pan without steamer rack
4. Stir in syrup and coat well
5. Garnish with chives if desired

title: make  ahead  layered enchilada  casserole
steps:
1. Combine ground meat , onion , pepper and seasonings
2. Cook until meat is brown
3. Drain fat
4. Mix soup with enchilada sauce and water until well blended and add to the ground meat mixture
5. Simmer for about 10 minutes and reserve
6. Grease 9x13" baking pan
7. Layer six tortillas , half meat mixture with the sauce and half grated cheese
8. Repeat another layer with the remaining ingredients
9. Cool completely
10. Cover with foil and refrigerate 24 hours
11. Bake at 350f
12. For 45 minutes covered with foil until heated through before serving
13. Serve with shredded lettuce , chopped tomatoes , sour cream , salsa and guacamole if you like
14. Variation: this casserole can also be made filling each flour tortilla with the ground meat and rolled up , then covered with the enchilada sauce and soup mixture , and the grated cheese on top
15. Refrigerated and heated before serving

title: jack fry s key lime pie ice cream
steps:
1. In a heavy saucepan , bring cream to a simmer
2. Place the egg yolks in a bowl
3. Slowly beat the hot cream into the egg yolks
4. Pour the mixture back into the pan , and place over low heat
5. Stir constantly with a wooden spoon until the custard thickens slightly , 8 to 10 minutes
6. Be careful not to let the mixture boil or eggs will scramble
7. Remove from heat
8. Pour hot custard through a strainer into a large , clean bowl
9. Allow the custard to cool slightly
10. Then stir in the sweetened condensed milk and key lime juice
11. Cover and refrigerate until cold
12. Stir the cold custard well , then freeze in your ice-cream freezer according to manufacturer's instructions
13. Fold the marshmallow cream and crumbled graham crackers into the ice cream when it is finished

title: easy grape salad
steps:
1. Wash grapes and dry
2. Beat sugar , vanilla , cream cheese and sour cream in a mixer until smooth
3. Fold with grapes
4. Chill and enjoy !

title: apple and flax pancakes
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine flour , ground flax , sugar , baking powder , salt , cinnamon and nutmeg
2. In a medium bowl , lightly beat together the egg yolks , milk and melted butter
3. Add liquid ingredients to the dry ingredients
4. Stir until just combined
5. Shred the apple and add to the batter
6. Stir until just combined
7. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites
8. Preheat griddle or heavy fry pan to medium heat
9. Lightly grease pan or spray with nonstick vegetable spray
10. Using a 1 / 3-cup measure , pour batter onto pan
11. Cook pancakes until bubbles appear on the surface - about 1 minute
12. Turn pancakes over and brown on the other side

title: pear relish
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients
2. Let stand 1 hour
3. Drain well , discarding liquid
4. Heat mixture to a boil
5. Lower heat , and simmer 15 minutes
6. Spoon mixture into hot sterilized jars , leaving 1 / 8 inch headspace
7. Adjust lids
8. Process 10 minutes in boiling water bath

title: black bean sunshine pasta salad
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to package directions for the minimum cooking time
2. Place peas and carrots in a colander
3. When pasta is done , pour into the colander over peas and carrots
4. Drain and place in a large bowl
5. Add pineapple , beans , bell pepper , onions , and orange sections
6. Toss to combine
7. Combine reserved pineapple juice and remaining ingredients
8. Mix well
9. Taste to adjust vinegar and salt and pepper
10. Pour over pasta mixture
11. Mix gently until well combined
12. Cover with plastic wrap and chill overnight
13. Mix a few times while chilling

title: slow cooker chicken  tomato and white bean soup
steps:
1. Place vegetables , garlic , salt and pepper in crock pot
2. Top with the chicken pieces , butter , broth and bouillon
3. Do not stir
4. Cover and cook on low for 7 1 / 2 hours
5. Stir in drained tomatoes and beans
6. Continue to cook 1 / 2 hour more
7. Before serving , stir in parsley and tabasco sauce

title: texas roadhouse cinnamon butter
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in a food processor and blend until mixture is smooth
2. Serve with hot rolls or muffins
3. This may be stored in the refrigerator

title: mincemeat streusel
steps:
1. Preheat your oven to 200c / 400f / gas 6
2. You will need a 12" x 9" tin
3. Measure the flour and icing sugar into a mixing bowl and rub in the butter until the mixture resembles coarse breadcrumbs
4. Add sufficient water to mix to a firm dough
5. Roll out the pastry to a rectangle slightly larger than the tin , the line the base and sides of the tin with pastry
6. Trim level with the top edges of the tin and patch any gaps if necessary
7. Spread the mincemeat evenly over the pastry base
8. For the topping:
9. Put the flour , semolina and caster sugar into a mixing bowl
10. Melt the butter , allow to cool slightly , pour onto the dry ingredients and mix together to form a dough
11. Chill for 30 minutes , as this will make it easier to grate
12. Grate the dough using a coarse grater and spread evenly over the mincemeat
13. Bake in a pre-heated oven for 20 - 25 minutes until golden brown
14. Cut into 16 evenly sized slices and serve warm with cream or brandy butter

title: creamy pasta primavera    easy
steps:
1. Heat a large pot of water to boiling and throw in the pasta
2. Meanwhile , heat 1 tbsp of the oil in a small sauce pan and put in the white part of the spring onion
3. Fry for about 30 seconds and then add the tomatoes
4. Bring to a simmer and let cook for about 10 minutes , adding a spoonful of water if the tomatoes get too dry , until you have a sauce
5. While the tomatoes are simmering , you can lightly fry your veggies in the other tbsp of oil
6. When the tomatoes have cooked down , add the ricotta , milk and hot sauce
7. Blend with a hand blender to make the sauce smooth
8. Drain the pasta and toss with the sauce
9. Top with the veggies , green part of the spring onion and parmesan cheese if desired
10. Salt and pepper to taste

title: eatmore bars
steps:
1. Melt honey and peanut butter on stove
2. Bring to boil
3. Remove from heat
4. Add choc
5. Chips and marshmallows and heat until melted
6. Add peanuts and rice krispies
7. Pat firmly into a 9x9" greased pan
8. Cut into squares

title: butternut squash   sweet potato curry
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a large saucepan and fry the onions for 4 - 5 minutes until golden
2. Add the garlic , squash , sweet potatoes , potato and apple
3. Stir in the curry paste , turmeric powder , ginger , bay leaves , stock and seasoning to taste
4. Bring to the boil , stir well , then cover for 15 - 20 minutes until vegetables are cooked to liking
5. Stir from time to time
6. Serve with boiled basmati rice

title: italian hot dogs
steps:
1. Grill or broil hot dog
2. Wash peel and cube potato
3. Toss potato in oil , season with salt - pepper
4. Saut potatoes until fork tender
5. Saut onion and pepper until tender
6. Place your hot dog in torpedo roll ,
7. Top with spicy mustard , potatoes , peppers and onions
8. Enjoy !

title: orange babycake cheesecake
steps:
1. Crust:
2. Spread 1 / 3 cup margarine on sides and bottom of 3" tall can
3. Press crumbs in bottom and on sides of can
4. Might need a little more on bottom
5. Batter:
6. Beat cream cheese till smooth , add sour cream and egg , mix well
7. Blend in melted chocolate and remaining ingredients
8. Pour equal portions into 4 cans -- bake 25-30 minutes at 325
9. Center will be jiggly and edges are semi-set
10. Remove from oven and let cool 1 hour
11. Run smooth knife around sides and invert onto saucer , and invert again on serving plate , crumb side down
12. Chill 1 hours
13. Top with glazed mandarine orange slices drizzled with curcao

title: dannon parmesan artichoke dip
steps:
1. In a bowl combine drained yogurt , parmesan cheese , artichokes , parsley , and pepper
2. Mix well , adding salt if necessary
3. Serve with flat breads , crackers , or veggies

title: knock  em dead shortbread
steps:
1. Turn your oven to 300f to heat up
2. Grease the inside of the pan with butter on a paper towel
3. Put a strainer over a large mixing bowl and pour the flour into it
4. Shake the flour into the bowl
5. Cut the butter into small pieces and put them into a bowl
6. Mix them with a blunt knife to coat them with flour
7. Rub the pieces of butter between your finger
8. Lift the mixture and let it fall back into the bowl as you rub
9. Continue rubbing in the flour until the mixture looks like breadcrumbs
10. Stir in the sugar with a wooden spoon
11. Holding the bowl in one hand , squeeze the mixture into a ball
12. The heat from your hand makes the mixture stick together
13. Press the mixture into the pan with your fingers , then use a spoon to smooth the top and make it level
14. Use prongs of a fork to press a pattern around the edge
15. Then cut the mixture into eight pieces
16. Bake for 30 minutes until it is golden brown
17. Leave the bread for 5 minutes before putting it on a wire rack

title: lee lee s famous barbecue sauce for chicken
steps:
1. Blend all ingredients and heat , stirring until butter is melted
2. Makes about 1 cup

title: zesty egg salad for two
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine mayonnaise , mustard , salt , pepper , and lemon juice
2. Stir in eggs with a fork , chopping them into bite-size pieces
3. Add green onion

title: dipping sauce for vietnamese spring rolls  sauce only
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a bowl and wisk
2. Serve with soft spring / summer rolls !

title: grilled cheddar and apple butter sandwich
steps:
1. The sandwich is assembled in a cold , non stick skillet
2. Butter one side of first slice of bread and place butter-side-down in skillet
3. Place one slice of cheese on bread , then 1 tablespoon apple butter in the center of the cheese
4. Top apple butter with second slice of cheese
5. Butter one side of second piece of bread and place butter-side-up on last slice of cheese
6. Turn on heat to medium / low heat
7. Toast each sides l o w l y and carefully to achieve a gooey inside and toasty-golden outside
8. Eat and repeat !

title: fireside popovers with brie
steps:
1. Heat oven to 450f
2. Generously grease 24 small muffin cups , 1 3 / 4x1 inch
3. In medium bowl , beat eggs slightly with fork or wire whisk
4. Beat in flour , milk , sugar and salt just until smooth
5. Fill cups about two-thirds full
6. Bake 5 minutes
7. Reduce oven temperature to 350f
8. Bake about 10 minutes longer or until crusty and golden brown
9. Cut a small slit in top of each popover
10. Insert cheese chunk in each popover
11. Bake 5 minutes
12. Immediately remove from pans
13. Serve hot
14. Do-ahead directions
15. Bake popovers and cut the slit in top of each
16. Cool , wrap tightly and freeze
17. When ready to serve , insert cheese chunk in each frozen popover
18. Place in muffin cups
19. Heat in 350f oven 8 to 10 minutes or until cheese is melted

title: italian sausage   roasted pepper sandwiches
steps:
1. Cook sausages in large frying pan over medium heat until golden brown
2. Remove from pan and set aside
3. Add oil , onion , garlic and peppers to pan drippings
4. Cook , stirring occasionally , until vegetables are soft , about 10-15 minutes
5. Stir in tomatoes , breaking up with a spoon
6. Stir in basil , sugar , salt and black ground pepper
7. Add sausages , cover and cook for 15 minutes
8. Remove cover , increase heat to medium high and cook for 5 minutes , stirring occasionally
9. Place sausages and pepper and tomato mixture in bun and enjoy !

title: apple bake
steps:
1. Set oven to 375 degrees
2. Place apples in an ungreased baking dish
3. Drizzle with lemon juice
4. Toss to coat and set aside
5. In a small saucepan , combine the apple juice , brown sugar , butter and cinnamon
6. Cook and stir , over medium heat until sugar is dissolved and butter is melted
7. Pour over apples
8. Bake , uncovered for 20 mins , or until apples are tender
9. Best served warm with ice cream or whipped topping

title: whizaroni
steps:
1. Boil macaroni in salted water as directed on package and drain
2. Brown ground beef and onion in a skillet
3. Add salt , pepper , garlic , cooked macaroni and cheez whiz
4. Simmer and stir until cheese is melted

title: cairns cooler  mocktail
steps: 1. Pour ingredients one after the other into a serving glass filled with ice

title: healthy couscous with roasted mediterranean vegetables  ww
steps:
1. Heat the oven to 350f or 180c
2. Put the olive oil and garlic in a roasting / baking pan
3. Finely dice the red onion into small chunks and add to the pan
4. Stir and cook in the oven for 5 minutes
5. Meanwhile , finely dice the yellow bell pepper and zucchini
6. Add these to the pan , with the cavenders seasoning
7. Stir , cover with aluminum foil and bake for a further 20 minutes
8. After 20 minutes , remove the foil and put the veggies back in the oven for a further 10 minutes until just starting to char around the edges
9. While the veggies finish cooking , make the couscous- heat the chicken broth in a jug or bowl , add the couscous and cover with the foil
10. Let sit until done
11. When cooked , fluff the couscous with a fork
12. Remove the veggies from the oven , add the couscous , stir and serve hot !

title: salmon on mash mountain
steps:
1. Peel and wash the potatoes
2. Half fill a medium saucepan with water and a little salt
3. Cook until firm
4. Fork should pass through
5. While potatoes are cooking , check there are no bones in salmon fillets
6. Remove if necessary
7. When potatoes are cooked , drain and put in a bowl , mash well with butter , milk , horseradish , pepper & nutmeg
8. Cover bowl
9. Heat olive oil in frying pan
10. When hot , sear salmon fillets for a couple of minutes only on each side
11. Remove the fillets to a warm plate and cover
12. Sauc:
13. Add the balsamic vinegar & mirin to frying pan
14. Stir over a medium heat for 30 seconds , allowing the liquid to reduce
15. Place a mound of mash potato onto each serving plate
16. Put the salmon on top and then spoon the sauce over the fish
17. Garnish with the chopped chives or the spring onions

title: churros with spiced sugar and chocolate dipping sauce
steps:
1. Combine the milk , cream , sugar , vanilla bean and seeds in a medium saucepan , bring to a simmer and cook until the sugar is completely dissolved , about 1 minute
2. Remove the pan from the heat , add the chocolate and let sit for 30 seconds
3. Whisk the mixture until smooth
4. Keep warm
5. Put the oil into a large saucepan and heat over medium heat until a deep fry thermometer registers 365 degrees f
6. Place several layers of paper towels on a baking sheet and set aside
7. Combine the water , butter , 1 / 4 cup sugar , and salt in a medium saucepan over high heat
8. Bring to a boil and cook until the butter is completely melted and the sugar is dissolved
9. Add the flour , 1 / 4 teaspoon cinnamon and 1 / 4 teaspoon anise seeds and quickly beat with a wooden spoon until a ball is formed and the mixture becomes dry , about 2 minutes
10. Transfer the mixture to the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the paddle attachment and beat for one minute to allow some of the steam to escape the mixture and to cool slightly before adding the eggs
11. Add the eggs , one a time , beating every time until each is incorporated
12. Add the vanilla extract and beat for 20 seconds longer
13. Scrape the mixture into a pastry bag fitted with a large star
14. Combine the remaining 1 cup sugar , 1 / 2 teaspoon cinnamon and 1 / 2 teaspoon anise in a baking dish
15. Working in batches , pipe 6-inch strips of the dough into the hot oil and fry until golden brown , turning once
16. Remove with a slotted spoon or spider to the prepared paper towel-lined baking sheet
17. Let the churros drain for 30 seconds and immediately toss in the sugar mixture
18. Serve the churros warm with the chocolate dipping sauce on the side

title: paneer makhani
steps:
1. Heat oil , add the chopped tomatoes , ginger , bay leaf , cardamom , methi and chilli powder
2. Cook covered till the tomatoes turn soft
3. Cool , and grind the tomato mixture to a puree and pass through a sieve
4. Keep the tomato puree on the fire , and add salt , sugar , garam masala and cook on low flame for 3-5 minutes
5. Add the paneer cubes and cook till soft
6. Now add the cream keeping some for the garnish and remove from fire
7. Just before serving add the paneer pieces and garnish with beaten cream and coriander leaves

title: spinach pancakes
steps:
1. Put spinach in a covered saucepan over medium heat , with just the water that clings to its leaves after washing
2. Or plunge it into a pot of salted boiling water
3. Either way , cook it until it wilts , just a couple of minutes
4. Drain , cool , squeeze dry and chop
5. Heat large skillet over medium-low heat while you make batter
6. Heat oven to 200 degrees
7. In a bowl , mix together dry ingredients
8. Place 1 1 / 2 cups buttermilk in another bowl
9. Beat eggs into it , then stir in the melted butter
10. Stir this into dry ingredients , adding a little more buttermilk if batter seems thick
11. Stir in spinach
12. Place a teaspoon or two of butter in pan
13. When butter foam subsides , ladle batter onto skillet , making any size pancakes you like
14. Adjust heat as necessary
15. First batch will require higher heat than subsequent batches
16. Add more butter to pan as necessary
17. Brown bottoms in 2 to 4 minutes
18. Flip only when pancakes are fully cooked on bottom
19. They wont hold together well until they are ready
20. Cook until second side is lightly browned
21. As pancakes are done , put them on an ovenproof plate in oven for up to 15 minutes
22. Mix sour cream and lemon peel together and place a small dollop on each pancake

title: carameltini
steps:
1. Put all ingredients in a cocktail shaker and shake to combine and chill
2. Strain into martini glass

title: roy s famous chocolate souffle
steps:
1. Melt butter and chocolate together in a double boiler
2. Combine sugar and cornstarch
3. In a separate bowl , whisk eggs with yolks
4. Add chocolate mixture to sugar mixture
5. Combine thoroughly
6. Add eggs and whisk just until smooth
7. Refrigerate overnight
8. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
9. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and spray with cooking oil
10. Spray molds with oil and line with parchment
11. Spray parchment with oil
12. Scoop batter into molds so they are 2 / 3 full
13. If using small ramekins , cut a piece of parchment to fit the bottom , then spray the sides generously
14. Bake on top rack of oven 20 minutes , or until sides are set but center is still undercooked
15. Remove from oven
16. Holding each mold with tongs or potholders , slip a metal spatula underneath and transfer to plate
17. Slip a butter knife between the parchment and the mold to loosen cake
18. Slip off mold and peel off parchment
19. Serve immediately
20. Makes 4 3-inch cakes
21. If you don't have bottomless round dessert molds , 8-ounce tomato sauce cans with the tops & bottoms removed work also

title: chicken   black bean enchiladas
steps:
1. Place chicken breasts in a skillet , cover with water , and add onion , peppercorns , garlic , bay leaves , and bouillon
2. Bring to a boil , then reduce heat and simmer until chicken is cooked , about 20 minutes
3. Remove from broth
4. Set aside and let cool
5. When the chicken is cool , shred
6. While chicken is cooking , melt 2 tbsp butter in medium sauce pan over medium heat
7. Add flour and cook for 2-3 minutes , until roux starts to turn light brown
8. Add tomato paste , chili powder , cumin , garlic powder and adobo
9. Stir to combine
10. Stir in chicken broth and 1 / 2 cup water
11. Bring to a boil , the reduce heat to low
12. Taste and season with salt and pepper
13. To assemble enchiladas , warm tortillas in the microwave so they are more pliable , approximately one minute
14. Sprinkle 1 tbsp of the roughly chopped cilantro down the center of the tortilla
15. Next , add 1 / 4 cup shredded cheese
16. Top with 2 tbls of black beans and a generous 1 / 3 cup of shredded chicken
17. Bring one side of the tortilla over the top of the filling , tuck in and continue to roll
18. Coat the bottom of a 9x13 baking dish with 1 cup of the enchilada sauce
19. Place rolled enchiladas in the pan and cover with remaining sauce and 1-2 cups of cheese and any remaining cilantro
20. Bake at 375 for 20-30 minutes , or until hot all the way thru and the sauce is bubbly

title: adult chocolate milk
steps:
1. Stir all together in a pyrex glass measuring cup , or what ever you have
2. Fill glass with ice
3. Pour mixture over ice
4. For extra fun , hang a small scoop of chocolate or coffee ice cream on the rim of the glass !
5. Enjoy ! :)

title: slow cooker party sausages
steps:
1. Cut sausages diagonally into 1 / 2 inch slices
2. Cook in a skillet over medium heat until lightly browned
3. Place sausages in the slow cooker
4. Discard drippings
5. Add dressings , sugar , and juice to skillet
6. Cook and stir over medium heat until sugar is dissolved
7. Pour over sausages
8. Heat on low for 1-2 hours or until heated through

title: southern chicken and dumplings
steps:
1. Combine chicken , salt and pepper in a large pot and cover with water
2. Cook until chicken is tender
3. Remove chicken from water
4. Remove bone and skin
5. Set chicken aside
6. Dumplings: in a large bowl , mix flour , salt , baking powder and shortening with a fork
7. Add egg and 1 / 2 cup milk
8. Mix to form dough
9. Roll dough to 1 / 4-inch thickness on floured surface
10. Cut into four-inch strips with sharp knife
11. Drop dumplings into simmering chicken broth
12. Cover and simmer until dumplings are done
13. Add chicken to dumplings and 1 cup milk
14. Cook slowly for 10 minutes

title: philippines monggo beans and pechay  mung beans and bok choi
steps:
1. Blend onion and 1 / 2 cup vegetarian broth in the blender
2. In a large pan cook blended onion & broth mixture , garlic , ginger , and tomatoes
3. Cook for about 3 minutes
4. Add the cooked green mung beans and remaining broth
5. Once it's begun to boil , add the pechay / bok choy and cook until it's smooth
6. Salt to taste
7. Tastes great served over cooked rice

title: south african milk tart    traditional
steps:
1. Roll out the pastry on a floured board until thinner
2. Beat an extra egg -- not one of the 4 in the ingredient list -- in a small bowl
3. Line 2 average-size or smaller pastry plates with the pastry , being careful not to strech it
4. Crimp edges , paint with the egg , and put in fridge to keep cold
5. Heat oven to 400 deg f / 200 deg celsius
6. Heat 3 of the cups of milk with the cinnamon
7. If using stick cinnamon , take it out when milk is hot
8. Mix the flour , cornflour , salt and 4 tablespoons of the sugar with the extra cup of milk in another pot
9. Add the hot milk to this mixture , and keep whisking to prevent lumps forming
10. Bring to a slow boil while stirring or whisking , add vanilla , keep stirring
11. Take from heat and add the butter
12. Whisk the egg whites until stiff , add the rest of the sugar and whisk until really firm and glossy
13. Now whisk the egg yolks well , and add to the cooled milk mixture: you don't want boiled eggs !
14. Fold in egg whites
15. Use a whisk to incorporate them
16. Pour into the 2 lined pastry plates
17. Bake in the pre-heated oven: 10 mins at heat given above , then lower heat to 350 deg f / 180 deg celsius
18. Bake until puffed up and golden brown on top -- about 20+ minutes extra
19. When they come out of the oven you can sprinkle the tops with a cinnamon-sugar mixture
20. The milk tarts will fall again , which is normal
21. Best served still slightly warm , but can be made ahead , cooled and refrigerated
22. Always serve at room temperature or warm in oven again

title: duck and wild rice casserole
steps:
1. Combine the first 5 ingredients in a large pot
2. Cover with water , and bring to a boil
3. Lower heat
4. Cover and simmer 1 hour or until ducks are tender
5. Remove ducks from stock
6. Strain stock and reserve
7. When ducks are cool enough to handle , remove meat from bones
8. Cut into bite-sized pieces and set aside
9. Cook rice by following the package directions
10. Drain mushrooms , reserving the liquid
11. Add enough duck broth to the mushroom liquid to make 1 1 / 2 cups
12. Saute chopped onion in the melted margarine until tender
13. Add in flour , stirring until smooth
14. Add in mushrooms
15. Cook / stir constantly for 1 minute
16. Gradually stir in mushroom liquid / broth mixture
17. Cook over medium heat , stirring constantly until thickened and bubbly
18. Stir in duck , rice , half-and-half , and parsley
19. Spoon into a greased 2-quart shallow casserole dish
20. Sprinkle almonds over the top
21. Cover and bake in a 350f oven for 15-20 minutes
22. Uncover and bake 5-10 more minutes or until thoroughly heated

title: veggie rice balls
steps:
1. Cook rice and lentils until soft , about 1 / 2 an hour
2. Meanwhile , in a large skillet sprayed with non stick cooking spray , cook onions until tender
3. Add the rest of the veggies and cook until very soft , about 20-25 minutes , adding water if needed
4. In a large bowl , combine hot rice and lentils with veggies , mash well
5. Add the rest of the ingredients and mix well
6. Form into 10 rice balls , or 4 patties to make veggie burgers , and refrigerate for 1 / 2 an hour
7. Fry in oil , turning frequently
8. Serve warm
9. I make veggie burgers and serve with a green salad

title: pesto popcorn seasoning mix
steps:
1. In a small bowl combine butter-flavored sprinkles , parmesan cheese , basil , parsley flakes , and garlic powder
2. Transfer mixture to 4-ounce bottle
3. Cover and store mix in the refrigerator for up to 1 month

title: chocolate sheath cake
steps:
1. For cake: mix flour and sugar together in a large mixing bowl
2. In saucepan mix water , cocoa , salt , and butter
3. Bring to a boil
4. Pour over flour and sugar
5. Add buttermilk , eggs , soda , and vanilla
6. Mix until blended
7. Pour into large greased cookie sheet
8. Bake in 375 oven for 20 minutes
9. For icing: while cake is cooking bring butter , cocoa , and milk to a boil in a small saucepan
10. Remove from heat
11. Add sugar& vanilla
12. Spread on hot out of the oven cake

title: marie s vegan banana pecan bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Grease and flour a loaf pan
3. In a medium bowl , mix all the wet ingredients until the sugar is dissolved
4. In a big bowl , sift all the dry ingredients together
5. Add the liquid mix to the sifted dry ingredients
6. Mix well and fold in the chopped pecans
7. Pour in the loaf pan and bake for 1 hour

title: low carb mac and cheese dog casserole
steps:
1. Boil a large pot of water for macaroni
2. Salt water and under cook macaroni , cook about 7 minutes until just under al dente in doneness
3. Preheat broiler and set rack 12 inches from heat
4. While pasta works , heat a large deep nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
5. Add 1 tablespoon extra-virgin olive oil , 1 turn of the pan , then add hot dogs and brown on both sides , 4 minutes total
6. Remove the dogs with a slotted spoon to a paper towel lined plate
7. Add another tablespoon extra-virgin olive oil , 1 turn of the pan , and the butter
8. When butter melts , cook onions 4 to 5 minutes , then add flour and cook another minute
9. Add beer and cook off completely , 1 minute
10. Whisk in milk and bring to a bubble , then season the sauce with salt and pepper and stir in the mustard and ketchup
11. Lower heat and add 2 cups of the cheese
12. Stir to melt , 1 minute
13. Adjust mustard , ketchup , and salt and pepper , to your taste
14. Drain pasta well
15. Combine pasta and hot dogs with sauce and coat evenly then pour into large casserole and top with remaining cheese
16. Melt and brown cheese under broiler , 2 minutes
17. Serve

title: roasted asparagus with lemon vinaigrette   courtesy melissa d ar
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f
2. Wash asparagus well to remove any sand from the
3. Pat asparagus dry
4. In a large bowl toss asparagus with the olive oil , and liberally season with salt and pepper
5. Spread the stalks out on a baking sheet , in a single layer , and roast until tender but still firm and moist , about 10 minutes
6. If you are using the really "skinny" stalks , be careful not to over roast them
7. Meanwhile , make the vinaigrette , see cooks
8. In a small bowl , vigorously whisk together the mustard and lemon juice
9. Slowly drizzle in the olive oil , whisking quickly to emulsify the olive oil into the juice mixture
10. Season with salt and pepper , to taste
11. Transfer the asparagus to a serving platter , toss with the vinaigrette and serve
12. The dish may be eaten warm or cold

title: yummy stuffed garlic rolls  everyone loves  em
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Slice approximately 1 / 2-inch across the top of each roll , set the top aside
3. Tear out the soft centers of each roll into small chunks leaving the crust intact
4. Melt the butter in a skillet on medium heat , add the torn bread chunks , garlic and sesame seeds
5. Cook stirring constantly until the bread turns a golden brown and butter has been absorbed
6. Remove from heat
7. About 3-5 minutes
8. In large bowl combine sour cream , cheddar cheese , salt , pepper , parsley , spinach and toasted bread mixture
9. Mix well , taste for seasoning
10. Spoon mixture into hollowed out rolls and sprinkle tops with parmesan cheese
11. Place filled rolls on a cookie sheet , cover loosely with foil and bake at 350 degree f
12. For 15 minutes
13. Remove foil and bake for an additional 10 minutes uncovered
14. Remove from the oven , place one on each individual serving plate
15. Lean the top of the crusty roll that you cut against each filled roll off to one side
16. Serve with a green salad such as arugula with grated parmesan cheese

title: cream of green pea soup with fresh mint
steps:
1. Saute onion , celery and garlic in the olive oil for a few minutes until vegetables soften
2. Add frozen peas , lettuce and broth
3. Heat until very hot but not boiling , then add milk , reduce heat and simmer covered 15 minutes
4. After 15 minutes , transfer the soup mixture into a blender , add the mint and parsley and process until smooth
5. Stir in the salt and white pepper , nutmeg , sour cream and butter
6. Blend soup mixture well by hand
7. Heat through and serve with a smile

title: garlicky shrimp with bread crumbs  de joughe
steps:
1. Pulse bread in a food processor until coarsely chopped , some larger crumbs remaining
2. There should be about 1 cup of crumbs
3. In a 12" skillet , melt 2 tbs
4. Butter over medium heat
5. Add crumbs , shallots , 1 / 8 teaspoons salt and 1 / 8 teaspoons pepper
6. Cook and stir until crumbs are golden brown , 5 to 10 minutes
7. Stir in 1 tbs
8. Parsley and transfer crumbs to a plate to cool
9. Wipe out the skillet with paper toweling
10. Thoroughly dry shrimp n paper toweling
11. Sprinkle shrimp with sugar , 1 / 4 teaspoons salt and 1 / 4 teaspoons pepper
12. Heat skillet over high heat and add 2 teaspoons oil and heat to shimmering
13. Add half the shrimp in a single layer and cook until it's spotty brown and edges are pink
14. Remove pan from heat and transfer shrimp to a large plate
15. Wipe out skillet with paper toweling and repeat with remaining 2 teaspoons oil and shrimp , transferring it to the plate with the first batch of shrimp
16. Wipe out skillet , return to medium heat and melt 1 tbs
17. Butter in the pan
18. Add garlic and red pepper flakes , cooking and stirring for about a minute
19. Add the flour and cook about a minute then slowly add the clam juice and sherry , stirring constantly
20. Bring to a simmer and reduce to about 3 / 4 cup , 3 - 4 minutes
21. Then stir in remaining 3 tbs
22. Butter , 1 tbs
23. At a time , to add shine to the sauce
24. Stir in lemon juice and remaining 1 tbs
25. Parsley
26. Reduce heat to medium-low and return shrimp to sauce and toss to coat
27. Cook covered for 2 or 3 minutes until shrimp is pink and cooked through
28. Transfer to serving dish and sprinkle with the toasted bread crumbs
29. Garnish with lemon wedges , if desired

title: salmon in rice paper
steps:
1. In a saucepan , combine sake , mirin , vinegar , ginger , garlic and jalapeno , bring to boil and reduce to about 1 / 2 c
2. Meanwhile heat oil in a skillet , saute peppers , zucchini , carrot until crisp tender
3. Add to the sake mixture with soy sauce and keep warm
4. Salt& pepper each salmon fillet and drizzle with oil
5. Wet rice paper wrappers one at a time in a bowl of warm water , then remove rice paper to a clean cloth towel on the work surface
6. Place salmon in center of rice paper , fold rice paper over , tuck in sides and fold again
7. Repeat with remaining fillets
8. Heat 3 tbsp of oil in a skillet
9. Place rice paper bundles seam side down , saute for 3-5 minutes , turn over , cook1-2 minutes more
10. Spoon sauce into 4 plates , top with salmon , garnish with cilantro

title: gravad lax with a mustard and dill sauce
steps:
1. To make the curing mix: place the salt , sugar and white pepper into a medium sized bowl , add the dill and stir to combine
2. Line a large , shallow , rectangular dish , to fit the salmon , with clingfilm
3. Sprinkle over a quarter of the curing mixture , spread over the base and top with one of the salmon fillets , skin-side down
4. Sprinkle over half of the curing mix and top with the other half of the salmon skin-side up , sprinkle over the remaining curing mixture on top of the fillet and wrap loosely in the cling film
5. Weigh the fish down with some cans or weights on top to remove any excess liquid or moisture
6. Place in fridge , turning the salmon over twice a day , for 3-4 days , if possible
7. Do not pour off the curing liquid if it leaks through the cling film , unless there is a change of over-flowing
8. Before serving the gravad lax scrape the curing mix off the fish to remove the salt and pat dry with kitchen paper
9. To make the sauce:
10. In a bowl whisk the mustard and sugar together with the egg yolk , gradually whisk in a steady trickle of oil , making sure the oil is well emulsified
11. Start to add the oil at a constant pace , when used up whisk in the vinegar
12. Taste the sauce and adjust seasoning if needed , add the dill and mix well
13. To serve , cut the gravad lax at an angle in slices
14. Place 3-4 good slices on a plate along with a spoonful of the sauce
15. Garnish with the dill

title: trail mix granola muffins
steps:
1. In mixing bowl combine milk , granola , sugar , butter , molasses , egg and apple blend well
2. In large bowl combine remaining ingredients
3. Add milk mixture and stir just until dry ingredients are moistened
4. Spoon into 18 lined or greased muffin cups
5. Bake at 400 for 20 minutes

title: leaf lettuce salad
steps:
1. Gently wash and dry lettuce
2. Place in a salad bowl or on individual plates , then top with onions and eggs
3. Combine the remaining ingredients with a whisk , adjusting sugar to tartness of vinegar
4. Whip until quite foamy then pour over salad
5. Sprinkle with chives

title: barbecue sauce  bar b que
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , melt butter over medium-low heat
2. Saute onion for 5 minutes
3. Add the remaining ingredients , bring to a boil
4. Reduce heat and simmer until reduced to desired thichness and flavors are well blended
5. Adjust seasonings to taste
6. Use to baste meats and poultry when grilling or roasting or use as a dipping sauce

title: dagwood sandwich  italian style
steps:
1. Slice roll and spread each half with french dressing
2. Then layer each half equally with the three meats
3. Place in toaster oven or under broiler for 2-3 minutes
4. Remove from flame and top meats with salt , pepper , and havarti
5. Place both halves back under the broiler
6. When the cheese is melting , remove and top with onion , lettuce and tomato
7. Press the two halves together with your hands and / or secure with toothpicks , slice cross-wise , and devour ! optional--can add pepperoni , canadian bacon , provolone , banana peppers --

title: peggy s chocolate mint dessert
steps:
1. Mix together 1 3 / 4 cup crumbs and melted butter
2. Press into bottom of 9x13" pan
3. Cover crust and chill
4. Pour cream into large glass mixing bowl
5. Add mints and food coloring
6. Cover
7. Refrigerate overnight to dissolve mints
8. Chill bowl and beaters thoroughly
9. Whip cream
10. Gently spread on prepared crust
11. Top with reserved 1 / 4 cup crumbs
12. Freeze until serving time
13. Cut into squares

title: shrimp escabeche with ginger grilled pineapple
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a large nonstick skillet
2. Season the shrimp with salt and pepper and cook over high heat for 1 minute
3. Add the onion and garlic and cook , stirring occasionally , until the shrimp are cooked through , about 2 more minutes
4. Stir in the orange juice , 2 tablespoons of the lime juice , the scallion and cilantro , transfer to a bowl and let cool
5. Meanwhile , in a bowl , combine the remaining 2 tablespoons lime juice with the ginger , sesame oil , 1 / 2 teaspoon salt and 1 / 4 teaspoon pepper
6. Brush the pineapple with the mixture and let stand at room temperature for 30 minutes
7. In a dry skillet , toast the sesame seeds over high heat , shaking the pan , until fragrant , about 2 minutes
8. Light a grill or preheat the broiler
9. Grill or broil the pineapple for about 2 minutes per side , turning once , until lightly browned
10. Cut each quarter crosswise into 6 pieces and arrange the pieces on 6 plates
11. Set 2 shrimp on each plate , spoon on a little of the orange juice marinade and sprinkle with the sesame seeds

title: eggs regal
steps:
1. In a saucepan , over medium heat , melt butter and mix in flour til smooth
2. Gradually blend in milk , salt and pepper
3. Cook , stirring until thickened
4. Add cheese and stir until melted
5. Gradually mix in chopped eggs and bacon
6. Serve hot over biscuits , english muffins or plain toast

title: caramel crackles
steps:
1. Combine caramels , cream butter & marshmallows in a saucepan , stir over low heat without boiling , until the marshmallows and caramels have melted and the mixture is smooth
2. Combine rice bubbles and coconut in a bowl and stir through the melted mixture
3. Spoon into patty cases and refrigerate several hours until firm

title: blueberry orange muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Lightly grease muffin cups or spray with cooking spray
3. Place orange pieces in blender and blend until finely chopped
4. Add margarine , eggs , and milk and blend until well mixed
5. Combine flour , sugar , baking powder , and baking soda in a large bowl
6. Make a well in center and add orange mixture , stirring just until moistened
7. Fold in blueberries
8. Fill muffin cups and bake for 22-25 minutes or until golden
9. Cool 10 minutes in pan before removing

title: lemon  thyme    basil bbq sauce marinade
steps:
1. Combine lemon juice , garlic cloves , onion powder , salt , and paprika in a blender and process for a minute on high speed
2. Through the hole in the top of your blender , slowly add the oil , with the blender set to high , and then cover up the hole and blend another minute
3. Add herbs blend for 30 seconds
4. Keep chilled for up to 2 days

title: lentil and spinach soup
steps:
1. Sort and rinse the lentils in a large bowl discarding any debris or damaged legumes
2. Place the lentils in a large pot with the water
3. Bring the water to a boil , reduce to a simmer and cover
4. Cook for 25-30 minutes until lentils are tender but still retain their shape
5. Finely mince the garlic and create a paste by mashing it with the salt using a mortar or the back of a large knife
6. In a separate pan , brown the chopped onions in the oil
7. Add the spinach leaves and stalks , as well as the garlic paste
8. Simmer over low heat until the spinach is wilted
9. Bring the lentils back to a boil and add the onion spinach mixture and the celery
10. Turn the heat down again and simmer for 5 minutes
11. If you would like a thin soup , add the lemon juice alone
12. For a thicker soup , whisk the cornstarch into the lemon juice before adding
13. If adding cornstarch be certain to simmer a few additional minutes until soup thickens

title: thai turkey burgers with cucumber pepper relish and spicy mayo
steps:
1. Combine all relish ingredients and refrigerate until ready to use
2. Combine all thai mayo ingredients and whisk
3. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour
4. Combine all burger ingredients in a large bowl and form into 4 patties , being careful not to overwork meat
5. Grill until cooked thoroughly , about 4 minutes per side
6. Once cooked , remove and set aside
7. Place buns on grill cut side down and toast until lightly browned , being careful not to burn
8. Spread mayo on top part of bun
9. Place burgers on bottom part of bun and top the burger with relish and a handful of bean sprouts

title: pear gingerbread cake
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350
2. Pour butter into 13x9 pan
3. Arrange pears over bottom of pan
4. In small bowl , stir together brown sugar and 1 tbs of the cinnamon
5. Sprinkle over pears
6. In medium bolw , whisk together flour , cocoa , baking soda , ginger , remaining 1 tsp cinnamon , cloves and salt
7. In large bowl , beat 1 / 2 cup of sugar and shortening at medium speed 3 minutes til blended
8. Beat in egg
9. Beat in molasses
10. Beat in flour mixture in 3 parts alternately with water , beginning and ending with flour mixture
11. Pour batter over pears
12. Bake 35-40 minutes til toothpick inserted in the center comes out almost clean with some moist crumbs attached
13. Cook in pan on wire rack 30 minutes
14. Invert onto serving platter
15. Remove pan
16. Meanwhile , in medium bowl , beat cream and remaining 2 tbs sugar at medium-high speed until soft peaks form
17. Serve cake warm with whipped cream

title: kiwi and pineapple smoothie
steps:
1. Put all the ingredients in a blender & process until smooth
2. Pour into two tall glasses & enjoy !

title: apricot and chicken bruschetta
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f
2. Slice the bread into 10 slices , each about 1 / 2-inch thick
3. Brush the bread slices with the olive oil and arrange on a baking sheet
4. Bake for 10 to 15 minutes until crisp and golden
5. Cool to room temperature
6. Spread each slice of the toasted bread with the apricot preserves then place a slice of the cheese on top
7. Arrange the sliced chicken on top of the cheese
8. Cut each piece of prosciutto in half and place on top of the chicken
9. Transfer the bruschetta to a serving platter
10. Drizzle with the extra-virgin olive oil and serve at room temperature , that's what makes it so great ! :)

title: smith college cookies  chewy chocolate cookies
steps:
1. Melt choc
2. And butter in double boiler
3. Add condensed milk and vanilla
4. Measure flour into large mixing bowl , gradually pour in the hot chocolate mixture while beaters are running
5. Add pecans and stir well
6. Allow to sit for 10 minutes
7. Drop by teaspoons onto cookie sheet that has been well greased
8. Bake at 350 deg
9. For 9 minutes , no longer
10. Cookies will look soft and shiny
11. Leave on cookie sheet for about 2 minutes and then carefully remove them
12. 60 cookies

title: 2bleu s smoky mexican mushrooms
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f place mushroom caps upside down in mini-muffin tin , one in each cup
2. Mix ground beef with taco seasoning mix and cook till done
3. Drain
4. Place small amount of meat mixture into each mushroom cup
5. Drop one tiny drop of hot sauce onto each mushroom
6. Sprinkle a bit of herbs onto each mushroom
7. Drizzle each mushroom lightly with a drop or two of olive oil
8. Top each mushroom with smoked swiss , tearing the slices in half if necessary
9. Bake for 6-8 min in center of oven
10. Turn oven to broil , and cook additional 2-3 minutes

title: berry fruitful morning
steps:
1. Peel your orange and banana :) and donate both to the blender
2. Add orange juice , blueberries and ice cubes
3. Blend fully for approximately 54 seconds , or until the ice cubes are done clacking

title: brazilian fish stew  moqueca de peixe
steps:
1. Combine first 6 ingredients in a large bowl
2. Toss to coat
3. Marinate in refrigerator 30 minutes
4. Heat oil in a large dutch oven over medium heat
5. Add the onion , bell peppers , green onions , garlic , and bay leaf
6. Cook 6 minutes , stirring occasionally
7. Increase heat to medium-high
8. Add tomato , and cook 2 minutes
9. Add 1 / 4 cup cilantro , clam juice , and broth
10. Bring to a boil
11. Reduce heat , and simmer 10 minutes
12. Discard bay leaf
13. Place one-third of vegetable mixture in a blender , and puree until smooth
14. Pour pureed vegetable mixture into pan
15. Repeat procedure with remaining vegetable mixture
16. Add coconut milk and red pepper to pureed vegetable mixture
17. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat
18. Cook 3 minutes
19. Add fish mixture
20. Cook 3 minutes or until fish is done
21. Sprinkle with 1 / 4 cup cilantro

title: steamed orange roughy with buckwheat noodles and asparagus mushr
steps:
1. In a wok , combine the chicken stock , quartered lemon , parsley stalks and thyme
2. Place the wok over medium-high heat and bring the stock to a boil
3. Place the filets of orange roughy in the bamboo steamer
4. Sprinkle the filets with salt and pepper
5. Place the bamboo steamer over the boiling liquid in the wok
6. Cover the steamer and steam the fish for 4 to 6 minutes depending on thickness of filets , or until the fish is opaque and just cooked through
7. Once the fish is cooked , remove the steamer from the wok
8. In a large saucepan , bring 2 cups of water to a boil over high heat
9. Strain the stock from the wok into the saucepan of boiling water
10. Return the liquid to a boil
11. Add the noodles to the boiling liquid and cook for 4 to 5 minutes or until al dente , stirring often
12. Heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil in the wok over medium-high heat
13. Swirl the wok to coat with the oil
14. Add the asparagus and morels and stir-fry for 2 to 3 minutes
15. Add the garlic to the wok and saut for 1 minute
16. Sprinkle the lemon zest and lemon juice over the vegetables and season with salt and pepper
17. Toss the stir-fried vegetables with 3 tablespoons of the noodle cooking liquid
18. Remove from heat
19. Strain the noodles from the cooking liquid , then season the noodles to taste with salt and pepper
20. Toss the noodles with 1 tablespoon of olive oil
21. Using a two-pronged carving fork , twist the noodles around the fork and divide them among 4 plates
22. Place 1 orange roughy filet over each plate of noodles
23. Divide the stir-fried vegetable among the 4 plates

title: vegetarian stuffed bell peppers
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Heat oil in a medium pan
3. Saute garlic and onion until onion is transucent
4. Add dried tomatoes , minced bell pepper , and breadcrumbs and saute until the bell pepper is softened
5. Add canned tomatoes a little at a time , allowing the liquid to be absorbed before adding more
6. Then add the pepper and mustard
7. Spoon mixture into the halved bell peppers , top with grated cheese , and bake for 10 minutes at 350 degrees
8. Top with parsley if desired

title: more brisket  please
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f degrees
2. Place brisket in a large roasting pan with chili sauce , french onion soup and beef broth
3. Place sliced onions on top and sprinkle with seasonings
4. Cover tightly with foil and roast 2 hours , remove foil and slice thinly against the grain
5. Return meat to pan , re-cover and roast 45 minutes
6. Remove foil and roast another 15 minutes to allow juices to thicken

title: mandarin mojito
steps:
1. Add mint and lime wedge into collins glass , then muddle
2. Fill glass with ice
3. Add sprite and sweet and sour mix
4. Stir

title: banana pudding bread
steps:
1. Beat butter in mixer at medium speed till creamy
2. Gradually add sugar , beating well
3. Add eggs , one at a time
4. Beating after each one
5. Combine flour , baking powder , salt , and vanilla wafers
6. Add to creamed mixture alternately with banana and milk , beginning and ending with flour mixture
7. Mix at low speed after each addition
8. Stir in 3 / 4 cup walnuts
9. Spoon batter into a greased and floured loaf pan
10. Sprinkle with remaining walnuts
11. Bake at 350 degrees for 55 minutes- 1 hour or till a toothpick comes out clean- loosely covering with foil after 45 minutes
12. Let cool in pan on a wire rack 10 minutes
13. Remove from pan and let cool completely on rack

title: stuffed naan bread with minced meat  keema naan
steps:
1. To make the naan bread:
2. Sift the flour , salt , baking powder , yeast and sugar in a bowl and pour in the hand-hot milk , oil , yoghurt and the beaten egg and mix it all together to form a ball of dough
3. Place the dough on to a clean surface and knead it for 10 minutes or more , until it is smooth and satiny
4. Pour about 1 / 4 tsp oil into a large bowl and roll the ball of dough in it
5. Cover the bowl with a piece of cling film and set aside in a warm , draught-free place for an hour or until the dough has doubled in size
6. To make the mince stuffing:
7. Heat oil in a pan and on medium heat , fry the finely chopped onion , minced ginger and garlic till lightly golden browned
8. Add the mince meat , chopped chillies , spices and salt and stir fry till nicely browned
9. Add in the tomato puree and about 2-3 tbsp water and let the mixture cook thoroughly , stirring occasionally , till all the liquid have evaporated
10. Remember , no liquid should remain
11. If the mince stuffing is wet , it will be impossible to roll out the naans without bursting them
12. Keep aside to cool completely then mix in the chopped coriander leaves
13. Back to making the naan bread:
14. Pre-heat your oven to the highest temperature
15. Put the heaviest baking tray to heat in the oven
16. Punch down the dough and knead it again and divide into 8 equal balls
17. While working on 1 ball , keep the remaining balls covered
18. Flatten the ball using your hands , roll it out slightly and then place about 1 heaped tbsp of the mince stuffing in the centre and pull the edges up , seal and shape into a ball again
19. Dust will a little flour if needed and roll out into a tear-shaped naan , about 15 cm in length and about 12 cm at its widest
20. Brush the top with melted butter
21. Remove the hot baking tray from the oven , grease it well with butter and place the naan on to it
22. Put it into the oven on the top rack for 2-3 minutes
23. It should puff up and brown slightly
24. Once puffed up and browned on one side , flip the naan and back into the oven again for another 1-2 minutes till the top of naan goes golden brown
25. Wrap the naans in a clean tea towel and serve hot

title: mirj s oven bag figgy chicken
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f
2. Clean the chicken
3. Place it in the oven bag
4. Add the fig jam
5. Add the salt and pepper
6. Tie a knot in the bag
7. Moosh the jam around until the chicken is completely coated
8. Place in a roasting dish
9. Roast in the oven for 1 hour , turning the bag over halfway through
10. Remove the chicken from the oven and let rest for about ten minutes
11. Cut open the bag , remove the chicken and cut into serving pieces
12. Top with the juices in the bag

title: sicilian eggplant  aubergine
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Combine ingredients in a oven-proof dish
3. Cover and bake for 45 minutes or until eggplant reaches the desired tenderness
4. If you don't want to use roasted garlic , just minced 1 tbls of fresh garlic

title: pat s baked beef
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 350 put beef in bottom of 13x9 in baking pan
2. Mix bbq sauce , mushroom soup and water together
3. Pour over beef
4. Place sliced onion on top
5. Cover and bake for 90 minutes
6. The gravy is very good on mashed potatoes

title: my mother s clam chowder
steps:
1. Combine cut vegetables in a large stew pot
2. Drain juice off canned clams and pour juice over veggies
3. Add enough water to cover vegetables
4. Simmer over medium heat until tender
5. Melt butter in a sauce pan
6. Add flour and blend until smooth
7. When vegetables are tender add the flour mixture and all other ingredients to the vegetables
8. Make sure flour mixture is mixed in well
9. Simmer all ingredients for 30 minutes
10. Add salt and white pepper to taste

title: almond bark mix
steps:
1. Melt almond bark in microwave according to package
2. In large bowl , combine everything except the almond bark and m&m's
3. Mix well
4. Pour warm almond bark over mixture and gently mix
5. Add m&m's and mix again
6. Pour onto waxpaper and let harden
7. Break apart and store in an airtight container

title: 1 000 artichoke hearts
steps:
1. Squeeze as much liquid as possible out of the artichoke hearts and drain them on paper towels
2. Roll each heart in egg wash , and then roll in breadcrumbs until well-coated
3. Deep fry for one to two minutes until lightly browned and slightly crispy
4. Melt butter and garlic in a small , individual saut pan
5. Saut hearts for two minutes in the garlic butter , basting each heart and taking care not to burn the butter or garlic
6. Serve right in the pan with firm bread such as french or italian

title: peanut butter rice pudding
steps:
1. Combine the first 5 ingredients and beat until well blended
2. Add the milks & sultanas & mix thoroughly
3. Pour mixture into a greased casserole dish and put into a larger dish filled with about 1 / 2 inch hot water
4. Bake at 160
5. C for 20-25 mins , then stir to redistribute the rice and continue baking for a further 15-20 mins until the custard is set
6. Serve sprinkled with peanuts and whipped cream

title: green onion cakes
steps:
1. Add salt to flour in a mixing bowl and mix throughly
2. Add honey to hot water in a separate cup or dish until the honey melts and mixes with the water
3. Slowly add water / honey mixture into the flour while stirring the flour
4. Knead the mixture until smooth
5. If it is too dry add a little extra water
6. If it is too wet , add a little flour
7. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 1 hour
8. After at least an hour remove mixture and roll into a sausage shape and divide into 10 equal portions
9. You will work with one cake at a time so cover the others so they don't dry up
10. For each portion of dough , roll into a ball between the palms of your hands , then on a floured surface roll the dough out into a thin round pancake
11. Sprinkle the surface of the dough with green onions
12. Roll the pancake into a sausage shape , trapping all the green onions inside the dough
13. Roll the dough again along the length of the sausage to make a coil shape
14. With the coil still standing up on your counter top flatten it with the palm of your hand
15. Roll the dough into a circle about 5 inches in diameter and place to the side while you make the rest of the cakes
16. Heat up the oil in a frying pan or skillet at a medium heat and fry each cake , one side at a time , until it is light brown
17. Cut into quarters and serve with chili garlic dipping sauce

title: onion sandwich
steps: 1. Slice onion into med slices , spread mayonnaise or miracle whip onto both slices of bread add the salt and the pepper to the mayonnaise add onions and enjoy

title: cashew ricotta
steps:
1. Combine first 4 ingredients in food processor
2. Puree to thick paste
3. Add tofu and blend until smooth
4. Blend in salt and basil

title: grapefuit basil gin fizz
steps:
1. Muddle basil in bottom of tall glass
2. Add ice , grapefruit juice , gin and tonic
3. Stir , then top with a few drops bitters
4. Garnish with basil sprig

title: garlic rosemary lamb chops
steps:
1. Preheat broiler
2. Combine the first 4 ingredients in a small bowl
3. Rub mixture over lamb chops
4. Place lamb on a broiler pan coated with cooking spray
5. Broil 5 minutes on each side or until desired degree of doneness

title: chiles rellenos casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Prepare a 2-quart baking dish by spraying with cooking spray
3. Sprinkle the chopped chili and cheese over bottom of dish
4. Combine the milk , biscuit mix , and egg substitute in a medium mixing bowl
5. Using a wire whisk beat till smooth
6. Stir in the cottage cheese and spoon mixture over the chili and cheese
7. Bake uncovered approximately 45 minutes or until puffed and a knife insered near center comes out clean
8. Allow to stand 10 minutes before serving
9. Top each serving with salsa , sour cream or plain yogurt

title: easiest pancake syrup
steps:
1. Stir together sugar and water in small saucepan till sugar is dissolved
2. Heat till boiling
3. Boil for about 2 minutes
4. Turn off heat
5. Add maple flavoring
6. Ready to serve !

title: chocolate peanut butter cream pie
steps:
1. Spoon 1 / 2 cup of the fudge topping into bottom of crust
2. Place in freezer 10 minutes
3. Whisk peanut butter and milk in a large bowl until well blended
4. Add pudding mixes
5. Beat for 2 minutes or until smooth
6. Stir in 1 / 2 cup of the whipped topping
7. Gently spoon over chocolate layer
8. Top with remaining whipped topping
9. Refrigerate 3 hours or until set
10. Drizzle with remaining 1 / 4 cup fudge topping

title: yogurt salad
steps:
1. Place the yogurt in a fine mesh strainer set over a bowl and drain for 1 hour
2. Discard the liquid in the bowl
3. Place the drained yogurt in a medium bowl
4. Add the remaining ingredients and stir well to combine
5. Place , covered , in the refrigerator for 1 hour to cool and blend
6. Stir well and serve

title: zrcher geschnetzeltes   zurich veal recipe
steps:
1. Sprinkle the flour over the meat and coat well
2. Heat half of both the butter and oil in a frying pan
3. As soon as the butter foams , add the meat and brown it very quickly on all sides
4. Set aside on a plate
5. Add the rest of the butter and oil to the pan and saut the onion , garlic and sage for a few minutes , then add the mushrooms
6. Stir well and when the mushrooms start to soften , continue cooking for about 5 minutes longer
7. Add the wine to deglaze the bottom of the pan , using a wooden spoon to scrape away any crust that has formed
8. Add the veal and cook , stirring , until the wine has evaporated
9. Turn the heat down to low and cook for another 10 minutes
10. Season with salt and pepper , and at the last moment , add the cream , let it bubble for 2 minutes , then remove from the heat and serve

title: pecan cream cheese frosting
steps:
1. Beat cream cheese , butter and vanilla at medium speed with an electric mixer until creamy
2. Gradually add powdered sugar , beating at low speed until blended
3. Beat at high speed until smooth
4. Stir in pecans

title: fiber one butterscotch haystacks
steps:
1. In microwave safe bowl heat butterscotch chips in 30 second intervals until melted
2. Pour in 1 pouch of fiber one cereal original
3. Stir until well combined
4. Drop by spoonful onto parchment paper and let sit until hardened , about 20 minutes

title: sausage cauliflower spaghetti
steps:
1. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil
2. Add the spaghetti and cook as the label directs
3. Reserve 2 cups cooking water , then drain
4. Meanwhile , heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat
5. Crumble the sausage into the skillet and cook , breaking it up with a wooden spoon , until lightly browned and no longer pink , 4 to 5 minutes
6. Clear a space in the pan , add the garlic and cook until just golden , 2 to 3 minutes
7. Add the cauliflower and cook until the edges are browned , about 2 minutes
8. Add 1 cup of the reserved cooking water , cover and reduce the heat to medium
9. Cook until the cauliflower is tender , about 8 more minutes
10. Uncover and boil over high heat until the liquid is almost evaporated , about 2 more minutes
11. Add the spaghetti to the skillet along with the scallions
12. Drizzle with olive oil and season with salt
13. Toss for a minute or two to wilt the scallions and coat the pasta with the sauce , adding up to 1 cup cooking water , if needed , to loosen
14. Remove from the heat , sprinkle with the cheese and toss
15. Divide among shallow bowls and drizzle with more olive oil , if desired

title: carol s oatmeal cookies
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 350 degrees
2. Cream shortening and sugar together
3. Add eggs and vanilla to mixture
4. Dissolve baking soda in the milk and add to mixture
5. Sift together flour , salt , cinnamon and allspice
6. Add to sugar mixture
7. Add oatmeal , pecans and raisins
8. Drop by tablespoons onto ungreased cookie sheet
9. Bake at 350 degrees for 12-15 minute

title: beed mahshi   egyptian deviled eggs
steps:
1. Boil eggs hard
2. Let cool and cut in half , remove yolks
3. Finely chop shallot , gherkin and olives
4. Combine egg yolks and yoghurt until smoot , mix in chopped shallot , gherkin and olives
5. Fill egg halves and serve

title: blueberry breakfast bars
steps:
1. Have all ingredients at room temperature
2. In a bowl combine flour , baking powder and salt
3. Place butter and sugar in mixer , with the paddle attachment , mix at low speed until light and fluffy
4. Add eggs and vanilla
5. Beat until smooth
6. Add milk , flour mixture , and oats
7. Stir until blended , scraping down sides of the bowl as necessary
8. Stir in blueberries
9. Spread evenly in a greased 9x13" pan
10. Sprinkle cereal over top
11. Bake at 350 until golden brown and tester comes comes out clean , about 40 minutes
12. Cool in pan
13. Cut into bars

title: danny s chicken tortilla soup
steps:
1. In a large dutch oven , saute butter and onions
