2. Add remaining ingredients , including 1 can of water
3. Bring to a boil , reduce heat to low and let simmer-- the longer , the better in order to let the flavors combine
4. Serve with sour cream , grated cheese , chips , cracker or cornbread

title: apple fritter cake
steps:
1. For filling: make your filling by combining apples , sugar , water , cinnamon and cornstarch in a small saucepan
2. Cook on low heat for 5 to 7 minutes , stirring constantly until the sauce is thickend and the apples are a bit soft
3. Set aside to cool
4. In a small bowl , mix the brown sugar and cinnamon together until well combined and set aside
5. For cake: preheat oven to 350
6. Grease and flour a 913 baking dish
7. Set aside
8. Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy , about 3 minutes
9. Add applesauce and vanilla and mix till combined
10. Add the eggs , one at a time , beating well after each addition
11. Sift the dry ingredients together
12. Add the dry ingredients to the batter in three parts alternating with the yogurt in two parts , beginning and ending with the dry ingredients
13. Beat until just combined
14. Spoon half of the batter into the prepared pan
15. Spoon the cooled apple mixture over the batter carefully and spread as evenly as possible
16. Sprinkle 2 / 3 of brown sugar cinnamon mixture over apples and cover with the rest of the batter
17. Sprinkle the rest of the brown sugar cinnamon mixture over the top
18. Bake for 45-55 minutes , until a toothpick inserted into the center of the cake comes out clean
19. For glaze: while the cake is baking , make the glaze
20. In a bowl , mix the powdered sugar , vanilla , and milk until the glaze is desired consistency
21. When the cake comes out of the oven , immediately but carefully pour onto hot cake
22. Try to pour as evenly as possible
23. You might have to pick up the cake and tilt it to spread the glaze evenly
24. I even poured some out that pooled at the corners and repoured that over the top
25. Let the cake sit for awhile for the glaze to set

title: mushroom marinara sauce  easy
steps:
1. Start by heating the oil over medium-low heat in a large pan
2. Slice mushrooms with egg slicer
3. When all the mushrooms are sliced , raise the heat on the pan to medium and add the mushrooms
4. Cook , stirring occasionally , for a few minutes until the mushrooms are tender and their juices released
5. Season the mushrooms with salt and pepper and reduce the heat to medium-low
6. Using the garlic press , place a clove of unpeeled garlic into the press and add right to the pan
7. Discard the peel , and continue with the remaining garlic
8. Stir in the pressed garlic and add a small pinch of red pepper flakes
9. Open the can of tomatoes and pour the liquid right into the pan
10. With a kitchen scissor , chop the tomatoes coarsely , right in the can , then , add them to the sauce
11. Add more seasoning , the bay leaf and dried basil , thyme and sugar , then simmer uncovered for about 15 minutes
12. When it is almost time to serve , add a little of the pasta cooking liquid to the sauce
13. Using the scissors , snip the parsley leaves into the sauce
14. I taste for seasoning , discard bay leaf and serve over cooked pasta

title: london sun martini
steps:
1. Stir or shake all ingredients together and pour into martini glass
2. Garnish with lemon twist

title: autumn carrot casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Place carrots in saucepan , add water to cover , bring to a boil and simmer for 10 minutes
3. Drain , place in casserole dish , and sprinkle with brown sugar
4. Melt butter and velveeta together and pour over carrots
5. Top with crushed ritz crackers
6. Bake for 30 minutes

title: quick crab quiche
steps:
1. Sprinkle crabmeat and cheese into pie shell
2. Beat together remaining ingredients
3. Pout over crabmeat and cheese
4. Bake in a preheated 357 degree oven 30-35 minutes until knife inserted in center comes out clean
5. Cool 5 minutes before serving

title: baileys irish cream truffles
steps:
1. Melt chocolate , baileys and heavy cream together over very low heat
2. Whisk in yolks , one at a time
3. Mixture will thicken
4. Whisk in butter
5. Refrigerate overnight , or until firm
6. With spoon make small balls
7. Roll in powdered sugar , cocoa , chopped nuts , sprinkles , etc

title: pan haggerty potatoes
steps:
1. Peel the potatoes , cut into very thin slices , rinse under cold water and then pat dry with paper kitchen towel
2. Over a medium-low heat , heat the oil in a non-stick pan which has a lid and which will fit under the grill
3. Add a third of the potatoes and spread in a single layer , then season to taste
4. Add half the onions , half the garlic , half the thyme and spread evenly
5. Top with one third of the cheese
6. Then layer the remaining potatoes , onions , garlic and thyme , finishing with a layer of potatoes
7. Cover the pan , cook over a medium heat for 30 minutes or until the base is golden brown , and the potatoes onion and garlic are tender
8. Preheat the grill to medium , top the potatoes with the remaining cheese , place the pan under the grill and grill until the cheese melts and the topping is golden
9. Garnish with parsley and serve hot
10. Serve as a heart main dish with a salad and steamed vegetables or as a side-dish with grilled chops or kebabs and a salad
11. If served as a side dish , it would probably serve 5-6

title: amazing crab rice cakes
steps:
1. Bring broth to a boil in small saucepan
2. Stir in rice
3. Cover
4. Remove from heat
5. Let stand 5 minutes
6. Fluff with fork
7. Beat eggs lightly in medium bowl
8. Add rice , crabmeat and cheese
9. Mix well
10. Divide and shape mixture into 8 patties
11. Let stand 5 minutes
12. Melt butter in large skillet on medium heat
13. Add patties
14. Cook 5 minutes on each side or until golden brown on both sides and heated through

title: orange coconut angel food cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Prepare angle food cake batter and use 1 cup water and 1 / 3 cup orange juice for liquids , instead of what the package indicates
3. Fold in 1 teaspoon of the orange extract
4. Pour into 10-inch ungreased tube pan and spread evenly
5. Break air pockets by cutting through the batter with a knife
6. Bake on lowest rack for 30 minutes , or until cake springs back when lightly touched in the center
7. Remove cake from oven
8. Invert pan and let cake cool completely up side down in pan
9. Loosen cake from sides of pan using a long spatula
10. Remove from pan
11. Slice cake horizontally into 4 equal layers using a serrated knife
12. Set layers aside
13. In a small bowl , prepare instant pudding mix according to package directions , using skim milk
14. Stir in remaining 1 teaspoon orange extract and orange rind
15. Fold in 1 cup coconut and 3 / 4 cup whipped topping
16. Chill at least 15 minutes
17. Place bottom cake layer on serving plate
18. Spread with 1 / 3 of pudding mixture
19. Repeat with remaining cake layers , ending with top cake layer
20. Spread remaining 2 1 / 2 cups whipped topping over top and sides of cake
21. Sprinkle with remaining 1 cup coconut
22. Store loosely covered in refrigerator until served
23. Recipe can be revised according to package directions of cake mix and pudding

title: monterey chicken ii
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Place chicken breasts between waxed paper and pound until thin
3. Lightly dust with flour and salt and pepper
4. Melt 1 / 4 cup butter or margarine in skillet
5. Saute chicken until brown
6. Remove and set aside
7. Melt remaining butter or margarine in same skillet
8. Saute onion , garlic and mushrooms until cooked
9. Stir in flour , celery salt , chicken broth and wine
10. Cook over low heat until thickened
11. Stir in avocado and 1 / 2 cup cheese
12. Blend to combine ingredients
13. Remove from heat
14. Arrange chicken in baking dish
15. Spoon avocado mixture over chicken and top with remaining cheese
16. Bake for 10-20 minutes or until chicken is cooked and cheese melts

title: chocolate black russian
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in an electric blender and blend at a low speed for a short length of time
2. Pour into a chilled champagne flute and serve

title: grammie bea s calf liver and onions
steps:
1. Fry up onions first in oil , and garlic , and salt , and pepper
2. Sometimes i put in green peppers too
3. When they are done , put them in a metal bowl , and cover , and set them aside while you cook the liver
4. To cook the liver , put 2-3 cups of flour on a large plate
5. Add garlic powder , seasoned salt and pepper , and mix well
6. Dredge the liver on both sides , with the flour
7. Turn the heat on high , and add a little more oil in the pan that the onions were cooked inches
8. Get the pan hot , then turn down to med
9. Add the liver to the pan , and cook on both sides , until cooked through
10. Add the onions on top , turn down the heat , and let sit for a few minutes for the flavors to meld
11. Serve liver smothered in onions and peppers
12. I dip in ketchup and voila !
13. Yum !
14. I buy only baby beef liver

title: spinach avocado orange toss
steps:
1. Put first 6 ingredients in a covered jar and shake
2. Mix remaining ingredients in a bowl and pour dressing all over
3. Toss lightly

title: hoisin and bourbon glazed pork tenderloin
steps:
1. Prepare grill-
2. Combine hoisin sauce and next 7 ingredients in a small bowl , stir with a whisk
3. Butterfly pork- slice pork lengthwise , cutting to , but not through , other side
4. Open halves , laying pork flat
5. Sprinkle pork with salt and pepper
6. If using wood chips , place on coals just before cooking meat
7. Place pork on grill that has been sprayed with cooking spray
8. Cook 5 minutes
9. Turn and baste top of pork with hoisin mixture
10. Cook 5 minutes
11. Turn and baste top of pork
12. Cook another five minutes
13. Check temperature with an instant read thermometer
14. If 155 degrees remove and let rest for five minutes
15. If it needs more cooking time , keep turning and basting every 2- 3 minutes until the right temperature
16. Do not overcook- it should be moist

title: el torito vinaigrette dressing
steps:
1. Combine all the ingredients in a blender jar and process until all ingredients are fully incorporated , takes a few minutes
2. Pour into a storage jar and refrigerate until ready to use

title: garlic lime chicken with olives
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
2. Cover a roasting pan with cooking spray
3. In a bowl combine chicken , onion , garlic , lime juice , molasses , worcestershire sauce , cumin , oregano , salt , and black pepper
4. Toss to coat
5. Transfer chicken to the roasting pan and pour put any of the remaining marinade over the chicjen
6. Arrange olives in pan
7. Roast 30 to 35 minutes , until chicken is cooked through

title: nancy duke s ratatouille
steps:
1. Saute' onion until transparent in olive oil in large skillet
2. Add remaining ingredients
3. Cover
4. Cook over medium heat 45 min
5. , stirring occasionally
6. A little water may be added if necessary
7. May be served with parmesan cheese on top
8. May be served cold
9. Serves 6

title: romantic wild mushroom and walnut conchiglie for two
steps:
1. Cook the conchiglie in a large saucepan of lightly salted , simmering water according to pack instructions or until al dente
2. Drain well and return to the pan
3. While the pasta is cooking , drain the jar of marinated mixed or wild mushrooms in oil and roughly chop with the walnut pieces
4. Place in a bowl and mix with finely grated parmesan and the half-fat crme frache
5. Season and add the chopped fresh italian flatleaf parsley
6. Toss through the pasta and heat gently for 1-2 minutes
7. Serve piping hot with more walnut pieces and plenty of shaved parmesan , as well as a big bowl of salad and ciabatta bread

title: mang ito
steps:
1. Muddle the mint and mango cubes in a mixing glass
2. Add vodka and ginger juice , then shake
3. Pour into a highball glass , and top with pineapple juice and sweetened ice tea

title: garlic lime chicken
steps:
1. Whisk together everything except the chicken in a large bowl
2. Add the chicken and toss to coat thoroughly
3. Let sit for 15 minutes
4. Toss again
5. Grill or broil quickly on medium-high heat until just barely done
6. Let sit for 5 minutes before serving
7. Freeze it in the marinade and grill when thawed

title: emily s rockin bagels
steps:
1. In a bowl add 2 tablespoons of yeast , 1 tablespoon of sugar and 1 1 / 2 cups of warm water
2. Stir mixture to help mix any clumps of yeast
3. Let mixture foam , about 10 minutes
4. Stir 4 cups flour and 1 tablespoon of salt gradually into yeast mixture
5. Mix until mixture becomes one large ball of dough
6. Kneed on lightly floured surface until dough has the constancy of a baby's bottom when you press a few fingers into it
7. Place dough in bowl at least twice it's size , cover the bowl with a tea towel and place someplace warm or without a draft
8. Let dough rise until doubled , about 1 hour
9. Fill a large pot with water to boil
10. Add 2 t sugar and 1 t salt to water
11. Punch down dough and form into a long narrow piece of dough
12. Cut dough into 12 pieces
13. Take dough in palm of hand and roll on counter or with other hand to form a ball , poke finger through ball of dough and twirl on finger until you have something that looks like a donut
14. I like to make my centers of bagels large to ensure there will be a hole after cooking
15. After forming all 12 bagels into donut like shapes , cover with a tea towel and let sit and rise for about 15 minutes
16. Place as many bagels in the pot of boiling water as you can , mine held 6
17. But make sure each bagel has enough room so they don't touch
18. Turn bagels over while boiling to ensure even cooking
19. Cook for about 2-4 minutes
20. Remove bagels from water and place on lined or sprayed cookie sheet , they won't spread much so leaving about 2 inches between each should be enough
21. Repeat process until all bagels are cooked
22. Whisk an egg and pinch of salt together in a bowl
23. Brush egg wash on the tops of each bagel
24. Bake for about 15 min at 450f
25. Keep a close eye on bagels , cooking time varies
26. Cook until browned on top
27. Variations:
28. Sprinkle on top sesame seeds , poppy seeds , garlic , onion , salt -- whatever your heart desires
29. You can also add goodies to your dough during the kneading process
30. I added sauted onion and poppy seeds
31. The bagel turned out a little more flat , but was still very good !

title: whole grain blackberry spice muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees farenheit
2. Line 17 muffin cups with paper liners
3. Combine flour , oats , brown sugar , baking powder , baking soda , salt , and apple-pie spice in a large bowl
4. Make a well in the center of the mixture
5. Combine milk , butter , vanilla , and egg in a small bowl
6. Pour into well in flour mixture , stirring until just moist
7. Gently stir in blackberries
8. Spoon 1 / 4 batter into each of 17 paper-lined muffin cups
9. Bake at 400 degrees fahrenheit for 16 minutes
10. Sprinkle muffing evenly with granulated sugar and return to oven to bake 3 minutes or until muffins spring back when touched lightly in center
11. Cool in pans for 10 minutes on wire racks

title: barley   bow tie pilaf
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. In a large skillet over moderately high heat , melt butter
3. Saute barely until lightly toasted , about 5 minutes
4. Slowly stir in broth and bring to a boil
5. Transfer to an ungreased 3 quart round casserole dish
6. Bake covered for 20 minutes
7. Stir in green onions , pasta , salt and pepper
8. Continue baking , covered , for 20 more minutes or until barley is tender
9. Uncover and bake for 5-10 more minutes , or until all liquid is absorbed

title: greek baklava   9x12 pan
steps:
1. In a small saucepan , combine syrup ingredients
2. Bring to a slow boil , stirring occasionally , until the sugar is dissolved
3. Cook over a medium heat for 10 minutes , until slightly thickened
4. Remove rinds and allow to come to room temperature before using
5. Combine nut filling ingredients together in a bowl
6. Brush bottom and sides of a 9x12 inch pan generously with melted butter
7. Place 8 phyllo sheets on bottom of pan , brushing each sheet with butter
8. Take an additional 4 sheets of phyllo and place in pan allowing sheets to drape over each of the 4 sides of the pan
9. Brush these with melted butter
10. Pour 1 / 2 the nut mixture into pan and spread evenly
11. Fold over the overlapping phyllo sheets , brushing each with butter , to envelope the nut mixture
12. Place 4 phyllo sheets over first nut layer , brushing each sheet with butter
13. Take an additional 4 sheets of phyllo and place in pan allowing sheets to drape over each of the 4 sides of the pan
14. Brush these with melted butter
15. Pour remaining nut mixture into pan and spread evenly
16. Fold over the overlapping phyllo sheets , brushing each with butter , to envelope the nut mixture
17. Top pastry with 8 phyllo sheets , brushing each sheet with butter
18. Tuck in the buttered phyllo neatly around
19. Score through top layers of pastry with a sharp knife making 3 strips lengthwise then cut 8 strips widthwise and then diagonal to form diamond shaped pieces
20. Pour remaining melted butter over pastry and lightly sprinkle some water on top too
21. Bake pastry in a 325 degree oven for 30 - 40 minutes , until nicely golden brown
22. Allow to cool for 5 minutes
23. Carefully spoon cool syrup over pastry
24. Allow to stand overnight
25. Cut through the scored pieces and serve

title: mixed greens with honey lime dressing
steps:
1. Whisk first 4 ingredients in a small bowl to blend , season dressing with salt and pepper
2. Transfer 2 tablespoons dressing to another smaller bowl
3. Mix in onions
4. Let onion and remaiming dressing stand at least 1 hour and up to 3 hours
5. Toss onion mixture occasionally
6. Mix lettuces , tomatoes , and onion mixture in bowl
7. Toss with dressing , serve

title: creamy holiday corn
steps:
1. Drain liquid from corn , set liquid aside
2. Place corn and cream cheese in a pan over medium-low heat
3. Cook until cream cheese is melted , stirring frequently
4. Do not let cream cheese burn
5. If mixture seems clumpy , add some of the corn juice back into the mixture
6. Stir in pimentos until they are heated
7. Serve as desired

title: muesli   grain free  raw
steps: 1. Mix ingredients together and serve with raw milk or nut milk

title: slow cooker cilantro lime chicken tacos
steps:
1. In a slow cooker , mix salsa , taco seasoning , lime juice and cilantro
2. Add chicken
3. Cook on low for 8-10 hours
4. Remove chicken and shred
5. Serve with a whole wheat tortilla and favorite toppings

title: coconut macadamia nut pie
steps:
1. Preheat over 425 degrees
2. Fit piecrust into a 9 inch pieplate according to package directions
3. Fold edges under and crimp
4. Freeze 15 minutes
5. Bake 6 -8 minutes or until golden
6. Cool on a wire rack
7. Whisk together sugar and next 5 ingredients
8. Stir in nuts and coconut
9. Pour into prepared piecrust
10. Lower oven temperature to 350 degrees and bake 55-60 minutes
11. Cool on wire rack

title: dad s tia maria
steps:
1. Steep 1 3 / 4 ounces of instant coffee in 4 cups of boiling water
2. Make a syrup by putting 6 cups of sugar in 5 cups of boiling water- allow to cool- then add 2 ounces of pure vanilla extract
3. Mix syrup with coffee mixture then add 1 3 / 4 pints of 190 proof ethyl alcohol
4. Let cool and enjoy !

title: chicken parm meatball subs
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 425f
2. Place the chicken in a bowl and season it with the grill seasoning
3. Add the egg , half of the grated cheese , bread crumbs , parsley , and a big drizzle of the olive oil
4. Combine the mixture and form 12 large meatballs , placing them on a baking sheet
5. Squish the balls to flatten them a bit - like mini oval meatloaves
6. Be careful not to form the balls wider than your bread
7. The flattened balls will stay put on your sub - no roll-aways ! bake the meatballs for 15 minutes , or until golden and firm
8. Switch the broiler on
9. While the chicken balls bake , heat a medium skillet over medium heat
10. Add the 3 tablespoons of olive oil and the garlic and cook them for 5 minutes
11. Discard the garlic , add the red pepper flakes and the tomatoes , and stir in the chicken stock
12. Season the sauce with salt and pepper and simmer for 10 minutes
13. Adjust the seasonings and stir in the basil
14. Use a thin spatula to loosen the chicken balls from the baking sheet and add them to the sauce , turning the meatballs to coat
15. Cut the sub rolls , making the bottom a little deeper than the top
16. Hollow out a little of the bread and lightly toast the sub rolls under the broiler
17. Fill the bottoms of the breads with the sauced meatballs
18. Combine the provolone and the remaining parmesan cheese
19. Cover the meatballs with cheese and return to the broiler to melt the cheese until it's golden
20. Set the roll tops in place
21. Pour any leftover sauce into a bowl and serve at the table for dipping

title: easy italian chicken and potatoes
steps:
1. Rinse chicken and pat dry , skin if you prefer
2. Wash and cut potatoes and tomatoes into bite-sized chunks
3. Cut onion into wedges
4. Combine all ingredients in 9x13 baking dish
5. Pour olive oil over all
6. Sprinkle italian seasoning evenly over all
7. Mix to ensure that all pieces are coated
8. Bake uncovered in 450 degree oven , 1 hour , or until chicken is cooked through and potatoes are fork tender
9. Variation: i have also added one large zucchini cut into bite sized chunks before baking
10. Delicious in the summer !

title: millet fruit squares   delicious and allergy free
steps:
1. Cook millet for about 45 minutes
2. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
3. Stir in rest of crust ingredients
4. Spread half of this mixture into an oiled pan
5. Bake for about 10 minutes
6. While millet is cooking , combine fruit filling ingredients in sauce pan , bring to a boil , then simmer on low for 30-45 minutes
7. Spread this fruit mixture over the first layer of millet in the pan
8. Add the other half of the millet mixture over top the fruit mixture
9. Bake for about 20 minutes at 350f until dryer and firm
10. Cool and chill
11. Keeps 6-8 days in fridge

title: creamed spinach
steps:
1. Heat the spinach and the water in a saucepan over high heat
2. Melt the butter in a skillet on medium heat and saute onions
3. Take the spinach off of the heat and strain in a mesh colander pressing the spinach to drain all of the water
4. Set aside
5. Cook the onions until translucent , about 10 minutes
6. Add the spinach , the garlic and continue sauteing for 1 minute
7. Add the half and half and brink to a low boil
8. Add the parmesan cheese and stir to incorporate
9. Once the spinach has come to a low boil again add the monterry jack cheese and stir to incorporate
10. Salt and pepper to taste
11. Cook on a low boil for an additional 2 minutes
12. If the mixture gets too thick you can add half and half a tablespoon at a time until the spinach is the consistency you like
13. Enjoy !

title: mexican tortilla casserole
steps:
1. Brown and drain meat
2. Stir in onion , bell peppers , chilies , and season mix
3. Cook until veggies are slightly tender
4. Blend salsa in blender and pour 1 / 2 cup on bottom of a greased 9x13-inch baking dish
5. Cover with 5 tortillas , spread with 1 / 2 of meat mix and 1 / 2 more salsa , sprinkle with 1 cup of cheese and layer rest of ingredients
6. Bake for 20 minutes at 350f or until top is golden brown
7. Top with lettuce , sour cream tomatoes , whatever you like
8. Enjoy

title: white christmas holiday eggnog fudge
steps:
1. Bring the sugar , butter and eggnog to a full boil in a heavy medium-size saucepan
2. Continue to boil for 8 to 10 minutes over medium heat , or 234f on a candy thermometer , stirring constantly to prevent scorching
3. Remove from heat and stir in the white chocolate chips and the grated nutmeg , stirring until the chocolate is melted
4. Add marshmallow creme and the rum or rum extract
5. Beat until well blended
6. Pour into a buttered 8 or 9-inch square pan
7. Cool at room temperature , then cut into squares
8. Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator
9. May be frozen for up to three weeks

title: parmesan knots
steps:
1. Combine oil , cheese , parsley , oregano , garlic powder and pepper
2. Set aside
3. Cut each biscuit in half
4. Roll each portion into a 6 inch rope
5. Tie in a loose knot
6. Place on greased baking sheets
7. Bake at 450 degrees for 6-8 minutes or until golden brown
8. Immediately brush with the parmesan mixture , then brush again
9. Serve warm or freeze for up to 2 months
10. To use frozen rolls: bake at 350 degrees for 6-8 minutes or until heated through

title: moroccan chocolate cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Grease and line a 9 inch round cake tin about 3 inches deep
3. Whisk the egg whites until stiff while adding the superfine sugar and flour a bit at a time
4. Fold in the choclate , dates , and almonds
5. Spoon mixture into the prepared cake tin
6. Bake the cake for 15 minutes , until the cake rises , then reduce temperature to 200 degrees and cook for a further 10 minutes to cook the center
7. Cool slightly , then dust with confectioners' sgar
8. To serve , cut into wedges and drizzle with chcolate sauce
9. Garnish with strawberries , and seve with ice cream

title: asian chicken salad with glass noodles
steps:
1. Cover noodles with boiling water and let sit 5-8 minutes , or until cooked
2. Drain and rinse under cold water
3. Steam chicken for 15 minutes , then shred into small pieces
4. Place noodles , chicken , onions , carrots , cucumber , bean sprouts , mint and cilantro into large bowl
5. Mix together chili sauce , lime juice and sesame oil then pour over noodle mixture and toss well
6. Top with toasted sesame seeds

title: honey and mustard pork skewers
steps:
1. Thread the onion , pepper and meat alternately onto the skewers and lay them in a shallow dish
2. Mix together the oil , garlic , oregano , honey and mustard and season with salt and freshly ground black pepper
3. Pour the mixture over the meat and leave it to marinate for half an hour or so
4. Remove the skewers from the marinade and broil or grill until the meat is cooked through
5. Serve immediately

title: white and green pizza
steps:
1. Heat oven to 450 degrees
2. Meanwhile , put spinach in a microwave-safe casserole dish
3. Season to taste , and sprinkle with water
4. Cover with plastic wrap , and pierce to vent
5. Microwave on high for 2 minutes
6. Drain well
7. Mix ricotta and garlic powder in a small bowl
8. Place the pizza crusts on an ungreased baking sheet , and spread half the ricotta mixture on each one
9. Top each pizza with cooked spinach , mozzarella , and parmesan
10. Drizzle with olive oil
11. Bake for 10 minutes , or until the cheese is melted
12. Cool slightly and cut each pizza in half to serve
13. How kid can help: sprinkle water on spinach
14. Mix ricotta and garlic powder , put topping on pizza
15. Nutrition: 352 calories , 13 g
16. Fat

title: yet  another broccoli rice casserole   husband approved
steps:
1. Very slightly steam broccoli
2. Place in greased casserole dish
3. Mix rest of ingredients , except topping , and pour over broccoli
4. Stir gently until well mixed
5. Top with additional cheese , if desired
6. Bake in 350 f oven for 30-35 minutes

title: papou s fasoverakia  green beans
steps:
1. Use a large stock pot or dutch oven , sautee onions over medium heat with the salt and pepper in 1 / 4 cup olive oil until onions just begin to soften- about 2-3 minutes
2. Add garlic and potatoes and stir
3. Add the tomato sauce and water
4. Add the green beans last , stir all together until well mixed
5. Drizzle the remaining 1 / 4 cup of olive oil on top
6. Cook over medium -low heat , stirring every 15 minutes or so , until potatoes are fork tender and beans are soft
7. Add additional salt and pepper to taste
8. This usually takes and hour and a half but i often lower the heat and leave the beans on for 2+ hours
9. The beans are even better the next day- get out your bread , load up a bowl and enjoy yourself ! kali orexi !

title: shakuti
steps:
1. Cut chicken into serviing pieces
2. Rinse and pat dry with peper towels
3. Heat ghee in large frying pan , add chicken and fry until golden brown , about 6 to 8 minutes
4. Remove from pan and drain on paper towels
5. Add spices , garlic and onion and fry until onion has softened , about 6-8 minutes
6. Stir in tomato paste and cook for 1 minute
7. Add chicken , coconut milk , stock and desiccated coconut , mix well and bring to the boil
8. Place lid on pan , lower heat and simmer for 40 minutes or until chicken is almost tender
9. Uncover pan and simmer 10 more minutes or until sauce is thick and dry

title: spanakorizo
steps:
1. Chop spinach roughly
2. Heat oil and saute onion for 10 minutes add rice and spinach and tomato paste
3. Saute 5 minutes
4. Add water and stock cube and seasoning , mix well
5. Bring to boil and turn down heat and cook for 20mins or until rice is soft
6. Serve

title: light twice baked potatoes
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400 degrees
2. Prick potatoes with fork to allow steam to escape bake for 60 to 75 minutes or until fork tender
3. Reduce oven temperature to degrees
4. Cut potatoes in half lengthwise
5. Let cool about 15 minutes
6. Using spoon , scoop out inside of potatoes , leaving a shell
7. Set aside shells
8. In large mixer bowl , combine potatoes , sour cream , butter , 1 t chives , salt an pepper
9. Beat at medium speed until smooth
10. Shells with potato mixture
11. Place on coo kie sheet
12. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes or until heated through
13. Sprinkle with chopped chives and paprika if desired

title: bill smith s atlantic beach pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Crush crackers finely but not to dust
3. Use food processor or your hands
4. Add sugar , then knead in butter until crumbs hold together like dough
5. Press into 8" pie pan
6. Chill 15 minutes , then bake 18 minute or until crust colors a little
7. While crust is cooling , beat egg yolks into milk , then beat in citrus juice until completely combined
8. Pour into shell and bake 16 minutes until filling has set
9. Chill completely before slicing
10. Serve with fresh whipped cream and a sprinkling of sea salt

title: rajun cajun omelette
steps:
1. In a small frying pan add your sausage , ham , onions , and bell peppers
2. Saute for about 3-4 minutes
3. You shouldn't need any butter or oil due to the fat content in your sausage
4. Once onions and bell peppers just start to soften add your garlic , take off heat and set aside
5. Heat butter and peanut oil in omelette pan on high
6. Whisk the eggs and water together until fluffy and combined
7. Once butter has completely melted into oil swirl butter and oil around to coat entire pan
8. Add your eggs to hot pan
9. Turn temp to med-high and let cook about 1 minute or until edges begin to look cooked
10. Carefully push cooked edges towards the middle using a spatula
11. You want to allow the uncooked eggs to move to the edge and coat the bottom of the pan
12. Shake a little and make sure eggs are not sticking
13. Turn heat to med
14. Once eggs look mainly cooked with very little rawness on the top you'll want to sprinkle lightly with creole seaoning , add your ham , sausage , onions , bell pepper , garlic and cheese
15. Flip half omelette over and onto itself and allow to cook for about 2 minutes or until cheese is fully melted
16. Garnish with fresh parsley and serve with a bottle of louisiana hot sauce on the side
17. I usually make these one at a time , even when i'm entertaining
18. If you really want to add some pow then i suggest serving with creole sauce over the top
19. But really good with or without it
20. If serving a large group you can 5x the recipe and combine ingredients and pour into a 8x 12x glass baking dish and bake for 40 minutes at 350f be sure to place a small oven safe bowl filled with water inside of the oven with the dish while baking
21. Let sit for at least 10 minutes before serving
22. Should withstand the toothpick check by poking middle with toothpick and coming out clean by the 40 minutes
23. If not clean then let bake another 5-10 minutes or until done in middle

title: fresh fruit salsa with cinnamon sugar chips
steps:
1. Combine apples , kiwi , strawberries , orange juice , zest , brown sugar , and apple jelly together
2. Cover and refrigerate
3. Place the tortilla wedges on a non greased baking sheet and sprinkle with desired amount of cinnamon and sugar
4. Bake the tortilla wedges at 325 degrees until warm
5. Remove from oven and let cool
6. Serve with fruit salsa

title: low fat papaya chicken breasts
steps:
1. Using a food processor , metal blade , pulse the garlic and shallot until chopped add papaya and pulse until chopped
2. Add remaining ingredients , except chicken , puree until smoothe
3. Put chicken large zip lock bag and pour the marinade over it
4. Refrigerate , turn chicken frequently to coat it evenly
5. Marinate for at least 4 hours or up to a day
6. Take chicken out of the marinade
7. Place breasts into a dutch oven or heavy casserole , without lid
8. Return the marinade onto the chicken , coating evenly with approximately a 1 / 4 inch on each breast
9. Place in 350f oven and bake until done approximately 30 minutes

title: mushroom baked sole
steps:
1. Saut onion , parsley , and mushrooms in 3 tablespoons of the margarine , stirring constantly until onions are soft
2. Place half the fillets in a greased baking dish
3. Sprinkle lightly with pepper , and spread sauted mixture evenly over fish
4. Top with remaining fillets , season with pepper , pour wine over all and dot with remaining margarine
5. Bake at 350 degrees f
6. , uncovered , for 15 minutes
7. Remove from oven and drain , reserving the pan liquid
8. In a small saucepan , combine flour and milk
9. Add the reserved pan liquid and cook , stirring constantly , until thickened
10. Pour over the fish and bake 5 minutes longer
11. Sprinkle with paprika and parsley

title: banana french toast
steps:
1. Place all ingredients except bread in a blender and mix well
2. Pour batter into a shallow dish
3. Dip each bread slice into batter for several seconds , coating both sides
4. Place bread in a buttered non stick skillet and cook over medium heat until golden on both sides

title: spicy peanut lamb chops
steps:
1. Preheat grill to medium high heat
2. Combine sauce ingredients and brush over both sides of lamb chops
3. Heat remaining sauce and bring to a simmer
4. Grill the chops about 5-7 minutes per side for medium
5. Serve with remaining sauce

title: best boiled ham and cabbage
steps:
1. Remove the ham from its wrappings
2. Cut off the skin and make sure you remove the plastic thing that covers the end of the bone
3. Stud the ham with the whole cloves , distributing them evenly over the surface
4. Put ham and onions into a very large pot and cover with cold water
5. Its important to use cold water because it draws the excess salt out of the meat and makes a more flavorful broth
6. Bring to a boil slowly over medium heat
7. Reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes
8. Add all the veggies except the cabbage
9. Raise heat and bring to a boil again
10. Reduce heat and simmer another 15 minutes or until the largest potatoes are nearly cooked
11. Add the cabbage wedges
12. Raise heat and bring to a boil
13. Simmer another 10-20 minutes until cabbage is cooked but not mushy
14. Use a large , slotted , serving spoon to remove all the veggies to a large serving dish
15. Lift ham onto a platter and carve off a suitable number of servings for the meal
16. Serve each person a slice of ham and a portion of each vegetable
17. Grind black pepper over the plate and offer butter for the potatoes and other roots if desired

title: quick tomato and beef macaroni and cheese
steps:
1. Brown ground beef and onion , drain
2. Add salt , pepper , tomatoes , and water
3. And bring to boil
4. Stir in macaroni and cover and simmer for 10 minutes or until macaroni is tender
5. Stir in cheese and garnish with sour cream if desired

title: grandma love s biscuits
steps:
1. Heat oven to 425f
2. Sift together into a bowl the flour , sugar , baking powder , salt , and cream of tartar
3. Add the butter or margarine
4. With a fork or a pastry blender cut the butter in util the mixture resembles coarse meal
5. Stir in the milk and the egg , just until combined
6. Turn the dough onto a floured board and knead lightly 4 or 5 strokes
7. Roll or pat into a 1 / 2-3 / 4-inch thick round
8. Cut with a biscuit cutter and place on an ungreased baking sheet , farther apart if you like crispy edges , and closer together if you like them soft
9. Bake at 425f for 10-15 minutes

title: cream of potato and ham soup
steps:
1. In large dutch oven , cook vegetables in salted water until tender
2. Do not drain
3. Meanwhile , in a saucepan , melt butter
4. Whisk in flour and salt
5. Cook for 1 minute
6. Gradually stir in milk and cheese
7. Cook until cheese is melted and mixture is thickened
8. Fold in ham
9. Stir into vegetable mixture
10. Simmer until ready to serve

title: pecan crusted chicken tenders over salad
steps:
1. Heat 1 to 2 inches oil over medium heat in a large skillet
2. Season chicken tenders with salt and pepper
3. Set out 3 shallow dishes
4. Place flour in one
5. Eggs beaten with milk in a second
6. In the third dish , combine the bread crumbs , ground pecans , nutmeg , and orange zest
7. In batches , coat tenders in flour , then egg , then bread crumb / pecan mixture
8. Fry tenders in small batches , 6-7 minutes , and drain them on paper towels
9. For dressing: combine maple syrup , barbecue sauce , and orange juice
10. Whisk in oil and set aside while cooking chicken
11. In a large bowl , combine romaine , radishes , and scallions
12. Toss with of the dressing
13. Season with salt and pepper to taste
14. Top with pecan-crusted chicken tenders and drizzle remaining dressing over the top

title: blender salsa
steps:
1. In a small pan , simmer tomatoes and chiles for 10 minutes
2. Drain
3. Place in a blender and add remaining ingredients
4. Blend until smooth

title: garden chowder
steps:
1. In a stock pot , saute green pepper and onion in butter until tender
2. Add vegetables , broth , salt , and pepper and bring to a boil
3. Reduce heat , cover and simmer 20 minutes
4. Combine flour and milk and stir slowly into soup
5. Allow to thicken at a low temperature
6. Add spices , and stir in cheddar until melted
7. Serve immediately or allow to cool and store in the freezer for oamc

title: fresh greens  avocado with a lime vinaigrette
steps:
1. Salad -- in a large bowl , mix up the greens
2. Add the onion , avacado , cilantro , beans , salt and pepper and cherry tomatoes
3. Dressing -- mix all the dressing ingredients in a measuring cup and stir well
4. Finish -- just toss the salad dressing over the salad and that simple
5. A great unique flavor
6. Don't be afraid to make this a whole dinner
7. Add some rotisserie chicken , or grilled shrimp , anything
8. Just have fun with it
9. You can even top this with some good mexican shredded cheese
10. It is a great salad
11. Even chopped up fresh fried tortillas or even just corn chips for a little crunch

title: peanut butter   jelly filled spiders
steps:
1. Prepare two baking sheets with cooking spray
2. Set aside
3. In a small bowl , combine peanut butter and jam
4. Set aside
5. Divide dough into sixteen equal pieces
6. It takes two pieces of dough to make one spider
7. To make spider , take one piece of dough , on a lightly floured surface , divide this piece into four equal pieces for spider's legs
8. Roll each of these pieces into thin ropes , each being eight inches long
9. Lay each of these ropes , parallel and equal in length to each other , half inch apart onto prepared baking sheet
10. For the spider's body , divide a second piece of dough , one twice as large as the other
11. On a floured surface , pat larger piece of dough with the palm of your hand to flatten
12. Place two teaspoons peanut butter and jam mixture onto center of circle
13. Bring ends of dough up together and seal seams
14. Gently roll this piece of dough into a ball
15. Set aside
16. Roll smaller piece of dough in a round ball
17. Place peanut butter filled body and head centered on top of the four ropes of dough
18. Finish with remaining pieces of dough to make eight spiders
19. Each spider should have eight legs
20. Let rise until doubled in size , one hour
21. Bake in a 375 degree oven for ten minutes , or until golden brown

title: rachael ray s baby back ribs with jammy glaze
steps:
1. Place ribs in extra large pot
2. Cover with water and boil for 30 minutes
3. Remove from pot and pat dry
4. Stir together chili powder , salt and pepper and rub the mixture all over the ribs
5. Place on grill over medium to medium low heat , meaty side up , and cook 10 to 15 minutes
6. While ribs are on the grill , in a small saucepan , combine the jam , ketchup , steak sauce and vinegar
7. Cook over medium heat , stirring often , until the glaze comes to a boil , about 5 minutes
8. Remove from heat and stir in the hot sauce
9. Brush glaze on the ribs and cook for 10 to 15 minutes longer until ribs are well done and glazed
10. Slice into individual ribs

title: mountain cookies
steps:
1. In a large mixing bowl , cream butter , sugar and vanilla
2. Combine flour and salt
3. Gradually add to the creamed mixture and mix well
4. Shape into 1-in
5. Balls
6. Place 2 inches apart on ungreased baking sheets
7. Make a deep indentation in the center of each cookie
8. Bake at 350 for 10-12 minutes or until the edges just start to brown
9. Remove to wire racks to cool completely
10. For the filling , in a large mixing beat cream cheese , sugar , flour and vanilla
11. Add pecans and coconut
12. Mix well
13. Spoon 1 / 2 teaspoon into each cookie
14. For topping , heat chocolate chips , butter and water in a small saucepan until melted
15. Stir in sugar
16. Drizzle over cookies

title: best smoked salmon brine ala poppie
steps:
1. Dissolve the salt and sugar in apple cider or juice , then add more apple cider / juice to 'cover' the fish
2. Yes , they float , it's okay , just try to turn them if you can now and again
3. Let them soak for about 6 hours
4. Drain and rinse them
5. Here's the important part: dry them off and leave them uncovered in the fridge for at least 4 hours , more hours the better
6. This time allows the brined fish to form a "pellicle" on the brined part which takes the smoke flavor
7. Now smoke the fish for whatever you usually do
8. Yum

title: hot pink fruit dip
steps:
1. Place the raspberries and cream cheese in a blender or food processor , and puree until uniform
2. Transfer to a bowl
3. Add the yogurt and lemon juice and whisk until it is all one color
4. Pour the dip into a serving bowl and enjoy with your favorite fruit for dipping !

title: shrimp salsa
steps:
1. In a medium nonmetallic bowl combine all ingredients
2. Refrigerate covered at least one hour to allow flavors to blend

title: apricot rosemary jam
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine apricots , rosemary and sugar
2. Mix well and let sit about 30 minutes until juices form at the bottom of the bowl
3. Transfer the mixture , with juices , to a large pot and heat over medium high
4. Once mixture begins to boil , reduce heat to medium and cook , while stirring often , until apricots are soft and begin to lose their shape , about 30 minutes , or more
5. Add a little water if mixture starts sticking
6. Press apricots through a ricer or fine mesh strainer and return to pot
7. Discard solids
8. Taste for sweetness and add sugar if needed
9. Cook jam a few minutes more to dissolve any added sugar
10. While still hot , ladle jam into hot , sterilized canning jars , leaving about 1 / 4 inch head space at the top
11. Remove air bubbles by running a nonmetallic utensil or skewer between the jar and the jam
12. Top with new , clean lids , close tightly , and let come to room temperature
13. Check seal by pressing down in center of lid , it should not spring up
14. Process any jars that have not sealed in a hot water bath for 15 minutes
15. Retest
16. Have ready seven 8-ounce canning jars with 2-piece lids
17. Immerse the pint jars in the canning kettle
18. Place the rings and lids in a separate small saucepan and cover them with hot water
19. Leave the jars and lids immersed while you cook the jam

title: a different espresso martini
steps:
1. Shake all ingredients in a shaker of ice
2. Pour into a chilled martini glass
3. Garnish with three floating espresso beans
4. Enjoy !
5. )

title: bbq piggie bites
steps:
1. Cut the ribs into 3 / 4-inch pieces
2. In large skillet over medium-high heat , cook and stir pork cubes in oil 4-5 minutes or until pork is no longer pink
3. Remove excess fat from skillet
4. Reduce heat to low
5. Add remaining ingredients to skillet , stirring to coat pork cubes
6. Cover and cook 1 minute or until thoroughly heated
7. Transfer to warm serving dish
8. Serve with toothpicks

title: grandmas hamburger pie with cornbread topping
steps:
1. Brown hamburger , onion and green peppers in pan
2. Drain the grease
3. Stir in corn and tomatoes and add salt and pepper to taste
4. Pour into a 9x13-inch pan
5. Mix cornbread topping and pour over hamburger mixture
6. Bake at 425 for 35-45 minute

title: turkish coffee
steps:
1. Measure water and sugar in small saucepan
2. Dissolve the sugar in the water by bringing the mixture to a boil stirring constantly
3. Remove from heat and stir in coffee
4. Return to heat and bring slowly back to a boil
5. When the coffee begins to rise up remove from heat
6. When foaming recedes return to heat and bring back to a boil
7. Repeat this procedure three times
8. The goal is to get maximum coffee flavor without over boiling
9. There should be a thick sediment on the bottom and a brown froth on the top
10. Best way to drink: serve the coffee by pouring gradually into each cup to evenly distribute the sediment

title: orange juice cake
steps:
1. Heat oven to 325
2. Spray bundt pan with non-stick spray then pour 1 cup of pecans in the pan
3. Mix cake mix , 4 eggs , 1 / 2 cup of vegetable oil , 1 cup of orange juice , 1 box of vanilla pudding & a splash of vanilla extract
4. Mix well with whisk
5. Pour mixture in pan over the pecans
6. Put into oven & cook for about 50 - 60 minutes
7. While it's cookin' ! make the glaze
8. Take a small pot , and put in 1 stick of butter , 1 / 2 cup of orange juice , 12 cup of sugar
9. Bring to a boil & boil for 2 minutes
10. Once the cake comes out , let it cool until it's ready to be flipped over
11. Then flip it over , poke hole around top of the cake , and pour the glaze over the top
12. Eat ! & enjoy !

title: zucchini cake
steps:
1. Mix dry ingredients
2. Combine oil and eggs with vanilla
3. Add to dry ingredients , mix well
4. Add zucchini , stir until combined well
5. Fold in walnuts
6. Place in greased 13x9 baking pan
7. Bake at 350 for 40 minutes , or until pick comes out clean

title: chip   dip burgers
steps:
1. Preheat grill
2. In a medium bowl , combine beef , 1 / 4 cup crushed potato chips , 1 / 4 cup sour cream dip and relish
3. Mix very well
4. Shape mixture into 2 patties
5. Grill patties until done as desired

title: cranberry pudding
steps:
1. Sift together sugar , flour and baking powder
2. Add milk and cranberries
3. Pour into a shallow pan , 7 1 / 2 x 11 inch
4. Bake at 350 degrees for 25 minutes
5. Sauce: mix all ingredients together and cook in a double boiler for 10 minutes
6. Pour hot sauce over slices of pudding as you serve it
7. Serve hot

title: old fashioned sour cream fudge cake
steps:
1. Cake: preheat oven to 350 degf
2. Sift tog
3. Flour , baking soda and salt , set aside
4. Cream butter , then add brown sugar and continue beating for 5 minutes
5. Add eggs , one at a time , beating well after each addition
6. Add vanilla and chocolate
7. Alternately blend in flour mixture and sour cream , 1 / 3 at a time on low speed of electric mixer
8. Add boiling water , blending well
9. Pour into 2 greased and floured 9" round layer cake pans
10. Bake at 350 degf for 35- 40 minutes or until cake tester inserted in centre comes out clean
11. Cool in pans for 10 minutes
12. Remove and finish cooling on racks
13. Frosting: combine chocolate , icing sugar , butter , hot water and egg
14. Blend
15. Then beat at medium speed of electric mixer for 2 minutes
16. Chill until of spreading consistency
17. Carefully ice cake
18. You may not want to use the above icing due to the raw egg , so i would suggest making a seven minutes frosting

title: creamy beef and onions
steps:
1. In a large heavy skillet , cook meat , mushrooms , onions and garlic , until meat is no longer pink and onions are tender
2. Drain well
3. In a bowl , mix together gravy , sour cream , worcestershire sauce , thyme , pepper and salt
4. Stir into meat mixture
5. Heat until bubbly

title: maple sugar cookies
steps:
1. Sift first three ingredients together
2. Cream butter and sugar together
3. Add eggs , lemon extract and milk
4. Add flour mixture and blend well
5. Refrigerate about 1 / 2 hour
6. Preheat oven to 350f and lightly grease cookie sheets
7. Roll dough 1 / 4" thick and dust with maple sugar
8. Cut into attractive shapes with cookie cutters , place on prepared cookie sheets and bake about 15 minutes

title: chicken breast with tomato sauce and mozzarella
steps:
1. Grease a 13 x 9-inch baking pan
2. In a shallow dish mix together the breadcrumbs with the next 5 ingredients
3. In another small shallow dish whisk the eggs
4. Heat oil in a skillet over medium-high heat
5. Dip the breasts first in the egg and then coat in the breadcrumbs mixture
6. Place in oil and cook on both sides until browned
7. Place the browned breasts single layer in the greased casserole dish
8. At this point you can cool and refrigerate until ready to bake
9. Spread about 1 / 4 to 1 / 3 cup the marinara sauce over the browned breasts
10. Set oven to 350 degrees , oven rack set to bottom position
11. Bake for about 35 for smaller thin breasts and 45 minutes for thicker-sized breasts or until the chicken is done
12. Remove the chicken and place 1 or 2 slices of mozzeralla cheese on top of each cooked breast then return to oven for anout 4-5 minutes or until cheese is hot and bubbly or place under the broiler to melt cheese
13. Delicious

title: grilled cajun chicken salad
steps:
1. 1
2. For dressing , in a screw-top jar combine cider vinegar , 3 tablespoons of the salad oil , the water , sugar , thyme , 1 / 4 teaspoon of the onion powder , 1 / 4 teaspoon of the cayenne pepper , the garlic powder , and the mustard
3. Cover and shake well
4. Chill until serving time
5. 2
6. In a small bowl combine remaining 1 tablespoon salad oil , remaining 1 teaspoon onion powder , remaining 1 / 4 teaspoon cayenne pepper , the black pepper , and salt
7. Brush all of the oil mixture on the chicken
8. 3
9. Place chicken on the rack of an uncovered grill directly over medium coals
10. Grill for 12 to 15 minutes or until chicken is tender and no longer pink , turning once halfway through grilling time
11. 4
12. To serve , in a large serving bowl combine salad greens , carrot , red sweet pepper , and green onion
13. Cut chicken into bite-size pieces
14. Add chicken and dressing to salad
15. Toss to coat

title: basmati and nut pilaf
steps:
1. Rinserice before cooking put rice in large bowl of cold water and swill around , pouring out cloudy water as needed
2. Leave to soak for 30 min in remaining rinsing water
3. In lrg pan , fry onion , garlic , and carrot in oil
4. Stir in rice and spices and cook 1-2 minutes , so grains are coated in oil
5. Pour in stock or water , add bay leaf , and season well
6. Bring to boil
7. Cover and simmer gently for 10 minutes
8. Remove from heat without lifting lid
9. Leave for 5 minutes
10. If rice is cooked , there will be small steam holes in the center
11. Discard bay leaf / cardamom pods
12. Stir in nuts and check seasoning
13. Scatter parsley over mixture
14. Can be reheated !

title: rye crackers
steps:
1. Mix together
2. Roll out thinly on floured surface
3. Cut into desired shapes
4. Bake on cookie sheets at 375 degrees for about 30 minutes

title: ham and onion muffins
steps:
1. Cook ham and onions with sauce and pepper in microwave on high , stirring occasionally until onions are wilted
2. Sift flour into a mixing bowl and make a well in the center
3. Whisk egg , milk , oil and salt together and pour into flour
4. Mix gently until partially combined
5. Add in ham mixture and the rest of the ingredients
6. Fold through until smooth
7. Spoon into muffin tray and bake in 350 degree oven for approximately 30-45 minutes or until tops brown and skewer comes out clean
8. Serve with cream cheese and dashes of black pepper
9. Or however you wish !

title: chipotle cheddar sticks
steps:
1. In blender or mini food processor , pure together tomato paste , chipotle pepper , abodo sauce and green onions
2. Spread scant teaspoonful tomato mixture over each slice of bread
3. Top half with cheese
4. Top with remaining bread slices , tomato side down
5. Spread butter on tops and bottoms
6. Arrange sandwiches on large rimmed baking sheet
7. Broil , turning once , until golden and crisp , about 4 minutes
8. Cut lengthwise into 1-inch wide sticks

title: matcha green tea smoothie or iced latte
steps:
1. Mix 1 / 2 tsp green tea powder in 2 ounces of hot water in a bowl
2. Stir with a whisk until completely dissolved
3. Stir in 3 teaspoons of sugar or sugar substitute
4. Add in 4 ounces of milk and stir
5. Add 1 teaspoon of vanilla syrup , such as torani or davinci brands
6. Add ice cubes and blend in a blender until smooth
7. Enjoy !

title: whipped cream biscuits
steps:
1. Mix ingredients together with a fork just until moistened
2. Drop by tablespoons onto sprayed cookie sheet
3. Bake in preheated oven at 450 degrees for 10- 12 minutes

title: simply marinated cucumbers
steps:
1. Place cucumbers and scallions in a large bowl
2. In a seperate bowl , whisk together red wine vinegar , sugar , salt , pepper , and dill
3. Pour over the cucumber / scallion mixture
4. Toss to coat evenly
5. Chill for about 2 hours
6. Toss again before serving

title: hot liverwurst toast with tomatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Remove the liverwurst from its casing and place into a large mixing bowl
3. Mix together well with the cracked peppercorns , a little marjoram , chopped parlsey to taste , the egg yolk , and the brandy
4. Set aside
5. Core the apple , then slice into 4 thick apple rings - they should resemble canned pineapple rings
6. Heat butter in a skillet and first brown the apple slices on both sides , then add the leek and saute until lightly browned
7. Spread each slice of toast with even amounts of the liverwurst mixture , then top each with a sauteed apple ring
8. Scatter the sauteed leeks on top , followed by the shredded cheese
9. Place all four toasts onto a foil lined baking sheet , along with the tomato halves cut sides up , seasoned with a little salt if desired-if you wish , you may brush tomato halves with a little olive oil and sprinkle with a little extra swiss cheese , or leave them plain
10. Place in the preheated oven for about 10 minutes or until nicely browned
11. Serve each slice of toast with a grilled tomato set atop a lettuce leaf on the side and sprinkled with some more freshly chopped parsley
12. Serve immediately

title: garlic cilantro mashed sweet potatoes  thanksgiving
steps:
1. Saute garlic in 1 tablespoon of butter for 2 minutes , in a deep enough pot to hold the potatoes
2. Add potatoes to garlic and add remaining butter , sour cream and salt
3. Mash throughly in the pot
4. Fold in cilantro
5. Transfer to a serving bowl and enjoy !

title: chicken enchiladas with ancho chile cream sauce
steps:
1. Ancho chile cream sauce:
2. Bring 2 cups water to boil in small sauce pan
3. Remove pan from heat , add ancho chiles , soak 30 minutes
4. Reserve 6 tbsp of liquid , drain rest of liquid
5. Cut stems off of chiles , cut open and scrape out seeds
6. Combine ancho chiles , reserve liquid and garlic in blender and puree
7. Combine cream and chile puree in heavy skillet
8. Bring to a boil , reduce heat , simmer for 3 minutes
9. Whisk in lime juice , season with salt
10. Strain sauce
11. Enchilada filling:
12. Mix 1 3 / 4 cup sour cream , canned chiles , green onion , cilantro and cumin in large bowl
13. Mix in shredded chicken , mushrooms , 1 cup of cheese , tomatoes , 3 tbsp of ancho chile cream sauce , salt and pepper to taste
14. Assembly:
15. Bring remaining ancho chile cream sauce to a simmer , cook tortillas in sauce for 15 seconds , coating both sides
16. Place tortilla in baking dish , spoon 1 / 2 cup of filling down center of tortilla
17. Roll tortilla closed , arrange seam side down
18. Repeat
19. May need another small glass dish for all enchiladas
20. Cover with foil and bake 30 - 45 minutes
21. Uncover and sprinkle with 1 cup of cheese
22. Bake uncovered until cheese melts , approximately 5 minutes
23. Serve with sour cream , guacamole and pico de gallo

title: easy berry muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Lightly spray muffin tin with non-stick spray
3. Wash and drain berries with soap even if they are organic
4. Combine flour , flax meal , baking powder , the sweet stuff , the apple sauce , and milk
5. Add the berries
6. Use an ice cream scoop with a emptier to put the batter into the pan , if you don't have this kind of ice cream scoop just get it in there the best you can
7. You want the cups about 2 / 3 full , but more or less doesn't matter
8. Bake for 17 minutes , or until tops are light brown
9. After baking feel free to drizzle honey on top , allow muffins to cool before removing them from the tin

title: roasted garlic pate
steps:
1. Wrap each head of garlic in a double thickness of aluminum foil
2. Bake in the middle of a 300f oven until soft , about 40-45 minute set aside until cool enough to handle , about 15 minutes
3. Remove foil and separate cloves from the heads of garlic
4. Pinch each clove to remove it from its skin and place in the bowl of a food processor
5. Add cheese and pepper
6. Process for 30 seconds
7. With machine running add olive oil until mixture has the texture of softly whipped potatoes
8. Serve with crackers or as a topping for baked potatoes or fettucine or linguine

title: moosewood s butternut squash soup with sage
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400f
2. Brush the bottom of a baking pan with olive oil and set aside
3. Cut the squash through the stem ends into halves , prick the skin in several places with a knife , and scoop out the seeds with a spoon
4. Brush the cut surfaces with about a tablespoon of the olive oil
5. Put the garlic inside the squash cavities and place halves in the pan cut side down
6. Add the onions to the pan and brush with remaining olive oil
7. Pour the water into the bottom of the pan , cover with aluminum foil , and bake for 50 minutes
8. Uncover and bake for 5-10 minutes more or until the squash is tender and the onions are soft
9. When the squash is cooled enough to handle , scoop out the flesh
10. Squeeze the garlic cloves out of their skins and discard the skins
11. In batches in a blender , combine the baked vegetables , apple juice or stock , thyme , nutmeg , salt and pepper and puree until it is smooth
12. Pour the soup into a pot and heat gently
13. In a small skillet , melt the butter and saute the sage leaves until dark and curled
14. Garnish each bowl of soup with the sage leaves

title: black bean and red pepper salsa
steps:
1. Heath olive oil in a 10" skillet over moderate heat
2. Add peppers and onion and saute until vegetables start to soften , about 3-4 minutes
3. Add garlic and saute 1 minute
4. Add wine and oregano and cook 3-4 more minutes , until vegetables are tender , but still have bite
5. Remove from heat , allow to cool slightly , then stir in beans , tabasco , lime juice and cilantro
6. Add salt and pepper , to taste
7. Add garnishes , if desired

title: coconut crisps
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees
2. Cream sugar and butter
3. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition
4. Add vanilla
5. Sift flour , baking powder and salt into mixture
6. Combine cornflakes , coconut , and nuts
7. Gently fold this into batter
8. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto a greased baking sheet
9. Bake for 15 minutes until golden

title: good gravy beef stew
steps:
1. Coat meat with flour and brown in oil
2. Drain
3. Add soups
4. Simmer 30 minutes
5. Add vegetables and simmer another hour

title: corned beef and cabbage potato salad
steps:
1. Place salad ingredients in large bowl
2. Whisk dressing ingredients together in a small bowl
3. Toss dressing with salad
4. Chill and serve

title: chinese tuna with curry chive mayonnaise
steps:
1. For mayo , combine all ingredients in a steel bowl and stir until completely incorporated
2. Refrigerate for later use
3. For marinade , add all ingredients in a steel bowl and stir until well combined
4. Let sit for 2 hours for flavors to blend
5. Marinate tuna steaks in marinade for 2 hours
6. Grill tuna on high heat for 2 minutes on each side
7. Place mayo in a plastic bag , cut off the bottom corner of bag and squeeze sauce across grilled tuna in a "zig zag" pattern

title: chocolate chip yoghurt muffins
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 180c cream butter and sugar in a bowl
2. Add the eggs one by one
3. Combine flour and baking powder and add to the egg mixture
4. Then add the yoghurt and afterwards the chocolate
5. Fill the dough into a lines muffin pan and bake for about 15-20 minutes or until golden brown
6. Enjoy ! =)

title: beef tenderloin in wine sauce
steps:
1. Sprinkle beef tenderloin with salt and pepper
2. Place tenderloin in a foil-lined roasting pan
3. Bake at 450 degrees for 15 minutes
4. In a saucepan , over medium heat , melt butter
5. Add onion , garlic , and mushroom
6. Saute 7 minutes
7. Add wine , worcestershire sauce , italian seasoning , and hot sauce
8. In a small bowl or liquid measuring cup , whisk together beef broth and flour
9. Stir into wine mixture
10. Reduce heat , and simmer , stirring occasionally , for 10 minutes or until onion is tender
11. Remove beef from oven , and top with sauce
12. Bake beef 18 more minutes or to desired degree of doneness , basting once
13. Transfer beef to a serving platter , reserving sauce in pan
14. Let beef stand 10 minutes before slicing
15. Serve with sauce

title: easy fruit cobbler with splenda
steps:
1. Combine all of the ingredients except the fruit in a bowl
2. Pour it into an 8x8 pan coated with cooking spray
3. Add the fruit right on top
4. The crust will come up over the fruit and cover it
5. Bake in a 350 degree oven for 40 minutes

title: johnny appleseed cakes in jar
steps:
1. Cream shortening and sugar together
2. Add the eggs , baking powder , soda , salt , and spices
3. Add the water alternately with the flour
4. Stir in the nuts and apples
5. Grease 8 wide-mouth pint-size jars
6. Fill the jars half full of batter
7. Wipe the rims clean and bake in a 325f oven on a cookie sheet for 35 to 45 minutes
8. Meanwhile , bring water to a boil
9. Once it boils , turn it off and place the lids and rings in the water and let sit until ready to use
10. When the cakes are done , remove the jars one at a time and place the lids on them
11. No need to wipe water off the lids--the extra moisture will not hurt the cakes
12. Place the ring on and screw tight
13. Allow the sit and cool completely
14. The jars will seal as they cool
15. Makes 8 pint-size jar cakes that store up to 6 months
16. If giving as a gift , cover top with pretty fabric and attach a card with name of cake , date made , and expiration date
17. If not for gift , just write the info on top with a marker
18. When ready to eat , if cakes does not come out easily , just run the jar under hot water for a few seconds or place in microwave for 2 second with the lids removed
19. Recipezaar editor
20. "these products are not recommended for canning
21. Choose recipes that you can freeze
22. In fact , most of these products are not really canned
23. The directions call for baking in the jar and then closing with a canning lid
24. Many recipes for quick breads and cakes are low acid and have the potential for supporting the growth of bacteria like clostridium botulinum if it is present inside the closed jar
25. You will see these products made commercially
26. However , additives , preservatives and processing controls not available for home recipes are used
27. Canning jar manufacturers also dont endorse baking in their canning jars

title: hot strawberry cider
steps:
1. Combine apple cider or juice , frozen strawberries , stick cinnamon , and whole cloves in a large saucepan
2. Bring to boiling and reduce heat
3. Cover and simmer for 10 minutes
4. Strain through a sieve lined with 100%-cotton cheesecloth
5. To serve , pour beverage into eight heatproof glasses
6. Garnish each serving with a cinnamon stick and a fresh strawberry or apple slice , if desired
7. Makes 8 servings

title: orange nut bread with orange cream spread
steps:
1. I wash the navel orange and set aside to dry
2. Remove both ends
3. Toast the pecans on a flat sheet in oven for 5 minutes in 350 oven
4. Grease 3 6x3 1 / 2" loaf pans
5. Set aside
6. In a medium mixing bowl , sift flour , salt , baking powder and baking soda -- set aside
7. In a large mixing bowl , cream sugar , and butter ,
8. Beat in eggs , one at a time
9. Stir in the orange juice with pulp and water , alternately with flour mixture
10. Combine well
11. Add the extracts and pecans and pour into prepared loaf pans --
12. Bake in a 350 oven to 40-45 minutes
13. Remove from pans after 5 minutes and wrap
14. Chill well before serving
15. Makes 3 small loaves
16. To prepare the orange cream cheese spread:
17. In a food processor with steel blade in place , combine the cream cheese , powdered sugar and orange
18. Process to a thick spread --
19. Refrigerate for at least several hours to blend the flavors
20. Spread lightly on sliced orange nut bread

title: traditional gravy
steps:
1. Collect the juices and the fat from the meat you are roasting
2. Put the juices in a glass jug and allow to stand for a few minutes so that the fat will rise to the surface
3. Skim off the fat
4. Put the roasting tin that you used to cook the meat on the hob on a medium heat and add the fat
5. Stir in the flour and cook for 1 minute
6. Stir in the meat juices and gradually stir in the stock until you get a smooth gravy
7. You can add some white or red wine at this point for more flavor
8. Use a wooden spoon and stir all over the surface of the pan to incorporate any meat juices that are stuck to it
9. Bring to the boil and allow to simmer for 10 minutes

title: no fat  low calorie yogurt chocolate chip cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Beat splenda and promise together
3. Add yogurt and vanilla
4. Combine flour , soda and salt
5. Stir flour mixture into splenda mixture
6. Fold in chocolate chips
7. Drop by spoonfuls on well-greased cookie sheet
8. Bake for 12 minutes
9. Yield 40 cookies

title: quick grape jelly
steps:
1. Combine grape juice and sugar in a large dutch oven
2. Bring to a boil , stirring constantly
3. Stir in pectin
4. Boil 1 minute , stirring constantly
5. Remove from heat , and skim off foam with a metal spoon
6. Quickly pour hot jelly into hot sterilized jars , leaving 1 / 2 inch headspace
7. Wipe jar rims
8. Cover at once with metal lids and screw on bands
9. Process in boiling water bath 5 minutes

title: dinner party nibbles
steps:
1. Mix together the cream cheese with the finely diced cornichon and place onto crustini and top with smoked salmon
2. Slice the mushrooms as thin as you can , finely chop the dill and mix together with the parmesan oil and white balsamic vinegar
3. Place the mushrooms in this mix and allow to sit for 15 minutes then fry quickly in hot oil and place on top of crustini
4. Finely dice the spanish onion and half the cherry tomatoes , chop the coriander then mix all together with the tuna , balsamic , olive oil and salt and pepper
5. Allow to sit for 20 minutes so that flavour really infuses , then place onto crustini

title: fettuccine with veal  olives   tomatoes
steps:
1. In a dutch oven , over medium heat , add the oil , garlic , anchovys and red pepper flakes and cook until fragrant , about 30 sec
2. Add in the veal and brown on all sides , about 5 to 7 minute
3. Add in the tomatoes , olives , parsley and season with salt and pepper
4. Bring to a simmer and gently cook for 5 to 7 min , stirring occasionally
5. Cook the pasta according to package directions
6. Add the pasta to the sauce
7. Add the basil , drizzle with extra-virgin olive oil , toss to combine , plate and serve

title: mango chicken tarkari
steps:
1. In a non-stick saut pan , heat two tablespoons of butter
2. Fry the black pepper corns for 30 sec
3. Add turmeric and onion and saut until translucent
4. Add garlic , ginger and cumin powder
5. Stir well for a minute or so
6. Put the mango chunks into the onion mixture
7. Mix well and saut for five minutes to allow sweating of the mango
8. Add chili paste , salt and pepper
9. Stir thoroughly for the complete incorporation of the ingredients
10. Allow the mango mixture to simmer for another 10 minutes or so
11. Reduce the mixture by half
12. Remove from heat and transfer to a blender for pureeing
13. Puree the mango mixture into a mango sauce
14. In a large bowl , season chicken pieces with lemon juice , salt and pepper
15. In a non-stick sauce pan , heat two tablespoons of butter
16. Add chicken mixture and brown well over medium heat for 8-10 minutes until the chicken pieces are almost done
17. To the browned chicken add pureed mango mixture and stir well to coat all the pieces of chicken
18. Lower the heat and allow braising for 10-15 minutes until the chicken pieces are tender and the curry has attained a thick , saucy consistency
19. Adjust seasoning with salt and pepper
20. Garnish with a tablespoon of chopped cilantro
21. Serve with rice and roti

title: easy malteser whopper fudge slice  ww 3 points
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180 deg c
2. Coat a 20x30cm lamington pan with cooking spray
3. In a large bowl combine flour , cocoa and maltesers well , breaking any cocoa lumps
4. In a large jug thoroughly mix together the eggs , sugar , oil and frommage frais
5. Fold into the dry ingredients
6. Pour into prepared tin and spread evenly
7. Bake for 25-30 minutes or until firm to touch
8. Cool in pan and then slice into 16 pieces
9. Dust with icing sugar or cocoa powder

title: skiiers french toast
steps:
1. Mix syrup , butter and brown sugar in a small saucepan
2. Bring to boil and simmer 5 minutes
3. Pour into 9 x 13 pan that had been lightly greased or sprayed with pam
4. Make two layers of bread slices , 6 slices each
5. Beat eggs , milk , vanilla and salt and pour over bread layers
6. Cover and refrigerate overnight
7. In the morning , bake uncovered at 350 dg
8. For 45 minutes or until golden brown
9. Cut slices in desired quantity , serve , and enjoy

title: real quick fettuccine alfredo
steps:
1. Cook pasta acc to pkg directions
2. In skillet , melt butter with cream
3. Stir in cheese , salt and pepper
4. Drain pasta , toss with sauce

title: australian honeycomb
steps:
1. In a medium size , heavy bottomed saucepan , combine water , sugar , honey and corn syrup
2. Clip a candy thermometer onto the inside of the pan
3. Over medium-high heat , bring mixture to a boil without stirring
4. Using a pastry brush dipped in water , brush down the sides of the pan to remove any undissolved sugar granules
5. Continue cooking until sugar reaches 300 degrees before removing from heat
6. Working quickly , add baking soda to sugar mixture and whisk until baking soda is well-incorporated
7. This may take a few seconds and liquid will bubble up and become foamy
8. Still working quickly , pour mixture onto a silicone baking mat or a parchment lined baking sheet
9. The mixture will spread out , puff up slightly and have a porous , shiny surface
10. Allow to harden for about 20 minutes without touching or moving it
11. Once cooled break honeycomb into pieces
12. Store in an airtight container at room temperature
13. It will last 1 to 2 days before it begins to lose it's crunch
14. Be sure to coat with semi-sweet chocolate chips melted in the microwave before breaking this if you want the lovely confection as served in australia

title: figure friendly french fries
steps:
1. Peel potatos
2. Cut potatos into strips
3. Brush potatos with egg whites , be sure to all sides are coated
4. Sprinkle all sides with season salt
5. Bake at 375 for about 30 minutes or until they reach desired crispiness

title: the realtor s party potatoes
steps:
1. Boil potatoes until tender , about 20-30 minutes
2. Mash while hot
3. Stir in butter and cream chesse
4. Add remaining ingredients and stir to combine
5. Serve immediately or spread in a 13x9 casserole and refrigerate until ready to use
6. An hour before serving , remove from refrigerator , set on counter for 30 minutes or so
7. Bake , uncovered at for 30 minutes or so to heat through

title: oh so easy sweet tea
steps:
1. Fill you're 10-12 cup coffee maker's pitcher with water and pour it in the machine
2. Tear open 2 family size tea bags and put the tea in a coffee filter in your coffee machine's basket
3. Turn on the machine and let it do all the work !
4. When all the tea has brewed , pour it into a 2-quart pitcher
5. Add the pinch of baking soda and the cup of sugar and stir until all the sugar is dissolved
6. Cover and chill in the fridge or serve immediately in glasses filled with ice
7. Make sure there's a little plate of lemon slices available for anyone who prefers lemon in their tea
8. You can make this with decaf tea , but it won't taste as good
9. Trust me , i've done it
10. The baking soda may sound strange , but don't leave it out
11. It cuts down on the bitterness of the tea , making it more smooth

title: rainbow jello
steps:
1. You can use any variety of jello you want and as many as you want
2. Use 1 box of lemon jello with 3 / 4 cup boiling water and 3 / 4 cup cold water
3. Mix well and pour into a 9x13 tupperware container
4. Let set a little awhile
5. The next layer consists of the other box of lemon jello , but this time combine 3 / 4 cup boiling water and let that sit for awhile and when a little cool , add 3 / 4 cup evaporated milk and mix together and pour onto the 1st layer in tupperware pan
6. Continue with the other colors of jello you want
7. Kids love it

title: lebanese spinach and lentil soup
steps:
1. In a large saucepan set over low-moderate heat , saute the onion in a drizzle of oil with a pinch of salt until transparent and starting to brown , 4 to 7 minutes
2. Add the garlic and cook for 1 more minute
3. Add the water , stock , lentils , and spices , and bring to a simmer
4. Cook , covered , until the lentils are tender , 30 to 40 minutes
5. In the meantime , drain the spinach in a colander and squeeze by handfuls to remove as much liquid as possible
6. In a large skillet , saute the spinach in batches with a drizzle of olive oil and a pinch of salt until cooked and almost crisp
7. Transfer the cooked spinach to a plate and set aside
8. Once the lentils are tender , add the vermicilli pieces and cook until the pasta is nearly tender , about 4 to 6 minutes
9. Add the sauteed spinach and juice of half a lemon to the pot , stir well , and add salt and pepper
10. Add more lemon if you like , or pass around wedges at the table
11. Ladle into bowls and top with cilantro

title: hot dogs in the crockpot
steps:
1. Place the hotdogs in the crockpot , leaving space between them and having them touch the sides of the pot
2. Where they make contact with the surface of the crockpot they will be brown and crispy
3. Cover and cook the hot dogs on the hi setting for 2 hours
4. Do not lift the lid of the crockpot while they are cooking
5. Do not add water or anything else to the crockpot
6. If you have another crockpot or crockette , use it to heat the chili , if you wish to make chili dogs
7. If you'd rather , sauerkraut may be heated in the crockette instead of the chili
8. A few minutes before serving , place hot dog buns in the crockpot the the dogs to warm up and soften the buns
9. You might enjoy setting up a hotdog bar for your teen-ager's special function
10. Set out the crocks of hotdogs and chili also with other condiments like mustard , relish , etc
11. So the teens can help themselves

title: broccoli and ham stuffed chicken breasts
steps:
1. Spray a 9x13 inch pan , set aside
2. On a sheet of waxed paper , combine bread crumbs , parmesan cheese , and seasonings , set aside
3. In small bowl , using fork , combine egg and butter and mix well
4. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
5. Roll each pounded breast into egg mixture and then into crumbs , coating both sides evenly
6. On each breast arrange 1 / 2 oz
7. Cheese , 1 / 2 oz
8. Ham and 2 tablespoons brocoli on top of ham
9. Place near one end for easier rollup
10. Roll to enclose filling
11. Arrange breast seams side down in baking pan
12. Bake until tender at 350 degrees for about 40 minutes

title: arroz con  crema rice with sour cream
steps:
1. The day before make up the prepared sour cream
2. By combining all ingredients
3. For the rice
4. Bring water butter and salt to a boil
5. Add rice
6. Reduce heat to very low cover
7. Cook 20 minutes
8. Put into large bowl
9. Cool
10. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
11. Heat oil in skillet add onion and garlic
12. Then add chillis stir 1 minute
13. When wilted
14. Cool
15. Combine with rice
16. Mix in corn thats been thawed
17. Add 1 1 / 2 cups sour cream mixture
18. And cheese jack chhese or mexican white cheese
19. Pour mixture in 9x13 baking pan and bake through about 30 minutes dont brown it

title: ham spread
steps:
1. Put ham into blender bowl and mix until fine
2. Add the other ingredients and mix until you get a smooth paste
3. Use spatula if necessary

title: nanny s bourbon baked beans  rachael ray
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Heat a large skillet over medium heat and cook bacon until fat begins to render out
3. Add onion and cook 1 minute
4. Add mustard , molasses , sugar and chutney and heat through
5. Add pepper to taste
6. Stir in beans then pour mixture into a large , lightly greased baking dish
7. Bake 30 minutes covered
8. Remove from oven and stir in bourbon
9. Bake uncovered 15-20 minutes longer until beans are bubbly and thick

title: artichoke chowder
steps:
1. In a skillet , saute the artichoke hearts garlic , and shallots in the stock
2. Set aside half the hearts and puree the rest in blender
3. Add the butter and milk and whip till smooth
4. Place in a saucepan and simmer over low heat for 20 mins
5. Season with salt and pepper
6. Fold in rest of the hearts and heat thoroughly
7. Garnish with basil and croutons

title: blueberry and pecan muffins
steps:
1. Mix together by hand the flour , sugar , baking powder , and salt in large mixing bowl
2. Combine the milk , vanilla , egg together and then add all at once to dry ingredient until moistened
3. Do not over mix
4. Gently mix the 4 tablespoons sugar , drained
5. Berries , lemon peel and pecans together
6. Fold the berry mixture lightly into the batter
7. Fill greased and dusted muffin pans half full
8. Bake for 20 minutes at 400 f or until done
