9. While muffins are still warm , dip the tops in melted butter , then in the sugar

title: naomi judd s chili pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Brown beef , onion& garlic until no longer pink
3. Drain off excess fat
4. Stir in flour and cook 1 minute
5. Stir in chili seasoning , chili powder , tomato paste , water , corn& olives
6. Bring to a boil , then reduce heat to low and simmer covered for 10-15 minutes
7. Take biscuits out of tube and separate in half
8. Put bottom halves in the bottom of a 9" square pan or deep dish pie plate-- i spray mine with pam first
9. Spoon chili mixture over biscuits
10. Top with remaining biscuits torn side down
11. Sprinkle with cheese
12. Bake at 350 degrees for 16-18 minutes until biscuits are brown and cheese is melted

title: crumbled feta salad tarts
steps:
1. Thaw phyllo tart shells according to instructions
2. In a medium bowl , combine yogurt , sour cream , lemon pepper , oregano , garlic powder and lemon juice
3. Mix well
4. Stir in feta
5. Add cucumber , red onion , tomato and olives
6. Toss well
7. Allow mixture to marinate 1 / 2 hour before serving
8. To serve , fill phyllo tart shells with salad mixture

title: simple alfredo sauce
steps:
1. Melt butter or margarine in a sauce pan over medium heat
2. Add heavy cream , stirring constantly
3. Stir in salt , grated parmesan cheese , and grated romano cheese
4. Stir constantly until melted , then mix in egg yolk
5. Simmer over medium low heat for 3 to 5 minutes
6. Garnish with additional grated parmesan cheese , if desired

title: kabuli channa
steps:
1. Heat ghee and fry mustard till they begin to pop
2. Reduce heat , add onion , saute until translucent
3. Add garlic and fennel and saute for up to 5 minutes
4. Dont let garlic burn
5. Reduce heat and add curry paste
6. Fry gently on low heat , constantly moving until water evaporates and paste darkens a little
7. Add tomato puree , chickpeas and tomatoes with pint hot water
8. Cook gently until water evaporates
9. Add another pint hot water and the salt , pepper and asafoetida
10. Cook gently until water has evaporated again leaving a dryish curry
11. Stir in coriander and serve

title: asparagus fish bake
steps:
1. Place the asparagus in a small saucepan and cover with water
2. Bring to boil
3. Cook for 1-2 minutes
4. Drain and place in a 1-qt
5. Baking dish coated with nonstick cooking spray
6. Top with fish
7. Set aside
8. In a small saucepan , saute onion in 1 tablespoon butter until tender
9. Stir in the flour , salt and pepper until blended
10. Gradually whisk in milk
11. Bring to a boil
12. Cook and stir for 1-2 minutes or until thickened
13. Remove from the heat , stir in cheese until melted
14. Pour over fish
15. Melt remaining butter
16. Stir in crackers and parsley
17. Sprinkle over cheese sauce
18. Bake , uncovered , at 350 degrees for 20-25 minutes or until crumbs are golden brown and the fish flakes easily with a fork

title: impossible zucchini tomato cheese pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Spray a 10" deep dish pie plate with veggie oil
3. Layer the zucchini , onion , & tomato in the pie plate
4. Sprinkle cheeses evenly over the veggies
5. Combine the biscuit mix , pepper , parsley& milk , mix well using a whisk
6. Pour mixture over the veggies
7. Bake for 30 minutes or until a knife comes out clean , cool on wire rack for 5 minutes- serve

title: peach   strawberry  punch nectarine sunrise fruity lemonade
steps:
1. Peach& strawberry punch combine sliced berries and chopped peaches in a small bowl
2. Sprinkle with sugar and gently stir
3. Allow the fruit to stand at room temperature 30 minutes to an hour
4. Pour fruit into iced punch bowl followed by wine , water , mint and ice
5. Makes2 quarts nectarine sunrise reserve 8 nectarine slices
6. In blender combine the chopped nectarines , orange juice concentrate , tequila and puree till smooth
7. Add crushed ice making sure to blend until slushy
8. In bottom of glasses add 1 tbsp grenadine
9. Add slushy nectarine mixture
10. Top with a mint sprig and a nectarine slice
11. Makes8 servings fruity lemonade combine cherry lemonade concentrate , 1 can water , apricot nectar and pineapple juice in large pitcher
12. Ifadding rum or vodka do so now-- add ice cubes and then slowly pour in ginger ale and stir gently
13. Thread pineapple wedge , lime slice and marachino cherry onto plastic skewer for garnish
14. Makes8 servings

title: stir fried pork in black bean sauce
steps:
1. Cut the pork into 1-inch cubes
2. In a bowl , combine the pork , baking soda , salt , sugar , white pepper , and 2 tablespoons water and mix well
3. Cover and marinate in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour or for up to 3 hours
4. To make the sauce: in a bowl , stir together the black beans , oyster sauce , soy sauce , sesame oil , sugar , cornstarch , white pepper , and 1 / 4 cup water
5. Set aside
6. Dice the onion
7. Cut the bell pepper halves into cubes
8. Set aside
9. In a wok or large saute pan over high heat , heat 1 tablespoon of the canola oil until almost smoking
10. Add the garlic and ginger and fry until golden brown , about 4-5 seconds
11. Using a slotted spoon , lift out the garlic and ginger and discard
12. Add the onion and bell peppers and stir-fry until just tender , about 5 minutes
13. Add the rice wine and deglaze the pan , stirring to scrape up any brown bits from the bottom
14. When the wine has nearly evaporated , transfer the vegetables to a bowl
15. Remove the pork cubes from the marinade and pat dry with paper towels
16. Discard the marinade
17. Return the pan to high heat and heat until very hot
18. Add the remaining 1 tablespoon oil to the hot pan
19. When it is hot , add the pork and stir-fry until it browns and turns opaque , about 3 minutes
20. Transfer the meat to a colander to drain
21. Return the pan to high heat and heat until very hot
22. Add the cooked vegetables , the pork and the sauce and stir-fry rapidly until the sauce thickens and the mixture is heated through , about 5 minutes
23. Transfer the pork mixture to a warmed platter , garnish with cilantro sprigs , and serve with the rice

title: thai chicken barley risotto
steps:
1. Heat 1 1 / 2 teaspoons oil in a medium saucepan over medium-high heat
2. Add 1 / 2 cup onions and 1 tablespoon garlic
3. Saut 1 minute
4. Stir in barley , 1 / 4 cup cilantro , salt , black pepper , 1 / 2 cup broth , and jalapeos
5. Bring to a boil
6. Cook 3 minutes or until liquid is nearly absorbed , stirring constantly
7. Add remaining broth , 1 / 2 cup at a time , stirring constantly until each portion is absorbed before adding the next
8. Combine juice and next 5 ingredients
9. Set aside
10. Heat 1 1 / 2 teaspoons oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
11. Add 1 cup onions , 1 tablespoon garlic , lemongrass , and ginger
12. Saut 1 minute
13. Add chicken , bell pepper , and peas
14. Saut 2 minutes
15. Stir in barley mixture , juice mixture , and milk
16. Bring to a boil
17. Reduce heat
18. Simmer 5 minutes or until sauce thickens , stirring occasionally
19. Stir in 1 / 4 cup cilantro
20. Sprinkle each serving with 1 teaspoon nuts

title: top secret recipes version of ihop french toast by todd wilbur
steps:
1. Beat eggs in a shallow bowl
2. Add milk , vanilla , flour , and salt to eggs
3. Beat with an electric mixture until all is well combined
4. Heat a large skillet over medium heat
5. When the surface is hot , add about a teaspoon of butter
6. Dip the bread into the batter and drop it onto the hot skillet
7. Let cook for 2-3 minutes on each side or until each side is golden brown
8. Cut toast in half diagonally and sprinkle with powdered sugar

title: herbed chevre spread
steps: 1. Combine ingredients well , and serve either packed into a bowl and drizzled with olive oil , or formed into a ball and rolled into chopped toasted walnuts or almonds

title: chocolate brandy sauce
steps:
1. Bring cream to a boil
2. Remove from heat and stir in chocolate until melted
3. Stir in brandy
4. You can use a cornstarch slurry to thicken it up
5. Serve warm sauce over warm chocolate bread pudding

title: shrimp florentine with pasta
steps:
1. Heat oil
2. Saute half of the shrimp to use as garnish , reserve shrimp
3. Add cut up tomato with juice , spinach and cook , until spinach wilts
4. Chop remaining shrimp and add to the spinach mixture
5. Cook 3 min
6. Stir in seasonings
7. Toss with pasta and add shrimp garnish and serve

title: crack in good tuna mornay
steps:
1. Gently melt butter in pan
2. Stir in flour over heat until dry and grainy
3. Remove from heat and gradually stir in milk and crumbled stock cube- stir over heat until sauce boils and thickens
4. Stir in cheese , tuna , pepper , peas and shallot
5. Gently fold in eggs
6. Pour into a oven proof dish combine topping ingredients in a separate bowl
7. Sprinkle mornay with topping
8. Bake in a moderate oven about 25 minutes or until topping is browned and mornay is heated through

title: orange streusel topped muffins
steps:
1. Combine flour , baking powder , baking soda , salt , sugar and grated orange peel
2. Stir in orange juice , melted butter , eggs and chopped nuts
3. Pour into 12 muffin cups
4. Blend 1 tablespoon melted butter , brown sugar , cinnamon and sprinkle on top of each muffin
5. Bake in a preheated 350f oven for 20 - 25 minutes

title: ukrainian  almond date horikhivnyk  almond date bars
steps:
1. Sift the flour with the granulated sugar and a pinch of salt
2. Cut in the butter
3. Combine the egg yolks , cream and vanilla
4. Add them to the flour and mix until the dough coheres
5. Pat the dough in a smooth layer into a buttered 9 x 12 inch baking pan
6. Bake in a preheated 350f oven for 10 to 15 minutes , or until it is firm but not browned
7. For the almond and date topping: while the dough is baking , prepare the topping
8. Beat the egg whites until stiff
9. Gradually beat the confectioners sugar into the beaten egg whites
10. When the mixture is firm , fold in the almonds , dates and chocolate
11. Spread the topping over the partially baked dough
12. Reduce the oven temperature to 325f and continue baking for about 40 minutes , or until the topping is set
13. Cool the sheet in the pan , then cut it into 1 1 / 2 by 3 inch bars
14. Makes 24

title: couscous with pine nuts and currants
steps:
1. Melt butter in a small saucepan
2. Add chopped shallot and simmer for about 2-3 minutes , stirring a few times
3. Add vegetable broth and bring to boil
4. Once boiling remove from heat and add couscous
5. Give it a quick stir and cover
6. Let it sit covered for 10 minutes
7. While it's sitting toast pine nuts
8. Put the pine nuts in a small pan and cook over low-medium heat for about 3-5 minutes , until the nuts are fragrant
9. Shake the pan around a few times too
10. Lastly , add the pine nuts and currants to the couscous and stir to combine everything

title: the definitive peaches and cream
steps:
1. Slice up the peaches
2. Arrange in a bowl and pour heavy cream on the top and around the edges
3. If desired , sprinkle lightly with ground cinnamon
4. Take a whiff then enjoy and savor summer and its bounty !

title: savory mince hotpot
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180 degrees celcius
2. Par boil potatoes till semi-soft (but not too soft
3. In a large frying pan , fry the onion , garlic and carrot
4. Add mince and brown
5. Add herbs , tomato sauce , stock and water and stir through until well mixed
6. Transfer to casserole dish
7. Add frozen peas and par-cooked potato's
8. Bake in oven at 180 degrees celcius for one hour
9. Check half way through cooking and add some water if need be

title: honey spiced duck
steps:
1. Score the duck breast skin in a criss-cross fashion
2. Blend the honey , vinegar , soy sauce , ginger , garlic , cinnamon , five spice powder and pepper in a small bowl
3. Coat the duck in this marinade in a shallow bowl
4. Cover and leave for 1 hour or overnight
5. Set the oven to fairly hot , 200c / 400f
6. Put the duck on a rack in a roasting tin , reserving the marinade
7. Cook for 20-30 minutes depending on their size and how well you like your duck cooked
8. Put the marinade and 40mls of the roasting juices in a small pan
9. Add the spring onions and bring to the boil
10. Simmer gently for 2 minutes
11. I serve the duck on a bed of rice with the sauce and spring onions spooned over , and sometimes some cranberry sauce to finish

title: roasted asparagus   peppers with feta
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400f
2. Arrange asparagus in row on foil-covered baking sheet
3. Sprinkle peppers onto bottom ends of spears
4. Bake 20 minute or until vegetables are crisp-tender
5. Top with dressing and cheese

title: sweet corn cake recipe from el torito restaurant
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Spray an 8" x 8" pyrex baking pan with no-stick spray and set aside
3. Beat the butter and shortening together until fluffy
4. Gradually beat the instant masa into the butter mixture , then beat in the water
5. Add the chopped corn kernels to the masa mixture
6. In a large bowl , combine the cornmeal , sugar , cream , baking powder and salt
7. Add the masa mixture to the cornmeal mixture and stir well to combine
8. Spoon the dough into the prepared pan , cover pan with foil and bake 40-50 minutes until the sweet corn cake is firm
9. Remove pan to a wire rack to cool 15 minutes before serving
10. Serve with a cookie dough scoop

title: marinated grilled hanger steak
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine the dijon , garlic , rosemary , lemon juice and zest and crushed red pepper
2. Schmear the steaks with this deliciousness and let them hang out in the fridge overnite at up to 2 hours minimum in the fridge
3. Preheat the grill
4. Season steaks with salt
5. When the grill is hot , brush and oil the grill
6. When the flames have dissipated , place the steaks on a hot spot on the grill
7. Brush with the excess marinade and move the steaks out of the flame if there is a flareup
8. Grill the steak for 4 to 5 minutes on each side for medium rare
9. Remove the steaks from the grill and let them rest 5 to 10 minutes before slicing
10. Serve immediately after slicing

title: baked stuffed lobster for two
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450f degrees
2. When lobster is cool enough to handle , split in half lengthwise
3. Remove dark strip if present
4. Remove the coral and liver to a medium bowl
5. To coral , add bread crumbs and butter , salt , pepper and taragon
6. Put mixture in cavaties of lobster , drizzle with vegetable oil
7. Bake for 25 minutes or until browned

title: cranberry stuffing
steps:
1. Combine cranberries and sugar
2. Cook celery , onion and parsley in butter until just tender
3. Toss together remaining ingredients and add a bit of water if needed

title: peanut butter finger bars
steps:
1. Cream butter , sugar and brown sugar
2. Blend in egg , 1 / 3 cup peanut butter , baking soda , salt , and vanilla
3. Stir in flour and oats
4. Spread in a greased 9x13 pan
5. Bake at 350 for 20-25 minutes
6. Sprinkle with chocolate chips , let stand 5 minutes or until chips are melted and then spread
7. Combine powdered sugar , 1 / 4 peanut butter , and enough milk to make it just thin enough to drizzle over the chocolate layer
8. Let cool until topping is hard

title: canadian maple leaves
steps:
1. Into large bowl , measure all ingredients
2. With mixer on low speed , beat ingredients until well mixed , occasionally scraping bowl with rubber spatula
3. Shape dough into ball
4. Wrap with plastic wrap
5. Refrigerate dough 1 hour or until easy to handle
6. Preheat oven to 350f
7. Grease large cookie sheet
8. On lightly floured surface , with lightly floured rolling pin , roll 1 / 3 of the dough at a time 1 / 8 inch thick , keeping remaining dough refrigerated
9. With floured 3 1 / 2 inch maple leaf shaped cookie cutter , cut dough into leaves
10. Place cookies 1 inch apart on greased cookie sheet bake 10 minutes or until golden
11. With pancake turner , carefully remove to wire racks to cool
12. Repeat until all dough is used , greasing cookie sheet each time
13. Store cookies in tightly covered container

title: weight watchers chicken marsala
steps:
1. Sprinkle chicken with salt and pepper
2. Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
3. Add chicken and cook through , about 3 minutes on each side
4. Transfer chicken to a platter and keep warm
5. Add mushrooms to skillet and cook , stirring frequently , until browned , about 3 minutes
6. Sprinkle mushrooms with flour , stirring to blend
7. Add the marsala and broth
8. Bring to a boil
9. Let the mixture simmer until it is slightly thickened , about 5 minutes

title: crispy salt crusted chicken with roasted shallots
steps:
1. Salt crusted chicken
2. Toss the chicken thighs together with thyme , shallots , salt and peppercorns in a large bowl
3. Place a wire rack over a roasting tray
4. Arrange the chicken and the garlic on top of a roasting rack
5. Place in the fridge overnight or for a minimum of 2-3 hours
6. Pre-heat the oven to 180 degrees c / 350f drain the roasting tray of any chicken juice that has been extracted by the salting process
7. Pour about a cup of water into the roasting tray
8. Rub the chicken thighs with butter
9. Scatter on top the shallots and the garlic from the marinade
10. Place the rack with the chicken back on top of the roasting tray
11. Dust the chicken thighs with paprika and place in the oven to roast until the skin is crispy and the chicken thighs are done
12. Roasted garlic aioli
13. Meanwhile , make your mayonnaise by whisking the egg yolks with the juice of 1 lemon and a pinch of salt
14. While whisking , slowly incorporate the oil into the egg yolk mixture until you get a smooth , thick texture
15. When the chicken is cooked , remove the roasted garlic and squeeze the soft centre into the mayo and whisk to blend
16. To serve
17. To serve divide the shallots and chicken between your plates
18. Dress the rocket with the sherry vinegar and scatter over the chicken
19. Dollop with the roasted garlic mayo

title: decadent eggnog  bailey s
steps:
1. In a lrg bowl , beat eggs till very thick & creamy
2. Gradually beat in sugar
3. Blend in milk & bailey's
4. Whip cream in another bowl till it holds soft peaks
5. Stir whipped cream into egg mixture
6. Chill till ready to serve & stir again just before serving
7. I skipped step 2 , added the unbeaten cream w / the milk + bailey's & cannot imagine it being any better if done as written , but you may choose your method

title: falafel w  avocado spread   veggie burgers w  guacamole
steps:
1. To prepare patties place pinto beans in a medium bowl
2. Partially mash with a fork
3. Add cheese and next 5 ingredients
4. Stir until well combined
5. Shape bean mixture into 4 oval patties
6. Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
7. Add patties to pan
8. Cook 3 minutes on each side or until patties are browned and thoroughly heated
9. To prepare spread combine avocado and next 5 ingredients , stirring well
10. To serve place 1 patty in each pita half
11. Spread about 2 tablespoons avocado spread over patty in each pita half
12. Top with onions and greens

title: grilled cheese croutons
steps:
1. On stove , heat a grill pan over medium-high heat
2. Brush one side of each bread slice with butter
3. Place two slices in the pan , buttered side down
4. Top with one slice of cheese each , then top with remaining slices of bread , buttered side up
5. Grill 2-3 minutes , until toasted
6. Turn and grill other side
7. Cut into 1-inch squares
8. Serve your choice of soup hot , topped with a few croutons per serving
9. This recipe should make enough for 6 servings of soup

title: gnocchi con salsicce  rucola e pomodoro secc
steps:
1. Heat the 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat
2. Add the garlic , onion and sausage , seasoning the meat with salt and pepper as desired
3. As you saute , break the sausage into small bite size pieces with your spoon
4. In the meantime , boil water in a pot to cook the gnocchi according to package instructions
5. Remove from the heat
6. In a blender , blend together the basil , 1 / 2 cup of water from the gnocchi pot , 1 / 2 cup olive oil and half and half
7. Drain the gnocchi
8. When the sausage is fully cooked , add the drained gnocchi and blender sauce to the skillet as well as the arugula and sundried tomatoes
9. Reduce heat to low and stir until the arugula wilts
10. Remove from heat and serve

title: reynolds overnight french toast  rsc
steps:
1. Dice up peaches and pears and put in large mixing bowl
2. Squeeze the juice of 1 lemon on fruit
3. Add craisens , 2 tsp cinnamon , melted butter , brown sugar and toss together
4. In another bowl put cubed french bread sprinkle with cinnamon
5. In a small bowl beat eggs , milk , and honey
6. Then pour milk mixture over bread cubes and toss to coat
7. Next line 8 small flower pots with reynolds foil with pleanty hangin out to cover pot for baking
8. Spray with olive oil spray
9. Next divide fruit mixture into the bottom of each pot
10. Then divide bread mixture between 8 pots
11. Next sprinkle to the tops of each pot with 1 / 8 of the chopped almonds
12. Wrap closed the foil over each pot and place in the refrigerator for 4-24 hours
13. When you are ready to serve place pots in a 350 degree pre-heated oven for 50 minutes after 50 minutess open up the tops and bake for an additional 5 minutes
14. Then serve with maple syrup
15. Looks like a pretty flower pot breakfast !

title: quick homemade applesauce   no sugar added
steps:
1. Peel and core apples
2. Cut apples into approximately 1 inch cubes
3. Add all ingredients to pot , and turn heat on high
4. Bring to a boil , then cover and reduce heat to low
5. Simmer for 20 minutes or until the apples have softened significantly
6. Stir frequently , making sure that the apples are not sticking to the bottom of the pot
7. Add more water if necessary
8. Remove lemon slices
9. Mash with a potato masher or use a food mill for a smoother consistency
10. Serve warm or at room temperature

title: perfect crispy potatoes   recipe courtesy melissa d arabian
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. In a large saute pan , heat the oil over medium-high heat
3. Add the potato cubes and season with salt and pepper , to taste
4. Saute stirring frequently , for 5 minutes
5. Turn the heat up to high , add the water , stir , and cover the pan with a lid
6. Steam the potatoes until the water evaporates , about 3 or 4 more minutes
7. Lower the heat to medium , and saute another 1 to 2 minutes until all traces of water are gone
8. Toss in the butter and stir to coat the potatoes
9. Spread the potatoes out on a baking sheet
10. Bake in the oven until the potatoes are crisp and browned to your liking , about 15 to 25 minutes depending on how dark you want them
11. Transfer the potatoes to a serving bowl and serve

title: caramelized banana splits with hot chocolate sauce
steps:
1. Melt butter in a 12 inch heavy skillet over medium heat , then add bananas in 1 layer and sprinkle with brown sugar
2. Increase heat to medium-high and cook bananas , gently turning once and shaking skillet occasionally , until sugar is caramelized , 3-4 minutes
3. Divide bananas among 4 dessert bowls , leaving any remaining caramel in skillet
4. Add cream to skillet and boil over medium heat , stirring , until caramel is dissolved
5. Add chocolate with a pinch of salt and whisk until melted
6. Top bananas with scoops of ice cream , then drizzle with some chocolate sauce , then sprinkle with nuts

title: corn  bean and chickpea salad
steps:
1. Combine chickpeas , kidney beans , black beans , corn , onion ,
2. Red pepper and celery
3. Set aside
4. Mix together basil , vinegar , oil , mustard , garlic
5. Salt and pepper
6. Pour over bean salad and toss
7. May add 1 12 tsp hot pepper if desired

title: cranberry orange tea bread  sugar free
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Coat 9x5 inch loaf pan with nonstick cooking spray
3. In a medium bowl , stir together orange juice , milk , oil , eggs , zest and vanilla
4. Set aside
5. In a large bowl , combine flour , splenda , baking powder , baking soda , salt , nuts and cranberries
6. Stir
7. Make a well and add the liquid mixture , stirring just until blended
8. Spoon into prepared pan and smooth
9. Bake for 50 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into the middle of the loaf comes out dry
10. While bread is baking prepare glaze: combine orange juice and splenda in a small saucepan
11. Place on medium heat and reduce by one half
12. Stir in cream cheese until melted
13. Brush glaze onto warm loaf immediately after removing from oven
14. Cool on rack for 15 minutes
15. Then remove from pan
16. Gift loaf variation: makes 2-3 small loaves - fill mini loaf pans 2 / 3 full and bake for 30-35 minutes

title: ww low fat cream cheese icing
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients on low with mixer
2. Enjoy

title: chicken cauliflower casserole
steps:
1. Combine cauliflower , onion and water in a medium saucepan
2. Cover and bring to a boil
3. Reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes or until veggies are tender
4. Drain and set aside
5. Add milk , cornstarch , bouillon granules , and salt to saucepan , stirring with a wire whisk
6. Bring to a boil
7. Reduce heat and simmer , stirring constantly until thickened and bubbly
8. Add cheese
9. Stir until cheese melts
10. Remove from heat
11. Add cauliflower mixture , chicken and pimento to cheese sauce
12. Spoon mixture into a 1 1 / 2 qt casserole coated with cooking spray
13. Bake at 325 for 20 minutes

title: brunch eggs          sheryl webb shaw
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450o
2. Lightly grease 12 x 9 x 2 baking dish
3. Layer canadian bacon in bottom of dish
4. Add a layer of the swiss cheese on top of canadian bacon
5. Beat eggs
6. Add whipping cream to eggs and whip together
7. Pour egg and cream mixture over swiss cheese
8. Bake in oven for 10 minutes
9. Sprinkle parmesan cheese , pepper and paprika on top
10. Bake an additional 8 to 10 minutes
11. Let stand 10 minutes and serve

title: i can t believe it s low fat carrot bread
steps:
1. Mix together carrots , eggs , sugars , apple sauce , milk and vanilla
2. Stir in dry ingredients
3. Bake at 350 for 50 - 55 minutes in a greased 9" x 5" loaf pan
4. Cool and cut into 18 1 / 2" slices

title: jacques pepin s clear vegetable stock
steps:
1. Place all ingredients , along with ingredients for herbes de provence , and 10 cups of water into a stockpot or heavy kettle
2. Bring mixture to a boil
3. Reduce heat and simmer for 1 hour
4. Strain

title: spiced blueberry soup
steps:
1. Combine blueberries , water , cinnamon stick , honey , ginger and cardamom pods in a large saucepan
2. Bring to a boil , stirring occasionally
3. Reduce heat and simmer , stirring , until most of the blueberries have burst , 1 to 2 minutes
4. Remove the cardamom pods and cinnamon stick
5. Puree the soup in 2 batches in a blender until smooth
6. Place a fine sieve over the pan and pour the soup through it back into the pan , straining out any solids
7. Whisk cornstarch and milk in a measuring cup until smooth
8. Whisk into the blueberry mixture
9. Bring the soup to a boil over medium heat , stirring
10. Boil , stirring constantly , until the soup thickens slightly , about 1 minute
11. Remove from the heat and let cool for 10 minutes
12. Transfer to a bowl , loosely cover and chill until cold , at least 5 hours or up to 2 days
13. Just before serving , whisk 1 cup sour cream into the soup and ladle into bowls
14. Top each serving with 1 / 2 teaspoon sour cream and swirl decoratively into the soup
15. Garnish with additional blueberries , if desired

title: asparagus beef skillet
steps:
1. Freeze steak for two hours
2. Slice in 1 / 4-inch strips
3. Lightly brown meat but still leave pink
4. Place in a bowl
5. Add onion to skillet and cook 3 minutes
6. Add sherry and asparagus
7. Cover cook 5 minutes
8. To skillet add worcestershire sauce , cornstarch , sugar and spices
9. Stir while cooking to thicken mixture
10. Return steak to mixture and cook just till meat is warm but still pink
11. Serve with rice

title: im jud   dara  lentils on rice
steps:
1. In pan heat oil , add onions to brown , set aside
2. Combine lentils and 4 c water in a large saucepan , bring to boil , cover and simmer for 10 minutes add rice , onions in oil , salt and pepper , cover and cook 25-30 minutes
3. Serve hot , warm or cold , garnish w / yogurt and herbs

title: mushroom shrimp creole
steps:
1. In a large skillet , cook bacon over medium heat until crisp
2. Drain on paper towels
3. In the drippings , saute onions , green peppers and garlic
4. Add the next 8 ingredients
5. Bring to a boil
6. Reduce heat
7. Cover and simmer for 30-45 minutes
8. Add the shrimp , mushrooms , butter , lemon juice and savory
9. Cook 5-10 minutes longer or until thoroughly heated
10. Discard bay leaf
11. Stir in bacon
12. Serve over rice

title: greek walnut pie
steps:
1. Heat oven to 325f spray 9-inch glass pie pan with cooking spray
2. Make pie crusts as directed on box for two-crust pie using sprayed pie pan
3. In medium bowl , mix walnuts , brown sugar , 2 tablespoons granulated sugar and the cinnamon
4. Pour and evenly spread 1 / 4 cup of the cooled melted butter over bottom of pie crust
5. Spread walnut mixture evenly over butter
6. Drizzle another 1 / 4 cup butter over nut mixture
7. Top with second crust
8. Seal edge and flute
9. Cut large slits in several places in top crust for steam to escape
10. Drizzle remaining 1 / 4 cup butter evenly over top crust
11. Bake at 45 to 55 minutes or until golden brown
12. About 5 minutes before removing pie from oven , in 1-quart saucepan , cook honey and lemon juice over medium heat , stirring frequently , until mixture has a watery consistency
13. Remove pie from oven
14. Place on wire rack
15. Slowly pour hot honey mixture evenly over top of hot pie , making sure it seeps into slits in top crust
16. Cool at least 3 hours before serving
17. Just before serving , in small bowl with electric mixer , beat topping ingredients on high speed about 2 minutes or until stiff peaks form
18. Spoon topping onto individual servings of pie

title: shrimp egg foo yong    low cal  fat   carb
steps:
1. Place 2 tablespoons of oil in a large skillet and cook the onions and cabbage over medium-high heat until tender
2. Remove from the heat , drain and set aside
3. In a bowl , whisk the eggs and add soy sauce , salt , pepper , garlic powder , drained cabbage mixture and sliced bamboo shoots
4. In a non-stick pan , over medium-high heat , add 2 tablespoons oil and heat until oil is hot
5. Ladle half of cabbage mixture into the hot pan , and then the other half of the cabbage mixture into the pan , as you would for 2 large pancakes and then sprinkle the diced shrimp evenly on top of each
6. Cook about 3 minutes , or until the edges begin to brown and when jiggled , they slide in the pan
7. Turn over and cook another 2 to 3 minites until cooked through

title: salad de colores
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine the spinach , cabbage , carrots and bell pepper
2. Add enough salad dressing to coat
3. Toss , and sprinkle with pumpkin seeds and salt and pepper if desired

title: chinese take out sweet and sour pork
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , toss the pork with the wine , soy sauce , and pepper
2. Marinate for at least 15 minutes
3. Fill a wok or large frying pan with 3 inches of oil and heat to 360
4. In a bowl , combine the ketchup , sugar , cider vinegar , stock , soy sauce , sesame oil , and chili sauce
5. Set aside
6. In a separate bowl , combine the flour , cornstarch , egg white , vegetable oil , salt and 1 / 4 cup water to form a batter
7. Dip the pork in the batter , then carefully add about 10 pieces of pork to the wok and fry for 3 minutes
8. Remove the cooked pork with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels
9. Continue to dip and cook the remaining pork in the same manner
10. Pour off all but about 3 tablespoons of the oil in the wok or heat another pan with 3 tablespoons of oil
11. Add the garlic to the pan and cook for about 30 seconds , being careful not to burn it , then add the bell peppers , onion , and pineapple
12. Stir-fry the vegetables until they begin to soften , about 3 minutes
13. Stir the reserved sauce and add it to the vegetables along with the fried pork
14. Toss until the sauce lightly coats the vegetables and meat
15. Serve hot with rice and garnished green onions

title: caramel sweet rolls
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine brown sugar and cream until sugar is dissolved
2. Spread into a greased 8-in
3. Square baking dish
4. Sprinkle with walnuts
5. On a lightly floured surface , unroll breadstick dough
6. Combine sugar and cinnamon
7. Sprinkle over dough
8. Reroll , starting with a short end
9. Cut along breadstick scored lines
10. Place cut side down in prepared pan
11. Bake at 350 for 25-30 minutes or until golden brown
12. Cool for 1 minute before inverting onto a serving plate
13. Serve warm

title: blackberry cobbler  quick and easy
steps:
1. Mix butter , flour , sugar and milk with beaters
2. Place in bottom of a 9x9 pan
3. Top with berries
4. Bake at 350f for 1 hour

title: best ever banana cake with cream cheese frosting
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 275f
2. Grease and flour a 9 x 13 pan
3. In a small bowl , mix mashed banana with the lemon juice
4. Set aside
5. In a medium bowl , mix flour , baking soda and salt
6. Set aside
7. In a large bowl , cream 3 / 4 cup butter and 2 1 / 8 cups sugar until light and fluffy
8. Beat in eggs , one at a time , then stir in 2 tsp vanilla
9. Beat in the flour mixture alternately with the buttermilk
10. Stir in banana mixture
11. Pour batter into prepared pan and bake in preheated oven for one hour or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
12. Remove from oven and place directly into the freezer for 45 minutes
13. This will make the cake very moist
14. For the frosting , cream the butter and cream cheese until smooth
15. Beat in 1 teaspoon vanilla
16. Add icing sugar and beat on low speed until combined , then on high speed until frosting is smooth
17. Spread on cooled cake
18. Sprinkle chopped walnuts over top of the frosting , if desired

title: traditional chicken teriyaki
steps:
1. In a microwavable bowl , combine mirin , tamari , sugar
2. Microwave for 30 seconds to blend the sugar into sauce
3. Using a meat tenderizer , flatten chicken thighs into an even thickness
4. Sprinkle chicken with salt and pepper on both sides
5. Heat a large flat-iron skillet to medium-high heat --make sure it's thoroughly heated
6. Add oil , then saute the chicken for 7-9 minutes each on both sides
7. After 5-6 minutes on the second side , chop the chicken into bite size chunks then stir for about a minute
8. Deglaze with a generous amount of sauce that covers all the pieces and stir for about a minute
9. Transfer to serving dish and add extra sauce

title: white trash party mix
steps:
1. Mix the cereals , peanuts , pretzels and m&m's together in a very large container
2. Melt the almond bark
3. I do this by placing it all in a large bowl and microwaving on high for 2-3 minutes , stirring and repeating until it is melted
4. Pour over the cereal mixture and mix well
5. Lay out on a table or a long counter and break apart
6. Allow to dry , breaking apart as needed
7. Store tightly covered

title: easy and delicious coleslaw
steps:
1. Mix together mayonnaise , sugar , vinegar , salt , celery seed and horseradish
2. Add shredded cabbage and carrots and toss until covered
3. Let stand five minutes
4. Enjoy !

title: pepper steak ponzu
steps:
1. In a skillet warm the olive oil
2. Add in sliced round steak and saute until browned
3. Place the browned beef and any juices in crock-pot
4. Mix together the ponzu sauce , ketchup , pepsi cola , garlic and red pepper flakes
5. Pour over all
6. Cover and cook for 3 hours on low or until meat is tender and cooked through
7. Add onion and bell peppers to crock pot
8. Stir to combine
9. Mix the cornstarch with a small amount of water
10. Turn crock-pot to high , stir in cornstarch mixture and continue to cook for 30 minutes
11. After 30 minutes check seasoning and if necessary add salt and pepper to taste
12. Stir in tomato wedges and cook an additional 30 minutes
13. Stir before serving
14. Serve on top of cooked rice of choice

title: golden potato wedges
steps:
1. Peel potatoes
2. Cut in half lengthwise
3. Cut each half into 4 long wedges
4. Dip wedges in melted butter
5. Roll in bread crumbs
6. Place on a greased pan
7. Bake 35 minutes at 400 degrees fahrenheit or until golden brown

title: apricot brandy chicken
steps:
1. In a large fry pan heat some oil , add chicken and brown well on both sides
2. Remove and set to one side
3. In the same pan add water , brandy , jam , stock and mustard stir to combine , mix a little water with the cornflour and add to sauce , stir until mixture thickens
4. Add sour cream , return chicken to pan cook for about 10-15 min's over a low heat to cook chicken through , stir in tarragon
5. Remove chicken and slice thickly
6. To serve: i served mine over celeriac mash drizzled with sauce and garnished with half an apricot

title: thick and hearty stew
steps:
1. Brown meat and place in stockpot with garlic , onion , boullion granules , salt , pepper , lentils and carrots
2. Simmer while preparing celery and potatoes , approximately 10 minutes
3. Add celery and potatoes to soup stock
4. Add remaining ingredients and simmer until potatoes and carrots are tender , approximately 20 minutes more
5. It may be necessary to add more water
6. Serve

title: pan fried chicken with bacon and thyme gravy
steps:
1. In a plastic storage bag , combine the chicken , buttermilk and 1 teaspoon of thyme
2. Turn and coat the chicken well
3. In another plastic storage bag , combine the 3 tablespoons of flour and the cornmeal
4. Add the chicken and coat completely
5. Season generously with salt and pepper
6. In a medium , heavy skillet , cook the bacon until crisp and brown
7. Transfer bacon to paper towels , leaving drippings in the skillet
8. Add chicken to skillet and cook until brown on both sides and cooked through , about 5 minutes per side
9. Transfer chicken to plates and keep warm
10. In a small bowl , whisk together the 2 teaspoons flour , 2 teaspoons thyme , and the chicken broth
11. Add mixture to the skillet and boil until reduced to 1 / 3 cup , whisking now and then , about 3 minutes
12. Crumble the bacon and stir into gravy along with the green onions
13. Return to a boil and season with salt and pepper
14. Spoon gravy over chicken
15. Serve

title: tomato achar
steps:
1. Roast tomatoes in oven for about 30 minutes , or until charred
2. Remove charred skin and reserve flesh in a bowl
3. In a sauce pan , heat oil
4. Add cumin and mustard seeds
5. Fry for 30 seconds or so
6. Add chilies , garlic , ginger , timur , asafetida , lime juice and salt
7. Stir for a minute
8. In a blender , combine roasted tomatoes , chopped cilantro and mint , if used , and spice mixture
9. Process to form smooth paste-like mixture
10. Transfer into a large bowl
11. For garnish , in a non-stick pan heat one tablespoon of oil , splitter fenugreek until it turns dark
12. Add slices of garlic and fry till light brown
13. Pour the garlic-oil mixture and chopped cilantro over the tomato mixture
14. Mix well and refrigerate for at least two hours before serving

title: fish fillet with garlic butter and black olives
steps:
1. In a large skillet , heat butter and garlic at medium heat until butter is frothy
2. Reduce heat to medium-low and cook for 15 minutes or until butter is golden , stirring from time to time
3. Reduce in pure the garlic cloves
4. Add red bell pepper , black olives and capers and cook for 4 minutes
5. Add sage and lemon juice and stir
6. Meanwhile , in another large skillet , heat oil at medium-high heat
7. Add fish fillets and cook 6 to 8 minutes or until golden and the flesh is easy to flake with a fork
8. Garnish the fillets with garlic butter and olives

title: spanish chicken with vegetables and olives   pollo a la chilindr
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Truss your chicken
3. Brush with butter salt and pepper
4. Place chicken breast up in dutch oven
5. Cook , uncovered until thighs test done
6. Add rest of ingredients , cover and bake until veggies are tender
7. , about 30 minutes
8. Remove chicken to a serving platter , surround with vegetables
9. Serve with rice

title: caramelized baked chicken party wings
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. Place chicken in a 9x13 inch baking dish
3. Mix together the oil , soy sauce , ketchup , honey , garlic , salt and pepper pour over the chicken
4. Bake in preheated oven for one hour , or until sauce is caramelized

title: jalisco jericalla
steps:
1. Bring milk and cinnamon sticks to a boil in a saucepan , stirring constantly so as not to scorch
2. Reduce heat , and simmer for 10 minutes , add vanilla
3. Remove from heat
4. Cool
5. Stir in sugar , and cook over low heat , stirring occasionally for 30 minutes
6. Remove from heat and cool
7. Meanwhile , beat egg yolks and add to cooled milk mixture
8. Preheat oven to 350f
9. Divide mixture among 8 heat-resistant dessert dishes or ramekins
10. Bake in a water bath for 30 to 35 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in center of custard comes out clean
11. Brown under broiler for 3 to 5 minutes or until tops are golden or use a crme brle torch
12. Refrigerate for 2 hours
13. Un-mold onto dessert plates
14. If you wish , you can garnish the plates with a raspberry sauce , a few fresh raspberries and a sprig of mint

title: potato nuggets with dill   cream
steps:
1. Steam or boil your new potatoe nuggets until cooked
2. Melt butter in a skillet , add potatoes , toss to coat
3. Mix dill into the cream
4. Pour dilled cream over the potatoes and continue cooking over medium-low heat until the cream has turned into an almost golden sauce , stir frequently
5. Season to taste

title: grannydragon s catalina dressing
steps:
1. Mix ingredients well and store in refrigerator
2. Fat-free version:
3. In place of oil , bring 1 / 2 cup water and 1 / 2 tablespoon cornstarch to a boil , stirring frequently
4. Remove from heat
5. Add remaining ingredients and mix well
6. Dressing will thicken when chilled

title: raw tuscan kale salad with pecorino
steps:
1. Trim bottom 2 inches off kale stems and discard
2. Slice kale , including ribs , into 3 / 4-inch-wide ribbons
3. You should have 4 to 5 cups
4. Place kale in a large bowl
5. If using bread , toast it until golden on both sides
6. Tear it into small pieces and grind in a food processor until mixture forms coarse crumbs
7. Chop or microplane the garlic and transfer to a small bowl
8. Add 1 / 4 cup cheese , 3 tablespoons oil , lemon juice & zest , salt , pepper flakes and black pepper , and whisk to combine
9. Pour dressing over kale and toss very well to thoroughly combine
10. Let salad sit for 5 minutes , then serve topped with bread crumbs , additional cheese and a drizzle of oil

title: royal cheesecake
steps:
1. Crust using a pastry blender or 2 knives cut cold margarine into flour , baking powder and sugar until pieces are the size of peas
2. Stir in sour cream , egg yolk& salt
3. Form into a ball& refrigerate for at least 1 hour
4. Roll out into a circle to cover bottom& halfway up sides of a well-greased , 9 inch springform pan
5. Filling beat egg yolks until light , adding half the sugar
6. Stir in remaining ingredients except egg whites , remaining sugar , and cherry pie filling
7. Beat egg whites , gradually adding remaining sugar
8. Beat until able to form stiff peaks
9. Fold egg white mixture into cheese mixture
10. Pour into crust
11. Bake in a preheated 350 oven for 45 minutes
12. When cool , spread with a can of cherry pie filling
13. Refrigerate

title: apple pork chops in the crock pot
steps:
1. Saute onion and apples in butter then place in crock pot
2. Add pork chops to crock pot
3. Pour the apple sauce , spices and apple juice on top
4. Cook on low for 8-10 hours

title: steak gorgonzola alfredo with reduced balsamic  copycat olive ga
steps:
1. First start with the reduction it will take the longest and can be done ahead of time and stores for months at room temperature
2. In a wide sauce pan add the balsamic vinegar , cook uncovered over med / low heat until reduced by 1 / 2
3. Open a window or well vent your kitchen the sauce will seem a little thin while it is hot
4. Let it cool in the pan for 1-2 hours and place back into the original bottle
5. Can be stored room temp for 6 mo to 1 year , refrigerated until the apocalypse or fuzzy
6. See for further help
7. Next will be the alfredo sauce: in a sauce pot add the heavy cream and place over med to med / high heat
8. Add the garlic , onion , salt and pepper
9. Heat until the cream is reduced by 1 / 2 occasionally stir
10. Add the cheese and reduce the heat to low , stir in well
11. This sauce can be held on low for 15-20 minutes without breaking or loss of flavor
12. Season to taste with salt and pepper
13. With the sauce on low , your pasta should be cooking and all most done
14. Heat a 12" cast iron skillet over high heat
15. Season both sides of the meat with salt and pepper and coat in oil
16. When the skillet is ripping hot , sear the steak on both sides 1-2 minutes per side max
17. The meat should be rare at this point , that is ok
18. Remove and set on a plate , remove the skillet from the heat
19. Cut the meat into bite sized pieces
20. Add the butter to the cast iron skillet , it should melt quickly
21. Add the meat to the skillet and stir the butter into the meat
22. Let sit in hot skillet until cooked to med 2-5 minutes
23. Finish option 1: in a large skillet , heat 1 tablespoon of oil over med / high heat
24. Add the spinach heat 1-2 minutes
25. Add the pasta and sauce and heat through , stir with tongs
26. Plate the pasta mixture , add the cooked meat on top
27. Add the crumbled gorgonzola , and drizzle the balsamic reduction over the top
28. Finish option 2: in a large skillet , heat over med / high heat
29. Add the sauce , cook 1 minute add the pasta and toss with tongs
30. Plate the pasta mixture , add the cooked meat on top
31. Add the crumbled gorgonzola , and drizzle the balsamic reduction over the top
32. Finish option 3: place cooked pasta on a plate , add some of the sauce , the meat , the gorgonzola cheese and drizzle the reduction
33. It is quick down and dirty , but the way i serve most days , unless i am trying to impress
34. This recipe may seem long , but i have tried to put as much detail into it as possible
35. There are a lot of advanced cooking techniques , that are hard to explain , but once you make the recipe it is actually quite easy and goes really fast 30-40 minutes
36. Thank you for bearing with me
37. Edit addition 07 / 19 / 18
38. Here is a new way to cook your lovely piece of meat
39. Heat a well seasoned cast iron skillet in the oven at 450f when the skillet is hot remove from the oven and place on med-high burner
40. Let it sit for at least one minute
41. Add the steak , prepared as before , and cook for 1-2 minutes per side
42. After the sear add 1 tablespoon of butter and place the skillet back into the oven for 4-7 minutes
43. This duration will depend on you preference in steak and the cut and thickness of the meat
44. When the time is up remove from the oven , place skillet off burner and remove the steak from the pan to rest 5-10 minutes
45. Cut into thin strips and place back into the skillet and mix well with the oils in the skillet , salt and pepper to taste

title: irish egg rolls
steps:
1. Heat oil in deep-fryer to 375 , or , if pan-frying , in heavy skillet
2. In bowl , mix together corned beef , cabbage , potatoes , carrot and onino
3. Season with salt and pepper to taste
4. Lay the egg roll wrappers on clean dry surface a few at a time
5. Place about 1 / 2 cup of filling into center of each wrap
6. Roll up into logs according to the directions on the package
7. Wet the edge with water to seal
8. Fry rolls a few at a time , turning as necessary , for about 5 minutes , or until golden
9. Remove from hot oil and drain on paper towels

title: jiffy cobbler
steps:
1. In a large mixing bowl
2. Mix together peach pie filling and blueberries and spoon onto bottom of a prepared 8-inch baking pan
3. Sprinkle cake mix over the top
4. Drizzle melted butter over cake mix and sprinkle chopped nuts on top
5. Bake in a preheated 350f oven for 45 to 50 minutes , or until top is golden brown
6. Variations:
7. Use apple pie filling and spice cake mix
8. Use blueberry pie filling and lemon cake mix
9. Use any pie filling combined with any cake mix

title: low fat asian halibut in foil
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees
2. Tear off 4 sheets of foil wrap , 12 inches by 18 inches each
3. Place halibut fillets in center of foil sheets
4. Top with vegetables
5. Combine ginger , vinegar and oil in a small bowl
6. Drizzle a little over each fish and vegetable mound
7. Close the foil packets by bringing the sides up and folding the edge over twice , then sealing the ends in the same way
8. Leave enough room inside for air to circulate
9. Place foil packets on a large cookie sheet and bake for 15-18 minutes

title: easy chicken and dumplings
steps:
1. Melt butter in a large saucepan
2. Add onion , carrot , bell pepper and celery
3. Saute until onion and pepper are soft , 4-5 minutes
4. Sprinkle flour and poultry seasoning over , stirring until flour is slightly cooked , 1-2 minutes
5. Add broth , cream , peas and chicken
6. Stir well
7. Bring to a heavy simmer
8. Cut each biscuit in quarters
9. Drop biscuit pieces into pot without stirring
10. Simmer 5 minutes uncovered , then lower heat , cover and simmer an additional 10 minutes , or until dumplings are cooked
11. Stir gently to distribute dumplings before serving

title: oven roasted eggplant and butternut squash curry
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450f
2. Wrap the eggplant and the butternut squash individually in aluminum foil
3. Place them on a baking tray and bake them for 1 1 / 2 hours or until they are very soft
4. The eggplants will become mushy and deflated
5. While the eggplant and butternut squah are cooking , heat oil in large frying pan on medium-high heat for 1 minute
6. Add cumin seeds and allow them to sizzle for about 30 seconds
7. Stir in onions and saute until brown , 8 to 10 minutes
8. Reduce heat to medium and stir in tomatoes
9. Add turmeric , fenugreek , coriander , black pepper , jalapeo pepper and salt
10. Cook this masala for 10 minutes
11. If the eggplant and squash are still cooking , remove the masala from the heat and set aside
12. Remove eggplant and squash from the oven and cool for 5 to 10 minutes so you can unwrap the aluminum foil
13. Using a pairing knife or potato peeler , peel the squash and discard the skin
14. Cut the squash in half
15. Using a spoon , scoop out the seeds from the squash
16. Cut in 1 / 2 inch cubes and place in mixing bowl
17. Using your hands , peel the skin from the eggplant
18. Discard the skins
19. Add the eggplants to the mixing bowl
20. Stir the eggplant and squash mixture into the masala
21. Turn the heat on to medium and cook , covered for 10 minutes
22. Just before serving , add the green onions and heat for 2 to 3 minutes
23. Remove from heat and stir in cilantro
24. Serve as main dish with chappatis or as a side dish

title: red lentil soup with spiced oil
steps:
1. In a large bowl wash the lentils in several changes of cold water until the water runs clear and drain them in a fine sieve
2. In a large heavy saucepan cook the onions in the oil over moderate heat , stirring , until they are softened , add the garlic and the gingerroot , and cook the mixture , stirring , for 1 minutes
3. Add the cumin and the ground coriander seeds and cook the mixture over moderately low heat , stirring , for 1 minute
4. Add the lentils , the broth , 1 1 / 2 cups water , and the tomatoes and simmer the mixture , covered , for 15 to 20 minutes , or until the lentils are tender
5. Use a stick blender to puree the soup or in a blender or food processor puree the mixture in batches , transferring it to a bowl as it is pureed , return the soup to the pan , cleaned , and season it with salt and pepper
6. The soup may be made 3 days in advance and kept covered and chilled
7. Reheat the soup and thin it , if necessary , with water
8. Make the spiced oil:
9. In a small skillet or saucepan heat the oil over moderately high heat until it is hot but not smoking , add the chili , the cuminseed , and the turmeric , and fry the spices , stirring , for 10 to 15 seconds , or until the sizzling begins to subside
10. Remove the skillet from the heat
11. Heat the soup over moderate heat , stirring , until it is hot and ladle it into bowls
12. Drizzle the spiced oil with a spoon over the soup , garnish each serving with a coriander sprig , and serve the soup with the pappadams
13. Make the pappadams:
14. In a skillet at least 2 inches wider than a pappadam heat 1 / 2 inch of the oil to 375f on a deep-fat thermometer and in it fry the pappadams , 1 at a time , turning them , for 10 to 15 seconds , or until they have expanded and turned pale golden
15. Transfer the pappadams as they are fried to paper towels to drain
16. The pappadams may be fried 1 day in advance and kept , covered loosely , at room temperature

title: best ham and bean soup ever
steps:
1. In a 3 quart saucepan , saute ham , onion and garlic in butter until onion is tender
2. Add the next seven ingredients
3. Cover and simmer for 30 minutes or until vegetables are tender
4. Add peas and cook for 5 minutes
5. Add parsley and serve

title: grilled salmon salsa wraps
steps:
1. For the limed sour cream: combine all ingredients in a small mixing bowl and stir thoroughly
2. For the salmon wraps: combine tomato , onion , red and green peppers , cilantro and lime juice in a bowl and mix well
3. Set aside
4. Lightly coat salmon with oil and season generously with salt and pepper
5. Grill fish , skin side up over hot fire until well-seared on bottom , about 2-3 minutes
6. Turn and grill just until fish is warmed through , but dark pink and creamy inside , 2-3 minutes longer
7. Remove skin and cool slightly
8. Working over the bowl of salsa , use your fingers to break fish into chunks
9. Combine with salsa and gently fold inches adjust seasoning with salt , pepper and lime juice
10. Grill each tortilla , flipping until warm and ever-so-slightly browned
11. Spoon 1 / 4 cup salmon salsa and 1 tablespoon limed sour cream down the center of 1 tortilla
12. Fold one end in , and roll up tightly
13. Cut in half and serve immediately

title: matzoh  brei  5 w w pts
steps:
1. Run warm water over each piece of matzoh until it begins to bend
2. Break each wet piece into 2-inch pieces
3. Mix matzoh with egg in a large bowl until well coated
4. In a large nonstick pan over medium heat melt butter
5. Add motzoh mixture and cook , turning occasionally , until motzoh just begins to brown and is warmed through , about 5 minutes
6. 1 cup per serving

title: caramelized bacon
steps:
1. Heat oven to 450f
2. Spray top of broiler pan lightly with no stick cooking spray
3. Line bottom of pan with aluminum foil
4. Combine brown sugar and cinnamon in small bowl
5. Coat bacon slices with brown sugar mixture
6. Place coated bacon onto prepared pan
7. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes or until well-browned
8. Immediately remove bacon
9. Place onto serving plate

title: self saucing cherry pudding
steps:
1. Spread the drained cherries evenly in the bottom of a deep 9 x 9 greased baking dish
2. To prepare batter , cream together the 3 / 4 cup sugar and butter until well blended , then stir in milk
3. Sift 1 cup flour , baking powder , and salt over creamed ingredients
4. Combine thoroughly until batter is smooth
5. Turn batter over cherries and smooth evenly with back of spoon
6. To make topping , mix together 1 / 4 cup sugar and 2 1 / 2 tbsp flour
7. Sprinkle it evenly over top of batter
8. Pour reserved cherry liquid in a 2 cup measure and add enough water to make 1 1 / 2 cups of liquid
9. Heat this liquid in a saucepan until boiling , then remove from heat and stir in red food colouring
10. Slowly , with a back and forth motion , pour liquid all over top of batter
11. Bake at 350 for 45 minutes

title: irish potato carrot pancakes
steps:
1. Shed potatoes and carrot
2. Wrap in several thicknesses of paper towels
3. Squeeze to remove excess moisture
4. Combine potatoes , carrot , onion , flour , egg , salt and pepper in medium bowl
5. Mix well
6. Heat oil in large skillet over medium heat
7. Drop spoonfuls of potato mixture into skillet
8. Flatten to form thin pancakes
9. Cook 5 minutes or until browned on bottom
10. Turn pancakes and cook 5 minutes or until potatoes are tender

title: mini fruit pizza
steps:
1. Mix the cream cheese and strawberry jam together
2. Spread the mix onto the bottom of each cookie
3. Top with the sliced strawberries
4. Sprinkle the powdered sugar over the top

title: broccoli  grapes  sunflower seeds cold salad
steps:
1. Chop broccoli , red onion , and grapes
2. Transfer to large bowl
3. Add bacos and sunflower seeds
4. Prepare sauce and add to bowl
5. Stir and serve or refrigerate

title: biscuit  bites
steps:
1. Heat oven to 425
2. Generously grease a large cookie sheet
3. In a large bowl , combine flour and cheese and mix well
4. Add salsa , margarine and water and stir just until blended
5. Knead dough gently on lightly floured surface just until smooth
6. Press or roll out dough to 12- x 6-inch rectangle
7. Cut into 2- x 1-inch strips with sharp knife or pizza cutter
8. Place strips about 1 / 2 inch apart on greased cookie sheet
9. Bake for 11 to 13 minutes or until light golden brown
10. Serve warm

title: impossible breakfast pie
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400 degrees and grease a 10 inch pie plate
2. Cook sausage and onion until sausage is fully cooked
3. Drain
4. Mix sausage , potatoes and 1 cup cheddar cheese in pie plate
5. Combine remaining ingredients except the 1 / 4 cup cheese and pour into pie plate with the sausage and potato mixture
6. Bake about 40 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean
7. Sprinkle with remaining 1 / 4 cup cheese and bake an additional 2 minutes or until cheese melts

title: potato salad with rosmary and capers
steps:
1. Peel potatoes and cut into 1
2. 5cm dice
3. Cook diced potatoes in a large saucepan of boiling water until just tender , and drain
4. Panfry bacon until crisp
5. Transfer warm diced potato and bacon to a large bowl , stir in rosemary , capers , onion and mayonaise
6. Mix until all ingrediants are combined
7. Serve salad either warm or cold

title: cinnamon honey bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Grease 15x10inch baking pan
3. In large bowl , combine flour , sugar , cinnamon , and baking soda
4. Add oil , 1 / 4 cup honey and egg
5. Stir until combined
6. Stir in walnuts
7. Press into prepared pan using waxed paper or hands
8. Bake 18-20 minutes or till toothpick inserted comes out clean
9. In small bowl , combine powdered sugar , butter , vanilla , hot water and remaining 2 tbsp honey
10. Beat until smooth
11. Spread over warm bars
12. Cool completely before cutting into bars

title: black magic  black lentils   soybean dal
steps:
1. Put soaked lentils and soyabeans in a cooker with 4 cups of water
2. Add salt , turmeric powder and onions along
3. Pressure cook for 18-20 minutes on medium heat
4. If you do not use a pressure cooker then you have to wait till the ingredients turn absolutely tender and may have to increase the quantity of water in the pot
5. This will take a longer time
6. Meanwhile take a pan and melt the butter
7. Add garlic and brown the same
8. Add all the remaining spices and turn the heat off
9. Open the cooker and mash dal gently
10. Transfer the same to the pan
11. Add some water if the consistency is too thick
12. Take care that it does not turn too watery
13. Garnish with fresh coriander leaves
14. Serve warm with a dash of fresh cream
15. This goes well with steamed white rice and indian breads

title: easy raspberry bars
steps:
1. Set oven to 350
2. Combine flour , sugar , walnuts , butter and egg in large bowl
3. Beat on low speed for 2 minutes , or until mixture is crumbly
4. Reserve 1-1 / 2 cups of crumb mixture for topping
5. Press remaining crumb mixture in botom of 11" x 7" baking pan
6. Stir raspberry preserves until smooth
7. Spread over crumb crust , to within 1 / 2" of sides of pan
8. Crumble the 1-1 / 2 cups of reserved mixture over the top
9. Bake for 45 minutes , or until lightly browned
10. Cool completely and cut into small bars

title: boo boo bananakins
steps:
1. Mix together 2 cups self raising flour
2. 1 / 2 cup sugar
3. 1 egg
4. 1 cup water
5. 1 / 2 teaspoon cinnamon
6. Mash banana and add to batter a mix in until smooth
7. Add butter to frying pan , not too much though , let it get hot
8. Place 1 / 4 cup of batter in pan and when it has bubbles on the top , flip it over and cook the other side

title: omelette souffle
steps:
1. Beat egg yolks with sugar , salt , and lemon rind
2. Beat egg whites until stiff
3. Fold into yolk mixture
4. Heat butter in a 9" skillet
5. When begins to bubble , add egg mixture
6. Cook slowly til bottom is golden brown
7. Cover pan til top is completely cooked , or serve with top slightly runny , as with a regular french omelette
8. You may also turn it browned on both sides
9. Spread with fruit sauce or preserves
10. Fold in half and serve

title: salsa chicken
steps:
1. Make the rice
2. While making the rice , dump the entire jar of salsa into a large pan
3. Bring to a simmer over med heat
4. Add chicken and cover
5. Cook for 20 minutes or until chicken is done
6. Serve over rice

title: seattle lasagna
steps:
1. Cook lasagna noodles in boiling salted water until tender , about 15 minutes
2. Heat salad oil in skillet
3. Cook garlic and onion until soft
4. Add beef and seasonings
5. Cook until crumbly
6. Add tomato paste and hot water
7. Simmer 5 minutes
8. Set aside
9. Blend beaten eggs with cottage cheese or ricotta cheese
10. Put a thin layer of meat sauce in a 9x13x2 baking dish
11. Then half of the noodles , all of the cottage cheese mixture , half of the mozzarella , half of the meat sauce
12. Rest of noodles , rest of the sauce , and rest of the mozzarella
13. Top with parmesan cheese
14. Bake uncovered at 350 for 30 minutes
15. Let cool for 5 minutes before serving
16. Unbaked casserole can be frozen
17. Allow to come to room temperature before baking
18. Also , leftover lasagna freezes well

title: steamed pork wontons
steps:
1. The 8 ounces pork loin should be ground together with 1 ounce of fatback or suet
2. Blanch bamboo shoots for 1 minute in boiling water
3. Drain , pat dry and mince finely
4. In a large bowl , combine pork , bamboo shoots , sesame oil , rice wine , cornstarch , egg white , salt , sugar and pepper until well mixed
5. Form into 30 1-inch balls
6. Trim the corners of won ton wrappers to form circles
7. Cover with plastic wrap to prevent them from drying out
8. To assemble , place a meatball in the center of each wrapper and bring up sides , to form an open topped basket
9. Flatten the top of each meatball with a butter knife dipped in water and flatten bottoms of dumpling so they stand upright
10. Place on a lightly oiled plate and set in bamboo steamer or on an inverted heatproof bowl or trivet set in a wok filled with 2 inches of boiling water
11. Cover and steam for 5 to 8 minutes or until done
12. Serve hot

title: fast and easy stromboli
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 and spray a cookie sheet with nonstick spray
2. On a lightly floured surface , press pizza dough into a 9x12 rectangle
3. Top with mozzarella , leaving a 1 / 2 to 1 inch border
4. Top with proscuitto , pepperoni and diced roasted red peppers
5. Roll up jelly-roll style , seal the edges and place seam-side down on the baking sheet
6. Bake at 375 for about 25 minutes or until golden
7. Serve with a side of warm marinara sauce for dipping

title: cheesy hash spinach pie
steps:
1. Prepare pastry shell
2. Prick bottom and sides well with fork
3. Bake at 450 for 10 to 12 minutes
4. Remove from over
5. Reduce oven temperature to 350
6. Cook spinach according to package directions , except omit salt
7. Drain well , pressing out excess water
8. Combine eggs , mushroom soup , flour , horseradish and mustard
9. Stir in drained spinach
10. Spread hash in baked pie shell
11. Spoon spinach mixture over
12. Bake , uncovered , at 350 for 45 minutes
13. Combine cheese and pimiento , sprinkle over pie
14. Bake 2 to 3 minutes longer
15. Let stand 5 minutes

title: caramelized pineapple and mango
steps:
1. Melt butter in frypan over moderately high heat
2. Add fruit and cook and stir for 3 or 4 minutes till browned
3. Add sugar and rum
4. Cook and stir further 3 or 4 minutes till mixture thickens and caramelizes
5. Cool for 30 minutes

title: traditional roast beef with gravy
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Rub outside of meat with pepper , salt and garlic
3. Place on a rack in a baking dish
4. Pour 1 / 3 cup water into bottom of baking dish
5. Roast beef , allowing 25 minutes per pound for medium rare , a little longer for well done
6. Cover loosely with foil
7. Stand for 15 minutes before carving
8. To prepare gravy: drain off all except 1 tblsp of fat from the baking dish
9. Place dish over a low heat
10. Add flour and stir well to incorporate all the bits and pieces in the dish
11. Cook , stirring constantly , over medium heat until well-browned , taking care not to burn
12. Combine wine , stock and tomato paste
13. Gradually stir into flour mixture
14. Heat , stirring constantly , until gravy boils and thickens
15. Cook for about 3 minutes
16. Season to taste

title: country style pork and sauerkraut
steps:
1. Heat oil in frying pan , brown ribs and season with onion salt / powder
2. Place in baking dish
3. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over ribs
4. Cover and bake at 350 for 1 1 / 2 to 2 hours

title: shredded mexican chicken
steps:
1. Remove remaining fat and skin from chicken
2. Rub lime halves all over chicken and allow to sit to impart flavor
3. In a large pot , bring next 6 ingredients to a boil
4. Add chicken , reduce heat and simmer until chicken is cooked
5. Meanwhile , mix salsa , cumin and chili powder in a large bowl
6. Drain chicken until it is cool enough to handle
7. Add chicken to salsa mixture and shred chicken with two forks , stirring to distribute salsa and seasoning
8. Add salt and pepper to taste

title: butternut squash pesto pizza flatbread
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400f
2. In s medium bowl , mix squash , onion , brown sugar , salt , black pepper and 1 1 / 2 tablespoons of the oil
3. Spread mixture in ungreased 13x9-inch glass baking dish
4. Bake about 20 minutes , stirring occasionally , until squash is tender
5. Spray large cookie sheet with cooking spray
6. Unroll pizza crust dough on cookie sheet into 13x9-inch rectangle
7. Bake at 400f 7 to 10 minutes or until light golden brown
8. Meanwhile , in a 10-inch skillet , heat remaining 1 / 2 tablespoon oil over medium heat
9. Add pancetta
10. Cook 4 minutes , stirring frequently , until lightly browned
11. Drain
12. Spread pesto over partially baked crust
13. Top with squash mixture , pancetta , roasted peppers , walnuts and cheeses
14. Bake 6 to 8 minutes longer or until edges are golden brown
15. Let stand 5 minutes before serving

title: wheat free feather pancake
steps:
1. Blend all ingredients until there are no lumps
2. Drop batter by spoon onto lightly greased griddle until 1 side bubbles
3. Flip pancakes and bake until golden brown

title: greek honey   lemon cake with a twist
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 200c / 400f lightly grease and line a 7 1 / 2 inch square deep cake tin
2. Place margarine / butter and 3 tablespoon honey in a saucepan and heat gently till melted
3. Reserve 1 tablespoon lemon juice , stir in the rest with lemon rind and milk
4. Combine both the lemon mixture and butter mixture together
5. Sift together the flour , baking powder and nutmeg , add to the wet mixture
6. Add the semolina flour into the mixture
7. Fold egg whites evenly into the mixture
8. Spoon into cake tin and sprinkle with sesame seeds
9. Bake for 25-39 minutes , till golden brown
10. Mix the reserved honey and lemon juice and drizzle over the cake while it is still warm
11. Cool in the tin , then cut into fingers to serve

title: butternut squash cookies
steps:
1. In a large mixing bowl , cream butter and sugars until fluffy
2. Beat in the eggs and squash
3. Stir well
4. Sift together the flour , baking soda , baking powder , and spices and add to mixture , stirring until well blended
5. Stir in raisins and nuts
6. Spoon onto cookie sheets and bake at 375 degrees f for 10-12 minutes

title: mile high spaghetti pie
steps:
1. Lightly grease an 8" spring form pan and preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Brown sausage in a skillet with onions and garlic , salt & pepper making sure to break up meat into small bits
3. Pour in sauce and simmer while cooking spaghetti in a seperate pot until just done
4. Remove sauce from heat and drain pasta
5. Also , while doing this , thaw the broccoli and squeeze as much water out as possible
6. Press the biscuits into the spring form pan , making sure to press the edges together and up the sides of the pan to form a thin crust covering the entire bottom and sides
7. Spread 1 / 2 the meat sauce into bottom of the pan
8. Sprinkle 1 / 3 of the cheese over sauce
9. Place all of the pasta on top
10. Cover pasta with remaining sauce
11. Sprinkle with 1 / 3 more cheese
12. Top this with the broccoli , then the tomato and finally the olives
13. Bake for 20 minutes
14. Remove from oven and top with the remaining cheese , bake for 5 more minutes
15. Remove and let rest for 10 minutes
16. Release from the pan and place on a platter to serve

title: cream   cheesy corn
steps:
1. In saucepan , cook bacon until crisp
2. Remove bacon , reserving 2 tablespoons of drippings in pan
3. Drain bacon and set aside
4. If using fresh corn , cut the corn from cobs , with a sharp knife , at 2 / 3 depth of the kernels-- do not scrape cob
5. Add the fresh or frozen corn , water , onion and pepper to the saucepan
6. Bring just to boiling
7. Reduce heat , cover and simmer for 5 to 7 minutes , or until corn is crisp-tender
8. Add the cream cheese to the undrained corn mixture
9. Stir over low heat until melted
10. If necessary , stir in the milk to make corn mixture of desired consistency
11. Stir in reserved bacon and serve
12. Enjoy !

title: don t peek stew
steps:
1. Using a large dutch oven , put in the beef first--this is the first layer
2. The 2nd layer is carrots
3. The 3rd layer is celery
4. The 4th layer is onions
5. Then combine all of the dry ingredients
6. Combine dry ingredients with tomato juice
7. Pour this mixture over the meat and veggies
8. Cover with lid or foil
9. Bake 5 hours at 200 degrees
10. The secret is the slow baking and not peeking
11. Don't peek !

title: chicken with honeyed vegetables over penne
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to package directions
2. Slice chicken and set aside
3. Starting with the harder veggies , stir-fry the vegetables for 8 to 10 minutes or until tender but still slightly crisp
4. Mix all the honey dressing ingredients together and gently heat in a saucepan or the microwave until the honey is melted
5. Toss the chicken into the pan with veggies
6. Pour the hot dressing over the warm vegetables and chicken
7. Serve over hot pasta

title: port  wine mushroom sauce
steps:
1. In a medium skillet , melt the butter and saute the mushrooms for about 3 minutes , then stir in flour , combining well
2. In another skillet , combine the wine , shallots and vinegar , boiling until thickk , about 3 minutes
3. Reduce heat to medium
4. Add broth , worcestershire , tomato paste and rosemary , cooking for 1 minute
5. Add mushroom mixture and cook 3 minutes , stirring constantly , then add mustard to sauce
6. Serve warm

title: conch chowder
steps:
1. Grind conchs
2. Fry salt pork in large pot , then add onion , pepper , tomatoes , ground conch , potatoes and water
3. Cook for about an hour or until the potatoes fall apart and thicken the chowder
4. Turn off heat and let the chowder stand for about an hour to mingle the flavors
5. It will improve more if made the day ahead
6. Just reheat to serve

title: zaar chat buffalo roast
steps:
1. Mix all brine ingredients together in a large pan
2. Bring to a boil
3. Lower heat and simmer for 15 minutes
4. Allow to cool but it does not need to be cold either
5. Put the buffalo roast in the brine and cover with a lid
6. Refrigerate for 48 hours to attain ultimate tenderness
7. After the 48 hours remove the roast from the brine and rinse it off
8. Discard brine
9. Put the roast in a large crockpot
10. Add all of the roast ingredients except the potatoes
11. Stir until all of the ingredients are well mixed
12. Set crockpot on low
13. Cook for 8-9 hours on low or until fork tender
14. Add the potatoes and cook for another 30 minutes or until potatoes are done
15. Remove roast from the crockpot and put it on a plate
16. While the roast is still hot , slice or shred it , depending on how you like it
17. If you want it as a soup , return meat to the crockpot , bring it back to a boil and serve it in bowls
18. If you want it as a stew , thicken the broth to your desired consistency and return the meat to the stew
19. If you want it as a main dish , remove the vegetables to the meat plate and thicken the broth to make a gravy at your desired consistency
20. This can be served with whatever you want to serve it with
21. Now , enjoy !

title: pilgrim s cole slaw
steps:
1. Shred the cabbage into 1 / 4-inch slices
2. Shred the carrots
3. Toast the pine nuts , if desired
4. In a small bowl , mix the mayonnaise , cranberry shallot relish , honey and salt to make a dressing
5. In a larger bowl , combine the other ingredients
6. Pour over and fold in the dressing mixture to coat all the ingredients well
7. Chill at least a couple of hours to meld flavors

title: crab rangoon wonton cups
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees
2. Lightly spray 12 small muffin cups
3. Melt 1 tablespoon of butter and lightly brush each wonton pastry before pushing into muffin cups
4. Saute green onions
5. Melt cheeses and mayonnaise in pan
6. Add seasonings and lemon juice
7. Add filling to heat only
8. Scoop into wonton cups
9. Bake 12-15 minutes until wontons are golden brown

title: kool   aid   jello popsicles
steps:
1. In a 2-quart glass measure , combine the kool-aid , jello powder and sugar
2. Add hot water and stir until completely dissolved
3. Stir in cold water
4. Pour into popsicle molds and freeze

title: sweet pickled banana peppers
steps:
1. Sterilize 2- 1 / 2 pint jars
2. Bring the vinegar , sugar , mustard seed and celery seed to a rolling boil
3. Place peppers in the 1 / 2 pint jars
4. Pour on the hot pickling juice and bring liquid to within 1 / 2" of the top
5. Be sure the edge of the jar has no juice on it
6. Place lids and screw on bands finger-
7. Seal jar and leave for 2 weeks
8. This is an heirloom recipe that uses a method no longer recommended by the usda / nchfp
9. Current guidelines recommend processing in a boiling water bath at least 10 minutes at sea level to 1000 feet in elevation and left to cool , upright and undisturbed , on a cloth-protected counter for 24 hours
10. Check for seal
11. If the jar hasn't sealed , either re-process the jars within the 24 hours or refrigerate and use first

title: oatmeal raisin applesauce cookies
steps:
1. Heat the oven to 375f lightly grease cooking sheet
2. In a large bowl combine the flour , baking powder , baking soda and salt
3. In the bowl of an electric mixer , cream the butter and both sugars together
4. Beat until smooth , about 1 minute
5. Add the applesauce , egg and vanilla and mix until blended about 2 minutes
6. Add the flour to the applesauce mixture and mix well
7. Remove the bowl from the mixer and stir in the oats and raisins
8. Drop rounded teaspoonfuls onto the prepared baking sheets about two inches apart
9. Bake until slightly golden , about 10 to 12 minutes
10. Remove the baking sheets from the oven and cool on wire racks for 5 minutes
11. Remove the cookies and cool completely

title: white chocolate macadamia toffee
steps:
1. Line a 15xl0xl-inch baking pan with foil , extending foil over edges of pan
2. Set aside
3. Butter the sides of a heavy 2-quart saucepan
4. Melt the 1 cup butter in saucepan
5. Add sugar , the water , and corn syrup
6. Cook and stir over medium high heat until mixture boils
7. Clip a candy thermometer to side of pan
8. Reduce heat to medium
9. Continue boiling at a moderate , steady rate , stirring frequently , until thermometer registers 290f , soft-crack stage
10. Watch carefully after 280 degrees f
11. To prevent scorching
12. Remove pan from heat
13. Remove thermometer
14. Stir in vanilla
15. Pour candy into the prepared pan , spreading quickly to about 1 / 4-inch thickness
16. Let candy stand for 2 to 3 minutes or just until set
17. Sprinkle with white baking pieces
18. Let stand for 1 to 2 minutes
19. When baking pieces are soft , spread over candy
20. Sprinkle with nuts , pressing lightly into melted white chocolate
21. Chill in the refrigerator about 20 minutes or until firm
22. Use foil to lift candy out of pan
23. Break candy into pieces about 2 inches in size
24. Store candy in a tightly covered container in the refrigerator for up to 3 weeks

title: chipotle salsa negra  dark chipotle salsa
steps:
1. Rinse chiles
2. Heat half of the oil in a cast-iron skillet over medium heat
3. Add chiles and garlic and cook , stirring , about 5 minutes
4. Set garlic aside
5. Transfer chiles to a bowl and cover with hot water
6. Let soak until soft
7. Drain and remove stems , seeds and veins
8. Pure chiles , garlic and 2 cups water
9. Heat the other 3 tablespoons of oil in the same skillet over medium-high heat
10. When the oil is hot , add the pureed salsa and cook , stirring occasionally , until thickened , about 10 minutes
11. Season to taste with salt

title: easy tomato chutney
steps:
1. Take a non stick heavy bottom pan and heat the oil
2. Put bay leaves , cloves , cinnamon first and then add onion , garlic , salt and black pepper powder
3. Saute for 2 minutes and add chopped tomatoes , salt and sugar
4. Keep covered and stirring for 10 minutes or until tomatoes are soft
5. Allow to cool to the room temperature
6. Add nutmeg now
7. Put the mixture in the blender and blend till smooth
8. Fill in a sterilised jar and keep refrigerated

title: salsa de picante
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in a large pot and bring to a boil
2. Boil for 5 minutes
3. Cool & refrigerate

title: baked beans don t get any better than this
steps:
1. Fry bacon
2. Remove from pan and set aside
3. When cooled , break up into small pieces
4. In the bacon grease , cook ground beef and onions until beef is no longer pink
5. Mix all the ingredients together , stir well
6. Pour in a 9 x 13 baking dish
7. Bake at 350 for about 1 hour
8. These are sweet baked beans
9. You may cut back or eliminate the brown sugar according to your tastes

title: pork chops with savory blueberry sauce
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 425f
2. Salt and pepper both sides of each pork chop
3. Heat a tablespoon of oil over medium-high heat in an oven-proof skillet big enough to hold all four pork chops
4. Brown the pork chops , about 2 minutes on each side
5. Remove the chops from the pan and transfer to an ovenproof platter
6. Place in oven
