7. Remove when the pork is just cooked through , about 10-12 minutes
8. While the pork chops are in the oven , prepare the sauce
9. Heat a tablespoon of oil on medium high heat in the same skillet you used to brown the chops
10. Saut the shallots until soft and golden
11. Add the wine and water and let boil down for 1-2 minutes , scraping up the brown bits
12. Add the blueberries
13. When the skins begin to burst , add the lemon zest and juice
14. Let the sauce continue to boil and thicken until the pork chops are ready
15. Once the pork chops are ready , remove the pan from the oven and place the pork chops on a cutting board and let them rest while finishing the sauce
16. Turn the heat off under the saucepan and stir in the butter until it is completely melted
17. If using unsalted butter , add a pinch of salt
18. Serve the pork chops either whole or sliced , topped with the blueberry sauce and fresh parsley

title: lemon freeze dessert
steps:
1. Combine corn flake crumbs , 2 tbsp sugar and melted butter in an 8 inch pie pan
2. Mix well
3. Remove 1- 2 tbsp of the mixture and reserve for topping
4. Press remaining mixture of crumbs to evenly form crust
5. Beat egg yolks until thick
6. Combine with condensed milk
7. Add lemon juice and lemon peel
8. Stir until thickened
9. Beat egg whites until stiff , not dry
10. Gradually add 3 tbsp sugar to egg whites
11. Fold gently into lemon mixture
12. Pour into pie pan
13. Sprinkle with reserved crumbs
14. Freeze until firm
15. Remove from freezer 10- 15 minutes before serving

title: cabbage burger casserole
steps:
1. Place 1 / 2 cabbage into crockpot , crumble beef over the top sprinkle with salt and pepper
2. Evenly sprinkle rice and onion over top
3. Top with cabbage and pepper
4. Combine spaghetti sauce , water and remaining spices
5. Pour over cabbage
6. Cover and cook on low 5-6 hours or until rice is tender

title: blueberry curd
steps:
1. Place the blueberries and lime zest in a covered saucepan with 1 tablespoon water and cook gently , shaking the pan occasionally , until very soft
2. Press through a fine sieve into a heatproof bowl or the top of a double boiler , then stir in the butter and sugar and put over a saucepan of gently simmering water
3. Do not allow the bottom of the bowl to sit in the water
4. Heat gently , stirring , until the sugar has dissolved and the butter has melted
5. Strain in the eggs and continue to stir over gently simmering water until the curd thickens enough to coat the back of the spoon , which should take 30-40 minutes
6. Stir only occasionally at first , more frequently as the cooking progresses , then constantly toward the end so that the curd cooks evenly and does not curdle
7. The water must not boil
8. Strain the curd , if necessary , into clean , dry jars
9. Refrigerate up to 2 weeks

title: mamounia
steps:
1. Melt the butter in a heavy pan
2. Lightly brown the semolina on low heat for 5 minutes
3. Meanwhile , combine the sugar , water and milk in another pan and bring almost to a boil
4. Once the semolina is done , gently stir in the sugar / milk mixture
5. Use a whisk to break up any lumps
6. Cook to desired consistency
7. For me , this step only took about 2 minutes
8. If the mixture is too thick , add a little bit of milk or water
9. Stir in the rosewater
10. Spoon the semolina pudding into individual dessert cups and set aside to cool slightly
11. Cover and chill
12. Just before serving , sprinkle the top of the pudding with ground cinnamon and garnish with the sliced almonds

title: hot five bean salad
steps:
1. In a skillet , cook bacon until crisp
2. Reserve 1 / 4 c drippings
3. Set the bacon aside
4. Add sugar , cornstarch , salt and pepper to drippings
5. Stir in vinegar and water
6. Bring to a boil , stirring constantly
7. Cook and stir for two minutes
8. Add the beans
9. Reduce heat
10. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes or until beans are heated through
11. Place in a serving bowl
12. Top with bacon

title: bittersweet flourless chocolate cake
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
2. Butter the sides and bottom of a 10-inch springform pan and set aside
3. In the top of a double boiler , combine the butter , chocolate and coffee and melt slowly , stirring occasionally , until smooth
4. Remove from the heat and let cool for 5 minutes
5. In a medium mixing bowl , whisk together the eggs , sugar and vanilla until frothy
6. Whisk the eggs into the melted chocolate until combined
7. Pour the mixture into the prepared pan
8. Bake for 1 hour and cool on a wire rack until it reaches room temperature
9. Remove the sides of the pan , cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight , before serving

title: mexican spiced rice
steps:
1. Mix dry rice , spices and dried onions
2. Cook rice according to package directions , either on stove top or in rice cooker
3. Fluff rice with fork
4. Add cheese to warm rice and let melt a bit
5. Add cilantro and combine well

title: creamsicle party punch
steps:
1. Place ice-cream and sherbert in punch bowl
2. Pour juice over both
3. Lastly add soda and give a quick stir

title: pumpkin polenta cake
steps:
1. Adjust rack to lower third of oven
2. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
3. Grease and flour a 10-inch angel food tube pan
4. For best results , have all ingredients at room temperature
5. Sift together the flour , spices , baking powder , baking soda and salt
6. Set aside
7. Using an electric mixer , preferably with a paddle attachment , beat the butter at medium speed until creamy and smooth
8. Add the brown and granulated sugars
9. Beat until light
10. Add the eggs , 1 at a time , beating well after each addition
11. Reduce mixer speed to low
12. Add the pumpkin puree and polenta
13. Add the flour mixture to the pumpkin mixture alternately with the milk , ending with the dry ingredients , and stir just until well blended
14. Pour the batter into the prepared pan , spreading it evenly
15. Bake for 55 to 65 minutes , or until a cake tester comes out free of raw batter
16. Remove the pan from the oven and place on a wire rack
17. Let the cake cool in the pan for about 10 minutes
18. Invert the cake onto the wire rack
19. Remove the cake pan
20. Let the cake cool completely before slicing

title: spam  i am     home made spam
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300f
2. Grind the pork shoulder in a meat grinder (either use a tabletop meat grinder or a kitchenaid mixer with the meat grinder attachment
3. Set aside
4. Finely mince the ham with the garlic in a food processor
5. Dump the ground pork shoulder , minced ham / garlic mixture and the tender quick into a large bowl and mix by hand until fully combined
6. Pack the meat mixture into a bread pan and cover with foil
7. Place the bread pan into a large baking dish filled 3 / 4 full with water
8. Place the baking dish in the oven and bake for three hours
9. Remove from the oven and uncover the bread pan
10. Pour off all of the fat into a jar or can to dispose of later
11. If you do , your loaf will be covered in a thick coat of gelatine
12. Cover the bread pan loosely with foil and place a heavy weight on top of the foil
13. Place the weighed down spam loaf into the refrigerator and keep it there overnight
14. In the morning , your spam will be ready to use however you choose to use it
15. Keep it as long as you would keep ham

title: one bowl chocolate cupcakes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Line standard muffin tins with paper liners
3. Set aside
4. Sift together cocoa powder , flour , sugar , baking soda , baking powder , and salt into a large bowl
5. Add eggs , warm water , buttermilk , oil , and vanilla , and mix until smooth , about 3 minutes
6. Scrape down the sides and bottom of bowl to assure batter is well mixed
7. Divide batter evenly among muffin cups , filling each 2 / 3 full
8. Bake until tops spring back when touched , about 20 minutes , rotating pan once if needed
9. Transfer to a wire rack
10. Let cool completely

title: rooibos milk
steps:
1. Combine in a shaker
2. Mix until frothy
3. Pour into ice filled glasses

title: spinach and chickpeas with couscous
steps:
1. Heat 1 / 4 cup broth in a large saucepan
2. Add onion , garlic and curry powder and saute until onion begins to soften , about 4 minutes
3. Add remaining broth and spinach
4. Bring to a boil , reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes
5. Stir in chickpeas and black pepper , continue simmering until spinach is tender and chickpeas are heated through
6. Pour boiling water over couscous , cover and let stand for 5 minutes
7. Divide couscous among bowls
8. Serve spinach-chickpea mixture over couscous

title: coconut sorbet
steps:
1. Whip the coconut milk with the instant pudding
2. Pour into a freezer container and freeze for several hours
3. To serve , scrape sorbet with a heavy spoon and serve shavings in a dessert glass

title: peking beef
steps:
1. Mix all of the marinade ingredients together in a mixing bowl
2. Make sure you mix them well
3. Put meat into mixture and cover
4. Refridgerate for 2 hours
5. Heat frypan over medium heat
6. Add oil
7. When oil is hot add marinaded meat
8. Leave frypan at medium heat until beef is cooked
9. When meat is cooked turn the frypan down to a simmer
10. Sauce should start to thicken up within 10 minutes
11. If you are still not happy with the consistency you can add a bit more corn flour
12. Remember to mix it with water first

title: peanut butter and butterscotch rice krispies squares
steps:
1. Cook syrup and sugar on low heat until it comes to a boil
2. Remove and add peanut butter and cereal
3. Press into a buttered 13 x 9-inch pan and let harden
4. Melt chocolate chips and butterscotch chips in top of double boiler
5. Stir to blend
6. Spread over the rice mixture and chill for 5 minutes before cutting to desired size

title: olney inn imperial crab
steps:
1. Place crabmeat in large bowl , after removal of cartilage and shell
2. Mix mayonnaise , pimento , worcestershire sauce , salt , and tabasco together
3. Pour over crabmeat and toss gently , not to break lumps
4. Divide crabmeat between 8 shell-shaped baking dishes
5. Top each shell with 1 tablespoon mayonnaise
6. Sprinkle with paprika
7. Place baking shells on shallow baking pan
8. Bake at 375f for 20 minutes
9. Garnish with sprig of parsley , or cross 2 strips of pimento

title: italian screwdriver
steps:
1. In a tall glass , add all ingredients except ice
2. Stir
3. Add ice to glass to fill

title: mushroom sauce   salsa di funghi
steps:
1. Melt the butter in a large saute pan , and cook the garlic until it is soft
2. Stir in the mushrooms , and cook until they begin to give off their liquid
3. Transfer the mushrooms to a bowl , and set aside
4. Brown the pork sausage in the same pan , breaking it up with a fork
5. Season with salt and pepper
6. If the sausage seems dry , add a little butter to the pan while it is cooking
7. Return the mushrooms to the pan , and mix ingredients well
8. Cover the pan and keep warm
9. Cook the fettucine as directed on the package , then drain it , and add it to the pan with the sausage mixture
10. Stir in the cream and cheese , and mix everything quickly over med-high heat , until the mixture is hot
11. Serve immediately

title: chinese beef and mango stir fry
steps:
1. Combine sugar , soy sauce , garlic , and triple sec in a large bowl an mix well
2. Add meat , combine and coat
3. Cover and refrigerate 1 to 4 hours
4. Drain meat , reserving marinade
5. Add cornstarch to reserved marinated and mix until blended
6. Set aside
7. Add oil to a large wok or skillet and bring to medium heat
8. Stir fry steak for 3 minutes or until almost cooked through
9. Add broccoli and stir fry for another 3 minutes , or until tender
10. Add reserved marinade and mango and bring to a boil
11. Stir constantly for two minutes or until sauce thickens and coats the meat
12. Add chili powder
13. Season to taste with pepper
14. Serve over cooked rice

title: lemon cream dessert
steps:
1. In a small saucepan , combine sugar and cornstarch , gradually stir in water until smooth
2. Bring to a boil , cook and stir for 1 minute or until thickened
3. Remove from heat
4. Stir a small amount of hot filling into egg yolk , return egg yolk mixture to the pan , stirring constantly
5. Bring to a gentle boil cook and stir for 1 minute
6. Remove from the heat , stir in butter and lemon peel
7. Gently stir in lemon juice
8. Refrigerate until cool
9. In a small bowl combine flour and nuts
10. Cut in butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs
11. Press into a 13x9x2-inch baking pan
12. Bake at 350f for 15 minutes or until edges are golden brown
13. Cool on wire rack
14. In a mixing bowl , beat the cream cheese and confectioners sugar until smooth
15. Carefully spread over crust
16. Spread the cooled lemon mixture the cream cheese
17. In another bowl , beat milk and pudding mixes on low for 2 minutes beat in vanilla
18. Fold in half of the whipped topping
19. Spread this over the lemon mixture
20. Spread the remaining whipped topping over this
21. Chill for at least 4 hours
22. I try to make this at night so it has plenty of time to get cold and set

title: mini smoky bacon wraps
steps:
1. Set oven to 350f
2. Grease a baking sheet
3. Cut each bacon slice into thirds
4. Wrap each slice around each of the small smokies
5. Place in foil-lined baking pan
6. Bake for about 10 minutes
7. Meanwhile in a small bowl mix together the ketchup with brown sugar to form a thick mixture
8. Remove the cocktail wieners from oven and brush about 1 teaspoon of the ketchup / brown sugar mixture over the wiener
9. Place back in the oven and bake until the bacon is lightly crisp

title: brunch in a bun
steps:
1. Slice the buns horizontally and spread the bottom half thinly with butter or margarine and the top half with english mustard
2. Fry the sausages and bacon , and broil or grill the sliced cherry tomato , and at the last minute fry the eggs
3. Drain and arrange on the bun
4. Season with pepper
5. Serve with apple juice , coffee and bran muffins

title: chicken enchiladas  from southern living
steps:
1. Melt butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat
2. Add onions and cook 20 minutes or until tender
3. Reduce heat to low
4. Add chopped chicken , roasted pepper , and cream cheese
5. Stir until combined
6. Set aside
7. Pulse chiles and next 5 ingredients in blender or food processor several times until combined
8. Bring chile mixture and chicken broth to a boil in a saucepan over high heat
9. Cook 5 minutes or until slightly thickened
10. Remove from heat and stir in salsa
11. Spread one half of the chile mixture on bottom of a lightly greased 13x9 baking dish
12. Spoon chicken mixture evenly down center of each tortilla
13. Roll up and place , seam side down , in prepared baking dish
14. Top with remaining chile mixture , spreading to coat
15. Sprinkle with cheese
16. Bake at 375 for 20 to 25 minutes or until bubbly

title: fruit cocktail coconut cake
steps:
1. Combine cake mix , fruit cocktail with syrup , 1 cup coconut and eggs in large bowl
2. Beat at medium speed with electric mixer for 2 minutes
3. Pour into greased 13x9 inch baking pan
4. Sprinkle with brown sugar
5. Bake at 325 degrees for 45 minutes or until cake springs back when lightly touched
6. In saucepan bring butter , sugar and milk to a boil , boil 2 minutes
7. Remove from heat , stir in remaining coconut
8. Spoon over hot cake in pan
9. Serve warm or cool

title: coffeehouse chocolate spoons
steps:
1. In a heavy saucepan heat semisweet chocolate pieces over low heat , stirring constantly until the chocolate begins to melt
2. Immediately remove from heat
3. Stir until smooth
4. Dip half of the spoons into chocolate , tapping handle of each spoon against side of pan to remove excess chocolate
5. Place spoons on waxed paper
6. Refrigerate for 30 minutes to allow chocolate to set up
7. In a heavy saucepan heat white baking bar over low heat , stirring constantly until baking bar begins to melt
8. Immediately remove from heat
9. Stir until smooth
10. Dip remaining spoons into the melted baking bar
11. Refrigerate for 30 minutes to set up
12. Place the remaining melted white baking bar in a small , self-sealing heavy plastic bag
13. Using scissors , make a small opening at one bottom corner of the bag
14. Drizzle one or both sides of the chocolate-coated spoons with the melted white baking bar
15. Drizzle remaining melted bittersweet chocolate on white baking bar-coated spoons
16. Refrigerate spoons for 30 minutes to allow chocolate to set up
17. Wrap each spoon separately and store in cool , dry place for 2 to 3 weeks
18. Makes 20 to 24 chocolate-covered spoons
19. To present this as a gift: you will need matching teacup and saucer , coffee beans , gold-tasseled cord , cellophane bags , and thin gold ribbon
20. Fill the cup with the beans
21. Place on the saucer
22. Place a pair of chocolate spoons on top of the cup
23. Arrange tasseled cord around the base of the cup
24. Wrap extra spoons in cellophane bags
25. Tie with gold ribbon
26. Also try this: wrap cellophane packages of spoons with gold curling ribbon to add even more cheer

title: dutch babies pancakes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees
2. Beat eggs until well aerated
3. Add milk and beat again
4. Add salt and flour and beat on low , just until blended
5. Meanwhile , put butter into a 9 x 13 baking dish , or divide it into two round cake pans , or two large cast iron skillets and place in the preheated oven to melt the butter and heat the pan
6. Pour batter into the warm pan , top with fruit , if you want to add some and place in the oven
7. Bake for 15 minutes

title: sweet onion corn casserole
steps:
1. In a large skillet , saute onions in butter until tender
2. In a small bowl , combine sour cream , milk , dill , and salt until blended
3. Stir in 1 cup cheese
4. Stir into onion mixture
5. Remove from heat and set aside
6. In a bowl , combine egg , corn , corn bread mix and hot pepper sauce
7. Pour into a greased 13-in
8. X 9-in
9. X 2-in
10. Baking dish
11. Spoon onion mixture over top
12. Sprinkle with remaining cheese
13. Bake , uncovered , at 350 for 45-50 minutes or until top is set and lightly browned
14. Let stand for 10 minutes before cutting

title: little finger biscuits
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 425 degrees
2. Put the butter and mashed potato in a large bowl
3. Sift the flour and salt into the bowl , then mix to a soft dough
4. Knead the dough on a lightly floured surface for a few seconds , or until smooth
5. Wrap in clear film and chill for 30 minutes
6. Roll out the potato dough on a lightly floured surface until 1 / 3 inch thick
7. Brush with beaten egg , then cut into strips 3 / 4 in x 3 inches transfer to a greased baking sheet and sprinkle with caraway seeds
8. Bake for 12 minutes , or until lightly browned
9. Transfer to a wire rack and leave to cool
10. Store in an airtight container

title: celery parmesan
steps:
1. Prehaet oven to 325 degrees
2. Lightly spray a 2-qt casserole dish with nonstick cooking spray
3. Cook celery , onion and garlic in small amount of boiling salted water until tender
4. Drain
5. Pour into prepared casserole dish
6. Top with tomatoes and bacon , then sprinkle with parmesan cheese
7. Bake at 325 degrees for 30 minutes
8. Serve

title: cone oli
steps:
1. Put the ricotta in a fine-mesh sieve set over a bowl
2. Refrigerate 30 minutes to drain
3. Transfer the ricotta to a large bowl
4. Add the cream cheese , confectioners' sugar , vanilla and almond extracts , and the orange zest and beat with a mixer until smooth and fluffy , about 1 minute
5. Fold in 3 tbsp chopped chocolate
6. Cover and refrigerate until thick and cold , at least 1 hour
7. Transfer the ricotta mixture to a resealable plastic bag
8. Snip off one corner and pipe the mixture into the cones
9. Gently press the remaining chocolate and the pistachios into the ricotta mixture
10. Dust the cones with confectioners' sugar
11. You can fill the cones up to 4 hours in advance , cover and refrigerate , then dust with sugar just before serving

title: low carb pizza bites
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f
2. Poke the pepperoni slices into the bottoms of the mini-muffin cups , or butter the cups well if you aren't using the pepperoni
3. Cream the cream cheese with a mixer until smooth and fluffy
4. Add eggs , garlic , and oregano , and beat until smooth
5. Mix the rest of the ingredients in by hand
6. Fill the muffin cups with the egg and cheese mixture
7. Bake for about 15-18 minutes , or until lightly browned on top and set in center
8. Remove from oven , and cool for a few minutes , then run a knife around the top to loosen
9. Remove to a plate

title: bananas with cocoa
steps:
1. The banana needs to be smashed so that it is still in small chunks , but very broken down
2. Put it in a bowl , add the ingredients and mix together

title: turkey breast with barley cranberry stuffing
steps:
1. Combine broth , barley , onion , cranberries , almonds , sage , and garlic pepper in slow cooker
2. Brown the half turkey breast and add to cooker
3. Cook on low 3-4 hours or until temperature reaches 170f
4. Place turkey breast on a cutting board , cover with foil , and let stand 10-15 minutes before carving
5. Stir parsley into the stuffing and serve with turkey

title: braised lamb shanks with mushrooms and pasta
steps:
1. Set oven to 325 degrees
2. In a large dutch oven or oven-proof pot heat oil over high heat
3. Season lamb shanks with salt and pepper then brown on both sides transfer to a platter or plate
4. Add in onions , garlic , mushrooms , thyme , majoram and crushed red pepper
5. Saute for about 7-8 minutes or until veggies are tender
6. Return the lamb back to the pot
7. Add in wine and bring to a boil
8. Simmer for about 6-8 minutes
9. Add in broth , worcestershire sauce and crushed tomatoes
10. Bring back to a boil
11. Cover the pot and transfer to the oven to cook for about 2-1 / 2 - 3 hours , or until the lamb is very tender
12. Season with salt and pepper about the last 30 minutes or cooking
13. Meanwhile cook the pasta in boiling salted water until just firm-tender
14. Drain and place the pasta in a large bowl
15. Spoon the sauce over the cooked pasta , sprinkle with grated parmesan cheese , then place the shanks on top
16. Serve and pass more parmesan cheese separatel at the table

title: fluffy melty scrambled eggz
steps:
1. Break the eggs in a saucepan
2. Turn on the fire on its minimum and cook until the egg white is visible
3. It should take about 20 to 30 seconds
4. Add the milk into the pan and rapidly stir the mixture
5. Sprinkle the grated cheddar evenly across the top of the egg
6. When the cheese has become runny but not fully melted , stir the mixture vigorously
7. Then let it stand for about 20 seconds
8. Add salt and pepper to your personal taste and rapidly stir again
9. Turn off the heat and continue to stir rapidly to break the egg bits to tiny pieces
10. They kind of stick back together so it doesn't look ugly , it just creates a nice texture
11. Voila ! serve with toast or bagel
12. Absolutely gorgeous !

title: minted tomato  rhubarb and lime cooler
steps:
1. Combine rhubarb , sugar & water in a med pan
2. Cover , simmer about 10 min or till rhubarb is tender & allow to cool
3. Just b4 serving , blend or process rhubarb w / remaining ingredients till smooth & serve immediately

title: red onion  garlic and rosemary focaccia
steps:
1. Sift the flour , salt and sugar into a bowl
2. Stir in the yeast , oil and water
3. Mix to a dough
4. Add more liquid if kneaded but be careful
5. Turn the dough out and knead it for 10 minutes on a lightly floured surface
6. Place in an oiled bowl in a warm place for about an hour to double in bulk
7. Cover it with cling film or a wet tea towel to stop it from forming a crust
8. Roll the dough out into a rough oval shape about 1cm thick , and place onto an oiled baking tray
9. Make deep holes in the dough about 1 inch apart
10. Allow to rise for 20-30 minutes
11. Preheat the oven to 200c / 400f / gm6
12. Mix together the remaining oil , garlic and rosemary
13. Spread over the surface of the bread , and cover with the chopped onion
14. Sprinkle over the salt , and then flick on some cold water to stop a skin from warming as it cooks
15. Bake for 25 minutes , and then cool on a wire rack

title: parmesan crusted grilled cheese sandwich
steps:
1. Spread out bread slices and spread each with about 1 t butter
2. Sprinkle parmesan cheese on each slice and press firmly into bread
3. Melt 1 / 2 stick butter and pour half into large skillet preheated on medium-high
4. Place 4 of the bread slices in skillet , parmesan-crusted side down
5. Arrange 1 slice each of the 3 cheeses on each bread slice and grill undisturbed about 7 minutes
6. Cheese slices should begin to soften
7. Flip sandwich slices and grill briefly on other side , then set aside
8. Wipe skillet , add remaining melted butter and repeat with remaining bread with cheeses
9. Assemble sandwiches and let sit 3-5 minutes before serving

title: want to try my beef kabobs underwraps
steps:
1. Barbeque or bake the beef kabobs as directed on box
2. The nana bread can be heated on top of the barbeque or in the oven for about 2 3 minutes , then wrap in tin foil to keep warm
3. Prepare the pineapple and vegetables and set aside until ready to assemble
4. Season the onion , tomatoes and orange pepper slices with the sea salt and ground black pepper
5. When ready to assemble the sandwich , divide the ranch dressing between the two naans breads
6. Spread the dressing in the middle of the naan bread
7. His on top of the prepared naan bread add the tomatoes , onions and beef kabobs
8. Roll the wrap towards you like a cinnamon roll and secure with 3 tooth picks
9. Hers to the prepared naan bread add the tomatoes , onions , sweet pepper slices , pineapple slices , hot peppers , beef kabobs and cilantro
10. Roll the wrap towards you like a cinnamon roll and partially wrap in either wax paper or paper towels

title: southwest side dish
steps:
1. Prep all veges
2. Heat oil in large skillet on medium high heat
3. Saute onions , red bell pepper , and green beans 5 minutes
4. Add zucchini , saute 3-5 minutes
5. Add corn and black beans and heat through
6. Timing can vary a bit with size of veggie pieces - the goal is to have them crisp tender with perhaps an occasional blackened spot
7. Season with vinegar , chili powder , salt and pepper to taste
8. Sprinkle with cilantro and stir to combine
9. Serve at once

title: i can t believe it s low calorie milkshake
steps:
1. Prepare the day before:
2. Freeze coffee and sliced banana in a plastic container
3. If your blender isn't very strong , freeze the coffee separately in an ice cube tray
4. The next day , place the frozen coffee and banana in the blender
5. Add the peanut butter , chocolate , vanilla yoghurt and soy milk
6. Mix until smooth
7. If you want the smoothie to be more filling , you can add some high fibre cereal
8. Enjoy your delicious , guilt-free ice cream milkshake goodness !

title: baked french fry crispy
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450f
2. Spread french fries in a 13x9-inch dish , sprayed with cooking oil
3. Sprinkle with cheese , parsley , garlic , half and half , salt and pepper
4. Cover and bake for 1 hour or longer until bubbly and done

title: drambuie dragon on skates
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in blender container
2. Process until well blended
3. Serve as an after-dinner drink in 5 or 6 oz
4. Glasses
5. Sprinkle with additional cinnamon , if desired

title: blue cheese tenderloin steaks
steps:
1. Combine cream cheese , blue cheese , yogurt , onion and pepper
2. Set aside
3. Rub each side of steaks with cut surface of garlic
4. Place steaks on rack in broiler pan so surface of meat is 2-3 inches from heat source
5. Broil 5-6 minutes
6. Season with 1 / 4 tsp
7. Salt
8. Turn and broil 3-4 minutes
9. Season with remaining salt
10. Top each steak with an equal amount of the cheese mixture
11. Broil an additional 1-2 minutes
12. Garnish with chopped parsley

title: steel cut oatmeal in a thermos overnight
steps:
1. Measure oats into thermos
2. Pour over boiling water
3. I boiled water in the microwave , easy
4. Close thermos tightly , enjoy in the morning !
5. Drain out excess water , stir in dried fruit , sugar , milk whatever you prefer

title: chicken for people who ve been told  that they can t cook
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Spray baking dish with pam
3. Pound chicken breast into a thin slab and place in baking dish
4. Slather with mustard to your taste and cover with one to two layers swiss cheese
5. Cover dish with aluminum foil and bake in oven for 20 minutes
6. Remove foil and finish baking - 10 more minutes or until the cheese is melted
7. There ! all done ! take a bow !

title: very simple black beans  caraotas negras
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large dutch oven over medium heat
2. Add onion and bell pepper to pan
3. Cook 5 minutes or until tender , stirring occasionally
4. Stir in sugar , garlic , black pepper , and cumin
5. Cook 1 minute , stirring constantly
6. Stir in 1 cup water and beans
7. Bring to a boil
8. Partially cover , reduce heat , and simmer 30 minutes or until slightly thick , stirring frequently
9. Remove from heat , and stir in vinegar

title: instant pot or slow cooker pork carnitas
steps:
1. Slow cooker method:
2. Place pork in slow cooker
3. Pour in chicken broth , orange juice , and lime juice
4. Sprinkle in salt , pepper , cumin , oregano , coriander , chili powder , cayenne pepper , onions , and garlic
5. Cover and cook on low heat for 8 hours
6. Leave liquid in slow cooker , remove pork and shred with 2 forks
7. Spray a rimmed 18x13 inch baking sheet with non-stick cooking spray
8. Place pork on baking sheet , pour over 1 cup reserved broth , drizzle with oil and toss and spread into an even layer
9. Position oven rack near broiler and preheat broiler to high
10. Broil until pork is browned and crispy in places about 3 to 6 minutes
11. Serve warm with tortillas and desired toppings
12. Instant pot method:
13. Cut pork into 4 chunks and place pork in instant pot , pour over chicken broth , orange juice , and lime juice
14. Sprinkle in salt , pepper , cumin , oregano , coriander , chili powder , cayenne pepper , onions , and garlic
15. Cover and seal lid , press manual or high pressure , and select 60 minutes
16. Once cooking is done , let pressure come down naturally for 10 minutes then use quick release method to release any remaining cooking pressure
17. Once steaming has stopped , remove pork from pressure cooker while leaving broth in pressure cooker
18. Shred pork and proceed with broiling method above
19. Instant pot method will take approximately 80 minutes plus 10 minutes prep

title: peach chili pork chops
steps:
1. Pour a small amount of olive or vegetable oil into a 10 or 12-inch skillet
2. If using onions , cook them over low heat until tender and set aside
3. Brown pork chops on both sides in same pan
4. Sprinkle chops with salt and pepper
5. Put onions back in pan
6. Add chicken broth , syrup from the can of peaches , 1 / 4 cup chili sauce and the lemon juice
7. Reduce heat to low
8. Cover and simmer for one hour
9. Skim fat from pan liquid
10. Place chops on a plate and cover
11. Meanwhile , increase heat to high and boil down the sauce to desired thickness
12. Add peach halves to sauce
13. Pour sauce over pork chops and serve

title: rolled stuffed eggplant  aubergine
steps:
1. Saute garlic in 1 tbls
2. Of oil in large saucepan until golden brown , about 4 minutes
3. Working in batches , combine crushed tomatoes , tomato sauce , salt , pepper , basil , oregano , and parsley in blender
4. Whirl until smooth
5. Pour into saucepan
6. Add bay leaf
7. Bring to boiling
8. Lower heat
9. Simmer , partially covered , 30 minutes
10. Reserve
11. Combine crumbs and flour in large shallow pan
12. Beat eggs and milk in large bowl
13. Peel eggplants
14. Cut lengthwise into 1 / 8-inch-thick slices
15. Dip into egg mixture
16. Dredge with flour mixture , shaking off excess
17. Set on wax paper
18. Working in batches and using about 3 tbls
19. Of oil per batch , saute eggplant in large skillet until golden , 1 minute per side
20. Drain on paper toweling
21. Combine ricotta , mozzarella , parmesan and parsley in bowl
22. Mix well
23. Spread 2 to 3 tbls
24. On one side of each slice of eggplant
25. Roll up jelly-roll fashion
26. Spread 1 cup tomato sauce over bottom of each of two 11 3 / 4"x7 1 / 2"x1 3 / 4" baking dishes
27. Arrange rolls seam-side down in single layer in dishes
28. Spoon sauce over rolls
29. Save remaining sauce to pass
30. Bake , covered in preheated 450 degree oven for 30 minutes or until sauce is bubbly
31. Garnish with chopped parsley , if you wish
32. To make ahead: prepare rolls early in day
33. Bake just before serving
34. Or freeze
35. Defrost in refrigerator overnight
36. Bake as above
37. It's up to you !

title: sweet and sour chicken thighs with carrots
steps:
1. Pat chicken dry
2. Stir together 1 1 / 2 tsp salt with paprika , cinnamon and pepper
3. Rub onto chicken
4. Heat oil and brown chicken in 2 batches , turning over once , about 10 minutes per batch
5. Transfer browned chicken to a plate
6. Discard all but 3 tbs of fat from the skillet and add onion and carrots
7. Sprinkle with remaining 1 / 2 tsp salt and pepper to taste
8. Cook over moderate heat , stirring occasionally until onion softens and begins to brown , about 8 to 10 minutes
9. Add garlic and cook , stirring 1 minute longer
10. Return chicken to skillet , skin side up , nestling it into vegetables
11. Stir together honey , water , lemon juice until blended and add to skillet , then cook over moderately low heat , covered , until chicken is cooked through and carrots are tender , 25 to 30 minutes
12. If necessary skim fat from sauce , then add salt to taste
13. Sprinkle with herbes just before serving

title: crispy oven baked chicken breasts
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f cut off any fat from the chicken pieces and pound with a meat mallet to an even thickness
2. Pat dry
3. Mix mayonnaise with dijon mustard in a shallow dish
4. Combine bread crumbs with seasonings and herbs in another shallow dish
5. Lightly coat baking sheet with cooking spray and preheat in oven for 5 minutes
6. Meanwhile , coat chicken with mayonnaise mixture , then roll in bread crumbs
7. Arrange on preheated baking sheet
8. Bake 8 minutes , then turn and bake an additional 8-10 minutes or until and internal temperature of 165f

title: yummy fuzzy navel jello shots
steps:
1. Mix the jello and boiling water until jello dissolves
2. Add cold water and peach schnapps and mix again
3. Pour into shot cups

title: leek soup with brie toasts
steps:
1. In a dutch oven , saute the leeks , mushrooms , garlic , tarragon and pepper in 2 tablespoons butter for 8-10 minutes or until vegetables are tender
2. Stir in flour until blended
3. Gradually add broth and cream
4. Bring to a boil
5. Cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened
6. Lightly toast bread on a baking sheet
7. Spread one side of each slice with 1 / 2 teaspoon butter
8. Place brie on buttered side of toasts
9. Broil 3-4 inches from the heat for 1-2 minutes or until cheese is melted
10. Ladle soup into six 8-oz
11. Bowls
12. Place two toasts in each bowl
13. Yield: 6 servings

title: rao s blueberry cream cheese filled muffins
steps:
1. Bring all ingredients to room temperature
2. In a small pan heat the butter over a low heat until melted
3. Increase heat and swirl gently until butter takes on a slightly brown color
4. Add oil , stir and allow to cool slightly while the oven's preheating to 425f
5. Grease a standard 12 muffin tin , i prefer a medium coat of crisco
6. Mix filling ingredients in a small bowl and beat at medium speed until well combined and creamy , about 2 minutes
7. Mix dry ingredients in a large bowl and whisk to combine
8. Add butter milk to cooled butter , stir and add eggs and vanilla , stir to combine
9. Pour wet mixture into dry mixture , mix with a wooden spoon or rubber spatula until the dry ingredients are just moist
10. Don't over mix
11. Fold in blueberries and add spoon into tin , it will yield 12 muffins , so take your time and divide it evenly
12. With two teaspoons create a well in the center of a muffin and place a heaping spoonful of cream cheese in that well
13. Do them one at a time and be sure not to go to the bottom of the muffin
14. Once again there is enough to do all 12 muffins , so take your time and divide it equally
15. Lightly sprinkle just a bit of brown sugar over each muffin
16. Bake for 18-22 minutes , tops will be light brown and a toothpick inserted in the cake part of the muffin will come out clean
17. Muffins should just be starting to pull away from the sides of the tin
18. Allow to cool in pan for 20 minutes on a rack
19. This seems like a long time , but the filling makes these delicate and the extra cooling time allows them to set
20. Once removed from the pans allow the muffins to cool to room temperature on a rack

title: easy black beans and rice
steps:
1. In a stockpot over medium-high heat , heat the oil
2. Add the onion , pepper and garlic and saute for 4 minutes
3. Add the rice and saute for 2 minutes
4. Add the vegetable broth , bring to a boil , cover and lower the heat and cook for 20 minutes
5. Add the spices and black beans

title: baked ham and cheese in a mashed potato crust
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Mix mashed potatoes and mustard spread evenly in bottom of non-stick 8x8 baking pan
3. Add ham cubes in layer on top of potatoes
4. In electric blender , blend cottage cheese and cheddar cheese until fairly smooth
5. Spread over ham
6. Bake for 30 minutes

title: baked  chicken stuffed portabella mushrooms
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. In a small bowl , combine marinara sauce and basil , blending well
3. Set aside
4. With a sharp knife , remove stems from mushrooms
5. Coarsely chop stems and set aside
6. Arrange mushrooms , rounded-side-down in a 12 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish and set aside
7. In a medium bowl , combine chicken , marinara / basil sauce , garlic , green onion , peppers , italian parsley , and italian herbs , if desired , mixing well
8. May add salt and pepper to taste , if desired
9. Press mixture onto mushrooms , dividing evenly and fitting each mushroom
10. Bake , loosely covered with aluminum foil , in a preheated moderate oven for 20 to 25 minutes
11. Uncover and sprinkle each mushroom with shredded mozzarella cheese or cheese of choice and continue baking , uncovered , for 6 to 7 minutes , or until cheese is melted
12. Sprinkle each lightly with parmesan or romano cheese , if desired , and continue baking for 6 to 8 minutes or until cheese becomes lightly browned

title: crumb topped apple   pumpkin pie
steps:
1. On a lightly floured surface , unroll pastry
2. Transfer pastry to a 9" deep dish pie plate
3. Flute pastry edges
4. In a large bowl , combine the apples , sugar flour , lemon juice , and cinnamon
5. Spoon into crust
6. In another large bowl , whisk the pumpkin filling ingredients
7. Pour over apple mixture , bake at 375 for 30 minutes
8. For topping , combine flour and sugar
9. Cut in butter until crumbly
10. Stir in walnuts
11. Sprinkle over pie
12. Bake 20-25 minutes longer or until a knife inserted into pumpkin layer comes out clean
13. Cool on a wire rack
14. Refrigerate leftovers
15. Enjoy !

title: eggnog custard pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Prick holes in the bottom of the pie crust and bake 15 minutes to partially cook
3. To make the fiiling , beat eggnog , eggs , liquor and vanilla in a large bowl
4. Add the sugar , salt and nutmeg
5. Mix well
6. Pour into pie crust
7. Bake 25 minutes
8. Cover with foil and bake 30-40 minutes longer , or until a knife inserted in the center comes out clean
9. To make the topping , beat whipping cream in a small bowl until soft peaks form
10. Add connfectioner's sugar and liquor
11. Beat until stiff peaks form
12. Garnish pie with whipped cream and sprinkle with nutmeg

title: greek gyro meat   rotisserie  grill or oven
steps:
1. Process the onion in a food processor for 10 to 15 seconds and turn out into the center of a tea towel
2. Gather up the ends of the towel and squeeze until almost all of the juice is removed
3. Discard juice
4. Return the onion to the food processor and add the lamb , garlic , marjoram , rosemary , salt , and pepper and process until it is a fine paste , approximately 1 minute
5. Stop the processor as needed to scrape down sides of bowl
6. To cook in the oven as a meatloaf , proceed as follows:
7. Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f
8. Place the mixture into a loaf pan , making sure to press into the sides of the pan
9. Place the loaf pan into a water bath and bake for 60 to 75 minutes or until the mixture reaches 165 to 170 degrees f
10. Remove from the oven and drain off any fat
11. Place the loaf pan on a cooling rack and place a brick wrapped in aluminum foil directly on the surface of the meat and allow to sit for 15 to 20 minutes , until the internal temperature reaches 175 degrees f
12. Slice and serve on warm pita bread with recipe #296173 sauce , chopped onion , tomatoes and shredded lettuce
13. To cook on a kitchen or bbq grill rotisserie , proceed as follows:
14. Form the meat mixture into a loaf shape and place on top of 2 overlapping pieces of plastic wrap that are at least 18 inches long
15. Roll the mixture in the plastic wrap tightly , making sure to remove any air pockets
16. Once the meat is completely rolled in the wrap , twist the ends of the plastic wrap until the surface of the wrap is tight
17. Store in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours or up to overnight , to allow the mixture to firm up
18. Preheat the grill to high
19. Place the meat onto the rotisserie skewer
20. Place a double-thick piece of aluminum foil folded into a tray directly under the meat to catch any drippings
21. Cook on high for 15 minutes
22. Decrease the heat to medium and continue to cook for another 20 to 30 minutes or until the internal temperature of the meat reaches 165 degrees f
23. Turn off the heat and allow to continue to spin for another 10 to 15 minutes or until the internal temperature reaches 175 degrees
24. Slice and serve on warm pita bread with recipe #296173 sauce , chopped onion , tomatoes , and shredded lettuce

title: peanut butter chews
steps:
1. Pour cereal into large bowl
2. In saucepan combine sugar& corn syrup
3. Stir
4. Occasionally , bring to a boil over medium heat
5. And boil 1 minute
6. Remove from heat , stir in peanut butter until smooth
7. Pour over cereal , stir to coat well
8. Press evenly into 9 inch square pan coated
9. With shortening or cooking spray
10. Cool completely
11. Invert pan on cutting board
12. And cut into bars

title: slow cooker hash browns casserole
steps:
1. Stir first 5 ingredients in large bowl
2. Add potatoes and cheese
3. Place in crockpot and cover
4. Cook on high 3-4 hours
5. Melt butter in small frying pan
6. Stir in cornflakes and cook until crisp
7. Scatter over potatoes and serve

title: vegetarian baked beans with pineapple
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients
2. Bake for 30 minutes at 350 degrees f

title: dutch apple pie bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425
2. Lightly grease a 13x9 inch pan
3. Crust: in a mixing bowl , whisk together the flour and salt
4. Using a pastry blender , cut in the butter
5. Drizzle the beaten egg over the mixture
6. Toss lightly to combine
7. Add the ice water 1 tablespoons at a time , stirring gently until the dough starts to clump together
8. Grab a fistful
9. If it sticks together easily , you have added enough water
10. Roll the dough into a generous rectangle to fit your pan
11. Place the dough in the pan
12. Prick it all over with a fork
13. Bake it for 10-12 minutes , until it is set and barely starting to harden
14. Filling: in a bowl , whisk the flour , sugar , spices , and salt together
15. Add in the apples , tossing to coat
16. Stir in the vanilla , then the cream
17. Spread the filling over the crust
18. Topping: in a mixing bowl , whisk together the flour , sugar , salt , and cinnamon
19. In another bowl , combine the melted butter and extracts
20. Pout over the flour mixture
21. Stir until the butter is absorbed and the mixture forms fairly even crumbs
22. Sprinkle over the filling
23. Bake for 15 minutes
24. Decrease temperature to 350
25. Bake for 30-35 minutes , or until the topping is brown and the filling is bubbly
26. Remove from oven and cool on a rack
27. Let them cool to lukewarm before cutting

title: italian broccoli with bacon
steps:
1. Steam fresh broccoli , or microwave frozen or fresh bagged broccoli according to package directions
2. Drain any excess liquid and set aside
3. Meanwhile , cook bacon in nonstick skillet until done
4. Remove from skillet and crumble
5. Wipe most of the excess grease from the skillet
6. Saute onions and mushrooms in skillet until tender
7. Add broccoli to skillet
8. Stir in salad dressing
9. Add crumbled bacon
10. Serve immediately

title: biscuit topping for pot pie
steps: 1. Mix together , pour over pot pie , bake @350 for 45 minute

title: super easy cucumber salad
steps:
1. Put the peeled sliced cucumbers into a large resealable container that fits in your refrigerator
2. In a separate bowl mix the sugar , vinegar , and spices
3. Pour the marinade over the cucumbers
4. Chill , let sit for about 30 minutes before serving
5. I don't suggest putting new cucumbers into old marinade , too much risk of contamination
6. Make a fresh batch of marinade for each fresh batch of cucumbers

title: pork chops with apples and swiss
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 375f and butter a baking pan
2. Press a clove into each chop , then add the chops to the pan , followed by the wine , celery leaves , and bay leaves
3. Bake the chops for 30 minutes
4. Meanwhile , heat the butter in a frying pan and saute the diced celery for 5 minutes , tehn add the apples and brown sugar
5. Turn the heat to low and cook for 10 minutes , or until just tender
6. After 30 minutes , remove the pork chops , discard the bay and celery leaves and sprinkle cheese on each chop
7. Baste with juices and broil a few minutes to brown
8. Add a few pan juices to the apple-celery mixture , and serve as a side with the pork chops

title: chile con queso  chile cheese dip
steps:
1. In a medium skillet , cook onion in butter until tender but not brown
2. Stir in tomatoes , chili peppers and salt
3. Simmer , uncovered for 10 minutes
4. Add cheese a little at a time , stirring until cheese melts
5. Stir in a little milk if mixture becomes too thick
6. Serve immediately with chips
7. Keep warm in a fondue pot over low heat

title: roasted red bell pepper   chipotle hummus
steps:
1. Rinse and drain garbanzo beans
2. Rub skins off beans with fingers and discard
3. This is very tedious , and you do not have to do it , but i found that it helps in making my hummus very smooth and creamy
4. Place garbanzo beans in salted water , in a pot over high heat
5. Bring to a boil for 10-15 minutes
6. Drain and place in food processor
7. Cool for 15 minutes
8. Add remaining ingredients and blend until very smooth
9. If the mixture is dry , add a bit more water to smooth out
10. Serve the hummus with soft pita bread or pita chips
11. I love it when still warm , but it will last for several days in the refrigerator
12. This is a great make-ahead party pleaser

title: homemade pancakes
steps:
1. Sift flour , baking powder and baking soda all together
2. Cream butter and gradually add sugar , creaming till light and fluffy
3. Add egg , beating thoroughly
4. Add flour mixture alternately with milk , beating till mixture is smooth
5. Heat griddle or frying pan
6. Lightly grease
7. Put enough batter on hot griddle to make size of pancake you desire
8. Cook until bubbly on top and turn
9. Brown other side and then serve with your favorite topping

title: turkey tenders over linguine
steps:
1. Dredge turkey strips in flour
2. Saute in oil and butter about 4 minutes , turning often , and adding a little broth if necessary
3. Add broth and next 5 ingredients
4. Simmer 8 to 10 minutes , stirring occasionally
5. Serve over linguine

title: low fat creole style black eyed peas
steps:
1. Heat 2 1 / 2 cups water and dried black-eyed peas
2. Once at full boil , continue boil for two minutes , remove from heat , cover and let stand for 1 hour
3. Then drain whatever water remains and allow peas to sit uncovered
4. In another saucepan , combine 1 cup water , chicken broth , finely diced onion , finely diced celery , parsley and 2 cans / 3 1 / 2 cups diced italian tomatoes in juice , mustard , chilli pepper , ginger , black pepper and bay leaves
5. Bring to a boil
6. Add cooked black-eyed peas
7. Cover and simmer on low for 1 hour and 45 minutes
8. Stir occasionally
9. If liquid is evaporating too quickly , you can add more water to make sure peas are covered with tomato / water mixture
10. Enjoy !

title: swiss   bacon crustless quiche
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Fry bacon in skillet until crisp
3. Drain bacon
4. Crumble and set aside
5. Beat eggs , half-and-half , mustard , salt and swiss cheese in bowl
6. Stir in bacon
7. Pour into 4 custard cups
8. Place custard cups in 13x9x2-inch baking pan
9. Fill pan with 1 inch of hot water
10. Carefully place pan in oven
11. Bake 45 to 50 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean

title: zopf or braided bread
steps:
1. In a large bowl mix the warm milk , sugar , salt , butter , egg yolk and 200 g flour
2. Mix with the hook for 1 minute
3. Add the yeast and mix for 2 minutes again
4. Add the remaining 300 g flour and work with the hook
5. When the dough has pulled together and becomes smooth and elastic you can form the braid
6. Divide the dough into 2 equal pieces and roll each piece into a 60 cm long cylinder
7. Braid the pieces together and place on a lightly greased baking sheet
8. This is the method that i use:
9. In a small bowl , mix egg white and water and brush the bread with this mixture
10. Let the dough rest after forming for 90 minutes until it doubles in size
11. Bake in the preheated oven at 180c for 20 to 25 minutes , until golden

title: cheesy hash browns
steps:
1. Put all ingredients in a large oven proof bowl
2. Mix thoroughly , cover and bake at 350 degrees f
3. For 1 hour

title: easy chicken almond stir fry
steps:
1. Heat oil in a wok on medium-high
2. Add chicken and almonds
3. Stir-fry 2 minutes
4. Add frozen vegetables , cover and cook 4 minutes , stirring once
5. Combine cornstarch and next 4 ingredients
6. Add to wok
7. Cook , stirring constantly , 2 to 3 minutes or until mixture thickens
8. Serve over rice

title: i thought i had nothing to eat  rice
steps:
1. Boil water , take off heat and add tea bag
2. Let steep
3. Add rice and all other ingredients except butter , bring back to a boil
4. Reduce heat , cover and simmer for 20 minutes
5. Remove from heat , stir in butter until completely melted

title: spinach rice salad
steps:
1. Mix cooked rice with next 6 ingredients
2. Toss lightly
3. Brown bacon and put in with salad just before serving

title: my big fat greek pasta salad
steps:
1. Prepare the dressing: grate 1 / 2 teaspoon fresh lemon zest
2. Knead and cut lemons into halves to juice , yielding 2 1 / 2 tablespoons juice
3. Whisk together remaining ingredients well
4. Set aside
5. Bring bring 6 quarts water to a boil in a large pot
6. Add 1 1 / 2 tablespoons kosher salt and spiral pasta , returning to boiling
7. Cook pasta according to package directions
8. Drain pasta well
9. Return pasta to pot and toss with a very small amount of olive oil to prevent sticking
10. Let stand to cool
11. Prep all pasta salad vegetables and fresh herbs to specifications
12. Place prepped vegetables into a large bowl
13. Add the cooled pasta to vegetables in bowl , combining well
14. Add 4-6 ounces cubed or crumbled feta cheese , without tossing
15. Whisk the dressing mixture again
16. Pour the dressing evenly over pasta salad
17. Gently fold pasta salad over from the bottom a few times to evenly distribute the dressing and combine feta cheese
18. Chill pasta salad at least 2 hours to overnight
19. Garnish pasta salad with parsley sprig , or fresh basil or mint leaves
20. Serve and enjoy !

title: saigon chicken cole slaw
steps:
1. Toss all but last 4 ingredients in large bowl
2. Whisk together last 4 ingredients until sugar is dissolved
3. Pour dressing over salad , and toss
4. Slaw is best if refrigerated for 30 min
5. -1 hour before serving , but is still wonderful if served immediately
6. Most grocery store versions are mainly salt flavor
7. For best results , take a trip to the asian market if possible

title: skillet cream potatoes
steps:
1. Peel potatoes and dice into a skillet
2. Add boiling water and salt
3. Cover and cook 10 minutes , or until potatoes are tender
4. Uncover and simmer until water has almost evaporated
5. Add milk or cream
6. Season to taste
7. Cook until slightly thickened , stirring gently with a fork
8. Sprinkle with chopped parsley

title: crusty bread salad
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients except bread and toss well
2. Chill for at least 45 minutes
3. Cut thick slices of bread
4. Broil bread until light brown
5. Place bread on plate and top with salad

title: simple   tasty apple pie
steps:
1. For crust:
2. In a medium to large sized bowl , mix together flour and salt
3. Cut in butter with a pastry blender , until you have oatmeal-sized pieces of butter
4. Slowly add water , little amounts at a time and toss with fork until dough starts to come together
5. On a lightly floured surface , roll out dough
6. Put one crust in the pie pan , set the other aside
7. For filling:
8. Preheat oven 450f , after 5 minutes of preheating , pre-bake the bottom pie shell 1-2 minutes
9. Cut apples and sprinkle with lemon juice , set aside in a medium / large sized bowl
10. In another bowl , mix sugars , spices and 2 tbsp flour
11. Reserve 2-3 tbsp of mixture in a separate bowl
12. Toss apples in mixture , and arrange in pie pan
13. Sprinkle 1 tsp flour , then with reserved mixture
14. Dot with butter , and cover with second crust
15. Seal / flute edges and slit steam vents
16. Bake for 10 minutes at 450f , then rotate pie and bake 30-35 minutes at 350f enjoy !

title: best ever italian style meatloaf
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Combine all ingredients in a large bowl , mix well
3. Press into a 9x5 inch loaf pan , and cover with foil
4. Bake for 1 hour , uncover and pour extra sauce out
5. Return to oven and bake for 5-10 minutes
6. Leave in pan for 10-20 minutes , this will prevent the meatloaf from falling apart when cut

title: peas  pasta and a red pepper vinaigrette salad
steps:
1. Peas -- mix the shallots and baby peas in a large bowl , salt and pepper and just let them hang out
2. Pasta -- cook the pasta according to directions
3. The last minute add the snow peas in to blanch
4. After 1 minute , drain and cool
5. Finish -- add the baby peas and shallots to the drained pasta and top with the vinaigrette and chives
6. It is that easy
7. Top with some grated parmesan if you like for a crisp fresh salad

title: three onion spread
steps:
1. Heat oil in a nonstick skillet over medium heat
2. Add onions and cook about 5 minutes , stirring occasionally , until tender
3. Stir in parsley and cream cheese spread until smooth
4. Spoon into serving dish
5. Can be served warm , but better cold with your choice of crackers

title: sweet and gooey chicken wings
steps:
1. In a 9x13 inch casserole , combine soy sauce , brown sugar , oil , ginger , and garlic powder
2. Mix until brown sugar completely dissolves into the mixture
3. Place the chicken wings in the dish and turn them over until they are all well coated
4. Cover the dish and refrigerate for at least 4 hours
5. Turn the chicken again , after 2 hours
6. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
7. Bake chicken at 350 degrees f , covered , for 45 minutes
8. Turn the chicken wings , and spoon sauce from the bottom of the pan over the tops of the wings
9. Cook an additional 50 minutes , uncovered

title: heavenly  whole wheat  bread
steps:
1. Mix all in your bread machine , in order to your machines instructions
2. Press start , for a basic light crusted bread
3. Watch as machine is kneading making any adjustments as needed
4. Flour is tempermental , so it could use a little more water , or a little more flour
5. Should be a round soft sticky ball of dough
6. Remove after baked to cool

title: eggplant stew  simple  persian style
steps:
1. Heat 1 tbs olive oil in a pot
2. Add the finely chopped onions and saut over medium heat until they begin to brown
3. Add the turmeric , beef and garlic
4. Cook until the beef is browned
5. Add the water , tomato sauce , and 1 tsp salt
6. Cover , and simmer over low heat for 2
7. 5 hours
8. Slice the eggplant lengthwise into pieces about 1 / 4" thick
9. Sprinkle them on each side with the remaining salt and place them aside for 20 minutes in a strainer set over a plate
10. Afterward , rinse each piece and pat dry
11. Saut them in the remaining oil over medium heat until they begin to brown , then set them aside
12. Add the eggplant to the beef and simmer for another hour
13. Serve over basmati rice or with bread

title: jackie s marvelous and easy pineapple punch
steps:
1. In a gallon-sized ziploc bag , mix pineapple juice , sugar , and extract
2. Freeze until hardened in bag
3. To serve , thaw for 30 minutes and mix into ginger ale

title: potato curry for 1
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a pan and saut the potato for 5-6 minutes
2. Add mushrooms , chilli and curry powder
3. Fry for a further few minutes
4. Stir in the yoghurt and cook for 2-5 minutes or until the potatoe is done
5. Season with salt and pepper

title: barley pilaf
steps:
1. Melt margarine
2. Saute onion until brown and add mushrooms and barley to coat
3. Mix all ingredients and place in a covered casserole dish
4. Bake at 350f covered for 1 hour

title: quick cranberry nut bread
steps:
1. Directions:
2. Preheat oven to 350f
3. Grease an 8 1 / 2 x 4 1 / 2 x 2 1 / 2-inch loaf pan
4. Combine flour , baking powder , cinnamon and nutmeg in a small mixing bowl
5. Set aside
6. Using an electric mixer , beat butter or margarine with sugar in a medium mixing bowl until light and fluffy
7. Add egg
8. Mix well
9. Break up cranberry sauce with a fork and add to the butter mixture
10. Add nuts
11. Add dry ingredients to the cranberry mixture , mixing just until the dry ingredients are moist
12. Spread batter evenly into prepared loaf pan
13. Bake until golden brown and a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean , about 1 hour and 15 minutes
14. If bread begins to brown too quickly , loosely cover with foil and continue to bake until bread tests done
15. Makes 1 loaf

title: holiday tortellini soup
steps:
1. Heat the olive oil in a dutch oven over medium heat
2. Add pancetta
3. Cook until crisp
4. Add onion
5. Cook 3-4 minutes or until soft
6. Add garlic
7. Cook 1 more minute
8. Add broth and italian seasoning
9. Bring to a boil and simmer for 5 minutes
10. Meanwhile , cook tortellini according to package directions
11. Drain
12. Add cooked tortellini to soup mixture
13. Stir in tomatoes and simmer 5 minutes
14. Add spinach and cook just until wilted
15. Season with salt and pepper
16. Garnish with cheese

title: lemon banana  preserves
steps:
1. In large dutchoven pan , add sugar and 3 1 / 2 cups water , cloves and ginger
2. Cook on low heat and stir occasionally
3. Remove rind with peeler or a zester and add very small pieces or strips to the cooking sugar , water and spice mixture
4. Use all of the rind on one lemon
5. Add to the pan
6. Juice all of the lemons and add the juice and if desired add chopped lemon pulp
7. Do not use the white portion which hold the pulp
8. It is very bitter
9. Mash the bananas
10. The mixture should have been simmering about 10 minutes
11. Stir so the mixture does not scorch and burn
12. Add 1 cup water
13. Stir
14. Take out the cloves and ginger pieces if not
15. The pureed ginger
16. Add the mashed bananas
17. Add yellow food coloring
18. Stir
19. Cook about 6 minutes on low heat
20. The preserves should be the consistency of thick applesauce
21. If it is too thin , add another mashed banana
22. Wash 8 half pint jars , with hot soapy water , rinse and place in 9 x 13 pan with water , set in 275 oven to heat and sterilize
23. Turn the washed jars upside down so that the hot water in the pan is around the rims and up the sides a little
24. Heat seals and rings in water in a saucepan on the stove
25. Pack in jars
26. Make sure you wipe the rim of the jars after packing
27. Place hot seal on jar and then ring
28. Tighten
29. Make sure the water is boiling before placing in the water bath
30. Water bath for 10 minutes

title: cherry vanilla fudge
steps:
1. Combine sugar , salt , cream , mil , corn syrup and butter in a large heavy saucepan
2. Cook over medium heat , stirring constantly , until mixture comes to boiling
3. Continue cooking , stirring occasionally , until candy thermometer reaches 238f
4. Remove from heat , leaving thermometer in the saucepan
5. Cool to 100f
6. Add vanilla
7. Beat briskly until fudge thickens and begins to lose its gloss
8. Stir in cherries
9. Pour into buttered 8" square pan
10. Cool
11. Cut into squares when firm

title: smucker s peanut butter oatmeal treats
steps:
1. In a small bowl mix together flour , baking soda , salt , and set aside
2. In a large bowl cream butter , peanut butter , and sugars
3. Beat in eggs and vanilla , stir in flour mixture , oats , and chocolate
4. Do not over beat mixture
5. Place mixture in an ungreased pan measuring about 15 1 / 2 by 10 1 / 2 by 1 inch
6. Press the cookie dough down slightly to fill the pan
7. Bake at 350 degrees fahrenheit for 15-17 minutes

title: stoli doli
steps:
1. Slice the pineapple into chunks and place into a large container , preferably one with a spigot , such as an ice tea jug
2. You may not need all the pineapple , just enough to fill the jug
3. Pour the vodka over the pineapple using more if needed to cover pineapple
4. Cover , and allow to sit for 3 to 4 days , or longer , to infuse the vodka with the pineapple juice
5. To serve , pour into a shaker filled with crushed ice
6. Shake well to chill and pour into martini glasses

title: mushroom barley pilaf
steps:
1. Heat vegetable stock in a saucepan or the microwave
2. Heat olive oil in a deep skillet on low heat
3. Add the onion and saute until soft
4. Should be slightly golden
5. Add mushrooms and basil and continue cooking about 4 minutes
6. Stir in barley
7. Be sure it's well coated
8. Raise heat to medium and cook 5 more minutes
9. Stir in hot veg
10. Stock and bring to a boil
11. Reduce heat and simmer 25 mins until all liquid is absorbed
12. Reserve some tomatoes for garnishing and mix in the remainder
13. Garnish and serve !

title: dirty your deep dish pan   pizza
steps:
1. Crust:
2. Bring 1 quart water and the potato to a boil in a small saucepan over medium-high heat
3. Cook until tender 10 - 15 minutes
4. Drain the potato and and cool until it can be handled
5. Press potato through a potato ricer or grate on the large holes of a box grater
6. Measure 1 1 / 3 cups lightly packed potato
7. Discard the remaining potato
8. Adjust an oven rack to the highest position and the other rack to the lowest position
9. Heat the oven to 200 degrees
10. Once the temperature reaches 200 degrees , maintain the heat for 10 minutes then turn off the heat
11. Combine the flour , yeast , and salt in a food processor
12. With the motor running , add the water and process until the dough comes together in a shaggy ball
13. Add the potato and process for several seconds , then add 2 tablespoons of the oil and process several more seconds , until the dough is smooth and slightly sticky
14. Transfer the dough to a lightly oiled medium bowl , turn to coat with oil and cover the bowl tightly with plastic wrap
15. Place in the warmed oven until the dough is soft and spongy and doubled in size , 30 - 35 minutes
16. Oil the bottom of two 10-inch cake pans with 2 tablespoons of oil each
17. Turn the dough onto a clean , dry work surface
18. Divide it in half
19. Pat each half into a 9-inch round
20. Transfer the round to the oiled pans , cover with plastic wrap , and let rest until the dough longer resists shaping , about 10 minutes
21. Place a pizza stone or rimless baking sheet on the lowest oven rack and preheat the oven to 500 degrees
22. Uncover the dough and pull it into the edges and up the side of the pans to form a 1 inch high lip
23. Cover with plastic wrap and let rise in a warm , draft-free spot until doubled in size , about 30 minutes
24. Uncover the dough and prick generously with a fork
25. Reduce the oven temperature to 425 degrees and bake on the heated stone or baking sheet until the crust is dry and lightly browned , about 5 - 10 minutes
26. Add the toppings
27. Bake on the stone or baking sheet until the cheese melts , 10 - 15 minutes
28. Move the pizza to the top rack and bake until the cheese is golden brown in spots about 5 minutes longer
29. To make sure the crust is done , use a spatula to lift up the crust - it should be nicely browned underneath
30. Let cool 5 minutes , then holding the pizza pan at an angle with one hand , use a wide spatula to slide the pizza from the pan to a cutting board
31. Cut into wedges and serve

title: almond rice casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Heat oil in large skillet and cook celery , onions , pepper , mushrooms and parsley over med heat until onions are translucent , about 10 minutes
3. Stir in remaining seasonings
4. Add the uncooked rice and cook for several minutes , mixing well
5. Transfer the ingredients to a lightly oiled 3-qt casserole
6. If usng precooked rice , add it in this step
7. Add broth and half of the alomds
8. Stir until ingredients are well combined
9. Top with remaining almonds and bake , covered , for one hour or until rice is soft and liquid has been absorbed

title: crushed potatoes
steps:
1. Peel potatoes and quarter
2. In a saucepan cover potatoes with cold salted water by 1 inch and simmer 15 minutes , or until just tender
3. Drain potatoes in a colander and let stand 5 minutes
4. Finely chop white and light green parts of scallions
5. Finely chop parsley
6. In saucepan heat oil and chopped scallions over moderate heat until oil begins to sizzle and add potatoes
7. With a fork lightly crush potatoes into scallion oil
8. Season potatoes with salt and pepper and stir in parsley

title: lemon buns
steps:
1. ---manual / mixermethod---
2. Combine all of the dough ingredients in a large mixing bowl and stir to form a cohesive dough
3. Knead the dough , by hand or machine , for 5 to 8 minutes , until it's smooth , soft and supple
4. Avoid adding too much flour , as this will make the buns tough and dry
5. Place the dough in a lightly greased bowl , cover the bowl with plastic wrap , and allow the dough to rise for about 1 1 / 2 hours , or until it's puffy , though it may not have doubled in bulk
6. ---breadmachine method---
7. Place all of the dough ingredients into the pan of your machine , program the machine for manual or dough , and press start
8. When the machine has completed its cycle , set a timer for 30 minutes , and allow the dough to continue to rise
9. It may crest the top of the bucket , but shouldn't overflow
10. Transfer the dough to a lightly oiled work surface , and divide it into 20 pieces
11. Allow the pieces to rest , covered , for 10 minutes
12. Round the dough into balls , and place them in two lightly greased 9-inch round cake pans
13. Cover the pans , and allow the buns to rise for about 1 hour , or until they're nice and puffy and have filled the pan
14. While the buns are rising , combine the glaze ingredients , and set aside
15. Brush the buns lightly with half of the glaze
16. Bake them in a preheated 375f oven for 30 to 35 minutes , or until they're golden brown
17. Remove the buns from the oven , and brush them with the remaining glaze
18. Transfer them to a wire rack to cool

title: bruschetta with white beans  tomatoes and olives
steps:
1. Place beans in large saucepan
2. Add enough cold water to cover by 3 inches
3. Bring to boil
4. Cover and remove from heat
5. Let stand 1 hour
6. Drain beans
7. Return to pan
8. Add enough cold water to cover by 3 inches
9. Bring to boil
10. Reduce heat and simmer until tender , stirring occasionally , about 1 hour 10 minutes
11. Drain and cool
12. Transfer 1 1 / 2 cups beans to medium bowl
13. Mix in tomatoes , olives , 4 tablespoons oil , basil and garlic
14. Season to taste with salt and pepper
15. Preheat broiler
16. Place bread on baking sheet
17. Brush with 2 tablespoons oil
18. Broil until golden , about 1 minute
19. Spread with cheese
20. Top with bean mixture

title: caramelized heath bar coffee ice cream cake
steps:
1. For crust , heat butter in pan mix in crushed graham crackers
2. Pour mixture in 9" pan and press down firmly
3. Slice pound cake into chunks and start the cake with one thin layer of pound cake chunks on top of crust
4. For ice cream layer , mix crushed heath bars into ice cream and then stir in caramel sauce
5. Spoon 1 / 3rd of ice cream mixture on top of pound cake layer
6. Repeat layering of ice cream mixture and pound cake until ingredients are gone
7. Put pan in freezer for several hours or overnight
8. Once frozen , take cake out of pan and frost with a coat of cool whip
9. Sprinkle the remaining heath bars on top

title: impossibly easy use it up pie   oamc
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Lightly grease pie pan
3. Whisk millk , buscuit mix , eggs , salt , pepper and nutmeg until smooth , and pour into pan
4. Lightly saute onions
5. Sprinkle over egg mixture along with cooked vegetable and cheese and meat if used
6. Bake in preheated oven for 30 minutes until golden brown and knife inserted near center comes out clean
7. Let stand 10 minutes before serving , if serving fresh
8. Cooled pie may also be wrapped right in its pan , labeled and frozen
9. You may serve pie cold after thawing
10. Or heat the thawed pie at 350 degrees for 20 minutes

title: tuna salad sandwich
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine all ingredients
2. Season to taste with salt and pepper and mix until well combined
3. Divide tuna salad between 2 slices of bread and spread evenly
4. Top each with a second slice of bread , cut on the diagonal , and serve

title: southwest style stuffed cheeseburgers
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine chilies , cheese , butter and garlic
2. Blend well
3. Divide ground beef into four , 3 / 4 cup pieces
4. Place 1 piece on cutting board
5. Divide in half
6. Flatten each half into thin patty about 4 inches wide
7. Season each half with salt and black pepper
8. Place 2 tablespoons cheese mixture in center of one patty
9. Cover with other patty
10. Pinch edges together to seal
11. Shape burger until round and slightly flattened
12. Season again with salt and black pepper , if desired
13. Repeat with remaining ground beef and cheese mixture
14. Spray grill with nonstick cooking spray
15. Preheat grill to medium-hot
16. Grill burgers about 6 minutes per side or until desired doneness
17. Do not flatten burgers with spatula
18. Remove from grill
19. Let stand 2 minutes before serving
20. Place finished burgers between hamburger rolls or on grilled sourdough bread and garnish with lettuce , avocado and tomato , if desired

title: canadian pork roast with gravy
steps:
1. Cut roast in half
2. Transfer to a 5-qt
3. Slow cooker
4. Combine the syrup , lemon juice , mustard and garlic
5. Pour over pork
6. Cover and cook on low for 5-6 hours or until a meat thermometer reads 160 and meat is tender
7. Remove meat to a serving platter
8. Keep warm
9. Strain cooking juices
10. Transfer 1 cup to a small saucepan
11. Combine cornstarch and water until smooth
12. Stir into cooking juices
13. Bring to a boil
14. Cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened
15. Slice roast
16. Serve with gravy

title: easy puto cakes
steps:
1. Prepared ungreased mini muffin or mini tart pans with 12 built-in molds
2. Set aside and bring enough water to boil in a wide steamer
3. In a bowl , blend well all ingredients up above
4. Spoon mixture into muffin molds about 2 / 3 full
5. Place muffin pan carefully in steamer
6. Cove and steam for about 8 t 10 minutes
7. Carefully remove the muffin pan and let the puto cool a little
8. Remove puto by loosening sides with a small and thin metal spatula and carefully pulling cakes away from pan
9. Repeat process with the rest of the mixtures

title: le lasagne autentiche siciliane supreme
steps:
1. Prepare the lasagna noodles according to package directions
2. Drain and set aside
3. Cook the ground beef and sausage
4. Drain off the grease
5. Add the onion , garlic and mushrooms to the meat / sausage mixture
6. Saute until onion is tender
7. Add the sugar , salt , basil , fennel seed , pepper , tomatoes and tomato paste
8. Blend well
9. Simmer for 1 hour
10. Combine the eggs , ricotta cheese , parsley and salt
11. Blend well
12. In the bottom of a very large baking pan , spread just enough of the meat mixture to cover the bottom
13. Layer lasagna noodles , meat sauce , black olives , ricotta cheese mixture , mozzarella cheese , asiago cheese and parmesan cheese
14. Repeat layering making sure to end with the parmesan cheese
15. Cover with foil
16. Bake at 375 degrees for 25 minutes
17. Remove the foil and bake for 25 additional minutes

title: moist butter cake with browned butter frosting
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Sift together flour , baking soda , and salt
3. Cream sugar and butter in a separate bowl
4. When sugar and butter is smooth , mix in buttermilk , eggs , and vanilla
5. Add flour to this mixture slowly and mix until combined
6. Pour into a greased bundt pan or a greased 13x9 baking pan
7. Place in oven and bake for 35 to 45 minutes or until a knife inserted into the center of the cake comes out clean
8. Remove from oven and cool cake completely
9. While cake is cooling , place the butter for the frosting in a saucepan
10. Melt over med heat slowly
11. If it is sizzling , turn down the heat slightly
12. Continue to cook the butter until it becomes rich brown in color , it will be foamy and bubble
13. Remove from the heat and pour into a glass bowl
14. Cool completely
15. When the butter has completely cooled , mix in the powdered sugar at little at a time until it is totally incorporated
16. Also mix in the vanilla
17. At a medium speed , mix in the milk until it is at a consistency you like
18. Spread frosting on your cooled cake

title: gluten free sourdough bread
steps:
1. Combine the wet ingredients in a large bowl
2. Combine the dry ingredients very thoroughly
3. Mix together in a large bowl with a wire whist or in a gallon-sized plastic food storage bag
4. For bread machine: pour the wet ingredients into the baking pan
5. Add dry ingredients on top
6. Set machine to a basic cycle and start the machine
7. Once the mixing action has gone on for a few minutes , use a spatula to make sure that all the dry ingredients are fully incorporated
8. When the baking cycle ends , let the bread stand in the pan for 10 minutes , then invert onto a rack to cool before slicing
9. For mixer: the wet ingredients can be mixed in the mixing bowl
10. With the mixer on a low speed , gradually add the dry ingredients until completely combined
11. Beat about 10 minutes
12. Pour batter into a greased 9x5 loaf pan and allow to rise in a warm place for about an hour
13. Bake at 375 deg f for 60 minutes , testing for doneness with a toothpick
14. Remove from oven and allow to stand for 10 minutes , then invert onto a rack to cool before slicing
15. :

title: hop butterscotch cookies
steps:
1. Mix all dry ingredients together
2. Then add the wet ingredients
3. If the batter is slightly stiff , add a few tablespoons of water to soften it up
4. Put on un-greased baking sheets
5. Bake for 8-10 minutes at 350

title: peanut lime noodle salad
steps:
1. In salted water , boil spaghetti noodles to al dente and set aside
2. Vinaigrette:
3. In a food processor , combine everything except the oil
4. Once combined , slowly drizzle in the oil until emulsified
5. Pour into a bowl and set for at least 1 / 2 hour for flavors to develop
6. Salad:
7. Toss all ingredients together
8. Toss all ingredients with just enough dressing to moisten and flavor the salad
9. Garnish with extra ingredients
10. Best served at room temperature or cold

title: turkey teriyaki with grilled mushrooms
steps:
1. Cut turkey into 2-inch-wide strips
2. Combine sake , soy sauce , sugar , ginger , garlic and oil in 2-quart glass dish
3. Add turkey
4. Turn to coat
5. Cover and refrigerate 15 minutes or overnight
6. Remove turkey from marinade
7. Discard marinade
8. Thread turkey onto metal or wooden skewers alternately with mushrooms and green onions
9. Grill on covered grill over medium-hot coals about 3 minutes per side until turkey is cooked through

title: oven roasted turkey
steps:
1. Heat oven to 325f
2. Place turkey , skin side up , on rack in large shallow roasting pan
3. Insert ovenproof meat thermometer so
4. Roast uncovered 1 hour
5. Mix butter , wine , thyme , salt , paprika and garlic
6. Brush turkey with half of the butter mixture
7. Roast 30 minutes
8. Brush with remaining butter mixture
9. Roast about 1 hour longer or until thermometer reads 180f and juice of turkey is no longer pink when center is cut
10. Remove turkey from oven and let stand 15 minutes for easier carving
11. Meanwhile , pour pan drippings into measuring cup
12. Skim fat from drippings
13. Add enough water to drippings to measure 2 cups
14. Heat drippings to boiling in 1-quart saucepan
15. Mix cornstarch and 2 tablespoons cold water
16. Stir into drippings
17. Boil and stir 1 minute
18. Serve with turkey

title: almond spice rice pudding from leftover rice
steps:
1. Put cooked rice , sugar , and milk in a saucepan
2. Add extracts , cardamom , and flax
3. Heat to just before boiling , or to an early boiling point , stirring constantly
4. Remove from heat , cool , and serve
5. Store remaining quantities in the refrigerator

title: easy peas and cheese salad
steps:
1. Put peas into colander and run hot tap water on them for two to three minutes , until peas are cold but not frozen
2. Strain all water from peas and place into large mixing bowl
3. Add cheese and mayo
4. Mix well and serve
5. May garnish with a sliced hard boiled egg
6. May add black pepper and / or to suit your taste

title: cabbage and potato soup  caldo verde
steps:
1. Peel and cut up potatoes , and boil in salted water , with garlic
2. When soft , mash and add olive oil and cabbage or kale
3. Boil uncovered for about 3 minutes
4. Season to taste
5. Serve in bowls with a drop of olive oil in the bottom of each

title: 250 chocolate chip cookies recipe
steps:
1. Blended oatmeal: measure and blend in a blender to fine powder
2. Cream butter and both sugars
3. Add eggs and vanilla
4. Mix together with flour , oatmeal , salt , baking powder and soda
5. Add chips , candy , and nuts
6. Refrigerate for 1 / 2 an hour
7. Roll into balls and place 2 inches apart on cookie sheet
8. Bake for 6 minute at 375 degrees

title: fasoolya khadra  jordanian beef stew
steps:
1. Lightly salt and pepper the beef then place it in a covered skillet , add water to just cover the meat
2. Bring to a boil over medium heat , lower the heat and simmer for about an hour
3. Remove the beef from the heat , reserve 1 cup of the broth , discard the rest
