4. Roughly chop the tomatoes and the garlic then whirl them in a food processor with the reserved broth until you have fairly smooth sauce
5. Add the sauce , the beans , the cumin and coriander to the pot with the meat and simmer for about another hour , until the beef is tender
6. Adjust salt and pepper to taste

title: fudge chewies
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375f
2. Grease cookie sheets
3. In large bowl , combine butter and cream cheese
4. Beat until smooth
5. Add sweetened condensed milk and egg
6. Blend well
7. Lightly spoon flour into measuring cup
8. Level off
9. Add flour and brownie mix
10. Mix well
11. Stir in pecans , coconut and chocolate chips
12. Drop dough by heaping tablespoonfuls 1 inch apart onto greased cookie sheets
13. Bake at 375f for 9 to 12 minutes or until set
14. Cool 1 minute
15. Remove from cookie sheets
16. Cool completely
17. Cut very small hole in corner of reserved chocolate-flavored syrup packet
18. Lightly drizzle over cooled cookies store in tightly covered container

title: for kids  m m m meatballs
steps:
1. Mix the ground beef , bread crumbs and egg together in a bowl
2. Shape meatballs using your hands
3. Lay them out on waxed paper until all are done
4. Heat the oil in a fry pan and brown the meatballs , a few at a time , until all are done
5. Drain on paper towels
6. Mix all the sauce ingredients together in a saucepan
7. Cook on top of the stove on low heat for 20 minutes
8. Add the meatballs and cook for another 20 minutes
9. Serve on toothpicks for a snack , or over rice or noodles for dinner

title: cheesy garlic bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Cut slices down the length of bread loaf at 1 inch intervals without cutting all the way through
3. Rub slices and top of loaf with cut slices of garlic halves
4. Mince garlic
5. Combine butter , garlic , parsley and parmesan cheese in a small bowl
6. Spread butter mixture between bread slices and on top of loaf
7. Wrap bread in foil , leaving top partially uncovered
8. Bake until heated about 15 minutes

title: cheddar butternut squash soup  lightened up
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , combine squash and broth
2. Bring to a boil and reduce heat to medium
3. Simmer until squash is vry tender , about 20 minutes
4. Remove from the heat and let stand until warm , then puree in batches in the blender
5. Return the puree to the saucepan and place over medium low heat
6. Stir in the sour cream , cheddar , butter and cayenne
7. Season with salt and pepper
8. Stir the soup until heated through
9. Don't allow it to boil
10. Now taste the soup , adding brown sugar if not sweet enough
11. Sprinkle with chopped chives and serve
12. Enjoy !

title: new england seafood cocktail sauce
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients , squeeze in juice of 1 / 2 lemon
2. Adjust to taste
3. Chill for 1 hour
4. Wedge out remaining half of lemon to squeeze over seafood
5. Serve with shrimp , calamari or other seafood

title: grilled cheese chipotle sandwich
steps:
1. Spread each piece of bread with thin coating of pureed chiles , or more if you like your sandwich really hot
2. Cover bottom slice with layer of cheese , tomato and onion slices and as much cilantro as you like
3. Top with second slice of bread and butter it
4. Place sandwich , butter-side down , in cast-iron skillet
5. Spread top piece of bread with butter as well and cook sandwich slowly
6. When golden brown on bottom , turn it over and cook on the other side
7. Covering pan will help melt cheese by the time bread is crisped and golden
8. Eat right away with something very cold to drink

title: cinnamon sour cream coffee cake
steps:
1. Combine the walnuts , 1 tsp cinnamon and 2 tb sugar together and set aside
2. Mix the butter , sugar and eggs together until fluffy
3. Blend in the sour cream
4. Sift the flour , soda and baking powder together
5. Mix into the creamed mixture and blend well
6. Add the vanilla
7. Spoon half of the batter into a greased and floured tube or bundt pan
8. Sprinkle half of the cinnamon mix over the batter
9. Spoon in the remaining batter and top off with the remaining cinnamon mix
10. Place the pan in a cold oven
11. Set to 350 degrees , then bake for about 55 mins until a toothpick comes out clean
12. Serve warm or cold

title: low carb crustless green chile and cheese quiche
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Lightly spray or butter an 8-inch deep-dish pie plate or a 7" x11" casserole dish
3. Optional: in a saucepan , heat 2 tablespoons olive oil on medium-high heat , and add 6 oz
4. Uncooked spinach , and saut until wilted , about 2-3 minutes
5. Set aside
6. In a large bowl , whisk eggs until well blended
7. Add half and half , cottage cheese , salt and pepper and mix well
8. Whisk in well-drained chilies and cheese
9. Pour into prepared dish and bake until top is golden and quiche is set in center , 25 to 30 minutes
10. Cool for at least 5 minutes before cutting into wedges

title: spoon cookies  lusikkaleivat  finland
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f
2. Line 2 baking sheets with parchment paper or silicone baking mats
3. Melt the butter in a small , heavy-bottomed saucepan over medium heat
4. Continue to cook , swirling the pan occasionally , until the butter browns lightly and smells slightly nutty , about 15 minutes
5. Transfer the butter to a medium bowl -- be sure to get all the tasty brown bits -- and cool slightly
6. Meanwhile , whisk the flour , baking powder and salt in another medium bowl
7. Whisk the egg yolk , sugar and vanilla into the cooled browned butter
8. Stir the dry ingredients into the butter mixture to make a uniform but crumbly dough that looks like wet sand
9. Scoop out dough with a small teaspoon
10. Rock spoon gently back and forth against the side of the bowl , packing the dough into the spoon , then scrape / slide the spoon against the inside of the bowl to make spoon-shaped cookies
11. Trim excess dough with your fingers and slide out onto the prepared pans , preserving their shape
12. Bake cookies until just browned , about 12 to 15 minutes
13. Cool almost completely on the baking sheets , and then transfer cookies to a rack to cool
14. When cool , spread 1 / 2 teaspoon jam on the flat side of a cookie , and then sandwich together with a second cookie
15. Repeat until all cookies have met their match
16. Lightly dust the cookies with the confectioners' sugar
17. Serve
18. Busy baker's
19. Freeze baked cookie halves wrapped tightly in plastic wrap , followed by aluminum foil for up to 2 weeks
20. When ready to serve , defrost at room temperature and assemble as desired
21. Store sandwiches in an airtight container for up to 3 days
22. Do not store with crisp cookies , as moisture from the jam will soften the texture of other crisp cookies

title: penne with chicken   tomato sauce
steps:
1. Heat oil in large , deep skillet
2. Add chicken breast pieces
3. Cook until lightly browned , about 2 minutes
4. Add garlic
5. Cook stirring 1 minute longer
6. Add tomatoes and bring to a boil
7. Reduce heat
8. Simmer gently 10 minutes
9. Add cream , salt& pepper and heat thoroughly
10. Meanwhile , cook pasta in salted water
11. Drain well and toss with sauce
12. Add cheese and parsley as desired

title: oven baked steak with mustard sauce
steps:
1. To make the mustard sauce: in a small / medium saucepan , melt the butter and mix with bbq sauce , worcestershire sauce , dry mustard powder
2. Heat over medium heat for a couple of minutes
3. Remove from heat
4. Stir in the cream
5. Heat again
6. Serve over the cooked steak
7. For the steak: turn oven to broil setting
8. Set oven rack to under the broiler heat
9. Season steak with black pepper on both sides
10. Broil the steak on both sides a couple of minutes to brown under the broiler in a broiler pan with higher sides
11. Remove and drain off the fat
12. Mix together the onion , ketchup , butter , lemon juice and chopped green pepper
13. Pour over the steak in the pan
14. Set oven to 400 degrees
15. Bake for about 30 minutes
16. Remove to a warm platter or serving dish
17. Serve with the mustard sauce

title: frugal oatmeal banana bars
steps:
1. Grease a 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan
2. Cream the butter and brown sugar until light and fluffy
3. Add egg , salt , bananas , vanilla and peanut butter
4. Beat until very well mixed
5. Stir in the oats and blend thoroughly
6. Spread the mixture evenly in pan
7. Bake in a preheated 350-degree oven for 50-60 minutes cool slightly , then cut into bars of about 1 x 2 inches

title: papaya and strawberry coulis over pound cake
steps:
1. Cut pound cake into 6 slices and arrange on individual serving plates
2. Combine the strawberries and rum in blender
3. Cover and pulse on and off until the mixture becomes a coarse puree
4. Add papaya to blender and pulse until the mixture is smooth
5. Pour 1 / 4 cup coulis over each cake slice and top with a dollop of whip cream
6. Serve at once

title: black bean chili and rice wraps
steps:
1. In large nonstick skillet , heat oil over medium heat
2. Add yellow onion and bell pepper and cook , stirring occasionally , until onion is translucent , about 5 minutes
3. Add garlic , chili powder , cumin , oregano and coriander and cook , stirring , 1 minute
4. Stir in canned tomatoes , beans , salt and pepper
5. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer until most of liquid has evaporated , stirring occasionally , about 5 minutes
6. Remove from heat
7. In large skillet , warm each tortilla over medium heat just until soft and flexible , about 1 minute per side
8. Spoon row of chili down center of each tortilla
9. Top with rice , then diced tomatoes , shredded cheese and red onion , dividing equally
10. Fold bottom end of tortilla partially over filling , then roll into a bundle and serve

title: chocolate oatmeal chippers
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. In a small bowl , combine flour , cocoa , baking soda , and salt
3. Set aside
4. In a large mixing bowl , beat butter , brown sugar , granulated sugar and vanilla extract until creamy
5. Add eggs , one at a time , beating well after each addition
6. Gradually beat in flour mixture
7. Stir in milk chocolate chips , oats , and walnuts
8. Drop by slightly rounded tablespoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet
9. Bake for about 10 minutes or until edges are firm
10. Let stand on cookie sheet for about 2-3 minutes
11. Remove from cookie sheet and let cool on wire rack

title: creamy corned zucchini and peppers
steps:
1. Clean and small dice zucchini , onion , and pepper
2. Heat oil in skillet
3. Add onion , cook until onions are clear but not browned
4. Add zucchini , pepper , corn , and spices , cook over medium high while stirring often , until desired tenderness
5. Add goat cheese , stir until the cheese it melted and evenly distributed

title: biscochitos
steps:
1. Cream lard and butter
2. Add sugar and beat until fluffy
3. Add eggs , anise seed , salt , baking powder and brandy , mix
4. Add flour gradually , til dough is firm , shape into a log and wrap in clear wrap
5. Chill , then slice in 3 / 4" slices
6. Mix cinnamon sugar , press uncooked cookie slice into mixture to coat one side and flatten slightly
7. Bake at 350 degrees until lightly browned

title: blackberry   orange iced tea
steps:
1. Ice cubes - for flavored ice cubes - freeze orange juice in ice cube trays
2. For the orange slices / blackberries ice cubes - place half a slice of orange and two blackberries in ice cube tray and fill with water -- freeze and store in plastic bag until ready to use
3. Steep teabags in 4 cups of boiling water for 3 - 4 minutes , then discard the teabags
4. Place tea on counter to cool
5. Don't allow tea to over steep , it will result in a bitter tea
6. In large pot , bring blackberries , juice , sugar and 1 / 2 cup water to boil
7. Reduce heat and simmer , stirring occasionally until the blackberries break down
8. Next add the berry mixture to the tea
9. Allow the hot tea to cool on the counter before putting into the fridge to prevent clouding in your tea
10. Once tea has cooled put in fridge to chill for 4 hours
11. Strain tea mixture and serve in a ice cube filled glass that you have rimmed with orange juice and dipped in sugar
12. Garnish with orange slice and mint
13. Close your eyes , sit back on the deck and enjoy
14. Iced tea taste best when it is freshly made and will last for two or three days

title: simple stuffed mushrooms
steps:
1. Clean mushrooms & remove stems
2. Place hollow side up on baking sheet
3. Fill each with 1 teaspoon of cheese & sprinkle with bread crumbs
4. Bake at 375@ for 12-15 minutes
5. Serve hot

title: spicy banana bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Grease and flour a 13"x9" pan
3. Cream together margarine and sugar
4. Beat in the egg
5. Stir in banana
6. Stir in the milk
7. Combine flour , baking powder , salt , baking soda , cinnamon , allspice , and nuts
8. Stir into creamed mixture
9. Spread in the pan
10. Bake 20-25 minutes at 350f
11. Until golden brown
12. Frosting: melt margarine
13. Stir in icing sugar and lemon juice
14. Stir in water , 1 tsp
15. At a time , to get a good spreading consistency
16. Spread over warm bars
17. Cool completely
18. Cut into bars

title: jalapeno cheeseburgers
steps:
1. In medium bowl , combine ground beef , jalapeno pepper and mexican seasoning , mixing lightly but+thoroughly
2. Shape into four 1 / 2" thick patties
3. Place patties on grid over medium ash-covered coals
4. Grill uncovered 14-16 minutes or until centers are no+longer pink , turning once
5. Approximately 1 minute before burgers are done , sprinkle each with 1 tablespoon cheese
6. Place one slice tomato on bottom half of+each bun
7. Top with burger
8. Close sandwiches

title: artichokes 101
steps:
1. In a large non reactive mixing bowl combine lemon juice and 6 cups water
2. Pour remaining water into large pot and bring to boil
3. You will need a steaming basket
4. To prepare artichokes one at a time cut off stems , peel off outer leaves until yellow leaves show , cut off top 1 inch so that you can see the inner flower , place in bowl
5. When all are prepared , put them in steamer basket over pot and cover
6. They are done when fork tender

title: sauteed rosemary mushrooms
steps:
1. Heat in a medium skillet olive oil and butter on medium heat
2. Add sliced mushrooms , shallots and rosemary
3. Sprinkle mushrooms with seasonings and brown for approx 10 minutes , stirring occasionally
4. Add wine and continue cooking on med-low heat until moisture is absorbed , stirring ocasionally
5. Remove rosemary twigs and serve as a side dish
6. If serving with dinner a red wine use a marsala cooking wine instead of white / sherry

title: taco bell xxl copycat beef nachos
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Mix ground beef , jalapeo pepper , chili powder and salt in skillet
3. Cook over medium-high heat until meat is browned
4. Drain fat
5. Stir in the salsa and ground cumin
6. Simmer for 2 minutes
7. Arrange chips in a large baking dish & add meat mixture , then cheeses , onion , olives & red bell pepper
8. Bake until warm & cheese melts - approx 8-10 minutes
9. Remove from oven & top with sour cream and guacamole
10. Here is link to my sauce queens copycat signature salsa:

title: grilled chicken and spinach quesadillas
steps:
1. Heat grill to medium
2. In a large bowl , combine the chicken , spinach and cheese
3. Dividing evenly , place the mixture on one half of each tortilla
4. Fold the other half over to cover
5. Grill the quesadillas until the cheese has melted and the tortillas are crisp , 3 to 4 minutes per side
6. Serve with the avocado , salsa and sour cream

title: caramel marshmallow ice cream
steps:
1. Combine marshmallows and cream in pot
2. Stir over low heat till marshmallows have melted
3. Cool
4. Slightly soften ice cream in large bowl
5. Swirl through marshmallow mix and topping to give a marbled effect
6. Return to ice cream container , cover and freeze till firm again

title: tropical cucumber salad
steps:
1. For the dressing , wisk together first eight ingredients
2. Add cucumber , avacado , mango , cilantro and red onion if using
3. Toss gently then chill
4. Serve within a few hours

title: no cans please green bean casserole
steps:
1. Snap the ends off of the green beans and then snap the green beans in half
2. Place the green beans in a crock pot with the ham hock
3. Add enough water to barely cover the green beans
4. Cook on high for 4 hours
5. Take the green beans and ham hock out of the crockpot
6. Gently remove the meat off of the bone of the ham hock and place the meat into a bowl
7. Working with your hands tear the ham into tiny pieces
8. Pour the cream of mushroom soup and the buttermilk into the bowl with the ham
9. Stir to combine
10. Stir in half of the cheese and then gently fold in the green beans carefully so the beans do not break
11. Pour the mixture into a buttered casserole dish
12. Top with the rest of the cheese and the french fried onions
13. Bake on 375 for 20 minutes or until bubbly and hot

title: orange pork tenderloin marinade
steps:
1. Mix together and marinade at least 8 hours , preferably overnight
2. This is good for about 2 lbs
3. Of pork tenderloins

title: holiday cut out cookies
steps:
1. Beat together butter , sugar and vanilla for one minute at medium speed of mixer
2. Add flour and baking powder
3. Chill dough
4. Roll dough between two pieces of wax paper to 3 / 8" thick
5. Cut into shapes
6. Place 1" apart on lightly greased baking sheet
7. Bake at 375 until lightly browned

title: hush puppies ii
steps:
1. Preheat oil in frying pan or deep fryer to 350f
2. Mix first seven ingredients together and drop by tablespoons into hot oil and fry until golden
3. Drain on paper towels and serve while still hot

title: vegan cranberry pumpkin bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Lightly coat a 9 inch square cake pan with vegetable oil spray
3. In the work bowl of a food processor , process the cranberries a few times until approximately quartered
4. Transfer the cranberries to a small bowl
5. Add the dry ingredients to the bowl of the food processor and process briefly to blend
6. In a large mixing bowl , mix together the remaining ingredients
7. Then add in the dry ingredients and cranberries to the mixing bowl , using the muffin method to combine
8. Scrape the batter into the prepared pan
9. Bake until the bread has shrunk slightly away from the sides of the pan and a tester inserted in the center comes out clean
10. If you cool it in the pan briefly it will be easier to remove it from the pan , but do not leave it sitting in the pan too long or it will get soggy on the bottom
11. Turn onto a rack to cool completely before putting in a airtight container , where it will keep for about 4 days , after which it begins to dry out

title: mama s fried catfish
steps:
1. Mix the flour , seasoned salt , pepper , and cornmeal
2. Cover both sides of the catfish with the mix
3. Fry in about a tablespoon of oil in frying pan until both sides are golden brown and crispy

title: philly cheese steak sandwich as it should be made     authentic
steps:
1. Have your butcher slice a thick ribeye into slices as thin as he can
2. If you like the original chop the slices into bite sized pieces
3. If you like geno's then don't chop
4. Start a double boiler up & place the cheez whiz in it to warm up , if you can't find that size just any squeeze bottle will do as long as it's cheez whiz , that's the important part
5. Place onions in some butter on a griddle or in a large skillet and cook until nicely carmelized
6. Scootch them over & add beef , turn once browned , when done just scootch them over to cook the rest of the meat
7. You don't want to overlap the meat while it's cooking
8. Place a nice heap of the beef onto a hoagie roll , no need to warm the roll , it's positively awesome as is , add a good heap of the onions & slather with the cheese whiz
9. That's it ! enjoy the hell out of it , these are so darned good ! trust me , it was the hit of our little super bowl party --

title: raw green pea and almond dip    courtesy of kurma dasa
steps:
1. Put the almonds into your food processor until rustically chopped
2. Mix in the remaining ingredients until you get a nice thick consistency
3. You might to add a bit more water
4. I keep it pretty chunky and rough
5. Add in more lime juice , ginger and seasoning to taste
6. I like mine with quite a bit of kick so i tend to be a bit more heavy handed with the ginger , lime juice and sea salt
7. Slather on crackers , serve with veggies chips , or top raw tacos
8. Yum !

title: shrimp and corn soup  crock pot
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in crock pot , except shrimp and green onions
2. Cook on low for 8 hours
3. Add shrimp during the last hour of cooking
4. Stir and turn cooker to high
5. Ladle into bowls and garnish with green onions , enjoy

title: gluten free creamy potato soup
steps:
1. Place the ingredients in a 4 quart soup pot and cook uncovered over low heat for 30-40 minutes
2. For a thicker broth press some of the potatoes against the side of the pot with a spoon

title: potato crusted chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Spray 9x13 baking dish with nonstick cooking spray
3. Cut any visible fat from chicken
4. Place italian dressing in a large bowl
5. Place potato flakes in a separate large bowl
6. With one hand , coat chicken with dressing
7. Sprinkle with salt , pepper , and paprika to taste with your 'dry hand'
8. Place chicken breast in potato flake bowl
9. With dry hand , coat chicken well with potato flakes
10. Place breasts in a baking dish
11. Bake in oven for 40-45 minutes until chicken is no longer pink

title: fudgy chocolate dessert
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f , & spray 13"x9" glass baking dish with nonstick cooking spray
2. In large bowl , combine cake mix & pumpkin , then spread evenly into baking dish
3. Bake 20-25 minutes or until toothpick inserted near center comes out clean
4. Cool completely on wire rack
5. In large bowl , whisk milk & pudding mixes for 2 minutes , then let stand 5 minutes or until soft-set
6. In small mixing bowl , beat cream cheese until smooth
7. Add pudding & beat until well blended
8. Spread over cake , then cover & refrigerate at least 2 hours
9. Before serving , spread whipped topping over dessert
10. Drizzle with fudge & caramel toppings , & sprinkle with almonds
11. Refrigerate left-overs , if there are any !

title: dom deluise s cheese and onion bread
steps:
1. Saut onion in 2 tablespoons butter until tender
2. In a bowl , combine onions with egg , sour cream , and pepper
3. Mix well
4. Set aside
5. In another bowl , mix flour and baking powder
6. Cut in 1 / 4 cup butter until crumbly and fine
7. Stir in half the cheese
8. Add milk to make a soft dough
9. Pat into a 9" pan
10. Spread sour cream mixture on top
11. Sprinkle with remaining cheese and parsley
12. Bake at 425 for 25 minutes
13. Cut into squares and serve warm

title: delicious pork chops
steps:
1. Salt and pepper the pork chops
2. Heat evoo in pan and brown chops
3. Deglaze the pan using the apple cider
4. Add garlic and diced apple
5. Cover pan and simmer till apples are soft enough to mash with fork
6. Mash apples in pan to make the sauce ,
7. Simmer on stove till sauce is reduced to your liking and the pork chops are cooked through
8. Serve with your favourite potato , rice or noodle dish
9. Add your favourite vegetable or salad
10. Enjoy !

title: tyler florence s ultimate barbecued chicken
steps:
1. Brine the chicken as follows: combine water , salt , sugar , garlic , and thyme in a 2-gallon sized resealable plastic bag
2. Add the chicken , close the bag and refrigerate 2 hours to allow the salt and seasonings to penetrate the chicken
3. Meanwhile , make the sauce as follows: wrap the bacon around the bunch of thyme and tie with kitchen twine so you have a nice bundle
4. Heat the oil in a large saucepan over medium heat
5. Add the thyme and cook slowly 3 to 4 minutes to render the bacon fat and give the sauce a smoky taste
6. Add the onion and garlic
7. Cook slowly without coloring for 5 minutes
8. Add the remaining ingredients , give the sauce a stir , and turn the heat down to low
9. Cook slowly for 20 minutes to meld the flavors
10. Cook the chicken as follows: preheat an outdoor gast or charcoal barbecue to medium heat
11. Take a few paper towels and fold them several times to make a thick square
12. Blot a small amount of oil on the paper towel and carefully and quickly wipe the hot grates of the grill to make a non-stick surface
13. Remove the chicken from the brine , pat the chicken dry on the paper towels
14. Arrange the chicken pieces on the preheated grill and cook , turn once mid way , and cook for a total of 15 minutes
15. Serve with extra sauce

title: vanilla mashed sweet potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f put potatoes on baking sheet and bake until fork tender , approximately 1 hour
2. Remove from oven and let cool until just cool enough to handle
3. Peel and discard skins
4. Set aside in a covered bowl
5. Pour half and half into a 2 quart pot
6. Add vanilla and orange zest
7. Bring to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes
8. Mash sweet potatoes and butter with a potato masher or mixer on low
9. Slowly add vanilla milk mixture until potatoes reach desired consistency
10. Season with kosher salt and white pepper to taste
11. Serve warm

title: cheese joes
steps:
1. Split hamburger buns and toast in oven till lightly brown
2. Fry ground beef , till no longer pink , drain
3. Add tomato sauce , parmesan cheese and salt / pepper
4. Mix well
5. Divide meat mixture evenly among buns , top each with a tomato slice and a cheese slice
6. Broil till cheese is melted
7. Watch closely can burn quickly
8. Enjoy !

title: lentil bolognese
steps:
1. In a large saucepan gently fry the onion , garlic , carrots and celery in the oil for about 5 mins , until they are soft
2. Add the lentils , tomatoes , tomato paste , stock , herbs and seasoning
3. Bring the mixture to a boil then partially cover with a lid and simmer for 20 minutes until thick and soft

title: herb seasoned cheesy beef   rice
steps:
1. Brown ground beef , drain
2. In saucepan , saute rice and garlic in margarine / butter until golden brown
3. Stir in water , carrots , boullion , parsley , basil , salt and minced onion
4. Bring to a boil , simmer for 5 minutes , while stirring in ground beef
5. Transfer into a square casserole dish , cover and bake at 325 degrees for 45 minutes , stirring 2 times
6. Uncover , sprinkle cheddar and bake for 5 minutes or until cheese is melted

title: open faced asparagus omelet
steps:
1. In a skillet with an oven proof handle heat 1 tbsp each of butter and oil
2. Cook mushrooms and garlic , stirring often , when the mushrooms are soft remove from pan
3. Drain liquid from skillet
4. Heat remaining butter& oil , coat the pan
5. Combine the flour& milk , add sour cream then the eggs , , parsley& pepper pour into the skillet
6. Cover and cook over medium heat for 5 minutes or until the top is almost set , lift the eggs and let the fluid egg run under while cooking
7. Sprinkle with the mushrooms , arrange the asparagus like spokes of a wheel
8. Sprinkle with the cheeses
9. Broil until the cheese has melted and is lightly brown
10. Serve

title: best ever sweetened condensed milk cookies
steps:
1. Combine flour , baking powder and salt
2. Cream butter and sweetened condensed milk mixer on low speed , beat in , eggs and vanilla
3. Beat at medium speed for 1 minute add flour mixture and beat on slow speed until combined
4. Divide dough into thirds
5. Wrap and chill dough about 2 hrs until easy to handle
6. Preheat oven to 350f
7. On a lightly floured surface , roll out dough to 1 / 8 inch thickness
8. Reroll as necessary to use all dough
9. Place one inch apart on ungreased baking sheets
10. Sprinkle with colored sugar if desired
11. Bake 9 to 11 minutes or until very lightly browned around the edges
12. Store loosely covered at room temperature
13. Decorate as you wish

title: zippy cheese bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Lightly grease an 8x8in baking pan
3. Spread about half the bread cubes over the bottom of baking pan
4. Sprinkle cheese over bread
5. Arrange the rest of the bread cubes over the cheese
6. Mix eggs , milk , butter , salt and pepper in a medium bowl
7. Pour egg mixture over bread cubes
8. Let stand 10 minutes
9. Sprinkle paprika lightly over top
10. Place baking pan in a larger pan that has been half filled with hot water
11. Place both pans in oven together
12. Bake about 40-45 minutes
13. To see if the casserole is cooked , put a small knife in the middle of it , if it comes out clean , the casserole is done

title: apple marinated roast chicken with grilled apple rings
steps:
1. To make the chicken: combine the apple juice concentrate , maple syrup , vinegar , oil , salt , cinnamon and pepper
2. Put the chicken pieces in a large ziploc bag with the above combined ingredients
3. Marinate this in the fridge for 4 hours , or even overnight , turning occasionally
4. Heat the oven to 375 degrees f
5. Remove the chicken from the marinade and put the pieces into a baking pan and roast for 1 to 1 1 / 2 hours
6. Let it rest for a bit
7. Meanwhile , while the chicken is roasting , pour the marinade into a pot and bring to a boil
8. Reduce the heat and let simmer for about 5 minutes
9. In a small cup , stir together the cornstarch and water , and then stir it into the marinade
10. Boil for about 1 minute until it thickens
11. To make the apple rings: stir together in a bowl the butter , maple syrup and cinnamon
12. Add the apple rings and toss to coat
13. Broil the apple rings about 4-6 inches from the heat for about 3 minutes each side , or , cook in a pan for about 2-3 minutes each side
14. Serve the chicken with the sauce and the apples

title: elswet s uber   tangy chicken pepperoni
steps:
1. Prepare pasta by instructions on box using salted water
2. Rinse , drain and set aside
3. Over a medium heat , in a large skillet , saute celery , bell pepper , onion and mushroom in 1 tablespoon of the olive oil until onion is clear
4. Add pepper flakes , oregano , basil , garlic , black pepper and salt
5. Cook [stirring often] for another 5 minutes
6. Add cayenne pepper , tabasco sauce , pepperoni and chicken
7. Stir , cover and cook over medium heat until chicken pieces outsides are white
8. While chicken cooks , in another medium skillet , heat remaining 2 tablespoons olive oil , add the remaining garlic and mix very well
9. When oil is hot , slowly stir in the flour , 1 tablespoon at a time mixing well until it is a thick paste
10. Stop adding the flour and remove from heat
11. Mix in 8 tablespoons of the tomatoes and blend very well , quickly , into a thick tomato paste
12. Add remaining tomatoes , stirring during addition and mix until thoroughly blended
13. Stir into cooked chicken mixture , add cream cheese and blend well
14. Return to heat and cook an additional 8 minutes to ensure thorough heating of the tomatoes and melting of the cream cheese
15. Either mix into cooked prepared pasta , or spoon over a bed of the pasta
16. Top with grated parmesan and serve hot

title: ginger cucumber limeade
steps:
1. In a blender container combine 1 1 / 2 cups cucumber , limeade concentrate and ginger
2. Cover and blend until nearly smooth
3. In 1-quart pitcher gently stir together cucumber mixture and club soda
4. Serve immediately over ice cubes
5. Garnish with cucumber slices , if desired

title: baked hush puppies
steps:
1. Heat oven to 425f degrees
2. Spray of small muffin tin with veggie oil
3. Mix dry ingredients
4. Stir in onion
5. Mix egg , milk& olive oil , beat well
6. Add to cornmeat mixture and stir gently until just blended
7. Spoon batter into muffin tins fill 1 / 2 to 2 / 3 full
8. Bake until golden , about 15-20 minutes
9. Serve immediately

title: smoked salmon  tomato and feta pizza
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 240c
2. Lightly grease 2 pizza trays and place the bases on them
3. Spread sauce evenly over each base and bake for 10 minutes or until bases a light golden in colour
4. Top bases with equal amounts of tomato , squid , salmon , pizza cheese , onion and feta
5. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes or until squid is cooked and bases are crisp
6. Sprinkle with parsley and chilie and cut into wedges and serve with lemon

title: mediterranean cauliflower salad
steps:
1. Steam cauliflower florets until just tender
2. Refresh under cold water to stop the cooking process
3. In a bowl , combine cauliflower , pepper , parsley , olives and capers , toss lightly
4. Whisk together the vinegar , oil and oregano and pour over vegetables
5. Marinate in the refrigerator for two hours or even overnight
6. Serve cold

title: fried pickles  rsc
steps:
1. 1
2. Place pickles on paper towel to dry
3. 2
4. Mix together ingredients for your batter
5. Set aside
6. 3
7. Place dry mix #1 ingredients into bowl and mix together
8. In seperate bowl , mix together dry mix #2
9. 4
10. Dip pickles , one at a time , into dry mix #1
11. Shake off any excess flour
12. Dip pickles into batter then immediately coat with dry mix #2
13. 5
14. Place prepared pickles onto wire rack and freeze for 20 minutes
15. 6
16. Preheat oil in pan to 375 degrees
17. Fry pickles in batches of 3 or 4 for 3 to 5 minutes or until golden brown
18. Remove from oil and drain on paper towel
19. Repeat until done
20. Let cool several minutes before serving
21. Enjoy

title: crab cannelloni
steps:
1. Thaw phyllo according to the instructions on the package
2. Melt the butter in a skillet and saute the garlic for a few minutes , then add the spinach and cook until the spinach is dry
3. Mix together the rest of the ingredients , except the phyllo and melted butter , folding in the garlic / spinach mix
4. Cut the phyllo lengthwise into 2 strips , stack and cover with some plastic wrap or a lightly dampened dish towel
5. For each pastry roll , take 2 strips from the stack and lay them out one on top of the other
6. Brush the top strip with melted butter
7. Place about 4 tablespoons of filling at the bottom of the strip
8. Fold the bottom edge of the phyllo over the filling
9. Fold the left edge of the phyllo strip over about 1 / 2 inch and brush with butter
10. Repeat with the right edge
11. Now roll up the pastry , egg roll style , stopping halfway through to brush the top with butter , then continue rolling pastry to the end
12. Place the roll seam side down on a greased baking sheet , brushing the top of the pastry with more butter
13. The recipe can be made to this point in the morning to be baked and completed that evening
14. Bake in a preheated 350f oven until golden brown , about 30 minutes

title: spinach dip pinwheels
steps:
1. Stir together soup mix , sour cream , and mayo until well blended
2. Stir in spinach , water chestnuts and green onions
3. Spread tortillas with dip , not quite to the edges
4. Roll up tightly
5. Slice into 1 inch pieces
6. Arrange on serving platter and refrigerate until ready to serve

title: easy as can be creamed turkey   veggies
steps:
1. In a medium sized bowl add soup and milk , mixing well
2. Pour soup mixture into a large skillet
3. Add turkey and veggies
4. Bring to a simmer over medium heat
5. If it looks to thin , add cornstarch mixed with water
6. Stir until thickened
7. Season with pepper to taste

title: spicy garlic chicken with lemon glaze
steps:
1. Season chicken with salt and pepper
2. Stir together panko , garlic and oregano
3. Place in a shallow dish
4. Dredge both sides of chicken in panko mixture
5. Combine lemon juice , honey , tabasco , and zest for glaze in a small bowl , set aside
6. Heat oil in a nonstick skillet over medium heat
7. Add chicken
8. Saute' until browned on both sides and cooked through , about 12 minutes
9. Remove chicken from the skillet
10. Add lemon-honey glaze to the skillet
11. Reduce until syrupy , less than a minute
12. Return chicken to the skillet , flipping the pieces once to coat them with glaze
13. Serve

title: stove top scalloped apples
steps:
1. Place apples in a nonstick saucepan with the butter
2. Cook for several minutes
3. Add sugars , spices and vanilla and continue cooking until apples are tender , about 20-25 minutes over low heat

title: cuban passion
steps:
1. Add all the ingredients to an ice-filled shaker
2. Shake vigorously
3. Strain into an ice-filled highball glass
4. Garnish with lime wedge

title: easy crock pot pumpkin soup
steps:
1. Roughly chop the pumpkin - most pumpkins you can leave the skin on because the crock pot cooks over such a long period - and place in the crock pot
2. Chop potatoes up into cubes , dice onions , place in crock pot
3. Put remaining ingredients in crock pot
4. If you don't want very thick pumpkin soup , add some water
5. Turn crock pot to auto - i usually either put it on before i go to bed for the next morning , or when i get up in the morning for that evening's meal
6. Pumpkin and potatoes should be very soft when ready for the next step
7. Using either a blender or a hand held barmixer , blend until very smooth
8. Serve with crusty bread , topped with grated cheese and a dollop of sour cream
9. This soup freezes very well , and lasts a decent length of time in the fridge
10. I do find that it will need some water added if you freeze or refrigerate it
11. For vegetarian use only the vegetable broth

title: spicy dijon salad dressing
steps: 1. Combine in a small bowl , chill for 2-3 hours serve over tossed salad

title: lemon spice bread   breadmaker 1 1 2 lb  loaf
steps:
1. Measure all ingredients except sweet spice butter into bread machine pan in the order that the bread machine manufacturer suggests
2. Process in basic cycle on lightest crust setting
3. Remove baked bread from pan and cool on wire rack
4. Serve with sweet spice butter , if desired
5. Sweet spice butter: in small bowl , combine 1 / 2 cup softened butter or margarine , 1 / 3 cup sifted powdered sugar and 1 / 8 to 1 / 4 teaspoon ground nutmeg
6. Beat until smooth
7. Cover and chill until ready to serve

title: cowboy coffee steak rub
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a spice or coffee grinder
2. Finely grind the mixture
3. Rub onto your favorite steak or tri-

title: bistecca alla pizzaiola  steak with the pizzaiolos wifes sauce
steps:
1. To prepare tomato sauce place about a tbsp of oil and a crushed clove of garlic in a medium size pot
2. Let garlic turn slightly golden but remove from pot before it becomes too brown
3. Add tomatoes with their liquid and simmer until there is little to no more liquid on top of the sauce
4. Set aside
5. Season steaks on both sides with salt and pepper
6. Heat remaining oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until hot
7. Add garlic and saute for 1 minute then add steaks
8. Quickly brown 1 minute on both sides then transfer to a plate
9. Add the red pepper flakes and oregano to the pan the steaks were cooked in , then add the wine and cook stirring until the liquid is slightly reduced
10. Add tomato sauce , stir then return steak to pan
11. Reduce heat to medium and cook 6-8 minutes turning once
12. Put steak on a serving dish and pour sauce over top

title: roasted garlic soup with swiss cheese and prosciutto
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350^f
2. In a baking dish toss the garlic and oil
3. Bake , covered with foil , about 45 minutes until tender , stir now and then
4. Place garlic in a large saucepan and reserve the oil
5. Add chicken broth , wine and potatoes
6. Cook at a simmer about 20 minutes , until potatoes are tender , stirring now and then
7. Add the cheese and stir until melted
8. Remove from heat and let stand 5 minutes
9. In a blender , puree the soup in batches and strain into another large saucepan
10. Add the cream , sherry , and cognac
11. In a large skillet , heat the reserved oil and saute the onion until golden , about 7 minutes
12. Add prosciutto and saute until heated through , about 2 minutes
13. Stir into soup
14. Season and stir over medium heat until serving temperature

title: almond rice
steps:
1. Combine first four ingredients in a saucepan over high heat
2. Bring to a boil and stir rice and butter
3. Cover pan and reduce heat to medium low
4. Cook 20 minutes
5. Remove from heat and let stand 5 minutes
6. Fluff rice with a fork
7. Gently toss in toasted almonds and serve

title: fank hungarian doughnuts
steps:
1. Dissolve yeast in warm milk
2. Add 2 cups flour and let stand in warm place for 1 / 2 hour
3. In another bowl , beat the eggs and sugar until light
4. Add to the yeast mixture
5. Add 5 cups flour and melted butter
6. Let rise until doubled in bulk
7. Place dough on floured surface and pat with hands until 1 / 2 inch thick
8. Cut into circles with doughnut cutter
9. Cover and let rise until doubled
10. Heat oil to 350 degrees fahrenheit
11. Deep fry until golden

title: broccoli with red pepper flakes and toasted garlic
steps:
1. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium high heat
2. Add broccoli , salt , crushed red pepper and sliced garlic
3. Saute 2 minutes
4. Add 1 / 4 cup water
5. Cover , reduce heat to low and cook for 2 minutes or until broccoli is crisp tender

title: easy cocktail weiners
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in crock pot
2. Heat on low 3-4 hours stirring occasionally
3. Serve warm
4. You can adjust how spicy to prepare according to your tastes , add more mustard , less jelly , etc
5. This is a great recipe base that takes all kinds of changes according to individual tastes easily

title: italian gravy and meatballs
steps:
1. In a large pot combine tomato sauce , tomato puree , tomato paste , water , sugar , oregano , 2 tspn salt , 1 tspn pepper , garlic cloves and bring to a simmer on low heat
2. Combine ground beef , bread , eggs , romano cheese , 1 1 / 2 tspn salt , garlic powder and 1 / 4 tspn pepper
3. Mix ingredients and form into meatballs 2-3" in diameter
4. In a large skillet use enough of the veg oil to have approx 1 / 8" covering bottom
5. Heat on medium
6. When oil is hot enough , brown meatballs on all sides and add to pot with sauce
7. Brown pork neck or ribs in same pan and add to sauce
8. Add at least 1 / 2 of remaining oil in skillet to pot
9. Don't forget to add all of those small cooked bits from skillet bottom
10. Any excess oil or fat can be spooned off of sauce after cooking
11. Cook uncovered for 1 1 / 2 hrs

title: black   white vegetarian chipotle chili  crock pot
steps:
1. Stir everything together in a 4 1 / 2 quart or larger slow cooker
2. Set power to low and cook for 6 hours or longer
3. Serve with cheese or sour cream if you wish

title: mexican fiesta
steps:
1. Grill chicken breast all the way until cooked
2. While chicken is cooking , heat up salsa on stove
3. Place refried beans in a microwave safe bowl and heat about 1 minute or until hot
4. Once chicken is no longer pink , slice into strips and mix into the salsa
5. Place the lettuce shreds on plate , and layer the hot beans on top
6. Top the beans with the chicken salsa mixture and spoon on the sour cream on to
7. Serve with a side of your favorite rice and garnish with sliced green onion

title: butternut  chard   white bean soup pressure cooker
steps:
1. In 1t
2. Olive oil , saute onion , celery and carrot until softened try not to let brown
3. Add in
4. White beans , rosemary sprig , thyme sprig , chicken stock and pepper
5. Bring pressure to 15lbs and cook for 35 minutes
6. Beans should be almost soft but still have a small bite to them
7. Using the quick-release , cold water method , open lid , add in butternut squash , garlic , fresh rosemary minced , garlic and salt & pepper to taste
8. Place lid back on and pressure cook for 10 more minutes with a natural release method
9. Stir in chard greens just before serving and use remaining chicken stock to thin soup if too thick
10. Test to make sure beans are completely soft
11. Pull out stems of rosemary and thyme
12. Add salt to correct seasonings
13. Serve with a dollop of sour cream and croutons

title: red beans and rice with veggies and beef
steps:
1. In skillet saute onion , carrot , and bell or banana pepper in oil
2. Add beef , garlic , cumin , and cayenne pepper
3. Cook till beef is done
4. Drain
5. In lg soup pot add beans , beef mixture , basil , tomatoes , and rice with 6 cups of water
6. Cook 1 hour
7. Stirring often
8. Keep eye on it and cook until beans and rice are tender and water is cooked down
9. Add more water if necessary
10. May take up to 2 hours
11. Enjoy !

title: chocolate ice cream   almost
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients but ice in the blender
2. Add ice and blend to a soft-serve consistency
3. You can add sugar free coffee syrups to this as well - caramel and hazelnut are great with chocolate
4. You can also use frozen raspberries , sugar free raspberry syrup and a bit less ice instead of chocolate !

title: parmesan pull aparts
steps:
1. Stir together yeast , sugar and 1 / 3 cup of warm milk in mixer bowl and let stand until foamy , about 5 minutes
2. Wisk together flour , cheese , and salt , then mix into yeast mixture along with remaining 1 / 3 cup of milk at a low speed
3. Increase speed to medium once flour is incorporated , and beat in two eggs , scraping down sides of bowl occasionally until a very softr dough forms
4. Beat in butter until dough is elastic , dough will be very sticky !
5. Scrape down bowl , cover with plastic wrap and a kitchen towel and let rise in at a warm room temperature until doubled
6. Punch down dough , and turn out on a floured surface
7. Cut into 12 equal pieces , and roll each into a ball
8. Arrange balls 1 inch apart in a buttered 9-by-2 inch round cake pan , and cover with a kitchen towel
9. Let dough rise in a draft-free place at a warm room temperature until doubled and dough fills pan , 1-1 / 12 hrs
10. Preheat oven to 375f with rack in middle
11. Wisk together remaining egg with water and brush on tops of rolls
12. Bake until deep golden brown , 20 to 25 minutes
13. Loosen edges of rolls pan when the come out of the oven , then let cool for several minutes before serving

title: ladybugs on a stick   tasty dish
steps:
1. They won't be so wobbly
2. Ask an adult for help
3. Head: place a grape on a toothpick or wooden skewer , sliding it all the way to the end of the stick
4. Body: next place the strawberry on the skewer , stem end first , and slide it down to touch the grape
5. Spots: lay the ladybug down and carefully push the pointed ends of several chocolate chips into the strawberry to make the ladybug's spots
6. Presentation: place several large lettuce leaves on a pretty platter
7. Arrange the ladybugs on the leaves

title: sour cream swiss steak
steps:
1. In a shallow bowl , combine flour , salt , pepper , paprika and mustard
2. Dredge the steak
3. In a large skillet , heat oil and butter
4. Cook steak on both sides until browned
5. Carefully add water
6. Cover and simmer for 30 minutes
7. In a bowl , combine the sour cream , onion , garlic , soy sauce , brown sugar and flour
8. Stir until smooth
9. Transfer steak into a greased 2 1 / 2 quart baking dish
10. Add sour cream mixture
11. Cover and bake at 325 for 1 1 / 2 hours or until tender
12. Sprinkle with paprika if desired

title: west african groundnut stew  moosewood
steps:
1. Saut the onions in the oil for about 10 minutes
2. Stir in the cayenne and garlic and saut for a couple more minutes
3. Add the cabbage and sweet potatoes and saut , covered for a few minutes
4. Mix in the juices , salt , ginger , cilantro , and tomatoes
5. Cover and simmer for about 15 minutes , until the sweet potatoes are tender
6. Add the okra and simmer for 5 minutes more
7. Stir in the peanut butter , place the pan on a heat diffuser , and simmer gently until ready to serve
8. Add more juice or water if the stew is too thick

title: sweet potato pancakes with pecan honey butter
steps:
1. To make pecan honey butter: combine butter , honey and toasted pecans
2. Set aside
3. To make the pancakes: combine dry ingredients in a mixing bowl
4. Stir in milk and beaten eggs
5. Add oil and vanilla
6. Beat until smooth
7. Fold in the mashed sweet potatoes
8. In a small nonstick frying pan , heat 1 teaspoon vegetable oil over medium heat
9. Pour in batter to desired size
10. Cook until dark brown
11. Serve pancakes warm with pecan honey butter

title: hanky panky
steps:
1. Brown hamburger , sausage and onion
2. Add velveeta cheese until melted , sprinkle cayenne pepper and pepper flakes to taste
3. Let cool completely
4. Mound onto cocktail rye slices and bake at 350 for 10-12 minutes or until bubbly

title: tuna with hoisin  maple and ginger marinade
steps:
1. Whisk together all the marinade ingredients in a small bowl
2. Place the tuna in a large zip lock bag and add marinade
3. Turn bag several times to coat tuna with marinade
4. Marinate in fridge for no more than 1 hour
5. Preheat grill
6. Grill for about 3 - 4 minutes per side , basting generously with reserved marinade
7. Tuna should be slightly pink in the centre

title: fresh fruit with basil
steps:
1. In a saucepan , combine sugar , 1 / 2 cup water , honey and vanilla
2. Bring to a boil , stir to dissolve sugar
3. Reduce heat
4. Simmer , uncovered for 5 minutes
5. Combine the cornstarch and 1 tablespoon cold water
6. Add to saucepan
7. Cook and stir until thickened and bubbling
8. Cook and stir for 2 additional minutes
9. Cool slightly
10. Add orange juice and liquid vanilla
11. Place fruit and basil in large bowl
12. Pour syrup mixture over fruit , stirring gently
13. Cover and let stand about 1 hour or until cooled to room temperature or chill several hours , stirring once or twice
14. If using bananas , slice and add just before serving
15. Serve fruit over a 1 / 2 cup sherbet
16. Cooking time does not include chilling time

title: minted lemonade
steps:
1. In a big saucepan , add the water , sugar , mint leaves , and orange slices
2. Bring to a full boil over high heat
3. Take the saucepan off the burner , cover , and let cool for 1 hour
4. Strain mixture into a large pitcher , discard mint leaves
5. Add the lemon juice
6. Stir to mix well
7. Serve in glasses over ice

title: cheesy bean and vegetable chowder
steps:
1. Combine vegetables , seasonings and milk in 2-quart microwaveable casserole , cover
2. Microwave at high 7 minutes , stirring once after 4 minutes
3. Stir in beans and cheese
4. Microwave at high 5 to 6 minutes or until vegetables are tender
5. Stir halfway through cooking and again before serving

title: oatmeal chocolate chip muffins with chocolate streusel
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f
2. Line twelve medium muffin cups with paper baking cups or spray bottoms only with cooking spray
3. For streusel , combine all ingredients in medium bowl
4. Mix well
5. Set aside
6. For muffins , combine flour , oats , chocolate chips , baking powder , baking soda and salt in large bowl
7. Mix well
8. In medium bowl , combine buttermilk , honey , oil and egg
9. Blend well
10. Add to dry ingredients all at once
11. Stir just until dry ingredients are moistened
12. Fill muffin cups almost full
13. Sprinkle with reserved streusel , patting gently
14. Bake 20 to 22 minutes or until light golden brown
15. Cool muffins in pan on wire rack 5 minutes
16. Remove from pan
17. Serve warm

title: spicy grilled turkey burgers
steps:
1. Preheat the grill
2. Mix together , but don't overmix , the burger ingredients and brush with oil
3. Place on the grill when hot and grill until the center is no longer pink
4. Place on warmed buns and top with any burger fixin's
5. I tried mayo and dill pickles and that was pretty good

title: chicken coconut satay skewers
steps:
1. Soak skewers in cold water for 1 to 2 hours before grilling
2. Cut meat into 3 / 4 inch pieces
3. Place in a medium sized bowl
4. In a food processor or blender whirl together shallots , garlic , coconut milk , lemon juice , sugar , coriander , salt , cumin and turmeric to form a smooth paste
5. Combine with meat and marinate , covered in the fridge for 1 to 2 hours
6. Thread onto skewers without crowding , about 4 pieces per skewer
7. Grill or broil until crisp and browned , but still juicy , about 3 to 6 minutes , turning to cook evenly

title: ham and cheese stuffed  potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Wash and pat dry potatoes
3. Rub each potato with shortening
4. Prick potatoes several times with fork
5. Bake for 1 hour at 375 degrees
6. Cut in half , and scoop out inside leaving shell , and place on a cookie sheet
7. In a large bowl , beat potatoes for 1 minute
8. Add butter , onion , eggs , and pepper
9. Continue until smooth and fluffy
10. Fold in 1 cup of cheese and 1 / 2 cup of ham , fill potato shells with mixture
11. Top with remaining 1 / 2 cup of cheese , and 1 / 2 cup of ham
12. Sprinkle with paprika
13. Bake at 375 degrees for 15-20 minutes or until potatoes are throughly heated , and cheese is melted

title: pear tuna salad
steps:
1. Combine first 5 ingredients in a bowl
2. Stir in tuna and mayonnaise and toss to mix
3. Serve on a bed of greens

title: chocolate nut squares
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350
2. Mix brown sugar , 1 cup butter , vanilla , egg together
3. Stir in flour
4. Spread in bottom of ungreased 9x13 pan
5. Bake 20 to 22 minutes: till golden brown
6. Melt chocolate chips with corn syrup and butter
7. Either in microwave or on stove top
8. Cool chocolate mixture while crust bakes
9. Spread chocolate mixture over crust , then sprinkle with nuts
10. Gently press nuts into chocolate
11. Cool in refrigerator , uncovered , about 2 hours

title: maple   ginger butternut squash
steps:
1. Halve squash and discard seeds
2. Cook , covered with plastic wrap , in microwave on high for 5 to 8 minutes until cooked and tender cool slightly , scoop flesh into a bowl
3. Mash slightly with a fork
4. Add syrup , ginger and salt and pepper to taste

title: rich tea biscuits
steps:
1. Put first 5 ingredients in bowl
2. Stir thoroughly
3. Cut in butter until crumbly
4. Pour in milk
5. Stir quickly to combine
6. Dough should be soft
7. Turn out on lightly floured surface
8. Knead gently 8-10 times
9. Roll or pat 1 / 2 to 3 / 4 inch thick or half the thickness you want the baked product to be
10. Cut with small round cookie cutter
11. Place on greased cookie sheet close together for soft sides or apart for crisp sides
12. Bake in 450 degrees oven for 12 to 15 minutes
13. Brushing biscuits with milk before baking will produce a pretty brown top
14. Makes 10

title: vegetarian white bean soup
steps:
1. Soak beans for 20 minutes in enough lukewarm water to cover
2. Heat oil in dutch oven over medium heat until hot
3. Add onion and garlic , cook and stir until tender
4. Drain the beans and add them along with the potatoes , carrots , celery , cabbage , parsley , bouillon , bay leaf and 6 cups water to dutch oven
5. Mix well
6. Bring to a boil
7. Reduce heat
8. Simmer 1-1 1 / 4 hours or until beans are tender
9. Adding additional water if necessary

title: mostly healthy tuna  n veggie salad
steps:
1. Cook pasta to desired doneness according to package directions
2. Drain well and rinse thoroughly in cold water
3. Dice celery and onion
4. Cut carrots into"half circles"
5. Open tuna cans and drain well
6. Scoop tuna out into a large mixing bowl
7. Add mayonnaise , salt , pepper and lemon juice to tuna and mix well
8. Add relish , if using , and mix well
9. Add celery , onions , carrots , and peas to tuna mixture , mixing well after each addition
10. Add pasta to tuna and vegetable mixture and gently mix well with a large rounded spatula or similar utensil to avoid tearing pasta
11. Wash desired amount lettuce or spinach leaves and pat dry between paper towels
12. Place lettuce or spinach leaves on serving plates or in bowls and top with desired amount of tuna salad
13. Hint: an ice cream scoop works very well for scooping the tuna salad and making a nice looking dish
14. Top with shredded cheese , if using

title: pink dream
steps:
1. Fill a shaker with lots of ice
2. Add gin , campari and cointreau
3. Shake for one minute
4. Strain into a glass
5. Serve immediately

title: taco spaghetti casserole
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375f
2. Cook pasta according to package directions
3. Drain , rinse under cold water
4. Drain again
5. In a 12-in
6. Skillet on med
7. High heat cook ground beef and onion till meat is brown and onion tender
8. Stir in taco seasoning and cook for a few minutes
9. Turn down the heat , add water , bring to a boil , cover and cook 5 minutes
10. Uncover and add the pasta , corn , olives or black beans , 1 / 2 celsius cheese , salsa and green chilli peppers
11. Stir together and pour into a casserole dish , cover with foil and bake for about 30 minutes until hot and bubbly
12. Uncover , sprinkle with the rest of the cheese and bake until cheese melts
13. Serve with lettuce , chips , tomatoes and sour cream

title: jim s chicken provolone
steps:
1. Pound breasts to flatten
2. Mix 1 tb
3. Flour and 1 cup of milk together
4. Add a little garlic salt and salt , to taste
5. Pour over the chicken breasts
6. Cover and refrigerate and let marinate while preparing rest of the ingredients
7. Fry bacon crisp , saving grease to cook in
8. Set bacon aside
9. Thaw and squeeze our liquid of spinach until dry
10. Mix the spinach with the sour cream
11. Add a pinch of garlic salt , salt and 1 tb
12. Of fresh , chopped basil to spinach and sour cream
13. Mix and refrigerate
14. Take the breasts out of the refrigerator and drain
15. Pat off excess moisture with a paper towel
16. Saute the chicken in the bacon grease 8 to 10 minutes until golden brown
17. Remove chicken and put in a 9 x12 elongated dish or pan
18. You don't want the sides to deep
19. Spoon the sour cream / spinach mixture over the top of each breast and top with grated provolone cheese and finish with a crisp bacon strip
20. Bake at 350 or 325 for about 20 or 30 minutes
21. You can put this dish together the night before but bake longer if do so
22. This dish rewarms very well

title: spice crusted roasted butternut squash
steps:
1. Heat oven to 450
2. Spray rimmed baking sheet or roasting pan with cooking spray
3. Combine all ingredients except oil in large bowl
4. Toss with oil to coat
5. Arrange in single layer on baking sheet
6. Bake 25-35 minutes or until tender and browned in spots , turning several times

title: broccoli carrot soup
steps:
1. Prepare broccoli using peeled stalks
2. Cut into small pieces
3. Peel& cut carrots into small coin-size pieces
4. Steam both vegetables until fork tender
5. Place steamed vegetables into blender
6. Add 1 / 2 warmed broth
7. Liquefy , being careful not to overflow
8. Remove to large pot with lid
9. Add remaining broth , half& half , milk , hot sauce , cheese , and salt to blender
10. Liquefy
11. Add to soup in pot
12. Stir to combine
13. Peel& dice potato
14. Place with filtered water in saucepan
15. Bring to boil , turn down to simmer until fork tender
16. Do not overcook
17. Strain , saving potato water
18. Set potatoes aside
19. Add potato water to thicken soup , if desired
20. Blend well and reheat
21. Serve hot with potatoes
22. Add pepper to taste

title: easy french onion bread
steps:
1. Slice bread
2. Mix butter and soup mix- until well blended
3. Spread on one side of each slice of bread
4. Push loaf back together and wrap in aluminum foil
5. Bake at 350 degree oven for approx
6. 30 minutes

title: my citrus cheesecake dessert
steps:
1. Preheat conventional oven to 325f
2. Crush the crackers , add water and maple syrup
3. Spray with cooking spray and line a 9x11 pan with the mixture and place in oven for 10 minutes
4. Meanwhile , soften cream cheese by placing in the microwave for 1 minute and combine it with flour and lime jello powder
5. Add egg whites and mix with electrical mixer
6. Add sour cream , vanilla , and sugar substitute , mix until even
7. Take the crust out of the oven and turn up the heat to 450f
8. Evenly spread the filling in the pan
9. Bake for 10 minutes then reduce heat to 250f and bake for 30-40 minutes
10. Take out and cool for a few minutes
11. Then go over the edges with knife to separate cake from pan
12. Cut into 24 square pieces
13. Let cool before removing because it will fall apart otherwise
14. Topping is optional but it makes it look pretty
15. Cut up the lemon in a food processor to where its pretty much a light yellow mush
16. Peel orange and cut up the peels
17. Combine with lemon
18. Add the maple syrup and sugar substitute to the mixture
19. Smooth about 1 teaspoon of mixture on each cake
20. Add 1 blueberry on top of each cake and sprinkle with sugar
21. Chill for at least 2 hours before serving

title: reese s peanut butter chocolate poke cake
steps:
1. Bake a chocolate cake with your recipe of choice in a 9x13 pan
2. Use the bottom of a wooden spoon to poke holes evenly throughout the cake
3. I usually end up poking 20-25 holes
4. Pour the can of sweetened condensed milk evenly over top of the cake , aiming to fill up the holes
5. Scrape the hot fudge into a medium bowl
6. Add the 1 / 4 cup peanut butter
7. Microwave for 30 seconds
8. Mix until smooth and spread over the cake
9. In a large bowl , whisk together the 3 tbsp peanut butter with the cool whip
10. Spread the peanut butter cool whip over top
11. Chill for at least 4 hours
12. Top with chopped reese's cups and reese's pieces
13. Serves approximately 12

title: gourmet pork chops
steps:
1. Trim excess fat from chops
2. Coat chops with flour , salt and pepper
3. Cook until brown
4. Combine soup , water , ginger , and rosemary
5. Pour over chops
6. Sprinkle with half the onion rings
7. Cover and bake at 350 for 50 minutes
8. Uncover and sprinkle with remaining onion rings and continue cooking for 10 minutes

title: no weep  no shrink meringue
steps:
1. Mix cornstarch , 2 tbls sugar and water and cook over low heat till mixture is clear -- remove from heat -- in a bowl , whip egg whites until peaked and then slowly add the heated cornstarch-sugar-water mixture
2. Beat until creamy
3. Add salt and 6 tbls sugar and beat again till fluffy -- pile on your pie and bake in a 350 oven till meringue is gold tinged , usually 20-30 minutes

title: cauliflower low cal layer salad
steps:
1. Line bottom of large shallow bowl with 12 cups of bite size pieces of torn romaine lettuce
2. Top with cauliflower florets and onion slices
3. With spatula , spread mayo over entire surface of salad
4. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese and bacon bits
5. Salad will be tossed just before serving
6. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight or for 8 hours

title: red velvet cupcakes
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease 12 cupcake cups or line with paper liners
3. Cream butter and sugar until fluffy
4. Add eggs and blend well
5. Make a paste of cocoa and food coloring and add to the butter mixture
6. Sift flour and salt togethr into this mixture
7. One at a time , add the following ingredients: buttermilk , vanilla , and water
8. In a small bowl , combine the vinegar and the baking soda
9. Fold it into the cake batter
10. Make sure it's incorporated , but don't beat it
11. Pour the batter into the cupcake cups
12. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes , until the cake springs back when touched
13. Remove from oven and let cool for about 10 minutes , then turn out of pan and onto a rack to finish cooling completely
14. Cream cheese frosting: blend together the following: 1 package cream cheese , softened , 1 / 2 cup unsalted butter , softened , 1-1 / 2 cups powdered sugar , and 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
15. Blend until smooth

title: hot mexican cider
steps:
1. Add together the first three ingredients in a saucepan
2. Over medium heat , bring to a simmer
3. Add tequila and triple sec and stir occasionally until hot
4. Pour mixture into 8 mugs
5. Garnish with lemon slices if desired

title: buffalo wing wontons
steps:
1. Saute chicken breast until done
2. Chop into small chunks
3. Mix chopped breast with remaining ingredients
4. Place wonton skins in a small muffin pan
5. Scoop 1 teaspoon of the chicken mixture into each wonton "cup" and tightly fold in corners
6. Bake for 7-8 minutes at 450 degrees f or until golden brown

title: little lemon meringue pies
steps:
1. In a bowl , combine flour and salt
2. Cut in shortening and butter until crumbly
3. Gradually add water , tossing with a fork until dough forms a ball
4. Divide in half
5. Roll each portion into a 5-in
6. Circle
7. Transfer to two 10-oz
8. Custard cups
9. Press dough 1-1 / 8 inches up sides of cups
10. Place on a baking sheet
11. Bake at 425 for 7-10 minutes or until golden brown
12. In a saucepan , combine sugar , cornstarch and salt
13. Gradually stir in cold water until smooth
14. Cook and stir over medium heat until thickened and bubbly
15. Reduce heat
16. Cook and stir 2 minutes more
17. Remove from the heat
18. Stir half of hot filling into egg yolk
19. Return all to the pan
20. Bring to a gentle boil
21. Cook and stir for 2 minutes
22. Remove from the heat
23. Stir in lemon juice and butter
24. Pour into pastry shells
25. In a small bowl , beat egg white and cream of tartar on medium speed until soft peaks form
26. Then gradually add sugar and continue beating until stiff peaks form , approximately 1 to 2 minutes
27. Spread evenly over hot filling , sealing edges to crust
28. Bake at 350 for 15-20 minutes or until meringue is golden brown
29. Cool on a wire rack for 1 hour
30. Refrigerate for at least 3 hours before serving

title: mediterranean grilled fish
steps:
1. Lay down a piece of aluminum foil on the grill to cook on or use a grill pan designed for grilling fish on a bbq
2. Heat grill to medium heat
3. In a small bowl , combine the garlic , basil , parsley and lemon juice
4. Spray the foil or grill pan with cooking spray
5. Be careful not to spray directly on your heat source , or you'll get a flare up
6. Place each fillet on the grill and spray the fillets with cooking spray
7. Top each piece of fish with equal amounts of the garlic mixture
8. Sprinkle with black pepper to your liking
9. Grill over medium heat turning once until the fish is cooked through , about 10 minutes
10. Garnish with green olives and lemon slices

title: creamed spinach  like boston market
steps:
1. In a saucepan over medium low heat , melt 3 tbls butter
2. Stir flour and salt into pan until creamed together
3. Slowly stir in cream , then stir in cream cheese , increase heat to medium
4. Constantly whisk until mixture becomes thick and smooth , remove from heat and set aside
5. In a saucepan over medium-high heat , saute onions and garlic in remaining butter until transparent
6. Add spinach and water to pan , reduce heat to low , cover
7. Cook , stirring occasionally for 8 minutes
8. Stir prepared sauce and parmesan cheese into pan , stir until completely blended

title: nanay s filipino fried chicken
steps:
1. In a large pan combine the chicken , garlic , peppercorns , bay leaves , soy sauce , vinegar and water and bring to a boil
2. Simmer uncovered over low heat until chicken is cooked through
3. Remove chicken from pan and pat dry
4. In a large skillet heat the oil over medium heat until it is hot but not smoking
5. Then deep fry the chicken in batches until it is brown and the skin looks crispy
6. Serve with rice
7. Enjoy --

title: finjan erfeh   spicy tea
steps:
1. In a pot , bring the water , anise seeds , ginger , cloves , and cinnamon to a boil
2. Seep on low in a teapot or pan for 10-15 minutes
3. Strain and pour into cups
4. Garnish and top with walnuts and sugar to taste

title: deep fried jalapeno slices
steps:
1. In a bowl mix together flour , salt , pepper , chili powder , garlic powder , eggs and beer together until well combined
2. Heat vegetable oil in a deep fryer or a large heavy pot to 365 degrees
3. Dip / coat the jalapeno slices into the batter , then carefully drop into the hot oil
4. Fry until browned

title: old fashioned biscuits  from my great recipe cards
steps:
1. Mix flour , baking powder , baking soda , salt and sugar in a bowl
2. Cut in butter using pastry cutter or use 2 knives
3. With fork stir in buttermilk to make a soft dough (i have used an equal amount of buttermilk powder with added water and it works wonderfully in this recipe
4. Turn out onto lightly floured workspace and knead no more than 10 times to form a ball
5. Roll into a 6" x 6" square
6. Place on ungreased baking sheet
7. Cut into 12 portions but do not separate
8. Bake at 400 f for 15 minutes or until golden brown
9. Serve with butter , honey , jam , or gravy

title: low fat yogurt biscuits
steps:
1. Combine dry ingredients
2. Cut in margarine and mix until crumbly
3. Stir together yogurt and sugar
4. Add the yogurt mixture to the dry ingredients
5. Mix just until moistened
6. If the dough is too sticky , add more flour
7. If it's too crumbly , add more yogurt
8. Turn onto a floured surface and knead 4-5 times
9. Grease a baking sheet with non-stick spray
10. Place dough on top and pat into a 6x4-inch rectangle
11. Cut into 6 square biscuits
12. Do not separate
13. Brush tops with milk
14. Bake at 450f for 12-15 minutes , or until the tops are golden brown
15. These are best served warm , but they also store well and stay moist

title: blueberry soup  mustikkakeitto
steps:
1. Combine water , blueberries , and sugar in saucepan
2. Cook and stir for about five minutes
3. Dissolve the potato flour in 50 mls of water
4. Remove the boiling blueberry mixture from heat
5. Thoroughly stir the potato flour liquid into the blueberry mixture
6. Return saucepan to stove and bring to a boil
7. Remove from heat as soon as the first bubbles appear
8. Sprinkle with sugar and cool
9. Serve cold with sweet rusks or cookies

title: betty crocker peach pancakes
steps:
1. Beat egg with hand beater until fluffy
2. Add rest of ingredients
3. Grease griddle and heat
4. Pour about 3 tbsp batter onto hot griddle and cook until edges of pancake puff and look dry around edges
5. Flip , and cook opposite side until golden brown

title: bailey s irish cream bread pudding
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300 degrees
2. Butter one 2-quart casserole dish
3. Prepare a water bath for the 2-quart casserole dish by placing a larger dish with water in the oven
4. Place bread cubes in the 2-quart casserole dish
5. Beat together the eggs , sugar , and vanilla
6. Slowly add the scalded milk and bailey's irish cream
7. Pour over the bread
8. If desired , sprinkle with brown sugar , nutmeg , and raisins
9. Place the casserole in the water bath and bake for 50 to 60 minutes or until a knife inserted in the middle comes out clean
10. Server either hot or chilled
11. When you take the pudding out of the oven , if the pudding seems to be dry , you can sprinkle some bailey's over the top to help make it moist

title: janie s hamburger soup
steps:
1. Saute onion
2. Brown ground beef with onion
3. Add remaining ingredients
4. Simmer on low until pasta is cooked
5. 2-3 hours

title: pouding aux pommes au sirop d erable  apple maple pudding
steps:
1. Arrange apples in a greased 8 inch square baking pan
2. Pour 1 / 2 cup of the maple syrup over apples , stirring to coat well , and spread in an even
3. Layer
4. In a bowl , combine beaten egg , butter and lemon juice with remaining 1 / 2
5. Cup maple syrup
6. In another bowl , combine flour , baking powder and salt
7. Stir the dry ingredients into the egg mixture
8. Fold in raisins
9. Pour batter evenly over apple pieces
10. Bake in preheated 375 deg f oven for 30 to 35 minutes or until top is lightly browned
11. Serve warm with unsweetened whipped cream , if desired

title: chicken with dill sauce
steps:
1. Trim excess fat from chicken
2. Place each piece between 2 sheets of waxed paper
3. Flatten to 1 / 4" thickness , using a meat mallet or rolling pin
4. Place chicken in 13x9x2" baking dish
5. Combine next 5 ingredients in a small bowl
6. Pour over chicken
7. Cover and refrigerate 2 hours
8. Remove chicken from marinade , discarding marinade
9. Coat a grill with cooking spray
10. Grill chicken 6" over med coals 8 minutes , turning once
11. Arrange chicken on a serving platter
12. Garnish with lime wedges
13. Serve with 1 1 / 2 t dill sauce per serving
14. Dill sauce: combine all ingredients in blender
15. Process till smooth

title: mediterranean lemon olive chicken
steps:
1. Season chicken with salt and pepper
2. Heat 2 tbsp oil in large skillet , and quickly sear the chicken on both sides
3. Chicken should be golden brown
4. Remove the chicken from the skillet
5. Set aside
6. Slice lemons thinly , and then cut slices in half
7. If necessary , add the remaining oil to the pan
8. Fry the onion and garlic until soft , but not brown
9. Add the lemons , olives , broth , and water
10. Simmer for 10 minutes
11. Place the chicken in the skillet on top of the veggies and sprinkle with thyme and red pepper
12. Cover and simmer until chicken is cooked , about 15 minutes

title: fresh tomato sauce sicilian
steps:
1. Heat an 8- to 10-quart heavy-bottom pot and add the oil , garlic , and onion
2. Saute until the onion is clear
3. Add the remaining ingredients except the butter and salt and pepper
4. Bring to a simmer and gently cook , uncovered , for 4 hours , stirring often
5. Stir in the butter and salt and pepper to taste

title: my really good beef roast  crock pot
steps:
1. Rinse roast under cool water
2. Add roast to crock pot
3. Sprinkle brown gravy mix on and around roast
4. Add 1 / 2 cup water around roast
5. Add quartered potatoes around roast
6. Sprinkle ranch mix over roast and potatoes
7. Season potatoes with salt
8. Set crock pot on high for 3 hours
9. Cut carrots same size as quartered potatoes or if using baby carrots , use whole
10. Add carrots and additional 1 / 2 cup water if you like a thinner gravy or au jus
11. Change setting to low for 2 more hours
12. Slice roast on serving platter , surround with veggies
13. Serve gravy or au jus on the side
14. Any cut of roast would probably work , but this is a good , lean cut that doesn't require trimming and also slices nicely
15. A larger roast may also be used
16. Cooking: you can also add the carrots after step 7 and cook on low for 6-8 hours total
17. The carrots will just be a little softer than the other method

title: portabella breakfast casserole
steps:
1. Spray a 10" frying pan and place over medium heat
2. Add mushrooms , garlic , onion , and rosemary
3. Cook until tender but not completely done
4. Spray a 1 qt
5. , 6 1 / 2" round casserole dish
6. Place half of the bread evenly in dish
7. Layer in half of the cheese , and then half of the vegetable mixture
8. Repeat
9. In a large bowl , mix egg substitute , milk , salt and pepper
10. Pour over bread , cheese , and veggies and cover casserole with plastic wrap
11. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours or up to overnight
12. Remove plastic wrap and bake the casserole at 350f
13. For 45 to 55 minutes or until set in the center
14. Let stand for 5 minutes
15. Serve hot

title: raisin filled cookies   zcmi recipe
steps:
1. For dough:
2. Cream together shortening and sugars
3. Add eggs , one at a time
4. Beating well after each addition
5. Stir in water
6. In a small bowl , mix flour , salt and soda
7. Add wet ingredients , mixing well
8. Divide dough into four parts
9. Roll each section into a 2 inch thick log
10. Wrap in plastic wrap or wax paper
11. Chill for several hours or overnight
12. For filling:
13. Combine ingredients for filling in a saucepan
14. Stir and heat to boiling
15. Cook until thickened - then cool
16. Heat oven to 375 degrees
17. Using one roll of dough at a time , cut dough into 1 / 4 inch thick slices
18. Lay slices on a greased baking sheet , leaving ample space between cookies
19. Place a teaspoon of filling on dough
20. Place another slice of dough on top , dough slices can be left unsealed , or for a slight decoration , press together with tines of a fork
21. Bake 15 minutes or until lightly browned
22. Cool on rack , cookies freeze well

title: seafood  cataplana
steps:
1. Place all the ingredients in the bottom of a cataplana or a wide saucepan with a close fitting lid
2. Place over a low / medium heat , cover with the lid and cook for 5-8 minutes until the mussel and clam shells have steam open
3. Stir well and remove and discard any mussels or clams which haven't opened
4. Serve immediately

title: green beans in olive oil
steps:
1. Place onions and tomatoes in a saucepan
2. Sprinkle with salt and stir gently
3. Add green beans , olive oil and sugar
4. Stir
5. Cover and cook over medium low heat , stirring occasionally , for about 15 minutes until beans are softened
6. Once the liquid has been absorbed , stir fry a couple of minutes
7. Add 1 / 2 cup water , cover , and simmer 40 minutes until beans are tender
8. The beans will be moist , but not watery
9. Serve cold or room temperature

title: grilled potato wedges
steps:
1. Cut scrubbed potatoes into large chunks
2. Boil potatoes for 5 minutes
3. Mix butter and seasonings together
4. Place butter and seasonings in pie plate with several holes punched in it
5. Coat drained potatoes in seasoning mixture in pie plate and grill over medium heat for 10-15 minutes or until crispy , turning occasionally

title: judy s vegetarian black bean soup
steps:
1. Heat olive oil in a skillet
2. Add onion , bell peppers , celery , and garlic
3. Saut until tender
4. Drain and rinse black beans
5. Combine sauted vegetables , water , undrained tomatoes and black beans in a large sauce pan
6. Stir in the salt , pepper , coriander and cumin
7. Simmer over a medium-low heat for 15 minutes , stirring occasionally
8. Place 1 / 2 of the pan contents into a blender and pure
9. Return to sauce pan with remaining bean mixture
10. Cook , stirring occasionally , until hot
11. Ladle into serving bowls and top each bowl with one tbs sour cream

title: turkey sausage and cheese omelet
steps:
1. Add eggs and milk in small bowl beat well
2. Heat small egg pan on medium heat
3. Add 1 tsp oil , onion , and sausage
4. Cook for 5 minutes or until sausage is fully cooked
5. Remove sausage from pan to small bowl
6. Reheat pan and add 1 tsp oil
7. Add eggs and cook omelet on both sides
8. Top eggs with sausage on one side , top with cheese
9. Fold omelete onto plate
10. Serve with whole wheat toast

title: ragout de boulettes   meatball stew
steps:
1. Dump meatballs into slow cooker
2. Combine seasonings and flour
3. Mix chicken stock with water
4. Add flour and seasonings to liquid and whisk thoroughly
5. Pour over meatballs and cook on high for 4 - 5 hours or on low for the day
6. Serve over naked mashed potatoes
7. If you happen to pass through the kitchen , stir the mixture a couple of times during the day , but this is not critical
8. If you are in a real hurry , just whisk the flour into the water and dump everything into the slow cooker , stir as well as possible as let it cook

title: onion haystacks
steps:
1. Combine dry ingredients
2. Add remaining ingredients except for onions , and mix well
3. Stir onions into batter
4. Using heat resistant metal tongs to place onion stacks into hot oil
5. Cook 3 minutes or until done

title: sauteed portabellas   spinach
steps:
1. Melt butter in a large skillet or saute pan over medium heat
2. Saute mushrooms , spinach , basil , salt , pepper and garlic until mushrooms are tender and spinach is heated through
3. Pour in wine and reduce heat to low
4. Simmer 1 minute
5. Stir in parmesan cheese and serve

title: red lobster white cheddar mashed potatoes recipe
steps:
1. Place potatoes in pot and cover with cold water
2. Bring to a boil and simmer until fork tender
3. Drain completely
4. Mix potatoes with an electric mixer until smooth
5. When smooth , add butter and blend
6. Add cream , a little at a time and beat
7. Add sour cream and blend
