8. Add cheese , salt and pepper and blend again

title: corn chowder with fingerling potatoes   smoked bacon
steps:
1. Cook bacon in a large pot oven over medium heat until crisp
2. Remove bacon from pan and set aside to drain on paper towels
3. Add butter and onion to drippings in pan and cook 8 minutes or until tender , stirring occasionally
4. Add flour and stir to coat onions
5. Continue to cook until flour has turn a very pale , golden color , one or two minutes
6. Add corn , chopped thyme , cayenne pepper , and garlic to pan , and stir to combine
7. Cook for 30 seconds , stirring constantly
8. Stir in broth , cream , and potatoes
9. Cover , turn heat to high and bring to simmer
10. Reduce heat to medium low and cook 10 to 15 minutes or until potatoes are tender and the broth has thickened , stirring frequently
11. Season with salt and black pepper
12. To serve , ladle into bowls and sprinkle with the reserved crumbled bacon and thyme leaves

title: crock pot chicken stew   3 ww points
steps:
1. Put everything in a large crockpot
2. Cook on low 8-9 hours
3. Cooks
4. Keep in mind that this is a stew not a soup
5. Dont be afraid of big chunks of food
6. Dont chop your vegetables too small

title: lemon sauce  for chicken or fish
steps:
1. Combine lemon juice , sugar , soy sauce , cornstarch , bouillon cube , water , salt and pepper in a small sauce pan
2. Cook and stir over low heat until sauces comes to a boil and becomes thick
3. Add red pepper and green onions
4. Mix well and pour over cooked chicken or fish

title: pickled peppers with shallots and thyme
steps:
1. Slice peppers crosswise into 1 / 4 inch rounds , seeded
2. Separate shallot slices into thin rings
3. Place peppers and shallots in medium bowl
4. Mix vinegar and next 6 ingredients in medium saucepan
5. Bring to boil over medium heat , stirring to dissolve sugar and salt
6. Remove brine from heat
7. Carefully pour over peppers and shallots
8. Cover bowl
9. Let sit 5 minutes
10. Uncover
11. Let cool to room temperature
12. Transfer to quart-size jar , pressing peppers into brine
13. Cover
14. Chill at least 4 hours and up to 10 days

title: reese s cup cake
steps:
1. Prepare cake mix as directed in three 8 inch round pans
2. Beat softened cream cheese and confectioner's sugar until creamy
3. Fold in cool whip
4. Chop 1 / 3 bag of reese's cups until fine
5. Fold into mixture
6. Spread between layers and on sides and top of cake
7. Half enough reese's cups to circle the bottom
8. Chop the remaining reese's cups coarsely and sprinkle on top
9. Chill

title: alfredo shrimp tilapia
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425
2. Wash and dry tilapia filets , spread with olive oil and creole seasoning , to your taste
3. Place in well oiled baking pan , bake for 8-10 minutes , until just white
4. While fish is baking , saute slivers of red pepper in 1 tbs butter , until cooked , about 5 minutes
5. Warm alfredo in a small saucepan
6. In a frypan , melt 3 tbs butter , add minced garlic and cleaned , prepared shrimp , saute for about 5 minutes
7. When fish is ready , remove from pan from oven
8. Carefully remove fillets , 4 per plate
9. Place one quarter of the red pepper slivers and one quarter of the cooked shrimp on top of fillets
10. Top with 1 / 4 cup of alfredo , sprinkle of grated cheese and a dusting of more creole seasoning
11. If you like , you can put this under the broiler for about a minute

title: gluten free fudgy brownies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Spray pan and dust w / cocoa powder
3. Melt margarine
4. Mix ingredients in one big bowl
5. Pour into prepared pan
6. Bake for 25 minutes

title: scallop purleau
steps:
1. Cook bacon until done , remove bacon , save grease
2. Add onion , green pepper and grape tomatoes to bacon grease
3. Cook until liquid is dissolved
4. Add chicken stock , bring to boil
5. Add rice and cover , turn down heat
6. After 10 minutes add scallops and jalapeo pepper by fluffing rice recover
7. When rice is fully cooked , stir , serve and enjoy

title: spinach  bacon   mushroom salad
steps:
1. In a heavy skillet , fry bacon
2. Crumble & set aside
3. Reserve 2 t
4. Drippings
5. While bacon is frying , mix greens with onion in a large serving bowl
6. To drippings in skillet , add remaining ingredients
7. Bring to a boil , stirring constantly to bring up the fond
8. Drizzle dressing over greens in bowl
9. Toss gently
10. Garnish with eggs , radishes , and mushrooms
11. Serve immediately

title: crock pot  lentil   ham soup
steps:
1. Put all ingredients except green onion and sour cream into the crock pot cook on low 7 hours
2. Come home , dish into bowls and top with sour cream and green onions if desired
3. Enjoy !

title: aroz con pollo  chicken with rice
steps:
1. Sprinkle chicken lightly with salt
2. Brown chicken in hot oil for about 15 minutes
3. Remove chicken from pan
4. Cook rice , onion , garlic in the same pan with drippings until rice is browned
5. Add water , undrained tomatoes , bouillon , salt , pepper , and saffron
6. Bring to boil
7. Stir well
8. Arrange chicken on top of rice
9. Cover and simmer for 35 minutes or until chicken is tender
10. Add peas and pimiento
11. Cover and cook 5 minutes more

title: chicken mediterranean for two
steps:
1. Combine first 3 ingredients in a heavy-duty zip-lock plastic bag
2. Seal and chill 2 hours
3. Cook this chicken mixture in a large skillet over medium-high heat for about 8 minutes or until the chicken is done
4. Remove from skillet and set aside
5. To the empty skillet , add the tomatoes and their juice , olives , parsley , basil , and oregano
6. Reduce heat , simmer , stirring often for about 7 minutes
7. Return chicken to skillet
8. Sprinkle with the feta cheese , remove from heat
9. Cover and let stand for 5 minutes so the cheese can melt a little
10. Pour over cooked , hot pasta and serve immediately

title: french onion and  beef pinwheels rollups
steps:
1. Mix the french onion spread ingredients and chill in the fridge for an hour
2. Once the spread has been chilled , roll out a long piece of foil and lay the tortillas on the foil so that the ends of the tortillas overlap on the inside
3. Generously spread the french onion mixture over the tortillas
4. Try to cover as much of the surface as possible
5. Place the slices of roast beef down the middle of the tortillas
6. Overlap them so it is like one continuous strip of roast beef
7. Roll the tortillas carefully and tightly
8. Cover the rolled tortilla with the surrounding foil
9. Be careful to make sure the ends are sealed
10. Chill in the fridge for a few hours or overnight
11. Take out and slice the big roll into smaller pieces

title: fancy fast chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Place the chicken in a 9x13 pan sprayed with"pam"
3. Top each piece of chicken with a slice of cheese
4. Arrange the sliced mushrooms over the cheese
5. Mix the soup and the wine together , and pour over the top
6. Sprinkle the stuffing over the top
7. Melt the margarine and drizzle over the top
8. Bake for approx 40 minutes or until chickenis baked through

title: tyrosalata   spicy feta dip
steps:
1. Blend all ingredients together in blender until smooth
2. Add more feta if too thin
3. Add more cayenne if not spicy enough

title: whole wheat date nut muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Spray muffin tin with oil
3. Mix the flours , baking powder , and salt together
4. Beat together the oil , honey , eggs , milk and vanilla
5. Mix the dates with the dry ingredients , then add the wet ingredients
6. Finally , stir in the walnuts
7. Fill muffin tins , adding a few coarsly chopped walnuts on the top if you'd like
8. Bake 25 minutes , until golden

title: barbecue ribs
steps:
1. Wrap ribs in double thickness of foil and bake for 2 hours at 300 degrees f
2. Unwrap and drain drippings
3. Combine all ingredients and pour over ribs
4. Marinate at room temperature for 1 hour
5. Bake at 350 degrees 30 minutes , basting with sauce , or grill 30 minutes , 4 inches above coals turning and basting

title: hot apple toddies
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan over medium heat or in a 4 quart slow cooker , combine all ingredients and heat through
2. Do not boil
3. Mull for 45-60 minutes
4. Serve warm in footed glasses with cinnamon sticks as garnish

title: chile verde  green chile sauce
steps:
1. Heat shortening in medium-sized skillet on medium heat
2. Saute the onions in shortening
3. Add flour and cook for 1 minute
4. Add all remaining ingredients and simmer for 20 minutes

title: broccoli balsamico
steps:
1. In a small bowl , whisk the vinegar , sugar , garlic , ginger , salt and pepper
2. Add the oil and set aside
3. Place the broccoli in a deep saucepan
4. Pour in 1 / 2 c water , cover and set over medium-high heat
5. Cook until
6. Remove from heat and add the balsamic mixture , pouring it down the side of the pot so it mixes with the cooking water
7. Return the pot to the heat and cook , stirring , until the liquid has almost completely evaporated
8. Serve immediately

title: biscotti di anise
steps:
1. In a large bowl place the butter and sugar , and cream them together
2. One at a time add the eggs and beat them in
3. Add the anise seeds and mix them in
4. Add the vanilla and anisette and beat them in
5. In a mixing bowl place the flour and baking powder , and mix them together
6. Add the flour to butter mixture
7. Combine the ingredients together well
8. Add the almonds and stir them in well
9. Form the dough into a flat loaf
10. Cover it and place it in the refrigerator overnight
11. Preheat the oven to 375xf
12. Place the loaf on a cookie sheet and bake it for 20 minutes , or until it is firm
13. Remove the loaf and let it cool
14. Slice it diagonally into 3 / 4" thick slices
15. Preheat the oven to 375xf
16. Place the slices on a cookie sheet and bake them for 15 minutes , or until they are golden brown
17. Let them cool before serving

title: sweetheart steaks
steps:
1. In a small saucepan , combine the first 15 ingredients
2. Bring to a boil
3. Reduce heat
4. Simmer , uncovered , for 30 minutes , stirring occasionally
5. Set aside 1 / 4 cup sauce for serving and keep warm
6. Place steaks on a broiler pan
7. Top with some of the remaining sauce
8. Broil 4 to 6 inches from the heat for 10 to 16 minutes on each side or until meat reaches desired doneness , basting occasionally with remaining sauce
9. Serve with reserved sauce

title: karen s delicious peanut butter cookies
steps:
1. Cream the butter , peanut butter , sugars , eggs and almond extract till fluffy
2. Sift the dry ingredients and add to the creamed mixture
3. Shape into quarter cup sized balls , roll in additional granulated sugar and flatten with the tines of a fork
4. Bake on un-greased cookie sheets for 11-13 minutes
5. Cool slightly and remove from pans to cool on racks
6. I use a smaller ice cream scoop to measure my cookies out
7. You can make them whatever size that you want , be careful to not overbake , i bake for only 11 minutes

title: mexican chicken  parmesan   minus the parmesan
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Pound chicken breasts to approximately 1 / 4-1 / 2 inch thickness
3. In 3 separate shallow bowls put enough flour to lightly dredge the chicken in one bowl , 2 beaten eggs in the second and the panko bread crumbs mixed with the taco seasoning in the 3rd
4. In the following order for each breast: dredge in the seasoned flour shaking off excess , put them next into the eggs to moisten each side and then into the panko / taco seasoning mixture making sure to coat the chicken breast entirely
5. Set the prepared chicken breasts aside for a few minutes
6. Meanwhile , add the canola oil to a large enough skillet to fit all 4 breasts and preheat the pan over med / high heat
7. Cook each breast until lightly browned on each side and remove from the pan
8. The chicken does not have to be cooked through as it will continue cooking in the oven
9. Place the 4 chicken breasts in a casserole dish
10. Top each with 1 / 2 cup of prepared salsa
11. Place in the oven for 15 minutes to finish cooking the chicken and heat the salsa through
12. Remove from the oven and top with 1 / 2 shredded cheese on top of each breast and return to the oven for 5 minutes or until the cheese is melted and it's ready to serve
13. I serve this over cilantro rice and add a "blop" of sour cream and some diced green onions on top

title: russian radish tomato mint salad
steps:
1. Peel radish and slice finely
2. Slice tomatoes
3. Chop onion and mint finely
4. Combine all the ingredients and dress with oil , lemon juice
5. Season to taste

title: picadillo tacos
steps:
1. Place diced potatoes in boiling water and cook until soft
2. In the mean time fry the ground beef in a pan over medium high heat
3. When the meat is nearly cooked add the onion and continue cooking until the onions are soft and browned
4. Add the chili powder , coriander , cumin , and pepper , cooked potatoes and minced garlic
5. Also add a little water to your meat to moisten it and pick up some of the bits of meat from the bottom of the pan , it only needs to be about a 1 / 4 of a cup
6. Serve with warm flour tortillas and salsa

title: fusako s egg drop soup
steps:
1. Heat broth to boiling
2. Mix water with beaten eggs
3. Add ginger root to boiling broth- remove in 3 minutes
4. Drizzle egg mix into boiling broth
5. Serve while hot

title: hot   spicy mushrooms
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400
2. Combine all of the ingredients except for the mushrooms in a plastic freezer bag and mix to combine
3. Dump the mushrooms into the bag and turn to make sure all of the mushrooms are evenly coated
4. Pour the mushrooms into a pan lined with foil
5. Bake for 20 minutes , or until mushrooms start releasing liquid , stirring once or twice

title: low carb pumpkin sausage soup
steps:
1. Brown sausage , drain , then add the onion , garlic , italian seasoning and mushrooms and saut until done
2. Add pumpkin to this mixture and mix well
3. Then stir in the broth and mix well
4. Simmer 20-30 minutes
5. Stir in the heavy cream and water and simmer on low another 10-15 minute taste and add salt& pepper as needed

title: beef   mushroom ragu over fresh cheese ravioli
steps:
1. Heat 1 tbsp olive oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
2. Add mushroom , onions and garlic and saut 6 minutes or until onions are soft
3. Remove mixture from the skillet and set aside
4. Add the lean ground beef to the skillet and cook about 6 minutes or until no longer pink
5. Add the mushroom mixture , tomatoes , tomato paste , italian seasoning , sugar and salt and pepper to the beef mixture
6. Bring to a boil , reduce heat , cover and simmer 15 to 20 minutes until the sauce has thickened and the flavors have had chance to blend
7. While cooking the sauce , bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil
8. Add ravioli and cook according to package directions
9. Drain and return to pot , adding 1 tbsp olive oil and toss to coat
10. Spoon ravioli into a serving dish and top with sauce
11. Serve with freshly grated parmesan cheese and enjoy !

title: warm salmon and couscous salad
steps:
1. Measure broth into a large microwave safe bowl
2. Heat on high to boiling point then add couscous , chili powder , lemon zest and spinach
3. Stir , cover tightly and let stand 5 minutes
4. Add salmon , carrot , lemon juice , green onions , and walnuts
5. Fluff with a fork and serve immediately on a bed of lettuce or spinach leaves

title: camper s fish meal packets
steps:
1. Divide fillets into 3 equal amounts
2. Place each on double thickness foil squares
3. Divide vegetables among packs , place on top of fish
4. Sprinkle with salt and pepper , add a dab of butter and paprika
5. Wrap and place on grill and cook over medium heat with lid closed
6. Cook for 10 minutes then turn and cook 5 minutes more

title: ww 1 5 points   skinny b tch
steps:
1. Mix liquor and diet coke
2. Squeeze lime juice in to drink
3. Mix well and enjoy

title: creamy southwest noodles
steps:
1. Cook noodles drain
2. Meanwhile in pan stir together sour cream and taco mix low heat toss with noodles top with all the optionals if desired

title: southern fried rattlesnake
steps:
1. Skin rattlesnake
2. Clean and wash meat
3. Cut in 4 inch lengths
4. Beat egg and milk
5. Mix salt , pepper , garlic salt , accent and flour
6. Preheat deep fat fryer with cooking oil
7. Dip snake into egg mixture and then in flour mixture and place it in hot oil
8. Cook until golden brown

title: simple fig   mascarpone dessert  or tapas
steps:
1. Spread approx 1 / 2 t cheese on each fig half and arrange figs on a plate
2. Drizzle agave syrup / sweetener over and around the figs
3. Sprinkle figs with 1 pinch of salt and 1 pinch of nutmeg
4. Enjoy !

title: artichoke hearts salad
steps:
1. Mix sour cream and curry powder and set aside
2. Mix salad ingredients in a bowl and pour sour cream mix over salad
3. Season with worchestershire , salt , pepper and paprika and mix well
4. Serve on a bed of lettuce or spinach or in tomato or bell pepper bowls
5. Or serve topped with red onions and parsley

title: crab cakes with a bite
steps:
1. Pick through the crab meat to remove any shell or cartilage
2. In a large bowl , beat the eggs until smooth
3. Add the cheese , mayo , seasonings , worcestershire sauce and spicy mustard to the eggs and whisk until smooth
4. Gently fold in crab meat , bread crumbs and parsley and mix by hand until combined
5. Divide into 4 parts and mold into 4 balls , place on a plate and chill at least an hour in the refrigerator
6. When chilled , preheat the oven to 350 degrees
7. Use the non-stick foil if you have it or coat an ovenproof pan with non-stick spray
8. Place the crab cakes in the pan and bake at 350 degrees for 10 minutes
9. Then switch to high broiling temperature
10. Broil until browned and then remove the pan and gently flip them , return to oven and brown the other side
11. Enjoy !

title: french yogurt cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Coat pan with vegetable oil spray
3. Dust with flour
4. Tap out excess
5. Whisk 1 1 / 2 cups flour , baking powder , and kosher salt in a medium bowl
6. Using your fingers , rub sugar with lemon zest in a large bowl until sugar is moist
7. Add yogurt , oil , eggs , and vanilla extract
8. Whisk to blend
9. Fold in dry ingredients just to blend
10. Pour batter into prepared pan
11. Smooth top
12. Bake until top of cake is golden brown and a tester inserted into center comes out clean , 5055 minutes
13. Let cake cool in pan on a wire rack for 15 minutes
14. Invert onto rack
15. Let cool completely
16. Do ahead: can be made 3 days ahead
17. Store airtight at room temperature

title: sourdough pizza dough   abm
steps:
1. Load bread machine according to manufacturer's instructions
2. Watch when it starts the kneading cycle & adjust dough consistency with either a bit of flour or water as sourdough starters vary in thickness
3. Goal is an elastic somewhat soft but not at all sticky dough
4. Once dough cycle completed , roughly knead & then dump dough into an oiled bowl & let rise 2nd time , either room temp or in fridge
5. Knock down after 2nd rise & divide into 2 pieces
6. Shape your pies and add your favorite sauces & toppings
7. Bake on preheated stone at 475 degrees f for 14 - 16 minutes
8. Oiled dough can also be divided & frozen in freezer bags with the air expressed
9. If freezing , remove from freezer & allow to thaw , do 2nd rise & use for pie

title: ham breakfast casserole
steps:
1. Spray 8 x 8 baking dish with cooking spray
2. Place 4 slices of bread in prepared baking dish
3. Sprinkle ham , mushrooms , and chees over top
4. Cover with 4 slices of bread
5. In a medium bowl , combine eggs and skim milk
6. Add onion flakes , parsley flakes , and lemon pepper
7. Mix well to combine
8. Evenly pour egg mixture over bread
9. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour or overnight
10. Uncover and bake at 350 f for 1 hour
11. Place baking dish on a wire rack and let set for 5 minutes
12. Cut into 4 servings

title: homemade condensed milk
steps:
1. Pour the milk into a medium heavy saucepan and bring to a boil
2. Reduce to a simmer and cook 45 minutes , stirring occasionally
3. Stir in the sugar and continue simmering 10 to 15 minutes or until reduced to 3 cups
4. Strain
5. Homemade condensed milk can be refrigerated up to a week

title: lebanese yogurt and cucumber salad
steps:
1. Drain the yogurt in a cheesecloth-lined colander for several hours , discarding the liquid that has collected
2. Place the mint and garlic together in a salad bowl and crush with a little salt
3. Add the drained yogurt and cucumbers
4. Mix well and chill before serving

title: tangy crock pot pork chops
steps:
1. Place chop in a slow cooker
2. Sprinkle with salt and pepper
3. Add onions , green pepper and tomatoes
4. Combine ketchup , vinegar , sugar , worcestershire sauce , lemon juice and bouillon
5. Pour over vegetables
6. Cover and cook on low 5-6 hours
7. Mix cornstarch and water until smooth
8. Stir into slow cooker
9. Cover and cook on high for 20 minute or until thickened
10. Serve over rice

title: english sausage and bean  casserole
steps:
1. Grill the sausages until brown
2. Fry the chopped onions with the garlic and bacon
3. In a large saucepan add all the ingredients except only add half the stock
4. Bring to the boil and then simmer slowly
5. The recipe doesn't tell you how long to simmer for but sometimes i serve after 20-30 mins or so
6. If i keep it on for longer i haven't managed to overcook it yet
7. I just add in the rest of the stock as and when required if i'm waiting for guests to arrive

title: hedda s cookies
steps:
1. Cream together 1 cup sugar , shortening , egg and almond extract
2. Add flour and salt and mix well
3. Fold in coconut
4. Drop by teaspoon on ungreased cookie sheet and flatten slightly with fork
5. Sprinkle with red or green sugar
6. Bake at 325 degrees for 15 to 18 minutes until slightly golden around edges

title: pasta with tomato  courgette and garlic
steps:
1. Fry the onion
2. Garlic and courgette in the oil , fry for 5 mins or until cooked
3. Now add the pasta to the hot water and cook until it still has a slight crunch
4. Add the tinned tomatoes and cook for a further 10 minutes add the parmasan , pinch of salt and pepper
5. Place into bowl and garnish with the pine nuts

title: lazy butt pepperoncini crock pot beef
steps:
1. Make small cuts in roast and insert garlic slices in cuts
2. Place roast in the slow cooker , and pour the entire contents of the jar of pepperoncini , including liquid , over meat
3. Cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours
4. Pig the heck out
5. Moo

title: cinnamon apple syrup
steps: 1. Simmer all the ingredients in a small saucepan over medium-low heat until the mixture becomes slightly thickened , about 5 to 7 minutes

title: macadamia nut caramel squares
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180c / 350f / gas mark 4
2. Coarsely chop the macadamia nuts
3. To make the base , beat together the flour , sugar , and butter until the mixture resembles fine breadcrumbs
4. Press the mixture into the bottom of a 30x20 cm / 12x8" rectangular baking tin
5. Sprinkle the macadamia nuts over top
6. To make the topping , put the butter and sugar in a saucepan , and stirring constantly , slowly bring to a boil
7. Boil for 1 minute , stirring constantly , then carefully pour the mixture over the macadamia nuts
8. Bake for about 20 minutes , until the caramel topping is bubbling
9. Remove from the oven and immediately sprinkle chocolate chips evenly over top
10. Leave for 2-3 minutes , until the chocolate begins to melt , then using a fork or knife , swirl the chocolate over the top
11. Leave to cool in the tin , then cut into squares

title: creamy fresh tomato soup with dumplings
steps:
1. Heat oil in a 2 quart sauce pan over medium high heat
2. Add onions and garlic and saut until tender , then add tomatoes , and mush them up a bit , and stir
3. Cook over medium heat about 10-15 minutes , until tomatoes are quite soft and breaking down
4. Add water , basil , bouillon cubes , salt and pepper , and sugar
5. Bring to boil , reduce heat to low , cover and simmer about 20 minutes
6. Near the end of the cooking time , heat half and half or milk so that it is hot
7. Add hot milk to soup and stir
8. Pure with an arm blender , or do it in batches in a blender
9. Strain soup through a sieve or run it through a food mill to eliminate any peels and seeds that remain
10. Mix egg with about 1 / 4 cup flour and salt and pepper to taste , until well combined
11. Bring soup to just below boiling and drop in dumplings by very small spoonfuls
12. Cook about three minutes , or until dumplings float to the surface
13. Dumplings should be almost like spaetzle , quite small , and soft when cooked
14. Serve hot with chopped fresh basil or toasted croutons as a garnish if desired

title: oven scrambled eggs for a crowd
steps:
1. Divide butter among four 13 x 9 inch baking dishes
2. Combine eggs and salt
3. Mix well
4. Gradually stir in milk
5. Pour evenly into baking dishes
6. Bake , uncovered at 350f for 10 minutes
7. Stir
8. Bake 10-15 minutes more or until eggs are set
9. Serve immediately

title: my favorite macaroni  and cheese
steps:
1. Prepare the mac'n cheese according to package directions
2. Just before serving , stir in the salsa

title: green beans with roasted onions
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450f
2. Spray 2 heavy large baking sheets with vegetable oil spray
3. Arrange onions in single layer on prepared sheets
4. Dot onions with 4 tablespoons butter , dividing equally
5. Season with salt and pepper
6. Bake until onions are dark brown on bottom , about 35 minutes
7. Meanwhile , boil broth in heavy large skillet over high heat until reduced to 1 / 2 cup , about 6 minutes
8. Add sugar and vinegar and whisk until sugar dissolves and moisture comes to boil
9. Add onions to sauce
10. Reduce heat to medium-low
11. Simmer until liquid is slightly reduced , about 5 minutes
12. Season with salt and pepper
13. Cook green beans in large pot of boiling salted water until crisp-tender , about 5 minutes
14. Drain well
15. Return beans to same pot
16. Add remaining 2 tablespoons butter and toss to coat
17. Mound beans in large shallow bowl
18. Top with onion mixture and serve

title: awesome sauce chicken wings
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Spray 9x13 pan with cooking spray and lay wings in pan
3. Mix all other ingredients in a bowl and pour over wings
4. Turn wings to coat with sauce
5. Bake at 375 for one hour and turn wings after 30 minutes , then raise oven temp to 450 and bake about 10 minutes

title: cheesy veggie pizza
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375f
2. Cook and stir brocoli , onions , garlic , and basil in oil for 2 min in medium skillet
3. Sprinkle cheese over crust
4. Top with veggie mixture and tomatoes
5. Bake 15 minute

title: cornbread   dairy free
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425
2. Combine all ingredients and beat well
3. Bake in greased and floured 8-inch cake pan for 20- 25 minutes
4. This recipe is a crumbly corn bread
5. If not looking for an egg-free or vegan corn bread , an egg can be added as a binder , for a less crumbly corn bread

title: kfc bean salad
steps:
1. Method:
2. Drain and rinse kidney beans well
3. Drain additional beans and combine all ingredients together
4. Marinate and refrigerate overnight
5. Bean salad tastes better after 3 or 4 days
6. Makes about 7 cups

title: yummy low carb gingersnaps diabetic friendly
steps:
1. Cream butter , splenda , molasses and vinegar together until blended
2. Beat in eggs
3. In separate bowl mix all dry ingredients and blend into butter / sugar mixture
4. Will be a very firm dough
5. Break off pieces and roll into 3 / 4 inch balls and place on greased cookie sheet
6. Flatten to disk size 1 / 2 inch thick
7. Bake at 350 for 8 minutes only
8. They will not darken so don't overbake
9. Remove from cookie sheet immediately to prevent further cooking
10. Enjoy while still warm !

title: simon and garfunkle dry rub
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in a blender or food processor and whiz
2. Store , tightly covered

title: mom s seven layer casserole
steps:
1. Break up raw hamburger in tiny pieces
2. Cut up onion and spread over hamburger
3. Slice up the 6 carrots , then dice the potatoes
4. Throw in the macaroni , then add the soup
5. You can mix it all up or leave layered
6. Bake for 2 hours at 350

title: anjou salad
steps:
1. In a large bowl
2. Mix balsamic , honey , vanilla , lemon juice , and almonds
3. Add strawberries and pears then toss to coat
4. Chill then enjoy !

title: crock pot choucroute
steps:
1. Stir together the cabbage , carrot , sauerkraut , cider , sugar , garlic , pepper , caraway , and allspice in slow cooker
2. Bury the canadian bacon in the kraut , pressing down to compact
3. Top with kielbasa & potatoes
4. Cover & cook on low for 7 hours , until potatoes are tender

title: hoosier chicken with potato chip crust
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 225
2. Mix mayonnaise , chile powder , five-spice powder , lemon zest , pepper and a pinch of salt
3. Add chicken and coat
4. Spread crushed chips on a sheet of wax paper or cookie sheet
5. Coat chicken with crumbs , pressing to adhere if needed
6. Melt 1 / 2 tablespoon of the butter in a large skillet
7. When the foam subsides , add half of the chicken cutlets and cook over moderately high heat , turning only once , until browned and cooked through , this will take about 5 minutes or so
8. Transfer the chicken to a baking sheet and keep warm in the oven while you cook the remaining batch of chicken

title: grilled lemon basil halibut
steps:
1. Mix lemon juice , olive oil , garlic , lemon peel and sun-dried tomatoes in blender or food processor
2. Stir in 2 tbsp fresh basil and the capers
3. Season to taste with salt and pepper
4. Pour half of vinaigrette over fish and marinate 15 to 30 minutes
5. When ready to grill fish , remove from marinade
6. Discard that marinade
7. Prepare the grill and spray with oil to keep fish from sticking
8. Grill fish until just cooked through 2 to 4 minutes per side
9. Divide fish among 4 plates
10. Stir remaining vinaigrette and drizzle over fish

title: cumin crusted salmon with orange rice pilaf
steps:
1. Wash salmon fillets and pat dry
2. In a small dish mix together the cumin through black pepper
3. Rub over salmon fillets and allow to rest at room temperature for 30 minutes
4. Rinse the rice well under cold running water
5. In a large pot , bring 12 cups of water to a boil , add in rice , stir once and boil uncovered for 30 minutes
6. Place a stainer in the sink and pour rice into a stainer
7. Allow to drain for 10 seconds
8. Return to the pot , turn off heat source , cover and let rice steam for 10 minutes
9. In a small dry skillet , lightly toast the walnuts
10. Set aside
11. While rice is steaming , warm the olive oil and butter in a large skillet over medium high heat
12. Add in onion , celery and carrot
13. Cook until onion is wilted
14. Cover and reduce heat to low
15. Allow to cook for 4 to 5 minutes or until carrot is barely tender
16. Add in garlic and zucchini
17. Cook until zucchini is crisp tender stirring frequently
18. When rice is done add to vegetable mixture
19. Thoroughly combine vegetables with steamed rice
20. Stir in peas
21. Cover and allow to rest for a few minutes
22. Zest orange then remove peel
23. Cut and section the orange
24. Cut sections into thirds if large or into half for smaller sections
25. Add orange zest and sections to rice mixture along with toasted walnuts
26. Keep warm while grilling the salmon
27. Grill salmon over medium heat until it flakes
28. Approximately 5 to 8 minutes per side
29. Spoon the rice pilaf onto serving plate and top with grilled salmon
30. Garnish each serving with fresh cilantro if desired

title: easy crockpot meatballs and gravy  slow cooker
steps:
1. Place meatballs in crockpot
2. Add soup , water , dry gravy mix , thyme and bay leaves
3. Cover crockpot and cook on low 3-4 hours on low
4. Discard bay leaves
5. We like to serve over egg noodles

title: cranberry apricot  chutney
steps:
1. In a heavy saucepan , combine white sugar and water
2. Cook and stir over medium heat until sugar is dissolved
3. Bring to a boil without stirring
4. Stir in cranberries , apricots , brown sugar , vinegar , and ginger
5. Reduce heat
6. Simmer , uncovered , for about 5 minutes or until the berries have popped and mixture starts to thicken , stirring occasionally
7. Remove from heat and allow to cool if serving that day
8. Can be covered and refrigerated for up to four days
9. Makes 3 1 / 2 cups

title: honey and raisin bran muffins
steps:
1. Soak bran , buttermilk and raisins together while preparing the rest of the batter
2. Cream butter and sugar
3. Beat in the honey and egg
4. Add the bran mixture
5. Stir together the flour , baking powder , baking soda and salt
6. Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients and stir just until moistened
7. Bake in greased muffin cups at 375 degrees fahrenheit for 20 minutes or until done

title: bagels
steps:
1. In a mixer bowl combine 1 1 / 2 cups of the flour and the yeast
2. Combine warm water , the 3 tbsp sugar and the salt
3. Pour over the flour mixture
4. Beat at low speed of electric mixer for about 30 seconds scraping the bowl as you mix
5. Beat 3 minutes at high speed
6. Stir in as much remaining flour as you can mixing with a spoon
7. Turn out onto a lightly floured surface
8. Knead in enough remaining flour to make a moderately stiff dough that is smooth and elastic
9. Cover
10. Let rest 10 minutes
11. Cut into 12 portions
12. Shape each into a smooth ball
13. Punch a hole in the center of each
14. Pull gently to make a 1 1 / 2-2-inch hole
15. Place on a greased baking sheet
16. Cover , let rise 20 minutes
17. Broil 5 inches from heat 3-4 minutes , turning once
18. Heat 1 gallon of water and 1 tbsp of sugar to boiling
19. Reduce heat
20. Cook 4 or 5 bagels at a time for 7 minutes , turning once
21. Drain
22. Place on a greased baking sheet
23. Bake at 375: in the oven for 25-30 minutes
24. Light rye bagels prepare bagels as above
25. Except substitute 1 1 / 2 cups rye flour for the first 1 1 / 4 cups of the all-poupose flour
26. Herb bagels prepare bagels as above , except add 2 tsp
27. Dried marjoram , crushed or 1 tsp dried dill
28. Or 1 tsp
29. Dried tarragon , crushed
30. Or 1 / 2 tsp
31. Garlic powder to the flour-yeast mixture
32. Onion bagels prepare as above except cook 1 / 2 cup finely chopped onion in 3 tbsp butter till tender but not brown
33. Brush onion mixture over tops of bagels after first 15 minutes of baking
34. Poppy or sesame seed bagels prepare bagels as above except before baking brush tops with beaten egg
35. Sprinkle with the seed

title: cheesecake topping for brownies or cakes
steps:
1. Combine three ingredients using a hand-mixer until soft and creamy
2. Gently spoon over brownie or cake batter
3. Swirl topping with a knife , cutting through the batter underneath
4. Bake per directions of your favorite brownie or cake recipe
5. Cool completely before cutting
6. Enjoy !

title: hamburg pie
steps:
1. Pre heat oven 375 degrees
2. Take beef , onion , 1 / 2 teaspoons garlic powder , milk and ketchup and mix up good
3. Pat in a 9 inch deep dish pie pan on bottom and up sides of dish , covering all sides and bottom
4. Bake for 20 minutes or until done
5. Drain grease off
6. Mix corn , 1 / 2 teaspoons garlic powder , 1 / 3 cup parmesean cheese and put on top of baked meat
7. Mix hot mashed potatoes , egg and rest of parmesean cheese together and put on top , covering the whole top with potatoes
8. Dot with butter and salt and pepper to taste
9. Bake another 25 minutes
10. Serve

title: ginger rice balls
steps:
1. Form sushi cakes either using a rice mould or your hands
2. Make a small hole in the cake and fill with 2 slices sushi ginger
3. Re-seal hole and let rest for 5 minutes
4. Heat grill
5. Glaze rice ball and sprinkle with a few sesame seeds
6. Grill until golden
7. Turn , glaze and grill
8. Scoff , yum

title: vanilla chai cupcakes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees
2. Prepare a cupcake pan with liners
3. In a small bowl or plastic bag , combine the chai spice mix ingredients
4. Set aside
5. Cream together the butter and sugar
6. Add the vanilla and beat in one egg at a time
7. Stir in 2 teaspoons of the chai spice mix
8. Fold in the flour and buttermilk alternately and stir until combined , dont over mix
9. Mix together the baking soda and vinegar in a separate bowl , then add it to the batter and mix until combined
10. Spoon into prepared cupcake tins until 3 / 4 full and bake 15-20 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean
11. Buttercream directions:
12. In a stand mixer , beat the butter until it is creamy
13. On low , mix in the vanilla and the rest of the chai spice mix
14. Carefully beat in the powdered sugar about cup at a time
15. If the buttercream is too thick add 1-2 tbs of cold milk until the desired consistency is reached
16. Then pipe onto cooled cupcakes with your favorite frosting

title: baked bbq chicken
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375f
2. Pour sauce over chicken in 13x9-inch baking dish
3. Bake 25 minute or until chicken is done

title: healthy almond biscotti
steps:
1. Put almonds in a shallow pan
2. Toast at 350f for 10 minutes
3. Turn oven down to 300f cool almonds and chop coarsely or pulse in food processor
4. Mix flour , splenda , baking soda and nuts in a large mixing bowl
5. In a separate bowl , beat remaining ingredients for about one minute
6. Add flour mixture into liquid
7. Cut dough in half
8. On a baking sheet with parchment paper , pat dough into two logs- 1 / 2" thick x 1 1 / 2" wide x 12" long and place 2 " apart
9. Bake at 300f for 40 minutes or until golden brown
10. Cool on a rack for 5 minutes or until cool enough to handle
11. Cut loaves at a 45 degree angle , 1 / 2" thick with a serrated knife
12. Lay slices flat on baking sheet and bake an additional 15 minutes , turning once
13. Store in an airtight container

title: creamy italian chicken
steps:
1. Mix water and dressing
2. Pour over chicken in the bottom of a skillet
3. Cover and cook chicken until done and no longer pink
4. In a small mixing bowl , beat cream cheese and soup until no longer lumpy
5. Pour over chicken and heat through
6. Serve over rice or pasta

title: blue cheese and pear bruschetta
steps:
1. Cut pears into a small dice , and place in a small bowl
2. Sprinkle pears with lemon juice and toss
3. Add the parsley , blue cheese , and oil and toss gently and thoroughly
4. Season to taste with freshly ground black pepper
5. Set aside
6. Preheat the broiler
7. Arrange bread slices in a single layer on a baking sheet and toast under the broiler until lightly browned and crisp , 1 to 2 minutes per side
8. Spread each toast round with a teaspoon of mascarpone
9. Top with a generous tablespoon of the diced pear mixture , mounding it up high and pressing it firmly
10. Finish each one with a sprinkling of walnuts and serve

title: nopalitos con huevos breakfast tacos
steps:
1. Cook nopalitos in boiling water 10 minutes
2. Drain
3. Combine eggs and next 4 ingredients stir well with a whisk
4. Heat butter and oil in skillet over medium heat
5. Add the onion and garlic and saut 2 minutes or until tender
6. Add the egg mixture , and cook until bottom begins to set , stirring gently to scramble
7. Stir in the tomato and nopalitos , and cook 1 minute
8. Wrap tortillas in foil and place in 325 degree oven for about 5 minutes
9. Spoon about 1 / 2 cup egg mixture onto each tortilla
10. Sprinkle evenly with minced cilantro , and fold in half

title: tomatoes stuffed with herbed grains
steps:
1. Cut the tops from the tomatoes- save
2. Scoop out the inside of the tomatoes leaving a solid shell , chop the tomato pulp
3. Mix the pulp with the grain , nuts , garlic , parsley cheese and season with salt& pepper
4. Fill the tomatoes with the mixture , replace tops
5. Spray the tomatoes lightly with oil , set them close together in an oven proof dish
6. Bake in 375f oven for apprx 25 minutes or until hot through
7. Remove carefully

title: cranberries with caramel sauce
steps:
1. Roll cranberries in powdered sugar and divide between four serving bowls
2. To make sauce: combine cream , granulated sugar and brown sugar in a saucepan and bring the mixture to a boil , stirring
3. Reduce heat and cook for about 10 minutes , stirring continuously , until the mixture thickens slightly
4. Remove from heat , stir in butter and vanilla sugar
5. Pour hot sauce over cranberries
6. Serve immediately

title: round steak withtomato gravy
steps:
1. Brown steak in oil in dutch oven
2. Mix water , tomato sauce and seasonings
3. Pour over steak
4. Bring to a boil
5. Reduce heat , cover , and simmer for 1-1 / 2 hours
6. Mix flour and water
7. Stir into steak
8. Bring to a boil , boil for 1 minute
9. Serve with rice or mashed potatoes

title: tsr version of dive  carrot chips by todd wilbur
steps:
1. Peel carrots , then slice them crosswise in half
2. Use a slicer to make them lengthwise , thin slices of carrot no more thn 1 / 16 inch thick
3. Heat the oil in a deep pot or deep fryer to 350 degrees f
4. Drop a handful of carrot slices at a time into a hot oil
5. Fry the carrots for 10-15 seconds or until they turn a dark brown
6. Remove carrots and drain and cool on a paper towel
7. Serve carrots in a shallow bowl with sauce

title: za tar
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients and store in a cook dark place
2. Use as is or mix the blend with some olive oil to make a rub or with more oil a dip for bread or anything you like

title: pound cake style lemon cake
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees
2. Spray a 9-inch square pan with vegetable cooking spray
3. In a large bowl , stir together the flours , baking powder , sugar , baking soda and salt
4. In another bowl , stir together the milk , eggs , canola oil , lemon peel , lemon juice and vanilla and lemon extracts
5. Add the milk mixture to the dry ingredients
6. Stir just to combine
7. Pour the mixture into the prepared pan and spread it into an even layer
8. Bake for about 45 to 55 minutes , until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean
9. Cool in the pan on a wire rack for 10 minutes
10. Remove the cake to the rack and cool to room temperature
11. Sift confectioners' sugar over the cooled cake , if desired
12. Top the cake with fresh raspberries or strawberry slices , if desired
13. Optional icing: whip one 8 oz
14. Pack of softened reduced-fat cream cheese , thinning it to the desired consistency with skim milk and a little honey
15. Spread it over the top of the cake

title: hummingbird pancakes
steps:
1. Pancakes--stir together the first 4 ingredients in a large bowl
2. Whisk together the buttermilk and next 5 ingredients in another bowl
3. Gradually stir in the buttermilk mixture into the flour mixture just until dry ingredients are moistened
4. Fold in the pecans
5. Pour about 1 / 4 cup batter for each pancake onto a hot buttered griddle or large nonstick skillet
6. Cook pancakes 3-4 minutes or until tops are covered with bubbles and edges look dry and cooked
7. Turn and cook 3-4 minutes or until done
8. Place pancakes in a single layer on a baking sheet and keep warm in a 200 oven up to 30 minutes
9. Garnish pancakes with banana slices and pineapple chunks , if desired
10. Serve with cream cheese anglaise--process first 6 ingredients in a blender until smooth
11. Bring mixture to a boil in a medium saucepan over medium heat , whisking constantly
12. Boil , whisking constantly , 1 minute
13. Remove from heat , and whisk in butter and vanilla
14. Serve immediately

title: chipotle dip
steps:
1. Finely chop scallions
2. Wearing protective gloves , mince enough chipotles to a paste to measure 1 1 / 2 tablespoons
3. In a bowl whisk together all ingredients with salt to taste
4. Dip may be kept , covered and chilled , 3 days

title: apricot oven fried chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Brush chicken liberally with preserves
3. Dredge in crumbs & place in shallow dish or pan on a nonstick pad
4. You may totally leave fat out or place chicken in sprayed pan and spray with pam or drizzle melted butter over the chicken in the pan
5. Cook uncovered 45 minutes or until done if chicken pieces are large

title: bison steak and broccoli salad  ww 5 pointsplus
steps:
1. In large bowl combine the teriyaki sauce , sesame oil , and ginger
2. Coat both sides of the steak with 2 tablespoons of the mixture
3. Let stand 5 minutes
4. Meanwhile , place the broccoli in a microwave-safe bowl
5. Cover with waxed paper
6. Cook on high power for 2 to 3 minutes or until crisp-tender
7. Add to bowl containing teriyaki mixture and toss to coat
8. Set aside
9. Grill the steak over medium-hot coals or over medium-high heat on a gas grill or broil in the oven for 3 to 4 minutes per side for rare depending on the thickness of steak
10. Transfer cooked steak to a carving board
11. Allow it to rest 5 minutes
12. Add vinegar to the broccoli mixture and toss
13. Toss in the salad greens and transfer to four serving plates
14. Carve the steak crosswise into thin slices and arrange over the salads
15. Top with the broccoli sprouts

title: fresh raspberry sauce  easy   pleasy   sugar free
steps:
1. Wash , drain and crush your berries
2. And splenda and mix together
3. Let sit a couple of hours and it will thicken up because of the natural pectin in the raspberries
4. If you want to remove the seeds you can strain them
5. I have also added 1 t
6. Cornstarch and cooked in the microwave for 2 minute for more pie filling effect
7. My favorite is raw , and a little chunky

title: chipotle salt
steps:
1. Place the salt and chipotle-powder in a small container with a lid , seal the container , and shake vigorously for several seconds until the chipotle powder is evenly distributed in the salt
2. If you cannot find chipotle powder , grind chipotle flakes until they are reduced to a fine powder

title: amish friendship starter
steps:
1. Day 1: in a large glass or plastic bowl , combine 1 cup sugar , 1 cup flour , and 1 cup milk
2. Stir with a wooden spoon
3. Cover loosely with a clean cloth dish towel
4. Keep at room temperature
5. Day 2: using a wooden spoon , stir once a day
6. Day 3: using a wooden spoon , stir once a day
7. Day 4: using a wooden spoon , stir once a day
8. Day 5: add 1 cup sugar , 1 cup flour , and 1 cup milk
9. Stir
10. Day 6: using a wooden spoon , stir once a day
11. Day 7: using a wooden spoon , stir once a day
12. Day 8: using a wooden spoon , stir once a day
13. Day 9: using a wooden spoon , stir once a day
14. Day 10: add 1 cup sugar , 1 cup flour and 1 cup milk
15. Stir
16. Remove 3 cups of mixture and give one cup to three friends
17. Save remaining starter for yourself , feeding every fifth day with 1 cup sugar , 1 cup flour and 1 cup milk
18. ~

title: creamy chicken casserole for a crowd
steps:
1. Combine chicken , soup , and sour cream
2. Spread into greased 13 x 9 inch baking dish
3. Combine butter , crumbs , and celery seeds , then sprinkle over chicken mixture
4. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 to 35 minutes or until bubbly
5. Optional step: add frozen peas , diced cooked carrots , and mushrooms to chicken mixture before baking
6. If adding extras , you may need to increase the amount of soup by 1 / 2 to 1 can
7. Mix vegetables in , and if it looks dry , add 1 / 2 can of soup-mix well , and if it still looks dry , add some sour cream or the rest of the soup

title: authentic falafels  the good for you way
steps:
1. Throw the onion and garlic in a food processor until they're chopped
2. Drain chickpeas and give them a wash , then add them to food processor
3. Pulse until mashed -- but not to mushy !
4. Scrape the onion / garlic / chickpeas mix into a large bowl and add all remaining ingredients
5. Mix until completly blended
6. The mix should be thick but not too stiff
7. Grease a non-stick pan and drop mixture in tablespoon sized 'blobs' into the pan
8. Cook on each side for a few minutes -- until browned and slightly crunchy- then flip
9. Continue until all mix is cooked
10. Enjoy !
11. P
12. S: the final product will be a bit crumbly but it doesn't matter -- they're so delicious !

title: linguine della mare
steps:
1. Cool the pasta as directed on the box
2. Meanwhile , in a saucepan , melt the butter over medium heat
3. Add the onion and cook , stirring often until softened , for about 5 minutes
4. Stir in the flour and cook for about 1 minute
5. Whisk in the clam juice and cream
6. Bring to a boil , whisking continuously
7. Drain pasta and return to the pot
8. Stir in the crab , cream sauce , parsley , and cheese
9. Toss to combine all the ingredients
10. Squeeze in lemon juice and stir again

title: chicken provolone
steps:
1. Boil pasta and set aside
2. Butterfly chicken breasts
3. Place boned side up and pound thin
4. Season with salt and pepper
5. Lay provolone , salami and torn basil leaves on one side of the butterflied breasts
6. Fold breast in thirds
7. In nonstick skillet heat a little olive oil along with red pepper flakes
8. Brown chicken
9. Cook over medium-low heat , covered , until juices run clear
10. While chicken is cooking , melt butter in saucepan and add 1 cup heavy cream
11. Heat cream to scald
12. Slowly add 1 / 4-1 / 2 cup parmesan cheese as desired , stirring constantly
13. Keep on low heat until thickened
14. Serve chicken on top of pasta with sauce spooned over the top

title: guatemalan icebox cookies
steps:
1. Mix egg , vanilla and sugar on medium speed until mixture is white and creamy
2. Using cold butter , cut into small pieces and add to mixture stirring well
3. Mix together the dry ingredients in a separate bowl and slowly add to egg / sugar / butter mixture being careful to not over mix
4. Make half of mixture into 8 inch log on wax paper and roll paper around it
5. Repeat with other half of mixture
6. Place in freezer for at least 4 hours , ideally 8 hours
7. Remove from freezer , preheat oven to 350f
8. Slice into 1 / 4 inch thick rounds
9. Place on greased cookie sheet 1 inch apart
10. Bake at 350f for 8-12 minutes or until small cracks appear on tops
11. Should have between 2-3 dozen cookies , depending on thickness

title: fluffy orange pie
steps:
1. Combine crumbs and butter
2. Press firmly on bottom and up sides of 9" pie plate , chill
3. In large mixer bowl beat cream cheese until fluffy
4. Gradually beat in condensed milk and concentrated orange juice until smooth
5. Fold in whipped cream
6. Pile into crust
7. Chill 2 hours or until set

title: unique egg salad for one
steps:
1. Dice up eggs in bowl
2. Stir all other ingredients into eggs
3. Spread on bread or crackers

title: mimi s vegetable soup
steps:
1. In a large stock pot , add 2 cups liquid and stew beef
2. Bring to a boil and remove any foam from the water
3. Cook 5-10 minutes
4. Add onion , celery , salt , pepper , and parsley
5. Add tomato soup
6. Fill soup can with water and add to pot
7. Cook on medium heat for approximately 30 minutes
8. Add the raw vegetables next - turnips , potatoes , carrots , etc
9. , and bring pot to boil
10. Cook over medium low heat until raw vegetables are tender , about 45 - 60 minutes
11. Stir occasionally and test doneness of vegetables with fork
12. Add other canned or frozen vegetables last
13. Cook until thoroughly heated
14. Serve with grilled cheese or a green salad

title: strawberry chocolate mousse cake
steps:
1. In a 9 inch springform pan mix the wafer crumbs and butter thoroughly and press evenly into the bottom of the pan
2. Stand strawberry halves around the pan , touching , side by side , pointed ends up , with cut sides against the side of the pan
3. Set aside
4. Save the strawberries that are left to garnish the mousse cake
5. Place chocolate chips , corn syrup , and orange liqueur in a microwave safe bowl
6. Microwave on high for 1-2 minutes or until the chocolate chips are melted
7. Whisk until all the liquids are incorporated and the mixture is smooth , then cool
8. Beat 1 1 / 2 cups of cream until it forms stiff peaks
9. Fold the cool chocolate mixture into the whipped cream
10. Carefully pour into the strawberry lined pan
11. Refrigerate at least 5 hours or overnight
12. When ready to serve , release the sides of the pan and whip the remaining whipping cream with the powdered sugar
13. Arrange the whipped cream on top of the cake and top with the remaining berries

title: biscotti cocoa
steps:
1. Heat one cup of water til boiling
2. Stir in hot cocoa mix
3. Add biscotti liqueur
4. Top with whipped cream and sprinkle with cinnamon
5. Sip !

title: ladylynne s meatloaf
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine ketchup , tomato juice , salt , and both peppers , eggs , bread crumbs , onions , and mustard
2. Mix until thoroughly blended
3. Add ground beef
4. Mix gently , but thoroughly
5. Line a 9x5 inch loaf pan with foil
6. Press in beef mixture
7. In separate bowl , combine the topping ingredients , mixing well
8. Spread over top of loaf
9. Bake at 400f 45 minutes or until done
10. Drain off fat
11. Rest meatloaf five minutes before serving

title: chocolate zucchini bread with nuts
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f lightly grease two 9x5 inch loaf pans
2. In a large bowl , combine eggs , sugar , cocoa , oil , grated zucchini , and vanilla
3. Beat well
4. Stir in the flour baking soda , salt and cinnamon
5. Fold in the walnuts
6. Pour batter into prepared loaf pans
7. Bake in preheated oven for 60 to 70 minutes , or until a toothpick inserted into the center of a loaf comes out clean

title: beefy noodles romanoff
steps:
1. Cook noodles according to package , omitting salt
2. Drain well
3. At the same time , brown beef with garlic
4. Drain fat
5. Combined noodles , meat and next 6 ingredients lightly but well
6. Spoon into a lightly greased baking dish
7. Bake uncovered at 350 until heated through , about 15-20 minutes
8. Top with cheese and bake another 5 minutes until melted
9. Let sit 5 minutes
10. Enjoy !

title: smoked salmon lasagne  lasagna  rolls
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f spread noodles evenly with cream cheese
2. Top with salmon
3. Roll up each noodle
4. Place , seam sides down , in greased 13 x 9 inch pan
5. Top with sauce and sprinkle evenly with mozzarella
6. Cover with foil
7. Bake 25 minutes or until heated through , removing foil after 15 minutes
8. Garnish each roll with a dill sprig

title: apricot barbecue sauce
steps:
1. Place ingredients into pan and heat over a low flame until slightly thickened
2. Brush over sausages while cooking if desired & serve the rest as an accompaniment

title: kittencal s alfredo sauce
steps:
1. In a medium heavy-bottomed saucepan melt butter over medium-low heat
2. Add in the garlic and thyme
3. Whisk for about 2 minutes
4. Add in flour and stir for 1 minute
5. Add in table cream and heavy whipping cream
6. Bring to a boil and simmer over low heat , whisking constantly until thickened , about 2 minutes
7. Continue to simmer for about 2-3 minutes over low heat stirring continuously until bubbly and thickened
8. Mix in the parmesan cheese
9. Stir to melt the cheese
10. Season with salt and black pepper to taste
11. Serve over pasta and sprinkle with more parmesan cheese

title: baked sausage and eggs
steps:
1. Brown sausage and drain
2. Set aside
3. Butter casserole dish
4. Sprinkle half grated cheese on top of butter
5. Crack eggs on top of cheese
6. Break yolks
7. Add salt and pepper
8. Pour unwhipped cream over eggs
9. Top with cooked sausage
10. Top with rest of cheese
11. Bake 30 minutes at 350 degrees fahrenheit
12. Can be made ahead of time

title: cucumber boats
steps:
1. In a small bowl
2. Combine chopped tomatoes , oil , vinegar , oregano , salt , and pepper
3. Toss gently until well mixed
4. Chill until serving time
5. Just before serving , add feta cheese to tomatoes and mix well
6. Peel cucumbers and cut them in half lengthwise
7. Using a melon ball scoop or a spoon , scoop out and discard seeds
8. Pile tomato mixture into cucumbers
9. Serve right away
10. Preparation time does not include chilling time

title: bacon and potato soup
steps:
1. In your soup pot , saute the onion and bacon on medium heat until the onion is soft and the bacon is becoming crispy
2. Drain off excess fat , if necessary , leaving 2 t
3. Behind
4. Add carrots and celery and saute for 2 minutes on medium heat
5. If using , add flour and stir to coat vegetables
6. Turn heat to medium high for 1 minute then add 1 cup of stock , stirring to get brown bits off bottom of pan
7. Add the rest of the stock and potatoes and bring to a boil
8. When potatoes are soft , add milk / cream and heat until the soup is warm again
9. If desired , use a potato masher to break down the potatoes to your desired texture or simply continue to cook until the soup is as thick as you like
10. If using , add cajun seasoning
11. Add salt and pepper to taste
12. Before serving add chopped parsley

title: snowman poop christmas snack
steps:
1. Melt almond bark in saucepan , stir frequently to prevent scorching
2. Pour entire box of cereal , the 3 cups of marshmallows , and walnuts into a large bowl
3. Pour melted almond bark into the bowl , and mix well
4. Pour out onto waxed paper and let dry
5. Addictive !
6. You may also use chocolate chips , coconut , or butterscotch chips , whatever you prefer

title: whole wheat cornbread with flax   syrup
steps:
1. Mix dry ingredients first
2. Heat soy milk , flax , and syrup together over low heat for ~10 minutes
3. Combine & mix
4. Roll into a simple loaf
5. Bake on lightly oiled pan or pizza stone at 375 for ~50 minutes , cover loosely with foil for the first 1 / 2 hour

title: easter grass slaw
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine the first six ingredients
2. In a small bowl , combine the mayonnaise , sugar , vinegar , salt and pepper
3. Pour over the cabbage mixture and toss to coat
4. Cover and refrigerate until serving

title: grilled ham steaks
steps:
1. Preheat charcoal or gas grill
2. In a small saucepan , heat jelly and garlic over medium heat until jelly is melted , or in a microwave safe bowl , heat in microwave oven at high power until melted , about 1 minute
3. Stir in cilantro
4. Set aside 1 / 4 cup of glaze mixture for serving
5. Place ham steaks on grill over medium heat
6. Grill 3 minutes
7. Turn steaks over , brush with half of remaining glaze mixture and continue to grill another 3 minutes
8. Turn again , brush with remaining half of glaze mixture and continue to grill 1 to 2 minutes or until ham is glazed and heated through
9. Serve with reserved glaze mixture

title: mango pear syrup
steps:
1. Blend all ingredients together in a blender until smooth
2. Heat in a pan on low heat while continually stirring until reaching a boil
3. Immediately remove from heat and serve on your favorite pancakes or waffles
4. We serve this on our waffles perfect

title: calico corn salsa
steps:
1. Combine corn and peas in large bowl
2. In nonstick skillet , cook cumin and oregano in oil over medium heat for 2 minutes
3. Pour over corn mixture and stir to coat evenly
4. Stir in beans , tomato , and onion
5. Whisk lime juice , mustard , garlic , and salt together in small bowl
6. Stir in cilantro
7. Pour over corn mixture and stir to coat
8. Serve with baked tortilla chips and refrigerate any leftovers

title: red satin party punch
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a large bowl or punch bowl
2. Just before serving , add soda ice cubes , if desired

title: guadalajaran swiss chard quesadillas
steps:
1. Heat oil in pot over medium heat
2. Add onion and saute 5 minutes , until golden
3. Stir in garlic , chile , cumin and oregano , and saute 2 minutes
4. Add tequila and simmer 1 minute , or until liquid has evaporated
5. Stir in chard
6. Cover
7. Reduce heat to medium low , and steam 5 minutes , or until chard wilts
8. Uncover , and cook 3 minutes or until liquid has evaporated
9. Place 1 tortilla in skillet over medium heat
10. Sprinkle with 1 / 4 c cheese
11. Top with chard mixture and second tortilla
12. Cook 2 minutes per side , or until browned
13. Repeat with remaining ingredients
14. Slice into wedges and serve

title: super easy chickpea salad
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a large bowl
2. Chill at least 2 hours
3. Serve

title: navel orange souffl
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Butter 3 6-oz
3. Ramekins and dust with granulated sugar
4. Cut the rind and pith from the oranges
5. Halve the oranges across the equator and take out any seeds , then cut into chunks and put them in a blender or food processor
6. Pulse until they're reduced to a smooth puree
7. Pour the puree into a small saucepan , stir in the sugar and saffron and bring to a boil over medium heat , stirring occasionally to avoid sticking
8. In a cup or small bowl , mix the cornstarch and water to create a slurry
9. Stir the cornstarch mixture into the orange-sugar mixture over high heat
10. When it begins to boil , reduce the heat and simmer for 5 minutes
11. Transfer to a nonreactive bowl and let cool to room temperature
12. Place the eggs whites and cream of tartar in a large bowl
13. Using an electric mixer , whip the egg whites at high speed until stiff peaks form
14. Gently fold in the orange mixture with a rubber spatula until blended
15. Fill each ramekin to the top with the souffle mixture and smooth flat with a spatula
16. Place the ramekins on a baking sheet and set them on the top rack in the oven
17. Bake for 10 to 15 minutes until the souffles have risen about 1 / 2 inch above the ramekins and are golden brown on top
18. Remove from oven and dust with confectioners' sugar
19. Serve immediately

title: stuffed pide  turkish pizza
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients for the dough and knead until smooth
2. Grease the dough with some drops of oil , cover and let rest 30 minutes
3. Give a short knead
4. Cover and let rise until almost doubled
5. In the meantime prepare the filling:
6. In a large skillet heat the oil
7. Add chopped onions along with chopped garlic
8. When onions are translucent , add ground meat , cumin , coriander , salt and pepper
9. Saute for 5 minutes until meat is done
10. Add tomato and cook briefly until water is absorbed
11. Remove from heat and keep aside
12. When cool add parsley and 2 tablespoon fresh mint
13. Preheat oven at 200 degrees celsius / 400 degrees fahrenheit
14. Place the dough on a floured surface
15. Cut into 4 pieces or 8 pieces
16. Make round balls and , using a rolling pin , roll into ovals
17. I possibly try to let the borders stay thicker
18. Transfer the oval dough on the baking sheet
19. Divide filling in equal portions
20. Spread on the dough
21. Pinch the points together giving a boat-like shape
22. Bake for 15 minutes or until golden
23. Remove from oven and , if desired , drizzle with lemon juice
24. Top with remaining chopped fresh mint and serve
25. You can also top the filling with grated cheese
26. Serve immediately and enjoy !

title: broiled peaches
steps:
1. Drain peach halves and pat dry a little bit with a paper towel
2. Mix flour , sugar and cinnamon together
3. Turn peach halves in flour mixture and spray with butter flavored cooking spray to moisten flour
4. Store in refrigerator until ready to cook
5. Just before serving broil in oven just until crisp looking
6. About 3-4 minutes when about 3" under preheated broiler
7. For flare ! pour a little bourbon or brandy over the top after they are plated
8. Ignite the alcohol carefully - impressive !

title: basic smoothie recipe
steps:
1. Put ingredients in blender and blend until smooth
2. Pour and enjoy !

title: warm spinach and rice chicken salad
steps:
1. Brush chicken with 2 teaspoons of the salad dressing
2. Grill or broil chicken , turning once , for 20 to 25 minutes or until juices run clear
3. Meanwhile , prepare rice pilaf mix according to package directions
4. Combine hot cooked rice with remaining salad dressing , spinach , tomatoes and olives
5. Stir until spinach is slightly wilted
6. Spoon rice mixture onto serving plates
7. Top with sliced chicken breast

title: mucho queso pizza
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees
2. Spread the queso on the bread shell to within 1 / 4-inch of the edge
3. Top with the meat , tomatoes and cheese
4. Bake for 15 minutes or until the queso is hot and bubbly

title: junior league  roquefort pear salad w grapes   spiced pecans
steps:
1. For the pecans , combine the brown sugar , cayenne pepper and cumin in a bowl and mix well
2. Stir in the oil
3. Add the pecans and toss to coat
4. Spread the pecans in a single layer on a baking sheet
5. Toast at 350 degrees for 15 to 20 minutes or until light brown , stirring once
6. Let stand until cool
7. You may prepare up to 2 days in advance and store in an airtight container
8. For the vinaigrette , process the apple and shallot in a blender or food processor until smooth
9. Add the vinegar and sugar
10. Process until blended
11. Add the corn oil and walnut oil gradually , processing constantly until creamy
12. Season with salt and pepper
13. Use immediately or store covered in the refrigerator
14. Shake well before using
15. For the salad , soak the onion in cold water or wine vinegar in a bowl
16. Blanch the beans in boiling salted water in a saucepan until tender-crisp
17. Drain
18. Rinse with cold water until cool
19. Drain
20. Toss the pecans , drained onion , beans , mixed greens , grapes and pears in a salad bowl
21. Add half the vinaigrette and toss gently until coated
22. Sprinkle with salt and pepper
23. Crumble the cheese over the top and toss to mix
24. Sprinkle with the chives
25. Serve with the remaining vinaigrette

title: free range fruitcake
steps:
1. Combine dried fruits , candied ginger and both zests
2. Add rum and macerate overnight , or microwave for 5 minutes to rehydrate fruit
3. Place fruit and liquid in a non-reactive pot with the sugar , butter , apple juice and spices
4. Bring the mixture to a boil stirring often , then reduce heat and simmer for 5 to 10 minutes
5. Remove from heat and cool for at least 15 minutes
6. Heat oven to 325 degrees
7. Combine dry ingredients and sift into fruit mixture
8. Quickly bring batter together with a large wooden spoon , then stir in eggs one at a time until completely integated , then fold in nuts
9. Spoon into a 10-inch non-stick loaf pan and bake for 1 hour
10. Check for doneness by inserting toothpick into the middle of the cake
11. If it comes out clean , it's done
12. If not , bake another 10 minutes , and check again
13. Remove cake from oven and place on cooling rack or trivet
14. Baste or spritz top with brandy and allow to cool completely before turning out from pan
15. When cake is cooled completely , seal in a tight sealing , food safe container
16. Every 2 to 3 days , feel the cake and if dry , spritz with brandy
17. The cake's flavor will enhance considerably over the next two weeks

title: mascarpone panna cotta
steps:
1. Place mixed berries in a small bowl and crush slightly with the back of spoon
2. Stir in 3 tablespoons sugar
3. Cover with plastic wrap and set aside
4. Spray four 3 / 4 cup ramekins with cooking spray
5. In a small bowl , pour 1 tablespoon milk
6. Sprinkle gelatin over and allow it to soften
7. Meanwhile , combine cream , 1 / 3 cup milk , vanilla , and 1 / 4 cup sugar in a saucepan
8. Bring to a boil over medium high heat , stirring often
9. Remove from heat , add gelatin mixture and stir until melted
10. Let the mixture cool slightly down to a warm temperature
11. In a medium sized bowl , whisk together mascarpone cheese and sour cream until smooth
12. Slowly add the now warm cream mixture into the bowl , whisking constantly
13. Pour mixture into prepared ramekins
14. Chill until cold and set run a small knife around the edge of the ramekins to loosen the panna cotta
15. If that doesn't work , dip the bottom of the ramekin in hot water for a few seconds
16. Invert ramekin onto a plate
17. Spoon berry sauce over panna cotta
18. Serve

title: chocolate baklava
steps:
1. In a small skillet , melt butter over low heat
2. Let stand a few minutes
3. Skim off and discard white foam from top and do not use any milky residue that sinks to bottom
4. The clear yellow liquid is clarified butter
5. Preheat oven to 350f
6. In a medium bowl , combine pecans , cinnamon , 1 / 4 cup sugar , and chocolate chips
7. Mix well
8. Open and stack phyllo sheets on a damp towel
9. Cover with a damp towel to prevent drying out
10. Brush a 12x18-inch sheet cake pan with clarified butter
11. Layer half of phyllo sheets in pan , brushing each sheet with butter
12. Spread half of nut mixture evenly over layered phyllo sheets
13. Brush next phyllo sheet on both sides with butter , then place on top of nuts
14. Add 5 or 6 more phyllo sheets , brushing each sheet with butter
15. Top with the remaining nut mixture
16. Butter next phyllo sheet on both sides and place on top of the nuts
17. Top with remaining phyllo sheets , brushing each with butter
18. Using a sharp knife , cut pastry into 50 diamond-shaped pieces
19. Do not remove pastry from pan
20. Brush top with remaining clarified butter
21. Bake 40 to 50 minutes , or until golden
22. About 30 minutes before baklava is finished baking , in a small saucepan , combine remaining 1 / 2 cup sugar and orange juice
23. Heat to boiling over medium heat , stirring often
24. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer 10 minutes
25. Stir in vanilla
26. Pour hot orange syrup over hot baklava as soon as it is removed from oven
27. Let stand until cool , 4 hours or overnight
28. When baklava is cool , drizzle thin chocolate glaze on top
29. Allow glaze to set up before serving
30. Baklava may be kept , covered , 4 to 5 days at room temperature
31. Freeze for longer storage
32. To make the thin chocolate glaze------------------
33. In a small glass bowl , combine chocolate , butter , and 1 tablespoon water
34. Heat in the microwave on high 30 to 45 seconds , or until melted and smooth when stirred

title: low cal tater tot casserole
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees
2. Brown ground turkey and onion with the minced garlic and salt and pepper
3. Add cans of celery soup and mix well
4. In 9 x 13 baking dish , spread tater tots on bottom
5. Spread green beans over tater tots
6. Spread turkey mixture over green beans
7. Sprinkle cheese over entire dish
8. Bake at 350 for 1 hour , or until cheese on top is melted and golden brown

title: healthy 7 layer dip
steps:
1. In a blender mix the can of black beans hot sauce to taste and clove of garlic
2. Layer bean mix on the bottom of a shallow dish
3. Add a layer of sour cream , then a layer of salsa
4. Next spread cheese , then tomato and green onion and serve

title: dark   sumptuous chocolate cake
steps:
1. Equipment: 8-inch round springform cake tin
2. Start with the icing , though first preheat the oven to 180c / 350f / gas mark 4 and pop in a baking sheet at the same time
3. Put all of the icing ingredients except the chopped chocolate into a heavy-based saucepan and bring to the boil , making sure everythings dissolved
4. Then turn off the heat but leave the pan on the hob then quickly add the finely chopped chocolate and swirl the pan so that it is all underwater , so to speak
5. Leave for a scant minute , then whisk until you have a darkly glossy icing , and leave to cool
6. I find this takes exactly the amount of time the cake takes to make , cook and cool
7. But do give the icing a stir with a spatula every now and again
8. Line the bottom of your springform cake tin with baking parchment
9. Put the flour , bicarb , salt and instant espresso and unsweetened cocoa in a bowl and fork to mix
10. Mix together the sugar , water , coconut oil and vinegar until the coconut oil has melted , and stir into the dry ingredients , then pour into the prepared tin and bake for 35 minutes
11. Though do check at the 30-minute mark to see if it is already done
12. When it's ready , the cake will be coming away from the edges of the tin and a cake tester will come out clean , apart from a few crumbs
13. This is a fudgy cake and you don't want to overdo it
14. Once the cake is cooked , transfer the tin to a wire rack and let the cake cool in its tin
15. Turn to your icing , and give it a good stir with a spatula to check it is at the right consistency
16. It needs to be runny enough to cover the cake , but thick enough to stay on the top
17. So pour over the unmoulded cake , and use a spatula to ease the icing to the edges , if needed
18. If you wish to decorate , now is the time to do it
19. In which case , sprinkle joyously with rose petals and chopped pistachios or anything else that your heart desires
20. Otherwise , leave it gleaming darkly and , indeed , sumptuously
21. Leave to stand for 30 minutes for the icing to set before slicing into the cake
22. Freeze
23. When cool , carefully wrap cake in a double layer of clingfilm and a layer of foil
24. Freeze for up to 3 months
25. To defrost , unwrap and place on a serving plate at room temperature for 34 hours

title: raisin griddle cookies
steps:
1. Heat griddle until moderately hot
2. Sift together flour , sugar , baking soda , salt and nutmeg
3. Cut in shortening , as for pastry
4. Combine milk and egg
5. Add with raisins to dry mixture
6. Stir until moistened and mixture holds together
7. Roll dough out onto floured board to 1 / 4-inch thick and cut with 2-inch round cookie cutter
8. Oil griddle lightly
9. Place cookies on griddle
10. As bottoms brown , top will get puffy
11. Turn and brown other side
12. Serve hot or cold

title: mango butter
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , beat the honey , butter and mango together with a wooden spoon or electric beater
2. Transfer to a small bowl and serve with bread

title: tomatoes stuffed with corn chili
steps:
1. Cut 1 / 2 inch off the tops of the tomatoes and scoop out the flesh , leaving a shell
2. Mince the garlic
3. Chop the red pepper
4. Seed and mince the jalapeno
5. Melt butter in a medium skillet over medium heat
6. Add garlic and cook until softened
7. Add corn , red bell pepper , jalapeno , and salt
8. Cook , stirring occasionally , until heated through
9. Spoon mixture into tomato shells
10. Top with bread crumbs
11. Bake at 375 degrees for 10 minutes , until bread crumbs are toasted and tomatoes are softened

title: kentucky breakfast casserole
steps:
1. Place thawed hashbrown potatoes between several layers of paper towels and press to absord excess water
2. Lightly spray 9x13 glass casserole dish with cooking spray
3. Cube bread in 1 / 2" cubes and place in even layer in bottom of casserole
4. Sprinkle 1 1 / 2 cups cheddar cheese over bread layer
5. Beat eggs , evaporated milk and milk together , set aside
6. Brown sausage in large deep skillet , crumbling with edge of spatula
7. Drain fat
8. Place hashbrown potatoes in skillet and stir to mix with sausage until all is warm
9. Spread sausage and hashbrown potato mixture over bread and cheese layer
10. Sprinkle with salt and pepper
11. Sprinkle with remaining 1 1 / 2 c cheddar cheese
12. Pour egg and milk mixture evenly over entire casserole
13. Cover and place in refrigerator overnight
14. Bake at 350 degrees for 45 to 50 minutes
15. Let stand for 10 minutes before serving

title: black currant mango iced tea
steps:
1. Place tea bags , mint and lime in large measuring cup or teapot
2. Cover with boiling water and steep for 10 minutes
3. Strain into large pitcher
4. Stir in splenda granulated until dissolved
5. Stir in mango juice
6. Serve over ice

title: carrot fritters with chives and thyme
steps:
1. Mix the carrots , flour , herbs , salt and baking powder together thoroughly
2. Gradually add the water to form a thick batter
3. Heat one inch of oil in a skillet over medium-high heat
4. Drop the carrot batter into the skillet by teaspoons and fry until slightly crisped , flipping once
5. Drain on a paper towel
6. Serve warm

title: mediterranean spinach turkey wrap
steps:
1. Chop up olives
2. Combine cream cheese , feta cheese , olives and oregano in bowl and mix
3. Evenly spread the mixture over entire tortilla
4. Place turkey over the cream cheese mixture on half of each tortilla
5. Place spinach leaves on top of turkey
6. To assemble just start with the side that is topped with the turkey and roll up tightly
7. Wrap each sandwich with saran wrap
8. Refrigerate wraps at least 1 hour
9. Before serving , unwrap , and trim of ends of each roll
10. Cut wraps into 3 sections
11. Cut each section on a slight diagonal into half
12. Wraps can be made a day ahead
13. Enjoy

title: patrick s buffalo wings  chicken wings
steps:
1. Make up the dredge by mixing together the cayenne pepper and the flour
2. Cut the remaining joint so that all the wing is separated
3. Rinse and thoroughly dry the wings with paper towels and then dredge them
4. Allow them to sit on wax paper for about 30 minutes
5. Heat the vegetable shortening in a large skillet
6. Lightly brown the wings once the oil is hot
7. Do this in batches so that you do not crowd the chicken
8. Pre-heat the oven to 300 degrees f
9. Make up your wing sauce by melting the butter and combining it with the hot sauce
10. Dip the browned wings in the sauce and lay them out on a large baking sheet with sides which has been sprayed with cooking spray and bake for 40 minutes
11. Turn the wings after the first 20 minutes
12. Bump up the oven temperature to 375 degrees f
13. And "tent" the baking sheet with aluminum foil
14. Bake the wings for 20-25 more minutes
15. Serve with a spicy sour cream sauce
16. I have tried this recipe using various cooking oils and they simply do not turn out as good

title: ultimate killer cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 deg
2. F
3. In a large mixing bowl , combine oats , corn flakes , sugars , raisins and coconut
4. Add eggs , vanilla and melted butter
5. Mix until well blended
6. Mix in chocolate chips
7. In a seperate bowl , mix flour salt , baking powder and baking soda
8. Add flour mixture and stir until it is all incorporated into the dough
9. Drop rounded tablespoons of dough onto a greased cookie sheet and bake for 12- 15 minutes or until nicely browned
10. Cool on a wire rack

title: sunday gravy  real italian spaghetti sauce and meatballs
steps:
1. Sauce: heat oil in large heavy pot
2. Place the pork in the pot and brown until just about cooked
3. Transfer pork to plate
4. Do the same with the sausage and transfer to plate
5. Leave fat in pot
6. Add whole peeled garlic cloves cook until tender
7. Put garlic on plate with meat and stir in tomato paste until "saucy"
8. Chop up tomatoes leaving the tomato juice in the cans and add them to the pot
9. Then add 1 / 2 of one can of the juice to the pot
10. Add salt and pepper to taste
11. Add the meats and garlic to the sauce and bring to a boil
12. Turn down to low and cook for about 1 1 / 2 hours
13. Leave the sauce on low and remove all the meat and garlic cloves
14. Mix all ingredients for meatballs and shape into balls
15. Add to sauce turn up just a little higher than low and let cook the raw meatballs until they are done thats it !
16. Now this is an old recipe , but i have seen it in the sopranos cookbook and this is a bit different
17. I used this sauce to make the ziti al forno from the sopranos cookbook and it was the most amazing thing i have ever eaten , so i posted that too

title: peanut butter cookies
steps:
1. 1 heat oven to 375f
2. 2 combine peanut butter , crisco shortening , brown sugar , milk , and vanilla in large bowl
3. Beat at medium speen on electric mixer until well blended
4. 3 combine all-purpose flour , salt , and baking soda
5. Add to creamed mixture at low speed
6. Mix just until blended
7. 4 drop spoon fulls of the mixture on to cookie sheets
