8. 5 bake for 8-10 minutes !

title: portuguese felog  doughnuts
steps:
1. Boil together lemon rind and cinnamon stick in water
2. Meanwhile , into a large bowl , add together all the dry ingredi-
3. Ents
4. Into the boiling water , add butter
5. When butter is completely melted , remove cinnamon sticks and rind
6. Pour water into the dry ingredients , mixing very fast
7. Add one egg at atime , until completely blended
8. Drop by spoonfuls into hot oil
9. Let cook until puffs brown evenly
10. Do not pierce with fork
11. Remove puffs from oil and let drain on paper towels
12. Then remove puffs to another dish of paper towels
13. When cool , roll on sugar and cinnamon mixture
14. It will look like a puff but inside will have a texture of an eclair

title: 40 minute hamburger buns
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl , dissolve yeast in warm water
2. Add oil and sugar and let stand for 5 minutes
3. Add the egg , salt and enough flour to form a soft dough
4. Turn onto a floured surface and knead until smooth and elastic , about 3 to 5 minutes
5. Do not let rise
6. Divide into 12 pieces and shape each into a ball
7. Place 3" apart on greased baking sheets
8. Cover and let rest for 10 minutes
9. Bake at 425 for 8 to 12 minutes or until golden brown
10. Remove from pans to wire rack to cool

title: cauliflower   red lentil curry
steps:
1. In a large saucepan over low heat , combine lentils , onions , curry powder , salt , turmeric and 2 cups of water
2. Bring to a simmer
3. Cover and cook , stirring occasionally , until the lentils are soft and the sauce has thickened , about 45 minutes
4. Add tomatoes , cauliflower , and chili and simmer , covered , until the cauliflower is tender , aprox 8 to 10 minutes
5. Then remove from heat
6. Heat oil in a small pan over medium-high heat
7. Add cumin seeds and cook for about 10 seconds
8. Add garlic and ginger
9. Continue to saute until the garlic is lightly browned , about 1 minute
10. Stir in cayenne and immediately add the oil-spice mixture to the cauliflower mixture
11. Stir in lemon juice , cilantro and sugar
12. Taste and adjust seasonings with additional salt and cayenne

title: 20 minute white bean chili
steps:
1. In 3 quart saucepan , over medium heat , saute onions and garlic in oil until tender
2. Add turkey
3. Cook until done , stirring occasionally to break up meat
4. Drain
5. Stir in tomatoes , chicken broth , mustard , chili powder and pepper
6. Heat to a boil
7. Reduce heat
8. Simmer for 10 minutes
9. Stir in beans and corn
10. Cook 5 minutes
11. Top with tortilla chips , shredded cheese and cilantro , if desired

title: failproof french bread  bread machine
steps:
1. Place ingredients in bread machine according to manufacturers directions
2. Start machine on dough setting
3. When dough cycle is complete , remove dough with floured hands and cut in half on floured surface
4. Take each half of dough and roll to make a loaf about 12 inches long in the shape of french bread
5. Place on greased baking sheet and cover with a towel
6. Let rise until doubled , about 1 hour
7. Preheat oven to 450
8. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown , turning pan around once halfway during baking
9. Remove baked loaves to wire racks to cool

title: spice rubbed snapper with lime and cilantro
steps:
1. Season the snapper with salt and pepper
2. In a large shallow bowl , whisk together the lime juice , olive oil , chopped cilantro , turmeric , ginger , shallot and garlic
3. Add the snapper fillets and turn to coat well
4. Cover and let stand for 30 minutes
5. Preheat a broiler
6. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil
7. Remove the fish from the marinade and arrange on the prepared baking sheet
8. Broil 6 to 8 inches from the heat until the fish is opaque in the center , 8 to 10 minutes
9. Garnish with cilantro sprigs and serve immediately

title: chocolate filled bonbons
steps:
1. Cream lard , beat in sugar
2. Add eggs , and flavourings
3. Mix dry ingredients and add
4. Form into 1 inch balls
5. Press each ball around a chocolate rosebud
6. Bake 12 mins on an ungreased cookie sheet at 350f

title: quick yellow cake
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350
2. Mix dry ingredients in lg bowl
3. Add shortening , milk and vanilla
4. Beat on med for 2 minutes
5. Add eggs and beat for 30 seconds more
6. Bake in greased 13x9 pan for 35 minutes , or until pick comes out clean

title: buttertart muffins 1983
steps:
1. In a saucepan over med
2. Heat stir in the raisins , butter , , sugar , , eggs , milk , and vanilla
3. Stir over the heat for 5 minutes
4. Just until thick , and just coming to a boil
5. Remove from heat and add in dry ingredients
6. Add in nuts
7. Just until blended
8. Pour into 12 muffin cups
9. Bake 18 minutes at 350 degrees
10. Remove when done and drop 1 tsp of lyles golden syrup over the top of each while still hot
11. Let cool in pan
12. Remove from pan
13. Thanks andy

title: classic creamy greek rice pudding
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , combine milk and sugar , and bring to a boil
2. Add rice , then reduce heat to low , cover , and cook for 1 hour , stirring gently every 10 to 15 minutes
3. When it thickens , stir every 2 to 3 minutes
4. In a small bowl , beat egg , vanilla , and tangerine rind together
5. After rice pudding has cooked for 1 hour , add 1 / 2 cup of the hot mixture to the egg mixture
6. Pour the egg mixture into the pot , turn off the heat and stir
7. Pour into serving dishes
8. Sprinkle with cinnamon and chill

title: fondue scones
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425f
2. Place flour , baking powder , baking soda , nutmeg , salt and garlic powder in a large bowl and whisk to combine
3. Cut in the cold butter until mixture is crumbly
4. Add wine and cheese and stir until all dry ingredients are moistened
5. Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface
6. Knead 5 to 6 times
7. Pat dough into an 8-inch circle
8. Cut dough into 8 wedges
9. Place wedges 1 inch apart on lightly greased baking sheet
10. Brush tops with melted butter
11. Bake until golden brown , about 15 minutes
12. Serve warm or at room temperature

title: creamless cream of celery soup
steps:
1. Treat a large non-stick stockpot with cooking spray
2. Heat the garlic and onions over medium heat for 5-7 minutes , until onions begin to soften
3. Add celery , broth , and bay leaves
4. Bring to a boil , reduce heat , cover and simmer 20 minutes
5. Meanwhile , puree the tofu in a food processor along with reserved broth
6. Ensure that the tofu is totally smooth !
7. Once the celery is softened , remove the bay leaves from the soup , and use an immersion blender to puree the celery and onions
8. With the soup on the stovetop over medium low heat , add the smooth tofu , white pepper , hot sauce , and lemon juice
9. Heat gently before serving
10. Top with parmesan cheese and additional hot sauce as you like !

title: lager and lemon limeade
steps: 1. Stir together all ingredients and serve in a glass with a floating lime wedge as a garnish

title: sarah s creamy custard lemon bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Prepare a glass 8" square pan by lining it with baking parchment
3. Put the stick of butter in a small skillet and melt about halfway over medium-low heat
4. Combine the butter and powdered sugar in a food processor
5. Add the baking powder and flour
6. Resulting mixture should be crumbly
7. Press into the bottom of the pan
8. Make small holes in the crust with a fork
9. Bake for 15-20 minutes
10. Meanwhile , warm the cream in a small saucepan over medium or medium-low heat
11. You want it to be heated , but do not allow it to come to a boil
12. In a large bowl , beat the egg yolks until lighter in color
13. Add the sugar and beat until combined with eggs
14. Slowly add the lemon juice as you whisk or beat the eggs
15. When cream is hot , add slowly to the egg mixture while continuing to whisk or beat the eggs
16. Reduce the oven temperature to 300 degrees , once crust is removed
17. Pour custard mixture over crust
18. Return to the oven
19. Bake for 25-30 minutes at 300
20. Remove pan and sprinkle coconut over the top of the custard
21. Reduce temperate again to 275 degrees
22. Bake another 30-60 minutes until custard is set
23. Wiggle the pan and if the custard still seems to have a liquid-like slosh , return to the oven
24. Custard is set when it only has a pudding-like jiggle
25. Refrigerate at least two hours before serving

title: garlic butter for freezer garlic bread  oamc
steps:
1. Put the softened butter into a bowl
2. Add the pepper in a little pile on top of the butter
3. Brown the minced garlic in a non-stick skillet on low heat until the water evaporates
4. Add a drizzle of evoo and stir to combine
5. Continue to cook until the garlic begins to turn light brown
6. Add the italian seasoning and another drizzle of evoo
7. Stir to combine
8. Leave on heat until the seasonings feel like they have softened under your spatula
9. Scrape the garlic mixture into the butter bowl on top of the pile of pepper
10. Wait about 10 min for the garlic / seasoning to cool a little then mix everything together
11. If using to make garlic bread spread liberally onto the cut sides of the bread and put two spread sides together facing each other
12. Wrap in foil and either freeze in a zip-loc bag or bake at 350 degrees for about 6 minutes
13. If baking off the bread from the freezer allow the bread to defrost first

title: onion  olive and orange salad
steps:
1. Spread romaine leaves on a platter
2. Scatter red onions and olives over top
3. Remove skin and white pith from oranges and slice into sections
4. Place over onions
5. Whisk together lemon juice , sugar , cumin , paprika and olive oil
6. Drizzle over salad
7. Garnish with parsley

title: peanut butter   banana goodies
steps:
1. Peel banana
2. Slice banana in half lengthwise , then slice crosswise , so that you have 4 pieces
3. Spread peanut butter onto the flat side of each banana piece
4. Top peanut butter with rice krispies and other toppings
5. If it is too soft , place in freezer for a few minutes

title: cheesy chicken artichoke bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Open and drain artichoke hearts , and roughly chop them if they are not quartered
3. Add artichoke hearts , mayo , ricotta cheese , sour cream , parmesean cheese , garlic salt and parsely to bowl
4. Add salt and pepper to taste
5. I also added crushed red pepper
6. Mix well
7. Place chicken breasts in shallow baking or casserole dish
8. Spread artichoke mixture over the top of chicken
9. Sprinkle with parmesean cheese
10. Bake for 30 minutes
11. I serve with wild rice mushroom mixture cooked in chicken stock

title: summer chicken rice salad
steps:
1. Cook rice or pasta according to package directions
2. Set aside
3. Cook chicken , cool , chop and set aside
4. Combine vinegar , oil , orange juice and salt in a medium bowl
5. Add chicken , let marinate 30 minutes
6. Do not drain
7. Add rice or pasta , grapes , and pineapple to the marinated , undrained chicken
8. Add mayonnaise , 1 / 2 cup at a time , until everything is lightly coated
9. Gently fold in mandarine oranges
10. Chill
11. Peel and seed cantaloupe
12. Cut into 1 inch rings
13. Lay cantaloupe ring on lettuce lined plate
14. Fill with chicken salad and serve

title: tapas   scallops in saffron   rioja wine sauce
steps:
1. In a saute pan over medium high heat , add olive oil and butter
2. When butter melts , add the shallots , saute for 30 seconds
3. Add the scallops and wine
4. Turn scallops and add saffron
5. Season with salt
6. Cook until scallops are golden brown , about 30 seconds to 1 minute
7. Remove from heat and serve hot

title: my favorite pumpkin pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees
2. In large mixing bowl , combine pumpkin and eggs until well mixed
3. Add the sugars , vanilla extract , cinnamon , ginger , cloves and salt
4. Mix well
5. Add the evaporated milk gradually
6. Pour into pie shell
7. Bake for 15 minutes at 425 degrees
8. Reduce heat to 350 degrees and bake for another 40-50 minutes , depending on your oven
9. Pie is done when knife inserted in the middle comes out clean or until the center is no longer jiggly
10. Do not overcook
11. This leads to the pie cracking
12. Cool pie on rack for two hours
13. Serve at room temperature or refrigerate
14. Enjoy !

title: traci s meatloaf
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Combine all ingredients in a medium size bowl
3. Divide mixture into 6 mini-meatloaves
4. Place in a large baking dish
5. Bake 25 minutes

title: 21  apple pie
steps:
1. Add the cold butter cubes and , with a pastry blender , blend in the flour until mixture becomes mealy ans butter forms peas-size nuggets plainly visible in the flour
2. The water should be added to the flour slowly to ensure that only the minimum amount of water is used
3. Do not over-mix the dough
4. When the dough has been mixed just sufficiently to combine the ingredients , form it into a ball and wrap in a piece of plastic wrap and refrigerate for several hours
5. To prepare the filling , melt the butter in a large saute pan until it begins to brown
6. Add the sliced apples and cook over medium heat until they begin to soften , about 2 to 3 minutes
7. In a bowl , combine the lemon juice , sugars , southern comfort , and cinnamon
8. Add this mixture to the apples and cook 2 to 3 minutes over medium-high heat until the apples are completely caramelized and covered with all the sugar
9. Remove filling from the heat and allow to cool
10. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees
11. When ready to use , remove the dough from the refrigerator , lightly flour a pastry board and a rolling pin , and unwrap the dough
12. Divide the dough into 2 equal pieces and begin to roll out into a circle by rolling evenly outward from the center and turning the dough in small 1 / 8th turns to keep the rolling even
13. When the dough is rolled out to an even thickness and is about 12 inches in diameter and 1 / 8-inch thick , it is ready to be transferred to a 10-inch pie pan or plate
14. Lightly butter the pie plate , partially roll the dough up on the rolling pin , lift the dough and center it in the pie pan and unroll
15. Roll the second half of the pie dough into a round slightly larger than the pie pan
16. Fill the bottom crust with the cooked apples using a slotted spoon to drain the apples
17. Reserve juices if desired , for sauce
18. Brush an egg wash coating over the lip of the dough
19. This is where it will be sealed to the top crust
20. Cover the apples with the top half of the pie dough
21. Trim any excess from the top crust before using both hands to crimp the edges of the two crust together to seal
22. With a sharp knife , make several crosshatch slits in the top crust
23. Brush with the egg wash and bake for 35 to 40 minutes
24. Remove from the oven and cool 20 minutes
25. Serve with vanilla ice cream
26. Reserved juices can be reduced with heavy cream for a sauce for the pie

title: vegetable spaghetti sauce
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , heat oil over medium-high heat
2. Add zucchini , onion , carrot , and garlic
3. Cook for 10 minutes or until onions are tender
4. Stir frequently
5. Break up tomatoes
6. Add tomatoes and liquid , tomato sauce , mushrooms and liquid , tomato sauce , mushrooms and liquid , and seasonings to cooked vegetables
7. Cover and simmer for 2 hours or until sauce thickened
8. Stir occasionally
9. Beef and vegetable sauce variation: cook 1 / 2 pound lean ground beef until brown and crumbly
10. Drain fat
11. Add to cooked vegetables and cook as recipe directs
12. Makes 8 servings

title: layered macaroni and cheese
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit
2. Coat a 2-quart baking dish with nonstick cooking spray
3. Layer 1 / 3 of the cooked macaroni in the baking dish
4. Sprinkle with 1-1 / 2 cups cheese
5. Repeat the layers
6. Top with the remaining macaroni
7. Reserve the remaining 1 cup cheese
8. In a medium bowl , whisk together the eggs , milk , salt , and pepper until blended
9. Pour over the macaroni
10. Cover and bake for 45 minutes , or until heated through
11. Uncover and sprinkle with the remaining cheese and the paprika
12. Cover and let stand for 10 minutes before serving

title: piggy dip au gratin
steps:
1. With a sharp bread knife , cut the top of the loaf of bread off and hollow out the inside of the loaf , leaving the shell
2. Combine cheeses , garlic , onions , bacon bits and sour cream , mix well and place mixture in bread shell
3. Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes
4. Serve with crackers

title: chicken cajun
steps:
1. Preheat the grill to moderate heat
2. Line the grill pan with foil and place the chicken wings on top
3. Mix remaining ingredients together in a small bowl and then brush over the wings
4. Grill for 15 minutes , turning once and brushing the pan juices until chicken is deep brown and cooked through
5. Arrange the chicken wings on plates and serve with coleslaw

title: grated baked carrots
steps:
1. Mix veggies in casserole dish then dot with butter
2. Add water , cover and bake at 350f for 20 - 30 minutes until tender

title: chai
steps:
1. In a small saucepan , combine water , tea bags , cinnamon stick , cardamom , clove and ginger
2. Bring to a boil
3. Reduce heat
4. Cover and simmer for 5 minutes
5. Stir in milk
6. Return to a boil for 1 minute
7. Strain
8. Discard tea bags and spices
9. Stir in sugar until dissolved
10. Ladle into mugs
11. Garnish with whipped cream and cinnamon

title: pickled eggplant  aubergine    jamie oliver
steps:
1. Combine water , vinegar and salt in a pot
2. Bring to a boil
3. Remove the green end of each eggplant
4. Slice in half lengthwise , then cut across into 1 / 2" slices
5. Cut slices into 1 / 2" batons
6. Add to boiling brine for 3 minutes
7. If they float , keep re-submerging them with a spoon
8. Combine oregano , chile , garlic and both oils
9. Drain eggplant and add to oil mixture
10. Toss well
11. Put canning jars into boiling water for 5 minutes
12. Transfer eggplant and oil to canning jars and seal

title: pistachio chocolate chip cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Grease and flour a 10-inch tube pan
3. Blend cake mix , pudding , eggs , sour cream , oil , and extract in large mixer bowl on low speed , scraping bowl constantly , until moistened , about 1 / 2 minute
4. Beat on medium speed , scraping bowl frequently , 3 minutes
5. Toss chocolate chips with a little bit of flour
6. Fold chocolate chips into batter
7. Sprinkle top of batter with chocolate jimmies
8. Pour batter into prepared pan
9. Bake 50 minutes or until wooden toothpick inserted in center of cake comes out clean
10. Cool 15 minutes
11. Inverted on wire rack
12. Remove pan
13. Cool completely

title: pink cookies
steps:
1. Combine the cake mix , vegetable oil , eggs , and water in a large bowl and mix well
2. Fold in the chocolate chunks
3. Drop by spoonfuls onto a ungreased cookie sheet
4. Bake at 350 for 10-12 minutes

title: cinnamon honeygrapefruit
steps:
1. Prepare the grapefruit in your usual manner
2. Place cut side up in an oven proof dish
3. Drizzle each with 1 tsp honey
4. Sprinkle with the cinnamon
5. Broil 2-3 minutes or until bubbly
6. Serve warm

title: chocolate fudge power oatmeal
steps:
1. Combine oats and flax meal
2. Add water and stir to combine , using less water for thicker oatmeal and more water for thinner oatmeal
3. Microwave on high for 1 minute
4. Add remaining ingredients and stir to combine
5. Return to microwave and set timer for 2 minutes
6. Heat on high stirring every 20-30 seconds until desired consistency is reached
7. Watch carefully or it might bubble over
8. Sprinkle with cinnamon if desired

title: sweet green tomato corn muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees f
2. Saute tomatoes and 2 tbs
3. Sugar in 2 tbs
4. Butter in large skillet over medium-high heat 10 to 12 minutes or until tomatoes begin turn light brown
5. Stir cornmeal mix , zest and remaining sugar together in large bowl
6. Make well in center
7. Whisk eggs , sour cream , and remaining butter
8. Add to dry ingredients , stirring until dry ingredients are moistened
9. Fold in tomatoes
10. Either coat wells in muffin tin with spray or fill wells with cupcake papers
11. Fill wells / papers 2 / 3 full of batter
12. Bake at 450 degrees f
13. For 15 - 17 minutes
14. Test with toothpick
15. While baking , mix butter with basil
16. Serve with warm or cooled muffins

title: portobello lasagna with basil cream
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan , melt 3 tbs
2. Butter over low heat
3. Stir in the flour and cook for 2 minutes
4. Slowly whisk in the hot milk , then the smashed garlic clove and 3 / 4 teaspoon salt
5. Bring the garlic sauce to a boil and cook , whisking , until thickened , 3-5 minutes
6. Set aside
7. In a large pot of boiling salted water , cook the lasagna noodles for 8 minutes
8. Drain and transfer to a bowl of cold water
9. Position a rack in the center of the oven and preheat to 375 degrees
10. In a large skillet , melt the remaining 2 tbs , butter over low heat
11. Add the onions and chopped garlic and cook until softened , about 5 minutes
12. Stir in the mushrooms , increase heat to medium-high and cook , stirring often , until dry , 5-7 minutes
13. Using a food processor , puree the basil leaves with the cream
14. Set aside 1 / 2 cup basil cream
15. Stir the remaining basil cream and 1 / 2 cup parmesan into the mushroom mixture
16. Season with salt and pepper
17. Grease a 2 quart rectangular baking dish , and spread 3 / 4 cup reserved garlic sauce on the bottom
18. Drain the lasagna noodles and lay 3 , lengthwise , in the baking dish , trimming the ends with scissors to fit the pan
19. Top with half of the mushroom mixture , half the mozarella cheese and a layer of noodles and repeat
20. Combine the remaining garlic sauce and basil cream
21. Spoon on top
22. Sprinkle with the remaining 3 / 4 cup parmesan
23. Bake until golden , 40-45 minutes
24. Let stand 15 minutes

title: green beans with walnut vinaigrette
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , bring the water to a boil over high heat
2. Add the beans , reduce the heat to moderate , cover , and cook until crisp tender-about 5 minutes
3. Drain the bean in a colander and rinse under cold water
4. Drain well and place in a serving bowl
5. Blend the walnuts , green onions , parsley , dill , olive oil , vinegar , salt , and pepper in a food processor or blender until smooth , about 1 minute
6. Spoon over the beans and toss well
7. Refrigerate , tightly covered , for about 1 hour
8. This will keep up to 24 hours
9. Just before serving , garnish with the radishes and parsley , if desired
10. Serve as a side dish or a light luncheon dish with cheese and a crusty bread
11. Enjoy !

title: coconut poke cake
steps:
1. Prepare and bake white cake mix according to package directions
2. Remove cake from oven
3. While still hot , using a utility fork , poke holes all over the top of the cake
4. Mix cream of coconut and sweetened condensed milk together
5. Pour over the top of the still hot cake
6. Let cake cool completely then frost with the whipped topping and top with the flaked coconut
7. Keep cake refrigerated

title: super easy chocolate ricotta mousse
steps:
1. Use a food processor or imersion blender to blend the ricotta , confectioners' sugar , and melted chocolate together until you reach a smooth consistency
2. Top with shaved chocolate or eat as it

title: brown rice and broccoli
steps:
1. In a saucepan over high heat , bring broth to a boil
2. Add in salt and rice
3. Boil 1 minute
4. Transfer to a 2 1 / 2 quart casserole dish that has been coated with cooking spray
5. Cover and bake in a 350 oven for 40 minutes
6. Add in remaining ingredients and mix well
7. Cover and bake until liquid is absorbed and vegetables are tender , about 20 minutes

title: duffins   donut muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. Line 2 12-cup muffin tins with paper liners
3. Spray lightly with non-stick spray
4. Combine butter and applesauce
5. Add sugar and beat for 1-2 minutes , until fully incorporated
6. Beat in egg whites and whole egg for another 2 minutes
7. Mix in vanilla and buttermilk
8. Stir in flour , baking powder , salt , nutmeg , and baking soda until combined
9. Be careful not to overmix when adding the dry ingredients or muffins will be tough
10. Scoop batter into prepared muffin tins , about two thirds full
11. Bake muffins for 13-15 minutes , or until batter starts to pull away from the liners and tops spring back when poked
12. While muffins are baking , mix 1 / 4 cup sugar and cinnamon
13. Sprinkle tops of muffins with cinnamon sugar right after removing them from the oven
14. Cool for 2 minutes in pan , then remove to cooling rack
15. Refrigerate

title: mock crab pate
steps:
1. Combine tomatoes and cheese in a saucepan on low heat and stir gently until cheese is melted
2. Remove from heat and add well beaten eggs
3. Return to low heat and cook until it is thick
4. Serve with crackers or chips

title: alli s crunchy ranch chicken  rsc
steps:
1. 1
2. Mix yogurt , milk and chives in a bowl large enough to hold your chicken breasts
3. 2
4. Add 1 1 / 2 tablespoons of hidden valley ranch mix to yogurt mixture
5. Stir
6. 3
7. Add chicken breasts to marinate in fridge for at least 1 hour
8. 4
9. Add 1 1 / 2 tablespoons hidden valley ranch mix to panko breadcrumbs
10. Mix well
11. 5
12. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
13. Grease a baking dish and set aside
14. 6
15. Place breadcrumbs in a shallow dish
16. Add chicken breasts , turning to coat both sides well
17. 7
18. Place chicken in baking dish
19. Lightly spray chicken with short bursts of cooking spray
20. This will help to crisp it up !
21. 8
22. Bake for 20-40 minutes or until juices run clear
23. 9
24. Remove from oven
25. Serve and enjoy !

title: tomato beef curry
steps:
1. Mix marinade ingredients and marinate the beef slices for about 15 minutes
2. Heat 2 tablespoons oil in wok
3. Stir-fry onion 1 to 2 minutes in hot oil
4. Add celery and bell pepper
5. Stir-fry briefly
6. Remove vegetable mixture from wok and reserve
7. Heat about another 2 tablespoons oil in wok
8. Add curry , beef and salt
9. Cook until beef is about 3 / 4 done
10. Add tomatoes , ketchup and the reserved vegetables
11. Stir to heat thoroughly
12. Add soy sauce to taste

title: vegetable samosa filling
steps:
1. Heat a large frying pan and add the ghee , potatoes , garlic , onion and ginger
2. Cover and cook on low for 10 minutes to sweat the potatoes down
3. Stir a few times
4. Dont brown
5. Add the remaining ingredients and continue cooking , covered until the potatoes and peas are tender
6. I use this as a side dish -- or you can buy eggroll wrappers -- fill them and deep fry till golden -- very nice

title: green chile hash browns
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
2. Grease a 9 x 13-inch glass baking dish
3. Combine all ingredients in a large bowl to blend
4. Transfer mixture to prepared baking dish
5. Cover and bake 30 minutes
6. Uncover and bake until top is golden brown , about 45 minutes longer
7. Serve hot

title: copycat chicken quesadillas like ruby tuesday s
steps:
1. Place chicken breast in a bowl with enough italian dressing to coat
2. Allow to marinate 30 minutes in refrigerator
3. Grill marinated chicken until done in a lightly oiled pan
4. Cut into 3 / 4" pieces and set aside
5. Brush one side of tortilla with margarine and place in frying pan over medium heat
6. On one half of tortilla , add cheese , 1 tbls
7. Tomatoes , peppers , and cajun seasoning
8. Make sure to spread to the edge of the half
9. Top with diced chicken , fold empty tortilla side on top , and flip over in pan so that cheese is on top of chicken
10. Cook until very warm throughout
11. Remove from pan to serving plate and cut into six equal wedges on one side of plate
12. On the other side put lettuce , topped with 1 / 4 cup tomatoes , and then topped with sour cream
13. Serve your favorite salsa in a small bowl on the side

title: savory vegetable and noodle kugel
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease a 9-by-9-inch nonstick pan
3. Cook the noodles according to package directions and set aside
4. Coarsely chop the broccoli and cauliflower
5. Steam the vegetables together for 4 or 5 minutes
6. Set aside to cool
7. Heat the oil in a skillet
8. Add the onion , mushrooms and garlic
9. Saut for 10 minutes
10. In a large bowl , combine the noodles , broccoli , cauliflower , onion , mushrooms , ricotta cheese , 1 / 2 cup of the cheddar cheese and dry mustard
11. Toss to thoroughly mix
12. Add salt and pepper to taste
13. Place the mixture in the nonstick pan
14. Sprinkle the remaining cheddar cheese all over the top of the kugel
15. Bake for 30 minutes , or until the cheese bubbles and browns slightly
16. Enjoy !

title: plum muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425f
2. Generously grease 12 muffin cups or line with papers
3. Combine flour , sugar , baking powder , and salt in a large mixing bowl
4. Whisk to blend thoroughly
5. In a separate bowl
6. Whisk milk , egg , melted butter , and almond
7. Make a well in the center of dry ingredients and pour in the egg mixture
8. Blend with a wooden spoon until a moist , lumpy batter is formed
9. Stir in plums
10. Spoon into prepared cups and bake for 20 to 25 minutes , or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean
11. Cool on a rack for 5 minutes , then remove to a rack to cool completely

title: cannellini bean saute
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat
2. Add onion and garlic , and cook until soft and fragrant , about 2 minutes
3. Add beans , lemon juice , salt , pepper , italian seasonings , and a splash of white wine , and cook , stirring until softened and warmed through and liquid has reduced , about 3 minutes
4. Serve warm with a sprinkle of parmesan cheese

title: weight watchers banana oatmeal cookies 1 pt
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Melt butter in a small dish in microwave , 10 seconds at a time
3. Transfer to mixing bown
4. With an electric mixer , thoroughly mix in sugars , banana , egg and vanilla
5. Mix together flour , baking powder , baking soda , cinnamon , salt
6. Mix in to the banana mixture
7. Mix in oatmeal and coconut
8. Drop dough by tablespoons onto a baking sheet lined with parchment
9. Bake for 11-14 minutes until set and golden
10. Cool 5 minutes and remove from tray right away to a cooling rack

title: pizzadilla    weight watchers
steps:
1. Place tortilla on skillet and turn heat between low and medium
2. Spread out sauce over tortilla
3. Add chopped vegetables
4. Spread out cheese over tortilla
5. Add pepperoni
6. Once the cheese starts to melt fold in half
7. Keep on skillet until cheese is melted throughout
8. You may have to flip / adjust heat so that it doesn't burn

title: toasted sesame orzo
steps:
1. Place sesame seeds in a small skillet
2. Cooke over medium heat until golden brown , stirring constantly
3. Set aside
4. Cook pasta according to directions , omitting salt
5. Drain and set aside
6. Melt margarine in medium skillet
7. Add spinach and garlic
8. Cook over medium heat until spinach is wilted
9. Stir in milk , cheese , oregano , paprika , pepper and seeds
10. Serve immediately

title: cinnamon   spice trail mix
steps:
1. Mix margarine and honey in large bowl
2. Add cereal , tossing to coat well
3. Spread mixture on greased 15 1 / 2 x 10 1 / 2 baking pan
4. Bake in preheated 350 oven for 15 minutes , stirring every 5 minutes
5. Mix sugar and cinnamon
6. Sprinkle over cereal mixture , stirring to coat well
7. Stir in raisins
8. Cool completely
9. Store in airtight container

title: fried tortilla chips
steps:
1. Arrange 8 corn tortillas in a stack and cut into 6 equal wedges
2. Pour about 1 / 2 inch salad oil in a deep 2 or 3-quart pan and set on medium-high to high heat
3. When oil is hot enough to make a piece of tortilla sizzle , add tortilla pieces , a handful at a time , and stir to separate
4. Cook until crisp
5. Lift from oil with slotted spoon and drain on paper towels

title: hearty winter stew
steps:
1. Place chicken , beef and bones in a 12-quart pot , adding enough water to cover and bring to a boil
2. Reduce heat , cover and simmer until meat is tender
3. Remove chicken and beef
4. Let cool and cut meat and chicken off bones , discarding skin and bones
5. Strain stock
6. , cover and refrigerate in two containers
7. Degrease stock and bring to a boil in dutch oven
8. Cut chicken and beef into small pieces and add to stock
9. Add vegetables to pan
10. Reduce heat , simmer stirring occassionally for 6-7 hours
11. Season with salt , pepper , and pepper sauce
12. Garnish with cilantro or parsley , if desired

title: fudge drops
steps:
1. Melt chocolate and butterscotch pieces in the top of a double boiler over hot water
2. Remove from heat
3. Stir in quaker harvest crunch and peanuts
4. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper
5. Chill
6. Store in refrigerator

title: sunday s lamb stew   crock pot
steps:
1. Take lamb out of package and put into crock pot
2. Cover the lamb with 2 bay leaves , cooking wine , 1 can of chicken broth and enough water to cover
3. Add 2 garlic cloves , preferably use a garlic press
4. Put the lamb on high for 4 hours
5. Remove lamb from crock pot , and let liquid cool for 1 hour
6. Chop up onion , potatoes , carrot , celery and tomato
7. Place 1 / 2 carrots and chopped up yukon potato on the bottom of a baking dish , and place lamb on top
8. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 min and remove from oven
9. Skim off any fat from the top of the liquid in the crock pot
10. Add , 2 tablespoons flour and whisk with the cooled liquid
11. Use a garlic press to press the last 2 garlic cloves
12. Add the rest of the ingredients in the crock pot , and let cook for 3-4 more hours
13. Let stand for a while before serving to thicken
14. Use parsley as a garnish !
15. Enjoy !

title: curried lentils with spinach
steps:
1. Wash lentils
2. Cook till tender but firm
3. Heat olive oil in large pot & when hot add garlic
4. Sautee for 1 minute
5. Add spinach leaves & steam till they wilt
6. Add lentils & rest of ingredients
7. Cover & simmer for 15 minutes
8. Serve over rice

title: avocado salad dressing
steps:
1. Mash avocado with lemon juice until it is smooth
2. Add remaining ingredients and mix well

title: sesame asparagus with garlic
steps:
1. Combine first 4 ingredients in a small bowl and set aside
2. Snap off tough ends of asparagus
3. Place asparagus and 1 / 4 cup water in an 11 x 7 inch baking dish
4. Microwave at high 3 minutes or until tender , drain , pour the vinegar mixture over asparagus , toss well
5. Serve at room temperature or chilled
6. Sprinkle with sesame seed , if desired

title: barley lentil soup
steps:
1. In large saucepan or soup pot , heat oil over medium heat
2. Saute onion , garlic , carrot , celery , thyme , marjoram and pepper until onions are softened , about 5 minutes
3. Add stock , water , lentils and barley to the pot and bring to boil
4. Reduce heat , cover and simmer until barley and lentils are tender , about 40 minutes
5. Stir in chopped parsley before serving
6. To serve , top each serving with a dollop of yogurt
7. Sprinkle with finely chopped parsley

title: beef   cabbage alfredo
steps:
1. Cook and drain beef
2. Season with garlic , black pepper
3. Shred cabbage into long "noodle-like" strips
4. Cook in 4 quarts of boiling water
5. Add a dollop of cream to the water to make a milder cabbage flavor
6. Drain when tender
7. Mix all ingredients for alfredo sauce in a small saucepan and heat until melted and thoroughly mixed together
8. Ps--the alfredo sauce is great over low carb pasta or spaghetti squash
9. Can be used as a side dish or main course

title: chocolate carrot cupcakes with chocolate cream cheese icing
steps:
1. In medium bowl , mix together flour , baking powder , cinnamon , baking soda , allspice and nutmeg
2. In large bowl , with electric mixer , beat eggs and sugar
3. Beat in chocolate , oil and vanilla
4. Stir in dry ingredients and milk
5. Stir in carrots
6. Spoon batter into greased or paper lined muffin tins
7. Bake in 375f oven 18 to 20 minutes or until tester comes out clean
8. Remove from muffin tins
9. Cool completely
10. Spread with chocolate cream cheese icing
11. In medium bowl , blend together cream cheese and sugar
12. Blend in chocolate and vanilla
13. Stir in cream until smooth and creamy

title: but i don t eat broccoli  broccoli salad
steps:
1. Cut the broccoli florets and non-woody parts of the stems into small pieces
2. Dice the bacon and fry until crisp and allow to cool
3. Mix all the ingredients together and serve

title: lentil pate
steps:
1. Start by chopping up the onion and crushing the garlic
2. Fry the onion and garlic in the oil
3. Once the onion becomes translucent , add the spices and fry them for a little bit too
4. Add 180g of lentils , and the vegetable stock , and sprinkle some salt and pepper if desired
5. Leave the lentils to stew for about 20 minutes over a moderate heat until practically all the liquid is absorbed
6. Take the lentils off the heat and strain them , transferring into a food mixer
7. Add the mango chutney , the egg and the milk , and then blend until making a smooth paste
8. Pour into a lined loaf tin and transfer to the oven for 40 minutes at 200 degrees c
9. Once removed for 20 minutes , turn out onto a wire rack (but leaf the baking paper stuck around to hold it together
10. Chill for a few hours and then serve with salad , pitta and more mango chutney

title: whole grain kefir banana bread
steps:
1. Combine all dry ingredients together , along with chopped nuts and chocolate chips
2. Begin preheating the oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit
3. This recipe is quick to make , so make sure that the oven is almost ready when you begin to add wet ingredients
4. If you bananas are too ripe to be eaten , great ! they will make your bread great
5. Crush bananas into a creamy mass and begin stirring the mass into dry ingredients
6. Mix well , so that the consistency of the mixture is quite uniform
7. Once the oven is ready , add kefir to the mixture and again stir well to combine
8. You may need to use a little less or more , depending on the amount of liquid your bananas produce
9. Baking soda will begin to react with the acid in kefir right away , so work fast
10. Transfer the mix into a greased baking pan , a silicone mold , or a non-stick baking pan
11. For looks toss some rolled oats on top of the bread once it is leveled in the pan
12. Place the pan in the preheated oven and bake on the middle rack for about 50 to 55 minutes
13. Test it with a toothpick towards the end of cooking
14. Let it cool , cut and enjoy

title: brian s milk chocolate chip cookies  aka dirt cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. In a small bowl , combine flour , baking soda , cocoa powder and salt
3. Set aside
4. In a large bowl , beat butter , granulated sugar , brown sugar , and vanilla extract until creamy
5. Add eggs , one at a time , beating well after each addition
6. Gradually beat in flour mixture to the butter mixture
7. Stir in chocolate chips
8. Drop by rounded tablespoon or roll into your hand an make a ball and place onto ungreased cookie sheet
9. Bake for 10-11 minutes
10. Allow to cool on the baking sheet for 2 minutes , then transfer the cookies to wire racks to cool completely
11. Enjoy !

title: meatloaf with cheese and bacon and a bit of a bite
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a fry pan , add the bacon , onion and garlic and cook over a moderate heat until the onion is softened
2. Remove from the heat
3. Mix the remaining ingredients and the onion , bacon mix together in a large bowl-i find this best done by hand
4. Place in a 9inch long by 3 inch wide and deep loaf dish , patting down very firmly and shaping the top nicely
5. Bake in a moderate oven for 1 1 / 2 hours , draining any accumulated fat about half way through
6. Mix the topping ingredients together , spread over the meatloaf and return to the oven for the final 30 minutes of cooking
7. Allow the meatloaf to stand about 10 minutes before slicing

title: microwave broccoli and rice
steps:
1. In a bowl , combine the water , rice , butter , bouillon and pepper
2. Top with broccoli florets
3. Cover and microwave on high for 2 1 / 2 to 3 minutes or until broccoli is tender
4. Let stand for 5 minutes
5. Stir before serving

title: mexican chicken tortillas
steps:
1. Rinse and drain 1 x 15 ounce can of black beans
2. Alternatively , cook 1 cup of dried black beans as per becky fenter's black bean recipe#22162
3. As i was short of time , i adapted becky's recipe
4. I followed steps 1 and 2 , then used the'quick-soak' method then continue with steps 5 to 8 , inclusive , of becky's recipe , but simmer the beans for two hours , instead of one
5. Do not add any salt during this cooking process or beans will toughen !
6. Place drained beans in a large bowl
7. Saute strips of chicken meat , in two batches , in 1 tablespoon of olive oil
8. Remove from pan and place in the bowl with the beans
9. Heat the remaining tablespoon of olive oil in the same pan , add onion and cook for 2 minutes
10. Add red pepper , and continue sauteing over moderate heat until just tender
11. Quickly add the corn and cook gently , stirring , until just heated
12. Transfer onion , red pepper and corn mixture , along with 1 1 / 2 cups of sour cream , 1 / 2 the grated cheese , jalapeno peppers , ground cumin and salt to taste , to the bowl with the beans and chicken , and mix well
13. Grease the bottom of a lasagne pan with olive oil or butter
14. Arrange half the tortillas over the bottom of the prepared pan , overlapping slightly if necessary
15. Top tortillas with black bean , chicken and red pepper mixture
16. Place remaining tortillas over the top , then sprinkle with the remaining cheese
17. Bake in a pre-heated 350 deg
18. F oven for 40 minutes , until cheese is melted and browned
19. Serve garnished with black olives and fresh cilantro , and hand around the remaining sour cream separately

title: tuscany stuffed chicken breasts
steps:
1. Place each chicken piece , boned side up , between 2 pieces of clear plastic wrap
2. Working from the center to the edges , pound lightly with the flat side of a meat mallet to 1 / 4-inch thickness
3. Remove plastic wrap
4. Sprinkle chicken with black pepper
5. Layer cheese , roasted red sweet pepper halves , and sage in the center of each breast
6. Fold in edges
7. Roll up into a spiral , pressing the edges to seal
8. Roll in flour
9. In an 8-inch skillet heat the oil over medium heat
10. Cook chicken in hot oil about 5 minutes , turning to brown all sides
11. Remove from skillet
12. In the same skillet bring wine or broth to boiling
13. Reduce heat
14. Simmer , uncovered , about 2 minutes or until 1 / 4 cup liquid remains
15. Return chicken to skillet
16. Cover and simmer for 8 to 9 minutes or until chicken is tender and no longer pink
17. To serve , spoon juices over chicken

title: best ever low carb cheesecake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300 degrees
2. Cream softened cream cheese with splenda until very smooth
3. Blend in sour cream , vanilla , and lemon juice
4. Add eggs one at a time and beat until smooth but don't overbeat
5. Pour mixture into an 8 or 9 inch springform pan and wrap bottom and sides of pan with tin foil to form a watertight barrier
6. Set pan in larger pan and add water to about half way up the springform
7. Place into oven and cook 1 hour
8. Reduce heat to 200 and cook another hour
9. Cool slowly at either room temp or it is actually best to turn off the oven and leave the cheesecake in it overnight to cool
10. Place in fridge for several hours before serving
11. Top with your favourite fresh fruit if desired and whipped cream

title: bom dia   breakfast muffins from the cafe sintra
steps:
1. Mix together the flour , sugar , baking soda , cinnamon and salt in a large bowl
2. Add the carrots , walnut , coconut and apple and mix together
3. In a small bowl , beat together the eggs , oil and vanilla
4. Add the egg mixture to the large bowl and stir until just combined
5. Bake in muffin tins greased or lined with paper liners , in a 350 degrees f oven for about 25 to 30 minutes , until a wood pick inserted in the center comes out clean

title: apple butter bread  two recipes
steps:
1. Combine flour , brown sugar , baking powder , baking soda and salt in a large mixing bowl
2. In a small bowl mix 3 / 4 cup apple butter , apple juice , butter and egg together
3. Fold in the raisins and chopped nuts
4. Add the apple butter mixture to the dry ingredients and blend together
5. Pour half the mixture in a loaf pan that has been sprayed with cooking spray
6. Gently spread the reserved 3 / 4 cup apple butter over the batter
7. Pour the rest of the batter over the apple butter mixture and spread evenly over the top to cover
8. Bake at 350 degrees for 55 to 65 minutes or until done
9. To bake "my mistake loaf" just put all the apple butter in the wet ingredients and blend into the dry ingredients
10. I cut up dried pineapple pieces and added with the nuts instead of the raisins
11. Pour the whole batter into the loaf pan and bake as above
12. This makes a heavy moist bread that is delicious
13. Any kind of nuts can be used and any kind of dried fruit that your prefer
14. This can be sugar free using splenda brown sugar blend and margo's apple butter recipe using splenda

title: butternut squash   couscous
steps:
1. For almonds:
2. In a small frying pan toast the almonds over moderately low heat , stirring frequently , until golden brown , about 5 minutes
3. Alternately , you may toast them in a 350 f oven for 5 to 10 minutes
4. For squash:
5. In a dutch oven or large saucepan , heat the oil over moderately low heat
6. Add the onions and cook , stirring occasionally , until translucent , about 5 minutes
7. Add the garlic , cayenne , nutmeg , and cinnamon and cook , stirring , 1 minute longer until fragrant
8. Stir in the tomatoes , squash , raisins , broth , and 1 teaspoon of the salt and bring to a simmer
9. Stir in the chickpeas and cook , covered , for 10 minutes
10. Uncover and simmer until the squash is tender , about 10 minutes more
11. Stir in the parsley
12. For couscous:
13. Meanwhile , in a medium saucepan , bring the water and 1 / 4 teaspoon salt to a boil
14. Follow the directions on your package for the correct amount of water
15. Stir in the couscous
16. Cover , remove from the heat , and let stand for 5 minutes
17. Fluff with a fork
18. Serve the stew over the couscous and top with the toasted almonds

title: gomae   japanese style spinach salad
steps:
1. Toast sesame seeds until slightly brown , you will smell the scent of the sesame seeds when its ready
2. Reserve small amount of the sesame seed for the garnish
3. Place the rest on a plate and crush , then place in a bowl
4. Add water , soy , sugar into the bowl with the sesame seed
5. Set aside until spinach is ready
6. To cook the spinach: add a pinch of salt into a pot of boiling hot water
7. Mix then add spinach for one minute
8. Pour the spinach and water into a colander and run cold tap water to cool down the spinach , this will stop it from cooking more
9. Squish the spinach with your hands , until all the moister is out of the spinach
10. Cut spinach into strips
11. Place spinach onto serving bowls and drizzle the dressing onto the spinach , then add reserved sesame seed as garnish
12. Enjoy chef flowers gomae - japanese style spinach salad
13. Www dot recipezaar dot com

title: nut crusted chicken breasts
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f poke each breast several times with a fork
2. Sprinkle each breast with 1 / 2 tsp kosher salt , coating both sides
3. Refrigerate , uncovered , 15-20 minutes
4. Process nuts in food processor , about 20 1-second pulses , until it looks like coarse meal
5. Heat butter in skillet over medium flame until melted
6. Swirl constantly until butter is brown and smells nutty , 4-5 minutes
7. Add shallot and 1 / 4 tsp kosher salt
8. Cook , stirring constantly , until shallot is soft , about 2 minutes
9. Reduce heat to medium-low
10. Add nuts and panko and stir often until golden brown , 10-12 minutes
11. Transfer to a shallow dish and stir in lemon zest , thyme and cayenne
12. Beat egg , mustard and black pepper in a second bowl
13. Place flour in a third dish
14. Pat breasts dry
15. Dip breasts , one at a time , into flour , patting off excess , then into egg , then into nut mixture
16. Scoop nut mixture on top of the chicken and press it down hard to make it adhere
17. Place breast on a rack placed over a cookie sheet , then prepare the second one
18. Place rack in lower-middle of preheated oven and bake until internal temperature of chicken is 160f , 20-25 minutes
19. Rest 5 minutes , then serve with lemon wedges

title: julie s deviled eggs
steps:
1. Peel the eggs and slice them in half lengthwise
2. Slip the yolks out and place them in a small bowl
3. Break up the yolks by pressing them through a fork
4. Add the mayo , dried minced onion , curry , garlic , and salt and pepper to taste , and moosh around with the fork until it's all mixed / creamed together well
5. You can add a little mayo to get the texture you prefer
6. Fill the egg white halves with the yolk mixture and sprinkle each half with a little paprika
7. Set them on the serving plate
8. If you can chill them for at least 30 minutes before serving , that's great- otherwise , put'em on the table and step back quickly before you're run over by your guests
9. A
10. Sometimes i add some chili powder , tabasco , or jalapeno for a little kick , depending on the guests i'm making them for

title: garlic grilled artichokes
steps:
1. Heat grill to medium-high direct heat
2. Trim sharp
3. Cut artichokes in half lengthwise
4. Brush both sides of artichokes w / 1 tbsp olive oil
5. Place artichokes on grill and grill for about 5 minutes on each side or until they are slightly charred
6. Remove from grill
7. Tear off 4 12" x 12" pieces of aluminum foil
8. Place each artichoke half on 1 square of foil , cut side up
9. Sprinkle garlic and lemon zest evenly over artichokes
10. Drizzle with melted butter and sprinkle with salt and pepper
11. Wrap foil edges up around artichoke halves but don't close completely
12. Add 1 tbsp water to each packet
13. Close foil packet
14. Grill over indirect heat for 35-45 minutes or until tender
15. Serve w / additional melted butter for dipping , if desired

title: red snapper with pepper and vinegar
steps:
1. Salt fish filets and let stand 15 minutes
2. Dredge in flour
3. In a large skillet over medium high heat melt 1 tbs
4. Butter with 1 tbs
5. Olive oil
6. When butter and oil start to brown put fish in and cook about 3-4 minutes on each side
7. Remove and keep warm
8. Add shallots and pepper to skillet and cook 30 seconds
9. Add chopped tomato and stir until mixture comes to a boil , then add red wine vinegar
10. Cook until reduced by half
11. Pour cognac over and ignite
12. When flames die out add 1 tbs
13. Butter and parsley
14. Pour over fish and serve immediately

title: mom s southern style split pea soup
steps:
1. You may substitute a meaty hambone , diced smoked ham , cut up smoked pork butt , or , if like my husband prefers and no pork is allowed , use smoked turkey
2. Put all ingredients except salt into large heavy-bottomed stock pot
3. Cook over low-med
4. Heat
5. Stir occasionally
6. Simmer until meat falls off bone and split peas have become mush
7. Be careful not to burn
8. Stir more often as soup thickens
9. Remove bone , bay leaves and spices
10. Puree and test for salt
11. Add salt if needed and cook an additional 15 minutes
12. Adjust water if necessary
13. The soup should be very thick
14. It becomes almost paste when cold
15. You may need to add some water to reheat
16. This soup freezes very well
17. If you leave out the cloves you won't have this special recipe
18. They are the secret ingredient
19. I'm guessing on servings and amount
20. It depends on how much you cook it down

title: feed me now soup
steps:
1. Put the couscous , stock powder , shrimp and peas in a soup bowl
2. Pour in the boiling water and stir briefly to dissolve the stock powder
3. Grate the garlic directly into the soup bowl , using a fine grater
4. Cover and let stand for five minutes
5. Grind in some black pepper and enjoy

title: world s best banana bread
steps:
1. Mash bananas
2. Add sugar , oil , eggs , sour cream , vanilla , baking soda , and flour
3. Mix until well combined
4. Pour into greased bread pans until 1 / 2 full , reserve half of batter
5. Combine 1 / 2 cup sugar and cinnamon
6. Sprinkle generously 1 / 2 of cinnamon / sugar combination onto batter
7. Pour rest of batter into pans
8. Sprinkle rest of cinnamon / sugar on top of batter
9. Bake at 350 for approximately 1 hour , or until a toothpick comes out clean

title: easy creamy corn casserole
steps:
1. Grease a 1-quart baking dish
2. Set oven to 350 degrees
3. In a bowl , combine the first seven ingredients
4. Transfer to a baking dish
5. Mix cracker crumbs and parmesan cheese together , then add in the butter and butter
6. Mix to combine , then sprinkle over top
7. Bake uncovered for 45-50 minutes or until heated through

title: creamy orange trifle
steps:
1. Stir gelatin into cold water until dissolved
2. Add boiling water , orange juice and lemon juice
3. Stir until smooth
4. Add sugar and continue stirring until dissolved
5. Refrigerate until mixture starts to thicken , about 1 hour
6. Whip heavy cream to stiff peaks
7. Fold into orange juice mixture
8. Tear cake into bite-size pieces and place in 13x9x2"-inch baking dish
9. Pour orange juice-whipped cream mixture evenly over cake pieces
10. Cover and refrigerate overnight
11. Scatter nuts and orange zest , if desired , over the top and serve

title: shredded beef sandwiches
steps:
1. In a slow cooker , combine the beef , green peppers and onions
2. In a small bowl , combine tomato paste , brown sugar , vinegar , chili powder , salt , worcestershire sauce and mustard
3. Stir into meat mixture
4. Cover and cook on high for 7-8 hours or until meat is very tender
5. Skim fat from cooking juices
6. Shred beef using two forks
7. With a slotted spoon place about 1 / 2 cup beef mixture on each bun and serve

title: caramelised redcurrant onions
steps:
1. Heat oil and butter in a medium frying pan
2. Add onions and garlic , cook on a low heat for 10 minutes or until lightly coloured
3. Stir occasionally
4. Add the sugar , rosemary , vinegar and jelly
5. Cook a further 10 minutes until the onions are soft and the liquid has evaporated
6. Season with salt and pepper and serve
7. Will keep a few days covered in the fridge

title: jello fruit punch
steps:
1. Mix jello with boiling water till dissolved
2. Mix in all other ingredients except ginger ale
3. Take four cups of mixture and put in a 6 cup ring mold- cover and freeze to make an ice ring
4. Chill the rest of the mixture and the ginger ale
5. To assemble in punch bowl , unmold ice ring , place in bowl , pour equal amounts of chilled juice mixture and ginger ale over and serve
6. This recipe makes about 2 gallons
7. Can easily be doubled or tripled

title: spiced banana muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Whisk together the flour , bran , baking powder , salt and nutmeg
3. Mash the bananas and stir in the eggs , brown sugar , oil and vanilla
4. Mix well and add to the dry ingredients
5. Stir until well combined
6. Spoon the batter into a prepared muffin pan and bake until the tops are golden brown and a toothpick comes out clean when inserted , about 12-15 minutes

title: orange dreamsicle cheesecake
steps:
1. Line the bottom and sides of a 9 inch springform pan with a single piece of extra wide aluminum foil as smoothly as possible
2. Pour orange soda into the pan until 1 / 4 inch deep
3. Place in freezer , making sure the pan is level
4. Freeze until hard
5. Beat cream cheese and sugar until smooth and fluffy
6. Beat in the milk
7. Refrigerate 30 minutes in mixing bowl to chill
8. Fold 1-1 / 2 of the tubs of the cool whip into the cheese mixture until smooth and fluffy
9. Spoon filling into the springform pan on top of the frozen orange soda layer
10. Freeze at least 4 hours
11. Mix the graham cracker crumbs , sugar , and melted butter until they form a crumbly texture
12. Gently sprinkle the crumbs over the frozen cheesecake , smoothing across to form a crust
13. Return to the freezer overnight
14. When ready to serve , remove the sides of the springform pan
15. Loosen the the aluminum foil from the sides of the cheesecake
16. Invert the cheesecake onto a serving plate and carefully peel off the aluminum foil
17. Decorate the top with the remaining cool whip and serve immediately
18. Cut with a knife that has been dipped in hot water
19. Store any leftovers in the freezer

title: kabuki
steps:
1. Pour sake , cordial , syrup , lime juice , cointreau and ice into a blender
2. Blend well
3. Pour into a salt-rimmed glass
4. Garnish with a twist of lime

title: no cooking sweet potato salad
steps: 1. Mix together and eat !

title: whole wheat carrot cake with cream cheese frosting
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Butter 13 x 9 inch pyrex baking dish
3. Combine oil , sugars and eggs in mixing bowl
4. Sift together flours , cinnamon , soda and salt
5. Mix into liquid ingredients
6. Stir in carrots , pineapple with reserved juice and walnuts
7. Bake about 45 minutes or until tester comes out clean
8. Cool
9. Ice with cream cheese frosting

title: couscous salad with chickpeas  dates   cinnamon
steps:
1. Finely chop white part of green onions
2. Slice green parts
3. Reserve for salad
4. Heat 1 tablespoon of the oil in medium saucepan on medium heat
5. Add white onion pieces
6. Cook and stir 5 minutes
7. Stir in chicken broth , cinnamon , 1 / 4 teaspoon of the black pepper and red pepper and bring to boil
8. Add couscous
9. Cover
10. Remove pan from heat
11. Let stand 5 minutes
12. Whisk vinegar , 1 / 2 teaspoon of the salt and remaining 6 tablespoons oil in small bowl
13. Fluff couscous with fork
14. Spoon into large bowl
15. Add sliced green onions , chickpeas , carrots , dates , pine nuts , remaining 1 / 4 teaspoon salt and remaining 1 / 4 teaspoon black pepper
16. Toss lightly
17. Add vinaigrette
18. Toss again
19. Serve immediately or refrigerate until ready to serve
20. Garnish with chopped cilantro , if desired

title: swedish creamed potatoes from skane  skansk potatis
steps:
1. Saut onion in 2 tbs bacon fat until soft and a medium frying pan
2. Remove from pan and set aside
3. Add remaining bacon fat and potatoes
4. Fry until golden brown on the outside
5. Stir in the onions
6. Add milk and cook a couple of minutes
7. Look to see how much of the liquid is absorbed before adding the cream as you want enough to slightly cover the potatoes and enough to cook them
8. Sprinkle with salt and pepper
9. Stir until blended
10. Cover pan
11. Cook very slowly , low heat until potatoes are soft , about 15 minutes this will depend on how large your potato cubes are
12. Pour into serving dish and sprinkle with parsley

title: tropical green beans
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Brush a large baking dish with 2 tablespoons of the olive oil
3. Put green beans , onion , and garlic in dish , drizzle with remaining oil and sprinkle with salt
4. Bake for 25 minutes , stirring beans at least 3 times
5. When tender , remove beans from oven and transfer to bowl
6. Immediately drizzle with vinegar
7. Add hearts of palm , tomatoes , pine nits and pepper to taste and toss
8. Serve warm or room temperature

title: quick honey mustard pork stir fry
steps:
1. Slice pork thinly
2. Mix together the honey & mustard
3. Marinate the pork in honey mustard mixture for at least 15-20 minutes
4. Heat oil in nonstick wok or pan
5. Add meat & stirfry with high heat until cooked , stirring & tossing all the time
6. Serve with stir fried veggies & rice or potatoes & salad

title: sylvia s easy steak   gravy
steps:
1. Place steak in baking pan
2. Cover with cream of mushroom soup and sprinkle onion soup mix on top
3. Cover with foil and bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes

title: pumpkin pizzelles
steps:
1. Preheat the pizzelle iron
2. Beat the sugar and butter until light and fluffy , then add the eggs , pumpkin , and vanilla
3. Sift the dry ingredients together , then fold into the sugar mix
4. Lightly brush the pizzelle iron with butter , then drop a teaspoon amount of dough onto the iron
5. Close the lid and bake for 34-60 seconds
6. Remove
7. Before the cookies cool , you can shape them into cones or rolls or shallow bowls , if you want , or leave them flat
8. Repeat buttering the iron as needed and dropping on dough and baking it until all the dough is gone
9. Garnish by dusting with powdered sugar

title: refried bean dip
steps:
1. Heat together beans , taco sauce , cream cheese , onion , garlic , and cilantro until well combined
2. Remove from heat and stir in cheese to melt

title: orinoco red beans and rice
steps:
1. In a very large , deep skillet , heat the olive oil
2. Add the chopped bacon and cook over moderate heat , stirring , until golden brown
3. Add the garlic and cook , stirring , until golden
4. Add the onion , bell pepper , chile peppers , scallions , leek , celery , chopped cilantro and parsley and cook , stirring frequently , until the vegetables soften , about 5 minutes
5. Add the beans and cook , stirring gently , for 2 minutes
6. Add the rice , water , cilantro sprigs and 2 teaspoons of salt and bring to a boil
7. Reduce the heat to moderately low and simmer until the liquid is almost completely absorbed , about 6 minutes
8. Fluff the rice with a fork
9. Reduce the heat to very low , cover and cook until the rice is firm-tender , about 25 minutes
10. Fluff the rice , season with salt and serve

title: whole wheat tortilla pinwheels
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , mix together cream cheese , taco seasoning and picante sauce
2. Stir until smooth and well blended
3. Fold in black olives , green chiles , cheese , peppers , and cayenne and garlic
4. Place one tortilla on a plate
5. Spread a thin layer of cream cheese mixture onto the tortilla
6. Fold sides of tortilla in , fold bottom of tortilla up , and roll to opposite end
7. Cut into -inch slices and place pinwheels on a festive serving platter
8. Repeat with remaining tortillas
9. Serve immediately or cover and chill until serving time
10. Enjoy !

title: p b   j stacks   peanut butter and jelly
steps:
1. In 2-quart saucepan , heat jam and syrup over medium heat , stirring occasionally until warm
2. Grease griddle with cooking spray
3. Heat greased griddle or skillet over medium-high heat
4. In medium bowl , stir bisquick mix , 3 / 4 cup peanut butter , milk and eggs with a wire whisk or fork until blended
5. For each pancake , pour slightly less than 1 / 4 cup batter onto hot griddle
6. Cook until edges are dry
7. Turn
8. Cook until golden
9. Serve stacks of pancakes with additional peanut butter or bananas and syrup
10. High altitude : no change

title: crustless pumpkin pie
steps:
1. Mix ingredients
2. Pour into sprayed 9 x 9 pan
3. Bake at 350 degrees until set or approx 55 minutes
4. Cut into 9 squares and serve with fat free cool whip

title: chewy oatmeal cookies
steps:
1. Cream margarine and brown sugar
2. Combine flour and baking soda
3. Add to creamed mixture , a little at a time , stirring
4. Add oats and mix well
5. Shape into 1-1 / 2 inch balls
6. Roll in the sugar
7. Place 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheets
8. Flatten with a glass
9. Bake at 350 for 10 minutes or until golden
10. Cool on wire racks

title: grilled ham and mixed cheese sandwich
steps:
1. Combine the cheeses , mayonnaise , mustard and onion
2. Spread this mixture on 4 of the slices of bread
3. Top each cheese mixture with a ham slice , and cover with another piece of bread
4. Butter the top half of the sandwiches and invert onto a hot nonstick skillet , cooking over a medium heat until browned
5. Butter the ungrilled side and turn and grill until browned

title: olive cheese bread
steps:
1. Rough chop black and green olives
2. Combine green onions and olives with the softened butter , mayo , and cheese
3. Mix thoroughly
4. Slice french bread in half lengthwise
5. Spread mixture evenly over halves
6. Bake at 325 for 25 minutes or until thoroughly melted and starting to turn light brown and bubbly
7. Can make mixture 2 days ahead , spread on unbaked bread and freeze too !

title: copycat mccormick swiss steak bag and seasoning
steps:
1. Combine the flour , minced onions , dried green bell peppers , garlic powder , salt , ground black pepper and paprika in the resealable jar
2. Close the jar and shake to combine the ingredients
3. Store the dry swiss steak seasoning in a dry , dark place for up to one month
4. To prepare swiss steak using your seasoning mixture
5. Combine the dry mix with 8 oz of tomato sauce and 1 cup of water
6. Pour this over 1 1 / 2 lb
7. Of round steak in a baking dish and cover
8. Bake the steak for 45 minutes at 350 degrees fahrenheit

title: veal parmigiana
steps:
1. Heat the 3 tablespoons of oil in a saucepan and saute the onion and garlic until golden
2. Stir in tomato sauce , water , oregano , pepper , and parsley
3. Cover and simmer 10 minutes
4. Combine 1 / 2 cup parmesan cheesewith bread crumbs
5. Dip veal into egg , then into cheese crumb mixture
6. Heat remaining olive oil in skillet and saute veal until golden , turning only once
7. Pour 1 / 2 the tomato sauce into baking dish
8. Place veal and mozzarella cheese in alternating layers in dish
9. Pour remaining sauce over veal and cheese
10. Sprinkle with 2 tablespoons parmesan cheese
11. Bake in moderate oven 25 minutes , or until sauce is bubbly and cheese melts slightly
12. Serve with capellini , crusty bread , and a salad

title: ghostly green brew
steps:
1. Allow sherbet to melt for about 1 hour in bottom of punch bowl
2. Pour ginger ale over and stir until all sherbet is dissolved

title: uncle bill s macaroni with 3 cheese
steps:
1. Cook elbow macaroni according to package instructions , al dente' , about 15 minutes
2. Drain well and set aside
3. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
4. In a saucepan over medium heat , melt 4 tablespoons of butter
5. Stir in flour to form a paste
6. Do not let it burn or go lumpy
7. Slowly whisk in milk and bring to a simmer , stirring constantly until sauce begins to thicken
8. Add salt , pepper and tabasco or red hot sauce
9. Remove from heat and stir in 1 cup of grated sharp cheddar cheese , stirring until blended
10. Butter a 9" x 9" ovenproof casserole dish
11. In a bowl , mix together elbow macaroni , cheese sauce and half of the tomatoes with juice
12. Transfer macaroni to the prepared casserole dish
13. Sprinkle top with remaining 1 1 / 2 cups grated sharp cheddar cheese , swiss cheese and parmesan cheese
14. Add remaining 4 tablespoons of butter in dollops on top
15. Bake uncovered in preheated 350 f oven for 30 minutes or until bubbly and golden
16. Serve with the reamining crushed tomatoes and a sprinkle of chopped onions or chopped green onions

title: 5 tacos
steps:
1. Cook meat
2. Add taco seasoning
3. Place meat into taco shells / tortillas
4. Top with tomatoes , onions , lettuce , salsa and cheese
5. Boil corn cobs 5-7 minutes

title: holiday applesauce
steps:
1. Bring all ingredients except the vanilla extract to a boil in a 6-qt
2. Saucepan over high heat
3. Reduce heat to low , cover , and cook for 10-15 minutes , or until the apples start to break down
4. Uncover and cook for a further 1-1 1 / 2 hours , or until the mixture has reduced by about a third and the sauce becomes thick and amber-colored
5. Remove from heat and stir in the vanilla extract
6. Serve warm or cool

title: spiced pork loin steaks with prunes
steps:
1. Heat oven to 325f
2. Peel and thinly slice the onions
3. Dip the meat in the seasoned flour
4. Heat the olive oil in a roomy frying pan , add the pork steaks and brown each one on both sides
5. Transfer to a large casserole
6. Add theonions to the hot oil and stir to soften over a moderate heat
7. Add the sugar and stir until the onions caramelize
8. Stir in the spices , vinegar and 2 tbs cold water
9. Simmer until the onions are syrupy , about 2 to 3 minutes
10. Pour the caramelized onions over the pork
11. Add the bay leaves , prunes and stock
12. Cover with the casserole lid
13. Set in the heated oven and cook for 1 1 / 2 hours
14. Season with salt and freshly milled pepper to taste before serving

title: shrimp imperial with pasta and broccoli
steps:
1. In a 3-quart saucepan , melt butter over medium heat
2. Add in shallots and old bay seasoning
3. Stir / saute 2 minutes or until the shallots are softened
4. Add in the shrimp
5. Stir / saute for about 2 minutes or until shrimp begin to turn pink
6. Stir in the soup , milk , mayonnaise , sherry , worcestershire sauce , horseradish , and 1 / 4 cup cheese
7. Stir and cook just until cheese melts
8. Add in the pasta and broccoli
9. Stir to combine
10. Transfer mixture to a greased 2 quart casserole dish
11. Top with remaining cheese
12. Bake in a 350 oven for 30-45 minutes or until casserole bubbles and cheese is golden

title: awesome chicken noodle soup
steps:
1. Cut chicken breasts and cook in olive oil to carmelize
2. Cook egg noodles , drain
3. Add all ingredients
4. Simmer for 2 hours or longer to blend flavors

title: rhubarb mallow cobbler
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine rhubarb and 1 1 / 2 c sugar
2. Transfer to a greased 11x7 dish
3. Sprinkle with marshmallows
4. In a small mixing bowl , cream butter , vanilla and remaining sugar
5. Combine flour , baking powder and salt then add alternately with milk to the creamed mixture
6. Beat just until moistened
7. Spoon over rhubarb / marshmallows
8. Bake 350 degrees for 50-55 minutes or until topping is golden brown
9. Serve warm

title: saltgrass steakhouse garlic mashed potatoes
steps:
1. After washing potatoes , rub potatoes with softened butter and place in a 375 degrees oven until potato is soft , when checked with a fork
2. The potatoes should take about a 1 1 1 / 4 hour
3. To prepare garlic cut the top of the head of garlic off so you can see garlic cloves with out any peelings covering them
4. Spoon the vegetable oil on top of garlic and wrap in foil
5. Place in oven while baking the potatoes
6. Garlic will take about 1 / 2 3 / 4 hour
7. Garlic should be soft and golden in color when finished baking
8. When garlic is removed from the oven cool slightly and squeeze soft garlic from head
9. Depending on the size of the cloves it should take about 4 5 cloves
10. The crushed garlic should measure out to be 1 1 / 2 teaspoons more garlic may be added for the hearty
11. When potatoes are done chop slightly and place in a large mixing bowl
12. Add salt , butter , pepper , and roasted garlic that have been mashed and measured
13. Add 1 / 2 cup milk
14. Beat with a electric mixer until fluffy
15. There will be little chunks of potatoes that will not be completely mashed
16. The small lumps and peelings will give these potatoes a hearty flavor
17. If potatoes seem to be to dry add little more milk
18. These potatoes will be a hit
19. They really are a great change from those same old french fries with that favorite cut of steak

title: warm green and yellow squash salad with cranberry vinaigrette
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , combine the vinegar , cranberry juice , honey and salt and white pepper to taste
2. Slowly add the oil and whisk until the oil is incorporated into the vinaigrette
3. Chop the cranberries and add them to the vinaigrette
4. Stir to combine
5. Set aside
6. Cut each zucchini and yellow squash in half lengthwise
7. Drag the
8. Slice each half into 1 / 4-inch-thick half-moon slices
9. Steam the squash until the slices are just cooked through
10. The white flesh will start to look opaque and the slices will start to wilt
11. Be careful not to overcook
12. Transfer squash to a large bowl
13. Add the dressing gradually to the squash--just enough to keep the salad moist--and toss to combine
14. (you probably will not need all the
15. Dressing
16. ) set aside for 5 minutes
17. Transfer to a serving dish
18. Serve immediately
19. Do ahead
20. The squash can be sliced , covered with plastic wrap and refrigerated ahead of time
21. The dressing also can be made hours in advance , then whisked together again before adding to the squash

title: cornmeal lime cookies
steps:
1. Cream butter and sugar 3-4 minutes
2. Add egg and beat until just combined
3. Add zests , lime juice and extract
4. Add flour and cornmeal and mix until well blended
5. Cover with waxed paper or plastic wrap
6. Form into a disc and chill , at least , 1 hour
7. Roll heaping teaspoons of dough into balls and place on baking stones 3" apart
8. Dip bottom of a medium drinking glass into a bowl filled with the cornmeal and flatten balls with the bottom of the glass until dough is 1 / 4" thick
9. Bake cookies at 350 until golden brown around the edges , about 14-16 minutes
10. When cookies cool pour lime glaze over them
11. Let glaze set
12. Devour

title: golden tangerine nut bread
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease and lightly flour one 8 1 / 2- by 4 1 / 2-inch loaf pan or two 5 3 / 4- by 3 1 / 2-inch loaf pans
3. In a large mixing bowl , cream the butter and 3 / 4 cup of sugar together until blended
4. Add the eggs and beat until fluffy and light
5. Add the tangerine rind
6. In another bowl , stir the 1 1 / 4 cups of flour and the baking powder and salt together until blended
7. Toss the walnuts with the 1 tablespoon of flour until all the pieces are lightly coated
8. Blend the flour mixture into the creamed mixture alternately with the milk
9. Fold the walnuts into the batter until blended
10. Turn into the prepared pans or pan
11. Bake 35 to 45 minutes for small loaves , 55 to 60 minutes for the medium loaf , or until they test done
12. Meanwhile , combine the juice and sugar in a small pan to make the glaze
13. Heat just until the sugar is dissolved
14. Poke the hot loaves with a skewer or toothpick in several places and pour the syrup over them
15. Cool in the pan for 10 minutes , then remove and finish cooling on a rack
16. This recipe yields one medium or two small loaves

title: five  minute chicken vegetable soup
steps:
1. Put all of the ingredients in a large saucepan
2. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat
3. Reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes

title: greek bruschetta with florina peppers and smoked trout
steps:
1. Grill the peppers on both sides , place them immediately in a bowl and cover with cellophane , keeping the bowl covered for 20 minutes
2. Skin the peppers and remove the seeds
3. Dry them on paper towels and cut them up
4. Fry them together with the oil and garlic in a frying pan on a low heat for 7 - 8 minutes until most of their juices have evaporated
5. Process them at medium speed until they become a velvety cream
6. Season with salt and pepper
7. Grill the bread on both sides and spread the pepper cream on each slice
8. Place two slices of trout on each piece of bread and decorate with the dill leaves and lemon zest

title: potato salad with lime and sun dried tomatoes
steps:
1. In a large pot , cover the potatoes with lightly salted water and bring to a simmer over high heat
2. Cook just until tender , 15 to 20 minutes , depending on size
3. Drain and rise under cold water for a minute or two to stop them from cooking further
4. Drain well again and allow to cool completely
5. Cut the potatoes in halves or quarters and set aside
6. Put the sun dried tomatoes into a small bowl
7. Add themayonnaise , lime juice , lime peel , garlic , tabasco , salt , pepper and parsley
8. Whisk to blend
9. Toss the potatoes with enough dressing to coat
10. Serve cold or at room temperature

title: just like stephenson s green rice
steps:
1. Combine the rice , parsley , cheese , green pepper and garlic in a greased casserole dish
2. Blend together the remaining ingredients and add to the rice mixture
3. Bake at 350f for 45 minutes or until it is like a custard
4. It can be garnished with paprika before baking if you wish

title: jamaican haze
steps:
1. Blend rum , apricot brandy , and sour mix with crushed ice
2. Pour into a sour glass
3. Garnish with a cherry

title: traditional bulgogi  barbecued beef
steps:
1. The meat:
2. Slice the meat very thinly along the grain
3. Use a tenderizer or the back of your knife to soften the meat
4. Cut the meat into mouth size pieces
5. The marinade:
6. Mince the garlic
7. Chop the scallions
8. Slice or chop the onions depending on your preference
9. Put garlic , scallions , and the onions into a bowl and add soy sauce , sesame seed oil , sugar , and ground pepper
10. Add the meat into marinade bowl and let it sit for 3 hours
11. Cook in a skillet , stirring often until well done

title: shrimp with sun dried tomato basil sauce
steps:
1. Cover sun-dried tomatoes with hot water and allow to soak 5 to 10 minute
2. Once reconstituted , julienne and set aside
3. Reserve soaking liquid
4. Cook pasta according to package directions
5. Strain and set aside
6. In a large skillet , heat oil over medium heat
7. Saute garlic and onions for 1 or 2 minutes
8. Add shrimp and brown 1 to 2 minutes
9. Add diced tomatoes , sun-dried tomatoes along with reserved soaking liquid , tomato juice , and balsamic vinegar
10. Heat to a simmer
11. Add pasta , basil
12. Return to simmer
13. Once hot , remove from heat , add lemon and add pepper to taste

title: easy vegetable black bean soup
steps:
1. Heat oil in the bottom of the soup pot
2. Add onion , garlic and carrot until the onion becomes clear
3. Add chicken broth and bring to a boil
4. Add the beans , corn , cumin , cilantro , and chili powder if using , and bring to a boil
5. Add tomato puree and heat again until hot and steamy
6. Salt and pepper to taste
7. I personally didn't use salt because canned veggies are pretty salty on their own , but for people who like a lot of salt , i would add some
8. The longer you leave the soup cooking on low , the better the flavors meld together
9. However it can be served immediately if you're in a rush
10. Serve with crackers , because this soup is perfect for them ! also good with a little cheese sprinkled on top

title: hawaiian rhubarb crisp
steps:
1. Crust and topping------------
2. In a medium size mixing bowl , mix together quick-cooking rolled oats , salt , baking powder , brown sugar , all-purpose flour
3. Mix well to combine
4. Add margarine or butter and using a fork or pastry blender , mix until crumbly
5. Spoon half the crumbly mixture into a 9 inch x 12 inch oven proof baking casserole dish and pat down with a spatula
6. Save the remaining half mixture for topping
7. Filling------------
8. Preheat oven to 350 f degrees
9. In a medium size mixing bowl , combine cornstarch and granulated sugar
10. Mix well
11. Combine beaten egg with cornstarch / sugar mixture and mix until smooth
12. Add chopped rhubarb , crushed pineapple and stir well to blend
13. Pour mixture over the crumbly mixture in the casserole dish
14. Sprinkle with cinnamon
15. Sprinkle remainder of crumbly mixture over the top
16. Bake in preheated 350 f oven for 45 to 50 minutes or until lightly browned
17. Remove from oven and let cool slightly before serving
18. Serve with your choice of ice-cream or whipping cream

title: red punch in a rush
steps:
1. Pour the hawaiian punch into a punch bowl
2. Add the chilled soda by pouring it down the side , slowly
3. Add ice and serve

title: heavenly pasta salad
steps:
1. Cook pasta until bite tender
2. Rinse and drain
3. Let cool
4. Add remaining ingredients to pasta
5. Mix dressing ingredients in a separate bowl
6. Add to pasta mixture
