7. Refrigerate a couple hours before serving
8. My m-i-l only puts the red and green peppers in hers
9. I like the carrots and tomatoes added in as well

title: easy lemon basil chicken
steps:
1. Sprinkle chicken , both sides , with basil
2. It should be a liberal coating
3. You can even use more than what's listed
4. Heat a fry pan on medium-high and add 1 t of the olive oil
5. Mix remaining oil , lemon juice and soy sauce
6. Set aside
7. Brown chicken in oil , both sides
8. Add liquid mix
9. Bring to a boil
10. At this point you can either place chicken in an oven pan and bake at 375f or just turn the stove down to a simmer
11. Cook for 15-20 min for boneless and 40-45 min for bone-in chicken

title: tomato leek tart
steps:
1. To make the pastry: in a food processor combine 3 cups of flour , sugar and salt until on / off turns
2. Add fennel and process for 30 seconds
3. Blend in 1 cup of butter using on / off turns until mixture resembles coarse meal
4. Add eggs while machine is running and mix just until dough comes together
5. You may need to add a bit more flour if dough doesn't come together
6. Remove dough from processor and shape into disc and wrap in wax paper and refrigerate for several hours or overnight
7. To prepare filling: melt the 3 t of butter and oil in a large skillet over medium heat
8. Add leeks and shallots and cook until soft
9. Add garlic and saffron and stir 2 minutes more
10. Blend in liqueur and cook for 2 more minutes or until it evaporates
11. Stir in parsley and salt and pepper
12. Cool to room temperature before proceeding
13. To assemble tart: preheat oven to 425 degrees f
14. On a floured board roll dough out to fit 11-inch tart pan circle
15. Fit into pan with a removeable bottom , and trim edges
16. Chill 30 minutes
17. Line pastry with foil and fill with dried beans or pie weights
18. Bake for 8-10 minutes , remove foil and weights and bake for 10 more minutes or until golden
19. Spoon in leek mixture
20. Sprinkle with cheese
21. Top with tomato slices , overlapping circles
22. Whisk together eggs , cream and salt and then pour over filling
23. Set tart on a baking sheet and bake for 30-40 minutes or until filling is set
24. Brush with melted butter during last 5 minutes of baking
25. Cool in pan on rack

title: wild west baked chili mac
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f prepare shells and cheese dinner as directed on package
2. Stir in chili and peppers
3. Spread into 13x9-inch baking dish
4. Prepare the cornbread batter as directed on package
5. Spoon evenly over chili mixture to within 1 / 2 inch of edges
6. Bake 25 to 30 minutes in preheated 375 degree oven , or until top of cornbread is golden brown and wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean
7. Serving suggestion -- a little extra shredded cheese , or some sour cream ! if you like it a little spicy , use hot chili with beans

title: bread machine pizza crust and dairy free toppings
steps:
1. Place liquid ingredients into the bread machine
2. Place flour and salt in the bread machine
3. Make a well in the top of the flour and pour in the yeast
4. Close the machine and set it to the dough setting
5. When the machine beeps and the dough is ready , sprinkle some flour on a working surface and form the dough into 2 balls
6. Flatten it while pressing from the center outwards
7. Stretch the dough while turning it
8. Once it's the right size for your preference , you are ready to put it on a pan
9. Grease a cookie sheet or pizza pan and , if desired , for a pizza shop flare , you can sprinkle a light dusting of cornmeal on the surface before placing the dough down
10. I like to stretch my dough to the edge of a cookie sheet pan and then pinch the edges up
11. Prick the dough with a fork all over
12. Drizzle small amount of olive oil over the dough
13. I spread mine around with clean fingers
14. Add toppings - pizza sauce and then whatever you want
15. We like mushrooms , diced red pepper , and diced onion
16. Be creative !
17. Top with the cheese substitute
18. Cook in a preheated 400 degree oven until the crust and cheese lightly browns
19. Serve and enjoy !

title: bubble pizza
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375 degrees
2. Separate biscuit dough into 8 biscuits
3. Cut each biscuit into 8 pieces
4. Place in medium bowl
5. Add pizza sauce , 1 cup of cheese and 10 quartered pepperoni pieces
6. Toss to coat
7. Spread mixture in ungreased oblong 2-quart glass baking dish
8. Top with remaining pepperoni and cheese
9. Bake 22 to 28 minutes or until golden brown and bubbly
10. You can customize this meal by using cooked italian sausage or ground beef instead of pepperoni
11. Add your favorite vegetables

title: missy s tacos
steps:
1. Brown ground beef and drain , put ground beef in pan and add all ingredients
2. Stir and cook on medium heat till comes to a boil , then turn down and cook on low , and serve as soon as possible
3. Toppings is whatever you like on tacos with hard or soft shells

title: fall harvest apple spiked pumpkin bread
steps:
1. To prepare pumpkin: first of all , use a smaller variety of pumpkin
2. The lighter the skin , the sweeter the taste
3. Cut the pumpkin in half and scoop out the seeds and pulp
4. Save the seeds for drying or roasting put both halves cut side down on a foil lined baking sheet , loosely cover them with foil , and pop them in the oven for about an hour at 375
5. When they're done , scoop the flesh from the skin with a spoon and mush up the yummy pumpkin goodness
6. It should keep in a refrigetator for about a week or so
7. If you've decided to just go with canned pumpkin: open the can
8. Preheat your oven to 350 degrees and ready a 9x5 inch loaf pan
9. In one bowl , combine the flour , oats , baking soda , salt , allspice , and cinnamon
10. In another bowl , combine the brown sugar , pumpkin , egg , egg white , and apple sauce until the mixture looks like bright orange mush
11. Stir the dry stuff into the wet stuff just until you don't see dry stuff anymore
12. Fold in the chopped apples
13. At this point , you can also add any solid ingredients that you think would taste good inside of a loaf of pumpkin bread
14. Pour the batter into your loaf pan and sprinkle a few pumpkin seeds on top
15. Bake in the middle oven position at 350 degrees for about an hour , turning once or twice throughout the process
16. It will look and smell done - just check it with a toothpick
17. As a precautionary measure , i recommend putting a foil-lined baking sheet on the rack below the bread so it doesn't get so much direct heat from the bottom heating element
18. When you decide that the baking process has completed , cool the bread for about 10 minutes to let the anxiety build
19. Flip the loaf out of the pan and let it cool a bit more to build up some extra anxiety
20. Enjoy your supprisingly easy to make pumpkin bread and give yourself a hug for a job well done

title: wild rice pancakes
steps:
1. Sift dry ingredients
2. Beat egg , milk and sour cream in another bowl and pour into dry ingredients and beat until smooth
3. Add butter and milk
4. Drop batter by tablespoons onto preheated , lightly-greased griddle

title: chocolate broiler cake frosting
steps:
1. Combine the butter , brown sugar , and milk in a saucepan
2. Bring to a boil
3. Remove from heat and stir in the nuts / coconut
4. Spread evenly over the top of the warm cake
5. Place cake low under a slow broiler
6. Broil until lightly toasted
7. Watch carefully
8. Cool completely in pan

title: low fat chicken divan
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Arrange cooked broccoli in greased 7x11 or 9x13 in pan with crowns facing the edges of the pan
3. Place chicken on top
4. In a small bowl , combine soup , mayo , lemon juice , and curry powder and pour on top of chicken
5. Sprinkle with cheese
6. Combine bread crumbs and margarine and sprinkle all over
7. Bake 30 minute

title: bananas  n cream bundt cake
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl , cream together shortening and sugar
2. Add eggs , one at a time , until well blended
3. Stir in vanilla and bananas
4. In a separate bowl , combine flour , baking powder , baking soda and salt
5. Add to banana mixture alternately with sour cream
6. Stir in walnuts
7. Pour into a greased and floured 10-inch bundt pan
8. Bake at 350 for 50 minutes or until cake tests done
9. Cool , then dust with confectioners' sugar before serving
10. Useful

title: bacon wrapped waterchestnuts with pineapple
steps:
1. Cut the bacon in half
2. Cut pineapple rings into chunks about the size of a waterchestnut
3. Take a half slice of bacon and wrap around one waterchestnut and one pineapple chunk
4. Secure with toothpick
5. Place in 8x8 or 9x9 pan
6. Repeat until all the bacon is gone
7. Bake at 325 degrees for 1 hours optional: stir once to distribute the rendered bacon fat which will help the bacon crisp up
8. Add the sauce and return to the oven
9. Bake 20 minutes or until sauce begins to carmelize and thicken

title: potatoes with raclette cheese and garlic
steps:
1. Wrap potatoes and whole garlic individually in foil
2. Place in a disposable baking dish
3. Cook in covered bbq , using indirect heat , following manufacturer's instructions , 30 min's or until garlic is tender , remove garlic from dish
4. Cook potatoes for a further 20-30 min's until tender
5. Cut garlic in half , squeeze out pulp into a small bowl , stir in butter and combine well
6. Partially unwrap potatoes , cut length ways down the centre , being careful not to cut all the way through potato or foil
7. Open out potatoes and cup foil around them
8. Divide butter mixture among the potatoes , top with cheese
9. Place in baking dish and return to the bbq , cook covered , using indiect heat again , for a further 15-20 min's or until cheese mealts and bubbles

title: sled dog potatoes
steps:
1. Boil potatoes in their skins till just tender and no more
2. Cool until not too warm to handle and remove skin by scraping off with paring knife
3. Slice thinly into a large casserole dish sprayed with cooking spray ,
4. In a saucepan mix together 1 cup butter , the 2 cans of soup , 1 1 / 2 cups grated cheese , green onions and sour cream
5. Stir over low heat till melted and combined
6. Pour over potatoes in dish
7. Sprinkle remaining cheese over this mess
8. In small saucepan , melt 1 / 2 cup butter and add cornflake crumbs
9. Sprinkle , , over top of casserole
10. Bake 350 30-45 minutes till bubbly
11. (

title: salami
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together
2. Refrigerate for 24 hours
3. Shape into rolls and place in baking pan
4. Bake at 300f degrees for 1 hour

title: slow cooker nacho bean dip
steps:
1. In 3 1 / 2 to 4-quart slow cooker , mix all ingredients except shredded cheese blend and tortilla chips
2. Cover
3. Cook on low heat setting 3-4 hours , stirring after 2 hours , until cheese is melted
4. Scrape down side of slow cooker with rubber spatula to help prevent edge of dip from scorching
5. Sprinkle with shredded cheese blend
6. Serve with tortilla chips
7. You can keep dip on low heat setting up to 2 hours

title: creamy chicken and bacon gorgonzola
steps:
1. 1
2. Fry bacon in a heavy skillet
3. Once bacon is done remove from skillet , crumble and set aside
4. 2
5. Add to chicken , shallot , garlic , marjoram and thyme and let chicken brown
6. Add wine and cover
7. Let simmer for 10 minutes or so untill chicken is cooked through
8. Uncover and stir in cream , gorgonzola and bacon
9. Allow gorganzola to melt
10. Serve over pasta or rice

title: cinnamon tea cake   women s weekly
steps:
1. Preheat oven 180c
2. Grease a deep 2cm round cake pan , line base with paper
3. Grease paper
4. Cream butter and essence in small bowl with electric mixer , gradually add sugar , then egg , beat until light and creamy
5. Stir in sifted flour and milk , beat lightly until smooth
6. Spread into prepared pan , bake in moderate oven 180c for about 25 minutes
7. Stand 2 mins before turning onto wire rack
8. Brush with exta butter , sprinkle with combined extra sugar and cinnamon
9. Keeping time: 1 day

title: lean lasagna
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f heat oil in large skillet
2. Saut onion for 2 minutes , then add turkey and cook an additional 5 to 7 minutes
3. Add tomato sauce , all seasonings , garlic , and mushrooms and simmer 2 minutes
4. Remove pan from heat
5. In a bowl , combine spinach , ricotta , and nutmeg
6. Bring a large pot of salted water to boil
7. Cook pasta according to package directions until al dente
8. Drain and rinse with cool water
9. Coat a 9" x 13" baking pan with cooking spray
10. Arrange 1 / 3 lasagna noodles on the bottom of the pan
11. Spread a layer of ricotta mixture , then turkey mixture , then 1 / 3 mozzarella
12. Repeat layers , ending with mozzarella
13. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until cheese bubbles
14. Cool at least 5 minutes before cutting

title: curried string   green beans
steps:
1. Saut onion in oil until lightly browned
2. Add garlic and saut briefly
3. Add remaining ingredients
4. Add water to just barely cover string beans
5. Mix well
6. Partially cover and cook on low flame for approximately 40 minutes , until string beans are tender and liquid is partially absorbed

title: super moist banana pecan cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 and grease 2 round cake pans or one large cake pan
2. Mash bananas and mix all ingredients except pecansin a large bowl
3. Use a hand mixer and beat ingredients for about 3 minutes
4. Pour batter into baking pans or into large baking pan
5. Bake for 40-50 minutes or until tester comes out somewhat dry
6. I recommend frosting this with a nice cream cheese frosting

title: lemon and garlic rice
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a pan over a medium heat
2. Add the garlic cloves and cook for 1 minute
3. Add the lemon juice and cook for a further minute
4. Add the rice to the pan and stir to coat the rice with the liquid mixture , being careful not to burn the rice
5. Add the chicken stock , stir and cover to cook , turning down the heat
6. Check on the rice while cooking to ensure it does not run out of liquid and boil dry
7. After 20 minutes , remove the lid and stir
8. The rice should still have a little too much liquid at this stage so cook uncovered until the rice is done and the liquid is all absorbed
9. Mix in the chopped fresh parsley and serve hot !

title: terrific iced tea
steps:
1. Steep tea and mint leaves in boiled spring water for 10 minutes
2. Strain
3. Zest orange and lemon rinds , avoiding the white pith
4. Squeeze the juice of the orange and lemon into a large jug , add the strained tea , fruit zest and sugar
5. Stir well to make sure sugar is dissolved
6. Chill and serve over ice
7. Hint: freeze some of this mixture into ice cubes !

title: mexican layered salad
steps:
1. In a 2-quart trifle dish or glass bowl , layer the first five ingredients
2. Combine the mayonnaise , chilies , and seasonings
3. Spread over the top of the salad
4. Sprinkle crushed chips and cheese over the top and serve immediately

title: watermelon cooler
steps:
1. Mix all but the garnish in a blender till slushy
2. Pour into 4 chilled glasses and garnish with wedges on melon

title: chocolate covered strawberry  alcoholic drink
steps:
1. In a shaker , mix the the two liquors with ice
2. Shake and strain into a chilled champagne or martini glass
3. Garnish with a real chocolate covered strawberry
4. Sit back and enjoy !

title: home style white  for the bread machine
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients according to your manufactor's directions
2. Makes one 1 1 / 2 pound loaf
3. Success hints: the honey in this recipe makes the loaf prone to a darker crust
4. Use a"light crust" setting when possible
5. This dough makes great dinner rolls
6. During kneading , dough may appear wet
7. This is normal
8. This recipe may be made using the regular and rapid bake cycles

title: peanut butter pie with fudge topping
steps:
1. For crust: generously butter 9 inch glass pie plate
2. Mix all crust ingredients in medium bowl and press into plate
3. Refrigerate 1 hour
4. For filling: beat cream cheese and peanut butter in large bowl until well blended
5. Add 1 cup icing sugar and butter and beat until fluffy
6. Beat cream in separate bowl until soft peaks form
7. Gradually add remaining 2 tblsps sugar and vanilla and beat to stiff peaks
8. Fold 1 / 3 of cream into peanut butter mixture to lighten
9. Gently fold in remainder
10. Spoon into crust
11. Refrigerate until firm , about 3 4 hours
12. For topping: melt chocolate with cream
13. Stir until smooth
14. Cool to lukewarm and spread over pie
15. Refrigerate until firm , about 3 4 hours
16. Can be prepared 1 day ahead

title: seafood trio w shrimp  scallops and crab
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Heat olive oil in heavy-bottomed sauce pan over medium-low heat
3. Add scallion and a good pinch of salt
4. Cook about 5 minutes , stirring frequently
5. Do not allow to brown
6. Add flour and stir until all oil is absorbed , forming a heavy paste
7. Cook paste for about 2 minutes , stirring constantly to avoid browning
8. Add 1 / 2 of the clam juice , stirring well to incorporate and avoid lumping
9. Add 1 / 2 of the clam juice , repeating the process
10. Stir in the wine
11. Stir in the cream
12. Add cayenne and white pepper
13. Bring sauce to a very low simmer
14. Taste sauce and adjust salt to taste
15. Test the thickness by dipping a spoon into the sauce and letting it run off
16. It should be just thick enough to coat and cling to the back of the spoon -- this is called "nappe" in classical cooking
17. If it is too thick , add a bit more clam juice or cream until you get the desired thickness , and reheat to a very low simmer
18. Add parsley and stir to incorporate
19. Preheat 2 oval ramekins by running them under hot water
20. Place 1 / 2 of shrimp in one end of each ramekin
21. Place 1 / 2 of crab in opposite end of each ramekin
22. Place 1 / 2 of scallops in the center of each ramekin
23. Pour 1 / 2 of the sauce evenly over the contents of each ramekin
24. Don't worry if the sauce wants to stick on the top -- it will run down into the seafood as the "casserole" bakes
25. If desired , you can put a thin layer of panko to the top of each ramekin
26. Bake for 20 minutes , or until the top begins to show signs of browning
27. If there is no sign of browning after 20 minutes , raise the shelf and turn your oven to broil
28. Broil for no more than 5 minutes ! this depends on your oven , and if you cook the seafood too long , you will get rubbery seafood
29. Remove from oven and allow to rest for 5 minutes before serving

title: artisan basic french bread and variations  overnight
steps:
1. Mix and knead
2. Cover and let rise 12 hours
3. Divide dough into 2 pieces
4. Shape and let rise 2-3 hours
5. Preheat oven to 425 degrees for about 30 minutes if using a baking stone
6. Slice tops
7. If you are not confident in slicing tops , slice before rising -- or dust with flour and use a very sharp knife -- you don't want the whole thing to collapse
8. For ideal results allow to rise on a pizza peel dusted with flour and make a quick transfer to stone at baking time
9. Bake at 425 degrees for about 20 minutes , with steam first 10 minutes
10. Round or boule shaped loaves will take ~ 30 minutes to bake
11. Best steaming method: put shallow pan on bottom rack and allow to preheat 10-15 minutes before baking bread
12. Pour 2 cups into pan so there will be steam throughout baking time
13. Variations:
14. Asiago or pepper cheddar: add to basic recipe 1 cup grated or cubed asiago or 1 cup grated or cubed cheddar and 1 1 / 2 t black pepper
15. Black olive and sweet red pepper: after first rising , knead in one sweet red roasted red pepper , thinkly sliced , and 1 cup coarsely chopped black olives
16. Shape into 3 round loaves and place on cookie sheets sprinkled with cornmeal
17. Let rise and bake
18. Fresh rosemary bread with olive oil: substitute q cup whole wheat flour for white flour , and add in 1 / 4 cup olive oil to dough
19. After kneading , knead in 1 / 3 celsius fresh rosemary leaves , chopped
20. Let rise overnight , shape into 2 or 3 boules , let rise and bake
21. Brush warm loaves with olive oil
22. Also good with 1 cup sunflower seeds
23. Multigrain: soak together 1 / 2 cup oatmeal , 1 / 4 cup wheat kernels , 1 / 4 cup rolled barley or wheat , 1 / 4 cup sunflower seeds , 1 t millet , 2 t molasses , 1 / 2 c more water for 20 minutes
24. Combine with 4 3 / 4 c whole wheat flour , 1 1 / 2 cups water , and 2 tsp yeast
25. Knead into the basic bread
26. Pizza crust: use 1 / 3 batch for a 14-16" round pizza , 1 / 2 batch for a rectangular pizza on a cookie sheet
27. Rye bread / rye onion bread: stir 3 / 4 cup water into 1 2 / 3 cup ry flour , let sit at least an hour
28. For onion bread , add in 1 / 2 cup chopped onion
29. Mix and knead this in after the first rising
30. Shape , let rise , and bake
31. Seeds , whole wheat , and fruit: before mixing dough , combine in a small bowl 1 t flaxseed , 1 t millet , 1 / 2 c raisins , 1 / 2 c chopped dried apricots , and 1 / 2 c chopped pitted prunes
32. Add enough hot water to just cover
33. Mix dough , subbing whole wheat flour for hal the white flour
34. Knead till smooth , then knead in seed and fruit , rained , as well as 1 / 2 c sesame seeds and 2 / 3 c cooked wheat kernels
35. Let rise overnight
36. Shape into 2 disks , 2" thick
37. Score into 6 wedges each
38. Let rise until nearly doubled
39. Bake
40. Serve warm or cold , plain or with jam or cream cheese
41. Whole wheat and barley: mix 4 3 / 4 c whole wheat flour with 1 1 / 2 cups water
42. Add 1 / 2 t year and 1 cup cooked barley to basic bread dough
43. Shape , rise , and bake
44. Great for sandwiches
45. May also add in 1 cup chopped walnuts

title: easy salsa meatloaf
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. In a large bowl , mix the ground sirloin , salsa , bread crumbs , cheese , egg , and garlic
3. Season with parsley , salt , and pepper
4. Transfer to a 5x9 inch loaf pan
5. Bake 45 minutes in the preheated oven , or to a minimum internal temperature of 160 degrees f

title: surprise meatball skewers
steps:
1. In a bowl season the ground beef using your favorite recipe
2. Divide into 12 even portions
3. Place a cheese cube inside of each mushroom cap
4. Place each mushroom cap into each hamburger mixture then shape around the mushroom and into a ball
5. Brush olive oil over the tomatoes then season with salt
6. Using wooden skewers or metal skewers alternately thread the cherry tomatoes and meatballs
7. Grill about 10-12 minutes or until meat is cooked through

title: cheddar tuna chowder
steps:
1. Put water in pan
2. Season with salt
3. Add potato , onion , carrot
4. Bring to a boil
5. Cover and simmer 10 minutes
6. Do not drain
7. In another pan , melt butter
8. Blend in flour
9. Gradually stir in milk and cook , stirring until smooth and thickened
10. Add cheese and stir until melted
11. Add vegetables and liquid , tuna corn and spices

title: italian style turkey meatloaf
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. In a large glass bowl combine all the ingredients except 1 / 2 cup of sauce
3. Mix all ingredients together well
4. Turn out and shape meat into a loaf and place in a bread pan
5. Spread remaining sauce over top of loaf
6. Bake for 1 hour or until the internal temp reaches 165 degrees

title: crab fettuccine
steps:
1. Drain crabmeat , remove any bits of shell
2. Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat
3. Add pressed garlic and saut until tender
4. Stir in half and half , and bring to a boil
5. Reduce heat and simmer , stirring occasionally , 5 to 7 minutes or until mixture is thickened
6. Add crabmeat , hot cooked pasta , parmesan cheese , chopped parsley , and pepper , tossing gently
7. Serve immediately

title: chicken kiev
steps:
1. In a small bowl , blend butter , parsley , tarragon , chives , garlic salt and pepper
2. Shape into a 4-inch square on aluminum foil
3. Wrap and freeze until firm , 30-40 minutes
4. Place chicken breasts between two pieces of plastic wrap
5. Pound to 1 / 4-inch thickness
6. Cut frozen butter square into 12 pieces
7. Place 1 piece of butter in the center of each chicken breast
8. Fold chicken over butter , making sure butter is sealed completely inside chicken
9. Fasten with wooden picks
10. Roll chicken in flour
11. Dip in beaten eggs and coat with bread crumbs
12. Repeat
13. Heat 3-4 inches of vegetable oil in deep fryer to 340f
14. Fry chicken , 3 pieces at a time , until deep golden brown , about 8 minutes , turning if necessary
15. Drain

title: fluffy lemonade gelatin
steps:
1. Dissolve gelatin in boiling water and stir in lemonade until dissolved
2. Chill until partially set- about 2 hours
3. Whisk in whipped topping
4. Pour into a 13-in
5. X 9-in
6. X 2-in
7. Dish
8. Chill until firm

title: thai shrimp fried rice with pineapple
steps:
1. Prepare rice by crumbling it with your fingers , breaking up the bigger lumps , and set it aside in a bowl
2. Heat wok or large , deep skillet over high heat
3. Add oil until it sizzles , and then add garlic and onion and toss well until shiny and fragrant , about 1 minute add shrimp and cook , tossing now and then , until the onion begins to wilt and shrimp are pink and cooked through , 2-3 minute
4. Add rice , fish sauce , and sugar and toss well
5. Add pineapple and green onion and cook about 2 min more , tossing often , until rice is tender and heated through
6. Serve hot or warm

title: six layer casserole
steps:
1. Partially cook sausage and drain off fat
2. Place sausage in 2 quart casserole and cover with layers of rice , potatoes , onions and carrots
3. Add tomatoes with juice
4. Add tomato juice until it comes up about half-way on the layers
5. Combine salt , pepper and sugar and sprinkle over top
6. Cover casserole and bake at 350 degrees for 1 1 / 2 to 2 hours
7. Add some water or tomato juice while cooking if casserole seems too dry

title: jamaican style chicken
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients , except the chicken in a bowl
2. Mix well , until smooth
3. Place chicken pieces in zip-lock bag
4. Pour sauce mixture over chicken & close the bag
5. Lay flat on a plate or whatever you have
6. Refridgerate for at least 4hours -- overnight is preferred , for best flavor
7. Turn bag over , every couple hours if possible
8. Preheat oven to 350
9. Lightly coat a 9 x 13 pan with cooking spray
10. Place chicken in a single layer in the pan
11. Pour remaining sauce over all
12. Bake , uncovered , 1 to 1 hours

title: easy cream cheese pound cake
steps:
1. Cream butter , cream cheese& sugar together
2. Beat until fluffy
3. Gradually add eggs
4. Beat a couple of seconds between adding eggs
5. Gradually add flour
6. Add vanilla , mix well
7. Grease pan well
8. Sprinkle flour into the greased pan so that a light film of flour covers the entire inside of the pan
9. Do not preheat oven !
10. Bake 1 hour at 300
11. Increase oven temperature to 325 and bake an additional 25 minutes
12. Let cake cool
13. Put on cake plate and cover with foil to hold in the moisture

title: gluten free meatloaf
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Combine contents of stuffing mix with the milk , egg and worcestershire sauce and set aside
3. Saute onion and garlic in oil , when translucent and soft add half to stuffing mixture , retainind other half for sauce topping
4. Remove sausagemeat from the skins and add to the minced beef , mix well until all meat is combined
5. Add to the stuffing and onion mix , blend well
6. Press into a loaf tin or four individual tins
7. Prepare mustard to maufacturers instructions , add to ketchup and bbq sauce
8. Return remaining onion an garlic to the heat and gently stir in the sugar
9. When the sugar has melted add ketchup mix and cover the meat with sauce
10. Place tin or tins carefully in a ban-marie and bake for 45mins
11. Serve hot or cold

title: kittencal s spaghetti pie
steps:
1. Grease a round 2-quart casserole dish or an 11 x 7-inch baking dish
2. For the sauce
3. In a skillet or saucepan brown the ground beef with onion and red chili flakes until no longer pink
4. Drain fat then add in garlic , oregano and basil
5. Cook for 2 minutes
6. Add in tomato sauce , mushrooms and 1 / 2 teaspoon salt , bring to a boil over medium heat stirring
7. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 30-40 minutes stirring occasionally , season with more salt to taste if desired
8. Meanwhile cook the spaghetti in boiling water until almost tender drain in a colander then rinse under cold water , drain well again then place into a large bowl
9. Add in melted butter , garlic powder , eggs , 1 / 2 cup parmesan cheese and black pepper
10. Using clean hands toss / mix until well combined season with salt to taste if desired
11. To assemble
12. Spread the spaghetti mixture evenly into bottom of the pie plate , pressing down with hands to flatten
13. In a bowl mix 2 cups cottage cheese with 1 / 4 cup parmesan and 1 cup mozzarella cheese cheese then spread over the spaghetti
14. Dollop the tomato sauce mixture over the cottage cheese then spread out with a spoon
15. Top with 1 cup or more of mozzarella cheese
16. Cover with foil and bake at 350f for 30 minutes
17. Uncover and continue to bake 10-15 minutes more or until hot and bubbly

title: granny doria s rhubarb pie
steps:
1. Beat first 6 ingredients until smooth
2. Add rhubarb to the mixture
3. Sprinkle 1 t
4. Flour and 1 t
5. Sugar on the bottom of the crust
6. Add rhubarb mixture to the pie crust
7. Make lattice strips with the 2nd pie crust
8. Top with lattice
9. Bake at 450 degrees for 10 minute then bake at 350 for about 30 minutes

title: chocolate fudge shake
steps:
1. Pour milk into blender and then add the remaining ingredients
2. Cover and blend 15 seconds or until smooth
3. Thin with additional milk , if desired

title: fire   ice pineapple bits
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , combine sugar , salt , and chile , pressing with the back of a spoon until mixed
2. Stir in the pineapple and refrigerate for at least 2 hours or up to 1 day

title: 100   whole wheat bread
steps:
1. In saucepan , heat milk not to boiling
2. Remove from heat and add sugar , salt and 1 / 4 cup butter , stir until blended
3. Cool to lukewarm
4. Sprinkle yeast over water in large bowl
5. Stir to dissolve yeast- stir in lukewarm milk mixture
6. Add 4 cups whole wheat flour , beat vigorously with wooden spoon until smooth
7. Gradually add remainder of whole wheat flour
8. Mix in last of it with hands until dough is stiff turn dough out onto lightly floured surface
9. Knead dough for about 5 minutes until dough is smooth and has some elasticity
10. Place in greased large bowl
11. Turn dough so greased side is up
12. Cover with towel
13. Let rise in warm place , until it doubles in size , about an hour
14. Turn dough again on floured surface
15. Divide into halves
16. Cover about 10 minutes
17. Cut each of the two halves into two pieces
18. Roll each piece into about a 12 inch strip
19. Twist two strips together
20. Repeat the process
21. Roll into a ball to fit into a 9x5x2-3 / 4 greased pan
22. Mold evenly into pan
23. Repeat process with remaining two pieces
24. Brush tops of two loaves with a little butter , margarine or oil
25. Let the two loaves rise in a warm place until dough rises to tops of pans- about an hour
26. Preheat oven 400f
27. Bake in middle of oven for 35- 40 minutes
28. Turn out pans onto racks , brush top with melted butter
29. Makes 2 loaves

title: spinach gruyere tart
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 200c / 400f
2. Heat oil in a small pan and cook onion for 4 minutes till soft
3. Remove from heat
4. Place the spinach in a large pan with only the water that clings to the leaves
5. Heat gently until wilted , cool , then squeeze out the excess moisture
6. Roll out pastry or use frozen slices , cut into desired shape and spread pesto sauce on the pastry
7. In a bowl put grated cheese onion , egg , salt and pepper and spinach and mix
8. Place in the centre of the pastry and pinch or fold up around the edges and sprinkle the reserved cheese on top
9. Bake in the oven for 15-20 minutes until golden

title: kiwi and grape drink
steps:
1. Push kiwi's through the juicer first followed by the grapes
2. Pour into a glass , garnish with some grapes and a kiwi slice skewered on a wooden stick

title: green pea soup
steps:
1. Heat olive oil in a large pot over low-med
2. Heat
3. Add onion , cover and cook until onions are softened about 5 minutes then add broth , salt , a few turns of freshly ground black pepper and the tarragon , bring to a boil
4. Add the frozen peas and cook until they are defrosted
5. In a blender , puree the soup in 2 batches until very smooth
6. Return to the pot and just simmer
7. Ladle into bowls while hot and finish off by puttin a swirl of smooth yogurt on top
8. Or , you can put in the fridge and chill - if you like cold soup
9. I serve oyster crachers or saltines with it or better yet ? a nice crusty piece of bread
10. And butter oh well your choice

title: shrimp   garlic w  white wine
steps:
1. In a large skillet over medium heat , melt butter
2. Add garlic and saute 2 minutes
3. Add shrimp and saute until shrimp turn pink and curl , 2-3 minutes
4. Season with salt and pepper and remove to a warm platter
5. Add wine and lemon juice to skillet , bring to a boil , and boil for 1 minute
6. Reduce heat , return shrimp and parsley to pan , and heat through
7. Transfer to serving platter , garnish with parsley sprigs and serve at once

title: roasted acorn squash with spinach and gruyere
steps:
1. Rinse the squash and cut each in half lenghthwise: scoop out and discard seeds
2. Place squash halves , cut side down , in a 10-by-15 inch pan
3. Bake in a 400 degree regular or convection oven until squash is just tender when pierced , 25 to 30 minutes
4. Meanwhile , squeeze moisture from spinach
5. In a bowl , mix spinach , 3 / 4 cup cheese and walnuts
6. Season to taste with salt and pepper
7. With tongs or a spatula , turn squash halves over and spoon spinach mixture equally into cavities of squash
8. Sprinkle with remaining 1 / 4 cup cheese
9. Return squash to oven and bake until cheese melts and filling is hot in the center , 15 to 20 minutes , serve

title: onion salad or hors d  oeuvre   oignons marines
steps:
1. Roughly chop and mix all sauce ingredients and cook 30-45 minutes or until soft
2. Put through a sieve or in a blender , i like the blender because i like to leave the sauce small lumpy , do not liquefy
3. Peel the onions and put in a stockpot with the sauce and all the other ingredients except the sugar
4. Add barely enough water to cover
5. Stir and bring to boil
6. Reduce to simmer , taste
7. Add sugar , a teaspoonful at a time , to counteract the acidity of the tomatoes and vinegar , the dish should taste slightly sharp , not unpleasantly sour
8. Simmer uncovered for about 1 hour
9. If onions are not tender , replace lid and cook until they are
10. It should finish fairly thick , if watery , boil briskly , uncovered to evaporate excess moisture
11. Serve hot or cold with dinner or cold as a hors d' oeuvre

title: koftit roz  rice meatballs
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Puree the sauce ingredients in blender / food processor
3. Combine together together all the kofta ingredients in a large bowl
4. Ball your kofta into 1
5. 5 inch balls and place in a 9in x 9in oven safe pan
6. Pour sauce over kofta and cook in oven for 45-60 minutes turning once

title: moorish zucchini salad   ensalada de calabacines a la morisco
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat
2. Add the garlic and then let cook until golden to flavor the oil , then remove and discard
3. Add the zucchinis and cook , stirring until just tender
4. Immediately remove from the skillet and transfer to a large serving bowl
5. Add the pine nuts , raisins , mint , lemon juice and salt and pepper to taste and stir together
6. Taste and add more oil , lemon juice and seasonings if necessary
7. Set aside and let cool completely
8. Cover and chill for at least 3 hours
9. Remove from refrigerator 10 minutes before serving
10. Cooks
11. This salad is best made with young , tender zucchinis no more than 1 inch thick
12. If using older , larger zucchinis , cut them in half or quarter lenghtwise first , then slice thinly
13. For a more robust flavor , chop 4 drained anchovy fillets in oil and add in step 2

title: retro russian  tea
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients and put into a sealed jar
2. The longer it sets , the better it gets
3. To serve , use 2 teaspoons of tea mix to a cup of boiling water
4. Add 1 teaspoon rum and enjoy !

title: french gateau marjolaine  marjolaine cake
steps:
1. For the meringue nut cake: preheat oven to very hot 450f
2. In separate pans or pie plates put 1 1 / 2 cups blanched almonds and 1 full cup skinned hazelnuts
3. Bake in the hot oven for 20 minutes , or until brown , shaking pans occasionally
4. Remove from oven and cool
5. Grind 1 cup at a time in an electric blender on high speed for about 5 seconds , and empty into a bowl
6. Mix ground nuts with 1 1 / 2 cups sugar
7. Reduce oven to very slow 250f
8. Beat until stiff: 8 egg whites , a pinch of salt , and 1 / 4 teaspoon cream of tartar
9. Gradually fold in the sugar nut mixture
10. Line baking sheets with waxed paper or parchment paper and butter paper lightly
11. On it mark 4 bands about 12 inches long and 4 inches wide
12. Spread these bands thickly with the meringue nut mixture , and bake in the slow oven for about 30 minutes , or until crusty on top , but still pliable
13. Invert on waxed paper , and carefully remove waxed paper from bottom of bands
14. Cool
15. For the chocolate wafers: melt: 6 ounces semisweet chocolate pieces over hot water
16. Cut circles 2 1 / 2 inches in diameter from waxed paper or parchment paper and spread these rounds with a thin coating of the melted chocolate
17. Place rounds on a cookie sheet and chill in refrigerator
18. For the butter cream: in saucepan combine: 1 cup sugar , 1 / 3 cup water , and 1 / 8 teaspoon cream of tartar
19. Bring to a boil and boil rapidly to 240f on a candy thermometer , or until syrup spins a long thread
20. Gradually in a thin stream pour the hot syrup into 8 egg yolks beating all the time , and continue to beat until the mixture is cool and thick
21. When cool beat in bit by bit 1 1 / 2 cups sweet butter
22. This makes 1 quart butter cream
23. Measure 1 cup of the butter cream and flavor it with 1 teaspoon vanilla
24. Measure a second cup and flavor it with 1 / 4 cup praline powder
25. Melt: 3 ounces semisweet chocolate pieces with 1 tablespoon water and stir into remaining butter cream
26. Chill all 3 flavored creams until firm enough to spread
27. Praline powder: in a saucepan combine: 3 / 4 cup sugar , 1 / 4 cup water , 1 / 4 teaspoon cream of tartar , and 1 / 2 cup blanched almonds
28. Cook without stirring until mixture is color of dark molasses
29. Pour onto oiled cookie sheet and let cool
30. Detach the praline from sheet with pancake turner and break into pieces
31. Blend half at a time in container of an electric blender for about 20 seconds , or until ground to a fine powder
32. Store in refrigerator in a tightly closed container
33. Makes a bout 3 / 4 cup
34. Presentation: place a meringue band on a serving plate and spread with the vanilla cream
35. Top with second meringue band and spread with half the chocolate cream
36. Top with the third meringue band and spread with praline cream
37. Top with fourth meringue band
38. Frost sides with remaining chocolate cream and sprinkle top heavily with confectioners sugar
39. Carefully peel waxed paper from bottom of the chocolate wafers and decorate the sides of the cake by overlapping the wafers all the way around
40. Serves 10
41. A treasury of great recipes by mary and vincent price

title: frosty m m pie  or toffee bits  butterfingers  etc   no bake
steps:
1. In a large mixing bowl , beat cream cheese and sugar until smooth
2. Beat in cream until blended
3. Fold in whipped topping
4. Crush m&m's in a food processer or put them in two ziplock and roll over them with a rolling pin
5. Fold candies into previous mixture
6. Spoon mixture into crust
7. Sprinkle with extra candies
8. Cover and freeze over night
9. Remove from freezer 10 min before serving time

title: fabulous chicken marinade for bbq
steps:
1. Blend all in cuisinart or blender
2. Pour over raw chicken and allow to marinate in the refrigerator , preferably overnight
3. Remove chicken from marinade and discard marinade
4. Grill chicken until cooked through

title: passover brisket by emeril
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 500 degrees f
2. Using a paring knife and your finger , stuff brisket all over with garlic
3. Place brisket in a baking dish or casserole and bake until browned on top , remove from oven , turn brisket and return to oven until browned on both sides
4. Reduce oven temperature to 350 degrees f
5. Add enough beef stock to casserole to come up 1 inch on sides , cover with foil and bake one hour
6. While brisket is cooking , heat a large skillet over medium high heat and saute onions in vegetable oil , stirring occasionally , until caramelized and most liquid has evaporated , about 20 minutes
7. Set onions aside
8. Remove brisket from oven after one hour and add caramelized onions and all remaining ingredients , moving meat around to combine ingredients
9. Cover and continue to bake until very tender but not falling apart , another 2 to 3 hours
10. Remove brisket to a carving board and slice
11. Strain reserved cooking liquids and pour over sliced brisket
12. Brisket may be returned to casserole dish and allowed to cool , then served the next day

title: limoncello   lemoncella
steps:
1. Wash the lemons well with a vegetable brush and hot water to remove any residue of pesticides or wax
2. Pat the lemons dry
3. Using a vegetable peeler , peel the lemons
4. If you do get some of the pith with the zest , carefully scrape it away with the
5. Fill the jar with one bottle of the vodka and the zest
6. Cover the jar and let it sit forty days at room temperature in a dark cabinet
7. Combine the sugar and water in a saucepan , bring it to a boil and cook until thickened , about five minutes
8. Let the syrup cool before adding it to the limoncello mixture , along with the other bottle of vodka
9. Cover and return to the cupboard for another 40 days
10. Strain the limoncello into bottles and discard the lemon zest
11. Store them in a cupboard or the freezer

title: roast turkey with sage and thyme
steps:
1. Remove and discard giblets and neck from turkey
2. Rinse turkey with cold water , and pat dry with paper towels
3. Loosen skin from turkey breast without totally detaching skin
4. Stir together 2 tablespoons , butter , salt and pepper
5. Rub butter mixture evenly over turkey breast under skin
6. Carefully place sage leaves and thyme sprigs evenly on each side of breat under skin
7. Replace skin
8. Place pear halves , celery , onion , and garlic inside cavity
9. Place turkey breast side up , on a lightly greased wire rack in an aluminum foil lined shallow roasting pan
10. Rub entire turkey evenly with remaining 2 tablespoons butter
11. Bake at 325f for 2 hours and 45 minutes to 3 hours and 30 minutes or until a meat thermometer inserted in thigh reads 180f basting turkey every 30 minutes with pan drippings
12. Remove turkey from roasting pan , and let sand 20 minutes before slicing
13. Garnish

title: spicy pineapple rice
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan , saut shallot and garlic in the olive oil until translucent , approximately 5 minutes
2. Add curry powder
3. Pour in rice and stir constantly until rice is opaque and begins to brown
4. Pour in pineapple juice , water and coconut
5. Bring to a boil
6. Add crushed red pepper and reduce heat to low
7. Simmer 25 minutes or until rice is a desired doneness
8. Add pineapple chunks
9. Fluff with fork

title: saucy steak pocket pies  a1
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Cut defrosted puff pastry into 8 squares
3. Line 8 holes in cupcake pan with puff pastry
4. Bake puff pastry for 10-12 minutes until set
5. While oven is preheating amd puff pastry is baking , heat a skillet on medium-high heat
6. Add butter
7. Season steak with salt and pepper
8. Sear steak on each side 2-3 minutes , depending on thickness
9. Remove steak from pan and let rest on plate
10. Add wine to skillet and scrape up bits on pan
11. Add mushrooms and sautee for 8-10 minutes until the mushrooms have soaked up most of the liquid
12. Remove from heat
13. Remove puff pastry from oven to cool slightly
14. Slice steak into bite sized pieces
15. Add steak , mushrooms , fresh spinach , and a-1 to a bowl and stir
16. The cold spinach should wilt and cool off the mixture
17. Crumble goat cheese into mixture
18. Fill the puff pastry cups with steak mixture and bake for 5 minutes to heat through
19. Remove from oven and enjoy !

title: bahama mama banana rum cake
steps:
1. To make the glaze
2. Combine the butter , water , and sugars in a heavy-bottomed saucepan over medium-high heat and bring to a boil
3. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for 5 minutes
4. Remove from heat and stir in the rum
5. Set aside and keep warm
6. To make the cake
7. Position a rack in the middle of the oven and heat to 350f spray a 10-cup tube pan with nonstick cooking spray
8. Sprinkle the pecans in the bottom of the pan and set aside
9. In a large bowl , use an electric mixer to beat together the butter and sugars until light and fluffy
10. One by one , beat in the eggs , taking care to mix well between each addition
11. Beat in the mashed bananas , vanilla , and rum
12. Sift the flour , baking soda , baking powder , and salt over the batter and fold in using a rubber spatula , just until no streaks of flour remain
13. Fold in the sour cream
14. Spoon the batter into the pan and spread to the pan using the back of a rubber spatula
15. Bake about 60-80 minutes , or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean
16. Transfer to a wire rack and allow to cool for 5 minutes
17. Use a wooden skewer to poke holes all over the cake and pour 1 / 4 cup glaze over the cake
18. Allow to cool for 5 more minutes
19. Place a serving platter over the pan and invert to release the cake
20. Spoon the remaining glaze over the cake , little by little , and let stand until the glaze is completely absorbed by the cake
21. If the glaze starts to pool at the base of the cake , use a small metal spatual to spread it up and around the sides of the cake
22. As the glaze cools , it will form a rummy , sugary shell
23. Allow to cool completely before serving

title: woodlawn ginger cakes
steps:
1. Beat butter and shortening until soft
2. Slowly add and beat in the 2 cups of granulated sugar
3. Beat in the eggs and molasses
4. In a second bowl sift flour , baking soda , cinnamon , cloves and ginger
5. Add to creamed mixture , mixing well
6. Dough will be soft
7. Refrigerate for about 1 hour or until dough is firm
8. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
9. Roll dough into 1-inch balls the roll each in the coarse sugar
10. Place balls about 3 inches apart on lightly greased cookie sheets
11. Bake 10-12 minutes , or until slightly cracked on top
12. Watch carefully toward the end of the cooking time so they don't burn on the bottom
13. Cool slightly and remove to a wire rack to cool completely

title: sugar free blueberry pie
steps:
1. Recipe says make enough pastry dough for a 9 inch double crust pie then put it in the refrigerator over night
2. This will make the crust much more flaky and it will roll out easier
3. Pre heat at 400 degrees
4. Mix together egg and water to make a egg wash
5. This will give the crust a rich golden brown color when baked
6. Mix together in a bowl blueberries , splenda , flour , cinnamon , allspice , salt , then pour into prepared pie crust
7. Drizzle lemon juice over mixture then drop butter on top of mixture
8. Add top crust , cut slits in top to vent and brush with egg wash
9. Cut slits in top crust to vent and bake for 45-50 minutes
10. Cool at least 2 hours before serving

title: rainbow cookies 7 layer
steps:
1. Beat eggs , add melted butter , almond extract , sugar , and flour
2. In 3 bowls , evenly divide batter
3. Leave 1 bowl white , 1 bowl red , and 1 bowl green
4. Place each batter in a very shallow pan-seperately
5. Bake at 350 for 10-12 minutes- approximately
6. Put red layer on top of wax paper
7. Spread raspberry preserves on layer
8. Take white layer , place on top of the red layer and spread preserves
9. Take the green layer , place it on the white
10. Spread the melted chocolate chips on the top
11. Place in the freezer , just long enough for the chocolate to harden
12. When hardend , take out and do the same on the other side
13. Take out carefully and slice into bars
14. Whole pieces can be frozen and sliced when needed
15. While the 1st side of the bar is hardening , you can start the whole process over because you will have enough batter and melted chips for a 2nd bar of cookies
16. Also add some oil to melting chocolate chips to keep it from clumping together

title: bar cookies
steps:
1. Beat the cake mix briefly with the egg and butter , until just blended
2. Press into 9 x 13 inch pan , lightly coated with vegetable spray
3. Sprinkle the nuts and chocolate chips on top and lightly press into first layer
4. Beat together confectioner's sugar , eggs , and cream cheese
5. Spoon over top , spreading mixture evenly to edges
6. Bake 1 hour to 1 hour and 15 minutes at 350 degrees , or until top is puffed and as brownded as you like
7. Cool and cut into bars

title: fooler chicken
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease a shallow baking dish with cooking spray
3. In one bowl , stir together the cornflake crumbs , breadcrumbs , salt , garlic powder , onion powder and paprika
4. In another bowl , whisk together the evaporated milk , egg , lemon juice and butter using a fork
5. Dip the chicken pieces in flour , and shake off the
6. Excess
7. Dip into the milk batter , then into the crumb mixture
8. Place pieces in a single layer in the greased baking dish
9. Spray the top of the chicken with cooking spray
10. Bake uncovered for 1 hour in the preheated oven , until nicely browned , and juices run clear

title: bananas foster milkshake
steps:
1. In a blender , combine the banana , caramel sauce , cinnamon , rum , and milk and blend until smooth
2. Add the ice cream and blend until incorporated
3. Pour into a tall glass , and garnish with a dollop of whipped cream , a few slices of banana and a drizzle of caramel sauce
4. Serve immediately !

title: emeril s strawberry crumb pie
steps:
1. In the bowl of a food processor combine butter and cream cheese and process until smooth
2. Add flour and salt and process just until mixture comes together to form a ball
3. Remove dough from the processor and shape into a disk , wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate for at least 1 hour
4. While the pie crust is chilling , prepare the crumb topping
5. Combine the 1 / 3 cup sugar , 1 / 2 cup flour , and the oatmeal in a small bowl and toss to combine
6. Add the melted butter and stir until thoroughly incorporated
7. Refrigerate until thoroughly chilled
8. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
9. Working on a lightly floured work surface , roll out dough out to a thickness of 1 / 8-inch and fit it into a 9 or 10-inch tart pan with a removable bottom
10. Return pie crust to the refrigerator for 20 minutes , then blind bake until lightly golden , about 18 minutes
11. Remove and transfer to a wire rack to cool while you assemble the strawberry filling
12. Increase the oven temperature to 375 degrees f
13. In a mixing bowl combine the strawberries with the sugar , lemon juice , and cornstarch and toss to combine
14. Spoon the strawberry filling into the prepared piecrust and spread the crumb topping evenly over the top of the filling
15. Bake in the middle of the oven for 1 hour , or until filling is bubbly and crust and crumb topping are golden brown
16. Transfer to a rack to cool to room temperature before serving

title: roxstarbakes cut out sugar cookie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. Sift dry ingredients and set aside
3. Beat butter and sugar until light in color
4. Add egg , milk and vanilla until just combined
5. Gradually add flour on low speed and then beat until dough becomes a ball
6. Now add chocolate chips until just combined /
7. Divide the dough into 2 , wrap , and refrigerate dough for 2 hours to overnight
8. Role to inch thick
9. Make sure the dough isnt sticking to the surface
10. Bake 7 minutes rotating half way

title: sin free  fries
steps:
1. Cut the potato into fries as usual and then boil them for a few minutes in salted water
2. Drain them then shake them in the pan to "rough" up the surfaces
3. Spray a baking sheet with cooking spray and spread the potatoes on it
4. Spray some more cooking spray on the potatoes
5. Cook them in a fairly hot oven , around 200-220c until they are nice and crispy , turning at least once

title: skillet burgers
steps:
1. Brown ground beef
2. Add onion and celery and cook till tender but not brown
3. Add remaining ingredients and simmer uncovered for 30 minutes
4. Serve on buns

title: almost no knead bread 2 0
steps:
1. Whisk flour , yeast , and salt in large bowl
2. Add water , beer , and vinegar
3. Using rubber spatula , fold mixture , scraping up dry flour from bottom of bowl until shaggy ball forms
4. Cover bowl with plastic wrap and let sit at room temperature for 8 to 18 hours
5. Lay 12- by 18-inch sheet of parchment paper inside 10-inch skillet and spray with nonstick cooking spray
6. Transfer dough to lightly floured work surface and knead 10 to 15 times
7. Shape dough into ball by pulling edges into middle
8. Transfer dough , seam-side down , to parchment-lined skillet and spray surface of dough with nonstick cooking spray
9. Cover loosely with plastic wrap and let rise at room temperature until dough has doubled in size and does not readily spring back when poked with finger , about 2 hours
10. About 30 minutes before baking , adjust oven rack to lowest position , place 6- to 8-quart heavy-bottomed dutch oven on rack , and heat oven to 500 degrees
11. Lightly flour top of dough and , using razor blade or sharp knife , make one 6-inch-long , 1 / 2-inch-deep slit along top of dough
12. Carefully remove pot from oven and remove lid
13. Pick up dough by lifting parchment overhang and lower into pot
14. Cover pot and place in oven
15. Reduce oven temperature to 425 degrees and bake covered for 30 minutes
16. Remove lid and continue to bake until loaf is deep brown and instant-read thermometer inserted into center registers 200 degrees , 20 to 30 minutes longer
17. Carefully remove bread from pot
18. Transfer to wire rack and cool to room temperature , about 2 hours

title: bloody mary dip
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together in a food processor
2. Add horseradish , lemon juice , tabasco sauce and salt and pepper to taste

steps:
1. In a saucepan , combine the tomatoes , basil , vinegar , olive oil , mustard and salt and pepper
2. Heat thoroughly bring to a simmer
3. Immediately remove from heat
4. Slice the avocados and place on the soft lettuce on individual salad plates
5. Spoon on the warm vinaigrette and serve immediately

title: garlic parmesan cream sauce over pasta
steps:

4. Mix in flour until combined

6. Add parmesan and stir until melted
7. Serve over pasta , and top with green onions

title: japanese crumbed pork with dipping sauce
steps:
1. Pound pork gently with a meat mallet
2. Toss in flour , shake off excess
3. Dip pork in combined egg and water , then dip into panko flakes and coat each side
4. Soak cabbage in iced water for 5 minutes to crisp , drain

6. Skim oil occasionally during cooking to remove any crumbs
7. Drain pork on absorbent paper and cut diagonally into 2 cm slices
8. To serve: place cabbage on a serving plate and arrange pork on top
9. Serve with lemon wedges , mustard and tonkatsu sauce

title: thai turkey
steps:
1. In a small bowl mix garlic , soy sauce , cilantro , honey , curry powder , sesame oil , cornstarch , crushed red pepper , and water until well blended
2. In a 10 inch skillet over high heat , warm the salad oil
3. Cook the green onions and red pepper , stirring frequently until the vegetables are tender and golden
4. Stir in liquid mixture and turkey meat and cook , stirring to coat turkey well , until heated through
5. Serve over cooked rice and garnish with more cilantro if you wish

steps:

3. Tender but still firm , 10 to 12 minutes

title: chocolate   gingernut ripple cake
steps:
1. Beat milo and cream together until stiff peaks form
2. Spread 1 side of a biscuit with milo mixture and sandwich together to another biscuit
3. Place on a tray
4. Spread another biscuit with mixture and sandwich to the first 2 , and continue with remaining biscuits to create a log shape
5. Optional: dip each biscuit briefly in liqueur or milk before speading with milo mixture
6. Using a flat knife , spread remaining milo mixture over log to cover
