title: new england kedgeree
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients to the hot rice and reheat for a few minutes
2. Serve at once

title: sweet vanilla milk
steps:
1. Pour milk into a glass , then add vanilla extract
2. Mix in sugar substitute
3. Enjoy cold or warm it in the microwave

title: kuwaiti chicken and rice with daqoos   garlic tomato sauce
steps:
1. Rinse chicken inside and out
2. Place in a stockpot with enough water to cover
3. Add cinnamon stick , cardamom pods , cloves , peppercorns , juice of 1 / 2 lemon and salt to taste
4. Bring to a boil skimming as required , continue to simmer partially covered until chicken is done
5. Remove and drain the chicken , reserving broth though a strainer
6. Prepare basmati rice according to it's package directions , using broth from chicken instead of water
7. Add turmeric for colour and salt to taste
8. While the rice is cooking , cook the onions in a skillet over medium heat , with 2 tablespoons olive oil , until soft
9. Sprinkle with a little water and stir quickly until onions are brown and the water has evaporated
10. Stir in drained raisins , pine nuts , sliced blanched almonds if using , teaspoons bahrat and loomi powder
11. Cook for one minute
12. Remove mixture from skillet and set aside
13. Lightly dust the boiled , drained chicken with flour
14. In a clean skillet over medium-high heat , brown the chicken in 1 tbs
15. Olive oil , turning , until the outside is crispy and brown
16. For the tomato sauce , add water , chopped tomatoes , crushed garlic , tomato paste , salt , sugar and the rest of bahrat in a small saucepan , saut until tomatoes are soft and the sauce is well blended
17. When the rice is done , spread it on a serving platter
18. Sprinkle the onion mixture over the rice , and place the chicken on top
19. Pass the tomato garlic sauce to spoon onto individual plates

title: silky cauliflower soup with parmesan crisps
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
2. Remove the leaves and thick core from the cauliflower , coarsely chop , and reserve
3. Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan or soup pot over medium heat and add the onion and garlic
4. Cook until softened , but not browned , about 5 minutes
5. Add the cauliflower and stock and bring to a boil
6. Reduce the heat to a simmer , cover , and cook until the cauliflower is very soft and falling apart , about 15 minutes
7. Remove from heat and , using a hand held immersion blender , puree the soup , or puree in small batches in a blender and return it to the pot
8. Add the parmesan and stir until smooth
9. Season , to taste , with salt and black pepper
10. Keep warm until ready to serve
11. Meanwhile , make the parmesan crisps:
12. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil
13. Spread the shredded cheese over the foil in 1 even thin layer
14. Bake about 10 minutes until golden brown and crisps
15. Remove from oven and let cool 5 minutes
16. Break sheet of crisp cheese into large pieces and garnish each soup bowl with a couple shards and a pinch of fresh chives

title: good for you easy breakfast pizza
steps:
1. Set toaster oven on to broil
2. Divide cottage cheese onto each side of toasted english muffin
3. Top with tomato & mushrooms , season to taste
4. Place under broiler until cheese begins to bubble & veggies are softened
5. Serve immediately

title: coconut cloud brownies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Butter an 8 inch square baking pan
3. Sift together flour , sugar , baking powder and salt and stir in eggs and butter
4. Transfer 2 / 3s of batter to another bowl , add the chocolate to it , combining the batter well , and turn the chocolate batter into prepared pan
5. Stir the coconut and extract into remaining batter
6. Spoon coconut batter over chocolate batter and spread decoratively
7. Bake for 30-35 minutes , or until coconut topping is light golden
8. Let cool in pan on rack and cut into 2 inch squares

title: maine blueberry compote
steps:
1. Mix blueberries into the cottage cheese and drizzle the maple syrup on the top
2. Serve in an ice cream dish
3. Best when using small low bush berries that are slightly tart

title: cheesy bbq biscuit cups
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. In large skillet coated with olive oil , brown meat , onion and green pepper
3. Drain , and add tomato sauce , brown sugar , mustard and black pepper
4. Simmer for 5 minutes
5. Place each biscuit in a sprayed muffin cup , pressing dough up sides , to the edge of cups
6. Evenly spoon mixture into the muffin cups
7. Bake 10-15 minutes or until golden brown
8. Sprinkle the cheese and bake 2-3 minutes or until cheese has melted

title: romeri s gnocchi   sauce
steps:
1. Mix all gnocchi ingredients in a food processor
2. Mix until a dough ball is formed
3. Place on a floury cutting board and knead into a firm consistency
4. Cut a small hunk off and hand roll out to a long thin strip
5. Cut the strip into small bite size pieces and place on a tray covered with waxed paper and flour
6. When the tray is full you can add another layer of waxed paper and flour and continue
7. They can then be frozen right on the trays covered with foil or cooked right away
8. Fresh or frozen , place them in boiling salted water like any pasta
9. Cook until tender - do not overcook
10. To make the sauce , cook chopped garlic in olive oil
11. Add tomatoes and basil
12. Cook until tomatoes are thick and sauce like
13. This needs to simmer only 30-45 minutes at the most
14. Rinse pasta , cover with sauce and parmesan cheese and enjoy

title: apple cider oatmeal
steps:
1. In a microwave-safe bowl , combine oats and cider
2. Microwave , uncovered on high for 1-2 minutes
3. Stir in the butter , cinnamon and salt
4. Serve

title: green salad with apples  peanuts and warm mustard dressing
steps:
1. Dressing:
2. Beat the eggs well
3. Add the mustard , sugar and salt and beat well
4. Slowly add one cup heavy cream and vinegar
5. Pour into heavy saucepan and cook slowly until thickened , approximately 5-15 minutes
6. Remove from heat and add the remaining cup of cream
7. Whisk to combine
8. Salad:
9. Tear the lettuce into bite size pieces
10. Cut apples into bite-size slices and add to lettuce
11. Add the peanuts
12. Just before serving warm the dressing and pour enough dressing over the greens to coat the lettuce
13. This makes 2 cups and will keep in the refrigerator for quite some time

title: zesty cheesy crumbed chicken
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 180c
2. Slice chicken in half longways , being careful not to cut all the way through and open out like a book
3. Cover in plastic wrap and pound chicken until less than 1 / 2 inch thick
4. Place 1 piece of cheese on each chicken breast and fold over to enclose
5. Secure with toothpicks , and set aside
6. Combine flour with salt and pepper , spread out on a plate
7. Whisk egg with lime juice , place in bowl
8. Combine breadcrumbs with lime zest and cayenne pepper flakes , mix well
9. Spread out on plate
10. With one chicken breast at a time , cover with flour , shaking off excess
11. Cover chicken with egg mix , shake off excess and put breast in crumb mixture
12. Turn to coat well and press crumbs onto chicken
13. Grease an oven proof dish
14. Add chicken to dish and place in oven for 60 minutes , turning halfway through cooking time

title: campbell s creamy chicken broccoli noodles
steps:
1. Cook noodles in saucepan according to package directions
2. Stir in seasonings packet
3. Drain off most of liquid
4. Add mushroom soup , milk , broccoli and chicken
5. Heat through
6. Stir in tomatoes

title: mulled cider
steps:
1. In a saucepan , mix cider , cloves , nutmeg and cinnamon with brown sugar
2. Bring to a boil and cook 5 minutes
3. Remove spices and serve hot , or allow mulled cider to chill and serve cold

title: na me inspired roasted squash  vegan friendly
steps:
1. Roasted butternut squash: preheat oven to 400f
2. Cut in half lengthwise and discard seeds
3. Arrange the two halves on a parchment lined sheet pan
4. Spoon and / or sprinkle the oil / butter , pomegranate molasses , honey and spices on the squash
5. Don't worry about mixing it all together
6. The heat from the roasting will do that
7. Roast squash for 45 minutes , or until starting to brown on the edges , adding the dried barberries or dried cranberries the last 10-12 minutes of roasting
8. Serve hot
9. Tastes best hot or at room temperature

title: turkey stew
steps:
1. Dissolve the bouillon in the hot water to make a broth
2. Set aside
3. Place the turkey meat , turkey bone , all the vegetables , flour , both rices , spices and chicken broth in a large kettle or dutch oven
4. Add as much of the 4 cups water as you prefer for desired consistency
5. Season with salt and pepper
6. Simmer over low heat for 30 to 45 minutes , or until the carrots and celery are tender and the turkey meat is heated through
7. Remove the turkey bone before serving stew
8. Just omit both the white and wild rices , and add about 1 cup uncooked egg noodles
9. But you could easily use only white or only dark meat , to suit your taste buds
10. For our health , we should consider this option but we are die-hard fans of this recipe and haven't been able to bring ourselves to do that -- at least not yet !

title: cinnamon tortilla with cream cheese   strawberries
steps:
1. Combine sugar substitute and cinnamon in cup
2. Mix well
3. Heat large nonstick skillet over medium heat
4. Lightly spray one side of tortilla with cooking spray
5. Sprinkle with cinnamon mixture
6. Place tortilla , cinnamon side down , in hot skillet
7. Cook 2 minutes or until lightly browned
8. Remove from skillet
9. Spread uncooked side of tortilla with cream cheese
10. Arrange strawberries down center of tortilla
11. Roll up tortilla , or fold , to serve
12. Mash a few of the strawberry slices with a fork until almost smooth
13. Stir into cream cheese
14. Proceed as directed in step 4

title: kittencal s make ahead stuffing balls
steps:
1. Butter a 13 x 9-inch baking pan
2. In a large fry pan heat butter over medium-high
3. Add in the onions and celery and cook stirring until soft and translucent but not browned
4. Add in the garlic and cook for 2 minutes
5. Add in chopped mushrooms , creamed corn , niblets corn , broth , poultry seasoning , parsley , parmesan cheese , seasoned salt or white salt and black pepper pepper
6. Bring to a medium boil , simmer for 10-15 minutes over low heat
7. Remove the mixture and transfer to a large bowl
8. And cool for 20-30 minutes
9. Add in eggs and mix well
10. Add bread crumbs or cubes
11. Mix well to combine
12. Taste the mixture and then adjust the poultry seasoning , salt and pepper to taste if needed
13. At this point you may cover the bowl and refrigerate until ready to shape into balls
14. With moistened hands shape into golf ball-size balls add in more breadcrumbs if needed just to hold the mixture together
15. Transfer the shaped balls to the prepared buttered casserole dish
16. When ready to bake drizzle melted butter over the balls
17. Cover loosely with foil
18. Bake at 350f for about 20-25 minutes

title: fish camp stew   soup
steps:
1. Prepare fish by removing skin and cutting into one-inch pieces
2. Set fish aside
3. In a 5 quart dutch oven saucepan , fry bacon and crumble
4. In bacon drippings saute onions and celery
5. Add tomato soup , diced tomatoes , potatoes , carrots , garlic salt , worcestershire sauce , water , salt , black pepper and tabasco sauce
6. Cook on low simmer heat
7. When potatoes are one-half done , add prepared fish pieces and simmer on low heat for approximately 15 minutes or until vegetables and fish are tender
8. Serve hot with cornbread or crackers

title: hello  aloha  dollies
steps:
1. Melt butter in a 13 x 9 inch oblong baking pan
2. Sprinkle the crumbs evenly over the butter to form the crust
3. Evenly distribute in the order listed , the next ingredients , over the crust
4. Remove the entire top of the can of condensed milk , and gently stir in the rum flavoring
5. Drizzle the milk over the top of the last layer
6. Bake at 350 for 30 minutes
7. Cool before cutting into squares

title: pumpkin tart with pecan crust
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Spray a 9 inch pie plate
3. Spread nuts over a baking pan
4. Toast for 7-10 minutes on middle shelf , or until the smell of nuts fills the kitchen
5. Combine oats , flour , remaining pecans , 1 / 2 teaspoon cinnamon , and a pinch of salt in a food processor
6. Pulse until mixture becomes a coarse meal
7. Whisk together applesauce and 3 tablespoons maple syrup
8. Mix into dry ingredients to form a soft dough
9. Press mixture into pie plate
10. Crimp edges
11. Bake for 10 minutes , and set aside to cool
12. Using a whisk , dissolve the cornstarch in the milk
13. Add pumpkin , 1 / 2 cup maple syrup , salt and spices
14. Blend until smooth
15. Pour filling into crust , and smooth the top
16. Bake for about 35 minutes , or until the crust is lightly browned and the outside inch of the filling is set
17. Don't worry if the center is still soft
18. It firms up as the pie cools
19. Transfer pie to a wire the rack
20. Cool to room temperature , and then chill until set , about 3 hours
21. Serve chilled or at room temperature

title: breakfast  pizza   somersize
steps:
1. Combine the sausage and 1 1 / 2 cups cheese and spread in the bottom of a pie plate or a 9" x 9" casserole dish
2. Pour the eggs over the top of the meat mixture and top with remaining cheese
3. Sprinkle tomatoes and mushrooms over the top
4. Bake at 350 degrees until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean , about 20-30 minutes

title: spinach   cheese stuffed eggs
steps:
1. Remove yolks from the eggs and mash , combine with the finely chopped spinach , cheese , nutmeg , dash of pepper stir in the milk& mayo , mix well
2. Spoon a well rounded tbsp of the mixture into each half egg , cover& chill until serving

title: oatmeal fruit crisp
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Slice apples in large greased large casserole dish
3. You can leave them unpeeled or peeled as you wish
4. Combine dry ingredients , then cut in margarine until crumbly
5. Put over fruit and cook for approximately 35 to 45 minutes until fruit is cooked through
6. Check with a knife - if the fruit is soft and the oatmeal crisp is brown , it is done
7. You can substitue diced rhubarb , pears , berries like saskatoons or blueberries for part or all of the apples
8. You may want to sprinkle a bit of cornstarch over top before you put the oatmeal over top to thicken the fruit as it cooks
9. Apples don't need thickening , but berries and pears are juicier
10. Serve warm with vanilla ice cream

title: sam s birth day spaghetti carbonara
steps:
1. Add spaghetti to boiling water
2. When soft , drain & rinse
3. Drop in butter , stir , keep warm & set aside
4. While spaghetti is cooking , fry bacon just until lightly crisped
5. Remove from pan and cut or crumble to bite-size pieces
6. Reserve 2-3 t
7. Fat
8. To hot fat in frying pan , add pepper flakes and garlic
9. Stir for 30 seconds
10. Remove from heat
11. Break eggs into medium bowl , with an egg beater beat until frothy , then stir in parmesan cheese
12. Set aside
13. Add half-n-half to frying pan , stirring up fond and thickening slightly
14. Dump spaghetti into large serving bowl , then add meat mixture and toss well
15. Then cheese mixture , toss well
16. Sprinkle on the parsley
17. Serve with additional parmesan

title: banana split freezer jam
steps:
1. Mix exactly 2 cups crushed strawberries and 1 / 2 cup mashed bananas in large bowl
2. Stir in sugar and lemon juice
3. Let stand 10 minutes , stirring occasionally
4. Add chocolate syrup
5. Mix well
6. Mix water and pectin in small saucepan
7. Bring to boil on high heat , stirring constantly
8. Continue boiling and stirring 1 minute
9. Add to fruit mixture
10. Stir 3 minutes or until sugar is dissolved and no longer grainy
11. Fill clean plastic containers immediately to within 1 / 2 inch of tops
12. Wipe off top edges of containers
13. Immediately cover with lids
14. Let stand at room temperature 24 hours
15. Jam is now ready to use
16. Store in refrigerator up to 3 weeks or freeze extra containers up to 1 year
17. Thaw in refrigerator before using

title: quick california style ham and eggs benedict
steps:
1. Bake biscuits according to package
2. Combine melted butter , 1 tablespoons chives
3. Split biscuits , and brush with mixture
4. Place biscuits , buttered side up on a baking sheet and bake at 375f for 5 minutes or until toasted
5. Meanwhile , prepare hollandaise according to package , using milk and lemon juice but omit the butter
6. Saut ham in skillet over med- heat 3 minutes or until lightly browned
7. Stir ham and red pepper , if using , into hollandaise sauce
8. Keep warm
9. Add water to a depth of 2 inches in a large sauce pan
10. Bring to a boil
11. Reduce heat , and maintain at a light simmer
12. Add teas white vinegar
13. Break eggs one at a time into a large serving spoon , and slip carefully into the water
14. Simmer 3-5 minutes or to desired doneness
15. Remove with slotted spoon
16. Trim edges with sharp knife
17. To serve:
18. Place bottom biscuit halves , buttered side up on 4 warmed plates
19. Top with arugula , slices of avocado , and then poached eggs
20. Pour the hollandaise mixture evenly over eggs
21. Sprinkle with remain chives and black pepper to taste
22. Serve remaining biscuit halves on side

title: braised chicken and apples
steps:
1. Heat a heavy-bottomed skillet over medium-high heat
2. Season chicken breast with salt and pepper
3. Brown chicken on both sides , about 3 minutes per side
4. Remove chicken to plate and keep warm
5. Add apples and shallots to the skillet
6. Cook until apples begin to soften , about 2 minutes
7. Add thyme , salt and a generous grinding of pepper , cook 1 minute
8. Pour in chicken broth and cider and cook over high heat until the liquid has reduced by half , about 5 minutes
9. Return chicken breast to the skillet , nestling them in among the apples
10. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer until chicken is no longer pink in the middle , about 8 minutes

title: middle eastern spice baked chicken breasts
steps:
1. Place all ingredients , except chicken , in a blender and process until well mixed
2. Pour over chicken and bake at 350 degrees f
3. For about 50 minutes or until done
4. Serve with the suggested condiments listed in the description above

title: spiced cranberry apple juice
steps:
1. Place cinnamon , cloves and allspice on a piece of cheesecloth
2. Tie securely with clean string to form a bag
3. In 3 quart saucepan over high heat , heat spice bag , honey and 2 cups juice to boiling over high heat
4. Reduce heat to medium
5. Cover and simmer 5 minutes
6. Remove spice bag
7. Pour mixture into large bowl
8. Stir in remaining juice
9. Cover and refrigerate until well chilled , about 2 hours

title: pan seared pork chops w  rosemary
steps:
1. Season pork chops with salt , rosemary , & pepper , then drizzle with olive oil
2. Place saut pan or skillet over medium-high heat
3. Add chops and lower heat to medium
4. Cook 5-6 minutes until well browned on first side
5. Flip & cook 3-4 minutes more

title: chicken   rice salad
steps:
1. Mix the ingredients for the dressing together in a small bowl , set aside
2. Place the salad ingredients in a medium glass bowl
3. Pour the dressing over top then stir until well blended
4. Serve cooled or at room temperature

title: moist garlic chicken
steps:
1. Combine first 4 ingredients in a pie plate or shallow bowl
2. This
3. Will be bowl "a"
4. Combine the next 4 ingredients in a separate bowl
5. This will be bowl
6. "b"
7. Dip chicken in bowl a and then in bowl b to coat
8. Place chicken in a
9. Greased 13x9x2 pan
10. Sprinkle the remainder of bowl b over the chicken
11. Cover tightly with aluminum foil
12. Bake @ 350 for 50 minutes , or until juices run clear

title: roast turkey pan gravy
steps:
1. Spoon off all but about 4 tbsp of the fat in the roasting pan
2. Make sure you leave all the brown bits
3. Add wine the onions , shallots and mushrooms
4. Turn heat to high , stirring and scraping until most of the wine has evaporated , the onion is soft and the bottom of the pan is clean
5. Add the stock and continue to cook for about 10 minutes
6. If you are using giblets put them in for this cooking time
7. Mix cornstarch with the water
8. Turn heat to low and stir in the mixed cornstarch
9. The gravy will start to thicken almost immediately
10. Cook stirring until the gravy has thickened , if you want it thicker mix a bit more cornstarch with water and add stirring and cook for 5 minutes more
11. Season to taste with salt& pepper

title: very easy crispy cinnamon treats
steps:
1. Preheat an oven to 350
2. Brush the butter evenly over the pita
3. Sprinkle sugar and cinnamon evenly over the pita
4. Cut into strips or wedges
5. Place on baking sheet and bake for 5-8 minutes , or until crsipy and slightly golden
6. Cool and serve with vanilla ice cream
7. Enjoy !

title: reuben burger
steps:
1. Mix the salt , pepper and chili flakes into the hamburger , form two patties
2. Place cheese on one patty and put the other one on top , seal edges well
3. Fry the bacon until crisp , remove from pan , drain on a paper towel and drain grease from the pan leaving a bit of the bacon grease on the pan
4. Brown one side of the burger on high heat flip after 2 minutes , turn heat to medium , cover and continue cooking for another 5 minutes
5. Flip the burger , add mushrooms to the pan , cover and continue cooking
6. Make room on the pan for the kraut and brown it a bit heating it through during the last 2 minutes cooking time-keep it separate from the mushrooms
7. Meanwhile toast the inside of the bun , when the burger is cooked place patty in the bun , top with kraut , bacon & jalapenos
8. Serve mushrooms on the side

title: onion jam
steps:
1. Heat oil in heavy frying pan , then add onions & saute untils slightly brown
2. Season with salt , then reduce heat & continue to cook , stirring constantly , until caramelized & tender
3. Add rest of ingredients except the tomato , & cook on low heat for 30 minutes , stirring occasionally
4. Add tomato & cook 15 more minutes
5. Remove from heat & let cool
6. Store in a jar in the refrigerator for up to 2 weeks

title: roasted red peppers with halloumi
steps:
1. Cut the bell peppers in half lengthwise and remove the cores and seeds
2. Rub the skins of the bell peppers with 1 tbsp olive oil and arrange the peppers skin side down on a greased baking sheet
3. In this order , scatter half the garlic into the bell peppers , add the cheese , mint leaves , lemon zest , remaining garlic , thyme , pine nuts , and pepper
4. Drizzle the remaining oil and the lemon juice over the peppers
5. Roast the peppers in a preheated oven at 400 degrees fahrenheit for 30 minutes , until tender and beginning to char around the edges
6. Serve warm

title: brandy meyer lemon marmalade
steps:
1. Halve lemons crosswise and remove seeds
2. Tie seeds in a cheesecloth bag
3. Quarter each lemon half and thinly slice
4. Combine with bag of seeds and water in a 5-quart nonreactive heavy pot and let mixture stand , covered , at room temperature 24 hours
5. Bring lemon mixture to a boil over moderate heat and add brandy
6. Reduce heat and simmer , uncovered , until reduced to approximately 4 cups , about 45 minutes
7. Stir in sugar and boil over moderate heat , stirring occasionally and skimming off all foam and scum until it reaches 215 to 220f remove the bag of seeds
8. Ladle hot marmalade into 3 pint size jars and wipe rims with dampened cloth and seal jars with lids
9. Put jars in a water-bath canner or on a rack set in a deep pot
10. Add enough hot water to cover jars by 1 inch and bring to a boil
11. Boil jars , covered , 15 minutes and transfer with tongs to a rack
12. Cool jars completely
13. Marmalade keeps , stored in a cool , dark place , up to 1 year

title: tropical baked bananas
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400f peel the bananas and slice in half lengthwise
2. Lay the pieces into a buttered 9x13x2-inch ovenproof dish
3. Pour the lime juice and rum evenly over the bananas
4. Sprinkle on the cinnamon , nutmeg , and brown sugar
5. Dot on the butter , if using , and bake for 10 to 15 minutes
6. Serve hot , topped with a tablespoon of fresh cream or ice cream

title: omelet espanola squares
steps:
1. In nonstick 10-inch skillet with oven safe handle , heat olive oil over medium heat
2. Add potatoes , onion , green pepper and 1 / 4 teaspoon of salt and cook until vegetables are tender , about 20 minutes , stirring occasionally
3. Meanwhile , preheat oven to 400 degrees
4. In medium bowl , with wire whisk or fork , beat eggs with pepper , 1 / 2 teaspoon salt , and 1 / 2 cup water
5. Stir in tomatoes and olives
6. Stir egg mixture into potato mixture in skillet and cook , covered , 5 minutes or until egg mixture begins to set around edge
7. Remove cover and place skillet in oven
8. Bake 15 to 20 minutes , until omelet is set
9. Carefully invert omelet onto large , flat plate
10. Let cool before cutting into 1-inch squares
11. Garnish with chives

title: red  white  and  blue jello flag
steps:
1. Add 1-1 / 2 cups boiling water to dry berry blue gelatin mix in medium bowl
2. Stir at least 2 minutes until gelatin is dissolved
3. Dissolve dry red gelatin mix in 1-1 / 2 cups boiling water in separate bowl
4. Stir 1-1 / 2 cups ice cold water into dissolved gelatin in each bowl
5. Spray 10-cup flag mold with cooking spray
6. Place on baking sheet
7. Pour red gelatin into mold
8. Refrigerate 45 minutes until set but not firm
9. Meanwhile , refrigerate berry blue gelatin in bowl for 45 minutes
10. Meanwhile , stir remaining 1 cup boiling water into dry lemon gelatin mix in bowl at least 2 minutes until dissolved
11. Refrigerate 25 minutes or until slightly thickened , stirring occasionally
12. Stir in whipped topping with wire whisk
13. Gently spread over red gelatin in mold
14. Refrigerate 10 minutes or until set but not firm
15. Gently spoon thickened berry blue gelatin over lemon gelatin mixture in mold
16. Refrigerate 4 hours or overnight until firm
17. Unmold

title: hot crab dip
steps:
1. Combine milk and salsa
2. Transfer to a slow cooker / crock pot coated with nonstick cooking spray
3. Stir in cream cheese , crab , onions , and chilies
4. Cover and cook on low for 3 to 4 hours , stirring every 30 minutes
5. Serve with assorted breads , crackers , etc
6. Keep warm while serving

title: chocolate and peanut butter ice box dessert
steps:
1. Mix the milk and pudding mix and place in fridge until just set
2. Meanwhile , place 4 of the graham cracker sheets in an even layer on the bottom of an 8x8 square pan
3. Mix the peanut butter with the cool whip and spread it over the graham crackers in the pan
4. Place another layer with 4 of the graham cracker sheets over top and then layer on the chocolate pudding mixture
5. Crumble the remaining sheet of graham cracker and sprinkle on top
6. Place in the fridge overnight

title: coco shrimp with orange marmalade and beer batter
steps:
1. Take 6 eggs and whisk in a mixing bowl until smooth and consistent
2. Add 12 oz of beer
3. Mix well till smooth
4. Add the baking powder and the cajun season or make your own
5. I go with mostly paprika , a dash of garlic and onion powder , and a pinch cayenne and red pepper , but only make a tablespoons worth
6. Mix evenly then add the flour little at a time
7. This prevents clumping--no one wants to eat a flour ball
8. You should have a rich and smooth texture
9. To test this , dip a spoon in and pull it out
10. The spoon should stay covered
11. If it is runny , add a little flour till you have the consistency you want
12. Place in the fridge and let chill
13. Take unpeeled 16 / 20 and peel over a sink with a slow run of water to wash
14. Make sure to place shrimp in an ice bath or they will spoil and make you sick
15. Be very careful of what you touch while doing the shrimp
16. You do not want to spread bacteria everywhere
17. Handle like you would raw chicken or pork
18. To peel shrimp , leave the tale on and try not to bend the shrimp too hard
19. You don't want to break its back yet
20. Be sure to remove the spinal column
21. Clean as you peel under the running water
22. You will see a variety of colors in them
23. Heat your deep fryer to 350f after cooking in the grease everything will taste a little fishy , so you want to dump it when you are done unless you can filter clean
24. Place in one container that is 1 inch high by 6 inches wide and however long you want: the coconut next to it will be the beer batter and in the last container , place a mixture of your cajun season and flour
25. Mix the seasoning well in to the flour
26. It will have an orange tint
27. Take the shrimp and snap it a little in the middle of the back then cover it in the flour , then dip in the beer batter , and then roll it in the coconut
28. This will get messy
29. Repeat with all shrimp and place in basket
30. When you put the basket in the fryer they will float
31. You might want to hold them down with a metal spatula
32. They should cook for 2-2 1 / 2 minutes or until golden brown
33. It is important that you let them cook this long
34. You do not want raw shrimp
35. If your shrimp are too big , you will cook longer--too small , cook less
36. Use good judgment here ! they should come out flat on the bottom
37. Now you can snap the middle piece of the tail inwards so they fan out
38. Now the sauce is the easy part
39. Mix in a bowl the orange marmalade , horseradish , and corel mustard in a mixing bowl on med-low till blended

title: creamed chicken over cornmeal rings
steps:
1. In heavy skillet , fry bacon until crisp
2. Remove to paper toweling to drain and cool
3. Reserve drippings
4. Mix cornmeal as directed with milk and eggs
5. Heat a griddle to med-hi and pour on bacon drippings
6. Lightly spray egg rings and place on griddle
7. Pour batter into rings , cover with foil or heat resistant lid
8. Cook until set
9. Remove rings and flip over
10. Brown other side
11. Remove to heated plate and keep warm while repeating with remaining batter , spraying rings each time
12. Add more bacon drippings or oil if needed
13. Meanwhile in heavy skillet , heat to med
14. Add butter and melt
15. Add flour and stir constantly to light brown
16. Add chicken stock
17. Whisk to blend
18. Add cream about 1 / 2 at a timewhisking constantly , until thicken
19. Reduce heat and add seasoning
20. Blend
21. Add mushrooms and chicken
22. Cover and simmer over low heat for about 15 minutes to blend flavors
23. Add white wine to thin if needed
24. To serve , place 1-2 cornmeal rings on each plate and spoon chicken and sauce over rings
25. Sprinkle with crumbled bacon
26. Top with a parsley sprig
27. And serve hot
28. Serves 6-8
29. If you have no rings , grease muffin tin cups with bacon drippings and pour about 1 / 2 of batter in each cup and bake at 400f
30. For about 10-15 minutes
31. Watch closely
32. Can burn easily !
33. Let set for at least 5 minutes before removing from muffin pan

title: timballo di maccarun  molded macaroni casserole
steps:
1. In a bowl , gently combine the ground meats
2. In a separate bowl of water , dip the bread slices just until softened , then squeeze out the water , crumble the bread , and add to the meats along with the eggs , herbs , salt , pepper , and parmigiano-reggiano cheese
3. Mix just to combine the ingredients
4. Set aside
5. In a separate bowl , combine the cooked macaroni with the remaining cheeses and 1 cup of tomato sauce
6. Set aside
7. Grease the bottom and sides of a 9-inch springform pan with olive oil
8. Cut a piece of parchment paper to fit the bottom of the pan
9. Place the slices of prosciutto or pancetta in the bottom of the pan in a spoke-like or circle fashion
10. Cover the slices and sides of the pan with about two thirds of the meat mixture
11. Make sure there are no gaps
12. Gently fill the center of the pan with the macaroni mixture , patting it down firmly
13. With a rolling pin , roll the remaining meat mixture between 2 sheets of waxed paper to fit the top of the pan
14. Remove 1 sheet of the waxed paper and invert the meat over the top of the pan
15. Carefully pull back the remaining sheet of waxed paper
16. Neatly press the edges of the meat all the way around the pan , making sure that there are no gaps
17. Preheat the oven to 350f
18. Cover the top of the pan tightly with a piece of aluminum foil
19. Place the pan on a baking sheet and bake for 30 minutes , covered
20. Remove the foil and bake 15 minutes longer , or until the meat is browned on top
21. Remove the pan from the oven
22. Run a knife around the edges of the pan
23. Place a serving platter over the pan and invert onto the platter
24. With a potholder , carefully release the spring and lift off the sides of the pan
25. Remove the bottom of the pan and the parchment paper
26. Let the timballo cool for 5 to 10 minutes
27. Serve the timballo cut into wedges and pass extra tomato sauce on the side

title: strawberry angel food dessert
steps:
1. Prepare angel food cake according to directions given on box
2. Once cooled completely , remove from pan and tear up into bite sized pieces
3. Place them into a 9 x 13' pan
4. Dissolve jello in the boiling water , which should take about a minute
5. Put the jello in the fridge until it has a pudding-like consistency
6. This should take about 1 hour to 1 1 / 2
7. Add the strawberries into the jello and pour over the cake pieces
8. If you want , you can spread the cool whip over the top
9. Refrigerate at least 3 hours or until set
10. Serve , and enjoy !

title: spring biscotti
steps:
1. In a large bowl , cream together butter , sugar , orange zest , and vanilla with an electric mixer until light and fluffy
2. Mix in eggs and egg white one at a time , beating well after each addition
3. Sift together the flour , baking powder , and salt
4. Gradually blend into the creamed mixture using a wooden spoon
5. Stir in the white chocolate , dried cranberries , and pistachios
6. Cover , and chill for 30 minutes , or until dough is no longer sticky
7. Preheat oven to 325ff
8. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper
9. Turn dough out on a lightly floured surface , and divide into halves
10. Form each half into a flattish log about 12 inches long by 3 inches wide
11. Arrange logs at least 3 inches apart on baking sheet
12. Bake for 30 minutes in preheated oven , or until pale gold
13. Allow logs to cool on the baking sheet until cool enough to handle
14. On a cutting board , cut logs crosswise on a diagonal into 1 inch thick slices
15. Arrange on baking sheet
16. Bake for an additional 15 minutes , or until golden
17. Transfer biscotti to wire racks , and cool completely
18. Store in an airtight container at room temperature

title: apple confit  pate
steps:
1. Put 1 cup sugar in a small pot , melt , stirring constantly over low heat and cook until golden brown
2. Pour sugar into a 9x5 loaf pan or 3 inch deep , 9 inch round cake pan being sure to coat bottom well
3. Zest orange into long thin strips
4. Place in saucepan , cover with water and bring to a boil
5. Drain , refresh under cold water then drain again
6. Peel apples , halve and core
7. Cut into 1 / 8-inch thick slices
8. Keep neatly stacked
9. Using flat pieces only place a layer neatly into bottom of loaf pan
10. Cover with another layer keeping as neat as possible
11. Press down to even them out
12. Sprinkle with a bit of sugar , then some zest
13. Repeat adding sugar and zest every 2-3 layer
14. Continue to build layer 3-4 inches above edge of pan keeping lines straight
15. Cover with plastic wrap then wrap entirely in aluminum foil
16. Place in a shallow tray to catch drippings
17. Let sit for 24 hours
18. Drain juice and unwrap pan
19. Re-wrap in double layer aluminum foil
20. Place in a large deep roasting pan , fill pan up the sides of pan with water
21. Bake at 300f for 5-6 hours
22. It is done when it fills about of the mold , apples are dark brown and a knife passes easily through
23. Unwrap , cool and let chill for several hours
24. Slice thinly and serve

title: mucho bueno taco salad
steps:
1. Brown ground beef in a large skillet , breaking up beef
2. Add tomatoes , pinto beans , chili powder , cumin , and oregano and simmer for about 25 minutes , or until most of the liquid from the tomatoes has evaporated
3. Cool to room temperature
4. Divide salad greens among 4-6 plates , and top with meat mixture
5. Sprinkle with onion , cheddar cheese , black olives , cilantro and tortilla chips
6. Garnish with avocado slices and jalapeo slices and serve

title: my mom s bar b que sauce
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a medium saucepan
2. Stir well to make sure the brown sugar and mustard is disolved
3. Bring to a boil , then simmer uncovered for 15 minutes , stirring occasionally
4. Can be brushed on cooked chicken or ribs and grilled for ten minutes , or made into ham or pulled pork bar-b-que sandwiches using 3 lbs
5. Of meat
6. Enjoy !

title: shrimp and rice casserole  or crawfish
steps:
1. Saute onions and bell pepper in butter until soft
2. Combine all ingredients and mix well
3. Pour in ungreased baking dish
4. Cover with foil and bake at 325f for 1 hour , but during the last 15 minutes remove foil

title: low fat cashew and carrot soup  vegetarian too
steps:
1. Rough cut carrots , onion and potato
2. In large pot , heat the pot , then add 3 tablespoons vegetable stock
3. Add carrots , onion and potatoes and stir fry for about 5 minutes
4. Add 1 1 / 2 pints vegetable stock and cover for 25 minutes
5. Place cashews in dry frypan
6. Constantly stirring until slightly brown
7. Allow soup and cashews to cool and place both through a food processor or blender
8. Enjoy !

title: creamy tomato soup and italian patty melts
steps:
1. Heat the milk over moderate heat in a medium pot
2. Put tomatoes , tomato paste , onions , salt and pepper , sugar , flour , butter , celery into a food processor and grind until smooth
3. Pour mixture into milk and raise heat to bring soup to a boil
4. Reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes
5. While soup cooks , make pesto and sammies
6. Fill the food processor with watercress , loosely packed
7. Add hazelnuts , 1 / 2 of the oil and garlic cloves to the watercress in the processor
8. Add nutmeg , salt and pepper to the processor bowl , set lid in place and pulse grind the mixture into a thick paste
9. Add any remaining watercress to the processor and grind into the paste by pulsing the processor again
10. Transfer watercress paste to a bowl
11. Stir in the remaining oil and the cheese
12. Taste pesto sauce and adjust seasonings
13. Heat a griddle over medium high heat
14. Drizzle the pan with extra-virgin olive oil and add the patties and cook 5 minutes on each side
15. Remove from the griddle and add another tablespoon extra-virgin olive oil and the peppers and onions
16. Season the peppers and onions and cook until just tender , 5 minutes
17. Remove them from the griddle
18. Wipe the griddle clean and reduce heat to medium low
19. Assemble sandwiches: place 4 slices of bread down , top with 1 / 4 each of the peppers onions , then a slice of cheese , a cooked sausage patty , another slice of cheese and then place bread on top
20. Add butter to griddle and cook sammy melts 2 or 3 minutes on each side until golden and cheese is melted
21. Press with spatula as sammies cook or set another heavy skillet on sammies to weigh them down
22. Pour soup into shallow bowls and add a couple of rounded spoonfuls of pesto to each dish and stir it into the soup
23. Cut the patty melts corner to corner and dip in the soup as you eat

title: homemade canning salsa
steps:
1. Prepare the jars , lids , and rings in hot water bath
2. Combine all ingredients in a large saucepot
3. Bring mixture to a boil
4. Reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes
5. Carefully ladle hot salsa into hot jars , leaving 1 / 4-inch headspace
6. Wipe rim of jar clean
7. Place lid on jar and tighten with ring
8. Process in warm water bath for 15 minutes

title: special k cereal biscotti
steps:
1. Combine the eggs and sugar in a mixer until fluffy
2. Add in the oil , beating well
3. Add in all the dry ingredients , combine well
4. Fold in all the cereal and nuts , combining with clean hands
5. Spread onto parchment lined cookie sheet into logs and flatten the tops slightly
6. Preheat oven to 350f and bake 15 minutes
7. Turn oven off and leave in for another 15 minutes
8. Remove then from oven , onto a wire rack and cool 10 minutes
9. Reset oven to 325f
10. Cut into slices with serrated knife and place back onto parchment lined sheets cut side down
11. Bake 7 minutes
12. Turn each slice over
13. Bake another 9 minutes
14. Until golden and toasty

title: marinated artichoke kebabs
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine artichoke hearts , mozzarella cheese and tomatoes
2. Cover and refrigerate overnight , or at least 1 hour
3. To assemble , thread 1 artichoke , 1 piece dried tomato and 1 cube of cheese on each toothpick , weding tomato between two larger items
4. Brush with marinade and arrange in a shallow serving dish , garnish with parsley , if desired

title: honey mustard barbecue veggie marinade
steps:
1. Combine all of the ingredients in a medium sized bowl and blend well
2. Add prepared vegetables to the marinade , cover , and marinate for one hour
3. Remove the vegetables from the marinade , and barbecue on the grill

title: broiled fish with buttery caper sauce
steps:
1. Preheat broiler
2. Line baking sheets with fillets
3. Broil 6-inches from heat , about 3 -5 minutes total for thin fillets , about 10 minutes total for fish about 1-inch thick
4. Season with salt and pepper
5. Meanwhile , in small saucepan , melt the butter over low heat
6. Add vinegar and capers
7. Heat through
8. Remove from the heat
9. Stir in the parsley
10. Plate the fish
11. Spoon a little sauce over each fillet

title: chocolate bonbon pops   no bake
steps:
1. In large food processor bowl combine cookies and 3 / 4 cup of the nuts
2. Pulse until cookies are crushed
3. Add orange liqueur , corn syrup , and cocoa powder
4. Process until combined
5. Add remaining nuts
6. Pulse until coarsely chopped
7. Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper
8. Shape cookie mixture in 1-inch balls
9. Place on baking sheet , insert a lollipop stick , and freeze for 30 minutes
10. In a small saucepan combine chocolate pieces and shortening
11. Cook and stir over medium-low heat just until melted
12. Remove from heat
13. Dip pops in chocolate
14. Return to baking sheet
15. Loosely cover and refrigerate 1 hour or until chocolate is set
16. If using liqueur , flavor will mellow after a day or two
17. Makes 20 pops
18. To store: place in covered container
19. Refrigerate up to 1 week

title: orange poppy seed cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325
2. Beat butter with orange zest until it whitens and holds soft peaks
3. Beat in sugar until well blended
4. Whisk together yolks and vanilla
5. Add to butter mixture and mix scraping down sides as necessary
6. Add flour and poppy seeds mixing only to combine divide dough into 4 pieces and roll into 4 logs , each about 1 1 / 2 inches in diameter
7. Dough should be frozen for 30 minutes so that it can be easily cut or you can freeze , wrapped well for later use
8. Slice 3 / 8 inch rounds
9. Bake on a parchment lined sheet pan until firm and lightly and evenly browned- about 12-15 minutes
10. The cookies must be cooked through to be tender

title: my cabbage and spinach salad
steps:
1. Whisk together the garlic , salt , dijon , honey , balsamic and oil
2. Spread pine nuts in an iron skillet
3. Heat until toasted
4. Add ham
5. Saut until crisp
6. Add cabbage
7. Cover
8. Cook 8 minutes
9. Add spinach
10. Saut until just wilted
11. Toss in vinaigrette
12. Serve warm

title: peppered pork tenderloin with mango ginger puree
steps:
1. For the pork:
2. Trim any excess fat or "grisle" off the loins
3. Mix the salt and cracked pepper and coat the loins with the mixture
4. Roast in a 350 degree oven for about 40 minutes , or to desired doneness
5. For the puree:
6. Combine all ingredients in the med-large sauce pan
7. Simmer for 15 minutes or until the mango is very tender
8. Puree the mixture either in a blender or with an emulsion blender
9. Slice the pork tenderloin and top with the puree

title: corn dog twists
steps:
1. Separate corn bread twists
2. Wrap one strip around each hot dog
3. Brush with butter
4. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese
5. Place on a lightly greased baking sheet
6. Bake at 375 degrees for 11-13 minutes or until golden brown
7. Can use refrigerated tube of breadsticks instead of corn bread twists

title: hoisin and peanut  asian style dipping sauce
steps:
1. Combine the caster sugar , rice vinegar and water in a small saucepan
2. Stir over low heat until the sugar dissolves
3. Add the hoisin sauce , peanut oil or vegetable oil , and chopped peanuts
4. Stir thoroughly

title: rigatoni in woodsman s sauce
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a large saucepan
2. Add the onions and cook until wilted
3. Add the sausage and cook , breaking it up with a spoon , until no pink remains
4. Drain all the fat from the pan and add the mushrooms and butter and cook about 3 minutes
5. Add the tomatoes and simmer genly until thick
6. Add 1 / 4 c
7. Ricotta and mix well , then add the peas and half-and-half and let cook another 5 minutes or so
8. Season to taste with salt and pepper
9. Pour the sauce over the cooked rigatoni and mix well over low heat
10. Fold in the remaining ricotta , the parmesan cheese and serve

title: steve s tiramisu
steps:
1. Most of this recipe comes from the one on the side of the belgioso mascarpone container , but with some changes
2. This recipe isn't an easy one - the most difficult part is properly saturating the ladyfingers without making them soggy - don't be upset if your first try doesn't come out so well
3. In large bowl , combine 3 egg yolks , 1 tbs espresso , sugar , vanilla , and marsala wine
4. Beat ~3 minutes , and finally add mascarpone and beat 3-5 minutes more
5. Mixture should be slightly firm , and very tasty :)
6. Add more sugar to suit your taste , i prefer 1 / 3 cup , some people like 1 / 2 cup
7. In a separate bowl , add whipping cream & a pinch of sugar , whip until stiff peaks form
8. Fold whipping cream into mascarpone mixture - should end up being fluffy but stiff
9. Now , you need to layer the ladyfingers & mascarpone in a pan - i use a 8x8 glass pan , works perfect
10. Here's the difficult part - your first layer should be ladyfingers soaked in espresso
11. I say soaked , but make sure they are not soggy
12. To soak the ladyfingers , i work with 1 / 2 a ladyfinger at a time , dipping each side for a split second , just enough to barely cover the top or bottom
13. If you soak it too much , just sqeeze the excess out like a sponge
14. If you don't get enough , use your fingers to drip some coffee on the ladyfinger , and sort of massage it inches lay down 12 ladyfinger halves in the pan , and spread a layer of mascarpone mixure on top
15. Sprinkle cocoa on top of each layer
16. Repeat for the next 3 layers
17. Chill for at least 2 hours before serving
18. Enjoy !

title: chili con carne soup
steps:
1. Coat a pan with cooking spray , saut onion until it is softened
2. Stir in the beef mince and brown , add the garlic , paprika and cumin , cooking for 1 minute
3. Stir in the crushed tomatoes and stock , cover and simmer for 30 minutes
4. Add the kidney beans and warm through
5. Scatter with the grated cheese and parsley before serving

title: pumpkin creme brulee
steps:
1. Preheat the oven at 300f to obtain pumpkin puree , steam the pumpkin flesh or cook in a marguerite
2. Pureed in food processor and set aside
3. With a sharp knife , open the vanilla bean in half lenghtwise and scratch the inside
4. Add the inside of the vanilla bean to the cream and heat in a casserole
5. When it begins to simmer , remove from the heat
6. Set aside
7. In a big bowl , mix together egg yolks and sugar 3 to 4 minutes with a whisk
8. Drizzle the hot cream on the mixture of eggs
9. Add pumpkin puree and amaretto and stir
10. Strain and pour in 4 ramequins
11. Put the ramequins in a oven dish
12. Pour hot water in the dish , around the ramequins , until 2 / 3 of the height of the ramequins
13. Cook in the oven 30 to 40 minutes or until the center move a little bit when you move the dish
14. Let cool and put in the fridge at least 2 hours before serving
15. When ready to serve , put around 2 tablespoon of brown sugar on top of each creme brulee
16. Put in the oven at broil unter the broiler
17. Until it is caramelized

title: sweet   savory spiced nuts
steps:
1. Toast pecans in a 350f oven for 6 minutes , or till they smell good & have started to change colour
2. Stir spice mix together
3. Combine glaze ingredients in a heavy pot , bring to boil over medium heat , whisk constantly
4. Stir nuts into glaze & continue stirring till all the nuts are shiny & the liquid is gone , about 1 or 2 minutes
5. Pour nuts in a mixing bowl , sprinkle on spice mix & toss to coat nuts
6. Spred on parchment lined cookie sheet and bake at 350f for 4 minutes
7. Watch carefully to make sure they don't burn
8. Cool & store in airtight container

title: almond orange chicken
steps:
1. Whisk together the first 5 ingredients
2. Place in a shallow dish , reserving 1 / 4 cup mixture
3. Add the chicken to the dish , cover and chill 1 hour
4. Remove chicken from marinade
5. Discard marinade
6. Cook the chicken in 1 teaspoon hot oil in a skillet over medium-high heat 8 minutes on each side or until done
7. Remove the chicken , reserving the drippings in skillet
8. Add the reserved 1 / 4 cup marinade mixture and chicken broth , stirring to remove the yummy bits from bottom of the skillet
9. Stir together the cornstarch and water and add to the broth mixture
10. Bring to a boil
11. Cook , stirring constantly , 1 minute
12. Stir in the marmalade and the next 4 ingredients
13. Return the chicken to the skillet
14. Spoon the sauce over the chicken
15. Sprinkle with the parsley and almonds

title: creamy chipotle vinaigrette
steps:
1. In a small saucepan combine the orange juice& vinegar
2. Bring to a boil over high heat
3. Then , reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer vigorously until the liquid is reduced by 2 / 3 , about 25 minutes
4. Remove the liquid from the heat , and allow to cool to room temperature
5. Add the mayonnaise and whisk together until well blended
6. Add the chipotle , cilantro , cumin and lime juice
7. Whisk together well
8. Season with salt and pepper

title: graham cracker muffins
steps:
1. In medium bowl , combine crumbs , sugar and baking powder
2. Add eggs , milk and margarine
3. Stir just until moistened
4. Spoon batter paper-lined muffin pan cups
5. Bake at 400 for 18 to 20 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
6. Serve warm

title: green beans with pecans  lemon and parsley
steps:
1. Cook beans in large pot of boiling salted water until just tender , about 5 minutes
2. Drain
3. Transfer to bowl of ice water and cool
4. Drain and pat dry
5. Melt butter in large deep skillet over medium heat
6. Add pecans
7. Saut until nuts are crisp and butter is lightly browned , about 3 minutes
8. Add beans
9. Toss to heat through , about 5 minutes
10. Mix in lemon zest
11. Cook 1 minute
12. Mix in parsley
13. Season with salt and pepper
14. Transfer to bowl

title: salisbury turkey
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Mix cavenders and turkey together and make into patties
3. Place patties in a casserole baking dish
4. Evenly pour turkey gravy and mushrooms over patties
5. Bake for 20 minutes or until cooked through
6. Serve over rice or with mashed potatoes and green beans or any veggie

title: sticky sweet chilli pork and basil rice
steps:
1. Heat a wok or large frying pan over moderately high heat and add half the oil and swirl to coat surface and stir fry pork for 5 to 6 minutes or until browned
2. Add garlic , chilli and ginger and stir fry for 1 minutes or until fragrant and then add sauces and stire fry for 1 minute or until pork is cooked and then remove from wok
3. Add remaining oil to wok , heat over high heat and add capsicum and rice and stir fry for 3 to 4 minutes or until heated and then add the bok choy and stir fry for 1 to 2 minutes or until heated and then return pork , cooking juices and 1 / 3 cup of the basil leave to work and stir fry until heated
4. Spoon into shallow serving bowls and serve topped with remaining basil

title: lemon dill mayonnaise sauce
steps: 1. In a small bowl , whisk together ingredients until blended

title: crostata dough
steps:
1. Cut butter into 1 / 2 inch pieces and put in freezer
2. Put dry ingredients in cuisinart and pulse to mix
3. Add butter , pulse until you have pea sized bits of butter
4. With machine running add water and stop before you have a solid mass
5. It should be crumbly
6. Dump out , divide in half and form each half into flat disks
7. Wrap in plastic and refrigerate for at least 1 hour
8. Roll dough into a rough circle and place on sheet pan with parchment
9. Sprinkle pastry with 1 / 2 the cinnamon sugar
10. Place fruit filling in center 2 / 3 of pastry , sprinkle with remaining cinnamon sugar
11. Fold sides 1 / 3 of the way in toward center all the way around , leaving a 2 / 3 of the fruit exposed
12. With your thumb press down on the outside edge of the pastry circle to seal
13. Baked at 400 until pastry is nicely browned
14. Cool

title: frank s cheesy buffalo chicken dip
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f and spray a pie pan with cooking spray
2. Mix everything together and place in prepared pie pan
3. Bake for 20 minutes , or until hot and bubbly
4. Stir and serve with tortilla chips or celery sticks

title: strawberry french toast sandwiches
steps:
1. On 6 slices of bread , spread layer of cream cheese
2. On other 6 slices , spread jam
3. Close one of each to make a sandwich
4. Combine eggs , milk and salt in shallow dish
5. Beat well
6. Dip both sides of sandwich in mixture quickly but coat evenly
7. Melt butter in large skillet
8. Brown sandwiches on both sides until golden brown
9. Add more butter if needed
10. Serve hot garnished with a sprinkle of powdered and a few slices of strawberries
11. Enjoy !

title: vegetarian mafe  african stew
steps:
1. Heat oil in dutch oven or heavy soup pot over medium-high heat
2. Add the onions and cook until beginning to brown
3. Add vegetables one at a time , sauteing each one for a minute or two before adding the next
4. Stir in tomato sauce and about one cup of water
5. Reduce heat & simmer until all the vegetables are tender
6. Spoon out half a cup of the broth & mix it with the peanut butter to make a smooth paste
7. Return to the pot & simmer for 15 minutes
8. Serve over cooked , hot rice

title: wine braised brisket of beef with caramelized pearl onions
steps:
1. Season the brisket evenly on both sides with salt and pepper
2. Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours
3. Meanwhile , in a medium saucepan , bring the wine to a boil and continue boiling until it reduces to half its original volume , 15 to 20 minutes
4. Preheat the oven to 350f
5. Evenly sprinkle the brisket all over with flour , shaking off excess
6. Heat a heavy dutch oven over high heat
7. Add 2 tablespoons of the oil and when it is almost smoking , turn the heat to medium-high , carefully add the brisket , and sear until well browned , about 5 minutes per side
8. Transfer the brisket to a platter
9. Pour off the fat from the dutch oven and add another 2 tablespoons of oil
10. Add the garlic , shallots , carrots , celery , and leek , and saut until glossy and lightly browned , about 5 minutes
11. Add half of the apricots and all the parsley , thyme , bay leaves , and tomato paste , and continue to cook 1 minute more
12. Return the browned brisket to the dutch oven and add the reduced wine and 2 quarts stock or broth
13. If the brisket is not completely covered with liquid , add enough extra stock , broth , or water to cover
14. Bring the liquid to a simmer
15. Cover the pot and carefully place it in the oven
16. Cook until the brisket is fork tender , 2 to 2 hours
17. Meanwhile , blanch and peel the onions as instructed in the
18. Cut the remaining apricots into 1 / 4-inch strips
19. In a small saut pan , heat the remaining 2 tablespoons oil over medium-high heat and saut the pearl onions until lightly golden , 5 to 7 minutes
20. Add the apricot strips and pour in the remaining 1 / 4 cup stock or broth , stirring and scraping with a wooden spoon to deglaze the pan deposits
21. Reduce the heat and simmer gently until tender , about 5 minutes
22. Cover and keep warm
23. When the meat is done , carefully transfer it to a heated platter , cover with aluminum foil , and keep warm
24. Boil the liquid in the dutch oven until it thickens and reduces to about 1 quart , 15 to 20 minutes
25. Pour it through a fine-mesh strainer into a bowl , taste , and adjust the seasonings if necessary with more salt and pepper
26. To serve , use a sharp knife to cut the brisket across the grain into 1 / 4-inch slices
27. Arrange the slices on heated serving plates or on a heated platter , spoon half the sauce over it , and garnish with the pearl onions and apricots
28. Sprinkle with minced parsley and pass the remaining sauce on the side
29. Serves 8

title: white bread plus
steps:
1. Combine yeast , 1 / 2 c water and 1 t
2. Sugar in bowl and allow to proof
3. Add egg , melted lard , salt and remaining sugar and water
4. Add 4 cups flour and beat for one minute
5. Stir in remaining flour one cup at a time , until dough pulls away from the sides of the bowl and can be handled
6. Turn out on a floured surface and knead until dough is smooth and pliable , about 10 minutes
7. Shape into a ball and place into a greased mixing bowl
8. Turn dough over so greased side is on top , cover with a tea towel and allow to rise in a warm place until doubled in size
9. Punch dough down , turn it over in the bowl , and allow to rise again until almost doubled in size
10. Punch down and shape into 3 large loaves , or 4 braided loaves
11. Allow loaves to rise
12. Brush with egg wash or milk , if desired , and sprinkle with aunt jane's salt
13. Bake in 375f oven for approximately 17 minutes
14. Or 30-40 minutes until brown on the outside and sounds hollow when tapped

title: power peanut butter biscotti
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325f
2. Combine flour , sugar , baking soda and salt in a large bowl
3. Combine peanut butter , vanilla , eggs and egg whites in a medium bowl , stirring well with a whisk
4. Add peanut butter mixture to the flour mixture , stirring just until blended
5. Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface
6. Shape dough into a 10 inch long roll
7. Place roll on a baking sheet coated with cooking spray
8. Flatten to a 1-inch thickness
9. Bake at 325f for 35 minutes
10. Remove roll from baking sheet and cool 10 minutes on a wire rack
11. Reduce oven temperature to 300f
12. Cut cooled rolls diagonally into 18 slices
13. Place slices , cut sides down , on baking sheet
14. Bake at 300f for 20 minutes
15. Turn cookies over and bake an additional 20 minutes
16. Remove from baking sheet and cool completely on a wire rack

title: crock pot roast pork
steps:
1. Rub pork roast with salt and pepper
2. Make tiny slits in meat and insert slivers of garlic
3. Place in broiler pan and broil about 15-20 minutes to remove excess fat
4. Check frequently
5. Mix hot water and soy sauce
6. Put one sliced onion in bottom of crockpot
7. Add browned pork roast and remaining onion and other ingredients
8. Cover and cook on high for 4 or so hours
9. Low setting would probably be 6-8 hours
10. To thicken gravy: remove roast to serving platter
11. Blend 2 tablespoons cornstarch with 2 tablespoons cold water to form a smooth paste
12. Stir well and let come to a boil
13. Doesn't get too thick which is how we like it)

title: pancit
steps:
1. Boil pork chops for 30-45 minutes
2. Let pork chops cool and pull apart into bite size pieces
3. Remove the fat
4. Reserve broth
5. Soak rice noodles in cold water for 10-15 min until soft
6. Heat oil and saute onions and garlic until soft
7. Add celery and carrots continue stir frying for 2-3 minutes
8. Add cabbage and stir fry for about 5 minutes more
9. Add green beans and stir fry for 1-2 minutes
10. Add about 1 / 4 c broth and 1 / 4 c soy sauce and bring to a boil
11. Pull noodles apart with hands to make in closer to bite size pieces before draining
12. Add 1 / 4 c broth , if needed
13. Add noodles and mix together
14. Serve immediately

title: cauliflower almondine
steps:
1. Cook cauliflower in water until slightly tender
2. Drain and arrange in small casserole dish
3. Then heat soup and stir in almonds
4. Pour over cauliflower
5. Top with mixed butter and corn flake crumbs
6. Bake 10 minutes in 325 degree oven

title: turkey or chicken rice casserole
steps:
1. Cook rice according to the package directions
2. Cube turkey or chicken
3. Dice celery and onions
4. Combine soup and mayonnaise
5. Add to other ingredients
6. Place in large , buttered casserole dish
7. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes , until it is heated through
8. Add topping and bake an additional 1 / 2 hour until the casserole is golden and bubbling

title: ethiopian tomato   cucumber salad
steps:
1. Toss together all ingredients except olive oil
2. Sprinkle with olive oil

title: smoked salmon fettuccine with healthy dill alfredo sauce
steps:
1. Boil and prepare fettuccine as directed on package instructions
2. Drain and set aside
3. Place cottage cheese , 1 tbsp parmesan cheese , flour , black pepper , lemon juice , garlic , and dill weed in a food processor bowl and pulse until smooth
4. Set aside
5. In a large nonstick pan or wok , heat oil over medium heat and saute green pepper and onion for about 3 minutes
6. Turn heat down to low or low-medium and allow the pan to cool enough that the next ingredients won't burn
7. Add tomatoes , capers , salmon , and sauce to the pan
8. Stir and cook for 1-2 minutes or until heated through
9. Add pasta and parsley and continue to cook on low for 1-2 minutes
10. Remove from heat and serve , topping individual servings with pepper , lemon pepper , and parmesan to taste

title: chicken in a barbecue sauce
steps:
1. Sweat diced onion and diced green pepper in oil for 10 - 15 minutes
2. Add all the other ingredients to the pepper and onion
3. Cook in the oven at 180oc , 350of or gas mark 4 for 30 - 40 minutes

title: semi homemade italian sausages   peppers
steps:
1. In a large skillet , mix together spaghetti sauce , peppers , onions and drained tomatoes
2. Set your sausage links in the sauce
3. Cover and simmer on med-low for 45 minutes
4. If sauce is thick enough for you , move on to the next step
5. Otherwise , if you prefer a thicker sauce , remove the sausages and thicken your marinara sauce by adding 1 tsp of cornstarch mixed with 1 tbsp cold water to your sauce , turn up to med-high heat and bring to a boil , return it to a simmer for 5 more minutes and it should be plenty thick
6. To serve , place one sausage on your plate , cover with 1 / 2 cup of sauce and sprinkle with the cheeses to your liking
7. Enjoy !

title: four bean chilli
steps:
1. Heat oil , cook celery and onion
2. Cook about 6 minutes till soft
3. Add garlic and chilli , cook 2 minutes
4. Add tomatoes and beans , bring to boil
5. Simmer 20 minutes , add lime juice
6. Add salt and pepper to taste
7. Serve with sour cream and chopped coriander on top

title: davy crockett bars
steps:
1. Mix together flour , sugar , salt , baking powder , and baking soda
2. Mix in brown sugar , oats , and chocolate chips
3. Combine eggs , oil , and vanilla
4. Stir into chocolate chip mixture
5. Press into an ungreased 15x10x1 inch jelly roll pan
6. Bake at 350f for 15 minutes or until lightly browned
7. Cool slightly before cutting

title: spice em  up pork chops
steps:
1. Mix first 4 ingredients
2. Dredge chops
3. Brown chops in oil on both sides
4. Cook chops 8 minutes
5. Mix sauce ingredients
6. Pour over chops
7. Cover and simmer for about 20 minutes , until chops are tender

title: easy baked chicken parmesan  no breading
steps:
1. The morning or the night before serving , combine italian dressing , ranch dressing , 3 tablespoons minced garlic and 2 tablespoons olive oil in a large zip lock bag
2. Squish bag around to combine all ingredients
3. Add chicken breasts to bag , close and squish until they are well coated in the dressing mixture
4. Put the bag in bowl and refrigerate all day or overnight up 24 hours
5. When ready to cook , preheat oven to 400f
6. Then mix 2 cups parmesan cheese , with parsley , 1 1 / 2 tablespoons of the basil and oregano
7. Spray a large baking dish with olive oil cooking spray
8. Remove chicken from baggie one by one and "dredge" in the cheese and spice mixture , until thoroughly coated in cheese mixture
9. Then place chicken in a single layer in the dish
10. When all chicken is coated , place chicken in oven and bake for 20-25 minutes
11. While chicken bakes , in a large non stick sauce pan , make the sauce
12. Spray sauce pan with olive oil cooking spray
13. Then saute onions and remaining garlic until tender and onions are translucent
14. Add tomato paste and tomato sauce to garlic and onions
15. Stir until smooth
16. Then add the remaining , oregano and basil and the other spices including the bay leaf
17. Allow to simmer for the remainder of the baking time until you need it
18. When chicken has baked 20 minutes , remove from oven and top each breast with sauce then top with 1 / 4 cup of mozarella cheese put baking dish back into the oven for 10 more minutes or until cheese is bubbly
19. Then switch your broiler on to brown cheese
20. Remove from oven and sprinkle with remaining parmesan cheese
21. Serve it up , i have never had anyone not finish this !

title: fantasy fudge
steps:
1. Line a 9-inch square pan with foil , with ends of foil extending over sides of pan
2. Combine sugar , butter , and evaporated milk in a large heavy saucepan and bring to a full rolling boil over medium heat , stirring constantly
3. Boil 4 minutes or until candy thermometer reaches 234f , stirring constantly to prevent scorching
4. Remove from heat
5. Add chocolate and marshmallow creme
6. Stir until completely melted
7. Add vanilla and mix well
8. Pour immediately into prepared pan and spread to form even layer in pan
9. Let stand at room temperature until completely cooled , about 4 hours
10. Cut into 1-inch squares
11. Store in tightly covered container at room temperature
12. You can package up a few pieces together for gift giving

title: crappy grabbies  for freezing ahead of time
steps:
1. In medium bowl , blend first 6 ingredients until well blended
2. Stir in crab meat and parsley
3. Spread crab mixture evenly on each english muffin half , all the way to the edges
4. Don't scrimp , you'll have plenty for each muffin
5. Using a bread knife , cut each muffin half into 4 quarters
6. Place crabby grabbies on cookie sheets , making sure they are not touching each other
7. Place cookie sheet in freezer overnight
8. Place frozen grabbies in freezer safe container or in freezer bags and store in the freezer
9. To bake: preheat oven to 350 degrees
10. Place frozen grabbies on cookie sheet and bake until browned and bubbly , 10-15 minutes

title: southern short ribs
steps:
1. Sprinkle salt and pepper on all sides of short ribs and place in a 3-quart dish
2. Heat oven to 275f
3. In a small pan combine tomato sauce with molasses , vinegar , worcestershire and onion , bring to a boil and simmer 5 minutes
4. Pour over short ribs , cover and bake 3 to 4 hours or until very tender
5. Spoon off excess fat before serving

title: rollin s garlic butter spread
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a small bowl
2. Stir until well combined
3. Spread over cut french bread or rolls
4. Broil in oven until toasty and golden brown

title: black raspberry cream pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 f
2. Brush pie shell with egg white
3. Bake for 5 minutes , let cool
4. Beat whipping cream on medium high until stiff peaks form
5. Set aside
6. Beat cream cheese until smooth
7. Add black raspberry spread
8. Beat until combined
9. Fold in whipping cream
10. Spoon mixture into pie shell
11. Cover and freeze for at least 4 hours
12. Garnish with black raspberries and lemon twist and mint

title: autumn harvest soup
steps:
1. Heat olive oil in a heavy bottomed soup pot and saute bacon for 3 minutes
2. Pour off any excess fat
3. Add onions and garlic continuing to cook until onions are softened
4. Add leeks , celery , carrots , butternut squash and soaked white beans along with thyme and rosemary
5. Saute for 2 more minutes
6. Pour in chicken stock and bring to a boil
7. Turn down heat and simmer slowly for 1 1 / 2 hour or until beans are tender
8. Adjust final seasoning

title: aunt dot s hot dish
steps:
1. Brown hamburger in skillet
2. Boil noodles
3. Mix beef , noodles , mushrooms , olives , cheese , and salt together
4. Pour into a greased casserole dish
5. Mix soup and milk together
6. Pour on top of the casserole ingredients
7. Bake at 375 degrees for 40 minutes total
8. After about 25 minutes sprinkle the casserole with one cup of chow mein noodles
9. Put back in oven to brown the noodles for the last 15 minutes

title: coffee bourbon barbecue sauce
steps:
1. Simmer all ingredients in a 2 1 / 2- to 3-quart heavy saucepan , uncovered , stirring occasionally , until reduced to about 1 cup , 15 to 20 minutes
2. Cool to room temperature
3. Serve with steak or chicken

title: sesame peanut candy
steps:
1. Combine sugar , vinegar and water in a medium saucepan and cook over low heat , stirring just until sugar dissolves
2. Continue to cook without stirring until mixture boils
3. Allow to boil without stirring until mixture is golden and reaches 300 f on a candy thermometer , about ten minutes
4. While the sugar mixture is boiling , generously butter an 11" x 7" baking pan
5. Sprinkle half the sesame seeds and all of the peanuts evenly onto the pan
6. When the sugar mixture has reached the requisite temperature , carefully pour the sugar mixture over the nuts in the baking pan
7. Smooth the surface with the back of a buttered wooden spoon
8. Sprinkle with the remaining sesame seeds and cool slightly
9. While candy is still warm , cut into 2" by 1" pieces and then allow to cool completely in the pan
10. Remove from pan and enjoy !

title: snappy gingersnaps
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. On your mixer using the paddle attachment , beat the butter and sugar until light and creamy
3. Add the egg and the molasses and beat until incorporated
4. Scrape down the bowl , then add the remaining ingredients and mix on low speed until everything is combined
5. Do not overmix
6. Using about 1 tablespoon of dough per cookie , roll into balls and place them 2 inches apart on parchment lined pans
7. Bake until flat and evenly browned , about 13 minutes
8. Cool on the pan , the remove to a rack to finish cooling
9. These cookies are best the day they are baked , but will keep for several days
10. That's how i make them

title: beef semur
steps:
1. Slice steak thinly and set aside
2. Brown the onions , garlic , ginger and candle nuts in the peanut oil
3. Add the meat slices and water chestnuts , cook for 5 minutes
4. Add the soy sauce and water and cook for at least 35 minutes
5. Salt and pepper may be added to taste
6. Serve over jasmine rice or plain rice

title: jolean s simple benedictine dip
steps:
1. Mix sour cream with cream cheese
2. Add vinegar , celery salt , chives , and 1-2 drops food coloring
3. Fold in the finely chopped cucumber
4. Chill for at least 1 hour

title: super savory shrimp fajitas
steps:
1. Combine all seasonings and mix well
2. Take out 1 tbsp for later use
3. Combine the seasoning blend with 1 / 4 cup olive oil , garlic and shrimp
4. Toss to mix well
5. Set aside
6. Heat the 2 tbsp of olive oil in skillet and saute onions until softened
7. Add peppers and continue to saute until tender
8. Sprinkle the reserved tablespoon of seasoning blend over vegetables and stir to mix well
9. Remove the vegetables from the skillet and set aside
10. Add shrimp to skillet and cook until shrimp are cooked through
11. This will only take about 3 to 5 minutes
12. Add the vegetables back into the skillet and toss to combine
13. Serve in warm tortillas with cilantro , juice of lime , and sour cream

title: fountain style vanilla malt shake
steps:
1. In a blender mix together milk , ginger ale , malted milk powder and vanilla for a few seconds just to combine
2. Add in vanilla ice cream and blend until smooth
3. Pour into large tall chilled glass / s with a long straw
4. Delicious !

title: pasta with sausage  tomatoes  and cream
steps:
1. Heat oil in a heavy skillet over medium heat
2. Add sausage and crushed red pepper
3. Cook until sausage is no longer pink , stirring frequently , about 7 minutes
4. Add onion and garlic to skillet and cook until onion is tender and sausage is light brown , stirring occasionally , about 7 minutes
5. Add tomatoes , cream , and salt
6. Simmer until mixture thickens slightly , about 4 minutes
7. Cook pasta in large pot of boiling water
8. Drain
9. Bring sauce to a simmer
10. Add pasta to sauce and cook until pasta is heated through and sauce thickens , stirring occasionally , about 2 minutes
11. Divide pasta between plates
12. Sprinkle with parsley
13. Serve , passing parmesan separately

title: lazy mom s focaccia
steps:
1. Prheat oven to 425 f and lighly grease a large baking sheet to cover an 8x10" area
2. Unroll dough onto the greased area of pan , pressing any seams together and forming into an oblong shape - it can be an uneven shape
3. Using a wooden spoon hadle
4. Sprinkle dough evenly with olives , rosemary , salt , and pepper , then drizzle with the oil
5. Bkae 12-15 minutes , or until bottom and edges are golden brown
6. Remove to a cutting board and cut into 12 squares , strips or triangles- they can be uneven shapes
7. Serve warm
