title: duck breast scaloppine
steps:
1. Pound boneless skinless duck breasts until very thin
2. Spread 1 t of honey on each breast
3. Dip duck breasts into buttermilk and then the buckwheat flour
4. Bake in 350 degree oven for 30 minutes , or until breasts are cooked through
5. Serve over 1 cup of brown rice
6. Steamed veggies go well with this dish

title: oven fried cajun chicken breasts
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425f
2. Place chicken in a shallow nonmetal dish and pour the buttermilk over the pieces , turning to coat
3. Cover and refrigerate several hours or overnight
4. Combine cornflake crumbs , paprika and cajun seasoning in a gallon size plastic bag
5. Close the bag and shake well to mix
6. Take one piece of chicken at a time out of the buttermilk , place in coating bag and shake to coat evenly
7. Place on a baking sheet or stoneware pan
8. Repeat with remaining chicken
9. Lightly spritz each piece with nonstick vegetable spray or an olive oil spray
10. Bake at 425 f for 20-25 minutes

title: maori   new zealand  fry bread
steps:
1. Stir together water , yeast , sugar and 2 tablespoons flour
2. Leave to stand for 15 minutes in a warm position
3. At the end of 15 minutes this should have about 2 inches of froth on top
4. In a large bowl put in 8-10 cups plain flour
5. Add a pinch of salt and stir
6. Make a well in centre and add the yeast mixture
7. Gradually stir in flour but don't add too much flour at once - a light hand is the story
8. When the liquid has absorbed as much flour as necessary for it to be kneaded place on a floured board and knead until you can sit the dough in the palm of hand
9. Spread some plain flour on a baking board
10. Let this stand for 15 minutes -- this is the working time for the yeast and the dough should be nice and spongy and fluffy
11. As soon as i have let the dough stand for 15 minutes i prepare my cooking pot
12. Sufficient lard , dripping , cooking oil or tallow to cover at least 1 / 3 of cooking utensil
13. Heat until blue smoke rises
14. Cooking
15. Again ! don't worry overly much about the dough
16. If it fluffs up nice and spongy and fat is not ready to fry bread , then just knead the dough again and let stand , but perhaps for only 10 minutes this time
17. All things being equal , the dough and the fat should be ready together by this time
18. So press the dough out
19. Cut into required shaped , pressing to about 1 / 4 inch thick
20. Fry one side , then brown fry other side and there is your bread
21. Well , hope you enjoy your cooking and eating
22. Signed -- ngati tarwhai cooks

title: ocean spray s cranberry nut bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease a 9 x 5-inch loaf pan
3. Mix together flour , sugar , baking powder , salt and baking soda in a medium mixing bowl
4. Stir in orange juice , oil , orange peel and egg
5. Mix until well blended
6. Stir in cranberries and nuts
7. Spread evenly in loaf pan
8. Bake for 55 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean
9. Cool on rack for 15 minutes
10. Remove from pan and cool completely

title: durgin park cornbread
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f
2. In a large mixing bowl mix the flour , cornmeal , salt , sugar , and baking powder
3. Beat the eggs and add to the dry ingredients alternately with the milk
4. Mix by hand
5. Do not use a mixer
6. Pour the mixture into an 11 x 13-inch baking dish and bake for 35 to 40 minutes
7. Cut into squares and serve hot

title: crock pot italian beef sandwiches
steps:
1. Spray crock pot with cooking spray
2. Cut roast in half
3. Put roast in crockpot and add all ingredients
4. Cook for 7-8 hours on low or until beef is cooked to your desire
5. Remove roast and shred
6. Put shredded beef back in broth to blend
7. With slotted spoon put beef on bun

title: blueberry jam   half recipe
steps:
1. Place crushed blueberries in a medium-sized pot
2. Add lemon juice and water and mix gently
3. Stir-in only half packet of the pectin
4. Save the other half for another half recipe
5. Bring to a boil and boil for one minute
6. Add the sugar
7. Bring again to a boil and boil hard for one minute
8. Remove from heat and skim any foam
9. Ladle into half pint jars
10. Adjust caps and process 8 minutes

title: najla s lemon chicken
steps:
1. Melt the butter in a saucepan and saut the onion and garlic
2. Add the chicken and cook on each side for about a minute , then pour in the water mixture and cook , turning until there is no liquid left
3. Remove the chicken and set aside
4. Use the lemon juice to make some gravy , then pour the gravy on the chicken
5. My sister serves this with french fries

title: it needs something   creamy chicken and noodles
steps:
1. Cook egg noodles according to package directions
2. In a saute pan , saute onions and garlic in olive oil until onions are clear
3. Add chicken and heat until browned
4. Add mushrooms and cook until softened
5. Mix chicken broth with cooking creme and poor over chicken mixture
6. Add roasted red pepper and spices and allow to simmer for 15 to 20 minutes
7. If too thin
8. Mix a teaspoon of cornstarch with a little more chicken broth and add to pan
9. Mix well to thicken
10. Serve over egg noodles

title: clam risotto
steps:
1. In a 2 quart saucepan melt butter over medium heat
2. Saute minced shallots in butter until soft but not browned
3. Add the rice and cook until the rice becomes translucent
4. Add the wine and cook until nearly dry
5. Add one cup of hot , not boiling , clam juice
6. Stir the rice continually as it cooks
7. When the rice absorbs all the juice add another cup and continue to stir the rice
8. Continue in this manner until you add the last cup of clam juice
9. At this time the rice should be fully cooked
10. If not add a little water and continue to stir and cook until the rice is just cooked through
11. Next , add the clam meat and cook for one minute
12. Add the cream and season the rice to taste
13. Cook for one additional minute
14. Serve immediately

title: sesame noodle vegetable toss
steps:
1. Cook noodles according to package , drain , and rinse with cold water
2. Meanwhile , in small bowl , combine all dressing ingredients , and blend well
3. In large bowl , combine all salad ingredients , and mix well
4. Add cooked noodles to salad
5. Mix gently
6. Pour dressing over salad , and toss to coat

title: dive on in cake
steps:
1. Prepare and bake cake mix in 13x9-inch baking pan as directed on package
2. Cool completely
3. Invert cake onto large platter
4. Remove pan
5. Using a serrated knife , cut and scoop out a shallow rectangle from center of cake , leaving a 2-inch border of cake on all sides and a thin layer of cake on the bottom
6. Reserve removed cake for snacking or other use
7. Stir boiling water into dry gelatin mix in large bowl at least 2 minute until completely dissolved
8. Stir in cold water
9. Refrigerate 1-1 / 4 hours or until slightly thickened
10. (shortcut: for a quick-set gelatin , simply add 4 cups ice cubes to the dissolved gelatin mixture in place of the 1 cup cold water
11. Stir 8 minute or until gelatin begins to thicken
12. Remove any unmelted ice
13. Pour thickened gelatin into center of cake
14. Refrigerate 3 hours or until set
15. Frost borders of cake with whipped topping
16. Decorate with remaining ingredients as desired to resemble a swimming pool
17. Store leftover cake in refrigerator
18. Fun idea: insert bite-size fish-shaped and octopus-shaped chewy fruit snacks into gelatin "pool" before refrigerating for an added treat !

title: salisbury steak with wine sauce
steps:
1. In a large skillet cook bacon over moderatly-high heat
2. Cook until crisp and browned , about 5 minutes
3. Transfer bacon to paper towels and set aside
4. Reserve drippings in the skillet
5. Core and seed the bell pepper
6. Cut into strips , add mushrooms , onions and bell pepper to the drippings in the skillet
7. Cook stirring frequently , until crisp tender , about 4 minutes
8. Meanwhile , shape ground beef into 4 oval steaks about 3 / 4 inch thick
9. Sprinkle on both sides with salt and pepper
10. Transfer vegetables to a warm serving platter , cover and keep warm
11. Cook steaks until they are well browned , about 3 minutes on each side for medium
12. Place the steaks on top of vegetable mixture , cover , and keep them warm
13. Add wine and thyme to the skillet
14. Bring mixture to a boil , stirring and scraping bottom of skillet
15. Pour the wine sauce over the steaks
16. Crumble the bacon over the sauce and serve

title: super  shrooms
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f
2. Remove stems from the mushrooms
3. Wipe the caps clean
4. Arrange the caps , upside down , in single layer in a baking dish , preferably glass
5. Rinse and finely chop the stems
6. In a mixing bowl , combine chopped stems with crab , onions , cream cheese , mayonnaise , and tabasco
7. Add a little celery or garlic if desired
8. Salt to taste
9. Fill each mushroom cap with some of the mixture
10. Add enough water to cover the bottom of the baking dish
11. Sprinkle each cap with parmesan cheese
12. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes , or until they are hot through and the cheese has browned

2. After you cook your ground beef add maybe a 1 / 4 cup of water and add mix
3. Right before you serve sprinkle salt substitute on beef
4. You taste it more and end up using less salt
5. Your heart will thank you

title: pineapple and cheese salad
steps:
1. Drain the pineapple rings reserving all the syrup
2. In a small saucepan combine sugar , flour , beaten eggs and reserved syrup from the can of pineapple rings
3. Cook the mixture over medium high heat stirring constantly until thickened
4. Remove from heat and allow sauce to cool completely
5. Cut pineapple rings into bite-size pieces
6. Stir completely cooled sauce , pineapple pieces , cheese pieces and mini marshmallows together until everything is well coated with sauce
7. Refrigerate until serving

title: romanian potato salad
steps:
1. Cut the potatoes in bite size pieces
2. Cut the onion in half and moon slice it
3. Add the rest of the ingredients
4. Optional:black olives and parsley leaves

title: mac n cheese for grown ups
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Butter 3-4 quart square baking dish
3. In 4 quart saucepan over medium heat , melt 6 tablespoons of butter
4. Stir in flour , cook , stirring , 1 minuted
5. Add bay leaf
6. Slowly whisk in milk until smooth
7. Simmer , whisking occasionally , 14-16 minutes
8. Discard bay leaf
9. Whisk in creme fraiche and 1 1 / 2 teaspoon fleur de sel
10. Bring to simmer
11. Off heat , stir in 1 1 / 2 cups each mozzarella and cheedar
12. Season with fleur de sel and white pepper
13. In large bowl , combine pasta and cheese sauce
14. Stir in 2 cups mozzarella
15. Transfer to prepared casserole dish
16. Sprinkle with remaining 1 / 2 cup mozzarella and cheddar , then with bread crumbs
17. Bake 30 minutes
18. Let stand 10 minutes before serving

title: fill you up tuna noodle casserole
steps:

2. Preheat oven to 350 degrees

title: pressure cooker lentil soup
steps:
1. In your pressure cooker , sweat the onions and garlic in the olive oil until the onions are translucent
2. Add the carrots and celery and saute for a minute or two
3. Add the ground cumin and stir well
4. Add the vegetable broth , lentils , and bay leaves , close the pressure cooker , and bring up to pressure
5. Cook for 20 minutes
6. Open the pressure cooker via the quick release method or let the pressure come down on its own
7. Remove the bay leaves
8. If desired , stir in the spinach , and stir until it wilts
9. Season with salt and fresh ground pepper to taste

title: riviera spa salad
steps:
1. Broil the red pepper half until the skin blisters and chars
2. Let cool and remove the skin
3. When the pepper is cooled and peeled , dice them
4. Clean the green beans , remove the ends , and cut into smaller pieces if desired - they look better long but are easier to eat small - you can always cut them up on the plate
5. Blanch the green beans in boiling water for about 6 minutes
6. Make the dressing: mix the yogurt , vinegar , and garlic , then mix in the rest of the dressing ingredients
7. These amounts are for 2 servings , so you'll use half of everything on each plate:
8. On each plate , arrange green beans , chickpeas , and tuna each on a third of the plate
9. Sprinkle the capers over the tuna
10. Sprinkle the diced roasted red pepper over the chickpeas
11. Pour as much dressing as desired over each salad

title: reduced calorie banana bread
steps:
1. In a medium mixing bowl stir together flour , baking powder , baking soda , cinnamon , and salt , set aside
2. In a large mixing bowl stir together egg whites , banana , sugar , and oil
3. Stir flour mixture into banana mixture until just moistened
4. Spray a 8x4x2-inch loaf pan with nonstick cooking spray
5. Spread batter in prepared pan
6. Bake in a 350 degree oven 45 to 50 minutes or until toothpick inserted near middle comes out clean
7. Cool bread in the pan for 10 minutes
8. Remove from pan and cool throughly on a wire rack
9. For eaiser slicing , wrap the bread in plastic wrap and store overnight
10. Make ahead directions
11. Cool completely , wrap in release foil , then seal in a plastic bag , freeze for up to 3 months

title: giant upside down pecan rolls
steps:
1. For the rolls ~ in a large mixer bowl , dissolve yeast in warm water , then add 3 / 4 cup sugar , milk , 1 / 2 cup butter , salt , egg , egg yolk & 3 cups flour , & beat on medium speed for 3 minutes
2. Stir in enough of the remaining flour to form a soft dough , then turn onto a floured surface & knead about 6 to 8 minutes or until smooth & elastic
3. Place in a greased bowl , turning once to grease the top , then cover & let rise in a warm place until doubled , about 1 1 / 2 hours
4. After that time , punch the dough down & turn onto a lightly floured surface
5. Roll it into a 24-inch by 18-inch rectangle
6. Melt the remaining butter & brush it over the dough
7. Combine cinnamon & remaining 1 cup of sugar , then sprinkle that over the dough to within 1 / 2 inch of the edges
8. Sprinkle the chopped pecans onto the dough in a similar fashion , then , starting with a short side , roll up the dough jelly-roll style
9. Pinch the seam to seal it , then cut the roll into 6 slices
10. Grease a 13"x9" baking dish
11. For the syrup ~ in a saucepan , combine the brown sugar , butter & water , bringing it to a boil , then boiling & stirring for 1 minute
12. Pour this syrup into the prepared baking dish , & arrange the pecan halves , flat side up , over the syrup
13. Place the rolls cut side down over the peacns , pressing down on each roll gently , before covering & letting rise in a warm place for 1 hour or until doubled in size
14. After that time , beat the egg white & the water & brush it over the rolls , before baking for 35 to 40 minutes or until golden brown
15. Immediately invert onto a serving platter & allow to cool somewhat before devouring them completely !

title: chicken curry with whole spices
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a pan and fry the cumin seeds till they start to pop
2. Add the onions , ginger , garlic and red chillies , fry till onions are soft , do not brown them
3. Add the cinnamon , cloves , cardamoms and allspice stir and fry for 1 minute
4. Add the turmeric and paprika , stir and add the chicken
5. Fry for 5 mins over medium heat
6. Add water and salt , bring to boil , cover the pan and cook on low heat for 20 minutes
7. Add the tomatoes , green chilli and the ground almonds stir and cook a further 6 minutes
8. Stir in the coriander leaves and serve

title: lemon orzo with baby spinach and feta
steps:
1. Cook orzo according to package directions
2. Drain and rinse under cold water to stop the cooking
3. Toss with 1 tablespoon olive oil
4. Reserve
5. Heat a large heavy bottomed , wide-surfaced saut pan , until very hot
6. Reduce heat to medium-high
7. Add vegetable oil and sliced onions
8. Cook onions on high for about 10 minutes , adding up to 1 tablespoon more oil if pan becomes dry
9. Reduce heat to medium-low , add garlic and continue to cook for another 20 minutes until golden
10. In a large bowl , combine reserved orzo with green onions , feta cheese , baby spinach , mint , olive oil , lemon zest and lemon juice
11. Toss to mix
12. Add caramelized onion and garlic mixture
13. Season with salt and pepper
14. Can be made 2 days in advance
15. Keep refrigerated until serving

title: pork   shrimp spring roll with peanut sauce
steps:
1. Place the pork tenderloin in a bowl with the shallot , garlic , fish sauce , sugar , black pepper , and oil , if using , and turn to coat
2. Cover with plastic wrap and marinate , turning occasionally , at least 1 hour and up to overnight in the refrigerator
3. Preheat a grill to high
4. Grill the tenderloin , turning occasionally , until just cooked through and an instant-read thermometer registers an internal temperature of 145 degrees f
5. Transfer tenderloin to a plate and set aside to cool to room temperature before proceeding
6. Once cooled , slice tenderloin into 1 / 8-inch thick slices and set aside , covered and refrigerated , until you are ready to assemble the spring rolls
7. Prepare the rice vermicelli according to package directions and strain in a colander
8. Run under cold running water until cool and set aside to drain
9. Assemble the rolls 1 at a time: dip 1 spring roll wrapper into lukewarm water and quickly transfer to a clean kitchen towel
10. Lay 4 shrimp halves in a horizontal line across the center of each wrapper and top with a few tablespoons of cooked vermicelli
11. Top the vermicelli with 1 or 2 slices of cucumber , 2 tablespoons or so of the shredded romaine , 4 mint leaves , 2 sprigs of cilantro , and 4 basil leaves
12. Place a few sticks of carrot julienne along the top of the filling ingredients and top with 2 slices of pork
13. Carefully pull the lower edge of the wrapper up and over the filling
14. Fold the 2 sides inward over the filling and press to seal
15. Work carefully so as not to tear the wrapper
16. Once both sides are folded inward over the filling , roll the spring roll upwards so that the filling is tightly contained and roll up to seal
17. Set the spring roll aside on a plate , covered with a damp paper towel or damp clean kitchen towel
18. Repeat with the remaining wrappers and filling
19. Once you have assembled all of the spring rolls , serve them immediately either at room temperature or slightly chilled , with the peanut sauce on the side for dipping
20. Directions for peanut sauce: heat the oil in a small saucepan and , when hot , add the garlic , chile paste , and tomato paste , and cook until garlic is golden , about 30 seconds
21. Add the broth , sugar , peanut butter and hoisin sauce and whisk to combine
22. Bring to a boil , reduce the heat and simmer for 3 minutes
23. Remove from the heat and cool slightly before serving
24. Serve in small bowls , garnished with the peanuts , sliced chiles and optional hot sauce
25. May be served warm or at room temperature
26. Yield: about 1 1 / 4 cups

title: shortcut filipino style ensaymada especial
steps:
1. Take a sweet roll
2. Spread butter on top
3. Sprinkle sugar over the butter
4. Garnish with cheese and ham
5. Eat & enjoy !

title: heritage bread and butter pickle   pickled cucumber and onions
steps:
1. Layer the sliced onions and cucumber in a large non-metallic bowl - sprinkling each layer with the salt
2. Leave for one hour and then drain and rinse thoroughly
3. Put the vinegar , sugar , celery and mustard seeds into a large saucepan and heat gently , stirring all the time until the sugar has dissolved
4. Then bring it to a rapid boil and boil for 3 minutes
5. Pack the cucumbers and onions into pre-heated and sterilised jars - then pour over the hot vinegar mixture , making sure that it covers the vegetabes
6. Seal immediately with sterilised and vinegar proof lids
7. Keep in a dark and cool storage area for 2 months before using
8. Use this pickle for: bread and butter , sandwiches , salads , toasted snacks , cheese , cold meats and pies
9. Ideal for picnics

title: easy no knead dutch oven crusty bread
steps:
1. In a large bowl , dissolve yeast in water
2. Add the flour and salt , stirring until blended
3. The dough will be shaggy and sticky
4. Cover bowl with plastic wrap
5. Let the dough rest at least 8 hours , preferably 12 to 18 , at warm room temperature , about 70 degrees
6. The dough is ready when its surface is dotted with bubbles
7. Lightly flour a work surface and place dough on it
8. Sprinkle it with a little more flour and fold it over on itself once or twice
9. Cover loosely with plastic wrap and let it rest for about 15 minutes
10. Using just enough flour to keep the dough from sticking to the work surface or to your fingers , gently shape it into a ball
11. Generously coat a clean dish towel with flour , wheat bran or cornmeal
12. Put the seam side of the dough down on the towel and dust with more flour , bran or cornmeal
13. Cover with another towel and let rise for about 1 to 2 hours
14. When its ready , the dough will have doubled in size and will not readily spring back when poked with a finger
15. At least 20 minutes before the dough is ready , heat oven to 475 degrees
16. Put a 6- to 8-quart heavy covered pot in the oven as it heats
17. When the dough is ready , carefully remove the pot from the oven and lift off the lid
18. Slide your hand under the towel and turn the dough over into the pot , seam side up
19. The dough will lose its shape a bit in the process , but thats ok
20. Give the pan a firm shake or two to help distribute the dough evenly , but dont worry if its not perfect
21. It will straighten out as it bakes
22. Cover and bake for 30 minutes
23. Remove the lid and bake another 15 to 20 minutes , until the loaf is beautifully browned
24. Remove the bread from the dutch oven and let it cool on a rack for at least 1 hour before slicing

title: patchwork veggie pizza
steps:
1. With crescent rolls , press to form rectangle on 15x12 inch pan
2. Bake at 375 for 11 to 13 minutes , until golden brown
3. Cool completely
4. Combine cream cheese and salad dressing
5. Spread over crust
6. Mark off 20 squares with knife
7. Fill each square with one vegetable to form patchwork
8. Refrigerate or serve immediately
9. You can mix the vegetables up if you like
10. Feel free to put whatever vegs
11. You like in it
12. Enjoy !
13. For a change , use ranch dressing instead of italian

title: the best chicken and sausage kebabs ever
steps:
1. Cut the chicken and sausage into thick pieces of roughly equal size and place in a large ziploc bag
2. In a small bowl or measuring cup , whisk together the remaining ingredients for the marinade
3. Pour the marinade into the ziploc bag with the meat , seal and distribute so all of the meat is covered with marinade
4. Let sit for a minimum of two hours or up to eight
5. When finished marinating , skewer the meat onto metal or wooden skewers , alternating two pieces of sausage , then two pieces of chicken
6. Grill for 20 minutes or until done , turning the kebabs once halfway during cooking
7. Serve on a platter , and take the meat off the skewers at the table
8. It makes a nice presentation

title: eggs and chickpeas in spicy tomato sauce
steps:
1. Simmer sauce in a skillet along with jalepeno juice , olive oil , sea salt
2. Carefully break whole eggs into the simmering sauce
3. Add the chickpeas and sliced jalepenos
4. Allow eggs to firm up and whiten
5. You can serve the eggs like this or flip them in the sauce carefully and cook on the other side depending on preference
6. Remove some sauce and chickpeas and place eggs on top
7. Sprinkle some cheese
8. Server with yogurt if prefered and fresh pita bread

title: asian snow peas and carrots
steps:
1. In a custard cup stir together 1 / 4 c water , soy sauce , cornstarch , and crushed red pepper
2. Micro-cook , uncovered , on 100% power for 1 to 1 1 / 2 minutes or till thickened and bubbly , stirring every 30 seconds
3. Saute carrot in a little oil over medium heat
4. Add snow peas and walnuts
5. Saute till the vegetables are crisp-tender
6. Add soy sauce mixture and serve immediately

title: kittencal s marinated vegetables
steps:
1. Bring a large pot of water to a boil
2. Add in the cauliflower and broccoli
3. Blanch for 1 minute
4. Drain then immediately plunge into ice or very cold water to stop the cooking process
5. Drain well
6. In a large glass bowl combine all veggies with the olives
7. In a small bowl whisk together all marinade ingredients until completely combined and no sugar or salt granules remain
8. Pour over veggies
9. Toss well , cover and chill for 24 hours before serving

title: ukrainian cabbage rolls with mushrooms and mushroom sauce
steps:
1. Prepare the rice according to the directions on the package
2. Remove the core from the cabbage and place the full head in a large pot of boiling water
3. Cover and cook for about 3 minutes
4. Remove the cabbage from the water and let cool until it's easy to handle
5. Then remove the softened whole leaves from the head and stack them on a platter for filling
6. Thin out the tough vein near the stem portion of the leaf to make easier rolling
7. Prepare the mushroom filling by placing the dried and bottled mushrooms in a medium saucepan
8. Cover with water and bring the mushrooms to a boil over medium-high heat
9. Reduce the heat to simmer and continue to cook the mushrooms for about 1 hour
10. Strain off the liquid and grind the mushrooms in a food processor or blender
11. Meanwhile , melt two tablespoons of butter in a large skillet over medium heat and saut the two medium chopped onions until transparent , about 5 minutes
12. Mix the two medium sauted onions with the mushrooms and a dash of salt and pepper to taste
13. Saut the one large chopped onion in two tablespoons of butter in a skillet over medium heat until transparent
14. Add the mushroom filling and cooked rice to the large fried onion
15. Line the bottom of a casserole dish with cabbage leaves not suitable for stuffing
16. Save about 6 good , whole leaves and fill the stem portion of each leaf with 2 or 3 heaping tablespoons of the rice mixture
17. Place the stuffed leaves seam-side down in the casserole dish
18. Prepare the mushroom sauce by melting two tablespoons of butter in a large skillet over medium heat
19. Saut the 1 / 4 cup chopped onions until tender
20. Add the one cup of freshly chopped mushrooms and cook for about 10 minutes
21. Sprinkle the flour over the mixture and blend well
22. Slowly pour in the broth and stir constantly until the mixture thickens
23. Remove from the heat source and stir in the parsley , then season with salt and pepper to taste
24. Let the sauce cool a bit , then add the sour cream and blend well
25. Cover the stuffed cabbages with the mushroom sauce and bake the casserole , uncovered , in a 350-f degree oven for one to one-and-a-half hours
26. Serve warm
27. Makes a great companion for plain roast beef

title: wild blueberry charlotte
steps:
1. In a small saucepan , bring the sugar and water to a boil
2. Boil for 5 minutes and pour over wild blueberries
3. Place half of he blueberry mixture into blender and pure until smooth
4. Set aside other half
5. Sprinkle gelatin over 1 / 4 cup water in a small saucepan
6. Heat over medium heat until dissolved and add to wild blueberry pure
7. Set aside and let cool , stirring occasionally , for about 15 minutes or until thickened
8. Stir in creme fraiche
9. In another bowl , whip cream until stiff peaks form and fold into wild blueberry mixture
10. Line a 2-cup deep dish with ladyfingers
11. Spoon wild blueberry mixture over ladyfingers and spread evenly
12. Cover and refrigerate for about 4 hours or until set
13. Turn out charlotte onto serving plate and garnish with reserved wild blueberries and mint

title: sugar free orange polenta muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Mix all dry ingredients together except splenda or sugar , set aside
3. Mix all milk and all orange juice together , set aside
4. Beat butter until light and fluffy , add splenda or sugar and beat until extra light and fluffy
5. Add eggs one at a time and beat after each addition
6. Add vanilla and zest , and beat well to combine
7. Fold in half flour mixture , mix slightly , fold in half milk / oj mixture , mix slightly and repeat flour / oj mixture combination
8. Fold until all is well combined
9. Divide into 12 muffin cups , sprinkle brown sugar over the top of each muffin , and bake at 375 for 25-30 minutes or until cake tester comes out clean

title: irish stout chicken
steps:
1. Heat oil in large skillet over medium heat until hot
2. Add onion and garlic
3. Cook and stir 3 minutes or until tender
4. Remove vegetables with slotted spoon to small bowl
5. Arrange chicken in single layer in skillet
6. Cook over medium-high heat 5 minutes per side or until lightly browned
7. Add onion , garlic , carrots , parsnips , thyme , salt and pepper to skillet
8. Pour stout over chicken and vegetables
9. Bring to a boil over high heat
10. Reduce heat to low
11. Cover and simmer 35 minutes
12. Add mushrooms and peas to skillet
13. Cover
14. Cook 10 minutes
15. Uncover skillet
16. Increase heat to medium
17. Cook 10 minutes or until sauce is slightly reduced and chicken is no longer pink in center

title: crispy fried onion strings
steps:
1. Slice onion into thinnest possible rings
2. Place in a shallow dish
3. Combine ranch dressing and milk and pour over onions
4. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour
5. In a plastic bag , combine flour , salt , black pepper and cayenne pepper
6. Shake to evenly distribute ingredients
7. Heat oil to 375 in deep saucepan
8. Remove a small handful of onion rings from dressing and shake off excess
9. Drop into flour , separate rings and shake to coat
10. Drop a few rings at a time into hot oil and cook until golden
11. Remove from hot oil with a slotted spoon and drain on a paper towels
12. Repeat with remaining rings until all have been battered and fried
13. Keep warm

title: split pea soup  my way too
steps:
1. Place first 10 ingredients in heavy pot
2. Cook over low heat , stirring occasionally for 3 hours until peas are soft
3. Remove from heat
4. Remove ham from the bone , dice and set aside , discarding skin and bone
5. Remove bay leaf
6. Using immersion blender , puree soup to desired consistency
7. Return ham to kettle and add cream , milk and sherry
8. Add salt and pepper to taste
9. Simmer for 15-20 minutes , stirring
10. Serve , adding a splash more sherry on top of each portion , if desired

title: chicken chasseur
steps:
1. Heat the oil to medium in a large skillet , or buffet casserole
2. Saut the chicken until golden brown on both sides
3. Remove to a plate or bowl and reserve
4. Saut the shallots until soft but not brown
5. Add the mushrooms , put on the lid , and cook for 3 minutes
6. Add the flour and cook , stirring , for 1 minute
7. Add the white wine , stirring as you do , then the brandy , tomato paste , and chicken stock
8. Bring to a simmer , stirring
9. Then reduce the heat
10. Add the tarragon
11. Put the chicken and juices back into the pan
12. Cover and simmer for 45 to 60 minutes , or until the chicken is tender
13. Serve directly from the buffet casserole , or remove to a platter
14. If your parsley is not bitter tasting , sprinkle with chopped parsley

title: banana coffee cake with streusel topping
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 350
2. Grease and flour 9 1 / 2 x 4 inch tube pan
3. Stir chopped chocolate , brown sugar , walnuts and cinnamon in small bowl
4. Stir till blended , set aside
5. Sift flour , baking soda , baking powder and salt in a medium bowl
6. Set aside
7. Cream butter in a large bowl using an electric mixer till light and creamy
8. Add sugar gradually
9. When mixture is fluffy , add egg 1 at a time
10. Beat in mashed bananas , coffee and buttermilk
11. Add in dry ingredients and blend well
12. Pour half of batter in prepared tube pan
13. Sprinkle half of the streusel topping
14. Repeat with remaining batter ending with streusel topping
15. Bake banana coffeecake about 45 minutes
16. Till tester comes out clean when dipped in the center
17. Cool in pan on wire rack
18. Slice and serve warm
19. Deeeelicious !

title: ww 2 point chicken noodle soup
steps:
1. Cut chicken into bite size pieces
2. Saut in a bit of cooking spray
3. Heat broth , pasta , herbs , carrots , celery , and salt and pepper together
4. Add chicken
5. Simmer until noodles are tender
6. Season to taste

title: green rice cubes
steps:
1. Steam the spinach in a covered steamer or saucepan over boiling water until limp , about 3 minutes
2. Transfer to a blender or food processor and puree until smooth
3. Set aside
4. In large pan , combine water and rice
5. Cover and bring to a boil
6. Reduce heat and cook until the water is absorbed , about 25 minutes
7. Mix in the spinach puree and simmer for 5 minutes
8. Add salt and pepper
9. Prepare a 10-inch square pan by oiling
10. Spoon the hot rice into pan and press it into the pan firmly with a spoon
11. Rinse the spoon with water as needed to prevent rice from sticking
12. Allow rice to cool completely
13. Run a knife or spatula around the pan edge to loosen , then turn the rice out onto a cutting board
14. Cut into 1-inch cubes with a knife , rinsing the knife in cold water after each cut
15. Arrange the cubes on a platter and drizzle with a little of the soy sauce

title: pumpkin spice ricotta creme  south beach diet
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients in a bowl
2. Chill for about 30 minutes and serve

title: asian barbecue sauce
steps:
1. Stir together all ingredients in a small bowl
2. Use on any meat or fowl to be roasted or grilled
3. Make ahead

title: extreme ambrosia fruit dessert
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine the cool whip topping , coconut chopped walnuts , fruit cocktail , pineapple , oranges , marshmallows , cherries , nutmeg and cinnamon
2. Mix all together very well
3. Chill in refrigerator for 2 or more hours before serving
4. Delicious !

title: mexican pork chops and rice
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 350
2. In a large saucepan combine the tomatoes , 2 jalapeno peppers , 1 onion , 3-4 cloves garlic , 3 / 4 of the bell pepper and salt and pepper to taste
3. Cook over medium high heat until the peppers and onions are tender
4. While the sauce is cooking , dice the remaining jalapeno , onion , garlic , and bell pepper
5. Set aside
6. In a large deep skillet fry pork chop strips over medium heat until fully cooked and tender
7. When the pork chops are fully cooked , pour the tomato mixture into a blender until liquified
8. Pour over pork chops in skillet , cover and simmer on low heat
9. While that is simmering , cook the rice according to directions
10. Saute the diced peppers , onion , and garlic in oil until tender
11. Pour cooked rice into sauted ingredients and mix well
12. Pour rice into 13x9 baking dish , pour pork chop mixture over rice and cover with shredded cheese
13. Bake uncovered for 10-15 minutes

title: mediterranean brussels sprouts
steps:
1. Trim and clean brussels sprouts , cut into quarters , and let sit for at least 5 minutes to bring out the health benefits
2. Fill the bottom of a steamer with water about 2 inches
3. Steam brussels sprouts for about 10 minutes
4. If you like them less cooked , steam for 5-7 minutes only
5. While brussels sprouts are steaming combine all dressing ingredients except parmesan cheese and lemon zest in a small bowl
6. Transfer steamed brussels sprouts to a large bowl and toss with mediterranean dressing while still hot
7. Top with parmesan cheese and lemon zest

title: chocolate beetroot muffins
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f
2. Line paper muffin cases in a 12-mould muffin tin
3. Sift the cocoa powder , flour and baking powder into a bowl
4. Mix in the sugar , and set aside
5. Pure the beetroot in a food processor
6. Add the eggs , one at a time , then add the vanilla and oil and blend until smooth
7. Make a well in the centre of the dry ingredients , add the beetroot mixture and lightly mix
8. Divide this mixture over the 12 muffin cases
9. Bake for 20 to 30 minutes , depending on your oven , or until the top is firm when pressed with a finger
10. Cool on a wire rack and dust with icing sugar to serve

title: quick lime   coriander  cilantro  salsa
steps:
1. Fling all the ingredients in a bowl and mix well
2. If you're not so keen on lots of lime then add it in slowly until it suits your tastes
3. Serve immediately

title: copycat sbarro baked ziti
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Cook ziti according to package directions - 12 to 14 minutes until al dente stirring often
3. After cooking , drain ziti well , but
4. Do not rinse off under water !
5. Combine ricotta , romano , tomato sauce and pepper in large mixing bowl
6. Gently combine cooked ziti with cheese / sauce mixture
7. In a 13"x9"x2" pan , spread the 1 / 4 cup reserved sauce
8. Add ziti and top with mozzarella cheese
9. Cover loosely with aluminum foil and bake until mozzarella is thoroughly melted
10. Serve with garlic bread and additional
11. Sauce if desired

title: deviled eggs with bacon and cheddar cheese
steps:
1. Slice eggs in half lengthwise
2. Remove yolks and set whites on a plate
3. In a small bowl , mash yolks
4. Stir in the mayonnaise , bacon , cheese , mustard and pepper
5. Stuff into egg whites
6. Cover and refrigerate until serving

title: bacon crisp
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 250 degrees
2. Place 1 teaspoon of the cheese on each cracker
3. Wrap cracker tightly with a strip of bacon
4. Place the wrapped crackers on a broiler rack on a baking sheet and put the baking sheets on the oven rack
5. Bake for 2 hours or until the bacon is done
6. Do not turn
7. Drain on paper towels
8. Serve hot or at room temperature

title: maine wild blueberry cobbler
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Combine maine wild blueberries , 3 / 4 cup white sugar , water , and lemon rind in a baking dish
3. Bring to boil and simmer for 2 minutes
4. Meanwhile , combine reserved 1 / 4 cup white sugar with brown sugar , flour baking powder , and cinnamon
5. Cut in butter until mixture is crumbly
6. Sprinkle crumbs over blueberry mixture
7. Bake approximately 25 minutes or until top is brown
8. Serve warm with heavy cream or vanilla ice cream

title: black bean burger with sriracha sauce
steps:
1. For the sauce: combine yogurt , sriracha and cilantro
2. Set aside
3. Add to a food processor the black beans , green peppers , garlic cloves , and red onion
4. Pulse until pureed
5. I prefer to leave a few semi-whole beans
6. Transfer to a medium sized bowl
7. Add the egg and mix well
8. Add to the bean mixture: the cumin , chili powder , onion powder , cilantro , salt and pepper
9. Mix thoroughly
10. Add the panko and mix to combine
11. Preheat grill pan or skillet on medium-high heat
12. Form patties and cook for 3-4 minutes on each side
13. Transfer to rolls and top with sriracha sauce and toppings , if desired

title: crunchy salmon pie
steps:
1. Grease a 20cm pie dish
2. Process the flour , paprika , butter and cheese
3. Reserve 2 / 3 cup of the flour mixture , then press the remaining flour mixture over the base of the base and sides of the prepared dish
4. Refrigerate while preparing the filling
5. Preheat the oven to 180c
6. Filling:
7. Whisk the eggs , sour cream , mayonnaise , tabasco , salt and pepper in a medium bowl until combined
8. Stir the salmon into the egg mixture with the onion , celery and cheese
9. Pour the filling into the pastry case and sprinkle over the reserved flour mixture
10. Bake for 40 minutes or until browned
11. Serve warm or cold with a salad

title: pork stew with cumin portugal
steps:
1. Marinate pork in mixture of cumin , garlic , bayleaf , salt , pepper , wine and lemon juice
2. Marinate for 6 hours
3. Remove pork from marinade and reserve liquid
4. Saute in oil , onion and pork until pork is browned
5. Add marinade and bring to a simmer
6. Simmer 30 minutes add water or stock if necessary to keep it moist
7. Scatter with olives and serve with lemon wedges

title: ham and string green bean soup
steps:
1. Place the ham in large pot and fill pot about half way with either water or chicken stock , add onion , and celery and cover
2. Bring to a boil and turn down to simmer for about 30 minutes to an hour
3. Add carrots , potatoes , and string beans to pot and continue simmering for about 30 minutes
4. Salt and pepper to taste
5. If using a ham bone remove ham from bone while the veggies are cooking and discard the bone
6. When potatoes are done mix butter and flour to form paste , slowly add to pot to slightly thicken broth

title: amras  a mango delicacy that will make you kitchen goddess
steps:
1. Remove the pulp of the mangoes
2. Mash / blend it coarsely
3. Add condensed and cold milk and serve chilled

title: starbucks java float
steps:
1. In each of 2 glasses , stir together 2 tablespoons of chocolate syrup and 1 cup of club soda
2. Place 2 scoops of ice cream in each glass
3. Optional - if you wish , you can top with a heaping mound of whipped cream , then drizzle a little additional chocolate syrup on the whipped cream
4. Serve immediately

title: spicy zucchini and tomatoes
steps:
1. Saute the onion and garlic in the sherry until tender
2. Add the zucchini , tomatoes , and chipotle puree
3. Bring to a boil , reduce heat , and simmer , covered , for 10-15 minutes or until the zucchini is tender
4. Add 2 tablespoons of lemon juice and salt and pepper to taste

title: 50 shades of garlic roasted chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. Roasting bed:
3. Cut off tops of heads of garlic
4. Arrange in bottom of half size serving tray
5. Spray roasting bed with olive oil flavored cooking spray
6. Spread a small piece of fresh thyme on each head of garlic , then lay 2 branches of rosemary across center group of garlic heads
7. Chicken:
8. Combine onions , bell peppers , celery , parsley , fresh thyme sprigs and 5 garlic cloves
9. Place in cavity of the chicken
10. Place chicken , breast side up , on top of the roasting bed
11. Sprinkle chicken with mix of pepper , salt and 1 / 2 teaspoon dried thyme
12. Coat chicken with cooking spray
13. Tie end of legs together with cooking twine and tuck wing
14. Roast for 40 minutes
15. Increase the oven temperature to 450 degrees f
16. Bake an additional 20 minutes or until a thermometer registers 170 degrees
17. Transfer chicken to a platter
18. Remove garlic cloves from the roasting pan , squeeze them out of the skins and reserve 5 of them for the sauce
19. Scatter the remainder around the chicken , cover the platter with foil and allow the chicken to rest
20. Creamy thyme sauce:
21. Place the reserved roasted garlic cloves , broth , white wine and salt in a medium saucepan
22. Bring to a boil , cover , and reduce heat
23. Simmer for 10 minutes
24. While the broth is simmering , combine flour and water in a small bowl , stirring with a whisk until smooth
25. Slowly pour the slurry into the broth while whisking the broth
26. Simmer the broth for 5 minutes or until thicken , whisking often
27. Remove and discard garlic from the sauce
28. I recommend that you leave the skin on this chicken
29. It is terrific !
30. Carve chicken , garnish with thyme sprigs , if desired
31. Serve chicken with garlic cloves and sauce
32. Bonus: we always have chicken-roasted garlic cloves left over , so i freeze 6 cloves to a sandwich bag and put all the sandwich bags into a 1-pint freezer bag so they are ready to plop into whatever recipe needs some garlic
33. Roasted garlic does not requiring sauteeing

title: bailey s irish cream truffles
steps:
1. Place the chocolate in a heat proof bowl and bring the cream to a boil in a small pot
2. Pour the boiling cream over the chocolate and let stand for 1 minute
3. With a rubber spatula , begin stirring the cream and the chocolate together in the center of the bowl
4. Gradually incorporate the chocolate and cream from the edge of the bowl
5. Stir in the bailey's irish cream
6. Cover and let stand overnight or refrigerate for up to 2 weeks
7. Scoop the chocolate mixture out into small round balls , about 3 / 4" in diameter
8. Roll the truffles , individually , in the palms of your hands to achieve a uniform shape or leave them as is and irregular
9. Store the truffles in the refrigerator for up to 2 weeks and toss them in confectioner's sugar just before serving

title: pork loin chops with garlic sauce
steps:
1. Salt and pepper pork
2. Heat oil and butter in skillet
3. Dredge chops in flour
4. Fry on med-hi until browned on both sides
5. Reduce heat to low , cover and simmer for 10 minutes
6. Remove chops and keep warm
7. To skillet add garlic
8. Cook 1 minute until garlic is soft
9. Add cream , cook for 1 minute
10. Add 1 t butter , stir to mix well
11. Serve chops with sauce on top

title: orange roasted salmon
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Mix the lemon pepper , garlic , and parsley in a small dish
3. Place the slices of one orange in a single layer in a 13 x 9 inch glass baking dish
4. Place onion slices on top
5. Drizzle with the olive oil and sprinkle 1 / 2 of the herb mixture over all
6. Roast the orange and onion mixture in the oven for about 25 minutes , or until the onions look browned and tender
7. Remove dish from oven
8. Increase the oven temperature to 450f
9. Push the onion and orange slices to the sides of the dish
10. Place the salmon in the center of the dish and sprinkle with the remaining herb mixture
11. Spoon orange and onion slices back on top of the salmon
12. Whisk the orange juice , lemon juice , and honey together in a small bowl
13. Pour over the salmon
14. Roast for about 12-15 minutes , or until the salmon is opaque in the center
15. Discard the cooked oranges
16. Serve the salmon with roasted onions on the side , and garnished with the remaining orange slices

title: grilled jamaican pork tenderloin salad
steps:
1. Prepare grill
2. To prepare dressing , combine first 11 ingredients in a food processor
3. Process until smooth
4. To prepare pork , slice pork lengthwise , cutting to , but not through , other side
5. Open halves , laying pork flat
6. Rub 2 tablespoons dressing on pork
7. Reserve remaining dressing
8. Place pork on grill rack coated with cooking spray
9. Cook 10 minutes on each side or until a meat thermometer registers 155
10. Let stand 5 minutes
11. Cut pork into 1 / 4-inch-thick slices
12. Toss with reserved dressing
13. Place 1 cup greens on each of 4 plates
14. Top with 3 ounces pork , 1 / 2 cup pineapple , and 1 / 4 cup papaya

title: baked egg custard  low carb
steps:
1. Using custard or desert dish , beat eggs well
2. Add splenda and flavoring
3. Stir cream or half& half into eggs and mix well
4. Sprinkle with nutmeg or cinnamon
5. Place in microwave and cook on 50% power for about 5-6 minutes
6. Custard will rise and fall as it cooks
7. Knife should come out clean when inserted in center of custard

title: simmering hot and sour soup
steps:
1. Combine broth , chicken , mushrooms , bamboo shoots , vinegar , soy sauce , and chili sauce in slow cooker
2. Cover
3. Cook on low 3 to 4 hours
4. Stir in tofu and sesame oil
5. Blend cornstarch and water until smooth
6. Stir into slow cooker
7. Cover
8. Cook on high 15 minutes or until soup is thickened
9. Serve hot
10. Garnish with cilantro

title: tex mex ketchup
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , combine all ingredients
2. Stir until well blended
3. Store in an air-tight container in the refrigerator

title: italian chicken bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375' sprinkle chicken breasts with garlic powder and brown in oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat about 3 minutes per side
2. While chicken is browning , rinse spinach and tear into smaller pieces
3. Put in microwave-safe bowl , cook on high with 1 tablespoon water for 3 minutes
4. Drain
5. Mix in ricotta cheese and seasonings
6. Place a thin layer of pasta sauce in bottom of 2-qt
7. Baking dish
8. Place chicken breasts on top
9. Spoon one fourth of ricotta cheese mixture on top of each chicken breast
10. Spoon 1 tbsp
11. Of sauce on top of ricotta cheese mixture
12. Place slices of mozzarella cheese on top of sauce
13. Bake for 30 minutes
14. While chicken is cooking , cook pasta according to package directions and serve with rest of heated pasta sauce

title: leeanne s spinach stuffed pork chops
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees
2. Spray pan with non-stick cooking spray and saute garlic and onions
3. Filling: squeeze spinach to remove as much moisture as possible
4. In a small bowl , combine the spinach , cheese , mayonnaise , onion , garlic , seasoned salt and italian seasonings
5. Trim chops of visible fat
6. Cut a slit about 3 / 4 of the way horizontally through the pork chops to form a pocket
7. Fill each chop with 1 / 4 of the filling
8. Press down on all sides of chops to enclose filling , although some may still show
9. Baking with sauce: place stuffed pork chops in bottom of baking dish
10. Place mushrooms in pan around the pork chops
11. Mix the liquid sauce ingredients together and pour over the chops and mushrooms
12. Cover and bake 20 minutes
13. Reduce heat to 375 degrees
14. Uncover and bake an additional 20 minutes or until piping hot

title: creamed peas and carrots
steps:
1. Cook carrots in water to cover until tender
2. Add peas
3. Cook 5 more minutes
4. Melt butter in saucepan
5. Add flour , salt , and pepper
6. Slowly stir in milk
7. Bring to a boil , boil 1 minute
8. Drain carrots and peas , mix with creamed mixture
9. Heat through
10. Put in serving bowl
11. Sprinkle with paprika

title: almond rice cookies
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 325f
2. Mix the rice , ground almonds , and sugar
3. Thoroughly beat in the egg white , honey , and almond essence
4. Line a cookie sheet with waxed paper
5. Place teaspoons of the mixture well apart on the paper , and press a split almond on top of each
6. Bake in the oven for 15-20 minutes , until the cookies are light golden brown
7. Leave them to cool slightly on the cookie sheet , then lift them off the waxed paper
8. When cool , store in an airtight tin

title: chicken salad with pineapple
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients except almonds
2. Add a little pineapple juice if salad is too thick
3. Chill
4. Serve on crisp lettuce with almonds scattered on top

title: vegetarian mexican casserole   plus low cal and low fat
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Heat 2 teaspoons oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat
3. Add onion to pan
4. Cook 4 minutes or until tender
5. Add garlic and jalapeno
6. Cook 1 minute
7. Stir in chili powder , cumin , black pepper , and crumbles
8. Cook 3 minutes or until thoroughly heated
9. Arrange half of tortilla chips in an 11 x 7-inch baking dish coated with cooking spray
10. Top evenly with the crumbles mixture
11. Heat remaining 2 teaspoons oil in skillet over medium heat
12. Add beans , mashing with the back of a wooden spoon until chunky and thick
13. Cook 2 minutes or until heated , stirring constantly
14. Stir in lime juice
15. Combine tomato , cilantro , and salt
16. Layer beans and tomato mixture over crumbles mixture in dish
17. Top with remaining tortilla chips , pressing to slightly crush
18. Sprinkle evenly with cheese
19. Bake at 375 degrees for 13 minutes or until cheese is bubbly
20. Cut casserole into 6 equal pieces
21. Top each serving with 1 teaspoon sour cream , 1 teaspoon onions , and 2 teaspoons olives

title: creamy chicken spirals
steps:
1. Cook pasta
2. While pasta is cooking , heat oil in large pan over medium / high heat
3. Add chicken and cook stirring until golden brown , about 3- 4 minutes
4. Reduce heat , add garlic and tomatoes and cook further 3 minutes , stirring constantly
5. In a bowl combine sour cream and stock , mix well
6. Add to frying pan with basil and black pepper to taste , reducing heat to low and simmer , stirring for 2 minutes
7. Drain pasta and add to pan with chicken mixture , olives and parmesan cheese
8. Toss over low heat until heated through

title: white chocolate orange cookies
steps:
1. Cream the butter and sugars together until light and fluffy
2. Beat in the egg and orange peel
3. Stir together the flour , baking soda , and slat and add to the butter mixture , stirring to combine
4. Stir in the white chocolate chips
5. Drop by spoonfuls onto an ungreased baking sheet
6. Bake 12 minutes at 350 degrees

title: juan carlos cruz s pork fried rice
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , toss the pork with 1 tablespoon of the hoisin sauce , 1 teaspoon of the soy sauce , 1 tablespoon of the ginger , and 2 teaspoons of the garlic
2. Mix well
3. Heat a heavy nonstick wok with 1 / 2 teaspoon of the canola oil
4. Add the pork with the spices and saute until pork is cooked , about 2 minutes
5. Remove pork from teh wok , set aside , and keep warm
6. Add the remaining oil to the wok and heat over medium heat
7. Add the remaining hoisin and soy sauces , the remaining ginger and garlic , the sesame oil , and green onions and cook for about 3 minutes or until crisp tender
8. Add the carrots , peas , and rice
9. Continue cooking until warmed through , about 2 minutes
10. Add the egg substitute stirring to scramble until well cooked
11. Add the pork back into the wok and toss
12. Serve warm

title: alli s microwave cashew brittle
steps:
1. Mix sugar , salt and corn syrup in microwave safe bowl
2. Microwave for 3 minutes -15 seconds
3. Stir
4. Microwave 2 minutes
5. Mix in vanilla , butter and cashews
6. Microwave 1 minute
7. Stir in baking soda
8. Quickly turn out on onto a greased pan , using a silicone or greased spatula
9. Spread to 1 nut depth with off-set spatula
10. Cool and break into bite-sized pieces

title: best double chocolate muffins
steps:
1. Set oven to 425 degrees
2. Line a deep 12-cup muffin pan with paper liners
3. Melt the chocolate squares in the microwave , stirring occasionally
4. Remove the chocolate
5. Using a wooden spoon , stir in the cocoa powder , flour , baking powder , brown sugar , semisweet , and white chocolate chips , milk , olive oil and the egg , until very well blended
6. Divide the batter among the lined muffin cups
7. Bake for 15-17 minutes , or until well risen , and firm to the touch
8. Serve warm or room-temp

title: simple crusty bread
steps:
1. In a large bowl or plastic container , mix yeast and salt into 3 cups lukewarm water
2. Stir in flour , mixing until there are no dry patches
3. Dough will be quite loose
4. Cover , but not with an airtight lid
5. Let dough rise at room temperature 2 hours
6. Bake at this point or refrigerate , covered , for as long as two weeks
7. When ready to bake , sprinkle a little flour on dough and cut off a grapefruit-size piece with serrated knife
8. Turn dough in hands to lightly stretch surface , creating a rounded top and a lumpy bottom
9. Put dough on pizza peel sprinkled with cornmeal
10. Let rest 40 minutes
11. Repeat with remaining dough or refrigerate it
12. Place broiler pan on bottom of oven
13. Place baking stone on middle rack and turn oven to 450 degrees
14. Heat stone at that temperature for 20 minutes
15. Dust dough with flour , slash top with serrated or very sharp knife three times
16. Slide onto stone
17. Pour one cup hot water into broiler pan and shut oven quickly to trap steam
18. Bake until well browned , about 30 minutes
19. Cool completely
20. Variation: if not using stone , stretch rounded dough into oval and place in a greased , nonstick loaf pan
21. Let rest 40 minutes if fresh , an extra hour if refrigerated
22. Heat oven to 450 degrees for 5 minutes
23. Place pan on middle rack

title: czech summer kohlrabi
steps:
1. In a heavy frying pan over medium heat , saut onions and 1 pound kohlrabi in butter until well coated with the butter
2. Sprinkle with salt and pepper
3. Cover tightly and cook , stirring occasionally , until kohlrabi is tender , about 25 minutes
4. Sprinkle with flour and turn to mix
5. Gradually add milk and cook and gently stir mixture until milk thickens to a smooth sauce
6. Correct seasoning , adding salt and pepper generously
7. Stir in parsley
8. Makes 4 servings
9. Womans day home cooking around the world

title: mackinac island chocolate butter pecan fudge
steps:
1. Combine sugar , butter and milk in a heavy 2 1 / 2 quart saucepan
2. Bring to full rolling boil , stirring constantly
3. Continue boiling 5 minutes over medium heat or until candy thermometer reaches 234 degrees , stirring constantly to prevent scorching
4. Remove from heat
5. Stir in chips until melted
6. Add marshmallow creme , nuts and vanilla
7. Beat until well blended
8. Pour into greased 9 inch x 13 inch pan
9. Cool at room temperature ,
10. Cut into squares

title: apple pie caramel apples
steps:
1. Wash and dry apples thoroughly
2. Put the wooden sticks in the apples
3. Melt the caramels and milk either over low heat or in the microwave
4. Dip each apple into the caramel and let firm up completely
5. Melt the white chocolate chips in microwave
6. Dip each apple in chocolate and let the excess drip off
7. Let cool slightly , but before its completely hard , roll in the sugar mixture
8. Sit on wax paper and put in fridge to harden completely

title: sweet chili tofu goodness
steps:
1. For the quinoa , combine all the ingredients in a pot that has a tight fitting lid
2. Bring to a boil , then cover and reduce heat to low
3. Cook for 20 minutes , then turn off heat and move pot away from burner
4. Do not open lid
5. Let steam for 10 minutes before serving
6. Pat tofu dry and cut the block into 8 rectangles widthwise , then each rectangle in half to make two squares per rectangle
7. Then cut each square diagonally to make four triangles per square
8. In a medium non-stick skillet over medium-high heat , add the oil and saut the tofu until browned , flip the tofu over and brown the other side
9. Reduce heat to medium-low and add the garlic , ginger , and chili
10. Saut for 5 minutes
11. Add the maple syrup , tamari , and lime juice
12. Cover and cook until the liquid has evaporated
13. For the kale , heat a frying pan or wok over medium-high heat and add the chopped kale along with the water , tamari , and lime juice to the pan
14. Saut the kale for about 3-4 minutes or until the kale softens and turns a bright green
15. Remove from heat
16. For plating , arrange the kale over a bed of quinoa
17. Add tofu over the top , and sprinkle with green onions and toasted almonds
18. Garnish with lime slices

title: butterscotch banana bread waffles
steps:
1. Sift together flour , baking powder , baking soda , salt , cinnamon , nutmeg and brown sugar in a large bowl
2. In another large bowl beat the egg yolks
3. Add sour milk and mashed bananas
4. Stir in the dry ingredients until well mixed
5. In a mixing bowl , whip the egg whites until stiff peaks form
6. Fold into batter
7. Gently stir in butterscotch chips
8. Heat waffle iron and brush with oil
9. Pour batter into iron and cook until golden brown
10. Serve with maple syrup or butter , if desired

title: cranberry pecan streusel coffeecake
steps:
1. To make the streusel: combine the flour , sugar , and cinnamon in a small bowl
2. Rub the softened butter into the flour mixture until it holds together when squeezed
3. Gently mix in the pecans
4. Set aside
5. To make the coffeecake: in a mixing bowl , combine the flour , sugar , butter , baking powder , baking soda , salt , flavorings , and buttermilk
6. Mix on low speed for one minute , scrape the bowl , and beat for another 30 seconds
7. Scrape the bowl
8. Slowly add the eggs , one at a time , combining well after each addition
9. Scrape the bowl after each egg is added
10. Once all the eggs are added , scrape the bowl and mix on medium speed for one minute
11. Gently fold the cranberries in by hand
12. To assemble the cranberry-pecan streusel coffeecake: grease an 8x8 inch square pan and place about half of the batter in the pan
13. Smooth it out evenly with a small offset spatula or a knife
14. Spread 1 / 3 of the streusel topping over the coffeecake batter
15. Place the remaining coffeecake batter on top of the streusel topping and gently smooth out to the edges of the pan
16. Top with the remaining streusel
17. An alternative to layering the coffeecake and streusel is to place all of the coffeecake batter in the pan , top with 2 / 3 of the streusel , and marble the streusel through the coffeecake with a knife by drawing the knife down through the streusel and into the batter , making swirling motions
18. Once swirled , top with the remaining streusel
19. Bake the coffeecake in a 350f preheated oven for 20-25 minutes , or until a toothpick inserted near the center tests clean
20. Changed time from the original 45-50 minutes , because of recipe reviewer
21. Allow the cake to cool in the pan
22. This cake is very delicate with a crunchy streusel if served warm the same day , so if you prefer a slightly denser coffeecake with a softer streusel crumb , serve the coffeecake the next day
23. After the cake has cooled , wrap it well in plastic wrap and store in the refrigerator overnight
24. Allow to come to room temperature before serving
25. Regular pastry flour can be substituted for whole wheat pastry flour
26. If buttermilk is not available , place 1 tsp lemon juice or vinegar in a measuring cup and fill to the cup mark with milk

title: pumpkin pound cake
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl , beat butter using an electric mixer on medium speed for about 2 minutes or until soft and creamy
2. Gradually add in sugar , beating at medium speed 5-7 minutes
3. Add in eggs , one at a time , beating just until yellow disappears
4. In another bowl , combine flour and the next 6 ingredients
5. In another bowl , combine the pumpkin and rum
6. Add the flour mixture to the creamed mixture alternately with the pumpkin mixture , beginning and ending with the flour mixture
7. Mix at lowest speed just until blended after each addition
8. Transfer batter into a greased and floured 10-inch tube pan
9. Bake in a 325 oven for 1 hour and 25-30 minutes or until a pick comes out clean
10. Cool in pan on a wire rack for 10 minutes
11. Remove from pan and let cool completely on wire rack

title: soy maple salmon
steps:
1. Blend soy , syrup and oil and pour into shallow dish
2. Add the steaks in a single layer , turning to coat
3. Blend ginger and garlic , and rub into both sides of steaks
4. Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours , turning occasionally
5. Place marinade in small saucepan on stove , boil on high until syrupy , around 3 minutes
6. Light an oil grill
7. Cook steaks 4-6 minutes a side over moderately high heat
8. Plate fish , pour marinade over and garnish with scallions

title: italian salad mix
steps:
1. Toss together the first 6 ingredients and store in a tightly closed plastic bag in the fridge
2. To serve , divide the lettuce into 8 individual bowls
3. Use about 1 cup lettuce for each
4. Add about 1 / 2 cup of the mix to each bowl
5. Toss with the salad dressing

title: green chilie squash casserole
steps:
1. Combine eggs , oil , and biscuit mix
2. Stir in chillies , onion , garlic and half of the cheese
3. Stir in squash
4. Pour into a greased 9x13 inch baking dish
5. Bake at 350 degrees for 40 minutes
6. Sprinkle with remaining cheese and bake 5 minutes more

title: chiang mai curry noodles  kao soi
steps:
1. Heat the vegetable oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat , and then add the garlic
2. Toss well and add the red curry paste , mashing and stirring to soften it in the oil , about 1 minute
3. Add the chicken and cook 1 to 2 minutes , tossing now and then to brown it evenly and mix it with the curry paste
4. Add the coconut milk , chicken broth , turmeric , soy sauce , sugar and salt and stir well
5. Bring to a gentle boil and adjust heat to maintain a lively simmer
6. Cook about 10 minutes until meat is cooked through
7. Stir in lime juice , remove from heat and cover to keep curry warm while you prepare the noodles
8. Cook the noodles in a large pot of rapidly boiling water until tender but still firm , as little as 2 minutes for fresh noodles and 7 minutes or more for dried
9. Drain , rinse well in cold water , drain again and divide the noodles among individual serving bowls
10. Ladle on hot curry , and sprinkle each serving with the shallots , cilantro and green onions
11. Serve hot and garnish with crunchy noodle nests as

title: sauteed leeks  mushrooms   onions
steps:
1. Spray a non stick skillet with oil
2. Saute the onions until tender and starting to brown
3. Add mushrooms and continue cooking for apprx 3 minutes
4. Add leeks , salt , pepper& oregano
5. Saute a further 8 minutes

title: pear   walnut salad w creamy bleu  blue  cheese dressing
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , whisk together the mayo , sour cream and lemon juice until smooth
2. Fold in the bleu cheese crumbles and add salt and pepper
3. Refrigerate until ready to use
4. Tear a combination of the romaine and red leaf lettuce into individual serving bowls or onto plates and top with the bleu cheese dressing
5. Place the pear slices on top of the dressing and finish each salad with the glazed walnuts and a sprinkling of cranberries

title: moist healthy cupcakes  perfect for cupcake menorah
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 f
2. Line 10 muffin cups with foil or paper liners
3. In a bowl , stir together the flour , baking powder and baking soda
4. Set aside
5. In a large mixing bowl with an electric mixer , beat together the sugar , butter and vanilla on high speed for about 2 minutes , or until well mixed
6. Add the egg whites , one at a time , beating for about a minute after each one
7. Now add the flour mixture alternately with the yogurt , in about 3 portions each , beating after each addition just until combined , and scraping down the sides to make sure everything is well mixed
8. Pour batter into the prepared cupcake pan and place in the oven
9. Bake for 20-25 minutes or until lightly browned on top and a toothpick poked into the middle of a cupcake comes out clean
10. Let cool completely on a rack
11. To assemble the cupcake menorah , frost all the cupcakes with your choice of icing and decorate in any way your heart desires
12. Place 9 cupcakes in a row on a platter or foil-covered cardboard base
13. Raise the middle cupcake up higher than the others the "shamash" or leader
14. Stick candles into each of the 9 positions
15. When its time to light the candles enjoy the flickering flames while you eat dinner , then eat the menorah for dessert !

title: lettuce salad
steps:
1. Put lettuce in a salad bowl
2. Combine remaining ingredients , except chives
3. Pour over lettuce
4. Toss
5. Serve at once garnished with chives

title: boston market cranberry sauce
steps:
1. In 2 quart saucepan , over medium to low heat , use rubber bowl scraper to
2. Stir together jellied sauce , marmalade and ginger untilmelted , about 6 to 8 minutes
3. Add the sliced cranberries , keeping sauce on low
4. Stir often
5. Continue cooking and stirring often until cranberries are no longer white
6. And taste tender to the bite
7. Stir in walnuts
8. When cooled to lukewarm , refrigerate , covered and use with a week to 10 days
9. Should freeze well to be used within 4 months

title: sirloin tips with garlic butter
steps:
1. Combine first 5 ingredients & stir garlic butter well
2. Melt 3 tablespoons butter in skillet on med-high heat
3. Add onion& cook 3 minutes till golden
4. Add mushrooms & cook 4 minutes till tender
5. Remove from skillet
6. Sprinkle steak with salt & pepper
7. Melt 3 tablespoons butter over med
8. High heat & add steak
9. Cook 5 minutes , stirring constantly
10. Return onion / mushroom mix to skillet & stir in sherry
11. Cook till thoroughly heated & serve over rice

title: crispy squid with capers
steps:
1. Place the flour , salt and capers in a strong plastic bag , shake vigorously to coat
2. Cut the squid into rings approx 1cm wide
3. Pat dry and add these , and the tentacles , to the flour and capers
4. Shake again until completely covered
5. Deep-fry in small batches for a couple of minutes until slightly golden
6. Remove from the oil with a slotted spoon and allow to drain on kitchen towel
7. Sprinkle with sea salt and freshly ground black pepper , if desired , before serving

title: molten cheese gnocchi
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Set potatoes on a baking sheet and slash each deeply lengthwise down the center
3. Bake potatoes until they are tender and look slightly dried out , 1 1 / 4 to 1 1 / 2 hours
4. In a small bowl , mix together 3 cups cheese and the cream
5. Set aside
6. As soon as potatoes are cool enough to handle , peel them
7. Discard peels
8. Put potatoes through a potato ricer into a large bowl
9. Mix in egg , salt , and 1 cup flour , adding just enough additional flour to make the dough pliable and not sticky
10. Turn out onto a floured work surface
11. With floured hands , knead dough 10 to 12 times
12. Divide dough and cover one batch with a damp kitchen towel
13. Roll other batch into a 3 / 4-in
14. -thick rope and cut into 3 / 4-in
15. -long pieces
16. Roll each piece into a ball , then flatten into a 2-in
17. Circle with your fingers or the bottom of a well-floured drinking glass
18. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil
19. Top each dough circle with 1 / 2 teaspoons cheese-cream mixture
20. Gather up dough around filling and pinch to close , then roll into a small , smooth ball
21. Repeat rolling , filling , and forming with second batch of dough
22. Preheat broiler with rack 4 inches below heating element
23. Divide melted butter between two 2-qt
24. Casserole dishes
25. Working in batches , drop gnocchi into boiling water , being careful not to crowd them
26. Boil gnocchi until they rise to the surface , 4 to 5 minutes
27. Cook 8 to 10 seconds longer , then transfer with a slotted spoon to casserole dish , making sure water drains off from gnocchi
28. Turn gnocchi to coat in butter
29. Sprinkle with pepper and remaining cheese and broil until browned on top , 5 minutes
30. Sprinkle with parsley and serve immediately

title: fish finger wraps   fish stick wraps  usa
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180c
2. In a bowl combine onion , soup , sweet chilli sauce , sour cream and 1 / 2 cup grated cheese
3. Place two fish fingers down the centre of each tortilla and spoon over about 2 tbsp sauce to cover fish fingers
4. Carefully roll up tortillas and place seam side down in a single layer in a baking dish
5. Spoon over remaining sauce and sprinkle with extra grated cheese
6. Bake for 15-20 mins until sauce is bubbling and tortillas golden

title: twice baked cheddar potatoes
steps:
1. Bake potatoes in oven until easily pierced with fork
2. Cut off , lengthwise , top 1 / 3 of potatoes
3. Scoop out potato with spoon into a medium mixing bowl , leaving shells intact
4. Add butter , cheese , salt , and pepper to potatoes
5. Blend with a hand-held mixer , adding milk a little bit at a time until mixture is creamy but still pretty thick
6. Using a spoon , scoop potato mixture back into emptied shells
7. It is ok if the potatoes are stuffed over the top
8. Bake in a 375 oven for 20-25 minutes , or until cheese is bubbly and potatoes are brown on top
9. Sprinkle with chives before serving

title: grandma norn s unbelievable blackberry cake
steps:
1. In large bowl mix cake mix , eggs , oil and jello on high speed with electric mixer about 2 minutes
2. Add berries
3. Mix until blended well
4. Pour into greased and floured 9x13-inch pan
5. Bake at 350 until fork inserted in center comes out clean , about 40-45 minutes
6. Allow cake to cool completely
7. In bowl make icing by beating cream cheese and butter until smooth
8. Gradually add confectioners' sugar
9. Frost cake , chill and serve

title: coffee mocha icing
steps:
1. In a bowl using an electric mixer on medium speed mix the cocoa powder with butter , coffee and vanilla until creamy and smooth
2. Add in confectioners sugar starting with 1 / 2 cup and adding in more until desired consistency is achieved

title: chicken enchilada sour cream casserole
steps:
1. Cook chicken breasts and tear into small pieces
2. Preheat oven to 350f
3. Combine cream soups , broth & cheese in a medium sauce pan
4. Cook & stir until cheese is melted
5. Add sour cream and green chiles
6. Layer tortillas , chicken and sauce in 11x13 glass baking dish 2 or 3 times
7. Bake for approximately 30 minutes or until bubbly

title: strawberry cheesecake muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f grease 12 muffin cups or line with paper muffin liners
2. Beat together cream cheese and sugar until smooth , set aside
3. In a large mixing bowl , combine flour , baking powder and salt
4. In a separate bowl , beat together egg , milk , brown sugar , margarine or butter , lemon zest and vanilla extract
5. Stir egg mixture into dry ingredients , stirring just until moistened
6. Spoon half of batter into muffin cups
7. Top each portion with 1 tablespoon cream cheese mixture and 1 teaspoon jam
8. Spoon remaining muffin batter on top
9. Bake in preheated oven for 20 minutes , or until golden
10. Cool in pan for 5 minutes , then remove muffins and cool on rack
11. Store in airtight container

title: caribbean pepper pot soup
steps:
1. Cook onions in oil in a skillet until tender
2. Place onions in crockpot along with garlic , ginger , chili powder , scotch bonnet , coriander , celery seeds , salt , pepper , sugar , squash , kidney beans , tomatoes and stock
3. Stir to mix well
4. Cover and cook on low for 8-10 hours or on high for 4-6 hours or until vegetables are tender
5. Add coconut milk and stir well
6. Set crockpot to high and cook for 15-20 minutes more
7. Garnish with cilantro before serving

title: lively lime salsa
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in bowl
2. Allow flavours to meld for about 10 minutes before serving

title: oysters kilpatrick
steps:
1. Preheat the grill to the highest temperature
2. Arrange the oysters on a bed of rock salt in a large , shallow , ovenproof dish
3. Combine the worcestershire sauce and butter in a small saucepan and heat the butter until it melts and the mixture begins to bubble around the edges of the saucepan
4. Remove from the heat
5. Spoon a little of the worcestershire sauce and butter mixture over each oyster , and top evenly with the diced bacon and season with sea salt and freshly ground black pepper , to taste
6. Cook under a preheated grill for 3-4 minutes , or until the bacon is crisp
7. Sprinkle with parsley , and serve with lemon wedges
8. Variation: the recipe for oyster's kilpatrick on huey's website is cath claringbold's , and varies from this more traditional recipe by including 100g finely chopped onion which is gently sauted with the bacon in some olive oil
9. When the onions and bacon are removed from the stove , 2 drops of tabasco sauce are added along with the worcestershire sauce
10. Otherwise , the steps are much the same
11. I'm including this variation here , because unlike me some chefs i know are always looking for ways to add extra heat !

title: easy lamb curry
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine flour and curry powder
2. Set aside
3. Place oil in a skillet over medium-high heat
4. Add onions and celery and saute lightly
5. Stir in flour mixture and blend until smooth
6. Add broth and ketchup
7. Reduce heat , cover and simmer about 1 hour , stirring occasionally
8. Add lamb and apple
9. Simmer another 20 minutes
10. Cook rice according to package directions , omitting salt and butter
11. Place 1 / 2 cup rice in each of four shallow bowls
12. Spoon lamb mixture evenly over rice
13. Serve hot

title: teriyaki marinated flank steak
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients and trim any fat from the flank steak
2. Score the flank steak and put into a gallon size freezer bag , add the marinade and put in refrigerator for at least 4 hours
3. Also , you may double or triple the marinade recipe and do several flank steaks and store in the freezer , just be sure to get as much air out of the bags before putting in the freezer
4. Cook the flank steak approx
5. 5-6 minutes on each side for medium rare

title: ensalada mixta  special mixed salad
steps:
1. Slice lettuce chiffonade style and arrange on a serving platter
2. Slice tomatoes in wedges , the onion jullienne , the cucumber in quartered slices , and the avocado in thin slices and arrange over lettuce
3. Break up tuna with a fork , and place in the center of the salad
4. Drain corn , and arrange around tuna
5. Garnish with olives
6. Serve with oil , vinegar , salt and pepper on the side , so that each person dresses their own salad
7. Other optional ingredients include pickled beets , pineapple slices , and grated carrots

title: french bread with pesto and peppers
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Spread pesto on the cut sides of both loaves of bread
3. Arrange red peppers on the bottom two halves , and sprinkle cheese over peppers
4. Replace the top halves of bread
5. Wrap each loaf in aluminum foil
6. Bake for 20 minutes , or until cheese melts
7. Cut into 2 inch pieces

title: hobo adobo foil dinner  rsc
steps:
1. For the ground beef in adobo sauce:
2. Mix the first seven ingredients well in a medium-sized bowl
3. Soak the ground beef in the adobo sauce for 1-2 hours
4. After soaking , strain excess moisture off using a colander
5. For the hobo dinner potatoes:
6. In a small bowl , whisk together the lemon juice and olive oil
7. Toss with potatoes , red peppers and onions
8. To assemble:
9. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
10. To assemble the meat patties , divide ground beef in adobo sauce into 8 balls
11. Press into patties
12. Place 1 oz
13. Monterrey jack cheese on each patty , as pictured below
14. Place another patty on top , and press together to seal
15. To assemble your hobo dinners , tear off a large piece of aluminum foil
16. Place one adobo patty on the bottom , and spoon potato mixture on top
17. Sprinkle with salt and pepper
18. Seal well
19. Bake for 1 -1 1 / 4 hours or until potatoes are tender

title: teriyaki sauce  for a marinade or for basting
steps:
1. Mix together in a saucepan
2. Heat and simmer for just a few minutes till all flavors are blended
3. Use with steak or chicken

title: bacon wrapped corn
steps:
1. Wrap each ear with a bacon strip
2. Place each ear on a piece of heavy duty aluminum foil
3. Sprinkle with chili powder
4. Wrap securely , twisting ends to make handles for turning
5. Grill uncovered , over medium-hot heat for 20 minutes or until corn is tender and bacon is cooked , turning once

title: greeny s chocolate chunk oatmeal cookies
steps:
1. In a large bowl , cream together the butter , brown sugar , and white sugar until smooth
2. Beat in eggs one at a time , and then stir in vanilla
3. In a separate bowl , combine the flour , baking soda , baking powder , spices , and salt
4. Stir into the creamed mixture until just blended
5. Mix in the quick oats and chocolate chunks
6. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
7. Drop by heaping spoonfuls onto parchment-lined baking sheets
8. Bake for 8-10 minutes in the preheated oven
9. Transfer to a wire rack to cool completely

title: orange chipotle chicken with cilantro rice
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine chile powder , cumin and 1 / 4 tsp salt
2. Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet to medium-high
3. Tilt skillet to coat bottom lightly
4. Season both sides of chicken with chile-cumin mixture and cook for 3 minutes per side or until no longer pink in center
5. Remove from skillet and set aside
6. Add orange juice and maple syrup to juice and bits left in skillet and cook for 1 minute to thicken slightly , stirring constantly
7. Remove from heat , stir in chipotle chiles in adobo sauce and orange zest
