8. Add chicken back to skillet , return to heat and cook for 1 minute on medium-high , turning constantly
9. In a medium bowl , combine rice , cilantro and remaining 1 / 4 tsp salt
10. Serve chicken over rice and spoon any excess glaze over top chicken pieces

title: vegan corn chowder
steps:
1. Sautee onions , pepper , and carrot in oil over medium heat until onions are translucent
2. Add herbs and salt , sautee a minute more
3. Add corn , stock , potatoes , bay leaf , and cayenne
4. Cover and bring to a boil for 3 minutes
5. Reduce heat and simmer for about 15 minutes , uncover and simmer for 7-10 minutes more
6. Puree half of the chowder
7. Add soy milk , lemon , juice , and maple syrup
8. Stir to combine and serve

title: banana poppy seed quick bread
steps:
1. Mash bananas with a potato masher until all large pieces are broken down - you should receive about 1 cup of banana total
2. If not , then add enough banana to equal one cup
3. Cream together the sugar and butter until light and fluffy
4. Beat in eggs and grated lemon peel until blended
5. Combine the flour , baking powder , salt and cinnamon
6. Beat the bananas into the wet ingredients alternately with the dry ingredients -- repeating twice ending with dry ingredients
7. Hand stir in the poppy seeds
8. Pour into a well-greased 9x5 inch loaf pan
9. Bake at 350 f for 50-60 minutes until pick inserted in center comes out clean
10. Cool in pan for 10-15 minutes before turning out onto a wire rack to completely cool

title: dairy egg nut free dried fruit cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f grease a baking sheet or line with parchment paper
2. Place banana slices in a medium bowl
3. Mash with a fork until smooth , then add tahini and mix well
4. Add remaining ingredients and stir well
5. Roll the dough into balls , using about 2 tbsp each
6. Place on baking sheet and press balls down to about 1 / 2 inch thickness
7. Bake for about 20 minutes until golden then place sheet on rack to cool

title: green bean and tomato salad
steps:
1. Place beans in a saucepan and cover with water
2. Bring to a boil
3. Cook , uncovered , for 8-10 minutes or until crisp tender
4. Drain and rinse with cold water
5. Place in a large bowl
6. Add onion
7. Place tomatoes in another bowl
8. In a small bowl , whisk together the lemon juice , oil , water , salt and pepper
9. Pour over the vegetables in each bowl
10. Toss to coat
11. Cover and refrigerator for at least 1 hour
12. Stir celery into bean mixutre
13. Transfer to a serving platter
14. Surround with tomatoes

title: garlic basil chicken with red roasted pepper alfredo spaghetti
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven 350
2. Mix half of chopped fresh basil , melted butter and garlic together in baking casserole dish
3. Place chicken breasts on top of mixture and top with remaining fresh chopped basil
4. Bake covered for 45 minutes
5. Bake uncovered for 15 minutes
6. Prepare spaghetti noodles boil for 7-10 minutes to preferred taste
7. Over low heat warm alfredo sauce , stir often
8. Be careful not to scorch
9. Serve
10. Pepper to taste

title: glazed baked ham
steps:
1. Heat oven to 325 degrees
2. With sharp knife , score top of ham
3. Insert cloves
4. Place ham on rack in shallow roasting pan
5. Bake at 325 degrees for 1 hour
6. Meanwhile , combine glaze ingredients
7. Mix well
8. Spoon glaze over ham
9. Bake an additional 15 to 30 minutes or until ham is thoroughly heated , occasionally spooning glaze over ham

title: spiced panko bread crumbs
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , combine all the ingredients and mix well
2. Use or store

title: easy and tasty tuna salad
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients
2. Serve on toast , rolls , salad greens , or halves of ripe tomatoes

title: biscuit de savoie   sponge cake
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f butter two 8-inch square pans , line them with parchment paper , and set them aside
2. In a large bowl , beat the egg yolks , sugar , and vanilla extract until the mixture becomes light yellow and fluffy
3. Gently stir the flours into the creamed mixture until they are thoroughly incorporated into the batter
4. Beat the egg whites until stiff , glossy peak form
5. Gently stir 1 / 3 of the whipped egg whites into the sponge cake batter , and then carefully fold the remainder of the egg whites into the mixture
6. Carefully fill each prepared pan with the cake batter and bake for 22 to 26 minutes , until the cakes test done in the middle
7. Invert the cakes onto a wire rack and allow them to cool before serving with fruit and whipped cream

title: open faced tuna and artichoke melt
steps:
1. Preheat broiler
2. Combine first 8 ingredients in a medium-size bowl
3. Divide the mixture evenly among muffin halves
4. Sprinkle with cheese
5. Place on a baking sheet
6. Broil 5 inches from heat until golden brown , 5 minutes

title: creamy tomato soup with fennel and dill
steps:
1. In a large stockpot , melt 2 tablespoons of butter over medium high-high heat
2. Add chopped onion and fresh fennel along with 1 teaspoon salt and 1 / 2 teaspoon pepper
3. If using fennel seed instead , add that now
4. Saute onions until soft and slightly caramelized , about 5 minutes
5. Add carrot and cook for an additional 3 minutes
6. Pour in chicken broth
7. Then add plum tomatoes , diced tomatoes , tomato paste , and 1 tablespoon of the parmesan cheese
8. Using a wooden spoon , break up the plum tomatoes
9. Add 1-2 teaspoons salt , and 1 / 2- 1 1 / 2 teaspoons pepper
10. Bring to a boil then , reduce heat to simmer and cover
11. Cook for 25-30 minutes , stirring every now and then to ensure even heat distribution
12. Add the dill and heavy cream and stir to combine
13. Add 1-2 tablespoons of remaining parmesan , and the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter
14. Simmer for 10-15 minutes
15. Adjust seasonings to taste
16. Take soup off heat and carefully ! blend in food processor or with a stick blender
17. Process to desired consistency
18. Enjoy alone , or with crusty fresh bread
19. Yum ! :)
20. If using fresh fennel , only use the fennel bulb , not the stalks or fronds
21. Cut the bulb in half , cut out core and discard
22. Cut fennel into medium dice and add to soup where directed

title: upside down butterscotch cake
steps:
1. Topping: combine the melted butter , graham cracker crumbs , butterscotch chips , coconut , and pecans
2. Spread over bottom of a buttered 13x9-inch baking pan
3. Cake: cream shortening with granulated sugar until light
4. Add vanilla and mix well
5. Beat in eggs , one at a time , beating well after each addition
6. Into another bowl , sift together the flour , salt , and baking powder
7. Add sifted ingredients to the creamed mixture , alternating with the milk , beginning and ending with the flour
8. Beat well after each addition
9. Beat for about 1 minute longer then pour over the topping
10. Bake in a preheated 350 degree oven for 30 minutes , or until the cake bounces back when touched lightly with finger
11. Cool for 5 minute in the pan
12. Invert carefully onto serving plate , spooning any topping left in the pan over the cake
13. Cut into squares

title: chile verde meatballs
steps:
1. Into a large , heavy pot , add the onion , garlic , salsa verde , broth or beer , and the meatballs
2. Simmer on low for 30 minutes , stirring occasionally
3. Add the ground cumin and simmer for 15 minutes more
4. Serve with sour cream for garnish , along with rice and beans and tortillas

title: low sugar natural pectin jam
steps:
1. Place a small saucer in the freezer to chill for later testing of jam thickness
2. In large deep heavy skillet , or your widest heavy-bottom sauce pan , sprinkle cleaned berries or other sliced fruit with 3 / 4 cup of the sugar
3. Mash coarsely and let sit 15 minutes to "juice"
4. Bring fruit mixture to a boil over medium-high heat , stirring occasionally
5. Boil 15 minutes - hard enough to bubble but not splatter , stirring occasionally & skimming any foam off
6. Meanwhile , peel , core & grate apples
7. Stir in apples , lemon juice & remaining 1 / 4 cup sugar & keep boiling , stirring more often now & scraping bottom of pan to prevent sticking
8. Cook this way until thickened , about 20-45 more minutes
9. Test by placing a small drop of jam on the chilled plate from the freezer and let it sit a minute
10. When properly thickened , the jam should not run at all when plate is tilted at a steep angle
11. If not thick enough , let it cook longer -- it will get there eventually !
12. Ladle hot jam into half-pint canning jars and put the lids on hand-tight
13. Because this jam has less sugar , it's best to use half-pint or smaller jars , because it may spoil quicker once opened
14. You can either store the jars as-is in the freezer once cooled , or you may can them by submerging hot jars immediately in boiling water for 10 minutes
15. If you don't have canning jars , let jam cool in the covered pan until room temperature
16. Ladle into plastic or other containers , and store in freezer

title: diet delight chicken curry
steps:
1. Heat oil in large skillet over medium heat
2. Add apple and next 7 ingredients
3. Cook 5 minutes , stirring occasionally
4. Combine cornstarch and chicken broth , and add to apple mixture
5. Stir in chicken and raisins , and bring to a boil
6. Cook over medium heat , stirring constantly , until thickened
7. Serve or rice

title: chocolate butterscotch graham cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. In a bowl , mix together graham cracker crumbs , flour and baking powder
3. In a bowl beat milk and butter until smooth
4. Add in the crumb mixture
5. Mix well
6. Stir in chips , coconut and walnut
7. Drop by tablespoonfuls onto lightly greased cookie sheet
8. Bake for 9-10 minutes , or until lightly browned
9. Cool for 2-3 minutes
10. Remove to wire rack
11. Store loosely , covered at room temperature

title: quick pumpkin pudding
steps:
1. Beat pudding mix and evaporated milk according to package directions in large bowl
2. Refrigerate for 5 minutes
3. Add pumpkin and pumpkin pie spice
4. Mix well
5. Stir in chocolate chips
6. Spoon into dessert dishes
7. Refrigerate for 10 minutes or until ready to serve
8. Top with whipped topping and chocolate syrup , if desired

title: grilled jerk chicken ala bobby flay
steps:
1. Puree all the ingredients , except the chicken , in a food processor until almost smooth
2. Pierce the chicken with a fork to make tiny holes
3. Place the chicken in a large shallow baking dish and rub the marinade into the chicken
4. Cover and refrigerate for 24 to 48 hours , depending on how intense you want the flavor to be
5. Preheat grill
6. Grill chicken on each side for 5 to 6 minutes or until cooked through

title: garlic onion dinner muffins
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400f
2. In a large bowl , mix flour , baking powder , salt and sugar
3. In a small bowl , mix together egg , milk , garlic and onion
4. Make a well in the center of dry ingredients and pour in the egg mixture and melted butter
5. Mix together using as few strokes as possible
6. Do not over beat--the batter should have small lumps in it
7. Pour into 12 paper-lined muffins tins , filling about 2 / 3 full
8. Bake 20 minutes or until muffins begin to turn golden on top
9. Test for doneness with a toothpick which should come out clean
10. Remove from tins and cool slightly before serving

title: broccoli with artichoke hearts
steps:
1. Bring a small amount of water to boil and steam flowerets until bright green and crisp-tender , about 5 minutes
2. Plunge into cold water to stop cooking , drain and set aside
3. Heat oil in skillet over medium heat
4. Add hot peppers and garlic and cook 1 minute
5. Stir in artichoke hearts and cook about 3 minutes , remove from heat and stir in broccoli and lemon juice
6. Transfer to serving bowl and serve immediately

title: applebee s tequila lime chicken
steps:
1. To prepare chicken , pour lime juice and tequila into a sealable plastic bag
2. Place chicken in the bag and place in refrigerator
3. Marinate chicken overnight or up to 6 hours
4. To prepare salsa ranch dressing , in a small bowl mix salsa and ranch dressing
5. Remove chicken from marinade and grill over medium heat 10-15 minutes or until thoroughly cooked
6. To assemble: scatter tortilla chips on an oven-safe plate
7. Place shredded chicken on top of tortilla chips
8. Pour salsa ranch dressing over chicken
9. Cover with the shredded cheddar jack cheese
10. Place chicken under the broiler until cheese is melted
11. Be careful , plate will be hot !
12. Serve with pico de gallo and spanish rice on the side

title: poultry poppy seed casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Saute the onion , celery , and mushrooms in the 2 t butter for 3-5 minutes , until still crisp-tender
3. In a large bowl combine the cooked veggies , soup , sour cream , poppy seeds , dillweed and wine
4. Mix well
5. Stir in cooked poultry and rice , again mixing well
6. Spread mixture into a lightly greased 9x13pan
7. Combine cracker crumbs and melted butter and sprinkle over casserole
8. Bake uncovered for 30 minutes
9. Let stand 5 minutes before serving

title: scrumptious salad supper
steps:
1. Cut iceberg lettuce head in 1 / 2 then in 1 / 2 again
2. Slice into 1 / 2-inch wide pieces and put in salad bowl
3. Cut off bottom of romaine and slice the romaine widthwise in 1 / 2-inch strips
4. Place in salad bowl
5. Toss with remaining vegetables
6. Add croutons and cheese , toss again
7. When salad is well mixed , pour dressing over and toss again
8. Serve with toasted garlic french bread

title: golden raisin coconut oat bars
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees
2. Butter a 9-inch square baking dish
3. For the crust
4. In a bowl stir together the melted butter , white sugar , brown sugar until well blended
5. In a small bowl mix together flour , oats , cinnamon and pinch of salt , then add to the creamed mixture
6. Mix until just blended
7. Lightly press the mixture into the bottom of the prepared baking dish
8. Bake for 15 minutes , or until lightly browned
9. Cool to room temperature
10. For the raisin topping
11. In a bowl beat the eggs with sugar and vanilla using an electric mixer until fluffy
12. In a small bowl mix together flour , baking powder and cinnamon
13. Using a spatula fold into the egg / sugar mixture until blended
14. Stir in raisins and coconut
15. Mix to combine
16. Spread over the cooled crust
17. Bake for about 20-25 minutes , or until golden brown
18. Cool before slicing

title: cappuccino chip cookies
steps:
1. In a medium bowl stir together flour , baking powder , salt and cinnamon
2. In a large bowl cream together butter and sugars until combined
3. Stir in the egg
4. In a small bowl mix espresso powder and vanilla until dissolved
5. Stir espresso mixture into butter mixture until combined
6. Gradually stir in flour mixture until blended then stir in chocolate chips and nuts
7. Cover and refrigerate dough for 1 hour
8. Preheat oven to 375
9. Grease 2 baking sheets
10. Drop dough by heaping tablespoonfuls onto baking sheets
11. Leave about 2" between rounds
12. Bake for 9-14 minutes , or until cookies are lightly browned on bottoms
13. Cool on baking sheet a few minutes then remove to a wire rack and cool completely

title: tex mex chicken lasagna
steps:
1. In saucepan over medium heat , combine spaghetti sauce and 1 cup of picante sauce ,
2. Seasoning mix , cook for 10 minutes
3. Spread cup picante sauce in bottom of deep 8 x 12 baking dish
4. Layer tortillas , chicken , sauce mix , cottage cheese , and olives , in that
5. Order
6. Top with cheese and olives
7. Bake at 350 for 20-25 minutes or until cheese is melted and casserole is bubbly
8. Let stand 10 minutes before cutting

title: provencial black olive and fresh thyme mashed potatoes
steps:
1. Put potatoes in a large saucepan and cover with cold water and bring to a boil
2. Reduce heat to med and cook until potatoes are very tender when stabbed with a fork , about 15 minutes
3. Drain well
4. Return to the saucepan and add the cream and butter
5. With a hand mixer , blend until just smooth
6. Add the olives and thyme
7. Garnish with fresh thyme
8. Season generously with salt and pepper
9. According to oprah this serves 12 to 15

title: ww core mongolian beef
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , mix together 1 tablespoon soy sauce , 1 tablespoon cornstarch , and minced garlic
2. Stir in beef strips
3. Let stand for at least 10 minutes
4. In a separate small bowl , mix together water , soy sauce , 2 1 / 2 teaspoons cornstarch , splenda , and red pepper
5. Set aside
6. Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a skillet over high heat
7. Cook and stir beef in hot olive oil for 1 minute
8. Remove , and set aside
9. Heat remaining tablespoon of olive oil in the same pan
10. Saute carrots and white part of green onions for 2 minutes
11. Stir in green portion of the onion , and saute for 1 minute
12. Stir in sauce mixture and beef
13. Cook and stir until sauce boils and thickens

title: 5 layered lasagna
steps:
1. Boil lasagna noodles until soft
2. Cook beef and onion in big fry pan for 10 min or until thoroughly cooked
3. Add spaghetti sauce , italian seasoning , and parsley
4. Simmer for 5 minute
5. Drain noodles and rinse with cold water
6. Spray / grease 9 x 13 pan
7. Put 3 noodles across bottom of pan
8. Put half of spaghetti sauce on top
9. Put 3 more noodles across
10. Put of mozzarella cheese on top
11. Put 3 more noodles across
12. Put all of cottage cheese on top
13. Put 3 more noodles across
14. Put the remaining spaghetti sauce on top
15. Put 3 more noodles across
16. Sprinkle the rest of the mozzarella cheese , cheddar and parsley on top
17. Bake at 400 f for 10 minute until cheese is melted on top

title: provencal soup
steps:
1. In a saucepan , heat oil and melt butter
2. Brown garlic and onion 4 minutes
3. Add salt and pepper
4. Add red bell pepper and zucchini , and let cook 4 minutes
5. Deglaze with the white wine
6. Add tomatoes and vegetable stock
7. Heat and let reduce , uncovered , 5 to 7 minutes
8. Add olives and basil
9. Stir delicately and heat a little bit more
10. Serve with garlic croutons

title: super cherry cola float
steps:
1. Stir boiling water into gelatin in medium bowl 2 minutes until completely dissolved
2. Stir in cola
3. Refrigerate 20 to 30 minutes or until slightly thickened
4. Reserve 1 / 2 cup gelatin
5. Place 1 / 2 cup ice cream into each of 4 tall ice cream soda glasses
6. Top with thickened gelatin mixture
7. Beat reserved 1 / 2 cup gelatin mixture with electric mixer on medium speed until light and fluffy
8. Spoon into each glass
9. Refrigerate 2 hours or until firm
10. Garnish each float with a maraschino cherry and sprinkles

title: balsamic hummus
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in food processor
2. Blend / process until smooth

title: brussels sprouts hash
steps:
1. Saute shallots in butter until soft and golden , about 10 minutes
2. Add vinegar and sugar , stirring until brown and glazed , about 3 minutes
3. Meanwhile , heat olive oil in pan over medium heat
4. Add brussel sprouts , salt and pepper
5. Saute 6 minutes or until brown around the edges
6. Add 1 cup water and remaining 3 tbls butter
7. Saute until most of moisture has evaporated and brussel sprouts are tender , about 3 minutes
8. Add vinegar mixture to brussel sprouts and stir to cover
9. Add crumbled bacon
10. Enjoy !

title: 20 minute tomato basil pork chops
steps:
1. Brown chops in skillet in oil
2. Combine tomato , soup , water and seasonings and add to browned chops
3. Cover and simmer about 15 minutes , or until chops are done
4. Stir in butter or margarine prior to serving
5. Serve over noodles or rice

title: two  minute shrimp scampi
steps:
1. Defrost shrimp
2. In a large bowl , mix all the ingredients together , tossing well to coat the shrimp
3. Cook in skillet until pink
4. Top with sesame seeds if desired

title: sweet   speedy breakfast oat bran muffin  microwave
steps:
1. Combine egg and stevia , and mix thoroughly
2. Add cinnamon , baking soda , vanilla extract , and oat bran and mix completely
3. Let sit for a couple of minutes , so the oat bran can absorb some of the liquid
4. Microwave on medium for a little over a minute

title: double berry margaritas in the ice cream maker
steps:
1. Add blackberries and raspberries with 1 / 2 cup sour mix to a blender
2. Chop until berries are processed
3. Add remainder of sour mix , triple sec , tequila and sugar to the blender
4. Puree until smooth , about 30-40 seconds
5. Start ice cream maker and pour in liquid
6. Let the machine do its work until the liquid becomes slushy to your liking
7. Ours was good at about 15-20 minutes
8. Pour into a margarita glass and garnish with a slice of lime !

title: apple poached pork chops
steps:
1. In a deep fry pan sear / brown the pork chops
2. This step keeps the chops from drying out and adds a lot of flavor to the final sauce
3. Add in the apple juice
4. Cook on a medium high heat for around 6 minutes each side
5. Once cooked remove thge pork chops
6. Mix the flour and water together and add to the remaining juice
7. Once thickened serve with the pork chops

title: pretty pink drink
steps:
1. Pour the pineapple juice among 2 ice-cube trays and place in the freezer for 4 hours or until set
2. Combine lemonade and grapefruit juice in a large serving jug
3. Add the ice cubes and serve immediately
4. You can make the ice cubes and chill the lemonade and grapefruit juice up to 1 day ahead
5. Carry out step 2 just before serving

title: gingerbread caramel corn
steps:
1. Divide popped popcorn equally between 1 lightly buttered 13x9 baking pan
2. Combine salt , butter , brown sugar , corn syrup , molasses , ginger and cinnamon in a large heavy saucepan
3. Heat over medium heat till mixture comes to a full boil
4. Boil for 5 minutes , stirring frequently , remove from heat
5. Add baking soda , it will foam up -- stir well
6. Pour over popcorn in prepared pans and toss to combine well
7. Bake at 250 for one hour , stirring every 15 minutes
8. Till popcorn is crisp --
9. Cool completely , and store in an airtight container

title: spaghetti with best ever bolognese sauce
steps:
1. In 12-inch skillet brown ground beef , onion , carrot , and garlic until meat is no longer pink , stirring occasionally
2. Drain off fat
3. 2
4. Add half-and-half
5. Bring to boiling
6. Reduce heat
7. Simmer , uncovered , 5 minutes or until half-and-half is nearly evaporated
8. Stir in broth , then vinegar
9. Return to boiling
10. Reduce heat
11. Simmer , uncovered , 15 minutes or until liquid is nearly evaporated
12. Stir in crushed tomatoes , tomato paste , seasoning , pepper , and salt
13. Bring to boiling
14. Reduce heat
15. Simmer , uncovered , 5 minutes or until thickened
16. 3
17. Meanwhile , cook spaghetti , with 1 tablespoon salt added to water , according to package directions drain
18. Serve spaghetti with sauce
19. Sprinkle with cheese and oregano
20. Makes 8 servings

title: natural pumpkin pudding
steps:
1. Sift together the dry ingredients
2. Mix in the liquid ingredients until smooth
3. Pour into a 9 x 9 cake pan and bake at 350 for 40 min
4. , it won't be completely set , but do not overcook
5. Eat warm or cold

title: tropical dream smoothie
steps:
1. Put all ingredients into blender
2. Blend until smooth
3. Serve

title: brown sugar pecan meringues
steps:
1. First , mix both sugars , set aside
2. Whip whites on med
3. Up to a soft peak
4. Add sugars one tablespoon at a time , while mixing
5. When all sugar is added , turn on high and whip to a stiff peak
6. Fold in pecans and vanilla
7. Drop by spoonfulls onto parchment lined cookie sheets
8. Smooth with the back of the spoon into rounds a half to 3 / 4 inches thick
9. Bake at 300 for 30-40 minutes or until dry and a light golden brown
10. Makes 24 big cookies

title: cranberry walnut pumpkin bread
steps:
1. In a large bowl , mix together cranberry sauce , molasses , pumpkin , oil and eggs
2. In a second bowl , stir together the remaining ingredients
3. Add cranberry mixture to flour mixture and stir until all ingredients are well moistened
4. Divide batter between two 9 x 5-inch greased loaf pans
5. Bake at 350 degrees for 65 minutes or until bread tests done with wooden pick

title: refrigerator minted brownies
steps:
1. In a large bowl combine the nuts , mallows , graham crumbs and sugar
2. Toss well
3. In a saucepot place evaporated milk with the chocolate pieces and melt stirring until smooth over low heat
4. Remove from heat and add the flavouring
5. Reserve 1 / 2 cup of the melted chocolate for the frosting
6. Stir the remaining chocolate into the dry ingredients and combine well
7. Press into a well buttered brownie pan 7 x 11 inch pan or a 9 inch pan
8. Pour remaining chocolate over the top and smooth out
9. Chill until ready to serve
10. Cut into 16 two inch pieces

title: banh mi vietnamese sandwiches  bnh mi
steps:
1. If using satay marinade , combine ingredients , and marinate meat at least 2 hours in the refrigerator
2. Sprinkle carrot and daikon with salt and 1 teaspoon of the sugar and toss with fingers
3. Let sit about 3 minutes , until softened
4. Rinse and drain
5. Mix vinegar , water , and 1 tablespoon of sugar
6. Add carrot and daikon , and let marinate at least 1 hour in the refrigerator
7. Grill meat until done and slice
8. Lightly toast bread
9. Spread lightly with mayonnaise and sprinkle on soy sauce
10. Fill with cilantro , carrot , daikon , cucumber , meat and jalapeno
11. Close and enjoy !

title: moroccan pilaf
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Lightly oil a shallow 1 1 / 2 quart ovenproof casserole
3. Heat the oil in a large skillet , and saute the almonds over medium heat until they are browned and fragrant , 3 minutes
4. Stir in the onion , carrot , and cinnamon
5. Cook 3 more minutes
6. Add the rice and cook , stirring , until translucent , about 1 minute
7. Stir in the broth , currants , orange zest , cayenne pepper , and salt and pepper to taste
8. Bring to a boil
9. Remove from the heat
10. Transfer the mixture to the prepared casserole and bake , uncovered , until the liquid has been absorbed and the rice is tender , about 45 minutes
11. Sprinkle with chives , and serve
12. Enjoy !

title: tassajara bread
steps:
1. Step one:
2. Mix together water and yeast , let rest for 5 minutes
3. Then add honey , powdered milk , whole wheat flour and white flour
4. Beat all these ingredients together well
5. This batter will be thick
6. Once well mixed , let rise 1 hour
7. Step two:
8. Fold in salt , oil and flour
9. Use more flour as needed to knead bread
10. Let bread rise for 50 minutes , then punch down
11. Let rise 40 more minutes then shape into loaves
12. This makes approximately 5 loaves
13. Put loaves into greased pans
14. Let loaves rise for 20 minutes
15. Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour
16. When you remove the loaves from the oven , take a stick of butter or margarine and rub it over the top crust of the bread for a softer crust
17. Let cool in the pans for 5 minutes and remove to cooling racks
18. Now when my mom makes this bread , she makes half of the loaves with cinnamon , sugar , a little melted butter and raisins make those loaves just like you would a cinnamon roll - flatten the dough out and spread the rest of the ingredients on the dough , then roll back up and put in pans

title: hearts of palm with garlic dip
steps:
1. Put your garlic in your food processor and process until smooth
2. Add hearts of palm process until they are like a rough puree
3. Slowly , in a thin drizzle , pour in oil until the mixture has a fluffy , velvet consistency
4. Season to taste
5. Stir in the green onions just before serving
6. Serv e within a few hours of processing

title: cherry chocolate crock pot dessert
steps:
1. Place pie filling in slow cooker
2. Combine dry cake mix and butter
3. Sprinkle over filling
4. Cover and cook on low for 3 hours

title: toffee studded snickerdoodles
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400
2. Beat butter , shortening and 1 cup sugar in bowl until light and fluffy add eggs beat thoroughly
3. Add vanilla extract
4. In a seperate bowl stir together flour , cream of tartar , baking soda and salt
5. Gradually add the flour mixture to the butter mixture beating until blended and then stir in toffee bits
6. In a seperate bowl stir together 3 tbsp sugar and 1 tsp cinnamon
7. Shape cookies into 1 1 / 4 inch balls and roll in cinnamon and sugar mixture
8. Place on ungreased cookie sheets for 9-11 minutes
9. Cook until slightly brown around the edges
10. Cool overnight for the best flavour

title: crawfish stew
steps:
1. Best thing to use is an iron pot heat fat until melted in your iron pot
2. Add green peppers , celery , garlic , onions and saute until they are cooked
3. Add flour , blending very well , gradually add all seasonings , tomato sauce , water& crawfish tails
4. Simmer on very low heat
5. In 30 min's it will be done
6. You can serve over rice
7. I like it just plain with no rice

title: mashed potatoes   cauliflower with ginger scallion pesto
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , combine potatoes , cauliflower and salt with enough cold water to cover
2. Bring to a boil and cook until potatoes are easily crushed with a fork
3. Drain and mash with butter and milk until smooth
4. Warm potatoes over medium heat for 1 minute
5. Add pesto , and stir well
6. Season to taste with salt and pepper
7. Serve

title: stuffed chicken breasts with smashed potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300 degrees f
2. For the stuffing:
3. Saute pancetta in a pan sprayed with non stick spray until crisp , remove to a bowl
4. Add the spinach , ricotta , gorgonzola , basil , parsley and mix well
5. Season with salt and pepper
6. Add the eggs , mix well , and set aside
7. Make the chicken:
8. Place each chicken breast between 2 doubled-up sheets of plastic wrap , and pound to an even 1 / 4-inch thickness with a meat-pounder or rolling pin
9. Divide the stuffing between the breasts , mounding it along the center of each
10. Fold the bottom edge of each breast over the stuffing , fold in the sides , and roll forward until completely wrapped , to form a tight rolled package
11. Secure each flap with a toothpick
12. Season the chicken all over with salt and pepper , to taste
13. Heat 2 tbsp oil in a large skillet over medium heat
14. Add the chicken in batches and cook , turning occasionally , until browned , about 2 minutes per side
15. Cover the skillet , turn the heat down to low , and cook until just cooked through , about 5 minutes more
16. Transfer to a platter , tent with foil and keep warm in oven
17. Meanwhile make the potatoes--
18. Add potatoes in a 6 qt pan with water to cover and kosher salt
19. Bring to a boil
20. Lower to simmer , cover and cook 15-20 minutes until potatoes are tender
21. Drain
22. Return to pot and cook over low heat until dried , remove from heat
23. Add butter , salt , pepper and milk , mashing with a masher until chunky , set aside
24. For the sauce :
25. Pour wine into the skillet over high heat and cook , stirring and scraping the bottom with a wooden spoon
26. Add stock , mustard , lemon zest and juice , parsley , salt and pepper to taste
27. Bring to a boil and simmer until thickened , 5-8 minutes
28. Place potatoes on 4 plates
29. Serve 1 chicken breast overlapping potatoes and serve sauce atop

title: lori s savory sweet potatoes
steps:
1. Heat oven 350
2. Toss all together to coat
3. Place on a sprayed baking sheet
4. Bake 20-25 minutes or until golden and crispy

title: oven fried chicken breast cutlets
steps:
1. Stir together first 5 ingredients in a medium bowl
2. Combine cracker crumbs and cheese in a shallow bowl
3. Dip chicken in butter mixture
4. Dredge in cracker crumb mixture
5. Place on an aluminum foil-lined baking sheet
6. Bake at 400 degrees for 25-30 minutes or until the chicken is brown and done
7. Garnish , if desired

title: creamy chicken   mushroom pasta
steps:
1. Cook pasta until cooked , drain and return to the pan
2. In a large frypan , add olive oil and fry the onion until translucent , add chicken , chilli , basil and oregano and cook until browned
3. Remove from pan
4. In the same pan add mushrooms and cook until tender
5. Add chicken stock , cream and mustard and return the chicken and onion mixture to the pan
6. Bring to boil
7. Bring to boil , reduce heat and simmer until chicken is cooked through and the sauce is thickening
8. Add the chicken sauce to the pasta and fold through
9. Top with shaved parmesan cheese

title: cashew mushroom stroganoff
steps:
1. Place cashews in a shallow pan and warm slightly in a 250 degree oven
2. Keep warm until serving
3. Then , in a large saucepan , heat oil over medium heat and saute garlic and onions until onions are soft but not brown
4. Add mushrooms and tamari soy sauce and cook until tender
5. Add tomato paste and mix thoroughly , cooking about 2-3 minutes
6. Slowly add sour cream , combining all ingredients well
7. Serve stroganoff over a bed of brown rice , cover with toasted cashew nuts and garnish with the parsley and paprika

title: honey nut cake
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 175c
2. Finely chop the hazelnuts and apple
3. Mix the nuts , apple and
4. Honey in a bowl
5. Whisk in the eggs
6. Spread the mixture into a large circle on a greased baking tray
7. Bake on the middle shelf for approximately 15 minutes

title: algarve oven baked codfish with cauliflower  pescada assada
steps:
1. Set your oven to 400 degrees f
2. Clean the cauliflower and parboil the entire head in lightly salted boiling water for 10 minutes
3. Drain and then separate into fleurettes
4. Set aside in a warm place
5. While the cauliflower is cooking , grease an ovenproof casserole dish with olive oil
6. Arrange the fish in the dish , then sprinkle it with the onion and garlic
7. Season with salt and pepper and the chile powder if using
8. Pour the wine over the fish and drizzle with the olive oil
9. Bake the fish for 20 minutes
10. About 5 minutes before the fish is due to be done , add the cauliflower to the pan
11. Garnish with the parsley and serve immediately

title: latvian borscht aka ukrainian borshch
steps:
1. Heat the stock in a large soup pot , add cabbage and potatoes and simmer for 15 minutes
2. In the meantime , mix the beets , vinegar , bacon fat , sugar , and tomatoes in a saucepan and cook gently , covered , for about 5 minutes
3. Set aside
4. Then , in another small pan , heat the butter , mix in the onion , carrot , and parsley root , and braise
5. When the cabbage and potatoes are finished simmering , add the beet mixture , the onion mixture , the peppercorns , allspice berries , and bay leaves--and cook another 10 minutes
6. Stir in the chopped garlic , the remaining bacon fat , and the chopped parsley
7. Then turn the heat down to a very low simmer , lightly cover the pot , and simmer very slowly for about 4 hours
8. Turn off the heat , let cool , and allow to ripen for about 12-18 hours
9. When ready to serve , reheat gently then ladle into bowls
10. Top each with a teaspoonful of sour cream and serve with a slice of dark rye bread

title: ultimate chicken patty sandwich
steps:
1. Breading:
2. 1 cup all-purpose flour
3. Salt and freshly ground black pepper
4. 3 eggs , beaten
5. 2 cups panko bread crumbs , in shallow dish
6. Chipotle mayo , recipe follows
7. Preheat a deep-fryer with canola oil to 350 degrees f
8. Pick the chicken from the bones and add to a large bowl
9. Set aside
10. In a medium saute pan over medium-high heat , add the 2 tablespoons of olive oil
11. Add the peppers , onions , jalapenos , and garlic and cook until slightly caramelized
12. Stir in the bouillon and cayenne and season with salt and pepper , to taste
13. Place pepper and onion mixture , picked chicken , egg and bread crumbs into a food processor and pulse until well incorporated and slightly chunky
14. Form chicken mixture into burger-size patties
15. Put the flour into a shallow dish and season with salt and pepper
16. Put the eggs and bread crumbs into separate shallow dishes
17. Bread the patties by dredging into the seasoned flour , then the eggs and finally through the bread crumbs
18. Transfer to a platter
19. Fry the patties until crispy and golden , 1 to 2 minutes
20. Spread chipotle mayo on both sides of the portuguese rolls
21. Add the chicken patties to the bottom of the rolls and top with a good spoonful of tabbouleh
22. Cover with the roll tops and serve
23. Chipotle mayo:
24. 1 cup mayonnaise
25. 1 lemon , juiced
26. 1 teaspoon minced garlic
27. 2 chipotle peppers , minced
28. Pinch kosher salt
29. Pinch cracked black pepper
30. 1 teaspoon chopped garlic
31. In a small bowl , mix all the ingredients until well incorporated
32. Cover and put in the refrigerator until ready to use

title: marinated vegetables deluxe
steps:
1. Break or cut vegetables into bite size pieces and place in large bowl
2. Pour dressing over vegetables , mix and refrigerate overnight
3. Stir occasionally

title: beer and honey marinade
steps:
1. Blend all the ingredients and pour the marinade over your meat
2. Marinate 1-24 hours in the refrigerator , turning pieces occasionally

title: mashed baked potatoes
steps:
1. Boil potatoes 15 minutes or until done
2. Mash potatoes with margarine
3. Using mixer , add milk a little at a time , alternately with cream cheese cubes and onion
4. Season w / salt and pepper to taste
5. Pour into 2 quart casserole dish
6. Bake@325 for 30 minutes

title: savory burgers
steps:
1. Thaw ground beef
2. Add soy sauce and bbq sauce and mix well because the soy sauce tends to settle at the bottom
3. Add the desired amount of seasonings and grill

title: jaegerschnitzel
steps:
1. Preparation of meat: pound cutlets and rub in salt and pepper
2. Let stand for about 10 minutes
3. Dip the cutlets in beaten egg and then in crumbs
4. Brown in a small amount of oil over a low heat for about 10 minutes on each side
5. Preparation of gravy whilemeat is browning , saute bacon and onions until golden brown
6. Add tomato paste and mushrooms , and saute over a low heat
7. Add wine , water and seasonings
8. Let simmer for about 5 minutes
9. Stir in the sour cream
10. Pour over schnitzel

title: easy low carb pizza sauce  and pasta sauce base
steps:
1. 1
2. Place tomato paste in a small mixing bowl
3. Add water , using some of the water to rinse the last of the paste out of the cans
4. Stir well
5. 2
6. Add seasonings and stir again
7. You will have a very thick pizza sauce
8. Add more water if you like a thinner sauce
9. 3
10. Refrigerate leftovers up to one week
11. Freeze for up to a year

title: banana bread  with a twist
steps:
1. Grease 2 loaf pans
2. Preheat oven to 350
3. Mash 2 bananas with 1 teaspoon baking soda
4. Slightly beat 2 eggs , add sugar and peanut butter , mixing well
5. Mix in the banana mixture and the flour , combining well
6. Pour into prepared pans
7. Bake 40-50 minutes
8. Cool 10 minutes , then remove from pans and finish cooling on wire racks
9. Freezes well

title: haricots verts with carmelized shallots
steps:
1. Cook the green beans in boiling salted water to cover 3 to 4 minutes , or until crisp tender
2. Drain
3. Plunge the beans into ice water to stop the cooking process
4. Drain
5. Melt the butter and brown sugar with olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat
6. Add shallots , and saute 2 minutes
7. Reduce the heat to medium-low , add vinegar , and saute 10 minutes or until the shallots are golden brown and tender
8. Increase the heat to medium-high
9. Add the green beans
10. Saute 5 minutes or until thoroughly heated
11. Season with salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste

title: buttered wine rice
steps:
1. Heat butter in a pan , add onion and cook gently until onion is tender and lightly golden
2. Add rice and stir for 3 minutes
3. Add 1 cup of hot chicken stock to pan and stir until almost completely dissolved
4. Add remaining stock & wine , bring to the boil , reduce heat & simmer gently for approximately 10 mins until rice is tender
5. Season with salt & pepper & serve

title: pork chop and new potato skillet
steps:
1. Season pork chops with salt and pepper
2. Heat 10-inch skillet over medium-high heat and add butter and oil
3. Cook pork in skillet until brown on both sides
4. Mix soup , mushrooms , water , wine , thyme , garlic powder , worcestershire sauce and salt and pepper
5. Pour over pork
6. Heat to boiling , stirring occasionally
7. Reduce heat
8. Cover and simmer 15 minutes
9. Add potatoes
10. Cover and simmer 15 minutes
11. Stir in pimiento and peas
12. Cover and simmer about 10 minute , stirring occasionally , until pork is tender and slightly pink when centers of thickest parts are cut and peas are tender

title: super easy 6 ingredient stroganoff
steps:
1. Brown meat and drain
2. Add the last 4 ingredients to meat , simmer 10 minute
3. Serve over cooked egg noodles

title: chipotle taco sauce
steps:
1. In a blender or food processor add the chipotle peppers in adobo , vinegar , sugar and tomato paste
2. Cover with lid and puree until smooth
3. With blender or food processor running add a slow stream of water until you reach the desired thickness of your perfered taco sauce
4. You may wish to use less or add more water than 1 cup
5. This keeps in the fridge for 1 month

title: canadian butterscotch pie
steps:
1. Mix in pan the first 3 ingredients and add the 2 cups milk and the 3 egg yolks , beaten / cook on medium heat until boiling
2. Remove from heat and add vanilla and butter-- pour into pre-baked crust
3. Chill

title: spam pasta casserole
steps:
1. Cook pasta 2 minutes under package directions
2. Drain
3. Meanwhile , in a large frying pan , melt butter
4. Saut celery , onion and spam until vegetables are just getting soft
5. Add soup , tomatoes and seasonings
6. Cook until well blended and heated through
7. Place pasta in a large casserole
8. Add spam mixture and tomato sauce
9. Tossing well to mix
10. Cover tightly and cook in a 325 oven for 45 - 60 minutes

title: bay scallops in wine
steps:
1. Dredge scallops in flour , salt and pepper
2. Heat oil in a wok or large frying pan and brown the scallops , then remove from heat
3. Add onions and garlic to oil and stir
4. When the onions and garlic are soft , add the wine , tarragon , and parsley and boil to reduce liquid by 1 / 3
5. Return the scallops to the sauce and cook for 30 seconds
6. Serve with rice or noodles

title: chicken or lamb biriyani
steps:
1. Combine together ingredients 3 to 15 and mix well
2. Add the meat to it and let it marinate for about 2 hours
3. Heat the ghee in a pan and add the cashew nuts , cinnamon , cardamom and cloves
4. Fry for 15 seconds and add the sliced onion
5. When the onions turn transparent , add the marinated meat and without adding any water , cook the meat on medium heat till the meat is completely done
6. The masala will reduce and lose all moisture
7. Set aside
8. Wash the rice and steam cook it so that individual grains can be separated
9. Dissolve the saffron in the milk
10. Take about one cup of cooked rice and add the saffron to it
11. Now mix this colored rice with the rest of the cooked rice , so that you get streaks of orange in the rice
12. In a deep oven-safe bowl , pour this rice and spread to cover the entire bottom of the vessel
13. Pour the meat on top and spread evenly
14. Cover the dish with foil and bake for about 20 minutes at 300f
15. Remove and serve hot , garnished with chopped herbs and fried onions

title: tasty oven fried potatoes
steps:
1. Peel potatoes and cut into 1 inch cubes
2. Place potatoes in a large resealable plastic bag
3. Combine parmesan cheese , salt , garlic powder , paprika and pepper
4. Add to potatoes
5. Seal the plastic bag and carefully shake to coat the potatoes with the spice mixture
6. Coat a 15 x 10 inch pan with a thin coating of vegetable oil
7. Spread potatoes evenly in a single layer in the pan
8. Bake uncovered at 375 degrees for 40 - 50 minutes until potatoes are tender

title: leeky spud vegetarian soup
steps:
1. Cook leeks in butter with salt and pepper for 10 minutes
2. Do not brown !
3. Add water , broth , and potatoes
4. Cook 20 minutes
5. Scoop 1 / 2 of soup out from pan , place in blender , puree , return to pan
6. Add dash of marjoram and tabasco

title: varna style braised chicken  bulgarian dish
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 200 degree celsius
2. Heat oil and butter in wok , and in the meantime season chicken with salt , pepper and thyme
3. Add the seasoned chicken pieces to the wok and brown at all sides
4. Place the cooked chicken in a casserole dish and set aside
5. For the sauce:
6. Stir fry garlic and onions approximately 2-3 mins until soft , adding the rest of the sauce ingredients except mushrooms
7. Bring to a boil , then reduce heat and add the mushrooms
8. Pour sauce over chicken , cover and bake for 1hr hour , or until cooked thoroughly
9. Garnish with basil or thyme and serve

title: apple onion jam
steps:
1. Combine the onion in a small saucepan with three-quarters cup of the cider and the vinegar , allspice berries and jalape&#961
2. O
3. Bring to a boil over high heat , then reduce the heat to medium and cook , stirring occasionally , for 30 minutes
4. Remove and discard the allspice
5. Peel and core the apple , then cut lengthwise into eighths and crosswise into very thin slices
6. Add the apples to the onion mixture along with the remaining cider
7. Cook , stirring often , until the mixture is soft , about 30 minutes
8. Remove the mixture to a bowl and cool to room temperature

title: cavatini
steps:
1. Cook the beef , sausage , onion and green pepper until brown
2. Drain and set aside
3. Mix the pepperoni , tomatoes , spaghetti sauce , salsa , mushrooms and salad peppers
4. Stir into the meat mixture
5. Add the cooked pasta shells
6. Spoon 1 / 2 of the mixture into 2 greased 11x7 inch baking dishes
7. Combine the two cheeses and divide the amount in half
8. Take one half of the cheese and sprinkle on top of the meat in each dish
9. Take the remaining 1 / 2 of the meat mixture and cover the cheese in the two dishes
10. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes
11. Top each dish with the remaining 1 / 2 of the cheese
12. Bake 5 more minutes or until cheese is bubbly

title: short ribs with tagliatelle  and chocolate   giada de laurentiis
steps:
1. Place the olive oil in a large heavy soup pot over medium heat
2. Cook the pancetta until golden and crisp , about 4 minutes
3. Meanwhile , season the short ribs with salt and pepper , and dredge in the flour
4. Using a slotted spoon , remove the pancetta from the pan and set aside
5. Add the short ribs to the pan and brown on all sides , about 7 minutes total
6. Meanwhile , combine the onion , carrot , parsley and garlic in a food processor and blend until finely minced
7. Then add the tomatoes and tomato paste and pulse
8. Once the short ribs are browned , carefully add the mixture from the food processor to the pot
9. Return the pancetta to the pot and stir
10. Add the rosemary , thyme , oregano , bay leaf , beef broth , and wine
11. Bring the mixture to a boil
12. Reduce the heat and simmer , covered , for 1 hour and 15 minutes
13. Remove the lid and simmer for another hour and a half , stirring occasionally
14. Remove the meat and bones from the pot
15. Discard the bones
16. Shred the meat and return it to the pot
17. Season with 1 / 2 teaspoon salt and 3 / 4 teaspoon pepper , or to taste
18. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil over high heat
19. Add the pasta and cook until tender but still firm to the bite , stirring occasionally , about 8 to 10 minutes for dried pasta and 2 to 3 minutes for fresh
20. Drain the pasta , reserving 1 cup of the cooking liquid
21. Add the pasta to the pot and stir to combine
22. Add the reserved pasta liquid 1 / 4 cup at a time , if needed , to moisten the pasta
23. Transfer to serving bowls , top each bowl with 1 teaspoon of chocolate shavings
24. Serve immediately

title: pat s rice a roni salad
steps:
1. Dressing: 1 / 3 cup mayonnaise 1 tsp
2. Curry powder 2 tbsp
3. Italian dressing cook rice-a-roni in 2 tablespoons oil instead of butter and use 2 cups water
4. Cool in large bowl
5. Add onions , pepper , olives , artichokes
6. Blend dressing ingredients and toss with rice mixture
7. Chill several hours before serving

title: spinach breakfast casserole
steps:
1. In a large skillet , cook / crumble sausage over medium heat until sausage is browned
2. Drain
3. Spread croutons evenly in the bottom of a 3-quart casserole dish
4. Spread sausage over croutons
5. Top with spinach and carrot
6. In a mixing bowl , whisk the milk , eggs , and soup together
7. Stir in the mushrooms , 1 cup cheddar cheese , 1 cup monterey jack cheese , and dry mustard until mixed together
8. Pour over layers in casserole dish
9. Cover and chill for 8-24 hours
10. Bake , uncovered , in a 325 oven for 45 minutes
11. Sprinkle with additional cheese
12. Bake 10 minutes or until edges are bubbly and center is heated through
13. Let stand for 10 minutes before serving

title: boilermaker
steps:
1. Pour whiskey into a shot glass
2. Serve beer in a frosted mug or glass as a chaser
3. Or drop whiskey-filled shot glass into beer-filled mug

title: irish macaroni and cheese with stout
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 f and butter a 9x13-inch baking dish or six 6-ounce ramekins
2. Cook pasta acording to its directions
3. Al dente is fine
4. Cool pasta and set aside for later
5. In a skillet over medium heat , melt 1 teaspoon of the butter
6. Add the shallots and cook until soft , but not browned , about 3 minutes
7. Add the guinness and cook until reduced by half , about 5 minutes
8. Then add the cream and cook until reduced by half , about 5 minutes more
9. Remove from heat and cool to room temperature
10. Seperately , melt remaining 2 teaspoons of butter
11. In a bowl , combine the cooked pasta , cheese , and cream mixture
12. Pour into prepared pan or ramekins
13. Top with bread crumbs and spoon melted butter over the top
14. Bake for 30 minutes , until bread crumbs are lightly browned and sauce is bubbling

title: knock you nakeds
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180c& grease and line a 8 x 13 inch pyrex dish
2. Combine cake mix , nuts , 1 / 3 cup evaporated milk and butter
3. Press half of the mixture into the pyrex dish , bake at 180c for 8 minutes
4. Melt carmel candy with 1 / 2 cup evaporated milk in the top of a double-boiler
5. When caramel mixture is melted and well mixed , pour over the top of the baked mixture
6. Cover with the choc chips and pour the rest of the cake mixture on top of the choc chips
7. Bake at 180c for 18 minutes or until cooked
8. Cool before slicing

title: angel hair shrimp bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Mix the shrimp , pasta , feta cheese , swiss cheese , and salsa in a bowl
3. Pour into a greased 13-in
4. X 9-in
5. X 2-in
6. Baking dish
7. Mix the monterey jack cheese , parsley , basil , and oregano
8. Sprinkle on the pasta
9. In a small bowl , whisk the eggs , half-and-half , and yogurt
10. Pour over the casserole
11. Bake , uncovered , at 350 for 25-30 minutes or until pasta is tender
12. Let stand for 5 minutes before serving
13. Serve with garlic bread and a salad

title: ww slow cooker chicken paprikash
steps:
1. Coat a nonstick skillet with cooking spray and heat
2. Add mushrooms , onion , garlic and pepper
3. Saut 5 minutes
4. Stir in paprika , salt and pepper
5. Cook 30 seconds more
6. Spoon mixture into a 4- to 5-quart slow cooker
7. Add broth
8. Cut each chicken breast into 4 long strips
9. Add to slow cooker
10. Cover and cook on low setting for 5 to 6 hours
11. Stir together flour and sour cream in a cup
12. Stir into chicken mixture
13. Cover and cook on low until the mixture is thick and hot , about 10 minutes more
14. Yields about 1 1 / 2 cups per serving

title: eggplant bharta
steps:
1. Heat oil in a saucepan on medium flame
2. Add onion and saute until it turns transparent
3. Fold in garlic and saute for 2 minutes or until the raw smell is gone
4. Stir in all the spice powders
5. Saute for 2 minutes
6. Now add half a cup of water and the tomatoes and cook for 5 minutes
7. Fold in eggplant and salt
8. Cook for 10 minutes or until the eggplant is well cooked
9. It should be dry
10. Garnish with chopped cilantro
11. Serve hot with rotis and raita
12. Enjoy !

title: pita triangles with sun dried tomato basil dip
steps:
1. Mix together the cream cheese , mayo , tomato , lemon juice& garlic , mix well
2. Cut each pita into 12 bite size triangles , the trangles are double thickness , and place them on a cookie sheet
3. Mix together the butter , lemon pepper , fresh basil and pepper
4. Brush one side of each triangle with the butter mixture
5. Bake in 350f oven for apprx 10 minutes or untilcrisp& browned
6. Cool the pita chips& serve with the dip

title: pueblo pumpkin muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Mix together oil , sugar , eggs , pumpkin , and buttermilk , and extract
3. Add flour , baking powder , baking soda , cinnamon , allspice , and beat until batter is smooth
4. Stir in walnuts and raisins
5. Spoon into greased muffin tins full and bake 10 minutes , reducing the oven to 350 and bake until toothpick comes out clean , about 15 additional minutes

title: weight watcher s 5pts creamy baked tacos
steps:
1. Set oven to 325 degrees
2. Spray a 9-inch baking dish with cooking spray
3. In a large non-stick skillet sprayed with cooking spray , cook meat with onion , garlic and bell pepper with until browned
4. Drain fat well , then return to skillet
5. Add in the taco seasoning mix and water
6. Bring to a boil and simmer over medium-low heat stirring for 10 minutes
7. Evenly divide the meat mixture between the 6 tortillas
8. Roll up tortillas and place seam-side down into the prepared baking dish
9. Evenly sprinkle the shredded cheese over the top
10. In a bowl mix together the mushroom soup with milk
11. Drizzle evenly over the top of tortillas
12. Bake uncovered for 20-25 minutes
13. For each serving place 1 tortilla on a plate , sprinkle with 1 / 3 cup shredded lettuce and chopped tomatoes
14. Garnish with 1 tablespoon fat-free sour cream

title: sauteed broccoli and onions
steps:
1. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat
2. Add broccoli , onion , italian seasoning and cilantro
3. Stir occasionally until broccoli and onion are tender , about 10 minutes ,
4. Add garlic and quartered mushrooms
5. Stir occasionally until mushrooms are tender , about 5 minutes
6. Add tomatoes and wine , stir occasionally until tomatoes are cooked , about 5 minutes
7. Top with shredded swiss cheese immediately before serving

title: awesome golden oven fried chicken
steps:
1. Wash chicken and soak in salt water for about 20 minutes
2. I use a large bowl and 1 teaspoon of salt
3. Preheat oven to 425
4. Place oil and butter in a shallow baking pan and set in the oven to heat and melt
5. Combine the flour and seasonings and dredge the chicken in the flour mixture
6. Remove hot pan from the oven and arrange the chicken in the pan skin side down , but do not crowd
7. Place in the oven and bake for 30 minutes , turn chicken so that the skin side is up and continue baking for 20 to 30 minutes more , until nicely browned and juices run clear
8. Remove onto a platter and let cool at least 10 minutes

title: oprah s favorite turkey burger
steps:
1. Saut the scallions , celery and apples in the canola oil until tender
2. Let cool
3. Place the ground turkey in a large mixing bowl
4. Add sauted items and the remaining ingredients
5. Shape into eight 8-ounce burgers
6. Refrigerate for 2 hours
7. Season the turkey burgers with salt and pepper
8. Place on a preheated , lightly oiled grill
9. Grill each side for 7 minutes until meat is thoroughly cooked
10. Let sit for 5 minutes

title: grandma potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 275f
2. Pour hashbrowns onto large cookie sheet and place butter slices all around on top of them
3. Pour enough whipping cream over potatoes to just cover , but not soak
4. Season with garlic powder , paprika , salt and pepper
5. Spread cheese over potatoes
6. Bake about 45 minutes to 1 hour , or until potatoes are cooked and cheese is lightly browned

title: strawberry upside down cake
steps:
1. In a 9" cake pan mix together the first three ingredients and dot with 1 t butter , then set aside
2. For the topping , sift together dry ingredients
3. Cream butter and sugar
4. Add egg and vanilla and beat well
5. Add dry ingredients alternately with milk , beginning and ending with dry ingredients
6. Spoon batter over fruit mixture
7. Bake at 350 deg f for 30-35 minutes or until golden brown
8. Serve warm , topped with whipped cream , ice cream or cream

title: crock pot miner s stew
steps:
1. Layer ingredients in crock pot in the order they appear above
2. Cook on low 4-6 hours

title: savory rice pilaf with lavender   apricots
steps:
1. Melt butter in medium saucepan
2. Gradually add onion and celery
3. Cook until wilted
4. Add garlic and rice
5. Stir until thoroughly coated with butter
6. Add broth , ginger , lavender and salt
7. Bring to boil
8. Reduce heat to low
9. Cover and cook without stirring until liquid is absorbed
10. When rice is tender , stir in currants , apricots , and lemon juice
11. Remove from heat and let stand covered to soften fruits
12. Add nuts and herbs and mix well
13. Serve immediately

title: mayan spice brownies
steps:
1. Soak the first three ingredients for 8 - 12 hours at room temperature
2. Puree the above seeds and water in a blender or food processor
3. Then blend or mix in the rest of the ingredients
4. Grease a med / sm square pan and bake at 350 for about 30 minutes

title: okra   tomatoes
steps:
1. Clean and trim okra just before cooking
2. Cut each okra in half lengthwise , if there are any pieces longer than 4 inches , cut them in half crosswise and then lengthwise
3. Heat the olive oil in a deep sided skillet over medium heat and add the onions along with the salt
4. Cook until they begin to soften , approximately 4 minutes
5. Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute longer
6. Add the tomatoes and bring the mixture to a boil
7. Decrease the heat to low and add the okra
8. Stir to combine
9. Cook , uncovered for 20 minutes
10. Serve immediately

title: apricot colada alcohol optional
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in blender
2. Whirl until smooth and blended

title: spinach rice
steps:
1. Heat butter on low heat and add rice , milk and salt and cook for 1 minute
2. Heat the oil and fry cumin seeds until they begin to crackle
3. Add onion and fry for 1 minute
4. Then add the green chilli and fry for some time
5. Add spinach and salt and cook till spinach is soft
6. Spread spinach at the bottom of a greased jelly mould
7. Spread the rice on top
8. Press well and cover
9. Bake in a preheated oven for 10 minutes at 400f
10. While serving , invert on a plate and serve with hot cream of tomato soup ro any other thick soup

title: ludicrous speed rice   bean bowl
steps:
1. Heat oil in a nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
2. Add onions and sautee until translucent , about 4 minutes
3. Add bell peppers , corn , chile , cumin and coriander and cook another 2-3 minutes , stirring to keep from sticking
4. Stir in rice , beans , salsa , and salt and pepper to taste
5. Cook till heated through
6. Put it in a bowl , top it with your preferred garnishes , and dig in !
7. For vegan omit the cheese and the sour cream

title: basil lemon brined grilled chicken
steps:
1. Prepare an ice water bath for the basil
2. Bring a small saucepan of water to boil over medium high heat
3. Wilt basil leaves , drain , and plunge basil into ice water bath , then drain
4. Puree blanched basil , salt , lemon zest , pepper and water in a mini food processor or blender until smooth
5. Combine chicken with puree in a large resealable plastic bag and allow to marinate several hours or up to overnight
6. Grill chicken over indirect heat for 20 to 25 minutes or until an internal temperature of 165 degrees f with grill cover on
7. Open grill lid and grill chicken , skin side down , over direct heat to crisp skin and give it some char , 1 or 2 minutes
8. Loosely tent chicken with aluminum foil and let rest several minutes before serving

title: vegan chocolate chilli pepper mousse
steps:
1. Throw all ingredients in your blender and puree until smooth and well combined
2. You might have to stop and scrape the sides of your blender to make sure it is all mixed through
3. Spoon mixture into martini glasses or serving bowls , and chill in the fridge for a couple of hours to yield the best results
4. The mixture will thicken slightly and the flavor of the chilli will strengthen
5. However , i have scoffed this after half an hour and been more than satisfied
6. Like i always say , people take the first bite with their eyes
7. I like to serve this in gorgeous clear shallow cocktail glasses to elevate this into my simple but special file
8. Serve with fresh raspberries , a dollop of soy cream , and some crushed raw almonds
9. The different textures and flavours make this a winner on every level
10. Please
11. It is not in contact with peanuts

title: grilled turkey  cheddar   cranberry on sourdough
steps:
1. Spread 1 1 / 2 tablespoons of cranberry sauce on each of 4 slices of bread
2. Add 2 ounces of cheddar onto each piece , followed by two ounces of roasted turkey
3. Be sure to mash down the cranberry sauce and the cheese
4. Cover each prepared bread slice and evenly butter the top of each sandwich
5. Place each sandwich butter side down in a frying pan over medium heat
6. While the first side is grilling , butter the second side of bread
7. Cook until golden and crusty , about 3-4 minutes
8. Carefully turn and cook until second side is golden , about 2-3 minutes more

title: mexicali shrimp kebabs
steps:
1. Place shrimp in a medium bowl
2. Add oil , salt , tequila , cayenne , garlic and chili sauce
3. Cover and refrigerate 1-2 hours
4. Prepare a hot grill
5. Remove shrimp from marinade and thread onto long metal skewers
6. Place on an oiled rack above ashen coals and grill , basting frequently with marinade and turning once , until shrimp are pink and loosely curled , about 2-3 minutes per side

title: uncle bill s choco bars
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl , combine flour , brown sugar , salt and crunchy peanut butter
2. Add butter and shortening and using a pastry blender , blend until crumbly
3. In a small bowl , mix together egg and vanilla extract
4. Whisk until smooth
5. Add egg / vanilla mixture to flour mixture and mix until incorporated
6. Press mixture into a 10" x 15" cookie sheet
7. Bake in preheated 350 f oven for 15 minutes
8. Frosting: in a 4 cup measure , add chocolate chips and microwave on medium-high for 2 minutes
9. Stir well and microwave on medium-high for another 1 minute
10. Remove and stir until chocolate is smooth
11. Add butter and coconut and stir until well combined
12. Spread over warm base
13. Let cool completely
14. Cut into squares

title: chicken strawberry pecan salad greens with feta
steps:
1. Assemble salad in order by ingredient
2. Enjoy !

title: creamy 3 cheese quesadillas
steps:
1. Melt butter in skillet
2. On one half of each tortilla , spread 2 tbsp of cream cheese , then sprinkle 2 tbsp of mild cheddar , followed by the mexican blend
3. Fold tortillas over to make half-moon shapes
4. Place in skillet and cook until both sides are slightly browned to your liking
5. Cut in half and enjoy !

title: cajun lemon chicken spaghetti
steps:
1. Saute onions and garlic in butter and oil
2. Add chicken and seasonings and lemon juice , stir well
3. Simmer on med-low for 20 minutes , until juices run clear
4. There should be a slight sauce , but not too much liquid
5. Add chicken to spaghetti
6. Deglaze pan with white wine- allow to reduce so the finished product isn't too liquidy
7. Add the wine reduction to the chicken and spaghetti and toss well
8. Serve with parmesan cheese

title: kiwi pineapple cream
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in blender and pulse 15-30 seconds to break up chunks until smooth
2. Divide between 2 glasses and garnish w / extra kiwi and pineapple chunks if desire

title: after dinner mocha
steps:
1. For every 8 oz of water , brew 2 tbsp of coffee
2. In a mug , add the cocoa , cognac , kahlua and vanilla
3. Add coffee , and top with the half-n-half
4. If you like , garnish with whipped cream
5. Serve hot and enjoy !

title: tuna stuffed potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f wrap potatoes in foil and bake until fork tender , about an hour
2. Let cool
3. Split potatoes in half and spoon out the filling into a medium sized bowl leaving enough in the shell so that the skin does not break when handling
4. Break up potatoes with fork
5. To potatoes add mayo , 1 cup cheese , green onion , green pepper , and tuna
6. Restuff potatoes with mixture to a slight mound
7. Sprinkle with remaining cheese
8. Place in 13x9-inch baking dish and bake for 20 minutes

title: spanish rice and prawn one pot
steps:
1. In a non-stick frying pan , fry the onion , peppers , chorizo and garlic in the oil over high heat for 3 minutes
2. Stir in the rice , tomatoes and boiling water
3. Cover and cook over high heat for 12 minutes
4. Uncover and stir - the rice should almost be tender at this point
5. Stir in the prawns , with a bit more water if the rice looks dry
6. Cook for another minute until the prawns are just pink and the rice tender

title: gluten free ravioli filling
steps:
1. Saute leeks in butter until soft
2. Add ricotta and stir
3. Add shredded cheese
4. Salt and pepper to taste
5. Because you heat everything up together you dont need an egg to hold the mix
6. Put spoonfulls onto rolled out pasta
7. Fold over the pasta , then cut into desired shape
8. Seal by pinching with fingers or the ends of a fork
9. Freeze at this point if saving for later
10. Boil for 8-10 minutes from frozen
11. Toss in a little tomato sauce , top with some grated old cheeze and enjoy !

title: grilled sirloin steak
steps:
1. In a large resealable plastic bag , combine the first seven ingredients
2. Add beef
3. Seal bag and turn to coat
4. Refrigerate for at least 3 hours or overnight
5. Drain and discard the marinade
6. Grill steak , covered , over indirect medium heat for 1-1 / 2 to 2 hours , turning once , or until meat reaches desired doneness

title: skillet steak with mushroom sauce
steps:
1. Season the steak with pepper , then let the steak sit out to almost room temperature , this will help relax the meat fibers and make for a more tender and flavorful steak
2. In a large skillet , melt half the butter over high heat
3. Brown steak on both sides
4. Transfer to a plate
5. Reduce heat to med-high
6. Add remaining butter to skillet
7. Cook onions , mushrooms and thyme , stirring for 10 minutes , or until liquid is released , and the mushrooms are starting to brown
8. Add in the garlic and cook for 2 minutes
9. Add flour and cook stirring for 1 minute
10. Gradually stir in beef stock , cream and horseradish
11. Reduce heat , and simmer , stirring for 5 minutes , or until sauce is thickened
12. Return steak , and any accumulated juices to pan
13. Simmer for 5 minutes , or until steak is desired doneness
14. Let steak rest for 5 minutes
15. Season sauce with more salt and pepper to taste
16. Slice steak thinly across the grain , and serve with the sauce

title: southern belle chocolate praline pecan pie
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees
2. Melt the butter and set aside
3. Beat the eggs in a large mixing bowl
4. Sift the brown sugar into the eggs and mix well
5. Add the remaining ingredients except for the pecan halves and mix thoroughly
6. Distribute the pie filling evenly between the 3 pie crusts , and decorate the tops of each pie with 6 pecan halves in a pinwheel pattern
7. Bake at 400 degrees for 15 minutes then reduce the heat to 350 degrees and bake for another 35 minutes

title: peach cake pudding
steps:
1. Combine peaches with sugar , orange juice& nutmeg
2. Spoon into a 11x7 baking dish
3. Topping: beat butter with sugar til fluffy
4. Beat in eggs one at a time
5. Stir in orange rind and vanilla
6. Stir 1 / 2 dry ingredients into batter , then stir in milk and then rest of flour
7. Spread on peaches and bake at 375 for about 50 minutes

title: meaty macaroni and cheese
steps:
1. Prepare mac and cheese according to box directions , using salted water
2. Meanwhile , brown meat and drain grease
3. Rinse meat if desired to remove even more grease
4. Season meat with onion and garlic- fresh and sauteed can be used instead- and add any additional seasonings that your family likes
5. Add meat to prepared mac and cheese and season with additional salt and pepper if desired
6. At this point you can add extras such as additional grated cheese , great opportunity to sneak in veggies - peas , carrots , broccoli , mushrooms , etc
7. , use what you like or try this to entice kids to eat things they normally wouldn't
8. I have even added some spinach to the meat mixing it in well so it is not as noticeable ! sometimes you have to be sneaky ! hehehe
9. No this isn't the healthiest meal- but it is so much healthier for them than a greasy burger grabbed on the run , and you can make it as healthy as you choose- i have even used leftover homemade mac and cheese- no preservatives at all that way !
10. You can 'fancy' it up by topping it with extra cheese or breadcrumbs and popping it under the broiler for a minute just to brown
11. A real time saving

title: frank x  tolbert s original bowl of red
steps:
1. Break off the stems of the chiles , and remove the seeds
2. Place chiles in a small saucepan and cover them with water
3. Simmer for 30 minutes
4. Pure the chiles in a blender with a tiny bit of cooking liquid to make a smooth , thin paste
5. Use as little liquid as possible , unless you want the chili to be soupy
6. Pour the chile pure into a dutch oven or large , heavy pan
7. In a heavy skillet , sear the meat in two batches with the beef suet until the meat is gray
8. Transfer each batch to the chile pure , then pour in enough of the chile cooking liquid to cover the meat by about 2 inches
9. Bring the chili to a boil
10. Reduce heat to a simmer
11. Cook for 30 minutes
12. Remove the chili from the heat , and stir in the rest of the ingredients
13. Return chili to the heat , cover and resume simmering for 45 minutes , keeping the lid on except to stir just occasionally
14. Add more chile liquid only if you think the mixture will burn otherwise
15. After 45 minutes , you may add the masa harina , if you wish
16. The masa adds a subtle , tamale-like taste , but it also thickens the chili
17. Cover the chili again and simmer for another 30 minutes
18. Do a lot of tasting to see if seasoning suits you
19. Add more seasonings as you like , but go easy on the oregano to avoid ending up with a spaghetti sauce flavor
20. Take the chili off the heat , and refrigerator overnight
21. Skim as much fat as you wish from the chili before reheating it
22. Serve hot

title: nutty pork
steps:
1. Heat oven 350
2. Place the butter in a bowl , the flour in another , the eggs in another and the nuts in another
3. Dip pork in butter , flour , eggs then nuts to coat
4. Place on a sprayed rack over a baking sheet
5. Drizzle with oil
6. Bake 35 minutes

title: old fashioned macaroni and cheese
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to package directions
2. Saute onion in butter until tender
3. Stir in flour , salt & pepper
4. Add milk or kefir all at once
5. Cook and stir until thickened and bubbly , then continue for 1-2 minutes more
6. Add cubed cheese , and stir til melted , or throw onion mixture and cheese into blender and blend til smooth
7. In a 2
8. 5 quart casserole , mix the pasta and cheese sauce together
9. Sprinkle with either shredded cheese , or a mixture of the butter / bread crumbs / parmesan cheese
10. Bake in 350 degree oven 30-35 minutes
11. Broil at the end to brown the topping to a crisp

title: just peachy cheesecake
steps:
1. Mix pudding into yogurt
2. Add drained cut-up peaches
3. Fold in cool whip
4. Can be eaten as is or put into a graham cracker crust

title: applesauce cereal snacks or bars
steps:
1. Mix all ingeredients in a medium bowl until well blended
2. Optional-throw a tbs or two of soy flour in to boost up the protine of a picky child's diet !
3. Spray pan with cooking spay
4. To make bars press into a 9x9 pan
5. To make bite sized snacks , spread loosely onto a jelly roll pan
6. Bake at 350 20-30 minutes unyil crisp and golden--watch the snacks , they cook faster
7. Cut or crumble , cool and enjoy !
8. Store in an air tight container , they never last more than a couple days at our house so i'm not sure how long they are shelf stable
9. Servings are approximate

title: three fruit salsa
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a bowl
2. Toss to combine
3. Serve salsa with a slotted spoon

title: korrat  leeks
steps:
1. Wash the leeks carefully to remove any soil nestling between the leaves
2. Trim the root ends and cut off the tough green part of the leaves
3. Cut the rest into 2-inch pieces
4. Fry the garlic and sugar in hot oil for moments only , until the sugar becomes slightly caramelized
5. Add the leeks and turn them , over moderate heat , to color them lightly
6. Sprinkle with lemon juice , add salt , and barely cover with water
7. Stew gently over very low heat until the leeks are tender and the liquid is reduced
8. Probably only about 10-15 minutes - whoever makes this first please let me know !
9. Serve hot or cold

title: paleo flatbread
steps:
1. Wisk eggs and water together in a bowl
2. Set aside
3. Mix all dry ingredients in a bowl
4. Pour liquid in and mix well with a fork until all ingredients are incorporated
5. The dough should be moist but not sticky and form a ball well when squeezed
6. Form dough into six balls and flatten each slightly in the palm of your hand , closing any major cracks that form at the edges
7. Place a ball of dough between two sheets of waxed paper and roll with a rolling pin until 1 / 8th of an inch thick
8. Remove one sheet of paper and flip the dough into a lightly greased frying pan on low to med heat
9. Gently remove the paper from the top of your dough
10. When it puffs slightly and browns around the edges you can flip it to toast the other side
11. Remove to a piece of paper towel to cool
12. When cool store these with sheets of wax paper between them in a ziploc bag in the fridge for 3 or 4 days

title: fudge meltaways
steps:
1. Melt butter and 1 oz chocolate then add next six ingredients
2. Press into bottom of lightly greased pan
3. Chill
4. Cream 1 / 4 cup of butter , add remaining 3 ingredients and beat until smooth and creamy
5. Spread evenly over base in pan
6. Chill
7. Melt last 1 1 / 2 oz chocolate and spread quickly on top of cream layer
8. Chill
9. Cut into small squares
10. No larger than 2x2" as these are very rich cookies
11. Makes one 9x9 pan

title: mom s thai fried rice
steps:
1. Heat peanut oil in a wok or large skillet over medium high heat
2. While pan is warming , toss the cold rice with your hands , making sure to separate the grains from any clumps
3. Add the garlic to the heated wok , and toss until fragrant and slightly golden
4. Add chicken , beef , or pork and stir fry for about 1 minute
5. Push the meat and garlic up the sides making a well in the middle and add eggs
6. Scramble eggs for 1 minute in middle of pan then , add green onions and peas and incorporate all ingredients together , stir frying for another minute
7. Add rice , turning over rice with pan ingredients several times to coat and stir frying for 2-3 minutes
8. You want the rice to begin to have a toasted smell , making sure that all the ingredients are constantly being moved around the pan for even cooking
9. If your pan seems to have cooled down to the point where the ingredients are no longer sizzling , you may need to turn the heat up slightly
10. Sprinkle in the sugar and add the fish sauce and oyster sauce
11. Stir fry all ingredients together for one minute more or until sauces are absorbed and mixture is completely combined
12. Transfer to serving platter
13. Garnish plate edge with sliced cucumber , lime wedges , and additional whole green onions if desired

title: strawberries with balsamic vinegar
steps:
1. Toss the strawberries with the 1 / 4 cup sugar and let sit for 10 minutes
2. Sprinkle with the vinegar
3. Taste and add more sugar or vinegar if necessary
4. Sprinkle with the pepper and serve

title: rasta pasta in a boat with a cilantro cream sauce
steps:
1. Cook the squash in a large pot of boiling salted water for 12-14 minutes
2. Meanwhile , in a medium bowl combine the 2 tablespoons of oil with the lime and orange juices , ginger , garlic , cumin and chile
3. Season with salt and pepper , add chicken pieces and toss to coat
4. Set aside
5. In a small bowl make the cilantro cream sauce
6. Blend the sour cream with the milk , cilantro and lime juice and season with salt and pepper
7. Set aside
8. Carefully transfer the squash halves to a large bowl and let cool
9. Using a fork and starting at 1 end of each piece of squash , scrape up and separate the strands
10. Pat dry with paper towels
11. Set aside
12. In a large nonstick frying pan , heat 1 tablespoon of the oil over moderate heat
13. Saut the onion , garlic and red pepper for one to two minutes
14. Add the chicken with its marinade and cook , stirring , until chicken is cooked through
15. Gently toss the chicken and vegetable mixture with the spaghetti squash and place in the empty squash shells for serving or place on plates
16. If you wish , you can place under broiler for a few minutes to darken the top
17. Top with the cilantro cream sauce and sprinkle with the tomatoes

title: pasta with spinach  nutmeg  and shrimp
steps:
1. Prepare pasta according to package directions , omitting salt and fat
2. Drain well
3. Return to pan
4. Stir in spinach
5. Toss well until spinach wilts
6. Melt 1 tablespoon butter in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
7. Add shrimp
8. Sprinkle with 1 / 4 teaspoon salt
9. Saut 2 minutes or until shrimp are done
10. Remove shrimp from pan
11. Set aside
12. Melt 1 tablespoon butter in pan over medium heat
13. Add onion
14. Cook 10 minutes or until tender , stirring often
15. Stir in broth , vermouth , and rind
16. Increase heat to medium-high
17. Cook 8 minutes or until mixture begins to thicken
18. Reduce heat to medium
19. Add cheese
20. Stir until well blended
21. Stir in 1 / 4 teaspoon salt , nutmeg , and pepper
22. Remove from heat
23. Add shrimp and onion mixture to pasta mixture
24. Toss to combine
