title: ben s oven fried chicken strips
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Mix butter , garlic powder , egg and hot sauce until smooth
3. In separate pan , combine dry bread crumbs , finely grated cheese , and parmesan cheese
4. In another pan , mix flour , salt and pepper
5. Rinse and pat dry chicken strips
6. Dip chicken strip in the wet mixture
7. Dredge in the flour
8. Place in breadcrumb mixture and sprinkle it over the top of it
9. Place strips on a wire rack on top of a cookie sheet
10. Bake for 30-35 minutes

title: kentucky fried chicken
steps:
1. In a small bowl combine the egg and milk
2. In a separate bowl , combine the remaining four dry ingredients
3. Dip each piece of chicken into the milk mixture until fully moistened
4. Roll the moistened chicken into the flour mixture until completely coated
5. Pour the oil into the pressure fryer and heat over medium heat to about 400
6. In groups of 4 or 5 , drop the chicken pieces into the oil and lock the lid into place
7. When the steam begins shooting through the pressure release , set the timer for 10 minutes
8. After 10 minutes , release the pressure according to manufacturer's instruct ions , and remove the chicken to paper towels or a metal rack to drain
9. Repeat with remaining chicken
10. Tidbit: if you prefer not to use msg , you may substitute an additional 1 / 2 tbs
11. Of salt
12. Be aware however that using msg produces the best clone of kfc's fried chicken

title: my favorite chocolate chip cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Beat eggs in a large bowl
3. Add cake mix , oil , water , and sour cream
4. Mix well
5. Stir in pudding mix and chocolate chips
6. Pour into a greased bundt pan or 2 greased loaf pans
7. Bake at 350 degrees for 45-50 minutes

title: maple syrup orange chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Line a 9 x 13-inch baking pan with nonstick foil
3. Place chicken quarters skin-side up on the prepared pan
4. Remove the zest from the orange with a grater , then juice the orange
5. Whisk together orange zest , orange juice , butter , maple syrup , onion powder , and salt
6. Brush orange mixture over the chicken pieces
7. Bake 45 to 50 minutes , until done , basting midway with drippings

title: picnic party potato salad
steps:
1. Dice potatoes
2. Cook until tender
3. Drain
4. Put into large bowl
5. Add onions and italian dressing
6. Toss to coat
7. Cover and chill at least 1 hour
8. Combine mayonnaise , mustard and salt in small bowl
9. Pour over potatoes
10. Toss to coat
11. Add celery , eggs and relish
12. Toss lightly
13. Slice remaining eggs
14. Garnish top of salad
15. Sprinkle with paprika

title: mamma s icebox fruitcake
steps:
1. Mix graham cracker crumbs and milk until well blended
2. Add remaining ingredients until well blened
3. Mixture will be very stiff
4. Pack into a christmas mold , which has been sprayed with oil , or form into logs and wrap with wax paper
5. Cover and keep refrigerated
6. Remove from mold just before serving

title: sloppy joe skillet
steps:
1. Mix stufing mix and hot water , just until moistened and set aside
2. Brown meat in large skillet and drain
3. Sprinkle meat with salt , pepper and garlic to taste
4. Add zucchini , tomatoes with their liquid , ketchup , dressing and chili powder to skillet
5. Bring to a boil
6. Reduce heat to medium
7. Cover and simmer 5 minutes , or until veggie is tender
8. Top with prepared stuffing
9. Cover and simmer 3 minutes

title: mahi mahi in caper garlic cream sauce
steps:
1. For sauce- combine all ingredients except lemon juice and reduce by half over medium heat
2. Add lemon juice and serve over prepared mahi mahi fillets
3. For fillets- coat bottom of a large skillet with olive oil and heat to almost smoking
4. Salt and pepper fillets and pan sear each fillet for 3-4 minutes on each side
5. Plate each fillet and serve with caper garlic cream sauce

title: yucca fries  yuca
steps:
1. Boil yuca in a large pot of lightly salted water for 10 minutes
2. Add one cup of water to the pan and return to a boil
3. Continue to boil for about another 5 minutes , until tender
4. Drain and dry completely
5. Pull out all stingy fibers
6. In a deep-fryer or your usual stove-top pot you deep fry in , heat 2 inches of oil to 350
7. Divide the yucca into 4 batches and fry until golden brown , about 2 to 4 minutes
8. Using a slotted spoon , carefully place the yucca on a paper towel covered plate or rack to drain
9. Sprinkle with sea salt and serve at once

title: bbq plank salmon
steps:
1. Seriously , read this thoroughly first
2. Cooking planks is a fire hazard if handled carelessly
3. Your home is not worth the best salmon you'll ever have
4. Almost , though
5. Also important , farm raised salmon has been consistently found to be the most toxic meat produced for consumption
6. Don't trust me , google it ! this makes preserving wild salmon runs that much more important
7. An hour and a half prior to cooking soak your plank in water for at least 45 minutes
8. Hot water's best
9. This is important to keep it from catching fire in the bbq
10. After soaked , place rinsed salmon on plank skin down
11. No flesh should be hanging off the edges , this makes picking a fillet's size really important because it is easier to pick the size of fillet than find or cut a plank to fit the fish
12. I use planks packaged and marked for this
13. Don't waste your time with cedar bbq envelopes / pockets
14. These products are crap
15. Again , with the skin down , spread your mustard over the pink flesh to cover but not to smother
16. Sprinkle paprika or cayenne pepper on fillet to your taste preference
17. Let rest until cooking time
18. Meanwhile , prepare bbq to a high heat and get together the tools / instruments you are going to use to remove the burnt plank from the grill
19. Keep these close by and ready
20. Also , consider where are you going to let the plank with an underside covered in red hot embers rest ? think this through thoroughly !
21. You're going to lay the plank directly on the grill to cook the fish
22. As the damp wood starts to burn it will smoke the fish
23. It creates a lot of smoke , so bbq placement might have to be evaluated
24. When your grill is ready place planked fish on grill and cover
25. Vent the bbq medium , you want to retain as much smoke around the fish , but not suffocate your heat source
26. Cooking takes about 10 to 20 minutes depending on the thickness of your fillet
27. If you know how to test steak for rareness , the fillet should feel medium
28. Remember to let the meat rest and allow for it to finish cooking off the grill , so pulling it a little early is a good thing
29. Now , removing the plank is serious business ! its underside will be burning red hot and will catch other wood on fire if you let them stay in contact ! i use a heavy duty spatula to support one end and a strong pair of cooking tongs that allow me to really grip the plank tightly for the other end
30. Your goal is to find something that will hold the plank so tightly without damaging fish that you can hold it with one hand if necessary , and it will likely be necessary
31. Let the meat rest 5 minutes before serving
32. I put mine on the hot-plate burner cover of my gas grill
33. Its metal , making it safe
34. Alternatively , you do not need to use mustard for a good plank salmon
35. It's better with it , even on premium king fillets
36. It just is
37. And , cedar planks are likely easier to find
38. I have used a 1x9x2' of cedar i bought at a local hardware store to cook this recipe and it worked beautifully
39. The guys at the store assured me that the processing of the wood did not include toxic chemicals

title: mostly a tomato sandwich with basil mayonnaise
steps:
1. Mix the mayo , basil , lime juice and zest
2. Split the rolls and generously slather top and bottom with mayo mixture
3. Layer on 1 / 2 the tomato slices , pepper rings , onion rings and sprouts if using
4. Top with more tomato
5. Salt and pepper to taste
6. Close the roll and mush it down a bit so it will fit in your mouth
7. Grab plenty of napkins and enjoy !

title: sassy  n spiked pink lemonade pitcher  hungry girl  2 ww points
steps:
1. Place all ingredients except the lemons in a pitcher , and stir well
2. Cut 1 lemon into 8 slices , and set slices aside
3. Cut the remaining lemons in half , and squeeze the juice into the pitcher
4. Serve over ice and garnish with lemon slices !
5. Makes 8 servings
6. Hg alternative ! use extra ocean spray instead of vodka for a virgin version with 14 calories , 0g fat , 3
7. 5g carbs and a points value of 0

title: dee s pork chops
steps:
1. Season pork chops , in a baking dish , with pepper and paprika
2. Add boullion cubes , onion , and water
3. Cover with foil paper
4. Bake at 375 degrees fahrenheit for 2 hours or until tender
5. Uncover and allow to brown , not burn , making sure there is still water in the bottom of the pan , for 10 to15 minutes

title: cauliflower   garbanzo curry
steps:
1. Chop cauliflower & green beans into bite sized pieces & boil separately for 3-5 minutes or until tender
2. Set aside
3. Saute onion in oil , 3-5 minutes over medium heat , until soft
4. Add curry , ginger , & cayenne , if desired
5. Stir about one minute , keeping the heat on medium
6. Add broth , salt & corn starch
7. The sauce should be about the consistency of milk
8. Add cooked vegetables , beans , and tomatoes
9. Turn heat up to medium-high
10. Cook for about 5 minutes , stirring constantly
11. Add chili sauce & cook 1-2 minutes more
12. The sauce should be nice and thick
13. Serve over hot basmati with mango chutney

title: holiday turkey
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400f you will reduce it later
2. Dump the vegetables into the bottom of a roaster
3. Add the chicken broth
4. You want about of broth covering the bottom of the roaster so the vegetables dont burn
5. Rinse the turkey breast under cool water and dry with paper towels
6. Cut off any large wads of fat and discard
7. Set aside the gravy packet for later
8. Stir the butter , poultry seasoning and seasoned salt together
9. Gently insert your fingers under the skin to loosen the skin over the breast , leaving it attached at breastbone and sides
10. Smear the butter under the skin
11. Pat the top of the skin to distribute the butter evenly over the meat
12. Spray the skin generously with non-stick cooking spray or rub with some vegetable oil
13. Butter or margarine arent used as they contain water which will make the skin rubbery and the browning blotchy
14. Place the turkey breast on top of the vegetables
15. They act as a rack but wont leave dents in the bird
16. If you have a meat thermometer , insert it into the thickest part of the breast and make sure it isnt touching bone
17. Important: reduce the oven temperature to 325f when you put the turkey into the oven
18. Roast according to the chart on the turkey wrapping
19. It should take between 2 and 2 hours
20. Mul
21. You can put more than one breast in a roaster , but if they are touching each other they won't brown where they touch
22. Resist the temptation to baste
23. Every time you open the oven , heat escapes , resulting in uneven cooking and pale , spongy skin
24. Feel free to open the oven to put in side dishes , but have them ready to slide in before you open the oven
25. Occasionally , turn on the oven light and check for browning
26. If the skin is getting too brown , remove the turkey , close the oven , tent the turkey with foil and slide it back into the oven
27. Also check the liquid in the bottom of the roaster
28. Add broth or water as needed
29. 30 minutes before minimum time , check the temperature
30. Take the turkey out when it reads 155f there will be some carry over cooking and the temperature will go up to 165f within 15-20 minutes
31. Never rely on a pop-up timer in the bird , they are notoriously unreliable
32. Remove turkey from the roaster and place on a cutting board
33. Save the vegetables to make broth with the carcass tomorrow
34. They are overcooked and not good for eating as is
35. Tent the turkey with aluminum foil and set aside to rest at least 15 minutes
36. It will stay piping hot for a long time
37. Allowing meat to rest allows the juices to be reabsorbed , so the meat will be juicy
38. Pour the pan juices through a strainer into a large measuring cup
39. Add chicken broth to measure the amount of liquid called for on the gravy packet and follow directions on packet
40. When you are ready to serve the meat , cut down the side of the breast bone , following the ribs , cut off the entire breast half
41. Do the same on the other side
42. Slice the meat crosswise into serving slices
43. Cutting the meat this way gives it a more tender mouth feel
44. It wont be chewy or stringy

title: toasted ham and cheese
steps:
1. Spread one side of two slices of bread with the mayonnaise , then onto the mayo side layer the ham , cheese & onion
2. Spread one side of the remaining two slices of bread each with a teaspoon of the horseradish sauce
3. Place the 2nd slice of bread horseradish-side down over the onion , then on the outer sides of the sandwich , spread the softened butter evenly
4. In a skillet over medium heat , toast the sandwiches for about 5 minutes on each side or until the bread is lightly browned & cheese has melted

title: bacon   onion nachos
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 475
2. Cook bacon on stovetop until crisp
3. Drain on absorbent paper
4. When the bacon is cool , coarsely chop it
5. Arrange the tortilla chips on a large rimmed baking sheet
6. Scatter the bacon , onions , and jalapenos evenly over the chips
7. Sprinkle the grated cheese over all
8. Bake about 5 minutes , or until the cheese is melted and the nachos are sizzling
9. Serve immediately , accompanied by sour cream and salsa for dipping

title: tater tots chicken casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. In a non-stick skillet over medium heat , brown the ground chicken and the onion until the chicken is no longer pink
3. Stir in pepper , water and mushroom soup and heat till bubbling
4. Add frozen vegetables and stir cook until the vegetables are warm
5. Pour the mixture into a 2 quart casserole
6. Arrange tater gems in a single layer on top of the chicken mixture
7. Bake , uncovered , for 40 to 45 minutes or until the tater gems are crisp and the chicken mixture is bubbling

title: caramelized onion pizza with cream cheese sauce
steps:
1. Melt the butter and 2 tablespoons of olive oil in a large skillet or cast iron pan
2. Add the onions , salt , and pepper and cook for 5 minutes or until they soften a little
3. Add the sugar and stir every few minutes for 20 minutes
4. Turn off burner and prepare the crust
5. In a large bowl mix the cream cheese and 1 / 4 cup of olive oil
6. Spread on top of pizza ctust and top with the onions
7. Sprinkle with gorgonzola cheese if you wish
8. Bake 15-20 minutes or until desired results

title: chicken joseph monroe
steps:
1. Melt 1 / 4 cup butter over low heat
2. The fat will rise to the top , and the solids will sink to the bottom
3. Skim off the white froth that appears on top
4. Then strain off the clear , yellow clarified butter , keeping back the sediment of the milk solids
5. Set the clarified butter aside
6. Combine cream cheese and the next 3 ingredients in a large mixing bowl
7. Beat at medium speed of an electric mixer until creamy
8. Shape the mixture into 6 balls
9. Roll in swiss cheese
10. Cover and chill 1 hour
11. Place chicken between 2 sheets of heavy-duty plastic wrap , and flatten to 1 / 4-inch thickness , using a meat mallet or rolling pin
12. Spread mustard evenly over each chicken breast half
13. Top each with a chilled cheese ball
14. Fold long sides of chicken over cheese ball
15. Fold ends over , and secure with wooden picks
16. Dredge chicken in flour
17. Dip in egg , and roll in breadcrumbs
18. Cover and chill 1 hour
19. Brown chicken in clarified butter in a large ovenproof skillet over high heat 2 to 3 minutes
20. Place skillet in oven
21. Bake , uncovered , at 400 degrees for 7 minutes or until chicken is done
22. Remove and discard the toothpicks

title: coconut banana cream pie  raw vegan
steps:
1. Blend the crust indgredients in a food processor
2. Add more agave if needed to make crust sticky
3. Line pie pan with saran wrap and press crust on top or use a tart pan with a removable bottom
4. Place in freezer while making the filling
5. Blend the pie ingredients , except banana slices , in a blender until smooth
6. Make sure there is enough liquid to have the ingredients swirling in a vortex
7. Add coconut water , if needed
8. Take crust out from freezer and place sliced bananas on top of crust
9. Pour filling on top of bananas
10. Place in freezer for 3-4 hours to set
11. Decorate with walnuts , coconut shavings , or banana slices :d

title: sweetheart salad
steps:
1. Honey of a dressing directions:combine vinegar and honey
2. Mix well
3. Stir in remaining ingredients
4. Marinate chicken in 1 / 4 cup dressing at least 2 hours or overnight , refrigerated
5. Drain and reserve marinade
6. Heat oil in non stick pan and stir fry chicken until juices run clear
7. Add pepper , onion , mushrooms and reserved marinade
8. Stir fry 1 minute
9. Add spinach leaves and toss in pan until barely wilted
10. Add radishes and toss to mix
11. Enjoy !

title: mexican wedding cakes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Place pecans on a cookie sheet and toast for about 5 minutes , stirring occasionally , until lightly browned
3. Cool pecans completely before proceeding
4. In the food processer -----------
5. Process pecans , salt and sugar until pecans are ground very fine
6. Cut the butter in chunks and , with the motor running , add
7. Process until smooth and creamy
8. Scrape down bowl , add vanilla and pulse
9. Add flour and salt , pulse until it starts to clump
10. Or in the mixer-------------
11. Soften butter
12. Grind toasted pecans
13. In medium bowl whisk , flour , nuts and salt until combined
14. Combine sugar and butter in a mixing bowl , beat until light and fluffy
15. Beat in vanilla extract and scrape down bowl
16. Stir on low speed , gradually adding the flour mixture until just incorporated
17. For either method-------------
18. Place dough into a bowl and refrigerate for 1 to 3 hours
19. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
20. Measure dough using a gently rounded 1 " scoop , or 1 scant tablespoon , roll between palms to form a 1" balls
21. Place balls 1 " apart on cookie sheet , bake for 15 mins or until just beginning to brown , undersides will be lightly browned
22. Rotate pan half way through cooking for even baking
23. Cool cookies on sheet for 2-3 mins , using a small angled spatula lift the cookies from the sheet and gently roll several times in powdered sugar
24. Cool completely on rack and roll again in powdered sugar
25. Store in an airtight container for about 1 month

title: absolutely wonderful cheesy creamy spinach artichoke dip
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Combine all ingredients into a mixing bowl , gently fold together until combined
3. Pour into a greased or oiled 8" or 9" pie plate or other baking dish
4. Bake in oven at 375 degrees for 25 to 35 minutes or until browned and bubbly
5. Let stand to cool down it will be very hot
6. Hint !
7. Slice bread 1 / 4" to 1 / 2" and place directly on oven rack to toast for the last 5 to 10 minutes of baking time

title: moroccan harira
steps:
1. Put the lamb , spices , butter , celery , onion , and parsley / cilantro in a large soup pot and stir over a low heat for 5 minutes
2. Add the tomato pieces , and continue cooking for 10 to 15 minutes
3. Salt lightly
4. Add the juice from the tomatoes , 7 cups of water , and the lentils
5. Bring to a boil , then reduce heat , partially cover , and simmer for 2 hours
6. When ready to serve , add the chickpeas and noodles and cook for 5 minutes
7. Beat the 2 eggs with the juice of 1 / 2 lemon
8. Then , with the soup at a steady simmer , stir the lemony eggs into the stock with a long wooden spoon
9. Continue stirring slowly , to create long egg strands and to thicken the soup
10. Season to taste
11. Ladle into bowls and dust with cinnamon
12. Serve hot immediately

title: chocaholic torte
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Butter and flour a 10" springform pan
3. Melt butter and chocolate chips in double boiler until mixed and smooth
4. Beat eggs and sugar in large bowl until light and fluffy
5. Combine cocoa powder , cinnamon , flour and espresso powder
6. Add dry ingredients to egg mixture on lowest mixer speed
7. Slowly add melted chocolate mixture to other ingredients , still at lowest mixture speed
8. Pour batter into springform pan and bake for 25-45 minutes
9. Check cake with toothpick every five minutes after 25 minutes
10. Cool in pan on rack
11. When ready to serve , dust the top with sifted powdered sugar and sprinkle with fresh raspberries

title: chicken marsala  pollo marsala
steps:
1. Add oil to saut pan and put on medium heat
2. Salt and flour chicken breast , pat off excess flour
3. When oil is hot , saut chicken breast until browned on both sides , remove breast
4. Leaving oil in pan , add mushrooms and onions , and a pinch of salt and pepper
5. Saut
6. When mushrooms and onions are sauteed add marsala , demi glace , and cream , and another pinch of salt
7. Reduce until bubbles start to slow and sauce thickens , add chicken breast for one minute and turn off heat , flip the chicken breast in the sauce and serve when ready , pour sauce over chicken breast

title: texas roadhouse cajun horseradish dip
steps:
1. Mix all of the above ingredients together
2. Chill for several hours and serve with chips or fried onion rings , fried zucchini , fried mushrooms , etc

title: chicken with onions  olives and capers
steps:
1. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium high heat
2. Add the garlic and the bacon and cook , stirring , until the garlic turns golden
3. Add the chicken and cook until browned , about 3 minutes per side
4. Remove chicken to a warm platter and set aside
5. Add onion slices to the skillet and cook , stirring often , until the onion wilts and turns golden brown
6. Stir in the wine , scraping up the browned bits in the pan
7. Cook until the wine reduces to a syrup
8. Add the chicken broth and cook until reduced slightly
9. Return the chicken to the pan and turn to coat with the sauce
10. Add the olives and the capers
11. Reduce heat to simmer and cook to combine flavors
12. Season with pepper to taste

title: easy slow cooker beef stroganoff
steps:
1. Combine first 3 ingredients in slow cooker
2. Cook on low for 6-8 hours
3. Serve over cooked egg noodles
4. Enjoy !

title: pasta with marinated tomatoes and mozzarella
steps:
1. In a large bowl , gently combine the tomatoes , onion , oil , bocconcini , salt , and pepper
2. Set aside and let marinate at room temperature for at least 10 minutes
3. Meanwhile , cook the pasta according to the package directions
4. Add the drained pasta and basil to the marinated tomatoes and toss to combine
5. Divide among individual bowls
6. The longer the tomato mixture marinates , the more flavorful it becomes
7. Keep it in the refrigerator for up to 2 days
8. Spoon it over chicken or warm bread

title: rosemary dijon chicken
steps:
1. Heat oil in a nonstick skillet over medium high heat
2. Add chicken breasts and brown on both sides , about 3-5 minutes per side
3. Mix orange juice , mustard and rosemary
4. Pour over chicken
5. Simmer another 10 minutes , turning chicken occasionally
6. Remove chicken to serving dish and turn heat to high
7. Boil sauce to reduce 1 or 2 minutes until it is thick enough to coat the back of a spoon , and pour over chicken

title: couscous with feta  chickpeas and tomato
steps:
1. Heat olive oil in a medium saucepan or large skillet over medium heat
2. Add red pepper and garlic and cook for three minutes , stirring frequently
3. Stir in a half a cup of the broth , along with the dried oregano or basil and chickpeas
4. Turn heat up to boil the mixture , then lower heat and simmer for 15 minutes
5. Add remaining 1 and 3 / 4 cups of broth and salt , then bring to the boil
6. Add tomatoes
7. Gradually stir in couscous , then remove from heat , cover , and let stand 5 minutes until couscous cooks
8. Stir in green onions and feta , toss well , and serve
9. May add some cracked black pepper , if you like
10. Great next-day leftovers !

title: whine   jerk grilled fruit salad
steps:
1. Very , very lightly schmear the pineapple , mango , papaya & peach with the jerk seasoning
2. A little goes a long way ! unless you like blistering spice , that is
3. Grill both sides until heated through & have nice grill marks
4. Let cool slightly then cut into bite sized pieces
5. Place in a medium bowl
6. Add the rest of the fruit & stir gently
7. Combine well the yogurt , lime zest & juice , sugar & salt
8. Add to the salad and stir together gently until well combined

title: quick spanish rice
steps:
1. In medium saucepan , combine all ingredients
2. Bring to a boil
3. Reduce heat to low
4. Cover and simmer 25 minutes or until rice is done
5. Garnish with green onions and / or cheddar cheese

title: mocha yogurt loaf
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f grease a 9 x 5 loaf pan , and line it with waxed paper
2. Sift the flour and dry ingredients into a medium bowl and set aside
3. Blend the egg whites in a large bowl until foamy , and blend in the cream of tartar
4. Gradually add 1 / 4 cup of sugar , beating until the whites are stiff and glossy
5. Set aside
6. Combine 3 / 4 cup sugar , butter , yolks , and coffee granules in a large bowl and beat at medium speed until fluffy
7. Reduce speed to low
8. Add the flour , yogurt , and coffee alternately to the egg yolk mixture , beating until blended after each
9. Stir in 1 / 3 of the egg whites
10. Fold in the remaining egg whites and optional pecans
11. Put the batter in the pan , smoothing the top
12. Bake for about one hour , until a cake tester comes out clean
13. Cool for 10 minutes before removing

title: hungarian chicken paprika
steps:
1. Sauce procedure: cut whole chicken into it's constituent parts and remove skin
2. Remove skin from thighs
3. This step is critical
4. Cut all chicken pieces in half
5. This exposes the crucial bone marrow
6. The more marrow you expose , the better the sauce
7. I chop the wings into 4 or five pieces
8. Do not add giblets and neck
9. In large pot , combine chicken , salt , paprika , chicken base , and enough water to just cover the chicken pieces
10. Cook , partially covered , at such temperature that a simmer to very gentle boil is achieved
11. You want just a bit of bubbling
12. Do so until the chicken is thoroughly cooked and easily removed from the bone--about 1
13. 5 hrs
14. Strain mixture to separate liquid and chicken
15. Place chicken into a warm serving dish
16. Return liquid to pot , and vigorously mix in sour cream and milk
17. I use a whisk for this
18. Carefully bring the sauce to a boil and remove immediately from heat
19. Failure to remove promptly will result in very messy boiling over !
20. Set burner to it's lowest setting and return pot to the burner to keep sauce hot
21. The sauce is basically finished at this point
22. You may wish to fine tune by adding more salt , sour cream , paprika , and / or chicken base
23. I sometimes add a 1 / 2 cup or so of heavy cream for added richness
24. You may also want to skim most of the liquid fat from the sauce surface
25. Noodles procedure: combine flour , salt , and eggs in a hemispherical bowl large enough to accommodate mixing
26. Add about 1 / 2 cup water and proceed to blend ingredients with a fork until well blended
27. The consistency your striving for is such that the dough is clearly wet , adheres to the bowl , and is loose enough to slowly spread out when a dollop is applied to the cutting board
28. Add enough water to achieve this
29. I've never measured how much water i use , but think it's about 1 / 2 cup plus some
30. Actually , the consistency is not critical
31. I'm guessing you've made noodles like this , and that additional , excruciating explanation is not necessary
32. Set a dutch oven 2 / 3 full of water to boil
33. At this point , obviously the dough goes into the water
34. I place a good size dollop on a small cutting board and use a gently curved , sharp knife to cut perhaps 1 / 2" size blobs which are then vigorously swept off the board into the boiling water
35. They are done when they float to the surface
36. A perforated spoon is used to remove the noodles from the water which are placed in a warm serving bowl
37. I cut perhaps 3-4 dozen noodles , let them cook , remove , and proceed to add the next 3-4 dozen until all of the dough is consumed
38. If it looks like boiling over is about to occur , add some cold water
39. Finally: at this point you should have a pot of wonderful sauce , a bowl full of chicken pieces , and a bowl of noodles
40. For serving , place a good serving of noodles and half as much chicken into a flat bowl
41. Apply enough sauce to almost cover noodles and chicken
42. You may want to salt to taste
43. My wife likes pepper on it
44. I do not
45. In any case , viola ! that's it
46. I really want you to try this , as everyone on both sides of our family loves it
47. My instructions are laborious because attention paid to various details will produce a superb dish , while an average effort with average ingredients produce a result that is only very good

title: baked orzo and shrimp
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425f
2. Cook onion , garlic , oregano , and red pepper flakes in 1 tablespoon oil in a 4-quart heavy pot over moderately high heat , stirring , until onion is softened , about 3 minutes
3. Add wine and boil until reduced by 1 / 2 , about 3 minutes
4. Stir in tomatoes and salt , then reduce heat , and simmer briskly , stirring frequently , until slightly thickened , about 8 minutes
5. Stir shrimp into sauce and simmer , stirring occasionally , until shrimp are just cooked through , about 3 minutes
6. While sauce and shrimp are cooking , cook orzo in a 6-quart pot of boiling salted water until al dente
7. Reserve 1 / 2 cup cooking water , then drain orzo in a sieve
8. Return orzo to pot and toss with remaining tablespoon oil
9. Stir in sauce with shrimp and reserved cooking water , then add olives and salt and pepper , to taste
10. Spoon 1 / 2 of pasta into an oiled 13 by 9 by 2-inch glass baking dish , then sprinkle with 1 / 2 of feta
11. Top with remaining pasta and feta , then bake in middle of oven , uncovered , until cheese is slightly melted and pasta is heated through , 10 to 15 minutes

title: no bake chocolate cake
steps:
1. If using hazelnuts: preheat the oven to 350 degree f and place the hazelnuts on a baking sheet
2. Bake for about 15 minutes or until fragrant and the skins begin to flake
3. Remove from oven and place a dish towel over the nuts
4. Let the nuts sit for a few minutes and then rub the nuts in the towel briskly to remove the skins
5. Let cool and then chop coarsely
6. If using almonds , walnuts , pecans , and / or macadamia nuts: in a 350 degree f oven bake the nuts for about 8 - 10 minutes or until lightly brown and fragrant
7. Let cool then chop coarsely
8. Then in a heatproof bowl over a saucepan of simmering water , melt the butter and chocolate
9. Meanwhile break the digestive cookies into small pieces
10. Once the butter and chocolate are melted , remove from heat and stir in the digestive cookies , along with their crumbs , and the chopped nuts
11. Spread this mixture into a lightly buttered 8 inch tart or cake pan , cover , and refrigerate for several hours or until set
12. Cut or break into slices
13. Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator

title: tomato and balsamic pasta
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to directions
2. Heat oil in large sauce pan on medium heat
3. Add onions and garlic , saute for 3 minutes
4. Add tomatoes , basil , bring to a simmer
5. Add balsamic vinegar and parmesan cheese

title: lemon baked fish fillets
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 450f grease a large baking dish
2. Arrange the fish in the baking dish in a single layer
3. Stir together the shallot , parsley , lemon juice , sugar and salt in a small bowl
4. Whisk in the oil until well blended
5. Pour over the fish
6. Top with lemon slices
7. Bake until the fish is just cooked through , 5 to 8 minutes , allowing about 10 minutes per inch of thickness
8. Serve hot

title: devil s chocolate cookie crinkles
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Grease cookie sheets
3. Combine cake mix , eggs , oil and milk
4. Stir until thoroughly blended
5. Chill dough for 30 minutes
6. Place confectioners" sugar in a separate bowl
7. Drop rounded teaspoonfuls of dough into conf sugar
8. Roll to coat and form balls
9. Place 2 inches apart on cookie sheets
10. Bake for 8-9 minutes or until set
11. Cool 1 minute

title: pear gorgonzola tart
steps:
1. Bake the pie shell in a square or round tart pan according to package instructions
2. Remove from the oven and let cool slightly
3. Meanwhile , combine the cream cheese , gorgonzola , thyme , salt , and pepper in a medium bowl
4. Using a hand blender , whip the cheeses together
5. In a large , heavy skillet , melt the butter over medium-high heat
6. Add the pears and cook until golden on both sides , about 5 minutes
7. When the tart crust has cooled slightly , gently spread the whipped cheese mixture evenly over the bottom of the tart
8. Place the pear slices in a decorative pattern over the cheese mixture
9. Sprinkle the thin strips of prosciutto over the pears
10. Cut into squares or wedges and serve

title: apple iced tea
steps:
1. Pour a heat-proof bowl or use a saucepan pour 3 cups boiling water over the tea bags
2. Cover and steep for about 5 minutes
3. Remove tea bags and discard
4. Stir in sugar , juice concentrate and 2 cups cold water
5. Stir well
6. Serve over ice
7. Garnish with a cinnamon in each glass

title: healthy tuna casserole  low fat
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees f
2. Grease an 11 x 7 or 13 x 9-inch baking dish with cooking spray
3. Boil the pasta in a large pot of boiling water until al dente
4. Drain then transfer to a large bowl
5. Add in onion and tuna
6. Toss to combine
7. In a saucepan heat soup with milk until smooth
8. Stir in mushrooms mayonnaise , mrs dash seasoning , garlic powder and black pepper until combined
9. Pour into the bowl and toss to combine
10. Transfer mixture to prepared baking dish
11. Bake for about 30 minutes
12. Remove from oven then sprinkle with cheddar cheese , return to oven for 2-4 minutes to melt the cheese

title: corn and potato pancakes with salsa
steps:
1. In a medium mixing bowl , combine potatoes , corn and egg
2. Mix well with a spoon
3. Place bread crumbs in a shallow bowl
4. Using clean hands , form mixture into 1 1 / 2" diameter patties: dip each pattie in bread crumbs , coating both sides
5. Over medium heat , in a large non-stick , heat heat 2 tablespoons of the canola oil until hot
6. Fry the patties , a few at a time , for 2 minutes , or until golden brown on the bottom
7. Flip and cook another 2 minutes
8. On the second side
9. Transfer finished cakes to a baking sheet and keep in a warm oven until all cakes are cooked
10. Transfer cakes to a serving platter and serve with salsa , if desired

title: i can t believe there s no dairy in this green bean casserole
steps:
1. In a small saucepan , melt 2 tbsp margarine
2. Add mushrooms and garlic and saute till the mushrooms change color
3. Pour the mixture out into a bowl and set aside
4. Melt the remaining 6 tbsp margarine
5. Add flour gradually and whisk into butter
6. Add mushroom mixture back in , along with onion powder , salt , pepper , and gradually add hot soy milk
7. Cook for another 30 seconds , stirring constantly
8. Pour this mixture into a 9x13 casserole dish
9. Add the cold soy milk , salt , pepper , and 1 cup of the onions
10. Drain 2 of the 3 cans of green beans before adding
11. Add the third can with its juices
12. Pour the remaining onions on top
13. Cover with foil and bake at 350 for 30 minutes

title: boston cooking school brownies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325
2. Grease and 8x8 baking pan with butter
3. Line with parchment paper and grease the paper
4. Set aside
5. Melt butter and chocolate together in a 2-qt saucepan , stirring often
6. Remove from heat and stir in sugar
7. Add eggs and vanilla and stir until smooth
8. Add nuts , if using , and flour , and stir until incorporated
9. Pour into prepared baking pan and smooth
10. Bake about 60 minutes , or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean
11. Let cool at least 2 hours before cutting and serving

title: caesar coleslaw
steps:
1. Process first 4 ingredients in small blender until anchovies and garlic have dissolved into the dressing
2. Season dressing to taste with salt and pepper
3. Place cabbage and green onions in large bowl
4. Add dressing and toss to coat
5. Mix cheese into coleslaw
6. Transfer to large shallow bowl and serve

title: greek style spaghetti bake
steps:
1. Heat the oven to 375 degrees f
2. Grease a 2-quart casserole dish
3. In a skillet saute the ground beef , onion , garlic and oregano
4. Add in the wine , water , cinnamon , salt and pepper and the tomatoes with juice
5. Bring to a boil simmer for 25-30 minutes , or until thick
6. In a medium pan , combine the flour , half and half cream 1 / 2 tsp allspice
7. Bring to a boil , reduce the heat and cook for 5 minutes stirring constantly until thick
8. Remove from heat
9. Stir in mozzarella cheese , 2 tablespoons parmesan cheese and egg
10. Mix well until cheese has melted
11. In the bottom of the greased casserole dish , sprinkle 2 tablespoons bread crumbs
12. Then evenly spread in about 2 cups cooked spaghetti
13. Top with 2 cups of cooked ground beef mixture , then 1 cup of cream sauce
14. Repeat the layers
15. In a small bowl , combine the 1 / 2 cup bread crumbs with 2 tbsp parmesan cheese
16. Sprinkle over the top of the casserole
17. Bake for 25-30 minutes , or until hot and bubbly

title: thai curry chicken
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a large skillet
2. Brown the chicken over medium heat
3. Remove from pan
4. Add onions and cook for 5 minutes
5. Add garlic and curry paste , cook , stirring for a minute
6. Add coconut milk , sugar , and salt , then bring to a boil
7. Add bamboo , cover , then reduce heat to medium and simmer about 12 minutes
8. While the curry simmers , cook the rice
9. Add the chicken and bell pepper to the curry , cover and cook for about 8 minutes
10. Turn off heat
11. Stir in lemon juice and basil

title: pineapple cheese salad
steps:
1. Assemble the salad as follows:
2. Place 2-3 lettuce leaves on a small salad plate
3. Top with pineapple rings
4. Fill the "hole" in the pineapple ring with a 1 / 2 tablespoon to 1 tablespoon mayonnaise
5. Sprinkle with cheese to "hide" mayo

title: butter   ginger chicken
steps:
1. Defrost chicken , cut into 2 inch porton
2. Wash throughly and drain excess water using strainer
3. On medium heat , heat non-stick wok and add 100 grams butter
4. Once butter is semi melted , add ginger and stir for 30 seconds
5. Then add splice shillies and stir for 30 secs
6. Now add chicken to wok , add salt
7. Stir well and close lid for 1 minute
8. Open and add onions and black pepper and balance of butter
9. Stir well
10. Lower heat to low / med ad close lid
11. Cook for 5 minutes
12. Open , you will see some water
13. Stir well and close lid for another 5 minutes
14. Open , you will see chicken semi cooked
15. Taste for chilly and salt
16. Adjust to your taste
17. If they is water , then cook open on low / med heat
18. Keep stirring every 2 minutes
19. Careful it does not get burnt at bottom of wok
20. Water is burning off and liquid is now becoming gravy
21. Stir well and if you think chicken is cooked , close lid and leave aside for 5 minutes

title: yahoolie chocolate drink
steps:
1. In a gallon container , mix nestle powder and sugar with lukewarm water
2. Stir until sugar is dissolved
3. Add "creamer" , vanilla and salt
4. Mix and add cold water or water and ice to fill the container
5. Serve cold
6. Stir before serving because the chocolate settles to the bottom of the container

title: no bake diabetic pineapple cheesecake

3. Fry onion , garlic and spices in 1 tbsp oil 4-5 minutes
4. Chop the cashew nuts in a food processor until powdered
5. Add cashews and chicken stock to the onion and spices
6. Cook for 2 minutes until slightly thickened
7. Add the tomatoes and cook for 20 minutes
8. Add the chocolate and spinach
9. Heat and taste
10. Add salt or more spices if needed
11. Serve with roasted cashew nuts and whole grain rice

title: minted mayonnaise
steps:
1. Place the egg yolks in a bowl and use a whisk to mix in the lemon juice , mustard and a little salt
2. Beat continuously , adding minted oil 1 tablespoon at a time until all the oil is incorporated and the mixture is smooth and creamy
3. Minted olive oil instructions
4. Bring the oil slowly to temp of 70-80d in a pan
5. If you don't have a thermometer , don't boil it , it is better to be colder than too hot
6. Place the mint in a heatproof bowl and poor the oil over it , mix well and allow to cool
7. Strain oil into a jar and discard the mint

title: viki s almond encrusted tilapia fillets with orange sauce
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Pre-spray iron skillet or baking dish with pam
3. Combine almond syrup and egg whites and whip until stiff peaks
4. I used a stick beater bouncing up and down gently to add air
5. Gently fold in almond flour until incorporated
6. Rinse fresh fillet , then pat fillet dry and season with salt and pepper
7. With spatula , coat one side of fillet with egg white mixture
8. Lay coated side down on skillet
9. Top each fillet with more egg white mixture until fillet is totally encased with coating top and sides
10. Bake 9 - 11 minutes until egg white mixture is starting to brown
11. Remove from oven and serve on a bed of butterhead lettuce dressed with sugar free raspberry vinaigrette
12. Orange sauce: mix marmelade , butter , parsley and red pepper flakes together in small bowl and microwave for 30-60 seconds , stir well
13. Spoon orange sauce on top of fillets and serve

title: strawberry spinach won ton salad
steps:
1. Directions:
2. Set oil at 350 and deep fry the won tons until lightly brown and crisp
3. Or spray with olive oil spray and bake 400 for 5 minutes
4. Cook bacon and crumble , or buy pre-cooked bacon and cut into pieces
5. Put the almonds in a frying pan over medium heat , and continue to move around until lightly browned , and set aside until cooled
6. Slice strawberries
7. For dressing , mix red wine vinegar , mustard , salt , sugar and raspberry jam
8. Then add oil and shake or mix well
9. Refrigerate after serving
10. Layer salad ingredients
11. Serve dressing on the side

title: slow cooker maple berry oatmeal
steps:
1. Combine water plus next 3 ingredients in a 3 quart crockpot
2. Cover and cook on low for 7 to 8 hours or until oats are tender and creamy
3. At the end of cooking time , stir in dried cranberries and maple syrup

title: penne a la broccoli
steps:
1. Cook the pasta in rapidly boiling water until al dente
2. Trim the ends of the broccoli stems and cut off the flowers
3. Peel the outer fibrous layer off the main stalks and cut the stalks into bite-sized pieces
4. Separate the flower of the broccoli into bite-sized pieces
5. Place the broccoli in a colander and rinse under cold running water
6. Put it in a saucepan with the olive oil , garlic , water and salt
7. Bring to a boil , cover tightly , and let steam until the broccoli is bright green and very crunchy-tender - no more than 5 minutes
8. Remove the lid and boil off most of the remaining liquid
9. Toss the broccoli with cooked pasta
10. Top with red pepper flakes and parmesan cheese , if desired

title: avocado frappe
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in blender
2. Whirl until smooth and thick
3. Pour into tall glass and serve

title: cauliflower popcorn   roasted cauliflower
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees
2. Trim the head of cauliflower , discarding the core and thick stems
3. Cut florets into pieces about the size of ping-pong balls
4. In a large bowl , combine the olive oil and salt , whisk , then add the cauliflower pieces and toss thoroughly
5. Line a baking sheet with parchment for easy cleanup then spread the cauliflower pieces on the sheet and roast for 1 hour , turning 3 or 4 times , until most of each piece has turned golden brown
6. Serve immediately and enjoy !
7. Where i got it: i originally heard about this recipe at gail's recipe swap , where josh posted it and many folks tried and loved it

title: miss jean s cocoa
steps:
1. Scald milk
2. Mix cocoa , sugar , and salt in top of double boiler
3. Add boiling water gradually
4. Biol 5 minutes
5. Pour in scalding milk
6. Beat 2 minutes with egg beater

title: grilled honey cumin bbq pork packs
steps:
1. Heat coals or gas grill for direct heat
2. Spray half of one side of four 18x12-inch sheets of heavy-duty aluminum foil with nonstick cooking spray
3. Mix barbecue sauce , honey and cumin in small bowl
4. Place 1 pork chop , 3 pieces corn , 1 / 4 cup carrots and 1 / 2 cup potato wedges on center of each sprayed foil sheet
5. Sprinkle with 1 / 4 teaspoon salt
6. Spoon 3 tablespoons sauce mixture over pork and vegetables on each sheet
7. Fold foil over pork and vegetables so edges meet
8. Seal edges , making tight 1 / 2-inch fold
9. Fold again
10. Allow space on sides for circulation and expansion
11. Grill packets 4 to 6 inches from medium heat 15 to 20 minutes , turning once , until pork is slightly pink in center
12. Place packets on plates
13. Cut large x across top of each packet
14. Fold back foil

title: charlie s revenge chocolate surprise dessert
steps:
1. Cake
2. Make cake according to instructions or use your own chocolate fudge cake recipe
3. Mix 3 eggs , oil , and water with cake mix on medium speed until all the lumps are gone
4. Pour into a 9 x 13 cake pan and cook according to directions 35-40 minutes
5. Let cool at least 1 hour
6. Revenge:
7. Make pudding with 1 3 / 4 c milk
8. With a spoon or spatula fold in 1 / 2 of tub or 4 oz of whip cream
9. Add baileys irish cream folding in , chill in fridge
10. Break up cake into chunks and put 1 layer in decorator bowl , preferable see through
11. Gently spread 1 / 2 tub or 4 oz of whip cream
12. Pour 1 / 2 can or 8 oz cherry pie filling on top
13. Pour in 1 / 2 of pudding baileys mix , spread over top gently
14. Repeat layers 10 - 13
15. Dollop whip creams mounds in decorator style
16. Place 3 cherries in middle
17. Dust with cocoa or sprinkles or chocolate slivers
18. The theme here is chocolate lol !
19. Chill for 2 hours before dinner
20. Times are approximate as each oven cooks different
21. Cooking time does not include chill time after completion

title: fusilli cheddar bake
steps:
1. Oven at 350f
2. Cook noodles as per package directions
3. Sautee onions in butter till softened
4. Divide cheese into 2 amounts , 1 1 / 2 cups and 1 / 2 cup
5. Mix all ingredients in a casserole dish , reserving 1 / 2 cup of cheese
6. Top with reserved cheese
7. Bake for 30 minutes , until hot and bubbly

title: chocolate maraschino cherry cake
steps:
1. Grease and flour pans
2. Sift flour and soda
3. Cream butter and sugar
4. Add egg , melted chocolate nuts and cherries and juice to creamed mixture
5. Add dry ingredients and buttermilk alternately
6. Pour into pans
7. Bake in a 350 oven for 30 minutes
8. Cool
9. Frost with ganache

title: red river hot cereal mix  copycat
steps:
1. Combine ingredients in a bowl then transfer to an airtight container or "ziploc"-type plastic bag
2. To prepare: for 2 servings , place 1 1 / 2 cups filtered water , 1 / 2 cup red river copycat hot cereal mix and 1 / 4 teaspoon salt in a sauce pan
3. Bring to a boil
4. Stirring occasionally
5. Reduce to a gentle boil and cook 5 minutes uncovered , stirring occasionally
6. After cooking is complete , remove sauce pan from stove top and cover
7. Set aside for a few minutes
8. Enjoy with your favorite additions and toppings: milk , dried fruit , cinnamon , etc

title: steak tartare burgers
steps:
1. Combine all the ingredients except the olive oil in a large bowl
2. Use your hands , and make sure everything is mixed well and distributed evenly
3. Form the mixture into 2 large , thick round patties
4. Heat the oil in a large non-stick fry pan and cook the burgers on one side for 5 minutes , until dark and crusty
5. Turn and cook for 1-2 minutes more or until cooked to your liking
6. Serve on grilled turkish bread with oven roasted tomatoes , and a rocket salad , or how ever you wish
7. You can serve this mixture raw if you really want to !

title: kehali s kicking hot salsa
steps:
1. Wash tomatoes and place in large container
2. Boil hot water and pour over tomatoes to scald skin
3. Let tomatoes stand in hot water for 10-15 minutes
4. Pour off hot water and add ice water to help peel skin off tomatoes and chop to desired consistency
5. Chop all peppers and onions
6. In large cooking pot , add onions , peppers and spices , cooking for about 15 min add chopped tomatoes and tomato sauce
7. Add sugar to taste
8. Cover and slow cook for approximately 2 hours
9. If salsa is too thick , just add addtl tomato sauce / water mix
10. Taste to see if more spices are need and add to taste
11. Place in canning jars after cooling
12. Tastes really good when still hot
13. Serve with tortilla chips

title: chicken wings in honey sauce   crock pot
steps:
1. Rinse chicken and pat dry
2. Cut off and discard wing
3. Cut each wing at joint to make two sections
4. Sprinkle wing parts with salt and pepper
5. Place wing parts on broiler pan
6. Broil 5-4 inches from heat 20 minutes , 10 minutes a side or until chicken is brown
7. Transfer chicken to crock pot
8. For sauce , combine honey , soy sauce , ketchup , oil and garlic in bowl
9. Pour over chicken wings
10. Cover and cook on low 4-5 hours or on high 2-2 / 2 hours
11. Garnish with sesame seeds , if desired

title: good for you meatloaf
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degree
2. Combine and mix all the ingredients in oven safe pan
3. Cook for 1 hour 30 minutes

title: bagel dogs or mini bagel dogs
steps:
1. In a large mixing bowl , dissolve the yeast , brown sugar and salt in the 1 1 / 2 cups warm water
2. Stir in flour , and knead dough on a floured surface until smooth and elastic , about 8 minutes
3. Place in a greased bowl , and turn to coat the surface
4. Cover , and let rise for one hour
5. Combine 2 cups warm water and baking soda in an 8 inch square pan
6. After dough has risen , divide in half and put one ball back in the bowl and cover again
7. Gently roll and stretch the second half into a log about 16 inches long and cut into 16-20 pieces
8. Roll each piece into a 7 inch rope , then starting at one end of the little smokie begin wrapping the dough around in a spiral , ending at the other end
9. Crimp the end or push it under the last wrap if needed to secure
10. Dip it into the baking soda and water solution
11. Place on parchment covered cookie sheets , loosely cover with foil and let rise 15 to 20 minutes
12. Repeat all with second half of dough
13. Bake at 450 degrees f for 8 to 10 minutes , or until golden brown
14. Brush with melted butter , and sprinkle with coarse salt
15. Repeat with remaining dough
16. Feel free to experiment with different sizes of dough you use for wrapping , especially if you choose to make the full-sized dogs
17. I ended up liking the thicker wraps best because the dough stayed soft and puffy instead of getting hard and crunchy on the outside
18. Any leftover dough can be formed into pretzels , twisted into pretzel sticks or i even tried just cutting them into bite-sized bits that were great for toddler snacks
19. Serve with cheese sauce , ketchup , mustard , bbq or horseradish sauce for dipping
20. Yield depends on how many little smokies or hot dogs you're using
21. One full recipe though will make a nice addition to your appetizer tray

title: simple sugar syrup
steps:
1. Bring water to a boil in a small saucepan
2. Pour in sugar
3. Stir until sugar is completely dissolved
4. Remove saucepan from heat and allow contents to cool
5. Refrigerate in a sealed container until ready for use

title: pineapple corn salad
steps:
1. Drain the corn and pineapple real well
2. Add the mayonnaise

title: shrimp enchiladas
steps:
1. Melt butter over medium heat in a frying pan , add peppers , onions , jalapeno pepper , garlic and oregano
2. Cook until soft , about 5 minutes
3. Add salt and pepper
4. Mix in the cream and broth
5. Bring to a boil , then simmer 3 minutes
6. Stir in the cheese until melted
7. Remove from heat add the sour cream
8. Keep warm
9. Makes 2 1 / 2 cups sauce
10. Heat oven 350:
11. In a large skillet , melt butter over medium / high heat
12. Add shrimp and 1 / 2 of the green onions-cook until the shrimp are pink
13. Stir in 1 / 2 of the tomatoes and 1 / 2 of the sauce / spoon shrimp mixture into tortillas and roll up
14. Place seam side down in a baking dish
15. Spoon remaining sauce over the rolled tortillas , cover and bake 30 minutes or until hot
16. Uncover and sprinkle with the remaining cheese and tomatoes
17. Bake until cheese melts

title: meatloaf miniatures
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine ketchup , brown sugar and mustard
2. Remove 1 / 2 cup for topping
3. Set aside
4. Add eggs , worcestershire sauce , cereal and seasonings to remaining ketchup mixture
5. Mix well
6. Let stand for 5 minutes
7. Crumble beef over cereal mixture and mix well
8. Press meat mixture into 18 muffin cups
9. Bake at 375 for 18-20 minutes
10. Drizzle with reserved ketchup mixture
11. Bake 10 minutes longer or until meat is no longer pink and a meat thermometer reads 160
12. Serve desired number of meat loaves
13. Cool remaining loaves
14. Freeze
15. Transfer to freezer bags
16. Freeze for up to 3 months
17. To use frozen meat loaves: completely thaw in the refrigerator
18. Place loaves in a greased baking dish
19. Bake at 350 for 30 minutes or until heated through , or cover and microwave on high for 1 minute or until heated through

title: kfc gravy  copycat
steps:
1. Before adding the sesame oil to the broth , dispense 1 small drop into a spoon first , to avoid excess spillage
2. Whisk together the liquid ingredients in a large bowl
3. Mix together the dry ingredients in a another bowl
4. Quickly whisk the dry ingredients into the liquid ingredients , until thoroughly dissolved
5. Melt 3 tablespoons vegetable shortening in a medium saucepan over low heat
6. Stir in 2 tablespoons all-purpose flour
7. Cook the roux ingredients slowly over medium-low heat until just bubbly
8. Pour the blended broth mixture into the roux in saucepan
9. Whisk until mixture is thoroughly blended
10. Bring gravy mixture to a boil while whisking constantly
11. Boil one minute
12. Reduce heat
13. Simmer until gravy deepens in color and desired consistency is reached , whisking as needed
14. Remove gravy from heat and allow to cool slightly before serving , stirring a often to avoid a skin from forming on surface
15. Serve and enjoy !

title: mushrooms newburg
steps:
1. Wipe mushrooms with damp cloth
2. Remove stems
3. Melt butter in pan
4. Add mushrooms , celery , onion juice , and paprika
5. Cover
6. Simmer until mushrooms are tender
7. Stir in flour
8. Add cream
9. Cook for a moment more
10. Add orange juice , rind , and grape juice
11. Season to taste with salt , pepper , cayenne , and nutmeg
12. Serve in individual dishes , on toast , or in croustades
13. Makes 4 servings

title: niku jaga  flavoured meat and potatoes
steps:
1. Peel potatoes and cut into 4-6 pieces
2. Soak in water for 5 minutes
3. Cut thinly sliced meat into 4-5 cm pieces
4. Mix sugar , soy sauce , sake and ginger and bring to a boil
5. Add the meat and bring to a boil again
6. Add potatoes and water to cover , and place a lid inside the pot , right on top the ingredients
7. This is called the"dropped lid technique" and is used to stop the ingredients breaking up , whilst distributing the flavour without stirring
8. Bring to a boil again , then simmer until the potatoes are cooked

title: choose a cookie dough
steps:
1. Basic directions:
2. In a large mixing bowl beat the shortening and butter with a mixer on medium to high speed for 30 seconds
3. Add the brown sugar , granulated sugar and baking soda
4. Beat until fluffy
5. Add eggs and vanilla , beat until combined
6. Beat or stir in flour
7. Use the dough immediately , or cover and chill for up to 24 hours
8. Drop slightly rounded tablespoon of cookie dough 2 inches apart onto an ungreased cookie sheet
9. Bake at 375f , for 10-12 minutes , or until the edges are lightly browned
10. Remove the cookies and cool on a wire rack
11. Makes about 48 cookies
12. Fruit oatmeal rounds:
13. Prepare dough as directed , but substitute 1 cup of rolled oats for 1 cup of flour
14. Stir 1 teaspoon of ground cinnamon into flour mixture
15. Also stir a 6 ounce package of mixed dried fruit bits or raisins into the dough
16. Bake as directed
17. Peanut butter buddies:
18. Prepare dough as directed , but add 1 / 2 cup peanut butter along with eggs and vanilla
19. Also , stir a 12 ounce package of peanut butter chips in to dough
20. Bake as directed
21. Malted milk treats:
22. Prepare dough as directed , but substitute 1 / 4 cup instant malted milk powder for 1 / 4 cup of flour
23. Also , stir in 1 1 / 2 cups chopped-up malt balls into dough
24. Bake as directed
25. Macadamia mania:
26. Prepare dough as directed , but stir 2 cups of coarsely chopped white chocolate baking bar and 3 1 / 2 ounce of macadamia nuts into dough
27. Bake as directed
28. Double chocolate delights:
29. Prepare dough as directed , but substitute 1 / 3 cup of unsweetened cocoa powder for 1 / 2 cup of flour
30. Also , stir a 12 ounce package of semi-sweet chocolate chip pieces into dough
31. Bake as directed
32. Chocolate candy cookies:
33. Prepare dough as directed , but stir 2 cups of candy-coated milk chocolate pieces into dough
34. Bake as directed
35. Super-chunk chippers:
36. Prepare dough as directed , but stir 1 cup of coarsely chopped semi-sweet chocolate , 1 cup coarsely chopped milk chocolate and 1 cup chopped pecans into the dough
37. Drop dough from a 1 / 4 cup measuring cup about 4 inches apart onto an ungreased cookie sheet
38. Flatten the cookies slightly with a spoon
39. Bake for 13-15 minutes , or until the edges are slightly browned
40. Make 18 cookies
41. To make a variation in advance , wrap the dough in freezer wrap , and freeze for up to 6 months
42. Before baking , thaw dough overnight in the refrigerator
43. Bake as directed

title: mesquite grilled cajun turkey
steps:
1. Prepare grill using mesquite chips or coals
2. Brush turkey with oil
3. Combine remaining ingredients and sprinkle over turkey
4. Place turkey on grill
5. Cover grill and cook according to package directions
6. Wrap in foil and let stand 10 to 15 minutes
7. Remove netting from turkey and slice it

title: gump shrimp wraps
steps:
1. Preheat a grill pan or heavy skillet over high heat
2. Toss shrimp with a drizzle of oil and season with crushed pepper , salt and black pepper
3. Mix marmalade and barbecue sauce
4. Grill shrimp 2 minutes on the first side , turn and baste liberally with sauce
5. Cook a minute or 2 longer , turn and baste again
6. Cook 1 minute more then transfer to a serving dish
7. To eat , wrap shrimp in lettuce with cucumber

title: toffee crunch cake mix cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Mix all ingredients well , and put by tablespoons on parchment-covered baking sheet
3. Press each cookie lightly with fork , bake for about 15 minutes , until lightly browned around edges
4. Remove to wire cooling rack

title: very  simple fried rice
steps:
1. Whip eggs until they are frothy
2. Scramble , then set aside
3. Steam carrots until slightly soft
4. If using frozen peas & corn , run under hot water to thaw
5. Break up any clumps in the rice
6. Over medium-high heat , heat oil in a large pan or wok
7. Add rice and stir for about 1 minute , until heated through
8. Reduce heat to medium
9. Add soy sauce , garlic , salt & pepper
10. Stir-fry for 1 minute
11. Add onions , peas , corn , carrots and eggs
12. Stir-fry for 1 minute , until heated through

title: big john s rocky mountain ribs
steps:
1. Remove rack ends of ribs if not done prior to purchase
2. Pierce meat with a fork several times and cut racks in half
3. In a large pot , combine dr pepper , pineapple juice , ale and brown sugar , mix and add ribs
4. Add water in order to submerge ribs completely if necessary
5. Bring to a boil and cook for 1 hour , retaining the liquid when finished
6. Saut onion , garlic and green pepper in butter for about 5 minutes until tender
7. Add tomato paste and about 3 cups of the liquid remaining from boiling the ribs
8. Add worcestershire sauce , mustard , vinegar , molasses , liquid smoke and spices , mix well
9. Let mixture boil down stirring often until fairly thick
10. Remove from heat and whisk lime juice into mixture
11. Remove ribs from mixture , dust with cayenne and grill them on a bar-b-q over medium heat for 5-8 minutes per side
12. Brush ribs with sauce , then put them back on the bar-b-q over low heat for another 10-15 minutes , bushing frequently with sauce and being careful not to burn them

title: coconut toffee oatmeal cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Line a few cookie sheets with parchment paper
3. Beat the butter and brown sugar until smooth
4. Add the eggs and vanilla
5. Blend until smooth
6. Combine the flour , baking soda , cinnamon , and salt
7. Gradually add to the creamed mixture just until combined
8. Stir in the oats , toffee bits , and coconut by hand
9. Drop dough by rounded teaspoons
10. 2" apart onto the cookie sheets
11. Bake 8-10 minutes , or until edges are lightly browned
12. Cool 1 minute on the cookie sheets
13. Transfer cookies to wire racks and cool completely

title: smoky thousand island dressing
steps:
1. Mix'em up
2. Stick it in ye olde icee boxe for a bit to allow flavours to blend
3. Store unused portion , refrigerated , in airtight container

title: stuffed clams
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Open clams , making sure to save any juice and half the clam shells
3. Chop the clams by hand or use the food processor
4. Set aside
5. Dice the bacon and cook until done
6. When cool , add to the clams
7. Dice the vegetables and add to the clams
8. Add seasonings
9. Add the bread crumbs 1 / 2 cup at a time , until it resembles stuffing
10. If the mixture seems too dry , add the reserved clam juice
11. Spoon mixture into clam shells and bake for 15 or 20 minutes
12. Enjoy

title: giada de laurentiis  little thimbles sciue sciue
steps:
1. Boil up a large saucepan of salted water
2. Add the pasta and cook until tender but still al dente , stirring often to prevent sticking
3. This takes about 8 minutes
4. Drain
5. Meanwhile , heat the oil in a large heavy skillet over medium heat
6. Add the garlic and saute until fragrant , about 1 minute
7. Be careful not to burn
8. Add the tomatoes and saute just until heated through , about 2 minutes
9. Add the cooked , drained pasta
10. Remove skillet from heat
11. Add the cheese and basil and toss to coat
12. Season to taste with salt
13. Spoon into small serving bowls and serve immediately

title: daddy s favorite carrot cake
steps:
1. Combine flour , baking powder , salt and cinnamon
2. In a separate bowl , beat eggs , sugar and oil
3. With mixer running on low speed , slowly add the flour mixture
4. Blend in vanilla , carrot , raisins and pecans
5. Pour batter into a well greased 8 x 12 inch pan
6. Bake in 325f oven for 35 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
7. When cake is cool , spread with cream cheese icing
8. When cake is frosted , sprinkle a small handful of pecans on top of cake

title: penne with king prawns   jumbo shrimp  cherry tomatoes and lemon
steps:
1. Bring a large saucepan of water to the boil and add the pasta
2. Give it a stir and cook for 10 minutes exactly , uncovered
3. When the pasta is cooked , drain quickly and reserve the pasta water in a jug
4. Meanwhile , heat the butter in a deep frying pan and add the garlic , and gently cook for 1 minute without colour
5. Add the tomatoes and cook over a low-medium heat for 10 minutes - resist the urge to stir them as this will break them down and you want to retain a little of their shape
6. Pour 1 cup of the pasta water onto the tomatoes and garlic and bring to the boil
7. Then add the prawns and continue to cook over a medium heat for 2-3 minutes , stirring until they are cooked through and have all turned pink
8. Just before serving add the pasta , lemon zest , season with freshly ground black pepper and parsley and toss through
9. Serve on warmed plates with a wedge of lemon

title: salmon fillets w green sauce
steps:
1. Mix wine , olive oil , lemon juice , salt , pepper , thyme , marjoram and 2 tbsp parsley together and pour over salmon filets
2. Marinate at least three hours , turning occasionally
3. Bake salmon at 400 degrees for 15-20 minutes
4. While your salmon filets are marinating , make the sauce
5. Place spinach , remaining parsley , watercress and green onions in a food processor and blend will
6. Add lemon juice , mustard , basil and tabasco and blend again
7. Add mayonnaise and blend
8. Fold in capers
9. Taste for seasoning and refrigerate until chilled

title: fabulous fish tacos
steps:
1. Cabbage slaw: whisk vinegar , oil , and mustard together in a large bowl
2. Add cabbage and parsley , and toss to coat
3. Season with salt and pepper
4. Chill until ready to serve
5. Make ahead of time , this gives the slaw time to develop flavor
6. Tartar sauce: puree ingredients for the tartar sauce in a blender or food processor until smooth
7. Chill until serving
8. Fish: prepare fish by cutting fillets into 1x3" strips
9. Season with salt and pepper
10. 4combine eggs and milk in a shallow dish
11. Place flour on a plate and panko on another plate
12. Dredge each fish strip in flour , tapping off excess
13. Dip in egg mixture , letting excess drip back into dish
14. Coat with panko , pressing crumbs to adhere
15. Heat 1 / 2 cup oil to 360f in a pan
16. Fry half the fish on both sides until golden , turning once , about 6 minutes total
17. Transfer to a baking sheet
18. Keep warm in a 200f oven
19. Repeat with remaining fish strips
20. Tortillas: fry each tortilla in 1 / 2 teaspoons oil in a skillet
21. Assemble tacos with fish and slaw
22. Top with tartar sauce

title: home style beef cubes
steps:
1. In medium bowl , mix flour salt and pepper
2. Dredge meat in seasoned mixture and saut in oil until brown
3. Place in slow cooker
4. Add the onion , garlic and mushrooms to the pan and stir for a few minutes
5. Deglaze pan with ketchup , worcestershire sauce and beef broth
6. Pour liquid over meat
7. Cook on low for 7 hours
8. Add a few potatoes and carrots to the meat and you have a dinner in a pot
9. In lieu of potatoes and carrots , add 2 cups cooked pasta shells 1 / 2 hour before serving

title: crispy potatoes au gratin
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Arrange potatoes and 1 cup french fried onions in greased 13x9 dish
3. Combine half-and-half , ricotta , salt , garlic powder and pepper
4. Whisk until well combined
5. Pour over potatoes
6. Stir gently
7. Bake , uncovered , 50 minutes or until potatoes are tender
8. Sprinkle with cheddar cheese and remaining 1 cup onions
9. Bake 3 minutes or until cheese is melted and onions are golden

title: 24 karat cake
steps:
1. Prepare cake:
2. Place oil in mixing bowl of electric mixer
3. Mix on low speed , adding sugar
4. Mix all dry ingredients together
5. Add eggs to oil and sugar mixture
6. Mix
7. Add dry ingredients and mix
8. Add the carrots , pecans , raisins and crushed pineapple
9. Fold together
10. Coat three 10 x 2 inch round cake pans with vegalene spray
11. Press a circle of parchment paper into the bottom of each pan and spray again to coat with vegalene
12. Coat the pans with flour and remove the excess
13. Divide the batter evenly between the cake pans
14. Bake at 300f for 18 to 22 minutes or until a toothpick or cake tester inserted in center of cake comes away clean
15. Remove from oven and allow to cool 20 to 30 minutes
16. Invert the cake pan onto a parchment paper-lined sheetpan
17. Refrigerate until cold before assembly
18. Prepare filling:
19. Place sugar , flour and salt in saucepan
20. Mix until well combined
21. Gradually stir heavy cream into dry ingredients
22. Add butter and stir
23. Place saucepan over medium heat , stirring constantly until mixture comes to a simmer
24. Simmer , stirring constantly for 20-30 minutes or until the mixture is light golden brown
25. Cool to room temperature and then stir in nuts and vanilla
26. Refrigerate until needed
27. Prepare frosting:
28. Place butter and cream cheese into the bowl of electric mixer
29. Mix at medium high speed until mixture is very light and fluffy
30. Gradually add sugar and heat on high speed until light , fluffy and lump-free
31. Fold in vanilla
32. Hold at room temperature - do not refrigerate
33. Assemble your creation:
34. Place a cake layer onto a 12" plate and top with half of the pecan caramel filling , spreading evenly to the edges
35. Top with second layer and then remaining pecan caramel filling
36. Spread evenly to the edges
37. Top with the third layer
38. Use a spatula to remove any excess filling from around the edges
39. Frost the cake with cream cheese frosting about 1 / 4 inch all over
40. Sprinkle top of cake with additional pecan pieces , if desired
41. Refrigerate at least 2 hours before slicing
42. Remove the cake from the refrigerator
43. Heat a knife with hot water and cut the cake into 8 or 10 portions
44. Heat the knife between each cut for a neat , precise cut
45. Place onto plates and serve immediately

title: 5 ingredient macaroni and cheese
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Cook macaroni according to package directions until al dente
3. Drain
4. Melt 2 tbsp butter in sauce pan over medium heat
5. Stir in flour and cook 1 minute
6. Add milk
7. Cook 6 minutes or until thickened , stirring constantly
8. Remove from heat
9. Stir in 1 1 / 2 cups cheeses
10. Season with salt and pepper
11. Pour over noodles and combine
12. Transfer to a 9x13-inch baking dish
13. Sprinkle with remaining 3 / 4 cup cheese
14. Bake 45 minutes or until top is crisp and beginning to brown
15. Let stand 10 minutes before serving

title: beef stir fry on a stick
steps:
1. For glaze , in a small bowl , combine the hoisin sauce , water , oil , soy sauce , garlic and pepper flakes
2. On four metal or soaked wooden skewers , alternately thread the broccoli , squash , red pepper and beef
3. Brush with 1 / 3 cup of glaze
4. Grill , covered , over medium heat for 6-7 minutes on each side or until meat reaches desired doneness and vegetables are tender , basting once with remaining glaze
5. Serve with rice

title: orange rice pudding with minted orange cranberry glaze
steps:
1. Orange / cranberry glaze: place the orange juice and cranberries in a small saucepan
2. Bring to simmer over medium heat and reduce mixture by half
3. This should take about 15 minutes
4. Stir in the honey
5. Rub the mint leaves vigorously between your fingers to release the natural oil then stir into the glaze
6. Let mixture stand 10 minutes , then remove the mint
7. Pudding: in a medium size saucepan , place the half and half and milk
8. Add the raw sugar , vanilla bean or extract and orange zest
9. Bring to a simmer over medium heat , stirring continually until the sugar is dissolved
10. Place the eggs in a medium mixing bowl
11. Now {{slowly}} pour the hot milk liquid into the eggs while whisking constantly until the liquid is absorbed
12. Next , whisk in the orange juice and stir in the hot rice and dried cranberries
13. Pour the mixture back into the saucepan and cook over medium heat until the mixture becomes hot and slightly thickened , approximately 3-4 minutes
14. Keep stirring constantly to avoid scorching
15. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
16. Spray or butter a 9x9 inch baking dish
17. Pour the warm pudding into the prepared baking dish and bake in oven for 15 minutes , or until the pudding is {{softly}} set
18. Use an ice cream scoop to portion out the pudding
19. Drizzle the prepared orange / cranberry glaze over each serving and garnish with fresh mint leaves if desired
20. Each serving is approximately 7 ounces

title: florentine cupcakes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180c and line a 12-hole 2-tablespoon capacity flat-based patty pan with paper cases
2. Using an hand electric mixer , cream the butter and caster sugar until it is pale and creamy
3. Add the egg and beat until the ingredients are well-combined
4. Sift the flour over the butter mixture and stir gently to combine
5. Stir in the cream
6. Two-thirds fill each paper case with the mixture and smooth the surface
7. The florentine topping: combine the butter , brown sugar and cream in a heatproof , microwave-safe bowl
8. Microwave , uncovered , on high for 1 minutes or until smooth
9. Stir in the flour , almonds , apricots and cherries and spoon the topping over the cupcakes
10. Bake for 20 minutes or until the tops are golden
11. Allow to completely cool in the pan
12. Then transfer to a serving plate
13. Spoon the melted chocolate into a snap-lock bag , seal and snip off 1 corner
14. Drizzle the melted chocolate over the cakes and serve

title: spinach  souffle
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Combine all ingredients , and place in large casserole dish that has been greased with cooking spray
3. Top with additional parmesan
4. Bake 30-45 minutes , or until bubbly

title: homemade vitamin water
steps:
1. Stir all ingredients in a pitcher
2. Place in fridge overnight and serve

title: best tossed salad
steps:
1. Whisk together first eight ingredients and refrigerate
2. To glaze pecans , melt 1 / 3 cup of sugar over medium high heat
3. When sugar is melted , add 2 / 3 cup of pecans and coat
4. Spread on buttered waxed paper to cool
5. Break apart
6. Mix together rest of ingredients except for nuts
7. And refrigerate until time to serve
8. When read to serve , add nuts and salad dressing

title: pappadeaux blackened oyster and shrimp fondeaux
steps:
1. Make sauce and set aside
2. Melt butter in a saucepan
3. Whisk in flour and chopped onion
4. Cook over
5. Medium heat until onion is tender
6. Slowly stir in stock and wine
7. Whisk
8. Until smooth
9. Add cayenne , garlic powder , & salt
10. Simmer 10 minutes
11. Add cream
12. Simmer 5 minutes
13. Remember not to let the cream scorch
14. Season shrimp and oysters with blackened seasonings available in most supermarkets
15. Melt butter in hot saut
16. Pan , and saut shrimp and oysters , about 2 minutes per side
17. Add spinach , mushrooms , crawfish , crab and green onion
18. Saute until mushrooms and spinach soften
19. Fold in sauce and bring to a simmer
20. Pour into heatproof dish
21. Top with grated cheese
22. Place under a broiler until cheese melts
23. Use garlic bread as dippers
24. Prepare shrimp stock by boiling down 1 cup of shrimp shells in 4 cups of water
25. Boil shells for 30 minutes

title: slow cooker chicken  barley  vegetable soup
steps:
1. The celery and onions can be reduced to 1 cup each and replaced by one or more of the optional vegetables
2. Place everything in a large crockpot with dial set on high
3. Cook 1-2 hours
4. Reduce heat to low setting
5. Cook for 6-8 hours
6. Or
7. Set crockpot on low and cook 10 hours
8. Add water or canned broth to thin the soup if it gets too thick
9. This can be frozen in individual portions and reheated as needed

title: pig sandwich like hard rock cafe
steps:
1. Pulled pork:
2. In a large bowl , combine vinegar , tabasco sauce and sugar with hot water
3. Stir till sugar is dissolved
4. Pour marinade over pork , cover and refrigerate for at least 12 hours
5. Preheat oven to 450f remove pork from marinade and place in a baking pan
6. Cook in the oven until well browned
7. Remove pork from oven
8. Pour some marinade over pork , lower temperature to 300f , cover with foil
9. Return pork to oven and slow-roast for an additional two hours or until meat pulls away easily from the bone
10. Coleslaw:
11. In a large bowl , mix sugar , vinegar and water with a wire whisk
12. Stir until the sugar is dissolved
13. Add shredded cabbage and mix well
14. Cover and refrigerate
15. Sauce:
16. Place all ingredients except the vegetable oil in a saucepan
17. Bring to a boil , stirring occasionally
18. When mixture has reached boiling stage , stir in vegetable oil till incorporated
19. Allow to simmer for 20 minutes , stirring occasionally
20. Remove from heat
21. Pour into proper storage container , and cool in an ice bath to 40f
22. Cover and refrigerate
23. Assembly:
24. Toast hamburger buns
25. Place the bottom of the toasted bun on the serving plate
26. Place a level scoop of pork on the bottom of the toasted bun
27. Place coleslaw on top of the meat , then ladle sauce over the slaw and meat
28. Serve the sandwich open-faced with the top part of the bun on the side
29. Serve immediately with a side of onion rings and beans

title: armenian steak tartare  chee kufta
steps:
1. Combine vegetables and basil together and mix well
2. In a large bowl combine 2 cups of chopped vegetables and mix the bulgur , water , tomato sauce and salt
3. Mix well and let stand 10 minutes
4. Add meat and blend well
5. Knead about 5 minutes , moistening your hands with cold water at intervals
6. Taste for salt
7. Add more if necessary
8. Shape as desired and place on platter
9. We liked it squished flat with a fork and spread liberally with fresh chopped parsley and green onions as garnish
10. Eat with pita bread or crusty french bread , yum !

title: country pork ribs
steps:
1. In a bowl , combine the first 10 ingredients
2. Mix well
3. Pour 1-1 / 2 cups marinade into a large resealable plastic bag
4. Add the ribs
5. Seal and turn to coat
6. Refrigerate for at least 4 hours
7. Cover and refrigerate remaining marinade
8. Drain and discard marinade from the ribs
9. Grill , covered , over indirect medium heat for 20 minutes on each side
10. Meanwhile , in a saucepan , combine the honey , brown sugar and reserved marinade
11. Bring to a boil
12. Cook and stir for 2 minutes or until slightly thickened
13. Baste ribs with some of the sauce
14. Grill 15-20 minutes longer or until a meat thermometer reads 160 degrees , turning and basting occasionally
15. Serve with the remaining sauce

title: lemony mustard chicken
steps:
1. Marinate chicken in lemonade for 1 hour
2. Drain , reserving the lemonade and pat dry with paper towels
3. Stir together bread crumbs and nuts on a plate
4. Put the egg in a shallow bowl and beat lightly
5. Place 3 tbls
6. Of mustard in another bowl
7. Brush the chicken with mustard , dip into the beaten egg , then dredge in crumbs / nuts
8. Chill , loosely covered , for 2 to 3 hours
9. Heat 1 / 2 inch of veg
10. Oil with the walnut oil in a large skillet until hot
11. Add the breaded chicken and fry , turning once , for 10 to 12 minutes
12. Remove to a plate and keep warm
13. While chicken is cooking , combine reserved lemonade , broth , and remaining 2 tbls
14. Of mustard in a small saucepan
15. Bring to a boil and reduce over high heat to 1 / 2 cup
16. Add the cream and cook about 1 1 / 2 minutes to heat through and thicken slightly
17. Season with salt and pepper
18. And pour over the chicken
