19. Serve hot
20. Enjoy !

title: special indoor barbecued spareribs with sauce
steps:
1. In small saucepan , saute onion in wesson oil until transparent
2. Add remaining ingredients except spare ribs
3. Mix well
4. Simmer 15 minutes
5. Pour over spare ribs in large glass baking dish
6. Let stand 1 hour , turning occasionally
7. Arrange on shallow rack or broiler pan
8. Bake 350 2 hours
9. Turn ribs and baste with remaining barecue sauce two or three times during baking
10. Cut in portions and serve with extra sacue for dipping
11. Makes 4 servings

title: simple ground chicken stroganoff
steps:
1. Heat a large skillet over medium heat
2. Add chicken and break into small crumbles
3. Add onion , garlic powder , salt and pepper
4. Cook 6 to 8 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink
5. Blend soup , broth , mushrooms , flour aqnd tomato paste: add to skillet
6. Heat until bubbly , stirring frequently
7. Reduce heat and simmer for about ten minutes , stirring frequently
8. Stir in sour cream and heat through
9. Sprinkle with parsley and serve over rice or pasta

title: avocado tea sandwiches
steps:
1. Combine mayonnaise , lemon juice and pepper in a small bowl
2. Thinly spread on bread and top with salmon , avocado and cucumber
3. Serve with your favorite tea beverage

title: scored parmesan potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. With a sharp knife , cut potatoes in half lengthwise
3. Slice each half widthwise six times , but not all the way through
4. Fan potatoes slightly
5. Place potatoes in shallow baking dish
6. Brush potatoes with 1 tbs butter
7. Sprinkle with paprika , parsley , salt , pepper and cheese
8. Bake , uncovered at 350 for 50 minutes or until tender
9. Drizzle with the rest of the butter

title: restaurant style bruschetta   cheese stuffed chicken breasts
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Combine tomatoes , 1 cup of the mozzarella cheese , the oregano and dry stuffing mix
3. Stir just until moistened
4. In separate bowl , combine dressing and parmesan cheese
5. Place chicken breasts in large plastic bag
6. Pound chicken until chicken is 1 / 4 inch thick
7. Place chicken , top-sides down , on baking dish
8. Spread evenly with stuffing mixture
9. Starting at one of the narrow ends , tightly roll up chicken
10. Place , seam-sides down , in the baking dish
11. Drizzle evenly with dressing mixture
12. Bake 40 minutes
13. Sprinkle breasts with remaining 1 / 2 cup mozzarella cheese
14. Bake an additional 5 minutes or until chicken is cooked through and cheese is melted

title: roasted lemon and garlic potatoes
steps:
1. Spray an 9x13-inch baking pan with cooking spray , or coat bottom of dish with oil
2. Preheat oven to 425f
3. Combine potatoes with remaining ingredients in a bowl
4. Toss to coat completely
5. Let coated potatoes stand 10 minutes
6. Spoon potato mixture into prepared baking pan in a single layer
7. Bake for 35-40 minutes or until tender and lightly browned , stirring occasionally
8. I cook a little longer , because i like mine brown and crispy !

title: no bake maple syrup pie
steps:
1. Whisk water with flour until smooth
2. Stir in syrup
3. Stir in egg
4. In a small heavy saucepan , cook over medium -low heat , stirring , until thick , 5-6 minutes
5. Add butter & stir till melted
6. Pour into baked pie crust
7. Let cool

title: chinese fried rice
steps:
1. Season eggs with salt and pepper
2. Peel onion and cut into wedges about 1
3. 5cm wide
4. Cut spring onions into shorts lengths on the diagonal
5. Cut the ham into very thin strips
6. Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a wok or large frying pan and add the eggs , pulling the set egg towards the centre and tilting the pan to let the unset egg run to the edges
7. When almost set , break up into large pieces , to resemble scrambled eggs
8. Transfer to a plate and set aside
9. Heat the remaining oil in the wok , swirling to coat the base and side
10. Add the onion and stir-fry over high heat until it starts to turn transparent
11. Add the ham , stir-fry for 1 minute
12. Add rice and peas , stir-fry for 3 minutes until rice has heated through
13. Add eggs , soy , spring onions and prawns
14. Heat through and serve

title: easy chili  crockpot
steps:
1. Brown ground beef in skillet
2. Drain beef and add onion , the 3 pkgs of chili seasoning and cumin to the skillet and cook a little longer until the seasonings are well blended
3. While seasonings are cooking into the meat , rinse and drain the kidney beans well and add to crockpot
4. Add the diced tomatoes to the crockpot
5. Add the browned beef mixture to the crockpot
6. Pour in about 1 / 2 of the tall 46 oz can of vegetable juice to the crockpot
7. Cook on low in crockpot for about 2 hours or until all is heated through
8. Serve with cheese , crackers , fritos , cornbread

title: spinach and feta crepes
steps:
1. Wash spinach and remove stalks
2. Place in bowl and microwave for a very short time- divide the spinach leaves into 2-3 bunches , cover and cook a bunch at a time
3. Spinach should be limp
4. Drain well- squeeze as much liquid from cooked spinach as you can
5. Chop roughly
6. Add finely chopped onion , the feta , romano and ricotta cheese
7. Mix well
8. Add ground nutmeg , salt and pepper
9. Add lightly beaten egg
10. Set aside
11. Crepes-----------------
12. Method: sift flour and salt into a bowl
13. Add eggs and a little milk
14. Beat well
15. Add the remaining milk and lastly the melted butter
16. Heat oil in crepe pan
17. Pour about 3-4 tablespoons of crepe mixture into pan- enough to cover the base of the pan thinly and evenly
18. Cook over high heat for about 1 minute until mixture looks as though it is setting on the top and the underneath is lightly browned
19. Turn crere over and cook the other side for about 1 / 2 a minute
20. Remove from pan and place on piece of waxed paper
21. Continue until all the crepe mixture is used up
22. This recipe should yield approx
23. 12 crepes
24. Place wax paper between crepes as you remove each one from the pan
25. Assemble the crepes------------
26. Place even amounts of spinach mixture in the centre of each crepe
27. Fold crepe into a'parcel' and place in lightly greased baking dish
28. I usually have enough mixture for 8 crepes
29. Over the crepes spoon some italian tomato sauce - onions , garlic , canned tomatoes , basil , oregano , salt and pepper
30. And then sprinkle lots of grated mozarella cheese !
31. Place in moderate oven about 15-20 minutes
32. This recipe may seem fidley to some or alot of work but it's not really- believe me
33. The recipe is always nicer a day old and re-heated
34. Typing the recipe out has got my salivary glands going- i think i'll have to make it soon again
35. Cooked , diced chicken can also be added to the spinach mixture

title: santa fe black bean gazpacho
steps:
1. Combine beans and v8 juice , oil , lime juice , cucumber , onion , worcestershire sauce , and garlic , etc , etc , hand blend until only till a bit chunky need to put in 2 large pots to blend
2. Chill at least three+ hours
3. Serve cold !
4. Serve with: cobbettes & corn tortillas

title: leek  onion and potato soup
steps:
1. Melt butter in a large saucepan
2. Add leeks , onions and potatoes and stir
3. Cover saucepan and sweat veg for 10-15 minutes
4. Add stock and milk and bring to boil
5. Replace lid and simmer for 20 minutes
6. Blend the soup and return to the saucepan
7. Season and add cream to taste

title: hot corn salad
steps:
1. In a skillet , fry green pepper and onion till tender
2. Add corn , tomato , salt and pepper
3. Mix well and lower heat
4. Cover and cook from 5 to 10 minutes till good and hot , stirring once or twice

title: frostbite
steps:
1. Add all ingredients to a cocktail shaker filled with ice
2. Shake vigorously
3. Strain into a chilled cocktail glass

title: barefoot contessa s linguine with shrimp scampi
steps:
1. Drizzle some oil in a large pot of boiling salted water , add 1 tablespoon of salt and the linguine , and cook for 7 to 10 minutes , or according to the directions on the package
2. Meanwhile , in another large , heavy-bottomed pan , melt the butter and olive oil over medium-low heat
3. Add the garlic
4. Saute for 1 minute
5. Be careful , the garlic burns easily !
6. Add the shrimp , 1 1 / 2 teaspoons of salt , and the pepper and saute until the shrimp have just turned pink , about 5 minutes , stirring often
7. Remove from the heat , add the parsley , lemon zest , lemon juice , lemon slices , and red pepper flakes
8. Toss to combine
9. When the pasta is done , drain the cooked linguine and then put it back in the pot
10. Immediately add the shrimp and sauce , toss well , and serve

title: cincinnati turkey chili
steps:
1. Place all ingredients , except turkey and spaghetti in a heavy large pot
2. Stir until smooth
3. Bring to a boil , reduce heat and simmer 60 minutes or until thick
4. Brown ground turkey and add to large pot
5. Stir gently and simmer an additional 20 minutes , stirring frequently
6. While sauce simmers , cook spaghetti according to package instructions and drain well
7. Serve chili over spaghetti
8. If desired , serve with additional onions and shredded cheese

title: roasted tomato soup with parmesan wafers
steps:
1. Put oven rack in middle position and preheat to 350f
2. Arrange tomatoes , cut sides up , in 1 layer in a large shallow baking pan and add garlic to pan
3. Drizzle tomatoes with oil and sprinkle with salt and pepper
4. Roast tomatoes and garlic 1 hour , then cool in pan on a rack
5. Peel garlic
6. Cook onion , oregano , and sugar in butter in a 6- to 8-quart heavy pot over moderately low heat , stirring frequently , until onion is softened , about 5 minutes
7. Add tomatoes , garlic , and stock and simmer , covered , 20 minutes
8. Pure soup in batches in a blender , then force through a sieve into cleaned pot , discarding solids
9. Stir in cream and salt and pepper to taste and simmer 2 minutes
10. Divide soup among 8 bowls and float 1 wafer in center of each

title: apple apricot smoothie
steps: 1. Place all ingredients in a blender and puree until smooth

title: another spinach salad
steps:
1. Microwave dressing until sugar dissolves
2. Cool , add to taste and toss with spinach salad

title: indian curry rub
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients into a paste
2. Cut slashes into chicken of choice and cover in paste

title: chewy chocolate cookies
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f
2. Spray cookie sheet with cooking spray
3. In a large bowl combine flour , sugar , cocoa , baking soda and salt
4. Stir in corn syrup and egg whites until throughly blended
5. Drop dough by rounded teaspoonfuls , about 1 inch apart onto prepared sheets
6. Bake 7 to 9 minutes , or until set
7. Remove cookies to wire rack to cool completely

title: martha s blue ribbon sugar cookies   christmas
steps:
1. In a large mixing bowl , cream butter and sugar until well mixed
2. Add 2 eggs to the creamed mixture
3. Mix well
4. In another large bowl , mix sifted flour , baking powder and salt together
5. Add to creamed butter mixture
6. Mix well
7. Add in grated orange rind , and mix well
8. Make into a ball , and chill in bowl covered with saran wrap , for at least 2 hours , or overnight in the refrigerator
9. When ready to bake preheat the oven to 350
10. With a floured rolling pin , roll out the dough to about 1 / 4" thick on a very lightly floured surface
11. Make into desired shapes using cookie cutters
12. If you don't have cookie cutters , you can use the bottom of a glass instead
13. Brush off any excess flour before putting them on the cookie sheet , if there is any
14. Place cookies on ungreased cookie sheet about 2" apart
15. You may use parchment paper if you like
16. Bake for 8 minutes
17. Let cookies cool on wire racks
18. Decorate
19. Store in a covered plastic container , or cookie tin

title: jam buttons
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees f
2. With an electric mixer , beat butter , sugar , salt , orange zest and vanilla until well combined
3. Do not overmix
4. Beat in yolk
5. Sift the flour and add into the mixture until just combined
6. Scrape the bowl and mix again
7. Turn dough onto work surface and knead together until smooth
8. On a lightly floured surface , press the dough into a 1 / 2-inch thick patty
9. Dip a 1-inch round cutter into flour and cut out circles
10. Place cookies on an ungreased baking sheet at least 1 inch apart
11. Gather up scraps , form another patty and repeat until all the dough is used up
12. Using your thumb or the end of a large wooden spoon , make an impression in the center of each cookie without going through
13. Fill each impression with about 1 / 4 teaspoons jam
14. Bake for 22 minutes or just until the jam bubbles
15. Let the cookies cool on a baking sheet for 20 minutes , then cool completely on wire rack

title: wasabi aioli
steps: 1. Stir all ingredients together and serve

title: cindy s zuchinni casserole
steps:
1. Parboil zuchinni
2. Brown beef with the onions
3. Layer in the order listed above in a 9 x 13" pan
4. Bake at 350 for 45 mn

title: orange tiger martini
steps:
1. Place chopped apricots , brown sugar , 1 ounce of the grand marnier and 5 tablespoons of the orange juice in a small pot over low heat and simmer until thick and syrupy , stirring frequently
2. About 8-10 minutes for the apricot flavor to infuse the simple syrup
3. Strain syrup mixture pressing with the back of a spoon to release all the liquid
4. In a cocktail shaker filled with ice combine syrup solution with whipping cream , coconut milk , rums , remaining 1 / 2 ounce of grand marnier and 3 ounces of fresh squeezed orange juice
5. Add a dash of bitters
6. Vigorously shake and strain into a martini glass
7. Serve
8. Yum !

title: duck filled beggar s purses
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Roast the duck: score fatty skin on duck breasts and place on roasting pan , fat side up
3. Roast in preheated oven 30 minutes
4. When cool , discard the skin , bones and fat
5. Reduce oven temperature to 350 degrees
6. Make the filling: chop the meat finely
7. In a large bowl , combine chopped duck with cranberries , raisins , rosemary , salt and pepper
8. Prepare the chives: blanch chives for 3 minutes in boiling water
9. Drain and plunge into ice water
10. Drain and let dry
11. Assembly: place one sheet of phyllo dough on a clean surface
12. Cover remaining dough with damp dish towel
13. Brush dough with butter , then top with another sheet of phyllo
14. Brush with butter and repeat until you have four layers
15. Cut the phyllo into six squares
16. Place tablespoon of filling in center of each square
17. Pull corners to the center , pinching dough in center to close over filling
18. Tie each bundle with a single chive
19. Snip dough one inch above the chive ribbon so all tops are even
20. Bake the purses: place the purses on baking sheets and bake in 350-degree
21. Oven for 10 to 15 minutes until golden brown

title: hot asian noodles with broccoli
steps:
1. Cook pasta as package directs , adding broccoli for the last 6 minutes
2. Put peanut butter , soy sauce , vinegar , garlic and crushed red pepper flakes in a medium bowl
3. Drain pasta and broccoli , reserving 1 / 2 cup cooking liquid
4. Return pasta to pot
5. Add reserved cooking liquid to peanut butter mixture , stir until smooth
6. Then add to pasta
7. Toss to mix and coat
8. Top with carrots and scallions and toss again

title: french onion jambalaya
steps:
1. Heat oil in skillet
2. Add the chicken , sausage , and garlic and brown over medium heat
3. Remove drippings from pan
4. Turn heat to high , add the soup , salsa , and cayenne and bring to a boil
5. Stir in the rice , cover , lower heat and simmer for about 20 minutes or until rice is to desired texture
6. Stir in the shrimp and peas , re-cover , season to taste with salt and pepper , and cook for 5 minutes

title: asian hot and sour chicken soup
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan combine the chicken broth , mushrooms , bamboo shoots , sliced ginger , garlic , soy sauce and chili flakes
2. Bring to a boil , reduce heat to low and simmer while you assemble the other ingredients
3. Place the chicken strips in a bowl and toss with the sesame oil
4. In another bowl stir together the cornstarch and vinegar
5. Set aside
6. Increase the broth heat to medium-high and return to a full boil
7. Add in the coated chicken slices and return to a boil again , then drizzle in the egg while stirring slowly to create long strands of egg
8. Stir in the vinegar / cornstarch mixture
9. Simmer over medium heat stirring occasionally until the chicken is cooked through and the broth has thickened slightly
10. Garnish the top with chopped green onions
11. Delicious !

title: mixed greens with raspberry walnut dressing
steps:
1. Whisk together raspberry preserves , oil , vinegar , and dijon mustard
2. Season , to taste , with salt and black pepper
3. Arrange lettuce on salad plates
4. Top lettuce with dressing and walnuts just before serving
5. My
6. Much easier and quicker than trying to whisk
7. Or if you are down to the last little bit of preserves in your jar - just add ingredients to the jar , seal and shake
8. I also add a couple of tablespoons of water to it as well to kind of thin it out
9. I usually make it in the morning or the night before and have it ready to go by dinner time
10. I also sometimes add a sprinkle of feta cheese as well

title: cherry buttermilk clafoutis
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 375&deg
2. F grease a 9-inch pie pan with unsalted butter
3. Sprinkle with 1 tablespoon of the sugar
4. Arrange the cherries in a single layer on the bottom of the pan
5. Set aside
6. In a bowl , whisk together the eggs , buttermilk , remaining sugar , almond flour , brown rice flour , vanilla , ginger , and salt until smooth
7. Pour evenly over the fruit
8. Bake for about 50 minutes , until golden brown around the edges and set in the center
9. Test by inserting a toothpick in the centerif it comes out clean , the clafoutis is ready
10. Allow to cool slightly , then dust with confectioners sugar and serve

title: fantastic double chocolate pecan biscotti
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees
2. Butter and flour a large baking / cookie sheet
3. In a small bowl whisk together flour , cocoa powder , baking soda and salt
4. In another large bowl with an electric mixer beat together 1 / 4 cup plus 2 tablespoons softened butter with 1-1 / 4 cups sugar until light and fluffy
5. Add in eggs and beat until well combined
6. Stir in flour mixture to form a stiff dough
7. Stir in chopped pecans and mini chocolate chips
8. Mix to combine
9. Divide the dough in half or you can make 4 smaller logs for easier handing and cutting if desired)
10. On the greased baking sheet , shape into two slightly flattened logs
11. Sprinkle with confectioners sugar
12. Bake logs for 35 minutes or until slightly firm to the touch
13. Cool the logs on the baking sheet for 5 minutes , then remove logs to a cutting board
14. Cut the logs diagonally into about 3 / 4-inch slices
15. Place back on the baking sheet
16. Return to oven and bake for about another 7-10 minutes
17. Cool on a rack

title: trout stuffed with couscous  almonds and herbs
steps:
1. Heat 2 tablespoons of the oil in a frying pan , add the onion and fry until softened , adding the garlic toward the end
2. Stir in the couscous , fish or vegetable stock , parsley and mint
3. Bring to a boil , then remove the pan from the heat and leave for 10-15 minutes , or until the liquid has been absorbed
4. Preheat oven to 400f
5. Season the trout with salt and pepper and fill the cavity of each with one-fourth of the couscous mixture
6. Lay the fish in a greased shallow baking dish
7. Mix the remaining oil with the almonds and spoon over the fish
8. Bake for 15-20 minutes , or until the fish flakes when tested with a fork

title: indian spiced eggplant  aubergine
steps:
1. Preheat broiler
2. Trim ends off eggplant and cut into 1 / 4" thick rounds
3. Spray cookie sheet with cooking oil
4. Place eggplant on cookie sheet and spray with cooking oil
5. Broil eggplant until tender and browned , about 3-5 minutes per side
6. Set aside
7. In a small bowl , combine the first 7 spices
8. In a large frying pan , heat the olive oil over medium heat
9. Add spice mixture and cook , stirring constantly , for about 30 seconds
10. Quickly add the onion and saute until soft and translucent , about 5 minutes
11. Add the tomato sauce or halved cherry tomatoes , molasses , garlic and vinegar
12. Cook the sauce , stirring occasionally , until thickened , about 5 minutes
13. Season with salt and pepper
14. Transfer eggplant to serving dish and pour sauce over
15. Top with chopped cilantro

title: easy egg salad with cream cheese
steps:
1. Place eggs in cold water in a pot
2. The eggs should just be covered by the water
3. Bring to a boil and let simmer for 10 minutes
4. Drain and rinse eggs with cold water for a minute or so
5. Peel the eggs and place in a bowl with the cream cheese
6. Mash using a fork until your egg salad has reached the consistency you prefer
7. I like to leave some larger chunks
8. Add the dill , salt and pepper and sun-dried tomato pieces
9. Mix and enjoy

title: spicy corn
steps:
1. Grill corn to desired doneness , i like mine charred a little
2. And cut from cob
3. Melt butter in skillet and brown onion , bell pepper , jalapeno and half of basil
4. When onions and pepper are tender , add corn and heat all the way through
5. Mix in remaining basil

title: lemon lemony pecan cookies
steps:
1. Combine butter and sugar until fluffy
2. Add beaten egg , lemon juice , lemon rind and lemon extract
3. Mix well
4. Combine flour , baking powder and salt
5. Add to creamed mixture , beating until just blended
6. Stir in pecans
7. Shape dough into a long roll , 2 inches in diameter
8. Wrap in waxed paper and chill 2 to 3 hours or until firm
9. Unwrap roll and cut into 1 / 4 inch slices
10. Place on a lightly greased cookie sheet
11. Bake in a 350 degree oven for 10 to 12 minutes
12. Do not overbake

title: california seafood make ahead brunch bake
steps:
1. Grease a 9x13" casserole and set aside
2. Melt butter and saute mushrooms and onions until tender , stirring frequently
3. Add shrimp and cook until pink , stirring often
4. Spread 3 slices of the bread with the pesto sauce , then top each with another bread slice , pressing together so thick stick
5. Cut pesto sandwiches into small cubes and layer half of them in the bottom of the baking dish
6. Sprinkle half of the cheese on top , then pour all of the mushrooms on top , then the crabmeat and the artichokes
7. Top with remaining bread cubes , then sprinkle the rest of the cheese on top
8. Beat eggs , add milk , salt , and cayene pepper
9. Beat well
10. Pour wet mixture over the bread mixture , covering evenly
11. You may need to poke some some parts of the bread to get them wet- you want everything to be moistened with the egg mixture
12. Cover and chill overnight
13. Heat oven to 350 f , remove cover , and bake casserole for about 35-40 minutes , or until a knife inserted in the center comes out clean
14. Let rest 5 miutes before slicing to firm up and cool slightly
15. Cut into 12 squares

title: mexican flan
steps:
1. Caramel
2. Put the sugar and water in a small saucepan and stir over low heat until the sugar dissolves
3. Bring to the boil and cook until golden
4. Pour into an 18cm sandwich pan or 6 individual moulds
5. Rotate the pan or moulds until the caramel coats the sides and base
6. Set aside
7. Heat the evaporated milk and fresh milk with the split vanilla pod - but don't boil
8. Remove from the heat and let stand for 5 minutes
9. Beat the eggs and sugar together until blended
10. Pour the egg / sugar mix slowly into the milk , stirring constantly
11. Remove the vanilla pod and pour the filling into the caramel lined pan or moulds
12. Put the custard into a baking dish with hot water to come halfway up the sides
13. Bake in a moderately warm oven 160c for 25 minutes or 45 minutes - or until a knife inserted in the centre comes out clean
14. Cool , then chill for a few hours or overnight
15. Unmould on to a serving dish or individual plates
16. Serve with pouring cream

title: tomato pattypan squash salad
steps:
1. Cook squash in a large saucepan , covered , in enough lightly salted boiling water to cover until tender , about 5 minutes
2. Drain
3. Cool vegsetables by adding cold water and ice cubes to pan
4. Drain well
5. Combine the drained squash , tomatoes and herbs in a serving bowl
6. Add lettuce of choice if desired
7. In a screw top jar , combine remaining ingredients
8. Cover and shake well
9. Add half to salad
10. Toss to coat
11. Season to taste with additional salt and pepper , if desired
12. Pass the remaining dressing enjoy !

title: double or triple coconut muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f either grease 10 muffin cups with butter or coconut oil , or line them with papers
2. In a small saucepan , warm your coconut oil just until it melts
3. Or use your microwave on defrost setting 10 seconds at a time
4. It should still be on the cool side
5. Don't over heat
6. On a hot day mine will liquefy on its own
7. In a medium bowl , whisk together your flours , baking powder and salt
8. Stir 1 / 2 cup shredded coconut
9. In a separate bowl , whisk together egg , sugar , coconut oil , yogurt and vanilla
10. Stir into dry ingredients until just combined
11. Divide batter among prepared muffin cups then sprinkle the top with remaining 1 / 4 cup coconut , about 1 to 2 teaspoons on each
12. Bake until a tester inserted into the center comes out batter-free , about 20 minutes
13. Transfer muffins to a rack and let cool

title: pumpkin bread pudding with raisin nut bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees
2. Butter sides and bottom of 13x9" baking pan
3. Butter one side of each bread slice and layer in pan alternately with croissants
4. In large bowl with an electric mixer set on med-high speed , beat eggs until slightly thickened , about 5 min
5. Add sugar and vanilla and beat at med
6. Speed until thoroughly combined
7. Reduce speed to low and add cream
8. Mix until smooth
9. Pour egg-cream mixture over bread and croissant slices
10. The slices will absorb egg-cream mixture slowly , so continue adding liquid until all is in pan
11. In small bowl combine cinnamon , nutmeg and 1 / 8 teaspoon sugar
12. Sprinkle sugar-spice mixture over the bread pudding
13. Fill a baking pan larger than the 13x9" bread pudding pan halfway up with hot water
14. Place in oven , set bread pudding pan in the water bath
15. Bake 45-50 min
16. Or until custard is set
17. When set , remove the bread pudding from the oven , and discard water in larger pan
18. Cool to room temperature
19. Refrigerate for 2 hours or until firm

title: seafood gourmet
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. In butter , saute the onions , bell pepper and celery until tender
3. In large bowl , mix cooked rice and the cooked onions , bell pepper and celery
4. Mix in grated cheese
5. Thoroughly combine soup with half-and-half , and add to the rice mixture
6. Now , very gently fold in the seafood , so as not to break up the crab meat too much , you want lumps of it in there , so stir as little as possible
7. Pour into buttered lasagna pan
8. Sprinkle with toasted almond slices
9. Bake in 350f oven 35-40 minutes
10. Let stand about 10 minutes before serving

title: easy steak nuggets
steps:
1. Cut steak into 1 / 2 inch cubes
2. Mix bread crumbs and seasonings together in bowl
3. Dip cut steak into water to moisten and then coat it with the breadcrumb mixture
4. Place on lightly greased cooking sheet
5. Continue with the rest of steak
6. Place into oven at 400 degrees for about 15 minutes
7. Check for doneness and serve-- very simple but very good

title: crispy healthy raisin bran breakfast cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Coat baking sheets with non-stick spray
3. In a medium bowl , combine bran , raisins , nuts , and cornflakes
4. In a large bowl , mix together sugar , flour , cinnamon , nutmeg , baking powder , and baking soda
5. Add bran mixture to flour mixture
6. Mix well
7. Add yogurt , oil , and vanilla
8. Mix well
9. Drop by heaping teaspoons onto cookie sheets
10. They don't spread so you can either drop them close together or flatten them , but however they go in is the same shape they come out
11. Lower oven temperature to 350f before putting cookies inches
12. Bake for 15 minutes
13. Take cookies out of oven
14. Turn cookie over and bake for 10 more minutes
15. Turn oven off
16. If cookies aren't crispy yet , return to oven until crispy

title: basic vegetable fettuccini
steps:
1. Chop the broccoli and cauliflower and put into boiling water for 10 minutes
2. Heat the olive oil in a skillet and add the zucchini , onion and carrots
3. Sautee the vegetables for 10 minutes and add the broccoli and cauliflower
4. Add the onion soup mix and evaporated milk , let cook for 5 minutes over medium heat
5. Add the cheese and milk and cook for another 5 minutes , until cheese is melted through
6. As this cooks fry the bacon
7. Serve the vegetable mixture over noodles and crumble the cooked bacon on top

title: lemon dill pesto
steps:
1. Place walnuts and garlic in a food processor and process until finely chopped
2. Add the dill , lemon zest , and salt
3. Process until you have a thick paste
4. Continue to process while gradually adding the oil until the pesto is the consistency of a thick tomato sauce
5. Refrigerate until ready to use

title: healthy date   walnut fruit loaf  no butter oil egg
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Lightly grease a 9x5 inch loaf pan
3. In a large bowl , combine ingredients a and soak for 15 minutes
4. In another bowl , combine ingredients b and mix well
5. In a separate bowl , sieve flour and baking soda
6. Ensure baking soda is not lumpy
7. Add in soft brown sugar
8. Mix well and put aside
9. Add ingredients b to ingredients a
10. Mix well
11. Then add ingredients c and mix well
12. Pour batter into the prepared loaf pan
13. Bake in preheated oven for 50 - 55 minutes , or until a toothpick inserted into the center of the loaf comes out clean
14. Let the loaf cool in the tin for at least 5 minutes , then turn out onto a cooling rack to cool completely

title: maple walnut apple crisp
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Lightly spoon flour into a dry measuring cup
3. Level with a knife
4. Combine flour , sugar , oats , and 1 / 4 teaspoon cinnamon in a medium bowl
5. Cut in butter with a pastry blender or 2 knives until mixture is crumbly
6. Stir in walnuts
7. Combine apple and remaining ingredients in a large bowl
8. Toss well
9. Spoon apple mixture into an 8-inch square baking dish or 1 1 / 2-quart casserole
10. Sprinkle with crumb mixture
11. Bake at 375 for 45 minutes or until golden brown
12. Serve warm

title: roasted red onions with blue cheese nut butter
steps:
1. Make blue cheese and walnut butter: combine butter and cheese
2. Stir in nuts and pepper
3. Scrap onto plastic wrap
4. Shape into 6-inch log
5. Wrap and chill until firm , 1 hour
6. Heat oven to 425 degrees
7. Peel onions and brush lightly with oil
8. Place in shallow 11x7-inch baking pan
9. Cover with foil and bake 30 minutes
10. Uncover and brush with pan juices
11. Bake uncovered until tender when pierced with skewer , 25-30 minutes
12. Cut 10 slices from the blue cheese butter
13. Place 1 slice on each onion
14. Cover and keep warm
15. Serve alongside entree

title: lemon basil chicken schnitzel
steps:
1. Combine crumbs , cheese and seasonings in a shallow dish
2. In a large dish beat egg with lemon juice
3. Dip chicken pieces in egg mixture
4. Roll in crumb mixture and pat to ensure even layer of crumbs
5. Place on rack or wax paper
6. Heat butter and oil together in frying pan over medium heat
7. Add several peices of chicken at a time but do not crowd
8. Cook until golden on both sides , about 5 minutes per side
9. Remove to serving platter
10. Brown any remaining chicken pieces
11. Return all chicken to the pan
12. Cover and cook for 2 minutes more or until chicken feels springy to the touch

title: portabella panini with gorgonzola cheese and sun dried tomatoes
steps:
1. Reconstitute the sun-dried tomatoes by soaking them in boiling water for 10 minutes
2. Remove the tomatoes from the water and chop them
3. Slice the stems off of the mushrooms so they can lay completely flat
4. Slice each cap in half so you have 8 round mushroom slices
5. Top half of the mushrooms with 1 tablespoon of tomatoes and 1 tablespoon of cheese
6. Top with remaining mushroom slices
7. Brush the top side of each "sandwich" with olive oil
8. Preheat a large , nonstick skillet or grill pan
9. Place the mushroom sandwiches in the pan carefully , oil side down , and cook for 2 minutes
10. Brush the top half with oil , flip , and cook for 2 minutes more
11. Season with salt and pepper , to taste , and serve

title: almond poppy seed pound cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325f lightly grease a 8 1 / 2 by 4 1 / 2 loaf pan
2. In a bowl , mix the flour , baking soda , and salt and set aside
3. In another bowl beat together the butter , sugar , vanilla , and almond extract until light and fluffy
4. Add the eggs one at a time beating well after each addition , until just blended
5. Sprinkle half the four mixture into the egg mixture and stir until just incorporated
6. Stir in the sour cream , then sprinkle in the rest of the flour mixture
7. Add the poppy filling until just incorporated
8. Pour the batter into prepared pan and tap
9. Bake until toothpick inserted in the middle comes out clean , about 70 minutes , or longer if using a metal pan
10. Let cool 15 minutes
11. Run a knife around the inside of the pan , invert the cake onto a wire rack , and lift off the pan
12. Serve warm or at room temperature

title: lemon jam slices
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 375f lightly grease two baking sheets
2. Beat together the soft butter , sugar , salt , vanilla extract , and lemon powder until fluffy
3. Scrape the bottom and sides of the bowl , and beat in the egg yolk
4. Mix in the baking powder and flour until well blended
5. Divide the dough into four pieces
6. Roll each piece into a log about 12" long and 1" in diameter
7. Place two logs on each prepared baking sheet , leaving several inches between them
8. Use the handle of a wooden spoon or a dowel to make a shallow trench down the center of each log
9. Fill the well with a generous tablespoonful of jam per log , using a pastry bag with a round
10. Bake the cookie logs for 15 to 20 minutes , until they're set and lightly browned around the edges
11. Remove them from the oven , let them cool for 3 minutes , then slice on the diagonal into 1" pieces
12. As the cookies cool , make the glaze: sift together sugar and lemon powder
13. Heat butter and milk together until the butter is melted , then add to the sugar mixture
14. Beat until smooth
15. Drizzle the glaze over the cooled cookies

title: chipotle marinade for grilling
steps:
1. Add all ingredients into the work bowl of a food processor
2. Process until pureed
3. Transfer mixture to a ziploc bag then add meat of choice
4. Marinade 24 hours
5. Very important: this marinade contains no salt
6. Season with salt the marinated meat to taste before grilling

title: pork tenderloin mango tango
steps:
1. Pork: whisk juice , syrup & mustard in a glass measure until smooth and set aside
2. Pat tenderloins dry & sprinkle all over with salt & pepper
3. Heat oil in a heavy , oven-proof skillet over medium heat
4. Add tenderloins and cook for 4 to 6 minutes , turning often , until golden brown on all sides
5. Drizzle mango mixture over each tenderloin , dividing evenly and transfer the skillet to the middle rack of a preheated 400f oven for 20 to 25 minutes , basting every 5 minutes , until juices are no longer pink inside
6. Remove tenderloins to a cutting board , cover loosely with foil and let rest for 10 minutes
7. Slice very thinly
8. Salsa: combine all ingredients in a glass measure
9. Serve with pork

title: kittencal s greek moussaka
steps:
1. Grease a 9 x 9-inch baking pan although you could use a 13 x 9 pan using a smaller pan will result in a thicker casserole
2. Peel the eggplants then slice 1 / 4-inch thick
3. Brush cookie sheet with olive oil
4. Coat each side of sliced eggplant with olive oil then season slices with salt and freshly ground pepper
5. Place the eggplant slices on cookie sheet
6. Broil under the broiler until brown
7. Turn and broil the other side , brushing with oil if needed
8. Repeat with all eggplant slices
9. In the bottom of the prepared baking dish arrange half of the eggplant slices
10. In a large skillet , combine beef and onions
11. Cook stirring until the beef is no longer pink and the onions are soft
12. Drain fat
13. Add in the garlic , tomato sauce , oregano , 1 / 2 tsp salt and black pepper to taste
14. Pour mixture over eggplant slices
15. Arrange the remaining eggplant slices over the beef mixture
16. Prepare the cheese sauce: melt the butter in a saucepan , whisk in flour , 1 / 2 tsp salt and pepper to taste
17. Gradually stir in half and half or milk , cook and stir over medium heat until thick and bubbly
18. In a small bowl , beat egg
19. Stir in some of the hot sauce , then add egg to sauce mixture , mix well
20. Add in parmesan cheese , and stir again
21. Pour the cheese sauce over mixture in baking dish
22. Bake in a preheated 350 degree f oven for 45 minutes
23. Cut into squares

title: dried fruit compote with rum
steps:
1. Divide the dried fruits among 6 pint jars , filling them just over half full
2. Add half of a sliced lemon to each jar
3. Mix honey & rum & fill jars , but leaving a 3 / 4" space at the top
4. Cover tightly & store at room temperature at least 30 days before using

title: vincent van gogh cocktail
steps:
1. Shake &
2. Strain into a large shot glass

title: cheesecake kugel
steps:
1. In a large mixing bowl , combine the cheese , sour cream , milk and half of the melted butter
2. Beat the eggs together with the sugar and vanilla and add to the cheese mixture
3. Add the cooked noodles and the raisins
4. Turn into a large buttered pan or into two smaller ones
5. Top with the remaining melted butter
6. Mix the cinnamon and sugar together and sprinkle on top
7. Bake at 180 degrees celsius for approximately one hour or until lightly browned
8. May be frozen and reheated

title: sardines and tomatoes over spaghetti squash
steps:
1. Bisect the spaghetti squash lengthwise
2. Remove the seeds and place half the squash face down on a plate and microwave for about 6 minutes
3. While the squash cooks , place everything else in a saucepan and bring to a boil then simmer
4. Break the sardines into small chunks with a spoon
5. When the squash is done , grab it with a towel , hold vertically over a plate or platter and scrape the strands of squash out with a fork
6. Pour the sardine-tomato-spice mixture over the mountain of squash and enjoy !

title: indian khatte chole  hot and sour chickpeas
steps:
1. Heat oil , keep about 2 tbsp of the onion aside and fry the rest over medium heat for about 4-5 minutes , until tinged brown
2. Add the tomatoes , cook for another 5 minutes , until soft
3. Stir frequently , mashing the tomatoes to a pulp
4. Stir in coriander , cumin , fenugreek , and cinnamon
5. Add the chickpeas
6. Add salt to taste
7. Cover and simmer for 15-20 minutes , stirring occasionally
8. Add some water if the mixture becomes too dry
9. Meanwhile mix together the chillies , ginger , lemon juice , cilantro , and remaining onion
10. Just before serving , and the ginger and onion mixture
11. Mix well

title: cheesy beef   n biscuit casserole
steps:
1. Brown ground beef , onion and green pepper
2. Drain
3. Stir tomato sauce , chili powder and garlic salt
4. Simmer while preparing dough
5. Separate biscuit dough into 10 biscuits
6. Pull each apart into 2 layers
7. Press 10 biscuit layers over bottom of ungreased 9 inch baking pan
8. Combine 1 / 2 cup cheese , sour cream and egg
9. Mix well
10. Remove meat mixture from heat
11. Stir in sour cream mixture
12. Spoon over biscuits
13. Arrange remaining biscuit layers on top
14. Sprinkle with remaining cheese
15. Bake at 375 degrees for 30 to 35 minutes or until biscuits are a deep golden brown

title: all purpose cornbread  best of both regions
steps:
1. Adjust oven rack to middle position
2. Heat oven to 400 degrees
3. Spray 8-inch-square baking dish with nonstick cooking spray
4. Whisk flour , cornmeal , baking powder , baking soda , and salt in medium bowl until combined
5. Set aside
6. In food processor or blender , process brown sugar , thawed corn kernels , and buttermilk until combined , about 5 seconds
7. Add eggs and process until well combined , about 5 seconds longer
8. Using rubber spatula , make well in center of dry ingredients
9. Pour wet ingredients into well
10. Begin folding dry ingredients into wet , giving mixture only a few turns to barely combine
11. Add melted butter and continue folding until dry ingredients are just moistened
12. Pour batter into prepared baking dish
13. Smooth surface with rubber spatula
14. Bake until deep golden brown and toothpick inserted in center comes out clean , 25 to 35 minutes
15. Cool on wire rack 10 minutes
16. Invert cornbread onto wire rack , then turn right side up and continue to cool for about 10 minutes longer
17. Cut into pieces and serve

title: peppered cod
steps:
1. Coarsely crack the peppercorns
2. Lightly salt the fish fillets then roll them in the cracked pepper
3. Heat the oil in a frying pan and brown the fillets on all sides for 3 minutes , or until just cooked through
4. [take care not to over cook
5. If necessary cook each fillet at a time , try not to steam the fish by overcrowding the pan]
6. Serve with a salad , pasta or crusty bread on the side

title: chicken floating in curried coconut soup
steps:
1. Saute the boneless , skinless chicken breasts in sesame oil , over medium high heat , until they are golden brown
2. Remove the chicken from the pan , cool , slice thinly and put in refrigerator until needed
3. To a pot add the coconut milk and chicken stock , mix well
4. Add all the remaining ingredients , except for the garnish
5. Allow to simmer for 15 minutes then add the chicken to the soup
6. Now simmer for another 15 minutes , then pour the soup into bowls and garnish with thai basil or cilantro

title: grapefruit banana smash
steps:
1. Mash banana and beat into grapefruit juice
2. Sweeten to taste and chill until ready to serve

title: chocolate filled graham cracker treats  kid friendly
steps:
1. Break graham crackers in half to form squares
2. Spread half of squares with frosting and then top with remaining squares

title: benihana hibachi chateaubriand
steps:
1. Melt 1 / 2 cup plus the 2 tsp of butter along with the crushed garlic in a sauce pan
2. Add parsley , lemon juice and season with salt and pepper
3. Pour into a small container and refrigerate til solid
4. When ready to cook , trim beef tenderloin of unnecessary fat
5. The tenderloin should be about 1 inch thick , so if it's too thick , pound to flatten
6. Melt 2 tablespoons of prepared butter and coat over the surface of the meat
7. Season with black pepper
8. Preheat grill
9. Place the tenderloin on hot grill and sear on each side for about 4 minutes
10. Reduce heat and continue grilling until it reaches the desired doneness
11. Remove from grill and slice into 1 / 2 inch thick slices
12. Serve garnished with watercress and the butter mixture

title: greyhound in the pink
steps:
1. Prepare the rim of a tall glass that has been just taken out of the freezer , by rubbing it with a slice of lime and then spinning it on a plate full of sugar
2. Place ice , grapefruit slices , and cherries in glass
3. I add about 1 tablespoon sugar over the ice cubes but i like this sweet
4. Add 1-2 ounces vodka and fill to the rim with the grapefruit juice
5. Stirr lightly to mix the liquids
6. Add a straw and garnish with a slice of lime on the rim

title: samhain legendary oven hash
steps:
1. In frying pan , combine and cook beef , potatoes , onion , parsley , and worcestershire sauce , and evaporated milk
2. Remove from heat and turn out into a 1 qt casserole dish
3. Mix bread crumbs with melted butter and sprinkle on top
4. Bake in oven at 350f for 30 minutes

title: herb seasoned squash bake
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees
2. In a saucepan over medium heat , boil the squash and onion in salted water for 5 minutes
3. Drain well
4. Combine the squash , chicken soup , and sour cream
5. Toss the stuffing mix with butter , sage , and onion powder
6. Butter a 2 quart casserole dish
7. Layer half the stuffing in the bottom
8. Sprinkle half the cheese over the stuffing
9. Spread the squash over the cheese and top with remaining cheese and then the remaining stuffing
10. Bake for 30-40 minutes

title: fresh broccoli gratin
steps:
1. Steam fresh broccoli to tender-crisp , 5-6 minutes
2. Spray shallow 1 1 / 2 qt casserole dish with cooking spray
3. Place steamed broccoli in casserole dish
4. Sprinkle parmesan and cheddar cheeses over evenly
5. In separate bowl , stir together sour cream , milk , and cornstarch until smooth
6. Pour over broccoli-cheese mixture
7. Sprinkle with salt and pepper
8. Sprinkle bread crumbs
9. Bake in 375-degree oven until milk mixture is thickened and crumbs are golden brown , about 20-30 minutes
10. Cover after 10-15 minutes if needed to prevent over-browning of crumbs
11. This is not rocket science ! you can adjust amounts , oven temperature , and baking-time as needed

title: skillet slaw for two
steps:
1. Fry bacon till crisp
2. Drain and reserve drippings
3. Add onion to drippings and cook 2 minutes
4. Stir in vinegar , water , sugar , salt , and pepper
5. Bring just to boiling
6. Add cabbage and apple
7. Toss to coat
8. Cover and cook over medium heat 5 minutes or until cabbage wilts
9. Stir in sour cream and sprinkle with crumbled bacon

title: retro orange kiss me cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease and flour a 13-by-9-inch pan
3. Squeeze orange , reserving 1 / 3 cup juice for topping
4. Remove seeds
5. In blender container , food processor bowl with metal blade , or food mill , grind orange peel and pulp , raisins and 1 / 3 cup walnuts
6. Set aside
7. In a large bowl , combine flour and all remaining cake ingredients at low speed until moistened
8. Beat 3 minutes at medium speed
9. Stir in orange-raisin mixture
10. Pour into prepared pan
11. Bake for 35 to 45 minutes , or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean
12. Drizzle reserved 1 / 3 cup orange juice over warm cake in pan
13. In a small bowl , combine 1 / 3 cup sugar and cinnamon
14. Mix well
15. Stir in 1 / 4 cup walnuts
16. Sprinkle over cake
17. Cool 1 hour , or until completely cooled
18. Time does not include cooling time

title: greek polpetes  potato cakes
steps:
1. In large pot , boil the potatoes until soft
2. Do not salt the water until ready to mash the potatoes with the other ingredients
3. While still warm , mash the potatoes with the feta cheese , green onion , red onion , dill , mint , egg , lemon juice , salt and pepper
4. Taste the mixture first before adding the salt because feta itself is quite salty
5. Place the potato mixture in the refrigerator to firm up
6. Refrigerate potato mixture until ready to fry
7. Divide the potato mixture into little balls approximately 3 / 4"-1" in diameter
8. Flatten the balls slightly and dredge in flour
9. Heat the olive oil in the pan and fry up the cakes until golden brown on both sides
10. Drain on paper towel
11. Serve warm
12. I like to drizzle extra lemon juice on top of the potato cakes
13. Yield is not known
14. Serving is estimated

title: sweet texas caviar
steps:
1. Rinse the canned items
2. Chop the veggies
3. Mix everything together and let marinade 2 or more hours
4. Serve on fritos'scoops'
5. This dip is great for parties as it can sit out for several hours without refrigeration

title: asian shrimp and ginger fritters with sweet chili dipping sauce
steps:
1. Shrimp and ginger fritters: place the breadcrumbs and coconut milk together in a bowl , and set aside
2. Place the shrimp meat , ginger , cilantro , egg and fish sauce into a food processor bowl , and pulse until the mixture is combined
3. It is important not to over-mix or otherwise it will turn into a paste !
4. Add the breadcrumbs , which by now should have absorbed all the coconut milk , and pulse until just blended
5. Heat the vegetable oil over high heat , or to 350 degrees f in a deep-fryer
6. Drop rounded tablespoons of the mixture into the hot oil , and cook until golden brown on all sides , about 2 minutes
7. Do this in batches
8. As the fritters cook , remove from the oil with a slotted spoon , drain on kitchen paper , and keep warm in a low oven
9. Sweet chili dipping sauce: place all ingredients in a blender and whizz until blended and sugar is dissolved
10. Serve in a small bowl to accompany the asian shrimp and ginger fritters

title: low fat sugarless blueberry squares
steps:
1. Preheat oven 350 degrees
2. Mix the flour , baking powder , and salt
3. In a separate container mix the fruit concentrate , milk and extract until blended well
4. Pour the liquid ingredients into flour mixture and mix until smooth
5. Don't overbeat
6. Place a 9 inch square baking pan in oven with the teaspoon of margarine until melted
7. Swirl the pan around until it coats pan
8. Pour batter into pan and sprinkle evenly with blueberries
9. Bake for about 30 to 40 minutes , or until golden brown
10. Mix the jam with the water
11. Heat until melted
12. Brush the top with the glaze when it comes out of the oven
13. Cut into 9 squares and serve warm
14. Fruit concentrate is a available at health food stores
15. Can also use cranberries , strawberries , or sliced peaches

title: cranberry banana breakfast drink
steps:
1. In blender place half the orange juice , bananas , cranberries , milk , sugar and ice cubes
2. Cover and blend
3. Pour into pitcher or chilled glasses
4. Repeat with remaining ingredients
5. Serve

title: balsamic roasted squash and vegetables
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425f
2. Bring water to boil in medium saucepan
3. Peel and cut squash into 2-3 inch chunks
4. Put onion , pepper blend and squash in a bowl and add garlic , spices and vinegar
5. Toss until all veggies are coated and let marinate 1 hour or overnight
6. Preheat oven to 425f
7. Place marinated veggies into baking dish , sprayed with cooking spray , and bake for 30 minutes , stirring every 15 minutes
8. Bring water to boil in medium saucepan
9. Add brussel sprouts and cook 5 minutes
10. Slice into halves or quarters depending on size of sprouts
11. After 30 minutes of roasting veggies , stir brussel sprouts and artichokes into mix and return to oven
12. Bake an additional 15 minutes or until squash is fork tender
13. Remove from oven and adjust seasonings with salt and pepper
14. To give a more intense flavor , toss with balsamic vinaigrette
15. Serve immediately

title: carnitas  mexican pork  my way  crock pot
steps:
1. Mix all of the spices together and sprinkle most on the roast , reserving about 1 tsp
2. Put the roast and water / broth in a crock pot on low for 6-8 hours
3. Now you can do 2 things here: remove the roast , drain the liquid , put the roast back in the crock , shred it with the remaining seasonings and about 1 / 2 cup of water and stir or
4. Remove a little of the liquid from the pot and shred the meat in the remaining liquid and taste and season if necessary
5. If i use a roast with a good amount of fat i usually drain it to drain off some of that grease , if it's lean then i use the liquid it cooked in
6. Serve it up ! it makes great burritos with all the fixins- including the beans and rice

title: chocolate layer cake with chocolate cream cheese frosting
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees
2. Butter and flour 3 cake pans
3. Cut 3 circles of waxed paper or parchment paper to fit the bottoms of the pans , then press them in
4. In a mixer fitted with a whisk attachment , cream the butter until smooth
5. Add the sugar and eggs and mix until fluffy , about 3 minutes
6. Add the vanilla , cocoa , baking soda and salt and mix
7. Add 1 / 2 of the flour , then 1 / 2 of the sour cream and mix
8. Repeat with the remaining flour and sour cream
9. Drizzle in the hot coffee and mix until smooth
10. The batter will be thin
11. Pour into the prepared pans and bake until the tops are firm to the touch and a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean , about 35 minutes
12. Halfway through the baking , quickly rotate the pans in the oven to ensure even baking , but otherwise try not to open the oven
13. Let cool in the pan 10 minutes
14. Turn out onto wire racks and let cool completely before frosting
15. Frosting:
16. In a mixer fitted with a paddle attachment , cream the butter and cream cheese together until smooth
17. Drizzle in the melted chocolate and mix
18. Add the coffee and vanilla and mix
19. Add the sugar , 1 cup at a time , mixing after each addition
20. Mix until well blended and fluffy
21. To frost the cake , use a spatula to cover 2 of the cake layers with frosting
22. Stack them together
23. Flip the third cake layer over and rest it on the top to create a very flat top for the cake
24. Frost on the sides and top
25. Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve

title: isreals pie yummy
steps:
1. Saute onion and green pepper in pan
2. Add ground beef and cook until no long pink
3. Drain
4. Put onion / green pepper / hamburger in the bottom of the bread pan
5. Mix in spagetti sauce
6. Next , lay the sour cream on top of the hamburger mixture evenly covering all of hamburger but do not mix in
7. Finally , take cresent rolls but do not roll them up !
8. Just lay them flat on top of the sour cream
9. Almost like a pie topping making sure that the cresent rolls are covering the hole pan
10. Bake at 350 until cresent rolls get nice and golden brown
11. Take out of oven and let sit for a few minutes before cutting-- enjoy !

title: blueberry peach smoothie
steps: 1. Throw everything in a blender and blend for 5 minutes or so

title: polenta   sausage stuffed pepper gondolas  ragu
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 f and place a pot with a gallon of water on high heat
2. Add 1 tablespoon salt and 1 tablespoon olive oil to the water and cover
3. Cut the four lobed green pepper in half through the stem to the base and carefully remove the seeds to protect the integrity of the pepper
4. Use a paring knife or scissors to remove the stem
5. Rub a teaspoon of olive oil and italian seasoning on the pepper halves inside and out and place open side down on a cookie sheet
6. Place in the oven for 15 to 20 minutes , or until tender-crisp
7. While the pepper is cooking , heat 2 cups of chicken broth to boiling in a saucepan
8. Add the polenta and whisk in until smooth
9. Stir in the crumbled feta and set aside
10. Preheat a grill or grill pan to hot and grill sausages until done
11. Slice sausages on a bias
12. Remove tender-crisp peppers from the oven , turn over and fill halfway with polenta mixture
13. Top the polenta with sausages and sprinkle with mozzarella cheese
14. Place back into oven until cheese is melted
15. Heat ragu pasta sauce and ladle some onto two plates
16. "float" pepper gondolas onto the ragu sauce
17. Place long fusilli 200 pasta into boiling water , uncovered until al dente , 8 to 11 minutes
18. Strain and place on plate
19. Ladles on some ragu pasta sauce and top with pecorino romano cheese
20. Serve with a side salad if desired

title: blueberries cream cheese pie
steps:
1. Beat cream cheese , the first quantity of sugar and lemon juice in a small bowl until homogeneous
2. Pour in the pie shell
3. Put in the fridge
4. Spread the first quantity of blueberries on the cream cheese
5. In a saucepan , mix 3 / 4 cup sugar , cornstarch , water , blueberries and lemon juice
6. Heat and stir until boiling and its thick
7. Let cool down
8. Spread on the blueberries
9. Put back in the fridge

title: go patriots meatballs
steps:
1. Combine cocktail sauce , jelly and minced onion in a large pot over medium heat , stirring until the jelly melts and everything is smooth and combined well
2. Add the meatballs , lower the heat , and let simmer , stirring occasionally , until meatballs are heated through and nicely coated with sauce
3. You can pop this into a small crockpot on low to keep warm during your party

title: rich lemon cake
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 325 degrees and grease and flour a 9-inch tube pan or bundt cake pan
2. Beat the butter and sugar in a large bowl until light and fluffy
3. Beat in the eggs one at a time , mixing well until they are incorporated
4. Mix in the lemon zest , baking powder , and almond extract
5. Add the milk and flour in alternating doses , starting and ending with the milk , and mixing very well after each addition
6. Pour the batter into the prepared pan
7. Bake for 1 hour , or until the cake is browned and the sides of the cake have pulled away slightly from the sides of the pan
8. While the cake is baking , mix together the lemon juice and powdered sugar until smooth
9. Set aside
10. Remove the cake from the oven and poke small holes into the top of the cake using a wooden or metal skewer or cake tester
11. Pour about 3 / 4 of the glaze over the top of the cake
12. Cool the cake completely in the pan
13. Remove the cake from the pan , invert , and place on a serving plate or waxed paper if freezing
14. Pour the remaining glaze over the top of the unglazed part of the cake
15. Let sit at room temperature until the glaze dries
16. Cover and store at room temperature for up to 48 hours , or tightly seal in a freezer proof container for up to 3 months
17. Serve at room temperature or chilled
18. Thawing directions: simply thaw overnight at room temperature

title: bacon with brown sugar and cardamom
steps:
1. Position a rack in the upper third of the oven and another rack in the lowest third
2. Preheat to 350 degrees
3. Line the bottom and sides of two rimmed baking sheets with foil
4. Arrange the bacon slices in a single layer on the prepared baking sheet
5. In a small bowl , toss together the seasonings
6. Sprinkle evenly over the bacon
7. Place one pan on the upper rack and the other pan on the lower rack
8. Bake , without turning , for 20 to 25 minutes
9. Switch the position of the pans , top to bottom and front to back
10. Continue to bake until dark brown but not quite crisp , 10 to 15 minutes longer
11. Using tongs , lift the bacon from the pans , gently shaking off excess drippings
12. Transfer to paper towels to drain briefly
13. Arrange the bacon on a warmed platter and serve at once

title: healthy peanut wheat flax bars  no bake
steps:
1. Combine cereals , wheat germ and flax seed in a large mixing bowl , and set aside
2. In small sauce pan over medium heat combine honey and sugar stirring constantly until sugar is crystallized
3. Remove from heat and add peanut butter and stir until incorporated
4. Pour peanut butter mixture over cereals in the large bowl
5. Stir until evenly coated
6. Pour mix into a 9x13-inch pan
7. Let set and cool completely
8. Cut into bars

title: spinach   artichoke casseroles
steps:
1. If frozen artichokes are used , cook according to instructions
2. Do not overcook
3. Drain the artichokes , and place them on bottom of a 3-quart casserole
4. Squeeze as much moisture as possible from the spinach , and layer it on top of the artichokes
5. In an electric mixer blend the cream cheese , mayonnaise , and butter or oil until light and fluffy
6. Gradually beat in the milk , and spread this mixture over the top of the spinach
7. Sprinkle with pepper and the cheese
8. Bake , uncovered , at 375 degrees for 40 minutes , or until the top is lightly browned
9. You can refrigerate this dish after putting it together and before baking it , but if it is chilled , slightly increase the baking time

title: white sauce with spinach
steps:
1. Measure flour into saucepan
2. Slowly whisk in milk to avoid lumps
3. Cook over medium-high heat until thick and bubbly , making sure you stir constantly
4. Reduce heat to low-medium
5. Stir in the garlic powder , nutmeg and parmesan
6. Simmer 1-2 minutes
7. Remove from heat and stir in the spinach

title: apricot spice bread  abm
steps:
1. Place the apricots and water in a small saucepan and bring to a boil
2. Remove from the heat and allow to steep for 5 minutes
3. Drain the apricots , reserving the liquid , and spread them out on a double thickness of paper towels
4. Allow the apricots and the liquid to cool to room temperature
5. Finely chop the apricots
6. Measure the reserved cooking liquid and add enough apricot nectar to measure 7 / 8 cup
7. Place all ingredients in machine according to manufacturers directions - except apricots
8. Program the breadmaker for the medium crust mode and whatever setting your machine has for adding things later , and press start
9. At the end of the mixing cycle and just before the kneading cycle begins , add the chopped apricots
10. Remove bread at the end of the baking cycle promptly
11. Allow to cool on wire rack completely before slicing or wrapping for storage

title: crushed pineapple coffee cake
steps:
1. Cream sugar with butter
2. Sift flour and baking powder
3. Add to creamed mixture alternately with egg / milk mixture
4. Spread in 9x13 pan
5. Cover with well-drained pineapple
6. Mix topping ingredients till crumbly and sprinkle over pineapple
7. Bake at 350 for 1 hour

title: sugar free cheesecake
steps:
1. In standup blender , beat cream cheese until smooth
2. Add vanilla and sour cream until blended
3. Add whipped topping
4. Spoon into graham cracker crusts
5. Chill for at least 24 hours
6. If using chocolate cocoa powder , add 1 / 4 tsp salt and 1 / 2 cup splenda

title: my secret  stuffed chicken recipe
steps:
1. Mix cheese , tomato , garlic , and basil together
2. Place chicken in baking dish and spread mixture evenly over all four breasts
3. Sprinkle with fresh grated parmesan cheese
4. Bake at 425 till chicken is lightly browned and cooked through , aprox
5. 15-25 minutes
6. You might want to adjust the amount of garlic , we like a lot

title: easy chicken fajita skillet
steps:
1. Cook chicken with chili powder and salt in a non-stick or pam sprayed fry pan until cooked through
2. Add broth and bring to a boil
3. Stir in macaroni and cover , reducing heat to medium-low
4. Simmer 5 minutes and add peppers and onions and velveeta cubes
5. Cook until cheese is melted , stirring frequently

title: appalachian chili
steps:
1. In a large cooking pot , pour in the beef and chicken broth and crumble in the burger
2. Bring to a boil over medium heat
3. Add all other ingedients , except for the beans and the spaghetti , stirring after adding each one
4. Once the chili begins to boil , reduce the heat so that it will boil slowly with the lid on
5. Allow the chili to slowly boil for 90 minutes , stirring occasionally
6. Add the beans after 90 minutes and allow the chili to continue the slow boil for another 30 minutes
7. If desired , prepare the spaghetti separately , boiling in water per package directions , and set aside , covered
8. Serve either in medium-sized bowls with saltines or oyster crackers available at the table or , portion out the chili over the spaghetti on large plates

title: crunchy chicken strips
steps:
1. Slice chicken long or short , your way is best
2. Soak chicken in wine for an hour or overnight
3. Mix together flour , bread crumbs , salt and pepper
4. Coat chicken strips with flour mixture
5. Dip in milk
6. Coat a second time with flour
7. Heat stove top to medium
8. Cook until brown and cooked all the way through
9. Sprinkle lemon salt and pepper on both sides while cooking

title: cranberry orange bread with grand marnier glaze
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 330
2. Butter two 6-cup-capacity loaf pans (or , if making the mini loaves , butter six 2-cup-capacity pans
3. With an electric or standing mixer on medium speed , cream butter and sugar together in a large bowl until pale and fluffy , about 3 minutes
4. Add eggs one at a time , mixing well after each
5. Add orange juice , sour cream , orange zest , and vanilla
6. Mix until blended
7. In a separate bowl , whisk together flour , baking powder , and salt
8. Add flour mixture and cranberries to wet ingredients and mix just until dry ingredients are absorbed
9. Do not overmix
10. Pour batter into prepared loaf pans
11. Bake until a toothpick inserted in centers of breads comes out clean , 70 to 75 minutes for large loaves and 60 minutes for mini loaves
12. Meanwhile , in a small bowl , whisk together powdered sugar and 7 tablespoons grand marnier
13. Glaze should have consistency of thick maple syrup or corn syrup
14. If it is too thick , thin with an additional tablespoons of liqueur
15. Let loaves cool in pans for 10 minutes , then remove and transfer to a cooling rack set over a large baking sheet
16. With a thin skewer or long toothpick , poke deep holes in tops of loaves
17. Drizzle with grand marnier glaze so that it coats the top , runs down the sides , and seeps through the holes
18. Let loaves cool completely , then slice and serve , or wrap and freeze

title: healthy taco salad
steps:
1. In a medium saute pan over medium high heat , cook onions in 1 to 2 tablespoons water until softened and cooked through , about 12 to 15 minutes
2. Cook covered , stirring once or twice , add more water if necessary to keep onions from burning
3. Add chicken meat , and cook until crumbly and golden , about 7 to 9 minutes
4. Add citrus juice , zest , and taco seasoning mix , stir until well combined
5. Taste and adjust seasonings
6. Set aside to cool
7. Arrange lettuce on large platter with remaining ingredients
8. Top with chicken , garnish with baked chips and jalapenos

title: three layer strawberry cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 and grease and flour 3 round cake pans
2. Stir together cake mix and jello mix in a large bowl
3. Make a well in the center and pour in 1 cup mashed strawberries , oil , milk and eggs
4. Beat on low speed until blended
5. Scrape bowl and beat for 4 minutes on medium speed
6. Fold in the coconut and pecans
7. Divide the batter among the prepared pans
8. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until toothpick inserted into the center of the cake comes out clean
9. Let cool in pans for 10 minutes , then turn out onto a wire rack and cool completely
10. For frosting , mash the 3 / 4 cup strawberries to make 1 / 2 cup , then drain well and set aside
11. In a medium bowl , beat cream cheese and butter until smooth , then blend in powdered sugar and drained strawberries
12. Beat on medium speed until frosting lightens and is well combined
13. Fold in the coconut
14. Frost between layers and on top and sides
15. Chill uncovered for 30 minutes or until frosting sets , then cover and chill for 4 hours before serving

title: creepy eye balls
steps:
1. In mixing bowl stir together peanut butter and butter
2. Gradually add powdered sugar until combined
3. Shape into 1-inch balls
4. Place on waxed paper
5. Let stand about 30-45 minutes
6. In small bowl melt almond bark in microwave
7. Dip balls into almond bark one at a time
8. Let excess bark drip off balls then place on waxed paper
9. Immediately press a m&m into center of each ball
10. Let stand until almond bark coating is firm
11. Add a dot of black gel to the center of m&m for pupils
12. Drizzle red gel onto balls for bloodshot eyes

title: personal virgin pink elephant
steps:
1. In blender , add cold milk , sherbet and non dairy creamer and blend on high until smooth
2. Serve immediately

title: beer and sriracha marinated beef lettuce cups
steps:
1. For the marinade , whisk together soy sauce , beer , garlic , sugar , 2 tablespoons lime juice , sriracha and sesame oil in a large bowl
2. Add meat and toss to coat
3. Let sit at room temperature 1 hour or refrigerate covered up to 24 hours
4. To prepare condiments
5. Toss carrot with remaining lime juice and salt in a small bowl and set aside
6. Place peppers , green onions , mint , cilantro , sesame seeds , sriracha and rice in individual serving bowls
7. Arrange lettuce on a platter
8. To prepare the steak: heat peanut or vegetable oil in a skillet or grill pan over medium-high heat
9. Add beef strips in batches in one layer without overcrowding
10. Brown on both sides
11. Transfer to a platter and keep warm
12. Once all the beef has been browned , pour the remaining marinade and any collected meat juices into the skillet
13. Bring to a boil , scraping up any bits and reduce until somewhat thickened
14. Pour into a small bowl
15. To serve , top a lettuce leaf with a few spoonfuls of rice , 1-2 meat strips , and a spoonful of the marinade reduction
16. Sprinkle with the other condiments and drizzle with sriracha
17. Roll up and eat

title: simple roasted butternut squash cinnamon soup
steps:
1. Roast the butternut squash , flesh side down onto a lightly oiled roasting pan for 40 to 45 minutes in a 425 degree oven
2. In the mean time , sautee the onion , ginger , and garlic in butter until soft
3. Add the broth , simmer for ten minutes
4. Add pulp from the butternut squash
5. Puree in a food processor or blender
6. Return to pan
7. Add cream , salt , pepper , and a pinch or 2 of cinnamon
8. Simmer until heated through

title: ww core zucchini crust cheese pizza
steps:
1. Salt coarsely grated zucchini and let stand 15 minutes
2. Squeeze moisture out of zucchini
3. Combine eggs , cornmeal , 1 / 2 cup mozzarella cheese , parmesan cheese and basil
4. Add zucchini and mix well
5. Spray nonfat cooking spray on a 9 x 13 baking pan
6. Spread zucchini mixture into baking pan
7. Bake 20-25 minutes at 350f
8. Broil 5 minutes to golden brown
9. Remove "crust" from oven
10. Spread tomato sauce on crust
11. Arrange vegetables liberally over crust
12. Sprinkle remaining fat free mozzarella over the pizza
13. Bake at 350f for 20-25 minutes

title: pretty party pasta salad
steps:
1. Cook and drain the pasta
2. Toss all the ingredients together in a large bowl
3. Chill for a minimum of four hours
4. Put in your prettiest clear glass bowl , and serve

title: smokey chipotle tomato soup
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large , deep skillet
2. Saute onions until tender
3. Add tomatoes , carrots and chicken broth
4. Mix well
5. Bring to a boil then reduce heat and simmer until vegetables are tender , about 15 minutes
6. Stir occasionally transfer vegetables to a blender in small batches
7. Cover
8. Blend until smooth , adding dressing and chipotles to the last batch
9. Serve warm or chilled

title: crisp fried tofu with avocado salsa   watercress salad
steps:
1. To make the dressing , dissolve the sugar in 50ml water over a low heat
2. Bring to the boil and simmer until thick bubbles form
3. Take off the heat and pour in the chilli sauce and lime juice
4. Strain and cool
5. This will keep for a week in the fridge but must be brought back to room temperature before use
6. For the salsa , mix all the ingredients in a bowl and season
7. Drizzle in enough oil to lightly coat
8. Store in an airtight container and chill
9. Toss the tofu in the flour , dusting off any excess
10. Heat a little oil in a shallow pan , add the tofu and fry for 2 minutes
11. Carefully turn and fry for 2 more minutes
12. Remove with a slotted spoon , drain on kitchen paper and sprinkle with salt
13. To serve , pour the dressing into a sauce bottle with a thin nozzle
14. Zigzag the dressing onto the plate
15. Toss the watercress with the rest of the salad ingredients and throw in the tofu
16. Spoon some avocado into the centre of the plate and slightly flatten to resemble a thick disc
17. Pile the salad on top

title: shrimp fettuccine alfredo
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan melt butter , cream and cheeses
2. Add garlic powder
3. Simmer on very low heat for 5 minutes
4. Add cooked and drained noodles
5. If you desire a thinner sauce , add more cream
6. Place in serving dishes and add cooked shrimp
7. Sprinkle with tomato which has been cut into tiny cubes
8. Time does not include time for shrimp or noodles
9. A pretty dish !

title: stacy s breakfast loaf
steps:
1. In large skillet , saute the sausage
2. Cool
3. In a bowl combine meat , cheese , 3 eggs , green onion , parsley , onion and garlic powder
4. Mix well unroll pizza dough and roll into a 12x8" rectangle
5. Spread sausage mix down the center
6. Bring dough over filing , pinch seams to seal
7. Place seam side down on a greased baking sheet
8. Tuck ends under
9. Beat remaining egg and brush over top
10. Bake at 350 for 30 minutes
11. Let stand 5 minutes before serving

title: apple crisp with corn flakes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Put half of the apples in a greased 9x9-inch pan
3. Blend together remaining ingredients , except juice , and crumble half the flour mixture over the apples
4. Cover with remaining apples and flour mixture
5. Pour juice over top
6. Bake 35 minutes
7. Do not use a food processor or mixer to mix in the cornflakes as the topping will turn pasty on you
8. My mother just mixed hers with her hands
9. I sprinkle a light dusting of powdered sugar on mine when serving
10. :)

title: slow cooker pork cushion roast
steps:
1. Spray slow cooker with cooking spray
2. Arrange onion and garlic slices evenly over the bottom of the slow cooker , then place the roast on top of the onion and garlic
3. Add carrots and potatoes to the slow cooker , around the roast
4. Mix water , sugar , vinegar , soy sauce , ketchup , black pepper , garlic powder , chicken bouillon , wine , and hot sauce in bowl
5. Microwave mixture for 30 seconds to blend flavors
6. Pour mixture over meat in slow cooker
7. Cover and cook on low for 8 hours
8. At 7 hour mark , stir in cornstarch and water mixture to thicken the sauce
9. Serve over egg noodles , rice or stuffing

title: president s soup  sauerkraut soup
steps:
1. Coarsely chop onions , finely mince cloves
2. In a large pot heat oil and saute onions and cloves until onions are translucent , then add the ground beef
3. Cook until done , mashing all lumps of meat thoroughly with a fork
4. There should not be big lumps of meat when it's done
5. Pull the sauerkraut apart and add it to the meat in small portions
6. Immediately add tomato paste , tomato juice and beef stock
7. Mix well , then add one tablespoon pepper , paprika powder and caraway and some salt
8. Bring to a boil and simmer on low heat for about 30 minutes
9. Try the soup and add salt and spices to taste , then add tabasco to taste
10. Finely slice the cucumbers and add to soup , let simmer for five more minutes
11. Finely chop the parsley
12. Serve the soup in bowls , garnish with one dollop of sour cream and some parsley
13. Enjoy !

title: coffee cream filling   frosting
steps:
1. Mixed all three ingredients in a medium sized glass bowl
2. Beat ingredients still stiff
3. Use as a filling in your favourite cake or as frosting for cupcakes
4. Be creative !

title: banana berry drink
steps:
1. Place half of each ingredient in a blender
2. Cover and process until smooth
3. Pour into chilled glasses
4. Repeat with the remaining ingredients
5. Serve immediately

title: lentil bro
steps:
1. Melt the butter in a large saucepan and saut the lentils and all the vegetables
2. Season with salt and black pepper and add the stock
3. Bring to the boil and simmer for 2 hours
4. Adjust the seasoning to taste and serve garnished with parsley

title: no puree cauliflower soup
steps:
1. Cook cauliflower according to package directions , drain and chop into small pieces
2. In a dutch oven , saute onions and carrots in oil until tender
3. Stir in cauliflower , corn , and parsley
4. Add chicken broth
5. Bring to a boil
6. Reduce heat and simmer 5 to 10 minutes
7. In a saucepan over medium heat , melt butter
8. Whisk in flour
9. Gradually add milk and half and half
10. Cook , stirring continously until thickened
11. Do not allow to boil
12. Carefully stir thickened mixture into chicken broth and vegetables in dutch oven
13. Add salt and pepper , then adjust seasonings to taste

title: disacolada
steps:
1. Combine ingredients in a shaker with ice
2. Shake , strain and serve in a martini glass
3. You can increase the amount if you want

title: fresh tuscan rosemary wet rub
steps:
1. Use a knife to finely chop the herbs
2. Place in a food processor along with the garlic , salt and pepper
3. With the processor motor running , drizzle in the oil and process until smooth

title: monty s spinach cheese scones
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 f
2. In a large bowl , blend the dry ingredients
3. Cut in the butter until the mixture resembles cornmeal
4. Blend in the spinach and cheeses
5. In a separate bowl , whip the milk and eggs together
6. Stir egg mixture into the spinach mixture until well-combined
7. Turn onto a floured surface and knead gently
8. Roll the dough out to a one-inch thickness
9. Cut into 3-inch rounds
10. Place rounds on a greased baking sheet and bush with the egg white
11. Bake for 20 minutes

title: tsr version of hooters buffalo chicken wings  rf  by todd wilbur
steps:
1. Preheat oven on broil
2. Line a cookie sheet or shallow baking pan with a sheet of aluminum foil
3. Spray foil with nonstick spray
4. Arrange chicken wings on the foil with the side that has the most skin on it facing up
5. Broil wings for 12 to 14 minutes , or until skin begins to dry
6. Remove wings from oven , and set to 450f allow wings to cool for 10 to 15 minutes or just long enough so they can be touched
7. While the wings cool , prepare sauce by combining hot sauce , fat free buttery spread , and water in small saucepan over med / low heat
8. Heat mixture , stirring often , until it begins to boil
9. Immediately remove sauce from heat and cover the saucepan until chicken wings are ready to coat
10. Prepare chicken breading by combining flour with salt , paprika , and cayenne pepper in small bowl
11. Pour milk into another small bowl
12. When wings are cool enough to touch , remove skin from each of the chicken pieces , and discard it
13. Dip wings , one at a time , in breading , then into milk and back into breading , so that each one is well coated
14. Place wings back on baking sheet
15. Spray a coating of nonstick oil spray over each wing , so that the breading is moistened , and then bake wings at 450f for 12 minutes
16. Crank oven up to broil for 3 to 5 minutes , or till wings begin to brown and become crispy
17. Remove wings from oven
18. Let them rest for about a minute , then put them into a plastic container
19. Pour generous amount of sauce over wings , cover , and gently shake wings so that they are all well coated with sauce
20. Serve immediately

title: creamy cajun shrimp and pasta
steps:
1. Heat a large skillet over medium heat
2. Melt butter
3. Add onion , garlic , green onion , tony chachere's , white pepper , and cook until softened
4. Add wine and tomatoes
5. Simmer for 15 minutes
6. Add heavy cream and spinach , simmer 5 minutes
7. Add pasta , shrimp , and 1 / 2 cup parmesan reggiano
8. Simmer until shrimp is warmed
9. Top with rest of parmesan reggiano and serve

title: crab and silverbeet  chard  cannelloni
steps:
1. Start preparing the bechamel sauce by melting butter in medium saucepan over medium-low heat
2. Whisk in flour and cook 3 minutes
3. Whisk in milk and bring to boil , stirring
4. Add salt and nutmeg
5. Reduce heat and simmer until the same consistency as thickened cream
6. Refrigerate the sauce for 30 minutes or more
7. Combine all filling ingredients in a bowl and mix well with 1 / 2 cup of the bechamel sauce
8. Fill cannelloni tubes with the mixture
