9. Spread pasta sauce evenly over the bottom of a small baking dish
10. Place the cannelloni tubes over the top in the dish
11. Pour the remaining bechamel sauce over the top and sprinkle lightly with dried parsley
12. Bake for 30 minutes at 180c / 360f

title: spring greens with toasted cheese
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400f line baking sheet with aluminum foil
2. Place 1 / 4 cup dressing in shallow bowl
3. Combine bread crumbs and garlic salt in another shallow bowl
4. Dip each piece of cheese into dressing
5. Shake off excess dressing
6. Coat with bread crumbs
7. Place cheese onto prepared baking sheet
8. Bake for 3 to 4 minutes or just until soft
9. Arrange salad greens , herbs and tomatoes on 6 individual salad plates
10. Drizzle with remaining dressing
11. Place 3 cubes toasted cheese on each salad
12. Serve immediately
13. Refrigerate , covered on baking sheet or in a covered container
14. Bake just before serving

title: yet   another way to make crock pot apple butter
steps:
1. Combine the first six ingredients and 2 tablespoons of the butter in a crock pot and cook on low for 6 - 8 hours
2. Before serving , add in the remaining 2 tablespoons butter and the vanilla and stir to combine
3. Goes great with biscuits

title: colombian potato salad
steps:
1. Peel cooled potatoes and chop into bite sized dice
2. Place in a large bowl
3. Rinse and drain vienna sausages , cut each into 4 rounds
4. Add to potatoes
5. Add onion and celery to potatoes
6. Coarsely chop eggs and add to potatoes
7. Add peas and carrots
8. Combine mayonnaise and sour cream
9. Stir into potato mixture
10. Season with salt and pepper
11. Garnish with green onions

title: grilled cheese tomato panini with crispy apples
steps:
1. Sprinkle half of cheese evenly over one of bread slices
2. Arrange tomato halves over cheese , covering bread slices evenly
3. Top with apple slices
4. Sprinkle with remainder of cheese
5. Top with remaining bread slice
6. Heat a non stick saut pan and spray lightly with veggie oil
7. Place sandwich in pan and weigh top down by pressing a plate over sandwich , topped with a can
8. Saut over low heat 3 to 4 minutes
9. Turn sandwich over and repeat process until bread is golden brown and cheese is melted
10. Slice in two and serve immediately

title: cauliflower cheese pie with grated potato crust
steps:
1. Set the freshly grated potato in a colander over a bowl
2. Salt it and leave for 10 minutes
3. Then , squeeze out the excess water
4. Beat in the egg , salt and grated onion
5. Pat into a well oiled 9 inch pie tin , building up the sides of the crust with lightly floured fingers
6. Bake at 400f for 40 to 45 minutes , until browned
7. After the first 30 minutes , crush with some more oil to crispen it
8. Meanwhile saute the onions and garlic in the butter for 5 minutes
9. Add the herbs and cauliflower and cook , covered , 10 minutes longer , stirring occasionally
10. Season to taste with salt and the pepper
11. Spread half the cheese into the baked crust
12. Top with the saute , then the rest of the cheese
13. Beat together the egg and milk and carefully pour over
14. Dust with paprika
15. Lower the oven temperature to 375f and bake for 35 to 40 minutes longer , until custard is set and is pie is nicely browned

title: walnut raisin scones
steps:
1. In a large bowl combine flour , sugar , baking powder , baking soda , salt and lemon peel
2. With a pastry blender or 2 knives , cut in butter until mixture resembles coarse meal
3. Mix in all but 2 tablespoons of the nuts and the raisins
4. Mix in buttermilk with fork
5. Gather the dough into a ball and knead for about 2 minutes on lightly floured board
6. Roll or pat out 3 / 4 inch thick
7. With a chef's knife cut into 3 inch triangles
8. Place , spaced 1-inch apart , on a greased baking sheet
9. Brush tops with remaining 1 tablespoon buttermilk
10. Sprinkle with the remaining sugar and the nuts
11. Bake in center of 425 degree f oven about 15 minutes or until nicely browned
12. Serve warm with butter or jam

title: ccc   coconut coffee cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 175 c and line baking sheets with parchment paper
2. Mix butter , sugar and salt with an electric mixer until creamy , about 1 minute
3. Add the egg and beat well
4. Heat the coconut milk gently in a saucepan over medium heat or in the microwave
5. Add instant coffee and stir to dissolve
6. Stir the coconut-coffee mixture into the butter mixture
7. Sift together flour and baking powder and add to the batter , stirring just until the ingredients are incorporated
8. Fold in the flaked coconut
9. Drop heaping teaspoons of batter 1 inch apart on baking sheets
10. Bake in the preheated oven for 12-15 minutes or until cookies are pale golden brown
11. Transfer to wire racks to cool
12. Store cookies in an airtight container at room temperature
13. Cookies will keep up to two weeks

title: white castle casserole
steps:
1. Cook hamburger with onion mix , dry extremely well
2. Lay whole can of crescent rolls in bottom of pan
3. Layer hamburger mixture , cheese , pickles and squirt mustard up and down across pan
4. Put whole can of crescent rolls on top
5. Bake at 350 until golden brown
6. Cut in squares
7. Hints i find shredded cheese taste better
8. I also made one with shredded pepper jack cheese
9. The people went for that one first

title: dad s favorite cheesy potatoes in foil
steps:
1. Slice potatoes thinly onto a big piece of heavy aluminum foil and sprinkle with salt and pepper
2. Crumble bacon over potatoes
3. Add onion and cheese cubes
4. Slice butter over all and mix mixture gently on the foil
5. Bring edges of foil up , leaving room for steam expansion
6. Seal with a double fold
7. Place package on grill and cook about 1 hour , turning several times
8. Be careful not to burn

title: crock pot asparagus casserole
steps:
1. Place drained asparagus in lightly buttered crock pot
2. Combine soup and cheese
3. Top asparagus with soup mixture , then the cracker crumbs
4. Dot with butter
5. Cover and cook on low for 4 to 6 hours

title: greek bulgur pilaf
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a medium size skillet over medium high heat
2. Add the bulgur and onion and saut until both are translucent , about 5 minutes
3. Stir in the stock , bring it to a boil , then reduce the heat and cover the pan
4. Simmer until the bulgur is just tender and all the liquid is absorbed , 20 to 25 minutes
5. Add salt and pepper to taste , then cover and let sit for 5 minutes
6. Fluff with a fork and serve
7. Serves 4
8. Be sure also to increase the amount of olive oil and onion as you increase the bulgur and stock
9. The olive and the caper

title: the most awesome chocolate fondue
steps:
1. 1
2. Combine chocolate chips cream and corn syrup in large microwave safe bowl
3. 2
4. Microwave uncovered on high power for 1 minute
5. Stir by hand (if nessesary , microwave for an additional 20 to 30 seconds
6. 3 stir untill the chocolate is melted , it is all combined and sauce is smooth
7. 4
8. Add liqueur and stir again
9. 5
10. Serve warm and with assorted fruits , cookies , marshmellows , etc

title: easy oven lasagna
steps:
1. Brown ground beef , drain
2. Add water , spaghetti sauce and sugar , bring to a boil
3. In a 2 qt
4. Baking dish layer sauce , uncooked lazagna , beef , ricotta cheese mozzarella cheese , spinach
5. Repeat layers , ending with sauce
6. Top with 1 / 2 c mozzarella and 1 / 4 c parmesan cheese
7. Cover tightly with foil
8. Bake at 375 degrees f for 1 hour
9. Let stand 5 to 10 min
10. Before cutting

title: pork and sweet potatoes  oamc
steps:
1. Cut chops into slices , not too thin or they dry out , cook lightly , do not over cook as they dry out and they still get cooked once more
2. Leave a line of pink inches
3. Using 2 large ziplock freezer bags , place half of cooked pork in each bag
4. Drizzle 2 tablespoons of oil in each bag , squish the meat around in it to coat , you might want to do this each time you add stuff to the bag
5. It helps keep things nicely covered
6. Place 2 chopped apples in each bag
7. 1 onion chopped in each bag
8. 1 / 2 tsp's of thyme and salt , 1 / 4 teaspoons pepper in each bag
9. Add 3 cups of frozen roasted sweet potatoes to each bag
10. Add 2 cups of apple juice to each bag
11. Close and shake the bags really really well
12. Freeze here
13. To cook:
14. Remove from freezer , dump contents of bag in a large pan , add a little water , about a tbsp
15. , cover , cook 10 minutes , you want it to thaw , uncover and simmer 10 minutes longer
16. Alternatively you can precook the apple and onion when you cook the pork , but then they're softer like the things you buy in the store freezer

title: vegetarian croissant sandwich
steps:
1. If desired , wrap croissant in foil and heat in a 350f oven about 4 minutes or just until warm
2. Split croissant , then spread lightly with mustard
3. Arrange lettuce leaf , swiss cheese , tomato slices , avocado , zucchini or cucumber , and mushroom slices on bottom half of croissant
4. Combine mayonnaise , milk , and dill weed or basil
5. Add sprouts if desired
6. Spoon over filling
7. Add top half of croissant
8. Makes 1 serving
9. Some vegetables , such as green beans , thinly sliced carrots , or asparagus , are especially good when steamed for a few minutes and then marinated for several hours in a vinaigrette dressing
10. Enjoy !

title: vietnamese style cucumber pickle
steps:
1. Combine the above ingredients and allow to marinate overnight
2. Makes approximately 2 cups

title: cindi s spaghetti sauce
steps:
1. In a dutch oven or large pot , brown the ground beef , onion , and green peppers
2. Drain off fat
3. Add the remaining ingredients
4. Cover , and simmer until heated through
5. Serve with cooked spaghetti and parmesan cheese

title: beef bourguignon ala pressure cooker
steps:
1. In a 4 or 6 quart pressure cooker , combine beef , carrots , mushrooms , onion , garlic , bay leaf , salt , thyme , black pepper , beef broth or beef stock , wine and tomato paste
2. Place seal in the pressure cooker lid and lock the lid in place
3. Place pressure regulator on vent pipe and bring to pressure over high heat
4. Reduce heat just enough to maintain pressure so the pressure regulator rocks gently
5. Cook for 12 minutes
6. Remove cooker from heat and allow pressure to come down naturally
7. Once pressure is down , remove pressure regulator from lid
8. Unlock lid and carefully remove it
9. Remove the bay leaf and discard
10. In a small bowl stir together flour and 1 / 4 cup water till well combined
11. Add this mixture to cooker
12. Replace cooker over medium to medium high heat , and cook until stew is thickened and bubbly , stirring frequently
13. Once stew begins to thicken , continue cooking for 1 minute more
14. Remove cooker from heat
15. Serve stew over egg noodles

title: peanut butter chocolate chip muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 / gas 4
2. Measure flour using the spoon method
3. Into a medium sized bowl sift flour , baking powder , baking soda and salt
4. Whisk to combine and set aside
5. In a small jug mix vanilla extract and milk , set aside
6. In a large bowl mix melted butter with peanut butter followed by sugar , beat until light and fluffy
7. With a fork , whisk egg until lightly beaten and in two steps pour into butter / sugar mixing to combine
8. Next in three steps start to add the flour alternating with the milk
9. Finally fold in chocolate chips
10. Spoon batter into paper lined muffin tin and bake for 20-23 minutes

title: salsa cakes
steps:
1. Mix salsa and sour cream
2. Put 1 rice cake on a plate
3. Put fat free cheese on rice cake
4. Heat in microwave for 10-15 sec
5. Put salsa / sour cream mix on cheesy rice cake
6. Put the other rice cake on top of mixture
7. Voila ! eat your salsa sandwich !

title: lamb kebabs with lima bean salad
steps:
1. Soak 8 wooden skewers in water for at least 15 minutes
2. Bring a large saucepan of water to a boil
3. Meanwhile , in a medium bowl , make the vinaigrette: whisk together the oil , vinegar , oregano , garlic , 1 / 4 teaspoon salt and pepper
4. Transfer half the vinaigrette to another medium bowl , add the lamb , and toss to coat
5. Heat broiler
6. Thread the lamb , lemon , and onion onto the skewers and place on a boilerproof baking sheet
7. Broil 3 to 4 minutes per side for medium-rare
8. Add the beans and 1 tablespoon salt to the boiling water and cook until the beans are tender , 2 to 3 minutes
9. Rinse with cold water , drain well , and add the bowl with the remaining vinaigrett
10. Add the feta , olives , and mint and toss to combine
11. Serve with the kebabs

title: grilled tortilla dessert wraps
steps:
1. Preheat a grill to low
2. Spread almond paste evenly on each tortilla
3. Sprinkle 1 / 4 of the marshmallows and 1 / 4 of the chocolate chips and 1 / 4 of the coconut on half of each tortilla
4. Roll the tortilla up and wrap in heavy-duty foil
5. Seal tightly
6. Grill over low heat until heated through , about 5 to 10 minutes
7. Remove foil and place on a plate
8. Garnish with fresh sweetened whipped cream or prepared whipped topping
9. Serve vanilla ice cream on the side

title: scalloped scallops
steps:
1. Melt butter in a saucepan
2. Stir in the cracker crumbs , eggs
3. And remove from the heat
4. Preheat oven to 350f
5. Butter a 2 quart casserole and put in the cracker crumb mixture and scallops in alternating layers , with crumbs on top
6. Bake for 30 minutes
7. Serve from casserole

title: maple butter twist kuchen
steps:
1. Dissolve yeast in warm water
2. Stir in milk , sugar , salt , eggs , shortening and 2 1 / 2 cups flour
3. Beat until smooth
4. Mix in enough remaining flour to make dough easy to handle
5. Turn dough onto lightly floured board
6. Knead until smooth and elastic , about 5 minutes
7. Place in greased bowl
8. Turn greased side up
9. Cover and let rise in warm place until double , about 1 1 / 2 hours
10. Punch dough down
11. Divide dough in half , using 1 / 2 at a time
12. Roll dough into rectangle , 15"x9"
13. Cream the filling ingredients together
14. Spread each 15"x9" rolled rectangle with 1 / 2 of the filling ingredients
15. Roll up , beginning at wide side
16. Pinch edge of dough into roll to seal well
17. Stretch roll to make even
18. With sealed edge down , shape into ring on lightly greased baking sheet
19. Pinch ends together
20. With scissors or sharp knife , make cuts 2 / 3 of the way through ring at 1" intervals
21. Twist each section on its side with the cut side out
22. Let ring rise until double
23. Bake 20-25 minutes at 350 degrees until top is golden brown
24. While warm , frost with icing

title: beer muffins
steps:
1. Spray muffin tin with nonstick spray and set aside
2. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
3. Heat beer in sauce pan until just warm , do not let boil , and remove from stove
4. Add sugar to beer and stir until sugar is disolved
5. Add flour into beer and sugar and stir until blended
6. Spoon into muffin tins filling each about half way
7. Bake for 30 minutes or until golden brown

title: diabetic virgin white sangria
steps:
1. Combine all the ingredients except the soda in a large pitcher and chill for at least 1 hour
2. When serving , add the soda
3. Serve with a pretty fruit garnish

title: quick creamy broccoli soup
steps:
1. In a large pot , combine broccoli , onion , garlic , broth or water , and salt
2. Cover pot , bring to a boil , and then simmer for about 15 minutes , or until everything starts getting soft
3. Use a ladle to transfer 2 / 3 of the soup into a blender
4. Blend the soup until smooth
5. Pour back into saucepan and turn on heat to medium setting
6. In a small bowl , combine milk with flour and whisk together until smooth
7. Pour mixture into soup and stir
8. Add basil and parsley and stir until soup begins to thicken
9. Add vinegar , and salt and pepper to taste

title: curried pan fried potatoes
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , add the onionsm garlic , mustard seeds , and curry paste to a splash of olive oil and saute on medium heat until mixed well and onions are translucent
2. Add the potatoes and fry , flipping occasionally , until the potatoes are soft enough to pierce with a fork
3. Season with salt and pepper to taste

title: cinnamon spread
steps:
1. In a small mixing bowl , add the butter , brown sugar , cinnamon and nutmeg
2. Stir until well blended
3. Spread on toast , bagels , biscuits , and my personal favorite--pumpkin bread

title: zucchini italiano
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Place oil and garlic in a skillet over medium-high heat
3. Saute until garlic is browned
4. Add onion and zucchini
5. Toss well with garlic oil , gently stirring
6. Stir in tomato sauce and seasonings
7. Turn into a 2-quart baking dish
8. Cover and bake for 20 minutes
9. Remove from oven and sprinkle on cheeses
10. Cover casserole and let sit for 2 minutes or until cheese melts- serve immediately

title: italian beef and peppers goulash
steps:
1. In large pan , brown steak in oil
2. Add onions and cook 3 minutes
3. Add tomato sauce , water , tomatoes and spices
4. Bring to boil , then simmer 30 minutes or more
5. Add green peppers
6. Cook 15 minutes
7. Serve over rice

title: grasshopper pie   nigella lawson
steps:
1. Take out and set aside 1 biscuit
2. Process the rest of the biscuits and chocolate in a food processor until they start to break down into a crumb mixture , then add the butter and carry on processing until it starts to clump together
3. Press into a loose-based , high-sided tart tin and make a smooth base and sides with your hands or the back of a spoon
4. Put into the fridge to chill and harden
5. Melt the marshmallows in a saucepan with the milk over a gentle heat , once the milk starts to foam take off the heat and keep stirring until the marshmallows blend into the milk to make a smooth mixture
6. Pour the mixture out of the saucepan into a heatproof bowl , and then whisk in the crme de menthe and crme de cacao
7. Leave to cool
8. Whisk the cream until it starts to hold soft peaks then , still whisking , add the cooled marshmallow mix
9. This filling should be thick but still soft , not stiff or dry , so that it will eventually drop easily out of the bowl into the chilled pie crust
10. Once the marshmallow mixture and cream are combined , add a few drops of food colouring and gently mix inches
11. Spread the filling into the chilled base tin , swirl it about with a palette knife or a spatula to fill evenly and put back in the fridge , covered , to chill overnight or for a minimum of 4 hours until firm
12. Crush the biscuit you put aside earlier and sprinkle over the top of the pie before slicing
13. The pie can be made 12 days ahead
14. When chilled and firm , tent with foil and store in fridge
15. Decorate just before serving
16. The pie will keep 34 days total
17. Freeze
18. Open-freeze undecorated pie just until solid , then wrap pie in double layer of clingfilm and layer of foil
19. To defrost , unwrap pie and tent with foil , then defrost overnight in fridge
20. Decorate before serving

title: cola baked ham
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 275 degrees
2. Remove any visible excess fat from ham
3. Place the ham in a large turkey roasting oven bag and place in a baking dish
4. Pour cola over ham , remove as much air as possible and seal bag
5. Prick a few holes in bag to let steam escape and bake for 4 to 5 hours
6. Pour off excess juice and slice

title: vanilla and cinnamon milk
steps:
1. Put the milk , honey , vanilla extract and cinnamon in a small saucepan and cook stirring occasionally , over a low heat for 5-7 minutes or until warm
2. Pour into mugs and serve

title: mini chocolate chip crumb cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Spray 13 x 9 pan with pam and sprinkle with flour
3. Or make 24 muffins
4. Mix topping ingredients , cutting in butter to small pieces the size of peas -- and set aside
5. Mix dry ingredients and set aside
6. Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy
7. Add eggs and vanilla and mix well
8. Add flour alternately with sour cream beginning and ending with flour
9. Add mini chips
10. Pour into 13 x 9 pan and sprinkle topping over
11. Bake at 350 for 30 to 35 minutes or 15 minutes for muffins
12. Do not overbake !

title: lucky charms treats
steps:
1. Grease 9x9x2-inch pan
2. Melt margarine and marshmallows until smooth , either over medium heat in a saucepan or in the microwave
3. Stir in lucky charms until well coated
4. Press into pan with buttered hands
5. Cut into squares when cool

title: carrot dill soup
steps:
1. Saute chopped celery , onions , garlic , salt and pepper , in the butter until soft
2. Add carrots sliced about 1 / 2 inch , and cook about 4 minute
3. Add stock and cook until vegetables are fork tender
4. Puree with hand blender
5. Stir in dill

title: grpa s best homemade turkey gravy
steps:
1. This recipe is made together with roast turkey , and the turkey fat and drippings that render out while the turkey is roasting in the oven
2. Strain the turkey liquid and the vegetables through a fine mesh sieve , pressing on the vegetables to get out as much juice out of them as possible
3. Discard the vegetables
4. They did their job
5. Set the turkey drippings aside for about 5 minutes
6. The fat will rise to the top
7. If you have a gravy separator , this would be the time to use it
8. Carefully spoon the fat into a small saucepan
9. You should have approximately cup of the turkey fat
10. If your turkey is on the leaner side , or youre cooking a wild turkey , add additional butter or oil , to have cup
11. You should also have about 2 cups of turkey liquid , if not , add more broth , to equal 2 cups
12. You can also add a splash of white wine
13. I normally add wine to most of my gravies and sauces , but in this case , the gravy is so flavorful , i dont think it needs it
14. Heat up the fat until its simmering
15. Add the flour and whisk to combine
16. Cook for about a minute , to cook off the raw flour taste
17. Slowly pour in the turkey liquid , whisking the whole time
18. Bring it to a simmer and keep slowly adding more turkey liquid or chicken broth , whisking the whole time
19. Simmer the gravy until it thickens , about 5 minutes
20. Set aside
21. Serve with mashed potatoes and turkey
22. You can easily reheat the gravy , if you make it ahead of time
23. It will thicken significantly with time , so if youre serving it the next day , you may wish to add more chicken broth to thin it out
24. My

title: blueberry apple crumble
steps:
1. Stir together oats , sugar , flour , and cinnamon
2. Cut in butter and oil until thoroughly incorporated
3. In a bowl toss apples with lemon juice and rind
4. Stir in blueberries
5. Reserve 1 cup of oat mixture for the topping
6. Toss the remainder with the fruit
7. Spread mixture in a baking dish
8. Sprinkle with reserved oat mixture
9. Bake 35-45 minutes or until bubbly and browned on top
10. Serve with vanilla ice cream , if desired

title: good sandwich
steps:
1. First you should lightly toast the bread
2. Then you spread the miracle whip & mustard on the bread
3. Put your chicken breast on the bread
4. Put the one leaf of lettuce on
5. Put the 3 slices of tomato on in a line
6. Then you should put your onion on
7. Then put your green pepper on
8. You then put the avocado on , as much as desired
9. Then you eat the sandwich and enjoy

title: heavenly peach crisp in the crock pot
steps:
1. Spray slow cooker with nonstick cooking spray
2. Combine all ingredients , except 1 / 3 cup granola in slow cooker
3. Sprinkle 1 / 3 cup granola on top
4. Cook on low 4-6 hours
5. Serve with ice cream !

title: fresh peach salsa
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients in a medium mixing bowl
2. Cover and chill for 1 to 2 hours

title: slow cooker orange chicken  low sugar
steps:
1. Toss chicken with flour in slow cooker
2. Stir in all remaining ingredients
3. Cover with lid
4. Cook on low for 6-8 hours , or on high for 3-4 hours

title: southwest corn and bean dip
steps:
1. Mix all in pan on stove top in order given over medium heat
2. Add cheese last and let it melt and turn off heat
3. Serve with tortillas or crackers

title: sloppy joes manwich style
steps:
1. In a large skillet brown the beef in a small amount of oil , if needed
2. Add the remaining ingredients , except buns and mix well
3. Bring to a boil , reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 15 minutes , or until mixture is reduced and has reached the desired thickness your looking for
4. Serve on toasted buns

title: golden grand marnier cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. In a small bowl , toss the chocolate chips and a few spoons of grand marnier until chips are moistened and shiny
3. Add the 1 teaspoon flour and toss until evenly coated
4. In a medium bowl , lightly combine the eggs , cup sour cream , and vanilla
5. In a large mixing bowl combine the dry ingredients and orange zest and mix on low speed a moment to blend
6. Add the butter and remaining cup sour cream
7. Mix on low speed until the dry ingredients are moistened
8. Increase to medium high speed for 1 minutes to aerate and develop structure
9. Scrape down sides
10. Gradually add egg mixture in 3 batches , beating for 20 seconds after each addition to incorporate the ingredients
11. Scrape down the sides , and fold in the chocolate chips
12. Scrape the batter into a well buttered bundt pan
13. Bake 55 to 65 minutes or until the cake tests done with a toothpick
14. Shortly before the cake is done , prepare the syrup: heat the sugar , orange juice , and grand marnier until the sugar is dissolved
15. Do not boil
16. As soon as the cake comes out of the oven , place the pan on a rack , poke the top all over with a wire tester , and brush on the syrup
17. Cool in the pan for 10 minutes , then invert onto a serving plate
18. Brush with the remaining syrup and cool completely before wrapping airtight
19. This cake can be made several days ahead and refrigerated , wrapped well
20. I like to glaze it with a chocolate cream ganache before serving

title: maddog s mango coconut bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Spray two loaf pans well with no-stick cooking spray
3. Set aside
4. In a large mixing bowl , cream butter and sugar together until light using an electric mixer on medium speed
5. Add eggs one at a time , beating well after each addition
6. On low speed of mixer , beat in flour and nutmeg
7. Fold in mangoes and coconut
8. Divide batter between prepared pans and bake in center of oven about an hour or until center of each loaf is set
9. If edges seem to be getting too brown , cover them lightly with foil the last few minutes of baking
10. Let sit in pans about 8 minutes , then turn out onto wire racks to cool
11. Best if completely cool before slicing
12. Slices even better from refrigerator
13. Makes 2 loaves
14. 16 slices ea

title: lemon dill rice
steps:
1. Heat the olive oil in a saucepan
2. Saute the chopped onion for 1 minute
3. Add rice and "parch" over low heat , by stirring until the rice turns white again
4. Do not let the rice brown
5. Add the rest to the ingredients and bring to boil
6. Lower heat and cover with a tight fitting lid
7. Cook until all of the liquid is absorbed
8. Fluff well with a fork , replace the lid and let sit for 5 minutes
9. Sauteing the rice greatly reduces foaming during cooking

title: speedy spicy vegetable curry
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a large frying pan and fry the onion until soft and pale golden
2. Add the garlic and ginger and cook for 2 minutes , stirring frequently
3. Add the curry powder and cook for another 2 minutes , stirring all the time
4. Add all the vegetables to the pan and stir well so everything is completely coated in the spice mixture
5. Add the chopped tomatoes , lentils , vegetable stock and coconut milk and stir together gently
6. Bring to the boil , then reduce the heat , cover and leave to simmer gently for about 20 to 25 minutes , until the vegetables are tender
7. If you are adding the fresh cilantro leaves , stir them into the curry just before serving

title: sensational herbed chicken
steps:
1. Combine the three spices
2. Sprinkle the herb mixture over the chicken
3. Brown the chicken , in batches , in the butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat
4. Place the chicken in a lightly greased baking dish
5. Combine the wine and lemon juice
6. Stir well
7. Pour wine mixture over the chicken
8. Cover and bake at 375 for 45 minutes or until the chicken is done

title: cheesy bacon strips
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. In a medium bowl , whisk together flours , baking powder , baking soda and salt
3. Cut in the cubed butter with a pastry blender until mixture resembles coarse meal
4. Add cheese and crumbled bacon - toss well to combine
5. Pour in yogurt and stir just until combined
6. Scoop the mixture out to a lightly floured surface and knead just until it forms a dough , about 10 to 15 times
7. Pat the dough out until it is about a 8" square
8. Evenly divide the dough in half , then cut each half into 8 sticks - place each stick onto a parchment lined baking sheet
9. Bake until golden , about 10 to 15 minutes
10. Remove and let cool slightly before serving

title: basic waffles
steps:
1. Add dry ingredients to mixing bowl and stir to mix well
2. Add remaining ingredients and blend until smooth
3. Let batter sit for 5 minutes before using
4. Use less than you think on your 1st waffle , spreading batter with a non-stick spatula
5. Batter spreads and rises , so you don't want to overfill your waffle iron
6. Cook until done--varies depending on temperature of your waffle iron

title: sarah shipley s chicken pot pie
steps:
1. Toss cheese with flour
2. Combine cheese and almonds with turkey , celery , lemon juice , mayonnaise , poultry seasoning and salt
3. Mix well
4. If using refrigerated dough , follow mfg's directions
5. Line 8- or 9-inch pie plate with one of the pastry rounds
6. Fill with turkey mix
7. Top with second pastry round
8. Trim edges to 1 / 4-inch and crimp to seal
9. Flute as desired
10. Cut vents or decorative designs in top to allow steam to escape
11. Bake at 400f 30 to 35 minute

title: orange nut asparagus
steps:
1. Cook asparagus in boiling salted water until al dente , drain
2. Whisk together the dressing ingredients , top with walnuts , serve

title: pork strips
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl add the sugar and soy together
2. Make it more of a marinade sauce than a paste
3. Add the pork strips and refrigerate at least one hour or over night
4. When ready to cook add the extra virgin olive oil to a large skillet brown the pork then remove from the skillet add the tomatoes with green chilli , corn and mushrooms
5. Let them get warm
6. In a sauce pan bring the water to a boil then add the rice
7. When the veggies are warm add the sauce in the skillet along with the pork
8. Put the rice on the bottom of the plate then add the mixture of pork and veggie
9. Salt and pepper to your liking
10. Enjoy

title: quick quiche or pie crust
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in food processor , and pulse slowly until mixture is the size of peas
2. Slowly add in , 1 tbls
3. At a time , cold water until you can form it into a ball
4. Pat evenly into a 9 inch pie or quiche pan

title: nif s seared scallops
steps:
1. In a large nonstick frying pan , add olive oil and turn on low heat
2. Let oil warm
3. Add basil and let oil absorb flavour for 5 minutes
4. Turn heat to medium
5. Sprinkle scallops with salt and pepper and add to hot oil
6. Add butter and cook on each side for 2 minutes
7. Remove from heat and add to serving dish
8. Sprinkle with fresh lemon
9. Place chives over top and serve

title: grilled shrimp tacos
steps:
1. Whisk together the sour cream , mayonnaise , milk , and cumin
2. Set aside
3. Skewer the shrimp
4. In a small bowl , combine the butter and garlic
5. Preheat a gas grill to high
6. Adjust to medium after 15 minutes
7. Brush the skewered shrimp with the garlic butter
8. Place them on the grill with the limes
9. Cook about 4 minutes on each side or until the shrimp are opaque and the limes are browned
10. Remove from grill
11. Lightly salt the shrimp
12. Grill the tortillas for 30 seconds on each side , then place inside a paper bag to keep warm
13. To serve , pull the shrimp off the skewers and divide them evenly among the tortillas
14. Top with the cabbage , sour cream sauce , tomatillo salsa , and a spritz of grilled lime
15. Rainy-day method: broil the shrimp and limes about 4 inches from the heat using the cooking times above
16. Wrap the tortillas in foil and heat in a 350 f oven for 15 minutes , or wrap them in a napkin and microwave for 3 minutes

title: skillet pizzas
steps:
1. In a skillet , saute onion and green pepper in 1 teaspoon oil until almost tender
2. Add mushrooms
3. Cook 2-3 minutes longer
4. Remove and keep warm
5. In the same skillet , lightly brown one tortilla in 1 / 2 teaspoon oil
6. Turn over
7. Top with half of the pepperoni , tomatoes , onion mixture and cheese
8. Cover and cook until cheese is melter , about 2 minutes
9. Sprinkle wilth pepper flakes if desired
10. Repeat for second pizza

title: green tea mochi
steps:
1. Combine mochiko , sugar , gelatin , and maccha in a large bowl and mix
2. Add milk green tea and water , and mix througly with whisk or spoon
3. Pour into a 9x13" greased pan
4. Cover tightly with foil and bake at 350f for 55 minutes
5. Cool with cover on for 15 minutes
6. Remove foil and cool for several hours before cutting
7. Cut out outer hardened portion of the mochi , and then cut into 32 squares
8. Optional step: place 1 / 2 teaspoon of red bean paste in the middle of each square , fold square into triangle and press on the sides
9. Optional step: to improve presentation and add a bit of taste , soak 32 oak or sakura leaves in water , drain , and wrap around mochi pieces

title: pecan coconut sweet potaotes
steps:
1. Place sweet potatoes in a 3-qt
2. Slow cooker coated with cooking
3. Spray
4. In a small bowl combine the brown sugar , coconut , pecans ,
5. Vanilla , salt and cinnamon
6. Sprinkle over sweet potatoes
7. Drizzle
8. With butter
9. Cover and cook on low for 5-6 hours or until potatoes are tender ,
10. Sprinkling with marshmallows during last 5 minutes of cooking time

title: apple butter in a crock pot
steps:
1. Peel and slice enough apples until you fill your crock pot
2. Add 2 tablespoons of water to the pot to prevent sticking
3. Cook approximately 24-36 hours on low , stirring occasionally during the day
4. To cut cooking time , cook on high during the day , but reduce temperature to low over night
5. After the first day of cooking , add sugar to taste , approximately 2-1 / 2 to 3-cups
6. Continue to cook until thick and glossy
7. Stir in seasonings and cook for another hour
8. Ladle hot into jelly jars
9. Seal and put in 10-min
10. Water bath
11. And you can combine sweet and tart apples

title: baked german potato salad
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees f
2. Butter a 3-quart baking dish
3. Fry bacon
4. Drain drippings from skillet reserving 1 / 4 cup
5. Add celery , onions , salt and flour
6. Simmer , stirring constantly
7. Add sugar , vinegar , pepper and water
8. Bring to a boil
9. Toss bacon and potatoes together in the baking dish
10. Pour celery mixture over top
11. Cover and bake for 30 minutes

title: sesame seed cheese biscuits
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees f
2. Combine the biscuit mix , cheese , sesame seed and half and half in a bowl and mix well
3. Shape into balls and place on a greased baking sheet , flaten slightly with palm of hand
4. Brush with the melted butter
5. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes or until lightly browned

title: cranberried steak sauce   paula deen
steps: 1. Combine all the ingredients together and whisk or beat with an electic mixer until smooth

title: asian dumpling soup
steps:
1. In a 5- to 6-quart pan , add chicken broth , ginger , garlic , rice vinegar , and soy sauce
2. Bring to a boil over high heat
3. Add potstickers or won tons and simmer , uncovered , until hot in center , 6 to 8 minutes
4. Add sliced green onion
5. Serve in bowls and add asian sesame oil to taste

title: golden rum cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees f
2. Grease and flour a 10 inch bundt pan
3. Sprinkle chopped nuts evenly over the bottom of the pan
4. In a large bowl , combine cake mix and pudding mix
5. Mix in the eggs , 1 / 2 cup water , oil and 1 / 2 cup rum
6. Blend well
7. Pour batter over chopped nuts in the pan
8. Bake in the preheated oven for 60 minutes , or until a toothpick inserted into the cake comes out clean
9. Let sit for 10 minutes in the pan , then turn out onto serving plate
10. Brush glaze over top and sides
11. Allow cake to absorb glaze and repeat until all glaze is used
12. To make the glaze: in a saucepan , combine butter , 1 / 4 cup water and 1 cup sugar
13. Bring to a boil over medium heat and continue to boil for 5 minutes , stirring constantly
14. Remove from heat and stir in 1 / 2 cup rum

title: the skinny girl with fat appetite apple turnovers
steps:
1. Mix all filling ingredients
2. Place stacked sheets of phyllo on a flat surface and cover with plastic wrap to keep from drying out
3. Place 1 phyllo sheet on work surface
4. Lightly coat with nonstick cooking spray
5. Top with another sheet
6. Cut lengthwise in three 4-inch-wide strips
7. Move strips apart
8. Mound 1 heaping tablespoon filling at one end about 1-inch from corner
9. Fold opposite corner at same end over filling , forming a triangle
10. Continue folding your way up the strip , as you would a flag , to the end
11. Repeat with remaining phyllo and the filling
12. You'll have 12 turnovers
13. To bake freshly made or frozen turnovers: heat oven to 400-degrees f
14. Lightly coat a cookie sheet with nonstick cooking spray
15. Arrange turnovers seam-side down on prepared cookie sheet
16. Lightly spray tops with cooking spray
17. Sprinkle with cinnamon sugar
18. Bake 15 - 17 minutes , or until golden
19. Remove to wire rack to cool

title: prosciutto baked tilapia
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f lightly coat a rimmed baking sheet with cooking spray
2. Arrange four slices of prosciutto evenly spaced on the baking sheet
3. Place a second slice over each of the first four
4. Set one tilapia fillet over pair of prosciutto slices
5. Season the fish with salt and pepper , then drizzle each with about 1 / 2 tablespoon olive oil
6. Spoon a quarter of the diced red pepper over each fillet and spread it evenly
7. Starting at one end of each fillet , carefully roll it up , holding the prosciutto so that it wraps around the outside of the fish
8. Poke a toothpick through the center of each roll to help it hold together
9. Bake 20 to 25 minutes , or until the flesh feels firm and flakes easily

title: mussels and sweet leeks
steps:
1. Melt butter and olive oil in a large pan
2. Saute leeks and garlic until very soft , about 5 minutes
3. Add wine and turn up heat , for about 1 minute , until alcohol smell disappears
4. Add cream and bring back to a boil
5. Add mussels
6. Cover and cook until all mussels have opened
7. Discard any mussels that remain closed
8. Serve in a large bowl with crusty bread
9. Enjoy !

title: tasty apple pork chops   potatoes
steps:
1. Place pork chops in deep baking dish
2. Mix soup , apple juice or cider , onion , thyme , soy sauce and garlic powder and pour over chops
3. Bake at 325 degrees fahrenheit for approximately 1 1 / 2 hours or until chops are no longer pink
4. Optional: put oiled baking potatoes in the oven with chops , and they will be ready at the same time- dinner is served !

title: cheesy goodness in a bun
steps:
1. Brown the ground beef in a skillet until no longer pink , drain grease
2. Add soup , paremsan , and spices , simmer for 5 minutes
3. Stir in the velveeta until melted
4. Spoon 2-3 tbsp of beef mixture into each hotdog bun
5. Bake in an oven preheated to 350f until crispy , roughly 5-7 minutes

title: creamy orange shake
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in blender on high speed until thoroughly mixed
2. Pour into 4 glasses and serve immediately

title: pumpkin pie less
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl , blending well
2. Pour into 1-quart casserole dish or glass pie plate lightly sprayed with oil
3. Bake in preheated 400f oven for 50-60 minutes
4. Serve warm or at room temperature

title: my grilled caramel sandwich
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine the softened butter and brown sugar until combined well
2. Spread and pack down the mixture in between the slices of bread
3. Heat the skillet over med-high heat and add butter
4. Fry the sandwich until brown and the caramel has turned gooey
5. You will need to be very careful when flipping this sandwich , as it is not a "sticky" filling and could come apart very easily , but if you're careful and cook it long enough , the brown sugar and butter will turn into a caramel
6. Remove from the skillet and cut into fourths
7. Serve with a scoop of vanilla ice cream

title: shrimp etouffee  a 2 fay
steps:
1. Melt butter in heavy skillet , saute onion and bell pepper , add garlic , add tomato sauce and water
2. Bring to a boil and reduce until slightly thickened
3. Add shrimp and seasoning , cook until shrimp are pink , serve over cooked rice

title: easy italian supper
steps:
1. Heat a heavy nonstick pan over medium high heat
2. Add ground beef and cook
3. 4-5 minutes , stirring frequently until browned
4. Drain off excess fat
5. Add
6. Vegetables and pasta to pan
7. Reduce heat to low , cover pan and simmer 8-10 minutes ,
8. Or until vegetables are crisp-tender , stirring occasionally
9. Stir in sauce and simmer
10. 2 minutes , or until hot
11. Sprinkle with cheese before serving

title: chicken tortilla soup  in a flash
steps:
1. Spray saucepot with vegetable cooking spray and heat one minute
2. Add chicken and cook until browned , stirring often
3. Add broth , rice and cumin
4. Heat to a boil
5. Cover and cook over low heat for 20 minutes
6. Stir in corn , salsa , cilantro and lime juice and heat thoroughly
7. Top with crisp tortilla strips :
8. Crisp tortilla strips
9. Preheat oven to 425
10. Cut 4 corn tortillas into thin strips and place on baking sheet
11. Spray with vegetable cooking spray
12. Bake 10 minutes or till crispy-golden

title: seven layer jello
steps:
1. Dissolve 1 package jello in 1 cup boiling water
2. Add 1 / 2 cup cold water
3. Pour into a 9x12x2 inch pan and put into the refrigerator to set until firm
4. Bring 2 cups of milk to a boil , mix in a cup of sugar until sugar is dissolved
5. Dissolve 2 envelopes of knox gelatin in 1 / 4 cup of cold water and add to mixture
6. Add 2 cups sour cream , 2 teaspoons vanilla until blended
7. When mixture is fairly cool , pour 1-1 / 2 cups on top of first jello layer
8. Return pan to refrigerator until white layer is firm and completely set
9. Mix next package of jello as indicated in step 1
10. Pour onto completely set white layer
11. Return to refrigerator and allow to set completely
12. Again add 1-1 / 2 cups white mixture and return to refrigerator and allow to set completely
13. Mix third package of jello as indicated in step 1
14. Pour onto completely set white layer
15. Return to refrigerator and allow to set completely
16. Add remaining white mixture
17. Return to refrigerator and allow to set completely
18. Mix the last package of jello as indicated in step 1 and pour onto completely set white layer
19. Return to refrigerator and allow to set until firm

title: carolina red rice
steps:
1. Cook bacon
2. Remove from pan and crumble
3. Cook onions in bacon fat until tender
4. Add rice , tomatoes , seasoning and crumbled bacon
5. Cook on low heat about 35 minutes , stirring well
6. Stir with a fork several times while cooking
7. Check after 15 minutes and add water if needed

title: mexican mix up
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in a saucepan
2. Simmer for 25-30 minutes
3. Serve in bowls topped with shredded cheese and corn chips

title: cognac grilled striped sea bass
steps:
1. Dip steaks in cold , salted water and pat dry
2. Marinate in remaining ingredients for 1 hour , reserving marinade for basting
3. Place on grill racks sprayed with cooking oil spray or in fish basket over hot coals for approximately 12 minutes , turning once
4. Baste frequently while cooking
5. Fish will flake easily with fork when done

title: banana jubilee pie
steps:
1. Prepare pie-crust , bake and cool
2. Mix sugar , flour , and salt in a medium heavy saucepan
3. Slowly stir in scalded milk
4. Cook , stirring constantly , over medium heat until mixture thickens and boils 1 minute
5. Remove from heat
6. Beat eggs in a small bowl
7. Slowly stir in cup of the hot mixture
8. Stir back into the pan
9. Cook stirring constantly , over medium heat 3 minutes , or until mixture thickens again and mounds softly
10. Remove from heat
11. Stir in butter or margarine and vanilla
12. Cool
13. Peel and slice one banana and place in the bottom of the baked pie-crust
14. Spread half of the custard over the banana
15. Repeat with another banana and remaining filling
16. Cover with plastic wrap and chill in the refrigerator 4-5 hours or until set
17. Just before serving , peel and slice diagonally the remaining banana and arrange in a rosette on the top center of the pie
18. Top with one or two spoonfuls of the jubilee sauce and / or whipped cream , if desired
19. Serve with remaining sauce , if desired
20. Optional jubilee sauce:
21. Drain syrup from cherries into a 1-cup measuring cup
22. Add water to make 1 cup
23. Set cherries aside
24. Mix sugar and cornstarch in a small saucepan
25. Stir in cherry liquid
26. Cook , stirring constantly , until sauce thickens and boils 3 minutes
27. Stir in rum extract or flavoring and cherries
28. Cool

title: campfire coconut macaroon cake
steps:
1. Using a bread knife , trim all crust off the loaf of bread
2. Cut bread into approximately 2-inch cubes
3. Pour sweetened condensed milk into a pie pan or shallow bowl
4. Place some coconut into pie pan or onto a plate
5. Evenly coat bread cube with sweetened condensed milk , letting any excess drain off over dish
6. Lightly pat cube into coconut makeing sure that coconut adheres to all sides
7. Place cube onto a long toasting skewer or sharpened stick
8. Turn slowly , over the hot coals , until coconut is toasted brown
9. Remove from skewer and enjoy
10. Caution: let cool slightly as the sugars in the milk and coconut can be quite hot right out of the fire

title: homemade silky chocolate pudding
steps:
1. In a heavy-bottomed saucepan , stir together granulated sugar , cocoa , cornstarch and salt slowly pour in 1 cups milk , stirring or whisking to create a lump-free mixture stir in 1 cup heavy cream
2. Place saucepan over medium heat and , stirring gently and continuously scraping bottom and sides of pan , bring mixture to a boil remove from heat
3. Stir in 1 teaspoon vanilla extract
4. Pour pudding into stemmed glasses or custard cups or other container
5. Chill at least 1 hour

title: deep fried avocados
steps:
1. Combine all batter ingredients
2. Dust avocado wedges with flour
3. Put wedges into batter mixture until coated
4. Fry in deep fat fryer until lightly browned-about two minutes
5. Serve with sour cream and salsa

title: assyrian chicken and potatoes with yellow rice
steps:
1. Mix turmeric , cinnamon , cumin , salt , paprika , and parsley together
2. Rub mixture all over chicken
3. Saute onion in butter and oil
4. L add garlic
5. Brown chicken
6. Take out put in a casserole dish
7. Add cooked potatoes and cook until lightly browned
8. Put potatoes in casserole dish over chicken
9. Cover with foil
10. Bake at 375 degrees fahrenheit for 40 minutes
11. Uncover
12. Bake another 20 minutes
13. Start rice when you uncover chicken
14. Heat oil
15. Add rinsed rice and turmeric
16. Fry until puffed not burned
17. Add boiling water
18. Bring to a boil
19. Cover
20. Cook 20 minutes
21. Serve under chicken
22. Bake
23. Cover

title: country cooking cheesy vegetable soup
steps:
1. Melt butter in a large heavy saucepan over low heat
2. Add flour
3. Cook and stir until think and bubbly
4. Remove from the heat
5. Gradually blend in broth
6. Return to the heat
7. Cook and stir until the mixture comes to a boil
8. Cook and stir 1 minute longer
9. Add the next seven ingredients
10. Reduce heat
11. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes or until vegetables are tender
12. In a small bowl , beat egg yolk and cream
13. Gradually stir in several tablespoons of hot soup
14. Warning , adding the cream mixture directly to the soup will cause it to curdle , it is important for you to add the soup to the cream mixture in order to prevent this from happening
15. Once the cream mixture is hot , return all to pan , stirring until slightly thickened
16. Simmer 15-20 minutes longer
17. Stir in cheese and heat over medium just until melted

title: pork shoulder roast in cider pressure cooker
steps:
1. Season the roast with salt and pepper
2. Heat oil in a 10-quart pressure cooker , over med-high heat
3. Sear the roast on all sides
4. Add all ingredients , except flour to pan , arranging potatoes on top of roast
5. Close and lock lid
6. Bring to pressure and cook for 45 minutes at high pressure
7. Release pressure using natural release method
8. This may take about 10 minutes
9. Remove vegies and roast from pan and keep warm
10. Mix about 2 tbls flour with a little cold water and stir into sauce , cooking until thickened
11. Carve meat and serve with vegies and gravy

title: tami s yummy flank steak marinade
steps:
1. Mix first 7 ingredients i use my trusty tupperware shaker !
2. Take a sharp knife and pierce meat along the grain on both sides
3. Mix ginger , onion and garlic and rub on both sides
4. Place in large glass dish and pour marinade over and refrigerate for 8-10 hours , turning once

title: brown sugar glazed winter squash
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f and adjust oven rack to upper-middle position and place baking sheet on rack to preheat
2. Divide squash in half lengthwise and remove seeds
3. Remove preheated baking sheet from oven and place squash halves on it cut side down
4. Return to oven immediately and roast until tender and flesh is easily pierced through skin with skewer , 40 to 50 minutes
5. Remove from oven and flip squash so cut side is up and set oven to broil
6. In small bowl , whisk together the butter and sugar
7. Brush butter mixture on squash , sprinkle with salt and pepper , and place under broiler until browned and crisp , about 5 minutes
8. Serve
9. Variation for small winter squash
10. Follow recipe above using 2 medium acorn , delicata , or sweet dumpling squash
11. Reduce roasting time to 20 to 30 minutes
12. Reduce butter and brown sugar to 3 tablespoons each

title: easy applesauce muffins
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375 degrees
2. Spray muffin tins with nonstick spray
3. Mix flour , sugar , baking powder , cinnamon , and salt in a bowl
4. Mix in beaten eggs , applesauce and melted butter
5. Evenly scoop mixture into muffin pans
6. Sprinkle crystal sugar sprinkles on tops of muffins
7. Bake for 18 to 20 minutes
8. Test to see if toothpick comes out clean

title: buffalo chicken and potatoes
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees
2. Spray 13x9-inch baking dish with cooking spray
3. In medium bowl , stir together chicken strips and buffalo wing sauce
4. In large bowl , stir together potatoes , dressing , cheese and soup
5. Spoon into baking dish
6. Place chicken strips evenly over potato mixture
7. In small bowl , stir together crumbs and butter
8. Sprinkle over chicken
9. Sprinkle green onions on top
10. Cover with foil
11. Bake 30 minutes
12. Uncover and bake 20-25 minutes longer until potatoes are tender and chcken juices run clear
13. Enjoy !

title: california chicken pockets
steps:
1. Cook and drain broccoli
2. In medium bowl , combine chicken , broccoli , avocado , rice , tomatoes , cheese and egg
3. In small bowl , stir together mayonnaise , mustard and celery seed
4. Pour over mixture and toss to coat
5. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour to blend
6. To serve , spoon approx 1 / 2 cup mixture into each pock bread half

title: salmon salad for sandwiches
steps: 1. Mix all together and put on sandwiches or use as a dip

title: paula deen s canned cranberries plus
steps:
1. In a medium-sized bowl , gently fold together the cranberries , mandarin oranges , walnuts and pecans
2. Refrigerate
3. Serve chilled
4. When paula demonstrated this recipe , she mentioned she liked walnuts best and didn't use pecans
5. She did not use 2 cups of nuts either , which leads me to believe you can tinker some with this recipe !

title: moroccan rice pilaf with saffron
steps:
1. In a sauce pan , heat the stock almost to boiling
2. Meanwhile , mix the remaining ingredients in a very large skillet or shallow stock pot
3. Cook the rice and vegetables over medium heat , stirring frequently , for about 10 minutes , or until the onions are translucent and the rice begins to color
4. Add the stock and saffron to the rice , stirring only once
5. Bring the stock to a simmer , and taste for salt
6. Adjust the seasoning if desired
7. Cover the rice , reduce the heat to low , and simmer gently and undisturbed , for about 25 minutes , or until the liquid is absorbed and the rice is tender
8. Fluff the rice with a fork , and serve

title: sour cream date pie
steps:
1. Combine sour cream , sugar , salt , nutmeg , eggs , and brandy
2. Beat until smooth
3. Add the dates and nuts and blend well
4. Pour into pie shell
5. Bake in a 425 degree f
6. Oven for 10 minutes , then reduce heat to 325 degrees f
7. And continue baking for 25 minutes , or until firm

title: splenda walnut date oatmeal
steps:
1. Bring water to a boil in a small saucepan
2. Stir in oats and salt
3. Cook , stirring occasionally , over medium heat 5 minutes
4. Sprinkle 2 teaspoons splenda brand brown sugar blend , 1 tablespoon chopped dates , and 1 tablespoon chopped toasted walnuts over hot cooked oatmeal
5. Drizzle with 1 tablespoon skim milk
6. Microwave directions
7. Combine water , oats , and salt in a microwave-safe bowl
8. Cover tightly with heavy-duty plastic wrap
9. Fold back a small edge to allow steam to escape
10. Microwave on high 2 1 / 2 to 3 minutes
11. Stir before serving

title: mediterranean lamb chops
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f
2. Using a pestle and mortar or wooden spoon and bowl , pound together the fresh mint , fresh rosemary and the garlic , then mix with 1 tbsp olive oil
3. Smear over four lamb chops or cutlets
4. Place the eggplant , zucchini and red bell pepper on to a baking sheet
5. Drizzle with 1 tbsp olive oil and place the lamb chops on top
6. Bake in the oven for 20-25 minutes
7. Top the chops with feta cheese and add the cherry tomatoes to the pan
8. Cook for a further 10 minutes until the cheese just starts to brown
9. Serve the chops with the roasted vegetables , toasted ciabatta bread and mixed leaf salad

title: curried spinach salad
steps:
1. Remove stems from spinach
2. Wash leaves thoroughly , and pat dry
3. Tear into bite size pieces
4. Combine spinach , apple , peanuts , raisins , green onions , and sesame seeds in a large bowl
5. Toss gently
6. Dressing: combine white wine vinegar , chutney , salt , curry powder , dry mustard , and hot sauce
7. Gradually add oil , beating with a wire whisk until blended
8. Cover and let stand at room temperature 2 hours
9. Pour dressing over salad just before serving

title: baked cod portuguese
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 375f or 190c and grease an ovenproof dish
2. Sprinkle the cod with salt , pepper and garlic powder then set aside
3. Fry the onion , garlic and pepper in a pan to soften
4. Add the tomatoes and paprika and simmer for about 5 minutes until the sauce is thickened
5. Taste and add salt and pepper if required
6. Put your cod in the dish , pour the tomato sauce over and bake in the oven for about 20 minutes until the cod is cooked
7. Sprinkle the parsley over and serve

title: crock pot cranberry brisket
steps:
1. Rub brisket with salt , pepper and thyme
2. Place in a 5-qt slow cooker
3. In a bowl , combine all remaining ingredients and mix well
4. Pour over brisket in slow cooker
5. Cook on low for 8-10 hours or until tender and done

title: morning breakfast panini
steps:
1. Preheat an electric panini maker on high heat according to the manufacturer's instructions
2. Place the bread slices on a cutting board
3. Brush one side of each slice with melted butter
4. Turn one slice over and sprinkle with the cheese
5. Top with the bacon and fried egg , and season with salt and pepper
6. Top with the arugula and the other bread slice , buttered side up
7. Place the sandwich on the preheated panini maker and cook according to the manufacturers instructions until the bread is golden and the cheese is melted , 3 to 5 minutes
8. Transfer the sandwich to a cutting board and cut in half
9. Serve immediately
10. Serves 1

title: zucchini cranberrry bread
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees
2. Greas large loaf pan and dust with flour
3. Whisk together the egg , egg white , buttermilk and oil
4. In large bowl , combine the flour , whole-wheat flour , splenda granules , cinnamon , baking soda and salt
5. Gently mix the wet and dry ingredients together
6. Stir in the zucchini and cranberries inches pour in to the prepared loaf pan
7. Bake 30 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean

title: sopa dourada  portuguese christmas golden soup
steps:
1. Mix the sugar with the water and bring to the boil to make a thick syrup
2. Remove from the heat
3. Using a slotted spoon , dip each slice of cake into the syrup , and place them on a large serving dish
4. Beat the egg yolks and mix them with the remaining syrup
5. Bring to heat for one moment and stir , only to thicken , without allowing the yolks to curdle
6. Pour this custard over the slices , sprinkle with cinnamon and serve cold
7. Enjoy !

title: dilled corn and peas
steps:
1. Place peas , corn , red pepper and water in a saucepan
2. Cover and cook over high heat for 2-4 minutes or until vegetables are crisp-tender
3. Drain
4. Add butter , dill , salt and pepper
5. Toss to coat

title: crock pot cranberry pork roast and gravy
steps:
1. Rub salt and black pepper onto pork loin and place in crock pot
2. Add all of remaining ingredients except cornstarch and water
3. Turn crock pot on high for 1 hour and then cook on low for 5-6 hours
4. Mix cornstarch and water in small bowl and add last 15 minutes of cooking time which will help make the gravy
5. Remove loin onto a serving plate
6. This recipe will go well with rice , potatoes or noodles

title: ranch chicken stuffed baked potatoes  rsc
steps:
1. Cut chicken into 1" cubes or smaller and put in large zip-lock bag
2. Add greek yogurt and packet of ranch seasoning mix to bag and let marinate in refrigerator for 1-3 hours
3. Cook marinated chicken in large skillet till fully cooked
4. Add frozen spinach and continue heating
5. Remove from stove and stir in cream cheese
6. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
7. Cut small layer off the top of each baked potato and scoop out most of the potato
8. Put some cheese at the bottom of each potato and fill wit chicken mixture
9. Cover opening with the rest of the cheese and top with turkey bacon crumbles
10. Bake in oven for 15 minutes or until cheese is melty
11. Top with shallots and serve hot

title: burnt sage butter sauce for gnocchi
steps:
1. Cook chopped butter until melted in a large frying pan , then add sage leaves
2. Cook butter and sage leaves , swirling pan often , for 4-5min or until sage leaves are crisp and butter deep nut-brown colour
3. Season to taste with salt and pepper
4. Add gnocchi to frying pan and toss to coat in burnt sage butter

title: rhubarb juice
steps:
1. Wash and cut red rhubarb as tou would for a pie
2. Cover with water and boil until soft
3. Drain through jelly bag
4. Measure 11 cups juice and 1 cup sugar
5. Bring to boil
6. Seal in sterilized jars

title: broccoli and cheddar bow ties
steps:
1. Cook pasta in boiling water until just tender
2. Stir in broccoli and drain immediately and return to pot
3. Whisk flour , salt and pepper into milk and pour over pasta
4. Stir in mustard and cook stirring over medium-high heat for 5 minute or until thickened
5. Remove from heat and stir in cheese until melted

title: pork and pineapple stir fry
steps:
1. Prepare rice according to package instructions and keep warm
2. Should give you about 4 cups prepared
3. Mix 2 tablespoons cornstarch with 2 tablespoons soy sauce and ginger and coat pork
4. Drain pineapple keeping a 1 / 2 cup of the juice and set pineapple aside
5. Combine the 1 / 2 cup of pineapple juice with 1 tablespoon cornstarch and 1 / 4 cup soy sauce and set aside
6. Heat oil and stir fry pork for 2 minutes
7. Add peas and pepper and stir fry another 2 minutes
8. Add sauce mixture and pineapple and cook on medium heat until it boils and thickens
9. Serve over rice

title: chicken   cashew fettuccini
steps:
1. Cook fettuccini in boiling salted water
2. Cut chicken into strips
3. Preheat a large skillet , add oil , and when hot add onion and garlic
4. Gently saute about 5 minutes , until soft
5. Add mushrooms and saute 4 minutes
6. Remove onion , garlic and mushrooms from pan
7. Add chicken and toss to seal
8. Add the stock: replace onion , garlic and mushrooms
9. Cook over a gentle heat 5 minutes until chicken strips are cooked through
10. Add spinach , cover and let spinach wilt for about a minute
11. Swirl in the pesto and lemon juice
12. Taste and adjust for seasoning
13. Meanwhile , drain fettuccini and place into individual bowls
14. Spoon the chicken and sauce over
15. Sprinkle with cashew nuts parmesan and serve

title: springtime spinach salad
steps:
1. Place asparagus in a foil lined 1
2. 5 inch x 10 inch x 1 inch baking pan
3. Sprinkle with olive oil and toss to coat
4. Bake , uncovered , at 400 degrees for 15 minutes or until crisp-tender , turning occasionally
5. Cool
6. In a large bowl , combine the spinach , strawberries , walnuts , asparagus
7. In a jar with a tight fitting lid , combine the vegetable oil , vinegar , sugar and salt
8. Shake well
9. Drizzle over salad and toss to coat
10. Serve immediately

title: low fat apple spice cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Spray bundt pan with non stick cooking spray
3. Combine all ingredients in bowl using hand mixer , until well blended
4. The apples should be pretty well pulverized
5. Pour into bundt pan
6. Bake for approximately 40 minutes

title: cream of chicken and celery soup  cheating
steps:
1. Heat chicken and celery soup with milk and water , do not boil
2. Add chicken , heat in soup , taste and add extra milk if needed
3. Sprinkle with parsley and serve with croutons

title: simple and fresh collard greens
steps:
1. Chop your greens into 1 inch strips that are no longer than 4 or 5 inches long
2. Rinse your greens
3. Heat your skillet to medium and spray or add oil , and garlic if wanted
4. Then just add your greens and stir just until all greens have just turned bright green , usually not more than 3~ minutes
5. Turn up to medium-hot and fry for 30 more seconds or until greens are just tender
6. Toss with salt and pepper to taste
7. Serve with your favorite entree :) !

title: brown sugar bread pudding with creme anglaise
steps:
1. Whisk together egg whites and egg in a medium bowl until blended
2. Whisk in reduced-fat milk and next 7 ingredients
3. Arrange bread cubes in an 8-inch square pan coated with cooking spray
4. Pour egg mixture evenly over bread
5. Sprinkle evenly with 4 teaspoons brown sugar , butter , and almonds
6. Press down gently on bread cubes , and let stand 10 minutes
7. Bake at 350 for 30 to 35 minutes or until a knife inserted in center comes out clean
8. Serve warm with 2 tablespoons chilled crme anglaise per serving
9. Garnish , if desired
10. Creme anglaise:
11. Heat milk in a medium saucepan over medium heat just until bubbles and steam appear
12. Remove from heat
13. Whisk together sugar and egg yolks in a medium bowl until blended
14. Gradually add heated milk to egg yolk mixture , whisking constantly
15. Return mixture to saucepan
16. Cook over medium heat , whisking constantly , 6 minutes or until mixture thinly coats the back of a spoon
17. Pour mixture into a bowl
18. Stir in vanilla
19. Place plastic wrap directly on surface of mixture , and chill at least 4 hours
20. Stir in bourbon before serving

title: polynesian pork and rice
steps:
1. Cut the pork in 1-inch cubes
2. Mix the flour , salt and pepper
3. Coat the pork with the flour mixture using all the flour
4. Brown in oil in a large pan
5. Slice the celery and onion
6. Slice the peppers into thin strips
7. Add the vegetables to the pan along with the remaining ingredients
8. Simmer covered for 30 minutes
9. Serve over rice
10. Enjoy !

title: herb roasted red potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425f
2. Wash and cut potatoes into quarters or about 1 inch pieces
3. Mix olive oil , and italian seasoning in small bowl
4. Rub rosemary between fingers to grind into oil mixture
5. Toss potatoes with oil to coat
6. Place in baking pan , season with salt and pepper to taste
7. Bake at 425f on lower rack for about 25 min , stir once , and cook until golden about another 20- 25 minutes

title: frangelico chocolate cake
steps:
1. Sprinkle nuts over bottom of greased 10 inch tube pan or 12 cup bundt pan
2. Stir together cake mix , pudding mix , eggs , water , oil and frangelico
3. Pour batter over nuts
4. Bake at 325 in oven for 1 hour
5. Cool 10 minutes in pan
6. Invert onto serving plate and prick top
7. Glaze-----------------
8. Melt butter in saucepan
9. Stir in water and sugar
10. Boil 5 minutes , stirring constantly
11. Remove from heat
12. Stir in rum
13. Brush glaze evenly over top and sides of cake
14. Allow cake to absorb glaze
15. Repeat until glaze is used up

title: fresh ginger cake
steps:
1. Position rack in lower third of oven and preheat to 350f
2. Generously grease a ring mold pan and dust generously with flour
3. Sift the flour , baking soda and salt and set aside
4. Whisk the egg just enough to combine the yolk and white [think egg beaters dear]
5. Pour the molasses , corn syrup ans water into a cup and stir to combine
6. Place butter in bowl of mixer and with paddle attachment cream on medium until it clings and looks satiny
7. Add the sugar and scrape the bowl
8. Contine to cream at med speed for 2 to 3 minutes or until light and fluffy
9. Keep mixer at med add the egg a tbsp at a time
10. Stop the mixer and scrape the bowl at least once
11. After a couple minutes the mix should be light and fluffy and increased in volume remove the beater
12. Scrape batter off beater stir in lemon zest and the ginger
13. Using a rubber spatula stir a quarter of the flour mix inches
14. Add 1 / 3 molasses mix
15. Stir to blend
16. Repeat
17. Alternate the dry and liquid and end with the flour
18. Scrape bowl often
19. You want a smooth mix before the new addition
20. Pour into mold
21. Spread slightly higher toward edges
22. Bake 35 to 37 minutes or until sides begin to pull away and surface springs back when touched
23. Yes the tootpick should come out clean
24. Place the cake on a rack to cool for 5 to 10 minutes
25. With mitts , tilt and rotate the mold and gently tap it on the counter to see if the cake is releasing from the sides of the mold
26. If not , run a small metal spatula or the blade of a table knife around the outer edge to loosen the cake from the mold
27. Invert the cake onto a rack covered with parchment
28. Remove mold
29. Cool completely
30. Decorate cake in pattern with powered sugar in a sieve
31. Transfer to serving platter
32. The original poster recommended cream cheese frosting
33. I do not
34. For the traditional manner sprinkle with confectioners sugar in a pleasing pattern or serve plain
35. The cream cheese frosting makes it too rich
36. This is not intended to be a rich overpowering cake
37. To veganize and it works well with this recipe: use egg sub such as energ in place of the egg and use a vegan butter sub in place of the butter
38. To low fat use egg sub and use take control light spread in place of the butter
39. [i am not certain that is vegan without checking the package but it is low fat
40. ]
41. The cake is very forgiving
42. Do watch your time

title: tuscan beef stew
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients except for the beans in crock pot
2. Cover and cook on low 8-9 hours
3. Stir in beans
4. Turn heat to high and cook 10 minutes

title: mrs  k s toll house pecan pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degree f
2. In a medium size bowl , mix karo syrup , sugar , butter , and eggs
3. Add salt and vanilla
4. Set aside
5. Sprinkle dry pecans over the bottom of the pastry shell
6. Pour liquid mixture evenly over the top of the pecans
7. Bake at 400 degrees f for 10 minutes then at 375 degrees f for 30 minutes or until set
8. Cool
9. Serve with whipped cream

title: caramelized baked chicken legs wings
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit or 180 degrees celsius
2. Place chicken in a 9x13 inch baking dish
3. Mix together the oil , soy sauce , ketchup , honey , garlic , salt and pepper
4. Pour over the chicken
5. Bake in preheated oven for one hour , or until sauce is caramelized
6. Could also use wings or pork ribs

title: the real  black tie mousse cake by olive garden
steps:
1. There are four layers to make:
2. Bottom layer :
3. Bake according to directions on box using 2 round pans , then cool
4. Once cooled , use the cake from one pan as one layer
5. Place this round cake at the bottom of a cheesecake pan
6. Press it with your fingers and flatten the cake a little
7. This is the bottom layer out of four layers
8. Second layer :
9. Melt chocolate and cream cheese together
10. Let cool
11. Soften gelatin with cold water for 1 minute , then add boiling water , stir until dissolved and clear
12. Let this cool while you start whipping the heavy cream and sugar
13. As cream starts to thicken , add gelatin
14. Continue to whip until stiff peaks form
15. Add 1 / 4 of the cream to the chocolate mixture and mix thoroughly
16. Then fold this into the remaining cream
17. Once you have it completed , spread this chocolate mousse onto the cake and refrigerate
18. Third layer :
19. Beat egg yolks until pale
20. Add sugar , flour , and gelatin , then beat until mixed
21. Bring cream and vanilla extract to a boil
22. Add a small amount of cream to egg mixture while stirring
23. Gradually add until all of the cream has been added and then pour entire mixture through a strainer into the pan
24. Continue to cook until custard begins to thicken
25. Cool slightly , then pour on top of the chocolate mousse layer and freeze while getting the fourth layer ready
26. Fourth layer :
27. Please
28. Bring butter and cream to a boil , pour over chocolate and let sit for 5 minutes
29. Stir until smooth
30. Let cool until it starts to thicken
31. Remove cake from freezer , remove the cheesecake pan collar , then pour some of the icing and use a spatula to spread it evenly across the top and sides of the cake
32. While this is still wet , put chocolate chips onto the side of the cake
33. Optional: melt half a cup of white chocolate chips and swirl into the icing if you want yours to look like the picture
34. Refrigerate the cake
35. Be sure to see the picture
36. Serve cold
37. Delicious !
38. Enjoy ! --adrienne

title: apple butter spice cookies
steps:
1. Combine flour , baking powder , baking soda , salt , and cinnamon
2. Set aside
3. Combine sugar and shortening
4. Cream until light and fluffy
5. Beat in egg
6. Stir in apple butter
7. Add dry ingredients
8. Mix well
9. Stir in raisins and nuts
10. Drop dough by heaping teaspoons onto lightly greased baking sheets
11. Bake at 375 degrees for 10 minutes
12. Cool on racks

title: veggies in garlic butter
steps:
1. Melt butter on very low heat in large frying pan
2. Add garlic and washed / cut vegetables
3. Cook vegetables at medium heat for a few minutes , mixing in garlic butter
4. Cover with a lid , lower heat , and cook to desired doneness
5. Place on plate
6. Sprinkle with salt and pepper to taste

title: carolina mustard bbq and basting sauce
steps:
1. Combine first 7 ingredients in a heavy saucepan
2. Bring to a simmer
3. Do not boil otherwise the sugar will scorch !
4. Continue to simmer for 20 minutes , stirring frequently
5. Add the rest of the ingredients and continue to simmer for an additional 20 minutes , stirring frequently
6. Pour into an air-tight jar and refrigerate overnight to allow the flavors to blend

title: pretty stuffed spring peas
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine the first seven ingredients
2. Cover and refrigerate overnight
3. Let filling stand at room temperature for 30 minutes
4. Meanwhile , in a large saucepan , bring 6 cups water to a boil
5. Add snow peas
6. Cover and boil for 1-2 minutes
7. Drain and immediately place peas in ice water
8. Drain and pat dry
9. Gently split peas open , pipe about 1 teaspoon of filling into each pod

title: crepes made easy
steps:
1. With a whisk , beat eggs till well mixed and then start to add the flour
2. Add enough to thicken the batter to the consistency of a thick cake batter
3. Then slowly start to mix in the milk
4. Add enough milk to thin the batter out to the consistency of half and half
5. Add salt , and for sweet crepes , the sugar and vanilla
6. Mix
7. Heat a 9 inch nonstick pan over med
8. To med / high heat
9. Spray with non stick spray or grease with a small drop of butter
10. Using a small ladle or a 1 / 3 measuring cup , lift pan off stove and pour measured batter in , quickly swirling the batter to coat the pan
11. Keep swirling the pan till all the batter has solidified
12. Return to heat
13. Cook approximately 1- 2 minutes
14. You can flip and cook other side for another 45 sec
15. Or just remove to a plate
16. Repeat with remaining batter
17. Fill with whatever you would like
18. My personal favorite is after flipping the crepe , i break an egg on the crepe and quickly scramble it and spread it out over the crepe , being careful not to tear the crepe
19. Add salt and pepper then a slice of ham and a bit of cheese
20. Wait a minute for the egg to cook and the cheese to melt and then fold in half and half again
21. Oh so good ! my kids love sugar and cinnamon or jam , my husband loves lemon and sugar
22. And lets not forget nutella with bananas and toasted almonds

title: cannellini and smoked sausage salad
steps:
1. Whisk together the vinegar and mustard and incorporate the oil into the mixture slowly
2. Toss in the remaining ingredients together with the dressing chill until ready to serve

title: cocoa krispies  biscotti
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f and line two baking sheets with foil or parchment paper
2. In large mixing bowl , combine sugar , butter and vanilla
3. Beat on medium speed of electric mixer until creamy
4. Add eggs , one at a time , beating well after each addition
5. Add flour , cocoa powder , chocolate chips , baking powder and salt
6. Beat on low speed until combined
7. Stir in cocoa krispies cereal
8. Shape dough into two 8-inch long rolls
9. Place on 2 baking sheets lined with foil or parchment paper
10. Bake at 350f for 30 minutes
11. Cool slightly
12. Reduce oven temperature to 300f
13. Diagonally cut each roll into 3 / 4-inch thick slices
14. Place slices cut side down on baking sheets lined with the foil or parchment paper
15. Bake at 300f for 10 minutes
16. Turn slices and bake about 10 minutes more or until firm
17. Transfer to a wire rack to cool completely

title: parmigiano regianno with fruit and aged balsamic
steps:
1. Cut the apple and pear into thin matchsticks
2. Place the fruit in a bowl and add the olive oil and lemon juice
3. Toss to coat
4. Season with salt and pepper
5. Divide the fruit mixture onto 4 salad plates
6. Break the cheese into about 8-12 equal chunks
7. For each salad plate , place 2-3 chunks of the parmigiano-reggiano cheese
8. Garnish with the fresh basil
9. Drizzle the vinegar around the cheese , then sprinkle salad lightly with cracked black pepper
10. Serve at room temperature

title: western beef casserole au gratin
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f
2. Lightly grease 2 1 / 2 or 3 quart casserole
3. In large skillet , brown ground beef and onion
4. Drain well
5. Add tomato sauce , garlic powder , 1 / 4 teaspoons salt and pepper
6. Blend well
7. Spoon into greased casserole
8. Spoon corn evenly over meat mixture
9. In medium saucepan , combine water , butter and 1 / 2 teaspoons salt
10. Bring to a rolling boil
11. Remove from heat
12. Stir in milk and potato flakes with fork until potatoes are desired consistency
13. Stir in green chiles
14. Spread potato mixture evenly over corn
15. Sprinkle with cheese
16. Bake at 350f for 30-35 minutes or until cheese is melted and bubbly around edges
17. Let stand 5 minutes
18. Top with chopped tomato

title: sweet potato tzimmes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Lightly grease a 3-quart casserole or baking dish with non-stick cooking oil spray
3. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil
4. Add the carrots and sweet potatoes
5. Cover , and reduce the heat to medium-low
6. Cook about 15 minutes , until the vegetables are easily pierced with a fork
7. Meanwhile , in a medium bowl , combine the orange juice , honey , salt , and cinnamon
8. Set aside
9. Drain the vegetables and transfer them to the prepared baking dish
10. Add the prunes and toss gently
11. Stir the orange juice mixture and drizzle over the top
12. Sprinkle with the butter pieces
13. Cover with aluminum foil and bake 20 to 25 minutes , stirring once or twice , until warmed through
14. If the tzimmes becomes dry , add a few more tablespoons of orange juice

title: inside out chicken korma kievs
steps:
1. Place the chicken on a baking tray
2. Rub with a little of the butter , season , then cook under a heated grill / broiler for 15 minutes , turning just once until cooked through
3. Mix together the remaining garlic butter , korma paste and the breadcrumbs
4. Remove the chicken from the grill , then top each breast with a smear of the breadcrumbed butter
5. Return to the grill and cook for 3 to 5 minutes until the breadcrumbs are golden and the butter melted
6. Serve the chicken and all of the buttery juices with some potatoes and veg if you like

title: cheddar spirals
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to package directions
2. Drain
3. In a 5-qt
4. Slow cooker , combine the cream , soup and butter until smooth
5. Stir in the cheese and pasta
6. Cover and cook on low for 2-1 / 2 hours or until cheese is melted

title: sauteed green beans with lemon and walnuts
steps:
1. Toast the walnuts in a medium-heat iron skillet , on the stove top , stirring constantly until fragrant ~ be careful they don't burn !
2. Steam beans until barely tender but still crisp , about 3 minutes
3. In a saute pan , heat the butter , salt , lemon zest , lemon juice , and chicken stock over medium-high heat for 2 minutes
4. Add the beans and simmer until beans are cooked through , about 2 minutes more
5. Top beans with the walnuts and serve
6. Makes 4 servings

title: shrimp medley with saffron sauce
steps:
1. While cooking pasta to al dente , in a 2 cup glass measuring cup combine wine and saffron
2. Let stand 15 minutes
3. In a large skillet , over medium heat , cook and stir shrimp in oil until shrimp are pink
4. Remove from skillet
5. In same skillet add wine mixture and shallots
6. Brink to a boil
7. Continue boiling rapidly until most of the liquid is absorbed
8. Stir in cream and bouillon
9. Bring to a boil and boil 5 minutes or until thickened
10. Stirring constantly
11. Stir in pasta , asparagus and shrimp
12. Heat through
13. Top with chives
