title: awesome asparagus
steps:
1. In medium fry pan , heat oil and butter on med-high heat
2. Place asparagus in pan trying to get in a single layer so all can cook evenly
3. Season with the salt and pepper , cover with a lid to help "steam" the asparagus for about 5-6 minutes , tossing occasionally with tongs
4. When done to your likeness of crisp or tender , toss in the parmesan cheese and serve immediately

title: all in one bolognaise
steps:
1. Heat oil in large pot
2. Saute onion till tender
3. Add mince and brown well , breaking up lumps
4. Stir in sauce , mushrooms , wine and seasonings
5. Bring to the boil
6. Reduce heat and stir in pasta
7. Simmer for 20 minutes
8. Serve with grated cheese

title: vegetable lasagna rolls
steps:
1. In a large skillet , heat oil over medium high heat
2. Add carrots and onion
3. Cook , stirring , 5 minutes
4. Add broccoli , salt and pepper
5. Cook , stirring , 3 minutes
6. Remove from heat and cool for 10 minutes
7. Meanwhile , cook noodles according to directions
8. Drain and rinse under cold water
9. Stir 1 cup provolone cheese , ricotta , and egg into broccoli mixture
10. Lay out lasagna noodle , spread with mixture , roll up , placing in baking pan on coating of tomato sauce
11. Continue until all noodles are rolled up and in pan
12. Cover with sauce
13. Cover pan , baking at 350 degrees for 30 minutes
14. Remove cover , sprinkle with remaining provolone cheese if desired , and bake for an additional 15 minutes
15. Enjoy !

title: bloated bag of monkey spunk
steps:
1. Shake and strain into a collins glass with ice
2. Garnish with cherry

title: golden yellow cake
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
2. Grease 2 cake pans with shortening and set aside
3. Cream the butter and sugar together , add 2 tablespoons of the 4 tablespoons of vegetable oil in 1 of the 2 bowls
4. Then mix the egg yolks one by one , completely mix them--do not add another one until the one before is completely mixed
5. Get another bowl and sift the cake flour , salt , and baking powder together
6. Stir to distribute everything good
7. Slowly mix it together with the stuff in the other bowl
8. When it starts to get dry or hard to mix with the mixer add the milk , yogurt , 2 tablespoons of vegetable oil , and vanilla
9. Add about seven drops of yellow food coloring or until you get the perfect golden yellow
10. Mix completely and very well , leave no unmixed cake flour on the sides--believe you me it does not make a good cake having droplets of or little chunks of cake flour in the cake so make sure you scrape the sides down good and mix it in well
11. Pour into the prepared pans leaving enough space to rise
12. Bake for 18 to 20 minutes or until you can stick a toothpick into the cake and it comes out clean
13. Remove from oven and cool on a rack
14. You can make a really good chocolate or vanilla frosting for the cake
15. Or you can buy the frosting

title: peanut butter and dark fudge brownie cupcakes  mix
steps:
1. For the cupcakes:
2. Preheat oven to 350f
3. Combine the brownie mix , eggs , and milk in a bowl , and mix until combined
4. Add the peanut butter and mix until incorporated
5. If the batter is too thick , add the water
6. Spoon the batter into paper-lined cupcake tins
7. Bake for 25 minutes , or until a toothpick inserted into the center of a cupcake comes out clean
8. Allow to cool
9. For the frosting:
10. Whisk together the water and powdered sugar
11. Once combined , add the peanut butter and mix until smooth
12. Spread on cooled cupcakes , and top with peanut brittle or chopped peanuts if desired

title: sugar cookies with icing
steps:
1. Cream shortening
2. Gradually add sugar , beating until fluffy
3. Add eggs and vanilla
4. Mix well
5. Combine dry ingredients
6. Add to creamed mixture , mixing well
7. Divide dough in half
8. Wrap in wax paper , chill at least one hour
9. Roll half of dough to 1 / 4 inch thick on a lightly floured surface
10. Keep remaining dough chilled
11. Cut dough with a cookie cutter
12. Place on lightly greased cookie sheet
13. Bake at 350 for 12 minutes or until edges are lightly browned
14. Cool on wire rack
15. Cream butter
16. Graduallly add sugar , beating until blended
17. Add milk and vanilla , mixing until smooth , stir in food coloring , if desired
18. Spread on cookies

title: fried nut rolls   nashab
steps:
1. Mix the nut filling ingredients together and add cardamom to taste
2. Unroll the filo pastry and cut into pieces about 15cm by 20cm
3. Cover with a damp cloth
4. Take a strip of pastry with the narrow side nearest to you
5. Spread 2 tsp of the nut mixture over the pastry keeping about 1 cm each side clear to prevent them from bursting out
6. Moisten the sides of the strip with water and roll up firmly brushing the underneath piece at the end with water to seal it
7. Repeat using all the ingredients
8. Heat the oil to about 190 c and deep fry the pastries for about 2-3 minutes
9. When golden brown remove from heat and drain on paper towels
10. Store in a sealed container and serve when desired

title: a fool for strawberries
steps:
1. Process the frozen berries and sugar in a blender with the on and off pulse button until just mixed
2. Add extract of your choice
3. In a separate mixing bowl , whip the cream until stiff , then fold in the strawberry mixture
4. Transfer to parfait glasses and refrigerate at least 4 hours , or until set
5. For presentation , garnish each serving with a few threads of orange zest and some toasted almonds slices if desired
6. Yield is estimated

title: summer picnic macaroni salad
steps:
1. Drain the macaroni
2. Pour a mixture of 3 tablespoons vinegar and 2 tablespoons sugar over the drained macaroni
3. Drain the macaroni
4. In a large bowl mix salad macaroni , peas , baby gherkins , celery , sweet onion , tuna , cubed cheese
5. Dressing: take the mayo , sugar , some vinegar , salt and pepper to taste
6. Mix into the macaroni mixture
7. You may want to add more dressing
8. This is a very forgiving salad
9. You can sub salad shrimp , ham or chicken for the tuna or ditch the meat / fish and add some grated carrots , diced zucchini and diced red peppers
10. Chill , check the dressing and enjoy

title: stuffed turkey burgers
steps:
1. Place jalapeno in cast iron skillet
2. Cook over low heat till skin is blisterd and blackened slightly
3. Remove from skillet and let cool
4. Peel off skin and remove seeds ,
5. Coarsely chop
6. Divide turkey into 8 pieces
7. Gently press or pat to make rounds about 4 in in diameter
8. Layer cheese , pepper and olives on the 4 patties
9. Top with the remaining 4 patties
10. Pinch edges together to seal
11. Season with salt and pepper
12. Heat oil in large non-stick skillet over medium heat
13. Add patties and cook until brown on first side , about 3 to 4 minutes
14. Flip and cook till browned , 2 to 3 minutes more
15. Reduce heat to low and cook till meat is no longer pink but juicy , 6 to 8 minutes

title: peanut chicken    yummy
steps:
1. In a large non-stick skillet heat peanut oil& sesame oil over medium-high heat
2. Add ginger& garlic& cook until aroma is released
3. Stir in chicken pieces& cook until golden brown
4. Stir in peanut butter
5. Stir in scallions& coconut milk& simmer until thickened , about 3 minutes
6. Season with salt& pepper& serve over white rice
7. If desired , garnish with toasted peanuts& cilantro

title: strawberry angel cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325
2. Using a mixer , beat the angel food cake mix and the preserves
3. Batter will be dry
4. If needed , add a bit more preserves to add some moisture
5. Add chocolate chips
6. Place 2 inches apart on greased cookie sheets
7. Bake 10-12 minutes
8. Let stand 1 minute before removing from tray

title: slow roasted garlic
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Peel the head of garlic of all the papery skin with the exception of the very last layer
3. Garlic should still hold together in its original shape , but individual cloves should be visible
4. Rub head and inside of oven proof dish with butter or olive oil
5. Put water / stock in bottom of dish
6. Cover dish with foil and place in preheated oven for 45 minutes
7. After the 45 minutes are up , uncover the dish and bake for an additional 30 minutes
8. Remove garlic and dish from oven and allow to cool
9. After cooled , remove cloves and squeeze the roasted garlic from the cloves into a dish or container
10. The roasted garlic should be a light yellowy-brown and very soft and sticky
11. Store in the refrigerator and use in place of garlic for a milder and delicious flavor

title: forde s diet soup
steps:
1. Cut veggies into small pieces and cover with water or v8 juice
2. Boil rapidly for 10 minutes
3. Reduce heat and simmer until veggies are tender

title: old fashioned apple raisin crunch a la mode
steps:
1. Preheat oven 400 degrees
2. In a heavy 12" skillet over medium heat , melt 1 / 4 cup butter , watching that it doesn't burn
3. Gradually add the 1 / 2 cup sugar and stir the mixture until the sugar is completely dissolved , becomes carmelize and reduced
4. Slowly add the liqueur and the apple juice , stirring constantly until all the ingredients are smooth
5. At this point , drop in the sliced apples and sprinkle cinnamon over the top
6. Mix together well , making sure that the apple slices are coated with the syrup
7. Reduce the fire to low and simmer the fruit until it begins to soften , about 5 minutes
8. Do not over cook because the dessert will be baked later
9. While the apples are simmering , butter a 10"x12" baking dish with the 3 tablespoons butter
10. Evenly sprinkle the 1 / 2 cup raisins on the bottom
11. In a large bowl , mix together the 1 cup flour , 2 / 3 cup sugar and 1 / 2 cup softened butter to form a crumbly topping that resembles granola
12. This works best if using 2 knives to "cut" the ingredients into each other
13. Finally , pour the apple mixture into the prepared baking pan with raisins then sprinkle the pastry mixture over the top of the apples , working a little of it into the fruit
14. Bake in preheated oven for about 20-30 minutes or until the top turns a crunchy , crispy brown
15. Spoon generous helpings of the apples , raisin and crunchy topping into small bowls and serve piping hot , topped with slightly softened vanilla ice cream

title: cold melon soup
steps:
1. In a blender container , combine honeydew , lime juice , and honey
2. Blend until smooth
3. Pour into a bowl and add yogurt
4. Beat with a fork or wire whisk until blended
5. Chill several hours
6. Serve cold
7. Whisk before serving and garnish each bowl with a few melon balls

title: jo s appetizer pepperoni rolls
steps:
1. Mix together the softened cream cheese , the sliced pepperoni , the mozzarella cheese , the parm
2. Cheese , the garlic and italian seasoning
3. Unroll the crescent dough carefully , the dough will be a large rectangle
4. Separate into four rectangles
5. Divide the cheese / pepperoni mixture into four equal parts and place on each rectangle
6. I place this mixture along the longest side of the rectangle - kind of forming a log
7. Fold the dough over , and seal
8. Repeat with the other 3 pieces of dough
9. Cut these pepperoni rolls into 6 slices , or whatever works best for you
10. Place on a cookie sheet lined with a piece of parchement paper
11. I try to place the rolls where they are not touching
12. Bake in a preheated 400 degree f oven for 13-16 minutes , or til brown

title: asparagus in soy cream sauce  zwt ii   asia
steps:
1. Bend ea asparagus stalk till it snaps at its tenderest point
2. In a med-sized skillet , bring 1 cup water to a boil
3. Add asparagus & reduce heat to med
4. Cook for 5 minutes
5. Remove asparagus w / a slotted spoon to a serving platter
6. Return the remaining water in the skillet to a boil & reduce liquid to about 2 tablespoons add soy sauce , butter & cream
7. Stir & remove skillet from heat
8. Pour the cream sauce over the asparagus & garnish w / toasted sesame seeds

title: tuna bruschetta pasta
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to directions on box
2. In the meantime , add all other ingredients to medium saucepan and simmer for 15 minutes , stirring frequently
3. Add sauce to drained pasta and toss to coat
4. Serve warm

title: caribbean coconut chicken bites with mango cream
steps:
1. Mango cream:
2. Place the mango in a mini food processor and pulse till it is a pulp
3. Scrape all of this into a bowl adding the sour cream , sugar , and extract
4. Mix well and set aside
5. Do not refrigerate this , it is best served at room temperature
6. For chicken -- in a bowl place 1 cup plus 2 t flour and set aside
7. In another bowl place the remaining flour , sugar , and salt
8. Stir milk and extracts into this
9. The mixture should resemble a thin pancake batter
10. Set this aside
11. Place the bread slices in a food processor and pulse till you have fine crumbs , measure out approx 1-1 / 2 cups
12. Place these on a pie pan and place in a 350f oven till lightly toasted and dried out
13. Mix toasted bread crumbs in a third bowl with the coconut
14. Preheat a deep fryer with oil according to the directions of the fryer
15. Place a cooling rack on a large cookie sheet and cover the rack with paper towels
16. Now one at a time drag each chicken bite through the pan with just flour , then using a slotted spoon drop it into the milk mixture coat well and use the spoon to retrieve it
17. Drop the coated bite into the coconut mixture being careful not to get to much of the excess wet mixture into the coconut
18. Cover evenly with the coconut mixture and set on a second cookie sheet
19. After all the chicken pieces are ready begin to cook them in the hot oil
20. Just do a few at a time to keep your oil from cooling to much and becoming gummy
21. The heat time will vary a great deal on this because it is raw meat and it depends on how big of chunks you make them
22. Make sure they are cooked completely , you may want to test the first one out and see how long it takes to get it done thoroughly
23. I cook mine for approx 5 minutes and the batter should turn a nice golden brown
24. Remove from oil and drain on the cookie sheet that has been prepared with paper towels
25. Serve with mango cream

title: smothered chicken breasts
steps:
1. Sprinkle chicken with salt and lemon-pepper
2. In a large skillet , cook chicken in oil for 13-15 minutes or until juices run clear
3. Remove and keep warm
4. In the same skillet , cook bacon over medium heat until crisp
5. Using a slotted spoon , remove to paper towels
6. Drain , reserving 2 tablespoons drippings
7. In the drippings , saute the onion and brown sugar until onion is golden
8. Place two bacon strips on each chicken breast half
9. Top with caramelized onions and cheese

title: creme fraiche mashed potatoes
steps:
1. Wash but don't peel the potatoes
2. Place in a large pot of water
3. Boil over medium heat until the potatoes are soft , about 15 minutes , then drain
4. Mash the potatoes then add the butter , creme fraiche , salt and and pepper to taste

title: cauliflower olive antipasto salad
steps:
1. Combine dressing ingredients
2. Set aside
3. Cut and drain all vegetables
4. Place in a large bowl and add dressing
5. Toss to coat

title: italian hamburgers
steps:
1. Combine the first seven ingredients
2. Add beef and 3 tblsp
3. Of parmesan cheese
4. Mix well
5. Shape into six patties
6. In a skillet , brown patties for 2 minutes on each side
7. Combine the tomato saude and italian seasoning
8. Pour over patties
9. Reduce heat
10. Cover and simmer for 10-15 minutes or until meat is no longer pink
11. Sprinkle with remaining cheese
12. Serve patties and sauce alone or over pasta if desired

title: versatile chicken
steps:
1. Mix the buttermilk , bouillon , and oregano in a bowl
2. Let set 10 minutes to blend flavors
3. Put chicken in a large bowl and pour buttermilk mixture over the chicken
4. Let set 30 minutes to blend flavors
5. Mix flour and paprika in a plastic bag
6. Add chicken , one or two pieces at a time , to coat
7. Place coated chicken in a 9x13 pan
8. Drizzle melted butter over the chicken
9. Bake at 350 degrees for one hour , or until golden brown
10. To fry chicken , omit the butter , and fry in oil until brown

title: bowl of red   texas chili con carne
steps:
1. In a large dutch oven , heat the oil and cook the onion over medium heat until it is soft
2. Add the garlic and cook until it's transparent
3. Add the meat in several batches along with the chili , cumin , oregano and paprika
4. Remove each batch to a large bowl as it's cooked
5. Stir and cook until the meat is browned , then put all the meat back in the pot and add the vinegar , coffee and enough water just to cover the meat
6. Add the salt and cayenne and stir well
7. Cover the pot and cook over low heat for 2 hours , stirring from time to time
8. Remove the lid and simmer the final hour
9. Skim off any fat on the surface
10. Add the cornmeal and stir in well
11. Cook for 15 more minutes and serve hot in deep bowls
12. Garnish with sour cream , chopped cilantro and shredded cheese

title: american egg rolls
steps:
1. This is very easy just cube the pork or chicken in 1 / 2 inch cubes and stir fry , season with salt pepper and soy sauce to taste
2. Let cool roll meat and both cheeses in wrappers
3. Fry egg rolls in 1 / 2 inch of oil til brown

title: avocado  tomato  and hummus sandwich
steps:
1. Lay 4 of the slices of bread out on a plate
2. Slice the tomato into 8 slices and set aside
3. Cut the avocado in half and slice it longways into 4 pieces on each half and set aside
4. On each piece of bread that is already out , spread a tablespoon of hummus
5. Put two slices of avocado and tomato on top of each bread slice
6. Top each with the last slices of bread and cut in half

title: pain de provence  herb french bread
steps:
1. The night before baking , make the poolish by mixing together 1 cup of flour , 1 cup of water , and 1 / 2 teaspoon of yeast to make a batter
2. Cover the container with plastic wrap and set aside for 8 to 16 hours
3. Next day:
4. In large bowl combine the remaining flour with the remaining yeast , salt , and herbs
5. Add the poolish , the liqueur , and 1 / 4 cup of the additional water
6. Mix the ingredients , and , if necessary , add more water or flour until the proper consistency is reached
7. Knead by hand for 10 to 15 minutes or in a mixer for 5 to 10 minutes
8. Place the dough in a well-greased bowl and cover the bowl with plastic wrap
9. Set aside to rise until doubled in size , approximately 90 minutes
10. Remove it from the bowl and gently degas it , then return it to the bowl , cover it , and allow it to double in size again
11. Remove the dough from the bowl and shape it into a ball or long loaf
12. Cover the loaf with a damp towel and allow it to rise again until doubled in size , which takes between 60 and 90 more minutes
13. While the loaf is in its final rise , preheat the oven and baking stone , if you are using one , to 450
14. I also preheat a broiler pan , or cast iron skillet , into which to pour a cup of hot water just after placing the loaf in the oven
15. This creates steam in the oven which increases the crunchiness of the crust
16. Just prior to placing the loaf in the oven , score the top of it with a sharp knife or razor blade
17. Place the loaf in the oven and bake for 20 minutes at 450 , then rotate it 180 degrees and reduce the oven temperature to 375 and baked it another 25 minutes
18. The internal temperature of the loaf should be approximately 200 degrees when you remove it from the oven

title: ultimate great northern beans
steps:
1. Soak the beans in cold water overnight
2. Make sure that there is twice as much water as beans because they will swell up
3. In a large cooking pot , pour in the cooking oil and toss in the smoked jowl pieces
4. Stir and allow them to sizzle over medium heat for 5 or 6 minutes
5. After they brown a bit , deglaze the pot with about 4 ounces of the chicken broth
6. Add the onion and allow to simmer until the onion is tender , stirring often
7. Rinse the beans in fresh water a final time and , after draining , add them , plus all the remaining ingredients into the pot
8. This should include the 48 ounces of water listed in the ingredients
9. Boil , covered , over low heat until beans are tender , stirring occasionally
10. Serve with cornbread , fried potatoes , eggs and biscuits
11. If you wish , you can use chunks of ham or bacon instead of pork jowl

title: acadia s tropical iced tea
steps:
1. Boil water in tea pot
2. Pour water over tea bags and let steep for 15 minutes
3. Discard tea bags
4. In a plastic pitcher add 2 cups of ice
5. Add tea to cool down
6. After cooled , may transfer to a glass pitcher
7. Added pineapple orange juice and coconut juice to tea and mix together
8. Add 1 / 2 a cup of ice to each glass and pour tea / juice mixture over ice
9. May garnish with slice of pineapple
10. Enjoy !

title: betty jo s banana pudding
steps:
1. Beat milk and pudding
2. Add sour cream and mix
3. Fold in thawed cool whip
4. Layer pudding , bananas , and vanilla wafers

title: sorta spicy mexican chip casserole  not hot
steps:
1. In a skillet , cook meat , onion& garlic over med
2. Heat until meat is browned and onion tender
3. Add soup , corn and chilies
4. Mix well
5. In an ungreased 9x13 baking dish , layer meat mixture , topped by corn chips and enchilada sauce , then top with cheese
6. Bake , uncovered , at 350 for 8-10 minutes or until heated through

title: spaghetti aglio olio  spaghetti with garlic and oil
steps:
1. Bring salted water to a boil , and cook spaghetti for about 8 minute
2. Remove just before the al dente stage
3. Drain but reserve a few ladles of pasta water
4. Toast breadcrumbs along with parsley in a dry saucepan until golden brown
5. In another pan , heat extra virgin olive oil and combine garlic and chili peppers
6. Cook for a few minutes or until golden brown
7. Do not burn the garlic
8. Otherwise it will become bitter
9. Add spaghetti to the pan with olive oil and mix well
10. To prevent dryness , ladle some pasta water to the pasta
11. Cook for another minute or until desired state of al dente
12. Mix in toasted breadcrumbs and parsley before serving

title: philadelphia sticky buns
steps:
1. Yeast dough:
2. In a small pan , heat milk just until bubbles form around edge of pan
3. Remove from heat
4. Add sugar , salt and butter
5. Stir to melt butter , then cool to lukewarm
6. Sprinkle yeast over water in large bowl
7. Stir to dissolve then stir in lukewarm milk mixture
8. Add the egg and 2 cups of the flour
9. Beat with electric mixer until smooth
10. Add the remaining 1 / 2 celsius flour and mix by hand until dough is smooth and leaves sides of bowl
11. Turn dough onto lightly floured surface
12. Knead until dough is smooth and blisters appear
13. Place in lightly greased bowl
14. Turn to grease all over
15. Cover with towel and let rise in warm , draft-free place until double , about 1 to 1 1 / 2 hours
16. Topping:
17. While dough rises , in a small bowl with spoon cream the butter and brown sugar
18. Spread on bottom and sides of 9x9x2-inch square baking pan
19. Place pecans evenly on top , flat sides up
20. When dough has risen , roll dough into a 16x12 inch rectangle
21. Spread with butter , sprinkle with brown sugar , the raisins and cinnamon
22. Roll up from long side , jelly-roll fashion
23. Pinch edge to seal
24. Cut crosswise into 12 pieces
25. Place , cut side down , into prepared pan
26. Let rise , covered in warm place free of drafts until doubled , 1 to 1 1 / 2 hours
27. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
28. Bake sticky buns 25 to 30 minutes , or until golden brown
29. Invert on plate , let stand 1 minute then remove pan
30. Serve warm

title: james beard s cream biscuits
steps:
1. Sift dry ingredients together
2. Fold in cream until it makes a soft dough that can be easily handled
3. Turn on to a floured board and knead for about one minute
4. I make these as drop biscuits: take a large mound of dough and dip into melted butter
5. Arrange biscuits on a baking sheet spritzed with baking spray
6. Bake at 425 for 15-18 minutes

title: ww 4 points   wild mushroom tacos
steps:
1. Rinse mushrooms and pat dry
2. Trim and slice
3. Heat the oil in large nonstick skillet over medium heat
4. Add the onion , chile , and garlic
5. Saute until softened , about 2 minute add the tomato and cook , stirring , until mixture appears fairly dry , about 3 minute stir in the mushrooms and salt , cook , covered , stirring occasionally , until mushrooms are tender but not mushy
6. Stir in the sour cream and heat through
7. Meanwhile , heat the taco or tostada shells according to pkg directions
8. Keep warm
9. To serve , spoon 1 / 4 cup of mixture onto each shell , sprinkle with cilantro
10. 4 points per serving

title: waffles with peach and passionfruit
steps:
1. Toast the waffles until golden brown and put on plates
2. Top with peach slices and spoon the passionfruit pulp over and top with the fruche and drizzle with maple syrup to serve
3. Variation - replace the fruche with any low-fat or diet flavoured yoghurt and the peach with any canned fruit in juice

title: margo s guacamole
steps:
1. In a bowl combine avocado , cilantro and salt
2. In a blender combine water , tomatillos , serrano peppers and onions
3. Stir well in the avocado mix
4. Important , serve immediately !

title: oatmeal soda bread
steps:
1. Grease a baking sheet
2. Set aside
3. In a large mixing bowl , stir together flour , oats , baking powder , baking soda and salt
4. Using a pastry blender or two knives , cut in margarine or butter til mixture resembles coarse crumbs
5. Make a well in center of the dry ingredients
6. Stir together one beaten egg and buttermilk or sour milk , then add mixture all at once into the dry well
7. Using a fork , stir just till moistened
8. Turn dough out onto a well-floured surface
9. Quickly knead dough by gently folding and pressing dough for 10 to 12 strokes or until dough is barely holding together
10. On the prepared baking sheet , shape dough into a 6-inch round loaf
11. On the top of the loaf , cut a 4-inch cross , 1 / 4 inch deep
12. Brush with the remaining beaten egg
13. Bake in a 375 degree oven for about 35 minutes or until done
14. Remove from baking sheet and serve warm
15. Can be eaten with soup , stew , applesauce , etc
16. It is a relatively dense bread , so do not be afraid at how heavy it feels when you lift it off the baking sheet

title: goat cheese pasta with roasted asparagus
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450f
2. Bring a large pot of water to a boil for pasta
3. Place asparagus on a large rimmed baking sheet
4. Dot with 1 tablespoon butter , and season with salt and pepper
5. Roast until tender , tossing occasionally , 10 to 15 minutes
6. Cut into 2-inch lengths
7. While asparagus is roasting , generously salt boiling water
8. Add pasta , and cook until al dente , according to package instructions
9. Set aside 1 1 / 2 cups pasta water
10. Drain pasta and return to pot
11. In a medium bowl , combine goat cheese , remaining 3 tablespoons butter , and 1 / 2 cup pasta water
12. Season with salt and pepper , and whisk until smooth
13. Add goat-cheese mixture and asparagus to pasta
14. Toss to combine , adding more pasta water if necessary for sauce to coat pasta
15. Serve pasta garnished with chives

title: taco pie in pie crust
steps:
1. Brown meat > drain fat and season
2. Unroll crust , put into 9 or 10 inch pie plate
3. Bake crust for about 10 minutes until just starting to bubble
4. Spread beans on pie crust
5. Layer half of meat , chilis and cheese
6. Layer other half of meat , chilis and cheese
7. Top with crumbled corn chips
8. Bake in 350 degree oven for about 25-30 minutes
9. Serve with guacamole , olives , tomatoes , lettuce , salsa and sour cream

title: cabbage rolls  holupchi
steps:
1. For the sauce:
2. Take your onion and with a knife make 5-7 slits
3. Insert your cloves into the slits
4. Finely chop your garlic and dill
5. Sweat off your garlic and your whole onion for about a minute , flipping the onion once
6. Add the remaining ingredients for the sauce , bring to a boil and reduce to simmer for about 30 minutes
7. Taste your sauce , if it needs more of anything , add it
8. I find sometimes i need more sugar , sometimes more vinegar
9. For the rolls:
10. Preheat oven to 350
11. Cook your rice as you normally would
12. Once cooked , put it in a large bowl to cool
13. Core your cabbage
14. Reserve two outer leaves and shred
15. Finely chop your dill
16. Bring a large pot of water and the cabbage to a boil
17. As the cabbage cooks , remove the leaves that separate and set aside
18. Depending on the size of your cabbage , you'll want 20-30 leaves
19. Meanwhile , add the ground veal , dill , shredded reserved cabbage , salt and pepper to the rice and mix well with your hands
20. Take a 1 / 2 cup of the tomato sauce and add it to the rice mixture
21. Mix again and check the consistency
22. You can choose to add up to another 1 / 2 cup of the tomato sauce , this is a personal choice
23. Line the bottom of a roast pan with 2-3 leaves , so that the bottom is covered
24. Ladle a small amount of the sauce on the bottom of the pan
25. Take the cabbage leaves you've removed and remove the cores
26. If your leaves are big you may also want to cut them in half
27. Grab some of the rice mixture , about i'm guessing a 1 / 4 cup or about the size of a golf ball , and shape it into a finger
28. Put it in the cabbage and roll the cabbage , folding the ends in , and lay in the roast pan seam side down
29. Repeat until you have filled the bottom of the pan and ladle about 1 / 2 cup of the sauce over the rolls
30. Repeat until you run out of the stuffing
31. Take the remaining sauce and pour it all over the rolls
32. Cover and bake for about 30-45 minutes , until your meat is cooked

title: toasted almond tiramisu  lower in fat not in flavor
steps:
1. Combine first 5 ingredients in a blender and blend till mixed
2. Gently fold in whipped topping
3. Chill
4. Combine water , and amaretto
5. Split ladyfingers in half lengthwise
6. Arrange 1 / 3 of the ladyfinger halves , flat sides down , in a trifle bowl or large glass bowl
7. Drizzle with 1 / 3 of amaretto / water mixture
8. Spread one-third of pudding mixture evenly over ladyfingers
9. Sprinkle with 1 / 3 toasted almonds
10. Repeat layers , ending with toasted almonds
11. Cover and chill for 8 hours
12. Enjoy !

title: white sauce butter balls
steps:
1. Sift dry ingredients into a large bowl
2. Using mixer or food processor add butter to the flour mixture and pulse or mix until mixture is smooth
3. Drop by heaping tablespoons onto a waxed paper lined baking sheet
4. Place into freezer until balls are frozen
5. Remove from freezer and place into freezer bags label and store in freezer for up to 6 months
6. Recipe makes 28 butter balls
7. To make a white sauce:
8. In a small saucepan combine butter balls and 1 cup milk
9. Use a whisk to crush the butter ball
10. Stir constantly over medium heat until mixture is smooth ans slightly thickened
11. This will make about 1 cup of white sauce
12. Thin sauce: use 1 butter ball
13. Medium sauce: use 2 butter balls
14. Thick sauce: use 3 butter balls
15. Creamy rich sauce: substitute heavy cream for the milk
16. Cheese sauce: add 1 cup cheddar cheese to a medium sauce and stir until cheese melts

title: super simple apple turnovers
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400f
2. Combine apple , applesauce , and 1 / 4 tsp cinnamon in a bowl
3. Separate biscuits and roll out each into a 6-inch circle
4. Place biscuits onto greased baking sheet
5. Spoon apple mixture onto the center of each biscuit , dividing evenly
6. Fold biscuits in half and pinch the edges to seal
7. Brush tops of each biscuit with melted butter
8. Combine sugar and the rest of the cinnamon
9. Sprinkle over the tops
10. Bake for 8-10 minutes or until edges are golden brown
11. Serve warm with vanilla ice cream

title: melitta mocha fudge cake 1996  canadian   flourless   gluten fre
steps:
1. In a large saucepan add sugar , chocolate , coffee and butter
2. Stirring constantly , heat until melted and dissolved
3. Remove from stove and place in a large mixer bowl
4. Whisk the eggs
5. Slowly very slowly , add the eggs into the warm chocolate mixture
6. Beat on low speed until just blended
7. Pour into a foil buttered lined 9 inch spring form pan
8. Bake 1 hour at 350 degrees , or just until almost set
9. Remove to a cooling rack
10. Cool thoroughly
11. Then place into the refrigerator
12. Slice next day , garnishing with whipped cream

title: lasagna with saucy sausage  peppers   onions
steps:
1. Cook sausage , onion , peppers , and garlic in a pan over medium heat till it is no longer pink and veggies are tender
2. Drain fat
3. Add sauce to sausage mixture
4. Mix ricotta cheese , 3 cups mozzarella cheese , 1 / 4 cup grated parmesan cheese , eggs and parsley
5. Spread 1 cup of sauce on bottom of a 13x9x3 pan
6. Top with 4 noodles
7. Spread 1 / 3 of cheese mixture on noodles follow with 1 / 3 sausage mixture repeat 2 more times
8. Mix remaining 1 cup mozzarella and parmesan cheese
9. Sprinkle the cheese mixture on top
10. Place foil on a cookie sheet and place lasagna on foil loosely cover with additional foil and bake for 30-40 minutes at 350 degrees
11. Uncover and bake for 15 more minutes
12. Remove and let set for 15 minutes before slicing

title: irish pin oats
steps:
1. Melt 1 tbs butter in a small saucepan over med high heat
2. When the butter stops foaming , add the oats and stir well for 1 minute
3. Reduce heat to low , and let the oats cook for 1 more minute
4. Add the water , stir and place the lid on tightly
5. Allow to simmer for 20 minutes , or until the majority of the water is absorbed
6. Add the half and half and turn off the heat
7. Replace the lid and allow to sit for 5 minutes
8. Add the remaining 2 tbs butter and salt to taste
9. Brown sugar and cinnamon may be added if you prefer sweet oats

title: bulgur pilaf w  almonds and cranberries
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan , over medium heat , cook almonds , tossing occasionally until golden , 4-5 minutes
2. Remove from skillet and let cool
3. In same saucepan , melt butter over med
4. Heat
5. Add onion and cook , stirring occasionally , until beginning to brown , 6-8 minutes
6. Add bulgur and stir to coat
7. Add broth , season with salt and pepper , and bring to boil
8. Reduce heat to low , cover saucepan , and simmer until liquid has cooked out and bulgur is tender , about 15 minutes
9. Remove from heat , sprinkle bulgur with cranberries
10. Cover and set aside to steam , about 5 minutes
11. Add toasted almonds and stir to combine and fluff bulgur

title: hot pizza sub sandwich
steps:
1. Slice bread in half horizontally
2. Spread bottom half with pizza sauce , sprinkle with seasoning
3. Top with green pepper , ham , salami , pepperoni
4. And cheeses , replace bread top
5. Place on baking sheet
6. Bake 425 degrees for 12-15 minutes or until cheese is melted
7. If cooking on open grill-wrap in foil
8. If cooking on gas grill covered doesnt need foil

title: garlic lime chicken wings with chipotle mayonnaise
steps:
1. Combine chicken & marinade ingredients in a ziplock bag , squish around to combine & coat thoroughly & refrigerate 2-4 hours , turning occasionally
2. In a small bowl , stir together all mayonnaise ingredients & refrigerate 30 minutes
3. Heat grill or broiler
4. Remove chicken from marinade
5. Discard marinade
6. Gril or broil 12-14 minutes until browned & juices run clear , turning once
7. Serve with avocado slices & use mayonnaise as a dipping sauce

title: steamed potatoes
steps:
1. Peel and dice potatoes
2. Chop onion
3. Heat shortening in skillet
4. Add potatoes and onion
5. Fry until almost crisp
6. Add water
7. Cover skillet
8. Stir frequently
9. Steam until most of liquid is gone

title: panko tofu
steps:
1. Open the tofu slice into cubes or slabs depending on preference
2. Wrap in kitchen towel
3. Try to get as much water out as you can by changing the towels when they are damp
4. The tofu needs to be as dry as possible for this recipe
5. Coat the tofu with egg or sweet chili sauce depending on which you are using and then roll in the panko gently patting the breadcrumbs on
6. Fry until crisp and golden brown
7. Drain on kitchen towel and serve with your choice of sauce

title: luscious lime angel squares
steps:
1. In a bowl , dissolve gelatin in boiling water
2. Refrigerate until mixture begins to thicken about 35 minutes
3. Place cake cubes in a 13x9x2" dish coated with non stick spray , set aside
4. In a small mixing bowl , beat cream cheese until smooth
5. Beat in sugar , lemon juice and peel
6. Add gelatin mixture
7. Beat until combined
8. Fold in 1 1 / 2 cups whipped topping
9. Spread over cake covering completely
10. Refrigerate at least 2 hours
11. Cut into squares and top with remaining whipped topping

title: chicken shortcake
steps:
1. Combine flour , baking powder , baking soda , salt , pepper , thyme , parsley and sage in bowl
2. Add milk and oil
3. Mix just until combined
4. Transfer dough to sprayed cookie sheet
5. Pat into a 7 inch circle about 1 / 2 inch thick
6. Bake at 400 for 15-20 minutes , or until golden brown
7. Meanwhile in skillet cook mushrooms and onion , stirring frequently 4-5 minutes , until vegetables are golden and cooked through
8. In small bowl , with whisk , combine broth , lemon juice and cornstarch , blending to dissolve cornstarch
9. Stir into vegetable mixture
10. Reduce heat to low and simmer stirring constantly for 1 minute , until slightly thickened
11. Stir in chicken , sour cream , salt and pepper
12. Simmer , stirring constantly , 2 minutes longer
13. Just before serving cut shortcake into 4 pieces
14. Top with chicken mixture

title: low fat ground turkey stroganoff
steps:
1. Start cooking your noodles
2. Microwave corn 1 / 2 the amount of time according to packaging
3. Meanwhile , spray pan with very little oil , then cook onions and mushrooms until they start to soften
4. Add turkey , and cook thoroughly
5. Add corn , soup , milk , garlic salt , pepper , and stir
6. Bring to boil , then cover , reduce heat , and let simmer for 5 minutes
7. Stirring 1 / 2 way through
8. Remove lid , raise heat slightly , and let simmer for 5 more minutes
9. Reduce heat to low , add sour cream and stir till fully mixed inches
10. Serve over noodles

title: threadgill s pinto beans
steps:
1. Clean and rinse beans , and pick through carefully
2. Soak overnight in cold water to cover well
3. Drain beans and place all ingredients , except salt into a 4 quart pot and bring to a boil
4. Reduce heat to simmer
5. Cover and cook about 90 minutes , or until beans are tender
6. Add salt to taste and garnish with sliced onion

title: healthy whole wheat pumpkin pie pancakes
steps:
1. Combine egg substitutes , pumpkin , sugar , oil , and milk in a large bowl
2. Combine the rest of the ingredients in a smaller bowl
3. Mix in the dry flour mixture with the wet pumpkin mixture until smooth , folding in pecans or cinnamon chips
4. Dont over mix
5. Let batter sit for 5 minutes -- this lets the oat bran absorb
6. Add a touch of milk to thin out if necessary
7. Pour batter onto well greased griddle and let sit until batter starts to bubble
8. Flip and brown
9. Enjoy warm with a dot of butter and maple syrup
10. Enjoy !

title: country style pork ribs in a crock pot
steps:
1. Brown country style pork ribs in margarine or butter
2. Mix everything and cook in a crock pot on high for 3-4 hours
3. Reduce heat to low for the last hour
4. Chicken can be used in lieu of pork
5. Use the sauce as gravy on mashed potatoes

title: paraguayan cheese cornbread sopa paraguaya
steps:
1. Heat half the butter in a skillet and cook the onions over moderate heat until tender but not brown
2. Set aside
3. Combine the remaining butter with the farmer's or cottage cheese and mix until thoroughly combined
4. Add the muenster , onions , cornmeal , corn , salt , milk , egg yolks , and mix thoroughly
5. Beat the egg whites until soft peaks form and fold them into the batter
6. Pour the batter into a greased and floured 10 inch by 13 inch baking pan and bake in a preheated 400f oven for 45 to 55 minutes , or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean

title: yummy coffee cake
steps:
1. Heat oven to 325 degrees
2. Grease and flour a 10-inch tube cake pan
3. Cream butter until soft
4. Add sugar and cream until light and fluffy
5. Add eggs one at a time , beating after each addition
6. Sift flour , baking soda , baking powder and salt together
7. Add dry ingredients alternately with sour cream , beginning and ending with flour mixture
8. Stir in vanilla
9. Pour half of the batter in prepared pan
10. And add half of nut filling / topping mixture
11. Pour remaining batter over nut mixture and top with remaining nut mixture
12. Bake for 40 to 50 minutes or until done when tested with tooth pick

title: flaeskeaeggekage  danish bacon   egg pancake omelet
steps:
1. Fry bacon in a med-sized non-stick skillet till crisp
2. Remove bacon to drain on paper towel
3. Remove any rendered bacon fat in excess of 3 tablespoons when bacon has cooled , crumble into sml pieces & set aside
4. Beat eggs w / milk , flour , salt & chives
5. Reheat bacon fat & pour egg mixture into it
6. When the omelet begins to set , sprinkle the crumbled bacon on the top & lift cooked omelet edges w / a fork so the uncooked portion runs underneath
7. Cont cooking till the eggs are set & the edges golden brown
8. Fold the omelet & serve hot , cutting the omelet in half to serve 2 hearty appetites or 3 wedges for less hearty appetites
9. For a firmer omelet , turn out onto a plate& return the omelet to the skillet , uncooked side down
10. Brown lightly & serve

title: super quick light hummus
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in a blender and pure until smooth
2. Garnish with black pepper and mint
3. Chill until needed

title: butter bean hummus  houmous
steps:
1. Put all ingredients in a food processor , apart from salt and pepper , and blend until just about smooth
2. Alternatively you can put them in a mixing bowl and use a stick blender
3. Season with salt and freshly ground pepper to taste

title: chocolate cherry martini
steps:
1. Fill a cocktail shaker with ice
2. Add the chocolate , cherry liqueur and vodka to the shaker
3. Shake very very briskly to mix and well chill
4. Strain into a chilled martini glass that you drizzled the chocolate syrup into
5. Garnish with chocolate covered cherries

title: emily s sloppy joes
steps:
1. In a large frying pan over med
2. Heat , brown the beef until done
3. Add the chopped onion / pepper and saute until just done
4. In a bowl , mix remaining ingredients together and pour over the beef / veg
5. Mixture
6. Stir until combined
7. Cook until desired consistancy is reached
8. Aprox
9. 20 minutes
10. Serve on toasted buns of your choice

title: savory croissant breakfast pudding
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
2. Lightly grease a 3-quart casserole dish and set aside
3. In a large skillet , melt 1 1 / 2 tablespoons of the butter over medium-high heat
4. Add the onions , reduce the heat to medium , and cook , stirring , until soft and lightly caramelized , about 15 minutes
5. In a medium skillet , melt another 1 / 2 tablespoon butter over medium-high heat
6. Add the canadian bacon and cook , stirring , for 3 minutes
7. Drain on paper towels
8. Add the sausage to the skillet and cook , stirring , until browned , about 5 minutes
9. Drain on paper towels
10. In a large bowl , beat the eggs
11. Add the milk , cream , salt , essence , and pepper and whisk to combine
12. Add the croissants and let sit for 5 minutes
13. Add the sausage , bacon , onions , fontina cheese , stir together , and let sit for 5 to 10 minutes
14. Pour into the prepared dish and bake until almost completely set , 35 to 45 minutes
15. Cover with aluminum foil if it's browning too much
16. In a small bowl , melt the remaining 2 tablespoons butter in the microwave , then combine with the bread crumbs and parmesan
17. Uncover the pudding and evenly cover with the bread crumb mixture
18. Return to the oven , increase the heat to 375 degrees f and bake until completely set in the center and golden brown on top , about 15 minutes
19. Serve hot
20. Emeril's essence creole seasoning :
21. 2 1 / 2 tablespoons paprika
22. 2 tablespoons salt
23. 2 tablespoons garlic powder
24. 1 tablespoon black pepper
25. 1 tablespoon onion powder
26. 1 tablespoon cayenne pepper
27. 1 tablespoon dried oregano
28. 1 tablespoon dried thyme
29. Combine all ingredients thoroughly
30. Yield: 2 / 3 cup

title: twice  baked potato casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Lightly grease a shallow 2-quart baking dish
3. Cook potatoes in a large pot with salted water to cover for 20 to 25 minutes , until tender when pierced
4. Drain well and return to pot
5. While potatoes are still hot , add butter and mash with a potato masher until smooth
6. Stir in 1 cup of cheese , milk , sour cream and eggs until blended
7. Then add 1 / 2 cup of scallions , 3 slices of bacon , crumbled
8. Salt and pepper to taste
9. Spoon into the prepared baking dish
10. Sprinkle with remaining cheese and 2 slices of bacon , crumbled
11. Bake uncovered for 35-40 minutes or until the top is lightly golden brown
12. Sprinkle with remaining 1 / 4 cup of scallions and serve

title: house of blues ginger lemongrass soda water
steps:
1. Combine water and sugar in a medium size saucepan
2. Stir until sugar dissolves
3. Add lemongrass , ginger , lemon juice and vanilla bean
4. Bring to boil over high heat , then reduce heat to low and simmer 20 minutes
5. Remove from heat , cover and let steep overnight
6. Strain through a fine mesh strainer
7. To serve , fill chilled bar shaker halfway with ginger syrup
8. Top with equal amount of soda water
9. Strain into sugar-rimmed glasses and serve

title: greek tomatoes  ww
steps:
1. Arrange tomato slices on a serving platter
2. Sprinkle feta cheese , parsley , and pepper over tomatoes
3. Drizzle with olive oil
4. Serve immediately

title: italian mushrooms and spinach
steps:
1. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat
2. Saute onion and garlic in the oil until they start to become tender
3. Add the mushrooms , and saute until they begin to shrink , about 3 to 4 minutes
4. Add the wine and simmer 3-4 minutes until volume reduces by half
5. Add the vinegar and spinach , and saute , stirring constantly , for a few minutes , or until spinach is wilted
6. Season with salt and pepper to taste , and sprinkle with fresh parsley and parmesan cheese
7. Serve hot

title: colorful mango salsa
steps:
1. Whisk jelly and lime juice in large bowl
2. Mix in all remaining ingredients
3. Season to taste with salt and pepper

title: au gratin potato balls
steps:
1. Bake potatoes in either oven or microwave
2. Cool , peel & shred
3. In a large bowl combine onion , cream cheese , sour cream , butter , and seasonings
4. Mix in shredded potatoes until well combined
5. Take an ice cream scoop & dip out mixture & roll into balls
6. Roll the potato ball in parmesan cheese until well coated and place on a cookie sheet
7. Continue making balls until all mixture is gone
8. Cover & freeze
9. Once frozen , they can be placed in freezer bags & kept frozen
10. To cook , remove as many as you want and place on a cookie sheet
11. Bake at 350 degrees for 10-12 minutes or until lightly browned

title: giblet gravy  microwave
steps:
1. Pierce membranes of giblets and place in a 1 quart casserole with water , onions , & celery
2. Cover& microwave on medium for 45-50 minutes or until giblets are tender
3. Reserve liquid
4. Chop giblets and set aside
5. Pour drippings from roasted turkey into a 4 cup microwave safe measure and microwave on high for 1 to 2 minutes , or till hot
6. Stir in flour , salt , and pepper until smooth
7. Gradually , blend in reserved giblet broth and cover
8. Microwave on high for 3 to 4 minutes , stirring occasionally to prevent lumps
9. Add chopped giblets and microwave on high for 1-2 minutes or until thickened

title: noodles   sauerkraut casserole
steps:
1. Saut onions in margarine and add onion soup
2. Mix onion mixture with remaining ingredients in large casserole
3. Top with bread crumbs and parmesan cheese
4. Cover and bake at 350 for 1 hour

title: millet   quinoa mediterranean salad
steps:
1. Bring millet and 1 cup water to boil , reduce heat , and simmer for five minutes
2. Turn off heat , cover , and let sit for 10 minutes
3. Bring quinoa and 3 / 4 cup water to boil , reduce heat , and simmer , covered , for 12-14 minutes
4. Fluff
5. Combine all ingredients and toss
6. Chill
7. Enjoy !

title: extreme cereal bar  square
steps:
1. In a pot , over medium heat , combine peanut butter with corn syrup and butter , stir until smooth
2. Stir in cereals and peanuts , remove from heat
3. Place mixture in an 8 x 8 cake pan
4. Melt chocolate chips with butter and spread over the cereal and peanut butter mixture
5. Refrigerate for a few hours until chocolate is firm

title: cajun chicken fettuccine alfredo
steps:
1. Cut the chicken into bite size chunks and fry with the garlic
2. When chicken is done , add the cream and stir just until bubbly
3. Then add the tony's seasoning and the parmesean cheese and cook until bubbling , but dont let it curdle
4. Make fettucine according to package and mix all together when done !

title: vegan  pureed chickpea and kidney bean curry soup
steps:
1. First , empty both cans of beans into a colander and rinse off all of the liquid that came from the can onto the beans
2. Leave aside until later
3. Chop all vegetables into smaller pieces
4. Leave aside until later
5. In a large pot , heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil on medium-high and toss in mustard seeds
6. Heat until you hear the mustard seeds crackle a bit
7. Once this has been accomplished , toss in the chopped garlic and onion and stir around a bit with turmeric and cumin powder
8. After 30 seconds , toss in the rest of the chopped vegetables and canned tomatoes
9. After 1 minute , toss in the beans , and the rest of the spices and basil
10. If you like your soups spicier then put in more curry powder than the recipe calls for
11. Stir in the 2 cups of water at this time as well
12. If it seems 2 cups will make the soup too thin , then only add 1 or 1
13. 5 cups
14. After heating this concoction for 5 minutes or so , use a hand-held immersion blender to blend it all up
15. I like mine blended up pretty good , but it tastes great no matter the texture
16. Once it has been blended up , add salt to taste
17. Leave the temperature on low-medium for a couple of minutes longer to let the spices seep in more

title: russian cheesecake   zapekanka
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Drain cottage cheese in a sieve
3. Mix sugar and 2 tbsp butter
4. Add eggs , semolina and 3 tsp vanilla sugar
5. Gently stir in curds then fold in raisins
6. Grease a 9-inch round pan with butter , coat with flour
7. Carefully pour mixture into pan , smooth evenly
8. Bake on middle rack for 30 minutes
9. Melt remaining butter
10. Pour on top , spreading evenly
11. Broil for 5 minites to brown top
12. Mix sour cream with vanilla sugar and sugar
13. Serve like whipped cream

title: azorean  portuguese
steps:
1. In a pasta / stock pot place frozen block of shrimp along with water
2. If you are using fresh shrimp be sure to rinse and clean the shrimp before cooking making sure that the shell is still intact
3. Cover shrimp with water and follow remaining instructions for cooking
4. Add remaining ingredients
5. On high heat , place a lid on the top of the pot
6. Allow for block of ice / shrimp to thaw completely
7. Once the shrimp are loose , stir to mix all ingredients well
8. Place heat at a low temperature as to simmer the shrimp for 2 hours
9. This ensures that all the flavors blend well otherwise you may eat them immediately
10. If there are leftovers be sure to refrigerate
11. You can eat them cold or warm them back up in original broth for the next day
12. Enjoy

title: toss me later salad
steps:
1. Mix garlic , salt , dry mustard , lemon juice and oil together with a fork in the bottom of the serving bowl
2. Sprinkle parmesan cheese over all but do not stir
3. Cover with washed and dried greens , filling to top of bowl
4. Seal tightly with clear plastic wrap
5. Refrigerate for at least 6 hours , up to 2 days
6. When ready to serve , toss very well , this can be done by turning upside down as long as the wrap is tightly in place

title: raspberry and roasted red pepper chicken fillets
steps:
1. Preheat a large saut pan on medium-high heat for 2-3 minutes
2. Combine flour and seasoned salt in a large ziploc bag
3. Add chicken and shake to coat
4. Alternatively , place flour mixture into a pie plate or pan and dredge the chicken in it
5. Remove pan from heat and coat with cooking spray
6. Place chicken in the pan
7. Cover and cook 2-3 minutes on each side or until chicken is browned
8. Cut peppers lengthwise into 1 / 4-inch strips
9. Combine with sliced green onions and add to chicken
10. Cook 2-3 more minutes or until onions and peppers are softened
11. Whisk raspberry preserves , water , cornstarch , sherry and dried mint in a small bowl until blended
12. Reduce heat to low and stir in raspberry mixture
13. Simmer 10 minutes , turning chicken occasionally to coat with sauce , until chicken reaches an internal temperature of 165f
14. Serve chicken right away

title: strawberry cheese parfaits
steps:
1. Beat egg white until soft peaks are formed
2. Blend with cottage cheese , whipped cream , salt , vanilla , and sugar
3. In parfait gasses , alternate spoonfuls of cheese mixture with strawberries
4. Freeze
5. Remove from freezer 20 minutes before serving

title: poppy seed and green onion noodles
steps:
1. Cook noodles in medium saucepan of boiling slated water until al dente
2. Drain well , reserving 4 tablespoons cooking liquid
3. Melt butter in same saucepan over medium heat
4. Add noodles , green onions and poppy seeds
5. Toss until pasta is well coated , adding reserved cooking liquid by tablespoonfuls to moisten if noodles seem dry
6. Season to taste with salt and pepper and serve

title: slow cooker moroccan spiced chicken with apricots
steps:
1. Pat the chicken dry with paper towels and season with salt and pepper
2. Heat the oil in a 12-inch skillet over medium-high heat until just smoking
3. Brown half of the chicken on both sides , 5 to 8 minutes per side , reducing the heat if the pan begins to scorch
4. Transfer the chicken to a plate , leaving the fat in the pan
5. When cool enough to handle , remove the browned skin from the thighs and discard
6. Transfer the chicken to the slow cooker
7. Return the pan with the fat to medium-high heat and repeat with the remaining half of the chicken
8. Pour off all but 1 tablespoon fat from the pan
9. Add the onions , paprika , cardamom , and 1 / 4 teaspoon salt and cook until the onions are softened , 5 to 7 minutes
10. Stir in the garlic and cook until fragrant , about 30 seconds
11. Stir in 2 1 / 2 cups of the broth , the apricots , and cinnamon stick , scraping up any browned bits , and bring to a simmer
12. Pour into the slow cooker
13. Cover and cook on low for 3 hours
14. Quickly stir in the chickpeas , replace the cover , and continue to cook until the chicken is tender , about 1 hour longer
15. Transfer the chicken to a large serving dish and tent loosely with foil
16. Discard the cinnamon stick
17. Set the slow cooker to high
18. Whisk the remaining 1 / 2 cup broth and flour together until smooth , then stir into the slow cooker
19. Cover and continue to cook until the sauce is thickened and no longer tastes of flour , 15 to 30 minutes longer
20. Stir in the cilantro and lemon juice and season with salt and pepper to taste
21. Spoon the vegetables and some of the sauce over the chicken and serve with lemon wedges , passing the remaining sauce separately

title: peanut noodle salad
steps:
1. Peel cucumbers
2. Cut in half lengthwise , removing and discarding seeds
3. Cut cucumber halves into half-moon shaped slices
4. Whisk together soy sauce and next 7 ingredients in a large bowl
5. Add cucumber , pasta , carrot and onions , tossing to coat
6. Serve chilled or at room temperature

title: cambodian style ground pork
steps:
1. Place the pork , anchovies , paprika
2. Chili powder and cayenne in a large ungreased frying pan
3. Cook over medium high heat
4. Stirring occasionally to break up the chunks of meat about 5 minutes until the pork is browned
5. Add the coconut milk and cook until almost all the liquid evaporates , about 10 minutes
6. Mix the jicama and the lime juice to assemble
7. Spread about 1 / 3 cup of the pork filling in the center of a tortilla
8. Top with the jicama , eggplant , cabbage , cucumbers , and mint
9. Fold and serve

title: tarragon chicken salad wraps
steps:
1. In a large bowl
2. Combine the chicken , mayonnaise , lemon juice , tarragon and snap peas together
3. Mix until well coated and season to taste with salt and pepper
4. Lay tortillas on a flat surface and using 1 / 4 of chicken salad mixture , place it down the center of each tortilla
5. Top each with 2 lettuce leaves and roll up , folding in ends

title: grilled chicken breasts
steps:
1. Preheat an outdoor grill for medium-high heat , and lightly oil grate
2. Dip chicken in lemon juice , and sprinkle with the onion powder , ground black pepper , seasoning salt and parsley
3. Discard any remaining lemon juice
4. Cook on the prepared grill 10 to 15 minutes per side , or until no longer pink and juices run clear

title: frangelico coconut cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Combine frangelico , cake mix , eggs , water , and almond extract
3. Pour batter into two prepared 8 inch cake pans
4. Bake for 25 - 30 minutes
5. Turn onto a cooling rack
6. Beat cream with the sugar until stiff
7. Split the cake layers in half
8. Spread with whipped cream and stack on a serving plate
9. Frost the top and sides of the cake with your choice of frosting or frangelico frosting
10. Sprinkle with coconut

title: adam s laksa for one
steps:
1. Heat a wok until it is hot
2. Add 1 tbsp peanut oil and 1 tsp sesame oil
3. When the oils are hot add the chopped onion and stir for 2 to 3 minutes
4. Add the ginger , garlic , curry paste , then stir until thoroughly mixed
5. Do not burn
6. Next , open widows in the house and grab a tissue to wipe your teary eyes because the aromatic smell is so strong but smells delicious
7. Add chicken and stir for 2 minutes , coating well with the paste
8. Add chili sauce , fish sauce and stir for 30 seconds
9. Add the hot stock , stir
10. Add the cooked noodles and simmer for 2 minutes
11. Then add the lemongrass and coriander
12. Stir well
13. Add the chopped assorted vegetables
14. Stir for a minute
15. Do not over cook the vegetables
16. Add the coconut milk or cream and stir and simmer for 1 minute
17. Remove from the heat and serve immediately in a huge bowl

title: grilled salmon   cheddar sandwiches
steps:
1. Mix the salmon with the onion , lemon juice , and mayonnaise
2. Spread the mixture on thick slices of french bread and top with a slice of cheddar cheese
3. Add a top slice of bread and butter both sides of the sandwich generously
4. Grill until brown , then turn and brown the other side , and the cheese is melted
5. Serve hot

title: t town cheese spread with pimiento
steps:
1. Mix together all ingredients except cheddar cheeses
2. Blend well and add shredded cheeses
3. Cover and chill , removing from refrigerator 15 minutes before serving
4. Garnish with a sprinkle of bright red paprika and serve with good crackers , baquette slices or vegetable spears

title: cheeseburger mashed potato pie
steps:
1. Fry the beef in a nonstick pan , and when finished , drain off the fat and set it aside place the potatoes in a medium sized mixing bowl , mash them , or if using the instant , follow the directions on the box
2. Add the milk and whip them until creamy
3. In a medium sized baking dish , place a layer of the whipped potatoes about an inch thick
4. Add all of the ground beef for the second layer
5. Add half of the cheese for the third layer
6. Use the rest of the potatoes for the fourth layer
7. Add the rest of the cheese on top
8. Place in oven and bake at 350f until the cheese is melted and you see part of the potatoes golden brown
9. Let it set for five minutes and then serve

title: keto seed crackers
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300 degrees f
2. Place all the seeds , flour , salt and psyllium powder in a food processor and grind the seeds down to a uniform small size
3. Boil the 1 cup of water and make sure coconut oil is in liquid form if you refrigerate it
4. You should have one cup and a quarter of liquid
5. Pour ground seeds into a large mixing bowl
6. Pour boiling water into the seed mixture slowly , stirring as you pour
7. Mix thoroughly until all the liquid is mixed inches
8. Spread onto a 11x17 inch cookie sheet
9. Using a small roller , roll out the dough as thin as is possible
10. The thinner the dough , the crispier the cracker
11. Using the straight edge of a spatula , score the batter with straight lines in the dough until you have cracker size rectangles
12. Place crackers into the oven and set timer for 1 hour
13. Check crackers at 1 hour and if getting brown , turn off the oven and let the crackers cool slowly in the oven
14. When a bit cooler , finish cooling on a baking cooling rack to room temperature
15. Store in a sealed container and use with cheese , creamed cheese , peanut butter for snacks , hummus , etc

title: our favorite potato salad
steps:
1. Peel and wash potatoes
2. Cut into small cubes and boil for approximately 10 minutes
3. Don't let them get too soft
4. Drain them
5. In a large bowl add potatoes& italian salad dressing
6. Let it sit for about 15 minute
7. This lets the dressing mingle with the potatoes !
8. Add the diced celery , onion , eggs , s&p , and mayo
9. Mix it up good
10. Put in your favorite serving dish and layer the top with the sliced hard boiled egg , some parsley& some pakrika
11. Chill before serving

title: caramel apple pecan pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Line 9-inch pie plate with 1 pastry crust
3. In a large bowl , toss together apples , pecans , sugar , caramels , flour , and milk
4. Spoon mixture into pie shell
5. Top with remaining pastry
6. Fold the edge of the top pastry under the bottom pastry
7. Pinch together and flute the edge with a fork
8. Cut several slits in top so the steam can escape during baking
9. Brush top with milk and sprinkle with sugar
10. Bake until crust is golden brown , about 45 minutes
11. Pie is best served slightly warm

title: millet burgers
steps:
1. Use 1 cup of millet for 3 cups of water , add a pinch of salt and cook for about 25-30 minutes
2. The millet can be roasted before cooking to add a nutty taste to the grain
3. Saute the onion and garlic first , then add the carrot
4. Simmer for about 5 minutes then mix in a large bowl along with the other ingredients
5. The mixture can be made into patties and fried until golden or they can be baked at 375 f for 40 minutes
6. Alternatively: the mixture can become a millet loaf by putting the mixture in a baking dish in the oven

title: vegetarian portuguese kale soup
steps:
1. In a large stock pot , heat the olive oil over medium-high heat
2. Add the garlic , onions , turnips and carrots and cook for 5 minutes
3. Add the kale , chorizo , bay leaves , parsley and thyme and mix well
4. Add the veg
5. Stock , beans and tomatoes
6. Bring the soup to a boil , and then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 30 to 40 minutes
7. Meanwhile , in a medium saucepan , bring the salted water to a boil and add the diced potatoes
8. Cook until tender , about 10 minutes
9. Drain the potatoes and add them to the soup
10. Remove the bay leaves and serve hot
11. Enjoy !

title: pie filling bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Generously grease a 10-inch x 15-inch jelly-roll pan
3. Cream the sugar and butter together until fluffy
4. Add the eggs , one at a time , beating well after each addition
5. Mix in the flour , salt and vanilla , and beat until well-mixed
6. Spread the batter in the prepared pan and using a knife or spatula , score into whatever size bars you desire
7. In the middle of each of the bars , put about a tablespoon of the pie filling
8. Place on middle rack of preheated oven and bake for 25 to 28 minutes , or until lightly browned
9. Let cool completely and re-slice into bars , then sprinkle with powdered sugar

title: yummy parmesan chicken fingers
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
2. Line a baking sheet with a greased rack
3. In a food processor , combine cracker crumbs , parmesan cheese , basil , marjoram , paprika , optional salt , and pepper
4. Process to make fine crumbs
5. Place in a shallow bowl
6. Cut chicken breasts into four strips each
7. In a bowl , beat egg
8. Add chicken strips
9. Using a fork , dip chicken strips in crumb mixture until evenly coated
10. At this point they can be frozen then continue on with the instructions when ready to bake
11. Arrange on greased rack set on a baking sheet
12. In small bowl , microwave butter and garlic at high for 45 seconds or until melted
13. Brush chicken strips with melted butter
14. Bake in preheated oven for 15 minutes or until no longer pink in center

title: cocoa
steps:
1. In a large heavy saucepan combine milk , cocoa powder and sugar
2. Bring to a simmer over medium high heat , whisking frequently
3. Add chocolate and continue whisking until melted and smooth
4. Add salt
5. Bring back to a simmer whisking constantly until frothy
6. Ladle into warm mugs and top with marshmellows

title: shrimp in green sauce
steps:
1. Add olive oil and garlic to a food processor
2. Process until the garlic is finely chopped , scraping sides of bowl occasionally
3. Add in green onions and parsley
4. Pulse until minced
5. Transfer garlic mixture into a large bowl
6. Add in 1 / 2 teaspoon salt , black pepper , red pepper , and shrimp
7. Toss well to coat
8. Transfer shrimp mixture to a shallow roasting pan
9. Add in the wine
10. Bake in a 500 oven for 7 minutes or until shrimp are done , stirring once
11. Serve with bread

title: grandma s rhubarb crisp
steps:
1. In bowl combine sugar , 1 t flour and cinnamon
2. Add rhubarb
3. Toss
4. Place in a greased 9x13 inch baking dish
5. In bowl combine brown sugar , baking powder , baking soda , and remaining flour
6. Stir in butter
7. Sprinkle over rhubarb
8. Bake in preheated 350 degree oven for 40 minutes or until rhubarb is tender

title: never fail garlic bread
steps:
1. Mix margarine and garlic till combined
2. Sprinkle as much italian herb as you want for the zest taste
3. Combine sugar into the mixture
4. Spread mixture on bread and put under hot grill for 5-10 minutes
5. Serve !

title: hungarian mushrooms with spaetzle  sptzle
steps:
1. Mushrooms:
2. Heat a wide pan over a low flame and add butter
3. Add onions and cook until soft and translucent
4. Add the mushrooms , salt and pepper , raise the heat and stir
5. When the moisture from the mushrooms has been released , allow it to evaporate , concentrating the flavour
6. This might happen quickly or slowly , depending entirely on the type of mushrooms used
7. Add the paprika and cayenne then fry for a few moments more , until the paprika turns a shade darker
8. Finally , add the sour cream or crme fraiche and dill , and allow it bubble gently for about 5 minutes more
9. Spatzle:
10. Choose a large boiling pot and a large-hole colander which will rest on top of the pot
11. Fill the pot with water and rest the colander on top , so that the base of the colander is at least 5cm / 2 inches above the surface
12. Bring to the boil , salt it well , and reduce to a simmer
13. Meanwhile , mix the salt into the flour
14. Add the egg and gradually work in the milk
15. You may need more or less milk , but you want to achieve a consistency somewhere between a dough and a batter , though leaning towards batter you should be able to push it through the holes of the colander quite easily
16. Using a large metal spoon , scoop part of the batter into the colander and push it through into the simmering water
17. The spatzle will sink to the bottom , then rise when cooked
18. Remove cooked spatzle with a slotted spoon and keep warm while you cook the remaining batches

title: bell s homemade seasoning
steps: 1. Mix all together and use

title: not the usual turkey chili
steps:
1. Place vinegar , ground turkey , and cinnamon in a bowl
2. Allow to marinate about 30 minutes
3. In a large non-stick saucepan , cook onion about 5 minutes , or until transparent
4. Add turkey mixture and cook another 5 minutes
5. Add garlic and jalapeno peppers and cook 3-4 minutes
6. Add kidney beans , tomatoes , chili powder , and cumin , and simmer about 15 minutes
7. Add salt and pepper
8. Taste and adjust seasoning , adding more chili powder or cumin as needed

title: reblochon tarts with bacon   fingerling potatoes
steps:
1. In a small saucepan , cover the potatoes with cold water and bring to a boil
2. Cook over high heat until tender when pierced with a knife , about 15 minutes
3. Drain , then peel and thinly slice crosswise
4. Meanwhile , in a medium skillet , cook the bacon over moderately high heat until crisp , about 5 minutes
5. Transfer to paper towels
6. Cut the slices in thirds
7. Preheat the oven to 375f
8. Pour off the bacon fat in the skillet and add the oil
9. Add the onion and cook over moderate heat , stirring frequently , until softened and browned , about 15 minutes
10. Add water as necessary , 1 tablespoon at a time , to prevent scorching
11. Transfer the onion to a bowl
12. Season with salt , pepper , & crushed red pepper flakes
13. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper
14. On a lightly floured work surface , roll out the puff pastry to an 11-inch square
15. Using a plate as your guide , cut out four 5-inch rounds
16. Transfer the rounds to the prepared baking sheet and prick them all over with a fork
17. Bake the rounds in the center of the oven for about 8 minutes , until puffed and lightly golden
18. Using the back of a fork , deflate the rounds and bake for about 4 minutes longer , until the pastry is just set
19. Top the pastry rounds with the onion , potato slices , bacon and cheese
20. Bake for about 10 minutes , until the cheese is melted and the pastry is browned
21. Transfer the tarts to plates
22. Serve hot or warm

title: cream cheese bacon croissants
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f mix cream cheese and bacon in a small bowl until well blended
2. Separate each can of dough into 8 triangles
3. Cut each triangle in half lengthwise
4. Spread each triangle with 1 generous tsp of cream cheese mixture
5. Roll up , starting at shortest side of triangle and rolling to opposite point
6. Place point sides down on ungreased baking sheet
7. Bake 12 -15 minutes or until golden brown
8. Serve warm

title: peanut butter hazelnut pudding trail mix
steps:
1. Combine the cereal , nuts , raisins and banana chips
2. In saucepan , combine vanilla pudding and honey
3. Bring to a boil and boil 30 seconds
4. Remove from heat
5. Stir in peanut butter
6. Mix well
7. Pour over the cereal mix and combine until coated
8. Put on cookie sheet to cool

title: healthy banana nut muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 430 degrees
2. Pour all ingredients into a bowl , and mix thouroughly
3. Also , if you prefer your muffins sweeter , add around 5 or 6 artificial sweetner packets to the batter
4. Cook for around 10 minutes

title: salsa  low cal
steps:
1. In medium sized bowl , combine all ingredients
2. Mix well
3. Place in covered container
4. Chill until ready to serve

title: zucchini bars with cream cheese frosting
steps:
1. Bars:
2. Combine oil , sugar , and eggs in a large mixing bowl
3. Beat at medium speed until well blended
4. In another bowl , combine the flour and next 5 ingredients
5. Stir well
6. Add the flour mixture to the creamed mixture , beating until well blended
7. Stir in zucchini
8. Pour the batter into an ungreased 15 x 10 x 1 inch jellyroll pan
9. Bake at 350 degrees for 25 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in the center comes out clean
10. Let cool in the pan on a wire rack
11. Once cool , spread cream cheese frosting evenly over the top
12. Cut into bars
13. Frosting:
14. Combine the cream cheese , butter , and vanilla in a small mixing bowl
15. Beat at medium speed until light and fluffy
16. Add the powdered sugar , beating until the frosting is smooth
17. Spread on the cooled zucchini bars

title: vanilla dream float
steps:
1. Place 2 large scoops of ice cream in the bottom of each of four 8-ounce glasses
2. Fill each glass with cream soda

title: ham and cheese pita pizza
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f
2. Line a large baking sheet with parchment paper for quick clean up
3. Place the pita breads onto the baking sheet
4. Spread the tomato sauce evenly over the pitas
5. Top evenly with ham and the two cheeses
6. Season the pizza with salt , pepper and the oregano , if using
7. Drizzle with a little olive oil
8. Bake until the cheese is golden and bubbly , about 10 to 15 minutes
9. Cut into quarters and serve

title: old fashioned cream of broccoli soup
steps:
1. Melt butter in large sauce pan
2. Saut vegetables in butter until tender
3. Sprinkle with flour , salt and pepper
4. Stir in well
5. Add chicken broth and cream
6. Cook until thick and comes to a slow boil
7. Stirring frequently
8. Add wine and correct salt and pepper to taste

title: decadent triple layer mud pie
steps:
1. Mix chocolate and sweetened condensed milk until well blended
2. Pour into crust
3. Sprinkle with pecans
4. Press pecans lightly into chocolate mixture
5. Refrigerate 10 minutes
6. Pour milk into large bowl
7. Add pudding mixes
8. Beat with wire whisk 1 minute
9. Spoon 1-1 / 2 cups of the pudding over chocolate in crust
10. Gently stir 1 / 2 of the whipped topping into remaining pudding
11. Spread over pudding in crust
12. Top with remaining whipped topping
13. Refrigerate 3 hours
14. Store leftover pie in refrigerator

title: crispy fish sticks
steps:
1. Mix the first 4 ingredients in a shallow plate and set aside
2. Cut the tilapia fillets in long sticks with a width of about 1 inch
3. Marinate them in the lemon juice and season with salt and pepper to taste
4. Store meanwhile in the fridge
5. Then cover your cutting board with aluminum foil
6. Cut away the thick crusts of the bread
7. Then , tear the bread in coarse pieces and fill your food-processor or blender with it
8. Blend it to medium sized breadcrumbs
9. Toast your fresh breadcrumbs for 1-2 minutes at 400f this is necessary to evaporate most of the water
10. For a better crunchy skin
11. Remove and let it cool of and toss it a bit with a fork
12. Dispose it in another shallow plate
13. Pour a sizable amount of cooking oil in a deep pan , and turn your stove on low heat
14. Break eggs and whisk in a bowl
15. Place your marinated fish in front of the board , the flour-mixture next to it
16. Then follow the eggs and , the breadcrumbs and finally a bowl of water
17. Now the real deal begins ! lift a piece of fish with 2 forks and drop it into the flour-mix
18. Wallow the fish until fully covered and shake any excess flour off
19. Then transfer to the beaten eggs and do the same
20. At last , transfer to the plate with breadcrumbs and put away the forks in the bowl of water
21. Use your hands to tumble and lightly press around the fish until thoroughly covered in the crumbs
22. Move the fish-stick to the cutting-board and wipe your forks clean with a piece of paper towel
23. Repeat likewise for the other fish-sticks
24. When done , turn up the heat of your stove to high
25. The sticks have to rest for about 15 minutes , to get the crust set
26. So
27. Meanwhile you could clean up the counter in advance
28. The easiest last step: deep-fry the fish-sticks in about 5 minutes to a nice golden-brown colour
29. Serve with your favourite sauce !

title: spicy cinnamon dip
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients well
2. Chill until ready to serve

title: chocolate cake to die for
steps:
1. Bake cake according to directions
2. Immediately after baking , poke holes all over cake with end of wooden spoon
3. Pour can of condensed milk on top of the cake
4. Melt jar of hot fudge and pour that over the cake
5. Before serving , top cake with cool whip and crushed score or heath bar

title: mtabal
steps:
1. Roast the eggplant in a hot oven until the insides are soft , about 45 minutes
2. You will see the eggplant start to shrivel
3. Let cool and scrape out the pulp
4. Mix the flesh in a food processor with the rest of the ingredients
5. Serve chilled with a baguette or pita bread for dipping

title: mary jane s potatoes
steps:
1. Boil potatoes with the skin on until barely fork tender , about 20 minutes
2. Drain and cool
3. While potatoes are cooling , saute onion in butter just until opaque
4. You don't want them browned
5. Set aside
6. When cool enough to handle , peel potatoes and grate them into a 9 x 13 casserole
7. Top potatoes with onions and butter , and sprinkle on seasoning salt to taste
8. Pour cream over potatoes
9. Bake in a preheated 350f oven for about 45 minutes or until golden brown on top and cream has cooked into the potatoes

title: glorified rice  dessert salad
steps:
1. Mix rice , pineapple , sugar and marshmallows in a bowl
2. Whip cream with additional sugar and vanilla until stiff
3. Fold into rice mixture
4. Chill
5. Decorate with maraschino cherries or slices of fresh pineapple or strawberries
6. Serves 6-8

title: cheddar cheese grits
steps:
1. In a large saucepan over medium heat , add the water and milk
2. When bubbles just begin to break the surface , slowly add the grits , whisking constantly
3. Cook , stirring frequently and scraping the bottom of the pan , until thickened and cooked , about 7 minutes
4. Add the cheese and butter and stir just until melted
5. Remove from the heat
6. Add salt to taste and hot pepper sauce , if desired
7. Serve immediately

title: parsnip and carrot roast
steps:
1. The recipe uses 3-5 parsnips and 3-5 carrots both peeled and sliced into 'logs' , approximately 2-inch long , 1 / 4 - 1 / 2-inch on sides
2. Toss the parsnip and carrot 'logs' with the garlic and olive oil until well coated
3. Spread the vegetables on a baking sheet so that they don't overlap
4. Bake in a 450 deg
5. Oven for 30-45 min or until browned
6. They should get turned every 10 min or so to ensure that all sides get browned
7. Remove from oven and sprinkle with parmesan cheese before serving
8. The recipe will easily scale to fit your requirements

title: guilt free candy bar smoothie
steps:
1. In a blender container , combine almond milk , peanut butter , caramel flavoring syrup , chocolate syrup and flax
2. Blend until smooth
3. With motor running , add ice cubes one at a time through feed tube until thick and smooth
4. Add marshmallows and chocolate and process until finely chopped

title: vietnamese potato croquettes  cha khoai tay
steps:
1. Shred the potatoes in a food processor and place in a colander
2. Sprinkle with the salt and mix well
3. Let stand in the sink to drain for 15 minutes
4. Mix the dry seasonings together
5. Squeeze the potatoes dry and place in a mixing bowl
6. Add the cornstarch and mix thoroughly
7. Add all the remaining ingredients except the panko crumbs and oil and mix well
