8. Drop the potato mixture by tablespoonfuls into the panko crumbs and flatten slightly
9. Coat all the way around
10. Divide the oil in half and heat in a pan over moderately high heat
11. Lower the patties into the hot oil and flatten the patties with a spatula if necessary: the patties should not be too thick , and should be about 2 inches across
12. Fry until crisp and golden on the bottom , then turn and fry the other side
13. Drain on a wire rack or on paper towels , then transfer to plates
14. Add more oil as needed for frying the remaining patties
15. Optional: serve with nuoc cham dipping sauce

title: simple   delicious pot roast
steps:
1. Thaw roast if frozen
2. Trim excess fat
3. Rub all over with cajun seasoning , sprinkle with salt to taste
4. Spray crock pot with cooking spray
5. Put roast in bottom
6. Mix together both soups , and pour over
7. Cook on low heat until tender and falling apart
8. Slice and keep in gravy
9. Serve with salad and mashed potatoes

title: turkey casserole
steps:
1. Melt butter over low heat , add green pepper , celery , onion
2. Saute until tender , but not brown
3. Blend in flour and seasonings
4. Stir in milk and broth and cook until thick and smooth , stirring constantly
5. Fold in turkey and pimento , if using , and allow to heat through
6. Place cooked rice in bottom of a 2 quart casserole
7. Pour over turkey mixture
8. Mix crumbs , melted butter , and cheese and sprinkle over top
9. Bake in 350f oven for 30 minute or until lightly browned
10. Makes 6 servings

title: baked squash sticks
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 450 degrees
2. Spray a cookie sheet with non-stick spray
3. Cut the vegetables in half lengthwise and then cut each section in half crosswise
4. Cut the quaters into long strips 1 / 4 inch thick
5. Mix all of the dry ingredients in a large bowl
6. Add the vegetables to the bowl and mix until coated with the seasonings
7. Drizzle olive oil over vegetables and mix until the vegetables are coated with oil
8. Place the vegetables in a single layer on the cookie sheet
9. Bake for 10 minutes
10. Turn the vegetables over and bake for another 5 to 10 minutes , until vegetables are tender

title: bbq crock pot beef
steps:
1. Cut or trim beef if needed
2. Place all ingredients in crock pot
3. Stir to combine
4. Cover
5. Turn on high for 4-5 hours low for 6-8 hours
6. Taste great served on rice or egg noodles

title: exotic ice cubes
steps:
1. Keeping each fruit separate , whiz the flesh in a blender until smooth
2. Pour into ice cube trays and freeze
3. Defrost for about 5 minutes prior to serving

title: baked fish with onions
steps:
1. Heat oil and 2 tablespoon of the butter and cook onions over medium heat until soft and golden , stirring often-- about 15 minutes
2. Stir in the flour and cook for 2 minutes
3. Whisk in the milk , bring to a boil , reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes
4. Add more milk if sauce is too thick
5. Season with salt and pepper
6. Spread one third of the onion sauce in a casserole and sprinkle with one third of the cheeses
7. Cover with the fish fillets , then sprinkle with one third of the cheese
8. Pour the remaining sauce over the fish and sprinkle with the remaining cheese
9. Top with the fresh bread crumbs and dot with small pats of butter
10. Bake in a preheated 400 degree oven for about 20 minutes until the casserole is bubbly

title: warm chocolate cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450f
2. Butter and lightly flour 6 ramekins
3. Tap out excess flour
4. In a small saucepan , bring 2 inches of water to a boil
5. In a large glass bowl , add butter , chocolate and espresso powder
6. Lower heat and place bowl over the simmering water
7. Slowly whisk mixture until the chocolate is almost completely melted
8. Remove bowl from heat and continue to whisk mixture until all chocolate has melted
9. Allow to cool slightly
10. In a large bowl , add eggs , yolks , and sugar
11. Using an electric mixer , beat until light and fluffy and pale in color
12. Reduce speed to medium-low and slowly pour in the chocolate mixture
13. Add the flour and mix until just combined
14. Do not overwork the batter
15. Divide the batter between the molds
16. Place molds on a baking sheet and place in oven for 7 minutes
17. The top and sides should be cooked and dry and the inside will be runny
18. Using oven mitts , carefully invert each mold onto a plate and let sit for 10 seconds
19. Then lift one corner of the ramekin and the cake should slip out
20. Garnish with sweetened whipped cream and serve warm

title: cranberry upside   down cake
steps:
1. Drain pineapple , reserving juice
2. Add water to juice to measure 1-1 / 4 cups
3. Set aside
4. Pour butter into a greased 13 x 9 x 2 inch baking dish
5. Sprinkle brown sugar evenly over melted butter , then cranberries and walnuts
6. Top with pineapple
7. Keep all fairly even
8. In mixing bowl , combine dry cake mix , eggs , oil and reserved pineapple juice
9. Beat on medium speed for 2 minutes
10. Pour into prepared pan
11. Bake at 350 for 40-45 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean
12. Cool for 10 minutes before inverting onto a large serving platter
13. Cool down to room temperature
14. Cover with plastic wrap until ready to serve

title: mini cinnamon buns  bread machine dough
steps:
1. For dough , add all ingredients in a bread machine pan in the order listed
2. Select the dough / pasta setting
3. Press start
4. When beeps to "add ingredients" , don't do anything
5. Let it go all the way
6. When dough is finish , remove from machine
7. Knead dough for about 10 minutes using flour if sticky
8. Roll out into a rectangle
9. Cut dough into 4 rectangles
10. For each smaller rectangle , spoon 1 / 4 of the mixture on the dough
11. Roll into a long pinwheel
12. Pinch the end the dough to keep in place
13. Cut into 1 / 2 inch pieces
14. Makes about 18
15. Do the same thing for the other 3 pieces of dough and the rest of the filling
16. Place onto a greased baking pan
17. Cover
18. Let rise for 30-40 minutes
19. Preheat oven to 350f
20. Bake for 12-15 minutes , or until lightly brown on top
21. Remove from oven and let cool completely
22. Mix together sugar , vanilla , and milk
23. Drip icing on top of buns
24. Enjoy !

title: penne with pancetta
steps:
1. Over medium heat , fry pancetta in hot oil in a large pot until crisp
2. Transfer pancetta to papertowel lined plates to let drain
3. Reserve 1 tablespoon drippings in the pot
4. Saute onions in drippings for 3-4 minutes
5. Add in garlic and cook / stir for 2-3 minutes
6. Add in tomatoes , salt , and peppers
7. Stir to combine
8. Cook , stirring frequently , for 10 minutes or until thickened
9. Add penne
10. Stir and cook until heated through
11. Sprinkle with pancetta
12. Sprinkle with romano or parmesan cheese

title: southern tea vegetable sandwiches
steps:
1. After grating all vegetables , drain and squeeze out all the liquid you can
2. Mix with cream cheese
3. Add seasonings and enough mayonnaise to spread
4. Serve on white bread with the crust removed and sliced in quarters

title: diamond chicken
steps:
1. Place chicken breasts in an 8x8-inch pan
2. Lay swiss cheese over each breast
3. Sprinkle with seasoned salt
4. Mix soup with wine , pour over chicken
5. Sprinkle with stuffing mix
6. Bake at 350f for 1 hour

title: texas  mop sauce  barbecue sauce
steps:
1. In medium saucepan bring water to a boil
2. Stir in coffee granules
3. Stir in remaining ingredients
4. Bring to a boil and simmer 20 minutes , stirring occasionally
5. Serve immediately or pour into covered container after cooled
6. Keep in fridge for up to 7 days
7. Makes 4 cups

title: joyce lamont s ground beef stroganoff
steps:
1. Cook noodles according to package directions
2. When they are tender , drain them and toss them with 2 tablespoons butter- put the noodles in a 2-quart casserole
3. Melt 2 tablespoons butter in a large skillet
4. Add the onions and mushrooms and sauce for 5 minutes , stirring continuously
5. Add ground beef and cook and stir until meat is browned
6. Add almonds , soup , sour cream , salt , pepper and brandy
7. Spoon meat mixture over the noodles in the casserole
8. Bake uncovered for 30 minutes at 375 degrees

title: individual blueberry cobblers
steps:
1. Pick over and wash berries
2. Place in saucepan with 1 / 4 cup sugar , lemon rind and water
3. Bring to a boil and simmer for 5 minutes
4. Pour equal amounts into 4 greased tart pans
5. Cream butter , 1 / 3 cup sugar , egg and vanilla until well blended
6. Mix flour , baking powder , salt and nutmeg
7. Add to creamed mixture along with the milk
8. Beat until smooth
9. Spoon batter over hot blueberries
10. Bake at 375 for about 30 minutes or until browned
11. Serve warm , plain or with ice cream or whipped cream

title: dilly salmon spread
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a bowl until smooth
2. Serve with crackers or fresh veggie sticks , if desired

title: lemon grass chicken soup
steps:
1. In an 1 to 10-quart pan , bring broth to a boil over high heat
2. Meanwhile , pull off and discard course outer layers from lemon grass and trim off and discard stem ends
3. Cut each stalk into about 3-inch lengths
4. With the flat side of a knife , lightly crush lemon grass and ginger
5. Cut one or two chilies in half lengthwise
6. Stem remaining chilies , finely chop and reserve
7. Add lemon grass , ginger , and halved chilies to boiling broth
8. Reduce heat and simmer , covered , for 20 to 30 minutes
9. Meanwhile , rinse cabbage and cut into shreds about 1 / 4 inch wide and 2 to 3 inches long
10. Rinse mushrooms , trim off and discard stem ends and discolored parts , and slice lengthwise 1 / 4 inch thick
11. Peel carrots and slice 1 / 4 inch thick
12. Rinse chicken and cut into 1 / 4-inch thick slices 1 1 / 2 to 2 inches long
13. With a slotted spoon , remove and discard lemon grass , ginger and chilies from broth
14. Add cabbage , mushrooms , carrots , and garlic to broth
15. Cover and bring to a boil over high heat
16. Reduce heat and simmer until carrots are tender when pierced , 8 to 10 minutes
17. Add chicken and tomatoes with their juice
18. Cover and cook over high heat until chicken is no longer pink in the center
19. This will take about 3 to 5 minutes
20. Add lemon juice and fish sauce to taste
21. Sprinkle with green onions
22. Place rice , lemon wedges , cilantro and chopped chilies in separate bowls and offer with soup to add to taste

title: pecan crusted baked chicken breasts
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees f
2. Combine honey and mustard in a small bowl
3. Stir well
4. Combine nuts and panko in a separate shallow bowl
5. Brush each side of each chicken breast with the honey mixture
6. Dredge chicken in panko mixture
7. Press panko mixture onto chicken , so it will stick
8. Place chicken on a baking sheet coated with cooking spray
9. Lightly coat chicken with cooking spray
10. Bake at 450 degrees f for about 12 minutes or until done

title: pork and red chili stew
steps:
1. Wash the chili pods removing seeds
2. Please
3. You may leave in some of the seeds if you want a spicier dish
4. Place chili pods , sun dried tomatoes and 1 cup of broth in saucepan
5. Bring to a boil
6. Turn off heat , cover and allow to steep while browning the onions and meat
7. In a heavy skillet or dutch oven , cook bacon until crisp
8. With a slotted spoon , remove the bacon from fat and set aside to drain
9. Discard the fat , add in 1 tablespoon olive oi to pan and warm over medium heat
10. When warm add in chopped onion and garlic
11. Cook until onions begin to brown
12. Transfer to crock-pot
13. Cut the pork loin into 1 1 / 2 to 2 inch cubes
14. Mix together the flour , salt and pepper
15. Place pork in container with tight fighting lid , sprinkle with seasoned flour , cover and shake to lightly coat the meat
16. Add another tablespoon of oil to skillet and cook meat in small batches until lightly browned , adding in additional oil as needed
17. As meat is browned transfer to crock-pot with onions and garlic
18. De-glaze the pan with a small amount of broth
19. Place the chili pods and sun dried tomatoes in blender container
20. Add in salt , pepper to taste
21. Process until smooth adding remaining broth
22. Pour over meat in crock-pot , stir in ground cumin , oregano and bay leaves
23. Crumble bacon and stir into mixture
24. Cover and cook on low for 3 to 4 hours or until meat is fork tender
25. The last 45 to 60 minutes of cooking add in the package of simply potatoes and turn up to high
26. Stew will be thick
27. Continue to cook until potatoes are tender and cooked through
28. Serve with tortillas of choice or use filling to make burritos

title: galette
steps:
1. Soften butter
2. Add sugar
3. Beat until whipped
4. Add eggs one by one
5. Add almond powder , salt , flour , and vanilla extract
6. Take the dough and make it into a circle and put teh batter in the center
7. Put a coin inside the batter without looking
8. Put the second piece of dough on the first piece of dough
9. Put a bit of water in a cup
10. Close the two pieces of dough by by putting your fingers in a cup and clamping the two pieces of dough together
11. Take the yolk of your eggs and spread them around the top until the top is covered
12. Make a design on the top with a knife
13. Place the galette in the oven for about 30 to 45 minutes
14. Enjoy !

title: chez panisse zucchini fritters
steps:
1. Grate the zucchini and salt them
2. Let stand for 30 minutes in a colander
3. Squeeze the zucchini dry with your hands or wring it out in a towel
4. Peel and chop the garlic fine , chop fine about 1 tablespoonful of the chives , and grate the zest from the lemons
5. In a large bowl , combine the zucchini with the garlic , chives , lemon zest , the potato starch , and the egg , lightly beaten
6. Heat the olive oil in a nonstick saut pan over medium heat
7. For each fritter , pour a generous tablespoonful of the zucchini batter into the pan
8. They will look like little pancakes
9. Turn them over after about 3 minutes , or when golden
10. Cook 2
11. Minutes more on the other side
12. Drain on paper towels

title: white bean and rosemary soup
steps:
1. Rinse well and drain white beans
2. Rinsing away the liquid around canned beans can help cut down on the amount of gas you may experience from beans
3. In a large pot , warm the olive oil over medium-high heat
4. Add onion , carrot , and celery
5. Saute while stirring lightly until vegetables are soft
6. Add garlic and rosemary and saute for another 3 to 4 minutes
7. Add drained beans and vegetable stock
8. Bring to a boil , reduce heat , and simmer gently for 20 to 30 minutes
9. After simmering , place 1 / 3 to of the bean soup in the blender
10. Carefully blend until thick and smooth
11. Caution: be very careful when blending , letting steam and heat escape every few seconds , by lifting blender lid slowly throughout blending
12. If steam and heat build up , the lid can blow off the blender
13. Return blended soup to pot and stir to mix
14. Season with salt and pepper
15. Ladle soup into bowls and sprinkle each bowl with a little parmesan cheese
16. See above for chili variation
17. If you do not like pureed soup , do not use the blender method just eat as cooked
18. I like it without the blender method

title: simple chicken cordon bleu
steps:
1. Pound chicken breast to -inch thickness
2. Sprinkle each piece on both sides with salt and pepper
3. Place 1 cheese slice and 1 ham slice on each breast
4. Roll up each breast using toothpicks to secure if necessary
5. Dredge each in flour , shake off excess , then in egg and finally in bread crumbs
6. Place seam side down in baking dish that has been sprayed with pam
7. Place 1 tablespoon butter on each piece of chicken
8. Bake at 350 for 35 minutes until juices run clear
9. Meanwhile , in a saucepan , combine broth and whipping cream
10. Season to taste
11. Simmer on low stirring until thickened
12. Pour over chicken

title: my favorite color is purple salad
steps:
1. Dressing: to prepare the vinaigrette , combine all of the ingredients in a jar with a tight-fitting lid
2. Shake until blended
3. Taste and adjust seasonings
4. Salad: arrange the vegetables artfully on a salad platter lined with the romaine lettuce
5. Serve raspberry-lavender vinaigrette on the side

title: german chocolate cake  high altitude recipe
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. Prepare three 8-inch layer pans by lining them with wax paper and greasing them
3. In a double boiler melt the chocolate with the water over simmering water
4. Let cool
5. In a large bowl using a mixer cream the butter with the sugar until light and fluffy
6. Beat in egg yolks one at a time and then blend in the melted chocolate
7. In a measuring cup dissolve the baking soda in the buttermilk
8. In a bowl sift flour and salt together
9. Add dry ingredients alternately with the buttermilk mixture , mixing well after each addition
10. Add vanilla
11. Mix well
12. With a rubber scraper or whisk fold in beaten egg whites
13. Pour batter into prepared pans
14. Bake for 35-40 minutes or until cake center springs back when pressed with finger
15. Cool
16. Fill and frost with frosting
17. To make the frosting: in a saucepan combine butter , evaporated milk , cream , sugar , beaten egg yolks , and salt
18. Cook over low heat , stirring constantly until mixture is thickened
19. Remove from heat
20. Stir in vanilla , coconut and nuts
21. Beat until consistency for spreading

title: armenian pumpkin and lamb stew
steps:
1. Cut the pumpkin into 2 to 3 inch chunks , leaving skin on
2. Brush with oil & roast at 400 degrees f skin side up about 30 minutes until softened & browned
3. Remove from oven & set aside to cool
4. Combine coriander , cardamom , cinnamon , cumin and clove in a spice mill
5. Or coffee grinder
6. Grind until smooth
7. Set aside
8. Head a tblsp of oil
9. In large , heavy-bottom saucepan
10. Add the lamb in one layer
11. Sprinkle with
12. The spice mixture
13. Seer over medium heat until lightly browned , about 3-5
14. Minutes
15. Remove the lamb from the pan and set aside
16. Add the onion and garlic to the pan
17. Saute , stirring frequently , until translucent , about 5 minutes
18. Add the carrots , celery root , tomatoes , and acorn squash
19. Add the broth
20. Return lamb to the pan
21. Partly cover and gently simmer until the lamb is tender , about 1 1 / 2 to 2 hours
22. While the stew is simmering , peel the skin from the roasted pumpkin & add to the stew in the last 1 / 2 hour of cooking
23. Season to taste with salt and pepper
24. Cook the rice according to package directions , set aside
25. Divide the rice among warmed bowls
26. Ladle the stew over the rice
27. Garnish with coriander and parsley
28. Serve immediately

title: like that sweet curry salad dressing
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in jar with tight fitting lid and shake well
2. Refrigerate until ready to use
3. Shake dressing well before serving
4. Fyi: if the dressing is too thick , thin with a little bit more milk or water to desired consistency

title: filet mignon with rum butter
steps:
1. Combine half of rum , shallots , lime juice and pepper in shallow dish
2. Add steaks
3. Marinate 30 to 60 minutes , turning once
4. Sprinkle with salt
5. Heat remaining rum , shallots , lime juice and pepper in small pan on preheated outdoor grill
6. Stir in butter a small piece at a time
7. Stir in parsley
8. Brush steaks with half of rum butter and grill 8 to 10 minutes
9. Turn and brush with remaining rum butter
10. Grill another 8 minutes or until desired doneness

title: liz s easy garlic herb butter
steps:
1. Make sure that your butter is softened
2. Not melted
3. Put all of your ingredients in a mixing bowl and beat it until everything is mixed well and incorporated
4. Your butter will probably be a little creamy
5. Scrape the bowl and put your garlic butter in a container that has a lid and close the lid completely to make sure that no outside air will come inches
6. Stick your dish in either the fridge or your freezer
7. I like to make this butter a day in advance so all of the ingredients can hang out
8. You don't have to let it sit if you need to use it immediately

title: atkins creamy mushroom soup
steps:
1. Melt half of the butter in a large sauce pan and saute mushrooms for about 5 minutes until done
2. Add the broths to the mushrooms and bring to a simmering boil
3. Melt the other half of the butter in a small frying pan and mix in the crushed sesame seeds
4. Gradually add several tablespoons of the broth to the sesame butter , stirring constantly
5. Stir the sesame mixture into the broths , salt and pepper to taste
6. Cook broth over low heat for 10 minutes
7. Remove from heat and stir in heavy cream until well blended
8. Serve garnished with chives

title: honey mustard acorn squash
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Use a large knife to cut stem off squash and then to cut it in half vertically
3. Use a spoon to scrape out seeds and any stringy stuff from inside the squash
4. Set squash on a baking pan , cavity side up
5. If it wobbles too much , slice a piece off the backside so squash will lie still and flat
6. Combine butter , mustard and honey and place into cavity of squash
7. Top with a light sprinkling of salt and pepper
8. Bake until squash is very tender , about 1 to 1-1 / 2 hours
9. For a variation on sweetness , use 2 tablespoons of real maple syrup instead of honey

title: tuna and olive salad sandwich
steps:
1. Whisk together mayonnaise and lemon juice in a large bowl
2. Add remaining salad ingredients and stir together gently
3. Season with salt and pepper
4. Assemble sandwiches: cut baguette into 4 equal lengths and halve each piece horizontally
5. Brush cut sides with oil and season with salt and pepper
6. Make sandwiches with baguette , lettuce , and tuna salad

title: honolulu bob burgers
steps:
1. Divide the ground beef into 4 portions and shape each into a patty
2. Grill over hot coals until cooked on one side
3. Turn the patties over
4. Spread with the desired amount of country bob's all purpose sauce and top with the pineapple slices
5. Grill for several minutes or until cooked through
6. Add the cheese slices
7. Grill until the cheese melts
8. Top with additional sauce and serve as desired

title: crock pot self frosting chocolate cake
steps:
1. Combine cake mix , 3 / 4 cup water , oil and eggs in greased crock pot
2. Mix nuts into batter
3. Mix together chocolate syrup , sugar and 1 / 4 cup warm water and drizzle over batter
4. Cover and cook on low for 2-3 hours

title: peanut dipping sauce for vietnamese spring roll
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a bowl
2. Season to taste

title: imam bayaldi
steps:
1. Peel half the skin away from the eggplants in long strips , so that they look stripy
2. With the
3. Sprinkle the eggplants with salt and allow them to stand for 30 minutes , then rinse
4. Preheat the oven to 180c / 350f / gas 4
5. Put the onions into a pan , preferably non-stick , with 50ml of the olive oil and the sugar
6. Cook very slowly for about 1 hour until the onions are completely soft and the mixture is the consistency of a light jam
7. Spread one third of the mixture over the base of an oiled casserole dish , then add a layer of chopped tomatoes and set aside
8. Add the remaining tomatoes to the fried onions in the pan
9. And add the nutmeg and half of the parsley
10. Mix well and cook for 10 minutes
11. Add the water to the pan contents and stir
12. Arrange the eggplants on the onion mixture in the bottom of the casserole and with a spoon , stuff the garlic slices into the slashes in the eggplants
13. Add the pan contents to the casserole dish and work it into the slashes in the eggplants as well
14. At this point , the casserole dish should be really full !
15. Season to taste and pour the remaining oil over the contents
16. Cover the casserole with a sheet of foil and then the lid
17. This should ensure that it is thoroughly sealed
18. Cook in the oven for 40 minutes , or until the eggplants are really soft
19. If you like a thick sauce , remove the lid for the last 10 minutes to allow it to dry off a little
20. Allow the dish to cool off until it is lukewarm , then sprinkle with the remaining parsley and serve

title: fontina and bell pepper baked potato topping
steps:
1. Microwave oil , peppers , and garlic in a microwave-safe dish on high 1 minute
2. Season with salt and pepper
3. Sprinkle cheese over hot split baked potato and microwave 30 seconds
4. Spoon pepper mixture over cheese

title: milk and honey quick bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Butter loaf pan
3. In medium saucepan , combine 1 / 2 cup honey and milk
4. Stir over medium heat until honey dissolves
5. Stir in melted butter
6. Set aside to cool
7. Sift flour , sugar , baking powder and salt into large mixer bowl
8. Add pecans and toss to coat
9. Set aside
10. Whisk egg into cooled milk mixture
11. Add to flour mixture
12. Beat at medium speed just until blended
13. Pour into pan and smooth top
14. Bake for 65-75 minutes until toothpick comes clean from center
15. Cool on rack 10 minutes , remove and cool again on rack

title: buttery layer supreme cake
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease a 13" x 9" baking pan
3. In a medium bowl , combine the flour , 1-1 / 2 cups granulated sugar , baking powder and salt
4. Cut in the shortening with a pastry blender or in a food processor , until the mixture resembles coarse meal
5. Mix in 3 of the eggs , and the melted butter
6. Mix with a wooden spoon to combine well
7. Spread this batter over the bottom of the prepared baking pan
8. In another bowl , combine the softened cream cheese , the 2 remaining eggs the confectioners sugar and the vanilla
9. Pour this mixture over the batter in the baking pan
10. Bake for 15 minutes
11. Remove from oven , and sprinkle the reserved 2 tbsp sugar over the top
12. Return the cake to the oven , and bake for 35 minutes more
13. When done , the cake will still be moist in the center
14. Cool slightly before serving

title: lindas cajun spice mix
steps:
1. Mix the spices together in a small bowl
2. Store in an airtight container

title: stuffing for turkey  mom s way
steps:
1. Melt butter in a skillet on medium , sautee the celery , onion and garlic until transparent
2. Combine the sauteed veggies with the cubed bread and croutons in a large mixing bowl
3. Add the water chestnuts , parsley , sage and poultry seasoning , salt and pepper
4. Moisten the mixture with the chicken broth , use as much as needed to get the bread moist , not wet or soggy
5. Add the beaten eggs as well
6. Mixing with the hands is the best way
7. Prepare the turkey
8. Stuff the cavity and neck cavity
9. Put any extra in another baking dish and cook with turkey in the oven

title: scalloped sweet potatoes with ground beef
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. In an 8 cup baking dish mix ground beef , onion , green pepper , salt and pepper
3. Press into a thin layer
4. Peel potatoes , slice thinly and layer over meat mixture
5. Combine brown sugar and flour together
6. Mix pineapple juice , vinegar and soya sauce together
7. Stir the juice mixture into the brown sugar and flour
8. Pour over the potatoes and ground beef
9. Cover and bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour

title: pork chops on rice
steps:
1. In skillet , brown chops and season
2. Place rice in 12"x7&1 / 2"x2"< baking dish
3. Pour orange juice over rice
4. Place on chops and pour soup over all
5. Cover and bake in pre-heated 350 degree oven for 45 minutes , uncover and bake 10 minutes longer

title: lemon cream cheese strudel
steps:
1. Defrost filo , following the package directions
2. Zest the lemon , mince and reserve
3. Carefully peel the lemon , removing all of the white pith
4. Thinly slice the peeled lemon with care , set aside
5. Lemon is easier to cut if first frozen
6. Combine the cheese , yolks , sugar and extract with an electric mixer or food processor
7. Blend until creamy
8. Fold in raisins if desired , and zest
9. Refrigerate
10. Heat oven to 375
11. Grease a baking sheet
12. Dampen a large cotton cloth , place on work surface
13. Remove first filo leaf from package and place on cloth
14. Brush the leaf quickly with melted butter
15. Sprinkle with 2 tablespoons of breadcrumbs
16. Top with another filo leaf , butter and sprinkle with 2 tablespoons breadcrumbs
17. Repeat with 2 more filo leaves
18. Working across only the bottom half of the short end of the prepared filo , spread half of the filling on the pastry , leaving a one-inch border acress the short end and halfway up both sides
19. Lay half of the lemon slices in a row across the filling
20. Fold the border over the filling , and using the cloth as a guide , loosely roll the pastry jellyroll fashion , taking care to keep ends tucked inches
21. Place rolled strudel , seam side down , on prepared baking sheet , brush with butter
22. Using a sharp knife , make seven slashes just through the top layer of filo leaves dividing the strudel into 8 equal servings
23. Repeat entire process with remaining filo leaves and filling to make a 2nd strudel
24. Bake 50-55 minutes , or until deep golden brown
25. Cool on wire rack for 30 minutes
26. Sprinkle with powdered sugar

title: pigs in the garden casserole
steps:
1. Pre heat oven to 350 , spray 9 x 13 with cooking spray and set aside
2. Bring all vegetable to boil and boil for 10 minute
3. In large skillet cook the bacon until crispy then set bacon aside , but leave grease in skillet
4. In the skillet , add the ranch , salsa , chopped up sausage and crumble the bacon over top
5. Mix together and cook til mix simmers
6. Drain vegetables and spead them into 9 x 13 in even layer
7. Pour the sausage mix down middle of vegetable mix length wise of dish
8. Cover the rest of the exposed vegetables on either side of sausage mix with the shredded chesse
9. Bake casserole for 15 to 20 min and enjoy !

title: fresh lime
steps:
1. Clean the lime very well
2. Cut the lime in half and then cut it into wedges
3. Squeeze the juice from three wedges into a tall glass
4. Drop the lime wedges into the glass
5. Squeeze the juice from the remaining wedges into another glass
6. Drop the lime wedges into the glass
7. Fill the glasses with ice and sprite
8. Enjoy !

title: brazilian  flan
steps:
1. Coat tube pan with caramelized sugar
2. Allow to harden
3. Blend all the other ingredients together and pour in mold
4. Place mold in pan with 2" hot water in preheated oven
5. Bake at 350f for about 1 hour or 1 hour and 15 min until deep golden brown
6. Let cool , refrigerate overnight , then invert and unmold

title: melissa d arabian s pulled pork
steps:
1. Rinse the pork , dry with paper towels and season with salt and pepper
2. Put into the slow cooker
3. Top with onions and garlic , add the broth or wine
4. Slow cook on low for 8 hours or until completely done
5. Pull pork apart with two forks
6. Enjoy !

title: pumpkin seed chicken mole
steps:
1. Place a dry cast-iron skillet over low heat
2. Toast the pumpkin seeds , cumin seeds , pepper and oregano , shaking the pan occasionally , until their aromas are released , about 5 minutes
3. Do not brown
4. Set aside to cool and then grind in a blender or food processor to a powder
5. Reserve
6. Combine the tomatillos , serrano chile , garlic , lettuce , cinnamon , cilantro , radish tops , onion and salt in a food processor
7. Puree until smooth
8. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
9. Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over high heat
10. Standing back to avoid splatters , pour in the pureed tomatillo mixture , and sizzle for 30 seconds
11. Stir in the stock , reduce the heat and simmer 10 minutes
12. Turn the heat up to high and bring to a boil
13. Stir in the ground nut mixture and remove from the heat
14. Puree in a food processor or blender , in batches if necessary
15. Pass through a fine strainer , pressing with the back of a ladle to extract all the juices , into a 13 x 10-inch flameproof baking dish
16. Place the chicken breasts in the sauce and bring to a boil over moderate heat
17. Cover with foil , transfer to the oven and bake 20 minutes
18. Serve the chicken and sauce over a bed of white rice
19. Sprinkle the radish slices over the top

title: kilimanjaro
steps:
1. Blend all ingredients until smooth
2. Pour into a tall glass
3. Garnish with crushed peppermint

title: fall off the bone bar b q chicken
steps:
1. Combine ingredients and bring to a boil
2. Simmer for 10 minutes
3. Pour 1 / 4 cup water in bottom of a shallow pan
4. Lay chicken tightly in the pan
5. Pour sauce over chicken
6. Bake at 275 degrees for 2 1 / 2 to 3 hours uncovered
7. Turn chicken halfway through

title: bawang goreng fried shallots
steps:
1. Peel and slice the shallots as thinly as possible , using a mandoline or a very sharp knife
2. Spread the sliced shallots out in a thin layer on a large sheet tray , overlapping as little as possible
3. Pour peanut oil into a small heavy saucepan to a depth of 1"
4. Heat over medium hight heat until a deep fry thermometer registers 325f
5. Working in 5-6 small batches , add shallots to oil and fry , stirring constantly , until light golden brown , about 1 1 / 2 minutes
6. To get them perfectly golden , remove them from the oil a few seconds before they actually appear done
7. Remove shallots from oil with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towel lined plate
8. Let cool
9. To store , refrigerate in an airtight container for up to 1 week
10. Makes about 2 cups

title: creole bread pudding
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f
2. In a large bowl , blend the sugar , cinnamon and nutmeg
3. Whisk in the eggs , milk , cream and vanilla
4. Tear the bread slices into big , bite-sized pieces and place in a lightly buttered 9 x 13 pan
5. Pour the custard mixture over the bread and allow to soak until soft , about 1 hour
6. Stir the raisins into the pudding and top with the nuts
7. Bake uncovered 1 1 / 2 hours
8. Prepare the whiskey sauce and keep warm until needed
9. Scoop the bread pudding into individual bowls and top with the reserved whiskey sauce
10. To prepare the whiskey sauce: heat the cream and sugar in a heavy-bottomed medium saucepan over medium-high heat until mixture begins to boil
11. Mix the cornstarch and cold water in a small bowl until smooth
12. Slowly whisk into simmering cream
13. Simmer 2-3 minutes
14. Put the yolks into a stainless steel bowl
15. Whisk
16. Temper the yolks by slowly whisking 1 cup hot , thickened cream mixture into yolks
17. Return the yolk mixture to hot cream mixture , whisking in slowly
18. After the mixture is whisked together , cook over medium-low heat until mixture reaches 140 degrees f
19. Remove from heat and pour through a fine mesh strainer
20. Add the whiskey , adjusting to taste , and keep warm until ready to use
21. Sauce may be stored in a covered container in the refrigerator up to 3 days

title: mocha milkshake
steps:
1. Mix coffee and hot water until coffee is dissolved
2. Crush ice in blender
3. Add all ingredients to blender
4. Puree until smooth

title: african lullaby cocktail
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients in blender with one cup crushed ice
2. Pour into glass and garnish with red cherry

title: design your own flavored vodka
steps:
1. Clean and chop the fruit , vegetables or herbs
2. Wash a 1 qt jar in soapy water and rinse well
3. Very well unless you like dishsoap flavored vodka
4. Let drain on a clean paper towel
5. Once dry , add the ingredients you choose
6. Pour the vodka over top , screw on lid and refrigerate until you are ready to drink up
7. It take about 4 days
8. Taste to check when it is ready
9. Keep refrigerated ok ?

title: food for the gods
steps:
1. Combine butter , sugar , corn syrup , vanilla and eggs
2. Mix well
3. Sift dry ingredients , toss in nuts and dates until well coated
4. Fold into wet ingredients
5. Bake 325f for 40-45 min in a 7x11 pan lined w / foil

title: ann s close to wendy s style chili recipe
steps:
1. Brown the hamburger and drain the grease
2. Add seasonings and frozen vegetables when frozen vegetables start to heat up
3. Add the rest of the ingredients
4. Simmer the longer the better i like to simmer at least a couple of hours
5. Remove the bay leaf before serving

title: mrs v s pumpkin pie
steps:
1. Combine pumpkin , sugar and spices
2. Beat egg yolks slightly
3. Add milk and melted margarine to mmixture , blending thoroughly
4. Fold in stiffly beaten egg whites
5. Pour into unbaked pie shell
6. Bake in preheated 450 degree oven 10 minutes , reduce heat to 350 degrees and bake 35 minutes longer or until tooth pick inserted in pumpkin comes out clean

title: kenyan ground round curry
steps:
1. In a deep medium-sized frying pan , saute onions and ground beef in oil until meat is browned
2. Skim fat
3. Add curry powder , garlic , ginger and tomatoes
4. Fry briefly , then add tomato paste , cinnamon and cilantro
5. Stir and add water and salt to taste
6. Simmer 20 minutes over medium heat to blend flavors
7. Serve over rice , spaghetti or with chapatis

title: new england soup factory s asparagus  lemon  and orzo soup
steps:
1. Bring the chicken stock to a boil in a large stockpot
2. Add orzo
3. Cook 5-7 minutes
4. Add asparagus
5. Cook 5-7 minutes more
6. Bring soup back to a brisk boil and whisk in beaten eggs
7. Cook for 1 minute
8. Remove from heat and add remaining ingredients
9. Serve immediately

title: new orleans baked stuffed red snapper with creole sauce
steps:
1. Make creole sauce: in 2 t
2. Hot butter in medium saucepan , saute celery , 1 / 2 cup o nion , the green pepper and garlic , stirring , until onion is golden-brown - 5 minutes
3. Stir in tomatoes , bay leaf , chili powder , 1 t
4. Salt , sugar , and 1 / 8 t
5. Pepper
6. Bring to a boil , stirring constantly
7. Reduce heat
8. Simmer , uncovered and stirring occasionally , 20 minutes or until thickened
9. Makes about 2-1 / 2 cups sauce
10. Make stuffing: trim crusts from bread and grate on medium box grater or use food processor
11. Set aside
12. In 1 / 4 cup hot butter in medium skillet , saute green onion , stirring for 3 minutes
13. Add parsley , salt , and pepper
14. Mix well
15. Add bread crumbs
16. Toss to mix well
17. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
18. Wash fish inside and out under cold running water
19. Drain well
20. Pat dry with paper towels
21. Line a shallow roasting pan with foil
22. Butter foil
23. Place fish in prepared pan
24. Brush inside of fish with mixture of melted butter , salt and pepper
25. Fill cavity with the stuffing
26. Close the opening with skewers or wooden picks
27. Pour 2 t
28. Lemon juice over the fish
29. Bake , uncovered , 30 minutes
30. Pour 1 cup sauce over fish
31. Bake , basting twice , 10 minutes longer , or until fish flakes easily with a fork
32. With 2 wide spatulas , remove fish to serving platter
33. Garnish with chopped parsley and pass rest of sauce on the side

title: honey lemon chicken wings
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400f
2. Put the chicken wings in a baking dish , sprinkle with the salt and roast for 30 minutes
3. Put the lemon juice , garlic and honey in a small bowl and stir until the honey has dissolved
4. Pour over the chicken wings and stir until well coated
5. Return to the oven and cook for another 20 minutes
6. Serve with lemon wedges

title: southwestern monte cristos
steps:
1. Spread the bread with a light layer of pepper jelly
2. Build sandwiches using 2 slices each of ham , cheese , and turkey per sandwich
3. Beat the eggs with the milk and hot sauce
4. Season with salt
5. Heat a griddle pan or nonstick skillet over medium heat
6. Melt the butter in the skillet
7. Dip each sandwich in the egg coating
8. Cook 3-4 minutes on each side to melt the cheese and warm the meats through
9. Cut the sandwiches corner to corner and serve

title: pork chops with blue cheese sauce
steps:
1. Sprinkle pork chops on both sides with pepper
2. Broil 3-4 inches from the heat for 4-6 minutes on each side or until a meat thermometer reads 160f
3. Meanwhile , in a small saucepan , saute the onion and garlic in butter until tender
4. Sprinkle with flour
5. Stir until blended
6. Gradually add milk
7. Bring to a boil
8. Cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened
9. Add cheese and wine
10. Heat through
11. Serve sauce with chops

title: cookies  n cream fudge
steps:
1. Line 8-inch-square pan with foil so that foil extends over sides of pan
2. Butter foil
3. In large heavy duty saucepan , combine sugar , margarine , and milk
4. Bring to a boil over medium heat , stirring constantly
5. Continue boiling 3 minutes over medium heat , stirring constantly
6. Remove from heat
7. Add marshmallow creme , candy coating and vanilla
8. Blend until smooth
9. Pour half of mixture into foil-lined pan
10. Sprinkle cookie pieces over entire surface
11. Top with remaining mixture
12. Cool to room temperature
13. Refrigerate 1 to 2 hours or until set
14. Remove fudge from pan by lifting foil
15. Remove foil from fudge
16. Using large knife , cut into squares
17. Store in refrigerator

title: apple brown sugar pork chops
steps:
1. Combine ingredients in a plastic bag or bowl
2. Marinade pork chops in refrigerator
3. Grill over direct medium heat for 10-12 minutes , turning once
4. Serve with rice

title: football peanut butter balls
steps:
1. Mix together powdered sugar and peanut butter
2. Portion mixture into approximately 36 balls
3. Roll balls between the flattened palms of your hands to create a ball shaped like a top
4. Then roll ball on flat surface to smooth middle into more round shape leaving the ends with points creating the football shape
5. Arrange finished footballs in a single layer on wax paper and place in refrigerator for 30 minutes
6. Melt milk chocolate chips , 3 tablespoons butter , and 2 tablespoons shortening over double boiler
7. Mixture should be thin and shiny for dipping
8. Crush peanuts and set aside
9. Coat footballs with chocolate by rolling gently in melted milk chocolate while still over double boiler , being careful not to crush pointed ends
10. Place on wire rack to allow excess chocolate to drip off
11. While chocolate is still tacky but not still wet , place bottom of football in crushed peanuts
12. Draw line on top center of football using black gel frosting
13. Melt white chocolate chips and 1 tablespoon butter in microwave and place in frosting bag or sandwich bag with cut corner and draw laces and end lines
14. Return finished footballs to refrigerator for 30 minutes
15. Serve chilled if you don't want your fingers all chocolatey or room temperature if you don't mind

title: saucy pepper steak
steps:
1. Heat a large nonstick skillet sprayed with cooking spray on medium-high heat
2. Add bell peppers and onions
3. Cook and stir 6 to 8 minute or until vegetables are crisp-tender
4. Transfer to large bowl
5. Keep warm
6. Add the meat , garlic and black pepper to same skillet
7. Cook and stir 3 minute add soy sauce
8. Cook 1 minute or until meat is cooked through
9. Add barbecue sauce
10. Cook until heated through
11. Spoon the meat mixture into bowl with vegetables
12. Toss gently
13. Serve over hot rice

title: banana nut granola
steps:
1. Bring water and dates to a boil in a covered saucepan
2. Remove from heat
3. Let stand 5 minutes , then blend in blender with all but oats and seeds or coconut
4. Stir all ingredients together
5. Spread on two cookie sheets
6. Bake at 225 degrees for 2 hours , stirring
7. Put in a air tight container until ready to use

title: lime almond cakes in jars
steps:
1. Preheat oven
2. Grate lime finely
3. Divide into two parts
4. Mix one part with 1 tablespoon sugar
5. Put into an airtight container and set aside
6. Divide eggs into yolks and egg whites
7. Beat the three egg whites with salt until stiff
8. Add 1 tablespoon sugar and beat further until sugar is dissolved
9. Set aside
10. In a bowl mix softened butter with the rest of sugar until the sugar is dissolved
11. Add cream cheese and mix well
12. Add egg yolks and mix well
13. Add lime juice and and the 2nd part of lime peel and mix
14. Mix finely grounded almonds with cornstarch and add to mixture
15. Mix until blended
16. Don't overmix
17. Fold in the egg whites carefully
18. With a brush oil 4 preserving jars
19. But don't oil the rim
20. Divide dough equally into the 4 jars and bake for 25 - 30 minutes until dough is done or until a toothpick comes out clean
21. Take out of the oven and while hot close the preserving jars
22. Let cool completely in the jars
23. You can store the cakes for about 2 weeks
24. Serving: open the glasses and carefully take out the cakes
25. Sprinkle each cake with some of the lime sugar
26. Enjoy
27. The rim of the glasses should not be oiled , because glasses would not be airtight then

title: cousin helen s dal
steps:
1. Wash dal thoroughly
2. Boil the dal
3. Set aside
4. In a separate frying pan , heat oil
5. Add mustard , cummin seeds , dry red chillies and curry leaves when the oil is hot
6. Lower the heat and put in the cayenne pepper , turmeric , coriander powder add chopped tomatoes and cook this on slightly higher heat adding a little water as necessary
7. Add tamarind juice and add this mixture to the boiled dal
8. Bring it all to a boil

title: beef and eggplant bake with polenta crust
steps:
1. Place eggplant in colander , sprinkle salt all over , leave 30 min , rinse then drain
2. Meanwhile , heat oil in medium frypan
3. Cook onion , capsicum and garlic , stirring until onion softens
4. Add beef , cook stirring until beef browns
5. Add paste , cook stirring for 2 minutes
6. Add wine , cook stirring 5 minutes
7. Add undrained tomatoes
8. Bring to a boil
9. Reduce heat
10. Simmer , uncovered , stirring occasionally , for 15 minutes or until liquid is almost evaporated
11. Chop 1 / 4 of the basil coarsely and add along with the oregano
12. Preheat oven to moderate heat
13. Cook eggplant on heated oiled grill plate until just browned
14. Meanwhile , combine stock and milk in medium saucepan
15. Bring to a boil
16. Gradually add polenta , stirring constantly
17. Reduce heat
18. Simmer for 10 minutes or until polenta thickens
19. Using 3 litre dish , layer 1 / 2 eggplant , then 1 / 2 beef mixture , repeat then top with remaining basil
20. Spread polenta on top then sprinkle with cheese
21. Cook , uncovered , in moderately hot oven about 20 minutes or until top is browned lightly
22. Stand 10 minutes before serving

title: kelly s mushroom sauce
steps:
1. Melt the butter and the oil in a large skillet over medium heat
2. Add the mushrooms and saut about 3 minutes
3. Stir in 1 cup of the beef broth and both of the mustards
4. Increase the heat to high and boil to reduce by half
5. Add remaining broth 1 / 4 cup at a time , boiling until sauce is reduced by half with each addition
6. Stir in the cream and boil until sauce coats the back of a spoon

title: slow cooker arroz con pollo
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in the cooking vessel
2. Stir well
3. Cover and cook: low-8 hrs high-5 hours

title: authentic sauerbraten
steps:
1. Place the beef roast in a deep ceramic or glass bowl
2. Add onions , peppercorns , cloves , and bay leaf
3. Pour white vinegar and cider vinegar over the meat
4. Chill , covered , for 4 days
5. Turn meat twice each day
6. Remove the meat from the marinade , dry it well with paper towels , and strain the marinade into a bowl
7. Reserve onions and 1 cup marinade
8. In a dutch oven brown the meat on all sides in hot vegetable oil
9. Sprinkle meat with salt
10. Pour boiling water around the meat
11. Sprinkle in crushed gingersna ps , and simmer covered for 1 1 / 2 hours
12. Turn often
13. Add 1 cup of reserved marinade and cook meat 2 hours or more , until tender
14. Remove the meat and keep it warm
15. Strain the cooking juices into a large saucepan
16. In a small bowl mix sour cream with flour
17. Stir it into the cooking juices and cook , stirring , until sauce is thickened and smooth
18. Slice meat in 1 / 4 inch slices
19. Add to hot gravy
20. Arrange meat on a heated plater and pour extra sauce over it

title: all about the heart salad
steps:
1. In a bowl , arrange the hearts of romaine and the hearts of palm
2. Toss in the cherry tomatoes
3. Combine the zest , orange juice , lemon juice and olive oil
4. Mix well , and pour over salad when ready to serve
5. Season with salt and pepper , and garnish with reserved zest

title: crab cakes sandwiches
steps:
1. In a bowl comine the first 7 ingredients
2. Fold in the crabmeat
3. Mix gently to combine then season with salt and pepper to taste
4. Shape the mixture into 5 or 6 patties , then coat on both sides with dry breadcrumbs
5. Place on a baking sheet or a flat plate
6. Cover with plastic wrap and chill for a about 2 hours
7. In a skillet heat oil and butter over medium-high heat
8. Cook the crab patties on both sides until golden brown
9. Serve between buns with tartar sauce and prepared coleslaw
10. Delicious !

title: sausage stuffed banana peppers
steps:
1. Cut off tops of peppers , and remove stuff inside& seeds
2. Chop edible portions of tops
3. Set aside
4. Bring a pot of salted water to a boil
5. Add peppers , reduce heat , and simmer until tender but still firm , about 5 minutes
6. Drain and set aside
7. Heat butter in a medium skillet
8. Saut reserved chopped pepper , onion and celery until tender , 3 to 5 minutes
9. Stir in crushed tomatoes , tomato sauce and garlic
10. Season with basil , oregano , 1 1 / 2 teaspoons salt and 1 / 4 teaspoon pepper
11. Simmer uncovered for 10 minutes
12. Preheat oven to 350f
13. In a large mixing bowl , combine egg , 1 teaspoon salt , 1 / 4 teaspoon cayenne pepper , worcestershire sauce and parmesan
14. Mix in hot sausage , mild sausage , bread crumbs and 1 cup of the tomato sauce mixture
15. Fill each pepper with the meat mixture
16. Place in a 3-quart casserole dish , and pour remaining tomato sauce mixture over peppers
17. Bake uncovered in preheated oven for 1 hour

title: greek style pasta
steps:
1. Bring pot of lightly salted water to boil and add pasta
2. Cook until al dente
3. Meanwhile , in large frying pan , saute peppers and onion in olive oil for 3 minutes
4. Add artichokes and cherry tomatoes
5. Saute an additional 2 minutes
6. Add chicken broth to pan and heat through
7. Toss in feta cheese , olives and oregano
8. Stir over low heat until cheese begins to melt
9. Serve over hot pasta
10. Squeeze lemon juice over top

title: judy s broccoli salad
steps:
1. Soaked the raisins in water for 20 minutes , meanwhile chop the broccoli into very small pieces
2. Mix it with the onions , cheddar cubes and bacon
3. For the dressing mix mayo , vinegar and sugar all together
4. Add raisins and sunflower seeds to broccoli mix
5. Mix a little dressing at a time , you may not need to use all of it

title: s more chow
steps:
1. In a microwave safe bowl , place chocolate chips , butter and peanut butter
2. Melt in microwave
3. While chocolate mix is melting , put cereal and marshmallows in a large bowl
4. After chocolate is melted , pour over cereal and marshmallows and stir to coat
5. Place powdered sugar in a large resealable bag
6. Pour in chocolate coated cereal
7. Shake everything together until coated
8. You may need to use more or less powdered sugar

title: ethiopian cabbage
steps:
1. In a medium skillet heat the olive over medium heat
2. Add the carrots and onion and cook in the hot oil about 5 minutes
3. Add the salt , pepper , cumin , turmeric , and cabbage and cook another 15 to 20 minutes
4. Stir in the potatoes
5. Cover and reduce heat to medium-low
6. Cook 15 to 20 minutes or until potatoes are soft

title: jewelled persian rice
steps:
1. Heat a heavy-based saucepan over a medium heat , add oil , onion , almonds , pistachios , saffron and cardamom pods
2. Cook for 7-8 minutes , stirring often until nuts turn golden , and saffron and onion are fragrant
3. Add rice , cook for 2 minutes , stirring to coat with oil
4. Add stock , sultanas and a pinch of salt
5. Cover with a lid and bring to the boil
6. Reduce heat and cook for 15-20 minutes , until stock is absorbed and rice is tender , adding a splash more water if necessary
7. Allow to stand covered for 10 minutes
8. Stir through pomegranate seeds and coriander leaves
9. Spoon rice onto a large platter

title: condensed tomato soup recipe  gluten free
steps:
1. Place tomato paste in pan or bowl and gradually stir in water
2. Add remaining ingredients and heat to dissolve chicken base or bouillon
3. If you want reconstituted soup , you can add an additional 12 oz
4. Of milk or water
5. If you use the milk , you may want to add 1 / 4 t
6. Baking soda to the condensed mixture and heat both before adding tomato mixture to milk to prevent curdling

title: potato torte
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees
2. Place potatoes in a large pot , and add enough cold water to cover , bring to boil and lower heat
3. Simmer until tender but firm , about 5-7 minutes , drain and return to hot pan to dry out
4. Melt butter in a cast iron skillet over medium heat
5. Saute shallot in butter for about 5 minutes
6. Season with salt and pepper and turn off heat , set aside to cool
7. In a bowl , beat the eggs
8. Add the shallots mozzarella and 3 / 4c parmigiano , mix to combine
9. Make sure your cast iron pan is buttered all around and on the sides
10. Place 1 layer potatoes in the bottom of the pan , top with 1 / 4 of the egg mixture , add another layer of potatoes and 1 / 4 of the eggs , repeating until all of the ingredients are used
11. Be sure to end with a layer of potatoes
12. Top with remaining parmigiano and bake 40-50 minutes until tender and knife inserted in center comes out clean

title: baked breakfast casserole ala francis
steps:
1. Place the bread in the bottom of a 9x13 pan
2. Beat together all other ingredients and pour over bread
3. Leave this in the fridge overnight
4. The next morning mix 1 can cream mushroom soup , cup milk
5. Pour over the top of the and bake uncovered 1 hr at 300 degrees

title: currant and tea crumpets
steps:
1. Add tea and currants into a small bowl
2. Allow to steep until tea is cold and currents plump
3. Sift flour into a clean bowl add sugar and combine well
4. Make a well in the center , add tea mixture and egg
5. Mix with a wooden spoon till all the ingredients are incorporated and the batter is lump free
6. Grease a frying pan with a little butter at a time
7. Drop a tablespoon of batter at a time , try to fit a few at a time in the frying pan
8. Cook over medium heat for 2-3 minutes or until bubbles appear on the surface
9. Turn and cook the other side
10. Repeat with remaining batter
11. Serve with whipped cream

title: chive egg dip
steps:
1. In a small bowl , beat the cream cheese until smooth
2. Gradually beat in milk and mayonnaise until blended
3. Add the mustard , worcestershire sauce , salt and pepper
4. Stir in eggs and chives
5. Mix well
6. Serve with peppers or crackers
7. Refrigerate leftovers

title: salmon with tomatoes and cucumbers
steps:
1. To make lemon infused olive oil: combine extra virgin olive oil with lemon rind and let sit overnight
2. Preheat oven to 425-degrees f
3. Season salmon with salt and pepper
4. Cut parchment into 8"x11" pieces
5. Put salmon with vegetables on center of parchment , add olive oil and wine
6. Then top with dill , shallot and salt and pepper
7. Fold parchment over salmon , making packages , securing edges well
8. Place on cookie sheet
9. Bake in preheated oven for 9 - 10 minutes

title: green chile cheese enchiladas
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Melt butter in a medium sauce pan , and sprinkle in flour
3. Stirring constantly , allow flour to brown , about 2-3 minutes
4. Slowly stir in half-and -half
5. Simmer , stirring frequently about 5 minutes , or until thickened
6. Add chiles , 1 / 2 cup onion and cayenne , and simmer for 10 minutes on low heat
7. Mix cheese and medium minced onion
8. Heat oil in a skillet , then dip the tortillas in hot oil , one at a time , for about 5 seconds each
9. Stack them on top of each other on a plate , covered with paper towels as you go
10. Scoop cheese mixture onto tortillas , and roll up , placing seam side down in a 13 x 9 inches baking pan
11. When all tortillas are rolled , pour the green chile sauce over all , and top with the remaining cheese
12. Bake uncovered in preheated oven , for 20 minutes , or until cheese is melted and bubbly
13. Great when garnished generously with sour cream

title: fabulous flourless fudge brownies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees f
2. Prepare a 9-inch square baking pan by lining it with foil and spraying the foil with nonstick cooking spray or brushing it with vegetable oil
3. Melt the semisweet chocolate and the butter in a double boiler
4. Stir until smooth
5. Add vanilla and cinnamon
6. Stir thoroughly to combine
7. Remove mixture from the heat and cool to room temperature
8. In the bowl of your stand mixer , beat the eggs on high speed until very frothy and about triple in volume
9. Fold half of the beaten eggs into the chocolate mixture and combine
10. Then fold in the remaining egg
11. Pour the batter into the prepared baking pan and smooth the top with a spatula
12. Place the pan of brownie batter into a larger pan , like a roasting pan and fill that pan with hot water half way up the side of the smaller pan containing the batter
13. Place the pan on the middle rack of the preheated oven and bake for 15 minutes
14. Turn off the oven but keep the brownies in the closed oven for another 10 minutes
15. After 10 minutes , remove the brownies pan from the larger water bath pan and place it on a wire rack to cool while making the glaze
16. To make the glaze , heat the cream and the dark chocolate in a double boiler over simmering water
17. Stir until the chocolate is melted and the mixture is smooth
18. Pour the hot glaze over the brownies and smooth it out with a spatula
19. Set the pan aside to cool completely
20. When cool , cover the pan with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight
21. Cut chilled brownie into 12 squares
22. Brownies taste best when allowed to come to room temperature for 30 minutes before serving

title: cinnamon apple crostata
steps:
1. Heat oven to 450f
2. Remove pie crust from pouch
3. Place flat on ungreased cookie sheet
4. In medium bowl , mix 1 / 2 cup sugar , the cornstarch and cinnamon
5. Gently stir in apples
6. Spoon apple mixture onto center of crust , spreading to within 2 inches of edge
7. Fold crust edge over filling to form 2-inch border , pleating crust as necessary
8. Brush crust edge with water
9. Sprinkle with 1 teaspoon sugar
10. Bake 15 minutes or until crust is golden brown
11. Sprinkle pecans over apple mixture
12. Bake 5 to 15 minutes longer or until apples are tender
13. Serve with whipped cream

title: cutout cookies
steps:
1. In a large mixing bowl , cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy
2. Beat in eggs and vanilla
3. Combine the flour , baking powder and salt
4. Gradually add to creamed mixure
5. Refrigerate for 1 hour or until firm
6. On a lightly floured surface , roll out dough to 1 / 4 inches thickness
7. Cut out with christmas cookie cutters of your choice
8. Using floured spatula , transfer cookies to greased baking sheets
9. Bake at 375 for 8-10 minutes or until lightly browned
10. Cool completely on wire racks
11. Decorate cookies with forsting and colored sugars

title: green tomato sweet relish
steps:
1. Mix tomatoes , onion , pepper and salt , let stand 1 hour
2. Drain well and add remaining ingredients
3. Bring to a boil and simmer 20 minutes
4. Pour into sterilized jars and seal
5. Process in boiling water bath 20 minutes

title: mushroom caps stuffed with smoked salmon
steps:
1. Clean mushrooms by wiping
2. Take stems out of mushrooms and save for another purpose
3. Combine cream cheese , mayonnaise , smoked salmon , dill , lemon juice , margarine , 1 tablespoons butter , and parsley
4. Mix well
5. Brush insides and outsides of mushrooms with olive oil
6. Stuff mushrooms with cream cheese mixture , mounding it up a little
7. Mix the breadcrumbs , parmesan cheese and melted margarine and sprinkle over the mushrooms
8. Bake at 375 degrees for 15 to 20 minutes
9. The bread crumbs should be golden brown
10. Take care when eating
11. They will be very hot and there will be some very hot liquid in the mushroom

title: sierra beef   rice supper
steps:
1. Spray large skillet with butter-flavored cooking spray , saute meat and celery for 8 to 10 minutes
2. Stir in soup and water
3. Add uncooked rice and parsley flakes
4. Mix well to combine
5. Lower heat , cover and simmer for 6 to 8 minutes or until rice is tender , stirring occasionally
6. Stir in sour cream
7. Continue simmering for 2 to 3 minutes , stirring occasionally

title: sweet red pepper ziti
steps:
1. In a large skillet , heat the olive oil over medium heat
2. Add red pepper , onion and garlic
3. Saute 5 minutes
4. Stir in water , bouillon cubes and basil
5. Bring to a boil , stirring occasionally
6. Reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes
7. Stir in cream
8. Simmer , stirring constantly , 2 minutes
9. Spoon over ziti and toss
10. Top with fresh cracked pepper , if desired

title: individual buffalo style chicken pizza
steps:
1. Place crusts on an ungreased 15x10x1 baking pan
2. In a large bowl , combine the chicken , butter , and pepper sauce
3. Spread`salad dressing over crusts ,
4. Top with chicken mixture , and sprinkle with cheese
5. Bake at 425 degrees for 10-15 minutes or until the edges are lightly browned
6. Let stand for 5 minutes

title: southern eggs benedict
steps:
1. The day before , cook the grits according to package directions to taste
2. Allow to cool and then spread onto cookie sheet or something similar and spread out grits so they are about 1" thick
3. Refrigerate overnight
4. The idea is to make them stiff and dry them out
5. The morning of , create the remoulade by combining all ingredients in a bowl
6. Rinse and thaw shrimp before adding to remoulade
7. Cut grits into 4 sections the size of a piece bread or an english muffin
8. Lightly flour the grits so they will brown and hold together
9. Pan fry the grit cakes in butter and oil until slightly brown
10. Cut the country ham in a similar fashion to the grits so when you put the ham on the grit "cake" it will have similar proportions
11. Poach each egg and plate with grit section on bottom followed by country ham then poached egg
12. Pour remoulade over stack and sprinkle with paprika

title: marinated feta with greek olives appetizer
steps:
1. Combine the peppers , feta and olives in a large bowl
2. Add the olive oil and toss gently
3. Add the remaining ingredients and toss gently again
4. Adjust seasonings , cover and chill at least 5 hours before serving
5. Serve this with toasted pita bread as an appetizer

title: pan roasted salmon with ginger and curry
steps:
1. Bring large saucepot of water to a boil
2. Season with salt
3. Add 1 / 2 pund soba noodles and cook al dente , about 8 minutes
4. Stir together ginger and curry and season with salt and pepper
5. Pat spice mixture on to flesh sides of salmon and let salmon set for 10 minutes before cooking it
6. Heat oil in a nonstick skillet over moderate heat until hot but not smoking , then cook salmon , skin sides down , covered , 5 minutes
7. Chop scallions
8. Set aside
9. Turn salmon over and cook , covered , until just cooked through , about 2 minutes more
10. Add scallions to skillet with salmon and cook 30 seconds

title: broiled shrimp
steps:
1. Preheat broiler
2. Put shrimp in lg
3. Bowl
4. Add all other ingredients
5. Toss well to coat shrimp
6. Place on shallow baking sheet
7. Broil 7 in from heat for about 6-7 min , turning once
8. Serve with sauce from pan
9. Add a little butter if you like

title: vanilla banana   date porridge  oatmeal
steps:
1. Combine ingredients in a bowl & cook in the microwave for approx 1 1 / 2 mins , stirring after a minute
2. Serve with extra milk

title: chocolate no bake cookies with nuts
steps:
1. Put first 4 ingredients in pan and bring to boil
2. Boil for 4 minutes
3. Remove from heat and add last 4 ingredients
4. Mix well and drop by teaspoonfuls on waxed paper
5. Refrigerate until firm

title: quick biscuit bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Lightly grease a cookie sheet
3. Remove the buiscuits from the can and separate
4. Place one buiscuit in the center and place the remaining buiscuit around it slightly overlapping
5. Now flatten them out with your fingers into a 10 inch circle
6. Brush with the olive oil
7. Sprinkle with the remaining ingredients
8. You can use any kind of cheese you have on hand
9. Chili powder and monterey jack and some chopped chillies give you a great tex-mex bread
10. Bake about 15 minute until edges are nice and brown
11. Pull apart to serve

title: pork tenderloin grand marnier
steps:
1. Cut tenderloin into slices about 2" thick and pound to flatten into cutlets
2. Or save yourself the work and have your butcher do this for you
3. Mix the beaten egg and sour cream
4. Dip cutlets in the egg mixture and then the seasoned bread crumbs
5. Fry in hot oil / butter just a few minutes per side
6. Lay in bottom of casserole dish and cover with mushrooms
7. Blend the sauce ingredients and simmer for about 25 minutes
8. Pour over pork and mushrooms
9. Bake 40 minutes at 400 degrees

title: quickie chicken veggie soup
steps:
1. Pour the chicken with juice into a pot , break the chicken up with a fork
2. Pour the whole tomatoes into the pot
3. Slice each tomato at least in half , this can be done in the pot with a shap knife
4. Add the rest of the ingredients
5. Stir well
6. Do not add salt , there is enough salt in the two canned ingredients
7. Bring to simmer , lower heat and simmer for about 25 minutes or until the veggies are tender crisp
8. The veggies can be any you have left in your fridge , except for the tomatoes and the chicken can be cooked left over chicken , if left over chicken is used add at least a cup of chicken broth

title: fusion ketchup
steps:
1. Thoroughly mix all the ingredients together
2. Store refrigerated in a covered jar
3. This low-sodium ketchup will last for several weeks

title: armenian nutmeg cake   honigkuchen marlenka
steps:
1. Combine sugar , sifted flour , baking powder , and salt
2. Rub in butter until mixture resembles fine breadcrumbs
3. Press half the mixture into a well greased 8x8" square pan
4. Dissolve baking soda in milk , add egg and nutmeg and pour over remaining sugar and flour mixture
5. Mix well , then spoon into pan on top of pressed in mixture
6. Sprinkle walnuts over
7. Bake in preheated oven at 350f for 1 hour
8. Allow to stand 15 minutes before turning out on to a wire rack to cool

title: carl s jr   the six dollar burger    copycat
steps:
1. Preheat barbecue or indoor grill to medium heat
2. Form the ground beef into a patty with a slightly larger diameter than the sesame seed bun
3. Grill the burger on the grill for 3 to 4 minutes per side or until done
4. Be sure to generously salt and pepper each side of the patty
5. While the patty grills , brown the faces of the bun in a hot skillet over medium heat
6. After the buns have browned , spread about 1 1 / 2 teaspoons of mayonnaise on the face of the top bun , as well as on the bottom bun
7. Spread 1 teaspoon of mustard on the face of the top bun , followed by 2 teaspoons of ketchup
8. Arrange 3 or 4 bread& butter pickles slices on the bottom bun
9. Arrange lettuce on pickles followed by the tomato slices and red onion
10. When the beef is cooked , arrange two slices of american cheese on the patty , let it melt a bit , then place the top bun on the cheese and scoop up the whole thing with a spatula and place it on the bottom half of the burger

title: nene s amazing avocado dip
steps:
1. Just blitz all ingredients in a food processor or mix by hand
2. That's it ! serve with your favorite tortilla chips or anything you'd like
3. If there are leftovers just squeeze a bit of lemon juice on top and place plastic wrap right on the dip to prevent browning

title: spritz cookies with variations  america s test kitchen
steps:
1. Adjust an oven rack to the middle position
2. Heat the oven to 375f in a small bowl , beat the egg yolk , cream , and vanilla with a fork until combined
3. Set aside
4. In a standing mixer , cream the butter , sugar , and salt at medium-high speed until light and fluffy , 3 to 4 minutes
5. Scrape down the bowl with a rubber spatula
6. With the mixer running at medium speed , add the yolk-cream mixture and beat until incorporated , about 30 seconds
7. Scrape down the bowl
8. With the mixer running at low speed , gradually beat in the flour until combined
9. Scrape down the bowl and give a final stir with the rubber spatula to ensure that no flour pockets remain
10. If using a cookie press to form the cookies , follow the manufacturers instructions to fill the press
11. If using a pastry bag
12. Press or pipe cookies onto ungreased baking sheets , spacing them about 1 1 / 2 inches apart
13. Bake , one sheet at a time , until the cookies are light golden brown , 10 to 12 minutes , rotating the baking sheet halfway through the baking time
14. Cool the cookies on the baking sheet until just warm , 10 to 15 minutes
15. Using a metal spatula , transfer them to a wire rack and cool to room temperature
16. For lemon spritz cookies: follow the recipe for spritz cookies , adding 1 teaspoon lemon juice to the yolk-cream mixture in step 1 and adding 1 teaspoon finely grated lemon zest to the butter along with the sugar and salt in step 2
17. For almond spritz cookies: grind cup sliced almonds and 2 tablespoons of the flour called for in spritz cookies in a food processor until powdery and evenly fine , about 1 minute
18. Combine the almond mixture with the remaining flour
19. Follow the recipe for spritz cookies , substituting 3 / 4 teaspoon almond extract for the vanilla
20. Technique: filling a pastry bag: make a c shape with one hand and hold the piping bag
21. Fold the bag over that hand about halfway down , insert the
22. When the bag is about half full , pull up the sides , push down the dough , and twist tightly while again pushing down on the dough to squeeze out any air
23. Grab the bag at the base of the twist
24. Using the other hand as a guide , hold the top at a 90-degree angle about 1 / 2-inch above the baking sheet and squeeze to form the shape

title: rachael ray s mexican sundaes
steps:
1. Drizzle a little honey in the bottom of each ice cream dish
2. Place a scoop of vanilla bean ice cream on top
3. Drizzle scoops with a little more honey , just enought to glaze the scoops
4. Sprinkle sundaes with salted spanish peanuts and serve

title: creamy beef  noodle casserole
steps:
1. In large , deep skillet , cook beef , onion and pepper til done
2. Drain grease
3. Add manwich , soup , brown sugar and mushrooms , mix well
4. Heat til bubbly , stir in 1 cup of the cheese
5. Gently fold in noodles well
6. Pour into lightly greased 4 qt casserole , pan or crock pot
7. Sprinkle top with cheese
8. Turn crockpot on low , cover and bake for about an hour til heated through
9. Or bake , covered , in 350 oven for about 35-40 minutes
10. This makes 1 large pan , or 2 pans
11. Canmake half a batch

title: horseradish gremolata
steps: 1. In medium bowl whisk butter with ingredients and stir in parsley

title: applebee s classic patty melt  copycat
steps:
1. Season one side of the burger with salt , pepper and garlic
2. Place on grill or in broiler , seasoned side down
3. Season the other side and flip
4. Cook to prefered doneness
5. While burger is cooking , melt butter in fry pan on medium heat
6. Spread mayonnaise onto bread
7. Drop bread , dry side down , onto melted butter and swirl to coat
8. Cover one slice of bread with two slices of swiss cheese and the other with two slices of cheddar
9. In a separate frying pan , melt butter and saute sliced onions
10. Season with salt , pepper and garlic
11. Place cooked burger patty on top of one cheese-topped slice of bread and the saute onions on the other
12. Carefully assemble and cut sandwich

title: east african roast chicken
steps:
1. Remove the giblets from the chicken , if necessary , rinse out the cavity and pat the skin dry
2. Put the butter and all the remaining ingredients in a bowl and mix together well to form a thick paste
3. Gently ease the skin of the chicken away from the flesh and rub generously with the herb and butter mixture
4. Rub more of the mixture over the skin , legs and wings of the chicken and into the neck cavity
5. Place the chicken in a roasting tin , cover loosely with foil and marinate overnight in the fridge
6. Preheat oven to 375f / 190c
7. Cover the chicken with clean foil and roast for 1 hour , then turn the chicken over and baste with the pan juices
8. Cover again with foil and cook for 30 minutes
9. Remove the foil and place the chicken breast-side up
10. Rub with a little extra butter and roast for a further 10-15 minutes until the meat juices run clear and the skin is golden brown
11. Serve with a rice dish or a salad

title: brazilian hot chocolate
steps:
1. In a double boiler , melt the chocolate , then stir in the sugar , salt cinnamon and instant coffee
2. Remove the top of the double boiler and warm over direct heat , adding c of the hot water , stirring for minute
3. Then , stirring constantly , add in the rest of the hot water and milk
4. Remove from heat and stir in the vanilla
5. Serve while still hot
6. Enjoy !

title: tipsy turtle
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together and pour over ice
2. Garnish with a pineapple slice

title: victory s kicked up beer steamed shrimp
steps: 1. In pot combine all ingredients except shrimp bring to a hard boil shut off heat add shrimp stir cover steam for 6 minutes its that easy enjoy

title: frikl   norwegian lamb and cabbage stew
steps:
1. Slice the cabbage into "boats" , just radiating slices from the middle , out
2. Find the fattiest bits of meat and place one layer of that on the bottom of the pot
3. Add a layer of cabbage
4. Strew quite a bit of the pepper-corns , salt and flour over
5. Repeat until you reach the top of the pot , or you run out of meat and cabbage
6. Cabbage is the top layer

title: baked onions
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Cut stem and root off onions and place stem side up in center of aluminum foil
3. Place one tablespoon of butter or margerine on top of each onion , then wrap up so that the foil has a point on top
4. Make sure it is wrapped good
5. Place onions on a baking sheet and bake for 1-2 hours , depending on how soft you want them
6. When finished , open up the top of the tin foil and pour the italian dressing on top to taste
7. I like to use a lot

title: australian french toast
steps:
1. Beat eggs , salt and milk together in flat bottomed container
2. Place bread into egg mixture and soak until all mixture is absorbed
3. Heat frying pan and add margarine , cook soaked bread until brown

title: iced nutty irishman coffee frappe  non alcoholic and diabetic
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in blender and blend until smooth
2. Pour into glass and enjoy

title: easy layered chicken bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
2. Place chicken in 13x9 baking dish
3. Sprinkle with poultry seasoning
4. Combine stuffing mix with 1 cup water
5. Mix soup with milk and spread over chicken
6. Spread green beans over next
7. Sprinkle with cheese
8. Top with stuffing
9. Bake 30 mins or until chicken is cooked through

title: mexicana mama  carnival cocktail  5
steps: 1. Blend all ingredients together , pour over ice & garnish w / an orange slice

title: 2 minute broccoli
steps:
1. Put broccoli and water in a large , round microwave proof tupperware / gladware
2. Press lid on top but do not fully seal
3. Microwave on high for two minutes
4. Press and seal lid
5. Let stand for one minute
6. You can let the broccoli steam longer if you prefer it to be more tender
7. Drain and serve

title: smoky black bean and ham soup
steps:
1. In a large saucepan over medium heat , saute onions , garlic and celery in the vegetable oil until softened
2. Add oregano , cumin , coriander , chili powder and paprika
3. Cook , stirring often , for 2 minutes
4. Add remaining ingredients and simmer for 20-30 minutes
5. Serve with garnishes like sour cream or yogurt , grated cheese , chopped fresh tomatoes and cilantro

title: white cheddar macaroni and cheese  panera copycat
steps:
1. Boil 2 oz of pasta shells
2. Slightly undercook the pasta
3. Set aside
4. Microwave 4 tbs of butter with 8 tbs of flour for two minutes , stirring with a whisk after each minute
5. Then slowly add 2 cups of milk , stirring with the whisk constantly
6. Microwave the entire mixture for several minutes , stirring after each minute , until sauce thickens and takes on a matte finish
7. How many minutes will depend on the power of your microwave
8. Add grated vermont white cheddar to sauce
9. The sauce should be hot enough that the cheese will melt as you stir
10. If not , you may add the cheese then microwave a little more
11. For an extra creamy sauce , pour a small amount of the pre-cheese sauce into a separate bowl , add one egg and beat vigorously , then return the reserved sauce to the original sauce
12. Add cheese to taste
13. I used an entire 8oz block
14. Add a dash of grated american cheese
15. Combine pasta and sauce , then pour into a well-greased baking pan
16. The pasta will absorb some of the liquid , so don't worry if the mixture seems more liquid-y than the way you would normally serve pasta
17. I used a 9 by 9 inches pan
18. Bake at 350 degrees covered for about 25 minutes or until bubbling and starting to become golden

title: peach puzzle  a magic recipe
steps:
1. For the peaches and syrup: adjust an oven rack to the middle position and heat the oven to 400f
2. Place a 6-ounce custard cup or ramekin upside down in the center of a 9-inch pie plate and arrange the peaches around the custard cup
3. Combine the brown sugar , water , butter , vanilla , and salt in a medium saucepan and stir over medium heat until the sugar dissolves and the butter melts , about 5 minutes
4. Pour the syrup over the peaches
5. For the dough: pulse the flour , sugar , baking powder , and salt in a food processor until blended
6. Add the butter and pulse until the flour mixture is pale yellow and resembles course cornmeal
7. Put the mixture into a medium bowl
8. Using a rubber spatula , fold the milk into the flour mixture , pressing the mixture against the sides of the bowl to form the dough
9. Squeeze the dough together and flatten into a disk
10. On a lightly floured work surface , roll the dough into a 9-inch circle
11. Lay the dough directly over the peaches and press and fit the dough so that it fits snuggly around peaches
12. Bake until the top is golden brown , 25 to 30 minutes
13. Transfer the pan to a rack and let cool for 30 minutes
14. Place a large rimmed serving plate over the top of the pie plate and quickly invert the puzzle onto a plate
15. Cut into wedges around each peach and serve , pouring syrup over each portion
16. And it is important to choose peaches that are neither very ripe nor rock-hard they should give a little when squeezed
17. Be sure to invert the pie plate quickly to avoid losing any of the syrup
18. Serve with vanilla ice cream or sweetened whipped cream

title: morton thompson turkey
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 500f
2. Chop fine the reserved turkey fat
3. In a small saucepan set over moderate heat , combine the reserved fat with 1 / 2 cup of the water
4. Bring to a boil and simmer until all the water has evaporated and only clear fat and small pieces of solid remain
5. Reserve fat for stuffing
