6. Season the inside of the turkey with salt and pepper
7. Rub the skin all over with the oil and season with salt and pepper
8. Prepare the giblets for the basting liquid
9. Bring to a boil and simmer the entire time you for basting
10. Add more water as needed
11. Meat mixture: melt butter & brown veal , pork
12. Cool and add to bread crumbs , combine >
13. Make the dressing:
14. Prep bowl of fruits : combine all ingredients
15. Prep bowl of seasonings : combine all ingredients
16. Prep bowl of breadcrumbs and cooked meat mixture
17. In a very large bowl combine ingredients from all three bowls listed above
18. Mix it well
19. Loosely stuff the turkey
20. Stuff the neck cavity and sew closed the openings
21. Tie legs together
22. In a separate bowl: make the paste with ingredients listed above
23. Combine all ingredients for paste in a bowl , adding enough flour to form a thick paste
24. In a large open roasting pan with a rack: arrange turkey breast side down on a rack sitting in a shallow roasting pan
25. Preheat oven to 500
26. Put the turkey in the oven and roast it for 15 minutes , or until browned
27. Turn it breast side up and roast for and additional 15 minutes
28. Remove from oven
29. Now that it's nice and brown , using a pastry or paint brush coat the turkey completely with the paste -- in every nook and cranny
30. Reduce oven temperature to 325f
31. To the simmering basting liquid , continue to add cider and water and reduce until all cider has been added
32. Remove from heat but keep warm on top of stove
33. This is your basting liquid
34. Roast the bird , basting it frequently , for 4 1 / 2 to 5 hours , or until an instant meat thermometer reads 180 to 185 in the thigh
35. 170 in the breast and 160 in the stuffing
36. Let rest at least 15 to 20 minutes , before peeling away crust / skin
37. Make gravy as usual
38. Remove the dressing
39. Carve as usual & enjoy !

title: cheese and meatball soup
steps:
1. Meatballs: mix ingredients together thoroughly
2. Shape into medium size meatballs
3. Place uncooked meatballs and all other ingredients , except cheez whiz , in electric slow cooker
4. Stir gently
5. Cover and cook on setting # 2 for 8 to 10 hours
6. Before serving add cheez whiz , stirring gently until well blended

title: christine s dinner sweet rolls
steps:
1. Blend margarine , sugar , salt and boiling water
2. Let cool
3. Dissolve yeast in 1 / 4 cup likewarm water
4. Add to first mixture when it is cooled
5. Add beaten egg and flour
6. Blend until sticky
7. Place in refrigerator at least 24 hours
8. When ready to use , divide into 3 sections
9. Roll like pie dough
10. Cut in triangles
11. Roll large end of triangles to small pointed end
12. Place crescents on greased cookie sheet and let rise at least 3 hours in a warm place
13. Bake in preheated 375 degree oven for 12-15 minutes
14. Dough can also be used for sweet rolls and pizza crust -- just cut sugar in 1 / 2 for pizza crust dough

title: awesome pierogi casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Place the potatoes in a large pot with water to cover over high heat
3. Bring to a boil and cook until the potatoes are tender
4. Remove from heat , drain , then combine with milk and 6 tablespoons of butter , mash and set aside
5. Melt the remaining 2 tablespoons of the butter in a large skillet over medium high heat
6. Saute the bacon , onions and garlic in the butter for 5 to 10 minutes , or until the bacon is fully cooked
7. Cook the lasagna noodles according to package directions and cool under running water
8. Place 1 / 2 of the mashed potatoes into the bottom of a 9x13-inch baking dish
9. Top this with 1 / 3 of the cheese , followed by a layer of lasgana noodles
10. Repeat this with the remaining potatoes , another 1 / 3 of the cheese and a layer of noodles
11. Then arrange the bacon , onion and garlic over the noodles , then another layer of noodles , and finally top all with the remaining cheese
12. Season with salt and pepper to taste
13. Bake , uncovered at 350 for 30 to 45 minutes , or until the cheese is melted and bubbly
14. Serve with sour cream and chopped fresh chives

title: habanero bbq sauce
steps:
1. Brown onions and peppers on oil
2. Add remaining ingredients and simmer for 30 minutes
3. I store this in an old bbq sauce bottle in the fridge for a few weeks , it keeps pretty well

title: shredded sweet potato pudding
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. If you haven't already done so , peel sweet potatoes , cut into large chunks and run through the shredder of your food processor
3. Combine the sugar , egg , butter , milk , and vanilla with a whisk
4. Stir in shredded sweet potato and turn into a medium sized greased casserole dish
5. Bake , uncovered , for 1-1 1 / 2 hours , stirring every 20 minutes or so or until brown on top and bubbly- do not overbake

title: i ve got the spinach apple blues salad
steps:
1. Prepare vinaigrette:
2. In large bowl , mix chopped walnuts with cider vinegar , apple cider , honey and mustard
3. In separate bowl , mix oils
4. While mixing , slowly drizzle oil into walnut mixture to emulsify
5. Before serving , warm over a very low heat , making sure not to boil
6. Makes 1 pint
7. To prepare salad , place spinach leaves in serving bowl and top with cheese and the toasted walnuts
8. Place apples around outside , drizzle with warm walnut vinaigrette and serve
9. Cook over medium heat 5 to 7 minutes , stirring frequently until nuts begin to brown , then stirring constantly until golden brown

title: pioneer woman cajun chicken pasta
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to package directions
2. Drain when pasta is still al dente
3. Do not overcook !
4. Sprinkle 1 1 / 2 teaspoons cajun spice over chicken pieces
5. Toss around to coat
6. Heat 1 tablespoon oil and 1 tablespoon butter in a heavy skillet over high heat
7. Add half the chicken in a single layer
8. Do not stir
9. Allow chicken to brown on one side , about 1 minute
10. Flip to the other side and cook an additional minute
11. Remove with a slotted spoon and place on a clean plate
12. Repeat with remaining chicken
13. Remove chicken , leaving pan on high heat
14. Add remaining olive oil and butter
15. When heated , add peppers , onions , and garlic
16. Sprinkle on remaining cajun spice , and add salt if needed
17. Cook over very high heat for 1 minute , stirring gently and trying to get the vegetables as dark / black as possible
18. Add tomatoes and cook for an additional 30 seconds
19. Remove all vegetables from the pan
20. With the pan over high heat , pour in the wine and chicken broth
21. Cook on high for 3 to 5 minutes , scraping the bottom of the pan to deglaze
22. Reduce heat to medium-low and pour in cream , stirring / whisking constantly
23. Cook sauce over medium-low heat for a few minutes , until cream starts to thicken the mixture
24. Taste and add freshly ground black pepper , cayenne pepper , and / or salt to taste
25. Sauce should be spicy !
26. Finally , add chicken and vegetables to sauce , making sure to include all the juices that have drained onto the plate
27. Stir and cook for 1 to 2 minutes , until mixture is bubbly and hot
28. Add drained fettuccine and toss to combine
29. Top with chopped fresh parsley and chow down !

title: low fat fudge chocolate chip muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees and use nonstick spray on regular sized nonstick muffin tin
2. Combine all of the above ingredients
3. Using a 3 ounce ice cream scoop , evenly scoop into muffin tins and bake for 20 minutes to an hour , rotating half way through
4. Place toothpick in center and when toothpick comes out clean , muffins are done
5. Allow to fully cool then pop out with a spoon

title: scalloped garlic potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. In lightly greased 2-quart shallow baking dish , arrange potatoes
3. In medium bowl , blend remaining ingredients , pour over potatoes
4. Bake , uncovered , 45 minutes , or until potatoes are tender
5. Use immediately or cover with water to prevent discoloration

title: crock pot pork chops
steps:
1. Trim fat from pork chops , coat in flour and brown pork
2. Layer pork chops in crock pot
3. Cover with sliced onions and celery
4. Pour soup over
5. Cook on low 5-6 hours
6. Can serve pork chops separately , but they are usually so tender that they fall apart into large pieces
7. We cook additional rice and serve the chops and sauce over it
8. Is a great combination between a stew , soup and meat !

title: silver dollar pancakes  gluten free
steps:
1. In a large bowl whisk together eggs , water , vanilla and agave
2. Add almond flour , salt and baking soda and mix until thoroughly combined
3. Heat grapeseed oil on skillet over medium low to medium heat
4. Scoop 1 heaping tablespoon of batter at a time onto the skillet
5. Pancakes will form little bubbles , when bubbles open , flip pancakes over and cook other side
6. Remove from heat to a plate
7. Repeat process with remaining batter , add more oil to skillet as needed

title: sweet shrimp and white kidney beans
steps:
1. Heat the olive oil in a deep pan over medium heat
2. Add the shallots and fennel seeds and cook for 1 minute
3. I 'crushed' the fennel seeds by chopping them with a very sharp knife
4. Add the shrimp , wine and vinegar
5. Cook for 1 to 2 minutes
6. Stir in the beans and red peppers and season to taste with salt and pepper
7. As soon as the shrimp and beans begin to saute , cover and cook for 2 minutes
8. Stir in the chervil / tarragon , adjust the seasoning to taste and serve at once

title: tater tot surprise
steps:
1. Press uncooked ground beef in a 9x13 pan
2. Season with salt , pepper & garlic powder
3. Add diced onions
4. Mix soup with 1 / 2 can of milk
5. Place cheese slices over meat & then pour soup mixture over cheese
6. Place tater tots close together until mixture is covered
7. Bake at 350f for 1 & 1 / 2 hours
8. Enjoy !

title: fresh blueberry bars
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl , add the flour and brown sugar
2. Stir to mix
3. With a pastry blender , cut in the butter until mixture resembles coarse meal
4. Press 1 1 / 3 cup of mixture onto the bottom of an ungreased 8-inch square baking pan
5. In another bowl , mix together the cinnamon , baking soda , and salt
6. Add the remaining crumb mixture , sour cream , egg , and vanilla
7. Stir to blend
8. Add blueberries
9. Stir to combine
10. Spoon filling mixture evenly over the crust
11. Bake at 350 degrees for 35 minutes
12. Cool in the pan
13. Sprinkle with powdered sugar
14. Cut into bars and serve

title: greek fries
steps:
1. Cook french fries according to package directions
2. Sprinkle with lemon juice
3. Sprinkle on feta cheese and seasoning
4. Serve and enjoy !

title: caramelized apple and arugula salad
steps:
1. Melt butter and syrup in a medium skillet
2. Cut apple slices in half and add to skillet
3. Cook over medium-low heat for 20 minutes , stirring frequently
4. Let cool to warm
5. In a medium bowl , toss arugula with apples , bacon , onions and apple vinaigrette dressing

title: babaloo corn cakes
steps:
1. In a medium sized bowl assemble the dry spice mix ingredients and mix well
2. Add the corn flour , corn meal , baking powder , and the baking soda
3. Mix well and set this flour mixture aside
4. In a large bowl , whisk together the buttermilk and melted butter
5. Add in the beaten egg and whisk well
6. Gradually whisk the flour mixture into eggy mixture
7. Whisk this until it is completely blended
8. Add the honey , shrimp , corn kernels , scallions , garlic , and fresh cilantro
9. Mix well
10. You now have your corn cake batter !
11. To fry the corn cakes :
12. Wipe down the interior of a non-stick pan with 1 tablespoon of peanut oil
13. Heat the pan over medium heat for 1 to 2 minutes
14. Ladle the batter into the pan to form corn cakes
15. Do not overcrowd the pan
16. Fry off the corn cakes 2 to 3 minutes per side until they are golden brown
17. Repeat this process until all of the batter is fried off
18. While frying off the rest of the corn cakes , keep the completed ones warm in your preheated oven
19. To serve--garnish each portion with a dollop of sour cream

title: peanut butter chocolate balls
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. In a bowl , blend peanut butter , brown sugar and egg until smooth
3. Roll dough into 1 1 / 2" balls and place on parchment paper lined cookie sheet 2" apart
4. Press a chocolate into each ball , slightly flattening dough
5. Bake @ 350 for 10-12 minutes , or until set and lightly browned

title: honey chipotle pecans
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325f
2. In a skillet , warm honey with chipotle powder and cinnamon over low heat , then add the nuts and stir to coat evenly
3. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper , then spread nuts evenly in a single layer on the sheet
4. Bake in preheated oven until nuts are fragrant
5. Allow to cool slightly
6. In a mixing bowl , combine sugar and salt
7. Add the warm pecans , and toss to coat evenly
8. Spread out on fresh sheet of waxed paper and let dry completely
9. Store in an airtight container

title: spicy shrimp and chorizo kebabs
steps:
1. On a cutting board , using the flat side of a chef's knife , mash the garlic and salt to a coarse paste
2. Add the caraway seeds and finely chop them
3. Transfer to a large bowl and stir in the chile powder and olive oil
4. Add the shrimp and toss to coat
5. Meanwhile , bring a small saucepan of water to a boil
6. Add the chorizo and cook over high heat for 5 minutes
7. Drain and pat dry
8. Let cool slightly
9. Tuck a chorizo slice in the crook of a shrimp and thread onto a skewer
10. The shrimp should be attached at both ends
11. Push it to the end of the skewer and repeat with 2 more shrimp and chorizo
12. Using more skewers , repeat with remaining shrimp and chorizo
13. Grill kebabs over a hot fire , turing once or twice , until charred and the shrimp are cooked through , about 5 minutes
14. Do not over cook
15. Serve immediately

title: gluten free apple cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Grease either 9 inch round springform pan , or 8 inch square cake pan , and dust with rice flour
3. In a medium bowl , whisk together the flour mix , xanthan gum , baking soda , baking powder , and cinnamon
4. Set aside
5. In the bowl of your mixer , cream the butter for about 1 minute or until softened
6. Add both sugars , and beat for about 2 minutes
7. Add the eggs , one at a time , and beat until well incorporated
8. Blend in the milk
9. Then turn mixer to low and add the dry ingredients half at a time , beating after each addition , until they are well absorbed
10. Remove the bowl from the stand and gently fold in the shredded apples
11. Spoon the batter into the prepared pan and bake for 40-45 minutes , or until toothpick inserted tests clean and the cake pulls away from the edge of the pan
12. If serving from the pan , cool at least 10 minutes before removing
13. Dust lightly with icing sugar , if desired

title: easiest peanut dressing for fruit in the whole world  2 ingredie
steps:
1. Put the peanut butter in a small bowl and add the water slowly , stirring vigorously with a spoon throughout until a smooth , kinda runny paste is formed
2. Spoon over a chopped sweet apple or banana for the best snack you've ever had !

title: pecan pie cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. For cookies: beat butter and sugar on medium speed of an electric mixer until creamy
3. Add egg and vanilla and mix
4. Reduce speed to low and add flour and baking powder
5. Beat until well mixed
6. Shape dough into 1 1 / 4-inch balls
7. Place 2 inches apart on ungreased baking sheets
8. Make an indentation in each cookie with your thumb
9. Rotate thumb to hollow out slightly
10. Combine all the filling ingredients in a small bowl
11. Fill each cookie with 1 rounded teaspoon of filling
12. Bake for 8-12 minutes or until lightly browned
13. Cool for 1 minute on baking sheet then remove to cool completely on a wire rack or sheet of aluminum foil

title: pineapple  papaya   mango salsa
steps:
1. All the work is in dicing the fruit
2. One whole pineapple is around 2 1 / 2 cups , 2 medium papaya and 2 medium mangoes are around 2 cups per each fruit to give you a hint about how much to get
3. Combine everything and stir very , very gently
4. Chill for at least 6 hours
5. Keeps in fridge for 4-5 days

title: chicken pot pie   reduced fat
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Dice the chicken into small cubes and pan fry them with some cooking spray
3. Add soup with 1 / 2 can water
4. Add mixed vegetables
5. Cook down mixture on medium heat for 5-10 minutes
6. In a pie pan roll out half the crescent roll and smuch until it takes up the whole bottom and sides of the pan
7. Add mixture from frying pan
8. Cover top with other half of crescent roll
9. Cook for 30 minutes or until crust is golden brown

title: vegan apple pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Prepare apples
3. Boil water in a large pot and add apples and raisins
4. Turn down heat to medium and simmer apples and raisins for 10 minutes or until soft
5. Save 1 / 4 cup of water used for cooking apples for later use
6. Drain apples and place in large bowl
7. Mix apples with maple syrup , cinnamon , and lemon juice
8. Set aside
9. In a saucepan , add"applewater" and corn starch
10. Stir continuously until mixture is thick , then add to apple mix
11. Lastly , add whole wheat flour to mixture
12. Stir well and carefully
13. Pour final mixture into the pie crust and bake on 350 for 30 minutes , or until brown

title: apple cake w  cream cheese frosting
steps:
1. Stir together first 4 ingredients in a large bowl until well blended
2. Combine flour and next 3 ingredients
3. Add dry mixture to the butter mixture , stirring until blended
4. The mixture will be very thick
5. Stir in apple slices
6. It hardly seems like enough batter to coat the apples , but bakes up beautifully
7. Spread batter into greased 9x13 pan and bake at 350 for 45 minutes
8. For the frosting , beat cream cheese and butter until creamy
9. Gradually add sugar and salt , beat well
10. Stir in vanilla and frost the cooled cake

title: quick garlic lemon broccoli
steps:
1. Separate broccoli florets from stalks , break florets into smallish pieces
2. Peel the stalks
3. Chop into 1 / 2 inch pieces
4. In a 12" skillet , cover and cook florets and stems with water over high heat for 2 minutes
5. Remove cover , continue to cook over medium-high heat until water has evaporated and broccoli is tender , about 5 minutes
6. Clear out the center of the pan , add garlic , chilies , and lemon zest
7. Cook for about 15 seconds before stirring it into the broccoli
8. Remove from heat
9. Stir in lemon juice

title: garlic chicken spaghetti
steps:
1. Cook spaghetti according to package directions
2. Meanwhile , place tomatoes in a small bowl
3. Add boiling water
4. Cover and let stand for five minutes
5. Drain and chop tomatoes
6. Set aside
7. In a large resealable plastic bag , combine flour and garlic salt
8. Add chicken a few pieces at a time , and shake to coat
9. In a large skillet , saute chicken in two tablespoons oil until no longer pink
10. Remove and keep warm
11. In the same skillet , saute mushrooms and garlic in remaining oil
12. Add the broth , parsley , basil , salt , pepper , and pepper flakes
13. Stir in the reserved tomatoes and chicken
14. Heat through
15. Drain spaghetti and add chicken mixture and cheese
16. Toss to coat
17. Serve warm

title: red lobster cheddar bay biscuits   copycat
steps:
1. Combine bisquick , milk , and cheddar and beat with a wooden spoon for about 30 seconds
2. -spoon onto a lightly greased cookie sheet
3. -bake in 450 degree oven for 8 - 10 minutes
4. -combine butter and garlic powder and pour over hot biscuits
5. Sprinkle with parsley

title: burger king s hershey s sundae pie
steps:
1. Whip the cream cheese until softened
2. Blend in powdered sugar , cool-whip and vanilla extract
3. Put into crust and smooth out top
4. Make pudding as directed on box for a pie , using only 1 1 / 2 cups of milk
5. Top pie with pudding mixture and smooth out top
6. Finish with cool whip and chocolate curls
7. Refrigerate until set

title: baked scallops
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Pour melted butter into a 2 quart casserole dish
3. Combine the bread crumbs , onion powder , garlic powder , paprika , parsley , minced garlic and parmesan cheese
4. Top scallops with above mixture
5. Bake about 20 minutes

title: wendy s mandarin chicken salad
steps:
1. Add the dressing ingredients in a mixing bowl and blend with a mixer until combined
2. Chill before serving
3. As the dressing chills , add chicken breasts to a pot of boiling water
4. Reduce the heat , cover and simmer for 25 minutes or until cooked
5. Once the chicken is tender and no longer pink , remove from the pot and cut into bite sized pieces
6. Combine chicken and other remaining salad ingredients in a bowl
7. Toss the salad with the dressing and serve

title: shrimp and pineapple fried rice
steps:
1. Peel pineapple and cut up into inch pieces to measure 1 cups
2. Combine pineapple , bell pepper , scallions and jalapeno
3. In a bowl , whisk together soy sauce , sugar , anchovy paste , turmeric and 1 tblsp water
4. In wok , heat 1 tblsp oil over moderate-high heat until hot but not smoking
5. Stir fry shrimp for 1 minutes or until just firm and transfer to a bowl
6. Heat remaining 1 tblsp oil and stir fry garlic 5 seconds , or until golden
7. Add rice and stir-fry 30 seconds , or until rice is hot
8. Add soy mixture and fry 1 minute
9. Add pineapple mixture and shrimp
10. Stir-fry 1 minute
11. Stir in coriander

title: almond asparagus
steps:
1. Clean and trim off the tough ends of asparagus
2. Melt margarine in a large skillet
3. Add the asparagus
4. Saute' at medium heat for 3-5 minutes
5. Add lemon juice , cover , and simmer until crisp-tender
6. Add the almond slivers
7. Season with salt and pepper to taste
8. Toss gently , then serve

title: zucchini bread   betty crocker 1996
steps:
1. Move oven rack to low position so that tops of pans will be in center of oven
2. Heat oven to 350 degrees
3. Grease bottoms only of 2 loaf pans , 8 1 / 2 x 4 1 / 2 x 2 1 / 2 inches or 1 loaf pan , 9x5x3 inches , with shortening
4. Mix zucchini , sugar , oil , vanilla , and eggs in large bowl
5. Stir in remaining ingredients
6. Pour into pans
7. Bake 8-inch loaves for 50 to 60 minutes , 9-inch loaf 1 hour 10 minutes to 1 hour to 20 minutes , until tootpick inserted in center comes out clean
8. Cool 10 minutes in pans on wire rack
9. Loosen sides of loaves from pans
10. Remove from pans and place top side up on wire rack
11. Cool completely before slicing
12. Wrap tightly and store at room temperature up to 4 days , or refrigerate up to 10 days

title: herb roasted pork loin
steps:
1. Preheat an oven to 325f
2. Using a chefs knife , very finely chop together the garlic , rosemary and sage
3. Transfer to a small bowl , add the fennel seeds , season with salt and pepper , and mix well
4. Make slits 1 / 2 inch deep all over the pork roast and insert some of the mixture into each slit
5. Rub the roast with the remaining seasoning , then rub with 2 tbs
6. Of the olive oil
7. Place the meat in a roasting pan just large enough to hold it
8. Transfer the pan to the oven and roast the meat for 1 hour
9. In a bowl , toss the onion slices with the remaining 2 tbs
10. Olive oil and scatter them around the meat
11. Continue to roast until an instant-read thermometer inserted into the thickest part of the roast , away from the bone , registers 150f , or the meat is pale pink when cut into at the center , about 1 1 / 4 hours more
12. Transfer the roast to a carving board , cover loosely with aluminum foil and let rest for 15 minutes before carving
13. Meanwhile , pour off most of the fat in the roasting pan and place the pan over medium-low heat
14. Add the wine and deglaze the pan , stirring to scrape up any browned bits from the pan bottom
15. Simmer until the sauce is slightly reduced
16. Carve the roast and arrange on a warmed platter
17. Spoon the pan sauce over the pork and serve immediately

title: brown rice and barley
steps:
1. Rinse the rice and barley in a sieve , then drain and move to a 4-5 quart heavy pot
2. Add water or broth and bring to a rolling boil
3. Reduce heat to low and cook covered , about 45 minutes
4. Remove from heat and let stand , covered , 10 minutes
5. Stir from top to bottom with a rubber spatula
6. Add salt and pepper to taste , or whatever seasoning you like
7. This is good served with veggies , soy sauce and a little butter too
8. Enjoy !

title: peruvian anticuchos
steps:
1. Place the pieces of heart in a glass or ceramic tray
2. Previously , soak the chiles in hot water until they are soft , devein and take the seeds off
3. If you want you can keep some of the seeds to make it spicier
4. In peru we use aji panca , but this works well too
5. Blend the vinegar , garlic , aji panca , and all other ingredients with 1 / 2 cup of the oil until you have a soft paste
6. Pour it on the pieces of heart and distribute evenly so all pieces are well covered and can absorb the marinade
7. Cover and let sit in the refrigerator for about 30 minutes
8. Do not let them marinade for too long or they will dry out because of the vinegar
9. In the meantime , place thick bamboo skewers to soak in water so they don't burn when they go on the grill
10. Use a charcoal grill and make sure the coals are very hot before you start
11. Stick three or four pieces of heart in each skewer , so that the meat lays flat
12. Save the rest of the marinade in a cup or small bowl and add the rest of the oil to it , mixing well
13. This will be used for basting the anticuchos on the grill
14. Tie some pieces of fresh corn husk with a string made out of some more husk and shred them half the way to make a kind of brush and use it for basting
15. When the coals are ready and the grill is hot place the anticuchos flat on the grill and baste them generously with the leftover marinade and oil mix
16. This will drip and cause the coals to flame , make sure it flames over because this is what gives the anticuchos their distinctive flavor
17. Let anticuchos cook for about 1 minute and a half on each side
18. Do not overcook ! they will dry out and become tough
19. Medium or medium well is fine
20. Turn them over continuously and keep basting and flaming until they are done
21. Hold two or three at a time to turn them over quickly
22. At the same time , place the pieces of corn and potatoes on a corner of the grill , baste them with the same marinade and allow them to be flamed too
23. Serve three skewers in each plate , accompanied by one piece of corn and one potato
24. You can also cut the potatoes in half and stick a piece at the end of each skewer
25. Serve hot , right out of the grill , don't let it get cold ! enjoy ! :p
26. What takes the longest time is to slice and cut the heart in squares and stick the pieces on the skewers
27. As you get practice doing this it will be faster , allow yourself some more time of preparation the first couple of times
28. You can also use regular beef , chicken , fish , prawns , or lamb to make anticuchos , but the original and traditional recipe calls for cow heart
29. Hope you like it ! :)

title: cran honey brussels sprouts
steps:
1. Heat oven to 450 degrees f
2. On baking sheet , gently toss leeks with 1
3. 5 t olive oil
4. Arrange brussels sprouts cut side down on baking sheet surrounding leeks
5. Season with salt / pepper , if desired
6. Roast 20 minutes , until brussels sprouts are tender
7. In bowl , gently toss together roasted sprouts , leeks , cranberries , honey and remaining oil
8. Garnish with walnuts if you like

title: soup
steps:
1. Wash and trim the onion , carrots and celery and dice them
2. Put the onion , carrot , celery and olive oil in a larger , non-stick frying pan over medium-low heat
3. Stir the vegetables every few minutes so they don't burn
4. Once the vegetables have softened , after 7-10 minutes , add garlic , herbs and water
5. Turn the heat down to low so the pan is just simmering
6. After simmering for 10 minutes , carefully puree the soup using an immersion blender
7. Options below--choose an option or two to make the soup your own:
8. Strain the soup through a fine sieve to make a clear broth
9. Add 2 cups vegetables and simmer until vegetables are cooked--about 10 minutes
10. Add 1 / 2 cup of barley , rice or pasta or other favorite grain and simmer until cooked
11. Replace 2 cups of the water with 2 cups of chicken or beef broth
12. Add 3 cups of already-cooked dried beans
13. Add 1-2 cups of finely chopped , cooked meat or fish and heat through
14. With raw meat or fish , cook it first , then drain off fat if the meat is very fatty and begin the soup adding the olive oil and veggies --
15. Add 1 cup of cream or half and half at the end of cooking to make into a creamy soup
16. Add 3 tablespoons of tomato paste and 2 tablespoons of balsamic vinegar , stir in and heat through
17. Add 1 / 2 cup very finely chopped spinach
18. If already cooked , then heat through , otherwise , simmer the spinach for 3-4 minutes
19. Get creative with garnishes to put on top--croutons , shredded cheese , mint or parsley , teaspoon of sour cream , paprika sprinkle

title: fish eye salad or italian fruit salad
steps:
1. Cook , and drain pasta per package instructions
2. Mix pudding mix , oranges , and pineapple
3. Mix in pasta and cool whip
4. Chill at least 1 hour

title: classic chicken and coconut soup
steps:
1. Bring first 3 ingredients to boil in heavy medium saucepan
2. Reduce
3. Heat , add chicken and simmer until almost cooked through , turning occasionally , about 12 minutes
4. Transfer chicken to plate
5. Cool
6. Remove chicken skin and bones
7. Cut meat into 1 / 2-inch pieces
8. Strain soup through sieve into small saucepan
9. Add 1 tbsp lime juice and jalapeno to soup and simmer until reduced to 2 cups , about 20 minutes
10. Add chicken and simmer just to heat through
11. Taste , adding more lime juice if desired
12. Ladle soup into bowls
13. Sprinkle with fresh cilantro

title: eggless scones
steps:
1. Whisk , or sift the dry ingredients
2. Cut the butter into the flour , with a pastry blender , until it resembles coarse crumbs
3. Stir in the milk
4. Add any optional ingredients , if desired
5. On a floured surface , lightly knead the dough 5-10 times
6. Place on a greased , or parchment lined , baking sheet
7. Flatten gently to a 1" thick round
8. Cut , like a pie , into 8 wedges , but do not separate
9. Brush the top with about 1 tablespoon milk
10. Sprinkle with sugar , if desired
11. Bake 400 degrees , 12 -15 minutes , until golden brown

title: chicken stroganoff with mushrooms  sherry   sage
steps:
1. In a 10-inch straight-sided saute pan , heat 2 teaspoons of the oil over medium-high heat
2. Add the mushrooms , season generously with salt , and cook undisturbed until well browned on one side , 1 to 3 minutes
3. Add half of the shallot and 1 / 2 tbs
4. Of the sage to the pan and continue to cook , stirring , until the mushrooms are well browned all over , another 3 to 5 minutes
5. Season generously with black pepper and transfer to a bowl
6. Leave the pan off the heat
7. Generously season the chicken thighs with salt and pepper
8. Return the pan to medium-high heat , add the remaining 2 teaspoons oil , and swirl to coat the pan
9. Add the chicken and cook undisturbed for 1 minute
10. Add 1 / 2 tbs
11. Of the garlic , 1 / 2 tbs
12. Of the sage , and the remaining shallot and continue to cook , stirring , until the chicken is no longer pink on the outside , 2 to 4 minutes
13. Add the mushrooms , sherry , and red pepper and cook to reduce the sherry slightly , about 2 minutes
14. Lower the heat to medium and stir in the sour cream , tomato , and the remaining garlic
15. Partially cover the pan and simmer until the chicken is cooked through , 15 to 20 minutes
16. If the sauce seems overly thick , thin it with a little water
17. Season to taste with more salt and pepper
18. Serve sprinkled with the remaining sage

title: chili cheese pie
steps:
1. Mix egg , sugar , milk and cornbread mix
2. The box may call for less milk but a half cup makes the batter loose enough for this recipe
3. Butter your casserole dish and pour in batter
4. Set it aside
5. Mix onion , bell peppers , chickpeas , salsa , chili and half the cheese and spoon on top of the corn bread batter
6. Top with the rest of the cheese
7. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes or until the cheese is browning and bubbling

title: mustard chicken crock pot
steps:
1. Rub each chicken piece with 2 tbsp of mustard
2. Heat some oil in a crock pot
3. Put the chicken pieces in the crock pot and turn the pieces
4. Remove the chicken pieces when they reach a golden brown color on all the sides , then brown the next batch of chicken
5. Be careful not to burn the mustard
6. When all the chicken pieces have been browned , put the sliced onion in the pot for about 5-10 min to brown
7. Then put all the chicken pieces back into the crock pot and add enough water to just cover the pieces
8. Bring to the boil and reduce the heat to medium
9. Cover and let it simmer for about 45 minutes or until the chicken is cooked
10. Season to taste
11. Mix the 1 / 2 cup mustard and 1 / 2 cup of cream together and add to the sauce
12. Stir well and serve

title: chicken and biscuits
steps:
1. In medium saucepan over medium heat , melt butter or margarine
2. Add flour
3. Cook and stir for 1 minute
4. Add broth and milk
5. Stirring , bring to a boil
6. Boil until thickened
7. Stir in sage , thyme , mrs dash and pepper
8. Stir in chicken , carrots , green peas / beans , onions
9. Pour into a deep 2-qt
10. Casserole
11. Cover and refrigerate for up to 24 hours
12. Bake , covered , in a preheated 425-degree oven for 25-30 minutes or until very bubbly and hot in the center
13. Remove from oven
14. Stir
15. Arrange as many biscuits on top as possible
16. Place any remaining biscuits on baking sheet to bake seprarately sprinkle paprika over casserole
17. Bake casserole and remaining biscutis for 15 minutes or until biscuits are done

title: peppered pork roast
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350
2. Mix garlic pepper and rosemary
3. Rub over entire surface of roast
4. Place roast , fat side up , on rack in shallow roasting pan
5. Roast uncovered 40 to 50 minutes or until meat thermometer registers 155 degrees
6. Let stand 5 to 10 minutes before slicing

title: chocolate peanut butter protein oatmeal
steps:
1. Add oats to water and cook as normal on stove or microwave
2. When oats are done , add peanut butter and protein powder and mix well
3. Enjoy !

title: cauliflower provencale
steps:
1. Boil or steam cauliflower until barely done- still slightly crunchy
2. In a separate pan fry finely chopped onion on medium heat for 4 or 5 minutes adding minced or finely chopped garlic halfway through
3. When soft but not brown add tomato & other ingredients
4. Simmer gently for 3 or 4 minutes
5. Adjust seasoning
6. Mix cauliflower and sauce and serve

title: orange pecans
steps:
1. Combine sugar , cream of tartar , and orange juice in a saucepan
2. Cook over low heat , stirring gently until sugar dissolves
3. Cover orange mixture , and cook over medium heat 2 to 3 minutes to wash down sugar crystals from sides of pan
4. Uncover and cook over medium heat to a soft ball stage
5. Remove from heat , and beat with a wooden spoon just until mixture begins to thicken
6. Stir in pecans and oranger ind
7. Working rapidly , drop by heaping teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper
8. Let cool

title: berry pie   for april fools  day
steps:
1. Place bottom crust in pie pan
2. Fill tightly with cotton balls
3. Cut a few slashes in top crust & place over cotton
4. Crimp edges as you would for pie
5. Drizzle a small amount of jelly on top crust where filling "would run over"
6. Bake in 350 oven on bottom rack , watching very carefully till pie looks done

title: tortellini with a tomato basil cream sauce
steps:
1. Prepare tortellini as directed on package
2. Chop tomatoes in chunky pieces
3. Blend bouillon with basil , parsley and pepper into the tomatoes
4. Saute the garlic in olive oil until just white
5. Add to the sauce and bring just to a simmer
6. When sauce is hot , add the cream to a non-aluminum skillet and bring to a slow boil and add the hot tomato sauce and cheese
7. Stir well and blend the tortellini into the pan of tomato basil cream sauce
8. Serve , topped with parsley and cheese

title: basil vegetables
steps:
1. Put olive oil in a large skillet over medium low heat and add seasonings
2. Add salt if desired
3. Slice onion thin and add to melted butter
4. Saut onion for 1-2 minutes
5. Slice zucchini and squash in half lengthwise and remove seeds
6. Slice zucchini and squash about 1 / 4 inch thickness and add to onions
7. Saut about 1-2 minutes
8. Core and chop tomatoes into bite size pieces
9. Add to vegetables about 5 minutes before serving but do not saut them

title: grape nut pudding
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. In a large bowl , pour scalded milk over the grape-nuts and let sit 5 minutes
3. In a medium bowl , beat eggs , sugar , salt and vanilla
4. Add to the milk and grape-nuts , and stir a couple of times
5. Pour into a greased 2-quart casserole dish
6. Sprinkle generously with ground nutmeg
7. Set the casserole dish in a larger pan and pour very hot water until halfway up the sides of the casserole dish
8. Bake for about 1 hour , or until a knife inserted 1 inch in the center comes out clean
9. Serve warm or cold in individual dessert bowls with whipped cream

title: plain rice     make ahead oamc throw it in the freezer
steps:
1. Cook as directed in rice cooker
2. When rice is done immediately rinse , in strainer , with cold water till rice is cool
3. Fill ziplock baggies with 2 cups of rice each
4. Flatten out and remove air
5. Makes 4 bags
6. I usually have 1 / 2 - 1 cup rice leftover which i just make a little dish for myself with
7. Use one bag for 2 of you ~ two bags for 4 of you :o) just take out of the freezer in the morning and throw in the fridge till you start cooking !

title: grilled sesame garlic beef skewers
steps:
1. In a shallow glass baking dish , combine the worcestershire , sherry , peanut oil , sesame oil , garlic , and ginger
2. Alternately thread the beef strips and snow peas on twelve 10-inch bamboo skewers
3. Place the skewers in the baking dish and turn to coat with the marinade
4. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour or up to 4 hours , turning the skewers several times
5. Remove the skewers from the refrigerator 30 minutes before cooking
6. Light a fire in a charcoal grill or preheat a gas grill or broiler
7. Grill or broil the skewers for 4- to 6 minutes on each side
8. Serve immediately

title: white   wild rice pilaf
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet
2. Add onion , carrots , celery and garlic and cook until tender
3. Add wild rice and broth
4. Heat to a boil
5. Cover and cook over low heat for 25 minutes
6. Add white rice
7. Cover and cook over low heat for 20 minutes or until done
8. Stir in parsley

title: amish after easter hard boiled egg veggie cream cheese salad
steps:
1. Mix celery , cucumber and onion together and salt to taste
2. Dissolve 1 package lemon jello in 1 cup boiling water
3. Mix cream cheese and mayo together and add other ingredients
4. Add jello last when cool
5. Refrigerate until set
6. Cooking time is setting time

title: marion s potato salad
steps:
1. Boil potatoes in a large pot of water until fork tender
2. Potatoes should not be splitting their skins
3. Boil eggs in a separate pot of boiling water for 10 minutes , until completely hard boiled
4. Allow potatoes and eggs to cool completely in the refrigerator , uncovered , about 2 hours
5. When cool , peel potatoes and eggs
6. Discard potatoes skins and eggshells
7. Cut potatoes into bite size pieces and put in a very large bowl
8. Coat with vegetable oil
9. Add vinegar to oiled potatoes
10. Add black pepper , onion powder , dill , parsley , salt
11. Mix well
12. Taste
13. Add more salt or other seasonings if potatoes still taste bland
14. Add dried mustard and mix well
15. Hint: do not add more mustard
16. Add hellmann's mayonnaise one cup at a time
17. You may not need to use the whole jar
18. Potatoes should be well coated , but not covered in mayonnaise
19. Chop eggs into quarters
20. Reserve 1 whole egg for garnish
21. Add to potato mixture and stir gently
22. Scrape down the sides of the bowl with a rubber spatula to get all the mayonnaise off the sides and into the potatoes
23. Transfer to serving bowl , if you are not going to serve it in the mixing bowl
24. Sprinkle top with a light dusting of paprika and a bit of dried parsley
25. In center of bowl , place slices of the hard boiled egg reserved for garnish
26. Allow to chill at least 4 hours in the refrigerator
27. Repeat frequently for a happy summer

title: maque choux
steps:
1. Saute the onion , bell pepper , garlic , and jalapeno pepper in hot oil in a dutch oven over medium-high heat 10 minutes or until tender
2. Stir in corn , tomatoes , and creole seasoning
3. Reduce heat to low
4. Cover and cook 10 minutes , stirring occasionally

title: tostado casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Brown ground beef in a skillet , drain off fat
3. Add 1-1 / 2 cups tomato sauce and the taco seasoning
4. Mix well
5. Line bottom of a 9x13 casserole with two cups corn chips
6. Crush remaining corn chips
7. Set aside
8. Spoon meat mixture over corn chips
9. Combine remaining tomato sauce and the refried beans
10. Spread over the meat
11. Bake , covered , for 25 minutes
12. Sprinkle with cheese and crushed corn chips
13. Return to oven and bake 5 minutes more

title: great gazpacho
steps:
1. Roughly chop all vegetables , blend together in food processor , or blender , until fairly smooth
2. Stir in lemon juice , parsley , tomato juice and tabasco sauce
3. Chill for 30 minutes , or more , and serve

title: bondi rip  a mango shake
steps:
1. In a blender , put the mango , banana & pineapple juice & process until smooth , then add the ice cubes & blend until smooth
2. Drizzle a little raspberry syrup down the inside of 2 tall glasses , then pour in the blended fruit & stir to combine
3. Serve immediately

title: fried eggplant
steps:
1. Place flour in a shallow bowl
2. Whisk wine into flour , beating until batter is smooth and the consistency of thin pancake batter , then season to taste with salt and pepper
3. Preheat oven to 200f
4. Salt or freeze eggplant slices to lessen bitterness and remove excess moisture
5. Pour vegetable oil into a heavy skillet to a depth of 2"
6. Heat oil to 375f or until it sizzles when you drop in a little batter
7. Dip eggplant slices in batter , then place into oilas many at a time as you can without crowding the pan
8. Fry until golden , cooking on both sides , then drain on paper towels
9. Keep fried slices warm in oven
10. When all eggplant slices are cooked , season to taste with salt and pepper , and serve with a squeeze of fresh lemon

title: lively tuna loaf
steps:
1. Preheat oven at 200c / 400f
2. Mix the flour and the eggs together until smooth
3. Add the milk slowly , and then the oil
4. Add the baking powder , the crushed tuna and then the cheese
5. Mix well and add all the seasonings
6. Butter a loaf tin , pour in the mixture and bake in preheated oven for 40 minutes

title: zucchini avocado salad
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients
2. Cover and chill at least one hour

title: zucchini cobbler
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , over medium-low heat , cook and stir zucchini and lemon juice for 15-20 minutes or until zucchini is tender
2. Add sugar , cinnamon and nutmeg
3. Simmer one minute longer
4. Remove from heat and set aside
5. For crust , combine flour and sugar in a bowl
6. Cut in butter until mixture resembles course crumbs
7. Stir 1 / 2 cup into zucchini mixture
8. Press half of remaining crust mixture into a greased 15x10x1-inch baking pan
9. Spread zucchini mixture over top
10. Crumble remaining crust mixture over zucchini
11. Sprinkle with cinnamon
12. Bake at 375f for 35-40 minutes or until golden and bubbly
13. Top with ice cream or whipped cream to serve , if desired

title: chicken with black beans
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. Place chicken pieces in an ungreased baking dish
3. Bake , uncovered , for 25 minutes
4. Drain off excess fat
5. Mix remaining ingredients and spoon around chicken
6. Cover and bake 25 minutes longer , or until chicken is done
7. Serve

title: shrimp and scallop stroganoff
steps:
1. Shell and devein shrimp
2. Rinse scallops and shrimp well
3. Pat dry with paper towel
4. Slice mushrooms
5. Melt 2 tbs of the butter in a large skillet
6. Add shrimp and scallops
7. Cook over medium heat about 5 minutes , until shrimp turn pink and scallops are tender
8. Remove with a slotted spoon to bowl
9. To the drippings in the skillet , add 1 more tbs butter and melt
10. Add mushrooms and sherry
11. Cook at stir over medium heat until mushrooms are just tender
12. In a cup , stir flour , pepper , crushed bouillon cube and 1 cup water until blended
13. Stir into mushrooms
14. Cook mushroom mixture until sauce boils and slightly thickens
15. Reduce heat to low and stir in sour cream until blended
16. Return shrimp and scallops to skillet and cook over low heat until hot this is good over rice or noodles

title: summer pasta with peas   mint
steps:
1. Boil the spaghetti according to pack instructions and , when you have two minutes left , throw in the peas
2. Meanwhile , whisk the olive oil , lemon juice and mustard together , then season with salt , if you like and pepper
3. Drain the pasta , reserving a couple of tablespoons of cooking water and return to the pan
4. Stir the reserved cooking water , olive oil mixture and mint through the pasta
5. Serve

title: rissoles
steps:
1. Mix all the ingredients together , this is best done with your hands
2. Shape into 4 or 6 round balls and dust with the flour
3. Heat the oil on high in a heavy based frying pan until the oil is very hot
4. Place the rissoles in the hot oil
5. Don't over crowd your pan
6. Make sure the rissoles do not burn
7. Turn the rissoles over when one side is browned and slightly crispy
8. Cook the other side the same way , turn the heat down to medium and cook through
9. Depending on the thickness of the pan and the size of the rissoles , it may take about 3-4 minutes to cook the rissoles on each side
10. Do not over cook the rissoles
11. The cooking time would be similar to cooking american hamburgers
12. Serve with brown meat gravy and mashed potatoes with minted peas

title: diane s brownies
steps:
1. Brownies: mix the ingredients in the order given with an electric mixer
2. The batter is very thick
3. Spread in a greased & floured 9"x13" cake pan
4. Bake at preheated 350 degree oven for 25 minutes
5. Frosting: cook sugar , margarine or butter , milk and marshmallows over medium heat until melted
6. Stir in the chocolate chips and spread on slightly cooled brownies

title: broken glass salad
steps:
1. Prepare lime , strawberry and orange jello separately , using 1 cup boiling water and 1 / 2 cup cold water for each package of jello
2. Pour into separate 8x8 inch separate pans
3. Chill until firm
4. Drain pineapple
5. Heat reserved pineapple juice to boiling point
6. You should have one cup of juice
7. If you have to , add water to equal one cup liquid
8. Add lemon jello to boiling juice
9. Remove from heat
10. Add sugar
11. Stir until dissolved
12. Add 1 / 2 cup cold water
13. Add 4 oz
14. Cool whip and pineapple
15. Stir well
16. You may add up to another 4 oz
17. Cool whip if you need it
18. Pineapple mixture should be slightly thick and not too runny
19. Cut jello into 1 / 2 inch cubes
20. Fold into pineapple mixture
21. Pour into glass bowl
22. Chill 5-8 hours or overnight

title: not a hot wing
steps:
1. Roll wing sections in melted butter
2. Place them on a jelly roll pan
3. Line pan with foil if desired for easier clean up
4. Bake for 30 minutes at 325 degrees
5. Combine sauce ingredients in a sauce pan and bring to a boil
6. Boil for 1 minute
7. After 30 minutes , pour sauce over wings
8. Bake one hour longer , turning the wings every 15 minutes
9. Serve warm

title: tofu
steps:
1. Drain tofu and mash well with fork
2. Combine tofu with mayonnaise and spices
3. Blend well
4. Then mix in diced vegetables
5. Serve on a bed of crisp greens or use as a sandwich spread

title: kid friendly chocolate cupcakes
steps:
1. Prepare cupcake tins
2. Lightly grease or insert paper liners
3. Mix all ingredients together with an electric mixer on medium speed until moist and well blended
4. Fill each cup 3 / 4 full
5. Bake for 20-25 minute at 350 degrees f

title: sour cream   dill sauce to serve with salmon
steps:
1. Combine sour cream through lemon juice in small bowl
2. Refrigerate until ready to use

title: tomato and red onion compote
steps:
1. Heat oil in large skillet over medium-high heat
2. Add remaining ingredients and saut just until heated through , about 2 minutes
3. Season with salt and pepper

title: nutella sandwich  mock pain au chocolat
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
2. Cut the croissant horizontally
3. Spread a tablespoon or two of nutella on the bottom half and top with the other half
4. Place on an aluminum foil lined baking sheet in the middle rack of the oven
5. Bake for 5 to 8 minutes or until croissant is golden brown and nutella has warmed through
6. Let sit for a couple minutes , then enjoy !

title: egg noodle salad
steps:
1. Combine first five ingredients in a large bowl
2. In a smaller bowl , combine the remaining ingredients to create a dressing
3. Thoroughly combine the salad with the dressing , before serving at room temperature
4. Be careful to get the bottom of the salad coated with the dressing , as that is a difficult part for me

title: chicken with chili pasta
steps:
1. Cook rotini per package directions
2. In large skillet , heat tbs oil over med-high heat
3. Add chicken and onion cooking 5 to 7 min stirring until chicken is browned
4. Stir in chili beans , tomatoes , chili powder , cumin powder , and chili flakes
5. Bring to boil , reduce heat and simmer 10 to 15 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink
6. Serve the chicken mixture over the rotini
7. Option: garnish with sliced olives , avocado , and cheese
8. Serve with warm tortillas and ice cold beer

title: couples  bec breakfast casserole
steps:
1. Preheat your oven to 350f
2. Spread frozen potatoes over the bed of a lightly greased 16oz oval baking dish
3. In a mixing bowl , beat the eggs , milk , onion , mayonnaise , and ketchup until mixed thoroughly
4. Evenly spread the mixture over the potatoes in the baking dish
5. In a bowl , mix the bacon pieces and cheese
6. Spread them in an even layer over the baking dish
7. In a small dish , mix the seasonings , then sprinkle them evenly over the baking dish
8. Place casserole in oven and cook for 15 minutes
9. While the casserole is baking , prepare the crust by rolling out the crescent roll dough for easy transfer to the top of the baking dish
10. Remove the casserole , but do not turn off the oven
11. Place in refrigerator for 5 minutes to cool the dish
12. Carefully cover the casserole with crescent roll dough
13. Make sure to press the edges of the dough to the sides of the dish
14. Using a toothpick , gently cut decorative vents into the dough
15. Bake the casserole for an additional 15-20 minutes , until the crust is a deep , golden brown
16. Remove the casserole from the oven , and let it stand 5-10 minutes before serving
17. Yum !

title: italian chicken packets
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Cut 6 pieces of foil each measuring about 10" square
3. Brush the foil squares lightly with oil and set aside
4. Slash each chicken breast at regular intervals and place the mozzarella slices into the cuts
5. Place zucchini & tomatoes slices evenly on each piece of foil and sprinkle with basil or oregano
6. Place chicken breasts on top of each pile of veggies then wrap in the foil to enclose the chicken and veggies , tucking in the ends
7. Place packets on baking sheet , bake for 30 minutes
8. Remove from oven and unwrap each packet and serve with rice or pasta

title: chicken lyonnaise
steps:
1. In a plastic bag , shake together the flour , 1 tablespoon thyme , salt and pepper
2. One at a time , dip chicken breasts into the egg , and then shake in flour mixture
3. In a large deep skillet , heat 2 tablespoons of the vegetable oil over medium-high heat
4. Place chicken in pan , skin side down
5. Cook , turning once , for 10 minutes or until golden brown
6. Remove from skillet and place chicken in 225f oven to keep warm
7. Reduce heat to medium
8. Add remaining oil to skillet
9. Stir in onions , garlic and remaining thyme
10. Cook , stirring often , for 5 minutes or until onions are translucent
11. Increase heat to medium-high and continue to cook onions , stirring often , for 5 more minutes or until golden brown
12. Add wine to pan
13. Cook , stirring to scrape up any brown bits , for about 1 minute or until reduced by half
14. Stir in stock , tomato paste and sugar
15. Boil for 2 minutes or until mixture begins to thicken
16. Return chicken to pan , turning to coat
17. Cook for 5 minutes or until juices from chicken run clear
18. To make cutlets , cut chicken breast into 2-3 pieces of approximately equal size
19. Cover with plastic wrap and gently pound to even 1 / 2-inch thickness
20. Cutlets cook more evenly and are more tender than a whole breast piece

title: sweet and sour chicken and rice
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Coat a 2-quart casserole with cooking spray
3. Wash the chicken , pat it dry
4. Put the rice in the casserole
5. Pour the broth over the rice and top with the chicken pieces
6. Mix the pineapple and juice , brown sugar , cornstarch , lemon juice , mustard , and soy sauce in a medium bowl
7. Pour over the chicken
8. Cover and bake for 1 1 / 2 to 2 hours , or until the chicken is cooked through

title: white chocolate and cherry cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Cream butter , shortening , and sugars
3. Add eggs , beating well after each one
4. Add in extracts
5. Sift together dry ingredients
6. Add to wet mixture
7. Stir in cherries and chocolate chips
8. Drop onto well-greased cookie sheets , 3" apart
9. Bake 10-14 minutes

title: dads egg rolls
steps:
1. Cut pork into large chunks and boil till done about 15 minutes , then shred in a food processer
2. Then set aside
3. In a wok or a large deep sided skillet add garlic , sesame oil , olive oil , and ginger , and saute about 1 or 2 minutes
4. Now add shredded cabbage and carrots and stir fry till almost translucent , about 5 to 10 minutes
5. Stir in shredded pork and stir fry to mix about 5 more minutes , set aside
6. You can now wrap your egg rolls , however
7. It best to let it set in the refridgerator at least 1 hr , over night is even better
8. Whip 1 egg with 1 tbsp water to make an egg wash
9. Now place 1 egg roll wrap on a cutting board to appear like a diamond
10. Brush the top half with egg wash
11. Place approx 2 tbsp filling on lower half
12. Fold bottom point up and over filling and tuck
13. Roll about a half turn , now fold in outside corners and finish rolling to seal , to form a small log
14. In a 8 inch skillet fill just over half full with canola oil , and heat to 350f
15. Place egg rolls in hot oil turning as required till golden brown
16. Will hold about three at a time

title: party quiche
steps:
1. Place first 5 ingredients in blender
2. Process until smooth
3. Divide bacon among tart shells
4. Spoon cheese mixture over bacon
5. Bake in 350 oven for about 25 minutes until set
6. To freeze , i bake them first and thaw out before reheating
7. It only takes a wee while to thaw out
8. I put them in the oven for 5 to 8 minutes to heat through
9. I found by reheating them while still frozen they got a little soggy

title: sugee cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven 180 c and line one 8" cake pan
2. Whip eggs whites to a stiff froth and set aside
3. Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy
4. Add egg yolks one at a time , mixing well after each addition
5. Add rose essence , ground nutmeg , ground cinnamon , and almonds
6. Mix in semolina flour
7. Fold in self raising flour and alternating with the egg whites , a little at a time until well blended
8. Bake for one hour until golden brown , or the cake skewer comes out clean when you stick it inches
9. Remove from pan and leave to cool
10. Pour brandy over and let it steep for a few hours
11. Tastes best if you let the brandy steep in the cake for a day

title: hiyashi chuka  japanese summer salad with egg noodles  ham and g
steps:
1. All ingredients should be as cold as possible for maximum body-chilling benefit
2. Divide chilled noodles among serving plates
3. Add toppings of your choice
4. My personal favorite is ham , omelette , cucumber , carrot , bean sprouts and ginger
5. Add dressing of your choice just before eating

title: swedish spareribs
steps:
1. In a small mixing bowl , combine the pepper , sugar , salt , and allspice
2. Sprinkle over all sides of ribs , making sure to coat evenly
3. In a large skillet , melt butter over medium-high heat , making sure butter does burn
4. Brown ribs on all sides
5. Pour beef broth over ribs , cover the skillet and reduce to low heat
6. Simmer for 1 to 1 1 / 2 hours
7. Do not remove the cover during cooking

title: fresh fruit dessert with honey wine squares
steps:
1. Pour wine in bowl and bring to room temperature
2. Sprinkle gelatin over wine and let stand 1-2 minutes
3. Add 1 / 2 cup boiling water and stir until gelatin deissolves , between 1-5 minutes
4. Stir in honey
5. Pour into a 9x9 pyrex pan
6. Refrigerate until firm , about 4 hours
7. To serve cut into 1-inch squares
8. Arrange fruit and wine squares in dessert cups

title: southern dumplings
steps:
1. Sift dry ingredients together
2. Cut in butter
3. Add liquid and mix until moistened
4. Roll out dough on floured board and cut into strips
5. Drop in hot broth and cook , covered , for 8 to 10 minutes

title: spotted lizard margaritas
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a blender and process until smooth
2. Run lime wedge around the rim of margarita glass , and holding glass inverted , sprinkle sugar around the outside , to frost the rim
3. Pour drink into margarita glasses and serve

title: high rollin chile cherry salsa
steps:
1. In a non-reactive bowl , combine the cherries , chile , bell pepper , garlic , ginger , olive oil , lime juice , zest , salt and pepper
2. Refrigerate 3 hours or until thoroughly chilled
3. Serve chilled

title: miriam reichl s corned beef ham
steps:
1. Cover corned beef with water in a large pot
2. Add bay leaves and onion
3. Cook over medium heat about 3 hours , until meat is very tender
4. While meat is cooking , mix mustard and brown sugar
5. Preheat oven to 325
6. Take meat from water and remove all visible fat
7. Insert cloves into meat as if it were ham
8. Cover the meat with the mustard mixture and bake 1 hour , basting frequently with the peach syrup
9. Surround meat with spieced peaches and serve

title: easy weiner wraps
steps:
1. Run a knife down the middle of each hot dog
2. Slice cheese into 4 sections
3. Insert 2 sections of cheese into each hot dog
4. Spread mustard on hot dog and wrap in lightly moistened egg roll wrapper
5. Cook on a drip rack in small pan in your toaster oven at 350 for about 5 to 7 minutes
6. When the wrapper begins to brown slightly , your weiners are done
7. Garnish with mustard and sweet relish

title: mary s carrot cookies
steps:
1. Cream sugar and shortening
2. Add eggs , vanilla and carrots
3. Mix well
4. Put all dry ingredients in a seperate bowl - mix together and add to wet mixture slowly
5. Stir in coconut
6. Bake at 375 degrees for 10 minutes
7. Whip together the icing ingredients and frost when cooled

title: spicy tofu wontons
steps:
1. Drain the tofu
2. Blend the mushrooms , chestnuts , garlic , and tofu in a food processor until roughly blended , there should still be a few chunks
3. Place the blended ingredients in a bowl and add the soy sauce , chili sauce , salt , and mustard , and mix
4. Wet the corners of the wonton wrappers with a little bit of water as you need them
5. Spoon a little more than a teaspoon of tofu filling into the middle of the wrapper
6. Fold the corners of the wrappers and seal with a fork
7. Place them on a greased pan and place in the oven for 10 minutes at 375f
8. Enjoy them with sweet thai chili sauce or with more chinese mustard

title: mary s broccoli casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Mix together 1 stick melted butter or margarine with the finely crushed cracker crumbs
3. Place in the bottom of a greased baking pan
4. Reserve 1 / 2 cup of crumbs for the top
5. Steam the broccoli until crisp tender , about 5 minutes , and drain well
6. Put drained broccoli on top of crumbs in the pan
7. Mix remaining 1 / 2 stick melted butter with the velveeta in a small saucepan
8. Heat on low until well blended and smooth
9. Pour cheese sauce over broccoli in the pan
10. Top with the reserved buttered crumbs
11. Bake 20 minutes in a preheated oven

title: spinach artichoke cheesy tortellini
steps:
1. Heat a deep skillet over medium heat with the oil and butter
2. When butter melts , add garlic and grated onion
3. Saute for 5 minutes
4. Sprinkle the flour into the skillet and cook for 1 minute
5. Whisk in the broth , then the cream and bring to a bubble
6. Season the sauce with nutmeg and reduce heat to low
7. Separate spinach into pieces as you add it to the sauce
8. Stir in the artichokes and cheese and season to taste with salt and pepper
9. Cook the tortellini in salted boiling water according to package directions , about 7 minutes
10. Drain and toss with the spinach artichoke sauce
11. Serve immediately with additional grated cheese and diced tomatoes , if desired

title: passover farfeloni and cheese casserole
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f
2. In a medium bowl , lightly beat 2 of the eggs and mix in the farfel or broken matzos
3. In a blender , beat the remaining egg with the milk , salt , and pepper
4. Grease or spray a 2 quart rectangular casserole
5. Place half the farfel mixture and half of the cheese in the casserole
6. Add half the sour cream , distributing evenly in dollops then half the butter in pieces
7. Make an identical layer on top
8. Pour the milk mixture over the top
9. Cover the casserole and bake for 30 minutes
10. Uncover and bake 10-15 minutes to brown on the top
11. Cut into squares and serve
12. I have got this out of a cookbook and plan to make it on passover
13. I will probably mix all the cheeses into the farfel mixture pour the milk mixture over the top and bake

title: cherry coconut easter eggs  gluten free
steps:
1. Combine the dessicated coconut , chopped cherries , a few drops of red food colouring and the condensed milk in a bowl and mix well
2. Add colouring a little at a time until you get a bright colour
3. We aimed for something like a 'cherry ripe' chocolate bar colour
4. Roll heaped teaspoonfuls of the mixture into egg shapes
5. Squeeze the mix together and roll into ball shapes
6. Then shape with your hands to make oval egg shapes
7. If the mixture is too soft -- add a little more coconut and mix thoroughly
8. Place eggs on a tray and refrigerate until firm
9. Combine the melted chocolate with the copha or oil
10. You can just use chocolate without the copha or oil- these just give a glossier looking finish to the eggs
11. Dip eggs into chocolate and again refrigerate
12. Decorate as desired with melted nestl dark melts or white melts that have been coloured with red food colouring

title: salsa verde  italian green sauce
steps:
1. Blend all the ingredients in a blender or with pestle and mortar
2. Leaving it to stand for a while allows the flavors to develop
3. Mix with pasta or place a dollop on meat or fish
4. Enjoy !

title: alaskan salmon dip
steps:
1. Wrap salmon in tin foil with butter and onions , bake in oven on 350 for about 15 to 20 or until done
2. Then debone the salmon and flake it using a fork
3. In a large bowl add salmon , cream cheese , stir , add sour cream , worcestershire , relishes , and garlic salt , stir again
4. Makes sure to add worcestershire and garlic salt to taste
5. Can be served hot or cold
6. Goes well with crackers , bread or even sandwiches

title: sugar free orange mocha  mock starbucks mocha valencia  mix
steps:
1. Mix the dry ingredients well
2. Add 1-2 heaping tablespoons to hot coffee
3. Mix
4. Add a splash of milk or cream if desired

title: rhubarb cream squares
steps:
1. Mix first four ingredients well and press into 9" x 13" pan
2. Bake at 350f for 5-10 minutes
3. Mix together remaining ingredients and pour over crust
4. Bake at 350f for 40 minutes or until set

title: french pancakes
steps:
1. Heat together milk and butter in a saucepan on medium low heat until butter is melted
2. Remove from burner and let cool slightly
3. Add 2 eggs
4. Blend dry ingredients and add
5. Spoon out into melted butter in a hot skillet or griddle
6. Turn very quickly - as soon as bubbles form on top
7. These should be only lightly brown
8. The first 2 or 3 usually don't come out the best -
9. Serve with real maple syrup or maple sugar - or with just plain sugar
10. You can substitute 1 / 4 tsp of lemon juice if you don't have baking powder on hand
11. You can pour 1 / 4 cup of batter into a non-stick pan , coat the bottom , and then flip quickly [remembering that it is better to undercook these for delicacy and maximum tenderness] - if your flip isn't perfect , these are just as good if they are crumpled up

title: ranch deviled eggs
steps:
1. Place eggs in sauce pan and cover with water
2. Bring water to a quick boil
3. Remove from heat and cover for 20 minute
4. Let eggs cool
5. Shell eggs and cut in half
6. Scoop out hard boiled yoke
7. Mash the yoke with a fork until smooth
8. If you add your salt now this will help
9. Add ranch salad dressing and cream cheese to the mashed yokes and mix well
10. You may need to add a little more ranch dressing to get your desired creaminess
11. Use a piping bag or spoon to fill the egg halves
12. Sprinkle with paprika

title: best crab dip on the planet
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees
2. In a large bowl , combine all ingredients
3. Spread mixture evenly into a shallow baking dish coated with cooking spray
4. Bake 20 minutes or until mixture starts to bubble
5. Let stand for 5 to 10 minutes before serving

title: fresh cream of tomato soup
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a large nonstick saucepan over medium heat
2. Add the onions and cook , stirring occasionally , until softened , about 5 minutes
3. Stir in the tomatoes , broth , garlic , thyme , and basil
4. Simmer , covered , until the vegetables are tender , about 5 minutes
5. Cool slightly
6. Transfer to a blender and puree
7. Return the mixture to the saucepan
8. Whisk the milk and tomato paste in a small bowl
9. Stir into the soup
10. Add the basil , salt and pepper
11. Cook , stirring occasionally , until just heated through

title: healthy but oh so damn good banana bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Prepare a loaf pan
3. Mix sugars and melted margarine in a large bowl
4. Pre-mix your fake eggs and add them
5. Mash the 3 ripe bananas and mix those in too
6. Add soda , vanilla , cinnamon , allspice and nutmeg
7. Mix in the flour , oats and wheatgerm
8. Now add all your seeds and raisins
9. Place mixture into the pan and cook in the oven for an hour
10. And there you have it ! enjoy !

title: chicken spinach quesadillas
steps:
1. Squeeze excess liquid from the spinach
2. Place 4 tortillas on a work surfaced
3. Spread 2 tablespoons pesto on each tortilla
4. Top with 1 / 4 cup spinach
5. Sprinkle each tortilla with 1 / 4 cup each cheese and chicken
6. Top with remaining tortillas and press firmly
7. Heat a large skillet over medium heat and cook each quesadilla until cheese melts and tortillas are golden brown , about 3 minutes per side
8. Trasnfer to a plate
9. Cut each into quarters before serving

title: jasper s new england clam chowder
steps:
1. Heat 4 to 6 quartsized soup pot , over low heat
2. Add diced bacon , rendering fat , cook til crisp , with slotted spoon , remove bacon and set aside
3. Add butter to the bacon drippings in the soup pot , then add diced onions , garlic , celery , thyme and bay leaves
4. Saute , stirring occasionally with wooden spoon , until onions are softened , not brown , about 10 minutes
5. Drain the canned clams , saving the liquid into the soup pot
6. Set the clams aside with the crisp bacon
7. Add the diced potatoes and bottled clam juice to the soup pot
8. Total broth should just barely cover the potatoes , if it does not , add a little water
9. Cover and cook vigoriously about 10 minutes
10. Mash cooked potatoes with a spoon against side of pot to thicken chowder
11. Cook 1 to 2 minutes more , uncovered , to release the starch from the potatoes , which causes the chowder to thicken nicely
12. Remove from heat
13. Add clams , bacon , and cream
14. Season and add parsley
15. Serve immediately

title: delicious low cal smoothie
steps:
1. If your pineapple isn't already chopped up , chop it into pieces so its easier to blend
2. Add all fruits into a blender
3. Add the can of sprite , add less than the whole can if you want a thicker smoothie
4. Blend on high power until smooth
5. Serve in your favourite glasses , either with spoons or straws

title: omelette w goat cheese  green onions   cilantro
steps:
1. Beat eggs
2. In a small skillet sprayed with vegetable spray add the beaten eggs and begin to cook on medium heat
3. After 2 minutes sprinkle the goat cheese , green onions , cilantro , salt and pepper over top and cook for 3 more minutes or just until omelette is no longer runny
4. Flip in half and serve overtop the toast

title: walnut stuffed baby red potatoes
steps:
1. Cook potatoes in boiling water for 8 to 12 minutes until just tender
2. Drain and cool
3. Slice off the bottom end of each potato so it sits upright and slice off a third of the top
4. With a melon baller , scoop out the potato and fill with a dollop of sour ream
5. Top with walnut halves and tuck in a sprig of dill

title: apple and leek frittata
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , beat together the eggs and egg whites and set aside
2. Coat a large skillet over medium heat with cooking spray and add leeks sauting for 1 or 2 minutes
3. Add the apples and continue to cook until the apple is just tender , about 3 minutes
4. Add sage to the pan
5. Season with salt and pepper to taste
6. Spread the apple and leek filling evenly around the pan
7. Add eggs and swirl so that each piece of the frittata will have an equal amount of egg and filling
8. Reduce heat a bit and cover the pan , cooking 3-6 minutes until the eggs are set
9. Cut the frittata into fours and ease the slices onto the serving plates
10. Garnish with additional sage if desired

title: gingered blueberry shortcake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Combine first 3 ingredients in a medium saucepan over medium heat
3. Cook 6 minutes or until berries begin to pop , stirring frequently
4. Set aside
5. Lightly spoon flour into dry measuring cups
6. Level with a knife
7. Place flour , baking powder , and salt in a food processor
8. Pulse to combine
9. Finely chop the candied ginger - don't rely on the food processor to continue chopping it , as the pulses are too brief
10. Add the ginger with the butter to processor
11. Pulse until mixture resembles coarse meal
12. Add milk , and pulse 3 or so times , just until combined
13. Turn mixture out onto a lightly floured surface
14. Press mixture into a 7-inch circle
15. Cut into 8 wedges
16. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper
17. Place wedges 1 inch apart on the prepared baking sheet
18. Combine egg white and 1 tablespoon water in a small bowl
19. Lightly brush tops of wedges with egg white mixture
20. Sprinkle evenly with the remaining 1 tablespoon sugar
21. Bake at 400 for 18-20 minutes or until golden brown
22. Cool on a wire rack
23. Place cream in a medium bowl
24. Beat with a mixer at medium speed until soft peaks form
25. Add powdered sugar , beating until stiff peaks form
26. Split shortcakes in half horizontally
27. Divide the berries evenly , spooning approximately 1 / 3 cup berry mixture over each bottom half
28. Top each with about 2 tablespoons whipped cream
29. Cover with shortcake tops
30. To prepare in advance: you can make all the components in advance and then assemble just before serving: prepare the berry mixture and whipped cream earlier in the day , and refrigerate
31. Bring berry mixture to room temperature or warm slightly in a pan before serving
32. Make the shortcakes early in the day and wrap in plastic wrap until needed later
33. Or , make in advance and freeze them , then defrost at room temperature when ready to serve

title: mel s chili sauce
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in non-aluminum pot
2. Simmer ingredients over medium heat , stirring occasionally and slightly mashing vegetables as they cook
3. Cook until thickened
4. Place in 1-pint canning jars
5. Let stand , cool , and seal using hot-water canning method

title: rusty nail
steps:
1. Pour the scotch and drambuie into an old-fashioned glass almost filled with ice cubes
2. Stir well
3. Garnish with the lemon twist

title: candy cane cheesecake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325f
2. Combine cookie crumbs , sugar and butter , and press into a 9 inch springform pan
3. Blend sour cream , sugar , eggs , flour and peppermint and vanilla extracts until smooth
4. Add cream cheese and 2 tablespoons butter
5. Stir in crushed candy
6. Pour into the crust and bake on lowest rack of oven for 50-60 minutes or until firm
7. Allow to cool and refrigerate overnight
8. The top may crack , but that's okay ! remove from pan and serve
9. Top with sweetened whip cream and garnish with candy cane if desired
10. Enjoy !

title: curds   whey   for canadian poutine
steps:
1. Heat the water in a very large pot over low heat
2. Stir in the dry milk powder as the water heats
3. Heat it gently until it is very hot but not boiling
4. Stir in about a cup of vinegar
5. Turn off the heat and allow the mixture to sit for about 10 minutes - don't skip this part because the mixture has to sit for the milk to have a chance to curdle
6. After 10 minutes there should be a big clump of white cheese curd in the middle of a pool of clear amber liquid
7. If the liquid is still milky , then you need to add more vinegar to finish curdling the milk
8. Add a couple of spoonfuls of vinegar at a time and stir gently so that more of the milk will curdle and clump up
9. Continue until all of the milk is curdled into curds , and the liquid is clear
10. Line a strainer or collander with a lightly damp thin cotton cloth
11. Carefully pour the big pot of curds and whey into the strainer and let all of the whey strain off
12. Run a little cold water over the curds to cool them down , and to rinse out all of the whey
13. Squeeze the curds with your fingers to break them up , and rinse them thoroughly
14. Gather up the cloth around the curds and squeeze to remove as much of the moisture as you can - the curds should be quite dry
15. Transfer the cheese curds to a bowl or container and stir in the salt

title: raisin spice hot cereal with quinoa
steps:
1. Rinse quinoa well with water to remove bitter coating
2. Drain
3. Place almonds in a medium saucepan over medium-high heat
4. Stir frequently until almonds are toasted and fragrant , about 3-4 minutes
5. Set aside
6. Combine quinoa , water , raisins , cinnamon , and nutmeg in the same saucepan
7. Bring to a boil , cover , and reduce to a simmer for 10 minutes
8. Stir in the oats , replace cover , and cook for an additional 6 minutes
9. Add the almonds and sugar
10. Top with vanilla yogurt , milk , soymilk , or half and half cream , if using
11. Serve immediately

title: hawaiian oatmeal
steps:
1. Combine the eggs and sugar , beating until light
2. Sift flour , salt and soda
3. Add to egg mixture and beat until smooth
4. Add the rest of ingredients and mix well
5. Spoon batter into a greased and floured 9x5 loaf pan
6. Bake at 325f for 1 hour
7. Remove from pan immediately

title: stuffed yellow peppers with spicy swiss chard and scallion pilaf
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400
2. In a medium saucepan , cover the rice with the water and bring to a boil
3. Cover the saucepan and cook the rice over low heat until the water is absorbed , about 15 minutes
4. Remove from the heat and let the rice stand for 5 minutes
5. Fluff the rice
6. Meanwhile , in a large skillet , bring 1 / 2 inch of water to a boil
7. Add the swiss chard and cook over high heat until tender , about 2 minutes
8. Drain the chard and let cool , then squeeze dry and coarsely chop
9. In the skillet , heat the olive oil
10. Add the scallions and garlic and cook over moderate heat until softened , about 4 minutes
11. Add the turmeric , cumin , ginger , cinnamon and cayenne and cook , stirring , for 2 minutes
12. Add the tomato and cook , stirring , until the liquid evaporates , about 2 minutes
13. Add the currants and chopped swiss chard , cover and cook for 2 minutes
14. Add the lemon juice and rice
15. Season with salt and pepper and stir well
16. Cut the tops off the peppers and reserve
17. Scoop out the seeds and ribs
18. Spoon the rice filling into the peppers and replace the tops
19. Pour the broth into a shallow baking dish that will hold the peppers snugly
20. Stand the stuffed peppers in the broth
21. Cover tightly with foil and bake for about 1 hour and 10 minutes , or until the peppers are tender
22. Serve the stuffed peppers warm or at room temperature

title: lemon delicious pie
steps:
1. Mix sugar and cornstarch
2. Combine with butter , lemon juice , egg yolks and milk
3. Cook in top of a double boiler until thick and cooked
4. Remove from heat and let cool
5. When cool , stir in sour cream
6. Pour into baked pie shell
7. Serve with whipped cream or make meringue with 3 egg whites
8. Preheat oven to 425f degrees
9. In mixing bowl , beat egg whites until frothy
10. Add cream of tartar and beat until stiff peaks form
11. Gradually beat in sugar and continue beating until stiff and glossy
12. Pile meringue lightly on cooled pie making sure it touches edge of pastry to prevent it from shrinking
13. Bake five to six minutes

title: breadbeckers whole wheat english muffins
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine water , milk , honey and salt
2. Thoroughly beat 2 cups of the flour , the flax meal and the yeast into the milk mixture to form a loose batter
3. Cover and let the "sponge" rise in a warm place for about 1 hour
4. Beat in the softened butter
5. Knead in the remaining flour forming a smooth , soft dough for about 4-5 minutes
6. Turn the dough out onto a surface sprinkled with cornmeal and roll to a 1 / 2" thickness
7. Cut into 3-4 inch rounds
8. Let these rest on parchment paper or a slightly greased cookie sheet until doubled
9. Carefully lift the rounds with a pancake turner oto a hot , well-buttered skillet or griddle at about 350 degrees
10. Cook until lightly brown , turning once
11. Cool slightly and slice in half
12. Toast the halves , if desired

title: country style spaghetti and meatballs
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , add first 8 ingredients
2. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat , stirring occasionally
3. Lower heat and simmer for 40 minutes , stirring occasionally
4. Add meatballs
5. Simmer and occasionlly stir for 20 additional minutes
