6. Serve over hot cooked spaghetti

title: black bean and chicken soup with sweet corn
steps:
1. Boil chicken breast in water for 10-20 minutes or until juices run clear and chicken is done
2. Dice chicken and set aside
3. Mix cream of chicken soup with 1 / 2 can water and 1 / 2 can milk and heat through , about 5 minutes on medium heat
4. Add taco seasoning , cumin , and cilantro , stir
5. Add onion and celery , cook on low about 5 minutes
6. Add black beans , sweet corn , and chicken
7. Cook on low for 10-20 minutes , stirring occasionally
8. Serve topped with grated cheese and with tortilla chips for dipping
9. Enjoy !

title: warm beets with pineapple
steps:
1. In a saucepan over med-low heat , melt butter
2. Stir in brown sugar , cornstarch , salt and the juice / syrup only from the pineapple tidbits
3. Cook and stir until thickened
4. Add in pineapple tidbits and beets
5. Gently stir and heat through
6. Serve

title: crock pot roasted chicken
steps:
1. In a large ziploc bag , place chicken , dressing and lemon juice
2. Refrigerate overnight
3. Place chicken in crock pot , discard leftover marinade
4. Mix all spices and sprinkle over all sides of chicken
5. Set on low and cook for 6 hours
6. Drain juice and chicken will pull easily apart
7. Serve with rice or potatoes and a salad or vegetable and some crusty bread

title: microwave apple crisp
steps:
1. Place apples in 1 quart casserole
2. Sprinkle with lemon juice
3. Microwave 2 1 / 2-4 minute
4. Combine remaining ingredients in another bowl
5. Microwave 1 1 / 2-3 1 / 2 min until bubbly
6. Stir and spread over apples
7. Microwave 4-6 minute until apples are tender

title: creamy garlic cheese pizza with fresh basil
steps:
1. Mix garlic , ranch , and cayenne pepper together
2. Then spread it over the pizza crust leaving about 1 inch border of crust
3. Cover the pizza with mozzerella cheese
4. Then sprinkle the fresh basil leaves over the top
5. Bake at 350 f for approximately 15-25 minutes
6. Generally it takes about this long but the time can vary depending on the pizza crust being used

title: cacao nib masa drink
steps:
1. Using a coffee grinder or spice mill , grind the cacao nibs as finely as possible-this will take about 30 seconds in a standard electric spice mill
2. In a bowl , combine the cacao nibs with the masa harina
3. Add in 1 cup milk and whisk to combine
4. Set aside
5. In a 2-quart nonstick saucepan , combine the remaining 1 cup milk with the honey , ground cinnamon , and salt
6. Place over med-low heat and bring to just a boil , whisking to dissolve the honey
7. Immediately whisk in the masa harina mixture
8. Bring to a boil , then lower the heat and simmer , whisking often , for about 5 minutes , until the porridge is thick enough to hold very soft peaks with the whisk is lifted out of it
9. Stir in the vanilla and remove from the heat
10. Pour into 2-4 warmed cups and insert a cinnamon stick into each one to use as a spoon for the thick drink
11. Serve immediately

title: baked beans with baked bacon
steps:
1. Baked bacon:
2. Preheat oven to 375f
3. Line a half sheet with aluminum foil and put a cooling rack on top
4. Arrange slices in rows , with fat edges slightly overlapping lean edges
5. Bake 375 degrees without turning 20-25 minutes but remove from oven before it begins to crisp
6. If needed , cook more , 2 minutes at a time
7. Remove bacon to double layer of paper towel and blot excess grease
8. Lay bacon on cutting board and cut into bite-size pieces before completely cool
9. Baked beans:
10. Set oven to 350f
11. Mix the baked beans ingredients in a 3-quart casserole dish or half buffet tray
12. Add the cut-up cooked bacon and mix a little
13. Bake uncovered for 1 hour
14. Allow to cool 1 hour before serving

title: chicken  bacon and white bean soup portuguese style
steps:
1. Put the beans into a large pot
2. Add water to cover by 2 inches and soak for at least 8 hours or overnight
3. Then drain
4. Fry the bacon in a heavy stockpot over medium-high heat until crisp , about 7 minutes
5. Use a slotted spoon to lift onto paper towels to drain
6. Pour off all but 2 tablespoons of the bacon fat from the pot
7. Add the onions and celery and cook , stirring occasionally , until tender , about 4 minutes
8. Add the shallots , garlic , bay leaves , salt and cayenne
9. Cook , stirring occasionally , until the shallots soften , about 1 minute
10. Add the beans to the pot with the stock , and bring to a boil
11. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer , uncovered , stirring occasionally , until the beans are tender , about 1 1 / 2 hours
12. Stir in the chicken and the reserved bacon and heat through
13. Remove and discard bay leaves
14. Ladle into warm bowls and sprinkle with the grated cheese

title: lamb stew
steps:
1. Sprinkle lamb with sugar
2. Brown in oil in skillet
3. Remove lamb and place in slow cooker , reserving drippings
4. Stir in salt , pepper , and flour into drippings until smooth
5. Stir in water and wine , until smooth , stirring until broth simmers and thickens
6. Pour into cooker
7. Add remaining ingredients and stir until well mixed
8. Cover
9. Cook on low 8-10 hours
10. Serve with crusty bread

title: real ukrainian cabbage rolls
steps:
1. Take core out of center of cabbage
2. Place head of cabbage in a large pot of boiling water , cored side down
3. Cover and simmer as the leaves become pliable remove with tongs and place in a colander that has been placed on a cookie sheet to catch excess water
4. When done removing all the leaves that can be used ,
5. Place leaves on a cutting board and shave down the "vein" or if the leaf is large enough cut in half on either side of it
6. Dice bacon and onion and place in a frying pan cook until tender but bacon is not crisp
7. Cook rice as pkg
8. Directs but remove from heat while rice still has a hard kernel in the center
9. Add rice and bacon mixture together along with the garlic , dill and the veg oil
10. Place a spoonful in center of leaf tuck in the sides and roll
11. Place in a foil pan or roaster until all leaves etc
12. Are done
13. To bake either use enough water to just cover the rolls or for a different taste , mix one can tomato soup with i / 4 can water and pour over top
14. Use the leftover cabbage leaves from the core to put over top to prevent scorching
15. Cover with foil
16. Bake at 325f for 1
17. 5 to 2 hours

title: cranberry cooler slush
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a large freezer container
2. Freeze until slushy , at least 8 hours
3. Spoon into cocktail glasses , serve immediately while still slushy

title: kotopoulo me sika  chicken with figs in red wine
steps:
1. Arrange the chicken pieces and giblets in a heavy roasting dish
2. Sprinkle with the spices and salt and massage into the flesh
3. Distribute the onions , garlic , bay leaves and figs over and between the chicken pieces , pour in the wine and cover
4. Cook in an oven preheated to 180 c / 350 f / gas 4 for about 50 minutes , until the chicken is barely tender
5. Stir in the lemon zest and juice and return to the oven until almost falling from the bones - another 10-i5 minutes
6. If there is an excess of liquid , leave off the cover for this part of the cooking
7. Sprinkle with parsley and serve with saffron

title: unbelievable crab dip
steps:
1. Spray a small slow cooker with vegetable cooking spray
2. In a large bowl , combine cream cheese , mayonnaise , seasoned salt , and worchestshire sauce , and mix well with a fork
3. Stir in sherry , onions , and crabmeat and spoon into slow cooker
4. Cover , and cook on low for 1 1 / 2 -2 hours and stir once half way through

title: seafood pasta w jalapenos
steps:
1. Dice tomato , jalapeno and red onion
2. Do not combine
3. Chill while preparing rest of recipe
4. Place olive oil in large skillet
5. Add shrimp , scallops and garlic and cook shrimps curl and turn pink
6. Heat the alfredo sauce and thin it down a little with milk
7. I prefer a lighter alfredo is with the seafood
8. Stir the seafood into the alfredo
9. Place pasta on plate and top with seafood mixture
10. Top with the diced tomato , jalapeno and red onion
11. Sprinkle with fresh grated parmesean

title: peeled tomatoes for soups and sauces   a  how to
steps:
1. Bring a large pot of water to a boil , add salt if using
2. The size of pot depends on how many tomatoes you put in at a time
3. I only put in five at a time
4. At boil , submerge tomatoes , bring water back to a boil
5. Boil for three to seven minutes depending on the size of tomato
6. Remove tomatoes but keep the water simmering for next batch
7. Cool enough to handle
8. The skin should be split on each tomato now , so just peel from that starting point
9. Cut in half and remove seeds
10. Now , you have tomatoes ready for whatever is your next step
11. Easy , right ?

title: grilled tuscan chicken panini
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine mayonnaise , basil , 1 tablespoon lemon juice , and 1 teaspoon garlic
2. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours
3. In a large resealable plastic bag , combine olive oil , remaining 3 tablespoons lemon juice , remaining 3 teaspoons garlic , italian seasoning , salt , and pepper
4. Add chicken
5. Seal bag and toss gently to combine
6. Refrigerate for 1 hour
7. Heat a medium skillet over medium-high heat
8. Remove chicken from bag , discarding marinade
9. Cook chicken until browned on both sides and cooked through , about 5 minutes per side
10. Preheat panini press to medium-high heat
11. Spread mayonnaise mixture on cut sides of bread
12. On bottom half of bread , layer chicken , tomato , avocado , cheese , and top half of bread
13. Cut sandwich into fourths or sixths
14. Cook on panini press according to manufacturers instructions
15. Serve immediately

title: aunt jane s eggplant fingers
steps:
1. Peel eggplants and cut into 1 / 2 inch strips
2. Heat oil in deep fat fryer to 375 degrees
3. Dip eggplant strips into milk , then flour
4. Then dip into milk again and finally into bread crumbs
5. Fry about 12 at a time for 4 minutes
6. Drain on paper towels
7. Serve sprinkled with powdered sugar

title: hot tamale meatballs
steps:
1. In a bowl , combine 1 / 3 cup of tomato juice , cornmeal , 1 tablespoon of cumin , 1 tablespoon of chili powder , 1 / 4 tsp of salt , garlic , and cayenne
2. Add the beef and sausage and mix well
3. Shape into 1 -inch balls
4. In dutch oven , combine the remaining ingredients and bring to a boil
5. Add the meatballs , cover , and simmer for 45 minutes or until the meat is no longer pink

title: best no cook peanut butter fudge
steps:
1. Melt in a large sauce pan the butter and peanut butter
2. Cook and stir until all is smooth and melted
3. Remove from heat
4. Add the vanilla
5. Beat in the powdered sugar until smooth
6. Add 1 / 2 cups walnuts if desired
7. Pour into a buttered 8 x 8 pan or a greased cookie sheet
8. Put into the refrigerater , cut when set

title: reese s peanut butter cake
steps:
1. Prepare cake according to directions for a 9x13 pan
2. Set aside to cool
3. Mix peanut butter , powdered sugar and vanilla with mixer
4. Add small amounts of milk until desired consistency is achieved
5. This is frosting
6. So thicker is better
7. Spread evenly over cool caked
8. Melt chocolate chips in microwave for one minute
9. Stir to ensure all is melted and it has a slightly "runny" consistency
10. Makes it easier to spread !
11. Spread this over the top of the peanut butter frosting
12. Spoonfuls at a time
13. Reheat if it hardens
14. Sprinkle the chopped peanut butter cups over the warm chocolate to ensure it sticks
15. Chill to set chocolate
16. This will be easier to cut at room temperature as the top chocolate layer will have hardened
17. You can bypass that difficulty by cutting thru the first layer before it sets too hard
18. Not a problem really if you don't
19. Just not as pretty if the top breaks while cutting it
20. As an alternative
21. You can also use a bundt cake pan
22. Make the peanut butter frosting a little thinner in that case so it drips better
23. Another idea would be to add the chopped peanut butter cups to the cake mix before baking

title: ricotta frittata
steps:
1. Preheat broiler beat eggs with 3 / 4 teaspoon salt and white pepper to taste
2. Stir in cheeses , marjoram and garlic
3. Heat oil and butter in 8- or 10-inch skillet
4. Add egg mixture and lower heat
5. Cook until set , about 12 minutes , then brown under broiler
6. When done , slide frittata onto plate
7. Serves 6

title: molten flourless chocolate cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425
2. Place a saucepan of water on high heat
3. Heat to a boil , then reduce to simmer
4. In a mixing bowl , crack eggs and warm them over simmering water for 1 minute , whisking constantly
5. Remove eggs from heat , and whisk for another minute until eggs are very fluffy
6. Meanwhile , put the chocolate and butter in a large , heatproof , stainless-steel or tempered-glass bowl
7. Set it over the simmering water , making sure the water doesn't touch the bowl
8. Let the chocolate and butter melt
9. Remove from heat
10. Let mixture cool slightly by stirring occasionally , about 5 minutes
11. Once slightly cooled , fold the chocolate and butter into the whipped eggs until no more streaks show
12. Spray 6 ramekins or ovenproof dessert cups with nonstick cooking spray
13. Fill them 3 / 4 of the way full and place on a baking sheet
14. Bake for 10-12 minutes , depending on how gooey you'd like the centers
15. Turn the cakes out onto dessert plates , and serve immediately with a sprinkle of powdered sugar

title: greek lamb brochettes
steps:
1. Cut trimmed lamb into 1 and 1 / 2 inch cubes
2. Mix the lamb and the rest of the ingredients in a glass baking dish
3. Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 and no more than 8 hours , turning the lamb occasionally
4. Preheat broiler or prepare barbecue
5. Divide lamb among six to eight skewers and arrange on grill or broiler pan
6. Paint with marinade
7. Broil to desired doneness , turning occasionally and painting with marinade , 9 minutes for medium rare , 12 minutes for medium to medium well

title: hearty sausage cheesecake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Mix flour and crushed tortilla chips together
3. Pour mixture in the springform pan
4. Add melted butter , mix and press into pan creating a crust
5. Bake for 7 minutes
6. When crust is done baking , allow to cool in freezer for 10 minutes
7. Spray sides of the pan with non-stick cooking spray
8. Preheat oven to 300 degrees
9. Mix cream cheese together with flour , in a mixer on medium speed
10. When flour is nicely incorporated , add egg , reduce speed to low
11. Saute sausage , peppers , onions , ketchup , garlic , and pepper together until sausage is fully cooked
12. Add mixture into cream cheese batter
13. Pour mixture into pan
14. Bake for 30-45 minutes , or until cake shakes very slightly in the center
15. Let cool for 30 minutes , outside of oven
16. Refrigerate for at least 3 hours
17. Enjoy , reheat slightly when serving

title: mushroom vol au vent
steps:
1. If you would rather not make the pastry you can purchase vol au vent shells and can skip the first several steps
2. Roll the pastry out to 1 / 4 inches thick on a well floured board
3. Cut six 3 inches circles with a pastry cutter
4. Make a smaller cut 1 / 4 " inside each case all around but do not cut all the way through
5. Place on ungreased baking tray and chill in the refrigerator for 30 minutes
6. Brush the tops of the cases with the egg and water glaze and bake at 400 degree for 20 minutes or until well risen and golden
7. Cool on a wire rack then carefully remove the lids with a sharp knife and scoop out any uncooked mixture
8. Filling
9. Melt the butter in a skillet and add the sliced mushrooms
10. Cover and cook for 2 minutes
11. Blend in the flour and cook for 1 minute
12. Blend in the milk , bring to a boil then lower to a simmer for 2 minutes
13. Season well with salt and pepper
14. Fill the prepared cases with the filling , replace the lids and return to a 400 degree oven for another 10 - 15 minutes
15. Be careful they do not burn
16. Prep time includes making the shells

title: slow cooked greek style chicken recipe
steps:
1. The first step is to place the chicken in the slow cooker
2. If there are any bones on the meat then you can remove them but it is also okay to leave them in as they will usually come away once the chicken is cooked
3. Mix the olive oil , garlic , lemon juice as well as the preferred amount of oregano , salt and pepper into a large bowl and stir
4. Pour on top of the chicken and stir again
5. Set the cooker on a high heat for approximately 6 hours or on a low heat for 8 to 10 hours
6. Prepare the carrots , broccoli and shallots as well as draining and rinsing the chickpeas and potatoes before adding to the cooker
7. These should be placed in the pot around 1 hour prior to the relevant finish time
8. Make sure the chicken is thoroughly cooked and that all bones are removed
9. Drain off any left over liquid before serving and enjoy

title: brownie points  chewy brownie bites
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 f
2. Melt the butter with the chocolate and the salt
3. You can do this on the stovetop or in the microwave
4. When it has all melted leave it to cool to room temperature
5. In a mixer , combine the sugar with the eggs until fluffy and creamy
6. Beat in the vanilla and add the cooled chocolate mixture
7. Fold in the flour
8. Spray the wells of a mini-muffin pan with non-stick spray or use mini liners
9. Fill each well 3 / 4 of the way full
10. Push on any desired add-ons , like nuts , candied fruit or sprinkles
11. If you are actually following directions and using a mini-muffin pan , then bake for 25 minutes
12. Otherwise , if you've decided to bung this into a square cake pan and bake like regular brownies , then bake for 30-35 minutes
13. Keep in mind that if you make this as you would regular brownies and not as the mini-muffins , they will not be as darling as they are meant to be

title: pulehu tri tip steak
steps:
1. Combine spices and rub into meat
2. Let sit for 30 minutes
3. Broil or grill the steaks , turning every 4 minutes

title: bare cupboards dinner party casseroles
steps:
1. Brown meat in enough oil to keep meat from sticking , about 5 minutes
2. Drain fat
3. Add onions , celery , carrots , and cook another 5 minutes , stirring occasionally
4. Add tomatoes , salt , oregano , pepper , and garlic powder
5. Bring sauce to a boil , then lower the heat , cover , and let simmer for 1 hour
6. Meanwhile , cook your pasta , timing it so that it is ready when the sauce has finished simmering
7. Mix pasta , sauce and spinach all together , then pour into 2 greased 9x13" casseroles
8. Sprinkle each casserole with parmesan cheese and bake at 350 f for about 30 minutes , or until bubbly

title: hearty chicken and rice soup
steps:
1. Combine the fist 8 ingredients in dutch oven or large soup pot
2. Bring to a boil over high heat
3. Stir and reduce heat to low and simmer uncovered 10 to 15 minutes
4. Add chicken and simmer uncovered for 10 more minutes or until the chicken is cooked
5. Remove and discard the bay leaf
6. Stir in the rice and lime just before serving
7. Garnish with lime slices

title: drunk cheesy chicken
steps:
1. Cut a slice into each uncooked chicken breast to make a pocket
2. Stuff each breast with half the cream cheese then wrap with 4 of the rashers of bacon to keep it together
3. Slice up the leeks into fairly large slices and place in a roasting tin
4. Place the breasts in the roasting tin surrounded by the leeks and pour in the white wine until it reaches just under half way up the chicken breasts
5. Cook in a pre heated oven at 200 for 45 minutes but keep an eye on the developing cheese sauce as the wine evaporates quite quickly towards the end of cooking so if your sauce looks too thick for your liking add a little more wine to thin it 10 minutes before it should be done

title: bow tie pasta with artichokes and mushrooms
steps:
1. Prepare pasta according to the package directions
2. Cook until al dente
3. Spray a large skillet with cooking oil spray and heat skillet over high heat
4. Add 1 / 4 cup water and mushrooms
5. "sweat" the mushrooms by covering skillet for 2-3 minutes , or until mushrooms are slightly wilted
6. Add in the artichoke hearts
7. Continue to cook , uncovered , for about 3 minutes or until most of the liquid is gone
8. Cut the cream cheese into several pieces
9. Add to the skillet with 1 cup water or the reserved liquid from the canned artichokes plus enough water to make 1 cup
10. Using a wooden spoon , gently stir and smooth the sauce while if comes to a simmer
11. Add in the lemon juice and pepper
12. Add more water if needed to bring sauce to a medium consistency
13. Also may add salt to taste
14. Drain pasta when it is done
15. Add pasta and sauce to a serving bowl
16. Mix well
17. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese , wheat germ , and parsley
18. Serve right away

title: cheat steak subs  ground beef subs  whiz with
steps:
1. Sweat onion with a sprinkle of kosher salt and some olive oil
2. When onion is tender , add ground beef and garlic and brown
3. After beef has browned , add stock and worcestershire
4. Simmer until liquid is absorbed
5. Grind black pepper over beef mixture to taste
6. While beef is simmering , microwave velveeta and milk to make "whiz"
7. Whisk until smooth
8. Place sub roll over beef mixture to warm and soak up some juice
9. Spread with mayo and ketchup
10. Top with beef , "whiz" , and lettuce

title: whipped celery potatoes
steps:
1. Combine potatoes , water , and 1 teaspoon salt in a large saucepan , and bring to a boil
2. Cover and simmer 30 to 35 minutes or until tender , and drain potatoes
3. Cool 5 minutes
4. Peel and place potatoes in a large mixing bowl
5. Melt 2 tablespoons butter in a skillet
6. Add celery and onion
7. Cook , stirring constantly , 3 to 4 minutes , or until tender
8. Add to potatoes
9. Beat at low speed with an electric mixer until potatoes are mashed
10. Add remaining ingredients , and beat at high speed until whipped
11. Serve immediately

title: killer spaghetti sauce
steps:
1. Add to spaghetti sauce the onion , bell pepper , veggies , olive oil , basil , oregano , marjoram , celery seed , bay leaves , garlic , salt , cayenne pepper , black pepper , and tomato
2. Place on low heat , covered , about 30 minutes , till it bubbles
3. Add ketchup and tobasco
4. Immediately reduce heat to simmer
5. Keep it covered
6. After 2 hours , remove bay leaves , add parmesan cheese
7. Stir it in well
8. After 2 and 1 / 2 hours , brown ground chuck
9. Brown it well done , almost crunchy
10. Drain it well , on paper , and add it to the sauce , with about 40 minutes remaining
11. Stir it in well
12. Keep it covered
13. Takes 4 hours , but it's worth the wait
14. World acclaimed
15. Enjoy

title: smartie cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. Cream butter and both sugars until light and fluffy
3. Add egg and vanilla , beat till smooth
4. Stir in flour , soda and salt , blend well
5. Gently fold in smarties
6. Drop by teaspoon onto ungreased cookie sheet 2" apart
7. Bake 8- 10 minutes

title: shrimp with chipotle sauce
steps:
1. Chipotle dry rub:
2. Shell , clean , and devein shrimp
3. Leave the tails on
4. Pat dry with a paper towel
5. In a medium-size bowl , mix oregano , thyme , lemon pepper , salt , and black pepper
6. Toss shrimp thoroughly with mixed spices
7. Keep refrigerated until ready for cooking
8. Heat oil and chipotle pepper and sauce in a well-seasoned iron skillet or non-stick pan over high heat
9. Place about ten shrimp in pan so that each one has enough room to lie on its side
10. Cook for approximately 1-1 / 2 minutes per side , or until shrimp is no longer translucent
11. Do not overcook
12. Serve hot , or at room temperature , with cilantro dipping sauce
13. To prepare cilantro dipping sauce:
14. Blend cilantro and lime juice in a food processor or blender until cilantro is liquefied
15. Pour into a small bowl and use a fork to blend in sour cream until fully blended into a pale green sauce
16. Refrigerate until ready for use

title: cat head biscuits with sawmill gravy
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f lightly coat a baking sheet with cooking spray
2. Set aside
3. For the biscuits , in a medium bowl , gently stir together the 3 cups flour , the buttermilk , and butter until the dough just comes together
4. On a floured surface , pat the dough into a 1 1 / 2-inch-thick round
5. Cut the dough into six 4-inch circles
6. Transfer to the baking sheet
7. Bake about 25 mintues or until golden brown
8. For the gravy , in a large skillet , cook the sausage over medium heat until brown , breaking meat up with a fork as it cooks
9. Using a slotted spoon , transfer sausage to a paper towel-lined plate to drain
10. Pour off all but 2 tablespoons fat from the skillet
11. Heat the remaining fat over medium heat and whisk in the 4 1 / 2 tablespoons flour
12. Cook and stir for 2 minutes
13. Slowly whisk in the milk
14. Increase heat to medium-high and simmer about 3 minutes or until thickened
15. Stir in the sausage , pepper , and salt
16. To serve , split the biscuits and top with generous spoonfuls of gravy

title: garlic prime rib
steps:
1. Place the roast in a roasting pan with the fatty side up
2. Loosen the fat from the meat by cutting with a sharp knife
3. In a small bowl , mix together the garlic , olive oil , salt , pepper and thyme
4. Spread the mixture under the fatty side and over it as well
5. Secure with kitchen twine
6. Let the roast sit out at room temperature , no longer than one hour
7. Preheat the oven to 500 degrees
8. Bake the roast in the preheated oven for 20 minutes , then reduce the oven temperature to 325 and continue roasting for an additional 60 to 75 minutes
9. The internal temperature of the roast should be at 145 degrees f for medium rare
10. Allow the roast to rest for 10 to 15 minutes before carving so the meat can retain its juices

title: japanese cucumber salad
steps:
1. Slice cucumbers very thin
2. Soak a few minutes in salt water , drain and squeeze
3. Mix the remaining ingredients together and marinate cucumbers in the sauce for at least 15 minutes
4. Serve sprinkled with sesame seeds to taste

title: pork wraps
steps:
1. Slice pork chops , bell pepper and onion into thin strips
2. Start browning the pork chops in a large skillet with 1 tbl oil for about 3 minutes over medium high heat , stirring often
3. Add veggies and continue to saute the three until the veggies are starting to be tender crisp and the pork is cooked
4. Add barbecue sauce and sautee a few more minutes until all are coated well with barbecue sauce and barbecue sauce starts to thicken slightly
5. Warm tortillas in a microwave
6. Divide filling among warmed tortillas
7. Tuck in bottom and roll and tuck in sides to creat an enclosed wrapper open at one end

title: delish  strawberry fruit salad like no other
steps:
1. Bowl 1: combine drained peaches , frozen strawberries , sliced bananas , and pineapples
2. Mix together
3. Bowl 2: combine pineapple juice , pudding , and tang
4. Stir together and then add to bowl 1
5. Refrigerate until served

title: medium hot enchilada sauce
steps:
1. Put all ingredients into a 2 quart saucepan and simmer , stirring frequently , until slightly thick and smooth
2. Remove from heat and use to make your favorite enchiladas

title: divinely creamy low fat fettuccine alfredo
steps:
1. Cook the fettuccine according to package directions , omitting salt if desired
2. Drain , reserving 1 / 4 cup of the cooking water
3. Place the pasta in a serving bowl and keep warm
4. Meanwhile , melt the butter in a medium nonstick skillet
5. Add the flour and cook , stirring constantly , until the mixture becomes straw-colored and fragrant , about 45 seconds , then remove from the heat and whisk in the milk
6. Return the pan to the stove , raise the heat to medium-high , and continue cooking , whisking constantly , until slightly thickened , about 2 minutes
7. Add the reserved cooking water , the cheese , the lemon juice and nutmeg
8. Stir until just smooth
9. Pour over the hot pasta , toss gently to coat , and serve at once

title: coconut custard
steps:
1. Beat coconut milk , eggs and sugar together until sugar dissolves and mixture is well blended
2. Sieve through cheesecloth so mixture is fine and smooth
3. Pour into serving bowl
4. Place serving bowl inside steamer
5. Steam until firm - time varies depending serving size

title: roast chicken leftover soup
steps:
1. Preheat oven to gas mark 6 , get out a nice tray with a rack to rest your chicken on
2. Take your chicken drumsticks and spray them with a little olive oil
3. Sprinkle with some lemon zest and juice
4. Put the squished half of lemon underneath the chicken on the rack so the flavour imparts into the chicken
5. I like to sprinkle a little salt onto the chicken as well
6. Put it in the oven on gas mark 6 for 30-35 minutes until it's done and juicy
7. Leave to rest for 10 minutes
8. After 10 minutes , peel of the skin and feed to husband , to yourself , or throw in the bin , depending if you're on a diet or not
9. Chuck your drumsticks into a big pan
10. Cover with the water and some salt and a pinch of the herbs
11. Cover and boil for about 40 minutes
12. If you can't be bothered doing this step as you don't have leftover chicken , just use some stock cubes or concentrate
13. I was feeling particularly cookin that day , hence making the stock
14. Pull out the skin with some tongs and strain the liquid if the chicken has fallen apart removing any bony or gristle bits
15. Keep the liquid to one side as this is your stock
16. Strip the chicken off the bones using a fork and discard the bones
17. Put chicken to one side
18. In the same big pan heat the olive oil and throw in the onions and garlic
19. Fry for about 5 minutes and then add the other veggies , giving it a good stir
20. Pour over the stock
21. Add the chicken , the wine and the spices and sugar
22. Bring to the boil and simmer for 30 minutes
23. I like to add an extra stock cube in as well , but this is up to you depending on how chickeny you want it
24. Before serving , squeeze over the remainder of lemon juice
25. Serve with chunky bread and feel very pleased with yourself

title: homestyle tuna salad sandwich
steps:
1. Drain tuna fish and put in mixing bowl
2. Add in celery , onion , mayo , mustard , relish and pepper
3. Spread tuna salad on bread
4. Top with tomato slices and lettuce
5. Enjoy !

title: zucchini casserole that even  foodies  will love
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degree
2. Mix all ingredients in very large bowl until well blended
3. Place in large casserole dish
4. Bake covered for 1 hr
5. , 15 minutes
6. Remove foil and bake for an additional 15 minutes or until golden brown

title: baked chicken with dumplings and rice
steps:
1. Prepare the chicken for baking
2. Season each piece with the morton's seasoning
3. Place the breasts in a 13 x9 baking pan
4. Pour the cream of mushroom soup over the chicken along with two cans of water
5. Cover and bake at 350
6. In a mixing bowl , add 2 cups of bisquick and 2 / 3 cup of milk
7. Mix together to form a dough
8. Boil 3 cups of chicken broth and add a spoonful of dumpling dough
9. When the broth cooked out , i added water so they wouldnt burn
10. Leave on a low heat till chicken is done
11. About 20 minutes before the chicken is ready , boil the water for rice
12. Once boiling , add 2 cups of rice
13. Enjoy !

title: lattice top chicken
steps:
1. Combine soup , milk , seasoned salt , chicken , veggies , 1 / 2 of the cheese , and 1 / 2 can french fried onions
2. Place mixture in 8x12 baking dish
3. Bake covered at 375 degrees for 20 minutes
4. Unwrap rolls , separate into 2 rectangles
5. Press together perforated cuts
6. Cut each rectangle lengthwise into 3 strips
7. Place strips on casserole to form lattice top
8. Bake uncovered 15 minutes longer
9. Top lattice with remaining cheese and onions
10. Bake uncovered 3-5 minutes or until onions are golden brown

title: junior s pound cake
steps:
1. Place a rack in the middle of the oven and preheat the oven to 325
2. Butter 2 loaf pans , then line the bottoms with parchment or wax paper
3. Sift the cake flour , baking powder , salt , and nutmeg together into a medium-size bowl and set aside
4. Cream the butter and shortening in a large bowl with an electric mixer on high until light yellow , about 5 minutes
5. Then , while the mixer is still running , add the sugar , about 1 / 2 cup at a time , beating 1 to 2 minutes after each addition
6. Now add the eggs , one at a time , beating 3 minutes after adding each one
7. Beat the batter until it is light yellow , airy , and starts crawling up the sides of the bowl , a total of about 35 minutes in all
8. Beat in the vanilla
9. Sift about one fourth of the flour mixture over the batter and stir it in by hand , then stir in one third of the milk
10. Repeat by adding one-quarter more flour , one third more milk , another one fourth of the flour , then the rest of the milk
11. Finally , stir in the rest of the flour
12. Stir after each addition until the ingredients are well incorporated
13. Gently spoon half of the batter into each loaf pan
14. Set the 2 pans side by side in the oven , making sure they are not touching each other
15. Bake the cakes until the tops are golden and the center of each cake springs back when you touch it lightly and a toothpick inserted in the center comes out with moist crumbs clinging to it , about 1 hour
16. Let the cakes cool on a wire rack for 30 minutes before removing them from the pans

title: halloween brain dip
steps:
1. Wash cauliflower
2. Cut florets from the top of the cauliflower until you have a cauliflower 'bowl'
3. Remove greens from bottom
4. Cut stems from radishes , leave the root which will look like an optic nerve , and remove skin but leave a little to resemble blood shot eyes / veins
5. Hollow out the cut end of the radish with the
6. Use a toothpick to hold everything together
7. Line your "bowl" with aluminum foil or a clear cling wrap so dip doesn't escape
8. Fill cauliflower with dip , garnish with radish 'eyes' , pepper nose and onion mouth , and serve with veggies and crackers

title: madeira cake
steps:
1. Reserve 1 tablespoon of the poppy seeds for garnish , if desired
2. Grease a 10-inch bundt pan or spray with non-stick cooking spray
3. Mix the cake mix , pudding mix , eggs , oil , wine and poppy seeds in a large bowl
4. Beat 3 minutes
5. Pour batter into prepared pan
6. Bake at 350 degrees for 40-55 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the middle of the cake comes out clean
7. Do not overbake - start testing at 40 minutes
8. Let the cake cool in the pan , then invert onto a serving plate
9. Dust with confectioner's sugar and sprinkle with reserved poppy seeds if desired

title: bacon  egg  and cheddar cups  ww
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350-degrees f
2. Place 1 slice bacon in each of four custard cups
3. Pour eggs over bacon and top with tomatoes , croutons and cheddar
4. Place cups on baking sheet and bake for 20 minutes or until eggs are set
5. Garnish with the parsley

title: green feta dip
steps:
1. Mix the pesto and the oil together
2. Crumble the feta into your dip bowl
3. Pour over the pesto mix
4. Toss it around with a metal spoon
5. Cover and refrigerate

title: walnut and rosemary oven fried chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425
2. Combine buttermilk and mustard in a shallow dish , stirring with a whisk
3. Add chicken to buttermilk mixture , turning to coat
4. Heat a small skillet over medium-high heat
5. Add panko to pan
6. Cook 3 minutes or until golden , stirring frequently
7. Combine panko , nuts , and next 4 ingredients in a shallow dish
8. Remove chicken from buttermilk mixture
9. Discard buttermilk mixture
10. Dredge chicken in panko mixture
11. Arrange a wire rack on a large baking sheet
12. Coat rack with cooking spray
13. Arrange chicken on rack
14. Coat chicken with cooking spray
15. Bake at 425 for 13 minutes or until chicken is done
16. Garnish with rosemary leaves , if desired

title: roasted garlic chicken with rosemary
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Chop 2 cloves garlic from 1 head , reserve cut off top third of all 3 garlic heads and discard
3. Grate 2 tsp zest from lemon
4. Cut lemon in half
5. Combine chopped garlic& zest with 1 tbsp butter , chopped rosemary , 1 / 4 tsp salt& 1 / 4 tsp pepper
6. Separate chicken skin from breast
7. Spread butter mixture over breast meat , place lemon halves , 1 garlic head and rosemary sprigs in cavity
8. Spread remaining butter over skin
9. Sprinkle with 1 / 4 tsp salt& 1 / 4 tsp pepper
10. Place chicken on rack in roasting pan
11. Add remaining garlic heads to roasting pan
12. Roast for about 2 hrs or until juices run clear when pierced with fork
13. Transfer to serving platter
14. Let stand 10 minutes before carving meanwhile , place broth in bowl
15. Stir in flour& remaining salt& pepper
16. Reserve place roasting pan over two burners on high
17. Add wine , cook stirring constantly about 1 minute
18. Add broth mixture
19. Cook stirring constantly until thickened
20. 2-3 minutes
21. Remove from heat
22. Strain if necessary
23. Serve chicken with gravy
24. Serve roasted garlic cloves from heads with chicken

title: garlic pizza
steps:
1. Allow pizza dough to be in the refrigerator for at least one day so it will be defrosted
2. Allow pizza dough to sit out for 30 minutes
3. Combine margarine , 2 tbsp
4. Parmesan cheese and garlic powder
5. Brush margarine mixture onto pizza dough using a pastry brush , allow for about 1 inch for crust
6. Sprinkle w / extra parmesan cheese , if desired
7. Bake at 400 degrees f for 10 minutes or until cooked through

title: whole wheat overnight yeasted waffles
steps:
1. 1
2. Heat the milk in the microwave until warm
3. Stir in the melted butter
4. 2
5. Whisk together the flour , sugar , yeast , cinnamon , and salt in a large bowl
6. Gradually whisk in warm milk and butter until smooth
7. Whisk in the eggs and vanilla until incorporated
8. Scrape down sides of bowl , cover and refrigerate 12-24 hours
9. Heat the waffle iron
10. When the iron is hot , remove batter from refrigerator and whisk to recombine and deflate
11. Spread the correct amount of batter onto waffle iron and cook until golden brown , about 3-4 minutes
12. Repeat with remaining batter or put batter in fridge to use again the next day
13. Mine usually lasts about 3 days

title: shrimp and chorizo paella
steps:
1. Heat a dutch oven over medium heat
2. Add chorizo and cook until fat begins to render
3. Add garlic and saute until fragrant
4. Add saffron , rice and broth , cover pot and bring to a boil
5. Reduce heat and cook at a gentle simmer for 30 minutes
6. Stir in diced tomatoes and juice , cover pot and continue to cook another 25 minutes
7. Season shrimp with salt and pepper
8. Stir shrimp and peas into mixture , adding more broth if rice appears dry
9. Cover , and continue to cook until shrimp are coked through and rice is tender
10. Allow paella to rest for 5 minutes
11. Fluff rice with fork and serve

title: white chocolate amaretto cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Lightly oil a 10 inch non-stick bundt pan
3. In a large bowl , combine cake mix , eggs , pudding mix , 1 / 2 cup of cold water , oil , 1 / 2 cup amaretto and 1 / 4 teaspoon almond extract
4. Blend well for approximately 3 minutes
5. Pour batter into prepared 10 inch bundt pan
6. Bake at 350 degrees f for 45 minutes to an hour , or until a toothpick inserted into the center of the cake comes out clean
7. Remove cake from oven , and use an ice pick or skewer to make as many holes as possible into the cake
8. Apply glaze while cake is still warm
9. Slowly and patiently drizzle glaze over cake , including the edges and center of bundt pan
10. Allow cake to cool in the pan for at least 2 hours
11. To make the glaze: combine butter , sugar , 1 / 4 cup water , and 1 / 2 cup amaretto in a saucepan
12. Bring to a boil , and continue to boil for 10 minutes , stirring constantly
13. Topping: lightly toast slivered almonds in the oven
14. This will take 5 to 10 minutes
15. Stir frequently and be careful not to burn
16. Heat 1 / 4 cup of the prepared frosting in the microwave for 10 seconds , to soften
17. Place the cake on serving dish and use a spoon to drizzle the softened frosting over the cake
18. Scatter toasted almonds over cake before frosting cools

title: risotto bravo
steps:
1. Bring wine to a boil in a small saucepan
2. Stir in dried mushrooms
3. Remove from heat and set aside
4. Bring chicken broth to a boil in a large saucepan
5. Cover , reduce heat to low , and keep warm
6. Saute onion in olive oil in a dutch oven over medium heat , stirring constantly , until tender
7. Add minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds
8. Add rice
9. Cook , stirring constantly , 2 minutes
10. Add 1 cup reserved chicken broth
11. Cook over medium high heat , stirring constantly , until most of the liquid is absorbed
12. Continue adding the chicken broth , 1 cup at a time , and cook , stirring constantly , until 4 cups of the chicken broth have been added and absorbed
13. Add reserved mushroom mixture , chicken , and tomatoes
14. Continue adding chicken broth , 1 cup at a time , and cook , stirring constantly , until the mixture is creamy and the rice is tender
15. Stir in salt and pepper to taste
16. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese
17. Serve immediately

title: paprika spiced italian meatballs
steps:
1. Put the minced beef in a bowl
2. Add breadcrumbs , parmesan cheese , tasty cheese , eggs , paprika , nutmeg , herbs , onion , garlic , bacon , salt and pepper
3. Mash up and mix well with wet hands
4. Divide the mixture into equal portions and roll each into a ball
5. Place the meatballs into a baking dish , put diced carrot , celery and capsicum in as well
6. Pour over the can of crushed tomatoes
7. Sprinkle with cheese then dried herbs
8. Bake in oven for 40- 50 minutes at 180 degrees

title: banana strawberry muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Line 12 muffin cups with paper baking cups
3. Combine sugar , oil and eggs and blend well
4. Stir in bananas and vanilla
5. Lightly spoon flour into measuring cup and level off
6. Add flour , baking soda and salt to sugar mixture and stir just until combined
7. Stir in strawberries
8. Spoon batter evenly into lined muffin cups
9. Bake for 17 to 21 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
10. Immediately remove from muffin cups

title: brownie bites
steps:
1. In a medium-size pan , place butter and chocolate and heat over low heat
2. Stir occasionally until melted and smooth
3. Remove pan from heat and stir in sugar and vanilla
4. Add eggs , one at a time , stirring well after each addition
5. Stir in flour
6. Spoon batter into mini muffin pan sprayed with cooking spray , filling almost to the top
7. You can use mini muffin paper liners in the pan instead if you want
8. Place a walnut half on the top of each brownie
9. Bake in a 325 oven for about 20 minutes or until brownies look dry and feel firm to the touch
10. I do these in my convection oven and it takes about 15 minutes
11. Let cool in pans for about 10 minutes then transfer to wire rack to cool completely
12. Store in an airtight container

title: sauteed zucchini with oregano and feta
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat
2. Add zucchini and oregano
3. Saute until zucchini is golden brown , about 4-6 minutes
4. Remove skillet from heat and add parsley
5. Toss to combine
6. Season to taste with salt and pepper
7. Sprinkle feta cheese over top just before serving
8. Yields about 1 / 2 cup per serving

title: macadamia nut mocha
steps: 1. Combine ingredients in a 360ml mug

title: turkey verde
steps:
1. Place turkey in 3 1 / 2 to 4-qt slow cooker
2. Mix salsa , onion , garlic , broth and cumin
3. Pour over turkey
4. Cover and cook on low 8-10 hours , or until center of turkey is no longer pink when cut
5. Remove turkey from cooker , place on cutting board
6. Cut turkey into slices , serve with sauce and tortillas

title: smoky apple butter county ribs
steps:
1. Sprinkle ribs with salt and pepper
2. In 3 1 / 2 to 4 quart slow cooker , place ribs
3. Cover with onion slices
4. In small bowl , mix remaining ingredients , pour over ribs and onions
5. Cover , cook on low heat for 8 to 10 hours
6. Remove ribs from cooker , place on serving platter
7. Cover to keep warm
8. Pour juices from cooker through strainer into 1 quart saucepan
9. Heat to boiling over medium-high hfeat
10. Reduce heat to medium
11. Cook about 5 minutes or until sauce has slightly thickened
12. Serve sauce with ribs

title: granola nut protein bar
steps:
1. In a double boiler , warm the peanut butter and honey to a smooth consistency
2. This step can be done in the microwave as well--just heat both ingredients for 70 to 90 seconds
3. In a mixing bowl , stir together all remaining dry ingredients
4. Pour in the peanut-butter mixture and stir until completely combined
5. Spread uniformly into a brownie pan
6. Slice into 12 to 16 pieces , then wrap each piece in plastic wrap
7. Refrigerate or freeze before cutting if mixture does not seem to be hard enough
8. Each granola nut protein bar costs 25 to 35 cents to make , as opposed to 99 cents and up for store-bought energy bars
9. On top of that , if you do use organic ingredients , you won't believe the difference !

title: roast cauliflower with almond  pomegranate seeds and tahini sauc
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 410f
2. Place head of cauliflower sideways on a large cutting board , and start slicing about 1 / 2 inch slices across the top
3. There will be a mess of tiny florets everywhere , that's okay
4. When you reach the core , slice the sides of the cauliflower in the same manner
5. Chop any large florets into smaller bits
6. Discard the core
7. Drizzle olive oil over a large baking sheet
8. Add all the cauliflower to the baking sheet , drizzle with a bit more olive oil and roll around so that cauliflower is coated
9. Season well with sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
10. Roast cauliflower for 16-35 minutes , until browned in spots and large pieces of cauliflower are tender when poked with a knife
11. Meanwhile , while cauliflower is roasting , place raisins in a bowl and pour boiling water over the cover
12. Let sit to plump
13. Toast almonds in a skillet until lightly browned and fragrant
14. Transfer cauliflower to a serving bowl
15. Drain raisins , and add raisins and almonds to cauliflower , stirring to mix
16. Drizzle tahini sauce including the garlic option over top
17. Sprinkle pomegranate seeds over top
18. Serve warm or at room temperature
19. Enjoy !

title: lentils vegetable soup
steps:
1. Saut the onions , carrots , celery with olive oil by gradually adding half cup of water until soft
2. Add to the saut onions , diced tomatoes , hot red pepper powder and stir for five minutes
3. Add 3 cups of water , leave it to boil
4. Rinse the lentils with cold water
5. To the boiling sauce , add lentils , ginger juice , white pepper and two cups of vegetable broth
6. Reduce the heat to medium
7. Cook for 30 minutes or until the lentils are very soft
8. Using a cooking stick , puree the soup in its pot or transfer to a food processor , blend the lentils until smooth
9. And bring it back to its saucepan
10. Add the rest of the vegetable broth or water as need
11. Then in a lower heat stir the soup for 10 minutes
12. Add salt and black pepper
13. Remove from heat
14. Garnish it with fresh parsley , basil or cheese of your choice
15. Serve it hot or cold
16. Keep it in the fridge

title: ham   potato casserole
steps:
1. Peel and slice potatoes , carrots , and onion
2. Mix ham cubes with vegetables
3. Spray 11x14 baking dish with pam
4. Put vegetables in dish
5. Mix soups and milk with a wire whisk
6. When smooth add to vegetables and ham
7. Mix well then sprinkle with salt& pepper
8. You may cover the top with sliced velveeta cheese if you prefer
9. Cover with aluminum foil and bake 1 hour at 350 or until vegetables are tender
10. This way the ham is always tender and has it's own natural juices
11. I mix the juices with the soups

title: turkey bacon avocado sandwich
steps:
1. Spread the mayonnaise on one side of both slices of toasted bread
2. Top a bread slice with provolone cheese , turkey , bacon , tomato , and lettuce
3. Sprinkle with black pepper , if desired
4. Place the remaining bread slice on top , slice in half , and serve

title: russian garlic side dish
steps:
1. Blanch the garlic in boiling water for 6minutes
2. Remove and plunge into cold water
3. Drain well and add remaining ingredients to the garlic , mix well
4. Marinate in the fridge for 5-7 days before serving

title: authentic lumpia
steps:
1. Mix all well in a large bowl
2. If you can find lumpia wrappers from an oriental store , these work best
3. Allow mix to sit for a while
4. Put a small amount of mixture into middle of wrapper and roll up and fold in the edges
5. Wet down with a little water
6. Fry until golden brown
7. Serve with sweet and sour or some crushed garlic with vinegar

title: no roll coconut milk pie crust
steps:
1. Mix ingredients together with a fork until just blended
2. Do not over mix
3. Do not use a mixer
4. Dough should be soft but not sticky
5. If it is too stiff add more coconut milk
6. If it is too loose add a little more flour
7. Since this is pressed it is more moist than rolled pie dough
8. Press into 9 inch pie pan evenly
9. I start with the sides and work toward the center
10. Crimp the edges when you are done to make it pretty
11. If you need it cooked
12. Poke with a fork all around to keep it from getting air bubbles
13. Bake at 375 for about 15 minutes or until golden brown
14. I often freeze them in the pan when i am using them for fruit pies so the filling cooks without the crust burning or getting soggy

title: rosemary roasted pork loin
steps:
1. Directions
2. Pound garlic , rosemary , sage , and pepper with pestle in mortar until paste forms
3. Alternatively , puree ingredients in mini food processsor
4. Mix in oil
5. Place pork in baking dish
6. Spread herb mixture all over pork
7. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours
8. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
9. Place pork fat side up , on rack set in heavy roasting pan
10. Drape pancetta strips crosswise over pork
11. Roast until thermometer inserted into center of pork registers 160 degrees f for medium doneness , about 1 hour
12. Remove fromoven
13. Let stand 5 minutes
14. Discard pancetta strips
15. Cut pork crosswise into 1 / 3 - inch thick slices
16. Arrange pork slices on platter
17. Garnish with rosemary sprigs
18. If desired , and serve

title: greek green beans  sketa fassoula
steps:
1. Wash and string the beans , but leave them whole
2. In a large , deep skillet , heat olive oil until hot
3. Add the onion and saute for about 5 minutes until it is tender , but not brown
4. Add the green beans
5. Cover the skillet
6. Cook for about 15 minutes or until the beans start to wilt
7. Coarsely chop two of the tomatoes
8. Add to the pan and cover again
9. Cook for another 15-20 minutes until the tomatoes have melted into a sauce
10. Taste and add salt and pepper as needed
11. If necessary add another one or two chopped tomatoes and continue cooking
12. You may need to add extra olive oil also as it contributes to the flavor
13. Cook until the beans are very tender
14. Trust me , crunchy does not work with this dish
15. Serve hot , cold , or at room temperature
16. If you can find good , creamy feta , crumble a good chunk into the beans before serving

title: cinnamon roll icing
steps:
1. Heat cream cheese and butter in a small microwavable bowl for about 30 seconds watch closely
2. Once softened , stir to combine
3. Add powdered sugar about 1 / 4 cup at a time
4. Add vanilla , milk , and last bit of powdered sugar and stir to combine well
5. Add more milk for a thinner consistency and more sugar for a thicker consistency
6. Spread / pour over hot rolls

title: creamy mustard chicken   light
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Place chiken in single layer in lightly greased , oven-proof casserole
3. Combine yogurt , mayonnaise , onions , mustard and seasonings
4. Spoon sauce over each chicken piece
5. Bake in 350f oven for about 45 minutes , or until chicken is tender
6. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese and brown under the broiler

title: magic chicken noodle soup
steps:
1. In a large soup put melt butter over high heat add onions , carrots and celery
2. Season with salt and pepper
3. Saute over high heat until slightly softened , about five to eight minutes
4. Add corn , broth and all seasonings
5. Stir and bring to a boil
6. Add egg noodles and cook until noodles are almost done
7. Add in chicken and continue to cook until egg noodles are done and chicken is heated through
8. Serve alone or as we like it with grilled cheese sandwiches !

title: cukes and onions  cucumbers and onions
steps:
1. In a bowl , combine mayonnaise , sugar , vinegar and salt
2. Add cucumbers and onions
3. Stir to coat
4. Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours

title: extra special ham sandwich  inspired by starbucks ham and brie
steps:
1. To assemble the sandwich , split the french baguette lengthwise , but not all the way through , so that there's a "hinge" on one side
2. Spread desired amount of honey mustard on both sides
3. Pile on the sliced black forest ham
4. Sprinkle with desired amount of dried cherries
5. Close up the two sides of the sandwich , and eat
6. :)

title: luchow hot potato salad with bacon aka speck salat
steps:
1. Same amount of boullion may be used for stock
2. Scrub potatoes , rinse
3. Boil in jackets
4. Let cool
5. Peel and cut into 1 / 4 slices
6. Cook bacon until crisp
7. Add the onion and stir until transparent
8. Add the vinegar , stock and seasonings
9. Stir
10. Let come to a boil
11. Stir in the egg
12. Remove from heat and pour over potatoes
13. Servings 2 to 4
14. Time to make is a guess

title: rich irish cream truffles
steps:
1. In a 2-quart saucepan over medium , heat whipping cream
2. Add vanilla extract and salt
3. Stir in half of the bittersweet chocolate and half milk chocolate with a whisk until melted
4. Stir in the yolks , cooking over low heat
5. Stir often until lightly thickened
6. Remove from heat
7. Stir in remaining chocolate and the liqueur until chocolate is melted
8. Cover and refrigerate until mixture is firm enough to shape
9. In medium shallow bowl , sift in cocoa
10. By rounded tbsp , drop chocolate mixture into cocoa , rolling to coat
11. Form into balls and roll in cocoa again
12. Carefully put onto tray
13. Refrigerate until firm

title: cheesy bacon carrots
steps:
1. Combine carrots , margarine , cheddar and bacon in a saucepan
2. Heat until cheese melts
3. Add salt and pepper to taste

title: southwest barley salad
steps:
1. In a saucepan over high heat , bring the stock to a boil
2. Add barley
3. Reduce heat to medium low
4. Simmer , covered , 40 minutes or until barley is tender and liquid is absorbed
5. Transfer to a serving bowl
6. Cool to room temperature
7. Add corn , black beans , peppers , green onions and mix well
8. In a bowl , combine the dressing ingredients and mix well
9. Pour dressing over salad
10. Toss to coat well and serve

title: pepper cheese breadsticks  bread machine
steps:
1. Add the first 9 ingredients to a 1-1 / 2-2 pound bread machine according to the manufacturer's direction
2. Select the dough cycle
3. When the cycle is complete remove the dough , punch down and let rest for 10 minutes
4. Divide the dough into thirds
5. On a lightly floured surface roll each portion into a 14x10-inch rectangle
6. Using a pizza cutter or a sharp knife , cut the dough lengthwise into 1 / 2-inch wide strips
7. For each breadstick pick up 2 strips together and twist several times
8. Press ends together
9. Place the breadstick dough about 1 / 2-inch apart on a greased baking sheet
10. Stir the egg and water together , then brush onto the breadsticks
11. Sprinkle with pepper , salt or cheese
12. Bake in a 400f oven for about 10-12 minutes or until golden brown
13. Remove from baking sheet , then cool on wire racks

title: pistachio mousse brownie torte
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f
2. Lightly spray bottom of 2 round cake pans with non-stick cooking spray
3. Line bottoms of pans with cooking parchment paper
4. Lightly spray paper with cooking spray
5. In large bowl , stir brownie mix , oil , water and eggs 50 strokes with spoon
6. Spread half of batter evenly in each pan
7. Bake 27 to 30 minutes or until toothpick inserted 2 inches from edge of pan comes out clean
8. Cool in pans on cooling racks 10 minutes
9. Run knife around edge of pans to loosen
10. Place cooling rack upside down on 1 pan
11. Turn rack and pan over
12. Remove pan and parchment paper
13. Repeat with second brownie layer
14. Place racks with brownie layers in refrigerator to cool completely , about 20 minutes
15. Meanwhile , measure 1 tablespoon of the pudding mix
16. Reserve for garnish
17. In large bowl , beat remaining pudding mix , the milk and 1 cup whipping cream with electric mixer on high speed about 2 minutes or until mixture is thick and creamy
18. Stir in nuts
19. Cover
20. Refrigerate
21. Carefully cut each brownie layer horizontally in half , using long serrated knife , to make 4 layers
22. On serving plate , place 1 brownie layer , cut side down
23. Spread 1 / 3 of the mousse evenly to edge of brownie
24. Repeat layering twice , using 2 brownie layers and remaining mousse
25. Top with remaining brownie layer , cut side down
26. Refrigerate torte while making glaze
27. In 1-quart saucepan , heat 1 / 2 cup whipping cream over medium heat , stirring occasionally , just until bubbles start to form at edge of saucepan
28. Remove from heat
29. Add chocolate
30. Stir constantly until smooth
31. Stir in vanilla and corn syrup
32. Remove from heat
33. Let stand 10 minutes
34. Stir glaze
35. Spoon over top of torte , allowing some to run down side
36. Return torte to refrigerator while making garnish
37. In medium bowl , beat 1 / 2 cup whipping cream , the powdered sugar and reserved 1 tablespoon pudding mix on high speed until stiff peaks form
38. Spoon mixture into decorating bag fitted with star
39. Refrigerate at least 30 minutes before serving
40. Cover and refrigerate any remaining torte

title: puerto rican stewed beans   habichuelas guisadas
steps:
1. Add olive oil and add sofrito heat through for 1 minute
2. Add olives , beans , sazon packet , tomato sauce and cook for 1 minute
3. Add water
4. Cook for 20-25 minutes at medium heat , you want bean stew to thicken slightly
5. Serve with yellow or white rice

title: sesame delight
steps:
1. Stir together the lime juice , honey and tahini in a shaker
2. Add the rum and ice , shake and pour into a martini glass

title: tomatoes with feta cheese
steps:
1. Arrange tomato slices on a serving plate
2. Sprinkle with feta cheese and drizzle with vinegar
3. Sprinkle with basil and pepper

title: cilantro mustard mayo  dip or sauce
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together
2. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour up to 3 days

title: hearts of palm spread
steps:
1. Drain hearts of palm and chop finely
2. (one of those zyliss choppers come in handy here) save 1 t green onion and 1 t parmesan for garnish
3. Mix hearts of palm with the rest of the ingredients
4. Spread mixture into a medium-sized baking dish
5. Garnish with cheese and onion
6. Bake at 350f until hot and bubbly , about 20 minutes
7. Pop under the broiler to brown
8. Serve with bread or crackers

title: solo spam puff
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Put the butter into a single serving oven proof dish and place in oven until the butter is melted
3. Dice the spam and mix with all the remaining ingredients , being sure to stir out most of the lumps
4. Pour into the dish and bake for 20 minutes

title: polish pork chops with sauerkraut
steps:
1. In a large heavy skillet heat oil to medium high and brown the chops on both sides
2. Remove from pan
3. To the pan add the onions and garlic
4. Reduce heat to medium and cook onions until translucent
5. Season with salt and pepper
6. Add the bay leaf and the drained sauerkraut
7. Arrange chops on top
8. Pour the stock over top , bring to a slow boil and cook for 15 minutes
9. Peel , core and dice the apple
10. Add to the pan with the cumin seeds and stir well , simmering for another 15 minutes
11. Test for doneness
12. Remove bay leaf and serve

title: dark meat seitan
steps:
1. In bowl mix the first 7 ingredients to paste
2. Add the next 6 stir to blend and set aside
3. It should still be a paste after mixing in the onion powder
4. In large nonreactive pot combine wine , stock and water
5. Boil
6. Ladle about 1 cup of the hot liquid into paste
7. Stir until well incorporated
8. Now put it into the pot and bring back to boil
9. Place wrapped [or not] seitan in pot
10. Reduce to simmer and cook for 1 hour partially covered
11. Using tongs turn so all sides are exposed to broth
12. Cook for an hour to an hour and half
13. The longer you cook the firmer it will be
14. After 1 1 / 2 hours of cooking remove from pot and start checking firmness and taste
15. When you reach your desired taste , stop cooking
16. If the liquid evaporates and more than 1 / 2 of the seitan is exposed add about 1 to 2 cups stock
17. It will be firm after this but continue to firm up overnight
18. Cool , remove wrap if using , slice into rounds 1 / 2 inch or any shape desired
19. Cook with recipe of your choice
20. Store this in refrigerator , completely immesed in brasing liquid and well sealed for up to 3 days

title: john s italian bread machine loaf
steps: 1. Put all ingredients in inner pot to specifications of manufacturer , select"french" or"white" bread 1 lb , medium crust and push start

title: bucatini with pancetta  cheese and eggs
steps:
1. Cook pasta until al dente
2. Heat the butter and fry the pancetta until lightly browned
3. Set aside
4. Lightly beat the egg yolks and the milk in a bowl
5. Add the cheese
6. Pour the egg mixture into the bacon and add the pasta
7. Warm through , but do not cook the eggs
8. Toss well adding plenty of black pepper

title: ginger orange cupcakes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325
2. Insert liners into cupcake pans
3. In a bowl , sift flour , baking powder , salt , and baking soda
4. Add butter and sugar to the bowl of a stand mixer with the paddle attachment , beat at medium speed until mixture is light and airy
5. Reduce speed to low , add eggs in one at a time , mixing well
6. Add in half the orange juice and the ginger to the batter
7. Gradually add half the amount of dry ingredients , mixing until just incorporated
8. Add in remaining orange juice and remaining half of dry ingredients , mixing until batter is smooth
9. Fill the cupcake liners 2 / 3 full
10. Bake for 20-25 minutes , or until cupcakes are springy to the touch and a pick comes out clean
11. Remove from oven and cool on wire rack for 10 minutes
12. Make the glaze: add orange juice , lemon juice , and powdered sugar into a small saucepan on low heat , mixing for about 2 minutes until liquids slightly evaporate
13. Remove from heat and glaze cupcakes with a tablespoon each
14. Wait about 5 minutes for glaze to cool and harden before topping with peeled tangerine wedge

title: baked leek and tomato
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f degrees
2. Spray an oven proof gratin dish with veggie spray
3. Cover bottom of dish with half the leek slices and layer half the tomato slices over to cover
4. Sprinkle with salt and pepper to taste
5. Sprinkle half the olive oil over all
6. Make a second layer , ending with the tomato slices , salt and pepper and olive oil
7. Top with jalapeno and sprinkle with shredded cheddar cheese
8. Bake , uncovered , in 400f oven for 30 minutes

title: lemony orzo salad
steps:
1. Cook orzo according to package directions , omitting salt and fat
2. Drain well
3. Combine orzo , zucchini , and onion in a large bowl
4. Toss well
5. Combine parsley and next 6 ingredients
6. Stir well with a whisk
7. Stir into orzo mixture
8. Add tomato , cheese , and olives , tossing gently to coat

title: low cal veggie focaccia sandwich
steps:
1. Drizzle olive oil in frying pan
2. Add garlic and saut until fragrant
3. Julienne thick slices of each vegetable
4. Add zucchini , red pepper and squash to apn and saut until soft
5. Add mushrooms
6. Saut until soft
7. Toast focaccia in oven at 350f
8. When vegetables are cooked , place vegetables on one side of bread
9. Sprinkle with fresh parmesan cheese
10. Place 1-2 sweet red peppers over veggies
11. Drizzle with balsamic vinegar , place basil leaves on top of veggies and sandwich them between the bread

title: peanut sitting pretties
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Blend butter and sugar in a bowl
3. Stir in egg yolk and vanilla
4. Sift flour and salt into bowl
5. Mix well
6. Chill 1 hour
7. Roll into 1-inch balls
8. Dip into slightly beaten egg whites
9. Roll in chopped nuts
10. Place 1 inch apart on cookie sheet
11. Bake at 350f for 7 minutes
12. Press thumb into center of each
13. Bake 5 to 7 minutes longer or until done
14. Cool
15. Fill with frosting and top with m&m candies

title: pricomigdale
steps:
1. Cream the sugar with the eggs and butter
2. Add walnuts , rum flavoring and flour
3. Mix well then drop by teaspoons onto greased cookie sheets , leaving plenty of space in between
4. Bake at 350 degrees until golden brown

title: sugar free short bread cookies
steps:
1. Put in a food mixer till smooth
2. Roll into a long sausage and wrap in plastic wrap / freezer for or till you want to bake
3. Oven 350
4. Cut into cookie size
5. Bake 20-25 min till firm
6. Slightly brown edge
7. Take out and sprinkle with splenda , looks festive

title: lite  n easy crustless pumpkin pie  diabetic
steps:
1. Coat 9-inch deep-dish pie plate with nonstick cooking spray
2. Place water in medium bowl
3. Sprinkle gelatin over water
4. Let stand for 5 to 10 minutes or until softened
5. Mixture may be firm
6. Bring 1 cup evaporated milk just to a boil in small saucepan
7. Slowly stir hot evaporated milk into gelatin
8. Stir in remaining evaporated milk , pumpkin , sugar , pumpkin pie spice and vanilla extract
9. Pour mixture into prepared pie plate
10. Refrigerate for 2 hours or until set
11. Garnish with whipped topping and raspberries , if desired

title: no bake strawberry dessert
steps:
1. Arrange cake cubes in a single layer in a 13-in
2. X 9-in
3. X 2-in
4. Dish
5. In a bowl , dissolve gelatin in boiling water
6. Stir in strawberries
7. Pour over cake and gently press cake down
8. Refrigerate until set , about 1 hour
9. In a bowl , whisk milk and pudding mix for 2 minutes or until slightly thickened
10. Spoon over gelatin layer
11. Spread with whipped topping
12. Refrigerate until serving

title: broccoli cornbread casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Grease a 9x13" pan
3. Mix all ingredients well and spread in pan
4. Bake 30 to 35 minutes

title: delectable osso bucco
steps:
1. In a large pot , heat half the oil over medium heat
2. Add veal shanks and brown evenly , turning occasionally
3. Add remaining oil as needed
4. Remove shanks and season with 1 teaspoon salt
5. Add onion , carrot and garlic to pan
6. Cook and stir 6 to 8 minutes or until tender
7. Add tomatoes , wine and basil
8. Return shanks
9. Bring to a boil
10. Reduce heat to low
11. Cover tightly and simmer 1-1 / 2 hours or until veal is tender
12. Meanwhile combine gremolata ingredients
13. Set aside
14. Remove shanks and skim fat
15. Cook liquid over high heat until slightly thickened , stirring occasionally
16. Spoon approx
17. 3 / 4 cup sauce over shanks
18. Sprinkle with gremolata
19. Serve with remaining sauce

title: moroccan coconut fudge zucre coco
steps:
1. Line an 8"x8" pan with foil
2. Combine coconut , condensed milk , and sugar in a large sauce pan
3. Gently simmer until it reaches the "soft ball stage" which is 235f-245f
4. When the mixture is the right temperature stir in the butter and lemon rind
5. Allow to cool to room temperature and then beat the mixture until it is thick and glossy
6. Pour into the pan lined with foil and chill
7. Once it is chilled , cut into small squares

title: slow roasted prime rib
steps:
1. Allow beef roast to come to room temperature before cooking
2. In small bowl , blend butter with salt , pepper , rosemary , thyme , and garlic
3. Spread butter mixture evenly over all side of roast
4. Preheat oven to 325 degrees and place rack in center of oven
5. Heat olive oil in large skillet over medium-high heat for one minute
6. Sear roast in skillet on all sides until well-browned
7. Transfer roast , bone-side down , to a roasting pan with rack
8. Roast beef until thermometer inserted in center reads 125 degrees for rare , 135 degreed for medium-rare , , or 145 degrees for medium
9. Let meat rest at least 15 minutes before carving

title: chicken pot pie bundles
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350
2. Heat 1 t
3. Of the oil in a large non-stick skillet , over medium-high heat
4. Add carrot and onion and cook , stirring frequently , until softened , about 5 minutes
5. Add the garlic , and cook 1 minute more
6. Stir in the chicken , tarragon , salt , and pepper
7. Cook until the chicken is no longer pink , about 5 minutes
8. Place the broth and cornstarch in a bowl , and whisk until well combined
9. Add to the skillet along with the peas and corn , and bring the liquid to a simmer , stirring constantly
10. Continue to simmer and stir gently until the sauce thickens , about 2 minutes
11. To prepare the bundles , use a muffin pan with 12 medium-size cups
12. Gently place 1 egg roll wrap into each cup , letting it extend over the sides
13. Place a generous 1 / 4 cup of the chicken mixture into each wrap , and sprinkle the parmesan cheese on top
14. Fold the corners up and over the top of the filling and press to seal the edges
15. Brush the remaining oil on top of each bundle
16. Bake until golden and crisp , 12-15 minutes
17. Cool slightly before eating

title: easy  no frying  no pan to clean hot wings
steps:
1. If using frozen wings: i buy iqf - individually quick frozen- chicken wings that come in a bag and have already been separated into two sections and
2. If using frozen wings do not thaw just rinse chicken in a large strainer to remove any ice crystals
3. If using fresh / thawed not frozen wings: rinse chicken wings and follow directions starting at #3) but you may need to reduce your cooking time
4. I have not done them this way so i dont know how long they will take
5. Please watch them so they dont burn and do let me know how long they take to cook
6. Thanks !
7. Pat wings dry with some paper towels
8. They do not have to be perfectly dry-just get most of the water off
9. Place wings in a large disposable foil roasting pan that has been sprayed or oiled well
10. I also take some foil and very loosely crumple it into balls and fill the pan so the wings can sit on the top of those and everything can drain off
11. Season wings with cajun seasoning and garlic powder
12. Toss to coat
13. Bake at 375f until browned -about 30-40 minutes , using tongs flip each wing piece so that the browned side is down
14. Bake another 30 minutes or until chicken is browned and crispy all over
15. If you prefer them nice and crispy make sure to use a pan with a rack so that any liquid and grease can drain off
16. Sauce: in microwave safe bowl , combine hot sauce , butter , vinegar and more garlic powder if desired
17. Heat for about 2 minutes of until butter is melted and sauce is hot
18. To serve: depending on the formailty of your party- lol- if you are having hot wings it isnt too formal is it ? - you can serve directly from the foil pan or place wings on a platter
19. I like my wings to stay crispy after they are drenched in the sauce so i serve them with the sauce on the side and allow guests to place the wings in a bowl and add sauce as desired
20. Some have them swimming and others- like me- dip each wing just before it is eaten
21. The crispiest !
22. Update: this weekend made these again ! seasoned with garlic powder and cajun seasoning and grilled them starting with a preheated grill set to high
23. Oiled grill racks and seared each side of the chicken , then cooked over low to perfectly done and brown , crispy perfection
24. Removed from grill and tossed in sauce ! again , no messy pan to clean ! :)

title: sexy  spicy chili for the gourmet cowgirl   wstrn north carolina
steps:
1. Brown meat in skillet and sprinkle with cumin
2. Brown in large chunks and do not overcook - the insides of the big chunks should be a little pink
3. While you are browning the meat , heat up a large pot or dutch oven on another burner
4. If using veggie crumbles you can skip this step
5. In large pot or dutch oven , saute onions and peppers in olive oil for about 5 - 7 minutes
6. They should just start to turn golden
7. If using veggie crumbles - add them once the onions start to cook down
8. Add garlic , cans of tomatoes and can of green chilies , cook until heated through season with pepper
9. Add cans of beans to tomato mixture along with drained browned ground beef
10. Add hot peppers and seasonings
11. Lower heat and let simmer for 2 hours
12. Taste chili throughout cooking period and adjust all seasonings as needed
13. I found i needed to add more chili powder as it cooked
14. Add chipotle seasoning as it cooks until there is just a hint of smokiness
15. Adjust heat at this point with cayenne
16. Serve with your favorite cornbread

title: grilled swordfish sicilian style
steps:
1. Preheat grill on high
2. In a small bowl , mix the lemon juice with the salt until the salt dissolves
3. Stir in the oregano
4. Slowly whisk in the olive oil and season generously with pepper
5. Grill the swordfish steaks over high heat , turning once , until cooked through , 6 to 7 minutes
6. Transfer the fish to a platter
7. Prick each fish steak in several places with a fork to allow the sauce to penetrate
8. Using a spoon , beat the sauce , then drizzle it over the fish
9. Serve immediately

title: asian miracle diet soup
steps:
1. In a large pot heat oil over medium heat
2. Add the ginger and garlic and cook until tender , 3 to 4 minutes
3. Combine 1-cup broth with the cornstarch and blend until smooth
4. Pour the cornstarch mixture into the pot and add the remaining broth , tofu , mushrooms , bamboo shoots , soy sauce , vinegar , sugar and crushed red pepper flakes
5. Bring the soup to a boil and cook until thickened
6. Add the frozen vegetables , shrimp and cilantro
7. Simmer until shrimp is just opaque , about 10 minutes
8. Stir in the spinach and cook until just wilted
9. They say if you eat a full pot every 2 to 3 days , that is all you need to drop pounds fast

title: szechuan pork  crock pot
steps:
1. Trim chops of excess fat and brown on both sides in a skillet on the stove top
2. Place chops in the bottom of the crock pot and cover with bamboo shoots , water chestnuts , and green onions
3. Combine remaining ingredients together in a bowl and pour over vegetables
4. Cook on low for 3-5 hours or until chops are tender and cooked through
5. Serve hot with cooked rice

title: silky spicy carrot soup
steps:
1. In a large pot , combine the stock with the carrots , celery , onion , leek , potato , ginger , cumin , coriander , and cayenne , and bring to a boil
2. Cover and simmer over low heat until the vegetables are tender , 20-25 minutes
3. Working in batches , puree the soup in a food processor , then return to the pot
4. Stir in buttermilk and lemon juice , and season with salt and pepper to taste
5. Reheat gently
6. Ladle into bowls , and sprinkle with the parsley and serve
7. Enjoy !

title: mandarin pork
steps:
1. Combine ingredients for marinade in a shallow dish
2. Slice pork at an angle in thin medallions and add to marinade , tossing to coat
3. Allow meat to marinate for at least 30 minutes at room temperature or several hours refrigerated
4. Mix together sauce ingredients in a small bowl and set aside
5. Mix together cornstarch with the 3 tbsp water in a shallow dish and set aside
6. Heat 1 tbsp of oil in wok on med-high heat and add the 4 cloves of minced garlic
7. Allow garlic to sizzle briefly , then add pork , and stir-fry for approximately 3 minutes
8. Remove pork from wok using a slotted spoon and leave any meat juices in the pan
9. Add broccoli to the wok with the pan juices and cook , stirring , for 2 minutes
10. Add mushrooms to the wok along with 1 / 2 tbsp of oil and stir-fry for another minute
11. Place bamboo shoots and water chestnuts in the wok and mix together , stir-frying an additional minute
12. Return pork to wok , stirring all together , then add contents of sauce bowl and mix thoroughly
13. Re-stir thickener in its little dish before adding to wok , then add it to the stir-fry , stirring until the dish is thickened , about 1 more minute
14. Serve with hot steamed rice

title: barbeque beef in biscuit baskets
steps:
1. Heat the olive oil in a large pot
2. Brown the beef and onions together in the oil
3. Add the barbeque sauce , basil , salt and pepper
4. Turn down to a simmer and let cook for 1 hour
5. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
6. Open biscuits can and place individual biscuits on a large microwave safe plate
7. Heat biscuits for 40 seconds on 50% power
8. This makes them soft for easy shaping
9. Spray large muffin tin or custard cups with non-stick cooking spray
10. With your hands flatten out each biscuit and press into each muffin cup or custard cup
11. Cook the biscuit baskets in oven for 15 minutes
12. When you remove from the oven use the back of an ice cream scoop to press the biscuit basket into the tin to flatten out as much as possible
13. Divide up the barbeque beef between all the biscuit baskets
14. Sprinkle a little cheese on top of each
15. Cook in 350 degree oven for 10-15 minutes until cheese is melted

title: buffalo potato skins
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees
2. Have a rimmed baking sheet ready
3. Pierce potatoes in 3 or 4 places with a fork
4. Bake directly on oven rack 55 to 60 minutes or until tender when pierced with a fork
5. Remove to cool
6. When baked and removed , increase oven temperature to 450 degrees ,
7. When cool enough to handle , cut each potato into quarters
8. With a spoon , scoop pulp from skins , leaving at least 1 / 4 inch think shell
9. Reserve pulp for another use
10. Place skin side down on ungreased rimmed baking sheet
11. Mix butter , hot sauce , salt , garlic and onion powder in a small bowl
12. Brush evenly on potatoes
13. Bake 15 minutes or until browned at edges and crisp
14. Serve with dressing for dipping

title: tangy buttermilk cheese bread
steps:
1. Bring all ingredients to room temperature by letting them stand on counter about 30 minutes
2. Place yeast in bread machine pan according to directions in manual
3. In medium bowl , combine flour , oats , sugar and salt
4. Mix well
5. Stir in cheese
6. Place all ingredients in bread machine pan according to manual
7. Select white bread , light crust setting
8. Remove bread from pan to wire rack and cool before slicing

title: paarikyaai poolikootakari  bitter gourd side dish
steps:
1. Head oil in a skillet over medium-high heat and add mustard seeds and urad dal
2. When the mustard starts to sputter , add the sliced gourd , turmeric powder and salt and saute on a low flame for about 10 minutes
3. Add the water that the tamarind was soaked in , sambar powder and jaggery
4. Cover and cook on a low flame for about 10 minutes
5. Then check if the karela has been cooked
