6. If not , add an additional 1 / 4 cup water , cover and cook until all the water has been absorbed
7. Remove from flame and serve hot with rice and sambar , or chappatis

title: best turkey burgers
steps:
1. Prepare your grill for direct high heat
2. Or right before cooking , heat a griddle or large cast iron frying pan on the stovetop
3. Combine the turkey , bread crumbs , mayonnaise , chives , green onions , worcestershire sauce , chili sauce , basil , salt and pepper in a large bowl and work the mixture with your hands to just mix
4. Do not over mix or the burgers will be tough
5. Form the mixture into 4 1-inch thick patties
6. Season both sides of the patties with salt and pepper
7. Grill them for 5-7 minutes on each side , until the internal temperature of the patties reach 170f on a meat thermometer
8. Turkey burgers should be cooked through , not rare
9. Toward the end of the cooking , put the buns on the grill to toast for about a minute
10. Remove the burgers from the grill to a platter , cover and let rest for 5 minutes
11. Serve with your favorite condiments

title: easy spinach lasagne with pesto and cheese
steps:
1. Grease a 13x9 inch baking dish or lasagne pan
2. Spread 1 / 2 cup pasta sauce on bottom of dish
3. Mix together ricotta , egg , and pesto until thoroughly blended
4. Layer noodles , ricotta and pesto mixture , spinach , 1 / 2 cup parmesan , 1 cup mozzarella , and 1 cup pasta sauce
5. Repeat layers using remaining ingredients
6. Bake 1 hour at 350f

title: bon appetit lamb stock
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400f
2. In a roasting pan , roast the bones and trimmings until well browned , about 45 minutes , stirring occasionally
3. Transfer the bones and trimmings to a stockpot , and degrease the roasting pan
4. Place over medium-high heat and stir in 4 fluid ounces of water , scraping up any browned bits
5. Pour these deglazed juices into the stockpot
6. Add the remaining ingredients and water to cover
7. Bring to a simmer over medium heat , reduce the heat to low , cover partially , and simmer for 3 to 4 hours , skimming frequently
8. Strain the stock into a bowl through a colander lined with a double layer of dampened cheesecloth
9. Gently press the solids to extract all the liquid
10. Discard the solids
11. Cool
12. Remove fat from the surface
13. The stock can be stored for up to a week in a refrigerator , or longer if frozen

title: corn and bacon soup
steps:
1. Cook the corn in simmering water for about 10 minutes
2. Remove the corn from the water with tongs
3. Strip the kernels from the cobs and set the kernels aside
4. Chop the stripped cobs into 3 or 4 pieces and put them back into the simmering water
5. Continue to simmer them for about an hour to make a good corn stock
6. Drain the stock into a bowl through a fine strainer there is usually some silk left in the water- and reserve it
7. Melt the butter in a saucepan
8. Add the chopped onions , the garlic and the bacon and soften them over a gentle heat
9. Chop the potatoes into inch dice and add them to the pan
10. Let them take up a little of the butter& onion flavour
11. Add the reserved corn stock and the corn kernels
12. Cook until the potatoes are soft
13. Allow the soup to cool and then blend lightly
14. Season to taste , top with parsley and serve

title: pork chops in tomato sage sauce
steps:
1. Heat 4 t
2. Oil and 2 t
3. Butter in heavy medium skillet over medium high heat
4. Add tomatoes , reserving juice and dried sage
5. Cook until thickened to saucelike consistency , stirring frequently , about 15 minutes
6. Add set aside
7. Divide remaining 2 t
8. Oil , 2 t
9. Butter and whole sage leaves between 2 heavy large skillets
10. Cook mixture over medium-high heat until butter melts
11. Add 2 chops to each skillet
12. Cover and cook until brown , turning frequently , about 10 minutes
13. Add 1 / 4 cup wine to each skillet
14. Boil uncovered until reduced to a glaze , about 5 minutes
15. Divide tomato sauce between pans , spreading over chops
16. Reduce heat , cover and simmer until chops are tender , about 30 minutes longer
17. Degrease sauce
18. Adding reserved tomato juice if you like a thinner sauce
19. Season with salt and pepper
20. Transfer chops to a platter , and spoon sauce over
21. Sprinkle with mnced sage and reserve

title: edamole  edamame guacamole
steps:
1. Simmer edamame in 2 cups water for 2 minutes
2. Remove edamame from the pot with a slotted spoon and set aside to cool
3. Blanche the peeled broccoli stems in the same water for about 2 minutes
4. Drain and set aside to cool
5. When edamame and broccoli are cooled , pure both together in a blender , until smooth
6. Cut avocados in half , remove pits , and spoon out the avocado from its skin into a large bowl
7. Mash the avocados together with the lemon and lime juice
8. Add the edamame-broccoli mixture to the avocado and stir together well
9. Fold in the remaining ingredients , including the spice mixture
10. Taste and adjust the seasonings to your own taste from there

title: ground turkey crock pot dinner
steps:
1. Put potatoes on bottom and sides of crock
2. Then add turkey , onion , and garlic salt
3. Then add soup and other wet ingredients
4. Cook on low for 7-9 hours , or high 4-6 hours

title: bacon chili burrito dogs
steps:
1. Place all ingredients on a flour tortilla in the order listed
2. Begin rolling-up tightly , folding top and bottom in and over the ingredients to form a sealed envelope

title: chocolate peanut butter streusel cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 / grease a 13x9x2-inch baking pan
2. In a large bowl , combine first 4 ingredients
3. With a electric mixer , beat on low speed until streusel is blended and crumbly
4. Transfer 1 cup lightly packed streusel to a small bowl to reserve
5. Add the eggs , milk , vanilla extract , baking powder , and baking soda to remaining streusel
6. Beat on low speed until well-blended
7. Increase speed to medium and beat until well blended
8. Scrap the bowl occasionally , about three minutes
9. Stir in 1 cup of chocolate chips
10. Transfer batter to pan and sprinkle evenly with reserved streusel and remaining cup of chips
11. Bake about 35 minutes , until tester inserted into center comes out clean
12. Cool cake in pan on a wire rack

title: big and chewy chocolate chip cookies
steps:
1. Cream together sugars and margarine until fluffy with mixer
2. Blend in eggs , 1 at a time
3. Blend in vanilla
4. Combine flour , salt and baking soda
5. Add flour , combining with a spoon
6. Add chocolate chips
7. Use an ice cream scoop for measurement and place on shiny cookie sheet
8. Bake in a preheated 350f oven for 18-20 minutes or until golden

title: johnny jalapeno s mexican rice
steps:
1. --- place rice in a fine mesh strainer and rinse under cold running water until water runs clear- about 1-2 minutes , stirring with your fingers or shaking rice around in the strainer
2. Shake afterwards also to remove excess water / moisture
3. Set aside
4. In a large measuring cup or bowl , whisk the broth and tomato paste to incorporate
5. Set aside
6. Heat grease / oil over medium high heat in a dutch oven
7. Add rice and stir until rice is translucent , about 3-5 minutes
8. Add the onion , jalapeno , and garlic
9. Saute' for 1-2 minutes until onion is translucent
10. Stir the broth / paste mixture into the rice
11. Increase heat to medium high , and bring to a boil
12. Once it begins to boil , give a final stir and reduce heat to low , cover pot and simmer 20 minutes
13. Do not remove lid
14. Remove from heat and let sit for an additional 5 minutes still covered
15. Remove lid and stir , fluffing rice

title: one loaf white bread
steps:
1. Mix the butter , sugar , and salt into the warm water
2. Stir in 1 tablespoon flour and the yeast
3. Wait 5 minutes
4. If yeast does not bubble buy new yeast
5. Put flour in a large bowl
6. Stir in yeast mix
7. Stir thoroughly
8. Turn onto a floured board and knead
9. Knead in as much of the flour as possible to make a satiny dough
10. If dough is sticky add more flour a tablespoon at a time
11. Put dough in a greased bowl and turn to coat
12. Cover with a clean damp towel and let rise til double
13. Punch down
14. Shape into loaf and put in greased loaf pan
15. Let rise
16. Bake at 375 for 50 minutes or until bottom sounds hollow when thumped
17. Can also be shaped into 12 dinner rolls or 8 hamburger buns
18. Bake for less time if using these shapes

title: moroccan carrots
steps:
1. Soak the currants in hot water to cover for 30 minutes
2. Drain and reserve 1 / 4 cup soaking liquid
3. Thinly slice the carrots or cut into julienne on a mandoline
4. You should have about 5 cups
5. Heat the butter in a large saute pan over low heat
6. Add the sugar , spices , and carrots
7. Cook , stirring constantly , 2-3 minutes
8. Stir in the orange juice and currants with reserved soaking liquid
9. Turn up heat to bring to boiling , then reduce heat and simmer , covered , until tender
10. Season to taste with salt and pepper
11. Sprinkle with mint or parsley and serve hot

title: sloppy joe pizza
steps:
1. Heat oven to 425
2. In large non-stick skillet brown beef , stirring occasionally
3. Drain off fat
4. To beef , add corn , barbecue sauce , and green onions
5. Heat through
6. Place bread shell or pizza crust on baking sheet
7. Spoon beef mixture evenly over crust
8. Sprinkle with cheese
9. Bake 12-15 minutes or until cheese is melted
10. Slice into wedges

title: boston style baked beans
steps:
1. In a saucepan , cover beans with cold water , bring to a boil
2. Boil 1 minute
3. Remove from heat , cover pot , and let sit for 1 hour
4. Drain well
5. Score the bacon in squares without cutting through the rind
6. Put half the beans in the pot in which you will bake them , and add the onion , molasses and seasonings
7. Add remaining beans and bury the bacon rind up in the top layer of beans add just enough water to cover
8. Cover the pot tightly
9. Bake for 4-6 hours , or more to melt the pork fat , and blend the flavors
10. Add boiling water from time to time if needed
11. The last 30 minutes of baking , remove the lid to make a brown crust

title: mom s chicken breasts with mushroom soup
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Put chicken breasts in oven-ready pan
3. Sprinkle with onion , celery , garlic salts / powder and pepper
4. In a medium bowl , combine condensed soup and half and half
5. Pour over chicken breasts until well coated
6. Sprinkle generously with sliced almonds , then paprika
7. Bake for one to one-and-a-half hours

title: delicious quinoa supper   vegetarian  or not  and yummy
steps:
1. Stir fry onion , pepper , carrot and zucchini in a small amount of oil until tender
2. Lightly steam broccoli in the microwave
3. Add cooked broccoli to veggie mixture
4. Season veggies with mrs
5. Dash , add wine and let it cook down
6. Add cooked quinoa , mix well
7. Add butter to hot mixture and stir
8. Add chicken , if desired
9. Serve !

title: mexi cheeseburger quiche
steps:
1. Cook ground beef in skillet until done
2. Drain
3. Add onions and chiles and cook for 5 minutes
4. Meanwhile , mix the rest of the ingredients in a bowl
5. Put beef mixture into a pie dish
6. Pour cheese mixture over it
7. Bake at in a 350 oven for 35-40 minutes or until cheese is puffed and slightly brown

title: black bean  zucchini    olive tacos
steps:
1. Preheat a heavy bottomed skille tover medium-high heat
2. Pour in the oil and add the zucchini and jalapeno , sprinkle with the salt
3. Saute for about 7 minutes , or until the zucchini is lightly browned
4. Add the garlic , olives , cumin , and coriander , and saute for 2 minutes more
5. Add the salsa verde and black beans and cook for 5 minutes
6. The salsa should reduce a bit so its not soupy
7. Mix the ingredients for the garlic-lemon yogurt if your using
8. Warm the tortillas in a skillet or wrap in a moist towel & nuke for a minute
9. Assembly the tacos by adding the filling , yogurt , and topping with scallions
10. Enjoy !

title: jello poke cake
steps:
1. Bake cake according to package directions
2. Cool completely
3. Poke cake with a fork
4. Mix jello with boiling water until dissolved
5. Mix in cold water
6. Pour over cake
7. Top with cool whip
8. Keep in refrigerator

title: haupia cake
steps:
1. Make cake & whipped cream frosting: preheat oven according to directions on cake mix
2. Grease and flour two 8 or 9-inch round cake pans
3. Prepare the cake according to the package directions , using 2 / 3 cup of the coconut milk , water , and egg whites
4. When cakes are finished baking , cool and cut each cake horizontally into 2 layers
5. If your top layers are mound-shaped , cut them so they are flat
6. Soften gelatin in remaining 1 / 3 cup of coconut milk
7. Dissolve over hot water
8. Cool completely
9. In a bowl , whip the heavy cream
10. Fold the gelatin mixture , sugar , and extract into the whipped cream
11. Chill frosting until it is of spreading consistency
12. Make haupia filling: in a small bowl , mix together the sugar , salt , cornstarch and water
13. Set aside
14. In a saucepan , heat the coconut milk
15. When hot , add the sugar mixture
16. Cook , stirring constantly , until the mixture thickens
17. Remove from heat
18. Stir in vanilla and cool
19. Chill the filling until it is of spreading consistency
20. Assemble the cake: spread the haupia filling between each cake layer
21. You'll have the following layers: cake , filling , cake , filling , cake , filling , cake
22. Refrigerate assembled cake until set
23. Frost entire cake with whipped cream mixture
24. Sprinkle coconut all over the cake sides and top
25. Keep refrigerated until ready to serve

title: chicken rice
steps:
1. Combine ingredients in a 13x9 baking dish
2. Bake at 350 for 45 minutes

title: chicken enchilada pasta soup
steps:
1. In dutch oven or large saucepan , combine broth , corn , enchilada sauce and chiles
2. Mix well
3. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat
4. Add all remaining soup ingredients
5. Mix well
6. Reduce heat to low
7. Simmer 8 minutes or until vermicelli is tender , stirring occasionally
8. Ladle soup into individual bowls
9. Garnish each serving with onion and cheese

title: roasted poblano and corn soup
steps:
1. Roast whole poblanos on grill or under broiler , until skin turns black and blisters
2. Place blackened chilies in covered dish or paper bag and allow to cool for 10 to 15 minutes
3. Peel and rinse the skins off the peppers
4. Slit lengthwise and remove the stems , seeds and ribs
5. Pat the chilies dry and then dice
6. Set aside
7. Pour the milk and broth into a heavy saucepan
8. Toast the cumin seeds in a small dry frying pan , shaking the pan constantly until they are aromatic and begin to change color , about 4 minutes
9. Remove from the heat and immediately add to the milk
10. Add the chipotle chilies , adobo sauce , bay leaves and rosemary and place over low heat
11. Cover and bring to a gentle simmer
12. Do not allow to boil
13. Remove from the heat and let stand , covered , for 20 minutes
14. Meanwhile , in a stockpot over medium heat , melt the butter with the olive oil
15. Add onions and salt
16. Saut , stirring , until the onions are soft and golden brown , 15 to 20 minutes
17. Reduce the heat to medium-low , add the garlic and ground cumin , and saut , stirring constantly , until aromatic , about 5 minutes
18. Stir in the corn and poblano chilies , and continue cooking until the corn is lightly browned , about 5 minutes
19. Strain the milk mixture into the corn mixture
20. Bring to a gentle simmer and continue to simmer until the flavors have melded , about 15 minutes
21. Remove from the heat and let cool for a few minutes
22. Puree one-third of the soup
23. Return the puree to the stockpot , stirring well
24. Add cream and reheat over low heat , stirring gently
25. Taste and adjust the seasonings
26. Garnish with cilantro or green onions and serve

title: honey dijon vinaigrette
steps:
1. Whisk all ingredients together
2. Taste for preference
3. If too sour , add more dijon mustard and honey

title: egg and soldiers
steps:
1. Toast bread
2. Butter
3. Cut in half then into 4 strips
4. Boil the egg
5. 3 minutes for soft and 6 minutes is hard
6. Place in an egg cup
7. Tap the top of with a knife or spoon
8. Serve
9. Make sure you dip the soldiers in the runny egg
10. Kids will love it

title: cinnamon focaccia
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl , combine 2 cups flour , yeast and salt
2. Add water and oil
3. Beat until smooth
4. Stir in enough remaining flour to form a soft dough
5. Turn onto a floured surface
6. Knead until smooth and elastic , about 6-8 minutes
7. Place in a greased bowl , turning once to grease top
8. Cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled , about 1 hour
9. Punch dough down
10. Turn onto a lightly floured surface
11. Divide in half
12. Pat each portion flat
13. Cover and let stand for 10 minutes
14. Press dough into 2 greased 12-inch pizza pans
15. Prick top of dough with a fork
16. Brush with butter
17. Combine sugar and cinnamon
18. Sprinkle over dough
19. Top with nuts
20. Let stand 10-15 minutes
21. Bake at 350 for 25-30 minutes or until lightly browned
22. Remove from pans to wire racks
23. Combine powdered sugar and enough cream to achieve a glaze consistency
24. Drizzle over warm bread

title: alouette pecan caramel brie recipe
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. In an ovenproof dish , bake pecans for about 7 minutes being careful not to over cook
3. Spread caramel over the top of the alouette baby brie
4. Sprinkle pecans on top
5. Serve at room temperature

title: dj s chicken   portabella mushrooms
steps:
1. Saute seasoned chicken breasts with minced garlic in olive oil approximately 1 minute
2. Add portabello mushrooms next to chicken
3. Cover and saute 5 minutes
4. Add onions and saute a few more minutes
5. Add zucchini and asparagus , and more oil if necessary to keep simmering--don't let the vegetables dry out
6. Cover and saute till done , 10-15 minutes
7. Add optional roasted peppers , if desired , a few minutes before done

title: baked corn from scratch
steps:
1. Melt shortening and then add the flour
2. Add milk gradually and bring to a boil , stirring constantly
3. Add corn , sugar , salt and pepper and heat thoroughly
4. Remove from heat and add beaten eggs
5. Pour into greased baking dish , sprinkle with buttered crumbs if desired
6. Bake at 350f for 35 minutes or until firm

title: australian grilled moreton bay bugs  bay lobster
steps:
1. Cut soft shell covering away from the underside of bugs
2. Brush with combined butter , lime juice , garlic , dill and pepper
3. Barbecue or grill bugs until tender , brushing with butter mixture while cooking

title: healthyish blueberry dump cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease a 9 x 13 pan
3. Rinse blueberries and let drain in a colander
4. Dump blueberries into pan , dump sugar over them , sprinkle some cinnamon over top , dump cake mix over blueberries-sugar mixture
5. Shake pan to evenly distribute
6. Pour buttermilk over cake mix-
7. Sprinkle cinnamon and a teaspoon of sugar over top
8. Do not stir
9. Bake in oven until top is light brown and blueberries start top poke through
10. Should look solid and cakey- not wet
11. Oven time could be between 20-35 minutes

title: daughter s banana bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Make sure all the ingredients are at room temperature
3. Whisk together the flour , salt , soda , and powder
4. Set aside
5. In a large bowl beat on high speed for 2-3 minutes the butter , and sugar
6. Beat in the flour mixture till blended and is the consistency of brown sugar
7. Gradually beat in the eggs
8. Fold in the bananas and nuts till combined
9. Put into a greased and floured bread pan and bake for 50-60 minutes or until bread tests done
10. Cool pan on rack for 5-10 minutes
11. Take out and cool on rack

title: marshmallow delight
steps:
1. For crust:
2. In 9x13 inch pam , mix crumbs and margarine
3. Press to cover bottom of pan
4. For filling:
5. In large saucepan , heat milk and marshmallows
6. Bring to a boil , stirring constantly
7. Set aside to cool
8. When cooled , add remaining ingredients
9. Stir well
10. Pour into crust
11. Drizzle caramel topping on top
12. Chill until set

title: maple pear oatmeal muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Prepare muffin cups with a light coating of cooking spray
3. Combine dry ingredients together in a bowl
4. Core and dice the pears into small chunks
5. Combine the pears , buttermilk , maple syrup , oil , sugar , egg and all but 2 tablespoons of the oatmeal together in a second bowl
6. Let sit for 5 minutes
7. Combine the pecans and reserved oatmeal together to use as a topping for the muffins
8. Set aside
9. Combine the wet and dry ingredients together until just mixed
10. Spoon batter into muffin cups , filling 2 / 3s full
11. Sprinkle with the pecan / oatmeal mix
12. Bake 18 to 20 minutes until a toothpick inserted in the middle comes out clean
13. Cool 5 minutes and remove from pan
14. Serve warm or let the muffins finish cooling on a rack

title: crab cole slaw
steps:
1. In a large salad bowl , combine cabbage , bell pepper , onions , and crab meat and mix well
2. In a small bowl , whisk together the olive oil , vinegar , garlic powder , mayonnaise , salt and hot sauce
3. Pour the dressing over the vegetables and mix until coated
4. Serve immediately or refrigerate until ready to serve

title: ikea swedish meatballs
steps:
1. For meatballs:
2. Fry the onion till golden in a couple of tablespoons of lightly browned butter
3. Mash the potatoes
4. Mix all the ingredients until meatball consistency
5. Flavour with salt , white pepper and a little finely crushed allspice
6. Shape the mixture into relatively large , round balls and transfer to a floured cutting board
7. Fry them slowly in plenty of butter
8. Cream sauce:
9. Melt butter in pan and add flour , whisk till golden brown and flour is cooked
10. Add beef stock and cream until desired thickness
11. Season well with salt and pepper
12. Serve the meatballs with the sauce , freshly boiled yukon potatoes , and lingonberry jam

title: ultimately yummy cheesecake marble brownies
steps:
1. Preheat oven 375f
2. Grease a 13x9 inch metal pan
3. Brownie mixture: in a small saucepan , combine chocolate and 1 / 2 cup butter
4. Stir over low heat until melted and smooth
5. Remove from heat
6. Cool 10 minutes
7. In a large bowl , beat 1 1 / 2 cups sugar and 3 eggs until well blended
8. Add 1 1 / 4 cups of flour , baking powder , salt and 1 / 2 teaspoon vanilla
9. Stir until well blended
10. Add cooled chocolate mixture
11. Stir to combine thoroughly
12. Evenly spread batter into prepared pan
13. Cream cheese mixture: in a medium bowl , beat cream cheese , remaining sugar and butter till smooth
14. Beat in remaining egg and vanilla
15. Stir in remaining flour
16. Pour mixture gently and evenly over chocolate batter
17. Gently swirl batters together using
18. Bake 40 minutes or until set
19. Cool in pan on rack

title: all purpose crock pot chicken
steps:
1. If using thigh portions or a cut up fryer , etc , remove all skin and as much fat as possible
2. I boil the skins with garlic for the dog
3. There is no need to bone the chicken
4. Put about 1 / 4 inch water in the slow cooker
5. Rinse the chicken well , getting into the crevices , and sprinkle with the cajun seasoning on both sides
6. Go easy at first
7. This is not low-salt and it tends to be a little spicy
8. I start immediately placing the chicken in the slow cooker
9. I rinse one piece , season both sides , and layer it in the pot
10. When you are done seasoning all the chicken , cover the pot and let the chicken stand for 30 minutes
11. At the end of that time , cover the chicken fully with water and set the cooker on "low
12. " cooking time is up to you
13. A minimum of 8-10 hours is what i recommend
14. I usually set the chicken cooking in an afternoon , and let it cook overnight
15. Often it will cook for 12-24 hours
16. This is an excellent dish for those of us who never learned to properly debone a chicken
17. ) at the end of the cooking time , merely pull out the chicken pieces and separate the bones from the meat
18. It will literally fall apart
19. Save the broth for adding to mashed potatoes , gravy , rice or soup
20. You will have a good deal of chicken here
21. Separate into smaller portions and freeze

title: heirloom fruitcake
steps:
1. Finely chop candied fruits and pecans
2. Snip dates and raisins into small pieces with kitchen shears dipped in hot water occasionally to prevent stickiness
3. Combine fruit and nuts in a bowl , add 2 or 3 t flour and toss to mix well
4. Sift together flour , baking powder , soda , nutmeg , allspice , and cinnamon
5. Set aside
6. Cream butter until fluffy , then add brown sugar and gradually beat until light and fluffy
7. Beat in eggs two at a time , then stir in vanilla , lemon juice , and orange juice
8. Mix jelly and rum / juice until smooth
9. Add alternately to batter with dry ingredients
10. Pour batter over fruit and mix throughly , using a wooden spoon or your hands
11. Pour batter into 2 greased and lined loaf pans or 1 ten-inch tube pan
12. Bake at 275 f for 3 1 / 2 hours
13. Paint generously with grape juice / brandy and wrap in cheesecloth and foil , keeping refrigerated until christmas time
14. Paint on more juice once or twice per week

title: bachelor beef stew
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in a heavy 5 quart pot with tightly fitting cover
2. Bake in 300 degree oven for 5 hours
3. Do not open oven at any time
4. Do not increase amounts of ingredients
5. Turns out perfect every time

title: african style turkey on couscous  crock pot
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in crock pot
2. Cover
3. Cook on low for 8 hours
4. Serve over couscous

title: ginger peachy baked spareribs
steps:
1. Heat oven to 250f
2. Ribs:
3. Make sure that you remove all excess fat from the ribs
4. Lay the ribs in a single layer in a baking pan and sprinkle with the seasoned salt
5. Bake for 2 hours or until ribs are well cooked and the meat is tender
6. Brush the honey over all the ribs and continue cooking for 5-10 minutes until the surface looks smooth and slightly glazed
7. Ginger peachy sauce:
8. Put peaches in a medium to large saucepan
9. Beat the peaches for 5 minutes at high speed with a hand held electric mixer
10. The peaches should be fairly smooth
11. Put ginger in a small bowl
12. Add vinegar a couple of teaspoons at a time , stirring constantly , until mixture is smooth
13. Add ginger mixture to peaches
14. Stir in brown sugar , ketchup , soy sauce , garlic powder and salt
15. Cook over medium heat , just until the mixture simmers
16. Stir mixture occasionally
17. Remove from heat and pour into a sauce or gravy boat and serve with ribs

title: irish roast beast
steps:
1. Spray the inside of a 4 to 6 quart slow cooker with non-stick cooking spray
2. Mix all the ingredients , except the meat and gravy mix , in a large bowl
3. For the slow cooker: put half a cup of the sauce mixture in the bottom of the slow cooker
4. Set the meat in and pour the rest of the sauce over the top
5. Turn the slow cooker to low and cook for 8 to 10 hours when the meat is easily pierced with a fork , remove from the sauce and cut into chunks and put on a platter
6. Cover platter with foil to keep meat warm
7. Turn the slow cooker to high and sprinkle in the packet of beef gravy mix
8. Stir until sauce has thickened
9. To serve , drizzle some of the sauce over the meat on the platter
10. Put the rest of the sauce in a gravy boat or small pitcher for the table
11. Instructions for the oven: spray the inside of the roasting pan with non-stick cooking spray
12. Follow the directions as above and cover the pan tightly with heavy-duty aluminum foil
13. Bake in preheated 325 degree oven for 5 to 6 hours or until easily pierced with a fork
14. Take off the foil and let brown in oven for another 45 minutes
15. Remove meat from sauce and cut into chunks and put on a platter
16. Cover platter with foil to keep meat warm
17. Pour the sauce into a saucepan and sprinkle with beef gravy mix
18. Thicken over medium heat and serve , as described above

title: italian grilled mushrooms
steps:
1. In a stainless steel bowl mix together the mushrooms , salt , pepper , garlic , onion powder and olive oil
2. Cook on the grill on high heat for about 2-3 minutes per side
3. Place the grilled mushrooms back in the bowl and mix well , while still hot with the cheese and parsley

title: cheese bars
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together with your hands
2. Make dough and then make one big sheet 1
3. 5 cm thick with your rolling pin
4. With sharp knife , cut bars and place it to baking pan
5. Bake on 250c until light golden

title: seasoned pork roast with mushroom sauce
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425f
2. Mix all the spices together in a small bowl
3. Coat the roast with the spices , patting to keep on meat
4. Insert a meat thermometer in the roast and place the roast on a rack in a shallow baking pan
5. Roast for 15 minutes
6. Reduce the temperature to 325f and continue to roast until the center temperature registers 150f
7. About 1 1 / 2 hours
8. Allow the meat to rest for 10 minutes before carving
9. Serve with mushroom sauce
10. Mushroom sauce: heat the oil in a medium skillet
11. Saute the garlic and shallot for 1 minute
12. Add the mushrooms and saute over medium-high heat for 4-5 minutes or until they start to brown
13. Add the wine and 1 / 2 cup of chicken stock and simmer until most of the liquid evaporates
14. Add the chicken stock and soy sauce
15. Bring to a boil
16. Stir in the cornstarch mixture and simmer for 2 to 3 minutes
17. Season with salt and pepper , if desired

title: country corn chowder
steps:
1. Melt butter in a large saucepan over medium-high heat
2. Add onion and cook , stirring frequently , until golden and tender , about 7-10 minutes
3. Add potatoes and chicken broth
4. Bring mixture to a boil
5. Reduce heat to low and simmer , partially covered , until potatoes are tender , about 15-20 minutes
6. Stir in corn , milk , salt and pepper
7. Simmer uncovered 5 minutes
8. Ladle chowder into bowls
9. Sprinkle with chopped chives

title: chinese rice salad
steps:
1. Cook rice
2. Chill
3. Add next 4 ingredients
4. Put dressing in a jar and shake well
5. Just before serving , add dressing a few spoonfuls at a time until salad appears moist enough
6. Add noodles and toss

title: blue ridge mountains chocolate chip cookies
steps:
1. I add the 1 / 4 cup making it 2 3 / 4 cups total
2. Cream shortening , butter , sugars , then eggs and vanilla and almond extracts
3. Blend dry ingredients and add to mixture
4. Stir in chocolate chips
5. Drop by large tablespoons onto ungreased cookie sheet , leaving 2-inches room in between to allow cookies to spread
6. I press down lightly with a measuring cup to bake more uniform cookies)
7. Bake at 375 for 10 minutes until lightly brown
8. Makes 2-3 dozen cookies depending on size

title: black bean tortilla casserole
steps:
1. In a large skillet combine onion , green chilis , undrained tomatoes , picante sauce , garlic and cumin
2. Bring to boiling
3. Reduce heat
4. Simmer , uncovered , for 10 minutes
5. Stir in beans
6. In 13x9x2 inch baking dish spread 1 / 3 of bean mixture over bottom
7. Top with 1 / 2 of tortillas , overlapping if necessary , and 1 / 2 of the cheese
8. Add another 1 / 3 of the bean mixture , then remaining tortillas and remaining bean mixture
9. Cover and bake in a 350 degree oven for 30-35 minutes or until heated through
10. Sprinkle with remaining cheese , and return to oven until cheese is melted
11. Let stand for 10 minutes
12. If desired , top with tomato slices , green onions and olives
13. Cut into squares and serve with sour cream or yogurt

title: baked avocado fries with chipotle cream
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450
2. Coat avocado slices in the four , then egg , then panko
3. Spread on a cooling rack that has been sprayed with non-stick spray , then place on a cookie sheet
4. Spray the top of the wedges with olive oil and sprinkle with salt , then bake for about 20 minutes at 450 , or until they are golden brown
5. Cool and eat with sauce
6. Sauce: mix all ingredients and chill in refrigerator
7. Dip fries in sauce , or if you want to make the platter prettier , drizzle fries with sauce and sprinkle plate with additional chopped cilantro

title: quick pasta salad
steps:
1. Prepare pasta and rinse with cold water
2. Meanwhile in a very large bowl , combine the next 10 ingredients
3. Add drained pasta to veggie mixture
4. Add salad dressing
5. Toss to coat
6. Sprinkle salad with parsley and cheese
7. Toss again
8. Chill covered in the refrigerator for 4-24 hours stir before serving

title: colorful sausage  peppers  and onions medley
steps:
1. Cut sausages into 1" bite sized rounds
2. Cut peppers and onions into 2"x1 / 2" slices
3. Combined all spices into 1 bowl and mix well
4. Heat large skillet with oil to medium heat
5. Cook all sausages until 90% done
6. Add peppers and onions and mixed spices to pan
7. Continue cooking for 5 to 10 minutes until peppers and onions are just done , do not over cook
8. Serve on you favorite platter with a side of red pasta sauce if you wish !

title: gluten free chicken rice a roni dinner
steps:
1. Place broken spaghetti on dry cookie sheet and place in 400f oven shaking every couple of minutes until it is brown and smells nutty , usually between 5 to 10 minutes
2. Remove and set aside
3. In a deep pan with a lid or a dutch oven on medium , heat butter and oil until bubbly then add onions , carrots , and celery
4. Salt the vegetables to help them release their liquids and cook until onions are translucent
5. Add the poultry seasoning , pepper and the dry rice and cook , stirring constantly until the rice is coated , about one minute
6. Add the pasta , the stock , the bay leaves , zucchini and the chicken , stir and cover
7. Bring to a boil then turn heat down to medium low and cook for 15 minutes
8. Check to see that it has enough fluid , if not add a 1 / 2 cup of water and continue cooking , covered until rice is done , about five more minutes
9. If you like spinach , add it now and cook until it wilts down
10. I stir in a couple of tablespoons of butter at the end for the flavour and shine
11. Remove the bay leaves and serve

title: sausage wraps
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. In a skillet cook up the patties or form your own patties , small
3. Remove from heat and blot on paper towel
4. Seperate and cut dough into triangles enough for each patty
5. Brush with the mustard and place piece of cheese small enough to fit under the patty
6. Place sausage on top of triangle and wrap around it , covering most of it by crisscrossing
7. Place wrapped patty on ungreased cookie sheet or baking stone and bake for 11-13 minutes or until golden brown
8. How many this yields depends mostly on how big you make the patties and how many triangles you cut
9. For ready made patties it makes 8

title: whole wheat gingerbread cake
steps:
1. Cream butter , gradually add brown sugar and beat until fluffy
2. Add egg and beat well
3. Mix in molasses
4. Mix dry ingredients together , add gradually to mixture
5. Add boiling water and stir until batter is smooth , mixture will be thin
6. Pour into greased and floured 8" square baking pan
7. Bake at 350 degrees for 40-45 minutes , until edges are starting to pull away from pan and toothpick inserted in center of cake comes out clean

title: egg and ham pinwheels
steps:
1. Place the eggs into a pan of cold water and bring to boil then simmer for about 5-6 minutes to hard boil them
2. Remove from heat and run under cold water , then crack & remove shells
3. I do this under the running cold water
4. Place shelled eggs into a bowl and add the butter , parsley if using , salt & pepper and mayonnaise or whatever you choose to moisten the mixture with and mash with a fork until a spreading consistency is reached
5. Sometimes you may need a little more mayonnaise or cream
6. Don't make into a smooth paste though
7. Spread the tortillas with a layer of cream cheese
8. Spread over this a layer of mashed egg
9. Lay on top of this the shaved ham
10. Roll up the tortillas tightly like a sponge roll and wrap in plastic wrap
11. Place in fridge for at least 2 hours or can be left overnight
12. Remove plastic and place the roll seam side down on the cutting board
13. Using a serrated knife , cut off a piece each end of the rolls to neaten , then slice into approx 1-inch slices
14. Arrange on platter and serve
15. I like to place one layer on plate then arrange another layer on top , slightly in from the edge of the bottom ones
16. Continue up with another layer until all are used
17. Top with a sprig of parsley

title: chocomallow brownie bars
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375
2. Grease bottom of 13x9 pan
3. Empty cookie mix into large bowl
4. Using microwave or stovetop , melt one stick or butter and bag of chocolate chips together
5. Add to sugar cookie mix and mix well
6. Using microwave or stove top , melt one stick of butter and marshmallows together
7. Add this to chocolate / cookie mixture and mix well
8. Spread evenly in pan and back 30 minutes at 375 until knife inserted comes out clean
9. Using microw

title: tropical fruity jello
steps:
1. In a heatproof jug , mix the jello powder with the boiling water until dissolved
2. Add the cold water and pineapple juice
3. Put in the fridge for about an hour , until starting to set but not set yet
4. Add the fruit , evenly scattered through the jello
5. Put back in the fridge until completely set

title: granny s apple cake
steps:
1. Cream eggs , oil and sugar together and then add flour and mix well
2. Add apples and nuts and mix well
3. Bake in a greased and floured 9x13 pan in 275 degree oven for 1 hour

title: linguine tuna salad
steps:
1. Break linguine lengthwise into thirds and cook according to package directions
2. Drain
3. Meanwhile , in a large bowl , combine lemon juice , oil , onions , sugar , italian seasoning , and salt , mix well
4. Add hot linguine
5. Toss
6. Flake tuna with a fork , then stir tuna and thawed peas into the linguine mixture
7. Gently toss in chopped tomatoes
8. Cover
9. Chill several hours or overnight to blend flavors
10. Serve cold
11. Refrigerate any leftovers

title: non spicy thai coconut chicken
steps:
1. Saut the chicken in oil of your choice on medium heat until the pink is gone
2. Put the chicken onto a plate with paper towel over it to drain the oil off the chicken
3. Wash the pan
4. Put the chicken back in the clean pan on medium low heat and add coconut milk
5. Stir in the soya sauce , brown sugar , and salt
6. Taste and add more as necessary
7. Take the leaves off the sprig , chop and add to chicken
8. Stir every so often and just allow to heat to desired temperature
9. Serve with rice and rosemary vegetable kabobs

title: toasted ham and gouda sandwiches
steps:
1. Arrange the bread slices on a cutting board or counter top
2. Spread all slices with mustard-mayo sauce
3. Sprinkle 4 of the slices with the fresh chives
4. Add ham , tomato and cheese
5. Cover these four slices with the remaining bread slices , putting the sauce side down
6. Using one of the tablespoons of butter , spread it over the tops of the sandwiches
7. Heat a large skillet over low heat and melt the remaining two tablespoons of butter
8. Place the sandwiches , butter side up , into the skillet and cook for 3 to 4 minutes or until toasted
9. Turn the sandwiches over
10. Cook until toasted and the cheese is melted

title: spicy cranberry salsa
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in a food processor
2. Pulse until ingredients are coarsely chopped
3. Cover and chill overnight

title: mushroom sherry sauce
steps:
1. Melt butter in heavy skillet over medium heat
2. Add the onions and garlic
3. Saut 5 minutes
4. Stir in the mushrooms and saut until they start to give off their liquid , about 5 minutes
5. Remove mushrooms and keep warm
6. Stir flour , paprika , thyme , marjoram , salt and pepper into butter
7. Cook 1 minute
8. Stir in the sherry and cook 1 minute
9. Stir in the stock and return mushrooms to pan
10. Simmer 5 minutes
11. If thinner sauce desired , add small amounts of sherry until desired consistency

title: nat s always requested garlic butter
steps:
1. Mix all the ingredients together
2. Butter is ready to use right away
3. Can be stored in fridge for a couple of weeks , but if you don't use much of it , it can be frozen into desired portions
4. I put this butter on vegetables of all kinds
5. Use to make garlic toast , or garlic bread
6. Best not to store in tupperware , as it is difficult to get the garlic smell out !

title: shabbat chicken
steps:
1. In a dutch oven , heat oil over medium-low heat and brown onion
2. Add cloves , salt , turmeric , ginger , and garlic
3. Add chicken parts and a few pieces of skin
4. Raise heat to medium to brown meat
5. Mix / turn the chicken parts frequently
6. Reduce heat to low , cover , cook until tender about 30-45 minutes
7. Check it frequently and mix / turn chicken
8. There will be a lot of juice
9. At this point , the reason it is called shabbat chicken is to place the pot on a warmer / hot plate until the men arrive home from synagogue and then serve over couscous or rice
10. I have found that this can be served immediately , simmered for longer , and tastes great heated up
11. I also usually make 2 chickens and double the spices

title: eggless microwave chocolate cake
steps:
1. Grease a round microwaveable cake tin and line with greaseproof paper
2. Sift together the flour , cocoa powder , baking powder and bicarbonate of soda and set aside
3. Cream together the butter and the sugar
4. Add the condensed milk , melted chocolate and vanilla essence and beat well to mix
5. Add the dry ingredients and mix well together
6. Slowly pour aerated soda into the mixture and mix in well
7. Pour the cake mixture into the prepared tin
8. Microwave on high for 4-5 mins and on medium 4-5 mins
9. Hold in dish for 2-4 after baking
10. Then , remove from the cake tin and place it on a wire rack to allow it to cool
11. Decorate if desired before cutting into slices to serve

title: low fat ground beef wellingtons
steps:
1. Heat stock in frypan
2. Saute finely diced onion 5 minutes
3. Add garlic , finely diced mushrooms and celery
4. Cook until celery is soft
5. Place mixture in bowl and place in fridge 20 minutes until cool
6. Add pepper
7. Combine in bowl ground beef , parsley , egg and breadcrumbs
8. Roll into 8 patties
9. Cut 2 sheets of puff pastry into 4 pieces
10. Place pattie in middle of pastry , add the mushroom mixture on to of the beef and fold like and envelope
11. Making sure you pinch close all seams
12. Helpful hint --- do not feel you have to be gentle with the pastry and you do not want to touch it for too long so that the heat of your hands melts it
13. Spray each wellington with oil and
14. Place wellingtons on tray with baking paper
15. Bake in oven for 35-40 minutes 200c / 400f
16. Enjoy !
17. He did say they were terrific ! :)
18. Served with rocket , feta and tomato

title: seasoned baked potatoes
steps:
1. Scrub potatoes and cut in half lengthwise
2. Place cut side up on an ungreased baking sheet
3. Brush with oil
4. Sprinkle with basil , onion salt and garlic powder
5. Bake at 400 degrees fahrenheit for 35 to 40 minutes or until tender

title: fried mashed potatoes
steps:
1. Add the onion to the mashed potatoes
2. Form into hamburger shape
3. Dip patties in flour on both sides
4. Fry in some hot grease until golden brown on each side

title: spaghetti squash with sage and walnuts
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees
2. Cut squash in half lengthwise and deseed
3. Place the squash halves on a roasting rack and season with 1 / 4 teaspoon each of salt and pepper
4. Place 1 tablespoon of butter and 2 sage leaves in the hollowed-out core of each half
5. Bake the squash on a tray on the oven's middle rack until the flesh is just soft--about 1 hour
6. Remove the squash and let it cool until you can work with the flesh comfortably , about 15 minutes
7. Using a fork , scrape the meat of the squash away from the skin , so that you get fluffy spaghetti-like strands
8. Reserve these and discard the skins
9. The squash will hold at this point up to a day ahead of time , in an air-tight container in the fridge
10. Heat the remaining 3 tablespoons of butter in a large saucepan over medium heat
11. When the butter has melted , add the walnuts
12. Toast the nuts and allow the butter to bubble , about 1 minute
13. Add the rest of the sage leaves
14. When the leaves release their aroma and begin to crackle in the pan , add the squash and stir to coat it with the flavored butter
15. Cook for 2 minutes over medium heat until the squash is warm , stirring frequently so the flavors get inside the squash
16. Season the rest of the salt and pepper
17. Serve on a large plate or platter , topped with the cheese

title: coca cola bar b que sauce
steps: 1. Mix all , pour over meat and simmer

title: apple gingerbread cobbler
steps:
1. Stir together 2 cups gingerbread mix and 3 / 4 cup water until smooth
2. Set mixture aside
3. Stir together remaining gingerbread mix and brown sugar
4. Cut in 1 / 4 cup butter until mixture is crumbly
5. Stir in pecans
6. Set aside
7. Combine apple pie filling and remaining 1 / 4 cup butter in a large saucepan , and cook , stirring often , 5 minutes over medium heat or until thoroughly heated
8. Spoon hot apple mixture evenly into a lightly greased 11x7-inch baking dish
9. Spoon gingerbread mixture evenly over hot apple mixture
10. Sprinkle with pecan mixture
11. Bake at 375 for 30 to 35 minutes or until set
12. Serve cobbler with vanilla ice cream

title: smoked salmon cucumber cups
steps:
1. Peel and finely dice one cucumber , place into a bowl
2. Cut remaining cucumbers into 2cm slices and using a melon baller or teaspoon scoop out seeds , leaving a base to form a cup
3. Add remaining ingredients to diced cucumber and mix well
4. Season to taste
5. Fill each cup with salmon mixture , top with extra dill and serve

title: rich  moist secret ingredient pumpkin bread
steps:
1. Sift together first 8 ingredients
2. Beat eggs well in another bowl
3. Add oil , sugar , pumpkin , and vanilla to the eggs and mix well
4. Combine wet mixture with flour mixture gently by hand , pressing out any large lumps with your spoon , just until ingredients are moistened- do not overmix
5. Pour into 2 loaf pans and bake in a preheated oven at 350f for 1 hour to 1 hr 15 minutes
6. Cool in pan 10 minutes then let cool completely on wire racks- don't skip of your loaves will fall apart

title: california tuna roll
steps:
1. Place toasted nori on rolling mat
2. Cover center of nori with sushi rice
3. Mix together mayo with wasabi powder to make wasabi mayo
4. Spread wasabi mayo over rice
5. Place a row of tuna , cucumber and avocado over rice
6. Roll up nori using mat , and moisten the farthest edge of exposed nori to form a seal
7. Slice into serving pieces
8. Serve garnished with pickled ginger , daikon radish , wasabi , and soy sauce , if desired

title: tortellini casserole
steps:
1. Melt the butter in a large saucepan
2. Add garlic and onion and cook gently 3-4 minutes until fragrant and tender
3. Sprinkle with flour
4. Cook 3-4 minutes longer
5. Whisk in milk and bring to a boil
6. Add tomatoes , paste , herbs , s / p and cook 5 minutes
7. Meanwhile , cook tortellini in boiling water for 3 minutes
8. Add the broccoli and continue to cook for 5 minutes
9. Drain very well
10. Combine the pasta and broccoli with the sauce
11. Add grated cheese and transfer to a large baking dish
12. Sprinkle with parmesan
13. Bake in preheated 350 degree oven for 30 minutes

title: easy dilly rolls
steps:
1. In small saucepan , combine cottage cheese , butter , and water
2. Heat over low heat until butter melts , stirring frequently
3. Stir in instant onion and dill seed
4. Set aside to cool for 15 minutes
5. In large bowl , combine 1-1 / 4 cups flour , sugar , yeast , and salt
6. Make sure the cottage cheese mixture is lukewarm
7. Add to flour mixture along with egg
8. Beat until smooth
9. Stir in remaining flour to form a stiff batter
10. Cover and let rise for 30 minutes until doubled in bulk
11. Spray 12 muffin cups with nonstick baking spray with flour
12. Stir down batter by beating with spoon 20-25 strokes
13. Spoon batter into prepared muffin cups
14. Let rise , uncovered , for 20-30 minutes until batter fills cups
15. Preheat oven to 400f
16. Bake rolls for 15-20 minutes or until golden brown
17. Brush with melted butter and remove from pan
18. Cool on wire rack

title: fruit and berry dessert
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Mix fruit / berries with sugar and cornstarch and pour into casserole dish
3. Sprinkle entire box of dry cake mix on top of fruit mixture
4. Drizzle cubes of melted butter over the top and bake for about 1 hour
5. Serve as is or with fresh whipped cream

title: spinach and chickpeas
steps:
1. Wash spinach and drain chickpeas
2. Put the spinach , chickpeas , olive oil and lemon juice in a saucepan , cover and cook over medium heat , stirring occasionally , for about 15 to 20 minutes or until spinach is tender
3. Season with salt and pepper to taste and serve warm

title: sirloin tip pot pie
steps:
1. Prepare the chicken gravy as directed adding all the seasonings , plus the beef flavored soup base and set aside
2. Heat skillet until hot
3. Add most of the olive oil to the skillet and quickly brown the cut up steak and onion
4. Salt and pepper to taste , and set aside
5. In the microwave , partially cook carrots and peas in separate bowls with a small amount of water and covered with cling wrap
6. Use the remaining olive oil to lightly oil a square or round eight inch glass cooking dish
7. Place the meat , onion , carrots and peas in the cooking dish
8. Distribute evenly
9. Pour enough of the gravy over all to bring the level up 3 / 4 inch from the dish rim
10. Lightly push around so gravy gets mixed in but does not disturb meat and vegetables placement too much
11. Cover with the puff pastry turning in the edge
12. Press and seal with a fork to the edge of dish
13. Poke several holes all over the pastry with a fork
14. Bake in a hot oven , 400 degrees fahrenheit , for 40 minutes
15. Ovens vary so until dark golden brown
16. Sometimes it bubbles over so a piece of aluminum foil underneath saves a mess
17. You can brush the pastry with a small amount of beaten egg to add a beautiful golden brown color to the pastry the last 10 minutes of the cooking time
18. Enjoy !

title: jim s burgers
steps:
1. If necessary , start coals heating , start grill , or preheat broiler
2. Spritz bread slices with olive oil on each side
3. Shape beef into oblong patties to fit the bread slices
4. Season with salt and pepper to taste
5. Grill or broil patties until cooked to taste , about 12-15 minutes for medium well
6. Meanwhile , broil or toast bread slices , turning once , until golden on both sides
7. Top patties with cheese slices and grill or broil a few seconds longer , until cheese barely starts to melt
8. Place patties on toasted bread , top with chili strips , and serve
9. Enjoy !

title: peach crumb cobbler
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Spray 9-inch square deep-dish pie plate with non-stick oil
3. In a mixing bowl , combine peaches , sugar , lemon juice , and mint
4. Mix cornstarch and orange juice
5. Let rest 15 minutes , then mix into peaches
6. Pour peach mixture into prepared pie plate
7. Mix flour with brown sugar and cinnamon
8. Use a pastry cutter to cut margarine into flour until mixture resembles course crumbs
9. Sprinkle over peaches
10. Bake 45 minutes
11. Serve hot

title: baked chicken breasts with parmesan garlic crust
steps:
1. Adjust oven rack to upper-middle position and heat oven to 425f combine bread crumbs , parmesan , garlic , oil , salt , and pepper to taste in bowl
2. Pat chicken dry with paper towels and transfer to 13x9 inch baking dish
3. Combine basil and mayonnaise in small bowl and spread mixture evenly over chicken
4. Sprinkle bread-crumb mixture over mayonnaise , pressing lightly to adhere
5. Bake until crumbs are golden brown and instant-read thermometer inserted in thickest part of chicken registers 160f 18-22 minutes
6. Serve with lemon wedges

title: okonomiyaki   japanese pizza
steps:
1. Toast the nori by waving it over a flame until it stiffens slightly , but be careful--it burns easily
2. Crumble into little pieces and set aside
3. Combine all the sauce ingredients in a small saucepan and simmer for 30 seconds , stirring constantly
4. Remove from the heat and cool to room temperature
5. Beat the eggs in a large bowl
6. Add the flour and water and continue beating until you have a batter the consistency of pancake batter
7. Add the sake and salt
8. Fold in the cabbage , carrots , and scallions
9. Be sure to mix the batter and vegetables together evenly
10. Each okonomiyaki will use 1 / 4 of this mixture
11. Heat 1 tbsp
12. Of the oil in a standard 10-inch skillet
13. Spoon 1 / 4 of the batter onto the hot skillet making sure the vegetables are evenly distributed
14. Then sprinkle 1 / 4 of the shrimp or meat of you choice on top
15. Cook each side on medium heat for 2 minutes , until lightly browned
16. Reduce the heat to low and cook , covered , for another 5 minutes , occasionally turning and gently pressing the okonomiyaki with a spatula
17. Prepare three more okonomiyaki as above
18. Keep the finished pancakes warm in a low oven while making the rest , or use two skillets and make two okonomiyaki at a time
19. Serve hot with the sauce to taste--i recommend 1 tbsp
20. Per okonomiyaki-- and top with about a tsp
21. Of mayonnaise and a sprinkling of toasted nori

title: coconut bread
steps:
1. Sift flour , baking powder , cinnamon , nutmeg and salt together into large bowl
2. Stir in sugar and cocunut
3. Beat in eggs , milk and butter
4. Add water , stir well
5. Divide dough into two greased loaf pans
6. Bake for 1 hour at 325 degrees

title: hpnotiq blue dragonfly
steps:
1. Serve over ice in a rocks glass
2. Granish with lemon wedge

title: pomegranate ginger muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425f
2. Grease 12 muffin tins
3. Mix dry ingredients in a large bowl
4. Mix wet ingredients in a medium bowl
5. Make a"well" in your dry ingredients and pour in your wet ingredients until just mixed
6. Overmixing will make your muffins tough
7. You may want to undermix it a bit and finish your mixing with the next step when you add the pomegranate / ginger
8. Fold in pomegranate seeds and ginger
9. Spoon into greased muffin tins
10. Sprinkle tops with sugar , which will caramelize in the oven and make a lovely sugary top
11. Bake for 10-15 minutes until puffed and golden and a toothpick inserted into the center of a muffin comes out clean
12. Let cool for 5-10 minutes in the tin , then remove and cool on a cookie rack , or serve
13. You may use mini-muffin tins or jumbo muffin tins , but the cook time will vary
14. Muffins tend to need to be watched carefully , regardless
15. Another possibility might be to mix some powdered ginger with your sugar topping

title: gluten free sponge cake
steps:
1. Sift cornflour , baking powder and salt together
2. Beat egg whites until stiff but not dry
3. Beat in egg yolks
4. Gradually beat in sugar until mixture forms a figure 8
5. Fold in the dry ingredients
6. Divide into 2 well greased 20 cm sandwich pans
7. Bake at 180 c or 350 f for about 20 minutes
8. Remove from pans and cool on wire rack
9. When cool , top one with whipped cream and jam
10. Place the other on top and dust with icing sugar

title: oven roasted tomatoes with basil and bacon
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180c
2. Place tomatoes , bacon , salt and pepper , minced garlic and 1 / 4 cup of torn basil leaves into a baking dish lined with non stick baking paper
3. Drizzle lightly with olive oil
4. Roast for 30-35 minutes or until the tomatoes are tender and the bacon is crispy
5. Top with basil leaves to serve

title: mrs kitching s smith island 10 layer cake
steps:
1. Lightly grease and flour dust 10 9-inch round pans
2. Oven middle rack , 350f
3. Cream together sugar and butter
4. Add eggs one at a time
5. Beat till smooth
6. Sift flour with salt and baking powder and mix into batter one cup at a time
7. Slowly pour in evaporated milk while mixing
8. Then add vanilla and water till batter is uniform
9. Put 1 / 2 cup of batter into pan , smoothing out with back of spoon
10. Bake for 8 minutes or until it no longer 'sizzles' in pan
11. Layers will be slightly golden and released from pan edges
12. Let cool only 3 minutes in pan
13. Run spatula around edge and cool on rack
14. Icing: melt butter then remove from heat
15. Stir in evaporated milk
16. Whisk in cocoa till smooth and return to low heat for 10 minutes
17. Stir and do not boil or scorch
18. Remove from heat and whisk in confectioners' sugar slowly
19. Return to low heat occasionally stirring for about 45 minutes or until icing is thick and sticks to back of spoon or whisk
20. Cool
21. Put two tablespoons of icing between each layer and spread just barely to the edge before next layer goes on top
22. Take your time as icing will be 'fluid' and harden or dry out slowly

title: beans and greens pasta
steps:
1. Spray a large skillet with cooking spray
2. Saute the onion , mushrooms , garlic , and rosemary until tender , about 5 to 8 minutes
3. Add the spinach and the broth to the skillet , then heat to boiling
4. Reduce heat and simmer , covered , until the spinach is wilted , about 5 to 8 minutes
5. Stir in the beans and cook until the broth is evaporated , about 3 to 4 minutes
6. Stir the bean mixture into the pasta
7. Add half of the cheese , and the pine nuts / almonds
8. Season to taste with salt
9. Sprinkle remaining cheese on top

title: chile verdadero
steps:
1. Put salt and pepper in enough flour to dredge the pork
2. Dredge
3. Put oil into hot skillet and brown the pork
4. In large pot , place a little oil and simmer the onions
5. Then add stock , chiles , tomatillos , cumin , oregano and bay to simmer
6. Add pork after browned
7. Salt and pepper to taste
8. Green chile powder can be added to increase heat
9. Simmer for 3 hours or until the pork falls apart

title: blackberry mini muffins or mini cupcakes   you decide
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Grease a 24 mini-muffin tin with cooking spray
3. Slice the blackberries in half and place in a bowl with the lemon juice
4. Add the sugar and toss away
5. But do so lightly
6. You don't want to hurt the blackberries !
7. Try your best not to eat 'em up !
8. Prepare the batter in a stand mixer or mixing bowl with hand mixer by beating the butter , sugar , eggs , vanilla and milk until smooth
9. Then add the flour , baking soda and salt and beat until smooth , about 2 to 3 minutes
10. Pour some batter into each of the mini muffin wells
11. Fill about 1 / 4 full
12. Add 2 blackberry halves to each well
13. Be sure to not let too much of the liquid from the blackberry bowl get into the batter
14. A little is fine
15. Pour the remaining batter over the top of the blackberries
16. Fill up the muffin tins
17. All the way full is fine !
18. Bake in the preheated oven for 14 to 16 minutes , or until cooked through !
19. Let cool on cooling rack
20. Enjoy !

title: pumped up pecan pie
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees , fit pie crust into a 9-inch pie plate , flute edges
2. Reserve 1 / 2 cup mixed nuts and 1 / 4 cup dried cranberries in a bowl
3. Coarsely chop remaining nuts and cranberries: spread evenly over in crust
4. Whisk together eggs , brown sugar , both syrups , flour and butter in a mediun bowl until well blended
5. Pour over nut mixture
6. Decoratively place reserved nuts and cranberries on top of pie
7. Bake 50 to 60 minutes until set , , remove to rack to cool , enjoy

title: dishwasher salmon
steps:
1. Place the whole salmon in the center of the foil , season with herbs inside and out
2. Place half the slices of butter inside of the fish and the other half on top of the fish
3. Do the same with the slices of lemon , arranging them in the cavity and on top of the fish
4. Fold the foil and roll the edges so that the entire fish is sealed
5. Turn on the dishwasher , normal or hot cycle and run your dishwasher as you normally would
6. By the time the washer is done with the drying cycle , the fish will be done and ready to serve
7. Simply unwrap the fish at the dinner table and serve with vegetables of your choice

title: spinach hummus dip
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients except spinach in food processor and process until smooth
2. If necessary , add tsps of water to thin consistency
3. Add the spinach and process until smooth and dark green
4. Chill to blend flavors before serving

title: sweet potato cranberry casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Mix sweet potatoes and onions and put mixed veggies in two sprayed shallow oven proof dishes
3. Spray the veggies lightly with oil and bake until sweet potatoes are just tender about 20-25 minutes
4. Lower heat on oven to 350f
5. Combine the remaining ingredients , mix well and pour equally into the two casseroles
6. Mix well to coat all the pieces of vegetable
7. Bake uncovered about 30-40 min or until tender and getting sticky , stir once during cooking
8. You may freeze the casseroles , tightly covered , before the final baking
9. Then on the day of your dinner defrost and follow through the final baking
10. Or you may hold it in your refrigerator , tightly covered , for a day and then bake on the day of your dinner

title: don pablo s frijoles a la charra
steps:
1. Saute bacon , jalapeno and onion until well browned
2. Add the beans , tomato and spices
3. Bring to a boil and add cilantro
4. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 15 minutes

title: soy ginger marinade
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a small bowl , cover and refrigerate
2. Can be stored up to 3 days in advance of use

title: cheesy sausage cocktail squares
steps:
1. Cook hamburger meat and sausage in pan until no longer pink , drain grease
2. Cut in velvetta cheese , then add remaining ingredients
3. Spread 1-2 t
4. Of mixture on each cocktail rye , place on greased baking sheet and cook at 400 degrees for 10 minutes

title: easy lemon bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Spray a 9x9 pan with nonstick spray and lightly flour
3. Mix flour , salt , and sugar together
4. Add butter and mix until it clumps
5. I just squish it with my hands until the butter is evenly distributed and looks like breadcrumbs
6. Pat this baby evenly on the pan and bake about 15 minutes until the top appears dry and the edges are lightly brown
7. Cool on wire rack and reduce heat to 350
8. While you're waiting for crust , mix all the topping ingredients together and food processor / mix until well blended
9. Pour mixture on top of the prebaked crust and bake for about 15 - 17 minutes or until the top appears dry
10. Don't overcook , por favor !
11. Cool for an hour
12. Sprinkle with a bit of confectioner's sugar if you wish
13. Cut into 25 squares
14. Make sure you share ! :]

title: grandma andersen s whole wheat buttermilk pancakes
steps:
1. Blend all the dry ingredients together in a large bowl
2. Mix together wet ingedients in a medium bowl , except water
3. Add wet mixture to dry mixture and mix until just moistened
4. Add water starting with 1 c until thin enough to pour easily
5. Cook pancakes on a hot buttered griddle
6. We like ours nice and big , but you can make yours any size

title: yummy pepperoni pizza breadsticks
steps:
1. Dissolve yeast in warm water and let sit 8 minutes
2. Add to mixer bowl
3. Add olive oil , starter , garlic powder , both cheeses , salt , dill , rosemary
4. Mix with bread hook until combined
5. Add flour and mix well , add pepperoni and green onions
6. Mix until incorporated
7. Using a large bowl spray bowl with cooking spray , add dough to bowl
8. Loosely cover dough and let rise in a warm place about an hour
9. Flour a work surface
10. Turn dough onto the work surface and cut into 8 equal pieces
11. Using your hands , shape into 8 long bread sticks
12. You can twist them into spiral sticks , if you like
13. Spray a cookie sheet with cooking spray and sprinkle with a little cornmeal
14. Place 8 bread sticks about 2 apart
15. Cover and let rise 30 minutes
16. Preheat oven to 375f
17. Drizzle top of sticks with olive oil and sprinkle with italian seasoning
18. Sprinkle top of bread sticks with water
19. Place in preheated oven and bake about 20-25 minutes
20. Breadsticks are done when the bottom is lightly golden
21. Serve with marinara sauce and sprinkle with parmesan cheese , or top with mozzarella and broil until cheese is melted

title: cherry tomato gratin
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425f
2. In small bowl , combine breadcrumbs , parmesan , garlic , pepper , and oil until blended
3. Place cherry tomatoes in shallow 1 1 / 2-quart casserole or 9-inch deep-dish pie plate
4. Top with breadcrumb mixture and sprinkle with parsley
5. Bake until heated through and crumbs have browned , about 20 minutes

title: crock pot spaghetti sauce   mmmm oamc
steps:
1. Turn crock pot on high
2. Add all ingredients in phase i to crock pot
3. Add olive oil to large skillet
4. Over medium-high heat wait until olive oil just starts to smoke
5. Saute onions and mushrooms , until onions have browned
6. Add garlic and saut for one minute
7. Add to crock pot
8. Next , in same skillet , brown ground beef
9. Drain fat
10. Add to crock pot
11. Simmer on low for 6-8 hours
12. Add salt and pepper to taste
13. Serve over spaghetti topped with cheese

title: weight watchers italian zero points soup
steps:
1. Put escarole , garlic , onions , spinach , zucchini , red pepper , fennel bulb , vegetable broth , diced tomatoes , red pepper flakes , thyme and oregano into a large soup pot
2. Stir to combine
3. Cover and bring to a boil over high heat
4. Reduce heat to low , and simmer , partly covered , for about 10 minutes
5. Stir in salt , black pepper , parsley and basil
6. Serve
7. Serving size: about 1 cup

title: gluten free 90 second flax bread
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together really well
2. Grease a flat bottom glass bowl , dish or pan such as pyrex or corningware that is about 6" wide across the middle
3. Pour batter into the dish
4. Microwave on high for 90 seconds
5. Remove and
6. When cooled slice it across into 2 slices of bread about 6 inches round and 3 / 8" thick
7. It's very easy to do this even though it's fairly thin

title: lobster and asparagus with lemon butter sauce
steps:
1. Cut the lobster tails along each side of the underside with scissors
2. Pull the lobster flesh away from the shells and cut into thick slices
3. Top and tail the snow peas
4. Break off the woody end of the asparagus
5. Boil , steam or microwave the asparagus until barely tender , add the snow peas and cook for 1 minute longer
6. Drain and refresh under cold water until no longer warm
7. Heat the butter in a pan , add green onions , lemon rind and juice
8. Add the lobster , stir fry until the lobster is just tender then add the pine nuts , asparagus and snow peas
9. Stir until heated through

title: three step stroganoff
steps:
1. Slice round steak into thin strips and stir-fry in oil until no longer pink
2. Stir in soup , water and onion soup mix
3. Reduce heat , cover and simmer for 20 minutes
4. Stir in sour cream , heat through
5. Serve over noodles

title: german strawberry tart   erdbeer tortenboden
steps:
1. Grease an 8 inch raised-based flan tin
2. Sprinkle over 2 tsp sugar and tilt to coat evenly
3. Add 1 level tsp flour and coat similarly , knocking out any excess
4. Place the eggs and remaining sugar in a deep bowl and whisk until the mixture is very thick
5. Sift the flour over the surface of the mixture
6. Fold in gently with a metal spoon , then turn into the prepared tin and tilt to level the surface
7. Place on a baking sheet and bake in the oven at 180 degrees c for 20-25 minutes until the sponge springs back when pressed lightly
8. Allow to cool on a wire rack
9. Arrange the sliced fruit in the flan case
10. Put the strawberry jam and 1 tbsp water in a small saucepan and heat gently together until liquid
11. Cool a little then brush over the fruit

title: jumbo shrimp with pepper salsa
steps:
1. If using a broiler , preheat to high
2. If cooking on bbq , start it up !
3. Soak 8 bamboo skewers in cold water so they won't burn
4. Combine all ingredients for the marinade
5. Add the shrimp and stir to coat them completely
6. Cover and chill while preparing the salsa
7. Mix together all salsa ingredients and season with salt and pepper
8. Thread the cubes of melon onto 8 unsoaked skewers and set aside on serving tray
9. Thread 4 shrimp onto each of the soaked skewers , piercing them through both ends
10. This way should help keep them flat
11. Broil 4 inches from the heat until pink , turning them once
12. Or cook on bbq , turning once until pink
13. This should only take 3-4 minutes
14. Move cooked shrimp to serving tray with the melon
15. Serve with salsa on the side
16. Enjoy !

title: greek grouper
steps:
1. Put olive oil on a piece of grouper
2. Add some blackened seasoning and bake at 350 degrees for 10-15 minutes or until golden brown
3. To make the sauce , blend the remaining ingredients together , put them over fish , and serve

title: super easy cheese and spinach  stuffed mushrooms
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Wipe mushrooms clean with a damp towel
3. Thaw spinach and squeeze out as much moisture as possible
4. In mixing bowl combine all ingredients except mushrooms and parmesan
5. Mix well
6. Fill mushroom caps with mixture and place on cookie sheet
7. Sprinkle parmesan cheese on top
8. Bake 15-20 minutes
9. Serve warm

title: bacon and brussels sprouts hash   tyler florence
steps:
1. Pour oil into a skillet over medium-high heat
2. When shimmering , add bacon and thyme
3. Stir occasionally until bacon is crispy
4. Remove to a paper-towel-lined plate
5. Add brussels sprouts , potatoes and pearl onions to bacon drippings
6. Season with salt and pepper
7. Stir occasionally until golden-brown
8. Add chicken stock and cook 3-5 minutes until vegetables are tender and liquid is nearly evaporated
9. Add balsamic vinegar , parsley and reserved bacon bits
10. Stir well and serve

title: chickpea broccoli casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. In large bowl , mash the chickpeas well , using a potato masher or a firm fork
3. It takes about 2 minutes to get the right consistency
4. Add vegetables and mix well
5. Add the bread crumbs and mix , then add the oil and mix again
6. Finally , add teh vegetable broth and salt , mix one last time
7. Transfer all ingredients to a 9 x 13 casserole dish
8. Press the mixture firmly into the casserole
9. Cover with foil , bake 45 minutes
10. Uncover and bake for 15 more minutes
11. Serve it hot the day you cook it , but it tastes good cold as well

title: fantabulous radish chips
steps:
1. Slice radishs thin
2. Sprinkle with chili powder and salt
3. Shake in a bowl
4. Snack all you want , they are completely guilt free !

title: spectacular midori cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. In bowl , combine all ingredients except frosting
3. Beat 4 minutes
4. Pour into well-greased bundt pan
5. Bake 35 to 45 minutes
6. Remove from oven and cool in pan about 15 minutes
7. Remove from pan , prepare frosting and frost cake while still warm
8. Cool completely before serving
9. Frosting
10. In bowl , mix and beat all ingredients together at high speed until smooth and spreadable
11. Frost cake while still warm

title: amazing braise
steps:
1. Rinse and pat dry all chicken pieces
2. Sprinkle with salt and pepper to taste
3. Heat olive oil in saute pan
4. Add chicken pieces to hot oil and brown on each side
5. Remove chicken from the pan , and set aside
6. Toss garlic , potatoes and carrots in the remaining olive oil and chicken fond in the saute pan
7. Season vegetables with salt and pepper , and sprinkle with the rosemary leaves
8. Saute and stir until the vegetables start to brown
9. Juice the orange , and mix 3 tbsp of the orange juice with the soy sauce , reserving the rest for another use
10. Add chicken back to the pan with the vegetables
11. Drizzle the orange / soy mixture over the chicken
12. Cover the pan , and simmer for 20 minutes , turning the chicken after 10 minutes
13. Serve with a green salad

title: eggplant  aubergine    tomato casserole
steps:
1. Cook onion and eggplant in butter until golden brown
2. Add tomatoes , salt , pepper and mix thouroughly
3. Pour into casserole
4. Top with crumbs
5. Bake at 350 for 30 minutes

title: spinach and roasted cauliflower salad
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees
2. Combine cauliflower , 11 / 2 tbs
3. Olive oil 1 / 4 tsp salt and pepperin a shallow roasting pan , tossing to coat well
4. Roast uncovered 30-35 minutes , stirring twice
5. Remove and allow to cool
6. Meanwhile combine vinegar , mustard , and remaining 1 / 4 tsp salt in a small bowl
7. Whisk in remaining 3 tbs of olive oil until well combined
8. In a large bowl , combine cauliflower , onion and spinach
9. Add vinegar mixture and toss gently
10. Top with parmesan

title: tennessee pride sausage
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients and mix well
2. Store in an air tight container
3. Add 2 tsp of spice mix to 1 pound of fresh ground pork
4. I know our local grocery stores carry fresh ground pork just like hamburger
5. Ask your butcher if you don't see it :)
6. Add a couple tablespoons of oil to pan if your sausage is really lean
7. Pat sausage out into 4-6 patties depending on desired size preference
8. Fry on medium heat for about 4 minutes , flip and fry other side for another 3 minutes
9. Make sure sausage is fully cooked
10. Time may very depending on how thick you make your patties

title: chuckwagon stew
steps:
1. Heat a little oil in a large pot or dutch oven
2. Just enough oil to keep food from sticking
3. Add meat , onion , potatoes , carrots , cumin , salt , pepper , and chili powder to hot oil
4. Saute until the onions turn clear and the meat has browned on all sides
5. This will infuse the seasonings deeply into the meat and vegetables
6. Water
7. ( this means 1 bouillion cube with 1 quart water , or 1 can broth with 17
8. 5 oz water or 2 cups broth and 2 cups water
9. )
10. Add that liquid to the pan along with the tomatoes and their liquid and stir / scrape well to get any browned bits off the bottom
11. Bring to a rolling boil
12. Cover and and reduce to simmer , stirring once or twice
13. Cook at least one hour and taste
14. Adjust seasoning if needed adding more chili powder if you want it spicier
15. Uncover and continue to simmer until meat and veggies are tender and done to your liking
16. Taste and adjust seasoning if desired
17. Great with some warm crusty bread

title: chicken souvlaki salad
steps:
1. Mix all of the marinade ingredients in a bag with the chicken
2. Shake to coat
3. Original recipe didn't call for any marinade time , but we marinated for a couple of hours
4. Broil , grill , or pan fry chicken until done
5. Set chicken aside to cool slightly
6. Cut chicken into 1-inch pieces
7. Combine all dressing ingredients together in a bowl
8. Mix well
9. Combine chicken with salad fixins
10. Pour dressing over all and mix well
11. Enjoy !

title: ginger peach freeze
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan , combine water , sugar , lemon juice , and ground ginger
2. Bring to a boil and remove from heat
3. Add frozen peaches
4. Let stand about a half hour or till peaches are thawed and mix has cooled
5. Add peach mix , half at a time , to a blender container
6. Cover and blend till smooth
7. Move blended mix to a 2 quart rectangular baking dish
8. Cover and freeze for 3 to 4 hours
9. Break up the mix with fork tines , and spoon into dessert dishes
10. Top with fresh peach slices
11. Enjoy !

title: simple bacon and mushroom pasta
steps:
1. Saute the onion , garlic and bacon in the olive oil over a low heat until soft for around 15 minutes , stirring occasionally
2. Meanwhile , cook the tagliatelle in a large pan of slightly salted water according to the instructions on the packet
3. Drain the pasta in a colander and pour over some boiling water to wash away the starch and prevent the pasta from sticking together
4. Stir the mushrooms into the onion and bacon mixture and saute for five minutes
5. Stir in the creme fraiche , season to taste and heat through
6. Remove from the heat and stir in the cooked tagliatelle
7. Serve immediately

title: chocolate macadamia nut cookies
steps:
1. In a large bowl
2. Cream butter , sugar and vanilla
3. Add egg
4. Mix together dry ingredients
5. Add to creamed mixture
6. Mix well
7. Fold in chocolate chips and nuts
8. Drop by teaspoons on greased sheets
9. Bake at 350f degrees for 10 minutes or until golden
10. Glaze---
11. Melt caramels and cream
12. Drizzle over cooled cookies

title: spicy crab cakes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
2. In a large bowl mix together mayonnaise , both mustards , a generous dash of hot sauce , horseradish , and the egg
3. Gently stir in the saltines and crabmeat
4. You may form the crabcakes immediately , however allowing the mixture to sit in the refrigerator for 1 hour will make the shaping easier
5. Divide the mixture into 4-6 large crabcakes , and place on a lightly oiled or nonstick baking sheet
6. Bake for 15-20 minutes , or until a light golden brown
7. Serve immediately
8. Variation:
9. Baltimore crab cakes: add a dash of worcestershire sauce and old bay seasoning to taste

title: italian tomato and pasta salad
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine all ingredients , mixing well
2. Add small amounts of tomato liquid until pasta is evenly moistened
3. Chill several hours to blend flavors
4. Mix well before serving

title: palestinian spinach pies
steps:
1. In the bowl of a standing electric mixer fitted with the dough hook , combine the 1 cup plus 2 tablespoons of all-purpose flour with the whole wheat flour , yeast , water , 1 / 2 teaspoon of salt and 3 tablespoons of the olive oil
2. Mix at medium speed until a soft , supple dough forms , about 10 minutes
3. Using oiled hands , transfer the dough to an oiled bowl
4. Cover with plastic wrap and let the dough stand in a draft-free spot until slightly risen , about 1 hour
5. Meanwhile , in a large skillet , heat the remaining 3 tablespoons of olive oil
6. Add the diced onion and cook over moderate heat until softened , about 7 minutes
7. Add the sumac and lemon juice and season with salt and pepper
8. Stir in the spinach and let cool completely
9. Preheat the oven to 450 and line 2 baking sheets with parchment paper
10. Divide the dough into 10 pieces
11. Form each piece of dough into a ball , dust with flour and let stand for 10 minutes
12. On a lightly floured surface , roll each ball of dough to a 5-inch round
13. Spread the spinach filling over half of each round , leaving a 1 / 2-inch border
14. Brush the rims with water and fold the dough over to enclose the filling
15. Pinch the edges to seal
16. Transfer the spinach pies to the prepared baking sheets and brush the tops with the beaten egg
17. Bake the pies for about 18 minutes , or until golden
18. Shift the pans from top to bottom and front to back halfway through baking
19. Transfer the spinach pies to a platter and serve warm or at room temperature
20. Make ahead: the cooled spinach pies can be tightly wrapped in foil and refrigerated overnight
21. Reheat the pies in the foil in a 325 oven
