22. It is available at middle eastern markets and online from penzeys
23. Com

title: tiramisu fit for a crowd
steps:
1. You first want to make the coffee mixture
2. This can be achieved by brewing about 3-4 tbsp of coffee with about 4 cups of water
3. Add sugar to the brewed coffee , mix well and chill
4. Slice up the angel food cake and set aside
5. Soften the cream cheese in the microwave for approximately 1 minute
6. Then prepare the pudding as directed
7. You will need an extra large bowl or mix it in a stainless steel pot
8. Once the pudding is prepared , add the cream cheese and mix well
9. Fold in cool whip
10. Pour coffee in a large bowl
11. Dip each sliced piece of cake in coffee as you make 1 layer in dish
12. Spoon creamy mixture over top of cake
13. Then repeat steps to make another layer
14. Sprinkle with cocoa powder and let chill for at least 4 hours
15. You can also garnish top with chocolate shavings
16. Enjoy

title: haselnuss bllchen  hazelnut balls
steps:
1. Using a blender or coffee grinder , reduce the hazelnuts to dust or very fine pieces
2. Lightly grease cookie sheet
3. Preheat oven to 300f
4. Beat the egg whites until frothy
5. Add about 2 tablespoons of the sugar to the egg whites , whipping well after each addition
6. Once all the sugar is added , continue beating the meringue until stiff peaks are formed
7. Fold the hazelnut dust into the mixture and tehn make balls of the mixture that are about 1 / 2 inch in diameter
8. Place on the cookie sheets
9. Bake at 300f for 25 minute when done , remove from cookie sheet to cooling rack with spatula

title: dolly mixture cupcakes
steps:
1. Cup cakes:
2. Pre-heat oven to 200c
3. Put all ingredients except milk in a food processor , blitz until smooth
4. Pulse while adding milk down the funnel , to make for a soft , dropping consistency
5. This can be done by hand
6. It should look like a small mixture
7. Spoon into 12 muffin cases
8. Bake for 15-20 minutes or until firm on top and golden brown
9. Turn onto wire rack when bearable
10. Icing:
11. If necessary , cut tops of cakes so they are as flat as possible on top
12. Make up icing following instructions on packet
13. Dollop tbsp or so into a bowl , add colouring of your choice
14. Ice the cakes
15. Decorate with five dolly mixtures on top

title: kumquat pecan bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Lightly grease an 8x5-inch loaf pan
3. To puree kumquats: wash the kumquats and cut each one in half
4. Remove seeds
5. Place kumquat halves in food processor and process until pureed
6. Set aside
7. In a mixing bowl , combine milk , eggs and oil
8. In another bowl , mix flour , sugar , baking powder , salt , and baking soda
9. Add liquid mixture to the dry ingredients , and stir until moistened
10. Fold in pureed kumquats and pecans
11. Bake in a 350 oven for 50-60 minutes
12. Cool and remove from pan

title: french vanilla cappuccino
steps:
1. Using a saucepan , add 1 cup of milk and 1 / 2 tea spoons of vanilla
2. On a medium heat warm the milk until it starts bubbling
3. Remove the milk from heat and stir sugar in to taste
4. Using a hand frother or blender whisk milk until frothy
5. Half fill a cup with fresh hot coffee
6. Add the hot milk to almost fill cup
7. Dust the top of cup with cinnamon

title: blue cheesecake
steps:
1. Arrange the oven rack in the center of the oven
2. Preheat the oven to 375f remove as much skin as possible from each clove , place in a small baking dish without crowding , cover tightly with aluminum foil , and bake until the garlic is very tender and easily squeezed from the skin , 35 minutes
3. Set aside until cool enough to handle
4. Meanwhile , combine the water and cornmeal in a small saucepan
5. Bring to a boil , stirring often , then add the chopped garlic , basil , herbes de provence , and salt
6. Reduce the heat to a simmer and cook until smooth and creamy , stirring occasionally and adjusting the heat as necessary so the polenta doesnt overcook or bubble up and splatter , 12 to 15 minutes
7. While the polenta is cooking , place the cream cheese and blue cheese in a large mixing bowl
8. Add the eggs one at a time and mix by hand or beat with an electric mixer until the eggs are thoroughly incorporated
9. Set aside
10. When the garlic is done , reduce the heat to 325 degrees f
11. Lightly oil a 9-inch springform pan or spray with nonstick cooking spray
12. When the polenta is done , remove it from the heat and stir in the parmesan cheese
13. Let cool for 5 minutes
14. With a rubber spatula , press the polenta into the bottom of the prepared springform pan and set aside
15. Pour the reserved cheese filling evenly over the polenta crust
16. Tap the pan lightly on the counter to remove any air bubbles
17. Squeeze the garlic cloves from their skins and arrange them around the perimeter of the pan at equal distances
18. Sprinkle the hazelnuts evenly in the center of the cheesecake
19. Place the cheesecake on a baking sheet to catch any drips , transfer to the oven , and bake for 1 hour , or until the cake springs back when lightly jiggled and the internal temperature on an instant-read thermometer reaches 160 degrees f
20. Cool on a wire rack for at least 1 hour
21. To serve , release and remove the sides of the springform pan
22. Serve the cheesecake warm or at room temperature , cut into slices as an appetizer or spread onto crostini or crackers for a more rustic look
23. The cheesecake can be covered and kept in the refrigerator for up to 1 week
24. If serving from the refrigerator , slice and warm it in a 350 degree f oven or microwave briefly before serving

title: cleo s pumpkin dog biscuits
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. In large bowl , whisk together eggs and pumpkin to smooth
3. Stir in dry milk , sea salt , and dried parsley
4. Add rice flour gradually , combining with spatula or hands to form a stiff , dry dough
5. Turn out onto lightly floured surface and if dough is still rough , briefly knead and press to combine
6. Roll dough between 1 / 4 1 / 2 depending on your dogs chew preferences , and use biscuit or other shape cutter to punch shapes , gathering and re-rolling scraps as you go
7. Place shapes on cookie sheet , no greasing or paper necessary
8. If desired , press fork pattern on biscuits before baking , a quick up-and-down movement with fork , lightly pressing down halfway through dough
9. Bake 20 minutes
10. Remove from oven and carefully turn biscuits over , then bake additional 20 minutes
11. Allow to cool completely on rack before feeding to dog
12. Brown rice flour gives the biscuits crunch and promotes better dog digestion
13. Many dogs have touchy stomachs or allergies , and do not , like many people i know , tolerate wheat
14. Makes up to 75 small biscuits or 50 medium biscuits

title: three bean salad  high protein
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients in a large bowl
2. Cover and refrigerate , stirring occasionally , at least 3 hours
3. Serve and enjoy !

title: easy peach crisp for two
steps:
1. Mix all filling ingredients together and put in small casserole dish
2. For topping , mix flour , brown sugar and oats together and spoon evenly on top of filling
3. Lay thin slices of butter on top of topping mixture
4. Bake 350 degrees for 30 minutes

title: vegan french onion soup
steps:
1. Heat the olive oil over medium-low heat in a soup pot
2. Add the onions and saut them until golden , being careful not to burn - adjust heat down if necessary
3. Add the garlic and continue to saut slowly until the onions are lightly and evenly browned , stirring frequently , about 20 to 25 minutes
4. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees
5. Pour the water over the onions and give them a good stir
6. Then add the broth , wine , and mustard
7. Bring to a gentle boil , then lower the heat
8. Cover and simmer for about 15 minutes
9. Season to your tastes with salt and pepper
10. While the soup is simmering , cut the bread into 1-inch-thick slices , allowing 1 or 2 slices per serving depending on the size of your soup bowls
11. Lay the slices on a baking sheet and bake them for about 15 minutes until they are dry and crisp , turning the slices over once about halfway through the baking time
12. Watch that they don't burn
13. To assemble the soup , place one layer of bread in each ovenproof bowl and ladle a serving of soup over it
14. If you're using the cheese - sprinkle about 1 / 4 cup of the grated cheese over each
15. Place the bowls back onto the baking sheet and bake them for approximately 10 minutes , or until the cheese is melted
16. Serve immediately

title: aruba ariba non alcoholic
steps:
1. Pour all ingredients into a pitcher and stir lightly
2. Serve over ice in a tall glass with a splash of grenadine
3. If you like , you can garnish with a slice of orange or pineapple
4. Enjoy !

title: crab and andouille jambalaya
steps:
1. In a medium to large enameled cast-iron pot , heat the olive oil
2. Add the andouille and cook over med-high to high heat , stirring occasionally , until lightly browned , about 3 minutes
3. Transfer to a bowl
4. Add the onion , bell pepper , celery and garlic to the same pot
5. Cover and cook over med-high heat , stirring occasionally , until the veggies are soft , about 3 minutes
6. Add the old bay , rice , andouille and cook , stirring occasionally , until the rice is opaque , about 2 minutes
7. Add the chicken stock , water and thyme , season lightly with salt and pepper and bring to a boil - then turn heat to very low
8. Cover and cook over very low heat until the rice is tender and the liquid is absorbed , about 15 minutes
9. Fluff the rice with a fork and stir in the crab and scallions
10. Cover and let stand for 2-3 minutes , just until the crab is hot
11. Discard the thyme sprig
12. Serve the jambalaya in bowls , passing the hot sauce at the table

title: carolina bbq rub
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a small bowl and mix well
2. Use as a dry rub on beef , chicken , lamb or pork

title: cellophane noodles with garlic  cucumbers and cilantro   ww
steps:
1. Bring a large pot of water to a boil
2. Add noodles , simmer 3 minutes and drain
3. Stir together cilantro , garlic , oil , vinegar , sugar and fish sauce in a large bowl
4. Add noodles , carrots , snowpeas and cucumber
5. Toss well
6. Yields about 1 1 / 2 cups per serving

title: chicken vegetable soup with orzo
steps:
1. Combine water and chicken in a 3-quart casserole
2. Cover with lid
3. Microwave at high 30 minutes or until chicken is done , stirring after 15 minutes
4. Drain in a colander over a bowl , reserving cooking liquid
5. Cool chicken slightly
6. Remove chicken from bones , and discard bones
7. Shred chicken with 2 forks to measure 2 1 / 2 cups
8. Combine broccoli and next 4 ingredients in casserole
9. Cover
10. Microwave at high 8 minutes or until tender , stirring after 4 minutes
11. Add the reserved cooking liquid , chicken , pasta , salt , and pepper
12. Cover
13. Microwave at high 6 minutes or until pasta is tender
14. Ladle soup into 6 bowls
15. Sprinkle each serving with cheese

title: lemon pound cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Cream butter
3. Add granulated sugar , and beat until light and fluffy
4. Add lemon zest , lemon juice , and sour cream
5. Sift together dry ingredients including flour powdered sugar , baking powder & soda , and salt
6. Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form
7. Add flour mixture to butter mixture in increments until combined
8. Fold in eggwhites
9. Spread into lightly greased loaf pan
10. Bake in preheated oven for 55 minutes
11. Cool on a wire rack

title: potato and ricotta ravioli  5fix
steps:
1. Mix mashed potatoes , ricotta cheese , chives and garlic together
2. Season with salt and pepper to taste
3. Lay out wonton wrapper on counter
4. Spoon mixture one inch apart on wanton wrapper
5. Using water , brush edges of wrapper
6. Lay second sheet on top , careful to line up the sheets
7. Using a pastry or ravioli cutter , cut down horizontally and vertically on pasta , making 4 even squares of ravioli
8. Do this until all of the mixture is used up
9. Bring pasta to a boil in a pot , seasoned with salt and olive oil
10. Wait until you can clearly see through them and carefully take them out on a plate topping with a sauce or cheese of your choice

title: new england soup factory s spicy chickpea and butternut soup
steps:
1. Heat olive oil and garlic in a large heavy stockpot
2. Saut 1-2 minutes
3. Add onions , carrots and celery
4. Saut 10-15 minutes
5. Add squash , canned tomatoes , stock , tomato juice , soy sauce , lime juice , chickpeas , ginger and coriander
6. Bring to a boil
7. Cook until all the vegetables are tender , approx 30 minutes
8. Add coconut milk , flaked coconut , coconut extract and cilantro , warm through

title: citrus vodka
steps:
1. Fold 1 strip orange peel in half crosswise without breaking and thread onto skewer
2. Repeat with 1 strip each lemon and lime peels
3. Repeat , alternating remaining peels
4. Push skewer through neck of clean bottle
5. Being careful not to break peels
6. A chopstick may help this process
7. Fill 1 empty , clean 750-ml clear bottle with a cork
8. With vodka
9. Cork and chill at least 1 week and up to three weeks before serving

title: no bake raspberry lemon bars
steps:
1. Reserve 20 berries for the garnish
2. Mix crumbs and butter together and press into 9" square pan
3. Refrigerate crust till filling is made
4. Beat the cream cheese , marshmallow creme and lemon juice with mixer on medium speed till light and fluffy
5. Stir in the raspberries
6. Spoon into crust
7. Refrigerate 4 hours cut into 20 bars
8. Tope each one with a berry
9. Time indicated is chill time

title: gina s apple joy
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Cream butter , sugar & velveeta cheese
3. Add flour and mix well
4. Place apples at the bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan then pour cheese mixture over apples
5. Bake for 45 minutes

title: beefy tex mex skillet
steps:
1. In medium-sized skillet , cook beef , onion and peppers until beef is brown and vegetables are tender
2. Drain if necessary
3. Stir in tomatoes , beans , chili powder , salt , cumin , rice and water
4. Cover and simmer over medium-low heat , stirring occasionally , for 20 minutes
5. Top with cheese
6. Cover and heat until cheese melts , about 3 minutes
7. Before serving , top individual servings with salsa and sour cream

title: wonder brownies
steps:
1. Cream sugar , eggs , oil , and vanilla
2. Add dry ingrediants
3. Beat well
4. Pour batter into an oiled 9x13 inch pan
5. Bake at 350 degrees for approximately 30 minute do not overbake

title: tatiana s vegetable soup
steps:
1. In a large dutch oven , saute onions in olive oil
2. Add celery , saute until lightly browned
3. Add the rest of the vegetables to the pan as you slice them
4. Add corn and peas
5. When all vegetables have been added to the pot , add the tomatoes and juice , salt and pepper
6. Bring to a boil and simmer about one hour
7. Serve with freshly made bread
8. Optional: pan toast over high heat 1 / 2 cup dry breadcrumbs in 1 teaspoon olive oil
9. Add 1 / 4 teaspoon garlic salt
10. Sprinkle 1 tablespoon crumbs over each bowl of soup
11. Optional: chop 1 / 2 cup of parsley fine , sprinkle 1 tablespoon over each bowl of soup

title: spareribs   rub  dry
steps:
1. Mix molasses and sugar together stir
2. Add all other ingredients and mix well
3. Pull membrane off of ribs - found on site an easy way to remove the membrane is to work a spoon , into the bottom center of the membrane , work it back and forth to form a "pocket" then slide thumbs in and work the membrane off from the center outward to the ends
4. Use rub generously on spare ribs
5. Rub is sufficient for two to three full rack of ribs or more - i tend to put a lot on
6. I have retained juices from cooking as extra sauce when serving ribs

title: elegant salmon
steps:
1. Cut salmon fillet into 4 serving pieces
2. Remove any small bones
3. Peel 1 grapefruit
4. Cut into segments between membranes
5. Set aside
6. From remaining grapefruit , squeeze enough juice to measure 1 / 4 cup
7. In 1-quart saucepan over medium-high heat , heat red wine to boiling
8. Cook wine until reduced by half , 3 to 4 minutes
9. Stir in grapefruit juice , sugar and 1 / 4 tsp salt
10. Keep sauce warm
11. In cup , mix oil , dried thyme , pepper and 1 / 2 tsp salt
12. Spray rack in broiling pan with nonstick spray
13. Place salmon pieces , skin-side up , on rack
14. With broiling pan at closest position to source of heat , broil salmon 3 minutes
15. Turn salmon and brush with oil mixture
16. Broil 5 minutes longer or until fish flakes easily with a fork
17. To serve , place 1 piece of salmon on each of 4 warm dinner plates
18. Spoon grapefruit sauce over
19. Garnish with grapefruit segments and fresh thyme
20. Makes 4 servings

title: niagara peach and blueberry french toast
steps:
1. Make 2 sandwiches with the bread using the softened cream cheese as filling
2. For the batter , beat the eggs , milk , cinnamon and nutmeg together
3. Slice the peaches and saute over medium heat in butter until slightly soft
4. Add the blueberries and amaretto
5. Let simmer for a minute or so
6. Dip the sandwiches into the egg batter and cook until golden brown and crispy
7. Transfer to a warmed plate and slice on the diagonal
8. Pour fruit over top of the toast
9. Garnish with a sprinkling of confectioners sugar and toasted almonds

title: joanne s spicy shrimp salsa
steps:
1. Drop the fresh tomatoes into a small pan of boiling water for about 2 minutes or until the skins blister
2. Remove from the water , cool , and peel
3. Coarsely chop the fresh or canned tomatoes and place in a large bowl
4. Stir in the remaining ingredients
5. Cover and refrigerate at least 4 hours
6. Serve with baked tortilla chips or as a side dish
7. For a thicker salsa , combine all the ingredients except shrimp in a food processor
8. Pulse 3 times or until desired consistency
9. Stir in shrimp

title: hungarian style cabbage rolls soooo good
steps:
1. In large pot , boil cabbage whole until tender enough to remove leaves
2. Place in cold water in sink
3. When cool enough to handle , remove leaves and let float in water
4. Mix hamburger and rice , add salt and pepper to taste
5. Place the 2 ham hocks in bottom of pot
6. Roll large golf ball size hamburger mixture in cabbage leaves and stack on top of hocks
7. Cover with water just to the top of rolls
8. Don't go above the rolls with water
9. Spread the sauerkraut over the top of rolls and bring to a boil
10. As soon as it boils , reduce heat to simmer and cover for at least 6 hours
11. Serve with mashed potatoes for an ultimate taste sensation
12. Very easy and the final product is awesome ! no tomatoes ? wow ! hope you enjoy as much as we do !

title: pritikin fruitcake
steps:
1. Place fruits , spices and water into a large saucepan and heat till simmering
2. Simmer for about 3-4 minutes and then remove from heat , allow to cool for about 30 minutes but not to get cold
3. Add flour , milk and egg white and mix well
4. Line a medium caketin with baking paper and pour in mix
5. Bake in a moderately hot oven for 45 minutes

title: slow cooker rice pudding
steps:
1. Put all in slow cooker , stir , turn on heat
2. Stir occasionally - at least once an hour - no skin should form and the rice should plump up nice and slow
3. Keep it cooking until it just a bit wetter than the consistency you like as some more liquid is absorbed as it cools
4. Serve hot , warm or cold

title: cucumber  bean sprout and red onion salad
steps:
1. Prepare the salad ingredients and put them in a salad bowl that is large enough to hold them all
2. Put the dressing ingredients in a small bowl , and whisk to combine
3. Toss together the salad ingredients and dressing , and serve

title: cheesy rotel corn casserole
steps:
1. Saute' onion in 1 t of the butter
2. Melt remaining butter , and mix with all other ingredients
3. Pour into buttered casserole dish and bake at 350 until slightly set , about 25 minutes

title: chinese ramen broccoli slaw salad
steps:
1. Mix all dry ingredients together , sprinkle with ramin seasoning
2. Then mix dressing ingredients , add to salad and mix well
3. Can be served right away or chilled

title: moo goo gai pan ii
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , toss chicken with ginger , garlic and 1 tablespoon corn starch
2. Set aside
3. In a small bowl , combine remaining 1 tablespoon cornstarch , chicken broth , soy sauce and sesame oil , set aside
4. In a saute pan , saute almonds in butter , set aside
5. In a wok or large skillet heat oil over med-high heat
6. Add chicken and cook stirring quickly and frequently 3 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink
7. Add sherry , mushrooms , snow peas , red pepper , green onions , water chestnuts , salt and pepper and stir fry 4-5 minutes or until red bell pepper is tender-crisp
8. Stir soy mixture until blended then pour into wok , stirring constantly
9. Bring to a boil and boil 1 minute
10. Add almonds
11. Serve with rice

title: light as a feather banana bread
steps:
1. Mash bananas
2. Cream shortening , sugar and egg yolks and add to bananas
3. Add soda dissolved in hot water
4. Add nuts , vanilla and banana extracts
5. Sift flour and salt together and add to mixture
6. Fold in beaten egg whites
7. Put in greased 9 x 5 loaf pan
8. Bake at 325 degrees for 45 to 55 minutes , until toothpick comes out clean
9. Makes one large loaf

title: 2bleu s white lasagna  lite bleu
steps:
1. Spray non-stick cooking spray in a large skillet
2. Saute' chicken with garlic , onions , mushrooms , italian seasoning , salt and pepper
3. Cook until done
4. Remove from heat and transfer to a large bowl
5. And one 16 oz jar of alfredo sauce
6. Set aside
7. Mix together steamed broccoli , carrots , and roasted red peppers
8. Set aside
9. In a medium bowl mix ricotta and mozzarella cheese , parsley , and egg set aside
10. Preheat oven to 350f pour 1 / 2 of the remaining jar of alfredo sauce in bottom of a deep 9x13-inch casserole dish , spreading out evenly
11. Layer as follows: 1 / 3 cooked lasagne noodles
12. 1 / 2 ricotta / mozzarella cheese mixture
13. 1 / 2 chicken mixture
14. 1 / 2 vegetable mixture
15. Repeat
16. Finally , top with remaining pasta and 1 / 2 jar of alfredo sauce
17. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese and bake for about 1 hour
18. Let stand 10-15 minutes before serving

title: spam a la king
steps:
1. In large saucepan , saut green pepper in butter until tender
2. Blend in flour , salt , and pepper until smooth
3. Stir in water , half-and-half , and bouillon cube
4. Cook over low heat , stirring until bouillon dissolves and mixture boils and thickens
5. Add spam and mushrooms
6. Cook and stir 3 minutes
7. Serve over hot , cooked rice or toast

title: kaiser rolls  bread machine
steps:
1. Bread machine method:place all of the ingredients into the pan of your machine , program the machine for manual or dough , and press start
2. About 10 minutes before the end of the final kneading cycle , examine the dough's consistency
3. It should be quite stiff , but not at all "gnarly
4. " adjust its consistency with additional flour or water , as necessary
5. Allow the machine to complete its cycle
6. Shaping:transfer the dough to a lightly greased work surface , and divide it into six equal pieces
7. Shape the pieces into round balls , and place them on a lightly greased or parchment lined baking sheet
8. Working with one ball of dough at a time , center your kaiser stamp over the dough
9. Press down firmly , cutting to the bottom but not all the way through the dough
10. This is important
11. If you don't cut deeply enough , the shape disappears as the roll bakes
12. If you cut too deeply , the roll will form "petals" as it rises and look like a daisy , not a kaiser roll
13. Practice makes perfect ! repeat with the remaining rolls
14. Place the rolls cut-side down onto a lightly greased or parchment-lined baking sheet
15. Cover the rolls , and allow them to rise for 45 minutes to 1 hour , or until they've almost doubled in volume
16. Turn the rolls cut-side up
17. Dip tops in milk and coat with poppy or sesame seeds , if desired
18. Bake the rolls in a preheated 425f oven for 15 to 17 minutes , or until they're golden brown
19. Remove them from the oven , and cool on a wire rack

title: mock danish
steps:
1. In a small bowl , microwave cream cheese 15 seconds or just enough to soften it
2. Stir in egg until smooth
3. Add sweetener - artificial or otherwise , as desired
4. Add vanilla , salt , and cinnamon
5. Microwave 1
6. 5 to 2
7. 5 minutes , until just soft in center
8. Turn occasionally if you don't have a turntable microwave
9. Also good with jam

title: zwiebelwhe  swiss onion tart
steps:
1. Crust:
2. Pulse flour , baking powder , and salt in a food processor to combine
3. Add butter and pulse until pea-sized pieces form
4. Add water
5. Pulse briefly
6. Transfer dough to a floured work surface
7. Form into a disk
8. Wrap in plastic wrap
9. Chill for 1 hour
10. Heat oven to 425f transfer dough to a floured work surface
11. Roll dough into a 13-inch circle
12. Transfer to an 11-inch fluted tart pan with a removable bottom , pressing into bottom and sides
13. Trim excess dough
14. Chill for 30 minutes
15. Prick bottom of dough with a fork
16. Cover bottom with a sheet of parchment paper
17. Fill with pie weights or dried beans
18. Bake until crust is set , about 20 minutes
19. Remove paper and b eans
20. Bake until crust is light brown , about 15 minutes
21. Let cool
22. Filling:
23. Cook bacon in a 4-quart saucepan over medium heat until crisp , 7-8 minutes
24. Using a slotted spoon , transfer bacon to a plate
25. Discard bacon fat
26. Add butter
27. Add onions and season with salt
28. Reduce heat to low , cover , and cook , stirring occasionally , until soft , about 10 minutes
29. Uncover
30. Cook until lightly browned , 10 minutes
31. Let cool
32. Whisk milk , cream , and eggs in a bowl
33. Add reserved bacon and onions along with cheese
34. Season with salt , pepper , and nutmeg
35. Pour filling into tart
36. Place on baking sheet
37. Place tart in oven and reduce heat to 400f bake until filling is golden brown and set , 45-50 minutes
38. Transfer tart to a wire rack to let cool completely before slicing and serving

title: raspberries   crystallized ginger smoothie
steps:
1. Blend all the ingredients until smooth as possible
2. Taste and adjust any ingredient if needed by adding more to your taste
3. Enjoy in a tall glass !

title: oven baked barbecue style baby back ribs
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. In a large bowl , thoroughly combine ketchup , molasses , brown sugar and white vinegar
3. Stir in onion , garlic , dry mustard and cayenne pepper
4. Let rest 15 minutes
5. Pour in bourbon , mixing all ingredients to form a thick sauce
6. Season ribs on all sides with kosher salt and pepper
7. Set seasoned ribs in a roasting pan , then brush with thick layer of sauce , reserving the rest for basting
8. Roast ribs 15 minutes at 375 degrees , then lower oven to 325 degrees
9. Continue to roast for approximately 1 14 hours , basting ribs with reserved sauce about every 30 minutes until ribs are tender and falling off the bone
10. Remove from oven
11. Let rest 10 minutes
12. Slice into individual portions and serve warm

title: linguini with creamy spinach
steps:
1. Remove any tough stems from the fresh spinach
2. In large frying pan , melt butter over low heat
3. Add green onions and garlic and cook for 1-2 minutes
4. Add spinach and salt and stir until wilted
5. Simmer until liquid evaporates from spinach , about 5 minutes
6. In large pot of boiling water , cook linguini according to package directions
7. Reserve 1 cup of pasta water
8. Drain linguini and toss with 3 / 4 cup of pasta water , spinach mixture , cream cheese , parsley , and ground pepper
9. If sauce seems too thick , add the rest of the reserved pasta water , otherwise you can throw out the remaining 1 / 4 cup pasta water
10. Salt to taste

title: ellen s spicy gingerbread men
steps:
1. In a large bowl , cream margarine and sugar til smooth
2. Stir in , molasses and egg yolk
3. Combine flour , salt , baking powder , baking soda , cinnamon , cloves , ginger , and nutmeg
4. Blend into the molasses mix
5. Til smooth
6. Cover and chill for at least 1 hour
7. Preheat oven to 350%
8. On lightly floured surface , roll the dough to 1 / 4 thickness
9. Cut into desired shapes
10. Place 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheets
11. Bake for 8- 10 minutes
12. Remove and cool
13. Frost and decorate
14. At easter , for an added surprise , i like to dip them in melted chocolate and then decorate

title: cuban stuffed avocados
steps:
1. Cut avocados in half and peel them carefully
2. Mix vinegar , oil , paprika , salt and pepper
3. Marinate the avocados in the mix
4. Place in the refrigerator
5. Cut lobster in small cubes , mix well with mayonnaise
6. Fill avocado halves , decorate with olives and pimentos
7. Serve cold over lettuce leaves

title: irish nachos
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450f
2. Arrange the waffle fries on a baking sheet and cook according to package directions , adding about 10 minutes onto the baking time to make them extra crispy
3. When the fries have about 10 minutes left , place a medium skillet over medium-high heat with 2 turns of the pan of evoo , about 2 tablespoons
4. Add the corned beef to the skillet and saut until light golden brown and heated through , 2-3 minutes
5. Add the onions and cabbage to the pan , and cook until the onions have softened and cabbage has wilted , 4-5 minutes
6. Season with salt and pepper and reserve warm
7. While the veggies are cooking , place a medium pot over medium-high heat and melt the butter
8. Add the flour to the pot and cook for about a minute
9. Whisk the beer into the mixture and cook for about 30 seconds to cook off the alcohol
10. Whisk the chicken stock into the pan and bring up to a bubble
11. Simmer until thickened , 2-3 minutes , then remove from heat and stir in the cheese to melt
12. Season the sauce with salt and pepper
13. To serve , arrange the crispy waffle fries on a platter , top them with the corned beef and cabbage mixture and douse with a good helping of cheese sauce

title: mandarin vegetable medley
steps:
1. In a large skillet , bring asparagus and broth to a boil
2. Reduce heat
3. Cover and simmer for 3 minutes or until crisp-tender
4. Drain
5. Immediately place the asparagus in ice water
6. Drain and pat dry
7. In a large bowl , combine the peas , corn , oranges , water chestnuts , celery , onions and asparagus
8. In a small bowl , whisk the lemon juice , oil , soy sauce , honey , mustard , garlic , pepper and salt
9. Pour over vegetables
10. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour
11. Sprinkle with sesame seeds before serving

title: seven layer dip
steps:
1. In small bowl , mix taco seasoning with sour cream
2. Evenly spread beans on the bottom of 9 x 13-inch baking dish
3. Spread sour cream over beans , followed by guacamole , then salsa
4. Top with shredded cheese
5. Chill for at least 2 hours
6. Serve with tortilla chips

title: wolfgang s garlic bread
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 500 degrees
2. In a blender , combine the garlic , basil , rosemary , sage , chili flakes and a pinch of salt
3. Puree
4. With the blender running , slowly drizzle in the olive oil
5. Slice the bread into 1 / 2 inch thick slices and place on a cookie sheet
6. Brush with the garlic pesto
7. Sprinkle with parmesan and mozzarella , if desired
8. Bake on the upper rack until golden brown and bubbly , about 5 to 7 minutes

title: vegan butter
steps:
1. Mash the avocado and mix all ingredients together in a bowl until creamy smooth
2. Joila , it is ready to use on your sandwich or toast

title: rhubarb bread pudding
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease an 11 x 7-inch baking dish
3. Combine the cubed bread and rhubarb , and place in the baking dish
4. In a bowl whisk together evaporated milk , water , eggs , sugar , rind , vanilla and cinnamon
5. Pour egg mixture evenly over the rhurbarb and bread in the baking dish
6. Let stand for about 10 minutes
7. Bake for 50-60 minutes , or until a knife inserted in middle comes out clean
8. Set oven to broil
9. Sprinkle the top of the baked bread pudding with brown sugar
10. Broil about 6 inches from heat for about 1-2 minutes , or until sugar melts and the top is golden
11. Best served warm

title: irish mashed potatoes
steps:
1. Heat 1 / 2 the butter and one tablespoon of the cooking oil in a frying pan over a high heat
2. When the butter starts to bubble , add in the onions and cook , stirring constantly , for five minutes or until the onions start to wilt
3. Turn the heat down very low and continue to cook , stirring occasionally , until the onions are evenly browned and wilted , but not crisp
4. In ireland , potatoes are always boiled in their skins , drained and then left in the hot pan for the skins to dry and crack before they are peeled and mashed
5. If you like , though , you can also peel the potatoes beforehand , wash the starch off , then boil in salted water until tender
6. Drain and mash
7. Meanwhile , trim and slice the spring onions , including all the dark green bits
8. Place in a pan with the milk and simmer until tender
9. Season with salt and pepper
10. Melt the remaining butter
11. Serve the mash in a mound on each plate , making a well in the centre of each mound to fill with the remaining melted butter
12. Top with the onions
13. Serve immediately and encourage your diners to dip their spoonfuls of mashed potato into the pools of butter

title: gourmet potato skins
steps:
1. Rinse potatoes , prick all over with a fork and place on a bed of salt in a baking dish
2. Bake in a preheated 400f oven for an hour or until just tender , turning once
3. After the potatoes have cooled slightly , cut in half lengthwise and , using a small spoon , scoop out the flesh , leaving about 1 / 4 inch of potato lining each half
4. Brush the potato halves inside & out with butter and place on a baking sheet
5. Sprinkle with half the cheese , fill the potatoes with ham , red pepper & green onions
6. Season with salt & freshly ground pepper and top with remaining cheese
7. Bake for 15 minutes or until hot & bubbling

title: festive fruit tart
steps:
1. Press pastry onto the bottom and up the sides of an ungreased 9-inch tart pan with a removable bottom
2. Trim edges
3. Generously prick the bottom with a fork
4. Bake at 450f for 10-12 minutes or until golden brown
5. Cool completely on a wire rack
6. In a small mixing bowl , beat the cream cheese , sugar , vanilla and 1 / 2 teaspoon almond extract until smooth
7. Spread over crust
8. Arrange fruit over cream cheese mixture
9. Start with peach or nectarine slices in the center formed like a flower , circle the peach or nectarine slices with the blueberries and then the raspberries
10. In a small microwave-safe bowl , combine apricot preserves and remaining almond extract
11. Microwave , uncovered , on high for 20-30 seconds or until warm
12. Brush over fruit
13. Chill until serving

title: southwest steak   beans  crock pot
steps:
1. Trim excess fat from steak
2. Place onions and garlic in bottom of 3-4 quart slow cooker and top with steak
3. Mix salsa , oregano , chili powder , salt , and pepper in small bowl and pour over meat
4. Top with drained black beans
5. Cover slow cooker and cook on low for 7-9 hours until meat is tender
6. Remove meat from slow cooker and slice into thin strips against the grain
7. Turn heat to high and return beef to slow cooker along with sliced peppers
8. Cover and cook on high for 30 minutes , until peppers are tender
9. Serve with rice

title: sausage rolls the australian way
steps:
1. 1
2. Preheat oven to 425f in a large bowl , mix together the sausage , onion , breadcrumbs , salt , pepper and milk or cream
3. 2
4. Unfold the puff pastry onto a lightly floured work surface
5. Cut each sheet in two lengthwise to make four long rectangles
6. Form a log of sausage down the center of each puff pastry sheet , leaving a 1-inch edge
7. Starting from a long edge , roll the puff pastry up and over the sausage , brushing the edge with the beaten egg to seal
8. Pinch the ends closed
9. 3
10. Cut each roll into quarters
11. Place the rolls seam-side down on a parchment or wax paper-lined baking sheet and brush the tops with the egg wash
12. 4
13. Place in the oven and bake for 5 minutes
14. Reduce heat to 350f , and bake for another 30 to 35 minutes , or until the pastry is puffed and golden and the sausage is cooked through
15. 5
16. Let cool for a few minutes , then serve with ketchup
17. Variations
18. Add extra flavorings to your sausage mix as you like: chopped parsley , thyme , curry powder , crumbled sage , garlic powder , paprika
19. Appetizer portions: cut each rolled up puff pastry log into 8 portions instead of 4 to make appetizer-sized sausage rolls
20. Adjust down the cooking time to allow for the smaller size
21. Sprinkle the rolls with sesame seeds or paprika before baking

title: costa rican marinade
steps:
1. Using a shallow non-metal dish or reasealable plastic bag add all the ingredients and mix together well
2. Up to 3 pounds of beef , chicken , or pork can be placed in the marinade and refrigerated for 8 hours but no longer than 24
3. Cover the dish or seal the plastic bag and turn meat occasionally
4. Grill meat to desired doneness and discard remaining marinade

title: curried savory veggie neatballs
steps:
1. To make the"meat" balls , in a large bowl combine the ground meat alternative , 1 / 4 cup of the tofu , the peanuts , fresh ginger , cilantro , salt , 1 / 8 tsp
2. Of the cayenne and 3 / 4 cup of the chopped onions
3. Shape into 1 1 / 2-inch balls
4. Heat 1 tbsp
5. Of the oil in a large skillet
6. Add the balls and brown on all sides , about 3 minutes
7. Remove from the skillet with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels
8. To make the curry sauce , heat the remaining 1 tbsp
9. Oil in a skillet
10. Add the remaining onions and brown lightly
11. Add the cinnamon , cardamom , garlic , turmeric , ground ginger , coriander , remaining cayenne and salt to taste and saut 2 minutes
12. Add the tomato and simmer , stirring , for 2 minutes
13. Remove the pan from the heat and whisk in the remaining tofu
14. Add enough water to make a thick sauce
15. Carefully add the"meat" balls to the sauce and warm over low heat without boiling
16. Garnish with the parsley

title: ooey gooey chess bars
steps:
1. Set your oven to 350
2. Grease a 13 x 9 pan
3. With mixer , mix yellow cake mix , melted butter and 1 egg
4. Press into pan
5. Next , beat cream cheese until creamy , add confectioners sugar and two eggs and mix until well blended
6. Fold in peanut butter chips and cup heath bar bits
7. Pour all this over yellow cake mixture
8. Sprinkle the rest of the heath bar bits on top and bake for 45 minutes
9. You can garnish with confectioners sugar

title: mashed potato pancakes southern style
steps:
1. In medium bowl combine all ingredients
2. Whisk together until combined well
3. Consistency should be similar to cornbread mixture
4. Heat skillet with a light layer of oil on medium-high heat
5. Spoon batter to form 3 1 / 2 to 4 inch rounds
6. Brown each side to a rich dark golden brown
7. Potato pancakes should look like a thick regular pancake
8. Place on paper towel to drain excess oil
9. Don't stack on top of each other or the bottom pancakes will become soggy

title: cranberry sausage quiche
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Let frozen pie shell stand at room temperature for 10 minutes
3. Do not prick the shell
4. Bake pie shell for 7 minutes
5. Remove from oven and set aside
6. Reduce oven temperature to 375 degrees
7. Crumble sausage , and cook in a large skillet with onion over medium-high heat until sausage is thoroughly cooked
8. Drain off excess fat
9. Remove from heat
10. Stir in cranberries
11. Sprinkle cheese on the bottom of the pie shell
12. Top cheese evenly with sausage mixture
13. Combine eggs and half and half in medium bowl
14. Whisk until blended but not frothy
15. Pour egg mixture over sausage mixture in pie shell
16. Bake for 40-45 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean
17. Let stand for 10 minutes before serving
18. Garnish with fresh parsley or sage

title: raspberry marshmallow creme dip for fruit
steps:
1. Put all the ingredients in a medium mixing bowl & blend with an electric mixer on high speed until smooth
2. Cover & refrigerate at least 2 hours , but not more than 12 hours
3. We like it with apples , fresh strawberries , peaches & pineapple !

title: creamy scalloped potato bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit
2. Grease 13x9 baking dish
3. Add butter and olive oil to frying pan on medium-high heat
4. When hot , add spam and fry until slightly browned
5. Remove spam from pan and add sliced onions
6. Cook onions for 4 or 5 minutes until translucent
7. Slice potatoes
8. Layer in greased casserole dish: potatoes , onions , spam , cheddar , alfredo sauce
9. Keep layering until you run out of ingredients
10. Cover with foil and bake for 2 hours

title: chicken and couscous salad
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan bring the water and curry powder to a boil
2. Stir in the couscous and salt
3. Cover the saucepan
4. Remove the pan from heat
5. Let stand 5 minutes or until water is absorbed by the couscous
6. Stir about half of the chutney into the couscous mixture
7. In a medium bowl combine the chicken , green onions , tomatoes , melon , and remaining chutney
8. To serve , arrange torn lettuce on 6 individual plates
9. Spoon couscous onto the lettuce then top with the chicken mixture
10. Squeeze a lime wedge over each serving

title: country fried elk deer  wild game  steak
steps:
1. First , thaw your steaks
2. Then use a meat tenderizer to hammer the steaks on both sides
3. If you don't have a tenderizer you can use a knife and hit the steak in a parallel hatching pattern , then cross hatch them , on both sides
4. Set aside
5. Second , set out your 3 medium bowls
6. In the first one put 1 cup flour , and 3 tsp of lemon pepper and mix
7. The second bowl is your beaten eggs
8. The third bowl will be 1 cup of breadcrumbs mixed with your barbecue seasoning / season salt
9. Next , put a large skillet on the stove
10. Melt your 2 to 3 tbsp of vegetable shortening on medium low
11. Take a steak with your fingers or a set of tongs , and dredge it in the flour mixture on all sides
12. Then dredge it in the egg mixture followed by the breadcrumb mixture
13. Carefully place in the skillet
14. Repeat this process until all steaks are in the skillet
15. Cook for approximately 6 minutes on each side
16. Check the center of your thickest steak with a knife before removing them from the heat
17. It should be just slightly pink or medium well done
18. Place the steak on a paper towel covered serving platter
19. Serve hot and enjoy !

title: chimichurri bread    breadmaker 1 1 2 lb  loaf
steps:
1. Place ingredients in the pan of the bread machine in the order recommended by the manufacturer
2. Select basic or white cycle
3. Press start

title: tomato basil chicken breasts
steps:
1. In a shallow bowl , combine the flour , salt and pepper
2. Coat chicken with flour mixture
3. In a nonstick skillet , brown chicken in oil over medium heat
4. Drain
5. Cook pasta according to package directions
6. Meanwhile , pour soup over chicken
7. Bring to a boil
8. Reduce heat
9. Cover and simmer for 5 minutes or until chicken juices run clear
10. Drain pasta
11. Top with chicken and sauce
12. Sprinkle with basil if desired

title: arabian stew
steps:
1. Brown pork chops in pan with cooking spray
2. Till about 1 / 2 done
3. Drain tomatoe juice into measuring cup
4. Squeeze tomatoes to get out excess juice
5. Add enough water to make 2 cups liquid
6. Pour rice into bottom of prepared baking dish
7. And even out
8. Lay pork chops in single layer over rice
9. On each chop put one slice of green pepper , onion and tomato
10. If you have extra vegetables chop and shrinkle over casserole
11. Pour reserved tomato juice over te top
12. Cover and bake in a 350 degree oven for 1 hour or until rice is tender

title: cherry delight
steps:
1. Mix the graham crackers and margarine together and press into a 13 x9 pyrex dish
2. Blend the sugar , eggs , vanilla , and cream cheese
3. Pour the mixture into the graham cracker crust
4. Bake 15 minutes at 350 degrees
5. Cool and spread the cherry pie filling over cheese mixture
6. Chill 24 hours

title: banana chocolate mini muffins
steps:
1. Mix flour , baking powder and chocolate chips together in large bowl
2. Melt butter and combine with sugar , mashed banana , vanilla , eggs and milk
3. Pour the wet ingredients onto the dry ingredients and mix until dry ingredients are barely damp
4. Spoon mixture into well-sprayed or buttered mini-muffin pan
5. Bake at 200c for 10 minutes or until muffins spring back when pressed lightly in centre

title: deb s italian noodle casserole
steps:
1. Cook noodles according to package directions , set aside
2. Brown ground beef and garlic in butter , drain
3. To the ground beef , add tomato sauce & sugar
4. In a seperate bowl , combine cottage cheese and cream cheese , add sour cream , onion and green bell pepper to the cheese mixture , stir thoroughly
5. In a greased 9 x 13 inch casserole dish , layer 1 / 2 of the cooked noodles , layer of cheese mix and then the rest of the noodles
6. Cover the layers with the ground beef mixture and top with the cheddar cheese
7. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes
8. Enjoy !

title: sheila s sauteed soft shell crabs with lemon butter sauce
steps:
1. In ziploc bag , add flour and old bay seasoning
2. Seal and shake to mix
3. In bowl , combine eggs and milk
4. Dredge crabs in egg mixture , then add to seasoned flour and shake to coat
5. Shake off excess when removing from bag
6. Heat 3 t
7. Oil in large saute pan or skillet over medium heat
8. Add 3 crabs in a single layer and cook for about 3 minutes , then turn and cook for another 3 minutes
9. The crabs should be nice and golden brown
10. Remove crabs to serving dish
11. Heat remaining 3 t
12. Oil in pan , then add the next 3 crabs and repeat cooking instructions
13. Do not clean out pan when crabs are removed , but add butter
14. Let the butter melt and turn a little brown
15. Add the capers and the wine
16. Cook for about 1 minute , then add the lemon juice and the parsley
17. Cook for about 2 more minutes , or until reduced by about a third
18. Pour sauce over the crabs and serve

title: exotic spice cookies with ginger  cardamom and rose water
steps:
1. Whisk the flour , ground ginger , baking soda , cardamom , cinnamon , coriander , pepper and salt in a medium bowl until blended
2. Mix in the crystallized ginger and set aside momentarily
3. In a large bowl beat the brown sugar , butter and shortening with an electric mixer until fluffy
4. Add the egg , honey and rosewater and beat until blended
5. Stir in the flour mixture with a wooden spoon , mixing until just until blended
6. Cover and refrigerate 1 hour
7. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
8. Lightly spray 2 cookie sheets with nonstick cooking spray
9. Spoon the turbinado sugar in thick layer onto small plate
10. Using wet hands , form dough into 1 1 / 4-inch balls
11. Roll in sugar to coat completely
12. Place balls on prepared sheets , spacing 2 to 3 inches apart
13. Bake cookies until cracked on top but still soft to touch , about 11 to 13 minutes
14. Cool on sheets 1 minute
15. Carefully transfer cookies to wire racks
16. Cool completely

title: 15  bean soup
steps:
1. Presoak beans overnight , or boil them according to package
2. Combine all in crockpot
3. Cook on high 6-8 hours , or until beans are soft
4. Remove ham hocks / bone and bay leaves
5. Enjoy !
6. Could also be done on the stove top by simmering all on low for 3-4 hours

title: old fashioned english spiced pork and herb sausages or bangers
steps:
1. Combine all the meats with the fresh breadcrumbs , grated onion , lemon rind , nutmeg , parsley , dried herbs , pepper & salt
2. Mix well , it's better to mix this together with your hands
3. Bind with the 2 beaten eggs & mix well again
4. At this stage you can chill the sausage mixture in the fridge - it's easier to handle when it is slightly firmer
5. You can also use the mixture for stuffing at this stage too
6. When you are ready to cook the sausages or to shape them ready for freezing , form the mixture into sausage shapes - using a little flour to help you
7. Dip the sausages into the beaten egg white and then dust lightly with the flour and set aside until ready to cook
8. Heat up the oil and butter together in a large frying pan and cook the sausages for about 10-15 minutes over a medium heat
9. Turn them regularly to ensure they brown evenly
10. Drain them on a paper towel & serve hot with mashed potatoes & onion gravy for "bangers & mash" or use them in toad-in-the-hole as well as serving them for cooked breakfasts & brunches
11. They are delicious served cold with chutney too
12. Herbs
13. I generally use a pre-mixed home-made dried mixture of sage , parsley , thyme & majoram
14. However any combination of dried herbs would be good - but not rosemary as it is too pungent & will overpower the other flavours
15. One herb which is always a must no matter what combination you use , is sage - it has a wonderful affinity with pork & pork sausages in particular ! i also use fresh herbs when they are available in my herb garden
16. Use at least double the quantity of fresh herbs as they are not as strong as dried herbs
17. Chop or mince very finely
18. Hope that helps !

title: the bread recipe
steps:
1. In large bowl combine sugar , salt , pepper , yeast and 2 cups of flour
2. Heat milk and butter until about 120-130 degrees
3. With mixer gradually beat liquid into dry ingredients
4. Increase mixer speed to medium for 2 minutes
5. Beat in one egg at a time and 1 / 2 cup of flour to make thick batter
6. Continue to beat for another 2 minutes
7. With a spoon stir in cheese and add 1 1 / 2 cup of flour until a soft dough forms
8. Turn dough out onto floured surface and knead until smooth and elastic , about 5 minutes
9. Work in last 1 / 2 cup of flour during the kneading if needed
10. Shape dough and let rise about 30 minutes
11. Punch dough and let rest for 15 minutes
12. Shape any way you want to and place on greased cookie sheet and let rise
13. Bake at 375f 12-15 minutes

title: rice cooker chicken paprikash
steps:
1. Hit cook and brown onions
2. Then combine flour and chicken in a medium bowl
3. Toss well
4. Add chicken mixture to chopped onion , and brown lightly and then add next 6 ingredients into the pan
5. Hit cook
6. When it switches to warm , add the sour cream and mix and allow to heat for a few minutes while you get the rest of the dinner completed
7. Then serve it with either , noodles , rice or dumplings
8. Yield: 6 servings

title: potato salad for a crowd
steps:
1. Peel and dice the potatoes
2. Boil in salted water until just tender , about 30 minutes
3. Meanwhile , cook eggs until done and cool immediately
4. Drain olives and pickles and chop finely
5. Chop onion
6. When potatoes are done , drain and cool quickly
7. Using a wire whisk , prepare dressing by combining mayo , sour cream , buttermilk , salts , and pepper
8. Peel the cooled eggs
9. Save the best looking 4-5 to slice for garnish , chop the rest and add to cooled potatoes
10. Add chopped olives , pickles , and onion to potatoes
11. Stir well
12. Add dressing and stir to coat evenly
13. Carefully slice eggs for garnish and arrange on top of salad
14. Sprinkle with paprika
15. Cover and chill through prior to serving

title: curry lamb chops
steps:
1. In a medium skillet , warm the oil and brown lamb chops on all sides
2. Drain excess fat
3. Combine the orange juice , teriyaki sauce , orange peel , curry and garlic
4. Pour over lamb
5. Cover and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes or until meat is tender
6. Remove the chops and keep warm while preparing the sauce
7. Combine the cornstarch and water until smooth
8. Stir into pan drippings
9. Bring to a boil and cook , stirring constantly for 2 minutes or until thickened
10. Serve chops on top of cooked rice or couscous and pour gravy over

title: ultra low fat chicken fried chicken with cream gravy
steps:
1. Lightly pound chicken breasts with table knife handle until they are thinner , larger and lightly tenderized
2. Dip in egg white and roll in crushed corn flakes
3. In skillet sprayed with nonstick cooking spray , brown and cook over medium-low heat 5-6 minutes on each side
4. Turn only once
5. When chicken is done , remove from skillet
6. Add flour to skillet and brown over medium heat , stirring occasionally
7. This will burn easily
8. Remove skillet from heat and set aside
9. In medium bowl , combine remaining gravy ingredients
10. Using a whisk , with skillet still removed from heat , add gravy liquid while stirring
11. Return to heat , whisk and stir until gravy thickens
12. Serve gravy spooned over chicken
13. Enjoy !

title: m s  s sweet potato and sage butter casserole
steps:
1. Place sweet potatoes and potatoes in a large saucepan
2. Cover with water , and season with salt
3. Bring to a boil
4. Reduce heat , and simmer until potatoes are tender , about 9 minutes
5. Drain
6. Pass through a ricer into a bowl
7. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
8. Melt 1 stick butter in a small saucepan over medium heat , swirling occasionally , until golden brown , 5 to 7 minutes
9. Remove from heat
10. Add 2 tablespoons sage
11. Stir butter mixture and milk into potatoes
12. Season with salt and pepper
13. Transfer to a 2-quart casserole dish
14. Combine breadcrumbs with 2 tablespoons melted butter and remaining 1 / 2 tablespoon sage
15. Season with salt and pepper
16. Toss to combine
17. Top potato mixture with breadcrumbs
18. Bake , uncovered , until bubbling around edges and breadcrumbs are golden brown , 30 to 40 minutes
19. Let stand , uncovered , for 10 minutes

title: soup  vegetable or chicken vegetable  no salt added
steps:
1. Make chicken stock
2. Add olive oil to soup pot
3. Chop onion , carrots , and celery
4. Heat olive oil over medium heat
5. When hot , add onion , carrots , and celery
6. Saute until softened
7. Add chicken stock and water and increase heat to high
8. Add remaining vegetables except tomato paste , and flavor enhancer
9. Bring to a boil
10. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer uncovered for 1 hour , stirring occasionally
11. Mix tomato paste in 1 / 2 cup of the broth and add to soup
12. Add black pepper
13. Increase heat to high to return to simmer , then reduce to medium-low
14. Simmer for another 30 minutes , stirring occasionally
15. Add chicken , if using , and cook for 5 minutes
16. Set aside enough soup for rest of week
17. Freeze remaining soup in one cup containers for future use

title: traditional pumpkin pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425
2. With mixer beat pumpkin , eagle brand , eggs , spices and salt
3. Pour into crust
4. Bake 15 minutes
5. Reduce oven temperature to 350
6. Bake 35 to 40 minutes longer
7. Cool
8. Garnish as desired
9. Refrigerate leftovers
10. Sour cream topping: in medium bowl , combine sour cream , sugar and vanilla extract
11. After pie has bake 30 minutes at 350 , spread sour cream topping evenly over top bake 10 minutes

title: soft and chewy chocolate drops
steps:
1. Microwave unsweetened chocolate and butter 2 minutes or until butter is melted
2. Stir until chocolate is smooth
3. Add sugar and mix well
4. Add eggs and vanilla
5. Mix well
6. Add flour and mix well
7. Cover and refridgerate 1 hour to make dough easier to handle
8. Shape into 1" balls and place on cookie sheets
9. Bake at 350 for 8 minutes or just until set
10. Do not overbake !
11. Let stand 1 minutes and remove from cookie sheet
12. Cool completely before glazing
13. Put frozen cool whip and semi-sweet chocolate in a bowl and microwave for 1 1 / 2 minutes or unti chocolate is melted and mixture is shiny and smooth
14. Wait 1 minute before stirring
15. Stir and let stand 15 minutes to thicken
16. Spread over cookies and let stand until glaze is set
17. Can be garnished with christmas sprinkles or frosting to make holly and berries

title: meatballs in mushroom sauce
steps:
1. Mix meatball ingredients and form into balls
2. Brown in fry pan till done , remove meatballs
3. Stir into meat drippings the sauce ingredients , cook till well blended
4. Put meat balls back into pan and simmer for 30 minutes on low heat

title: tiffany s chocolate sheet cake
steps:
1. Bring to boil the cocoa , water , and margarine
2. Remove from heat
3. Add sugar , flour , salt , and baking soda
4. Mix by hand until blended well
5. Beat in eggs
6. Add sour cream
7. Bake at 375f in a shallow 9x13 pan for 22-25 minutes or until toothpick comes out dry
8. While cake is baking prepare the icing as follows
9. Bring to boil cocoa , margarine , and milk
10. Remove from heat
11. Add powdered sugar to desired consistency
12. Icing should pour like pancake batter
13. Add vanilla and nuts
14. Pour over warm cake
15. Allow to cool , then brace yourself !

title: cajun smothered pork chops
steps:
1. Heat olive oil in a 5 quart cast iron dutch oven on medium high
2. Season pork chops with cajun seasoning
3. Place in skillet and brown well on both sides over medium - medium high heat
4. Remove from pan and set aside
5. Add onion , green and red bell peppers , and celery
6. Cook until onions are soft and transparent , stirring frequently as not to burn
7. Return pork chops to pot
8. Add just enough water to cover the meat
9. Add garlic and worcestershire
10. Stir well
11. If your gravy isn't dark , add a tablespoon of kitchen bouquet and stir
12. Cover pot almost all of the way
13. Simmer until meat is tender
14. Uncover
15. Add mushroom and green onions and parsley
16. Adjust seasoning by tasting gravy
17. Simmer 5 minutes longer
18. Serve over hot cooked rice
19. C'est si bon , cher !

title: twisted taco salad with fritos
steps:
1. Brown ground beef in skillet and drain
2. Season with garlic salt to taste
3. Add chopped lettuce , chopped and seeded tomatoes , cheese and onion to big bowl
4. If eating immediately , add warm ground beef to salad mixture
5. Just before serviing mix in fritos and western salad dressing
6. Be sure to mix carefully and don't dump the entire bottle of dressing in at once
7. You want to lightly coat with the dressing , not drown the salad in it
8. I always leave a little on the side if someone wants more

title: lemon chicken soup with orzo
steps:
1. Heat 2 teaspoons oil in a pot over med-high heat
2. Season the chicken with salt and add it to the pot
3. Cook / stir occasionally , until just cooked through , about 5 minutes
4. Transfer the chicken to a dish
5. Set aside
6. Add the remaining 2 teaspoons oil to the pot
7. Add in onions , celery , carrot , and thyme
8. Cook / stir over med-high heat until the vegetables are tender , about 5 minutes
9. Add in 5 cups broth and bring to a boil
10. Add in orzo and let simmer until tender , about 8 minutes
11. Decrease heat to low to keep the soup hot , but not boiling
12. Warm the remaining 1 cup broth in a small pan until it is hot , but not boiling
13. In a bowl , beat the eggs
14. Gradually whisk the lemon juice into the eggs
15. Then gradually add the hot broth to the lemon-egg mixture , whisking all the while
16. Add the mixture to the soup , stirring well until the soup is thickened
17. Do not let the soup come to a boil
18. Add in cooked chicken
19. Season to taste with salt and pepper
20. Serve

title: simple baked chicken
steps:
1. Pour water in 8 inch baking dish
2. Rinse chicken and then coat with butter
3. Holding chicken up , sprinkle all over with seasoned salt
4. Place chicken in baking dish , top with any extra seasoned salt
5. Put celery and onion in chicken's"cavity"
6. Cover with aluminum foil and bake for at least 1 hour at 350 degrees
7. Uncover and bake an additional 10 to 15 minutes for chicken to"brown" lightly

title: alternative muffins
steps:
1. Blend all dry ingredients together
2. Combine the rest of the ingredients and then add to the dry mixture
3. Stir just until everything is mixed
4. Best not to overmix
5. Fill muffin tins 2 / 3 full
6. Bake at 350 for about 15 minutes or until dry when checked with toothpick in center

title: corn  tomato and soyrizo frittata
steps:
1. Heat broiler to high with rack at medium height
2. Beat eggs , salt and pepper until well blended
3. Spray an oven-safe skillet with oil and heat over medium-high
4. Brown the chorizo
5. Add the corn and tomatoes and simmer for about four minutes
6. Reduce heat to medium and add the egg mixture , ensuring it evenly coats the bottom of the pan and that vegetables are evenly distributed
7. Lift the edges of the frittata to ensure all egg gets heated
8. Cook until only the top of the mixture is liquidy
9. Place the pan under the broiler until surface is puffed and lightly browned , about 2-4 minutes
10. Remove from oven
11. Sprinkle with cheese and cover and let sit for about five minutes , or until cheese is melted
12. Sprinkle fresh cilantro over the top
13. Serve hot

title: cod fish with pine nut brown butter
steps:
1. Melt butter in a large pan over medium heat , till it is light golden in colour
2. Add lemon juice and pine nuts and saute for 1 minute
3. Add fish to pan and cook for 2 minutes on each side , or till it is cooked to your liking
4. Serve fish on steamed greens with the brown pine nut butter as a sauce
5. Serve with a lemon wedge

title: green tea sauteed vegetables
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a wok or large pan over medium-high heat
2. Add chile pepper , lemon zest and tea leaves and saute till fragrant
3. Add the broccoli and squash and stir-fry about 2 minutes
4. Add the brewed tea and bell pepper and season with salt and pepper to taste
5. Simmer until most of the liquid evaporates
6. Serve immediately

title: oven roasted pork loin with dry rub
steps:
1. In a bowl stir together brown sugar , white sugar , black pepper , salt , ginger , garlic powder , onion salt , dry mustard , cayenne , cumin , paprika and crushed thyme
2. Make small slits and stuff a garlic clove in the slit
3. Rub the pork loin all over generously with olive oil then rub the roast all over with about 1 / 2 to 3 / 4 cup dry using your hands to rub in the spices
4. Cover the roast with plastic wrap and refrigerate for a minimum of 6 hours or up to 24 hours
5. Place roast in a foil-lined shallow roasting pan
6. Let the roast sit out at room temperature for a couple hours
7. Roast uncovered at 350 degrees f until the internal temperature is 150f the cooking time will vary depending on the size of your roast
8. Remove and cover with foil , let stand for 20 minutes before slicing

title: marinated roast beef
steps:
1. Pierce roast at 1 inch intervals with a meat fork , and place in a large zip lock bag
2. Combine vegetable oil and next 5 ingredients
3. Pour over roast in zip lock bag
4. Seal and chill for 24-48 hours , turning roast occasionally
5. Bake at 325 degrees for 1 hour and 50 minutes or until a meat thermometer registers 145-160 degrees
6. Let stand for 5 minutes before slicing thinly across the grain
7. Roast beef will be rare

title: cold asparagus with mustard dressing
steps:
1. Steam asparagus until crisp but fork tender chill in cold water to stop cooking process
2. Mix together ingredients
3. Add asparagus to mixture and toss
4. Let stand in refidgerator for at least 1 hour

title: garlic mushroom rib eyes
steps:
1. Sprinkle steaks with pepper and salt
2. In a large skillet , melt 1 tablespoon butter
3. Cook the steaks for 2 minutes on each side or until meat reaches desired doneness remove and keep warm
4. In the same skillet , cook the garlic in 1 tablespoon butter for 2 minutes
5. Remove garlic and set aside
6. Add mushrooms and remaining butter to skillet
7. Saute for 5 minutes
8. Stir in broth
9. Bring to a boil
10. Cook and stir over high heat until liquid is absorbed
11. Add reserved garlic
12. Serve over steaks

title: english muffin french toast
steps:
1. Whisk eggs in small bowl until frothy
2. Add milk , sugar and cinnamon
3. Whisk well
4. Transfer to shallow dish
5. To cook , open english muffins
6. Place in milk mixture , cut-side down , for about 4 minutes
7. Turn and soak 1 minute more
8. Heat greased nonstick skillet over medium heat
9. When hot , cook muffins , cut-side down , until browned , about 3 minutes
10. Turn , brown other side , about 3 minutes more
11. Can be kept warm in 200 degree oven while cooking remaining muffins
12. Serve hot with warm maple syrup passed separately

title: apple zeppole with cinnamon whipped cream
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan combine the butter , salt , sugar , and water over medium heat
2. Bring to a boil
3. Take pan off the heat and stir in the flour
4. Return the pan to medium heat and stir continuously until mixture forms a ball , about 3 to 5 minutes
5. Transfer the flour mixture to a medium bowl
6. Using an electric hand mixer on low speed , add eggs , one at a time , incorporating each egg completely before adding the next
7. Beat until smooth
8. Add the grated apple and stir to combine
9. If not frying immediately , cover with plastic wrap and reserve in the refrigerator
10. Combine the whipping cream , 2 tablespoons confectioners' sugar , and cinnamon in a
11. Medium bowl
12. Whip until medium soft peaks form
13. Transfer the whipping cream to a serving dish
14. Meanwhile , pour enough oil into a large frying pan to reach a depth of 2 inches
15. Heat the oil over medium heat until a deep-fry thermometer registers 325 degrees f
16. Using a small ice-cream scooper or 2 small spoons , carefully drop about a rounded tablespoon of the dough into the hot olive oil
17. Turn the zeppole once or twice , and cook until golden and puffed up , about 4 minutes
18. Fry the zeppole in batches so as not to overcrowd the pan
19. Drain on paper towels
20. Transfer the zeppole to a serving dish and sprinkle with powdered sugar using a small sieve
21. Serve with the cinnamon whipped cream alongside for dipping

title: peacock vegetables
steps:
1. Place first 7 ingredients in a large bowl
2. Combine parsley and next 5 ingredients in a jar
3. Cover tightly and shake vigorously
4. Pour over vegetables and toss well
5. Spoon vegetables in an ungreased 13x9 in baking dish , and bake at 425 degrees for 20 minutes , stirring every 5 minutes
6. Serve warm , or at room temperature

title: portabella and brie appetizers
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f spray 24 mini muffin cups with cooking spray
2. Clean mushrooms if needed and chop finely
3. In a small skillet , combine chopped mushrooms , butter , wine , garlic , thyme , parsley and cayenne
4. Cook over medium heat for 5-6 minutes or until mushrooms are tender
5. Stir in green onions and mustard
6. Unroll crescent dough into 4 rectangles
7. Press perforations firmly to seal
8. Cut each rectangle into 6 pieces
9. Press 1 square of dough into each muffin cup , letting the corners stick up above the edges
10. Divide mushroom mixture evenly among cups , about 1 1 / 2 tsp per cup
11. Bake for 10-12 minutes or until light golden brown
12. While baking , cut brie into 24 pieces
13. Remove cups from oven and place 1 piece of brie over each cup
14. Return to oven and bake an additional 2-4 minutes or until dough is golden brown and cheese is softened
15. Cool slightly before serving

title: confetti cucumber salad
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a pan and fry the garlic over medium heat until crispy , set aside to cool
2. Mix the vinegar and sugar together
3. In a bowl , toss together the chopped onion , bell pepper , and cucumbers
4. Pour the vinegar / sugar mixture and the chili sauce over the salad and toss
5. Add the cooled garlic and toss
6. Upon serving , sprinkle the chopped peanuts over the salad
7. Enjoy !

title: crab asparagus lettuce rolls
steps:
1. Combine all dressing ingredients in food processor or blender
2. Blend until smooth and the consistency of a mayonnaise based dip
3. Cover and set aside in the refrigerator
4. Pour the pecan halves on a tray and toast , 7 or 8 minutes
5. Remove from oven and sprinkle with kosher salt and cayenne pepper to taste
6. Set aside to cool , when cool , coarse chop 1 / 4 cup , leave the rest whole
7. Break tough ends off asparagus
8. Steam for 3 minutes , just until tender crisp , there should be lots of crunch left
9. Plunge into ice water
10. Slice all but 12 spears into 1 / 4 inch pieces
11. Scrape the carrots and grate , seed and dice the tomatoes
12. Rinse the crabmeat and thourghly dry on paper towel , squeezing out the moisture
13. Combine crabmeat , chopped asparagus , grated carrots , diced tomatoes , chopped pecans , dried dill weed , salt and cayenne pepper
14. Mix well
15. Add 1 / 2 of the dressing to the crabmeat mixture
16. Use only enough dressing to hold the mixture together
17. The mixture should be fairly dry , not runny
18. Reserve the rest of the dressing to use as a dip for the lettuce rolls
19. Wash and separate lettuce leaves , dry as much as possible , best dried in a spinner
20. Place 1 to 2 tablespoons of crabmeat mixture in lettuce cup and roll as tightly as possible appetizer size , use toothpicks if necessary , or leave open if you wish
21. Repeat until all filling mixture is used
22. Place on serving platter and sprinkle with grated parmesan cheese , if using
23. Place a pecan half on top of each roll
24. Garnish the platter with more pecan halves and the 12 reserved asparagus spears
25. Serve chilled at least one hour
26. The lettuce rolls can be made larger for luncheon use etc
27. , or they can be served with crabmeat mixture in a bowl and the lettuce cups separate for each diner to fill themselves , serve extra asparagus and pecan halves on the side

title: peach glazed pork chops
steps:
1. In a skillet , heat 1 tablespoon oil over medium heat
2. Season chops with salt and freshly ground pepper
3. Place chops in skillet and brown on both sides
4. Remove and set aside
5. Add remaining oil and onion to skillet and cook until translucent
6. While onion cooks , combine next five ingredients in a bowl
7. Add flour to skillet and cook for 1 minute
8. Stir in jam mixture , add pork chops to skillet and coat with sauce
9. Cook uncovered , stirring and turning chops occasionally for 15 minutes on low heat

title: strawberry preserve muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Grease or spray muffin tins
3. Combine the dry ingredients in a large bowl
4. Melt butter
5. Add the milk , then beat in the egg and vanilla
6. Stir in the yogurt
7. Add this mixture to the flour mixture until moistened
8. Fill the muffin cups halfway
9. Put 1 teaspoon of preserves in the center of each muffin cup
10. Fill the cups with the remaining batter
11. Bake at 400 for 15 minutes

title: tomato onion salad
steps:
1. Layer tomatoes and onions in a shallow serving dish
2. In a jar with a tight-fitting lid , combine the remaining ingredients
3. Shake well
4. Drizzle over salad
5. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours before serving

title: crisp rice date nut balls
steps:
1. In sauce pan , combine sugar , margarine , salt and dates
2. Allow to boil for five minutes , stirring constantly
3. Remove from heat , add vanilla
4. Fold in crisp rice cereal and nuts
5. While warm , roll into balls and let dry on waxed paper or racks
6. To make balls , butter hand well and keep buttering while you work
7. When cold , roll into confectioners sugar

title: cinnamon spiced coffee   citrus clove spiced coffee
steps:
1. For cinnamon spiced coffee: in a saucepan , over low heat , simmer cinnamon , allspice , and 2 cloves in coffee for 5-7 minutes
2. Or for citrus clove spiced coffee: in a saucepan , over low heat , simmer orange peel , lemon peel , and 10 cloves in coffee for 5-7 minutes
3. Strain into cups and sweeten each to taste
4. Top with whipped cream and sprinkle with cinnamon

title: african vegetable stew
steps:
1. Melt margarine over medium heat in a large saucepan
2. Add onion , parsley , garlic , cinnamon , turmeric , pepper and ginger
3. Stir occasionally until onion is tender - add some water if it begins to stick
4. Stir in water , carrot and lentils
5. Boil , then reduce heat and cover to simmer 25 minutes
6. Stir in rice , and undrained tomatoes
7. Boil , then reduce heat and cover to simmer for 20 minutes
8. Stir in peas , beans and salt and pepper to taste
9. Boil , then reduce heat and cover to simmer 5 minutes or till tender
10. If desired , serve with a dollop of yogurt or sour cream - 1 serving = 275 cal , 3g fat , 56g carb , 10g fibre , 12 g pro

title: mango coconut sorbet  diabetic friendly
steps:
1. Puree in food processor
2. Chill
3. Freeze in ice cream maker according to your machine's directions

title: oatmeal peanut butter chip cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Combine dry ingredients in a large mixing bowl and set aside
3. In large bowl , beat together the butter , granulated sugar and brown sugar
4. Add the eggs and vanilla to the mixture
5. Beat until all ingredients are well combined and smooth
6. Slowly add the dry mixture to the wet mixture until well combined
7. Add the oats and chips to the mixture
8. Drop the dough by spoonfuls onto a greased cookie sheet
9. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes or until light golden brown

title: strawberry squares   south beach style
steps:
1. Preheat over to 350f
2. Spray a 8" by 8" non-stick square pan lightly with cooking spray
3. Mix the kashi , 2 teaspoons of splenda and sunflower oil and press evenly over the bottom of the pan
4. Bake for 10 minutes then remove from oven and cool
5. Mix the boiling water and the strawberry or raspberry jello and stir until jello is dissolved , put mixture in refrigerator until cool but not set
6. Mix the jello mixture with the skim milk and add the vanilla pudding mix , beat until lump free then stir in the strawberries
7. Pour the strawberry mixture over the cooled kashi crust , and spread to even out the strawberries
8. Chill until well set , then if desired , spread ultra low fat cool whip evenly over the top

title: hard rock cafe bbq beans   copycat by todd wilbur
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Pour the can of pinto beans into a casserole dish
3. Dissolve the cornstarch in a small bowl with the 2 tablespoons of water
4. Add this solution to the beans and stir
5. Add the remaining ingredients to the dish , stir to combine and cover
6. Bake for 90 minutes or until the sauce thickens
7. Stir every 30 minutes
8. After removing the beans from the oven , let the beans cool for 5 to 10 minutes before serving , topped with crumbled bacon

title: erik s tasty creamy jalapeno dip
steps:
1. Mix the dry ranch dip packets , salt , and can of green chilis into the sour cream
2. Finely chop the jalapenos , garlic and cilantro
3. Mix the chopped mixture into the sour cream mixture
4. Refrigerate the dip to thicken

title: brown sugar syrup with walnuts
steps:
1. Bring sugars , corn syrup and water to boil in a saucepan
2. Reduce heat
3. Simmer until thickened , 10 to 12 minutes
4. Stir in butter and nuts
5. Cool slightly
6. Serve

title: gluten free salmon patties
steps:
1. Heat skillet on med
2. -high heat , with oil
3. Mix all the rest of ingredients together very well , patty , and throw on skillet
4. Cook on each side 5-10 minutes , or until it is browned and firm
5. Remove , serve , and enjoy , i like mine with a horseradish sauce

title: crunchy granola over plain yogurt  middle eastern style
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 300 degrees
2. In a large mixing bowl , stir together the oats , wheat germ , nuts , sesame and sunflower seeds , maple syrup / demerara or brown sugar , cinnamon , cardamom and salt
3. Make a well in the dry ingredients and add the olive oil , agave or honey , and water
4. Toss the mixture until it is well combined , then spread it evenly on a cookie sheet
5. Bake the granola until lightly browned , approximately 40 minutes , stirring every 10 minutes to keep the mixture from sticking
6. Set aside to cool completely , then stir in the dried fruit
7. Store left over granola in an airtight container in the refrigerator
8. For 1 serving: spoon yogurt into a serving bowl
9. Stir the rosewater or orange blossom water into the yogurt
10. Top yogurt with some of the granola and add a light drizzle of agave or honey
11. Enjoy !

title: banana bread with strawberry compote
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Grease a 9x4x11 in loaf pan and place a piece of parchment paper on the bottom of the pan
3. Beat together the sugars and butter until light and fluffy
4. Add in the eggs , one at a time , incorporating well after each addition then add the vanilla extract
5. Peel and mash bananas
6. Stir into the butter mixture
7. Add the flour , nutmeg cinnamon until just combined
8. Do not over-beat
9. Pour mixture into pan and bake for 1 hour , 15 minutes until a toothpick inserted into the bread comes out clean
10. Remove from the oven and let stand for 5 minutes before turning out onto a wire rack
11. Made the compote while bread is baking by mixing the first four of the compote ingredients together in a medium sized pan and bringing to a boil add fruit and return to a boil
12. Remove from heat , pour into a heatproof bowl , and let cool
13. Serve slices of banana bread with a spoonful of mascarpone or yogurt and spoon over either warm or cold compote
14. Fish with a light dusting of confectioners' sugar

title: chicken in tarragon mustard cream sauce
steps:
1. In large skillet , heat 2 t oil
2. Salt and pepper chicken
3. Cook in a single layer until browned on all sides , about 4-5 minutes
4. Remove chicken
5. Pour off skillet fat
6. Add remaining 1 t oil to skillet
7. Add mushrooms , and cook , stirring occasionally , for 4-5 minutes
8. Add shallot , and stir for 2 more minutes
9. Add wine , and cook for 4 more minutes
10. Add stock , cream , mustard , and bring to boil
11. Reduce heat and cook for 6 minutes
12. Add chicken and tarragon and simmer for 2-3 minutes , or until chicken is done
13. Serve over cooked hot noodles

title: delicious pineapple sausage stuffing
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees
2. In a large skillet , over med-high heat , cook pork until browned
3. Drain , set aside
4. In another skillet , melt butter
5. Stir in celery , onion and garlic
6. Cook about 10 minutes , or until veggies are tender
7. In a bowl , stir together the bread , cooked sausage , celery , onion , pineapple , cranberries , pecans , parsley , oregano , sage , salt and pepper
8. Pour into a lightly-greased 3-quart casserole dish
9. Cover the casserole
10. Bake for 30-35 minutes , or until heated through

title: bacon and cheese dip
steps:
1. Put all ingredients in the crock pot and cook on low , stirring occasionally until cheese melts , about 1 hour
2. Taste and adjust seasonings , add bacon , and keep on low to serve
3. Serve with cubed or sliced french bread

title: skirt steak with red wine sauce
steps:
1. Pat dry steaks and sprinkle all over with salt and pepper
2. Heat oil in 1 12-inch heavy skillet over moderately high heat until hot but not smoking , then cook steaks , turning over once , 5 to 7 minutes total for medium-rare
3. Transfer to a platter
4. Pour off fat from skillet , then add wine , thyme , bay leaf , sugar , and worcestershire sauce and bring to a boil , scraping up brown bits
5. Continue to boil until reduced by half , about 3 minutes
6. Add any meat juices on platter , then remove from heat and discard bay leaf and thyme
7. Stir in butter and salt and pepper to taste and serve with steaks

title: panang tofu souffle   vegan
steps:
