1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Heat oil in a frying pan and saut bell pepper , onion for 5 minutes
3. In a blender or food processor , blend tofu , coconut milk , curry paste , sugar , salt and pepper until smooth
4. Pour mixture into a souffl dish or small casserole and add peppers , onions and basil
5. Place dish in a roasting pan that is filled half way with water
6. Bake for 30-45 minutes or until souffl is firm and top is golden brown
7. Serve with jasmine rice

title: sweet   spicy broiled ham steak
steps:
1. Arrange your oven rack to be 2 to 3 inches from the broiler
2. Heat the broiler to high heat
3. Dry the ham steak with paper towels and set on the broiler pan
4. In a small sauce pan , combine the 6 glaze ingredients
5. Bring to a simmer over medium heat for 2 to 3 minutes while constantly stirring
6. Brush one side of the ham with the glaze and broil until the glaze is bubbling and browned - 4 to 5 minutes
7. Remove and flip the ham steak and brush the other side - repeat the process
8. Serve immediately

title: crock pot nacho pork chops
steps: 1. Put soup and red pepper in a slow cooker , add chops and cook on low heat setting for 6-7 hours until fork-tender

title: southwest chipotle seasoning
steps:
1. Combine all in a medium bowl
2. Store in an airtight jar for up to 4 months
3. Makes 1 cup seasoning

title: bunny muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Coat 12 cup muffin pan with non-stick cooking spray
3. Mix carrot , egg , cheese , and chives
4. Add flour and baking powder , stir
5. Spoon batter equally among muffin cups
6. Bake 25-30 minutes until golden brown

title: puppy chow or monkey munch
steps:
1. Measure cereal in large bowl
2. Set aside
3. Microwave chocolate chips , peanut butter and butter for 1 minute on high
4. Stir
5. Cook for 30 seconds longer or until smooth
6. Add vanilla
7. Pour mixture over cereal , stirring until coated
8. Pour mixture into large ziploc bag and add powdered sugar
9. Shake until well coated
10. Spread on waxed paper to cool
11. Store in ziploc bags or large sealed bowl
12. Recipe

title: berry blast protein shake    fruit smoothie
steps:
1. Put ingredients in a food processor or blender and pulse until it is your desired consistency
2. For a thicker shake or if you use fresh berries add a few ice cubes

title: krissy s olive tapenade dip
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients in a bowl
2. Seal and store in refrigerator for 4-8 hours
3. 20 minutes before serving remove from refrigerator and stir
4. Serve with sliced baguettes , crusty french bread or crackers
5. Also may be used in salads , sandwiches and stuffing

title: super easy potatoe skins
steps:
1. Pre-heat the broiler on your oven
2. Wash the potatoes thoroughly
3. Poke the potato 4-6 times with a fork to let moisture out during "baking"
4. Optional: rub butter on the out side of the potato and season with garlic , salt , pepper , or what ever seasoning you would like to give it a little extra flavor
5. Put the potatoes on a plate and put cook in the microwave for 10 minutes
6. While the potatoes are baking , cook the bacon
7. I did it in the broiler to save on an extra pan and keep it easy
8. Just keep an eye on it so they don't burn
9. I just laid the bacon out on my broiler pan and put it right under the broiler
10. Once the potatoes are done , take them out and slice them in half
11. Use a spoon to scoop out a little of the inside to form a small shallow "bowl" with the potato
12. Chop the cooked bacon and sprinkle some in each of the potato "bowls" i plan for appx one slice per potato half
13. Next , sprinkle cheese over the potatoes
14. I say 1 / 2 cup for 4 halves just as a general guess
15. You can go light or go heavy , how ever you prefer
16. Put the potatoes on a broiler pan , if you used one for the bacon , or even just a cookie sheet
17. Put the pan directly under the broiler and cook until the cheese melts and starts to brown
18. Remove from oven
19. Top with desired amount of sour cream and serve
20. Optional: you can sprinkle fresh chives or green onion on top after the sour cream

title: baked stuffed apples with apple pie spice
steps:
1. Mix raisins and sugar together in a small bowl
2. Stand apples on bottom of slow cooker
3. Spoon raisin-sugar mixture into centers of cored apples , dividing mixture evenly
4. Sprinkle apples with apple pie spice , and dot with butter
5. Add water along the edge of the cooker
6. Cover , and cook on low 3-5 hours or on high for 2 1 / 2 - 3 1 / 2 hours or until apples are tender but not collapsing
7. Serve warm as is , or with ice cream or frozen yogurt

title: fat free cinnamon apple bake
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees
2. Peel and core apples
3. Cut each one into 16 slices
4. Arrange slices on a greased 8" x 8" baking dish
5. In a small bowl , combine the water with flour , cornstarch and butter buds
6. Stir until the dry ingredients are dissolved and not lumpy
7. Add in the brown sugar and cinnamon , stir until smooth
8. Pour the cinnamon mixture over the apple slices
9. Cover the dish with foil
10. Bake for 40 minutes
11. Stir the apples every 10 minutes

title: bacon cheeseburger puff rolls
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f line a jellyroll pan with parchment paper
2. Place ground beef , bacon , and sweet onion in a large , deep skillet and saute until bacon has rendered its fat and onions are translucent
3. Break up chunks of ground beef as you are saute-ing ,
4. Add red bell pepper and garlic to the ground beef
5. Cook an additional 2 minutes
6. Remove from heat and stir in oregano , basil , green onions , and ketchup
7. Add salt and pepper to taste
8. Let cool to room temperature
9. Place one sheet of puff pastry between two sheets of plastic wrap and gently roll out to a rectangle about 12 inches by 10 inches
10. Remove the top piece of plastic wrap
11. Spread half of the ground beef mixture on puff pastry , leaving 1 inch clear on each of the four sides
12. Sprinkle with half of the cheddar cheese
13. Use the bottom piece of the plastic wrap to help you roll the puff pastry and filling lengthwise into a log
14. Use the egg white as glue to seal the roll
15. Gently press both ends closed
16. Using the plastic wrap , lift the roll onto the prepared jellyroll pan and place seam-side down
17. Repeat process with the remaining sheet of puff pastry
18. Brush the tops of the bacon cheeseburger puff rolls with egg white and bake for 20 to 25 minutes until golden brown
19. Let rest for 10 minutes , then slice each roll on the diagonal into 4 pieces to serve

title: spicy fried chicken  ayam goreng pedas
steps:
1. Combine the 1st 5 ingredients in a bowl and rub the mixture over the chicken , cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour
2. Heat the oil in a heavy based pan and add the chicken in 2 batches , cook , turning occasionally until well browned all over , drain on paper towels
3. Blend or process nuts until finely chopped
4. Return the chicken to the pan and add the nuts and chillies , cook stirring for about 1 minute
5. Add the water and cauliflower , simmer covered for about 15 mins until chicken is tender
6. Add peas and tomatoes , cook stirring gently until peas are just soft
7. Just before serving top with the eggs

title: savory onion pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Mix bisquick and milk to form dough
3. Spray 9 inch pie plate with cooking spray
4. With fingers , spread dough to edges and slightly up sides of pie plate
5. Saute onions in butter for 5 minutes
6. Cook only until soft , do not brown
7. Spread onions over pie crust
8. Mix cream cheese , milk and egg well
9. Pour over onion mixture
10. Bake at 350 for 45 minutes
11. Let stand 10 minutes before serving

title: pork green chile stew
steps:
1. Dredge pork cubes in masa flour in plastic bag until all pieces are coated
2. Brown in oil in large dutch oven or pot - set aside
3. Add butter to same pan , lightly cook onion until slightly colored - then add garlic cook 1-2 minutes until aromatic
4. Add small amount of chicken stock to browned bottom of pot / dutch oven - as stock heats up , scrape browned bits off of the pan to create a roux
5. After all bits are scraped , add remaining stock to pan
6. Add remaining ingredients to same pan
7. Bring to slow boil , then cover , reduce to simmer for about 30 minutes -- then add green chiles and cook until pork is tender - a little over an hour is usually good - too long and the meat will toughen
8. Make sure it never boils as it will cook too fast
9. Sometimes i turn the stove off after about 40 minutes to make sure it cooks slowly
10. Add salt / pepper to taste
11. After 45 minutes , check consistency - if it needs to be thicker slowly add a small amount of masa at a time and stir until thick - shouldn't be more than 2 tablespoons the chiles will breakdown into the roux while cooking
12. Taste for heat - if you like it spicy , add a couple of diced serrano chiles
13. Garnish with sour cream and cilantro
14. Serve with corn bread or homemade tortillas -- and several tecate's or margaritas !
15. Do not add beer like other recipes suggest - it will dilute the chile flavor and can add a bitterness
16. Never used canned chiles as they don't have much flavor
17. New mexican chiles are the best -- you can buy them online already roasted and peeled otherwise use fresh anaheims or big jims and roast on the grill until skins turn brown / black - place in a brown paper bag to steam the skins off
18. Do not rinse them under water as it removes the flavorful oils
19. Organic chicken stock is fine , but don't use low sodium

title: banana apple and oatmeal muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f degrees
2. Grease a 1 / 3-cup muffin pan or line with paper cups
3. In a bowl combine bananas , milk , oil , sugar , vanilla and egg
4. In another bowl whisk together dry ingredients flours , oats , cinnamon and baking powder
5. Add dry mixture to wet mixture , mix well
6. Dust apples , raisins , and walnuts lightly to cover with flour , then fold inches
7. Spoon the mixture evenly into muffin cups
8. Bake for 20-25 minutes or until tester comes out clean
9. Make sure you remove muffins immediately after they are done
10. Let them cool on a wire rack

title: pumpkin dip
steps:
1. Put the first 3 ingredients in a medium bowl , and mix with a fork until smooth
2. Add syrup and cinnamon , and mix some more
3. Cover and chill 30 minutes
4. Serve with apple and / or gingersnaps

title: gingerly molasses christmas banana bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Mix butter , oil , bananas , sugar , molasses , and egg until smooth
3. Sprinkle baking soda & spices over mixture , mix lightly
4. Add flour , stir until combined
5. Add raisins , stir
6. Pour into buttered bread pan
7. Sprinkle top with kosher salt
8. Bake for one hour
9. Remove from pan and cool on rack

title: the greatest smoothies ever
steps:
1. In a blender , combine all ingredients
2. Enjoy !

title: better than sex cake  chocolate
steps:
1. Bake cake in 9x13 pan , as directed on box
2. Let it cool slightly and poke little holes in the top of the cake with a pencil
3. Dribble sweetened condensed milk and caramel sauce over cake
4. Let stand for over an hour until the cake has completely cooled
5. Frost with whipped topping and sprinkle crushed candy bars over the topping
6. Refrigerate until time to serve

title: irish cowboy
steps: 1. Skae all ingredients in a cocktail shaker with ice , serve in a chilled glass

title: washington state caramel apple cheesecake pie
steps:
1. Place crust on baking sheet & spread half of the apple filling in crust
2. Set aside
3. In large mixing bowl beat cream cheese , sugar , lemon juice and vanilla on medium speed of electric mixer until fluffy
4. Add eggs , one at a time , mixing until just combined after each addition then gently spread over filling in crust
5. Bake on baking sheet at 350f for 30 to 35 minutes or until center is almost set
6. Cool for 1 hour
7. Refrigerate at least 3 hours
8. Spread with remaining pie filling
9. Drizzle with ice cream topping & garnish with pecans
10. Store in refrigerator

title: white bean salad
steps:
1. Combine the beans , vegetables and parsley
2. Whisk dressing ingredients together and mix into salad
3. Add salt and pepper to taste
4. Cover and refrigerate till ready to eat

title: the best broccoli you ll ever eat    without turning on the oven
steps:
1. Bring large pan of salted water to a boil
2. Cut broccoli into florets
3. Add broccoli to boiling water and blanch for 1 minute
4. Drain
5. In a large skillet , warm sesame oil , garlic , and red pepper over low heat for 2 minutes
6. Stir in soy sauce and lemon juice
7. Add broccoli , toss to coat
8. Eat !

title: shrimp copobianco
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 300f
2. Thoroughly wash the spinach , if needed
3. Peel the shrimp , leaving the tail and last section on
4. Place the pine nuts on a baking sheet and toast in the oven 10-12 minutes or until golden brown
5. Halve the onion
6. Peel and very thinly slice
7. Remove the stems from the tomatoes and coarsely chop into 1 1 / 2 inch pieces
8. Trim the ends of the zucchini , cut in half , and then into julienne strips
9. Remove the rosemary from the stems and coarsely chop
10. Peel , crush , and finely chop the garlic
11. Heat a 12 inch frying pan over high heat
12. Add a tablespoon of olive oil and the sliced onions
13. Saut the onions 4 minutes until they begin to brown slightly and soften
14. Add the zucchini and tomatoes , then quickly saut for about 2 minutes until the vegetables begin to render their liquids
15. Season to taste with salt and pepper and remove to a warm platter
16. Return the frying pan to high heat
17. Add another tablespoon of olive oil
18. Saut the spinach leaves with the garlic for about one minute or until the leaves are wilted and the garlic has released its flavors
19. Season to taste with salt and pepper and add to the vegetables on the platter
20. Return the frying pan to high heat
21. Add a tablespoon of olive oil and quickly saut the shrimp and rosemary
22. Shake the pan so they cook quickly and uniformly
23. When the shrimp are pink and opaque , after 2-3 minutes , season to taste and transfer to the platter of vegetables
24. Sprinkle with pine nuts and serve immediately

title: macaroni pie from trinidad
steps:
1. Boil macaroni in salted water until tender and drain
2. Beat eggs until fluffy
3. Combine macaroni , eggs , cheese , milk , salt and pepper
4. Pour into a greased baking dish and bake at 350 degrees f
5. Until firm , about 30 minutes

title: rosemary roasted sweet potatoes
steps:
1. Peel potatoes and cut into 8 wedges
2. Stir together melted butter , brown sugar , chopped rosemary , and orange rind , until sugar dissolves
3. Pour mixture into a plastic ziplock bag and add potatoes
4. Seal bag and work mixture over potatoes , coating them thoroughly
5. Place potatoes on an oiled baking sheet and bake at 400f for 35-40 minutes or until potatoes are fork-tender and golden brown , turning potatoes once or twice during cooking

title: chili con pollo
steps:
1. In large saucepan , combine all ingredients except sour cream and salsa
2. Cook over medium heat about 10 minutes , stirring occasionally , until hot
3. Ladle chili into individual bowls
4. Top each serving with sour cream and salsa

title: hot chili powder
steps:
1. Grind all ingredients to a fine powder in a blender or spice mill
2. Store in an airtight container in a cool , dry place

title: quick and easy apple crisp
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Peel , core and slice apples
3. Place in a well greased 8x8-inch baking pan
4. Mix cake mix , oats , sugar and cinnamon in a large bowl
5. Melt butter and pour over the top of the dry cake mixture and mix until crumbly
6. Sprinkle this over apples
7. Bake 35-40 minutes until golden

title: judith comfort s crispy oven fried chicken
steps:
1. In bowl , whisk together egg and milk
2. In large bag , shake together flour , sesame seeds , baking powder , paprika and salt
3. Dip chicken pieces , one at a time , into egg mixture
4. Shake chicken in flour mixture
5. Place on foil-lined baking sheet
6. Drizzle with butter
7. Bake in 350 f oven for 1 hour or until chicken is crispy on outside and no longer pink inside

title: cranberry pumpkin muffins
steps:
1. Combine eggs , sugar , oil and pumpkin , mix well
2. Combine flour , spice , soda , and salt in a bowl
3. Make a well in the center and pour pumpkin mixture into well
4. Stir just until dry ingredients are moist
5. Stir in cranberries
6. Spoon into greased muffin pans
7. Bake at 350 degrees for about 30 minutes
8. I start checking for doneness around 20 minutes

title: ww 2 points   banana mousse
steps:
1. In medium bowl , combine banana slices , rum , and lemon juice
2. Let marinade 1 hour
3. Transfer to food processor or blender and process until pureed
4. Transfer to medium bowl , fold in whipped cream
5. Serve immediately or cover with plastic wrap and freeze
6. 2 points per serving

title: sofrito    puerto rican
steps:
1. You may have to do this in batches depending on the size of your food processor
2. Add onion to the food processor and let blend until smooth
3. Then add tomatoes and let blend until smooth
4. Then add the rest of the ingredients and let blend until smooth
5. Refridgerate promptly
6. This last for about 2 days in the fridge , freezing is highly recommended
7. The best way to freeze this is in ice cube trays to make it convenient or small snack sized baggies
8. This makes a large batch

title: grilled shrimp kabobs with creole butter
steps:
1. Combine the smart balance spreadable butter , creole seasoning , red pepper & paprika
2. Soak wooden skewers in water for at least 20 minutes
3. Season shrimp lightly with salt and pepper
4. Place shrimp on skewers
5. Heat grill to medium heat
6. When hot , lightly spray with smart balance omega non-stick cooking spray and add shrimp
7. Grill on both side for 6 to 8 minutes
8. Set shrimp aside on platter and brush creole butter onto the shrimp
9. Serve immediately

title: tuna surprise
steps:
1. In sauce pan fix the noodles according to the package directions
2. Do not add the seasoning pouch
3. Crush the fritos in a zip lock bag
4. Chop the onion finely or to the thickness of your liking
5. Chop the jalopenos finely
6. Open the tuna and drain and put in large mixing bowl
7. Add mayo , onion , jalopenos , fritos , and the jalopeno juice
8. When the noodles are done add them
9. Mix well and put on your favorite bread
10. Enjoy
11. For diabetics: use nature's own white wheat bread it only has 17g of carbs for 2 slices of bread

title: california pasta salad
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to package directions
2. Chop vegetables while pasta is cooking
3. Mix olive oil , red wine vinegar and lemon juice in a small bowl with a fork
4. In a large bowl , mix cooked pasta , chopped vegetables , dressing mixture , fines herbes , and salt
5. Sprinkle feta cheese on top of pasta and enjoy !

title: zippy cranberry salsa
steps:
1. Combine well the cranberries , pineapple , sugar , pepper , cilantro , onions , jalapeno , and salt
2. Cover and chill 2 hours
3. Serve as a condiment with meat or as a dip for chips

title: marinated artichoke tomato sauce
steps:
1. Chop the artichoke hearts
2. Pour the can of crushed tomatoes , artichokes , artichoke oil , chicken stock in a pot on high heat
3. Add the garlic and italian seasoning
4. Bring to a low boil and then reduce to a simmer on low heat
5. Allow the flavors to meld together and the sauce to reduce down for 1 hour
6. Add salt and pepper to taste as needed

title: to die for spaghetti and meatballs moms go to weeknight dinner
steps:
1. Preheat over to 350
2. In large bowl , mix egg , basil , oregano , parsley , salt , pepper , garlic and water
3. Add meat , breadcrumbs , and parmesan cheese and mix until just combined
4. Take 2 tbs meat mixture and roll into balls and place on ungreased baking sheet and bake for 10 minutes
5. Flip and cook another 10 minutes
6. While the meatballs are cooking , bring marinara sauce to simmer
7. Transfer meatballs to large saute pan with tomato sauce and cover and simmer on low heat for 10 minutes
8. Bring a large pot of salted water to boil and cook spaghetti
9. Drain and toss with sauce and meatballs in the same pan
10. Garnish with basil and parmesan cheese !

title: carolina mustard bbq pork sauce   lower sodium
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients
2. Whisk well
3. Enjoy !

title: friendly on the waistline bread delight
steps:
1. Apply honey on one side of a bread slice
2. Add oats over it
3. Add shredded carrot and grated cucumber over the oats
4. Pour and spread 1 tbsp
5. Honey over this
6. Top with the other bread slice
7. Pick it up and start eating !

title: 10 layer poor man s lasagna casserole
steps:
1. Brown hamburger in frying pan with salt and pepper , oregano , italian seasonings , onions and garlic until done
2. Drain grease
3. Stir in mushrooms and spaghetti sauce
4. Simmer on very low
5. Meanwhile , in small bowl , heat cream cheese in microwave until very soft
6. Stir in the sour cream and beef bouillon well
7. Set aside
8. Cook macaroni until just done or al dente
9. Drain well
10. In greased 4 quart roaster or crock pot , place 1 / 3 noodles , then 1 / 3 cream sauce , then 1 / 3 meat sauce , repeat 2 more times until ingredients are used up
11. Top with shredded mexican blend cheese
12. Bake in 350 degree fahrenheit oven for about 35 to 40 minutes until heated through and lightly bubbling
13. Let rest 5 or 10 minutes before serving
14. About 10-12 servings
15. Serve with garlic bread and a tossed salad

title: koofteh tabrizi  herbed meat   rice balls
steps:
1. Mix all the meatball ingredients together and roll into balls , 2-1 / 2 inches in diameter , firmly packed
2. Refrigerate them for 1 hour
3. To make the broth , heat the oil in a pan or soup kettle , add the onions and turmeric , and stir-fry over moderate heat until light brown , about 3 minutes
4. Add the tomatoes and salt and stir-fry for 2 minutes more
5. Add the water and bring to a boil
6. Moisten your hands with cold water
7. Take each herbed ball and roll it firmly
8. Add the balls to the broth very carefully , one at a time , so that they do not not fall apart
9. The water should just cover the balls
10. Cover the pan and cook over moderately low heat , without stirring , for 45 minutes
11. Add the green peas and cook for 10 minutes more
12. The broth will reduce somewhat , the balls swell considerably due to the expansion of the rice
13. Serve warm-- with the meatballs in the broth

title: kumquat curry with shrimp
steps:
1. Melt butter in a large skillet over high heat until it foams
2. Stir in curry powder
3. Reduce heat to medium
4. Cook , stirring constantly , 1 minute or until lightly darkened
5. Add cream , chicken broth , kumquats and raisins
6. Increase heat to high
7. Cook , stirring occasionally , 2 to 3 minutes or until slightly thickened
8. Reduce heat to medium
9. Add shrimp
10. Cook 3 minutes or until shrimp turn pink
11. Stir in cilantro

title: creamed spinach and bacon bake
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees
2. Butter an 9-inch baking dish
3. In a medium saucepan melt 5 tablespoons butter over medium heat
4. Add in onions and saute for about 4 minutes
5. Add in garlic , mushrooms , cooked bacon , cayenne pepper and seasoned salt , saute for 1 minute
6. Add in flour and stir with a wooden spoon and stir constantly for 2 minutes
7. Slowly add in the cream
8. Bring to a boil over medium heat stirring constantly until thickened and smooth
9. Reduce the heat to low and add in the spinach and stir until combined and mixed into the cream sauce
10. Mix in the cheddar cheese and 1 / 3 cup grated parmesan cheese
11. Stir until the cheese has melted
12. Season with black pepper to taste
13. Transfer to prepared baking dish
14. Sprinkle with 1 / 3 parmesan cheese
15. Bake for about 25 minutes or until browned on top and bubbly
16. Let sit for 20 minutes before spooning out of the baking dish , this only gets better the longer you leave it sit , but you won't be able to keep your spoon out of the dish lol !

title: cream cheese sour cream potato bake
steps:
1. In sauce pan over low heat blend milk and cream cheese
2. Heat until smooth
3. Add sour cream ,
4. Onion , and seasonings
5. Add potatoes and mix carefully so you won't mash the potatoes
6. Dish up in shallow baking pan
7. Sprinkle with paprika
8. Bake 350 for 30 minutes

title: sweet potato and carrot crumble
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Coat 2-quart baking dish with cooking spray
3. Toss potatoes , carrots and shallot with 1 / 4 cup melted butter , 1 / 4 cup brown sugar , 1 / 4 t
4. Cinnamon , 1 / 8 t
5. Nutmeg , salt and pepper
6. Transfer to baking dish
7. Cover
8. Bake 40 minutes or until potatoes and carrots are tender
9. Meanwhile , mix flour , pecans , remaining brown sugar , cinnamon and nutmeg
10. Stir in vanilla and remaining butter until crumbly
11. Top vegetables with crumb mixture
12. Bake , uncovered , 15-20 minutes or until lightly browned

title: spinach feta lasagna
steps:
1. Make the bechamel: heat the butter in a medium saucepan over low heat , and as soon as it begins to sizzle , add the flour and stir for 5 minutes
2. Slowly add the milk , whisking all the while , until smooth and thick , about 5-7 minutes
3. Cover the bechamel with a kitchen towel and set aside until ready to use
4. Bring a large pot of salted water to a rolling boil and cook lasagna noodles until firm , about 10 minutes
5. Remove , drain , and place in a large bowl of cold water until ready to use
6. Heat 3 tablespoons olive oil in a medium skillet
7. Add the onion and celery cover the skillet , and cook over low heat until soft , about 10 minutes
8. Combine the spinach , onions and celery , dill , feta and anthotiro in a large bowl
9. Mix in the eggs , season with salt , pepper , and nutmeg , and toss with 2 to 4 more tablespoons of olive oil
10. Preheat oven to 350d
11. Lightly oil a large shallow baking dish
12. Spread 2-3 tablespoons of bechamel on the bottom
13. Remove the lasagna noodles from the water one at a time and blot dry with a paper towel
14. Arrange one-third of the noodles in a single layer over the bechamel
15. Spread half the filling over the lasagna
16. Repeat with remaining lasagna and filling , ending up with a final layer of noodles
17. Spread the bechamel evenly over the noodles , and sprinkle with grated cheese
18. Bake for 45-50 minutes , until top is golden brown
19. Remove , cool slightly and serve

title: rita s christmas cheese logs
steps:
1. Allow all ingredients to come to room temperature
2. Mix ingredients in a food processor or with a powerful mixer
3. Shape into balls or logs in the desired size and roll in the pecans
4. Wrap in plastic wrap and return to the refrigerator

title: zesty crab dip
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 375f and lightly spritz a shallow baking dish with cooking spray
2. Mix all the ingredients except for the almonds and place in prepared baking dish
3. Sprinkle the almonds over the top and bake for 15 minutes

title: french vanilla  ice cap
steps:
1. Place ice cubes and milk in a electric blender and mix for 1 min or until smooth
2. Add instant coffee powder , vanilla , sugar and mix until foamy pour in a tall glass

title: hungarian vegetarian cabbage soup
steps:
1. Combine everything except the carraway seeds and yogurt in a large pot
2. Bring to a boil , reduce heat , and simmer uncovered for an hour
3. When serving , garnish with yogurt and carraway seeds , if desired

title: glazed fruit salad
steps:
1. Drain pineapple , reserving 1 cup juice
2. Combine pineapple , remaining fruit , and pecans in a large bowl
3. Toss gently
4. Combine pudding mix and reserved pineapple juice in a mixing bowl
5. Beat on high speed of electric mixer 1 minute
6. Pour pudding mixture over fruit and pecans
7. Toss gently
8. Chill and serve

title: northern jambalaya
steps:
1. Preheat your oven to 350
2. Mix the soup , cayenne and rice together
3. Brown the hamburg and kielbasa
4. In that same pan cook the green pepper , onion and celery until soft
5. Add all the ingredients to a 9 x 13 pan , mix together
6. Bake until brown and bubbly

title: cinnamon apple syrup from peel
steps:
1. Bring all four ingredients to a boil in a large stockpot
2. Stir until sugar dissolves
3. Reduce heat to medium and simmer until peels lose their bright color
4. Remove apple peels with tongs or a slotted spoon
5. Continue simmering until mixture has reduced by half
6. Test consistency by dipping a spoon into the mixture and then rubbing your finger across it
7. You will be able to tell when it has thickened
8. Cooking time will vary
9. You may can this in sterile jars or let it cool and keep in the refrigerator

title: chopped cobb salad  no cheese
steps:
1. Heat a grill pan or nonstick skillet over medium high heat
2. Coat chicken breasts with 2 teaspoons oil , poultry seasoning , salt and pepper
3. Wash hands
4. Grill or pan-fry chicken 6 to 7 minutes on each side
5. Remove from heat and let rest 5 minutes
6. In a small pot , cover eggs with cold water
7. Place over high heat and bring water to a boil
8. Once it comes to a boil , cover the pot and turn off the heat
9. Set a timer for 10 minutes
10. After the 10 minutes , cool eggs under cold running water
11. Peel and chop
12. Brown chopped bacon in a skillet over medium high heat
13. Drain bacon on paper towels
14. Chop 3 hearts of romaine lettuce and place in a large serving platter or salad bowl
15. Dress chopped lettuce with the juice of 1 1 / 2 lemons
16. Drizzle remaining 2 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil over lettuce
17. Season greens with salt and pepper , to taste
18. Toss diced avocados with juice of remaining 1 / 2 lemon , to retard browning
19. Halve chicken breasts and chop the meat
20. To serve , arrange rows of chopped chicken , chopped hard boiled egg , crisp bacon bits , diced avocado , diced tomato and chopped red onion on top of either 4 individual portions of dressed romaine or 1 large serving platter

title: smothered steak burger
steps:
1. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium heat
2. Coat pan with cooking spray
3. Add shallots and garlic to pan
4. Cook 1 minute or until tender , stirring frequently
5. Increase heat to medium-high
6. Add mushrooms to pan
7. Cook 10 minutes or until moisture evaporates , stirring occasionally
8. Combine broth , steak sauce , and cornstarch , stirring with a whisk
9. Add broth mixture to pan
10. Bring to a boil
11. Cook 1 minute or until thickened , stirring constantly
12. Stir in 1 / 4 teaspoon pepper
13. Remove mushroom mixture from pan
14. Cover and keep warm
15. Wipe pan with paper towels
16. Burgers can be grilled seperately on out door grill and then mushrooms cooked as directed
17. Combine remaining 1 / 4 teaspoon pepper , ketchup , and worcestershire sauce in a large bowl , stirring with a whisk
18. Add beef to bowl
19. Toss gently to combine
20. Shape beef mixture into 4 patties
21. Sprinkle evenly with salt
22. Heat pan over medium-high heat
23. Coat pan with cooking spray
24. Add patties to pan
25. Cook 4 minutes
26. Turn and cook 3 minutes or until desired degree of doneness
27. Place 1 lettuce leaf and 1 tomato slice on the bottom half of each roll
28. Top each serving with 1 patty , about 1 / 4 cup mushroom mixture , and top half of roll

title: bourbon manhattan     a classic cocktail
steps:
1. In a mixing glass , half-filled with ice cubes , combine all the ingredients , except the cherry
2. Stir a couple of times
3. Strain into a cocktail glass
4. Let the cherry drop to the bottom

title: chicken breasts with mustard caper sauce
steps:
1. Heat oil in large skillet over medium-high heat
2. Season chicken on both sides with salt and pepper
3. Add chicken to skillet
4. Cook about 5-6 minutes per side or until internal temperature reaches 170 degrees on an instant-read thermometer when inserted into chicken
5. Remove to platter and keep warm add broth , capers , rosemary and thyme to skillet
6. Cook over medium-high heat , scraping up any browned bits from bottom of skillet , for 5 minutes
7. Remove skillet from heat
8. Stir in the mustard , butter and honey just until the butter is incorporated
9. Butter should not completely melt and sauce should be frothy and somewhat thick
10. Pour sauce over chicken
11. Serve immediately with couscous , if desired

title: garlic chicken with orzo pasta
steps:
1. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil
2. Add orzo pasta , cook for 8 to 10 minutes until al dente , drain
3. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat , and cook the garlic and red pepper 1 minute , until garlic is golden brown , being careful not to burn the garlic
4. Stir in chicken , season with salt , and cook 2 to 5 minutes , or until lightly brown
5. Reduce heat to medium , and mix in the parsley and cooked orzo
6. Add spinach to the skillet
7. Continue cooking 5 minutes , stirring occasionally , until spinach wilts
8. Remove from heat
9. Serve topped with parmesan cheese

title: popeyes fried chicken
steps:
1. Combine first 9 ingredients in large bowl
2. Put the cornflakes into another bowl
3. Put eggs and water in a 3rd bowl
4. Put enough corn oil into a heavy roomy skillet to fill it 1 inch deep
5. Get it hot !
6. Grease a 9x12x2-inch baking pan
7. Set it aside
8. Preheat the oven to 350f
9. Dip the chicken pieces 1 piece at a time as follows: into dry coating mix
10. Into egg and water mix
11. Into corn flakes
12. Briskly but briefly back into dry mix
13. Drop into hot oil , skin-side-down and brown 3 to 4 minutes on medium high
14. Turn and brown other side of each piece
15. Don't crowd pieces during frying
16. Place in the prepared pan in a single layer , skin-side-up
17. Seal in foil , on 3 sides only , leaving 1 side loose for steam to escape
18. Bake at 350~ for 35-40 minutes removing foil then to test tenderness of the chicken
19. Allow to bake uncovered 5 minutes longer to crisp the coating
20. Leftovers refrigerate well up to 4 days
21. Do not freeze these leftovers

title: mexican casserole dinner
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f
2. Cook ground beef , stirring occasionally until brown
3. Drain off fat
4. Stir in rice , soup , chilies , and taco seasoning mix
5. Spoon into 12 x 8-inch baking pan
6. Top with tomatoes cheese and corn chips
7. Bake for 30-35 minutes or until heated through

title: donut shop donuts  filling  and icings glazes
steps:
1. Donuts:
2. To make the dough , in a medium bowl combine 3 cups of the flour , the yeast , sugar and salt
3. Stir together with a fork and set aside
4. In the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the dough hook , combine the milk and eggs
5. Add the flour mixture and mix on low speed for 3-4 minutes or until a ball of dough forms
6. With the mixer on low speed , add the softened butter a piece at a time , mixing for about 15 seconds between each addition
7. Continue mixing for about 3 minutes longer , adding the remaining flour 1 tablespoon at a time if necessary , until the dough forms a ball
8. Transfer the dough to a lightly oiled bowl , turning once to coat
9. Cover with plastic wrap and let rise at room temperature for 90 minutes
10. Transfer the dough to a lightly floured surface and roll it to a thickness of inch
11. Traditional donuts: cut the dough into rounds using a 2-3 inch biscuit or cookie cutter
12. Use a smaller circle cutter to cut the hole out of the middle of each , creating the doughnut shape
13. Reroll and cut the dough scraps as necessary to make use of all the dough
14. Long johns: using a pizza cutter , trim the rounded edges and then cut dough into 4"x2" rectangles
15. Reroll and cut the dough scraps as necessary to make use of all the dough
16. Place the shaped doughnuts and doughnut holes onto a lightly floured baking sheet , and cover loosely with plastic wrap and let rise at room temperature 90 minutes
17. Meanwhile , fit a candy thermometer to the side of a large dutch oven
18. Add the shortening to the pot and gradually heat it over medium-high heat until it reaches a temperature of 375f
19. Place the rings and holes carefully into the hot fat 4 or 5 at a time , or the long johns 2 at a time , being sure not to crowd the pan
20. Fry until golden brown , about 30-45 seconds per side
21. Remove from the hot oil with a skimmer and transfer to a paper towel-lined cooling rack
22. Repeat with the remaining doughnuts , returning the temperature to 375 f between batches
23. Cool the doughnuts for about 10 minutes before topping or glazing
24. If filling with cream , wait 20 minutes or until room temperatureserve warm or at room temperature
25. Cream filling: place butter and shortening in a mixing bowl , and at low speed , gradually beat in the sugar and water
26. Turn the mixer on high and beat for 2 to 3 minutes until filling is light and fluffy
27. Fit a pastry bag with a long and narrow
28. Fill the bag with the cream
29. Poke the
30. For filled long johns , pipe the cream through three small holes in the bottom of the donut
31. Vanilla glaze:
32. Mix all glaze ingredients in a bowl until completely smooth
33. One by one , dip doughnuts into the glaze until halfway submerged
34. Remove from glaze , then turn right side up on a cooling rack over a cookie sheet
35. Maple-coffee glaze:
36. Mix all glaze ingredients in a bowl until completely smooth
37. One by one , dip doughnuts into the glaze until halfway submerged
38. Remove from glaze , then turn right side up on a cooling rack over a cookie sheet
39. Caramel icing:
40. In a medium heavy-bottomed saucepan , bring sugar , water , and corn syrup to a boil over medium high heat , stirring just to combine before bring to boil
41. When caramel turns a light amber , remove from heat and carefully add butter
42. Stir to incorporate , then beat in milk and powdered sugar until smooth- mixture will be thick
43. Holding donut , use a spatula or spoon to carefully scrape a thick layer of icing over the donut
44. Chocolate icing:
45. In the bowl of an electric mixer , beat butter on medium speed until creamy
46. Add powdered sugar , cocoa powder , and milk and beat until smooth
47. Holding donut , use a spatula or spoon to carefully scrape a thick layer of icing over the donut

title: garlicky barley vegetable chicken soup for one or two
steps:
1. In a saucepan saute the garlic and onion in the oil until the onion is clear
2. Add veggies and lightly saute
3. Add broth and tomatoes and simmer about 5-8 minute stir in the barley , chicken and herbs heat through

title: ww crumb topped jumbo bran muffins
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees
2. Spray a 6-jumbo-cup nonstick muffin pan with nonstick spray
3. To make the crumb topping , combine 2 tablespoons of the all-purpose flour and the brown sugar in a medium bowl
4. With a pastry blender , cut in the butter until the mixture is crumbly
5. Stir in the walnuts
6. Combine the bran , wholewheat flour , the remaining 1 / 2 cup all-purpose flour , the baking soda , baking powder , and salt in a large bowl
7. With an electric mixer on medium speed , beat the egg , egg whites , sugar , and molasses in a large bowl intil blended
8. Gradually beat in the buttermilk
9. Gradually add the bran mixture , mixing on low speed until just blended
10. Stir in the raisins
11. Spoon the batter into the cups , filling each about half full
12. Sprinkle with the crumb topping
13. Bake until a toothpick inserted into a muffin comes out clean , about 25 minutes
14. Cool in the pan on a rack 5 minutes
15. Remove from the pan and cool completely on the rack

title: so easy bbq chicken
steps:
1. Combine coke and ketchup
2. Combine coke mix and chicken in fry pan
3. Heat for about 20-30 minutes until chicken is tested and done
4. If the sauce is runny , turn down the heat and cook until thick , 5-10 minutes
5. That's it !

title: baked egg boats
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Cut a deep v through the tops of each baguette until about a 1 / 2 inch to the bottom
3. Partially unstuff the baguettes
4. Set aside
5. Place the eggs and cream into a mixing bowl and lightly beat together
6. Whisk in the remaining ingredients and lightly season with salt and pepper
7. Divide and pour the mixture into each baguette boat and place onto a baking sheet
8. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown , puffed and set in the center
9. Season with salt and pepper
10. Allow to cool for about 5 minutes , cut and serve

title: king arthur chewy coconut chocolate chunk cookies
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 375f lightly grease two baking sheets , or line with parchment paper
2. In a large mixing bowl , cream together the butter , coconut milk powder and sugars
3. Stir the coconut milk powder through a strainer as you add it to the mixing bowl , to take out any lumps
4. Beat in the egg , corn syrup , and coconut flavor
5. Scrape the sides and bottom of the mixing bowl , and beat for another 30 seconds to make sure everything is evenly combined
6. Whisk together the flour , salt , baking soda , and baking powder
7. Beat into the butter mixture until evenly combined
8. Mix in the coconut and chocolate chips or chunks
9. Scoop by the tablespoonful onto the prepared baking sheets , and bake for 9 to 11 minutes
10. A tablespoon cookie scoop works well here
11. Bake just until the edges of the cookies are a light golden brown
12. Remove from the oven and let the cookies cool on the pan for 5 minutes before transferring to a rack to finish cooling completely

title: eggs a la russe
steps:
1. Arrange egg halves on a serving plate , cut side down
2. Combine remaining ingredients and spoon over eggs

title: yummy bagel sandwich
steps:
1. Mix cream cheese , banana and preserves
2. Spread on toasted bagel and enjoy

title: sun dried tomato mini meatloaves
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit
2. Line baking sheet with parchment paper
3. Place sun-dried tomatoes and boiling water in small bowl
4. Cover
5. Let stand 5 minutes or until soft
6. Remove tomatoes from bowl
7. Cool
8. Squeeze out moisture
9. Chop
10. In large bowl , gently mix together sun-dried tomatoes , turkey , oats , cheese , eggs , onion , thyme , pepper and salt
11. Divide into 4 portions
12. Gently form each portion into loaf shape
13. Place on baking sheet
14. Press 2 sage leaves onto top of each loaf
15. Drizzle loaves with oil
16. Bake 25-30 minutes or until no longer pink in center and internal temperature reaches 170 degrees fahrenheit

title: sauerkraut mit kielbasa
steps:
1. Place half the sauerkraut in a slow cooker , and top with the sausage
2. Cover with the remaining sauerkraut , apples , and onion
3. Pour chicken broth over all , and sprinkle with caraway seeds
4. Cover , and cook on high 3-4 hours or low 6-8 hours
5. Place each serving in a broiler-safe individual bowl or casserole , sprinkle with swiss cheese and place under broiler for 1-2 minutes until cheese turns bubbly and brown

title: 57 chevy
steps:
1. Shake the bourbon , grand marnier and vodka
2. Pour into a cocktail glass and add pineapple juice to fill

title: cherry crumb coffee cake
steps:
1. In mixing bowl , cream together butter and sugar
2. Add eggs , one at a time
3. Mix well
4. Add remaining ingredients except pie filling
5. Beat well
6. Spread half of the batter in a greased 13 x 9" baking pan
7. Spread cherry pie filling over batter
8. Cover with remaining batter
9. For topping: combine all ingredients except
10. Butter and nuts in a small mixing bowl
11. Cut in butter
12. Stir in nuts
13. Sprinkle topping over batter
14. Bake at 350 about 45 minutes until cake springs back when lightly pressed with finger

title: metric bagels  when i go back home
steps:
1. In large bowl , sprinkle yeast over warm water to soften
2. Stir to dissolve
3. Add 2 tablespoons sugar , oil , 6 cups of flour , and salt
4. Mix thoroughly until the dough forms up and leaves the sides of the bowl
5. Turn dough out on floured board and knead , adding small amounts of flour as necessary
6. Bagel dough should be pretty stiff
7. Work in as much extra flour as you can comfortably knead
8. Knead until smooth and elastic , 12-15 minutes
9. Roll the dough into a ball , place it in a large oiled bowl , and turn to coat
10. Cover and let fully rise until an impression made with your finger remains and does not sink into the dough
11. Punch down and cut into thirds , and roll each piece between your palms into a rope
12. Cut each rope into 4 equal pieces and shape into balls
13. Roll the first ball into another rope that is about 2" longer than the width of your hand
14. Make a ring with the dough , overlapping ends about 1 / 2" and sealing the ends by rolling with your palm on the board
15. If the dough resists rolling , dab on a drop of water with your finger
16. Evenly place the bagels on 2 nonstick baking pans or very lightly oiled baking sheets
17. Cover and let stand until puffy , about 20 minutes
18. While bagels are proofing , fill a 4 quart saucepan 2 / 3 full with cold water
19. Add 1 tablespoon sugar and bring to a boil
20. When ready to cook , drop 2 or 3 bagels at a time into the boiling water and wait until they rise to the top
21. Cook for a total of 1 minute , turning once
22. Carefully lift each bagel out with a slotted spoon or skimmer
23. Drain momentarily
24. Turn into a dish with topping , if desired
25. Evenly space bagels on 2 nonstick baking pans or very lightly oiled baking sheets
26. Bake with steam in a preheated 500 degree f oven until well-browned , about 20 minutes
27. Turn bagels over when the tops begin to brown , and continue baking until done

title: ranch dressing mix plus
steps:
1. In a large mixing bowl , combine first 8 ingredients
2. Mix well
3. Store in airtight container in a cool dry place
4. Yield: 3 cups mix
5. For ranch salad dressing: in a bowl , whisk together 2 tablespoons of mix with mayonnaise and buttermilk
6. Refrigerate until serving
7. For thousand island dressing: add chili sauce and pickle relish to 1 cup prepared ranch dressing
8. For cucumber dressing: add cucumber and celery seed to 1 cup of prepared ranch salad dressing

title: slow peaches
steps:
1. Spray crockpot with non-stick spray
2. Mix dry ingredients together
3. Stir in peaches and pour into crockpot
4. Cook on low 4 to 6 hours

title: oma s giant rhubarb cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Spray a 10 by 15" pyrex baking dish with cooking spray
3. Prepare base by mixing 3 cups flour , 1 cup butter , salt , baking powder and 2 eggs in the bowl of a mixer until dough resembles streusel crumbs
4. Pat three-quarters of the base dough into the prepared pan
5. Sprinkle with cinnamon
6. Set aside remainder in a small bowl
7. In mixer bowl , combine 3 cups sugar , 1 cup flour , melted butter and 3 eggs and mix until combined
8. Add rhubarb and mix gently
9. Spread over base and sprinkle with cinnamon
10. Crumble remaining base dough over cake like streusel crumbs
11. Sprinkle with cinnamon
12. Bake at 350f for one hour

title: carrot and rutabaga puree
steps:
1. In a large pot of boiling , salted water , cook the carrots and rutabagas for 30 minutes or until tender
2. Drain and mash by hand or in a food processor until coarse
3. Blend in butter , a pinch of sugar and salt and pepper to taste
4. Serve warm

title: biftek hache a la lyonnaise
steps:
1. Cook the onions slowly in 2 tablespoons of butter until tender not browned
2. Place onions in mixing bowl
3. Add the beef , butter the seasonings and the egg
4. Mix well
5. Form into patties 3 / 4" thick
6. Cover & refrigerate till ready to use
7. Just before sauting , roll the patties lightly in flour
8. Shake off any excess flour
9. Place butter and oil in heavy skillet over med-high heat
10. When butter foam begins to subside , saute the patties for about 3 minutes per side
11. Place burgers on serving platter and keep warm while finishing the sauce
12. Pour fat out of the skillet and discard
13. Add stock and boil down rapidly
14. Scraping up the coagulated pan juice till reduced to almost a syrup
15. Off heat , swirl 2-3 tablespoons of butter into the sauce - 1 / 2 tablespoon at a time until absorbed into the sauce
16. Pour the sauce over the hamburgers and serve

title: garlic artichoke dip
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Mix all ingredients in bowl
3. Spoon into baking dish and bake for 20 minutes
4. Serve with french , sourdough or your favorite bread
5. As always , my disclaimer: if you do not adore garlic , i would reduce the amount to 4 cloves

title: low fat potato bacon and cheese hash browns homemade
steps:
1. Peel potatoes and cut in half
2. Place in large saucepan and cook uncovered for 15 - 20 minutes until soft
3. Mash
4. Fine dice onion and bacon
5. Spray frypan with cooking oil and saut both for 5 minutes
6. Add above mixture , egg , cheese and parsley to potato mash
7. Season with pepper
8. Using 1 / 2 cup of potato mixture , roll slightly in breadcrumbs
9. Place on a plate and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes
10. Spray frypan with cooking oil and cook patties 5 minutes of until golden brown on both sides
11. Enjoy !

title: pattypan squash fritters
steps:
1. Before shredding , cut out the stem of the squash , but there's no need to peel it
2. If the squash is large , more than 4 inches across , you may wish to cut out the bigger seeds
3. Preheat about 1 / 2 inch oil over medium-high heat in a deep skillet
4. Beat the eggs , milk and oil into the squash in a large bowl , then add the flour , baking powder and salt and mix until combined with a few strokes
5. Drop tablespoons of batter into hot oil-- in a big skillet , you can cook up to 8 at a time
6. Cook until brown , turn with a spatula and cook the other side until brown
7. Drain on newspaper or other suitable draining surface
8. Serve with horseradish sauce , ketchup or whatever catches your fancy

title: sambousa with beef
steps:
1. In a pan cook the onion and garlic to golden brown , add pine nuts and cook for 2 minute more
2. Add the meat and spices , and cook on medium flame , while stirring , until the meat changes color
3. It is vital to stir the meat to avoid the formation of big lamps of meat
4. Heat oven to 180c
5. Roll out the dough to 3mm and cut 10cm circles
6. Put a tablespoon of filling in the middle of each circle and fold into half a circle
7. Pinch the edges tightly
8. Put sambousa in oiled and floured pan
9. Brush a little egg yolk on each sambusak
10. Bake for 30 minute or until golden brown

title: cowboy casserole
steps:
1. Brown ground beef and drain , preheat oven to 425f
2. Stir baked beans and barbecue sauce into beans heat to boiling while stirring , pour into sprayed 2 quart casserole dish
3. Stir bisquick mix , milk , and butter until dough forms
4. Drop by spoonfuls onto beef mixture
5. Bake uncovered 20 minutes until topping is golden brown
6. Sprinkle with cheese and cook about 3 minutes more or until cheese is melted

title: vegan egg replacer   substitute
steps:
1. Whisk ingredients together until foamy
2. One batch = equivalent of one egg

title: danny s sauce for burgers
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together in medium pot and boil about 5 minutes to thicken
2. Pour sauce in and over a cheeseburger

title: roasted brussels sprouts with hazelnut brown butter
steps:
1. Position rack in bottom third of oven and preheat to 450f
2. Put butter on a large rimmed baking sheet and roast until the butter is melted , browned and fragrant
3. Remove baking sheet from oven and toss brussels sprouts and hazelnuts with the browned butter
4. Sprinkle with salt and pepper
5. Return to oven and roast for 7 minutes
6. Sprinkle with water , toss , and continue roasting until the sprouts are tender and lightly browned

title: pineapple glazed steaks
steps:
1. Combine last 4 ingredients in microwave-safe bowl
2. Microwave on high 2-3 minutes or until thickened
3. Place steaks on hot grill , turning occasionally and brushing both sides with some of the glaze
4. Grill steaks 13-15 minutes
5. Carve steaks
6. Drizzle with remaining glaze

title: baby potatoes with cumin
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Set potatoes on cookie sheet and drizzle with oil
3. Toss with cumin seeds and roast 20 min , then broil 5 min to brown cut edges
4. Toss cooked potatoes with salt , and serve

title: spicy perogy pizza
steps:
1. Thinly slice potatoes and place , over lapping , on a greased baking sheet
2. Sprinkle with salt , pepper , garlic powder , parsley , dried red chilies and paprika
3. Bake for 20-30 minutes at 350f
4. Spread a very thin layer of tomato sauce on crust and sprinkle with mozzarella carefully spread sour cream on top of sauce / cheese
5. Place baked potato slices on top and sprinkle with broken up bacon and then onions
6. Bake at 425f for 15-20 minutes
7. Take pizza out and sprinkle cheddar cheese and chopped green onions
8. Turn oven off and put pizza back in for about 5 minutes to melt the cheddar

title: festive winter salad
steps:
1. Combine the vinegar , oil , honey , salt and pepper in a medium bowl , and whisk to combine
2. Taste for seasoning , and add more salt or pepper if needed
3. Place half of the lettuce on each of two salad plates
4. Scatter the pomegranate seeds , pistachios , and cheese over each plate
5. Drizzle with the dressing , and serve immediately

title: onion and yoghurt dip
steps:
1. Peel and mince the onion
2. Clean , wash and chop corriander and mint leaves
3. Wash and mince the green chillies
4. Peel and chop the ginger
5. Roast and powder the cumin seeds
6. Powder the mustard seeds
7. Put the onions in water for 15 minutes
8. Drain thoroughly and keep aside
9. Blend the yoghurt with 2 tablespoons of water and seasonings
10. Beat till smooth
11. Stir in the rest of the ingredients
12. Serve garnished with a slit green chilli

title: lemon pepper baked sweet potato
steps:
1. Do not puncture potato since sweet potatoes will drip juices while baking
2. Wrap in foil and bake at 400 degrees for about 45 minutes depending on size
3. Slice open and top with butter , cheese and lemon pepper seasoning in that order so cheese has an opportunity to melt
4. Dress with sour cream and chives
5. Sprinkle with additional lemon pepper

title: grandma s banana bread
steps:
1. Mash bananas well
2. Mix in the sugar and let stand for 10 minutes
3. Grease and flour loaf pan and preheat oven to 350
4. Add vanilla , egg and oil to the banana mixture
5. Mix in flour , baking soda and salt
6. If you choose , mix in walnuts
7. Pour batter into prepared loaf pan and bake for 60-90 minutes (until a toothpick inserted into the center of the loaf comes out clean

title: low fat beef marrakesh
steps:
1. Heat frypan
2. Add 1 tbsp stock and saute diced red onions for about 5 minutes
3. Lightly brown
4. Set aside
5. Add in small batches diced beef
6. Brown
7. Set aside
8. Return beef and onion to pan and add rest of ingredients
9. Combine well
10. Cover and simmer on low for about 1 to 1 1 / 4 hours until meat melts in your mouth
11. Check at about 15 minute intervals and stir
12. If requires more liquid , add 1 / 2 nectar plus 1 / 2 beef broth at a time
13. Enjoy !

title: easy mousse cake filling   any flavor
steps:
1. In a chilled metal bowl , beat whipping cream on medium-high speed until it begins to thicken
2. Gradually add in the instant pudding mix and continue to beat , just until thick
3. If you'd like to add fruit filling , fold it into the cream after it's thickened

title: low carb wonton sundaes
steps:
1. Place wonton wrappers on a work surface
2. Spritz with butter flavored spray
3. Combine 1 tbsp sugar with cinnamon
4. Srpinkle over wontons
5. Press into mini muffin cups coated with spray
6. Bake 350 for 4-5 min till light brown
7. Immediatley remove wonton cups to an ungreased sheet
8. Bake 2-3 minutes longer till bottoms are light brown
9. Remove to rack
10. In a small bowl , beat cream cheese , vanilla and remaining sugar till smooth
11. Stir in chocolate chips and pecans
12. Spoon into wonton cups
13. Top each with a cherry

title: lemon marinated chicken breasts
steps:
1. Process the first 7 ingredients in a blender or food processor until smooth , scraping down sides of the bowl frequently
2. Remove about 1 / 4 cup of the mixture to a small bowl , cover and refrigerate
3. Place the chicken breasts in a shallow glass dish
4. Pour the marinade over and toss using clean hands to coat the chicken with marinade
5. Place in the refrigerator for about 2-3 hours , turning the bag occasionally
6. Remove the chicken and discard the marinade
7. Season the chicken with seasoned salt and more black pepper
8. Grill or broil the chicke breasts until completely cooked , basting frequently with the reserved 1 / 4 cup lemon marinade

title: tomato and mushroom pasta
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to directions on package
2. In a medium skillet , heat olive oil over medium heat
3. Add onions to skillet and saute 3-4 minutes , stirring occasionally , until onions are softening
4. Add mushrooms , tomatoes , 1 tablespoon butter , and soy sauce to skillet
5. Cook , stirring occasionally , for about 8-10 minutes or until tomatoes are beginning to fall apart
6. When pasta is done cooking , drain and toss with remaining 2 tablespoons butter until coated
7. Stir in tomato-mushroom mixture and parmesan
8. Serve immediately

title: cream cheese ball
steps:
1. Chop onions and beef into small pieces
2. Mix all ingredients together and shape into a ball
3. Serve with crackers or vegetables

title: egg white omelet with spinach or chard
steps:
1. In a small nonstick skillet , heat one teaspoon of oil , add the spinach or chard , and cook until it's wilted
2. Season with salt and pepper , then move it to a plate
3. Add the second teaspoon of oil to the pan , then pour in the whites
4. Tilt the pan to spread them out , then cook over medium heat until they're set
5. Season with a pinch of salt and pepper , arrange the spinach over 1 / 3 of the eggs , then gently prod the eggs over it to make a rolled omelet

title: southwest risotto
steps:
1. Cook onion and garlic in butter in a large skillet over medium heat , stirring until tender
2. Add rice
3. Cook 2-3 minute stirring constantly
4. Add wine , cook uncovered until wine is absorbed
5. Add 1 celsius broth
6. Cook stirring over med-high 5 minute or until broth is absorbed
7. Add remaining broth 1 celsius at a time , cooking and stiirring constantly until each cup is absorbed , about 25-30 minute
8. Stir in whippng cream and next 5 ingredients
9. Cook 2 minute longer

title: pina colada fudge
steps:
1. Line 8 or 9 square pan with foil , extending foil over edges
2. Place chips in medium microwave-safe bowl
3. Microwave on high for 1-2 minutes or until melted , stirring every 15 seconds until smooth
4. Reserve 1 / 4 cup nuts for garnish
5. Add remaining nuts and all remaining ingredients to melted chip mixture
6. Mix well
7. Spread in foil-lined pan
8. Sprinkle with reserved nuts
9. Refrigerate 1 hour or until firm
10. Remove fudge from pan by lifting foil
11. Remove foil
12. Cut into squares
13. To toast macadamia nuts and coconut , spread on separate small cookie sheets
14. Bake at 350f
15. For 5 to 8 minutes or until light golden brown , stirring occasionally

title: scallops with lemon chive sauce
steps:
1. Season scallops with salt and pepper
2. Melt 1 tbs butter in non-stick skillet over medium-high heat
3. Add garlic and cook until fragrant , about 30 seconds
4. Add spinach and stir until wilted
5. Transfer spinach to platter and cover to keep warm
6. Wipe out skillet and return to heat
7. Add remaining butter
8. When butter is melted , and just begins to sizzle , add half the scallops and cook until browned , about 2 minutes
9. Transfer to platter
10. Repeat with remaining scallops
11. Carefully add lemon juice to pan , scraping up any brown bits from bottom of pan
12. Remove from heat , stir in chives and zest
13. Pour over scallops and spinach and serve

title: orange soda
steps:
1. Stir together orange juice concentrate and lemon-lime soft drink just before serving
2. Serve over ice in individual glasses with an orange slice

title: pot sticker and roasted pepper salad
steps:
1. In a 10- to 12-inch frying pan , arrange frozen potstickers in a single layer
2. Add 2 / 3 cup water and salad oil
3. Cover and bring to a boil over high heat , then reduce heat and simmer until liquid cooks away and potstickers begin to brown , 12 to 17 minutes
4. Cut red peppers into thin strips
5. In a large bowl , mix hoisin , lemon juice , toasted sesame oil , sugar , ginger , and garlic
6. Add salad mix to bowl and mix with dressing
7. Spoon salad onto dinner plates and top with equal portions of red peppers and hot potstickers

title: wendy richard s chili recipe   the best chili ever
steps:
1. From wendy richard herself:
2. Fry onions in little olive oil with crushed garlic
3. Add meat together with all seasonings
4. Add rest of veg , together with made-up chicken stock
5. Add chocolate and tomato paste
6. Gently simmer for about three hours , stirring occasionally
7. Serve with boiled rice or pasta
8. Grated cheese is also a good addition , sprinkled over the top
9. The dish freezes well & gains in strength of flavour
10. I thank you w
11. R
12. Here is the link to the touching tribute to wendy in the "guardian" along with a copy of this recipe:

title: salmon  microwave cooked
steps:
1. Marinate and / or baste salmon with 1 / 2 of your favorite marinade
2. Place fish , skin side down in a shallow microwave-safe dish
3. Cover with plastic wrap
4. Cook , on high , for 7-8 minutes
5. Remove dish , uncover and baste with the rest of marinade
6. Recover and cook on medium for 6-7 minutes
7. Salmon will come out tender and flaky

title: pork chops in mustard sauce
steps:
1. Melt butter in a pan and saute onion
2. Set onions aside
3. Mix flour , salt and pepper and cover the meat with it
4. Brown the meat and add the onion and beer
5. Leave to simmer covered for 30min
6. Put meat on a plate and stir mustard and sugar into the sauce
7. Pour over the chops and serve

title: absolutely the easiest  baked macaroni and cheese
steps:
1. Spray a 9x11x2 pan and spread the uncooked macaroni in the bottom
2. Dot with butter and evenly spread the cottage cheese over this
3. Don't mix
4. Add the american cheese and then add the cheddar cheese evenly
5. Pour the boiling water over the top
6. Do not stir
7. Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour

title: ww core chocolate banana smoothies
steps:
1. In a blender , combine the skim milk , pudding mix , banana , and ice cubes
2. Cover and process until blended
3. Pour into chilled glasses
4. Serve immediately

title: israeli couscous with pistachios and apricots
steps:
1. Preheat a large heavy bottomed skillet over medium-low heat
2. Place the garlic and oil in the pan and saute for 1 minute
3. Add the couscous , raise the heat to medium , and stir constantly for 4 minutes
4. The couscous should start to toast-- add the cinnamon stick , cumin , cardamom , pepper , and salt to toast a bit-keep stirring for another one to two minutes
5. Add broth and lime zest
6. Raise the heat and bring to a boil
7. Once the mixture is boiling , lower the heat again to as low as possible and cover
8. In about 10 minutes , most of broth should have been absorbed
9. Add 2 tablespoons of the mint , and the apricots , pistachios , and lime juice
10. Stir , cover again , and cook for 5 more minutes
11. At this point , the broth should be thoroughly absorbed
12. Remove the cinnamon stick , fluff the couscous with a fork , garnish with the remaining mint , and serve

title: big kahuna personal pizza
steps:
1. Spread pizza sauce on bun
2. Sprinkle handful of cheddar cheese on bun
3. Sprinkle handful of mozzarella cheese on bun
4. Put 3 pepperonis on , 2 on one side of bun on the ends , 1 in the middle on the opposite side of the bun
5. Cook in toaster oven at 425 until cooked and cheese is sizzling
6. Serve on a plate
7. You can break the two sides off separately , fold them over sub sandwich style , or eat it whole
8. Enjoy !

title: creamy potato salad
steps:
1. Cook potatoes in boiling , salted water until tender
2. Drain well
3. Peel and cube potatoes
4. Transfer to a large bowl
5. Add celery , onion , sweet relish and bacon bits
6. Combine mayo , sugar , celery seed , vinegar , mustard , and salt
7. Add mayo mixture to potatoes
8. Toss lightly to coat potato mixture
9. Carefully fold in the chopped eggs
10. Cover and chill thoroughly
11. Bacon bit
12. Use a sharp knife and cut the frozen bacon into long strips about 1 / 4 inch wide
13. Turn the bacon and cut the strips into pieces also about 1 / 4 in wide
14. You now have perfect raw bacon pieces to fast fry
15. No need to separate
16. They will separate during cooking
17. Perfect bacon bits

title: stuffed poblanos
steps:
1. Fry chicken in a bit of oil , sprinkling with any or all of the seasonings to taste
2. Put heat on low and cover fry pan , turning chicken occasionally till done
3. If there's some juice in the pan , after removing the chicken , cook on high heat till reduced to just a couple tablespoons or so and set aside
4. Remove chicken from pan and chop
5. Mix with cream cheese
6. Add jack cheese , cilantro , jalapeno , scallion and a little salt , and mix well
7. Place poblanos in a lightly greased baking dish cut side up and fill each with chicken mixture
8. If you have the reduced chicken broth , pour over peppers
9. Top each with a little or a lot of your favorite salsa , picante sauce or any mexican tomato based sauce
10. We use just a tsp or so on each pepper because hubby is on atkin's , and it's just enough to add the salsa flavor
11. Bake at 350 for anywhere from 20 to 45 minutes till heated through and a bit bubbly

title: chocolate chip devils food muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Lightly spray muffin tins
3. In a large mixing bowl , combine flour , baking powder , sugar , salt and soda -- stir to blend
4. In a seperate bowl , whisk milk , oil , eggs and vanilla
5. Till smooth --
6. Add the liquid ingredients and 1 / 2 cup of chocolate chips to the dry ingredinets and fold just until evenly moistened -- do not overmix
7. Divide batter evenly among the muffin tins , sprinkle the muffins with mini chocolate chips , and bake until a toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
8. 20-22 minutes
9. Cool on wire rack before removing from pan

title: quick and easy peach cobbler
steps:
1. Heat oven to 425
2. Spoon butter in an 8x8 inch casserole dish
3. Place in oven so the butter can melt
4. Sift the flour and sugar together
5. Slowly stir in milk
6. Add the vanilla extract
7. Pour mixture into baking dish
8. Spoon in peaches
9. Then , pour the peach syrup over the peaches
10. The peaches will sink in , so don't stir the mixture
11. Bake for 30-40 minutes or until brown
12. Either way it'll turn out great !

title: french cake   sauce   passed down by generations
steps:
1. Mix cake ingredients together in order
2. After adding each one , mix
3. In different bowl mix sauce ingredients together in order
4. After each one , mix
5. Pour cake mixture in glass 11x14-inch cake pan then sauce over top from side to side through the cake till all the sauce is used
6. Bake at 350f degrees for 30-35 minutes
7. It looks like a lot of work but it's not and the end results is well worth it
8. Enjoy

title: fresh fruit with lemon mint sauce
steps:
1. Place the orange and grapefruit pieces along with the grapes and chopped mint in a medium bowl , gently tossing to combine
2. Cover and chill 2 hours
3. Stir together yogurt with the lemon rind , lemon juice and honey just before serving , and serve with fruit mixture
4. Garnish with fresh mint sprigs

title: peach melba crepes cake
steps:
1. Quick crepe batter:
2. Place the eggs , milk and oil into blender container , cover and process by pulsing several times
3. Add pancake mix and process until smooth
4. Scrape down sides of the container with a spatula
5. Blend until smooth
6. Spray a 10 non-stick skillet with the non-stick spray
7. Heat the pan over medium-high heat
8. Remove the pan from the heat and pour 3-4 tablespoons crepe batter into the center of the pan , about 1 / 4 cup
9. Quickly rotate the pan tilting to coat the surface
10. Cook until the crepes center and edges appear dry and lightly browned
11. Carefully turn the crepe over and cook the other side
12. Turn out the crepe onto a plate
13. Cover to keep warm if desired
14. Repeat with remaining batter
15. Filling:
16. Combine cream cheese , powdered sugar and almond extract in a small bowl with hand mixer until smooth
17. Assembly:
18. Place a crepe on the serving plate , spread with two tablespoons of the cream cheese mixture
19. Repeat with the next 6 crepes
20. Top off the crepe cake with the last remaining crepe
21. Cover and refrigerate
22. Bring to room temperature just before serving
23. Arrange peaches in a spoke-like fashion in the center
24. Garnish with whipped cream along the outside edge
25. You could use fesh made whipped cream
26. Drizzle with raspberry jam
27. Cut into 6 or 8 wedges and serve with additional whipped cream and raspberry sauce

title: chicken penne al fresco
steps:
1. Spray a mw safe lidded casserole
2. Add garlic and tomatoes
3. Cover
4. Microwave on high 4-5 minutes or until tomatoes begin to burst , stirring after 2 minutes
5. Crush tomatoes with fork and add uncooked pasta , broth , wine , salt and black pepper
6. Return baker to microwave
7. Cover and microwave on high 16-18 minutes or until pasta is tender , stirring after 10 minutes
8. Meanwhile , grate cheese and coarsely chop basil , reserve about 1 / 4th for later
9. Carefully remove baker from microwave and remove lid , lifting away from you
10. Add remaining basil , cheese and chicken to baker
11. Mix well
12. Garnish with reserved basil , additional parmesan cheese and black pepper , if desired
13. Any tube-shaped pasta requiring 9-11 minutes cook time , such as penne or rigatoni , can be substituted for the mezze penne pasta
14. To grill chicken in the grill pan , season 2 chicken breasts , about 6 oz each , with salt and black pepper
15. Heat grill pan over medium-high heat 5 minutes
16. Spray pan with oil
17. Cook chicken 4-6 minutes or until grill marks appear
18. Turn chicken over
19. Cook 4-6 minutes or until center of chicken is no longer pink and pocket thermometer registers 170f

title: dundee marmalade lamb chops
steps:
1. You will need a frying pan with a heavy base and a close-fitting lid
2. First , brown the chops in the butter
3. Sprinkle the ginger , paprika , salt and pepper over the chops and add water and vinegar
4. Place a generous tablespoon of marmalade on the top of each chop
5. Bring to a slow simmer and cook for 45 minutes on a very low heat
6. If required , add a little extra water
7. Serve with a twist of orange on top of the chops and with boiled potatoes and fresh vegetables

title: beet root and apple raita
steps:
1. Join the roots and the apples cubes in salad bowl
2. Roast coriander , cumin and mustard seed in the oil until it smells nice
3. Mix well the remaining ingredients with the roasted seeds in a small separate bowl
4. Put the mixture on the cubes , add some drops of pomegranate syrup on top and decorate with a knife

title: pat s chiles rellenos squares
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients , mixing well
2. Pour into a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish
3. Bake 50 to 60 minutes at 325f
4. Optional: add small can sliced black olives and / or cover top with thinly sliced tomatoes as soon as it is baked

title: chili potato salad
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine potatoes , corn , celery , onion and bell pepper
2. Add oil , vinegar , chili powder , garlic and hot pepper sauce
3. Season to taste with salt and pepper
4. If made ahead , cover and refrigerate for up to 1 day
5. Serve cold or at room temperature

title: sirloin super surprise
steps:
1. Dredge sirloin in flour
2. Brown sirloin in 1 / 2 the butter in skillet over medium-high heat
3. Use other half of butter as necessary to brown meat
4. Use all the butter
5. Remove meat and add onions , and mushrooms
6. Add tomatoes , sherry and salt and pepper to taste
7. Bring to a boil
8. Reduce heat to low , cover for an hour or hour and a half until meat is so yummy and tender
9. Remove from heat , stir in sour cream and adjust seasonings --
10. Serve over egg noodles or rice

title: stuffed jalapeos
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 350
2. Pull stems off jalapeos and rinse
3. Slice jalapeos in half , lengthwise , and remove all seeds
4. Fill each jalapeo half with cream cheese
5. Place cocktail frank between two jalapeo halves
6. Wrap one slice of bacon around stuffed jalapeo and secure with a toothpick
7. Place stuffed jalapeos in a shallow baking dish and cook on 350 for at least 30-45 minutes
8. I would not recommend cooking for less than 30 minutes , however , since the bacon needs to be cooked thoroughly

title: slow cooker country captain chicken
steps:
1. Season chicken with salt and pepper
2. Heat oil in large skillet over medium-high heat until shimmering
3. Add chicken and brown on both sides , about 10 minutes
4. Slightly cool chicken on plate , remove and discard skin , and transfer chicken to slow-cooker insert
5. Discard all but 1 tablespoon fat from skillet and return pan to medium-high heat
6. Add onions , bell pepper , and 1 / 2 teaspoon salt and cook until vegetables soften , about 5 minutes
7. Add broth , tomatoes , and tomato paste and , using wooden spoon , scrape up browned bits from pan bottom
8. Simmer until thick and smooth , about 2 minutes
9. Off heat , stir in chutney , garlic , curry powder , paprika , thyme , and cayenne
10. Pour mixture into slow-cooker insert , submerging chicken in sauce
11. Cover and cook on low until chicken is tender , about 6 hours
12. Turn off slow cooker , remove lid , and gently stir sauce to recombine
13. Replace lid and let stand for about 15 minutes to thicken sauce before serving

title: ham  green beans  and potatoes  slow cooker
steps:
1. 1
2. Place whole ham shank in slow cooker
3. 2
4. Cover ham with prepared fresh green beans and potatoes
5. 3
6. Pour chicken broth and canned green bean juice over all ingredients
7. 4
8. Top with salt and pepper
9. 5
10. Cook on low 7-8 hours
11. 6
12. In the last hour of cooking , remove the bone from the ham shank
13. The meat should fall off pretty easily
14. Keep meat in slow cooker and continue cooking for 30 minutes

title: mexicali chicken stew
steps:
1. Place half of taco seasoning in a small bowl
2. Cut chicken into 1 inches pieces
3. Coat with taco seasoning
4. Coat large nonstick skillet with cooking spray
5. Cook and stir chicken 5 minute over med
6. Heat
7. Add tomatoes , beans corn , and remaining taco seasoning
8. Bring to a boil
9. Reduce heat to medium-low
10. Simmer 10 minute

title: carrots in dilled wine sauce
steps:
1. Peel and cut carrots into strips
2. Place them in the bottom of your slow cooker
3. Combine in a small mixing bowl , bouillon , wine , dill , onion , garlic salt , and lemon juice
4. Mix well and pour over carrot sticks
5. Cover and cook on high for 2 to 3 hours or low for 4 to 6 hours
6. Before serving , dissolve cornstarch into water and mix well until cornstarch is dissolved
7. Blend into carrot mixture
8. Cook on high for 10 more minutes so juices will thicken

title: versatile chili cheese sauce
steps:
1. In large saucepan , melt butter
2. Stir in flour until smooth
3. Gradually add cream
4. Bring to a boil
5. Cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened
6. Stir in sour cream , chilies and bouillon
7. Reduce heat to medium
8. Cook and stir for 3-4 minutes or until heated through
9. Add cheeses and pepper
10. Cook until bubbly and cheese is melted , stirring occasionally

title: hazelnut baked plums with orange cream
steps:
1. Lay the plums , cut side up , in one layer in a buttered oven proof dish
2. Toast the hazelnuts in a pan , shaking until even
3. Reserve 3 tablespoons
4. Grind the rest in a blender
5. With a hand blender or wooden spoon , cream the butter and sugar until softened and pale , about 5 to 8 minutes
6. Beat in egg , stir in cinnamon , flour and round hazelnuts
7. Spoon a little on to each plum
8. Roughly chop the reserved hazelnuts
9. Scatter on top
10. Heat oven to 190c
11. Grate zest of one orange
12. Whip the cream and icing sugar so that it just holds its shape
13. Fold in most of the zest
14. Put in a bowl , sprinkle with remaining zest , wrap and chill in fridge
15. Pour juice of both oranges around the plums
16. Bake uncovered for 30 to 35 minutes , until tender
17. Remove from oven and let sit 10 minutes
18. Serve warm with the cream

title: julie s caramel apple salad
steps:
1. Combine brown sugar , flour , salt , egg , pineapple and cider vinegar in a small pan
2. Heat on stove over medium high heat until thickened stirring occasionally
3. Remove from stove and cool in refrigerator
4. After sauce has cooled , stir it together with the cool whip in a large bowl
5. Core apples and chop into bite size pieces
6. Mix apples and peanuts into sauce
7. Serve chilled

title: pork barbecue
steps:
1. Put 1 / 2 of the onions on bottom of crock-pot
2. Add meat and water with remaining onions
3. Cover and cook overnight or 8-12 hours on low
4. Remove bone and fat from meat
5. Put meat back into crock-pot
6. Add one 16-ounce bottle kraft barbecue sauce
7. Cook 2 to 3 hours longer on low heat

title: 7 layer salad
steps:
1. Use 9 x 13 pan place in layers lettuce , onion , gr
2. Pepper , peas , bacon
3. Spread miracle whip on top to seal
4. You can use more or less to suit your taste
5. Sprinkle cheese on top of miracle whip
6. Then sprinkle the seasoned salt and mrs
7. Dash according to taste
8. Chill for several hours or overnight

title: garlicky tomato bruschetta
steps:
1. Bread: slice bread into 1 / 2" slices
2. Brush oil on one side
3. Broil briefly just until it barely starts to brown
4. You have to watch it !
5. Cool
6. Store in zip lock bag
7. Topping: in a medium bowl , mix tomatoes , basil parmesan , olive oil , garlic and a little salt and pepper to taste
8. Cover and chill in the refrigerator for 8 hours or overnight
9. Spread a spoonful on toasted rounds and serve

title: seared scallops or shrimp with orzo risotto
steps:
1. Cook orzo according to package directions and set aside
2. In large heavy pot , heat oil and saute mushrooms , onion , sun-dried tomatoes and red pepper until soft
3. Add stock and bring to a boil
4. Stir in orzo , parmesan and parsley
5. Add cream and simmer gently , stirring frequently , until mixture is creamy but not runny , about 20 minutes
6. Meanwhile , heat oil in very hot pan
7. Season scallops or shrimp with salt and pepper
8. For scallops: sear until brown on outside but opaque in the middle
9. For shrimp: sear until just pink and cooked through
10. Sprinkle parmesan cheese over risotto and top with scallops or shrimp

title: mushroom salsa
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients
2. Cover and allow to chill in the refrigerator at least 20 minutes before serving
3. Serve with tortilla chips and your favorite salsa

title: baked pasta with tofu cheese  vegan
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f cook pasta in boiling salted water according to package instructions
2. Mix mushrooms into marinara
3. Drain pasta well and transfer to a 7-x-11-inch baking dish
4. Stir in olive oil and a cup of the pasta sauce
5. Set aside
6. Put tofu , nutritional yeast , mustard , onion powder , basil , garlic , salt and pepper in the bowl of a food processor
7. Process until the mixture reaches the consistency of ricotta cheese
8. Taste and adjust seasonings
9. Spread tofu mixture over the cooked pasta and top with remaining pasta sauce
