10. Sprinkle with vegan cheese or additional nutritional yeast , if desired
11. Bake until bubbly , 30 to 40 minutes
12. Serve immediately

title: greek potato patties
steps:
1. Boil potatoes until soft
2. Drain and mash
3. Place in bowl with crumbled feta cheese , spring onions , dill , egg and lemon juice , seasoning to taste
4. Stir well
5. Cover bowl and chill until firm
6. Divide mixture into six big patties , flatten slightly and then dredge with flour
7. Heat oil in pan and shallow fry patties until golden brown on each side

title: granny s squash casserole
steps:
1. Place chicken broth , squash and onions in saucepan
2. Simmer until veggies are tender , about 15 minutes
3. Add remaining ingredients except of stuffing mix
4. Pour into 2 or 3 quart greased casserole dish
5. Top with remaining stuffing mix
6. Bake at 350 degrees for 30-40 minutes until bubbly and light brown

title: gluten free hamantaschen   sugar free   purim cookies
steps:
1. With an electric hand mixer , or in the bowl of a standing mixer , cream the butter or margarine with the agave nectar
2. Add the unbeaten egg , lemon juice , lemon zest and vanilla and continue combining
3. In a separate bowl , combine all dry ingredients
4. Slowly add the dry mixture into the liquid mixture
5. Mix until combined into a cohesive ball of dough
6. Refrigerate for 2 hours or overnight
7. Line two cookie sheets with parchment paper
8. Flour a counter or other surface thoroughly
9. Remove dough from refrigerator and immediately roll into a ball and roll the ball in flour before placing it on the floured counter
10. Roll out until 1 / 4" to 1 / 8" thickness
11. Using a juice glass or biscuit cutter , cut into 3-4" circles
12. Immediately move dough circles to parchment-lined cookie sheets
13. If the dough begins to stick to the counter , use a pastry scraper to gently transfer the disks of dough
14. Place approximately 1 teaspoon of filling in the center of each circle
15. Using a pastry brush , apply well-beaten egg to the perimeter of each dough circle and immediately fold 3 sides of circle together so that the cookie becomes a triangle , and pinch corners to seal
16. Seal completely and firmly , using beaten egg so they do not come apart in baking
17. If you have trouble sealing the corners , try folding them over a bit
18. The final cookie should look like a triangle with the filling showing through only at the center
19. Use the remaining beaten egg to lightly brush the top of each pastry
20. Bake at 350 f for 12-15 minutes or until lightly golden on top but not overly browned on the bottom
21. Let cool slightly before serving or transferring to cooling rack

title: pondicherry lentils
steps:
1. Pick lentils over for any small stones
2. Rinse and soak 2 hours in tepid water
3. Drain
4. Place lentils and water in a large saucepan
5. Heat to a boil
6. Reduce heat to low
7. Cover and cook until lentils are tender , but still firm , 20-25 minutes
8. Rinse the lentils with cold water
9. Drain
10. Mix together the lentils , apple , bell pepper , jalapeno , parsley , lemon juice , olive oil , vinegar and salt in a large bowl
11. Chill until serving time
12. Just before serving , heat the sesame oil in a skillet over medium-high heat
13. Add the ginger and coconut
14. Cook , stirring occasionally , until golden , 3-5 minutes
15. Sprinkle ginger and coconut over the lentils

title: chicken fettuccini alfredo
steps:
1. Boil the fettuccine noodles in water with a tsp of olive oil
2. While the noodles are boiling season your diced chicken breast with the garlic powder onion powder black pepper and italian seasonings and if you like some seasoning salt
3. Drain the noodles dont rinse them
4. Brown the diced chicken breast in a saucepan until fully cooked
5. Set chicken aside
6. In a large pot , put the cream cheese , butter , milk , and parmesan cheese and mix together with a whisk until creamy
7. When the mixture is creamed together add the chicken to the mixture and mix well
8. Add the fettuccine to the cream cheese and chicken and mix well and cook on low heat for 3 minutes
9. Enjoy

title: lemon sesame dressing
steps:
1. Measure ingredients including the sesame seeds into a blender
2. Blend until smooth
3. Taste on a piece of lettuce or a vegetable stick for seasoning and adjust if needed

title: lamb  lemon and olive pasta
steps:
1. Cook onion in olive oil spray until soft
2. Add minced lamb , spices , salt and pepper , combine and cook till browned and cooked through
3. Drain off any fat from the meat mixture
4. Cook pasta and drain it , saving a little bit of the pasta water for the dressing
5. Combine all ingredients but the feta , toss well and put a bit of the water in to make a nice texture
6. Put into bowls , crumble feta over the top and season with salt , pepper and olive oil

title: allergen free soup base  previously called gluten free mushroom
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , saut onion in butter until tender
2. Add mushrooms and saut until tender
3. Combine flour and broth until smooth , stir into the mushroom mixture
4. Bring to a boil
5. Cook and stir for 2 minute or until thickened
6. Reduce heat
7. Stir in the cream , salt and pepper
8. Simmer , uncovered , for 15 minutes , stirring often

title: mujaddarah lentil and rice pottage
steps:
1. Bring water to boil , then add the lentils , lower heat to simmer and cook about 30-60 minutes
2. Meanwhile , saute onions in the oil to caramelize about 15-20 minutes , then add half of onions , rice and seasonings to lentils
3. Let the mixture boil for a few minutes
4. When it thickens , pour into a tureen , and spread the remaining onions over the top
5. And serve
6. Yield: 4 servings

title: carne assada a portuguesa  portuguese pot roast
steps:
1. Marinade:
2. Place roast in a glass oblong pan , add red wine , 2 sliced onions , garlic , salt and pepper
3. Put in refrigerator and marinate for 24 hrs and turn a few times
4. Heat oil in a dutch oven or heavy kettle with lid , add the remaining 1 sliced onion , brown , remove and save for later
5. Remove roast from marinade , drain and dry
6. Save marinade for later
7. Brown roast in hot oil on all sides , add browned onions and marinade
8. Add water
9. Water should cover 2 / 3's of the roast
10. Cover tightly and simmer for 4 to 4 1 / 2 hours , turning occasionally
11. The last half hour , add sliced tomatoes and cook uncovered for the last 30 minutes
12. You can strain and thicken the sauce , if desired

title: awesome brown sugar bacon
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Lay out bacon slices on a broiler pan rack
3. Brush the bacon lightly with honey mustard
4. Lightly coat both sides of bacon in brown sugar
5. Bake 15 minutes , turn them over and bake 5-10 more minutes or until the bacon is to your liking

title: sugar free apricot butter
steps:
1. Soak dried fruit overnight in fruit juices
2. If this does not cover the fruit , add enough water to cover
3. Next day , add chopped lemon [i usually add the lemon zest , juice , and pulp but not the entire lemon]
4. Place in blender to soften hard pieces
5. Cook over low heat until fruit tastes cooked , about 8 minutes , stirring often
6. Add spices& simmer until thick , about 10 minutes longer
7. Pour into hot , sterile 1 / 2 pint jars , leaving 1 / 2 inch at top
8. Cap with hot , sterile lids
9. Process in boiling water bath for 5 minutes after water returns to boiling
10. If any jars fail to seal , refrigerate& use within 10 days or freeze

title: beef with cannellini beans
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a pan and add the onion , beef & sausage , saute over high heat , stirring constantly until the beef juices run
2. Pour in the tomato paste , water & wine & season with salt & pepper
3. Bring to the boil & cover & simmer for 45 minutes
4. Add the beans & cook uncovered for a further 15 minutes

title: candy cane crisps
steps:
1. Oven 325
2. Beat together butter and powdered sugar until creamy
3. Mix in vanilla extract
4. Add flour , oats and salt
5. Combine well
6. Stir in 1 / 4 cup crushed candy canes
7. Roll rounded teaspoonfuls of the dough in the 1 / 2 cup powdered sugar
8. Place balls about 2 inches apart on a greased cookie sheet
9. Flatten with a fork in a criss-cross pattern and sprinkle cookies with about 1 / 4 tsp of remaining crushed candy canes
10. Bake at 325 for 18-20 minutes or until the edges of the cookies are slightly brown
11. Let cookies cool on the pan for about 2 minutes , and then transfer to a rack to cool

title: meatless meatloaf
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Roast the nuts for 5-7 minutes and then chop coarsely
3. Turn up the oven to 375f
4. Cook the onion in the butter until soft
5. Season with salt and pepper , add the garlic , chopped mushrooms , and herbs
6. Cook until the liquid released by the mushrooms is reduced
7. In a bowl , combine the onion / mushroom mix with the cooked rice , nuts , eggs , cottage cheese and grated cheese
8. Season to taste
9. Butter a loaf pan and fill it with the loaf mixture
10. Bake the loaf about 1 to 1 / 4 hours until the top is golden and rounded
11. Let the loaf sit out of the oven for 10 minutes before turning out onto a serving plate
12. Serve with a mushroom or herb bechamel sauce

title: jam swirled coffee cake
steps:
1. Combine the flour , sugar , baking powder , and salt in a medium bowl and mix well
2. Cut in butter with a pastry blender or fork until crumbly
3. Add egg and milk and stir until just moistened
4. Spread in a well greased 9x9 baking dish
5. Spread both preserves over top using a knife to swirl the preserves through the batter
6. Don't swirl too much ~ you want to be able to see some swirls
7. Sprinkle evenly with the topping
8. Bake at 400 for 25-35 minutes
9. Use a toothpick to check for doneness
10. Topping: in a small bowl , mix all ingredients with a fork until crumbled

title: tropical oats
steps:
1. Soak oats overnight
2. In a pan , heat evaporated milk for 1 minute
3. Add oats , banana , coconut shreds , cinnamon , and optional salt
4. Cook for about 5 minutes or until desired doneness
5. Have a great morning !

title: spiced oatmeal  raisin nut cookies
steps:
1. Set oven to 350
2. Light grease a large baking sheet
3. In a large bowl cream butter and both sugars until light and fluffy
4. Add in eggs and extract , and beat until thoroughly combined
5. In another bowl combine flour , baking soda , salt , cinnamon , mace , nutmeg and cloves
6. Add the dry mixture to the creamed mixture and stir until well blended
7. Add in oats , nuts and raisins
8. Mix until blended
9. Drop by tablespoonfuls onto baking sheet about 2-inches apart , then flatten slightly
10. Bake for about 8 minutes for a soft cookie

title: lemon   pine nut lamb patties
steps:
1. Combine the lamb mince , pine nuts , mint , lemon rind , cumin and egg in a large bowl , and mix until well-combined
2. Divide the mixture into 12 equal portions and shape into 6cm patties , about 1
3. 5 cm thick
4. Preheat a bbq plate on medium , lightly spray the patties with olive oil , cook on the bbq plate for 5-6 minutes , each side or until they are cooked through
5. Transfer to a plate and cover with foil , to keep warm
6. To make the tabouli: place the burghul in a heatproof bowl and pour the boiling water over it
7. Cover with plastic wrap and set aside for 10 minutes or until all the liquid has been absorbed
8. Then use a fork to separate the grains of burghul
9. Add the tomatoes , mint , parsley and shallots , and stir well until all the ingredients are combined
10. To serve: divide the tabouli among the serving plates , top with the patties and babaghannoush , and serve with lemon wedges

title: chocolate fiber muffins
steps:
1. Mix buckwheat flour , flax , and water
2. Let stand
3. Preheat oven to 350f line two muffin trays with paper baking cups
4. Spray with oil or pam
5. In a separate bowl , mix all dry ingredients
6. Add vanilla , oil , vinegar , and eggs to buckwheat mixture
7. Blend well
8. Add liquids to dry ingredients and mix well
9. Fill cups about 2 / 3 full
10. Bake for 20 - 30 minutes , or until toothpick inserted comes out clean

title: stay in bed stew
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients in a casserole dish or roaster pan that has a tight fitting lid
2. Place in oven at 275 degrees for 5 hours or until meat very tender and sauce thick and bubbly

title: lemon rosemary salmon
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
2. Arrange half the lemon slices in a single layer in a baking dish
3. Layer with 2 sprigs rosemary , and top with salmon fillets
4. Sprinkle salmon with salt , layer with remaining rosemary sprigs , and top with remaining lemon slices
5. Drizzle with olive oil
6. Bake 20 minutes in the preheated oven , or until fish is easily flaked with a fork

title: chocolate chip carrot bread
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine the first nine ingredients
2. In a small bowl , beat the eggs , orange juice , oil , and vanilla
3. Stir wet ingredients into dry ingredients until just moistened
4. Fold in carrots and chocolate chips
5. Transfer to two greased loaf pans
6. Bake at 350f for 55-60 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean
7. Cool for 10 minutes before removing from pans to wire rack

title: scratch hot water pastry
steps:
1. Cream shortening with a fork into the 1 / 4 cup of boiling water
2. Mix and sift the flour , salt , and baking powder
3. Add the mixture to the shortening slowly
4. Blend well
5. Form into a ball and refrigerate until ready to use
6. Yield = 1 pastry shell

title: easy decadent truffles
steps:
1. In a large bowl , beat cream cheese until smooth
2. Gradually beat in confectioners' sugar until well blended
3. Stir in melted chocolate and vanilla until no streaks remain
4. Refrigerate for about 1 hour
5. Shape into 1 inch balls
6. Roll truffles in ground walnuts , cocoa , coconut , confectioners' sugar , candy sprinkles , etc
7. To flavor truffles with liqueurs or other flavorings , omit vanilla
8. Divide truffle mixture into thirds
9. Add 1 tablespoon liqueur to each mixture
10. Mix well

title: oven baked country ribs with gravy
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f
2. Dredge in flour sage , salt and pepper mixture
3. Heat oil and butter in a medium high fry pan
4. Add ribs and brown on all sides , then remove from pan
5. Lower heat and brown onions and garlic lightly , about 2 to 3 minutes
6. Add soup , broth , water and kitchen bouquet , stir to combine
7. Add ribs back to pan and spoon soup mixture over meat
8. Bake covered for 35 minutes then flip ribs and check thickness of gravy , add more liquid at this point if necessary
9. Continue baking , covered another 20 to 30 minutes , until ribs are fork tender this last step may take longer , depending on the size of your ribs

title: bird s chicken piccata
steps:
1. Combine flour , garlic , salt , pepper , and paprika in a plastic grocery bag
2. Add chicken and shake to coat well
3. Set aside
4. Heat butter and olive oil in a large skillet over med-high heat
5. Shake excess flour from chicken pieces and place in skillet and saute for about 5 minutes , until golden brown
6. Do not overcook
7. Remove chicken from pan , and set aside , covered to keep warm
8. Remove all but 2 tbsp of fat , retaining browned bits of breading
9. Stir wine and broth into pan drippings , deglazing the pan
10. Add lemon juice , capers , and parsley
11. Return chicken to skillet , tossing to coat
12. Reduce heat to medium , and continue cooking until sauce thickens slightly and chicken is cooked thru
13. Serve immediately with fresh lemon wedges

title: sunshine farm lavender tea scones
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Combine flour , sugar , baking powder , baking soda , salt and lavender in a large bowl
3. Add butter and beat with an electric mixer until well blended
4. Stir in zest
5. Pour in buttermilk and mix until blended
6. Gather dough into a ball and divide in half
7. On lightly floured surface , roll each half into a circle
8. Cut into wedges
9. (
10. Use parchment paper to reduce the amount of flour needed
11. I also tend to hand shape , rather than roll the circle
12. Cut the wedges with a sharp knife
13. I gently tap the 3 sides of the scones on the parchment to make smooth edges
14. )
15. Place scones on lightly greased cookie sheet
16. Bake in preheated 400 f oven for 12-15 minutes or until golden
17. Serve warm or cooled with butter , and choice of lavender syrup or jam , honey , lemon curd , or british clotted cream , and a nice cup of tea !

title: portuguese clam rice
steps:
1. In a saucepan , cook onion and garlic in oil until tender
2. Add pimento paste and parsley
3. Cook for a couple of minutes
4. Drain clams but reserving liquid
5. Add the clams to the saucepan
6. Measure clam juice and add enough water to measure 1 1 / 4 cups of liquid
7. Add rice and tomatoes and bring to boil
8. Cover and reduce heat to low for 20 minutes
9. Add salt if necessary

title: country style potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Scrub potatoes under running water thoroughly
3. Slice them lengthwise into quarters
4. Slice each of the quarters across into 4 chunks
5. In a pot add potatoe chunks with enough water to cover them
6. Boil 25-35 mins or until tender when pierced with a fork
7. Drain chunks
8. In a bowl mash potatoes with a hand masher to a very coarse texture adding 2 tbs butter at the same time
9. To the potatoes gently mix in the cottage cheese , onion , garlic salt and pepper to taste
10. Pour mixture into a greased casserole dish-- place small pieces of the remaining 2 tbs of butter over top of the potatoes
11. Sprinkle with small amount of paprika
12. Bake uncovered for 30 mins
13. Let cool for 10 mins or so before serving

title: iowa stuffed pork chops with sweet apple dressing
steps:
1. Cut 2 inch pockets into chops from bone side so dressing stays in
2. In bowl combine apples , bread , sugar , cinnamon and salt
3. Mix well
4. Stuff into pockets of pork chops
5. Place chops in a 9x13 baking dish
6. Pour melted butter or marg
7. Over chops and bake at 350
8. When chops have browned , add 1 cup of water and cover with foil
9. Bake for 2 hours

title: austrian mushroom soup
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , combine stock and mushrooms , bring to a boil
2. Add butter if using canned broth and simmer 2 minutes
3. Remove from heat and stir in sherry
4. Ladle into soup bowls and top with chives

title: susan s winter potato soup plus
steps:
1. Saute onions in margarine until tender
2. Add next 6 ingredients and cook until vegetables are tender
3. Add soup and milk cook on low until heated through
4. Add cheeses 2 to 3 minutes before serving

title: macaroni pie
steps:
1. Boil water in saucepan
2. Add macaroni and cook until it is a little soft
3. Drain and rinse
4. Grease 20cm pie dish and spread a layer of macaroni on it
5. Sprinkle flaked tuna followed by cheese and capsicum
6. Repeat step 2 except for the greasing part
7. Beat eggs with the rest of the ingredients
8. Drizzle it over the macaroni
9. Bake in pre-heated oven of 180 c for 25 minutes

title: potatoes with egg  fennell   smoked salmon
steps:
1. Cut the eggs and potatoes in half
2. Cut the salmon in big chunks
3. Slice the fennel as thinly as you can
4. Place the potatoes , dill , eggs , fennel and salmon in a big bowl
5. Drizzle dressing on all and gently toss
6. Dressing: mix the lemon juice and the cream and stir carefully until the cream thickens
7. It is important that you stir -- and not whisk ! season with salt , pepper , sugar and ground nutmeg

title: countryside pasta salad
steps:
1. In a large bowl combine pasta , tomatoes , bacon , onions , peppers , cheese , and basil
2. Drizzle with the dressing and toss until thoroughly mixed
3. Season with salt and pepper to taste

title: southwestern frittata
steps:
1. Lightly spray a 9x13-inch baking dish
2. Mix the onion , garlic and cheeses
3. Mix the chilies and chopped tomatoes
4. Cut or tear the tortillas into 1 inch strips
5. Spread 1 / 3 of the chili and tomato mixture in the bottom of the pan
6. Top with 1 / 3 of the tortilla strips
7. Cover with 1 / 3 of the cheese mixture
8. Repeat layers until all ingredients are used
9. Beat eggs and milk together with the cumin , salt and pepper
10. Pour the egg mixture over the the layers
11. Sprinkle with the paprika
12. Cover with foil and refrigerate overnight
13. Next morning , preheat oven to 350 degree
14. Remove foil and bake for 45 minutes

title: peanut butter marshmallow cookie bars
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350
2. Crust in a large bowl combine the cake mix , margarine , and egg
3. Mix until crumbly
4. Press into bottom of ungreased 13x9 pan
5. Bake at 350 for 15-20 minutes or until golden brown
6. Remove from oven and immediately sprinkle with 3 cups mini marshmallows
7. Return to oven for 1-2 minutes until marshmallows begin to puff
8. Topping in large saucepan , heat corn syrup , margarine , vanilla , and peanut butter chips until chips are melted and mixture is smooth
9. Remove from heat and stir in cereal
10. Immediately spread over crust
11. Chill and cut into bars

title: spiced peach jam
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in a heavy large pot
2. Stir to combine
3. Bring to a rolling boil over medium-high heat
4. Boil , stirring occasionally , 15 minutes , adjusting heat as necessary to maintain an even boil
5. While the mixture boils , mash fruit with a potato masher to desired consistency
6. Boil an additional 5 to 10 minutes , stirring frequently , or until slightly thickened and set
7. Remove from heat
8. Remove cinnamon stick
9. Pour hot jam into 4 sterilized 8-oz
10. Jars
11. Carefully wipe jar rims
12. Cover
13. To store at room temperature , immediately process in a boiling water bath for 5 five minutes
14. Remove with slotted spoon
15. Drop into ice water to cool
16. Use a knife to peel away skins
17. To test jam , before you begin cooking , place a small plate into the freezer to chill
18. When jam begins to thicken slightly , place a small amount of jam on chilled plate
19. Return to freezer for 1 to 2 minutes
20. When set , jam will be slightly set and will not run on plate
21. If jam is too liquid , cook an addition 1 to 2 minutes before testing again

title: boursin stuffed eggs
steps:
1. Combine boursin and sour cream in a bowl and mix until smooth
2. Halve the eggs length-wise and add the yolks to the boursin mixture
3. Mash yolks into the mixture and combine well
4. Stuff boursin mixture into the egg white halves

title: sweet potato  pasta  with tangy marinara  a raw food r
steps:
1. Place sun-dried tomatoes in warm water to start softening
2. Set aside
3. Raw foodists take care not to use water hotter than 118 degrees
4. Choose to peel the sweet potato or leave the skin on
5. Shred into lengthy strips using the small side of a standard shredder or spiralizer
6. Set aside
7. Dry presoaked almonds with a paper towel
8. Place them in a blender or food processor and blend into a flour-like consistency
9. Add lemon juice , olive oil , and seasonings
10. Blend until mixed , adding a splash of water as necessary
11. Chop roma and sun-dried tomatoes and add to the sauce base
12. Blend into a thick , creamy marinara sauce
13. Divide sweet potato noodles into two servings and top with tangy marinara sauce
14. Garnish with additional red pepper flakes if you wish

title: parmesan scallion dip
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a small bowl or blender
2. Mix well
3. Taste and add more cayenne if desired
4. Cover and chill at least 2 hours before serving

title: steak sandwiches with crispy onions
steps:
1. In a skillet cook the onions in the butter and the oil over moderate heat , stirring occasionally , until they are crisp and golden and transfer them with a slotted spoon to paper towels to drain
2. In the fat remaining in the skillet cook the mushrooms and the garlic over moderately low heat , stirring occasionally , until the mushrooms begin to turn brown and transfer the mixture to a plate
3. Add the broth to the skillet and deglaze the skillet , scraping up the brown bits
4. Add the cream , the ketchup , the worcestershire sauce , and the mustard and stir in the mushroom mixture and the steak slices
5. Divide the steak mixture among the bottom bread pieces , sprinkle it with some of the onions , and top the onions with the remaining bread pieces

title: grilled tofu with chili lime marinade
steps:
1. Slice tofu in half lengthwise , then cut each half into two long strips , approximately 1 / 2-inch thick
2. Mix remaining ingredients in a small bowl
3. Lay tofu strips in a shallow pan and pour marinade over , turning tofu to coat
4. Marinade for at least 1 hour , or as long as overnight
5. Heat oil in grill or nonstick pan over high heat
6. Sear tofu on each side until browned and heated through , approximately 2-3 minutes per side

title: tomato bisque for uncle vic
steps:
1. On medium heat saute onions in butter till they caramelize
2. After onions have browned add the tomatoes , bouillon , sun-dried tomatoes , herbs , salt and pepper
3. Turn up heat and bring to a boil
4. Once mix begins to boil , reduce heat and simmer 20 minutes
5. Process in blender till smooth
6. Return to pot and heat on low setting
7. Stir in cream
8. Serve immediately
9. Fill the blender , at the most , half full
10. Begin blending on a low setting while holding the lid firmly down
11. If you overfill the blender , or begin blending on a high setting , or do not hold the lid down steam builds up under the lid and the hot contents will shoot out of the blender spraying you and your kitchen in molten chunks of burning hot bisque bits
12. Both painful and grotesque
13. Be warned

title: whole baked tilapia
steps:
1. In large bowl , combine onions with lemon juice and ginger
2. Arrange a few onion slices on the bottom of a baking dish
3. Rinse tilapia , pat dry with paper towel , brush outside with oil , lay fish on top of the onion mixture
4. Cut off about 1 / 2 inch from each of the lemons
5. Stuff the fish cavity with reserved onions , lemon ends and half of the cilantro
6. Cut remaining lemons into thin slices
7. Tuck slices around base of fish and sprinkle remaining cilantro over onions and lemons in dish
8. Bake , uncovered , in a 400f oven until fish temperature reaches 135f and flesh in opaque and flaky
9. Gently pull off skin and serve fish with onions and a fresh lemon slice
10. Add salt and pepper to taste
11. I think this may take 30-40 minutes i have not made this but my gf has :)

title: easy all cranberry bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Sift flour , sugar , baking powder , salt , and baking soda into a large bowl
3. Cut in butter until the mixture is crumbly
4. Add egg , finely grated orange peel , lemon peel , and orange juice all at once
5. Carefully stir until the mixture is evenly moist
6. Fold in cranberries
7. Spoon and spread evenly into a greased 9x5x3-inch loaf pan
8. Bake for 55-65 minutes , or until a tooth pick inserted in the center comes out clean
9. Remove from the pan and cool on a wire rack

title: flufferbutter
steps:
1. Brin the sugar and water to a boil
2. Let cool
3. Add vanilla , peanut butter and marshmallow fluff
4. Mix well
5. Mixture will be thin so let it sit overnight
6. Granny never kept this in the fridge , but neither did she keep pickles , jams , or ketchup / mustard in there either , and none of us has died from it yet , but i suppose i am supposed to say "keep refrigerated" just for liablility purposes
7. So , yeah , do that

title: the best healthy waffles  low fat
steps:
1. Sift dry ingrediants in one bowl
2. Separate one of the eggs
3. Add the yolk and the rest of the wet ingredients together and whisk
4. Beat the egg white in a clean bowl until peaks form
5. Add the wet into the dry , mixing until just combined
6. Fold in the egg white
7. Pour into a preheated greased waffle iron , and i cook mine for 3-4 minutes with my waffle iron
8. This recipe yeilds 16 small square waffles for me
9. These freeze well

title: oriental slaw salad
steps:
1. Before serving , mix dressing ingredients in a container with a lid and shake vigorously
2. Brown silvered almonds in a skillet , using 2 tablespoons of oil
3. Crush ramen noodles in a plastic baggie in small pieces
4. Discard seasoning packet
5. Mix all ingredients together when ready to serve
6. I usually add the dressing and soup noodles right before

title: tomato  rice and italian sausage soup
steps:
1. Saute bacon and onion together until lightly browned
2. Drain off fat
3. In soup pot , add peeled and diced fresh tomatoes or break up canned tomatoes
4. Add sugar , then bacon / onion mixture
5. Simmer for 10 minutes
6. Meanwhile , in separate pan cook sausage covered in water for 15 minutes
7. Drain , then cut into slices
8. Place sausage in soup pot with bacon / tomato mixture
9. Add beef stock or broth and oregano , then bring to a rolling boil
10. Stir in rice
11. Cook over medium heat uncovered until approximately 10 minutes until rice is tender , adding additional broth if needed
12. Remove from heat then stir in parmesan cheese and butter
13. Salt and pepper to taste
14. Put in serving bowls and sprinkle on minced fresh parsley
15. Additional parmesan cheese may also be sprinkled on

title: chickpea salad pockets
steps:
1. In a bowl , combine all ingredients , tossing to mix everything evenly
2. Spoon into pita pockets
3. For vegan use the soy cheese option

title: strawberry rhubarb compote
steps:
1. In large saucepan , bring sugar , orange rind and orange juice to a simmer
2. Add rhubarb
3. Simmer gently until tender , about 15 minutes
4. Stir in strawberries

title: cottage cheese cheddar enchiladas with taco sauce
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease a 13 x 9-inch baking dish
3. In a bowl mix together cottage cheese , 1-1 / 2 cups shredded cheddar cheese , tomatoes , green onions , chili powder , seasoned salt and green chilies
4. Divide the mixture between the 8 corn tortillas
5. Roll up the tortillas and place seasom-side down in the baking dish
6. Drizzle the taco sauce over the tortillas and thne sprinkle with 1 cup grated cheddar cheese
7. Bake for 15-20 minutes or until hot and the cheese has melted

title: kittencal s caramelized onions
steps:
1. In a skillet , melt the butter with oil over medium-high heat
2. Add the sliced onions then sprinkle the sugar over the onions
3. Cook stirring with a wooden spoon for about 20-25 minutes or until onions become golden brown and tender
4. Add in salt and season with black pepper to taste and continue to cook , stirring for an additional 5 minutes

title: vegetable sesame rice balls
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 180 degrees celsius
2. Chop the vegetables very finely - if the pieces are too big , the mixture will not stick together
3. Combine the rice and vegetables in a bowl
4. Mix the tahini , lemon juice , tamari and tofu in a blender until smooth and creamy
5. Pour this sauce over the rice and vegetables and mix thoroughly
6. With wet hands , roll bits of the rice mixture into balls of about 5cm in diameter
7. Roll the balls in the sesame seeds until they are completely coated and place them on a baking tray
8. Bake for 40 minutes , turning the balls twice during the baking process
9. While the balls are cooking , make the dipping sauce by mixing the tamari and mirin together in a small bowl

title: maria s paleo pecan ice cream
steps:
1. Partially thaw frozen bananas so they can blend in the food processor
2. Add all ingredients except pecans and process to a smooth and thick consistency
3. Add pecans and pulse chop to desired size - just a few pulses is fine
4. Eat !
5. If you return to freezer , this will freeze pretty solid so you might as well eat it all right away
6. :)

title: healthy broccoli gratin
steps:
1. Boil broccoli and potatoes in a large pan until tender , for about 15-20 minutes
2. Drain and reserve a little cooking liquid
3. Coarsely mash veggies , adding some reserved cooking liquid if mixture seems dry
4. Stir in nutmeg , half of the parmesan , salt , and pepper
5. In a shallow baking dish , spread vegetable mixture
6. Sprinle with remaining parmesan and bake it at 180 c for 15-20 minutes or till the parmesan is browned

title: ultimate spaghetti
steps:
1. Saute the ground beef , diced onions and diced bell pepper together until meat is browned
2. Add all spices , tomato sauce , stewed tomatoes and water
3. Simmer for twenty minutes
4. Because of the bullion cubes make sure you taste before adding salt
5. Boil four quarts of water
6. Add spaghetti to boiling water and stir vigorously until water returns to boil
7. Turn heat down and simmer 8 to 9 minutes to desired tenderness
8. Drain and pour directly in to sauce and serve

title: tofu pie
steps:
1. Dissolve jello in 1 cup boiling water in a bowl
2. Cool in refrigerator until slightly thickened
3. In another bowl , mix tofu until smooth with mixer blender
4. Add lemon juice and thickened jello and half of cool whip
5. Pour into pie crust
6. Use remaining cool whip to top the jello mixture
7. Refrigerate until set

title: hambalaya cornbread
steps:
1. In large skillet , saut green pepper and onions in butter until tender
2. In a bowl , combine the flour , cornmeal , baking soda and salt
3. In another bowl , combine eggs and buttermilk
4. Stir into dry ingredients just until moistened
5. Fold in the ham , sausage and green pepper mixture
6. Transfer to a greased 10-inch ovenproof skillet or 9-inch square baking pan
7. Bake at 425 for 20-25 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near center comes out clean
8. Serve warm
9. Refrigerate leftovers

title: terri s cinnamon raisin bread  bread machine
steps:
1. In a small sauce pan bring about 3 / 4 cup water to a boil
2. Add 1 cup of raisins to the boiling water and remove from heat
3. Give the raisins and water a stir and then set them aside until they are room temperature
4. Add all ingredients except for raisins to your bread machine in the order specified by the manufacturer
5. My machine calls for wet ingredients first , but i had another that called for dry ingredients first
6. Set your bread machine for the appropriate size loaf on the wheat setting
7. Begin cycle
8. Drain the room temperature rehydrated raisins and measure them , add enough dried raisins to make 2 cups total if you are making the extra large loaf
9. When your bread machine has a good ball of dough circulating for a while , dump in your raisins
10. Watch carefully and add flour as needed until a good ball of dough is once again circulating
11. When your bread is finished baking let it cool completely before slicing

title: kahlua dip for fruit
steps:
1. Beat cream cheese until smooth , slowly add kahlua , cream & sugar
2. Beating well
3. Refrigerate until ready to serve
4. Top with almonds when ready to serve

title: tunnel bar b q coleslaw
steps:
1. Remove outer leaves of cabbage , core and cut in half
2. Shred cabbage , carrot , and sweet onion
3. Mix salt and pepper in vinegar to dissolve
4. Add to shredded vegetables
5. Combine remaining ingredients , then mix them with the shredded coleslaw mixture until thoroughly covered
6. Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve

title: big poppas eat mo  tuna salad
steps:
1. This is idiot proof
2. You stick it all in a bowl stir it up and add more miracle whip of its not to your liking
3. Serve on iceberg leaves garnish with the cilantro and serve with wheat crackers and monterrey jack cheese or garlic bagel chips tambien
4. Whatever you like-- lemonade goes best with this dish

title: redstone restaurant famous cornbread with maple butter
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Mix together all ingredients in the order given
3. Pour into greased 8" or 9" iron skillet
4. Bake 35 minutes
5. Insert toothpick- if it comes out clean the corn bread is done
6. If not , continue baking & check every 5 minutes with a toothpick
7. Serve warm with maple butter
8. Maple butter:
9. Allow butter to soften to room temperature
10. In mixer , whip butter & salt until creamy
11. Slowly drizzle syrup into mixture until well blended

title: marinated feta
steps:
1. In medium bowl , combine all ingredients except cheese
2. Mix well
3. Add cheese , stir gently to coat
4. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours to allow flavors to blend

title: ham and potato soup  no milk or cream
steps:
1. Empty frozen potatoes and 3 cans chicken broth into large pot
2. Bring to a boil , then lower to medium heat
3. In a small bowl , mix 1 / 2 cup of water and package of gravy
4. Stir well-mixed gravy into potatoes and broth
5. Add ham and peas
6. Allow all ingredients to heat through , stirring often
7. Salt& pepper to taste
8. Dip into bowls and serve !

title: mexicali pizza
steps:
1. Place tortillas on lightly greased baking sheet
2. Sprinkle one tortilla with 1 / 2 cup cheese
3. Top with half of the veg-all , tomato , onion , pepper , and chilis
4. Sprinkle with 1 / 2 cup cheese and top with 1 / 2 of the olives
5. Repeat procedure with second tortilla
6. Bake at 425'f
7. Approximately 10-12 minutes , until cheese is melted and tortillas are crisp

title: tabbouleh with roasted peppers
steps:
1. Place the bulgar in a bowl and stir in the boiling water , lemon juice , and olive oil
2. Coer and refrigerate for 30 minutes
3. Remove and fluff with a fork
4. Coarsley chop the roasted peppers and add them to the bulgar
5. Using a fork , mix in the tomatoes and mint leaves
6. Season well with salt and pepper
7. Serve chilled or at room temperature

title: sugar and cinnamon spice muffins
steps:
1. Combine dry ingredients
2. Stir in milk , egg , and butter , beating only enough to blend
3. Stir in raisins and nuts , of desired
4. Fill greased muffin cups 3 / 4 full
5. Bake at 400 for 20 minutes or until muffins test done

title: sloppy toms  sloppy joes with turkey
steps:
1. In a large frying pan , brown ground turkey , minced garlic and onion powder
2. Drain , if needed / wanted
3. Meanwhile , wisk together tomato paste , catsup , mustard and worcestershire sauce
4. Return drained turkey to pan , stir in sauce
5. Cook on low for 10 minutes
6. Serve on hamburger buns

title: pear  blue cheese  walnut and bacon salad
steps:
1. Whisk together all vinaigrette ingredients until well blended
2. Set aside
3. In a small frying pan set on a medium heat , melt the butter , stir in the maple syrup or honey and then stir in the walnuts
4. Continue to heat the walnuts , stirring continuously , for approximately 2-3 minutes or until they are fragrant , caramelized and lightly browned
5. Remove from the heat
6. Set aside
7. Place the greens in a large salad bowl or , if individual servings are preferred , distribute them equally among 6 salad plates
8. Sprinkle over the pears , blue cheese and walnuts
9. Place over chicken then drizzle with dressing and toss

title: marinated grilled chuck steak
steps:
1. Trim excess fat from the steak , and place in a shallow container or a large zip lock bag
2. Combine all the other ingredients , stirring well
3. Pour the marinade over the steak
4. Cover and marinate in the refrigerator at least 8 hours , turning once
5. Take steak out of the refrigerator to let it sit while you are getting your charcoal ready on your grill
6. This will help relax the meat so it is even more tender
7. Remove steak from the marinade
8. Grill over hot coals 8 minutes on each side , or until it reaches the desired degree of doneness

title: slightly different meatloaf
steps:
1. Preheat oven at 375f
2. Combine all meatloaf ingredients in large bowl mixing well
3. Shape meatloaf onto lightly greased baking tray into a free form log shape
4. Bake for 45 minutes
5. Lightly saut onion in margarine until translucent
6. Add all other sauce ingredients and bring slowly to the boil
7. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 15 minutes
8. Once meatloaf has been cooking for 45 minutes reduce oven to 350f baste meatloaf with half of bbq sauce and cook for further 45 minutes basting with remaining sauce often
9. Rest for 10 minutes loosely covered with foil before slicing meatloaf thickly and serving with mashed potato and any remaining sauce

title: artichoke french bread
steps:
1. Cut the loaf in half lengthwise , then tear the center from the bread , leaving a shell
2. Brown the torn bread pieces in a skillet with butter , sesame seeds and garlic
3. Stir in sour cream , monterey jack cheese , parmesan cheese , parsley and artichoke hearts
4. Place this mixture back in bread shells and top with cheddar cheese
5. Bake at 350f for 30 minutes
6. Cover with foil for the first 15 minutes
7. Slice and serve

title: basil spinach and orange salad
steps:
1. Combine the spinach , basil , onion and orange in a large salad bowl
2. In a smaller bowl , whisk together the olive oil , vinegar , brown sugar , oregano , salt and pepper
3. Toss the salad ingredients with the dressing and serve

title: german pancake soup
steps:
1. Prepare pancakes while soup is simmering
2. To prepare soup put all ingredients except beef bouillon cubes into a 3 quart pot
3. Pour enough water to cover about 1 inch from top
4. Bring to a boil
5. Lower heat to a simmer and simmer for 45 minutes
6. Put in the beef bouillon cubes and salt and pepper to taste
7. Cook 5 minutes longer
8. Remove bay leaf and soup bone
9. To prepare pancakes put all ingredients into a medium bowl and stir well
10. Let stand for 15 minutes
11. Heat a small amount of oil in a large skillet
12. Cook pancakes flipping when top dries out
13. Remove from skillet onto paper towels
14. Roll up pancakes and let cool
15. Cut pancakes into thin slices
16. Put pancakes in bottom of soup bowl and top with soup

title: summer sparkle
steps:
1. Mix together the grapefruit juice , orange juice concentrate and lemonade concentrate in a gallon size pitcher
2. Cover and refrigerate until well chilled
3. When ready to serve , add the sprite or 7-up to the pitcher
4. Stir
5. Pour into glasses over ice
6. Garnish with orange or lemon slices

title: polish bigos   hunter s stew
steps:
1. Brown pork and spareribs in a large heavy pot
2. Add smoked butt with 1 cup of water and simmer for 1 hour
3. Add the sauerkraut and one cup apple juice
4. Chop the cabbage fine and add to sauerkraut
5. Add lots of pepper and salt cover and simmer 1 hour
6. Remove lid and keep pot on a very low simmer
7. In a pan , fry bacon until crisp , then crumble into sauerkraut mixture
8. Remove most of the bacon fat and fry onions and mushrooms and flour until they just brown
9. Mix into sauerkraut mixture
10. Cut kielbasa into slices add to sauerkraut mixture with the tomatoes
11. Bring to a boil , simmer 30 minutes and serve hot with rye bread and mashed potatoes

title: maharaja curry
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat
2. Stir in cumin seed and cook until they start to pop , 20 to 45 seconds
3. Stir in onion , and cook until golden brown , about 5 minutes
4. Season with turmeric , cayenne , garam masala , garlic , and ginger
5. Cook for 1 to 2 minutes until fragrant
6. Puree the mixture with the tomatoes in a blender until smooth
7. Return the puree to the saucepan , and add the chicken
8. Simmer gently until the chicken has cooked , about 20 minutes
9. Add water as needed while cooking to maintain desired consistency

title: perfectly easy roast chicken
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f
2. Remove the chicken giblets
3. Rinse the chicken inside and out
4. Remove any excess fat and leftover pin feathers and pat the outside dry
5. Liberally salt and pepper the inside of the chicken
6. Stuff the cavity with the bunch of thyme , both halves of lemon , and all the garlic
7. Brush the outside of the chicken with the butter and sprinkle again with salt and pepper
8. Tie the legs together with kitchen string and tuck the wing
9. Place the onions , carrots , and fennel in a roasting pan
10. Toss with salt , pepper , 20 sprigs of thyme , and olive oil
11. Spread around the bottom of the roasting pan and place the chicken on top
12. Roast the chicken for 1 1 / 2 hours , or until the juices run clear when you cut between a leg and thigh
13. Remove the chicken and vegetables to a platter and cover with aluminum foil for about 20 minutes
14. Slice the chicken onto a platter and serve it with the vegetables

title: fiber one parmesan crusted chicken tenders
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400
2. Place the cereal , parmesan cheese and spices in a blender or food processor to make the breading
3. Season the chicken with salt & pepper
4. Dip the tenders in breading to coat
5. The chicken is normally moist enough for the breading to stick without the use of egg
6. Of course , you could dip it if you like
7. Spray a cookie sheet lined with aluminum foil with non-stick cooking spray , place tenders on sheet and spray tops with non-stick cooking spray
8. Bake the chicken 1 rack from the top for about 6-8 minutes a side

title: skillet mac   cheese  macaroni   cheese
steps:
1. Cook macaroni according to the package directions
2. Meanwhile , in a large nonstick skillet , melt butter over medium heat
3. Stir in flour until smooth
4. Gradually add cream
5. Bring to a boil
6. Cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened
7. Reduce heat
8. Stir in cheese until melted
9. Drain macaroni , add to cheese mixture
10. Cook and stir for 3-4 minutes or until heated through

title: easy   kid friendly sweet green beans
steps:
1. Remove stems from beans
2. Add garlic , butter and green beans to frying pan , simmer covered on medium low heat -stirring occasionally- for 20 minutes or until beans are tender
3. Drizzle small amount of honey and maple syrup on top of beans occasionally as they cook
4. You can add as much or as little as you like for desired sweetness !

title: rich sweet potato chocolate fudge cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease two 9" round cake pans
3. At low speed , beat cake mix with eggs , melted butter and 1 cup water for 30 seconds
4. Increase speed to medium
5. Beat 2 minutes
6. Reduce speed to low
7. Beat in cooked mashed sweet potatoes , and chocolate chips
8. Divide batter between pans
9. Bake 25-30 minutes , or until cake test done
10. Cool on rack 15 minutes before removing from pans
11. Frost cake with desired frosting

title: rolled buttercream fondant
steps:
1. In a large bowl , stir together the shortening and corn syrup
2. Mix in the salt and vanilla flavoring , then gradually mix in the confectioners' sugar until it is a stiff dough
3. If you are using a stand mixer , use the dough hook attachment
4. Otherwise , knead by hand
5. If the dough is sticky , knead in more confectioners' sugar until it is smooth
6. Store in an airtight container at room temperature or in the refrigerator
7. To use , roll out on a clean surface that has been dusted with confectioners' sugar until it is 1 / 8 inch thick or thinner if you can
8. Drape over frosted and chilled cakes and smooth the sides down , or cut into strips to make bows and other decorations

title: cuervo daisy
steps:
1. Shake all ingredients well with cracked ice
2. Strain and pour into two chilled martini glasses

title: caithiseach brownies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Melt butter , combine with sugars and cocoa
3. Add eggs one at a time
4. Add vanilla
5. Mix flour , salt , and baking powder
6. Add the wet ingredients to the dry , mixing well
7. Once everything is mixed add in the chocolate chips
8. Spread in a greased or nonstick 9 x 13 inch baking dish
9. Bake until toothpick comes out clean , approximately 25 minutes

title: meat market spaghetti sauce
steps:
1. This is one tasty italian meat sauce !
2. It's great to get a big pot simmering on a cold winter day
3. In large soup kettle brown all meats in olive oil
4. Drain and add onions and garlic
5. Add all remaining ingredients and bring to a boil
6. Reduce heat to low and simmer , loosely covered , for three hours , stirring occasionally
7. Serve over pasta , use in lasagna , or whatever your heart desires !

title: easy and good zucchini and pepper saute
steps:
1. In a large skillet heat oil and butter
2. Saute the onions and garlic until tender
3. Add in zucchini , both peppers and corn
4. Saute for about 4-5 minutes or until the zucchini and peppers are just tender but not mushy
5. Add in grated parmesan cheese and salt and pepper to taste
6. Mix to combine

title: payday candy bars
steps:
1. In large bowl combine cereal and peanuts
2. Set aside
3. In small saucepan combine corn syrup and sugar
4. Heat to 240 degrees
5. Stirring occasionally
6. Remove from heat and immediately stir in peanut butter until smooth
7. Pour over cereal and peanuts and gently stir just until coated
8. Pat into greased 9x13-inch pan
9. Cool completely before cutting

title: eggplant meat lasagna
steps:
1. Saute onion until soft
2. Brown meat and add to onions
3. Mix with 15 oz
4. Marinara sauce
5. Peel eggplant and slice into 1 / 2 inch rounds
6. Dredge in flour , then egg , then cornflake crumbs
7. In an oven proof dish , lay down raw lasagna noodles
8. Layer on half of the eggplant rounds
9. Add a layer of 1 / 2 the meat
10. Repeat noodles , eggplant and meat
11. End with a layer of noodles
12. Mix the remaining marinara sauce with a cup of water and pour over the noodles
13. Sprinkle with some cornflake crumbs and fresh or dried parsley
14. Bake at 350 for 1 hour

title: hot and sour shrimp stir fry
steps:
1. Peel and devein shrimp
2. Combine shrimp and next 5 ingredients in a shallow bowl
3. Stir well
4. Cover and marinate in refrigerator 30 minutes , stirring occasionally
5. Discard stems from mushrooms
6. Cut mushrooms tops in half
7. Set aside
8. Heat oil in large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
9. Add green onions and shrimp
10. Stir-fry 1 minute
11. Add mushroom tops
12. Stir-fry 2 minutes or until shrimp turns pink
13. Serve over rice

title: simple ham spread
steps: 1. In a small bowl , mash all ingredients together , adding a bit more mayonnaise if too dry

title: chicken with shitakes and artichokes
steps:
1. Cut chicken into strips and sprinkle with mrs
2. Dash
3. Melt butter in a large fry pan over medium-high heat
4. Add chicken and saute until lightly brown , about 10 minutes
5. Remove chicken and set aside
6. Add green onions to pan and saute about 2 minutes
7. Add mushrooms , salt , pepper , and garlic and cook for another 2 minutes , stirring often
8. Add wine , olive oil , and artichoke hearts and simmer for 5 minutes
9. Return chicken to pan and simmer until heated through
10. Serve over rice

title: kahlua aggravation
steps:
1. Pour kahlua and scotch over ice
2. Fill with cream
3. Stir

title: south texas spanish rice
steps:
1. Saute garlic and onions with cumin , salt , & pepper
2. Add rice and brown
3. It should take 2-4 minutes stirring frequently
4. Add chili powder
5. Stir well
6. Add undrained ro-tel tomatoes
7. Let sit on heat for 2-3 minutes
8. Add water , bring to boil , reduce to good simmer , cover , and cook 17-20 minutes
9. Remove from heat , stir , cover , and let sit 5 minutes

title: five dollar beans
steps:
1. Brown meats and onion until meats are browned and onions are tender
2. Drain off any excess fat
3. Stir in remaining ingredients
4. Pour into baking pan
5. Bake at 350f for one hour

title: apple bundt cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Mix apples , cinnamon and sugar , set aside
3. Mix all the rest of the ingredients , mix well
4. Grease bundt pan
5. Add 1 / 3 of batter mixture to the pan
6. Sprinkle half of the apple mixture over the batter then follow with 1 / 3 batter , and then add rest of apples and top with rest of batter
7. Bake for 55- 60 minutes

title: cointreau blondies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Line a 9 inch square baking pan with waxed paper , then grease the paper
3. Melt white chocolate and butter in a double boiler over hot , but not boiling water
4. Stir mixture occasionally until smooth
5. Set aside
6. In a large mixing bowl , beat eggs until foamy
7. Add sugar , cointreau , vanilla extract , orange zest , melted chocolate and butter slowly
8. Fold in flour , salt , dried apricots , chocolate chips and macadamia nuts until well combined
9. Spoon mixture into the prepared pan
10. Bake 25 minutes
11. Cool bars in pan
12. Icing:
13. Melt all ingredients in a double boiler and mix well until smooth
14. Pour over the bars in the pan
15. Refrigerate overnight so that the icing will solidify
16. Using the wax paper as an aid , lift the bars from the pan
17. Use the blade of a pastry scraper or a knife to cut the bars into small squares or triangles
18. These are best served at room temperature

title: ginger chicken   shrimp stir fry with sesame noodles
steps:
1. Cook spaghetti until al dente
2. Drain in colander
3. While noodles cook , heat olive oil over high heat until rippling in a large nonstick skillet
4. Add chicken and stir fry till golden
5. Add scallions , mushrooms , red pepper , garlic and ginger and stir-fry 2 minutes
6. Add shrimp after 1 minute
7. Season with salt and pepper and keep warm
8. While spaghetti drains , add sesame oil and soy sauce to pasta pot
9. Add spaghetti and toss to coat
10. Either add stir-fry to noodles and toss to mix or serve stir-fry on top of noodles
11. Top with toasted sesame seeds

title: spinach   feta frittata
steps:
1. Preheat broiler and place heating rack 4-5" from the heating element
2. Microwave fresh spinach in a loosely covered bowl on high for about 3 minutes or until it is slightly wilted
3. Dry spinach thouroughly with paper towels and chop it coarsely
4. Meanwhile , coat bottom and sides of a 12" ovenproof skillet with cooking spray
5. Heat 1 tbs
6. Oil in the skillet on med-high and add onion
7. Cook until lightly browned
8. In a large bowl , beat eggs thoroughly
9. Stir in tomatoes , spinach , cheese , italian seasoning , salt & pepper
10. Add remaining 2 teaspoons oil to the skillet with onion and tilt pan to distribute oil evenly
11. Pour egg mixture in , evenly distributing vegetables with the back of a wooden spoon
12. Cook over medium heat without stirring for about 7 minutes or until only te surface is loose
13. Place skillet under broiler and cook for approximately 2 minutes or until surface is lightly browned
14. To serve , loosen edges with a knife , flip it onto a cutting board and slice

title: delish scrambled eggs
steps:
1. Whisk together eggs , milk , sour cream , salt , and pepper
2. Melt butter in frying pan
3. Add eggs to frying pan
4. Constantly stir with a spatula
5. When eggs are on the creamier end of firm add the cream cheese and cheddar cheese
6. Stir with spatula until cream cheese and cheddar cheese are melted
7. Serve with whatever you'd like

title: spring mix in  pasta salad
steps:
1. Cook pasta as directed , rinse and drain thoroughly
2. Place in large salad bowl , and mix in the black bean garlic sauce giving a light coating to all
3. This can be adjusted to your taste
4. Add bag of spring mix salad , olives and cherry tomatoes
5. Mix completely , and then pour the italian dressing over all mixing thoroughly once more
6. Can be eaten right off or chilled for later

title: beer dogs
steps:
1. Boil beer and water add hot dogs and seasonings cook until done
2. Use hot dogs of your choice i chose nathans

title: jewish spaghetti
steps:
1. Heat olive oil over medium heat in large frying pan
2. Cook onions until softened
3. Add peppers and cook until soft
4. Add tomato sauce , salt and pepper
5. Bring to a boil
6. Simmer on low for 10 minutes
7. Add to spaghetti

title: butternut squash enchiladas with tomatillo sauce
steps:
1. To prepare the sauce:
2. Peel the outer skins off tomatillos and blanch in boiling water for 4-5 minutes
3. Place tomatillos in a food processor along with chicken stock , cilantro , green onion , jalapeno and puree
4. Transfer to saute pan and simmer over med-low heat
5. Stir in sugar and pepper
6. In a small saucepan melt the butter and whisk in the flour to make a roux
7. Add roux to sauce for desired thickness , salt to taste
8. Set aside
9. To prepare the squash filling:
10. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
11. Cut squash in half lengthwise to clean out seeds
12. Place in small baking dish cut side up in one half inch of water and cook until soft
13. Let cool and spoon out meat
14. Heat olive oil in a large saute pan over medium heat
15. Add garlic , onions and saute 2-3 minute until translucent
16. Mix in squash and corn and set aside
17. To assemble enchiladas:
18. Quickly dip the tortillas in some of the enchilada sauce to soften them
19. Place a spoon or two of the squash mixture on a tortilla along with some cheese and roll up
20. Repeat , placing enchiladas side by side until baking dish is full
21. Top enchiladas with sauce and a little cheese
22. Bake at 350 degrees for 15-20 minutes

title: general mapache chicken surprise
steps:
1. Cut boneless and skinless chicken breasts into stripes
2. Chicken stripes season with salt and soak into lemon juice
3. Leave it 1 hour in lemon
4. In the meantime cut onion into rounds
5. Mince finely garlic
6. Cut bell peppers into stripes
7. Cut tomato into small pieces , cut zucchini into stripes
8. Wash canned corn and beans well to remove can taste
9. Heat olive oil in a frying pan and fry chicken until gets brown
10. Put chicken aside , add some more oil and add vegetables following this order: first onion , saut until softens
11. Than peppers , saut a bit , than tomato and garlic
12. Than add chicken , thyme , oregano , salt , pepper and chili
13. Add some broth and saut until everything softens
14. Add corn and beans and stir
15. Add zucchini last
16. Saut everything for 5-10 minutes or more: all liquid must evaporate and sauce must be sticky

title: indian chicken
steps:
1. Place yogurt and spices in a large mixing bowl
2. Add chicken in bowl and stir to evenly coat chicken
3. Cover and marinate over night
4. The next day take chicken out of the marinade and place on the grill
5. Cook until juices run clear and meat is fully cooked
6. Squeeze lemon juice over finished chicken
7. Enjoy

title: delicious low carb leftover pot  roast casserole
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 350 degrees
2. Chop roast into cubes or shred into bite size pieces
3. In a sprayed or buttered casserole dish mix the roast , left over sauce from roast , cream of mushroom soup , shredded cheddar cheese , frozen broccoli and milk
4. If you thaw the broccoli before you add it you likely will not need to cook for 45 minutes , but if you're feeling lazy then you don't have to thaw it - just make sure you keep the casserole in the oven long enough to get warm !
5. Top the mixture with the french fried onions
6. Bake in 350 degree oven for 30-45 minutes
7. Stir before serving

title: mediterranean smash
steps:
1. Preheat grill
2. Boil unpeeled potatoes until tender
3. Drain
4. Place on an oven tray
5. Grill until browned
6. Combine oil , 1 / 4 cup of basil and garlic in small saucepan
7. Cook over low heat 15 minutes
8. Smash potatoes in large bowl with strained basil oil
9. Stir in olives and remaining basil

title: creamed onions iii
steps:
1. Cook onions until tender
2. Add mushrooms
3. Set aside
4. Make sauce of butter , cream cheese , flour , salt and milk
5. Put onions and mushrooms in buttered casserole
6. Pour sauce over top
7. Cover with cheese and cracker crumbs
8. Bake at 400 degrees for 30 to 40 minutes

title: greek lemon roasted potatoes  martha stewart
steps:
1. Heat oven to 500 degrees
2. Place potatoes in a 10 x 15 inch baking dish
3. Add water , olive oil , lemon juice , dried oregano , salt and pepper
4. Toss potatoes until well coated
5. Bake uncovered about 50 minutes , until fork-tender and brown on the edges
6. Turn potatoes halfway through for even browning
7. Add more water if all the liquid has been absorbed
8. If desired , garnish with oregano
9. Serve

title: cherry pie streusel jumbo muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Grease 6 jumbo muffin cups , or line with jumbo paper liners
3. Streusel: in a small bowl , stir together the flour , almonds , brown sugar , cinnamon , and salt
4. Cut the butter into 1 / 2" cubes and distribute evenly over the flour mixture
5. Cut butter in until mixture is crumbly
6. Set aside
7. Muffins: in a large bowl , stir together the flour , sugar , baking powder , and salt
8. In another bowl , stir together the milk , melted butter , egg , vanilla , and almond extracts
9. Make a well in the center of the flour mixture
10. Add the milk mixture and stir just until combined
11. Do not overmix
12. Divide a little less than 1 / 2 the batter amongst the prepared muffin cups , spreading to cover bottoms
13. Place 1 tbsp
14. Of pie filling in the center of each cup , being careful to avoid the sides of the cup
15. Set aside 1 / 2 cup of the streusel
16. Sprinkle remainder over the pie filling
17. Cover with remaining batter , top each with another 1 tbsp
18. Of pie filling
19. Sprinkle remaining streusel over tops
20. Bake for 25-30 minutes , or until tops are lightly browned and a toothpick inserted in a"batter" section comes out clean
21. Cool 10 minutes in pan on a wire rack before inverting
22. Cool completely
23. Serve warm , or cool completely and store wrapped airtight in the refrigerator
24. Bring to room temperature before serving

title: baked crab dip  like simon and seafort s restaurant
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients well
2. Bake in a 1 quart dish at 350 for 8-10 minutes
3. Serve hot

title: omelet with corn and smoked mozzarella
steps:
1. Cut corn from cob or use frozen and place in a small skillet with a few tablespoons water
2. Cook over medium heat until heated through and drain
3. Meanwhile , combine eggs , a tablespoon water in a medium bowl and beat lightly
4. Add corn to the eggs and season with salt and pepper , add cheese and basil
5. Stir
6. Wipe out skillet , add butter and heat over medium high heat
7. When the butter just starts to foam , add egg mixture and stir once or twice
8. Cover and cook until the bottom is pale golden , then carefully invert with a plate and slide back into the skillet
9. Cook an additional 1 or 2 minutes and serve

title: phyllo pizza with fresh tomatoes and feta cheese
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
2. In a 9" x 13" baking dish or on a baking sheet , lay out one piece of phyllo dough
3. Spray or brush a thin layer of olive oil covering the whole piece of phyllo
4. Repeat until all 6 pieces are layered and coated with olive oil
5. Sprinkle the parmesan cheese over the phyllo , as evenly as possible
6. Spread tomato slices out over the phyllo dough
7. Tear the 12 leaves of basil and distribute evenly over the pizza
8. Season with the sea salt and pepper
9. If desired , drizzle with a little extra virgin olive oil
10. Bake for about 15 minutes , or until feta begins to brown
11. Be sure to keep a watchful eye on it though , if the edges begin to brown too much before the feta is browned to your liking cover the edges with strips of foil to impede burning
12. Garnish with fresh torn basil

title: lighter zucchini banana bread
steps:
1. Beat eggs
2. Add sugar , oil , applesauce and bananas
3. Mix well
4. Add vanilla
5. In separate bowl , combine flour , baking powder , baking soda , cinnamon and salt
6. Stir into wet mixture just until moistened
7. Add zucchini and nuts
8. Pour into 2 greased 9x5 inch loaf pans
9. Bake at 350 for 50 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean

title: chicken and mushroom casserole ii
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400
2. Stir together the mustard and olive oil
3. Rub mixture on chicken pieces
4. Season chicken with 1 / 2 teaspoons of the salt and pepper to taste
5. Set aside
6. Toss together mushrooms , garlic and green onions in a 2-quart shallow baking dish
7. Top with the chicken , skin side up
8. Bake until the chicken is nearly cooked , about 25 minutes
9. Turn oven to broil on high
10. Place chicken under broiler
11. Cook until the skin browns and crisps , about 5 minutes
12. Transfer the chicken and mushrooms to a serving platter or individual plates
13. Spoon cooking juices over

title: haystack supper
steps:
1. Divide crackers between two ungreased 13x9x2-inch baking dishes
2. Top with rice
3. In a skillet , cook beef and onion until meat is no longer pink
4. Drain
5. Add tomato juice , water and seasonings
6. Simmer for 15-20 minutes
7. Spoon over rice
8. Sprinkle with lettuce and tomatoes
9. In a saucepan , melt butter
10. Stir in flour until smooth
11. Gradually add milk and velveeta
12. Bring to a boil
13. Cook and stir for 2 minutes
14. Pour over the tomatoes
15. Top with cheddar cheese and olives
16. Serve with chips
17. Refrigerate any leftovers

title: spinach artichoke hummus
steps:
1. In a food processor , puree the chickpeas and garlic
2. Add the olive oil , tahini , and lemon juice , and process until smooth , adding more liquid if necessary
3. Add the spinach , and pulse a few times , until it is incorporated but not pureed
4. Transfer to a bowl and stir in the artichoke hearts by hand
5. Serve with fresh pita chips !

title: george family breakfast bars
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350
2. Cream butter and sugars
3. Mix in eggs , applesauce , and vanilla
4. Add dry ingredients until combined
5. Fold in chocolate chips
6. Spread batter in bar pan and bake 20 to 30 minutes or until golden brown
7. If using a 9 x 11 cake pan bake 40 minutes
8. These can also be made as cookies - bake 10 to 15 minutes

title: orange teriyaki salmon
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450
2. Combine the first 6 ingredients in an 8-inch square baking dish
3. Stir with a whisk to combine
4. Add fish to baking dish
5. Spoon sauce over fish
6. Bake at 450 for 15 minutes or until fish flakes easily with a fork , basting occasionally with sauce

title: patum peperium   the secret is out   gentleman s relish
steps:
1. Using a mortar and pestle , pound the anchovies and butter until they resemble a smooth paste
2. You could also use a food processor
3. Stir in the breadcrumbs , spices and pepper and spoon the paste into a large ramekin
4. Cover and chill before serving
5. Serve with scrambled eggs , toast , sandwiches and as a "kick" to savoury sauces !

title: grilled zucchini wrapped shrimp
steps:
1. Peel and devein shrimp
2. Combine lime juice , 3 tablespoons vegetable oil , and next 3 ingredients in a heavy-duty zip-top plastic bag , gently squeezing to blend
3. Add shrimp
4. Seal and chill mixture 15 minutes
5. Remove shrimp from marinade , reserving marinade
6. Bring reserved marinade to a boil in a small saucepan
7. Remove from heat
8. Cut zucchini lengthwise into thin'ribbons' with a vegetable peeler
9. Wrap each shrimp with a zucchini'ribbon' , and secure with a wooden pick
10. Brush with remaining 5 tablespoons vegetable oil
11. Grill without grill lid , over medium-high heat about 4 minutes
12. Brush with reserved marinade
13. Turn and brush again
14. Grill 2 more minutes or just until shrimp turn pink
15. Serve hot or at room temperature on a cilantro-lined platter , if desired

title: london broil stewed in stout
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 275 deg
2. To prevent the meat from curling , trim off and discard the fat layer around it
3. Pat the meat dry with paper towls and sprinkle it over with half the salt and pepper
4. Dredge with the cornstarch , patting it well into the meat pierce the meat in half a dozen or so places
5. Press the thyme leaves into the bacon pieces and force a piece of bacon and a garlic spike into each of the holes in the meat
6. Lightly oil a heavy bottomed braising pan
7. Place the bay leaf in the center of the pan and the meat on top of it
8. Pile the onion slices on top of the meat mix the stout , honey , vinegar , and worcestershire sauce and pour over the onions
9. Sprinkle on the rest of the salt and pepper
10. Cover the mount of meat and onions with a sheet of waxed paper
11. Seal the pot with two thicknesses of foil and press the lid down firmly
12. Put the pot in the oven and bake , undisturbed for 3 hours
13. Serve the beef hot , with the thin sauce poured over it
14. Thenatural juice will be thin
15. If you want to"finish" it you can add 2 tbs of tomato sauce and about 3 tbs of cornstarch disolved in 3 tbs of cold water
16. When the sauce has cooked and thickened sufficiently , salt to taste and pour over the meat

title: alli s fruity champagne punch
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients in a punch bowl
2. Great for a crowd !

title: crabmeat puff for 2
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f spray 1 qt baking dish with non-stick spray
2. Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat
3. Add onion , celery and green pepper
4. Saute until onions are translucent , about 6 minutes
5. Stir frequently
6. Add flour and stir until blended with vegetables
7. Add old bay and stir once more
8. Gradually add milk while stirring constantly until thick
9. Remove from heat
10. Add egg , salt , peppers and crabmeat
11. Stir to blend
12. Place mixture into casserole dish
13. Sprinkle with cheese
14. Bake , uncovered , 25 minutes , or until cheese melts and begins to lightly brown

title: cheesymite pies
steps:
1. Remove the crusts from the bread
2. Spread each slice of bread evenly with vegemite
3. Push bread gently into 8 x 1 / 2 cup capacity muffin pan to form a pastry case
4. Cook the bacon in a frying pan over medium heat until crisp
5. Divide evenly into cases
6. Combine cheese spread and eggs until mixed and pour mixture into the bread cases
7. Bake at 180c for 10-15 minutes or until bread is golden and filling has just set
8. Serve warm or cold

title: maple kissed sweet potato muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Lightly grease muffin pan or spray paper cups with oil-spray to prevent sticking
3. In a small bowl , prepare eggs and set aside
4. Whisk flour , baking powder , baking soda , pumpkin pie spice or cinnamon and sugar together in a large bowl
5. Add sweet potato , applesauce and maple syrup on top
6. Then add eggs and stir until just combined
7. Gently spoon the mixture into the cups or pan , filling 3 / 4 of the way
8. Baking 15 to 18 minutes , or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean

title: semolina s chicken cordon bleu pasta
steps:
1. Brown chicken
2. Add ham , garlic and parsley
3. Add alfredo sauce
4. Heat and toss with pasta
5. Put in casserole
6. Top with bread crumbs , parmesan , and fontina
7. Place under broiler and brown

title: spanish grilled chicken breasts
steps:
1. To make the marinade: in a medium bowl , whisk all ingredients except the chicken
2. Place the chicken breasts in a large , resealable bag , and pour in the marinade
3. Press the air out of the bag and seal tightly
4. Turn it several times to distribute the marinade and place it in a bowl and refrigerate for 3 - 4 hours
5. Remove the chicken from the bag and reserve the marinade
6. Pour the marinade in a small saucepan , bring to a boil , and boil for 1 full minute
7. Grill the chicken , skin side down first , and turning and basting with the marinade , over direct medium heat until the meat is firm to the touch and no longer pink in the center , or until it has reached an internal temperature of 165 degrees f
8. This should take a total of approximately 8 - 12 minutes

title: crock pot chicken taco soup
steps:
1. Put everything in crockpot in order listed
2. Do not rinse or drain beans
3. Do not stir
4. Cook on low for 6 to 8 hours
5. Take chicken out and shred with two forks
6. Put chicken back in , stir , and eat

title: caramel filled brownies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325f
2. Grease an 8x8 inch baking pan
3. In a small saucepan melt chocolate and 1 / 2 cup butter over low heat , stirring constantly
4. Remove from heat
5. In a large bowl , beat eggs using an electric mixer set on high until they thicken slightly
6. Slowly add the 1 1 / 2 cups white sugar
7. Add vanilla and mix well
8. Add the chocolate-butter mixture and beat on medium until uniform
9. Add the flour and mix on low speed until just combined
10. Do not overmix
11. Pour 1 / 2 of the brownie batter into the prepared pan
12. Smooth top
13. Bake 15-20 minutes or until the top is firm
14. Heat 1 / 4 cup butter , 1 / 3 cup brown sugar , and corn syrup in a heavy pan over medium heat , stirring constantly until the sugar dissolves
15. Increase the heat to high and boil 1 1 / 2 minutes
16. Remove from heat and stir in cream
17. Keep warm
18. Spread warm caramel evenly over top of baked brownie layer
19. Pour remaining half of brownie mixture over caramel , smoothing the top
20. Bake an additional 25-30 minutes or until brownies test done
21. Cool brownies in pan , then cut into squares
22. I think these are best served chilled

title: easy pasta lasagna
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Spray 9x13 inch baking pan with nonstick spray
3. Cook rigatoni according to package directions , drain , and divide in half
4. In large bowl , beat eggs and stir in ricotta and parmesan cheese , garlic , oregano , salt and pepper
5. In large bowl , mix the two jars of pasta sauce with the can of diced tomatoes including juice
6. Add 2 cups pasta sauce mix spreading to cover bottom of baking pan
7. Add half of cooked noodles over sauce , and top with half of ricotta mixture , dropped by spoonfuls
8. Add sour cream , dropped by spoonfuls
9. Add 1 cup mozzarella , 2 cups pasta sauce mix , remaining rigatoni and ricotta mixture , and top with 1 cup mozzarella
10. Add remaining pasta sauce mix and remaining mozzarella
11. Bake covered with foil until bubbly , about 60 minutes
12. Uncover and continue cooking about 5-10 minutes or until cheese is melted
13. Let stand for 10 minutes before serving

title: microwave potato soup
steps:
1. Microwave potatoes , onion and water on high 8 to 10 minutes until potatoes are tender
2. Cover and let rest 5 minutes
3. Mash potatoes with a fork into large pieces
4. This does help thicken the soup
5. Add remaining ingredients except cheese and cook on high 5 to 8 minutes to serving temperature
6. Garnish with cheese and bacon or chives

title: pork chops supreme
steps:
1. Sprinkle pork chops with salt and pepper
2. Cook pork chops in hot oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat 5 minutes on each side or until browned
3. Drain
4. Add onions , and remaining ingredients to skillet
5. Cover , reduce heat to medium , and simmer 30 minutes or until meat is tender

title: chickpea tunalike  salad
steps:
1. Coarsely chop the beans in a food processor , or mash well with a fork
2. Stir in the celery , lemon juice , onion , parsley , mayonnaise , relish , mustard , paprika , and salt and pepper to taste
3. Add in crushed toasted nori sheets if using
4. Mix well
5. Chill thoroughly before serving
6. Stored in a covered container in the fridge , the salad will keep for up to 1 week
7. Enjoy !

title: perch fajitas with pineapple salsa
steps:
1. Combine lemon pepper , cumin , salt , and 4 tbls
2. Lime juice in a resealable plastic bag
3. Add fish
4. Seal and shake
5. Chill 20 minutes
6. Combine pineapple , bell peppers , jalapeno , cilantro , and remaining lime juice in a medium bowl
7. Set aside
8. Grill fish , covered with grill lid , on a grill rack coated with nonstick cooking spray over medium heat 4 to 6 minutes on each side or until fish flakes with a fork
9. You may broil if you wish instead of grilling
10. If using vegetarian scallops , heat under broiler , turning once or twice)
11. Arrange fish and pineapple mixture evenly down center of warm tortillas
12. Fold
13. Serve and enjoy !

title: mexican white chili with chicken
steps:
1. In a skillet cook the onion and garlic in 2-3 tablespoons butter until softened
2. To make the roux: in a heavy-bottomed pot melt 6 tablespoons butter over medium heat and whisk in the flour , cook whisking for 3 minutes
3. Stir in the onion / garlic mixture and carefully whisk in the half and half cream , whisking constantly
4. Bring to a simmer , whisking until the mixture has thickened
5. Simmer for 5 minutes
6. Stir in tabasco , chili powder , cumin , salt and pepper
7. Mix to combine
8. Add in beans , chilies , corn , chopped cooked chicken and monterey jack cheese
9. Cook the mixture over medium-low heat (about 20 minutes
10. Remove from heat and stir in the sour cream
11. Transfer to serving bowls dollup with sour cream and drizzle with salsa if desired

title: cafe vienna
steps:
1. Mix together
2. Store in a small canister
3. Use 1 tablespoon per mug of hot water

title: s mores coffee and fudge ice cream cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Finely grind graham crackers , toasted almonds and 3 tbs sugar in processor
3. Add 1 / 2 cup melted butter
4. Process mixture until moist crumbs form
5. Press mixture onto bottom and up sides of 9 inch diameter spring form pan with 2 3 / 4 inch sides
6. Bake crust until edges are golden , about 12 minutes
7. Cool completely before proceeding
8. Spread 2 cups softened ice cream in cooled crust
9. Spoon 3 / 4 cup fudge sauce over
10. Freeze until sauce is just set , about 10 minutes
11. Repeat layering with 2 cups ice cream , then 3 / 4 cups sauce
12. Freeze until sauce is just set
13. Spread remaining 2 cups ice cream over
14. Cover and freeze cake overnight
15. Refrigerate remaining sauce
16. Preheat broiler
17. Warm remaining fudge sauce
18. Place cake in pan on baking sheet
19. Spread marshmallow creme over top
20. Sprinkle miniature marshmallows in a single layer over top
21. Broil , just until marshmallows are deep brown , watching closely to avoid burning , about 1 minute
22. Run knife between pan sides and cake to loosen
23. Remove pan sides
24. Cut cake into wedges
25. Serve cake immediately with warm fudge sauce

title: blackberry syrup
steps:
1. Process blackberries in a blender until smooth , stopping to scrape down sides
2. Pour through a fine wire-mesh strainer into a medium saucepan , discarding solids
3. Stir in remaining ingredients
4. Bring mixture to a boil over medium heat , stirring occasionally
5. Boil , stirring occasionally , 1 minute
6. Remove from heat
7. Cool
8. Serve with cobbler , pound cake , fruit , pancakes , or ice cream

title: 3 ingredient carnitas
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Add pork , water or chicken stock , and 1 tablespoon salt to a large dutch oven with a tight fitting lid
3. Liquid should just cover meat
4. Add additional as necessary
5. Place over medium-high heat and bring to a boil
6. Transfer to oven and cook , about 3 -4 hours , until meat is very tender and liquid is reduced to 1 cup
7. Baste meat every 45 minutes with cooking liquid
8. Increase heat to 400 degrees f
9. Remove pot from oven and drain all but 3 tablespoons fat from pot
10. Add cumin , cloves , cayenne , and 2 teaspoons black pepper
11. Stir to combine , and return to oven
12. Roast , stirring after 10 minutes , until meat is browned , crisp , and liquid is evaporated , about 20 minutes more
13. If meat is very fatty , you may need to continue to drain fat as pork crisps
14. Season to taste with salt and and pepper , and serve in tortillas , with cabbage , sour cream , pickled red onions , cilantro , avocado and serranos chiles

title: hash brown egg bake
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine hash browns , bacon , 1 / 2 cup cheese , and salt
2. Spoon into a greased 13x9" baking dish
3. In a separate bowl , beat eggs and milk until smooth and pour over hash brown mixture
4. Sprinkle with paprika
5. Bake , uncovered , at 350 for 45 to 50 minutes or until golden
6. Top with the remaining cheese

title: pork chops with apples and bacon
steps:
1. Cook bacon in a heavy skillet over medium heat until crisp
2. Remove to a paper towel and reserve
3. In the bacon fat , saute the apples over medium heat until they are soft , but not mushy
4. The cut edges should brown and caramelize
5. Remove apples with a slotted spoon and keep warm
6. Place flour , salt and pepper in a brown paper bag and shake thoroughly
7. Shake the pork chops in the seasoned flour
