8. Fry the chops in the remaining fat over medium high-heat until they are browned , turning once
9. Serve the chops on warmed plates , covered with the apples and 4 pieces of bacon per chop

title: south beach diet spicy grilled fish and peppers
steps:
1. Preheat grill to medium-high heat
2. Mix dressing and crushed red pepper
3. Pour half of dressing mixture over fish in resealable plastic bag
4. Pour remaining mixture over peppers in separate resealable plastic bag
5. Seal bags
6. Turn bags over several times to evenly coat fish and peppers
7. Refrigerate 15 minutes to marinate
8. Remove fish from marinade
9. Discard marinade
10. Remove peppers from marinade , reserving marinade
11. Place peppers on grill
12. Top with fish
13. Cover grill with lid
14. Grill 4 minutes
15. Carefully turn fish
16. Brush with reserved marinade from peppers
17. Grill , covered , an additional 2 minutes or until fish flakes easily with fork
18. Place fish and peppers on plate
19. Let stand 3 minutes
20. Sprinkle with cheese and cilantro

title: raspberry cranberry iced tea
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , add the frozen raspberries , and the water
2. Bring water to a boil , stirring to break up the raspberries
3. Reduce heat to a simmer , cover the pan , and simmer the berries for 10 minutes
4. Remove pan from the heat , strain and discard the raspberry seeds
5. Add the tea bags to the pan , cover the pan , and steep the tea for 1 hour
6. Remove the tea bags from the pan , and strain the tea once again
7. Pour the raspberry-tea into a heat proof glass pitcher
8. To the pitcher , add the sugar and stir until sugar has dissolved
9. Add the raspberry-cranberry juice to the pitcher , and stir
10. At this point you can immediately serve the tea in a glass filled with ice , or you can chill the tea in the refrigerator until ready to serve

title: peach and wild blackberry salsa
steps:
1. Prepare peaches and place in a large mixing bowl
2. Wash and pat dry blackberries and set aside
3. To the mixing bowl with peaches , add sweet red pepper , red onion , jalapeno peppers , cilantro , cumin , lime juice , orange juice and honey , mix well
4. Add blackberries and fold in gently trying not to mash them
5. Set mixture aside in refrigerator so that flavors will combine
6. Serve with grilled fish or seafood of your choice

title: gerry s  sauced hamburgers
steps:
1. Pan fry or grill the hamburger patties
2. Drain patties on paper towel
3. Put prepared patties in a casserole dish or a roaster
4. Prepare sauce in a medium pot add the sauce ingredients and blend smooth with a whisk
5. Cook gently over medium heat , stirring until heated through
6. Pour over the prepared patties
7. At this point you may cover and refrigerate until ready to heat for your meal
8. If preparing this at mealtime , place in a 300 degree oven for 25 minutes or until nicely heated through
9. I like serving marinated onions , sliced tomatoes , pickles and all the extras that make for a loaded burger

title: dark chocolate   orange muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180c
2. Line muffin tin with paper
3. Place the flour , baking powder , sugar , orange zest , and chocolate in a large bowl and mix to combine
4. In another smaller bowl , combine the yogurt , butter , eggs and orange juice until well blended
5. Add the wet mixture to the dry mixture and mix until just combined
6. Spoon the batter carefully into the prepared muffin tin
7. Bake for 35-40 minutes or until the tops are golden and cooked when tested with a skewer
8. Remove from oven and cool for 5 minutes
9. They are ready to serve straight away

title: baked potato bread  for the bread machine
steps:
1. Put all ingredients into a bread machine in the order suggested by the manufacturer
2. Set to the regular bake cycle

title: bananas ghana
steps:
1. Cut 8 medium bananas in half lengthwise and then crosswise
2. Blend: 1 / 4 cup sugar and
3. 1 teaspoons cinnamon and
4. Dip the bananas in this mixture until coated
5. Place the four quarters cut side down , side by side , in a 9-inch round or square ovenproof dish
6. Blend: 1 cup orange julce with
7. 3 tbs
8. Curacao or apricot brandy
9. Pour juice over all the bananas
10. Bake at 350' for 20 minutes , basting with the juice if required
11. Sprinkle 4 tbs
12. Shredded coconut or chopped peanuts over the top
13. Serve piping hot directly from baking dish
14. Pass a bowl of sweetened sour cream as a garnish

title: winter wonderland martini
steps:
1. Add the vanilla vodka , white chocolate liqueur , crme de cacao and cream into a shaker and shake over ice
2. Strain martini into a martini glass and add half a teaspoon of coconut flakes
3. Stir martini gently with white chocolate wafer stick to create a blizzard !

title: low fat banana split dessert
steps:
1. Mix cracker crumbs and butter
2. Pat into a 9x13 pan
3. Freeze 10 min
4. Combine cream cheese and sugar in bowl beat with electric mixer until blended
5. Carefully spread mixture over crust
6. Top cream cheese mixture with drained pineapple
7. Slice bananas 1 / 4 to 1 / 8in think and place over pineapple keeping the slices as close as possible
8. Mix pudding mix and milk in another bowl and mix until thickened
9. Fold in 1c cool whip
10. Spread pudding mixture over bananas
11. Top with remaining cool whip
12. Can add more than 1c if you'd like
13. Garnish with chopped nuts and additional banana slices in desired
14. Refridgerate 3 hours

title: fantastic apple cranberry apricot matzoh kugel
steps:
1. Set oven to 350f
2. Grease a 3-quart casserole dish
3. In a bowl toss the apple pieces with 1 / 3 cup brown sugar and 1 / 4 cup fresh orange juice
4. Set aside
5. In another bowl soak the matzoh pieces in 1 cup warm water until soft but not mushy
6. Set aside
7. While the matzoh is soaking , in a large bowl whisk the eggs until well blended
8. Add in the salt , cinnamon , 1-1 / 2 cups sugar , melted butter , cranberries and chopped dried apricots
9. Mix to combine
10. Gently squeeze the liquid from the matzohs add to the egg mixture along with the chopped apples
11. Mix very well
12. Transfer the mixture into greased baking dish
13. Sprinkle lightly with about 2 tablespoons white or brown sugar , then dot all over with the cold butter pieces
14. Bake covered with foil for about 40 minutes
15. Remove from oven uncover , then return and bake uncovered for another 20 minutes , or until the casserole is set
16. Serve at room temperature

title: broccoli carrot rice stir fry
steps:
1. Heat oil over medium high flame
2. Saute vegetables for 2 minutes
3. Add rice and saute 2 minutes more
4. Add 2 / 3 cup chicken stock
5. Bring to boil
6. Cover & lower to simmer for 15 - 20minutes
7. Enjoy !

title: braised beef with tea
steps:
1. In a saucepan , bring the chicken stock to boil
2. Add tea , remove from the heat and let infuse about 15 minutes
3. Remove the tea bags
4. Set aside
5. Put the grill in the center of the oven
6. Preheat to 350f
7. In a large ovenproof saucepan , brown the beef in butter and oil
8. Add salt and pepper to taste
9. Set aside on a plate
10. In the same saucepan , brown the onions
11. Add more butter if needed
12. Put the beef back in the saucepan and add the chicken-tea stock
13. Bring to boil
14. Cover and cook in the oven for 1 hour and 30 minutes
15. Add carrots and keep cooking , covered , 30 minutes
16. Add green beans and prunes , making sure to soak them in the stock
17. Keep cooking about 30 minutes , uncovered or until green beans are tender
18. Adjust seasoning
19. Serve on mashed potatoes , plain couscous or noodles with butter

title: sliced potatoes with bacon and parsley
steps:
1. Peel potatoes and place in a large pot with enough water to cover by several inches
2. Bring to a boil over high heat , add 1 tablespoon salt and reduce to a gentle boil
3. Cook until potatoes are just tender when pierced with a knife
4. Do not overcook
5. While the potatoes cook , combine the vinegar , sugar and remaining salt in a small saucepan and place over medium heat until sugar is dissolved , then pour over potatoes
6. Saute bacon in a large skillet placed over medium-low heat , stirring frequently until browned and crispy
7. Remove with a slotted spoon
8. Drain on paper towels
9. Drain excess fat from skillet , leaving a thin coat of bacon grease in skillet
10. Saute onions until translucent but not browned
11. Pour in the beef broth and bring to a boil over high heat
12. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook until reduced by half
13. About 20 minutes
14. Pour the broth mixture over the reserved warm potato mixture and sprinkle with the reserved bacon and chopped parsley
15. Gently stir to combine and serve immediately

title: deluxe turkey club pizza
steps:
1. Heat oven to 425
2. Lightly spray 12" pizza pan or 9x13 pan
3. Unroll dough and place on pan
4. Press out to form crust
5. Sprinkle sesame seeds evenly over dough
6. Bake 10-12 min or light golden brown
7. Meanwhile , cook bacon over medium heat until crisp
8. Drain
9. In small bowl mix mayo and lemon peel until blended ,
10. Spread mayo over crust
11. Top with jack cheese , basil , turkey , bacon , and tomatoes
12. Sprinkle with the swiss
13. Bake 7-9 min or cheese is melted and crust has browned

title: the ultimate baked potato salad
steps:
1. Place potatoes in even layer in greased 13x9-inch baking dish
2. Combine 3 cups cheese , mayonnaise and onion in medium bowl
3. Spread mixture over potatoes
4. Sprinkle potato mixture with bacon , peppers and olives
5. Bake in preheated 350f oven 35 minutes or until bubbly
6. Top with remaining cheese
7. Bake 5 minutes more
8. Make-ahead
9. Bake in preheated 350f oven 45 minutes or until bubbly
10. Top with remaining cheese
11. Bake 5 minutes more

title: lady and sons asparagus sandwich   paula deen
steps:
1. First , blanch the asparagus spears in boiling , salted water for 1 minute
2. Remove immediately to a bowl of ice water
3. Melt 1 tablespoon of butter in a large skillet over medium heat
4. Add asparagus and saute lightly
5. Season with the salt and pepper , or lemon pepper
6. Remove asparagus from pan and set aside
7. Butter 2 pieces of the pumpernickle bread with the remaining 1 tablespoon butter
8. Place the bread in the same skillet , buttered side down , and grill on 1 side
9. Flip bread and place 1 piece of cheese on each slice of bread
10. Grill until cheese is melted and then remove from pan
11. Spread desired amount of dressing on top of each slice of bread
12. Arrange asparagus on top of cheese , rotating the spears
13. Place onion rings on top of asparagus
14. Cut sandwich in half
15. Garnish with pickle slices or parsley , if desired
16. Enjoy !
17. In a medium bowl , mix all ingredients together
18. Season with salt , pepper , and lemon pepper , to taste
19. Store it in an air-tight container and refrigerate until ready to serve
20. Yield: 2 3 / 4 cups

title: lighter parmesan spinach stuffed potatoes with vegan variation
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 450 degrees fahrenheit
2. Pierce the potatoes in several places with a fork
3. Bake for 45 minutes , or until tender
4. Meanwhile , lightly coat a large skillet with nonstick spray and warm over medium-high heat
5. Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute
6. Add the spinach and cook , stirring frequently , for 2 minutes , or until wilted
7. Stir in the cottage cheese and the parmesan cheese , and cook , stirring , for 2 minutes or until the parmesan melts
8. Cut a 1-inch to 2-inch x in each potato and squeeze to open slightly
9. Divide the stuffing among the potatoes

title: spiced pickled carrots
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in saucepan and bring to a boil
2. Simmer for 8-10 minutes , or until the carrots are crisp-tender
3. Pour hot mixture into a heat safe container and cover tightly
4. Refrigerate at least 12 hours , but 24 is better
5. You can add a small hot pepper or two to the pot while boiling to add heat
6. Drain to serve

title: keoke coffee
steps:
1. Pour liquours into a mug and fill with hot coffee
2. Top with a dollop of whipped cream

title: captain don s onion soup with garlic flavored croutons
steps:
1. Peel the onions and slice thin
2. Heat the beef broth in a large soup kettle
3. Melt 8 t
4. Butter in large , heavy skillet , add the onions and sprinkle with nutmeg
5. Cover and cook over low heat until onions are translucent and soft
6. Stir occasionally to make sure that all the onions cook evenly
7. Caramelize the onions as follows: turn heat up to high and add 1-2 t
8. Sugar and 1 / 2 t
9. Salt to cooked onions
10. Stir constantly and continue cooking until onions are deep brown
11. Be sure to scrape the bottom of the pan to get up any bits of caramel , which adds enormously to the flavor
12. When the onions are a lovely , glistening color , remove from heat and stir in 3 t
13. Flour
14. Return to stove over medium heat , and add a bit of the beef broth , which has been heated
15. Now add the onions to your large kettle of boiling beef broth
16. Stir in the dry vermouth and kitchen bouquet
17. Pour the soup into a heavy , oven proof casserole and gently fold in the swiss and most of the gruyere cheeses
18. Cover the entire top with garlic-flavored croutons
19. Top the croutons with the remaining gruyere and pop into a preheated 350-degree oven or 20-30 minutes until the top browns
20. Serve at once by ladling into individual serving dishes and topping each with a healthy sprinkling of parmesan cheese
21. To make garlic-flavored croutons: slice a stale italian or french bread into 1-inch slices and then into 1-inch cubes
22. Brush all sides of bread with olive oil and place in oven to toast until brown
23. About halfway through process , remove bread from the oven and rub each piece with a cut garlic clove
24. Continue toasting until well browned , but not burned

title: greek eggplant  tomato  and feta pizza
steps:
1. Mix together the first 6 ingredients in a bowl
2. Set aside
3. Cut the eggplant crosswise into 1 / 2 inch thick slices
4. Brush both sides of the eggplant with oil
5. Put slices on a foil-lined baking sheet
6. Broil for 2 minutes on each side or until lightly browned
7. Place eggplant evenly over the pizza crust
8. Top with tomato mixture
9. Sprinkle with cheese
10. Bake at 450 for 8-10 minutes or until heated
11. Serve immediately

title: savory parmesan popovers  healthier
steps:
1. Place the oven rack on the next-to-lowest shelf of the oven
2. Preheat the oven to 450
3. Coat 6 popover cups , deep muffin cups , or custard cups with nonstick spray
4. In a medium bowl , stir together the milk , unbleached or all-purpose flour , whole wheat flour , oil , basil , and salt
5. Vigorously whisk in the egg and egg whites
6. Spoon the batter into the prepared cups
7. Sprinkle with parmesan evenly over the batter in the cups
8. Bake for 15 minutes
9. Reduce the oven temperature to 350
10. Do not open the oven door
11. Bake for 15-20 minutes longer , or until deep golden brown and puffed up
12. Remove the popovers from the oven and cool in the cups on a rack for 5 minutes
13. Carefully remove from the cups and serve

title: springtime barley risotto
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , heat oil over medium heat
2. Add barley and leeks
3. Cook until leeks begin to soften , 5 to 7 minutes
4. Add wine
5. Cook until evaporated , about 5 minutes
6. Add 2 cups water
7. Bring to a boil and season with salt and pepper
8. Reduce heat
9. Simmer until liquid is absorbed , about 10 minutes
10. Add broth and continue to cook , stirring occasionally , until barley is tender and creamy , about 10 minutes
11. Add asparagus
12. Cook until tender , about 5 minutes
13. Stir in peas until heated through
14. Add parmesan and mint
15. Season with salt and pepper
16. Garnish with mint leaves

title: mrs  seiko s fried rice
steps:
1. Heat oil in frying pan
2. Add rice , green onion , and meat
3. Cook over medium high heat for 1-2 minutes trying to coat the rice with the oil
4. Add sauces and mix well
5. Push rice to sides and scramble eggs in hole made in middle until done
6. Combine eggs with rice
7. Add in vegetables , if desired
8. Season with salt and pepper , if desired
9. Serve and enjoy !

title: leek and apple bake  crustless quiche
steps:
1. Cut off the white and soft green part of the leeks , split in half length wise and wash well in a bowl of water
2. Slice the leeks into 1 / 8 - 1 / 4 slices across the grain creating moon shaped slices
3. Set aside
4. Core and dice the granny smith apples , do not peel
5. Place into a bowl and set aside
6. In a small skillet or wok , i used a wok , melt 1 stick or 1 / 4 pound of butter on medium heat
7. When melted add your leeks and saute until tender and fragrant
8. Remove the leeks from the heat and place in a medium to large size bowl
9. Let them cool while you cook your apples
10. Now add more butter to the skillet or wok to melt then add your apples to it
11. Cook them until they are soft adding the brown sugar at the end
12. This is optional depending on your taste and sweetness of your apples
13. I used two teaspoons of splenda brown sugar
14. Add the cooked apples to the leeks and continue to let them cool
15. Next in a medium size bowl beat four eggs well and add the half and half and beat well again
16. Add the cottage cheese to your egg and milk mixture and beat well
17. Combine the two together in the bowl with the now cool leeks and apples
18. 1 / 4 tsp of salt or to taste
19. Mix well and then pour into your well sprayed or buttered casserole dish
20. This can also be placed into a slightly cooked pie crust for a crusted quiche it you like
21. It is very versatile
22. Bake at 350 degrees until solid and golden on the top
23. It will depend greatly on your choice of dish
24. I cooked mine for an hour in a round two quart dish
25. This can easily be split into two 8-9 inch pie plates and cooked for less time
26. Serve at room temperature or hot with a nice spinach salad for a complete meal

title: old fashion apple mint jelly
steps:
1. Wash the apples and remove the stems and dark spots
2. Quarter but do not peel or core
3. Place in a medium size enamel pot
4. Add just enough water to half cover the fruit
5. Cook over low heat until fruit is soft place cooked apples in a jelly bag and drain out the liquid
6. You will get more juice if you squeeze the bag but the jelly will be cloudy if you do
7. Measure the juice
8. Add 1 / 2 c honey for each cup of juice
9. Boil until jelly is done
10. To test if your jelly is done remove the syrup from the heat and scoop up a small amount of jelly with a cold metal spoon
11. Raise it about a foot above above the pot away from the steam and wait about 20 seconds
12. If the syrup forms two drops that flow together and slide off the spoon in one sheet the jelly should be done
13. If it slides off in several separate drops cook it longer
14. Add 1 / 4 c mint leaves for every quart of juice
15. Stir and allow to cook 1 minute further
16. Remove leaves and ladle into hot sterile jars
17. Seal and process in a boiling water bath for 5 minutes or as according to canners instructions
18. For special occasions you can pour hot jelly into buttered molds

title: linda s cheesecake stuffed strawberries
steps:
1. Place cream cheese in a bowl , and microwave for 30 seconds , so that it's soft
2. Whip together the cream cheese , vanilla , and sugar
3. In the center of each strawberry , using a sharp knife , make a hole in each one , as deep as you can without going out the bottom
4. Spoon or pipe the filling into each hole
5. Dip cheesecake end of strawberry into chopped almonds , making sure you completely cover the cheesecake filling with the nuts
6. Lay strawberries in a pretty serving dish
7. Sprinkle with any leftover nuts around the dish
8. Chill , and serve
9. Makes 24 servings

title: soft pumpkin yummy cake
steps:
1. In a bowl mix flour and baking powder
2. Set aside
3. In another bowl cream butter , sugar and vanilla
4. Stir in egg yolks
5. Beat egg whites until stiff
6. Fold into butter-sugar mixture carefully
7. Then fold in flour mixture and add the pumpkin
8. If the dough is too thick add 3 tbs water to it
9. Now you can add in any or none of the add-ins listed above
10. Fill into a greased baking tin
11. Bake in the pre-heated oven at 180c / 350f for 55-65 minutes
12. Let cool a little in the pan and then invert onto a wire rack to cool completely
13. If you like dust with some icing sugar before serving

title: deutsche donuts  german doughnuts
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , dissolve yeast in water
2. Add 1 cup milk and 1 cup flour
3. Cover and let rise for 30 minutes
4. In a large bowl , cream butter and sugar together with a fork
5. Then mix in the eggs , one at a time
6. Add in flour , salt , raisins , yeast mixture and milk
7. Stir until completely blended
8. I used a rubber spatula to scrape down the sides of the bowl
9. Cover and let rise for 30 minutes
10. Heat oil to 375f
11. Drop batter by the tablespoon into the hot oil
12. I used 2 spoons to help scoop the batter out of one with the other
13. When one side of the doughnut is browned , flip over and cook on other side
14. Set doughnuts on paper towels to drain
15. After placing on serving plate , sprinkle with powdered sugar

title: low carb baked spaghetti squash with garlic sage cream
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 400f
2. Prick squash in several places and bake 45 min until tender
3. Allow to cool slightly , cut in 1 / 2 and scoop out seeds
4. Pull out squash strands from each side with a fork
5. Transfer to a warm bowl
6. While squash is baking: heat cream , garlic and sage in pan over med
7. Heat
8. Cook 10 min until cream is thick enough to coat the back of a spoon
9. Pour sauce over squash , toss lightly until combined
10. Add salt and pepper to taste , sprinkle with parmesan cheese
11. Serve immediately

title: tuna cream spread
steps:
1. Mix well
2. Chill for one hour before serving

title: touchdown pepperoni pizza sandwich
steps:
1. Spread mayonnaise on one slice and pizza or spaghetti sauce on the other slice
2. Lay pepperoni slices on the pizza sauce and the cheese over the top of that
3. Sprinkle parmesan on the mayonnaise slice
4. Pop both pieces into the toaster oven until cheese is bubbly and melted
5. Fold sides together , and serve while warm
6. Variation: try this with your favorite pizza toppings or cheeses
7. Serving suggestion: cut on point into four pieces and use as "appetizers" or little kid-wiches

title: dog food dessert
steps:
1. Preheat oven 350 degrees
2. Grease and flour 13 x 9 inch pan
3. Combine first 2 ingredients
4. Cook over low heat until caramels are melted
5. Keep warm
6. Combine cake mix , butter and nuts
7. Press 1 / 2 mixture in bottom of pan
8. Bake 6 minutes
9. Sprinkle chips over crust
10. Spread caramel mix next , then crumble dough over top
11. Bake 15-20 minutes

title: cabbage rolls voycheshin style
steps:
1. Core and soak the cabbage leaves , rinse them well and cut them to 5"x5" squares , or similar size triangles
2. Prepare the rice according to instructions , but use slightly less water and cook to al dente
3. Chop the bacon and saute until lightly browned , but not crisp
4. Add the chopped onion to the bacon and continue cooking until limp and transluscent
5. Season the rice with granulated garlic and season salt
6. Season the bacon and onion with a small amount of salt and pepper
7. Add the bacon and onion mixture to the rice and blend well
8. You can add a bit of the bacon fat as this helps hold the rice together
9. When the rice has cooled slightly you may begin making the rolls
10. I try to keep the rolls to about a 3 bite size , and line them up tightly in a loaf pan
11. I like to make two layers , and then cover all with some of the spare leaves
12. Pour tomato juice or soup over all
13. Sprinkle slightly with salt and pepper
14. Bake at 300f for 2 hours to fully cook the leaves

title: thai grilled chicken  gai yahng
steps:
1. To make pesto , crush or grind the peppercorns with a mortar and pestle or in a spice or pepper grinder
2. Combine pepper , cilantro , and garlic and work into a smooth paste with a mortar and pestle or in a food processor
3. Add a little oil or water if needed to facilitate the grinding
4. To make sauce , combine sugar , water , vinegar , garlic , and salt in a small , non-reactive saucepan
5. Bring to a rolling boil over medium heat
6. Stir to dissolve sugar and reduce heat to low
7. Simmer until slightly reduced and thickened to a light syrup consistency , about 20 minutes
8. Remove from heat and stir in chili-garlic sauce
9. Cool to room temperature
10. If not using right away , transfer to a jar and seal tightly
11. In a 1-gallon ziplock bag , combine 1 / 3 cup of the pesto , the soy sauce and the salt , if desired
12. Add chicken pieces and shake until coated
13. Cover and chill 1-2 hours , turning over now and then
14. Prepare a hot coal fire or preheat a gas grill
15. Arrange chicken on grill and cook for about 45 minutes-1 hour , turning now and then to cook evenly
16. When chicken is done , transfer to a platter and serve with the sauce and some rice

title: italian veggie creamy fettuccini
steps:
1. Heat olive oil in large skillet over medium-high heat
2. Add broccoli , celery , onion , garlic and basil
3. Cook , stirring occasionally , for 5 minutes or until vegetables are tender
4. Stir in evaporated milk , cheese and pepper
5. Bring just to a boil
6. Reduce heat to low
7. Cook , covered , for 5 minutes
8. Combine cornstarch and small amount of broth in small bowl
9. Add to skillet
10. Gradually stir in remaining broth , bell pepper and peas
11. Cook over medium heat , stirring constantly , until sauce is thickened and vegetables are tender
12. Serve over pasta
13. Sprinkle with cheese

title: caramelized squash   onion
steps:
1. Slice onion into medium-sized pieces
2. Slice squash into rounds
3. Cut ends off snap peas
4. Melt butter in pan and add vegetables and seasoning
5. Cook over med-low heat stirring periodically and covering pan in between to soften veggies
6. Cook until very tender and light to medium brown
7. Serve warm and enjoy !

title: oktoberfest strudel with mustard sauce
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. In a large skillet , over medium heat , warm 2 tablespoons butter , and saute onion for 3 minutes or until clear
3. Add diced apple and saut 3 more minutes
4. Remove from heat , stir in sauerkraut and caraway , mixing well
5. On a large baking sheet , lay out one sheet of phyllo and fold in half lengthways and brush with about 1 tablespoon butter
6. Repeat layering
7. Spread mustard over last layer of phyllo
8. Then spread sauerkraut filling along the long lengthwise side to the center of the dough leaving a 1-1 / 2 inch border around the edges
9. Top sauerkraut with bratwurst slices
10. Roll jellyroll-style folding in the short edges
11. Place seam-side down on pan
12. Brush top with butter
13. Bake 25-30 minutes or until golden brown
14. Meanwhile prepare mustard sauce:
15. In a large skillet , melt butter over medium-low heat , stir in flour to form a smooth past
16. Slowly stir in cream and continue stirring to keep lumps from forming
17. Whisk in mustard and heat through
18. To serve:
19. For an appetizer , slice into 8 portions , as an entree , 4
20. Slice warm strudel and serve in a pool of mustard sauce
21. Sprinkle mustard sauce with the paprika

title: honey pecan candy
steps:
1. Place large piece of foil on work surface
2. Stir sugar , honey , butter and salt in heavy medium skillet over medium-low heat until sugar dissolves , butter melts and syrup comes to simmer
3. Add pecans
4. Cook until syrup turns deep caramel color and bubbles thickly
5. Stir nuts occasionally to coat
6. Scrape onto foil
7. Working quickly , separate nuts with spoon
8. Cool completely
9. Break candy apart into desired sizes
10. Place in airtight container
11. You may now eat a piece of heaven -- or five pieces --
12. Enjoy !

title: curried wedges with minted yoghurt cucumber topping
steps:
1. Preheat oven ro 200 degrees c
2. Scrub potatoes , do not peel
3. Cut into wedges
4. Mix paprika , curry powder , salt & pepper together
5. Place potatoes , oil and paprika mixture in a large baking dish
6. Toss well to ensure the potatoes are evenly covered
7. Bake , uncovered , qt 200 degress c for 30 - 40 minutes
8. Turn over once or twice during cooking
9. Mix yoghurt , mint and cucumber together
10. Serve with the wedges

title: georgia peach and praline pie
steps:
1. Sprinkle 1 teaspoon flour over pie crust
2. Set aside
3. Add 3 tablespoons flour , sugar , salt , nutmeg , corn syrup and eggs to a mixing bowl
4. Beat at medium speed with an electric mixer for 1 minute
5. Fold in peaches and 1 / 4 cup melted butter
6. Pour mixture into piecrust
7. Mix together the remaining flour and brown sugar in another bowl
8. Cut in 2 tablespoons butter using a pastry blender , until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs
9. Add chopped pecans and stir
10. Sprinkle crumb mixture evenly over peach filling
11. Bake at 375 for 45-50 minutes or until center of pie is set

title: good grits
steps:
1. Slowly stir 1 / 2 cup instant grits into 2 cups boiling water to which you've added 1 teaspoons salt , 1 tblsp
2. Instant minced onion and 3 / 4 teaspoons dried parsley
3. Cook uncovered for 3 to 5 minutes , stirring occasionally
4. Stir in 1 beaten egg and 1 cup flour
5. Blend well
6. Drop from tablespoon into 4 cups simmering chicken broth
7. Poach for 10 minutes
8. Remove from liquid with slotted spoon and drain on paper towels
9. Place in a flat baking dish
10. Top with 2 tblsp
11. Melted butter and 1 / 4 cup grated parmesan cheese
12. Broil for 5 minutes or until lightly browned
13. Serve at once

title: limoncello chicken
steps:
1. Season chicken with salt and pepper and dredge well in flour
2. Melt butter in a medium skilet and add chicken
3. Cook over medium heat until both sides are golden brown
4. Add stock
5. Limoncello and lemon slices
6. Cook for 5 minutes more to thicken slightly , pressing the lemon slices with a wooden spoon to release juices
7. Top with basil

title: alton brown s overnight cinnamon rolls
steps:
1. For the dough: in the bowl of a stand mixer with the whisk attachment , whisk the egg yolks , whole egg , sugar , butter , and buttermilk
2. Add approximately 2 cups of the flour along with the yeast and salt
3. Whisk until moistened and combined
4. Remove the whisk attachment and replace with a dough hook
5. Add all but 3 / 4 cup of the remaining flour and knead on low speed for 5 minutes
6. Check the consistency of the dough , add more flour if necessary
7. The dough should feel soft and moist but not sticky
8. Knead on low speed 5 minutes more or until the dough clears the sides of the bowl
9. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured work surface
10. Knead by hand about 30 seconds
11. Lightly oil a large bowl
12. Transfer the dough to the bowl , lightly oil the top of the dough , cover and let double in volume , 2 to 2 1 / 2 hours
13. Combine the brown sugar , cinnamon and salt in a medium bowl
14. Mix until well incorporated
15. Set aside until ready to use
16. Butter a 9 by 13-inch glass baking dish
17. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured work surface
18. Gently shape the dough into a rectangle with the long side nearest you
19. Roll into an 18 by 12-inch rectangle
20. Brush the dough with the 3 / 4-ounce of melted butter , leaving 1 / 2-inch border along the top edge
21. Sprinkle the filling mixture over the dough , leaving a 3 / 4-inch border along the top edge
22. Gently press the filling into the dough
23. Beginning with the long edge nearest you , roll the dough into a tight cylinder
24. Firmly pinch the seam to seal and roll the cylinder seam side down
25. Very gently squeeze the cylinder to create even thickness
26. Using a serrated knife , slice the cylinder into 1 1 / 2-inch rolls
27. Yielding 12 rolls
28. Arrange rolls cut side down in the baking dish
29. Cover tightly with plastic wrap and store in the refrigerator overnight or up to 16 hours
30. Remove the rolls from the refrigerator and place in an oven that is turned off
31. Fill a shallow pan 2 / 3-full of boiling water and set on the rack below the rolls
32. Close the oven door and let the rolls rise until they look slightly puffy
33. Approximately 30 minutes
34. Remove the rolls and the shallow pan of water from the oven
35. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
36. When the oven is ready , place the rolls on the middle rack and bake until golden brown , or until the internal temperature reaches 190 degrees f on an instant-read hermometer , approximately 30 minutes
37. While the rolls are cooling slightly , make the icing by whisking the cream cheese in the bowl of a stand mixer until creamy
38. Add the milk and whisk until combined
39. Sift in the powdered sugar , and whisk until smooth
40. Spread over the rolls and serve immediately

title: tropical gold punch
steps:
1. Mix orange juice , lime juice , and honey in a pitcher
2. Mix well
3. Add club soda and fruit slices
4. Pour over ice into tall glasses and serve
5. Enjoy !

title: ruby jewel christmas cookies  williams sonoma
steps:
1. In a small bowl , whisk the egg yolks and vanilla together , set aside
2. Combine the flour and granulated sugar in a food processor / mixer and process just to blend
3. With the machine running , add the butter 2-3 pieces at a time and process until the mixture looks crumbly
4. With the machine still running , add the egg yolk mixture and process until blended and the dough begins to pull away from the sides of the bowl
5. Turn dough out onto a sheet of plastic wrap and shape or roll it into a flat disk about 3 / 4 in thick
6. Wrap and refrigerate until chilled , about one hour
7. Preheat oven to 350f line a miniature muffin pan with paper liners or line a cookie sheet with parchement paper
8. For cookie cutters: on a lightly floured surface , with a cold rolling pin , roll out the dough to 3 / 4 in thick , cut cookies out and place on baking sheet about 1 in apart
9. For muffin liners: with lightly floured hands , shape the dough into balls and flatten a little then place the balls into the muffin liners about 1 in apart
10. Using the end of a wooden spoon dipped in flour , make an indentation in the center of each cookie , but do not press all the way through the dough
11. Using a spoon or a pastry bag fitted with a plain
12. Bake the cookies until the edges are golden , 15-20 minutes
13. Let the cookies cool completely in the pans on wire racks
14. Transfer the cooled cookies to wire racks and dust with powdered sugar , if desired

title: lemony risotto with asparagus and shrimp
steps:
1. Bring broth and water to a simmer in a medium saucepan
2. Add asparagus and simmer , uncovered , until just tender , about 4 minutes
3. Transfer asparagus with a slotted spoon to an ice bath to stop cooking , then drain
4. Keep broth barely simmering , covered
5. Cook onion in 2 tbsp butter with 1 / 4 tsp salt in a 4 qt heavy saucepan over medium heat , stirring occasionally , until softened , about 5 minutes
6. Add rice and cook , stirring constant
7. Y , 1 minute
8. Add wine and simmer , stirring constantly until absorbed
9. Stir in 1 / 2 cup broth mixture and briskly simmer , stirring frequently , until absorbed
10. Continue adding broth , 1 / 2 cup at a time , stirring frequently and letting each addition be absorbed before adding the next , until rice is creamy and tender but still al dente , about 18 minutes
11. There will be some left-over broth mixture
12. Sir in shrimp , zest and remaining2 tbsp butter , parmesan , parsley and pepper to taste

title: bleu cheese dressing
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl , combine first 6 ingredients and blend 2 minutes at low speed
2. Add mayonnaise and blend 1 / 2 minute at low speed , then increase speed to medium and blend an additional 2 minutes
3. Slowly add bleu cheese and blend at low speed no longer than 4 minutes
4. Refrigerate for 24 hours before serving

title: hot chocolate with pink peppermint whipped cream
steps:
1. This recipe can also be made with white chocolate
2. Simply substitute white chocolate and leave out the coffee
3. Beat the cream , pulverized peppermints and sugar untill stiff peaks form
4. Pipe or spoon onto a parchment paper lined baking sheet , sprinkle with the crushed peppermints , and freeze until firm , about 20 minutes
5. Heat the milk and salt for the hot chocolate in a saucepan over medium heat until steam begins to rise
6. Whisk in the remaining ingredients until smooth
7. Ladle into mugs and top with a rosette of frozen whipped cream
8. Doubling the whipped cream will give you quite a few rosettes to keep in the freezer until needed
9. Store them in an airtight container and try to use them within 2 or 3 weeks

title: machine mixed whole wheat sandwich bread
steps:
1. Add the ingredients to the bread machine in the order listed
2. Select the dough cycle on the machine
3. Be sure that a 1
4. 5-lb loaf is selected
5. Start the machine
6. When it begins the fast mix , lift the lid and use a rubber scraper to push down any dough or flour that is not being mixed into the dough ball
7. Once the first mix is done , turn off the machine
8. Allow the bread to rise in the machine for about 20 minutes , or until it is roughly doubled in size
9. Turn out the bread onto a well-oiled surface
10. Flatten the dough somewhat , then fold it
11. Begin by bringing the edge closest to you into the center , then fold down the top
12. Repeat with the left and right sides
13. If needed , stretch the loaf to make it more oblong
14. Place the loaf into a greased 9 x 5 loaf pan
15. Preheat the oven to 375
16. While the oven is heating , allow the loaf to rise until it has just crested the top of the pan
17. Bake at 375 for 20 minutes
18. Tent the bread with foil , and bake for an additional 20 minutes
19. Cool on a wire rack before slicing
20. It helps give the bread its light , fluffy texture
21. You can find it at whole foods or in the bulk bins at winco

title: thai grilled chicken thighs
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients except chicken in a bowl
2. Mix thoroughly
3. Add chicken and leave to marinate at least one hour , preferably longer
4. Grill chicken on the bbq , hotplate or in the griller until golden brown and cooked through
5. Ususlly you would expect 12 thigh fillets to feed 4 to 6 people- in my family the kids eat 4 each so this recipe serves 3

title: ultimate coffee cake  paula deen
steps:
1. The night before place frozen rolls in well greased bundt pan
2. Sprinkle dry pudding mix over rolls , sprinkle brown sugar over pudding mix , sprinkle chopped pecans over brown sugar , pour melted butter over all
3. To prevent dough from forming a hard crust while it's rising overnight , cover with a damp towel or tightly wrap with plastic wrap
4. Let rise overnight at room temperature about 8 to 10 hours
5. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
6. Bake in oven for 30 minutes
7. Remove from oven and allow to cool for 5 minutes
8. Turn pan over onto a serving platter to remove
9. Serve by pulling apart chunks with forks
10. Enjoy !
11. Update: you are right ! i didn't realize that when i was making it , i was only using 14 rolls
12. I tried it with 16 this morning and while rising , the dough 'overflowed' , i can't imagine using 18
13. Maybe paula was using a bigger bundt pan ? anyway , with a regular sized bundt , i've found 14 rolls to work out great !

title: grilled beef kebabs
steps:
1. Rinse the pieces of meat thoroughly to remove any debris , and drain for 15 minutes
2. Combine the oregano , salt , and pepper in a small bowl
3. Sprinkle the meat with the seasonings , and add oil and vinegar
4. Use hands to mix and coat all pieces of meat
5. Thread skewers : put a piece of meat on the skewer and slide down to 2 inches from the handle end of the skewer
6. Add a vegetable piece , another piece of meat , and continue , alternating vegetable pieces , using a total of 5 pieces of meat on each skewer
7. A piece of meat should go on last , using the meat to hold the vegetable pieces firmly so they don't fall off during cooking
8. Cover and refrigerate skewers for at least one hour before cooking
9. Mix 3 tablespoons of olive oil with the lemon juice and brush the skewers just before cooking
10. Grill to taste over hot coals (or on a gas grill and brush with the oil and lemon mixture a couple of times while cooking
11. You'll want to turn the skewers at least once during grilling
12. It should take somewhere between 10 and 15 minutes depending on the thickness of your cubes for a medium temperature
13. Yield: 7-8 skewers

title: angel food puffs   ww
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Combine first 3 ingredients in a large bowl
3. Beat with a mixer at medium speed until smooth
4. Drop batter by heaping tablespoon onto baking sheet coated with cooking spray
5. Bake at 350 for 9 minutes or until lightly browned
6. Remove from baking sheets
7. Immediately , and cool on wire racks
8. Try strawberry or lemon-lime for starters

title: goop casserole
steps:
1. Mix ingredients together
2. Bake at 350 for 30 minutes

title: cheesy stove top macaroni and cheese
steps:
1. Start cooking the macaroni while you prepare the sauce to save time
2. Melt butter in a medium sauce pan
3. Whisk in flour
4. On medium-high heat , whisk in milk a little at a time
5. Continue to whisk til thick and bubbly
6. Do not allow to burn , turn down heat if sauce is cooking to fast to keep from burning
7. Whisk in mustard , salt and pepper
8. Reduce to medium heat , stir in cheeses
9. When melted and blended pour over cooked and drained macaroni
10. Taste , add more salt if needed
11. Mix and cook 1 or 2 minutes on medium heat
12. Serve

title: chocolate chocolate chip oatmeal cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Beat butter and sugars until light and fluffy
3. Blend in eggs and vanilla
4. In a separate bowl , stir together flour , cocoa , baking soda , and salt
5. Gradually add flour mixture to butter mixture , mixing well
6. Stir in oats and chocolate chips
7. Use a cookie scoop to place on cookie sheet
8. Bake 11 to 12 minutes
9. Do not overbake
10. Cookies should be soft in the center
11. Cool on pan one minute , remove to wire rack

title: mexican jack casserole
steps:
1. In large ovenproof pan , cook the ground beef , celery , onion and bell pepper until beef is cooked and vegetables are tender
2. Drain fat
3. To pan , add rice , water , diced tomatoes , olives , chopped green chili's , bouillion , chili powder , worcestershire sauce and hot pepper sauce
4. Heat to boiling and remove from heat
5. Cover and a bake at 350 for 1 hour
6. Remove from oven and sprinkle with the monterey jack cheese
7. Cover and let stand for about 10 minutes

title: n awlins praline kugel
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Mix together all ingredients excpet for the noodles and the pralines
3. Stir in cooked noodles gently
4. Pour into a greased 8 inch square casserole
5. Bake for 35 minutes
6. Sprinkle crumbled pralines on top and bake another 12 minutes
7. Let stand 10 minutes , then cut into squares

title: lemon shrimp with pasta and basil
steps:
1. Cook pasta in a large pan of boiling water for 10 minutes or until al dente
2. Add shrimp and drain immediately
3. Return pasta mixture to the pan
4. Combine next 5 ingredients in a bowl
5. Toss with cooked pasta and shrimp
6. Sprinkle cheese over pasta and serve immediately

title: brownie caramel layer bars
steps:
1. Combine caramels and the first 1 / 3 cup evaporated milk
2. Cook over low heat until melted
3. Grease and flour 13x9 inch pan
4. In a large bowl combine cake mix , butter , second 1 / 3 cup evaporated milk , and nuts
5. Stir until dough holds together
6. Press half of the dough on the bottom of the pan , bake for 6 min at 350 degrees
7. Sprinkle chocolate chips over crust
8. Spread caramel over crust
9. Press the last half of cake mixture gently on top of the caramel
10. Bake for 15-18 minute
11. Cool slightly and refrigerate
12. Cut into squares and serve with cool , creamy milk !

title: lemon sangria
steps:
1. In a large pitcher , combine all ingredients except for the ice , club soda and green grapes
2. Chill overnight , before serving , add ice cubes and club soda , stir lightly
3. Pour into tall glasses and garnish with the green grapes if desired
4. Enjoy !

title: pistachio bread
steps:
1. Mix first set of ingredients for the bread and pour 1 / 2 of the batter into 2 9x5" loaf pans
2. Put layer of topping ingredients which has been well blended , then cover with remaining batter
3. Bake at 350 for 45 minutes --

title: creamy brussels sprouts
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Cook the bacon in a large skillet over medium heat until crisp
3. Drain the bacon and discard all but 2 tablespoons of the fat
4. Add the shallots and the brussels sprouts and cook over medium heat until the shallots are soft and the sprouts have begun to turn golden
5. Add the wine , salt , and pepper
6. Stir well , scraping any bits from the bottom of the pan
7. Add the chicken stock and stir
8. Reduce heat to low and cook until the sprouts are tender and the liquid is syrupy and reduced to half
9. Transfer to an 8 x 10 inch casserole
10. Cut the bacon into 1 / 2 inch pieces and add it to the brussels sprouts
11. Add the cream and sprinkle with the cheese
12. Bake about 20 minutes , until the liquid is bubbling , the cheese has melted and the top is golden brown
13. Serve immediately

title: sheepherder bread
steps:
1. Into a large bowl , sift the dry ingredients , and dig a well in the center of the sourdough starter
2. Blend the dry mix into the starter from the edges with enough flour to knead until smooth and shiny
3. Place in greased bowl and let rise until almost double
4. Shape into 2 loaves and place in greased bread pans
5. Bake at 375 degrees f until done

title: layered cheesy tuna and zucchini casserole
steps:
1. Cook the egg noddles in boiling water according to package directions
2. Drain and rinse under warm water , then set aside
3. Drain the tuna and flake with a fork
4. In a large bowl , combine tuna , cooked egg noodles , celery and onions
5. Mix well to combine
6. In another small bowl , combine sour cream , mustard powder , mayo , parmesan cheese , milk , thyme , salt and pepper
7. Add into the tuna mixture and toss well to combine
8. Set oven to 350f
9. Grease a 2-quart casserole dish
10. Spoon half of the mixture into prepared dish
11. Top with half of the sliced zucchini
12. Then sprinkle with cheddar cheese
13. Top with noodle mixture then remaining zucchini
14. Sprinkle with more grated parmesan cheese if desired
15. Bake covered with foil for 30 minutes
16. Remove from oven and uncover , sprinkle with grated mozzarella cheese , return to oven and bake for another 10 minutes
17. Sprinkle chopped tomato over casserole before serving

title: italian style swiss chard
steps:
1. Trim stem ends of chard
2. Thinly slice stems crosswise up to base of leaves
3. Set slices aside
4. Reserve a few whole leaves to line serving dish
5. Coarsely chop remaining leaves
6. In a 6 to 8 quart pan over medium high heat , stir oil , garlic and capers until garlic is slightly softened , about 2 minutes
7. Add chard stems
8. Stir until softened , about 2 minutes
9. Stir in chopped leaves , part at a time if pan if full , cover and cook until wilted , about 4 minutes
10. Mix in vinegar
11. Season to taste with salt and pepper
12. Garnish a serving dish with reserved chard leaves
13. Spoon greens along side

title: daikon radish stuffed flatbread mooli paratha
steps:
1. Make up the dough using the water discard any left over water
2. Leave the dough covered in a warm place to rest for half an hour
3. Add salt to the grated radish
4. After 15 mins squeeze out more water and discard this
5. Then to the dry grated radish add the rest of the filling mix
6. Now make small balls of the dough a little bigger than an egg
7. Flatten them out , dip in dry flour and roll them out using a rolling pin to a teacup saucer size
8. Make smaller balls of the filling mix about the size of an egg yolk and place each filling ball in the center of the dough soucer
9. Gather the rest of the dough around it so that the dough complety covers the filling
10. Dip it in dry flour and roll it out again theis time bigger than a saucer
11. Heat a tsp of oil in the frying pan
12. Add the bread and shallow fry on each side until brown spots appear

title: mini pecan muffins
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 350 degrees combine all ingredients except pecans using a mixer fold in chopped pecans
2. Pour mini muffin pan about 2 / 3 full sprinkle with more chopped pecans on top bake for 12-15 minutes

title: orange upside down oven biscuits
steps:
1. For the topping:
2. Combine ingredients in a saucepan and cook over medium heat until butter and sugar melt , about two minutes
3. Divide the topping among a standard muffin tin
4. Do not line the muffin tin with paper baking cups
5. For the biscuits:
6. Preheat the oven to 425 degrees
7. Sift the flour , salt and baking powder into a large bowl
8. Cut in the shortening with two knives or a pastry blender until it forms coarse , uneven crumbs
9. Add the milk
10. Mix well , but with a light touch
11. On a flour-dusted surface , roll the dough into a large rectangle
12. Spread with butter
13. Mix the sugar and cinnamon and sprinkle it over the dough
14. Roll as you would a jelly roll and slice into 12 biscuits
15. Place a single biscuit in each muffin cup
16. Bake until golden , about twenty minutes
17. Cool a couple of minutes , then invert cautiously onto a plate , taking care that the sticky topping doesnt burn you

title: sue s she crab soup
steps:
1. In a large pot , melt the butter over moderately low heat
2. Add the scallion and celery and cook , stirring occasionally , until the vegetables are soft , about 4 minutes
3. Sprinkle with flour , and cook roux for 2 minutes , until bubbly
4. Stir in the stock , milk , and cream
5. Bring to a simmer , stirring
6. Add the chopped egg yolks , crabmeat , salt pepper , paprika and old bay , and bring almost to a simmer
7. Ladle into bowls , sprinkle with chopped cooked bacon , and green onion slices

title: almond roca fruit pie  a k a  toffee crumb fruit pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Spoon fruit filling into unbaked pie shell
3. Mix sugar and flour together
4. Cut in butter using pastry blender
5. Add crushed toffee candy and mix in with fork
6. Sprinkle toffee candy mixture over fruit filling
7. Bake for approximately 30 minutes or until lightly browned
8. Cool
9. Serve with fresh whipped cream or ice cream

title: grandmother s chocolate peanut butter fudge
steps:
1. Combine first 5 ingredients , boil until soft ball stage
2. Remove from heat , then add butter and peanut butter
3. Stir around a few times and let cool slightly
4. Then add vanilla
5. Beat it and pour out onto buttered dish , or parchment covered dish
6. Cool , and cut into squares

title: bush pesto
steps:
1. Puree the nuts , parmesan and 1 / 4 cup of the oil in a blender
2. Add the remaining ingredients and blend to a chunky paste
3. Serve on bread sticks or wattle seed blinis

title: apple cranberry raspberry pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Roll out bottom crust and place in a pie plate
3. In a small bowl mix together first 5 ingredients
4. Place the fruit in a large mixing bowl
5. Add the dry ingredients and stir well
6. Dump the fruit mixture into the pie crust
7. Trim excess crust to edge of pie plate
8. Roll remaining cust , and place on top of pie
9. Trim top crust aproximately 2" larger around than the top edge of the pie plate
10. Tuck the edge of top crust between bottom crust and pie plate , leaving folded edge standing about 3 / 4" above edge of pie plate
11. Pinch standing edge of pie crust between two fingers with thumb , to form a crimp
12. Cut slits into top crust in a decorative design
13. Sprinkle the top of crust with sugar
14. Bake for 55 to 60 minutes

title: stroganoff  1953
steps:
1. Dust meat lightly with flour and season with salt and pepper
2. Heat 2 tablespoons butter in a skillet
3. Add meat and saute until browned , about 3 minutes
4. Heat remaining butter in a separate skillet
5. Add mushrooms and onions
6. Cook until lightly browned , 3-4 minutes
7. Add consomme , vinegar and sour cream
8. Bring to a boil , then immediately reduce heat to low
9. Add meat to mushroom mixture , cover , and simmer for 30 minutes , or until meat is tender

title: pumpkin peanut butter bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. In a mixing bowl , combine the sugar , pumpkin , eggs , oil , water and peanut butter
3. Beat well
4. Combine the flour , baking soda , salt , cinnamon and nutmeg
5. Gradually add to pumpkin mixture
6. Mix well
7. Pour into two greased 9x5x3-inch loaf pans
8. Bake for 60-70 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean
9. Cool for 10 minutes before removing from pans to wire racks

title: boiled eggs and potatoes in bechamel sauce
steps:
1. Boil the potatoes in their jacket for about 20 to 30 minutes until cooked
2. Drain the potatoes and leave them to cool a little before peeling them and slicing them to prepare the bechamel , melt butter in a large saucepan over medium-low heat
3. Pour the flour over the melted butter and mix well to form a soft dough
4. Maintaining a low heat , add progressively the milk to the dough , mixing well until all the milk is absorbed and continue pouring the milk until obtaining a sauce that is not not too thick
5. Season the bechamel with salt and nutmeg
6. Slice the boiled eggs and add them to the bechamel
7. Add the sliced potatoes to the bechamel sauce , mixing delicately so not to mash them
8. Serve at once

title: pumpkin chocolate chips cookies
steps:
1. In a bowl , combine flour , oats , soda , cinnamon and salt
2. Set aside
3. In a large bowl , combine softened butter
4. Gradually add sugars , beating until light and fluffy
5. Add egg and vanilla
6. Mix well
7. Alternate additions of dry ingredients and the pumpkin , mixing well after each addition
8. Stir in the chocolate chips
9. Dough will be stiff
10. For each cookie , drop 1 / 4 c of dough onto greased cookie sheet
11. Bake at 350f for 20-25 minutes , or until cookies are firm and lightly browned
12. Remove from cookie sheet and cool on rack

title: lebanese baba ghanoush
steps:
1. Grill the whole aubergines , turning them frequently until the skin blackens and blisters
2. Remove the peel , chop roughly and leave to drain in a colander
3. Squeeze as much liquid out of teh aubergines and place in a processor
4. Addd the garlic , tahini , ground almonds , lemon juice and cumin , season to taste and process to a smooth paste
5. Rough chop half of the mint leaves and stir into the dip
6. Spoon dip into a bowl and scatter remaining leaves and the olive oil on top
7. Serve with toasted pitta bread

title: chicken  pesto  and olive panini
steps:
1. On bottom of both bread pieces brush on olive oil
2. Spread one tablespoon of pesto on each piece of bread on the top side
3. So the bottom will have olive oil and the top will have pesto
4. On the the pesto side on one half of bread place spinach leaves
5. Repeat with other bread
6. On top of spinach place 1 / 4 of mozzarella
7. Repeat with other bread
8. Layer on chicken , olives , tomatoes and 1 / 4 of mozzarella
9. Repeat on other bread to make two complete sandwiches
10. Fold in half with the olive oil side on the outside
11. Grill on panini press or foreman grill
12. If you don't have these heat grill pan to medium heat
13. Wash two bricks and cover with foil
14. Place sandwiches side by side on grill pan
15. Place foil covered bricks on top
16. Cook on medium for 4-6 minutes
17. Turn over and replace bricks
18. Cook an additional 4-6 minutes until cheese is melted and bread is toasted brown

title: super easy salisbury steak
steps:
1. Place breadcrumbs in medium sized bowl and add milk
2. Allow to soak for 5 minutes
3. Add other ingredients except jar of gravy and mix thoroughly
4. Form into 6-8 patties
5. Place patties in pan and cook until brown , adding gravy mix
6. Simmer in gravy for 5 minutes

title: southwestern egg rolls
steps:
1. Combine beans with reserved juice , spinach , tomatoes , cilantro , onions , cumin , salt and pepper to taste in a large stainless or glass bowl
2. Refrigerate while the chicken is cooking
3. Either bake , broil or grill the chicken until almost done , still pink in the middle
4. Remove chicken from oven or grill , let cool slightly , shred with a sharp knife or by hand
5. Remove vegetable mixture from refrigerator , strain out any liquid , stir in the cheeses and shredded chicken
6. Following the directions included in the eggroll wrapper package , make individual rolls with the vegetable , cheese and chicken mixture
7. Place on baking sheet and put in freezer while oil to fry is heating
8. When oil has reached 375f , bring the eggrolls out and fry them 3 to 4 at a time , until crispy and golden brown
9. This will take about 5 minutes
10. When the rolls are done , they will float and there should be very little bubbling of the fat around them
11. They shouldn't spatter much , but be careful
12. Remove each batch of rolls to a cooling rack and place in a slow oven while cooking the remaining rolls
13. When all rolls are cooked , cut them in half , diagonally
14. Serve with whatever type of dipping sauce you prefer

title: coconut cupcakes
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 325 degrees
2. In the bowl of an electric mixer fitted with a paddle attachment , cream the butter and sugar until light and fluffy , about 5 minutes
3. With the mixer running on low , add the eggs one at a time , scraping down the bowl after each addition
4. Add the vanilla and almond extracts and mix well
5. In a separate bowl , sift together the flour , baking powder , baking soda , and salt
6. In three parts , alternately add the dry ingredients and the buttermilk to the batter , beginning and ending with the dry
7. Mix until just combined
8. Fold in 7 ounces of coconut
9. Line a muffin pan with paper liners
10. Fill each cup to the top with batter
11. Bake for 25 to 35 minutes , until the tops are brown and a toothpick comes out clean
12. Allow to cool in the pan for 15 minutes
13. Remove to a baking rack and cool completely
14. Frost with cream cheese icing and sprinkle with the remaining coconut
15. For the cream cheese icing
16. In the bowl of an electric mixer fitted with a paddle attachment , blend together the cream cheese , butter , and vanilla and almond extracts
17. Add the confectioners' sugar and mix until smooth

title: peanut honey balls
steps:
1. Reserve two tablespoons crushed cereal
2. Mix honey and peanut butter
3. Gradually add nonfat milk , mixing well
4. Spray hands with non-stick cooking spray and shape into 1 / 2 inch balls
5. Roll ball in reserved cereal
6. Chill until firm , about 1 hour
7. Store in refrigerator

title: stir fried rice with pork
steps:
1. Saute onions , celery and pork in oil until vegetables are tender crisp
2. Add rice and water chestnuts
3. Combine pepper , salt , egg and soy sauce
4. Stir into rice mixture
5. Cook , stirring 2-3 minutes or until heated

title: greek  pasta  with  white  beans  and  spinach
steps:
1. Cook the pasta in a large pot of boiling salted water as directed on the box
2. Saute onion and garlic in olive oil in a large non-stick skillet until translucent
3. Add tomatoes , cooked beans , and seasonings to the skillet and bring to a boil over medium high heat
4. Reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes
5. Add spinach to the sauce and cook until spinach wilts , stirring constantly
6. Serve sauce over pasta and sprinkle with feta cheese
7. Calories 440 , carbohydrates , 76 g , fat 7 g , protein 16 g

title: salmon with maple syrup and toasted almonds
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425
2. Place fillets in a 13x9-inch baking dish coated with cooking spray
3. Combine sugar , syrup , soy sauce , mustard , and black pepper
4. Pour sugar mixture over fillets
5. Cover with foil
6. Bake at 425 for 10 minutes
7. Remove foil
8. Sprinkle fillets with almonds
9. Bake an additional 10 minutes or until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork
10. Serve with sugar mixture

title: cuban style pot roast  boliche
steps:
1. Place the onions and bell peppers in a bowl and add the black pepper , garlic , oregano and bay leaves
2. Let marinate for 30 minutes
3. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
4. Heat the oil in a large oven-proof cooking pot like a dutch oven
5. When the oil is hot , add the vegetable mixture from bowl and saute until soft
6. Add the roast and brown on all sides for 5 minutes , or so
7. Add the wine and vinegar and allow to reduce briefly
8. Add 2 cups of the broth and all the remaining ingredients
9. Bring to a boil , then place in the oven for 1 hour
10. Check at intervals , adding the remaining 2 cups of chicken broth , if needed
11. Remove the meat from the oven and let sit for 30 minutes
12. Strain the sauce
13. To serve: slice the meat about 3 / 4-inch thick and serve with the sauce

title: better than grannie s creamed corn
steps:
1. In a saucepan over medium heat , sweat the onion in butter and salt until translucent
2. In a large mixing bowl , place a paper bowl in the middle of the bowl
3. Resting the cob on the bowl in a vertical position remove only the tops of the kernel with a knife , using long smooth downward strokes and rotating the cob as you go
4. After the cob has been stripped , use the dull backside of your knife to scrape any remaining pulp and milk off the cob
5. Add the corn and pulp mixture to the saucepan and cook over medium high until the juice from the corn has tightened
6. Add the rosemary
7. Sprinkle the corn with the sugar and turmeric
8. Stir constantly for about 2 minutes
9. Sprinkle the cornmeal onto the corn , using a whisk to combine well
10. Add the heavy cream and cook until the corn has softened , about 2 to 3 minutes
11. Remove the rosemary
12. Season with freshly ground black pepper

title: slow cooker chicken korma
steps:
1. Preheat the slow cooker if necessary
2. Heat the oil in a skillet , add the chicken a few pieces at a time until they are all in the pan , then fry , stirring , until golden
3. Remove the chicken from the pan with a slotted spoon and put it in the slow cooker pot
4. Add the onions , chilies , ginger and curry paste to the pan and fry , stirring , for 2-3 minutes
5. Pour in the coconut cream or milk , stock , and ground almonds
6. Tear half the cilantro into pieces and add to the sauce with a little salt and pepper
7. Bring to a boil , stirring , then spoon over the chicken
8. Cover with a lid and cook on low for 6-8 hours
9. Stir the korma , then ladle it into bowls , top with spoonfuls of yogurt , the tomatoes and extra raw onion and the remaining cilantro torn into small pieces
10. Serve with warm chapattis

title: a berry good banana smoothie
steps:
1. Peel and slice the bananas
2. Wash and cut off the tops of the strawberries
3. Put into the blender with the milk and yogurt and whirl away
4. You can also do variations of this:
5. Apples: instead of yogurt and milk , add 1 / 2 cup apple juice , 1 cup crushed ice and 1 tablespoon honey
6. M&m powered: use only 1 / 2 cup milk and substitute 1 / 2 cup vanilla ice cream for the yogurt
7. Then add a handful of crushed ice and a small bag of m&ms -- yummy !

title: flavored marshmallow swizzle sticks
steps:
1. Stir together powdered sugar with water , a teaspoon at a time , until it is the consistency of a thin glaze
2. Dip half of marshmallow in glaze , lightly shaking to remove excess
3. Roll glazed end of marshmallows in finely crushed candy canes
4. Place on waxed paper coated side up to set
5. Thread on skewers and serve with drink of choice

title: cranberry apple dessert
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f in 13x9-inch pan , melt butter in oven
2. In medium bowl , stir bisquick mix , sugar and milk until smooth
3. Pour batter evenly over butter in pan
4. In small bowl , mix cranberry sauce and applesauce
5. Spoon evenly over batter
6. Place apple slices on sauce mixture
7. Bake 50 to 60 minutes or until golden brown
8. Serve warm with whipped cream

title: fresh texas salsa
steps:
1. Use a food chopper to chop everything up fine
2. Serve immediately or keep for a day in the refrigerator

title: fast veggie pizza
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Spread rolls on cookie sheet and seal edges , bake for 8-10 minutes
3. Let cool
4. Mix cream cheese , salad dressing , and ranch
5. Spread on crust
6. Add chopped veggies and top with cheese
7. Cut into squares and enjoy !

title: joy s chicken pot pies
steps:
1. Place 2 pie crusts in oven on 350 degrees for about 7-8 minutes
2. These will be the bottom of your pot pies
3. Meanwhile , in a skillet , saute onion and celery in heated margarine until tender
4. Add all other ingredients and mix well
5. Remove bottom pie crusts from oven and put half of mixture into each crust
6. Place one of the uncooked crusts upside down on top of each mixture
7. Gently remove aluminum pan from each
8. Press edges of top and bottom crusts to seal
9. Cut a few small slits into top of each pie crust
10. Put both pies in oven and bake for 30 minutes at 400 degrees or until crust is browned
11. Hint: if you want to use fresh carrots and peas , you'll want to saute them in step 2 with the onions and celery to tenderize

title: chicken breasts with rosemary
steps:
1. Pat chicken dry and season lightly with salt& pepper
2. Dip chicken in flour and shake of excess
3. Heat butter and cook chicken 4-6 minutes per side or until no longer pink in the center and lightly browned
4. Remove from pan
5. Discard any fat from the pan
6. Return pan to heat
7. Add chicken stock and rosemary
8. Cook 2 minutes
9. Add cream and mustard
10. Bring to a boil
11. Cook 4-5 minutes until slightly thickened
12. Season to taste with salt and pepper
13. Return chicken to pan
14. Coat with sauce and heat thoroughly

title: melting chocolate puddings
steps:
1. Pre-heat the oven to gas mark 6 / 200f / 400f
2. Melt the chocolate , butter and brandy over simmering water in a heatproof bowl , stirring well
3. While the chocolate is melting , whisk the sugar , eggs , egg yolks and vanilla until the mixture doubles in volume and ribbons
4. Pour the melted chocolate around the edges of your sugar and egg mixture and sift the flour over the top
5. Fold together carefully with a metal spoon
6. Be patient and be careful - it may take time but it's important you do it right
7. Put the mixture in well greased ramekins and either --
8. -- cook straight away in the oven for 12 minutes
9. -- refrigerate and cook later from chilled for 14 minutes
10. -- freeze and cook when ready from frozen for 15 minutes
11. Leave to stand for a couple of minutes
12. The puddings should be firm to touch but will be fantastic and gooey on the inside ! mmmmmmmm !

title: tasty tortilla crisps
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Cut each tortilla into 6 wedges
3. Place on a lightly greased baking sheet- use two if necessary to keep wedges in one layer
4. With a pastry brush , lightly brush the tortillas with the olive oil
5. Bake at 350f for 10 minutes or until lightly colored
6. Sprinkle on the cheese and serve

title: cuban pork tenderloin
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients in large resealable plastic bag
2. Add pork to marinade
3. Close bag and turn pork to coat
4. Refrigerate overnight , turning pork once
5. Preheat grill or oven to 400f
6. Transfer pork to baking pan or grill discarding the marinade
7. Roast until thermometer inserted into center of pork registers 150f
8. Let pork stand 5 minutes then cut crosswise into 1 / 2-inch-thick slices

title: kaffi
steps:
1. A typical luxembourger will have his after-dinner coffee accompanied by a measure of "mirabelle" or "quetsch" either in a separate glass , or poured into the coffee
2. A 'measure' is equivalent to a 'jigger' which is 1
3. 5 fl
4. Oz
5. Enjoy !

title: gail s peach muffins supreme
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. In a small bowl , combine topping ingredients and set aside
3. In a large bowl , combine flour , baking powder and salt
4. In a separate bowl or shaker container , combine the beaten egg with the sugar , butter and milk
5. Add to dry ingredients
6. Toss the peaches with brown sugar and cinnamon
7. Gently add to batter
8. Fill paper lined muffin tins 3 / 4's full
9. Sprinkle with topping mix
10. Bake for 20 - 25 minutes

title: mexican hot chocolate balls
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325f
2. Beat butter in a large mixing bowl using an electric mixer for 30 seconds
3. Add in 1 / 2 cup of the powdered sugar , 1 / 4 cup of the cocoa powder , and the vanilla and mix until combined , scraping the sides of the bowl occasionally
4. Add in as much flour as you can while using the mixer
5. Stir in any remaining flour , 1 / 2 teaspoon of the cinnamon and the pecans
6. Shape dough into 1 inch balls and place 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheets
7. Bake 18-20 minutes or until lightly browned
8. Allow to cool completely
9. Combine the remaining 3 / 4 cup powdered sugar , 1 / 4 cup cocoa powder and 1 / 2 tsp cinnamon in a small bowl
10. Roll the cooled cookies in this mixture
11. Store in layers separated by waxed paper in an airtight container
12. Cookies can also be frozen for up to 3 months , thaw before serving

title: grilled salmon kyoto
steps:
1. N a shallow glass baking dish , combine soy sauce , orange juice concentrate , oil , tomato sauce , lemon juice , mustard , green onion , garlic , and ginger
2. Place salmon in marinade , and turn to coat
3. Cover , and refrigerate for 30 minutes to 1 hour
4. Preheat an outdoor grill for high heat
5. Remove salmon from marinade
6. Pour marinade into a small saucepan
7. Bring to a boil , and cook for 1 minute
8. Lightly oil the grill grate
9. Brush or spray salmon with olive oil
10. Cook on grill for 5 to 10 minutes , or until fish flakes easily with a fork
11. Turn salmon once , and brush with boiled marinade halfway through cooking time

title: hot and spicy pork ribs
steps:
1. Slice ribs into individual pieces , trimming excess fat
2. Boil until cooked , drain
3. Combine ingredients and mix well
4. Marinate for 2-24 hours
5. Grill for best results
6. Brush on any remaining sauce while grilling or discard
7. Served with white rice

title: fall off the bone baby back ribs
steps:
1. Remove membrane from back of ribs
2. This is a must ! if you don't remove the membrane , don't bother making the recipe
3. Apply rub to both sides of the ribs
4. The measurements given in the ingredient list are approximate -- go with amounts you prefer and add / remove any rub ingredients to fit your taste
5. Lay a bay leaf on top of each rack of ribs
6. Wrap the ribs in aluminum foil -- wrap them very well , either all in one big piece of aluminum foil , or individually wrapped
7. Put in a large roasting pan
8. You can put them directly on the oven rack , but i use a roasting pan in case juices escape
9. Bake at 200f for 6-8 hours
10. Remove ribs from oven and unwrap
11. Generously apply hot sauce to ribs
12. Brush on barbecue sauce , then grill until nicely browned

title: cherry vanilla protein oatmeal
steps:
1. Put water , oats , salt and cherries into a medium sized saucepan
2. Bring to a boil , reduce the heat and simmer for about 5 minutes for old fashioned oats , or 1 minute for quick cooking oats
3. Remove from heat
4. Stir in the vanilla extract , protein powder and cherry jam
5. Put into serving bowls and pour 2 tablespoons of milk over each bowl

title: malai mixed vegetable curry
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a pot
2. Add the red chillies , cloves , cardamom , cinnamon stickand the bay leaves
3. Cook till the bay leaves turn golden brown
4. Add the onion and cook for 2 mins , reduce heat and add the garlic and ginger , fry for 4 minutes
5. Add all of the vegetables , sprinkle with the chilli powder , add the corriander powder , cummin powder and turmeric
6. Stir well to incorporate the spices
7. Add 1 / 2 cup of water , mix cover pot and cook for 15 mins , do not let the pot dry out
8. Add water if the pot becomes too dry
9. Add the tomato paste and salt
10. Reduce heat to low and cook covered till veg is tender
11. Stir in the cream and garam masala
12. Recover the pot and remove from the heat , allow to stand for 2 mins before serving
13. Garnish with the fresh chopped coriander
14. Serve with plain boiled rice

title: grilled zucchini and red onion with lemon basil vinaigrette
steps:
1. Putonion rounds , from side to side , onto 2 metal skewers
2. Brush onion and zucchini evenly with cup olive oil and season with 2 teaspoons kosher salt and pepper to taste
3. Whisk remaining 2 tablespoons olive oil , garlic , lemon zest and juice , mustard , and teaspoon kosher salt together in small bowl
4. Set aside
5. Grill vegetables over medium heat , turning once , until tender and caramelized , 18 to 22 minutes
6. Transfer vegetables to platter
7. Remove skewers from onion and discard any charred outer rings
8. Rewhisk vinaigrette and pour over vegetables
9. Sprinkle with basil and serve

title: banana and coconut tart
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Put pastry case in a greased pie dish , or use puff pastry to line a pie dish
3. Cook blind for 15 minutes
4. Beat eggs , add coconut and sugar
5. Bring milk to boil and add little by little to mixture
6. Bring whole mixture to boil to thin
7. Remove from heat , add rum
8. Pour mixture over pastry , chop banana and arrange on top to decorate
9. Cook for 10 minutes in oven
10. Sprinkle with icing sugar and serve
11. Advice :
12. Try pouring a second shot of rum over the pie while hot , then flambing at the table - be careful of your guests !

title: gluten free raspberry coconut   yoghurt muffins
steps:
1. 1
2. Prepare muffin pan with cooking spray , or with paper baking cups
3. Preheat oven to 180 celsius
4. 2
5. Combine dry ingredients in a large bowl , and set aside
6. 3
7. In a medium bowl , combine yogurt , oil , egg , and vanilla
8. 4
9. Gently stir yogurt mixture into flour mixture until dry ingredients are moistened , but batter is still lumpy
10. 5
11. Gently fold in raspberries
12. 6
13. Fill muffin cups almost to top
14. Bake 18 to 20 minutes , or until golden brown

title: chocolate cuppies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Spray 4 muffin cups with non-stick cooking spray
3. In a small bowl , mix together all ingredients until well combined
4. Fill muffin cups 3 / 4 full
5. Bake for 15 minutes , or until set

title: fresh cilantro bean salsa
steps:
1. Mix everything together gently in a fair-sized bowl , but do not overmix or it will turn "murky" looking
2. Serve immediately , it does not store well
3. Serve with a spoon and scoop chips
4. I am still playing with this recipe to get it the way i like
5. It definitely helps to have a ripe avocado !

title: apricot  banana and buttermilk bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180c
2. Line a loaf pan with non-stick baking paper
3. Sift flours , baking powder , bicarbonate of soda , salt and cinnamon into a large bowl
4. Stir in sugar and dried apricots
5. Combine buttermilk , vanilla , eggs and mashed banana in a large jug
6. Whisk until well combined
7. Make a well in the centre of dry ingredients
8. Using a metal spoon , gently fold egg mixture into dry ingredients until well combined
9. Spoon mixture into prepared pan
10. Bake for 50-55 minutes or until a skewer inserted in the centre comes out clean
11. Cool in pan for 10 minutes then turn onto a wire rack to cool completely
12. Slice and serve

title: chicken and bacon pan fried sandwich
steps:
1. Place the bacon under a preheated hot grill and cook for 1-2 minutes or until crispy
2. Place the maonnaise , garlic , lemon juice , chives and chicken in a bowl and mix well to combine
3. Spread both sides of the bread with butter
4. Divide cheese and chicken mixture between 4 slices of bread and sandwich with another slice of bread
5. Heat a large non-stick frying pan over low heat and cook the sandwiches in batches in necessary for 3-4 minutes each side or until golden the cheese is melted

title: saucy garden patch vegetables
steps:
1. Microwave directions:
2. Combine soup , sour cream and milk in large bowl
3. Stir in vegetables , cheese and 2 / 3 cup french fried onions
4. In a 2 quart microwave safe oblong baking dish , spoon in vegetable mixture
5. Loosely cover with paper towels or paper plate
6. Microwave on high for 10 minutes or until vegetables are tender and mixture is heated through , stirring halfway through cooking time
7. Remove cover and spinklw with remaining 2 / 3 cup french fried onions
8. Microwave on high for 1 minute or until onions are gold in color
9. Oven directions:
10. Prepare vegetable mixture as above
11. Bake in a 400 degree oven for 45 minutes or until tender and mixture is heated through
12. Stir
13. Sprinkle with remaining onions
14. Continue to bake uncovered for 1 minute until french fried onions are golden brown

title: bread machine whole grain bread
steps: 1. Put ingredients into bread machine in order listed and select desired time and crust

title: piedmont roasted bell peppers
steps:
1. Cut the peppers in half and remove seeds and ribs , but leave the stalks intact for presentation purposes
2. Place the peppers in a lighly oiled roasting pan
3. Cut the peeled tomatoes in quarters and place in peppers
4. Divide the anchovies among the 4 peppers
5. Thinly slice garlic and divide between the peppers
6. Drizzle the olive oil onto each pepper
7. Season with freshly ground pepper
8. Roast peppers on the highest shelf of a 350 degree oven for 50 minutes to 1 hour

title: chocolate rum sauce
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan , combine sugar and margarine
2. Cook over medium heat until sugar has dissolved , about 5 minutes , stirring occasionally
3. Remove from heat
4. Stir in remaining ingredients

title: sourdough buckwheat waffles
steps:
1. Mix wet ingredients
2. Add sifted dry ingredients and mix well cook according to your waffle makers instructions do not overfill the waffle iron
3. Be sure to cook until all the steam escapes from the waffles before peeking
4. Serve with honey or maple syrup

title: green beans with bacon and blue cheese
steps:
1. In a large casserole , place green beans and margarine
2. Microwave greenbeans to desired doneness
3. Just before serving , top with bacon and blue cheese
4. Toss to mix
5. Do not add blue cheese too far ahead of time
6. If you have to reheat , it melts and turns into an un-appetizing mess !

title: healthy mango chicken
steps:
1. Dice the raw chicken , spray the pan with pam and cook until tender , remove from heat
2. Dice in big chunks the onion , mushrooms , and peppers and toss in the wok or large frying pan on medium high heat until cooked
3. In a separate saucepan , crush garlic and add sliced mangoes , lime juice , fish sauce , soy sauce , chili flakes and brown sugar
4. Simmer and stir on low heat until flavors meld
5. Serve all over brown rice

title: greek style zucchini croquettes
steps:
1. Combine zucchini and onions in a colander and sprinkle with salt
2. Let sit for 20 minutes and then squeeze out all the water
3. Add dill , mint , egg , cheese , bread crumbs and butter , and combine well
4. Fashion mixture into tablespoon-sized balls and fry- 6 at a time- in 5 1 / 2 inches olive oil , heated to a temperature of 325 degrees , for 2-3 minutes , or until light brown
5. Drain on paper towels and serve hot

title: bean nachos
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large heavy-based frying pan over medium-high heat
2. Add onion and cook , stirring , for 2 to 3 minutes or until onion is tender
3. Add red and green capsicum , corn kernels , tomatoes , beans and tabasco
