4. Season with salt and pepper
5. Bring to the boil
6. Reduce heat to medium and simmer for 20 to 25 minutes , or until vegetables are tender and beans are heated through
7. Preheat oven to 200c
8. Arrange corn chips on heatproof serving plates
9. Sprinkle with half of the cheese
10. Spoon over bean mixture
11. Sprinkle with remaining cheese
12. Bake for 10 minutes or until corn chips are crisp and cheese is melted

title: easy 4 ingredient blondies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Set aside 13x9 pan
3. Blend cake mix , eggs and melted butter with electric mixer on low speed until the ingredients are moistened
4. Scrape down sides and stir in chocolate chips , stirring until well incorporated
5. Mixture will be very thick
6. Scrape mixture into 13x9 pan
7. Using fork or finger
8. Bake until golden brown and a toothpick inserted in the center comes out with a few crumbs attached
9. Bake 20-25 minutes
10. Cool on wire rack for 30 minutes before cutting into squares

title: garlicky tofu with spinach over pasta
steps:
1. Cook linguine according to package directions
2. Drain
3. Warm pasta sauce in pot over medium-low heat
4. Coat nonstick skillet with cooking spray , and place over medium heat
5. Add tofu , and cook 5 minutes , or until crisp and browned , turning often
6. Stir in garlic , and cook 1 minute more , or until tofu is coated with browned garlic
7. Transfer to plate , and cover to keep warm
8. Add spinach to same skillet
9. Cover , and cook 2 minutes , or until tender
10. Divide cooked pasta among 4 individual plates
11. Top each with equal amounts of spinach then garlic tofu
12. Spoon sauce on top , and serve

title: famous banana bread
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees f
2. Line the bottom of a loaf pan with parchment paper
3. Sift together the flour , baking soda , cinnamon and salt
4. Beat sugar and eggs with a whisk until light and fluffy , about 10 minutes
5. Drizzle in oil
6. Add mashed bananas , creme fraiche , and vanilla
7. Fold in dry ingredients and nuts
8. Pour into a lined loaf pan and bake for about 45 minutes to 1 hour

title: trinidad black cake  a hilarious  tasty  rummy  lump of a cake
steps:
1. Puree all prep ingredients in a food processor until you have a black / brown paste
2. You will have to do this in batches unless you want your machine to die a horrible death
3. Put it all into a large bowl and --
4. This is the point at which you will start laughing at how crazy this recipe is
5. Just wait --
6. -- stir the rum into your paste , inhale , pass out -- come to and cover the bowl and let it mature for a long time on the counter
7. Weeks
8. As long as you can
9. I let mine sit at least a month
10. If the paste gets dry- add more rum
11. It should always be moist and heady with the scent of jamaican paradise
12. I usually do this in october
13. The day before you are ready to bake the cake , cook the caramel sugar
14. To make the caramel sugar: boil together the dark brown sugar and water until it is reduced to 1 3 / 4 cups
15. It should simmer on med-low for about 15 minutes
16. Set aside overnight to cool
17. It may solidify , if so , just microwave it for 2 minute when ready to use
18. Baking day :
19. Preheat oven to 250f yes- 250 degrees
20. Find your most humongous bowl and go buy one twice as large for mixing together everything , set aside
21. Bring fruit from its resting place
22. Stir in the lime peel , vanilla , and caramel
23. Set aside
24. Sift together the flour , baking powder and cloves in a big bowl
25. Set aside
26. Cream together the butter and dark sugar in the humongous bowl you bought
27. Add the eggs one at a time until well blended
28. Stir in the dry ingredients until blended
29. Stir in the fruit mixture
30. Pour into greased , parchment lined , mini loaf pans , filling each pan 2 / 3 full
31. You will need 10 pans
32. The mini loaves are best for this cake is potent
33. Tiny , tiny , tiny slices are best
34. Bake 2 1 / 2 hours
35. Checking for doneness after 2 hours
36. When the cakes are done let cool on the counter completely
37. Drizzle with yet more rum , wrap in foil and let sit for at least a week more
38. Drizzling with rum everyday -- yummm

title: sicilian style sardine pasta with breadcrumbs
steps:
1. In a large skillet preheated over medium heat , add 1 / 4 cup extra-virgin olive oil , and chopped garlic
2. When the garlic begins to sizzle in oil add bread crumbs
3. Stir bread crumbs until deeply golden in color
4. Add parsley and a liberal amount of salt and pepper , about 1 teaspoon of each
5. Transfer bread crumbs to a dish and reserve
6. Return skillet to heat and 3 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil
7. Add sardine and red pepper flakes to pan and saute over medium heat 2-3 minutes
8. Add hot , cooked pasta to the skillet and toss with sardines
9. Add bread crumbs to the pot and toss thoroughly to combine and evenly distribute the mixture
10. Taste , to adjust seasonings , and serve

title: spinach swiss pie
steps:
1. Cook spinach according to package directions
2. Drain well
3. In a bowl , combine cheese , onion and spinach
4. Transfer to a greased 9 inch pie plate
5. In a blender , combine milk , eggs , biscuit mix , salt , pepper and nutmeg
6. Cover and process until smooth
7. Pour over spinach mixture
8. Bake at 350 f for 45-50 minutes or until a knife inserted near the center comes out clean

title: senor pico s picante sauce
steps:
1. Saute onion , garlic , and hot peppers in oil until the onion is trasparent , but not browned
2. Add tomato paste and chopped tomatoes
3. Simmer about 2 minutes
4. Add broth , sugar , salt and vinegar
5. Simmer until the tomatoes are cooked , then puree in a blender
6. Re-heat and thicken lightly with flour mixed with 1-2 tablespoons cold water
7. Cook , stirring , until sauce comes to a boil
8. Remove from heat
9. Top rellenos with sauce

title: tomato mac and cheese
steps:
1. Boil macaroni according to pkg directions
2. While that is cooking , heat bacon grease in small saucepan
3. Add tomato sauce , garlic powder and salt
4. Bring to boil , then simmer till heated through well
5. Put macaroni in large bowl and add cheese
6. Pour hot tomato sauce over cheese and macaroni and mix very well till cheese is all melted

title: muffin tin crab cakes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees
2. Generously coat a 12-cup nonstick muffin pan with cooking spray
3. Mix crabmeat , breadcrumbs , bell pepper , scallions , mayonnaise , eggs , egg white , hot sauce , celery salt , and pepper in a bowl until well combined
4. Divide mixture evenly among the 12 muffin cups
5. Bake until crispy and cooked through , 20 to 25 minutes , serve with lemon wedges

title: almost cherry garcia cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Line two baking sheets with parchment paper
3. Plump the dried cherries by soaking them in boiling water to cover for a couple of minutes
4. Drain well and toss with cherry brandy
5. Let the cherries sit in the brandy for a couple of hours , or even overnight for the best flavor , then drain before using
6. Cream the butter with both sugars
7. Blend in the egg , vanilla and almond extracts
8. Fold in the salt , baking soda and flour
9. Fold in the cherries , white and dark chocolate and , if using , the macadamia nuts
10. Batter should be soft
11. Drop in generous tablespoons onto the baking sheets , leaving space between dollops of batter
12. Bake until lightly browned around the edges , 12-14 minutes
13. Cool on racks

title: herb scented blueberry s mores
steps:
1. Stir together blueberries , sugar , wine , stock , lemon juice and herbs in a medium saucepan
2. Bring to a boil
3. Reduce heat to medium-high
4. Cook , stirring frequently , for about 40 minutes or until mixture is thickened and reduced to a jam-like consistency
5. Let cool , then remove herb stems
6. Place mozzarella balls onto skewers and toast over an open flame , turning skewers to evenly melt cheese
7. Top grilled baguette slices with a little of the sun-dried tomatoes , a spoonful of blueberry mixture , then a melted cheese ball

title: 7 flavorful butter twists
steps:
1. In a food processor , blend room-temperature salted butter with any of the flavor combos listed under the above options
2. Serve immediately or chill till ready to use
3. Best served at room temperature

title: scalloped potatoes and ham with cheese
steps:
1. Peel potatoes , i usually use about 6 for a 2 quart baking dish
2. Slice the ham
3. Make basic white sauce:melt butter or margarine
4. Add flour and mix
5. Add chopped onions
6. Add milk and stir until mixture thickens
7. Add cheese to white sauce and stir until melted
8. In the meantime , slice potatoes
9. Place one layer of potatoes in a 2 quart baking dish
10. Top with ham slices
11. Add another layer of potatoes , another layer of ham slices and so on
12. Pour the cheese sauce over all
13. Cover and bake at 350 degrees fahrenheit for one hour
14. Remove the cover and bake another 1 / 2 hour until cheese bubbles and top browns

title: thai curried game hens
steps:
1. Heat 1 t oil in heavy medium saucepan over medium heat
2. Add curry paste and tomato paste and stir until fragrant , about 3 minutes
3. Add coconut milk , broth , mushrooms , kaffir limes leaves , fish sauce , and brown sugar
4. Bring to simmer
5. Remove from heat
6. Add cherry tomatoes
7. Season sauce with salt and pepper
8. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
9. Heat 2 t oil in large nonstick skiller over high heat
10. Sprinkle hens with salt and pepper
11. Add hens to skiller and cook until browned , about 4 minutes per side
12. Transfer hens to 13x9 inch pyrex
13. Pour sauce over
14. Bake uncovered until hens are cooked through , about 35 minute transfer hens to shallow serving bowl
15. Tent with foil
16. Skim fat from sauce
17. Pour sauce over hens
18. Garnich with basil and chilies , if desired

title: creamy fried onion mashed potatoes
steps:
1. Do this firstly or while potatoes are boiling , in a skillet fry the onions in butter until golden brown
2. Boil the russets in a large pot of boiling water until fork-tender
3. Drain and transfer the cooked potatoes to a large bowl
4. Mash the potatoes with the whipping cream and fryed onion / butter mixture until fluffy
5. If desired you can add in more whipping cream depending on the consistancy you desire
6. Season with salt and tons of black pepper

title: marinated octopus
steps:
1. Place octopus in a large pan with plenty of water and boil for 2 hours
2. Remove from heat
3. Wash and remove the skin
4. Cut in desired size pieces
5. In a bowl , combine all the ingredients , except the lemon juice , and add octopus
6. Mix well
7. Cover
8. And refrigerate for several hours or overnight
9. When ready to serve , stir in the lemon juice

title: blue blue mashed potatoes
steps:
1. Steam blue potatoes for 40 minutes , or until tender
2. Drain potatoes and place in large bowl
3. In a pan , bring cream and butter to a boil-- remove from heat immediately
4. Mash cooked potatoes in the large bowl
5. Fold cream and butter into potatoes with a rubber spatula
6. Season with salt and pepper
7. Fold in blue cheese and scallions

title: real   somali tea
steps:
1. Peel and crush about a thumb sized amount of fresh ginger
2. Crush cardemon and cloves
3. Add all ingredients to pot of water except milk
4. Boil for 30 mins or until spices permeate tea
5. Add milk to each serving cup to taste

title: chipotle ground beef tacos
steps:
1. Heat a large skillet to medium high
2. Brown the beef in the skillet for a minute , then add the garlic and onion
3. Once the meat is no longer pink , drain
4. Add the chili powder , chipotles , tomato sauce , and salt
5. Heat over medium until ready to serve on warm tortillas or taco shells with desired toppings

title: no ice cream nutella cones
steps:
1. Smear semi-sweet chocolate on the inside of the cones
2. Use a dowel or wooden skewer to help smear the chocolate on the inside
3. Place in cup of uncooked rice or lay on parchment paper to set
4. Swirl small amount of remaining semi-sweet chocolate into the melted white chocolate
5. Dip open tops into the swirled chocolate and immidiately place upright so it drizzles a little down the outside of the cone
6. Allow to set again , this time in the refridgerator until chocolate is hard and fully set
7. Meanwhile , mix banana with nutella
8. When cones are set , place half the banana / nutella evenly into bottom of each cone
9. Divide the whipped topping and to half , mix in the strawberries , the other half mix in the lemon juice
10. Place strawberry mixture over banana / nutella layer thats in the cone
11. Follow with remaining banana / nutella
12. Top with lemon whipped cream , sprinkle with chopped nuts and enjoy

title: baked shredded carrots
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine the carrots , onions , sugar , salt and celery salt
2. Transfer to an ungreased 1-1 / 2-qt
3. Baking dish and dot with butter
4. Cover and bake at 325 for 45-50 minutes or until carrots are crisp-tender

title: peanut molasses cookies
steps:
1. Cream the butter and sugar
2. Add egg while beating
3. Add peanut butter and molasse and beat well
4. Combine all remaining ingredients and add to the peanut butter mixture
5. Stir well
6. Drop the dough with a spoon on a ungreased baking sheet
7. Squeeze the dough with a floured bottom glass or with a fork
8. Bake in preheated oven of 375 f for 12 to 15 minutes

title: mike s favorite fudge brownies
steps:
1. Mix together all ingredients except frosting , until well mixed
2. Grease and flour a 13x9 baking pan and bake in a preheated 350 degree oven for 30-40 minutes
3. When cooled frost with cream cheese frosting
4. Makes about 12 to 16 brownies depending on how large you cut them

title: mom s mint stuffing for lamb
steps:
1. Cut bread into cubes and dry slowly in barely warm oven
2. Combine all ingredients , mix well , and let stand in refrigerator for a minimum of an hour to intergrate flavours
3. Use the mixture to stuff boned lamb shoulder or for chops , steaks etc
4. Bake the mixture in a covered casserole dish for one hour at 325 degrees and spoon 2 tablespoons of drippings from the lamb chops over the casserole to enhance the flavour

title: lentil soup with swiss chard
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in a 5 to 6 quart crockpot , stir , and cook for 4 hours on high or 6 to 8 hours on low
2. Lentils and other vegetables should be cooked but not overly soft
3. Remove bay leaves , stir and serve with fresh baked cornbread and jalapeno pepper sauce on the side

title: zesty stewed tomatoes
steps:
1. Cross cut tomatoes on top and bottom
2. In a large pot , boil for 3-5 minutes
3. Remove tomatoes and place in a colander
4. Cool tomatoes until they can be handled
5. Using your thumb and a small knife , peel and core tomatoes over colander
6. Add tomatoes and remaining ingredients to pot
7. Cook over medium heat for about 1 hour , stirring occasionally and breaking up tomatoes while stirring
8. Allow to cool to room temperature if you are going to store in freezer

title: rice and barley side
steps:
1. Brown rice , barley in butter until golden
2. Add green onions , consomme soup , water and mushrooms
3. Cook in covered dutch oven for 30 minutes
4. Fluff up and serve

title: bananas foster ice cream cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f spray two 8-inch round cake tins with cooking oil
2. Flour lightly
3. In a medium mixing bowl , mix together cake mix , water , 1 / 2 cup softened butter and eggs at low speed
4. Then beat at medium speed for 4 minutes
5. Pour batter evenly into pans and bake for 22-25 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into the center of each cake comes out clean
6. Cool in pan on wire rack for 30 minutes
7. Then place cakes in the freezer until ready to assemble
8. Toast chopped pecans on a baking sheet in the oven for 8-10 minutes or until fragrant and lightly browned
9. Set aside to cool
10. Pour caramel ice cream topping into a small bowl
11. Add 1 / 2 teaspoons cinnamon and whisk until fully incorporated
12. Set aside
13. Reserve remaining caramel sauce for drizzling the cake later
14. In a large skillet over medium-high heat , melt 2 tbs
15. Butter
16. Once the butter begins to bubble slightly , add sliced bananas
17. Saute for 2 minutes
18. Then add half of the caramel sauce mixture , stir until bubbling , remove from heat and set aside to cool for 15 minutes
19. Refrigerate until ready to place atop the cake
20. To assemble , place one cake layer onto a cake plate
21. Top with half the ice cream , making sure to leave at least 1 / 4 inch of space around the edge of the cake
22. Sprinkle with toasted pecans and drizzle with reserved caramel sauce
23. Return both ice-cream-topped cake and ice cream carton to freezer for 30 minutes
24. Then add second layer of cake , top with ice cream and sprinkle with pecans
25. To finish off , place bananas in a mound atop the cake
26. Drizzle around the edges of the cake with remaining caramel sauce and sprinkle with remaining pecans
27. Freeze for 2-4 hours or until ready to serve
28. If the cake is frozen-hard , allow to sit at room temperature for 5-8 minutes or until softened to your liking
29. Freeze any remaining cake

title: delicious gluten free trifle
steps:
1. Mix the jell-o pudding in a large bowl following the directions
2. After the pudding is chilled , add a layer of the pudding
3. Next , add a layer of cookies , chopped in quarters or eighths
4. Add kool whip to the top of the cookies
5. Repeat steps 2-4
6. Decorate the top with seasonal candies or other decorations of your choice
7. Let sit in the refrigerator for one hour
8. Enjoy !

title: bacon cheddar mashed potatoes
steps:
1. Place potatoes in a large saucepan and cover with water
2. Bring to a boil
3. Reduce heat
4. Cover and cook for 20 minutes or until tender
5. Drain
6. Add the milk , mayonnaise , chives , garlic powder and pepper
7. Mash potatoes
8. Stir in cheese and bacon

title: spicy chipotle turkey rollups
steps:
1. Combine neufchatel cheese , onion powder , garlic , tomato , chipotle , and adobo in a mini-food processor and pulse until smooth
2. Cut off stem and remove seeds from jalapeno and cut into 8 long thin strips
3. Spread each piece of turkey flat , and spread some of the cheese mixture on the turkey using a spatula
4. Place 1 strip of jalapeno at one end of the turkey slice and roll up
5. Repeat with remaining ingredients
6. Serve chilled

title: smokin  fire roasted red pepper soup
steps:
1. Roast bell peppers over a gas flame , tending carefully and turning to blacken all sides
2. When completely roasted , place in heatproof bowl , cover with plastic wrap and let sit for 10 minutes
3. Remove from bowl and remove skin , seeds and stems
4. In a large pot , heat olive oil over medium high heat
5. Add carrots , celery and red onion
6. Cook over medium high heat until vegetables are beginning to soften
7. Add roasted peppers , tomatoes , basil and balsamic vinegar
8. Stir well to combine
9. Cook until tomatoes are beginning to break down
10. Remove from heat and transfer to a food processor fitted with a metal blade
11. Process until mixture has reached a smooth consistency
12. Add heavy cream and mix until well combined
13. Serve warm

title: warm layered bean dip
steps:
1. In a bowl , mix beans , garlic , gr onions and salsa
2. Spread on bottom of greased casserole dish or serving dish
3. Season cooked hamb meat with chili powder and salsa to taste
4. Layer on top of beans
5. Sprinkle cheese next as a layer then hot sauce layer
6. Microwave until piping hot , making sure to cook evenly
7. Meanwhile , in a bowl mash avocadoes til chunky
8. Stir in cilantro , red onion , lime juice and salt
9. Spoon avocado mixture over hot dip mixture and spread sour cream on top
10. Sprinkle w / remaining green onions
11. Serve w / chips and hot sauce , if any left

title: egg in a glass
steps:
1. Pick a cup or a glass that you would not be afraid to heat slightly
2. Place it on the stove near the burner you are going to use for cooking the egg , not touching the burner , so it will heat slightly while the egg cooks
3. Put all ingredients except for the egg into the cup
4. Put the egg into a pan with cold water
5. Heat it to boiling , then lower heat to medium and simmer 3 minutes
6. Plunge the egg into cold water and peel it fast
7. Put the warm peeled egg into the cup and roll it around slightly in cheese , butter , herbs , and cayenne

title: can t stop eatin  poppy seed cake
steps:
1. Mix together all ingredients
2. Pour into well greased bundt pan
3. Bake at 350f for 45-50 minutes
4. Cool on wire rack 10 minutes
5. Remove from pan and sprinkle top with powdered sugar

title: italian marinated steak
steps:
1. Mix olive oil , vinegars , salt , garlic , pepper and rosemary
2. Pour over london broil and marinate 4 hours or overnight
3. Grill 15 minutes on each side , or until desired doneness

title: simple zucchini pasta  by mark bittman
steps:
1. Bring a large pot of water to a boil and salt it
2. Put olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat
3. Add zucchini , onion and thyme , and cook , stirring occasionally
4. Add salt and pepper and adjust heat so onion and zucchini release their liquid without browning
5. Cook for about 20 minutes , or until very tender
6. Add tomatoes and their liquid to zucchini and raise heat a bit so mixture bubbles
7. Cook pasta until it is nearly but not quite tender
8. If sauce threatens to dry out , add a little pasta cooking water
9. Drain pasta and finish cooking it in sauce
10. Serve , garnished with parsley or parmesan

title: quick chicken tortilla soup
steps:
1. Open the cans of corn , chicken broth , black beans , and salsa
2. Pour everything into a large saucepan or stock pot
3. Add chicken and rice and simmer over medium heat until chicken is heated through , about 5 minutes
4. Place 1 / 4 cup crushed tortilla chips per serving bowl , top with soup
5. Garnish with sour cream , cheese , avocado , black olives , and / or cilantro

title: wild and brown rice dressing with apples  pecans and cranberries
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , simmer the wild rice in 4 1 / 2 cups broth , salt to taste , until the grains start to break open
2. Drain off any liquid , return to the pot and stretch a clean kitchen towel beneath the lid and let sit 10 to 15 minutes
3. Meanwhile , in a smaller saucepan , simmer the brown rice , with 1 1 / 2 cups broth , salt , until tender and all the liquid has been absorbed , 35 to 40 minutes
4. Turn off heat and stretch a clean kitchen towel under the lid and let sit 10 to 15 minutes
5. In a large skillet , heat oil , over medium heat , and cook the onion , stirring often , until it begins to soften , about 3 minutes
6. Add celery and a generous pinch of salt , and continue cooking another 3 or 4 minutes
7. Stir in garlic , if using , and cook 30 seconds
8. Remove from heat and transfer to a large bowl
9. Add rices and toss well
10. Increase the heat in the skillet to medium high and add the butter
11. When the foaming subsides , add apple , stirring until they begin to caramelize , about 5 minutes
12. Remove from heat and add to the rice mixture
13. Add remaining ingredients , toss and season to taste with salt and pepper
14. Preheat oven to 325 degrees f
15. Grease a large baking dish with butter or oil
16. Transfer rice mixture to baking dish , cover with aluminum foil , and warm in oven for 20 to 30 minutes
17. The entire dish is better the second day , so you can make it a day ahead and heat the day you are serving it

title: chicken with creamy green onion sauce
steps:
1. Melt butter over med
2. High heat
3. Stir in flour and cook until bubbly
4. Reduce heat to medium
5. Stir in remaining ingredients except yogurt
6. Make sure you stir the green onions into the sauce at this point
7. The release of these flavors as it warms is what makes the sauce !
8. Continue cooking , stirring occasionally , until sauce thickens
9. Stir in yogurt and heat through
10. Serve over baked or sauteed chicken breast

title: everyday gourmet breakfast quesadilla
steps:
1. Saute pepper and onions in olive oil til softened
2. Scramble eggs in non-stick skillet
3. Add onions and peppers to scrambled eggs
4. Add cumin , salt , chile powder , cracked pepper and mix together
5. Warm tortillas in a large skillet , add filling onto tortilla
6. Cover with cheese blend
7. Place second tortilla over top and close press on high heat til cheese is melted through , approximately 2
8. 5 minutes
9. Serve topped with salsa or sour cream
10. More salt , cumin or other spices can be added to taste if you wish , and jalapenos are always an option !

title: ease chicken   cheese enchiladas
steps:
1. In a small bowl combine soup , milk& taco seasoning
2. Set aside
3. In medium bowl combine chicken , salsa , chillies and 2 tablespoons of the soup mixture
4. Spread about 1 / 3 cup of chicken mixture alonge one side of each tortilla
5. Roll and place seam side down in greased 3-quart oblong baking dish
6. Pour remaining soup mix over enchiladas
7. Sprinkle with cheese and cover wih foil
8. Bake at 375 deg f for 35 min
9. Until hot and bubbling

title: ribollita  tuscan minestrone
steps:
1. Heat the olive oil in a large pot and saut the onion and leek together over low heat until they begin to caramelize
2. Add the garlic and saut for 1 minute
3. Add all the remaining vegetables
4. Season to taste and stir to mix
5. Cover and cook for 20 minutes or until the vegetables have reduced in volume by half
6. Stir again and add broth
7. Bring to a boil and then lower the heat
8. Add the tomato paste and stir to dissolve
9. Cover and cook the soup for 1 hour
10. Add the beans
11. The next day , reheat soup gently and stir in the bread cubes until the bread has turned into a mush
12. If the soup is too thick , thin with more stock to suit your taste
13. Serve at table with freshly-cracked black pepper , grated parmesan cheese , and drizzle with extra virgin olive oil

title: couscous dried fruit and honey pudding
steps:
1. Combine the couscous , dried fruit and nuts
2. Set aside
3. Scald the milk
4. Stir in the honey and vanilla
5. Add the couscous mixture
6. Stir once
7. Cover and let stand until all the milk is absorbed , about 15 minutes
8. To serve , spoon into bowls
9. Combine the sugar and cinnamon in a separate bowl
10. Drizzle puddings with cream and sprinkle with cinnamon sugar

title: cheesy corn loaf
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Sprinkle 2 teaspoons cornmeal on the bottom and sides of a greased 8x4-inch loaf pan
3. Set aside
4. In a large bowl , combine remaining cornmeal , flour , sage , baking powder , salt , pepper , baking soda and cayenne if desired
5. In another bowl , beat the eggs , buttermilk and oil
6. Stir into dry ingredients until just moistened
7. Fold in cheese
8. Pour into prepared pan
9. Bake until a toothpick inserted near the center comes clean , about 40 to 50 minutes
10. Cool for 10 minutes before removing from pan to a wire rack
11. Store leftover bread in the refrigerator

title: creamless  cream of tomato soup
steps:
1. Heat 2 tablespoons oil in dutch oven over medium-high heat until shimmering
2. Add onion , garlic , red pepper flakes , and bay leaf
3. Cook , stirring frequently , until onion is translucent , 3 to 5 minutes
4. Stir in tomatoes and their juice
5. Using potato masher , mash until no pieces bigger than 2 inches remain
6. Stir in sugar and bread
7. Bring soup to boil
8. Reduce heat to medium and cook , stirring occasionally , until bread is completely saturated and starts to break down , about 5 minutes
9. Remove and discard bay leaf
10. Transfer half of soup to blender
11. Add 1 tablespoon oil and process until soup is smooth and creamy , 2 to 3 minutes
12. Transfer to large bowl and repeat with remaining soup and oil
13. Rinse out dutch oven and return soup to pot
14. Stir in chicken broth and brandy
15. Return soup to boil and season to taste with salt and pepper
16. Serve soup in individual bowls
17. Sprinkle each portion with pepper and chives and drizzle with olive oil

title: sultan of swing
steps:
1. Keep the grenadine and the noilly prat in the fridge
2. So they are already cold enough
3. Mix first four ingredients
4. Fill a martini glass with ice
5. Pour the mixture over the ice and garnish with lemon wedges
6. If you can't get it , use a very dry vermouth
7. Use a high quality pomegranate syrup , because it makes this cocktail

title: commissary blackberry cobbler
steps:
1. Place frozen blackberries in bottom of 9x13 baking dish
2. Sprinkle cake mix over blackberries
3. Cut butter into little 1 / 2 inch cubes and"dot" the butter over the cake mix
4. Bake at 350 for about 40 minutes until brown and bubbly
5. I serve this with vanilla ice cream

title: vegetarian pitas
steps:
1. Slit open the pitas
2. Spread the insides of each pocket with hummus
3. Stuff each pita with half of remaining ingredients
4. Enjoy !

title: quick chicken kebabs
steps:
1. Put chicken , onions , garlic , chillies , black pepper powder and salt in the blender and run the same till mixture is totally smooth
2. Add very little water if at all necessary
3. Transfer the mixture to the bowl
4. Add bread crumbs and the bread pieces
5. Mix them well using your hands
6. Heat the oil in a pan
7. Fill almost 5 1 / 2 inches for frying
8. Take out small scoops of mixture
9. Make small balls and flatten them a little before putting in the oil
10. Fry on medium heat on both the sides till well done
11. Serve hot with your favourite salsa , mint chutney or sauce

title: go go garlic bread
steps:
1. In a small mixing bowl , beat butter and mayonnaise until smooth
2. Beat in the parmesan cheese , garlic , oregano , basil and seasoned salt
3. Stir in monterey jack cheese
4. Spread over cut sides of bread
5. Place on an ungreased baking sheet
6. Bake at 350 degrees for 10-15 minutes or until cheese is melted
7. Slice and serve warm

title: spanish potato omelet  tortilla de patatas
steps:
1. Fry bacon in 10 inch skillet until crisp
2. Remove bacon , drain all but 4 tablespoons of fat from pan
3. Add potato and onion , cook and stir until the potatoes are tender and golden , about ten minutes
4. Whisk eggs with salt and pepper
5. Add the bacon back to the pan , add eggs
6. Cover with lid and cook on low until the eggs are set , perhaps 10 minutes more
7. Garnish with parsley
8. Cut into wedges and serve
9. Be sure not to overcook , it will get rubbery ! eggs cook themselves even after they are off the heat , as i'm sure you know

title: cheesy garlic scalloped potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
2. Grease a 1 1 / 2 quart or larger casserole dish with butter or nonstick spray
3. Layer half of the potato slices in the bottom of the casserole dish
4. Dot with half of the butter cut or pinched into small pieces
5. Arrange half of the garlic slices over the potatoes , then pour half of the heavy cream over
6. Sprinkle one cup of cheddar cheese over the layer , and season with salt and pepper
7. Repeat layering of potatoes , butter , garlic , cream and cheddar cheese , then top with the slices of provolone cheese
8. Season again with salt and pepper
9. Cover with foil that the underside has been sprayed with cooking spray
10. Bake for 1 hour in the preheated oven , then sprinkle the parmesan or romano cheese over the top
11. This will create a semi-hard cheese crust
12. Continue baking uncovered for another 30 minutes , or until potatoes are tender when tested with a fork

title: summer beans with marinated mozzarella and cherry tomatoes
steps:
1. In a medium-size bowl , toss the shallots with vinegar
2. Add cubed mozzarella , herbs and oil
3. Toss well to coat , season with salt and pepper and marinate for a few hours or overnight to let flavors blend
4. Bring a medium-size pot of water to a boil and add 1 / 2-teaspoon salt
5. Drop in the beans and cook until just tender , 1 to 2 minutes for small young beans and up to 6 minutes for larger beans
6. Drain
7. Toss the hot beans with the olive oil , shallots , tarragon , 1 / 2-teaspoon salt and pepper
8. The beans will soak up the flavors as they cool to room temperature
9. Toss in the cherry tomatoes
10. Season and drizzle with additional oil and vinegar if desired

title: new england shrimp chowder
steps:
1. Peel shrimp , and devein , if desired
2. Set aside
3. Cook onion , celery , bell pepper , and garlic in 1 tablespoons oil in large dutch oven , stirring often , about 8 minutes , or until garlic is tender
4. Add flour and cook , stirring constantly , 1 minute
5. Gradually stir in chicken broth and next 6 ingredients
6. Bring to a boil
7. Reduce heat , and simmer , stirring often , 20 minutes or until potatoes are tender
8. Stir in half and half , corn , and hot sauce
9. Return to a boil
10. Add peeled shrimp
11. Cook , stirring often , 5 minute , or until the shrimp turn pink
12. Remove and discard bay leaves

title: bow thai chicken
steps:
1. Cook pasta in large saucepan as directed on package
2. Drain
3. Return to saucepan and cover to keep warm
4. Meanwhile , in medium bowl , combine curry powder and soy sauce
5. Add chicken strips
6. Toss to coat
7. Heat oil in large skillet or wok over medium-high heat until hot
8. Add chicken
9. Cook and stir 4 to 5 minutes or until no longer pink in center
10. Add frozen sauce and vegetables from meal starter
11. Bring to a boil
12. Reduce heat
13. Cover and cook 6 to 9 minutes or until vegetables are crisp-tender , stirring frequently
14. Stir in lime juice and peanut butter
15. Add alfredo sauce to cooked pasta
16. Toss to coat
17. Spoon vegetable mixture over pasta mixture
18. Stir well
19. Spoon onto individual serving plates
20. Sprinkle coconut , onions , and peanuts from packet over each serving
21. Garnish each with lime wedge

title: granola blondies
steps:
1. In a large mixing bowl , beat the egg , egg white , brown sugar and oil until blended
2. Combine the flour , baking powder and salt
3. Gradually stir into sugar mixture just until blended
4. Stir in granola and cranberries
5. Spread into a 9-in
6. Square baking pan coated with cooking spray
7. Bake at 350 for 25-30 minutes or until golden brown and set
8. Cool on a wire rack
9. Cut into bars

title: yellow lemony cake
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients and beat for 2 minutes
2. Pour into greased and floured 9x13 baking pan
3. Bake at 350 for 50 minutes , or until pick comes out clean
4. Cool for 10 minutes

title: special scottish swede
steps:
1. Boil the swede until tender and drain
2. Meanwhile , fry the onion in the oil and after 2 minutes add the drippings and apples
3. Cook for 10 minutes over medium heat
4. Mash the swede and add to the pan
5. Season and stir well
6. Sprinkle a little grated nutmeg on top and serve
7. For the vegetarian option please use butter

title: beef stroganoff with cream cheese
steps:
1. Combine the meat , soups , onion , worcestershire sauce , garlic , water , bouillon , and pepper together in a crock pot
2. Cook on low for 8 hours
3. Just before serving , stir in the mushrooms , cream cheese , and sour cream
4. Serve over cooked , whole wheat egg noodles

title: sherried mushrooms
steps:
1. Coat a large nonstick frypan with cooking spray , place over medium high heat until hot
2. Add green onions , saute until tender
3. Stir in mushrooms and remaining ingredients , cover and cook over low heat 10 minutes or until mushrooms are tender

title: caponata   eggplant and lots of good things
steps:
1. In a large hot pan heat oil and stir fry eggplant till golden brown about 10 minutes add celery , onions , garlic , and tomatoes cook till tender about 5 minutes
2. Add remaining ingredients and simmer for 15 minutes
3. Stirring occasionally !
4. Jar or place in a sealed container and refrigerate over night
5. Serve cooled
6. Season with salt and pepper if needed

title: fried peanut butter and jelly sandwich
steps:
1. Make a traditional peanut butter and jelly sandwich
2. Spread butter on one side
3. Melt 1 teaspoon butter in small frying pan
4. Put unbuttered side in pan
5. Continue as if making a grilled cheese sandwich

title: strawberry mango smoothie
steps:
1. Place strawberries , mango , honey and lime juice into a blender
2. Cover and blend until smooth
3. Add ice 1 / 2 cup at a time and blend until smooth
4. Turn blender off between additions , scraping the sides of the blender pitcher with a rubber spatula to incorporate all the fruit and ice
5. If you wish , add more ice until desired texture is reached
6. Pour into tall glasses , insert a straw , sit back and enjoy !

title: ww tropical chicken with grilled sweet potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat grill
2. In a large bowl , whisk together lime juice , ginger , preserves , and soy sauce
3. Set aside 1 / 2 of the marinade
4. Add chicken to remaining marinade , cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour and up to 24 hours , turning chicken occasionally
5. Grill sweet potato slices until tender , about 8 minutes , brushing with reserve marinade as they cook
6. At the same time , grill chicken until firm and cooked through , about 4 to 5 minutes per side

title: chicken divan for two
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450f or grill to medium-high
2. Center one chicken breast half on each sheet of heavy duty foil
3. Combine rice , soup and water
4. Spoon over chicken
5. Arrange broccoli and mushrooms on top of chicken and rice mixture
6. Top with ice cubes
7. Bring up foil sides
8. Double fold top and ends to seal packet , leaving room for heat circulation inside
9. Repeat to make two packets
10. Bake 24 to 26 minutes on a cookie sheet in oven or grill 14 to 16 minutes in covered grill
11. Sprinkle with cheese before serving

title: sweet potatoes and cranberry saute
steps:
1. In a large skillet , heat apple juice
2. Add sweet potatoes , spreading in an even layer
3. Lower heat and cover
4. Cook for 10 minutes or until potatoes are nearly tender
5. Stir in apple , cranberries , maple syrup , rum and salt
6. Cover and cook 3-4 minutes longer or until apple is tender
7. Uncover
8. Boil gently until liquid is syrupy
9. Pour into a serving dish and sprinkle with pecans
10. Garnish and serve

title: hot spiced cider tea
steps:
1. Lightly crush the cinnamon , peppercorns , cloves , and cardamom pods in a mortar and pestle or on a cutting board with the bottom of a saucepan
2. Transfer the spices to a medium saucepan , add the ginger , star anise and citrus peels
3. Add the water
4. Bring to a boil , reduce the heat , and simmer , partially covered , until aromatic , and the cinnamon stick opens a little , about 10 minutes
5. Add the tea bags to the pan and immediately remove from the heat
6. Set aside to steep for 3 to 4 minutes
7. Remove the tea bags , and add the apple juice and orange juice
8. Return the pan to a medium heat and warm , taking care not to let the tea boil
9. Strain and serve hot

title: amys lasagna style casserole
steps:
1. Prepare spaghetti sauce in advance
2. Set aside to cool
3. I do mine the night before and place in the refrigerator to cool overnight
4. If using the recipe for my grandma's spaghetti sauce , see recipe below
5. Boil noodles al dente
6. Drain and give a quick rinse in cold water to stop the cooking
7. Stir the pasta into the spaghetti sauce
8. Set aside
9. In a separate bowl , combine egg , ricotta , mozzarella , romano , salt , pepper and parsley
10. In a foil-lined and greased 10x13-inch casserole pan , spread half of the pasta / meat mixture into the bottom of the pan
11. Layer cheese mixture over all
12. Top with remaining pasta / meat mixture
13. Sprinkle the reserved parmesan and mozzarella cheese over the top
14. Bake in a 375f oven for 50 minutes
15. Uncover and cook an additional 15-20 minutes , or until bubbly and nicely browned on top
16. Grandma shannon's spaghetti sauce:
17. Saute the onion , garlic and meat over medium-high heat
18. Add the remaining ingredients and let simmer for 1 hour or more
19. Serve over your favorite pasta
20. Serve with green salad , french / italian bread , and red wine

title: drew s famous onion dill bread
steps:
1. In the order listed , place dry ingredients and egg in the bread machine
2. Warm the next set of ingredients and add them
3. Select white bread setting on bread machine and press start
4. Brush top lightly with a little melted butter when machine enters bake cycle if you wish
5. If you don't have a bread machine you can knead by hand let rise and bake in 2 loaf pans

title: roast fillet of beef with mushroom tarragon sauce
steps:
1. Position rack in center of oven and preheat to 400f degrees
2. Heat oil in large skillet over high heat
3. Pat beef dry
4. Add to skillet and brown on all sides , turning frequently , about 7 minutes
5. Place rack in roasting pan
6. Transfer beef to rack
7. Roast about 25 minutes for rare , or longer , if desired
8. Pour oil from skillet
9. Add butter and melt over medium-low heat
10. Add shallots and saute 1 minute
11. Add mushrooms , tarragon and salt
12. Increase heat to medium , cover and cook until mushrooms release their juices , stirring once or twice , about 6 minutes
13. Add wine and bring to boil
14. Boil uncovered until almost no liquid remains , about 2 minutes
15. Mix in 1 cup stock
16. Stir cornstarch and remaining cup stock in small bowl
17. Add cornstarch to mushroom sauce and bring to boil
18. Stirring constantly
19. Boil until thickened , about 1 minute
20. Cut beef into inch slices
21. Overlap slices on plates
22. Spoon sauce over and serve
23. This is excellent served with scalloped potatoes with cream and broccoli with lemon-garlic crumbs

title: herb broiled tomatoes
steps:
1. Combine first 4 ingredients in a small bowl , add margarine , stirring well
2. Set aside
3. Cut tomatoes in half crosswise
4. Place tomato halves , cut side up on rack of broiler pan
5. Broil 7 inches from heat for 3 minutes
6. Sprinkle tomatoes with cereal mixture , broil 1 additional minute or until lightly browned
7. Place on a serving platter
8. Garnish with fresh parsley , if desired

title: beef stew or venison stew
steps:
1. Coat beef stew meat with flour
2. In a large skillet , melt shortening
3. Add the flour coated meat
4. Season with salt and pepper
5. When the meat is almost browned , add onions
6. Finish browning
7. Add the worcestershire sauce
8. Stir for another minute
9. Transfer to a 5 quart dutch oven , or a large soup kettle
10. Add the hot water , bouillon granules , thyme , bay leaf , lemon juice , and whole cloves
11. Bring to a boil
12. Cover , reduce heat to a simmer , and cook for 2 hours
13. Add the carrots , potatoes , green peppers , celery , mushrooms and tomatoes
14. Cover , and simmer 1-1 / 2 hours
15. Remove bay leaf and whole cloves at this point
16. Bring back to a boil
17. Combine the flour and cold water , and add this to the boiling stew
18. Stirring constantly
19. Finally add the kitchen bouquet
20. Mix through thoroughly
21. Serves 8 - 10
22. Also , if wanting to add peas to the stew , add the frozen peas within the last 20 minutes of cooking time

title: amish upside down ham loaf
steps:
1. Drain pineapple , reserve the juice
2. Preheat oven to 375
3. In a small bowl , mix together butter , brown sugar , and drained pineapple
4. Coat a 10x10" baking pan with vegetable spray , pour in the pineapple and pat it out smoothly on the bottom of the pan
5. In a large mixing bowl , beat the eggs with a fork
6. Stir in the ham , pineapple juice , bread crumbs , parsley , onions , mustard , ginger , curry powder and pepper
7. Mix well
8. Spread the ham mixture over the pineapple , patting it firmly over the pineapple
9. Bake for 45 minutes
10. Remove from the oven and allow to stand for 10 minutes
11. To serve , invert onto a serving platter
12. If any of the pineapple mixture remains in the bottom of pan , pat it on the loaf and serve immediately

title: beefy spanish rice
steps:
1. In a large saucepan over medium heat , heat the oil
2. Add the rice , onion and bell pepper and saute for 5 minutes , or until onions are tender
3. Add the ground beef and saute until browned
4. Drain excess oil and fat
5. Add the corn , tomato sauce , ketchup and water
6. Reduce heat to low , cover and simmer for 20 minutes or until rice is cooked , stirring occasionally
7. Season with salt , pepper and garlic powder to taste

title: vodka pasta
steps:
1. Melt butter in a medium skillet
2. Add pepper flakes---cook over med high heat 1 minute
3. Add garlic cook 1 min
4. Move off heat add vodka
5. Cook on high 2 minute
6. Add tomatoes cook 2 minute
7. Add cream & cream cheese , cook 2 minute
8. Adjust hot pepper or add salt if you think it's necessary
9. Drain cooked pasta , add to sauce , toss to mix , cook 1 minute covered , put into serving bowl , top with parmesean and chopped parsley
10. Serve with salad and crunchy italian bread

title: spicy   sweet popcorn
steps: 1. Combine all ingredients and pour over popcorn , toss to coat

title: farfalle with goat cheese and roasted peppers
steps:
1. Cook pasta in a large pot of boiling salted water until al dente
2. Crumble goat cheese into a large serving bowl
3. Add cherry tomatoes , roasted pepper , olive oil , garlic , salt and pepper
4. Drain pasta , and toss with goat cheese mixture
5. Enjoy !

title: bobby flay s rib rub
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a large bowl and mix well
2. Store in an airtight container
3. Pack on the dry rub onto your next rack of ribs

title: chicago style butter and garlic pizza crust
steps:
1. In large bowl , dissolve yeast in 1 / 4 cup lukewarm water
2. Add 1 / 4 cup flour and the sugar , stir together
3. Cover with plastic wrap and let rise in a warm place for 20 minutes
4. Stir the remaining 1 cup lukewarm water , 3 cups flour , the cornmeal and salt into the yeast mixture
5. Combine the butter and garlic
6. Mix into the dough
7. Turn out onto a lightly floured work surface and knead until soft and elastic , 10-12 minutes
8. Lightly grease a large bowl , add the dough and turn to coat
9. Cover and set in a warm place until the dough is doubled in size , 1 hour
10. Punch dough down , then knead for 2-3 minutes
11. Grease a 9x13-inch baking pan , then press in dough to cover the bottom and 2 inches up the sides
12. Let rise for 20 minutes
13. Preheat the oven to 500 degrees
14. Top the pizza dough with your favorite toppings
15. Lower the oven to 450 degrees and bake for 30 minutes

title: steamed new potatoes with lemon garlic sauce
steps:
1. Steam the halved potatoes
2. Meanwhile , in a medium bowl , blend the remaining ingredients with a whisk or a fork
3. Add the hot potatoes to the sauce and toss
4. Garnish with the parsley if desired

title: slow cooker chili
steps:
1. Cook ground beef in a skillet until browned
2. Drain off fat
3. Pour into a slow cooker
4. Add the next 9 ingredients
5. Cover and cook on low for 6-8 hours
6. Ladle chili into individual serving bowls
7. Sprinkle with cheddar cheese

title: sausage skillet dinner
steps:
1. Place onion , garlic , green pepper and celery into a pan
2. Saut for about 5 minutes
3. Add sausage and saut another 5 minutes
4. Add remaining ingredients except cheese
5. Cook over low heat , stirring frequently , until thoroughly heated
6. Sprinkle with cheese and cook just until cheese melts
7. Serve and enjoy !

title: fat free banana bran bread
steps:
1. Beat together banana , egg substitute , applesauce , bran cereal , and vanilla
2. Set aside
3. In another bowl , mix whole wheat flour , all purpose flour , baking powder , baking soda , salt , and sugar
4. Combine wet and dry ingredients , sitrring only until moistened
5. Spoon batter into greased loaf pan
6. Bake at 340 degrees for 50 minutes to 1 hour or until a toothpick comes out clean
7. Renmove from oven and cool in pan for 5 minutes
8. Remove from pan
9. Cool completely before slicing

title: chicken salad veronique with nectarines
steps:
1. Put the chicken breasts in a large saucepan and add water to cover
2. Season with 1 t salt
3. Bring just to a boil
4. Reduce heat and simmer 10 to 15 minutes or until cooked through
5. Remove chicken from water and cool
6. Dice and put in large bowl
7. While chicken is cooking , toast the almonds in a skillet set over medium heat
8. Time 5 minutes or just until the almonds are beginning to turn golden
9. Let cool and coarsely chop
10. Mix together mayonnaise , yogurt , 2 t lemon juice , salt and pepper to taste
11. Fold into the chicken , stir in the thyme , celery , green onions and grapes
12. Cover and refrigerate several hours to chill and blend flavors
13. Just before serving , dice the nectarine and toss with the other tablespoon of lemon juice
14. Fold the nectarine and almonds gently into the salad

title: barbecued baby back ribs
steps:
1. Trim the fat from the ribs
2. In a bowl , add the paprika , garlic salt , onion powder , dried sage , celery seeds , and cayenne pepper
3. Stir to combine
4. Sprinkle the rub mixture over both sides of the ribs
5. Rub in using your fingers
6. Prepare grill for indirect grilling
7. Medium heat
8. Place ribs with the bone side down on the grill rack over the drip pan
9. Cover and grill for 1 1 / 2 to 1 3 / 4 hours or until ribs are tender , brush occasionally with apple juice after the ribs have grilled for 45 minutes

title: lip smacking and finger sticking good drumsticks
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Heat a oven proof fry pan to medium high heat
3. Make a dredge with the red pepper flakes , flour , paprika , salt and pepper in a zip lock bag , add in the drumstick and toss to coat , set aside
4. Saute chopped onions in butter and olive oil in the fry pan until translucent , add in garlic and cook until tender
5. Remove the onion and garlic from the pan and set aside
6. Add the drumsticks and cook for 15 minutes turning the chicken often until nice and crispy
7. Meanwhile prepare the dipping sauce by mixing the sauce ingredients together , and place in the refrigerator to chill
8. Sprinkle 2 tbs tabasco sauce on top adding 1 / 4 cup dark corn syrup
9. Put pan in oven and continue to cook for 15 minutes turning drumsticks often
10. Sprinkle the rest of the tabasco sauce on top adding the remainder of the dark corn syrup
11. Cook for another 15 minutes while turning drumsticks often
12. Add back in the onion mixture
13. Simmer to caramelize the dish about 5-8 minutes
14. Sprinkle the slivered snow peas on top and serve with the dipping sauce

title: prawns in spiced coconut sauce
steps:
1. Remove shells from prawns , leaving tails and heads intact
2. Remove waste veins and slits prawns down the underside form the head to the tail
3. Chop onion finely and fry in oil until soft
4. Add lemongrass , sliced chilies and ginger and saute for 2min , then add soy sauce with combined evaporated milk and coconut essence
5. Add tomatoes to the pan with a little water
6. Cook on low heat until tomato soft and sauce well flavoured
7. Add prawns and simmer for about 5 minutes until tender
8. Season with pepper
9. Serve with steamed rice and green salad

title: buttermilk banana pancakes  healthy
steps:
1. Substitute first 7 ingredients with 1 cup of my reduced fat bisquick mix and set aside
2. Whisk all remaining ingredients together except banana until frothy
3. Add homemade bisquick mix and gently stir until well-blended , but still lumpy
4. Heat a skillet on medium-high setting for several minutes
5. Spray skillet with cooking spray
6. Drop 1 / 4 to 1 / 3 cup of batter onto skillet for each pancake
7. When batter begins to bubble , carefully drop about 4 or 5 banana slices onto each pancake
8. Carefully flip the pancakes and cook until lightly browned
9. Remove from pan
10. A great-tasting sugar free syrup that isnt runny !

title: pasta and potatoes  pasta e patate
steps:
1. Chop the bacon , carrot , celery , onion , and parsley together
2. Pour the oil into a large pan , add the chopped mixture and cook over medium low heat until the vegetables are tender and golden
3. Stir in the tomato paste and season with salt and pepper
4. Add the potatoes and water , bring to a simmer , and cook until the potatoes are very tender , about 30 minutes
5. Mash some of the potatoes with the back of a spoon
6. Add the pasta and boiling water
7. Cook , stirring often , until the pasta is tender
8. The mixture should remain quite thick , but add more water if it seems too thick
9. Stir in the cheese and serve

title: feta dip
steps:
1. In a large bowl , mix all ingredients
2. Serve with sesame crackers or melba toasts

title: bbq spoon burgers  crock pot
steps:
1. Brown ground beef in skillet , drain fat
2. Combine all ingredients in crock pot
3. Stirring well
4. Cook on low for 6-8 hours or on high for 3-4 hours
5. Serve over warm hamburger buns , noodles or rice

title: fast fiesta dip
steps:
1. In medium bowl , combine sour cream , salsa , and taco seasoning mix
2. Mix well
3. Serve with tortilla chips

title: garden quesadillas
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees f
2. Heat 1 tsp olive oil in a large non-stick frying pan
3. Saute the garlic until sizzling , then add the onion and cook for 2 minutes
4. Add the red and green peppers , mushrooms , jalapeno pepper
5. Cook until the veggies are tender but not overcooked
6. Approx 3-5 minutes
7. Stir in the black pepper , cumin , chili powder and cilantro until well blended
8. Spread 1 / 2 of one side of each tortilla with cream cheese
9. Top the cream cheese evenly with the cooked veggies staying about 1 / 2" away from the edge
10. Sprinkle the veggies evenly with the green onions and diced tomato
11. Fold the tortilla in half over the veggies , press gently around the edges to seal shut
12. Place tortillas on a non-stick baking pan and bake for 5 minutes or until tortillas are desired level of crispiness
13. Cut into wedges if serving as an appetizer
14. If desired serve with salsa and / or fat-free sour cream

title: cream of garlic  onion  and mushroom soup
steps:
1. Saute chopped mushrooms in olive oil over high heat for 2-3 minutes
2. Stir as little as possible so that they brown , not steam
3. Remove from pan and set aside
4. Melt butter over medium-low heat
5. Add onions and garlic
6. Cover and cook for about 10 minutes , stirring occasionally
7. Add the flour and cook , stirring , for 3 minutes
8. Add the broth , half and half , sherry , thyme , and bay leaf
9. Stir well and bring to a boil
10. Lower heat and cook uncovered for 15 minutes
11. Add the bread pieces , stir well , and simmer for another 5 minutes
12. Discard the bay leaf
13. Using an immersion blender , puree the soup until the bread has dissolved and the soup is smooth
14. Add the reserved mushrooms to the pureed soup and heat through
15. Add salt and pepper to taste

title: crock pot italian roast beef
steps:
1. Put all the ingredients in a crock pot on low overnight or on high for 5 hours
2. Shred meat with a fork
3. Put meat back in the crock pot and add the ketchup
4. Cook another 6-8 hours on low or 3 hours on high
5. Serve on the roll or bread of your choice

title: microwave poached eggs
steps:
1. Add the water and white vinegar to a 6 ounce custard cup
2. Break egg into cup , pierce egg yolk with toothpick , and cover dish loosely with plastic wrap
3. Place in microwave and cook for 1 minute or until desired doneness
4. You may need to experiment with cooking times based on the wattage of your microwave and taste preference
5. Immediately remove egg from hot water with a slotted spoon as it will continue to cook
6. Serve with salt and pepper to taste

title: cottage cheese with banana and blueberries
steps:
1. Slice banana
2. Top cheese with banana and berries
3. If using honey , either mix in with cheese first or drizzle on top

title: toasted almond berry bark
steps:
1. Line 8-inch baking pan with wax paper
2. Microwave chocolate in small , dry , uncovered , microwave-safe bowl on high power for 45 seconds
3. Stir
4. Pieces may retain some of their original shape
5. If necessary , microwave at additional 10- to 15-second intervals , stirring just until melted
6. Pour onto a cookie sheet
7. Sprinkle with almonds and fruit
8. Tap pan several times to spread chocolate and settle almonds and fruit
9. Refrigrate for about 1 hour or until firm
10. Break into pieces
11. Store in airtight container at room temperature
12. Enjoy !
13. Recipe makes 1 / 2 pound bark

title: tomato and feta relish
steps:
1. In a large bowl , stir together the crushed tomatoes , olive oil , garlic , salt , basil , chopped olives , onion , feta and red wine vinegar
2. Cover and refrigerate overnight to give the flavors time to marry
3. Stir again and taste , adjusting the seasonings and flavorings , if desired , before serving
4. Serve with sliced ciabatta bread
5. The recipe can be made using fresh tomatoes
6. Substitute a generous pound of plum tomatoes , peeled , seeded and crushed with juice

title: sweet tequila lime chicken
steps:
1. Combine first 7 ingredients in a small bowl
2. Coat a skillet with spray , and heat to medium high heat
3. Add chicken , cook for 4 minutes in each side until browned
4. Add mixture , bring to a boil
5. Cover , reduce heat , and simmer 8 minutes
6. Uncover , turn chicken , and simmer 2 minutes or until sauce is chickened
7. Serve

title: goat cheese cakes  to top your salad
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees and position your cooking rack on the upper 1 / 3 of the oven
2. Slice the goat cheese into 8-10 rounds
3. Place the ground almonds on a plate
4. Pour olive oil onto another plate
5. Roll the cheese rounds around in the oil
6. Then gently turn the cheese around in the almonds , making sure it's completely coated
7. Place cheese rounds onto a baking sheet and bake 3-4 minutes until lightly toasted

title: great wall green beans
steps:
1. Wash and cut ends off your beans and place them in a large skillet with 4 cups of water
2. Bring to a boil , then boil beans for 5 minutes
3. After boiling , pour beans into a collander and dump the water
4. In a small bowl
5. Mix together rice vinegar , honey , lawry's , cornstarch , soy sauce , pepper , red pepper flakes , toasted sesame oil , ginger , and cinnamon
6. Heat the canola oil on med-high in your skillet and add the garlic
7. Saute garlic for 1 minute then add back your beans and the marinade
8. Stir fast
9. Saute beans on med heat for 8 minutes , stirring often
10. Remove skillet from burner and let beans continue to sizzle just from the heat of the pan
11. When sizzling stops , sprinkle sesame seeds on top and serve

title: aj s best baked beans
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Saute the bacon til brown , then drain the bacon , reserving some of the drippings
3. Add your red onion and green pepper til onion is translucent and both are tender
4. Drain off drippings
5. Drain the juices from one can of pork and beans , then empty contents of both cans into baking dish
6. Mix beans with the fried onion , bacon bits , and green pepper
7. Add mustard , bbq sauces , thai chili sauce , brown sugar , and cajun seasoning
8. Mix well
9. Bake for 40 minutes

title: southern chicken and yellow rice
steps:
1. Cover chicken thighs with water
2. Water needs to be about 2 inches over thighs
3. Boil chicken thighs 30 minuter or until no longer pink inside
4. Remove chicken , let cool
5. Reserve 3 cups of broth , and pour in yellow rice
6. Simmer on med-low heat 30 min or until rice is tender
7. While rice is simmering de-bone thighs
8. After rice is done , stir in chicken
9. Enjoy
10. Especially good with collard greens

title: honey peach freeze
steps:
1. Place a few peach slices aside for garnish
2. Put remaining peaches in a blender or food processor
3. Add the honey and juices
4. Cover and process until smooth
5. Pour into four freezer-proof dishes and freeze
6. Remove from the freezer 5 minutes before serving
7. Garnish with the reserved peaches
8. Enjoy !
9. Yield: 4 servings

title: pecan lace cookies
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400f
2. With a pastry brush , spread 2 tbs
3. Of the softened butter over two large baking sheets
4. Sprinkle each baking sheet with 1 tbs
5. Of the flour and
6. Discard excess
7. Combine 1 / 2 celsius of the flour , baking powder and salt , and sift them together in a bowl
8. Set aside
9. In a deep bowl , cream 2 tbs
10. Of the butter until light and fluffy
11. Add sugar , beat in the eggs and the vanilla , and stir the flour mixture into the batter
12. Then add the pecans
13. Drop the batter by heaping teaspoonfuls onto the prepared baking sheets , spacing the cookies about 3-inches apart
14. Bake for 5 minute or until golden brown and the cookies have spread into lace like 4-inch rounds
15. Let the cookies cool for a minute or so then transfer them to a wire rack to cool completely
16. Let the baking sheets cool completely , then coat again with butter and flour
17. Bake the remaining cookies

title: your last spinach dip recipe
steps:
1. Take both boxes of frozen spinach and place in boiling water until cooked
2. When done strain and squeeze in a cheesecloth or dry with good old paper towels
3. It is important that the spinach be very dry
4. When you have finished drying chop the spinach into a very fine consistancy
5. When done place spinach into a large mixing bowl and put aside for later
6. In a heavy saucepan melt butter
7. Add the garlic and the onions and saute for 3 to 5 minutes
8. Add flour to make a roux
9. Stir and cook for about 30 seconds
10. Slowly add heavy cream and as you do this stir with a whisk to prevent any lumping
11. When you see and feel everthing getting all nice and thick and bubbly you will want to add lemon juice , pecorino romano cheese , and the mozzarella cheese
12. Stir until cheese is melted and the mixture looks smooth
13. Now when you get the smoothness add the sour cream and mix for an additional minute
14. Now that this is done combine the spinach that you dried out earlier and the the yummy cheese mix
15. Fold everything together in something big until you can't see the dark green color of the spinach ,
16. Now place the dip into your serving bowls
17. Take the vermont white cheddar and sprinkle enough to cover the top of each bowl , or to your taste
18. More is better !
19. After this all you have to do is put a bowl in the microwave and heat for about 1 minute or until cheese is melted all the way
20. When you remove it from the microwave just stir in the white vermont cheddar so it mixes evenly
21. Sit back , eat and enjoy
22. Exercise !
23. Because this is not on the atkins diet , and you might gain a pound or two

title: mixed berry couscous
steps:
1. Place the couscous in a bowl
2. In a saucepan put the fruit juices and cinnamon stick , bring to the boil then pour over couscous
3. Cover the bowl and leave to stand for 5 minutes
4. Remove the cinnamon stick and put in the fridge
5. When cool separate couscous with a fork until light and fluffy , add the berries , lime and lemon zest and mint and gently fold through
6. Put yogurt on top , drizzle with honey and top with any remaining zest

title: strawberry shortcake trifle
steps:
1. Break the angel food cake into small pieces
2. Cook the glaze following package directions , stir in the sliced strawberries , set aside
3. Beat the softened cream cheese with the sugar , then fold in the cool whip
4. Place half the cake pieces into the bottom of a large trifle bowl
5. Spoon 1 / 2 the cream cheese mixture over the cake
6. Place 1 / 2 the strawberry mixture over the cream cheese , then repeat all three layers
7. Garnish with cool whip and whole berries , chill for several hours

title: rosemary citrus scones
steps:
1. Spray a baking sheet with nonstick coating
2. Set aside
3. In a large bowl combine flour , oats , sugar , baking powder , orange peel , rosemary , and salt
4. In another bowl stir together milk , oil , and egg product
5. Add milk mixture all at once to flour mixture
6. Stir just until moistened
7. On a lightly floured surface knead dough 10 times
8. Lightly roll or pat dough to an 8-inch circle , about 3 / 4 inch thick
9. Cut dough into 12 wedges
10. Carefully transfer wedges to prepared baking sheet
11. Bake in a 400 degree f oven for 15 to 18 minutes or until golden brown
12. Remove from baking sheet and cool on a wire rack for 5 minutes
13. Serve warm

title: bahmi goreng  fried noodles
steps:
1. Cook the noodles according to the directions on the pack
2. Cut the onions and garlic into fine pieces
3. Make little balls of the minced pork and fry this together with the sausages in a wok or wide frying pan
4. Then add the cooked noodles and stir-fry
5. Now add all the vegetables , soy sauce , shrimp , ham , and spices , add salt and pepper to taste ans stir-fry till it is thoroughly hot
6. Serve on a plate
7. Add soy sauce , sambal oelek , or sambal manis to taste
8. Sambal manis is used more with these two than the soy based pork ones

title: yummy grilled tuna and cheese sandwiches
steps:
1. Spread both sides of the bread thinly with butter
2. Place the cheese on the bread and then the tuna
3. Grill for 2 minutes on each side or until the bread is golden brown
4. Serve or refrigerate and eat later

title: summer squash dressing
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. In large bowl , put cornbread , onion , and summer squash
3. Mix remaining ingredients together , pour over dressing , give it a gentle stir
4. Put into greased 9 by 13 inch pan , bake uncovered for 45 to 50 minutes
5. Or freeze , defrost , and bake later--freezes well

title: banana bisquick muffins
steps:
1. Place biscuit mix in a medium bowl and break up any lumps
2. Combine remaining ingredients and stir into the biscuit mix
3. Fill paper-lined muffin cups 2 / 3 full
4. Bake at 400f 15-20 minutes
5. Cool in pan 5 minutes

title: lake charles dip or salad dressing
steps:
1. Mix sour cream , italian salad dressing mix , mayonnaise , tabasco and lemon juice together in glass bowl
2. Carefully fold in tomatoes and avocado
3. Chill before serving

title: yummy mexican lasagna w  a healthier kick
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Brown turkey in skillet over medium heat for 5 mins , add onion and garlic and sautee another 5 mins , add taco sauce , rotel , black olives , refried beans and simmer on low for 15 minutes
3. In a 3 quart casserole dish put a thin layer of meat mixture at the bottom , place 2 overlapping tortillas on top
4. Then add a layer of meat mixture and cheese , repeat w / tortillas , meat , cheese until tortillas are gone -- leaving a layer of the meat mixture w / loads of cheese on top
5. Bake at 350 for 20 mins or until cheese is melted and bubbly
6. Enjoy !

title: firecracker wings by sunny anderson
steps:
1. In a food processor , blend together all the ingredients but the chicken until smooth
2. Reserve 1 cup of marinade
3. Place chicken wings into a large resealable plastic bag and pour marinade over them
4. Seal and marinate in the refrigerator 4 to 6 hours
5. Preheat grill to medium-high
6. Remove wings from marinade
7. Arrange wings on grill and brown 5 minutes -- then turn and brown the other side , about 5 minutes more
8. Meanwhile , in a small saucepan bring reserved marinade to a boil
9. Reduce by 1 / 3 until it thickens slightly , about 10 minutes
10. When wings are golden brown , brush them with the glaze
11. Put the wings on a cooler part of the grill , cover and cook until cooked through , another 15 to 20 minutes

title: artichoke fettuccine
steps:
1. In a large pot of salted boiing water add fettuccine- cook according to package directions
2. Heat oil in skillet , add onions and saute until softened
3. Add artichokes , season with salt and pepper , cover and cook on low 20 minutes
4. Add stock , cream , hazelnuts , parsley , and simmer over low heat
5. Drain pasta , reserving 1 c cooking water
6. Add pasta to sauce , add additional cooking water if needed

title: drew s curry chicken
steps:
1. Brown chicken in olive oil with garlic
2. Then brown onion
3. Add curry , chicken bouillon and tomato paste
4. Stir well
5. Add chicken and green beans
6. Simmer over low heat for 30-45 minutes , stirring occasionally
7. Make cous cous according to package directions only add a chicken bouillon cube to the cooking water
8. Serve chicken curry over cous cous

title: holiday biscotti
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
2. Line a heavy large baking sheet with parchment paper
3. Whisk the flour and baking powder in a medium bowl to blend
4. Using an electric mixer , beat the sugar , butter , lemon zest , and salt in a large bowl to blend
5. Beat in the eggs 1 at a time
6. Add the flour mixture and beat just until blended
7. Stir in the pistachios and cranberries
8. Form the dough into a 13-inch long , 3-inch wide log on the prepared baking sheet
9. Bake until light golden , about 40 minutes
10. Cool for 30 minutes
11. Place the log on the cutting board
12. Using a sharp serrated knife , cut the log on a diagonal into 1 / 2 to 3 / 4-inch-thick slices
13. Arrange the biscotti , cut side down , on the baking sheet
14. Bake the biscotti until they are pale golden , about 15 minutes
15. Transfer the biscotti to a rack and cool completely
16. Stir the chocolate in a bowl set over a saucepan of simmering water until the chocolate melts
17. Dip half of the biscotti into the melted chocolate
18. Gently shake off the excess chocolate
19. Place the biscotti on the baking sheet for the chocolate to set
20. Sprinkle with the sugar crystals
21. Refrigerate until the chocolate is firm , about 35 minutes
22. The biscotti can be made ahead
23. Store them in an airtight container up to 4 days , or wrap them in foil and freeze in resealable plastic bags up to 3 weeks
24. Cooking time does not include the 30 minutes of cooling time before dipping in white chocolate or the 35 minutes refrigeration time after the biscotti is dipped in the chocolate

title: muddled basil martini
steps:
1. Muddle the basil , simple syrup and lime juice together
2. Add gin or vodka
3. Combine in a cocktail shaker with loads of ice
4. Shake until there are shards of ice and the mix turns frothy
5. Strain
6. Original recipe reads: 2 1 / 2 jiggers of vodka or gin
7. 1 jigger simple syrup
8. 1 jigger fresh squeezed lime juice
9. 4 fresh sweet basil leaves
10. 1 fresh spearmint leaf

title: tea house chai concentrate
steps:
1. Crush together the black pepper , ginger root , cardamom , cinnamon stick , and cloves in a coffee grinder or food processor
2. Add to 8 cups of water
3. Bring to a boil , reduce heat to medium and cook for 10 minutes
4. Add 8 teaspoons of tea
5. Allen uses darjeeling op
6. Steep for 8-10 minutes
7. Stain out the spices and tea
8. Add 1 teaspoons of vanilla and 3 teaspoons of honey , or sweeten to taste
9. Enjoy !
10. This can be refrigerated for weeks
11. Heat up as needed and add an equal amount of hot milk
12. Top with ground cinnamon
13. For a mocha chai , use chocolate milk instead of white
14. For herbal chai , replace the darjeeling with 1 teaspoons each of chamomile , fennel seed and peppermint

title: ww crispy onion rings
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450f
2. Coat a large rimmed baking sheet with cooking spray
3. Spread cornflake crumbs on large plate
4. Whisk together egg white , milk , flour , onion powder , salt and cayenne pepper in shallow plate
5. Dip onion rings in egg mixture then dredge in cornflake crumbs , turning to coat
6. Place in single layer on prepared plan
7. Coat onion rings with cooking spray and bake , turning once , until onion rings are golden brown , about 12 minutes
8. Sprinkle with additional salt and pepper before serving , if desired

title: loaded potato quesadillas     5fix
steps:
1. Cook bacon in large skillet over medium heat until crisp
2. Drain on paper towels
3. Chop bacon
4. Reserve bacon drippings for later use
5. Prepare mashed potatoes according to package directions
6. Stir in bacon , green onions and cheese
7. Spread mashed potato mixture onto one side of 4 tortillas to within 1 / 2 inch of edges
8. Top with remaining tortillas
9. Heat large skillet over medium heat
10. Add 1 teaspoon reserved bacon dripping to skillet
11. Place 1 quesadilla into skillet
12. Lightly brush top of quesadilla with bacon drippings
13. Cook until golden brown and crispy on bottom
14. Turn and cook until golden brown on bottom
15. Repeat to cook remaining quesadillas
16. Cut into wedges before serving

title: chateaubriand a la maison
steps:
1. Grill the steak to your desired doneness
2. Put butter , salt , white pepper , cayenne , mustard , chopped parsley , sherry and worcestershire sauce into a pan and heat
3. When butter has fully melted and sauce has been stirred , add the steak , pour over with the cognac and flambe
4. When cognac has burned off , remove the steak and cut into 3 slices per steak
5. Keep warm
6. Mix ketchup and whipping cream then fold in to the sauce along with the sauteed mushrooms
7. Stir well and bring to just under a boil
8. Plate the steak and pour sauce over
9. Serve with french fried potatoes and peas

title: old spaghetti factory s thousand island dressing
steps:
1. Place onions and celery in food processor and chop until soupy
2. In a large bowl thouroughly mix mayonnaise , onions & celery , chili sauce , ketchup and both relishes
3. Stir in milk and half & half
4. Mix for one minute
5. Refrigerate overnight

title: california santa maria style tri tip
steps:
1. Pat roast dry with paper towels
2. Using fork , prick roast about 20 times on each side
3. Combine garlic , oil , and salt and rub over roast
4. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 1 hour or up to 24 hours
5. Soak wood chips in bowl of water to cover for 15 minutes
6. Open bottom vents on grill
7. Light large chimney starter filled with charcoal briquettes and burn until charcoal is covered with fine gray ash
8. Pour hot coals in even layer over one half of grill
9. Set cooking grate in place , cover , open lid vents completely , and let grill heat for 5 minutes
10. Scrape cooking grate clean
11. Using paper towels , wipe garlic paste off roast
12. Rub pepper and garlic salt all over meat
13. Grill directly over coals until well browned , about 5 minutes per side
14. Carefully remove roast and cooking grate from grill and scatter wood chips over coals
15. Replace cooking grate and arrange roast on cooler side of grill
16. Cover , positioning lid vents directly over meat , and cook until roast registers about 130 degrees , about 20 minutes
17. Transfer meat to cutting board , tent loosely with foil , and let rest for 20 minutes
18. Slice thinly across the grain
19. Serve

title: eggplant  aubergine  balls
steps:
1. Bring a large saucepan of salted water to the boil
2. Remove the eggplant stalks and place the eggplants in the boiling water and boil vigorously for 5 minutes
3. Drain off the water and leave to cool
4. Squeeze any excess liquid from the eggplants and chop finely
5. Place in a bowl , add the basil , crushed garlic , pecorino , egg and a large pinch of salt
6. Mix thoroughly
7. Add enough breadcrumbs to hold the mix firmly
8. Form the mixture into walnut sized balls and roll in breadcrumbs
9. Heat plenty of corn oil in a deep pan
10. Fry the eggplant balls in batches so that they have enough room to move about in the oil
11. They should be golden-brown after about 5 minutes
12. Leave to dry on paper towels
13. Serve hot or cold

title: red eye gravy
steps:
1. Heat grease , add flour and sugar until dissolved and incorporated with ham grease
2. Add water , coffee and bullion cube , stir until gravy is well blended
3. Turn down heat and cook for 1 minute , add butter and cook for 1 minute longer
4. Serve immediately with hot biscuits or grits

title: piquant tomato sauce
steps:
1. Combine tomatoes , garlic , celery , peppers , onion& water in a large stainless steel or enamel saucepan
2. Bring to a boil , reduce heat , cover & boil gently , stirring occasionally , for 20 minutes or until mixture has thickened& vegetables are soft
3. Cool slightly
4. Puree in a blender or food processor until smooth
5. Return mixture to pot and add vinegar & spices
6. Boil gently for 5 minutes to blend the flavours , stirring continuously
7. Ladle sauce into hot , sterile jars allowing 1 / 2 inch of head space
8. Process 15 minutes for 250 ml jars & 20 minutes for 500 ml jars

title: homemade lavender honey
steps:
1. Warm the honey in a small saucepan over low heat
2. Stir in the lavender
3. Remove from the heat , cover , and let stand at room temperature for 24 hours
4. Warm the honey again over low heat until it is liquid enough to pour freely
5. Strain through a wire sieve , into a clean jar
6. Cool and cover
7. Store in the refrigerator for up to 6 months
8. Serve at room temperature

title: quick tuna spread  lower carb
steps: 1. Mix and serve on whole grain bread , rolls , or crackers

title: banana praline muffins
steps:
1. Stir together pecans , brown sugar and sour cream
2. Set aside
3. Mash bananas in a medium bowl , add egg and next 3 ingredients , stirring just until dry ingredients are moistened
4. Place paper baking cups in muffin pans and coat cups with cooking spray
5. Spoon batter into muffin cup , filling three fourths full
6. Carefully spoon pecan mixture evenly in center of each muffin
7. Bake at 400f for 18-20 minutes or until golden
8. Remove from pans immediately and cool on wire racks
9. To reheat , microwave at high 1 minute

title: persian chicken w pomegranate and walnuts
steps:
1. Heat 1 tbl
2. Oil in a large frying pan and saute chicken until golden brown
3. Add half the onion and fry til softened , then add water
4. Bring to a boil , cover and reduce heat
5. Simmer 15 minutes
6. In another fry pan , heat remaining oil and fry the rest of the onion for 2-3 minutes , until soft
7. Add the chopped walnuts and fry for 2-3 more minutes , stirring frequently so the walnuts don't burn
8. Stir in pomegranate juice , tomato paste , lemon juice and sugar
9. Let simmer for 5 minutes , adding salt and pepper to taste
10. Pour sauce over chicken , ensuring all pieces are coated
11. Cover again and simmer for 30-35 minutes until the chicken is done and the oil from the nuts has risen to the surface
12. Serve at once with rice or a savory couscous

title: ms clarke s molasses ribs
steps:
1. Place ribs in a shallow pan
2. Combine ingredients and pour over ribs
3. Chill approximately 1 hour
4. Baste
5. Cover and bake at 350f for 1 1 / 2 hours , basting frequently

title: omeleta horiatiki
steps:
1. Heat 1-2 tablespoons of oil in a frying pan and saut the onions for 5 minutes or until they are semi see-through , and set aside
2. Add the olives , red peppers and feta cheese to the onions and cook for another 5 minutes
3. Beat 3 eggs in a bowl then add half of the onion , olive , and cheese mixture
4. In a separate frying pan , heat 2 tablespoons pour in the omelet mixture and fry the omelet on both sides until done , make the second omelet and serve hot

title: brownies
steps:
1. Combine sugar with melted margarine
2. Cream well
3. Add eggs and mix well
4. Stir in flour and cocoa
5. Add vanilla
6. Grease and flour a 9 inch round or square cake pan
7. Bake approximately 20 minutes @ 350
8. Best not to over bake them , they shouldn't be dry

title: baked ziti from cook s illustrated
steps:
1. Adjust oven rack to middle position and heat oven to 350f whisk cottage cheese , eggs and 1 cup parmesan together in medium bowl
2. Set aside
3. Bring 4 quarts of water to boil in large dutch oven over high heat
4. Stir in 1 tablespoon salt and pasta
5. Cook , stirring occasionally , until pasta begins to soften but is not yet cooked through , 5 to 7 minutes
6. Drain pasta and leave in colander
7. Meanwhile , heat oil and garlic in 12 inch skillet over medium heat until garlic is fragrant but not brown
8. Stir in tomato sauce , diced tomatoes , and oregano
9. Simmer until thickened , about 10 minutes
