10. Off heat , stir in 1 / 2 cup basil and sugar , then season with salt and pepper
11. Stir cornstarch into heavy cream in small bowl , transfer mixture to dutch oven set over medium heat
12. Bring to simmer and cook until thickened , 3 to 4 minutes
13. Remove pot from heat and add cottage cheese mixture , 1 cup tomato sauce and 3 / 4 cup mozzarella , then stir to combine
14. Add pasta and stir to coat
15. Transfer pasta mixture to 13 x 9 inch baking dish and spread remaining tomato sauce evenly over pasta
16. Sprinkle with remaining 3 / 4 cup mozzarella and remaining 1 / 2 cup parmesan over top
17. Cover baking dish tightly with foil and bake for 30 minutes
18. Remove foil and continue to cook until cheese is bubbling and beginning to brown , about 30 minutes longer
19. Cool for 20 minutes
20. Sprinkle with remaining 3 tablespoons basil and serve

title: pasta al forno  rachael ray
steps:
1. Bring a large pot of water to boil , then salt and cook the pasta to al dente on the chewy side , 7 minutes
2. Once your pasta water comes to a boil to cook the ziti , preheat the oven to 500 degrees f
3. To a medium skillet over medium heat , add the extra virgin olive oil
4. Cook the onions and garlic in the oil 3 to 5 minutes
5. Stir in the tomatoes and bring to a bubble
6. Add the cream and season with the cinnamon , salt and pepper
7. Add the chopped prosciutto to the sauce and stir with the cooked pasta to combine
8. Grease a medium casserole dish
9. Adjust the seasonings and transfer the pasta to the casserole
10. Cover the pasta with parmesan cheese and place in the oven for 10 minutes
11. Serve hot

title: avocado and crab meat soup
steps:
1. Mash together avocados and crab meat
2. Saute chopped onion in the butter over med heat
3. Add the all-purpose flour , garlic powder and chicken stock , mix until smooth
4. Add the avocado / crab mixture to the liquid and simmer for twenty minutes
5. Add the cream and salt and pepper
6. Serve

title: macadamia banana french toast
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 475 degrees
2. Butter well 2 large baking sheets
3. In blender or food processor add one banana , milk , half the chopped nuts , vanilla and cinnamon , blend until well mixed
4. Pour into large , shallow dish
5. Dip bread slices into mixture until well absorbed on both sides
6. Arrange on well-buttered baking sheets
7. Bake until golden
8. About 5 minutes
9. To serve , slice diagonally and dust with powdered sugar
10. Top with remaining sliced banana and chopped nuts

title: shredded beef barbecue
steps:
1. Place roast , onions , celery , garlic and water in a large pot
2. Bring to a boil then cover and turn down to low heat and simmer the roast for at least 4 hours
3. Remove from liquid , saving about 1 cup of liquid , and cool slightly
4. Shred roast and add to the remaining liquid
5. Add all remaining ingredients and cook uncovered for 1 hour
6. Serve on buns with coleslaw

title: mixed bean goulash
steps:
1. Heat oil , fry onion for 5 min until soft
2. Add paprika and stir
3. Add tomatoes plus half of their can filled with water
4. Simmer for 10 mins until glossy
5. Best served with toast and sour cream drizzed on but also is a complete meal in itself

title: fettuccine primavera
steps:
1. Be sure everything is cut about the same size so the dish has a nice uniform look
2. Bring water and salt to a rolling boil
3. Add asparagus and broccoli and cook for one minute
4. Remove veggies and plunge into cold water to stop cooking
5. Reserve vegetable cooking water for boiling pasta
6. Heat butter and oil in a large skillet over med heat
7. Add onion and carrots
8. Cook , stirring , till soft , about 5 minutes
9. Add blanched asparaguys and broccoli along with the frozen or fresh peas and s&p to taste
10. Cook till all veggies are tender
11. Return veg cooking water to a boil
12. Add fettuccine and cook till tender
13. While pasta is cooking , add cream to veggies and stir while simmering
14. Drain pasta and add to veggies with basil leaves and cheese
15. Serve this terrific dish while very hot

title: grandma geldner s german nut stollen
steps:
1. In a large bowl , mix 3 cups flour , yeast , salt and sugar well
2. In a saucepan , heat milk , vanilla , and 1 / 2 cup butter slightly until butter melts
3. Cool with an ice cube
4. Add milk mixture to flour mixture and mix by hand for 2 minutes
5. Add 1 / 2 c flour and eggs and mix until well blended
6. Stir in remaining 3 / 4 c flour and hand mix until dough is smooth
7. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour
8. Roll out dough into two oblong shapes and spread 1 tbsp melted butter on each piece
9. Sprinkle cinnamon and spread nuts onto both pieces of dough , to 1 / 2" from the edge
10. Roll up jelly roll fashion along the long side of the dough , and crimp ends shut
11. Seal ends and opening along dough with wet fingers , so that dough does not open up during baking
12. Place both on an ungreased cookie sheet , and allow to rise uncovered in a warm place until double in bulk , 1 to 1 1 / 2 hours
13. Bake in a preheated 350 f oven for 20 minutes , until light golden brown
14. Allow to cool and frost with desired frosting

title: chocolate of the gods
steps:
1. Place first seven ingredients in a food processor and pulse until smooth
2. Sift cocoa powder with a metal strainer to remove lumps , then add to avocado mixture and blend until smooth
3. At this point you can refrigerate the pudding in a tightly-sealed container for up to a week or freeze it for up to a month
4. Serve chilled , layered with raspberries , if desired , and garnished with fresh mint and shaved chocolate

title: mandi s cauliflower casserole
steps:
1. Steam cauliflower
2. In a bowl combine mayo , mustard , bacon bits , salt and pepper
3. Pour mayo mixture over cooked cauliflower
4. Sprinkle cheese over mixture
5. Bake 375f for 10 minutes or until bubbly

title: wasabi devilled eggs
steps:
1. Prepare an ice-water bath
2. Place eggs in a medium saucepan
3. Add enough cold water to cover eggs by about 1 inch
4. Bring to a boil
5. Cover and remove from heat
6. Let stand for 13 minutes
7. Drrain , and transfer eggs to ice-water bath until cold
8. Peel eggs , and halve lengthwise
9. Transfer yolks to a medium bowl , and mash with a fork until smooth
10. Stir in mayonnaise , wasabi , vinegar , and scallions
11. Season with salt
12. Pipe or spoon filling into whites
13. Garnish with pea shoots or sprouts

title: lollipop chippy chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Grease a baking sheet
3. Crush potato chips onto a plate
4. In a large bowl , whisk together egg and milk
5. Dip the chicken cubes into the egg mixture , then coat well with potato chips
6. Spread the nuggets onto the baking sheet
7. Bake for 10 minutes
8. Turn nuggets over , and bake for 10 minutes more , until golden brown
9. Remove baking sheet from oven , and insert a lollipop stick into each nugget

title: sausage   noodle casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 f
2. Cook and drain the noodles
3. Meanwhile , brown the meat , drain
4. Drain and wipe the pan
5. Add oil and heat
6. Saute the bell pepper and onion 'til the onion is translucent
7. Mix together all except the corn chips
8. Pour into a 2 qt
9. Casserole dish
10. At this point you can cover the dish with plastic wrap and put it in the fridge to be baked later
11. Top evenly with corn chip crumbs
12. Bake 35- 40 minutes

title: finnish berry dessert
steps:
1. In a large heat-proof bowl , combine the fruit with 2 tablespoons of sugar
2. In a saucepan , combine the cornstarch and juice until smooth
3. Bring to a boil and cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened
4. Remove for heat and allow to cool for 10 minutes
5. Pour the mixture over the fruit tossing to coat
6. Sprinkle with remaining sugar , cover and refrigerate until chilled
7. To serve , spoon the fruit into individual dessert dishes and top with frozen yogurt if desired

title: mexican meatballs in chipotle chili sauce
steps:
1. For the meatballs , combine all meatball ingredients in a large bowl , mix with hands
2. Refrigerate and cover for 1 hour
3. Meanwhile for the sauce , if using fresh tomatoes , place on a cooking sheet and broil , turning once or twice until the skins bister and blacken , about 10 minutes
4. Peel the skin off tomatoes and place the peeled in to a blender or food processor
5. Put the garlic and onion into a hot , dry skillet and cook , turning occasionally , over medium heat , until the garlic is lightly browned and the onion is lightly scorched ,
6. Add to the blender along with 1 / 2 cup broth , chipotles to taste , cinnamon , salt and pepper
7. Blend until smooth , taste , and add more chipotles if desired
8. Heat oil in a large , heavy and deep skillet over medium heat until quite hot but not smoking
9. Add the tomato mixture and "fry" until it thikckens , about 10 minutes
10. Stir in the remaning 2 cups broth and heat to a boil
11. Stir in mint
12. Taste again , adjust salt and pepper , and add some adobo from the canned chilies if not spicy enough
13. Shape the meat mixture into meatballs , the mixture should make 60 meatballs
14. Add the meatballs to the sauce , shake the pan once or twice in the first 5 minutes of cooking to prevent sticking
15. Simmer slowly until the meatballs are done , about 30 minutes

title: sausage appetizers
steps:
1. Preheat broiler
2. Crumble and cook sausage in medium skillet until browned
3. Drain on paper towels
4. T
5. Transfer sausage to small bowl
6. Stir in cheese , sour cream , mayonnaise , green onions and worcestershire
7. Cut crusts from bread
8. Cut each slice into 4 squares
9. Spread about 1 teaspoons sausage mixture onto each square
10. Arrange squares on ungreased baking sheet
11. Place under hot broiler just until cheese melts and filling bubbles
12. Serve hot and enjoy

title: sweet and spicy shrimp stir fry
steps:
1. In a small bowl , whisk water , soy sauce , sweet chili sauce , honey , vinegar , garlic powder and corn starch
2. Set aside
3. Heat vegetable oil in wok over medium-high heat until oil begins to glisten
4. Add vegetables and black pepper
5. Saute until tender-crisp
6. Add sesame oil to vegetables at this point and toss to combine
7. Remove from wok to another dish , cover and set aside
8. Cook rice according to package instructions
9. Return wok to heat and add shrimp
10. Saute for two minutes or until heated through
11. Return vegetables to wok
12. Make a well in the center of the wok and whisk in sauce until it begins to thicken
13. Toss all together and serve over hot , cooked rice

title: yummy black bean soup
steps:
1. Saute the onions and garlic in the oil till fragrant and the onions are transparent , about 5-7 minutes
2. Add beans , stock , vinegar , salsa , spices and salt and pepper
3. Simmer for 30 minutes to combine flavors
4. Remove about 1 cup of the beans and puree in the blender or food processor and add back to the soup
5. Stir , and when soup is at desired thickness , serve
6. Garnish with lime wedges , sour cream and cilantro as desired

title: indian spiced crunchy chickpeas
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f coat a cookie sheet with cooking spray
2. Heat a small pan over medium-high heat
3. Add oil , spices and salt and stir until fragrant , about 1 to 2 minutes
4. Place chickpeas in a large bowl
5. Add spice mixture and mix well to coat chickpeas
6. Place chickpeas on cookie sheet in a single layer and roast in oven until crunchy , checking and shaking pan twice during cooking , about 1 1 / 4 hours
7. Yields about 1 / 2 cup per serving

title: green beans with garlic and ham
steps:
1. Bring a large pot of water to a boil
2. Add garlic
3. Cook 8 minutes until very tender
4. Transfer to a paper towel using a slotted spoon
5. Pat dry
6. Add salt to pot
7. Return water to boil and add green beans
8. Cook beans until just tender , about 6 minutes
9. Drain beans , rinse under cold water , pat dry and set aside
10. Heat 2 t oil in heavy nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
11. Add ham and saute until crisp , 6 or 7 minutes depending on the moisture content of the ham
12. Set aside
13. Can be prepared 1 day ahead
14. Keep garlic separate from beans and ham
15. Melt butter with remaining oil in a large heavy skillet over medium high heat
16. Add garlic and mash with a fork or the back of a spoon
17. Add green beans and ham
18. Toss until heated through and coated with garlic
19. Season to your taste with salt and pepper
20. Serve

title: sweet onion muffins
steps:
1. In a bowl , combine flour , sugar , baking powder , and salt
2. In another bowl , beat the eggs , onion , and butter until blended
3. Stir into the dry ingredients just until moistened
4. Fold in walnuts
5. Fill greased or paper-lined miniature muffin cups 3 / 4 full
6. Bake at 400f for 10-12 minutes or until a tooth pick inserted near the center comes out clean
7. Cool , for 5 minutes before removing from pan to wire racks
8. Yield: 3 dozen minis or 1 dozen regular muffins

title: oh my gosh    this is good pasta
steps:
1. Cook and drain pasta according to package directions
2. Drain and put back in the saucepan
3. While pasta is cooking , stir together the butter , ricotta and 1 / 2 cup parmesan
4. Toss this with the hot pasta
5. Put in serving dish or dishes
6. Top with tomato , basil and remaining parmesan

title: macadamia nut crusted snapper with mango lime butter
steps:
1. In a saucepan , combine the mango , wine , sugar , ginger , and lime juice and simmer over medium heat for 5 minutes , until thick and syrupy
2. Add the cream , mix well , and remove from the heat
3. Pour into a blender and blend until smooth
4. Return to the saucepan and simmer over low heat for 8 minutes , until the mixture thickens slightly
5. Add the butter , a piece at a time , and stir until incorporated before adding the next piece
6. Be careful not to boil the sauce , or it will separate
7. Season with salt and pepper and keep warm
8. Preheat the oven to 450 degrees
9. Place the nuts , panko and basil in a food processor and process until fine
10. Spread on a plate
11. In a bowl , combine the mayonnaise and sriracha and mix well
12. Lightly season the fish with salt and pepper
13. Evenly spread a light coat of the chile mayonnaise on one side of each fish fillet
14. Coat the same side evenly with the nut coating
15. In an ovenproof saute pan or skillet , pour in just enough oil to coat the bottom and heat over medium heat
16. Add the fish , crust side down , and saute for 3 minutes , until golden brown
17. Turn the fish and place in the oven for 5 minutes , until cooked through and firm to the touch
18. Place the fillets on warmed individual places
19. Serve with the mango-lime butter

title: pumpkin pie ice cream
steps:
1. Wisk sugars and egg together
2. Set aside
3. In a saucepan over low / meduim heat , heat milk , and cream
4. Do not boil but heat just until the edges start to bubble
5. Slowly add part of the heated milk to the eggs wisking constantly
6. This keeps the eggs from scrambling lol
7. Add the heated egg mixture to the remaining milk in pan
8. Add spices and pumpkin and slowly cook until it thicken slightly and coats a spoon
9. Remove from heat
10. Strain through sieve
11. Pour into an ice cream maker and follow the manufacturs directions

title: spinach with olive oil and lemon
steps:
1. Add spinach to boiling water
2. Cook 1 minute
3. Drain
4. Squeeze off all excess water
5. Toss with oil and salt
6. Add lemon juice
7. Toss again

title: crock pot cranberry chicken
steps:
1. Place onion in slow cooker , then arrange thighs over onion
2. Combine remaining ingredients together and whisk well
3. Spoon over chicken , making sure to get some on every piece
4. Cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours or on high for 3 to 4 hours

title: sauerkraut pie uses leftover mashed potatoes
steps:
1. Brown hamburger , drain if needed
2. Add onion , saute lightly
3. Mix in spices if you wish or do your own spice thing
4. Take off burner
5. Open kraut and drain if you wish
6. Spread sauerkraut top of hamburger , ya it is like raking hay , use your hands , do not over fill there is potatoes yet to go
7. Spread mashed potatoes over the top , and to the edges , to "seal in" , this will bubble
8. Cut with wet knife in center to vent steam
9. Add butter or marg on top if you wish
10. Bake 350 for about 45 min , or until top browns
11. Sis likes hers with bo-mondy ? this is a spice , brother likes his with cheddar or mozzarella cheese melted on top
12. This is a one pan clean up , but you can do it in a deep cass
13. Dish also
14. All ingredients depend on your pan size
15. This is easy to "make bigger" , as more company comes in the door

title: apple cider sauce
steps:
1. Combine cider , broth , vinegar , and cinnamon stick in medium saucepan
2. Simmer over medium-high heat until liquid is reduced to 1 cup , 10 to 12 minutes
3. Remove cinnamon stick and discard
4. Set sauce aside until pork is cooked
5. Put 1 tablespoon butter in a clean skillet and heat over medium heat until melted and foaming subsides
6. Add shallot and apple and cook , stirring occasionally , until softened and beginning to brown , 1 to 2 minutes
7. Remove skillet from heat and add calvados
8. Return skillet to heat and cook about 1 minute , scraping bottom with wooden spoon to loosen browned bits
9. Add reduced cider mixture , any juices from resting meat , and thyme
10. Increase heat to medium-high and simmer until thickened and reduced to 1 1 / 4 cups , 3 to 4 minutes
11. Off heat , whisk in remaining 3 tablespoons butter , and adjust seasonings with salt and pepper
12. Pour sauce over pork and serve immediately

title: south african boboejie bobotie
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , saute one one chopped onion in 3 tablespoons butter until translucent
2. Add the ground beef , salt and pepper and saute until meat is no longer pink
3. Add the gravy powder , bay leaf , and beef stock
4. Braise while working on next step
5. In another saucepan , brown remaining onion in remaining butter and then add curry , tomato sauce , stewed tomatoes , apricot jam , vinegar and chutney
6. Merge the ingredients from the 2 pans into one saucepan and continue to cook until the sauce has reduced to a stew consistency

title: key lime meringue pie made with no condensed milk
steps:
1. Combine 1-1 / 2 cups sugar with the cornstarch and salt in a 2-quart saucepan
2. Add egg yolks , lime juice and cold water
3. Blend well
4. Add butter , and gradually add boiling water
5. Bring to a boil over medium heat and cook 3 minutes , stirring constantly
6. Stir in zest and food coloring , remove from heat and cool 20 minutes
7. Meanwhile , beat egg whites with electric mixer on number 1 speed till frothy
8. Add cream of tartar and whip until soft peaks form
9. Continue on number 4 speed , gradually adding remaining sugar , beating until stiff peaks form
10. Pour cooled filling into pie shell
11. Lightly pile meringue on filling and spread to edges
12. Bake 350 degrees for 15 minutes
13. Cool completely before serving

title: spicy tortilla lasagna with ricotta cheese
steps:
1. Cook chicken in frying pan or microwave until no longer pink
2. Set aside
3. Cook onion and garlic until softened
4. Add spices and cook for one more minute
5. Stir in tomatoes and sauce and bring to a boil
6. Reduce heat and add chicken , simmer for 10 minutes
7. Spread 1 / 3 of tomato mixture in 13x9 baking dish
8. Top with 2 tortillas , spread 1 / 3 tomato mixture , half of ricotta and half of mozerella
9. Repeat with remaining tortillas , tomatoes and cheeses
10. Bake at 350 for 20-30 minutes or until sauce is bubbling
11. Let stand for 10 minutes before cutting

title: quick shrimp scampi bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees
2. In a small saucepan over medium heat , combine the butter , white wine , lemon juice , garlic , and parsley
3. When the butter melts completely , remove from heat
4. Arrange shrimp in a shallow baking dish
5. Pour the butter mixture over the shrimp
6. Bake in preheated oven for 10 minutes or until the shrimp are pink and opaque
7. Serve over rice or pasta

title: chinese pasta primavera
steps:
1. Fill a large pot with water and begin heating it for the pasta
2. In a large skillet or wok , heat oil and butter and stir-fry vegetables , onion and garlic about 3 minutes
3. Add cilantro and basil and cook another minute , or until vegetables are done to your taste , leaving them a little crunchy
4. Season vegetables with salt and pepper and mix with soy sauce
5. When the water boils , add linguine and cook al dente , according to package directions
6. Drain
7. Toss vegetables with pasta and sprinkle with parmesan cheese

title: french hot chocolate
steps:
1. About 50 minutes before serving: in double boiler over hot , not boiling water , melt chocolate and corn syrup until chocolate is melted and mixture is smooth , stirring occasionally with rubber spatula
2. Cover and refrigerate 30 minutes or until mixture is cool
3. Stir in vanilla
4. In 2 quart saucepan over medium-low heat , heat milk until very hot and small bubbles form around edge
5. Meanwhile , in small bowl with mixer at medium-low speed , beat cream and chocolate mixture until soft peaks form
6. To serve , pour milk into warm coffee pot
7. Spoon whipped cream mixture into 8 coffee cups and fill with hot milk

title: zucchini mock crab cakes
steps:
1. Preheat oil for frying in pan
2. If you want to eliminate the oil , preheat a non-stick pan and spray with pam or equivalent
3. Mix all ingredients together and form into patties
4. Fry in oil till browned and crisp

title: spinach dip in cob loaf
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients , mix well and leave to sit in bowl for 5 minutes
2. Cut a layer off the top of the cob loaf and hollow it out , making a bowl out of the bread
3. Tear excess bread into bit size pieces and place in 150 degree oven for 15 minutes or until nice a crunchy
4. Add mixture to the hollowed cob loaf , place prepared bread pieces around on the plate and serve

title: chicken in garlic vinegar sauce
steps:
1. Pat chicken pieces dry with paper towels and season with 1 / 2 teaspoon salt and pepper
2. Heat 2 teaspoons oil and butter in a large heavy casserole or dutch oven over medium heat
3. Add half the chicken pieces and cook , turning occasionally , until browned on all sides , 5 to 7 minutes
4. Remove to a large plate
5. Add 2 teaspoons oil to the pot
6. Add the remaining chicken and cook , turning occasionally , until browned on all sides , 5 to 7 minutes
7. Remove to the plate
8. Heat 2 more teaspoons oil
9. Add shallots and garlic and cook , stirring , until the shallots are soft and lightly browned , about 1 minute
10. Add vinegar and bring to a simmer
11. Return the chicken to the pot
12. Pour in broth and then carefully nestle the thyme sprigs among the chicken pieces
13. Cover the pot with a tight-fitting lid and simmer over medium-low heat until the chicken is very tender , about 50 minutes
14. Just before the chicken is done , whisk sour cream , mustard , tomato paste and flour in a small bowl until smooth
15. Combine tomatoes , chives , the remaining 1 teaspoon oil and pinch of salt in another small bowl
16. Reserve for
17. When the chicken is done , remove to a plate , discarding the thyme sprigs
18. Stir the sour cream mixture into the sauce
19. Bring to a simmer
20. Reduce heat to low , return the chicken to the sauce and reheat , about 1 minute
21. Serve garnished with the tomato mixture

title: beef short ribs with red chili sauce
steps:
1. Cut 1 head of garlic crosswise in half
2. Place in large pot with ribs , 3 quarts water and quartered onion
3. Bring to boil over high heat
4. Reduce heat to medium and simmer uncovered until meat is cooked through , about 50 minutes
5. Strain , reserving 6 cups meat broth
6. Discard onion and garlic
7. Reserve ribs
8. Preheat oven to 400
9. Wrap remaining head of garlic tightly in foil and place directly on oven rack
10. Place tomatoes and sliced onion on rimmed baking sheet
11. Drizzle with 1 tablespoon oil
12. Sprinkle with salt and pepper
13. Roast garlic , tomatoes and onion until tender , for about 1 hour
14. Transfer tomatoes and onion to processor
15. Using fingers , squeeze garlic from papery skin into processor
16. Blend until smooth
17. Set tomato sauce aside place quajillo and ancho chilies in medium bowl
18. Add 4 cups reserved meat broth
19. Let stand for 30 minutes
20. Transfer mixture to processor and blend until smooth
21. Strain chili sauce into medium blend until smooth
22. Strain chili sauce into medium bowl , pressing on solids in strainer with rubber spatula to exct as much liquid as possible
23. Heat remaining 2 tablespoons oil in heavy large pot over medium-high heat
24. Add chili ace
25. Simmer for 5 minutes
26. Add tomato sauce , cumin , oregano and cloves
27. Simmer for 5 minutes
28. Add ribs , vinegar and remaining 2 cups meat broth
29. Bring to simmer
30. Reduce heat to low and simmer uncovered until sauce is thick for about 50 minutes

title: jalapeno popper spread
steps:
1. Stir together cream cheese and mayonnaise in a large bowl until smooth
2. Stir in green chilies and jalapeo peppers
3. Pour mixture into a microwave safe serving dish , and sprinkle with parmesan cheese
4. Microwave on high until hot , about 3 minutes

title: cinnamon apple tart
steps:
1. In a small bowl , toss apple with lemon juice
2. Set aside
3. On a lightly floured surface , roll pastry into a 14 inch circle
4. Transfer to a parchment paper lined baking sheet
5. Spread jelly to within 2 inches of edges
6. Sprinkle with apple mixture , sugar , baking chips and almonds
7. Fold up edges of pastry over filling , leaving center uncovered
8. Brush folded pastry with milk
9. Bake at 400f for 20-25 minutes or until golden brown
10. Move to wire rack to cool
11. In a small bowl , combine confectioners' sugar , extract and enough milk to achieve desired consistency
12. Drizzle over tart

title: popcorn  stove top
steps:
1. Put the oil in a 4 quart heavy pot and let it heat over medium heat for 30 seconds
2. Stir in the kernels , turning with a spoon so that they are evenly covered with oil , then spread them in one layer on the bottom of the pot
3. Cover the pot , leaving a small space at the edge for escaping steam
4. As soon as the first kernel pops , move the pot gently and continuously back and forth over medium-high heat until the popping stops
5. Turn into a warm bowl
6. Toss with melted butter , if desired , and salt to taste

title: pan fried fish fillets
steps:
1. Dust the fish , oysters , or shrimp in the mixture and shake off the excess
2. Dunk it in a cup of milk or buttermilk and dip it again
3. Fry immediately in a small amount of canola oil with about one pat of butter

title: chicken with cordon bleu gravy
steps:
1. Cook chicken patties according to package
2. Meanwhile in a small to medium saute pan , cook the bacon until crisp over medium heat
3. Remove the bacon from the pan and crumble
4. Pour enough of the fat in the pan out to leave 2 tablespoons in the pan
5. Whisk the flour into the bacon drippings and cook , stirring constantly , for 2 minutes
6. Whisk in the milk and bring to a simmer
7. Remove pan from heat and stir in the cheese , salt , pepper , and garlic powder
8. Pour over the sauce over cooked chicken patties , sprinkle on the crumbled bacon , and serve

title: walnut and dried cherry rugelach
steps:
1. Combine dough ingredients in food processor or blender until smooth dough forms
2. Divide dough into 4 pieces , forming each piece into a 5-inch disk
3. Wrap each disk in plastic and refrigerate 3 hours or overnight
4. Preheat overn to 375f
5. On lightly floured surface , roll out piece of dough into an 8-inch circle , 1 / 8-inch thick
6. Spread 2 tbsp of jam onto each circle
7. Sprinkle each circle with 1 / 4 of walnuts and 1 / 4 of cherries
8. Cut each circle into 8 wedges using a sharp knife or pastry wheel
9. Starting with the outside edge , roll each wedge , enclosing the filling
10. Place point side down onto greased cookie sheet
11. Combine sugar and cinnamon and sprinkle onto each pastry
12. Bake until golden brown , approximately 35 minutes
13. Let pastries rest approximately 10 minutes before removing from cookie sheet

title: strawberry banana smoothie
steps:
1. Cover and freeze strawberries and sliced bananas until firm , about 4
2. Hours or overnight
3. Combine all ingredients in a blender
4. Process until smooth
5. Serve immediately in chilled glasses
6. Mmmmm mmmmm----- recipe via meal-master v8
7. 06

title: artichoke dip with parmesan and mozzarella
steps:
1. Mix artichokes , mozzarella cheese , mayo , onion , garlic salt , pepper , tabasco , and 1 / 2 cup parmesan cheese in a bowl
2. Place in a microwave safe casserole dish and top with remaining parmesan cheese
3. Heat in microwave or oven until bubbly
4. Garnish with olives if desired

title: sweet n sour crock pot pork
steps:
1. Salt and pepper and dredge roastin flour
2. Heat 2 tablespoons oil in skillet
3. And brown meat on all sides
4. Remove to crock pot
5. Saute fresh mushroom and onions to soften
6. Do not over cook ! place mushrooms and onions in crock pot over meat
7. In small mixing bowl , combine duck sauce , wine / water , and red pepper flakes
8. Pour over meat and veggies
9. Cook on low for 6-8 hours or high for 4 hours
10. Remove meat and cut into chunks
11. Thicken sauce if needed
12. Return meat to sauce
13. Serve with rice or chow mein noodles

title: best  no roll  baking powder biscuits
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450
2. Mix dry ingredients together thoroughly
3. Add shortening and cut into dry mix until it resembles course crumbs
4. Add milk and stir until dough just clings together
5. Form dough into balls a little larger then a golf ball and place side by side on a baking sheet
6. Press balls down with the palm of your hand until they are about 1 / 2 inch thick
7. Bake in oven for 10 - 12 minutes or until golden

title: orange berry smoothie
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a blender , and blend until smooth , adding flaxseed if desired
2. Pour into 2 glasses and enjoy

title: potato chip chicken  gluten free
steps:
1. In large plastic bag , combine crushed potato chips , parsley , salt , paprika , and onion powder
2. Brush chicken with mayonnaise
3. Add chicken to crumb mixture and coat , shaking off extra
4. Place in greased 9x12 dish
5. Bake at 350 degrees for about 20 to 30 minutes

title: deep dish pueblo pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f lightly grease 10 inch round deep dish pan , skillet or crock pot
2. Arrange 1-2 tortillas to cover bottom of pan
3. Generously brush tortillas with 1 / 4 cup enchilada sauce
4. Spread beans over sauce and tortillas followed by half the onions and a third of the cheese
5. Place 2 more tortillas over cheese and again brush with 1 / 4 cup enchilada sauce
6. Evenly spread sour cream over sauce , place avocado slices over sour cream
7. Place a third layer of tortillas over avocados , again brush with enchilada sauce
8. Place sliced tomatoes , green chilies , remaining onion and a third of the cheese over tortillas and enchilada sauce
9. Top with remaining tortillas and spread remaining enchilada sauce to the edges , top with remaining cheese
10. Bake covered for 35 to 40 minutes
11. Cool 10 to 15 minutes before cutting into wedges
12. If using this recipe in a crock pot cook on low for 2 hours approximately

title: hot mocha pudding cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy
3. Add unbeaten egg and vanilla , mix well
4. Sift flour , baking powder , cocoa and instant coffee
5. Add to the creamed mixture alternately with the milk
6. Spread mixture evenly into 8 inch square ovenproof dish
7. To prepare topping: mix together the sugar , instant coffee and cocoa
8. Sprinkle evenly over the batter
9. Carefully pour the hot water over the top
10. Bake for 35-40 minutes
11. The sauce will be on the bottom and the cake on top
12. Spoon out some cake and sauce into serving bowls
13. Best served hot or warm

title: auntie barb s moist chocolate cake
steps:
1. In a bowl combine the sugar and margarine well and then add the buttermilk , vinegar , vanilla and eggs
2. Using a 2 cup measuring cup put the cocoa in and pour the boiling water overtop and mix well
3. Add this to the above mixture
4. Combine the flour and baking soda and add to the cocoa mixture
5. The batter will be thin
6. Pour the batter into a greased and floured 9 x 13 pan
7. Bake a 350 for 30-40 minutes or when tooth pick inserted comes out clean

title: spinach timbale
steps:
1. Pre heat oven to 180 c
2. Melt the butter in a pan , saute the onion and cook until soft but not brown
3. Add the spinach and cook for a further 5 minutes until soft , stirring once or twice
4. Add the milk and cream and heat gently without boiling
5. Beat the eggs in a bowl , take the spinach mixture off the heat and add the eggs , cheese , breadcrumbs , nutmeg , salt and pepper
6. Transfer the mixture to a greased 1
7. 1 litre ring mould and cover the mould with foil
8. Place the ring mould in a roasting dish that is half filled with hot water
9. Bake at 180 c for 1 1 / 4 hours until it is firm to the touch and a knife inserted in the middle comes out clean
10. Turn the timbale out onto a flat serving dish and garnish with slices of tomato

title: dannon low fat apple spice cake
steps:
1. In large bowl , mix flour , sugar , baking soda , baking powder , cinnamon , allspice , salt and cloves
2. Add applesauce , yogurt , egg , and oil
3. Mix well
4. Stir in raisins
5. Pour into greased and floured 12-cup bundt or 13 x 9 inch pan
6. Bake at 325 f
7. For 50- 60 mins , or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
8. Cool 15 mins
9. Serve with quick yogurt glaze: glaze: in small bowl , combine dannon plain nonfat yogurt , brown sugar and vanilla
10. Beat with fork or whisk until smooth

title: crunchy curried chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Flatten the chicken breast between two sheets of plastic or parchment paper
3. Mix the mayonnaise with the garlic , curry powder , chives and salt
4. With a knife , spread a layer of this mixture on one side of the chicken , press into the cornflakes , now spread the mixture on the side which is up , and press that in the cornflakes (use a spatula or your hands for pressing down)
5. Repeat with the rest of the chicken
6. Put on a baking tray lined with parchment paper and bake for 20-25 minutes , do not turn over , until done and lightly browned

title: black forest oreo crisp
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Mix cookie crumbs , almonds and butter until well blended
3. Set aside
4. Spoon pie filling into lightly greased 13x9-inch baking pan
5. Top with the crumb mixture
6. Bake 30 minutes or until pie filling is hot and bubbly and topping is lightly browned
7. Cool
8. Top each serving with 1 / 3 cup of the ice cream

title: basic tomato sauce for pasta
steps:
1. Add enough olive oil to cover the bottom of a large pan , add the onions and garlic , cover and sweat on a low flame for a few minutes
2. Add the tinned tomatoes , sugar , salt and pepper to taste and italian herbs
3. Cook , uncovered , on a high flame for about 20 mins or until liquid has reduced by half
4. Check seasonings
5. Blend in a food processor until smooth

title: cabbage soup ala nita
steps:
1. Prepare vegetables
2. Set aside
3. In a heavy pot or dutch oven over medium-low heat , cook bacon until browned
4. Remove and drain on paper towels
5. Reserve bacon drippings for another use , if desired
6. Add butter to pot
7. Melt over low heat
8. Add onions and stirring , saute over medium heat until tender and somewhat translucent-- 5 to 7 minutes
9. Add cabbage and carrots
10. Stir in and saute-- also stirring-- for about 5 minutes
11. Do not overcook
12. Cabbage should be just wilted good and soft
13. Add tomatoes and juice from cans
14. Add chicken broth or bouillon cubes dissolved in hot water
15. Thin with additional chicken broth or water if desired
16. Cook covered at a slow boil for about 20 minutes
17. Add dark brown sugar and black pepper
18. Top with crumbled crisp bacon
19. Serve hot

title: creamy braised brussels sprouts
steps:
1. Heat the grape seed oil in a large skillet or dutch oven over medium-high heat
2. Toss in the brussels sprouts and shallots
3. Saute , stirring occasionally until the sprouts are browned in some spots
4. About 5 minutes
5. Pour in the heavy cream , season with salt and pepper to taste , stirring to mix then cover
6. Reduce the heat to low and simmer , stirring occasionally until the sprouts are tender enough to pierce easily with a
7. Stir in the balsamic vinegar
8. Taste and add more salt and vinegar if needed
9. Simmer , uncovered for 1-2 minutes to allow the flavors to mingle
10. Be careful not to boil the mixture once you've added the heavy cream !
11. Serve immediately

title: corn salsa
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a large bowl
2. Cover and chill for several hours

title: philadelphia brownie cheesecake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Line 13x9-inch baking pan with foil , with the foil extending over the sides of the pan
3. Spray with cooking spray
4. Combine brownie mix , oil , water and 2 eggs
5. Spread brownie batter into the prepared pan
6. Bake 15 minutes or until the top of brownie is shiny and center is almost set
7. Meanwhile , beat cream cheese , sugar and vanilla in a large bowl on medium speed until well blended
8. Add sour cream and mix well
9. Add the final 3 eggs , one at a time , mixing on low speed after each egg just until well blended
10. Pour over partially baked brownie in the pan
11. Bake 40 minutes or until center is almost set and let cool
12. Refrigerate 4 hours or overnight
13. Let stand at room temperature for 30 minutes before serving
14. Lift cheesecake from pan , using foil handles
15. Drizzle with chocolate and let stand until chocolate is firm
16. Cut into 16 pieces
17. Store leftovers in the refrigerator

title: roasted pumpkin seeds   halloween thanksgiving
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400
2. Separate the seeds from the pumpkin flesh
3. Using a colander under running water to make the job a little easier
4. Remove all the flesh and the strings , so they dont burn in the oven
5. Dry the seeds with layers of paper towels or a dishtowel
6. Spread the butter onto a cookie sheet and place it in the oven
7. When the butter melts , add the pumpkins seeds
8. Season with salt
9. Mix everything together on the cookie sheet , then spread the seeds out , and place back into the oven
10. Roast for 15-30 minutes , until the pumpkin seeds are golden brown
11. Be sure to shake the pan every once in a while so the seeds dont burn
12. Remove the pan from the oven , and let cool
13. Get creative with their pumpkin seeds , and season with various herbs and spices
14. Try mixing in some garlic powder , celery powder , cajun seasoning , old bay seasoning , hot sauce , red pepper flakes or even some worchestershire sauce

title: best broccoli and cheese casserole
steps:
1. Mix together the soup , mayo , egg and onion
2. In a large bowl , fold the broccoli and the soup mix and the cheese together
3. Spread into a greased 9x13 inch pan
4. Sprinkle with salt , pepper , and paprika
5. Bake at 350 for 45 minutes

title: lucille ball special
steps:
1. Brown ground beef
2. Before done , add all other ingredients and simmer covered for 20-30 minutes

title: asian  ground beef and pepper saute
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan , bring the rice and water to a boil
2. Cover , reduce heat , and simmer 20 minutes
3. Cook the ground beef until evenly browned
4. Drain , and set aside
5. Heat the olive oil in the skillet over medium heat
6. Stir in the red bell pepper , green bell pepper , parsley , garlic and ginger
7. Season with red pepper , salt , and pepper
8. Cook and stir until tender
9. Return the beef to the skillet
10. Mix in the beef stock , soy sauce , chile paste , and worcestershire sauce
11. Cook and stir until thickened and heated through
12. Serve over the cooked rice

title: yam quesadillas
steps:
1. Saute onion and garlic in olive oil in medium skillet till translucent
2. Add oregano , basil , marjoram , chili powder , and cumin and cook another minute , till fragrant
3. Add mashed yams and stir till well combined and heated through
4. Lay tortillas out on work surface
5. Spread 1 / 2 cup filling on half of each tortilla , leaving a 1-cm border at the edge
6. Sprinkle each tortilla with 2 tablespoons cheese and fold over , pressing slightly to spread filling to edges
7. Place quesadillas on lightly oiled baking sheets
8. Brush tops with olive oil
9. Bake at 400 f for 15-20 minutes , till lightly browned
10. Serve with salsa and sour cream if desired
11. Serves 8 as a main / side dish , 32 as an appetizer

title: skordalia  greek potato   garlic dip
steps:
1. Put the potatoes in a medium saucepan and cover with cold water by 2 inches and season generously with salt
2. Bring to a boil over high heat , lower the heat to maintain a gentle simmer and cook until very tender , about 30 minutes
3. Drain the potatoes and let cool slightly
4. Rub the skins off the potatoes and discard them
5. Coarsely chop the potatoes and puree them through a food mill or ricer into a medium bowl
6. Meanwhile , on a cutting board , lightly sprinkle the garlic with a generous pinch of the salt and smash it into a fine paste with the side of a cook ? s knife
7. In a food processor , combine the garlic , almonds , and oil and puree into a paste
8. Mix the oil mixture into the potatoes until incorporated
9. Then mix in the 1 tablespoon and 1 teaspoon salt , water , lemon juice , and vinegar and season with pepper , to taste
10. Serve

title: southwestern salad
steps:
1. Poach chicken then shred
2. Mix cooked corn and chicken in a bowl with taco seasoning mix
3. Divide lettuce , beans , tomato , corn and chicken mixture among two bowls
4. Top with salsa cheese and crushed chips
5. Top with ranch dressing if you please
6. You can mul

title: beef korma
steps:
1. In a blender , combine coriander seed , cumin seed , cardamom seed , crushed red pepper , and whole cloves
2. Grind the spices to a fine powder
3. Add 1 / 3 cup water , almonds , garlic cloves , coarsely chopped gingerroot , salt , and ground cinnamon
4. Blend until the mixture has a paste consistency
5. In a 5-quart dutch oven or other large pot , brown half the meat on all sides in 1 tablespoon of hot oil
6. Remove
7. Repeat with remaining meat in batches , adding more oil as needed
8. Remove
9. Heat 2 tablespoons oil in the dutch oven and add onions
10. Cook and stir over medium-high heat for 8 to 10 minutes or until onions begin to brown
11. Reduce heat to medium
12. Add blended spice mixture
13. Cook and stir 3 to 4 minutes more , or until browned
14. Add meat and 1 / 2 cup water to the dutch oven
15. Cover and simmer for 1 1 / 2 to 1 3 / 4 hours or until the meat is tender
16. Stir occasionally and test meat's tenderness
17. Stir together whipping cream , yogurt , flour , and garam masala in a bowl
18. Stir mixture into dutch oven
19. Cook until thickened and bubbly
20. Cook and stir two minutes more
21. Transfer to a serving bowl
22. Sprinkle with snipped cilantro or parsley and serve over basmati rice

title: simply potatoes cheesy hash browns
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f spray 2 quart glass baking dish with nonstick cooking spray
2. In large bowl , combine all hash brown ingredients
3. Mix well
4. Spread into prepared baking dish
5. In small bowl stir together topping ingredients
6. Spread topping evenly over hash browns
7. Bake 45 minutes or until hash browns are tender

title: creamed onions   carrots
steps:
1. For easy peeling , cut stem from onions
2. Cook in boiling water for 5 minutes
3. Drain , rinse under cold water& slip out of their skins
4. Melt butter in a large heavy bottomed frying pan over medium-high heat
5. Add onions& cook , uncovered , stirring often , for 5 minutes
6. Sprinkle with sugar
7. Continue to cook , stirring often , until golden- about 2 or 3 minutes
8. Stir in broth , wine , garlic& bay leaf , bring to a boil , then reduce heat to medium-low
9. Partially cover& boil gently for 5 minutes
10. If any of the carrots are thicker than your baby finger , slice them lengthwise
11. Add carrots to the frying pan& continue cooking , stirring often until the onions can be easily pierced with a knifepoint , about 25 minutes
12. Remove the lid , & boil over high heat , stirring often , until the liquid is reduced to a glaze , from 12- 15 minutes
13. Remove bay leaf
14. If you aren't using right away , pour into storage container , cover& refrigerate for up to 3 days
15. Whisk cream& mustard together in a small bowl& stir into onion / carrot mixture
16. Cover& cook over medium heat , stirring often , until mixture comes to a boil
17. Uncover& simmer , stirring often , until the cream is reduced& coats the onions , about 2 minutes
18. Season to taste& sprinkle with parsley

title: pasta pea   pepper salad
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan , bring peas and 2-1 / 2 cups water to a boil
2. Reduce heat , cover and simmer 15-20 minutes or until peas are just tender
3. Drain and transfer to large bowl
4. Stir salad dressing into peas& set aside
5. Cook noodles according to package
6. Drain
7. Toss with peas and add your peppers
8. Salt and pepper to taste

title: vegetable couscous with apricots and sunflower seeds
steps:
1. In a shallow saucepan with tight fitting lid , combine europe's best romanesco concerto with water or stock
2. Bring to a boil , reduce heat
3. Cover and cook for 5 minutes or until vegetables are tender
4. Remove from heat
5. Gently stir in couscous
6. Spread over apricots , tomatoes , salt , pepper and cumin
7. Cover and let steam for 10 minutes
8. Fluff with a fork
9. Gently mix in olive oil , sunflower seeds , green onions and cilantro and serve

title: gluten free featherlight vinegar pastry
steps:
1. In a mediuim bowl , blend all of the dry ingredients until well blended
2. Cut in the shortening until coarse crumbs form
3. In a small bowl , beat the vinegar and egg together with a fork
4. Add the ice water and combine
5. Stir the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients with a fork and keep blending until the door forms a ball
6. Work a little with your hands to obtain a smooth texture
7. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes or more before rolling out
8. Divide the dough in half and roll out on waxed paper or plastic wrap dusted with flour
9. Roll out to a 11" circle , using as much flour as needed to prevent sticking
10. Place the dough in a 9" pie plate
11. Repeat with second piece of dough and cut steam vents in top if making a two crust pie
12. Fill with filling , and place second piece of pastry on top , adjust to fit
13. Roll under and crimp pastry
14. Bake as directed for filling used
15. For a baked single crust , prick the pastry with a fork on sides and bottom
16. Bake the crust in a pre-heated 450 degree oven for 10-12 minutes or until slightly browned
17. Cool before filling

title: potato curry
steps:
1. Peel potatoes and dice as evenly as possible
2. Heat oil and add spices when warm
3. Let simmer for 2 to 3 minutes , then add potatoes and stir well to coat with oil and spices
4. Continue for 5 to 10 minutes so potato cubes are slightly crisp
5. Add water , lower heat and simmer slowly for 30 minutes , stirring occasionally , until potatoes are tender
6. Add yogurt and peas , heat for another 5 minutes and serve

title: asopao de gandules con camarones
steps:
1. In a large 8qt pot , add all ingredients
2. Bring to a boil and cook for about 10 minutes
3. Bring heat to medium , continue cooking until is not to watery and not too dry

title: 90 minute bread
steps:
1. Mix water and yeast until yeast is dissolved
2. Add other ingredients
3. Stir in 11-12 cups flour - any combination of wheat or wheat / white you desire
4. Knead for 10 minutes
5. Extra flour may be needed so the dough isn't sticky
6. Divide dough into 4 sections
7. Cover and let rest for 15 minutes
8. Knead and shape into 4 loaves
9. Put in greased pans
10. Bake at 400 degrees for 30 minutes
11. Less time for rolls

title: a lighter broccoli salad
steps:
1. Mix salad ingredients
2. In separate bowl , mix dressing ingredients
3. Combine the two just before serving

title: huevos rancheros potato waffles
steps:
1. To make the waffles , in a large bowl , mix together the potatoes , salsa , eggs , cheese , salt and pepper until well combined
2. Spoon about 1 / 2 a cup of the potato mixture into each cavity of a preheated waffle iron
3. Cook until crispy and golden brown , according to your machines manufactures directions
4. Transfer the waffles to a wire rack , set over a baking sheet , to prevent the waffles from getting soggy
5. To serve the waffles , top each with a fried egg , salsa , pickled jalapeos , queso fresco , and cilantro
6. Serve with lime wedges on the side and enjoy !

title: mizzmila s italian scramble
steps:
1. In a medium bowl whisk eggs until light and frothy
2. Add to the bowl of beaten eggs the following: chopped parsley , shredded mozzarella , parmesan cheese , crushed tomatoes , hot / tabasco sauce , salt , and pepper
3. In a large non-stick saute pan melt butter over medium heat
4. Add egg mixture to the saute pan
5. Using a spatula , stir eggs sparingly until the mozzarella cheese is melted and the eggs are done to your desired consistency
6. Serve with a fennel breakfast sausage , toast , and cappuccino

title: chicken with fennel  tomatoes  and zucchini
steps:
1. Dredge the chicken in breadcrumbs
2. Heat 3 teaspoons oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
3. Add the chicken
4. Saut 3 minutes on each side or until golden brown
5. Remove from pan
6. Heat 2 teaspoons oil in pan over medium heat
7. Add fennel bulb , zucchini , and leek
8. Cook 5 minutes , stirring occasionally
9. Add broth and next 6 ingredients
10. Cover , reduce heat , and simmer 15 minutes or until the vegetables are tender , stirring occasionally
11. Return the chicken to pan
12. Cover and cook 12 minutes or until the chicken is done
13. Sprinkle with fennel fronds

title: fresh strawberry cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. For cake: sift together: flour , salt , and baking powder
3. In a separate bowl , combine butter , sugar , eggs , and vanilla
4. Beat for a total of 3 minutes , scrapping the sides of the bowl
5. Then add flour mixture to creamed mixture , alternating with strawberries
6. Beat for two minutes
7. Pour batter into two 8-inch round greased and floured cake pans
8. Bake in pre-heated oven for 25-30 minutes , or until cake tests done
9. Turn out on to wire cooling racks to cool
10. When cool , top with strawberry glaze
11. For strawberry glaze: mix together all ingredients
12. Use enough strawberries to thin mixture

title: hot spinach and artichoke dip  lower than normal fat
steps:
1. Drain any liquid that may be sitting on top of the sour cream
2. Mix everything together well
3. Bake it at 350 degrees , stirring once or twice , until heated through
4. If lazy , hungry , or just plain impatient , use the microwave
5. This mix freezes well
6. There is no need to bake before freezing
7. You may want to freeze this recipe in four 2-cup containers
8. Serve with tortilla chips or pita

title: asparagus  beans   arugula salad with mustard vinaigrette
steps:
1. Asparagus -- in a small sauce pan , fill with about 1" or a bit less of water and salt and bring to a low boil
2. Add the asparagus and cook , just 2-3 minutes depending on it's thickness
3. Then immediately remove and add to a ice bath
4. Just a bowl of water with ice
5. This will stop the cooking and keep the asparagus a bright green color
6. Just let them cool off in the ice bath for a minute then remove and let drain and dry
7. Vinaigrette -- just mix the vinegar , olive oil , mustard , garlic , lemon , sugar , salt , and pepper
8. I like to use a small tupperware and then i just shake it up
9. You can also mix it in a small measuring cup or bowl
10. Whatever is easier for you
11. Salad -- in a small bowl , i like to add the beans , asparagus , dill , and just a couple of teaspoons of the vinaigrette and toss well
12. Greens -- on your serving platter , i add the arugula , micro greens , onion and a squeeze of one of the lemon wedges and another couple of spoons of the vinaigrette and toss lightly
13. Then top with the asparagus and bean mixture
14. Just lightly toss
15. Top the whole thing with the pecorino romano , a sprig of dill and the lemon slices around the side
16. Serve -- grill some salmon or possibly chicken - slice and top the salad
17. Drizzle the vinaigrette over the top
18. This makes an amazing dinner

title: cherry amaretto dessert  low carb
steps:
1. Make the gelatin according to package directions: add boiling water to gelatin and mix until completely dissolved
2. Add the cold water and almond extract
3. Chill for 20 minutes in the refrigerator
4. Whip the cream till stiff
5. Be careful not to overbeat
6. Add the whipping cream to the gelatin
7. For a stiffer , jello-like consistency simply mix with a spoon
8. For a flufflier consistency more like light mousse , use an electric mixer and mix the cream with the jello until frothy
9. Chill until set

title: caryn s blueberry crumb pie
steps:
1. Mix all the ingredients except for the pie filling together into a sticky dough
2. Using 2 / 3 of the dough , fill a 8 inch round cake pan with the dough , pressing up the sides
3. Spread the pie filling over the dough
4. Add the remaining 1 / 3 of the dough over the pie filling
5. I usually pat out pieces flat with my hand and lay them over the filling
6. Bake at 350 degrees c for 45-60 minutes

title: heavenly pork chops
steps:
1. 1) in a small bowl , combine the first seven ingredients
2. Rub over both sides of pork chops
3. Cover
4. Refrigerate 1-4 hours
5. 2) in a shallow dish , beat egg and milk
6. In another shallow dish , combine breadcrumbs and parmesan cheese
7. Dip pork into the egg mixture , then into the crumb mixture
8. 3) spray a broiler pan with cooking spray
9. Place pork chops on the rack
10. Bake at 375 degrees f for 30 minutes
11. Remove from oven , flip the chops over , and bake on second side for about another 30 minutes

title: orange cinnamon rice pilaf
steps:
1. Melt butter in sauce pan over medium-high heat
2. Add onion
3. Saute 5 minutes
4. Add rice , juice , peel , cinnamon , cumin , and salt
5. Stir 1 minute
6. Add broth
7. Bring to simmer
8. Reduce heat to low , cover , and cook until broth is absorbed , about 19 minutes
9. Season with pepper
10. Mix in nuts

title: blue ribbon almond bear claws
steps:
1. In a bowl , toss butter with 3 cups flour until well coated
2. Refrigerate
3. In a mixing bowl , combine fleischmann's yeast and remaining flour
4. In a saucepan , heat cream , sugar and salt to 120 to 130 degrees
5. Add to yeast mixture with 1 egg
6. Mix well
7. Stir in butter mixture just until moistened
8. Turn onto a lightly floured surface
9. Knead 10 times
10. Roll into a 21x12-inch rectangle
11. Starting at a short side , fold dough in thirds , forming a 12x7-inch rectangle
12. Cover and chill for 1 hour
13. For filling , in a mixing bowl , beat egg white until foamy
14. Gradually add powdered sugar and almond paste
15. Beat until smooth
16. Cut dough in half widthwise
17. Roll each portion into a 12-inch square
18. Cut each square into three 12x4-inch strips
19. Spread about 2 tablespoons filling down center of each strip
20. Fold long edges together
21. Seal edges and ends
22. Cut into three pieces
23. Place on greased baking sheets with folded edge facing away from you
24. With scissors , cut strips four times to within 1 / 2-inch of folded edge
25. Separate slightly
26. Repeat with remaining dough and filling
27. Cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled , about 1 hour
28. Lightly beat water and remaining egg
29. Brush over dough
30. Sprinkle with sugar and almonds
31. Bake at 375 degrees for 15 minutes or until golden brown
32. Remove from pans to wire racks to cool

title: green chile  chicken enchiladas
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees
2. Wrap tortillas in foil and heat in oven until warm and soft
3. Meanwhile , , in a large heavy saucepan or cast iron skillet , saut onion in oil for 3-4 minutes
4. Add spices and green chilies , cooking over a low heat
5. Add salsa and chicken , increasing heat to medium and stir until hot
6. In the bottom of a 13 x 9 inch casserole , spread about 1 / 4 of the enchilada sauce
7. Place even amounts of the chicken mixture on each tortilla , roll up , and place in baking dish seam-side down
8. Pour the remaining sauce over the top and sprinkle with cheese
9. Bake for 15-20 minutes at 375 degrees until the cheese is hot / bubbly and a little browned

title: broccoli and bacon pasta bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180c
2. Cook pasta according to the directions on the packet
3. Drain and return to pan
4. Heat the oil in a frying pan over a medium heat
5. Add the bacon and onion and cook until soft and lightly browned
6. Break the broccoli into small florets
7. Cook the broccoli and peas in a steamer until tender
8. Gently mix together the broccoli , bacon , onion , peas and cheese sauce
9. Spread into a 2 litre ovenproof dish
10. Sprinkle with cheese
11. Bake until golden
12. About 15 - 20 minutes
13. Serve with mashed potatoes and a salad if desired

title: mexi ground beef rice skillet
steps:
1. In a medium 4-quart heavy pot over medium heat cook the ground beef or sausage meat with onion , garlic , bell pepper and jalapeno pepper
2. Cook until browned then drain fat
3. Add in the taco seasoning mix with a wooden spoon until well combined
4. Add in all remaining ingredients except the cheese
5. Stir with a wooden spoon to combine and bring to a simmer over medium heat
6. Reduce heat to medium-low or low
7. Cover and simmer for 25 minutes or until the rice is tender
8. Season with seasoned salt and pepper
9. Mix in 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese until melted , the sprinkle the top with 1 cup
10. Let stand for 5 minutes until melted

title: buttermilk toaster pancakes
steps:
1. Preheat griddle
2. Beat eggs with brown sugar until very light , about 2 minutes
3. Mix dry ingredients
4. Stir gently into beaten eggs
5. Add buttermilk and oil
6. Stir only until mixed
7. Batter will be lumpy
8. For each pancake , pour 1 / 4 cup batter onto hot griddle
9. Cook until surface is covered with bubbles , turn , and cook other side until light brown
10. Cool on rack
11. Place pancakes in an airtight container with waxpaper between layers
12. Or wrap singly in foil
13. Label and store in freezer
14. To reheat in toaster: remove from freezer and unwrap pancakes to be reheated
15. Set toaster on medium-low setting
16. Toast pancakes , twice if necessary , to heat through

title: quick blueberry delight bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Spray a 9x5 loaf pan set aside
3. In a large bowl , whisk together flour , brown sugar , baking powder , baking soda , and salt
4. Set aside
5. In a medium bowl , combine butter , egg , vanilla and milk
6. Add wet mixture to dry mixture and whisk to combine , gently fold in blueberries
7. Pour batter into prepared pan
8. The batter will feel rather thick
9. In a small bowl mix the turbinado sugar and cinnamon and sprinkle over loaf before baking
10. Bake for 50-55 minutes or until tooth pick inserted in middle of loaf comes out clean

title: oven roasted spicy sweet sweet potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f line a roasting pan large enough to contain your potato pieces
2. Mix butter , honey , lime juice , chile powder , cumin and cayenne together
3. Coat sweet potatoes with butter / honey / spice mixture and season to taste with salt and pepper
4. Empty into prepared roasting pan
5. Bake for 25 minutes
6. Give potatoes a stir to redistribute and recoat with liquid
7. Bake 20 minutes longer , or until potatoes are tender all the way through when pierced with the

title: buttermilk cornbread
steps:
1. Combine dry ingredients and set aside
2. Mix eggs , buttermilk oil , applesauce , and honey
3. Gently fold in dry ingredients , mix just until blended
4. Batter will be lumpy
5. Pour into greased 9x13 pan
6. Bake at 400 degrees for about 20 minutes or until lightly browned
7. Also makes 12 muffins , if desired

title: green beans with shallots and red bell pepper
steps:
1. Cook beans in boiling water to cover in a dutch oven 3 to 4 minutes or until crisp-tender
2. Drain
3. Melt butter in dutch oven over medium-high heat
4. Add shallots and bell pepper , and saute 4 minutes or until tender
5. Add beans
6. Toss with salt , pepper , and garlic powder

title: easter scrambled eggs  1950
steps:
1. Combine eggs , cream , and salt and pepper in a bowl
2. Beat lightly
3. Mix in chives and chili sauce
4. Melt butter in a skillet over medium-low heat
5. Add egg mixture and cook , stirring , until done to your liking

title: lobscouse  sailor s beef stew    skipper labskovs
steps:
1. Brown meat and cook onions in the butter , stirring occasionally
2. Add stock , beer , bay leaves , salt and pepper
3. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes
4. Add potatoes and continue to simmer for 2 hours
5. Mash any remaining pieces of potato , so that you have a thick'gravy' with just a few pieces of potato
6. Serve in bowl with 1 tablespoon butter on top
7. Sprinkle with onion tops

title: tater dipped oven fried chicken
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit
2. Place margarine in a 13 x 9-inch baking dish
3. Melt in oven
4. In plastic bag , combine potato flakes , garlic salt , seasoned pepper , and seasoning salt
5. Add chicken one at a time and shake in the plastic bag
6. Place chicken skin-side down in melted margarine
7. Bake 30 minutes , uncovered , turn chicken
8. Bake 30 minutes more

title: horseradish mustard dipping sauce
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine all ingredients
2. Serve with deli meats , crackers or raw veggies

title: cream cheese cheddar biscuits
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees
2. Measure dry ingredients into food processor and pulse until well combined
3. Add cheese and cut butter and cream cheese into small chunks and distribute throughout processor bowl
4. Hit pulse about 10 times for 1-2 seconds each pulse until course crumbs develop
5. Pour milk through feed tube in a slow stream while pulsing until cohesive but crumbly dough forms
6. Turn dough onto floured surface and gently squeeze it into a ball
7. Flatten and gently shape into an 8 by 8 inch square
8. Cut into 16 even squares
9. Place on ungreased baking sheet and bake 15-18 minutes until lightly browned

title: seaweed and split pea soup
steps:
1. Soak the split peas overnight
2. Drain and cover with water and bring to the boil
3. Lower the heat then cover and simmer for 20 minutes
4. Meanwhile cover the wakame with cold water and leave to soak
5. Chop the carrot and onion finely
6. Drain and chop the wakame , discarding the tough centre
7. Add the seaweed , carrots and onion to the pot
8. Continue to simmer for about 25 minutes
9. Remove from heat , add the tahini and the soy sauce and salt to taste
10. Serve immediately

title: acadia s eggplant and pepper w velveeta
steps:
1. Chop onion into 1 / 4" pieces
2. In skillet add 1 tablespoon of margarine
3. On low heat saute onion until translucent
4. Add bell pepper and eggplant pieces with onion
5. Sprinkle salt over mixture
6. Stir
7. Saute until tender
8. Add velveeta cheese by placing cheese on top of mixture
9. When it melts , stir the whole mixture together so cheese coats vegetables
10. Enjoy

title: tex mex chicken and rice
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Spread rice evenly into a greased 2 1 / 2 quart glass baking dish
3. Top with chicken
4. Sprinkle with onions and garlic
5. In a bowl , mix together remaining ingredients
6. Spoon over last layer
7. Cover and bake 1 hour

title: vegetable and pasta toss
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to package directions omitting any oil
2. Add broccoli and cauliflower to boiling pasta for the last minute of cooking
3. Drain
4. Rinse with cold water
5. Drain well
6. Cook artichoke hearts according to package directions
7. Drain
8. Rinse with cold water
9. Drain well
10. Halve any large pieces
11. In a large mixing bowl combine pasta mixture , artichoke hearts , carrot and green onions
12. Add the italian dressing
13. Toss to coat
14. Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours
15. If desired , serve on lettuce lined plates

title: pam s african chicken stew
steps:
1. In a large skillet with a tight-fitting lid , heat oil over medium high heat
2. Add chicken , and brown quickly
3. Remove chicken from pan
4. Reduce heat to medium low , and add garlic , onion and sweet potato to the pan
5. Cook for 5 to 7 minutes
6. Season with cumin , coriander , red pepper , and salt and pepper
7. Mix in chicken broth and browned chicken
8. Place lid on skillet and simmer , stirring occasionally , for 10 to 15 minutes
9. Remove lid , and stir in the peanut butter and garbanzo beans
10. Make sure the peanut butter is blended well
11. Replace lid to simmer for 2 more minutes

title: stromboli appetizers for a crowd
steps:
1. Let dough rise until doubled , according to package directions
2. Punch down
3. Roll each loaf into 15" x 12" rectangle
4. Arrange a fourth of the salami , ham , pepperoni and provolone cheese over each rectangle
5. Sprinkle each with a fourth of the mozzarella cheese , romano cheese , garlic powder , oregano , parsley and pepper
6. Roll up each rectangle jelly roll style beginning with the long side
7. Seal seams and ends
8. Place seam side down on two greased baking sheets
9. Brush with egg yolk
10. Bake at 375f for 25-30 minutes or until golden brown
11. Let stand for 5 minutes before slicing
12. Serve warm
13. Refrigerate leftovers
14. Good cold too !

title: flambed shrimp with tomatoes  feta cheese  and ouzo
steps:
1. Heat 1 tablespoon of the oil in a 12-inch skillet over high heat until just smoking
2. Meanwhile , pat the shrimp dry with paper towels and season with salt , pepper , and sugar
3. Add half of the shrimp to the skillet in a single layer and cook , without stirring , until the bottoms of the shrimp turn spotty brown , about 30 seconds
4. Off the heat , flip the shrimp over , then transfer to a medium bowl and repeat with 1 more tablespoon oil and the remaining shrimp
5. Add the remaining 2 tablespoons oil , onion , and 1 / 2 teaspoon salt to the skillet and cook over medium heat until the onion is softened , 5 to 7 minutes
6. Stir in the garlic , oregano , and red pepper flakes and cook until fragrant , about 30 seconds
7. Stir in the tomatoes and 1 / 2 cup of their juice and cook until thickened slightly , about 2 minutes
8. Stir the reserved shrimp and accumulated juices and ouzo into the skillet
9. Ignite the ouzo and shake the skillet until the flames subside
10. Sprinkle with the feta and parsley before serving
11. To flambe on an electric stove , add the ouzo to the pan , wave a lit match over the pan until the ouzo ignites , and then shake the skillet
12. Be careful

title: stuffed mexican chicken medallions
steps:
1. Place poblano peppers , skin-side up , on foil-lined baking sheet
2. Broil until skin is black and blistered
3. Fold foil around peppers and let steam at room temperature until skin has softened , about 5 minutes
4. Discard blackened skin
5. Season chicken with salt and pepper
6. Place single layer of spinach in center of each breast
7. Top with 1 / 4 cup cheese , 1 tablespoon sun-dried tomatoes and 1 roasted pepper quarter
8. Roll up chicken to enclose filling
9. Wrap each chicken roll tightly in plastic wrap , twisting ends to secure
10. Chill for at least 1 hour
11. Remove plastic wrap from chicken and secure rolls with toothpicks
12. Place flour on sheet of waxed paper
13. Dip chicken in flour , shaking off excess
14. In a large skillet , heat olive oil over medium-high heat
15. Place chicken in skillet seam-side down and cook until golden brown on all sides , about 2 minutes per side
16. Place chicken on foil-lined jellyroll pan and bake in a 400 degree oven about 15 minutes , or until temperature reaches 165 degrees
17. Cover and let stand 5 minutes , remove toothpicks , then slice into medallions
18. Serve over creamy chipotle sauce

title: chori queso or choriqueso tacos
steps:
1. Fry the chorizo in oil until completely "browned" and very crispy
2. Keep the chorizo on heat that's just high enough to keep it hot
3. Heat another pan over medium heat
4. When the pan is hot , place a corn tortilla in the bottom for about 15-30 seconds and then flip it and repeat this with the opposite side
5. Cut a reasonable piece of mexican cheese and place on one half of the tortilla in the hot pan
6. When it starts to melt , spoon about a tablespoon of chorizo onto the melting cheese , fold the tortilla in half and immediately remove the taco from the heat
7. Stuff a little guacamole , salsa , queso blanco , sour cream or whatever you prefer in the tortilla to keep it company and immediately eat
8. These are good hot -- so don't bother making a bunch ahead
9. This is the kind of food you cook for people standing around in the kitchen so they can eat it fresh

title: risotto verde
steps:
1. In large sauce pan bring stock to a boil
2. Reduce to a simmer
3. Heat olive oil in separate large sauce pan
4. Saute garlic and leeks until softened
5. Add rice and cook for two minutes , stirring frequently
6. Add half the wine to rice mixture and about 1 / 2 cup of the hot stock
7. Cook on medium low until all liquid has been absorbed
8. Add the remainder of stock and white wine and cook over low heat for 25 minutes , until rice is creamy
9. Stir in basil and baby spinach
10. Season with salt and pepper and cook for 2 minutes
11. Add plain yogurt and mix well
12. Serve hot

title: easy crescent sausage and cheese appetizers
steps:
1. Prepare a lage baking sheet and spray with non-stick cooking spray
2. Unroll the crescent dough and separate on the perforations into individual triangles
3. Spread about 1 teaspoon honey mustard on each crescent
4. Sprinkle about 1 tablespoon grated cheese on the mustard
5. Arrange one sausage quarter on the triangle
6. Fold the short side of the dough over the sausage , continue to roll up
7. Arrange sausage rolls seam-side down on the prepared baking sheet
8. At this point you can cover and refrigerate up to 1 day until ready to bake
9. Set oven to 375 degrees
10. Bake the crescents until the dough is golden , about 20 minutes

title: chocolate almond crisps
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 325f
2. Line a couple of cookie trays with parchment paper
3. In a food processor , process the almonds with the sugar until finely ground
4. Add the cocoa , spices and broken up chocolate and process again , until the chocolate is finely ground
5. Process in the egg whites and the extract until it blends and forms a mass
6. Remove the dough , let sit for about 5 minutes
7. Roll out on a board sprinkled with icing sugar
8. Cut with cookie cutters and place on the trays
9. Bake in the centre of the oven for 10 to 12 minutes until almost firm and slightly puffed
10. They should not be browned
11. Let cool then peel from the paper

title: pasta in a creamy gorgonzola sauce
steps:
1. Heat wine to boiling , cook until reduced by half
2. Whisk in cream cheese until smooth , heat to boiling
3. Reduce heat to low and simmer uncovered , stirring frequently , until thickened , about 15 minutes
4. Stir in seasonings
5. Meanwhile , cook pasta according package directions
6. Stir in parmesan cheese and half of gorgonzola into cream sauce , pour over pasta: sprinkle with remaining gorgonzola cheese and parsley , serve

title: jamburger   hamburger  quiche perfect for midweek
steps:
1. Brown meat and drain
2. Mix meat and next 4 ingredients
3. When mixed well , stir in the rest of the ingredients
4. Put the mixture into the pie crust
5. Bake 40-45 minutes at 350 degrees

title: blackeyed peas and cajun sausage
steps:
1. Pick and wash peas
2. Combine in sauce pan with sausage , water , seasons , onions and pepper
3. Cover and simmer over low flame for 1 and 1 1 / 2 hour or until tender
4. Add water if needed
5. You want to have enough water to make thick gravy
6. Add green onions and serve over rice

title: almond lemon tea cake
steps:
1. Position a rack in the lower third of the oven
2. Preheat oven to 350
3. Lightly butter and flour an 8 inch tube pan or a 9x5 inch loaf pan , knocking out the excess flour
4. Make the cake: sift together the flour , baking powder , and salt twice
5. In a small bowl , combine the eggs and vanilla
6. Whisk just to combine
7. In the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with paddle attachment , beat the almond paste on low speed until it breaks up
8. This can take up to a minute , depending on how soft and warm it is
9. Slowly add the sugar in a steady stream , beating until incorporated
10. If you add the sugar too quickly , the paste wont break up as well
11. Cut butter into 1 tablespoon pieces
12. Continue on low speed while adding the butter , a tablespoon at a time , for about 1 minute
13. Stop the mixer and scrape down the sides of the bowl with a rubber spatula
14. Then turn on the mixer to medium speed
15. Beat until mixture is light in color and fluffy , 3-4 minutes
16. With the mixer still on medium , add the eggs in a very slow , steady stream and mix until incorporated
17. Stop the mixer and again scrape down the sides
18. Resume mixer at medium speed and mix for another 30 seconds
19. Add in the citrus zest and mix in with a wooden spoon
20. Finally , add the flour mixture in batches , stirring after each addition until incorporated
21. Scrape down the sides of the bowl one last time
22. Spoon batter into prepared pan
23. Smooth the surface with an offset spatula
24. Bake 45-50 minutes , until the top springs back when lightly touched and a pick comes out clean
25. Let cool in pan on a wire rack for 5-7 minutes
26. Meanwhile , stir together the lemon and orange juices and sugar in a small bowl
27. Place the wire rack holding the cake over a sheet of waxed paper or foil to catch any drips
28. Invert the cake onto the rack
29. Brush the entire warm cake with the glaze , then let the cake cool completely on the rack
30. When the cake is cool , transfer it to a serving plate
31. Serve at room temperature

title: zucchini blueberry muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees f and grease a muffin pan with pam
2. Combine zucchini , applesauce , oats , flours , egg , sugar , and lemon juice in a bowl
3. Let this mixture sit for about 15 minutes
4. In the meantime , mix together the baking soda , baking powder , salt , and cinnamon
5. Fold this into the first mixture
6. Stir in blueberries and add a dash of vanilla
7. Scoop the batter into muffin pan and sprinkle with cinnamon
8. Bake for approximately 25 minutes
9. You can also double the recipe and still make only twelve , to make larger , heartier muffins

title: no bake fudgy brownies
steps:
1. 1 grease 8-inch square baking pan or line with foil
2. 2 in a medium saucepan over low heat , combine the sweetened milk and chocolate
3. Cook and stir just until boiling
4. Reduce heat
5. Cook and stir for 2-3 minutes or until mixture thickens
6. 3 remove from heat and stir in vanilla
7. 4 stir in 2 cups of cookie crumbs
8. Spread evenly in prepared pan
9. Sprinkle with remaining cookie crumbs and sprinkles or nuts
10. Press down gently with a spatula
11. 5 cover and chill 4 hours or until firm
12. Cut into squares
13. Store covered in refrigerator

title: tortellini and cheese
steps:
1. In a large saucepan cook tortellini according to package directions
2. Place frozen vegetable in colander
3. Drain the hot pasta over vegetables to thaw
4. Return pasta-vegetable mixture to pan
5. Meanwhile , in a small saucepan combine cream cheese and milk
6. Heat and stir until cheese is melted
7. Heat chicken according to package directions
8. Stir cheese sauce into cooked pasta-vegetable mixture
9. Cook and gently stir until heated through
10. Spoon into individual serving bowls
11. Top with chicken

title: my pasta beef stew
steps:
1. Saute meat in large dutch oven and sprinkle with flour and brown
2. Stir in seasonings and tomato juice
3. Cover and simmer on medium heat for 1 hour , stirring occasionally
4. Stir in onions , carrots and turnips and simmer another 30 minutes
5. Add pasta and cook another 20 minutes for bows and shells and only 5 minutes for macaroni
6. Stirring occasionally
7. Add frozen peas and cook 10 minutes more
8. Check seasonings and adjust

title: greek macaroni   hamburger casserole  makaronia phournista
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Put water , salt , olive oil and in a large pot and bring to a boil
3. Add macaroni , cook until well done , and drain
4. Melt butter in sauce pan , add tomato paste , stir and mix well
5. Add sugar , salt , cinnamon , oregano , orange rind , orange juice , bay leaves , and cloves , and stir well
6. Continue stirring while slowly adding warm water
7. Cover and simmer until only 2 / 3 of the liquid remains
8. Season beef with salt and pepper , and saut in olive oil until meat is dry , breaking up meat while browning , so it will not be lumpy when done
9. Add onions and garlic and continue to saut until onion is yellow
10. Pour wine over this mixture , stir well , cover tightly , and set aside
11. When only 2 / 3 of the liquid remains in the tomato sauce , add the ground beef mixture
12. Continue to simmer covered until sauce is thickened
13. Keep hot
14. Put layers in a baking pan in the following order: macaroni meat sauce kephalotiri cheese
15. Keep layering until everything is used up , with the last layer being the meat / tomato sauce
16. Cover the top layer with a single layer of kaseri cheese
17. Bake until the kasseri is melted
18. Serve hot

title: gary rhodes   sticky toffee pudding
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f and grease an 11x7 inch baking dish
2. Boil the dates in the water for about 5 minutes until soft , then add the baking soda
3. Cream the butter and sugar together until light and fluffy , then add the eggs and beat well
4. Mix in the dates , flour and vanilla , then pour into the greased baking pan and cook in the preheated oven for about 30-40 minutes , or until just firm to the touch
5. To make the sauce , simply place all the ingredients in a pan over a low heat and stir together until blended , then bring to the boil
6. Some of this can be poured over the pudding and finished under the broiler , or it can be kept totally separate and ladled over the pudding when served

title: bloody mary salad
steps:
1. Dressing: in a saucepan over medium-high , heat the olive oil
2. Saute the shallots until soft about 2-3 minutes
3. Deglaze the pan with vodka
4. Simmering until almost all evaporated
5. Add the v8 juice , worcestershire sauce , vinegar , mustard , sugar , horseradish , celery seed , and fresh lemon juice
6. Boil the mixture for 5 minutes
7. Season with salt and pepper to taste
8. Remove from heat and chill
9. Dressing can be prepared several hours in advance
10. Salad: toss remaining ingredients together and season with salt and pepper
11. Divide the mixture among 4 plates , arranging on each plate a shot glass filled with the salad dressing , placed to the side

title: pineapple   raspberry smoothie
steps:
1. Place everything in blender and blend until smooth and frothy
2. Poor into glass and enjoy !

title: oven fried spicy chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. In a ziploc bag , combine cornmeal and next 5 ingredients
3. Shake well to combine
4. Dip chicken pieces in milk and place 2 pieces at a time in the bag and shake to coat the chicken well
