5. Place the chicken skin side up in a 13x9 pan
6. Drizzle butter over the chicken and bake 50-55 minutes or until no pink remains

title: silver state brownies
steps:
1. Cream margarine , add sugar
2. Beat eggs and add to mixture , add vanilla
3. Mix cocoa and flour together and stir into mixture
4. Stir in nuts
5. Pour into 9 x 13 greased and floured pan
6. Sprinkle with mini chocolate chips
7. Bake at 350 degrees for 25 to 30 minutes

title: oven barbecued st  louis style ribs
steps:
1. -------- the sauce will take a few hours ! ---------
2. If you don't have that kind of time , use a commercial sauce and skip to cutting and baking ribs
3. Do this step the night before or a few hours before serving
4. You are making your own bbq sauce ! stir ingredients , beginning with water , into a stock pot
5. Bring to a boil
6. Allow to boil for about 15 minute stirring occasionally
7. Simmer uncovered , allow to reduce to desired thickness
8. Preheat oven to 350f when sauce has reached desired thickness
9. Cut ribs into serving sizes
10. Place in greased roasting pan or casserole dish
11. Sprinkle with garlic salt to taste
12. Bake uncovered for 45 minutes bone side up
13. Drain the grease off the ribs
14. Pour sauce over ribs
15. Cover with aluminum foil and bake for 1 hour
16. Uncover and bake for an additional 30 minutes , basting the ribs 2-3 times during final stage

title: apache green chili
steps:
1. Brown meat in a little oil
2. Heat water , add spices , meat , chilies , onion , etc
3. Bring to a slow boil
4. Turn down and simmer 2 to 3 hours
5. Thicken with flour and water
6. If you desire more "spice" add picante sauce or more chilies and jalapenos

title: black eyed peas in the crock pot
steps:
1. Chop bacon into 1 inch pieces
2. Add to medium pan and cook until crispy
3. Do not drain off the grease !
4. Add onion , celery , and garlic to bacon and cook for 5 minutes
5. Add all of the ingredients from the pan including the bacon grease to crock pot
6. Add remainder of ingredients to crock pot
7. Cook on low for 2 hours or on high for 1 hour
8. Stir and serve on rice
9. Enjoy

title: margie s salmon macaroni salad
steps:
1. In a large bowl combine salmon , green pepper , green onion , mayonnaise , worcestershire sauce , lemon pepper and lemon juice
2. Mix together
3. Add hot cooked macaroni and toss together
4. Salad can be served at once or refrigerated and served cold

title: slow cooker hearty beef chili
steps:
1. Brown meat
2. Drain
3. Add to slow cooker with remaining ingredients except cheese
4. Stir
5. Cover with lid
6. Cook on low 5 to 6 hours
7. Stir just before serving
8. Serve topped with cheese
9. Serving suggestion: serve with a simple side of ritz crackers

title: california shrimp dip
steps:
1. Mix soup mix with sour cream
2. Add shrimp and catsup
3. Chill for 2 hours

title: grandma s one bowl molasses applesauce cake
steps:
1. Sift dry ingredients , cut in butter
2. Stir in molasses , egg , applesauce , raisins
3. Pour into greased and floured 8" square pan
4. Bake 350 for 40-45 minute
5. Drizzle with glaze when cool

title: gilded saffron and butter basted roast turkey with herb garland
steps:
1. Pre-heat the oven to 170c / 350f or gas mark 4
2. Wipe the turkey , and remove any giblets from inside the bird if necessary
3. Smear the butter all over the bird and place the onion , herbs and lemon inside the body cavity
4. Season the bird with salt and pepper to taste
5. Place the buttered bird into a foil lined turkey tray
6. Cut a piece of greaseproof paper or baking parchment and press this over the breast part of the bird - to prevent the breast becoming too dry during cooking
7. Cover the turkey with 2 large pieces of tinfoil / aluminum foil - making sure the foil does not touch the bird - you are creating a tent - with lots of air to circulate inside !
8. Cook in the preheated oven for 20 minutes per pound , plus 20 minutes - so a 10lb turkey will take about 3 hours and 40 minutes
9. Try to take the turkey out at least twice during cooking time , to baste it with the buttery juices
10. Replace the foil cover before putting it back to continue cooking in the oven
11. Whilst the bird is cooking , prepare your gilded glaze - choose which one you prefer , egg glaze or butter glaze
12. Whisk the egg yolks with the saffron and melted butter
13. It needs to be the consistancy of a coating glaze , or a thick pouring cream or custard
14. If you are using just the butter glaze - whisk the saffron and melted butter together - this glaze will be thinner than the egg glaze
15. Twenty minutes before the end of the cooking time , remove the turkey from the oven , and drain off all the juices for your gravy
16. Turn the oven up to 190c / 380f or gas mark 5
17. Apply your gilded glaze to the turkey with a large pastry brush - brush it all over the turkey as evenly as you can and not too thickly with the egg glaze
18. Return the turkey to the oven uncovered for the last 20 minutes - remove from the oven and allow to "rest" for 30 minutes before carving
19. Remove the herbs , lemon and onion from the cavity before carving and serving
20. Make the herb garland - twist sprigs of thyme , bay and rosemary together with some cooking string or twine , to form a circlet
21. Serve the turkey adorned with a twisted garland of herbs , and with traditional accompaniments such as: roast potatoes , mixed vegetables , red cabbage , gravy , stuffing , bacon rolls and chipolata sausage rolls
22. You can also "gild" the turkey by sprinkling edible gold dusting powder over the breast and legs of the turkey - this is available from specialist cake decorating shops

title: i want more zucchini soup
steps:
1. Melt butter in a skillet add diced zucchini , onions and 1 minced clove of garlic
2. Cover and cook 10 minutes until soft but not brown
3. Combine half of the zucchini mixture , 2 cups of the chicken broth , curry powder , salt and cayenne in a food processor or blender
4. Puree
5. Pour into large soup pot
6. Repeat pureeing with remaining 2cups of chicken broth and remainder of zucchini mixture
7. Combine the 2 batches into a large soup pot and cook until hot
8. Serve with your favorite bread recipe
9. Comfort !

title: pudding oatmeal cookies
steps:
1. Mix flour with baking soda
2. Combine butter , the sugars and pudding mix in a large mixing bowl
3. Beat until smooth and creamy
4. Beat in the egg
5. Gradually add flour mixture , then stir in oats and the raisins
6. Drop rounded teaspoonfuls on ungreased baking sheet
7. Bake at 375f about 10-12 minutes
8. Other flavor pudding mixes can be used

title: omg tropical smoothie
steps:
1. Very simple instructions for this incredible tasting , thick texture , amazingly tasty smoothie add everything in your blender
2. Mix on"cream" setting for 30-45 seconds
3. Makes enough for 2 big glasses full so you can share !
4. Enjoy it , i know i will

title: strawberry or raspberry bisque
steps:
1. Combine berries and sugar and mix well
2. Stir in lemon juice
3. Run berries through blender or food processor briefly to break them up
4. Melt butter in a saucepan and blend in flour
5. Add cream cheese and milk all at once and immediately stir vigorously over moderate heat
6. Continue to cook until thickened , stirring frequently to create a sauce-like consistency , although it will stay a bit thin
7. Cool , stirring occasionally
8. Chill
9. Just before serving , stir berries gradually into the sauce

title: aunt sharon s pork and bean bake
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl combine pork & beans , green pepper , onion , bacon , molasses , ketchup , mustard , and worcestershire sauce
2. Stir to incorporate all ingredients
3. Pour into a baking dish and bake at 350 for 30 minutes or until heated through

title: tuscan bean soup with arugula in crockpot
steps:
1. Saute the onion , carrots , and celery in the olive oil
2. Dump the beans in crock pot
3. Add the water and boullion
4. I cooked the beans on high for 4 hours and they were done
5. If you want to cook longer put on slow
6. My crock pot runs kinda hot so judge by your cooker
7. Cook until you get home
8. You may need to add water later
9. Add arugula , which has been minced fine , and parmesan cheese for the last 15 minutes of cooking
10. Garnish with a dash of lemon juice in bowl

title: cinnamon sugar muffins
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl combine flour , the 1 / 2 cup sugar , baking powder , nutmeg and salt
2. Make a well in the center of the dry ingredients
3. In another bowl , beat egg slightly
4. Stir in milk and 1 / 3 cup melted butter or margarine
5. Add egg mixture to flour mixture
6. Stir just until moistened
7. Lightly grease 12 muffin cups
8. Fill cups about two-thirds full with batter
9. Bake in 350 f oven for 20 to 25 minutes or until muffins are golden
10. Meanwhile , in a shallow bowl combine the 1 / 4 cup sugar and cinnamon
11. Immediately dip tops of hot muffins into the 1 / 4 cup melted butter or margarine , then into the cinnamon-sugar mixture until coated
12. You need to work quickly as the muffins are hot
13. Baked muffins can be placed into freezer containers or bags and frozen up to 1 month
14. It really depends on how much you fill each muffin cup
15. I was able to get all 12 muffins from this recipe

title: i did it my way  tossed salad
steps:
1. Combine first 6 ingredients and stir well
2. Add lettuce and toss
3. Throw in the olives
4. Sprinkle on the cheese
5. Enjoy with or without the dressing !

title: quick beer pizza dough
steps:
1. Mix and knead together all the ingredients - by hand , mixer or bread machine - until you've made a smooth , soft dough
2. Cover the dough , and allow it to rise for 30 minutes or up to 2 hours
3. Preheat the oven to 500f with a pizza stone on a lower rack
4. Divide the dough in half
5. Shape each half into a 10" to 12" round
6. Place the rounds on parchment paper , if you're going to use a pizza stone
7. Or place the dough on a lightly greased or parchment-lined baking sheet
8. Transfer the pizzas , parchment and all to the baking stone
9. Or place the pans in the oven
10. Bake for 3 to 4 minutes
11. Remove from the oven , top as desired , and bake for an additional 15 to 20 minutes , until the bottom crust is crisp and the cheese is bubbly and browned
12. Remove from the oven , and serve hot

title: farfalle with cauliflower and sausage
steps:
1. Preheat your oven to 450f
2. Poke sausage links with a knife several times
3. Combine sausage , cauliflower and 1 tablespoon oil in a roasting pan
4. Sprinkle with 1 / 4 teaspoon salt
5. Roast at 450f for 15 minutes
6. Add garlic to the pan , stir to combine
7. Continue roasting for 5 more minutes , or until sausage is done
8. Let rest for 5 minutes
9. Cut sausage links into 1 / 4 inch slices
10. Cook pasta in boiling salted water until al dente
11. Drain pasta , reserving 2 tablespoons of the cooking water
12. In a large serving bowl , combine pasta , reserved water , 1 tablespoon oil , 1 / 4 teaspoon salt , and crushed red pepper
13. Add cauliflower mixture , sausage , and cheese
14. Toss gently to combine
15. Sprinkle with black pepper , and serve

title: christina s surprise spread
steps:
1. Mix first three ingredients
2. Spread into a pie plate or onto a pizza pan
3. Spread the cocktail sauce on next
4. Top with green onions , shrimp , tomatoes , green peppers and cheese
5. Cover and chill for at least 2 hours
6. Serve with crackers and chips -- make lots it disappears fast !

title: napa salad
steps:
1. Put slaw in a large bowl
2. Add diced onions
3. Break up ramen noodles and add them to bowl set the bowl aside
4. Melt butter in a skillet and brown almonds and sunflower seeds
5. Cool the almonds and sunflower seeds , then add them to the bowl
6. Place all of the dressing ingredients in a separate bowl
7. Whisk together and pour over slaw mixture
8. Serve immediately

title: salmon in thai red curry sauce
steps:
1. Heat oil and fry lemon grass for less than a minute or until very fragrant
2. Blend in red curry paste , stirring to break it up until it is fragrant
3. Do not let it burn
4. Stir in coconut milk until well blended and lower heat to simmer
5. Stir in brown sugar and fish sauce and add kaffir lime leaves
6. Allow to simmer at least 15 to 20 minutes or until oil begins to separate
7. Add salmon fillets and poach in sauce on medium heat until cooked
8. Serve immediately

title: seared tuna steak w wasabi green onion mayo
steps:
1. Whisk first 4 ingredients in small bowl , cover and refrigerate --
2. Whisk teriyaki , soy , vinegar and i also added some grated ginger to make your marinade -- marinate and refrigerate your tuna steaks for several hours -- remove from fridge while the grill heats up
3. Brush grill and fish lightly with oil and salt & pepper
4. Grill tuna on high heat for 2 mins , turn over and grill 2 mins on high heat to sear , then lower temp and grill until desired doneness -- serve with the yummy wasabi sauce !

title: mexican style meat and vegetable stew   azteca s molcajete
steps:
1. Fry the bacon in a large skillet until crispy
2. Remove from pan , reserving drippings , cut into small pieces , and set aside
3. Add the oil to the bacon drippings over medium temperature , then saut the chicken and beef strips until browned , stirring occasionally , about 7 minutes
4. In another large saucepan over medium heat , stir together the boiling water and bouillon granules until dissolved
5. Add remaining ingredients and the cooked meat strips , and simmer for 10 minutes
6. Garnish , serve , and enjoy !
7. If the soup isn't as thick as you'd like it to be , try adding a can of refried beans - it works well ! we've also served it with crisp tortilla strips and a dollop of mexican crema instead of monterey jack
8. It's a versatile recipe , so experiment and enjoy yourself ! :) if you have made the rich and delicious enchilada sauce recipe of mine , you might recognize many of the soup ingredients - to make the sauce into soup , use 2 cups of the sauce , add 1 cup hot water and 1 / 2 teaspoon chicken stock granules , then add the cooked chicken and garnish ingredients as usual

title: grapes with butterscotch sauce
steps:
1. Bring cream , salt and sugar to a boil and boil 10 minutes , stirring frequently
2. Remove from heat and stir in sour cream and vanilla
3. Place grapes into four serving dishes
4. Pour over sauce and sprinkle with almonds

title: tomato salad with fresh basil vinaigrette
steps:
1. Place chopped tomatoes in an attractive , medium sized bowl
2. Place all other ingredients in a shaker jar and shake to combine
3. Pour vinaigrette over tomatoes and stir to coat
4. Stir occasionally until ready to serve
5. Marinate at room temperature for at least one hour
6. Serve at room temperature

title: pancakes and waffles
steps:
1. Crack the eggs , letting the whites fall into a clean , dry , mixing bowl and dropping the yolks into a separate bowl
2. Beat the whites with a mixer , on high speed , or whip with a balloon whisk for about 2 minutes until the egg whites become fluffy and then firm
3. Be careful not to overmix , or they will flatten out
4. Mix the egg yolks with a fork
5. Add the orange juice and vanilla and whisk everything together until it becomes foamy
6. Add the milk , barely stirring
7. Place the dry ingredients together in a separate bowl and stir with a wooden spoon until everything is thoroughly blended
8. Slowly stir the dry ingredients into the egg-yolk mixture and continue to mix until all the dry ingredients are wet and there are no clumps of flour
9. Slowly fold in the egg whites and stir only once or twice
10. To make regular sized plain pancakes: coat the bottom of a flat griddle with 1 / 4 teaspoon butter and set it over medium heat for about 1 minute
11. Pour 3 tablespoons of batter onto the griddle and cook until bubbles start to form on top of each pancake
12. Turn them over and cook for about 2 minutes more
13. Transfer the pancakes to a hot platter and stack them to keep them warm
14. To make waffles: preheat the waffle iron until the signal comes on indicating it is ready
15. Pour enough of the batter evenly over the iron to fill it )usually about 1 / 2 cup) and let the batter cook until the edges are golden brown
16. Turn out onto a warm palte and top with the banana , chopped walnuts , and maple syrup
17. For medallion-sized blueberry pancakes:
18. 1 pint blueberries , washed
19. To make medallion-sized blueberry pancakes: coat the bottom of a flat griddle or large frying pan with 1 / 4 teaspoon butter or grapeseed oil and set it over medium heat for about 1 minute
20. Drop 2 tablespoons of batter onto the hot grill , placing them far enough apart so the pancakes don't touch
21. Distribute 1 tablespoon of blueberries on top of each pancake , letting the berries sink into the batter
22. When bubbles begin to appear on the surface , in about 2 minutes , flip the pancakes over
23. Cook the side for 3 minutes
24. Transfer pancakes to a hot platter and stack them to keep them warm
25. Continue cooking the pancakes until all the batter is used up
26. Serve immediately
27. Makes 30 medallion-sized pancakes
28. Fresh fruit compote for plain pancakes:
29. 1 pint strawberries , washed , hulled , and sliced in half
30. 1 pint blueberries , washed
31. 1 / 2 cup pure maple syrup
32. Prepare the fruit compote by mixing all the ingredients together until all the fruit is completely coated with syrup
33. When all the batter is used up , top each 3 pancakes with 3 tablespoons of the fruit compote
34. Makes 12 regular sized pancakes
35. )
36. Waffle topping:
37. 1 / 2 banana , sliced
38. 1 / 4 cup walnuts
39. 1 tablespoon pure maple syrup

title: frozen margarita
steps:
1. Mix all the ingredients in a blender till well blended
2. Dip rim of mararita glasses with grand mariner then into salt
3. Pour in mix and drink away !

title: shower punch
steps:
1. In a large punch bowl , empty the fresca and pineapple juice
2. Stir to mix the two
3. Drop dollops of lime sherbert all over the top and serve
4. You may add ice cubes and recipe can be doubled

title: rosemary lemonade
steps:
1. Mix rosemary , sugar and 1 cup water in a saucepan over medium heat
2. Bring to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes
3. Strain into a bowl and set aside to cool
4. In a pitcher , mix lemonade concentrate with 3 cans of water
5. Add the cooled rosemary / sugar mixture
6. Serve over ice , garnished with sprigs of fresh rosemary
7. Makes 2 quarts

title: blueberry banana muffins
steps:
1. Combine first 5 ingrdients in a mixing bowl
2. Mix well
3. Beat egg , banana and melted butter together
4. Add to dry ingredients until just blended
5. The batter should look lumpy
6. Fold in blueberries
7. Grease muffin tin
8. Fill muffin cups almost full
9. Bake at 375f for 20-25 minutes or until top springs back when lightly touched

title: chicken breasts with lavender and honey glaze
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Melt butter in small saucepan over low-medium heat
3. Add honey , dried lavender and dijon mustard , stirring until mixture is smooth
4. Set aside to infuse for 15 minutes
5. Arrange chicken breasts , skin side up , in shallow baking dish
6. Pour honey mixture evenly over chicken
7. Bake for 35-45 minutes , basting every 15 minutes , or until crispy and golden brown
8. Garnish with a few stems of lavender if desired

title: easy vegetarian vegan black bean soup
steps:
1. Rinse and drain the black beans
2. Put the vegetable broth in a saucepan and let it come to a low boil , then put the beans in and stir them in well
3. Add the oil and stir it inches add all the dry ingredients and raise the heat
4. Let it simmer on medium heat for 15 minutes

title: chinese sticky rice dumplings
steps:
1. Soak the dried mushrooms for 45 minutes
2. Then drain them and cut into a small dice
3. Set aside
4. Meanwhile -- chop the pork and the prawns finely
5. Do not mince them
6. Mix the pork and prawns with the 3 teaspoons of cornflour , wine and 1 / 2 teaspoon of salt
7. Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in a wok and then stir-fry the pork and prawn mixture for about 2 or three minutes
8. Add the remaining filling ingredients , including the mushrooms
9. Stir until the mixture boils and thickens
10. Remove and cool (overnight works best
11. Store in the refrigerator until ready to be used
12. For the dumplings: dissolve the 1 / 2 cup sugar and water in a saucepan
13. Add the glutinous rice flour
14. You will need to stir vigorously to blend
15. It is important that this is done energetically and quickly
16. Transfer the dough to a floured board and knead lightly to a smooth silky dough
17. Use a very generous amount of rice flour
18. The dough is very soft and sticky- you cant have too much flour
19. Any excess flour can be dusted off when the dumpling is completed
20. Shape the dough into a long roll and cut it into 24 pieces
21. Cover the dough with a damp tea-towel
22. Flatten each piece of dough with your hand or use a rolling pin
23. Form a flat circle about 6 centimetres in diameter
24. Into each round -place a heaped spoonful of the cooled filling mixture into the centre
25. Fold the dough over in half and pinch the edges to seal
26. Repeat until all 24 dumplings are made
27. To cook: roll each dumpling in sesame seeds and deep fry them in a moderate heat until they turn a golden brown
28. This should only take a few minutes
29. The dumplings will float to the top when they are cooked

title: red  green and white onion sauce with pork cube steak
steps:
1. In a teaspoon of oil of choice , saut all of the onions until they are slightly limp on high heat
2. Add all other ingredients except steak and turn to medium heat and let thicken
3. Cook steaks in separate pan until they are no longer pink
4. Once sauce is thick , serve on top of steaks

title: polynesian chicken       4 ingredients
steps:
1. Arrange chicken thighs in greased 9 x 13 inch pan
2. Combine remaining 3 ingredients in small bowl
3. Pour over chicken
4. Bake , covered , in 350f oven for about 1 1 / 2 hours , turning chicken halfway through cooking time , until no longer pink inside
5. Remove cover for last 15 minutes to thicken sauce if desired
6. For oamc: place all ingredients into a large ziploc bag
7. Label and freeze
8. To serve: defrost overnight , dump ingredients into baking pan and cook until done , about 1 1 / 2 hours
9. I think this would also work in a crockpot as well

title: crawfish pie
steps:
1. Saute onions , garlic , bell pepper and celery in butter until limp
2. Add tomato sauce , crawfish and parsley
3. Cook slowly for 10 minutes
4. Turn off heat
5. Add bread crumbs , salt , pepper , egg and milk then mix well
6. Bake 35 to 40 minutes in 350 degree oven
7. If you don't care for the delicious mud bugs you may substitute shrimp

title: pizza burgers
steps:
1. Mix first 6 ingredients and grill or pan fry
2. After they are done , add one slice of mozzarella cheese to each
3. Top each with a small amount of tomato paste
4. Serve on toasted french bread !

title: agni beverage
steps:
1. Melt ghee in a pot over medium heat
2. Add ginger , cinnamon and black pepper
3. Simmer until aromatic , about a minute -- more or less
4. Add almond milk and honey
5. Continue to stir just until the mixture comes to a boil
6. Immediately remove from heat and serve warm

title: baked oriental salmon
steps:
1. In a bowl combine marinade ingredients
2. Place salmon in a glass baking dish-pour the marinade over the fillets
3. Let stand 10 minutes at room temp
4. Bake at 425: 10-15 minutes basting once or twice with the pan juices until the fish flakes easily with a fork

title: cold jalapeno cheese dip
steps: 1. Mix all ingrediants and enjoy with tortilla chips

title: creamy chicken noodle soup
steps:
1. Put chicken in large pot , cover w / water , add celery , onion& peppercorns
2. Bring to boil , skim foam
3. Reduce heat to steady simmer , cover& simmer 1 1 / 2 hour
4. Add water if needed
5. Remove chicken& cut into bite size pieces
6. Bring stock to boil , add noodles , carrots& salt
7. Boil 10 minutes
8. Prepare cream suce in small sauce pan- melt oleo , whisk in flour , slowly add milk , stirring& cooking till thickens
9. Add hot cream sauce to soup , whisking constantly till well blended
10. Add chicken and serve

title: french onion pastina
steps:
1. Heat oil over medium in a large deep saucepan until it shimmers
2. Add onions and saute slowly until very soft and a deep mahogany color , 25-30 minutes
3. If the onions stick , add a small amount of cold water and scrape with a wooden spoon to dissolve the sticking solids
4. Remove about 1 / 4 of the cooked onions to a bowl
5. Reserve for use as garnish
6. Sprinkle flour into pot and stir well to coat
7. Add beef stock and thyme
8. Bring to a boil , then reduce to a simmer
9. Adjust seasoning with salt and pepper , and add pasta
10. Cover pan and simmer until pasta is al dente and most of the liquid is absorbed
11. Stir once or twice during cooking
12. Off heat , stir in parmesan
13. Serve , topped with remaining onions and parmesan frico

title: cassada cake
steps:
1. Make custard filling by placing granulated sugar , flour and salt in medium sauce pan
2. Add milk and cook over medium heat till thick and bubbly
3. Temper egg yolks by adding some of the hot mixture to the beaten egg yolks and then returning the egg yolk mixture to the hot mixture whisking till blended
4. Cook mixture another five minutes
5. Remove from heat , add vanilla and refrigerate mixture till completely cool
6. Stir together the sliced strawberries and strawberry glaze , keep refrigerated till ready to use
7. Cut the half sheet cake in half to make two-quarter sheet cake layers approximately 1" thick
8. Best to freeze these cake layers before working with the filling and frosting to prevent them from breaking apart
9. Place bottom layer of cake on platter or cake tray
10. Stir the cooled custard and spread on the bottom layer of cake making sure to leave about half inch from outside all the away around
11. Spread the strawberry glaze filling on top of the custard filling
12. Place the other cake layer on top of the fillings
13. Keep refrigerated till ready to ice the cake
14. For icing , beat the whip cream until frothy
15. Add the powder sugar and vanilla gradually and beat until frosting consistency
16. Ice the cake to your liking and keep cake refrigerated

title: mom s macaroni and potato salad
steps:
1. Wash and peel the new potatoes than cut into cubes
2. Add potatoes and eggs to a dutch oven or large pot and over medium high heat cook until potatoes are just fork tender , approximately 20 minutes
3. Cook pasta according to package directions
4. Drain pasta well and place in a large mixing bowl
5. When potatoes and eggs are ready drain well and set eggs in a bowl of ice water to cool
6. Add potatoes to mixing bowl with pasta and add remaining ingredients
7. Peel and chop eggs , add to bowl
8. Gently fold everything together , taste , and season with salt and pepper
9. Place in refrigerator until chilled or overnight for best flavor
10. More mayonnaise and yogurt can be added if creamier texture is desired

title: fresh pumpkin puree
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Line one baking sheet with foil and set aside
3. Line another baking sheet with paper towels and set aside
4. Rinse dirt off the outside of the pumpkins and pat dry with a clean towel
5. Cut pumpkins in half , vertically , with a large knife
6. Scoop out seeds and pulp from each pumpkin half with a large spoon , separating the seeds and the pulp
7. Discard pulp and save the seeds for another use if desired
8. If saving the seeds , wash them thoroughly and spread them onto the baking sheet lined with paper towels and allow to dry
9. Place pumpkin halves cut side down onto the foil lined baking sheet
10. Bake for 1 - 1 1 / 2 hours , or until flesh is tender
11. Cool the pumpkin halves until they are cool enough to handle
12. Scoop out pumpkin flesh and place it in a food processor
13. Puree flesh until smooth
14. Line a strainer with either cheesecloth or coffee filters
15. Pour puree into the strainer
16. Place strainer on top of a bowl large enough to catch the juices and place both in the refrigerator for 4 hours
17. Discard the juices in the bowl and use the puree for pies , biscuits , pumpkin cinnamon rolls , dog treats and more !

title: spicy red pasta sauce
steps:
1. Heat oil in a five to six quart pot over moderately high heat
2. Add garlic and pepper flake , saute until golden
3. Be careful not to burn the garlic
4. Stir in tomatoes and salt
5. Simmer uncovered for 35 minutes
6. Serve with pasta

title: quick glazed snow peas
steps:
1. Place all ingredients , except the peas , in a shallow , wide , saute pan over medium-high heat
2. Stir and bring to a boil
3. Add snow peas , toss to coat and stir occasionally , 3 minutes just until peas are cooked
4. Serve immediately

title: thai style butternut squash soup
steps:
1. Heat the olive oil in a heavy based pan and cook the onion until soft
2. Add the stock , butternut squash and curry powder to taste- as spicy as you like !
3. Bring to the boil and then cover and simmer until the squash is tender
4. Once the squash is cooked , stir in the coconut milk
5. Pour into a food process / liquidiser and blend until smooth
6. Return to the pan and warm through
7. Season to taste and serve

title: healthy herb pepper sirloin steak
steps:
1. Stir together catsup , black pepper , rosemary , basil , garlic powder , and , if desired , cardamom
2. Coat both sides of steak with catsup mixture
3. Grill steak on an uncovered grill directly over medium coals for 6 minutes
4. Turn steak
5. Grill for 8 to 12 minutes more or until desired doneness
6. Cut into serving-size pieces
7. Garnish with fresh rosemary and serve with grilled sweet peppers , if desired
8. To grill by indirect heat: arrange preheated coals around a drip pan in a covered grill
9. Test for medium heat above pan
10. Place steak on grill over drip pan
11. Cover and grill for 20 to 24 minutes or until desired doneness , turning steak once

title: hazelnut cinnamon cocoa
steps:
1. Mix the liquid creamer , , cinnamon and cocoa together in a mug
2. Add about two or three tablespoons of boiling water and mix to get out any lumps
3. Add the remaining cup of water
4. Adjust sweetness with splenda to taste
5. Enjoy !

title: parma style scrambled eggs   parmesan sauce
steps:
1. For the eggs:
2. In a non-stick saut pan , cook the butter , garlic , and onion over medium heat
3. Cook until the onion is soft and the garlic is starting to brown , which will take about three to four minutes
4. Transfer the onion and garlic to a large bowl
5. Add to this bowl the eggs , cream , salt , pepper , and parmesan cheese
6. Mix well
7. Then add the egg mixture to the pan , stirring well , until the eggs are scrambled soft , which will take about three minutes using medium-high heat
8. For the sauce:
9. In a small non-stick saucepan , cook the cream over medium heat until the cream is reduced by a third
10. This will require about five minutes
11. Add the grated parmesan cheese and stir well until the cheese is completely melted
12. The sauce is now ready to be used
13. Keep warm over low heat
14. Serve the sauce spooned over the scrambled eggs and garnish with a sprinkling of chopped parsley

title: blackberry and apple crisp
steps:
1. Peel apples and cut into bite size pieces
2. Mix with the blackberries and place in a buttered casserole dish
3. Mix together the white sugar , cinnamon and t
4. Flour and spoon over top
5. Next , mix together the cup of brown sugar , flour and butter until it is coarse and place on top of the fruit
6. Bake in a 350f oven for 30 minutes or until golden brown

title: dream mushroom  vegetable broth pulao pilaf  with parsley and yogurt
steps:
1. Firstly , prepare the vegetable broth
2. For this , add 1 cube of'maggi vegetable stock with onion' to 3 cups of water
3. Allow to boil until the cube has completely dissolved in the water
4. Set aside
5. Now , heat oil in a large heavy bottomed skillet
6. Add in the chopped onions and garlic
7. Saute on medium flame till golden brown
8. Add mushrooms and continue to saute for 4 minutes
9. Add vegetable broth and rice
10. Stir once , bring to a boil
11. Lower flame , partially cover and cook on medium flame till the broth has evaporated and rice is ready
12. Garnish with parsley and serve with a dollop of low-fat yogurt and your favourite vegetarian curry for a memorable summer lunch

title: true believer tomato sauce
steps:
1. In a large pot , pour both cans of tomatoes and heat
2. Add the whole stick of butter
3. As the butter starts to melt , add the onions
4. Stir and bring to a boil then set the heat to low
5. Cook for 1 1 / 2 hours
6. Serving suggestion: pour over linguini and top with fresh grated parmesan cheese

title: greek meatballs  feta yogurt sauce and lemon couscous
steps:
1. Sauce -- mix the feta , yogurt , half and half , salt and pepper and lemon juice
2. Set to the side in a small bowl and refrigerate
3. Done !
4. Couscous -- as i said takes literally 5 minutes to boil , stir in couscous and it's done
5. Don't worry about that until the dinner is done
6. Although you can put a pot on the stove with the broth , lemon juice , olive oil , salt and pepper and put the couscous in a measuring cup on the side , just so it is all ready
7. Cucumber and lemon -- now i use a english (or seedless cucumber and just dice it up and set to the side
8. Same with slicing the lemon
9. One less thing to do at the end of the meal
10. Meatballs -- simply in a large bowl , add the feta , milk , parsley , scallions , egg , oregano , salt and pepper
11. I mix everything well and then add the meat last
12. You don't want to over mix the meat as it can make it tough
13. Just mix enough to be combined
14. Roll into golf ball size meatballs
15. Saute -- just heat up the olive oil in a large saute pan on medium high and cook them until golden brown
16. Remove to a plate while you make the sauce
17. Sauce -- in the same pan with the drippings from the meatballs , add the olives , garlic and red pepper and cook just a minute
18. Then stir in the tomatoes , oregano and parsley and cook just another minute to heat up
19. Add the meatballs back in to finish cooking
20. They will take approximately 5-10 minutes depending on the size
21. Just keep them on a low simmer
22. Couscous -- as the meatballs finish , cook the couscous
23. Just bring the broth , lemon , olive oil and seasoning up to a boil
24. Add the couscous , stir and remove from the heat and cover
25. Use foil , a lid , saran wrap , a plate , or anything you have will work just fine
26. Just let it set for 5 minutes and it is done
27. Serve -- use a fork to fluff the couscous and then just spoon some on your plate
28. Top with 2-3 of the meatballs and some of the tomato and olive sauce , and now the good part
29. Finish with a spoon of the yogurt sauce over the meatballs and some diced cucumber and then squeeze the lemon
30. And trust me -- now you have a totally amazing dish

title: lemon pepper bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Cream together butter and sugar
3. Add egg yolks one at a time , beating well after each one
4. Stir in lemon juice and zest
5. In another bowl , combine flour , baking powder , and black pepper
6. Stir 1 / 3 of the mixture into butter mixture
7. Add 1 / 3 cup of the milk and mix together
8. Continue alternating milk and remaining flour
9. Do not overmix
10. In another bowl , whip egg whites with the pinch of salt until soft peaks form
11. Fold egg whites into the batter , then pour batter into a greased 9x5x3 inch loaf pan and bake at 350 degrees f for 50 to 60 minutes or until toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean
12. Remove from oven , allow to sit in pan for 5 minutes , then remove bread and cool on a rack

title: curried lentils and rice
steps:
1. Mix mint and yogurt and refrigerate
2. Wash rice in warm water until the water runs clear
3. Add olive oil , onion , curry , ginger and cumin to the rice cooker
4. Cook 4-5 minutes , stirring , to soften the onions
5. Add lentils and stir to coat
6. Add the broth , cover and cook for 15 minutes
7. Add remaining ingredients , except spinach , and continue to cook until rice cooker swithches to "warm" function
8. Carefully lift cover , then quickly stir in the spinach and re-cover
9. Allow to stand for 10 minutes
10. The rice should have an attractive , light brown crusting on the bottom
11. Serve with a dollop of the chilled , minted yogurt

title: carrots and onions
steps:
1. Place butter in medium stockpan and melt
2. Add carrots and onions and bring to a boil reduce heat and cover and cook until carrots are tender , usually about 45 minutes
3. Enjoy

title: peanut butterscotch fudge
steps:
1. In microwaveable mixing bowl , cook butterscotch chips for 2 1 / 2 to 3 minutes on 50% power , stirring once or twice until melted
2. Blend in milk , peanut butter , vanilla and salt
3. Cook for 1 1 / 2 to 2 minutes on high , until bubbly , watching closely
4. Spread into buttered 8x8 inch baking dish
5. Chill until firm
6. Cut into squares
7. Keep refrigerated

title: pizza pizzazz
steps:
1. Place pepperoni slices in the bottom of a 10-inch skillet
2. Heat the skillet on a medium heat
3. Place any of the optional ingredients on next
4. Beat eggs and gently pour over ingredients in skillet
5. Cover pan and turn heat to low
6. Cook 10 to 12 minutes , until eggs are set
7. Spread pizza sauce over eggs and top with mozzarella cheese for the last couple of minutes of cooking
8. Cut into wedges and serve

title: pork tenderloin with spicy guava glaze
steps:
1. Prepare your grill -- charcoal or gas -- for medium to medium / high heat
2. Combine first 6 ingredients in a small bowl
3. Sprinkle pork with 2 tsp salt , and rub pork with the garlic powder mixture
4. Combine onion and remaining ingredients except cooking spray in a small saucepan over medium heat
5. Bring to a boil
6. Cook 4 minutes or until guava paste dissolves , stirring constantly
7. Reduce heat , and simmer 4 minutes or until thickened , stirring constantly
8. Remove from heat
9. Place pork on grill rack coated with cooking spray
10. Grill 20 minutes or until a thermometer registers 160 degrees , turning pork occasionally
11. Brush guava mixture over pork
12. Let it stand 10 minutes before slicing into 1 / 2 inch slices

title: butter with limburger
steps: 1. Mix all ingredients in a blender or food processor until smooth

title: cornbread topped tamale pie
steps:
1. Mix corn bread mix , egg , and milk and let set
2. Brown ground beef in 1 cup water for fine crumbles
3. Drain and rinse fat
4. Mix all non-cornbread ingredients
5. Spray or grease an 8x8 pan
6. Spread all of meat mixture in pan
7. Carefully pour cornbread on top
8. Bake 400 degrees for 20 minutes or until a toothpick in the cornbread's center is clean

title: hot coconut vegetable curry
steps:
1. Fry onion , garlic and ginger in large pot until onion appears translucent
2. Add the spices and continue to cook for 2 minutes , constantly stirring
3. Stir in the coconut milk , water , chickpeas and tofu and bring to boil
4. Add the vegetables and bring curry to a simmer
5. Continue to cook until all vegetables are tender
6. Before serving , take off the heat and stir in the cilantro
7. Garnish with the coconut and a slice of lemon

title: hazelnut  chocolate bourbon balls  no bake
steps:
1. In a medium size bowl mix together the vanilla crumbs , bourbon , cocoa and corn syrup until well combined
2. Shape into small balls
3. Place on waxed paper
4. Place the granulated sugar in a small shallow dish
5. Roll the small balls in sugar to coat
6. Place in a tightly covered container for a minimum of 24 hours to develop flavors

title: tofu stuffed zucchini
steps:
1. In a dutch oven parboil the zucchini for 10 minutes in boiling water
2. Remove from the pot and cool
3. Cut zucchini and half lengthwise and trim the bottoms so they lie flat
4. Scoop out the insides and salt lightly
5. Chop zucchini pulp , onion and tomatoes
6. Set aside
7. In a 1-quart saucepan heat 1 tablespoon oil
8. Add flour and cook , stirring , for about 5 minutes
9. Add the tofu and cook , stirring until thick
10. Preheat oven to 350 f degrees
11. In a skillet , heat 1 tablespoon oil and saut the zucchini , onion and garlic
12. Remove from heat
13. Add chopped tomatoes , season with salt and pepper
14. Stir in tofu sauce
15. Stuff the zucchini halves with tofu and vegetable mixtures , then top with mozzarella cheese
16. Place on a greased baking sheet , bake for 20-30 minutes , or until cheese melts

title: very easy garlic sauteed spinach
steps:
1. In a pan large enough to hold the spinach , put olive oil and garlic , over medium heat
2. Add spinach immediately and saute , moving the cooked spinach from the bottom up to keep things cooking evenly
3. When all of the spinach is wilted and the stems are tender , it's done
4. Do not let the garlic brown or it will get bitter

title: hearty beef and rice supper
steps:
1. Preheat skillet to 325f
2. Place butter into skillet to melt
3. Add dry rice mix into skillet and saut until vermicelli is golden brown , about 3 minutes
4. Add ground beef and celery
5. Cook , stirring occassionally , until beef is no longer pink
6. Reduce heat to 275f
7. Add water and rice seasoning packet
8. Stir until well mixed
9. Cover , and simmer for 15 minutes
10. Remove cover and stir
11. Sprinkle cheese over the entire mixture and continue cooking until cheese has melted , about 1 minute

title: pollo magnifico
steps:
1. Pound chicken to flatten 1 / 4" thickness
2. In a large zip bag combine everything and add chicken , seal and squeeze air out turn to coat chicken chill 6-8 hours or overnight turn bag occasionally
3. Remove chicken and grill drizzle with any remaining marinade

title: tombo s chile rellenos
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees
2. Remove seeds from chilies
3. Slice open the chilies and line a 9x13 casserole with half of them
4. Cover chilies with half of the cheddar and half of the jack cheese
5. Use the rest of the chilies on top of the cheeses
6. Beat the egg whites till stiff peak
7. Beat the yolks and add flour , milk , salt and
8. Pepper
9. Fold in whites and pour over top of chilies and cheese
10. Bake in oven for 1 hour
11. Top with the remaining cheeses
12. Top with salsa , if desired

title: turkey almondine
steps:
1. Combine the rice , turkey , soup , mayonnaise , celery , onion , and salt in a 13"x9" baking pan
2. Distribute cornflakes , almonds , and melted butter on top
3. Bake at 350f
4. For 30 minutes
5. Enjoy !

title: underwoods cherry cobbler
steps:
1. Combine crisco and flour in a bowl and mix well
2. Add salt and enough cold water to make ingredients cling together
3. Roll dough until it is very thin
4. Cut up butter or oleo and place in a 12 x 13 inch pan
5. Combine in bowl the sugar , salt and flour
6. Mix well
7. Add cherries , water and food coloring
8. Mix well and pour over butter in pan
9. Top with rolled out crust
10. Bake at 350 until brown
11. Very good !

title: baked applesauce
steps:
1. Place applesauce in a square baking dish
2. Mix remaining ingredients in bowl till crumbly
3. Sprinkle over applesauce and bake at 350f for 15 minutes

title: mustard and thyme baron of beef au jus
steps:
1. The evening before
2. Slice small slits all over the roast then stuff with the garlic clove halves
3. Rub the roast all over with oil , then brush the top and sides of the roast with the mustard , then sprinkle with thyme and black pepper
4. Place into a shallow roasting pan , do not use a rack set directly on the pan
5. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate 24 hours or up to 2 days
6. The following day remove the roast from the fridge , uncover and discard plastic wrap
7. Let sit out on the counter to bring down to room temperature
8. Set oven to 450f
9. Pour 1 cup beef broth into the roasting pan
10. Roast uncovered for 20 minutes in a preheated 450f oven
11. After 20 minutes of cooking reduce the heat down to 325f
12. Cook roast until desired doneness
13. For a rare roast 50 minutes more cooking time
14. For medium-rare 60 minutes more cooking time -- 70 minutes for medium and 80 minutes for medium-well
15. When the roast is cooked remove from the pan and set on a plate
16. Tent with foil to prevent drying out
17. To make the jus set the roasting pan on stove top over medium heat
18. Add in 3 cups beef stock , using a wooden spoon scrape the bottom of the pan to release the browned bits , gently simmer for 4-5 minutes (adjust the heat downwards so that the jus maintains a gentle simmer
19. Using an electric knife or a sharp carving knife slice the roast as thinly as possible and serve with the au jus

title: quinoa bread
steps:
1. Add all ingredients according to your baking machine manual
2. Process on bread cycle

title: emeril s sausage pot
steps:
1. In a large pot or dutch oven , saute onion in olive oil for 2 minutes add bacon , seasoning with salt and pepper
2. Cook for 5 minutes , or until bacon begins to render and onions are beginning to carmelize
3. Add creole mustard and the beer
4. Stir
5. Add half the sausage
6. You may want to cut the sausage into bun-length sections
7. Add the sauerkraut on top of the sausage
8. Add the rest of the sausage
9. Add the hot dogs , and the garlic
10. Bring to a boil
11. Reduce to a simmer , cover and cook for 45 minutes
12. Garnish with cracklins , green onions , and creole seasoning

title: callas
steps:
1. Place rice in medium bowl
2. Drizzle milk over the rice and mash until almost smooth
3. Add next 5 ingredients , beat until smooth
4. Fry in hot oil until golden brown , about 2 1 / 2 minutes , turning once
5. Dust with powdered sugar
6. Serve hot

title: hawaiian tropical delight
steps:
1. In a bowl , combine mandarin orange sections , pineapple chunks , banana , coconut , marshmallows , and whipped cream
2. Cover and chill for several hours or overnight

title: black beans  n rice
steps:
1. Cover beans with water an soak overnight
2. Drain
3. Add water in ingredient list and crushed tomatoes
4. Bring to a boil
5. Lower to simmer
6. In a skillet saute the onions , bell pepper , celery tops and garlic in oil for 5 minutes , until tender
7. Add to beans

9. Simmer for 2-2
10. 5 hours
11. Just before you place over rice in containers , stir in apple cider vinegar and remove and bay leaves

13. For large , place 2

16. Refrigerate or freeze , depending on how long it is before delivery date
17. Enjoy !

title: delicious homemade lemonade
steps: 1. Mix together all three ingredients in a jug and enjoy !

title: santa fe penne primavera w cumin ancho chile cream sauce
steps:
1. Have all of your ingredients prepped and ready to go before you start cooking
2. Meanwhile , add approximately 1 tbsp of extra virgin olive oil and 2 tbsp fresh chopped garlic to a large , heavy , deep nonstick skillet and set the heat to medium-high
3. Add the ground meat to the pan and cook , stirring often , to brown the meat , breaking up any lumps with your spoon so it crumbles
4. Once the meat has fully cooked , use a slotted spoon to remove it to a small bowl and set aside
5. Drain any remaining fat / oil from the pan and wipe dry with a paper towel
6. Using the same skillet , add approximately 1 teaspoon more oil to the pan , along with 1 teaspoon of garlic and all of the chopped red onions
7. Saute , over medium-high heat , about 2 minutes or until onion is translucent& lightly browned , stirring often
8. As soon as the onions have softened a bit and are lightly browned , add the peppers to the pan and continue to stir about 1-2 minutes more
9. Add the zucchini and the corn , stirring to coat well
10. Add the seasoned salt and about 8 grinds of black pepper , stirring well to coat the vegetables
11. Let the veggies cook about 5 minutes- stirring often- until they are still a bit crisp , but just beginning to soften& brown
12. Return the meat to the pan , and also add all of the remaining spices , stirring to combine
13. Lower the heat just a bit to medium and slowly pour in the evaporated milk , stirring constantly to blend
14. Add the sour cream and the cheese and stir until everything has blended together
15. Raise the heat back to medium-high and let the sauce cook down just a bit- about 5 minutes or so , stirring- it will be quite thin , you may a dd a little more sour cream if you prefer it a bit thicker
16. Test the flavor for seasonings- adding a little more salt , hot sauce , cumin , etc if needed to suit your tastes
17. Toss drained , hot pasta with a little olive oil or butter to taste- just enough to keep it from sticking together
18. Divide pasta among 4 large dinner plates and ladle out the sauce into the center of each
19. Place a dollop of sour cream in the very center of each portion and sprinkle some freshly chopped cilantro leaves over all
20. Serve immediately

title: persimmon apple smoothie
steps:

title: poblano chicken chowder
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a large stockpot over medium heat
2. Add the carrots , onions , celery , garlic , poblano peppers , salt , white pepper , cumin , and thyme
3. Saut for 7 to 8 minutes , or until the vegetables begin to soften
4. Stir in the chicken bouillon
5. Add the chicken broth and cilantro , and cook for 10 to 12 minutes , or until the carrots are tender
6. Stir in the chicken and cook , stirring frequently , until the chowder is thick and the chicken is heated through
7. Shortly before the chowder is done , melt the butter in a large skillet over medium heat
8. Add the flour and stir to combine
9. Cook , stirring frequently , for 3 to 4 minutes to cook the flour
10. Do not allow the mixture to brown !
11. Ladle 1 cup of the hot liquid from the stockpot into the skillet , whisking constantly
12. When the first cup of liquid is incorporated , add another 2 cups of liquid , 1 at a time
13. Pour the mixture in the skillet into the stockpot , whisking to blend
14. Cook , stirring frequently , for 3 to 5 minutes longer , or until the mixture begins to thicken
15. Remove the pot from the heat
16. Stir in the hot sauce , then the cream , and serve

title: chocolate mint creams
steps:
1. Stir together flour and baking soda and set aside
2. In a medium saucepan heat together brown sugar , butter and water until melted
3. Add chocolate chips and melt in butter and sugar mixture
4. Pour into mixing bowl and let stand to cool for 10 to 15 minutes
5. Add eggs into chocolate mixture and beat
6. Stir in flour mixture until mixed well
7. Chill for 2 hours , any more and the dough will be too firm
8. Take 1 tablespoon of dough and roll into a ball
9. Place on an ungreased cookie sheet and bake at 350f for 8 minutes
10. Top each cookie with a mint and return to oven for 2 more minutes
11. The program wouldn't let me put theses into the recipe
12. Remove from oven and swirl the soft mints like frosting
13. Place on cookie racks until the mints firm

title: sweet and sour thai shrimp salad
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , bring water to boil
2. While water is boiling , heat oil in a small saucepan over low heat
3. Add red pepper flakes and cook , stirring occasionally for approximatley 3 minutes
4. Strain oil into a small bowl , discarding the red pepper flakes and whisk in clam and lime juices
5. Set aside dressing mixture
6. When water has come to a boil drop in shrimp and reduce heat to medium-low
7. Simmer approximately 2 minutes or until shrimp turn opaque
8. Drain shrimp and rinse under cold water to prevent further cooking , drain well
9. In a large bowl , transfer shrimp and add cabbage , carrot , bean sprouts , peanuts , coconut , and scallion
10. Pour dressing over salad and toss to coat

title: roast veal in tuna sauce   from the madeira islands  portugal
steps:

3. Add bay leaves , onion slices , and juice from garlic cloves , and roast in oven at 180c / 350f for two hours
4. Leave to cool in liquid
5. Sauce:
6. Squash tuna with fork , mix with chopped anchovies , chopped capers and lemon juice , season with salt and pepper , and fold in mayonnaise and whipped cream
7. Remove veal from liquid , dry with absorbent paper , cut in thin slices
8. Arrange on platter and pour sauce over meat
9. Place in refrigerator overnight
10. Garnish with olives , lemon slices and parsley
11. Mixed salad , french bread , and a well-chilled rose wine are nice accompaniments

title: the best grilled steak ever
steps:
