title: thermonuclear bbq shrimp
steps:
1. Wash the shrimp , drain and place on skewers 4-6 per skewer
2. Saut onions and garlic in butter , remove for heat and place in blender
3. Add cayenne , worcestershire sauce , lemon juice pepper , cumin , brown sugar and the habaneros with seeds
4. Blend till smooth
5. Brush onto the shrimp skewers and let marinate for 30-60 minutes in fridge
6. Start grill and cook till opaque and slightly crispy
7. Dust with paprika and serve

title: seven flavor slow cooked pork
steps:
1. In a ziplock bag , combine onions , 1 / 3 cup rice wine , soy sauces , bay leaves , tumeric , pepper , and 5-spice
2. Mix well and add pork , turning to coat
3. Marinate in refrigerator over-night , turning once
4. Remove the pork from the marinade
5. Set marinade aside
6. Pat the pork dry with paper towels
7. Heat a wok over high heat until hot
8. Add the oil and swirl to coat the sides
9. Place the meat fat side down in the wok and cook , turning as necessary until brown on both sides , about 2 minutes per side then remove from wok
10. Discard pan drippings
11. Add the reserved marinade and water to the wok
12. Bring to a boil then adjust the heat so the liquid is simmering
13. Return pork then cover the wok and simmer until meat is very tender , about 2 hours
14. Lift the pork onto a carving board , reserving liquid in wok , and let it rest for 5-10 minutes then cut into slices about 1 / 4" thick
15. Heat reserved liquid on high
16. While stirring , add remaining 1 / 4 cup rice wine and dissolved cornstarch
17. Cook for about 1 minute until sauce thickens
18. Serving suggestions: boil chinese egg noodles
19. Top noodles with blanched mung bean sprouts , julienned carrots , julienned cucumbers , and a slice of pork with gravy
20. Also good with some jasmine / white rice

title: gingery carrot  and orange soup  add a touch of spice to your da
steps:
1. Roughly chop the onions
2. Scrub and roughly chop carrots , celery and potatoes
3. Saute onions and celery in oil in the bottom of a large saucepan
4. After a few minutes add carrots , and continue to saut until onions are beginning to go pearly
5. Stir occasionally to avoid burning
6. Stir in the potatoes , then add enough water to cover the vegetables by a couple of inches
7. Bring to the boil , then reduce heat and simmer until the vegetables are tender
8. Add the orange juice , zest and grated ginger
9. Blend the soup
10. Add more stock / hot water / orange juice to achieve desired thickness
11. Season with salt , freshly ground black pepper , bouillon powder , and a little butter

title: chai spiced apple oatmeal bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Mix together the first 7 ingredients in a medium sized bowl
3. In a separate bowl , combine the milk , honey , oil and egg until well blended
4. Add the dry ingredients to the wet and stir until just combined
5. Fold in the diced apples
6. Dump the batter into a well-greased loaf pan and bake for 45-50 minutes or until the top gets golden and a knife inserted into the center comes out clean
7. Cool

title: chicken san remo
steps:
1. Chicken: heat oil in skillet
2. Mix flour , salt& pepper
3. Light beat egg& water
4. Dredge each chicken piece in flour , then dip each side of chicken in egg wash
5. Place in pan in single layer& saute to a golden brown , turning once
6. About 2 min
7. Per side
8. Transfer to a baking pan just large enough to hold the chicken in a single layer
9. Tent with foil to keep warm
10. Preheat broiler sauce: wipe out the skillet& add oil over med heat add shallots& spinach
11. Saute until spinach is completely wilted
12. Stir in chick broth , wine and cream
13. Bring to boil& cook 12 minutes until reduced by half season with cayenne& salt remove foil& spoon sauce over chick breasts
14. Divide the mozzarella over the tops of each piece of chick
15. Broil chicken 4 to 5 inches from the heat 2 to 3 minutes or until cheese bubbles& is light golden brown

title: chocolate coffee bread  bread machine
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in the pan of the bread machine in the order recommended by the manufacturer
2. Select basic bread cycle
3. Press start
4. If your machine has a fruit setting , add the chocolate chips and mocha mix at the signal , or about 5 minutes before the kneading cycle has finished

title: wheat berry salad with goat cheese
steps:
1. Place wheat berries in a medium bowl
2. Cover with water to 2 inches above wheat berries
3. Cover and let stand 8 hours
4. Drain
5. Place wheat berries in a medium saucepan
6. Cover with water to 2 inches above wheat berries
7. Bring to a boil , reduce heat , and cook , uncovered , 1 hour or until tender
8. Drain and rinse with cold water
9. Drain well
10. Place wheat berries in a large bowl
11. Add cucumber , green onion , arugula , parsley and tomatoes
12. Combine lemon rind , lemon juice , sugar , salt and pepper
13. Gradually add oil , stirring constantly with a whisk
14. Drizzle dressing over salad
15. Toss well to coat
16. Stir in cheese
17. Let stand at least 30 minutes
18. Serve at room temperature

title: grilled zucchini roll ups
steps:
1. Discard outermost zucchini pieces
2. Brush zucchini with olive oil on both sides
3. Sprinkle with salt and pepper
4. Grill until tender
5. In a small bowl , combine goat cheese , parsely , and lemon juice
6. Put 1 / 2 teaspoon of the cheese mixture about 1 / 2 inch from the end of a zucchini slice
7. Top with a few spinach leaves and one small basil leaf
8. Roll up and place seam side down on a platter
9. You can make these up to a day before you are ready to serve and store them in an airtight container in the refridgerator

title: chocolate oranges
steps:
1. Cut oranges in halves , scoop out orange pulp
2. Melt chocolate over hot water , cool
3. Whip cream until soft peaks form
4. Beat egg yolks and sugar until light and pale in colour , about 5 minutes , add liqueur
5. Beat egg whites until soft peaks form
6. Fold chocolate into egg yolk mixture , then fold in egg whites and cream
7. Sit orange halves in patty pan , spoon chocolate mixture into oranges , cover , freeze until firm
8. To serve , cut each orange half in half again

title: spiced potato crisps
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325f
2. Combine spices , herbs and the sesame seeds in a small bowl
3. Slice the potatoes very thinly and place half the slices on a baking tray line with parchment paper
4. Top each slice of potato with another slice of similiar size and press together
5. Brush with butter and sprinkle with spice mix
6. Bake for 45 minutes or until crisp and golden brown
7. Drain on paper towels and serve

title: banana beignets
steps:
1. Heat oil in deep fryer to 360
2. Whisk eggs in a large bowl
3. Mash banana
4. Add banana , flour , milk , sugar , baking powder , and salt to eggs
5. Whisk until smooth
6. Drop tbs of batter into hot oil
7. Cook until golden on both sides
8. Remove and sprinkle powdered sugar over beignets while still warm
9. Enjoy !

title: orange walnut bar cake
steps:
1. Preheat your oven to 180 degrees c
2. Grease a loaf or square cake tin well with some butter and line the base with baking paper
3. Cream the butter , sugar and grated rinds until light and fluffy
4. Add the eggs , one at a time , and beat in well
5. Fold through the sifted flour
6. Stir in the walnuts , followed by the orange juice and then the milk
7. Pour into the prepared tin and sprinkle with the 2 teaspoons sugar
8. Bake for about 50 minutes
9. Stand for a few minutes then cool on a wire rack
10. To make the frosting , cream the butter in a small mixing bowl until light
11. Beat in the icing sugar
12. Add the rind and juice then beat at high speed with electric mixer for a few minutes until frosting is stiff enough to shape easily but not too stiff to spread
13. If it's too thin add more sifted icing sugar
14. If too thick add some more juice or water
15. When the cake has cooled frost with the prepared frosting

title: fruity jello cool whip
steps:
1. Boil 3 cups of water
2. Empty all four boxes of jello into large bowl and mix in boiling water
3. Stir until completely dissolved , then pour in the remaining 2 cups of cold water
4. Stir in all of the ice until you see the jello start to set and get thick
5. Quickly add one tub of coolwhip and whip into jello by hand , once mixed in add the other tub as well
6. Mix until completely smooth
7. Put in the fridge to set for about 10-15 minutes
8. Drain whatever kind of canned , or fresh fruit you have and just stir it around until it is all through the jello mixture
9. Put back in the fridge for 1 hour and serve !

title: airbake giant cashew white chocolate cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325
2. In a large bowl , cream butter and sugar
3. Stir in egg and vanilla
4. Mix until well blended
5. Stir in flour and soda
6. Add 1 1 / 2 cups vanilla chips and 1 cup cashews
7. Mix well
8. Shape dough into 2 inch balls
9. Place 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet
10. Flatten slightly
11. Bake 15 to 18 minutes until golden brown
12. Cool 10 minutes
13. Remove to wire cooling racks
14. Cool completely
15. Melt remaining 1 / 2 cup vanilla chips
16. Dip in an edge of each cookie and decorate with remaining chopped cashews
17. If desired , drizzle with melted chocolate

title: raw kale salad with lemon honey vinaigrette
steps:
1. Combine the four salad ingredients in a large bowl
2. Whisk together the vinaigrette ingredients and toss with the salad
3. I like to massage the kale and dressing at this point
4. Just massage it with both hands for a few minutes
5. Toss in any additional fruits or berries
6. Refrigerate for at least one hour prior to serving to allow the flavors to develop
7. Serve and enjoy !
8. This is even better the next day and hold up well w / o wilting
9. Try adding mango , watermelon or blueberries to the mix !

title: shoofly coffee cake
steps:
1. Mix flour , baking powder , baking soda and salt
2. Set aside
3. In large bowl of electric mixer , combine butter , granulated sugar , eggs , vanilla and molasses
4. Beat at medium speed for about 2 minutes
5. Add dry ingredients alternately with sour cream , beating until smooth
6. Mix brown sugar , walnuts and cinnamon
7. Spread 1 / 3 of batter in greased and lightly floured 10-inch tube pan
8. Sprinkle with 1 / 3 of the nut mixture
9. Repeat twice
10. Bake at 350 for 55 minutes or until pick inserted near center comes out clean

title: bbq beans and sausage crock pot
steps:
1. Spray slow cooker with cooking spray
2. Mix all ingredients except sausage in crock pot
3. Place sausage on top of mixture
4. Cover and cook on low heat 5 to 6 hours

title: jelly belly banana split    tasty dish
steps:
1. Put the jelly beans together in a bowl
2. Eat ! yum !

title: crusty catfish delight
steps:
1. Preheat oven
2. Cut tomatoes into small pieces
3. Place in an oven-proofed casserole
4. Add orzo pasta , sugar , chopped herb leaves , water and salt to taste
5. Mix well
6. Put fish filet on this bed of tomatoes and orzo pasta
7. Drizzle the lime juice over fishfilets and mixture
8. Salt the fish filet to taste
9. Mix breadcrumbs , parmesan and olive oil in small bowl
10. Sprinkle this mixture over the fish filets
11. Put into oven and bake for 20 minutes until cooked and crust is lightly brown
12. Take out and serve with green salad
13. Choose the fish you like best
14. I like it that way , because the pasta will remain more "al dente"

title: betsy s red wine beef stew
steps:
1. Toss beef with herbs , paprika , 2 teaspoons salt and the ground black pepper
2. Heat the oil in bottom of heavy stew pot over medium-high heat
3. Brown the beef
4. Transfer to a bowl and set aside
5. Melt butter in same pot
6. Add chopped onion
7. Cook 7 to 8 minutes until onions begin to brown
8. Add garlic during last 2 minutes of cooking time
9. Add reserved meat and accumulated juices , bay leaf , wine and water
10. Bring to a boil
11. Cover , lower to a strong simmer and cook for 1 hour
12. After 1 hour , taste , and if needed , add 1 teaspoon salt
13. Then add bullion cube
14. Stir and bring back to simmer
15. Cover and simmer for 1 more hour , until beef is tender
16. Stir in vegetables and beef broth
17. Simmer 15 30 minutes more

title: grilled hamburgers
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients [except the blue cheese] into hamburger meat and gently make into about 10 thick paddies
2. Cook until about 145 to 160 degrees internal temperature
3. Always use your meat thermometer to prevent being over / under done
4. Place on toasted onion buns with all the trimmings
5. You will never go back to plain burgers again !
6. Enjoy !

title: fine cooking s  french onion soup
steps:
1. In a large , wide soup pot , melt the butter over medium heat
2. Add the onions and season lightly with salt and pepper
3. Cook the onions gently , stirring frequently , until they're very soft and have begun to turn a dark straw color , 35 to 45 minute
4. When the onions are ready , stir in the flour and cook for 3 to 4 min
5. , stirring frequently
6. Pour in the wine and increase the heat to medium high , stirring and scraping to loosen any caramelized juices , until the liquid is mostly reduced , 5 to 8 minute add the broth , toss in the tied herbs , and bring to a simmer
7. Season to taste with salt and pepper and simmer for 20 to 30 minute to infuse the broth with onion flavor
8. The onions should be soft but not falling apart
9. Remove the herb bundle and taste the soup for seasoning
10. If making ahead cool and refrigerated up to a few days
11. To serve -- heat the oven to 350f , put the baguette slices on a rack , and toast lightly
12. Set aside
13. Increase the oven temperature to 450f bring the soup back to a simmer
14. Set six ovenproof soup crocks on a heavy baking sheet and ladle the soup into the crocks
15. Float a few toasted baguette slices on top , enough to cover the soup surface without too much overlap
16. Top the bread with a handful of the grated gruyre
17. Slide the baking sheet into the oven and bake until the cheese is melted and just browning in spots , 10 to 12 minute
18. Melted , bubbly , just barely golden cheese is what you're after
19. Serve the soup right away , while the crock is hot and the cheese is still gooey

title: banana berry tarts
steps:
1. In a small mixing bowl , beat the cream cheese and honey until smooth
2. Whisk in raspberries until blended
3. Stir in marshmallows and banana
4. Fold in whipped topping
5. Spoon into tart shells
6. Refrigerate until serving

title: glazed plum bundt cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Spray a 12 cup bundt pan with cooking spray
3. Lightly dust pan with flour
4. In a large mixing bowl , cream the sugar , 1 / 2 cup oil , and butter until fluffy
5. Add dry ingredients and mix until blended
6. Add egg yolks , vanilla , and buttermilk
7. Blend well
8. Whip egg whites until they hold a soft peak
9. Fold in egg whites
10. Carefully stir in plums and walnuts
11. Pour the batter in the pan and bake for 50 minutes , or until a toothpick inserted in center of cake comes out clean
12. While the cake is baking , heat the remaining 1 / 2 cup oil and brown sugar in a saucepan until hot
13. Add the milk , stir and set aside
14. Cool the cake in pan , then invert it onto a plate , and spoon the glaze over the top
15. Enjoy !

title: fancy apricot chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 475f , line the bottom of a 9"-13" pan with foil
2. Remove the giblets from the chicken and just throw them away
3. Dry the bird off and place it , breast side up , in the lined pan
4. Stuff the bird with as many apricots and onion pieces as you can then just toss the ones that would fit around the bird stuff the cinnamon sticks , one under each breast , inside the bird
5. Smear the butter , curry powder , and cayenne all over the top and sides of the chicken
6. Cook for 20 minutes in the 475f oven then loosely cover with foil , turn the oven to 350f and cook for 2 1 / 2 to 3 hours more
7. When the bird is down , remove from the oven and spit it open down the back bone
8. Turn oven down to 250f
9. Remove the apricots and onion from inside and around the bird and place them in a blender or food processor
10. Finish carving the bird and set it aside
11. Line another 9"-13" pan with foil pour the rice into the pan and stir in the butter and curry powder
12. Place the chicken on top of the rice and set aside
13. Add all the ingredients for the sauce plus 1 / 4 cup reserved apricot syrup to the blender or food processor with the cooked apricots and onion
14. Blend until smooth then pour over the chicken
15. Return to the 250f oven for 15 minutes

title: hash
steps:
1. Heat 2 tsp butter in skillet
2. Add onion and fry until soft
3. Remove
4. Heat 2 tablespoons butter and 2 tablespoons oil in same skillet
5. Add potatoes
6. Fry on medium-high heat until golden brown and crispy , turning occasionally
7. Turn down heat
8. Add cooked onion and leftover meat of your choice
9. Heat until warmed through

title: updated chicken pot pie
steps:
1. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat
2. Add the chicken
3. Cook and stir for 5 minutes , or until the chicken is cooked through
4. Stir in frozen vegetables , soup , and velveeta
5. Stir until the velveeta is melted
6. Spoon into a greased 8x8 baking dish
7. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f
8. Unfold the pastry sheet , and place it over the chicken mixture
9. Fold the edges of the pastry under itself , inside the lip of the dish , and press the pastry somewhat against the edges of the dish to seal
10. Brush the top of the pastry with an egg
11. Cut several slits in the pastry to permit steam to escape
12. Place the dish on a baking sheet , and bake for 30 minutes , or until golden brown
13. Let stand 5 minutes before serving

title: salmon burgers
steps:
1. Drain and flake salmon
2. Combine lemon juice and mustard
3. Blend flaked salmon with breadcrumbs , green onions , and lemon juice-mustard mixture
4. Mix in egg whites until well blended
5. Form mixture into 4 patties and cook on a lightly oiled grill or saut in skillet until golden brown on both sides
6. Serve each burger on a bun with lettuce , tomato slices

title: bow ties with creamy artichoke sauce
steps:
1. Cook bow tie pasta as directed on packaging , drain
2. Meanwhile , place alfredo sauce , artichokes , garlic , tomatoes , rosemary , salt and pepper in a saucepan and simmer over low heat , strirring occasionally , until hot
3. Pour sauce over pasta , toss and sprinkle with parsley

title: crock pot hash browns casserole
steps:
1. Stir together butter , onions , hash browns , soup , milk , cheese , pepper , and 1 / 2 cups cornflakes
2. Pour into greased crock pot
3. Top with remaining corn flakes
4. Cover and cook on high for 3-4 hours

title: bakinbaby s  zucchini summer  casserole
steps:
1. Saute' ground beef , chopped red pepper , onion and garlic in medium skillet , until meat is well browned
2. Add zucchini , salt , cumin & pepper , cook over medium heat 8 minutes
3. Add tomato sauce , crushed red pepper and corn or , bring to a boil , reduce heat , cover and simmer 10-15 minutes or until zucchini is beginning to soften
4. If mixture is too thick , add a little water
5. Top each serving with parmesan cheese or cheddar cheese
6. We like parmesan

title: cinnamon butter cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300f
2. In a medium bowl , combine flour , soda and salt
3. Set aside
4. In a large bowl , blend sugars with a mixer
5. Add butter and mix
6. Add eggs and vanilla
7. Mix until light and fluffy
8. Add flour mixture and blend just until combined
9. Do not overmix
10. Shape dough into 1-inch balls
11. Roll in combination of remaining sugar and cinnamon
12. Place 2-inches apart on ungreased cookie sheets
13. Bake for 18-20 minutes
14. Remove immediately from pan and cool

title: aussie key lime pie
steps:
1. If not using a prepared crust: preheat oven to 180c
2. Process biscuits in a food processor then add melted butter
3. Pulse several times until butter is well mixed with biscuit crumbs
4. Place a loose based 23cm flan dish on an oven tray
5. Using your hands , press crumbs firmly into the base and sides of the tin
6. Place flan tin onto the centre shelf of the oven and cook for 10-12 minutes until the crust is golden brown
7. Meanwhile , in a small mixing bowl and using an electric mixer , beat together the egg yolks and the lime zest until the yolks thicken and the beaters leave a 'trail' in the mixture
8. Now add the condensed milk
9. Beat until mixture thickens and beaters leave a 'trail' in the mixture
10. Add the lime juice and mix briefly to combine
11. When the crust is ready , remove it from the oven and pour in the filling
12. Reduce the oven temperature slightly to about 170c
13. Place the pie on the centre shelf of the oven and cook for 10-15 minutes being careful not to overcook it
14. Remove pie from oven when the centre is just set
15. Allow the pie to cool , then cover and chill in the refrigerator
16. Meringue topping : reset oven to 150c
17. Grease two baking sheets / oven trays / cookie trays
18. In a small mixing bowl beat egg whites until soft peaks form
19. Gradually add sugar , beating between each addition
20. Beat until mixture is thick and glossy
21. Spoon mixture into a piping bag fitted with a medium sized fluted piping tube
22. Pipe small meringues , about 5cm high onto greased trays
23. Place trays on centre shelves of oven and immediately reduce temperature to 140c
24. Cook for one hour , but do not remove meringues from oven
25. Turn off heat and leave overnight
26. If not serving the pie immediately , store meringues at room temperature in an airtight jar or tin
27. They will keep well for several days
28. When ready to serve the pie , spread a thin layer of whipped cream over the top and decorate with meringues

title: pork in lime cream sauce
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. In a large ovenproof skillet , heat oil and 1 tbsp butter over high heat
3. Add pork and brown on all sides , turning
4. Remove skillet from stovetop and place in preheated oven , and bake pork until cooked through , about 20 minutes
5. While pork is baking , melt the remaining butter in a large skillet over medium heat
6. Add onion , garlic , and green onion and saute for 3 minutes
7. Add wine and sherry and boil until liquid is reduced by half , stirring occasionally , for about 5 minutes
8. Add the chicken and beef broths and boil , stirring frequently , until liquid is reduced to 6 tbsp , about 10 to 15 minutes
9. Add the half and half and simmer , stirring , until sauce is reduced to 1 cup , stirring frequently , about 7 minutes
10. Whisk in the fresh lime juice
11. Season sauce to taste with salt and white pepper
12. Cut pork diagonally into 1 / 4-inch thick slices
13. Spoon sauce onto serving plate
14. Fan pork on top of the sauce , garnish with basil or cilantro , and serve with any extra sauce on the side
15. Tweaked and adapted from a recipe posted to gail's recipe swap by debby bradford , who got it from the november 1991 bon appetit

title: grandma s homemade chicken noodles
steps:
1. The chicken can be whole pieces or bite sized whatever you prefer
2. I like to cut chicken breast into bite sized pieces
3. In a large soup pot boil chicken in water or chicken broth
4. Add garlic , salt and pepper to taste
5. While chicken is boiling combine flour , salt and eggs into a large mixing bowl
6. Start with a 1 / 4 cup of milk and add more milk or flour to get a pie crust type consistency
7. Roll out dough on a floured surface as thin as you like remembering that the noodles will probably double in thickness when cooking
8. Cut the noodles with a pizza or noodle cutter
9. I typically cut them into 1 / 2 inch by 5 inch pieces
10. If the chicken is finished cooking then add the noodles into the boiling broth and cook until done
11. Takes about 5 minutes to cook at the thickness that i roll the noodles
12. Add the worcestershire sauce and butter
13. Serve in a bowl or plate depending on if you want lots of broth or not and i recommend sprinkling parmesean cheese over the top when finished

title: lao style papaya salad
steps:
1. Using a mortar and pestle , pound garlic and chiles until broken into small pieces
2. Add remaining ingredients
3. Use a spoon to scrape the sides of the mortar and turn the ingredients
4. Pound the papaya until it is limp and soft
5. Taste and adjust the seasonings to a balance of sour , hot , salt and sweet
6. Garnish with fresh ongchoi , in 4-inch pieces

title: blue cheese date wraps
steps:
1. Slice each bacon strip into thirds
2. Place the bacon strips onto a baking sheet then bake at 350 degrees f until just partially cooked but not crisp remove and place onto paper towels to drain
3. Carefully cut a slit in the center of each date then fill with blue cheese
4. Wrap a piece of bacon around each stuffed date
5. Secure with a wooden toothpick
6. Place onto a baking sheet
7. Bake at 375 degrees f for about 10 minutes or until the bacon is crisp

title: honey lime chicken
steps:
1. Drain pineapple , reserve 2 tablespoons of the juice
2. Rub chicken with garlic , sprinkle with salt
3. Broil or cook chicken until cooked through
4. Combine reserved pineapple juice , honey , soy sauce and cornstarch in saucepan
5. Cook , stirring until thickened
6. Add pineapple to sauce and heat through
7. Place pineapple slices on chicken and spoon sauce over chicken and pineapple
8. Sprinkle with lime peel

title: lettuce wrap fish tacos
steps:
1. For the batter - combine all dry ingredients together in a bowl deep enough to cover the fish once placed in it
2. Whisk the egg in a separate bowl and add it to the dry ingredients
3. Add the water slowly , as needed , until the batter is loose enough to work with but still thick enough to cover the fish when coated
4. For frying the fish - add the canola oil to a deep pot and set it to medium-high heat
5. Let the oil preheat for about 5 minutes
6. Slice each tilapia fillet in thirds and drop it into the batter
7. Make sure the fish pieces are fully covered in batter
8. Place fish gently into the frying pot to avoid oil splatter
9. Do not overcrowd the pot
10. After about 4 minutes or until golden brown , flip the fish
11. After golden brown on both sides and about 10 minutes in the pot , rest the fish on paper towel to dry
12. Turn the heat down to medium and repeat the batter / frying / drying process
13. For the red pepper pesto - in a blender , add solid ingredients first: garlic cloves , roasted red peppers , fresh basil
14. Add wet ingredients next: greek yogurt , olive oil
15. Blend at medium speed to incorporate
16. Add dry ingredients last: pepper and cheese
17. Blend at medium speed until combined
18. Taste and season with more pepper as needed
19. To assemble - layer two pieces of lettuce for each taco to help give it a solid base
20. Add 2-3 small pieces of fish per taco , and 3-4 slices of avocado per taco
21. Drizzle the red pepper pesto on top and hold each taco together with toothpicks for easy handling

title: hot crab casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. In a skillet or saucepan , melt butter
3. Saute onions and peppers over medium heat until tender
4. Stir in the crushed crackers
5. Remove from heat
6. In a mixing bowl , beat together cream cheese , sour cream , worcestershire , hot sauce , and dry seasonings
7. Stir in the sauteed onion / pepper / cracker mixture
8. Gently fold in the crabmeat -- careful not to break up the lumps too much
9. Pour into a 2-1 / 2 - 3 quart casserole dish
10. Bake uncovered for 20 minutes at 350
11. Remove from oven and stir
12. Sprinkle cheese on top and return to oven for another 10 minutes

title: tex mex corn chowder
steps:
1. In a large soup pot saute the onions in oil until almost translucent
2. Add the broth and remaining vegetables except corn
3. Simmer for 45 minutes
4. Add the corn and simmer for 10 minutes more
5. Add the cream and milk
6. Turn heat up to medium but do not boil-you want a hearty simmer
7. Remove from heat and pour into a soup tureen
8. Offer pepper , cilantro and cheese at the table

title: parmesan potato bites
steps:
1. Cook potatoes in boiling water 15 minutes or until tender , drain
2. Heat oil in a nonstick frypan over medium high heat
3. Add onion , bacon , pepper and garlic , saute 5 minutes or until tender
4. Preheat broiler
5. Cut potatoes in half , carefully scoop out pulp with a melon baller , leaving 1 / 4 inch shell
6. Mash potato pulp with a fork
7. Stir in cheese and sage
8. Add to onion mixture , stirring well
9. Spoon about 1 tablespoon potato mixture into each shell
10. Arrange stuffed potatoes on a baking sheet , and broil 3 to 4 inches from heat , 3 minutes or until lightly browned
11. Serve warm

title: poor man canadian poutine
steps:
1. Heat oil in a deep fryer or deep heavy skillet to 365f
2. Warm gravy in saucepan or microwave
3. Place the fries into the hot oil , and cook until light brown , about 5 minutes
4. Remove to a paper towel lined plate to drain
5. Place the fries on a serving platter , and sprinkle the cheese over them
6. Ladle gravy over the fries and cheese , and serve immediately

title: charishma s ultimate lemony potatoes
steps:
1. Peel and dice potatoes
2. In the meantime , heat oil in a wok
3. Once hot , add mustard seeds and cumin seeds
4. Allow to crackle
5. Add all the other ingredients
6. Mix well
7. Cover
8. Cook on medium heat for 10-15 minutes until slightly brown
9. Serve with hot puris

title: salmon with cucumber sauce
steps:
1. Heat the oven to 425f
2. Line a rimmed baking sheet with foil
3. Place the salmon on the baking sheet
4. Mix the cumin , paprika and pepper in a cup and rub on the salmon
5. Bake 10 minutes or until the salmon is cooked through
6. Meanwhile , mix the rest of the ingredients in a bowl
7. Serve on the fish

title: hungarian rakott kaposzta  cabbage casserole
steps:
1. In a large skillet , medium heat , fry the onions and garlic in the butter until golden
2. Add caraway seeds
3. Stir in the cabbage and mix well , add a few teaspoons of water and cook until the cabbage has just turned bright green
4. Stir in the dill and half the paprika
5. Place half the cabbage mixture in a 13x9" casserole dish , then put a layer of potato , cheese and apples
6. Cover with remaining cabbage mixture
7. Sprinkle with the vinegar and dust with the remaining paprika
8. Bake covered for 45 minutes 325f oven
9. Uncover and bake until the casserole is lightly brown , approximately 15 minutes
10. Let cool for a few minutes and serve with sour cream or yogurt on the side

title: govyadina v smetane  russian steak in sour cream
steps:
1. Prepare the 4 steaks and brown them quickly in the olive oil
2. Transfer them to a baking pan , season with salt and pepper
3. Keep warm
4. Chop the onions and soften them in the same frying pan
5. Spread them over the steaks
6. Sprinkle with the grated cheese and pour over the sour cream
7. Cover with foil
8. Bake in a pre-heated oven at 350f for one hour , removing the foil for the last 20 minutes
9. Serve with plain cooked vegetables

title: food processor french bread
steps:
1. Grease baguette pans for two loaves or cookie sheet if making rolls
2. Combine 1 / 2 cup cup water , 1 1 / 2 tbls yeast , 1 teaspoon sugar
3. In food processor bowl , let sit 5 minutes to proof
4. Add 3 1 / 4 cups flour , 1 1 / 2 tsp salt , 1 teaspoon sugar , process for 30 secs
5. Slowly add 1 cup of water with the processor running , once dough comes together process mix for 1 minute
6. Check dough , it will be slightly moist and sticky , add extra flour if needed and process for 30 seconds
7. For loaves , divide dough in half and shape into 2- 11"-12" loaves
8. Place on pan , and cut or snip 4 diagonal slashes into top of the loaf
9. For rolls pinch off dough and form 24 balls place on cookie sheet
10. Snip a small slash into the top of each roll
11. Set loaves or rolls in a warm spot to rise , rise for 40 - 60 minurtes for loaves , 30- 40 minutes for rolls , depending how warm your room is
12. As soon as you set you bread to rise , preheat oven to 450 degrees , after 20 minutes place a shallow pan of warm water on the lower rack of you oven
13. Bake for 10 minutes , lower temperature to 400 degrees bake 15 minutes more , check rolls at 10 minutes
14. With the oven i have now , i have to remove the loaves from the pan turn them over and bake for 5 minutes more to get the bottom crusty , you may have to also

title: bacon ranch bread bites
steps:
1. Roll bread dough into 1 / 2-inch thick rectangle
2. Brush top of dough with oil
3. Cut dough with sharp knife into 11 inch pieces
4. Toss bread pieces , cheese , salad dressing mix and bacon in large bowl
5. Place on ungreased cookie sheet , shape into oval loaf
6. Let rise until double in size
7. Bake at 350 until golden brown

title: sate babe  pork sate
steps:
1. Cut pork into small cubes and marinate for at least 2 hours
2. Put 5 or 6 pieces of pork onto each skewer
3. Bake at 350f for 30 minutes turning halfway through
4. Brush with glaze and place on grill , turning once , for about 3 minutes

title: spicy prawn fried rice from new zealand
steps:
1. 1
2. Pour the beaten eggs into a hot , lightly greased frying pan and cook for 1-2 minutes until eggs are set , then turn the omelette onto a chopping board , cool , roll up and slice thinly
3. Pat prawns dry with paper towels and heat sesame oil in a wok or open deep frying pan , add the prawns and cook until they turn pink , then set aside and keep warm
4. Add spring onions and garlic and stir-fry over medium heat for 1 minute , next add the sweet thai chilli sauce , dark soya sauce , fish sauce and lime juice
5. Return the prawns to the wok with the cooked rice and snow peas and toss together in the sauces
6. Continue stir-frying until the rice and prawns are hot , then carefully stir through the sliced omelette and enjoy

title: grilled crazy chicken
steps:
1. In a blender , combine the water , salt , pepper , garlic and food coloring
2. Blend on high speed for about 15 seconds
3. Add the pineapple juice and the lime juice to the marinade and blend for another 5 seconds
4. Pour the marinade into a bowl and let the chicken marinate for 45 minutes
5. Turn the chicken over and let it soak for another 30 minutes
6. Fire up the barbie
7. Broil the chicken on the open grill for about 45 minutes to 1 hour , until the skin is a nice golden brown and crispy
8. Make sure the flames don't scorch the chicken , or you are going to get black skin and raw chicken
9. If using a gas grill , lower the heat if necessary and be patient , that chicken need slow cooking
10. If you are using a charcoal grill , you can spray a little water on the charcoal to keep the flames at bay
11. Turn the chicken often as it cooks
12. Cut the chicken into 8 pieces
13. Make sure to cut the breast in half and the thighs from the legs

title: lemongrass and beer shrimp
steps:
1. In a bowl large enough to hold the shrimp , mix the garlic , sugar , fish sauce and lime zest
2. Peel away and discard the tough outer layers of the lemongrass stalks , till you reach the tender centers
3. Finely mince these and add to the marinade
4. Add shrimp , mix well and allow to stand 30 minutes , refrigerated
5. When ready to cook , heat the oil in a wok
6. When smoking add the shrimps with marinade and cook until they are just pink on both sides (2-3 minutes , stirring all the while
7. Add the beer , cover and "steam" on a high heat for 6-8 minutes
8. You probably will have a quantity of liquid remaining in the wok , so remove the shrimps with a slotted spoon
9. Serve immediately with lemon or lime halves if desired

title: fiesta beef skewers with avocado and cilantro creme
steps:
1. Make the meatballs
2. Pour all ingredients into a large bowl & mix well
3. Form into 16 small balls as firmly as possible
4. Place on plate & flatten slightly
5. Cover & chill at least 30 minutes
6. The meatballs will be soft so chilling or even flash freezing is important
7. Make the creme
8. In small bowl mash the avocado
9. Add remaining ingredients & stir
10. Chill until later
11. Preheat indoor contact grill
12. Assemble the skewers
13. The vegetables should be similar in size to the meatballs to ensure even cooking
14. Alternate 2 sections of zucchini , 2 peppers , 2 red onion sections and 4 meatballs onto each of four skewers
15. Use the curves of the vegetables to "cup" the meatballs to help hold in place
16. Pack the skewers tightly
17. Spray the grill top & bottom liberally with cooking spray
18. Place skewers on grill & shut lid
19. Set timer for 7 minutes
20. Use spatula to gently flip skewers over & rearrange position on grill from front to back
21. Cook for an additional 4 minutes or longer depending on your grill
22. The veggies should be soft & the meatballs browned
23. Serve hot with the avocado & cilantro sauce to drizzle on top
24. The skewers would be good served on top of rice or even in tortillas

title: oatmeal fruit nut bars  from sara snow
steps:
1. Stir together dry ingredients
2. In a mixing bowl , beat butter and sugars
3. Add in honey , eggs and vanilla
4. Slowly add in dry mixture and beat together
5. Stir in oats , applesauce , coconut , fruit and nuts
6. Drop spoonfuls onto baking sheet
7. Bake 12-14 minutes at 350
8. Or , if making bars ,
9. Spread evenly into a large , glass baking pan
10. Bake 20-25 minutes

title: quick apple cobbler
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425
2. To make cinnamon mixture combine 3 t
3. Sugar with 1 teaspoons cinnamon
4. In a pan combine pie filling , lemon juice & nutmeg
5. Bake for 10 minutes
6. Cut biscuits in half & dip in melted butter , turn in cinnamon mixture and place on hot apple mixture
7. Bake 15 minutes

title: baked spicy shrimp
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients except shrimp and simmer briefly , then cool
2. Peel and devein shrimp , then wipe them dry
3. Marinate in butter mixture for 8 hours
4. Bake in 300 degree oven in a shallow pan for 10 to 12 minutes

title: chicken enchiladas with roasted tomatillo chile salsa
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
2. For the salsa:
3. On a baking tray , roast tomatillos , onion , garlic and jalapenos for 12 to 15 minutes
4. Transfer the roasted vegetables and any juices on the bottom of the tray to a food processor
5. Add the cumin , salt , cilantro , and lime juice and pulse mixture until well combined but still chunky
6. Enchiladas:
7. Meanwhile heat a 2 count of olive oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat
8. Add the onion and cook until soft and caramelized - this should take 5 to 7 minutes
9. Add the garlic and cumin then cook for a further minute
10. Sprinkle on the flour and stir to ensure the flour doesn't burn then gradually add the chicken stock to make a veloute
11. Continue stirring over a low simmer until the flour cooks and the liquid thickens
12. Turn off the heat , add half of the roasted tomatillo chile salsa , some additional fresh chopped cilantro and fold in the shredded chicken meat
13. Season , to taste , with salt and pepper
14. Change the temperature of the oven to 350 degrees f and begin assembling the dish
15. Take a large baking dish and smear the bottom with some of the reserved tomatillo salsa
16. Now take the flour tortillas and briefly flash them over the stove-top flame
17. Using a shallow bowl , coat each tortilla lightly with the reserved salsa mix
18. Put a scoop of the shredded chicken-enchilada mix on top of the tortilla followed by a sprinkle of the shredded cheese
19. Fold the tortilla over the filling and roll like a cigar to enclose it
20. Using a spatula place the tortillas in the baking dish and continue to do the same with all the tortillas
21. Finally pour over some more of the salsa and top with the remaining shredded cheese
22. Bake uncovered for about 30 minutes until bubbly and cracked on top
23. Garnish , cilantro and tomato
24. Serve hot with spicy black beans and yellow rice , the remaining tomatillo salsa , sour cream and fresh guacamole , if desired

title: creamy baked pork
steps:
1. Heat oven 400
2. Heat oil in a skillet
3. Brown pork in batches
4. Remove all to a plate
5. Season
6. To skillet add the oil and butter
7. Add onions
8. Saute 15 minutes
9. Stir in flour
10. Cook 1 minute
11. Stir in milk
12. Bring to a boil
13. Reduce
14. Simmer 15 minutes
15. Season
16. Remove from heat
17. Layer onion mix , pork and cheese in a sprayed 9x13
18. Top with crumbs
19. Dot with butter
20. Bake 20 minutes

title: pressure cooker chili
steps:
1. Place the meat in a large mixing bowl and toss with the peanut oil and salt
2. Set aside
3. Heat a 6-quart heavy-bottomed pressure cooker over high heat until hot
4. Add the meat in 3 or 4 batches and brown on all sides , approximately 2 minutes per batch
5. Once each batch is browned , place the meat in a clean large bowl
6. Once all of the meat is browned , add the beer to the cooker to deglaze the pot
7. Scrape the browned bits from the bottom of the pot
8. Add the meat back to the pressure cooker along with the salsa , tortilla chips , chipotle peppers , adobo sauce , tomato paste , chili powder , and ground cumin and stir to combine
9. Lock the lid in place according to the manufacturer's instructions
10. When the steam begins to hiss out of the cooker , reduce the heat to low , just enough to maintain a very weak whistle
11. Cook for 25 minutes
12. Remove from the heat and carefully release the steam
13. Serve immediately

title: cocoamisu aka chocolate tiramisu
steps:
1. Dissolve cocoa and sugar in 1 / 2 cup boiling water
2. Mix in 1 / 2 cup milk and set aside to cool
3. Beat egg whites until soft peaks form
4. In a separate bowl , beat egg yolks and sugar until smooth and light colored
5. Beat in marscapone cheese until well mixed
6. Fold in egg whites gently
7. Pour the cocoa mix into a small bowl that's big enough to fit one of the cookies laying flat
8. Take half of the cookies , individually dip them the in cocoa mix and then arrange in the bottom of a casserole dish
9. Spread half of the marscapone mixture over the cookies
10. Repeat with the rest of the cookies and then cover with the remaining marscapone mixture
11. Sprinkle a little cocoa powder over the top
12. Refrigerate for several hours or overnight
13. Serve with whipped cream

title: bob s favorite hot salsa   hot water bath canning method
steps:
1. Combine the tomatoes , peppers and onions and boil for 10 minutes
2. Remove from heat and add remaining ingredients , mixing well
3. Fill hot pint jars to 1 / 2 inch of the top
4. Process for 15 minutes in a hot water bath
5. Let cool and remove bands and store in a cool dry place for up to 1 year

title: yummy onion topping
steps:
1. In large skillet , melt butter over medium heat
2. Add onion
3. Cook , stirring occasionally , until lightly golden browned , about 10 to 13 minutes
4. Add splenda , salt , chili powder , and smokehouse pepper
5. Reduce heat to medium-low
6. Cook , stirring often , until onion is soft and dark golden brown , 2 to 5 minutes

title: kitty cat cookies
steps:
1. Beat together peanut butter , eggs , and water
2. Gradually add cake mix
3. Mix well
4. Form dough into 1-inch balls
5. Place on ungreased cookie sheet
6. Flatten balls with bottom of glass dipped in sugar
7. Pinch out 2 ears at top of cookie
8. Add m&m's and red hots
9. Press fork into dough to form whiskers
10. Bake at 375 degrees for 8-10 minutes
11. Makes 4 1 / 2 dozen

title: taste of mexico pie
steps:
1. Brown hamburger and onion , until meat is no longer pink
2. Drain off fat
3. Add green pepper , corn and jalapeos
4. Stir
5. Add envelope of taco seasoning and the amount of water the envelope calls for
6. Simmer until thick
7. Add salsa and stir
8. Line a pie plate with 1 / 2 crust pastry
9. Pour in hamburger mixture
10. Top with cheese and sliced olives
11. Place remaining half of crust pastry on top and seal edges
12. Cut several slits into top of crust for steam to escape
13. Bake at 350f for 45 minutes until crust is golden

title: fresh ravioli and grilled tomatoes with blue cheese sauce
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 100d celsius
2. Cook ravioli according to shop instructions and place in a porcelain dish
3. Halve and grill tomatoes and add to dish with ravioli
4. Place in oven to keep warm
5. Blend cornflour with about a third of the wine
6. In a small saucepan bring remaining wine to the boil and boil for 10 seconds
7. Whisk in the cornflour mixture and cook on low heat until thickened
8. Stir in crumbled blue vein cheese and stir until melted
9. Add sour cream , parsley , chives and black pepper and stir well until smooth
10. Spoon sauce over ravioli and tomatoes and serve

title: independence day special tiranga puri
steps:
1. Firstly , take washed , fresh spinach and steam it for 4 minutes in microwave
2. Place in blender
3. Puree
4. Remove puree to another container
5. Put one cup of flour in a bowl
6. Put salt and ghee in it
7. Make a dough with plain water
8. Put it aside
9. Now again take another cup of flour
10. Put salt and ghee
11. This time mix the flour with spinach and make the dough
12. Keep it aside
13. Again take the remaining flour left
14. Put in salt and ghee
15. This time mix the flour with the tomato puree
16. Put aside
17. Keep all doughs separately in fridge and leave it for one hour
18. Now make long and thin strips of all the three coloured doughs
19. Once you will make three long strips bring all of them together and make one stripe
20. Now make small balls as we make for puri and then make small round puri and then deep fry it
21. You will like three coloured puri and its tasty too

title: broiled chicken with fig sauce
steps:
1. Place broiler rack 4 to 6 inches from heat source , and turn broiler on
2. Sprinkle chicken on both sides with salt and pepper , and place skin-side down in a pan
3. Place honey in a 4- to 6-cup saucepan with one tablespoon water , and put on high heat
4. Let honey boil for a minute or so , then carefully add wine , cayenne , figs , coriander , orange zest and orange juice
5. Mixture should cook steadily
6. Do not let it boil over
7. Broil chicken until it begins to brown on skinless side
8. Turn it over , then broil until it browns nicely and is cooked all the way through
9. Total broiling time will be about 25 minutes
10. Cook sauce until figs are very tender , about 15 minutes
11. Add lemon juice , then taste , and add more salt , cayenne or lemon as needed
12. Serve chicken with sauce spooned over it

title: rhonda s hearty egg drop soup
steps:
1. Bring broth to a simmer and add shrimp , green onions , & peas let simmer for 5 minutes
2. Add egg while whisking the soup to give it the 'shredded' look let simmer for about 2 minutes
3. Mix the cold water and corn starch to the consistency of whole milk
4. Bring to a boil and add corn starch / water to thicken

title: super taco tater tots supper
steps:
1. Bake tater tots as per directions on pkg
2. In lg skillet , brown beef
3. Drain
4. Stir in seasoning
5. Divide tater tots between 4 plates
6. Top with meat , cheese , olives , lettuce , taco sauce and sour cream

title: simple italian baked lasagna
steps:
1. Cook lasagna noodles according to package directions or until tender but still firm
2. Drain , keep warm
3. Meanwhile , saute the ground beef , garlic and onion is a large heavy skillet or saucepan until beef is done
4. Add sauce , salt , and italian seasoning and mix well
5. Simmer on low heat 12-15 minutes
6. In a separate bowl , combine eggs and ricotta cheese
7. Grease a 9" x 12" or larger , baking pan
8. Arrange a first layer of noodles so the ends hang over the sides of the pan
9. Then add a layer of the cooked beef lasagna sauce , ricotta cheese and mozzarella cheese
10. Add a second alternating layer of pasta , the meat sauce and cheese mixture
11. Repeat until pan is almost full then fold over the ends of the first layer of noodles and top with more lasagna sauce
12. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese and bake at 350 degrees for 40-45 minutes , or till cheese is bubbly
13. Allow to set for 5-10 minutes before cutting
14. This lasagna recipe can be modified to suit individual preferences
15. I have also made it using italian sausage instead of beef , and i have added a can of chopped tomatoes to the sauce mixture with good results
16. Sometimes i mix in shredded parmesan cheese to the ricotta for an extra boost :)

title: rons baked corn dogs
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit
2. Grease eight mini-loaf pans and set aside
3. Whisk dry ingredients together in medium or large bowl
4. Stir in the remaining ingredients except for the hot dogs
5. Pour a half inch of batter into each mini loaf pan
6. Place a hot dog on top of the batter in each pan
7. Distribute remaining batter over the hot dogs so that the hot dogs are surrounded by batter
8. Bake in preheated oven for thirty minutes or until done
9. Based on your baking pans , youll need to check for doneness sooner or later

title: beer spice cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. Grease and flour a 9x5 inch loaf pan
3. Sift together flour , baking powder , cloves , cinnamon , allspice baking soda and salt
4. Set aside
5. In a large bowl , cream the butter and brown sugar until light and fluffy
6. Add egg and beat well
7. Add flour mixture alternately with beer and mix well to combine
8. Fold in the chopped walnuts
9. Pour into a 9x5 inch loaf pan
10. Bake at 375 degrees f for 40 to 50 minutes , or until a toothpick inserted into the cake comes out clean

title: tuscany potato and sausage soup
steps:
1. In a large pot heat 1 tsp olive oil , add onions carrots and celery cook till onion is nearly clear , approximately 5 minutes
2. Add sausage and cook till sausage is done
3. Add chicken stock , garlic , salt , pepper , italian seasonings and potatoes
4. Cook till potatoes are tender , approximately 60 minutes
5. Simmer for an additional 30 minutes with lid off the pot to reduce the volume by 1 / 8th
6. Serve with a good soaking bread and enjoy
7. You could add 1 cup of heavy cream for that creamy effect

title: spicy scallop pasta
steps:
1. While pasta is cooking , prepare scallops
2. If they are large cut in half horizontally
3. Pour oil in a large sauce pan and place over medium heat
4. Add garlic cook until golden 1-2 minutes
5. Careful not to burn
6. Add parsley and red pepper flakes
7. Stir once or twice
8. Add scallops with a pinch or 2 of salt
9. Increase the heat to high , and cook for 1 minute
10. Turn off the heat
11. In a large bowl add cooked pasta and toss the scallops
12. Top with bread crumbs
13. Serve immediately
14. Serve with a crusty bread and a nice green salad

title: salmon with tarragon sauce
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Melt 2 t
3. Of the butter in a roasting pan large enough to hold the fish
4. Put the fish in the butter and turn to coat
5. Sprinkle with salt
6. Bake 20 minutes , turning once
7. Meanwhile , in small saucepan , combine wine , tarragon , and mustard and bring to a boil over medium heat
8. Simmer for 2 minutes
9. Remove from heat and swirl in the 2 t
10. Remaining butter until melted
11. Divide fish into 4 servings and top with the sauce

title: almond rice pudding tart  3 ww points
steps:
1. Coat bottom and sides of a 9-inch springform pan with cooking spray
2. Spread toasted almonds in a single layer in bottom of pan
3. Set aside
4. In a heavy-bottomed saucepan , heat milk to boiling
5. Stir in rice , cinnamon and salt
6. Reduce to simmer and cook , stirring occasionally , 15 minutes
7. Add sugar and almond extract and cook , stirring often , 12 to 15 minutes longer or until rice is cooked through and mixture is thick
8. Gently spoon rice mixture into pan and spread evenly , keeping almonds intact on bottom
9. Cool to room temperature
10. Cover and refrigerate just until firm , about 40 minutes
11. To serve , remove sides of pan and invert tart onto serving plate
12. Lift off bottom of pan
13. Garnish with fresh cherries and serve

title: lamb stew with white beans
steps:
1. Toss the lamb with the orange juice , garlic , ginger , and mint in a large bowl
2. Let marinate , covered , in the fridge for 4 hours
3. Dump the lamb into a colander set over a bowl to catch the marinade
4. Reserve the liquid
5. Dry the lamb very well with paper towels
6. If you dont , the pieces will steam , not sear
7. Generously season the lamb with salt and pepper
8. Heat the oil in a large pot over medium-high heat until very hot
9. Working in 3 or 4 batches , sear the lamb pieces , stirring occasionally , until browned , 8 to 10 minutes
10. Using a slotted spoon , transfer to a bowl
11. Return all the lamb to the pot , sprinkle with the flour , and stir to combine
12. Pour in the reserved marinade and the stock
13. Add the drained soaked beans , the carrots , bay leaves , cinnamon , oregano , star anise , coriander seeds , cumin , lemon zest , and lemon juice , cover , and bring to a boil
14. Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 1 hours , stirring occasionally
15. Spoon in the tomatoes and the canned beans , if using
16. Continue simmering , uncovered if the stew is thin , until the lamb is tender and the beans are soft but still hold their shape , 15 to 20 minutes more
17. Toss out the bay leaves , cinnamon sticks , and star anise
18. Take a taste and season the stew with salt and pepper , if needed
19. To serve , ladle into bowls and speckle with parsley

title: the absolute best moist buttery blueberry coffee cake
steps:
1. Set oven to 350
2. Grease a 13 x 9-inch baking dish
3. In a bowl sift together the first 3 ingredients
4. In a small bowl mix together the milk with whipping cream
5. Set aside
6. In another bowl cream the butter with sugar and vanilla for about 4 minutes
7. Add in eggs and cream cheese
8. Beat until thoroughly blended
9. Add in the flour mixture alternately with milk / cream mixture
10. Spread half of the batter into prepared baking dish , then sprinkle the blueberries over the batter
11. Spread the remaining batter over blueberries
12. For the topping mix together the sugar with flour and cinnamon add in softened butter and mix with fingers until blended
13. Sprinkle on top of the cake batter
14. Bake for about 45-50 minutes , or until cake tests done
15. Delicious !

title: rhubarb mix and dump cake
steps:
1. Mix together the first 5 items
2. Flour , gelatin , sugar , cinnamon , and tapioca
3. Then mix together with rhubarb -- well coating rhubarb
4. Let set 5 min --
5. Spread into a 9x13 -- or close to that size -- glass cake dish
6. Sprinkle dry cake mix over the entire rhubarb mixture
7. Cover well
8. Drizzle the cup of water evenly over mixture
9. Spot the top with dabs of butter
10. Cover tightly with foil
11. Bake 350 f for 45-55 minutes or so until cake is done
12. If
13. The cake still looks like flour , in spots , after 45 minute
14. I smear a little more soften butter on top the area and let it set in the oven another 5 minutes cake should be done by then --
15. Remove from oven
16. Cool on rack
17. Top with , vanilla ice cream , or cool whip
18. And on top of that i pour a little of my rhubarb sauce over the cake when serving
19. My husband likes to pour a little of the vanilla flavored coffee cream over the cake -- so yummy
20. Jacqi's rhubarb sauce
21. -- in a small saucepan
22. Put 2 to 2 3 / 4 cups chopped rhubarb and 2-3 tablespoons water
23. 1 / 2 to 3 / 4 cup sugar --
24. 2 tablespoons of the mixture that was set aside from cake
25. -- cook over med
26. Heat , stir as not to bun -- will cook up fast
27. In about 5-7 minute

title: bagno di poppea
steps:
1. Chill a champagne glass with ice or in the freezer
2. Pour absolut vodka , banana liqueur , cream and triple sec into a shaker
3. Fill the shaker with ice cubes and shake it until the shaker is very cold
4. Empty the champagne glass from ice and water
5. Strain the drink into the champagne glass
6. Garnish with a maraschino cherry

title: johnny appleseed cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Generously grease bottom only of 8" square pan
3. In a large saucepan , combine butter and applesauce , heating over medium til butter melts remove from heat and blend in all remaining ingredients , stirring until well combined pour batter into pan , spreading to edges
4. Bake@ 350 30-35 minutes until top springs back when touched
5. Serve warm or cool , plain or with whipped cream

title: apple bacon pancakes with cider syrup
steps:
1. Syrup:
2. Combine cider , 2 tablespoons brown sugar , lemon juice and cornstarch in a small saucepan
3. Bring to a boil over medium heat , whisking , and cook until thickened , 1 to 2 minutes
4. Set aside
5. Pancakes:
6. Whisk whole-wheat flour , all-purpose flour , baking powder , baking soda and the remaining 1 tablespoon brown sugar in a small bowl
7. Whisk egg , egg white and buttermilk in a large bowl
8. Stir in the dry ingredients , apples and bacon until just combined
9. Brush a large nonstick skillet with 1 / 2 teaspoon oil and place over medium heat until hot
10. Cooking 4 at a time , use about 1 / 4 cup batter for each pancake and gently spread it to make them about 3 inches in diameter
11. Cook until the edges are dry and bubbles begin to form , about 2 minutes
12. Flip the pancakes and cook until golden brown , 1 to 2 minutes more
13. Repeat with the remaining oil and batter , reducing the heat as necessary to prevent burning
14. Reheat the cider syrup , if desired , and serve with the pancakes
15. Make ahead
16. Reheat on low before serving
17. Exchanges: 1 1 / 2 starch , 1 / 2 fruit , 1 other carbohydrate , 1 fat

title: easy cinnamon swirl quick bread
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees f
2. Grease a 9 x 5-inch loaf pan
3. In a small bowl mix together all topping ingredients
4. In a large bowl combine all the cake ingredients and mix until well combined
5. Transfer the batter to the prepared baking dish
6. Sprinkle the topping mixture over the batter , then run through with a knife to create a swirl pattern
7. Bake for about 45 minutes , or until the cake tests done

title: pasta with avocado pesto
steps:
1. Cook pasta until al dente
2. Combine avocado , garlic , lemon juice and cilantro in a food processor
3. Process about 1 minute or until smooth
4. Stir in chopped tomatoes
5. Drain pasta and pour pesto over it tossing well
6. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese

title: kato s  garage  style    tomato sauce   meatball dinner
steps:
1. Spicy tomatoe & vegetable sauce
2. In a large pot , cook the onion and garlic , red and green peppers , celery , carrotes , mushrooms and zucchini in olive oil over medium heat
3. Next add the lemon salt , celery salt , oregano , parsley , basil , cloves , caraway seeds , bay leaf , chili pepper flakes and coarse sea salt
4. Now add the white sugar , diced tomatoes , tomatoe sauce , tomatoe paste , chicken stock , v8 juice , red wine and cheeses and simmer over low heat for 30 minutes
5. Meatballs
6. Combine the beef , pork , veal , shallot , garlic , egg , prepared bread , parmesan cheese , salt , pepper , oregano and parsley in large bowl and gently mix by hand
7. Roll into balls , and drop raw into the simmering sauce
8. To the sauce add the raw sausages and pepperoni and cook gently on low for 3 hours
9. Serve over hot buttered noodles with calabrese bread and a simple salad

title: lobster pie
steps:
1. Break up cooked lobster meat
2. I like to have mine broken rather small , again , you be the judge
3. You can't really mess this recipe up
4. Lay the meat in the bottom of a glass pan , the lobster should cover the bottom of the pan
5. I have also made this in those individual little thingies you make onion soup in , this is nice if you are having company
6. Pour some melted butter on top of the lobster
7. Just enough to coat it a little
8. At this point is when i usually start to pick at the lobster , you know: one for the pan , one for me !
9. Try not to do this , it really is better if you have a nice amount of lobster at the bottom of the dish !
10. Pour some half& half over the meat next
11. The milk should come just about half way up the meat , not cover it
12. Don't worry if you think you have poured too much , it will be okay
13. I did this once and looked like an idiot at the sink trying to pour out some milk while keeping the lobster in !
14. It will all work out in the end , promise !
15. Put in the oven at 350 for about 15 minutes
16. While this is cooking you can make the crust
17. Super easy
18. Just crush up the crackers , right in a frying pan
19. Use the back of a big spoon , as fine as you like em
20. I don't make mine super fine , just kinda crushed
21. Then add whats left of the stick of butter
22. You can add more if you think it is too dry
23. Throw in the garlic and parsley
24. Cook over low heat just to let the butter melt
25. Stir it all together so the crackers get nice and coated
26. Spread this evenly over the lobster
27. Push it down a bit so that it can absorb the liquid in the pie
28. Set back in the oven for about 5 minutes
29. Let it sit on the counter for a couple minutes , just to set up and cool a bit
30. And then enjoy !
31. That was sure a lot of typing for such an easy recipe , but it is worth it
32. One of my favorie things to make and to eat !

title: strawberry margarita dessert sauce
steps:
1. In a small sauce pan , combine guava juice , strawberries , tequila , and lime juice
2. Bring to a boil , cook 10 minutes
3. Add strawberry jam and sugar
4. Boil for 5 minutes , stirring constantly
5. Serve hot or cold !

title: cranberry spice tea
steps:
1. Heat all ingredients to boiling
2. Reduce heat
3. Simmer uncovered 20 minutes , stirring occasionally
4. Remove cinnamon sticks
5. Serve tea warm

title: drumstick cake
steps:
1. First layer: mix together and press into a 10 x 13 pan
2. Second layer: mix together and spread on first layer
3. Cool in refrigerator for 1 / 2 an hour
4. Third layer: mix together and spread on second layer
5. Cool in refrigerator for 1 / 2 an hour
6. Fourth layer: top third layer with whipped cream
7. Mix milk chocolate with peanuts and sprinkle over the whipped cream
8. Cool in refrigerator for 1 / 2 an hour
9. Enjoy

title: cream cheese breakfast buns
steps:
1. Sift flour into a large bowl , make a well in the middle and crumble the yeast into it
2. Dissolve 1 tablespoon caster sugar in lukewarm milk
3. Pour over yeast and mix with yeast and some of the flour
4. This first yeast-mixture should be still fluid
5. Cover and let rise in warm place for 20 minutes
6. Meanwhile: mix all other ingredients for the buns until smooth
7. Add this mixture to the yeast and flour
8. Mix first with a spoon
9. Then knead with floured hands until dough is peeling away from the side of the bowl and blistering
10. This step may take 10 minutes
11. Use some additional flour , if dough is too sticky
12. At the end you should have a smooth dough
13. Cover and let rise in warm place for about 30 to 40 minutes or until dough has doubled
14. Line out baking tray with parchment paper
15. Preheat oven
16. After dough has doubled , knead again a few times
17. Roll out on a floured workspace
18. About 1 / 2 inch thick
19. Cut out circles of about 2 1 / 4 to 2 1 / 2 inches in diameter
20. Place the buns on baking tray
21. Let rise again for 15 minutes
22. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes until the top of the buns are slightly golden
23. Take out and let cool completely
24. It is the yeast sold as a solid block
25. You could replace it by dry yeast
26. If you use dry yeast , dissolve the dry yeast in lukewarm water prior adding it to the flour
27. Use as much dry yeast as you would need for 3 cups flour
28. But i prefer to do it by hand and i always have the feeling , that the texture of a hand kneaded dough is different

title: easy black bean lasagna
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f
2. Spray 13x9-inch baking dish with non-stick cooking spray
3. In a large bowl , mash beans slightly
4. Stir in tomatoes , onions , bell pepper , salsa , chili powder and cumin
5. Mix well
6. In a small bowl , combine ricotta cheese , garlic powder and egg
7. Blend well
8. Spread 1 cup of tomato mixture over bottom of spray-coated baking dish
9. Top with half of noodles , overlapping slightly
10. Top with half of remaining tomato mixture
11. Spoon ricotta mixture over top , spread carefully
12. Top with half of cheese , then with remaining noodles , tomato mixture and cheese
13. Cover tightly with spray coated foil
14. Bake at 350f for 40 to 45 minutes or until noodles are tender
15. Uncover , let stand 15 minutes before serving

title: tomato soup with pancetta   giada de laurentiis
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a large , heavy pot over medium flame
2. Add the pancetta and saute until crisp and golden , about 5 minutes
3. Add the onion and saute until tender , about 3 minutes
4. Add the bread cubes and toss to coat with the pan drippings
5. Saute until the bread cubes are golden , about 5 minutes
6. Add the broth , tomatoes , basil , oregano , and red pepper flakes
7. Bring the soup to a boil , then reduce the heat to medium-low
8. Simmer uncovered until the flavors blend , about 10 minutes
9. Season the soup to taste with salt and pepper
10. In a small bowl , stir together the mascarpone and sour cream until blended
11. Ladle the soup into bowls
12. Spoon a dollop of the mascarpone mixture onto each serving and serve

title: raisin peanut clusters
steps:
1. In a heavy 3 quart saucepan , melt chocolate and shortening over medium heat , stirring until melted
2. Remove from heat and stir in nuts and raisins
3. Drop by heaping tablespoonfuls onto a cookie sheet lined with parchment paper
4. Chill until firm , about 2 hours
5. Store in airtight conyainers in refrigerator

title: pumpkin hash browns   vegetarian pumpkin burgers
steps:
1. Combine pumpkin , cottage cheese , eggs , brown onion , spring onions and wholemeal plain flour in a large bowl
2. Season with salt and pepper
3. Heat a large non-stick frying pan over medium-high heat
4. Spray with oil
5. Shape 1 / 4 cup quantities of pumpkin mixture into patties
6. Place around edge of pan , allowing room for them to expand
7. Cook for 3 minutes or until golden brown
8. Turn and cook for a further 2 - 3 minutes or until golden
9. Transfer to a plate
10. Repeat last step until remaining pumpkin mixture is complete
11. To finish , arrange spinach on serving plates
12. Place two patties on each plate
13. Sprinkle ricotta on top and serve

title: marshmallow cream frosting
steps:
1. In top of a double boiler combine the sugar , water and egg whites
2. Cook over simmering water beating until soft peaks form
3. Add in the marshmallow cream
4. Continue beating until stiff peaks form
5. Remove from heat and beat in vanilla or almond extract

title: ravioli in mushroom cream sauce
steps:
1. While the water is boiling for the ravioli , chop the onions , mince the garlic , and grate the cheese
2. Prepare ravioli according to package directions
3. While the ravioli is cooking , melt butter in large pan over medium-high heat
4. Add mushrooms , green onions , garlic cloves , and dried italian seasoning
5. Saute over medium-high heat 7-9 minutes or until mushrooms are very tender and browned
6. Season with pepper
7. Stir in diced tomatoes and green chiles , basil , and cream
8. Bring to a boil
9. Reduce heat and simmer , stirring occasionally , 5 minutes
10. Stir in parmesan cheese and salt
11. Stir in ravioli , tossing to coat

title: chili with cheesy hash browns
steps:
1. Spread the 2 cans of chili in the bottom of a baking dish
2. Mix together the package of hashbrowns and 1 cup of cheddar cheese
3. Spread the hashbrown and cheese mixture over the top of the chili
4. Bake at 375 for 45 minutes and enjoy !
5. How much easier could that be ?

title: peach smoothie with a kick
steps:
1. Cut cream cheese into chunks and put into blender container
2. Drain peaches and reserve 3 tbl of syrup
3. Add fruit , 3 tbl syrup and rum to blender and blend until smooth
4. Stir in yogurt
5. Pour into 4 dessert dishes and chill in freezer for 25 minutes

title: maple mustard glaze for ham
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients
2. Add the glaze during the last 30 minutes
3. You can also add the ham dripping to the remainder of the glaze in a sauce pan and bring to a boil for a great sauce !

title: florentine basil stuffed chicken breasts
steps:
1. First make the basil filling:
2. Combine all the ingredients with just a few tablespoons of olive oil in the food processor
3. Process until finely chopped , scraping down the sides of the bowl
4. With the processor running , add the rest of the olive oil through the food tube until a paste forms
5. Place the chicken breasts between two sheets of plastic wrap and pound them with a mallet or with a cutting board to an even thickness
6. Sprinkle with salt and pepper to taste
7. Combine the margarine with the basil filling
8. Spread 2 tablespoons of the stuff across each pounded chicken breast
9. Roll up the breast and secure it with a toothpick
10. Combine the cornflakes , ground cashews and paprika in a shallow bowl
11. Beat the eggs in a separate bowl
12. Dip the chicken bundles in the egg , then dredge in the crumb mixture
13. Cover a baking dish in parchment paper and place the bundles in the dish
14. Cover and place in the fridge for 6-8 hours
15. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
16. Bring the chicken to room temperature
17. Bake uncovered for 35 minutes
18. Let stand for 10 minutes
19. Remove the toothpicks
20. Wash the spinach well and tear the leaves into smaller pieces
21. Wilt the spinach in a hot pan , with just the water clinging to the leaves , about 3 minutes
22. Season to taste with salt and pepper
23. Place the spinach flat on a serving dish
24. Place the chicken bundles on top , garnish with sprigs of basil

title: baked eggs and cheese
steps:
1. Beat together the eggs , milk and sugar
2. Add the cheeses and butter
3. Mix well then add the flour and baking powder
4. Pour into a greased 9x13 glass baking dish
5. Bake in a 325 degree oven for 45 minutes or until a knife inserted in the center comes out clean
6. This may be made ahead of time and refrigerated
7. If the pan goes from the refrigerator to the oven , bake 60 minutes

title: spicy shells with broccoli and blue cheese
steps:
1. Cook pasta in large pot of salted water according to package instructions
2. In a small kettle cover chicken with water , add salt and simmer until cooked through
3. Shred the chicken and set it aside
4. Save stock for later
5. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat
6. Add scallions , cook 4 minutes or until wilted but not brown
7. Add garlic and cook 1 minute
8. Add broccoli and chicken broth that you saved
9. Cover , bring to a boil and cook 2-3 minutes
10. Broccoli should be crisp-tender
11. Add undrained beans , salt , crushed red pepper and black pepper , stir gently
12. Heat for 1-2 minutes
13. Drain pasta , return to pot
14. Add the broccoli mixture and chicken
15. Increase heat to medium , add 1 / 4 cup of the chicken stock
16. Bring to a boil
17. Add 1 cup cheese , stir until cheese is melted
18. Add additional 1 / 4 cup chicken stock if necessary to thin sauce
19. Sprinkle with the rest of the blue cheese and serve
20. Top with cherry tomatoes

title: low fat loaded baked potato
steps:
1. 1
2. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
3. 2
4. Rinse potatoes and pat dry
5. Slice into 1 / 2 inch thick rounds
6. 3
7. Spray glass baking pan with nonstick cooking spray
8. 4
9. Place potatoes in baking pan and spray with i can't believe it's not butter until all potato rounds are evenly covered
10. Salt and pepper to taste
11. 5
12. Bake uncovered for 1 hour
13. 6
14. Approximately 5 minutes before it's time to take it out of the oven , spread the sour cream over the potatoes and all of the cheddar cheese
15. This will allow the cheese and sour cream to melt together making a great flavor
16. Enjoy !

title: black eyed pea pt
steps:
1. Place a 12-inch skillet over medium heat
2. Add the oil and then the onions
3. Saute for 3 minutes
4. Decrease heat slightly
5. Add in carrots and bay leaves
6. Stir / saute 6-7 minutes , until vegetables are quite soft but not brown
7. Add in garlic
8. Stir / saute minute
9. Remove and discard bay leaf
10. Scrape the mixture into a food processor
11. Add in the black-eyed peas , peanut butter , nutritional yeast , cognac , and tamari
12. Pulse until very smooth
13. Taste for seasoning
14. Add salt and pepper if necessary
15. Pulse again
16. Scoop spread into ramekins and refrigerate overnight to let flavors blend
17. Serve at room temperature , garnishing with a confetti of peppers and a sprig of parsley
18. Serve with lots of crudits and / or crackers

title: cream cheese poppy seed pound cake
steps:
1. Bring butter , cheese and eggs to room temperature before you begin
2. Grease and flour a 10-inch tube pan and preheat oven to 160c or 325f
3. Combine the flour , baking powder and salt in a bowl and set aside
4. In a large mixing bowl , beat butter and cream cheese until softened
5. Gradually add sugar 2 tablespoons at a time beating on medium speed about 5 minutes until very light and fluffy
6. Add poppy seeds and vanilla essence
7. Add eggs , one at a time , beating on low to medium speed 1 minute after each addition and scraping bowl frequently
8. Gradually add flour mixture beating on low speed until just combined
9. Pour batter into prepared pan and bake for about 1 1 / 4 hours or until a wooden skewer comes out clean
10. Cool in pan on wire rack for 15 minutes and then remove from pan and allow to cool completely before serving

title: beef hotpot pie
steps:
1. Place beef , onion , garlic , tomatoes , corn and worcestershire sauce into crock pot
2. Sprinkle with stock cube
3. Mix , cover and cook on low for 8-10 hours
4. Preheat oven to 230 degrees celsius
5. Transfer crock pot contents to ovenproof casserole dish
6. Cover with pastry , pinching edges decoratively
7. Bake for 20 minutes until pastry is golden

title: mexican layered ground beef enchiladas
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan , heat oil over medium low heat
2. Stir in flour until blended and light brown in color
3. Slowly pour in broth and whisk to make smooth gravy
4. Add chili powder , cumin , and garlic powder
5. Bring to boil and reduce heat to low and simmer for 8-10 minutes
6. Remove from heat and cool slightly
7. Pour gravy into a medium size bowl in which to dip tortillas
8. Brown ground beef in large skillet
9. Drain excess fat
10. Add one package of taco seasoning and tomato sauce and stir to combine
11. Bring to boil and then reduce heat to low and simmer 8-10 minutes
12. Remove from heat and set aside until ready to assemble layers
13. Spray bottom of 9 x 13 baking dish with non stick spray
14. Dip two tortillas into gravy and place into baking dish
15. Cover with one fourth of ground beef , cheese and onion
16. Repeat 3 times
17. Bake for 50-60 minutes at 350 degrees f

title: baked bean cake or muffins
steps:
1. Cake:
2. Place raisins in a bowl and pour boiling water over them , set aside
3. In large mixing bowl , mash beans with a fork
4. Add eggs , oil and sugar , beat well
5. Combine flour , baking soda , baking powder , cinnamon and salt
6. Stir into bean mixture
7. Drain raisins and reserve liquid
8. Add raisins , nuts and vanilla to batter
9. If batter is too thick , add a little of the raisin water , stirring to combine
10. Pour mixture into a greased 13" x 9" baking pan
11. Bake at 325 degrees for approximately an hour or until tester inserted in centre comes out clean
12. Remove from oven and let cool in pan on rack
13. Icing:
14. Combine sugar and cream in a heavy-bottomed saucepan over medium heat
15. Bring to a boil , cook for 2 minutes
16. Add butter , remove from heat and stir in nuts , coconut and vanilla
17. Pour evenly over the cake , allow to cool before cutting
18. This recipe will makes 24 large muffins , baking time is 30 minutes
19. Enjoy !

title: collard greens surprise
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat
2. Add the onion and saute until translucent
3. Add the garlic and cook until fragrant
4. Add the greens , water , smoked salt , cider vinegar , and tabasco sauce
5. Season with black pepper
6. Increase the heat to medium high and bring to a boil
7. Decrease the heat to medium low , cover and cook until the greens are tender , 20-25 minutes
8. Taste and season with smoked salt and pepper

title: squash  apple and onion soup  revised
steps:
1. Place all of the ingredients into a large saucepan
2. Bring to the boil then reduce the heat to a simmer and cover
3. Simmer for 20 to 30 minutes , or until all the vegetables are completely soft
4. Place the soup into a food processor and blend until smooth
5. Return the soup to the saucepan and heat through gently adding salt and pepper to taste , and water if it is too thick

title: no fail moist chocolate cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Prepare pans by greasing and flouring
3. In a large bowl , stir group one ingredients together and set aside
4. In another large bowl , stir group two ingredients together
5. Stir group two into group one
6. It is quite a liquidy batter , so do not be alarmed !
7. Pour batter into prepared pans
8. You may have extra batter , if so make a few cupcakes !
9. Rap baking pans sharply on the counter to release air bubbles
10. Bake at 350 until edges are slightly dry , cake springs back when lightly pressed in the center , and a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean or with a few crumbs
11. Baking times will vary based on pan size , but check at 40 minutes and continue checking every 5 minutes thereafter
12. For cupcakes , check at 15 minutes

title: grilled skirt steak
steps:
1. Cut each steak in half crosswise
2. Put in a large resealable plastic bag
3. Stir together beer , orange juice , lime juice , hot sauce , and garlic , then pour over steaks
4. Seal bag and refrigerate at least 5 hours and up to overnight
5. Prepare a gas or charcoal grill for medium-high heat
6. Drain meat and discard marinade
7. Mix salt and cumin and rub into meat
8. Spray onions lightly with vegetable oil spray and set , with steaks , on a cleaned and oiled cooking grate
9. Don't cover
10. For medium-rare to medium doneness , grill steaks 3 to 4 minutes per side if less than 1 / 2 inches thick
11. Add 1 more minute per side if more than 1 / 2 inches thick
12. Turn steaks at least once while grilling
13. Grill onions , turning once , until browned on both sides and cooked through , 8 to 10 minutes total
14. After removing steaks from grill , let rest 5 minutes before slicing
15. With a sharp knife at a slight diagonal , cut across grain into thin strips
16. Serve meat and onions with tortillas , lime wedges , and hot sauce

title: speedy chicken scarpariello
steps:
1. In large nonstick skillet , heat oil over medium-high heat
2. Season the chicken with 1 / 4 teaspoon each of the salt , italian seasoning , and pepper
3. Saut chicken for 5 minutes , stirring occasionally
4. Cut sausages in 1 / 2-inch pieces
5. Add to skillet along with potatoes , sweet peppers and garlic
6. Stir in remaining 1 / 2 teaspoon salt , 1 / 2 teaspoon italian seasoning , and 1 / 4 teaspoon pepper
7. Add italian dressing and stir to combine
8. Cover skillet and cook over medium-high heat for 15 minutes , stirring occasionally
9. Remove skillet from heat and let stand 5 minutes before serving

title: tomato pudding
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees
2. Butter a 2 quart casserole dish and place the bread crumbs evenly on the bottom
3. In a saucepan , combine the butter , onion , and bell pepper and saute until translucent
4. Add the tomatoes and brown sugar , and seasonings and bring to a boil
5. Put half the cheese over the breadcrumbs and pour the tomato mixture over the top
