6. Add the rest of the cheese and bake until bubbly and the cheese is browned

title: mean chef s sauteed mushrooms
steps:
1. In a large skillet , heat the oil over high heat
2. Add the mushrooms
3. Do not move the mushrooms until they have caramelized on the bottom
4. If you toss them too soon , they will release their liquid and begin to steam
5. When the bottoms are caramelized , toss them and continue to cook for about 5 minutes
6. Add the butter and continue to cook and toss for 5 minutes , until beautifully browned
7. Season with salt and pepper
8. Add the garlic
9. Saute another 2 minutes , and add the thyme and lemon juice
10. Cook to evaporate the liquid
11. Add the wine and reduce until the mushrooms are glazed with the sauce
12. Toss in the parsley and serve immediately

title: creamy feta dressing
steps:
1. Combine yogurt , cheese and oil
2. Mix well
3. Stir in basil , vinegar , salt and pepper
4. Chill
5. Alternatively-put every thing in the blender and let 'er rip

title: 5 ingredient dump cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Dump pineapples with juice and cherry pie filling into a 9 x 13 inch pan and smooth out
3. Sprinkle cake mix evenly over fruit
4. Next , sprinkle pecans over all
5. Drizzle butter over the top
6. Bake for an hour
7. Serve in pan

title: awesome white pizza dip
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients well
2. Place in a casserole dish and bake at 350 for 25 - 30 minutes
3. Serve with sliced italian bread or soft italian breadsticks

title: herbed zucchini bites
steps:
1. Pat zucchini slices dry with paper towels
2. Spread cheese over the tops of the zucchini slices
3. Sprinkle with the chopped olives and chives
4. Serve immediately

title: the best greek yoghurt
steps: 1. Mix all ingredients together and enjoy !

title: marinara sauce of alan leonetti  2 servings     the best
steps:
1. Empty hunts chunky crushed tomatoes and hunts tomato paste into the pot
2. Add the extra-virgin olive oil to the pot
3. Slice the cloves of garlic crosswise into either halves or thirds or pieces , and dump them into the pot
4. Dice the shallot , and dump that into the pot
5. Add the rest of the ingredients , and stir to mix well with a large long handled wooden spoon
6. Do not strain , as the pulp adds to make this a thick and wonderful sauce
7. Cover and cook on medium heat , stirring every 10 minutes for about an hour or until it bubbles and is completely heated throughout
8. Reduce heat to simmer , and continue to simmer , stirring every 10 or 15 minutes to keep from burning or sticking to the bottom of the pot for 1 or 2 hours
9. Remove from heat and give it one last stir
10. Serve over spaghetti , ravioli , pasta or use for chicken parmesan , veal parmesan , or anything that calls for a marinara sauce

title: frozen strawberry crunch dessert
steps:
1. In bowl , combine flour , brown sugar , walnuts and cinnamon
2. Mix well
3. Stir in melted butter until well blended
4. Transfer mixture to large baking tray
5. Bake at 350 for 20 minute stirring often
6. Mixture should be crumbly
7. Cool
8. In large bowl , beat egg whites until foamy
9. Gradually add sugar , beating constantly until very thick
10. Add undrained strawberries and lemon juice
11. Beat for at least 10 minute until mixture is very light and fluffy fold in whipped topping , blending well
12. Into bottom of buttered 9x13 glass dish , evenly distribute half of brown sugar and nut mixture
13. Carefully spoon in strawberry mixture , spreading evenly
14. Sprinkle with remaining nut mixture
15. Cover and freeze 8 hours or more
16. Remove from freezer about 20 minute before serving
17. Cut into squares
18. Garnish each serving with a whole strawberry and a mint leaf sprig , if desired

title: mom s cream cheese veggie dip
steps:
1. Heat water and bouillon cubes in microwave until dissolved
2. Mix in cream cheese with a mixer
3. Refrigerate , serve with your choice of raw veggies

title: macaroni carbonara supreme
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees
2. In a skillet cook the bacon until crisp , then chop finely
3. Butter a 13 x 9-inch baking dish
4. Cook macaroni in salted boiling water until just firm-tender and still firm to the bite drain and rinse with cold water
5. In a large bowl toss together chopped cooked bacon , 1 / 4 cup reserved bacon drippings , add in breadcrumbs , 1 / 4 cup parmesan cheese and 1 / 4 cup parmesan cheese , toss to combine well and set aside
6. To the skillet with the remaining bacon drippings add in the fresh garlic
7. Saute for about 1 minute
8. Add in the flour and whisk for about 3 minutes
9. Gradually add in full-fat milk , half and half cream , egg yolks and black pepper cook whisking until mixture thickens
10. Add in 2 cups fontina cheese and 1 cup grated parmesan cheese
11. Whisk until the cheeses melt
12. Remove from the heat and season with salt if desired
13. Mix in the cooked macaroni
14. Stir in the remaining 1-1 / 2 cups fontina cheese
15. Mix to combine
16. Transfer the macaroni / cheese mixture to a prepared baking dish
17. Bake for about 25-30 minutes
18. Remove from the oven and sprinkle the reserved bread crumb mixture over the casserole and return to the oven for another 15-20 minutes , or until the topping is golden
19. Let stand for 20 minutes before serving
20. Delicious !

title: lite thai curry
steps:
1. Cut the chicken into bite size pieces and place in a bowl
2. Add the lime zest and juice , season well and marinate for 15 minutes
3. Heat oil in a large pot and saute the spring onions , garlic and ginger until fragrant
4. Add the curry paste , fish sauce and soy sauce
5. Let the flavors develop on low heat for 10-15 minutes
6. Add the chicken , mushrooms , lite coconut cream and cook on medium to high heat for 20-25 minutes , or until chicken is cooked
7. Just before serving , add the extra coriander and season with salt to taste
8. Serve with steamed rice and scatter fresh coriander , basil and chili over the top
9. 2 servings

title: skinnybaker s healthy chocolate cupcakes
steps:
1. Preheat oven 350f
2. Place cupcake lining in pans
3. Sift flour , baking soda , and salt
4. Set aside
5. Melt semisweet chocolate chips in double boiler
6. Let cool slightly
7. Cream butter , applesauce , splenda , sugar , brown sugar , and egg whites
8. Add melted chocolate chips
9. Mix well
10. Add flour mixture , vanilla ext
11. , and milk
12. Pour in cupcake cases and bake for 25-35 minutes or do toothpick test to see if done
13. You can frost these cupcakes with whatever frosting you prefer
14. I suggest leaving the frosting out and serving it with some fat free cool whip -- yumm !

title: avocado salad with bleu cheese   bacon
steps:
1. Tear the lettuce into a salad bowl
2. Add tomatoes and avocado
3. Sprinkle with bacon and cheese
4. Just before serving toss with the dressing
5. To make the dressing: blend all the dressing ingredients together
6. Chill

title: argentinian grilled flank steak with chimichurri sauce
steps:
1. Prepare grill according to manufacturer's instructions
2. Place onion on baking sheet
3. Brush both sides lightly with oil and season with salt and pepper
4. Sprinkle both sides of steak with salt and pepper
5. Place onion and steak directly on grill
6. Grill onion , turning once , until streaked with dark grill marks , 10 to 12 minutes
7. Grill steak until well seared and dark brown on side , 5 to 7 minutes
8. Using tongs , flip steak
9. Continuing grilling on other side until interior of meat is slightly less done than you want it to be when you eat it , 2 to 5 minutes more for rare or medium-rate
10. Transfer steak to cutting board , cover loosely with foil and let rest for 5 minutes
11. Slice steak very thing on bias against the grain
12. Season with salt & pepper to taste
13. Place onions on platter and arrange meat over onions
14. Serve with chimichurri sauce
15. For chimichurri sauce:
16. Process parsley and garlic in the work bowl of a food processor fitted with a steel blade , stopping as necessary to scrape sides of bowl
17. Until ingredients are chopped fine
18. Transfer mixture to medium bowl
19. Whisk in oil , vinegar , pepper flakes , salt and 2 tablespoons water until thoroughly blended
20. Serve immediately

title: cheese muffin sandwich
steps:
1. Combine ingredients except muffins
2. Split muffins in half and spread generously with mixture
3. Bake 5-10 minutes at 350 degrees until puffy

title: green coriander chutney
steps:
1. Put the chilies , ginger , garlic and creamed coconut into a food processor and make into a paste
2. Add the coriander and mint and pulse until they are blended
3. Add the salt and sugar
4. With the motor still running , pour the juice of 2
5. 5 of the limes down the funnel , processing to mix thoroughly
6. Taste to see if the juice of the other
7. 5 lime is needed
8. This can be kept for up to a month in a sealed jar in the fridge
9. It will solidify due to the creamed coconut , but can be restored by bringing back to room temperate , blitzing and adding a little more lime juice if needs be

title: greek chicken and potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f arrange chicken , potatoes and garlic in large roasting pan
2. Season with salt and pepper
3. Pour broth over
4. Whisk olive oil , lemon juice and oregano to combine
5. Pour evenly over chicken and potatoes
6. Bake until chicken is cooked through and golden brown and potatoes are tender , basting occasionally with pan juices , about 1 1 / 4 hours

title: tomato bruschetta  dijon style
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl , add the vinegar and mustard
2. Whisk to blend
3. Slowly whisk in the 1 / 4 cup olive oil
4. Add in the tomatoes , olives , and green onions
5. Toss to coat
6. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes
7. Toast the bread slices
8. Rub one side of each bread slice with the cut side of the garlic clove and drizzle with olive oil
9. Top the bread slices with the tomato mixture
10. Serve

title: steve s wonderful and relatively uncomplicated pico de gallo
steps:
1. Skin tomatoes by blanching quickly in boiling water for a few seconds until skin begins to wrinkle at the top , then quickly plunging into ice water to stop the cooking
2. This loosens the skins for easy removal
3. Cut skinned tomatoes into quarters and scoop out seeds and any loose pulp
4. Dice into roughly small cutes
5. Toss into final serving bowl
6. Peel and dice the white onion
7. Toss into serving bowl
8. Wash and separate about 14 stalks or simply half a small bunch of fresh cilantro
9. Remove tough center stems from leaves with their tiny stems
10. ,
11. Finely mince the plucked cilantro leaves and toss into serving bowl
12. Cut the top and stem off one fresh jalapeo and cut in half vertically
13. If you want to reduce the spiciness , scoop out all seeds and pale flesh until only dark green flesh remains
14. Toss into serving bowl after dicing fine
15. Be careful to wash hands after handling
16. Very painful if rub eyes with jalapeo on your fingers
17. Squeeze half orange , strain to remove seeds and toss orange juice into serving bowl
18. Also , add fresh squeezed or reconstituted lime juice
19. ""
20. Add pickled jalapeo juice from can , or if low sodium , omit this step)
21. After dicing and combining all ingredients , gently toss to mix and put in refrigerator to chill before serving
22. As pico de gallo sits the 'heat' diffuses , so dont be fooled when you first taste it
23. Otherwise if it sneaks up on you , it can become over-hot and you have to add more tomato and other ingredients to balance it again
24. Make any final adjustments to balance the flavors
25. Also , adding too much salt draws water out of the vegetables and makes the pico de gallo watery that won't hurt anything but it is not as aesthetically pleasing if too much liquid
26. Makes at least 4 cups

title: baked beans vegetarian style
steps:
1. Precook beans in boiling water for 2 minutes
2. Cover and let stand 1 hour
3. Then simmer for 1 hour until tender
4. Drain , reserving liquid
5. Mix beans with onion if using
6. Place beans in crock pot
7. Mix 1 1 / 2 cup reserved liquid , brown sugar , molasses , salt and mustard
8. Pour over beans and dot with butter
9. Cover and cook for 6-12 hours on low setting
10. Meat could be added as the beans are put in the crockpot , salt pork cut into chunks , or bacon as your personal preferences desire
11. The crockpot can be used on high to half cooking time , but the longer slower cooking time gives the beans a truly deep and rich flavour

title: caesar salad with tequila   lime grilled shrimp with chipotl
steps:
1. Marinade:
2. Stir together ingredients for marinade
3. Add shrimp
4. Set aside to marinade 1 / 2 hour
5. Dressing:
6. Whip to a smooth consistency the dressing ingredients
7. Mayonnaise , broth , soy sauce , lemon juice , chipotle
8. Refrigerate for 30 minutes
9. Grill shrimp:
10. Remove shrimp from marinade and grill over medium-hot setting for a couple of minutes on each sitde
11. The goals is for the shrimp to taste grilled ! when shrimp is done , remove and set aside to cool
12. Assemble salad:
13. In a large salad bowl , mix romaine , corn and tomatoes with dressing
14. Place on a chilled salad plates
15. Place shrimp on lettuce bed
16. Garnish with parmesan cheese , croutons and cilantro
17. Serve additional dressing on the side
18. Serve immediately

title: frankly fake fudge   sugar free
steps:
1. Standing time 4 hours
2. In small saucepan , combine milk and cocoa
3. Whisk until there are no
4. Lumps of cocoa
5. Cook over medium heat , stirring for about 5 min or
6. Until thickened
7. In another small saucepan , sprinkle gelatin over water
8. Let stand for
9. 5 min to soften
10. Heat over low heat , stirring , until gelatin dissolves
11. Stir into
12. Cocoa mixture
13. Stir in sweetener (artificial sweetener like sugartwin equivalent to
14. 1 / 2 cup sugar) and brandy extract
15. Remove from heat
16. Pour into 8 inch square baking dish
17. Let stand at room temperature 4
18. Hours or until firm
19. To remove from pan , cut around edges with a sharp knife
20. Place dish
21. In shallow pan of hot water for about 30 seconds just to slightly
22. Soften bottom
23. Loosen one corner , then quickly flip gel out onto
24. Clean cutting surface
25. With sharp knife , cut evenly in 10 one way and 10 the other way
26. Place in container , cover and refrigerate
27. Will keep up to 1 week in
28. Refrigerator

title: butter sticks
steps:
1. Heat oven to 425
2. Place butter into 13x9 baking pan and place in hot oven just until butter has melted
3. In a bowl stir together the bisquik and the cold water
4. Gently smooth into a ball and on a floured surface knead about 5 times
5. Roll dough into rectangular 10"x6" with lightly floured rolling pin
6. Cut lengthwise in half
7. Cut each half crosswise into 12 equal strips about 3" long and 3 / 4" wide
8. Dip each strip into butter you have melted in the baking pan , coating both sides of strip
9. Arrange strips in baking pan
10. Bake 12-15 minutes

title: good morning bran muffins by splenda
steps:
1. Combine cereal and milk
2. Let stand 5 minutes
3. Stir in egg and margarine
4. Add carrots , apple and raisins
5. Combine remaining ingredients in large bowl
6. Stir cereal mixture into dry ingredients , stirring just until moistened
7. Spoon batter into 12 large , greased or paper baking cup-lined muffin tins
8. Bake at 400f for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown
9. Cool in pan 5 minutes and then turn out onto rack to cool
10. 12 muffins
11. Canadian living test kitchen

title: waffle recipe for waffle makers
steps:
1. Mix dry ingredients
2. Mix wet ingredients in a seperate bowl
3. Slowly add together
4. Pour into waffle maker
5. After the batter is in the waffle maker , you can add fruit or chocolate chips onto the batter
6. And close the top

title: citrus masquerade
steps:
1. Frost the side of a martini glass with a little bit of sugar
2. In a shaker , put 4 raisins , the lemon slice , and the remaining sugar and mash everything
3. Add vodka , orange liquor and ice
4. Shake well
5. Strain in the martini glass and garnish with 2 raisins and an orange slice

title: apple bread abm
steps:
1. Place apples pieces into a mixing bowl and stir in cinnamon and brown sugar
2. Let rest together overnight - this will create your apple / sugar juice
3. Separate the apples from the sugary juice and place them in the bread machine , along with your dry ingredients , and butter
4. Measure out one cup of the sugar juice , and separate your egg white
5. Add liquids and start the machine , manual or dough cycle
6. You want the dough to create a ball
7. When dough cycle has finished , divide dough into halves
8. Place each half into a well greased and floured 9 inch loaf pan
9. Bake at 350f for 50 minutes

title: smoked salmon   caramelized onion omelet    13
steps:
1. In a med bowl , beat eggs w / salt & pepper till just blended
2. In a 9-in skillet over med-heat , heat the oil & saute onion till soft & caramelized
3. Turn out of the pan & set aside
4. In the same skillet , melt butter over med-heat
5. Pour eggs into the pan & cook , lifting from the edge to let the runny portion flow underneath
6. When almost set , scatter the onion & salmon over it
7. Roll over 1 / 3 of the omelet & tilt it onto a warm plate , making another fold
8. Divide omelet into 2 servings
9. Spoon sour cream over the top , sprinkle w / chives & serve immediately

title: uncle bill s french mushroom soup
steps:
1. Rinse both mushrooms in cold water and immediately pat dry with paper towels
2. Cut mushrooms into quarters and then slice thinly , 1 / 8 inch thick
3. In a large heavy bottom soup pot , melt butter on medium heat
4. Add mushrooms and saute for 5 to 6 minutes or until liquid from the mushrooms has mostly evaporated
5. Sprinkle flour over mushrooms and cook for 1 minute , stirring often
6. Gradually stir in chicken broth , water and chicken soup base and bring to boil , about 5 minutes , stirring often so the bottom does not burn
7. Add thyme , bay leaf and green onions
8. Reduce heat , cover and simmer for 20 minutes
9. Remove bay leaf and discard
10. In a mixing bowl , whisk together egg yolks and whipping cream
11. Slowly add 1 cup of hot broth mixture from the soup pot to the egg / cream mixture , whisking constantly until incorporated
12. This prevents the egg yolks from cooking
13. Return mixture to the soup pot , adding slowly and whisking all the time while adding
14. Heat over low heat until hot , about 5 minutes
15. Add white pepper to taste
16. Serve soup sprinkled with minced parsley

title: mexican mocha spice mix
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a large bowl and stir well
2. Store in an airtight container and shake well before each use
3. Use to make hot cocoa or substitute for cocoa in chocolate pudding recipe

title: emeril s lyonnaise potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400 f
2. Place the potatoes in a pot of salted water and bring to a boil
3. Cook for 2 minutes
4. Remove the pan from the heat and drain
5. Heat the olive oil in a large ovenproof skillet over medium heat
6. Add the onions and season with salt and pepper
7. Cook , stirring , until the onions are caramelized , 8 to 10 minutes
8. Transfer the onions to a bowl
9. Place the pan back on the stove and melt the stick of butter
10. When the butter has melted , cover the bottom of the pan with 1 / 3 of the potatoes
11. Cover the first layer of potatoes with 1 / 2 of the onions
12. Cover the onions with 1 / 3 of the potatoes
13. Repeat the layering until all of the potatoes and onions are used
14. Place the pan in the oven and cook for 10 to 12 minutes or until the potatoes are golden brown
15. Remove the pan from the oven
16. Using a spatula , gently lift the potatoes out of the pan
17. Slice the lyonnaise into 12 slices
18. Garnish with parsley

title: gentlemen s morsels
steps:
1. Lay bread slices out on the counter or cutting board
2. Spread half the bread slices with a thin layer of apricot jam
3. Arrange sliced ham on top
4. Spread the other bread slices with a thin layer of dijon mustard and set on top of the ham
5. With a serrated knife , trim the crusts
6. To serve , cut into squares , triangles , or fingers

title: crock pot cajun crab dip
steps:
1. Saut onions and red pepper in butter
2. Place in a crock pot along with the tomatoes , seasonings and cheese
3. Cook on high until cheese is melted
4. Add crabmeat and cook on low for approximately 60 minutes

title: wild rice and sausage
steps:
1. Fry sausage until brown and drain off grease
2. Saut mushrooms , celery and onions in butter until tender
3. Add flour and stir until smooth
4. Gradually add milk , stirring constantly and keep stirring until sauce is thick and smooth
5. Add worcestershire sauce , rice and sausage to mushroom sauce and place mixture in a greased casserole dish
6. Top with buttered bread crumbs and bake at 375f for 30 minutes

title: avocado sauce
steps:
1. Put the avocado , lime juice , salt , jalapeno , cilantro , water and olive oil in a food processor
2. Puree until smooth
3. Add the onion and pulse to roughly blend inches
4. Serve immediately

title: pork chops hawaiian  ww 7 points
steps:
1. In skillet , brown chops
2. Pour off fat
3. Add remaining ingredients except the water and cornstarch
4. Cover
5. Simmer 45 minutes
6. Stir now and then
7. Mix 2 t
8. Water and 1 t
9. Cornstarch
10. Stir into sauce , cooking and stirring until thickened

title: nuts and berries
steps: 1. Combine all ingredients and serve on ice

title: moroccan eggplant  aubergine  salad
steps:
1. Soak sun-dried tomatoes in boiling water 15-30 minutes until they soften , then drain and dice
2. Set aside until needed
3. Heat oil in a large skillet
4. Add eggplant , red pepper , and onion along with salt , pepper , cumin , paprika , and garlic
5. Cook mixture , stirring occasionally , over medium heat , for 8-9 minutes or until lightly tender , then remove from heat and allow to cool
6. In a large bowl , mix together chopped olives , chopped sun-dried tomatoes , chopped parsley , toasted almonds , lemon juice , and mint
7. Mix in cooled eggplant mixture , tossing lightly
8. Serve salad warm or chilled with fresh pita bread , or alone as a salad or first course

title: ultimate beer butt chicken  beer can
steps:
1. Rinse chicken well inside an out
2. Pat bird completely dry with paper towels
3. To make the rub: mix 4 tbsp paprika , 2 tsp salt , 2 tbsp black pepper , 2 tsp cayenne pepper , and 1 / 4 cup brown sugar in a small bowl and set it aside
4. To make glaze: mix together 1 / 4 cup brown sugar , 4 tbsp ketchup , 3 tsp frank's red hot sauce , 4 tbsp white vinegar , 4 tbsp beer , and 2 tbsp of the spice rub you just made in a separate bowl
5. Set aside
6. Pour beer can out until it is just a bit over half way full and then add crushed bay leaves and 1 tsp of rub to the half full can
7. Loosen the skin on the breasts , legs and thighs of your chicken
8. Massage the rub into the meat under the skin and then all over the outside of the bird's skin as well as inside the cavity
9. Place beer can in the "butt" of the bird making the bird stand upright
10. Preheat grill with all burners on high until grill is heated and ready to cook
11. You must cook indirectly
12. So if you have 2 burners on your grill , turn one off
13. Place the standing bird on the cooler or "off" burner side of the grill with the breasts facing the hot or "on side of it
14. Close lid and cook for 30 minutes , then rotate bird so that the opposite side is not facing the heated side of the grill and then continue cooking with the lid closed for 30 more minutes
15. Rotate bird back to original position with breasts facing the heat and glaze the entire bird thoroughly with the pre-made glaze
16. Continue cooking 30 more minutes until cooked , brown and slightly crisped
17. Transfer chicken carefully off of beer can and onto cutting board
18. Let rest 5-10 minutes and then carve and enjoy !

title: pecan praline candy
steps:
1. Butter 2 cookie sheets , or line with wax paper
2. In a saucepan , combine sugars , cream and marshmallows
3. Cook , and stir over low heat until marshmallows are completely melted
4. Cook , over medium heat , stirring occasionally until a candy thermometer reads 234 degrees- 240 degrees
5. Without stirring or scraping , pour hot liquid into another saucepan
6. Add the pecans , butter , vanilla and cinnamon
7. Stir rapidly until mixture is thickened and creamy
8. Drop quickly by rounded tablespoonfuls onto prepared pans
9. Flatten slightly
10. Let stand until set
11. Store in an airtight container

title: protein porridge
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients in a saucepan
2. Bring to the boil , simmer for 1 - 2 minutes
3. Then serve in a bowl with your choice of cream , milk and sweeteners
4. So simple

title: pasta salad vinaigrette  mccormick style
steps:
1. Cook pasta as directed
2. Rinse under cold water and drain well
3. Mix oil , vinegar and seasonings till well blended
4. Toss pasta and vegetables in a large bowl
5. Add the dressing and toss gently
6. Cover and refrigerate for at least one hour before serving
7. Toss lightly before serving

title: sugar free iced rocky road mocha
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a tall glass or 2 8oz glasses
2. Stir and serve

title: chicken salad  with a buffalo twist
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together in a small bowl
2. Chill and serve on toasted bread or crackers

title: nimbu ka chaval  saffron rice with lime
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Place saffron in a small bowl and pour 1 / 4 cup boiling water over it
3. Let stand at least 10 minutes
4. Meanwhile , bring 4 cups of water to a boil in a heavy saucepan
5. Add rice , stirring constantly to keep water at a boil
6. Add 1 teaspoon salt
7. Cook over moderate heat , uncovered , for 10 minutes
8. Drain rice and set aside
9. Heat butter or ghee in a heavy 3-4 quart casserole with a tight-fitting lid
10. Add cashews , ginger , mustard seeds and clove
11. Cook , stirring constantly , until seeds begin to burst , about 1-2 minutes
12. Add remaining salt , chili pepper , rice , coriander , lime juice , coconut and remaining boiling water , stirring well
13. Sprinkle saffron and the water it soaked in over the top
14. Bring to a boil over high heat , stirring occasionally
15. Cover pan with aluminum foil
16. Place lid on top
17. Bake for 25 minutes , or until rice has absorbed all liquid
18. Fluff with a fork before serving

title: watermelon and cucumber salad
steps:
1. Combine vinegar , sugar and red pepper in a small saucepan
2. Bring to a boil and boil 1 minute
3. Remove from heat and set aside
4. Slice cucumbers and toss with salt to taste in a large bowl
5. Let stand at room temperature 30 minutes
6. Press the cucumbers with paper towels to remove any excess liquid
7. Toss the watermelon and the 1 / 2 teaspoon salt together in a large bowl
8. Add cucumbers and vinegar mixture and toss gently to combine
9. Chill or serve at room temperature

title: spicy easy english muffin pizza
steps:
1. Toast english muffin
2. When the muffin is done , put on about 3 tablespoons of sauce and about a handful of cheese
3. When that is done , put in microwave about 30 seconds
4. When it's done in the microwave , put on crushed red pepper and any other seasonings you would like
5. Enjoy

title: chicken thighs with olives and basil
steps:
1. Season the chicken with half the salt , and a good grinding of black pepper
2. Heat the oil in a large , heavy based frying pan over moderately high heat
3. Brown the chicken well on both sides , about 8 minutes in total
4. Remove
5. Reduce the heat to medium and and the onion and garlic
6. Cook for about 5 minutes , until the onion starts to soften
7. Add the rosemary and wine and bring to a simmer , scraping any brown bits from the bottom
8. Boil for 1-2 minutes , until the wine is reduced by half
9. Add the broth , tomatoes , olives the remaining salt and the chicken , skin side up , along with any juices
10. Cover and simmer for about 25 minutes or until the chicken is just done
11. Push the chicken to the side of the pan , crush the garlic with a fork and stir in the basil an another grinding of black pepper
12. Reheat for a minute and serve

title: bacon jam and potato breakfast pizza  sp5
steps:
1. Place a pizza stone in the oven and preheat oven to 500
2. Take potatoes out of bag and place in a colander
3. Rinse and drain well
4. Place potatoes in a clean dish towel and wring dry
5. Roll out pizza dough to a 10 - 12" round
6. Spread rolled out dough with 2 / 3 of the bacon jam
7. Top jam layer with one and a half cups of cheese
8. Top cheese with hash browns
9. Spread remaining cheese over hash browns
10. Make 4 small depressions in each quadrant of the pizza
11. Place 1 egg in each of the depressions
12. Dollop remaining bacon jam around top of pizza
13. Bake for 12 minutes , until egg white is cooked and yolk is runny
14. My oven is temperamental and takes longer to bake the eggs
15. Keep an eye on your eggs while they bake and adjust cooking time accordingly

title: tunisian brik  essential mediterranean
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f metl the butter in a small frying pan and cool the onion over low heat until soft but not brown , about 5 minutes
2. Combine the onion , tuna , capers , parsley and parmesan in a bowl
3. Season to taste with salt and pepper
4. Cut the filo pastry sheets in half widthways
5. Layer four of the half-sheets together , brushing each with melted butter
6. Keep the remaining pastry covered with a tamp towel
7. Spoon half the tuna mixture onto one end of the buttered pastry , leaving a border
8. Made a well in the center of the mixture and carefully break an egg into the well , being careful not to break it
9. Season with salt and pepper
10. Layer two more sheets of the filo together , brushing with melted butter , and place on top of the tuna and egg
11. Fold in the pastry sides , then roll into a firm parcel , keeping the egg intact
12. Place on a lightly greased baking tray and brush with melted butter
13. Repeat with the remaining pastry , filling and egg
14. Bake for 15 minutes , or until the pastry is golden brown
15. Serve warm or at room temperature
16. If you like your eggs firmer , bake for a little longer

title: lemon balsamic green beans
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large saucepan over high heat
2. Chop onion into thin strips and add them to the pan
3. Add half the garlic , salt , and pepper , and saute until onions barely begin to brown
4. Cut ends off green beans if fresh , and add them to the pan
5. Mix in remaining garlic
6. Juice 1 / 4 of a lemon into the pan and add 2 tbls of balsamic vinegar and i tsp of butter
7. Sample a green bean , and add remaining lemon , salt and pepper to taste
8. Before green beans are fully cooked , toss in desired amount of sliced almonds
9. Warm a little longer , and serve immediately

title: chicken taco fettuccine
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to package directions
2. Meanwhile , in a large skillet over medium heat , cook the chicken and garlic in oil for 4 to 5 minutes or until heated through
3. Whisk in cream and taco seasoning until blended
4. Cook until heated through , do not boil
5. Stir in parmesan cheese
6. Drain pasta , toss with chicken mixture

title: spinach artichoke stuffed potatoes
steps:
1. Steam chopped spinach for 1 minute , drain well and place in a large mixng bowl
2. Cut the baked potatoes in half lengthwise and scoop the insides into the bowl with the spinach
3. Add the remaining ingredients except the parmesan cheese and stir well
4. Mound the filling back into the potato shells and place them in a shallow baking dish
5. Sprinkle with the parmesan and place under the broiler until the cheese is bubbly and hot

title: cheezy chicken parmesan with zucchini  pasta
steps:
1. For the sauce , heat 1 tablespoon of the oil in a large skillet over medium-low heat
2. Add the onion , garlic and 1 / 2 teaspoon salt
3. Cook , stirring , 1 minute
4. Cover , reduce heat to very low and cook until vegetables are softened , about 5 minutes
5. Add the tomatoes with juice , basil and another 1 / 2 teaspoon salt
6. Bring to a simmer , cover and simmer gently 5 minutes
7. Then simmer very gently , partially covered , until thickened , about 20 minutes
8. Season with 1 / 8 teaspoon pepper
9. Meanwhile , using a mandoline or vegetable peeler , slice the zucchini lengthwise into 1 / 8-inch-thick long pappardelle-like strips , turning the zucchini and slicing on 4 sides only until you see the center seeds
10. Discard the centers
11. Remove the tomato sauce to a bowl with a rubber spatula
12. No need to clean the skillet
13. Heat the remaining 1 tablespoon of oil in the skillet over medium heat
14. Add the zucchini and 1 / 4 teaspoon salt
15. Cover and cook until wilted , tossing often with tongs for even cooking , 8 to 10 minutes
16. Return the tomato sauce to the pan , add 1 tablespoon of the parsley , and season with 1 / 8 teaspoon pepper
17. Cover and set aside
18. Cut chicken breasts in half to make 68 large , thin cutlets
19. On a plate , combine the bread crumbs , 1 / 4 cup grated parmesan and the remaining chopped parsley
20. Place the egg white on a second plate
21. Dip the chicken into the egg whites , and then into the bread crumb mixture to coat completely
22. Set aside on a large plate or platter
23. Heat 2 teaspoons oil in each of two nonstick 10-inch skillets over medium-high heat
24. Add half of the chicken to each skillet and cook until lightly browned on one side , 2 to 3 minutes
25. Flip , and cook until chicken is firm , and lightly browned on the other side , 1 to 3 more minutes
26. To serve , re-warm the zucchini in the tomato sauce over medium heat
27. Use tongs to make a twist of zucchini pappardelle on each of 4 plates
28. Lean chicken cutlets against the side of zucchini
29. Scoop 1 tablespoon ricotta onto each plate , and spoon remaining tomato sauce on top of the chicken
30. To garnish each plate , drizzle chicken with 1 / 2 teaspoon olive oil , and sprinkle with 1 teaspoon parmesan

title: zucchini puffs with lemon aioli
steps:
1. To make the lemon aioli
2. Place egg yolks , vinegar , garlic , lemon juice in the bowl of a food processor and process until combined
3. Gradually pour in the oil while the motor is still running and process until the mixture is thick and smooth
4. To make the puffs
5. Place the zucchini , mint , eggs , flour , salt and pepper in a bowl and stir well to combine
6. Heat 1cm of oil in a large non-stick frypan over medium heat
7. Add about 2 tablespoonfuls of the mixture and shallow-fry in batches for 1-2 minutes each side or until puffed up and golden
8. Serve with lemon aioli

title: bread machine rolls
steps:
1. Place the flour , sugar , salt , milk powder , water , butter , and yeast in the pan of the bread machine in the order recommended by the manufacturer
2. Set on dough cycle
3. Press start
4. Remove risen dough from machine , deflate , and turn out on lightly floured surface
5. Divide the dough into 12 equal pieces , and form into rounds
6. Place the rounds on lightly greased baking sheets
7. Cover the rolls with a damp cloth , and let rise until doubled in bulk , about 40 minutes
8. Meanwhile , preheat oven to 350
9. In a small bowl , mix together the egg white and 2 tblsp
10. Water
11. Brush lightly onto the rolls
12. Bake for 15 minutes , or until the rolls are golden brown

title: zucchini  ham and pumpkin slice
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 200c
2. Line a 20cm square baking pan with baking paper
3. Heat oil in pan over moderate heat
4. Cook onion and garlic , stirring , for 3 minutes
5. Add ham and cook for another 2 minutes
6. Whisk eggs with milk in large bowl
7. Add zucchini , pumpkin , and ham mixture
8. Fold flour through mix and season with italian herbs and salt & pepper to taste
9. Spoon mix into prepared pan
10. Bake for 35- 40 minute , until slice is golden and set
11. Cool for 5 minutes in the pan before slicing

title: edie s zucchini chocolate chip bread
steps:
1. Prepare two 8x4x2 inch loaf pans by spraying with non-stick spray or greasing with butter or shortening
2. In a large bowl , combine the flour , sugar , baking powder , baking soda , salt , nutmeg and cinnamon
3. In another bowl , beat the eggs , applesauce , oil , orange peel and vanilla
4. Stir wet ingredients into the dry ingredients just until moistened
5. Gently fold in the zucchini , nuts and chocolate chips
6. Transfer batter evenly into the two prepared bread loaf pans
7. Bake at 350f for 55-60 minutes or until a pick comes out clean from the center
8. Cool for 10-15 minutes before inverting bread onto wire rack to cool completely
9. Do not attempt to slice until bread is completely cool

title: ovaltine snickerdoodles
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400 degrees f
2. In large bowl combine first 4 ingredients
3. Blend well
4. Stir in flour , cream of tartar , soda and salt
5. You can also add 2 t of ovaltine if wanted
6. Shape dough into 1-inch balls
7. Combine 2 tbsp sugar , ovaltine and cinnamon
8. Roll balls in sugar mixture
9. Place 2 inches apart on cookie sheet
10. Bake 8-10 min or until set
11. Immediately remove from cookie sheet
12. Bake for 8 minutes for more chewy cookies or 9-10 minutes for crisper cookies
13. Enjoy !

title: cowboy hotpot
steps:
1. Grate or cube the cheese to suit your taste
2. Gently fry onion , pepper and carrot in oil until softened
3. Add green beans , baked beans , sweet corn , and tomato puree
4. Bring to the boil , and simmer five minutes
5. Transfer to a baking dish and scatter with cheese
6. Cover with sliced potatoes , brush with butter , and sprinkle with paprika
7. Bake 180c 30-40 minutes until potatoes are cooked

title: danish layer cake  dansk lagekage
steps:
1. Cut 5 or 6 pieces of wax paper and draw an 8" circle in each
2. Have available a large cookie sheet or jelly roll pan that will accommodate two wax paper sheets
3. In mixing bowl , cream softened butter with sugar and beat until fluffy
4. Blend in eggs and vanilla
5. Mix in flour and baking powder and beat until well blended
6. Divide cake batter among the 5 or 6 wax paper sheets
7. Spread batter into shape of circle and place on cookie sheet
8. Bake at 350 degrees about 9 or 10 minutes until golden around edge and cake springs back when touched
9. Remove from cookie sheet and cool
10. Repeat for remaining batter
11. Take 1st round of pastry and place on cake platter
12. Spread some raspberry jam on top and then some vanilla pudding
13. Repeat same with 2nd , 3rd , 4th , and 5th layer
14. Place 6th layer of pastry on top and frost top layer with a layer of icing
15. Beat whipping cream until stiff and frost sides of cake with whipping cream
16. You can decorate the cake as to what the occasion calls for - danish flags , candles for a birthday , cake sprinkles , etc
17. Cake can be assembled ahead of time and refrigerated
18. The flavors blend and it tastes somewhat like trifle
19. Frost sides of cake with whipping cream just before serving

title: stilton cheesecake
steps:
1. Set oven at 325 degrees f
2. Combine melted butter and crushed cookies in a bowl until mixed and press into the bottom of a 9-inch spring-form pan
3. Crumble stilton into a bowl
4. Add cream cheese and sugar , then beat with an electric mixer until well blended
5. Beat in eggs , one at a time until smooth and creamy
6. Add vanilla
7. Stir in flour , sour cream and dry vermouth or lemon juice until well blended
8. Pour cheese mixture over crust
9. Bake in oven for 1 hour , or until firm
10. Turn off heat and let cake cool in oven for 1 hour
11. Cool on wire rack 1 hour and cover pan with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight
12. Loosen cake from spring-form side with a narrow knife and remove side when ready to serve

title: minestrone with chicken and sausage
steps:
1. Defat the sausage- place the sausages in a sauce pan with enough water to cover
2. Bring to a boil , and let boil for 5 minutes
3. Drain , and when cool enough to handle , chop into small dice
4. Add the oil to a large pot , and heat over a medium flame until the oil is warm and fragrant
5. Add the onion , garlic , 1 / 2 teaspoon salt and pepper
6. Cook , stirring occasionally , 1-2 minutes
7. Add the chicken and sausage , and continue to cook , until the chicken is no longer pink in the center
8. Add the carrots , celery , stock , beans , tomatoes , bay leaf , thyme and remaining salt
9. Cover , and bring to a boil
10. Reduce the heat to medium low and simmer for 15 minutes
11. Add the pasta , simmer another 8-10 minutes , until the pasta is al dente
12. To serve , ladle into warm soup bowls , and top with a tablespoon of pesto

title: farmer bread  burebrot
steps:
1. Mix together the flours and salt
2. Add in the yeast
3. Add the water and buttermilk , and mix in an electric mixer fitted with a dough hook until the dough is fairly firm and does not stick to the side of the bowl
4. Rise at room temp until doubled in size
5. Heat oven to 425f
6. Shape the dough into a long oval on a baking sheet
7. Cover with a towel , and allow to rise again for about 30 minutes
8. Cut a lattice pattern into the dough with a sharp knife
9. Place into the oven , and bake for 40 to 45 minutes , until crusty

title: chunky caesar salad
steps:
1. Cut romaine into 1-inch wide strips
2. Grate 2 t
3. Zest , and squeeze 1 t
4. Juice from lemon
5. In serving bowl , whisk together dressing , lemon juice , zest , and pepper
6. Add lettuce , tomatoes , croutons
7. Toss to combine
8. Scrape a vegetable peeler over the widest side of a chunk of the cheese
9. Top with cheese shavings

title: cabbage broccoli salad and dressing
steps:
1. In small bowl mix miracle whip , sugar , and vinegar until sugar is dissolved
2. Set aside
3. Prepare all remaining ingredients and place in large bowl
4. Add dressing and mix thoroughly
5. Chill in fridge for up to 2 hours
6. Toss again before serving

title: borden s mini cheesecakes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300 degrees f
2. Line cupcake tin with cupcake papers
3. Combine crumbs , sugar and butter
4. Press equal portions onto bottom of cupcake papers
5. In large mixing bowl beat cheese until fluffy
6. Gradually beat in condensed milk until smooth
7. Add eggs and vanilla
8. Mix well
9. Spoon equal amounts into prepared cups
10. Bake 20 minutes or until cakes spring back when touched lightly
11. Cool and chill
12. Garnish with fresh berries or sliced fruits
13. Chocolate shavings
14. Toasted coconut
15. Or cake sprinkles for a festive look

title: 90 minute peanut butter rolls
steps:
1. In a large mixing bowl , combine 1 c flour , sugar , undissolved yeast and salt
2. Heat milk , water and peanut butter until warm- about 120-130f
3. Gradually add to dry ingredients
4. Beat for 2 minutes at medium speed by electric mixer
5. Add egg and 1 / 2 c flour , beat 2 minutes at high speed
6. Stir in enough remaining flour , by hand to make a soft dough
7. Knead on light floured surface until smooth and elastic- about 8- 10 minutes
8. Combine peanut butter filling ingredients until smooth
9. Cover and let rest 10 minutes
10. Divide dough into 2 equal portions
11. Roll each half to 14 x 8 inch rectangle
12. Spread with filling
13. Roll up tightly from long side , pinching the seam to seal
14. Cut into 8 equal pieces
15. Place cut side up in each of 2 greased 9 inch round cake pans
16. Cover and let rise in warm draft-free place until double in size- about 45 minutes
17. Bake at 375f for 20- 25 minutes or until done
18. Remove from pans and cool on a wire rack
19. Melt chocolate glaze ingredients together , stirring until smooth
20. Drizzle over rolls
21. Sprinkle with chopped peanuts

title: pineapple horchata mexico
steps:
1. Trim and core the pineapple , adding the pieces to a large pot
2. Sprinkle in the rice and water
3. Mix it up good
4. Let simmer , covered , for 30 minutes
5. Remove the skin and core , then puree the rice water with up to 2 cups cubed pineapple
6. You can use an immersion blender , or a regular blender but be careful cool before blending
7. Strain the horchata and whisk together with as much sugar as youd like
8. One cup is about right
9. You may drink this straight and it will be a smoothie consistency , or you can dilute it with water to make a thinner cocoction
10. Either way , add a spear of sweet pineapple

title: couch potatoes
steps:
1. In 12x8 baking dish , arrange potato halves , cut side up , around edges of dish
2. Add 1 tablespoon water and cook , covered , on high , 8-10 minutes until tender , rotating dish halfway through cooking time
3. Drain
4. Meanwhile , combine all remaining ingredients
5. Place this mixture on cut sides of potatoes and cook on high 1-2 minutes until cheese melts

title: ugly cake
steps:
1. Beat all cake ingredients together for 4 minutes
2. Pour into greased and floured 9x13-inch pan
3. Sprinkle coconut and brown sugar over top
4. Bake at 325 for about 45 minutes

title: chestnut stew
steps:
1. Boil the potatoes and sweet potato separately until soft - about 25 minutes each
2. Meanwhile boil the chestnuts for 20 minutes in the stock
3. Saut the rosemary , remaining vegetables , dates , yeast extract and tomatoes in the olive oil
4. Add this to the chestnuts and their juice and simmer for about 15 - 20 minutes
5. Heat the soya milk then using a hand-blender blend it with the oil
6. Once the oil and soya milk are blended , blend in the lime juice
7. Drain the potatoes and mash them with 3 tablespoons soya milk mixture , parsley and some salt and pepper
8. Blend the remaining soya milk mixture with mustard , bouillon mix , and the garlic clove
9. Mix together the balsamic vinegar , black strap molasses , carob powder , corn flour , tomato puree , and orange juice to make a paste
10. Add to the chestnuts and vegetables whilst stirring over a low heat until the sauce thickens
11. Divide the mixture into six 12 cm / 4" - 5" pots then cover with a layer of mashed potato , and finally top with the 'cheesy' sauce
12. Place in a preheated oven 180c gas mark 4 for about 20 minutes until the topping goes bubbly and golden
13. Alternatively make 6 stacks of the potato coated with the sauce and grill them for 10 minutes to serve separately with the hot stew

title: franks but no franks
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. In large bowl combine all of the ingredients except the buns
3. Fill the buns with the mixture and wrap each bun in foil
4. Bake in 375 oven for 20-25 minutes

title: easy chocolate crumb pudding
steps:
1. In the top of double boiler , melt the chocolate
2. Add in the bread crumbs , almonds and salt
3. Combine well
4. Fold in the 4 stiffly beaten egg whites
5. Cover , steam in double boiler for 25 minutes
6. This can be served warm , or chilled , with whipped cream if desired

title: orange roughy veracruz
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat
2. Add onion
3. And garlic , saute 7 minutes or until tender
4. Add peppers and tomatoes
5. Cook over medium-high heat 3 minutes
6. Add fish
7. Sprinkle with garlic powder and pepper
8. Cover and reduce heat , simmer 5 minutes
9. Turn fish over
10. Cover and simmer an additional 5 minutes or until fish flakes with a fork
11. Transfer to individual serving plates , reser ving cooking sauce in skillet
12. Keep fish warm
13. Place skillet with cooking sauce over medium-high heat , and cook 3 minutes or until thickened
14. Serve sauce over fish

title: mushroom and pate omelette aust ww 3 5 pts
steps:
1. Coat a small pan with cooking spray , heat and cook the mushrooms until tender
2. Stir in the pate and shallot
3. Cook , stirring , over the heat until the pate is melted
4. Beat the eggs and water together
5. Pour the egg mixture over the mushrooms and gently cook until the underside of the omelet is browned and to is beginning to set
6. Carefully fold the omelet in half and slide onto a serving plate

title: brandy velvet
steps:
1. Stir together coffee granules and hot water
2. Process coffee and next 3 ingredients in a blender until smooth
3. Garnish with grated chocolate , if desired

title: caribbean chimichangas with jamaican pepper sauce
steps:
1. In large bowl , mix together chicken , black beans , onions , corn , cilantro , jalapeo peppers , rice and jamaican jerk seasoning
2. On each tortilla , spoon about 1 / 3 to 1 / 2 cup chicken mixture just below center
3. Fold two sides of tortillas over filling
4. Fold over top and bottom edges of tortillas , making rectangles
5. Secure with wooden picks
6. On greased baking sheet , place tortillas , folded side down
7. Spray chimichangas with cooking spray and bake in 425f oven for 15 minutes , turning once
8. Remove picks and serve with mango pepper dipping sauce
9. Mango pepper dipping sauce: in medium bowl , whisk together all ingredients
10. Store in refrigerator until chimichangas are finished baking
11. Whisk again just before serving
12. For my friends who are also doing the ww core program , this can be easily modified to meet the program
13. First , use brown not white rice
14. In making the sauce , use a lesser amount of water in place of the nectar
15. Also , skip the brown sugar or use splenda
16. Now your only non-core ingredient are the tortillas
17. Count points for those
18. I used a fat free version that was 3 points for 2 tortillas
19. If you are saving points , it's a wonderful entree salad with a fruity mango dressing

title: pizza hotdish
steps:
1. Brown ground beef and onion
2. Place in greased 2 quart casserole
3. Cook macaroni per package directions , then drain and add to the meat mixture
4. Add 1
5. 5 cans tomato sauce , water , basil , garlic powder or salt , oregano , and fennel seeds , and 1 c shredded mozzarella cheese
6. If you are adding tomatoes or green beans , add them now
7. Mix well
8. Spread the rest of the cheese on top , add a layer of pepperoni , and evenly spoon on the last half can of tomato sauce
9. Sprinkle with some more oregano
10. Bake covered at 375f for 20 minutes
11. Remove foil
12. Bake 10 minutes more or until cheese is bubbly and starting to brown

title: michael s slightly salty pickled onions
steps:
1. Peel the onions
2. Place them in a large crock
3. Bring 1 cup of salt and 2 quarts of water to a boil , and pour over the onions
4. Let stand for 2 days in a cool spot , then drain them
5. Make more brine , and pour it while hot over the onions
6. Let stand for 2 more days , then drain them
7. Put your jars in a canner , and cover with water
8. Bring to a boil and boil 10 minutes
9. Make more brine and this time add the onions , and boil them for 3 minutes
10. Fill the hot sterilized jars with the drained onions
11. Mix the vinegar , water and sugar
12. Heat to boiling and pour over the onions
13. Seal at once , according to manufacturer's instructions and process in boiling water for 10-15 minutes
14. Jars should be kept in a cool , dry , dark place until opened
15. Leave them at least a couple weeks
16. Once opened , store each jar in the fridge

title: fried okra
steps:
1. Cut off and discard
2. Stir into buttermilk
3. Cover and chill 45 minutes
4. Combine cornmeal and next 3 ingredients
5. Remove okra from buttermilk with a slotted spoon
6. Discard buttermilk
7. Dredge okra , in batches in cornmeal mixture
8. Pour oil to depth of 2 inches into cast-iron skillet or dutch oven
9. Add bacon drippings
10. When oil is hot , fry okra in batches , 4 minutes or until golden
11. Drain on paper towels
12. Serve immediately

title: big  bold badass  bbq sauce
steps:
1. Add all ingredients into one pot --
2. Bring to a boil -- then simmer for 20 minutes --

title: orange cranberry date pumpkin cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f grease a loaf pan
2. In a large bowl , beat together pumpkin , eggs , oil , vanilla , sugars , orange zest and grated ginger
3. Be sure to scrape the sides and bottom of the bowl
4. In a small bowl , whisk dry ingredients together
5. Beat into wet mixture until well combined
6. Be sure to scrape the sides and bottom of the bowl
7. Stir in cranberries , dates , and pecans , if desired
8. Pour into greased loaf pan and bake for 60-70 minutes , until tests clean
9. Let cool in pan for 10 minutes and then loosen edges with a butter knife and turn out onto a cooling rack
10. To serve: dust cooled cake with powdered sugar or frost with frosting or drizzle with icing
11. Optional frosting: cream neufchatel and butter together
12. Beat in vanilla , orange zest and nutmeg
13. Beat in confectioners sugar until right consistency is reached
14. Add orange juice if it becomes too thick
15. Frost cake with frosting and sprinkle pecans over the frosting , if desired
16. You can also cut the loaf in half and frost in between layers
17. Optional icing: in a 1-2 cup pyrex , melt butter and white chocolate chips in the microwave for 60 seconds
18. Stir until smooth with a fork
19. Stir in nutmeg and orange zest
20. Stir in milk and confectioners sugar until smooth
21. Drizzle over cake
22. Wrap cooled loaf with plastic wrap or foil and store at room temperature or refrigerate
23. Refrigerate if frosted or iced
24. To freeze: wrap cooled loaf tightly with plastic wrap or foil and place in a ziploc bag and freeze it for gift giving at a later date
25. If you frost or ice it , you can put it on a cookie sheet and freeze it until firm , then wrap it and place in a ziploc bag

title: quick italian bread
steps:
1. Saute onion and butter until the onion is transparent
2. Meanwhile , combine the bisquick , 1 / 2 cup of cheddar cheese and milk and beat until smooth
3. This will be sticky
4. Knead 10 times on floured board working in a small amount of flour if it is sticking too much
5. Butter an 8 or 9 inch pie pan and also your hands
6. Spread the mixture on the bottom of the pan
7. Combine the cup of cheddar and egg
8. Spread over crust
9. Next , sprinkle with onion / butter mixture and top with 1 tsp of poppy seeds
10. Bake at 425 oven for 17-20 minutes watching near the end
11. To serve your guests , cut in wedges
12. You can also get creative and add additional herbs , salt , or different types of cheese to suit your taste

title: apple   brie half moon crepes
steps:
1. In a blender or food processor , blend the eggs , milk , water , flour , salt and the 2 tablespoons melted butter for 5 seconds , or until smooth
2. Stir down and repeat if necessary
3. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour or up to 24 hours
4. Gently stir the batter if it has separated
5. Heat a seasoned 6- or 7-inch nonstick crepe pan over medium-high heat until hot
6. Coat the pan lightly with butter , lift the pan from the heat , and pour in 2 or 3 tablespoons of batter into the pan , tilting and rotating the pan to coat the surface
7. Cook until almost dry on top and lightly browned on the edges , about 1 minute
8. Loosen the edges with a metal spatula and flip the crepe over using your fingers or the spatula , then cook the other side for about 15 seconds , or until lightly browned
9. Turn the crepe out onto a clean tea towel to cool
10. Repeat with the remaining batter wiping the pan with butter as needed and stacking the crepes as they are cooked
11. Using the prepared crepes , preheat the oven to 375 degrees f
12. Place a crepe in a 12-by-18inch baking pan and arrange a slice of the cheese and 3 slices of apples evenly over half of it
13. Fold over
14. Repeat with the remaining crepes
15. Brush the crepes with butter and sprinkle with nuts
16. Bake in the oven for 8 to 10 minutes , or until the cheese is melted
17. Serve at once

title: gluten free   thin pizza crust
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees
2. Combine yeast , sugar and 1 / 2 cup of water
3. Let rise till doubled in size
4. Combine flours , shortening and optional seasonings
5. Combine with risen yeast and remaining 1 / 2 cup of water
6. With oiled fingers , spread dough on pizza stone sprinkled with cornmeal
7. Bake in oven for 15 minutes
8. Remove and add pizza toppings
9. Return to oven and bake 10 minutes more
10. Be generous with the flours as you measure and do not be afraid of the dough being runny ! this will produce a softer , lighter crust

title: salvation army doughnuts
steps:
1. Cream sugar and lard together beat eggs into mixture
2. Add evaporated milk
3. And water
4. Add water to creamed mixture
5. Mix flour , baking powder , salt
6. And nutmeg in large sieve and sift into other mixture
7. Add enough flour
8. To make a stiff dough
9. Roll and cut
10. Five pounds of lard are required to
11. Fry the doughnuts

title: brandied cranberry sour cream cheesecake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Crust
3. Stir all ingrediants together until crumbly
4. Press into the bottom and to the top of the sides lightly greased 9" springform pan
5. Place on a baking tray & bake for 10 minutes
6. Then cool while preparing other ingrediants
7. Cranberry topping
8. Simmer all ingrediants over medium heat , stirring occasionally , until most cranberries "pop" , about 20 minutes
9. Cool , then chill completely
10. Cheesecake
11. Reduce oven to 325 degrees
12. Beat cream cheese until smooth & fluffy
13. Gradually add sugar while beating , scrape sides often
14. Beat in cornstarch & vanilla
15. Add eggs 1 at a time , scraping well after each addition
16. Scrape into crust
17. Bake 30 minutes
18. Sour cream layer
19. Stir sour cream , sugar & vanilla to blend
20. After cheesecake has baked , remove carefully & gently dollop sour cream layer on cheesecae
21. Spread until even & return to oven for 30 minutes
22. Chill overnight before garnishing
23. To garnish , spread cranberries over top of chilled cheesecake & chill until ready to slice

title: pumpkin cranberry bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. For the bars , in a large bowl , mix together first 7 ingredients
3. Stir in pumpkin , butter , eggs & vanilla until well blended
4. Stir in cranberries , then spread mixture into an ungreased 15"x10" jellyroll baking pan
5. Bake 20-25 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean
6. Cool completely in pan on wire rack
7. For the frosting , melt 1 / 2 cup butter in a saucepan over medium heat , stirring often , until butter just starts to turn a golden color ~ do not let it burn !
8. Remove immediately from heat & pour into a bowl
9. Let butter cool slightly , then stir in powdered sugar & vanilla
10. Stir in enough orange juice to form a frosting consistency
11. When pan of uncut pumpkin bars is cooled completely , frost & cut into bars
12. Serve & enjoy & refrigerate leftovers

title: donita s caramel brownies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 f and line a 9x13" baking pan with foil
2. Grease the foil lightly
3. Mix together the dry cake mix , melted butter , and just 1 / 3 cup of the evaporated milk
4. Spread half of this mixture into the prepared pan and bake for 6 minutes
5. Meanwhile , melt the unwrapped candies with the remaining 1 / 3 cup evaporated milk in the microwave
6. When the first layer is done pre-baking , remove from the oven and cover with chocolate chips
7. Pour the melted caramel mixture all over the top
8. Spoon the remaining raw batter in blobs all over the top and bake another 15-18 minutes
9. Allow too cool , then lift out of the pan and cut with a large knife , using a rocking motion - they are very gooey and if you try to cut them too soon it will be very messy
10. Pour half the mixture into the pan , and then continue with the rest of the recipe as directed
11. You may also need to adjust the time for the brownies , a little longer until it is bubbling up
12. Keep these brownies in the fridge to firm up

title: perfect german butter cake
steps:
1. Butter a 13x9x2 inch baking pan
2. In a small bowl combine the yeast , 1 tablespoon of the sugar , and the warm water
3. Set aside mixture 1 for 15 minutes or until bubbles appear
4. In a small bowl combine the remaining 1 / 2 cup sugar , salt , and butter
5. Pour the milk into a saucepan
6. Add vanilla bean and pour into mixture 2
7. Let mixture 2 sit until lukewarm
8. Stir in mixture 1 and add lemon zest
9. Add eggs 1 at a time beating well after each addition
10. Fold in flour a little at a time
11. Beat dough until smooth
12. Spread dough onto prepared pan and cover loosely with a tea towel and set aside in a warm place for 30-45 minutes
13. Let rise
14. Preheat oven to 400f
15. For topping:
16. Cream butter , sugar , and light brown sugar until fluffy stir in the vanilla , the cinnamon , and the nuts
17. Drop spoonfuls of the topping onto the dough
18. Bake cake for 35 minutes or until top is golden
19. Allow cake to completely cool in pan
20. Cut into slices and serve with butter

title: sesame roasted cauliflower
steps:
1. -cut cauliflower into florets
2. Toss with vegetable oil , sesame seeds , sesame oil , salt and pepper
3. -spread on greased large rimmed baking sheet
4. Roast in 400f oven stirring once until tender and browned , about 45 minutes
5. -sprinkle with onion , toss and bake until slightly wilted about 5 minutes

title: spinach and pea soup
steps:
1. In saucepan , melt butter over medium heat
2. Cook leeks until soft and fragrant but not browned
3. Add peas , spinach , chicken stock and savory
4. Bring to boil
5. Reduce heat , cover and simmer for 20 minutes
6. In food processor or blender , puree soup , in batches , until smooth
7. Season with salt and pepper to taste
8. Serve with a drizzle of yogurt on top of each serving

title: creamy mexican chocolate iced coffee
steps:
1. Whip 1 / 2 cup cream to soft peaks , set aside
2. Combine the remaining 1 / 2 cup cream , chocolate syrup , sugar and 3 / 4 teaspoon cinnamon in a pitcher or bowl
3. Stir in coffee until sugar dissolves
4. Fill 4 glasses with ice and pour the coffee mixture over the ice
5. Top with the whipped cream and sprinkle with cinnamon
6. Garnish with the chocolate-covered coffee beans , if desired

title: feather sponge cake  amy s grandma s
steps:
1. Beat egg yolks until thick and lemon colored
2. Add water and continue beating until thick
3. Gradually beat in sugar , then the extracts
4. Fold in flour , a little at a time
5. Beat egg whites until foamy , add the cream of tarter and beat until they form glossy peaks
6. Fold this carefully into the cake mixture
7. Bake in a 10" ungreased angel food cake pan ina 350 degree oven for approximately 1 hour
8. Invert pan to cool

title: apple apricot cider
steps:
1. In a large pot , add all ingredients
2. Bring mixture to a boil
3. Lower heat and simmer for 10 minutes
4. Take out cinnamon sticks
5. Ladle in to mugs and serve hot

title: light veal marsala
steps:
1. Dredge veal in 3 tablespoons flour
2. Combine 1 tablespoon flour and consomm , stirring with a whisk
3. Set aside
4. Melt butter in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
5. Add veal , cook 1 1 / 2 minutes
6. Turn veal over
7. Cook 1 minute
8. Remove veal from pan
9. Add wine to pan , scraping pan to loosen browned bits
10. Add consomm mixture , mushrooms , and salt
11. Bring to a boil
12. Reduce heat
13. Simmer 3 minutes or until thick
14. Return veal to pan
15. Sprinkle with parsley

title: too easy cheesy chicken  broccoli and rice casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees and boil water
2. In a 13x9 casserole dish , combine rice and contents of seasoning packet
3. Add boiling water to dish and mix well
4. Add chicken , sprinkle with garlic powder
5. Cover and bake for 30 minutes
6. Add broccoli and cheese
7. Cover and continue to bake for another 8-10 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink in center

title: homemade strawberry ice cream recipe
steps:
1. Combine strawberries , lemon juice , and 1 / 2 cup of sugar in a bowl and stir
2. Allow to sit for up to 2 hours
3. Strain berries and reserve the juices
4. Puree half the berries
5. In a medium bowl mix milk and remaining sugar until sugar is dissolved
6. Stir in heavy cream , leftover juice from the berry mixture , vanilla , and mashed strawberries
7. Turn on cuisinart ice cream machine and pour mixture into the frozen freezer bowl for about 20 minutes
8. Add the rest of the strawberries and mix for another 5 minutes
9. The ice cream will be very soft and creamy
10. We transferred ours to a container and stuck it in the freezer for about an hour to thicken it up a little the way we like it
11. I am looking forward to trying out some other new ice cream recipes now that i see just how easy it is to do ! in fact , i have a container of blueberries in the kitchen that i think would be great in ice cream too !

title: roast beef sandwich
steps:
1. Combine mayo with horseradish
2. Butter rolls this is important as the butter makes a lining to prevent the roll from getting too soggy , and it tastes good too
3. Fill rolls with layers of remaining ingredients
4. Season roast beef with lots of salt and freshly ground pepper
5. Top with mayonnaise

title: champagne fooler  non alcoholic
steps:
1. Chill 4 glasses
2. Mix apple and lemon joices
3. Add club soda , stir gently to blend
4. Pour into glasses and serve immediately

title: blueberry cheesecake and crust
steps:
1. Mix together graham cracker crumbs , your 3 tablespoons sugar and soft butter
2. Press into pie pan
3. Now mix together cream cheese , your 1 / 2 cup of sugar and cool whip
4. Spread cream cheese mixture into crust and cover with your favorite pie filling
5. I recomend blue berry or cherry
6. Chill for several hours before serving

title: chicken pasta milano
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , melt butter over low heat
2. Add the minced garlic and cook for about a minute
3. Add tomatoes and 3 / 4 cup of chicken broth
4. Increase heat to medium and bring mixture to a boil
5. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered , for about 10 minutes
6. Add cream and bring to a boil again , stirring frequently
7. Simmer over medium heat until sauce is thick
8. Sprinkle salt and pepper over both sides of chicken
9. Heat the olive oil in a skillet , then add chicken and saute until chicken is no longer pink inside
10. Remove chicken from skillet , drain fat from skillet
11. In the same skillet , stir 1 / 4 cup chicken broth with the pan juices , and bring to a boil
12. Reduce slightly and add to the cream sauce
13. Stir in basil
14. Serve chicken atop the pasta , coat with the cream sauce

title: jamaican spice bun bread
steps:
1. Warm beer on low flame- add browning , brown sugar , molassas , jam , honey & butter
2. Stir until dissolved
3. Let this mixture cool down to room temperature before proceeding
4. Sift together all dry ingredients
5. Mix in fruits
6. Add melted beer mixture
7. Stir together
8. Pour into two greased bread pans
9. Bake at 350 degree oven for about 1 hour

title: sweet and salty snack mix
steps:
1. In a large bowl combine cereal , nuts and pretzels
2. In a small saucepan over low heat melt butter
3. Add brown sugar and cook and stir until dissolved
4. Pour over cereal mixture and stir to coat
5. Place 1 / 3 on a greased 15x10x1 jelly roll pan and bake at 325 for 8 minutes
6. Stir and bake an additional 6 minutes
7. Spread on waxed paper to cool
8. Repeat w / remaining mixture
9. Enjoy !

title: grapefruit avocado salad
steps:
1. Combine first 4 ingredients until the mixture is smooth and creamy
2. Combine the remaining ingredients except greens in a bowl and toss with a little less than half of the dressing
3. Serve fruit over greens with extra dressing on the side

title: chocolate chip banana nut muffins
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl , cream butter and sugar
2. Beat in the egg , banana , and vanilla
3. In separate bowl , combine the flours , baking powder , salt , baking soda , and cinnamon
4. Add the flour mixture to the creamed mixture just until moistened
5. Fold in the walnuts and chocolate chips
6. Coat 6 muffin cups with nonstick cooking spray and fill two-thirds full with batter
7. Bake at 350 degrees for 23-25 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean
8. Cool for 5 minutes before removing from pan to a wire rack

title: cookies with a crunch
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
2. Either lightly grease your cookie sheets or line them with parchment paper
3. Combine the flour , baking soda and salt together in one bowl , stir to mix well
4. Beat together the butter , peanut butter , sugar , brown sugar and vanilla in another bowl until light and fluffy
5. Beat in the eggs and milk until smooth
6. Stir in flour mixture until well blended
7. Gently mix in granola and raisins
8. Drop the batter by rounded teaspoonfuls 2 inches apart on the prepared cookie sheets
9. Bake in the preheated for 12-15 minutes or until lightly browned
10. Remove to wire racks to cool

title: bev s macaroni and cheese
steps:
1. Melt butter in medium saucepan
2. Stir in flour , salt , mustard and pepper until smooth
3. Remove from heat and gradually stir in milk until smooth
4. Stirring constantly , cook over medium heat until thickened
5. Remove from heat
6. Stir in 1 1 / 2 cups cheese until melted
7. Combine cheese mixture with macaroni in greased 2 quart casserole
8. Sprinkle remaining cheese on top
9. Bake in 375 degree oven for 25 minutes or until lightly browned
10. Makes 6 servings

title: gigi s cranberry supreme salad
steps:
1. Dissolve raspberry jello in 1 cup boiling water
2. Stir in cranberry sauce
3. Pour into an oiled 1 1 / 2 qt jellow mold
4. Chill until partially set
5. Dissolve lemon jello in remaining boiling water and set aside
6. Beat cream cheese and mayonnaise
7. Fold in lemon jello and pineapple
8. Chill until partially set
9. Fold whipped topping into lemon mixture and add marshmallows
10. Spread lemon mixture onto the top of the cranberry layer
11. Chill until set

title: quick fried zucchini with toasted garlic and lime
steps:
1. Sweat the zuccini in a colander , toss it with the salt and let stand 1 / 2 hour over a plate to drain
2. Rince and dry on towels
3. Heat the oil and butter in a skillet , an a pan large enough to hold the zuccini in a single layer
4. Add the garlic and stir frequently until light brown , about 3 minutes
5. Do not burn
6. Scoop out and place ina small bowl to set aside
7. Raise the heat ot med-hi
8. Add zuccinin and fry stirring frequently for 8-10 minutes until browned and tender but still crunchy
9. Remove from heat
10. Add the lime and toasted garlic
11. Toss thoroughly
12. Sprinkle with pepper , oregano and parsley , mix and adjust salt as needed
13. Serve immeadiatly in a warm dish

title: spicy garbanzo salad
steps:
1. Heat a wok or large saucepan over a medium heat
2. Add the peanut oil and toss in the garlic and red onions
3. Stir fry for about a minute , until the garlic gives off a nutty aroma
4. Add the red wine vinegar while still on the heat - cook down and stir in the chile flakes along with a pinch of salt and pepper
5. Take the pan off the heat and leave to cool before adding the olive oil and lime juice
6. In a large bowl ,
7. Leave the garbanzos to steep for an hour or so before serving at room temperature , either as a starter or as an accompaniment to roast meats

title: mediterranean pizza
steps:
1. For the crust:
2. In a large bowl combine the flour , salt , sugar , and yeast
3. Add the water and oil and mix well
4. If making by hand , turn out the dough onto a lightly floured surface and knead until smooth and elastic
5. Shape the dough into a ball and allow to rest for 15 minutes
6. Preheat the oven to 400f
7. Use olive oil to lightly grease a round pizza pan
8. Roll out the dough and press into the pan
9. Allow to rest for another 10-15 minutes
10. Brush the crust with olive oil and before adding the toppings
11. While the dough is resting in the pan , brown the meat in a saut pan over medium-high heat
12. Add the onion and saut about 5 minutes
13. Add the cumin , tomato paste , water , salt , and pepper
14. Simmer 5-10 minutes uncovered
15. Layer the meat sauce on the pizza crust , leaving the edge uncovered
16. Top with spinach , artichoke hearts , mushrooms , tomatoes , and feta cheese
17. Bake in a 400f for 25-30 minutes until the crust is lightly browned and the cheese crumbles have melted

title: asian turkey lettuce wraps
steps:
1. In a large skillet , heat oil over medium heat
2. Add ground turkey and ginger and cook 3 to 5 minutes or until turkey is no longer pink
3. Add garlic and cook 30 seconds
4. Stir in hoisin sauce and stir while cooking
5. Add carrots and bell pepper and saut about 2 minutes
6. Spoon hot turkey mixture onto each lettuce leaf , sprinkle with cucumber and scallions
7. Wrap lettuce around filling and serve

title: jamaican jerk burgers with orange chipotle mayonnaise
steps:
1. For orange-chipotle mayonnaise:
2. Mix all ingredients in small bowl
3. Season to taste with salt and pepper
4. For jerk sauce:
5. Finely chop first 4 ingredients in processor
6. Add sugar and next 3 ingredients
7. Process until almost smooth
8. Season with salt and pepper
9. Prepare barbecue
10. Set aside 3 / 4 cup jerk sauce
11. Shape ground beef into six 1 / 2- to 3 / 4-inch-thick patties
12. Place in 13x9x2-inch glass baking dish
13. Pour 1 / 2 cup jerk sauce over patties and turn to coat
14. Let stand 20 minutes
15. Sprinkle patties with salt and pepper
16. Grill to desired doneness , brushing occasionally with remaining jerk sauce , about 4 minutes per side for medium
17. Spread mayonnaise over cut surfaces of buns
18. Place burgers on bottom halves of buns
19. Top with onion slices , tomato slices , lettuce , and bun tops
20. Serve , passing reserved 3 / 4 cup jerk sauce separately
21. Chipotle chilies canned in a spicy tomato sauce , sometimes called adobo , are available at latin american markets , specialty foods stores , and some supermarkets

title: crab phyllo cup tartlets
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Mix the cream cheese and horseradish sauce together
3. Fold in the crabmeat and onion
4. Using a small sized scoop , place filling into tart shells
5. Sprinkle with a small amount of paprika
6. Bake for 16-18 minutes , or until slightly brown on top

title: florida strawberry muffins
steps:
1. Combine first 6 muffin ingredients in large bowl and make a well in center
2. Stir together egg , butter and half and half in a separate bowl and add to flour mixture , stirring until just combined
3. Fold in strawberries and key lime rind
4. Spoon into paper lined muffin tins until they are three-fourths full
5. Sprinkle each muffin with 1 tablespoon streusel topping
6. Bake at 375 for 25 minutes
7. Cool muffins in pan for 10 minutes then remove to a cooling rack to cool completely
8. Drizzle glaze over muffins
9. Streusel: combine all ingredients and stir until well combined and crumbly
10. Glaze: stir ingredients together until smooth

title: low fat taco bell quesadilla sauce
steps:
1. Make sure not to buy the pickled jalapenos
2. Mix all of the ingredients very well and enjoy
3. Keeps 1 week covered in the fridge

title: easy  yet awesome  chicken empanadas
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f degrees
2. Heat oil over med-high heat in a large skillet
3. Saute onions and garlic about 4 minutes , until onions are translucent
4. Add cumin , cayenne pepper , chili flakes and dried oregano
5. Make sure to mix well and cook for 2-3 minutes
6. Add black beans , chicken and green chilies
7. Salt and pepper to taste
8. Cook for around 2 minutes until incorporated and heated through
9. Add chicken stock a little at a time , just to moisten the mixture
10. You may not need to use the entire 1 / 4 cup
11. You want to make sure that the mixture is moist but not soupy
12. Simmer for about 5-7 minutes
13. Take mixture off burner and let cool to room temperature
14. Add cheese and mix thoroughly
15. Roll out dough onto floured surface
16. Cut 4" circles out of the dough
17. Fill the middle of each circle with about 1
18. 5 - 2 tbl of the mixture
19. Don't overfill
20. Fold each circle in half and crimp the ends with a fork to close the dough
21. Brush tops with egg yolks and sprinkle with chili powder
22. Cook for 12-14 minutes at 400f
23. Enjoy !

title: penne pasta and artichoke salad
steps:
1. Toss all ingredients together , cover and chill for about an hour before serving
2. That's too strong for my taste , but i wanted to mention it here in case you prefer a dressing with a little more zing

title: chile and spice rubbed pork tenderloin with honey lime glaze
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Line a rimmed baking sheet with aluminum foil
3. Set aside
4. In a small bowl , combine coriander through red pepper and mix well
5. Store in an airtight container at room temperature for up to six weeks
6. Coat tenderloins with desired amount of chili and spice rub
7. In a large skillet , heat 1 tablespoon of oil over medium-high heat
8. Cook one pork tenderloin for two minutes or until lightly browned
9. Remove tenderloin and place on prepared pan
10. Repeat with remaining oil and tenderloins
11. Bake for 20 minutes or until a meat thermometer , inserted into the thickest part of the meat , registers 155 degrees or to desired degree of doneness
12. Combine honey and lime juice , drizzle over pork , and garnish with lime wedges

title: potato and green bean salad  egyptian style
steps:
1. Put the potatoes in a large saucepan , completely cover water and add salt
2. Bring to a boil
3. Cover and simmer over medium-low heat until a knife can pierce the center of the largest potato easily and the potato falls from the knife when lifted , about 25 minutes
4. In a small bowl combine minced garlic with a pinch of salt and mash with the back of a spoon
5. Whisk in 3 tablespoons lemon juice
6. Add 4 tablespoons olive oil , pepper and cayenne , then whisk again
7. Drain the potatoes in a colander , rinse them briefly and leave just until cool enough to handle
8. Peel them if you like , cut them in half and then into about 1 / 2 inch thick slices
9. Put them in a large bowl and add 3 tablespoons dressing and a sprinkling of salt and pepper
10. With a rubber spatula , fold together gently but thoroughly
11. Let potatoes cool to room temperature
12. Put the carrots in a saucepan of water , add salt and bring to a boil
13. Cover and simmer for 3 minutes
14. Add green beans and cook uncovered over medium-high heat for 5 minutes or until vegetables are just tender
15. Drain , rinse with cold water and drain thoroughly in a strainer
16. Add to the bowl of potatoes
17. Whisk the remaining dressing , pour it over the salad and fold it in
18. Add the green onions , mint and parsley and fold together lightly
19. Taste , adjust seasoning , and add more lemon juice and olive oil if needed
20. Garnish with quartered hard boiled eggs
21. Serve at room temperature

title: bavarian restaurant beer cheese soup
steps:
1. Saut celery , onions , carrots in butter
2. Add salt and pepper
3. Blend in flour
4. Add chicken stock and cheese
5. Heat gently until cheese melts
6. Add beer
7. Adjust spices to taste
8. Serve piping hot with croutons on top , if desired

title: torta de chocolate  chocolate pie
steps:
1. To prepare the pastry: sift the flour , cocoa and salt together into a bowl
2. Cut the butter into the flour mixture with a pastry blender or 2 knives until it resembles coarse meal
3. Add the sour cream and knead into a ball
4. Divide into 4 equal pieces and refrigerate 2 hours
5. On a floured board , roll each piece of dough out to a 10 x 10 inch square
6. Place each square on a buttered baking sheet , prick all over with a fork and bake in a 400f degree oven 10 minutes
7. Carefully transfer the pastry squares to wire racks to cool
8. They will be very fragile
9. To prepare the filling: place the chocolate , cream and butter in a saucepan and stir over low heat until the chocolate and butter are melted
10. Beat the egg yolks until thick
11. Beat in a few tablespoons of the hot chocolate mixture and stir back into the hot chocolate
12. Stir in the vanilla and let the mixture cool to spreading consistency
