13. Do not refrigerate or it will be too stiff to spread
14. Place 1 pastry layer on a serving plate and spread with the filling
15. Continue layering , leaving the nicest looking pastry square for the top
16. Sift powdered sugar over the top layer
17. Using a pastry bag fitted with a star tube , decorate the top layer with a little of the leftover filling

title: devilish cheesy halibut
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan , combine the sauce ingredients: tomato sauce , chicken broth , olive oil , garlic , curry powder , lemon juice and soy sauce
2. Bring to a boil , then simmer on low heat for 15 minutes
3. Remove from heat
4. Preheat oven to 450 degrees f
5. In large bowl , combine halibut fillet chunks with olive oil to coat
6. Add fine breadcrumbs , stirring around again to coat all sides of all pieces
7. Arrange breadcrumbed fish chunks in a greased 8x8 baking dish
8. Evenly sprinkle all of the cheese on top and bake uncovered for 10 minutes
9. Remove from oven
10. Evenly pour on 2 / 3 of the tomato sauce mixture
11. Return to the oven for another 10 minutes
12. Serve fish with the rest of the sauce

title: apple wheat muffins
steps:
1. In a bowl , combine the first 6 ingredients
2. In another bowl whisk the egg , yogurt , applesauce and oil
3. Stir into dry ingredients just until moistened
4. Fold in the apple , raisins and orange peel
5. Spray mini muffin tin with cooking spray
6. Bake at 400 for 15-20 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean
7. Cool for 5 minutes before removing from pan to a wire rack

title: ted s sweet   sour sauce for pork  chicken etc
steps:
1. Put tbsp of oil into a wok or skillet , heat but not smoking
2. Add garlic , carrot & green pepper stir fry for 2-3 minutes or until the carrot & pepper start to darken in color
3. Pour in the chicken stock , soy , vinegar & sugar , bring to a boil and boil rapidly for 1 minute
4. Add mixed cornstarch , keep stirring the sauce until it is clear and thickened
5. Pour over the meat and enjoy

title: shredded brussels sprouts with pine nuts and prosciutto
steps:
1. Remove root end and core from brussels sprouts , cut in half and thinly slice
2. Heat oil in skillet on medium-high heat
3. Add prosciutto
4. Saut until beginning to crisp
5. Add sprouts and garlic
6. Saut for 3 minutes
7. Cover pan and cook 2 minutes longer or until sprouts are crisp-tender
8. Toss in pine nuts , saute 1 minute and season with salt and pepper

title: easy cheesy chicken with pasta
steps:
1. Cook the pasta in a large pot of boiling salted water until al dente
2. Drain and place in a large bowl
3. In a saucepan over medium-low heat cook the velveeta cheese with sour cream and milk until smooth and the cheese has melted
4. Season with black pepper if desired
5. Pour over the cooked pasta
6. Stir in the chicken
7. Mix well to combine
8. Ladle the mixture into bowl and top with parmesan cheese if desired

title: slow roasted smoked pork shoulder
steps:
1. Turn oven on to 300
2. Place pork in lasagne pan fat side up
3. Score fat lightly in a diamond pattern , not piercing through to the meat
4. Rub salt , pepper and garlic on the fat
5. Cover lightly with tin foil and roast for 3 hours , this gets the fat melting
6. Remove tin foil and reduce oven to 225
7. Continue roasting for 4 hours
8. Remove from oven and drain drippings if desired
9. Turn oven up to 450-500
10. Place pork back in oven until fat is crispy and browned , about 5-10mins
11. Remove from oven , lightly tent with tin foil and wait till cool enought to handle
12. Remove meat and tear apart with 2 forks
13. Toss with favorite bbq sauce and serve on buns
14. Sometimes with aromatic herbs such as rosemary , thyme and sage
15. Sometimes with a wet rub
16. Sometimes with fruit such as apples , peaches , or pineapple
17. I've never had one not turn out
18. I posted this recipe today because that's what in my oven
19. Enjoy !

title: mom s squash casserole
steps:
1. Slice squash and place in large pot
2. Quarter and slice onion and place in pot with squash
3. Add enough water to pot to just cover squash and bring to a boil
4. Lower heat and simmer for about 15 minutes or until squash are tender
5. Drain squash and onions well and place in large , shallow casserole dish
6. Dot with one tablespoon of butter and mash slightly with fork until there are no more whole slices of squash in dish
7. Drizzle one tablespoon melted butter over breadcrumbs and spread evenly over casserole
8. Bake in 250 degree oven for about 20 minutes or until breadcrumbs are browned

title: strawberry bavarian jello
steps:
1. Dissolve jello in boiling water in a large bowl
2. Stir in the strawberries
3. Fold in marshmallows and whipped cream
4. Transfer mixture to a 5 cup serving bowl
5. Cover and refrigerate overnight

title: monday night american chop suey
steps:
1. Brown onion , pepper& ground beef
2. Add tomato soup , stewed tomatoes& seasonings
3. Cook pasta according to package directions
4. Drain pasta& add to sauce
5. Mix well& enjoy

title: pork and potato hash
steps:
1. Place the sliced potatoes , 1 1 / 2 cups water , onions , and juice from pork roast in a 12" nonstick skillet
2. Bring to a boil , cover , and boil over medium heat for 10 minutes
3. Add garlic , scallions , olive oil , tabasco , salt , worcestershire and pork
4. Mix well and cook , uncovered , over high heat , stirring , for about 5 minutes
5. Most of the moisture will have evaporated by now and the mixture should be starting to sizzle
6. Since the hash will begin to stick at this point , use a heat-resistant spatula to scrape up the crusty bits sticking to the bottom of the pan and stir them into the uncooked mixture
7. Continue to cook over medium heat for about 20 minutes , stirring every 3-4 minutes
8. The mixture will brown faster in the last 10 minutes of cooking and should be stirred every 2-3 minutes
9. Turn out onto a large platter and serve immediately
10. Garnish with fried egg on top , if desired

title: spinach stuffed portabella caps
steps:
1. Make sure the portabella caps are free of dirt and grit
2. Place upside-down on a foil-lined , greased cookie sheet
3. Place half a slice of swiss in each cap
4. In a small sauce pan , saut the onion , red pepper , and green onion until soft
5. Add the minced garlic and cook for a minute more
6. Drain the spinach in a colander or dish towel , squeezing to get most of the moisture out
7. Add the spinach , cavendar's , tony's , lemon pepper , and black pepper
8. Stir and cook just until the spinach is hot
9. Add cream cheese and stir to combine
10. The hot spinach mixture should melt the cream cheese
11. Distribute the spinach mixture evenly between the 4 caps , smoothing the tops with the back of a spoon
12. Combine the parmesan , bread crumbs , and olive oil
13. Stir well , then sprinkle over the tops of the stuffed mushrooms
14. Bake at 350 for 20-25 minutes , or until the tops are golden brown

title: easy turkey pot pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Place on pie crust in an ungreased pie pan
3. In a medium bowl , mix the mushroom soup and milk
4. Stir in the turkey meat , mixed vegetables and shredded cheese
5. Top with the other pie crust and seal the crust edges by crimping with a wet fork or with your fingers
6. Bake in the preheated oven for 45 minutes , or until the crust is a golden brown
7. Let cool for 10 - 15 minutes before cutting

title: sky blue potatoes  aka blue cheese twice baked potato appetizers
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees
2. In a medium bowl , toss the potatoes with the olive oil
3. Place cut side down on a baking sheet and bake until the skins are crisp , 20 to 25 minutes
4. Let them cool
5. Scoop out the center of each potato half and place in a medium bowl
6. Stir in the sour cream , blue cheese , bacon , and green onion
7. Fill each potato skin with the sour cream mixture and garnish with parsley

title: pillsbury s chocolate shadows
steps:
1. In a small saucepan , melt the chocolate chips over low , stirring constantly
2. Remove from heat
3. Stir in pepper extract
4. Set aside in cool
5. In a large bowl , combine remaining incredients
6. Blend well
7. Stir in melted chocolate , only until till blended , not overly
8. Shape into balls , using a rounded teaspoon
9. Place on ungreased cookie sheets
10. Flatten with bottom of glass , which has been greased and dipped into sugar
11. Bake at 375 for 8-10 minutes
12. Cool

title: whole wheat featherbeds
steps:
1. Place potatoes in large saucepan
2. Add water and a pinch of salt and bring to a boil
3. Reduce heat and simmer until potatoes are cooked through , about 10 minutes
4. Drain potato cooking water into measuring cup and add enough warm water to measure 1 1 / 2 cups
5. Mash potato in saucepan
6. Cool potato cooking water to 105f to 115f
7. Transfer 1 / 4 cup potato water to large bowl
8. Add yeast and sugar and stir to dissolve
9. Let stand until foamy , about 10 minutes
10. Add remaining 1 1 / 4 cups potato water , mashed potato , whole wheat flour , bread flour , oil and salt to same bowl
11. Stir batter until dough forms
12. Turn dough out onto lightly floured work surface
13. Knead until smooth and elastic , adding more whole wheat flour if dough is very sticky
14. This will take about 10 minutes
15. Lightly oil large bowl
16. Turn dough in bowl to coat with oil
17. Cover with plastic and let rise in warm draft-free area until doubled , about a hour and 15 minutes
18. Lightly grease large baking sheet
19. Punch dough down
20. Divide into 20 equal pieces
21. Roll each piece into a ball
22. Roll in additional whole wheat flour
23. Arrange on prepared sheet , spacing evenly
24. Using a sharp knife , cut 2 slashes into top of each ball
25. Cover with towel and let rise in warm area until almost doubled , about 55 minutes
26. Preheat oven to 400f
27. Place rolls in oven
28. Reduce heat to 375f
29. Bake rolls until light brown on top , about 25 minutes
30. Transfer to rack
31. Serve warm or at room temperature

title: apple crumble  gluten  dairy and egg free
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 190c
2. Peel , core , and slice apples thinly
3. Place in a pie dish with sugar , cinnamon and water
4. Place flour , almonds and brown sugar into a bowl
5. Rub the margarine into the mixture until the mixture is crumbly
6. Sprinkle crumble mixture over the apples
7. Bake at 190c for approximately 30 minutes or until golden brown on top
8. Serve with dairy-free custard or ice cream

title: beef carbonnade  beef   beer stew
steps:
1. In a dutch oven or oven safe pot heat 1 teaspoons of the veg oil over med-high heat
2. Brown the beef in small batches
3. When the pieces are nice and brown all over , set aside
4. In the same pot add the other teaspoons of veg
5. Oil , turn heat down to medium-low , add onions and salt to help remove moisture
6. Cook over medium-low heat for about 5 minutes then turn heat up to medium and cook onions until they are golden
7. Add tomato paste , garlic and flour , stir and cook for 2 minutes
8. Add beer and both broths
9. Scrape all the lovely bits of fond off the bottom of the pot
10. Add thyme bundle and bay leaves along with cider vinegar
11. Add the cooked meat in with it's juices
12. Season to taste with salt & pepper
13. Bring to a good simmer
14. Cover pot with lid
15. Offset the lid a bit so steam can escape while cooking in the oven
16. Cook for 2-2 1 / 2 hours in a 300 oven
17. Before serving remove thyme bundle and bay leaves
18. Serve over cooked egg noodles

title: crispy prawn baskets
steps:
1. Heat oil to 350f
2. Place 2 spring roll wrappers together with corners not matching
3. Lower wrappers into hot oil then immediately push soup ladle into center to form a cup
4. Cook until golden , lift and drain on absorbent paper
5. Allow to cool
6. Combine filling ingredients except gherkin
7. Spoon into crisp basket
8. Garnish with gherkin and serve

title: easy roasted garlic
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325f
2. Remove the loose , outer layers of papery skin from the garlic bulb
3. Slice off the top of the bulb , about 1 / 4 - 1 / 2
4. Cut enough to expose the top of the cloves but still leave the bulb intact
5. Tear off a 12-inch square piece of foil , place the garlic bulb in the center and drizzle it with a tablespoon of olive oil
6. Bring the edges of foil up and around garlic , wrapping tightly , and bake in the oven at 325 f for 35 minutes
7. Remove packet and carefully unwrap garlic
8. Squeeze each clove of garlic out of it's skin and use as needed or store in a zip-top baggie in fridge or freezer for later use

title: janet s peanut butter fudge
steps:
1. Mix sugar , margarine and milk
2. Boil for 7 minutes
3. Remove from heat
4. Add remaining ingrediants , mix
5. Put into a greased pan and let cool

title: the ultimate spice blend
steps: 1. Mix ingredients in large bowl

title: gluten free cake donuts
steps:
1. Heat oil in pan to 375 degrees
2. In a large bowl mix together dry ingredients
3. Mix in butter , milk and egg until smooth
4. Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface
5. Roll dough to 1 / 4 inch thickness and cut with a doughnut cutter
6. Carefully put doughnuts in hot oil , being careful not to overcrowd pan
7. Fry for about 3 minutes until golden brown , turning only once
8. Place doughnuts on paper towels to cool
9. Dust donuts with powdered sugar or frost with icing and decorateenjoy !

title: fluffy banana pancakes with caramel pecan sauce and ricotta cream
steps:
1. Caramel pecan sauce: in a small non-stick saucepan , melt caramel pieces gently with the cream , stirring occasionally until smooth and blended
2. Add pecans and flaked coconut , stir to combine with sauce , then remove from heat
3. Serve warm over pancakes
4. Can be prepared the night before , then heated in the microwave until warm
5. Ricotta cream: place ricotta cheese , confectioners sugar , orange juice and orange zest in a bowl
6. Beat with a whisk until well combined
7. Refrigerate until ready to serve
8. Can be prepared the night before
9. Fluffy banana pancakes: sift the flour , baking powder , bicarbonate of soda and salt into a bowl
10. Place buttermilk in a 2-cup glass-measuring cup and add butter
11. Microwave on high for 2 minutes , until butter melts
12. Lightly beat yolks , then combine with the buttermilk and butter mixture , whisking to incorporate
13. Then add vanilla essence and caster sugar and stir until sugar is dissolved
14. Add buttermilk mixture to the flour , and whisk together until batter becomes thick and smooth
15. Batter can be prepared to this stage , the night before
16. Beat egg whites in a clean dry bowl until stiff
17. Fold whites carefully into batter until evenly mixed
18. Heat a 6-inch diameter fry pan or skillet and brush lightly with melted butter , or spray with vegetable oil
19. For each pancake , pour 1 / 2 to 3 / 4 cup batter into pan , and swirl around quickly to distribute evenly over bottom of pan
20. Cook until bubbles begin to appear on the surface , then lay some banana slices over the top
21. When pancakes are lightly browned on the bottom , flip over and cook other side
22. When cooked through , transfer pancake to a baking tray and keep warm in a low oven while you cook the rest of the batter
23. To serve , drizzle warm caramel pecan sauce over each pancake , and top with a generous dollop or two of ricotta cream

title: tri chocolate chip cookies
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 375
2. Line 2 cookie sheets with parchment paper or a silicone mat
3. In a large mixing bowl whisk together the melted butter and sugars
4. Whisk in the eggs and vanilla and mix well
5. Combine the flour , baking powder and salt and sift into the butter mixture , stirring with a rubber spatula to blend well
6. Add the chocolate chips and pecans
7. Stir to combine
8. Using a #20 cookie scoop or a 1 / 4 cup measure , scoop balls of dough , placing them at least 3 inches apart on the cookie sheet
9. Flatten gently to form 2 1 / 2 to 3 inch discs
10. Bake 12-15 minutes , until just golden brown around the edges , but still pale in color
11. Remove from the oven , slide the paper or mat onto a metal rack to cool

title: the best beef stroganoff
steps:
1. In a large bowl , mix the flour salt and pepper together
2. Coat the beef in the flour mixture
3. Melt the butter / margarine in a large skillet
4. Add meat , mushrooms , onion , garlic and any leftover flour mixture
5. Stir frequently until onion and mushrooms become soft
6. Add the beef stock and tomato sauce
7. Heat to boiling , stirring often
8. When it's just about done , add the sour cream and white wine
9. Stir to mix , then remove from heat
10. Serve over a bed of egg noodles or mashed potatoes
11. We've even just had it with some crusty rolls
12. Mmmmmmmm --

title: two cheese quesadillas
steps:
1. Sprinkle each tortilla with cheeses , tomato , green pepper and onion
2. Fold in half and press edges lightly to seal
3. On a griddle , cook quesadillas over low heat 1-2 minutes on each side or until cheese is melted
4. Cut into wedges , serve with salsa and sour cream

title: chocolate covered cherry shake  sugar free
steps:
1. Place cherries , milk , vanilla and splenda into a blender and puree
2. Add ice cream and club soda to the puree and blend on low until desired consistency is reached
3. Drizzle chocolate syrup around the inside of one large or two medium glasses
4. Pour shake into glass
5. Drizzle more chocolate syrup over the top of the shake
6. Top with cool whip lite or whipped cream

title: chicken and tortellini with parmesan cream sauce
steps:
1. In pressure cooker , saute bacon for 2 minutes
2. Add butter , onions and parsley
3. Saute 2 minutes , stirring
4. Stir in chicken , carrot , tortellini , mushrooms and tarragon
5. Add broth and mix well
6. Secure lid
7. Over high heat , develop steam to high pressure
8. Reduce heat and maintain pressure and cook for 6 minutes
9. Release pressure and remove lid
10. Stir in asparagus
11. Over high heat , develop steam to med-high pressure and cook for 2 more minutes
12. Release pressure and remove lid
13. Combine milk , butter , 1 / 3 cup cheese in a bowl and blend thoroughly
14. Gradually add to chicken and tortellini mixture , gently stirring over medium heat until sauce thickens and becomes creamy
15. Transfer to a serving platter and sprinkle with additional cheese

title: jolly roger  drink
steps:
1. Put rum , galliano , apricot brandy , and orange juice with ice in a cocktail shaker
2. Shake well
3. Strain over ice into a tall glass
4. Decorate with the fruit slices

title: baked brie with mango chutney
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degreesf
2. Place brie on a cookie sheet and spread the chutney on top , leaving a 1 / 2 inch border place the almonds around the border
3. Bake for 15 minutes
4. Carefully transfer warm brie to a cheese board and surround with apples and french bread

title: home style yeast bread
steps:
1. Dissolve yeast and warm water in a mixing bowl
2. Add sugar , butter , salt , eggs and 4 cups of flour
3. Beat until smooth
4. Stir in enough remaining flour to form a soft dough
5. Turn onto a floured surface and knead until smooth and elastic
6. Place in a greased bowl and turn once to grease top
7. Cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled
8. Punch down dough
9. Turn on floured surface and divide into thirds
10. Shape into loaves and place in three greased 9" x 5" x 3" loaf pans
11. Cover and let rise until doubled
12. Bake at 350 degrees for 25-30 minutes or until golden brown
13. Remove from pans to wire racks to cool

title: beef and stout pie
steps:
1. In a 5 1 / 2 quart dutch oven over medium high heat , warm 1 tbsp oil
2. Cook mushrooms , onions , salt and pepper 12 minutes
3. Transfer to a bowl
4. Season beef with salt and pepper
5. Dredge in flour
6. In same pot over medium high heat , warm 2 tbsp oil
7. Sear one-third of beef 7 minutes
8. Transfer to separate bowl
9. Add 1 / 2 cup water to pot
10. Scrape up browned bits
11. Pour into separate bowl
12. Repeat twice with rest of beef
13. Return pot to medium high heat
14. Add garlic and tomato paste
15. Stir 30 seconds
16. Add beef , stout , broth and reserved liquid
17. Scrape up browned bits
18. Add mushrooms , onions , carrots , potatoes and thyme
19. Bring to a boil
20. Cover , simmer over medium low heat , stirring occasionally , 3 hours
21. In the meanwhile , prepare the pastry:
22. In a food processor , combine the flour , salt and sugar and pulse until blended , about 5 pulses
23. Add the butter and process until the mixture resembles coarse meal , about 10 pulses
24. Add 1 / 3 cup of the ice water and pulse 2 or 3 times
25. The dough should hold together when squeezed with your fingers but should not be sticky
26. If it is crumbly , add more water 1 tbs
27. At a time , pulsing twice after each addition
28. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured work surface and shape into a disk
29. Wrap with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 1 hour
30. Remove the dough from the refrigerator and let stand for 5 minutes
31. Sprinkle the top of the dough lightly with flour , place on a lightly floured sheet of parchment paper and roll out into a 12-by-16-inch rectangle
32. Sprinkle the cheese over half of the dough , then fold the other half over the cheese
33. Roll out the dough into a 16 1 / 2-inch square
34. Using a paring knife , trim the dough into a 16-inch round
35. Refrigerate the dough until firm , about 10 minutes , then lay the dough on top of the beef and stout pie and bake as directed in that recipe
36. Makes enough dough for a 16-inch round
37. Preheat an oven to 400f
38. Brush the rim of the pot with water
39. Lay the pastry round on top , allowing it to droop onto the filling
40. Trim the dough , leaving a 1-inch overhang , and crimp to seal
41. Brush the pastry with the egg mixture , then cut 4 slits in the top of the dough
42. Bake for 30 minutes
43. Let the potpie rest for 15 minutes before serving
44. Serves 8 to 10

title: spiced mussels in white wine
steps:
1. Heat butter in large pot on medium heat
2. Add onion , garlic , curry powder and fennel seeds
3. Saut 1 minute
4. Add wine and bring to boil
5. Stir in mussels , cover pan and cook until mussels open , shaking pan occasionally
6. Remove mussels and reduce liquid by half
7. Stir in cream and cook together for 3 minutes or until slightly thickened
8. Add parsley and season
9. Return mussels , stir everything together and serve

title: orange yogurt nog
steps:
1. Place yogurt , milk , and the thawed juice concentrate into blender
2. Blend mixture until smooth
3. Enjoy !

title: bucatini all amatrician
steps:
1. Can use guanciale instead of bacon
2. Chop the cherry tomatoes
3. Heat 1 tablespoon oil in heavy large skillet over medium heat
4. Add half of bacon / guanciale and saut until crisp , about 5 minutes
5. Transfer guanciale to paper towels to drain
6. Reserve for garnish
7. Add 2 tablespoons oil to same skillet over medium-low heat
8. Add garlic and red pepper
9. Saut about 2 minutes
10. Add onion and remaining bacon
11. Saut until onion is translucent and fat has rendered from guanciale , about 10 minutes
12. Stir in vinegar
13. Cook 1 minute
14. Add tomatoes
15. Simmer 6 minutes
16. Season sauce with salt and pepper
17. Meanwhile , cook pasta in large pot of boiling salted water until just tender but still firm to bite
18. Drain , reserving 1 / 2 cup pasta cooking liquid
19. Return pasta to same pot
20. Add tomato sauce and cheese to pasta and toss , adding some of reserved pasta cooking liquid if dry
21. Season to taste with salt and pepper
22. Transfer pasta to bowl
23. Sprinkle with reserved guanciale and serve

title: banana chocolate chunk pancakes   waffles
steps:
1. Peel and slice the banana's into small sections
2. Place the sliced pieces of banana into a medium size mixing bowl
3. Using a potato masher - mash the banana pieces
4. Add pancake mix , milk , and vanilla
5. Mix until smooth
6. Slice the dove dark chocolate into 1 / 4inch pieces
7. Add to banana pancake mix
8. Mix well
9. Using 1 / 4 cup batter cook pancakes over medium heat

title: old fashioned caramel pie
steps:
1. Leave oven on from baking pie shells
2. Whisk together the 1-2 / 3 cups sugar and cornstarch in a large microwaveable bowl until there are no more lumps from the cornstarch
3. Pour the milk into the sugar mixture and whisk together until smooth
4. Add the butter to the top of the mixture
5. Microwave on high for 3 minutes
6. Whisk thoroughly
7. Microwave for 3 more minutes , whisk again
8. Have the egg yolks in a separate bowl
9. Beat them slightly
10. Add a tablespoon full of the hot mixture at a time to the egg yolks , stirring well after each addition
11. Do this until the yolk mixture is warm
12. Then add the yolk mixture to the cooked mixture
13. Microwave in one minute increments , whisking each time , until the mixture is of pudding consistency
14. Whisk in the vanilla
15. Set aside
16. Put the 2 / 3 cup sugar into a small iron skillet
17. Cook , stirring constantly , on high until brown and bubbling
18. It will look like it's going to boil over
19. Pour immediately into cooked filling and whisk thoroughly
20. Divide between the 2 pie shells
21. Beat the egg whites and cream of tartar until foamy and slightly holding shape
22. Turn beaters on low speed
23. Add the 3 / 4 cup sugar
24. After sugar is mixed in , turn beaters on high again
25. Beat until meringue is hard to shake off a spoon
26. Spread meringue onto filling all the way to the edges
27. Bake about 10 minutes or until brown
28. Watch closely
29. Turn off oven , open oven door slightly , and let pies cool in oven for 1 hour
30. Let pies cool completely on counter
31. Spray plastic wrap with pam , cover pies and refrigerate

title: crispy cheddar cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Combine flour and butter in a large bowl using a pastry cutter or 2 knives or your fingers until mixture resembles coarse crumbs
3. Add the rest of the ingredients and mix until blended
4. Shape dough into 3 / 4 inch or 1 inch balls and place 2 inches apart on an ungreased cookie sheet
5. Flatten slightly with a fork
6. Bake for 15 to 17 minutes or until golden brown
7. Transfer to wire racks to cool immediately
8. Makes 48 small ro 30 large cookies

title: cocoa cola cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Grease a 13x9' baking pan
3. Mix all ingredients , exceept marshmallows in a bowl with mixer until well blended stir in marshmallows , pour into pan ,
4. Bake 35-40 minutes until a toothpick inserted to center comes out clean
5. Cool on wire rack , sprinkle with confectioners sugar

title: sour cream banana loaf cake  2 points
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Cream butter and splenda until light and fluffy
3. Mix in eggs and vanilla
4. Sift together flour , baking powder , soda and salt
5. Alternate between the flour mixture and sour cream
6. Begin and end with flour
7. Blend in mashed bananas and nuts
8. Do not over mix
9. Pour batter into large greased loaf pan
10. Bake for 40-45 minutes
11. Test with a cake tester
12. Cool on wire rack for 10 minutes then remove from pan to cooling rack

title: scratch lemon drink
steps:
1. Pour sweetened condensed milk into blender
2. Add the lemon juice , sprite , and lemon zest
3. Blend until the mixture is homogenous
4. Fill 6 tall glasses with crushed ice
5. Pour the drink over the ice , and serve immediately

title: blueberry fruit crumble
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees and butter bottom and sides of a baking dish
2. Zest lemon
3. Toss blueberries , 2 tablespoons sugar , zext and cornstarch in a bowl and place in bottom of baking dish
4. In seperate bowl , mix remaining sugar , flour , baking powder and salt
5. Add eggs and mix with fingers
6. Sprinkle over fruit then pour melted butter evenly over the crumble mixture
7. Place in center of oven and bake for 30 minutes until fruit bubbles and the crumble is a golden brown
8. Serve warm with a dallop of creme fraiche

title: panko stuffed mushrooms   asian style
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f
2. Remove the stems from the mushrooms
3. Chop up the stems and two of the whole mushrooms and set them aside
4. Preheat a large skillet over medium heat
5. Pour in the peanut oil and saut the chopped mushroom for about 3 minutes , until some moisture has released
6. Add the diced water chestnuts or daikon and cook for 5 more minutes , stirring often
7. Add the garlic and cook for a minute longer
8. At this point , lots of moisture should be released from the mushrooms
9. Add the rice wine vinegar or mirin , salt , and white pepper , and cook for about 2 minutes
10. Turn off the heat and add the panko in 1 / 2-cup batches and stir , alternately adding the sesame oil until all the bread crumbs are moist
11. If needed , add a coiple tbsp of water if panko seems overly dry
12. The mixture should be crumbly but , when you press some between your fingers , it should hold together
13. Mix in the scallions and adjust the salt to taste
14. Grease a baking sheet with a little sesame oil
15. Stuff each mushroom with the filling and place on the baking sheet
16. To stuff them , place a little of the filling into the mushroom crevice and then add another tablespoon on top of that , pressing firmly to form a mound
17. Bake for 20 minutes
18. To serve , sprinkle the toasted sesame seeds over the mushrooms and drizzle with a little sesame oil , if desired
19. Garnish with extra chopped scallions

title: high protein diet  cornell  bread
steps: 1. Add all ingredients to bread machine and set on whole wheat cycle

title: ham and cheddar muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 and lightly grease 12 muffin cups
2. Saut onion in butter until soft
3. In a bowl , combine flour , baking powder , salt , pepper and garlic powder
4. In another bowl , combine eggs , milk and mustard
5. Add the sauted onion , ham and cheese
6. Stir the wet mixture into the dry mixture just until moistened , dont over stir !
7. Spoon batter into prepared muffin pans and bake in preheated oven for 25-30 minutes
8. Enjoy !

title: filete de culichi  tilapia w mushrooms in poblano cream sauce
steps:
1. Preheat broiler
2. Poblano sauce: prepare poblano chilies by roasting under broiler until they are fully blistered
3. Remove chilies from broiler and turn off oven
4. Put chilies in a brown paper bag to steam for 10 minutes
5. Allow to cool , then peel and remove seeds and stems
6. Cut peppers and put into medium sized bowl
7. In a saucepan combine oil , poblano peppers , onions , cilantro leaves , garlic and seasoning
8. Saut over high heat , stirring occasionally , 2 minutes
9. Stir in stock , bring to a boil , and boil vigorously , 18 minutes
10. Reduce heat to medium , stir in heavy cream , and simmer 2 minutes
11. Transfer sauce to blender or food processor and puree until smooth
12. For a smoother sauce , you can strain sauce as well
13. Tilapia: melt in a butter large heavy skillet
14. Add garlic and saut for about 30 seconds
15. Season tilapia filets with salt and pepper and add to pan
16. Cook over moderately high heat until browned , 3 minutes per side
17. Remove tilapia filets from the pan leaving the garlic butter and arrange tilapia in a baking dish just large enough to hold them in a single layer
18. Add mushrooms to skillet
19. Cover and saut for about 15 minutes
20. When mushrooms are close to done , preheat oven to 350 degrees
21. Pour mushrooms over tilapia
22. Pour sauce over tilapia and mushrooms
23. Sprinkle cheese over the top
24. Bake for about 10 minutes or until sauce is bubbling and tilapia is cooked through
25. Serve with rice and refried beans on the side and flour tortillas for dipping

title: chicken pesto
steps:
1. Prepare pesto sauce according to package direction
2. Heat oven to 350 degrees
3. Spray rectangular dish with no-stick spray
4. Moisten chicken with water , shake off excess , and coat complete with bread crumbs
5. Place chicken in baking dish
6. Spread pesto sauce evenly over chicken breasts
7. Cover each breast with slice of provolone cheese
8. Spread mushrooms over cheese
9. Bake in oven for 45- 50 minutes
10. Serve with pasta

title: korean style whole fish  spicy
steps:
1. 1) preheat the oven to 375f rinse fish under cold water , and then dry with some paper towels
2. Sprinkle a bit of canola oil on a baking sheet , and set the fish on top
3. Make four diagonal slashes on each side of the fish
4. Sprinkle the salt on the fish
5. Place baking sheet in the oven and cook for about 8 minutes
6. 2) meanwhile , whisk together the rest of the ingredients for the sauce
7. 3) remove the baking sheet with the fish and turn the oven to 425 degrees
8. Brush the sauce on to both sides of the fish
9. Return the fish to the oven , and cook for about 3 minutes
10. 4) remove the baking sheet with the fish
11. Turn on the broiler
12. Slide the fish under the broiler and cook for about 1 minute for each side
13. The skin should get crisp and slightly blacken

title: mojo chicken wings
steps:
1. Pour mojo sauce over wings and marinate in the refrigerator for at least 4 hours
2. Drain excess sauce and add garlic salt , salt and pepper
3. Broil in the oven for 20-25 minutes

title: buckwheat wraps tortillas   gluten free
steps:
1. Blend first four ingredients , baking powder and xanthan gum
2. Add hot water and mix until well combined
3. At this point , if the dough is sticky to the touch , add sweet rice flour by the tablespoon until a soft , non-sticky texture is achieved
4. Shape the dough into 12 golf-ball sized balls
5. Put the balls under a damp towel until you are ready for them
6. Latten each as you would for a tortilla
7. Heat 1-2 teaspoons olive oil over medium-high heat on in a frying pan
8. Once the oil is hot , slide in one buckwheat wrap
9. Move it about the pan to coat the bottom of the wrap with oil well , then flip over and move it around again
10. Leave the wrap to brown on each side
11. Lay wraps on a paper towel and fold them gently in half
12. Cover the plate of completed wraps with a paper towel topped with a warm towel or a dish towel until ready to use

title: dani s homemade blender mayo
steps:
1. Add whole egg and egg yolks to the blender and pulse for a few seconds
2. Add lemon juice , vinegar , salt , sugar , mustard and paprika
3. Pulse for 30 seconds
4. Keeping the lid on , with the middle plug removed , blend ingredients , adding the oil slowly , only a few drops at at time at first , and then in a sloooooow steady stream
5. Mayo will lighten and thicken before your eyes !
6. Add salt , pepper , etc to taste , refrigerate and enjoy ! use within a few days , though -- it won't keep like a store brand

title: becky s taco soup
steps:
1. Brown hamburger and onion , drain
2. Add to the hamburger and onion the rest of the ingredients
3. Stir
4. Heat and let simmer an hour to let flavors combine
5. Enjoy by topping with fritos , shredded cheddar cheese and sour cream

title: low sugar banana bread
steps:
1. Mix mashed bananas and sugar until the sugar has dissolved
2. Beat eggs and add to bananas , blending well
3. Sift dry ingredients and mix in with banana mixture
4. If desired fold in nuts or chocolate chips
5. Pour into greased 9x5 loaf pan and bake at 325 degrees for ~50 minute

title: chocolate rice noodle haystacks
steps:
1. Melt the chocolate chips , butterscotch chips and peanut butter in the microwave , stirring every 25 seconds or so until smooth
2. You can also use a double boiler on the stovetop
3. Stir in the noodles and marshmallows
4. Drop by spoonfuls onto waxed paper or parchment paper and allow cookies to harden
5. They are sold as a "topper" for salads or main dishes
6. Not to be confused with rice noodles that you would add a sauce to or use in a soup !

title: firecracker burgers with cooling lime sauce
steps:
1. Combine the ground beef , curry powder , jerk seasoning , and 1 tsp salt in a large bowl
2. Mix lightly but thoroughly
3. Shape into 4 thick patties
4. Heat grill to medium
5. Place patties on the grill and grill 13-15 min , uncovered for medium doneness
6. Turning two to three times
7. Meanwhile , combine the mayonnaise , yogurt , lime juice , lime zest , and 1 / 4 tsp salt in a small bowl
8. Spread sauce on cut sides of rolls
9. Place a burger on bottom half of each roll
10. Top evenly with the mixed greens
11. Top with the other half of the rolls and serve

title: addicting sweet and sour salsa
steps:
1. Chop peppers and onion and combine with black eyed peas , shoepeg corn and pimientos
2. Whisk together sugar , apple cider vinegar , veg
3. Oil and tiger sauce
4. Mix all ingredients together- cover , marinate and chill for a couple of hours !
5. Enjoy ! :)

title: quick skillet meatloaf
steps:
1. Place ground beef in large mixing bowl
2. Combine onion soup mix and water
3. Pour 1 / 2 cup soup mixture over ground beef
4. Gently mix to blend
5. Shape into an 8 inch round patty in large skillet
6. Pour remaining soup mixture over top
7. Cover and cook over medium heat for 25 minutes or until cooked to desired doneness
8. Great serve with mashed potatoes and corn
9. It may come out a little "loose"- that's okay
10. This recipe is about taste not looks

title: grilled vegetable salad with feta and mint
steps:
1. Arrange the vegetables in a single layer on a tray or work surface
2. Lightly spray both sides with olive oil cooking spray
3. Preheat a grill or grill pan over a medium-high heat
4. Grill the vegetables in batches until both sides are nicely charred and the vegetables are just tender , about 10 minutes for the pepper , about 8 minutes for the eggplant and onion , and about 6 minutes for the zucchini
5. When the vegetables are cool enough to handle , cut into 1 / 2-inch pieces and transfer to a large bowl
6. In a small bowl , whisk together the olive oil , vinegar and oregano
7. Pour over the vegetables and toss
8. Season , to taste , with salt and pepper
9. Gently stir in the tomatoes and mint
10. Divide the salad between 4 plates and sprinkle with the feta

title: vegetarian artichoke fajitas
steps:
1. Cook rice in vegetable broth while cutting vegetables
2. Cook onions , peppers , and artichoke hearts
3. Warm the tortillas
4. Serve !

title: orange juice biscuits
steps:
1. In a 9 in
2. Microwavable pie plate , soften butter and orange juice concentrate in microwave for 1 minute on 50 percent power
3. Stir in sugar
4. Cut each biscuit into quarters and drop into orange juice mixture- turn each piece to coat
5. Bake at 450 degrees for 10-12 minutes until deep golden brown
6. Allow to cool slightly and invert onto serving plate with sides

title: my big fat greek pastitsio
steps:
1. In a nonstick skillet sprayed with nonstick spray , saute the onion over medium-high heat until translucent , 2-3 minutes or so
2. Add meat to the pan and cook over medium heat until browned all the way through
3. Drain fat
4. Add tomato sauce , garlic , just 1 tsp of the cinnamon , and some salt to taste
5. Simmer on low heat 20 minutes
6. Meanwhile , in a medium saucepan , melt the butter
7. Once the butter has melted , stir in the flour , whisking until blended
8. Remove pan from heat and whisk in the milk slowly until blended
9. Return pan to heat and let simmer over low heat about 5 minutes , stirring often , or until thick and smooth
10. Remove sauce from heat and let cool slightly
11. In a bowl , beat eggs and then add small portion of the cream sauce , whisking quickly as you do
12. Whisk in a bit more of the sauce , then add all the rest and whisk well until smooth
13. Season sauce with some salt& pepper and a dash of nutmeg to taste , mixing well
14. Grease a 9x13" casserole with deep sides well and place hot macaroni in it
15. Top with meat sauce , then sprinkle meat sauce with remaining 1 tsp cinnamon
16. Pour cream sauce over all to cover
17. You may need to shake the pan a little to make everything settle in
18. You may have a little extra cream sauce left over , depending on how deep your pan is
19. Bake in a preheated 350 f oven for approximately 40 minutes or until custard is firm
20. Let cool 10 minutes before serving

title: nanna s christmas cake
steps:
1. On the first day
2. Finely chop fruit and soak overnight in the alcohol , parisenne essence , orange juice and rind
3. On the second day
4. Pre heat oven to 160 degrees celsius
5. Cream butter and sugar
6. Add eggs one at a time , mix well and set aside
7. Sift flour , bicarbonate soda , nutmeg , baking powder and mix through the fruit mixture
8. Add the almonds and creamed mixture
9. Line a 20cm x 7cm square tin with two layers of brown paper , one layer being greaseproof paper
10. Bake at 160 degrees celsius for 30 minutes , then reduce the oven to 120 degrees celsius and cook for a further 150 minutes or until a skewer comes out clean
11. Let cake cool in tin and then remove from tin and place on a cooling rack

title: mimi s cafe whiskey sauce
steps:
1. Melt butter in a small saucepan over low heat
2. Add sugar and stir will
3. Remove from heat , let cool slightly , then quickly whisk in the beaten eggs and whiskey
4. Put the sauce back on the stove over low heat and whisk constantly until the sauce has thickened slightly
5. Keep the sauce warm until serving
6. If you like , you can serve the bread pudding with a sprinkle of powdered sugar and a scoop of your favorite ice cream

title: sweet and sour meatloaf
steps:
1. Mix together beef , bread crumbs , salt , pepper and eggs
2. Add onions and one-half of tomato sauce
3. Form into loaf in 9-in
4. X 5-in
5. X 3-in
6. Pan
7. Bake at 350 degree oven for 50 minutes
8. In saucepan , combine topping ingredients
9. Bring to boil
10. Pour over meat loaf
11. Bake 10 minutes more

title: brats n  tots bake
steps:
1. Crumble bratwurst into large skillet
2. Add onion
3. Cook over medium heat until meat is no longer pink
4. Drain
5. Stir in the soup
6. Transfer to a greased 13 in x 9 in baking dish
7. Top with tater tots and sour cream
8. Sprinkle with cheese
9. Bake , uncovered at 350 degrees for 35-40 minutes

title: frittata di spaghetti  spaghetti frittata
steps:
1. In a frying pan , saute the prosciutto or ham in the olive oil until crispy
2. Drain on brown paper or paper towels
3. In a large bowl , beat the eggs
4. Add the parmigiano-reggiano , salt and pepper , and basil or parsley
5. Add the spaghetti and mix well , then stir in the mozzarella cheese and proscuitto
6. In a 9-inch frying pan , heat 2t of the butter and 2t of the olive oil
7. Add the spaghetti mixture and smooth the top with a spatula
8. Cook over medium-low heat until the frittata is browned on the bottom and set
9. Invert a plate larger than the frying pan over the pan and turn out the frittata
10. Heat the remaining butter and olive oil in the pan , and return the frittata to the pan to brown the other side
11. Shake the pan occasionally to keep the frittata from sticking
12. Rather than turning the frittata , place the pan under the broiler for 5- 8 minutes
13. Invert a serving plate over the frying pan and carefully turn out the frittata
14. Serve at room temperature , cut in wedges

title: grilled prawns with cilantro and ginger sauce
steps:
1. Preheat the broiler or light a fire in an open grill
2. Peel prawns , discarding shells
3. Optional step: devein prawns using a small sharp knife to partially split the prawns lengthways and remove the fine digestive cord
4. Pat prawns dry with paper towels
5. Mix together the marinade ingredients
6. Add the prawns and set aside for 10 minutes
7. Mix sauce ingredients together and set aside
8. Place prawns on a baking tray big enough to fit under the broiler
9. Alternatively , cook them on a grill over gray coals
10. Cook the prawns for 3 minutes on one side , flip , and cook for 2 minutes on other side
11. Serve prawns with sauce

title: cider braised cabbage
steps:
1. Melt butter in large pot over medium-high heat
2. Add onion
3. Saute until beginning to soften , about 5 minutes
4. Add cabbage
5. Saute until slightly wilted , tossing frequently , about 6 minutes
6. Stir in apple cider
7. Reduce heat to medium
8. Cover and cook until cabbage is tender , stirring occasionally , about 6 minutes
9. Uncover
10. Simmer until almost all liquid in pot evaporates , about 3 minutes
11. Stir in vinegar
12. Season with salt and pepper

title: confederate bean soup
steps:
1. Melt the margarine in a large saucepan , then fry the bacon pieces in it until just beginning to crisp
2. Add the garlic , onion and green pepper
3. Cook until the veggies are wilted
4. Gently stir in the beans and sausage , and simmer uncovered for about 15 minutes
5. Stir in the half and half , and simmer about 10 more minutes

title: microwaved garlic mushroom rolls
steps:
1. Place butter and garlic in a bowl
2. Cover and cook on high 20 - 45 seconds to melt
3. Add mushrooms , lemon juice and pepper to taste , blending well
4. Cover and cook on high 5 minutes , stirring once
5. Cut a thin slice from the top of each roll and reserve
6. Pull out the soft crumb centre and use as breadcrumbs in another dish
7. Stir the parsley into the mushroom mixture , mixing well
8. Spoon the mixture into each roll and replace the lids
9. Arrange on a plate lined with absorbent paper and heat on high 30 - 60 seconds to heat through

title: pork braised in riesling with apricots
steps:
1. Trim fat from roast , sprinkle with salt and pepper , and set aside
2. Coat a large nonaluminum sacuepan with cooking spray , and place over medium high heat until hot
3. Cook roast on all sides until browned
4. Remove roast from pan , set aside
5. Wipe drippings from pan with paper towel
6. Insert meat thermoneter into thickest portion of roast
7. Return to pan , add riesling
8. Cover , reduce heat , and cook 1 hour
9. Add apricots , cook , covered , 30 minutes or until thermonmeter registers 160 degrees
10. Remove roast and apricots to a serving platter , keep warm
11. Bring cooking liquid to a boil , cook 10 minutes or until reduced to 1 / 4 cup
12. Serve sauce with roast and apricots

title: rabo de toro   oxtail stew from spain
steps:
1. Heat the olive oil in a large sauce pan
2. Lightly salt oxtails and brown on each side
3. Take oxtails off the oil and set aside
4. Brown the onion and garlic in the remaining oil until golden
5. Return the oxtails to the pan
6. Add vegetables , herbs and spices and stir to combine
7. Add the sherry and only enough stock to cover the meat
8. Bring to a boil , then reduce the heat and simmer covered for 3-5 hours , until the meat is done , and the sauce has reduced
9. If the sauce is still too liquid , uncover and boil rapidly for a few minutes

title: ham and broccoli strata
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine the broccoli , ham and cheese
2. Spread half the mixture into a greased 13x9x2-inch baking dish
3. Arrange bread slices on top and cover with remaining ham / / cheese / broccoli mixture
4. In a large bowl , combine the eggs , milk , onion flakes , mustard and hot pepper sauce
5. Pour over broccoli mixture
6. Sprinkle with paprika
7. Cover and refrigerate overnight
8. Remove from the refrigerator 30 minutes before baking , uncovered , for 35-40 minutes or until a knife inserted in the center comes out clean
9. Let stand 5 minutes before serving

title: sausage in a beer mustard sauce
steps:
1. Slice the sausage into 1 inch rounds
2. Place in a crock-pot
3. Top with the onions
4. Combine the remaining ingredients in a bowl and pour over the sausage and onions
5. Cook on low for 8 hours
6. Mix together cornstarch and water to form a paste add into crock-pot during the last 5 minutes of cooking

title: cheesy chicken chowder
steps:
1. Bring chicken broth to a boil
2. Add potatoes , celery , salt , carrots , onion and pepper to broth and cook 15 minutes or'till tener
3. Make a white sauce with margarine , milk , and flour and add to broth and vegetables along with cheese and chicken
4. Heat and eat

title: oatmeal and apple butter bars
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease 9-inch square baking pan with nonstick cooking spray
3. In large bowl , combine oats , flour , sugar , salt and cinnamon
4. Add butter and beat with electric mixer on low until mixture is crumbly
5. Pat half of the mixture , about 2 cups into baking pan
6. Spread apple butter evenly over crumb layer
7. Sprinkle remaining crumbs over apple butter and press down gently
8. Bake 30-35 minutes or until golden
9. Transfer pan to wire rack and cool completely
10. Cut into 16 bars

title: penne al funghi porcini  pierce brosnan s fave
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat , and saut the sliced porcini mushrooms with the garlic and parsley till tender , about 5 minutes
2. Season with salt and pepper
3. Add the wine and let it all simmer until the wine evaporates , about 5-8 minutes
4. Add the tomatoes and cook for 5 to 7 minutes
5. Meanwhile , boil the penne until al dente
6. Drain the pasta and add it to the sauce together with the grated cheese
7. Let cook for 2 minutes at low heat
8. Taste for seasoning
9. Serve piping hot
10. Pass extra cheese for sprinkling
11. Enjoy !

title: simply roasted pork loin roast with apricot glaze
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees
2. Place the preserves in a small saucepan over medium-low heat , and cook 10 minutes or until melted
3. Keep warm over low heat
4. Combine salt , oregano , garlic powder , and pepper
5. Rub evenly over pork
6. Place pork on a rack coated with cooking spray
7. Place rack in a shallow roasting pan
8. Bake at 425 degrees for 30 minutes
9. Brush 1 / 4 cup preserves evenly over pork
10. Bake an additional 10 minutes
11. Brush remaining preserves evenly over pork
12. Bake an additional 10 minutes or until meat thermometer registers 155 degrees
13. Let stand 10 minutes before slicing

title: seashells  pasta with spicy alfredo sauce
steps:
1. Melt butter in a medium saucepan over med / low heat
2. Add garlic , cream , pepper flakes and salt and bring to a simmer
3. Turn heat down when reaches to a rapid boil , simmer
4. Add cheese , and continue to simmer 8 minutes or until thickens
5. Pour sauce over top of pasta

title: sommer s strawberry banana peach smoothie  dairy free
steps:
1. Put frozen sliced bananas and frozen whole strawberries into blender with the soy milk
2. Blend until smooth and thick
3. Add in peach soy yogurt , blend more until smooth
4. Serve immediately or refrigerate , or freeze and thaw slightly

title: cauliflower  steaks  with olive relish
steps:
1. Remove leaves and trim stem end of cauliflower , leaving core intact
2. Slice cauliflower into four 1 / 2" "steaks" from center of cauliflower
3. Finely chop enough loose florets to measure 1 / 2 cup
4. Transfer chopped florets to a small bowl and mix with olives , sun-dried tomatoes , 1 tablespoon oil , parsley , and lemon juice
5. Season relish with salt and pepper
6. Preheat oven to 400
7. Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in a large heavy ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat
8. Cook cauliflower steaks until golden brown , about 2 minutes per side , adding tablespoon oil to pan between batches
9. Transfer steaks to a large rimmed baking sheet
10. Reserve skillet
11. Roast cauliflower until tender , about 15 minutes
12. Meanwhile , return skillet to medium-high heat and add garlic cloves and tomatoes , one cut side down
13. Cook until tomatoes are browned
14. Turn tomatoes over and transfer skillet to oven with cauliflower
15. Roast garlic and tomatoes until tender , about 12 minutes
16. Transfer garlic , tomatoes , and 1 / 2 tablespoon oil to a blender
17. Pure until smooth
18. Season with salt and pepper
19. Divide tomato sauce among plates
20. Place 1 cauliflower steak on each plate
21. Spoon relish over
22. Serve warm or at room temperature

title: mccormick s meatloaf seasoning mix
steps:
1. Combine dry spices and seal in ziploc or vacuum seal bag
2. Meatloaf directions:1 package meat loaf seasoning mix , 2 pounds ground beef or ground turkey , 2 eggs , 1 / 2 cup milk , 2 slices bread , finely crumbled or 1 / 4 cup dry bread crumbs , 1 / 2 cup ketchup
3. Mix seasoning mix , ground beef or turkey , eggs , milk and bread crumbs in large bowl
4. Shape into a loaf
5. Place loaf in a shallow baking pan or 9x5-inch loaf pan
6. Spread ketchup over top of loaf
7. Bake in preheated 375f oven 1 hour or until cooked through
8. Makes 10 servings , approx 3oz each

title: swirled cranberry cheesecake
steps:
1. Mix cookie crumbs and butter
2. Press onto bottom and 1 inch up sides of greased 9 inch springform pan
3. Bake at 350 degrees for 10 minutes
4. Cool completely
5. Process cranberry sauce and spices in food processor or blender
6. Set aside
7. Beat cream cheese until smooth
8. Add sugar and cornstarch
9. Beat well
10. Add eggs , one at a time , beating until just blended
11. Stir in vanilla
12. Pour 1 / 2 the batter into crust
13. Spoon 1 / 2 the cranberry mixture over batter , swirl with knife
14. Top with remaining batter
15. Repeat with remaining cranberry mixture
16. Bake at 350 degrees for 15 minutes
17. Reduce oven to 225 degrees
18. Bake 1 hour and 10 minutes
19. Remove from oven
20. Immediately run knife around sides of cheesecake to loosen from pan
21. Turn oven off
22. Return cheesecake to oven and let cool in oven 1 hour
23. Remove from oven
24. Cool completely on wire rack
25. Chill uncovered until ready to serve remove sides of pan
26. Serve

title: seafood club sandwich
steps:
1. Shred up crab into bowl and mix with a couple heaping tablespoons mayo until enough is added to your liking
2. In another bowl , mix drained tuna with mayo the same way as you did with the crab mixture
3. To these mixtures you can add seasonings if desired
4. I put black olives in my crab mix and dill relish sometimes in my tuna mix
5. Take the lightly toasted bread and on first slice scoop some crab mixture onto it to desired thickness
6. Place another slice of toasted bread on this
7. Scoop some tuna mixture onto this second slice of toast
8. Can now place any other options- i like lettuce , tomato and mozzarella cheese
9. Place third slice of toasted bread onto top layer
10. Can toothpick layers together and cut in half
11. Enjoy

title: grilled zucchini  parmesan
steps:
1. Place the zucchini and tomatoes on a large square of heavy-duty foil
2. Sprinkle with oregano , salt and parmesan and top with butter , cut in pieces
3. Shape foil into packet , seal , and place 6 inches above gray coals
4. Grill 20-25 minutes , turning packet every 10 minutes

title: rolled french steak
steps:
1. Lay all thin steaks out flat on cookie sheets
2. Put 1 / 2 slice of bacon on each steak
3. Sprinkle parsley over each steak
4. Sprinkle parmesan cheese over each steak
5. Sprinkle chopped garlic over each steak
6. Roll steak up and fasten with toothpick so steak does not unroll
7. Brown outside of steak rolls in oil in 4 to 6 quart pan
8. After all steak rolls are browned , place back in pan
9. Cover with tomato sauce
10. Simmer for approximately 1-1 / 2 to 2 hours
11. Sauce will thicken quite a bit
12. Make sure steak doesn't start to stick to bottom of pan

title: apple smiles
steps:
1. Core apples and slice each into 6-8 wedges
2. If you are slicing apples ahead of time , toss with lemon juice
3. Cover 1 side of apple wedge with about 1 tbs
4. Of peanut butter
5. Stand up 5 or 6 marshmallows in a line along the peel edge of apple
6. Cover with another apple wedge
7. Repeat with the other wedges

title: redneck caviar party dip salsa
steps:
1. Drain all canned ingredients
2. Mix vegetables together in bowl
3. Coat with the italian dressing
4. You may not need the entire bottle
5. Cover and chill overnight
6. Serve with corn chips or crackers

title: instant refried beans
steps:
1. In a coffee grinder , food mill , food processor or blender , grind beans until a flour consistency
2. Combine all ingredients and store in an airtight container
3. To prepare , in a medium-sized saucepan combine 3 / 4 cup bean flour mix with 2-1 / 2 cups boiling water
4. Mix with a whisk until combined
5. Bring to boil , cover , reduce heat to low and simmer for 4-5 minutes or until thickened
6. Mixture will thicken as it cools

title: garlic sauce
steps:
1. Combine first 4 ingredients and mix well
2. Sprinkle with green onion
3. Keep refridgerated till ready to use

title: hawaiian style banana bread
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350
2. Cream sugar and shortening
3. Add eggs and vanilla and beat until fluffy
4. Add baking soda , baking powder , nutmeg and cinnamon and mix at low spead
5. Stir in flour and nuts
6. Pour batter into a greased 9" by 5" loaf pan
7. Bake at 350 for 45 minutes
8. If loaf is browning too fast , cover top with a layer of foil
9. Cool in pan for 10 minutes

title: blueberry rum marinated pork tenderloin
steps:
1. To make the salsa: coarsely chop 2 cups blueberries
2. Stir together chopped blueberries , remaining 1 cup blueberries and the remaining ingredients
3. Cover and chill until ready to serve
4. To make the tenderloin: process the first 7 ingredients in a blender or food processor until smooth
5. Pour mixture into a large zip-lock heavy-duty plastic bag
6. Add in pork
7. Seal and chill at least 4 hours
8. Remove pork from the marinade and discard marinade
9. Grill pork , covered with grill lid , o ver medium heat 11-13 minutes on each side or until meat thermometer reads 155
10. Remove from grill
11. Loosely cover pork with foil
12. Let stand 10 minutes or until thermometer reads 160
13. Cut pork into slices and serve over toasted bread
14. Top with blueberry salsa

title: cauliflower gratine   gratin
steps:
1. Cook cauliflower in boiling salted water about 12 minutes , just until fork tender
2. Drain and place in shallow baking dish , combine soup , milk
3. Stir in cheese
4. Pour over cauliflower
5. Sprinkle with crumbs
6. Bake at 350 for 20 minutes , until hot and bubbly
7. Ganish with bacon

title: fried spaghetti
steps:
1. Melt the butter in a heavy nonstick skillet
2. Have the pasta out at room temperature in a large bowl
3. In a small bowl , beat together the eggs , milk , cheese , fresh parsley and / or chives , and a lot of freshly ground black pepper
4. Pour egg mixture over pasta and toss it well
5. When butter has heated past the point of foaming , add pasta and flatten into a big pancake
6. Cook over medium heat until the bottom forms a golden brown crust
7. Flip the"pancake" over and continue to cook until that side also forms a golden brown crust
8. Slide pancake out onto a hot plate
9. Cut in wedges
10. Serve hot
11. Pass additional grated cheese !

title: sticky rice with mango and lime
steps:
1. Rinse rice well under cold water , then drain
2. Place rice and water in a saucepan over medium heat and bring to the boil
3. Allow rice to simmer until almost all liquid has been absorbed
4. Remove pan from heat and pour coconut cream over rice
5. Cover rice and allow to stand for 5-7 minutes or until coconut cream has been absorbed
6. Stir sugar through rice and set aside
7. Place banana leaves in boiling water for 1-2 minutes or until they are soft
8. Divide rice into 6 portions
9. Spread half of each portion over the middle of the banana leaf
10. Top rice with a sprinkling of mango , lime rind and juice , and palm sugar
11. Cover filling with remaining portions of rice
12. Roll up leaves and secure with toothpicks
13. Place leaf packages on a hot barbecue or char grill and cook for 2 minutes on each side or until rice is heated through
14. Serve warm or cold

title: asian flavored aioli
steps:
1. Whisk all ingredients together until smooth
2. Chill until ready to serve

title: peanut butter chili
steps:
1. Place the diced tomatoes , water , garlic , and bay leaves into a saucepan , and bring to a simmer over high heat
2. Reduce heat to medium-low , and season with the cayenne pepper , chili powder , garlic powder , and italian seasoning
3. Cover , and simmer 15 minutes
4. After 15 minutes , pour in the black beans and kidney beans
5. Return to a simmer , and cook for 5 minutes
6. Stir in the peanut butter until dissolved , then remove and discard the bay leaves , and season the chili with salt and pepper to taste
7. Enjoy with a sprinkle of cheddar cheese , tortilla chips and smile !

title: sweet potato risotto
steps:
1. Heat 1 t butter in a saucepan and add onion and garlic
2. Cook for 3-4 minutes , stirring frequently , until onion is tender
3. Stir in rice and cook 1 minute more , stirring constantly
4. Add wine and cook until evaporated , stirring
5. Stir in sweet potato and 1 / 2 cup of broth
6. Cook , stirring constantly , until liquid is completely absorbed
7. Stir in 1 / 2 cup additional broth
8. Continue cooking about 20 minutes , stirring constantly and adding 1 / 2 cup of broth at every time previous additions have been absorbed until rice is creamy and tender
9. Add the remaining butter and peas and cook until heated , stirring throughout
10. Remove from heat
11. Stir in remaining ingredients

title: gordita bread
steps:
1. In a large bowl , mix masa harina and lard
2. Slowly add in the stock while mixing
3. Mix the salt and garlic powder into the flour and then add to the masa mixture
4. Knead the mixture in the bowl for 2-3 minutes
5. Pull off pieces of dough and roll in your hands to form a golf-ball sized ball
6. Lightly coat the balls with flour and place between to two pieces of cellophane or use a tortilla press
7. Roll or press the balls until the gorditas are about 1 / 4 inch thick
8. Heat a comal until hot
9. Cook the gordita for about one minute on each side , or until it is cooked through
10. Heat the oil over medium heat
11. Place the cooked gorditas in the oil one at a time and cook until the gordita puffs up
12. Drain on paper towels
13. Slice an opening in one end to open the pocket and stuff with your favorite fillings such as meat and beans

title: bacon  egg and cheese biscuit bowls
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Spray the bottom side of a cupcake pan with cooking spray
3. Flatten each dough round to 1 / 4-inch thickness
4. With the cupcake pan turned upside down , place each dough circle over the back of each cupcake cup
5. Press the dough around the cup to form a bowl
6. Bake for 12 minutes
7. Remove from the oven and allow to cool for 5 minutes
8. Carefully turn the biscuit bowls up-side down onto a baking sheet
9. Set aside until ready to assemble
10. Meanwhile , cook the bacon in a large skillet over medium heat until crispy , about 8 minutes
11. Remove the bacon and drain on paper towels
12. Discard half of the bacon grease from the pan
13. Add the eggs to the remaining bacon grease
14. Sprinkle with parsley , garlic powder , onion salt and pepper
15. When the eggs are done cooking , transfer them to a bowl and set aside
16. Arrange the breakfast bowls
17. Place the cooked eggs evenly in each biscuit bowl
18. Crumble the bacon over the eggs and top with american cheese
19. Place the biscuit bowls back in the oven to melt the cheese , about 2 to 3 minutes
20. Pull the bowls apart and enjoy !

title: super easy chicken casserole with stuffing
steps:
1. Place each piece of chicken in casserole
2. Lay a piece of cheese on top of each piece
3. Cover the chicken with soup
4. Add your favorite spices to soup
5. Prepare stuffing according to package directions
6. Place stuffing on top of casserole
7. Bake uncovered at 325f for 1 hour

title: sausage spinach  alfredo lasagna
steps:
1. Grease a 13 x 9-inch baking dish
2. In a large skillet brown the turkey sausage meat in 1 tablespoon oil along with the onion , garlic and cayenne pepper
3. Cook breaking up the sausage meat while browning
4. Cook until browned then add in the chopped red peppers
5. Cook for another 2 minutes
6. Drain fat and set aside
7. Place the spinach in a small saucepan , cover with water and bring to a boil simmer over low heat for about 10 minutes
8. Place in a small colinder , rinse under cold water then hand-squeeze very dry
9. Place the spinach in a large bowl , then add in the cottage cheese , ricotta cheese , fresh garlic , 1 egg , 1 / 2 cup parmesan cheese , 1-1 / 2 cups mozzarella cheese , seasoned salt and black pepper
10. Mix with a wooden spoon until well combined
11. Spread 1 cup alfredo sauce onto the bottom of prepared baking dish , then top with 4 cooked lasagna noodles , then half of the ricotta / spinach mixture , then sprinkle half of the sausage mixture on top
12. Place about 1 cup of shredded mozzarella cheese on top of the sausage
13. Repeat the layers
14. Top with remaining 4 lasagna noodles , then 1 cup shredded mozzarella cheese
15. Drizzle remaining alfredo sauce over the shredded cheese , then sprinkle with about 3 / 4 to 1 cup parmesan cheese
16. Cover with foil and bake at 350 degrees for 50 minutes
17. Remove the foil and bake uncovered for another 10-15 minutes
18. Let stand for 20 minutes before slicing

title: memphis sweet potato fries
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees f
2. In a large bowl , mix together olive oil , paprika and cinnamon
3. Toss the potato strips into mixture , to coat well , and spread onto baking sheet in a single layer
4. Sprinkle with salt and brown sugar
5. Bake for 30 minutes , turning every 10 minutes

title: easter bunny cupcakes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Line 24 muffin tins with paper liners
3. Prepare cake mix as directed for 24 cupcakes , substituting milk for water and adding vanilla extract to batter
4. Bake and cool completely as directed
5. Spoon 2 cups frosting into a bowl and tint yellow , light blue , pale green or pink with food coloring
6. Frost spoon a dollop of remaining white frosting onto center of each cupcake for bunny faces
7. To make ears: cut each marshmallow in half crosswise with kitchen shears , then cut each piece in half diagonally to form 2 ears , flattening slightly with your fingers
8. Press in pink decorating sugar
9. Stick 2 ears into each of white frosting mounds
10. Use pink candies to make noses , blue candies for eyes and chocolate sprinkles for whiskers

title: fruitcake ii
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 250f
2. Butter and flour 4 , 9 x 5 inch loaf pans
3. Cream together butter , brown sugar and honey
4. Add eggs , one at a time , beating well after each addition
5. In another bowl , mix flour , cinnamon , baking powder , allspice and salt
6. Stir half of flour mixture into butter mixture
7. In the remaining flour , dredge apricots , walnuts , dates and raisins
8. In a small bowl combine nectar , cream , vanilla extract and lemon juice
9. Add to batter and fold in fruit
10. Divide among 4 buttered and floured 9 x 5 inch loaf pans and bake for 2 to 3 hours , or until a tester comes out clean
11. Combine brandy with liqueur and sprinkle each cake with of this mixture
12. Let cakes stand 1 hour
13. Remove from pans and chill , tightly wrapped in foil , for atleast 1 week before cutting

title: crunchy taco mix
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degreesf
2. Melt butter in 13 x9-inch baking pan on oven
3. Stirring in seasoning mix
4. Add cereal
5. Stir to coat evenly
6. Bake , stirring after half the time , for 10 to 12 minutes or until cereal is crisp
7. Microwave directions: melt butter in 12x8-inch glass baking dish on high
8. Stir in seasoning mix
9. Add cereal
10. Stir to coat evenly
11. Microwave on high , stirring after half the time , until cereal is crisp

title: danube waves cake  donauwellen kuchen
steps:
1. Cake: preheat the oven to 375 degrees f
2. Grease a 12 x 8 pan
3. Beat the butter , eggs and sugar together until sugar is dissolved
4. Add the flour
5. Spread half of the batter into the pan
6. Add cocoa and milk to remaining batter , mix well and spread over the top
7. Bake for 30-40 minutes until done
8. Let cool for approximately one hour
9. For filling: drain the cherries , saving 1 cup plus 2 tablespoons of the juice
10. Heat the juice , sugar and cornstarch slowly , stirring constantly
11. Add the cherries
12. When the mix has thickened , set aside to cool
13. For cream: cook the pudding according to the package directions with the milk and sugar let cool to room temperature
14. Beat the butter until creamy and add the pudding spoon by spoon while beating let rest a few minutes
15. Assembly: spread the cherry mix on top of the cake and cover with the cream
16. Drizzle melted chocolate over the top

title: sweetie cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Cream margarine and sugar
3. Add eggs one at a time , mixing after each addition
4. Add almond extract , flour , baking powder , cream of tartar , and salt
5. Add a few drops of red food coloring to the dough and swirl through mixture
6. Do not over mix
7. Chill dough thoroughly
8. Roll chilled dough into balls and place on greased cookie sheet
9. Flatten balls slightly
10. Bake for exactly 10 minutes
11. While cookies are baking , mix together the glaze ingredients
12. Glaze cookies while warm

title: mish salad
steps:
1. Cut chili peper , tomatoe , and lemon into medium size pieces , and add them to the yogurt
2. Add salt and olive oil to taste
3. The salad taste better if left overnight in the fridge
4. The longer you leave it , the better the taste

title: goulash with green peppers and noodles
steps:
1. Cut beef into 1 1 / 2 in cubes
2. Dice the bacon and put into a heavy dutch oven
3. Saut over medium to high heat until fat is rendered out
4. Add beef cubes
5. Brown slowly until all cubes are nicely browned
6. Add the onions
7. Cook 2 to 3 minutes or until onions are softened
8. Add the red wine or broth , paprika , salt and green pepper
9. Blend well
10. Cook slowly , covered , without allowing to boil , about 2 hours , until meat is tender but not falling apart
11. Add more liquid if needed but don't let it go soupy
12. Add salt to taste
13. Serve over hot buttered noodles and top with sour cream
14. Add a crusty french bread for some good eating !

title: baked mashed potatoes with parmesan cheese and bread crumbs
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f
2. Coat a 13 by 9 by 2-inch baking dish with 1 tablespoon of butter and set aside
3. Cook the potatoes in a large pot of boiling salted water until they are very tender , about 15 minutes
4. Drain
5. Return the potatoes to the same pot and mash well
6. Mix in the milk and melted butter
7. Mix in the mozzarella and 3 / 4 cup of the parmesan
8. Season , to taste , with salt and pepper
9. Transfer the potatoes to the prepared baking dish
10. Stir the bread crumbs and remaining 1 / 4 cup of parmesan in a small bowl to blend
11. Sprinkle the bread crumb mixture over the mashed potatoes
12. Recipe can be prepared up to this point 6 hours ahead of time
13. Cover and chill
14. Bake , uncovered , until the topping is golden brown , about 20 minutes

title: chipotle mexican grill ancho chile marinade for meat recipe
steps:
1. Soak dry chiles in water overnight or until soft
2. Remove seeds
3. Add all ingredients except chicken in food processor
4. Puree until smooth
5. Spread mixture over chicken breasts and refrigerate at least one hour , up to 24 hours
6. Heat grill to about 400 degrees f , or if cooking inside , heat small amount of oil in skillet or grill pan over high heat
7. Salt chicken breasts to taste
8. Grill chicken breasts about4 minutes per side , depending upon thickness , until done
9. Serve with rice , black beans , or choice of side dish
10. Garnish with fresh cilantro

title: peasant soup  like olga s
steps:
1. In a large pot , brown lamb , onion and celery only until lamb is no longer pink
2. Drain off fat
3. Add tomatoes , garlic , bay leaf and broth
4. Bring to a boil
5. Add quick barley , zucchini , frozen vegetables , thyme , oregano , and parsley
6. Then reduce to simmer for 30 minutes
7. Salt and pepper to taste
8. Serve with toasted pita bread triangles

title: quick spinach and mashed potatoes
steps:
1. Peel and large dice the potatoes
2. Place in large pot , add enough water to cover potaotes by two inches
3. Bring to a boil , turn down to medium and cook until fork-tender
4. Drain cooked potatoes and return to hot pot
5. Turn heat to lowest setting
6. Add butter and mash well or leave with small lumps
7. Combine rest of ingredients and blend
8. Heat through
9. Serve hot
10. This makes a nice lunch
11. Serve with chilled sliced beef tomatoes topped with salt and pepper to taste and sprinkle with grated cheese as desired

title: mrs johnson s peach preserves
steps:
1. Peel and slice peaches
2. About 24 of them
3. Bring sugar and water to a boil
4. Cook for 5 minutes or till a syrup forms
5. Skim off any foam
6. Stir in peaches
7. Return to a boil
8. Watch for boiling over
9. Boil for 5 minutes stirring constantly
10. Remove from heat
11. Skim off any foam
12. Add extracts
13. Add salt
14. Fill clean sterilized jars

title: old fashioned drop cookies
steps:
1. Dissolve baking soda in 2 tablespoons hot water
2. Cream butter and sugar
3. Add eggs
4. Add spices , coffee and soda mixture
5. Mix nuts and flour
6. Add to mixture
7. If dough not stiff add little more flour
8. Drop mixture on greased cookie sheet by the teaspoon
9. Bake in 375f degree oven for 15 minutes

title: healthy warm artichoke dip
steps:
1. Finely chop artichoke hearts and put in a microwave-safe dish
2. Add yogurt , cheese , garlic , and basil
3. Mix well
4. Microwave 3 minutes on high
5. Stir
6. Microwave 2 minutes more
7. Serve warm

title: cheese onion bread
steps:
1. Add ingredients to breadmaker according to your machine's recommendations
2. Select cycle and press start

title: mini ham and cheese turnovers
steps:
1. On a floured surface roll 1 pastry sheet into a 16 inch square , and cut into 4 inch squares
2. Mix the pineapple preserves with the curry power and spread in each square leaving a 1 / 4 inch border
3. Divide the cheese and ham over the spread in each square
4. Brush the edges with the beaten egg and fold into triangles
5. Seal edges with a fork and brush with egg mixture
6. Preheat oven
7. Bake at 400 f on an ungreased baking sheet 10-12 minutes until golden brown
8. Mine baked a bit faster so i would keep an eye on them after 8 minutes

title: treva s lemon pound cake
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients in a large bowl with an electric mixer until blended
2. Pour batter into prepared tube pan
3. Bake at 350 for 50-60 minutes
4. Enjoy

title: pot roast and swiss cheese noodles
steps:
1. Pot roast: heat large pot for about 4 minutes so when you add meat it sizzles
2. Use cooking spray so meat doesn't stick
3. Brown well on all sides
4. Make sure the pot stays hot so the juices don't escape
5. Brown onions add ketchup salt and pepper
6. Cover meat with water bring to a boil then add the 2 cans of golden onion soup and packet of onion soup mix
7. Cover and simmer for about 3 hours
8. No thickening of the gravy is required unless you added too much water
9. Noodles:
10. Don't over cook noodles deduct about 2 minutes to the cooking time
11. Grate swiss
12. Drain noodles , melt butter in bottom of the pot , add noodles
13. Stir in swiss
14. When mixed well add sour cream
15. I don't usually deviate from the recipe but occasionally i add 1 / 4 cup of mozzarella with the swiss

title: ellie s herbed grilled zucchini slices
steps:
1. Mix all into a ziplock bag and maninate 2 hours
2. Grill 2-3 minutes on each side
3. Enjoy

title: chops and scalloped
steps:
1. In med saucepan , melt butter
2. Stir in flour , salt , italian seasoning , and pepper
3. Add broth
4. Cook and stir until mixture boils
5. Cook for 1 minute more
6. Remove from heat and set aside
7. In skillet , brown chops in oil
8. Season with additional salt and pepper if desired
9. Layer potatoes and onion slices in a greased 13x9 baking pan
10. Pour the broth mixture over
11. Put chops on top
12. Cover and bake at 350 for 1 hour
13. Uncover and bake an additional 30 minutes
14. Sprinkle with paprika and parsley

title: open faced stroganoff sandwich
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Slice the bread in half lengthwise , then lightly butter the bread and wrap in foil
3. Bake at 350 degrees f for 15 minutes
4. Brown the ground beef and drain the excess fat
5. Add the onion , and cook until the onion is transparent
6. Remove from the heat and add the sour cream , worcestershire sauce , salt and pepper
7. Remove the bread from the oven and spread the meat mixture on each half
8. Arrange the chopped tomatoes and chopped bell pepper on top of the meat mixture and top with the grated cheese
9. Place back in the oven and bake only until the cheese is melted
10. Serve hot

title: 6 point carne guisada  latin beef stew
steps:
1. In a large dutch oven or heavy pot , heat oil over medium heat
2. Add scallions and garlic and saut about 2 - 3 minutes
3. Add tomatoes , cilantro and a pinch of salt
4. Cook another 2 minutes , stirring
5. Add beef to the pot along with beer , water , cumin , adobo , achiote , bay leaf and salt if needed
6. Cover and simmer on low heat 1 1 / 2 hours
7. Test to make sure beef is tender , if not cook another 15 minutes
8. Add potatoes and cook until soft , about 20 minutes depending on the size

title: grilled sesame asparagus
steps:
1. Soak 2-3 bamboo skewers in water for 30 minutes or more
2. Wash asparagus and snap the ends off
3. Thread the asparagus spears onto the bamboo skewers
4. Spoon or brush the toasted sesame oil onto the asparagus
5. Spoon or brush the soy sauce onto the asparagus
6. Sprinkle with pepper
7. Place on bbq grill and cook for 3-4 minutes until tender-crisp
8. Sesame seeds can be added after cooking or before , whichever you like better
9. Any extra soy sauce-oil mixture can either be used for dipping or basting during cooking

title: low carb sugar free pumpkin cheesecake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325f
2. In large bowl combine softened cream cheese , splenda , and vanilla
3. Beat with electric mixer until smooth
4. Blend in eggs , one at a time
5. Remove one cup of batter and spread into bottom of glass or crockery baking dish which has been sprayed very lightly with non-stick spray
6. Add pumpkin and spices to remaining batter and stir until blended
7. Carefully spread pumpkin layer over first layer
8. Bake in preheated oven 35-45 minutes or until center is almost set
9. Allow to cool , then chill several hours or overnight
10. Serve with whipped cream if desired and wait for compliments
11. I used a 10" by 8" glass baking dish to cook this
12. Next time i think i would double the recipe and only increase to a 9" by 13" baking dish to make a thicker cheese cake
13. This would show of the layers better
14. Some cinnamon dusted on the top would have been a nice touch

title: yummy old fashion macaroni and cheese
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400f
2. Butter a casserole or 9 x 13 inch baking dish with 1 tablespoon of the butter
3. Cook macaroni until almost tender but still firm , about 2 minutes less than package directions
4. Drain and rinse under cold water
5. Meanwhile , in a small bowl , combine the bread crumbs , parsley , oil , 1 teaspoon of the salt and the pepper and set aside
6. In a saucepan , over medium heat , melt the butter
7. Stirring constantly , add the flour and cook for 3 minutes
8. The mixture will clump together
9. Still stirring constantly , add the milk slowly
10. Cook for 7 minutes
11. Add the cheddar and the remaining salt and cook , stirring , until thick and creamy , about 5 minutes
12. Add the macaroni and combine
13. Transfer to the baking dish and top with the bread crumb mixture
14. Bake until golden and bubbling slightly around the edges , about 25 minutes

title: sour cream  avocado dip  vegan
steps:
1. Peel and pit avocado , put in a large mixing bowl
2. Add entire block of tofu and salsa
3. Combine ingredients using a hand mixer on medium speed for about 1 minute or until the mixture becomes smooth
4. Add remaining ingredients , mix on low speed until all ingredients are blended together
5. Chill for one hour and serve
