6. Store leftovers in the fridge in an air-tight container

title: super bowl chicken supreme
steps:
1. I use a package of chicken breasts that has about 4 large to 6 smaller breasts
2. We've done the recipe skin on and skin off -- we prefer skin on but now that we're older my husband has to watch cholesterol and fat so we do skin off
3. Dredge breasts in flour and place them in a greased baking dish
4. Melt 1 stick of butter in a sauce pan
5. Add to butter oregano , garlic powder , parsley , paprika and curry powder
6. Let simmer for a few minutes
7. Pour over chicken
8. It's just as good -- but if you're daring -- keep going !
9. Cover breasts with table cream
10. Cover with almond slivers
11. Bake 45 minutes to an hour
12. Pour the juice off into a bowl
13. Mix just enough sour cream into the juice to make a sauce
14. Pour this mixture back on top of the chicken
15. Sprinkle the whole thing with herbed croutons
16. Put back into oven for about 15 minutes

title: cleveland style russian tea cakes
steps:
1. Sift dry ingredients in bowl
2. Make well in center and add oil , margarine , orange , juice and peel , eggs and vanilla
3. Knead dough , refrigerate at least 2 hours
4. Cut dough into 4 parts
5. Refrigerate unused dough in between rolling
6. Roll 1 dough piece on floured board , to 8" x 16" , spread with 1 / 4 cup jam , then sprinkle with nuts and raisins
7. Roll as for jelly roll
8. Brush top with egg white , sprinkle with sugar mixture
9. Slice into 1 1 / 2 inch slices , place 1 1 / 2 inches apart on very lightly greased baking sheet with topping side up
10. Continue with other pieces of dough
11. Bake 25 minutes at 350 degrees
12. Remove from baking sheet , and cool on rack

title: apple raisin muffins
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
2. Combine the water , sugar , apples , raisins , butter , cinnamon , nutmeg , and cloves in a saucepan
3. Bring to a boil
4. Remove the pan from the heat and cool completely
5. In a large bowl , stir the nuts and baking soda into the flour
6. Add the cooled mixture to the bowl , and stir until blended
7. Fill greased miniature muffin tins with batter to the top
8. Bake for 15 minutes

title: ground turkey tacos
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
2. Take each tortilla shell and spray with cooking spray
3. Bend the tortillas around the edges of a large , oven-proof plate to create a taco-like shape
4. Place in the oven for 10 minutes or until the tortillas have become rigid , then let them rest at room temperature , still around the plate
5. Saute the ground turkey in a frying pan with 1 / 2 the packet of taco seasoning and worcestershire sauce
6. Dice the pepper , red onion , and mushroom , and mix with the turkey in the pan
7. Cook until turkey is completely cooked and peppers are not brittle
8. Set the mixture aside
9. Prepare a baking dish by covering it with tin foil and greasing it
10. Remove the shells from the plate and spoon the turkey mixture into the shells
11. Sprinkle cheese on top of the turkey mixture
12. Place each stuffed taco into the baking dish
13. They should stand up on their own , supported by the others
14. Bake for 7 minutes or until cheese has partially melted
15. Take out of oven and add lettuce and tomato on top of the cheese
16. Top with special sauce
17. Sauce:
18. Mix sour cream and salsa together in a small bowl
19. Add the taco seasoning to taste
20. Serve on top of the the tacos

title: slow cooker pizza
steps:
1. Brown beef in saucepan with onions
2. Drain
3. Layer half of each of the following , in order given , in slow cooker: ground beef and onions , noodles , mushrooms , olives , pepperoni , sauce , cheddar , and mozarella
4. Then repeat layers
5. Cover and cook on low 3-4 hours
6. We like to add a bit of shredded parmesan to the top when we serve it

title: cheesy cornbread with roasted peppers
steps:
1. Set oven to 375f
2. Butter a 9-inch baking dish
3. In a small saute pan , melt butter and saute the onion and garlic over medium heat until tender
4. Cool and set aside
5. In a large bowl mix together cornmeal , flour , sugar , baking powder , salt and baking soda
6. Add in 7 tablespoons cold butter , and rub between fingers until the mixture resembles coarse meal
7. Whisk in buttermilk and eggs to blend
8. Add in buttermilk mixture to the flour mixture and stir until blended
9. Add in cheese , corn niblets , roasted peppers and onion / garlic mixture
10. Mix to combine
11. Transfer to prepared baking dish
12. Bake for about 45 minutes , or until the cornbread tests done

title: tomato salsa
steps:
1. Peel , seed , core , and chop the tomatoes
2. Place the tomatoes in a large colander and let them drain for 15 minutes
3. Discard the tomato juice drained off , or save for another purpose
4. Place the drained tomatoes in an 8 quart stainless steel pot
5. Bring to boiling
6. Reduce heat
7. Simmer , uncovered , about 1 1 / 4 hours until thickened , stirring frequently
8. Add the green bell pepper , jalapenos , onion , vinegar , tomato paste , garlic , cumin , salt , and pepper
9. Return mixture to boiling
10. Reduce heat
11. Simmer , uncovered , for 10 minutes
12. Ladle the hot salsa into hot canning jars , leaving 1 / 2 inch headspace
13. Wipe the rims of the jars with damp paper towels to remove any salsa which got on the rims or the threads
14. Place the lids and the bands on the jars , just tightening the bands finger
15. Process in a boiling water bath for 15 minutes , then remove and let sit , undisturbed , for at least 12 hours before checking seals
16. It is important to let them sit undisturbed for 12 hours because the sealing compound on the lids is still cooling and hardening , completing the seal
17. While the jars cool , you will hear a "plink" type sound from each jar - this is the jars completing the vacuum seal as the final air escapes the jar
18. After 12 hours have passed , remove the bands and check the lids - press down in the center of the lid
19. If you cannot push the lid down any further , the jar is sealed
20. If the lid "gives" a bit , and you can push it down , the jar did not seal
21. You can either put the band back on the jar , and reprocess it for another 15 minutes , or you can just put it in the fridge and use it within 3 months

title: spicy cucumber soup with yogurt by sy
steps:
1. Put cucumbers in a bowl or colander and sprinkle with salt and toss
2. Let stand for about 15-30 minutes
3. Put yogurt , sour cream and about 1 cup water into a bowl and blend till smooth
4. Add cucumber , scallion , garlic , lemon , jalapeno pepper to yogurt mixture
5. Use a motorized hand blender to chop the cucumber finer and leaving some small chunks
6. Not to fine though
7. (a braun hand mixer-chopper works well for blending the yogurt in step #2 and this step #3
8. Put into refrigerator to chill
9. Serve cold and topped with any combo of fresh dill , mint leaves , chives mrs
10. Dash spices and / or salt to taste

title: five minute ice cream
steps:
1. Put half the berries and half the sugar in the food processor or blender , chop fruit til it forms small chunks with the processor running , slowly pour in half the cream
2. Serve immediately
3. Repeat the steps to use the rest of the ingredients

title: wild mushroom pizza
steps:
1. Heat oven to 450f
2. Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over high heat
3. Cook sliced mushrooms , onion and garlic in oil about 5 minutes
4. Season with salt and black pepper to taste
5. Stir frequently , until onion is crisp-tender and caramelized
6. Stir in parsley
7. Spoon mushroom mixture over pizza crust
8. Sprinkle with cheese
9. Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until cheese is melted

title: magnolia bakery s chocolate drop cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Combine the flour , cocoa powder , baking soda and salt in large bowl
3. Set aside
4. In another large bowl cream the butter , brown sugar and white sugar until smooth
5. About 3 minutes
6. To the butter mixture , add the eggs and mix well
7. Next add the milk and vanilla extract
8. Blend for another minute
9. Stir in the flour mixture and beat thoroughly
10. Add the pecans , almond roca bits and the vanilla chips
11. Arrange the cookies on a parchment lined baking sheet
12. Leave several inches between each cookie as they will need room to expand
13. Bake for about 10-12 minutes
14. Remove from oven , cool cookies on the sheet
15. Remove the cookies after 1 minute and cool on wire rack

title: tilapia and bayou rice
steps:
1. Cook rice according to pkg directions , omitting any salt or fat
2. Meanwhile , sprinkle tilapia with cajun seasoning
3. Spray with cooking spray
4. Heat large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat until hot
5. Cook tilapia 5-6 minutes until just begins to flake , turning once
6. Stir all remaining ingredients except lemon into rice
7. Place tilapia on rice
8. Serve with lemon wedges

title: brandy cream chicken livers
steps:
1. Wash and trim the chicken livers
2. Pat dry on paper towels
3. In a baggie , combine the flour , cayenne pepper and mustard powder
4. Season with sea salt and crushed black pepper
5. Add the chicken livers to the baggie and shake to coat
6. Melt the butter in a frying pan and add the sliced mushrooms
7. Saute until golden
8. Brush the ciabatta with olive oil , season with a little pepper and pop under a grill to brown
9. Add the finely chopped garlic and floured chicken livers to the pan and saute for a couple of minutes until the outside of the livers are very lightly browned
10. Pour the brandy into the pan and allow to heat up for a couple of seconds before setting alight
11. Toss the livers around in the pan until the flames die out and allow the brandy to reduce a little
12. Add the cream and stir until the livers are done to your taste
13. If you'd like the sauce thinner , simply add a little more cream
14. Cut the browned ciabatta in half and put on a heat-proof plate
15. Turn the chicken livers out on top of the ciabatta
16. Crumble the cheese on top of the livers and pop under a hot grill until the cheese melts
17. Garnish with a little chopped flat-leaf parsley and serve

title: sauteed zucchini  cherry tomatoes  olives and basil
steps:
1. Heat oil in large skilled over medium-high heat
2. Add zucchini , garlic , and rosemary
3. Sprinkle with salt and pepper
4. Saute until zucchini is just tender , about 5 minutes
5. Add tomatoes and olives
6. Saute until tomatoes just begin to soften , about 2 minutes
7. Mix in basil and vinegar
8. Season vegetables to taste with salt and pepper

title: lazy day casserole   spam  r
steps:
1. Cook spinach according to package directions
2. Drain well
3. Spread spinach over bottom of lightly greased 13x9-inch baking dish
4. Cook noodles according to package directions
5. Drain
6. While noodles are cooking melt butter in medium saucepan
7. Blend in flour until smooth
8. Add milk , salt , and pepper
9. Cook and stir over medium heat until mixture thickens and boils
10. Stir a little hot mixture into sour cream
11. Return to pan
12. Add spam and peas or mixed vegetables
13. Combine sauce and noodles
14. Pour over spinach
15. Sprinkle with paprika
16. Cover and bake in 375f oven 20 minutes
17. Uncover and bake 20 minutes longer

title: squash and zucchini cakes  paula deen recipe
steps:
1. Grate zucchini and squash with a fine grater
2. Press between paper towels to remove excess moisture
3. In a medium bowl , combine grated zucchini and squash and the next 7 ingredients
4. Shape mixture into 2 inch patties , pressing together firmly
5. In a large skillet , melt butter over medium heat
6. Cook squash and zucchini cakes 3 to 4 minutes per side , or until lightly browned

title: sopapilla breakfast delight
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. In the microwave or saucepan , melt 1 / 4 cup of butter
3. Place in the bottom of a 13 x 9 inch baking pan
4. Place one tube of crescent rolls over the butter and press together to close the seams
5. Blend both packages of cream cheese with one cup sugar and spread over crescent rolls
6. Layer the other package of cresent rolls over the cream cheese , closing the seams
7. Melt the remaining 1 / 2 cup of butter and stir in the remaining 1 / 2 cup sugar
8. Spread over the the top of the crescent rolls
9. Sprinkle generously with cinnamon
10. Bake for 45 minutes and let cool slightly and serve warm

title: ediets lunch   turkey   cheese sandwich w  low calorie chips
steps:
1. Prepare sandwich
2. Eat with chips & grapes on the side

title: jq   bbq sauce
steps: 1. Mix well and store in regrigerator

title: southern living s cream cheese banana bread
steps:
1. Beat butter and cream cheese at medium speed with an electric mixer until creamy
2. Gradually add sugar , beating until light and fluffy
3. Add eggs , 1 at a time , beating just until blended after each addition
4. Combine flour and next 3 ingredients
5. Gradually add to butter mixture , beating at low speed just until blended
6. Stir in bananas , pecans , and vanilla
7. Spoon batter into 2 greased and floured 8- x 4-inch loafpans
8. Bake at 350 for 1 hour or until a long wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean and sides pull away from pan , shielding with aluminum foil last 15 minutes to prevent browning , if necessary
9. Cool bread in pans on wire racks 10 minutes
10. Remove from pans , and cool 30 minutes on wire racks before slicing

title: middle eastern salad with za atar dressing
steps:
1. Mix all the ingredients together for the dressing in a small glass bowl
2. Mix the vegetables together in a larger bowl
3. Pour the dressing over the salad
4. Stir to coat then refrigerate for 30 minutes before serving

title: red cake
steps:
1. For the cake , first sift together the dry ingredients in a medium bowl
2. In large bowl , cream together shortening , sugar , eggs , and vanilla
3. Dissolve baking soda and vinegar in buttermilk
4. In three additions each , add the buttermilk mixture and the dry mixture to the shortening mixture , alternating
5. Stir in red food coloring
6. Pour into a greased and floured 9x13 pan or two layer cake pans
7. Bake at 350 for 25 minutes
8. Cool completely
9. For the frosting , cook the milk and flour in a small saucepan over medium heat
10. Cook until thicker than gravy
11. Cool
12. Beat together margarine , shortening , and vanilla
13. Mix in the flour mixture
14. Beat in enough powdered sugar to make a good spreading consistency and desired sweetness

title: down east corn bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425f grease a 9x9 inche metal baking pan
2. In large bowl , combine first 6 ingredients
3. In medium bowl , whisk buttermilk , oil , and egg until blended
4. Stir into cornmeal mixture just until moistened
5. Pour batter into prepared pan
6. Bake 20-25 minutes or until golden and toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
7. Cut cornbread into 9 squares

title: coffee bars with coffee glaze
steps:
1. Cream the margarine , brown sugar and eggs until light and fluffy
2. Sift the dry ingredients and add to above until incorporated
3. Slowly add the hot coffee
4. Pour batter into a greased and floured jelly roll pan and bake for 20 minutes at 350
5. Remove from oven and top with the glaze while cake is still warm
6. To make glaze melt butter in a small saucepan and stir in the powdered sugar and coffee
7. Mixing with a wire whisk until smooth
8. Spread over the warm bars while the glaze is hot

title: spicy baked sweet potato fries
steps:
1. Preheat over to 425
2. Combine oil , taco seasoning , cayenne pepper and sweet potatoes in a large bowl
3. Toss until the fries are evenly coated
4. Spread the fries out in a single layer on a baking sheet
5. Bake for 30 minute or until crispy and brown on one side
6. Turn the fries over using a spatula , and cook for another 30 minute or until they are all crispy on the outside and tender inside
7. Thinner fries may not take as long

title: apple  cranberry  currant pie w  lemon nutmeg crust
steps:
1. Crust: combine flour , sugar , salt , zest , nutmeg & butter in food processor
2. Blend until mixture resembles coarse meal
3. Add lemon juice as a stream with motor on & process until moist clumps form
4. Gather dough into 2 balls , flatten into disks
5. Wrap each disc in wax paper and refrigerate for at least 30 minute
6. Position oven rack in lowest third of oven & preheat to 400f roll out 1 disc of dough to 12 inch round and place in 9 in pie dish
7. Trim to leave 1 / 2 inch overhang
8. Pie filling: combine all ingredients and spoon into crust
9. Roll out 2nd dough disk to 12-inch round and place atop pie filling
10. Crimp edges decoratively
11. Cut several slits to allow steam to escape
12. Sprinkle w / remaining sugar
13. Bake until crust is golden brown , apples are tender and juices bubble thickly , about 1 hour and 10 minutes
14. Cool 20 minutes before serving

title: colored marbles  bars
steps:
1. Cook sugar , eggs , and butter until butter is melted and sugar dissolved
2. Cool and add remaining ingredients
3. Mix and pat into 9x13 pan

title: texas bbq sweet hot chili
steps:
1. Saut onion in a little bit of oil
2. Add ground beef and minced garlic
3. Dust with dill , chili powder , cumin and red pepper flakes
4. Mix and cook covered over medium heat , stirring occasionally , until beef is cooked through
5. Drain fat
6. Add tomatoes , tomato paste and beans
7. Add picante sauce , barbecue sauce , diced green chilies
8. Add any additional chili powder and / or red pepper flakes
9. Bring to a low boil , reduce heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes or more
10. I have let this simmer for up to 2 hours and the longer it sits , the yummier it gets
11. It's great the next day , and the day after , too !
12. Serve with sour cream and shredded cheese on top
13. Eat with the frito scoops if you are feeling adventurous enough to dig in without a spoon
14. Optional - make a box of mac 'n cheese and ring your chili bowl with it before spooning in the chili
15. Delectable !

title: creamy mushroom   pepper    cheese quesadillas
steps:
1. Heat oil in large skillet over medium-high heat
2. Add garlic , onion , bell peppers , mushrooms , jalapeos , salt and pepper
3. Cook , stirring occasionally , 7-9 minutes or until the vegetables are soft
4. Transfer to bowl and cool
5. Stir mayonnaise into cooled mushrooms
6. Place tortillas on work surface
7. Sprinkle with cheese and top with mushroom mixture
8. Fold each in half to form a semi-circle
9. Wipe out skillet and return to stove over medium heat
10. When hot , add quesadillas 2 at a time to skillet
11. Cook 1-2 minutes per side or until lightly golden and cheese melts
12. Repeat with remaining quesadillas and serve immediately
13. Optional: you can heat in microwave oven if you don`t want your tortillas crispy !

title: potato  spinach and goat cheese eggrolls with sundried tomato
steps:
1. Cook bacon , reserve 1 tbls dripppings for dip , use the rest of the drippings to saute potatoes for about 5 minutes
2. Put potatoes , drained of excess grease , into a bowl
3. Stir in spinach , red peepper , bacon , onions , goat cheese , greek seasoning and salt
4. Let that cool while you mix together the dip
5. In a food processor , put the dip ingredients in and pulse , about 2 minutes , until you get a nice creamy mixture
6. Refrigerate until your ready to use
7. Heat oil to 350
8. While that is heating take out your wrappers
9. Take a wrapper , lightly wet the outer edges of wrapper with water so that the wrappers will stick together when rolled , and put 1 / 2 cup of potato mixture in it and roll according to the directions on the package
10. Put aside until all the eggrolls are filled
11. Fry eggrolls for approx 5 minutes or until golden brown
12. Let them drain and rest on a paper towel until all the eggrolls are cooked
13. Do not overcrowd eggrolls in the oil
14. I have a fry daddy and it usually fits 4 to 5 at a time
15. Serve cut on a diagonal with your dip

title: amaretto nut bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Beat egg whites until soft peaks form
3. Add 1 cup sugar gradually and beat until it holds stiff peaks
4. Set aside
5. Cream butter with remaining sugar
6. Add egg yolks , one at a time , beating well after each addition
7. Add flour in thirds , alternating with amaretto
8. Mix well
9. Stir in vanilla and nuts
10. Fold in egg whites gently
11. Pour batter into 3 well greased 8x4 inch loaf pans
12. Bake for 1 hour or until done

title: ham and cheese omelet
steps:
1. Whisk eggs with milk and salt and pepper
2. Set aside
3. Heat large nonstick frying pan with nonstick cooking spray over medium high heat
4. Add egg mixture and cook without stirring until only a tiny bit of egg is still wet
5. Place 2 cheese slices on half of the omelet
6. Sprinkle ham over the cheese and top with other 2 slices cheese
7. Carefully fold over one side of omelet on top of other
8. Slide out of pan onto plate

title: cornflake macaroons
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Cream the butter with the brown and white sugars
3. Add the eggs and vanilla and beat well
4. Mix in the flour until well combined
5. Stir in the corn flakes and the coconut
6. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto a parchment lined baking sheet
7. Bake at 375f for 8 to 10 minutes

title: unsloppy joes  easy vegetarian sloppy joes
steps:
1. Heat olive oil in a large skillet
2. Add onion , celery , carrot , green pepper , and garlic
3. Saute until tender
4. Stir in tomatoes and next 4 ingredients
5. Cover , reeuce heat , and simmer 10 minutes
6. Add kidney beans and cook an additional 5 minutes
7. If using kaiser rolls: cut a 1 / 4" slice off the top of each kaiser rolls
8. Set aside
9. Hollow out the center of each roll , leaving 1 / 2-in think shell
10. Reserve the inside of rolls for other uses
11. Spoon bean mixture evenly into rolls and replace tops
12. Serve immiediately
13. If using "hamburger" buns:
14. Just spoon onto buns and serve

title: chocolate raspberry ruffle cake
steps:
1. First of all: these are not typical directions , but you need to know about needed equipment before attempting this cake
2. Here it is:
3. 8-inch round cake pan , at least 2 inches high
4. 8-inch round cake pan with removable bottom or 8-inch springform pan
5. Untreated heavy-duty jelly-roll pans
6. Rubber spatula , offset spatula , and flexible 8-inch metal icing spatula
7. Decorating turntable , lazy susan , or inverted round cake pan
8. Ridged plastic shelf liner , freezer paper , or 055 mylar
9. Parchment paper and waxed paper
10. Making the cake:
11. Position a rack in the lower third of the oven or just below the center of the oven and preheat the oven to 350f fit the bottom of an 8-inch round cake pan , one at least 2 inches high , with parchment paper and set aside
12. Pour the clarified butter into a 1-quart bowl and stir in the vanilla extract , if you're using it
13. The butter must be hot when added to the batter , so either keep the bowl in a skillet of hot water or reheat at the last minute
14. Although the flour and cocoa were sifted before they were measured , they need to be triple-sifted together
15. Sift or sieve the flour and cocoa together 3 times , then set sifter on a plate or piece of waxed paper and return the dry ingredients to the sifter
16. Keep close at hand
17. Whisk the eggs and sugar together in a large heatproof bowl or the bowl of a heavy-duty mixer
18. Set the bowl over direct heat or in a pan of barely simmering water and heat the eggs , whisking constantly , until they are warm to the touch
19. Remove the bowl from the heat and , working with a heavy-duty mixer fitted with the whisk attachment , beat the eggs at high speed until they are cool , have tripled in volume , and hold a ribbon when the whisk is lifted
20. Sift one third of the dry ingredients over the eggs and , using a large rubber spatula , fold in gently but thoroughly
21. When the color of the batter is almost uniform , fold in the rest of the flour-cocoa mixture
22. Spoon about 1 cup of the batter into the hot clarified butter add fold together until well blended
23. Spoon this over the batter and , using the large rubber spatula , gently fold into the batter
24. Spoon the batter into the pan: there's no need to smooth the top or rap the pan on the counter , as is sometimes done with foam-based cakes
25. Bake the cake for 25-30 minutes , or until top of the cake springs back when pressed gently
26. Transfer the pan to a rack and let the cake cool in the pan
27. When the cake is completely cool , run a small knife around the sides of the pan to release the cake and unmold onto a rack
28. Invert right side up onto a piece of parchment paper
29. Preparing the chocolate:
30. The chocolate is going to be spread and then scraped into ruffles from four baking pans
31. If you don't have enough pans , you can make the ruffles in 2 batches
32. Choose heavy-duty jelly-roll pans that are neither warped nor dented , neither nonstick non treated with special coatings
33. Keep them close at hand
34. Melt the chocolate in a heatproof bowl set in a skillet of barely simmering water , in the top of a double boiler over an inch of simmering water , or in a microwave oven sat at medium power
35. Stir the chocolate regularly until it is fully melted
36. Smooth , and 115f to 120f
37. Hold the bottom of one of the baking sheets over a burner and , moving it back and forth , heat it until it is warm but not hot enough to burn your fingers
38. Put the baking pan upside down on a flat surface and pour on about 1 / 3 cup of the chocolate
39. Use an offset spatula to spread the chocolate thinly and evenly over the bottom of the baking pan: the chocolate will only be about 1 / 16 inch thick
40. Refrigerate the pan for at least 30 minutes , or for as long as several hours , depending on your schedule
41. Repeat with rest of the chocolate and the other baking pans
42. Making the ruffles:
43. To shape the ruffles , work with one baking pan of chocolate at a time
44. Remove a pan of chocolate from the refrigerator and leave it at room temperature to warm gradually until it is pliable enough to be scraped
45. Place the baking pan on a counter in front of you , a short side braced against your body
46. Hold the end of the blade of a then , flexible 8-inch metal icing spatula in your left hand and , with your right hand , grab the blade close to the handle
47. You should have 4 to 5 inches of blade exposed and available for ruffling
48. Using the top left corner of the pan as your staring point and imagining that corner of the pan as 12 o'clock , position your left hand in that corner , and your right at 2 o'clock
49. Press the edge of the blade against the chocolate at a very shallow angle , as if you were going to slide the spatula blade under the chocolate
50. Now slide the blade forward , moving your right hand down to 5 o'clock and then pivoting the blade to the left , all the way to the edge of the pan
51. As your right hand is moving down , so is your left , although not as far - your left hand will move down 4 to 5 inches
52. This is an important point - if you don't move your left hand down , you'll end up with tight curls of chocolate rather than ruffles
53. As you scrape and ruffle the chocolate against the blade and then make the pivot , the chocolate will gather against the blade -- use your left hand to pinch the chocolate so that the ruffles form a fan and the pinched part is a little handle
54. You've completed one ruffle
55. As you make each ruffle , place it on a parchment or waxed paper-lined baking sheet and refrigerate
56. When the ruffles harden , you can layer them between sheets of waxed paper
57. Make 2 more ruffles across the top of the pan , using the previously scraped area as your guide -- the left-hand corner of chocolate will be your 12 o'clock point and the cleaned-off section of the pan your edge , or end point
58. Make the next three ruffles just below
59. Then turn the pan around to get to the chocolate on the bottom and make three more
60. With practice -- and ruffling takes lots of practice -- you'll get 9 ruffles from each pan
61. Don't worry if you get fewer at the start
62. If , as sometimes happens , your ruffles crack or you get rolls of chocolate , not ruffles , it might be because the chocolate is too cold -- give it a few more minutes at room temperature before you try again
63. If the chocolate melts and gets gooey next to the spatula , it's too soft and needs a minute or two more in the refrigerator
64. When the temperature is just right -- smooth and pliable -- but you still can't get a nicely fanned ruffle , angle the blade differently as you scrape
65. For the syrup:
66. Bring the water and sugar to the boil in a small saucepan , stirring to dissolve the sugar , and simmer for 2 to 3 minutes
67. Remove from the heat and cool
68. Add 1 / 4 cup of the eau-de-vie
69. Taste the syrup and decide if you'd like a little more of the liqueur
70. Set aside
71. For filling and wrap
72. Beat the creme fraiche with the vanilla extract to soft peaks , then add 2 tbsp of the sugar , beating until thickened
73. Taste and add more sugar if you want it , then continue to beat until the cream just begins to stiffen
74. Cover and keep refrigerated until needed
75. Assembling the cake -- cut the cooled genoise into 3 even layers with a long serrated knife
76. Fit one layer into the bottom of a high-sided 8-inch round cake pan with a removable bottom or an 8-inch springform pan and brush the layer with syrup
77. Place the chopped chocolate in a small bowl and whisk in the boiling water until the chocolate is fully melted and smooth
78. Switch to a rubber spatula and folds 1 / 4 cup of the creme fraiche into the chocolate
79. Fold in another cup of the creme fraiche and then quickly , before it hardens , spread the chocolate creme fraiche evenly over the genoise layer in the pan
80. Moisten the second layer of genoise with syrup and set it , moistened side down , in the pan , pressing gently to level it on the chocolate creme fraiche
81. Moisten the top of the layer with some of the syrup and top with an even layer of fresh raspberries , leaving just a bit of space between each berry
82. Keep 1 perfect berry in reserve
83. Beat the remaining creme fraiche until it holds its shape
84. Spoon 1 to 2 cups of the creme fraiche over the berries and , using an offset spatula , delicately smooth the creme fraiche over and between the berries
85. Moisten the remaining layer of genoise with syrup and set it , moistened side down , into the pan , again pressing lightly to set it in place
86. Chilling the cake -- cover the cake and the remaining creme fraiche with plastic and refrigerate for at least 2 to 3 hours , or up to 24 hours
87. Run a knife around the sides of the cake , then release and remove the pan or the ring of the springform pan
88. Put the cake , still on its pan bottom , on a large piece of parchment paper and set the cake on a decorating turntable , a lazy susan , or a large inverted cake pan
89. Making the wrap -- using ridged plastic shelf liner , freezer paper , or 500 mylar , cut a strip 26 inches long and 3 / 8 inch wider than the height of the finished cake , about 3 inches
90. Place a larger piece of waxed paper on the counter in front of you --this is your drip sheet -- and put the strip on the waxed paper
91. Melt the chocolate in the top of a double boiler set over an inch of barely simmering water or in a microwave oven set at medium power , stirring chocolate once or twice until melted and smooth
92. The chocolate should be between 115f to 120f pour the chocolate down the center of the strip , spreading it with an offset spatula across the entire strip and beyond -- let it run over a bit onto the waxed paper
93. Slip the point of a small knife under one edge of the chocolate-coated strip and grab the edges of the strip with your fingers
94. Slide your free hand under the strip and grab the other end
95. Lift the strip and fit it neatly around the cake , positioning it so that the chocolate side is against the cake
96. Press one end against the cake and leave the other end standing away from the cake at the point where it would overlap if you pressed it closed
97. Slip a small piece of waxed paper into this spot , just to hold your place
98. Assembly and finishing
99. Chilling the wrapped cake -- refrigerate the cake of at least 1 hour , until the chocolate hardens
100. Finishing the wrapped cake -- place the cake on the decorating turntable and spread the remained creme fraiche over the top , spreading it out to the edge of the band
101. Remove the chocolate ruffles from the refrigerator and , beginning at the outside edge , arrange the ruffles in a circle , planting them gently in the creme fraiche and allowing their frilly edges to extend beyond the cake's rim
102. Continue to arrange the ruffles in slightly overlapping concentric circles until the creme fraiche is covered
103. Put the reserved perfect raspberry in the center of the cake and chill the cake for about 15 minutes , until firm , before removing the plastic and serving
104. To remove the plastic on the chocolate band , discard the waxed paper "place keeper" and peel away an inch of the plastic from the end of the band attached to the cake
105. Put a dollop of melted chocolate on that end to act as glue and overlap the other end of the band , pressing lightly to seal it
106. Carefully remove the plastic
107. If the plastic sticks , put the cake back in the refrigerator for about 10 minutes , then try again
108. To cut the cake , dip a long sharp serrated knife into hot water , wipe it dry , and cut straight down
109. Since the first piece is often difficult to remove , it's best to make it a generous , easier-to-remove slice
110. Storing -- although the parts of the cake can be made well in advance , the assembled cake should be served the day it is made

title: salmon miso yaki  weight watcher friendly   7 points

title: yummy no bake cookies
steps:
1. Bring sugar , margarine and corn syrup to a boil

steps:
1. Lightly grease 18 regular-size muffin cups

3. Prepare cake mix as directed , except use 4 eggs instead of 3
4. Add pureed spinach and beets to cake mix

6. Bake 22-25 minutes at 350 degrees f , or until a toothpick comes out clean
7. Cool completely before frosting with vanilla or chocolate frosting

title: electric iced tea
steps:
1. Fill a highball glass with ice
2. Add vodka , gin , rum , triple sec or cointreau and the sweet and sour mix , in that order
3. Add enough cola to almost reach the top of the glass
4. Garnish with a slice of lime or lemon

title: summer fruits with lime cooler
steps:
1. In small bowl stir together all dressing ingredients , set aside
2. In large bowl or individual fruit bowls toss together fruits
3. Serve dressing over fruit

title: cheddar cornmeal icebox crackers
steps:
1. Combine flour , cornmeal , salt , cayenne , and nutmeg in the bowl of a food processor

steps:
1. Arrange tomatoes , cut side up , on rimmed baking sheet
2. Sprinkle with salt and pepper , then 1 1 / 2 tablespoons each oregano and thyme leaves

steps:

steps:

4. Cover dish and bake at 315f for 2 hours or until lamb is very tender
5. Serve in deep bowls
6. Lovely with a garlic / potato mash

title: aussie christmas rum balls
steps:
1. Mix together well in a bowl
2. Cover in the fridge for hour
3. Shape into balls and roll in coconut or chocolate sprinkles

title: delicious meatloaf with vegetables
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees
2. In a large skillet melt butter
3. Saute the onions , green onion , garlic , chopped celery and carrots over medium heat , stirring for until the carrots are fork-tender
4. Season with seasoning salt and pepper
5. Add in worcestershire sauce and 1 / 2 cup ketchup
6. Cook stirring 2 minutes

title: spicy african chicken peanut soup
steps:
1. In a large dutch oven or soup pot , heat the sesame oil
2. Add chicken , onion , and garlic , sauteeing over medium heat until chicken pieces turn opaque
3. Add curry powder , salt , pepper , red pepper flakes , chicken broth , tomato paste , stewed onions and peanut butter
4. Heat through , but don't boil
5. Serve hot

steps:
1. Blend together the flour , sour cream and pepper , and set aside
2. In a large saute pan , saute garlic and shallots in olive oil 2-3 minutes until soft but not brown
3. Add the sliced mushrooms and saute stirring occasionally about 5-10 minutes until the mushrooms have given up their liquid
4. Add the sour cream mixture and just heat through until bubbly
5. Turn this mixture into a shallow baking dish or pie plate
6. Sprinkle with the parmesan cheese and then the parsley
7. Bake in a 425f oven about ten minutes , or until the parmesan is melted and the mixture is bubbly

title: microwave cooked corned beef
steps:
1. Place orange , onion , cloves , thyme and ginger ale into a large microwave proof casserole dish
2. Cook on high for 10 minutes
3. Add meat and cook on low for 1 to 2 hours

steps:
1. Cut pork and chicken into strips
2. Have 2 bowls ready and put half the cornflour , peanut oil and soy sauce in each bowl and mix well , place chicken strips in one and pork strips in the other , leave to marinate for 30 minutes

9. Combine cornflour and extra water together and stir into the lemon sauce and bring to the boil and let thicken
10. Stir in cooked pork and chicken and let warm through
11. Garnish with spring onion
12. Serve with rice and stir fry vegetables

steps:

16. Reheat syrup before serving
17. Serve french toast with syrup

title: smoked chicken  pecan and craisin salad
steps:
1. Combine the mustard , vinegar and oil- mis well
2. Combine the dressing with the remaining ingredients in a large bowl
3. Serve onto 4 plates

title: aunt frances  cheese ball
steps:

8. Cover and bake at 325 for 1 to 1-1 / 4 hours or until juices run clear , basting occasionally

title: gingerbread ornaments
steps:
1. Cream butter with sugars , molasses and egg yolk

5. Use christmas cookie cutters or knife to cut our shapes

title: honey soy chicken wings w  bok choy
steps:
1. Mix all the marinade ingredients together in a bowl and pour over chicken wings

1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees

steps:
1. For chicken:
2. In a shallow baking dish or pie plate combine coconut and bread crumbs

5. Dip chicken strips into beaten eggs , then dip in seasoned flour

1. In a deep skillet , combine vinegar , honey and broth with a whisk

4. Add to broth mixture and season with celery salt and pepper

1. Adjust oven rack to upper-middle position , and heat oven to 350 degrees

steps:
1. Melt butter in a large kettle or stock pot over medium heat
2. Add onions and celery , saute until clear
3. Add garlic and saute 1 minute stir in flour and cook over low heat , stirring frequently , for 2 to 4 minutes
4. Set aside to cool
5. In a separate pot , bring clams and clam juice to a boil
6. Reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes
7. In a saucepan , cover peeled potatoes with water
8. Bring to a boil and cook until potatoes are tender , about 15 minutes
9. Drain and set aside
10. Slowly pour hot clam stock into butter / flour mixture while stirring constantly
11. Add chichen broth continue stirring and slowly bring to a boil
12. Reduce heat and add cooked potatoes
13. Mix in half and half , salt and pepper and chopped dill
14. Heat through but do not boil
15. Serve with garnish of scallion tops

title: buffalo chicken quesadillas
steps:
1. Mix hot pepper sauce with melted butter and toss with chicken
2. Layer chicken mixture and cheese on 4 tortillas , dividing evenly
3. Cover with a top tortilla
4. In a grill pan or non stick skillet , cook each one for 3 to 5 minutes until toasted and cheese melts
5. Cut into quarters to serve
6. Serve with blue cheese dressing , if desired

title: green beans in garlic butter
steps:
1. Add chicken broth , salt and pepper to a
2. Stock pot
3. Bring to a boil
4. Add greenbeans
5. Heat until tender , stirring often
6. Drain
7. Place in a serving bowl
8. Saute' garlic in butter in a small skillet until golden
9. Pour over green beans
10. Tossing gently to coat
11. Serve warm

title: low carb turkey wraps
steps:
1. Lay the lettuce leaf flat on a plate
2. Place one slice of turkey
3. Spread with pesto
4. Top with 1 / 2 of the red pepper slices
5. Roll up
6. Repeat with second piece of lettuce and turkey

title: caribbean coleslaw with orange mango dressing
steps:
1. Prepare orange-mango dressing
2. Place mango in food processor
3. Process until smooth
4. Add remaining ingredients for the dressing and process until smooth
5. Set aside
6. Combine cabbage , mangoes , bell peppers , green onions and cilantro in a large bowl
7. Stir gently to mix evenly
8. Pour in orange-mango dressing
9. Toss gently to coat
10. Serve , or store in refrigerator up to 1 day

title: chocolate cabernet sauvignon tart
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Place cookie crumbs in a bowl , pour melted butter over crumbs and mix to incorporate
3. Press cookie crumb mixture into the bottom of a springform pan
4. Bake crust for 10 min or until firm
5. Cool crust completely on wire rack
6. While crust is cooling , place bittersweet chocolate in medium bowl and set aside
7. In smallheavy saucepan , whisk together the cream , wine , sour cream and sugar
8. Cook cream mixture over medium heat , whisking constantly until sugar is dissolved and mixture begins to bubble around the edges
9. Pour hot cream over chopped chocolate and let mixture stand for 30 seconds to melt the chocolate
10. Gently whick til smooth
11. Scrape the filling into the cookie crust and spread evenly with a spatula
12. Refrigerate at least 4 hours
13. Enjoy

title: loretta lynn s crispy fried chicken
steps:
1. Combine all seasoned flour mixand set aside
2. Combine batter ingredients
3. Heat crisco to 365f
4. Moisten chicken pieces
5. Dip in seasoned flour , then batter , then back in seasoned flour
6. Fry for 15 to 18 minutes or until well browned
7. Drain on paper towels

title: the best thai coconut soup
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a large pot over medium heat
2. Cook and stir the ginger , lemon grass , and curry paste in the heated oil for 1 minute
3. Slowly pour the chicken broth over the mixture , stirring continually
4. Stir in the fish sauce and brown sugar
5. Simmer for 15 minutes
6. Stir in the coconut milk and mushrooms
7. Cook and simmer until the mushrooms are soft , about 5 minutes
8. Add the shrimp
9. Cook until no longer translucent about 5 minutes
10. Stir in the lime juice
11. Season with salt
12. Garnish with cilantro

title: blueberry pie filling coffee cake with spice topping
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease a 10-inch sprinform pan
3. In a large bowl cream butter with sugar until fluffy
4. Add in eggs and vanilla
5. Beat until well combined
6. In a small bowl mix together flour , baking powder , salt and cinnamon
7. Add to the creamed mixture alternatley with warm milk
8. Spread 2 / 3 of batter into the pan , then dollup tablespoonfuls of the pie filling all over top of the batter
9. Dollup the remaining batter on top of the pie filling
10. In a small bowl mix together the topping ingredients with your fingers , then sprinkle on top of cake
11. Bake for about 45-50 minutes or until the cake tests done

title: the best crock pot barbecue ribs
steps:
1. Cut ribs apart , if necessary and trim
2. Sprinkle 1 teaspoon salt evenly over ribs , and set aside
3. In a medium to large bowl , stir together remaining 1 teaspoon salt , and remaining ingredients until blended
4. Pour half of mixture into a 5-quart slow cooker
5. Place ribs in slow cooker and pour remaining mixture over ribs
6. Cover and cook on high 6 to 7 hours

title: hot pepper chicken marinade
steps:
1. Remove seeds from hot chili peppers and finely chop peppers
2. Combine peppers and remaining marinade ingredients in a small bowl
3. Cover and refrigerate for 2 days to allow the flavours to blend
4. Makes enough marinade for 8 boneless skinless chicken breasts
5. Put chicken breasts in a closable plastic bag and pour in the marinade
6. Seal bag and marinate overnight in the refrigerator
7. Remove chicken from marinade and discard leftover marinade
8. Grill chicken over medium heat for 5-7 minutes per side
9. Makes 8 servings

title: quick   easy pork sausage
steps:
1. To make basic pork sausage recipe: place ground pork into a large bowl
2. Measure and distribute ingredient items evenly over pork
3. Wearing kitchen gloves , combine mixture using hands until thoroughly blended
4. Brown pork sausage in skillet , or cook according to recipe directions
5. To make variation sausage recipe: add specified additional ingredients before mixing
6. Brown in skillet , or cook according to recipe directions

title: sesame chicken for the crock pot oamc
steps:
1. Place chicken crock pot
2. In a bowl , combine soy sauce , brown sugar , garlic , and tomato sauce
3. Pour sauce over chicken
4. Cover and cook on low for about 5 hours or until chicken is tender
5. Remove to a plate and sprinkle with sesame seeds
6. To freeze: cool , bag , label and freeze
7. To serve: warm in microwave to desired temperature and top with the sesame seeds
8. Spread sesame seeds in a 9-inch pie or cake pan
9. Toast about 5 minutes or until golden
10. Or toast seeds in a dry skillet over low heat 3 or 4 minutes

title: peach skewers
steps:
1. Preheat grill or broiler
2. Slice peaches in half and remove pit
3. Cut each half into 3 slices
4. Mix allspice and splenda together and toss peach slices in mixture , making sure all of the slices are coated
5. Place slices on skewers and grill or broil 3 minutes , turn fruit over and grill or broil , serve warm

title: easy hash brown quiche
steps:
1. Press hash browns between paper towels to remove moisture
2. Add seasoning to hash browns
3. Grease a 9 inch pie plate with 2 tbsp butter
4. Press hash browns onto the bottom and up the sides of the dish
5. Drizzle with remaining butter
6. Bake uncovered at 425f for 20 to 25 minutes or until edges are brown
7. Combine cheese and ham
8. Spoon into crust
9. Beat eggs with cream and seasoning pour over ham and cheese
10. Reduce heat to 350f and bake uncovered for 20 to 25 minutes or until knife inserted comes out clean
11. Let stand for 10 minutes before cutting
12. Makes 4 to 6 servings

title: peanut butter oatmeal chocolate chunk cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Mix flour , oats , baking soda , baking powder and salt
3. Set aside
4. Beat sugars , butter and peanut butter in large bowl with electric mixer on medium speed until light and fluffy
5. Add egg and vanilla , mix well
6. Gradually add flour mixture , mixing until well blended after each addition
7. Stir in chopped chocolate
8. Drop heaping tablespoonfuls of dough , 2" apart , onto ungreased baking sheets
9. Bake 12-13 minutes or until lightly browned
10. Cool 1 minute
11. Remove from baking sheets to wire rackes
12. Cool completely

title: coconut curried vegetables   adapted from vij s
steps:
1. In large saucepan heat oil over medium heat for one minute and add curry leaves and mustard seeds
2. Wait until they start to sizzle and them sizzle for approximately 30 seconds or until a few start to pop
3. The curry leaves will cook and become shriveled
4. Immediately add garlic and onions
5. Saut until onions are golden brown
6. Add the tomatoes and the powdered spices
7. Continue to saut until the oil separates from the tomato masala
8. Add the coconut milk
9. Bring to a light boil , add eggplant , cover and simmer for 5 minutes
10. Add the remaining vegetables , cover the pan and cook to taste , approximately 15 minutes

title: chocolate cherry bread  bread machine
steps:
1. Place ingredients in bread machine pan in order suggested by manufacturer
2. Use regular , rapid or delayed time bake cycle

title: hot buttered bouquet  coffee
steps:
1. Put butter in an irish coffee glass or mug , then pour in the steaming coffee
2. Add brown sugar and stir until dissolved
3. Add clove and rum
4. Dust with nutmeg

title: lovely lentils  baby food
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan saute the onion , carrot , and celery in vegetable oil for 5 minutes or until softened
2. Add lentils and sweet potatoes and slowly add stock
3. Bring to a boil
4. Cover , reduce heat and simmer
5. Puree in a blender and portion out as desired
6. This recipe will make anywhere from 5-10 servings
7. Can be refrigerated for 1 week or frozen for 6 weeks

title: tangy tartar sauce  made with dill pickles  not sweet
steps: 1. Mix all ingredients together , and allow to stand for at least an hour

title: chicken baked with ginger and black pepper
steps:
1. In a large bowl combine lemon juice , salt , ginger , black pepper , coriander , cumin , paprika , cayenne and turmeric
2. Mix well
3. Add chicken pieces and toss to coat
4. Cover chicken and set a side in fridge a minimum of 3 hours , maximum of 24
5. Preheat oven to 200 degrees c , 400 degrees f , gas mark 6
6. Arrange chick npieces on a baking tray , skin side down
7. Brush with oil
8. Bake in centre of oven 20 minutes
9. Turn pieces over and cook a further 25 minutes until chicken is tender , basting 3-4 times
10. Transfer to a warmed serving plate

title: stuffed peppers style meatballs
steps:
1. Mix together ground beef , garlic , onion , green pepper , egg and bread crumbs
2. Form into one inch size balls
3. Add tomato juice to a large pot or skillet
4. Add meatballs to tomato juice
5. Cook over medium-low heat until meatballs are thoroughly cooked , about 30 minutes
6. Serve over cooked white rice

title: buttermilk pie in cornmeal pastry
steps:
1. For pastry: sift together flour and salt
2. Stir in cornmeal
3. Cut in shortening until mixture resembles fine crumbs
4. Stir in grated cheddar cheese
5. Sprinkle water over mixture gradually , mixing lightly with fork
6. Shape into ball
7. Flatten on lightly floured surface
8. Roll to about 1 / 8" thickness
9. Line 9" pie pan
10. Trim and flute edge
11. Fill and bake as directed below
12. For filling: separate 3 eggs and set whites aside for use in meringue
13. Beat yolks , adding sugar gradually
14. Cut butter into flour
15. Add buttermilk , lemon peel and juice
16. Fold in yolks
17. Pour into 9" cornmeal pie shell
18. Bake in hot oven 10 minutes
19. Reduce temperature to 350f and bake 20 to 25 minutes
20. Cool
21. To make meringue: beat 4-5 egg whites in a large bowl with electric mixer on high , until foamy
22. Gradually add sugar , beating until stiff peaks form
23. Pile meringue lightly over cooled butterrmilk filling
24. Bake in moderate oven 12 to 15 minutes

title: pecan maple loaf
steps:
1. Preheat oven , grease& line the base of a 9x5 loaf pan with baking / parchment paper
2. Sift flour and baking powder into a bowl
3. Cut butter into the flour and mix until the mixture looks like fine breadcrumbs
4. Add in the sugar and pecans
5. Beat eggs together with milk and lemon zest in a seperate bowl
6. Stir in maple syrup
7. Add this to the flour mixture and gently mix together
8. Do not overmix , only until all dry ingredients have become moist
9. The batter should be lumpy
10. Pour batter into pan and smooth out the surface of the batter
11. Bake in the oven for about 50-60 minutes or until cake is lightly browned
12. To make sure , insert a toothpick into the center of the cake and if it comes out clean then the cake is ready
13. Cool cake in pan for at least 10 minutes then turn out and let it cool on the rack
14. Sift the icing sugar into a small bowl and stir in the lemon juice to create a smooth icing
15. Drizzle over the loaf and then sprinkle the chopped pecans over the icing
16. Wait until the icing is set then slice

title: mango cucumber salsa
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together and let sit in fridge for an 30 minutes or more
2. This will keep one or two days if it lasts that long
3. I like to add the red pepper -- mostly for color
4. It just looks so lovely with the bright orange of the mango

title: malibu parilyzer
steps: 1. Mix together over ice and serve -- enjoy !

title: chilli con queso
steps:
1. In a medium sauce pan , melt butter over medium heat
2. Add onion , and heat until translucent
3. Continue cooking over medium heat , and mix in flour and whisk until smooth , and slightly browned
4. Gradually add milk while whisking continuously , so to incoprate the milk
5. Depending on your burner or the amount of flour you use , you may need anywhere between 1 / 2- 3 / 4 cup of milk
6. If after 2-3 minutes of cooking , the mixture is too thin add a little more flour , or vice versa if mixture appears very thick you can add more milk
7. It is best to start off with only 1 / 2 cup of liquids and use more as necessary
8. When milk is completely incoprated , and the mixture thickens add the cheese
9. Continue stirring until cheese is melted and the sauce is smooth
10. Remove from heat , spring with tomato and pepper and mix

title: ice pick
steps:
1. Mix vodka , sugar , and lemon juice in a tall glass
2. Add ice cubes , fill glass with iced tea , and stir

title: jealous marys
steps:
1. Pure all ingredients in a blender until very smooth , about 1 minute
2. Force through a fine-mesh sieve set into a bowl
3. Discard any solids
4. Serve over ice in small glasses

title: five spice pork roast for the crock pot
steps:
1. Rub roast with five spice powder
2. Sear roast in a skillet with hot oil before placing it in the cooker
3. Mix together and pour over roast: apple juice , wine and soy sauce
4. Cover and cook on low setting for 10 to 12 hours or on high setting for 4 1 / 2 to 5 hours
5. For gravy: strain cooking liquid
6. Skim off fat
7. Combine 2 cups of liquid with cornstarch and water
8. Cook until thick and bubbly
9. Serve over rice

title: zucchini  spaghetti
steps:
1. Heat a large skillet or roasting pan over medium heat
2. Add the olive oil and heat until the oil shimmers
3. Add the garlic and cook until light golden , about 5 minutes
4. Add the zucchini and cook for a few minutes without turning
5. Add salt and cook another 3 to 4 minutes , stirring occasionally , until barely tender
6. A mandolin is great for this

title: glazed pork loin roast
steps:
1. Make 4 slits in fat on pork roast with
2. Sprinkle roast with salt
3. Mix marmalade , mustard and thyme , spread on roast
4. Microwave instructions place roast in 16 x 10-inch cooking bag
5. Close bag loosely with string
6. Place roast on microwve roast- ing rack in oblong baking dish 12 x 7 12 x 2-inches
7. Microwave on medium-low 30 minutes
8. Turn roast over and turn dish one-half turn
9. Microwave until roast is done , 20 to 25 minutes
10. Let stand 10 minutes in bag in microwave
11. Serve with meat juices
12. Oven instructions preheat oven to 350 degrees
13. Put the pork loin which has been prepared with garlic and salt in a roasting pan
14. Bake at 20 minutes per pound or until a meat thermometer registers 160 degrees
15. Spread marmalade mixture on roast during last 15 minutes of cook time
16. Remove from oven and allow to rest for 10 minutes prior to slicing

title: awesome peanut butter cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325
2. In a mixing bowl beat peanut butter , sugars , and baking soda until combined
3. Beat in egg and vanilla until combined
4. Stir in flour and chocolate pieces with a wooden spoon
5. Shape dough into 1 1 / 4 in balls
6. Place dough on ungreased cookie sheet
7. Flatten slighly with fingers
8. Bake for about 10 min or until cookies are puffed and lightly browned around edges
9. Cool on cookie sheet for 5 minute transfer to wire wire rack
10. Cool completely

title: sangria bites
steps:
1. Pour the simple syrup into a small saucepan , sprinkle gelatin overtop and stir to combine
2. Let stand until gelatin softens , about 2 minutes
3. Place this mixture over low heat and stir , gently splashing around the sides of the pan until all of the gelatin has dissolved
4. Do not boil
5. Stir the wine and brandy into the gelatin mixture and stir slowly for 1 minute
6. Pour into an 8-inch glass baking dish and refrigerate for 2 hours or until very firmly set
7. Wash and dry the orange and remove 2 strips of rind using a vegetable peeler
8. Use the blade of a knife to scrape away all the white pith on the rind then slice into very thin strands , each about 12 inch long
9. Cut the set jelly into 34-inch cubes
10. Remove from the pan using a rubber spatula or an off-set palate knife
11. Garnish each cube with a few orange-peel slices before serving

title: weight watchers chocolate raspberry heart cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Coat an 8-inch-round disposable aluminum pan with cooking spray and sprinkle with flour
3. Bend sides of pan to form a heart shape
4. Mix together cake mix , water , egg substitute and 1 / 3 cup of jam with an electric mixer on low speed for 30 seconds
5. Change speed to high and mix for 2 minutes more
6. Pour into prepared pan and bake until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean , about 30 minutes
7. Cool on a wire rack for 10 minutes
8. Invert onto a plate and remove from pan
9. Place right side up on wire rack and allow to cool completely
10. Meanwhile , melt chocolate in a double boiler over simmering water
11. Allow to cool , then stir in remaining jam and half-and-half
12. Frost cake with chocolate mixture and outline perimeter of cake with raspberries

title: vera s apple pie in a jar
steps:
1. Combine everything but the apples and lemon juice
2. Cook until thick and bubbly
3. Add 3 tbs lemon juice
4. Pack apple slices tightly into quart jars and cover with syrup
5. Cold pack for 20 minutes to preserve or give to friends to use up within 2 weeks

title: the one spinach appetizer puff
steps:
1. Break egg into a bowl and beat with a whisk for 30 seconds
2. Add remaining ingredients and combine with a wooden spoon until well mixed
3. Let batter sit while greasing a mini-muffin pan and preheating oven to 375 degrees
4. Spoon batter into the mini-muffin pan to 3 / 4 full
5. Bake for 25-30 minutes or until puffed and golden brown
6. If you don't have a second pan , and you don't want to wait for the first batch to finish , use small foil tart cups for the last few , they may take a bit longer to cook
7. However , since these will disappear quickly , and they can be frozen , it is much easier to just double the recipe and just make 2 1 / 2 - 3 pans

title: baked shrimp in lemony garlic sauce
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees fahrenheit
2. Arange shrimp in a single layer in a 13 x 9 inch baking dish coated with cooking spray
3. Combine lemon juice with butter , garlic , worcestershire sauce , lemon pepper , and red pepper
4. Pour mixture over shrimp
5. Bake at 425 degrees fahrenheit for 8 to 10 minutes or until shrimp are done
6. Sprinkle parsley over shrimp
7. Serve immediately
8. Serving size is 3 ounces shrimp with 2 tablespoons sauce with 3 points per serving

title: split pea soup milano
steps:
1. Combine cubes , peas , water and salt and pepper
2. Bring to boil and simmer for 30 minutes
3. Stirring occasionally
4. Brown sausage , celery , onion , pepper and garlic , add to soup and add wine
5. Simmer for 15 minutes to blend flavors and top with parmesan cheese

title: turkish salad
steps: 1. Combine all ingredients in a bowl and chill for at least 1 hour before serving

title: thanksgiving leftover extraordinaire
steps:
1. Spread cranberry sauce on bottom of hoagie roll
2. Place turkey over that , then stuffing , then gravy
3. Eat with plenty of napkins !

title: cheddar macaroni and ham casserole
steps:
1. Cook macaroni in large saucepan for 8-10 minutes
2. Drain
3. Return to pan
4. Squeeze cheese sauce over hot macaroni
5. Stir until blended
6. Stir in ham , peas and milk
7. Spoon into a 2 quart baking dish and top with cheddar cheese
8. Mix crushed ritz crackers with melted butter
9. Sprinkle over casserole before baking
10. Bake at 400 degrees for 15 minutes or until heated through

title: sparkling apple punch
steps:
1. Combine apple cider , papaya nectar and ice in a punch bowl
2. Add papaya and orange slices

title: fancy macaroni   wisconsin style
steps:
1. Cook the macaroni and cheese according to the directions on the box , including mixing the milk , butter , and cheese mix all together
2. Add the cheeses , garlic , and spaghetti sauce to the macaroni and mix well
3. Dump the whole mixture into a deep casserole dish
4. Top with a little bit of parmesan cheese
5. Sprinkle italian spices on top of the casserole and sprinkle the breadcrumbs evenly over the top of the casserole
6. Bake at 400 degrees for about 10 minutes , or until the top is beginning to brown
7. Serve !

title: lady mom s pork loin
steps:
1. Mix together in a small bowl: garlic , lemon , mustard , soya sauce , water , beef granules , bay leaves , thyme , fennel and green onion
2. Pepper to your liking
3. Lay pork loin in a lightly greased crock pot
4. Pour mixture over top of tenderloin and lay the sliced onion over-top
5. Cook until no longer pink in middle , turning once

title: cherry tomato  white balsamic vinegar and basil salad
steps:
1. Slice tomatoes in half and put into a medium sized bowl
2. Sprinkle tomatoes with salt , dress with vinegar and oil and toss together
3. Cut basil leaves into chiffonade
4. Sprinkle basil over tomatoes , add pepper , toss and serve
5. The downside is that your basil can turn a little dark
6. I'd still say it is worth letting the salad mascerate for a couple hours--maybe adding basil leaves in an hour before serving

title: us army tamale pie 1940s 1950s
steps:
1. Sausage can be hot or mild
2. Combine all ingredients except corn meal , milk , and eggs in 5 or 6 quart pan
3. Cook over low heat for 10 minutes , stirring occasionally
4. Add corn meal , milk , and eggs
5. Cook an additional 15 minutes , stirring often , since it can stick
6. Pour into 2 greased baking dishes
7. Bake in 350 oven for about 30 minutes , until well set
8. Let sit for 5 minutes or so before cutting
9. Consistency should be just slightly less firm than cornbread

title: ham steak with apples   cranberries
steps:
1. In a measuring cup combine apple cider , brown sugar , lemon juice , dijon mustard , & cornstarch until smooth
2. In a large non-stick skillet heat butter over medium high heat
3. Brown ham on both sides
4. Set aside on plate & keep warm
5. Reduce heat to medium
6. Add liquid mixture , green onions , apple and cranberries
7. Cook and stir until sauce thickens
8. Return ham to skillet and cook for 1 -2 minutes or until heated through

title: peanut sauce vegetable stir fry with tofu
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine peanut butter , hot water , vinegar , soy sauce , and cayenne pepper
2. Heat oil in large skillet or wok over medium-high heat
3. Saut broccoli , pepper , mushrooms , and tofu for 5 minutes
4. Pour peanut sauce over vegetable-tofu mix
5. Simmer for 3-5 minutes , or until vegetables are tender and crisp
6. Serve over rice , and enjoy !

title: curried chicken bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180 degrees celsius lightly grease a 6-8 cup casserole dish
2. Heat oil over medium heat and brown the chicken
3. Remove from heat and cut into 3cm pieces
4. In a large saucepan melt butter and sautee onion for about 3 minutes
5. Stir in the flour and curry powder and cook for 1 minute until all combined
6. Remove from heat and stir in 1 1 / 4 cups milk gradually
7. Return to moderate heat and stir until thick
8. Add chicken pieces and capsicum to sauce and pour into the casserole dish
9. Combine eggs and extra 1 / 3 cup of extra milk and pour over dish
10. Top with grated cheese
11. Bake for 30 minutes or until golden brown and bubbling
12. Serve with rice or enjoy on its own

title: bacon wrapped parmesan breadsticks
steps:
1. Slice bacon s
2. Dredge in grated parmesan cheese
3. Wrap bacon , in spirals , around the breadsticks
4. Place on microwave safe paper towel on microwave safe tray , so that breadsticks are not touching
5. Cover with 2 layers of paper towels
6. Microwave on high for approximately 5 minutes
7. If not done , cook in 1 minute intervals until done

title: burgundian beef and beans
steps:
1. Trim the beef and cut into 2cm cubes
2. Heat half the oil in a heavy saucepan and brown the meat quickly in batches
3. Remove to a plate
4. Add the remaining oil with the onion , garlic and bacon and cook gently until the onion is soft
5. Add the carrot , celery , wine and tomato paste
6. Return the beef to the pan along with the bouquet garni
7. Season with a little salt and pepper to taste , cover and cook for 1 1 / 4 hours or until the meat is just tender
8. Drain the beans and add to the pan
9. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes
10. Serve with a nice crusty bread

title: lime  or lemon  mayonnaise
steps:
1. Combine egg yolks , mustard and half the lemon juice in a blender or food processor until light and creamy
2. With the blender still running , add the oil in a thin stream until the mixture thickens
3. Stir in remaining lemon juice
4. Stir in lime juice and the lime zest then season to taste

title: perfect pasta dough
steps:
1. Place the first 5 ingredients in a mixer using the paddle attachment
2. Gradually add the water until the dough begins to form a ball and is sticky
3. Remove and place on floured service
4. Kneed for 4-5 minutes incorporating enough additional flour into the dough until the tackiness is gone
5. Allow to sit for 15-20 minutes
6. Cut into 6 pieces , and flatten into a rectangular shape
7. Keep a dish towel over the other pieces to keep them from drying out
8. Run through the pasta machine at the widest setting 6-10 times until the dough is smooth
9. If one end is narrower than the other , fold the narrow end until the width evens a bit
10. To make linguine , i then begin narrowing the roller width step by step , sending the noodle though once on each setting , through the second thinnest setting
11. Place on a lightly floured baking sheet and cover with another towel
12. Repeat with the remaining pieces , slightly flouring in between noodles as you stack them
13. If the noodles are longer than your baking sheet , cut them in half with a pastry cutter
14. Allow the noodles to sit for 10 minutes before cutting them
15. It usually takes me longer than 10 minutes to roll the noodles , so i flip the noodles over and start cutting the first one rolled
16. Your sheets of noodles should no longer be tacky , and should process through the cutter without sticking
17. If the noodles are still sticky , you may want to flour them a bit before putting them through your cutter
18. Place noodles through desired cutter and lay on baking sheet to dry for 10-20 minutes before cooking
19. Dust each batch with a tiny bit of flour and separate them with your fingers to ensure they don't clump
20. Place in boiling , salted water and cook until they float to the top
21. 5 minutes or until your desired tenderness

title: fluffy coffee mousse
steps:
1. Heat the coffee and marshmallows in a small saucepan , stirring often until they are almost melted
2. Meanwhile , prepare an ice bath
3. Add the chocolate to the marshmallow mixture , remove from heat and keep stirring until it's smooth
4. Pour into a bowl and place on ice bath
5. Stir until cooled and beat with an electric mixer until frothy
6. In another bowl , beat evaporated milk until thickened and doubled in volume
7. Fold gently into marshmallow mixture
8. Divide into 6 custard or ice cream cups and refrigerate until set
9. Garnish with a dollop of whipped cream and more grated chocolate if desired

title: sensational coleslaw
steps:
1. Toss slaw ingredients well to mix
2. Measure first 6 dressing ingredients into a small mixing bowl , stirring to combine
3. Add cider vinegar
4. Stir until the liquid is absorbed and the dressing is a smooth texture
5. Store slaw and dressing separately in refrigerator
6. Shortly before serving , pour dressing over slaw ingredients and mix well
7. Can be mixed in smaller portions as needed , with leftover slaw and dressing stored separately for future use

title: no bake chocolate cheesecake
steps:
1. Melt the chocolate chips in a microwave or double boiler , stir till smooth
2. In a mixing bowl beat cream cheese and sugar add in melted chocolate and whipped topping at low speed
3. Pour into pie crust and cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours

title: danish potato salad
steps:
1. Boil the potatoes about 15 mniutes , drain and cool
2. Peel , if desired , and sliceinto 1 / 3" slices
3. Add to a bowl
4. Add chives , parsley and capers
5. Combine vinegar , caper liquid and mustard in a small bowl
6. Whisk in olive oil
7. Pour dressing over potatoes , toss , season with salt and pepper to taste
8. Serve at room temperature

title: mini mozzarella cheese scones
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 200c or around 400f
2. Cut a piece of parchment paper to fit a baking tray
3. Sift flour , salt , cayenne pepper and baking powder into a mixing bowl
4. Rub butter with finger
5. Mix grated cheese , paisley flakes and sugar into the flour mixture , mixture should have consistency which resemble "bread crumbs"
6. Make a well into the mixture and add milk , leaving a little bit to brush on the scones if you wish
7. Combine with a spatula or wooden spoon so that it becomes a dough , knead quickly and gently on a lightly floured board , pat dough out into approximately 2
8. 5cm thick and cut with a 4-5cm round cutter , into as many rounds as you can
9. I usually roll the last bits into balls , brush the top with a little milk and place on parchment paper on the tray and bake for about 10-12 minutes until tops are lightly browned
10. Remove from oven and place on cooling rack so as not to burn the bottom

title: peppermint mint chocolate chip cookies
steps:
1. Freeze mints , then crush into small chunks
2. Place back into freezer
3. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
4. Melt butter in saucepan over low heat
5. Sift together flour , baking soda , and salt
6. Set aside
7. Pour melted butter into the mixing bowl
8. Add sugar , brown sugar and cream on medium speed
9. Add egg , egg yolk , 2 tbsp milk , vanilla extract and peppermint extract
10. Slowly incorporate flour until thouroughly combined
11. Stir in andes' mint chunks
12. Chill dough , then scoop onto parchment paper , aprox
13. 6 cookies per sheet
14. Bake for 12-14 minutes , checking cookies after 5 minutes
15. Rotate the baking sheet to ensure even browning
16. Cool , and store in air tight container

title: stuffed steaks
steps:
1. In a non-stick pan , cook the bacon until crisp
2. Remove from the pan , when cool , crumble the bacon and set aside
3. In a skillet , melt the butter over high heat
4. Add the garlic and the onions , and sautee until soft , about 2-3 minutes
5. In a medium bowl , combine the feta cheese , crumbled bacon , and the sauteed onion and garlic
6. Mix well , and set aside
7. Season each steak with salt and pepper
8. Carefully cut a pocket in 1 side of each steak
9. Be careful not to cut all the way through
10. Stuff each steak with 1 / 4 of the cheese mixture
11. Broil or grill the steaks on high , for about 5-6 minutes per side for 1 inch thick steaks , 7-9 minutes per side if using 1 1 / 2 inch thick steaks , turning them over once during cooking
12. Remove the steaks from the heat , cover loosely with aluminum foil , and let sit for about 5 minutes
13. Remove the foil , and serve

title: grilled prawns italiano
steps:
1. Shell and de-vein the prawns , making sure you keep the tail intact
2. Wash well and keep aside
3. Mix together the olive oil , lemon juice , salt , peppercorns , basil leaves and rosemary to prepare a marinade
4. Thread prawns on satay sticks
5. Marinate them in the above marinade
6. Refrigerate for 30 minutes
7. Pre-heat the barbecue
8. Arrange the prawns on the hot barbecue and cook till done
9. Heat oil in a pan
10. Add the bell peppers and saute
11. Add the remaining marinade and mix
12. Serve the barbecued prawns with sauteed bell peppers

title: macaroni   tomato soup
steps:
1. Brown hamburger , drain
2. Mix two cans of soup with two cans of water and heat
3. Add macaroni , chili powder , and ground beef
4. Cook until macaroni is done

title: chickpea salad with roasted cumin
steps:
1. In skillet over medium heat , add cumin and toast 1 minute
2. Remove from heat
3. In small bowl , whisk together lime juice , olive oil and toasted cumin
4. In serving bowl , place remaining ingredients
5. Add dressing and toss to coat

title: pear and spinach salad with goat cheese vinaigrette
steps:
1. Place spinach in a salad bowl
2. Toss pear slices with lemon juice and add to bowl
3. Place remaining ingredients in a food processor or blender and process until smooth
4. Toss vinaigrette with salad

title: tiny tarts with pecan or pumpkin filling
steps:
1. Tarts:
2. In a mixing bowl , beat margarine or butter and cream cheese until thoroughly blended
3. Stir in flour
4. Roll rounded-teaspoonsbul of dough into balls
5. Press evenly into the bottom and up the sides of mini-muffin cups
6. Fill each pastry with 1 heaping teaspoon of desired filling
7. Filling:
8. In a small mixing bowl , beat ingredients together until mixed well
9. Bake at 325 degree for 25-30 minutes or until pastry is golden and filling is puffed
10. Cool slightly in pan
11. Remove from cups and cool completely on a wire rack

title: spicy soba sesame salad
steps:
1. Cook soba noodles by following the package directions
2. Drain and rinse briefly under cold running water
3. Drain completely
4. Put noodles in a large serving bowl
5. Make the dressing: in a small mixing bowl , whisk together the vinegar , red pepper flakes , sesame oil , chile oil , and tamari
6. Slowly whisk in the peanut oil until an emulsion forms
7. Pour the dressing over the noodles
8. Add in the snow peas , bell pepper , onions , and sesame seeds
9. Toss the salad gently to coat
10. Serve at once or you may refrigerate for up to 24 hours

title: lemon grilled chicken   pasta salad
steps:
1. In small bowl , combine dijon mustard , olive oil and lemon juice
2. In large bowl , mix together cooked pasta , red bell pepper , chopped parsley and sliced grilled chicken
3. Toss well
4. Season with salt and pepper and toss again
5. Stir dressing and pour over pasta mixture , tossing to coat well
6. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour before serving

title: chicken and black bean pitas
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 350 degrees
2. In a large skillet combine onions and garlic
3. Saut over medium heat for 2 minutes
4. Add corn , beans and chicken and saut for another 2 minutes
5. Drain mixture and cool slightly
6. In a large mixing bowl combine all ingredients except pitas
7. Mix well
8. Stuff pitas with mixture
9. Cook in preheated oven for 15-20 minutes
10. Serve with salsa and sour cream
11. Mmmmm !

title: mini pizzas with arugula  peppers   prosciutto
steps:
1. Lightly coat a large bowl with 1 teaspoons of the oil
2. Put the dough in the bowl , cover loosley , and let sit at room temperature until supple and relaxed
3. 45 minutes to an hour
4. Position racks in the top and bottom thirds of the oven and heat the oven to 475 degrees
5. Meanwhile put the tomateos , oregano , garlic , 2 teaspoons of the oil , and 1 / 2 tsp of salt & pepper in a food processor
6. Pulse to make a chunky sauce
7. Lightly oil 2 baking sheets with the remaining 2 teaspoons oil divide the dough into quarters
8. Divide each quarter into 3 equal parts
9. You'll have twelve 1 ounce pieces of dough
10. Shape each piece of dough into a 3 inch round and put on the baking sheets
11. Spread about 1 scant tablespoon of the sauce over each dough round , leaving a little border around the edge for the crust
12. Top each with a mound of arugula , then some strips of pepper & prociutto
13. Sprinkle the mozzarella and parmigiano on top
14. Bake until the cheese is bubbling and the crust in browned , 12 to 14 minutes , rotating and swapping the pans positions about halfway through for even baking
15. Sprinkle with crushed pepper flakes if desired and serve

title: hot parma dip   meatball sauce
steps:
1. Melt butter in saucepan , add celery , onions & pepper
2. Cook until tender
3. Add flour 7 cook for 2 mins , stirring , blend in tomatoes & seasonings , simmer for 5 minutes
4. Stir in cheese and water & wine until combined
5. Serve

title: german peasant style chicken
steps:
1. Wash and dry the chicken pieces
2. Beat the egg , 1 1 / 2 t salt and 1 / 4 t pepper
3. Dip chicken in mixture , then roll in the bread crumbs mixed with the cheese
4. Melt 4 tablespoons butter in a skillet , and saut the chicken until browned and tender
5. Transfer to a baking pan and place in a 350 oven while preparing the sauce
6. Melt the remaining butter in the skillet in which the chicken was cooked
7. Saut the mushrooms 5 minutes
8. Blend in the flour , dash of salt and pepper
9. Gradually add the milk stirring steadily until it reaches the boiling point
10. Mix in the wine and cook over low heat 5 minutes
11. Arrange the chicken on a hot serving dish ad pour sauce over it

title: onion rolls   bread machine recipe
steps:
1. Add water to the bread machine followed by the lemon juice , sugar , flour , and then the yeast
2. Set bread machine to the dough setting and start the cycle
3. When cycle is done , remove dough onto a lightly floured surface and knead about 5 minutes
4. Using a floured rolling pin , roll dough out into a large rectangle
5. Sprinkle dough with about 3 / 4 of the onions , reserving some to sprinkle on top later
6. Starting from the side closest to you roll the dough up into a tube shape
7. Slice the dough into 1 inch slices as if you were making cinnamon rolls
8. Place each slice , on it's side , on a greased baking sheet and cover loosely with plastic wrap
9. Allow rolls to rise for about 30 mins or until doubled in size
10. At this time you can sprinkle the remaining diced onions on the tops of each roll
11. While rising , preheat oven to 400 degrees farenheit
12. Bake about 20-25 mins or until golden brown
13. Cool and enjoy !

title: gluten free lazy lasagna
steps:
1. Brown the ground beef with the garlic in a large pan over medium heat
2. Add the onion
3. Saute until soft
4. Add the tomato
5. Saute until soft
6. Stir in tomato sauce , oregano , marinara seasoning , and cloves
7. Turn the heat to low , or until the sauce is barely simmering
8. Meanwhile , boil the pasta until al dente
9. Line a small oven-safe dish with tinfoil
10. Line bottom with cooked pasta
11. Lay the roasted red peppers overtop , if using
12. Pour the meat and sauce mixture evenly over pasta and peppers
13. Top with cheeses
14. Broil at 500 until cheese is browned and bubbly
15. Enjoy !

title: baked green beans
steps:
1. Place beans into an ungreased 1 1 / 2 quart baking dish
2. Stir bacon drippings into beans
3. Dissolve bouillon in water and add garlic salt and pepper
4. Pour over beans
5. Cover and bake at 350 for 1 hour
6. Top with crumbled bacon

title: penne with ginger garlic   vegetables
steps:
1. In a small bowl combine vegetable stock , soy sauce , balsamic vinegar , cornstarch , garlic& ginger
2. Set aside
3. Heat 1 teaspoon olive oil in a wok or large saut pan
4. Saut pasta for 2 minutes
5. Pour into a bowl and set aside
6. Heat remaining olive oil and saut shallots , carrots , red bell pepper and broccoli for 5 minutes
7. Add sauce and stir 2 minutes , until thickened
8. Add pasta , sesame oil and scallions
9. Toss and serve

title: garlic free parsley pesto
steps:
1. Clean and remove big stems from parsley
2. In a food processor or magic bullet put the parsley , salt , walnuts , shallot and half the oil
3. Blend until pureed
4. Add remaining oil , lemon juice and parmesan and blend quickly

title: chocolate chai
steps:
1. Combine tea , cardamom , cloves , cinnamon , allspice , cocoa powder , sugar and 1 1 / 2 cups of cold water in a saucepan
2. Bring to the boil over medium-high heat
3. Reduce heat to medium-low
