4. Simmer , stirring , for 5 minutes or until aromatic
5. Add milk
6. Simmer , stirring occasionally , for 5 minutes or until hot
7. Strain into 2 heatproof glasses or cups
8. Serve

title: egg roll wrappers
steps:
1. Combine ingredients to make a dough
2. Cover and let rest for 10 minutes
3. Knead until smooth and elastic
4. Divide into 16 pieces
5. Roll into 6 inch squares
6. Stack rolled squares separately with wax paper between each one
7. Keep covered so they will not dry out while making the entire recipe of wrappers
8. Fill by making a line of your favorite filling about 1 / 2 from top and side edges
9. Fold in each side over filling
10. Brush on a small amount of saved egg along remaining side edges and the bottom edge
11. Roll from the top to the bottom and press lightly so it will seal
12. Fry at 350 degrees until golden brown

title: solo chicken breast with honey rum sauce
steps:
1. Combine the mayonnaise , honey and rum and set aside
2. Pat the chicken breast dry , apply the pepper and olive oil to both sides
3. Sear in a very hot frying pan 4 minutes on each side
4. Let the chicken rest for a couple minutes , and then slice
5. Serve over cooked rice or pasta , and drizzle the sauce over the meat

title: dried onion soup mix
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients and mix well
2. Place in a storage container with a tight-fitting lid and seal tightly
3. Store in a cool , dry place for up to 6 months
4. Stir or shake well before each use
5. Measure about 1 / 3 cup dry mix to use as a substitute for one 1
6. 25-ounce package of purchased dry onion soup mix

title: multigrain onion rolls or bread  bread machine
steps:
1. Melt the butter in a skillet and saute the chopped onions , stirring frequently , until softened and lightly browned , about 8-10 minutes
2. Set aside to cool
3. Place all ingredients except for the sunflower seeds , steel-cut oats and sesame seeds in the pan of your bread machine , in the order recommended by the manufacturer
4. Select the dough cycle and start
5. About 5 minutes before the end of the cycle , add the onions , seeds and steel-cut oats
6. After dough has risen , punch it down and turn out
7. Divide into twelve pieces and shape as desired
8. Place on baking sheet dusted with cornmeal
9. Cover and let rise until doubled , about 40-45 minutes
10. Place in a preheated 400 deg
11. F
12. Oven and bake until golden brown , about 20 minutes
13. Turn out on wire rack to cool
14. The ball of dough will "come apart" , but should come back together again
15. Also feel free to change the proportion of the flours , but i find that the above makes a really nicely flavored bread

title: oriental ramen salad
steps:
1. Melt butter in large skillet
2. Add crumbled ramen noodles and nuts
3. Cook , stirring constantly , until noodles are golden
4. Remove from pan
5. Cool
6. Place evaporated milk , oil , ramen seasoning packet , vinegar and sugar in blender
7. Cover
8. Blend until smooth
9. Combine salad greens , noodle mixture , green onions and dressing in large bowl
10. Toss to coat well
11. Serve immediately

title: milli jhooli sabji   mixed vegetables
steps:
1. In a blender , process the onions , ginger and garlic until they form a paste
2. Heat the oil in a heavy skillet and add the paste
3. Saute for 3-4 minutes , then add the red and green peppers , cauliflower , potatoes and tomatoes
4. Mix well with ginger paste then add paprika , turmeric and pepper- mix well
5. Stir in water , cover and simmer on low heat for 15-20 minutes or until potatoes are tender
6. Stir in butter and cream and season with salt to taste

title: grilled chicken breast with tarragon lemon sauce
steps:
1. Spread mustard on both sides of the chicken and sprinkle with the black pepper
2. Cover and refrigerate 2 to 4 hours
3. Prepare your grill for cooking the chicken over medium coals
4. Melt the butter in a small saucepan over low heat
5. Stir in the remaining ingredients
6. Cook , uncovered , over low heat for 5 minutes , stirring occasionally
7. Remove the sauce from the heat
8. Baste the chicken with the sauce
9. Grill over medium coals for 50 to 55 minutes or until done turn and baste the chicken every 10 minutes with the remaining sauce

title: palestinian fruit soup
steps:
1. Combine all the ingredients except sour cream
2. Simmer about 30 minutes
3. Pure
4. Chill
5. Add sour cream before serving

title: savory grilled corn
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine the first seven ingredients
2. Spread over corn
3. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese
4. Wrap each ear of corn in a double thickness of heavy-duty foil
5. Grill , covered , over medium heat for 30-35 minutes or until corn is tender , turning occasionally

title: frozen lemon cream pie
steps:
1. Separate eggs
2. Be sure to use only grade a uncracked eggs !
3. In large mixer bowl , beat egg yolks and 1 / 2 cup sugar until light
4. Stir in lemon juice
5. In small mixer bowl , beat egg whites until soft peaks form
6. Gradually add remaining 2 t sugar , beating until stiff peaks form
7. Fold egg white mixture into lemon juice mixture
8. Fold in half the whipped cream
9. Fold in remaining whipped cream
10. Spoon into prepared crust
11. Freeze at least 3 hours or until firm
12. Serve more whipped cream or blueberry 'n' spice sauce

title: cream fudge  sucre a la creme canadien
steps:
1. Combine first 3 ingredients
2. Bring to a boil over medium heat
3. Boil 8 to 9 minutes , stirring constantly
4. Remove from heat , add icing sugar and nuts and stir until well mixed
5. Pour into 9" x 9" pan
6. Cool about 15 minutes in refrigerator and cut into small squares
7. Let cool completly and remove from pan

title: sicilian pizza dough   noble roman s copycat
steps:
1. Place all ingredients into breadmaker in the order listed
2. Allow breadmaker to knead and let rise slightly before removing , approximately 20 to 25 minutes
3. Don't forget to remove the dough before the bake cycle starts
4. Remove the dough and place it on a lightly floured cutting board and cover with a clean moist towel to rise an additional 30 minutes or so before forming on the pizza tray
5. To really bring out the flavor of the noble roman's sicilian pizza you should prepare a cake pan as follows:
6. Warning: make sure you keep good airflow through the kitchen & turn on the overhead fan as this will smoke like the dickens
7. The pan should be retained only for this use
8. Paint the inside of the cake pan with a thin coat of virgin olive oil
9. Bake the pan at 450 degrees until the oil has varnished the pan
10. Additional coats may be necessary
11. Before placing your dough in the pan paint it again with virgin olive oil
12. Place the dough in the pan and let the dough rise once
13. After the dough has risen , push the dough down working it to the pan edges
14. The cheeses used are 2 / 3 mozzarella and 1 / 3 muenster plus a dash of oregano
15. Put the cheese directly onto the dough
16. Add desired toppings
17. Then ladle the sauce in dots on the top ensuring the sauce does not contact the edges of the pan
18. The olive oil is what really lends the unique flavor
19. Noble roman's bakes them for 15-20 minutes at 500 degrees or until the cheese is golden
20. At 450 degrees bake you may have to add 5-10 minutes

title: orange chicken koresh iranian
steps:
1. Heat sesame oil
2. Saute chicken
3. Remove chicken to a platter
4. Add onions to oil
5. Add orange zest , cinnamon , cardamom , nutmeg , cumin , coriander , salt , and pepper
6. Stir
7. Add chicken back
8. Roll chicken around to coat in the spices
9. Add orange juice
10. Bring to near boil
11. Cook 20 minutes covered
12. Stir occasionally so it doesn't burn
13. Cook on low until chicken becomes tender
14. Combine vinegar , lime juice , sugar , and saffron water in medium saucepan
15. Heat for 10 minutes until hot
16. Add orange segments
17. Stir well
18. Add carrots , almonds and pistachio nuts to chicken mixture and cook for 15 minutes more
19. When done add lime juice mixture
20. Stir
21. Garnish with herbs like cilantro

title: tomato stuffed avocados
steps:
1. Combine tomatoes , onion , olives , lemon juice , vinegar , spices , olive oil , and salt and pepper
2. Let this mixture marinate for several hours
3. Peel avocados and slice in half
4. Remove pits and place tomato mixture where the pit was
5. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese and serve

title: t dad soul food  black eyed peas in coconut milk
steps:
1. Put peas in a large bowl and cover with water
2. Leave to soak overnight
3. After peas have soaked , put all ingredients into a large saucepan
4. Put on stove on high heat
5. Bring to the boil
6. Turn heat to low , and let simmer
7. Simmer until sauce thickens , and peas are soft and cooked
8. Add a little water if needed , mixture should not be too dry
9. Adjust seasoning to taste
10. Serve hot as a side dish

title: multigrain rolls
steps:
1. Combine the oat bran and flax seeds in a small bowl
2. Pour the boiling water into the bowl and mix to moisten
3. Let sit until the water is absorbed , about 5 minutes
4. Set aside to cool
5. Meanwhile , in the bowl of an electric mixer , combine the milk , yeast and honey
6. Mix briefly to blend
7. With the dough hook and the mixer on low speed , mix in the eggs , oats , wheat flour , pepper , salt and oat bran mixture until combined
8. Slowly add enough all-purpose flour , 1 / 2 cup at a time , to make a soft , slightly sticky dough
9. Continue to knead on medium-low speed , about 3 minutes
10. Form the dough into a ball
11. Transfer the dough to a lightly oiled bowl , turning once to coat
12. Cover with plastic wrap or a clean kitchen towel and let rise in a warm place until doubled in bulk , about 1 1 / 2 - 2 hours
13. Brush a baking dish lightly with oil
14. On a lightly floured surface , turn the dough out and divide into 16 equal pieces
15. Form each portion into a ball and place the dough balls in the baking dish , spaced slightly apart so they have room to grow together
16. Cover and let rise until puffy and nearly doubled in bulk , about 30 minutes
17. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f
18. In a small bowl whisk together the egg yolk and water
19. Brush lightly over the proofed rolls
20. Sprinkle the unbaked rolls with the seed mixture and coarse salt
21. Bake until the tops are golden , about 26 minutes
22. Let cool 10-15 minutes before removing from the pan

title: baby s millionaire pie
steps:
1. Cream together the cream cheese and sugar with electric mixer
2. Let the mixer run on high for 3-4 minutes
3. Stir pineapple into cream cheese mixture
4. Stir in coconut and pecans
5. Mix well
6. Carefully fold in 3 / 4 of cool whip
7. Fill pie crust with mixture
8. Top with remaining cool whip
9. Chill for several hours

title: cheesy chicken enchilada bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. In a large pot combine chicken , soup , tomato sauce , milk , sour cream , and spices
3. Bring mixture to a boil , then reduce heat and simmer for 15 - 30 minutes , stirring occasionally
4. The longer it simmers , the tastier it gets !
5. Remove sauce from heat
6. Get out a 13x9 cake pan
7. Put a thin layer of the sauce mix at the bottom of the pan - just enough to coat the bottom
8. Put a layer of corn tortillas on the bottom of the pan
9. Sprinkle about a third of the cheese on top of the tortillas
10. Pour half of the remaining sauce on top of the cheese
11. Add another layer of tortillas
12. Sprinkle another third of the cheese on top of the tortillas
13. Pour the rest of the sauce on top of the cheese
14. Add the last layer of tortillas
15. Sprinkle the rest of the cheese on top of the tortillas
16. Bake at 350f for 25 - 30 minutes until cheese is melted and casserole sauce is bubbly
17. Let the casserole cool for about 10 minutes before you serve it
18. Enjoy !

title: crock pot beef stroganoff  an msg free easy variation
steps:
1. Brown beef
2. Add onions and mushrooms until soft
3. Toss everything into crock pot
4. Cook on low about 6 hours

title: southern hot dog chili
steps:
1. Put all ingredients in a small sauce pan , stir well
2. Bring to a slow boil , i usually set burner at med
3. Low
4. Cook at least one hour , i cook mine for two hours usually
5. A

title: vegtable pilaf
steps:
1. In a pot add oil , on med / low heat saute onions , carrots , peppers , peas
2. Until onions have become slightly golden and vegetables are cooked
3. Add garlic , ginger , bay leaf , pepper , and turmeric
4. Saute for 5min on low heat
5. Add salt and broth
6. Cover and bring to a boil
7. Once it boils add the rice wait for it to come up to another boil
8. Reduce heat , cover and allow to cook on low for 15-20min's or until the fluid is gone and rice is fluffy
9. Add butter and fluff with fork , serve with any side

title: twisted chicken scallopini
steps:
1. Cut blood orange in half and set aside
2. Fill large sauce pan or pasta pan with salted water and bring to a boil over high heat
3. Place flour and seasoned salt in a plastic bag and shake to mix
4. Add chicken cutlets and shake to cover them
5. Let them sit for a few minutes to absorb some of the flour mixture and then shake again
6. Melt butter in a larger skillet over medium heat and then add chicken cutlets
7. Allow chicken cutlets to cook for about 3-5 minutes or until lightly golden brown
8. Turn cutlets over and then add diced shallots around the chicken
9. Allow to cook another 3-5 minutes until golden
10. Add the 2 teaspoons chicken base and stir with butter mixture
11. Now juice the blood orange into the pan and add the 2 teaspoons lime juice and mix juices with the butter mixture
12. Add the wine and allow it to simmer for 5 minutes
13. Turn down heat to low and add the heavy cream
14. Sprinkle with parsley
15. Serve chicken over pasta along with some of the sauce

title: molasses crinkles  cookies
steps:
1. Whisk together flour , baking soda , cinnamon , ginger , allspice , cloves , pepper , and salt in a bowl until combined
2. Set aside
3. Beat together shortening , butter , and brown sugar in a large bowl with an electric mixer at medium-high speed until pale and fluffy , about 3 minutes in a stand mixer or 6 minutes with a handheld mixer
4. Add egg and molasses , beating until combined
5. Reduce speed to low , then mix in flour mixture until combined
6. Put oven racks in upper and lower thirds of oven and preheat oven to 375 degrees f
7. Roll 1 heaping teaspoon of dough into a 1-inch ball with wet hands , then dip 1 end of the the ball in granulated sugar
8. Make more cookies in the same manner , arranging them , sugar side up , 2 inches apart on 2 ungreased baking sheets
9. Bake cookies , switching position of sheets halfway through baking , until undersides are golden brown , 10 - 12 minutes total
10. Cool cookies on sheets 1 minute , then remove from baking sheets and transfer to racks to cool completely

title: easy biscuits
steps:
1. Mix dry ingredients
2. Put oil in measuring cup and add milk
3. Do not stir
4. Add to dry ingredients
5. Mix lightly to moisten ingredients and knead one or two times to form ball
6. Roll out between two sheets of plastic wrap to about 1 / 2" thick
7. Cut into 2" biscuits
8. Bake on an ungreased pan at 475f for 10-12 minutes , until lightly browned

title: orzo salmon salad
steps:
1. In a sealable container , add the oil , lime juice , zest and seasonings
2. Shake well and set aside
3. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees
4. On a non stick baking sheet , place the salmon portions
5. Baste the fish with some of the dressing
6. Place in heated oven and bake approximately 15-20 minutes
7. Or until fish flakes
8. Meanwhile , put all the remaining ingredients in a large bowl
9. Add the rest of the dressing and mix well
10. When fish is done , add the spinach to the salad and toss
11. Divide the salad among 4 plates and place a salmon portion on top of each serving

title: lighter chicken parmesan with simple tomato sauce
steps:
1. Adjust an oven rack to the middle position and heat the oven to 475f
2. Combine the bread crumbs and oil in a 12-inch skillet and toast over medium heat , stirring often , until golden , about 20 minutes
3. Spread the bread crumbs in a shallow dish and cool slightly
4. When cool , stir in the parmesan
5. In a second shallow dish , combine the flour , garlic powder , 1 tablespoon salt and 1 / 2 teaspoons pepper together
6. In a third shallow dish , whisk the egg whites and water together
7. Line a rimmed baking sheet with foil , place a wire rack on top and spray the rack with vegetable oil spray
8. Pat the chicken dry with paper towels , then season with salt and pepper
9. Lightly dredge the cutlets in the flour , shaking off the excess , then dip in the egg whites , and finally coat with the bread crumbs
10. Press on the bread crumbs to make sure they adhere
11. Lay the chicken on the wire rack
12. Spray the tops of the chicken with the vegetable oil spray
13. Bake until the meat is no longer pink in the center and feel firm when pressed with a finger , about 15 minutes
14. Remove the chicken from the oven
15. Spoon 2 tablespoons of the sauce onto the center of each cutlet
16. Top the sauce with 2 tablespoons of the mozzarella
17. Return the chicken to the oven and continue to bake until the cheese has melted , about 5 minutes
18. Sprinkle with the basil and serve , passing the remaining sauce and parmesan separately
19. For simple tomato sauce: pulse the tomatoes in a food processor until mostly smooth , about ten one second pulses
20. Set aside
21. Cook the garlic , tomato paste , oil and pepper flakes in a medium saucepan over medium heat until the tomato paste begins to brown , about 2 minutes
22. Stir in the pured tomatoes and cook until the sauce is thickened and measures 2 cups , about 20 minutes
23. Off the heat , stir in the basil and season with salt and pepper to taste
24. Cover and set aside until needed

title: key lime cheesecake tarts
steps:
1. Crust:
2. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
3. Crush graham crackers very fine
4. Add sugar , nuts and melted butter
5. Mix well
6. Line your mini muffin pan with mini paper liners
7. Press firmly about a tbs of crust into each liner , make sure you press up the sides also
8. Bake for 8-10 min , or until crust is golden
9. Let cool completely , you can leave in pan or take out
10. Filling:
11. In a medium bowl beat softened cream cheese for about a min( if you skip this step , your cheese will be lumpy
12. Slowly add the sweetened condensed milk and mix until smooth
13. Add key lime juice , mix well
14. Taste , if you would like a stronger flavor add as necessary
15. Pour into a pastry bag or a ziploc bag with end cut off and fill each cooled tart evenly
16. Place in fridge for @ least 3 hrs-overnight
17. Just before serving you can sprinkle some toasted coconut and a strawberry slice or just one or the other

title: vegan blueberry cobbler
steps:
1. Combine dry ingredients , add milk and whisk until smooth
2. Pour into greased casserole dish and sprinkle with blueberries
3. Bake at 350 for 40 minutes

title: neely s grilled bbq pork chops
steps:
1. Mix 1 cup paprika , 3 1 / 2 tablespoons sugar , and 1 / 2 teaspoon onion powder in a small bowl
2. Apply to each pork chop
3. For the sauce: combine all of the sauce ingredients in a large saucepan or dutch oven
4. Over high heat , bring ingredients to a boil , stirring frequently to prevent sticking
5. Once sauce comes to a boil , reduce temperature to low and simmer , uncovered , for at least 2 hours
6. Place pork chops in a large freezer safe plastic bag
7. Pour 2 cups of neely's bbq sauce into bag
8. Marinate in refrigerator for 8 hours
9. Place pork chops on grill and cook until internal temperature is 160f
10. Reapply bbq sauce to pork chops prior to serving

title: grilled cheddar  tomato and bacon sandwiches
steps:
1. Cook bacon in heavy large skillet over medium heat until brown and crisp , turning occasionally , about 6 minutes
2. Transfer bacon to paper towels and drain
3. Wash and dry skillet
4. Place 4 bread slices on work surface
5. Press 1 / 4 cup grated cheese onto each slice
6. Top each with 2 tomato slices the optional basil leaves
7. Sprinkle with pepper
8. Place 2 bacon slices atop each , breaking into pieces if necessary to fit
9. Press 1 / 4 cup grated cheese over bacon on each
10. Top sandwiches with remaining bread slices , then spread 1 / 2 tablespoon mayonnaise over top of each sandwich
11. Spray with non-stick cooking spray 2 heavy large skillets
12. Heat skillets over medium heat
13. Add 2 sandwiches , mayonnaise side down , to each skillet
14. Place plate atop both sandwiches to weigh down
15. Cook sandwiches until bottom is golden brown , about 2 minutes
16. Spread top of each sandwich with 1 / 2 tablespoon mayonnaise
17. Turn sandwiches over , mayonnaise side down
18. Top with plates and cook until golden brown on bottom , about 2 minutes
19. Transfer sandwiches to work surface
20. Cut sandwiches crosswise in half and serve with pickle

title: bean chili  meat  and sugar free
steps:
1. Heat oil in frying pan at medium temperature
2. Addonion , celery , green pepper , garlic and stir fry until limp , 2-3 minutes
3. Add all beans and tomato sauce
4. Add chili powder , oregano and garlic powder
5. Heat through and serve
6. Best if simmered covered for one hour

title: basil pesto amato
steps:
1. Put the first four ingredients in a food processor
2. Process for 15-20 seconds
3. Add the olive oil in a stream
4. Blend / pulse until desired consistency leaving some texture
5. Add water gradually as needed
6. Serve over pasta , chicken , etc
7. You can freeze it in meal-serving containers or individual ice cube-sized blocks
8. If you need to thin it at any time , use water , not more oil

title: black sesame cupcakes  or muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 170c
2. Beat the margarine or butter until it is soft
3. Add the sugar
4. Add the black sesame powder and honey and mix well
5. In a separate bowl , beat the egg just a little
6. Add to the sugar , butter , and sesame mixture in 2 or 3 additions , or else it will curdle
7. Add the milk
8. Sift together the cake flour and baking powder
9. Fold in the flour to the mixture with a rubber spatula
10. Pour into the muffin liners
11. Add black sesame seeds on top to garnish if desired
12. Bake for 15 to 17 minutes

title: orange avocado salad with poppy seed dressing
steps:
1. Combine the vinegar , sugar , dry mustard , salt , oil and poppy seeds in a container
2. Mix well
3. Place the romaine lettuce on salad plates
4. Decorate with the orange and avocado slices
5. Drizzle the dressing over top and serve

title: bread an butter pickles
steps:
1. Rinse cucumbers under cold water and trim the ends
2. Rinse red bell pepper under cold water , slice in half lengthwise and remove seeds
3. Peel maui onions and set aside
4. Use a mandoline and slice cucumbers about 1 / 4 thick
5. Place cucumbers into a bowl
6. Slice maui onion and red bellpepper about 1 / 4 inch thick and add to cucumbers
7. Add kosher salt and water to the cucumbers
8. Stir pickles , cover with plastic and let stand for 3 hours
9. Rinse the cucumbers , onions and bellpeppers under cold water
10. In a large saucepan add vinegar , brown sugar , mustard seeds , tumeric , saffron , whole cloves , whole allspice berries , bay leaves and cucumbers
11. Bring cucumbers to a full boil and reduce to slow simmer for 15 minutes uncovered
12. Set pickles aside and let stand until they reach room temperature
13. Place pickles into a containers and refrigate for several hours

title: pumpkin spice muffins   gluten free   dairy free
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Mix all dry ingredients in a large bowl
3. Whisk wet ingredients together in a separate bowl , then fold into dry mixture
4. Whisk all ingredients until combined and smooth
5. Place muffin liners into two 12-muffin pans , and spray the insides of the papers with baking spray
6. Distribute batter evenly between muffin liners
7. Bake for 20-25 minutes

title: provencal tomato sauce  uses fresh tomatoes
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a heavy pot
2. Add the onions and saute for about 10 minutes , until they are translucent
3. Add in the garlic and bay leaves , let that saute about 5 minutes more
4. Add in the tomates , salt , pepper and herbs - simmer for 20 minutes
5. When the tomatoes have cooked down , add in the tomato paste and simmer for another 10 minutes
6. Adjust seasoning to your liking
7. Remove the bay leaves and your sauce is ready !

title: kahlua dip
steps: 1. Cream together the first 3 ingredients with a hand blender real quick and fold in the cool whip and enjoy -- hope you all enjoy

title: julie s almond chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. In 10x13 pan , melt butter with garlic
3. In wide , shallow bowl combine cracker crumbs , parmesan , almonds , parsley , salt , thyme and pepper
4. Mix well
5. Dip chicken in garlic butter , then in crumb mixture
6. Place skin side up in baking dish containing garlic butter
7. Bake uncovered one hour or until done , basting occasionally with pan drippings

title: bacon wrapped chicken breasts with chile cheese sauce
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Line a rimmed baking sheet with aluminum foil
3. Set aside
4. Wrap a slice of bacon around each piece of chicken and place on the baking sheet
5. Bake about 20 minutes or until cooked through
6. Remove chicken from the oven
7. Preheat the broiler
8. Meanwhile , in a saucepan , bring the soup , milk , chipotle pepper , worcestershire to a simmer over medium heat
9. Turn of heat
10. Keep sauce warm
11. Broil the chicken 4 to 5 inches from heat for 1 to 2 minutes or until the bacon is really sizzling
12. Serve chicken topped with the cheese sauce

title: foolproof roast beef and vegetable
steps:
1. Place all vegetables in a zip-lock bag
2. Add enough oil to lightly coat
3. Remove from bag and place vegetables in the roasting pan
4. Place roast on top of vegetables
5. Sprinkle roast generously with the garlic pepper
6. Sprinkle vegetables with garlic pepper and salt
7. Roast at 500 degrees for seven minutes per pound
8. Roast will be medium-rare
9. Remove from oven and allow roast sit for 20 minutes or more before carving
10. I always sprinkle with salt when roast is done

title: banana yogurt cake
steps:
1. In a large mixing bowl , stir together flour , the 1 / 3 cup sugar , baking powder , baking soda and salt
2. Set aside
3. In a medium bowl , stir together yogurt , banana , oil , lemon peel and vanilla
4. Set aside
5. In a small mixer bowl , beat egg whites until soft peaks form
6. Gradually add remaining 3 / 4 cup sugar
7. Beat on high speed until stiff peaks form
8. Stir yogurt-banana mixture into flour mixture until moistened
9. Fold in about a fourth of the egg-white mixture to soften
10. Then fold in remaining egg whites
11. Preheat oven to 350f
12. Pour the batter evenly into a greased and floured 9 by 9 by 2-inch baking pan
13. Bake for 40 to 45 minutes , or until a wooden toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean
14. Cool cake in the pan on a wire rack for 10 minutes
15. Remove cake from pan and cool completely on the wire rack place cake in a storage container or wrap with plastic wrap and store
16. This cake slices better when held overnight
17. For icing , stir together corn syrup and water
18. Add cocoa powder , stirring till smooth
19. Drizzle chocolate over cake in a lacy design
20. Let stand about 30 minutes , until set
21. Serve with raspberries

title: quick tofu and cashew sour cream  vegan
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in blender , except the chives
2. Blend for at least 1 minute until silky smooth
3. Add the chives
4. Serve

title: paneer  panir
steps:
1. Boil water in a large pot , then add milk
2. Bring to a full foaming boil , stirring to prevent sticking
3. Lower heat , the add lemon juice stirring constantly
4. Soft curds should appear in 10-15 seconds , separating from the light yellow , clear whey
5. Remove from heat and allow to stand 5-6 minutes
6. Line a colander with finely woven tea towels
7. Use a slotted spoon to remove the curds from the pot and into the towel-lined colander
8. Use fine strainer to get the smallest remainders
9. Gather the corners of the towels and twist into a tight ball
10. Put a weight on top of the ball and let it rest 10 minutes
11. Unwrap and use in recipe or wrap in plastic and refrigerate

title: chicken in foil triangles   aka twice baked chicken
steps:
1. Mix together all ingredients
2. Put into covered dish and put in fridge to marinate for one hour
3. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
4. Wrap tablespoon sized portions in pieces of aluminum foil , either in triangular shapes or about 2 1 / 2-inch square
5. Bake in 350 degree f oven for about 10 minutes
6. Serve along with stirfry and rice , or as an appetizer

title: hot buttered rum mix
steps:
1. Soften butter and mix with brown sugar , cinnamon , nutmeg and vanilla
2. Refrigerate or freeze
3. For each serving , use 1 tablespoon of the mix , 1 / 2 ounce to 1 1 / 2 ounces of rum and 6 ounces boiling water

title: linda s huli huli chicken
steps:
1. Split each chicken down the backbone , but leave attached at breast
2. Remove neck bone
3. Rinse off chickens , and pat dry with paper towels
4. Set into a lg
5. Plastic container
6. To make marinade , mix together soy sauce , lime juice , honey , brown sugar , oil , garlic , ketchup , gingerroot , sambal oelek or asian chile paste , salt and pepper , and sesame oil if using
7. Pour marinade over chicken , then cover , and store in refrigerator
8. Marinate split chickens for 20 minutes to 4 hours
9. During the marinating time , turn chickens often , to coat all areas of the chickens well
10. Secure chickens on rotisserie and roast 60-80 minutes , basting often with the marinade while cooking
11. If you don't have a rotisserie , grill the chicken on a barbecue rack over med
12. Coals , turning often for about 45 minutes baste frequently with the marinade , flipping chicken often while cooking
13. If you'd prefer , you can roast the chicken at 325 , for 1 1 / 2 hrs
14. , basting chicken often with the marinade , and flipping the chicken often while cooking
15. Do not save the marinade , or serve over chicken !

title: macaroni   goat cheese
steps:
1. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to boil
2. Add the macaroni and cook about 8 to 10 minutes , or until just tender , depending on the size of the pasta
3. Drain
4. Meanwhile , in a medium saucepan , melt the butter over low heat
5. When the butter is melted and sizzling , stir in the flour to create a paste and cook 1 minute
6. Slowly add the milk , whisking to create a smooth sauce
7. Let cook about 5 minutes or until thick enough to coat the back of a spoon
8. Remove the pan from the heat and slowly add the grated parmesan and the goat cheese , whisking to create a smooth sauce
9. Season with salt and pepper to taste
10. Use the olive oil to grease the bottom of a medium size gratin or baking dish , about 8 to 10 inches long
11. Place the drained macaroni in the dish and pour the cheese sauce on top , stirring gently to coat all the macaroni
12. In a small bowl , make the topping
13. Mix the parmesan , breadcrumbs , thyme , and pepper
14. Spoon over the macaroni and top with the goat cheese
15. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees and bake for about 25 to 30 minutes , or until the cheese is melted and bubbling and the pasta is hot

title: vietnamese coffee
steps:
1. Pour the milk into the bottom of an 8 ounce glass
2. Carefully pour in the coffee , trying not to disturb the layer of milk
3. Stir the milk up from bottom and sip the coffee
4. Variation: this coffee may also be served iced
5. Add some ice cubes on top of the layer of condensed milk and proceed as above

title: hearty brown lentil soup
steps:
1. Rinse the lentils and put them in a large pot with 10 cups water and 2 tsp salt
2. (i added the salt towards the end of the cooking period as salt added at the start of cooking can make the lentils hard
3. Finely dice the carrots , celery and potatoes and add them to the pot , along with the bay leaf and thyme
4. Bring the water to the boil , lower heat and simmer soup , loosely covered for about 1 hour
5. Meanwhile chop the onion medium fine and saute it in 2 tblsps olive oil , stirring often over a medium heat until it softens
6. Add the chopped garlic and keep cooking and stirring until the onion begins to colour , about 10 minutes
7. Add the onion and garlic to the soup as it simmers
8. Lightly toast the cumin seeds in a small pan , stirring constantly for a few minutes until they are fragrant
9. Grind the cumin in a mortar or spice grinder and add it to the soup , along with 1 tblsp lemon juice and plenty of black pepper
10. Add the vegetable broth and the fresh herbs , bring the soup back to a simmer and taste
11. Adjust seasonings if necessary
12. Stir in another 2 tblsps olive oil
13. When serving add a thin drizzle of olive oil on top of each bowl , or put a tsp of mild salsa on top of each serving

title: august sunset mocktail
steps:
1. In a cocktail shaker filled with ice , combine juices
2. Shake to mix
3. Strain into a martini glass and garnish with a pink grapefruit slice

title: hot cinnamon coffee
steps:
1. Mix the milk and water together in a pot and heat on a low flame
2. As the mixture just starts to boil , add the coffee powder and stir
3. Bring to a boil and switch off burner
4. Add cinnamon , stir , and pour into two small cups to serve

title: praline apple bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Bake 1 / 2 cups pecans in a single layer in a shallow pan 6-8 minutes or until toasted and fragrant , stirring after 4 minutes
3. Beat sour cream and next 3 ingredients at low speed with an electric mixer 2 minutes or until blended
4. Stir together flour and next 3 ingredients
5. Add to sour cream mixture , beating just until blended
6. Stir in apples and 1 / 2 cup toated pecans
7. Spoon batter into a greased and floured 9x5 inch loaf pan
8. Sprinkle with remaining 1 cup chopped pecans
9. Lightly press pecans into the batter
10. Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour to 1 hour and 5 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted into the center comes out clean , shielding with aluminum foil after 50 minutes to prevent excessive browning
11. Cool in pan on wire rack for 10 minutes
12. Remove from pan to wire rack
13. Bring butter and brown sugar to a boil in a 1 quart heavy saucepan over medium heat , stirring constantly
14. Boil 1 minute
15. Remove from heat and spoon over top of bread
16. Let cool completely

title: charosets  grandpa s recipe
steps:
1. Chop apples coarsely in a large bowl
2. Use a food processor to chop the other fruits and nuts
3. Add all the ingredients to the apples and chop very well to blend

title: slow cooked white beans
steps:
1. In a large pot , place the beans and cover with water by 3 inches
2. Bring to a boil
3. Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer , covered , until the beans are just tender , about 1 hour and 20 minutes , stirring occasionally
4. Drain and set aside
5. In a large pot , cook the bacon over medium-high heat until brown and the fat is rendered , about 6 minutes
6. Add the onions , cayenne , cajun seasoning , salt and pepper , and cook , stirring , until the onion is soft , about 4 minutes
7. Add the garlic and cook for 30 seconds
8. Add the tomatoes and their juices and cook for 2 minutes
9. Add the beer , molasses , sugar , stock , whiskey , mustard , worcestershire and bay leaves
10. Stire well and cook for 1 minute
11. Add the beans and bring to a boil
12. Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer , covered , for 1 hour , stirring occasionally
13. Remove the lid and continue to simmer until tender , about 30 minutes to 1 hour , stirring occasionally and adding more water as needed to cover the beans
14. Remove from heat , remove the bay leaves and adjust seasoning to taste

title: chicken with bulgur
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. Mix together the salt , cinnamon , allspice , and pepper
3. Rub mixture into chicken
4. In a heavy , wide frying pan over medium-high heat , heat the oil
5. Add the chicken pieces and cook , turning , until all sides are browned
6. Remove the chicken from the pan and set aside
7. Discard the pan drippings but do not wipe out the pan
8. Melt the butter in the pan you cooked the chicken in
9. Add the onion and cook , stirring , until soft
10. Add the uncooked bulgur and currants and stir to coat well with butter
11. Spread the bulgur mixture in the bottom of a 9x13-inch baking pan
12. Place the chicken pieces on top
13. Pour the water , then the broth , over the chicken
14. Cover the pan tightly with foil and bake in a 375 degree oven for 40 to 45 minutes or until juices run clear and bulgur has absorbed all liquid
15. Garnish with sprinkled parsley and mint and serve

title: shrimp onion dip
steps:
1. Beat cream cheese until fluffy , stir in remaining ingredients
2. Mix well
3. Chill
4. Serve with fresh vegetables or crackers

title: spicy  saucy ribs
steps:
1. Heat oven to 325
2. Cut ribs into serving pieces
3. Place meaty sides up
4. In a rectangular pan cover and bake for about 2 hours or until tender
5. Drain
6. Pour sauce all over ribs
7. Bake uncovered for 30 minutes longer

title: chocolate fondant
steps:
1. Mix cream and gelatin , allow to firm up
2. Set on double boiler with simmering water
3. Add salt and allow gelatin to melt
4. Add corn syrup , butter , glycerin and vanilla
5. Cook over simmering water until butter is almost melted
6. Remove from heat and allow to cool to luke warm
7. In large mixer bowl place desired amount of cocoa and 2 lbs
8. Of powdered sugar
9. Pour liquid through strainer into sugar and cocoa
10. Stir by hand until partially mixed
11. Attach to mixer using dough hook mix on low until sugar is combined
12. Add small amounts of powdered sugar mixing until fondant wraps around hook
13. Place fondant on surface that is heavily dusted with powdered sugar
14. Knead until smooth
15. Have ready some plastic wrap painted with cooking oil
16. Wrap fondant in oiled
17. Wrap , wrap again , then place in ziploc bag or other air tight container
18. Allow to rest overnight
19. If you want to make white chocolate fondant , chop up white chocolate and add with corn syrup
20. Always strain liquid
21. This fondant can be made any flavor , just leave out chocolate , add your flavor with the corn syrup and adjust pioneered sugar to get the proper consistency

title: coconut shrimp with tamarind ginger sauce
steps:
1. Make sauce:
2. Whisk tamarind concentrate into lime juice in a small bowl until dissolved
3. Stir in remaining sauce ingredients and chill , covered
4. Prepare shrimp:
5. Coarsely chop coconut and transfer half to a shallow soup bowl or pie plate
6. Whisk together flour , beer , baking soda , salt , cayenne , and egg in a small bowl until smooth
7. Heat oil in a 4- to 6-quart deep heavy pot over moderately high heat until it registers 350f on thermometer
8. While oil is heating , coat shrimp:
9. Hold 1 shrimp by tail and dip into batter , letting excess drip off , then dredge in coconut , coating completely and pressing gently to help adhere
10. Transfer to a plate and coat remaining shrimp in same manner , adding remaining coconut to bowl as needed
11. Fry shrimp in oil in batches of 8 , turning once , until golden , about 1 minute
12. Transfer with a slotted spoon to paper towels to drain and season lightly with salt
13. Skim any coconut from oil and return oil to 350f between batches
14. Serve shrimp with sauce

title: jean s risotto plus
steps:
1. In olive oil sweat onions , shallots and garlic until translucent
2. Add fresh herbs and rice
3. Cut down to 1 / 2 tsp each of using dry herbs
4. Cook 4-5 minutes until rice begins to stick
5. Deglaze with 1 / 2 cup white wine or chicken broth
6. Gradually add 2 cups of chicken broth stirring constantly
7. Remove from heat while rice is still al dente
8. It is best served when the rice is a bit crunchy
9. Add parmesan cheese and butter
10. Serve immediately
11. Mushroom risotto:
12. Add 1 / 2 cup chopped mushrooms of your choice to the onions
13. Use red wine instead of the white

title: lebanese syrian bazella
steps:
1. Cut onion in to small pieces
2. Do not mince or chop too finely , but at the same time , do not cut or chop too coarsely
3. Set aside
4. Wash carrots and cut them into 1 / 4" thick pieces
5. Basically , you don't want them too thin or they will disintegrate into the broth
6. You can peel them if you prefer , before cutting
7. Set aside
8. In a large frying pan , brown the meat with some seasoning salt and pepper
9. Add the onion and some olive oil from the bottle
10. Make sure all the meat is brown
11. Set aside
12. In a stew pan , fry the 3 tbsp of tomato paste in the 1 / 4 cup olive oil for about 5-8 minutes
13. If it seems dry-looking , add a small amount of extra oil at a time
14. It should look chunky in the oil , not runny like soup
15. Stir constantly , it will burn very fast !
16. Reduce the heat , add first 2 cups of water
17. Stand back , it may spit at you ! keep adding until all 6 cups have been added
18. Add the soup cubes
19. Let this boil for 5 minutes
20. Scrape the bottom of the pan , making sure all of the tomato paste mixes in the water
21. Add the meat , carrots and peas
22. Allow to come to a boil then reduce heat to a simmer
23. Add salt and pepper to your taste
24. Cook until meat is tender
25. Cooking time depends on the quality of meat
26. Serve with middle eastern rice
27. Extra water may be added to counter-act any saltiness or if too much evaporated out while cooking
28. Cooking times may vary depending on stove type
29. Just keep on eye on it and never walk away from cooking food ! stainless steel or a non-stick pan may be used
30. I prefer non-stick
31. This may also be transferred to a large crock pot and set on low
32. Yield depends on how much water is allowed to boil out , but pretty much it makes a lot ! count on leftovers if you're not having people over

title: asparagus with lemon browned butter sauce
steps:
1. Snap off or trim ends from asparagus
2. Steam in a large pot of water or asparagus steamer for 3 to 5 minutes , or until crisp-tender
3. Drain and transfer to a medium bowl and keep warm
4. Melt butter in a medium skillet
5. Cook over medium-high heat until butter just begins to brown and foam , being careful not to burn
6. Remove from heat and stir in garlic
7. Swirl pan several times , then stir in lemon juice and vinegar
8. Pour over hot asparagus and season with salt and pepper
9. Toss gently to mix
10. Transfer to a platter and sprinkle with thyme and lemon zest , optional

title: tandoori baked flat breads   naan
steps:
1. 1
2. Combine the yeast , 1 tablespoon of the sugar and 1 / 4 cup of the water in a large bowl and let stand until foamy , 5 to 10 minutes
3. Stir in the remaining sugar , the remaining water , the egg , milk , and salt
4. Add 4 cups of the flour and stir to form a dough that is soft and pliable , but not sticky
5. Knead the dough until smooth and elastic either by hand on a floured work surface , in a food processor , or a in mixer fitted with the dough hook
6. Add more flour , if necessary
7. It should take 6 to 8 minutes
8. 2
9. Use 1 / 2 tablespoon of the oil to lightly oil a large bowl
10. Place the dough in the bowl , brush the top with the remaining oil , cover with a clean kitchen towel , and let rise in a warm , draft-free spot until doubled in bulk , 1 to 1 1 / 2 hours
11. Punch down the dough and pinch off 2-inch pieces
12. Roll them between your palms into smooth balls
13. You should have 14 to 16 balls
14. Place the balls on a lightly floured baking sheet and cover with a lightly dampened clean kitchen towel
15. Let rise again until puffy , about 30 minutes
16. 3
17. Preheat the grill to high
18. 4
19. When ready to cook , place a rolling pin , cutting board , bowl of flour , and the melted butter near the grill
20. Roll out a dough ball on a lightly floured cutting board to form a disk about 5 inches in diameter
21. Gently slap the disk from one hand to the other to stretch it into an elongated 7- to 8-inch circle
22. Stretch the circle into a traditional teardrop shape and immediately lay it on the hot grate
23. 5
24. Cook the bread until the bottom is crusty and browned and the top is puffed and blistered , 2 to 4 minutes
25. Brush with butter
26. Invert the naan and grill the other side until lightly browned , 2 to 4 minutes
27. Prepare the remaining naan the same way
28. Brush each naan with more butter as it comes off the grill and serve while piping hot
29. Serve whole , or cut each naan into 3 wedges to serve the traditional way

title: garlic rosemary aioli
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients except oil in food processor
2. Blend till combined
3. While machine is running slowly pour in oil in thin steady stream
4. Continue to add oil until mayonnaise reaches desired thickness
5. Do not over beat

title: shredded chicken for tacos in a crock pot
steps:
1. Put all ingredients in the crock pot cook on low for 6-8 hours
2. Shred chicken and serve in taco shells

title: bumble bees
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl , mix peanut butter and honey
2. Stir in dry milk powder , sesame seed and wheat germ
3. Mix well
4. Lay wax paper on a cookie sheet
5. Using a teaspoon , shape and scoop up 1 tsp of peanut butter mixture into oval shapes , to look like bees
6. Place on cookie sheet
7. Dip a toothpick into cocoa
8. Press gently across bees to make the stripes
9. Stick 2 almonds slices into each side , for wings
10. Chill in refrigerator for 30 minutes

title: vegetable soup with tiny meatballs
steps:
1. Heat beef broth to boiling
2. Add veggies and oregano and simmer 12 minutes
3. Add pasta to bubbling soup
4. Cook until pasta is almost done
5. Drop tiny meatballs into soup
6. Simmer 2 minutes
7. Season with salt and pepper
8. Serve with grated paremsan cheese
9. Mini meatballs: soak 2 slices dry bread or toast in water
10. Squeeze out moisture
11. Lightly mix bread with 1 lb ground beef , egg , garlic and salt
12. Form in 3 / 4 inch balls using 1 teaspoon mixture for each
13. Brown in butter - makes 5 dozen

title: rhubarb ketchup
steps:
1. In a saucepan combine all ingredients and bring to a boil
2. Remove from heat for 30 minutes
3. Cover and simmer over medium heat for 5 minutes until rhubarb is tender
4. Remove orange zest and discard
5. Puree with a hand blender or pour into blender
6. Check seasoning
7. Pour into covered bowl and refrigerate

title: italian pasta and beans
steps:
1. Cook pasta per package directions and drain off half of the water
2. Saute onion and garlic in the oil
3. Add the parsley , salt , pepper , tomato sauce and bouillon cube and simmer for 5 minutes
4. Add the sauce and the beans to the pasta and water and simmer for another 5 minutes
5. Add the cheese and serve

title: italian turkey  burgers
steps:
1. Combine turkey , olives , and oregano
2. Mix well
3. Form into four patties
4. Season to taste
5. Drizzle with olive oil
6. Grill turkey until done
7. Just prior to being done add cheese so it will melt
8. Meanwhile toast bread
9. Spread pesto on the inside of toasted "buns"
10. Place cooked turkey patties on bun and top with tomato and roasted peppers
11. Enjoy

title: jean s chinese cabbage salad
steps:
1. Melt butter in fry pan
2. Add noodles broken in pieces
3. Add almonds and sesame seeds
4. Saute on a medium-low heat until golden brown
5. Set aside to cool
6. Mix salad oil , sugar vinegar , soy sauce , raman seasoning and salt and pepper
7. Set aside
8. Mix cabbage , onions , carrots , and chicken
9. Mix browned noodle mixture with cabbage mixture
10. Toss with dressing
11. Enjoy

title: spiced rum breakfast coffee
steps:
1. In basket of drip coffee make place coffee grounds , cinnamon stick , and the 3 cardamom seed pods broken open
2. Add 10 cups of water and brew
3. When done brewing add 1 teaspoon rum extract to brewed coffee
4. Serve
5. Can add milk and sweetener if you like

title: creamy cauliflower soup   ww friendly
steps:
1. Clean and chop the leeks and celery
2. Heat oil in a large nonstick sauce pan , over medium heat
3. Add the leeks and celery , stir frequently , cook until softened , not browned , about 4 minutes
4. Add the broth and cauliflower , bring to boil
5. Cover and simmer until the cauliflower is tender , about 10-15 minutes
6. Remove from heat
7. In batches or with a blender stick , puree to desired texture
8. You may want to spoon out and reserve some cauliflower pieces for added texture
9. Stir in half & half and nutmeg and blend
10. Top with grated cheddar cheese

title: pressure cooker albondigas soup
steps:
1. Heat oil in the pressure cooker over medium heat& saute onions& garlic until soft
2. Add tomato sauce , stock and carrots and bring to boil
3. Mix meat , rice , egg and spices together and form into small meat balls
4. Drop meatballs into boiling stock
5. Seal cooker and bring up to high pressure
6. Stabilize pressure and cook for 10 minutes
7. Quick release
8. Serve with grated pepper jack cheese

title: australian coleslaw
steps:
1. Add the first 3 ingredients to a bowl
2. Mix the remaining ingredients into a sauce and pour over the veggies
3. Mix thoroughly and refrigerate for at least 2 hours

title: new zealand apple dessert club sandwiches
steps:
1. Beat the cream cheese , sour cream , honey and orange zest together in a small bowl with an electric mixer
2. Spread each slice of pound cake evenly with the mixture
3. Core and slice the apple
4. Assemble the sandwiches: lay the apple slices on 4 of the cake slices , dividing equally
5. Top with 4 more of the cake slices followed by the strawberry slices , and cover with the remaining cake slices
6. Cut the sandwiches in half on the diagonal , then secure with a decorative pick
7. Serve immediately , or cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until ready to serve

title: citrus marinated mushrooms  cooking light
steps:
1. Combine first 7 ingredients in a small saucepan
2. Bring to a boil
3. Cook 1 minute or until sugar dissolves
4. Remove from heat
5. Stir in orange rind , oils , and lime rind
6. Combine vinegar mixture and mushrooms in a large bowl
7. Toss well to combine
8. Cover
9. Refrigerate overnight
10. Add parsley
11. Toss to combine

title: con queso bean dip  microwave
steps:
1. In a 1-qt
2. Microwave-safe casserole , , mash the beans with a fork
3. Stir in the salsa , chili powder , cumin , and salt , if desired
4. Stir to mix well
5. Stir in the cheese
6. Cover with the casserole lid , and microwave on high power for 3 to 4 minutes until heated through
7. Remove from the microwave
8. Stir to mix in the melted cheese
9. Spread the sour cream on top
10. Sprinkle with the chives
11. Serve warm with tortilla chips
12. Cover and refrigerate leftovers , which will keep 4 to 5 days

title: herbed potato salad with bacon and peas
steps:
1. In a small bowl , whisk all dressing ingredients together until well blended
2. Set aside
3. Cook potatoes in boiling salted water for about 12 minutes
4. Drain , let cool to touch , and cut into quarters
5. Cook fresh peas in salted boiling water for 6 minutes , frozen peas for 3 minutes
6. Drain under cold water and let cool
7. In a large bowl , toss still-warm potatoes with about half of dressing and let cool
8. Combine with peas and bacon and add remaining dressing
9. Taste and adjust seasoning

title: tomato corn salsa
steps:
1. Blanch and drain the corn
2. In a large bowl , combine all of the ingredients and set aside for the flavors to blend
3. Serve at room temperature

title: grilled s mores
steps:
1. Top one graham cracker square with one candy bar half , one marshmallow and another graham cracker square
2. Repeat with remaining graham crackers , candy and marshmallows
3. Center one s'more on each foil sheet
4. Wrap and seal to form four packets , leaving room for heat circulation inside packets
5. Grill , indirect heat , 4 - 5 minutes in covered grill until marshmallows are melted
6. Open carefully and enjoy !

title: cheesy chocolate chip squares
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Cut one roll of cookie mix into 1 / 4 inch slices
3. Put slices in ungreased 9 x 13 pan
4. In bowl , blend 16 oz
5. Cream cheese , at medium speed , until softened
6. Add sugar and blend well
7. Add eggs and vanilla and mix thoroughly
8. Pour evenly over slices in the pan
9. Cut 2nd roll of cookie mix into 1 / 4 inch slices
10. Place in pan , on top of mixture
11. Sprinkle chopped walnuts on top
12. Bake 45 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
13. Cool completely , slice in squares
14. Store in refrigerator

title: flavoured rice
steps:
1. Wash rice in a bowl several times until the water is no longer starchy
2. Heat up the butter in a medium size pot
3. Add onion & stir through washed rice quickly
4. Add water
5. For the perfect amount of water for cooking time , put water into pot with rice and use your middle finger , rest the
6. G
7. The whole
8. Add spices
9. Bring to the boil , stir thoroughly
10. Do not boil for long just bring to the boil then reduce heat
11. Reduce heat to simmer and put lid on the rice
12. Keep on low heat until all the water has evaporated
13. Remove spices and serve
14. Cooking time is approximate and depending on how much rice you are cooking , but is very quick to make

title: fried plantains
steps:
1. Combine flour , cinnamon , pepper and sugar in a zip-top plastic bag
2. Heat butter in a shallow skillet until melted
3. Peel plantains and slice into 1 / 2-inch thick rounds , then add to flour mixture and shake well
4. Remove plantain slices from bag , shaking off excess flour mixture , and place in prepared skillet
5. Fry 4 minutes on each side , or until golden brown and crisp
6. Drain on paper towels and serve hot
7. If desired , drizzle with a little honey to make a dessert instead of a side dish

title: panko salmon
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400f
2. Set the salmon on a foil-lined baking sheet skin side down
3. Sprinkle with salt and pepper
4. In a small bowl , combine the honey mustard and 1 teaspoon of the thyme
5. In another small bowl , mix the panko with the remaining 1 teaspoon of thyme , 4 teaspoons of olive oil , parsley , and paprika
6. Add salt and pepper
7. Using a small spoon , spread the mustard mixture on the salmon
8. Top with the bread crumb mixture
9. Roast the salmon for 12-14 minutes or until it is almost completely firm to the touch and flakes when poked with a fork
10. Serve at once

title: chocolate dipped butterscotch logs
steps:
1. In large bowl , beat butter on medium to high speed for 30 seconds
2. Add brown sugar , baking powder , and salt
3. Beat until combined , scraping sides of bowl occasionally
4. Beat in egg and vanilla until combined
5. Beat in as much of the flour as you can with the mixer
6. Stir in any remaining flour and the butterscotch pieces
7. Divide dough in half
8. Shape each half into a 9 inch long log
9. Flatten so logs are about 2 inches wide
10. Wrap logs in plastic wrap or waxed paper
11. Chill for 2 hours or until firm
12. Preheat oven to 350f using a sharp knife , cut logs crosswise into inch slices
13. Place slices 1 inch apart on un-greased cookie sheet
14. Bake in preheated oven for 8 10 minutes or until edges are lightly browned
15. Transfer to wire rack and cool
16. Meanwhile , spread almonds in a single layer in a shallow baking pan
17. Toast in the 350f oven for 5 10 minutes or until light golden brown , stirring occasionally
18. Remove from oven and cool
19. In a small saucepan , combine chocolate pieces and shortening
20. Cook and stir over low heat until melted
21. Dip ends of cookies into melted chocolate
22. Place cookies on waxed paper
23. Sprinkle almonds on chocolate
24. Let stand for 30 minutes or until chocolate is set
25. To store: place cookies in layers separated by waxed paper in an airtight container
26. Store at room temp for up to 3 days

title: grilled vegetable muffuletta
steps:
1. Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium-heat
2. Lightly brush the eggplant , zucchini , bell pepper , portobello and red onion with 1 / 4 cup of olive oil
3. Season with salt and pepper
4. Cover and grill , turning once , until charred , about 6 minutes
5. Using a food processor , puree the spinach , pine nuts and parmigiano-reggiano
6. Season with salt and pepper
7. With the machine one , drizzle in the remaining 1 / 4 cup of olive oil
8. Transfer the pesto to a bowl
9. Rinse the food processor
10. Using the food processor , pulse the giardiniera and olives into a coarse relish
11. Slice the top quarter off the bread and scoop out the insides
12. Spread half the pesto on the inside of the bread , layer with half of the grilled vegetables , then spoon the remaining pesto on top
13. Fill the bread with the remaining vegetables and top with the provolone
14. Spread the inside of the bread top with the vegetable relish and set into place
15. Press down firmly , then cut into wedges

title: cheesy carrot and rice casserole
steps:
1. Beat the egg
2. Mix egg with carrots , rice , onion , salt and pepper
3. Mix in 1 cup of chedder cheese with other ingredients
4. Pour into a greased casserole dish
5. Dot the top with the butter
6. Bake in a 375 degree oven for 35 minutes
7. Remove from oven and sprinkle the rest of the cheese over the top and cover with foil long enough for cheese to melt
8. Prep time includes cookin rice and carrots

title: grilled cheese quesadillas
steps:
1. Combine cheeses
2. Lightly butter sheet of aluminum foil 3-4 inches larger than tortillas
3. Place tortilla on middle of foil
4. Sprinkle one-thired of the cheese over tortilla , then one-third of the scallions
5. Top with second tortilla and press lightly together
6. Fold foil loosely over edge of tortillas , leaving most of the top exposed
7. Repeat with remaining tortillas , cheese , and scallions
8. When grill is waqrming and before it is hot enough to grill meat , place 1 or 2 foil packages , foil side down , on grill
9. Grill until cheese melts , about 4 minutes
10. Dlip packages and grill until top is lightly toasted , 1-2 minutes
11. Immediately cut each quesadilla into 6 wedges and serve hot
12. Grill remaining quesadilas

title: spinach  chicken  and wild rice soup  slow cooker
steps:
1. In slow cooker , combine the water , broth , cream of chicken soup , uncooked wild rice , thyme , and pepper
2. Cover and cook on low for 7 to 8 hours or on high for 3-1 / 2 to 4 hours
3. To serve , stir in chicken and spinach

title: frank s redhot buffalo chicken wings
steps:
1. If frank's redhot buffalo wings sauce is not available , mix together the frank's red hot sauce with the butter
2. Bake wings in foil-lined pan at 500f on lowest oven rack for 20 to 25 minutes until crispy , turning once
3. Alternatively: deep-fry at 375f for 10 minutes
4. Or broil 6-inches from heat 15 to 20 minutes , turning once
5. Or grill over medium heat 20 to 25 minutes turning often
6. Toss wings in buffalo wings sauce to coat
7. Serve with blue cheese dip and / or cucumber slices and / or celery slices if desired

title: docinho de nozes  walnut candies
steps:
1. Heat the condensed milk , walnuts , and butter in a heavy saucepan over medium heat until the mixture thickens , about 15 minutes
2. Make sure you keep mixing the pan constantly with a wooden spoon
3. When the mixture begins to "dis-glue" from the pan or when you can see the bottom of the pan after scraping the wooden spoon on the bottom of the pan , you know the cooking process is over
4. This will happen shortly after the mixture reaches boiling point
5. Remove from heat and transfer mixture on a well greased plate
6. Let cool for 15 minutes
7. Grease your hands well and form 1 inch balls with your hands
8. Roll the balls into a plate full of finely chopped walnutes
9. Cover the ball well with the walnuts
10. You may need to wash your hands in between rolling out these candies , because after a while the mixture will begin clinging to your hands
11. Wash out your hands , grease them up again and begin rolling again
12. Serve in miniature paper liners

title: cherry soup
steps:
1. In a large heavy saucepan , stir together all the ingredients except the cherries
2. Over medium heat , stir until thickened & smooth
3. Stir in cherries & cook for 1 minute
4. Pour into serving bowl , then cover & chill
5. Discard cinnamon stick before serving

title: steaks balmoral
steps:
1. Pan fry the steaks to desired 'doneness' and keep warm
2. In a separate pan , melt the butter
3. Saut the chopped shallot until soft
4. Add the whisky to the pan and carefully set it alight
5. When the flame goes out add the grain mustard , stock and mushrooms
6. Add the cream and bring to the boil
7. Simmer gently until the sauce has reduced by half , stirring from time to time
8. Add the chopped parsley just before serving
9. Season well
10. Pour over steaks to serve

title: shake n bake for chicken
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients in food processor and whirl until blended
2. Store in refrigerator
3. When ready to use , dip chicken pieces in 1 / 2 cup of evaporated milk and then coat with shake-n-bake mixture
4. Place chicken in shallow pan , skin side up
5. Bake in 375f oven for 30 minutes
6. After 30 minutes spray chicken with a light misting of oil
7. Return to oven and bake about 20 minutes longer or until juices run clear

title: reame s baked italian beef   noodles
steps:
1. Cook noodles in boiling water 20 minutes and drain
2. While noodles are cooking , brown ground chuck and sautee onions
3. Add spices , mushrooms and 1 cup shredded cheddar cheese
4. Poor cooked noodles and meat mixture into a 2 quart casserole
5. Top with tomato sauce
6. Bake in a preheated 350 degree oven for 25 minutes
7. Top with remaining cheddar cheese , sprinkle the top with grated parmesan cheese , and bake in oven for 5 more minutes , until cheese melts

title: pink lemonade margarita
steps:
1. Combine the first 3 ingredients in a cocktail shaker with 3 / 4 cup ice and shake vigorously
2. Pour into glass
3. Top with lemon-lime beverage , and garnish with lemon

title: glazed honey mustard pretzels
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 250 degrees
2. Spray a large roasting pan with non-stick cooking spray and put pretzels in it
3. Combine margarine , mustard , honey , garlic salt and onion powder
4. Microwave or heat on stove until hot
5. Drizzle over pretzels while stirring carefully to coat well
6. Bake for one hour , stirring every 15 minutes
7. Pour out onto waxed paper and quickly separate into a single layer
8. Cool completely
9. Store in sealed bag or container

title: strawberry blonde  adult beverage
steps:
1. Mix creme de cacao and cola in tall glass , place ice in glass
2. Float cream on top of cola mixture
3. Add a splash of grenadine

title: the simple but perfect pancake
steps:
1. Beat the eggs , milk , and vanilla until light and foamy , about 3 minute at high speed of a mixer
2. Stir in butter or oil
3. Whisk the dry ingredients together and gently , but quickly , mix into the egg and milk mixture
4. Let the batter relax while griddle is heating the batter will thicken upon resting
5. Grease and preheat griddle
6. The griddle is ready if a drop of water will skitter across the surface , evaporating immediately
7. Drop cupfuls of batter on the lightly greased griddle
8. Cook on one side until bubbles begin to form and break , then turn the pancakes and cook the other side until brown

title: arabian spinach
steps:
1. In a large wok , fry onion in oil for about 5 minutes , until softened
2. Add the garlic and cumin , and then fry for another minute
3. Add spinach in stages , stirring until leaves begin to wilt
4. Stir in chickpeas , butter and salt and pepper to taste
5. Reheat

title: kittencal s 5 minute cinnamon flop brunch cake
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees f
2. Prepare a greased 13 x 9-inch baking dish , or two 8 or 9-inch round cake pans
3. In a bowl mix the 2 cups flour , 1-1 / 4 cups white sugar , milk , vanilla or almond extract , baking powder , pinch of salt and egg until just combined careful not to overmix
4. Pour into prepared baking pan / s
5. Generously spread brown sugar and cinnamon on top
6. If desired sprinkle chopped walnuts or pecans over top
7. Drizzle melted butter over top
8. Bake for about 20-25 minutes for 8 or 9-inch round cake pan , and about 30 minutes for a 13 x 9-inch pan

title: chicken and vegetable bake
steps:
1. Sprinkle chicken with pepper and garlic powder
2. Put chicken in bottom of slow cooker
3. Pour half of the dressing over meat , making sure all pieces are glazed
4. Add potatoes , vege's and water chestnuts
5. Pour remaining dressing over them , making sure vege's are all lightly coated
6. Cover
7. Cook on high 4 hrs or on low 7-8 hours

title: good ole  gumbo
steps:
1. Have all the vegetables chopped and ready before beginning the gumbo
2. Dice half of the sausage
3. Cut rounds of the remaining sausage
4. In a heavy soup pot , combine flour and oil and optional bacon fat to form the roux
5. Cook over medium heat , whisking constantly , until the color of coffee
6. This will take 20 minutes or more
7. Do not walk away from the stove as the flour will burn and cause you to start again
8. Once the roux is finished , lower heat to medium low , and add all the chopped veggies except the okra
9. Cook stirring constantly until the veggies begin to sweat
10. The roux will absorb the sweat so watch carefully
11. Again , do not walk away
12. Once the veggies begin to sweat , add the tomato paste and stir until distributed
13. Add all the dry spices
14. Slowly add the chicken stock , stirring to avoid lumps
15. Add the chopped sausage and browned chicken
16. Cover and simmer until the chicken is cooked thru
17. Remove the chicken from the pot , and tear into bite sized pieces
18. Reserve
19. Add the okra and cook until tender , about 10 minutes
20. Return chicken to the pot , and add remainder of the sausage
21. Taste for seasoning and add salt or pepper to taste
22. In the last few minutes before you are ready to eat , add the shrimp to the simmering gumbo , and cover
23. Heat for two minutes and then turn off heat
24. Allow to sit for another 5 minutes
25. Serve over rice

title: mom s gingerbread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease 9" x 9" baking pan
3. Cream molasses , sugar , shortening and eggs
4. Set aside
5. Boil water , stir in baking soda , set aside
6. Sift together remaining dry ingredients , blend into creamed mixture
7. Add boiled water with baking soda , mix well
8. Bake at 350 degrees for 35 minutes

title: praline pecan crunch snack mix
steps:
1. Heat oven to 250f
2. Spray 13 x 9-inch baking pan with cooking spray
3. Combine cereal and pecans in pan
4. Mix well
5. In large microwaveable bowl , combine sugar , corn syrup and margarine
6. Microwave on high 1 minute 30 seconds
7. Stir
8. Microwave an additional 30 seconds to 1 minute 30 seconds or until boiling
9. Stir vanilla and baking soda and optional salt into sugar mixture
10. Pour over cereal mixture
11. Stir to coat evenly
12. Bake 1 hour , stirring every 15 minutes
13. Transfer to baking sheet , spreading mixture in even layer
14. Cool completely
15. Break into pieces
16. Store tightly covered at room temperature

title: beef tagine with brussels sprouts
steps:
1. Season beef cubes with salt and pepper
2. Heat olive oil in a dutch oven over medium-high heat
3. Add the turmeric and fry for 30 seconds
4. Add the beef and brown well on all sides
5. Cover the pot tightly and cook the meat 15 minutes over low heat in its own juices
6. Stir in the paprika , cayenne , ginger , cumin , onion , and half the cilantro
7. Add about 1 / 2 water , re-cover the pot , and simmer the meat gently over low heat for 1
8. 5 to 2 hours
9. Check periodically to see if water needs to be replenished
10. While the mixture simmers , bring 6 cups of water to a boil and add 1 t of salt
11. Blanch the sprouts for 30 seconds , drain , run under cold water and drain well
12. Heat oil in a large wok or skillet over high heat till almost smoking
13. Stir-fry the brussels sprouts for 2-3 minutes over high heat
14. Stir in half of the lemon juice and add salt to taste
15. Fold the sprouts , the remaining cilantro , and the remaining lemon juice carefully into the stew
16. Tasts again for seasoning and serve immediately

title: emeril s burger seasoning
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a mixing bowl and stir to blend thoroughly
2. Store in an airtight container
3. Use 2 to 3 teaspoons per pound of ground beef , turkey , or chicken

title: quick whipping cream biscuits
steps:
1. Cut 1 cup butter into flour with a pastry blender or fork until crumbly
2. Add whipping cream , stirring just until dry ingredients are moistened
3. Turn dough out onto a light floured surface and knead lightly 3 or 4 times
4. Roll or pat dough to 3 / 4 inch thickness
5. Cut with a 2-inch round cutter , and place biscuits on a lightly greased baking sheet
6. Bake at 400 degrees f
7. For 13-15 minutes
8. Brush warm biscuits with 1 / 2 cup melted butter

title: queen of puddings
steps:
1. Set oven to 350f or mark 4
2. Butter a 1 pint pie dish
3. Put the breadcrumbs , butter , 1 oz of the sugar , and the lemon rind into a bowl and mix together
4. Heat the milk in a pan and pour over the breadcrumb mixture
5. Beat the egg yolks and mix into the breadcrumbs
6. Pour into the pie dish and bake for about 35 minutes until set
7. Remove from the oven and spread the jam on top of the pudding
8. Reduce the oven to 300f or mark 2
9. Whisk the egg whites stiffly and fold in the remaining caster sugar
10. Pile this meringue on top of the jam layer and sprinkle with caster sugar
11. Bake for about another 30 minutes until the meringue is firm and brown on top

title: frozen snicker pie
steps:
1. Using a large mixing bowl let the ice cream soften , with an electric mixer mix in the dry pudding mix and peanut butter
2. With a spatula fold in the cool whip lite
3. Pour into the pie crust
4. Cover the pie with plastic wrap or the dome cover included with the pie crust and place in the freezer for at least two hours
5. Remove from freezer 10 minutes before serving
6. This can be refrozen
7. Diabetic exchanges: 1 / 2 meat , 1 1 / 2 starch , 1 fat

title: cheesy tuna macaroni casserole
steps:
1. Prepare macaroni and cheese dinner according to package directions
2. Mix together remaining ingredients in a large bowl
3. Stir in macaroni and cheese
4. Spoon tuna mixture into a lightly greased 1 1 / 2 quart baking dish
5. Bake at 350 degrees for 18-20 minutes or until lightly browned

title: lemon crisps
steps:
1. Cream shortening and add sugars
2. Add lemon juice , rind , eggs
3. Mix dry ingredients and add
4. Form dough into small balls
5. Place on a greased cookie sheet and flatten
6. Bake 350f for 10-12 mins

title: middle eastern fish or salmon with peppers and tomatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. In large saute pan or skillet , saute the onions , red bell peppers , green bell peppers and jalapeno in olive oil for about 5 minutes on med heat
3. Don't let them color
4. Add garlic , stir and cook 1 minute
5. Add tomatoes , broken up by hand , with all the juice from the can
6. Add 1 / 2 cup water
7. Add everything else except the fish
8. Stir and cook for about 2 minutes
9. Taste and correct seasoning if necessary
10. Put 1 / 3 of the tomato mixture in a 9x13 roasting dish
11. Arrange fish on tomato mixture
12. Spread the rest of the hot tomato mixture over the fish
13. Bake until fish is just done , about 10-15 minutes , depending upon the thickness of your fish - check it after 5 minutes or so to see how it's doing

title: best roasted corn on the cob
steps:
1. Shuck the corn almost to the bottom of the cob and remove as much silk as possible
2. Plunge the corn into a buck of cold water along with about 1 / 2 cup of sugar and let set at least 2 hours --
3. While the coals are heating or gas grill is coming to heat --
4. Partially dry corn that has been soaking and rub with butter and salt and pepper --
5. Pull the shucks back up and tie at the top with a piece of shuck or string
6. Place the corn on an outdoor grill and cover them with a wet , wrung out gunny sack to keep in the steam
7. Roast 15-20 minutes , turning frequently or until the corn is cooked through and smells irrestible --

title: chicken caesar tortellini with toasted almonds
steps:
1. Cook tortellini in salted water
2. Rinse tortellini under cold running water until cool
3. Drain
4. Stir dressing with black pepper and basil
5. Add tortellini -- avoid breaking up the pasta
6. Salad can be covered and refrigerated for up to a day
7. When ready to serve , gently fold in chicken and nuts
8. Sprinkle parmesan over top

title: bacon n  ranch dip
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients in bowl & cover
2. Refrigerate at least 1 hour

title: vegetarian pasta casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit
2. Spray nonstick cooking spray on 13x9x2" baking pan
3. Put baking pan in oven to warm while preheating
4. Cook the rigatoni in salted water
5. While the rigatoni is cooking , combine the tomatoes , cottage cheese , red pepper flakes , thyme , salt , pepper , and cannelini beans in a large bowl
6. Add the cooked rigatoni to the tomato mixture and combine well
7. Pour into the baking pan
8. Top with grated mozzarella
9. Bake in 400 degree oven for 30 minutes
10. Allow to stand for 10 minutes before serving

title: spaghetti casserole
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , brown hamburger , onion , and garlic
2. Drain grease when done
3. Add tomato paste , tomato sauce , diced tomatos , basil , oregano , italian seasoning , bay leaves , salt , pepper , sugar and water in same saucepan as hamburger
4. Stir the sauce until well mixed
5. Cover and bring to a simmer
6. Cook for 2 hours stirring often
7. When sauce is almost done preheat oven to 350 degrees
8. Also , boil the noodles
9. When done drain , rinse , and set aside
10. When sauce is done , remove bay leaves
11. Spoon a thin layer of sauce on a 9x13" pan
12. Start the layering with noodles then lay some shredded cheese on top
13. Then layer some sauce and then some parmesian cheese
14. Repeat layers ending with sauce and sprinkled with parmesian cheese
15. Bake covered with foil for 30 minutes
16. Uncover and bake for 15 more minutes
17. Take out and let set for atleast 15-20 minutes before cutting
18. Serve with salad and garlic bread

title: it s greek to me chicken breasts  somersize level 1
steps:
1. Combine lemon juice , olive oil , garlic , oregano and salt in desired quantities
2. Marinate chicken breasts in seasoning mixture for two hours
3. Seal in a foil packet and bake at 350 degrees for 20-30 minutes or until chicken is cooked through

title: poached cod in tomato sauce
steps:
1. Heat oil in large skillet
2. Add the onion and garlic
3. Cook till soft
4. Add the crushed tomatoes and capers and simmer for 10 minutes or so
5. Add the cod and simmer till flaky
6. Add the basil and serve

title: cheesy hot pizza dip
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl , beat cream cheese and italian seasoning
2. Spread in an ungreased 9-inch microwave-safe pie plate
3. Combine mozzarella and parmesan cheeses
4. Sprinkle half over the cream cheese
5. Top with the pizza sauce , remaining cheese mixture , green pepper and onion
6. Microwave , uncovered , on high for 3-4 minutes or until cheese is almost melted , rotating a half turn several times
7. Let stand for 1-2 minutes
8. Serve with tortilla chips

title: a masterpiece cheesecake
steps:
1. Crust:
2. Mix well and pat into greased 9-inch spring form pan
3. Place in refrigerator
4. While making filling
5. Filling:
6. Beat well and pour into pie crust
7. Bake in 350 degree f oven for 20 minutes only
8. Remove and cool
9. Cake may be decorated with any variety of fruits , canned or in season

title: garden fresh fettuccine
steps:
1. Cook fettuccine according to package directions
2. Meanwhile , in a large skillet , saute the zucchini , peppers , onions and garlic until tender
3. Add the tomatoes , salt , pepper , and pepper flakes
4. Saute 4-5 minutes longer
5. Drain pasta and add to vegetable mixture
6. Toss to coat and sprinkle with cheese
7. I liked putting a little sprinkle of fresh parsley over the top

title: pork tenderloin with cumberland sauce
steps:
1. Heat 2 tsp oil in a nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
2. Season pork lightly with salt and pepper and cook for 4 to 5 minutes per side , or until brown on the outside and no longer pink but still juicy inside
3. Transfer to plates or a platter and keep warm
4. Add remaining 1 tsp oil to the skillet
5. Add onions or shallots and cook , stirring , until softened , about 30 seconds
6. Add wine and bring to a boil , stirring
7. Boil for 5 to 6 minutes , or until reduced to about 1 / 3 cup
8. Dissolve cornstarch in lemon juice and whisk into the sauce
9. Cook , stirring , until thickened and glossy
10. Remove from heat and stir in jelly , sugar and mustard
11. Taste and adjust seasonings with more salt and pepper , if needed
12. Spoon the sauce over the pork
13. Serves 2 with side dishes , and doubles easily
14. I wouldn't describe it as sweet-and-sour - you'd have to taste it for yourself to know what i mean
15. But i used this recipe the first time i ever cooked pork tenderloin and it's become a recipe i use again and again as a favorite !
16. Posted to gail's recipe swap by liz la , who got it from eating well magazine

title: crunchy toffee chocolate chip cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f lightly grease 2 baking sheets
2. Beat the butter , oil sugars , vanilla , salt and instant coffee in a large bowl until smooth
3. Beat in the vinegar , egg , baking soda and baking powder until well combined
4. Stir in the flours until well combined
5. Stir in the chocolate chips , toffee bits and pecans , if desired
6. The dough wil appear oily
7. Scoop out 1 inch balls and place on baking sheets
8. They don't need to be spaced far apart because they don't spread much
9. I tried flattening some but didn't like them as much
10. Bake 14-16 minutes , reversing trays half way through , until golden brown all over with no hint of softness in the center
11. Remove from oven and allow cookies to cool 5 minutes on baking sheets before transferring to racks or paper bags to cool completely

title: grilled autumn vegetables
steps:
1. Cut aubergine into 1cm thick slices
2. Steam for 4 minutes
3. Cut courgettes diagonally into 5 mm thick slices
4. Brush with 5 ml of the oil
5. Seed and cut peppers lengthways into 8 pieces
6. Grill vegetables , in batches if necessary , under high heat for 4 6 minutes on each side or until tender but firm
7. Transfer to a serving bowl
8. Whisk together remaining oil , vinegar , thyme , water and salt and pepper to taste
9. Pour over hot vegetables and toss to coat
10. Vegetables can be covered and refrigerated for up to one day
11. Serve at room temperature

title: chocolate pecan cakes with choc baileys sauce
steps:
1. Preheat oven to moderate 180c , and grease 10 recesses in 2 6-hole muffin pans , and line the bases and sides of the 10 holes withbaking paper
2. In a small saucepan , melt the chocolate and butter over a low heat , transfer to a large bowl and cool for 10 minutes
3. In a small bowl , using an electric mixer , beatthe sugar and egg yolks together until the mixture is thick and pale
4. Fold the egg mixture , pecan meal , pecans and grated chocolate into the chocolate mixture , until it is just combined
5. In a small bowl , using an electric mixer , beat the egg whites until soft peaks form , fold the egg whites lightly into the chocolate mixture , then spoon into the prepared pans
6. Bake for 25-30 minutes , until cooked when tested with a skewer , and cool in the pan for 10 minutes
