7. Choc-liqueur sauce: combine all the ingredients in a small saucepan , stir over a low heat until smooth
8. To serve: serve the cakes drizzled with the choc-liqueur sauce and sprinkled with nuts
9. The liqueur used in this recipe is baileys irish cream liqueur , which zaar seems reluctant - or unable - to list in quite that form !

title: shanghai chicken and noodles
steps:
1. Cook fettuccine according to the directions on the box
2. Drain well and set aside
3. While fettuccine is cooking spray a nonstick wok or 12 inch skillet with cooking spray
4. Over medium high heat cook chicken for 3 to 4 minutes or until golden brown stirring often
5. Stir in the vegetables and mushrooms cooking for approximately 3 minutes or until tender crisp and chicken is no longer pink in the center
6. Stir the hoisin sauce into the chicken mixture and heat until boiling , stirring constantly
7. Boil and stir for one minute
8. Add well drained fettuccine and toss well until coated and heated through
9. Serve immediately

title: mexican ojarascas cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Sift together all dry ingredients into a bowl and set aside
3. In a large bowl , whip together the shortening and lard until nice and light
4. Add the dry mixture slowly , one cup at a time
5. Place the mixture on the countertop or on a table
6. Add the remaining dry mixture with the water and continue to knead the dough by hand until you form a good nice dough ball
7. Sprinkle some flour on the countertop or on the table and spread out the dough with a rolling pin to a thickness of 1 / 2 inches and use a cookie cutter to make cookies
8. Place on a cookie sheet
9. Bake in preheated oven for about 20 minutes
10. While cookies are being baked , mix together the topping ingredients in a bowl
11. Once the cookies come out of the oven , place one by one in the sugar and cinnamon mixture one at a time and sprinkle them with this mixture
12. Place on a cooling rack to finish cooling

title: rich raspberry brioche
steps:
1. In a small bowl , mix the cheese with the 2 tablespoons of sugar and lemon juice
2. Set aside
3. Butter one side of each slice of bread with the butter and sprinkle the remaining 2 teaspoons sugar over the buttered bread
4. Place 4 slices on your work surface , buttered side down
5. Spread the cheese mixture evenly over the 4 slices
6. Carefully position the raspberries in neat rows over the cheese
7. Place the remaining 4 bread slices on top , buttered side up
8. Cut off the crusts to create a seal
9. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium heat for 2 minutes
10. Put the sandwiches in the skillet , cover and cook for 2 minutes or until the undersides are golden brown and the cheese has begun to soften
11. Uncover and turn the sandwiches over , pressing each one lightly with a spatula to flatten them slightly
12. Cook for one minute or until the undersides are golden brown
13. Turn the sandwiches again , press lightly with the spatula , and cook for 30 seconds or until the cheese is soft and creamy

title: microwave banana surprise
steps:
1. Cut stem ends from bananas
2. Place bananas , enclosed in skins , on a cutting surface with curved ends up in the air
3. Cut length of each banana in half and place flat or cut side down on a large microwave safe plate
4. Arrange all slices so entire plate is covered with bananas
5. Microwave bananas on high till all skins are dark brown or black
6. Remove and let cool enough to handle
7. Remove skins from bananas
8. Scoop or gather all cooked bananas into a mixing bowl and mash or stir thoroughly with a masher or fork
9. Add honey and / or maple syrup to bananas and continue to blend
10. Add chopped nuts , coconut , nutmeg and cinnamon
11. Continue to blend
12. If too thick , add more honey or coconut , nutmeg and cinnamon
13. Continue to blend
14. Spoon mixture into graham cracker shells or pie crust till full
15. Garnish with a half walnut and chill
16. Serve with cool whip or whipped cream topping

title: down south lasagna
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 375 degrees f
2. Heat up a saute pan add meat and season with salt and pepper , cook 2 min add remaining seasons
3. Brown meat breaking any large lumps , until it is no longer pink
4. Remove from heat and drain any excess fat
5. Set aside and allow to cool
6. Meanwhile cook spinach according to package , drain
7. In a medium sized bowl add softened cream cheese , cottage cheese and spinach , mix well
8. In bottom of 13 by 9-inch baking dish spread about half of a cup sauce , now start your layers this will be 3 layers , place 3 lasagna noodles down add cheese mixture , add about 5 to 6 tbs meat then 3-4 tbs sauce on top , repeat till you have 3 layers , top with mozzarella , sprinkle with a little bit dried herbs
9. Cover with foil and bake for 45 min to an hour till middle is hot and top is bubbling

title: grilled steak with creamy herbed goat cheese sauce
steps:
1. In small bowl , mix chavrie , chives , parsley and basil
2. Rub all surfaces of steaks with garlic and season to taste with salt and pepper
3. Grill over medium-high heat or broil 4 to 6 inches from heat to desired doneness
4. Spoon herbed chavrie sauce over steaks
5. To make chiffonade , stack basil leaves and roll up like a jelly roll
6. Cut into thin slices

title: chocolate crispy biscuits
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180 degrees celsius
2. Line a baking tray with baking paper
3. Cream butter and sugar together till pale and creamy
4. Add egg and vanilla and beat till smooth
5. Add remaining ingredients
6. Stir till well combined
7. Place heaped tablespoons of mixture on trays
8. Allow room for spreading
9. Bake 15 - 17 minutes , then cool for 5 minutes
10. Transfer to wire rack

title: nif s pasta and shrimp
steps:
1. Heat oil in large nonstick pan and saute garlic and onion until soft
2. Add dried chili peppers and shrimp
3. Stir until shrimp is almost cooked
4. Add wine and pasta to pan
5. Toss
6. Add remaining ingredients and heat through
7. Serve immediately

title: kettle corn my way
steps:
1. Pour oil and butter into a med sized pot with lid
2. Put on med high heat till butter is melted
3. Stir in sugar and popcorn and cover
4. When corn begins to pop , using potholders , shake every few minutes with top on
5. When pan is full , carefully pour off the popped corn into a bowl
6. Using the lid , open pan partially and scraping off popped corn with lid
7. You may wish to put pan back on oven to pop the rest of corn
8. Be carefull to remove from heat when the corn stops popping or it will burn
9. Sprinkle cooked corn with salt to taste and enjoy

title: surimi snack
steps: 1. Mix it all together

title: chili topped baked potatoes
steps:
1. Put potatoes on microwave plate
2. Prick in several places with a fork
3. Microwave on high 8-10 minutes until tender
4. Heat chili
5. Cut potatoes , top with chili , sour cream , and cheese

title: scrumptious hot cheesy bacon dip
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Fry the bacon and drain on paper towels
3. Chop up the bacon
4. In medium bowl , beat mayonaisse , sour cream , cheeses , green onion , and bacon
5. Fold in tomato
6. Place in bread bowl if desired or put in casserole dish
7. Bake for 20 minutes
8. Serve with assorted crackers or bread

title: pasta with artichokes
steps:
1. To prepare the artichokes , peel the stems , break off any tough outer leaves , and cut off the
2. Chop them finely as they are done , and drop them in a bowl of water acidulated with the lemon juice
3. In a large skillet cook the scallion in the butter over low-medium heat , stirring until softened
4. Drain the artichokes , add them to the skillet , and cook them over medium heat for 5-7 minutes or until tender
5. Stir often
6. Add the tomatoes and cook over moderate heat , stirring , for 1 minute
7. Add the cream and salt and pepper to taste
8. Bring the sauce to a boil and simmer , covered , for one minute
9. Turn off the heat
10. In a large pot of boiling salted water cook the pasta al dente
11. Just before the pasta is done turn on the heat under the sauce to low
12. Drain the pasta well and add it to the skillet
13. Toss the pasta and sauce together
14. Serve the hot pasta with grated parmesan , a piacere

title: marinade for grilled or broiled pork chops
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients and mix well
2. Cover pork chops with the mixture and marinate in this mixture for 24 hours in the refrigerator
3. Remove from sauce when ready to prepare by grilling or broiling the chops until done

title: mongolian lamb
steps:
1. Partially freeze lamb so it's easier to cut and then slice paper thin
2. Soak lamb in cold water for 30 minutes
3. Rinse well under cold running water , drain and squeeze out excess moisture
4. Mix salt , soy sauce , egg , bicarbonate of soda and cornflour in a medium bowl
5. Add lamb to the bowl and mix well
6. Add one tablespoon of peanut oil , mix again , and leave to marinate in refrigerator for two hours
7. Heat one tablespoon of peanut oil in a wok over medium-high heat and stir fry onion wedges and spring onion for one minute
8. Remove and place aside
9. Heat remaining three tablespoons of peanut oil in the wok swirling to cover the surface
10. Stir fry garlic for 5 seconds
11. Add lamb and stir fry over high heat tossing constantly until brown
12. Add all sauce ingredients except the wine and toss a couple of times
13. Return onion and spring onion to the wok
14. Pour wine around the outside of the wok so it sizzles , mix and serve at once over rice

title: roasted asparagus with scrambled eggs
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees
2. Break off the tough ends of the asparagus and , if they're thick , peel them
3. Place the asparagus on a baking sheet , drizzle with olive oil , then toss to coat the asparagus completely
4. Spread the asparagus in a single layer and sprinkle liberally with salt and pepper
5. Roast the asparagus for 15 to 20 minutes , until tender but still crisp
6. Sprinkle with the parmesan cheese and return to the oven for 5 minutes , or until the cheese melts
7. While the asparagus is roasting , whisk the eggs in a bowl with the half-and-half , salt , and pepper to taste
8. Melt 2 tablespoons of butter in a large skillet
9. Cook the eggs on the lowest heat , stirring constantly with a wooden spoon , to the desired doneness
10. Remove from the heat , add 2 more tablespoons of butter , and stir until it melts
11. Check for salt and pepper and serve with the roasted asparagus

title: chocolate covered peanut clusters
steps:
1. Melt the chocolate chips and butterscotch chips together in a heavy pan , or a double boiler
2. Once melted add in peanuts
3. Use a spoon to make clusters on a piece of wax paper
4. Let set for 4-6 hours

title: dogs kraut and taters
steps:
1. In a large frying pan over medium heat , place the kraut with juice , potatoes , and hotdogs
2. Pour beer over top
3. Sprikle with dill and caraway seeds if using them
4. Top off with some cracked black pepper
5. Cover and let it simmer for 7-10 minutes until hot

title: kool aid syrup
steps:
1. Stir the kool-aid and sugar together in a small saucepan
2. Add the water and stir to get it down through the sugar
3. Warm over low heat until the water warms up enough to dissolve the sugar , stirring constantly
4. Don't let it get too hot
5. Once the sugar is dissolved , pour the syrup into a clean bottle - old coffee mate bottles work well
6. Store in the refrigerator
7. To use , add syrup to taste to a glass of cold water

title: tiramisu for atkins dieters
steps:
1. Beat egg whites to stiff peaks and fold in 10 equal packets
2. Beat cheese and egg yolks together , then fold in 14 equal packets
3. Toss ladyfingers in cognac and coffee
4. Butter a pyrex dish and line it with the lady fingers
5. Spoon cheese mixture on top of them
6. Top with egg white mixture
7. If needed , repeat layering process

title: favorite caesar salad dressing
steps:
1. Place garlic cloves , dijon mustard , worcestershire sauce and lemon juice in a blender or food processor and puree until smooth
2. While the machine is working , drizzle olive oil from the feeding tube
3. Add the grated parmesan cheese and puree until thoroughly combined
4. Add salt and pepper to taste
5. Transfer to a bowl and refrigerate the dressing at least an hour to allow the flavors to blend
6. To serve , toss dressing with torn romaine lettuce leaves
7. Add toasted french bread croutons , some grated parmesan and enjoy

title: olive garden portobello mushrooms with mozzarella
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Remove any dirt from mushroom caps with a damp towel and place in a 9x13 , tops down
3. Pour oil and balsamic vinegar over caps and allow to marinate for 1 hour
4. Flip caps over so the tops are up and bake caps in over for 8 - 10 minutes ,
5. Cut mozzarella balls in half and place in a bowl
6. Add pimento or sun-dried tomato , olives , pesto , salt , and pepper , and stir
7. Fill each cap with the mixture and drizzle with marinade
8. Bake caps for 8 - 10 minutes more , or until most of the cheese is melted
9. Garnish with fresh basil leaves and serve

title: kinda sorta sour pickles
steps:
1. Combine onion and cucumber slices in a clean jar
2. Combine the remaining ingredients , with the exception of the garlic , in a non-reactive saucepan
3. Bring to a boil and simmer for 4 full minutes
4. Add the garlic cloves to the jar
5. Slowly pour the pickling liquid over the slices , filling to the top of the jar
6. Cool to room temperature
7. Top off the pickles with any remaining liquid and refrigerate at least overnight

title: lemon berry tart
steps:
1. Melt stick of butter in the microwave
2. Blend together graham cracker crumbs , sugar , butter , cinnamon , and cardamon until it is well incorporated and looks like wet sand
3. Press half the mixture into the sides of a tart pan or pie plate using a measuring cup and your thumb to form the edge
4. Then press the rest of the mixture into the bottom for the base , and pressing firmly and sealing with the sides
5. Put the crust shell into the refrigerator to set up while you construct the fillings
6. In a medium bowl , beat lemon curd with a whisk until it is broken up and easily spread
7. Fold 1 / 3 of the whipped cream into the lemon curd until well incorporated
8. Fold in the remaining cream mixture until combined , and set aside
9. Spread the lemon mixture into the prepared crust , and place back in the fridge
10. In a microwave safe bowl , melt red currant jelly
11. Pour all the berries into the bowl and coat the berries by tossing them with a rubber spatula - taking care not to damage or break up the berries
12. Spread berries over top of the custard mixture , pressing into place
13. Wrap the tart in plastic wrap until ready to serve

title: wilted mustard greens
steps:
1. Cook mustard greens in 2 batches in a 6 to 8 quart pot of boiling salted water , stirring to submerge , until wilted and tender , about 5 minutes
2. Transfer to a large bowl of cold water to stop cooking
3. Drain greens in a colander , pressing to squeeze out excess moisture , then coarsely chop
4. Cook garlic in butter in a 4 to 6 quart heavy pot over moderately low heat , stirring until softened , about 2 minutes
5. Add boiled greens , salt and pepper and cook , covered stirring occasionally until heated through , about 5 minutes

title: low carb summer squash casserole
steps:
1. 1
2. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
3. Steam the fresh squash until very tender on top of the stove for aobut 10 minutes in 1 / 4 cup of water , or in the microwave , and drain
4. 2
5. Mash or puree the squash in a food processor , and in a large skillet saute the bell pepper and onion in the oil until tender
6. Mix the pureed squash , onion mixture , corn , sweetener and cornmeal , and add the salt and pepper
7. 3
8. Place the mixture in a 2-quart casserole dish coated with nonstick cooking spray , and bake for 30 minutes , or until it is bubbly and thoroughly heated , and serve

title: oriental chicken in tortillas
steps:
1. Soak mushrooms in hot water , covered
2. Let stand 30 minutes , drain well
3. Cut mushrooms into thin strips discarding stems , set aside
4. For sauce , stir together soy suce , cornstarch , and 1 / 3c water
5. Set aside
6. Spray cold wok / skillet with cooking spray
7. Preheat , and add eggs
8. Cook in sheet , and cut in narrow bite size strips
9. Set aside
10. Preheat same skillet over high heat
11. Add oil
12. Stir fry garlic for 30 sec
13. Add chicken & stir fry 2-3 minutes or till no longer pink
14. Push from center of wok
15. Stir sauce and pour into center of wok
16. Cook and stir till bubbly , stir in cabbage , bamboo shoots , onions , mushrooms , & egg strips
17. Cover & cook 1 minute or till hot
18. Spoon some of the chicken mixture into each tortilla
19. Roll and serve immediately

title: parmesan baked potatoes
steps:
1. Pour melted margarine into 13x9x2-inch baking pan
2. Sprinkle cheese over margarine
3. Place potatoes with cut side down , over cheese
4. Bake uncovered at 400f for 40-45 minutes

title: fresh herb spaetzle
steps:
1. Part one , the dumplings
2. Blend flour , salt , pepper , and nutmeg in large bowl
3. Whisk in eggs and milk , forming soft batter
4. Mix in half of herbs
5. Bring large pot of salted water to boil
6. Butter large bowl
7. Working with 1 / 3 cup batter at a time and using rubber spatula , press batter directly into boiling water through 1 / 4-inch holes on coarse grater , strainer , or wide ladle
8. Stir spaetzle to separate and boil 2 minutes
9. Using fine sieve , scoop spaetzle from pot , drain well , and transfer to buttered bowl
10. Can be prepared 3 hours ahead
11. Let stand at room temperature
12. Part two , saute dumplings
13. Melt 2 tablespoons butter with 1 tablespoon oil in heavy large skillet over medium heat
14. Add mushrooms
15. Saut until beginning to soften , about 4 minutes
16. Add onion
17. Saut until beginning to soften , about 5 minutes
18. Add remaining 2 tablespoons butter , 1 tablespoon oil , and spaetzle
19. Saut until spaetzle begin to brown , stirring often , about 10 minutes
20. Add 3 / 4 cup broth
21. Simmer until broth is absorbed , adding more broth if dry
22. Mix in remaining herbs
23. Season with salt and pepper

title: marshmallow pudding
steps:
1. Combine marshmallows , and milk
2. Heat until melted
3. Dissolve in pineapple
4. Add whipped cream
5. Put layer of cracker crumbs in bottom of pan
6. Alternate crumbs with pudding mixture

title: bananas over you
steps: 1. Mix all ingredients in blender

title: raspberry meringues
steps:
1. Heat oven to 225f
2. Cover cookie sheets with parchment paper
3. In a small bowl , beat egg whites , cream of tartar and salt until soft peaks form
4. Gradually add sugar , beating until very stiff peaks form--takes about 10 minutes
5. Add raspberry preserves and food color
6. Beat until well blended at highest speed
7. Drop teaspoonfuls of meringue mixture onto paper-lined cookie sheets , or fill a pastry bag fitted with a large star
8. Bake at 225f for 2 hours
9. Cool completely and remove from cookie sheets

title: layered chicken taco salad
steps:
1. Combine chicken , taco seasoning mix and water
2. Cook and stir over medium-low heat 5 to 10 minutes or until sauce is thickened
3. Make guacamole by mixing well
4. Avocados , sour cream , salsa , lemon juice and salt and pepper
5. In a 2-quart glass bowl layer
6. Lettuce , tomato , green onions , chicken mixture , guacamole , olives and cheese
7. Cover and refrigerate 1 hour
8. Top with corn chips before serving

title: vietnamese pickled carrots and daikon radish
steps:
1. Mix the water , vinegar , sugar and salt until the sugar and salt dissolves
2. Place the carrots and radish in a container and cover with the pickling liquid
3. Let pickle for at least and hour and store in the fridge for up to a week

title: falafel croquettes
steps:
1. Place chickpeas , garlic , coriander , cumin , chives , and salt and pepper to taste in a blender or food processor , process until well blended , adding a little water if necessary
2. Divide and roll the chick pea mixture into small balls
3. Fry the croquettes in hot oil , in batches , for about 2 to 3 minutes each , or until golden
4. Drain on paper towel
5. Serve hot

title: two potato moussaka
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 400 degrees
2. Cook red skinned potatoes in microwave for 5-7 minutes
3. Cook yams in microwave for 7-9 minutes
4. In medium skillet , brown beef for 5 minutes
5. Add tomatoes , cinnamon , and cumin
6. Simmer 3 minutes
7. Combine milk , flour , butter , and nutmeg in small saucepan over medium heat , stirring constantly
8. Bring to boil and simmer for 1 minute
9. Season with salt and pepper
10. Remove from heat and whisk in egg yolk
11. Thinly slice potatoes
12. Place half of potatoes and yams on bottom of 2 quart casserole
13. Layer meat mixture , then remaining potatoes and yams
14. Pour sauce on top
15. Sprinkle with parmesan
16. Bake for 30 minutes

title: bacon and chicken pastry pockets
steps:
1. Lay pastry puffs out to defrost while you are cooking chicken and bacon
2. Preheat your oven to 400 degrees
3. Warm cream cheese in the microwave for 30 seconds to soften it so it's easier to stir
4. Place the cream cheese into a mixing bowl with mozzarella cheese , chicken , bacon , and sun-dried tomatoes
5. Stir well to combine thoroughly and set aside
6. Lightly dust a work surface with flour and roll one sheet at a time into a 12 x 12 inch square
7. Cut 4 , 3 inch strips each direction to make 16 squares , 3 x 3 each
8. Cut other pastry puff the same way making a total of 32 squares
9. Place about 2 teaspoons of cream cheese mixture onto each square
10. With your finger , brush a dab of water around the edges of each square and fold over diagonally to make a triangle
11. Press edges together and crimp with a fork to seal
12. After stuffing and folding each pastry , place on a baking sheet
13. Whisk egg and 1 tablespoon water together and brush over the top of each pastry
14. Bake in preheated oven for 15 minutes or until puffed and golden brown
15. Cool 10 minutes before serving
16. Can also be served at room temperature

title: szechuan carrot soup
steps:
1. In a large heavy saucepan cook onion , celery , and garlic in oil over moderately low heat , stirring , until onion is softened
2. Add carrots , ginger root , red pepper flakes , and broth and simmer , covered , until carrots are very tender , about 45 minutes
3. Stir in remaining ingredients and , in a blender or food processor , puree mixture in batches
4. Return soup to pan and heat over low heat until hot , being careful not to let boil
5. Serve soup drizzled decoratively with sour cream mixture

title: hubby s meatloaf
steps:
1. Mix all well
2. Place in 9x13 pan
3. We prefer flat and square but can also do it as a large loaf
4. Spread catsup on top of meatloaf
5. Bake at 375 degrees for approx 1 1 / 2 hours

title: spring frittata
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a small non-stick skillet
2. Add the mushrooms , zucchini and asparagus
3. Cook until just soft
4. Add the basil and tomatoes and cook for 1 minute longer
5. Pour the eggs over the vegetables
6. When set , turn the frittata over , sprinkle with the cheese and place under the broiler for 45 seconds
7. Serve with grilled garlic bread

title: zucchini jack casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Combine flour , baking powder , salt , eggs and milk , stirring until smooth
3. Stir in zucchini , cheese , onion , chilies , parsley and garlic
4. Spoon into a greased 13x9-inch baking dish
5. Combine croutons and butter , stirring until coated
6. Sprinkle on casserole
7. Bake uncovered for 35-45 minutes

title: bev s grilled salmon
steps:
1. Combine syrup , worcestershire sauce , and lemon juice in zip-loc bag
2. Add filets and marinate for about an hour , turning fish
3. Fire up the grill and toss on the filets
4. Cover with aluminum foil
5. Bbq until fish is done and layers "separate , " turning once
6. Serve with lemon rice

title: cerino s italian pie  5fix
steps:
1. Bake pie crust according to directions
2. Separate cheese 1 / 2 cup-1 / 4 cup
3. Combine- egg , ham , 1 / 2 cup cheese -
4. Mix in potatoes
5. Pour in baked pie shell
6. Bake at 375 degrees for 15 minutes
7. Remove from oven and put remaining 1 / 4 cup cheese on top
8. Cook for another 20 minutes
9. Remove and let sit for 10 minutes and serve

title: pistachio lime snowballs
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325f
2. In a large bowl , beat butter with a mixer for 30 seconds
3. Add the powdered sugar beating until is it combined
4. Mix in the flour until fully incorporated
5. Stir in the nuts and lime zest
6. Shape dough into 1-inch balls
7. Roll each ball in green colored sugar and place about 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheets
8. Bake for 15 minutes , until the bottoms are lightly browned
9. Cool the cookies for 5 minutes on the cookie sheets
10. Remove warm cookies and roll in additional powdered sugar to coat
11. Place cookies on wire racks to cool completely
12. Cookies can be frozen for up to three months in an airtight container

title: campbell s slow cooked pulled pork
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a 10-inch skillet over medium-high heat
2. Add the pork and cook until its well browned on all sides
3. Stir the soup , ketchup , vinegar and brown sugar in a 5-quart slow cooker
4. Add the pork and turn to coat
5. Cover and cook on low for 8 to 9 hours or until the pork is fork-tender
6. Remove the pork from the cooker to a cutting board and let stand for 10 minutes
7. Using 2 forks , shred the pork
8. Return the pork to the cooker
9. Divide the pork and sauce mixture among the rolls
10. Can also be cooked on high for 4 to 5 hours

title: scalloped pineapple great side dish to ham
steps:
1. Pre heat oven to 375f
2. Moisten bread cubes with milk
3. Mix with remaining ingredients and bake in a 2-quart covered casserole dish for 45 minutes
4. Last 15 minutes remove lid and bake uncovered to form crust and firm
5. Allow to briefly rest before serving
6. Serve warm

title: breakfast empanadas  light version   3 pt
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Saute onion in oil in a non-stick skillet over medium heat until the onion is soft
3. Add hashbrowns and spinach , saute until all the moisture is gone and the potatoes start to brown
4. Move to a large mixing bowl
5. Spray the non-stick skillet with butter flavored spray and heat over medium heat
6. Add egg beaters and cook without stirring until eggs begin to set on bottom
7. Draw spatula across bottom of skillet to form large curds
8. Continue cooking until eggs are slightly thickened but still moist
9. Remove from heat and let cool , add to mixing bowl
10. Add bacon to bowl and stir well
11. Separate each biscuit to form a total of 16
12. Biscuits should be separated using the layers and be as close to even as possible
13. Flatten each biscuit into about a 5 inch circle
14. Spread cheese evenly over the tops of dough circles , leaving a 1 / 2 inch border around the edges
15. Top evenly with egg mixture
16. Fold dough circles in half over mixture , pinching edges to seal
17. Place 2 inches apart in a 15 x 10 jelly roll pan coated with pam
18. Press sealed edges with the tines of a fork
19. Bake at 375f 14-16 minutes until golden brown
20. Remove empanadas with a spatula onto a wire rack
21. Serve warm
22. To freeze: after baking allow empanadas to cool fulling
23. Place into a zip-top bag and freeze
24. To serve: from frozen , wrap empanada with a paper towel
25. Place on a microwave safe plate and microwave on 50% power 1-2 minutes or until the empanada is heated all the way through

title: herby potato cakes
steps:
1. Peel the potatoes and wash the potatoes and the carrot
2. Finely grate the potatoes and carrot , place between paper kitchen towels and squeeze firmly to remove excess moisture
3. Peel , crush and then finely chop the garlic
4. Wash , dry and then finely chop the parsley
5. Mix together , so that they are well-combined , the grated potatoes and carrot , the thyme , two-thirds of the parsley , the garlic , and the salt and pepper
6. Divide the mixture into 8 equal portions and between your palms , shape and flatten each one into a round cake
7. Heat the oil in a large pan over a high heat , and cook the cakes , for 5 minutes on one side , then turn and cook for 5 minutes on the other side
8. Cook until both sides are golden brown
9. Reduce the heat and cook for another 2-3 minutes in total , turning once
10. Place the first batch of cakes on paper kitchen towelling and place a sheet on top as well , to remove excess fat
11. And place them on the bottom shelf in a very low oven to keep warm
12. Cook the second batch
13. Because the pan is warm , the second batch will probably cook slightly more quickly , so be careful not to burn them
14. When the cakes are golden and cooked through , pat off any excess fat with paper towels , sprinkle them with the remaining parsley and serve immediately
15. Chef's
16. If you do so the starch will wash away and the potato cakes won't bind together
17. Better still , to save time and for greater nutritional benefits , select a variety of potato that does not need to be peeled
18. If you use a non-stick pan you will probably use less oil than the 3 tablespoons specified
19. If you do not use a non-stick pan , you will probably use more like 4 tablespoons of oil
20. Variation: use one zucchini instead of the carrot

title: traditional sapa sui  samoan chop suey
steps:
1. In a large pan , fry the onion , garlic and ginger until the onion is translucent over a med / high heat
2. Add and fry the meat for no more than 2 minutes it needs to be just seared
3. Stir so it doesn't burn
4. Add the soy sauce and water
5. Let simmer over a med
6. Heat while you prepare the noodles
7. Prepare the noodles as per the pack instructions
8. Snip the noodles , you want each strand to be short
9. Add the noodles plus 1 cup of the water from the noodles
10. Add the remaining ingredients
11. It will look soupy - this is normal
12. Stir and let simmer over a medium heart for 10-15 minutes
13. Serve as is !

title: mock pot roast
steps:
1. Mix one packet of beefy onion soup mix with the ground beef
2. Form 4-5 patties
3. Spray frying pan with cooking spray
4. Brown patties
5. When meat is browned , mix 2c water with other soup mix packet
6. Pour on top of patties , lifting patties so they do not stick to pan
7. Add frozen vegetables
8. Cover
9. Cook for 20 minutes
10. If desired , remove vegetables and meat from pan and stir in 1 t
11. Cornstarch to make a thicker gravy

title: two minute banana cinnamon caramel crunch ice cream
steps:
1. Toss bananas in food processor with cinnamon
2. Let sit about five minutes , until lightly thawed , and whiz until smooth
3. Stir in dates and pecans
4. Serve immediately
5. Using overripe bananas adds extra sweetness to the end result

title: crock pot baked potatoes
steps:
1. Scrub potatoes
2. Cut out any eyes
3. Stand potatoes up on end in crockpot
4. Cover
5. Cook on low 6-8 hours

title: fried pork  masas de puerco fritas
steps:
1. Cut pork into 2 inch chunks and remove excess fat and skin from pork
2. Combine spices , garlic , onion , green pepper , and olive oil
3. Pour over pork chunks and set aside for 2 hours or over night
4. Deep fry pork until crispy on the outside and tender on the inside

title: pf chang s tofu lettuce wraps
steps:
1. Drain the tofu , and then remove excess moisture by cutting it in half lengthwise and microwaving on high , uncovered , for two minutes
2. Gently squeeze out and wipe off excess moisture , then throw tofu in the freezer for one or two hours before removing to thaw in the fridge -- this will give the tofu a slightly heavier texture
3. Cut tofu into tiny cubes and arrange in a lidded dish to be marinaded
4. Combine brown sugar , soy sauce and rice vinegar in a small bowl
5. Pour over tofu
6. Let sit in the refrigerator for at least an hour
7. I usually leave it overnight
8. Heat olive oil in a skillet over medium-high heat
9. Add tofu , water chestnuts , mushrooms , onion , and garlic and cook until vegetables are tender
10. Dissolve 1 tsp brown sugar in 1 tsp soy sauce and add to pan
11. Saute until well mixed and heated through
12. Spoon mixture into lettuce leaf "bowls"
13. For the sauce , combine sugar , water , soy sauce , rice vinegar , ketchup , lemon juice , sesame oil , mustard and garlic in a bowl
14. Pour over lettuce wraps and serve

title: aloo curry  potato curry
steps:
1. Blend all the ingredients of puree to a smooth paste and keep aside
2. Heat oil in a non stick heavy base skillet and when medium hot put cloves
3. Now add all the spices and wait for 10 seconds
4. Add the puree and saute for 2-3 minutes till the raw smell is gone and oil appears on the sides of the skillet
5. Add 2 cups of water and the potatoes
6. Let it simmer for 15 minutes
7. Serve warm with rice , indian roti , paratha etc

title: mandarin broccoli chicken skillet
steps:
1. Place broccoli in a steamer over 1 inch of boiling water , and cover
2. Cook until tender but still firm , about 2-6 minutes , depending on size of florets
3. Drain , cool and set aside
4. Heat butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat
5. Salt and pepper chicken to taste
6. Saute chicken in butter until browned and cooked through , about 4 minutes per side
7. Remove from skillet and set aside
8. Saute mushrooms in skillet for 3 minutes
9. If using garlic , add to pan and cook for 1-2 minutes more
10. Remove mushrooms from skillet and set aside
11. Stir in flour , water , orange juice concentrate and seasoning
12. Heat to boiling , stirring
13. Simmer , stirring for 4 minutes
14. Return chicken and mushrooms to skillet
15. Add green onions and broccoli
16. Heat through
17. Just before serving , stir mandarin segments in and serve immediately

title: state fair potato salad
steps:
1. Cook potatoes in large pot of boiling salted water until just tender , about 10 minutes
2. Drain
3. Transfer to large bowl
4. Drizzle pickle juice over potatoes and toss gently
5. Cool to room temperature
6. Whisk mayonnaise , buttermilk , mustard , sugar and pepper in medium bowl to blend
7. Pour over potatoes
8. Add eggs , onion , celery , and pickles and toss gently to blend
9. Season to taste with salt
10. Can be made 8 hours ahead
11. Chill

title: beef style seasoning or chicken style
steps:
1. Mix all together and keep in a jar with a tight fitting lid
2. Will keep indefinately
3. Great replacement for beef seasoning

title: yellow squash or zucchini matchsticks sauted   4 ways
steps:
1. Place your matchstick squashi in a colander and set it in the sink or over a larger bowl
2. Toss with 1 tsp salt
3. Let it stand 10 minutes
4. Squeeze well to remove as much excess moisture as possible
5. Do not rince
6. Way 1 - toast the almonds in a dry skillet over medium heat , tossing until brown -- about 3 minutes
7. Remove from skillet
8. All ways - heat oil in the same skillet over medium heat
9. Add garlic and spices until fragrant , just a minute or two
10. Add squash and cook , tossing occasionally , until crisp tender , about 2-5 minutes
11. Don't let it go limp
12. Move to a serving bowl
13. Finish way 1 - fold in parmesan and almonds
14. Finish way 2 - cover with lime juice and pepitas
15. Finish way 3 - whisk together miso and vinegar
16. Sprinkle over squash
17. Finish way 4 - serve with a dollop of greek yogurt on top
18. Salt and pepper to taste

title: sticky toffee pudding
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Butter 9-inch-diameter springform pan
3. Line bottom of pan with parchment paper
4. Butter parchment
5. Place the chopped dates in a small bowl
6. Pour 1 cup boiling water over dates and let cool , about 1 hour
7. Using electric mixer , beat butter and sugar in large bowl to blend
8. Add 2 eggs , 1 at a time , beating well after each addition
9. Add half of flour and beat to blend
10. Add remaining 2 eggs , 1 at a time , beating to blend after each addition
11. Add remaining flour and beat until blended
12. Combine instant coffee and baking soda in small bowl
13. Pour into date mixture , stirring to dissolve coffee granules
14. Add date mixture to batter and beat to blend
15. Pour batter into prepared pan
16. Place on rimmed baking sheet and bake until tester inserted into center comes out clean , about 1 hour
17. Cool pudding until just warm
18. Unmold
19. Sprinkle with powdered sugar
20. Cut into wedges and serve with whipped cream and caramel sauce

title: braised straw mushrooms in soy sauce
steps:
1. Rinse mushrooms , pat dry with paper towel
2. Heat oil in a medium pan , saute garlic until fragrant
3. Add mushrooms , stir quickly then season with salt , pepper , sugar ans soy sauce
4. Saute until some liquid starts to evaporate
5. Remove from heat , spoon into serving dish and garnish with cilantro

title: sweet tomato chutney
steps:
1. In a saucepan combine undrained tomatoes , onion , garlic , and gingerroot
2. Stir in sugar , vinegar , salt , paprika , red pepper , and cloves
3. Bring to a boil
4. Reduce heat
5. Simmer , uncovered , for 30 minutes or until the mixture is thickened
6. Stir frequently
7. Stir in the raisins or currants and the almonds
8. Heat through
9. Remove from heat and cool
10. Pour into a container
11. Cover and label
12. Can be stored in the refrigerator for up to 3 weeks

title: roast chicken with black pepper glaze
steps:
1. In a food processor , combine garlic , lemon juice , and 1 tsp olive oil
2. Process 30 seconds , stopping once to scraped down the sides
3. Set the garlic paste aside
4. Remove the giblets and neck from the chicken
5. Rinse chickens thoroughly with cold water
6. Pat dry
7. Gently separate the chicken skin from the legs , thighs , and breasts
8. Be careful not to tear the skin
9. Spread the reserved garlic paste under the skin
10. Place the chicken on a lightly greased rack in a roasting pan , breast side up
11. Rub the remaining olive oil over the chicken
12. Squeeze the lemon halves over the chickens , and place the halves inside the chicken cavities
13. Lift the wing
14. Secure with wooden picks , and tie the leg ends together with kitchen string
15. Sprinkle with the salt and pepper
16. Cover and chill for 30 minutes
17. Add water to the roasting pan to a depth of 1 / 2 inch
18. Insert a meat thermometer into the breast of the chicken , making sure it does not touch bone
19. Bake , uncovered , at 375 degrees for 1 hour and 20 minutes , or until the meat thermometer registers 170 degrees
20. Place on a serving platter lined with curly endive

title: brittany chicken casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees
2. Cook beans in salted boiling water for 25 minutes
3. Heat the butter and olive oil in a flameproof casserole
4. Add the bacon and chicken
5. Cook for 5 minutes
6. Sprinkle with the flour
7. Add the cider and chicken stock , stirring to prevent lumps
8. Season with salt and pepper
9. Bring to a boil
10. Add the beans and the cover the pot
11. Bake for 2 hours
12. About 15 minutes before it is done , remove the lid
13. In a frying pan , gently cook the shallots and honey together for about 5 minutes
14. Turn the shallots frequently
15. Add the shallots and cooked beetroot to the casserole
16. Bake uncovered for 15 more minutes

title: new zealand birdseed bar
steps:
1. Roast first 4 ingredients in oven until nicely browned
2. Add sultanas
3. In a pot melt butter , honey and sugar
4. Mix into dry ingredients
5. Press into a tray and cut when cooled

title: firecracker cheeseburger
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine sour cream , horseradish , relish , and jalapenos
2. Cover with saran wrap and chill
3. Season meat with salt and pepper
4. Shape into patties and grill one side 5-8 minutes
5. Flip , top with cheese , & grill 5-8 more minutes till cooked through
6. Use garlic press to mince garlic
7. Mix into butter to make garlic butter
8. Brush burger buns with garlic butter & grill to toast
9. Serve patties on toasted buns & top with sour cream / horseradish mixture , tomato slices , lettuce , and desired condiments

title: hot delicious chili
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients and place in crock pot
2. Cook on low in crock pot for 4
3. 5 to 5 hours

title: microwaved scalloped potatoes and carrots
steps:
1. In an 8-cup casserole dish place the butter and onion
2. Microwave on high for 2-3 minutes , stirring once
3. Add potato and carrot slices and stir to mix
4. Sprinkle over the flour
5. Microwave on high for 4 minutes , stirring once
6. Add milk and continue to cook on medium / high for 6-8 minutes , or until the vegetables are tender
7. Sprinkle with cheese and cook for 2-4 mins , or until cheese melts
8. Place under a hot grill until top is brown and bubbly

title: scrumptious chocolate peanut butter cottage cheese
steps:
1. Mix all of the ingredients in a bowl , and stir until well combined
2. You can even toss it in the microwave for a few seconds if you prefer it to be warm
3. Enjoy !

title: beer steamed shrimp with tomato salsa
steps:
1. Make salsa: sprinkle salt over tomatoes in colander and toss gently
2. Let drain 10 minutes
3. Combine bell pepper , jalapeo , onion , scallions , garlic , parsley , pepper , and lime juice in mixing bowl
4. Toss gently and stir in drained tomatoes
5. Let stand at room temperature 30-60 minutes
6. Prepare shrimp: heat beer and old bay seasoning to boiling in bottom of steamer
7. Place shrimp in steaming rack and steam , tightly covered , 2 minutes
8. Stir once , then continue to steam just until shrimp turn pink , 1-2 minutes longer
9. Transfer shrimp to serving platter
10. If salsa is too watery , pour off excess liquid
11. Add salsa to shrimp and toss to combine
12. Serve hot , at room temperature , or chilled

title: succotash of fresh corn  lima beans  tomatoes and onions
steps:
1. Heat oil in heavy large skillet over medium heat
2. Add onion and sprinkle with coarse salt
3. Saut until soft and translucent , about 5 minutes
4. Add garlic
5. Stir until fragrant , about 1 minute
6. Add tomatoes , corn , and lima beans
7. Reduce heat to medium-low , cover , and simmer until corn and lima beans are tender and tomatoes are soft , about 20 minutes , stirring occasionally
8. Season to taste with salt and pepper
9. Stir in basil and serve

title: golden dream
steps:
1. In blender mix whipping cream and orange juice till fluffy
2. Then add liqueurs
3. Put in glass and enjoy

title: roasted carrots  memories of morocco  ww core
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees
2. Preapare a baking sheet with a light coating of cooking spray
3. Clean and scrub the carrots well
4. Cut into sticks 2-3 inches long and quartered
5. If the top sections are especially thick , cut into sixths rather than quarters
6. Place in large bowl
7. Add the onion rings and halved garlic cloves to the bowl of carrots
8. Drizzle oil on top and sprinkle the cinnamon and cumin
9. Toss the vegetables to coat
10. Place the vegetables in a single layer on the prepared baking sheet and cook for 10 minutes
11. Check the vegetables , turning lightly and return to the oven to cook an additional 5 to 10 minutes
12. You want the carrots to be tender but still crisp and the onions and garlic to be nice and soft
13. Place the roasted vegetables into a serving bowl and toss with the parsley , cilantro , olives and juice from the 1 / 2 lemon
14. Serve hot or at room temperature

title: turkey meatball stroganoff for noodles
steps:
1. Heat large non-stick skillet over high heat and sear meatballs on all sides , for about a minute
2. Remove to a plate
3. In a clean wide skillet , heat butter
4. Sweat onions and add mushrooms and saut over medium heat until deep golden , about 20 minutes
5. While this is cooking , blend broth , mustard , heavy cream and sour cream together
6. Lower heat
7. Add flour and cook stirring for a minute
8. Whisk in liquids , and any meat juices and simmer , without boiling until sauce thickens , about 5 minutes
9. Return meatballs to sauce and heat , without boiling until meat is warmed through
10. Season to taste with salt and pepper
11. Stir in dill , wine and parsley and spoon over noodles

title: beef tips and noodles
steps:
1. Trim meat of fat and cut into bite sized pieces
2. Brown meat in pan , seasoning with garlic and onion powders
3. Meanwhile , bring 3 cups water to a boil in a big pot and add bouillon cubes to make a broth
4. Add chopped onion and worcestershire sauce to broth
5. When meat is done , add to broth
6. Cover and simmer for 45 minutes to an hour , or until tender
7. Make a roux with the corn starch and remaining water and add to pot , stirring , in order to thicken the sauce to your liking
8. Serve over buttered egg noodles

title: crunchy pork chops with garlicky spinach and tomato salad
steps:
1. Trim all the fat off the pork chops
2. Lay the chops between two pieces of saran wrap and , using a rolling pin , beat them until the meaty part of the pork chop is half as thick , turning them over once as you go
3. Beat the egg in a shallow wide bowl , with the mustard , oregano and salt and pepper
4. On a large plate combine the bread crumbs and parmesan cheese
5. Dip each of the chops into the egg mixture , then roll to coat in the breadcrumb mixture , pressing the crumbs in to adhere on both sides
6. Let them dry for a few minutes on a wire rack while you heat the oil in a large frying pan
7. Fry the chops in the hot oil until deep golden brown , about 5- 7 minutes on each side
8. Meanwhile , quater the tomatoes and remove the seeds
9. Cut the tomatoes into strips and then dice them you may remove the skins before if you wish , but it works well without doing that
10. Combine the diced tomato with the minced garlic , olive oil and lemon juice in a bowl and add salt and pepper to taste
11. When the chops are ready , toss the spinach with the tomato mixture and divide the salad between two large plates , putting each large , crisp golden chop alongside
12. Enjoy !

title: spicy egg salad
steps:
1. Dice eggs - i use an egg slicer & pass egg through twice at 90 degree angles for regular dice
2. Stir in mustard , chile powder & mayo
3. Fold in celery & onion
4. Chill for 45 minutes
5. Taste - be ready for a little toasty kick ! add salt & black pepper if desired
6. Serve with lettuce & thinly sliced tomato on lightly toasted dark pumpernickel
7. Enjoy !

title: tuscan carbonara
steps:
1. Cook spaghetti al dente according to package directions
2. Meanwhile , fry pancetta and onion over medium-low heat in large , straight-sided skillet until pancetta is crispy and onion has softened
3. Turn heat off
4. In medium bowl , whisk together yolks , cream and grated cheese
5. When spaghetti is ready , drain and toss it into skillet with pancetta and onion
6. Quickly pour egg mixture over spaghetti and toss well to combine
7. Season spaghetti with salt and pepper and serve immediately

title: chtapodi ladorigani
steps:
1. Wash the octopus and remove the ink bag
2. Place the octopus in a pot with the vinegar and a little water
3. Bring to a boil and simmer until tender
4. Cut the octopus into small pieces and add the salt and pepper
5. Beat the oil , vinegar and oregano together and pour over the octopus and serve

title: cilantro cream chicken
steps:
1. Rinse chicken and pat dry
2. Season both sides with salt and pepper
3. Heat a large skillet , spray with cooking spray
4. Add the oil: brown chicken on both sides
5. Remove chicken from skillet
6. Keep warm
7. To the skillet , add cream cheese , stirring until cheese melts
8. Whisk in the milk
9. Stir until well blended
10. Add lime juice and cilantro
11. Return chicken to skillet
12. Cover and simmer for 15-20 minutes or until chicken is cooked through
13. Garnish with chopped cilantro before serving

title: chicken and spaghetti squash
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Coat chicken with spices and cook for 30 minutes
3. In a saucepan , melt butter , saut onion till translucent
4. Add garlic and saut for another 30 seconds , add cream and cheeses
5. When sauce is smooth , add squash and asparagus
6. Heat through
7. Add 2 t drippings from chicken pan and stir
8. Serve chicken on top of squash , garnish with tomatoes

title: mac  n cheese pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Spray pie plate with cooking spray
3. Cook pasta in boiling water until tender , adding broccoli during last 2 minutes of cooking time
4. Drain
5. Beat eggs in bowl
6. Stir in cheese sauce from the macaroni and cheese mix and ham until well blended
7. Pour mixture over pasta
8. Stir to combine
9. Place all into pie pan
10. Sprinkle with cheese
11. Bake 30 minutes or until set and golden brown

title: carolyn s meatballs in lemon sauce
steps:
1. Combine beaten egg , ground beef , bread crumbs , salt and pepper in a large bowl and form into 24 large meatballs
2. Bring beef broth to a boil , then add meatballs
3. Lower heat and poach gently for 15 minutes
4. Whisk to smooth 3 tbls
5. Flour and 1 / 2 cup of water
6. Remove meatballs to a heated dish and skim any fat from broth
7. Slowly stir flour mixture in to simmering broth and stir with a whisk until sauce thickens
8. Add lemon juice to sauce and return meatballs to the sauce
9. Simmer 5 minutes before serving

title: low fat chocolate cheesecake muffins
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f spray a 12-cup muffin pan with vegetable spray
2. In a large bowl , combine sugar , cocoa , yogurt , oil , vanilla and egg
3. In another bowl , stir together flour and baking powder
4. Stir the mixture into the cocoa mixture just until everything is combined
5. Divide half of the batter among the prepared muffin cups
6. In a food processor or using electric beaters , beat cream cheese , ricotta cheese and icing sugar until the mixture is smooth
7. Divide the cheese among the muffin cups
8. Top with the remaining batter
9. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until a tester inserted into the middle of a muffin comes out dry

title: lamb shanks    apricots
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 150c
2. In a casserole dish flour lamb and brown in hot oil
3. Then remove and set aside
4. Add a little more oil to dish and gently saut onion , capsicum and fennel until softish , stirring regularly and scraping the bottom of the pot
5. Add ginger , garlic , coriander and cumin , and mix well
6. Add stock , saffron , sambal , honey , seasonings and apricots
7. Return lamb to pot , stir , cover
8. Place in oven for about 1 1 / 2 - 2 hours or until cooked to your liking
9. Serve with rice or mashed potato , sprinkled with fresh parsley

title: yorkshire parkin
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 150c / gas 2 / 300f and grease an oven proof dish , approx 10x10 or equivalent
2. Over a very low heat , melt the butter with the golden syrup , treacle and sugar , stirring continuously until the sugar is all melted
3. In a bowl sift together flour , oatmeal , baking soda , salt , ginger and cinnamon
4. Make a well in the centre and pour in the melted butter mixture
5. Beat together
6. When combined add the egg and mix until you have a smooth soft batter
7. If the batter seems to be stiff add 1tbsp of milk
8. Pour into the greased oven dish and bake 50-60 minutes in the top half of your oven
9. Cool and cut into squares
10. This will last a long time if you store it in an airtight cookie tin

title: salsa with yogurt
steps:
1. Put all the ingredients in a bowl
2. Mix well
3. Serve

title: apple butter country ribs
steps:
1. Place ribs in a large dutch oven
2. Add water to cover
3. Bring to a boil
4. Cover and reduce heat
5. Simmer for 45 minutes or until tender
6. Drain well
7. Sprinkle with salt and pepper
8. Set aside
9. Combine apple butter and remaining ingredients in a saucepan
10. Stir well
11. Bring to a boil
12. Reduce heat and simmer , uncovered , for 25 minutes , stirring occasionally
13. Coat the ribs generously with apple butter sauce
14. Grill the ribs over low coals for 45 minutes , turning about every 10 minutes
15. Baste frequently with the remaining apple butter sauce

title: chili and lime dipping sauce
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together in a small bowl , stirring to combine
2. Serve with spring rolls , dim sums , won-tons or any other finger food

title: moroccan chicken with apricots
steps:
1. Chop the chicken into bite size pieces and salt and pepper
2. In a heavy skillet heat oil and saute chicken in oil until brown and cooked through
3. Remove chicken from skillet and keep warm while you make the sauce
4. Add onions and garlic to the skillet and saute
5. Add flour , cinnamon , cumin , and ginger to skillet and mix well
6. Whisk in chicken broth
7. Stir in apricots , lemon juice and honey
8. Boil sauce for about 5 minutes or until the sauce is thick enough to coat a spoon
9. While the sauce is boiling occasionally stir to prevent burning it
10. Coat the chicken with the sauce by either mixing the chicken back into the skillet or mixing both chicken and sauce into a serving dish
11. Sprinkle with toasted almonds

title: cambodian ginger catfish
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat
2. Cook and stir ginger in the hot oil until slightly softened and brown , 5 to 7 minutes
3. Add catfish fillets
4. Cook until firm , about 3 minutes per side
5. Remove fillets from the skillet to a place and set aside
6. Stir fish sauce , soy sauce , and oyster sauce together in the skillet
7. Add onion and red bell pepper
8. Cook and stir until softened , about 4 minutes
9. Return catfish fillets to the skillet and spoon sauce and vegetables over the fillets
10. Continue cooking until the flesh of the fish flakes easily with a fork , about 3 minutes more
11. Garnish with green onions to serve

title: super crispy chicken bake
steps:
1. Mix all crumb ingredients
2. Roll chicken in mixture to coat
3. Place on lightly greased foil-lined baking sheet
4. Bake at 350 for 40-45 minutes

title: veggie pasta pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Spray 8" springform pan or cake pan with nonstick cooking spray
3. Heat oil in small skillet
4. Add onion and garlic
5. Cook over med heat until onion is transparent
6. Place onion and garlic mixture in medium bowl
7. Mix in linguine , parsley , lemon juice , pepper 1 / 2 teaspoon each oregano and basil
8. In small bowl combine ricotta , 2 tablespoons of the parmesan cheese , egg and remaining oregano and basil
9. Stir into linguine mixture
10. Place half the linguine mixture in prepared pan
11. Using half of each , place a layer of tomato , then a layer of zucchini
12. Layer remaining linguine mixture
13. Top with a layer of tomato and a layer of zucchini
14. Sprinkle with mozzarella and remaining parmesan cheese
15. Cover with foil
16. Bake 35 minutes
17. Remove foil and bake another 5 minutes to melt and toast the cheese
18. Let stand 10 minutes before cutting
19. If you prefer your veggies a little on the crunchy side just reduce the cooking time

title: easy baked potato soup
steps:
1. Melt butter in large saucepan over medium heat
2. Add onion and garlic
3. Cook , stirring occasionally , for 1 to 2 minutes or until tender
4. Stir in flour
5. Gradually stir in broth and evaporated milk
6. Scoop potato pulp from 1 potato
7. Mash
8. Add pulp to broth mixture
9. Cook over medium heat , stirring occasionally , until mixture comes just to a boil
10. Dice remaining potato skin and potato
11. Add to soup
12. Heat through
13. Season with salt and ground black pepper
14. Top each serving with bacon , cheese and green onions

title: rotwein nudeln  red wine pasta with spring onions
steps:
1. Sauce:
2. In saucepan , heat butter over medium heat
3. Add green onions and saute until softened
4. Add cream and cinnamon and bring to boil
5. Let simmer 5 minutes
6. Add parmesan , stirring constantly
7. Season to taste with salt and pepper
8. Pasta:
9. In large pot combine red wine and water and bring to a boil
10. Add salt
11. Cook pasta al dente , stirring occasionally
12. Drain
13. Serve pasta topped with cream sauce

title: cheesy potato corn soup
steps:
1. In larger pan over medium-high heat add potatoes , can of soup , two cans of water , onion , carrot , corn , old bay , salt , vinegar , pepper
2. Stir until smooth , while bringing to a boil
3. Once boils , reduce heat , cover and simmer for about 20 minutes stirring occasionally
4. In a small bowl , whisk flour and milk together until smooth
5. Stir into soup and allow to simmer for 5-8 minutes
6. Stir in grated cheese until it has melted
7. Serve with salad and / or hearty bread

title: banana coconut pudding
steps:
1. In a small bowl , soften tapioca in warm water to cover 1 hour
2. While tapioca is soaking , in a small saucepan , cook coconut milk , ginger and sugar over moderate heat , stirring , until sugar is dissolved
3. Remove pan from heat and let mixture stand 10 minutes
4. Drain tapioca
5. Peel bananas and quarter lengthwise
6. Cut quarters into inch pieces
7. Heat coconut milk mixture over low heat and gently stir in tapioca and bananas
8. Cook pudding , stirring , until thickened slightly and bananas are heated through , about 5 minutes , and cool
9. Divide pudding among six ramekins and chill , covered , until cold
10. Garnish puddings with crystallized ginger

title: apple walnut tart with date nut crust
steps:
1. First make the date / nut crust -- best to do in 2 batches in your blender or food processor
2. Add 1 1 / 4 cups walnuts with 1 1 / 4 cups dates in blender or processor and pulse for 40 secons until coarse
3. Remove and add the remainder of nuts and dates and repeat process
4. Press in 9-inch tart pan
5. Put aside
6. Tart directions:
7. Squeeze the juice of 1 lemon and add to the 2 celsius water
8. Slice cored apples into fourths
9. Slice crosswide into 1 / 4 " slices
10. Put in lemon water and drain in a colander when all apples are sliced
11. Place apples in a large skillet and add the apple juice , honey , raisons , cinnamon , allspice , and cloves
12. Cook about 10 minutes over medium heat , stirring frequently
13. Remove apples with a slotted spoon to a bowl and cool completely
14. Reduce liquid to about half
15. Remove from heat and cool
16. Spread apples over crust
17. Brush syrup over the apples
18. Chill at least 2 hours
19. Enjoy !

title: tater tot potato skins
steps:
1. Use a wooden tool to push a thawed tater tot into a greased mini muffin pan
2. Sprinkle shredded cheddar cheese on each tater tot
3. Bake at 350 -400 until cheese is melted and bubbly and tater tots are a little browned
4. Serve with sour cream , bacon bits and chives on the side

title: ham chili stew
steps:
1. In dutch oven , heat oil and saute peppers , onion , and garlic until tender
2. Add ham , beans , tomatoes , tomato& picante sauces , and water
3. Bring to a boil
4. Add remaining ingredients , lower heat , and simmer uncovered for 20 minutes
5. Add cooked pasta , if desired , for"chili mac"

title: chile relleno in a blanket
steps:
1. Roast and peel the chiles and cut open lengthwise
2. Remove the seeds and stuff with the cheese
3. Wrap each chile tightly in a flour tortilla
4. Place on a microwaveable plate and heat for a couple of minutes on medium heat , until the cheese is melted
5. Or , heat in the oven for about 5-8 minutes at 350f , until cheese is melted
6. Serve hot

title: roman holiday cheeseburger spaghetti
steps:
1. Cook spaghetti until tender
2. Brown ground beef with chopped onion
3. Stir beef , cheese , tomato and salt and pepper to taste into spaghetti and mix well
4. Dot with margarine
5. Bake , covered , @ 350 for 45 minutes

title: peach soda ice cream
steps:
1. Puree sweetened condensed milk , peaches , and sugar in a blender
2. Transfer to a large bowl and sitr in peach soda
3. Pour into ice cream maker and freeze ice cream according to manufacturer's instruction
4. Tranafer to airtight container and freeze until firm ,

title: beef stroganoff  the best
steps:
1. In large sauce pan heat 2 tablespoons olive oil and saute beef strips until brown
2. Sprinkle with ground pepper
3. Remove from pan and place in a deep pot
4. Add onions and mushrooms to pan and saute until golden
5. Add to pot
6. Deglaze pan with red wine and add to pot
7. Add beef broth , ketchup , hp sauce , beef bovril , worcestershire sauce and bay leaves to pot
8. Cover and simmer for 2 hours
9. Mix the margarine and flour together with a fork in a bowl
10. Bring stroganoff to a boil and add a teaspoon of this mixture at a time to the stroganoff , until you get your desired thickness
11. Lower heat and add as much sour cream as you like
12. I'm not a big sour cream person , so i just add about 1 / 2 a cup
13. Boil egg noodles until al dente , drain and add to individual serving bowls
14. Top with stroganoff and sprinkle a little of dill on top

title: chard in dijon mustard sauce
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large skillet or wok
2. Saut the scallions and garlic for 2 minutes until softened and tender
3. Add mushrooms and cook 4-5 minutes more
4. Add chard , cover and cook over low heat for about 5 minutes or until chard is tender , but still crisp
5. Mix in mustard and heat 1-2 minutes more
6. Serve

title: healthy harvest breakfast muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Line muffin pan with cups , if desired
3. Squirt each cup with non-stick cooking spray
4. Combine first 8 ingredients in a large mixing bowl
5. Stir until well blended
6. In a separate smaller bowl combine next 5 ingredients , stir until well blended
7. In another separate small bowl , combine next 6 ingredients for muffin topping
8. Add banana mixture to the flour mixture along with the raisins , if you desire
9. Stir just until moistened
10. Do not over stir
11. Fill muffin cups 2 / 3 way full
12. Press enough of the brown sugar-nut topping into each muffin to cover the top , and to your taste
13. About 2 tbsp per muffin
14. Bake at 375 for about 20 minutes , until the muffin springs back when lightly touched
15. Makes 16 small muffins , or 8 giant-sized muffins

title: chocolate orange tart
steps:
1. Heat the oven to 180 degrees celsius
2. In the microwave or in a pan , melt the butter and dark chocolate together until liquid
3. Add the biscuit crumbs , mix well to combine and spoon into a 22cm fluted round , loose-bottomed tin
4. Press up the side to form the lip first , then press into the base , making sure there are no gaps where they join then put into the fridge to chill
5. Using a fork or a hand whisk , mix together the cream , eggs , orange zest and orange curd and pour into the crust in the tin
6. Bake in the oven for 30-35 minutes until just set
7. Leave to cool
8. Remove from the tin and drizzle with the melted chocolate
9. Leave to cool completely
10. Chill in the fridge before serving

title: orzo salad with spinach and feta
steps:
1. Whisk the vinegar , garlic , and pepper together
2. Slowly add olive oil until it begins to thicken and set aside
3. In a mixing bowl toss pasta , olives , onions , celery , spinach , nuts , and feta cheese until fully combined
4. Pour vinaigrette over the salad and toss until all the ingredients are covered
5. Chill at least 1 hour before serving
6. Be careful not to burn

title: watermelon barbecue sauce
steps:
1. Cut the melon into pieces and place in a saucepan
2. Cook it uncovered over medium heat until the melon is the consistency of applesauce
3. Stir it occasionally
4. Add remaining ingredients
5. Simmer uncovered over low heat for 2 hours
6. Allow to cool to room temperature before using

title: pumpkin chocolate chip bread pudding
steps:
1. Remove crusts from baked bread and cut into cubes
2. In a large bowl , combine eggs , half and half , sugar , pumpkin , vanilla , salt and spices
3. Mix well
4. Add the bread cubes and chocolate chips and toss gently
5. Pour into a sprayed 8-inch square baking pan
6. Let sit for 20-30 minutes
7. Sprinkle top with brown sugar and bake at 350f for 40-45 minutes
8. Serve warm with a dollop of whipped cream

title: jilmar s fruit dip
steps: 1. Mix and serve with fruit for dipping

title: reese s peanut butter pie
steps:
1. Place 2 / 3 cup mini kisses and milk in small microwave-safe bowl
2. Microwave at high 30-45 seconds or just until melted and smooth when stirred
3. Spread evenly over crust
4. Cover and refrigerate
5. Beat neufchatel cheese in a med bowl until smooth
6. Gradually beat in sugar
7. Stir in peanut butter and whipped topping until blended
8. Spoon evenly into crust over chocolate mixture
9. Cover
10. Refrigerate until set , at least 4 hours
11. Place remaining 2 / 3 cup chocolate pieces around edge of filling just before serving
12. Serve cold
13. Cover and refrigerate left over pie

title: the thing
steps:
1. Form two patties from ground beef and brown
2. While meat is cooking , butter buns and toast in a skillet
3. Take bottom bun and spread mustard over it
4. In order , place green chilies , pickles , jalpenos , lettuce , onions , tomatoes and bacon on top of mustard
5. Place two slices of cheese on each pattie just as they are getting done and place top bun on cheese to help the cheese melt
6. Take spatula and place meat and top bun on prepared bottom bun
7. Place in plate and serve with chips or french fries

title: naneh   mint paste   persian
steps:
1. Put the mint and the salt in a blender or chop it finely by hand
2. It can be stored in a jar in the fridge for a long time
3. Mix with yogurt to accompany iranian dishes
4. Great gift too

title: black bean pumpkin soup
steps:
1. In a food processor coarsely puree beans and tomatoes
2. In a 6-quart heavy kettle cook onion , shallot , garlic , cumin , salt , and pepper in butter over moderate heat , stirring , until onion is softened and beginning to brown
3. Stir in bean puree
4. Stir in broth , pumpkin , and sherry until combined and simmer , uncovered , stirring occasionally , 25 minutes , or until thick enough to coat the back of a spoon
5. Just before serving , add ham and vinegar and simmer soup , stirring , until heated through
6. Season soup with salt and pepper
7. Serve soup garnished with sour cream and toasted pumpkin seeds

title: roasted corn and black bean chili
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Place corn in a large baking pan
3. Add 1 tbs olive oil and stir the corn to coat
4. Bake until the corn is browned , stirring once , about 20 mins total
5. While corn is roasting , cook onion in remaining 1 tbs olive oil in a large sauce pan over medium heat until soft , about 5 minutes
6. Add garlic , cumin , and chili powder and cook , stirring constantly , about 1 minute
7. Stir in broth , beans , and tomatoes
8. Reduce heat to simmer
9. Cover and cook 15 mins then stir in corn and simmer for additional 5 minutes
10. Serve chili with sour cream and shredded cheese

title: almost as simple pasta with parmesan  herbs  and fresh garlic
steps:
1. Saute garlic in butter or olive oil with herbs until garlic is soft but not browned
2. Toss with hot pasta , parmesan , salt , and pepper
3. Herb suggestions: italian seasoning
4. Fresh or dried basil
5. Fresh or dried rosemary
6. Herbs de provence
7. Fresh or dried basil and oregano in combination
8. Fresh or dried parsley
9. Fresh or dried parsley , oregano , and basil
10. Italian seasoning with a pinch of crushed , red pepper
11. Fresh chives
12. Fresh parsley and fresh chives

title: pork cutlets with brussels sprouts
steps:
1. Using meat mallet or heavy rolling pin pound pork , layered between plastic wrap , to 1 / 4-inch thickness
2. In shallow dish combine flour , half the paprika , and 1 / 2 teaspoon each salt and pepper
3. Coat pork in flour mixture
4. Set aside
5. In large skillet cook sprouts in hot butter over medium-high 5 to 8 minutes , until crisp-tender and edges are brown
6. Remove from skillet
7. Cover and keep warm
8. In same skillet add additional butter , if needed
9. Cook pork 4 to 5 minutes , turning once , until golden outside and slightly pink in center
10. Remove from skillet
11. Cover
12. Keep warm
13. For sauce , combine sour cream , milk , and brown sugar
14. Whisk into skillet
15. Heat through
16. Serve sauce , sprinkled with remaining paprika , over pork and sprouts

title: rice  krispies  date balls  aka angel cookies
steps:
1. In a saucepan , melt butter
2. Add dates and granulated sugar and cook slowly , stirring constantly , until blended
3. Add cereal and coconut , stirring to combine
4. Remove from heat and let cool until you can handle the mixture without burning your fingers
5. Form into 1" sized balls with greased hands , then roll each into powdered sugar to coat

title: cushaw casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f and lightly grease a baking dish
2. Mix in order: cushaw , sugar , margarine , milk , egg and flavorings
3. Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour

title: brandy nut brie
steps:
1. Combine brown sugar , pecans , and brandy
2. Set aside
3. Score top of the cheese and place on an oven proof platter
4. Bake at 400 for 4 - 5 minutes , until cheese is softened
5. Mound sugar mixture over cheese
6. Bake 2 to 3 minutes more until sugar is melted
7. Serve with crackers
8. I have seen this recipe done up on a larger wheel of brie -- the sauce just needs to be adjusted

title: cheese wedges  made with frozen biscuits
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Arrange biscuits on a cookie sheet , pressing each one to slightly flatten
3. Cut into quarters
4. Brush the tops with melted butter , then sprinkle with grated cheese
5. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes until golden

title: chocolate chip pumpkin bread
steps:
1. In large bowl , combine sugar , pumpkin , oil , water , and eggs
2. Beat until smooth
3. Blend in flour , spices , baking soda and salt
4. Fold in chocolate chips and nuts
5. Grease and flour 3 coffee cans or 3 loaf pans
6. Fill cans 1 / 2-3 / 4 full
7. Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour or until a knife when inserted comes out clean
8. Cool on wire racks before removing from cans / pans
9. Wrap in cellophane once completely cooled
10. To freeze: wrap in cellophane , then foil and place in a ziploc freezer bag

title: the ultimate candy cookies recipe
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. In a large mixing bowl , cream together the butter , sugars , eggs , vanilla , and milk
3. In another bowl , mix together the flour , salt , baking powder and baking soda
4. Combine the wet and dry ingredients
5. Stir in the m& m candies
6. Place golf ball-sized dough portions 2 inches apart on an ungreased cookie sheet

title: grilled szechuan pork chops
steps:
1. To make marinade , combine green onions , soy sauce , garlic , sesame oil , lemon juice , chile paste , sugar , ginger root and chile oil in a small bowl
2. Place chops in a 1-gallon self-sealing plastic bag , pour marinade over chops , seal bag
3. Marinate in the refrigerator for 4 hours or overnight
4. Drain chops , reserving marinade
5. Place chops on a kettle-style grill directly over medium-hot coals , lower grill hood and grill for 4-5 minutes
6. Brush chops with reserved marinade
7. Turn and brush again
8. Grill for 4-5 minutes more until chops are just done

title: pig burger
steps:
1. Thoroughly mix together 60% ground beef , 40% ground sausage and form into 1 / 2 lb patties
2. Grill until golden brown
3. Serve with sauteed onions
4. Serve with a generous amount of your favorite bbq sauce on bun

title: chicken broccoli pizza  low carb
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Beat together half the cream cheese , milk , and eggs until smooth
3. Add any seasonings you want
4. Spray 9x13 pan with cooking spray or oil
5. Place 2 cups mozzerella cheese in bottom of pan
6. Pour egg mixture over cheese
7. Bake for 30 minutes
8. Meanwhile , steam the chicken and broccoli and cut into small pieces
9. Remove crust from oven and spread the remaining cream cheese on top
10. Put chicken and broccoli on cream cheese layer , then cover with remaining cup of mozzarella cheese
11. Bake another 5-10 minutes until cheese is melted

title: chi chi s chile con queso
steps:
1. Cut processed cheese into pieces no more than 1 inch thick
2. Spread cheese pieces evenly in the bottom of a microwavable dish large enough for all ingredients
3. Spread all remaining ingredients evenly over the top of the processed cheese
4. Cover with a microwavable plastic lid and microwave on high for 2 minutes
5. Stir
6. Repeat the microwaving process and stirring process until melted and heated to a temperature of 150f
7. Serve with your favorite tortilla chips

title: festive sangria
steps:
1. In a large pitcher or bowl , mix together the brandy , lemon juice , lemonade concentrate , orange juice , red wine , grand mariner , and sugar
2. Float slices of lemon , orange , and lime and maraschino cherries in the mixture
3. Refrigerate overnight for best flavor
4. For a fizzy sangria , add club soda just before serving

title: old fashioned brownies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit
2. Grease a 9 x 12 pan with oil or butter
3. Set aside
4. Combine melted butter , sugar and vanilla in large mixing bowl
5. Add eggs one at a time
6. Mix each in evenly before adding the next one
7. Add cocoa in 1 / 4 cup measures , dumping into a sieve and shaking into bowl to ensure no cocoa-y lumps
8. Make sure cocoa is well integrated before adding next 1 / 4 cupful
9. Add flour , baking soda and salt
10. Mix well
11. Add nuts and chocolate morsels and work well into batter
12. Pour batter into pan and shake , shake , shake to make sure everything settles
13. Bake for 30 minutes or until brownies begin to pull away from sides of the pan
14. Cool at least 20 minutes before trying
15. Top should be crunchy and brownie should be warm and gooey

title: coconut pineapple banana bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Spray 9 x 5-inch loaf pan with cooking spray
3. Combine flour , baking soda , salt , nutmeg and ginger in a bowl and stir with a whisk to combine
4. Set aside
5. Place sugar , oil , yogurt and eggs in mixer bowl and beat at medium speed until well blended
6. Add banana , vanilla and pineapple
7. Mix until blended
8. Add flour mixture and beat on low until just moist
9. Stir in walnuts and coconut
10. Put batter in loaf pan and bake 60-70 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean
11. Cool in pan 10 minutes on wire rack
12. Remove from pan and cool completely
13. Store in airtight container

title: entomado de pollo  tomatillos and chicken
steps:
1. Sprinkle chicken thighs on both sides with lemon juice , salt , and pepper
2. Marinate in fridge for about 2 hours
3. Heat olive oil in a large skillet or saut pan over medium heat
4. Saut garlic and onion
5. Add chicken , skin side down
6. Cook for 4-5 minutes or until light brown
7. Turn over and cook 4-5 more minutes
8. If you must , drain the juice , but i highly recommend you don't so you keep the flavor
9. Add the tomatillos , peppers , and oregano
10. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes
11. Season with additional salt and pepper if desired , and serve

title: kittencal s hearty chicken soup
steps:
1. Heat oil and butter in a large pot over medium heat
2. Add in onion , celery , garlic and thyme
3. Cook stirring for about 4 minutes
4. Add in 8 cups chicken stock with diced potatoes
5. Bring to a boil , reduce heat and simmer until the potates are tender
6. Using a potato masher mash the potatoes in the the stock
7. Add in sliced carrots , spinach and cooked chicken
8. Bring to a boil , reduce heat cover and simmer for about 30 minutes over low heat
9. Season with salt , pepper and cayenne to taste
10. In a small bowl combine 1 / 4 cup room temperature or cold stock with flour until smooth
11. Add into the simmering broth and cook until thickened
12. Ladle into serving bowls and sprinkle with grated parmesan cheese if desired

title: maple tarts
steps:
1. Mix ingredients well
2. Fill pastry-lined tart tins about two-thirds full with the mixture
3. Bake at 350f for about 20 minutes

title: pumpkin fruit and nut muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Prepare a non-stick muffin tin by spraying with non-stick cooking spray of if you prefer , use paper muffin liners
3. In a small microwavable bowl , place the raisins , chopped apricot halves and 1 / 3 cup water
4. Microwave for 45 seconds or until hot
5. Cover the bowl and allow fruit to plump while mixing the remaining ingredients
6. In a large bowl , mix together the flour , oats , sugar , nutmeg , cinnamon , powdered milk , baking powder and salt
7. Add the applesauce , pumpkin puree and egg , mixing until thoroughly combined
8. Drain any water from fruit that has not been absorbed and add fruit to muffin batter along with chopped cashews
9. Stir to blend
10. Divide batter into 9 muffin cups and bake in preheated oven for 15 to 20 minutes or until toothpick inserted off center comes out clean
11. Immediately remove muffins from tin and spread each with a small amount of apricot preserves

title: taco chicken skewers
steps:
1. Combine sour cream , salsa , and cilantro and one teaspoon taco seasoning mix in a bowl
2. Stirring well
3. Cover and chill up to 8 hours , if desired
4. Toss chicken with remaining taco seasoning mix
5. Cook chicken in a large non-stick skillet coated with vegetable spray over medium-high heat for 6-8 minutes or until done
6. Serve immediately
7. Serve on skewers with salsa mixture

title: peanut butter rice krispies cake
steps:
1. Heat corn syrup and sugar
2. Add peanut butter and mix
3. Remove from flame and add rice krispies
4. Spread into 9x13-inch pan
5. Melt chocolate chips and margarine
6. Spread over rice krispie mixture
7. Freeze
8. Thaw slightly before cutting and serving

title: ginger beer shandy  non alcoholic
steps:
1. Pour the lemonade into a frosted pint-size beer mug
2. Top with the ginger beer & serve immediately

title: one pot cowboy trail stew
steps:
1. Brown meat , then add bacon
2. Add onion and cook until soft
3. Drain
4. Put mixture into a crockpot or large stewpot
5. Add the rest of the ingredients
6. Stir well
7. Simmer four hours or more
8. The longer the better

title: two bean soup
steps:
1. Place beans in a large saucepan or dutch over
2. Add water to cover by 2 inches bring to a boil
3. Boil for 2 minutes
4. Remove from the heat
5. Cover and let stand for 1 hour
6. Drain and rinse beans , discarding liquid
7. Return beans to pan
8. Add broth and ham
9. Bring to a boil
10. Reduce heat
11. Cover and simmer for 1 hour
12. Add the onion , celery , carrots , garlic and ginger
13. Return to a boil
14. Reduce heat
15. Cover and simmer 30 minutes longer or until beans and vegetables are tender
16. Garnish with onions

title: jam squares
steps:
1. In food processor combine butter and cottage cheese til smooth
2. Put flour in medium bowl , stir in cottage cheese mixture
3. Mix well
4. Wrap dough in plastic wrap chill til firm
5. Divide dough in half
6. Roll out 12"x12" square
7. Cut each into 16 squares
8. Put a teaspoon jam in center of each square
9. Pull corners of each square over jam , sealing edges firmly
10. Bake350 degrees f 15-18 minutes or til edges are brown

title: rice flour muffin mix
steps: 1. Mix all ingredients and store in an air tight container

title: julie s baked oatmeal
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees and grease a 2 quart casserole dish
2. In a mixing bowl , stir all ingredients together
3. Pour into prepared dish and cook for 40 minutes
4. Top with brown sugar and cream

title: coke pork chops
steps:
1. Brown both sides of chops in oil in skillet with onion
2. Mix ketchup and coke together and pour over chops
3. Cook on low about 35 minutes until tender

title: baked penne
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Mix the ground beef and ground sausage thoroughly together
3. You'd like to have a little bit of each in every bite
4. Place your peppers , onions , mushrooms , spinach , and carrots in a pan , with a little olive oil
5. Once browned , add tomato sauce and diced tomatoes ,
