6. Let simmer for about 5 minutes , slowly add cheddar & salt and pepper , to taste
7. Stir in the cheddar until it lightens your sauce
8. Sprinkle sugar in to taste , until your sauce is no longer tart
9. Add meat into sauce and let simmer for 10 minutes
10. Boil water with butter and salt
11. Add penne once water is boiling
12. Strain pasta and pour into baking dish
13. Sprinkle cheddar over pasta , then spread sauce evenly over pasta
14. Sprinkle parmesan to cover the entire top
15. Put in oven until edges of parmesan brown
16. About 20-25 minute
17. Remove and serve

title: roast pork tenderloin with apple cider cream sauce
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees
2. Salt and pepper the pork
3. Spray a baking pan with nonstick spray and place the pork in it
4. Bake for 20 minutes , or until a meat thermometer registers 155 to 160 degrees
5. Remove from oven and place pork on a cutting board
6. Pour the apple cider in the baking pan and scrape any brown bits from the bottom
7. Put the pan on the stove over medium-high heat
8. Stirring occasionally , let the cider boil until it is reduced to 1 / 4 cup
9. It will be quite dark
10. Add cream & brown sugar and boil 5 minutes , or until very thick
11. Remove from heat
12. Add 1 tablespoon butter and beat vigorously as it melts
13. Add the second tablespoon and beat until it melts
14. To serve the pork , slice thinly and drizzle with sauce
15. Pass extra sauce in a gravy boat , if desired

title: grilled skewered beef
steps:
1. Drain the juice from the pineapple and mix with the soya sauce , garlic and ginger
2. Add the beef and let it stand for 1 hour
3. Place alternate pieces of beef and pineapple on wooden skewers and put an olive at the end of each skewer
4. Grill , turning once , for 10-12 minutes

title: bermuda chicken  caribbean
steps:
1. Place chicken breasts between two sheets of wax paper and pound lightly with a mallet or other heavy flat object to flatten to 1 / 4 inch thick
2. Heat 1 teaspoons oil in a heavy nonstick skillet over medium low heat
3. Saute shallot 1-2 minutes or until softened
4. Transfer shallot to a bowl and set aside
5. Stir next 4 ingredients and salt and pepper to taste into bowl with shallot
6. Add 1 / 2 teaspoons oil and egg yolk and lightly toss
7. Heat remaining oil in same skillet over medium high heat
8. Saute chicken 3 minutes per side
9. Turn on broiler
10. Place chicken breasts on an ovenproof platter
11. Press a portion of crumb mixture onto one side of each chicken breast until breadcrumb mixture is 1 / 4 inch thick
12. Place chicken on broiler pan , crumb side up , and broil 1 minute or until golden
13. Serve crumb side up

title: easy cheesy spinach and ham quiche pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Spray pan with pam and cook mushrooms , onions and ham until onions are tender
3. Thaw spinach and squeeze out excess water
4. Add to pan
5. In a large bowl , mix mayo , milk , eggs and cheddar cheese
6. Cool hot mixture slightly and add to bowl with liquids
7. Pour into pie shell and top with parmesan cheese
8. Bake for 45 minutes until set and golden brown
9. Enjoy !

title: drea s spicy orange shrimp
steps:
1. Dry off shrimp
2. In medium bowl , whisk the egg whites and cornstarch with fork , add sesame seeds , salt , pepper and stir
3. Add shrimp and toss
4. Heat 1 tablespoon of the oil in large nonstick skillet over medium heat
5. Once pan is hot and oil is shimmery , lay 1 / 2 shrimp so that they are not touching eachother in single layer on pan and let cook 2 minutes
6. Flip the shrimp and cook other side two minutes
7. Remove onto plate lined with paper towel and repeat this step with leftover oil and shrimp
8. Wipe skillet with paper towel if there is oil remaining
9. Add orange juice and soy sauce and turn up heat to high
10. Add red pepper and sugar and boil until reduced by 1 / 2
11. Add the shrimp to skillet , coat with sauce and re-heat
12. Add green onions to pan , stir , and serve immediately

title: spicy thai style beans with coconut milk  vegetarian
steps:
1. In a dutch oven heat oil over medium-high heat
2. Add in onions and red bell pepper and saute for 5-6 minutes , adding in the garlic the last 2 minutes of cooking
3. Add in the red curry paste and cook 1 minute
4. Add in the kidney beans , diced tomatoes , coconut milk , lime juice and sugar
5. Bring to a boil , reduce heat and simmer for about 35 minutes
6. Season with salt and pepper
7. Serve over basmati rice , then sprinkle with chopped green onion

title: banana burrito  ww
steps:
1. Lay tortilla on flat surface and spread evenly with peanut butter and jam
2. Sprinkle with coconut
3. Place banana on edge of tortilla and roll up to enclose
4. Wrap loosely in paper towel and microwave on high for 30-35 seconds
5. Unwrap from paper towel and enjoy !

title: calico bell pepper muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Grease or paper-line 12 muffin cups
3. In small skillet , over medium high heat , cook peppers in butter until color is bright and peppers are tender crisp , about 3 minutes
4. Set aside
5. In large bowl , combine flour , sugar , baking powder , salt , & basil
6. In small bowl , combine milk & eggs until blended
7. Add milk mixture & peppers & any liquid in skillet to flour mixture
8. Stir just until moistened
9. Spoon into muffin cups
10. Bake 15 minutes or until golden & wooden toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
11. Remove from pan
12. Serve warm

title: japanese chicken
steps:
1. Wash mushrooms , soak in warm water for 20 minutes , rinse , squeeze dry , remove stalks and cut the caps into quarters
2. Skin the chicken breasts , cut lengthwise into halves , carefully remove the bones , cut flesh into 1 / 2 inch squares
3. Dice the carrots and drained bamboo shoots
4. Heat 1 tablespoon oil
5. Add chicken , carrots , mushrooms and bamboo shoots , cook over high heat , stirring for 2 minutes
6. Add the stock , sake and sugar , cook over moderate heat , stirring frequently , for another 7 minutes
7. Stir in the soy sauce and cook gently until chicken is tender , stir in the green peas and reheat
8. Serve with rice

title: jerky camp chili
steps:
1. Cut jerky into small , bite-sized pieces- remember , it will swell when it absorbs water
2. In a heavy pot with heated oil , saute the jerky and cumin seeds gently for one to two minutes , constantly stirring to keep it from burning
3. Add the chili powder and continue to stir until well mixed
4. If you want your chili hotter , you can add cayenne- the amount of chili powder you use will depend on the spiciness of the jerky and what you prefer
5. To the pot add the onion , oregano , powdered cumin , garlic powder , pepper , catsup , beer , and enough water to cover generously
6. Stir and simmer for one to two hours , adding water as the jerky absorbs it
7. Allow chili to cool , and reheat before serving
8. If you'd like a thicker chili , you can add a little flour mixed to a paste with hot liquid from the pot , stir it in , and cook the chili to your desired consistency while stirring frequently
9. Please
10. However , season it to your preference

title: split seconds
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. In a mixing bowl , combine first 3 ingredients
3. Blend in butter , egg and vanilla to form a dough
4. Place on lightly floured surface and divide dough into 4 pieces
5. Shape each piece into a 13 inch long rope , 3 / 4 inches thick
6. Place on ungreased baking sheets , 4 inches apart and 2 inches from the edge of sheets
7. Make a 1 / 4 inch deep depression down the center of each rope with a butter knife handle
8. Fill depression with jam or jelly
9. Bake for 15 to 20 minutes or until light brown
10. While still warm , cut diagonally into bars and sprinkle with confectioners' sugar , if desired

title: goldenrod eggs
steps:
1. Separate the whites and yolks of cooked eggs , dice the whites , set aside yolks
2. Place butter in saucepan , and melt over medium heat
3. Stir in flour , stirring constantly , until butter and flour are well blended
4. Then cook over low heat stirring at least 2 minutes more
5. Slowly add milk , stirring constantly and cook for 5 minutes
6. Stirring until sauce has thickened , add salt and pepper to taste
7. Add the diced egg white to the sauce
8. Place toasted english muffin halves on serving plates , spoon sauce over muffins
9. Using a fine grater , grate egg yolks over each portion
10. Serve hot

title: traditional northern irish pasty
steps:
1. Mix all of the above irish pasty ingredients and add:
2. 2 tbls
3. Chopped parsley
4. 1 medium size onion [diced and sauteed]
5. Form the pasty into approx 3-inch diameter patties
6. Dip into your favourite fish batter and cover all over
7. Deep fry in 375f oil and remove when a golden
8. Brown
9. Serve with chips cooked in same
10. Oil
11. Woo hooooooo ! :))

title: dark and stormy sundaes
steps:
1. In a large skillet , melt the butter over a medium-high flame
2. Add the bananas and cook , stirring , 3 minutes until they begin to soften
3. Sprinkle the bananas with brown sugar and cook , stirring , 2 minutes more
4. Remove the skillet from the heat
5. Add the rum
6. Return the skillet to the heat
7. Standing back , carefully ignite the rum with a long wooden match
8. When the flame burns out , add the lime juice
9. Divide the bananas and sauce between four large martini glasses or dessert bowls
10. Top each serving with the ice cream , crushed cookies , whipped cream , coconut , and pineapple

title: aam lhassi
steps:
1. Combine mango , orange juice& sweetener in food processor
2. Blend for 1 1 / 2 minutes
3. Pour milk into processor& process till it has expanded& becomes frothy
4. Add the mango puree
5. Process for about 1 minute
6. Pour into chilled glasses
7. Serve immediately

title: blackberry lemon pudding cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Lightly spoon the flour into a dry measuring cup , and level with a knife
3. Combine the flour , 2 / 3 cup granulated sugar , salt , and nutmeg in a large bowl
4. Add the buttermilk , lemon rind , lemon juice , butter , and egg yolks , stirring with a whisk until the mixture is smooth
5. Beat egg whites with a mixer at high speed until foamy
6. Add 1 / 4 cup granulated sugar , 1 tablespoon at a time , beating until stiff peaks form
7. Gently stir one-fourth of egg white mixture into the buttermilk mixture
8. Gently fold in remaining egg white mixture
9. Fold in blackberries
10. Pour the batter into an 8-inch square baking pan coated with cooking spray
11. Place in a larger baking pan
12. Add hot water to larger pan to depth of 1 inch
13. Bake at 350 for 35 minutes or until the cake springs back when touched lightly in center
14. Sprinkle cake with powdered sugar
15. Serve warm

title: baked black bean veggie burgers
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 375 degrees f
2. Dry off the black beans as much as possible
3. In a bowl , mash black beans with a fork until thick and pasty
4. Finely chop bell pepper , onion , and garlic , and stir into mashed black beans
5. In a small bowl , stir together egg , spices , and chili sauce
6. Stir egg mixture into beans
7. Mix in the bread crumbs until the mixture is sticky and holds together
8. Divide the mixture into four patties
9. Place patties on lightly greased baking sheet
10. Bake about 10 minutes on each side

title: steak salad w creamy horseradish dressing
steps:
1. Steak:
2. Season steak with salt and pepper
3. Cook until medium-rare - approx 8 min - and place on cutting board and tent with foil
4. Let stand for 10 minute slice thinly accros the grain
5. Dressing:
6. Whish mayo , milk , horseradish , salt and pepper
7. Salad:
8. Heat oil in skillet and saute mushrooms , garlic , thyme and a bit of salt and pepper until mushrooms are golden - approx 5 minute
9. Place spinach on platter , add steak , mushrooms , red onion , cherry tomatoes on top and drizzle with dressing

title: makrout a louz   algerian almond cakes
steps:
1. Place the first 4 ingredients in a large bowl and mix well - traditionally with your hand
2. Dust work top with a little cornflour , seperate the dough into 1 / 4's and then roll mixture into a sausage shape - approximately the thickness of a frankfurter or average thumb !
3. Cut the sausage into 3cm pieces
4. Do this at an angle to create lozange or diamond shapes
5. Bake on middle shelf at approx 170c until set but still pale in colour
6. They should not be golden
7. When cooled slightly , drop one by one into the syrup
8. Hold on a fork and allow excess to dribble off before slowly dropping into the sugar
9. Re-dip with sugar 5 mins later and pop into paper cases
10. For the syrup you can make it easily by putting 2 cups of water , a halved lime and 1 cup of sugar in a pan and boiling for 10 minutes
11. It needs to be nice and light - just enough to hold the icing sugar on

title: raspberry oatmeal
steps:
1. Cook oats according to directions on package
2. When you add the oats to the milk , add the raspberries as well if you are using frozen
3. Otherwise , skip this step
4. When oats are done , add remaining ingredients and mix well
5. Yum !

title: tvp stroganoff
steps:
1. Heat oil in skillet over medium heat
2. Saute onions until soft
3. Add broth , crumbles and mushrooms
4. Season to taste
5. Add sour cream
6. Heat
7. Through
8. Serve over rice

title: alfredo chicken lasagna
steps:
1. In a large skillet , saut the chicken , mushrooms , onion and garlic in oil until chicken is no longer pink
2. Stir in flour until blended
3. Stir in alfredo sauce
4. Bring to a boil
5. Reduce heat
6. Simmer , uncovered , for 5 minutes
7. In a small bowl , combine the cottage cheese , 1 / 4 cup parmesan cheese , egg , italian seasoning and parsley
8. Spread 1 / 2 cup alfredo mixture in an 8-in
9. X 4-in
10. X 2-in
11. Loaf dish coated with nonstick cooking spray
12. Layer with two noodles , half of the cottage cheese mixture , 3 / 4 cup alfredo mixture and 3 / 4 cup mozzarella cheese
13. Sprinkle with remaining parmesan cheese
14. Repeat layers
15. Cover and bake at 350f for 30 minutes
16. Uncover
17. Bake 10 minutes
18. Let stand for 10 minutes before cutting

title: chicadeli tuna sandwich
steps:
1. In a large bowl combine all the ingredients
2. Spread mixture into your favorite style bread
3. Eat and have a ball !

title: chevre  goat cheese  and lox torte
steps:
1. Combine first 7 ingredients in food processor fitted with the metal blade and process until smooth , or combine in a bowl
2. Taste and adjust flavors
3. Oil a 4 to 5 cup straight sided mold , bowl , or pate terrine
4. Line with plastic wrap
5. Layer in all ingredients
6. I start with the lox , then green onion , dill , and cheese mixture
7. Repeat once more
8. Fold the plastic wrap over the top , press gently to compress the layers , chill until firm , at least 1 hour
9. Invert onto a platter , remove plastic wrap and enjoy !
10. Serve with bagel chips , crackers or bread

title: honey mustard glaze  so silly i probably shouldn t post it
steps:
1. Whenever there is a little bit left at the bottom of the squeeze bottle of your spicy brown mustard , add approximately the same amount of honey to the bottle and shake
2. Use this to squirt glaze on a baked ham during the last half hour of baking , it's easier than using a brush and there is no clean up of a bowl and spoon !
3. Oh , and it's also pretty darn good !
4. Or just use as honey mustard on anything you like
5. Store in refrigerator

title: the nutty bird
steps:
1. Spread cream cheese on both slices of bread
2. Use more , if needed
3. Sprinkle sunflower seeds on top of cream cheese on one slice of bread
4. Layer turkey breast and sprouts on top of sunflower seeds
5. Top with other slice of bread

title: orange french toast ii
steps:
1. Combine eggs and orange juice
2. Beat really well
3. Dip bread into egg mixture , then into crumbs
4. In a large frying pan , melt butter
5. Pan fry on both sides until lightly browned
6. Serve with syrup or honey and top with powdered sugar or fresh fruit

title: cameron s cabbage and noodles
steps:
1. Chop cabbage
2. Place in large frying pan with melted butter and saute
3. When cabbage is limp , toss in cooked noodles
4. Season with salt and pepper -- that's it !
5. I serve this as a side to a meal , but my son enjoys this for a lunch or snack

title: gingerly s campfire pouch steak dinner
steps:
1. Fold ingriedients in a foil pouch , sealing well as not to spill liquid
2. Cook over fire coals for 20-30 minutes

title: cashew crunch cookies
steps:
1. Beat butter at medium speed with electric mixer
2. Gradually add sugars , mixing well
3. Add egg and vanilla extract , beat well
4. Combine flour , baking soda and creaqm of tartar
5. Gradually add to creamed mixture , mixing after each addition
6. Stir in cashews
7. Drop cookie dough by rounded teaspoon onto lightly greased sheets
8. Bake at 350 degrees f for 10 to 12 minutes or until lightly browned

title: mrs  fields thumbprint jam cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300f
2. In a medium bowl combine flour and baking powder
3. Mix well with a wire whisk
4. Set aside
5. In a medium bowl with an electric mixer cream butter and sugar
6. Add egg and vanilla and beat on medium until smooth
7. Add the flour mixture and blend at low speed until thoroughly combined
8. Dough will be firm
9. Scoop tablespoonfuls of dough , roll into 1-inch-diameter balls and place on ungreased baking sheets , 1 inch apart
10. With the small end of a melon baler , scoop out the center of the dough balls
11. Do not scoop all the way through the cookie
12. Place teaspoons of jam in the center of each dough ball
13. Place scooped-out dough back into mixing bowl to use to form more cookies
14. Bake 22-24 minutes or until light golden brown
15. Transfer to a cool , flat surface

title: baked ziti  5 ww points
steps:
1. Cook the ziti according to the package directions
2. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees
3. Stir 1 / 2 of the sauce into the noodles
4. Spoon 1 / 2 of the noodles into an 8x8 inch pan that has been sprayed with non-stick cooking spray
5. In a small bowl , combine the egg white , cottage cheese , basil , parsley and 1 tablespoon of parmesan cheese
6. Spoon the cheese mixture evenly over the noodles
7. Top with the remaining noodles and pour the rest of the sauce on top
8. Sprinkle with remaining parmesan cheese
9. Bake uncovered for 30-35 minutes or until bubbly
10. Add mozzarella cheese and continue baking for an additional 5 minutes or until the cheese is melted
11. Allow to sit 5 minutes before serving

title: zucchini crescent pie
steps:
1. Separate crescent rolls into eight triangles , place in a greased 9 inch pie plate with points toward the center
2. Press onto the bottom and up the sides to form a crust , seal the seems and preforations
3. Bake at 375 for 5-8 minutes or until lightly browned
4. Meanwhile , in a large skillet , saute zucchini and onion in butter until tender
5. Stir in seasonings
6. Spoon into crust
7. Combine the eggs , cheese and ham
8. Pour over zucchini mixture
9. Top with tomato slices
10. Bake 375 for 20-25 minutes or until a knife inserted near the center comes out clean
11. Let stand for 5 minutes before cutting

title: flourless monster cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Line two baking sheets with parchment paper or silpats
3. Cream butter , peanut butter and sugars together in mixer
4. In a large bowl , toss oats , cinnamon and baking soda together
5. Add eggs to butter & sugar mixture one at a time
6. Make sure the eggs are mixed in well
7. Add vanilla and salt
8. Mix to combine
9. Add the oat mixture to the bowl and then slowly add the "stuff" and mix until it is incorporated
10. No need to worry about over-mixing because there is no flour
11. Using a small ice cream scoop or spoon , scoop the cookie dough onto the lined baking sheets
12. Space them about two inches apart
13. Flatten the tops a bit with the bottom of a glass
14. Sprinkle with fleur de sel if you wish
15. Bake for 10 minutes - turning halfway through the baking time
16. Cool on a rack but sneak at least one while they are warm

title: party stuffed mushrooms
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Remove and finely chop mushroom stems
3. Set aside
4. Place mushrooms cavity side-up on baking sheet
5. Melt 1 tablespoons margarine in small skillet
6. Add mushroom stems , celery , onion and all-purpose original blend
7. Saute until golden brown
8. Remove from heat
9. Mix bread crumbs , bacon , and sour cream
10. Spoon lightly into mushroom caps
11. Mix remaining tablespoon melted margarine and lemon juice
12. Drizzle over stuffed mushrooms
13. Bake 15 to 20 minutes or until golden brown
14. Serve immediately

title: sweet   spicy chai tea mix
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine all ingredients and mix well using a blender or food processor
2. If using a blender to mix , beat all ingredients well until mixture is the consistency of fine powder
3. If using your food processor to mix , mix one - two cups at a time until the mixture is a fine powder consistency
4. To serve: stir 2 heaping tablespoons chai tea mixture into a mug of hot water
5. This can also be chilled and served cold or frozen and served as an icy drink

title: chocolate rice krispies cake
steps:
1. Combine honey and peanut butter in saucepan and heat to boiling , stirring constantly
2. Remove from heat and add vanilla
3. Stir in rice krispies , chocolate chips and peanuts
4. Press into a greased 9x12-inch pan

title: lahme bi ajeen   meat in pastry
steps:
1. Cut puff pastry into 9 squares
2. On a floured surface , roll each piece as thin as possible
3. Saute the nuts just until golden
4. Take nuts out of pan and set aside
5. Saute the onion in oil until transparent
6. Add meat and cinammon and cook for 15 minutes
7. Drain meat mixture into a cup or bowl
8. Add the nuts to meat mixture
9. Place about 2 to 3 tablespoons of the mixture onto the middle of the pastry and fold the bottom up and the top down over some of the filling
10. Fold the sides in to the middle and overlap a bit
11. Grease the pan with some of the reserved oil from the meat
12. Place sandwiches seam side down onto the pan
13. Rub the tops with some of the remaining oil
14. Place in oven on 400 for about 10 minutes
15. Check frequently to prevent them from burning
16. Take out of oven and cool slightly before enjoying

title: grill marinade for chicken with cumin
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients and blend
2. Add chicken and marinate in the refrigerator overnight , turning several times
3. Grill to your liking !

title: sauteed pears with balsamic vinegar
steps:
1. Cut each pear into 8 wedges , removing the core and stem
2. Melt butter in large skillet over medium heat
3. Add sugar and pears , stirring gently
4. Cook until lightly brown , approximately 5 minutes
5. Remove to plates and drizzle each pear with several drops of balsamic vinegar
6. Serve warm or room temperature

title: rambutan  pineapple and tofu curry
steps:
1. Shallow fry the tofu and set aside
2. Heat the oil in a thick based saucepan
3. Add the ginger , chilies , cardamom pods and garlic and saut
4. Add the garam masala , coriander , cumin and turmeric and lightly fry
5. Add the salt , tofu , pineapple , rambutan and pineapple juice and simmer for 10 minutes
6. Add the coconut milk
7. Serve with rice when cooked

title: like arby s asian sesame dressing
steps:
1. Put all ingredients except oil into the bowl of your food processor
2. Slowly add the oil as you run the processor
3. Run until totally combined
4. Refrigerate if not using immediately

title: rabbit paprika
steps:
1. Melt 4 tblsps of the butter in a dutch oven over high heat
2. When foam subsides , add onion slices , saute , stirring frequently , until onion begins to wilt , about 2 minutes
3. Add 1 / 3 cup of stock and bay leaf
4. Heat to boiling
5. Reduce heat to very low
6. Cook , uncovered , stirring occasionally , for 30 minutes
7. Combine 1 tsp of paprika , caraway seeds and 3 peppers in a small bowl
8. Melt remaining 3 tblsps butter in large skillet over medium-high heat
9. When foam subsides , saute rabbit , in 2 batches if necessary , 3 minutes on each side
10. Sprinkle pieces evenly with spice mixture
11. Reduce heat to medium
12. Continue to saute until browned , about 5 minutes
13. Transfer rabbit to casserole with onions
14. Pour remaining stock in skillet
15. Heat to boiling , scraping bottom and sides of skillet to loosen browned bits
16. Add contents of skillet to casserole along with salt
17. Heat over high heat to boiling
18. Reduce heat to very low and simmer gently , covered , till rabbit is very tender , about 2 hours
19. When rabbit is done , transfer to a serving platter mounded with egg noodles
20. Keep warm in oven
21. Increase heat under casserole to medium
22. Heat sauce to simmering
23. Whisk in remaining paprika and sour cream
24. Do not allow sauce to boil
25. Remove from heat
26. Taste for seasoning and adjust
27. Pour over rabbit and noodles and serve

title: peanut butter crisp bars
steps:
1. Combine the oats , sugar , and salt together
2. Heat the margarine in the microwave , and mix with the oats mixture
3. In a 11x-7-inch pan pack half the mixture firmly
4. Spread the peanut butteron top of the packed oats on the pan
5. Gently pack the rest of the mixture on top of the peanut butter cream
6. Bake for 25 - 30 minutes in preheat oven of 350f
7. Let cool , and then cut into 18 squares

title: single serving pie in a jar
steps:
1. Wash and dry 4 half-pint tempered glass canning jars with lids
2. To make the topper , roll out dough and using the ring part as a cookie cutter , cut 4 tops
3. Set aside
4. Use the remaining dough to line the jars
5. No need to grease them
6. Begin at the bottom , pressing pieces together and inching your way up and around the sides sealing gaps
7. Make sure it's pressed all the way up to the top of the jar , slightly over topping so as to have enough to make a 'rim'
8. Using 1 tablespoon butter , combine filling ingredients then divide between the jars , about a 1 / 2 cup per jar
9. Don't feel tempted to overfill because it will bubble over
10. Dot a pat of the remaining 1 tablespoon butter on top over each
11. Place dough topper directly over filling
12. It will be large enough that the edge goes up the inside of the jar to the top
13. Crimp the side and top crust together with fingers to seal
14. If using optional crumb topping , combine sugar , flour and cinnamon
15. Cut in butter
16. Add oats and stir to combine
17. Smooth dough edges around the rim then divide crumb topping evenly between jars over filling
18. Make sure your top crust has a vent so steam can escape
19. Use a knife to make a couple of slits or a tiny cookie cutter for a decorative effect
20. Brush with butter and spinkle with sugar
21. Place metal lids back on and seal tightly
22. Freeze
23. To bake directly from freezer , remove lids and place on a baking sheet , setting aside for oven to heat
24. Set oven to 375 degrees
25. Once oven is ready , place in oven and bake for about 50-60 minute or until the tops are golden brown and the fillings are bubbly
26. If baking fresh and not frozen , cooking time should take about 45 minutes
27. Filling and jars will be extremely hot
28. Allow to cool
29. These can be eaten directly from the jar and depending on your filling , these can be popped out of the jar and onto a serving plate for the optimal serving suggestion

title: taco noodle dish
steps:
1. Cook noodles according to package directions
2. Meanwhile , in a large nonstick skillet , cook the turkey over medium heat until no longer pink
3. Drain
4. Stir in the tomato sauce , water , green chilies , taco seasoning , onion powder , chili powder and garlic powder
5. Bring to a boil
6. Reduce heat
7. Simmer , uncovered , for 5 minutes
8. Drain noodles
9. Place in an 11-in
10. X 7-in
11. X 2-in
12. Baking dish coated with nonstick cooking spray
13. Spread the turkey mixture over the top
14. Sprinkle with cheese
15. Bake , uncovered , at 350 for 10-15 minutes or until cheese is melted
16. Let stand for 10 minutes
17. Top with the lettuce , tomatoes , olives and taco sauce
18. Dollop each serving with 1 tablespoon of sour cream

title: spicy sweet potato  yam  pasty
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to gm6
2. Chop the sweet potato and carrot into small chunks , about 1cm-1
3. 5cm across
4. Crush the garlic onto a layer of foil , and sprinkle over the cumin and chilli powder
5. Put the sweet potato and carrot onto the foil , and roil them in the spices
6. Wrap the veg up completely , so that they bake rather than roast , and put them in the oven for 35 minutes
7. Meanwhile roll out your shortcrust pastry to make a rectangle about 12" by 9"
8. Break up 100g of feta cheese and crumble it across half of the pastry
9. Cut the broccoli into very small pieces and dot in between and over the feta
10. When the baking veg comes out of the oven mash it well
11. If it won't mash , put it back into the oven until it's soft enough to do so
12. Spread the mash over the broccoli and feta and then top with the remaining feta
13. Fold the other half of the pastry over the filling , and push it down well to seal the pasty
14. Wash with egg or milk and bake at gm 7

title: almond pistachio macaroons
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees f
2. Grate the almond paste on the large holes on a grater
3. Until you have about 1 3 / 4 packed cups
4. In an electric mixer , combine the grated paste and the granulated sugar on low speed for about 2 minutes , mixing until it resembles coarse crumbs
5. Gradually add the powdered sugar and keep mixing for about a minute until it's well combined
6. Increase the speed to medium and add the egg whites , vanilla , and salt and mix until it's just combined then add 1 / 3 cup of the chopped pistachios to complete the dough
7. Place remaining chopped pistachios in a shallow dish
8. Roll the dough into 1-tablespoon sized balls , then dip one side of each ball into the reserved chopped pistachios to coat only that side
9. Place cookies , pistachio side up and 1 inch apart , on a parchment-lined cookie sheet and press each one lightly so that they adhere to the paper
10. Bake cookies for 25 to 30 minutes and until the tops are evenly colored and the bottoms are smooth and golden brown when lifted carefully with a metal spatula
11. Let the macaroons cool on the baking sheets , then pull them gently off the parchment paper
12. They can be stored for up to 5 days at room temperature in an airtight container
13. Makes about 30 cookies

title: arabic chicken with lemon   thyme
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients for marinade
2. Marinade chicken at least an hour
3. Place chicken in baking dish
4. Bake 1 hr at 350 , then broil 15 min or until golden brown

title: asparagus supreme
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450
2. Steam asparagus for ten minutes , then arrange in an ungreased baking dish
3. Melt butter and mix in soup mix and pour over asparagus
4. Top with mozzarella cheese
5. Bake at 450 for 12-15 minutes , until cheese is melted and golden-brown around edges
6. Serve hot

title: sugarless apple cookies
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , combine dates , apple , raisins and water
2. Bring to a boil
3. Reduce heat and simmer for 3 minutes
4. Remove from heat and cool
5. Combine flour , cinnamon and baking soda
6. Stir into apple mixture and mix well
7. Combine eggs and sweetener
8. Add to batter and mix well
9. Drop by tablespoonfuls onto a nonstick baking sheet
10. Bake at 350 degrees for 10 minutes

title: potato  parmesan and anchovy focaccia
steps:
1. Proof yeast in sugar and water for 5 minutes , until foamy
2. Add flour , mashed potatoes , salt and 2 tblsps olive oil and combine dough well
3. Knead for 2 minutes , form into a ball , transfer to an oiled bowl and turn to coat
4. Let rise , covered with plastic wrap in a warm place , for 1 hours , or until double in size
5. Press dough into 15 x 10 inch oiled jelly-roll pan
6. Cover loosely , put in a warm place and let rise 1 more hour
7. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
8. Place rack in bottom third
9. Stir together garlic , rosemary , anchovy paste and remaining 4 tblsps oil
10. Arrange sliced potatoes on dough , overlapping
11. Brush with oil mixture
12. Sprinkle with parmesan and salt and bake in bottom third of oven for 40-50 minutes , or until golden-brown

title: shrimp with tomato   basil pasta
steps:
1. Toss tomatoes with cream cheese , dressing and basil
2. Add shrimp and cover
3. Refrigerate at least 2 hours
4. Cook pasta as directed on package
5. Drain
6. Place in large bowl
7. Add tomato mixture and pine nuts
8. Toss lightly

title: maple apple baked beans
steps:
1. Place beans in soup kettle
2. Add water to cover by 2 inches
3. Bring to boil
4. Boil for 2 minutes
5. Remove from the heat
6. Cover and let stand for 1 hour
7. Drain and rinse beans
8. Discard liquid
9. Return beans to the pan
10. Add 10 cups water
11. Bring to boil
12. Reduce heat
13. Cover and simmer for 30 minutes
14. Drain , reserving 1 / 2 cup liquid
15. Line the bottom of a 4qt baking dish with bacon
16. In a large bowl , combine the beans , onion , salt and mustard
17. Spoon over bacon
18. Pour syrup over the top
19. Cover and bake at 350 degrees for 3 hours , gently stirring occasionally and adding reserved bean liquid if needed
20. Arrange sliced apples over the top
21. In a small mixing bowl , cream butter and brown sugar
22. Spread over apples
23. Cover and bake 1 hour longer or until beans are tender

title: roasted cod with prosciutto  cherry tomatoes and olives
steps:
1. Combine the tomatoes , olives , capers , lemon rind , thyme and oil in a roasting pan and season with salt and pepper
2. Fit the cod fillets into the pan , spooning some of the tomato mixture over the fish
3. Scatter the ham over the top and roast in a preheated oven , 425 degrees f , for 15 minutes
4. Remove the pan from the oven , drizzle over the lemon juice , cover with foil and let rest for 5 minutes
5. Garnish the cod with basil leaves and serve with new potatoes and a green salad

title: sugar free  peanut butter pie
steps:
1. Prepare one pecan crust
2. Blend together the pecan , and melted butter
3. Pack it firmly into a pie pan with your hand
4. Bake in a 350f oven until lightly brown
5. Remove and cool
6. Filling:
7. Whisk together the pudding mix and milk until creamy
8. Add 1 / 2 cup cool whip , and the peanut butter
9. Mix throughly
10. Pour into the baked , and cooled pie shell , cover with the rest of the cool whip
11. Put in freezer for 1 hour to set
12. Melt the two squares of chocolate
13. Remove pie from freezer and drizzle with melted semi sweet chocolate , and the crushed peanuts
14. Cover and chill 2 hours before serving

title: bacon garlic fried rice
steps:
1. Slice the bacon slices cross ways into small slivers
2. This works well if you keep your bacon frozen
3. Thaw enough to slice and then just slice off your pieces of bacon across so you have a bunch of thin strips
4. Fry the slivers of bacon in a large wok or pan and then remove the bacon to drain on a paper towel
5. Reserve some of the bacon fat , about 2-4 tbsp , or use vegetable oil , or use a mixture
6. Lightly fry the garlic in the bacon fat / oil in the same pan you fried the bacon
7. Don't let the garlic get brown
8. Add the cold rice and the peas and carrots and let it all warm at high temperature and break up the big pieces of rice
9. It's ok for there to be some clumps of rice remaining
10. It is important your rice is cold when you start or the fried rice will get gluey and mushy
11. Day old rice is best , but if you want to make your rice fresh and then fry it , cook the rice and put in a flat baking pan in the freezer to cool for 30-60 minutes first
12. After about 5 minutes , or once the rice is heated through make a well in the center of your rice
13. Add your eggs and stir them slightly
14. I like to cook the egg most of the way through in the well , and then slowly bring in the remaining rice which gives some eggy chunks as well as a light coating of egg on some of the rice
15. Another option is to lightly fry the scrambled egg separately first and then add it to the fried rice
16. The last step is to add the soy sauce , crumble bacon pieces over , mix , taste and add salt if desired
17. This fried rice is surprisingly simple , but really awesome
18. I always use the frozen peas / carrots , but other veggies can work
19. Never use canned veggies , and ones that release water can be tricky , because your rice can get mushy
20. Fresh carrots , broccoli , snap peas , bell pepper , frozen / fresh corn have been tried and all work

title: a 1 hamburgers
steps:
1. Im a medium bowl , lightly combine all ingredients
2. Form 6 patties and broil or grill

title: snickerdoodle muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325
2. Line a standard 12-cup muffin pan with paper liners
3. In a medium mixing bowl , combine the first seven dry ingredients
4. In a small mixing bowl , combine the wet ingredients
5. Add to the dry ingredients , and stir to mix thoroughly
6. Fill each muffin cup 2 / 3 full
7. Combine remaining 1 / 4 c sugar and 1 tsp cinnamon
8. Sprinkle on muffins
9. Bake 15-18 minutes , or until toothpick inserted comes out clean
10. Enjoy !

title: pineapple semifreddo
steps:
1. Spray a 9 1 / 4 by 5 1 / 4 by 3-inch metal loaf pan lightly with nonstick spray
2. Line the pan with plastic wrap with enough plastic wrap extending over the sides to cover the top after the pan has been filled
3. In a medium bowl , whip the heavy cream , powdered sugar , and vanilla until stiff peaks form
4. Set aside
5. In another medium bowl , whip egg whites until foamy
6. With the mixer on , slowly add the simple syrup
7. Continue beating on high speed until the mixture is glossy and doubles in volume , about 7 to 10 minutes
8. Using a large rubber spatula , fold the pineapple into the egg whites
9. Fold the whipped cream into the egg white mixture
10. Gently , spoon the mixture into the loaf pan
11. Fold over the plastic wrap to cover and freeze for 8 hours
12. To serve: unfold the plastic wrap
13. Invert the semifreddo onto a cutting board
14. Remove the plastic wrap
15. Cut the semifreddo into 1-inch thick slices
16. Place on individual serving plates and top each slice with the crushed amaretti cookies

title: red beans with bell pepper
steps:
1. Heat beans or make the way you prefer
2. In the last 15-20 minutes of cooking the beans , clean and chop bell pepper
3. Add to pot
4. Simmer until bell pepper is soft and had slighty flavored the beans

title: strawmelon and waterberry slushie
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in blender and blend until smooth
2. Smack your lips !

title: shrimp in lobster style sauce
steps:
1. Wash shrimp and pat dry
2. Mix garlic with black bean mixture in a bowl , stir well
3. Heat 1 t
4. Oil in a wok , add shrimp and stir-fry until color changes and they begin to curl
5. Remove
6. Heat 1 t
7. Of oil in wok , add black bean mixture and stir-fry for 1 minute
8. Remove
9. Heat 2 t
10. Oil in wok , add ginger and scallion and stir-fry until there is an aroma , about 1 minute
11. Add pork
12. Stir-fry until color changes
13. Add 1 t
14. Of sherry , soy sauce , black bean mixture and stock
15. Bring to a boil
16. Add shrimp to meat mixture
17. Add 1 t
18. Sherry
19. Cover and cook 3 minutes over medium heat
20. Remove lid
21. Bring to boil
22. Thicken gravy with dissolved cornstarch
23. Season with salt if desired
24. Add scallions
25. Slowly pour in beaten egg
26. Stir-fry about 1 minute
27. Serve over steamed rice

title: easy shrimp fried rice
steps:
1. Pour olive oil in skillet over medium / high heat
2. Stir-fry shrimp until pink
3. Set aside when done
4. Melt butter in skillet , add yellow onion , saut
5. Add green onion and soy sauce
6. Mix in rice and make sure its evenly coated
7. Stir in shrimp and fry until steamy hot
8. Remove from heat and serve immediately with chicken stir-fry or eat by itself

title: layered vegetable salad
steps:
1. Put half of the lettuce in the bottom of a clear glass salad bowl
2. Layer the ingredients alternately with the peas
3. Use complimenting colors as you layer the veggies
4. Mix the mayo & chili sauce
5. Top the salad with the last half of the iceberg lettuce
6. Spread dressing over the top of the salad
7. Cover and refrigerate for 24 hours

title: syrian bread dip
steps:
1. Split bread , cut into triangles , brush with olive oil , oregano , garlic powder
2. Bake on cookie sheet at 400 till light brown
3. Mix remaining ingredients and serve
4. It's says to refrigerate dip 1 hour before serving , but i never have
5. As soon as the pita bread is ready everyone can't wait and just starts dipping

title: saturday morning syrup
steps:
1. Heat sugar and corn syrup until sugar is completely dissolved
2. Add liqueur and stir to blend
3. To cook out the alcohol simmer for two to three minutes
4. For thinner syrup or a stronger liqueur flavor , add more liqueur to taste
5. For a thicker syrup , add more sugar
6. When desired results are reached , cool liquid in pan over an ice bath
7. Syrup will thicken as it cools

title: salted caramel butter bars
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine the butter and sugars
2. Using mixer on medium speed , beat together until creamy
3. Add the vanilla and beat until combined
4. Sift the flour into the butter mixture and beat on low speed until a smooth soft dough forms
5. Spray a 913 inch baking pan lightly with non-stick cooking spray
6. Press one-third of the dough evenly into the pan to form a bottom crust
7. Preheat to 325f bake until firm and the edges are a pale golden brown approx 20 minutes
8. Transfer pan to a wire rack and let cool about 15 minutes
9. While the bottom crust is baking and the remaining dough is chilling , make the caramel filling
10. Place the unwrapped caramels in a microwave-safe bowl
11. Add the cream
12. Microwave on high for 1 minute
13. Remove from the microwave and stir until smooth
14. If caramels are not completely melted , microwave on high for 30-second intervals , stirring after each interval , until smooth
15. Pour the caramel filling over the crust
16. If you are going to salt the caramel sprinkle it on caramel layer now
17. Remove the remaining chilled dough from the refrigerator and crumble it evenly over the caramel
18. Return the pan to the oven and bake until the filling is bubbly and the crumbled shortbread topping is firm and lightly golden , about 25 30 minutes
19. Let cool before cutting into squares

title: tsr version of popeyes red beans   rice by todd wilbur
steps:
1. Pour the beans with their liquid into a large saucepan
2. Turn the heat to medium
3. Add the pepper , paprika , butter and garlic powder
4. When the beans begin to boil , use a fork to mash some of them against the side of the pan
5. Stir the mixture constantly
6. In about 20 minutes , the beans will reach the consistency of refried beans
7. Prepare the rice , using the butter and garlic salt to season instead of per package directions
8. To serve , pour 1 / 2 cup of beans into a serving bowl and using an ice-cream scoop , scoop the same amount of rice on top of the beans

title: spiced filet mignon with mushrooms
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 put shiitakes and hot water in a small bowl , soak for 20 minutes
2. Remove shiitakes , reserve water
3. Stem and slice
4. In a skillet heat 2 tbsp oil
5. Add crimini , garlic , shallots , shiitake , saute 5 minutes
6. Add wine and 1 / 2 c mushroom soaking liquid
7. Simmer until reduced to 1 / 2 cup , about 5 minutes add beef stock , reduce to 1 1 / 2 c , 6 minutes
8. Set aside
9. In a small pan toast mustard seeds until they begin to pop
10. Cool slightly and grind
11. Mix with 5 spice powder , salt and pepper to taste
12. Sprinkle over filets
13. Heat remaining oil in a skillet , add filets and cook for 2-3 minutes per side
14. Transfer to a baking dish and place in oven until done , 5 minutes for medium rare
15. Meanwhile add the sauce to the filet skillet , bring to a simmer and whisk in butter 1 tbsp at a time
16. Season with salt and pepper , serve sauce over filet mignon

title: deep dark devil s food cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Prepare bundt pan- oil and flour
3. Mix cake mix , eggs , sour cream , water , oil and pudding mix until well blended
4. Fold in chocolate chips
5. Bake 50 to 60 minutes
6. Cool 20 minutes
7. Cover with foil
8. Dust with powdered sugar or glaze if desired

title: baked noodles
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to instructions
2. Meanwhile mix all the other ingredients
3. When pasta is cooked , mix with the egg mixture and put in a greased tray
4. Bake for 30 minutes

title: zucchini cottage cheese casserole
steps:
1. Saute the zucchini and onions in the olive oil , then set aside
2. Mix together the cottage cheese , eggs , rice , salt and pepper
3. Layer the zucchini / onion mixture and the cottage cheese mixture in a greased casserole dish
4. Mix the bread crumbs and parmesan together , then sprinkle over the casserole
5. Drizzle the melted butter over all
6. Bake for 40 minutes at 350 degrees f

title: baked mushroom risotto
steps:
1. 1
2. Adjust an oven rack to the middle position and heat the oven to 400 degrees
3. Bring the broth and bay leaves to a simmer in a medium saucepan over medium-high heat
4. Cover and keep the broth warm over the lowest possible heat
5. 2
6. Melt the butter in a large saucepan over medium heat
7. Add the onion , porcinis and teaspoon salt and cook until lightly browned , about 9 minutes
8. Stir in the rice and cook until the edges begin to turn translucent , about 3 minutes
9. Stir in the garlic and saffron and cook until fragrant , about 15 seconds
10. Add the wine and cook , stirring frequently , until it is completely absorbed , about 2 minutes
11. 3
12. Spread the rice mixture into a 9 by 13-inch baking dish
13. Pour the warm broth over the top
14. Bake until the rice is tender and the liquid is absorbed , 25 to 30 minutes
15. 4
16. Saute cremini mushrooms over medium high heat until browned , about 10 minutes
17. Stir theparmesan and mushrooms into the baked risotto
18. Season with salt and pepper to taste

title: honey and balsamic lamb chops
steps:
1. Combine oil , garlic , honey , balsamic vinegar , salt and pepper in a small bowl and combine
2. Add the lamb chops and toss to coat
3. Place the lamb in a baking dish and roast for 10 minutes , baste with the marinade for 5 more minutes
4. Or grill on bbq basting with leftover sauce for 15 minutes
5. Serve with side dish of your choice , beetroot leaf and ricotta salad is suggested

title: barbados punch
steps:
1. Add first 8 ingredients into a pitcher
2. Stir to combine
3. Chill until ready to serve
4. Serve in ice-filled glasses

title: wild rice with mushrooms
steps:
1. Cook rice according to package directions , using the water and butter
2. Meanwhile , in large heavy saucepan , heat oil over medium-high heat for about 2 minutes , or until hot
3. Add mushrooms and cook for 7 minutes , stirring occasionally
4. Add shallot and thyme , stirring to combine
5. Cook for 3 minutes
6. Add mushroom mixture to cooked rice , stirring to combine
7. Serve immediately

title: benihana ginger dipping sauce
steps: 1. Combine all ingredients in blender and process until smooth

title: delicious homemade granola
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees
2. Prepare a cookie sheet
3. Mix all ingredients in a large bowl
4. Spread onto cookie sheet
5. Bake for 10-15 minutes , or until golden brown
6. Cool to room temperature
7. Store in a covered container

title: big thicket chicken and dumplings
steps:
1. Place whole chicken and water into large pot or dutch oven
2. Add poultry seasoning , garlic powder& pepper
3. Bring to boil and reduce heat to medium
4. Cook chicken for about 1 hour or until tender
5. When done , carefully remove chicken from pot
6. Set aside to cool
7. Remove 2 cups of stock and set aside to cool
8. Add celery , onion , carrot and bouillon cubes to remaining stock and continue to cook on simmer
9. While chicken is cooling , prepare dumplings
10. Into large mixing bowl , combine flour , baking powder , poultry seasoning and salt
11. Add margarine and combine until mixture is coarse and crumbly
12. Add eggs and cooled chicken stock then stir by hand to form a dough
13. Turn out onto floured surface and knead slightly until smooth
14. You may need to divide dough in half and only roll out half at a time
15. Roll out to approximately 1 / 8-inch thickness
16. Using a sharp knife or pizza cutter , cut dough in vertical strips about an inch wide
17. Then repeat the process , cutting horizontal strips , which will give you little square dumplings
18. Return chicken stock to a boil
19. Drop dumplings in , a few at a time , as quickly as possible
20. Cook about 15 minutes , stirring occasionally to prevent dumplings from sticking to bottom of pan
21. When done , remove from heat and cover pan
22. Remove skin and debone cooled chicken
23. Cut into bite size pieces then fold into hot dumplings & broth
24. This recipe will serve a family of 4 two main course meals
25. Leftovers can be frozen

title: key lime dip
steps:
1. In a bowl , mix together the sweetened condensed milk and lime juice until blended
2. Set aside
3. Beat egg whites at high speed until just foamy
4. Add sugar , 1 tablespoon at a time , beating until soft peaks form and sugar is dissolved
5. Fold egg white mixture into lime mixture
6. Pour into a 9-inch pie plate
7. Bake at 325 degrees for 25 minutes
8. Take out of the oven and stir well
9. Place in a serving bowl and cover
10. Chill in the refrigerator for 4 hours
11. Serve with graham crackers

title: way too easy choc orange  jaffa  cake
steps:
1. In a large bowl mix cocoa into dry cake mix
2. Chop well washed orange in 6-8 chunks , discard seeds , blitz orange til mushy
3. In separate bowl whisk eggs , salad oil , orange juice til combined
4. Pour wet ingredients into cake mix , add orange mush and beat all for 4-5 minutes
5. If it seems a litte dry add water a few drops at a time
6. Mixture should "ribbon" off beaters
7. Pour into buttered and floured bundt pan , thump to settle
8. Bake for 30-40 minutes at 350
9. Test before removing from oven
10. Leave to cool before turning out
11. Frost or glaze with choc orange frosting

title: grouper nuggets
steps:
1. Cut the grouper fillets in half lengthwise
2. Then cut into 1 inch strips
3. Place nuggets of grouper in a bowl with the buttermilk and hot sauce
4. Refrigerate 30-60 minutes
5. Heat oil in a pot or heat your electric fryer
6. Using your hand , strain out the buttermilk and then crack the egg into the bowl
7. Mix the egg around
8. Put the crackers , garlic salt , and pepper into a food processor and process until pretty finely ground
9. Put the crackers onto a plate and coat the nuggets one at a time , dropping into the hot oil as you go
10. These fry up really quick
11. Serve with cocktail sauce

title: see s fudge
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , mix sugar with evaporated milk
2. Stir well to dissolve sugar
3. Bring to a rolling boil for 7 to 8 minutes
4. In a large bowl , cream butter and marshmallow cream until fluffy
5. Stir in chocolate chips
6. Pour hot mixture over chocolate mixture
7. When chocolate is melted , add vanilla and nuts
8. Blend well
9. Pour into a buttered 9 x 13 pan
10. Chill
11. Cut into squares before becoming firm
12. Caution: this makes a lot of fudge !

title: sweet hot chili bacon sticks
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Stretch and spiral one strip of bacon around each breadstick from top to bottom
3. Combine brown sugar and chili powder on a plate
4. Roll the breadsticks in the sugar mixture and place on a rack over a foil-lined cookie sheet
5. Bake for 25-30 minutes , or until sugar is carmelized and bacon is brown
6. Remove pan from oven
7. The breadsticks will be kind of limp and soggy but when cooled they harden
8. Served when cooled and hardened

title: pork roast soup  2 meal recipe
steps:
1. Combine roast , broth and cream soups in crock pot and slow-cook per your manufacturers directions
2. After serving as a roast with your favorite side dishes , shred pork and mix well with the remaining 'gravy
3. '
4. For another meal , add potatoes and carrots and reheat till the veggies are cooked
5. We managed to have at least four servings of the roast and then four servings of the soup
6. Prep time includes dumping the stuff in the crock as well as prepping the soup veggies

title: top ramen with chicken
steps:
1. Cut the chicken into chunks , or thin slices , depending on how you like it to look
2. This is easiest if the chicken is still half frozen
3. Heat a skillet slightly
4. Add the first set of oil , shoyu , vinegar , garlic , and honey
5. Once it is warm enough that the honey melts , add the chicken
6. Cook over medium heat
7. Brown chicken until it is very dark
8. I like mine just before it burns
9. Once the meat starts to brown , let it cook for a while
10. Meanwhile , make the soup
11. Add the second set of shoyu , vinegar , ginger , and honey to a sauce pan
12. Add enough water that noodles will just be covered
13. Heat water until the honey is mixed in completely
14. This is when you want to adjust to taste
15. I find the soup is different every time
16. Partly because i don't measure , but partly because it depends on the honey
17. Add the konbu to the soup , if desired
18. Add the frozen veggies
19. Heat to a boil
20. Remove konbu
21. Add noodles and boil for three minutes
22. If the chicken isn't done , hold off on adding the noodles to the water
23. They'll get soggy otherwise
24. Place noodles in two bowls with a small amount of broth
25. Add chicken on top
26. Garnish with chopped peanuts or pickled ginger

title: chocolate cherry  bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Lightly grease a 13" x 9" baking pan
3. In mixing bowl , combine flour , sugar , and cocoa
4. Cut in butter with pastry mixer or fork until crumbly
5. Add egg and almond extract until blended
6. Set aside 1 cup of this mixture for topping
7. Press remaining crumb mixture into the prepared 13"x9" inch pan
8. Carefully top evenly with pie filling
9. Combine chocolate chips and almonds , with the 1 cup reserved crumb mixture
10. Sprinkle over pie filling
11. Bake at 350 for 35-40 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean
12. Cool then refrigerate for at least 2 hours before cutting

title: two meat pot roast
steps:
1. Prepare the roasts by trimming off any excess fat
2. Make slits with a sharp knife deep enough to insert garlic slivers fully
3. Repeat stuffing garlic into and around both beef and pork roasts
4. Season both roasts generously with salt and pepper or creole-cajun seasoning
5. In a heavy 8-quart dutch oven or cast iron dutch oven , heat the oil and brown the meat , one piece at a time on all sides
6. Browning the roasts well produces a darker and richer gravy
7. Drain off the fat
8. Return both pieces of the meat to the dutch oven
9. Add to the dutch oven the bay leaf and beef boullion
10. Pour into the bottom of the dutch oven 1 1 / 2 cups water , cover and simmer , low , for 2 - 2 1 / 2 hours
11. Turn occasionally and check for "near" doneness
12. You have 30 minutes left -- next step
13. Add the chopped onion , potatoes and carrots
14. Cover and simmer an additional 30 minutes or until tender
15. Remove roasts and vegetables to a platter
16. For every one cup of liquid in the dutch oven , combine 2 tablespoons flour with 2 tablespoons water
17. Stir flour mixture into the liquid , scraping bottom of browned bits and simmering over medium heat until the gravy is smooth and has thickened
18. Taste gravy and season with salt and pepper as needed
19. At this point , i slice the roasts and return it to the pot with gravy along with the onions and / or carrots and potatoes
20. Serve with rice or mashed potatoes

title: african red dip
steps:
1. Red pepper paste: process all paste ingredients except paprika in blender until smooht , scraping sides frequently
2. Heat paprika in 1-qt saucepan for 1 minute
3. Add spice mixture gradually , stirring until smooth
4. Heat , stirring occasionally until hot , about 3 minutes
5. Cool
6. To make dipping sauce: mix chili sauce with 2 tbsp red pepper paste
7. Serve with cooked , chilled shrimp
8. Leftover paste keeps well in refrigerator for the next batch

title: very moist grilled chicken
steps:
1. To prepare chicken , combine first 3 ingredients in a large zip-top plastic bag
2. Salt and pepper chicken and add to bag
3. Seal
4. Marinate in refrigerator 4-6 hours , turning occasionally
5. Remove chicken from bag
6. Discard marinade
7. Place chicken on a grill rack coated with cooking spray
8. Grill 12-15 minutes on each side or until done

title: valentine s cranberry oatmeal
steps:
1. Heat juice and cranberries in serving microwavable bowl 30 seconds add oatmeal stirring in to combine
2. Cook for 60 seconds more
3. Top with honey , cinnamon , and milk if desired

title: fresh apple yogurt coffee cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Sift flour , sugar , baking soda , cinnamon , mace and salt into a large bowl
3. Add the remaining ingredients and blend by hand until well mixed
4. Spoon into a greased 9-by-13-inch baking pan and bake 35 to 40 minutes , until a knife inserted in center comes out clean
5. Serve warm or cool
6. Yield 15 servings
7. 1 gram fat
8. 0
9. 5 milligram cholesterol
10. 147 milligrams sodium
11. 1
12. 9 grams protein
13. 21 grams carbohydrates

title: steamed snow crab legs
steps:
1. In a large pasta pot with strainer insert , bring 3-4 cups water to boil
2. Rinse ice from frozen crab legs , and place in the strainer insert of the pot
3. Cover
4. Steam crab legs for 6 to 14 minutes , or until heated through
5. Serve crab legs with clarified butter for dipping

title: two cheese panini with tomato olive pesto
steps:
1. In a food processor , combine the sun-dried tomatoes with the olives and oregano
2. Season with pepper and process to a coarse paste
3. Lightly brush 1 side of each slice of bread with olive oil and set on a large baking sheet , oiled side down
4. Top half of the bread with the provolone , spread each slice with 1 tablespoon of the tomato-olive pesto and top with the mozzarella
5. Close the sandwiches with the remaining bread , oiled side up
6. Heat a griddle or a very large skillet
7. Arrange 3 or 4 sandwiches on the griddle and top with a cast-iron skillet: do not press the pan down
8. Cook the sandwiches over moderately high heat until golden on the bottom , about 2 minutes
9. Flip the sandwiches and cook until browned and the cheese is melted , about 2 minutes longer
10. Transfer to a wire rack to cool
11. Repeat with the remaining sandwiches
12. Cut the crusts off the sandwiches , then cut into triangles and serve
13. Make ahead the panini can be prepared through step 3 and stored on a wire rack at room temperature for up to 6 hours
14. Reheat on a baking sheet in a 350f oven until crisp

title: north african meat rub
steps:
1. In a spice grinder grind the salt , oregano , rosemary , caraway and the turmeric to a fine powder
2. Mix this with the harissa , garlic and the three tablespoons of olive oil
3. Transfer to a small jar and top with more olive oil so it won't dry out

title: orange glazed game hens
steps:
1. Mix marinade ingredients
2. Place hens in baking dish , skin side down
3. Pour marinade over
4. Cover and refrigerate 24 hours , turning once
5. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
6. Transfer hens to shallow baking dish
7. Place marinade in heavy small saucepan and boil until reduced to 3 / 4 cup , about 12 minutes
8. Brush both sides of hens with marinade
9. Arrange skin side up in pan
10. Roast 5 minutes
11. Baste hens
12. Cook ten minutes longer
13. Reduce oven temperature to 350 degrees
14. Baste hens and cook 10 minutes
15. Sprinkle hens with sesame seed and roast until cooked through 10 to 20 minutes
16. Let stand 10 minutes before serving

title: overnight breakfast brunch casserole
steps:
1. Butter the bottom of a 13x9 inch pan
2. Place bread cubes into pan , followed by bacon , spinach , and mushrooms
3. Sprinkle cheese on top
4. Beat eggs together with milk , salt , and mustard
5. Pour over bread mixture
6. Cover pan tightly and refrigerate overnight or at least 3 hours
7. When ready to cook , remove pan from fridge and let sit at room temperature while oven preheats
8. Bake , uncovered , at 350 for 35 minutes

title: baked sweet   savory mashed potatoes
steps:
1. Bring potatoes , 1 teaspoon salt , and water to cover to a boil
2. Cook 30 minutes , or until tender
3. Drain
4. Return potatoes to pan
5. Add sweet potatoes and cream cheese
6. Mush until smooth with potato masher
7. Stir in bacon , next 3 ingredients , remaining 2 teaspoons of salt
8. Spoon mixture into lightly greased 11x7-inch baking dish
9. Bake uncovered at 350f for 20 minutes
10. Garnish with the rest of the bacon

title: pumpkin soup iii
steps:
1. First , steam a pumpkin , cut into pieces , for 30 to 45 minutes
2. Puree in electric mixer or food processor
3. Set aside
4. Can be prepared a day or two in advan ce
5. When ready to make the soup
6. Saute onions in butter in a large saucepan over low heat until soft
7. Sprinkle in flour and stir 2 to 3 minutes
8. Gradually add chicken broth , half and half , then pumpkin puree
9. Cook gently for 15 minutes
10. Salt and pepper to taste
11. Pour into bowls and top with dollop of whipped cream , a dusting of nutmeg and pumpkin seeds

title: ginger cole slaw with plums
steps:
1. In a large bowl mix together the vinegar , oil , ginger , and salt
2. Add the rest of the ingredients and mix well
3. Cover and put in the fridge for the flavors to blend
4. 1 to 4 hours is the recommended blending time

title: fizzy fruit punch
steps:
1. Pour juice and ginger ale in large punch bowl
2. Scoop sherbet into punch
3. Pour into cups with making sure to get a scoop of sherbet in there
4. Spike with rum when the kids are asleep !

title: tuna a la king
steps:
1. Melt butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat
2. Cook green pepper and mushrooms in butter , stirring occasionally , until pepper is crisp-tender
3. Stir in flour , salt and pepper
4. Cook over medium heat , stirring constantly , until bubbly
5. Remove from heat
6. Stir in milk and broth
7. Heat to boiling , stirring constantly
8. Boil and stir 1 minute
9. Stir in tuna and pimientos
10. Cook until hot
11. Serve over rice

title: chunky chicken noodle soup
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , saut fresh carrots , celery , and onions in butter until tender
2. Add broth and chicken
3. Bring to a boil and then reduce heat and add noodles
4. Cook for 10 minutes and then add seasonings
5. Cook for 5 minutes longer
6. Makes 6 servings

title: stir fried fish with oyster sauce
steps:
1. Add oil to heated frying pan or wok and then cook fish until golden brown , 5- 6 minutes
2. Remove fish and set aside
3. Add ginger , capsicum and snow peas and stir fry until vegetables are tender crisp , 2- 3 minutes
4. Combine cornflour with oyster sauce , soy sauce , sesame oil and water
5. Add to pan and cook 2- 3 minutes , add fish and cook , stirring gently , until heated through
6. Serve with rice or noodles

title: spicy chicken fried rice with peanuts
steps:
1. Combine first 4 ingredients in a small bowl
2. Stir well with a whisk
3. Heat canola oil in a wok or large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
4. Add bell peppers , diced onion , and 2 tablespoons green onions to pan
5. Stir-fry 3 minutes or until tender
6. Add ginger and garlic
7. Stir-fry 1 minute
8. Add rice , chicken , and water chestnuts
9. Stir-fry for 5 minutes or until thoroughly heated , stirring gently
10. Add soy sauce mixture
11. Cook 2 minutes more , tossing to coat
12. Sprinkle with remaining 2 tablespoons green onions and peanuts

title: baked salmon provencale
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
2. Wash and pat dry salmon steaks
3. Heat butter and oil in a large dutch oven over medium-high heat
4. Saute salmon briefly on each side about 1 minute
5. Remove salmon to a platter
6. Add saffron , garlic , tarragon , thyme , sage , bay leaves , tomatoes , olives , wine , fish stock , and salt substitute
7. Bring to a boil
8. Lower heat and simmer for 10 minutes , uncovered
9. Add salmon steaks
10. Remove pan from heat and place in oven
11. Bake until salmon is lightly pink and done to taste
12. To serve , place salmon steaks on platter
13. Remove bay leaves from sauce and spoon sauce over salmon

title: inside out bacon cheeseburgers
steps:
1. Preheat grill
2. Mix meat and 2 tablespoons of the dressing
3. Shape into 8 very thin , flat patties
4. Mix remaining 1 tablespoons dressing and the bacon
5. Spoon about 1 tablespoons of the bacon mixture onto the center of 4 burger patties
6. Top each heap of bacon mixture with 2 cheese quarters
7. Cover with second patty and pinch edges to seal
8. Grill patties 7 to 9 minutes on each side , or till cooked through
9. Place each burger on a bun and add your choice of condiments , lettuce , tomato , and onion

title: baked mahi mahi
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425f
2. Rinse fish and put in a baking dish
3. Squeeze lemon juice on fish then sprinkle with garlic salt and pepper
4. Mix mayonnaise and chopped onions and spread on fish
5. Sprinkle with breadcrumbs and bake at 425f for 25 minutes

title: honey beef and broccoli stir fry
steps:
1. Cut onion and beef into thin strips
2. Add two tbl oil to hot pan or wok
3. When oil is hot and swirly , add garlic and onions
4. Cook two minutes or until onion is lightly browned
5. Add florets and cook two minutes
6. Add sirloin and stir fry until cooked through
7. Don't overcook or florets will be mushy !
8. Meanwhile , combine sherry , cornstarch and soy
9. Turn heat off and drizzle honey all over stir fry
10. Add soy mixture and stir
11. Stir in red pepper

title: smoky tomato salmon chowder
steps:
1. Thaw salmon if frozen
2. Pat dry with paper towels
3. Sprinkle with chili powder and salt
4. Cover and refrigerate while roasting vegetables
5. Preheat oven to 425
6. Place sweet peppers , onion and jalapeno , cut side down , on a foil-lined baking sheet
7. Roast 15 to 20 minutes
8. Loosely wrap vegetables in foil , let stand 15 minutes
9. Meanwhile , place salmon in a shallow greased baking pan
10. Fold under thin edges
11. Bake 4 to 6 minutes per 1 / 2 inch thickness or until salmon flakes easily when tested with a fork
12. Keep warm
13. With sharp knife loosen and peel off skins from peppers
14. Discard skins
15. Coarsely chop peppers and onion
16. Transfer to a large saucepan
17. Add broth and undrained tomatoes
18. Bring to boiling , stirring occasionally
19. Remove from heat
20. Season with salt and pepper
21. Fold in chopped tomato and parsley
22. To serve , ladle chowder into shallow bowls
23. Break salmon in pieces and divide among bowls
24. Top with avocado slices and sprinkle with chili powder

title: biryani with murgh  chicken
steps:
1. Trim the fat from the chicken and cut into 1 inch pieces
2. Boneless , skinless breasts also work very well
3. In a shallow bowl or large zip lock bag combine the chicken , yoghurt , half the ginger-garlic paste and 1 teaspoon salt
4. Marinate for several hours at least
5. Rinse and soak the rice for an hour
6. Drain and keep aside
7. Heat the ghee or olive oil in an electric skillet or large heavy bottomed frying pan that has a tight fitting lid
8. When the oil is hot but not quite smoking add the cumin seeds and allow to sizzle for 30 seconds
9. Add the chopped onion and saute for 5 minutes then lower the heat to medium and cook for 10-15 minutes more , stirring every couple of minutes until they are golden brown
10. Don't hurry or skip this step !
11. When the onions are golden brown add the remaining ginger & garlic and saute for 3 minutes or so
12. Add the cinnamon , cloves , bay leaves , cardamom , raisins & cashews and cook for a minute
13. Add the cayenne powder & garam masala and stir for a few seconds
14. Add the pureed tomato & jalapeno and saute on high heat while stirring continuously for about 5 minutes until nearly all the liquid has evaporated and you are left with a thick paste
15. Add the chicken and marinade and fry on high heat for a few minutes
16. Lower the heat and saute about 10 minutes or until the chicken is about half cooked
17. Add the rice and stir gently to coat well
18. Add the lemon juice , water and salt and bring to a boil
19. Cover tightly and cook at 350f in an electric skillet for 10 minutes until the rice is cooked and nearly all the liquid has evaporated
20. Stir gently once halfway through
21. If using the stove , cook in a shallow frying pan with a tight fitting lid on med-low heat
22. May add one or two tablespoons additional water if needed at the end
23. Reduce heat to warm and allow to finish cooking about 5 more minutes
24. Fluff gently
25. Garnish by sprinkling 1 / 2 tsp of garam masala and the chopped coriander leaves
26. Serve with yoghurt or yoghurt raita

title: red wine meatballs
steps:
1. Combine ground beef , bread crumbs , onion , cornstarch and allspice , tossing lightly with a fork until blended
2. Beat egg slightly , add cream and salt and blend
3. Add to meat mixture and mix lightly
4. Shape into 1 1 / 2" balls
5. Heat oil in skillet , add meat balls and brown on all sides
6. Remove meatballs and reserve
7. Add flour to drippings in skillet and blend
8. Add consumme , water , pepper and wine
9. Cook , stirring constantly until thickened and smooth
10. Add salt to taste
11. Add meatballs , cover skillet and simmer 20 minutes

title: weight watchers honey banana toast   2 points per serving
steps:
1. Beat the egg in shallow bowl with milk and salt
2. Add 2 slices of weight watchers bread and turn to coat in eggy mixture
3. Heat a frying pan and coat with a low fat cooking spray and fry the bread for 2 minutes on the first side or until set and golden
4. Turn over and fry for another 1
5. 5 - 2 minutes or until cooked
6. Place french toast on a warm plate and add pieces of 1 small banana between the two slices
7. Sprinkle with cinnamon and drizzle with honey

title: crisscross apple crowns pampered chef copycat
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Peel , core and slice apples
3. Cut apple slices into wedges
4. Chop walnuts
5. Place apples , walnuts , raisins , flour , 1 / 4 cup of the sugar and 1 teaspoons of the cinnamon in a bowl
6. Mix well
7. Microwave apple mixture on high 3 minutes or until hot
8. Mix well
9. Separate 12 biscuits
10. You may discard the remaining or set aside for another use
11. Using a rolling pin , roll each biscuit into a 5" circle
12. Combine remaining sugar and remaining cinnamon in a bowl
13. Sprinkle the sugar / cinnamon mix evenly over the biscuits
14. Divide apple mixture evenly onto center of each biscuit
15. Gather up the edges over the filling , pinching lightly to seal
16. Melt butter in microwave on high 20 seconds , or until melted
17. Holding filled biscuits at the sealed end , dip each biscuit into butter , then into remaining cinnamon / sugar mixute in bowl
18. Place the biscuits , seam side down , into a muffin pan
19. Cut an x pattern through the top of each biscuit
20. Bake 25-30 minutes or until golden brown
21. Remove from pan
22. Serve with icre cream if you would like ! enjoy !

title: baked spicy rice
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a shallow greased 2-quart baking dish
2. Cover and bake at 350 for 45 minutes
3. Stir well , and bake , uncovered , 15 additional minutes or until liquid is absorbed and rice is tender

title: slovak christmas mushroom soup
steps:
1. Directions:
2. Remove dried mushrooms from packages and soak in water to re-hydrate
3. Wash button mushrooms and coarsely chop
4. Do the same with the re-hydrated mushrooms
5. Pour the kraut juice and water into a large pot
6. Add mushrooms
7. Bring to a boil and simmer for a minimum of two hours
8. Cook pasta till al-dente and set aside
9. Once the soup has simmered for at least two hours , make the roux
10. Melt the butter in a small skillet
11. Add the flour
12. Cook until the flour has thickened and you have a nice blond-like color
13. Add the roux to the soup
14. You're done !
15. How to serve:
16. Have pasta in one bowl and soup in another
17. Scoop some noodles into your bowl and add the broth on top
18. Oh , heaven in a bowl
19. Wishing you years of good luck ! :)

title: meatloaf with homemade ketchup hcg phase 2
steps:
1. First prepare the ketchup as it will be needed in the meatloaf
2. Mix all ketchup ingredients in a plastic bowl
3. Set aside
4. Mix all meatloaf ingredients in a bowl with only 1 / 2 of ketchup
5. Place in loaf pan with remaining ketchup on top of loaf
6. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes
7. Makes 9 slices
8. Leftovers can be frozen , if there are any
9. Lol

title: sesame coated tofu with spicy broccoli
steps:
1. Cover a cutting board with paper towels or towels
2. Cut the tofu into 1 / 2-inch-wide by 1 / 2-inch-thick long strips
3. Place the tofu on the cutting board and lay a weight such as a heavy frying pan on top
4. Drain for 20 to 30 minutes
5. Steam the broccoli until crisp-tender , 2 to 3 minutes , then plunge into a bowl of ice water
6. Drain and set aside
7. In a small , shallow bowl , combine the tahini , 1 tablespoon of the tamari , and enough water to make a smooth sauce
8. Place the sesame seeds on a plate
9. Dredge the tofu strips in the tahini mixture , then coat with the sesame seeds
10. Heat 1 tablespoon of the peanut oil in a large skillet over medium heat
11. Working with batches , add the tofu strips and cook until lightly browned on both sides , about 5 minutes total
12. Transfer to a serving platter and keep warm
13. Heat the remaining 1 tablespoon peanut oil in the same skillet over medium heat
14. Add the red pepper flakes and broccoli and stir-fry until hot , about 2 minutes
15. Splash with the remaining 1 tablespoon tamari and spoon the broccoli over the tofu
16. Drizzle the sesame oil over all and serve hot

title: barbecued potato salad
steps:
1. Place potatoes in a large saucepan
2. Cover with cold water
3. Bring to the boil over high heat
4. Reduce heat to medium
5. Boil for 10 minutes or until potatoes are just tender
6. Drain
7. Set aside for 5 minutes or until cool enough to handle
8. Cut diagonally into 2cm-thick slices
9. Drizzle with oil
10. Heat a barbecue plate or chargrill over medium-high heat
11. Cook potato for 4 to 5 minutes each side or until browned
12. Transfer to a bowl
13. Add onion , gherkin and parsley
14. Whisk sour cream and vinegar together in a jug
15. Season with salt and pepper
16. Drizzle over potato mixture
17. Serve

title: three sisters stew
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a large stockpot or dutch oven over medium heat
2. Add the onion , garlic and jalapeo , and saut until the onion is tender and translucent , for about 5 minutes
3. Stir in all the remaining ingredients except the thyme , salt and pepper , and bring to a boil
4. Reduce the heat to low , and cook , covered , over low heat for 15 to 25 minutes , or until all the vegetables are tender
5. Add the thyme leaves during the last 5 minutes of cooking
6. Add the salt and pepper to taste , stirring them in well , and serve the stew warm

title: israeli couscous with pine nuts and fresh parsley
steps:
1. Melt 1 tablespoon butter in a large saucepan over medium-low heat
2. Add pine nuts and stir until golden brown
3. Transfer to a small bowl
4. Melt the remaining 2 tablespoons of butter in the same pan over medium heat
5. Add shallots and saute until golden
6. Add couscous , cinnamon stick and bay leaf , stirring until couscous browns slightly
7. Add broth and salt then bring to a boil
8. Reduce heat to low , cover and simmer until liquid is absorbed and couscous is tender , about 10 minutes
9. Remove pan from heat and stir in the fresh parsley , pine nuts and lemon zest
10. Optional: add the raisins for a savory / sweet taste
11. Season with fresh cracked black pepper to taste

title: my favorite apple dip
steps:
1. Mix the sugars , vanilla , & cream cheese together
2. After the mixture is well blended add the toffee bits
3. Use as a dip to your favorite apples

title: quick oatmeal chewy bars
steps:
1. Prehaet oven to 350
2. Combine 1 / 2 cup butter , sugar , syrup , eggs and vanilla and beat until fluffy
3. Add one cup peanut butter and mix
4. Stir in flour , oats and salt
5. Spread in a 13 x 9 pan
6. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes
7. In saucepan combine 1 / 4 cup butter and 1 / 4 cup water and heat to boiling
8. Remove from heat and add 1 / 4 cup peanut butter and cocoa and mix
9. Beat in powdered sugar until smooth
10. Pour over bars and spread evenly
11. Cool and cut into squares

title: thai lychee soda
steps:
1. Puree the lychee fruit and water until a smooth consistency is reached
2. Strain the mixture into a pitcher , and discard the pulp
3. Add lime juice and red syrup and stir well
4. Pour into glasses filled with ice cubes until 3 / 4 full
5. Top the rest off with club soda
6. Garnish with mint and serve

title: apple maple jam
steps:
1. In a large saucepan combine all the ingredients
2. Bring slowly to a boil over medium high heat
3. Stirring constantly bring heat up to high and rapidly bring mixture to gelling point
4. Remove from heat
5. Skim foam
6. Ladle hot jam into hot jars leaving 1 / 4 inch head space
7. Adjust caps and process 10 minutes in a boiling water bath canner
8. Should make 8 half pints

title: zucchini pate
steps:
1. Coarsely grate the zucchini , mix with the vinegar , salt and sugar
2. Leave this in a sieve , you can line it with cheese cloth if you have it , cover and leave for an hour or so
3. In your food-processor , process the parsley and chives until finely chopped
4. Squeeze the zucchini to get as much moisture out as possible , with just your hands or whilst in the cheese cloth
5. Add the drained zucchini to the food-processor , process until smooth
6. Then add the cream cheese , some salt and pepper to taste , process until it is well combined
7. Put the pate in a small bowl , cover and put in the fridge for a few hours or overnight
8. If you line the bowl with cling film you can turn it out of the bowl , peeling of the cling film , dust the pate with some paprika , then garnish with some thin cucumber slices around it , but this is optional
9. Serve with pita toasts

title: red rocker margarita chicken sandwiches
steps:
1. In a medium mixing bowl add jalapenos , cilantro , tequila , garlic , red chili flakes , cumin , oregano , lime juice , and 1 teaspoon salt
2. Add the chicken breasts and red bell peppers to resealable gallon bag and pour in marinade
3. Let marinate in refrigerator for 4 to 8 hours
4. Heat grill to high
5. Remove chicken from marinade , and add chicken to the grill
6. In a small mixing bowl add flour , remaining 1 teaspoon salt and the garlic powder
7. Heat the canola oil to 350 degrees f
8. Remove bell peppers from marinade and dredge in flour and fry until crispy
9. When done drain on paper towels
10. Cook chicken thoroughly on both sides , remove from heat and cover
11. Let sit for 5 minutes before thinly slicing or shredding
12. Lightly toast rolls
13. Spread mayonnaise evenly among the rolls and then stack evenly with the cabbage or lettuce , onion , chicken breast , fried peppers , and top with cheese
14. Devour !

title: duck with mango
steps:
1. Make cuts in the duck breast skin and rub with salt and pepper
2. In a preheated heavy frying pan , fry the breasts on a fairly hot heat , skin side down for about 5 / 6 minutes until the skin has turned golden brown
3. Turn over , lower the heat and cook for several minutes more until tender and to your own liking
4. Remove the duck from the pan , cover and keep warm
