5. Skim off the duck fat from the juices in the pan , there will most likely be a lot of fat
6. Add the stock to the pan , stir to deglaze , then add the butter , chutney , orange juice and the brandy
7. Stir well , mix the potato flour with some water and add to the pan to thicken the sauce
8. Slice the duck diagonally , arrange with the mango slices on warmed plates
9. Pour over the sauce

title: polish mushroom dumplings   uszka
steps:
1. Filling: melt butter in a large skillet
2. Add the onion and saute until translucent , about 5 minutes
3. Add the chopped mushrooms and cook an additional 10 minutes , stirring from time to time , or until the liquid from the mushrooms has evaporated and the mixture starts to sizzle
4. Put the onion and mushroom mix in a large bowl
5. Add the breadcrumbs , parsley and the beaten egg
6. Season with salt and pepper , to taste
7. Mix everything together to form a firm paste
8. Allow the paste to cool slightly before filling the dumplings
9. The filling can be made 24 hrs ahead of time
10. Dough: whisk together the egg , milk and salt
11. Stir in half of the flour until it is incorporated , then add the other half and continue to stir
12. After it comes together into a thick , sticky dough , place the dough on a floured surface and knead until it is smooth , supple and soft , but not sticky
13. Add additional flour , as necessary , to achieve this
14. Form the dough into a ball , wrap it in plastic wrap or place in bowl and cover with plastic
15. Let rest 15 minutes
16. Dumplings: take half the dough and roll it out as thin as possible , about 1 / 8 in thick , cut the dough into 1 1 / 2 or 2 inch squares
17. Place a small amount of filling into the middle of the square
18. Brush a bit of the beaten egg along the edges and fold the dough over to form a triangle , seal well
19. Place on the work surface with the top pointing away from you and fold the two side point together , pressing to seal
20. Heat salted water in a large pot to a boil
21. Add the dumplings , let them rise and cook for 3 to 4 minutes longer
22. ,
23. Drain
24. Place a few pockets in each soup bowl and fill with hot borscht or broth

title: baked oatmeal creme brulee style
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees
2. Lightly oil a 9 x 13 baking dish
3. In a large bowl , combine dry mix
4. In a medium mixing bowl , whisk wet mix well
5. Add wet mix to dry mix , stirring well
6. Pour mixture into prepared dish
7. Bake 40- 45 minutes- centre will be jiggly
8. Remove pan from oven , place pan on a cooling rack
9. Hand sprinkle brown sugar over top of oatmeal
10. Return pan to oven , bake until sugar melts , 2- 3 minutes
11. Remove pan to cooling rack
12. Set oven to broil
13. Set pan under broiler 3 inches from heat till sugar bubbles and browns slightly , 1- 2 minutes
14. Remove pan from broiler and spoon mixture into serving bowls

title: famous dave s berry pancake syrup
steps:
1. In a saucepan , add the pureed berries , halved berries , champagne , lemon juice , cinnamon and vanilla
2. Add the sugar and honey , stir well
3. Bring to a boil and boil for 3 minutes
4. Serve warm or room temperature

title: garlic ricotta stuffed mushrooms
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Clean mushrooms , remove stems
3. Chop stems , and the one extra mushroom
4. Heat olive oil in saut pan
5. Add chopped stems and the one extra mushroom
6. Halfway through cooking add crushed garlic , salt and pepper
7. Remove from heat and allow to cool slightly in a small mixing bowl
8. Add ricotta and 2 tablespoons grated parmesan
9. Fill caps with the cheese mixture and place on a cookie sheet that has been sprayed with cooking spray
10. Sprinkle remaining parmesan on top
11. Bake for approx 20-25 minutes

title: garlic pepper pork
steps:
1. Heat oil to medium-high
2. Stir-fry garlic , dried chile , and pork , about 3-4 minutes until pork is nearly done
3. Add onions , ginger , bell pepper , and stir-fry 3 minutes
4. Add black pepper and remaining liquids and stir-fry another 1-2 minutes
5. Taste and adjust seasonings
6. Serve over white rice

title: lentil feta salad
steps:
1. In small dry skillet , toast almonds over medium heat , stirring often , until golden , about 5 minutes
2. Set aside
3. Bring large pot of salted water to boil
4. Add lentils and garlic
5. Reduce heat and simmer , uncovered , until tender , about 20 minutes
6. Drain and rinse in cold water
7. Drain again
8. Discard garlic
9. In large bowl , whisk together oil , vinegar , oregano , salt and pepper
10. Add lentils , cucumber , tomatoes , onion and parsley
11. Toss to coat
12. Stir in almonds and all but 1 / 4 cup of the feta
13. Sprinkle with remaining feta

title: slow cooker bbq beef
steps:
1. Season roast with garlic salt and pepper and place in slow cooker
2. Add all remaining ingredients but the bbq sauce
3. Cover and cook on low for 9 to 11 hours , until beef is very tender
4. Shred meat with a fork after cooking and retain 1 cup of the juice from cooking
5. Add bottle of bbq sauce
6. Cover and cook on high for another 45-60 minutes
7. Serve over split buns with a pasta salad

title: dijon pork chops   potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Toss potatoes with dressing in microwave bowl
3. Microwave on high 7 min
4. , stirring after 4 minute
5. Spread chops with mustard
6. Coat with shake n' bake
7. Place in center of foil-lined 15x10x1 baking pan
8. Arrange potatoes around chops
9. Bake 30 minute or until chops are cooked through and potatoes are tender

title: chicken   black pepper dumplings
steps:
1. Heat 1-1 / 2 cups milk , peas , carrots , chicken and soup to boiling in 3-quart saucepan
2. Stir bisquick mix , 1 / 3 cup milk and black pepper until soft dough forms
3. Drop dough by 8 spoonfuls onto chicken mixture
4. Cook uncovered over low heat 10 minutes
5. Cover and cook 10 minutes longer
6. Sprinkle with parsley

title: shotwell s famous sugar cookies
steps:
1. Mix 1 cup sugar with 5 cups flour and baking soda , baking powder , nutmeg , and salt
2. Blend butter in with pastry cutter / pastry blender until crumbly
3. Beat eggs slightly in separate bowl and add remaining sugar gradually to egg mixture
4. Blend buttermilk and vanilla into egg mixture , then blend egg mixture together with dry ingredients
5. I use powdered buttermilk mix
6. Chill dough in plastic wrap or plastic bags in refrigerator until ready to bake
7. If you are short on time , put the dough in the freezer for 15 minutes or so , rather than in the refrigerator overnight
8. Turn 1 / 4 of dough onto lightly floured board
9. Roll to about 1 / 8" to 1 / 4" thick
10. Cut with cookie cutters or hand-cut into circles or other shapes
11. Use cookie cutters that are relatively simple -- fancier cookie shapes tend to burn or break more easily with this recipe
12. Dip cookie top lightly into cinnamon / sugar blend or into nutmeg / sugar blend , or shake on top of cookies
13. Bake at 375 f for 6-9 minutes , until very light brown at edges
14. Put on wire rack to cool
15. Source: barbara / eric shotwell

title: best ever brownies from baking with julia child
steps:
1. Center a rack in the oven and preheat the oven to 350
2. I bake them at a lower oven temp of 330
3. Sift the flour and salt together
4. Set aside
5. Melt the butter and chocolate together in a medium saucepan over low heat , stirring frequently and keeping a watchful eye on the pot to make certain the chocolate doesn't scorch add 1 cup of the sugar to the mixture and stir for half a minute , then remove the pan from the heat and stir in the vanilla
6. Pour the mixture into a large bowl
7. Put the remaining 1 cup sugar and the eggs into a bowl and mix or whisk by hand just to combine
8. Little by little , pour half of the sugar and eggs into the chocolate mixture , stirring gently but constantly with a rubber spatula so that the eggs don't set from the heat
9. Fit the whisk attachment to the mixer and whip the remaining sugar and eggs until they are thick , pale , and doubled in volume , about 3 minutes
10. Using the rubber spatula , delicately fold the whipped eggs into the chocolate mixture
11. When the eggs are almost completely incorporated , gently fold in the dry ingredients
12. Pour and scrape the batter in to an unbuttered 9-inch square pan
13. Bake the brownies for 22-26 minutes , during which time they will rise a little and the top will turn dark and dry
14. Cut into the center at about the 22-minute mark to see how the brownies are progressing: they'll be perfect if they're just barely set and still pretty gooey
15. They're still awfully good on the other side of set , so don't worry if you miss the moment on your first try
16. Cool the brownies in the pan on a rack

title: guavaberry wine   virgin islands st  martin
steps:
1. Rinse berries with a small amount of water
2. Clean by popping berries and removing seeds
3. Rinse seeds , strain and save liquid
4. Put seedless berries into a large pot , but reserve -cup yellow and -cup red berries for later use
5. Add liquid saved from rinsing seeds into the pot and add brown sugar
6. Boil mixture until berries are soft
7. The juice should be a medium syrup consistency or sticky when cool
8. Mash or grind berries that were saved and mix with strongest old rum available
9. To the cooled mixture , add prunes , raisins , vanilla beans , sorrel , ginger root and cinnamon bark
10. Pour into bottles , cork and wire down securely
11. Store in a dark place or cellar for several months
12. When guavaberry liqueur is fully ripened , strain and re-bottle for use
13. Be careful - guavaberries can leave a permanent stain

title: rocco s famous chicken marsala
steps:
1. In a large saute pan , heat the olive oil on medium-high heat
2. Pound chicken breasts lightly on each side flipping twice
3. Place the bread crumbs in a shallow baking dish
4. Bread each breast by pushing down into bread crumbs and then flipping so both sides are breaded
5. Place the breasts in the hot pan and saute until lightly browned on each side
6. Drain the oil from the pan
7. The next two steps must be done quickly while pan is on the burner
8. Add the minced garlic to the hot pan , not on the chicken breasts
9. Add mushrooms , tomatoes , basil and marsala wine
10. Flip chicken breasts over placing them on top of the ingredients so they cook and the breasts do not burn
11. Let the alcohol burn off and let the wine soak in for a minute
12. Stir in the half and half , marinara sauce , and chicken broth and cook over high heat
13. Add pepper and continue cooking on high heat until liquid reduces into a thick , golden brown sauce , 3 to 5 minutes
14. Remove the chicken breasts from the pan and transfer to a serving platter
15. Pour the sauce directly from the pan onto the chicken breasts and serve

title: spiced blueberry muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425
2. Lightly spoon 2 cups of flour into dry measuring cups , and level with a knife
3. Combine 2 cups flour and next 6 ingredients in a large bowl , stirring with a whisk
4. Make a well in center of mixture
5. Place blueberries in a small bowl
6. Sprinkle 1 tablespoon flour over blueberries
7. Toss to coat
8. Place butter and cream cheese in a medium bowl
9. Beat with a mixer at high speed 1 minute or until blended
10. Add milk , eggs , and vanilla to butter mixture
11. Beat to combine
12. Add butter mixture to flour mixture
13. Stir just until moist
14. Gently fold in blueberry mixture
15. Spoon batter into 14 muffin cups coated with cooking spray
16. Sprinkle 1 1 / 2 tablespoons sugar evenly over batter
17. Bake at 425 for 15 minutes or until muffins spring back when touched lightly in center
18. Cool in pans 5 minutes on a wire rack
19. Remove muffins from pans
20. Place on a wire rack

title: portobello wellington
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degree f
2. Using a spoon , scrape gills from interior of mushrooms
3. Generously drizzle olive oil over mushrooms and season with salt and pepper
4. Place mushrooms on baking sheet and bake until tender
5. Set aside to cool
6. Cut puff pastry sheet into four equal squares
7. Place a mushroom in the center of pastry , layer with roasted pepper , basil leaves and goat cheese
8. Finish with a second portobello mushroom
9. Fold centers of pastry around filling , bringing them together at top
10. Be sure to enclose entirely
11. Place on parchment-lined baking sheet with folded side down
12. Brush top of wellington with egg wash
13. Bake in oven for 12-15 mins , until pastry is golden

title: herbed wild rice
steps:
1. Rinse the wild rice well under cold running water
2. Drain well , set aside
3. Bring large saucepan of water to a boil
4. Stir in rice , reduce to a simmer , and cook until rice is tender about 40 minutes
5. Drain the rice , transfer to a bowl , and stir in the olive oil , parsley , marjoram
6. Season with salt and peper , and serve at room temperature or chilled

title: famous dave s legendary pit barbecue ribs
steps:
1. Dave said 2 racks of spareribs , just to make clear
2. Mix all ingredients , down to ribs in airtight container
3. Seal and set aside ,
4. The night before smoking , trim off excess fat
5. Place in large plastic bag and pour in italian dressing to coat
6. Seal bag well and chill 4 hours , turning occasionally
7. Remove and wipe off dressing
8. Sprinkle each rib with pepper , then 1 / 4 cup of the brown sugar and 1 / 2 cup of the onion flakes ,
9. Wrap each rib in plastic and refrigerate over night
10. The next morning remove from wrap and wipe sludge off ribs
11. Generously coat front and back of the ribs with 1 cup rib rub using your hands , rub seasoning into meat and set aside
12. The smoking process will take 6 hours
13. Using a chimney charcoal starter get 15 briquetts red hot
14. Place coals on one end of the grill and place 1 pound of green hickory around coals
15. Using water-soaked hickory chunks if you can't get fresh cut hickory
16. Keep internal temperature of grill at 200-225f add more charcoal and hickory chunks every hour as needed
17. Place ribs bone side down but not directly over hot coals
18. After 3 hours , remove ribs from grill and wrap in aluminum foil
19. Hold in covered grill at 180-200f for 1 1 / 2 to 2 hours , or until fork tender
20. Next build a real hot bed of coals over the entire bottom of grill
21. Place ribs back on grill to add char flavor
22. When meat becomes bubbly it its done
23. Make sure to char off the bone side membrane until it becomes paper-y and disintegrates
24. Slather with bbq sauce
25. Let heat caramelize sauce
26. This caramelizing along with the charring and slow cooking is the secret to tender smokey ribs just like the championship pitmasters used to do down in the deep south
27. There are no short cuts to this time-honored way of barbecuing
28. Dave

title: healthy baked corn tortilla chips  homemade
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Stack tortillas one on top of the other and use kitchen sizzors to cut them into 4 slices like you would cut up a pizza
3. Spread them out in a single layer on a cookie sheet , spacing them at least 1 / 4" apart
4. Shake salt and desired toppings over tortillas
5. Topping options : spices: paprika , chili powder , cumin , onion powder , garlic powder , cayenne pepper
6. Cheeses: grated parmesan cheese , cheddar cheese , pepper jack cheese , etc
7. Or try sweet: cinnamon & sugar
8. Bake 8-12 mins or until chips are starting to get crispy and slightly golden brown at the edges
9. Remove from oven and let cool 5-10 mins before serving in order to let them fully crispen
10. Extra crispy: put back in turned off oven at least 10 mins or until ready to serve for extra crispy and warm chips

title: spicy kung pao tofu
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine first six ingredients
2. In a large wok or skillet over medium-high heat , cook garlic , ginger and red pepper flakes in hot oil about 10 seconds
3. Add bell peppers and stir-fry 1 minute , or until peppers begin to soften
4. Add tofu and broth mixture
5. Stir-fry 15 seconds
6. Cover , reduce heat to low , and cook 2 minutes , or until tofu is heated through and sauce has thickened slightly
7. Add salt and stir-fry 30 seconds
8. Sprinkle with peanuts if desired
9. Serve over rice

title: smoked fish omelet
steps:
1. Place the smoked fish in a saucepan , cover with cold water , bring slowly to the boil , then lower the heat and poach for 5 to 10 minutes
2. Carefully remove from the water , and allow to cool
3. Remove the skin and bones and flake the flesh
4. Toss the haddock over a medium high heat with half the butter and 3 tablespoons of the cream
5. Seperate the eggs , beat the yolks and a tablespoon of the cream and season with salt and pepper
6. Whip the whites stiffly and fold into the yolks with the haddock and half the grated cheese
7. Melt the remaining butter in a large pan and while still foaming pour in the mixture
8. Stir once or twice over a moderate heat then leave for about 1 minute for the bottom to brown
9. Sprinkle with the remaining cheese and cream slip the pan under a moderately hot griller or into a hot oven to set the omelet
10. This will only take a few minutes
11. When lightly browned and puffed , serve at once

title: jack s meat loaf
steps:
1. Grease a 3" x 9" loafpan w / margarine , mix all ingredients well , in a bowl , & form in a loaf in the pan
2. Bake @ 350' for 1 hour
3. Can make an optional sauce for the top = 1 / 4 c ketchup , 1 tsp onion powder & 1 tsp of prepared dijon or yellow mustard
4. Spoon on top and sprinkle a few minced onion flakes on top before baking

title: squash supreme
steps:
1. Put squash and onion in 2-quart saucepan with enough water to cover
2. Boil until tender , drain , and mash
3. Add other ingredients and mix well
4. Pour into a well-buttered 2-quart casserole dish and bake for 40 minutes at 375 degrees

title: cheesy brussels sprouts bake
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease a baking dish large enough to hold the mixture
3. To make the topping: stir together the bread crumbs and melted butter , add in the cheese , mix well until combined
4. Set aside
5. Wash and trim the sprouts and cut an "x" in the bottom
6. Cook the sprouts in boiling water for about 7-8 minutes , or until fairly tender
7. Drain and plunge into ice water or very cold water
8. Place into prepared baking dish
9. In a saucepan , melt butter over medium heat
10. Add in the thyme , fresh garlic and chopped onion
11. Saute for 3-5 minutes until soft
12. Add / whisk in flour , cook whisking for 5 minutes
13. Add in half and half cream , seasoning salt and pepper
14. Bring to a very light boil , and whisk continuously for about 6-7 minutes until mixture is smooth and thick
15. Remove from the heat
16. Add in the gruyere cheese
17. Stir until melted
18. Pour the creamed mixture over the sprouts in the dish
19. Sprinkle with the topping mixture
20. Bake for about 30 minutes , or until golden brown and bubbly
21. Delicious !

title: apple cinnamon butter crunch
steps:
1. Set oven to 375 degrees
2. Butter a 9 x 9-inch or an 11 x 7-inch baking pan
3. In a mixing bowl combine all the butter crunch
4. Mix well to combine with a wooden spoon
5. Sprinkle half of the mixture onto the bottom of the pan and press down light with back of a spoon
6. Bake for 15 minutes , or until lightly browned
7. In a mixing bowl combine the apple slices , brown sugar , flour , cinnamon , nutmeg and melted butter
8. Toss to combine
9. Spoon the mixture into the baked crust
10. Bake for about 30 minutes , or until apples are tender
11. Remove from oven and sprinkle the remaining butter crunch over the apples , then return to oven for about 10 minutes
12. Cool to room temperature

title: coffee soy glaze
steps:
1. In a small saucepan blend together the brown sugar and cornstarch
2. Add coffee , soy sauce , and vinegar
3. Mix well
4. Cook and stir mixture till thickened and bubbly
5. Use to baste spareribs or pork chops during the last 15 minutes of barbecuing

title: walnut cream cheese cake
steps:
1. Butter a 2 quart bundt or kugelhopf pan and dust with finely chopped walnuts
2. Preheat oven to 300f
3. Sift together the flour , baking powder , and salt
4. Set aside
5. In a large mixing bowl , cream the butter while adding the cream cheese , lemon rind , and sugar
6. Beat until smooth
7. Beat in the eggs , one at a time , until incorperated
8. The batter may appear slightly curdled , but that's normal for this batter so don't worry about it
9. Graduall add the dry mixture to the batter , then stir in the medium chopped walnuts
10. Pour the batter into the prepared pan and bake for about 1 hour and 20 minutes or until a knife inserted comes out clean
11. Cool on wire rack and serve at room temperature

title: skirlie  scottish oatmeal and onions
steps:
1. Melt the fat or heat the oil in a large frying pan
2. Add the onion and cook until soft and golden
3. Add the oatmeal and mix in well
4. Cook for about 5 minutes , stirring frequently
5. Add the stock and allow it to be absorbed by the oatmeal
6. Season well and serve with light creamy mashed potatoes

title: berry birthday waffles
steps:
1. Waffles: sift together dry ingredients in a medium mixing bowl
2. Beat egg whites until stiff and set aside
3. Whisk egg yolks , milk , agave nectar , and oil together
4. Add to dry ingredients and mix together thoroughly
5. Fold egg whites into the batter
6. Add batter to your heated waffle maker in amount recommended by your waffle maker's instructions and also cook per its instructions
7. Berry sauce: combine cup blueberries , preserves , and orange juice in a sauce pan over medium heat
8. Bring to a boil , reduce and cook for 5 minutes until thickened , stirring occasionally
9. Add remaining blueberries , strawberries , and orange liqueur
10. Stir and let stand a few minutes
11. Assembly: top each waffle with berry sauce and a dollop of whipped cream
12. For birthday waffles , add one candle to the top of the whipped cream and light after you have placed the waffle in front of your birthday boy / girl
13. Keeping the candle straight in your whipped cream could prove to be a little tricky but i made my own homemade and stiff enough to pull it off
14. Or , use a fresh strawberry to anchor your candle
15. The sauce was sweetened with mainstream tastebuds in mind
16. If you prefer something less sweet and a little tart as i do , you may want to skip the oj and go with water and a couple of teaspoons of lemon juice
17. I got 8-10 square waffles out of each batch using my chefmate waffle maker
18. Agave nectar is a syrup made from the agave plant whose sugars are mainly the fructose type
19. Coconut oil got a bad rap for years but make no mistake , it is good stuff
20. Your skin and hair will thank you for it

title: mustard  soy salmon
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees
2. Place salmon on foil lined baking sheet
3. In small bowl , mix tamari , honey , mustard and garlic
4. Pour over salmon and bake at 450 deg
5. For about 10- 15 minutes depending on thickness until salmon just pulls apart with fork
6. Meanwhile , cook rice according to package
7. Heat a skillet or wok over med-high heat , add oil , saute bok choy 4-6 minutes add onion , cook 1 more minute
8. Serve salmon and bok choy on top of rice

title: barbecue shrimp
steps:
1. Combine first 11 ingredients in a large nonstick skillet and bring to a boil
2. Add shrimp and cook 7 minutes , stirring occasionally
3. Add wine , cook another minute or two until the shrimp are done
4. Serve with bread and lemon wedges

title: crunchy potato casserole
steps:
1. In large , flat , rectangular pizza pan , melt butter in 375f oven
2. Meanwhile , arrange potato slices over bottom of pan , then turn once so they are coated with butter on both sides
3. Mix remaining ingredients and sprinkle over potatoes
4. Bake 30-40 minutes

title: fiery herbed barbecue sauce
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan over low heat mix brown sugar , cider vinegar , worcestershire sauce and coffee together
2. Whisk in ketchup , minced garlic , oregano , basil , rosemary , black pepper and cayenne pepper
3. Bring to a boil
4. Reducee heat and simmer , covered 5 minutes to allow the flavors to blend
5. Remove from heat and whisk in the oil
6. Taste and adjust seasonings if needed

title: radish  coleslaw
steps:
1. Shred cabbage , sprinkle with sugar and salt
2. Let set for two hours or longer
3. Turn mixture over a couple of time while cabbage is leaching its juices
4. Drain liquid from bowl
5. Add rest of the ingredients , toss and serve
6. May be chilled and served the next day

title: jalapeno butter sauce
steps:
1. Melt the butter
2. Whisk all ingredients together and serve
3. Voila !

title: homestyle pot roast for the crock pot
steps:
1. In a nonstick skillet , heat oil over medium high heat
2. Pat roast dry with paper towel and brown in skillet on all sides
3. Transfer to slow cooker
4. Reduce heat to medium
5. Add onions and celery and cook , stirring until softened
6. Add garlic , thyme , salt and pepper and cook , stirring for one minute
7. Add flour and cook , stirring for 1 more minute
8. Add beef broth and bay leaf and cook , stirring until thickened
9. Pour mixture over roast
10. Cover and cook on low for 10-12 hours or on high for 5-6 hours , until meat is tender
11. Stir green peppers and steak sauce into gravy
12. Cover and cook on high for 30 minutes until peppers are soft
13. To serve , discard bay leaf , place roast on platter and spoon sauce over
14. Enjoy !

title: seared sea scallops
steps:
1. Heat the olive oil and butter in a large pan over medium-high heat
2. Salt and pepper both sides of the scallops and place them in the pan
3. Whatever you do , do not move the scallops at all until ready to flip
4. Sear the scallops on each side for 1
5. 5 minutes , then remove from the pan and serve

title: authentic sopa de albondigas  meatball soup
steps:
1. Mix the meatball ingredients together in a bowl until combined
2. Shape the meatballs into walnut sized balls
3. Place the meatballs on a clean plate , cover with plastic and refrigerate until you are ready to cook them
4. Place the dry chilies , garlic cloves and tomato into a small sauce pan
5. Fill with water until the chilies are completely covered
6. Boil the chilies and tomato on medium high heat for 15 minutes
7. Cover and set aside
8. In a large stock pot , heat the oil
9. Saute the onions for 2 minutes
10. Add in the carrots and stir
11. Pour in the water , cumin , bouillon cubes , chayote , potatoes and green beans
12. While the soup is heating up , place the tomato , chilies and garlic in the blender with 2 cups of fresh water
13. Blend on high or 5 minutes
14. Using a fine mesh strainer , strain the blended chile into the stock pot scraping the bottom with a spoon
15. This may require two or three times once you have strained all of the chile into the stock pot , stir and bring to a boil
16. Once the soup is boiling taste the soup and add salt if needed
17. Cook the soup for 15 minutes
18. Next , turn the heat down to medium low
19. Add in the meatballs one at a time until they are all in the pot
20. Gently stir the soup to make sure the meatballs are incorporated in with the broth and vegetables
21. Cover the soup and cook for an additional 30 minutes
22. Serve the soup in bowls garnished with chopped cilantro and lime wedges
23. Enjoy !

title: california style salsa
steps:
1. In small bowl combine all ingredients and mix well
2. Store in refrigerator for 10 days
3. Serve as a garnish or dip

title: peach and ginger green tea smoothie
steps:
1. Brew green tea in 1 / 2 cup water , heated to 180degrees for 4 min
2. , remove leaves , let cool
3. Blend ice , peach , banana , honey and ginger until smooth
4. Right before serving stir in green tea
5. Serve immediately

title: chili fries
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees
2. Combine first 6 ingredients in a large bowl
3. Peel potatoes , and cut into 1 / 4 inch strips
4. Add potato strips to olive oil mixture
5. Toss gently to coat
6. Arrange potato strips in a single layer on a baking sheet lightly coated with cooking spray
7. Bake , for 25 minutes or until golden brown

title: paisano sandwich
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a skillet
2. Add the peppers , onion , garlic , basil and oregano
3. Cook until the vegetables are tender[just under 10 minutes]
4. Toast or grill the bread
5. Spoon the peppers and onions over the toasted bread , top with sliced mozzarella and melt the cheese under the grill

title: potatoes o brien  potatoes with peppers and pimentos
steps:
1. Peel the potatoes and cut into 1 / 2 inch cubes
2. Place potato cubes in a saucepan and cover with water
3. Salt to taste
4. Bring to a boil and cook 1 or 2 minutes
5. Drain
6. Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat
7. Add potatoes and cook while stirring and shaking pan until golden , about 10 minutes
8. Add the onion , salt and pepper , stir
9. Add green pepper and cook while stirring for about 3 minutes
10. Add butter and cook 2 minutes
11. Stir in pimento , stir , and serve

title: outstanding meatloaf
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. In a large bowl , mix all ingredients except bread slices together thoroughly
3. Line bottom of loaf pan with the sliced bread
4. Press meatloaf mixture firmly in the loaf pan and bake for 45 - 60 minutes until done

title: pineapple  apple  banana and orange juice
steps: 1. Place everything into a powerful blender and puree

title: ice cream drinks  alcoholic
steps:
1. Soften ice cream , in a very large bown mix all together with a hand held electric mixer
2. Pour back into ice cream bucket and freeze
3. Cooking time is freezing time
4. Liquors listed above are for a brandy alexander
5. Can vary:
6. Pink squirrel:
7. 3 / 4 to 1 cup creme de almond
8. 3 / 4 to 1 cup white creme de cocoa
9. Grasshopper:
10. 3 / 4 to 1 cup green creme de menthe
11. 3 / 4 to 1 cup white creme de cocoa
12. White russian:
13. 3 / 4 to 1 cup kahlua
14. 3 / 4 to 1 cup vodka
15. Mudslide:
16. 1 / 2 cup vodka
17. 1 / 2 cup kahlua
18. 1 / 2 cup baileye irish cream

title: polish hamburgers for a crowd
steps:
1. Mix together the beef , salt and pepper
2. Shape into 24 patties
3. Place in baking pan in single layer and bake in a 400 oven until browned
4. Combine chili sauce , beer , ale or consomme , onion soup mix and tabasco
5. Bring to a boil
6. Pour over hamburgers and bake 15 minutes
7. Then just keep them warm until they're gone
8. Or until the crowd is gone
9. Leftovers are good , too

title: green beans and water chestnuts
steps:
1. In a large saucepan over high heat , bring to a boil enough water to cover beans
2. Boil beans for 4 inutes
3. Drain and plunge into ice water to halt cooking
4. Drain
5. In a large skillet , heat vegetable oil over high heat , swirling to coat bottom of pan
6. Stir-fry water chestnuts for 1 minute
7. Add garlic and ginger
8. Add beans and salt
9. Cook until heated thoroughly , stirring constantly
10. Serve on a platter
11. Chef

title: shredded carrot salad
steps:
1. In a serving bowl , combine the carrots , raisins , nuts and mayonnaise
2. Refrigerate leftovers

title: low carb pancakes with soy and coconut flour
steps:
1. Mix wet ingredients and mix dry ingredients
2. Pour wet into dry ingredients and mix just until combined
3. This batter will be thicker than normal pancake batter
4. Cook in pan / griddle on med heat with oil
5. Flip when underside is browned
6. The middle of these pancakes will feel a bit soft on the inside
7. Once cooled a bit , it will firm up

title: cinnamon pancetta carbonara by giada de laurentiis
steps:
1. Saute the bacon and pancetta in a heavy large frying pan over medium heat until almost crisp , about 5 minutes
2. Sprinkle the cinnamon over the bacon and pancetta and saute until the bacon is crisp and golden , about 2 minutes longer
3. Cool
4. Whisk in the cream , cheese , and yolks to blend
5. Meanwhile , bring a large pot of salted water to a boil over high heat
6. Add the fettuccine and cook until it is just tender but still firm to the bite , stirring occasionally , about 3 minutes
7. Drain
8. Add the fettuccine to the cream mixture and toss over medium-low heat until the sauce coats the pasta thickly , about 5 minutes
9. Season the pasta , to taste , with salt and pepper
10. Transfer the pasta to a large wide serving bowl
11. Sprinkle with chives and serve

title: malaysian laksa
steps:
1. Shell prawns / shrimp and reserve prawn / shrimp in one bowl and heads and shells in a separate bowl
2. Set aside for later use
3. Using a food process make 'spice paste' add shallots , garlic , ginger , chillies , dried prawns and water
4. Then blend until it forms a smooth paste
5. Set aside
6. In a large pot , add vegetable oil and heat
7. Once the oil is hot add prawns / shrimp shells and fry for about one minute or until they turn red
8. Remove from pan and discard
9. This will add prawn / shrimp flavour to the oil
10. To make the 'laksa broth' add 'spice paste' to prawn / shrimp flavoured oil and fry for a minute
11. Add laksa paste and simmer for about two minutes
12. Pour in the chicken or vegetable stock and bring to boil ,
13. Then add coconut cream , fish balls , fried tofu , sugar , fish sauce , salt and freshly squeezed lime juice
14. Bring to boil
15. Half fill a medium pot with water and bring to boil
16. Add rice vermicelli for a few minutes until they become soft then remove into separate serving bowls
17. Add egg noodles in boiling water for five minutes or until soft and transfer into the same bowls as rice vermicelli
18. In the same pot poach reserved prawn / shrimp meat until it's pink then transfer them into the same bowl as the rice vermicelli and egg noodles
19. Pour 'laksa broth' into the serving bowls
20. Then top with shredded chicken , bean sprouts , spring onions , chilli , coriander , fried shallots and serve with lime wedge's
21. Enjoy

title: mocha whip drink  alcoholic  or not
steps:
1. Fill a tall glass with chipped ice
2. Add the chocolate milk and the cold coffee and mix gently
3. Top the mocha mix with your favorite whipped cream
4. Sprinkle the top with your shaved chocolate and you are ready to serve
5. This recipe makes one serving
6. For a little bit of a kick , add one ounce of either kahlua or bailey's irish cream
7. Enjoy !

title: spaetzle
steps:
1. Mix the flour eggs & salt together
2. Slowly add the water until the dough is smooth , but not stiff
3. Continue to blend the dough until it has enlarged in size
4. Heat a pot of salted water to boiling add a tbsp oil
5. Put batches of your dough in the hopper of the spaetzle grater and grate the noodles into the boiling water
6. Do the recipe bit by bit lifting the noodles out of the water when they float keep warm while you cook the rest
7. N>b> if you do not have a spaetzle grater roll out the dough to about 1 / 4" thickness and slice across then slice the other way to have them the size you want them
8. Boil the same as with the spaetzle grater
9. Enjoy

title: cheese crackers  gluten free
steps:
1. In a food processor or large mixing bowl , combine flour , salt , cayenne pepper , and ground mustard
2. Cut the butter into the flour mixture until it resembles coarse meal
3. Mix in the cheese , and blend until the cheese is evenly coated
4. In a separate bowl , mix together the egg yolks and the water
5. Add the egg mixture to the flour mixture and blend to form a dough that will hold together in a cohesive ball
6. Add more flour if needed to make a workable dough
7. It should be mostly cohesive but somewhat crumbly
8. Divide dough into two equal portions and flatten into discs about inches thick
9. Wrap each in plastic wrap and chill for about one hour
10. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f
11. On a lightly-floured surface or pastry cloth , roll out a dough disc into a circle approximately 1 / 2 inch thick
12. The dough will be somewhat crumbly
13. Just do your best to keep sticking it together
14. Cut the dough circle into four equal segments
15. Without rotating each segment to align the cut and non-cut sides , stack the segments atop each other
16. Press the dough segments gently together , and re-flouring if necessary , roll the dough out again
17. Repeat the cutting , lifting , and rolling two more times
18. The last time you roll the dough , roll it to about 1 / 8-inch thickness
19. If desired , sprinkle top lightly with salt
20. Press lightly into dough with rolling pin
21. Cut the dough into 1-inch squares
22. Place them on an ungreased baking sheet
23. Prick each square once or twice with the tines of a fork
24. Bake the crackers for about 8-10 minutes
25. If any crackers are browned through , remove them to a cooling rack
26. Turn the rest and bake an additional 5-8 minutes , or until medium to medium-dark brown
27. Cool on a rack
28. Then store in an airtight container
29. Repeat the rolling , cutting , and baking for the second dough disc

title: pampered chef banana split brownie pizza
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Prepare brownie mix according to package directions
3. Place parchment paper on 15-inch baking stone
4. Pour brownie mixture on paper and spread into 14-inch circle
5. Do not bake without parchment paper or batter will run off stone while baking
6. Bake 15-20 minutes or until set
7. Cool completely
8. Mix cream cheese and sugar until smooth
9. Add drained pineapple and mix well
10. Spread over brownie crust
11. Slice banana and strawberries
12. Chop nuts
13. Arrange fruits and nuts on top of cream cheese mixture
14. Drizzle with chocolate syrup
15. Chill

title: lamburgers with tzatziki sauce
steps:
1. Tzatziki sauce: mix together yogurt , cucumber , 1 clove chopped garlic , lemon juice
2. Add salt and pepper to taste
3. Place in the refrigerator
4. This should ideally sit for a few hours
5. Place ground lamb in large bowl and mix in oregano , parsley , 1 tsp salt , 1 tsp pepper , and 2 cloves chopped garlic until evenly distributed
6. Pour in feta and chopped green olives and mix gently
7. Form patties , trying to tuck as much of the cheese and green olives inside
8. Grill for 4-5 minutes per side for medium rare
9. If using a stove top , cook on medium high heat
10. Lightly toast buns
11. Serve burgers with tzatziki sauce , lettuce , and sliced tomatoes

title: pistachio pasta
steps:
1. Prepare linguini using package instructions
2. Meanwhile , heat oil in a nonstick pan
3. Fry garlic and pistachios until garlic is brown and pistachios are tender
4. Add onion to pan
5. Fry onion until tender
6. Add ingredients in pan to linguini
7. I added some prepared pesto sauce from a jar , but i think that a little olive oil and some shredded romano or parmesan cheese would be really good as well !
8. I also added crushed black pepper

title: new potato bake
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375 degrees f
2. Place potatoes and salt in large saucepan
3. Add cold water to cover
4. Bring to a boil
5. Simmer 8 minutes
6. Just before draining , add spinach
7. Drain
8. Sauce: in small saucepan , melt butter over medium heat
9. Add scallions
10. Cook for 5 minutes or until softened
11. Sprinkle flour over scallions and whisk to blend
12. In 2 additions , whisk in warm milk until smooth
13. Add salt , pepper , cayenne and nutmeg
14. Bring to a boil over medium heat , whisking occasionally
15. Remove from heat
16. Whisk in 1 cup of the cheese
17. Coat 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray
18. Layer half the potatoes and spinach in dish
19. Spoon half the sauce over
20. Sprinkle with half the remaining cheese
21. Top with remaining potatoes and sauce
22. Sprinkle with reserved cheese
23. Bake at 375 degrees f for 20 minutes
24. Top with bread crumbs
25. Bake 10 minutes more until browned
26. Let stand 10 to 15 minutes

title: chocolate panini
steps:
1. Brush butter on one side of the slices of bread
2. On a work surface , put 4 slices of bread , buttered-side down , and sprinkle with chocolate up to 1 / 4 inch from the crust
3. Cover with remaining slices of bread , buttered-side up
4. In a large striped pan or non-stick skillet , cook sandwiches at medium-low heat , 2 at the same time , 6 to 8 minutes or until chocolate has melted and the bread is golden
5. Cook remaining sandwiches the same way
6. Cut sandwiches in 2 and sprinkle with icing sugar
7. Serve warm

title: grand marnier pound cake
steps:
1. Cake:
2. Preheat oven to 350
3. Generously butter a 10-inch fluted tube pan
4. Then sprinkle it with flour , tapping out excess
5. Set aside
6. In large bowl , beat butter until creamy
7. Gradually beat in sugar , continue beating until the mix is light and fluffy
8. Turn mixer to low , sift in flour , baking powder , and salt
9. Beat until flour is absorbed
10. Beat in grand marnier and orange zest
11. Beat in eggs , one at a time , beating well after each addition
12. Add mini-chips
13. Spread the batter in the prepared pan , smoothing the top even
14. Bake for 1 hour or until the cake shrinks from the side of the pan
15. You can use the toothpick method too !
16. Let stand in the pan on a wire rack for 10 minutes , then carefully unmold the cake onto a second rack placed over a piece of wax paper or foil
17. Glaze:
18. Meanwhile , combine the orange juice , grand marnier and sugar in a small saucepan
19. Bring to a boil over moderate heat
20. Lower heat and simmer until the mixture forms a light syrup , about 5 minutes
21. Brush the syrup all over the warm cake
22. When cooled , transfer it to a serving plate

title: japanese steakhouse ginger salad dressing copycat shogun steak
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a blender
2. Blend on high speed for about 30 seconds or until all of the ginger is well-pureed
3. This recipe yields 1 3 / 4 cups

title: honey glazed shallots
steps:
1. Trim ends and
2. Remove papery skins
3. In a large nonstick skillet , melt butter over medium heat
4. Stir in honey
5. Add shallots salt and pepper
6. Pour in chicken broth and bring to a simmer
7. Cook , uncovered , shaking pan several times , until shallots are tender and almost all of the liquid has evaporated to a glaze , 25-30 minutes
8. Stir in parsley and mint before serving

title: chocolate crinkles
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , mix together the cocoa powder , sugar , and vegetable oil
2. Beat in eggs one at a time , then stir in the vanilla
3. In another bowl combine the flour , baking powder , and salt
4. Stir flour mixture into the cocoa mixture
5. Cover dough bowl with plastic wrap , put in refrigerator , and chill for at least 4 hours
6. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
7. Line cookie sheets with parchment paper
8. Roll the dough into one inch balls
9. Coat each ball in powdered sugar before placing onto parchment-lined cookie sheets
10. Bake in preheated 350 degrees f oven for 10 to 12 minutes
11. Let the cooked cookies stand on the cookie sheet for at least 1 minute before transferring to wire racks to cool

title: simply potato souffl  5fix
steps:
1. Crisp the prosciutto in a 350 oven for 10 minutes
2. Let cool then crumble into small pieces
3. Set oven to 375
4. Separate the egg whites and yolks
5. Whip the 3 egg whites until stiff
6. Mix together the simply potatoes , 1 egg yolk , prosciutto , and white cheddar cheese
7. Fold in the egg whites
8. Put the mixture into a greased mini-cheesecake pan
9. Sprinkle 2 t
10. Of chives on top
11. Bake for 25-30 minutes
12. Let cool for 5 minutes , then remove from pan
13. Sprinkle the remaining chives on top

title: freeform fruit tart
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Combine plums , raspberries , and splenda and toss gently to combine
3. Roll out pie crust to 12 inches
4. Place pie crust on parchment paper on baking sheet
5. Mound fruit in center of dough , leaving 2-3 inch border around edge
6. Fold dough up over fruit , continue around tart overlapping dough every 2 to 3 inches
7. Gently pinch pleated dough to secure
8. Working quickly , brush dough with water and sprinkle evenly with 1 tablespoon sugar
9. Bake until crust is golden brown and fruit is bubbling , 50 to 55 minutes
10. Cool tart about 20 minutes
11. Other delicious combinations: peaches and blueberries or apricots and blackberries

title: linda s roast pork with rosemary  garlic  lime and oil rub
steps:
1. Sprinkle the roast with lime juice , then liberally with garlic powder , putting some all over the bottom of the pan , so it will make a nice gravy
2. Pat on the rosemary , all over the roast
3. Pour olive oil over every side of the roast , and rub it in , then sprinkle with salt and pepper
4. Bake the roast in a lg
5. Cast iron frying pan , at 350f for 2 1 / 2 hours
6. When done remove the roast to a dish , and put it back in the oven , on warm , while you prepare the gravy
7. To make gravy:
8. Drain the fat out of the pan
9. Add about 5 cups of water
10. Add 1 pkg
11. Of mccormick gravy mix to the pan drippings , and mix inches
12. Put the heat on med-high
13. Add about 3 / 4 cup of cornstarch to 1 / 2 cup cold water
14. Pour into pan
15. Add salt and pepper to taste
16. Let come to a soft boil
17. If it is too thick , add a little water at a time , until desired consistency is achieved
18. If it is too thin , add more cornstarch , and water mix
19. After the roast sits for a few mins
20. , you can mix any juice , from the roast dish , into the pan of gravy , to give it more flavor
21. Add about 3 t
22. Gravy master , and stir in well

title: roasted prosciutto wrapped fish
steps:
1. Heat oven to 450 degrees
2. In a small food processor , combine herbs with pine nuts , enough olive oil to make a thick paste , and salt and pepper
3. Season fillets with salt and pepper
4. Lay two slices of prosciutto on a board , slightly overlapping like fish scales
5. Smear prosciutto with a layer of herb mixture , then lay fish in center and wrap it up
6. Heat a large ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat for about 2 minutes
7. Add butter
8. When foam subsides , cook fish for a minute on each side , then roast until tender , 5 to 10 minutes depending on thickness
9. Fillets are done when a thin-bladed knife will pass through their thickest point with little resistance

title: chocolate peanut butter cookies
steps:
1. Set aside 1 can plus 1 / 3 cup frosting
2. In a large bowl , combine egg , peanut butter and remaining frosting
3. Stir in flour until moist
4. Drop by rounded tablespoons 2 inches apart on greased baking sheets
5. Flatten cookies with a fork dipped in sugar
6. Bake at 375 degrees for 8 - 11 minutes or until set
7. Cool completely , spread with frosting

title: raw chocolate and date truffles
steps:
1. If using regular dates , you must soak them for at least 6 hours , or overnight then drain well
2. Place the seeds and or nuts in to a food processer
3. Blend for a minute or so until a dense flour like consistency is achieved
4. Add the remaining ingredients and pulse a couple of times until the ingredients begin to stick together , almost like a dough
5. Use your hands to form small balls
6. Roll the balls in the remaining desiccated coconut to finish
7. The truffles can be kept at room temperature , but i find they are best kept in the fridge
8. Makes around 30 truffles
9. They will keep for 3-4 days

title: cowboy casserole for two
steps:
1. In a large skillet , cook beef over medium heat until no longer pink
2. Stir in the corn , soup , 1 / 4 cup cheese , milk , sour cream , onion powder and pepper
3. Place 1 cup tater tots in a greased 3-cup baking dish
4. Layer with beef mixture and remaining tater tots
5. Sprinkle with remaining cheese
6. Bake , uncovered , at 375 for 20-25 minutes or until bubbly

title: steak mustard dip
steps:
1. Combine soy sacue , vinegar , mustard , & hot pepper sauce
2. Whisk in mayonaise& sour cream
3. Refrigerate for at least 30 minutes
4. Will keep for about a week
5. Serve as a dip for steak

title: conley s chicken cheese spread
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a baking dish except 2 oz cheddar cheese
2. Bake at 350 for 20 minutes
3. Add remaining 2 oz cheddar cheese and bake 5 more minutes

title: barley minestrone with pesto
steps:
1. Place the barley in a pan , cover with cold water , and bring to a boil
2. Cook for 25-30 minutes until tender
3. Then drain
4. In a large pot , combine all vegetables with the stock and bring to a boil , then lower the heat and simmer for 15 minutes until the vegetables are just tender
5. To make pesto , place the basil and garlic in a blender
6. Add 1 / 2 cup of the vegetable cooking liquid and blitz to a smooth puree
7. Add the puree to the soup , stir until combined , then add the cooked barley
8. Season with black pepper and serve

title: cream cheese banana nut bread
steps:
1. Beat butter and cream cheese at medium speed with electric mixer until creamy
2. Gradually add sugar , beating until light and fluffy
3. Add eggs , 1 at a time , beating until just blended
4. Combine flour , baking powder and soda , and salt
5. Gradually add this to butter mixture beating at low speed just until blended
6. Stir in bananas , pecans , and vanilla
7. Spoon batter into 2 greased and floured loaf pans
8. Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
9. You may need to shield the top with foil for last 15 minutes to prevent browning
10. Cool bread in pans for 10 minutes , remove from pan , and let cool additional 30 minutes

title: cranberry honey mustard
steps:
1. Soak dried cranberries with the mustard and vinegar in a covered jar for 48 hours add extra vinegar if needed but the seeds should stay covered
2. Scrape the soaked seed-and-cranberry mixture into a food processor and process until the mixture turns creamy 3-4 minutes add honey and salt
3. Process again for 30 seconds
4. Add more vinegar if needed for a creamy consistancy
5. It will thicken slightly and have a better flavor as it ages
6. Makes about 3 1 / 3 cups

title: creamed corn  parsley   bacon on muffins
steps:
1. Fry bacon in a non-stick pan until crisp
2. Drain
3. Heat corn in a pan over a low heat , add in bacon & parsley
4. Spread muffins with butter and top with corn mixture
5. Serve garnished with extra parsley if desired

title: cabbage soup with ham   fresh herbs
steps:
1. Tie together the sprigs of sage , parsley and bay with cooking twine to make an herb bundle
2. Set aside for later use
3. Coat a large non-stick pot with cooking spray
4. Add the onions , cover and cook over medium heat , stirring occasionally , for 5 to 6 minutes , or until the onions start to turn color
5. Uncover and cook for an additional 3 to 4 minutes , until golden
6. If necessary , add 1 to 2 tablspoons water to prevent sticking
7. Add the vegetable broth , cabbage , potatoes , ham or bacon , dill seed and herb bundle
8. Cover and bring to almost a boil
9. Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes , or until the potatoes are tender
10. If a slightly thicker soup is desired , mash some of the potatoes against the side of the pot with the back of a large wooden spoon
11. Remove the herb bundle and stir in the vinegar
12. Season to taste with salt and freshly ground black pepper
13. Serve each bowl garnished with freshly chopped parsley

title: mozzarella  tomato and basil quiche
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f or 180c
2. Lay the sheet of pastry dough over a 9-inch quiche pan , pressing the dough gently into the crimped edges
3. Cut away any excess dough so the pastry is level with the top of the pan
4. Prick the base of the pastry with a fork
5. Lay half the sliced tomatoes evenly over the pastry
6. Scatter half the cheese and chopped basil over the tomatoes
7. Repeat with the rest of the tomatoes , cheese and basil
8. Mix the eggs and cream together and season with salt and pepper to taste
9. Pour carefully over the other ingredients in the pastry shell , leaving a little space for the mixture to rise slightly in the oven
10. Bake in the oven for 40-45 minutes or until the egg mixture is cooked and set
11. Let stand for 5 minutes before cutting
12. Serve hot or cold !

title: dal bhat  red lentils with rice
steps:
1. Wash the lentils and rinse a couple of times
2. Be careful to remove any stones
3. If you have time , soak the lentils in water as long as you can , up to overnight , before you cook
4. They get very soft and cook faster
5. Start rice preparation according to package directions
6. Prep the onion , garlic , ginger , tomatoes , and cilantro / green onion and set aside
7. Heat oil on high
8. Add ginger , garlic and onion , and stir fry on high until the onion is a little brown on the edges , 1-2 minutes
9. Stir in cumin seeds , salt , turmeric , mustard seed and coriander powder
10. Turn the heat down to medium and cook for 2 minutes , stirring often
11. Add tomatoes and butter
12. Stir , cover with lid and cook for 4 minutes
13. Stir in the lentils , cover and cook for 5 minutes
14. After cooking for 5 minutes , add one cup of water , cover with lid and cook for 5 more minutes
15. When the 5 minutes are up , stir in 2 more cups of water , as the water will begin to decrease as you cook
16. Continue cooking on medium for 10 minutes
17. The dal should be cooked and ready to serve
18. If not tender , cook a little longer , adding more water if necessary
19. Sprinkle the chopped cilantro and / or green onion on top of the dal and serve with or on top of the rice
20. It is typical to serve with chutney or spicy peppers

title: yellow squash oreganato
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat
2. Add onion and garlic
3. Cook , stirring frequently , until onion is lightly browned , 8 to 10 minutes
4. Add squash
5. Sprinkle evenly with oregano , salt and pepper
6. Cover and cook until squash is lightly browned and tender-crisp , 5 to 7 mintues
7. Turn squash several times while cooking to brown both sides

title: crock pot golden chicken with noodles  campbell s
steps:
1. Mix soup , water , lemon juice , mustard , garlic and carrots in slow cooker
2. Add chicken and turn to coat
3. Cover and cook on low 7 to 8 hours
4. Or until done
5. Serve over noodles
6. Sprinkle with parsley
7. Serves 8

title: vegetable medley with toastedsesame seeds
steps:
1. In a large microwave safe bowl , combine the carrots , broccoli , mushrooms , zucchini , garlic , and water
2. Cover and microwave 3-5 minutes or until the vegetables are tender , stirring twice
3. Drain , stir in the butter , sesame seeds , salt , and pepper

title: korean grilled chicken  asian
steps:
1. In a shallow baking dish stir together the first nine ingredients
2. Add chicken , turning to coat
3. Cover and refrigerate , turning once , at least three hours
4. Grill over low coals or using indirect method , turning and basting frequently , about 50 minutes

title: thyme and garlic roast chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 160c
2. Wash and pat the chicken dry
3. Place 1 lemon into the cavity if the chicken and tie the legs with kitchen string to secure them
4. Place the garlic , thyme and remaining lemon into a baking dish and place the chicken on top
5. Brush chicken with the olive oil and sprinkle with salt
6. Pour in the stock and wine and cover with foil , and roast chicken for 2 hours
7. Remove foil , increase the oven temperature to 200 c and roast chicken for a further 25 minutes or until golden and juices run clear from chicken when tested with a skewer

title: lemony rhubarb upside down cake
steps:
1. Spray a 13 x 9 baking pan with a vegetable cooking spray
2. Layer rhubarb , sugar , marshmallows and dry jello
3. Make cake mix according to package directions and pour evenly over mixture in pan
4. Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour
5. Cool and turn pan upside down over a foil line cookie sheet
6. Cut into squares and enjoy !

title: vanilla cinnamon fruit salad
steps:
1. Combine all fruit in large bowl
2. In small bowl , combine pudding mix and cinnamon
3. Sprinkle over fruit and stir lightly
4. Sprinkle juice over fruit 1 t at a time , stirring lightly until slightly pasty

title: arm roast sloppy joes
steps:
1. In hot dutch oven , brown arm roast in oil
2. Cover and simmer for 1 1 / 2 hours adding water if necessary
3. Add onion and garlic and continue simmering for 1 hour , oruntil beef is fork tender
4. With two forks , break meat into coarse shreds and chunks
5. Add remaining ingredients , bring back to a simmer
6. Cover and simmer 1 hour
7. Grill lightly buttered hamburger buns and pile on the meat

title: classic apple charoset
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients
2. Refrigerate 2 hours in an airtight container
3. If you refrigerate , too far in advance , it will get watery

title: dauphine potatoes
steps:
1. Bring first 3 ingredients to boiling in 1 quart saucepan
2. Add flour all at once
3. Stir , cook over low heat for 1-2 minutes or until mixture leaves side of pan and forms ball
4. Cool slightly
5. Beat in 1 egg at a time
6. Peel potatoes , boil and mash until fluffy
7. Add to chou paste
8. Mix well
9. Shape into 1 inch balls
10. Roll in panko
11. Fry in olive oil for 2-3 minutes or until browned
12. Make sure oil is very hot before adding potato balls
13. Drain on paper towels

title: the perfect green smoothie
steps:
1. Put everything in a blender in the order that's listed-the milk should be on the bottom and the spinach on the top
2. Mix on high speed until the mixture is thick and chunless-you may have to scrape down the side because you do not want spinach chunks
3. Pour into a really tall glass and enjoy

title: outdoor  potato salad
steps:
1. Put the potatoes into a large cooking pot , cover with water and bring to a boil , lower the heat and simmer until the potatoes are fork tender
2. Drain and cool the potatoes , combine with the other ingredients and set aside for at least 1 hour

title: crock pot mexican chili con carne
steps:
1. In a large non-stick skillet over medium heat combine ground beef , garlic , celery and onions
2. Cook until vegetables are tender and meat is no longer pink
3. Add chilli powder , oregano , an cayenne
4. Cook 1 minute longer
5. With a slotted spoon , transfer mixture to slow cooker
6. Add tomatoes kidney beans , cocoa , sugar , cloves , vinegar and pepper , stir to combine
7. Cover and cook on low for 6-8 hours or on high for 3-4 hours until hot and bubbling
8. Add green pepper and stir to combine
9. Cover and cook 20-25 minutes longer
10. Season to taste with salt and pepper

title: lenten eggplant  aubergine
steps:
1. Cut eggplant into small cubes , place on platter and sprinkle them with 2 tablespoons of salt
2. Let stand for 15 minutes , then blot with paper towels , squeezing out as much juice as possible
3. In large skillet , heat oil and add eggplant , onion , scallions , dill , tomatoes , and salt and pepper to taste
4. Reduce heat , cover , and cook , stirring often , for 10-15 minutes
5. If necessary , add some water , about 2-3 tablespoons or more
6. When vegetables are tender , sprinkle with flour and parsley and cook for an additional 5 minutes , stirring occasionally
7. Add olives to heat through
8. Can be served hot or cold

title: mom s fried red tomatoes
steps:
1. Cut tomatoes into thick slices
2. Put aside
3. Mix flour , salt and pepper in shallow dish for coating
4. Heat butter and olive oil in pan , until it's hot enough to fry inches
5. Pre-heat oven to warm setting
6. Coat tomato slices in flour mixture
7. Place in pan until gloden brown
8. Place on baking sheet and place in warm oven until ready to serve

title: the embers original 1  pork chop
steps:
1. Marinating sauce:
2. Take soy sauce , water , brown sugar , molasses and salt - mix together in a saucepan and bring to a boil
3. Let cool
4. Put chops in a pan with bone side up
5. Pour marinade over the pork chops and let stand overnight in refrigerator
6. Take chops out of marinade , place in baking pan and cover tightly with foil
7. Put in 375 degree oven and bake until tender - about 2 hours
8. Red sauce
9. While chops are baking , combine all red sauce ingredients in heavy saucepan or double boiler
10. Mix well - leaving no lumps
11. Bring all ingredients to a slight boil
12. After chops are tender , remove from oven and dip in red sauce
13. Take chops after dipping and place in baking pan and bake for 30 minutes in 350 degree oven or until slightly glazed
14. Both sauces can be reused if brought to a boil and stored in refrigerator or frozen
15. For an extra flavor keep at room temperature until you are ready to put on a charcoal pit or grill
16. Have grill as high as possible from coals , not a large bed of coals is needed
17. Place finished chops on grill , let cook slowly , a little blacking does not hurt chops -- grilling should not take more than 15 minutes

title: tostones  pronounced toes tone es
steps:
1. Cut right through the skin og the plantains and cut them into 1 inch chunks
2. Peel the skins off and using the back of a big spoon , flatten the plantain down
3. Soak all the pieces in water for 10 minutes and them salt them
4. Fry them up in corn oil and voila , tostones
5. A puerto rican favorite

title: new potatoes with cumin
steps:
1. Scrub potatoes and put them in a saucepan
2. Cover with water to come about 1 inch above the potatoes
3. Add 1 t salt to the water and bring to a boil
4. Cover and boil till potatoes are just tender
5. Drain and peel
6. Put the oil in a frying pan and set over med-high heat
7. When the oil is hot , put in cumin seeds
8. Let the seeds sizzle for a few seconds
9. Put in potatoes
10. Turn heat down to medium
11. Brown potatoes lightly on all sides
12. Turn heat to low and add 3 / 4 t salt and ground cumin , garam masala and cayenne
13. Cook , stirring , for a minute
14. Add the cilantro just before serving and toss to mix

title: healthier huevos rancheros
steps:
1. Bake the two large tortillas into a bowl shape - about 10 minutes in a 350 degree oven
2. Watch them carefully so they do not burn on the edges
3. Put the refried beans in a microwave safe covered casserole and cook on high for 3-5 minutes
4. Spray a non-stick fry pan with cooking spray and fry eggs over easy
5. I fry six at once in a large fry pan
6. Pre-heat oven to 400 degrees
7. Spray a cookie sheet with cooking spray and put the empty baked tortilla bowls on it
8. Add 8oz beans to each tortilla bowl and spread evenly on the bottom of the bowls
9. Place 2 or 3 fried eggs on top of the beans in each bowl
10. Put about 8 oz salsa in each bowl on top of the eggs
11. Top each bowl with 1 cup of the shredded cheese
12. Carefully place in 400 degree oven for about 5 minutes to melt the cheese
13. Watch that the edges do not burn
14. If cheese does not melt enough turn on the broiler for 1 - 3 minutes
15. Garnish with jalapeno slices if desired
16. Enjoy

title: old wessex oat bran muffins
steps:
1. Combine dry ingredients and mix well
2. Whisk remaining ingredients together
3. Add wet to dry ingredients and stir until moistened
4. Divide batter between 12 sprayed muffin cups and bake at 425 degrees for 10-15 minutes , or until golden brown and test done

title: 15 minute jello trifle
steps:
1. Drizzle cake cubes with liqueur or juice
2. Fold 1 / 2 cup whipped topping into prepared pudding
3. Sprinkle strawberries with sugar
4. Assemble trifle by layering into deep glass bowl , half each of cake cubes , pudding mixture , strawberries and chocolate
5. Repeat layers , ending with chocolate
6. Top with additional whipped topping
7. Garnish with additional whole berries
8. Chill

title: texas fudge
steps:
1. Grease a 9x13" baking pan
2. Spread 1 / 2 of the grated cheeses on the bottom
3. Cover with the chiles
4. Top with the other half of the cheeses
5. Mix eggs with mustard and worcestershire sauce
6. Pour over cheese
7. Bake@ 375 for 30 minutes
8. Cut into squares to serve

title: vegan  buttermilk  brownies
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375
2. Grease a 9x13" baking pan
3. In a large bowl , combine flour , sugar and cocoa and mix well
4. In small saucepan , combine water and applesauce and bring to a boil
5. Add to flour mixture and beat at low speed just until blended
6. Continue beating at high speed until smooth
7. Add baking soda and soy milk-vinegar to flour mixture and blend well
8. Pour into greased pan and bake at 375 for 15 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the middle comes out clean
9. Be careful not to overbake
10. To make frosting: in large saucepan , combine cocoa , milk-vinegar , and butter substitute
11. Bring to a boil over medium heat , then remove from heat and add powdered sugar and vanilla
12. Mix well , and spread over warm brownies
13. Allow to cool before cutting into bars and serving

title: mediterranean roasted green beans with slivered almonds
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425
2. Lightly oil a baking sheet and set aside
3. Combine the broth , lemon juice and oil in a glass measuring cup
4. Place the beans on the prepared baking sheet and drizzle with the broth mixture
5. Spread the beans out into a single layer
6. Roast for 8 minutes
7. Remove the baking sheet from the oven
8. Season beans with the salt and the freshly ground pepper , then stir and turn over
9. Sprinkle with the almonds
10. Roast for an additional 5-7 minutes , or until the beans are wrinkled and tender and the nuts are fragrant and browned
11. Serve immediately

title: easy cheese and sour cream enchiladas
steps:
1. Heat vegetable oil in skillet over medium heat
2. Dip corn tortillas in hot oil for 2-3 seconds to soften them
3. Drain on paper towels until cool
4. Mix the sour cream , soup and green chilies
5. Spread about 1 cup of the sour cream mixture over the bottom of a 9" x 13" x 2" baking pan
6. Place some grated cheese& chopped onion about 1 inch from the edge of a softened tortilla
7. You'll need to experiment to get exactly the right amount of filling
8. Too much filling and the tortilla won't roll
9. Too little filling and you'll mostly taste corn tortilla
10. It will probably take about 2 tablespoons of filling
11. Fold the edge over the filling and roll it tightly
12. Place the filled tortilla in the pan , seam side down
13. Continue rolling the tortillas and place them side by side in the pan
14. Pour the remaining sauce over the top
15. Top with the remaining onion and cheese
16. Bake in a 350 degree oven for 30-40 minutes until bubbly

title: fiesta grilled chicken
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients for texas bean salsa
2. Cover , and refrigerate 6 hours or overnight
3. About 45 minutes before serving , place chicken breasts in baking dish
4. Squeeze lime juice over chicken
5. Drizzle with tequilla or apple juice
6. Sprinkle with paprika , salt and black pepper
7. Cover and marinate 10-60 minutes
8. Remove from marinade and grill or broil 10-12 minutes , until cooked , turning once
9. Lay a lettuce leaf on each plate
10. Place a chicken breast on top of the lettuce leaf , and top each chicken breast with 1 / 6 of the texas bean salsa
11. Garnish with additional cilantro leaves and / or lime wedges if desired

title: better than potato salad
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine rice , radishes , eggs , cucumber , celery and onion
2. Combine mayonnaise , mustard and salt
3. Mix well
4. Pour over rice mixture and toss
5. Cover and refrigerate at least one hour

title: pinata tostadas
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Stir together beans and chiles
3. Spread 2 to 3 tablespoons bean mixture onto each tostada shell and place on large ungreased cookie sheet
4. Bake 5 to 7 minutes or until hot
5. Brown beef in 10-inch skillet over medium-high heat , stirring frequently
6. Drain
7. Stir in 1 1 / 2 cups of the salsa
8. Reduce heat to medium
9. Cook 2 to 3 minutes or until hot
10. Serve tostada shells topped with hot beef mixture , shredded lettuce , cheese , tomatoes and remaining salsa

title: chicken and ham lasagna
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Place broth and 1 / 4 tspn pepper in a large skillet over medium high heat , and bring to boil
3. Add chicken , cover reduce heat , and simmer for 10 minutes or until chicken is done
4. Remove chicken from pan with a slotted spoon , set aside
5. Combine milk , flour , and remaining 1 / 4 tspn pepper in a bowl
6. Stir well with a whisk until smooth
7. Add milk mixture to chicken broth in pan
8. Bring mixture to a boil over medium-high heat , stirring constantly
9. Cook one minute , or until mixture thickens , stirring constantly
10. Add 1 cup cheese and parsley , stirring until cheese melts
11. Spread 1 cup sauce over bottom of a 13x9 inch baking dish coated with cooking spray
12. Arrange 3 lasagna noodles over the sauce
13. Spoon 3 / 4 cup sauce evenly over noodle tops
14. Top evenly with 1 / 3 ham and 1 / 3 chicken
15. Repeat layers twice , ending with noodles
16. Top with remaining sauce
17. Sprinkle evenly with with remaining 1 / 2 cup cheese
18. Cover with foil very lightly coated with cooking spray , bake at 350 for 30 minutes
19. Remove and discard foil , bake 10 minutes or until the cheese lightly browns
20. Sprinkle with parsley if desired

title: red curry beef stew
steps:
1. Heat oil in large stew pot
2. Add red curry paste
3. Saut for 1 minute
4. Add beef and brown on all sides
5. Add onions and carrots and saut until onions are soft
6. Add potatoes , coconut milk , fish sauce , canned corn , and brown sugar
7. Cover and simmer for approximately 1 to 2 hours or until meat is tender
8. Garnish with peanuts and cilantro

title: savory chinese beef  crock pot
steps:
1. Thinly slice the sirloin
2. Wash all the fresh vegetables
3. Finely chop the onions
4. Place the sirloin in the slow cooker , 3-6 quarts size pot
5. Pour broth , soy sauce , ginger and onion over the beef
6. Cover and cook on low , 6-7 hours
7. Uncover and turn to high
8. Mix cornstarch and water in a small measuring cup
9. Stir this mixture with the hot sauce into the cooker
10. Leaving lid slightly ajar , cook on high for 15 minutes until thickened , stirring occasionally
11. During last 5 minutes of thickening add sprouts , pea pods , water chestnuts and shoots
12. Cook 5-10 minutes until hot
13. Serve in individual bowls over chinese noodles

title: chocolate yogurt panna cotta
steps:
1. Add gelatin to 1 / 4 cup milk in a small bowl and let soften
2. Heat 1 cup milk to just below the boiling point
3. Stir in vanilla and chocolate syrup
4. Taste and add sugar if desired
5. Whisk in gelatin and milk mixture until gelatin dissolves
6. Remove from heat and stir in yogurt until smooth
7. Refrigerate 3-4 hours before serving

title: smashed potatoes with chorizo
steps:
1. Cook potatoes and the garlic in boiling , salted water until soft
2. Drain and reserve
3. In a non-stick , oven-safe pan , render chorizo until slightly brown
4. Preheat grill
5. Briefly mash the potatoes , fold in with the chorizo
6. Add butter , chives , salt and pepper , mix well
7. Sprinkle potatoes with cheese and place under the grill
8. Grill until the cheese is browned

title: gluten free pizza dough
steps:
1. Mix dry ingredients together and add oil and water , mixing well
2. Pat onto lightly oiled pizza pan with hands
3. Bake in pre-heated 425 oven for 20 minutes
4. Add your choice of delicious toppings
5. Bake another 15 minutes , or until cheese and crust start to get golden brown
6. Enjoy !

title: curry dip for raw veggies
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together and chill
2. Serve with fresh raw veggies

title: camper s omelets
steps:
1. Place a large pot of water on the stove and cover until boiling
2. Crack two eggs into each bag
3. Add butter and milk to each bag
4. Add desired optional items
5. Seal bag
6. Kneed the bag to mix ingredients
7. Boil each bag for 7-10 minutes in an uncovered pot
8. Unzip the bag and serve

title: spicy chinese potato salad
steps:
1. Combine first seven ingredients in blender
2. Cook potatoes until fork-tender over medium heat
3. Don't overcook , please , or they will fall apart
4. Drain well
5. Combine with peppers , onion and parsley in large bowl
6. Add blended dressing and toss gently
7. Add salt to taste
8. Cover and chill

title: seasoned hard pretzels
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325f break pretzels into bite size peices
2. Mix the garlic powder and dry dressing mix
3. Add oil and stir
4. Pour mixture over pretzels
5. Toss gently to coat then let stand 10 minutes
6. Stir again and let stand again for another 10 minutes
7. Spread on cookie sheet in a single layer and bake for 7 minutes
8. Turn pretzels and bake another 7 minutes
9. Serve with warm mustard

title: roast beef slather
steps:
1. This is enough for about a 3 lb roast and acts quite well as a tenderizer , and leaves a wonderful taste
2. Increase ingredients for a larger roast
3. Combine all ingredients
4. Whisk together till well blended
5. Smother entire roast with mixture , rub well into roast
6. Let stand 15 to 30 minutes

title: venison   or ground beef    potato casserole
steps:
1. Combine first 7 ingredients
2. Pour into crock pot or baking dish
3. Combine potato flakes , sour cream and water
4. Spread over venison mixture
5. Cover
6. Cook on low for 8 hours
7. Sprinkle with cheese 30 minutes before serving

title: avocado   roasted garlic dip
steps:
1. Mash avocados and roasted garlic
2. Fold in remaining ingredients , be sure to blend well
3. Let chill for a minimum of 1 hour
4. If color turns brownish upon serving , sprinkle with a bit of lemon or lime juice

title: pistachio eclair dessert
steps:
1. In a large bowl , whisk milk and pudding mixes for 2 minutes
2. Let stand for 2 minutes or until soft-set
3. Fold in whipped topping
4. In a 13x9x2 inch dish , layer a third of the graham crackers and half of the pudding mixture
5. Repeat layers
6. Top with remaining graham crackers
7. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour
8. Spoon frosting into a microwave-safe bowl
9. Cover and microwave on high for 15-20 seconds or until softened
10. Stirring once
11. Spread over graham crackers
12. Chill for at least 20 minutes or until frosting is set

title: buffalo chicken deviled eggs  aka buffalo horns
steps:
1. Cover chicken with enough buffalo sauce
2. Let sit at least 5 minutes
3. Combine yolk and butter
4. Stir in celery and tabasco
5. Add chicken and 5 teaspoons of buffalo sauce
6. Place mixture in zip lock bag with the corner cut off
7. Fill egg whites with mixture and garnish with celery
8. Enjoy right away or let it sit at room temperature for 15-20 minutes for flavors to develop

title: fleischsalat auf bremen  meat salad
steps:
1. Combine meats , cheese , and pickles in a large bowl
2. Add mayonnaise , vinegar , salt and pepper
3. Mix to combine
4. Deal the cards

title: cajun orange chops
steps:
1. Combine ingredients for marinade and pour over pork chops in shallow glass dish
2. Marinate 10 or 15 minutes while heating grill or broiler
3. Place marinated pork chops on grill or under broiler for 7 to 10 minutes per side , brushing marinade on chops as they are turned
4. Be careful not to overcook

title: indian spiced omelet
steps:
1. Heat the oil in frying pan and fry the onion , chilli , ginger , garlic until translucent
2. Add turmeric and saute for a minute more
3. Add the other spices and cook for a few minutes more stirring now and then
4. Take them off the flame
5. Beat the eggs lightly and add salt to taste
6. Now add the cooked mix to the eggs
7. Add the green leaves chopped ,
8. Now add it back to the pan which will have some grease in it
9. Cook for a few minutes and then flip over after sprinkling some lemon drops on the first side
10. You can also place this under a grill to do the second side
11. This goes very well with chapatis / rotis too
12. N
13. B
14. You can add mushrooms / carrots / spinach / tomatoes to the mix while it is cooking

title: palo verde s green chile cornbread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degree f
2. Cream butter and sugar
3. Add eggs slowly , one at a time
4. Add chiles , corn and cheese , mixing well to incorporate
5. Sift together dry ingredients , then add and mix until smooth
6. Pour into well-buttered , square 9 inch pan and bake about 1 hour

title: m m and chocolate chews
steps:
1. Cream ingredients in part 1 well
2. Add part 1 mixture to part 2 mixture
3. Spread 1 / 2 mixture in pan
4. Top with m&m's and then remaining dough
5. Bake at 375~ for 25-30 minutes

title: creamy avocado gazpacho
steps:
1. Combine all of the ingredients in a blender in the order listed
2. Start blender on low speed for a few seconds , then switch to high
3. Blend until creamy and smooth , about 1 1 / 2 minutes
4. Pour into 2 soup bowls
5. Dice reserved avocado and gently drop them into the center of the bowl
6. Add a mint leaf and sprinkle diced avocado with paprika if desired
7. Enjoy !

title: easy shrimp crawfish etouffee
steps:
1. Melt margarine on low
2. Add celery and onions
3. Cook until tender
4. Stir occasionally
5. In a separate bowl , combine water , ketchup , salt , corn starch , and red pepper
6. Stir until dissolved
7. Add this mixture to celery and onions
8. Stir , cover , and cook on low for at least 20 minutes
9. Add shrimp and cook , covered for 15 minutes
10. Serve over rice

title: croatian lamb beef stew with green peas
steps:
1. Cut meat into 2-3 cm large pieces
2. Finely mince onion and put it into a pot with lard
3. Saut onion until becomes soft and transparent
4. Add meat and saut until meat starts to release liquid
5. Now add paprika , thyme , salt and pepper and stir
6. Add wine and saut until alcohol evaporates
7. Add some water and cook for about 30 minutes
8. In the meantime peel potato and cut it into small cubes
9. Remove green peas from shuck
10. Add green peas and potato into stew and cook until all ingredients become soft and liquid is reduced a bit
11. Seve hot

title: strawberry almond cream roll recipe
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Line pan with aluminum foil and generously grease foil with margarine
3. Beat eggs in bowl at high speed for at least 5 minutes until thick and the color of lemons
4. Gradually add sugar , then reduce to low speed and add water and almond extract
5. Combine remaining dry ingredients and add to mixture slowly
6. Beat at low speed until batter is smooth
7. Pour into greased , foil-lined pan
8. Bake 12 to 15 minutes until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
9. Remove immediately from pan and carefully invert onto towel that has been dusted abundantly with confectioners sugar
10. Carefully remove foil and trim any hard edges
11. Lightly dust cake bottom with additional powdered sugar
12. While still hot , carefully roll cake and towel to form a 10 1 / 2" roll and cool 30-40 minutes on wire rack
13. While cake is cooling , slice strawberries and prepare almond whipped cream by beating remaining filling ingredients at medium speed until stiff
14. Unroll cake , remove towel , and spread cake with half of whipped cream
15. Arrange sliced strawberries on top and re-roll
16. Dust with powdered sugar , cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate about an hour before serving
17. Slice and top with additional whipped cream

title: flounder stefano
steps:
1. In a large skillet , saute garlic in oil until lightly browned
2. Add onions and saute until soft
3. Add the wine and cook over medium-high heat until reduced by half
4. Add the tomatoes , oregano , salt and pepper and cook for 5 minutes , stirring occasionally
5. Arrange the fish in the pan in a single layer , spooning some of the tomato mixture over the top of each piece of fish and reduce heat to medium
6. Cover and cook for 10 minutes or until fish is cooked through and flakes easily
7. Season to taste with salt and pepper

title: best ever broccoli salad
steps:
1. Wash and cut the broccoli into bite sized pieces
2. Use only the flowerets , discarding the large stem pieces
3. Cut the whole pound of bacon into small pieces and fry the bacon pieces until crisp
4. Drain bacon on paper towels
5. Whisk the mayonnaise and sugar together
6. After well blended , whisk in vinegar one tablespoon at a time
