7. Refrigerate this dressing until time to serve the salad
8. When taking this to a pot luck , i put each ingredient into a separate plastic bag and toss everything together in a large salad bowl just before serving

title: jack daniel s tipsy cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350-375 degrees , depending on how your oven bakes
2. Melt chocolate and set aside to cool down a bit
3. Dissolve the coffee granules in the boiling water
4. When dissolved , stir in the cold water
5. Add the whiskey and set aside
6. In a large electric mixer , cream the butter , vanilla , and sugar
7. Add the eggs , one at a time , beating well after each addition
8. Add the chocolate
9. With the mixer on low , add the flour alternating with the coffee / whiskey mixture
10. The batter will be thin & runny
11. Do not add more flour
12. Pour into two prepared loaf pans
13. Bake until a toothpick comes out clean , about an hour to an hour and a half
14. Cool
15. Sprinkle with powdered sugar when serving

title: shoestring  fries
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 475f
2. Spray a non-stick baking sheet with cooking spray , set aside
3. Scrub potatoes , pat dry
4. Cut into lengthwise strips about 3 / 8in thick
5. Place in a large bowl and add oil , salt and pepper , toss to coat
6. Place potato strips in a single layer on the prepared baking sheet
7. Bake until undersides are browned , about 10 minutes
8. Using a spatula , turn potatoes and bake until golden brown , about 10 mins more

title: chicken curry pie with sweet potato
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180c cook sweet potato in a saucepan of boiling water for 12 minutes or until tender
2. Drain and return to pan
3. Mash until smooth
4. Heat oil in a frying pan on medium-high heat
5. Saut onion , garlic , ginger and carrot , stirring occasionally , for 3-4 minutes or until soft
6. Add chicken and stir for 3-4 minutes or until browned
7. Add curry paste and stir for 1 minute
8. Add flour and stir for 1 minute
9. Add tomato and water and stir
10. Bring to boil
11. Cook for 2-3 minutes or until mixture thickens slightly
12. Remove from heat
13. Add peas , coriander , lime juice and sugar , season to taste with salt and pepper
14. Divide curry among four 250ml capacity ovenproof dishes
15. Place on a baking tray
16. Top with sweet potato
17. Bake for 15 minutes or until golden
18. Serve with steamed green vegetables

title: zucchini sticks with honey mustard mayo
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
2. Coat a large baking sheet with cooking spray
3. Combine flour , salt , pepper in a shallow dish
4. Place egg whites and bread crumbs in separate shallow dishes
5. Add zucchini to flour mixture , turn to coat
6. Transfer to egg white mixture
7. Turn to coat
8. And finally , transfer zucchini to bread crumbs and turn to coat
9. Place coated zucchini on prepared baking sheet and coat with cooking spray
10. Bake 40 minutes , until golden brown
11. Whisk together mayonnaise , honey and mustard
12. Serve zucchini sticks with honey-mustard mayo on the side
13. Yields 16 strips
14. 8 servings
15. 2 points per serving

title: neely s bbq sauce
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , combine all ingredients
2. Bring mixture to a boil , reduce heat to simmer
3. Cooked uncovered , stirring frequently , for 2 hours

title: sausage reuben
steps:
1. Cut sausage link down the middle and grill or pan fry until crisp along the edges
2. Spread mustard on one side of both slices of bread
3. Heat sauerkraut in sauce pan , then remove and squeeze off excess juices
4. Assemble sandwich by placing one slice of cheese on first slice of bread , place link on next , then pile on warmed sauerkraut , finally top with second slice of cheese and second slice of bread
5. Wrap in aluminum foil and place in preheated oven
6. Bake for 15 minutes at 350 degrees until cheese is melted
7. Remove , slice diagonally and serve with dill pickle and chips
8. If you're going to make several sandwiches for a group , you can either wrap each individually or place them in a shallow baking pan and cover the pan with foil

title: mint chocolate chip cheesecake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325f
2. Combine crumbs and melted butter , press onto bottom and 2 inches up side of springform pan
3. Sprinkle tablespoon of sugar over crust
4. Bake for 10 mins , remove from oven and raise temp to 450f
5. In a mixing bowl combine softened cream cheese , and sugar until well combined
6. Add creme de menthe , mix until well combined
7. Add eggs one at a time beating in at a very slow speed until well combined
8. Finally stir in 2 cups miniature chocolate pieces and pour filling into crust
9. Bake for 10 mins at 450f , then reduce heat to 250f and bake for 25-30 mins more , or until center appears nearly set when shaken
10. Loosen cake from rim of pan and then allow to cool before removing rim of pan
11. Chill the cheesecake
12. When ready to serve place 1 cup miniature chocolate pieces in zip lock bag
13. Put bag in microwave for 25-30 seconds , take it out of microwave and stir it around if not completely melted continue to put in microwave for 10-15 second spurts until melted
14. Put a tiny hole in corner of bag
15. Drizzle chocolate over cheesecake pieces and serve with delight to your guests !

title: rachelkitty s tuscan chicken
steps:
1. Heat large nonstick skillet sprayed with cooking spray on medium-high heat
2. Add chicken
3. Cover
4. Cook 5 to 7 minute on each side or until done
5. Remove chicken from skillet
6. Cover to keep warm
7. Add cream cheese , water , pesto and tomatoes and asparagus to skillet
8. Cook , uncovered , on medium heat 2 minute or until heated through , stirring occasionally
9. Return chicken to skillet
10. Cook and stir 1 minute or until chicken is coated and heated through
11. Sprinkle with shredded cheese
12. Variations: instead of cooking spray , drizzle with olive oil
13. Add fresh garlic and a finely cut shallot to cook with the chicken
14. Add spinach , red peppers , squash , zucchini or mushrooms
15. Sprinkle with freshly chopped basil when ready to serve

title: spicy french dressing
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients except oil in blender
2. Blend until smooth
3. With blender running , add oil in a slow steady stream
4. Continue blending until mixture is thick
5. Chill several hours before serving

title: cucumber and onion salad with yogurt cumin vinaigrette
steps:
1. In a large bowl toss together the cucumbers , onion , and salt
2. Add cold water to cover the mixture by 1 inch and refrigerate for 30 minutes
3. Drain the vegetables , pressing out as much water as possible , and return them to the bowl
4. Stir in the remaining ingredients and refrigerate salad until ready to serve

title: angel hair pasta with shrimp and snow peas
steps:
1. In a saucepan over medium heat , melt butter , stir in flour and cook for a few minutes until golden
2. Add milk and cream , bring to a gentle simmer and continue to stir until thickened
3. Add pesto , parsley , garlic , parmesan , salt , pepper , worcestershire and tabasco , and stir until blended
4. Reduce heat and keep warm , stirring occasionally
5. Cook pasta quickly in a large pot of boiling water
6. At the same time , poach the pepper and snowpeas in another pot of boiling water
7. Drain the pasta , mix it with the sauce and portion it into heated individual serving bowls
8. Garnish each portion with shrimp and vegetables , and serve immediately

title: curried kielbasa and black beans
steps:
1. Heat olive oil in skillet over medium heat
2. Add onion and curry powder and cook about 3-5 minutes , stirring often , until onion is tender
3. Stir in sausage and broth
4. Simmer 3-5 minutes
5. Stir in beans and cook until everything is heated through
6. Remove from heat and stir in vinegar
7. Serve over hot rice

title: chipotle turkey taco salad
steps:
1. Shred the cabbage in a food processor with the shredding blade
2. Place the cabbage with the chopped green onions into a large bowl
3. Rinse out the cabbage from the food processor and change to the regular chopping blade
4. Put the 2 chipotle peppers in and process until they form a smooth paste
5. Add to that the mayonnaise , honey , lime juice , and salt
6. Pour the chipotle dressing into the cabbage mix and toss to coat
7. Set aside in the fridge until ready to assemble salad
8. Heat the canola oil in a large texas skillet
9. Add the yellow onions , turkey meat , and zucchini
10. Sprinkle the mix with the garlic powder , salt , and pepper
11. Cook on medium heat , stirring often , until the turkey is no longer pink and the onions and zucchini have cooked down and gotten soft
12. Remove the turkey from heat and keep warm to assemble the salad
13. Assemble the salad by placing some of the frito chips around the edges of a plate and put some turkey mix in the middle of the chips , then some of the chipotle cabbage slaw , cheese , tomatoes , and avocado
14. Garnish with some optional cilantro if desired

title: frozen cookies  n cream milkshake
steps:
1. In blender , process ice cream , ice cubes , milk and vanilla extract until thick and smooth
2. Stir in oreos and sprinkles
3. Pour into 4 milkshake glasses
4. If desired , garnish with whipped cream and additional sprinkles

title: garbanzo bean salad
steps:
1. Drain garbanzo beans and put into a bowl
2. Add all other ingredients
3. Mix well and refridgerate for 2 hours

title: aloha   bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. In a large bowl , combine flour , salt , baking soda , sugar , and cinnamon
3. In another bowl , combine remaining ingredients together , add to flour mixture , stirring just until dry ingredients are moistened
4. Spoon batter into 2 greased and floured 8-1 / 2 x 4-1 / 2 x 3-inch loaf pans
5. Bake for 1 hour and 10 minutes
6. Remove from pans and let cool on wire racks

title: brandied peaches
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Drain peaches , reserving 3 / 4 cup syrup
3. Crumble mincemeat in a saucepan and add syrup
4. Boil , stirring for 3-4 minutes or until thickened
5. Add brandy and boil 1 minute longer
6. Place peach halves in baking dish
7. Spoon mince-meat mixture over peaches
8. Bake 15 minutes
9. After removing from oven sprinkle with pecans if desired

title: quesadillas  the pampered chef
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425
2. Combine olives , cheese , salsa , cilantro , green onions , and cooked chicken , mix well
3. Place 4 tortillas on a baking sheet divide the cheese mixture evenly among tortillas and spread
4. Top each tortilla with second tortilla pressing down firmly , spray tops with cooking spray
5. Bake 8-10 minutes or until tops are lightly browned
6. Remove from oven and cool for 5 minutes
7. Cut each quesadilla into 6 wedges
8. Serve with additional salsa or sour cream if desired

title: ham and cheese omelet  sandwich press style
steps:
1. Place a small amount of margarine in each of the sandwich maker wells
2. Preheat about 5 minutes
3. Pour half of the eggs evenly into the hot , buttered wells of the machine , top with the ham and cheese , pour remaining eggs on top
4. Close machine , cook for about 2 minutes or until done
5. Top with more cheese if desired

title: red pepper and feta salad
steps:
1. To make dressing: place garlic , ginger , and oils into a small pan over medium heat
2. Cook just until the garlic turns white
3. Do not allow garlic to brown
4. If garlic browns , toss out and start over
5. Transfer to a bowl and allow to cool to room temperature
6. The dressing may be made several hours in advance
7. Roast the pepper quarters under a broiler until skin blackens and blisters
8. Wrap in damp paper towels and place in a small paper bag , folding top down to close
9. Allow to sit until cooled enough to handle , 15-20 minutes
10. Peel , trim , and cut each quarter into halves
11. Slice the feta into 8 slices
12. On each of 4 salad plates , place one strip of pepper
13. Add a slice of feta , then top with 2 basil leaves
14. Repeat layers , fanning or arranging the layers so that each layer is visible
15. Cover loosely with damp paper towels and refrigerate until ready to serve
16. To serve , bring salads to room temperature
17. Drizzle the dressing over the salads and grind pepper over the top to taste
18. Garnish with a sprig of basil leaves and serve with lime wedges to squeeze over the salad

title: swiss nut cheese ball
steps:
1. Place cheddar , swiss , and cream cheese , sour cream , worcestershire sauce , paprika , black pepper , and garlic salt in a medium bowl
2. Place in a food processor and pulse until well blended
3. In bowl , place nuts and chives , if using
4. Stir to mix
5. Shape mixture into a ball , roll in the chopped nuts and chives
6. Wrap in waxed paper or plastic wrap and refrigerate until serving time
7. Serve with raw vegetables or crackers

title: roasted minestrone soup
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450
2. Mix onion , carrots , celery , zucchini , garlic , oil , salt and pepper in a large rimmed baking sheet
3. Place on middle rack and roast for 30 minutes , stirring once or twice
4. While vegetables are roasting , bring a pot of water to boil and cook pasta for 9-11 minutes , or until almost done
5. Drain and set aside
6. Remove vegetables from the oven and stir in beans and tomatoes
7. In a small bow , mix tomato paste and wine , then pour mixture over vegetables and mix to coat all the vegetables
8. Roast another 8 minutes
9. Remove from the oven and transfer vegetables to a large soup pot
10. Add 1 cup broth and scrape up all the bits from bottom of pan then add then add this mixture and remaining broth to pot of vegetables
11. Simmer soup over moderately high heat for 15 minutes
12. Stir in reserved pasta
13. Cook an additional 2-3 minutes until pasta is heated through
14. Add basil and taste for seasoning
15. Serve hot , with cheese on the the side

title: warm brie   berry dip
steps:
1. Slice the top off a round loaf of sourdough bread
2. Save the top , but hollow out the inside of the loaf
3. Discard insides or use for breadcrumbs later
4. Combine brie , sugar , nuts and berries
5. Place into the hollowed-out loaf and cover with bread top for a lid
6. Wrap in foil and bake for 40 minutes at 350 degrees
7. Serve warm with a tray of sliced baguettes
8. Bread lid can be cut into pieces and also used for dipping

title: spanish round steak
steps:
1. Place half of onion , green pepper and celery in slow cooker
2. Cut steak into serving size pieces
3. Place steak in slow cooker
4. Add remaining onion , green pepper and celery over steak pieces
5. Combine remaining ingredients and pour over meat
6. Cover and cook on low 8 hours
7. Serve over cooked rice or noodles , if desired

title: steamed chinese dumplings   dipping sauce
steps:
1. Divide the flour into two separate bowls
2. In first bowl , add 1 / 4 cup of cold water and mix with a spoon until a dough forms
3. In second bowl , add 6 oz of boiling water and mix with a spoon until a dough forms
4. Place 1 tbs
5. Of additional flour on a work surface
6. Remove the dough from the bowls and knead them together on the floured work surface for 10 minutes
7. Form the dough into a ball and then cover with a dry cloth and allow it to rest for 1 hour
8. Divide the dough into 24 evenly sized pieces by cutting the dough ball into 1 / 8's
9. Roll the pieces into a log and cut it into three , then roll the dough into little balls using additional flour if necessary flatten the dough in the palm of your hand-- into 3 1 / 2 inch circles
10. In a medium sized bowl , combine the ground pork or ground turkey , minced scallion , cabbage , grated ginger , dry sherry , soy sauce , sesame oil and salt thoroughly
11. Using the dough circles , place 1 tbs
12. Of meat filling in the middle
13. Fold the dough circle in half over the filling to make a half moon shape
14. Press the edges together to seal the dumpling
15. Turn the dumpling so the straight edge is facing you
16. Fold the two corners located at 9 and 3 o'clock to the center at 12 o'clock and press the dough to seal
17. Cook the dumplings in two batches in boiling water for 6 minutes
18. Remove from the water with a slotted spoon
19. Serve with dipping sauce
20. Combine the soy sauce , sesame oil , minced scallions and minced garlic together and mix thoroughly
21. Place the dipping sauce into a serving dish
22. Drizzle the dipping sauce over the hot steamed dumplings before serving
23. Enjoy !

title: toddler mana milkshake
steps: 1. Put all ingredients in the blender and liquify until all banana chunks are gone

title: dee s  dinner salad
steps: 1. Mix together

title: ann lander s best lemon meringue pie  with never fail meringue
steps:
1. In a double boiler , or a heavy bottomed saucepan , mix sugar and cornstarch together
2. Add in the 2 cups cold water
3. In a small cup / bowl , combine the egg yolks with lemon juice , and the yellow food colouring
4. Whisk until well mixed
5. Add to the sugar cornstarch mixture
6. Whisk until mixed
7. Cook and mix / whisk until mixture thickens , if you are making in a saucepan , be careful not to scorch the bottom of the pan , a double-boiler is definitely recommended for this
8. Remove from heat
9. Add / mix in the lemon extract , butter and vinegar
10. Stir thoroughly
11. Pour the lemon mixture into cooled pie shell
12. Set aside to make meringue
13. To make meringue:
14. Blend / whisk the cornstarch and cold water in a small saucepan
15. Add in boiling water , and cook , stirring until clear and thickened
16. Let mixture stand until completely cold
17. With an electric mixer at high speed , beat the egg whites until foamy
18. Gradually add in sugar , and beat until stiff but not dry
19. Turn mixer to low speed
20. Add in pinch salt and vanilla
21. Gradually beat in the cold cornstarch mixture
22. Turn mixer again to high
23. Beat well
24. Spread / pile meringue over cooled pie filling , making certain to seal the meringue to the baked crust
25. Set oven to 350f , and bake for 10 minutes , or until the meringue is lightly browned

title: countess mushrooms
steps:
1. Saute mushrooms in butter until tender
2. Sprinkle mushrooms with flour
3. Add broth and cook one minute more
4. Add rest of ingredients
5. Cook 3 minutes more , stirring

title: sauteed zucchini with oregano and feta   ww 1 point
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat
2. Add zucchini and oregano
3. Saut until zucchini is golden brown , about 4 to 6 minutes
4. Remove skillet from heat and add parsley
5. Toss to combine
6. Season to taste with salt and pepper
7. Sprinkle feta cheese over top just before serving
8. Yields about 1 / 2 cup per serving

title: weight watcher s pasta e fagioli
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in a medium-sized saucepan
2. Simmer for 10 minutes , if using cooked pasta , or until dry pasta is fully cooked
3. Add enough water during cooking to just cover the pasta

title: mean chef s triple lemon layer cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Position rack in middle of oven
3. Crease and flour two 8x2-inch round cake pans
4. Sift flour , baking powder and salt together
5. Pulse 1 / 4 cup of the sugar with the zest in a food processor until well combined
6. Beat the butter and lemon sugar in a mixer until light and fluffy-1 to 2 minutes
7. Add remaining 1 1 / 2 cups sugar and beat until smooth
8. Beat in 1 / 4 of the milk until just blended
9. On low speed , add flour mixture alternating with remaining milk in 3 batches , scraping as needed
10. Beat until just blended
11. In a clean bowl , whip egg whites on medium speed until foamy , add cream of tartar , increase speed to high , beat until whites just hold stiff peaks
12. Add 1 / 4 of the whites to batter and fold in with a whisk or spatula
13. Fold in remaining white 1 / 4 at a time
14. Divide batter evenly between cake pans and smooth tops
15. Bake until tester in center comes out clean- about 35-40 minutes
16. Let cool for 10 minutes , remove from pans and cool completely on rack
17. Cut each cake in half horizontally using a long serrated knife
18. Place one layer on a serving plate , cut side up
19. Spread with 1 / 3 cup of chilled lemon curd
20. Lay another cake layer on top , spread with lemon curd and repeat with 3rd layer
21. Top with fourth cake layer
22. Up to a few hours before serving , spread a thin layer of frosting on cake , filling gaps as you go
23. Chill to firm crumb coat for about 30 minutes
24. Spread remaining frosting decoratively over sides and top of cake
25. Scatter top with lemon zest as garnish
26. To make frosting: in an electric mixer , beat butter and lemon zest until light and fluffy
27. Add confectioners sugar in batches and beat until light and fluffy
28. Add lemon juice and beat for 1 minute
29. Can be made a couple of hours ahead and kept covered at cool room temperature

title: creamy cauliflower leek soup
steps:
1. Heat olive oil in a stock pan
2. Add leeks and cauliflower stems , simmer until slightly softened
3. Add chicken stock
4. Once leeks and cauli stems are softened somewhat , add florets and continue to cook until all are softened
5. Using immersion blender , puree all ingredients to desired consistency
6. Add freshly grated nutmeg
7. Heat through
8. Serve with salt and pepper

title: tofu au gingembre
steps:
1. Cut the tofu in slices and place them side by side in a shallow oven-proof dish
2. In a small bowl combine ginger , oil and tamari
3. Pour over the tofu
4. Let marinate overnight [for beginning tofu makers] or 3 hours for those who adore tofu straight
5. The longer the tofu soaks , the more it will taste like what it is soaking in
6. Tofu takes time to learn to like for most western tastes
7. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
8. Bake for 25 - 30 minutes

title: saskatoon berry jam
steps:
1. Prepare canner , jars , lids
2. In a large stainless steel saucepan combine the crushed saskatoons and lemon juice
3. Whisk in pectin until dissolved
4. Bring to a boil over high heat , stirring constantly
5. Add sugar all at once , return to a full , rolling boil while stirring constantly
6. Boil hard for 1 minute
7. Immediately stir in grand marnier
8. Remove from heat
9. Skim off foam if needed
10. Ladle hot jam into hot jars leaving 1 / 4 inch head space
11. Remove air bubbles , wipe rims , adjust caps and screw rings to finger
12. Process for 10 minutes in a boiling water bath
13. Remove canner lid and let stand 5 additional minutes
14. Remove jars , cool and store

title: rich fruit biscuits
steps:
1. Mix flour , cream of tartar , baking soda and salt together in a large bowl
2. Cut in butter with pastry cutter or 2 knives until mixture resembles bread crumbs
3. Stir in raisins and sunflower seeds
4. Combine eggs and ginger
5. Add beaten eggs to the flour mixture , mixing well to form a soft dough , add a little milk if dough is too stiff
6. Lightly flour a work surface
7. Turn out dough and kneed until smooth
8. Roll dough out to approx 1 / 2in
9. Cut dough into 2in rounds
10. Place biscuits onto a greased cookie sheet and brush each one with an egg glaze
11. Bake at 400f for 10-15 minutes or until golden brown and well risen

title: ham with pineapple sauce
steps:
1. Place ham in a rack in a shallow pan
2. If desired you can score top of ham
3. Insert meat thermometer
4. Bake in a 325 oven for 1
5. 25-2 1 / 2 hours or till thermometer reads 140 degrees
6. Meanwhile in sauce pan cook onion in margarine till tender but not brown
7. Stir in catsup , preserve , and dry mustard
8. Heat through
9. Brush some sauce onto ham before serving
10. Save remaining sauce for guests

title: vegetable stock
steps:
1. In a large pot , combine all ingredients
2. Bring to a boil
3. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 25 minutes
4. Strain stock and reserve for soups and sauces

title: from scratch brownies  death by chocolate
steps:
1. Melt the two chocolates and the butter together in a double boiler
2. Let the mixture cool to room temperature
3. Mix the eggs , sugar , salt and vanilla together until well blended , but do not whip
4. Whipping to a foam creates more leavening and results in a crumbly brownie
5. If the eggs are not at room temperature , stir the mixture over a hot bath just until the mixture is at a slightly warm room temperature
6. Blend in the chocolate mix
7. Sift the flour and fold in
8. Pour into a 9" x 13" pan
9. Bake at 325 degrees f for 45-50 minutes

title: beer marinated chuck steak for the grill
steps:
1. Slice onion paper-thin
2. Peel garlic clove and put it through the garlic press
3. Combine all marinade ingredients and stir well
4. Pour marinade over steaks
5. Marinade 4-6 hours , turning steaks periodically
6. Do not over-marinade because beer marinades make the steak bitter if soaked too long
7. Preheat your grill
8. You want a medium-high heat -- enough to get some good sizzle
9. There's no beating the flavor you get from a charcoal grill , but a gas grill will do the job
10. I do not recommend trying this on an electric , tabletop grill
11. Grill 7-10 minutes per side or until you reach the desired doneness
12. As you cook , drop a few bits of the onions from the marinade onto the coals or burner-covers to make an aromatic smoke which flavors the meat in a way really sets this recipe apart from other beer marinades
13. The marinade will have tenderized the steak significantly , but if you cook it well-done it will almost certainly be tough anyway so i recommend medium-rare to medium

title: lemon chicken orzo soup
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , bring the chicken stock to a boil
2. Reduce heat to medium-low and add orzo
3. Cook uncovered until tender , about 15 to 20 minutes
4. Five minutes before pasta is done , add chicken
5. Whisk eggs while adding lemon juice
6. Stir in zest
7. Whisking constantly
8. Slowly pour a ladle of the hot stock into the egg mixture to temper
9. Reduce heat to low and while stirring add the egg mixture to the soup
10. Add salt and pepper and garnish with parsley

title: molly s lemon summer picnic cake
steps:
1. Mix all cake ingredients together beating for 4 minutes and bake in a greased 9x13 inch pan for 35-45 minutes at 350 degrees
2. Poke holes in warm cake with a fork and drizzle topping over
3. Cool and serve

title: spinach pinwheel appetizers
steps:
1. In medium mixing bowl , combine cream cheese , sour cream and mayonnaise
2. Beat in dip mix
3. Add green onion , bacon bits and spinach
4. Mix thoroughly
5. Spread mixture onto tortillas , leaving a 1 / 2" space around edge
6. Roll up each tortilla tightly , and wrap each in plastic wrap
7. Chill for several hours or overnight
8. To serve , cut off ends and cut into 1 / 2" slices

title: potatoes for hash browns   how to parboil
steps:
1. Put the potatoes in a large pan
2. Cover with cold water
3. Bring water to a boil over high heat
4. As soon as the water starts to boil , turn the heat off but keep the pan on the burner
5. Let the pan of potatoes stand on the burner for about 5 minutes , depending on the size of the potatoes
6. Larger potatoes may need more standing time
7. Drain all of the water from the pan
8. Allow potatoes to cool enough to handle
9. Store the potatoes in a bowl in refrigerator until ready to use
10. Storing the potatoes in a plastic bag tends to make them "sweat" and softens them , which could cause them to go bad sooner
11. If you do store them in a plastic bag , use them within a day or two to ensure freshness
12. Use the potatoes for hashbrowns or fried potatoes

title: no bake fruitcake by paula deen
steps:
1. Spray 10 mini loaf pans with vegetable oil cooking spray
2. In a 2-quart saucepan , heat the milk and marshmallow together over low heat
3. Stir constantly , because condensed milk scorches easily , until the marshmallows are melted
4. Remove the mixture from the heat
5. Combine the cracker crumbs , pecans , coconut , dates and cherries in a large bowl
6. Add the bourbon to the milk mixture and pour over the crumb mixture
7. Mix well with your hands
8. Scoop the mixture into the prepared pans and press down firmly to mold into shape
9. Refrigerate for 2 days

title: low carb enchiladas
steps:
1. Sprinkle the chicken with salt & pepper along with the onion powder
2. Brown until no longer pink
3. Mix chicken with refried beans , 1 / 2 the enchilada sauce , sour cream and 2 / 3 cup cheese
4. Fill tortillas with the chicken mixture then place into a glass baking dish
5. Top with remaining enchilada sauce and cheese
6. Cook at 375 for 20 minutes

title: creamy orange liqueur
steps:
1. In a saucepan , bring sugar and water to a boil
2. Let cool
3. Whisk vodka , condensed milk , orange juice concentrate and vanilla into sugar-water mixture until creamy and well-combined
4. Pour into attractive bottles , seal , and keep stored in refrigerator
5. Makes approximately 5 cups
6. Keeps well in the fridge for at least 2 weeks

title: cool strawberry soup with pound cake croutons
steps:
1. Combine strawberries , banana , half and half , sour cream , orange juice , sugar and raspberry liqueur in a food processor fitted with a metal blade , or in a blender
2. Process or blend until smooth
3. Pour into a bowl
4. Cover
5. Refrigerate at least 1 hour or until ready to serve
6. Heat broiler
7. Spread pound cake cubes in a single layer on a baking sheet
8. Broil until lightly browned , 1 to 2 minutes
9. Turn cubes over
10. Broil until lightly browned , another 1 to 2 minutes
11. Serve soup in 6 dessert bowls , or parfait glasses
12. Top with pound cake croutons and mint sprigs

title: planet hollywood bubble gum shooter
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a shaker with a handful of ice , and shake well
2. Strain into a 2 oz shot glass and serve

title: candy cane popcorn crunch
steps:
1. Pop popcorn
2. 1 / 2 cup of unpopped popcorn yields approximately 10 cups of popped popcorn
3. Make 24 cups of popcorn
4. This is approximate-- not to worry if you have 22 cups or 28 cups-- it is a forgiving recipe
5. Put candy canes into a food processor
6. Finely crush
7. Melt dipping wafers following the package instructions
8. I used the microwave instructions-- very simple& easy
9. Put popcorn into a large bowl-- you need a really big bowl-- i actually used 2 bowls
10. Add melted dipping wafers to popcorn and stir to coat
11. A gentle hand is a good idea-- add crushed candy canes and gently mix
12. Spread popcorn mixture onto paper lined cookie sheets
13. I used non stick aluminum foil-- it worked well-- i used 2 cookie sheets
14. Place cookie sheets in frig for approximately 30 minutes or until coating hardens-- i had 2 cookie sheets and not enough frig space so i put 1 cookie sheet in the frig and the other cookie sheet in the freezer to harden the coating-- remove from frig / freezer-- break into pieces
15. Store in airtight container in a cool dry place for up to 1 week or in the freezer for up to 6 weeks

title: sugary snack
steps:
1. Cut the bread half into triangles
2. You may cut off the sides if you wish
3. Spread each with a layer of butter or margarine
4. Sprinkle sugar on one side sandwich and serve

title: crock pot tangy chicken and black beans
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients in crock pot , cook on low for 6-8 hours
2. Serve over rice , or use as filling with tortillas

title: choucroute garni a la juive
steps:
1. Wash the sauerkraut in cold water
2. Drain
3. Then wash it a second time , in very hot water
4. Drain again
5. Squeeze the water out of the sauerkraut by forming it into balls and pressing it between your hands
6. In a heavy-bottomed oven-proof pot , melt the goose or duck fat
7. Add the pastrami or goose breast and the sliced onions
8. Saut for a few minutes
9. Do not brown
10. Add the wine , 1 cup of the water , and 1 of the bay leaves
11. Place the remaining bay leaf , the juniper berries , and the caraway seeds in a piece of cheesecloth
12. Peel and smash the garlic cloves and place on top
13. Tie with a string and place in the pan
14. Peel the remaining onion and stick the 4 cloves into the outer layer
15. Place in the heavy pan
16. Add the sauerkraut , pepper , and the potatoes to the pot
17. Add more wine and / or water as needed for the liquid to go half way up the pan
18. Bring to a boil
19. Preheat the oven to 325f cover the pot and transfer to the preheated oven , and cook for an hour
20. Add the corned beef to the sauerkraut , return to the oven and cook for 15 minutes
21. Then add the frankfurters to the sauerkraut
22. Bring to a simmer , but not a boil
23. To serve , put the sauerkraut in the center of a serving plate
24. Slice the corned beef against the grain and arrange it on top
25. Surround the sauerkraut with the frankfurters and the potatoes
26. Accompany this choucroute garni with mustard and horseradish sauce

title: the miracle
steps:
1. Add everything into a shaker
2. Shake and strain into glass
3. Enjoy !

title: cherry vanilla cobbler
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. Mix sugar and cornstarch together in a bowl
3. Sprinkle mixture over cherries in a large bowl and toss to mix well
4. Add the juice and toss to mix well again
5. Spray 2-quart casserole dish and spread fruit mixture evenly in dish
6. Cover dish with aluminum foil and bake for 30-40 minutes or until hot and bubbly
7. Mix flour , oats , sugar , and baking powder in a bowl and mix well
8. Add just enough yogurt to make a moderately thick batter , stirring until dry ingredients are moistened
9. Drop spoonfuls of batter onto the hot cherry fillilng to make around 8 biscuits
10. Bake uncovered for 18-20 more minutes or until biscuits are lightly browned
11. Allow to cool for 10 minutes before serving

title: creamy honey dijon salad dressing
steps:
1. Process all ingredients in a blender until smooth , stopping to scrape down sides
2. Chill at least 8 hours
3. Serve

title: baked ratatouille gratin
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 450 degrees
2. In a 13x9 inch glass baking dish , combine the oil and garlic
3. Bake for 5 minutes or till the garlic is fragrant and hot
4. Stir in the zucchini , yellow squash , onion and eggplant , cover with foil and bake for 20 minutes , stirring occasionally till veggies are crisp tender
5. Uncover and stir in the tomato sauce , tomatoes and juices , oregano and salt and bake for 10 minutes or till mixture is bubbly
6. Sprinkle bread crumbs and cheese on top and bake for 10 minutes longer till lightly browned
7. Sprinkle with parsley and serve

title: amalou  almond honey butter
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Spread almonds onto a baking sheet in a single layer
3. Roast about 10 to 15 minutes , until slightly browned , tossing a couple of times for even browning
4. Let cool to touch
5. In a blender , mix or pulse the almonds with the walnut oil and salt
6. This can take about 10 minutes or so
7. Once smooth , spoon in honey and blend for 30 seconds to mix thoroughly

title: smoky potato and roasted cauliflower soup  5fix
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees
2. Chop cauliflower and place evenly on a sheet pan and roast in oven until tender and slightly charred
3. About 15 to 20 minutes
4. In a large pot , heat chicken broth over medium high heat
5. Chop chiles and add to broth
6. Add mashed potatoes and stir until incorporated
7. Bring to slow boil
8. Add salsa con queso and roasted cauliflower
9. Using a stick blender or standing blender , puree soup until smooth
10. Bring to a boil and reduce to simmer for 10 minutes

title: eggless crepe for egg allergies
steps:
1. Mix milk , water , melted butter , and vanilla extract in a medium bowl
2. In another bowl , mix flour , sugar , and salt
3. Whisk both mixtures together until batter is smooth
4. Cover and refrigerate 2 hours /
5. Warm a medium crepe pan over medium heat
6. Lightly grease with vegetable oil and pour about 2 tablespoons of crepe batter
7. Twirl pan around to spread out the batter thinly
8. Cook until edges are golden , and then flip to cook other side

title: roasted cod with white beans  tomato compote  and truffle oil
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f
2. Heat 1 tablespoon extra-virgin olive oil in a saucepan over medium-high heat , add the shallots and garlic , and saut for 1 minute
3. Add the tomatoes and season with salt and pepper
4. Reduce heat to medium low and cook the tomatoes until all the liquid has evaporated , but the tomatoes are still slightly chunky
5. While the tomatoes are cooking , heat the remaining tablespoon of oil in a large frying pan over high heat
6. Season both sides of the cod with salt and freshly ground black pepper , and sear each side for about 2 minutes , or until nicely browned
7. When the fillets are seared , place them on a baking sheet
8. Put cod in the oven to finish cooking
9. Place 1 / 2 cup of the beans in a food processor with the reserved bean-cooking liquid and pure until smooth to make the sauce
10. Season to taste with salt and pepper
11. To serve , spoon tomato compote in the center of each plate and place a cod fillet on top
12. Spoon bean sauce outside the compote , and sprinkle reserved whole cooked beans around the fish and over the two sauces
13. Drizzle with tiny drops of truffle oil

title: smothered steak with mushroom gravy
steps:
1. For steaks , in shallow bowl , mix flour , salt , and pepper
2. Coat meat with flour mixture , shaking off excess
3. Heat oil in large skillet over medium heat
4. Add meat and cook on both sides until almost cooked through and no red juices appear
5. Remove from heat and set aside
6. For gravy , in large saucepan , bring broth and soup to a boil
7. In small bowl , mix flour and water until flour is completely dissolved
8. Add to gravy , stirring constantly
9. Continue cooking , stirring frequently , until mixture thickens
10. Stir in wine
11. In small skillet , cook mushrooms in butter 3 to 4 minutes
12. Add to gravy with browning sauce and seasonings
13. Heat oven to 350f
14. Place meat in a shallow baking pan large enough to hold a single layer
15. Top with half the gravy
16. Cover with foil
17. Bake 12 minutes
18. Serve with remaining gravy

title: parsley  and chive scones
steps:
1. Combine the flour seasoning parlsey , chives , onion and shallots in a bowl
2. Rub in the butter until the mix resembles fine breadcrumbs , then add sufficient milk to make a soft manageable dough
3. Knead dough on a lightly floured board , to approx 2 1 / 2cm thick and cut into rounds
4. Place rounds on a greased baking sheet , glaze with a little milk and bake at 200c for 12-15 minutes or until cooked

title: asian baked chicken in vinegar sauce
steps:
1. Place chicken breasts in grease 9x13 dish
2. Mix all remaining ingredients& pour over chicken
3. Cover tightly with foil
4. Use toothpick to poke 6 holes in foil
5. Bake at 350f 35-45 minutes

title: french dip sandwiches  for crock pot
steps:
1. Place roast in a slow cooker
2. Add water , soy sauce , and seasonings
3. Cover and cook on high for 5-6 hours or until beef is tender
4. Remove meat from broth
5. Shred with forks and keep warm
6. Strain broth
7. Skim off fat
8. Pour broth into small cups for dipping
9. Serve beef on rolls

title: new orleans double chocolate praline fudge cake
steps:
1. Cake:
2. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
3. Combine butter , cocoa and water in a saucepan
4. Cook , stirring constantly , over low heat until the mixture is smooth and butter has melted
5. Remove from heat and cool
6. Combine the buttermilk , eggs , baking soda and vanilla
7. Beat on medium speed with a mixer until smooth
8. Combine the butter mixture and buttermilk mixture
9. Beat until well blended
10. Combine the sugar , flour and salt in a bowl
11. Mix well
12. Gradually add the flour mixture to the buttermilk mixture
13. Beat until blended
14. The batter should be thin
15. Spray three 8" round cake pans with cooking spray and line them with wax paper
16. Pour the batter evenly into the pans and bake at 350 degrees for 22-24 minutes or until cake tests for doneness
17. Cool in pans on wire racks for 10 minutes
18. Remove from pans and cool completely
19. To assemble the cake:
20. Spread 1 / 2 c ganache between the cake layers
21. Spread the remainder on the sides of the cake and chill for 30 minutes
22. Slowly pour the frosting over the center of the cake
23. Spread it to the edges of the cake , allowing some frosting to run down the sides
24. Chocolate ganache:
25. Microwave the chocolate and cream in a glass bowl for 2-3 minutes , or until the chocolate is melted
26. Whisk until smooth
27. Gradually add the butter , whisking until smooth and melted
28. Cool , whisking often , until spreading consistency , about 15-20 minutes
29. Praline frosting:
30. Combine the butter , brown sugar and whipping cream in a 2 quart saucepan
31. Bring to a boil , stirring often
32. Boil 1 min
33. Remove from heat and whisk in powdered sugar and vanilla
34. Add the pecans and stir gently for 2-5 minutes , or until the frosting begins to cool and thicken slightly
35. Pour immediately over the cake

title: cocoa oatmeal cookies czech style
steps:
1. Beat egg whites till stiff
2. Cream sugar and butter
3. Add egg yolk
4. Add cocoa and oats
5. Fold in egg whites
6. Drop on greased baking sheets by teaspoon
7. Bake 350 for 15 to 20 minutes

title: tuna and artichoke panini
steps:
1. Puree the olives , oil , garlic , and zest in a food processor until smooth and spreadable
2. Blend in the mayonnaise
3. Toss the tuna , artichokes , lemon juice , and pepper in a medium bowl , keeping the tuna in small chunks
4. Hollow out the bottom and top halves of the bread
5. Spread the olive puree over both cut sides of the bread
6. Spoon the tuna and artichoke mixture onto the bottom half of the bread
7. Sprinkle the tomatoes over
8. Cover with the bread top
9. Cut the sandwich crosswise into 6 pieces and serve

title: cooked turkey or chicken leftover tacos
steps:
1. Place turkey or chicken in pot and fill with water just slightly above the turkey
2. Add tomato sauce
3. Add remaining ingredients
4. Simmer on low and stir frequently
5. After the turkey has cooked for about an hour begin breaking up any clumped turkey pieces to get it shredded
6. Once the broth has dissapated and about 1 / 3 is left -- turn off and enjoy !
7. Add to taco shells or in a burrito
8. To add some zing add a litttle cayenne pepper
9. You can also fry the burrito to make it a chimichanga

title: sweet orange bread
steps:
1. Put ingredients in bread machine according to bread machine manufacturer reccomendations
2. Use sweet or basic / white cycle with medium or white crust
3. Remove from loaf pan and cool on wire rack when done
4. Make glaze: mix ingredients until smooth and thin enough to drizzle
5. Drizzle over cooled loaf

title: poulet bonne femme
steps:
1. Melt the butter in a large pot , and , fry the chicken and potatoes till brown all over
2. Remove from pot and set aside
3. Add the shallots and bacon to the pot and fry gently till softened
4. Add the flour and stir well fry for 2 minutes
5. Add the stock and blend into the flour to make a sauce
6. Add the mushrooms , wine , bouquet garni
7. Add salt and pepper to taste
8. Bring to the boil , reduce heat , add the chicken and potatoes , then simmer for 40 mins or till chicken is tender
9. Remove bouquet garnis , serve the chicken with the sauce poured over , and garnish with chopped parsley

title: mexican prawn salad
steps:
1. Line a lrg salad bowl , platter or individual serving dishes w / lettuce leaves
2. Mix the mayo , sour cream & opt old bay seasoning in a sml bowl & set aside
3. In a separate bowl , combine choppped prawns , beans , carrot , cucumber , eggs & chili
4. Season w / salt to taste preferences
5. Add the prepared dressing to the prawn mixture & fold it in gently to ensure all ingredients are well-mixed & coated w / the dressing
6. Pile the mixture into the bowl , onto the platter or divide equally among 4 individual serving dishes & serve immediately garnished w / opt avocado slices & / or lime wedges as desired

title: mango cheesecake with oreo graham crust
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees
2. For crust: combine all ingredients , and press into bottom of a 9 or 10-in spingform pan
3. Bake at 350 degrees for 10 mins
4. Cool , increase the oven temperature to 375 degrees
5. Filling: beat cream cheese and sugar until smooth
6. Blend in eggs one at a time
7. Then add remaining ingredients , mixing well
8. Pour into pan
9. Bake at 375 degrees for 10 mins , then lower temperature back to 350 degrees , for 35-40 mins , or until lightly golden , and just set
10. Cool 5 hours , then refrigerate 8 more hours or overnight

title: asparagus vinaigrette
steps:
1. Bring a large pan of well-salted water to a boil
2. Put in asparagus and bring back to a boil
3. Cook until just tender , about 5 minutes
4. Drain and refresh under cold water
5. Arrange the cooled asparagus on a platter
6. Whisk together the remaining ingredients , and spoon vinaigrette over all
7. Top with an additional grind of pepper

title: chocolate sponge custard
steps:
1. In small mixing bowl at high speed , beat egg whites with cream of tartar until stiff but not dry , just until whites no longer slip when bowl is tilted
2. In small mixing bowl , at high speed , blend or beat yolks , milk , syrup , flour , and vanilla until smooth
3. Gently , but thoroughly , fold into beaten whites
4. Place 6 lightly greased custard cups in large baking pan
5. Pour egg mixture into cups
6. Place pan on rack in preheated 350f oven
7. Pour very hot water into pan to within 1 / 2 inch of top of custards
8. Bake until puffed and cake tester or wooden pick inserted near center comes out clean , about 30 to 35 minutes
9. Remove promptly from hot water
10. Cool at least 5 minutes before serving
11. Top with a dollop of marshmallow fluff or whipped cream
12. Makes 6 servings

title: eggplant  aubergine  parmigiana soup
steps:
1. Combine oil , onions and garlic and saut for about 2 minutes
2. Add the eggplant , chicken stock , tomato juice , parsley and thyme
3. Bring to a boil , lower heat and simmer , covered for about 30 minutes
4. Serve with mozzarella cheese sprinkled over the top

title: lemon pepper marinade
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients
2. Cut chicken breast in cubes
3. Marinate for at least 2 hours
4. Place on skewers and bbq til done
5. Serve with rice

title: slow cooker meatloaf italian style
steps:
1. Reserve 1 / 3 cup pizza sauce
2. Cover and refrigerate
3. In a bowl , combine remaining pizza sauce with next 7 ingredients
4. Mix together well
5. Form meat mixture into loaf and place into crockpot
6. Cover and cook on low for 8-10 hrs or on high for 4-6 hours
7. Spread loaf with reserved 1 / 3 cup pizza sauce
8. Sprinkle with mozzarella cheese
9. Cover and let cook for another 15 minutes , or until cheese is melted
10. Remove meatloaf to serving dish , slice , and enjoy !

title: eggs benedict with asparagus and crab
steps:
1. Steam asparagus till tender with 1 teaspoon of vinegar
2. Steam crab till fully cooked
3. Poach eggs with parsley
4. Heat muffinfs and cut in half
5. Place eggs on muffin halfs
6. Add cooked bacon , crab and aspargus and top with hollandaise sauce

title: onion and apple pork chops
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine the pepper , salt , and garlice powder
2. Rub over pork chops
3. Grill chops , covered over medium heat for 7-9 minutes on each side or until meat thermometer reads 160 degree f
4. Meanwhile , in a large skillet , saute onions and apples in better until tender
5. Stir in brown sugar
6. Cook until thickened and bubbly
7. Also prepare desired noodles
8. Serve noodle and apple mixture with pork chops
9. Enjoy !

title: cristina s chicken pot pie
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400
2. Spray a 2-quart casserole with cooking spray or coat evenly with butter
3. In a large saucepan , heat the oil and butter and saut the onion until tender but not brown
4. Stir in the flour until blended
5. Slowly stir in the stock , whisking well
6. Cook the mixture over medium heat until the chicken , peas , potatoes , carrots , salt , pepper and hot sauce is heated through
7. Turn into the prepared dish , spreading evenly
8. To prepare the crust , stir together the cornmeal , flour , baking powder , sugar and salt
9. Stir in milk , egg and oil in a bowl
10. Do not overmix
11. Spoon the batter evenly over the filling
12. Bake until the top is golden brown , or for about 22 to 25 minutes
13. Cut into wedges to serve
14. Cristina ferrare

title: orange sesame noodles with grilled shrimp
steps:
1. Combine first 7 ingredients in a large bowl
2. Boil noodles according to package directions
3. Before draining , add snow peas and carrot
4. Let cook 30 seconds
5. Drain pasta , peas , and carrot , and toss immediately with orange juice mixture
6. Set aside
7. Brush shrimp with sesame oil , and grill over medium-hot coals 3 to 5 minutes
8. Arrange pasta on serving plates , and top with shrimp

title: low fat tuscan bean and pasta stew
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to package directions
2. Drain and set aside
3. Heat olive oil in a large saucepan
4. Add onion and half the garlic
5. Saut for 5 minutes over medium heat , until onion is translucent
6. Add thyme , sage and 1 / 2 t
7. Salt
8. Saut for 10 minutes more , until the onions just start to brown
9. Add the spinach , tomatoes and remaining garlic and salt
10. Stir , cover and cook over medium heat for 10 minutes , stirring once or twice , until the spinach has wilted
11. Add the basil , beans , and cooked pasta
12. Heat on low
13. When pasta is heated throughout , add black pepper and serve

title: flounder in jalapeno cream
steps:
1. In a large skillet over medium heat cook the scallions in the butter until softened
2. Add jalapeno , cream and 1 / 4 teaspoon salt and bring to a simmer
3. Pat fish dry then sprinkle with pepper and remaining salt
4. Fold each filet in half crosswise and place in sauce and cook at a simmer until fish is cooked through
5. Transfer fish to a platter and keep warm
6. Add tomatoes and cilantro to sauce in skillet and cook over medium low heat until heated through
7. Spoon sauce over fish and serve

title: belgian style seitan stew with dark beer
steps:
1. Heat 1 tbsp of the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat
2. Add the seitan and cook until browned on all sides , about 10 minutes , set aside
3. Heat remaining 2 tbsp olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat
4. Add the onion , cover , and cook until softened , about 5 minutes
5. Stir in the brown sugar and cook , uncovered , and stirring frequently , until the onion is caramelized , about 10 minutes
6. Add the flour , and cook , stirring for 1 or 2 minutes to remove the raw taste
7. Stir in the beer , molases , mustard , vinegar , thyme and bay leaf
8. Add the stock , and simmer , stirring occasionally , until thickened , 10 to 15 minutes
9. Add the seitan and simmer until the flavors are blended , about 10 minutes
10. Remove the bay leaf and adjust the seasonings with salt and pepper
11. Serve hot and enjoy

title: vanilla thumbprints
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees
2. Combine butter and sugar in bowl of an electric mixer
3. Cream using the paddle attachment until light and fluffy
4. Add egg and vanilla , scraping the bowl as needed
5. Add the flour and mix just until incorporated
6. Roll 2 teaspoons of dough between your hands into a 1-inch ball
7. Repeat , spacing 2 inches apart on an ungreased baking sheet
8. With a floured thumb , make an indentation in the center of each ball of dough
9. Fill each indentation with 1 / 2 teaspoon raspberry or apricot jam
10. Bake at 350 degrees f about 10-12 minutes or until lightly golden brown around bottoms
11. Remove to a wire rack to cool

title: chocolate chip coconut banana bread
steps:
1. Stir together flour , baking soda , and salt
2. Blend oil , applesauce , honey , and vanilla
3. Add eggs and blend well
4. Add bananas to oil mixture and blend thoroughly
5. Add dry ingredients to wet , alternating with water and mixing well after each addition
6. Fold in chocolate chips and coconut
7. Pour into two greased 5x9 loaf pans and bake at 325 degrees for 60-65 minutes , or until tests done
8. Remove to rack to cool for 20-25 minutes , then remove from pans to finish cooling

title: raisins  nuts n  bulgur
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300f degrees
2. In a buttered 1 quart casserole dish mix all the ingredients except the nuts
3. Bake uncovered for 30-45 min or until the moisture is absorbed and the wheat is tender
4. Fluff with a fork
5. Garnish with nuts

title: whiskey marinade
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a large zip lock bag
2. Place 2-3 lbs of desired meat in bag and marinate for at least 4 hours but up to 24 hours

title: chinese coconut buns
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degree fahrenheit
2. Coconut filling:
3. Process coconut and sugar in blender or food processor until very fine
4. Turn into small bowl
5. Stir in margarine and egg yolk until paste-like consistency
6. Dough:
7. Stir warm water and first amount of sugar in small dish until sugar is dissolved
8. Sprinkle yeast over top
9. Let stand for 10 minutes
10. Stir to dissolve yeast
11. Stir second amount of sugar , salt and cooking oil in large bowl
12. Add boiling water
13. Stir until sugar is dissolved
14. Stir in egg and yeast mixture
15. Slowly work in enough flour until soft dough forms
16. Turn out onto lightly floured surface
17. Knead for about 10 minutes until smooth and elastic
18. Place dough in large greased bowl , turning once to grease top
19. Cover with greased waxed paper and tea towel
20. Let stand in oven with light on and door closed for 1 1 / 2 to 2 hours until doubled in bulk
21. Punch dough down
22. Cover
23. Let rest for 5 minutes
24. Shape into 2 , 12 inch logs
25. Divide dough into 12 portions
26. Press and stretch each portion into 5 x 3 inch oblong shape
27. Place rounded 1 1 / 2 tablespoon filling lengthwise along centre of each piece
28. Bring long sides up and over filling , pinching all edges together to seal
29. Place , seam-side down , on greased baking sheet
30. Cover with greased waxed paper and tea towel
31. Let stand in oven with light on and door closed for about 1 hour until doubled in size
32. Egg wash:
33. Beat egg and water together with fork in small cup
34. Brush over buns
35. Bake in 350 degree fahrenheit oven for 15 to 18 minutes until golden brown
36. Honey wash:
37. Combine honey and hot water in separate small cup
38. Brush over warm buns
39. Serve warm
40. Makes 12 buns

title: cream of hearts of palm soup
steps:
1. Drain and rinse the palm hearts then place in a food processor and puree
2. Melt butter in a saute pan
3. Add flour and cook over low heat stirring constantly into a blonde roux
4. Slowly add warm chicken stock stirring with a wire whip so it is lump free
5. Blend in the palm hearts
6. Add the milk and cream just before serving
7. Bring to serving temperature but do not allow to boil
8. Add a little pepper to accent the taste

title: chocoalate self sauce puddings
steps:
1. Place butter in a large microwave-proof dish and melt at 350w for 60 seconds
2. Stir in sifted flour , caster sugar , and cocoa
3. Add the milk and vanilla and beat with a wooden spoon until mix is smooth
4. Spoon mixture into individual microwave-proof containers
5. Combine extra sifted cocoa and brown sugar and sprinkle equal amounts onto each pudding
6. Carefully pour the boiling water slowly over the back of a large metal spoon and over the pudding mixtures
7. Cook for 6-10 minutes , until springy~soft and just cooked in the centre remove and stand for 3 minutes before serving
8. N
9. B
10. As every microwave is different and you need to consider your own microwaves power
11. It may take less or longer to cook these
12. It may be better to cook them on medium high
13. Your microwave may take longer so keep an eye on times
14. Sprinkle each pudding with icing sugar and serve with ice-cream or cream

title: chocolate sour cream icing
steps:
1. Cream butter and sugar together
2. Add remaining ingredients and mix until smooth

title: caramel dessert
steps:
1. In a large mixing bowl combine flour , pecans , brown sugar and rolled oats
2. Add melted butter and mix well
3. Pat in a thin layer on a baking sheet and bake at 400f for 15 minutes , stirring occasionally
4. Crumble while still warm
5. Then cool and put half of the crumb mixture in a 9x13-inch pan
6. Drizzle the crumbs with half of the caramel sauce
7. Next spread the ice cream over the caramel ,
8. Top with remaining crumbs and drizzle the remainder of the caramel sauce over the top
9. Cover and freeze
10. To serve: cut into serving slices

title: maple butter blondie dessert   like applebee s
steps:
1. For brownies:
2. In mixer blend butter , and brown sugar
3. Then add baking powder , salt , vanilla , and then eggs
4. Mix in flour
5. Fold in chips and nuts
6. Grease a 9 by 13-inch pan and smooth brownie mixture in with a spatula
7. Bake 350f for 22-25 minutes
8. Top should be shiny and firm when you touch the center with a finger -- do not over bake or it will be dry
9. Sauce:
10. Combine first 3 ingredients in a sauce pan and bring to a boil
11. Cook for 2-3 minutes , remove from heat and add flavoring
12. To assemble:
13. While they are still warm , cut brownies into 12 pieces , they may be a little crumbly--they are more cake like in texture
14. Place a brownie on a plate and top with 2 scoops of ice cream
15. Then drizzle with sauce and sprinkle with more nuts

title: apple lemon slush
steps:
1. In a blender , combine apple-juice concentrate , lemon juice and crushed ice
2. Blend until slushy

title: southwest sausage and pasta casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Lightly grease a 13 x 9 dish
3. Set aside
4. Cook shell pasta according to package
5. Set aside and keep hot
6. While pasta cooks , brown the sausage in a skillet with the onions until no longer pink
7. Drain well
8. Return the cooked sausage and onions to the skillet
9. Stir in the salsa , salsa con queso , and fat free sour cream
10. Stir in the cooked shell pasta and mix well
11. Pour into the prepared casserole dish
12. Sprinkle with the cheese
13. Bake at 350 for about 20 - 25 minutes

title: cheesy ham   cauliflower casserole
steps:
1. Cut cauliflower into 1 / 2-inch pieces
2. Steam or microwave until just tender
3. Drain in a colander and set aside
4. Saute onion and cubed ham in butter in a large saucepan over medium-high heat until onions are translucent
5. Stir in cheese sauce , fire-roasted peppers , and chipotle pepper and reduce heat to medium-low
6. Cook , stirring occasionally , until sauce is heated through
7. Add about half of the shredded cheddar and stir until melted
8. Repeat with the remaining cheddar
9. Add salt and freshly-ground black pepper to taste
10. Add cooked cauliflower to sauce and stir gently to distribute sauce evenly
11. Pour into a buttered casserole dish and bake at 350f for about 20 minutes or until bubbly

title: catalan beef stew
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 160c heat a large flameproof casserole dish over high heat
2. Add the pancetta and cook , stirring , for 2-3 minutes or until golden
3. Transfer to a heatproof bowl
4. Add 60ml of the oil to the casserole dish
5. Add one-quarter of the beef and cook , turning , for 5 minutes or until brown
6. Transfer to the bowl with the pancetta
7. Repeat , in 3 more batches , with the remaining beef , reheating the dish between batches
8. Add the vinegar to the dish and cook , stirring to dislodge any bits that have cooked on to the base , for 1-2 minutes
9. Pour over the beef mixture
10. Heat the remaining oil in the dish over medium heat
11. Add the onion and garlic and cook , stirring , for 10 minutes or until soft
12. Add the beef mixture , stock , wine , tomato paste , cinnamon , thyme , orange peel and chocolate
13. Cover with foil and a tight-fitting lid
14. Bring to the boil
15. Bake in oven for 2 hours or until the beef is tender
16. Set aside for 15 minutes to cool
17. Place in the fridge for 6 hours to chill
18. Preheat oven to 160c use a spoon to remove any fat from the surface of the stew
19. Cook the stew , stirring , over low heat for 5 minutes or until heated through
20. Bake in oven for 45-50 minutes or until the meat is tender and the sauce thickens
21. Sprinkle the stew with parsley to serve

title: southwestern savory sandwich
steps:
1. Mix the tarragon with mayonnaise , then spread on 2 slices of bread
2. Mash the avocado , then add the cheeses , worcestershire sauce , salt and onions
3. Mix together and spread on remaining 2 slices of bread
4. Add the turkey slices
5. Tear green chiles into strips and add to sandwich
6. Put sandwich together , slice and serve

title: quicker corn dogs
steps:
1. Separate cornbread dough into 8 sticks , roll each piece into a 14-inch rope
2. Insert wooden sticks lengthwise into hotdogs , leaving 1 inch of each stick exposed
3. Wrap each cornbread rope around each hotdog , pressing ends of dough to seal at the top and bottom
4. Place on cookie sheet sprayed with no stick cooking spray
5. Bake at 350 degrees for 20 minutes or until cornbread is golden brown
6. My friend also likes to roll bacon around the outside and sometimes i add cheddar cheese to the hotdog before adding the dough
7. These can be prepared and then frozen before cooking
8. Just add a couple minutes to the cook time !
9. Hope you like them !

title: chicken cordon bleu bake  oamc
steps:
1. Prepare stuffing mixes according to package directions
2. Meanwhile , in a large bowl , combine soup and milk
3. Set aside
4. Divide chicken between two greased 13 x 9 inch baking dishes
5. Sprinkle with pepper
6. Layer with ham , swiss cheese , 1 cup cheddar cheese , soup mixture and stuffing
7. Sprinkle with remaining cheddar cheese
8. Cover and freeze one casserole for up to 3 months
9. Cover and bake the remaining casserole at 350 degrees for 30 minutes
10. Uncover
11. Bake 10-15 minutes longer or until cheese is melted
12. To use frozen casserole: thaw in the refrigerator overnight
13. Remove from the refrigerator 30 minutes before baking
14. Cover and bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes
15. Uncover
16. Bake 10-15 minutes longer or until heated through and cheese is melted
17. Each casserole serves 6

title: southwestern chicken   rice soup low fat and my way
steps:
1. Bring broth to a boil in a large saucepan
2. Stir in rice , and cumin
3. Return to a boil
4. Cover , reduce heat , and simmer 15 minutes until rice is tender
5. Skip these steps if you are using cooked brown rice
6. Stir chicken , and next 3 ingreds
7. Into rice mixture
8. Bring to a boil
9. Remove mixture from heat
10. Stir in lime juice , cilantro , and salt
11. Serve

title: scintillating lemon pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Roll out 1 / 2 of the dough into 9-inch circle
3. Cut into 6 wedges
4. Place wedges on cookie sheet
5. Mix 1 1 / 2 t sugar and nutmeg together in small bowl
6. Sprinkle over pastry wedges
7. Bake at 400 degrees for no longer than 5 minutes , or until set
8. Remove from cookie sheet and set aside
9. Grate yellow part of rind
10. Peel and slice lemons very thinly
11. Set aside
12. Cream butter , 1 1 / 2 cups sugar and flour in mixer bowl
13. Beat in eggs , then beat in water
14. Stir in reserved lemon slices and grated rind
15. Roll out remaining pastry to form 9-inch pie shell
16. Pour lemon mixture into prepared pie shell
17. Bake at 400 degrees for 25-30 minutes
18. Arrange baked pastry wedges on top of filling and bake for an additional 5 minutes , or until filling is firm

title: oriental meat bundles
steps:
1. Food process 1st four till finely chopped
2. Add veggie mixture to browned meat
3. Add egg
4. Cook till cabbage is soft
5. Drain in colander
6. Flatten each biscuit between wax paper until about 6 inches round
7. Add 1 / 3 cup filling
8. Fold dough over filling envelope style
9. Place on non-stick baking sheet
10. Spray it if you have to
11. Bake till golden about 12-15 min at 450f

title: potato and gruyere croquettes
steps:
1. Heat 2 tablespoons oil in large nonstick skillet over medium heat
2. Add potato and onion
3. Sprinkle generously with salt and pepper
4. Saut until vegetables are tender , about 20 minutes
5. Transfer to bowl
6. Cool completely
7. Mix next 4 ingredients into potato mixture
8. Using moistened hands , form 1 / 4 cup mixture into croquettes
9. Chill until firm , about 1 hour
10. Whisk eggs in medium bowl
11. Place breadcrumbs in pie dish
12. Dip each croquette into eggs , then coat with breadcrumbs , pressing to adhere
13. Chill 1 hour
14. Heat 1 / 2 cup oil in heavy large skillet over medium heat
15. Working in batches , add croquettes to skillet and cook until crisp and golden brown , turning occasionally , about 8 minutes
16. Transfer to paper towels and drain

title: best damn borracho beans period
steps:
1. Soak your beans
2. Bring beans to boil in 8-10 cups of water
3. Remove from heat covered
4. Let the beans soak for 30-45 minutes until the beans start to swell from the water infusing into them
5. Strain the beans
6. Bring another 8 cups of water to a boil
7. While beans are boiling , trim the ham hocks of fat
8. Leave fat in large pieces
9. Cut the meat into small bite-size pieces
10. Put all into pot
11. Remove fat and bones when your beans are done
12. Chop all veggies into small pieces
13. Combine veggies , meat , fat , and spices into large stock pot or dutch oven and simmer for at least 2 1 / 2 hours
14. Remove fat when finished
15. Taste , add more seasoning if needed

title: mexican rice bowl with chicken
steps:
1. Cook rice according to package instructions
2. Meanwhile , heat oil in a large skillet
3. Season chicken cubes with salt and pepper
4. Add chicken to the skillet and cook until well browned
5. Remove from skillet and set aside
6. Add onion and garlic to skillet , and saute for approximately 5 minutes or until soft
7. Add in red and green peppers , continue to saute on medium-low heat until peppers are soft , about 7 minutes
8. Once softened , add all remaining ingredients , as well as the cooked chicken
9. Stir until all ingredients are mixed well and heated through
10. Adjust salt and pepper
11. Serve over rice with shredded cheese and sour cream
12. Even heartier with a side of tortilla chips or warmed tortillas

title: coffee fluff shake
steps:
1. Put well-chilled milk , instant coffee granules & marshmallow fluff in a blender
2. Blend 30 seconds or until all ingredients are well-mixed & smooth
3. 5 oz is just never enough of a coffee fix for me

title: glazed corned beef
steps:
1. Rinse off corned beef and put in a large pot of water
2. Add package of spices and bring to a boil over high heat
3. Reduce and simmer over low for 60-90 minutes
4. Remove from pot and place in a baking dish
5. Cover with foil and bake at 350f for 60-90 minutes
6. Mix brown sugar , mustard , and corn syrup in a small saucepan
7. Bring to a boil and remove from heat
8. Pour over cooked corned beef and place back into oven for about 5-10 minutes
9. Serve with cooked cabbage
10. You can add the extra glaze to the cabbage

title: eggplant  aubergine  parmesan   vegan
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. In a food processor process till smooth: tofu , spinach , garlic , nutmeg , salt / pepper to taste and set aside
3. Place flour , water or soymilk , bread crumbs each in separate bowls
4. Heat olive oil in med frying pan
5. Dip eggplant slices into flour then into water or soymilk and finally into breadcrumbs
6. Place 4 slices at a time , into olive oil in frying pan
7. Fry eggplant on each side or until golden brown
8. Place on paper towels to drain excess oil
9. In a lasagna baking dish , spread about 2-4 tablespoons pasta sauce onto bottom of pan to evenly cover
10. Layer eggplant , tofu-spinach mixture and sauce
11. Repeat till all ingredients are done
12. Sprinkle cheese and bake for 30-45 minutes

title: java smoothie
steps:
1. Pour a glass full of ice into the blender
2. Add the coffee , milk , and peeled banana
3. Pour in the shot of vanilla syrup
4. Blend well until the texture is smooth
5. Serve immediately in the large glass topped with whipped cream for an addicting java smoothie taste !

title: 48 hour pork tenderloin
steps:
1. Place meat in a large heavy-duty resealable plastic bag
2. Measure all remaining ingredients into a jar with a tight-fitting lid
3. Shake vigorously to combine well
4. Pour marinade over tenderloins
5. Refrigerate for 24 to 48 hours
6. When ready to cook , discard the marinade and grill over medium coals until thoroughly done but still slightly pink in the center
7. Allow meat to rest for about 5 minutes before cutting , spooning a small amount of the juice which collects over each slice

title: homemade oatmeal cream pies
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
2. Line cookie sheets with parchment paper
3. Sift the dry ingredients into a medium bowl and set aside
4. Use an electric mixer to cream the brown sugar , butter , egg and vanilla
5. Once smooth , slowly add the dry mixture to the wet until well combined
6. Stir in the oats
7. Use a tablespoon-sized scoop to form equal dough balls
8. Allow them plenty of space to spread
9. Bake for 7-9 minutes
10. Allow the cookies to cool completely before moving off the parchment paper
11. Cream the shortening , powdered sugar , and vanilla together until smooth
12. Mix in the marshmallow fluff
13. To assemble: match up two cookies that are of equal size and shape
14. Turn the bottom cookies over
15. Use a piping bag to pipe the filling onto the bottom cookie
16. This is much easier than trying to spread it
17. Then add the top cookie of each cream pie and press down
18. I found i liked a thin layer of cream filling better than a thick layer--but you should have plenty if you want to pile it on !

title: buckwheat buttermilk pancakes
steps:
1. Preheat griddle or large skillet to 375f grease lightly with oil
2. Griddle is ready when small drops of water sizzle and disappear almost immediately
3. Mix dry ingredients together
4. Add egg , buttermilk and butter , beating well after each addition
5. Pour 1 / 4 cup batter for each pancake onto hot griddle
6. Cook 1 to 1-1 / 2 minutes , turning when edges look cooked and bubbles begin to break on surface
7. Continue to cook 1 to 1-1 / 2 minutes or until golden brown
8. Serve with maple syrup

title: lentil stew
steps:
1. Heat a large soup pot over medium heat
2. Dice onions , chop celery , chop carrots , crush garlic
3. Add oil , salt and chopped veggies to pot
4. Sweat veggies
5. While veggies are sweating , wash split peas , checking for stones or discolored peas
6. Put aside lentils and allow to drain
7. Add tomato paste to pot and boost heat to high
8. Cook tomato paste and veggies until the paste browns and smells cooked
9. Add lentils and toss to coat
10. Cover lentils with water until just barely covered
11. Add bay leaves , red pepper and thyme
12. Stir , lower heat to medium-low , and cover
13. Let cook , stirring occasionally until soft , 20-30 minutes
14. If the peas become too dry , add additional water
15. When peas are soft , mash coarsely with a large fork , or a stick blender
16. Thoroughly mix cornstarch with 1 / 4 cup water
17. Add cornstarch slurry to lentils and boost heat to medium-high
18. Once soup has thickened , add water if too thick , and then drop heat to low
19. If you want a creamier stew , or if the stew is too spicey , add 1 / 2 cup plain lowfat yogurt
20. Serve with a dollop of yogurt and / or parsley

title: kalamata caviar
steps:
1. Smash olives with the flat side of a chef's knife and remove the pits
2. Place pitted olives in a food processor with feta , pecans , garlic and olive oil
3. Process to a pesto-like consistency
4. Add more olive oil if necessary

title: nigella lawson roasted vegetables with cheese
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Peel and cut the sweet potato into 2 inch cubes and put it in the pan
3. Cut the red potato into slightly smaller cubes 1-1 / 2 cubes
4. Cut the red onion in the middle , then cut each half into 4-6 segments , discarding the dry outer skin
5. Cut peppers into 1 inch chunks
6. Separate the cloves of garlic but no need to remove the skin
7. Add the oil and mix everything together with your hands
8. Season with pepper , but no salt
9. Cook for 45-55 minutes until vegetables are cooked through and the tinged with brown
10. Top with cheese and broil 5 minutes or so until brown
11. Serve it right out of the pan at the table
12. Couldn't be easier or more delicious !

title: vidalia sweet onion wedges
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Saute onions in butter until golden brown and tender
3. Separate rolls into triangles
4. Place in ungreased round 8-inch pan , pressing together to form an even crust on bottom and half way up the sides
5. Spread onions on top of dough
6. Season well with salt and pepper
7. Beat egg slightly: add evaporated milk
8. Pour over onions
9. Bake for 20 50 25 minutes
10. Serve hot
11. Serves 6 to 8

title: vietnamese clay pot chicken
steps:
1. Remove the skin from the chicken
2. Mix all marinade ingredients together in a large bowl , add the chicken pieces and stir gently
3. Cover and place in the fridge for at least three hours , but not more than 24 hours
4. Place chicken , marinade , quartered onions , bok choy and chicken stock into the soaked clay pot , and mix gently
5. Cover and place the clay pot into a cold oven
6. Turn oven temperature to 360f - 375f
7. Bake for 1 hour or until chicken is tender
8. If using shiitake mushrooms , add 15 minutes before the end of cooking time

title: bakery style bran muffins
steps:
1. Adust oven rack to lower middle position and heat oven to 375
2. Beat butter in large bowl of electric mixer at medium speed until light and fluffy , 1-2 minute
3. Add brown sugar , increase speed to medum-high , and beat until combined and fluffy , about 1 minute longer
4. Add eggs one at a time , beating thoroughly before adding the next
5. Beat in vanilla , molasses , and sour cream until thoroughly combined and creamy , about 1 minute longer
6. Reduce speed to low and beat in buttermilk and half the flour mixture until combined , about 1 minute longer
7. Beat in remaining flour mixture unil incorporated and slightly curdled looking , about 1 minute longer , scraping sides of bowl as necessary
8. Stir in bran and raisins
9. Spray a twelve mold muffins tin or a six mold muffin tin with cooking spray
10. Divide batter evenly using ice cream scoop or spoon
11. Bake until a toothpick inserted into center withdraws cleanly of with a few moist particles adhering to it , about 25 minute set on wire rack to cool slightly , about 5 minute remove muffins from tin and serve warm
12. Makes 12 small muffins or 6 jumbo muffins

title: faux bbq baby back ribs
steps:
1. Heat oven to 225f
2. Lay back ribs on sheet of tin foil
3. Brush with half the bbq sauce
4. Take a 2nd sheet of tin foil place over the ribs and seal the ribs
5. Put into oven
6. Bake for 3 1 / 2 - 4 hours - take out of oven , cut open the top of the tin foil package -- brush on more bbq sauce
7. Place under the broiler for 5 minutes or so
8. Serve

title: marinated goat cheese
steps:
1. Cut goat cheese into 1 cm rounds and place in a deep glass container or jar add chilies , peppercorns , bay leaves , garlic and lemon zest
2. Cover with oil and lemon juice
3. Refrigerate 2 days
4. Serve at room temperature on crackers , baguette , stuffed in cherry tomatoes , crumbled over salad- be creative !

title: high fiber low calorie bran muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Spray muffin tins with pam and set aside
3. Mix all dry ingredients , including raisins , in a large bowl
4. Blend egg whites , buttermilk , water , mashed banana and extracts in a medium bowl
5. Add wet ingredients to dry and stir until thoroughly combined
6. Fill each muffin tin 1 / 2 full
7. Bake 15 minutes
8. Let cool on a wire rack
9. Freeze leftovers and defrost as needed

title: cranberry orange cheese ball
steps:
1. Beat cream cheese until smooth
2. Stir in dried cranberries
3. Stir in thawed oj concentrate
4. Mix until well combined
5. Shape into a ball or put in a nice bowl and cover with plastic wrap
6. Set in fridge for at least 2 hours-overnight -- the longer the better
7. Take out 20 min before serving to let soften
8. Serve with crackers or pretzels

title: tasty and easy ham egg bake it is the best
steps:
1. Directions
2. Preheat the oven to 350
3. Grease a 2-quart baking dish
4. Layer the bread , ham , and 2 cups cheese in the dish
5. In a medium bowl , whisk together the eggs , milk , 1 / 4 teaspoon salt and 1 / 2 teaspoon pepper
6. Pour into the dish and top with the tomato slices in an even layer
7. Bake the eggs until nearly set , about 30 minutes

title: hot dog surprise
steps:
1. Spray cooking spray in a small skillet
2. Let heat until water that is sprinkled on sizzles
3. Add cut up hot dog
4. They should be bite size
5. Probably cut in half and then 1 / 2 inch pieces across
6. While moving the hot dog bites around add the salt , pepper , cilantro and old bay
7. After 10 seconds of mixing add the worcestershire sauce
8. Mix until the sauce is combined with the hot dogs
9. Then turn off heat and remove from skillet
10. Eat with the mustard as a dip
11. Use your own mixtures of seasonings and tell me what you used and if you liked it

title: herbed turkey
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f
2. Mix together the garlic , rosemary , butter , salt and pepper
3. Pull apart from the meat , the skin to create a pocket
4. Push the herb mixture in between the skin and meat
5. Press down on the skin if necessary to distribute the mixture as evenly as possible
6. Spray the turkey with a non stick spray
7. Cover turkey with foil and place in oven
8. Bake approx 1 1 / 2 to 2 hours , or until meat thermometer reaches 185f
9. Uncover and bake the turkey about 15 minutes or until the outside becomes a golden brown
10. Pull out of oven and let sit about 15 minutes before carving

title: couscous and sun dried tomatoes
steps:
1. Heat oil in pan that has a tight fitting lid
2. Saute onions until they just start to soften
3. Add the tomatoes and continue to saute about 5 minutes more , or until the onions become translucent
4. Pour in boiling water , stir and bring back up to a boil
5. Add couscous and stir
6. Cover and simmer for 10 minutes
7. Fluff with a fork when done

title: caramel frappe     just like mcdonalds
steps:
1. Add these ingredients to blender -
2. 1 cup of ice
3. 1 / 2 cup of milk
4. 1 / 2 cup of double strength coffee
5. 2 tablespoons sugar
6. 2 tablespoons caramel
7. Blend well
8. Pour half into tall glass
9. Top with whipped cream
10. Drizzle with caramel
11. Enjoy !

title: fat free mini banana muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Place all ingredients into a large mixing bowl and mix until just moistened
3. Spoon into lined or nonstick , sprayed mini muffin pan
4. Bake at 350 degrees for 15 minutes
5. Remove muffins from the tray and cool on a wire rack

title: simple seven grain bread for abm
steps:
1. Add ingredients to your bread machine in order shown
2. Set to 1
3. 5 lb loaf on regular bread setting
4. Press start -- when done , enjoy !

title: 5 a day smoothie
steps:
1. Microwave sweet potato until soft
2. Scoop out pulp and put in blender
3. Peel orange and add to blender
4. Add banana , chopped carrot , and orange juice
5. Blend until smooth and creamy
6. Add ice cubes and water until desired thickness is achieved
7. Pour into glass and enjoy !

title: turkey and navy bean soup
steps:
1. In a 3 quart saucepan over medium heat , saute the onions and smoked turkey in the oil for 5 minutes , or until lightly browned
2. Add the garlic and stir for 1 minute
3. Add the stock , diced turkey , beans and pepper
4. Bring to a boil
5. Cover
6. Reduce the heat , and simmer for 10 minutes
7. Add salt to taste
8. Stir in the basil
9. Ladle into individual bowls , and sprinkle with the parmesan
