title: one bowl brownies
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine sugar , flour , cocoa , baking powder , salt and nuts
2. Add oil , eggs and vanilla
3. Stir just until moistened
4. Do not overmix
5. Spread in a greased 13x9 pan
6. Bake at 350 for 20-25 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean

title: my familys pancakes
steps:
1. Heat griddle over medium high , spray with cooking spray
2. Stir all ingredients pour by slightly less then 1 / 4 cupfuls onto hot griddle
3. Cook until edges are dry then turk and cook until golden

title: ultimate stuffed potato
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
2. Begin by baking the potatoes , as this will take the longest
3. Place potatoes onto a baking sheet
4. Pierce with a fork , drizzle with olive oil and season with salt
5. Place into preheated oven and bake for about 1 hour
6. While they are baking prepare the stuffing
7. Make a mornay sauce by combining the butter and flour over medium heat and then whisking in the milk
8. Fold in about 2 cups cheese and stir until melted
9. Once melted , remove from heat and fold in the cooked broccoli florets , crispy bacon bits , chopped chives and season with salt and freshly ground black pepper
10. When the potatoes are done make a cut across the top and squeeze it from the bottom so a small pouch opens up and the bottom is squared off
11. Spoon the filling over the top of the potato , sprinkle with remaining cheese , season with pepper , to taste , and then pop in the oven for 2 more minutes until golden brown and bubbly

title: boy scout apples
steps:
1. Core the apples and peel off a strip around the equator of each apple to prevent bursting
2. Mash together the butter , sugar or jam , cinnamon , and salt in a small bowl
3. Fill each apple cavity with some of the mixture and wrap each apple individually in aluminum foil
4. Preheat a grill to medium high heat
5. Place the apple packets on the grill
6. Close the cover and cook until the fruit is just tender , 8-10 minutes
7. Remove from grill , unwrap carefully , and enjoy !

title: christmas mice on shortbread
steps:
1. Cover work area with piece of waxed paper 18 inches long
2. Dry cherries with paper towels
3. Place 2 / 3 cup chips and the oil in 6oz custard cup
4. Microwave uncovered on high 1 minute to 1 minute 10 seconds , or until chips are softened
5. Stir until smooth
6. Hold 1 cherry by stem , and dip into melted chips , covering completely-- even stem
7. Immediately place on shortbread triangle , with tail at 45-degree angle
8. Place 2 of the sliced almonds against front of cherry to form mouse ears
9. Repeat with remaining cherries , shortbread and almonds
10. Using the remaining melted chips as glue and a toothpick to spread the melted chips , attach the flat side of a whole chip to the base of the almonds to form the mouse head
11. Using melted chips as glue , attach a few shreds of coconut for the whiskers and a red hot for the nose
12. Let cool without moving 50-60 minutes or until the melted chip mixture is firm and completely set
13. Store in cool place up to one week

title: chicken bang bang
steps:
1. Beat the chicken breasts with a rolling pin to loosen the fibres
2. Shred the chicken with two forks
3. Pour very hot water over the noodles and soak for 5 minutes
4. In a food processor , blend the garlic , coriander , peanut butter , soy sauce , honey , chilli oil , vinegar and sherry and blend until smooth
5. Divide noodles between four serving plates , top with cucumber strips , then the chicken
6. Drizzle with peanut sauce without smothering it
7. Garnish with extra coriander leaves and serve

title: chocolate biscuits  cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180 degree celsius
2. Lightly oil baking tray
3. Combine rolled oats , coconut , both flours , cocoa , sugar and bicarbonate of soda in a large mixing bowl
4. Melt the margarine in a small saucepan and add to the dry ingredients , then add the water and then the currants and peanuts and stir so all is well combined and mixed through
5. Roll the mixture into balls the size of a 20 cent piece and place on the baking tray
6. Bake in oven for 15 minutes

title: cherry bundt cake
steps:
1. Heat the oven to 325
2. In a large bowl combine sugar , cream cheese , butter and vanilla and mix till well blended
3. Add the eggs one at a time and mix well after each one
4. Gradually add 2 cups of the flour with baking powder
5. Mix well
6. Toss remaining 1 / 4 cup of flour with cherries and chopped nuts
7. Fold into the batter
8. Grease a 10" bundt pan
9. Pour batter inches bake 1 hr and 20 minute to 1 1 / 2 hours test with cake tester
10. Cool in wire rack for 5 minute then remove
11. Cool thoroughly
12. Combine icing sugar and milk , mix well and drizzle over the cake
13. Garnish with additional cherries and nuts if you like
14. I have not personally froze this cake but i tend to think it would freeze good

title: mom s favourite dalia for breakfast
steps:
1. Dry roast the dalia in a wok until lightly brownish in appearance and it smells aromatic
2. Remove from flame and transfer to a plate
3. Now heat oil in the same wok
4. Once hot , add cumin and mustard seeds
5. Allow to splutter
6. Once they stop spluttering , add curry leaves , green chilli and onions
7. Stir-fry until the mixture smells aromatic and the onions are lightly browned
8. Add corriander leaves and mix well
9. Fold in the veggies , salt and tomato
10. Mix again
11. Stir in about 2 tbsps
12. Of water to prevent the mixture from sticking to the bottom of the wok
13. Cook on medium flame for 5 minutes
14. Fold in the roasted dalia and mix thoroughly
15. Add water and then transfer the whole mixture to a pressure cooker
16. Cover and pressure cook for 2-3 whistles
17. This takes about 5 minutes
18. Switch off the gas , and then let the dalia cook in its own steam inside the cooker for 2-3 minutes
19. After 3 minutes , remove from cooker , garnish with corriander leaves and serve hot
20. Enjoy !

title: linguini and clam sauce
steps:
1. Cook linguini according to package directions
2. Drain
3. Meanwhile , make the sauce as follows
4. Melt butter with oil in saucepan
5. Add clams and garlic and saute for 2 to 3 minutes
6. Stir in oregano , basil , parsley , salt and pepper and simmer
7. In separate bowl or measuring cup , whisk cornstarch with 1 / 2 cup clam juice
8. Add to butter / clam mixture
9. Add cream or half & half , parmesan cheese , and wine
10. Boil for one minute , then stir the sauce in with the drained pasta

title: lemony chicken with mushrooms
steps:
1. In a heavy plastic ziploc bag mix the flour , salt , pepper and thyme
2. Shake the bag to combine all spices well
3. Shake / coat the chicken in the flour mixture
4. Brown the chicken pieces in 1 / 4 cup butter with 1 tablespoon oil on both sides , and transfer to a large greased casserole dish
5. In the same frypan , saute the green onions and mushrooms for about 3 minutes
6. Sprinkle over the chicken pieces in the casserole
7. In a small bowl , combine the lemon juice , sugar , 1 teaspoon salt and apple juice
8. Mix well to combine
9. Pour over the chicken pieces
10. Bake in a 325 degree oven for about 45 minutes

title: fiery fettuccine
steps:
1. Cook fettuccine according to package directions
2. While fettuccine cooks , mix milk , red peppers , and cajun seasoning in blender and mix well
3. Pour into fettuccine pan and heat over medium until thickened
4. Do not boil
5. Add smoked sausage and cooked fettuccine , mixing well
6. Add green onions last
7. Turn heat to low and warm through

title: lynn s versatile bran muffins
steps:
1. Cream shortening ans sugar
2. Add molasses ans eggs and beat
3. Add milk then bran
4. Combine flour , baking powder , soda& salt
5. Add to liquid ingredients then add fruit
6. Or be like me and put everything in one bowl& mix
7. Bake at 400 degrees for about 18-20 minutes
8. Makes 12 large , 15 medium 0r 18 small

title: italian  nachos
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Toast baguette rounds on a baking sheet in oven until crisp , 5-6 minutes , more if large slices
3. Turn oven off and preheat broiler to high
4. Drizzle toasted bread with oil and salt , broil until golden , 2-3 minutes
5. Transfer to oven safe serving dish or leave on baking sheet
6. Top with fontina and broil until melted , 2-3 minutes
7. Remove from oven
8. Sprinkle with tomatoes and peperoncini
9. Serve immediately

title: hot crab and artichoke dip
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees
2. Warm the oil in a medium nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
3. Add the bell pepper
4. Saute for 3-4 minutes or until light brown
5. Remove to a large bowl
6. Stir in the artichoke hearts , mayonnaise , parmesan cheese , green onions , worcestershire sauce , jalapeno , lemon juice and celery salt
7. Mix in the crab
8. Season with the salt and pepper
9. Put the mixture in an 8-inch quiche or pie pan with a 1 1 / 2-inch side
10. Bake for 30 minutes or until the top is light golden brown and bubbly
11. Serve with the crackers and baguette slices

title: brown sugar oatmeal cookies
steps:
1. In a big mixing bowl , add the brown sugar , shortening , and margarine
2. Beat until fluffy
3. Add in the vanilla and eggs
4. Mix until well blended
5. Add in the flours , and baking powder
6. Stir to mix
7. Add in the oats
8. Stir well to mix
9. Drop heaping tablespoonfuls of dough 2-inches apart onto an ungreased cookie sheet
10. Bake at 350 for 10-14 minutes or until a light golden brown
11. Cool for 1 minute , then transfer to cooling rack

title: chicken fricassee with chive dumplings
steps:
1. Wash chicken pieces and pat dry
2. Mix 1 cup flour , the salt , pepper and paprika
3. Coat chicken with flour mixture
4. Heat thin layer of salad oil in large skillet
5. Brown chicken on all sides
6. Drain off fat
7. Reserve
8. To skillet , add water and , if desired , chopped onion , lemon juice or herbs , such as rosemary or thyme leaves
9. Cover tightly
10. Cook chicken slowly 2 1 / 2 - 3 1 / 2 hours or until fork-tender , adding water if necessary
11. Remove chicken to warm platter
12. Keep warm
13. Pour off liquid in skillet
14. Reserve
15. To make gravy , heat 3 tablespoons reserved fat in skillet
16. Blend in 3 tablespoons flour
17. Cook over low heat , stirring until mixture is smooth and bubbly
18. Remove from heat
19. Add enough milk to reserved liquid to measure 3 cups
20. Pour into skillet
21. Heat to boiling , stirring constantly
22. Boil and stir 1 minute
23. Return chicken to gravy
24. Prepare dough for dumplings , drop by spoonfuls onto hot chicken
25. Cook uncovered 10 minutes
26. Cover and cook 20 minutes longer
27. For dumplings: measure flour , baking powder , chives and salt into bowl
28. Cut in shortening thoroughly until mixture looks like meal
29. Stir in milk

title: stuffed buns   chicken or paneer
steps:
1. Dissolve the yeast in warm water with 1 / 2 tbsp sugar and 1 / 2 tbsp flour
2. Leave aside for 10 mts
3. Boil the milk and cool till it is warm on touch
4. Add sugar , oil and salt
5. Mix well with a wooden spoon till the sugar dissolves
6. Add 1 cup flour and mix to a smooth paste
7. Add the beaten egg , yeast and mix
8. Add the remaining flour and mix well till it forms a smooth dough
9. Knead well for 10 mts
10. Let it rest till it doubles in volume
11. While its resting prepare the chicken filling
12. Punch down the dough lightly using your palm and divide the dough equally
13. Flatten each portion and fill with 1 tbsp of the chicken filling
14. Re-shape into a smooth ball
15. Sprinkle the top with sesame seeds
16. Let it sit / prove for another 20 minutes
17. Bake them in a pre-heated oven at 200 degrees c for 10-12 mts
18. When it starts to brown , brush tops with egg white
19. For chicken filling:
20. Heat oil in a heavy bottomed vessel , add the onions and saute for 4 mts
21. Add ginger garlic paste and saute for 4 mts
22. Reduce the heat , add the red chili powder , coriander powder , cumin powder and garam masala powder and mix well
23. Add the shredded chicken and mix well
24. Add salt to taste
25. Cook for 3 mts
26. Turn off heat and cool
27. Add coriander leaves and mix

title: great northern bean soup
steps:
1. Rinse and drain beans
2. Heat water , beans , bay leaves , onion , bacon and potatoes to boiling in 8-qt
3. Stock pot
4. Boil 2 minutes
5. Turn off heat , cover , and let stand 1 hour
6. Add tomato sauce , instant bouillon , salt , pepper , garlic and half of the carrots and celery to beans
7. Heat to boiling
8. Reduce heat
9. Cover and simmer until beans are tender , about 2 hours
10. Stir remaining carrots and celery into soup
11. Heat to boiling
12. Reduce heat
13. Cover and simmer until vegetables are tender , about 1 hour
14. Stir in additional 1 or 2 cups water for thinner consistency
15. Using a slotted spoon and a wooden spoon , scoop potatoes against inside of pot and smash them , letting smashed potatoes drop back into the soup
16. Stir in butter and milk and serve immediately

title: stracciatella  italian egg broth
steps:
1. Put chicken stock in pan and bring to boil
2. In a medium bowl , beat together the eggs , parsley and parmesan cheese
3. Whisk mixture quickly into the hot chicken stock
4. Stir over heat 1-2 minutes , or until heated through
5. Serve stracciatella topped with extra parsley and parmesan cheese , if desired

title: greyhound
steps:
1. In a highball glass filled with ice add vodka and grapefuit juice and stir
2. Enjoy

title: good for you gingerbread
steps:
1. In a large bowl , stir together the flours , brown sugar , ginger , cinnamon , baking powder , and baking soda
2. In a small bowl , combine the egg whites , buttermilk , applesauce , and molasses
3. Add the buttermilk mixture to the flour mixture and beat with an electric mixer until combined
4. Transfer the batter to an 8"x8"x2" baking pan that has been sprayed with nonstick cooking spray and bake for 30-35 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean
5. Cool on a wire rack 10 minutes and then remove from pan and serve

title: easy crawfish pistolettes
steps:
1. Clean crawfish
2. Leave in bowl of cold water until ready to use
3. Brown sausage per package directions
4. Drain
5. Add velveeta and crawfish to sausage
6. Cook on medium heat , until velveeta is melted , stirring often
7. Remove from heat
8. Using a spoon , poke an opening into each pistolette
9. Spoon 1 1 / 2 tbsp crawfish mixture into each roll
10. Place on lightly greased baking sheet
11. Brush with butter , if desired
12. Bake per package directions
13. Cool 5-10 minutes , and enjoy !

title: pumpkin soup with cinnamon crema and roasted pumpkin seeds
steps:
1. Bring 3 cups of the stock to a boil in a large saucepan over high heat
2. Whisk in the pumpkin puree , 1 teaspoon of the cinnamon , the ginger , allspice , nutmeg , honey , maple syrup , and chipotle puree
3. Reduce the heat to low and simmer , stirring occasionally , for 15 to 20 minutes
4. Add more stock if the soup is too thick
5. Remove from the heat and whisk in cup of the crema and season with salt and pepper to taste
6. Mix together the remaining cup crema and 1 teaspoon cinnamon until combined
7. Ladle the soup into bowls
8. Drizzle with the cinnamon crema and sprinkle with the roasted pumpkin seeds and a little cinnamon
9. Roasted pumpkin seeds
10. 1 cup raw pumpkin seeds
11. 2 tablespoons vegetable oil
12. Kosher salt
13. Preheat the oven to 325 degrees f
14. Toss the seeds with the oil and season with salt to taste
15. Spread the seeds evenly on a baking sheet and bake , tossing occasionally , for 15 to 20 minutes , until they are lightly golden brown and crisp
16. Let cool
17. These can be made up to 2 days in advance and stored in an airtight container

title: top secret recipes version of applebee s mud slide bytodd wilbur
steps:
1. Measure 2 cups of ice cream into your blender
2. Add the kahlua and blend until smooth
3. Prepare a 16-ounce wine glass by swirling chocolate syrup around the inside of the glass
4. Hold the wine glass by the stem with one hand and twirl the wine glass as you squeeze the chocolate
5. Slowly move the chocolate up toward the rim of the glass so that the chocolate makes a continuous spiral around the inside of the glass
6. Pour the drink from the blender into the glass
7. Add a pile of whipped cream to the top of the drink and drizzle additional chocolate syrup over the whipped cream
8. Add a straw and serve

title: mexican crock pot chicken
steps:
1. Combine the broth , salsa and flour in a slow cooker , whisking to blend , stir in onion
2. Arrange the chicken breast in the crock-pot
3. Cover and cook on low for 6 hours
4. Remove the chicken breast to a plate
5. Ladle sauce from pot into a blender and puree , , stir in sour cream
6. Return chicken and sauce to crock-pot
7. Keep warm until ready to serve
8. Warm beans in a small pan on stove
9. Warm tortillas in tortilla warmer in microwave
10. Arrange chicken on plates and top with shredded cheese
11. Serve with beans , lettuce , additional salsa and tortillas

title: daniel s ambitious invention cake
steps:
1. Put all of step one ingredients in a saucepan
2. Bring to boil
3. Take of heat and add step two ingredients
4. Cool
5. Then add step three ingredients
6. Bake in lined tin at 300f for 1 1 / 2 - 2 hours

title: crock pot short ribs with ale and winter squash
steps:
1. Brown the short ribs
2. Place the ribs in the bottom of the crock pot
3. Add the onions , garlic , bay leaf , squash , tomatoes
4. Season with salt and lemon pepper
5. Pour ale and canned tomatoes over the meat and vegetables
6. Cover and cook about 5 1 / 2 hours on high , or 7-8 on low
7. Correct seasonings to taste

title: fuzzy navel cheesecake
steps:
1. Crust:
2. Mix together crust ingredients and place in bottom of springform pan
3. Bake in oven 8-10 minutes at 350 degrees
4. Allow to cool slightly
5. Cheesecake filling:
6. In large bowl , combine cream cheese , sugar , sour cream and cornstarch
7. Beat with an electric mixer until smooth
8. Add eggs and egg yolk , one at a time , beating well after each addition
9. Beat in orange juice concentrate , peach schnapps , lemon juice and vanilla
10. Pour the cream cheese mixture over the crust
11. Bake at 350 degrees for 15 minutes
12. Lower the temperature to 200 degrees and bake for 1 hour and 10 minutes or until the center no longer looks wet and shiny
13. Remove the cake from the oven and run a knife around the inside edge of the pan
14. Chill , uncovered , overnight
15. Orange marmalade glaze:
16. In small saucepan stir together all the glaze ingredients
17. Cook until thickened and bubbly
18. Cook and stir 2 minutes more
19. Carefully pour over chilled cheesecake
20. Chill until serving time

title: haricots verts with warm bacon vinaigrette
steps:
1. Cook beans in boiling water for 7 minutes or until crisp-tender
2. Drain and plunge beans into ice water , drain
3. Cook bacon in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat until crisp
4. Remove with a slotted spoon
5. Add shallots to drippings in pan
6. Cook 5 minutes or until tender
7. Combine shallots and bacon in a large bowl
8. Add beans to pan
9. Cook 3 minutes or until thoroughly heated
10. Add beans , oil , vinegar , and salt to bacon mixture
11. Toss to combine
12. Sprinkle with walnuts and parsley

title: fried sauerkraut cakes with kielbasa
steps:
1. For sauerkraut cakes:
2. Preheat oven to 250 degrees fahrenheit
3. Pat sauerkraut dry between paper towels to remove as much moisture as possible
4. Transfer well drained sauerkraut into a bowl and stir in eggs , flour , onions , salt and pepper
5. Stir until combined
6. Heat 1 / 2 inch of oil in a 12 inch heavy skillet over medium-high heat until hot but not smoking
7. Fill a 1 / 4 cup measure 3 / 4 full with the sauerkraut mixture
8. Turn out into hot oil using a fork
9. Release and flatten to 3-1 / 2 inch diameter with the fork
10. Form 2 more cakes in the skillet the same way
11. Then fry , turning over once , until golden
12. Transfer the cakes with a slotted spatula to a paper towel to drain
13. Transfer to a baking sheet once drained
14. To keep warm , place cakes in the pre-heated oven in a shallow baking pan
15. Fry more cakes in the same manner with remaining ingredients
16. For kielbasa:
17. Brown keilbasa in 2 batches in oil remaining in skillet over medium heat and turn occasionally until browned
18. Transfer to paper towel to drain
19. Serve with sauerkraut cakes and noodles or mashed potatoes

title: lemon pepper cod with vegetable medley
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Rinse the fish and place on a nonstick baking sheet
3. Sprinkle both sides with lemon-pepper and sprinkle shallots over the top
4. Divide the butter into 4 pats and place one on top of each piece of fish
5. The fish will cook in 15-20 min , depending on how thick it is , so it should be popped into the oven the same time you start the water for the veggies
6. While the fish is cooking , cut the vegetables into bite size pieces
7. Set aside until the final 5 minutes of fish cooking time , but make sure you have 1 quart of water boiling by that point
8. Prepare the sauce by mixing the green goddess dressing base with water , let stand a minute , then whisk with light mayonnaise
9. Place the bowl on the table
10. Once the fish is close , add the vegetables to the boiling water , cook 3-4 min , till carrots are tender
11. Drain without rinsing , place in a small bowl
12. Crumble basil over the top , drizzle with olive oil and toss to coat
13. Divide between 4 plates , add the fish

title: miracle mustard marinade
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients well
2. Marinate whatever you're marinating and grill

title: black bottom zucchini brownies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f and grease a 9 x 13 baking pan
2. Stir the first 4 ingredients by hand until well combined
3. Drain any liquid from the shredded zucchini , add and mix until completely coated
4. Sift together the flour , baking powder soda and salt and add it to the zucchini mixture
5. Stir until the dry ingredients are evenly combined and add any optional ingredients
6. In a separate bowl , mix half of the batter with the coca then spread evenly over the bottom of the baking pan
7. Spread the remaining batter over the top until the chocolate batter is covered
8. Bake at 350f for 25-30 minutes or until lightly browned and the center tests done
9. Cool for about 5-10 minutes , while you prepare the glaze
10. Combine sugar , butter and canned milk in a small pan and stir occasionally on stovetop until it begins to boil
11. Stir continuously for 1 minute while the mixture boils then remove from heat and add the chocolate chips
12. Stir until smooth and spread evenly over brownies
13. After brownies have cooled and the glaze is set , cut and enjoy !

title: eggplant in garlic sauce
steps:
1. Cut eggplants to sticks
2. Sprinkle with salt and squeeze out water
3. Heat wok and stir fry garlic in oil 30 seconds
4. Add the ginger , stir fry till fragrant
5. Dump in ground pork , sautetill no longer pink
6. Add in eggplants and green onions
7. Pour in stock , chili garlic , hoisin , soy , sherry , sesame oil
8. Simmer awhile till flavor incorporates
9. Serve hot with rice

title: layered shrimp dip
steps:
1. Spread cream cheese in a plate
2. Spread chili sauce on top
3. Sprinkle bell pepper and green onions on chili sauce
4. Top with shrimp , cheese and olives in that order
5. Refrigerate at least 1 hour
6. Serve with tortilla chips

title: playground granola bars
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
2. Line a 9x13 inch baking pan with parchment or foil
3. In a large bowl , mix together the oats , brown sugar , wheat germ , cinnamon , flour , extras and salt
4. Make a well in the center , and pour in the honey , egg , oil and vanilla
5. Mix well using your hands
6. Pat the mixture evenly into the prepared pan
7. Bake for 18-20 minutes in the preheated oven , until the bars begin to turn golden at the edges
8. Cool for 5 minutes , then cut into bars while still warm
9. Do not allow the bars to cool completely before cutting , or they will be too hard to cut

title: christine s maple syrup scrambled eggs
steps:
1. Melt butter in frying pan over medium heat
2. Mix eggs , maple syrup , milk and salt till combined
3. Scramble in frying pan until cooked watching to prevent burning
4. Serve with a drizzle of pure maple syrup or without

title: strawberry spinach salad with balsamic vinaigrette
steps:
1. Whisk together the sugar , sesame seeds , poppy seeds , sesame oil , dried onion , paprika , oil and vinegar
2. Refrigerate until chilled
3. In a salad bowl , toss spinach and strawberries with some of the dressing
4. You will have more dressing than you will need
5. Sprinkle with sliced almonds if desired

title: spicy georgia peach chicken
steps:
1. Sprinkle chicken breasts with salt and pepper
2. Saut in olive oil about 5 minutes per side , or until center of chicken is no longer pink
3. Remove from skillet
4. Reserve
5. In same skillet , melt butter and brown sugar
6. Stir in dressing and mustard
7. Return chicken to pan with peaches
8. Coat thoroughly with sauce and heat through
9. Serve immediately

title: mom s hot rolls
steps:
1. Heat milk and shortening in large bowl in microwave until shortening melts
2. Meanwhile , dissolve yeast and pinch of sugar into warm water
3. In a smaller bowl , whisk the salt , soda , sugar and first portion of flour
4. Stir in half the flour mixture into the milk mixture
5. Stir in the yeast mixture , then stir in the remaining flour
6. Let rise 1 1 / 2 hour in a warm place covered with a damp dish towel
7. Whisk together baking powder and last portion flour
8. Stir into the batter
9. Cover bowl with a plate and let rise in refrigerator 12-24 hours
10. Shape rolls and let rise in a warm place for 1 1 / 2 - 2 hours
11. Bake at 400 degrees for about 15 minutes or until done
12. Parkerhouse method
13. Roll dough out on floured board to about 3 / 8" thick
14. Place on cookie sheet and brush with melted butter
15. Fold each one almost in half
16. Cloverleaf method
17. By hand , shape dough into 1" balls , dip in melted butter and place 3 per hole in a greased muffin tin
18. Put remaining dough back into fridge and use within the next few days
19. Makes great cinnamon rolls too

title: rose petal jam
steps:
1. Puree rose petals , 3 / 4 cup water and lemon juice in blender until smooth
2. Slowly add sugar
3. Blend till all sugar has dissolved
4. Stir 1 package pectin into 3 / 4 cup water , bring to a boil , and boil hard for 1 minute
5. Pour mixture into blender with rose petal mixture until well blended
6. Do this very quickly - it sets up fast ! ! pour into baby food jars
7. Let set for 6 hours , till firm
8. Will keep one month in refrigerator
9. Freezes well
10. This next recipe was donated by gina: rose hip jelly 8 cups of rose hips 6 cups of water 1 box of certo 1 / 2 cup lemon juice 5 cups of sugar boil the rose hips for 10 - 15 min
11. Until soft enough to crush
12. Crush them and squeeze through cloth , to make juice
13. For every 4 cups of juice add one box of certo and bring to a boil
14. Add the 1 / 2 cup of lemon juice and 5 cups of sugar
15. Bring to a boil and boil hard for 2 min
16. Remove from heat and pour into sterilized jars and seal with caps and rings
17. The jelly has a wonderful flavor and is the consistency of liguid honey

title: lentils and rice casserole
steps:
1. Cook lentils according to package , omitting salt
2. Drain and set aside
3. Melt margarine in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat
4. Add onion , green pepper , and garlic
5. Stir often and cook until tender
6. Stir in lentils , tomatoes with juice , paprika , salt , black pepper , and red pepper
7. Cover , reduce heat , and simmer for 20 minutes
8. Meantime , preheat oven to 325f
9. Spray a 2 quart baking dish with cooking spray , and place rice in dish , topped next with lentils
10. Bake for 15 minutes
11. Add cheese and bake 5 more minutes

title: alex guarnaschelli s mother chicken with bbq
steps:
1. Prepare the barbeque sauce:
2. In a medium saucepan or a large high-sided saute pan , combine the ketchup , cider vinegar , worcestershire sauce , soy sauce , light brown sugar , dark brown sugar , dry mustard , dijon mustard and chili powder
3. Whisk to blend
4. Bring to a simmer over medium heat
5. Add the ginger , garlic and lemon slices and stir to combine
6. Simmer until the vinegar mellows slightly and the flavors start to meld together , about 20 to 25 minutes
7. Remove from the heat and allow to cool
8. Discard the ginger pieces
9. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
10. Position the rack in the lower third of the oven
11. Line a baking sheet with foil
12. Season the chicken parts on both sides with salt , to taste
13. Pour about 1 1 / 2 cups of the barbeque sauce into a large bowl
14. Reserve the remaining sauce on the side
15. Submerge the chicken pieces in the sauce and arrange them on the prepared baking sheet with some of the lemon slices
16. The chicken should all be in a single layer with a little space between them
17. If additional space is needed , use the second baking sheet
18. Brush with barbeque sauce
19. Put the baking sheet in the oven and bake , undisturbed , for 20 minutes
20. Remove the chicken from the oven and use a pair of metal tings to turn the pieces to the other side
21. Use a pastry brush to coat the second side of the chicken with the barbeque sauce from the bowl
22. Do not reuse that bowl or brush again
23. Return the sheet to the oven and cook for an additional 15 to 20 minutes
24. Poke a thigh with the
25. And not pink
26. Turn the broiler on and broil for a minute until the chicken is charred on top
27. Warm the reserved barbeque sauce in a small saucepan over low heat
28. Pour into a serving bowl
29. Transfer the chicken to a serving platter and serve immediately with the warm sauce on the side

title: chocolate kahlua pie with pecans
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Beat sugar and butter in medium bowl until smooth
3. Beat in flour
4. Gradually beat in corn syrup , then kahla and vanilla
5. Mix in eggs , then chopped pecans
6. Sprinkle chocolate chips over bottom of crust
7. Pour filling into crust
8. Bake pie until filling is puffed around edges and just set in center , covering edge of crust if browning too quickly , about 45 minutes
9. Transfer pie to rack and cool completely
10. Beat cream in medium bowl until peaks form
11. Drop whipped cream in small dollops around edge of pie
12. Place pecan half atop each dollop , if desired

title: cream of parsnip and apple soup
steps:
1. Melt the butter , add the parsnips , apples , onions and sugar
2. Saut till soft
3. Add the curry powder , spices and garlic and cook for about 2 minutes , stirring well
4. Pour in the stock slowly , stirring until well mixed
5. Cover and simmer gently for 20 minutes , until the parsnips are tender
6. Taste for seasoning
7. Blend with a hand blender and add as much cream to thin to the consistency you like and reheat , do not boil
8. Garnish with parsley

title: soured milk cake
steps:
1. Cream butter and sugar , add eggs and beat well
2. Add flour , cocoa , raisins and milk
3. Lastly add vanilla and soda dissolved in a little boiling water
4. Bake in moderate oven until skewer comes out clean

title: no fat  no sugar low cal chocolate brownies
steps:
1. Heat oven to 180 degrees c and lightly spray a 4 by 8 inch cake tin
2. Mix the cocoa and water together in a heatproof bowl
3. Add the egg whites and vanilla and mix well
4. Separately stir together the flour , splenda , baking powder and salt
5. Add the powder mix to the cocoa mixture and combine the two together
6. Pour into the cake tin and bake for approx 20-25 minutes

title: grilled chicken satay salad
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f
2. Arrange tortilla strips in single layer on ungreased cookie sheet
3. Bake 7 to 11 minutes or until lightly browned
4. Meanwhile , make peanut satay dressing
5. Beat vinegar , peanut butter , peanuts , sugar , oils , soy sauce , ginger , and garlic in small bowl with whisk until smooth and creamy
6. Place chicken in resealable plastic bag
7. Add 3 tablespoons dressing
8. Seal bag
9. Turn to coat
10. Refrigerate 1 to 2 hours
11. Refrigerate remaining dressing
12. Brush grill rack with oil
13. Grill chicken covered , 10-15 minutes until juice is no longer pink
14. Cut chicken into strips
15. Toss remaining salad ingredients in large bowl
16. Toss with chicken and remaining dressing
17. Divide salad among 6 plates
18. Sprinkle with tortilla strips

title: greek mac and cheese
steps:
1. Put bread into the bowl of a food processor and pulse until finely ground
2. Put bread crumbs and 3 tablespoons butter into a small bowl and combine
3. Set aside
4. Bring a 6 quart pot of salted water to a boil
5. Add pasta and cook until cooked halfway through , about 3 minutes
6. Drain pasta , rinse with cold water , and set aside
7. Heat the remaining butter in a 4 quart saucepan over medium heat
8. Add flour and cook , whisking constantly , for 1 minute
9. Still whisking constantly , slowly drizzle in milk and cook until sauce has thickened and coats the back of a spoon , 10 to 15 minutes
10. Remove pan from the heat
11. Stir in cheese , cinnamon , and nutmeg and season with salt and pepper
12. Set bechamel sauce aside
13. Heat oven to 350
14. Heat oil in a 5-qt
15. Pot over medium heat
16. Add shallots and bell peppers and cook , stirring often , until soft , 3 to 4 minutes
17. Add spinach and scallions and cook , covered , stirring occasionally , until wilted , about 3 minutes
18. Stir in the reserved bechamel sauce , the dill , and the reserved pasta and move the mixture to a 9" x 13" baking dish
19. Sprinkle evenly with reserved bread crumbs and the feta
20. Bake until golden brown and bubbly , about 30 minutes
21. Let cool for 10 minutes before serving

title: chicken  thighs with cinnamon and lemon
steps:
1. Heat the olive oil in a saucepan and gently fry the celery , carrot , onion , garlic , rosemary and bay leaves until golden , about 15 minutes
2. Remove the rosemary sprig and bay leaves and season with salt and freshly ground black pepper
3. Add the grated lemon zest
4. Set to one side
5. Meanwhile , for the chicken , mix the flour with the salt and freshly ground black pepper and coat the chicken pieces in this mixture
6. Heat the olive oil in a frying pan and fry the chicken until golden brown
7. Add the wine and cook for five minutes
8. Add the chicken and wine reduction to the soffritto , then add half the lemon juice and cinnamon
9. Stir well
10. Add the stock and cook on a low heat for about 45 minutes , or until the sauce has reduced and the chicken is completely cooked through
11. Keep the pan covered for the first 30 minutes of cooking
12. Remove the cinnamon sticks , then mix the egg yolk with the remaining lemon juice
13. Quickly but carefully stir this mixture into the sauce until blended
14. Serve immediately

title: damson plum jam
steps:
1. Wash and pick over the plums
2. Combine the plums and the water
3. Bring to a boil and cook 15 minutes , stirring constantly
4. Allow to cool enough to handle - or completely , if you like - and fish out the pits
5. Return the pulp to the rest of the jam once the pits are out
6. Meanwhile , put the jars into a canning kettle and cover with water to one inch above the tops of the jars
7. Bring to a boil , boil 10 minutes to sterilize
8. Return the plums to the jam kettle , and bring them back to the boil
9. Add the sugar to the plums , stirring to dissolve
10. Boil to jam stage , about 20 minutes
11. Test for the gelling point with one of the following methods: temperature test use a jelly or candy thermometer , and boil until mixture reaches the following temperatures at altitudes of: sea level to 1 , 000 feet 104c / 220f
12. 1 , 001 feet to 2 , 000 feet 103c / 218f
13. Sheet or spoon test dip a cool metal spoon into the boiling jelly mixture
14. Raise the spoon out of the steam , about 12 inches above the pan
15. Turn the spoon so the liquid runs off the side
16. The jelly is done when the syrup forms two drops that flow together and sheet or hang off the edge of the spoon
17. I like the"sheet" test
18. As the jam cooks , remove any pits you may have missed
19. Remove from the heat and stir and skim 5 minutes
20. Pour into hot sterilized jars and seal with lids sterilized according to the manufacturers directions
21. Place jars of jam back in boiling water bath and boil for 5 minutes
22. Let cool , and store when the jars have sealed

title: waffle ice cream sandwiches with the works
steps:
1. If using peanut butter , fluff or preserves spread a thin layer on one waffle
2. Place the ice cream inside the waffles
3. Then roll the optional garnishes along sides of the ice cream
4. And enjoy !

title: apricot scones
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees
2. Grease cookie sheet
3. Mix baking mix , apricots , sugar , whipping cream and egg until dough forms
4. Turn onto surface dusted with baking mix , roll in baking mix to coat
5. Shape into ball , knead 10 times
6. Pat into 8 inch circle on cookie sheet
7. Brush with milk , sprinkle with sugar
8. Cut into 8 wedges
9. Bake 12 minutes or until golden brown , separate carefully
10. Serve warm

title: passionate dark sienna cookie
steps:
1. Bake at 350 degrees , 12-15 minutes , about three dozen cookies
2. To begin this healthy cookie recipe blend the dry ingredient , blend the wet ingredient
3. Combine wet and dry ingredient
4. Take a full teaspoon of dough , roll into a ball in palm of hand
5. If the dough will not form a ball add two more tablespoons of molasses
6. Place on aluminum foil or parchment paper about one and a half inch apart , flatten slightly , sprinkle top of cookie with water then sprinkle top with a hint of sugar
7. Bake at 350 for 12-15 minutes
8. Cool
9. The finished cookie is round and flattened when baked
10. The molasses makes the cookie a passionate dark sienna color and keeps the cookie soft
11. Very nice with pinot noir wine

title: cranberry pecan christmas scones
steps:
1. Combine first four ingredients in a large bowl
2. Cut in butter with a pastry blender until mixture is crumbly
3. Stir in cranberries and pecans
4. Combine 2 / 3 c milk and egg , stirring with a wire whisk in a small bowl
5. Gradually add milk mixture to flour mixture , stirring with a fork just until dry ingredients are moistened
6. Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface , and knead 3 or 4 times
7. Pat dough to 1-inch thickness
8. Cut with a 2-inch biscuit cutter
9. Place scones on a lightly greased baking sheet
10. Brush with 1 tb milk , and sprinkle with 2 tsp sugar
11. Bake at 400 degrees for 15 minutes or until barely golden
12. Cool slightly on a wire rack

title: pear  kiwi  berry  flax seed smoothie
steps:
1. Place ingredients in order starting with yogurt and ending with pear into a vita-mix or blender
2. Process till smooth and creamy
3. If using a blender grind seeds in a coffee grinder first

title: baked beans deluxe
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients
2. Pour in a 2 quart casserole
3. Cover
4. Bake 45 minutes at 400
5. Remove cover and bake 10 minutes longer

title: backpacker bars
steps:
1. Set oven to 350
2. Grease a 13 x 9" baking pan
3. Cream butter , with 1 cup brown sugar
4. Stir in oats , wheat flour , white flour , wheat germ and orange zest
5. Press mixture into bottom of prepared baking pan
6. Combine eggs , almonds , chocolate chips , raisins , coconut , and remaining 1 / 2 cup brown sugar
7. Mix gently , but thoroughly
8. Pour over butter mixture
9. Spread evenly
10. Bake for 30-35 minutes
11. Cool before cutting into bars

title: pasta seasoning mix
steps: 1. Combine all ingredients and store in an airtight container for up to six months

title: mango   yoghurt parfaits
steps:
1. Peel the mangoes and cut into large chunks
2. Place 1 / 2 cup in a blender with the orange juice and puree until smooth
3. Place a spoon of the chopped mango in the base of parfait glasses
4. Top with a spoon of the puree , then a layer of yoghurt and a drizzle of passionfruit
5. Repeat layers until all ingredients are used up , finishing with puree
6. Top with chopped macadamia nuts and serve immediately

title: roasted root vegetables with mustard
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Combine mustard , olive oil , mustard oil , thyme , paprika , cayenne pepper , sea salt and freshly ground black pepper together in large bowl
3. Whisk and add carrots , parsnips , potatoes , sweet potato and onions to bowl
4. Let stand 10 minutes and spread in one layer in large baking dish
5. Roast in 375f oven for 45- 50 minutes , gently turn vegetables every 15 minutes
6. Try not to break vegetables when turning

title: wasabi herbed mayonnaise
steps: 1. Mix all ingredients and enjoy !

title: grilled cheese grows up
steps:
1. Arrange chicken , pesto , and cheese between the two slices of bread
2. Spread outsides of sandwich with margarine
3. Cook sandwich in a non-stick skillet on medium-high heat for about 3 minutes per side , or until cheese is melted and bread is golden brown

title: apple doughnuts  baked
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. In a mixing bowl , combine flour , baking powder , salt , nutmeg and sugar
3. Cut in shortening
4. Mix in egg , milk and apples
5. Fill greased muffing pans or doughnut baking pan 2 / 3 full with batter
6. Bake for 20-25 minutes
7. While they are still warm , roll in 1 / 2 cup melted butter and then roll in cinnamon-sugar

title: german puffed apple pancake
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 450
2. Beat eggs , milk , flour and salt , and baking powder
3. Add 1 / 2 cup peeled sliced apples
4. Melt 2 tbs butter in 10 inch cast iron skillet until hot
5. Do not burn butter !
6. Add egg mixture and place in pre-heated oven
7. Bake 15 minutes
8. Peel and slice remaining apples in large bowl and dust with cinnamon and nutmeg
9. Melt 1 / 2 stick butter in large fry pan , add sugar , when mixture bubbles , stir in apples and cook until buzzer goes off
10. Turn oven temp to 350 add apples to puffed pancake and cook for 10 minutes
11. Yummy ! serve with maple syrup

title: skillet mac   beef
steps:
1. Cook beef and onion in a medium skillet over medium heat until beef is no longer pink , stirring to separate meat
2. Drain
3. Add soup , ketchup , worcestershire sauce and pasta
4. Reduce heat to low and heat thoroughly

title: godden s world famous chili con carne with beans
steps:
1. Put beef broth or buillon on low heat to simmer
2. While broth heats up , brown ground beef and drain excess fat , add to broth
3. While beef is browning , chop onion , add to broth
4. Add tomato paste , chili beans to broth
5. Add garlic , chili powder , oregano , basil , cumin
6. Add red peppers , salt , pepper , if desired
7. Simmer at least 2 hours
8. Serve with grated cheese on top
9. You can omit the red pepper and / or change the chili powder to teaspoons , if you like yours milder

title: x rated rita
steps:
1. In a blender add x-rated liqueur , tequilla , sweet and sour , lime juice and desired amount of ice
2. Set to crush , or until the consistecy desired for a margarita - may turn watery if you over blend though
3. Pour into margarita glass and topwith a splash of 7-up and a lime wedge for garnish
4. Enjoy !
5. )

title: carrabba s spiedino di mare
steps:
1. If using bamboo skewers , soak in water 1 / 2 hour
2. Season scallops and shrimp with salt and pepper
3. Lightly coat with olive oil , then dip in seasoned bread crumbs
4. Skewer and grill on both sides
5. Melt lemon butter and serve with seafood
6. Sprinkle chopped parsley on top

title: easy oven meatballs
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit
2. Combine milk , onion , eggs and salt
3. Stir in bread crumbs and let stand for 5 minutes
4. Crumble in the ground meat , and mix thoroughly with your hands
5. Threaten to touch someone with your gross meat-covered hands
6. Shape into 8 dozen small meatballs 1 to 1 1 / 2 inches in diameter
7. Place on baking pans and bake for 20 to 30 minutes , or until done- if you're not sure , cut one in half to check
8. If you don't have enough oven space or baking pans to bake all of this at once , please put the remaining raw meat mixture in the refrigerator until you can bake it
9. Let's be careful out there
10. Of course , using lean meat is the healthiest , but if the meat you're using is particularly fatty , i have found that baking the meatballs on a rack placed over a broiler pan or other shallow pan will allow most of the fat to drip away
11. If you do this , it's best to put a little water in the bottom of the pan or the fat may start to smoke
12. I do this in the oven , not the broiler
13. If you do try broiling meatballs , let me know how it turns out , for you are braver than i
14. Meatballs to die for- this is an idea my husband came up with
15. Put your already baked meatballs in a baking dish
16. The more shallow the pan , the shorter time this will need to bake
17. Now , take a can of cream of mushroom soup , and a can of cream of shrimp soup
18. Mix them together , and add about 1 / 2 cup milk , just enough to let you mix it smoothly
19. Pour the soup mixture over the meatballs evenly
20. Bake this at 350 for about an hour
21. You want the sauce to get real thick and rich
22. We usually serve this over rice , but it can go over noodles or mashed potatoes , or on bread or a roll for a hot sandwich
23. I have also made it in a crockpot , cooking it on low for about 8 hours
24. Cooking on high turns this to mush
25. Still tastes good , but not pretty for serving to guests
26. This dish has been taken to many potlucks and served to guests numerous times , and there has never once been any leftovers-- so i can't say how it tastes re-heated !
27. Other ideas of course , it goes without saying that these are a perfectly easy way to make spaghetti and meatballs
28. Make your sauce and gently heat the meatballs with the sauce
29. Using that same sauce , or using pizza sauce , or barbecue sauce , serve the meatballs on hoagie / submarine / poorboy / grinder8 rolls , with sauce and cheese of your choice
30. Heat in a sweet and sour sauce and serve on toothpicks as hors d'oerve or over steamed rice
31. A friend of mine used to make a simple barbecue sauce by mixing a jar of currant jelly with a bottle of chili sauce
32. Warm meatballs in this mixture , or use my bobbie-q sauce recipe , and serve over in sandwich rolls , or over hot cooked rice , potatoes or noodles
33. On a hors d'oerve buffet , you can serve plain hot meatballs with an assortment of sauces for dipping
34. Provide toothpicks and small plates
35. As you can see , easy oven meatballs in your freezer mean quick and easy meals !
36. You'll come up with plenty more ideas to use these versatile , mildly seasoned morsels

title: shrimp  scallop and sausage jambalaya
steps:
1. In a large skillet , heat the oil over medium heat
2. Add the onion , celery , and bell pepper and cook , stirring often , until the onion is softened , about 5 minutes
3. Add the rice and garlic and cook , stirring constantly , for 1 minute
4. Transfer the mixture to a 3 1 / 2 quart slow cooker
5. Add the tomato juice , clam juice , water , worcestershire sauce , thyme , oregano , salt , black and cayenne peppers , and break up the tomatoes with the side of a spoon
6. Cover and slow cook until the rice is barely tender , 5 to 6 hours on low
7. Meanwhile , in a medium skillet over medium heat , cook the sausage , turning often , until browned , about 5 minutes
8. During the last 15 minutes of cooking , stir the sausage , shrimp and scallops into the jambalaya
9. Increase the heat to high cover , and cook just until the shellfish are firm
10. Serve immediately

title: just a pizza salad  no salad on crust   no pasta   just salad
steps:
1. Cheese -- in a small pan , add the cheese , store bought dressing and a pinch of the red pepper flakes
2. Just toss to make sure everything is well combined
3. Cover with plastic wrap and marinate 1 hour to all day
4. Longer the better
5. Dressing -- another easy component of this salad
6. Make the day before
7. In a small measuring cup or bowl , mix the tomato juice , tomato paste , olive oil , red wine vinegar , lemon juice , garlic , and fresh basil
8. Just set to the side until you are ready to use
9. Crust -- in a small measuring cup or bowl , add the olive oil , pepper , and oregano and brush on a store bought pizza crust
10. Top with the grated cheese and bake according to package directions until crusty golden brown
11. Salad -- while your pizza crust is browning up - make your salad
12. To a large bowl , add the lettuce , onion , pepperoni , ham , red peppers , and olives
13. Remove the mozzarella from the marinade with a slotted spoon and add to the salad
14. You don't want any of the marinade in your salad
15. Then top with some of the tomato dressing and toss well
16. Cut the pizza crust with your pizza wheel and add the warm cheesy dough to the salad
17. You can cut it as small as you want , almost like a bread salad , or you can cut it in wedges
18. I personally cut mine in 1" pieces
19. Toss well
20. Serve -- nothing more needed
21. It is just a really nice salad
22. Last time i served this with a side of roasted corn chowder to my friends
23. Great dinner and it is best just served family style which makes it great for company

title: camping burgers in foil
steps:
1. Separate meat into 4 patties
2. Place each patty in the center of a square of foil
3. Top with equal portions of sliced carrots , potatoes and peppers
4. Season with dehydrated onions , worcestershire sauce , salt and pepper
5. Seal foil
6. Check for leaks
7. Place on hot coals for 12 to 15 minutes
8. Turn and cook an additional 10-15 minutes

title: dan s favorite mac and cheese
steps:
1. Cook the pasta until 'al dente' on the package directions
2. Meanwhile , melt the butter , then add the flour and cook until the mixture loosens , like a regular roux
3. Add the dry mustard , salt and paprika
4. Add the milk and simmer about 10 minutes , until thickened
5. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees
6. Toss the cheeses together
7. Place 1 / 2 of the pasta in a large casserole , sprinkle with 1 / 2 of the cheeses , then with 1 / 2 of the cream sauce
8. Then layer the rest of the pasta , the rest of the cream sauce and top with the rest of the cheeses
9. Bake in the bottom third of the oven for approximately 1 hour , or until the casserole is nice and bubbly with browning around the edges
10. Let rest 5-10 minutes before serving

title: baked eggs in tomato cups
steps:
1. Herbs: oregano , chervil , basil , sage , mrs
2. Dash
3. Preheat oven to 425f while slicing tomatoes
4. Remove tops the scoop out seeds and pulp
5. Place in a shallow baking dish , sprinkle with a bit of salt or mrs dash [i used italian] , fresh ground pepper and put in a pinch of the parmesan cheese
6. Crack the egg into the tomato
7. Sprinkle with pepper , salt or mrs
8. Dash , other herbs and a tiny bit of parmesan
9. Bake for 20 minutes for soft yolks and 30 to 35 for hard
10. During the last 4 minutes place two slices of the cheddar cheese in a cross pattern on top
11. Melt and let brown
12. When i removed i put a small amount of fresh chives on top of the cheese
13. Serves 8

title: smoked salmon   avocado baked eggs
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees f
2. Halve all of the avocados and remove pits
3. Place avocados on a baking sheet and fill the holes with strips of smoked salmon
4. Crack an egg into each hole , making sure the yolk remains intact
5. If all of the egg white doesn't fit into the hole , leave some out
6. Top each egg with salt and fresh black pepper
7. Bake eggs for 15 minutes or until whites are set
8. Garnish with red chili flakes and fresh dill
9. Serve with toast

title: beaujolais steak for two
steps:
1. Set a heavy-bottomed frying pan over medium heat
2. When hot , add butter and tilt pan to coat
3. When bubbly , add steaks and fry until well browned , about 3 minutes per side for rare or 5 minutes per side for medium steaks
4. Remove steaks to heated plates
5. Pour wine into pan juices and increase heat to medium-high
6. Scrape all brown bits from bottom of pan
7. Stir in salsa and boil gently , stirring often , until mixture is thick enough to coat steaks , about 2 to 3 minutes
8. Pour over steaks

title: quick chocolate sauce
steps:
1. Put chips in a microwave safe saucepan with butter on top
2. Microwave on medium for 2 minutes , then stir
3. Continue cooking at medium heat for 20 second increments then stirring until smooth
4. Add a spoonful of sour cream and stir well
5. Stir in the rest of the sour cream till well blended
6. Spoon over ice cream
7. Yum !

title: creole coleslaw
steps:
1. Combine mayonnaise , parsley , vinegar , sugar , mustard , celery seeds and hot pepper sauce in large bowl
2. Add cabbage , onions , celery and tomato
3. Mix slaw
4. Make sure dressing evenly coats vegetables
5. Chill at least 2 hours or as long as 6 hours
6. Before serving , stir well and adjust seasonings

title: salmon macaroni scallop
steps:
1. Cook macaroni according to directions on box
2. Grease a casserole dish
3. Melt in saucepan 4 tblsp butter
4. Remove from heat and blend in flour , salt , pepper , dry mustard , grated onion and nutmeg
5. Gradually stir in 2 cups milk and cook the sauce , stirring constantly until smoothly thickened
6. Add the shredded cheese to the sauce
7. Stir in the macaroni , celery and the flaked salmon
8. Turn into prepared casserole
9. Melt the 1 tblsp butter and add the bread cubes
10. Use to border casserole
11. Bake in preheated 350 degree oven about 30 minutes

title: martha stewart s beef bourguignon
steps:
1. In a 6-8 quart saucepan with tightly fitted lid , cook bacon uncovered over medium-low heat , until browned , 10-15 minutes
2. With slotted spoon transfer bacon to paper towel to drain
3. Set aside
4. Reserve bacon fat
5. Season beef generously with salt and pepper
6. In large bowl , dredge beef in flour , shaking off the excess
7. Raise heat to medium
8. Working in 2 batches , brown beef in bacon fat on all sides , without crowding , about 10 minutes per batch
9. Transfer each batch to a bowl
10. Pour water into pan and bring to boil
11. Cook , stirring to loosen browned bits , until liquid has reduced to a few tablespons , about 2-3 minutes
12. Add onions and garlic
13. Cook , stirring , until sightly softened , 3 minutes
14. Add tomato paste and cook one minute
15. Add carrots , meat with juices , wine , thyme and reserved bacon
16. Bring to a boil
17. Reduce heat , cover and simmer over low heat , stirring occasionally , until meat is tender but not falling apart , about 3 to 3 1 / 2 hours
18. Skim fat off surface of stew and discard
19. Serve or refrigerate covered , overnight

title: honey citrus cooler
steps:
1. Pour boiling water over tea bags , steep for 5 minutes , remove tea bags and stir in honey
2. Add cold water and fruit juices , chill for 1 hour
3. Put ice cubes into 4 tall glasses , add soda to tea mixture and pour over ice cubes
4. Garnish each glass with lemon half and maraschino cherry skewered on a toothpick

title: garbanzo noodle soup
steps:
1. Bring everything except noodles and cream of celery soup to a boil
2. Drop noodles into this boiling mixture
3. Let it simmer 15 to 25 minutes until the noodles are cooked through
4. Stir occansionally during this time
5. Turn off the stove and stir in 1 / 2 of the 10 3 / 4oz can of cream of celery soup
6. Salt to taste and enjoy !

title: monterey cheese and chicken tortillas
steps:
1. Cube or grate the cheese
2. Saute onion and garlice in butter for 5 minutes
3. Add tomatoes and spices
4. Bring to boil and simmer uncovered 20 minutes
5. Blend liquid from mushrooms with flour
6. Stir into tomato mixture
7. Add mushrooms , olives and chicken
8. Cook stirring until thick
9. Divide chicken mixture between the 8 tortillas and sprinkle the 1 cup of cheese between them
10. Roll and place in dish seam side down and top with the remaining cheese
11. Place under broiler until cheese melts
12. Serve

title: crab   swiss casserole
steps:
1. Split the english muffins with a fork , and spread 3 tbsp softened butter on them
2. Grease a 2 quart rectangular baking dish and set is half of the muffins , buttered side up
3. In a separate bow , fold together crabmeat , cheeses , and capers
4. Evenly distribute crab-cheese mixture on top of the muffins
5. Put remaining muffin halves over mixture to cover
6. In a pan , sautee onion in the remaining 1 tbsp of butter for 4-6 minutes until cooked
7. Add the sherry and the worcestershire sauce to the onion and bring to a boil
8. Remove from heat
9. In a separate bowl stir together the eggs , milk , mustard , parsley , and salt and pepper to taste
10. Put the egg mixture over the muffins and press down on the muffins to help the egg mixture moisten them
11. Cover and put in the refrigerator overnight
12. The next day , preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
13. Bake uncovered for 50-60 minutes or until a knife inserted near the middle comes out clean
14. Let stand a few minutes before serving

title: stir fried pork with broccoli and cashews
steps:
1. Spray non-stick skillet with cooking spray and place over medium heat
2. Add onion and cook 8 minutes , stirring occasionally
3. Remove from pan and set aside
4. Recoat pan with cooking spray and stir fry broccoli 3 minutes
5. Add broccoli to onion
6. Spray pan again and fry pork and red pepper for 4 minutes or until pork loses its pink color
7. Reduce heat
8. Stir in the green onions , sugar , ginger , and garlic and cook 30 seconds
9. Stir in onion and broccoli
10. Add chicken broth and soy sauce
11. Cook 1 minute
12. Drizzle with sesame oil and sprinkle with cashews
13. Serve over rice

title: toffee strawberries
steps:
1. Dissolve the sugar in the water in a small , heavy saucepan and boil without stirring - just swirl the pan around until the sugar syrup turns a golden caramel colour
2. Remove from the heat and dip strawberries into te syrup , holding them by the stalk
3. Leave to harden on a non-stick baking paper
4. This also works well with cherries

title: bacon cheese frittata
steps:
1. In a bowl , beat eggs , milk , butter , salt , and pepper
2. Pour into a greased 11x7x2" baking dish
3. Sprinkle with onions , bacon , and cheese
4. Bake uncovered at 350 for 25 to 30 minutes or until a knife inserted near the center comes out clean

title: spanish peasant bread
steps:
1. Dissolve yeast in 2 / 3 c water
2. Combine with salt , sugar , 2c water and 5 c flour
3. Beat 5 minutes
4. Add enough remaining flour , beating with wooden spoon , until dough is soft
5. Knead vigorously for 5 minutes
6. Place in a large greased bowl and brush top with melted butter
7. Cover and allow to rise until double
8. Punch down
9. Form into 1 large or 2 small oblong rolls
10. Place on lightly greased baking sheet that has been sprinkled with cornmeal
11. Brush with egg yolk glaze and sprinkle with poppy seeds or sesame seeds
12. Put bread in cold oven and turn oven temperature to 400 dg
13. Bake for 45-50 minutes
14. The bread will rise with the temperature

title: shirataki noodle and tuna bake
steps:
1. Drain noodles
2. Cut into pieces , and parboil for 2 minutes to rid of odor
3. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
4. Spray casserole with butter flavored non-stick spray
5. Mix noodles , tuna , soup , and seasonings , and pour into casserole
6. Add breadcrumbs to top if desired
7. Bake 30 minues

title: spicy moroccan butter
steps:
1. Place the scallions , garlic , ground spices , herbs , and 1 / 8 teaspoons salt in a food processor and process to form a slightly rough paste
2. Stir paste into the butter with the lime juice
3. Add to pasta , beans , rice , soup , vegetables , etc
4. Enjoy !

title: vanilla muffins
steps:
1. Combine sugar and egg , beat well
2. Combine flour and baking powder
3. Add to sugar mixture , alternately with the milk , beginning and ending with the flour mixture , beating well after each addition
4. Stir in butter and vanilla
5. Spoon into greased muffin pans , filling 2 / 3 full
6. Combine sugar and cinnamon and sprinkle evenly over muffins
7. Bake at 375f for 15-20 minutes

title: jamba juice peach pleasure
steps: 1. Combine all ingredients in blender and blend on high until all the ice is crushed and the drink is smooth

title: shortcut strawberry shortcake
steps:
1. In a large bowl , whisk milk and pudding mix for 2 minutes
2. Let stand for 2 minutes or until soft-set
3. Set aside
4. Slice the twinkies in half lengthwise
5. Place filling side up in an ungreased 13x9x2 inch dish
6. Spread the pudding over the top of the sliced twinkies
7. Arrange sliced strawberries over the pudding and then spread the whipped topping over the strawberries
8. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour before cutting
9. Garnish with strawberry halves if desired
10. Refrigerate any leftovers

title: mexican shrimp in green bean sauce
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a large saute pan or dutch oven over medium-low heat
2. Add onion and garlic and saute until softened , about 5 minutes
3. Add the tomatoes and cook for another 2 minutes
4. Add the green beans , spices , chipotle , adobo sauce and fish stock
5. Bring to a boil , then reduce heat to simmer
6. Simmer for 5 to 10 minutes to allow flavors to meld
7. Add shrimp
8. Stir and cook for 1 to 2 minutes
9. Remove pan from heat , cover and allow shrimp to stand until they turn bright pink
10. Garnish each portion with the cilantro
11. Serve immediately with a lime wedge on the side
12. This is good served with rice and warm corn tortillas to soak up the juice , refried beans and sliced avocado

title: lemon lentil soup
steps:
1. Presoak lentils and rinse or directly boil
2. Bring to boil the 4 cups of water and reduce to medium
3. Add the lentil and start to cook for 15 minutes on medium
4. Add stock and cook further
5. Simultaneously in a fry pan heat olive oil and add all spices and vegetable and cook on high for 3 - 5 minutes
6. Add wine and deglaze pan
7. Add tomatoes and lemon rind
8. Once tomatoes soften combine the mixture with the now boiling lentil and stock and cook until lentil reaches its desired tenderness

title: fruited marshmallow dessert
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients together except marshmallows
2. Mix well
3. Add marshmallows
4. Stir until well coated
5. Chill overnight
6. You will not want to skip this step
7. It does make a difference
8. Serve

title: 24 hour chicken casserole
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients except crackers and butter
2. Put mixture in greased baking dish and let sit in refrigerator for 24 hours
3. Remove from refrigerator and let sit at room temperature for 30 minutes
4. Meanwhile , mix crushed crackers and melted butter
5. Spoon cracker mixture over chicken mixture
6. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes

title: natali s amaretto cookies
steps:
1. Cream butter and sugar
2. Beat in egg and liquor slowly
3. Add flour slowly and mix well
4. Lay out saran wrap
5. Place dough in center work to get dough into log shape wrap in saran wrap and work dough into a rectangular log about 2x1 inches
6. Put in refrigerator until stiff or overnight
7. Cut thin slices off cold log and place on greased cookie sheet
8. Bake at 350 for 8 - 10 minutes
9. Let cool
10. Mix 1 cup powdered sugar and 3 tablespoons amaretto together until smooth
11. Cover cookie and top with pecan
12. Let set up and place on tray to enjoy
13. Mix more icing as needed

title: mini pain au chocolat
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degree f and butter a large baking sheet
2. Cut the chocolate into eighteen 2-by 1 / 2-inch pieces
3. Carefully unfold pastry sheet and roll out on a lightly floured surface with a floured rolling pin to form a 12-1 / 2-inch square
4. Trim edges of pastry with a pizza cutter or sharp knife to form a 12-inch square
5. Cut pastry into three 4-inch strips
6. Cut strips crosswise to make eighteen 2- by 4-inch rectangles
7. Working with 1 rectangles at a time , brush top with egg wash and place 1 piece of chocolate 1 inch from short end of rectangle and roll up pastry over chocolate to encase chocolate and form a log
8. Press edge of pastry to seal , leaving ends of log open , and arrange pastry seam sides down on baking sheet
9. Brush tops of pastry with some of egg wash
10. Repeat with remaining pastry and chocolate in same manner , and freeze pastry on baking sheet until firm , about 10 minutes
11. Now , bake pastries in middle of oven until puffed and golden brown on top , about 10 minutes
12. Transfer with a metal spatula to wire racks to cool
13. Dust tops of pastries with confectioners' sugar

title: german style potato supper
steps:
1. In large skillet , brown sausage
2. Stir in potatoes , 3 / 4 cup water and bouillon
3. Bring to a boil
4. Cover and simmer 10 minutes
5. In small bowl , combine remaining 1 / 4 cup water , lemon juice , sugar , cornstarch and dry mustard
6. Mix well
7. Pour over meat mixture
8. Simmer uncovered 5 minutes until thick and bubbly
9. Serve immediately

title: spicy italian meatballs
steps:
1. Cut the sausages in half and squeeze the meat out onto a mixing bowl
2. Mix ground beef with sausage meat with hands
3. Mix cayenne pepper , garlic salt , cilantro , onion
4. Parmesan cheese and basil with the meat mixture
5. Mix thoroughly
6. Beat eggs in a separate bowl
7. Pour eggs into the meat while adding bread crumbs
8. Add bread crumbs till the meat mixture is firm
9. Make 1 inch meatballs with hands
10. Fry meatballs in olive oil until brown
11. Enjoy with pasta sauce

title: sweet roll dough
steps:
1. Mix water and yeast in large mixing bowl
2. Stir until dissolved
3. Add milk , sugar salt , eggs , shortening and 1 / 2 of the flour
4. Mix until smooth and pour out onto floured surface
5. Knead while adding the additional flour
6. Knead until smooth and elastic
7. Round up in greased bowl with greased side up
8. Cover with damp cloth
9. Let rise in warm place until double
10. Punch down
11. Let rise again until almost double
12. Dough is ready to to make into cinnamon rolls or dinner rolls now

title: how to cook spaghetti squash
steps:
1. Pierce the whole shell several times with a large fork or skewer and place in baking dish
2. Cook squash in preheated 375f oven approximately 1 to 1-1 / 2 hours or until flesh is tender , it took about 1 1 / 2 hours for mine to tender up
3. Heat a pot of water large enough to hold the whole squash
4. When the water is boiling , drop in the squash and cook for 20 to 30 minutes , depending on its size
5. When a fork goes easily into the flesh , the squash is done
6. Cut squash in half lengthwise
7. Remove seeds
8. Place squash cut sides up in a microwave dish with 1 / 4 cup water
9. Cover with plastic wrap and cook on high for 10 to 12 minutes , depending on size of squash
10. Add more cooking time if necessary
11. Let stand covered , for 5 minutes
12. With fork "comb" out the strands
13. Choose a smaller spaghetti squash so that it will fit
14. Add 2 cups of water to slow cooker
15. Pierce the whole shell several times with a large fork or skewer , add to crock pot , cover and cook on low for 8 to 9 hours
16. Once the squash is cooked , let it cool for 10 to 20 minutes so it will be easier to handle , before cutting in half and removing the seeds
17. Pull a fork lengthwise through the flesh to separate it into long strands ,
18. You can do these steps ahead of time , then prepare any of the spaghetti squash recipes whenever the mood strikes
19. Buying & storing
20. When buying spaghetti squash , look for hard fruit that is heavy for its size , about eight to nine inches in length and four to five inches in diameter and with a pale even color
21. Avoid any squash with soft spots and green color is a sign of immaturity
22. The average four-pound spaghetti squash will yield about five cups
23. Spaghetti squash can be stored at room temperature for about a month
24. After cutting , wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate up to 2 days
25. Spaghetti squash also freezes well
26. Pack cooked squash into freezer bags , seal , label and freeze
27. Partially thaw before re-using , then steam until tender but still firm , about 5 minutes

title: white rice   chicken casserole
steps:
1. Combine the first 6 ingredients , spread in bottom of a casserole dish
2. Place chicken on top
3. Cover with tin foil and bake @ 325 for 2 hours
4. Take off the tin foil for hte last 40 minutes
5. If casserole gets dry , add water

title: tomatoes  feta and black olives bruschetta
steps:
1. In a bowl , mix tomatoes , feta , olives , chive and oil
2. Add salt and pepper
3. Brush toasted slices of baguette with olive oil
4. Spread the topping on the slices
5. And it's ready to serve

title: algerian chicken stew
steps:
1. In a large saucepan combine broth , bouillon , chopped chicken , onion , green beans , carrots , cumin , basil , garlic , bay leaves , parsley , salt and pepper
2. Bring to a boil
3. Reduce heat , cover and cook about 8 minutes
4. Add tomatoes and zucchini and cook briefly
5. Add garbanzo beans and red pepper
6. Cover and cook until heated through
7. Serve over steaming bowls of couscous

title: nif s easy grilled asparagus spears
steps:
1. Trim off the tough bottom of the spear by grasping each end and bending it gently until it snaps at its natural point of tenderness - usually two thirds of the way down the spear
2. Place asparagus on a plate and drizzle oil over spears
3. Sprinkle with salt and then mix spears with your hands to coat
4. Place aspargus on medium-hot grill , horizontally so they won't fall through the grates
5. Occasionally roll spears with the back of a spatula so they rotate and cook all around
6. As they caramelize , asparagus should begin to brown in spots but should not be allowed to blacken or char
7. They are done when slightly wilted
8. Remove from grill and sprinkle with parmesan
9. Serve immediately

title: cranberry port sauce
steps:
1. Bring port and cinnamon stick to boil in a saucepan
2. Reduce heat to medium , add dried cranberries and cook 3-5 minutes
3. Add fresh berries , water , sugar
4. Bring back to boil until sugar dissolves , then lower to simmer , cover and cook 15-20 minutes , stirring frequently
5. Discard cinnamon stick and serve at room temperature

title: scallops   mushrooms  in sour cream
steps:
1. Melt the butter in a saucepan and add the mushrooms and shallots , saute for 2-3 minutes
2. Season and add the scallops , sour cream , curry powder and lemon juice
3. Cook for a further 2 minutes and thicken with cornflour is desired

title: sweet chilli fish parcels
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180c
2. Tear off 4 pieces of foil about 40cm long and place on a flat work surface and top each piece with a piece of baking paper
3. Combine chilli sauce , oyster sauce and sesame oil in a small jug
4. At centre of each piece of paper , place a quarter of the bok choy , carrot and capsicum and top with the fish and then drizzle with sauce mixture and then top with the ginger and fold to make a parcel
5. Place seam side down on a baking tray and bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until cooked
6. Place rice in a medium saucepan and wash under cold water until water runs clear and drain
7. Add coconut milk and 1 1 / 2 cups of water and cover with a titght fitting lid and bring to the boil , reduce hat and cook rice for 10 to 12 minutes or until liquid is alsmost absorbed
8. Remove rice from the heat and stand for 5 minutes
9. Fluff with a fork to separate grains
10. Remove fish from parcels and serve with rice and top with coriander

title: basic sweet crepes
steps:
1. Pour the batter into a pitcher or other container with a pouring lip
2. Cover with plastic wrap and let stand for 30 minutes or in refrigerate for up to 2 days
3. Place a nonstick or seasoned crepe pan over medium heat
4. Coat the pan with a little unsalted butter
5. Stir the batter and pour about 2 tablespoons into the pan , lifting the pan off the heat and tilting and rotating it so that the batter forms an even , very thin layer
6. Cook until the top is set and the underside is golden
7. Turn the crepe over , using a spatula or your fingers and cook until the second side is lightly browned
8. Remove the crepe to a piece of wax paper
9. Continue cooking the rest of the crepes , buttering the pan and stirring the batter before starting each one
10. Stack the finished crepes between sheets of wax paper
11. Use immediately or let cool , wrap airtight and freeze for up to 1 month

title: roasted red pepper and carrot hummus
steps:
1. Add baby carrots to food processor and pulse to mince well
2. Add remaining ingredients , except water
3. Process until all vegetables and beans are well blended and creamy
4. Process less time for a chunkier hummus
5. Add up to a 1 / 4 cup water , as needed , to create the desired consistency
6. The hummus will not dry out as much as hummus usually does when stored
7. This will keep for about a week in the fridge
8. I haven't yet tried freezing this recipe
9. Variation: add some dried dill weed , fresh thyme or basil , or another favorite herb
10. Cayenne pepper , jalapenos , chilis , or tabasco sauce can be added for a spicy version
11. Makes about 3 cups
12. Six 1 / 2 cup servings

title: roast corn on the cob
steps:
1. Remove husk and silk from corn
2. Place each ear of corn on a piece of aluminum foil
3. Add 1 tablespoon butter and 1 ice cube
4. Wrap securely , twisting ends to make handles for turning
5. Place corn on gril
6. Cook for 25 minutes , turning once
7. Season with salt and pepper and additional butter if desired

title: lemon risotto with grilled tiger shrimp
steps:
1. Pour the stock into a saucepan and place over medium heat , bring to a boil then reduce to a simmer
2. In another saucepan , heat half the oil and all the butter
3. Add the shallots and cook gently for 5 minutes , then add the rice and stir until well coated
4. Pour in the vermouth and stir until absorbed by the rice
5. Add a ladleful of hot stock , keep stirring the simmering rice until the liquid is almost completely absorbed
6. Now add another ladleful of stock and continue cooking , adding more stock only when the previous liquid has been completely absorbed
7. After 15 to 20 minutes , the rice will be creamy and cooked but still slightly al dente
8. Preheat the broiler and place the shrimp on a baking sheet , shell-side down
9. Season them with salt and pepper , then drizzle over the remaining olive oil
10. Broil the shrimp just until they turn opaque , 2 to 3 minutes
11. Stir the herbs , zest and juice (you should have about 2 / 3 cup into the rice
12. Season with salt and pepper , then divide the risotto between 6 plates and top with the cooked shrimp

title: cheremsha  siberian onion salad
steps:
1. Wash green onions and cut across in small pieces
2. Chop the eggs into small pieces and mix with green onions
3. Mix the sour cream and mayonaisse throughly , season to taste , and pour over onion and egg mixture
4. Serve cold

title: broccolini sauted with olive oil and garlic
steps:
1. Steam broccolini covered 3 minutes
2. Drain
3. Heat olive oil in large nonstick skillet over medium high heat
4. Add garlic
5. Saut 1 minutes or until garlic begins to turn golden
6. Add broccoli
7. Saut 3 minutes
8. Remove from heat
9. Sprinkle with salt
10. Toss well
11. You may substitute regular broccoli in this recipe , if desired

title: greek grilled pita salad
steps:
1. Preheat the grill
2. In a large bowl , whisk together the vinegar , olive oil , pepper flakes , garlic , salt , cheese and oregano
3. Set aside
4. Place the whole pitas on the hot grill and cook on each side for about 1 1 / 2 minutes , or until nice grill marks form and the pitas are toasty
5. Remove and cut each pita in half , and then into 1 inch strips
6. Add the tomatoes , onion , cucumber , olives , parsley and grilled pita strips to the bowl of vinaigrette and toss together well
7. Serve immediately

title: moomba cocktail
steps: 1. Shake all ingredients in a shaker & strain into a cocktail glass

title: tomato and kielbasa shortcake
steps:
1. Make biscuits:
2. Preheat oven to 425f
3. Sift together flour , cornmeal , baking powder , baking soda , salt , sugar into a bowl and blend in butter with your finger
4. Stir together sour cream and water , then stir into flour mixture with a fork until just combined
5. Drop dough in 4 evenly spaced mounds on a buttered baking sheet and bake in the middle of oven until pale and golden and cooked through - 15 to 20 minutes
6. Cool biscuits slightly on a rack
7. Make filling while biscuits bake:
8. Brown kielbasa in a large heavy skillet over moderate heat , turning it and transfer it to a bowl with a slotted spoon
9. Our off all but 1 tablespoons fat from skillet , then cook the tomatoes , onion and jalapeno , stirring , until tomatoes are softened , 1 to 2 minutes
10. Toss tomato mixture with kielbasa and stir in cilantro , lime juice , and salt to taste
11. Split warm biscuits and spoon filling and sour cream onto bottom halves
12. Put tops on biscuits

title: chocolat chaud a la moi  ev s hot chocolate
steps:
1. Place the chocolate and half the milk in a pan and heat , stirring , until the chocolate has melted
2. Dissolve the cornstarch in the remaining milk and whisk into the chocolate with the sugar and vanilla extract
3. Cook on low heat , whisking constantly , until the chocolate is thickened , about five minutes
4. Add extra cornstarch if it doesn't start to thicken after 5 minutes
5. Remove and whisk smooth

title: amber crab souffle
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Brush 6 individual ramekins with melted butter
3. Whisk together eggs , milk , salt , pepper and dill
4. Stir in crab and cheese , but be gentle--don't break up the lumps of crab
5. Pour mixture in ramekins
6. Sprinkle with paprika
7. Bake 40-45 minutes

title: garlic chicken and corn stir fry
steps:
1. Place chicken in small bowl
2. Add soy sauce , garlic and black pepper
3. Stir to coat
4. Marinate 15 minutes at room temperature
5. Meanwhile , stir chicken broth and onion powder into cornstarch in small bowl until smooth
6. Set aside
7. Heat oil in wok over high heat
8. Reduce heat to medium-high
9. Add chicken
10. Stir-fry 2 minutes
11. Add bell pepper and celery
12. Stir-fry 2 minutes
13. Add corn
14. Cook and stir 3 minutes
15. Stir in cornstarch mixture
16. Cook and stir over high heat until mixture boils and slightly thickens
17. Serve over rice

title: chicken with red pepper sauce
steps:
1. In a shallow bowl , lightly beat the egg
2. In another shallow bowl , combine bread crumbs and salt
3. Dip chicken in egg , then coat with crumbs
4. In a large skillet , cook chicken in oil over medium heat for 6-8 minutes on each side or until juices run clear
5. Meanwhile , in a blender or food processor , combine the red peppers and italian seasoning
6. Cover and process until pureed
7. Transfer to a microwave-safe bowl
8. Cover and microwave on high for 1-2 minutes or until heated through , stirring once
9. Spoon over chicken
10. Sprinkle with feta cheese

title: ajlouk qura a  mashed zucchini salad
steps:
1. Place zucchini in a large saucepan
2. Cover with water to 1 inch above zucchini
3. Bring to a boil , and cook 20 minutes or until zucchini is very tender
4. Drain
5. While zucchini is still in colander , coarsely mash zucchini with a fork
6. Drain
7. Combine juice and next 6 ingredients in a bowl
8. Stir with a whisk
9. Add zucchini
10. Toss well
11. Sprinkle with cheese
12. Serve with pita bread
13. Yield: 8 servings

title: bisquick dumplings
steps:
1. In a medium bowl add bisquick mix and milk stirring until a soft dough forms
2. Drop mixture by spoonfuls onto boiling stew and reduce heat
3. Cook dumplings uncovered for 10 minutes
