4. Cover pot and cook an additional 10 minutes
5. Serve immediately

title: juicy pork chops
steps:
1. Place each pork chop in a baking dish
2. Top with onions and lemon slices on each
3. Mix together rest of ingredients and spread on each chop
4. Cover and bake on a 350 oven for 1 1 / 2 hour
5. Remove foil for last 15 minutes

title: the oak grill popover
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Lightly coat popover pans or deep muffin tins with nonstick cooking spray and heat pans in oven for at least 15 minutes
3. In a large bowl , using an electric mixer on medium speed , beat eggs until frothy
4. Add milk and melted butter and mix well
5. Add flour and salt and mix to just combine
6. Carefully divide batter among preheated pans , filling each cup just under half full
7. Bake 30 to 40 minutes , until puffy and well-browned
8. Remove from pan and serve warm

title: savoury italian fish soup  brodetto
steps:
1. In a large stock pot over medium high heat add olive oil , celery , spring onion , marjoram , parsley , thyme , and garlic sauti until onions begin to become transparent about 5 minutes
2. Add the vinegar , cherry tomatoes , peperoncino , canned whole tomato , cuttlefish and wine
3. Allow to come up to a simmer and then cook for 10 minutes
4. Add the bass by placing on top of the broth and very gently pushing the fish down
5. Allow to cook 5 minutes
6. Add the mussels , razor clams , shrimp , and squid by placing on top of broth and fish gently pushing down with a large ladle and basting the shell fish with the hot broth
7. Cover stockpot with a lid and cook for 2 to 3 minutes until mussels and clams are all open and shrimp and squid are cooked through
8. Taste and season with salt and pepper
9. Carefully remove to serving platter and sprinkle parsley on top

title: from scratch chili garlic sauce
steps:
1. Place chilies , garlic , vinegar , salt and sugar in a food processor or blender and pulse until coarsely pureed
2. Adjust sugar , salt and vinegar to taste
3. Transfer to a small sealable jar and refrigerate

title: dutch baby  german pancake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Melt butter or margarine in 9 inch pie plate
3. Mix all other ingredients
4. Pour mixture into plate with th melted butter
5. Bake 45minutes
6. Cut into slices you desire , i generally do 4 pieces
7. Serve and enjoy

title: no sugar banana bread  made with stevia and yogurt
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Lightly grease 9 x 5 loaf pan
3. In large bowl , combine flour , soda and salt
4. In separate bowl , cream together yogurt and stevia
5. Stir in eggs and mashed bananas until well blended
6. Stir banana mixture into flour mixture
7. Stir just to moisten
8. Pour batter into prepared loaf pan
9. Bake in preheated oven for 60-65 minutes until a toothpick inserted into center of loaf comes out clean

title: swiss  broccoli  and salmon pie
steps:
1. In a medium bowl mix celery , scallions , dill , pepper , mayo and 1 / 2 the swiss cheese
2. Set aside
3. Bake bottom pastry only , at 425 for about 10 minutes or until just barely lightly browned
4. Reduce oven temp to 375
5. Flake half the salmon into lighlty browned pie shell
6. Layer the broccoli over the salmon then layer the sliced eggs over the broccoli
7. Pour 1 / 2 the mayo mixture over the eggs
8. Top with remaining salmon , then remaining mayo mixture , then reserved swiss cheese
9. Cover with top pastry and brush with egg wash
10. Bake at 375 for 30 minutes or until golden brown
11. This pie can be made ahead and frozen

title: peanut butter striped delight
steps:
1. Place cookies in food processor and process to form fine crumbs
2. Transfer to medium bowl
3. Add butter
4. Mix well
5. Press firmly onto bottom of 13 x 9-inch dish
6. Refrigerate 10 minutes
7. Meanwhile , beat cream cheese , sugar , and 2 tablespoons of the milk in separate bowl with wire whisk until well blended
8. Add 1-1 / 4 cups of the whipped topping
9. Mix well
10. Spread over crust
11. Pour remaining 3 cups milk into large bowl
12. Add dry pudding mixes
13. Beat with wire whisk 2 minutes or until well blended
14. Add peanut butter
15. Mix well
16. Spread evenly over cream cheese layer
17. Let stand 5 minutes or until thickened
18. Top with remaining whipped topping
19. Cover
20. Refrigerate at least 4 hours before cutting into pieces to serve
21. Store in refrigerator

title: sandra lee semi homemade beef and broccoli soup
steps:
1. In a large heavy-bottomed pot , combine broth , sour cream , and teriyaki seasoning
2. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat
3. Reduce heat to medium-low , add noodles , and cook for 5 minutes
4. Add carrots , beef roast , broccoli , salt , and crushed red pepper
5. Cook for 2 minutes longer
6. Serve immediately

title: creamy lemon meringue pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. In a medium bowl , beat egg yolks
3. Stir in sweetened condenesed milk , real lemon , and rind
4. Pour into crust
5. In a small bowl , beat egg whites with cream of tartar until foamy
6. Gradually add sugar until stiff but not dry
7. Spread meringue on top of pie sealing carefully to edge of crust
8. Bake 15 minutes or until meringue is golden brown
9. Cool , chill before serving

title: chipotle tomatillo salsa
steps:
1. To roast tomatillos:
2. Place in shallow baking pan and place under broiler , turning occasionally , until charred and softened
3. To roast in a skillet , place whole fruit , in a hot skillet over medium high heat and roast , turning occasionally , until quite charred all over and slightly softened
4. Combine onion , garlic , chipotles , cilantro , and water in a small saucepan
5. Bring to a boil and simmer until the chile softens , about 5 minutes
6. Transfer to a blender
7. Add the remaining ingredients and puree until smooth
8. Store in a container in the fridge 2-3 days

title: bananaberry baked oatmeal
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Mix flax with water and set aside
3. In a bowl mix oats , baking powder , cinnamon , and salt
4. In a separate bowl add mashed banana , milk , vanilla , agave and flax mixture
5. Stir to thoroughly combine and then add to oat mixture
6. Stir everything together
7. Pour half the batter into a lightly greased 8x8 baking dish
8. Sprinkle blueberries and nuts over it and then pour remain batter over , smoothing out as needed
9. Bake for 20-25 minutes
10. Let cool for about 10 minutes so it can set
11. You can cut this into 6
12. Or 4 large servings if you prefer

title: polenta florentine
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Spray a 2 quart oven-proof casserole with non-stick spray
3. Combine broth , water , 1 teaspoon salt , garlic powder , cornmeal , and butter in the casserole
4. Stir well
5. Bake for 40 minutes
6. Meanwhile , defrost spinach and thoroughly squeeze dry
7. Season with remaining salt and pepper
8. Drain tomatoes
9. Remove polenta from oven
10. Add spinach , tomatoes , ricotta , and parmesan
11. Stir well
12. Return to oven and bake for 5 more minutes
13. Remove from oven and allow to rest for 5 minutes before serving

title: amish potato rolls
steps:
1. Sprinkle yeast over water that has been placed in your mixer
2. Allow the yeast to activate and then mix in sugar
3. Then add potatoes , salt , shortening , and eggs
4. Add flour a cup at a time stopping at 8
5. Only add enough of the remaining flour to get an only slightly sticky feel
6. The dough should be workable but not dry
7. Place in a greased bowl and cover with a towel
8. Allow to rise till doubled in a warm place
9. Measure another 1 / 2 c flour into a bowl
10. Spray hands with pan spray
11. Break off dough and form into rolls
12. Roll into flour just to coat
13. Place on a greased pan and allow to rise till almost doubled
14. Bake in a preheated 350f oven 20-25 minutes or till lightly browned
15. Prep time does not include rise time as that will vary

title: blackened chicken fingers with wango tango sauce
steps:
1. Marinate chicken in the oil and hot sauce while blending blackening spices
2. Whisk sour cream and dressing with last 5 ingredients
3. Roll chicken strips in the dry mix one at a time and place on non-stick cookie sheet
4. Spray tops of tenders with"pam" , or lightly brush with oil
5. Bake in top half of preheated 425 degree oven for 10-15 minutes
6. Let cool , serve on platter with dipping sauce in the middle

title: bea s caesar mashed potatoes
steps:
1. Cook potatoes in water until tender
2. Drain potatoes
3. Mash potatoes
4. Mix potatoes with remaining ingredients
5. Serve

title: perfectly fresh white bread  bread machines
steps:
1. Add ingredients in order suggested by your bread machine manufacturer
2. Recommended cycle for your machine would be the "basic" or "white" setting for large loaves
3. Remove from pan while hot and smear with margarine to keep the crust soft and fresh
4. Smear all sides and let cool for one hour on a cooling rack before cutting

title: just like  jack astor s crab dip   copycat
steps:
1. In a small pan , saute onion and garlic
2. Next saute bell pepper , then mushrooms
3. Let cool
4. In a bowl soften cream cheese with a spoon
5. Add cooled vegetables , crab meat , and cheese
6. Store in container in fridge until ready to serve
7. Serving instructions: place dip in a oven proof shallow bowl
8. Spread dip evenly in bowl and top with more shredded cheddar cheese
9. Warm slightly in microwave
10. Bake in oven at 350 degrees , until slightly bubbling and the top is starting to turn golden brown
11. Sprinkle with chopped parsley and parlsey sprig
12. Place bowl on a serving plate and surround with nacho chips and pita points

title: great italian spaghetti meat sauce
steps:
1. Cook and stir hamburger , onion and garlic in a 10-inch skillet until hamburger is light brown
2. Drain
3. Stir in remaining ingredients except spaghetti
4. Heat to boiling
5. Reduce heat
6. Cover and simmer , stirring occasionally , 1 hour
7. Serve sauce over hot spaghetti
8. Sprinkle with grated parmesan cheese if desired

title: dave and buster s white cheddar mashed potatoes
steps:
1. Wash potatoes and bring to a boil in salted water
2. Cook for 5 to 10 minutes until potatoes are soft
3. Drain potatoes well
4. Place back in pot or in a mixing bowl
5. Add cheese , cream , teaspoon of salt , pepper and garlic butter
6. Beat until smooth with a whisk or potato masher
7. Garlic butter:
8. Saut minced garlic in oil for approximately 2 minutes until softened
9. Mix with room temp butter and chopped fresh parsley

title: cheesecake factory chopped salad
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine lettuce , chicken , tomatoes , avocado , corn , bacon , blue cheese and apples
2. Toss until mixed
3. Add balsamic vinaigrette , tossing well
4. For the dressing: in a small food processor , combine dressing ingredients
5. Process until well blended

title: cwazzy wabbit
steps:
1. Stir the vodka with the juices
2. Pour over ice in chilled highball glasses
3. Garnish each with a baby carrot if desired and serve

title: chinese roast pork  authentic and delicious
steps:
1. Combine salt , sugar , soy sauce , oyster sauce , sesame oil , ginger , hoisin sauce , bean paste , garlic , shallots and wine in a large bowl
2. Add the pork loin roast , baste thoroughly and marinate 2 hours
3. Place the roast on a rack in a roasting pan , and bake in a preheated oven at 425 degree for 15 minutes
4. Turn meat and bake 7 minutes longer
5. Remove the meat and brush with the honey mixed with the red food color
6. Return to the oven for 10 minutes , or until done
7. Cut the meat crosswise into thin slices and serve either hot or cold

title: maple cinnamon protein oatmeal
steps:
1. Cook oats to package directions
2. Add protein powder , maple syrup , and cinnamon and stir well
3. Add rasins if desired

title: wheat berry waldorf salad
steps:
1. Add wheat berries and water to saucepan and bring the mixture to a boil , lower the heat and simmer covered until the wheat berries are tender but still chewy in texture , about 15 minutes
2. Set aside to cool
3. Toss cooled wheat berries and remaining ingredients together in bowl and serve

title: gruyere popovers
steps:
1. Place a popover pan in the oven and heat until oven and pan reach 350
2. Gently warm the milk over low heat and set aside
3. Whisk the eggs until frothy and slowly whisk in the milk
4. Set the mixture aside
5. Sift the flour with the salt
6. Slowly add the dry mixture and gently combine until almost smooth
7. Once combined , remove the popover pan from the oven and spray with non-stick vegetable spray
8. While the batter is still slightly warm or at room temperature , fill each popover cup 3 / 4 full
9. Top each popover with 2 1 / 2 tablespoons for grated gruyere
10. Bake at 350 for 50 minutes , rotating pan half a turn after 14 minutes of baking
11. Remove from oven , remove popovers from pan and serve immediately
12. They serve with an herb butter and slightly coarse sea salt
13. Yum !

title: zucchini potato latkes with tzatziki
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450f
2. Coat a baking sheet with cooking spray
3. Toss zucchini , potato , 3 tablespoons shallot and egg in a large bowl
4. Add breadcrumbs , feta , 1 tablespoon dill , 1 / 4 teaspoon salt and 1 / 4 teaspoon pepper
5. Toss to combine
6. Form the mixture into 12 patties
7. Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
8. Add 6 patties , cover and cook until crispy and browned on one side , 2 to 5 minutes
9. Carefully transfer the latkes to the prepared pan , browned-side down
10. Repeat with the remaining 1 tablespoon oil and patties
11. Transfer the latkes to the oven
12. Bake until firm and heated through , 10 to 12 minutes
13. Meanwhile , prepare tzatziki:
14. Combine yogurt , cucumber , vinegar , the remaining minced shallot , 1 tablespoon dill and 1 / 4 teaspoon each salt and pepper in a small bowl
15. Serve the latkes with the tzatziki on the side

title: eggs with crab meat
steps:
1. Combine crab meat , eggs and stock
2. Add soy sauce and beat lightly with a fork
3. Heat 1 t
4. Of oil in wok over medium-low heat
5. Stir-fry ginger and scallion for one minute , remove and set aside
6. Heat 2 t
7. Of oil in wok over medium-high heat
8. Add crab meat and egg mixture and stir-fry very gently
9. When mixture starts to set , add ginger and scallion
10. Cook for about 2 more minutes then thicken with dissolved cornstarch
11. Stir in the vinegar and serve hot over steamed rice

title: peaches velvetene
steps:
1. Strain peaches and reserved juice
2. Put peaches into serving bowl or individual glasses or bowls
3. Measure reserved juice , if you have 100ml then dissolve jelly in 150ml hot water , mix together
4. Whisk jelly / juice mixture into the yoghurt
5. Pour over the fruit
6. Refrigerate to set
7. Process the 4 tablespoons of reserved juice with the ricotta in a blender , food processor or mixer on high until smooth - use this to decorate the top of fruit / jelly
8. Either dollop on or pipe onto the dessert

title: fiesta fudge cookies  cookie mix
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f
2. In large microwavable bowl , microwave butter and chocolate on high 1 minute
3. Stir
4. Microwave on high 1 minute longer or until butter is melted and chocolate can be stirred smooth
5. Stir condensed milk into chocolate mixture
6. Stir in cookie mix and cinnamon until well blended
7. Using 1 level tablespoonful of dough for each cookie , shape into 60 balls
8. Place 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheets
9. Bake 6 to 7 minutes or until edges lose their shiny look
10. Immediately press 1 kiss into center of each cookie
11. Cool cookies on cookie sheet 5 minutes
12. Remove from cookie sheets
13. To get kiss to spread slightly on top of cookie , tap edge of each cookie lightly
14. Cool completely
15. Store covered at room temperature

title: herb  lemon and garlic dressing
steps:
1. Combine yoghurt , herbs , garlic , lemon juice and salt and pepper in a screw top jar
2. Secure lid and shake well to combine
3. Recommended for drizzling over lamb , spinach or green salad
4. Will keep in jar for up to 2 days in the fridge

title: smoky sausage   potato supper
steps:
1. Cut 1 / 2 pound sausage into 1 in
2. Pieces
3. Cut remaining sausage into thirds
4. Slice partially through
5. Researve for garnish
6. Melt butter in skillet , saute onion 3 minutes or until tender
7. In a large mixing bowl , combine sausage , hashbrowns , and onion
8. Mix well
9. Add remaining ingredients except 1 / 2 cup grated cheese
10. Spoon into 11 x 7 x 2 baking dish
11. Top with sausage thirds
12. Sprinkle remaining cheese around border
13. Bake in a preheted oven 350 degrees for 30 to 35 minutes

title: tofu bundles in phyllo
steps:
1. Combine tofu , carrot , zucchini , cheese , spinach and seasonings
2. Stack 4 sheets of phyllo and cut into 6 even squares
3. Spoon 2 to 3 tablespoons filling into each square
4. Fold corner to corner and turn over end flaps , sealing with a dab of water
5. Place bundleson non-stick or lightly sprayed baking sheet
6. Using a pastry brush , brush on melted butter and sprinkle with sesame seeds
7. Bake at 425 degrees for 25 minutes
8. Makes 2 servings of 3 bundles each

title: 10 10 10 bread
steps:
1. Mix first three ingredients and let sit for 10 minute
2. Mix in oil and salt , then add in flour
3. Mix together
4. Knead for a few minutes and then let sit for 10 minute
5. Roll or pat out on a greased cookie sheet until thin
6. Brush on melted butter
7. Sprinkle with spices- oregano , garlic powder , parmesan , basil , or whatever you desire
8. Bake at 450 degrees for 10 minute
9. Remove from oven , and slice as desired
10. Enjoy !

title: very simple crock pot lasagna
steps:
1. Brown and drain ground meat
2. Place a layer of lasagna noodles in bottom of crock pot
3. Spoon in a layer of ground meat
4. Layer approximately 1 / 3 jar of each sauce
5. Top layer with cheese
6. Repeat from step 2 for two more layers
7. Cover and cook on high for 2 hours

title: indoor beef  kabobs     persian kabob barg
steps:
1. Cut beef short ribs into long strips about 1 / 4-inch wide
2. Kitchen shears are very handy here
3. Mix all other ingredients except olive oil in a large plastic bag
4. Alternatively , of course , a bowl with a cover is fine
5. Coat the beef evenly in the yogurt mixture and marinade for 8-24 hours
6. Wipe or rinse most of the marinade off of the beef and pat mostly dry -- you want a little bit of marinade to stay on , for browning , but not a solid layer , which would burn while the meat steamed under it
7. In a large nonstick pan , heat the olive oil on high heat
8. When it starts to smoke very slightly , put in three or four pieces of meat -- don't crowd the pan here ! -- and brown on both sides , about one-two minutes per side
9. Rest on a plate in a very low oven while you cook the rest of the meat in batches
10. Cut the rested meat into bite-sized pieces
11. Again , a good pair of kitchen shears makes this much easier
12. Serve over rice

title: momma s sweet onion casserole
steps:
1. Peel and slice vidalias into thin rings
2. Saute in margarine until tender
3. Place 1 / 2 of vidalias into 1 1 / 2 quart baking dish
4. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese and crushed crackers
5. Repeat layers , ending with crumbs
6. Bake uncovered at 350 degrees for approximately 30 minutes

title: weight watchers barley with butternut squash  apples and onions
steps:
1. Bring 3 cups of water and 1 / 2 teaspoon of the salt to a boil in a medium saucepan
2. Add barley
3. Cover saucepan and simmer barley until tender , about 30 to 35 minutes
4. Drain
5. Meanwhile , heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
6. Add squash and cook , stirring often , until it's starting to soften--about five minutes
7. Add the onion and red pepper and cook for an additional 3 minutes
8. Stir in apple , garlic , thyme , black pepper and remaining 1 / 4 teaspoon of salt
9. Cook , stirring , until apple is almost tender , about 2 minutes
10. Stir in broth , scraping bottom of skillet with a wooden spoon to loosen any browned bits
11. Stir in cooked barley
12. Toss over low heat to mix and coat
13. Remove from heat and serve
14. Yields about 1 cup per serving
15. To make this vegetarian , use vegetable broth in place of the chicken broth

title: bow tie pasta with sausage and asparagus
steps:
1. Heat pan with olive oil and butter
2. Once butter melts , add garlic and cook until fragrant
3. Add sausage , and cayenne pepper
4. Cook 2 minutes
5. Add bell pepper , asparagus and black pepper , and cook for 8-10 minutes or until asparagus is tender , but crispy
6. Sprinkle cheese over sausage mixture and mix well
7. Pour over hot farfalle pasta
8. Toss to coat
9. Add salt if needed

title: moroccan chicken pilaf
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f
2. Put the saffron in a small bowl with 1 tbsp hot water
3. Allow to soak for at least 10 minutes
4. While saffron is soaking , using as little olive oil as possible , brown the chicken 2 minutes per side in appropriate casserole dish
5. Remove chicken and set aside
6. Add onion and peppers to casserole dish and cook 4 minutes , stirring regularly
7. Add more olive oil if required
8. Add the garlic , red pepper flakes , cumin , and coriander
9. Cook for 30 seconds
10. Remove from heat
11. Add rice and stir to coat each grain in a thin layer of oil
12. Place chicken on top of rice
13. Combine saffron liquid and chicken stock and stir
14. Pour the combined liquid over chicken and rice , return to heat , and bring to a boil
15. Place lid on casserole dish and bake 50 minutes
16. Remove from oven and let stand several minutes with the lid on
17. Stir in olives and serve

title: extreme low fat sweet and sour skillet chicken
steps:
1. In a large skillet , bring chicken and stock to a simmer over med-high heat
2. Add celery , onion and sweet peppers
3. Cook , stirring often , for about 5 minutes , or until chicken is no longer pink inside , and veggies are almost tender-crisp
4. Mix together the juice , brown sugar , vinegar and soy sauce until blended
5. Stir into skillet
6. Bring to a boil
7. Cook , stirring for about 2 minutes , or until glossy and thickened
8. Mix the cornstarch with a small amount of cold water and add to the simmering sauce to thicken
9. Add mango or pineapple chunks , salt and pepper
10. Simmer for 2 minutes , or until heated through

title: balsamic green beans with garlic
steps:
1. Cook green beans in boiling water that has been salted , for 6 minutes
2. Drain
3. Plunge beans in cold water and drain again
4. Saute garlic in oil for 30 seconds over medium heat
5. Add green beans and saute an additional 3-4 minutes
6. Add balsamic vinegar , salt , and pepper
7. Saute 1 minute longer

title: spelt flour flatbread
steps:
1. Mix dry ingredients
2. Add the liquids , garlic and oregano
3. For a thinner batter , add water as needed
4. Mix well
5. Preheat a cast iron griddle or pan and oil or spray
6. Ladle the batter onto the griddle and as it cooks , sprinkle the chopped onions on the top side
7. When bubbles appear on the surface and the center sets-up , flip over and cook till the edges start to dry and the center is firm

title: the jerkyest chicken around
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together
2. Refrigerate
3. In a bowl , marinate chicken in jerk marinade for 4 to 5 hours , in the refrigerator
4. Saute chicken in oil , over high heat , until cooked through , about 3 minutes on each side
5. Serve with rice and beans

title: catalan style cauliflower
steps:
1. Cut potatoes the same size as the florets
2. Add to a large sauce pan , cover with water and salt lightly
3. Bring to a boil and cook until easily pierced with a skewer , about 20 minutes
4. Drain and transfer to a serving plate
5. Mix oil , vinegar , salt and pepper , pour over potatoes and cauliflower , breaking them up a bit as you do
6. Serve immediately

title: vidalia onion kugel
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Stir together first 3 ingredients in a large bowl
3. Combine flour and next 3 ingredients , gradually stir into egg mixture
4. Set aside
5. Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat , add onion and cook , stirring often , 30 to 40 minutes , or until onion is caramel colored
6. Remove onion from heat
7. Stir onion into egg mixture and spoon into a lightly greased 13 x 9-inch baking dish
8. Bake for 30 minutes or until set

title: yoghurt and mint dressing
steps:
1. Mix together all the ingredients so that they are well combined
2. Store in the refrigerator for up to 2 hours before serving

title: hungry girl s cake batter shake
steps:
1. To make the chocolatey topping , in a small bowl , combine cool whip with cocoa mix
2. Stir until completely mixed
3. Cover and refrigerate
4. In a tall glass , combine powdered creamer with 2 tablespoons hot water and stir to dissolve
5. Add soymilk and pudding mix
6. Stir until mostly dissolved
7. Transfer contents of the glass to a blender
8. Add ice cream and ice to the blender
9. Blend at high speed until thoroughly mixed
10. If needed , remove blender from the base , stir mixture , and blend again
11. Pour into the tall glass
12. Gently stir in the sprinkles
13. If you want to get fancy with your chocolatey topping , spoon it into one of the bottom corners of a plastic bag
14. Snip off the
15. Or keep things simple and just spoon on the topping ! if you like , top with a few extra sprinkles
16. Enjoy !

title: low fat chocolate oatmeal cookies
steps:
1. Mix first four ingredients in a saucepan
2. Bring to a boil and boil for 2 1 / 2 to 3 minutes
3. Add vanilla , peanut butter , and oatmeal and stir well
4. Drop onto wax paper and let cool

title: blackberry vodka cordial
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a jar / container
2. Place the jar in a cool dark place for 24 hours , turning occasionally to combine
3. Strain into a bottle
4. Store in refrigerator
5. Serve with soda water
6. Discarded berries very good over ice cream !

title: mini kisses brownies
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f grease a 13"x9"x2" baking pan
2. Combine cocoa and baking soda
3. Stir mixture into 1 / 3 cup butter
4. Add boiling water
5. Stir until thickened
6. Stir in sugar , eggs , remaining 1 / 3 cup butter , and vanilla
7. Blend in flour and salt
8. Stir in mini kisses and nuts
9. Spread batter in prepared pan
10. Bake 35-40 minutes , or until edges begin to pull away from sides of pan
11. Cool completely on wire rack
12. Cut into bars

title: goat cheese mashed potato gratin
steps:
1. Boil potatoes in salted water until tender
2. Drain and peel when cool enough to handle
3. Boil garlic with potatoes until soft
4. Remove and peel
5. Mash potatoes with garlic , cream , butter and cheese
6. Stir in scallions
7. Spoon into buttered casserole dish
8. Run under the broiler until golden-brown on top

title: best cheese potatoes
steps:
1. Spray pan with cooking spray
2. Stir all ingredients in baking dish
3. Bake uncovered on 350 degrees for approximately 1 hour or until the edges start to bubble

title: potato and boursin frittata
steps:
1. Put oven rack in middle postiton and preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. Whisk together eggs , salt and pepper until just combined
3. Heat oil in and ovenproof 9-10 inch nonstick skillet over high heat until very hot but not smoking
4. Add potatoes and green onions to oil , stirring once , then cover and cook until beginning to brown , about 4 minutes
5. Stir potato mixture once , then cover and cook 3 minutes more
6. Pour beaten eddgs evenly over potato mixture and crumble cheese over eggs
7. Transfer skillet to oven and bake frittata , uncovered , until set and just cooked through , about 15 minutes
8. Invert a plate over skillet and , holding them together with oven mitts , invert frittata onto plate and serve immediately

title: dark chocolate honey almond fondue
steps:
1. Bring cream and honey to simmer in heavy medium saucepan
2. Add chocolate
3. Whisk until melted
4. Remove from heat
5. Whisk in kirsch and extract
6. Pour fondue into bowl
7. Place on platter and surround with assorted fruits
8. Serve fondue with skewers

title: pressure cooker corn on the cob
steps:
1. Pour the water in the bottom of your pressure cooker and set in the steamer insert
2. Arrange the corn in the steamer basket- i can only fit 3 ears of corn in my 5 qt cooker with the basket in place
3. If you have a larger cooker you can increase the amount of corn you cook , and can up the water to 1 1 / 2 cups
4. Secure the lid and seal
5. When the cooker comes up to high pressure , set a timer for 2 minutes
6. After the 2 minutes are up , run the cooker under cold water until it releases
7. Enjoy !

title: pissaladiere ii
steps:
1. Roll out pastry dough and line a 9-inch pie pan with it
2. Saute the onions and garlic in olive oil until tender and lightly golden
3. Add the basil and salt
4. Preheat oven to 375f
5. Thoroughly mix the eggs , milk , mustard and flour and set aside
6. Combine the 2 cheeses
7. Sprinkle 1 / 2 the cheese into the pie shell
8. Spread the sauteed onions over the cheese
9. Scatter on the olives
10. Pour the egg-milk mixture into the pie
11. Cover with remaining cheese and arrange the tomato slices on top
12. Bake 40-45 minutes or until set

title: tilapia en papillote
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Fold a parchment round in half
3. Place the tilapia against the fold and stack with the chopped fresh vegetables
4. Sprinkle with mrs
5. Dash and wine
6. Dot with butter
7. Fold the parchment over itself and 'seal' by folding up the edges and twisting them shut
8. Place on a baking tray and cook for 20 - 25 minutes , or until the fish is flaky and cooked through
9. Serve with a dash of lemon juice
10. Enjoy the remaining white wine

title: slow cooker chicken marrakesh
steps:
1. Place the onion , garlic , carrots , sweet potatoes , garbanzo beans , and chicken and vegetables
2. Pour in the tomatoes , and stir to combine
3. Cover the cooker , set to high , and cook until the sweet potatoes are tender and the sauce has thickened , 4 to 5 hours

title: chicken mashed potatoes
steps:
1. Recipe can be halved
2. Combine ingredients in large saucepan
3. Bring to a boil
4. Reduce heat and simmer about 10 minutes or until potatoes are tender
5. Drain , reserving broth
6. Add garlic powder , if you want , and then mash potatoes with as much broth as you like until you attain desired consistency

title: spicy pizza sub sandwiches
steps:
1. Split roll and layer with cheese , meats , and sauce
2. Top with jalepenos if desired
3. Use leftover sauce for dipping

title: ortega s mexican rice
steps:
1. Melt butter in large saucepan over medium heat
2. Add rice , onion and garlic
3. Cook , stirring occasionally , for 3 to 4 minutes or until rice is golden
4. Stir in salsa , water , cumin , carrot and peas
5. Bring to a boil
6. Reduce heat to low
7. Cook , covered , for 25 to 30 minutes or until liquid is absorbed and rice is tender

title: blender pancakes waffles
steps:
1. Put 1 cup milk into blender , add 3 / 4 cups clean whole wheat kernels
2. Blend for 4 minutes
3. Assemble and add the remaining ingredients , blending a few seconds more
4. Pour on lightly oiled , hot griddle or waffle iron and bake until done

title: freezer buttermilk biscuits
steps:
1. To sour milk , place one tablespoon lemon juice plus enough milk to equal one cup into a 2 cup measure
2. Stir , let stand 5 minutes before using
3. Combine flour , baking powder , sugar , baking soda and salt in large bowl
4. Cut in shortening with pastry blender or 2 knives until mixture resembles fine crumbs
5. Stir buttermilk into flour mixture until mixture forms soft dough that leaves side of bowl
6. Turn out dough onto well-floured surface
7. Knead 10 times , roll into 8-inch square
8. Cut dough into 16 squares
9. Place squares on baking sheet lined with plastic wrap
10. Freeze about 3 hours or until firm
11. Remove squares and place in airtight freezer container
12. Freeze up to 1 month
13. When ready to prepare , preheat oven to 400f
14. Place frozen squares 1 1 / 2 inches apart on ungreased baking sheet
15. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown , serve warm
16. Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown
17. Serve warm

title: fruited coconut limeade
steps:
1. In a large bowl combine coconut water , lime juice , sugar , mango and rum
2. Stir until sugar is well dissolved
3. Cover and chill for at least 4
4. To serve , transfer to a pitcher
5. Serve in tall glasses over ice cubes

title: 30 minute garlic chicken with potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees
2. Coat a large baking dish with vegetable or butter spray
3. Toss all ingredients together in a bowl and coat well
4. Place in baking dish and bake 30 minutes

title: apple puffed pancake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees
2. Combine eggs , milk and vanilla in the jar of a blender
3. Blend until well combined
4. Add flour , granulated sugar , salt , cinnamon , nutmeg
5. Blend until dry ingredients are well incorporated , set aside
6. Place butter in a 9x13 inch glass baking dish
7. Transfer dish to oven and heat until butter has just melted
8. Carefully remove from oven and place apples in a single layer in baking dish
9. Return to oven and cook until butter begins to bubble , about 4 minutes
10. Pour batter over apples , sprinkle with brown sugar , and continue baking until puffed and golden , about 20 minutes
11. Sprinkle with confectioners' sugar , if desired
12. Serve immediately

title: deep dish pizza bundle
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Spray an 8 inch round cake pan with nonstick cooking spray
3. Unroll the dough and place in the pan
4. There will be four corners of dough extending over the sides of the pan , pressing the dough lightly against the bottom and up sides of pan
5. Over the dough , sprinkle 1 cup shredded cheese , spread sauce evenly over cheese , sprinkle with italian seasonings , top with pepperoni slices ending with 1 cup shredded cheese
6. Using kitchen scissors , cut off about 2 inches of dough from each corner
7. Discard
8. Bring all ends of dough upward and together at center , twisting to close at top of pizza
9. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese and bake for 20-25 minutes or until a golden brown

title: bird s famous macaroni and cheese
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit
2. Melt butter in large saucepan over medium-high heat
3. Stir in flour , salt , dry mustard and pepper until smooth
4. Gradually stir in milk and heavy cream , stirring continuously until thickened , about 10 minutes
5. Remove from heat
6. Stir in cheeses and mix until smooth and cheese has melted
7. In a large bowl , pour cheese mixture over macaroni , mixing well
8. Place mixture into a greased 9x13 baking pan
9. Sprinkle seasoned bread crumbs on top
10. Bake for 25-30 minutes

title: 3 ingredient pumpkin spice cupcakes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Combine all ingredients in a large bowl for 2 minutes
3. Contents will be very thick
4. Line muffin tin with paper cups
5. Fill 2 / 3 full with batter
6. You may add a 1 / 4 cup of water to make it easier to stir
7. Bake 22 to 24 minutes
8. Optional: sprinkle tops with cinnamon sugar before placing in oven if you don't use frosting

title: snickerdoodle pinwheels
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine the 1 / 3 cup sugar and the cinnamon and set aside
2. In a large mixing bowl , beat the 1 / 2 cup butter and cream cheese on medium-high speed for 30 seconds
3. Add the 1 cup sugar and baking powder
4. Beat until combined , scraping sides of bowl occasionally
5. Beat in egg and vanilla
6. Mix in as much of the flour as you can with the mixer and stir in any remaining flour by hand
7. Divide dough in half
8. Between 2 sheets of waxed paper , roll each half of the dough at a time into a 12x8-inch rectangle
9. Remove top sheet of waxed paper
10. Brush half of the melted butter over the dough rectangle and sprinkle with 2 tablespoons of the reserved cinnamon-sugar mixture
11. Starting from a short side , roll up into a spiral , removing waxed paper as you roll
12. Pinch edges to seal
13. Roll in the remaining cinnamon-sugar mixture to coat roll
14. Wrap each roll in plastic wrap and chill about 4 hours or until dough is firm
15. Using a sharp knife , cut dough into 1 / 4-inch thick slices
16. Place slices 1 inch apart on an ungreased cookie sheet
17. Bake in a 375 f oven for 8 to 10 minutes or until edges are firm
18. Cool on cookie sheet for 1 minute then transfer cookies to a wire rack to cool

title: poached salamon with green bean salad
steps:
1. In a large skillet combine lemon , tarragon and 5 onions and enough water to come 2 / 3 up or that will cover the fish when added
2. Bring to a simmer over medium high heat
3. Sprinkle salmon with 1 / 2 tsp salt and 1 / 4 tsp pepper
4. Add salmon to skillet , adding water if needed to cover
5. Cook for 5-10 minutes or until done
6. Transfer to a platter when done
7. Meanwhile bring a pot of water to a boil and add green beans - cook for 3-5 minutes
8. Drain
9. In a large salad bowl toss beans , remaining onions , radishes and some chopped tarragon
10. Squeeze juice from one lemon and drizzle with olive oil
11. Toss
12. Serve salmon with salad

title: roasted zesty parmesan green beans
steps:
1. Preheat your oven to 425f line a baking sheet with aluminum foil or parchment paper
2. Trim the ends off of your green beans , and spread them out evenly on the baking sheet
3. Grab your olive oil and your drizzle it over the green beans
4. Shake the pan a couple of times to rotate the green beans to cover them fairly evenly
5. Add the salt , pepper , garlic powder , and paprika , and shake again to cover them evenly
6. Pop them in the oven for 10 minutes , shake the pan again to flip them over , and put them back in for another 5 minutes
7. After removing them from the oven , grate your parmesan cheese over the top and serve !

title: bombay sliders with garlic curry sauce
steps:
1. Mix the mayonnaise and yogurt together
2. Mix 3 / 4 cup of the mayonnaise and yogurt mix , 2 1 / 4 teaspoons curry powder , and next 3 ingredients in small bowl for sauce
3. Let stand at room temperature while preparing sliders
4. Place turkey or chicken , next 6 ingredients , remaining 1 / 4 cup mayonnaise mix , and 4 teaspoons curry powder in large bowl
5. Mix with fork or hands just until blended
6. Divide mixture into 12 equal portions
7. Using wet hands , form each portion into patty about 1 / 2 inch thick
8. Preheat broiler or heat 1 tablespoon oil in heavy large skillet over medium-high heat
9. If broiling patties , brush rimmed baking sheet with 1 tablespoon oil and arrange patties on sheet
10. Broil until cooked through , pressing patties down lightly with spatula before turning over , about 3 minutes per side
11. Place patties on bottom halves of rolls
12. Top each patty with sauce
13. Cover with roll tops
14. Place 3 sliders on each of 4 plates and serve

title: turkey pesto calzone
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Unroll pizza dough onto clean work surface
3. Pat out to 15x11-inch rectangle
4. Cut in half lengthwise , then in half crosswise to form 4 rectangles
5. Cover each dough rectangle with 1 tablespoon pesto sauce , 4 slices turkey , and 1 slice of cheese
6. Fold rectangle in half to enclose filling
7. Seal edges with fork
8. Place on baking sheet sprayed with cooking spray
9. Bake until golden brown

title: baked beans with a zing
steps:
1. In medium pan combine all ingredients
2. Cook at medium heat until heated through and flavors have blended

title: too much summer squash in the garden baked squash
steps:
1. Wash and cut up squash
2. Boil until tender
3. Drain thoroughly and mash slightly
4. Add all ingredients except 1 / 2 of butter and 1 / 2 of cracker crumbs to squash
5. Pour squash mixture into baking dish
6. Mix remaining butter and crumbs
7. Sprinkle over top
8. Bake at 375 degrees f for about 1 hour or until brown on top

title: wheat thins
steps:
1. Combine all dry ingredients
2. Add butter and mix till completely blended
3. Add vanilla and water , mixing until smooth
4. Roll out paper-thin on a lightly floured board or directly on a greased baking sheet
5. Lightly sprinkle with salt or herb seasoning
6. Cut into squares with a pastry wheel
7. Bake at 400 degf for 5-8 minutes or until crisp
8. If the outer rim browns too quickly , remove the browned sections and return unfinished portions to the oven

title: quick   easy baked beans
steps:
1. In an oven or microwave proof bowl thoroughly stir all ingredients together until well mixed
2. Bake in a 350 oven 40 minutes to an hour , stirring about halfway through cooking time
3. Or cover with waxpaper and microwave approximately 10 minutes , stirring halfway through cooking time

title: crock pot chicken tetrazzini
steps:
1. In slow cooker , combine onion , mushrooms , raw chicken meat , flour , salt , pepper and bouillon powder
2. Stir well to coat chicken with flour
3. In a bowl , combine water , evaporated milk and sherry
4. Stir well
5. Pour over chicken mixture
6. Cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours or on high for 3 to 4 hours
7. Stir in pasta
8. Mix well to avoid the spaghetti pieces from sticking together
9. Push under liquid
10. Sprinkle with cheese
11. Cook on high for 15 to 20 minutes , or until pasta is done

title: mock snickers munch bar
steps:
1. Be sure the dry roasted peanuts you use are the salted kind , and watch that thermometer closely once the candy gets simmering
2. Spread peanuts out on a baking sheet and heat them up in your oven set on 300 degrees
3. This will warm up the peanuts so that they don't cool the candy too quickly when added later
4. There's no need to preheat the oven
5. Melt the butter in a medium saucepan over medium / low heat
6. Add sugar and corn syrup and simmer , stirring occasionally
7. Put a candy thermometer in the mixture and watch it closely
8. When the mixture reaches 300 degrees add peanuts and stir well until all of the peanuts are coated with candy
9. Pour the candy onto the warm baking sheet and spread it flat
10. When the candy cools , break it into chunks and store it in a covered container

title: blueberry crisp squares
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325f
2. Line a 9x9x2-inch pan with heavy aluminum foil , letting the foil extend over the ends of the pan
3. Butter the foil
4. Crust: mix the crumbs and cinnamon in a large bowl
5. Melt the butter and then add to the crumbs , combining well
6. Press the crumb mixture evenly over the bottom and 1 / 2 inch up onto the side of the foil sides
7. Bake for 6 minutes
8. Filling: mix all filling ingredients together in a large bowl , then spread over the prepared crust
9. Topping: mix flour , both sugars , and salt in a large bowl
10. Using a pastry blender or an electric mixer on low speed , cut in the cold butter until crumbs are about 1 / 2 inch i size
11. Sprinkle evenly over the filling
12. Bake for about 40 minutes until the crumb topping is golden brown and the filling just begins to bubble
13. Leave the bars in the baking pan to cool thoroughly on a wire rack about two hours
14. Loosen the foil from the sides
15. Cut into 15 bars and use a wide spatula to slide the squares off the foil

title: greek lemon rice soup
steps:
1. Heat broth to boiling in medium saucepan
2. Stir in rice and garlic
3. Reduce heat and simmer , covered , until rice is tender , about 25 minutes
4. Reduce heat to low
5. Mix lemon juice and egg
6. Slowly stir mixture into soup
7. Stir in parsley
8. Season to taste with salt and white pepper
9. Pour soup into bowls

title: wild rice  orzo and mushroom casserole
steps:
1. Cook orzo according to package directions
2. Cook the wild rice in the broth according to package directions
3. Saute mushrooms in oil and butter and cook until liquid has almost evaporated
4. Add mushrooms and parsley to rice and orzo
5. Mix well ,
6. Bake at 350 for 30 minutes or until heated through

title: sausage   cheese crescent squares
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375f unroll 1 can of dough into 2 long rectangles
2. Place in ungreased 13x9 inch glass baking dish
3. Press over bottom and 1 / 2 inch up to form crust
4. Brown sausage with onions and bell pepper if using
5. Remove sausage from skillet and discard drippings
6. Add cream cheese to skillet
7. Cook over low until melted
8. Add cooked sausage , stir to coat
9. Spoon evenly over crust in baking dish
10. Sprinkle with the cheese
11. Unroll 2nd can of dough onto cutting board , press to form a 13x9 inch rectangle
12. Carefully place over cheese
13. Bake at 375f for 21-26 minutes until golden brown
14. Let cool 15 minutes
15. Cut into squares and serve

title: flavorful sausage gravy and biscuits for a cold morning
steps:
1. In a large skillet , over medium-high heat , cook sausage until browned and cooked through , crumbling and breaking it up as it cooks
2. Sprinkle flour over the sausage and drippings and stir until all flour is dissolved and incorporated
3. Cook for a minute or two longer
4. Slowly stir in milk , stirring constantly
5. Cook , stirring constantly , over medium-high heat until thick and bubbly
6. Remove from heat
7. Taste gravy and season with salt and pepper as desired
8. Serve over hot biscuits that have been split open on the plate

title: basic bread stuffing
steps:
1. Combine bread , onion , celery and all seasonings
2. Add melted butter
3. Toss gently to mix
4. Then add hot broth to moisten to desired consistency
5. Stuff into the cavity of the turkey before roasting , if desired
6. Or: pour all into a large casserole and bake in a preheated 350 degree oven for 35-45 minutes , not letting the top get too crispy

title: salat olivier  russian salad
steps:
1. Boil the potatoes , let cool , and cut into 1 / 2-inch dice
2. Boil the eggs , let cool , and coarsely chop
3. To prepare the chicken , combine ingredients water through thyme , and bring to a boil
4. Lower heat and simmer , covered , for 10-15 minutes
5. Add chicken breasts
6. Bring to a boil and lower heat
7. Simmer , covered , for 20-30 minutes
8. Cool breasts in the broth
9. While chicken is cooking , combine potatoes , eggs , and remaining salad ingredients in a large bowl
10. When chicken has cooled , drain the chicken
11. Remove skin , bones and any gristle
12. Cut chicken into neat 1 / 2 to 3 / 4 inch pieces
13. In a medium bowl , combine all dressing ingredients
14. Salt and pepper to taste
15. Combine chicken , salad ingredients , and dressing
16. Place chicken salad in a large serving bowl
17. Decorate with tomato wedges and egg slices
18. Sprinkle with dill
19. Serve cool , but not chilled

title: eileen s chili verde
steps:
1. Put cubed potatoes in 5 qt crockpot
2. Season with salt and pepper
3. Cover potatoes with half of the onion
4. Meanwhile in a fry pan , brown pork in oil
5. Remove to crockpot
6. Season with salt and pepper
7. Add rest of onions and the garlic
8. Add last 4 ingredients
9. Cook in crockpot on low for 8 hours or on high for 4 hours
10. Serve with refried beans and flour tortillas

title: veggie tetrazzini
steps:
1. Cook spaghetti until al dente and drain
2. While spaghetti is cooking , saute the veggies and vegan chik'n in olive oil until tender
3. While veggies are cooking bring broth to a boil , wisk in flour add the vegan cream cheese and nutrional yeast
4. Stir and heat throughly
5. Salt and pepper to taste
6. When everything is all cooked , stir everything together and pack into a greased 9x9 pan
7. Bake for 25 minutes
8. Let cool for 5-10 minutes to set up
9. Enjoy with some garlic bread !

title: fresh strawberry butter
steps:
1. In a food processor fitted with plastic blade , or in a medium-size bowl with electric mixer , beat strawberry puree into butter until fairly smooth
2. Beat in sugar
3. Pack strawberry butter into serving bowl or mold
4. Refrigerate until firm

title: crock pot stew   chicken and turkey sausage
steps:
1. In a skillet , warm oil over medium heat , and saut meat until browned and thoroughly cooked
2. Drain off fat and set aside
3. In the crock pot , whisk together the broth and tomato paste
4. Add all remaining ingredients and meat to the crock pot and stir
5. Cover and cook until meat and veggies are tender
6. Stir well before serving

title: jessgarfield s milo biscuits
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180
2. Grease oven trays
3. Beat butter , sugars , and vanilla in a large bowl with an electric beater until creamy
4. Add egg and beat until well combined
5. Fold in flour and milo
6. Add milo cereal pieces
7. Roll heaped teaspoons of mixture into balls and place on oven trays , about 4cm apart
8. Flatten slightly with a fork
9. Bake for about 12-15 minutes , or until golden brown
10. Leave to cool for 5 minutes
11. Serve warm , or cooled

title: heloise s cake mix cookies
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients well to remove lumps
2. Stir in raisins and / or nuts and / or chocolate chips if you so desire
3. Drop by teaspoonfuls on an ungreased baking sheet about 2-inches apart
4. Bake at 350f for 8-10 minutes

title: healthy low fat creamy potato apple brie soup
steps:
1. Spray a soup pot with cooking spray , then add the onion , leeks and quartered apples , sauteing over medium heat until softened , 5 to 7 minutes
2. Add the chicken broth , bay leaf , salt and thyme , bringing to a boil , then reduce heat to low and simmer for about 15 minutes
3. Remove the bay leaf , and turn off heat and set the mixture aside
4. While the broth mixture is cooking , combine the evaporated milk and potatoes in a separate saucepan then cook over medium heat until the potatoes are tender , 15 to 20 minutes , stirring frequently
5. Pour the potato mixture into the soup pot
6. Stir to mix evenly
7. In a blender or food processor , puree the soup in batches until smooth , adding the pieces of brie cheese while pureeing
8. Return the pureed batch to the soup pot and heat until warmed through
9. Serve immediately

title: philippine grilled pork tenderloin
steps:
1. Cut the pork into 1 / 2 inch thick medallions
2. You should have about 12 slices
3. Mix together the vinegar , soy sauce , garlic and pepper
4. Add the pork slices and let marinade 4 to 5 hours in the refrigerator , turning occasionally
5. Preheat the broiler
6. Broil the medallions 7 minutes on each side about 4 inces from the flame
7. While the pork is cooking , bring the marinade to a boil in a small saucepan , add the hot pepper flakes , then reduce by one quarter
8. Strain and serve as a dipping sauce with the meat

title: the greatest chicken bbq pizza ever
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Slice chicken into strips and salt and pepper
3. Dice onion and jalapeno- feel free to add more or less onion or jalapeno !
4. Rub pizza crust top and bottom with olive oil and pepper crust , put in oven for 7-8 minute
5. Cook chicken strips in pan until browned , add onion , jalapeno , and garlic in pan and 1 / 2 cup of kc masterpiece original bbq sauce-stir together and turn off of heat
6. After crust has precooked , use other 1 / 2 cup of bbq sauce to coat the crust , top with chicken mixture and add all of the cheese
7. Return to oven and cook until cheese is bubbly !

title: spinach and beans au gratin
steps:
1. Melt butter in a 10-inch cast iron skillet
2. Add onion and saute until translucent
3. Add garlic and saute 1 minute more
4. Add drained beans , chicken broth , tomatoes with juice , and spices
5. Cook over medium heat stirring occasionally for 15 minutes
6. Add spinach a cup at a time , adding more as the spinach wilts
7. Cover with cheese and place skillet under a broiler until cheese is bubbly and a little browned

title: kittencal s easy refrigerator kosher garlic dill pickles
steps:
1. Clean the glass jar and lid thoroughly in your dishwasher or with hot soapy water
2. Combine the water , salt and vinegar in a saucepan
3. Bring to a boil over medium heat
4. Remove from heat
5. Cool to room temperature
6. Pack the cucumbers and the remaining ingredients in a 2-quart glass jar , and pour brine over them , covering the cucumbers completely
7. Store , covered in the the refrigerator
8. The pickles will be ready in 7 days , but the longer you leave them in the refrigerator the better they will be and will keep refrigerated for months

title: whipped cream icing
steps:
1. Combine gelatin and cold water in small saucepan
2. Let stand until thick
3. Place over low heat , stirring constantly , just until gelatin dissolves
4. Remove from heat and cool , but do not allow to set
5. Whip cream , sugar and vanilla until slightly thickened
6. While beating slowly , gradually add gelatin to whipped cream mixture
7. Whip at high speed until stiff

title: quick and easy seasoned black beans
steps:
1. In saut pan heat garlic in oil on medium heat
2. Add onion and jalapeo as oil begins to warm
3. Add oregano and cumin and saut , stirring frequently , until vegetables are tender , adding a few drops of water if they begin to stick
4. Add contents of cans of black beans and bring to a boil
5. Reduce heat and simmer for 20-25 minutes , to allow flavors to blend
6. Add chopped cilantro and lime juice and stir
7. Serve

title: mom s marvellous macaroni   cheese
steps:
1. Cook macaroni until just al dente
2. You don't want it mushy ! drain and rinse
3. Combine cottage cheese , sour cream , salt , cheese , and macaroni
4. Mix well
5. Pour into 2-quart casserole dish
6. Sprinkle with paprika
7. Bake at 350 for 45 minutes

title: white cheese chicken lasagna
steps:
1. 1
2. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
3. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil
4. Cook lasagna noodles in boiling water for 8 to 10 minutes
5. Drain , and rinse with cold water
6. 2
7. Melt the butter in a large saucepan over medium heat
8. Cook the onion and garlic in the butter until tender , stirring frequently
9. Stir in the flour and salt , and simmer until bubbly
10. Mix in the broth and milk , and boil , stirring constantly , for 1 minute
11. Stir in 2 cups mozzarella cheese and 1 / 4 cup parmesan cheese
12. Season with the basil , oregano , and ground black pepper
13. Remove from heat , and set aside
14. 3
15. Spread 1 / 3 of the sauce mixture in the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish
16. Layer with 1 / 3 of the noodles , the ricotta , and the chicken
17. Arrange 1 / 3 of the noodles over the chicken , and layer with 1 / 3 of the sauce mixture , spinach , and the remaining 2 cups mozzarella cheese and 1 / 2 cup parmesan cheese
18. Arrange remaining noodles over cheese , and spread remaining sauce evenly over noodles
19. Sprinkle with parsley and 1 / 4 cup parmesan cheese
20. 4
21. Bake 35 to 40 minutes in the preheated oven

title: succulent spicy garlic and pepper shrimp
steps:
1. Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a skillet over high heat
2. Add cabbage and 1 tablespoon water and stir-fry for 30 seconds
3. Remove cabbage from skillet and place on a serving platter
4. Heat the remaining 1 1 / 2 tablespoons oil in the skillet over high heat
5. Place the garlic and shrimp in the skillet and stir until garlic is lightly browned and shrimp turns pink
6. Add pepper , onion , cilantro , soy sauce and remaining water to the skillet
7. Stir-fry for 10 seconds
8. Pour the hot mixture onto the cabbage

title: salmon sushi
steps:
1. Jellyroll fashion , roll up the ingredients in the following order
2. Place the dried seaweed on top of a bamboo mat
3. Top with a thin layer of rice , followed by the samon and finally 2 strips each of carrot and cucumber for each roll
4. Roll tightly and slice into 4 pinwheels

title: marinated artichoke salad
steps:
1. In a large mixing bowl , combine artichoke hearts , kalamata olives , red peppers , feta cheese , onion , olive oil , vinegar , garlic , salt , and pepper
2. Mix well
3. Cover and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes to allow flavors to meld
4. Serve as a small salad or a side to go along with a variety of appetizers
5. Or spread on bread

title: cheddar mushroom macaroni
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine the first six ingredients
2. Mix well
3. Stir in macaroni
4. Mix well
5. Transfer to a greased 9 inch baking dish
6. Cover and bake at 325 degrees f for 30 minutes or until heated through and cheese is melted

title: rote rubensalat  red beet salad
steps:
1. Wash beets , trim off greens , place in medium saucepan , and cook , without peeling , in salted water to cover , until beets are tender
2. Peel and slice
3. Prepare marinade dressing by combining remaining ingredients
4. Pour over beets and let stand for several hours before serving
5. Stir beets occasionally

title: easy quick bread
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , sprinkle the yeast onto the warm water and stir until the yeast dissolves
2. Stir in the honey and set aside for a few minutes , until the yeast blooms and swells a bit - 5 - 10 minutes
3. In the meantime , mix the flours , oats , and salt in a large bowl
4. Add the wet mixture to the dry and stir very well
5. Brush a 8-cup loaf pan generously with some of the melted butter
6. Turn the dough into the tin , cover with a clean , slightly damp cloth , and set in a warm place for 30 minutes , to rise
7. Preheat the oven to 350f / 180c , with a rack in the middle
8. When ready , bake the bread for 35-40 minutes , until golden and pulling away from the sides of the pan
9. I finish things up by leaving the bread under the broiler for just a heartbeat - to give the top a bit deeper color
10. Remove from oven , and turn the bread out of the pan quickly
11. Let it cool on a rack so it doesn't steam in the pan
12. Serve warm , slathered with butter
13. Makes 1 loaf
14. Adapted from gran's kitchen: recipes from the

title: 2bleu s sweet mustard sauce for pretzels and more
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together
2. Chill covered in fridge at least 1 hour

title: birthday cake remix ice cream
steps:
1. Mix the milk , cake mix , cream cheese and sugar together with a mixer
2. Mix until smooth
3. Add the cool whip and mix until combined
4. Add the sprinkles and brownies and mix until combined
5. Stir in the chocolate sundae syrup
6. Stirring a little less will give more of a ribbon of chocolate to the ice cream
7. Stirring more will make it more uniformly chocolatey
8. Scoop into a freezable container and freeze

title: dolma  meat filled
steps:
1. Combine meat with olive oil , onion , herbs , rice and season generously
2. Line the pot you will be cooking your dolma in with a couple of layers of torn grape leaves
3. Place a grape leaf , shiny side down , on surface in front of you
4. If the stem is quite thick , cut it out with a knife , making a v
5. Pinch off about a teaspoon of the meat filling and place in the centre of the leaf
6. Fold in sides of leaf and roll up , not too loose and not too tight , into neat little packets
7. Place neatly in pot and continue making dolma until you've used up all your meat mixture
8. Pour lemon juice over and cover dolma with boiling water , covering dolma with about 1 / 2 inch of water
9. Weight down with a plate and put lid on pot
10. Cook at a gentle simmer for 45 minutes to 1 hour , or until rice is tender
11. Carefully remove dolma , and place in a heatproof platter
12. Make egg-lemon sauce
13. Beat the eggs with the lemon juice and corn flour
14. Slowly dribble in hot stock left from cooking dolma , whisking egg mixture constantly
15. Keep adding hot liquid slowly , whisking , to temper the eggs
16. Pour the egg mixture into the pot with the remaining stock and whisk over a medium-low heat until sauce has thickened
17. Pour sauce over your dolma and enjoy !

title: lime chicken with peppers
steps:
1. Combine garlic , broth , 2 tbsp lime juice , soy sauce , chicken , red onion , and red and green peppers in slow cooker
2. Stir to coat chicken
3. Cook on low for about 4 hours
4. In a large skillet , melt butter over low heat
5. As soon as butter is melted sprinkle in 1 / 4 cup of flour
6. Stir with wire whisk
7. Slowly add in whole milk and stir with whisk
8. It should be pretty thick
9. Take your measuring cup and dip it in the slow cooker and get about 1 / 2 cup of the liquid and pour it into the skillet
10. Add in the rest of the flour and stir
11. Get more liquid from slow cooker and add it into creamy mixture
12. Add in about 2 tbsp to 1 / 4 cup of lime juice to the cream mixture
13. Add in the rest of the contents from the slow cooker and stir to combine
14. Add in the pasta and coat
15. Serve with cilantro for garnish , if desired

title: chicken with fennel
steps:
1. Cut the chicken into serving pieces and pat dry
2. Melt the lard in a casserole over medium-high heat and brown the chicken
3. When it is golden brown , add the water and salt to taste
4. Lower the heat and simmer , covered , for 40 to 45 minutes or until tender
5. Meanwhile , wash and thoroughly dry the herbs
6. Grind the almonds finely in a mortar and pestle or food processor , and then add the herbs and blend to a paste
7. Remove the chicken from the casserole and keep it warm in a very low oven , covered loosely with aluminum foil
8. Add the almond mixture to the casserole and reduce over medium heat until the sauce has thickened
9. Arrange the chicken on a serving platter and strain the sauce over the chicken
10. Sprinkle with the spices to taste and serve

title: zucchini carbonara for two vegetarian
steps:
1. Cook pasta in lots of boiling salted water for 6 minutes
2. Meanwhile , trim zucchini , cut lengthwise into thick slices , then into strips , and then dice in small pieces
3. Add the zucchini to the pasta pot and cook until they are tender , but not overly soft , and the pasta is al dente-tender but firm to the bite , about 2 minutes longer
4. Now in a large bowl , beat the egg yolks , parmesan cheese , lemon zest , salt and pepper together
5. Drain the pasta and zucchini , reserving a couple spoonfuls of the cooking water
6. Immediately add to the egg mixture , tossing quickly until the pasta is coated well
7. Add the reserved hot pasta water if it's too dry , and toss again until it's lightly creamy
8. Sprinkle with extra black pepper and parmesan cheese
9. Serve in warm shallow bowls
10. Enjoy !

title: asparagus on toast
steps:
1. Melt butter and stir in four , salt and nutmeg
2. Drain broth from mushrooms and add milk to broth to make 1-1 / 4 cups
3. Add to flour mixture and cook , stirring until thickened
4. Add mushrooms and heat through
5. Blend in sour cream
6. Arrange warm asparagus spears on toast
7. Top with sauce and garnish with pimento

title: andy s south west chicken soup  atkins low carb
steps:
1. Cut chicken breast into chunks , sized to your liking
2. Saut bell pepper , garlic and onion in butter
3. Add chicken to the pan with bell pepper , garlic , onion , and butter
4. Cook chicken just to to the point where it begins to change color
5. Preheat crock pot and add chicken stock , tomatoes , green chilies and the remaining ingredients from the pan
6. Stir in taco or chili seasoning
7. Set crock pot to high for around 45 minutes and reduce heat to low until ready to serve
8. Garnish with sharp cheddar and sour cream
9. Beans
10. Rice
11. Garnish with corn chips

title: spice  a cocktail
steps:
1. In cocktail shaker filled with ice , add rum , pear juice , lime juice , and simple syrup
2. Shake vigorously for about 6 seconds , then strain into 6-ounce cocktail glass
3. Top with dash bitters and a few gratings nutmeg

title: orange glazed brownies
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan , melt chocolate and butter over low heat , stirring constantly
2. Remove pan from heat
3. Stir in sugar , eggs , orange peel , and vanilla
4. Lightly beat mixture with a wooden spoon just until combined
5. Stir in flour and nuts
6. Spread batter in an ungreased 8-inch square baking pan
7. Bake at 350 for 30 minutes
8. Cool completely in pan on wire rack
9. Meanwhile , in a small saucepan , bring whipping cream to a gentle boil over med-low heat , stirring constantly
10. Remove from heat
11. Add in chopped semi-sweet chocolate and orange peel
12. Let stand 1 minute
13. Stir mixture with a wooden spoon until chocolate is melted
14. Cool glaze for 5 minutes before using
15. Pour glaze over cooled brownies , spreading to glaze top evenly
16. Let stand until glaze is set
17. Cut into squares
18. To store: cover and store in refrigerator up to 3 days
19. To freezewrap unglazed uncut brownies in heavy foil and freeze up to 3 months
20. Thaw brownies
21. Glaze and cut into bars

title: kittencal s creamy vanilla milkshake
steps:
1. In a blender combine all ingredients starting with 2 tablespoons sugar
2. Blend until smooth
3. Pour into a tall chilled glass
4. Top with whipped cream and a cherry if desired

title: olive oil sauteed mushrooms
steps:
1. Wash and slice mushrooms , at least 1 / 2 inch thick
2. Heat olive oil in a non stick sautee pan
3. Add mushrooms and allow to brown , before stirring or moving pan
4. Once mushrooms have browned nicely , season with salt and pepper and serve

title: rhubarb strawberry ice cream
steps:
1. Combine rhubarb , sugar , water & strawberries in a pan
2. Bring to a boil , reducing for 10-15 minutes , stirring
3. Add marshmallows and lemon juice and cook until marshmallows are melted
4. Put mixture into a large mixing bowl and refrigerate at least 4 hours
5. In chilled bowl , beat whipping cream to soft peaks
6. Fold into the fruit
7. Add food coloring to make a soft pink color
8. Put into ice cream maker and mix
9. Freeze at least 4 hours

title: beggar s chowder
steps:
1. Coat the slow cooker with non-stick cooking spray
2. Combine the butter , flour , garlic , thyme , paprika and pepper in a small bowl
3. Work into a smooth paste , using the back of a spoon
4. Rub the paste into all sides of the turkey thighs
5. Place the turkey thighs in the slow cooker
6. Add the corn , broth , onion and bell peppers
7. Cover and cook on high for 3 hours or until the turkey is fork tender
8. Remove the turkey and set aside until cool enough to handle
9. Add the mushrooms and tomatoes to the cooking liquid
10. Cover and cook on high 30 minutes longer
11. Meanwhile , remove the turkey from the bones and cut into bite-size pieces
12. When the mushrooms are tender , return the turkey to the slow cooker
13. Add the cream and parsley
14. Cook , covered , about 15 minutes or until heated through
15. Add salt and pepper and garnish with more parsley , if desired

title: fluffy jello dessert
steps:
1. Mix crust ingredients and press onto bottom and slightly up the sides of a buttered 9 x 13 x 2 inch pan
2. Mix jello , water , and sugar together
3. Chill until thick but not stiff
4. Whip the evaporated milk to the consistency of whipped cream
5. Fold into the jello mixture
6. Pour into the graham crust and chill until firm
7. Garnish with extra graham crumbs

title: moist oatmeal cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Mix flour and soda together and set aside
3. Combine butter , white and brown sugars , pudding mix and malted milk powder in mixer bowl
4. Beat until smooth and creamy
5. Add eggs and beat well again
6. Gradually add flour mixture
7. Add oatmeal and mix well
8. Add optional ingredients and stir well
9. Drop onto cookie sheet
10. Bake for 10 minutes

title: potato candy ii
steps:
1. All you do for delicious potato candy is this: combine mashed potatoes , powdered sugar , vanilla , butter and maple syrup until a dough forms
2. It's better to wait until the potato is cooled because if you don't , the sugar melts and you seem to have to add a lot more sugar than if the potato were cooled
3. Roll the dough out to whatever thickness you like
4. Roll it to about 1 / 4 inch or maybe a little thicker
5. Spread peanut butter onto the rolled out dough
6. Roll the candy up and wrap it in wax paper or plastic wrap
7. Put it in the refrigerator to harden it up a little
8. Slice and eat

title: paneer   capsicum
steps:
1. Grate the onions
2. Cube the paneer
3. Slice the capsicums
4. In a kadai heat oil , and add jeera
5. When it splutters , add the grated onions and fry till pink
6. Add the ginger- garlic paste and fry for some more time
7. Add the sliced capsicum and fry for 2 minutes
8. Add all the powder masala and fry
9. Add the pureed tomatoes and salt
10. Let it cook
11. Lastly add the paneer pieces and let it cook in the masala
12. Finally add the milk and the cream
13. Cook for 5 minutes
14. Garnish with coriander leaves and serve it hot with hot parathas
15. This is a favorite dish at all parties
16. The milk and cream makes the gravy rich , thick and creamy

title: berry bundt cake
steps:
1. Blend the eggs and sugar with an electric mixer
2. Add the butter and liqueur and beat until light and fluffy
3. Toss the berries with 2 tablespoons of the flour to coat well
4. Add the remaining flour and baking powder to the egg mixture and beat until the batter is smooth
5. Fold in the berries and pour the batter into a greased and floured 9-in bundt or tube pan
6. Bake in a preheated 325 oven until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean , about 1 hour
7. Remove from the oven and cool for 20 minutes before removing from the pan
8. Allow to cool completely on a wire rack and dust with powdered sugar immediately before serving

title: crunch pumpkin pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425f
2. To prepare crust ~~~ mix oats , flour , almonds , sugar , and salt in a small mixing bowl
3. Blend oil and water in a measuring cup with a small whisk until emulsified
4. Add oil mixture to dry ingredients and mix well
5. If needed , add a small amount of water to hold mixture together
6. Press into a 9-inch pie pan and bake for 8-10 minutes or until light brown
7. Remove crust from oven on place on wire rack
8. Turn down oven to 350f
9. To prepare filling ~~~ mix sugar , cinnamon , nutmeg and salt in a bowl
10. Add egg and vanilla and mix to blend ingredients
11. Add pumpkin and milk and stir to combine
12. To make the pie ~~~ pour filling into prepared pie shell
13. Bake at 350f for 45 minutes or until knife inserted near center comes out clean

title: coffee braised  roast w  caramelized onions   serrano gravy
steps:
1. Season roast with salt and pepper
2. Heat 2 teaspoons oil in large pot over medium heat
3. Add roast and cook 7-10 minutes , turning , until browned on all sides
4. Transfer roast to crock pot
5. Add 2 teaspoons oil to pot on stove
6. Add onions and cook , stirring , 5-7 minutes until golden
7. Add garlic and thyme
8. Cook , stirring , for 1 minute
9. Stir in coffee and vinegar
10. Bring to a simmer
11. Add onion mixture to crock pot
12. Cover and cook until , 4 1 / 2-5 hrs on high or 7-8 hrs on low
13. Transfer roast to plastic cutting board , tent with foil and let rest 10 minutes
14. Pour liquid from crock pot into medium saucepan skim fat from top
15. Bring liquid to boil over medium heat
16. Mix cornstarch in water & add to boiling liquid
17. Cook , stirring with whisk 1 minute till sauce thickens into gravy
18. Add black pepper and remove serrano peppers
19. Carve roast and serve with gravy

title: greek chickpea stew
steps:
1. Saute onion in hot oil in dutch oven for 5 min
2. Add garlic for last minute
3. Stir in tomatoes stock tomato paste chickpeas oregano salt and pepper
4. Bring to a boil reduce heat to low and simmer for 15 min
5. Stirring occasionally
6. Stir in spinach and parsley , cook 5 min
7. Serve topped with feta cheese

title: mesa grill bread rolls
steps:
1. Put yeast , water and sugar in mixer bowl and let proof
2. Meanwhile put water and salt in saucepan , bring to boil , add polenta , bring to boil again stirring , remove from heat
3. Add flour , milk and brown sugar to yeast / water , add polenta , stir / mix / knead until it is soft as a baby's ass but a bit sticky
4. Cover with plastic , proof for 15 minutes
5. Form loaves / rolls , cover with towel and proof for 1 / 2 hour
6. Score loaves / rolls , egg wash and sprinkle with additional polenta
7. Bake at 350 until golden

title: meatballs and kielbasa
steps:
1. Combine cranberry sauce and chili sauce
2. Cut kielbasa into 1 inch chunks
3. Put meatballs and kielbasa in slow cooker
4. Add sauce mixture
5. Cook on low until cooked through--approximately 4 hours

title: beef carbonade
steps:
1. Cook onions in oil in heavy 8 quart pot on medium heat , stirring often until browned , about 30 minutes
2. Preheat oven to 325
3. Combine flour salt and pepper and toss in beef
4. In a lge skillet brown beef , and add to onion mixture
5. Combine remaining ingredients , add and bring to a simmer
6. Cover pot and transfer to oven , cook aprox 2 hours

title: wonderful smokey oven barbecued brisket
steps:
1. Place the brisket in a glass shallow dish
2. Pour the liquid smoke over the brisket then rub all over with fresh garlic
3. Place the onions on and around the brisket
4. In a small bowl mix together the garlic salt , white salt , cayenne pepper and black pepper , then sprinkle the meat all over with the spice mixture
5. Cover and refrigerate for 8 hours
6. Remove the brisket and place on a large piece of heavy-duty foil , then discard the liquid smoke mixture
7. Place the foil with the brisket on it in a large roasting pan , then pour the worcestershire sauce evenly over the brisket
8. Fold the foil up to seal tightly
9. Set oven to 275 degrees
10. Bake for 5 hours
11. Remove from oven and unfold the foil
12. Pour the barbecue sauce evenly over the roast , return to oven uncovered and cook for another hour at 275 degrees
13. Delicious !

title: dolma  algerian stuffed vegetables
steps:
1. Peel the zucchini and potatoes
2. Chop the stem off the zucchinis
3. Chop the potatoes and zucchini in half short ways so now you have 4 zucchini pieces , each about 3 inches long and 4 potato pieces , each about 2 inches long
4. Carefully scoop out the inside of each zucchini piece , leaving a wall about 1 / 4 inch thick around
5. Discard the scooped out part
6. Carefully scoop out each potato in the same manner but save the scooped out portion
7. Mix together the ground meat , 1 tablespoon of parsley , rice , egg , 1 teaspoon salt , 1 / 4 teaspoon pepper and 1 / 4 teaspoon cinnamon
8. Stuff the meat mixture into the potatoes and zucchini , loosely
9. Heat oil in large pan and saute onion and lamb together
10. Add the water and bring to boil over medium high heat
11. Add the chick peas , 1 / 2 teaspoon salt , 1 / 4 teaspoon pepper and 1 / 4 teaspoon cinnamon and simmer over low heat for 20 minutes
12. Put the stuffed vegetables in the sauce along with the reserved potato pieces
13. Cook covered for 1 / 2 hour
14. Remove from heat and add lemon juice and 1 tbsp parsley

title: southern  church  rice
steps:
1. Boil thighs in 4 cups of water until cooked thoroughly -- usually 1 / 2 hour
2. Drain thighs in strainer
3. Chop onion in food chopper
4. Set aside
5. Cut thighs in portion that will allow chopper to easily shred
6. Chop thighs in food chopper or dice if doing by hand
7. Add slice of butter to medium sized pan on high heat , add onions
8. Cook for 1 minute
9. Add shredded / diced chicken and pepper to cooked onions
10. Cook for an additional minute
11. Add rest of butter , can of broth , reserved broth from chicken thighs , and rice
12. Stir until rice is broken up
13. Bring rice to a boil
14. Reduce heat to medium-low apply a tight lid and cook for 20 minutes until water is absorbed
15. Remove from heat , cool for 5 minutes , and then fluff with fork
16. Best served with chicken gravy

title: black bean quesadillas with corn salsa
steps:
1. They should be cooked
2. For vegan omit the cheese or sub in a vegan cheese
3. Preheat the broiler
4. In large hot skillet over med high heat place the olive oil to get hot then add garlic
5. Saut 30 seconds
6. Then add the tomatoes , 1 / 2 cup cilantro , and beans and cook 5 minutes or until liquid evaporates
7. Stir occasionally
8. Place tortillas on a baking sheet coated with cooking spray
9. Top each tortilla with 1 / 2 cup bean mixture and 3 tablespoons cheese
10. Fold in half
11. Lightly coat tops with cooking spray
12. Broil 3 minutes or until cheese melts and tortillas begin to brown
13. Cut each tortilla into 3 wedges
14. Salsa: combine ingredients in a saucepan
15. Bring to a boil over high heat , and cook for 2 minutes , stirring frequently
16. Serve with quesadillas

title: bacon  tomato   parmesan rolls with rosemary mayonnaise
steps:
1. To make the rosemary mayonnaise , place the mayonnaise , rosemary , lemon juice salt and pepper in a bowl and mix to combine
2. Set aside
3. Cook bacon in a fry pan over medium heat both sides until crispy
4. Cut the tops off the rolls , scoop out the centres and discard
5. Spread the rosemary mayonnaise on the inside of each roll
6. Layer the inside of the roll with rocket , bacon , basil , tomato , capsicum , parmesan and a little more rocket and replace the roll tops

title: cheryl s healthy   light sour cream chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Spray an 8 x 8 inch baking dish with olive oil cooking spray
3. Chop up the chicken into bite sized pieces trimming the excess fat and brown over medium heat in the olive oil
4. Add oregano , basil , salt and pepper
5. Stir until chicken looks cooked through
6. When the chicken is done , pour into your prepared pan and spread it out so that it's even
7. In a separate bowl , mix together the sour cream and the soup
8. Spoon this mixture over the chicken spreading it out to cover
9. Place the crackers in a ziploc bag and crush to fine crumbs
10. Spread the crackers over the chicken / soup mixture
11. Spoon the melted butter over the crackers
12. Bake until top is golden brown , approximately 20-30 minutes

title: black death
steps: 1. In a layering glass , layer the ingredients in the following order: kahlua , romana sambuca , bailey's , and half and half

title: creamy lemon fettuccine
steps:
1. Heat the cream in a small pot until it's just about to come to a boil
2. Remove from the heat and add the lemon zest
3. Set aside for 10 minutes
4. Drain the cream through a sieve to remove the lemon zest
5. Put a large pot of water to boil
6. Once it comes to a boil add the fettuccine and cook according to package directions
7. As the fettuccine cook , melt the butter in a large pan
8. Add the lemon cream and bring to a boil
9. Add a bit of salt and pepper
10. Lower the heat and let the cream simmer
11. It will reduce slightly and thicken
12. As soon as the fettuccine are cooked add them to the cream mixture
13. Immediately add the parmigiano reggiano and toss gently until all the fettuccine are covered in the sauce
14. As you toss the pasta , the melting parmigiano and the starch from the pasta will combine to thicken the sauce further
15. Serve the pasta immediately with additional parmigiano
16. Enjoy !

title: bette hagmans four flour pastry  gluten free pie crust
steps:
1. In a medium bowl whisk together the flours , xanthan gum , baking powder , salt and sugar
2. Cut in the margarine and crisco with a pastry cutter or two knives in small pieces until you have shortening the size of lima beans
3. In a separate bowl , beat together the egg , vinegar and 3 tablespoons of the ice water with a fork
4. Pour egg mixture into the dry ingredients and stir with your fork
5. Add 3 more tablespoons of ice water and stir for another 20-30 seconds
6. Continue to add water , 1 tbsp at a time , and stir until there are no crumbs left at the bottom of the bowl
7. Generously sprinkle your pastry cloth with sweet rice flour and rub around so it coats the area you will be working on
8. Roll your rolling pin through the flour on the cloth so it is fully coated as well
9. Divide dough into two halves and roll the first half out so it is about of an inch thick
10. Put the pin at one edge of the dough , lift up your pastry cloth and roll it over the rolling pin so the dough rolls up on top of the rolling pin
11. Lay the pastry cloth back on the counter and continue to roll the rolling pin so the dough is wrapped around it partially
12. Move your pie plate next to the rolling pin
