13. Lift up the rolling pin , gently holding the dough on top so it does not slide off , and drag the dangling edge so that it is laying about an inch over the edge of the pie plate
14. Carefully unroll the crust the rest of the way into the pan
15. Trim the edges of your crust so it hangs 1 inch over the edge of the pie plate
16. Lift the over hanging crust and fold under about 1 1 / 2 inch of the crust so you can see the rim of your pie plate all the way around
17. Add the pie filling and roll out the second half of the dough
18. Either place the second crust over the filling or into another pie plate
19. Pinch the edges using your thumb and pointer finger on both hands to make a decorative sealed edging
20. Bake as directed for the filling used
21. Put strips of tin foil over the edges of the crust until the last 15 minutes of baking to prevent the crust from browning too much
22. For a baked pie shell , prick the pastry with a fork on the sides and bottom
23. Bake in a preheated 425 degree oven for about 12-14 minutes
24. Cool before filling
25. Makes one 2-crust pie or 2 pie shells

title: sweet refrigerator pickles with onion
steps:
1. Mix cucumbers , onions , bell peppers , and salt
2. Cover and store in refrigerator for 2 hours
3. Drain liquid off and set cucumber mix aside
4. In large pot , mix sugar , vinegar , and mustard seeds
5. Heat until sugar melts
6. Remove from heat
7. Mix in cucumber mixture
8. Put in jars , let cool , then refrigerate
9. I was told this will last 2 weeks in an airtight tupperware type bowl-- but i put them in pint sized canning jars and they sealed
10. ~i do keep them in the refrigerator as they are called "refrigerator pickles" and they will ruin if they were not kept cold
11. ~
12. As for the mustard seed or celery seed-- we prefer mustard , but everyone has their own taste
13. My dad uses these pickles as hot dog relish

title: mc call s cooking school manicotti
steps:
1. Make sauce: in hot oil in a 5 quart dutch oven , saute onion and garlic 5 minutes
2. Mix in rest of sauce ingredients and 1 1 / 2 cups water , mashing tomatoes with fork
3. Bring to boiling , and reduce heat
4. Simmer mixture , covered and stirring occasionally , 1 hour
5. Make manicotti: in medium bowl , combine 6 eggs , the flour , 1 / 4 teaspoon salt , and 1 1 / 2 cups water with electric mixer
6. Beat just until smooth
7. Let stand 1 / 2 hour or longer
8. Slowly heat an 8" skillet
9. If you aren't using a skillet with a non-stick surface , brush skillet lightly with butter for each manicotti
10. Pour in 3 tablespoons batter , rotating the skillet quickly to spread batter evenly over bottom
11. Cook over medium heat until top is dry but bottom is not brown
12. Turn out on a wire rack to cool
13. Continue cooking until all of the batter is used
14. As the manicotti cool , stack them with waxed paper between them
15. Preheat oven to 350
16. Make filling: in large bowl , combine ricotta , mozarrella , 1 / 3 cup parmesan , the eggs , salt , pepper , and parsley
17. Beat with wooden spoon to blend well
18. Spread about 1 / 4 cup filling down the center of each manicotti and roll up
19. Spoon 1 1 / 2 cups sauce into each of two 12x8x2" baking dishes
20. Place 8 rolled manicotti seam side down in single layer
21. Top with 5 more
22. Cover with 1 cup sauce and sprinkle with parmesan
23. Bake , uncovered , 1 / 2 hour or until bubbly

title: inside out stuffed green bell peppers
steps:
1. In a skillet , brown beef
2. Drain
3. Transfer to a greased 2-quart casserole dish
4. Add the next 8 ingredients
5. Cover and bake at 350f for 1 hour or until rice is tender
6. Uncover and sprinkle with the cheese
7. Return to the oven until cheese melts , about 5 minutes

title: golden crusted brussels sprouts recipe
steps:
1. Gently rub each brussel sprout half with olive oil , keeping it intact
2. Heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat
3. Dont overheat the skillet , or the outsides of the brussels sprouts will cook too quickly
4. Place the brussels sprouts in the pan flat side down , sprinkle with a couple pinches of salt , cover , and cook for roughly 5 minutes
5. The bottoms of the sprouts should only show a hint of browning
6. Cut into or taste one of the sprouts to gauge whether theyre tender throughout
7. If not , cover and cook for a few more minutes
8. Once just tender , uncover , turn up the heat , and cook until the flat sides are deep brown and caramelized
9. Use a metal spatula to toss them once or twice to get some browning on the rounded side
10. Season with more salt , a few grinds of pepper , and a dusting of grated cheese
11. Serve immediately

title: asian shrimp and pasta
steps:
1. Place cooked pasta in a large bowl
2. Stir together soy sauce , vinegar , and sesame oil
3. Drizzle over pasta
4. Add green onions , water chestnuts , & cilantro to pasta
5. Toss
6. Saut ginger & garlic in hot oil 1-2 minutes , do not let it turn brown
7. Add shrimp , lime juice , & pepper
8. Cook & stir 3-5 minutes , just until shrimp turn pink
9. Add to pasta
10. Toss well
11. To serve , top with peanuts

title: creamy peaches
steps:
1. Thinly slice 4 peach slices
2. Set aside for garnish
3. Place remaining peaches in a food processor
4. Add cottage cheese
5. Cover and process until blended
6. Add cream cheese and sugar substitute
7. Cover and process until blended
8. Spoon into four serving dishes
9. Top with reserved peaches
10. Refrigerate until serving

title: mom s lasagna
steps:
1. In a large kettle or dutch oven , cook beef , sausage and onion until meat is browned and onion is tender
2. Drain
3. Stir in the next 10 ingredients
4. Simmer , uncovered , for 3 hours , stirring occasionally
5. Meanwhile , cook lasagna noodles according to pkg directions
6. Drain and rinse in cold water
7. In a greased 13 x 9 x 2 baking dish , layer a third of the noodles & meat sauce
8. Half of the cottage cheese
9. A third of the mozzarella
10. And a third of the parmesan
11. Repeat layers
12. Top with the remaining noodles , meatsauce , mozzarella and parmesan
13. Cover and bake at 350 for 45 minutes
14. Uncover and bake for 20 minutes
15. Let stand 20 minutes before cutting

title: mandarin orange cheesecake pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. Mix cream cheese , sugar , orange juice concentrate , eggs , and reserved mandarin juice on medium speed until fluffy
3. Pour into shortbread crust
4. Carefully arrange mandarin slices on top
5. Sprinkle with a little light brown sugar , which will caramelize with the mandarin while baking
6. Bake at 375 for 30-35 minutes , or until cheese portions you can see on top are slightly golden and cheesecake has set
7. Remove from oven
8. Allow to cool on counter , then refrigerate for 3 hours

title: cranberry date spread
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a medium saucepan
2. Cook over medium heat 8-10 minutes or until fruit is tender
3. Stir frequently
4. Position knife blade in food processor bowl , add fruit mixture , and process until smooth
5. Spoon into hot sterilized jars , covering at once with metal lids and screw on bands
6. Let stand at room temperature 2 hours , then store in the refrigerator

title: simple rosti
steps:
1. Scrub the potatoes but leave the skin on
2. Cook the potatoes in boiling water for 7 minutes and allow to cool completely
3. When cool grate into a bowl
4. Heat 15g of the butter and cook the onion until soft
5. Stir the onion mix into the potato
6. Melt half of the remaining butter in a frying pan and add the potato mixture forming it into a cake shape
7. Cook for 15 minutes or until the bottom of the cake is brown
8. Melt the remaining butter and pour over the top of the cake
9. Turn the rosti over and cook until golden

title: kate s moist and tender corned beef  cabbage  and vegetables
steps:
1. To a large soup pot , place corned beef brisket and all the spices and juices that came in its bag
2. Add onions , celery , garlic , water to cover , bay leaf , salt and pepper
3. Bring to a boil , cover , and simmer for 3 hours
4. Add carrots
5. Bring to a boil and simmer for 1 hour
6. Add potatoes
7. Bring to a boil and simmer for 1 hour
8. Add cabbage and turnips
9. Bring to a boil and simmer for 40 minutes
10. Add worcestershire sauce and parsley , and simmer for 20 minutes
11. Turn off burner
12. Remove corned beef brisket from pot
13. Let corn beef brisket rest for 10 minutes and then slice in 1 / 3 to 1 / 2 inch slices across the grain
14. Return corn beef to pot
15. Parsley sauce: saut onion in butter until lightly golden on medium heat
16. Add garlic and saut for 2 minutes more
17. Stir in flour and cook , stirring constantly , until lightly golden
18. Whisk in broth
19. Bring to a boil , and simmer for 10 minutes , stirring often
20. In a small bowl , combine sour cream , horseradish , parsley , and salt
21. Stir sour cream mixture into hot pan
22. Cook until heated through , but do not boil
23. To serve , transfer the tender corned beef , cabbage , and vegetables to a large platter or to individual plates
24. Pour the parsley sauce into a gravy bowl
25. Each person can use as much parsley sauce on top of the corned beef as they prefer

title: linguini with canned tuna
steps:
1. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil
2. When boiling , cook the linguini
3. Heat oil in a large skillet and add the garlic , red pepper flakes and fennel seeds
4. Cook until garlic is golden
5. Add the tuna and sea salt
6. Then add the tomatoes and bring to a boil
7. Reduce heat to a simmer and simmer 4 minutes
8. Add the lemon zest
9. Drain the cooked linguini and add to the pan with the tuna mixture
10. Toss gently and serve , garnished with chopped parsley

title: vegan carrot cake
steps:
1. Grease and flour a 13" x 9" pan
2. Stir together dry ingredients
3. Now add to the dry mixture , the carrots , tofu , oil , and vanilla
4. Beat about 2 to 3 minutes until well mixed
5. Stir in the nuts
6. Bake at 325 degrees for about 50 to 60 minutes
7. Cool on a wire rack
8. Frost and enjoy

title: chicken and noodles with dumplings
steps:
1. Bring to a boil in a large kettle 6 qts water , add salt and spices
2. When the water is boiling add chicken , celery , onion , garlic and vinegar and worcestershire
3. Cover and cook at least 1 hour
4. Remove chicken and set aside to cool
5. Remove broth from heat
6. Cooke noodles in a pot of boiling , lightly salted water
7. Cook according to package instructions
8. Drain and set aside
9. When the chicken is cool , clean off skin and bones and shred meat
10. Salt and pepper meat and set it aside
11. When broth is cool , skim off fat and discard
12. In a dutch oven or deep skillet , heat butter
13. Add flour and stir , adding small amounts of chicken broth to thicken
14. Add soup and 1 cup of chicken broth
15. Make your dumplings now
16. Add noodles , chicken and vegies
17. Cover and lower heat to simmer approximately 20-25 minutes
18. Add dumplings to the top of the dish and cover
19. Simmer for approximately 10 minutes
20. If you don't have enough broth to cook dumplings add more broth
21. Put the remaining broth into freezer containers and freeze for use later

title: iced espresso
steps:
1. Prepare coffee with shredded orange peel and water in a drip coffee maker or percolator according to manufacturer's directions
2. Pour coffee into a heatproof pitcher
3. Stir in sugar and milk
4. Chill at least 3 hours or until serving time
5. To serve , fill 6 glasses with ice cubes
6. Pour coffee mixture over ice
7. Garnish with orange peel strips and grated chocolate , if desired

title: quinoa applesauce muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
2. Sprinkle hazelnut flour over the apricots and set aside
3. Blend the baking soda , baking powder , salt , cloves and cinnamon with the quinoa flour
4. Separately mix together butter , sugar and egg
5. Combine all ingredients , adding the floured fruit at the end
6. Spoon into an oiled muffin tin and bake for 15 to 20 minutes , or until slightly spongy to the touch

title: pretty in pink pasta
steps: 1. Combine all cooked ingredients and simmer on low heat 10-15 minutes or until heated through

title: strawberry dreams
steps:
1. Wash strawberries
2. Cut out small hole / core in tops of strawberries
3. Blend cream cheese , sour cream , powdered sugar& extract in a bowl on medium speed until light and fluffy
4. Fold 2 tbsp of grated chocolate into cream mixture
5. Spoon mixture into a decorating bag with decorating
6. Squeeze the cream mixture into the holes / cores of the strawberries
7. Finally , top each strawberry off with a blueberry
8. Best if chilled for at least an hour before serving

title: caramel corn  with peanuts
steps:
1. Place popped popcorn in two very large bowls
2. Mix 1 / 2 pound peanuts into each bowl
3. In 5 quart sauce pan combine all the other ingredients
4. Bring to a boil over medium heat , boil for 5 minutes stirring constantly
5. Evenly distribute the syrup between the two bowls and stir until well coated
6. Turn coated popcorn into a large roasting pan
7. Bake at 250 degrees for 1 hour
8. Remove and break apart while still warm
9. Store in air tight containers

title: julie s lentil nut mushroom burgers
steps:
1. Using a food processor , finely mince the appropriate ingredients listed above
2. In a saucepan , bring the lentils , vinegar , oil , and water to a boil
3. Reduce the temperature , and simmer , partly-covered , 30 minutes or until the lentils are soft and the liquid is absorbed
4. In the meantime , saute remaining ingredients together over medium heat in butter and additional olive oil for 10 to 15 minutes and all are tender
5. When lentils are soft , and liquid is gone , place in large bowl and mash
6. Add the mushroom mixture to the mashed or processed lentils , and mix well
7. Chill for about 1 hour
8. Make 4-inch patties from chilled mixture
9. For freezing , make patties , place wax paper between each patty and stack
10. Wrap well and freeze
11. To cook: fry burgers in butter until brown , or broil about 8 minutes on each side
12. Try putting sesame seeds in pan to keep burgers from sticking to pan , if it is a problem
13. Serve either as patties , as burgers in a whole-wheat bun , or filling for a pita
14. Good with cheese melted on top , basil sprinkled on each burger is tasty also

title: copycat cheryl   co  buttery sugar cookies
steps:
1. In mixing bowl , cream together butter and sugar
2. Add egg , vanilla
3. Mix well
4. Combine flour , baking powder and salt
5. Add to creamed mixture and mix well
6. Put dough into cookie press with desired plate
7. Form cookies onto ungreased cookie sheets
8. Bake at 375 degrees for 6-8 minutes or until set , not brown
9. Cool on wire racks
10. Beat together butter , vanilla and 2 cups powdered sugar in mixing bowl
11. Add milk
12. Continue adding sugar in 1 / 2 cup increments until desired consistency is reached
13. Add food coloring to all or a portion of frosting and frost cookies
14. Enjoy !

title: meatball sub bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f / 190c
2. Place in a greased 9x13 baking dish
3. Cut each refrigerated biscuit into 8 pieces
4. Pour on the sauce , stir to coat all sides of the biscuits
5. Place the meatballs on top of the mixture
6. Top with the shredded cheese , and bake for 35 minutes
7. Enjoy !

title: bean soup  fasolatha
steps:
1. Soak the beans in water overnight to soften up
2. The following day rinse , drain and place them in a pot with water
3. Add the carrots , the celery , the tomatoes , the onions , the olive oil and let everything boil over a medium fire for about 1 1 / 2-2 hours
4. Serve warm with anchovies or grilled herring and black olives

title: orange and apricot glazed chicken cups
steps:
1. For glaze , in a blender or small food processor , combine the apricot preserves , orange juice concentrate , soy sauce , vinegar , and garlic
2. Cover and blend or process until smooth
3. Remove 1 / 4 cup to brush over chicken
4. Set remaining glaze aside
5. Season chicken lightly with salt and pepper
6. Brush with some of the 1 / 4 cup glaze
7. For a charcoal grill , grease the grill rack
8. Place chicken on grill rack over medium-hot coals
9. Cover and grill about 10 minutes or until chicken is done , turning once and brushing again with glaze halfway through
10. Remove chicken from grill and let rest for 5 minutes
11. Discard any remaining brush-on
12. While chicken is grilling , toss green beans in a bowl with oil and a dash salt and pepper
13. Place in a grill wok and place on the grill beside chicken the last 5 minutes of grilling , stirring once or twice
14. Remove and cool slightly
15. Cut beans crosswise into 1 / 2-inch pieces
16. Chop chicken
17. In a medium bowl toss chicken and beans with about 1 / 4 cup reserved glaze
18. Spoon rice onto lettuce leaves
19. Top with chicken mixture and drizzle with any remaining glaze
20. Makes 4 servings

title: tuna and egg salad
steps:
1. Whisk the dressing ingredients together and season with the salt and pepper
2. Set aside
3. Place mixed lettuce leaves onto 4 plates
4. Add the tomato wedges , sliced onion and capsicum
5. Top with the eggs , olives and tuna
6. Sprinkle with the chopped parsley
7. Drizzle over the dressing and serve

title: beer batter for fish  shrimp   onion rings
steps:
1. Mix flour , salt , and baking powder in a bowl using a fork
2. Beat beer , egg and oil together in a separate bowl
3. Stir into flour mixture until well blended
4. Batter should be pretty smooth and moderately thick
5. Dip fish , shrimp , or onion slices in coating and deep-fry in hot oil that has been heated to 350 degrees , until it becomes golden
6. Drain , and serve while hot and crispy
7. This recipe also works well with chicken tenders and vegetable pieces
8. Whatever you like to coat with beer batter

title: vegan peanut butter cookies    for picky people
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. In a mixing bowl beat margarine and peanut butter with an electric mixer on medium to high speed for 30 seconds
3. Add 1 / 2 cup of the flour , the sugars , egg sub
4. , baking soda , baking powder , and vanilla
5. Beat till throughly combined
6. Beat in remaining flour
7. If necessary , cover and chill dough till easy to handle
8. Shape dough into 1-2inch balls
9. If desired , roll in additional sugar
10. Place 2 inches apart on an un-greased cookie sheet
11. Flatten by cross crossing the tops with the tines of a fork
12. Bake in a 375 oven for 7-9 or till bottoms are lightly browned
13. Cool cookies on wire rack after a few minutes of sitting on the trey
14. Don't leave them there too long or they will get crispy

title: maple glazed pork tenderloins
steps:
1. In a plastic , resealable bag combine the first 5 in bag
2. Seal and shake well
3. Add pork slices to bag , reseal and shake to coat the pork well
4. In large nonstick skillet melt margarine or butter over medium-high heat
5. Add pork mixture to skillet , cook 8-10 minutes or until browned and no longer pink
6. When browned , add syrup and glaze pork well while stirring

title: buttered sugar snaps and green peas
steps:
1. Bring a large skillet half full of lightly salted water to a boil
2. Add snap peas and green peas
3. Return to boil
4. Boil 1 minute or until snap peas are crisp-tender
5. Do not overcook
6. Drain
7. Rinse with cold water and drain well again
8. Melt butter in skillet
9. Add snap peas , green peas , salt and pepper
10. Cook over medium-high heat , stirring , until hot
11. Remove to serving bowl
12. Sprinkle with mint , if desired

title: bhutanese cheese curry  ema daji
steps:
1. Put the chiles , onion , water and oil in a medium pot and bring to a boil
2. Cover , reduce the heat slightly and cook at a strong simmer for 15 minutes
3. Add the tomatoes and garlic and bring back to a boil , then simmer uncovered for 10 minutes , or until the tomatoes are melting into the liquid and the garlic has softened
4. Add the cheese and simmer for another 3 to 4 minutes
5. Stir , remove from the heat , cover , and let sit for 10 minutes before serving
6. This is best served warm , not hot
7. Stir in coriander leaves , add salt and pepper to taste and serves
8. This is usually served with bhutanese red rice , but it is also good with plain rice accompanied with a stir fried green vegetable

title: shrimp and chorizo saute
steps:
1. In a large skillet , heat 2 t oil over medium heat
2. Add the chorizo and cook , stirring , until lightly browned , about 4 minutes
3. Using a slotted spoon , transfer to a paper-towel-lined plate
4. Add the remaining 2 t oil , the garlic and red pepper flakes to the skillet and cook , shaking the pan a bit , until the garlic is lightly golden
5. Increase the heat to high , add the shrimp and stir to coat
6. Add the wine and cook , stirring , until the pan is nearly dry , 2-3 minutes
7. Return the chorizo to the pan , season with salt and pepper and sprinkle with the parsley
8. Cook until the chorizo is hot and the shrimp is opaque , about 2 minutes
9. Place the toasts on 4 plates
10. Spoon the shrimp , chorizo and pan juices on top

title: mr  steward s favorite hot cocoa
steps:
1. Place cocoa , sugar and salt in a saucepan
2. Add 2 / 3 cup milk and heat while stirring to make a thick chocolate paste
3. Add remainder of milk and vanilla
4. Heat until hot

title: monkey and gorilla bread
steps:
1. ::||monkey bread instructions||::
2. Butter and flour a bundt pan and set aside
3. Preheat oven to 350f
4. Combine sugar and cinnamon
5. Cut refrigerator biscuits in half and toss in cinnamon and sugar mixture
6. Melt the 1 stick of butter in a saucepan and add brown sugar and bring to a boil
7. Then add nuts
8. Line the bundt pan with biscuits and pour butter mixture over them
9. Bake for about 30 minutes
10. Remove from the pan when it's still hot to avoid sticking
11. ::||gorilla bread instructions||::
12. Butter and flour a bundt pan and set aside
13. Preheat oven to 350f
14. Combine sugar and cinnamon
15. Separate biscuits and flatten each slightly with your hand
16. Sprinkle 1 / 2 teaspoon of the cinnamon and sugar mixture onto each biscuit
17. Place one cube of cream cheese in center of biscuit and fold in half to resemble a half moon
18. Melt the 1 stick of butter in a saucepan and add brown sugar and bring to a boil
19. Remove from the heat
20. Place 1 / 2 cup nuts on the bottom of the bundt pan and then line the pan with a row of cream cheese filled biscuits
21. Sprinkle with half of the cinnamon and sugar mixture
22. Drizzle half of the butter mixture on top and then repeat steps , beginning with nuts
23. Bake for about 30 minutes
24. Remove from the pan when it's still hot to avoid sticking
25. Place the monkey on the gorilla's back and enjoy !

title: schroeder s spread
steps:
1. Combine first five ingredients until thoroughly mixed
2. Add mayonnaise and mix again well
3. Chill at least two hours

title: carraba s limoncello bread pudding
steps:
1. Put bread in 9-by-9-by-2-inch pan or a 2-quart baking dish
2. Whisk cream , milk , eggs , sugar , vanilla extract and limoncello
3. Pour over bread
4. Let sit 20 minutes
5. Heat oven to 350f
6. Cover pudding with foil
7. Bake 40-50 minutes or until pudding is set
8. For simple syrup , combine limoncello and sugar in a small pan
9. Bring to boil , stirring , to dissolve sugar
10. Drizzle over bread pudding

title: cauliflower salad made like  potato salad   low carb
steps: 1. Combine ingredients and chill before serving

title: avocado mousse
steps:
1. Sprinkle gelatin over broth and stir over low heat until melted
2. Add vinegar , onion , and lime juice
3. Mix well
4. Chill
5. Cut avocados , peel , seed , & beat until smooth & creamy
6. Blend 2 cups of the avocado mixture with mayonnaise and the broth mixture
7. Season with salt & hot sauce to taste
8. Fold in whipped cream & pour into 6 cup mold
9. Chill for 4 hours or until firm

title: zesty chicken with artichokes
steps:
1. Combine thyme , lemon peel , salt , and pepper
2. Rub into chicken
3. Heat 2 teaspoons oil in nonstick skillet over medium heat
4. Brown chicken
5. Remove and set aside
6. In same skillet , heat remaining oil
7. Saute onion and garlic until tender
8. Stir in artichoke hearts , wine , and olives
9. Return chicken to pan
10. Bring to a boil
11. Reduce heat , cover , and simmer 6-8 minutes or until chicken is cooked through
12. Remove chicken from pan
13. Cover and keep warm
14. Simmer sauce uncovered for 2-3 minutes or until most of the liquid has evaporated
15. Serve chicken with sauce

title: black bean chili with butternut squash
steps:
1. Heat oil in heavy large pot over medium-high heat
2. Add onions and cook until soft and beginning to brown , stirring often , about 8 minutes
3. Add garlic
4. Stir 1 minute
5. Sprinkle chili powder and coriander over
6. Stir 1 minute
7. Stir in tomatoes with juice , beans , chipotles , and oregano
8. Add 10 cups water
9. Bring to boil , reduce heat to low , cover with lid slightly ajar , and simmer until beans are tender , stirring occasionally , about 2 hours
10. Season to taste with coarse salt and freshly ground black pepper
11. Stir squash and bulgur into chili
12. Simmer uncovered over medium-low heat until squash and bulgur are tender , about 30 minutes
13. Season to taste with salt and pepper
14. Divide chili among bowls
15. Serve with sour cream , cheese , red onion , cilantro , and pickled jalapeo rings
16. Ahead chili can be made up to 2 days ahead
17. Cool slightly
18. Refrigerate uncovered until cold , then cover and keep chilled
19. Rewarm chili before continuing

title: fish with cumin pepper curry
steps:
1. Combine first 7 ingredients in a small bowl
2. Add 1 / 4 teaspoon of black pepper , stirring until well blended
3. Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat
4. Add onion
5. Cook 3 minutes , stirring occasionally
6. Add ginger mixture
7. Cook 1 minute , stirring frequently
8. Add broth
9. Bring to a boil
10. Reduce heat , and simmer 5 minutes
11. Add coconut milk and juice
12. Simmer 2 minutes
13. Sprinkle fish with remaining 1 / 4 teaspoon black pepper and salt
14. Add fish to pan
15. Cook 8 minutes or until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork or until the desired degree of doneness
16. Garnish with the chopped fresh parsley , if desired

title: ina garten s jalapeno cheddar cornbread  barefoot contessa
steps:
1. Combine the flour , cornmeal , sugar , baking powder , and salt in a large bowl
2. In a separate bowl , combine the milk , eggs , and butter
3. With a wooden spoon , stir the wet ingredients into the dry until most of the lumps are dissolved
4. Don't overmix !
5. Mix in 2 cups of the grated cheddar , the scallions and jalapenos , and allow the mixture to sit at room temperature for 20 minutes
6. Meanwhile , preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
7. Grease a 9 by 13 by 2-inch baking pan
8. Pour the batter into the prepared pan , smooth the top , and sprinkle with the remaining grated cheddar and extra chopped scallions
9. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes , or until a toothpick comes out clean
10. Cool and cut into large squares
11. Serve warm or at room temperature

title: mushroom whatnots
steps:
1. Filling:
2. Blend in a mixer cheese , sour cream and mayonnaise until smooth
3. Add remaining ingredients and continuing mixing until creamy
4. Gently wash mushrooms and remove steams
5. Fill hole in cap with cream cheese mixture
6. Top each mushroom with a piece of cheese
7. Butter topping:
8. Whip butter until smooth
9. Add remaining ingredients and mix until smooth
10. Place a dab of seasoned butter on top of cheese
11. Place mushrooms in shallow baking pan
12. Bake at 350 degrees for about 15 minutes

title: vegetable deviled eggs
steps:
1. Place onion , carrot , and celery in food processor with metal blade inserted and chop fine
2. Add cottage cheese , mayo , sugar , and lemon juice to mix and blend until smooth
3. Place approximately 1 tablespoon into each egg-white half
4. Garnish with paprika and parsley if desired

title: gooseberry pie
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients , except pie crusts
2. Let stand for 15 minutes
3. Pour into 1 pie crust
4. Top with the remaining crust
5. Pinch and seal edges
6. Bake at 350f for 30 minutes

title: lanai baked beans
steps:
1. Rub deep casserole with butter and pour in beans
2. Blend brown sugar , mustard and salt with juice and into beans along with half the pineapple and half the meat
3. Arrange remaining fruit and meat atop mixture and bake one hour at 350f
4. Cover casserole during last 20 mins , if fruit browns too fast

title: halibut salmon marinade
steps:
1. Mix ingredients together
2. Place in flat tupperware container and store in refridgerator
3. Marinate 6-24 hours

title: blue cheese orzo salad
steps:
1. Cook orzo according to package directions
2. Drain and place in a large bowl
3. Add the arugula , bacon , blue cheese , onions and walnuts
4. In a blender , combine the first six vinaigrette ingredients
5. Cover and process until blended
6. While procession , gradually add oil in a steady stream
7. Drizzle over salad
8. Toss to coat
9. Serve the salad immediately

title: easy cheesy mexican dip
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Spread cream cheese evenly on the bottom of casserole dish
3. Layer chili on top of the cream cheese
4. Distribute grated cheese evenly over the top
5. Bake in oven until cheese melts , approximately 12 to 15 minutes
6. Serve warm with tortilla chips

title: jalapeo cornbread
steps:
1. Beat "egg beaters" or egg whites , and add remaining ingredients , mixing well
2. Pour into large cast iron skillet that has been sprayed with a nonfat cooking spray
3. Bake at 350f for 50-60 minutes

title: chicken fricassee with lemon mustard sauce
steps:
1. Put oven rack in middle position and preheat oven to 500f
2. Heat oil in a 12-inch heavy skillet over moderate heat until hot but not smoking
3. While oil is heating , sprinkle chicken with 1 teaspoon salt and 1 / 2 teaspoon pepper , then dredge , 1 piece at a time , in 3 / 4 cup flour , knocking off excess
4. Brown in 4 batches , turning over occasionally , until golden , 5 to 6 minutes per batch
5. Transfer to a platter as browned
6. Stir together carrots , onions , garlic , cream , wine , lemon juice , mustard , thyme , bay leaf , and remaining teaspoon salt and 1 / 2 teaspoon pepper in a 5- to 6-quart heavy pot , then bring to a gentle boil over moderate heat , stirring occasionally
7. Add chicken and partially cover pot , then braise in oven 25 minutes
8. Reduce oven temperature to 350f and braise 20 minutes more
9. Transfer chicken to a clean platter and keep warm , loosely covered with foil
10. Pour cooking liquid through a sieve into a bowl , discarding solids , then stir in water
11. Melt butter in a 2 1 / 2- to 3-quart heavy saucepan over moderately low heat , then whisk in remaining 2 tablespoons flour and cook roux , whisking constantly , 3 minutes
12. Add cooking liquid in a fast stream , whisking vigorously , then cook at a bare simmer , whisking constantly , 5 minutes
13. Serve chicken with sauce

title: chocolate custard tart
steps:
1. In a 2 quart pan , heat milk slowly over a low heat
2. In a small bowl whisk together sugar and cornstarch
3. Add to hot milk and cook over medium heat , stirring often , until mixture thickens and starts to bubble
4. Cook for 3 minutes , stirring continually
5. Turn heat to lowest setting
6. In another bowl whisk egg yolks
7. Add a small amount of hot milk mixture to yolks while whisking to warm yolks- not to cook them
8. In a thin stream add the warmed eggs to the the rest of the milk mixture , while whisking continually
9. Cook over low heat for 2 more minutes
10. Remove custard from heat and stir in vanilla , butter , and chocolate
11. Dissolve gelatin in cold water and stir into custard
12. Pour immediately into pie shell and refrigerate for at least 3 hours
13. Pretty when garnished with chocolate curls

title: buffalo shrimp  oamc
steps:
1. To freeze: combine ingredients from oil through hot sauce to make marinade
2. Place shrimp in labeled freezer bag or container
3. Pour marinade over shrimp , seal , and freeze
4. To cook: thaw in refrigerator
5. You have several options for cooking: skewer shrimp and broil or grill
6. Or simply panfry for a few minutes
7. You only need to heat these up , they are already cooked
8. Discard extra marinade
9. Options: use as an appy with ranch dip , add these to pasta , serve over rice , turn into tacos , endless really !

title: reheating cooked shellfish
steps:
1. Thaw seafood , rinse and pat dry on paper towels
2. To steam: place one inch of water in a large pot , bring to a boil
3. Place shellfish in a steaming rack or colander and lower into boiling water - if the bottom of the rack goes below the level of the water , empty out some of the water as you don't want your shellfish to be sitting in water
4. You may have to break crab legs to fit into the pot
5. Cover pot and cook as follows:
6. Snow crab legs or claws - 5 minutes
7. King crab legs - 8 minutes
8. Maine lobster or dungeness crab - 10 minutes
9. In oven: preheat oven to 400
10. Wrap clean , thawed shellfish in foil , forming a tent
11. Place in oven for 20 minutes
12. Remember , you are only reheating , not cooking your frozen , thawed shellfish
13. Serve with melted herb , or garlic , or plain butter

title: mini nutella brownies 4 ingredients
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Use paper or foil liners in a 12-cup mini muffin pan
3. Add the nutella spread and egg to a medium bowl and whisk until well blended
4. Whisk in the flour until well blended
5. Spoon the batter into each prepared muffin tin and sprinkle each with some of the chopped nuts
6. Bake for 11-12 minutes
7. Cool completely on a rack

title: chocolate coconut fudge
steps:
1. Grease an 8-inch square pan
2. Slowly add in sugar to softened cream cheese
3. Combine well with each addition of sugar
4. Add other ingredients in to mix
5. Blend well
6. Pour mixture into pan
7. Refrigerate for several hours before cutting up
8. Enjoy !

title: chicken and pasta salad with raw vegetables
steps:
1. Toss hot pasta with 3 / 4 cup of salad dressing , reserve remainder to serve on side with completed salad
2. Cover and chill 12 hours
3. Just before serving toss chicken with mayonnaise and pasta and place on a platter
4. Sprinkle tomatoes , scallions , mushrooms , green pepper and croutons on top of chicken and pasta
5. Serve with reserved dressing

title: achiote pork torta    sandwiches
steps:
1. In a blender or food processor , combine the garlic , vinegar , juices , salt , and cumin
2. Pulse until well combined
3. Crumble in the achiote and pulse to combine into a very soft paste
4. Add more vinegar by the tablespoon to loosen it up if necessary
5. Blend in the cilantro
6. Cut the meat into lenghtwise slices 1 / 2 to 3 / 4 inch thick
7. Lay the meat between two sheets of plastic wrap and pound to an even thickness of 1 / 4 inch
8. Coat the slices generously with the paste and refrigerate for at least 6 hours and no more than 12 hours
9. Half an hour before cooking , clrean the grill thoroughly with a brush and wipe it down with an oil-dampened rag
10. Preheat the grill on high
11. Remove the meat from the marinade and shake off as much of the paste as possible
12. Place the meat on the grill , close the lid , and grill for 5 to 7 minutes on each side , checking often to make sure the meat doesn't burn or cook too quickly
13. If it does , move it to a cooler part of the grill
14. The meat is done perfectly when it has an internal temperature of 145 degrees
15. Do not overcook or the meat will dry out
16. Set the meat aside , loosely covered with foil
17. To serve , split the rolls and toast on the grill , then layer from the bottom up: cheese , meat , lettuce , tomatoes , guacamole , onion , jalapenos , and salsa
18. Skewer with a couple of toothpicks and cut in half

title: kentucky derby dessert
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Cream the butter and sugars with an electric mixer
3. Add the vanilla , eggs and flour and mix well
4. Stir in chocolate chips and pecans , and pour into an unbaked pie crust
5. Bake for 45 and bask in the compliments
6. No one will ever guess how easy that was !

title: robust italian salad
steps:
1. Cut salami halves into 1 / 4 inch slices
2. Pour dressing over combined salami , vegetables and tomatoes
3. Toss lightly , cover
4. Marinate in refrigerator several hours
5. Just before serving , add cheese
6. Toss lightly
7. Themarinating time is not included

title: white rum truffles
steps:
1. With an electric mixer or spoon , beat nuts , icing sugar , butter and rum together thoroughly
2. Chill until firm enough to shape
3. Roll into 1 inch balls for a white coating , roll in desiccated coconut , or very finely chopped blanched nuts
4. For a dark coating , roll on cocoa or chocolate sprinkles

title: skinny mashed potatoes
steps:
1. Boil potatoes until tender and drain well
2. Combine potatoes and broth in a bowl and mash to desired consistency
3. Season with salt and pepper if desired

title: ww black bean brownies
steps:
1. Drain blacks beans and rinse well
2. Put black beans and water into a blender and puree until very smooth
3. Add black bean mixture to brownie mix and stir
4. Put brownie mixture in a dish that you have sprayed with nonstick spray
5. Bake according to package directions
6. Cool before cutting
7. You can use any brand brownie mix

title: cake in a cup mix   cupcakes
steps:
1. Place dry cake mix and pudding mix in a large mixing bowl and stir well to blend
2. Measure out 1 / 2 cup portions and place each in a plastic sandwich bag with a tie closure
3. Tuck each bag in a large ceramic mug that will hold at least 1 1 / 2 cups of water
4. Because the cake is microwaved , be sure the cup does not have any metallic decoration on it
5. Place 1 / 3 cup of powdered sugar and 1 1 / 2 teaspoons of powdered creamer or hot cocoa mix into additional sandwich bags
6. Secure with a tie and attach to cake mix bag , labeling as glaze mix
7. Attach the following directions to each mug of mix: generously spray inside of coffee mug with non-stick vegetable spray
8. Empty contents of cake mix bag into mug and add one egg white , one tablespoon oil and one tablespoon water
9. Mix until well blended
10. Microwave on high for 2 minutes
11. While cake is baking , place glaze mix into a small bowl and add 1 1 / 2 teaspoons water
12. Mix well
13. When cake is done , pour glaze over cake in the cup and enjoy while warm

title: frosted spice latte
steps:
1. Add espresso to cup
2. Stir in syrups and extract
3. Fill with steamed milk and stir
4. Top with whipped cream and dust with cinnamon

title: mountain dew salad
steps:
1. Prepare pudding according to package directions and cool
2. Dissolve jello in 2 cups hot water and add mountain dew
3. Cool slightly
4. Whip jello and pudding together and fold in cool whip
5. Chill 4 hours

title: good eats roast turkey
steps:
1. Combine all brine ingredients , except ice water , in a stock pot and bring to a boil
2. Stir to dissolve solids , then remove from heat , cool to room temperature refrigerate until thoroughly chilled
3. Early on the day of cooking , combine the brine and ice water in a clean 5 gallon bucket
4. Place thawed turkey breast side down in brine , cover , and refrigerate or set in cool area for 6 hours
5. Turn turkey over once , half way through brining
6. A few minutes before roasting , heat oven to 500 degrees
7. Combine the apple , onion , cinnamon stick and cup of water in a microwave safe dish and microwave on high for 5 minutes
8. Remove bird from brine and rinse inside and out with cold water
9. Discard brine
10. Place bird on roasting rack inside wide , low pan and pat dry with paper towels
11. Add steeped aromatics to cavity along with rosemary and sage
12. Tuck back wings and coat whole bird liberally with canola oil
13. Roast on lowest level of the oven at 500f for 30 minutes
14. Remove from oven and cover breast with double layer of aluminum foil , insert probe thermometer into thickest part of the breast and return to oven , reducing temperature to 350f
15. Set thermometer alarm to 161f
16. A 14-16 pound bird should require a total of 2-2 1 / 2 hours of roasting
17. Let turkey rest , loosely covered for 15 minutes before carving

title: pizza  stuffed potato
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees
2. Cut potato in half lengthwise
3. Scoop out pulp from potato halves into a bowl , leaving 1 / 4-inch-thick shells
4. Mash pulp and reserve shells
5. Add 1 ounce mozzarella cheese , the tomato sauce , ricotta cheese , oregano and garlic powder to potato pulp and stir to combine
6. Spoon half of potato mixture into each reserved shell
7. Top each with half of the remaining mozzarella cheese and half of the parmesan cheese
8. Set potato shells in 1-quart casserole and bake until thoroughly heated , about 10 minutes

title: alpine village house seasoned cottage cheese
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together and chill for several hours or overnight
2. Serve as a condiment or as a dip with veggie sticks

title: asparagus with gorgonzola
steps:
1. Melt the butter very gently in a medium sized sauce pan and then add the gorgonzola
2. Heat until the cheese is softened , but don't allow it to become liquid , you want it just warm
3. Add the mascarpone , fresh basil , a little salt and some freshly ground pepper and remove from the heat
4. Briefly blanch the asparagus in a generous amount of boiliing salted water
5. Drain the asparagus and dry
6. Put the asparaus onto warmed plates
7. Pour over the sauce and serve with the fresh parmesan

title: bridal casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degree
2. Combine all ingredients together , except for crackers and butter
3. Make sure mixture is well moistened
4. Add more sour cream or cream of mushroom soup if not moist enough
5. More turkey if there is too much sour cream and mushroom soup
6. Pour into greased 9x13 baking dish
7. Mix together crackers and melted butter
8. Place cracker mixture on top of turkey mixture
9. Bake for 45 minutes or until topping is browned

title: diabetic  baked grated carrots with sherry
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Combine all ingredients except chives , stirring well
3. Put in a 1-quart casserole dish and sprinkle with chives
4. Bake , covered , for 30 minutes

title: pesto tuna sandwich
steps:
1. Combine the pesto , mayo , tuna , and tomatoes
2. Salt and pepper to taste
3. Spread the tuna mixture on the bottom half of the rolls and top with a slice of cheese
4. Broil until the cheese is slightly browned
5. Top with optional lettuce and the other half of the bun
6. Serve !

title: creamy turkey soup  crock pot
steps:
1. Ingredients in turkey stock , besides the leftover turkey parts , were 1 / 2 vidalia onion chopped , stalk of celery chopped and 1 / 4 cup chopped fresh parsley
2. Combine all soup ingredients , except milk , cream and flour , in crock pot
3. Use just enough chicken broth to barely cover meat and veggies
4. Cook on low for 8 hours , or until potatoes and carrots are easily pierced
5. Combine milk , cream and flour and add to soup
6. Let cook for approximately 30 minutes more , stirring occasionally to thicken
7. You can also add any leftover gravy you have

title: copycat chevys garlic mashed potatoes   fat free version
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Bake the potatoes by first spraying them with oil cooking spray and then baking them in the preheated oven for 1 hour until they are tender
3. Cool
4. Remove about half of the skin and mash the potatoes
5. Leave the rest of the skin in
6. Melt the butter in a large saucepan over medium heat , then add the garlic and saute for 5 minutes
7. Add the potatoes and remaining ingredients to the pan and cook for 5 to 10 minutes while stirring often until mashed potatoes are hot

title: super salisbury steak
steps:
1. Mix together the meat , eggs , bread crumbs , salt , onion powder and garlic powder
2. Form meat into 8 oblong patties
3. Heat vegetable oil in a large dutch-oven type pan
4. Fry patties about 4 minutes per side
5. You just want them to brown nicely - they won't be "done"
6. Adjust heat if necessary to prevent over-browning
7. Remove patties to a plate
8. Pour off all but about 1 t of fat in the pan
9. Add sliced onions and break them apart into rings
10. Also add mushrooms if using
11. If pan gets too dry , add a small amount of the wine and / or the beef broth
12. Stir with wooden spoon to get all those delicious browned bits off the bottom of the pan
13. Cook , stirring frequently until the onion rings are limp and well browned
14. Add the rest of the wine and boil for a few minutes to reduce the liquid
15. Add the beef broth and bring to a boil
16. In a small container with a tight fitting lid , add water to the cornstarch , attach lid and shake vigorously
17. Slowly pour the cornstarch liquid into the boiling broth , while stirring
18. When gravy has thickened , gently set the meat patties back into the pan and spoon gravy over the top of any patties needing it
19. Lid the pot , reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes

title: chocolate heath dessert
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease bottom only of 13x9 cake pan
3. Beat cake mix , butter and eggs on low speed 30 seconds , then on medium speed one minute , scraping bowl occasionally
4. Pour into pan
5. Bake until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
6. While cake is cooling , beat together puddings , milk and ice cream until smooth and thick
7. Place mixture in refrigerator until cake is completely cooled
8. Smooth pudding mixture over cooled cake
9. Spread cool whip over top of pudding mixture
10. Sprinkle crushed heath bars over top of cool whip
11. Refrigerate

title: ritz chicken
steps:
1. Take chicken and boil until done , cut into bite size pieces or filets
2. Line chicken in a greased 9x13x2 baking dish
3. Mix soup with cream cheese and pour over chicken
4. Crumble 45 ritz crackers : mix with butter and spread over chicken
5. Crumble remainder of crackers and fill in any missed spots
6. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes
7. Serves 4 to 6

title: aunt isse s salad dressing
steps:
1. In saucepan , combine sugar , flour , and salt
2. Add remaining ingredients and mix
3. Over medium heat , cook until thickened , stirring constantly
4. Remove from heat and cool slightly
5. Add butter , stirring until melted and blended
6. Stir in miracle whip
7. Use this dressing on your favorite macaroni or potato salad
8. Chill salad until ready to serve

title: mushroom bourguinon
steps:
1. Heat one tablespoon olive oil and one tablespoon butter in a medium dutch oven or heavy saucepan over high heat
2. Sear the mushrooms and pearl onions in batches until they begin to brown slightly , but the mushrooms have not yet released any liquid about three or four minutes
3. Remove them from the pan and set aside
4. Reduce heat to medium and add another tablespoon of olive oil
5. Add the carrots , onions , thyme , a few good pinches of salt and several grinds of black pepper into the pan and cook for 10 minutes , stirring occasionally until the onions are lightly browned
6. Add the garlic and cook for one more minute , until fragrant
7. Add the wine to the pot , scraping any stuck bits off the bottom
8. Turn heat to high and boil until reduced by half
9. Stir in the tomato paste and the broth
10. Add back the mushrooms and pearl onions with any juices that have collected
11. Once it boils , reduce to a simmer for 20 minutes , or until mushrooms are very tender
12. Combine remaining butter and the flour with a fork until combined
13. Drop it into the stew by small pieces , then stir well
14. Reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes longer
15. If the sauce is too thin , boil it down to reduce to the right consistency
16. Season to taste
17. To serve , spoon the stew over a bowl of egg noodles , dollop with sour cream and sprinkle with chives or parsley

title: hoisin salmon
steps:
1. Preheat broiler
2. In a glass measuring cup , whisk together orange juice , hoisin sauce , and honey
3. Season salmon with salt and pepper , and place on broiler pan skin side down
4. Brush half of the hoisin sauce mixture on salmon
5. Broil salmon about 4 inches from the heat source 10 minutes
6. Drizzle remaining sauce over salmon and serve

title: eggs benedict casserole
steps:
1. Cut muffins into 1 / 2-inch cubes
2. Set aside
3. Cut canadian bacon into 1 / 2-inch squares
4. Set aside
5. Whisk the eggs well in a 2-quart bowl
6. Whisk in milk and onion powder
7. Spray a 9-by-13-inch glass or ceramic baking dish with cooking oil spray
8. Scatter half the canadian bacon evenly in bottom of dish
9. Scatter muffin cubes on top of canadian bacon
10. Top with the remaining canadian bacon , scattering it evenly over the bread
11. Pour egg mixture over the casserole
12. Cover the dish with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight , or at least 8 hours , to let bread absorb egg mixture
13. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
14. Remove casserole from refrigerator and uncover it
15. Lightly sprinkle the paprika evenly over the top
16. Cover the casserole with foil and bake for 40 minutes
17. Remove dish from the oven , remove foil , return dish to the oven and continue to bake , uncovered , until the eggs are set and the bacon on top begins to crisp , about 20 minutes more
18. Remove the casserole from oven and let it stand 5 minutes before serving
19. While casserole bakes , make easy hollandaise sauce
20. To serve , cut casserole into squares and place them on plates
21. Spoon about 2 tablespoons warm hollandaise sauce over each serving just before serving
22. Makes 10 servings

title: scottish fish cakes
steps:
1. Marinate the salmon and cod in orange and lemon juice , salt and pepper , basil , parsley and olive oil
2. Boil potatoes until cooked , drain them and then bake them in the oven for 10 minutes
3. Mash the potatoes and mix in the fish and the marinade
4. Set the mixture aside to cool down
5. When the mixture is cold , add the beaten eggs and mix in
6. Take handfuls of the mixture and shape into large egg-sized balls , flatten to about 1-inch-thick rounds
7. Bake under a hot broiler for 2 minutes

title: jamaican christmas cake
steps:
1. One day ahead , in microwaveable bowl , combine raisins , currants , peel , walnuts , prunes and cherries
2. Add 2 / 3 cup of the brown sugar , vanilla and almond extracts , nutmeg , cinnamon , ginger , allspice and cloves
3. Stir in 1 / 2 cup of the rum
4. Cover and microwave at high for 10 minutes , stirring twice
5. Let stand overnight
6. Grease two 9 x 5 inch loaf pans
7. Line with double thickness of waxed paper
8. Grease paper
9. In large pan , bring fruit mixture and 1 / 2 cup water to boil
10. Reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes , stirring often
11. Meanwhile , in saucepan , bring granulated sugar and 2 tbsp water to boil over medium-high heat
12. Reduce heat to medium and boil for 6 minutes or until thickened , brushing down pan with water to prevent crystals from forming
13. Pour over fruit mixture , stirring to coat
14. Let cool
15. In bowl , beat butter with remaining brown sugar
16. Beat in eggs one at a time , beating well after each addition
17. Add fruit mixture , blending well
18. Combine flour , baking powder and salt
19. Fold into fruit mixture
20. Scrape into pans
21. Bake in 275f oven for 2 1 / 2 to 2 3 / 4 hours or until sides come away from pans and tester inserted in centers comes out slightly gooey
22. Puncture each cake several times with skewer
23. Mix remaining rum with port
24. Pour over cakes
25. Let cool in pans
26. Cover with foil
27. Let stand for 3 days

title: mocha truffle chocolate cookies
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees
2. Prepare a lightly greased cookie sheet
3. In a large saucepan , melt butter and 1 / 2 cup chocolate pieces over low heat
4. Remove from heat
5. Stir in the instant coffee granules , mix until blended
6. Remove from heat
7. Cool 5 minutes
8. Stir in sugars , eggs and vanilla
9. In a medium bowl , sift together , flour , cocoa powder , baking powder and salt
10. Stir into coffee mixture
11. Stir in 1 cup remaining chocolate pieces
12. Drop by rounded tablespoonfuls onto cookie sheet
13. Bake for 8-10 minutes
14. Cool 1 minute before removing from baking sheet

title: flourless brownies  sugar free  low carb
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees
2. Melt the chocolate and butter together on stovetop or in microwave
3. Add the splenda , eggs , egg yolks , vanilla and cocoa , stirring until well blended
4. Pour into a 9 x 13 inch pan
5. Bake at 350 degrees for 50 minutes

title: herbed potato slices
steps:
1. Mix thyme , cumin , sumac , salt and flour
2. Spray a large baking dish with cooking spray
3. Toss potato slices in flour mixture
4. Arrange slices in dish in one layer and dot each with butter
5. Bake at 200c for about 30 min , until brown

title: pb choco date balls
steps:
1. Combine peanut butter , dates , nuts , sugar and roll into balls
2. Melt paraffin in double-boiler and add chocolate
3. Dip balls in chocolate and place on wax paper to dry

title: patatas brava
steps:
1. Grease a roasting pan and arrange the potatoes in one layer
2. Brush with olive oil , sprinkle with salt and bake at 375 for about 45 minutes or until golden brown
3. Prepare the tomato sauce by heating the oil in a new skillet
4. Saute the onions and garlic until the onion is wilted
5. Add the tomatoes and saute for another few minutes stir in the tomato paste , wine water , parsley , chili pepper , tabasco , bay leaf , sugar salt and pepper
6. Cover and simmer for 30 minutes
7. Strain
8. The sauce should should not be too thick-thin with water if necessary to serve , arrange the potatoes in a bowl or on the dish
9. Spoon on several tablespoons of the tomato sauce , then if you wish 3 or 4 tablespoons of the aioli
10. Generally we eat either the potatoes with only the tomato sauce or a separate dish potatoes aioli with just the aioli sauce

title: citrus glazed pork tenderloin
steps:
1. Mix the sauce ingredients and add tenderloins
2. Marinate tenderloins 3 hours , or overnight
3. Heat grill , or broiler , cook until internal temp of pork is 160 , aprox 30-40 minutes , basting with sauce as needed

title: grandma s raisin bread
steps:
1. Place raisins and 2 cups water in sauce pan and bring to boil for five minutes
2. Remove from heat and add 1 cup cold water
3. Let cool until it is lukewarm
4. Cream together sugar and shortening , then add the salt , cinnamon , nutmeg , cloves and baking soda
5. Mix well
6. Add raisins and flour to dry mixture
7. Mix well
8. Bake in greased and floured cake pan for one hour at 350f
9. Recipe is great as is or add some cream cheese frosting

title: burnt sugar frosting
steps:
1. Place half of the cup sugar in a heavy skillet and cook , stirring over medium heat till melted
2. Add the boiling water and stir till a syrup forms
3. Heat the remaining 2 cups of sugar and milk
4. Add the cooked sugar mixture and cook to 234 -- soft ball stage
5. Cool for 10 minutes without stirring
6. Add the butter , salt and vanilla
7. Beat till thick enough to spread easily
8. If frosting becomes too stiff , add some milk
9. Enough frosting for 1 8" or 9" double layer cake

title: stacked stuffed apples
steps:
1. Mix together raisins and sugar together in a small bowl
2. Lay apples cut-side up and fill the core areas with raisin-sugar mixture evenly
3. Sprinkle stuffed apples with cinnamon , and dot with butter
4. Place apples in slow cooker , stacking if necessary
5. Add water along the edge of the cooker
6. Cover and cook on low 3-5 hours , or on high for 2 1 / 2- 3 1 / 2 hours or until apples are tender , but not collapsing
7. Serve warm , or with ice cream , or frozen yogurt

title: cucumber onion mustard pickles
steps:
1. Thinly slice the cucumbers
2. Peel and thinly slice the onions
3. In a large bowl , combine the cucumbers and onions
4. Sprinkle with the salt and let stand for 3 hours
5. Drain
6. In a large saucepan , combine the sugar , cornstarch , turmeric , ginger and the red pepper
7. Stir in the vinegar , the water and mustard
8. Cover and bring to a boil
9. Add the cucumbers and the onions
10. Pack into clean , hot pint jars leaving 1 / 2 inch of headroom
11. Rub a rubber spatula around the inside of the jars to release the air bubbles and wipe the rims of the jars with a clean rag
12. Place the lids and the screw bands on
13. Process in a boiling water bath canner for 15 minutes

title: lamb cutlets  mediterranean style
steps:
1. Combine the greek yogurt , garlic , lemon zest , lemon juice and freshly ground pepper and salt
2. Mix to combine
3. Add the lamb cutlets , combine
4. Cover and refrigerate for one hour
5. Chargrill the cutlets on a moderately high heat for 2-3 minutes on each side or until cooked to your liking
6. Suggested to serve with a greek salad and tzatziki for a complete meal

title: no knead sourdough bread
steps:
1. Mix together the dry ingredients in large non-metalic bowl
2. In measuring cup mix together water and sourdough starter
3. Mix in liquid until the flour is incorporated
4. The consistency should be firm and shaggy
5. Cover with plastic and let sit on the counter for 16-18 hours at room temperature , about 70f
6. With plastic scraper remove dough from bowl and gently place on floured surface
7. Gently flatten dough into rectangle and fold the ends inward
8. Fold the sides inward and form a dough ball
9. Place dough , seam side down , on parchment paper bowl or frying pan (helps to hold shape and cover loosely with a towel and allow to rise until doubled in size , about 1 1 / 2 hours
10. If using proofing basket , spray the basket with non-stick oil and dust with flour or wheat brand and place dough directly in the basket
11. Cover with towel and let rise about 1 1 / 2 hours
12. Dough is ready when it will not readily spring back when poked with a finger
13. Thirty minutes before baking , place cast-iron dutch oven or la cloche in oven and preheat to 500 degrees
14. With serrated knife place slits in top of loaf
15. Remove pot or la cloche from oven and carefully lift dough with parchment from bowl and transfer to la cloche or dutch oven
16. Shake pan once or twice if dough is unevenly distributed
17. It will straighten out as it bakes
18. Replace lid and return to oven
19. Turn oven to 475 degrees and bake for 30 minutes
20. Remove cover
21. Reduce heat to 450 degrees and bake an additional 15-20 minutes or until golden brown
22. Interior temperature should be 200 degrees and the bottom sounds hollow when thumped
23. Remove from pan and cool completely on rack before cutting

title: dot s cold broccoli salad
steps: 1. Mix well , toss again before serving

title: faux filets au beurre d anchois  steak with anchovy butter
steps:
1. Remove the anchovies from the cans and drain well
2. Rinse under cold running water and pat dry
3. Place the anchovies and the butter in a food processor or a blender and process , or mix with an immersion blender in a bowl until the anchovy butter is smooth
4. Set aside
5. Bring salted water to a boil in a steamer , place the broccoli in the top of the steamer and steam 3 to 6 minutes or until done to your taste
6. Remove from steamer and keep warm
7. Pre-heat the broiler
8. Heat a large frying pan over high heat
9. When the pan is very hot , saute the steaks about one minute one each side--the meat should be seared on the outside , raw on the inside
10. Place the steaks on a sheet pan and coat the steaks with 2 / 3 of the anchovy butter
11. Broil for three minutes without turning for medium rare , longer if you prefer
12. Place the steaks on a warm platter and cover
13. Place the sheet pan across two burners and , over medium high heat , melt the remaining butter , stirring and scraping to get all the fond from the pan
14. Cut the steaks into thin slices
15. Add the juice from the steaks to the butter
16. Spoon half half the butter mixture over the sliced steak and toss the broccoli in the remaining butter
17. Serve immediately

title: velveeta rye party squares
steps:
1. Brown sausage and drain well
2. Return cooked sausage to pan and add jelly
3. Cut velveeta in pieces and add to sausage mixture
4. Heat on low until cheese is melted
5. Top each bread slice with heaping teaspoonful of sausage mixture
6. Place under broiler until edges of bread are toasty
7. Serve warm

title: arkansas hot pepper pecans
steps:
1. Spread pecans evenly in a casserole or on a baking sheet and cover with butter
2. Bake at 300 degrees for 25-30 minutes or until lightly browned
3. Mix soy sauce , salt , and tabasco and stir into toasted pecans
4. Let stand at least 30 minutes and drain on paper towels
5. Pecans will keep for months in a tightly covered container

title: pasta alla cacio e pepe
steps:
1. Place finely grated pecorino romano in medium bowl
2. Set colander inside large bowl
3. Bring 2 courts water to boil in large dutch oven
4. Add pasta and salt
5. Cook , stirring frequently , until al dente
6. Drain pasta into colander , reserving cooking water
7. Pour 1 1 / 2 cups cooking water into liquid measuring cup and discard remainder
8. Return pasta to now-empty bowl
9. Slowly whisk 1 cup of reserved pasta water into finely grated pecorino until smooth
10. Whisk in cream , oil , and black pepper
11. Gradually pour mixture over pasta , tossing to coat
12. Let pasta rest 1 to 2 minutes , tossing frequently , adjusting consistency with remaining pasta water
13. Serve , passing coarsely grated pecorino separately

title: bittersweet amarula drumsticks
steps:
1. Prepare the drumsticks by cutting the skin loose around the bone and pushing in down with a scraping movement , using a small sharp knife
2. Cover exposed bone with foil
3. Dust meat lightly with seasoned flour
4. Mix the chives , marmalade , lemon , amarula cream and salt together
5. Coat the drumsticks in this mixture and arrange in an ovenproof dish
6. Bake at 200 degrees for 45 minutes until crispy
7. Remove the foil
8. May be served warm or at room temperature
9. For serving :
10. Wrap a bayleaf around each exposed bone-
11. Secure the leaf with a toothpick or porcupine quill
12. )
13. Serve on a bed of brown rice or your favorite starch
14. Enjoy !
15. )

title: french coleslaw
steps: 1. Mix together and chill

title: butter cream icing  buttercream frosting
steps:
1. Cream butter and then add vanilla and optional salt
2. Add sugar a cup at a time beating on medium speed
3. Add milk 1 tbls
4. At a time and beat on high until completely blended and desired consistency

title: cauliflower and potato curry
steps:
1. Select a large stockpot with lid , add all ingredients and gently cook for about an hour
2. Stir once or twice

title: grandmother s  coleslaw
steps:
1. Combine cabbage and carrots in medium-large bowl
2. Mix mayonnaise , apple cider vinegar , sugar , and celery seeds together until smooth
3. Pour dressing over cabbage and mix until cabbage is well coated
4. Refrigerate for at least 4 hours
5. Serve !

title: leftover cooked oatmeal muffins
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine flour , brown sugar , baking powder and baking soda
2. In another bowl , mix together melted butter , eggs , oatmeal , raisins and vanilla
3. Add to dry ingredients and stir just until moistened
4. The batter will seem thick , but don't worry
5. Any time i've added extra liquid the muffins turned out crumbly
6. Spoon batter into 12 greased muffin cups
7. Bake at 350 degrees for 18 minutes , or until the muffin centers are slightly firm

title: polish tuna melt sandwich
steps:
1. Preheat broiler
2. Mix first 5 ingredients in a bowl
3. Taste and adjust as desired
4. Spead tuna mixture on 6 slices of bread and cover with cheese slices
5. Spread a little mayo on other 6 slices
6. Place all 12 slices on a baking pan and broil until cheese is melted and starting to brown

title: moroccan harissa mayonnaise dip
steps:
1. Simply mix the harissa and mayonnaise in a bowl
2. Serving suggestion: serve as a delicious dip with vegetables , bread sticks or pitta bread
3. Try it as a sandwich spread !

title: marinated tomato  zucchini  pine nut and ricotta pasta
steps:
1. Place the tomatoes , garlic , shredded basil , balsamic and 2 tbs of the oil in a small bowl
2. Season with sea salt and freshly ground black pepper , then set aside for 20 minutes to marinate
3. Meanwhile , place the zucchini in a bowl with remaining oil and season with salt and pepper
4. Gently toss in the oil to coat
5. Preheat a char-grill pan on high
6. Add zucchini and cook for 2 minutes each side or until lightly charred and tender
7. Transfer to a bowl and set aside
8. Cook the pasta in a large saucepan of lightly salted boiling water following packet directions until al dente
9. Drain well
10. Return pasta to the saucepan and add the tomato mixture , zucchini , pine nuts and remaining basil
11. Season to taste with salt and pepper and toss to combine
12. Divide pasta among serving bowls , serve topped with ricotta and a drizzle of balsamic

title: marinade for chicken  pork  or beef
steps:
1. Mix the first 11 ingredients
2. Whisk in the oil
3. Marinate meat for several hours
4. Grill meat in the manner you desire

title: fast chinese pepper steak
steps:
1. Cook meat , onion , and pepper in oil until meat is browned
2. Stir in remaining ingredients
3. Cook and stir for 4 minutes

title: pork and apple pie
steps:
1. Prepare pastry dough and line a 9 inch pie plate
2. Combine the apples , pork , thyme , sugar , sage , salt and pepper and place the mixture in pie shell
3. Dot with butter
4. Roll out remaining dough and place on top , crimping the edges
5. Make several slits in the top and brush the top with egg-milk mixture
6. Bake in a preheated 400f oven for one hour
7. Serve at room temperature

title: 1 5 quart crock pot risotto
steps:
1. Spray inside of crockpot with olive oil spray
2. Combine ingredients and cook on high for around 2 hours , stirring occasionally

title: slow cooked chicken chow mein
steps:
1. Remove fat from chicken
2. Cut chicken into 1-inch pieces
3. Heat oil in 10-inch skillet over medium-high heat
4. Cook chicken in oil about 5 minutes , turning once , until brown
5. Place carrots , celery , onion , garlic and water chestnuts in 3 1 / 2 to 6-quart slow cooker
6. Add chicken
7. Mix broth , soy sauce and gingerroot
8. Pour over chicken
9. Cover and cook on low heat setting 6 to 8 hours or until chicken is no longer pink in center and vegetables are tender
10. Mix cornstarch and water until smooth , stir into chicken mixture
11. Stir in mushrooms and pea pods
12. Cover and cook on high heat setting 15 minutes
13. Serve over noodles

title: pork larb with fresh herbs
steps:
1. Heat oil in wok and stir fry the pork until cooked , about 6-7 minutes
2. Remove from heat and mix in the remaining ingredients , put in a nice bowl
3. Arrange the garnishes around the bowl on a nice platter
4. Diners just help themselves to the lettuce leaves and pork , plus garnishes

title: chewy peanut butter bars
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , melt the butter and peanut butter
2. Remove from the heat
3. Add sugar and flour
4. Stir in the eggs and vanilla
5. Spread into a greased 13-in
6. X 9-in x 2-in baking pan
7. Bake at 350 for 28-32 minutes or until lightly browned and edges start to pull away from sides of pan

title: citrus barbecued chicken
steps:
1. Place the chicken in a plastic ziploc bag
2. In a small bowl , combine juices , oil and seasonings
3. Mix well
4. Add to chicken in bag and turn to coat
5. Let stand for 25 minutes , turning occasionally
6. On greased grill , cook chicken over hot coals 5 to 7 minutes on each side or until done
7. Brush frequently with marinade while cooking

title: calabacitas  southwestern squash saute
steps:
1. In a large skillet , saute onion in butter and oil over medium heat about 4 minutes
2. Add the garlic and saute about 2 minutes more
3. Stir in the diced squash and zucchini
4. Saute until just softened , about 5 minutes
5. Add the corn and poblano and saute 3-5 more minutes
6. Stir in the cilantro and heat until just heated through
7. Season with salt and pepper
8. Serve

title: aartappel poeding  south africa
steps:
1. Prehest oven to 350 degrees
2. To the potatoes add eggs , sugar , salt , vanilla , almond or lemon essence and zest
3. Put dabs of butter on top and top with a good grating of nutmeg or almond slices
4. Bake in a lightly buttered casserole dish for 30 minutes till lightly browned

title: salisbury steak deluxe
steps:
1. In a bowl , combine soup , mustard , worcestershire and horseradish
2. Blend well and set aside
3. In another bowl , lightly beat egg , add bread crumbs , onion , salt , pepper and 1 / 4 cup of soup mixture
4. Add ground beef and mix well
5. Shape into 6 patties
6. In a large skillet , brown patties in oil
7. Drain
8. Combine water with remaining soup mixture and pour over patties
9. Cover and cook over low heat 10-15 minutes until meat is done
10. Arrange patties on a serving platter , spoon sauce over top and garnish with parsley

title: egg salad   either as a salad or on toasted bread
steps:
1. To cook eggs:
2. Put in a steamer and follow steamer instructions or
3. Place desired number of eggs [4-8] in pot
4. Cover with water by 1 inch
5. Bring to boil
6. Remove from heat and cover immediately
7. Let stand 12-13 minutes
8. Spoon out one egg at a time into cold water , then refrigerate
9. To assemble the egg salad:
10. Toast bread , if desired
11. Chop peeled egg with knife and then mash with fork or process in mini-chopper
12. I like my cooked egg white to be very finely chopped , mashed really
13. Add mayo to taste
14. Add splashes of red wine vinegar to taste
15. Add celery flakes as desired
16. Add minced sweet onion to taste
17. Add more shredded and chopped lettuce to taste
18. Mix to bind
19. Add freshly ground pepper if desired
20. Add salt if you think it needs it
21. This is better chilled and can be served just by itself as a salad or on lightly toasted bread for a sandwich
22. If you peel and leave an onion in the refrigerator for days , it makes it taste much sweeter
23. You could add pickle juice , minced pickle , mustard or dry mustard , sweet relish , capers as desired as well as paprika for color

title: pumpkin protein shake
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in a small blender
2. Process until slushy

title: spiced rice with lentils
steps:
1. In large nonstick saucepan , saute onion for 2 minutes or until translucent
2. Add ginger , garlic , dried red chile , and turmeric
3. Stir fry 1 minute
4. Add rice and lentils
5. Stir gently to mix
6. Add boiling water to cover ingredients by 1 / 2 inch
7. Bring back to boil , reduce heat , and simmer , covered , 45-50 minutes or till liquid is absorbed and rice and letils are tender
8. Remove mixture from heat and let sit , covered , about 5 minutes
9. Fluff gently with fork
10. Drizzle with lemon juice and garnish with chopped cilantro , if desired

title: roasted pumpkin   cider soup
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Cut pumpkin in half and scoop out seeds
3. Place in shallow roasting pan , cut sides up
4. Divide butter and brown sugar among cavities
5. Arrange onion , carrots , garlic and apple around pumpkin
6. Sprinkle with rosemary and salt and pepper
7. Pour 2 cups of stock around vegetables and cover pan with foil
8. Roast until vegetables are very soft and caramelized , 1 1 / 2 to 2 hours
9. Scoop pumpkin out of skin
10. Squeeze garlic out of skin
11. Process in food processor , in batches if necessary , adding enough stock to achieve a smooth puree
12. Transfer puree to a large saucepan and whisk in cider
13. Add as much of remaining stock as necessary to achieved desired consistency
14. Season with mace and ginger
15. Bring to boil , whisking , and simmer for 10 minutes to blend flavors
16. Re season with salt and pepper if necessary
17. Serve in soup bowls with a dollop of creme fraiche

title: egg calzone
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 210c / 190c fan-forced
2. Line 2 baking trays with baking paper
3. Combine yeast , sugar and 1 cup lukewarm water , in a large jug
4. Using a fork , stir
5. Cover , then let stand in a warm place for 5 minutes or until bubbles appear on the surface
6. Sift flour and salt into large bowl
7. Add yeast mixture and oil
8. Mix to combine
9. Turn out dough onto a lightly floured surface
10. Knead for 5 minutes
11. Divide dough into 4 portions
12. Meanwhile , heat a large frying pan over moderate heat
13. Crack eggs into pan
14. Cook for 1 minute or until just cooked underneath
15. For each calzone , roll a portion of dough into a 20cm round
16. Spread with paste
17. Top with ham , egg , cheese , onion and parsley
18. Lightly brush edges with water , fold rounds in half to enclose filling
19. Using a fork , press edges together to seal
20. Place on prepared trays
21. Bake for 15-18 minutes or until golden

title: pear yogurt shake anytime
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a blender or food processor & blend until smooth
2. Pour into chilled tall glasses , sprinkle with nutmeg & enjoy !

title: crock pot chicken w  blue cheese and mustard sauce
steps:
1. Rinse chicken and pat dry
2. Then arrange , overlapping pieces slightly , in a 4 qt or larger electric slow cooker
3. Sprinkle with pepper , thyme , and savory
4. Insert bay leaf between two chicken pieces
5. Mix mustard and wine
6. Pour over chicken
7. Cover and cook at low setting until meat in thickest part is very tender when pierced
8. Carefully lift chicken to warm serving dish
9. Keep warm
10. Mix cornstarch and cream
11. Blend into cooking liquid
12. Increase cooker heat setting to high
13. Cover and cook , stirring 2 or 3 time , until sauce is thickened
14. Add 1 / 4 cup of the cheese , cover , and let stand for 3 to 5 minutes
15. Stir until cheese is melted
16. Pour sauce over chicken
17. Sprinkle with remaining 1 / 4 cup of cheese

title: sun dried tomato pasta so good
steps:
1. In large pan- boil chicken in water until cooked set aside to cool
2. When cool cut in small pieces
3. I another large pan , cook 3 cups cream just until it boils add bouillon , asiago cheese and wine
4. Stir until well blended
5. Add cornstarch mixture and simmer constantly until thickened
6. Mix in sun-dried tomatoes
7. This can be made ahead of time and put in fridge for later use
8. Cook bacon in large fry pan and cook until crisp
9. Remove and drain on paper towel
10. In same pan add butter over medium heat , saute red onion and garlic and sliced mushrooms until cooked , add bacon cook for 2-3 minutes
11. Stir in green onions , chicken and remaining 1 cup cream and cook until heated
12. Add asiago cream sauce and blend together
13. Serve over pasta and sprinkle with parsley ! worth the effort -- enjoy with remaining white wine !

title: firefly juice   punch
steps:
1. Mix equal parts of pineapple-orange juice and sprite and stir gently
2. Top of a spritz of whipped cream and sprinkles
3. A straw is helpful
4. Enjoy your firefly juice !

title: rum fruitcake cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees farenheit lightly grease cookie sheets or use parchment paper
2. Set aside
3. Beat sugar and shortening in a large bowl until fluffy
4. Add eggs , orange juice and rum extract , beat 2 minutes
5. Combine flour , baking powder , baking soda and salt in a small bowl
6. Add candied fruit , raisins and nuts
7. Stir into creamed mixture
8. Drop dough by rounded teaspoonfuls 2 inches apart onto cookie sheets
9. Bake 10 to 12 minutes let cookies stand on cookie sheets 2 minutes
10. Remove to wire racks
11. Cool completely

title: bacon bourbon jam
steps:
1. Divide bacon between two large skillets and cook over medium-high heat , stirring frequently , until fat is rendered and bacon is lightly browned and starting to crisp , about 20 minutes
2. Transfer bacon to paper towels to drain
3. Reserve 1 tablespoon bacon fat and discard remainder
4. Add bacon fat , onions and garlic to one skillet and cook , stirring frequently , until onions are softened and translucent , about five minutes
5. Add vinegar , brown sugar , maple syrup , coffee , and bourbon
6. Bring to a boil and cook for two minutes , stirring and scraping browned bits from bottom of skillet with wooden spoon
7. Add bacon and stir to combine
8. Transfer mixture to a six-quart slow-cooker and cook on high , uncovered , until liquid has reduced and thickened slightly and bacon is a deep burnished brown , 3 1 / 2 to 4 hours
9. Transfer mixture to food processor and pulse until coarsely chopped
10. Let cool , then transfer to airtight jars
11. Store in refrigerator for up to one month

title: chocolate wafers
steps:
1. In a bowl , cream butter and sugars , add milk and egg
2. Mix well
3. Combine dry ingredients in separate bowl , and gradually add to the creamed mixture
4. Mix well
5. Cover and let chill until firm , or about two hours
6. Rolled chilled dough on a floured surface until about 1 / 8 inch thick
7. Cut with a 1 1 / 2 cookie cutter
8. Place 1 inch apart on a greased baking sheet
9. Bake at 375 for 5- 6 minutes or until edges are lightly browned
10. Let cool on wire racks

title: 5 minute artisan bread
steps:
1. Preparing dough for storage:
2. Warm the water slightly
3. It should feel just a little warmer than body temperature
4. Warm water will rise the dough to the right point for storage in about 2 hours
5. With cold water it will need 3-4 hours
6. Add the yeast to the water in a 5 quart bowl or , preferably , in a resealable , lidded plastic food container or food-grade bucket
7. Don't worry about getting it all to dissolve
8. Mix in the flour and salt - kneading is unnecessary
9. Add all of the flour at once , measuring it in with dry-ingredient measuring cups , by gently scooping up the flour , then sweeping the top level with a knife or spatula
10. Don't press down into the flour as you scoop or you'll throw off the measurement
11. Mix with a wooden spoon , a high-capacity food processor fitted with the dough attachment , or a heavy duty stand mixer fitted with the dough hook until the mixture is uniform
12. If you're hand mixing and it becomes too difficult to incorporate all the flour with the spoon , you can reach into your mixing vessel with very wet hands and press the mixture together
13. Don't knead , it isn't necessary
14. You're finished when everything is uniformly moist , without dry patches
15. It takes a few minutes , and will yield a dough that is wet and loose enough to conform to the shape of its container
16. Allow to rise
17. Cover with lid
18. Allow the mixture to rise at room temperature until it begins to collapse , approx 2 hours , depending on room temperature , and initial water temperature longer rising times , up to 5 hours , won't harm the result
19. You can use a portion of the dough any time after this period
20. Fully refrigerated dough is less sticky and easier to work with than dough at room temperature
21. On baking day:
22. Prepare your loaf tin , tray , or whatever you're baking it in / on
23. Sprinkle the surface of your refrigerated dough with four
24. Pull up and cut of a grapefruit-size piece of dough , using a serrated knife
25. Hold the mass of dough in your hands and add a little more flour as needed so it won't stick to your hands
26. Gently stretch the surface of the dough around to the bottom on all 4 sides , rotating the ball a quarter-turn as you go
27. Most of the dusting flour will fall off - that's fine , it isn't meant to be incorporated
28. The bottom of the loaf may appear to be a collection of bunched ends , but it will sort itself out during resting and baking
29. The correctly shaped final product will be smooth and cohesive
30. The entire process should take no more than 30 - 60 seconds
