31. Rest the loaf and let it rise in the form , on the tray / pizza peel , for about 40 minutes depending on the age of the dough , you may not see much rise during this period
32. That's fine , more rising will occur during baking
33. Twenty minutes before baking , preheat the oven to 450f place an empty broiler tray for holding water on any other shelf that won't interfere with the rising bread
34. Dust and slash
35. Dust the top of the loaf liberally with flour , which will allow the slashing knife to pass without sticking
36. Slash a quarter inch deep cross , diagonal lines , or tic-tac-toe pattern on top using a serrated knife
37. After a 20 min preheat you're ready to bake , even though the oven thermometer won't be at full temperature yet
38. Put your loaf in the oven
39. Pour about 1 cup of hot water into the broiler tray and close the oven to trap the steam
40. Bake for about 30 minutes , or until the crust is nicely browned and firm to the touch
41. Store the rest of the dough in the fridge in your lidded container and use it over the next 14 days
42. The flavour and texture improves , becoming like sourdough
43. Even 24 hours of storage improves the flavour
44. This is the standard bread
45. There are loads of variations - both savory and sweet - in the book

title: too good beef biryani
steps:
1. Heat oil in a wok
2. Fry the boiled beef in the hot oil until it turns brown on either side
3. Remove the fried beef and allow the excess oil to drain on clean paper kitchen napkins
4. Add all the onions to the hot oil , except for 2 sliced onions , and stir-fry briefly
5. Add turmeric powder , chilli powder , corriander powder , cardamoms , bay leaves and half the black peppercorns
6. Mix well until it forms a dry paste
7. Stir in the chicken stock
8. Add tomato slices and cook until the water in the tomato dries up and oil floats on the top
9. Put the fried beef lightly crushed by hand into it
10. Mix in the salt as per your taste
11. Allow it to cook on low flame until cooked
12. While it is cooking , heat oil in a skillet
13. Fry the remaining onions in it until they turn light brown
14. Remove from heat
15. Add the remaining peppercorns , bay leaves and green cardamoms to the same oil
16. Then , toss in the cashewnuts and pistachios and fry until lightly golden brown and aromatic
17. Add the drained rice to the oil and mix well
18. Add 5 glasses of water and a pinch of salt
19. When the rice comes to a boil , reduce flame and keep it covered
20. As the water gets absorbed by the rice , remove half of it and put the prepared beef curry on top
21. Garnish with mint leaves , corriander leaves , cashewnuts , fried onions and pistachios
22. Spread the remaining rice on top of this and give one more layer of garnish
23. Keep it on low flame , covered , for 10 minutes , and let it cook
24. All the flavours will blend most beautifully !
25. Serve this awesome complete meal hot !

title: italian noodle medley
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375f
2. Cook pasta according to package directions
3. Meanwhile , in medium saucepan , heat spaghetti sauce with chicken until warmed
4. In a 2-quart casserole dish , cover the bottom with a layer of sauce
5. Layer in 1 / 2 the pasta , 1 1 / 2 cups of the sauce , and 1 cup of the mozzarella
6. Repeat layers with remaining pasta , sauce , and mozzarella
7. Sprinkle the parmesan on top
8. Bake uncovered for 20 minutes or until bubbly

title: grilled eggplant  arugula and mozzarella panini
steps:
1. Brush eggplant slices with oil on both sides and place in a george foreman grill--or panini grill-- cook 4 minutes , remove
2. Brush bread slices with oil
3. On 4 slices , oil side down , arrange eggplant , arugula , and mozzarella , top with 4 bread slices oil side up add 2 sandwiches to grill , close and cook 3-4 minutes
4. Repeat
5. Cut sandwiches on diagonal and serve

title: potato baskets with mushroom  thyme filling
steps:
1. Potato basket: mash cooked potato and mix with celery root
2. Saute onion
3. Drain and add to mashed potato
4. Add egg , flour , seasoning , and knead into a dough
5. Form into balls 6 cm wide
6. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
7. Grease a cookie sheeet and place the"potato balls" on it
8. Flatten the balls and indent in the centres to form baskets
9. Filling: saute onion in butter , add soy
10. Add mushroom and sweat it for a few min
11. Stir in thyme and sage then remove from stove
12. Fill potato baskets with generous amount of mushroom fillling and sprinkele with parmesan
13. Bake for 20-30 til baskets are slightly browned and firm

title: kellogg s corn flakes pie crust
steps:
1. In medium mixing bowl , combine corn flakes and remaining ingredients
2. Press mixture evenly and firmly in bottom and sides of a 9-inch pan to form crust
3. Bake at 350f about 5 minutes or until lightly browned
4. Cool completely
5. Fill with ice cream or pudding , chilling until firm
6. Garnish with ice cream toppings , fruit or whipped topping if desired

title: awesome kahlua cake
steps:
1. Set oven to 350f
2. Set oven rack to second lowest position
3. Generously grease and flour a bundt pan
4. In a large bowl combine the cake mix with pudding mix , sour cream , oil , water , eggs , kahlua and cinnamon
5. Beat until well blended
6. Stir chocolate chips and walnuts
7. Pour into a greased and floured bundt pan pan
8. Bake at 350f for 45-60 minutes , or until the cake tests done
9. For the glaze
10. Mix confectioners sugar starting with 2 tablespoons kahlua until smooth adding in more kahlua until desired consistency is achieved
11. Pour over cake

title: simple parmesan tomatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Cut tomatoes in half lengthwise
3. Squeeze or scoop out some pulp and seeds with a spoon
4. Turn upside down on paper towels to drain
5. Place tomatoes cut side up in oven safe dish , and season with salt and pepper
6. In a bowl , combine bread crumbs , parmesan , thyme , garlic and olive oil
7. Season with pepper
8. Spoon crumb mixture over each tomato half and bake 10 minutes

title: best carrot cake
steps:
1. Combine flour , salt , soda , & cinnamon
2. Set aside
3. Combine eggs , sugar , & oil
4. Mix until smooth
5. Stir in flour mixture a little at a time until well blended
6. Stir in carrots , walnuts , pineapple , & vanilla , mixing evenly
7. Pour into a greased 9x13in pan
8. Bake at 350 degrees for 45-55 minutes
9. --------------frosting----------
10. Cream together , cheese and butter until smooth
11. Add vanilla
12. Add sugar a 1 / 4 cup at a time , until well blended
13. After frosting cooled carrot cake , sprinkle with toasted coconut
14. To toast coconut , put on cookie sheet , under broiler for about 1 minute
15. Keep an eye on it to be sure it does not burn !

title: grandma s homemade granola
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325
2. Combine all dry ingredients together in a large roasting pan
3. Stir well to combine
4. Add oil , honey and water to dry ingedients and stir until all ingredients are well coated
5. Bake at 325 for 1 hour stirring every 20 minutes
6. After 1 hour , turn off oven and continue to stir every 20 minutes until granola is golden brown
7. Cool completely and store in airtight container

title: delicious passover apple cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f , and grease a 9" x 13" pan
2. Peel , slice or grate apples and set aside
3. Beat eggs in mixer for about 5 minutes
4. Beat in sugar and salt , then oil , lemon juice and lemon peel
5. Mix together the cake / matzo meal and the potato starch , and add to the batter , still beating
6. Spoon or pour half of the batter into the greased pan
7. Top with all of the apples and raisins , if desired
8. Sprinkle with cinnamon
9. Top with remaining batter , and sprinkle with chopped nuts , if desired
10. Bake at 375f for 35-45 minutes

title: kittencal s chicken salad
steps:
1. In a medium bowl toss together chicken with celery , onions and cranberries
2. In another bowl mix all dressing ingredients until well blended
3. Add to the chicken mixture and toss to combine
4. Cover and chill for a minumum of 4-24 hours
5. Just before serving mix in grape halves then season with black pepper
6. Poaching chicken-------
7. Place the chicken breasts in a saucepan
8. Cover with water and 1 / 2 teaspoon salt bring to a simmer
9. Lightly simmer over low heat for about 15 minutes
10. Remove from heat and let sit in the water for about 10 minutes
11. Cool and chop

title: ceylonese roti
steps:
1. Sift flour , salt and baking powder
2. Add coconut and mix well
3. Add water and knead to a soft dough
4. Cover with a damp cloth
5. Keep aside for 30 minutes
6. Divide dough into 8 parts
7. Roll each into a ball
8. Roll out each ball into a round disc 5" in diameter and of 1 / 4" thickness
9. Sprinkle with a little flour , if needed
10. Heat griddle , lightly grease and cook one at a time over low heat until brown specks appear on both sides
11. Remove from griddle
12. Keep warm
13. Grease the griddle before each roti
14. Wrap in a piece of foil to keep until needed
15. Reheat with foil in oven

title: turkey scaloppine milanese with mustard cranberry sauce
steps:
1. Turkey preparation:
2. With a meat mallet or a rolling pin , pound the turkey between sheets of plastic wrap to 1 / 8-inch thickness
3. Season with salt and pepper and press the seasonings into the meat with your fingers
4. Make the coating:
5. Combine the bread crumbs , parmesan cheese , parsley , salt , and pepper in a small bowl
6. Work in the olive oil by hand , then spread the mixture on a dinner plate
7. Spread the flour on another dinner plate
8. Break the eggs into a shallow bowl and beat lightly
9. Dip the turkey in the flour , coating both sides and shaking off the excess
10. Then dip in the egg , letting any excess drip back into the bowl
11. Finally , coat the turkey on both sides with the seasoned bread crumbs , pressing them into place
12. As each piece is coated , place it on a tray
13. Cover and place in the refrigerator until you are ready to fry them
14. Heat a large skillet over high heat until very hot
15. Add olive oil to a depth of 1 / 4-inch
16. When the oil is almost smoking , add as many turkey scallopine as the skillet will hold comfortably
17. Do not crowd the pan
18. Cook until the cutlets are golden on the bottom , about 2 minutes
19. Turn and cook on the second side about 30 seconds longer
20. With tongs , lift the pieces as they are done , allowing any excess oil to drain back into the skillet , and transfer to several thicknesses of paper towels
21. Repeat with the remaining turkey scallopine
22. Prepare arugula:
23. Place the arugula in a large bowl
24. Drizzle with enough extra-virgin olive oil to coat the leaves lightly
25. Add lemon juice and some salt and pepper
26. Toss , taste , and adjust the seasoning
27. Divide the turkey among 4 plates , placing them in the center
28. Spoon a little mustard cranberry sauce on each side of the turkey
29. Mound the arugula salad on top
30. With a vegetable peeler , shave a little parmesan on top of the salad
31. Put a lemon quarter on each plate and serve immediately
32. Prepare mustard cranberry sauce:
33. In a large saute pan combine the sugar and water and boil to form a syrup
34. Add the vanilla beans and orange zest and simmer briefly
35. Add the orange juice , cranberries and season with salt and pepper
36. Simmer until the cranberries start to pop , about 3 to 5 minutes
37. Remove from heat and add mustard
38. Assembly:
39. Divide the turkey among 4 plates , placing them in the center
40. Spoon a little mustard cranberry sauce on each side of the turkey
41. Mound the arugula salad on top
42. With a vegetable peeler , shave a little parmesan on top of the salad
43. Put a lemon quarter on each plate and serve immediately
44. Serve immediately with roast potatoes and green beans with almonds

title: nutter butter easter chicks
steps:
1. Cut the tic tacs in half to form the chick's beak
2. Set aside
3. Melt the candy coating as directed on the package
4. I use the microwave
5. If using white candy melts , add enough yellow food coloring to get a bright yellow tint
6. Dip the nutter butter cookies in the melted candy coating , shake off the excess , then lay on the wax paper
7. Allow the coating to harden , about 10-20 minutes
8. Pipe eyes on each chick
9. Add eyebrows or eye lashes if you like -- i think it gives them more personality
10. Beak: attach the beak using a bit of melted candy coating

title: lemon dill chicken patties with orzo
steps:
1. Cook orzo in lightly salted water as package directs
2. Drain
3. Return to pot
4. Add remaining orzo ingredients
5. Toss to mix
6. Cover to keep warm
7. While orzo cooks , mix patties ingredients except chicken
8. Add chicken
9. Mix well
10. Form into sixteen 1 / 2-inch thick patties
11. Heat oil in large nonstick skillet
12. Add patties
13. Cook over medium heat , turning once , about 5 minutes , until opaque in center
14. Serve with orzo
15. Serves 4

title: dorothy smith goodens salmon loaf
steps:
1. Mix all the ingredients together
2. Place in a buttered loaf pan
3. Bake at 350f for apprx 1 / 2 hour or until baked

title: swedish coffee cake
steps:
1. Cake:
2. Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit
3. Cream together butter and sugar , add egg yolks gradually
4. Sift the flour , baking powder and salt into the batter
5. Stir
6. Add milk , vanilla , lemon juice and lemon rind
7. Stir
8. Beat egg whites until stiff
9. Fold into batter
10. Pour into 13x9 baking pan
11. Top with crumb topping and bake for 40 minutes or until tester comes out clean
12. Crumb topping:
13. Mix dry ingredients together
14. Cut in the butter with a pastry blender or the back of a fork until it resembles crumbs
15. Scatter crumbs over unbaked cake

title: rich   creamy crawfish or shrimp pasta w  cheese sauce
steps:
1. Chop the green onions
2. Open the cheese and slice it in as many pieces as possible so it can melt easily
3. Set onions and cheese aside separately
4. It is a good idea at this point to start a large pot of boiling water , and it should be boiling by the time the sauce is done
5. To make the sauce: melt stick of butter in a large skillet on medium heat
6. Add chopped onions
7. Simmer for a few minutes , stirring occasionally , until onions look nicely cooked
8. Add the package of crawfish and let simmer for another few minutes
9. Add the cheese , and once it has started to melt , add the can of soup
10. Dash of salt if desired
11. You can turn the heat up to medium hi
12. Continue stirring until the cheese is completely melted
13. If it is too thick , milk can be added to thin it out
14. Cover and turn heat back down to low
15. Stir occasionally so the sauce does not stick
16. Now just boil the pasta according to the package instructions
17. Sauce can be served over the pasta or mixed inches
18. If there are leftovers , i usually store it all mixed together
19. It reheats better that way

title: moist pork chops
steps:
1. Heat oil on medium high and brown both sides of pork chops
2. Dissolve beef boullion in the 3 cups of hot water and pour over pork
3. Pepper lightly and sprinkle onions over all
4. Cover and lower heat and let simmer for 1 hour
5. The longer the better
6. Remove chops and keep warm
7. If you want gravy mix 1 1 / 2 tbsp flour with 1 / 4 cup water until there are no lumps
8. Slowly stir flour mixture into pan and stir until thick
9. Can be poured over pork chops before serving

title: egg salad sandwich   simple and delicious
steps:
1. Place boiled eggs into a small bowl , mash about half of them with a fork
2. Stir in the green onions , miracle whip and dry mustard powder
3. Sprinkle with salt and pepper to suit your tastes
4. Makes 2 sandwiches

title: stir fry
steps:
1. Mix the desired sauce mix in a small bowl until blended
2. Heat 1 tablespoon oil in large nonstick skillet
3. Put 2 tablespoon cornstarch and 1 pound protein into a large ziptop bag , seal bag and shake to coat
4. Add protein to skillet
5. Stir fry over medium-high heat 3-5 minutes until cooked through
6. Remove to plate
7. Add 2 teaspoon oil to skillet
8. Heat
9. Add 4 cups of any one or combination of vegetables
10. Stir fry 3-5 minutes until crisp tender
11. Add sauce to skillet
12. Bring to simmer
13. Add protein
14. Simmer 1-2 minutes until sauce thickens and coats mixture
15. Serve with choice of side , and top with finishing touches
16. Protein : shelled shrimp , boneless skinless chicken breasts cut into 3 / 4-inch cubes , boneless sirloin flank or skirt steak cut into 1 / 4-inch thick strips , pork tenderloin cut lengthwise in half then crosswise into 1 / 4-inch slices , or firm tofu cut into 1-inch cubes
17. Vegetables :small broccoli florets , small cauliflower florets , sliced shiitake mushrooms , sliced white buttom mushrooms , shelled edamame , 1 / 2-inch red or yellow pepper strips , 1 / 2-inch cubanelle pepper strips , thinly sliced carrots , 1 1 / 2-inch long slices asparagus , snow peas , or 1 / 2-inch thick red onion wedges
18. Finishing touches: cashews , peanuts , almonds , toasted sesame seeds , crushed red pepper , thinly sliced scallions , cilantro , or mint
19. Sides: jasmine rice , brown rice , buckwheat noodles , cellophane / rice noodles , lo mein noodles or stir fry noodles

title: peanut butter candy bar brownies
steps:
1. Combine crushed cookies and butter in a medium bowl
2. Press crumb mixture into bottom of a greased aluminum foil-lined 13" x 9" pan , allowing foil to extend over ends of pan
3. Bake at 350 for 6 to 8 minutes
4. Combine condensed milk , peanut butter , and vanilla in a medium bowl , stirring until smooth
5. Sprinkle chopped candy bars , chocolate morsels , peanuts , and coconut over crust
6. Drizzle condensed milk mixture over coconut
7. Bake at 350 for 27 minutes or until lightly browned
8. Remove to a wire rack , and let cool in pan
9. Use foil to lift uncut brownies out of pan
10. Peel foil away from sides of uncut brownies , and cut into bars

title: dublin s balsamic vinaigrette
steps: 1. Mix oil and vinegar well then add spices

title: x rated on the beach
steps: 1. Combine all ingredients & serve over ice

title: roasted cauliflower with ras el hanout tahini sauce
steps:
1. Cauliflower:
2. Preheat oven to 400 f
3. Line baking sheet with parchment paper , or coat with cooking spray
4. Whisk together oil , tahini , and ras el hanout in large bowl
5. Add cauliflower , and toss to coat cauliflower with sauce
6. Spread cauliflower on prepared baking sheet , and roast 20-25 minutes , or until browned and dry , stirring once or twice
7. Tahini sauce:
8. Whisk together all ingredients with 1 / 2 cup water in bowl
9. Season with salt and pepper , if desired
10. Assemble:
11. Transfer cauliflower to platter , and drizzle with tahini sauce just before serving
12. Serve with lemon wedges

title: orange cranberry sauce
steps:
1. Mix marmalade , juice and cinnamon stick in a saucepan , bring to boil
2. Add cranberries , return to boil
3. Lower to simmer and cook until cranberries pop and thicken , about 8-10 minutes
4. Add grated nutmeg , if desired , remove from heat , cool

title: layered ground beef casserole
steps:
1. In a 2 quart baking dish , layer half the onion , celery and green pepper
2. Salt and pepper to taste
3. Top with ground beef sprinkled with garlic powder
4. Pour over tomato sauce
5. Top with remaining onion , celery and green pepper
6. Arrange potatoes over top and cover with soup
7. Bake at 350 degrees uncovered for 1 1 / 2 hours

title: country gravy mix
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients well and store in a tightly sealed container
2. To make gravy: discard all but 2 tablespoons of the oil used to fry the chicken in a skillet
3. Over low heat , mix in 2 tablespoons of the country gravy mix
4. Stirring constantly , cook about 2 minutes
5. Whisk in 1 cup chicken broth , scraping browned bits off bottom of skillet
6. Stir in 1 cup milk and bring all to a boil over high heat , stirring constantly
7. Reduce heat to low and simmer about 5 minutes
8. Serve immediately with chicken , mashed potatoes or biscuits

title: crisp lemon calf liver
steps:
1. Cook bacon until crisp
2. Drain on paper towel
3. You may remove some of the bacon fat but leave a generous amount , do not clean skillet
4. Crumble bacon
5. Combine flour , dill , salt& pepper in a paper bag
6. Add liver and coat well , shake off any excess flour
7. Fry liver in the "bacon" skillet over high heat until crisp on outside but still moist inside
8. Remove liver but keep warm
9. Discard fat from skillet but do not scrape the pan
10. Over medium heat melt butter scraping in all the brown bits
11. Stir in lemon juice , parsley and crumbled bacon
12. Put liver back in the pan to ensure it is hot
13. Sprinkle with grated lemon and enjoy

title: classic souvlaki
steps:
1. Trim lamb
2. Cut into 1 inch cubes
3. In a bowl , whisk together lemon juice , oil , garlic , salt and pepper
4. Marinate for up to 24 hours in refrigerator
5. Room temp , 30 minutes
6. Soak wooden skewers at least 10 minutes to prevent charring during cooking
7. Remove meat from marinade , thread meat on skewers
8. Broil under broiler or bbq over med-high until done to personal preference
9. Serve with your favorite tzatziki sauce and savour the efforts of your labour

title: peanut butter no bake cookies
steps:
1. In lg saucepan , mix sugar , margarine , and milk
2. Bring to a full , rolling boil over med heat
3. Boil for one minute , stirring constantly
4. Remove from heat and stir in peanut butter and vanilla , stirring until peanut butter is melted
5. Stir in oats
6. Working quickly , drop by spoonfuls onto waxed paper
7. Let cool completely

title: erskine bread   apple pudding
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325f
2. Lighly grease a 2 1 / 2 quart casserole
3. Place one cup of apples in the bottom
4. Combine sugar , spices and bread crumbs in a bowl
5. Sprinkle one cup of this mixture on top of the apples in the casserole
6. Layer the last cup of apples on this followed by the last cup of sugar mixture
7. Pour the pineapple juice evenly over the top and dot with butter
8. Bake 1 hr and serve warm with a cup of tea !

title: eggless chocolate bundt cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f grease and flour a 9-inch bundt pan
2. In a large bowl , sift together flour and cocoa powder
3. Whisk in sugar , brown sugar , baking soda and salt
4. Pour in water , vegetable oil , vanilla extract and vinegar , whisking thoroughly , but quickly , until the batter comes together and is quite smooth
5. Pour into prepared pan
6. Bake for 45-50 minutes at 350f , until a tester comes out clean and the cake springs back when gently pressed
7. Allow to cool in pan for 10 minutes , then turn out onto a wire rack to cool completely
8. Once the cake as cooled , top with any glaze

title: berried delight
steps:
1. Mix crumbs , 1 / 4 cup of the sugar and butter in 13 x 9-inch pan
2. Press firmly into bottom of pan
3. Refrigerate
4. Beat cream cheese , remaining 1 / 4 cup sugar and 2 tablespoons milk in large bowl with wire whisk until smooth
5. Stir in 1 / 2 of the whipped topping
6. Spread over crust
7. Top with strawberry halves
8. Pour 3 1 / 2 cups milk into large bowl
9. Add pudding mixes
10. Beat with wire whisk 2 minutes
11. Pour over strawberries
12. Refrigerate 4 hours or until set
13. Just before serving , spread remaining whipped topping over pudding
14. Garnish with additional strawberries and fresh mint

title: steamed spinach with herbs
steps:
1. In a large pan insert steamer and pour in 1" water
2. Bring to boiling
3. Combine spinach and herbs in the steamer basket
4. Cover , turn down the heat to medium low , and steam for 2 to 3 minutes or until wilted , stirring once
5. Remove basket carefully
6. Drain
7. Move spinach to a serving bowl
8. Drizzle with some of the vinegar
9. Season to taste with salt and pepper
10. Pass the remaining vinegar
11. Garnish with lemon slices , if desired
12. Makes 4 servings

title: hash brown benedict
steps:
1. Rinse the potatoes , drain and pat dry
2. In a bowl , combine the potatoes , cornstarch , salt and black pepper
3. In 10-inch fry pan over medium heat , warm the oil
4. Working in batches , form the potato mixture into 1 / 4-cup patties and drop them into the oil
5. Cook , turning once , until golden brown , about 4 minutes per side
6. Transfer to a paper towel-lined baking sheet and keep warm in a 250f oven
7. In a bowl , whisk together the egg yolks , lemon juice and 2 teaspoons water
8. Transfer to a double boiler set over medium-low heat , until the water is just simmering inside the double boiler
9. Whisk constantly until the mixture begins to thicken , then remove from the heat and whisk for 1 minute more
10. Season with salt , black pepper and cayenne
11. Whisking constantly , slowly stream in the melted butter until incorporated , then whisk in the chives
12. Keep the hollandaise sauce warm
13. Place 2 hash brown patties on each plate
14. Top each patty with 1 slice of canadian bacon , 1 poached egg and a spoonful of the hollandaise sauce
15. Serve immediately

title: quick and easy mini cinnamon rolls
steps:
1. Unroll crescent rolls , and separate each dough portion along center perforation to form 4 rectangles
2. Press diagonal perforations to seal
3. Stir together butter and next 4 ingredients
4. Spread evenly over 1 side of each rectangle
5. Roll up jellyroll fashion , starting at long end
6. Gently cut each log into 6 slices , using a serrated knife
7. Place rolls , 1 / 4 inch apart , into 2 greased cakepans
8. Bake at 375 for 15 to 18 minutes or until golden
9. Cool 5 to 10 minutes
10. Stir together powdered sugar and remaining ingredients
11. Drizzle over warm rolls

title: piranha
steps: 1. Pour the alcohol into a rocks glass containing plenty of cracked ice and stir vigorously , before adding the cola

title: spicy shrimp and pasta casserole
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
2. Grease a 12 by 8-inch pan or glass dish with butter
3. Combine the eggs , half-and-half , yogurt , swiss and feta cheeses , parsley , basil , and oregano in a large bowl , mixing until thoroughly blended
4. Spread 1 / 2 of the cooked pasta evenly over the bottom of the prepared pan
5. Cover the pasta with the salsa
6. Add 1 / 2 of the shrimp and then cover it with monterey jack
7. Add the remaining pasta and shrimp
8. Spread the egg mixture over top of the casserole
9. Bake for 30 minutes or until bubbly
10. Let stand for 10 minutes before serving

title: apple jack chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Place chicken between 2 sheets of waxed paper and , with rolling pin or metal "chicken pounder" flatten each breast piece to uniform thickness
3. Place chicken in prepared 9 x 13 baking dish and bake for about 30 minutes , depending on thickness and your particular oven
4. Turn chicken pieces and divide apple slices evenly on top of each piece
5. Bake for an additional 10 minutes
6. Top each chicken piece with a slice of cheese
7. Bake an additional 5 or 10 minutes or until cheese melts and chicken is cooked

title: chocoflan
steps:
1. Cake: preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Prepare cake batter according to instructions on package
3. Do not bake , set aside
4. Flan: in a blender , mix eggs , condensed milk , cream cheese and vanilla til smooth
5. On a small pan over the stove top pour the 1 / 2 cup of brown sugar til it melts to make the caramel topping
6. On a greased bundt pan pour the caramel to cover the bottom of the pan following pour prepared cake batter then on top of cake batter add flan mixture
7. It might seem everything is mixing together but once baked both will cook separately and it'll look beautiful
8. Bake 45 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean
9. Remove and cool
10. Place on a serving dish best when served cold

title: red lobster bananas foster cheesecake clone
steps:
1. Position rack in center of oven and preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Wrap outside of 9-inch diameter springform pan with 3-inch-high sides with heavy-duty foil
3. Combine flour , pecans , butter , sugar , brown sugar and vanilla in large bowl
4. Mix well
5. Press mixture onto bottom of prepared pan
6. Using electric mixer , beat cream cheese in large bowl until smooth
7. Gradually beat in sugar
8. Beat in cornstarch
9. Add eggs , one at a time , beating until just blended after each addition
10. Add pureed banana , sour cream , lemon juice , vanilla , cinnamon and salt
11. Beat just until combined
12. Transfer filling to crust-lined pan
13. Place pan in large roasting pan
14. Add enough hot water to roasting pan to come one inch up sides of springform pan
15. Bake until center of cake is just set , about 1 hour 15 minutes
16. Remove cake from oven
17. Maintain oven temperature
18. Meanwhile , prepare topping
19. Mix together sour cream , sugar and vanilla in small bowl until well blended
20. Spread topping over cheesecake
21. Bake until topping is set , about 10 minutes
22. Turn off oven
23. Let cake stand in oven until cooled to room temperature , about 2 hours
24. Refrigerate cake until well chilled
25. Cover and refrigerate overnight
26. Cutaround cake to loosen
27. Remove pan sides
28. Transfer cake to platter
29. Warm caramel sauce in small saucepan over low heat , stirring often
30. Mix in rum
31. Drizzle some sauce decoratively over cake
32. Arrange bananas atop cake
33. Cut cake into wedges and serve with sauce

title: light and zesty vegetable coleslaw
steps:
1. In large bowl , combine coleslaw blend , broccoli and onions
2. Stir gently to mnix well
3. In small bowl , combine dressing , marmalade and celery seed
4. Blend well
5. Pour over coleslaw mixture
6. Toss to coat
7. Add mandarin orange segments
8. Toss gently
9. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours before serving

title: lime jalapeno hummus
steps: 1. Combine all ingredients in food processor until smooth

title: strawberry amaretto cheesecake
steps:
1. You will also need: 9-inch springform pan
2. To prepare crust place graham crackers , sugar and butter in a small mixing bowl
3. Blend well with fingers or a pastry blender
4. Press into the bottom of a well-buttered 9" springform pan
5. Chill in the freezer or refrigerator for about 30 minutes while you prepare the batter and strawberries
6. In a large bowl , beat the cream cheese , sugar and heavy cream until smooth
7. Add the eggs , one at a time , making sure that the mixture is smooth after beating in each egg
8. Add the lemon juice , brandy extract , sour cream , vanilla , and flour and continue beating until very smooth and creamy
9. Fold in the chopped strawberries
10. Pour the mixture into the chilled springform pan that you have placed on a cookie sheet
11. Bake in a preheated 425 oven for 15 minutes , then reduce the temperature to 275 and continue to bake for 1 hour
12. Transfer to a wire rack and allow to cool for 3 hours
13. While the cake is cooling , marinate the sliced strawberries in the amaretto and sugar for about 3 to 4 hours
14. Arranges the slices decoratively on top of the cooled cheesecake and bake in a 350 oven for 7 minutes
15. Transfer to a wire rack and allow to cool completely for 2 hours
16. Remove the sides of the springform pan and refrigerate overnight
17. Remove the cake from the refrigerator for at least 2 hours before serving

title: skinny protein salad
steps:
1. Mix everything together
2. Chill 1 hour if you're not starving now
3. Eat

title: blue mountain coffee rum poached pears
steps:
1. Place the coffee in a pan large enough to hold the pears snugly with the sugar and cinnamon and heat gently
2. Carefully peel the pears , leaving the stalks intact
3. Poach in the sweetened coffee for 20 minutes , turning occasionally
4. Turn off the heat , stir in the rum and allow the pears to cool in the coffee mixture
5. Transfer to a bowl and chill until ready to serve
6. Toserve , place the pear in a pretty , shallow glass dish or bowl and spoon over the coffee syrup

title: chinese noodles   zucchini
steps:
1. Bring a medium sized saucepan of water to a boil
2. Add noodles and cook 3 minutes for dried or 1 minutes for fresh
3. Drain
4. Mix oyster sauce , vinegar , and sugar together
5. Spray a wok or skillet with vegetable oil and heat
6. Add zucchini and garlic
7. Stir fry for 3 minutes
8. Add drained noodles and continue to stir fry until noodles begin to crisp
9. Pour oyster sauce mixture into the middle of wok , and toss well
10. Making sure all of the noodles are coated with sauce
11. Spoon onto a serving platter or individual plates and sprinkle with chopped cilantro

title: crunchy apple coffee cake
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl , cream shortening and sugar
2. Add eggs and vanilla
3. Mix well
4. Combine flour , baking powder , baking soda and salt
5. Add to creamed mixture alternately with the sour cream
6. Stir in apples
7. Transfer to two greased 8-inch square baking pans
8. For the topping , combine brown sugar and cinnamon
9. Cut in butter until crumbly
10. Stir in nuts
11. Sprinkle over batter
12. Bake in a preheated 350f oven for 30-35 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean
13. Cool completely
14. Cover and freeze for up to 6 months
15. Thaw overnight in the refrigerator

title: greek nectarine preserves
steps:
1. Peel and seed nectarines
2. Cut into chunks
3. Boil in water until soft
4. Add sugar
5. Stir and watch to prevent burning
6. Cook 30 minutes
7. Last 5 minutes add brandy , vanilla , and lemon juice
8. Pour in hot sterile jars
9. Seal

title: braunschweiger ii
steps:
1. Cook liver in simmering water for 10 minutes then chill before grinding
2. Grind all meat through 3 / 16 plate
3. Chill in freezer for 30 minute
4. Chop in blender or food processor
5. This sounds a lot easier than it is as you can only do about half a cup at a time
6. Commercial sausage kitchens use a machine called a chopper but we have to make due with what we have
7. The idea is to produce what is known as an emulsion
8. This process is also required for hot dogs , bologna and other sausages where a homogeneous texture is required
9. Stuff in beef middles
10. Place the sausage in a 165 degree f water for about one hour to internal temp of 152f
11. Chill in cold water
12. Liver sausage: store in fridge for about a day before eating
13. Keeps for several weeks in fridge
14. Braunschweiger: dry in smoker at 100f , then smoke for 5 hrs at 120f

title: chocolate caramel squares
steps:
1. Add all ingredients for crust , except butter , in a mixing bowl
2. With pastry blender , cut in butter until mixture is crumbly
3. Press the mixture into an 8-inch square cake pan
4. Bake in a preheated oven at 350f for about 25 minutes or until just golden and firm
5. Cool in the pan
6. Place ingredients for caramel filling in saucepan and heat over low heat , stirring until sugar is dissolved
7. Bring to a boil over low heat and boil very gently for 3 to 4 minutes , stirring constantly until thickened
8. Pour the caramel filling over cookie base and allow to set
9. Melt the dark chocolate chips and spread over the caramel , allow to cool and set
10. When dark chocolate is set , melt the white chocolate and drizzle over top
11. Cut into squares and enjoy
12. Dh suggested to use a pizza cutter to cut bar cookies and it works like a charm

title: roast salmon with leeks
steps:
1. Combine zest , dill , salt , pepper
2. Using 1 tablespoon oil , brush fish with oil and top with lemon-dill mixture
3. Place salmon on pan and roast in 425 oven until cooked , about 15 minutes
4. In skillet , saute leeks in remaining 1 tablespoon oil
5. Season with salt and pepper
6. Transfer salmon to platter and top with leeks

title: fried noodles
steps:
1. In a large skillet add butter let melt then add cooked noodles
2. Fry noodles for around 10 minutes stirring occasionally
3. Let the outside of the noodles get crispy
4. Portion out and serve on a plate
5. Add a dollop of sour cream
6. Enjoy

title: tender whole wheat yogurt pancakes
steps:
1. Combine dry ingredients in a medium bowl - set aside
2. Combine wet ingredients in a small bowl with a whisk
3. Add wet to dry and stir until combined
4. Pour by 1 / 4 cup onto hot griddle sprayed with canola oil or brushed with butter
5. 3 pancakes per serving

title: crunchy raisin bread french toast
steps:
1. Mix eggs , milk , vanilla , powdered sugar and nutmeg in a shallow dish
2. Place cereal in another shallow dish
3. Spray a 12" nonstick skillet generously with butter
4. Heat over medium heat
5. Dip both sides of 4 slices of the bread in egg mixture , then in cereal
6. Cook 2 to 3 minutes or until golden brown , turning once
7. Repeat with remaining bread , egg mixture and cereal , buttering the skillet each time
8. Serve topped with powdered sugar , if desired
9. Enjoy !
10. Makes 4 servings

title: cantaloupe  marshmallow  and cool whip salad
steps:
1. Cut peeled cantaloupe into 1 / 4 or 1 / 2 inch cubes
2. Put into large bowl
3. Mix in mini marshmallows and cool whip
4. Stir and mix well
5. Serve chilled

title: healthy butternut squash muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Lightly grease a 12 cup muffin pan
3. In a medium saucepan with enough water to cover , boil squash 20 minutes , or until tender
4. Remove from heat , drain , and puree in a food processor
5. In a large bowl , whisk together flour , baking powder , sugar , salt and pumpkin pie spice
6. In a medium bowl , thoroughly mix together milk , egg and applesauce
7. Stir in squash
8. Fold the squash mixture into the flour mixture just until moistened
9. Spoon batter into the greased muffin pan , filling cups about full
10. Bake 20 minutes

title: karen s macaroni salad
steps:
1. Cook macaroni according to package directions
2. Drain and rinse well with cold water
3. In a large bowl mix mayo , onion , olives , salt and pepper until well combined
4. Add macaroni and mix well
5. Refrigerate until serving

title: devilicious cookie cake delights
steps:
1. Blend together cake mix , oil and eggs
2. Add chips of choice
3. Drop by rounded tablespoon onto ungreased cookie sheet
4. Bake at 350 for 9-12 minutes or until set
5. Let cool 5 minutes before removing from cookie sheet

title: filipino pandesal bread   bread machine
steps:
1. Combine the water , evaporated milk and milk and heat in the microwave for 35 seconds
2. Run tap water over the egg for 30 seconds to warm it
3. Add all ingredients in the order suggested by the manufacturer
4. The dough is supposed to be somewhat sticky
5. Spray two baking sheets with non-stick cooking spray
6. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
7. When the dough is ready , scoop out a small amount and roll in bread crumbs in an oval shape
8. Place on baking sheet
9. Cover and leave to rise in a warm place until doubled
10. Bake for 10 to 15 minutes , until golden brown

title: glazed orange rhubarb loaf
steps:
1. Measure out rhubarb
2. Defrost frozen rhubarb , then drain well and pat dry
3. If using fresh rhubarb , chop finely
4. Preheat oven to 350f
5. Lightly grease a 9x5-inch loaf pan
6. Stir rhubarb with 1 / 4 cup sugar and set aside
7. Finely grate peel from 2 oranges to make about 2 tablespoons , and squeeze out 1 cup juice
8. Measure 2 tablespoons of this juice into a dish
9. Stir in 2 tablespoons sugar and set aside to glaze loaf
10. In a medium-size bowl , beat egg
11. Stir in remaining juice , grated peel and vanilla
12. Measure flour , 3 / 4 cup sugar , baking powder , soda and salt into a large mixing bowl
13. Stir with a fork until blended and make a well in centre
14. Pour in egg mixture and cooled melted butter
15. Stir just until evenly combined
16. Batter is very thick
17. Stir in rhubarb mixture and nuts just until evenly distributed
18. Turn into prepared pan
19. Batter will almost fill the pan
20. Smooth top
21. Bake in centre of preheated 350f oven until top is golden and a skewer inserted into centre comes out clean , about 1 hour and 15 to 20 minutes
22. Place pan on a rack
23. Stir orange juice and sugar mixture
24. Pour over top of hot loaf
25. Cool loaf in pan for 10 minutes
26. Then , turn out of pan and place loaf on rack to finish cooling
27. Loaf will keep well , covered , at room temperature for up to 2 days
28. Store in refrigerator if longer
29. Or wrap airtight and freeze

title: halibut with strawberry salsa
steps:
1. Salsa: mix all ingredients together and refrigerate for 30 minutes
2. Make approximately 2 cups
3. Halibut: in a frying pan , heat oil on high
4. Sear halibut for 2 minutes on each side
5. Place halibut in a 350f oven for 5 minutes

title: potato salmon patties
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , mix salmon , eggs , garlic and herb seasoned dry bread crumbs , dry potato flakes , onion , garlic , dill weed , celery salt , salt , and pepper
2. Form the mixture into 2 inch balls , and flatten into patties about 1 / 2 inch thick
3. Heat olive oil in a medium skillet over medium heat
4. In batches , cook patties about 5 minutes on each side , until lightly browned

title: fruit tea ginger ale punch
steps:
1. In a punch bowl or large container make a syrup of the sugar and tea
2. Add fruit juices and enough water or more tea-- approximately 1 cup-- to make 24 cups
3. Freeze this punch base
4. Defrost and stir in ginger ale to make mixture"slushy"
5. Serve in a large punch bowl

title: cowboy s brisket
steps:
1. With a long thin , sharp knife , make slits in the meat and insert the slivers of garlic
2. Place the meat in a bowl , spread 1 sliced onion and the crushed garlic over the meat , and pour in the vinegar
3. Marinate for 6 hours at room temperature or overnight in the refrigerator , turning several times
4. When ready to cook , preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
5. Heat the bacon fat in a deep , heavy skillet large enough to hold the brisket
6. Remove the brisket from the marinade and discard the onion and vinegar
7. Dry with paper towels
8. Brown the meat well on all sides
9. Remove brisket to a platter
10. In the fat remaining in the skillet , saute the remaining sliced onions until deeply browned
11. Pour in 1 / 2 cup coffee
12. Bring to a boil , stirring and scraping the bottom of the skillet to loosen the browned bits
13. Spread the onions and liquid from the skillet in a shallow baking dish
14. Place the brisket on the onions
15. Season with salt and freshly ground pepper to taste
16. Pour in the remaining coffee and water
17. Cover tightly with foil and place in oven for 1 / 2 hour
18. Turn the oven down to 250 degrees f
19. And bake for an additional 2 hours or until meat is very tender
20. Slice the brisket thinly against the grain
21. Skim the fat from the pan liquid
22. Return the meat slices to the pan
23. Serve at once or refrigerate for later use

title: roasted cheddar potatoes  bhg com
steps:
1. Preheat oven according to package directions for potatoes
2. Place frozen potatoes in a large self-sealing plastic bag
3. Combine cooking oil , garlic , paprika , and salt
4. Drizzle over potato wedges
5. Seal bag and shake to coat potatoes
6. Lightly coat a 15x10x1-inch baking pan with nonstick cooking spray
7. Spread potatoes in a single layer on prepared pan
8. Bake potato wedges according to package directions , turning once
9. In another small bowl combine the cheese and crotons
10. Sprinkle over the potatoes the last 3 minutes of baking
11. Use a large spatula to transfer potato wedges to a platter or large plate
12. Serve with sour cream , if desired

title: peanut butter energy balls  energy bar    easy no bake
steps:
1. Mix peanut butter , oatmeal , sunflower seeds , raisins , and honey
2. Roll mixture into balls
3. Mix equal amounts of flax seeds and wheat germ in a bowl and roll the balls in this mixture
4. Let balls sit in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes
5. Additional
6. You can make some substitutions with the ingredients
7. For example , substitute the raisins for chocolate chips or chopped nuts instead of sunflower seeds
8. There are many possibilities , just be careful and keep the ratios consistent
9. Also , i used natural peanut butter which caused my mixture to be more dry
10. If this is the case add a little milk
11. About 1 / 2 tablespoon at a time

title: zucchini muffins with chocolate chips and honey orange glaze
steps:
1. Mix first five ingredients in a large bowl
2. In another bowl , mix the egg , applesauce , milk , orange zest and vanilla
3. Stir wet mixture into the dry ingredients until just moistened
4. Fold in the zucchini and chocolate chips
5. Spray non-stick muffin pans with cooking spray
6. Evenly spoon batter into 12 muffin cups
7. Bake at 350f for 20 minutes or until a toothpick inserted into center of muffin comes out clean
8. Set on cooling rack
9. While muffins are cooling , melt butter in a small microwaveable bowl
10. Add honey , orange zest and orange juice to butter and microwave 10-30 seconds until the honey has liquified and mixture is easy to mix
11. Poke holes in still warm muffins with a fork
12. Evenly spoon glaze mixture over each muffin
13. Let muffins cool completely
14. Enjoy !

title: italian cookies
steps:
1. Let the butter soften to room temperature
2. Mix these three ingredients well
3. With a teaspoon , form a small amount into balls
4. Place the balls into the refrigerator to chill overnight
5. The next day , roll the balls out on a floured surface
6. Sprinkle approximately a teaspoon of chopped pecans and then a teaspoon of sugar into the middle of the rolled out dough
7. Wrap the dough around the sugar and pecans pressing to seal it together
8. Form into a crescent shape
9. I then freeze these cookies with layers of wax paper in between them so they do not stick together
10. When i want some , i take out only the number that i want to bake , usually 2 4 dozen at a time , and bake at 350 degrees until nicely browned
11. Serve warm ! that is when they are the best

title: billie moores shrimp cocktail sauce
steps: 1. Mix well and chill

title: semolina halva
steps:
1. Melt the butter
2. Add semolina and pine nuts and roast by stirring for 10-15 min until pine nuts turn to light brown
3. Add water , milk and sugar respectively wait until boiling bubbles are observed
4. Lower the heat and stir occasionally untill the water runs out
5. Turn off the heat , cover the lid of the pot and let it cool down

title: mexican shepherd s pie with cornmeal buttermilk topping
steps:
1. For the topping beat together eggs , buttermilk and butter
2. Whisk in the dry ingredients until smooth and set aside
3. Brown ground beef with the onions and peppers
4. Drain off fat and return to the pan
5. Add remaining ingredients and simmer , covered , for 15 minutes
6. Pour into an ungreased 8 by 8 inch baking dish and level off the top
7. Spread topping over the meat
8. Bake at 350 degrees for 20 minutes
9. Prep time includes time to simmer the meat mixture

title: chicken from the french countryside  crock pot
steps:
1. Cut the chicken into serving portions , rinse and pat dry
2. Peel and dice carrots and onion
3. Wash beans and cut into 2 inch pieces
4. Clean and slice mushrooms
5. Smash , peel and dice the garlic
6. Wash , core and chop the tomatoes into 1 / 4 inch pieces
7. Place chicken into slow cooker
8. Add everything else except the rice and water
9. Cover and cook on low 4-5 hours
10. Stir in the rice and water
11. Cover and cook on low 3-4 more hours

title: gnocchi nicoise
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a medium skillet over medium-high heat
2. Add the bacon and garlic
3. Cook until the bacon starts to brown , about 4 minutes
4. Add the ground beef
5. Cook , stirring , 3 minutes
6. Add the brandy , shallots , carrots , celery and tomato paste
7. Cook until the vegetables soften , about 4 minutes
8. Season with salt and pepper
9. Crush the tomatoes into the pan with your hands and add any juices from the can
10. Stir in the broth , bay leaf , orange peel and olives
11. Bring to a simmer and lower the heat
12. Cover and cook 20 minutes
13. Uncover , increase the heat and bring to a boil to thicken the sauce
14. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil the gnocchi until one floats to the top , about 1 minute
15. Drain immediately to prevent the gnocchi from becoming mushy
16. Remove the orange peel and bay leaf from the sauce and season with salt and pepper
17. Toss the gnocchi with the sauce

title: bananas and cream bread  for bread machines
steps: 1. Add yeast , bread flour , wheat germ , powdered milk , sugar , salt , nutmeg , vegetable oil , bananas , sour cream or yogurt , and water in the order suggested by your bread machine manual and process on the basic bread cycle according to the manufacturer's directions

title: market mix  roasted potatoes  fennel  mushrooms and peppers
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450f
2. Combine all ingredients in a large shallow roasting pan
3. Toss well to coat all the vegetables
4. Roast for 30 minutes without stirring
5. Shake pan to loosen vegetables
6. Roast until potatoes are crusty and browned , about 20 minutes , stirring once or twice during last 10 minutes

title: pollo en escabeche   uruguayan marinated chicken
steps:
1. Brown the chicken in the 2 tablespoons olive oil in a heavy skillet over high heat
2. Place the chicken pieces in a large saucepan or casserole and add the carrots , onions , garlic and spices
3. Add the vinegar and oil and simmer over low heat for 45 minutes to 1 hour , until the chicken is done
4. Remove from the heat and allow to come to room temperature
5. Chill well in the refrigerator - at least 5 hours but best overnight - and serve cold

title: inside out bacon cheeseburgers with grilled green onion mayo
steps:
1. Preheat grill pan over high heat
2. In a medium pan brown bacon over medium high heat and drain on paper towel lined plate
3. Brush scallions with a little oil and grill on hot grill pan 2 or 3 minutes on each side
4. Remove from heat to cool
5. To make the burgers , combine ground beef with worcestershire and steak seasoning or salt and pepper
6. Divide meat into 4 equal parts
7. Combine cheese crumbles and cooked bacon
8. Take 1 / 4 of the meat in your hand and make a well in the center of it
9. Pile in cheese and bacon , then carefully form the burger around the cheese and bacon filling
10. Make sure the fillings are completely covered with meat
11. When all 4 patties are formed , drizzle burgers with oil and place on hot grill pan
12. Cook 2 minutes on each side over high heat , reduce heat to medium low and cook burgers 7 or 8 minutes longer , turning occasionally
13. Do not press down on burgers as they cook
14. Transfer burgers to a plate and let them rest 5 minutes before serving
15. To make the green onion mayonnaise , chop cooled , grilled green onions and add to a food processor
16. Add mayonnaise and cumin to the food processor and pulse the onions and mayonnaise
17. Season with salt and pepper , to your taste
18. Pile burgers on crusty buns and top with crisp lettuce leaves and a slather of green onion mayonnaise
19. As you bite into the burgers , you will find a smoky , cheesy surprise at the center

title: enchiladas de pollo  chicken enchiladas
steps:
1. To prepare filling , place first 6 ingredients in a dutch oven
2. Bring to a boil
3. Cover , reduce heat , and simmer 45 minutes
4. Remove chicken from cooking liquid
5. Cool
6. Remove chicken from bones
7. Shred with 2 forks
8. Discard bones
9. Reserve broth for another use
10. Preheat oven to 375
11. Combine chicken , 1 / 2 cup each monterey jack and cheddar cheeses , and 1 / 2 cup onion in a bowl
12. Set aside
13. To prepare sauce , place milk and next 5 ingredients in a food processor
14. Process until smooth
15. To prepare tortillas , fill a medium skillet with 1 inch of water
16. Bring to a simmer
17. Dip 1 tortilla in water using tongs
18. Spoon 1 / 2 cup filling in center of tortilla
19. Roll tightly , and place in an 11 x 7-inch baking dish
20. Repeat procedure with remaining tortillas and filling
21. Pour sauce over enchiladas
22. Cover and bake at 375 for 20 minutes
23. Uncover
24. Sprinkle with 1 / 4 cup each monterey jack and cheddar
25. Bake an additional 5 minutes or until cheeses melt
26. Top with sour cream

title: southwest rice salad
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine the rice , beans , corn and onions
2. Toss to mix
3. In a food processor , blend remaining ingredients , except the cilantro and tomatoes , until the peppers are finely minced
4. Pour the dressing over the rice mixture and mix well
5. Garnish with the cilantro and chopped tomatoes
6. This salad can be made 1-2 days in advance and served either cold or room temperature

title: nif s tasty tuna salad muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. In a large bowl , mix dry ingredients
3. In medium bowl , mix tuna , yogurt and veggies
4. In separate bowl , whisk together egg , milk and oil
5. Pour over flour mixture
6. Add tuna mixture to large bowl and stir until dry ingredients are just moistened
7. Do not over mix !
8. Spray a muffin tin with nonstick spray
9. Spoon equal amounts of muffin mix into 8 muffin cups
10. Bake in preheated oven for about 25 minutes , until golden brown

title: sigara bouregi bourek turkish cheese cigars
steps:
1. Prepare the filling by mixing the cheese , parsley , half the egg , salt , and pepper
2. You can do this with a hand mixer or food processor / blender , or a fork if you want to give your arms a good workout
3. Set aside into a bowl
4. Lay the 3 phyllo sheets down on top of each other on a clean surface
5. With a knife slice them vertically down the middle to get 2 long , even rectangles
6. Slice each rectangle diagonally to get 12 even , thin triangles
7. Take one phyllo triangle and place it so that its shorter side is closer to you and place a table spoon of filling along the opposite end of the triangle
8. Tuck the bottom of the triangle over the filling then roll up into a thin cigar wet the pointy
9. Repeat this until you have no more filling or phyllo left
10. Should have 12 "cigars"
11. Brush each cigar completely with half the egg , then the olive oil
12. To make sure the bottoms cook , i prefer to line my casserole pan with foil and put some of this egg-olive oil mixture all over the foil
13. Bake at 450f for 12-15 minutes or until golden-brown
14. Goes great with red lentil soup !

title: easy maple pecan pie
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees f
2. Sprinkle the chopped nuts over the pie crust
3. In a large bowl whisk together the maple syrup , brown sugar , eggs , white sugar , melted butter , flour and vanilla
4. Pour the filling over nuts and crust
5. Bake for about 50-60 minutes , or until filling is set and slightly puffed
6. Transfer to a rack and cool completely
7. Delicious !

title: catfish      salt and pepper catfish
steps:
1. Place buttermilk in a 2-quart baking dish
2. Place fillets in buttermilk and allow to marinate for 15 minutes
3. Place oil in a 12 inch cast iron skillet to a depth of about 2 inches
4. Heat until oil registers 375 degrees f
5. On an instant-read thermometer
6. In a large , zipper-lock food storage bag , mix remaining ingredients by zipping them inside bag and shaking until well blended
7. Remove fillets from buttermilk
8. Allow excess liquid to drain
9. Pplace fillets in bag and shake gently until completely coated
10. Gently shake off excess coating mixture and carefully place into hot oil
11. Fry until golden brown , about 5 minutes on each side
12. Drain on paper towels and serve

title: authentic polish cucumber salad  mizeria
steps:
1. Place cucumbers in a medium bowl
2. Add salt
3. Mix lightly until salt adheres evenly to cucumbers
4. Cover and refrigerate for one hour
5. Drain juice from limp cucumbers
6. In a small bowl , combine the remainder of the ingredients
7. Add to cucumbers , mixing gently
8. Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve

title: bacon   egg breakfast spread sandwiches
steps:
1. Mix eggs , mayonnaise , bacon , worcestershire sauce , and cheese together until they're a good consistency for spreading
2. Serve on crackers or bread

title: cardamom cheesecake bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. In a bowl , combine graham cracker crumbs and butter
3. Press firmly into a foil-lined 9-inch square pan
4. In a bowl , beat the cream cheese , sugar , cardamom and vanilla with an electric mixer on medium speed until well blended
5. Pour over the crust
6. For the streusel topping:
7. Mix flour , oats and brown sugar in a small bowl
8. Stir in cardamom
9. With two knives or a pastry blender , cut in butter until coarse crumbs form
10. Stir in sliced almonds
11. Sprinkle streusel topping over cheesecake mixture
12. Bake 45 minutes , or until center is almost set and topping is golden brown
13. Cool on a wire rack
14. Refrigerate 3 hours or overnight
15. Cut into bars
16. Store leftover bars in the refrigerator

title: creamy garlic chicken
steps:
1. Melt butter in skillet over medium / low heat and add garlic
2. When garlic becomes fragrant add the chicken and sour cream , increase heat
3. Cook until chicken is cooked thoroughly and sauce has slightly reduced
4. Add parsley and salt and pepper and allow flavors to blend
5. Serve chicken over rice or pasta with extra sauce

title: chipotle roast for tacos   sandwiches
steps:
1. Place chuck roast in large crock pot and sprinkle with the salt and pepper , chili powder and cumin
2. Add the remaining ingredients and simmer on high for 5 hours or on low for 7-8 hours
3. Shred the meat with a fork and simmer on high for additional 10-15 minutes
4. Serve in enchiladas , tacos or on crusty rolls with the juice for dipping

title: baked chicken and rice with three soups
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Combine the three soups , rice and water in a casserole dish , mixing until the ingredients are thoroughly combined
3. Place the chicken breasts on top of the rice
4. Sprinkle the chicken and the rice mixture with the salt , pepper , garlic powder , thyme and paprika to taste
5. Place the pieces of butter evenly over each piece of chicken , so that each piece gets two portions of butter
6. Bake the casserole at 375 for about 25-30 minutes or until the skin on the chicken is golden brown and the rice is hot , bubbly and fully cooked
7. Serve immediately
8. This dish can also be made with whole cut-up chicken pieces in lieu of only chicken breasts
9. I just make it this way so no one fights over the chicken breasts which they always seem to do if i do it the other way

title: holunderbeersuppe mit apfeln
steps:
1. Wash the elderberry bunches and strip off the berries
2. Bring to a boil in water with the sugar , 1 lemon rind and cinnamon stick
3. Simmer until cooked
4. Press the berries through a sieve
5. You will need 1 1 / 4 pints of juice so add water if needed
6. Peel , core and slice the apples
7. Add to elderberry juice along with the juice of 1 lemon and lemon rind and bring to a boil
8. Mix cornflour with 3 tablespoons of cold water and add to soup
9. Add sugar and lemon juice to taste
10. Serve hot or cold

title: hamburger corn pone pie
steps:
1. Brown meat and onion in melted shortening
2. Add seasonings and tomatoes
3. Cover and simmer 15 minutes
4. Add kidney beans
5. Pour into a greased casserole dish
6. Top with corn bread batter
7. Bake at 425 degrees for 20 minutes

title: shana s easy french bread appetizer
steps:
1. Mix up the ingredients , spread over sliced bread , and broil til golden brown
2. That's it !

title: vegan apple cookies
steps:
1. Pre heat oven to 350f
2. In large bowl stir together flour , oats , brown sugar , baking powder , baking soda , salt , cinnamon , and flaxseed meal
3. Add chopped dried apple and walnuts to flour mixture
4. In small bowl whisk together applesauce , vanilla , oil and 1 / 3 cup apple juice
5. Stir liquid into dry ingredients without over working over stiring will make them though adding a little more apple juice if need be
6. Drop a cookie scooper full or generous tablespoon full of dough onto silpat , these cookies won't spread much so you can get a few more per baking sheet
7. Bake in the preheated oven at 350 f for 12-15 minutes or until toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean
8. These cookies are more cake-like , so they will not get crisp and will only color slightly
9. Allow to cool on the baking sheet for 5 minutes and then remove to wire racks to cool completely

title: crabmeat cream cheese log
steps:
1. Stack cream cheese one on top of the other on a plate
2. Mix crabmeat with cocktail sauce , spread on 5 exposed sides of cream cheese
3. Serve with ritz crackers

title: low fat rice krispie meat loaf
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl , then place in a loaf pan
3. Spread ketchup over top
4. Bake for 60-75 minutes in a standard oven or 55 minutes in a convection oven

title: quick and easy 3 ingredient chocolate peanut butter logs
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 175 degrees celcius
2. Spray a cookie sheet lightly with cooking spray
3. Trim the edges of the bread slices
4. Roll out each bread slice individually into a 1 / 8 inch thick"sheet" using a rolling pin
5. Ensure that the bread does not crumble or tear
6. Spread 1 / 2 teaspoon of peanut butter horizontally over the lower half of a single pressed bread slice
7. Spread 1 / 2 teaspoon of chocolate syrup evenly over the remaining half of the bread slice
8. You should now have a bread slice with two horizontal sections
9. The one on top with chocolate syrup , and the one below with peanut butter
10. Roll the bread slice tightly from top to bottom , from the chocolate syrup-filled layer to the peanut butter layer
11. Using a sharp knife , cut this"log" into half , making two shorter"logs"
12. Repeat for the remaining 11 slices of bread
13. Arrange these"logs" , seam side down , on the prepared cookie sheet
14. Bake in preheated oven for 15 minutes
15. Serve warm , or cool completely on a wire rack and store in an airtight container

title: skewered ground meat
steps:
1. Wet hands in water and mix all ingredients together thoroughly
2. Cover and refrigerate 2 hours
3. Dampen hands and pat mixture around 6 skewers into long , flattened patties about 1 1 / 2 inches wide and 4-5 inches long
4. Grill or broil in oven until browned and cooked through , about 10-12 minutes
5. Serve with pita bread or rice
6. Suggestion: while meat mixture sets in the refrigerator marinate large chunks of tomatoes , onions , green peppers , or eggplant in a sauce made of equal parts of olive oil and lemon juice with a dash of salt and pepper
7. Thread vegetables on skewers and grill them alongside the meat

title: hot dates
steps:
1. Take scissors or a sharp knife and make a slit on one side of the date
2. Stuff a piece of pineapple chunk inside the date , wrap a half slice of bacon around date and pineapple and secure with a toothpick
3. Preheat the broiler and position oven rack 6" from heat source
4. Broil until bacon is crisp ,
5. Turn over and broil other side
6. Drain on paper towel
7. Serve warm
8. Instead of pineapple , you can also use gorgonzola cheese , or you can use dried apricots or fresh pear
9. These can be prepared a couple days ahead and refrigerated , then broil just before serving
10. I've made these several times for parties , and they're always the first to go - a big hit !

title: emeril s big em  little em cookies  for m m lovers
steps:
1. Make sure the oven rack is in the center position and preheat the oven to 350 degrees
2. Sift the flour , baking powder , baking soda , and salt into a medium mixing bowl
3. Set aside
4. Place the butter , granulated sugar , and light brown sugar in the bowl of an electric mixer and cream the ingredients on high speed
5. Add the vanilla and egg to the mixer and mix on medium speed
6. Stop the mixer and scrape down the sides of the bowl with a rubber spatula
7. Add the flour mixture and combine on low speed
8. It's important to do this on low or you'll get flour all over the kitchen !
9. Stop the mixer and , using a large spoon or rubber spatula , fold in both kinds of m&m's
10. With a tablespoon , form the dough into balls , using about 2 spoonfuls for each
11. Divide the balls of dough among three large baking sheets and press to slightly flatten , keeping the cookies about 2 inches apart
12. You should get 8 cookies on each sheet
13. Bake in batches in the oven until golden brown , about 20 minutes
14. Using oven mitts or pot holders , remove the cookies from the oven and transfer them with a plastic turner to wire racks to cool

title: emeril s caribbean cocktail
steps:
1. In a cocktail shaker , blend together all the ingredients , except the garnish
2. Pour into a tall glass filled with ice
3. Garnish with pineapple and serve

title: almost cheesecake  low fat sugar
steps:
1. Blend and pour into crust
2. Refrigerate until set
3. You can add fruity toppings or incorporate fruit into the recipe
4. You can also use chocolate pudding or any other flavor you want

title: claudia roden s hummus bi tahina  chickpea and sesame dip
steps:
1. Drain the chickpeas and simmer in fresh water for about an hour or until tender
2. Reserve the cooking water
3. Process the chickpeas in a blender with the lemon juice , tahina , garlic , olive oil , salt and enough of the cooking liquid to obtain a soft creamy consistency
4. Serve on a flat plate , garnished with a dribble of olive oil , a dusting of paprika and ground cumin and a little parsley
5. Serve with warm pita bread for dipping

title: nectarine upside down cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Melt 2 tablespoons butter over medium heat
3. Add brown sugar and cook , stirring constantly , 2 minutes
4. Transfer to 9" round cake pan and spread evenly
5. Arrange nectarine slices over top in concentric circles in pan
6. If using large nectarines , you will only need 2 nectarines and will make two overlapping circles
7. If using smaller nectarines , you may need 3 nectarines and have more circles
8. Beat butter until creamy
9. Add sugar and continue beating until light and fluffy
10. Add egg substitute or eggs and beat until blended
11. If using egg substitute , the mixture may look slightly curdled
12. Stir in milk and vanilla , blending well
13. Stir together dry ingredients
14. Add to batter and mix on low speed just until blended
15. Batter is not very thick
16. Spread batter evenly over nectarines
17. Bake cake until wooden pick tests clean , about 30-35 minutes
18. Let cool on wire rack 10 minutes , then invert onto serving platter
19. Cut into wedges to serve
20. This is great , warm , for brunch
21. For dessert , i sometimes add slightly sweetened whipped cream

title: snickers bar delight
steps:
1. Combine 1 cup chocolate chips , 1 / 4 cu butterscotch chips and 1 / 4 cup peanut butter in a small saucepan
2. Cook over low heat until melted and smooth , stirring constantly
3. Spread onto the bottom of a greased 9 x 13 baking pan
4. Chill until set
5. Melt the butter in a saucepan over medium high heat
6. Add the sugar and evaporated milk
7. Bring to a boil
8. Boil for 5 minutes , stirring constantly
9. Remove from heat
10. Add the marshmallow creme , 1 / 4 cup peanut butter and vanilla and mix well
11. Stir in the peanuts and spread over the chocolate mixture
12. Chill until set
13. Combine the caramels and cream in a saucepan
14. Cook over low heat until the caramels melt and the mixture is smooth , stirring constantly
15. Spread over the peanut layer
16. Chill until set
17. Combine 1 cup chocolate chips , 1 / 4 cup butterscotch chips and 1 / 4 cup peanut butter in a saucepan
18. Cook over low heat until melted and smooth , stirring constantly
19. Pour over the caramel layer
20. Chill for at least 1 hour
21. Cut into 1 inch squares
22. Store , covered , in the refrigerator
23. Bet you can't eat just one !

title: hot cheese hors d oeuvres
steps:
1. Trim crust and cut bread into 1-inch cubes
2. Melt cheeses and butter in top of double boiler
3. Remove from heat , cool slightly , and add the egg whites
4. With a fork , dip each bread cube in cheese mixture until well coated
5. Place on baking sheet , chill overnight or freeze
6. Bake at 350 degrees fahrenheit for 12-15 minutes until light brown and puffed
7. Serve hot

title: al roker s steaks as big as your head
steps:
1. Up to one day ahead: soften butter a bit but not quite to room temperature
2. Mix in the chopped rosemary , orange zest and pepper
3. Shape into a log on a sheet of waxed paper
4. Seal the ends and refrigerate
5. Place steaks in a large container with the first 4 ingredients
6. Turn to coat
7. Cover and marinate in the refrigerate for at least 2 hours , turning occasionally
8. Prepare grill to high heat
9. Do not wipe the garlic pices off the steaks
10. Grill steaks to desired doneness , adding some of the garlic and rosemary from the marinade as you grill
11. Allow steaks to rest , covered 5 minutes before serving
12. Slice compound butter into approximately 1 tablespoon sized disks
13. Serve steak topped with a disk of the butter
14. Call the cardiologist

title: chinese mystery casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 f degrees
2. Brown ground beef and onion in oil
3. Combine all ingredients in a huge bowl , and transfer to a 9x13 pan
4. Bake covered for 30 minutes
5. Bake uncovered for 30 minutes
6. Sprinkle the chow mein noodles on top of casserole , and bake for 15 minutes more

title: peppered chicken breast
steps:
1. Coat both sides of chicken with pepper
2. Heat oil in skillet
3. Cook chicken in oil about 20 minutes , turning once
4. Cook until juice is no longer pink when centers are cut
5. Mix honey and butter
6. Top hot chicken with honey / butter mixture

title: hunter s sauce  sauce chasseur
steps:
1. Melt butter in a saucepan and add mushrooms , shallots , salt and pepper to taste , and cook about 10 minutes
2. Add the wine and simmer briefly over high heat
3. Add the tomatoes and beef broth , and tarragon
4. Cook about 5 minutes , stirring occasionally
5. Blend the cornstarch with the water
6. Stir into sauce and cook until slightly thickened

title: peaches   cream smoothie
steps:
1. Puree peach slices , yogurt and orange juice together in blender
2. Enjoy !

title: chocolate chip treasure cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. In a small bowl mix graham cracker crumbs , flour and baking powder
3. Set aside
4. In a large bowl mix condensed milk , and margarine until smooth
5. Add graham cracker mixture and mix well
6. Stir in coconut , nuts and chocolate morsels
7. Drop by rounded tablespoons onto ungreased cookie sheets
8. Bake for 9-10 minutes or until lightly browned
9. Store loosely covered at room temperature

title: peanut butter brownie trifle
steps:
1. Line a 13"x9"x2" pan with a large sheet of aluminum foil , allowing foil to extend 2" out of both ends of dish
2. Prepare brownie mix according to package directions , using packets included in package
3. Bake according to package directions in prepared pan
4. Cool completely
5. Lift foil out of pan
6. Invert brownies onto cutting board
7. Remove foil
8. Cut brownies into 3 / 4" pieces , using a sharp knife
9. Combine vanilla pudding mix and milk in a large mixing bowl
10. Beat at low speed of an electric mixer 2 minutes or until thickened
11. Add peanut butter and vanilla
12. Beat until smooth
13. Gently fold in half of whipped cream
14. Set remaining whipped cream aside
15. Place half of brownies in bottom of a 3-quart trifle bowl
16. Top with 1 1 / 4 cups chopped peanut butter cup candies and half of pudding
17. Repeat layers with remaining half of brownies , 1 1 / 4 cups peanut butter cup candies , and pudding
18. Pipe or spoon reserved whipped cream over trifle
19. Garnish if desired

title: peanut butter oatmeal breakfast cookies
steps:
1. Mix dry ingredients through oatmeal , stirring with a wire whisk to combine well
2. In a separate bowl , beat egg , brown sugar , vanilla and peanut butter and oil until combined
3. Combine dry and wet ingredients mixing well
4. Dough will be stiff
5. Place on lightly greased baking sheets , flatten slightly and bake for 8-10 minutes at 350 degrees
6. Enjoy !

title: dad s casserole
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f
2. Spray 2-3 quart casserole with non-stick cooking spray
3. Cook noodles as directed on package
4. Brown beef with garlic until cooked through
5. Drain
6. Add salt , sugar and tomato sauce and simmer for 5 minutes
7. Combine sour cream , cream cheese and onion
8. Layer 1 / 2 of the noodles then 1 / 2 of the meat mixture in casserole dish
9. Spread with sour cream mixture
10. Top with remaining noodles and the tomato sauce
11. Bake for 30 minutes
12. Sprinkle grated cheese on top and bake for another 5 minutes
13. Enjoy !

title: brandied cranberry apricot bars
steps:
1. In a 4 cup glass measuring bowl combine raisins , cranberries , apricots , and brandy or water
2. Cover with plastic wrap
3. Turn back a corner to vent
4. Cook on high for 2 minutes
5. Let stand for 20 minutes
6. Drain
7. For crust , in a medium mixing bowl stir together 1 cup flour and 1 / 3 cup brown sugar
8. Cut in margarine or butter till mixture resembles coarse crumbs
9. Press into an ungreased 8x8x2-inch baking pan
10. Bake in a 350 oven about 20 minutes
11. Or till golden
12. In a medium bowl beat eggs with a mixer on low speed for 4 minutes
13. Stir in the 1 cup brown sugar , the 1 / 2 cup flour , and vanilla
14. Add drained fruit and nuts
15. Stir to mix
16. Pour mixture over crust
17. Spread evenly
18. Bake about 40 minutes
19. Or till a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean , covering with foil the last 10 minutes
20. To prevent over-browning
21. Cool
22. Sprinkle with powdered sugar
23. To serve , cut into squares
24. Makes 16 bars

title: broccoli and tofu with spicy peanut sauce
steps:
1. For the sauce: place peanut butter and water in a sauce pan , heat on low heat and whisk until mixture is uniform
2. Add vinegar , honey , soy sauce and red chili flakes
3. Set aside
4. In a wok , heat half the oil , half the ginger , and half the garlic
5. When hot , add tofu and stir fry for a few minutes
6. Add tofu to sauce and set aside
7. To wok add the rest of the oil , ginger , garlic , and onion
8. When hot add the broccoli and stir fry a few minutes
9. Add the soy sauce and stir fry until broccoli is just tender and bright green
10. Add sauce to broccoli and stir until everything is coated with sauce
11. Serve immediately over steamed rice
12. Top with lightly toasted chopped nuts and scallions

title: breakfast casserole  ala villani style
steps:
1. Prepare this casserole dish the night before
2. In a 9 inch x 13 inch oven-proof casserole dish , place 8 slices of bread to cover bottom of dish
3. Place 8 slices of italian sausage or more if required to cover the bread
4. Now place 8 slices of cheese over the sausage
5. Cover with another layer of 8 slices of bread
6. Then layer over with more italian sausage to cover the bread
7. Layer the top with slices of cheese
8. In a mixing bowl , beat eggs , add salt , pepper , mustard , onion , green and red peppers , worcestershire sauce , tabasco sauce and milk
9. Mix well to blend
10. Pour mixture over the prepared casserole
11. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight
12. Next morning , preheat oven to 350f
13. Remove casserole from refrigerator , remove the plastic wrap and discard
14. Melt butter and spoon over the top of the casserole
15. Cover the top with crushed cereal crumbs
16. Bake uncovered in preheated 350 f oven for 60 minutes
17. Remove from oven and let rest for 10 minutes before cutting and serving
18. You may also use back bacon or sliced ham instead of italian sausage

title: hansen hash
steps:
1. Brown ground beef and onion in frying pan
2. Drain and set aside
3. In same pan , add oil and brown the potatoes until done
4. Return the ground beef and onion mixture to the pan with potatoes
5. Add mushrooms and corn to the beef and potatoes
6. Let heat thoroughly
7. Add cheese , salt and pepper
8. Mix until cheese melts
9. Serve to plates and top with ketchup
10. Yum !

title: bread machine buttermilk bread
steps:
1. Put all ingredients in bread machine according to manufacturer instructions for your brand of bread machine
2. I warm the milk in the microwave for 30 sec
3. Then stir the beaten egg into the buttermilk
4. This helps with rising
5. Using butter makes a nice buttery crust
6. Can be stirred up in the bread machine and baked in a conventional oven at 350 degrees for 35 minutes
7. For cinnamon bread add 1 1 / 2 to 2 teas
8. Cinnamon
9. This makes really good french toast

title: moroccan style spicy chicken   rice   25 minutes to make
steps:
1. Coat chicken with the ras el hanout
2. Fry the onion in butter until soft
3. Add the chicken , then cook for a few mins more
4. Stir in the rice and apricots , then add the stock cube with 700ml boiling water and the chickpeas
5. Cover the pan and simmer for 15 mins or until the rice is tender and has absorbed most of the liquid
6. Remove from heat , add parsley & mix
7. Serve each portion with a sprinkle of pistachios

title: wok tossed lime and chilli chicken
steps:
1. Mince ginger , lemongrass , chillies and garlic with a touch of salt in a processor to make a paste
2. Stir fry the paste in half the oil in a wok over a very high heat for about a minute or so
3. Briefly pulse the chicken breasts until coarse minced but not mushy
4. Take off the heat and toss through all the remaining ingredients and serve with crunchy leaves , and extra lemon or lime wedges to squeeze over
5. Keep shaking the pan so that it doesn't burn
6. Cool and whizz to a fine powder in a coffee grinder or spice mill

title: small batch mandarin orange  or clementine  marmalade
steps:
1. Remove peel from all fruit , being careful to remove only the colored part from the lemon , and slice the peel thinly , using scissors or a sharp knife
2. Place slivers in a small non-reactive pan with the water , bring to a boil
3. Reduce heat , cover , and simmer 20 minutes
4. Remove and discard white pithy rind and seeds from the lemon
5. Chop orange and lemon pulp finely in a food processor or with a sharp knife
6. Add to the saucepan , return to a boil , reduce heat , cover , and simmer 20 minutes
7. Add sugar to mixture , return to boil , and boil rapidly , uncovered , until mixture forms a gel , about 10 minutes , stirring frequently
8. Remove from heat
9. Ladle into hot jars and process 10 minutes in a boiling water bath

title: the first chili we ever made
steps:
1. In a dutch oven , brown beef in hot oil- remove
2. Saute onion , peppers , and garlic in remaining oil
3. Add beef and stir in remaining ingredients- heat to boiling , then simmer , partially covered until meat is tender , about 1 1 / 2 hours
4. Skim surface grease or chill several hours to remove grease
5. Reheat until warm and bubbling

title: pesto tortellini salad with grape tomatoes
steps:
1. Prepare pasta according to package direc
2. Refrigerate until cold and serve

title: rum with christmas spices
steps:
1. In a jar of about 2 cups , mix all ingredients
2. Close hermetically
3. Let macerate about 1 week at room temperature
4. Strain
5. Keep the orange and lemon zest to garnish glasses
6. Serve on ice

title: coca cola pepper steak
steps:
1. Trim all fat from the meat and cut into pencil-thin strips
2. In a deep skillet or dutch oven , heat oil , garlic , and salt
3. Add the meat and brown over high heat , about 10 minutes , stirring occasionally with a fork
4. Add the beef broth
5. Cover and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes , or until the meat is fork-tender
6. Stir in the green pepper strips , celery , onions , and 4 fluid ounces of coca-cola
7. Cover and simmer for 5 minutes- do not overcook , the vegetables should be crisp-tender !
8. Peel the tomatoes , cut into wedges , gently stir into meat
9. Blend cornstarch with 2 fluid ounces of coca-cola and the soy sauce
