10. Stir mixture into the meat and cook until sauce is thickens , about 1 minute , stirring lightly with a fork
11. Serve over hot rice

title: sour cream fudge
steps:
1. Mix sugar , corn syrup , butter , salt and sour cream together
2. Cook over medium heat until reaches the soft ball stage , 235 degrees
3. Cool to room temperature in the cooking pot
4. Once cooled , add walnuts and beat until thick and pour all at once onto buttered platter
5. Do not spread top , it will be glossy and uneven
6. Cut into 24 squares
7. Keep in covered container chilled

title: red snapper veracruz
steps:
1. Using your hands crush the tomatoes
2. Add olive oil to skillet , saute onions and garlic until softened
3. Add tomatoes and spices and simmer until thickened , about 10-15 minutes
4. Add olives , raisins , capers and simmer 10 minutes more
5. Preheat oven to 425
6. In a glass baking dish spoon sauce over bottom
7. Add snapper fillets and top with remaining sauce
8. Bake uncovered for 20 minutes
9. Remove , garnish with almonds

title: sausage  leek and apple casserole
steps:
1. Cut the bacon into slices and brown it in a pan for a few minutes with the sausages
2. You can use cooking spray if you like but the bacon usually makes enough fat of it's own to help the sausages along
3. While the meat is browning , cut the mushrooms in half , cube the apple , slice the leek and cut the carrot into batons
4. When the meat is done , put it to one side in the crock pot / casserole dish along with the mushrooms and apple
5. Add the remaining veg to the pan to soften a little
6. After a couple of minutes , sprinkle the flour over the veg and mix through
7. Add the cider to the pan - it will bubble up to begin with but don't worry about it
8. Turn up the heat and cook for a couple of minutes to burn the alcohol off
9. Transfer all the ingredients in the pan to the crock pot / casserole dish
10. Now this is where you have to use your judgement a bit ! i find 300ml water is usually about right to top up my crock pot , but you may find you need a bit more / less depending on the exact amount of ingredients you have used
11. So as not to waste any of the stock cube , i crumble it into the crock pot without dissolving it in water first and then add as much water as is needed to just cover all the ingredients
12. Crockpot: cook on low for 8-9hrs or medium for around 5hrs
13. Oven: i've never actually made this in the oven but have no doubt it would work just as well
14. I would imagine that , if you cover the casserole dish and cook it at around 150 degrees it should be done in a couple of hours

title: sausage cheese quesadillas  oamc
steps:
1. Fry sausage until browned and crumble into small pieces
2. Melted butter on a griddle or skillet
3. Place tortillas on top of melted butter on low heat
4. Place crumbled sausage by teaspoonfuls on one-half of tortillas
5. Sprinkle cheese on top of sausage
6. Fold tortilla in half
7. Press with fork to allow heat to melt cheese inside and cook approximately 3 minutes for on each side until light brown
8. Lift to a serving dish
9. Serve with sour cream and salsa while hot
10. For oamc: when cool , place in ziploc bags and place in freezer
11. Remove later and microwave
12. Enjoy !

title: the purple chefs best brownie recipe
steps:
1. Lightly grease a 13 x 9 inch baking pan
2. Melt chocolate and butter in a bowl in microwave on high 2 minutes or place glass bowl on top of saucepan filled with boiling water
3. When chocolate and butter have melted remove from microwave or saucepan and stir in sugar until well blended
4. Mix in eggs and vanilla
5. Stir in flour , spread in pan
6. Bake in preheated 350f oven for 30-35 minutes or until done
7. Do not overbake
8. Glaze brownies by melting chocolate , butter and water together , mixing until smooth
9. Enjoy -- these are great when you are depressed !

title: mexican dinner pronto
steps:
1. In skillet heat oil
2. Saute onion until tender
3. Transfer to ovenproof baking dish
4. Arrange half the tamales and gravy over onions
5. Add the two cans of chili
6. Sprinkle with oregano
7. Top with remaining tamales
8. Bake at 350 for 30 minutes , or until bubbling hot
9. Remove from oven
10. Sprinkle with cheese
11. Bake 15 minutes more or until cheese has melted

title: no fail easy challah egg bread bread machine
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in bread machine pan
2. For dough cycle -- use 1 1 / 2 tsp yeast
3. For quick dough cycle---
4. Use 2 tsp quick yeast
5. Run dough cycle and remove dough
6. On floured board shape dough into 3 long rolled pieces
7. Braid
8. Put braid on cookie sheet lined with parchment paper
9. Let rise at least 1 hour
10. Beat egg and use paintbrush to paint challah braid
11. Sprinkle poppy seeds
12. Bake in preheated oven at 375 degrees 20 minutes or more
13. Cool

title: coca cola
steps:
1. Combine sugar , corn syrup , powdered nodoz , and citric acid in a large pitcher or bowl
2. Add the boiling water , and stir until the sugar has dissolved and the solution is clear
3. Strain the syrup through a paper towel-lined strainer to remove the nodoz sediment
4. Add the lime juice , vanilla , lemon oil , orange oil , and cassia oil to the syrup and stir
5. Add the colors to the syrup then cover it and chill it for several hours until cold
6. To make the soda , add 1 / 4 cup of cold syrup to 1 cup of cold soda water
7. Stir gently , drop in some ice , and serve

title: mjadra
steps:
1. Fry onion in olive oil until golden brown
2. Add in lentils , rice , water and salt
3. Bring to boil
4. Turn down to low / med heat and cook for approx 20 minutes or until rice and lentils are tender

title: mikey s cottage cheese snack
steps:
1. In small serving dish add the cottage cheese topped with the applesauce
2. Garnish with ground cinnamon if desired
3. Eat

title: broccoli with toasted garlic crumbs
steps:
1. Put 1 inch of water in a 5-quart wide heavy pot , then put a steamer basket inside pot and bring water to a boil
2. Add broccoli and steam , covered until just tender , 8-10 minute
3. Meanwhile , cook garlic in oil in a 12-inch heavy skillet over moderately low heat , stirring occasionally
4. Cook until garlic is a pale golden color , about 5 minute
5. Stir in breadcrumbs , pepper , and salt , then increase heat to medium and cook , stirring occasionally until crumbs are golden - about 3 minute remove from heat and stir in zest
6. Transfer broccoli to crumb mixture in skillet and toss to coat

title: kraft bacon  tomato   cheese crescents
steps:
1. Prehet oven 375
2. Separate dough and spread with cream cheese
3. Top with remaining ingredients
4. Roll up from shortest end to longest end
5. Place point side down on baking sheet
6. Bake 12- 15 minutes

title: red velvet valentine hearts  mini cupcakes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Prepare mini cupcake tins or heart-shaped tins with paper liners or spritz with non-stick cooking spray
3. In a large bowl whisk together all dry ingredients
4. In another large bowl mix together buttermilk or soured milk with vinegar and 1 teaspoons of vanilla extract
5. With an electric mixer cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy
6. Add egg yolks , one at a time until well incorporated
7. Slowly add half of dry mixture , followed by half of buttermilk mixture to creamed sugar mixture
8. Beat until just combined
9. Repeat until all of flour and buttermilk mixtures have been incorporated
10. Add 1 / 2 oz
11. Of red food coloring , or more to your liking and mix well with mixer
12. Do not overbeat
13. In a small bowl , whisk or beat egg whites until stiff peaks form
14. Fold into cake batter
15. Fill each muffin tin 2 / 3 full with batter
16. Bake for 8-10 minutes until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean
17. Watch carefully ! you do not want these little cuties to burn !
18. For icing:
19. Combine powdered sugar , softened cream cheese , and 1 teaspoons vanilla extract and mix until creamy
20. Spread on cooled cupcakes and enjoy !

title: chicken and vegetables congee  chok
steps:
1. Cut the chicken thighs up into two inch lengths
2. Marinate the chicken with the oyster sauce , chinese wine / sherry , soy sauce , pepper , sugar , worcestershire sauce and sesame oil
3. Leave the chicken to marinate in the fridge for about 30 min or longer
4. Grab a large pot , pour the rice , water , ginger , garlic and dried scallops inches
5. Let this boil on a low heat for about 1 hour
6. Do check on the congee frequently and give it a stir , so that the rice doesn't stick and burn at the bottom of the pot
7. Pour in the carrots , and allow the congee to continue simmering
8. Take the chicken out of the fridge , and pour it into the congee
9. Add 2 cups boiling hot water into the pot , and stir the congee
10. Allow this to cook for about 15 minutes
11. Add the broccoli into the pot
12. Allow the congee to cook until you are happy with the thickness of the congee
13. Bring the congee to a boil , while continuously stirring it
14. Once it boils , turn the heat off , and drop the two eggs into the pot of congee
15. Leave it for about 30 seconds , and give it a good stir to break up the egg totally and it mixes very well into the congee
16. Ladle into bowls , and garnish
17. Enjoy a bowl of smooth yummy congee

title: japanese steak house salad dressing recipe
steps:
1. Combine all together and use a hand mixer until blended then chill
2. If you are looking for lower calorie you can substitte with light mayo and use splenda instead of sugar
3. If you want more just double the recipe

title: showbizz s 20 minute sweet potatoes
steps:
1. Arrange the sweet potato and apple slices in a steamer basket
2. Sprinkle with the cinnamon or pumpkin pie spice
3. Steam over boiling water for 18-20 minutes or until tender

title: creamy sex on the beach
steps:
1. Pour the vodka , malibu rum , peach schnapps , pineapple juice and grenadine into a cocktail shaker half-filled with ice cubes
2. Add the heavy cream , and shake vigorously until frothy
3. Pour into a small highball glass or equivalent , and serve

title: puddin  head gingerbread men
steps:
1. Cream butter , brown sugar and pudding mix
2. Add egg and beat well
3. Combine flour , baking soda , ginger and cinnamon
4. Stir into creamed mixture and chill
5. Roll part of chilled dough out on floured surface to 1 / 8-inch thickness
6. Cut with 4-inch gingerbread man cookie cutter
7. Place on ungreased cookie sheets and bake in 350 oven for 6-8 minutes
8. Remove from cookie sheet to rack and cool
9. Mix powdered sugar , lemonade concentrate and enough water to make of spreading consistency
10. Frost cookies or use pastry tube
11. Decorate with candies if desired

title: kickin  creamy chicken stew in a slow cooker
steps:
1. Place frozen chicken breasts or tenders in bottom of slow cooker
2. Add remaining ingredients except cream cheese
3. Cook on high for 4-5 hours
4. At this point i remove about 1 / 2 the liquid because i like my sauce thick , like a stew
5. You can leave all the liquid if you want a soup
6. Add cream cheese , cook on warm setting for 30 minutes , then stir
7. This can be served over rice or wrapped in flour tortillas
8. One healthy serving is 1 / 2 a breast or 2 large chicken tenders

title: ham and grilled onion sandwiches
steps:
1. Slice onion in a few thin layers , sautee over med-high heat until browned
2. Toast bread to desired darkness in convection oven or toaster
3. Spread one side of bread with mayonnaise
4. Layer spinach leaves on top of mayonnaise , followed by the ham , onion , cheese , and bread

title: sharon s chocolate caramel cake
steps:
1. Combine cake mix , water , oil and eggs and beat on low speed for 2 minutes
2. Pour 2 cups of batter in greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish and bake at 350 for 15 minutes
3. Melt caramels , butter and sweetened condensed milk in saucepan over medium heat
4. Pour caramel mixture on cake as soon as it comes out of the oven and add rest of batter
5. Cook another 35-40 minutes
6. Frost with a chocolate frosting and serve

title: argentinian steak sandwiches
steps:
1. To make chimichurri sauce , combine all ingredients from 1 / 2 cup olive oil through 1 / 4 tsp salt in a bowl
2. Set aside
3. Preheat a barbecue grill or grill pan over mediumhigh heat
4. Brush steaks with oil , then season with salt and pepper
5. Cook steaks for 3 minutes each side for medium-rare or until cooked to your liking
6. Cover loosely with foil and rest for 5 minutes
7. Cut a slit lengthwise along top of baguettes , cutting almost to base
8. Pull them open without splitting
9. Brush inside with mayonnaise , then fill with lettuce and avocado
10. Thinly slice steaks across the grain , then divide among sandwiches
11. Spoon sauce over the top of the sandwiches and serve

title: cream cheese ball surprise
steps:
1. Soften cream cheese
2. Mix softened cream cheese , orange juice concentrate , craisins in bowl
3. Form mixture into ball using your hands
4. Roll in chopped walnuts
5. Refrigerate until ready to serve

title: crispy chopped broccoli
steps:
1. Place frozen broccoli in a 2-qt casserole
2. Add 3 tablespoons water
3. Cover and microwave on high , 7 to 10 minutes , stirring every 3 minutes
4. Let stand , covered 2 to 3 minutes
5. Drain well
6. Stir in butter
7. Mix remaining ingredients together
8. Reserve 2 tablespoons
9. Fold mixture into broccoli
10. Microwave on high , 5 to 9 minutes , stirring every 3 minutes
11. Sprinkle reserved crumbs on top
12. Microwave 1 to 2 minutes longer

title: steak with three chile sauce
steps:
1. Sauce:
2. Heat a dry 10" skillet over medim heat for 2 minutes
3. Toast the ancho and pasilla chiles in the heated skillet for about 20 seconds on each side
4. They'll become fragrant , but do not allow them to scorch or they'll become bitter
5. Remove the stems , seeds and ribs from the toasted chiles , and soak them in hot water to cover for about 20 minutes to rehydrate
6. Drain them and put them in the blender with the chipotle chile
7. Heat 1 tbs of oil over medium heat in the same skillet you used for toasting the chiles
8. Add the onions
9. Cook until soft and golden brown , stirring often , for about 10 minutes
10. Add the garlic and cook , stirring , for an additional minute
11. Move the onions and garlic to the blender , along with the cilantro , brandy , and 1 / 4 cup water
12. Puree everything to a smooth paste , adding more water as needed , 1 tbs at a time
13. Transfer the chile puree into a small bowl
14. Heat the remaining 2 tbs of oil in a small saucepan over medium-high heat
15. Make sure you're wearing an apron or smock at this point
16. When the oil is shimmery and just beginning to smoke , quickly add the chile paste
17. Cook , stirring constantly to incorporate the oil , for about 2 to 4 minutes , or until the mixture becomes very thick
18. Turn down the heat a bit if necessary to prevent scorching
19. Reduce the heat to medium and add the broth gradually , stirring
20. Add the brown sugar and salt
21. Simmer for another 1 to 2 minutes , or until the mixture has the consistency of a medium-thick sauce
22. Add salt to taste
23. Steaks:
24. Place your oven rack 4" from the broiler element and heat broiler on high
25. Drizzle both sides of your steaks with lime juice and season with salt and pepper to taste
26. Heat an 11 or 12" skillet over medium-high heat
27. Add the olive oil
28. Sear the steaks , two at a time , for two minutes per side
29. Lower the heat as needed , and continue cooking steaks until they are done to your liking
30. Transfer the first two steaks to a rimmed baking sheet and repeat with remaining 2 steaks
31. Once all the steaks are cooked , turn the heat to medium and pour the chile sauce into the pan
32. Stir to incorporate any browned bits and drippings into the sauce
33. Sprinkle the steaks with the oaxaca cheese , spoon some sauce over them , then top with the cotija
34. Put the baking sheet under the broiler for about a minute , just to melt the cheese
35. Serve immediately

title: popcorn salad   2
steps:
1. Combine celery , radishes , onion , water chestnuts , bacon and chives in large bowl and mix well
2. Set aside
3. When ready to serve , add lettuce
4. Pop popcorn and add immediately to the vegetables along with cheese and mayonnaise
5. Toss until mayonnaise is evenly distributed

title: wild rice with cranberries and caramelized onions
steps:
1. Combine chicken broth and both rices in medium saucepan
2. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat
3. Reduce heat to low
4. Cover and simmer 45 minutes or until rice is tender and the liquid is absorbed
5. Meanwhile , melt butter in a medium skillet over medium-high heat
6. Add onions and brown sugar
7. Cook 6 minutes or until liquid is absorbed and onions are soft and translucent
8. Reduce heat to low and slowly cook onion , stirring often for 25 minutes or until they are caramel color
9. Stir in dried cranberries
10. Cover and cook over low heat for 5 minutes or until cranberries swell
11. Gently fold cranberry mixture and orange zest into cooked rice

title: reuben dip
steps:
1. Combine and heat all ingredients , except for milk , in a small saucepan over low heat until hot
2. Thin with milk if necessary

title: raspberry brownie dessert
steps:
1. Prepare and bake brownies according to pkg directions , using eggs , water and vegetable oil and using a greased 13x9x2" baking pan
2. Cool completely on wire rack
3. In a small bowl , combine 1 cup cream and pudding mix
4. Stir for 2 minutes or until very thick
5. In a small bowl beat remaining cream until stiff peaks form
6. Fold into pudding
7. Carefully spread pudding mixture over cooled brownies
8. Top with pie filling
9. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours before cutting

title: lemonade
steps:
1. In a 1-quart bowl combine sugar and 1 1 / 4 cups hot water
2. Micro and stir occasionally , until sugar is dissolved , 1 to 2 minutes
3. Meanwhile , zest 1 tablespoon lemon peel from 2 or 3 lemons
4. Add peel to warm sugar mixture
5. Let cool about 10 minutes
6. Cut all lemons in half and ream enough juice to make 1 3 / 4 cups
7. Add to sugar mixture
8. Into a pitcher add lots of ice cubes , lemon syrup , 1 cup ice cold water
9. Stir lemon slices into lemonade& pour into glasses with garnish of mint
10. Taste you may want to add more water

title: pumpkin mascarpone ravioli with sage butter sauce
steps:
1. Slice seeded pumpkin in half and roast until soft in preheated 375 degree oven
2. Also can instead dice and boil pumpkin for 10-15 minutes
3. I prefer the roasting of the pumpkin for a richer flavor
4. Make mound of flour on clean work surface then "hollow out" the center where you will add your eggs
5. Add eggs , oil and salt to flour "well" and mix flour into eggs gradually
6. Once flour and eggs are completely incorporated , knead dough 5-10 minutes until it stiffens
7. Add water if dough is too dry , flour is it is too wet
8. Once pumpkin has completely cooled , use food proccessor to puree
9. Add in nuts , nutmeg , mascarpone , salt and pepper , egg , and parmesan and pulse until well mixed
10. Roll out thin even sheet of pasta dough onto well floured surface
11. Drop filling by even spoonfuls onto one side of pasta dough
12. Remember to leave space between to close raviolis
13. Brush water in between filling to seal edges
14. Fold over other side of pasta sheet to form top layer
15. Cut raviolis along seals with pizza cutter or ravioli cutter
16. Drop into salted boiling water for 5-7 minutes
17. Drain and pour out onto serving platter
18. In saute pan melt butter using low heat
19. When butter begins to look golden brown add sage and nutmeg , then warm for only 15-20 seconds
20. Pour butter sauce over ravioli , and for some added crunch , crumble with amaretti cookies !

title: ww cheese souffle
steps:
1. In as small cup or bowl stir the flour into 3 tablespoons of the milk until smooth
2. Pour the remaining milk into a large saucepan
3. Whisk flour / milk mixture into milk in sausepan over low heat
4. Cook , stirring , for 5 minutes or until mixture thickens
5. Remove from heat
6. Stir in cheese , 1 / 4 teaspoon of the salt and the cayenne
7. Transfer to a large bowl and let cool
8. Preheat oven to 350-degrees f
9. Put the egg yolks in a bowl , then add the yolk mixture into the cheese mixture , whisking to combie
10. In a mixing bowl of an electric mixer , beat all 4 egg whites until foamy
11. Add remaining salt
12. Beat egg whites until stiff
13. Stir 1 / 4 of the egg whites into the cheese mixture
14. Fold in the remaining egg whites with a rubber spatula
15. Scrape mixture into a 3-quart ungreased souffle dish
16. Bake for 30-35 minutes or until puffed and cooked through
17. Serve immediately

title: chicken mexican soup   for canning
steps:
1. Boil chicken covered in water until done
2. When chicken has cooled you can shred it or cut into 1-inch cubes
3. Set aside
4. Prepare pressure canner
5. Heat jars and lids in simmering water until ready for use
6. In large pot add all ingredients except chicken
7. Bring to a boil , cover and simmer 3 minutes
8. Add chicken and boil lightly for 5 minutes
9. Ladle hot soup into hot jars leaving 1-inch headspace , remove air bubbles and wipe rim of jar
10. Center hot lid on jar
11. Apply band and adjust until finger
12. Place jars into pressure canner
13. Process quarts at 11 pounds pressure for 90 minutes or pints for 75 minutes
14. Remove jars and cool
15. Check lids for seal after 24 hours
16. Lids should not flex up and down when center is pressed
17. This recipe yields 7 quarts !

title: oriental cauliflower
steps:
1. Wash cauliflower and break into florets
2. Cook in a small amount of water , about 8-10 minutes
3. Drain , set aside in a serving bowl
4. Saute onion , celery and parsley in butter until tender
5. Remove from heat
6. Add cornstarch , stirring until blended
7. Dissolve bouillon cube in 1 cup hot water
8. Gradually add to onion / celery mixture , stirring constantly
9. Add soy sauce and black pepper
10. Cook over medium heat , stirring constantly until smooth and thickened
11. Pour over cauliflower

title: smoky mac  n cheese
steps:
1. Cook and drain macaroni as directed on box
2. Return to saucepan
3. Keep warm
4. Meanwhile , heat oven to 375
5. Spray 13x9" glass baking dish with cooking spray
6. In a 2-quart saucepan , heat cream , mustard , salt and red pepper to boiling
7. Reduce heat
8. Stir in cheddar cheese with wire whisk until smooth
9. Pour sauce over macaroni
10. Stir in tomatoes and onions
11. Pour into baking dish
12. In small bowl stir together parmesan cheese and bread crumbs
13. Stir in oil
14. Sprinkle over top of macaroni mixture
15. Bake 15 to 20 min or until edges are bubbly and top is golden brown
16. Be sure to use whipping cream when making sauce as half-and-half and milk are more likely to curdle when combined with the tomatoes

title: using the christmas ham bone  makes you feel good potato soup
steps:
1. Place first 6 ingredients in a dutch oven , bring to a boil over medium heat , and simmer for 30 minutes or until meat easily comes off the bone with a fork
2. Shred ham from the bone , discard any fat , return meat to the pot
3. Add diced potatoes , bring to a boil , reduce heat and simmer until potatoes are tender
4. While potatoes are cooking , in a medium saucepan , melt butter over medium heat being careful not to brown
5. Add flour , stirring constantly until incorporated well
6. Bring heat to medium / high and gradually stir in the half n half until creamy , thick and bubbly , stirring constantly , being careful not to scorch
7. Once it thickly coats the spoon , remove from heat
8. When the potatoes are tender , stir the sauce mixture into the potato pot over medium heat , stirring constantly
9. Let simmer until soup reaches the desired consistency
10. You can add milk to adjust
11. There has been no salt added to this point
12. You may add salt , pepper , garlic , herbs or seasonings to your taste

title: walnut chicken stir fry
steps:
1. In medium bowl , combine soy sauce , sherry , cornstarch , jelly
2. Stir in chicken and set aside
3. In a wok or large frying pan , heat 1 tblsp oil
4. Add walnuts and cook until golden , about 5 minutes , stirring frequently
5. Remove pan from heat , sprinkle nuts with sugar
6. Spoon walnuts onto paper towels to drain
7. Add 1 / 3 cup oil to hot pan
8. Heat
9. Add green peppers and salt
10. Cook , stirring quickly until tender-crisp , about 3 minutes
11. Spoon peppers into a bowl
12. Set aside
13. Add onions to pan
14. Cook until lightly browned but not burned
15. Add onions to bowl with peppers
16. Now cook the chicken mixture , stirring quickly and frequently , until tender , about 5 minutes
17. Return peppers and onions to pan , stir and heat through
18. Spoon mixture into a warm bowl
19. Sprinkle walnuts over
20. Serve with rice

title: lemon cooler
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together in a pitcher and stir until sugar is dissolved
2. This drink tastes best cold so chill until serving
3. Serve over ice with a slice of lemon for the garnish
4. Make sure you do not leave out the citric acid
5. This gives this drink some tartness
6. You can usually find it at health food stores

title: chocolate toffee crunch candy
steps:
1. Sprinkle walnuts on bottom of a greased 9x9 inch pan
2. Combine sugar and butter in a saucepan
3. Bring to a boil and boil for 7 minutes , stirring constantly
4. Spread over nuts
5. Sprinkle chips on top of hot sugar mix and nuts
6. Spread melted chips with a knife to cover the top
7. Refrigerate to set
8. Cut into pieces
9. It will crack apart as well

title: mardi gras pizza
steps:
1. Top crust in the following order
2. Salsa
3. 1 / 2 of the cheddar and mozzarella
4. Chicken
5. Sausage
6. Pinapple
7. Green pepper
8. Remaining cheese
9. Bake in oven 450f 12-15 mins or until bubbly and brown

title: broccolini with pepper dressing
steps:
1. Combine first 9 ingredients in a bowl , toss well
2. Steam broccolini , covered for 5 minutes or until crisp tender
3. Drain
4. Spoon pepper dressing over broccolini

title: hodgepodge
steps:
1. Please the potatoes , and carrots in the steamer
2. Cook for about 5 minutes
3. Add the new peas and beans steam for another 5 minutes
4. Add the broccoli and snow peas steam until done but not overcooked
5. For sauce: cook the bacon until crisp
6. Remove bacon from the fat and reserve
7. Cook the green onion and mushrooms in the bacon fat until tender
8. Remove any excess bacon fat
9. Salt and pepper as desired
10. Add the bacon , cream and cheddar and stir at a low heat until the cheddar is melted
11. Pour sauce over vegetable mixture and sprinkle chives and pepper on top

title: glazed sirloin with leeks
steps:
1. Sprinkle steaks with salt and pepper
2. Set aside
3. Remove and discard roots , tough outer leaves , and tops from leeks , leaving 2 inches of dark leaves
4. Set aside
5. Combine peach jelly and next four ingredients in a glass measure
6. Microwave on high for 1 minute
7. Set aside half of mixture
8. Coat grill rack with cooking spray
9. Place on grill over medium coals
10. Place steaks and leeks on rack
11. Grill , covered 5 minutes on each side or until steaks are desired degree of doneness , basting both often with half of peach mixture
12. Serve with reserved peach mixture
13. If desired , garnish with cilantro and lime and peach slices

title: bacon wrapped grilled chicken
steps:
1. In a ziplock bag , combine the teriyaki sauce , vermouth and garlic
2. Add chicken and coat with teriyaki mixture
3. Refrigerate at least 3 hours
4. Prepare bbq for medium high heat
5. Brush bbq rack with vegetable oil
6. Remove chicken from marinade and wrap each breast with 2 strips of bacon , covering completely and securing with toothpicks
7. Grill chicken until it is firm to the touch , about 15 minutes , turning occasionally
8. Serve

title: sparkling sangria
steps:
1. Combine liqueurs and fruit in the bottom of a medium pitcher and lightly muddle
2. Fill pitcher with sparkling wine
3. Place a single grape in the bottom of each glass
4. The yeast on the grape skin will help retain some fizz in your drink
5. Spoon a bit of muddled berry from the pitcher into each champagne glass then pour in the liquid
6. Serve immediately
7. Cheers !

title: turnip apple carrot salad with eggs
steps:
1. Dice one half of the carrot and place in a pot together with diced turnip
2. Bring to a boil , add eggs and simmer for 15 minutes or until veggies are tender but still crisp
3. Meanwhile slice the other half of the carrot into long strips using a vegetable peeler
4. Place in a big bowl and add garlic , onion , scallion and apple
5. Combine yoghurt and spices in a separate bowl and season to taste
6. When ready lift out the eggs using a slotted spoon
7. Rinse them with cold water , peel and dice
8. Drain veggies
9. Add everything to the big bowl and stir to coat
10. Eat right away while still warm or let cool and serve later

title: lasagna from the kitchen of bernie knight
steps:
1. Brown ground beef , onions and garlic
2. Dont drain
3. Add tomatoes , tomato paste , salt , basil , oregano , & sugar
4. Simmer covered for 1 hour
5. Add browned sausage and butter last 15 minutes of simmer
6. Cook lasagna noodles per package directions
7. Drain& rinse with cold water to stop cooking
8. Set noodles aside to cool
9. Blend of mozzarella , parmesan and parsley with cottage cheese
10. Build lasagna
11. Place cup of sauce into bottom of 9x 13 baking dish
12. Place layer of 3 lasagna noodles on sauce
13. Spread of cheese mixture and meat sauce on the layer of noodles
14. Repeat with one more layer
15. Reserve 2 / 3 cup of the meat sauce for the top
16. Sprinkle remaining mozzarella on top
17. Spray a piece of aluminum foil with some pam and cover the dish
18. Bake at 350 for 30 minutes
19. Remove foil and bake another 15 minutes until lightly brown
20. Remove from oven and allow to set for at least 20 minutes before cutting

title: indian spiced marinated chicken  crock pot
steps:
1. Place the chicken in large zip-loc style plastic bag
2. Dump the next 9 ingredients in a blender and give a whirl for about 30 seconds
3. Add this marinade to the chicken in the bag and seal
4. Knead bag to mix meat in the marinade and ensure that the meat is covered
5. Marinate in the refrigerator for 18-24 hours
6. Place the chicken in the crock pot with the whole peppercorns and bay leaves
7. Cook on high for 6 hours

title: strawberry blender breakfast
steps:
1. In blender , combine strawberries , milk , yogurt , breakfast drink mix and honey
2. Put cover on blender , and blend until almost smooth , stopping the blender and stirring as necessary
3. Pour into 3 or 4 8oz
4. Glasses
5. Serve immediately

title: country caramel apple cake
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f spray 13x9-inch pan with nonstick cooking spray
2. In large bowl , combine oil and eggs
3. Beat well
4. Add quick bread mix , apple pie filling , cinnamon and nutmeg
5. Stir 50 to 75 strokes with spoon until mix is moistened
6. Stir in nuts from foil packet and 1 / 2 cup chopped walnuts
7. Spoon into sprayed pan
8. Spread evenly
9. Bake at 350f for 43 to 50 minutes or until cake is deep golden brown and toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
10. Cool 30 minutes
11. Meanwhile , in medium saucepan , combine sugar , brown sugar , butter and whipping cream
12. Mix well
13. Bring to a boil , stirring occasionally
14. Remove from heat
15. Stir in vanilla
16. To serve , cut warm cake into squares
17. Place on individual dessert plates
18. Top each serving with warm sauce and ice cream

title: white chocolate cake doughnuts
steps:
1. Preheat the fryer
2. In a mixing bowl , sift the flour , baking powder and salt together
3. In another mixing bowl , whisk the eggs and sugar together
4. Add the melted chocolate and butter
5. Stir in the milk and vanilla
6. Slowly add the sifted flour into the egg mixture , incorporate into a soft dough
7. Cover the dough and chill for 2 hours
8. Turn the dough out onto a floured surface
9. Roll the dough out to 1 / 2-inch thick
10. Cut the doughnuts out , using a 2 1 / 2-inch doughnut cutter
11. Fry a couple of doughnuts at a time for 1 minute on each side
12. Remove the doughnuts from the fryer and drain on a paper-lined plate
13. Place the doughnuts on a wire rack
14. Drizzle the warm doughnuts with the chocolate glaze and sprinkle with the macadamia nuts
15. Place the doughnuts on a platter

title: bacon brittle
steps:
1. Grease or butter a large nonstick baking sheet
2. In a medium heavy saucepan , combine the sugar , corn syrup and water over medium heat
3. Stir until the sugar dissolves and the syrup comes to a boil
4. Attach a candy thermometer to the pan , increase the heat to high , and cook , without stirring , until the mixture reaches 290 degrees
5. Immediately remove from the heat
6. Stir in the butter , vanilla , baking soda , pecans and bacon bits
7. Watch out , as the mixture will foam
8. When the foam subsides , pour the hot mixture onto the prepared baking sheet as thinly as possible
9. Do not use a spatula
10. Cool at least 10 minutes before breaking into pieces
11. Store in a covered container

title: brussels sprouts  1  roasted with walnuts
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Bring a medium pot of water to a boil
3. Wash sprouts , trim the bottoms , and remove outer leaves
4. Cut an x in the stem to promote even cooking
5. Add brussels sprouts to the pot and cook for 5 minutes
6. Drain well
7. Return to pot
8. Stir in oil , vinegar , and pepper
9. Spray a shallow roasting pan with olive oil spray
10. Spread sprouts in pan
11. Bake for 10 minutes
12. Stir
13. Bake for another 10 minutes
14. Remove from oven and add walnuts
15. Bake for an additional 5 minutes

title: honey mustard roasted chicken
steps:
1. Toss potatoes and carrols with oil , salt and pepper in a shallow baking dish
2. Place peeled garlic cloves among the veggies
3. Sprinkle rosemary over veggies
4. Place chicken on top of veggies
5. Bake uncovered in oven at 425 degrees for 30 minutes
6. While chicken & veggies are baking , mix mustard and honey together
7. Remove pan from oven
8. Place chicken on seperate plate
9. Spread honey-mustard all over the chicken
10. Stir veggies
11. Return chicken to veggies
12. Bake additional 10-20 minutes , until chicken is cooked and veggies are tender

title: chicken spinach pasta
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , melt butter and add the 4 tablespoons of olive oil
2. Add finely chopped onion and garlic and saute until onion is almost translucent
3. Add chicken and cook until chicken is done
4. Remove from pan
5. Add pasta liquid and spinach , continuing to add as it wilts and makes space for more
6. Add chicken mixture back to the pan
7. Mix it with the spinach , and add 1 / 2 of the olive oil
8. Add salt and pepper to taste
9. Add pasta , toss and mix in the rest of the olive oil
10. Tada ! it's ready to eat !

title: bacon   cheddar chipotle burgers
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients for meat together in a medium sized bowl
2. Allow to sit while preparing other items
3. Mix all ingredients for dressing
4. Place into refrigerator until ready to use
5. Slice tomatoes , onions & mushrooms
6. Melt butter under medium heat , add olive oil & syrah , saute mushrooms until cooked & slightly browned
7. Set aside
8. Cook bacon
9. I prefer to fry it but use whatever method you prefer
10. Set aside
11. Toast sour dough bread
12. Form meat into two large patties the same shape as your bread
13. Place patties on pre-heated grill & grill until moderately charred on the outside and medium or medium rare on the inside
14. When patties are almost done place cheese on patties
15. Cook until melted
16. Spread dressing on bread , to the thickness you prefer
17. Place patty on bread along with all toppings (mushrooms , bacon , tomatoes , & onions
18. Enjoy !

title: scalloped tomatoes au gratin
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degree
2. Cut 3 slices of toast into cubes
3. Mix tomatoes , chopped onion , sugar , salt and pepper together
4. Grease a casserole dish
5. Put in layers starting with cubed toast , then a layer of the tomato mixture , the toast , and then the tomato mixture
6. Top with the 1 slice of toast
7. Pour melted butter over the slice of toast
8. Sprinkle with the cheese
9. Bake for 20 minutes

title: tuna everything bagel
steps:
1. Begin with the tuna salad
2. Combine ingredients in a large mixing bowl and stir to combine
3. Taste and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper
4. Take cut bagels and toast under a hot broiler until golden brown
5. While still hot , smear the cut side of each bagel with the cream cheese
6. Layer each half with red onion , tomato , cucumber and lettuce
7. Top with a scoop of the tuna salad and serve

title: fauxscargot
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat
2. Add the garlic and shallots and cook until fragrant , about 30 seconds
3. Add the mushrooms , oregano , basil , wine , lemon juice , parsley , salt and pepper to taste and simmer until the mushrooms are tender and the liquid is reduced slightly , about 4-5 minutes
4. Meanwhile , cook the pasta in a large pot of boiling salted water until al dente , 2-4 minutes
5. Drain well and toss with a little olive oil
6. To serve , coil 4 to 6 hot pasta strands each in the six hollows of four escargot dishes , or make 6 coils each on small plates
7. Place a mushroom in the center of each pasta nest and drizzle the pan sauce over them
8. Serve hot

title: cajun spiced bbq chicken
steps:
1. Combine all the ingredients in a bowl and whisk until well blended
2. Reserve 1 / 4 cup of the marinade in a cup for basting
3. Add the chicken to the marinade
4. Cover and refrigerate for at least 2 1 / 2 hours
5. Preheat the grill for medium / high heat
6. Grill on a lightly oiled rack for 25 to 30 minutes , flipping and basting every 10 minutes

title: chocolate cake and frosting with raspberry filling
steps:
1. Cake
2. Heat oven to 350f
3. Grease and flour pans
4. Combine dry ingredients
5. Mix in all wet ingredients except for the boiling water beat at medium speed for about 2 minutes
6. Stir in boiling water the batter will be very thin
7. This is not a mistake
8. Bake in prepared pans for 30 35 minutes or until toothpick stuck in middle comes out clean
9. Cool on rack 10 minutes
10. Remove from pan and cool completely on rack
11. Frosting
12. Combine melted butter with cocoa
13. Add sugar and milk alternately , beating on medium speed until desired consistency is reached
14. Stir in vanilla
15. Filling
16. Stir the vanilla into the preserves until its smooth
17. Assembly
18. Spread raspberry jam between cake layers
19. Frost completely cooled cake
20. Mmm-mmmm so good !

title: citrus and herb roast turkey breast
steps:
1. Sprinkle turkey breast evenly with salt and pepper
2. Stir together butter , rosemary , and sage
3. Loosen skin from turkey without detaching it
4. Spread butter mixture under skin
5. Arrange one-fourth of orange and lemon slices over butter mixture
6. Gently pull skin over fruit
7. Coat with cooking spray
8. Place turkey in an aluminum foil-lined baking pan coated with cooking spray
9. Place onion and remaining orange and lemon slices in pan
10. Drizzle with wine
11. Bake at 325 for 2 hours and 15 minutes or until a meat thermometer inserted in thickest portion registers 170 , basting every 30 minutes
12. Cover loosely with aluminum foil coated with cooking spray to prevent excessive browning after 1 hour and 30 minutes , if necessary

title: korean vege cakes
steps:
1. Peel potatoes
2. Shred the potatoes , zucchinni and carrot
3. Place in bowl
4. Slice scallion into thin ringlets , add to bowl
5. Add salt and pepper to taste
6. Add approximately 2 tbsp flour and approximately 1 tsp olive oil to vegetable mixture and mix well
7. Heat remaining oil over medium high heat in skillet
8. Form vegetable mixture into small / medium sized balls
9. Press onto skillet using the back of a spatula
10. Cook until both sides are golden brown , turning only once
11. Drain on paper napkins and serve with favorite dipping sauce

title: chicken in mustard sauce
steps:
1. Brown the chicken in the oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat for 4 minutes or until done , turning occasionally
2. Remove the chicken from the skillet , reserving the drippings in skillet
3. Set the chicken aside
4. Keep warm
5. Add the wine to the drippings
6. Cook over high heat , deglazing pan by scraping the particles that cling to the bottom
7. Reduce heat to medium
8. Stir in the whipping cream , dijon mustard , lemon juice , salt , pepper , tarragon and a dash or ground red pepper
9. Cook , uncovered , until the mixture is thick enough to cat a spoon , stirring occasionally
10. Add the reserved chicken
11. Bring to a boil
12. Cover , and reduce the heat
13. Simmer for 5 minutes
14. Serve

title: renette apple dessert
steps:
1. Peel and dice the apples
2. Cook diced apples in a pan over low heat for ten minutes with the sugar , lemon peel , vanilla and white wine
3. Then , add the jam and carefully remove the lemon peel
4. Whisk until creamy
5. Cut 4 slices of soft white bread on the diagonal to make 8 triangles
6. Use a butter knife to butter one side of the bread
7. Line the bottom of a cake pan
8. Then do the same for the sides
9. Fill the cake pan with the applesauce and cover with the remaining bread , buttered side up
10. Bake in a 350 f oven for about 30 minutes
11. Remove from the oven and serve

title: mexican style skillet
steps:
1. Combine sausage , onion , and green pepper in a heavy skillet: cook until sausage is browned , stirring to crumble
2. Drain well
3. Stir in next 6 ingredients
4. Cover , reduce heat , and simmer 20-25 mins , stirring occasionally
5. Stir in sour cream
6. Cook until thoroughly heated
7. Sprinkle with cheese

title: texas fried onion wedges
steps:
1. Peel onions and cut each one into 12 wedges
2. Leave wedges attached at its root
3. Soak onion in cold water for 1-2 hours until each wedge fans out and seperates its layers
4. Remove onion wedges and place on paper towels to drain
5. Combine flour , cornmeal and seasonings in a bowl
6. In another bowl , pour buttermilk
7. Heat oil to 375
8. Dip onion wedge in buttermilk and then flour mix
9. Shake off excess
10. Carefully drop in oil
11. Fry about 4-5 wedges at a time for about 3-5 minutes
12. Drain on paper towels
13. The original recipe calls for fajita seasonings , but it would not let me enter it
14. But i guess you could use whatever seasonings you wanted

title: weight watchers jello cake
steps:
1. Mix cake mix with diet soda and applesauce , mix until well blended
2. Pour batter into desired pan
3. Bake at 350 for 20-30 minutes until done
4. Cool cake and then poke holes in cake with knife or fork approximately one inch apart
5. Prepare jello as directed
6. Pour jello over cake evenly
7. Place cake in refrigerator for 1-2 hours until cooled
8. Frost with cool-whip and enjoy !

title: quick and easy pork burgers
steps:
1. Mix all of the ingredients in a bowl
2. Let the mix refrigerate for at least 30 minutes
3. Then press the mixture into patties
4. You have many choices on how to cook these !
5. You can cook them on your indoor grill for 5-10 minutes each , or until they are cooked throughly
6. You could also cook them on the outdoor grill for 5-10 minutes each , or until they are cooked throughly
7. Lastly , you could cook them on the stove for 5-10 minutes each , or until they are cooked throughly
8. Serve on a bun , or by itself

title: thomas keller s favorite roast chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees
2. Rinse chicken in cold water , then dry very well with paper towels , inside and out
3. The less it steams , the drier the heat , the better
4. Salt and pepper cavity , then truss bird with kitchen twine to help it cook more evenly
5. Now , salt chicken -- i like to rain salt over the bird so it has a nice uniform coating that will result in crisp , salty , flavorful skin
6. When it's cooked , you should still be able to make out salt baked onto the crisp skin
7. Season to taste with pepper
8. Place chicken in saut pan or roasting pan and , when oven is up to temperature , put chicken in oven
9. I leave it alone -- i don't baste it
10. I don't add butter
11. You can if you wish , but i think this creates steam , which i don't want
12. Roast it until it's done , 50 to 60 minutes
13. Remove from oven and add thyme to pan
14. Baste chicken with juices and thyme and let it sit for 15 minutes on cutting board
15. Remove twine
16. Discard wing
17. Separate middle wing joint and eat that immediately
18. Remove legs and thighs
19. I like to take off the backbone and eat one of the oysters , the two succulent morsels of meat embedded there , and give the other to the person i'm cooking with
20. But i take the chicken butt for myself
21. I could never understand why my brothers always fought over that triangular
22. These are the cook's rewards
23. Cut breast down middle and serve it on the bone , with one wing joint still attached to each
24. The preparation is not meant to be super elegant
25. Slather meat with butter
26. Serve with mustard on the side and , if you wish , a simple green salad

title: star s sangria
steps:
1. In a large 4-qt
2. Glass pitcher , stir in wine , sugar , orange juice , orange liqueur
3. Stir to dissolve sugar
4. Add fruit and cover with plastic wrap
5. Refrigerate until ready to serve
6. Serve in well chilled tall glasses

title: macaroni   cheese
steps:
1. Following package directions , cook macaroni in a large pot of boiling salted water until al dente
2. Drain thoroughly
3. Melt butter in pot over medium-high heat , add milk , drained macaroni , cheese and paprika
4. Cook , stirring until cheese is melted
5. Season to taste with salt and pepper

title: crustless tomato and basil quiche  low carb
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Spray 9" pie pan with cooking spray and layer 1 / 2 cup of cheese on the bottom
3. Heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat and saute onion until soft
4. Layer over cheese in pie pan
5. Sprinkle tomato slices with flour and basil , then saute 1 minute on each side
6. Layer over onions in pie pan
7. In a small bowl , whisk together eggs and milk , season with pepper and pour over the onion / tomato layers in the pie pan
8. Sprinkle top of quiche with remaining 1 / 2 cup of cheese and bake at 400 f for 10 minutes
9. Reduce heat to 350 f and bake for 15 to 20 minutes , or until filling is puffed and golden brown
10. Serve warm

title: quick provencal mushroom and white bean stew
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large soup pot over medium-high heat
2. Add mushrooms , onion , garlic , and herbe de provence , and cook and stir until onion is very tender and mushrooms are slightly golden , about 8 minutes
3. Add vegetable broth , tomatoes , and wine
4. Bring to a boil , reduce heat , cover , and simmer to blend flavors , about 15 minutes
5. In a small bowl , mash 1 cup of the beans until smooth
6. Add to stew
7. Stir in remaining beans and heat until hot , about 8 minutes
8. Serve immediately

title: cinnamon roll pancakes
steps:
1. Prepare pancake batter: in a medium bowl , whisk together flour , baking powder and salt
2. Whisk in milk , oil and egg , just until batter is moistened
3. In a medium bowl , mix butter , brown sugar and cinnamon
4. Scoop the filling into a small zip baggie and set aside
5. In a medium , microwave-safe bowl- heat butter and cream cheese until melted
6. Whisk together until smooth
7. Whisk in powdered sugar and vanilla extract
8. Heat large skillet over medium-low heat
9. Spray with nonstick spray
10. Scoop about 3 / 4 cup batter onto the skillet
11. Snip the corner of your baggie of filling and squeeze a spiral of the filling onto the top of the pancake
12. When bubbles begin to appear on the surface , flip carefully with a thin spatula , and cook until browned on the underside , 1 to 2 minutes more
13. Transfer to a baking sheet or platter and keep in a warm oven until ready to serve
14. When ready to serve , spoon warmed glaze onto the top of each pancake
15. A few helpful
16. Dont flip them until you see those bubbles starting to pop on top
17. Flip them with a wide spatula so you can grasp the whole thing without batter and filling dripping all over the place !
18. If your baggie of filling begins to get too thick , just pop it in the microwave for a few seconds to soften it up again
19. Same with your glaze

title: creamy mango sorbet
steps:
1. Place all ingredients into a blender and puree until smooth and slightly thickened
2. Pour the puree into a plastic freezer storage ban and place in your freezer
3. About every 1 / 2 hour for the first 2 hours mash the bag by hand to keep the ice crystals small and the sorbet smooth
4. Freeze over night , and serve the next day for best results

title: southern oil biscuits with self rising flour
steps:
1. Make a well in the bowl with your flour
2. Pour in milk and oil , i use lemon juice cause it just helps the rise for me
3. Incorporate flour from inside going out may need a little more milk or flour
4. Pinch off six balls of dough , she used canned milk , which i do to i use 1 cup of the canned milk for gravy and 1 cup for biscuits with the wash out canned water 1 / 4 cup of it
5. , i like big biscuits , or 12 depending on size you want , just make them the same size
6. Put on lightly greased cookie sheet
7. Some people use cast iron skillet
8. Bake in preheated 425 degree oven 15- 20 minutes until browned

title: apple strawberry cobbler
steps:
1. Combine sugar , flour , lemon rind and cinnamon
2. Stir in apples , strawberries and lemon juice
3. Spread mixture in 8-inch square baking dish and bake in 400 degree oven for 10 minutes
4. Topping: in bowl , mix together flour , sugar , baking powder , baking soda and salt
5. Cut in butter until crumbly
6. With fork , stir in buttermilk until soft dough forms
7. Drop by spoonfuls onto fruit
8. Bake 35 to 40 minutes or until top is golden and biscuits are cooked through

title: dough for fried pies
steps:
1. Mix and place in refrigerator till ready to use
2. When ready to use , roll out pie dough
3. Use a small bowl to cut out circles
4. Put 2 or more tablespoons of fruit in the middle of the circle
5. Fold over and press edges together
6. Bake at 350 for 20 minutes or till browned

title: deviled ham spread
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together
2. Refrigerate until set
3. Serve with crackers
4. Great when used as a spread for finger sandwiches as well

title: steak  and potatoes  tacos
steps:
1. In a large pot on high heat combine the lard , your cubed steak , bacon and pepper
2. Sear your steak
3. Stir frequently to prevent the meat from burning
4. When meat is seared , reduce heat to medium high and add all ingredients , except the vinegar
5. If you are going to stretch the dish with potatoes , add them at this point and add the bouillon cubes when some of the fluid begins to cook out of your potatoes
6. This will make it easier for the bouillon cubes to dissolve
7. Stir constantly for about five minutes
8. If adding potatoes , stir until your potatoes are cooked , and you are just beginning to make mashed potatoes
9. Add vinegar and reduce heat somewhere between medium-low and low , stirring periodically
10. Reduce the fluid in the pot so your taco filling will not be too wet for your tortillas
11. Warm your tortillas and serve plain or with any of the following -- mexican table cream , cilantro & onions , salsa
12. If you make this without the potatoes , you might consider using two tortillas per taco

title: tomato basil bread   by hand or bread machine
steps:
1. In a large mixing bowl , dissolve yeast in water
2. Stir in basil , parmesan cheese , tomato paste , sugar , oil , salt , pepper flakes and 2 cups flour
3. Stir in enough remaining flour to form a stiff dough
4. Turn onto a floured surface
5. Knead until smooth and elastic , about 3-5 minutes
6. Place in a greased bowl , turning once to grease top
7. Cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled , about 1 hour
8. Punch dough down
9. Knead for 1 minute
10. Shape into a round loaf
11. Place on a greased baking sheet
12. Cover and let rise until doubled , about 1 hour
13. With a sharp knife , cut a large "x" in top of loaf
14. Bake at 375 for 35-40 minutes or until golden brown
15. Remove from pan to a wire rack to cool

title: ultimate makeover   toad in the hole   low fat
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 200c / gas 6 / fan oven 180c
2. Arrange the sausages on top of the onions , then add the oil and roast for 20 minutes
3. Sift the flour into a bowl , drop the egg in to the centre and beat in the milk a little at a time until it makes a smooth batter
4. Stir in the mustard and thyme and season
5. Pour the batter quickly into the tin and return to the oven for 40 minutes until the batter is risen and golden

title: soft and chewy gingersnaps
steps:
1. Mix , chill , roll into small balls
2. Roll in sugar , place on very lightly greased cookie sheet
3. Bake at 325f until brown , about 18 minutes

title: huevos diablos
steps:
1. Start by sweating the onion and garlic in a small skillet
2. When they are translucent add in the salsa and hotdogs
3. Crack the eggs over the top , letting them cook through
4. Place slices of cheese on top and cover until cheese melts
5. Flip it all onto a plate and enjoy !

title: chunky beef chili
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a large dutch oven over high heat
2. Season beef with salt and pepper and brown beef in batches , without crowding pot
3. Transfer browned beef to bowl or platter
4. Add onions , green peppers and jalapenos to pot and cook , stirring often , until soft , about 5 minutes
5. Add garlic to pot and cook veggies one minute more
6. Sprinkle veggies with chili powder , cumin and oregeno
7. Stir weel
8. Return beef and any juices to pot
9. Stir in tomatoes with their juice , broth and beer
10. Bring to a boil
11. Reduce heat to medium-low and cover pot
12. Simmer until meat is tender , about 2 hours
13. Remove from heat and let cool a few minutes
14. Skim off surface fat
15. Stir in cooked beans , if desired
16. Remove one cup of chili liquid and mix well with cornmeal
17. Stir the cornmeal paste into pot along with chocolate
18. Cook until thickens slightly , about 5 more minutes
19. Serve with sour cream , shredded cheddar and chopped green onions , if desired

title: roasted beets with yogurt and chives
steps:
1. Roast beets at 425 for 1 hour
2. Cool and peel
3. Chop or mash beets , as you prefer
4. Mix yogurt with chives
5. Serve beets with a health portion of yogurt on them

title: kahlua cinnamon brownies
steps:
1. Preheat oven 350 degrees
2. Combine chocolate chips and margarine in a small saucepan
3. Cook over medium low heat until chocolate melts , stirring constantly
4. Remove from heat and stir in kahlua and vanilla - set aside
5. Beat brown sugar and egg in a large bowl until well blended
6. Add the chocolate mixture and beat well
7. Then add the remaining dry ingredients
8. Coat an 8 in square baking pan with spray and pour batter inches
9. Bake at 350 for 30 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean
10. When they come out , immediately sprinkle sugar on top
11. Cool cut and enjoy

title: cream cheese and jalapeno tortillas
steps:
1. Mix together jalapenos , turkey , onion , and seasonings
2. Add serrano pepper , if you want these spicy
3. Blend in softened cream cheese , add jalapeno juice to thin cream cheese
4. Spread the mixture in a thin layer on each tortilla
5. Roll up tortillas
6. Place rolled up tortillas back into the plastic tortilla bag
7. Secure bag with a twisty tie
8. Refrigerate overnight
9. Slice rolls into 1 / 4 inch pieces and you are ready to serve
10. The rolls can be frozen and sliced before serving

title: bubba rice
steps:
1. Cook rice according to package
2. In large skillet , saute onion in butter or margarine until soft
3. Add cooked rice , chicken boullion dissolved in 1 cup of boiling water , salt , pepper , garlic powder , and parsley
4. Cook , stirring , over medium-low heat for 8-10 minutes , adding extra water to produce a creamy texture

title: easy caramello chocolate mousse
steps:
1. Melt the chocolate in the top of a double boiler , stirring constantly until there are no lumps
2. Add 150ml of the cream and stir to combine
3. Put to one side until the mixture is cool
4. When cool , whip the remaining cream in a bowl
5. Spoon the chocolate mixture into the whipped cream , and fold until well combined
6. Cover with plastic wrap and leave in the fridge until set
7. You can also pour this into individual ramekins if you are having a dinner party , and then garnish with chocolate shavings before serving
8. This is really quite rich so a little goes a long way
9. You can also use mint chocolate but the caramello tastes much better

title: luscious lemon angel roll  pampered chef
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Cut 18 inch long piece of parchment paper , press into bottom and up sides of cookie sheet or pan
3. Prepare angel food cake mix as directed on box , pour batter over parchment
4. Bake 30-35 minutes or until top springs back when lightly touched with finger
5. Remove and allow to cool
6. Sprinkle cup of powdered sugar over cake
7. Place sheet of parchment over cake and carefully turn cake over onto clean dish towel
8. Remove pan , and starting on the short end , roll up cake with towel and parchment
9. Leave rolled up and cool completely in fridge
10. Unroll cake and transfer to clean surface , discard parchment on top
11. Spread cup of strawberry ice cream topping on cake , press lightly
12. Combine cream cheese and cup of powdered sugar
13. Add 1 t of lemon zest
14. Add food coloring and mix well
15. Fold in 1 cup of the whipped topping , gently spread over the strawberry topping
16. Reroll the cake
17. Sprinkle with additional powdered sugar and slice with serrated knife
18. Garnish with whipped topping , fresh strawberries and lemon slices

title: scratch eggnog waffles
steps:
1. Plug in an electric waffle iron to heat
2. Make whipped cream: beat whipping cream , vanilla extract , cream of tartar and a pinch of salt until you have fairly stiff peaks
3. Refrigerate the whipped cream
4. Make waffles: whisk the dry ingredients together in a large mixing bowl
5. Add the oil and eggs then slowly whisk in the eggnog , starting with about a half cup
6. The ultimate amount of eggnog required will depend on the characteristics of your flour , the humidity and temperature
7. Add eggnog and whisk until the mixture is the consistency of heavy whipping cream
8. Cook the waffles according your griddle's instructions
9. Serve each with a dollop of whipped cream with a candy cane on top
10. Dust with powdered sugar , nutmeg , cinnamon or mace as desired
11. Serve with warmed syrup of choice

title: praline pumpkin dessert
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350
2. Grease bottom and sides of 13x9 baking dish , with shortening
3. Beat pumpkin , milk , eggs , sugar and 4 teaspoons pumpkin pie spice in medium bowl with wire whisk until smooth
4. Pour into pan
5. Sprinkle dry cake mix over pumpkin mixture
6. Sprinkle with pecans
7. Pour melted butter evenly over top of dessert
8. Bake 50-60 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean
9. Cool slightly
10. To serve , cut dessert into 4 rows by 3 rows
11. Serve warm or chilled with dollop of whipped cream sprinkled with pumpkin pie spice
12. Store covered in refrigerator

title: kasha varnishkes
steps:
1. In small bowl mix kasha with beaten egg , set aside
2. In skillet brown onions in oil
3. Add kasha and cook , separating grains until slightly toasted
4. Add broth , salt& pepper , bring to boil , cover and simmer until broth is absorbed , about 12 minutes
5. Mix in cooked bowties , season with additional salt& pepper

title: fig   almond bundt cake
steps:
1. Grease and flour a 9-inch bundt pan
2. In a food processor pulse with a metal blade almonds to a fine crumb add flour , baking powder , cinnamon , and salt pulse to mix and lighten
3. Beat together sugar and oil until light and fluffy
4. Add eggs , one at a time , beating after each addition
5. Add vanilla and almond extract
6. In a mixer at low speed , beat flour into egg mixture a little at a time , alternating with orange juice
7. Stir in figs
8. Spoon batter into prepared baking pan
9. Smooth top
10. Bake cake at 350 for about 40-45 minutes , or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean
11. Cool fig cake in pan on rack for about 5 minutes
12. Remove from pan to rack to cool completely
13. Dust with powdered sugar if desired

title: sausage dressing
steps:
1. Brown sausage with onions and celery
2. Mix remaining ingredients thoroughly in large pan
3. Add sausage , onions , and celery after draining
4. Let sit over night in refregerated area
5. Bake in oven at 375 degrees until golden brown

title: orangeade  new zealand style
steps:
1. Grate the zest of the lemon and one of the oranges
2. Set zest aside
3. Squeeze the lemon and all the oranges
4. Place juice and zest in a saucepan and add honey
5. Bring to a boil
6. Add ginger , cinnamon and cloves
7. Boil about 5 minutes , or until mixture is reduced by half
8. Strain
9. Pour into a covered container , cool and refrigerate
10. To serve , place a tablespoon of the mixture in a tall glass
11. Fill glass with ice and water

title: poulet au verjus   chicken with verjus
steps:
1. First , make verjus:
2. Pull the grapes away from their stems , then press them , extracting as much of the juice as possible
3. Filter this juice through muslin , a jelly bag , or use coffee filter paper
4. Bottle this and sterilize it , or freeze some in ice cube trays
5. Or use it up within the next few days
6. Brown the chicken cut in pieces for a good ten minutes
7. Add the chopped garlic and cook briefly
8. Pour in a large glass of verjus , and some chicken stock made with 1 / 2 cube 1 / 2 cup of hot water
9. Add the chopped parsley
10. Cook over low heat for 20 minutes , partially covered until towards the end , when you take the cover off
11. Use more verjus , if you want
12. It is a pleasant , fruity taste with a tart , vinegary quality
13. Serve with mashed potatoes or sarlat potatoes , recipe#209855 , fresh green beans , or other summer fare

title: broccoli and eggs
steps:
1. Mix the oils and teriyaki sauce in a skillet , and warm over medium heat
2. Baste eggs in skillet , turning constantly , until eggs turn dark brown
3. Remove eggs from pan
4. Mix garlic salt and pepper into oils in skillet
5. Stirfry broccoli until tender crisp , then melt cheese on top
6. Serve eggs with broccoli

title: roasted red pepper stuffed mushrooms
steps:
1. Remove stems from mushrooms
2. Reserve caps
3. Set stems aside for another use
4. In a bowl of a food processor fitted with a metal wing blade , place cream cheese , roasted red peppers , parmesan cheese , garlic and ground red pepper
5. Process until smooth , about 1 minute
6. In a pastry bag fitted with a large star
7. Pipe into mushroom caps
8. Garnish with toasted pine nuts , sliced green olives and parsley leaves , if desired

title: ready gravy mix
steps:
1. In a bowl combine all ingredients for mix
2. Store in an airtight container , for up to 6 months
3. Yield 8 batches
4. To prepare gravy:
5. In a saucepan , melt butter
6. Add 1 / 4 cup mix
7. Cook and stir until lightly browned , about a minute
8. Whisk in water until smooth
9. Bring to a full boil , cook and stir for 2 minute or until thickened

title: honduran mango avocado salsa
steps:
1. Cut up the mango avocados , tomato , red onion and red pepper in to the amounts described
2. For extra flavor , add a dash of garlic powder and / or a dash of lime juice
3. Then when all the work is done , let it sit in the bowl for about 20 minutes or over night with a plastic wrap over it to keep its flavor
4. After that , all you have to do is serve it with chips and enjoy !

title: sweet italian turkey sausage
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients an mix thoroughly
2. Shape into patties , links , or crumble into skillet and brown over medium heat
3. Mixture may be made in advance up to 36 hours and let sit in the refrigerator to absorb the flavors , or can be shaped and frozen until ready to use
4. Thaw in the refrigerator

title: catfish sandwiches  ww
steps:
1. Sprinkle catfish with the seaoning
2. Spray pam in a grill pan and set over medium high heat
3. Place catfish in pan and cook until done
4. Layer lettuce , catfish fillet and tartar sauce along with other optional sandwich fixings on each bun

title: magical sparkling snowflakes  christmas butter biscuits cookies
steps:
1. Place flour and the icing sugar in a food processor
2. Process for 30 seconds
3. Add butter
4. Process until mixture resembles fine breadcrumbs
5. Add egg and vanilla
6. Process until dough comes together
7. If it is too dry , add some milk
8. Transfer to a lightly floured surface
9. Knead dough until smooth
10. Press or roll into a 9" / 20cm circle
11. Wrap in greaseproof paper
12. Refrigerate for 1 hour or until firm
13. Preheat oven to 180c / 360f , and line 2 flat baking / cookie trays with baking paper
14. Roll out dough between 2 sheets of baking paper until about 1 / 4" / 5mm thick
15. Using snowflake biscuit / cookie cutters , cut shapes out of dough
16. Place on them gently on to the trays
17. Press leftover dough together and repeat cutting out shapes
18. Refrigerate for 30 minutes or until firm
19. Bake the cookies / biscuits for 10 minutes , swapping trays after 5 minutes , or until light golden in colour
20. Allow to cool on trays completely
21. Pipe trellis-work patterns following the snowflake shapes , or drizzle glace icing over the top
22. Then dust them with edible glitter / edible silver dusting powder whilst the icing is still wet
23. Dust with remaining sugar or edible glitter / silver dust just before serving
24. On taking them out of the oven , if the holes have closed up a bit , gently wiggle around again with a plastic drinking straw , to make the holes bigger ! excuse the language , i don't know how else to put it ! lol !

title: cauliflower cheese pie
steps:
1. Crust:
2. Set the freshly-grated potatoes in a colander over a bowl
3. Salt it and leave it for 10 minutes
4. Then squeeze out the excess water , and add to the remaining ingredients
5. Pat it into a well-oiled 9-inch pie pan , building up the sides of the crust with lightly floured fingers
6. Bake at 400 degrees for 40-50 minutes , until browned
7. After the first 30 minutes , brush the crust with a little oil to crispen it
8. Turn oven down to 375 degrees
9. Filling:
10. Saute onions and garlic in butter for 5 minutes
11. Add the basil and cauliflower and cook , covered , 10 minutes , stirring occasionaly
12. Spread 1 / 2 the cheese into the baked crust , then the saute , then the rest of the cheese
13. Beat the eggs and the milk together and pour over the vegetables
14. Bake at 375 degrees for 35-40 minutes until set

title: strawberry cheese ball
steps:
1. Soften cream cheese and butter in a large mixing bowl
2. Beat well
3. Cream in brown sugar and confectioners' sugar
4. Add vanilla extract
5. Fold in strawberries
6. Refrigerate in a bowl for 3 hours
7. Form into a ball , then roll in crushed graham cracker crumbs

title: tim s sausage burgers
steps:
1. If you cannot get bulk sausage , then squeeze the sausage out of the casing and discard casing
2. Mix all ingredients until well combined
3. Shape into patties
4. I make mine very thin and about 1" wider than a hamburger bun , because they shrink up and get thicker while cooking
5. Bbq grill or fry until juices run clear
6. Serve on your favorite buns or rolls
7. Enjoy !

title: soup of two mushrooms and  barley
steps:
1. Put dried porcini mushrooms in a bowl and cover with very hot water
2. Soak until they are soft , then drain
3. Heat oil in a large pot
4. Cook onion , celery , garlic , and both mushrooms about 8 minutes , until they are soft
5. Stir in barley and cook one minute
6. Add tomatoes , and stock
7. Bring to boil , then reduce heat and cover
8. Simmer 20 to 30 minutes , until the barley is tender
9. Stir in dill and cayenne pepper
10. Season with salt and black pepper to taste
11. Serve

title: handmade onion bread
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine warm water , yeast , salt , oil , sugar , and half the flour
2. Mix thoroughly , and let sponge rise until doubled in size , approximately 35 minutes
3. While the dough is rising , place thinly sliced or finely chopped onion in a saut pan with sesame seeds , garlic , and butter
4. Saut until caramelized
5. Remove from heat and let cool
6. Gradually add the rest of the flour , kneading just until smooth
7. I usually knead gently with my finger
8. Place dough in a greased bowl , and turn several times to coat
9. Allow to rise until doubled , approximately 35 minutes
10. Punch down the dough
11. Divide dough into three equal parts
12. Pour onion mixture onto the dough and fold over on itself just enough to distribute the onion mix throughout the dough
13. Shape into loaves , and place in three 8 1 / 2 x 4 1 / 2 inch greased bread pans
14. Let rise until almost doubled , approximately 35 minutes
15. Bake at 350f for 30-40 minutes
16. The loaves may need to be covered for the last few minutes with foil to prevent excess browning

title: one hellava chipotle salsa
steps:
1. Put the tomatoes , garlic and cilantro in blender or food processor and process until smooth
2. If you prefer a chunkier salsa , just mix ingredients together in a large bowl
3. Transfer to large bowl and add onion , adobo marinade and sugar
4. Add lime juice , salt and black pepper to taste , then add the cinnamon , allspice and ccumin , if using
5. Best when freshly made , but you may cover and chill until ready to serve

title: pork chop and rice casserole
steps:
1. Brown chops in oil
2. Combine all other ingredients and spread into a 9x13-inch baking dish
3. Lay chops on top and season with salt and pepper
4. Bake uncovered for 45 minutes at 350

title: brussels sprouts with onion alfredo sauce
steps:
1. Cook / steam brussels sprouts in salted water until tender about 5-7 minutes
2. Drain and place hot drained brussels sprouts in a serving dish
3. Meanwhile , in a saucepan , over medium heat , sautee onions and garlic in the butter until onions are translucent
4. About 4-5 minutes
5. Add cream , parmesan , salt and pepper and stir
6. Cook over medium heat , stirring frequently , until cheese is fully melted and sauce begins to thicken
7. Pour sauce over brussels sprouts and serve immediately

title: jagerschnitzel with bacon mushroom gravy
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Pound pork slices between sheets of plastic wrap to 1 / 4-inch thickness
3. In a shallow medium bowl , mix together 3 / 4 cup flour with salt , pepper , garlic and paprika
4. In another shallow medium bowl , combine egg , milk and mustard
5. In another medium shallow bowl , combine cracker and panko crumbs
6. Dredge pork slices first in flour , then in egg wash , and finally in crumbs
7. Let set on a baking sheet fitted with a cooling rack for 5 minutes
8. In a medium saute pan over medium heat cook the bacon until crispy
9. Remove from pan to drain on paper towels
10. In same pan with bacon fat , add onions and saute for 3 minutes
11. Add mushrooms and continue sauteing for 2 minutes
12. Stir in 1 / 4 cup flour
13. Cook flour to make roux until light brown , about 2 minutes
14. Add wine and cook for 3 minutes , reducing by 1 / 3 , then add stock
15. Continue cooking to reduce by 1 / 3 again
16. Season with salt and pepper
17. Keep warm
18. Heat 1 / 4-inch oil in thick saute pan or cast iron skillet to 350 degrees f
19. Cook pork evenly on both sides , about 5 minutes for the first side , 3 to 4 minutes for the second
20. Remove to platter when done
21. Add butter to sauce , stirring until it has melted
22. To serve , cover pork with sauce
23. Sprinkle with chopped bacon and fresh parsley to garnish

title: tarragon chicken linguine
steps:
1. 1
2. Cook pasta according to directions , adding broccoli the last 4 minutes
3. Drain
4. Keep warm
5. 2
6. Combine broth , cornstarch , and seasoning
7. Set aside
8. 3
9. Cut the chicken into 1 inch chunks
10. In a large nonstick skillet , cook chicken in hot oil 4 minutes or until no longer pink , stirring often
11. 4
12. Stir cornstarch mixture
13. Add to skillet
14. Cook and stir until thickened
15. Stir in tarragon
16. Cook for 2 minutes
17. Serve over pasta

title: good and easy breakfast hash
steps:
1. Oven at 375 degrees
2. Combine all ingredients except paprika and place in baking dish
3. Sprinkle with paprika
4. Bake 20-40 minutes or until well heated and brown on top i serve this with fried or scrambled eggs , toast and sliced tomatoes that have been sprinkled with a little sugar
5. Serves 4-6

title: chicken noodle parmesan
steps:
1. In a saucepan blend together the soups , milk , cheese , and pepper until smooth
2. Stir in the noodles and chicken , and simmer until heated through
3. Remove from the heat and serve

title: black cod with lime and coconut
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f sprinkle fish with salt and pepper
2. Place in 11x7x2" glass baking dish
3. Drizzle with 1 1 / 2 teaspoons lime juice
4. Heat oil in large skillet over medium heat
5. Add leek over medium heat
6. Add leek and garlic
7. Saute 7 minutes
8. Add coconut milk and remaining lime juic
9. Boil until thick , about 4 minutes
10. Stir in lime peel
11. Spoon sauce over fish
12. Bake about 20 minutes , until fish is just opaque in center
13. Transfer to platter
14. Whisk juices in baking dish
15. Spoon around fish , top with cilantro

title: coffee chip cake
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 375 degrees
2. In a large bowl , mix the first seven ingredients until well-blended
3. Mix in the chocolate chips
4. Grease a 9 x 9 x 2 inch baking dish
5. Pour in the batter and bake for 25-30 minutes
6. Dust with powdered sugar and serve

title: warm chocolate tart with red wine sauce
steps:
1. For the tart:
2. Preheat the oven to 325f
3. Place the chopped chocolate in a medium bowl and set aside
4. Combine the cream and milk in a medium saucepan , and bring to a boil over medium-high heat
5. Pour the hot cream mixture over the chocolate
6. Allow to stand for 30 seconds to melt the chocolate , then whisk until the chocolate is completely melted and the mixture is smooth
7. Allow to cool for 10 minutes
8. Whisk the egg into the chocolate mixture
9. Pour the filling into the prebaked tart shell
10. Bake the tart for 8 to 10 minutes , until the edges of the filling are set
11. The center will still be soft
12. Cool the tart on a wire rack for 10 minutes and served warm
13. For the red wine sauce:
14. Put the sugar in a deep sauce pan
15. Stir constantly on medium high heat until sugar liquefies and turns mahogany brown
16. Add the red wine and whisk until sugar is dissolved and wine is incorporated
17. Chill
18. Serve over tart

title: liquid lamington cocktail
steps: 1. Blend all ingredients until smooth & garnish with desiccated coconut

title: killer upside down banana walnut cake
steps:
1. Set oven to 325 degrees
2. Grease a 9-inch round cake pan
3. For the topping: in a heavy-bottom saucepan combine sugar and butter
4. Stir over low heat until butter melts and the mixture is well blended
5. Pour into cake pan , and spread to coat the bottom of the pan
6. Drizzle the maple syrup over the butter / sugar mixture , then sprinkle with chopped nuts
7. Place the long banana slices in concentric circles on top of the nuts , overlapping slightly but covering the bottom
8. For the cake: stir together flour , baking powder , cinnamon and salt in a medium bowl
9. Beat in sugar and butter in another bowl until creamy
10. Add in egg and vanilla
11. Beat until smooth , light and fluffy
12. Beat in flour mixture alternately with milk
13. Spoon the batter over the bananas in the pan
14. Bake for about 50-55 minutes , or until cakes tests done
15. Transfer cake to a rack and run a knife around the sides of the pan
16. Cool cake for 30 minutes
17. Place a plate over pan and invert onto plate
18. Let stand 3 minutes upside-down with plate on top , then gently lift off pan
19. Serve with whipped cream

title: greenies  brownies
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease and flour 9 x 13 inch pan
3. Melt , butter , chocolate and irish cream in small saucepan over low heat until smooth
4. Cool to room temperature
5. In large bowl , beat eggs on high speed of electric mixer until thick and light yellow
6. Gradually beat in sugar
7. Reduce mixer to low speed and beat in chocolate mixture
8. Stir in flour and salt
9. Reserve 2 tablespoons nuts
10. Fold in remaining nuts
11. Sprinkle with remaining nuts
12. Bake until crust forms
13. Cool in pan 10 minutes
14. Cut into 2 inch squares
15. Enjoy !

title: healthy mexicali chicken
steps:
1. Prepare salsa in magic bullet
2. Set aside
3. Spread mustard over one side of chicken breasts
4. Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat until hot
5. Add chicken breasts , with mustard side down
6. Cook 4 minutes
7. Turn chicken over
8. Reduce heat to medium
9. Combine salsa and lime juice
10. Spoon over and around chicken
11. Simmer uncovered until chicken is cooked through and sauce thickens , 6-8 minutes
12. Transfer chicken to serving plates
13. Cook the remaining pan juices in skillet over high heat until slightly reduced , about 30 seconds
14. Spoon juices over the chicken
15. Top with avocado
16. Garnish with green onions , if desired

title: dressed up burger patties
steps:
1. Mix first 5 ingredients
2. Shape into patties
3. Cook and brown patties , add onion , broth and mushrooms
4. Cover and simmer 10 minutes
5. Heat onion to boiling
6. Remove patties
7. Mix water and cornstarch
8. Add to skillet and stir until thickened

title: ice cream pancakes
steps:
1. Combine 1 cup ice cream with water and egg in a medium bowl
2. In a separate bowl , combine flour , baking powder , and salt
3. Add the wet mixture to the dry mixture and stir just until combined
4. Heat a greased skillet over medium
5. Spoon 1 / 3 cup of batter onto the skillet for each pancake
6. Flip once edges are cooked and pancake starts to bubble , about 1 minute
7. Cook other side until lightly browned and serve with a scoop of ice cream and strawberry syrup

title: blueberry   banana bread
steps:
1. Stir bisquick , oats , sugar , bananas , milk and eggs in bowl until moistened
2. Beat vigorously 30 seconds
3. Gently stir in blueberries
4. Heat oven to 350f and pour ingredients into a greased loaf pan
5. Bake 45 to 55 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
6. Cool for about 10 minutes and remove from pan

title: buffalo chicken party sandwiches
steps:
1. Combine chicken , hot sauce and water in medium saucepan
2. Cook on medium heat 5 minute or until heated through , stirring occasionally
3. While chicken is heating , mix mayo and dressing in small bowl
4. Stir in celery and blue cheese
5. Spoon chicken mixture onto bottom halves of buns
6. Cover with cheddar cheese , celery / dressing mixture and tops of buns

title: lentil soup   linsen suppe
steps:
1. Pick over lentils and wash
2. Dice bacon , and render in large pot to accommodate all ingredients
3. Sautee onions , carrots , and celeriac or celery leaves about 5 minutes
4. Add stock on lentils
5. Bring to a full boil
6. Reduce heat and cook for 1-1 / 2 to 2 hours
7. Can also be cooked in a crockpot about 4-5 hours on medium , 6-8 hours on low
8. Add sausage or smoked ham cut into bite size pieces
9. Optional: melt lard or margarine or butter and caramelize the coarsely chopped onion , individually add to lentils at the table
