10. Vinegar can be added to personal taste at the table also
11. Sourdough bread with caraway seeds is a great accompaniment

title: halibut  chard and potato casserole
steps:
1. Preheat ove to 350 degrees f
2. Oil a heavy casserole or oven safe dutch oven
3. In a medium skillet , heat 1 tablespoon olive oil , over medium heat , and cook onion , stirring often , until tender , about 5 minutes
4. Stir in the garlic , cook 30 seconds
5. Stir in tomatoes , with juice , and season with salt and pepper
6. Bring to a simmer , stir often , and cook 10 to 15 minutes
7. Meanwhile in another pot , steam chard , until just wilted , 2 to 3 minutes
8. Rinse with cold water , squeeze out excess water , and chop coarsley
9. Place a spoonful of the tomato sauce in the bottom of the casserole
10. Season potatoes with salt and pepper and arrange , in a layer , in the bottom of the casserole
11. In a large bowl , toss together the chard , salt and pepper , and parsley
12. Spread half of this mixture over the potatoes
13. Season the fish with salt and pepper and lay them on top of the chard
14. Pour half the tomato sauce over the fish , then top with the remaining chard mixture
15. Pour over the remaining tomato sauce , add in the wine , drizzle all with the remaining olive oil
16. Cover tightly and bake until the potatoes are tender , one hour
17. Tomato sauce can be made up to three days ahead of serving
18. The entire casserole can be assembled several hours before baking

title: krispies chocolate chippers
steps:
1. Cream margarine and sugar in mixer bowl til light and fluffy
2. Add vanilla and eggs
3. Beat for 5 minutes
4. Sift flour , salt , baking powder and baking soda into mixture
5. Mix well
6. Stir in chocolate chips and rice krispies
7. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto non-stick cookie sheet
8. Bake at 375f for 9-10 minutes , or until golden brown
9. Cool on wire rack

title: canadian living corn chowder
steps:
1. In large heavy saucepan , cook bacon until crisp
2. Add onion and celety cooking until soft , but not brown
3. Stir in flour and them slowly adding in chicken stock
4. Add potatoes and simmer 10 minutes or until tender
5. Add milk and cream corn
6. Simmer about 10 minutes
7. Add salt and pepper to taste
8. Do not boil

title: crazy awesome tuna salad
steps:
1. Start boiling the eggs
2. While they are boiling cut pickles and onions
3. Mix all ingredients
4. Stir it all up and then enjoy ! mmmm !

title: poc chuc
steps:
1. Blend all marinade ingredients in blender or food processor
2. Marinate pork at least 3 hours
3. Bring water to boil in deep saucepan
4. Add onions and blanch for 1 minute
5. Drain and place in stainless steel bowl
6. Toss with vinegar , cilantro , chile , salt and pepper
7. Grill pork steaks on barbecue
8. Serving suggestions: serve with mexican yellow rice
9. Garnish with habanero chile peppers and cilantro

title: greek sesame seed cookies
steps:
1. Mix butter , sugar , and eggs til fluffy
2. Stir in 1 / 3 cup of the sesame seeds
3. Combine flour , baking powder and salt
4. Add alternately with water to sugar mixture
5. Chill dough til stiff , 1-2 hours
6. Heat oven to 350' degrees f
7. Roll dough out on lightly floured board into rectangle 1 / 8th inch thick
8. Cut dough in strips about 2inches x 1 inch
9. Press one side of strip into reserved sesame seeds
10. Loop one end over the other making a bow-tie effect
11. Place on lightly greased baking pan
12. Bake 8-10 minutes
13. Until lightly browned
14. Cool slightly before removing from pan , cool on wire rack

title: classic chili rellenos with anaheim peppers
steps:
1. To roast chilies:
2. Place chile peppers on an aluminum foil-lined baking sheet
3. Broil 5 inches from the heat 5 minutes on each side or until chile peppers are blistered
4. Place chile peppers in a heavy-duty zip-top plastic bag
5. Seal
6. Let stand 10 minutes to loosen skins
7. Peel peppers , leaving stems attached
8. Make a slit in the side of each chile , remove seeds , and stuff with cheese sticks
9. Dredge chiles with flour
10. Beat egg whites until they become stiff and peaks form
11. Beat yolks with water , 3 tablespoons flour and salt until thick and creamy
12. Fold the yolks into the whites and dip the chiles in the mixture
13. Fry in 2-3 inches of oil until they become golden brown
14. Serve with your favorite salsa , refried beans and yellow rice for a great south of the border meal !

title: barbecued steak dijonnaise
steps:
1. Place steaks in shallow dish
2. Add wine and fresh sprigs herbs
3. Cover and marinate for at least 1 hour
4. Remove steaks from marinade and pat dry
5. On a preheated barbecue place steaks 6" away from heat source
6. Cook approximately 4 to 6 minutes per side for medium-rare steak
7. Meanwhile , sieve red wine
8. Discard herbs
9. Pour wine into a small saucepan
10. Bring to a boil and reduce amount by half
11. Mix together cream and cornstarch until smooth
12. Pour into saucepan with dijon mustard , chopped basil and oregano , salt and pepper
13. Bring to a boil and simmer about 1 minute , stirring continuously
14. Season to taste
15. Divide evenly , spoon over steaks and serve immediately

title: creamy mustard vinaigrette by ina garten  barefoot contessa
steps:
1. In a small bowl , whisk together the vinegar , mustard , garlic , salt and pepper
2. While whisking , slowly add the olive oil until the vinaigrette is emulsified
3. Toss salad with enough dressing to moisten and serve immediately

title: red lentil and vegetable stew
steps:
1. Saut the carrots , onion , and celery in the olive oil until they start to caramelize a bit
2. Add the garlic about a minute before the vegetables are finished sauting
3. Add the red lentils , and stir until mixed with the vegetables
4. Add the stock , tomatoes and juice , cumin , and tabasco , if using
5. Bring to a simmer over medium heat and reduce heat to medium low
6. Simmer until the lentils are tender , about 25 minutes
7. If the liquid all evaporates and the lentils are not done , add a little water to keep the simmer going

title: mexican heroes
steps:
1. Remove some bread from the inside surfaces of the rolls
2. Spread bottom half of each roll thinly with sour cream and add some lettuce
3. Spread with another layer of sour cream , then roast beef
4. Season to taste with salt & pepper and top with onion rings , chopped cilantro , avocado and more sour cream
5. Sprinkle with about 1 teaspoons chili powder
6. Then top with more lettuce and drizzle with chile sauce
7. Top with jack cheese
8. Spread cut surface of top half of roll with chile sauce
9. Put top on and dig in !

title: carol s hummous
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients except water in blender on pulse or puree setting , until smooth
2. You will need to add boiling hot water during this process as it tends to sieze up
3. If you accidentally add too much water it's okay as the lemon and tahini tend to suck it up
4. Transfer to serving plate
5. Drizzle with extra virgin olive oil or vegetable oil
6. Serve with carol's easy pita bread

title: 100 chocolate cake
steps:
1. Mix all cake ingredients till well blended
2. Bake in 2 greased round cake pans in 350f oven for 30 minutes
3. Cool , while cake cools completely mix filling and spread between cooled cake rounds and frost with grandmas fudge frosting
4. Must refrigerate if serve with pudding filling
5. Prep time does not include cooling time

title: berry bran muffins
steps:
1. Combine cereal and water
2. Let stand for 5 minutes
3. Add egg and oil , beat well
4. Add the flour , sugar , baking powder and salt
5. Beat just until combined
6. Add the blue berries last
7. Put into muffin pans sprayed with pam
8. Sprinkle the granola on top
9. 1 tsp per muffin is good !
10. Bake at 400 degrees fahrenheit for 20 minutes or until golden brown

title: mojito del sol
steps:
1. In a large container or bowl , muddle mint with sugar until the mint is coarsely chopped and the sugar has turned a shade of green
2. Add lime juice , rum and bitters and stir until sugar dissolves
3. Strain into a small pitcher
4. Pour into iced tea or mojito glasses that are filled about 1 / 3 with crushed ice and top each drink with 1 / 2 cup of the club soda
5. Garnish with mint sprigs and serve

title: tart pastry
steps:
1. Dump everything into a bowl , roll up your sleeves and get your hands right into it
2. Work the dough well and knead for a couple of minutes
3. Wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate for 30 minutes before proceeding with recipe
4. I have made up this dough up to a week ahead of time , and kept in a compartment in the refrigerator , wrapped airtight in plastic wrap
5. It is a wonderful thing to have on hand during the holidays to whip up a batch of tarts or tassies , fresh

title: jambalaya with sausage  rice cooker recipe
steps:
1. In large frying pan , heat the oil and saute onions , sausage and bell pepper
2. Cook until sausage is cooked and onion and pepper is tender
3. Add chopped tomato and garlic to pan
4. Saute until cooked
5. In rice cooker , put in 3 cups of rice , enough water to reach the paella or sweet rice level marked on rice cooker sausage and vegetables , pkg of frozen vegetables , bay leaves , thyme , parsley , black pepper , and salsa if desired
6. Press the select and cooking button according to rice cooker instructions
7. To cook in skillet instead of rice cooker: after vegetables are cooked add tomatoes , spices and 1 1 / 2 quart water or stock
8. Bring to boil
9. Add rice , bring to boil and reduce to simmer
10. Cover and simmer for about 25-35 minutes or until all liquid is aborbed and rice is somewhat dry and not sticky

title: easy meatloaf with gravy
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Mix 1 / 2 can of soup with ground meat , egg , bread crumbs and onion
3. Shape into loaf , place into pam sprayed pan to prevent sticking
4. Bake for 1 to 1 and 1 / 2 hours until done
5. Gravy: drippings from meat into sauce pan with remaining soup and water
6. Use bouillon if needed
7. Salt and pepper to taste
8. Stir over medium heat to boiling point
9. Remove from heat and serve with meat

title: italian tofu meatballs
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Drain tofu well and cut into several large cubes
3. Put the tofu into food processor with garlic cloves and grind until combined
4. Put tofu mixture into a bowl and mix with the ricotta , egg , parmesan and gradually add breadcrumbs until you get a workable consistencey- you may need less or more
5. Mix thoroughly and add salt and fresh pepper
6. Form balls out of the mixture making sure they are held together well and roll in the remaining breadcrumbs
7. Grease a baking sheet and place the tofu balls on the sheet
8. Bake for 35-45 minutes , until form , carefully turning halfway through
9. Serve as is , with tomato sauce , pesto or my favorite -- over spaghetti

title: cedar plank pork loin
steps:
1. Start with an untreated cedar plank
2. Make sure the plank is untreated
3. Immerse the plank in water and soak for at least 4 hours
4. You may have to weigh it down with a can
5. Preheat grill to medium heat
6. Using a brush , brush one side of the plank with oil
7. This will help prevent food from sticking to wood
8. Top the plank with meat , place on center of grill
9. Close the lid
10. Grill 1 hour or until meat thermometer inserted into thickest part of meat registers 150 degrees f
11. Check back occasionally to ensure plank doesn't flare up
12. You can brush with barbeque sauce during last 20 minutes of grilling time if desired
13. Remove from grill , cover loosely with foil
14. Let stand 10 minutes until internal temp reaches 160 degrees f
15. Disgard plank

title: pancakes filled with ricotta and toblerone
steps:
1. Pancakes: in a blender , reduce all the ingredients in a creamy and homogeneous mixture
2. In a non-stick skillet of 7 inches lightly brushed with butter , cook 8 to 10 pancakes , one after one , until golden on each side
3. Put the cooked pancakes in a plate and cover with aluminium paper to avoid drying
4. Let cool
5. Filling with ricotta and toblerone : in a bowl , mix ricotta , cream , sugar and vanilla with a whisk until the mixture is creamy and homogeneous
6. With a spatula , incorporate the chocolate
7. Assembling : spread each pancake with about 3 tablespoon of the filling and roll around themselves
8. Garnish with a fruit salad

title: chipotle apple pecan cake with spicy caramel glaze
steps:
1. Preheat your oven to 325f
2. Lightly coat a 10" fluted tube pan with cooking spray
3. Lightly sprinkle with flour
4. Set aside
5. In a bowl combine the 3 cups flour , cinnamon , nutmeg , baking soda , chipotle powder , ginger , white pepper , salt , and cloves
6. Set aside
7. In a mixing bowl beat oil and sugar with electric mixer on medium speed until combined
8. Add eggs , one at a time
9. Beat well after each addition
10. Beat in vanilla and as much flour mixture as you can
11. Stir in remaining flour mixture , apples , and pecans
12. Spoon batter into pan
13. Bake 1 1 / 4 hours at 325f , until wooden toothpick inserted near center comes out clean
14. Meanwhile , prepare the glaze
15. Cool cake in pan 10 minutes
16. Invert on rack
17. Place rack over baking sheet
18. Drizzle warm cake with the glaze , respooning glaze that drips on baking sheet over the cake
19. Cool completely before serving
20. To make glaze:
21. In a saucepan combine the brown sugar , butter , whipping cream and chipotle pepper
22. Bring to boiling , stirring occasionally
23. Boil gently 2 minutes
24. Remove from heat
25. Stir in vanilla and let stand 1 1 / 4 hours until slightly thickened
26. Drizzle over the warm cake
27. Enjoy !

title: spinach with artichoke hearts
steps:
1. Melt together cream cheese and butter
2. Put spinach in a 9x13" casserole and spread with cream cheese mixture
3. Then , evenly distribute artichoke hearts , cheese and crackers over the cream cheese
4. Cover and bake 20 minutes at 350 deg
5. F

title: dinner in a hurry curry
steps:
1. Saute onion and garlic in oil until soft
2. Add flour , tomato and curry and saute together
3. Add bouillon , tomato paste and lemon juice , and mix
4. Stir in chopped meat
5. Stir in raisins and mushrooms , if desired
6. Heat through
7. Serve over rice

title: low carb fauxtatoes cauliflower deluxe
steps:
1. Simmer the cauliflower in water with the cream added to it
2. Drain thoroughly when very tender
3. Place the warm cauliflower in a food processor with the cream cheese , butter , and salt and pepper to taste , and process until smooth , in batches if necessary

title: chocolate coma cookies   2000
steps:
1. Toast and cool nuts , set aside
2. Chop chocolate place in a bowl with chipits , nuts , cherries , oatmeal
3. Sift flour , soda , salt , and baking powder and set aside
4. Beat butter with both sugars until fluffy
5. Add eggs one at a time and beat for one minute
6. Add dry ingredients and combine for one minute
7. Add chocolate , nut , cherries , oats
8. Using a wooden spoon combine well
9. Place scoops about 1 3 / 4 inches onto ungreased parchment lined baking sheet
10. Bake 350 degrees for 12 to 14 minutes , until slightly flattened
11. Cool 2 minutes , then remove to rack

title: perfect fluffy mashed potatoes
steps:
1. Heat pot of water 'till boiling
2. Peel and cube potatoes - add to boiling water
3. Boil gently until a fork can be inserted very easily into a potato - drain
4. Add milk to the pot to heat it up
5. Transer potatoes to a mixing bowl
6. Add margarine / butter and turn on mixer to low
7. Gradually add warm milk until it is your desired consistency
8. Add baking powder - mix on high for 30-45 seconds
9. Salt & pepper to taste mixing thoroughly

title: charleston shrimp and grits
steps:
1. Combine shrimp with lemon juice and a couple of generous splashes of tabasco sauce
2. Let sit while you begin the grits and gravy
3. Make the grits: in a large heavy saucepan , bring 6 cups water and 1 teaspoon salt to a boil
4. Whisk in the grits a few handfuls at a time
5. When you have added all the grits , decrease heat to a very low simmer and cook over low heat for 35-40 minutes , stirring occasionally at first and more frequently toward the end
6. While the grits simmer , start the gravy: fry bacon in a skillet over medium heat until brown but still limp
7. Stir in the onion , green pepper , and garlic
8. Continue cooking until onion and pepper are limp , about 5 minutes
9. Add in the scallions
10. Sprinkle flour over the mixture
11. Continue sauting for 5 minutes longer
12. Stir in the stock and remaining salt
13. Cook for 5 minutes longer
14. Remove from the heat while you finish the grits
15. When the grits are thick and creamy , stir in as much of the butter as you wish , followed by the cheese
16. Add a splash of tabasco sauce and more salt if desired
17. Cover the grits while you finish the gravy
18. Return the gravy to the heat and stir in the shrimp
19. Cook until the shrimp are opaque throughout , about 5 minutes
20. Serve immediately mounding the grits in large shallow bowls or on plates and covering them with shrimp and gravy

title: jammy jobs
steps:
1. Roll out pastry thinly cutting rounds using a 3" cutter and line 16-18 pastry tins
2. Place a little jam in each
3. Cream margarine and sugar ,
4. Fold in beaten egg and flour
5. Place a small spoonful of mixture into each case sealing in the jam
6. Bake in a moderatly hot oven 200c 400f gas 6 for 15-20 minutes

title: easy  better than boiled  corn on the cob
steps:
1. Leave corn in the husks
2. Wrap each ear in a piece of plastic wrap
3. As many as you need
4. Microwave on high for 4 minutes per ear
5. Carefully unwrap corn and peel the husk off
6. The silk should just come right out
7. Enjoy with butter and salt if you wish

title: amy s enchilada sauce
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in sauce pan
2. Heat until thickened
3. Can be doubled easily
4. Freezes nicely

title: amarula ice cream
steps:
1. Cut pods in half lengthways and scrape out seeds
2. Mix egg yolk with sugar until fluffy and white
3. Heat milk , cream , liqueur and vanilla seeds
4. Do not boil !
5. Using a fine mesh strainer remove the vanilla seeds from the mixture
6. Add the milk mixture into the egg and sugar bit by bit stirring constantly
7. Place over a double boiler stirring until you have a custard consistency
8. Never let it boil
9. Process through your ice cream machine until set
10. If you do not have an ice cream machine , allow to set in the freezer for 8 hours
11. Beat into a smooth texture when icicles form in the setting process

title: seco de carne
steps:
1. Cut the beef into hunks and season with salt , pepper , cumin powder , and garlic paste
2. Heat a little vegetable oil in a stainless steel soup pot and pan fry the meat
3. When the meat is seared , add the chopped onion , aj panca , and aj amarillo
4. Stir until onion becomes translucent
5. Rinse the cilantro in water and cut off the bottom few inches from the stems
6. Chop by hand and transfer to blender
7. Add about 1 / 2 to 1 cup water to the blender and reduce the fresh chopped cilantro to liquid
8. Add liquid cilantro to soup pot , stir , lower heat and cover with lid
9. The meat will become tender , cooking in the liquid for at least 20 minutes
10. Add frozen peas , stir and cook covered another 10 minutes
11. Serve with white rice

title: game hens with cardamom and oregano
steps:
1. Pound the cardamom pods to loosen the husks
2. Use a mortar and pestle to pound the seeds , releasing their flavor
3. Add the garlic , salt , and oregano
4. And continue to pound until the ingredients are well mixed
5. Add 3 tablespoons of olive oil , and continue to crush until you have a smooth paste
6. Rub 3 / 4 of the paste over the hens , making sure you cover all of their surfaces
7. Mix the remaining paste with the remaining olive oil , and pour over the birds , reserving a little bit to baste with while grilling
8. Cover and marinate for at least four and up to eight hours , turning occasionally
9. Preheat a grill to high
10. Season the birds with plenty of pepper , then place on the grill and sear being careful of flare-ups , until the skin is golden
11. Move the birds to indirect heat , and grill until completely cooked , basting with the reserved marinate during the last few minutes of cooking

title: macadamia and wattleseed shortbread
steps:
1. Beat the butter until it resembles whipped cream
2. Gradually add the sugar and beat well between each addition
3. Mix the flour , macadamia nut meal and wattleseed together
4. Add to the butter mixture and mix well until you have a smooth dough
5. Divide mixture in two and knead for about 5-10minutes until the dough is very smooth
6. Roll out into a slab on a greased tray or on baking paper or alternately use a cookie cutter
7. Shortbread should be about 1 cm thick when rolled
8. Prick with a fork to allow the air to flow through and make the shortbread crisp
9. Dust with a little caster sugar
10. Bake in a slow oven 150c for about 40minutes

title: macaroni and 4 cheeses
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f
2. Coat a 9 by 13-inch baking pan with cooking spray
3. Bring a large pot of water to a boil
4. Add the macaroni and cook until tender but firm , about 5 to 8 minutes
5. Drain and transfer to a large bowl
6. Meanwhile , place the frozen squash and milk into a large saucepan and cook over a low heat , stirring occasionally and breaking up the squash with a spoon until defrosted
7. Turn the heat up to medium and cook until the mixture is almost simmering , stirring occasionally
8. Remove the pan from heat and stir in the cheddar , jack cheese , ricotta cheese , salt , mustard and cayenne pepper
9. Pour cheese mixture over the macaroni and stir to combine
10. Transfer the macaroni and cheese to the baking dish
11. Combine bread crumbs , parmesan and oil in a small bowl
12. Sprinkle over the top of the macaroni and cheese
13. Bake for 20 minutes
14. Then broil for 3 minutes so the top is crisp and nicely browned

title: mary s skillet cornbread
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl
2. Stir corn meal , flour , soda , salt sugar into pea size shapes
3. In a 450 degree oven in a heavy skillet heat butter till melted and sizzling but not brown
4. Meanwhile add egg and buttermilk to dry ingredients beat until completely combined
5. Stir in butter and pour into hot skillet until golden brown and bake for 20-25 minute

title: three layer mexican dip
steps:
1. Heat oven to to 200c
2. In an ovenproof dish layer the salsa first , sour cream and then top with the cheese
3. Bake for 10 mins until cheese is gooey

title: wheat loaf  no  meat meatloaf
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Mix together the nuts , wheat germ and cheese
3. Add remaining ingredients and mix well
4. Turn all of the mixture into a well oiled loaf pan
5. Bake for 45 minutes
6. I glaze this with ketchup about the last 5 minutes of baking
7. I also let this sit in the loaf pan for 5-10 minutes to firm up a little before removing
8. Serve like "meat loaf" with your favorite sides !

title: french quarter shrimp creole
steps:
1. Melt 2 tablespoons butter in medium skillet
2. Blend in 2 tablespoons flour
3. Add onion , celery , bell pepper and garlic
4. Cook and stir over medium-high heat 5 minutes or until vegetables are tender and flour mixture is lightly golden
5. Stir in tomatoes and hot sauce
6. Heat to boiling
7. Reduce heat to medium-low
8. Cook , uncovered , 5 minutes or until slightly thickened
9. Stir occasionally
10. Add shrimp
11. Cook 5 minutes or just until shrimp are pink
12. Serve over rice
13. Garnish with chopped parsley , if desired

title: chiles rellenos sandwiches
steps:
1. Mash chilies with a fork and spread on 3 slices of bread
2. Top with cheese and remaining bread
3. In a shallow bowl , beat eggs and milk
4. Dip the sandwiches in milk mixture
5. Melt 2 tbsp butter in a large skillet
6. Cook sandwiches until golden brown on both sides and cheese is melted adding additional butter if necessary

title: caramel coriander chicken
steps:
1. Place the turmeric , 2 crushed garlic cloves , the ginger , soy , rice wine , egg yolks , white pepper in a large bowl and mix together well
2. Add chicken toss to coat
3. Cover with plastic and refrigerate overnight
4. Pour away excess liquid from the chicken , add flour and toss to mix well
5. Heat wok until very hot
6. Add 1 tablespoon of oil and swirl to coat
7. Add 1 / 3rd or 1 / 4th chicken and stir fry for 4 minutes , or until golden brown
8. Remove from wok and keep warm
9. Repeat until all the chicken is golden brown
10. Add oil as necessary
11. Reduce heat to medium
12. Add remaining oil , brown sugar , and garlic
13. Mix together and leave for 1-2 minutes for the sugar to caramelize , and liquefy
14. Return chicken from wok and add coriander and vinegar
15. Stir gently for 2 minutes , and put the lid on for 2-3 minutes
16. Enjoy !
17. Variation: use twice the sauce and don't drain as much

title: orange breakfast couscous
steps:
1. Combine all of the ingredients in a 1-qt
2. Microwaveablecasserole dish
3. Cover and microwave on high until liquid is absorbed and the couscous is tender , 5 to 6 minutes
4. Let stand , covered , for 1 minute more

title: sweet potato hash browns with bacon and onions
steps:
1. In a large pot , place the peeled sweet potatoes and fill with water to cover
2. Bring to a boil and cook until easily pierced though with a skewer , about 15-20 minutes
3. Remove from the heat , drain , and re-cover with cold water
4. Allow to cool to room temperature , then cut into 1 / 2-inch chunks
5. In a large pan over medium heat , saut the bacon pieces until they begin to crisp , then add the onion and cook together until the onion is golden , about 7 minutes
6. Add garlic and saut for 3 minutes more , then remove mixture from pan and set aside
7. Remove most of the bacon drippings from the pan , but do not wipe it out
8. Return pan to the burner over medium-high heat and add the peanut oil , heating until it is very hot but not smoking
9. Add the sweet potato to the oil and fry until golden brown , about 7 to 8 minutes , turning occasionally to brown all the sides
10. Remove pan from the heat , add the bacon / onion mixture , season with salt and pepper to taste , and sprinkle the basil and parmesan on top

title: salad dressing for teenage boys  and their families
steps:
1. Mix everything together
2. Adjust seasoning to taste

title: nif s breakfast to go  sandwich  oamc
steps:
1. There are a few different ways that you can cook the eggs
2. I pierced each yolk , gently stirred each of them and used a plastic egg cooker in the microwave
3. Or you can lightly scramble each egg in a cup sprayed with cooking spray
4. Or you can lightly scramble each egg in a silicon muffin tin and bake them
5. Or you can lightly scramble each egg and cook in a tiny frying pan
6. It's up to you how to cook them ! you basically want them to end up being cooked through and slightly smaller than the size of the english muffin
7. While eggs are cooking , open each english muffin and lay them out
8. When the eggs are done , place each egg on the bottom half of the muffin
9. Add bacon to each muffin and top with cheese
10. Wrap each breakfast sandwich in plastic wrap
11. I placed the sandwiches in a large resealable bag and put them in the freezer
12. When cooking , placed wrapped sandwich in the microwave
13. Microwave on high for 30 to 45 seconds
14. Unwrap , turn over and cook on high for another 30 to 45 seconds
15. The cooking time varies on how frozen the sandwich is and the microwave

title: cake decorating icing
steps:
1. Cream butter and shortening , and add vanilla
2. Gradually add powdered sugar
3. Add milk by the tbsp until icing is desired consistency
4. Color with food coloring , or icing dye

title: ridiculously simple cinnamon biscuits
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit
2. Spray baking pan with cooking spray
3. I like to use a glass pie plate
4. It doesn't get as sticky as a metal pan
5. Mix together the sugar and cinnamon in a small bowl
6. Spread margarine on both sides of each biscuit
7. Dip each biscuit in the cinnamon sugar mixture
8. Press biscuit down lightly to get plenty on it
9. Place biscuits in the pan
10. Sprinkle any additional cinnamon sugar on the top
11. Bake as directed on biscuit can
12. Don't overcook ! i cook mine for 8 minutes exactly and they come out perfect !

title: iranian barley soup
steps:
1. Put everything into a pot and then bring to a gentle boil
2. Simmer for 1 1 / 4 hours , stirring occasionally
3. Variations: fry the onions in the oil before putting them in the pot
4. Add 1 cup of cooked chick peas or red kidney beans a few min before serving

title: custard pudding
steps:
1. Mix together the sugar and cornstarch , then add the eggs
2. Beat until the mixture is well combined and pale colored
3. In a large saucepan , bring the milk to a boil over miedium-high heat
4. Stir frequently to keep it from sticking
5. Add a little of the hot milk to the egg mixture , and stir until combined
6. Then pour the egg mixture into the milk
7. Cook the mixture until it reaches desired thickness , stirring constantly
8. Stir in the vanilla
9. Remove from heat , and place plastic wrap on the surface of the pudding instead of just around the pot
10. This will prevent a skin from forming while it cools

title: old fashioned peanut butter chocolate chip cookies
steps:
1. Combine dry ingredients
2. Beat butter , peanut butter , sugar , brown sugar and vanilla until creamy
3. Beat in egg
4. Gradually beat in flour mixture
5. Stir in milk chocolate chips
6. Refrigerate covered about 1 hour
7. Drop by rounded tbsps
8. Onto ungreased baking sheets
9. Press down slightly with bottom of glass
10. Bake at 375 degrees for 8-10 minutes
11. Cool on baking sheets for 4 minutes
12. Remove to wire racks to cool completely

title: irish apple potato mash
steps:
1. Cook potatoes in salted , boiling water until tender
2. Drain well
3. Meanwhile place apples in a pot with 1 / 3 cup of water and the sugar
4. Cook at a simmer until soft
5. Mash the cooked , drained potatoes thoroughly
6. Mash in the cooked apples , salt , pepper and butter

title: boiled bacon with parsley sauce  fresh ham
steps:
1. Place the ham in a large pot or dutch oven and cover with cold water
2. Bring to a boil over medium high heat
3. Remove ham and drain water
4. Return ham to pot along with onions , carrots , celery , bay leaf and peppercorns
5. Cover with cold water and bring to a boil over medium high heat
6. Skim surface with a slotted spoon , cover , reduce heat , and cook 1 hour and 20 minutes
7. Meanwhile , make the parsley sauce by whisking the butter , flour , and milk in a saucepan , over medium heat , until thickened and smooth , about 1 to 2 minutes
8. Season with salt and pepper and add parsley
9. Once the meat is done , remove the rind and excess fat
10. Slice
11. Serve the sliced meat with the parsley sauce

title: almond triangles   trigona
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Combine almonds , sugar , water , rose water or vanilla extract , and lemon juice in saucepan
3. Cook over low heat , stirring constantly , until mixture becomes thick and pasty
4. Cut phyllo sheets into thirds
5. Cover two-thirds with plastic wrap so it doesnt dry out
6. Lay strip in vertical position , brush with some melted butter , at bottom of strip add 1 teaspoon filling , bring the left side over so that you have a triangle , but keeping on going by bringing the right bottom
7. Brush triangles with butter and place on an ungreased baking sheet , seam side down
8. Bake for 30 minutes , or until golden not brown or they are over baked
9. Remove from sheet to cool
10. When slightly cool , sprinkle with confectioners' sugar
11. When ready to use , place unthawed in a preheated 350 oven
12. Bake for 45 minutes , or until golden

title: delicious apple squares
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 farenheit
2. Sift flour , baking powder , salt and cinnamon into a bowl
3. Melt butter in a medium size sauce pan over moderate heat
4. Remove from heat
5. Beat in sugars , egg and vanilla with a wooden spoon until smooth
6. Stir in flour mixture , apple and walnuts until thoroughly combined
7. Spread into a greased 8 x 8 x 2 inch pan
8. Sprinkle on the teaspoon of cinnamon and the teaspoon of white sugar
9. Put in the oven for approximately 30 minutes
10. While the apple square is in the oven mix the brown sugar , margarine and the half and half in a small pot over low heat
11. When it is completely melted and mixed together , pour onto the square and let it completely cool
12. Cut in to squares and store in an air tight container

title: apple bread pudding with maple rum sauce
steps:
1. In large bowl , combine bread cubes , apples and raisins
2. Place in greased 9-inch square baking pan
3. Whisk together eggs
4. Stir in eagle brand , hot water , butter and maple extract
5. Pour over bread cube mixture , completely moistening bread
6. Bake in preheated 350f oven for 45-50 minutes or until knife inserted in centre comes out clean
7. Remove from oven and cool slightly
8. Serve warm with maple rum sauce
9. Maple rum sauce - over medium heat , melt together butter , whipping cream and brown sugar until mixture comes to a boil
10. Boil 2-3 minutes
11. Remove from heat
12. Stir in rum and maple extract
13. Serve warm over apple bread pudding
14. Makes about 1 cup

title: german chocolate cheese pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300 degrees
2. Butter or grease a pie plate
3. Mix crushed corn flakes , 1 / 4 cup brown sugar and melted butter
4. Press into plate
5. Bake 10 minutes
6. Cool
7. For filling , heat water and chocolate over low heat until melted
8. Stir constantly
9. Let cool for 10 minutes
10. Mix in large bowl the cream cheese and brown sugar
11. Add vanilla and salt
12. Slowly add chocolate into cheese mixture
13. Mix to incorporate , by hand or with mixer
14. Refrigerate for 1 hour until very thick
15. Whip cream into stiff peaks
16. Fold whipped cream into chocolate mixture and pour into crust
17. Freeze for 4 hours or overnight
18. Can be doubled if you use a 9 x 13 inch dish

title: garlic tapenade   from enon valley garlic
steps:
1. Chop olives in food processor to desired consistency
2. Using a mortar and pestle , mash anchovies and garlic into a paste
3. Add all ingredients to chopped olives and add olive oil till desired consistency is reached
4. Refrigerate at least 1 hour to meld flavors and serve at room temperature
5. This recipe is greatly enhanced by using gourmet garlics such as korean red , metechi , and other hard stem varieties

title: purple cabbage   pecan salad
steps:
1. Mix the dressing separately
2. You can make the dressing in advance
3. Just shake well and pour over the cabbage , pecans , and scallions
4. Mix well to coat and serve immediately or else the pecans will start to soften

title: stuffed tilapia with crab meat
steps:
1. Chop the onion into fine pieces
2. Mince the celery into fine pieces
3. Saute the onion and celery with butter in a frying pan until the vegetables are tender
4. Add parsley to the frying pan
5. Remove the frying pan from the heat and stir in bread crumbs and crab meat , together with lemon juice and cayenne pepper
6. Grease a 9x13 inch oven pan
7. Spread the crab meat mixture over the tilapia fillets and roll them up
8. Place the stuffed tilapia in the greased dish , seam side down
9. Sprinkle melted butter and paprika powder over the stuffed tilapia
10. Place the stuffed tilapia in the oven and bake the tilapia rolls at 400f
11. The baked tilapia is finished when it is easy to flake the fish with a fork , usually after 20-25 minutes

title: super tasty white sauce
steps:
1. Place the butter in a preheated suacepan and melt the butter down
2. Once the butter is melted down add the plain flour
3. Stir well and cook the mixture of butter and plain flour which should go a bit lumpy and dry at this stage
4. Very important that you cook this well
5. Remove from heat and slowly , very slowly add the milk and stir in
6. The sauce should now be getting smooth
7. If it is lumpy you have been adding the milk to fast
8. Keep adding the milk until the desired thickness is achieved
9. Add the paprika for a bit of extra kick
10. Any other herbs or things like lemons can be added for a bit of extra taste
11. This sauce is used in my fish and white sauce and my tuna mornay recipes as well so look for them

title: chicken with blue cheese
steps:
1. Season the ckicken with salt and pepper
2. Add the olive oil and marinate chicken for 30 minutes
3. Grill or broil the chicken until done
4. In a small saucepan heat the cream and add a little salt
5. Add the blue cheese crumbled and stir until it melts
6. At last add the brandy and the dill
7. Stir until the sauce thickened
8. Serve the chicken with the sauce on the top

title: praline brookies
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f
2. Spray 9 x 13-inch pan with cooking spray
3. Make brownie mix as directed on box , using oil , water and eggs
4. Spread batter evenly in pan
5. Bake for 25 minutes
6. In a 2-quart saucepan , heat butter , milk , granulated sugar , brown sugar , pecans and vanilla to boiling , stirring constantly
7. Reduce heat to med-low
8. Simmer 3 minutes , stirring constantly
9. Remove from heat
10. Set aside , until brownies are baked
11. Immediately pour praline mixture evenly over partially baked brownies
12. Cut cookie dough crosswise into 4 equal pieces
13. Cut each piece into 4 slices
14. Carefully place slices in 3 rows of 5 slices each , using last slice to fill in spaces (spaces between cookie dough pieces will spread during baking to cover top
15. Bake 23-28 minutes longer or until cookie dough is deep golden brown
16. Cool 2 hours

title: swiss carrot cake
steps:
1. Grease and flour a 9 inch square cake pan
2. Preheat oven to about 180 degrees celsius
3. Beat the egg yolks into the sugar thoroughly
4. Add lemon juice and the zest , the carrots , almonds , flour , raisins and baking powder
5. Mix well
6. Beat egg whites until stiff and fold into the cake mixture with a large spoon
7. Pour the batter into the pan
8. Bake until the cake tests clean and the top has a nice golden colour
9. In a fan oven this only took me about 20 minutes but the original recipe says to bake for 45 minutes

title: chicken a  la can can
steps:
1. Combine soups , water , and chicken in a stovetop pot
2. Add minute rice , right from the box
3. Stir to mix
4. Bring quickly to a boil
5. Cover and reduce heat
6. Simmer 7 minutes

title: blazing venison  or beef  steaks
steps:
1. In a small skillet , heat oil and cook the habeneros until softened
2. Add worcestershire sauce , garlic and salt , heating until sizzling
3. Remove from heat and add wine , dry mustard and cinnamon , stirring until blended
4. Place the steaks and portabella mushroom in a ziplock bag , or large baking dish
5. Pour the marinade over the meat and mushrooms and refrigerate at least 1 hour or overnight
6. Preheat grill to medium high heat
7. Remove meat and mushrooms from marinade
8. Discard marinade
9. Grill portabellas 15 minutes
10. Grill the venision steaks 6-7 minutes , turning once , until done to your liking

title: jollof rice  rice w  chicken  ham   beef
steps:
1. Dry the chicken and beef with paper towels and sprinkle with salt and pepper
2. In a large heavy bottomed pan over moderate heat , heat 3 tbsp of the oil until a drop of water sizzles when dripped into it
3. Brown the chicken in the oil a few pieces at a time until golden brown , turning as needed
4. When done transfer to a plate and set aside
5. Add the last 3 tbsp of oil to the pan and brown the beef in it , turning them frequently until they are well browned
6. Add them to the chicken and set aside
7. Pour off all but a thin film of fat from the pan and add the onions
8. Stirring up the browned bits from the meat , stir and cook the onions until soft and lightly browned
9. Do not burn as it will add an acrid taste to the finished dish
10. Add the tomatoes , tomato paste , garlic , chili pepper , ginger and bay leaf
11. Raise the heat to high and still stirring cook for five minutes or until most of the liquid has evaporated and the mixture is thick enough to hold its shape almost solidly in a spoon
12. Stir in the broth and water and return the beef to the pan
13. Add the ham and turn the meats in the sauce until the pieces are evenly coated
14. Bring to a boil again then reduce the heat to low and simmer partially covered for 30 minutes
15. Add the chicken and any liquids around it , baste it with the sauce and let it simmer for ten minutes longer
16. Then gently stir in the rice
17. Return the mixture to a simmer , cover partially and cook for 20 to 30 minutes or until the beef is tender and almost all the liquid in the pan has been absorbed by the rice
18. Remove the pan from the heat , cover tightly and let rest for 15 minutes before serving
19. Jollof rice is traditionally served with hot boiled cabbage or spinach and slices of hard boiled egg

title: baked red snapper in dill sauce
steps:
1. Combine sauce ingredients in small bowl:
2. Mayonnaise , garlic , lemon juice , minced green onion , dried dill , black pepper
3. Set aside
4. Preheat oven to 400f
5. Place lemon slices in center of large sheet of foil
6. Top with sliced green onions and dill
7. Put fish fillet on top
8. Season with salt and pepper
9. Fold foil to make a packet
10. Bake about 20 minutes or until the fish is opaque
11. Spread some sauce in the middle of 2 plates
12. Top with the fish , onions and lemon
13. Garnish with fresh dill sprigs
14. Substituted sour cream
15. I think i like that better
16. 07 / 23 / 05

title: chicken seasoning  spice mix
steps: 1. Shake all together in a salt shaker until well blended

title: bubublueberry upside down cake
steps:
1. Cover the bottom of a 13"x9" baking dish with butter
2. Sprinkle with sugar and blueberries
3. Prepare the cake batter as directed on package
4. Spread over blueberries
5. Bake at 350f
6. For 40-45 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near center comes out clean
7. Cool for 10 minutes on wire rack
8. Invert onto a serving platter
9. Serve warm with whipped cream or whipped topping
10. Enjoy !
11. If using frozen blueberries , do not thaw !

title: the easiest and best chicken tortilla soup
steps:
1. Wash chicken
2. Place chicken and chicken stock into a 6 or 8 quart stock pot
3. Cover
4. Bring to a boil over high heat
5. Reduce heat and simmer for 25 to 30 minutes , until chicken is done
6. Remove chicken from pot and place on a cutting board
7. Add pico de gallo salsa , corn , black beans and tortilla chips to the stock pot
8. Dice chicken and add back into soup
9. Stir well
10. Bring to a boil and simmer , covered , for 10 to 15 minutes
11. Season to taste with salt & pepper , cumin and chili powder
12. Serve while hot
13. Also good reheated the next day
14. Garnish with a squeeze of fresh lime and your favorite toppings

title: chicken in the orchard
steps:
1. Wash chicken
2. Dry on paper towels
3. Trim fat with scissors , if necessary
4. Pare , core , and quarter apples
5. In a large , heavy skillet , heat 2 tablespoons butter
6. Add shallot and basil
7. Cook shallot until slightly transparent
8. Add half of chicken breasts
9. Saut over med
10. Heat until golden-about 15 minutes
11. Remove chicken from skillet
12. Add the remaining tablespoons butter and remaining chicken
13. Saut until golden--15 minute
14. Return all chicken to skillet
15. Add apple
16. Cook gently , uncovered and stirring occasionally , 5 minute add 1 / 4 cup of wine , cook several min
17. Add another 1 / 4 cup wine
18. Cook several minute longer
19. Add remaining wine , the salt , pepper , and nutmeg
20. Continue cooking until apple is tender
21. Meanwhile , in small bowl , combine cream , flour , cognac , and egg yolks
22. Mix well
23. Pour over chicken
24. Cook gently 5 more min
25. , or until sauce is slightly thickened
26. Serve at once

title: shrimp curry rice
steps:
1. Start cooking the rice:
2. Add rice and water to a pot
3. In a separate pot:
4. Add shrimp leeks and butter , stir at high heat for 3 minutes
5. Turn stove to low heat
6. Add curry powder , coriander and garlic salt
7. Stir well
8. Allow to simmer covered for 5 minute
9. Add mayo
10. Stir well
11. The mixture should be a pale yellow color
12. At this point the rice should be about half done and there should be a fair amount of water in the pot
13. Add rice and it's water to the shrimp mixture
14. Stir well
15. Cover and allow the rice to cook for a further 6 minutes or until the water has been absorbed but before the rice burns at the base of the pan

title: onion parmesan gratin
steps:
1. Slice the onions in half lenghwise , then cut crosswise into thin slices
2. In a large skillet melt butter , then add in onions , thyme , cloves , pepper and salt
3. Cover with lid and saute until the onions are very soft adjust the salt to taste
4. Transfer the onions to a buttered gratin dish or small casserole dish and smooth it out with a spoon
5. At this point you can cover and let sit at room temperature to broil later
6. Preheat the broiler
7. In a small bowl whisk together egg yolks and whipping cream , the stir in parmesan cheese
8. Pour the mixture over the onions in the baking dish
9. Place under the broiler
10. Broil until the top is golden
11. Serve immediately

title: seafood stuffed eggplant  aubergine
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425f
2. Score cut side of each eggplant half in a crisscross pattern
3. Lightly coat cut sides of eggplant halves with cooking spray
4. Place eggplant halves , cut sides down , on a baking sheet
5. Bake for 10 minutes
6. Turn eggplant halves over
7. Bake an additional 10 minutes or until tender
8. Remove from oven
9. Cool 10 minutes
10. Remove pulp from eggplant , leaving a shell
11. Place eggplant shells on baking sheet coated with cooking spray
12. Chop pulp
13. Set aside
14. Reduce oven temperature to 350f
15. Heat olive oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
16. Add ham , 1 / 2 cup onion , bell pepper , and garlic
17. Saut 5 minutes
18. Add reserved eggplant pulp and beer
19. Cook 10 minutes or until most of liquid evaporates , stirring occasionally
20. Stir in shrimp
21. Cook 1 minute
22. Remove from heat
23. Place bread in a food processor
24. Process until coarse crumbs form
25. Add breadcrumbs , 3 tablespoons cheese , green onions , basil , tarragon , rind , salt , and black pepper to eggplant mixture
26. Stir gently to combine
27. Mound about 1 / 2 cup shrimp mixture into each eggplant shell
28. Sprinkle each with 1 1 / 2 teaspoons cheese
29. Bake for 15 minutes or until thoroughly heated and shrimp are done

title: fire escape flank steak
steps:
1. Whisk oil , lime juice , garlic , cumin , chili powder , jalapenos , and cilantro together in a small bowl
2. Pace the meat in a zip lock bag pour the marinade over the meat cover and refrigerate for at least one hour but i do it over night
3. Light the grill
4. Generously sprinkle both sides of the steak with salt to taste
5. Scrape the hot grill surface clean
6. Grill the steak , turning once , until done the way you like it , 8 to 10 minutes for medium rare
7. Transfer steak to platter and carve , cutting meat into thin slices across the grain

title: cranberry autumn chicken
steps:
1. In a skillet coated with cooking spray , brown chicken on both sides
2. Place browned chicken in a 2 quart baking dish , coated with nonstick cooking spray
3. Combine the remaining ingredients: pour over chicken
4. Cover and bake in a 350 degree oven for 15 minutes then uncover and cook for 15 more minutes or until a meat thermometer reads 180 degrees

title: cool cucumber and black bean summer salad
steps: 1. Make sure everything is drained well , mix everything in a bowl and serve ! great alone , as a salsa for chips , or on a taco salad !

title: oatmeal cranberry applesauce muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. In a large bowl combine flour , oats , baking powder , baking soda , salt and cinnamon
3. In a medium bowl combine applesauce , buttermilk , sugar , oil and egg
4. Make a well in dry ingredients and add applesauce mixture and dried cranberries
5. Stir until just moist
6. Fill muffin cups 2 / 3 full , adding a tsp of cranberry sauce in the middle of each cup
7. Bake for 16-18 minutes

title: krafts baked crab rangoon
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Mix crab meat , neufchatel cheese , onions and mayo
3. Spray 12 medium muffin cups with cooking spray
4. Gently place 1 won ton wrapper in each cup , allowing edges of wrappers to extend above sides of cups
5. Fill evenly with crab meat mixture
6. Bake 18 to 20 minute or until edges are golden brown and filling is heated through
7. Serve warm
8. Garnish with chopped green onions , if desired

title: spanish chicken stew
steps:
1. Place olive oil , diced potatoes , carrots , tomatoes and garlic in deep pan
2. Add cubed chicken , turmeric and salt
3. Mix all ingredients
4. Cook for about 5 min on high heat
5. Add white wine , cook until wine is heated through
6. Cover the pan and turn heat to medium low
7. Cook for about 20-25 minutes until chicken is cooked to its ideal temperature
8. Sprinkle with fresh parsley
9. Enjoy !

title: spinach parmesan mini loaves  or muffins
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400f
2. Spray bottoms of 3 mini loaf pans
3. In large bowl , whisk together flour , cheese , sugar , baking powder , basil , onion powder , salt and pepper
4. In medium-size bowl , whisk egg , milk and oil until blended
5. Stir in spinach
6. Make a well in the flour mixture
7. Pour in egg mixture
8. Fold or stir gently until dry ingredients are just moistened
9. Spoon 1 cup batter into each mini loaf pan
10. If desired , sprinkle 1 teaspoon grated parmesan over each loaf
11. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
12. Remove pans to wire rack and cool for 5 minutes
13. Remove bread from pans
14. Cool on rack
15. For 12 standard muffins , spoon 1 / 4 cup batter into each cup
16. Bake for 20 minutes
17. For 36 mini muffins , prepare 3 mini muffin pans
18. Spoon 1 slighty rounded tablespoon batter into each cup
19. Bake for 15 minutes

title: kelly s blueberry banana bread
steps:
1. In large bowl , mix all ingredients except blueberries for about 30 seconds
2. Fold in frozen berries
3. Pour into 2 greased 8 1 / 2x4 1 / 2x2 1 / 2 loaf pans that have been greased on the bottoms only
4. Bake in 350 oven for 55-60 minutes , til toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
5. Cool slightly , loosen sides with knife from sides of pan , turn out onto rack to cool
6. When cool , wrap tightly with plastic wrap , keep refrigerated
7. Best the next day !
8. Ialways bake blueberries frozen in breads and muffins so they hold up perfectly , and you don't end up with a hollow blue hole , lol

title: homemade pudding with gourmet variations
steps:
1. Place a fine mesh sieve over a medium bowl and set aside
2. First , whisk together sugar , corn starch , and salt in a saucepan
3. Add milk gradually making sure to dissolve cornstarch
4. Add egg yolks and mix to combine
5. Turn on the element to medium heat and place saucepan on the element
6. Stirring constantly until the first large bubble forms and sputters , and then reduce heat to low
7. Continue to stir constantly for one minute and then remove from heat
8. Immediately pour the mixture through the sieve in the bowl to remove any lumps
9. Stir in butter and vanilla into the hot pudding
10. Place a layer of saran wrap over the surface of the pudding-this will prevent a skin from forming
11. Chill for 3 hours or for 3 days
12. Before serving whisk until smooth
13. For chocolate pudding: add cocoa powder with the sugar , corn starch , and salt and then proceed as directed
14. For chai cinnamon pudding: brew the two tea bags in 3 tbsp boiling water , set aside until cool
15. Squeeze out the teabags and reserve liquid
16. Mix the tea into the pudding after step 8 and sprinkle cinnamon on top before serving
17. For mocha chip pudding: prepare pudding with chocolate variation
18. Then dissolve the espresso powder into 2 tbsp boiling water and cool
19. Mix the cooled espresso into the pudding after step 8 and sprinkle chocolate chips on top before serving
20. For rum raisin pudding: combine 1 / 4 cup raisins and 1 / 3 cup rum in a small pot and bring to a boil
21. Remove from element and let cool completely
22. Remove raisins from rum and set aside
23. Mix the rum into the pudding after step 8 and sprinkle the raisins on top before serving

title: spotted dog cakelike raisin bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450f / 230c / gas mark 6
2. Do not start until oven is ready
3. Then ignore the doorbell , telephone and cell phone until your bread is in the oven
4. For best results , measure everything before you begin
5. Sieve the flour , bread soda , salt and about 2 teaspoons of sugar into a large bowl and mix in the fruit
6. Whisk about 1 1 / 3 cup of the milk together with the egg
7. Make a well in the center of the flour and pour in almost all of the milk and egg mixture
8. Quickly and with a light touch , use your fingers to quickly and lightly bring the flour in from the edges and mix with the milk , until all the ingredients come together into a dough
9. Use your hands , not a spoon or mixer
10. Work quickly and lightly
11. The dough should be soft rather than wet or sticky
12. If it is too dry add a little more of the milk and egg mix or the of the remaining buttermilk
13. Once it has come together , do not knead , just place it on a floured wooden board , pick up a handful of flour and rub it into the palms of your hands so that they are perfectly dry , and and then shape the dough into a round about 2 inches thick
14. Brush the top of the dough with some of the remaining milk and sprinkle the rest of the sugar over it
15. Cut a deep cross on the top of the dough
16. Put the bread into the oven immediately
17. After 5 minutes turn the oven down to 400f
18. The initial high temperature gives the bread a nice brown crust
19. After another 25 minutes take the bread out and knock on the base
20. If it sounds hollow it is done , if not return it to the oven for about 5 minutes and then check again
21. Eat the day of baking or toast it the next day

title: mini meat loaves
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Combine ketchup and mustard , stirring well with a whisk
3. Reserve 2 1 / 2 tablespoons ketchup mixture
4. Combine remaining ketchup mixture , beef , and next 6 ingredients in a large bowl , stirring to combine
5. Divide beef mixture into 4 equal portions
6. Shape each portion into a 4 x 2 1 / 2-inch loaf and place loaves on a jelly roll pan coated with cooking spray
7. Spread about 2 teaspoons reserved ketchup mixture evenly over each loaf
8. Bake at 400 degrees for 25 minutes or until done

title: peanut  orange  and carrot salad
steps:
1. In a medium microwave-able bowl , microwave the peanut butter for about 10 seconds to soften
2. Whisk in the tamari , orange juice and ginger
3. Stir in a splash of hot water if the sauce begins to tighten up
4. Stir the carrots into the dressing and toss
5. Scatter the scallions and peanuts on the salad
6. Season to taste with salt and pepper
7. Best if allowed to chill in the refrigerator for a bit

title: old world guinness cake
steps:
1. Move oven rack to middle position and preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Lightly brush 6 cup bundt pan or 8"x3" ovenproof ring mold with half the melted butter and chill 2 minutes
3. Butter again with remaining melted butter then chill until pan is needed
4. Bring stout to a boil in a small saucepan and add prunes
5. Remove from heat and let stand until most of the liquid is absorbed
6. Meanwhile , sift together flour , baking soda and salt into a bowl
7. Set aside
8. Melt the chocolate and 1 / 2 cup unsalted butter together in a small heavy saucepan over low heat , stirring constantly
9. Remove from heat and set aside
10. Beat together eggs , brown sugar and vanilla in a large bowl with an electric mixer at high speed until thick , about 2 minutes
11. Add chocolate mixture and beat until just combined
12. Reduce speed to low and add flour mixture , mixing until just combined
13. Stir in prune mixture until combined well
14. Spoon batter into pan and bake until a wooden toothpick inserted into middle of cake comes out clean , about 40-45 minutes
15. Cool cake in mold on a rack 10 minutes , then invert onto rack to cool completely , at least 30 minutes

title: lotsa broccoli cheese soup with real cheese
steps:
1. Gently simmer broccoli in the chicken or vegetable broth until tender
2. Leave broccoli and broth on stove on lowest setting
3. Add shredded carrot to broccoli and broth
4. Mix milk and soup and add to soup
5. Mix cornstarch and water , and add to soup
6. Simmer until thickened
7. Add shredded cheese , simmer just until melted
8. Serve

title: sugared cranberries and sage leaves
steps:
1. Bring water and 1 / 2 cup sugar to a boil in a small heavy saucepan , stirring until sugar has dissolved , then simmer , uncovered , 2 minutes
2. Remove from heat
3. Put remaining 1 / 4 cup sugar in a small bowl
4. Lightly brush cranberries and both sides of sage leaves with sugar syrup , then immediately roll in sugar
5. Transfer to a lightly oiled rack and dry at room temperature , 2 to 3 hours
6. Cooks'

title: shrimp   scallop ziti
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 combine hot water , cream cheese and red peppers in a processor and process until smooth
2. Heat oil in a large skillet
3. Add shrimp , scallops , garlic and salt and cook 2 minutes until almost done
4. Add pepper mixture to pan and cook 2 minutes to combine
5. Spray an 8" baking pan with cooking spray and pour in shrimp mixture
6. Sprinkle with grated provolone
7. Bake 20 minutes until cheese is melted , remove
8. Heat broiler to hi , add dish and broil 2 minutes to brown
9. Let it stand 10 minutes , serve

title: three herb drumsticks  weight watchers
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425f spray large rimmed baking sheet with nonstick spray
2. Place drumsticks on baking sheet
3. Mix lemon juice , garlic , sage , rosemary , thyme , oil , mustard , salt and pepper in small bowl
4. Pour over drumsticks and toss to coat
5. Add tomatoes
6. Roast until drumsticks are cooked through and tomatoes are softened , about 40 minutes , turning drumsticks once halfway through roasting time

title: delicious asparagus roll ups
steps:
1. Set oven to 400f
2. Grease a baking sheet
3. Flatten bread with a rolling pin
4. In a bowl combine the cream cheese with blue cheese , garlic and green onions
5. Spread about 1 tablespoon of the cream cheese mixture on each slice of bread
6. Top with asparagus spear then roll up tightly
7. Place seam side down on a greased baking sheet
8. Brush with butter and sprinkle with parmesan cheese
9. Cut roll-ups in half
10. Bake at 400f for 10-12 minutes or until lightly browned
11. Delicious !

title: shiny kahlua chocolate icing
steps:
1. Dump all ingredients into a medium sauce pan and cook on medium heat
2. Whisk until smooth and all ingredients have combined and melted
3. Drizzle over cooled cake while warm
4. Store leftover in fridge and serve with icecream !
5. Enjoy with someone you love !

title: jamie oliver s roast potatoes  parsnips  and carrots
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400
2. Peel the vegetables and halve any larger ones lengthways
3. Break the garlic bulb into cloves , leaving them unpeeled , and bash them slightly with the palm of your hand
4. Pick the rosemary leaves from the woody stalks
5. Put the potatoes and carrots into a large pan you may need to use two of salted , boiling water on a high heat and bring back to the boil
6. Allow to boil for 5 minutes , then add the parsnips and cook for another 4 minutes
7. Drain in a colander and allow to steam dry
8. Take out the carrots and parsnips and put to one side
9. Fluff up the potatoes in the colander by shaking it around a little its important to chuff them up like this if you want them to have all those lovely crispy bits when theyre cooked
10. Add the olive oil , garlic , and rosemary leaves
11. Put the vegetables into the tray with a good pinch of salt and pepper and stir them around to coat them in the flavours
12. Spread them out evenly into one layer this is important , as you want them to roast , not steam as they will if you have them all on top of each other
13. Cook for approximately 40 minutes or until the vegetables become browned and crispy

title: dried fruit balls
steps:
1. In a food processor , finely chop dates , figs , prunes / apricots and raisins
2. In a medium bowl , mix chopped fruit with nuts and seeds
3. Stir in lemon juice
4. Shape into 1 / 2-1" balls
5. Roll in coconut
6. Dry in your dehydrator at 135 for 4 to 6 hours , or until crisp on the outside

title: tagliatelle with parmesan and courgettes  zucchini
steps:
1. Add the olive oil and garlic into a thick bottomed pan and fry for 30 seconds
2. Add the courgettes and toss for 2 minutes
3. Add the lemon juice , salt pepper and most of the basil
4. Cook for a few minutes
5. Meanwhile cook the tagliatelle in boiling water until al dente
6. Toss with the courgettes in the pan adding most of the parmesan cheese
7. Serve with torn basil and sprinkle with parmesan

title: cool cannoli pudding
steps:
1. Beat the cheese until smooth
2. Stir in the remaining ingredients
3. Spoon into individual dessert dishes or custard cups
4. Refrigerate until ready to serve
5. Top with whole cherries , if desired

title: pecan topped pumpkin bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Lightly spoon flour into dry measuring cups
3. Level with a knife
4. Combine flour and next 6 ingredients in a bowl
5. Place sugar , egg substitute , oil , buttermilk , and eggs in a large bowl
6. Beat with a mixer at high speed until well blended
7. Add 2 / 3 cup water and pumpkin , beating at low speed until blended
8. Add flour mixture to pumpkin mixture , beating at low speed just until combined
9. Spoon batter into 2 loaf pans coated with cooking spray
10. Sprinkle pecans evenly over batter
11. Bake at 350 for 1 hour or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean
12. Cool 10 minutes in pans on a wire rack
13. Remove from pans
14. Cool completely on wire rack

title: lamb and pepper stir fry
steps:
1. In a small bowl mix the soy sauce and honey
2. Heat a large nonstick wok or skillet over high heat
3. Add the oil and lamb
4. Stir fry until the lamb loses its red color , 1-2 minutes
5. With a slotted spoon , transfer to a plate
6. Reduce heat slightly
7. Add the bell peppers
8. Stir fry until slightly softened , about 4 minutes
9. Add scallions , garlic , gingerroot , orange zest , pepper flakes , and soy sauce mixture
10. Stir fry 30 seconds longer
11. Return lamb to wok
12. Add the broth and pepper
13. Stir fry 30 seconds longer
14. Serve , sprinkled with the mint

title: copycat cinnabon rolls with icing
steps:
1. First , make cream cheese frosting: mix all frosting ingredients together until smooth
2. Set aside
3. Next , make rolls
4. In a bowl combine water , yeast and sugar
5. Stir until dissolved
6. Set aside
7. In large bowl , take pudding mix and prepare according to package directions
8. Add margarine , eggs and salt
9. Mix well , then add yeast mixture
10. Blend
11. Gradually add flour
12. Knead until smooth
13. Place in a greased bowl
14. Cover and let rise until doubled
15. Punch down dough and let rise again
16. Next , roll out on floured board to 34 x 21-inch size
17. Take 1 cup soft butter and spread over surface
18. In bowl , mix 2 cups brown sugar and 4 tsp cinnamon
19. Sprinkle over top
20. Roll up very tightly
21. With knife , put a notch every 2 inches
22. Cut with thread or knife
23. Place on lightly greased cookie sheet 2 inches apart
24. Take hand and lightly press down on each roll
25. Cover and let rise until double again
26. Bake in a preheated 350f oven for 15-20 minutes
27. Remove when they start to turn golden
28. Don't overbake
29. Frost warm rolls with cream cheese frosting
30. Makes about 20 very large rolls

title: elaine s brisket
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 450
2. You'll also need a roasting pan with a lid large enough to hold the brisket easily with a little space around it
3. Aluminum foil can be used to cover the pan if necessary
4. Put the meat in the roasting pan , and sear uncovered for 15 minutes
5. While the meat is searing , combine the cranberry sauce , onion soup mix and ketchup in a bowl
6. Mix well
7. Remove the pan from the oven and lower the heat to 350
8. Pour the cranberry sauce mixture over the brisket , then pour enough ginger ale into the pan so it will cover the meat about half way up
9. Bake , covered , for 2 1 / 2 hours , occasionally spooning some of the sauce over the meat if desired
10. Slice the brisket on the diagonal , against the grain
11. You can return the slices to the sauce to reheat , if desired

title: red zinger cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f grease bottom only of 13x9 pan
2. Prepare cake batter by beating cake mix , water , oil and eggs in large bowl on low speed 30 seconds , then on medium speed 2 minutes
3. Stir in the raspberry jello powder
4. Pour into prepared pan
5. Bake aproximately 30 minutes or until golden brown
6. Remove cake from oven and immediately poke holes all over the cake with a fork and then pour the condensed milk all over the top
7. Spread raspberry preserves over that and let the cake cool completely
8. Top with cool whip and then sprinkle with coconut

title: mrs  g s spicy corn chowder
steps:
1. Melt butter in heavy large saucepan over medium heat
2. Add onion , peppers , cumin and cayenne and saute until vegetables are tender , about 8 minutes
3. Add flour and stir for 1 minute
4. Gradually mix in broth , milk and reserve corn liquid
5. Bring mixture to a boil , whisking until smooth
6. Mix in canned corn and creamed corn and stir
7. I always add another cup or so of frozen corn
8. Heat soup until all of corn is heated through
9. Add cilantro and stir
10. Ladle into bowls and garnish with sour cream

title: cantonese corn soup
steps:
1. Combine chicken broth , 1 cup water , 1 / 3 cup rice wine , and the ginger in large saucepan
2. Heat to boiling
3. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered 20 minutes
4. Remove ginger from broth and stir in remaining 3 t
5. Rice wine , the corn and salt
6. Heat to boiling , then reduce heat to low
7. Dissolve cornstarch in remaining 1 / 4 cup water and gradually stir into soup
8. Heat , stirring constantly , until slightly thickened
9. Remove from heat and pour egg whites in thin stream around edge
10. Stir once and add sesame oil
11. Sprinkle ham over soup in bowls

title: sausage  n  chicken casserole
steps:
1. Place potatoes in a greased 13-in
2. X 9-in
3. Baking dish
4. In a small bowl , combine the salt , oregano , paprika and garlic salt
5. Sprinkle half over potatoes
6. Arrange sausage and chicken over the potatoes
7. Drizzle with oil
8. Sprinkle with remaining seasonings
9. Cover and bake at 400 for 55-60 minutes or until chicken juices run clear and potatoes are tender

title: little warm chocolate  caramel cakes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Generously coat six 6-ounce ramekins with softened butter
3. Chill in the freezer for about 10 minutes , and brush with a second coat of butter
4. Pour 3 tablespoons caramel sauce into the bottom of each ramekin
5. Now put 1 tbls
6. Of the chocolate syrup on top of the caramel sauce and transfer to the freezer for 1 hour
7. Whisk the cake flour , cocoa , baking soda , sugar , and salt together in a large bowl and set aside
8. Stir the coffee , oil , vanilla , and vinegar together and whisk into the flour mixture just until smooth
9. Fill each ramekin with 1 / 3 cup of batter
10. Bake at 400 degrees f until the cake is set and a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean , and the caramel has bubbled up the sides , about 20 minutes
11. Enjoy !

title: crock pot salsa chicken
steps:
1. Put chicken , salsa , taco seasoning , and soup in crock pot
2. Cook on low for 6-8 hours
3. Remove from crockpot and break up chicken
4. Stir in sour cream
5. Serve over rice

title: michelle s chicken salad with pecans
steps:
1. Trim excess fat from chicken
2. Sprinkle lightly with garlic salt and lemon pepper
3. Bake in covered dish at 350` for 30-40 minutes , or until juices run clear
4. Chop chicken breasts into -1 cubes
5. Stir in mayonnaise and yogurt , making sure to coat well
6. Make sure there is enough mayonnaise and yogurt to coat the chicken well because it soak into the chicken and be dry later
7. Add remaining ingredients
8. Stir well
9. Refrigerate for one hour , stir again and serve over romaine lettuce on sourdough toast
10. Will stay good in refrigerator for up to 3 days
11. May substitute light or no-fat mayonnaise
12. May substitute garlic powder and potassium salts such as nusalt- a heart healthy alternative

title: oven cooked dry beans
steps:
1. Turn oven to 325 degrees
2. Put beans in a dutch oven or large pan with a well-fitting lid
3. Add salt
4. Add water till it's about 1" over the beans
5. Cover and bake about 75 minutes
6. Stir and check to see if they're tender
7. If done , remove from oven
8. Otherwise cook for 15 minutes and check again
9. Continue the 15 minute intervals until they're done , adding water if they start getting dry
10. Use in your favorite bean recipe

title: gramma s banana bread muffins
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f mix butter into the mashed bananas in a large mixing bowl
2. Mix in the sugar , egg , and vanilla
3. Add baking soda and and mix
4. Add the flour and mix
5. Pour mixture into muffin tin
6. Bake 25 to 35 minutes until golden brown and a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean

title: broccoli   rice stir fry
steps:
1. Place broccoli in a microwave-safe bowl with 1 / 2 c water
2. Cover loosely and microwave 7-10 minutes or until mostly cooked
3. In large skillet or wok , heat both oils
4. Add garlic , ginger , and red pepper
5. Cook about 1 minute , or until fragrant
6. Do not allow garlic to brown
7. Stir in cooked broccoli and stirfry until cooked to desired doneness
8. Stir in cooked rice and stir fry sauce
9. Stir until heated through

title: nannie s snacker crackers
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 250
2. Empty crackers into a large bowl
3. Mix all other ingredients , except seasoned salt , in a small bowl , whisking vigorously
4. Pour liquid mixture over crackers , while stirring crackers gently don't break them up
5. I find it best to pour the mixture in 3 additions , stirring well after each one and turning crackers from bottom of bowl to insure that all are evenly coated
6. Some of the mixture will sink to the bottom of the bowl and that is fine
7. Spread crackers evenly on 2 cookie sheets , trying to make sure there is only one layer
8. Any mix that has sunk to the bottom of the bowl can be scraped out with a spatula and poured over the crackers
9. Place into preheated oven for 30-35 minutes
10. Occasionally stir crackers and turn to insure even browning
11. Taste to make sure they are crisp , then turn oven off
12. Leave in oven until they cool if possible
13. Remove and place crackers in a covered container lined with a paper towel to absorb any excess oil
14. Sprinkle very , very lightly with seasoned salt -- a little goes a long way
15. Will keep longer than they will last if you get my drift
16. Go easy on the salt
17. For some more heat , a few drops of tabasco mixed into the oil would be great

title: kahlua truffles
steps:
1. Melt chocolate in double boiler , then remove from heat and allow to cool to room temperature
2. Add egg yolks , one at a time until well blended
3. Mix in kahlua and return to double boiler for 2-3 minutes , stirring constantly
4. Pour into bowl and beat in butter one tablespoon at a time
5. Continue beating until light and airy
6. Cover and refrigerate overnight
7. Form into 1 inch balls and roll in nuts , cocoa or sprinkles
8. Refrigerate until used
9. Can be frozen

title: electric mixer sweet butter pie crust
steps:
1. Cut the butter into 1 / 2-inch cubes
2. Dump the flour , sugar , and salt into the bowl of a stand mixer fitted with the paddle attachment
3. Mix for a second or two to blend the dry ingredients
4. Add the butter and then , running the mixer on low , work the mixture until it's crumbly and the largest pieces of butter are no bigger than a pea
5. As the mixer turns on low sprinkle in cold water a tablespoon at a time
6. Try to sprinkle it evenly over the flour and butter
7. Continue mixing the dough as you slowly add water
8. The secret is to add just enough water until it just pulls together as a shaggy mass
9. If you add too much water it will cause the pastry to shrink into the pie pan and it won't look very pretty
10. To roll out the dough for a double-crust pie -- cut the dough in half and pat each piece into a thick flattened ball
11. Lightly flour your work surface and tap one of the dough balls down with four or five taps of the rolling pan
12. Begin rolling from the center of your dough outward
13. Stop the pressure 1 / 4 inch from the edge of the dough
14. Lift the dough and turn by a quarter and repeat the rolling until the dough is at least 12 inches in diameter
15. Be sure to re-flour the work surface if your dough is sticking
16. Using a pot lid or a circle of cardboard as a template , trim the dough to form a 12-inch round
17. Fold the dough in half , slide the outspread fingers of both hands under the dough , and gently lift it and transfer it to the pie pan
18. Unfold and ease the dough round into the bottom of the pie pan without stretching it
19. Roll out the other dough ball and cut a second 12-inch round to be used as the top crust
20. The next secret is to freeze the completed shell completely before baking
21. This step also helps to minimize that shrinking pie shell effect
22. Bake as directed for your pie recipe if using for a two crust pie
23. If baking a pie shell for a premade pie filling:
24. Preheat your oven to 350f when the pie crust is sufficiently chilled , line the pie crust with parchment paper , wax paper , or aluminum foil
25. Fill at least two-thirds full with pie weights - dry beans , rice , or stainless-steel pie weights
26. Bake with weights for 20 minutes
27. Remove from oven , cool a few minutes and carefully remove pie weights
28. Poke small holes in the bottom of the pie crust with a fork and return to oven and cook for an additional 10 minutes , until the crust is golden
29. Cool completely before filling
30. You may need to tent the edges of the pie with aluminum foil when you bake your pie , to keep the edges from getting too dried out and burnt

title: chicken a l apricot
steps:
1. Combine the apricot preserves , lime rind , lime juice , and the fresh ginger in a small bowl
2. Bring grill up to medium heat
3. Place the chicken on the grill and brush with half the marmalade mixture
4. Close the lid on the grill and cook for 6 minutes
5. Flip chicken and apply remaining marmalade , recover , and cook for an additional 6 minutes , or until done

title: holiday eggnog cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300
2. Mix flour , baking powder , cinnamon , and 1 / 2 teaspoon nutmeg
3. Mix well with a whisk
4. Set aside for now
5. Cream the sugar and butter until the mixture forms like a grainy paste
6. Add in the eggnog , vanilla extract and egg yolks
7. Beat on medium speed until smooth
8. Add the flour mixture and beat at low speed until combined , but do not over mix
9. Drop rounded teaspoonfuls 1 inch apart onto ungreased baking sheets
10. Lightly sprinkle with nutmeg
11. Bake 23-25 minutes or until bottoms are light brown
12. Let cool completely

title: sauteed mushrooms
steps:
1. Heat oil in pan , add mushrooms and herbs
2. Cook until mushroom are tender , stirring often

title: pan fried cornmeal batter fish
steps:
1. In 9" pie pan stir together all ingredients except cornmeal , fish and oil
2. On waxed paper place cornmeal , dip fish into batter , then coat both sides of fish with cornmeal
3. In 10" skittle heat oil until hot
4. Place 3 or 4 fish fillets in hot oil
5. Cook over med heat until golden brown
6. Turn and continue cooking until golden brown and fish flakes with a fork
7. Repeat with remaining fish , place fried fish on paper towel to drain any excess oil
8. Serve with potatoes or rice

title: go fish snack
steps:
1. Put 1 tablespoon of peanut butter , 2 breadsticks and a few crackers on a large plate for each child
2. Let the kids dip their breadstick in the peanut butter
3. Then use the peanut buttered stick to"fish" for the fish-shaped crackers on their plates

title: butterscotch cake with marshmallows
steps:
1. Sift the flour
2. Measure and sift again with the baking powder and salt
3. Mix the shortening , sugar , and water and cook over low heat until the sugar is dissolved
4. Cool and add vanilla
5. Add eggs one at a time , beating well after each addition
6. Alternately add dry ingredients with the milk
7. Beat until smooth , being careful not to overheat
8. Pour into 9 inch cake pan lined with paper
9. Place marshmallows at intervals on top of the batter
10. Bake at 350 for 50 minutes

title: risotto with asparagus  mint and lemon
steps:
1. Remove
2. Pour stock and water into medium saucepan and heat to low simmer
3. In 3-quart or larger pot , heat olive oil and 1 tablespoon butter over medium heat
4. Add onion and saute until soft and translucent
5. Add rice and cook , stirring constantly , until all the grains are well-coated
6. Quickly pour in vermouth or wine and stir until it has evaporated
7. Turn heat down to medium low and begin adding warmed stock to rice a ladleful at a time , stirring after each addition and waiting until the stock has been absorbed before adding more
8. Stir often enough to prevent rice from sticking to pan
9. When about half the stock has been absorbed , stir in asparagus slices and
10. About 20 minutes after you began the process , taste rice for doneness
11. It should be tender , but not mushy , with a bit of crunch at the center
12. You may not need to add all the stock
13. The end texture should be creamy and slightly loose
14. Turn off heat and stir in remaining butter , cheese , mint and lemon zest and juice
15. Check seasoning and add more salt and pepper if needed
16. Cover pan and let risotto rest for a few minutes before serving
17. Pass additional parmesan at the table

title: honey nut granola
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. In a large oven-proof bowl or pan , melt butter in oven
3. After butter is melted , add honey and cinnamon and mix well until cinnamon is dissolved into the honey and oil
4. Add the oats , nuts , and coconut if desired
5. Mix until the oats and nuts are well coated with honey and butter / oil
6. Place in the oven for 30 minutes or until oats and nuts are well toasted , stirring frequently
7. Allow to cool and add dried fruit and store in an airtight container
8. This stores for at least a month in the pantry and much longer in the refrigerator
9. I generally triple or quadruple this recipe
10. Cooking time is considerably longer
11. Just make sure you stir at least every fifteen minutes
12. Oil may be substituted for butter
13. Wheat germ can also be added but tends to make the texture grainy

title: date   raisin loaf  old black joe
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 160 deg celsius
2. Line an 8 inch cake tin with baking paper
3. Combine chopped dates , raisins and baking soda in a large bowl
4. Pour in the boiling water , stir
5. Leave to cool for 10 minutes
6. Add the sugar and stir to dissolve
7. Now , fold in the sifted flour and baking powder until just combined
8. Don't over mix at this point or the loaf will be tough
