9. Bake 160 deg c for approximately 1 1 / 4 - 1 1 / 2 hours , or until a toothpick inserted comes out clean
10. Leave in tin to cool for 10 minutes before turning out onto a cooling rack

title: pizza primavera
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees
2. Place pizza crust on pizza pan , prick several times with fork tines and bake for 7 to 8 minutes
3. In a medium skillet , heat the italian dressing to a boil and add the garlic and onion , cooking until the onion is wilted
4. Stir in the asparagus , carrot slices , broccoli flowerets and mushrooms
5. Cook over medium heat , stirring frequently , for 3 to 4 minutes or until vegetables are crisp tender
6. Remove the pizza crust from oven and top with sliced roma tomatoes , sprinkle basil over tomatoes and cover with the vegetable mixture
7. Sprinkle the roasted red pepper over all and top with mozzarella cheese and the grated parmesan
8. Return to oven and bake for 10 to 15 minutes or until cheese is melted and crust is golden brown

title: zucchini  courgette soup  good for weight watchers
steps:
1. Put the potatoes and onions into a large saucepan with the chicken broth and chicken stock cube
2. Bring to a boil and simmer for 3 minutes
3. Add the zucchini , garlic and cavenders seasoning and simmer , covered , for 30 minutes
4. Add the cream cheese and salt and pepper if using
5. Blend in a food processor or with a handheld blender until smooth , reheat if necessary , and serve !

title: poached egg avocado surprise
steps:
1. Toast the bread
2. Put the avocado on the toast and sprinkle with feta cheese
3. Set aside
4. Now for the poached egg , i do it the old fashioned way like my mom taught me
5. Fill a small pot with water about 3 / 4 full
6. Bring the water to a boil
7. Meanwhile , crack the egg into a small bowl
8. When the water is boiling , turn down the burner slightly , get a spoon and stir the water fast , making a "whirlpool"
9. Drop the egg into the center and let it finish swirling
10. Leave it in there a couple minutes until it's the consistancy you prefer
11. I like my yolks runny
12. Take the egg out with a slotted spoon and jiggle to drain as much water as possible
13. Plop the egg on top of the avocado and feta and sprinkle with salt and pepper to taste

title: strawberry balsamic vinaigrette
steps:
1. Place jam in a medium bowl and whisk in vinegar then extra-virgin olive oil
2. Season the dressing with salt and pepper

title: roasted corn and tomato relish
steps:
1. Soak cleaned corn in a bowl of water for approximately 30 minutes
2. Heat a grill and place corn straight on the cooking surface
3. Cook until beautiful black & caramelized grill marks appear , turning frequently
4. Do not boil or microwave corn or you will lose all of the sweet natural flavor
5. Once corn has cooled enough to handle , cut off all of kernels
6. Add all of the remaining ingredients and mix together
7. Serve at room temperature or cold

title: mcclellanville crabcakes
steps:
1. Combine crabcake ingredients thoroughly , then form into desired cake
2. Size
3. Prepare breading by making egg wash of 2 eggs and 1 / 4 cup of half & half half
4. Dip crab cakes in egg mixture , then roll in more bread crumbs
5. Saut in butter or olive oil until golden brown
6. To make the sauce seed and dice red pepper
7. Peel and chop shallots
8. Saut pepper and shallots together
9. Add cup water
10. Simmer 20
11. Minutes or until peppers are soft completely through
12. Using a high-speed blender , place peppers and shallots and all remaining ingredients in a bowl , blending until smooth and then run through a medium strainer
13. Add cilantro and set aside at room temperature
14. Serve sauce along side crab cakes

title: nimbu masoor dal   curried lentils
steps:
1. Heat 1 / 3 cup of the oil in a large , deep saucepan over a medium-low heat and cook three-quarters of the sliced onion for about 5 minutes , until soft
2. Add the cinnamon sticks , lentils and ginger , and cook for about 10 minutes , stirring frequently
3. Add the stock , hot water and chili powder
4. Bring to the boil and boil rapidly for about 10 minutes
5. Squeeze the juice from the lemon half and add to the pan with the squeezed lemon shell
6. Cook for a further 50 minutes , stirring frequently
7. Remove the lemon shell
8. Meanwhile , chop the remaining sliced onion , heat the remaining oil in a small frying-pan and cook the chopped onion , garlic , chili and bay leaves for about 10 minutes , until the onion is browned
9. Add this mixture , including the oil , to the lentils when they are cooked
10. Sprinkle with chopped coriander and serve hot

title: high energy  survival  bars
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients except for peanut butter through a meat grinder
2. Add peanut butter and mix well
3. Roll out into 1 / 2 inch thick sheets
4. Cut into bars and wrap well
5. Makes 60 2 ounce bars

title: zucchini and carrot a scapece
steps:
1. Heat 1 / 3 cup oil over medium-high heat
2. Add the zucchini and fry until golden , about 2 minutes per side
3. Transfer to a baking dish
4. Sprinkle generously with salt and pepper
5. Sprinkle with half of the garlic , basil , and mint leaves
6. Add remaining oil to the pan
7. Add the carrots and saute until golden , about 5 minutes
8. Transfer to the dish of zucchini
9. Sprinkle generously with salt and pepper
10. Sprinkle the remaining garlic , basil , and mint leaves over
11. Drizzle the vinegar over the vegetable mixture and toss gently to coat
12. Cool to room temperature
13. Cover and marinate at room temperature for 8 hours , or cover and refrigerate overnight
14. Allow the vegetables to come to room temperature before serving
15. Transfer the scapece to a platter and serve at room temperature
16. Serve with bread , fish or chicken

title: pumpkin chip bread
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine the flour , sugar , cinnamon , baking soda , salt , ginger , nutmeg and cloves
2. Combine the eggs , pumpkin and oil
3. Stir into dry ingredients just until moistened
4. Fold in cranberries and chocolate chips
5. Transfer to two greased and floured 8 x4 x2 inch loaf pans
6. Bake at 350 degrees for 50-55 minutes or until a pick inserted near the center comes out clean
7. Cool for 10 minutes before removing from pans to wire racks to cool completely

title: cherry crisp coffee cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Grease 9-inch springform pan
3. In medium bowl , combine 1 3 / 4 cup flour , baking powder and 1 teaspoons cinnamon
4. In large bowl , beat 5 tblsp
5. Margarine and 3 / 4 cup sugar
6. Blend in egg and vanilla
7. Gradually add flour mixture alternately with milk until well combined
8. Spread in pan
9. Spoon pie filling over batter
10. Bake 40 minutes
11. Combine remaining 1 / 4 cup flour , 1 / 4 cup sugar and 1 tsp cinnamon
12. Cut in 1 tblsp
13. Margarine until mixture is coarse crumbs
14. Stir in water
15. Sprinkle over top of cake
16. Bake 15-20 minutes longer or until toothpick comes out clean
17. Cool in pan on wire rack for 25 minutes
18. Remove sides of pan and serve warm or at room temperature

title: saint silvester pudding
steps:
1. Grease a loaf pan with butter , and dust with bread crumbs
2. In a mixing bowl , combine beaten eggs with spinach , cream and salt and pepper
3. Pour a third of the mixture into the loaf pan , and arrange a layer of cauliflour
4. Pour another third of the mixture over that , and layer shrimp
5. Top with remaining spinach mixture
6. Cover loaf pan with foil
7. Place loaf pan in another deep oven proof dish and add water to large dish--enough that it comes up to the top 1 / 3 of the loaf pan
8. Bake in a 375 oven for 45 minutes to an hour , or until egg is cooked through
9. Remove from oven and allow to cool 10 minutes
10. Turn pudding out onto a serving plate , and slice
11. This may be served hot or cold

title: best bread machine buns
steps:
1. Place the ingredients in bread machine pan in the following order: milk , oil , sugar , salt , beaten egg , and flour
2. Make a little well in the flour and add the yeast to flour
3. For rolls , select dough setting and press start
4. Shape dough into rolls when cycle is completed and place dough rounds unto a lightly floured cookie sheet about 1 inch apart
5. Cover and let rise for about 45 minutes in warm draft free area
6. When dough has doubled in size , uncover and bake@ 350 degrees for 15 to 17 minutes or until golden brown
7. Cool on cooling rack for 20 minutes , and once cooled it can be stored in plastic bag
8. For up to 1 week
9. If using a kitchen aid stand mixer use the following steps:
10. Dissolve 1 tblsp
11. Sugar and the yeast in 1 / 4 cup warm water
12. Scald 1 cup milk
13. In large mixing bowl combine sugar , oil , salt and milk
14. Cool to luke warm
15. Stir in eggs and yeast
16. Gradually add enough flour to form a semi-stiff dough , beating well after each addition
17. Once dough comes together in ball , take out dough and knead on a flat surface for about 5 to 10 minutes
18. The dough is ready when it feels soft like your earlobe
19. Let rest for 5 minutes , and cover and let rise in a covered bowl for 1 hours or until doubled in size
20. After first rise , punch down dough and knead for an additional 2-5 minutes
21. Form into desired shape and let rise again for 45 minutes to 1 hours
22. When dough has doubled in size , uncover and bake@ 350 degrees for 15 to 17 minutes or until golden brown

title: slow cooker corned beef
steps:
1. Pour into slow cooker water and vinegar ,
2. Peel and cut onion into quarters , add to slow cooker ,
3. Sprinkle in brown sugar ,
4. Place meat into slow cooker ,
5. Cover , set to low and leave for seven hours
6. Let stand for ten minutes before slicing , meat is so succulent
7. Top meat with mustard pickles , chutney or relish
8. Serve with your favourite vegetables , its such a quick and easy meal but so yummy , enjoy !

title: caribbean meatballs with tropical sauce
steps:
1. For the meatballs , combine the turkey and the next 6 ingredients , mixing well
2. Shape mixture into 24 , 1-inch , meatballs
3. Arrange on a rack or a roasting pan that has been sprayed with cooking spray
4. Bake at 400f for 12 minutes or until meatballs are browned
5. While the meatballs are in the oven , make the sauce by placing the mango in a blender and process until smooth
6. Combine cornstarch and sugar in a small saucepan and add the pureed mango , water and remaining ingredients
7. Cook over medium-low heat , stirring constantly , until thickened
8. This yields 1 1 / 2 cups sauce
9. Serve meatballs in a chafing dish with the sauce

title: sweet cinnamon fruit salad
steps:
1. Whisk together cinnamon , honey and orange juice
2. Toss fruit together , reserving blueberries and raspberries
3. Toss sauce with fruit
4. Add blueberries and raspberries last so you don't mush them up
5. Let sit in fridge for at least a half an hour for flavors to develop

title: avocado and sweet potato  hash
steps:
1. Cool sweet potatoes in an ice bath
2. Having cooked bacon in medium skillet , remove and set aside
3. Add sweet potatoes and caramelize on each side
4. Remove from heat
5. Add red onion , mustard , salt and pepper and toss
6. Chop bacon to 1 / 4 inch strips and mix into hash
7. Fold in parsley , pecans and avocado
8. Season to taste
9. Serve warm to room temperature

title: asian vegetable and chicken wrap
steps:
1. Heat a medium saute pan over medium high heat and add the vegetables
2. Stir-fry for about 1 minute and add the sesame dressing
3. Cook another 2 minutes
4. Remove from heat and set aside
5. Slice the chicken into strips and add to the vegetables and toss
6. Lay the tortillas on a cutting board
7. Divide the filling among the tortillas
8. Top with sunflower sprouts
9. Fold in the sides of the wrappers and begin folding from the bottom to form the wrap
10. Cut each wrap in half and serve

title: peach n cream pie
steps:
1. Topping: in medium bowl combine butter , oatmeal and coconut
2. Prepare pie
3. Pie: put sliced peaches into unbaked pasty shell
4. Mix whipping cream , sugar , and cornstarch til smooth , mix in egg and vanilla
5. Pour over peaches
6. Sprinkle topping mixture over
7. Bake in 425 oven for 15 minutes
8. Reduce heat to 325 and bake 1 hour

title: black bean tomato soup with cilantro lime cream
steps:
1. Cook bacon in a large saucepan over medium heat until crisp
2. Remove bacon with a slotted spoon , reserving 1 teaspoon drippings in pan
3. Set bacon aside
4. Add onion and celery to pan
5. Cook 5 minutes or until celery is tender
6. Stir in 3 / 4 teaspoon cumin , chile powder , and garlic
7. Cook 1 minute
8. Stir in bacon , pepper , beans , tomatoes , and broth
9. Bring to a boil
10. Cover , reduce heat , and simmer 10 minutes
11. Place half of bean mixture in a blender
12. Remove center piece of blender lid
13. Secure blender lid on blender
14. Place a clean towel over opening in blender lid
15. Blend until smooth
16. Pour into a large bowl
17. Repeat procedure with remaining bean mixture
18. Process until smooth
19. Keep warm
20. Combine sour cream , remaining 1 / 4 teaspoon cumin , cilantro , rind , and juice in a small bowl
21. Drizzle cream over soup

title: microwave scalloped potatoes peppers eggs nbacon
steps:
1. Fire up the wok , medium heat , with the bacon
2. You can use a skillet but the wok really works well
3. When the bacon just begins to try out add the peppers and onion
4. Chow for a few moments , lower the heat to medium low , cover and continue cooking till the onions are translucent
5. When finished , lift bacon , peppers , and onion out of the fat , , and drain on paper towels till cool
6. Beat together the egg , water , celery , chicken bullion , and liquid smoke
7. In a microwave proof around 9" dish , layer about 1 / 3 of the potatoes , half the bacon-pepper-onion , a splash of the egg mix
8. More potatoes , rest of the bacon-pepper-onion , a splash of egg , the rest of the potatoes , and egg
9. Top with the grated parmesan
10. Microwave 5 minutes
11. Rest a minute or so
12. Microwave another 4 or 5 minutes until the egg is well set and the cheese melted

title: simple baked eggs   ramekin baked eggs
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Coat each of 6 ramekins or custard cups with 1 / 2 teaspoon butter
3. Break 1 egg into each prepared ramekin
4. Sprinkle eggs evenly with pepper and salt
5. Spoon 1 teaspoon cream over each egg
6. Place ramekins in a 13 x 9-inch baking dish
7. Add hot water to pan to a depth of 1 1 / 4 inches
8. Bake at 350 for 25 minutes or until eggs are set

title: auntie s armenian rice pilaf
steps:
1. In 2-qt
2. Heavy saucepan with tight-fitting lid , melt butter over medium heat until foam subsides
3. Add vermicelli noodles and saute until dark and reddish in color
4. Stir in rice and saute in butter until rice is fragrant and nutty in aroma
5. Raise heat to medium-high
6. Pour in boiling chicken broth and stir
7. Add salt and pepper , tasting a bit of the broth to ensure desired seasoning
8. Cover and bring to a boil
9. Once boiling , reduce heat to keep broth at a simmer and cook for exactly 20 minutes
10. After 20 minutes , remove cover and taste a few grains of rice for doneness
11. If still a bit hard , replace cover and cook for two additional minutes
12. When rice is tender , remove pot from heat
13. Place a paper napkin directly on top of the pilaf and replace cover
14. Let sit undisturbed for 5 minutes
15. After rest-time has elapsed , remove cover , discard the paper napkin , and stir the pilaf before serving

title: grilled ham and gouda sandwich w caramelized onions
steps:
1. Heat oil in large nonstick skillet over medium heat
2. Add onion
3. Saut 5 minutes
4. Reduce heat to medium-low
5. Cover and cook until onion is very tender and golden , stirring frequently , about 25 minutes longer
6. Season with salt and pepper
7. Cool slightly
8. Butter 2 bread slices
9. Place bread , buttered side down , on platter
10. Divide onion , ham , gouda cheese , and frise between bread slices
11. Top each with another bread slice
12. Butter top slices
13. Heat another large nonstick skillet over medium heat
14. Add sandwiches and cook until bread is golden brown and cheese melts , pressing occasionally with spatula , about 4 minutes per side
15. Cut sandwiches in half diagonally and serve immediately

title: raspberry peach smoothie  diabetic
steps: 1. Place all ingredients in the blender and process on high until smooth

title: baby sweet potato cakes with pecans and sticky caramel sauce
steps:
1. Beat butter and sugar at medium speed with an electric mixer until smooth
2. Add eggs , 1 at a time , beating until blended after each addition
3. Combine flour and baking soda
4. Gradually add half of flour mixture to butter mixture , beating at low speed until blended , and stopping to scrape bottom and down sides of bowl
5. Add remaining half of flour mixture , and beat until blended
6. Add vanilla and next 5 ingredients , beating at medium speed until smooth
7. Spoon batter into 12 muffin cups coated with cooking spray , filling two-thirds full
8. 3
9. Bake at 350 for 15 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean
10. Cool in pan on a wire rack 5 minutes
11. Remove warm cakes from pan , and sprinkle with toasted pecans
12. Top each cake with 2 1 / 2 tbsp caramel-pecan sauce
13. Serve with vanilla ice cream or ice-cold heavy cream , if desired
14. Caramel-pecan sauce:
15. Cook butter and sugar in a medium nonstick skillet over medium heat 2 to 3 minutes or until butter melts and sugar dissolves
16. Whisk in heavy cream and coffee granules
17. Bring mixture to a light boil , stirring constantly
18. Turn off heat , and let stand on cooktop until slightly cool , stirring often
19. Makes 2 cups

title: fed up s cornbread
steps:
1. Preheat oven 450
2. Use 9" iron skillet
3. Place skillet with grease in oven to heat
4. Mix rest of ingredients let sit one minute
5. Add grease from skillet stir
6. Pour in skilllet
7. Bake 30 minutes or until top splits and browns

title: luscious lemon and lime water
steps:
1. Pour 8 cups water in pitcher or large bowl
2. Wash lemons and limes , cut into thin slices and add to water
3. Refrigerate for at least 3 hours before drinking , and enjoy ! keep ingredients refrigerated up to 2 days

title: pizza by the yard
steps:
1. Preheat broiler
2. Cut the french bread in half horizontally and place halves , cut side up , on a broiler pan
3. Broil 4 inches from heat for about 1-2 minutes or until the bread is lightly toasted
4. Transfer bread to cookie sheets and set aside
5. Turn off broiler and set oven temperature to 350
6. In a large skillet , brown ground beef until thoroughly cooked
7. Drain off fat
8. Stir in tomato paste , green onion , olives , water , salt , oregano , and black pepper
9. Cook over medium heat until heated through
10. Remove from heat and stir in parmesan cheese
11. Top bread halves evenly with the meat mixture
12. Top with the tomato slices , green pepper slices and pizza cheese
13. Bake for 8-10 minutes or until cheese is melted

title: cinnamon apple buns
steps:
1. In a small bowl combine yeast , warm water , and sugar
2. Set aside until foamy
3. In a large bowl: make pudding according to package directions
4. Add butter , eggs and salt
5. Mix well
6. Add yeast mixture , blend
7. Gradually add flour and knead until smooth
8. Adding sprinkles of flour to control stickiness
9. Once the dough is no longer sticky and soft and silky feeling the dough is ready
10. Place in a very large greased bowl
11. Cover and let rise until double in bulk
12. Punch down and on a lightly floured surface role out dough to a 34 inch x 21 inch rectangle
13. Spread softened butter on the dough
14. Combine the brown sugar , cinnamon , and diced apples , spread over the dough leaving about an inch away from the ends
15. Gently and tightly roll up the dough
16. With a knife , put a notch in the dough every 2 inches
17. Then with string or thread place under roll at marking and make a criss-cross over to cut the roll
18. Place on greased cookie sheets , 2 inches apart
19. Lightly press down rolls with your hand
20. Cover and let rise again
21. Bake at 350 degrees for 15-20 minutes
22. Take them out when the just begin to turn golden brown
23. Do not over bake !
24. Frost hot rolls with frosting
25. Frosting: 8 ounces cream cheese softened , 1 / 2 cup butter softened , 1 tsp vanilla , 3 cups powdered sugar , 1 tablespoon milk
26. Beat cream cheese and butter until light and fluffy , add vanilla and milk then gradually add powdered sugar
27. Beat until smooth

title: southern pride sweet cornbread
steps:
1. Grease a 9x13 inch baking pan with shortening
2. Preheat oven to 375f
3. Mix sugar , butter , eggs , milk , honey and water together in a large bowl
4. Mix dry ingredients together in a separate bowl: cornmeal , flour , baking powder , and salt
5. While stirring , add dry ingredients to sugar , egg , and milk mixture and mix thoroughly
6. Mixture will be slightly lumpy
7. Pour into greased rectangular pan
8. Bake for 25-30 minutes or until golden brown on top
9. Serve with butter

title: grilled maple salmon with pineapple
steps:
1. Preheat a lightly oiled grill to medium-hot
2. In a bowl , combine maple syrup , mustard and ginger
3. Generously brush pineapple slices with mixture and then salmon
4. Place the salmon on the grill and brush again with marinade
5. Grill pineapple for 2 to 4 minutes per side
6. Grill salmon for 3 to 5 minutes per side , or just until cooked through
7. Serve salmon topped with pineapple slice

title: popcorn muffins
steps:
1. Sift flour , powder , salt and sugar together
2. Add milk , popcorn and egg , well beaten , and melted butter
3. Bake at 25 minutes at 350 in greased or lined muffin tins

title: slow cooker cinnamon apples
steps:
1. You will need 1 reynolds slow cooker liner
2. Place liner inside a 3-6 1 / 2 quart slow cooker
3. Fit liner snugly against the bottom and sides of bowl
4. Pull top of liner over rim of slow cooker
5. Place apples in the lined slow cooker
6. Drizzle with lemon juice
7. Mix granulated sugar , brown sugar , flour , cinnamon and nutmedg in a medium bowl
8. Sprinkle mixture over apples
9. Stir gently to coat apples
10. Drizzle with butter
11. Place lid on slow cooker
12. Cook on low for 3 hours or high for 2 hours until apples are done
13. Carefully remove lid to allow steam to escape
14. Serve warm apple topping over ice cream
15. Top with crumbled cookies , if desired
16. Do not lift or transport liner with food inside
17. Cool slow cooker completely
18. Remove liner and toss

title: portabella mushroom bruschetta
steps:
1. Toast bread in 350f oven until golden brown , about 5 minutes
2. Rub lightly with garlic clove while still warm
3. Coarsely chop the mushrooms
4. In a large skillet heat 2 tablespoons oil over moderate heat until hot but not smoking and cook mushrooms until softened , then add shallots and garlic stirring , until all liquid mushrooms give off is evaporated , about 5 minutes
5. Season with salt and pepper
6. Remove skillet from heat
7. Keep mushrooms warm , covered
8. This can be made ahead , refrigerated and reheated at serving time
9. Tomato relish:
10. Quarter tomatoes
11. Combine with red onion , basil , vinegar , olive oil
12. Season , to taste , and let marinate for 15 minutes
13. Top toasted bread with sauteed mushrooms , tomato relish , shaved parmesan
14. Garnish with basil

title: freckle sandwiches
steps:
1. Butter 1 loaf of bread
2. Spread half the slices with strawberry jam , then top each slice with remaining slices to make sandwiches
3. Butter the remaining loaf of bread
4. Spread half the slices with nutella , then top with remaining slices
5. Remove the crusts from all the sandwiches , then cut each into 4 triangles
6. Lay the sandwiches on two separate platters long-edge down to form 2 long pyramids
7. Spread the remaining butter along one side of each pyramid
8. Sprinkle the buttered-side of the jam sandwiches with the 100s and 1000s and the chocolate sandwiches with the chocolate sprinkles

title: rou jia mo  spicy pork sandwiches
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375f
2. Cook sausage into ground bits and drain grease
3. While pork is cooking , chop onions and garlic
4. Add to sausage
5. Add white wine and vinegar
6. Add sugar
7. Stir well
8. Add chili oil and peppercorns
9. Stir well
10. Once most of liquid has been absorbed by meat , prepare dough
11. Separate dough into 8 biscuits
12. Press or roll each into 6-inch round
13. Divide filling evenly onto half of each biscuit round to within 1 / 4 inch of edge
14. Fold dough round over filling
15. Press edges to seal
16. Place on ungreased cookie sheet
17. Bake 15 to 20 minutes or until edges are golden brown
18. Immediately remove sandwiches from cookie sheet
19. Serve warm or cool down and serve later cold

title: my own french onion soup
steps:
1. In 5 quart dutch oven , saute` onions in butter over low heat 15 minutes or until onions are golden brown and tender
2. Stir in beef broth , beef consomme` , beef base , worcestershire sauce and pepper
3. Bring to a boil
4. Reduce heat
5. Cover and simmer 20 to 20 minutes
6. In a medium bowl combine cheeses
7. Ladle soup into 6 ovenproof bowls
8. Top each with slice of toasted french bread
9. Sprinkle with about 2 tablespoons cheese mixture
10. Broil about 3 to 5 inches from heat for 1 to 3 minutes or until cheese is bubbly
11. Add additional leftover cheese if desired

title: angel food cake with yummy chocolate whipped cream icing
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients on high with mixer until light and fluffy ice cake with frosting
2. You can cut the cake into 2 layers and also put frosting in middle
3. Especially good to put some toffee candy on top of the frosting in the center of the cake also

title: super easy horchata
steps:
1. Blend all together in blender till frothy
2. Serve over ice if desired

title: easy creamy coleslaw dressing
steps:
1. Stir the ingredients together
2. Pour the dressing over 2 cups cabbage
3. Cover and refrigerate 1 to 24 hours

title: dangerous chocolate chip cookies
steps:
1. Cream together sugars and butter
2. Add eggs , vanilla and mix well
3. Add dry ingredients to the butter mixture except the chips and mix until well combined
4. Add chocolate chips and mix just until incorporated
5. Bake at 350 for approximately 10 minutes
6. Cookies should be browned around the edges but not set in the center
7. Let cool and when hardened remove from pan
8. If you desire a thinner cookie use less flour , if you prefer a denser cookie simply increase the flour by 1 / 4 cup

title: ginger lemonade sekanji
steps:
1. Boil 1 cup water with sugar , rock salt , ginger , and cumin to make a simple syrup
2. Add remaining water and lemon juice
3. Chill to ice cold
4. Pour over ice or blend with ice

title: pre party smoothie
steps:
1. Place the milk , banana , raspberries , blueberries or strawberries , tahini , almond meal , psyllium husks or slippery elm , honey and cinnamon in the jug of a blender and blend until smooth
2. Pour into a glass to serve

title: baked blueberry  lemon and almond pudding
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Butter a 9x12 inch ovenproof dish
3. Put berries , sugar and 1 lemon zest into dish and mix
4. Sieve the flour into a bowl
5. Add cooled ground almonds and sugar
6. Beat in the melted butter , egg , buttermilk , lemon zest and almond extract
7. Spoon this over the fruit leaving about 1 inch of fruit uncovered around the sides
8. Sprinkle the flaked almonds over the top and bake until the fruit is bubbling and the pudding is browned , about 40 minutes

title: white cake with coconut pecan frosting
steps:
1. Cream butter and sugar until fluffy
2. Add eggs , one at a time and mix
3. Add flour , baking soda and buttermilk
4. Mix well
5. Add oil
6. Bake in layer cake pans for 40 minutes at 350 degrees f until done
7. Frosting: mix all ingredients together well and frost cake

title: passion fruit and blackberry jellies with lemon verbena cream
steps:
1. Passion fruit mixture: sprinkle gelatin over 1 / 4 cup water and let stand 2 minutes to soften
2. Heat sugar and remaining cup water in heavy saucepan , over moderately high heat , stirring , until sugar is dissolved
3. Add gelatin mixture and stir until dissolved
4. Transfer mixture to a 1-quart glass bowl , then set in a large bowl of ice and cold water and stir frequently until cold but not set
5. Stir in passion-fruit pure , chill until ready to use
6. Blackberry mixture: sprinkle gelatin over 1 / 4 cup water and let stand 2 minutes to soften
7. Heat sugar and remaining cup water in heavy saucepan , over moderately high heat , stirring , until sugar is dissolved
8. Add gelatin mixture and stir until dissolved
9. Transfer mixture to another 1-quart glass bowl , then set in a large bowl of ice and cold water and stir frequently until cold but not set
10. While gelatin mixture chills , pure blackberries in a food processor , then force through a fine-mesh sieve into a bowl , discarding seeds
11. Stir lemon juice and 1 cup pure into chilled gelatin mixture , then chill until ready to use
12. Assemble jellies: pour a 1 / 4 cup passion-fruit mixture into each glass , stand glasses in a wide pot
13. Fill pot with enough ice and cold water to reach level of jelly and chill in refrigerator until jelly is just set
14. Carefully pour 1 / 4 cup blackberry mixture on top of set passion-fruit jelly
15. Add enough ice to pot to reach level of jelly and chill in refrigerator until jelly is set
16. Repeat layers
17. When all layers are set , remove glasses from ice bath and chill , loosely covered with plastic wrap , 8 hours
18. Lemon verbena cream :
19. Combine lemon verbena with sugar in a small bowl , then gently bruise verbena with a pestle or wooden spoon
20. Stir in cream and chill , stirring occasionally , 1 hour
21. Pour through cleaned fine-mesh sieve into a larger bowl , pressing gently on solids
22. Discard solids and chill cream , covered , until ready to serve
23. Just before serving , beat cream with an electric mixer until it just holds soft peaks
24. Spoon dollops of cream over jellies

title: pasta with havarti and basil
steps:
1. Heat 3 tablespoons oil in skilled over medium high and add onion and garlic
2. Saute until onion is slightly browned
3. Mix in tomatoes , dried basil and crushed pepper
4. Bring to a boil
5. Break up tomatoes
6. Add broth and bring to a boil again
7. Reduce to simmer and cook until reduced to 6 cups , about one hour
8. Add salt and pepper to taste
9. Preheat oven to 375
10. Cook pasta , per package directions and drain well
11. Toss pasta with 2 tablespoons olive oil
12. Pour sauce over and mix well
13. Stir in havarti and transfer to a 13 x 9 baking dish
14. Sprinkle with parmesan and bake 30 minutes
15. When done , sprinkle with fresh basil

title: spanish rice with ham
steps:
1. In a large saucepan melt butter over medium heat
2. Saute green pepper until crisp tender
3. Stir in ham , undrained stewed tomatoes , tomato juice , peas , and water
4. Bring to a boil
5. Remove from heat and stir in instant rice
6. Cover and let stand about 5 minutes or until rice is tender

title: korean spicy chicken wings   restaurant recipe
steps:
1. Rinse the wings in cold water , then lightly salt and pepper them
2. Let stand about 10 to 15 minutes
3. Place wings in a large bowl and pour the milk over them , then place in refrigerator for about one hour , turning three to four times
4. For the stir fry sauce: place the ginger and garlic into a blender with just enough water to liquefy the mix
5. Pour into a small mixing bowl and add all other sauce ingredient & mix well
6. Finely chop the green / spring onion and set aside
7. Chicken wings: discard the milk and let wing section drain until just damp
8. Heat oil in a large cooking pot
9. Roll wings in starch and deep fry until golden brown then drain
10. Transfer the chicken to a large stir fry pan or wok over medium to medium high heat , add the sauce , and stir fry until all liquid is gone
11. Place onto a serving tray and garnish with the green onion and sesame seed
12. Serve as an appetizer or with sticky rice and ban chan for a meal

title: chorizo chili
steps:
1. Cook chorizo breaking it up
2. Drain
3. Add all to crockpot cook at least 6 hours , stirring every so often
4. Optional: two hours until done add hotdogs serve with favorite rolls

title: italian cheese stuffed shells
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Cook shells as directed on package and drain in single layer on paper towel
3. Mix together all ingredients and fill each shell with 2-3 tbsp
4. Of filling
5. Spread thin layer of sauce in 9x13-inch baking dish and place stuffed shells on top
6. Cover with remaining sauce
7. Cover with sheet of aluminum foil and bake 25-30 minutes
8. Serve with extra parmesan cheese to sprinkle over top

title: unleavened butterhorns
steps:
1. Measure flour into a large bowl and cut in butter
2. Add remaining ingredients
3. Form into a ball and wrap with plastic wrap
4. Chill overnight
5. Divide ball into 3 portions and roll each portion into a 12" circle
6. Cut each circle into 12 wedges and roll up , beginning with the wide end
7. Place each on a lightly greased baking sheet with the point tucked under
8. Bake at 375f for 20 minutes
9. When making these i like to put a thin layer of pizza sauce on the dough before rolling up the triangles

title: tajine de crevette   moroccan tiger prawns  shrimp
steps:
1. Mix everything together in a bowl
2. Cover & place in the fridge to marinate for at least 30 minutes - preferably 2 hours
3. Heat a large , shallow pan & cook the mix over a high heat , stirring continuously , for approx 5 minutes take care not to overcook as this will make the prawns tough & rubbery
4. Serve immediately

title: chicken avocado date sandwich
steps:
1. Mash the avocado , date , jalapeno pepper and mayonnaise in a food processor to chunky paste
2. Roast the chicken slices gently on both sides in a small skillet
3. Toast the bread and layer the avocado-date spread on a slice and add chopped scallions to top
4. Layer the chicken and the toast
5. Enjoy !

title: corn chowder  crock pot
steps:
1. In skillet or microwave , fry bacon until crisp
2. Remove and reserve
3. Add onion and potatoes to bacon drippings and saute' for about 5 minutes
4. Drain well
5. Combine all ingredients in crock pot
6. Stir well
7. Cover and cook on low setting for 6 - 7 hours

title: wholly guacamole
steps:
1. Cut avocados in half , remove pit , and spoon avocado into a mixing bowl
2. Add minced garlic and squeeze the juice from one-half of the lime into the bowl of avocado
3. Mash the ingredients together to desired consistency using the back of a large spoon or a potato masher
4. Fold in diced tomato and diced onion , a couple pinches of salt , and the juice from the remaining lime half
5. Cover the bowl and refrigerate for 30-45 minutes
6. Uncover and taste
7. Add salt as needed
8. If you don't give the resulting guacamole at least 4 stars , then you ain't making it right
9. Some folks use lemon , but it's been my experience that if you accidentally add too much lemon , it seriously affects the guacamole's flavor
10. If you happen to add too much lime , the guacamole just gets a little more tangy
11. If you find the leftover guacamole has darkened , simply stir it before eating and use more fresh lime juice next time
12. Wholly guacamole may be used as a topper with tacos , enchiladas , fajitas , etc
13. However , some say it is at its best with a bowl of warm tortilla chips and an ice cold beer

title: almond toffee popcorn
steps:
1. In heavy saucepan , combine sugar , butter , corn syrup , water and almonds
2. Cook over a moderate heat to 280~ on a candy thermometer
3. Add the vanilla
4. Stir well and pour over the popped corn

title: 100  whole wheat zucchini bread
steps:
1. Mix sugar , oil , eggs , grated zucchini and vanilla in a large bowl
2. In a separate bowl sift whole wheat flour , salt , baking soda , cinnamon and baking powder
3. Add dry ingredients to wet , stirring to combine well
4. Add chopped nuts
5. Bake at 350f for 45 / 50 minutes

title: sicilian salad dressing
steps:
1. In a very big bowl , combine everything , i use a hand emulsion blender to blend thoroughly
2. Chill for 1 hour
3. In an empty salad bowl , dump 1 / 4 cup of cold dressing and toss in torn cold romaine lettuce
4. Put on individual salad bowls
5. Top with diced tomatoes and chopped chicken
6. Scatter grapes and mangoes on top
7. Garnish with croutons and pine nuts

title: coffee sponge cake
steps:
1. Butter side and bottom of a 9" round pan
2. Line bottom with parchment paper
3. Sift flour , baking powder and salt together
4. Set aside
5. Heat milk in a small saucepan over low heat until 150f
6. Remove from heat
7. While milk is heating , beat eggs in a large bowl until yolks and whites are well-combined
8. Add sugar , then beat on high speed for about 4 mins until mixture is light , fluffy and thickened
9. Turn to low speed and beat in vanilla and dissolved coffee
10. Add in flour mixture , mixing until just incorporated
11. Slowly add in hot milk , continue mixing until mixture is smooth
12. Turn the batter into prepared pan
13. Bake in the middle rack of a preheated oven at 350f for 25 mins until the top feels firm when touched lightly , and a toothpick inserted in the center of cake comes out with just a few crumbs clinging to it
14. Cool cake for 5 mins in the pan
15. Loosen the side of the cake from the pan using a small knife , and invert the cake onto a wire rack
16. Remove the parchment paper from the bottom of the cake and replace it loosely on the cake
17. Let the cake cool thoroughly , top side down
18. To make the syrup: dissolve coffee granules and sugar in warm water , then stir in the kahlua / brandy
19. Assembly: cut the sponge cake into 2 layers with a long serrated knife
20. Set bottom layer onto a cake board / lazy susan
21. Brush top of 1st layer generously with syrup , and fill with the desired filling / frosting
22. Brush the 2nd layer of cake with syrup and set it on top of the filling , syrup side down
23. Brush the top of the cake with remaining syrup and frost the top and side as desired

title: iowa maid rites
steps:
1. Brown ground beef in skillet and drain
2. Add soup mix and french onion soup , cover and simmer for two hours
3. To serve , spoon onto buns and top with mustard and pickles

title: priest chicken
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients , cook in crock pot on low for 6-8 hours
2. This is great served with mashed potatoes

title: spicy dessert crepes
steps:
1. Combine flour , milk , eggs , sugar , oil , molasses , and spices in bowl
2. Beat with electric mixer until well blended
3. Heat a lightly greased skillet or crepe pan
4. Remove from heat and spoon in 2 tablespoons of batter
5. Lift and tilt skillet to spread batter evenly
6. Return to heat and brown on one side
7. Invert pan over paper towels or napkins and remove crepe
8. Repeat until all the batter is used

title: jerk snapper
steps:
1. Mix together ingredients for the jerk rub and massage it generously into the fillets
2. Refrigerate fish for about 1 hour
3. Preheat oven to 400f
4. Lightly oil a baking sheet large enough to hold the fish in a single layer
5. Place fillets on baking sheet and drizzle the tops lightly with olive oil
6. Bake at 400f for 6 minutes
7. Turn fillets and drizzle once more with a little olive oil
8. Continue baking for 4-6 minutes or until fish flakes easily with a fork
9. Just prior to serving , drizzle cooked fillets with lemon juice , a little soy sauce , and however much pepper sauce you prefer
10. Serve hot

title: chickpea sandwich salad
steps:
1. Drain the garbanzo beans and rinse them under running water in a colander
2. Let drain
3. In a flat-bottomed dish or pan and using a potato masher , mash them to whatever consistency you prefer
4. I like mine kind of chunky
5. In a bowl , combine the garbanzo beans with remaining ingredients and mix well
6. Spread on your favorite bread or in pita pockets and enjoy !
7. ) other possible additions include chopped celery and / or cucumber , paprika , a couple drops of balsamic vinegar , and perhaps a little cumin
8. Source: adapted from the peaceful palate , by jennifer raymond

title: pear bran muffins
steps:
1. Combine bran cereal , pears , and skim milk
2. Let stand for 5 minutes
3. Mix together flour , sugar , and baking powder
4. Add oil or applesauce and egg or egg substitue to the pear mixture
5. Stir in dry ingredients just until moistened
6. Fill greased muffin tins 3 / 4 full
7. May sprinkle with mixture of cinnamon and sugar before baking
8. Bake at 400 degrees 18 to 20 minutes

title: cuban mojito
steps:
1. Combine the lime , sugar , and mint in a martini shaker or wide glass
2. Use a muddler or the handle of a wooden spoon to smash and crush everything together to release the oils and juice
3. When there is a good amount of juice and the sugar begins to dissolve , add the rum and stir to combine
4. Fill two glasses with ice , divide the mixture between glasses , and top off with some soda water
5. Garnish with a couple of mint leaves and sugar cane stalks

title: chicken broccoli and stuffing casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Boil chicken until cooked and cut into small pieces
3. In the meantime , steam or cook broccoli until tender / crisp
4. Mix together soup , mayonnaise and lemon juice in a small bowl , and set aside
5. In an 8x8 inch baking dish , layer the chicken , broccoli and soup mixture
6. Splash the white wine over the soup for taste
7. Add the shredded cheese , and then sprinkle the stuffing mix over the top
8. Bake for 25- 30 minutes
9. Serve over rice

title: yummy summer chicken salad
steps:
1. Shred chicken and keep aside
2. Drain pineapple - reserve the juice
3. Heat oil in a frying pan and fry onion until tender
4. Stir in curry powder and chutney
5. Remove from the heat and stir through mayonnaise and 1 / 4 cup of the pineapple juice
6. Tear lettuce in half and place on serving platter or large bowl
7. Top with chicken , mango , avacado and macadamia nuts
8. Drizzle with dressing
9. Season with salt and pepper if desired

title: spicy hot dog bites
steps:
1. Combine ketchup , brown sugar , vinegar , soy sauce , mustard , and garlic in the crockery pot
2. Cover and cook on high for 1 hour , stirring occasionally
3. Add hot dogs
4. Stir to coat with sauce
5. Cover and cook on low for 1 1 / 2 hours , or until hot
6. Serve hot , with toothpicks , from crockpot

title: salmon with spiced red wine sauce
steps:
1. Pat salmon dry and season with salt
2. Heat a 12-inch nonstick skillet over moderately high heat until hot and sear salmon on flat sides until golden , 2 1 / 2 to 3 minutes total
3. Add wine , pepper , gingerroot , and garlic and cook salmon at a bare simmer , turning pieces over once , until just cooked through , 5 to 6 minutes total
4. Transfer salmon with a slotted spatula to 4 heated plates and keep warm , covered
5. Boil cooking liquid until syrupy and reduced to about 1 / 4 cup
6. Remove skillet from heat and add butter , stirring until incorporated
7. Season sauce with salt and pour over salmon

title: pumpkin ginger scones
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425
2. Set aside 1 tablespoon sugar
3. Combine remaining sugar , flour , baking powder , cinnamon , soda and salt in a large bowl
4. Cut in 4 tablespoons butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs
5. Beat egg in small bowl
6. Add pumpkin , sour cream and ginger
7. Beat until well combined
8. Add pumpkin mixture to flour
9. Stir until mixture forms a soft dough that leaves sides of bowl
10. Turn dough out onto a well floured surface
11. Knead 10 times
12. Roll into a 9x6 inch rectangle
13. Cut into 6 squares , cut each of those in half diagonally , making 12 triangles
14. Melt remaining tablespoon of butter
15. Brush tops of triangles with butter and sprinkle with reserved sugar
16. Bake 10-12 minutes until golden brown

title: shrimp with honey mustard and dipping sauce  zip and steam
steps:
1. Combine shrimp , salad dressing , salt and garlic powder in medium or large ziploc brand zip 'n steam bag
2. Seal bag and shake to mix ingredients
3. Pat ingredients into an even , single layer
4. Place bag in microwave
5. Cook on full power 2 - 3 minutes , until shrimp are pink and cooked throughout
6. If needed , continue microwaving for 30-second intervals until done
7. Allow bag to stand 1 minute before opening
8. Salt to taste
9. Serve with dipping sauce and garnish with lemon wedges
10. For dipping sauce , combine all of ingredints in a bowl and serve with shrimp

title: peach blueberry crumble
steps:
1. Gently toss the fruit , 1 / 2 cup sugar and cornstarch together in a 2 quart baking dish and set aside
2. Combine remaining ingredients
3. Stir with a fork until crumbly and sprinkle over fruit mixture
4. Bake at 375 for 20-25 minutes or until topping is golden

title: cream cheese cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Combine crisco , cream cheese and milk in a medium bowl
3. Beat at medium speed of elecric mixer until well blended
4. Beat in sugar and vanilla
5. Mix in flour
6. Add nuts
7. Drop by rounded teaspoon about 2 inches apart onto ungreased cookie sheet
8. Bake for 10 minutes
9. Remove to cooling rack

title: black bean and corn salad   spicy mexican salad side dish
steps:
1. Cook corn in boiling water to cover 5 minutes
2. Drain and cool
3. Cup corn from cob
4. Whisk together lime juice and next 4 ingredients in a large bowl
5. Add corn , black beans , and remaining ingredients
6. Toss to coat
7. Cover and chill 2 hours

title: better dressing for coleslaw
steps:
1. Whisk all ingredients together thoroughly
2. This will keep a week refridgerated in a tightly-lidded container

title: braised cauliflower with capers   toasted bread crumbs
steps:
1. Toasting the bread crumbs: heat the oven to 325 degrees
2. Spread the bread crumbs in a single layer on a baking sheet
3. Bake , stirring once or twice with a pancake turner , until the crumbs are the color of pale toast and lightly crunchy , about 15 minutes
4. Set aside to cool
5. Trimming the cauliflower: cut the cauliflower into florets , discarding the thick core
6. Cut into individual florets that are about 1 1 / 2 inches long and just about as wide
7. You want them small , but not trimmed so much that they are falling apart
8. Browning the cauliflower: heat the butter and oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat
9. When hot , add the florets and saute , turning frequently , until they are speckled allover with nice bits of brown , about 8 minutes total
10. Add the capers , stir to dis- tribute , and cook for another minute
11. The braise: pour in the stock or water , season with salt and pepper , cover tightly , and reduce the heat to low
12. Simmer gently until the cauliflower is tender enough to be easily pierced with the
13. If the liquid threatens to dry up at any point , add a splash of water
14. The finish: when the cauliflower is tender , remove the lid and boil away any remain- ing liquid , shaking the pan so the cauliflower doesn't stick
15. Add a squeeze of lemon , and taste for salt and pepper
16. Stir in the bread crumbs and serve immediately
17. Variation: penne with braised cauliflower & capers
18. Turn this cauliflower into a meal by boiling up 3 / 4 pound of short tube-shaped pasta , such as penne , fusilli , or gemelli
19. When the pasta is al dente , drain it , reserving about 1 cup of the cooking water
20. In step 14 , don't boil away any remaining liquid
21. Add the pasta to the cauliflower before adding the bread crumbs , and add enough reserved pasta cooking water to moisten the dish
22. Drizzle with a bit of extra-virgin olive oil , stir in the bread crumbs , and taste for salt and pepper
23. A small handful of chopped flat-leaf parsley and some freshly grated parmigiano-reggiano cheese are good finishing touches

title: baked alaska salmon fillet with mustard sauce
steps:
1. Arrange salmon fillets in baking pan , drizzle with combined butter and oil
2. Top with lemon slices
3. Bake in 400 degree fahrenheit oven 15 minutes or until flesh is no longer translucent
4. Mustard sauce:
5. Lightly saute shallots in butter
6. Add wine and reduce until nearly evaporated
7. Add cream
8. Cook and stir until thickened
9. Add mustard , chives , and parsley
10. Season to taste with salt
11. To serve:
12. Ladle serving of sauce on serving plate
13. Arrange lemon topped salmon on sauce
14. Garnish with pear tomatoes and parsley sprigs

title: pasta with broccoli   italian sausage
steps:
1. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil
2. Clean broccoli & separate florets from the stems
3. Remove the tough peel from the stems & cut into cubes
4. Place in steamer & steam to desired tenderness
5. Reserve the broccoli water
6. Remove the casings from the sausage
7. Heat the olive oil to medium high and brown the sausage flattening & chopping until all is browned
8. Add garlic , fennel seed & red pepper flakes
9. Cook until garlic is pale brown
10. Remove from the heat
11. Add steamed broccoli & 1 / 2 cup of the broccoli water to the sausage
12. Add the pasta to the boiling water and cook according to package directions
13. Scoop out the pasta & add to the sausage & broccoli along with 1 / 2 cup of the pasta water
14. Reheat the sausage , broccoli & pasta & stir until the water mostly boils away & forms a nice sauce
15. 1 1 / 2 to 2 minutes
16. If too dry add more water from pasta & / or broccoli
17. Grate 1 / 2 ounce of pecorino romano cheese over pasta reserving the remaing cheese for tableside
18. Salt & pepper to taste
19. Can be reheated in microwave
20. Just sprinkle with a little water before heating

title: thai noodles with spicy peanut sauce
steps:
1. Cook pasta in a large pot of salted water according to package directions
2. Drain and return to pot
3. Add 2 tbsp sesame oil and toss to coat
4. Set aside
5. Heat remaining 2 tbsp sesame oil in heavy pot over medium-high heat
6. Add green onions , carrots , stir-fry veggies , garlic and ginger
7. Saute until vegetables soften , about 4 minutes
8. Add honey , peanut butter , soy sauce , vinegar and chili-garlic sauce and mix well
9. Simmer sauce 2 minutes
10. Pour sauce over pasta and toss well
11. Transfer to platter and serve warm
12. Garnish with additional green onions , if desired
13. Yields 8 side dish servings or 4 main dish servings
14. Chili-garlicsauce can be increased or decreased depending on how spicy you like your dish
15. As written , this recipe has some heat , but is still edible for my toddler son

title: polevka s jatrovymi knedlicky  soup with beef liver dumplings
steps:
1. Mix ground beef liver with butter , garlic , lemon rind , marjoram and mace
2. Beat in eggs and then bread crumbs , flour , salt and pepper
3. Let it stand in room temperature for about 1 hour
4. Shape into small balls , bring consomme to a boil , drop in liver dumplings
5. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes

title: vegan spinach tofu stuffed shells
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Bring water to a boil
3. Cook shells al dente according to package directions
4. Drain and let cool
5. In food processor , crumble tofu
6. Add garlic , parsley , salt and olive oil
7. Blend to a smooth consistency , not unlike melty ricotta cheese
8. Cook frozen spinach according to package directions
9. Add spinach to tofu mixture , making sure to thoroughly drain spinach , if necessary
10. Coat bottom of casserole pan with sauce
11. Fill each jumbo shell with approx 2 tbsp of spinach tofu mixture
12. Place shells in casserole pan and cover with remaining sauce and a hefty layer of soy / rice cheese
13. Cover with aluminum foil and bake 15 minutes
14. Uncover and bake for additional 20 minutes or until cheese is melty and fantastic
15. Enjoy !

title: yummy gummy cheesecake
steps:
1. Mix together the cake mix , butter , 1 egg , coconut and pecans
2. Spread evenly in a square pan
3. Then mix well the box of sugar , creamcheese and 2 eggs
4. Pour on top of the other ingredients
5. Then bake at 325 degrees for 45 minutes

title: chocolate cashew pie
steps:
1. Prepare pie crust for one-crust filled pie using 9-inch pie pan
2. Heat oven to 325 f
3. In large bowl , combine corn syrup , sugar , margarine , vanilla and eggs
4. Beat with wire whisk until well blended
5. Reserve 2 tablespoons chocolate chips for topping
6. Stir in remaining chocolate chips and cashew halves
7. Spread evenly in crust-lined pan
8. Bake at 325 f
9. For 45 to 55 minutes or until pie is deep golden brown and filling is set
10. Cover edge of crust with strips of foil after 15 to 20 minutes of baking to prevent excessive browning
11. Cool 2 hours or until completely cooled
12. Eanwhile , line cookie sheet with waxed paper
13. In small saucepan , melt reserved 2 tablespoons chocolate chips over low heat
14. Dip each whole cashew in chocolate
15. Place on lined cookie sheet
16. Refrigerate 15 to 20 minutes or until chocolate is set
17. Garnish pie with whipped cream and chocolate-dipped cashews
18. Store in refrigerator
19. To flavor whipped cream , fold in sweetened cocoa mix , grated citrus peel , spices or a favorite liqueur

title: simple cinnamon raisin apple strudel
steps:
1. Heat the oven to 450f and arrange a rack in the middle
2. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper
3. Place apples in a large bowl with raisins
4. Whisk together sugar , cornstarch , cinnamon , and salt in a small bowl until combined
5. Sprinkle over apples and raisins and toss to evenly coat
6. Arrange a sheet of phyllo on a large , flat surface with the shorter side toward you
7. Brush with melted butter and arrange another sheet on top
8. Repeat , alternating butter and phyllo , until there are 6 layers , then brush the top layer with butter
9. Evenly arrange apple-raisin mixture on phyllo , leaving a 1-1 / 2-inch border at the top and sides
10. Begin to roll the phyllo away from you , folding in the sides as you roll
11. When youve rolled up the entire pastry , brush any exposed phyllo with butter
12. Place the strudel seam side down on the prepared baking sheet , brush again with butter , and cut 4 diagonal slits into the top just through the phyllo
13. Bake until golden brown , about 10 minutes
14. Reduce the heat to 350f and bake until the apples are knife tender and the juices are bubbling , about 30 to 40 minutes more
15. Let cool at least 10 minutes before slicing

title: chicken thighs cacciatore
steps:
1. Combine the first 5 ingredients in a large heavy-duty plastic zip-lock bag
2. Add chicken
3. Seal bag and shake to coat
4. Heat the oil in a large nonstick frying pan coated with cooking spray over medium-high heat
5. Add chicken
6. Cook 5 minutes or until browned , turning once
7. Add pepper stir-fry and remaining ingredients
8. Cover and cook 8 minutes
9. Uncover and cook 3 minutes or until thick
10. Discard bay leaf

title: fall apple chicken salad with maple mustard vinaigrette
steps:
1. Whisk the vinaigrette ingredients together in a small bowl or place them in a mason jar and shake
2. Divide the salad greens among four bowls
3. Top each with a chicken breast , 1 ounce crumbled goat cheese , 1 tablespoon almonds , 1 tablespoon cranberries , and half an apple
4. Top with vinaigrette

title: raspberry kirsch sorbet
steps:
1. Combine sugar and water in a small saucepan and bring to a boil over high heat , stirring until sugar is completely dissolved
2. Set syrup aside to cool slightly
3. Puree raspberries in a food processor or blender until smooth
4. Pour through a fine mesh strainer , pressing on the solids with a spoon or spatula to remove as much liquid as possible
5. Discard the seeds and solids
6. Combine raspberry pure and syrup and , if using , a few drops of kirsch
7. Cover mixture and place in refrigerator to chill thoroughly , at least 3 hours or overnight
8. Freeze raspberry mixture in an ice cream maker according to the instructions
9. The sorbet will keep in the freezer for up to 1 week

title: snickerdoodle pinwheels  2
steps:
1. Mix 1 / 3 cup of sugar and 1 tablespoon cinnamon
2. In a mixing bowl , beat softened butter and cream cheese
3. Beat in remaining cup of sugar and baking powder , scraping sides of bowl occasionally
4. Beat in egg and vanilla
5. Add flour to batter in small increments , beating as much as you can with an electric mixer
6. Blend in remaining flour with a wooden spoon , or , if wearing food-preparation gloves , blend in the flour by hand
7. Divide dough in half
8. Roll half of dough between two sheets of parchment paper or wax paper into a 12x8 inch rectangle
9. Remove top sheet of paper
10. Brush dough with melted butter
11. Sprinkle with 2 tablespoons of the cinammon mixture
12. Starting from one of the short sides , roll up jellyroll fashion , removing paper as you work
13. Use paper to bend and roll dough as you work
14. Repeat with remaining dough , melted butter and cinnamon mixture
15. At this point , wrap dough in parchment paper or wax paper and store in a freezer quality sealable plastic bag
16. Freeze overnight or for at least 4 hours before baking
17. Dough should be very firm
18. Using a very sharp knife , cut dough into slices
19. Place on an ungreased cookie sheet
20. Bake at 375 degrees for 8- 10 minutes or until edges are firm
21. Cool on cookie sheet for 1 minute
22. Transfer to a wire rack , cool

title: verry berry french toast
steps:
1. Cut bread into 1-inch cubes
2. Place half in a greased 13x9x2" baking dish
3. Cut cream cheese into 1-inch cubes
4. Scatter over bread
5. Top with berries and remaining bread
6. In a large bowl , beat eggs
7. Add milk and honey
8. Mix well
9. Pour over bread mixture
10. Cover and chill 8 hours or overnight
11. Remove from refrigerator 30 minutes before baking
12. Bake , covered , at 350 degrees for 30 minutes
13. Uncover and bake 25-30 minutes longer or until golden and center is set
14. For syrup: in saucepan , combine sugar and cornstarch
15. Add water
16. Bring to boil over medium heat and boil for 3 minutes , stirring constantly
17. Stir in berries
18. Reduce heat
19. Simmer for 8-10 minutes or until blueberries have burst
20. Stir in butter until melted
21. Serve over french toast

title: the easiest barbecued chicken wings ever
steps:
1. Bake chicken wings at 350' for 1 hour
2. Put cooked wings into the crock pot with barbecue sauce and cook on low for 1 hour

title: zesty bbq chicken
steps:
1. Marinate chicken: mix orange juice , soy sauce and ginger
2. Pour into zip lock bag
3. Add chicken breast
4. Marinate overnight
5. Bake chicken: salt and pepper chicken
6. Bake at 350f for 15 minutes
7. Remove from oven and baste with barbecue sauce
8. Bake for 15 more minutes
9. Remove chicken
10. Serve with extra sauce on the side

title: chicken soup for dummies
steps:
1. Place chicken and water in stock pot and bring to a boil
2. Reduce to a simmer and add remaining ingredients except pasta
3. Cover
4. Simmer for 45 minutes and then remove chicken to a plate
5. Add pasta to broth and bring back to a boil
6. Reduce to low / med heat , do not cover
7. Let cook for about 20 minutes
8. Meanwhile , when chicken is cool enough to handle , remove skin and discard
9. Pull bite sized pieces of chicken from bones and add back to soup , discarding bones
10. By this time , your pasta should be tender
11. If not , allow to simmer a few more minutes
12. Check to see if you need more salt and / or pepper and then serve

title: corn and bean chowder
steps:
1. In a large pot heat the oil
2. Saute the onions and garlic
3. Add 3 cups of corn , the stock , and the nutmeg
4. Bring it to a boil and simmer until the corn is tender
5. Meanwhile puree the additional 1 cup of corn in a blender or food processor
6. When the corn and stock is tender add the pureed corn , the milk , the kidney beans , and the salt
7. Bring it almost to a boil
8. Lower the heat and let it simmer for about 5 minutes

title: pepper pea salad with sesame dressing
steps:
1. Bring a small saucepan of water to a boil
2. Add the peas , cook 1 minute
3. Drain in a colander and place under cold running water to stop cooking
4. Chill in a bowl of ice water
5. Drain , pat dry with paper towels and place in a large serving bowl
6. Add pepper strips , radishes , scallions and salad greens
7. Cover and refrigerate
8. Toast sesame seeds in a small skillet over medium heat , stirring often , until golden brown
9. Scrape them onto a plate , cool , wrap and set aside
10. Put remaining dressing ingredients into a jar , cover , shake well and refrigerate
11. Just before serving:
12. Add sesame seeds to dressing
13. Cover and shake until blended
14. Pour over salad
15. Toss to mix and coat
16. Enjoy !

title: jimmy griffin s perfect raspberry and raisin irish scone
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 500
2. Place rack in the middle of the oven
3. Spray a cookie sheet with cooking spray , or cut a piece of parchment paper to fit it
4. Whisk the two eggs together in a small bowl and set aside
5. Combine flour with baking powder and salt
6. Sift five times
7. Set aside
8. Whisk together the buttermilk , olive oil , sugar , and egg
9. Moving very quickly , mix liquid ingredients into flour
10. This will immediately start to activate the baking powder , so don't loiter ! make a well in the middle of the sifted flour , pour in the milk / oil mixture , and sprinkle the raisins on top
11. Blend together with a wooden spoon , as lightly as you can
12. Turn dough out onto a large sheet of waxed paper and cover with another sheet of waxed paper
13. Pat it into a rough rectangle about one inch high
14. Remove the top sheet of waxed paper , scatter the frozen raspberries over half the rectangle , and fold the other half of the rectangle over the raspberries
15. Cover again with waxed paper and pat the rectangle until it is an even 1
16. 5" high
17. Remove the top sheet of waxed paper and cut the dough into rounds with a 3" round cookie cutter
18. Transfer biscuits on to the cookie sheet with a spatula dipped in flour , spacing them about 2" apart
19. Glaze the tops with the beaten egg mixture
20. Refrigerate scones for 15 minutes , then glaze the scones again
21. Turn the oven temperature down to 425f bake for 18 minutes
22. Don't bake any longer , even if you're tempted to !
23. Cool on baking sheet for 10 minutes , then remove to a cooling rack to finish cooling
24. Scones will stay moist for about two days
25. They freeze well
26. They're best served warm , with good butter and jam

title: my favorite chicken pot pie
steps:
1. Follow directions for thawing / preparing puff pastry sheets
2. Adjust oven rack to low center position , heat oven to 400
3. Put chicken broth in a dutch oven over medium heat
4. Add chicken
5. Cover and bring to a simmer
6. Simmer until chicken is just done , 8 - 10 minutes
7. Transfer meat to a bowl to cool
8. Transfer broth to small bowl
9. Increase heat to medium-high and heat 1 1 / 2 tablespoons oil in the dutch oven
10. Add onions , carrots and celery and saute until just tender , about 5 minutes
11. Season to taste with salt and pepper
12. Put cooked veggies in a large mixing bowl and set aside
13. Saute mushrooms in remaining 1 tablspoon of oil until liquid evaporates and mushrooms start to soften , about 5 minutes
14. Meanwhile , shred checken into bite size pieces
15. Place chicken in bowl with the veggies , add mushrooms to mixture
16. Heat butter over medium heat in dutch oven
17. When foaming subsides , add flour , cook for about 1 minute whisking constantly
18. Whisk in reserved chicken broth , milk and any accumulated chicken juices and thyme
19. Bring liquid to a simmer , reduce heat to low and continue to simmer , stirring , until sauce fully thickens about 1 minute
20. Season to taste with salt and pepper
21. Stir in sherry
22. Taste and adjust seasonings
23. Pour sauce over chicken-vegetable mixture , stir to combine
24. Stir in peas an parsley
25. Pour mixture into a 13x9 pan or any shallow baking dish of your preferred size
26. Place puff pastry sheet over pan and gently press to edges
27. You may need to lightly roll out the pastry sheet to get the right size
28. If you use different pans , you will obviously need to cut the puff pastry to the appropriate size , i use scissors and cut the pastry just a touch bigger than the diameter of the pan
29. Bake until pastry is golden brown and filling is bubbly , about 30 minutes for large pies and 20 - 25 minutes for smaller pies
30. Serve immediately

title: catherine s tangy chicken kabobs
steps:
1. Mix vinegar through salt and add chicken
2. Marinate at least 8 hours or overnight
3. Skewer chicken and vegetables
4. Grill until slightly charred

title: just say baa baa sloppy josephos
steps:
1. Brown the lamb on high heat in a non-stick skillet , crumbling the meat with a fork
2. Brown for about 8 minutes
3. Remove meat with a slotted spoon , reserving 1 tablespoon of the fat
4. Return the lamb to the pan and add the onion and garlic
5. Brown the mixture for about 4-5 minutes or until onion begins to brown
6. Add the tomato puree , honey , rosemary
7. Stir until hot , approximately 2 minutes
8. Add salt and pepper to taste
9. Steam the rolls and set roll bottoms on individual dinner plates
10. Divide the baby spinach leaves among each roll bottom , followed by the lamb mixture , roasted bell pepper slices and the cheese
11. Add the roll tops , slightly off-center
12. Fyi: yield may vary depending on what type of bread you use

title: fruit cheese roll
steps:
1. Combine fruits in bowl , add port , cover and allow to stand for 1-2 hours
2. Beat softened cream cheese and cheddar together in electric mixer , stir in rind and fruit mixture
3. Refrigerate covered for 1 hour
4. Roll mixture into a log shape about 20cm in length , roll in poppy seeds , cover and refrigerated 24 hours
5. Serve with crackers

title: vegetarian california rolls  sushi
steps:
1. Prepare the sushi rice according to package instructions
2. Prepare your veggies while the rice is cooking
3. Once the rice is done put it in a bowl and season to taste with rice vinegar and sugar - the mixture should be pleasantly sweet and sour
4. Spread up the edges of the bowl to cool for a couple of minutes
5. Lay down a nori sheet on a rolling mat
6. Using a spoon dipped in water spread the rice on the nori leaving a strip of about 2 in / 5cm at the far side of the sheet facing away from you
7. Use a teaspoon to spread some plum sauce down the middle of the rice
8. Top with 1-2 slices of cucumber , carrots , avocado and green onion each depending on size of the veggies you cut
9. Using your mat roll up the nori pressing down with your hands as you roll to keep the roll firm
10. Set the rolls on a plate with the bare strip of nori facing down
11. The moisture from the rice will seal the rolls
12. Let sit to firm up
13. Using a sharp knife cut the ends of the rolls and eat immediately
14. )
15. Cut the rest of the rolls into neat bite sized pieces and serve with the wasabi and pickled ginger and soy sauce for dipping - you may want to let your guests decide on how much wasabi to use , especially if they are french : )

title: cheese soup   caldo de queso
steps:
1. Toast the flour take the flour out of the pan and clean the pan with a napkin ,
2. Add oil to the pan and when the oil is hot add the potatoes to brown them , add some salt
3. You don't want the potatoes fully cooked because you are going to add them to the soup later , but you want them sealed
4. Take the potatoes out , then add to the same pan the garlic and the onion finely chopped , for like 2-3 minutes and add there the anaheim green peppers the green peppers should be finely chopped also , and mix them with the onion and garlic
5. At the end add the tomato finely chopped also , and mix it with the onion , garlic and green chiles
6. Add the toasted flour and mix
7. Add the boiling water and the chicken bouillon , salt , pepper
8. Add the potatoes and the milk , and as soon as it boils , add the cheese pieces let it boil for like a minute and turn it off
9. I add it to each plate at the end but thats up to you)

title: uncle bill s apple filling for peroshky
steps:
1. Prepare apples and place into a mixing bowl
2. Sprinkle lemon juice over and mix to coat
3. This prevents the apples from turning brown
4. In a mixing bowl , mix together sugar , tapioca starch and ground cinnamon and mix well
5. Add mixture to apples and mix well to coat
6. Let mixture sit for 5 minutes before using
7. Add about 1 1 / 2 tablespoons of apple mixture to the dough rounds or the prepared pastry cups
8. Bake in preheated 400 f oven for 12 to 15 minutes or until crust is just lightly browned

title: scotcheroos
steps:
1. Measure out 6 cups of rice krispies into large bowl
2. Measure out 1 1 / 2 cups of peanut butter , add to bowl with cereal
3. Heat 1 cup karo syrup and 1 cup sugar to a boil in a 2-quart sauce pan , stirring constantly
4. Remove and pour on peanut butter
5. Stir until cereal is covered , spread mixture into 9x13 pan , set aside
6. Melt chocolate and butterscotch chips in microwave or over medium heat on stove
7. Spread on top of cereal mixture
8. Refrigerate for 1 hour
9. Bars will cut best when they've warmed to room tempreature

title: mini sausage breafast casseroles
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f spray muffin tins well with non-stick spray
2. Mix the cottage cheese , eggs , flour , baking powder , and salt until blended
3. Add the remaining ingredients , and pour into muffin tins
4. Bake until they are golden brown on top and a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean , approximately 25-30 minutes

title: wild grape jelly
steps:
1. In large saucepan , crush grapes with potato masher
2. Pour in water and bring to boil
3. Reduce heat and simmer , covered , for 10 minutes or until fruit is very soft
4. Transfer to jelly bag or colander lined with a double thickness of fine cheesecloth and let drip overnight
5. Measure juice into a large heavy saucepan
6. Stir in sugar
7. Bring to boil over high heat , stirring constantly
8. Stir in pectin
9. Return to full boil and boil hard for one minute , stirring constantly
10. Remove from heat and skim off foam with a metal spoon
11. Pour into sterilized jars , leaving 1 / 8 inch headspace

title: ginger spice roll
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. Grease a 15x10x1 inch jelly roll pan
3. Line pan with parchment paper and grease
4. Dust pan with flour
5. Beat egg yolks for 4 minutes in a large bowl with an electric mixer at high speed until thick and lemony
6. Add butter and molasses and beat 1 minute
7. In a separate bowl , beat egg whites until foamy
8. Add sugar , beating until soft peaks form
9. Fold in egg yolk mixture
10. Sift together flour , baking soda , ginger , cinnamon , cloves , and nutmeg
11. Fold into egg mixture until blended
12. Pour batter into prepared pan
13. Bake 10 to 12 minutes until cake is golden and edges begin to pull away from sides of pan
14. Dust a clean linen towel with powdered sugar
15. Invert cake onto towel and peel off parchment paper
16. Gently roll cake with towel
17. Allow to cool
18. Meanwhile make filling
19. Beat cream cheese and butter in medium bowl
20. Stir in powdered sugar , vanilla , ginger and cinnamon until smooth
21. Unroll cake and spread with filling
22. Roll back up and sprinkle with more powdered sugar
23. Slice thin to serve
24. S

title: roasted root vegetables with chermoula
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425f
2. Place oil , garlic , paprika , cumin and salt in a food processor or blender and pulse or blend until smooth
3. Place potato , sweet potato , turnip , rutabaga , carrots and squash in a roasting pan large enough to accommodate the pieces in a single layer
4. Toss with the spiced oil mixture until well combined
5. Roast the vegetables , stirring once or twice , until tender , 45 to 50 minutes

title: doughnut glaze
steps:
1. Soften 1 / 2 pkg of gelatin with 2 tablespoons of cold water
2. Add boiling water and then add the powdered sugar
3. Mix till it is smooth

title: loobia polow
steps:
1. Peel and slice onions and fry in oil until slightly golden
2. Cut meat into small pieces and add to onions
3. Fry over medium heat until colour changes
4. Wash green beans and cut into 2-3 cm pieces
5. Add to meat with 1-2 glasses of hot water and cook for about 30 minutes on medium heat , adding more hot water if necessary
6. Add tomato paste , salt and black pepper and cook for another 15 minutes on medium heat
7. Prepare rice as described in the recipe for polow but after rice is half-cooked and rinsed , add the meat-mix and mix well
8. Cover and cook over low heat for about 30 minutes

title: easy roast turkey with apple stuffing
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325
2. Place onion , apple and half lemon in turkey cavity- reserve other half of lemon-put some of it in neck cavity if desired place turkey breast side down on oiled rack in roasting pan
3. Sprinkle with salt and pepper
4. Roast uncovered for 2 hours , basting with pan juices occasionally
5. Wearing clean oven mitts or my preference disposable latex gloves , turn turkey breast side up squeeze remaining lemon half over turkey breast and cover with bacon
6. Roast basting occasionally about another 2 hours or until done with meat thermometer giblet stock
7. While turkey roasts place all ingredients in medium saucepan
8. Bring to boil over medium heat
9. Reduce heat and simmer for 1 hour partly covered
10. Strain and add liquid to gravy
11. Apple stuffing
12. Cook bacon in skillet , until crisp and set aside
13. Add onion , celery and garlic to skillet and cook until soft-set aside
14. In large bowl , combine , bacon , onion , celery , garlic and lemon juice
15. Add bread cubes , apple , egg , parsley and spices
16. Spoon into greased baking dish
17. Cover with foil and cook in oven along with turkey for 30 minutes
18. Stir , add some juices from turkey and cook uncovered until golden brown

title: cappuccino in a jar
steps:
1. Have ready 2 canning jars
2. Put the instant coffee into a food processor , and process to a fine powder
3. If you don't have a food processor , put it into a large plastic bag , and crush with a rolling pan
4. In a large bowl , combine creamer , chocolate mix , instant coffee , sugar , cinnamon , and nutmeg
5. Stir together until well mixed
6. Spoon into 2- 12 ounce jars
7. Attach a

title: ginger dressing
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in a bowl
2. Whisk until well combined
3. Set aside for 10 minutes
4. Serve over a green salad

title: herbed chicken skewers
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients and let the chicken marinate for 20 minutes
2. Thread onto soaked skewers , bbq for 6-7 minutes until the meat is brown and tender
3. Serve with salad and bread

title: creamy mashed potato casserole with spinach and feta cheese
steps:
1. Cook the poatoes in boiling water until very tender
2. Mash with a potato masher or a fork
3. In a large bowl , mix together the mashed potatoes with the butter , sour cream , salt and pepper
4. Set the oven to 350 degrees
5. Butter a 10 cup casserole dish
6. Wash the fresh spinach leaves
7. Place the wet leaves in a microwave-safe dish
8. Cover , and microwave on high for 2-3 minutes , when cool , enough to handle , squeeze out all excess moisture
9. Chop coarsley , and place in a medium-size bowl
10. Stir in the feta cheese and the garlic
11. Stir the spinach mixture into the potatoes
12. Spoon the mixture into the prepared baking dish
13. Sprinkle with the grated parmesan cheese
14. Bake , uncovered in the center of the oven at 350 degrees about 40-50 minutes , or until the top is golden

title: strip t s
steps:
1. Cook coconut and sesame seeds in a dry skillet over medium heat until golden brown , stirring frequently
2. Transfer coconut and seeds to a pie plate and add bread crumbs , mixing well
3. Lightly beat egg whites and sesame oil in small large bowl
4. Add turkey strips and mix until all pieces are coated
5. Roll strips in coconut mixture one at a time and place on a baking sheet that has been sprayed with non stick cooking spray
6. Spray tops of strips with non stick spray
7. Bake at 425 degrees for 10 minutes
8. Remove from oven , turn pieces over and spray again with non stick spray
9. Return to oven and bake for 5 more minutes
10. Transfer strips to a platter and serve immediately with your favorite dipping sauce

title: cheesy corn bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. In a large dutch oven over medium heat , add butter
3. After butter has melted , add onions and garlic
4. Cook until onions have no color and are soft
5. Sprinkle flour over cooked onions and cook for one minute more
6. Add milk all at once and add lemon juice , stirring constantly till slightly thickened
7. Add cheese a little bit at a time stirring constantly until melted
8. Remove from heat and add ham and corn
9. Salt and pepper to taste
10. Transfer to a casserole dish and bake for 45 minutes
11. Let cool five minutes before serving

title: mini mocha macadamia muffins
steps:
1. In a small pot combine the hot coffee and 3 / 4 cup sugar and cook , stirring constanity just until sugar is dissolved
2. Wisk in the cocoa powder and cool to room temperature
3. Combine flour , baking powder , baking soda and salt in a small bowl and set aside
4. In a large bowl , cream together the butter and 2 tblsp sugar until light and fluffy , then add the eggs , one at a time , beating well after each addition
5. Add coffee mixture and beat until blended
6. Fold in half the dry ingredients using a spoon or spatula
7. Fold in sour cream , then add remaining flour mixture
8. Lastly , stir in the nuts and chocolate
9. Fill muffin cups 3 / 4 full
10. Bake 10-15 minutes at 400 degrees f
11. Makes 48 mini muffins
12. And that's a pile of muffins even if they are mini size

title: honey nut bars
steps:
1. Beat butter or margarine and shortening in a large mixing bowl with an electric mixer on medium to high speed for 30 seconds
2. Add honey , baking powder , and salt
3. Beat until combined
4. Beat in eggs and vanilla until combined
5. Beat in as much of the flour as you can with the mixer
6. Stir in any remaining flour with a wooden spoon
7. Stir in coconut and 1 cup walnuts
8. Spread batter in a greased 13x9x2-inch pan
9. Bake in a 350 degree f oven for 25 to 30 minutes or until a wooden toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean
10. Cool in pan on a wire rack
11. Meanwhile , for the powdered sugar icing , stir together sifted powdered sugar , vanilla , and milk
12. Stir in additional milk , 1 teaspoon at a time , until icing is drizzling consistency
13. Drizzle with powdered sugar icing
14. Sprinkle with nuts
15. Cut into bars
16. Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator up to 3 days
17. Make-ahead
18. Do not frost with icing
19. Place uncut bars in a freezer container and freeze for up to 1 month
20. Before serving , cut into bars and thaw for 15 minutes
21. Drizzle with icing and sprinkle with nuts

title: muffuletta w  kickin olive salad
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Pulse olives , vegetables , and oil in a food processor until chopped , add a bit of the stuffed olive brine if salad needs it
3. Brush cut sides of the focaccia with vinegar and sprinkle with oregano
4. Layer meats and cheese on the bottom half of the bread
5. Top with olive salad and the other half of the bread
6. Wrap in foil and bake until heated through , about 30 minutes
7. Slice into quarters , then cut each quarter in half diagonally , and serve

title: chocolate walnut cranberry cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Spray a 10 inch springform pan with cooking spray
3. Combine flour and the next 5 ingredients in a large bowl , stirring with a whisk
4. Combine applesauce , milk , and oil
