5. Add to flour mixture , stirring just until moist
6. Stir in cranberries and walnuts
7. Spread the batter in the pan
8. Bake for 45 minutes or until edges begin to pull away from sides of pan
9. Cool on a wire rack
10. When cool , sprinkle with powdered sugar

title: tres leches cake with seasonal fruit
steps:
1. Bake the cake according to the instructions and allow to cool thoroughly combine the 3 milks and add to the cooled cake
2. Allow the cake to soak overnight in the refrigerator
3. Cut the cake , garnish with the fruit and whipped cream

title: authentic hungarian goulash
steps:
1. Saute the onions in a dutch oven with 2 t olive oil over medium-low heat until they are golden and carmelized , about 45 minutes
2. Put the onions in a bowl and add 1 / 2 cup of water to the pot , scrape up all the brown bits and then pour it into the bowl of onions
3. In a plastic bag shake the flour , thyme , marjoram and beef until coated
4. Brown beef in the dutch oven with 1 t olive oil and save the extra flour mixture
5. Add the onions , 2 cups of water , wine , bay leaf and paprika
6. Cover , simmer and stir occasionally for 3 hours or until tender
7. Put 2 cups of sauce in a saucepan , pour a little warm water into the reserved flour mixture until it is the consistency of cream , add it to the saucepan and cook , stirring , until thickened
8. Pour contents of saucepan into dutch oven and cook another 5 minutes
9. Season with salt and pepper and serve over noodles
10. If using sour cream add it just before serving

title: mama mia crock pot spaghetti sauce
steps:
1. In a large skillet , brown meats with garlic and onion
2. When cooked through , pour in red wine
3. Meanwhile add remaining ingredients to crock pot
4. Then spoon meat mixture into crock pot
5. Cook on high heat 4-6 hours or all day on low
6. Serve over cooked spaghetti
7. You can also use it for lasagna
8. Mmmm

title: marinated green olives  tapas
steps:
1. Place the olives in a bowl
2. Mix in the garlic , coriander , fennel , thyme , rosemary , orange zest and orange juice
3. Transfer to a jar into which they just fit
4. Pour in olive oil to cover olives
5. Shake well and let marinate at room temperature for 6 days

title: apple gorgonzola fettuccine
steps:
1. Cook fettucini according to package directions
2. Cut the apple into 1-inch pieces
3. Melt one tbsp of butter in a pan , and saute the minced garlic until soft
4. Add the rest of the butter to the pan , then the walnuts and apples and saute until the apples are just heated through
5. Be careful that they don't get soggy
6. Make sure your noodles are heated !
7. Quickly toss the hot noodles together with the sauteed mixture and the crumbled gorgonzola cheese
8. Salt to taste
9. Enjoy !

title: crunchy fudge squares
steps:
1. Line an 8" pan with waxed paper
2. In a double boiler , melt chocolate chips , condensed milk , cocoa and peanut butter
3. While that is coming together , gather up the remaining ingredients
4. When the chocolate mixture becomes all creamy and blended together , remove from heat and quickly mix in the vanilla , chow mein noodles and oats
5. Dump into pan
6. With slightly damp fingers , press the fudge out to the edges
7. Place in the fridge to chill for about 1 1 / 2 - 2 hours
8. Cut into small squares
9. Keep covered as it will dry out

title: asian turkey or chicken salad with mandarin balsamic vinaigrette
steps:
1. Toss all salad ingredients except ramen noodles
2. Mix all dressing ingredients
3. Pour dressing over salad and toss
4. Add broken ramen noodles and enjoy

title: strawberries in orange butterscotch sauce
steps:
1. Hull strawberries , and if large , slice in half
2. Melt butter in a medium sized pan , add brown sugar and cook until sugar is just starting to melt
3. Add the orange juice and rind , and cook stirring until sugar has dissolved
4. Stir in the cream
5. Add the strawberries and warm through gently
6. Warm brandy separately , light , and pour over strawberries
7. Serve over vanilla icecream or crepes

title: deep fried mozzarella cheese sticks
steps:
1. Mix together the eggs and water , set aside
2. Combine the italian bread crumbs , garlic powder , dried oregano and dried parsley
3. Salt and pepper to taste
4. In a separate container , mix flour and cornstarch
5. Cut mozzarella cheese into any desired shape , rectangle strips are traditional
6. One at a time , dip mozarella slices into the egg mixture , then the breadcrumbs , then the flour
7. Fry sticks at 375 f until golden brown and serve with desired dipping sauce

title: swamp water
steps:
1. Pour milk in blender
2. Add jello powder and ice cream
3. Put lid on blender
4. Blend at high speed 30 seconds or until smooth
5. Pour into glasses and serve immediately
6. For a "frosty" look , freeze glasses for 1 / 2 hour before serving

title: simple cream of broccoli soup
steps:
1. Cook broccoli as directed on package
2. Do not drain
3. Add the remaining ingredients
4. Simmer for 1 hour

title: avocado   apple salad  ensalada de aguacate y manzana
steps:
1. Arrange avocado , apples , and almonds on a serving platter as you wish
2. Whisk together remaining ingredients and pour over fruit

title: salmon with ginger and orange sauce
steps:
1. Add a little peanut oil to a pan , about 1 / 2 tablespoon , add chili , ginger and garlic , cook for a minute , add marmalade , manis , vinegar and sugar , stir to heat through
2. Add another half tablespoon oil to another pan , cook fish skin side down first , to crisp skin , turn and cook salmon until pink , and flakes easily and is cooked as desired
3. Heat remaining tablespoon of peanut oil in a wok add pepper and garlic , stir fry 1 minute , turn heat down , add asian veg pack , asparagus and bean sprouts , stir fry until veg are tender
4. To serve: place vegetables on a plate top with salmon and drizzle with sauce

title: mom s chicken parmigiana
steps:
1. To make the chicken cutlets , heat 1 / 3 cup olive oil in a heavy 10-12 inch skillet over medium-high heat until shimmery
2. Gently pound out chicken breasts to flatten slightly
3. Combine breadcrumbs , parmesan cheese , salt , and pepper in a wide , shallow bowl
4. Whisk egg and water in another shallow bowl
5. Spread 1 / 4 cup flour on a plate
6. Coat the chicken with the flour and shake off the excess
7. Dip in the egg mixture and then coat with the breadcrumb mixture , patting with your fingers to make crumbs stick
8. Add the chicken to olive oil and cook until lightly browned , 2-3 minutes
9. Using tongs , turn the cutlets and cook 2-3 minutes more
10. Add a little more oil if the pan looks dry
11. Blot the chicken with paper towels
12. To make the parmigiana
13. Melt butter in a medium pan
14. Saute onions and add garlic for about 1 minute
15. Add tomato sauce and paste
16. Slowly add paste until you get desired thickness , you may not need all of it
17. Add italian seasoning and oregano
18. Cook over medium heat until hot
19. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
20. Grease a 13x9 inch pan or shallow baking dish
21. Spoon 1 / 2 cup of tomato sauce into the bottom of the pan
22. Arrange the chicken cutlets over the sauce , slightly overlapping them
23. Sprinkle with grated parmesan cheese
24. Spoon 1 cup of tomato sauce over the top of cutlets
25. Top with mozzarella cheese slices and 1 / 2 cup parmesan cheese
26. Cover the pan with aluminum foil and bake until heated through , about 25 minutes
27. Take foil off and bake another 5 to brown the top
28. Serve over your favorite pasta !

title: toblerone cocktail
steps:
1. Blend and serve over ice or blend with ice for a frosted drink
2. Drizzle top with chocolate syrup

title: glazed carrots ii
steps:
1. Cook with a little bit of water covering the carrots
2. Cook until tender
3. Drain
4. Add orange juice and mix
5. Add butter and brown sugar
6. Simmer / stir until butter and sugar melt
7. Carrots should have a "glazed" look to them

title: savoury rice
steps:
1. Melt butter in skillet and cook onions and celery until translucent
2. Into buttered casserole dish put alternate layers of rice , onion / celery mixture , and mushrooms
3. Add salt and a little pepper
4. Pour the two cans of broth over the mix and place covered in oven at 350f for 45 minutes or until liquid is absorbed
5. If rice seems dry , add a little water

title: sauteed apple  onion n  bell pepper
steps:
1. Put butter to melt in a flat bottomed pan
2. Let it go hot a little
3. Take care not to burn the same
4. Add all the chopped ingredients and increase the heat to the highest
5. While you see juices oozing out , add salt and black pepper powder
6. Keep sauteeing on high heat for around 4-5 minutes
7. Let the edges go brown a little
8. Remove from heat and serve warm with breads or steamed rice
9. Enjoy !

title: escarole and beans in red sauce
steps:
1. Soak the beans overnight
2. Drain and cover with 6 cups hot water and cook for 1 1 / 2 hours or until tender
3. Drain
4. Heat olive oil and chopped garlic for one minute
5. Add chopped escarole and cook until wilted down
6. This will look like a lot of greens , but by the end will cook down until almost nothing
7. Add beans , tomato sauce , diced tomatoes and broth
8. Stir to combine
9. Simmer together uncovered for 45 minutes until slightly thickened
10. Add salt and pepper to taste
11. Serve in bowls with delicious crusty bread !

title: my low carb catsup
steps:
1. Combine all the ingredients in a small saucepan
2. Mix thoroughly and bring to a simmer
3. Allow to simmer on low until the catsup is desired consistency
4. Taste and adjust seasonings if desired
5. This should keep in the refrigerator for at least a week

title: rogene s banana nut bread   see sharon s note
steps:
1. Cream butter and sugar , add eggs
2. Blend in flour , soda , and salt
3. Mix thoroughly , then add bananas and nuts
4. Makes 1 large loaf cooked at 350 degrees for 60 minutes or 2 small loaves baked for 40-45 minutes

title: new orleans skillet baked cornbread
steps:
1. Place an iron skillet 2 / 3 full with water on the floor of your oven before preheating to achieve a crisp crust and moist interior
2. Preheat oven to 425 degrees sift dry ingredients together into a large mixing bowl
3. Add egg , milk , and 1 / 4 cup shortening and beat with a wooden spoon until smooth , about 1 minute
4. Grease an 8 or 9 inch skillet or heavy square baking pan with the shortening or bacon drippings
5. Pour batter into pan and place in oven
6. Bake 25-30 minutes until light golden brown on top
7. To serve , take skillet to table and cut bread into wedges
8. Top with butter and / or honey if desired

title: southern sweet potato soup
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees
2. Line the broiling pan with foil and spread the cubed sweet potato in a single layer and drizzle the first amount of oil over the potatoes
3. Roast the potatoes for about 15-20 minutes , turn once
4. Heat the second amount of oil in a soup pan over medium heat and cook the onion , garlic , celery , and shallot until soft
5. Add the tomato paste and stir until combined with vegetables
6. Add the broth , cream corn , bay leaf and bring to a boil , add the baking potato and cover the pot and simmer 25-30 minutes or until the potato is tender
7. Add the sweet potatoes , whole corn kernels , and cream or milk , stir well
8. Season to taste with salt and pepper
9. Enjoy !

title: baked apples  with chopped hazelnuts
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180c
2. Core the apples , using an apple corer
3. If you dont have a corer , use a sharp knife leaving a wider opening at the top than at the bottom
4. There is no need to remove the apple skins
5. In a mixing bowl , combine the sugar , butter , hazelnuts , raisins , cinnamon and zest
6. Stuff the apples firmly with the fruit mixture
7. Pack the apples as much as possible and then pile any leftover mix into mounds on top of the apples
8. Place the apples into a baking dish , casserole or cake tin
9. Use a dish that fits them as snugly as possible-this will stop them from falling over
10. I usually use a pyrex pie / tart baking dish
11. Spoon 1 teaspoon of honey / syrup over each apple
12. I usually just guess the amount for each apple and use a pouring top bottle of honey
13. Pour the water into the bottom of the dish
14. Bake for 30-40 minutes , or until the apples are soft
15. Serve drizzled with any syrup remaining in the bottom of the dish
16. Serve with cream , ice-cream or custard if desired

title: spinach tomato pasta
steps:
1. Make pasta , drain , set aside
2. Saute onions and garlic in olive oil
3. Meanwhile , melt butter in large saucepan
4. Add flour gradually stirring until smooth
5. Slowly add half& half and milk and simmer until thickened , stirring constantly
6. Add cheese and italian seasoning , stirring until cheese is melted
7. Add tomatoes , spinach , and onion mixture and heat through
8. Pour sauce over warm pasta and serve

title: apple squares or apple coffee cake
steps:
1. Combine sugar and eggs
2. Stir in oil and vanilla
3. Combine flour , baking soda , cinnamon and salt and add to sugar mixture , stirring to combine
4. Stir in apples and walnuts
5. Spread evenly in an ungreased 13x9-inch pan
6. Bake at 375f for 45-50 minutes

title: aunt marge s potato chip cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. In large bowl cream together shortening and powdered sugar
3. Stir in flour
4. Beat in the vanilla
5. Fold in potato chips
6. Drop by spoonfuls 1 1 / 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet
7. Bake for 15-18 minutes until lightly golden brown
8. Sprinkle with powdered sugar

title: julia child s master recipe for beef bourguignon  in red wine
steps:
1. Make herb bouquet and tie in washed cheesecloth the following: 8 sprigs parsley , 1 large bay leaf , 1 t dried thyme , 4 whole cloves or allspice berries and 3 large cloves of smashed , unpeeled garlic together in a small square of washed cheesecloth
2. Can substitute with celery leaves and / or washed split leeks
3. Dry out the beef chunks by salting and peppering each and letting them sit at room temperature
4. Saute the bacon slices and set aside on paper towels
5. Choose a large frying pan and brown beef chunks on all sides in bacon grease , being careful not to crowd the meat
6. Turn browned meat into a heavy ovenproof casserole
7. Remove all but a little of the fat from the pan and add the sliced vegetables
8. Brown them and add them to the beef chunks in the casserole pot
9. Deglaze the pan with the wine and then pour liquid into the casserole with the meat and carrots and onions
10. Add enough beef stock or bouillon to almost cover all
11. Stir in the tomatoes and add the herb bouquet
12. Bring to a simmer over medium to medium-high heat
13. Cover and simmer slowly , either on the stove over a low heat or in a preheated oven set to 325 degrees
14. Cook until the meat is tender , tasting to check
15. Cook , "brown-braised" onions as follows: peel onions , heat butter and oil in a medium pan and saute in one layer until colored
16. Cover onions with a little water , salt to taste and 1 tsp sugar
17. Cover pan and cook at a rapid boil for 10-15 minutes , or until tender
18. To saute mushrooms , quarter washed mushrooms
19. Heat 1-1 / 2 tbs of butter and 1
20. 2 tbs olive oil in a large frying pan and when the foaming has subsided , turn in the mushrooms
21. Saute for several minutes , tossing frequently as the butter is absorbed and then reappears on the surface when the mushrooms begin to brown
22. Toss in 1 / 2 tbs chopped shallots , if desired , season with salt and pepper and saute another 30 seconds
23. Drain the meat and vegetables through a colander into a saucepan , pressing the juices out of the residue
24. Return the meat to the casserole pot and degrease the pan
25. Boil the liquid down to 3 cups
26. Off heat , whisk in the beurre manie [3 t flour mixed into a paste with 2 t softened butter) and add to cooking liquid
27. Simmer for 2 minutes as the sauce thickens slightly
28. Correct seasonings and pour over the meat , folding in the sauteed onions and mushrooms
29. {may be completed to this point a day in advance for a dinner party)
30. To serve , bring to a simmer , basting the meat and vegetables with the sauce for several minutes until thoroughly hot throughout
31. Serve with mashed or boiled potatoes , tinkyada brown rice pasta or a very good french bread or baguettes

title: iced hazelnut coffee
steps:
1. Pour 6 cups brewed coffee into ice cube trays
2. Freeze until firm
3. Combine hazelnut-flavored coffee , milk , and sugar
4. Stir until sugar dissolves
5. Pour over coffee ice cubes and serve immediately

title: chicken breasts with yogurt sauce
steps:
1. Melt butter in a large skillet
2. Add chicken and season with salt , pepper , and paprika
3. Brown on both sides
4. Add scallions , parsley , chicken stock , and lemon juice
5. Bring to a boil
6. Reduce heat and simmer covered about 20 minutes , or until chicken is tender
7. Remove chicken and arrange on a serving planter
8. Add mushrooms to the stock
9. Simmer uncovered 3 minutes
10. Blend in yogurt and walnuts
11. Add a little water if too thick
12. Heat just to warm yogurt
13. Do not boil
14. Pour sauce over chicken

title: old fashioned linguine with white clam sauce
steps:
1. In a 5 qt pot , heat water to a boil and cook pasta until al dente
2. While the pasta is cooking , melt butter and olive oil in pan
3. Sautee onion and garlic , and add crushed red pepper flakes
4. Add lemon juice , oregano , basil , and old bay seasoning , stir for one minute add clams with juice
5. Simmer for 5 minutes
6. Drain pasta and place in large bowl
7. Cover pasta with clam sauce , stir well and top with parsley and parmesan cheese
8. Serve with warm crusty bread and chilled white wine

title: spinach basil soup with lemon
steps:
1. In a large sauce pan , melt the butter over low heat and saute the onion until soft , about 10 minutes
2. Add the garlic , saute another minute or two
3. Mix in the drained spinach , basil and chicken broth and bring to a boil
4. Reduce the heat and simmer , uncovered , approximately 10 minutes
5. Mix in the remaining ingredients
6. Heat and serve

title: peanut butter   jelly wraps
steps:
1. You will also need: a drinking glass or rolling pin lay bread on a smooth counter top and use your drinking glass to roll over the bread a few times until the bread is flat and make sure you get the edges or crust too
2. Spread peanut better and jelly on the flattened bread
3. Roll bread up like a tortilla and viola !

title: kittencal s chocolate frosting icing
steps:
1. Cream the butter in a small bowl
2. Blend in the cocoa powder , vanilla , confectioners sugar , alternately with the cream
3. Beat with an electric mixer , until the desired texture is achieved

title: blueberry and banana pancakes
steps:
1. Mix flour , sugar , baking powder and salt in a large bowl
2. Add eggs , milk , melted butter , mashed bananas , cinnamon and vanilla
3. Stir until well blended and smooth
4. Gently fold in the blueberries
5. Spoon 1 / 8-1 / 4 cup of batter for each pancake on preheated , greased griddle or skillet
6. Once bubbling throughout on surface , turn over and cook until done

title: cabbage with juniper berries and cream
steps:
1. Quarter the cabbage , remove the core , and cut into wide ribbons or squares
2. Boil , uncovered , in generously salted water for 4 minutes
3. Drain , rinse under cool water , and squeeze out the excess moisture with your hands
4. Melt the butter in a large skillet
5. Add the leek , juniper , and 1 tbls
6. Water
7. Cook over medium heat until the leek is tender , about 5 minutes
8. Add the cabbage and cream
9. Taste a piece of the cabbage and add more sea salt if needed
10. Cover the pan and simmer over low heat 10 minutes
11. Taste again for salt and season with pepper
12. To make the cabbage stuffed cabbage with blue cheese:
13. Blanch and separate 8 cabbage leaves
14. Before stuffing , remove tough white vein at the base of each leaf
15. Place 1 / 2 cup of the cooked cabbage in the center of each leaf and set a cube of blue cheese inside that
16. Roll up the leaf , folding in the sides as you gor
17. Twist the roll in a towel to give it a plump , round shape
18. Steam until heated through , about 10 minutes , and serve

title: mc donald s hot mustard sauce   copycat
steps:
1. Mix all of the ingredients together in a microwave safe container until it is one solid color
2. A fork works well forthis
3. Microwave on high about 35 seconds , and mix again
4. Cover , and refrigerate at least 6 hours
5. Refrigerate until needed , and remember to refrigerate unused portions
6. This recipe makes a little more than 4 "packets" of hot mustard sauce
7. Double it or triple it as needed

title: perfect pizza dough
steps:
1. In bread maker measure first six ingredients in the order listed above into the baking pan
2. Insert baking pan and close lid
3. Select dough setting and push start button
4. There will be a 25 minute preheat delay before mixing begins
5. The complete signal will sound when dough is done
6. Using pot holders or oven mitts remove baking pan to a lightly floured surface
7. If necessary , knead in enough flour to make dough easy to handle
8. Divide dough into thirds
9. Roll out one piece of dough and place on pan , top with desired pizza toppings or make into one large pizza
10. Bake in oven preheated at 425f or 218c for 15-25 minutes

title: good for your gut guacamole
steps:
1. Mash avocado in a mixing bowl
2. Add diced tomato , onion and green pepper
3. Mix in garlic powder , salt and chili powder
4. Dip fresh vegetables or tortilla chips
5. Enjoy !

title: cunetto s tutto mare
steps:
1. Cook pasta until al dente
2. In the meantime , simmer rest of ingredients 5 minutes
3. Add fish mixture to drained pasta and simmer additional 3 minutes
4. Sprinkle liberally with parmesan

title: hot chocolate with skim milk  cocoa powder and maple syrup
steps:
1. Whisk everything together and heat over medium low heat for about 10 minutes , whisking often
2. Please
3. If you have an immersion blender , whip the mixture up with it for about a minute to make it a little frothy

title: octoberfest bratwurst and sauerkraut skillet
steps:
1. Fry bacon in a large skillet over medium heat until crisp
2. Remove from pan , drain , and crumble
3. Set aside
4. Drain off all but 2 tbsp of dripping in pan
5. Add onion and garlic to drippings
6. Cook over medium heat until tender , stirring occasionally
7. Stir in sauerkraut , potatoes , 2 cups water , apple cider , brown sugar , bouillon , caraway , and bay leaf
8. Bring to a boil over heat
9. Meanwhile , brown bratwurst in another skillet over medium heat until browned , turning to brown all sides
10. Add to sauerkraut mixture when it comes to a boil
11. Then reduce heat , cover , and simmer for 20-30 minutes , or until potatoes are tender , stirring occasionally
12. Add apples , and cook , covered , for 5-10 minutes more or until apples are tender
13. Stir in the bacon , and discard the bay leaf
14. Serve

title: swiss poppy seed bread
steps:
1. Cut loaf of french bread into 10 slices , 3 / 4 of the way through
2. Insert slices of swiss cheese between each of the bread slices
3. Saute onion in butter until transparent , not brown
4. Add poppy seed to butter
5. Spoon butter / onion / poppy seed mixture between the slices of bread and cheese
6. Wrap in foil
7. Bake at 300 degrees until the cheese melts and the bread is hot throughout , about 20-25 minutes

title: honey basil tea  shahad aur tulsi ke chai
steps:
1. Combine the basil leaves and water in a saucepan
2. Bring to a boil and simmer very gently for 5 minutes
3. Add the tea , ginger , honey , and peppercorns and bring back to a boil
4. Remove from the heat and steep , covered , for 5 more minutes
5. Just before serving , return to a boil and strain into tea cups

title: shrimp with hot sauce  szechuan style
steps:
1. Stir together ingredients for the seasoning sauce in a small bowl and keep near the cooking area
2. Stir together the cornstarch and water in a small dish and keep near the cooking area
3. Heat small amount of oil in wok or large skillet
4. Add shrimp and stir-fry until they just turn pink and start to curl
5. Remove from pan and set aside
6. Add a little oil to pan and heat
7. Add dried peppers and garlic to pan and cook just until you start to smell them
8. Do not allow to burn
9. Add the carrots and cook for 1- 1 1 / 2 minutes
10. Return the shrimp to the pan and toss with the carrots
11. Re-stir contents of seasoning bowl and add to pan
12. Quickly stir all ingredients
13. Re-stir the cornstarch and water slurry and add to the pan
14. Stir mixture and cook until sauce thickens and shrimp are coated with sauce
15. Remove from heat and serve with steamed rice

title: mama s macaroni pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Cut one block of cheese into small chunks
3. In a round casserole dish , mix the macaroni , eggs , butter , small chunks of cheese , and a few shakes of paprika together
4. Add the evaporated milk
5. The mixture should be thick , but not slushy
6. Cut the second block of cheese into strips , and place on top of the casserole
7. Sprinkle a little more paprika on top
8. Place some pieces of butter on top
9. Bake for 20 minutes until the top bubbles and becomes golden brown
10. Let it cool before cutting with a spatula into wedges , like a piece of pie

title: chocolate raspberry bread pudding with raspberry sauce
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f
2. In large bowl combine milk , sugar , egg and vanilla extract
3. Add bread squares to the cream mixture
4. Mix until all of the bread cubes are well coated
5. Let sit for 15 minutes so the bread can soak up the cream mixture
6. Stir every five minutes
7. Mix in raspberries and chocolate chips
8. Pour mix into a greased , round "souffle" baking dish
9. Place in the oven and bake for 1 hour
10. Remove bread pudding from oven and cool for 10-15 minutes
11. While bread pudding is cooling , prepare raspberry sauce
12. Heat raspberries and sugar until sugar dissolves
13. Add brandy and lemon juice
14. Cook until thickened
15. Serve bread pudding warm with raspberry sauce

title: the best oatmeal cookies i ve found
steps:
1. Preheat over to 375
2. Combine flour , baking soda , and salt
3. Set aside
4. In a large bowl cream butter , sugars , eggs and vanilla until light and fluffy
5. At low speed beat in flour mixture
6. Stir in oats and coconut until well blended
7. Add chips if desired
8. Drop by slightly rounded teaspoons 2" apart
9. Bake until just turning golden brown around edges , roughly 10-12 minutes

title: quick coconut orange balls
steps:
1. Mix everything except the coconut
2. Roll into bite-sized balls and roll in coconut
3. Refrigerate until firm , or overnight

title: wasabi dip
steps:
1. Stir lemon juice and wasabi paste into the sour cream
2. Add crushed garlic and horseradish
3. Season with salt and pepper to taste

title: middle eastern chicken with pumpkin and couscous
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 200 degrees celcius
2. Combine chicken , pumpkin , spice and oil and place on a baking tray
3. Bake for around 20-25 minutes
4. Cool slightly and slice the chicken into strips
5. In a large serving bowl combine the coriander , lemon juice and rind , feta cheese , and couscous
6. Mix well
7. Finally fold through the pumpkin and the chicken pieces
8. Serve garnished with lemon slices and coriander

title: crabmeat or salmon patties
steps:
1. Finely crumble crackers into a bowl
2. You should have 1 cup of coarse meal
3. Flake crab meat or salmon into bowl with crumbs , breaking up any skin and bones if using the salmon
4. Add worcestershire , hot sauce , parsley , mustard , and mayonnaise
5. Mix until blended
6. Add egg and blend well
7. Shape mixture into 8 patties
8. Lay them on waxed paper or parchment near the frying pan
9. In a frying pan , melt 1 tablespoon of the butter over medium heat
10. Cook 4 patties until browned , about 3 minutes
11. Add another 1 / 2 tablespoon of butter , turn and brown the other side
12. Repeat with the remaining butter and patties
13. You can keep the first batch warm in the oven
14. To plate , sprinkle patties with chopped parsley
15. Serve with lemon wedges

title: baked cheese sandwiches
steps:
1. Butter both sides of bread
2. Lay 8 slices in a 9x13 inch pan
3. Spread mustard on top
4. Cover each slice with velveeta cheese
5. Cover with remaining bread slices
6. In seperate bowl mix together eggs , milk , salt and pepper
7. Mix well
8. Pour over bread and place in refrigerator overnight , or for at least 6 hours
9. Bake at 325 degrees for 1 hour
10. Cut into serving size pieces and serve hot

title: bite size goat cheese and walnut cheesecake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Butter 18 mini muffin tins
3. Combine the first three ingredients with 1 / 4 tsp salt and 1 / 4 tsp pepper
4. Place heaping teaspoonfuls off walnut mixture into each mold and press down firmly
5. In another bowl , beat cream cheese until fluffy
6. Add the goat cheese and beat until creamy
7. Add the egg and beat until thoroughly combined
8. Add the chives and the remainder of salt and pepper
9. Divide the goat cheese mixture between the cups and smooth the tops
10. Place a walnut piece on top of nine cheesecakes
11. Top the remaining with diced peppers
12. Bake until puffed- approx 15 minutes
13. Cook on wire rack for 5 minutes before unmolding
14. Garnish with chives and serve warm or cold

title: easy swirled cookie cups
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f grease 20 mini-muffin cups
2. Place squares of dough into prepared muffin cups
3. Press down to make a deep well
4. Bake for 10 to 11 minutes or until edges are set
5. Remove from oven to wire rack
6. While still warm , fill cookie cups with morsels
7. Morsels will soften and retain their shape
8. Cool completely
9. With

title: chicken richuvio
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in baking pan and marinate in refrigerator , covered , for at least 2 hours
2. Bake at 375 degrees , covered , for 30 minutes
3. Uncover and stir
4. Cover again and bake for another 15 minutes
5. Serve

title: microwave twice baked potatoes
steps:
1. Pierce the potatoes with a knife in several places
2. Microwave on high until cooked completely for 6 to 11 minutes
3. Cut the cooked potatoes in half lengthwise and allow to cool slightly
4. Meanwhile , combine the alfredo sauce , garlic powder , thyme and pepper
5. Add 1 / 2 cup of the cheese to the seasoned sauce
6. Using a grapefruit spoon or other small spoon , scoop out the potato pulp leaving a thin , skin shell
7. Add the scooped-out potato to the sauce mixture
8. Mix the sauce and the potato well
9. Spoon back into the potato shells
10. Sprinkle with the remaining cheese and teaspoon of bacon bits per shell
11. Microwave on high for 1 minute or until the cheese melts

title: easy creamy  cheesy potato soup w  crisp bacon
steps:
1. In a 3-qt sauce pan , combine potatoes , water , regular salt , and pepper
2. If using canned potatoes , bring to soft boil
3. Turn down heat to medium
4. Gradually add soup and milk , stirring constantly
5. Add onions , garlic , johnny's seasoning salt , and dashes of hot sauce , and allow to cook , while stirring , for 5 minutes
6. Stir in sour cream , bacon , and parsley , and heat thru
7. Top with additional pepper and cheese

title: nutter butter frozen peanut butter pie
steps:
1. To make crust , crush the cookies in a zipper style plastic bag with a rolling pin , or in a food processor
2. Mix cookie crumbs with butter
3. Press into bottom and sides of a 9 inch pie plate
4. Mix cream cheese , peanut butter , sugar and vanilla with electric mixer on medium speed until well blended
5. Gently stir in 1 1 / 2 cups whipped topping
6. Spoon into crust
7. Freeze 4 hours or overnight until firm
8. Let stand 1 / 2 hour or until pie can be cut
9. Garnish with remaining whipped topping and additional cookies if desired
10. Special extra: just before serving , drizzle chocolate flavored syrup on plates
11. Ifdesired , omit nutter butter cookie crust and use an oreo crust instead

title: coconut pecan icing
steps:
1. In a pan combine milk , sugar , egg yolks , butter and vanilla
2. Cook over medium heat , stir constantly , till thickened
3. Add the coconut and pecans
4. Beat by hand till icing is cool and thick enough to spread

title: penne with sausage and spinach
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a large nonstick skillet over med-high heat until just smoking
2. Add in sausage and cook , breaking apart the meat , until lightly browned and no longer pink , 3-5 minutes
3. Stir in garlic
4. Cook until fragrant , about 30 seconds
5. Stir in the water , broth , sun-dried tomatoes , and 1 / 2 teaspoon salt , then add in the pasta
6. Increase heat to high and cook at a vigorous simmer , stirring often , until the pasta is tender and the liquid has thickened , about 15-18 minutes
7. Stir in the spinach , a handful at a time , and cook until wilted
8. Off the heat , stir in the parmesan cheese and pine nuts
9. Season to taste with salt and pepper
10. Serve

title: cheese rarebit
steps:
1. Melt butter in a heavy saucepan over low heat
2. Add flour , stirring until smooth
3. Cook 1 minute , stirring constantly
4. Gradually add milk
5. Cook over medium heat , stirring constantly until mixture is thickened and bubbly
6. Stir in cheddar cheese , salt , dry mustard , and paprika
7. Gradually stir approx one-fourth of hot mixture into beaten egg
8. Add to remaining hot mixture
9. Cook mixture over low heat 1 minute
10. Serve over toast points

title: orange vanilla liqueur
steps:
1. Pare the peel from each orange in a spiral , producing a 1-inch-wide strip
2. Try to get mostly the orange zest and leave most of the white membrane on the fruit
3. Put the peels in a saucepan with the 1 cup water plus the corn syrups and sugar
4. Bring to a boil and let boil , stirring constantly , 8-10 minutes
5. Remove from the heat and add the extracts
6. Let cool to room temperature and add the vodka
7. Pour into a jar or bottle with a tight fitting lid and let stand at least 2 weeks

title: summer fresh strawberry pie
steps:
1. Wash , drain and slice strawberries and sprinkle them with the 1 / 8 cup sugar
2. Set aside
3. Mix cornstarch , 3 / 4 cup sugar and water in saucepan
4. Bring to boil and stir several minutes , while boiling , until thickened and clear
5. Remove from heat and stir in gelatin until dissolved
6. Place berries in cooked , cooled shell and pour gelatin mixture carefully on top
7. Refrigerate until chilled
8. When completely cooled , spread thick layer of cool whip on top

title: cola ribs
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine soy sauce , brown sugar , garlic , worcestershire sauce and black pepper
2. Rub mixture onto rib pieces
3. Layer ribs and onions in a dutch oven and pour cola over all
4. Cover and bake at 250f for 4 hours
5. Remove pan from oven and pour off cola juices
6. Add bbq sauce , cover and return to oven for 1 hour more

title: hot and sour chicken soup
steps:
1. Bring stock to the boil in a saucepan over high heat
2. Add garlic , lemongrass , three-quarters of the chili and half the lime leaves
3. Reduce heat to medium-low
4. Add chicken
5. Simmer , uncovered , turning chicken occasionally , for 8 to 10 minutes or until chicken is just cooked through
6. Transfer chicken to a plate
7. Allow to cool slightly
8. Shred chicken and set aside
9. Strain stock mixture into a large heatproof jug or bowl
10. Return strained stock to saucepan
11. Bring stock to the boil over medium-high heat
12. Add fish sauce , sugar , 2 tablespoons lime juice and remaining chilli to soup
13. Stir in 1 / 2 cup cilantro
14. Divide chicken between serving bowls
15. Ladle over boiling soup
16. Top with remaining cilantro and lime leaves
17. Serve with lime

title: cucumber and tomato yogurt  kheera ka ray
steps:
1. Peel , seed , and chop cucumber
2. Mix the cucumber and finely chopped green onions , season well with salt
3. Let it stand for about 15 minutes
4. The salt will help the cucumber release some of its natural juices - press it lightly and drain off any liquid
5. Wash and chop the tomatoes
6. Mix the chopped parsley and dill with the cucumber-onion mixture
7. Beat the yogurt well , and combine with the other ingredients
8. Seasoned with salt and pepper to taste
9. Let it chill for about an hour
10. Garnish with extra dill
11. This recipe is ideal for a light-hearted evening snack or a snack with bread

title: strawberry poke cake
steps:
1. Combine 3 cups strawberries , 1 / 4 c sugar , orange juice and water in a saucepan
2. Cover and cook over medium heat until strawberries break down and become soft
3. Preheat oven to 350f butter and flour a 13x9x2" baking pan
4. In a large bowl , whisk together flour , salt and baking powder
5. Whisk together milk , egg whites and vanilla , just until egg whites are broken up
6. In the work bowl of a stand mixer , cream together 1 3 / 4 cups sugar and butter , about 3 minutes , until fluffy
7. Reduce speed to low
8. Add half the wet ingredients , then half the dry ingredients , then the remaining wet followed by the remaining dry
9. Pour batter into prepared pan
10. Spread evenly
11. Bake on middle rack of preheated oven for 35 minute
12. Separate strawberry solids from liquid
13. Set the solids aside
14. Add gelatin powder to liquid
15. Stir well and let stand until cake is baked
16. When done , set cake on a baking rack and let cool at least one hour
17. Using a large skewer , poke cake about 50 times
18. Do not poke all the way to the bottom , or the gelatin will run underneath
19. Pour gelatin all over the top of the cake
20. Refrigerate 3 hours , or up to 1 day in advance
21. Combine reserved cooked strawberry solids with 1 c frozen strawberries and 2 tbsp sugar in the work bowl of a food processor
22. Pulse until it has the consistency of strawberry jam
23. Spread evenly over top of cake
24. Spread cake with whipped cream

title: crunchy caramel snack mix
steps:
1. In a 13x9x2 baking pan combine the 1st four ingredients
2. Set aside
3. In a medium saucepan combine sugar , margarine and corn syrup
4. Cook and stir over medium heat until butter melts and mixture comes to boiling
5. Cook without stirring 4 minutes
6. Remove from heat
7. Stir in baking soda and cream of tartar
8. Stir in vanilla
9. Pour over cereal mixture
10. Kind of mix it up
11. Bake in 300 degree oven for 30 minutes , stirring after 15 minutes
12. Transfer to a large shallow pan
13. Cool
14. Keep mix at room temperature for no more than one week in a tightly covered container or freeze in freezer bag for up to 3 months

title: yogurt parfaits with walnuts  dates   honey
steps:
1. Spoon yogurt onto several layers of heavy-duty paper towels
2. Spread to 1 / 2-inch thickness
3. Cover with additional paper towels
4. Let stand 5 minutes
5. Scrape yogurt into a bowl using a rubber spatula
6. Spoon 1 / 2 cup drained yogurt into each of six parfait glasses
7. Top each serving with 1 tablespoon chopped dates , 2 teaspoons chopped & toasted walnuts , and 1-1 / 2 teaspoons of honey
8. Cover and chill 1 hour
9. Sprinkle with cinnamon , if desired

title: real beef stew  not polictically correct
steps:
1. Season flour with salt , pepper and cajun seasoning to taste
2. After cutting beef stew meat into 3 / 4 inch pieces , dredge meat in seasoned flour
3. In a large stew pot , brown meat in hot olive oil
4. Add beef broth , sugar , celery , garlic , bay leaves , wine and hot sauce
5. Bring to a boil , reduce heat and simmer for one hour
6. Taste and season to your choice
7. Add carrots and potatoes , simmer until vegetables are tender
8. Add onions of choice and mushrooms , simmer until onions are tender
9. Remove bay leaves

title: fresh corn and tomato salad
steps:
1. Prepare an ice water bath by filling a large bowl halfway with ice and water
2. Set aside
3. Bring a large pot of heavily salted water to a boil over high heat
4. Add the corn kernels and cook until tender , about 4 minutes
5. Drain and place in the ice water bath until cool , about 4 minutes
6. Combine the lemon juice , salt , and pepper in a large , nonreactive bowl
7. While continuously whisking , add the oil in a steady stream until completely incorporated
8. Add the remaining ingredients and the cooled corn and toss until well coated
9. Serve

title: dijon sirloin tips
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300f
2. In a large skillet , brown meat in butter and oil
3. Transfer to a 2 quart baking dish
4. In same skillet , saut mushrooms and garlic until mushrooms are tender , about 3 minutes
5. Pour mushrooms and liquid over meat
6. Cover and bake for 2 hours or until meat is tender
7. In same skillet combine broth , vinegar and soy sauce
8. Bring to a boil
9. Boil for two minutes and set aside
10. Combine mustard , cornstarch and cream
11. Stir into broth mixture
12. Return to heat and boil for two minutes , stirring constantly
13. Drain juices from baking dish into broth mixture
14. Cook over medium heat , stirring constantly , until thickened and bubbly
15. Add beef and mushroom to cream mixture
16. Serve over hot cooked egg noodles

title: lemon chicken primavera
steps:
1. Steam carrots and asparagus together until tender
2. Try not to overcook
3. Keep warm
4. Cook the whole wheat fettucine according to package directions
5. Try to time this to get done when the chicken is done cooking
6. Blend together the chicken stock , corn starch , lemon pepper and garlic powder in a bowl and set aside
7. Cook chicken breast strips until no longer pink
8. Approximately 8 minutes
9. Pour the chicken stock mixture into pan and boil until it starts to thicken
10. Add in the fettucine , asparagus , and carrots
11. Stir well
12. When all combined stir in the basil and lemon peel
13. Cook an additional minute
14. And serve
15. You can sprinkle parmesan cheese on top of each serving if desired
16. Just know that the parmesan is not figured into the nutrition info listed

title: traditional british mothering sunday simnel cake
steps:
1. Check list: a sifter , nest of bowls , food processor or electric beater , spatula , wooden spoon , 24 cm round cake tin , baking paper , brown paper and twine , rolling pin , thin metal skewer
2. Stage 1
3. To make your own almond paste you will need a food processor fitted with a steel blade
4. Don't be tempted to use store-bought almond paste because it contains lots of sugar and few almonds , it will turn to liquid under the grill
5. Place icing sugar and almonds in food processor bowl
6. Process , slowly dripping in egg yolk , orange juice and almond essence
7. The mixture should form a pliable paste
8. Set aside a small portion for balls with which to decorate the cake
9. Roll out the remaining paste into 2 circles which are the approximate size of the tin
10. Set aside
11. Stage 2
12. Preheat oven to 160c / 320f
13. Use a sturdy non-stick cake tub or line the buttered base with baking paper
14. As the baking period is long , prevent the cake drying out by wrapping a double thickness of brown paper around the pan and securing it with twine
15. Sift flour , salt and spices together , then stir in fruit and peel
16. Cream butter and sugar thoroughly until light and creamy then beat in eggs one at a time , until the mixture is fluffy
17. Stir flour and fruit into creamed mixture
18. Stage 3
19. Place half the mixture into a greased and lined cake tin
20. Place one pre-rolled round of almond paste over the top
21. Cover with remaining cake mixture
22. Before baking the cake , give the pan of mixture a sharp tap on to a firm surface
23. This settles the mixture and prevents holes from forming in the cake
24. Bake in the centre of the oven for 1-1 1 / 4 hours or until a thin metal skewer inserted in the centre of the cake comes out without a trace of stickiness
25. Level the cake by placing a weighted plate on top of the cooked cake while it is still hot
26. Turn out cake on to a wire rack after leaving it to settle in the cake tin for between 10 and 15 minutes
27. Peel off paper and leave to cool completely
28. Stage 4
29. Cover the top of the cake with a second round of almond paste
30. Roll 11 small balls of paste and place evenly around the top of the cake
31. Brush the top with a little beaten egg and very lightly brown under the grill until the almond paste turns light golden brown
32. Remove and leave to cool

title: garam masala chicken
steps:
1. Heat oil in skillet on medium-high heat
2. Cook chicken 3 minutes or until lightly browned
3. Turn chicken
4. Add green onions
5. Cook and stir onions 2 minutes longer
6. Stir in tomatoes , garlic salt and water
7. Sprinkle 1 1 / 2 teaspoons of the garam masala over chicken and vegetables
8. Bring to boil
9. Reduce heat , cover and simmer 10 minutes , stirring occasionally or until chicken and vegetables are tender
10. Stir remaining 1 / 2 teaspoon garam masala into skillet
11. Bring to a boil
12. Reduce heat
13. Cook 5 minutes longer , stirring occasionally

title: pecan apple strudel cake  gluten free
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325f
2. Prepare a small deep pan by greasing and dusting with white rice flour
3. Mix all strudel ingredients in a small bowl and set aside
4. In a medium bowl , sieve together all the dry ingredients
5. Add the wet ingredients and mix with a wooden spoon
6. Add the chopped apples and stir to combine
7. Scoop half the batter into the prepared pan
8. Then layer half the strudel mixture on top of the batter
9. Add remaining batter and then remaining topping
10. Place in the oven and bake approximately 1 hour , or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean
11. Cool at least 10 minutes before serving
12. I like it better cooled down to room temperature even more
13. Enjoy !

title: salmon and chive crustless quiche
steps:
1. Brush butter over base and sides of a 24cm diameter flan dish
2. Sprinkle breadcrumbs evenly over base and sides
3. Place sour cream in a large bowl
4. Gradually whisk in eggs
5. Stir in salmon , chives cheese and flour
6. Pour mixture into flan dish
7. Bake at 180c for 30 minutes or until just set
8. Garnish with parsley and serve with salad and crusty bread , if desired

title: one point pumpkin pie  crustless
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Combine all ingredients
3. Spray 9" pie plate with pam
4. Pour mixture into pie plate
5. Bake at 400 f for 15 minutes
6. Reduce heat to 325 f and continue baking for about 45 minutes or until a knife comes out clean
7. Slice into 8 pieces

title: quick vegetable gumbo
steps:
1. Heat oil over med heat in a 4 qt dutch oven until hot
2. Add bell pepper , celery , onion and garlic
3. Stir until crisp tender
4. Add tomatoes , juice , beans , parsley , oregano , pepper sauce and bay leaves
5. Bring to boil over high heat
6. Add rice
7. Cover and reduce heat to simmer
8. Simmer 15 minutes or until rice is cooked
9. Add okra
10. Cover and cook 5 minutes longer or until okra is tender
11. Remove bay leaves

title: pizza crust fruit pizza
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Spray 12 inch pizza pan with cooking spray
3. Place crust on pan and bake for 8-10 minutes
4. In a bowl , blend cream cheese , sugar , and vanilla
5. Spread mixture over crust
6. Arrange bananaslices in a layer over cream cheese mixture
7. Arrange remaining fruit slices in circles over bananas , varying colors and shapes
8. Sprinkle with raisins and nuts
9. Cut into 10 wedges

title: winter wonderland pecans
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 250f place pecans into a large wide bowl
2. Set aside
3. Add spices to melted butter in a small bowl and stir
4. Pour over pecans , tossing gently to coat
5. Spread pecans evenly in a single layer onto a baking sheet and bake for 12-15 minutes
6. Remove from oven and allow to cool to room temperature
7. Place pecans in a plastic grocery bag filled with the powdered sugar
8. Holding the front and back sides of the bag , roll pecans by alternating lifting each side to tumble the pecans to coat thoroughly
9. Shake off excess sugar and place into a decorative serving dish

title: brown sugar peach ice cream
steps:
1. To peaches , add 1 / 2 cup of the sugar and the lemon juice
2. Set aside , covered in refrigerator
3. In a medium saucepan combine milk , eggs , and remaining sugar
4. Cook over low heat , stirring constantly , until mixture is thick enough to coat a metal spoon , about 15 minutes
5. Stir in cream and vanilla
6. Chill
7. Stir peaches in cream mixture and freeze in ice cream maker according to manufacturer's instructions

title: roasted eggplant with harissa potatoes and tomatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 420 degrees f
2. Peel eggplant and slice into 1 / 3 inch thick slices
3. Sprinkle with salt and let sit while you skin and cube the potatoes
4. Place a non-stick sheet or paper on a baking tray , pat eggplant slices dry and brush both sides of each slice with olive oil
5. Layer on baking tray and put in the oven for about 15 minutes
6. Watch them , they might take longer or shorter
7. They should not become mushy but just look and feel done and smell a little caramelized
8. In a skillet , heat 1 tablespoon olive oil , add potatoes and season with salt to taste
9. Fry potatoes until crisp and done , about 15 minutes
10. Stir together water , tomato paste and harissa , pour over potatoes and heat through
11. Remove skillet from heat
12. Chop the tomatoes into 1 / 2 inch cubes
13. Get eggplant slices out of the oven , divide on two plates
14. Top the eggplant slices with potatoes
15. Top potatoes with chopped tomatoes
16. Serve immediately

title: artichoke sausage stuffing   dressing
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325f
2. Place a large skillet over medium-high heat
3. When pan is hot , add sausage and cook 3 to 5 minutes , until browned and cooked through , breaking up the meat as it cooks
4. Add mushrooms , onion , garlic , and poultry seasoning and cook 3 minutes , until mushrooms soften
5. Transfer mixture to a large bowl and add bread cubes , artichoke hearts , cheese , parsley , and 1 1 / 2 cups broth
6. Toss to combine , allowing liquid to soften bread cubes
7. If stuffing seems dry , add more broth to soak cubes
8. Bake stuffing at 325f for 30 minutes in shallow baking dish
9. If cooking in turkey: loosely stuff bread mixture into turkey
10. Place turkey in preheated oven and immediately reduce oven temperature to 325f roast turkey 20 minutes per pound , or until an instant-read thermometer registers 180-185f

title: candy strawberries
steps:
1. Mix first 5 ingredients together
2. Chill in refrigerator for 4 hours
3. Roll into balls and shape in the form of strawberries
4. Roll in the 3 tbsp of gelatin
5. Top with"leaves" made from almonds dyed green of green tinted powdered sugar icing

title: 100  whole wheat pizza dough and pizza tips
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients with a spoon for about 1 minute or use paddle on electric mixer for 1 minute
2. Rest for 5 minutes to hydrate dough
3. Cover while resting
4. Mix by hand or with dough hook on electric mixer for 5 to 6 minutes
5. Using a little oil on the counter and hands scrape onto counter and stretch by pulling on the bottom of the dough until a rectangle about 1 / 3 as thick as the dough is formed
6. Stretch and fold the dough as you would a letter
7. Do the same with the ends until a folded package is formed
8. Turn over and pull the dough to the bottom forming a smooth ball
9. Using a dough scraper or knife , cut and weigh our 5 equal pieces about 8 oz
10. Each or 227 g
11. Form each piece into a ball
12. Spray with oil and place each piece into a plastic sandwich bag or freezer bag that has also been sprayed inside with oil
13. Rest overnight or freeze for up to several months
14. Thaw frozen dough in the fridge for a day before cooking
15. On baking day , set out desired number of bags , remove from the bags onto an oiled pan or work surface
16. Gently press into discs , spray with oil and cover with oiled plastic
17. Preheat oven with pizza stone to 500f or slightly more if possible
18. Prepare toppings
19. Using flour , shape the dough using gravity and your knuckels , rotate and strech until desired size is reached
20. It should be thicker along the rim and thin , but not paper thin
21. Place on parchment paper and add sauce , cheese and toppings
22. Place on stone and bake until cheese is bubbly and crust is browned
23. This will take 7 to 8 minutes at 500f
24. Pinch of sugar helps remove any bitterness and provides correct consistency
25. Don't cook sauce

title: cranberry herb sauce
steps:
1. Cook and stir onions and garlic in oil in large saucepan over medium heat until onions are softened
2. Add cranberries , water , wine , honey , bouillion , thyne , bay leaves , worcestershire sauce , rosemary and red pepper
3. Bring to a boil
4. Reduce heat to low and simmer about 1 hour or untill mixture reduces by half , stirring frequently
5. Remove and discard bay leaves
6. Pruee sauce in blender or food procceser , hand blender works great
7. Serve with poultry , lamb , pork , great over sweet potatoes or dressing

title: tuxedo soup
steps:
1. Add white beans and drained black beans into a large soup pot and turn heat to medium-high
2. Add canned drained chicken breast and flake in pot
3. Can substitute leftover chicken or cook fresh
4. Dice your onion and green pepper and add to pot
5. Add all remaining ingredients excluding butter
6. Stir well and bring mixture to a boil
7. Let boil for 15 minutes and then cover and let simmer for 30 minutes
8. Remove from heat and add 3 tablespoons butter and cream into soup while stirring
9. Serve

title: creamy chicken noodle bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Prepare noodles according to package directions
3. Drain
4. Dissolve bouillon cubes in hot water and reserve
5. In saucepan , melt butter or margarine
6. Stir in flour and seasonings
7. Slowly add reserved water
8. Cook and stir over low heat until thickened
9. Add remaining ingredients and noodles , tossing gently to mix
10. Pour into a greased 13x9x2-inch pan
11. Bake for 35-45 minutes or until hot and bubbly
12. Refrigerate any leftovers

title: real chicago style italian beef i
steps:
1. Make a spice rub by combining 1 teaspoon each of dried basil , dried oregano , garlic powder , ground pepper , salt , red pepper flakes
2. Rub half of the spice rub over and around the roast , press the mixture into the meat as much as possible
3. Place the meat in a roasting pan
4. Add about 1 cup water to the pan
5. Preheat oven to 475 degrees f
6. Roast the beef for 35 minutes , now reduce the temperature to 400 degrees f
7. , and roast for 40 minutes
8. Do not turn off the oven , remove the pan from the oven and pour 1 1 / 2 cups cold water into the pan , let stand for 15-20 minutes
9. Add remaining seasoning mixture to the pan juices and water
10. Return meat to the oven and roast until meat thermometer reaches about 50 minutes but use the thermometer to make sure
11. When temp is reached remove pan and allow the roast to cool slightly befroe slicing
12. Slice almost paper thin
13. Transfer the juices to a sauce pan and keep it warm over low heat
14. Immerse the sliced beef into the warm gravy
15. To serve , scoop some of the beef out of the gravy using a fork , load it onto a gonnella french bread roll
16. Garnish with hot or sweet peppers and serve

title: chicken or prawn javanese beer curry
steps:
1. Melt butter over medium heat and brown onion , garlic and ginger until golden
2. Combine curry powder and flour and add to onion , stirring to blend
3. Reduce heat to low and cook 2-3 minutes
4. Add broth , beer , apple , chutney , tomato paste , honey and lemon juice
5. Blend well and simmer on low about 25 minutes
6. Let cool slightly then transfer to food processor and blend until smooth
7. Strain through a sieve to make a perfectly smooth sauce
8. Return to pan and stir in cream
9. Add shrimp , prawns or chicken and heat through gently
10. Season with salt and garnish with green onion , chopped peanuts or roasted coconut
11. Lovely with coconut rice

title: bourbon pork loin chili
steps:
1. Make one day before serving for optimal flavor
2. Heat 4 tablespoons of vegetable oil over high heat in large heavy pot or dutch oven
3. Generously season pork with kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper
4. Add pork loin in batches to sear on all sides
5. Remove pork and set aside
6. Turn heat down to medium
7. Add remaining 4 tablespoons of vegetable oil to pot
8. Add red bell pepper , jalepenos , onion cumin , chili powder , cayenne pepper , salt and pepper
9. Sweat vegetables until onions are soft
10. Add in the garlic and saute for 1 minute just until you smell the garlic cooking
11. Add the bourbon and let cook for 2 minutes
12. Add in the honey , kidney beans , black beans , and tomatoes
13. Turn up the heat until mixture is bubbling
14. Turn the heat down to lowest setting and simmer for at least 3 hours
15. Or until the pork is buttery and tender
16. Place cooked chili in refrigerator overnight to allow flavors to meld
17. Slowly reheat over medium low heat before serving
18. Top with cheddar cheese , sour cream , avoocados , and cilantro

title: red river rub
steps:
1. Use food processor fitted with metal blade to grind and mix all of the above ingredients and then place either in a shaker , or a container with a lid
2. Rub generously on ribs , chicken , pork chops , turkey , or steaks , for barbecuing
3. Let your meats marinate for 4 to 5 hours before grilling

title: walnut rosemary quinoa
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Heat oil in saucepan
3. Add onion and quinoa
4. Saut over medium heat , stirring constantly for about 3 minutes
5. Add pepper and saut an additional 2 minutes
6. Add water , soy sauce , rosemary and peas
7. Bring to a boil and cover
8. Simmer 15 minutes or until water is absorbed
9. Meanwhile , roast walnuts in oven for 3-5 minutes
10. When quinoa is cooked , turn off heat and mix in walnuts
11. Let sit an additional 10 minutes and serve

title: traditional irish ham and cabbage dinner
steps:
1. Place thyme , parsley , and onion in a cheese cloth for easy removal after cooking
2. Put ham into a large pot and cover with cold water
3. Add all other ingredients except cabbage and bring to a boil
4. Turn to simmer and cook until veggies are tender
5. Remove the herb bag
6. Add cabbage , simmer for 20 minutes
7. Or until cabbage is cooked
8. Remove ham and cut in to pieces
9. Place on the center of a large platter
10. Strain the cabbage and season it with pepper
11. Surround the ham with the cabbage , carrots , and potatoes
12. Eat !

title: calorie watchers dressing
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients well
2. Chill

title: flavored butter  garlic and parsley butter
steps:
1. Mix 2 tablespoons of parsley and garlic paste into the butter till well incorporated and refrigerate
2. For gift:
3. Wrap each butter roll in foil and then tissue paper , twisting the ends like a sweet wrapper
4. Add a label with the flavor
5. Include suggestions for uses or recipes and bundle together in a gift basket

title: kale  thornton gran s recipe
steps:
1. The night before you want your soup soak the barley , peas , and lentils in cold water overnight
2. Next morning , rinse the grains and put in a pot with the stock and cook on a low heat for about 1 hour
3. After the hour add the vegetables and the seasoning and cook for about 2 1 / 2 hours on a low heat
4. You can cook this in your slow cooker if you wish

title: onion zucchini bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Prepare a 9 inch round baking pan by spraying with non-stick cooking spray
3. In a bowl , combine the flour , onion 2 tablespoons of the grated parmesan cheese , baking powder , salt and baking soda
4. In a small bowl , mix the buttermilk , oil , egg substitute or eggs
5. Add the shredded zucchini to the milk mixture , stir to blend
6. Add milk mixture to the flour mixture and stir just until blended
7. Pour into prepared pan , sprinkle with remaining cheese and bake for 40 minutes

title: layered cheese and beef casserole
steps:
1. Cook noodles to desired doneness as directed on package
2. Drain
3. Meanwhile , in medium skillet over medium-high heat brown ground beef and 3 / 4 c
4. Onions
5. Drain
6. Add tomato sauce , salt , garlic powder and pepper
7. Mix well
8. Reduce heat , simmer 15 minutes
9. Heat oven to 350
10. In medium bowl , combine cottage cheese , cream cheese , green onions , bell pepper and 1 / 2 c
11. Parmesan cheese
12. Mix well
13. In ungreased 13 x 9 inch baking dish , layer half each of cooked noodles , meat sauce and cheese mixture
14. Repeat layers
15. Sprinkle additional parmesan cheese over top
16. Bake at 350 for 30 to 35 minutes or until thoroughly heated

title: creamy grilled chicken piccata
steps:
1. Combine first 6 ingredients and mix well
2. Place chicken in a ziplock bag and pour marinade over chicken
3. Marinate overnight in the refrigerator
4. When ready , grill chicken until done
5. Allow chicken to rest for a few minutes and then slice into strips to serve over pasta
6. While chicken is grilling
7. Cook pasta according to directions
8. Reserve 1 / 2 cup of pasta water and drain
9. In same sauce pan , melt butter over medium heat
10. Whisk in garlic and lemon juice
11. Pour in half and half and whisk until hot
12. Add some salt and pepper to taste
13. Add the parmesan cheese , basil and capers , and heat until cheese is melted
14. Check the consistency of the sauce and add some of the reserved pasta water to loosen the sauce if necessary
15. Toss in pasta
16. Serve in pasta bowls with grilled chicken on top
17. Sprinkle with more parmesan if desired

title: wicklewood s pear and roquefort salad
steps:
1. Peel , core and slice the pears and toss them in lemon juice
2. Arrange the salad leaves on serving plates and arrange the pears on top
3. Scatter the roquefort and nuts over the salad
4. In a screw top jar , mix the oils , vinegar mustard and seasoning
5. Seal the lid and shake well
6. Pour over the salad and serve immediately

title: spiced rum
steps:
1. Put all the ingredients in the bottle of rum , you may have to remove some to make room for the solids
2. Let steep a minimum of one month
3. The flavor improves with age , and it keeps for years

title: blastoff tequila
steps:
1. Pour the tequila and pineapple juice into a highball glas almost filled with ice cubes
2. Stir well
3. Drop the curacao into the center of the drink

title: pan fried chicken with garlic and lemon
steps:
1. Fry the onion with 1 tbsp olive oil , 3 minutes in a frying pan over medium-high heat
2. Remove onion from the pan , keep on a plate
3. Add the chicken fillets to the pan and fry them in remaining olive oil on high heat until cooked through
4. Add the fried onion , crushed garlic and sprinkle over some seasalt
5. Pour in the lemonjuice and toss everything together with the chopped parsley
6. Cook for another minute then serve

title: citrus salad with cumin vinaigrette
steps:
1. Prepare the vinaigrette:
2. In a small bowl , whisk together the citrus juice , olive oil , vinegar , garlic , mustard , cumin , salt , and pepper until blended
3. Arrange the lettuce
4. Arrange the endives and citrus fruits on top and garnish with the red onion and fennel slivers
5. Pour the dressing over all and serve immediately
6. Enjoy !

title: pastitso aust ww 5 5
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180c spray a 23cm x 30cm deep baking tray with oil and set aside
2. To make meat sauce , heat a large non-stick frying pan over medium to high heat
3. Add mince and onion and cook for 10 minutes , stirring to break up any lumps , or until meat is brown and onion is tender
4. Add pasta sauce , wine and cinnamon
5. Bring to the boil then reduce heat to medium low
6. Cover and simmer for 30 minutes , until sauce has thickened
7. Meanwhile cook pasta according to package instructions
8. Drain and set aside
9. Combine beaten egg , cup evaporated milk and cooked pasta in a large bowl
10. Toss to combine , then set aside
11. To make creamy sauce , melt butter in a small saucepan over medium heat
12. Stir in flour and season to taste with salt and pepper
13. Gradually add 1 cups evaporated milk and cook , stirring for 5 to 8 minutes , or until sauce is thick
14. Gradually stir in 1 beaten egg and egg whites , stirring continuously
15. Set aside
16. Layer half the pasta mixture into prepared dish
17. Spread with meat sauce and sprinkle with cup of cheese
18. Top with remaining pasta mixture
19. Pour cream sauce over top and sprinkle with remaining cheese
20. Cover and bake for 20 minutes
21. Uncover and bake for a further 15 minutes more , or until a knife inserted into the centre comes out clean
22. Allow to stand for 15 minutes , before slicing into 8 pieces

title: braised endive with avgolemono sauce
steps:
1. Soak the endive in salted ice water for about 15 minutes
2. Drain and remove as much moisture as possible
3. In a large skillet , over medium , melt butter
4. Add endive , lightly season with salt and pepper
5. Add lemon juice and saute lightly 2 to 3 minutes on each side
6. Add chicken stock and bring to a simmer
7. Lower heat to maintain a simmer and simmer uncovered 25 to 30 minutes or until tender
8. Remove skillet from heat
9. In small bowl of electric mixer , beat eggs until light and frothy
10. Add flour and continue to beat
11. Slowly add lemon juice
12. Gradually drizzle in hot broth from the skillet
13. Return skillet to low heat
14. Pour egg-lemon sauce over endive , shaking pan back and forth to incorporate avgolemono sauce with endive and to thicken sauce
15. Serve immediately

title: tsr version of outback ranch dressing by todd wilbur
steps:
1. Mix all of the ingredients in a medium bowl
2. Chill at least 1 / 2 hour before serving which is the key step to maximize flavor
3. Edit 4 / 15 / 2007: if you prefer a spicy , kicked up version of outback ranch dressing , substitute cayenne pepper for the paprika - your spicy preferring taste buds will thank you

title: tamilian shrimp curry
steps:
1. Wash srimp
2. Remove veins and remove shells
3. Bring water to a boil in a pot
4. Add chopped onion and tomato
5. Grind shredded coconut , cumin , turmeric , black pepper , & ground coriander in a spice or coffee mill
6. Add this spice mixture and the fresh ginger to the boiling pot of water , onion and tomatoes
7. Add the shrimp and cook covered over a low heat for 15 minutes
8. Heat oil in a small frying pan and fry fennel seeds until brown then add the curry leaves and green chilli
9. When shrimp is cooked pour in fennel mixture
10. Check for salt
11. The consistency should be watery like sambar
12. Coastal region shrimp kulambu is ready !
13. Serve hot with plain steamed rice

title: summer fruit ambrosia
steps:
1. Wash and prepare fruit
2. Place into a large bowl
3. I use a really large mosaic serving platter instead of a bowl and it makes a really nice presentation
4. Whisk the honey and lime juice together and pour on the fruit
5. Toss to combine
6. Refridgerate until ready to serve but not more than 2 hours
7. The fruit will become mushy if left to sit to long
8. Brown coconut with in a 300 degree oven or on the stovetop in a skillet
9. Watch carefully and stir periodically as it can burn easily
10. 5 - 10 minutes
11. Toss warm coconut with sugar and then the minced crystallized ginger and lime zest once cooled
12. Sprinkle fruit with the coconut topping when ready to serve

title: jamaica banana jam
steps:
1. Place lime juice in a one quart measure
2. Peel bananas and dice directly into lime juice
3. Stir with a wooden spoon
4. Keep stirring as you dice each banana into the lime juice to prevent darkening
5. Measure sugar and water into a wide 2 quart saucepan , and stir to dissolve sugar as you bring syrup to a boil
6. Cover tightly for the first 2 minutes then uncover , add bananas and boil over low heat for about 30 minutes or until thick
7. Stir often to prevent sticking , especially during last 10 minutes
8. Jam is done when a spoon scraped across bottom of pan leaves a track that closes slowly , or when jam mounds while stirring
9. Fill hot , sterilized jars quickly with the hot jelly or jam mixture , leaving 1 / 4 inch headspace
10. Wipe the sealing surface of the jars with a clean paper towel , dampened with hot water , to remove any jam or sugar crystals
11. Place lids , screw on bands finger-tight and process jars for 10 minutes in boiling water bath
12. Cool jars upright for 12-24 hours while vacuum seal is drawn and jam or jelly sets up
13. Let the jars sit undisturbed while they cool

title: oat and apple pancakes
steps:
1. Combine oats and buttermilk in a bowl
2. Cover and refrigerate overnight
3. Add the oil , eggs and apple to the oat mixture and mix until combined
4. Combine the flour , baking soda , baking powder and salt in another bowl , and then mix into oat mixture until just combined
5. Heat a non-stick pan , lightly sprayed with vegetable oil , to medium high heat
6. Pour on 4 inch round pools of batter
7. Cook pancakes 2-3 minutes each side
8. Keep pancakes warm in a 200 degree f oven until all are cooked
9. Serve with butter and applesauce or maple syrup

title: 1927 eskimo cup
steps:
1. Combine the fruit juices , sugar , and water
2. Stir until the sugar is dissolved
3. Now , add the gingerale and serve over cracked ice
4. Enjoy !

title: hawaiian pizza pineapples
steps:
1. Roll out the pizza dough
2. Cut into 4 1 / 2" x 7 1 / 2" shapes
3. Place each pizza dough square into a pineapple upside down mini cake pan
4. Add a layer of ricotta cheese , then pineapple chunks , cubed ham , mozzarella cheese , and sprinkle italian seasoning on top
5. Seal the pizza dough completely
6. Bake 400f for 20 minutes
7. Serve with marinara dipping sauce

title: margarita pie ala al roker
steps:
1. Position rack in center of oven
2. Preheat to 350
3. In a medium bowl , mix together cracker crumbs and butter
4. Press into a 9-inch pie plate
5. Bake until crust begins to puff , about 8 minutes
6. Remove from oven
7. Transfer to a cooling rack
8. If crust has pulled away from sides , use the back of a spoon to press it back
9. Let cool completely
10. In a medium bowl , stir together condensed milk , zest , juice , tequila , liqueur , and salt
11. Let stand for 5 minutes to thicken
12. Pour filling into crust
13. Cover with plastic wrap , and refrigerate until firmly set , for at least 2 or up to 8 hours
14. Just before serving , whip cream until soft peaks form
15. Fold in sugar and vanilla , whipping until stiff peaks form
16. Garnish pie with whipped cream and lime slices , if using
17. Serve immediately

title: basil bean salad
steps:
1. Cut beans into 1 1 / 4 inch pieces
2. Place in a saucepan and cover with water
3. Bring to a boil
4. Cook , uncovered , for 10 minutes or until crisp-tender
5. Rinse with cold water and drain well
6. In a large bowl , combine the beans and next 6 ingredients
7. Sprinkle with romano cheese and toss to coat

title: chocolate  strawberry   cookie parfaits
steps:
1. Add milk to dry pudding mix in medium bowl
2. Beat with wire whisk 2 minute or until well blended
3. Refrigerate 5 minute
4. Spoon one-third of the pudding mixture evenly into four mugs or parfait glasses
5. Top with layers of half each of the strawberries and cookies
6. Repeat all layers
7. Cover with the remaining pudding mixture and whipped topping
8. Serve immediately or store in refrigerator up to 2 hours before serving

title: great marinated grilled chicken
steps:
1. Combine oil , lemon zest with the juice of the lemon , oxo , dijon , parsley & pepper
2. Pour over the chicken , refrigerate covererd for a few hours or overnight
3. Grill or bbq as desired basting as you cook

title: frankfurter spaghetti
steps:
1. Saute wiener slices until slightly browned
2. Set aside
3. Saute onion in margarine until tender
4. Remove from heat
5. Stir in flour , oregano , salt and pepper
6. Heat until thick
7. Gradually add water , milk , worcestershire sauce and cheese
8. Stir over low heat until cheese melts
9. Add wieners
10. Spaghetti and veggies
11. Place in 1 1 / 2 quart greased baking dish
12. Bake 30 minutes at 350f

title: super creamy and cheesy mac and cheese
steps:
1. Cook the macaroni and set aside
2. In a pot , melt the butter and mix in salt and pepper
3. Slowly add in the flour , stirring continuously
4. Gradually add the milk and stir the mixture until smooth
5. Add the cheese on a low heat and melt into the mixture
6. Once the mixture is at your desired consistency , mix in the drained macaroni

title: orange vanilla pizzelles
steps:
1. Mix oil
2. Eggs and sugar unti blended with an electric mixer , add the dry ingredients and flavorings and mix till well combined
3. Allow to sit for 5-10 minutes while the iron is heating
4. Cook acccording to your own iron , i time my cookies for 15-18 seconds
5. Cooking time is the amount of time it takes to cook a whole batch of these

title: ayurvedic  toxins flush out  water
steps:
1. To make the water , boil two quarts of water and put it in a thermos flask
2. Then add all the remaining ingredients
3. Let it steep
4. Drink this water throughout the day for a very purifying effect
5. Also , this water will help enhance your digestion

title: macaroni chili   oamc
steps:
1. In large skillet cook ground beef , onions and garlic until beef is browned
2. Drain
3. In large dutch oven pour in meat mixture , add beans , tomato sauce , tomatoes with juices , marcaroni , water , chili powder and cumin
4. Bring to a boil , reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes
5. Cover and simmer about 10 minutes more or until the macaroni is tender but firm
6. Place in containers , sprinkle with cheese and freeze

title: thai style peanut dipping sauce
steps:
1. Heat curry paste in medium nonstick skillet for a minute
2. Add coconut milk & stir well to dissolve curry paste
3. When paste is dissolved & coconut milk is simmering , add next 4 ingredients
4. Stir constantly until well mixed , adding water by the tablespoonful if too thick
5. Serve hot or room temperature

title: hershey s disappearing cake
steps:
1. Generously grease and flour 2-9 inch round or 13x9 cake pan
2. Cream butter and shortning , sugar and vanilla until fluffy
3. Blend in eggs
4. Combine cocoa , flour , baking powder , baking soda and salt in bowl
5. Add milk and flour mixture alternatly to batter
6. Blend well and pour into pans
7. Bake at 350 for 30-35 minutes or until cake test done
8. Cool 10 minutes and remove from pans if using round pans
9. Frost with your favorite frosting
10. We use homemade white butter flavored frosting

title: vegetarian nasi goreng  fried rice
steps:
1. Cook the rice in boiling salted water for 12-15 minutes , until tender
2. Drain , rinse , and drain again
3. Stir in the tamarind paste and set aside
4. Heat 1 tbls
5. Of the oil in a large skillet or wok , add the shallots , and cook for 3-5 minutes , until softened
6. Add the garlic , ginger , curry powder , pepper flakes , and turmeric and cook gently , stirring , for 1 minute
7. Add the cabbage and cook for 3-5 minutes
8. Add the tomatoes and cook for 2-3 minutes
9. Remove from pan
10. Heat the remaining oil in the pan , add the rice , and cook gently until lightly browned
11. Return the vegetables to the pan
12. Add the soy sauce and sugar and heat gently to warm through
13. Serve hot , garnished with tomatoes , red pepper , cucumber , celery , and omelet strips
14. Melt 2 tbls butter in an omelet pan or small skillet
15. Add the eggs to the pan and cook until set
16. Leave to cool
17. Roll up the omelet and slice across into fine strips

title: jamocha cheesecake shake
steps:
1. Place milk , cottage cheese , cocoa and splenda in blender-- blend until smooth , about 30 seconds
2. Add frozen banana , broken into pieces -- blend until smooth
3. If you want your frozen treat thicker , add crushed ice -- blend until smooth
4. Makes one large serving
5. This recipe can easily be doubled in most blenders to make enough for 2-3 people
6. An addition of 1 / 4 tsp nutmeg or cinnamon or cardamon is a great flavor in this shake

title: elaine s dolmathes  stuffed grape leaves
steps:
1. Remove grape leaves from jar and cut off stems
2. Place a few leaves at a time in a deep fry pan of simmering water for a about a minute
3. This removes the brine
4. Line the bottom of a 3 qt pan with 3 to 4 large leaves
5. Mix remaining ingredients except water in a bowl and start rolling
6. Place leaf , face or shiny side down
7. Put a small amount of mixture on upper half of leaf
8. Make one roll then turn sides in
9. Continue to roll
10. Place rolled grape leaves in the prepared pot seam side down
11. I work from the outer edge
12. Once the first layer is complete start a second layer
13. When all filling is used cover rolled leaves with 4 large leaves
14. Cover the leaves with a saucer that will fit inside the pot and add the 1 cup water
15. Cover pot and bring to a boil
16. Lower heat to simmer and cook for 45 minutes

title: homemade healthy kettlecorn popcorn
steps:
1. Spray the bottom and sides of the inside of a brown paper lunch bag with the cooking spray
2. Add the popping corn to the bag , fold over the top of the bag once or twice to seal , and place it in the microwave
3. Microwave on high for 3 & 1 / 2 minutes or until popping significantly slows
4. When the popcorn is done popping , quickly add the truvia and salt , reseal the bag , shake , and serve
5. Enjoy an entire bag of kettle corn microwave popcorn all to yourself for only 4 weight watchers pointsplus points

title: cantonese soup
steps:
1. In large saucepan , lightly brown pork in oil , stirring frequently
2. Stir in soy sauce , pepper and ginger
3. Cook 5 minutes
4. Add chicken broth
5. Simmer 15 minutes
6. Add cabbage and cook until tender , about 5 minutes
7. Garnish each serving with noodles

title: you ve gotta try these nachos
steps:
1. Arrange the corn chips on a large serving platter
2. Combine the salsa ingredients and let the flavors meld
3. Make the beef and beans topping:
4. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium high and add the olive oil , garlic , onion and jalapeno
5. Saute for about 2 minutes
6. Add meat and break into smaller bits
7. Season with salt , chili powder , cumin and the cayenne pepper sauce
8. Cook meat mixture until browned , about 5 minutes
9. Stir in the beans and turn the heat down to low
10. Make the cheese sauce:
11. In a saucepan , melt the butter over moderate heat
12. Then add the flour , stirring and cooking for about a minute
13. Whisk in milk
14. When the milk comes to a bubble , stir in cheese using a wooden spoon
15. Remove cheese sauce from the heat
16. Pour cheese sauce evenly over the tortilla chips
17. Top evenly with the beef and beans mixture
18. Top it all off with the pico de gallo salsa
19. Serve it while it's hot !

title: grilled lamb chops with merlot marinade
steps:
1. Combine the onion , garlic , sage , wine and olive oil in a large ziplock bag and squish to mix well
2. Add the lamb chops and marinate in the refrigerator for 8 to 12 hours
3. Drain the lamb chops , reserving marinade
4. Pour reserved marinade into a saucepan and bring to a boil
5. Boil for 5 minutes
6. Arrange lamb chops on a grill rack
7. Brush with the cooked marinade and grill until chops are cooked through , basting occasionally with the cooked marinade

title: crock pot cashew chicken
steps:
1. Place chicken and mushrooms in a slow cooker
2. Add green onions , soy sauce , ginger , broth , salt and pepper
3. Cover and cook on low about 4 hours
4. Add bamboo shoots , cashews and pea pods
5. Turn control to high
6. In a small bowl , dissolve cornstarch in water
7. Stir into chicken mixture in cooker
8. Cover and cook on high 20-30 minutes or until thickened , stirring at least once
