9. Serve over cooked rice if desired

title: nif s 1 ww pt  spaghetti sauce
steps: 1. Mix in a medium pot and simmer for about 30 minutes

title: quick pb and graham snack
steps:
1. Spread pb on one half of cracker
2. Drizzle chocolate syrup in center of cracker
3. Make a sandwich and eat !

title: orange chicken dino nuggets
steps:
1. To make dino nuggets:
2. In a bowl , mix together the chicken , 1 eggs , 1 / 2 cup bread crumbs , sriracha , milk , salt , pepper , garlic powder , onion , dried oregano
3. Roll out the mixture between 2 pieces of greased parchment paper
4. Then chill
5. Once firm , use dinosaur shaped cookie cutters for a clean cut
6. Coat the dino nuggets with flour , then dredge in egg wash , and cover evenly with panko
7. Fry the nuggets until golden brown
8. Place the nuggets on a tray or paper towels
9. To make orange sauce:
10. In a small bowl , combine soy sauce , orange juice , brown sugar and orange zest making a soy sauce mixture
11. In a hot pan with oil and garlic , add ginger , red pepper flakes , the soy sauce mixture , rice wine vinegar
12. To finish:
13. In the orange sauce pan , add the deep fried dino nuggets , add cornstarch-water and mix
14. Set dill , broccoli and molded rice to create a jungle setting
15. Place the dino nuggets upright

title: margarita mac and cheese
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Cook macaroni as directed on the package
3. While macaroni is cooking , prepare the sauce
4. Heat olive oil in a medium saucepan over low heat
5. Add garlic and cook 1-2 minutes , or until garlic is fragrant
6. Whisk in flour , salt and pepper and cook over low heat , stirring until mixture is smooth and bubbly
7. Remove from heat and stir in milk
8. Heat to boiling , stirring constantly
9. Boil and stir one minute
10. Set aside
11. Drain pasta and mix with the drained diced tomatoes
12. Place half of the macaroni in an ungreased 2-quart casserole dish
13. Sprinkle with half the salt , pepper , basil and cheese
14. Repeat with remaining macaroni , salt , pepper , basil and cheese
15. Pour sauce over macaroni
16. Cover and bake for 30 minutes
17. Uncover and bake 15 minutes longer
18. Serve with fresh basil

title: green chile squares
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees
2. Sprinkle the cheese and chiles in the bottom of a 9 x 13 inch baking dish
3. P our the eggs over the top
4. Bake for 30-40 minutes or until golden brown and firm
5. Cool to room temperature and then cut into squares

title: boriqua pork burgers with creamy sofrito ranch slaw  rsc
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine yogurt , lemon zest , lemon juice , sofrito , ranch packet , sugar
2. Then add cabbage , carrots and jicama to yogurt mixture
3. Place bowl to the side
4. In a large bowl , combine ground pork , sofrito , egg , and bread crumbs
5. Separate meat and form in four patties
6. Sprinkle with adobo and brush with oil
7. Heat grill pan with medium heat and brush with oil
8. Cook patties for 4 min on each side
9. Remove patties on to plate
10. Toast buns om grill pan for 3 min till grill marks form
11. Arrange buns on plate
12. Place a pork pattie on each bun then scoop creamy slaw on each pattie
13. So spicy and good !

title: greek taboule salad
steps:
1. In large bowl , combine wheat salad mix and contents of spice sack
2. Stir in 1 cup boiling water and oil
3. Let stand 30 minutes
4. Stir cheese , tomato , basil and lemon juice into wheat mixture
5. Cover
6. Chill 2 hours before serving
7. Serve with freshly ground black pepper , if desired

title: all purpose vegan cheese sauce
steps:
1. Add ingredients to blender and puree until very smooth
2. Scrape down sides as you go
3. Add mixture to sauce pan over low to medium low heat
4. Wisk until thickened , about 15-20 minutes

title: australian damper  bread machine
steps:
1. Add ingredients in the order specified by your bread machine
2. Set machine to yeast free setting
3. If you don't have one , i would recommend making the dough in the machine , and then baking in the oven

title: the barefoot contessa peach and raspberry crisp   cobbler
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Butter the inside of a 10-by-15-inch oval baking dish
3. Immerse the peaches in boiling water for 30 seconds , then place them in cold water
4. Peel the peaches and slice them into thick wedges and place them into a large bowl
5. Add the orange zest , 1 / 4 cup granulated sugar , 1 / 2 cup brown sugar and 2 tablespoons of flour
6. Toss well
7. Gently mix in the raspberries
8. Allow the mixture to sit for 5 minutes
9. If there is a lot of liquid , add 1 more tablespoon of flour
10. Pour the peaches into the baking dish and gently smooth the top
11. Combine 1 1 / 2 cups flour , 1 cup granulated sugar , 1 / 2 cup brown sugar , salt , oatmeal and the cold butter in the bowl of an electric mixer fitted with a paddle attachment
12. Mix on low speed until the butter is pea-sized and the mixture is crumbly
13. Sprinkle the topping evenly over the peaches and raspberries
14. Bake the crisp for 1 hour , until the top is browned and crisp and the juices are bubbly
15. Serve immediately or store in the refrigerator and reheat in a 350-degree oven for 20 to 30 minutes until warm

title: egg flowers
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. In regular sized muffin pan , place one piece of ham in each , lining the cups
3. Break an egg into each "cup"
4. Sprinkle with salt & pepper
5. Bake for ~15 minutes or until done
6. Sprinkle with cheddar cheese and enjoy !

title: rice krispies treats with a twist
steps:
1. Bring karo syrup and sugar to a boil
2. Add peanut butter and vanilla and stir
3. Add cereal and stir well
4. Pour into 9x13-inch greased pan and smooth out
5. Melt both flavors of chips and frost top
6. Slice and enjoy !

title: ortega taco bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Grease 11 x 7 inch baking dish
3. Cook beef and onion until beef is browned
4. Drain
5. Stir in taco sauce , water , chiles and seasoning mix
6. Cook over low heat for 3 to 4 minutes
7. Layer half of broken shells on bottom of baking dish
8. Cover with half of meat mixture
9. Sprinkle with 1 cup of cheese
10. Repeat with remaining ingredients
11. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until bubbly

title: snapper fillets with herb and caper butter
steps:
1. Herb and caper butter:
2. Combine all ingredients in a small bowl
3. Snapper:
4. Heat oil in a large frying pan
5. Dust each fillet with seasoned flour and cook 2-3 minutes per side-or until done to your liking
6. Serve fish at once with the savoury butter

title: cheesy pasta primavera
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to package directions
2. Drain
3. Meanwhile , in large saucepan over medium heat melt butter
4. Saute carrots in butter 3 minutes
5. Add garlic , onion , zucchini and mushrooms
6. Cook until tender
7. Stir in flour
8. Gradually stir in milk , whisking until smooth
9. Cook , stirring constantly , until mixture boils and thickens
10. Remove from heat
11. Stir in cheddar cheese , dry mustard , salt and pepper to taste
12. Stir in cooked pasta
13. Serve immediately

title: chicken   gnocchi soup ala olive garden
steps:
1. Medium heat
2. Melt butter in soup pot , add garlic and sautee , add chicken and cook through
3. Add flour and mix well until flour is cooked into the chicken
4. Now add milk and heavy cream
5. Add veggies and bullion cubes
6. Add gnocchi last
7. Mix ingredients well until soup thickens , stirring constantly
8. Cover and simmer 10 minutes

title: littlemafia s mozzarella croquettes
steps:
1. Mix the flour , salt and pepper
2. Add the eggs in the middle of the flour mixture
3. Add the mozzarella and keep stirring
4. Shape into balls or croquettes and roll them in the breadcrumbs till well coated
5. Deep fry till they are golden brown

title: marshmallow fudge
steps:
1. Line an 8-in
2. Square pan wih foil and coatwith cooking spray
3. Set aside
4. In a heavy saucepan over low heat , mel chocolatechips with milk
5. Stir until smooth
6. Remove from the hear
7. Cool for 2 minutes
8. Stir in vanilla
9. Fold in the marshmallows and graham crackers
10. Pour into the prepared pan
11. Refrigerate for 1 hour or until firm
12. Lif out pan and remove foil

title: spicy sausage won ton cups
steps:
1. Brown sausage in a large skillet over medium high heat , stirring until it crumbles and is no longer pink
2. Drain on paper towels
3. Combine sausage and next 6 ingredients
4. Coat 4 miniature muffin pans muffin pans with cooking spray
5. Place won ton wrappers in pans , using fingers to create fluted shape
6. Lightly spray wrappers with cooking spray
7. Bake at 350 degrees for 8 minutes , turning pans after 4 minutes
8. Spoon 1 heaping tablespoon filling into each won ton cup
9. Bake at 350 degrees for 9-10 minutes or until browned and throughly heated
10. Remove from pans and serve hot

title: coffee alla chocolata
steps:
1. Add chocolate mint liqueur to the cup of freshly brewed coffee
2. Top off with whipped cream and shaved chocolate

title: pork tenderloin with orange marmalade
steps:
1. Combine the mustard , garlic , rosemary , and black pepper in a small bowl
2. Stir well , and set aside
3. Slice the tenderloins lengthwise to , but not through the center , leaving one long side connected
4. Spread the mustard mixture evenly into the opening of each tenderloin
5. Fold the top sides over the mustard mixture , and tie securely with string at 2 inch intervals
6. Place the tenderloins , seam side down , on a lightly greased rack in a roasting pan
7. Brush each with 1 tbsp marmalade
8. Add water to the pan
9. Bake uncovered , at 400 degrees for 35 minutes or until a meat thermometer inserted in the thickest part of the tenderloins registers 160 degrees
10. Combine the remaining 2 tbsp marmalade and chicken broth in a small saucepan
11. Bring to a boil
12. Reduce heat and simmer
13. Uncovered for 2 to 3 minutes or until thickened
14. To serve , slice the tenderloins , and arrange on a serving platter
15. Spoon the marmalade mixture over the slices

title: sour milk spice cakes
steps:
1. 2 tablespoons lemon juice to 1 cup milk will sour it
2. Soak raisins in hot water
3. Drain raisins
4. Flour raisins with 1 / 2 cup flour
5. Cream butter and sugar together
6. Add eggs
7. Sift dry ingredients together except soda
8. Dissolve baking soda in sour milk and add to dry ingredients
9. Beat wet and dry ingredients together until well mixed
10. Add floured raisins and mix
11. Fill mixture into paper cups in muffin pan
12. Bake 425f for 12 minutes or until inserted toothpick comes out clean
13. Let cool

title: lentil burgers   vegetarian
steps:
1. Combine lentils , celery , carrot , water , curry powder in a pan and bring to the boil
2. Reduce heat and simmer , covered for approx 20 minutes or until the mixture has thickened
3. Remove from heat and cool
4. Stir in 2 cups of breadcrumbs
5. Shape the mixture into 8 burger patties
6. Toss them in the flour , dip in the egg white and cover with the remaining breadcrumbs
7. Heat the oil in a non-stick pan
8. Add the burgers and cook until well browned on both sides
9. Season with salt and pepper to taste
10. Serve on a bun as a burger or as a meal with a salad on the side

title: stove top eye of the round
steps:
1. Heat half the oil in a dutch oven
2. Add the onion and garlic and cook , stirring , until the onion is soft
3. Remove with a slotted spoon and set aside
4. Sprinkle the meat with salt and pepper to taste
5. Heat the remaining oil in the same pan
6. Add the meat and cook , turning , until brown all over
7. Return the onion mixture to the pan
8. Add the wine , stock and herbs
9. Cook , covered , over low heat for 1-1 / 2 hours , turning the meat once during cooking
10. Remove the meat from the pan and let stand for 10 minutes before slicing
11. While the meat is standing , make a gravy by mixing together the flour and cold water and blending them into the remaining pan juices
12. Add a little extra stock to the pan if necessary
13. Cook until thickened and strain
14. Serve the sliced meat and gravy sprinkled with parsley

title: stuffed easter ham
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Poach yams and pears in hot water until tender but not overcooked
3. In a heavy bottom saut pan , melt butter over medium high heat
4. Add onions , celery , bell pepper and garlic
5. Saut until veggies are wilted
6. Add yams , pears , raisins and figs and continue to saut until mixture is well blended and resembles a chutney or stuffing
7. Season wit a pinch of cinnamon , nutmeg
8. Remove and allow to cool
9. Slice ham horizontally across the middle , and fill the centre of ham with stuffing mixture about 3 / 4 inch thick
10. Top with upper section of ham and secure in place with skewers
11. Garnish top of ham with pear halves and glaze with cajun glaze
12. Bake 20 to 30 minutes

title: southern creamed corn cakes  low fat
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together
2. Spray hot griddle with non-stick cooking spray
3. Spoon batter onto griddle as you would pancakes , leaving enough room so they will not run together
4. Cook on medium-high temperature for 2-3 minutes per side , or until browned on each side
5. Serve hot

title: merill s tuna casserole with crescent roll crust
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients except crescent roll dough
2. Open 1 can of the crescent rolls on waxed paper and roll dough to cover bottom on a baking dish for the lower crust
3. Add tuna mixture onto the crust evenly
4. Roll out the other can of dough and make 1 / 2 inch strips to form a lattice pattern on top of the tuna like a pie
5. Set the strips over the top in a diagonal manner
6. Bake at 350 degrees for 30-45 minutes or until crust is golden and puffed

title: low er  carb cola chicken
steps:
1. Place chicken n a large dutch oven
2. Combine the ketchup , cola and hot sauce in a bowl and stir well to
3. Pour the sauce over the chicken
4. Bring to a boil then cover and simmer 30 minutes
5. Uncover the pan and simmer 30 minutes longer to reduce and thicken the sauce

title: barbecued pork  chinese style
steps:
1. Trim fat off pork and cut meat into pieces about the size of pork chops , 3 / 4 inch thick
2. Combine the marinade ingredients in a large mixing bowl and mix thoroughly
3. Dip each piece of pork into the marinade to coat well
4. Cover and refrigerate for 4 hours or overnight
5. Place pork pieces on a barbecue grill over medium heat and barbecue for about 30 minutes or until fully cooked , turning once or twice while cooking
6. During the last 10 minutes , baste with the marinade
7. Line a roasting pan with foil and add some water to prevent smoking
8. Put the pan on the lower rack
9. Place the pork on the upper rack , 3 inches from the heat source
10. Broil pork pieces 2 minutes on each side
11. Brush with marinade
12. Reduce heat to 350f and roast for 30 minutes
13. Divide leftover pork into 4-ounce packages and freeze

title: french dry rub
steps: 1. Place all ingredients in a large bowl and crush with your fingers , of if you wish for a powder place in a spice grinder

title: mexican hots
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients
2. Form into your hamburger patties , or meatloaf

title: baked cheese and spinach  slk fel kousha
steps:
1. Cook spinach in small amount of water for 3 minutes
2. Drain and press out excess liquid
3. Heat oil in pan , add onion and meat
4. Stir fry , adding salt and pepper and cook for 5 minutes
5. Add water and spinach and cook for additional 5 minutes
6. Put mixture in baking dish and sprinkle with grated cheese
7. Bake in 350 degree oven for 10 minutes

title: mini goat cheesecakes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350-degrees
2. Butter a nonstick mini-muffin tin with eightenn 1 / 8 cup wells that measure 1 3 / 4 inches in diameter and 3 / 4 inch deep
3. Mix the bread crumbs , walnuts , and butter in a small bowl with half the salt and half the pepper
4. Stir with a fork until thoroughly combined
5. Place 2 teaspoonfuls of the mixture in each cup and press down into bottom to form a crust
6. Beat the goat cheese and cream cheese in the bowl of an electric mixer until smooth , light , and fluffy
7. Beat in the egg , chives , and remaining salt and pepper
8. Divide between the wells and smooth the tops with a knife
9. Bake until puffed , about 15 minutes
10. Cool on a wire rack for 5 minutes , then run a knife around the rim of each cake and carefully unmold
11. Reheat in a 350-degree oven until hot

title: cabbage burgers
steps:
1. Brown hamburger meat , onions and garlic in large stewing pot
2. Add salt , pepper , basil and thyme
3. Wash cabbage and cut in half
4. Remove core and cut cabbage into shreds
5. Add to hamburger meat mixture
6. Add sherry
7. Cook 15 minutes
8. Turn off heat and leave to the side to cool
9. Prepare hot roll mix as directed
10. Flour a surface and roll out dough
11. Cut a 4x4 square and fill with 1 1 / 2 table spoons of hamburger / cabbage mixture
12. Pull dough around mixture until closed
13. Bake on a greased cookie sheet till brown
14. Brush with butter / margarine
15. Bake at 375f
16. Makes approx 5 dozen

title: seafood pasta with tomato sauce
steps:
1. Mix all marinade ingredients in a cup and set aside
2. Get all tomato sauce ingredients in a pot , take it to boil once it's boiling take it to low and cook for about 30 minutes
3. Unless you buy them out of the shell , clean and boil mussels and clams and remove them from shell
4. Clean shrimp and devein
5. Cut fish in strips
6. Cut baby octopus in 3 strips
7. Cut calamari in strips about 1 / 4-inch width
8. Mix all seafood with marinade in a bowl and leave in fridge for about 1 hour
9. In a wok or a deep frying pan , add 1 tsp oil and heat till starts smoking , add seafood and cook for about 8 minutes
10. Mix seafood with tomato sauce and cook for 2 minutes stirring
11. Mix all with your pasta
12. Enjoy it with the left over wine

title: weight watchers chicken taco salad
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Coat a large baking sheet with cooking spray
3. Arrange tortillas on baking sheet
4. Spray tortillas with cooking spray and sprinkle with salt
5. Bake until golden , about 10 minutes
6. Arrange tortillas in bottom and up sides of 4 salad bowls
7. Place 1 / 4 of lettuce , chicken , tomatoes and cheese in each bowl
8. In a small bowl , whisk together sour cream , salsa , cumin and pepper sauce
9. Drizzle about 3 tablespoons dressing over each salad

title: chinese five spice seasoning
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together well
2. Store in a tighly sealed container

title: mom s peanut butter cookies
steps:
1. Mix in order
2. Make in to balls , flatten with fork coated in sugar
3. Bake at 400 degrees 10-12 minutes

title: drink from the bowl spaghetti sauce
steps:
1. Heat evoo in pot over medium-high heat
2. Sprinkle red pepper flakes and move pot to distribute the oil evenly for 1 minute
3. Add onion and saute for 2 minutes
4. Add garlic and saute for 1 minute
5. Add any extra veggies or continue on to step 6
6. Add the next 11 ingredients and mix thoroughly
7. Let sauce come to a boil and stir in the red wine
8. Lower heat and allow to simmer for 1-2 hours
9. Make sure to stir every 15-20 minutes to prevent the sauce from burning on the bottom of the pan
10. Optional: can add uncooked meatballs to simmering sauce , just make sure to simmer for at least 45 minutes to an hour
11. Enjoy :)

title: pasta with salmon and mascarpone
steps:
1. Cook the pasta in boiled water until done
2. Chop the salmon in big pieces
3. Heat the olive oil and lightly cook the salmon for 2 minutes
4. Turn the heat to low and add the mascarpone cheese
5. When mascarpone is melted add the dill
6. Mix well
7. Drain the pasta and add them into the sauce
8. Mix well
9. Serve immediately and add the pepper on top !

title: sour cream and lemon pound cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees f
2. Grease 16-cup tube pan
3. Dust with cake flour
4. Tap out excess flour
5. Sift flour , baking powder and salt into medium bowl
6. Using electric mixer , beat butter in large bowl at medium speed until fluffy
7. Gradually add sugar and beat 5 minutes
8. Add eggs 1 at a time , beating just until combined after each addition
9. Beat in lemon juice and peel
10. Using rubber spatula , mix in dry ingredients
11. Mix in sour cream
12. Transfer batter to prepared pan
13. Bake cake until tester inserted near center comes out clean , about 1 hour 30 minutes
14. Let cake cool in pan on rack 15 minutes
15. Cut around cake in pan
16. Turn out cake
17. Carefully turn cake right side up on rack and cool completely

title: mango and banana pancakes
steps:
1. Mix the ingredients together in a large bowl
2. Add some butter to a non stick pan
3. Ladel some batter onto surface
4. Flip when starts to have small bubbles
5. Put whipped cream for prep
6. And some butter , syrup[or podered sugar]on top if wanted
7. Serve

title: brunch eggs
steps:
1. Combine tomatoes and basil in a 13 x 9" baking pan
2. Form 8 wells in the tomato mixture and crack an egg into each well
3. Bake at 350f for 25 minutes or until eggs are set
4. Sprinkle with cheese and bake 5 minutes more
5. Serve over toasted muffin halves , sprinkle with parsley

title: fudge filled bars
steps:
1. Mix oats , flour , brown sugar and salt
2. Add butter and mix until crumbly
3. Stir in pecans
4. Set aside 1-1 / 2 cup for topping
5. Press remaining into a greased 13x9 baking pan
6. In saucepan combine milk , chips and shortening
7. Cook and stir over low heat until melted
8. Spread over crust in pan
9. Sprinkle with reserved topping
10. Bake at 350f for 20-25 minutes , until edges golden are brown

title: acadia s ratatouille
steps:
1. In a 3 quart dutch oven add the olive oil and onions
2. Saute on medium low until tender about 4 minutes stirring frequently
3. Add garlic and saute for an additional 1 minute stirring frequently
4. Slice up bell peppers , add to mixture and saute an additional 4 minutes stirring frequently
5. Add basil , oregano and parsley mixing with other ingredients
6. Add crushed tomatoes , zucchini , squash , red pepper flakes , salt and stir to mix thoroughly
7. Cover for and cook for 1 hour or so on low / simmer , stirring every 5 minutes until zucchini and squash are tender
8. Place parmesan cheese on table to be sprinkled on top of each individual serving
9. Enjoy !

title: tuxedo pasta
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to package directions
2. In a skillet , saute the chicken , mushrooms and red pepper in 2 tablespoons butter for 4-5 minutes or until vegetables are tender
3. Add the lemon juice and broth
4. Bring to a boil
5. Reduce heat , cook and stir for 2 minutes or until heated through
6. Drain the pasta and add to skillet
7. Stir in the parmesan cheese , basil and remaining butter

title: creamy artichoke spinach   crab dip
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat
3. Add the onions and cook until they begin to soften
4. Add the garlic and cook 1 minute longer
5. Stir in the spinach and artichoke hearts
6. Add the cream cheese , sour cream and mayonnaise , cooking and stirring until blended well
7. Turn the heat down to low
8. Add the shredded cheese and stir until just melted
9. Stir in the hot sauce , worcestershire sauce and lemon juice
10. Gently stir in the crab
11. Taste the dip and season with salt and pepper , to taste
12. Pour the mixture into an 8 x 8 baking dish
13. Sprinkle parmesan cheese over all
14. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes , or until the top begins to brown
15. Allow the dip to cool for 5 minutes
16. Top with tomato , if desired
17. Enjoy !

title: pecan crusted honey chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Mix mustard , honey and lemon juice
3. Brush mixture onto both sides of chicken breasts
4. Place chicken breasts in a single layer in a shallow baking pan
5. Combine pecans , bread crumbs , and butter
6. Sprinkle evenly over chicken , press lightly into chicken to secure
7. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until chicken is cooked through

title: easy as can be pineapple dessert
steps:
1. Mix together pineapple& pudding
2. Then add cool whip , marshmallows& walnuts
3. Put in a large bowl and refrigerate for about 2 hours

title: clam cakes
steps:
1. In a large bowl combine the flour , baking powder , sugar and salt
2. Mix well
3. Add the remaining ingredients and stir well
4. In a deep pot heat 3 inch of oil to 375 degrees
5. Drop batter in by the teaspoonfull
6. Cook for 3-4 minutes on each side or until golden brown
7. Drain and serve hot
8. Sprinkle with pepper and old bay seasoning

title: kevin s mom s pancakes
steps:
1. In bowl , whisk together all dry ingredients
2. In separate bowl , stir together all wet ingredients
3. Make a well in centre of dry ingredients
4. Dump wet ingredients into the well and stir together until just combined
5. A few small lumps in the batter are okay
6. Heat a nonstick pan over low-medium heat
7. Pour batter in 1 / 4 cup measures
8. Fry about 2 1 / 2 minutes , until edges are dry and bubbles are just starting to form
9. Flip and fry other side about 2 minutes

title: grandma joyce s sugar cookies
steps:
1. Cream together margarine and sugar
2. Beat in eggs one at a time
3. Combine oil , salt , and vanilla
4. Combine flour , baking soda , and cream of tartar
5. Alternate add the oil mixture and dry ingredient mixture to batter
6. Don't worry if you have a lot of extra dry ingredients at the end
7. Continue to add a little at a time so you don't flour your whole kitchen
8. Roll into balls
9. Flatten
10. Add sprinkles if you want
11. Bake at 350 degrees fahrenheit for 10 to13 minutes

title: major cojone s chili
steps:
1. In a large frying pan , cook bacon until crispy
2. Drain and add to a large pot
3. Then brown the sausage in the frying pan
4. Drain and add to pot with bacon
5. Then brown the ground beef
6. Drain and add to the pot with the other meats
7. Add all the remaining ingredients to the pot , and simmer for 4 to 6 hours for best results

title: thanksgiving sandwich
steps:
1. Toast bread , if desired
2. Spread both slices with mayonnaise
3. Layer turkey , cranberry sauce , cheese , and lettuce on one slice of bread and top with second slice

title: cola steak crock pot
steps:
1. Trim meat , cut into 4 portions , dredge with flour
2. Put meat in crock pot , add other ingredients
3. Cover and cook 8- 10 hours on low
4. Yield: 8 servings

title: vegetarian french onion soup au vin with jarlsberg garlic toast
steps:
1. In a large casserole , heat oil over medium heat
2. Add onions and cook , stirring occasionally until soft , 5-7 minutes
3. Add garlic and sugar
4. Continue to cook , stirring often , until onions turn an amber color , 20-25 minutes
5. Stir in flour to coat onions and cook , stirring , 2-3 minutes
6. Gradually add broth , stirring constantly to prevent any lumps from forming
7. Bring to a boil , stirring occasionally , until soup thickens , 5-7 minutes
8. Add wine , salt and pepper
9. Cover , reduce heat to low , and simmer 5 minutes
10. Make the toasts: preheat oven to 425
11. Cut garlic cloves in half
12. Rub bread slices with garlic
13. Top each bread slice with cheese
14. Set on an ungreased baking sheet
15. Bake 4-5 minutes until cheese melts
16. To serve: ladle soup into bowls and float jarlsberg garlic toast on top

title: chocolate souffles
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Butter six 1-cup ramekins and coat with granulated sugar , tapping out the excess
3. Place ramekins on sturdy baking sheet
4. In a large bowl set over a pan of simmering water , melt the chocolate
5. Off the heat , whisk in the water and cocoa until smooth
6. In another bowl , using a handheld mixer , beat the egg whites at med-high speed until soft peaks form
7. Gradually beat in the 1 / 3 cup of granulated sugar and beat at high speed until the whites are firm and glossy
8. About one minute
9. Fold 1 / 4th of the beaten egg whites into the chocolate mixture , then fold in the rest until no streaks of white remain
10. Spoon the souffle mixture into the ramekins and smooth the tops
11. Run the
12. Bake in the center of the oven for 16 minutes , or until very puffy and set around the edges
13. Dust the tops with confectioners sugar and serve

title: crispy parmesan cups
steps:
1. Heat a small non stick pan on the stove top over med
2. Heat
3. Place 1 tbs
4. Cheese on a small pile , about the size of a quarter , cook until cheese melts and flip over , continue cooking until they are light golden brown
5. Place a mini muffin tin upside down on a flat surface
6. Drape cheese over the "molds" of the pan and press down with a second inverted mini muffin tin
7. Let cool and remove from molds
8. You can trim off any excess cheese for a more uniform cup

title: joy s pasta with chicken and broccoli
steps:
1. In a large skillet , heat the oil over medium heat
2. Saute garlic for about 1 minute , until golden , stirring constantly
3. Add chicken strips and saute until white and almost completely cooked
4. Add broccoli and saute until crisp-tender
5. Then add sun-dried tomatoes , basil , red-pepper flakes , salt and pepper
6. Add wine , then broth and butter and cook 3-5 minutes , or until heated through , stirring occasionally
7. Toss the cooked pasta with the chicken mixture
8. Serve with parmesan cheese , if desired

title: country fried yellow squash
steps:
1. Wash tender yellow squash
2. Remove stem and blossom ends
3. Cut into 1 / 2-inch rounds
4. Place squash , butter , onions and salt into heavy skillet
5. Add water
6. Cover and cook on medium low heat until water is absorbed and squash is tender
7. Lightly mash with a fork
8. Add sugar and cream
9. Let it cook slowly until mixture is fairly dry and flavors develop , being careful not to let it scorch

title: grandma s potato salad
steps:
1. In top of a double boiler over boiling water , heat water , butter and vinegar
2. In bowl , beat eggs , add sugar and cornstarch
3. Add to butter mixture , cook and stir constantly until thick , 5 to 7 minutes
4. Remove from the heat and cool
5. Stir in the salad dressing and fold in the whipped cream
6. In a large bowl , toss the potatoes , onions and green onions , celery , green pepper if using , salt and pepper
7. Pour dressing over , toss and mix gently
8. Chill
9. Garnish with sliced hard cooked eggs and paprika

title: paula deen s hot bacon cole slaw
steps:
1. In a large skillet , cook bacon until crisp
2. Remove to paper towels to drain
3. Crumble bacon and set aside
4. In reserved bacon fat , cook onions and bell peppers until limp , about 5 minutes
5. Add shredded cabbage and cook until limp , but not soft , about 3 to 5 minutes
6. Add chili powder and salt , to taste
7. Add tomatoes and simmer just until warmed through
8. Slaw should be slightly crisp
9. Adjust seasonings and add salt to taste
10. Serve quickly with crumbled bacon

title: loaded scrambled eggs for a crowd
steps:
1. Break eggs into a bowl
2. Add milk and beat well with a fork
3. Melt butter in large skillet
4. Cut onion in half lengthwise then slice the halves lengthwise into slivers
5. The slices hold their shape and texture better this way than when sliced crosswise
6. Saute in melted butter until nearly cooked and slightly browned
7. Add the meat and vegetables to the pan and saute briefly with the onions until thoroughly hot
8. Pour the eggs over the meat and vegetable mix
9. Cook on low-medium heat until about half done
10. Spread half the cheese over the eggs them scramble them around
11. Cook until nearly done
12. Add the rest of the cheese and scramble around again
13. Complete the cooking , scrambling again if necessary
14. Serve with your favorite bread , with homemade biscuits , with hash browns , or load into rolls or wraps

title: leek mac and cheese
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350
2. Melt 2 tablespoons of the butter in a large skillet
3. Add the leek greens and cook over high heat , stirring just until slightly wilted , 5 minutes
4. Season with salt and pepper
5. Cook over low heat until very tender , about 20 minutes
6. Meanwhile , in a large saucepan , melt the remaining 2 tablespoons of butter
7. Add the flour and cook over moderately high heat , whisking , for 2 minutes
8. Add the half-and-half and bring to a boil , whisking until thickened , about 5 minutes
9. Remove from the heat
10. Add 2 cups of the cheese , season with salt and pepper and whisk the cheese sauce until melted
11. In a large saucepan of salted boiling water , cook the macaroni until nearly al dente
12. Drain well
13. Add the macaroni and the cheese sauce to the leek greens and stir until combined
14. Transfer the macaroni to an 8-by-11-inch baking dish and sprinkle with the remaining 1 / 2 cup of cheese
15. Bake for about 40 minutes , until bubbling
16. Turn the broiler on and broil the mac and cheese until golden brown on top , about 3 minutes
17. Let stand for 15 minutes before serving

title: ginger oatmeal raisin cookies
steps:
1. Sift together the flour , baking powder and baking soda
2. Set mix aside
3. Beat the butter , both sugars , ginger , cinnamon , salt , and cayenne in a bowl until light and fluffy
4. Beat in the eggs , one at a time , and then add the milk and vanilla
5. Add the 1 / 2 flour mixture & mix
6. Add the rest of the flour and mix just until incorporated
7. Stir in the oats and raisins
8. Chill dough for at least 2 hours before baking
9. Preheat the oven to 325f
10. Line baking sheet with parchment paper
11. Scoop the cookie dough into 1 inch balls and put 2 inches apart on the baking sheet
12. Slightly flatten each ball
13. Sprinkle the tops with chopped candied ginger , if desired
14. Bake the cookies until lightly golden brown , about 15 minutes
15. Place on cooling racks to cool crispier

title: yummy  large  blueberry oat bran muffins
steps:
1. Mix dry ingredients , then in seperate bowl mix the wet ingredients
2. Add wet to the dry
3. Blend in 2 cups of fresh or frozen thrawed blueberries
4. If using liners for the muffins try to get the foil ones they don't stick when you try to get the muffin out
5. Bake 20 minutes at 400
6. Makes 12 large or 18 smaller ones --

title: fig and bourbon fizz
steps:
1. Muddle fig , mint leaves , and brown sugar cubes against sides of a cocktail shaker
2. Add bourbon and enough ice cubes to fill shaker
3. Cover with lid , and shake vigorously until thoroughly chilled
4. Strain into a 10-oz
5. Glass filled with ice cubes
6. Top with chilled ginger ale
7. Stir gently , and garnish , if desired
8. Serve immediately

title: sugared french toast
steps:
1. Allow bread to sit out while mixing
2. Whisk eggs , continue whisking while adding milk , vanilla and your desired amount of cinnamon
3. Dip bread in mix and flip
4. Place bread on greased frying pan or skillet
5. Flip after browned
6. Toast is done when no longer saturated with mixture
7. Butter toast and sprinkle desired amount of sugar

title: albondigas spanish style
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine the pork , veal , garlic , breadcrumbs , spices , egg and season with salt and pepper
2. Mix by hand until the mixture is smooth and leaves the side of the bowl
3. Refrigerate covered for one hour
4. When ready to cook , roll tablespoons of the mixture into balls
5. Heat one tbsp of olive oil in a frying pan and brown half the meatballs on medium-high heat
6. Drain on paper towels
7. Add the remaining oil , if necessary , and brown the other half of the meat balls
8. Drain on paper towels
9. Set aside the meatballs while making the sauce
10. Heat the oil in a frying pan and cook the onion on medium high until translucent
11. Add the garlic and cook for 1 minute more
12. Increase the heat to high and add the wine
13. Boil for 1 minute
14. Add the chopped tomatoes , tomato paste , oregano and stock and simmer for 10 minutes
15. Stir in the cayenne pepper
16. Add the peas and the meat balls and simmer for 10 minutes or until the sauce is thick
17. Serve hot

title: strawberry monkey juice
steps:
1. Blend the strawberries , lime juice , banana , and a little orange juice in a blender until smooth
2. Add the remaining orange juice and cracked ice if desired
3. Blend again

title: forevermama s sweet and sour meatballs   asian style
steps:
1. Meatballs:
2. In a bowl
3. Mix the ground pork with the sesame oil until well mixed , then mix in the cornstarch , egg and soy sauce
4. Prior to shaping the meatballs , have a plate ready to set your meatballs inches wet your hands under cold water
5. Take small portions of the meat mixture , about the size of walnuts , and roll them in-between your palms , shaping them into balls
6. Keep wetting your hands as to prevent the meat from sticking to your hands
7. This will also help in producing an even , smooth surface
8. Once all meatballs have been shaped and placed in plate
9. Set aside
10. Preparing sweet and sour sauce:
11. In a bowl
12. Blend the cornstarch with the water
13. Add the sherry , soy sauce , tomato paste , sugar , and vinegar
14. Drain the liquid from the pineapple and add liquid to the sauce mixture
15. Set the pineapple chunks aside
16. Heat the 3 tablespoons of oil in a wok or skillet and fry the meatballs until evenly browned and cooked through
17. Remove them from pan using a draining-spoon and place on a paper-towel lined plate
18. To the hot wok or skillet add more oil if necessary
19. To the hot oil , add the onion , peppers and carrots
20. Stir fry for about 5 - 9 minutes until slightly softened
21. Give the sauce mixture a stir
22. Pour it into the pan and bring to a boil , stirring all the time
23. Stir in the meatballs and pineapple chunks and cook , stirring over reduced heat for about 3-5 minutes
24. Serve hot with rice
25. These have always disappeared

title: cocoa mocha pie
steps:
1. Finely chop four candy bars
2. Place in a microwave safe bowl or double boiler
3. Add milk and coffee granules
4. Heat and stir until melted and smooth
5. Place ice cream in a bowl
6. Fold in mocha mixture
7. Spoon into crust
8. Freeze
9. Remove from the freezer 15 minutes before serving
10. Cut remaining candy bars into 1 / 2 inch pieces for garnish

title: country carrot cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. In a large bowl , stir together the flour , sweetener , baking powder , cinnamon , and salt
3. Add the milk , vanilla , oil , egg replacer , carrot , and ginger and mix together gently until just mixed
4. Pour into a lightly oiled cake pan and bake for 25-30 minutes
5. Check with a knife to see if done
6. When cooled , ice and serve

title: veal cutlets with wild mushrooms
steps:
1. Place the veal cutlets between 2 pieces of parchment paper or plastic wrap
2. Using a meat mallet or rolling pin , flatten the cutlets to an even thickness of about 1 / 4 inch
3. In a shallow bowl or deep plate , mix together the flour , paprika , tarragon , 2 tsp salt , and 1 tsp pepper
4. Dredge the veal on both sides in the seasoned flour , shake off the excess , and set aside
5. In a large frying pan , melt the 1 tb butter with the olive oil over medium-high heat
6. When the butter is foaming , add the veal , in batches to avoid crowding , and saute , turning once or twice , until lightly browned on both sides , 5-6 minutes
7. Transfer the cutlets to a platter and tent loosely with aluminum foil to keep them warm
8. Add more butter if needed and add the mushrooms to the pan
9. Saute , stirring often , until softened and lightly browned , 4-5 minutes
10. Stir in the sherry , stock , and tomato paste
11. Raise the heat to high and cook , stirring often , until the sauce thickens , 3-5 minutes
12. Remove from the heat and stir in the cream
13. Transfer the veal to individual plates and top with the mushroom sauce
14. Serve at once

title: cinnamon honey oat drop cookies
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees
2. Line 2 baking sheets with parchment paper
3. In a medium bowl , use an electric mixer to beat the butter , brown sugar , honey and vanilla
4. With the mixer running , add the eggs , one at a time , scraping the bowl in between additions
5. Stir in the flour , baking soda , salt and 1 tsp of the cinnamon
6. Stir in the oats
7. Scoop by tbsp onto prepared pans , leaving 2 inches between each cookie
8. Using a slightly moistened hand , flatten the cookies until 1 / 2 inch thick
9. In a small bowl , stir together the granulated sugar and remaining 1 / 2 tsp of cinnamon
10. Sprinkle lightly over the top of each cookie
11. Bake for 8-10 minutes or until no longer glossy and just starting to turn golden brown at the edges
12. Let cool on the pan for 10 minutes , then transfer to a rack to cool completely
13. Store in an airtight container at room temperature for up to a week

title: calabacitas casserole with polenta and cheese
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 500 degrees
2. Grease a 9 x 13 baking dish with 1 t olive oil
3. Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat
4. Add remaining 2 t olive oil , corn , garlic and jalapenos
5. Saute 3 minutes
6. Add zucchini , yellow squash and onions , season with salt , pepper and chili powder
7. Cook 7-8 minutes
8. Add stewed tomatoes and heat through
9. Transfer skillet contents to baking dish
10. Cut tube of polenta in 1 / 2-inch slices
11. Top vegetables with polenta and cheese
12. Place in oven to melt cheese and warm polenta , 8-10 minutes
13. Garnish with scallions and cilantro

title: douglas fir sparkletini
steps:
1. Cocktail
2. Fill a cocktail shaker with ice
3. Measure in the infused gin , cranberry and lemon juices , and simple syrup
4. Cap and shake vigorously
5. Strain into a martini glass and top with a splash of champagne
6. Garnish with a fir sprig and float a cranberry in the drink
7. Douglas fir infused gin:
8. 1 5- to 6-inch sprig fresh-picked douglas fir branch , rinsed
9. 1 bottle gin
10. Put the fir branch into the gin bottle , cap , and let sit 24 hours
11. Remove the branch and discard
12. The infused gin can be stored at room temperature for up to one year

title: slow cooker split pea soup
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients except ham in 5 qt slow cooker , then add ham
2. Cover and cook on low heat 8 to 10 hrs or on high heat 6 to 7 hours until peas are tender remove ham from cooker
3. Place on cutting board
4. Pull meat from bones , using 2 forks
5. Discard bones and skin
6. Stir ham into soup
7. Stir well before serving

title: broccoli with indian spiced yogurt
steps:
1. Wash the broccoli , and break it into its florets , and cook 4 to 5 minutes at the most in salted water
2. Drain
3. Heat oil in a skillet , and add the drained broccoli
4. Meanwhile , in a small skillet , toast the cumin , fennel and cardamom until fragrant , about 3 to 4 minutes , and then grind them in a mortar and pestle
5. Stir most of the spice mixture into the yogurt with the juice of the lemon
6. Drizzel the spiced yogurt over the broccoli , and garnish with remaining spice mixture and some zest of the lemon

title: garam masala dipping sauce with pita wedges
steps:
1. Combine first 5 ingredients in a bowl
2. Cover and chill 1 hour
3. Serve with pita wedges

title: hot rolls
steps:
1. Mix yeast in water and let stand about 10 minutes
2. Add sugar , melted shortening and salt and mix well
3. Add egg to mixture
4. Stir in 4-5 cups of flour
5. Place on a flour surface and knead in the remaining cup of flour
6. Knead about 10 minutes
7. Put in large greased bowel and let rise until double in size , about 1 hour
8. Punch dough down and form into dinner rolls and place sides touching in a 9x13 greased pan
9. Let rise again until double , about 1 hours
10. Bake at 350 degrees 15-20 minutes or until golden brown

title: walnut chocolate chip cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325
2. Line baking sheets with parchment paper
3. Combine all-purpose flour , whole wheat flour , flaxseed meal , soda and salt until blended
4. Reserve
5. On medium-high speed , beat brown sugar , butter and granulated sugar until smooth
6. Stir in egg , yolk and vanilla until blended
7. On low speed , gradually beat in reserved flour mixture until blended
8. Stir in chips and walnuts
9. Drop by rounded tablespoonfuls , 2" apart , onto baking sheets
10. Flatten slightly
11. Bake 12 minutes or until lightly browned
12. Cool 1 minute on baking sheets
13. Transfer to racks
14. Cool

title: cheddar baked potatoes
steps:
1. In small bowl , combine soup , paprika , salt
2. In greased 2 qt
3. Oblong baking dish , arrange potatoes in overlapping rows
4. Sprinkle with cheese
5. Spoon soup mixture over cheese
6. Cover with foil
7. Bake at 400 for 45 minutes
8. Uncover
9. Bake 10 minutes or until fork-tender

title: low fat oatmeal waffles
steps:
1. Mix all dry ingredients together in a bowl
2. In another bowl , mix all wet ingredients
3. Make a well in the dry ingredients and pour in the wet , and mix together
4. Preheat waffle iron and coat with cooking spray
5. Cook waffles in waffle iron

title: happy s crockery pot fajitas
steps:
1. In slow-cooker , combine beef , peppers , onion , fajita mix and water
2. Cover and cook on low for 5-6 hours or until meat is tender
3. Warm tortilla in microwave according to package directions
4. With spoon , lift meat mixture out of pot
5. Place about 3 / 4 cup mixture along center of each tortilla
6. Top with chopped tomato , sour cream and avocado
7. Fold both sides over filling

title: roast chicken with orange  lemon   ginger
steps:
1. Preheat an oven to 400f
2. Cut the lemon into quarters
3. Rub the outside of the chicken with one of the lemon quarters then discard
4. In a small bowl , stir together the lemon and orange zests and 1 tablespoon of the grated ginger
5. Rub this mixture evenly in the cavity and put the lemon and orange quarters inside the bird
6. Place the chicken on a rack in a roasting pan
7. Sprinkle it with salt and pepper
8. In the now-empty small bowl , combine the melted olive oil , lemon and orange juices , honey , and the remaining 2 tablespoons ginger and mix well
9. Place the chicken in the oven on its side and roast about ten minutes
10. Turn on its other side and roast ten minutes more
11. Turn oven down to 350f and turn chicken so it is roasting breast side up and roast till done--about another 40 minutesuntil the juices run clear when the thigh is pierced with a knife , about 1 hour
12. Baste with the citrus juice mixture at least 4 times during cooking
13. Transfer to a serving platter and let rest for 10 to 15 minutes
14. Variation: use 4 tablespoons pomegranate juice in place of the lemon juice

title: healthy vegan banana prune cookies
steps:
1. First , mash bananas in large bowl
2. Then , add vanilla and salt
3. Stir
4. Then add prunes , raisins , flax meal , coconut , and chopped nuts
5. Stir
6. Last , add oats and stir again
7. Spoon heaping tablespoon onto baking sheet and flatten slightly with a fork
8. Cook for 20 at 350 degrees
9. Let cool and enjoy !

title: asparagus with herb butter
steps:
1. In small saucepan , melt butter
2. Stir in tarragon and lemon peel
3. Simmer 2 minutes over low heat
4. Pour over warmed asparagus spears

title: eggplant  aubergine  and portabella schnitzel
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f coat baking sheet with cooking spray
2. To make the schnitzel:
3. Whisk the milk and egg together in a large bowl
4. Spread the breadcrumbs on a large plate
5. Dip the mushroom and eggplant slices into the milk mixture , then coat the slices with breadcrumbs
6. Shake off the excess crumbs , and place on the prepared baking sheet
7. Spray the vegetables with cooking spray , and bake 10 minutes
8. Flip vegetables , and spray again with the cooking spray
9. Bake 10-15 minutes more , or until the vegetables are tender and breadcrumbs are dark golden brown
10. Set aside
11. To make lemon caper sauce:
12. Melt the butter in a saucepan over medium high heat
13. Cook 2-3 minutes , or until the butter begins to brown
14. Stir in oil and capers , and cook 1 minute more
15. Remove from the heat , and add lemon juice and parsley
16. To serve , stack 1 mushroom and several eggplant rounds on each plate
17. Drizzle with the lemon caper sauce , and garnish with lemon slices and parsley sprigs
18. Serve immediately
19. Enjoy !

title: easiest breadsticks ever
steps:
1. In large bowl combine warm water , yeast , & sugar
2. Let sit until yeast is dissolved
3. Add 3 cups flour and stir until smooth
4. Add salt and more flour
5. Knead until smooth ball
6. Let rest 10 minutes
7. Roll out on large cookie sheet
8. Melt 1 cube of butter with garlic salt and italian seasonings
9. Pour ever top of dough
10. Cut in strips with a pizza cutter
11. Top with parmesan cheese and bake at 350 degrees for about 25 minutes or until done

title: harvest snack cake
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine the flour , brown sugar , baking soda , cinnamon , nutmeg and ginger
2. Combine the eggs , applesauce and vanilla
3. Stir into dry ingredients just until moistened
4. Fold in the carrots and raisins
5. Spread evenly in a 13-in
6. X 9-in
7. Baking pan coated with cooking spray
8. Bake at 350 for 30-35 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean
9. Cool on a wire rack
10. Yield: 15 servings

title: sparkling carrots
steps:
1. Melt butter in saucepan over medium heat
2. Add sugar , lemon-lime soda and carrots
3. Cook on medium-high heat 8 to 10 minutes until carrots are slightly glazed

title: my blueberry cobbler
steps:
1. For topping: sift together flour , sugar , baking powder and salt
2. Cut in 1 / 4 cup butter until coarse crumb consistency
3. Combine milk and egg
4. Add all at once to dry ingredients , stirring until just moistened
5. Set aside
6. For fruit filling: combine blueberries , sugar , tapioca and water in a saucepan
7. Let stand 5 minutes to soften tapioca
8. Cook and stir until slightly thickened and bubbly
9. Stir in 1 tbsp butter
10. Pour filling into an 8-inch round baking dish
11. Immediately spoon on biscuit topping in 6 mounds
12. Bake at 400f for 20 to 25 minutes
13. Serve warm with cream or ice cream

title: vodka dip for shrimp
steps:
1. Whisk together all ingredients in a medium bowl , until well combined
2. Cover and refrigerate several hours for flavors to blend
3. Before serving , taste and adjust for seasoning
4. Place dip in a serving bowl and surround with shrimp

title: packer s asparagus   tomato quiche
steps:
1. Mix first seven ingredients until well blended
2. Set aside
3. Slice half of the asparagus spears and place on the bottom of the piecrust
4. Pour mixture on top
5. Bake for twenty minutes in a pre-heated 375 oven
6. Remove from oven and arrange remaining asparagus and tomatoes on top of the quiche
7. Continue baking for another 20-30 minutes or until set
8. Enjoy !

title: monkey balls
steps:
1. Knead dough
2. Mix sugar and cinnamon in small bowl
3. Pinch off dough into walnut-size balls
4. Roll in melted butter , then in sugar-cinnamon mixture
5. Place in butter-greased bundt or angel food pan , in layers
6. Sprinkle nuts over each layer , if desired
7. Pour remaining butter and sugar over top
8. Let rise , about 10 minutes
9. Bake in 325 degree oven for 35 to 45 minutes
10. Invert onto plate while still warm

title: kiwi cottage cheese wraps
steps:
1. Mix kiwifruit with cottage cheese
2. Set aside
3. Spread each tortilla with 1 tbsp of the peanut butter
4. Divide fruit mixture evenly among tortillas
5. Roll up and eat

title: mcgriddle  pancakes breakfast sandwich
steps:
1. Mix first four ingredients
2. Pour 1 / 4 cup batter for each pancake onto a 300 degree griddle
3. Flip when pancakes start to bubble
4. Place warm cheese on meat , sandwich between pancakes

title: strawberry hazelnut gateau
steps:
1. Beat the egg whites with salt until soft peaks form , gradually add sugar , beat until the sugar is dissolved and mixture is of meringue consistency
2. Beat in the vinegar and vanilla
3. Line bases of two 20cm springform pans with greased greaseproof paper which has been lightly dusted with cornflour
4. Spread meringue mixture evenly into tins
5. Sprinkle ground hazelnuts evenly over meringue in both tins
6. With a knife or small spatula , swirl hazelnuts lightly through meringue
7. Smooth over top of meringue with the back of a spoon
8. Bake in moderate oven 35 - 40 minutes or until meringue is crisp to touch
9. Release sides of pan , cool on the base of the pan
10. Chop chocolate
11. Combine with water in top of double saucepan
12. Stir over simmering water until melted
13. Cool
14. Remove cakes from bases
15. Place a layer of meringue on a serving plate , flat side down
16. Spread with a thin layer of chocolate
17. Spread whipped cream over chocolate
18. Reserve 4 strawberries , wash and hull the remainder , cut in half , arrange over cream
19. Spread the underside of second meringue with remaining chocolate mixture , place on top of strawberry layer , chocolate side down
20. Whip extra cream , cover sides and top of cake and if desired , pipe cream decoratively on top
21. Arrange reserved halved strawberries on top of cake
22. Refrigerate until ready to serve
23. If desired , brush strawberries used for decoration with warmed , sieved strawberry jam to give them a pretty glaze before arranging on cake
24. Cheers , doreen doreen randal , wanganui
25. New zealand

title: waldorf chicken  wrap
steps:
1. Place the yogurt in a strainer lined with a paper towel
2. Put the strainer over a bowl and place in the refrigerator to drain and thicken for 30 minutes
3. In a small bowl , combine the thickened yogurt , mayonnaise , lemon juice , mustard , salt and thyme until smooth
4. Fold in chicken , grapes , walnuts , celery and apples
5. Season with pepper
6. Place 1 lettuce leaf on a wrap
7. Spoon about 3 / 4 cup of the chicken filling onto wrap and roll wrap around filling

title: big low fat banana split
steps:
1. Grab a bowl
2. Scoop the ice cream in the bowl
3. Put syrup on the ice cream , if wanted healthy , and throw out sprinkles too
4. Put cherry on top

title: high alititude french macarons
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f
2. Place egg whites and cater sugar in a bowl and mix with electric mixer until stiff enough to turn the bowl upside down without it falling out , continue to whip for 1-2 more minutes
3. How long this takes will depend on you mixer
4. Add gel or powdered food coloring and continue to mix for a further 20seconds
5. Sift the almond meal and icing sugar and salt twice , discarding any almond lumps that are too big to pass through the sieve
6. Fold into the egg white mixture
7. It should take roughly 30-50 folds using a rubber spatula
8. The mixture should be smooth and a very viscous , not runny
9. Over-mix and your macarons will be flat and have no foot , under mix and they will not be smooth on top see the macaron troubleshooting post for examples
10. Pipe onto trays lined with baking paper , rap trays on the bench firmly and then bake in the oven for 20 minutes
11. Check if one comes off the tray fairly cleanly , if not bake for a little longer

title: i yam what i yam two  muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Add the brown sugar , flour , cinnamon to a small bowl and cut in softened butter
3. When mixture is well mixed stir in chopped pecans
4. Set aside
5. Spray a 12-muffin tin with non-stick cooking spray and set aside
6. Combine the flours , cocoa , baking powder , cinnamon , cloves , baking soda , and salt
7. Lightly beat eggs with honey , sugar , oil , mashed yams and orange juice
8. Add the egg mixture and buttermilk alternately to the dry ingredients , stir until well blended
9. Add orange peel to batter mixing well
10. Spoon batter into prepared muffin tins , sprinkle lightly with strussel topping and bake in preheated oven for 15 to 20 minutes

title: crab tomato bisque
steps:
1. Melt butter in a heavy saucepan
2. Add 3 / 4 of the crabmeat , 1 / 3 c basil , and garlic
3. Saute 2 minutes
4. Stir in flour , stir for 2 minutes
5. Add clam-tomato juice , cream , ketchup , clam juice , old bay and pepper sauce reduce heat to low , simmer for 10 minutes
6. Puree soup with an immersion blender add water and lemon juice , simmer
7. Season to taste with salt& pepper
8. Pour into 6 bowls , garnish with remaining crab and basil

title: healthy crispy fish sandwich with pineapple slaw
steps:
1. Whisk mayonnaise , yogurt , vinegar and crushed red pepper to taste in a medium bowl
2. Add pineapple and coleslaw mix and stir to combine
3. Place cornmeal in a shallow dish
4. Sprinkle both sides of fish with cajun seasoning and salt
5. Dredge the fish in the cornmeal
6. Heat 2 teaspoons oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
7. Add half the fish and cook until golden , about 2 minutes per side
8. Transfer to a plate and repeat with the remaining 2 teaspoons oil and fish , adjusting heat as needed to prevent burning
9. Top toasted bread with the fish and pineapple slaw to make sandwiches
10. Serve immediately

title: lighter guacamole
steps:
1. In a bowl lightly mash avocados
2. Put the thawed peas and the water in a blender to process until smooth , about 30 seconds
3. Remove and add to the bowl with the avocados
4. Stir in remaining ingredients
5. Cover with plastic wrap , pressed tightly to the guacamole to prevent browning
6. Refrigerate

title: clamdigger breakfast sandwich
steps:
1. Spray a frying pan with the cooking spray and put on medium-high heat
2. Beat together egg and milk
3. Dip a slice of bread in the egg mixture to coat and place it in the pan
4. You may need more egg mix to do both slices , but this is usually enough
5. Cook until toast is browned on one side , then flip
6. Cook on the other side until done in the middle and browned on both sides , adjust heat as necessary to get this result
7. Remove the slice from the skillet
8. Dip and cook the second slice the same way , but after flipping , top with cheese , ham and the other slice of toast in that order and cook until the second slice of toast is done
9. Serve with maple syrup
10. Yum

title: frozen bananas
steps:
1. Place bananas so they are not touching on a plate and freeze for one hour
2. Transfer to a resealable freezer bag , pressing out as much air as possible before sealing the bag , and return bananas to freezer
3. Frozen bananas will keep for up to one month

title: yorkshire pudding with blue cheese
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees
2. Combine first 7 ingredients in a bowl
3. Beat at medium speed with electric mixer until smooth
4. Beat at high speed 15 seconds
5. Set aside
6. Divide oil evenly among 8 muffin or popover cups
7. Coat sides of cups with cooking spray
8. Place muffin cups in oven for 3 minutes
9. Divide batter evenly among hot prepared cups
10. Bake for 10 minutes
11. Reduce oven temperature to 350 degrees
12. Bake additional 15 minutes or until golden
13. Serve immediately

title: wookie cookies
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 375
2. Put the flour , baking soda , salt , and cinnamon in a mixing bowl
3. Stir with the wooden spoon until well mixed
4. Set aside
5. Put the butter , brown sugar , and granulated sugar in another mixing bowl
6. Using the electric mixer set on high speed , beat together until well blended and creamy , about 3 minutes
7. Beat in the eggs and vanilla extract
8. Add the flour mixture and stir with the wooden spoon until blended
9. Stir in the chocolate chips
10. Scoop up a rounded tablespoonful of the dough and drop onto a baking sheet
11. Repeat until you have used up all the dough
12. Be sure to leave about 1 inch between the cookies because they spread as they bake
13. Using pot holders , put the baking sheets in the oven
14. Bake until golden brown , about 10 minutes
15. Again , using pot holders , remove the baking sheets from the oven
16. Lift the cookies from the baking sheets with a spatula , and place on cooling racks
17. Let cool completely
18. Makes about 3 dozen cookies

title: smothered ground sirloin steak with adobo gravy
steps:
1. Divide sirloin into 4 equal portions , shaping each into a 1 / 2 inch thick patty
2. Drain chipotles through a sieve over a bowl to catch sauce
3. Reserve 1 / 4 cup sauce
4. Save the chipotle peppers for another use
5. Heat a large nonstick skillet coated with cooking spray over medium high heat
6. Add patties and onion
7. Cook 5 minutes on each side
8. Add adobo sauce and consomme
9. Bring to a boil
10. Cover , reduce heat , and simmer 10 minutes
11. Combine soy sauce and cornstarch , stir well
12. Add to pan
13. Bring to boil
14. Cook 1 minute or until thick

title: rabbit with tarragon sauce
steps:
1. Put the flour , tarragon , salt& pepper in a zip lock bag and mix well
2. Add the rabbit piece by piece , shake well to lightly coat each piece
3. Melt butter in a large skillet , add oil
4. Saute the rabbit pieces until golden
5. Remove apprx 1 / 2 of the butter / oil so your sauce will not have too much grease
6. Add chicken broth
7. Simmer rabbit apprx 60 minutes
8. Cover for half the time uncover the last 30 minutes
9. If you wish you may thicken the sauce with a little flour

title: enchilada polenta pie
steps:
1. Heat oil in a small skillet and cook the onion until browned , about five minutes
2. Transfer the onion to a lightly oiled slow cooker
3. Add the cornmeal , salt , and 1 / 2 teaspoon of chili powder
4. Stir in boiling water
5. Cover and cook on low for 6-8 hours , stirring often
6. In a large bowl , combine the salsa , beans , corn , chiles , red onion , olives , and remaining 1 tablespoon chili powder
7. Set aside
8. About half an hour before ready to serve , spread the bean mixture over the top of the polenta
9. Cover and continue to cook on low until warmed through
10. Serve garnished with cheddar cheese or monterey jack cheese , and crumbled tortilla chips

title: moroccan spiced roast chickpeas
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f
2. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper
3. Pat the chickpeas dry between two paper towels then place on the baking sheet
4. Drizzle with the olive oil then roast the chickpeas in the middle of the oven , tossing every 15 minutes , until deeply golden , dry and crunchy , 40 to 45 minutes
5. While the chickpeas roast , prepare the spice mixture: combine the cumin , brown sugar , cayenne , cinnamon , garlic , ginger , paprika and salt in a medium bowl
6. Mix until the color is uniform
7. As soon as the chickpeas come out of the oven , toss with the spice blend
8. Serve warm or at room temperature

title: cheese ring
steps:
1. Mix all of the above together and form into a ring
2. Place large jar of strawberry preserves in middle of ring
3. Serve with escort crackers
4. This is a beautiful dish for the holidays

title: simple savory salmon patties
steps:
1. In a medium mixing bowl , combine salmon , egg , celery and green onion until mixed thoroughly
2. 2
3. Stir in flour , salt and pepper
4. 3
5. In a small mixing bowl , combine baking powder and reserved juice , stir into salmon mixture and form 6 patties
6. 4
7. In a large skillet , fry patties and oil for 3 to 5 minutes per side or until golden brown

title: watermelon fizz
steps:
1. Process watermelon in food processor until smooth
2. Strain through a sieve into a bowl
3. Discard seeds and pulp
4. Transfer juice to a jug
5. Chill in fridge
6. Divide ice and lime slices between 6 glasses
7. Pour over watermelon , then vodka , top up with ginger beer to serve
8. Alternatively , stir juice , vodka and ginger beer all together in a jug and pour over ice

title: thai rice salad with lemongrass
steps:
1. Heat a frying pan or wok at high temperature
2. Add oil , lemongrass , peppers and spring-onion an stir fry for 3 minutes
3. Mix rice , meat , mint , coriander , lime leaves and lemon grass root mixture in a bowl
4. Mix lime juice , sugar and fish sauce and pour over salad
5. Serve chilled

title: lemon garlic broccoli
steps:
1. Add broccoli florets , lemon zest , minced garlic , lemon olive oil , and 1 tablespoon water to a microwave-safe bowl
2. Stir to coat completely
3. Cover bowl with plastic and microwave on high for 4 to 5 minutes
4. Check for tenderness
5. Cook 1 more minute if needed
6. Sprinkle lemon juice over broccoli and toss to coat
7. Season to taste with salt and black pepper (add a light sprinkle of parmesan cheese if desired)
8. Serve immediately
9. Enjoy !
10. )

title: smoked mozzarella and greens penne
steps:
1. Heat evoo in a large pan
2. Brown pancetta , and onion
3. Add garlic and chili flakes
4. Add greens and cook until wilted
5. Add chicken stock and cook until stock reduces
6. Add pasta and cheese toss , add salt and pepper to taste , serve

title: great biscuits
steps:
1. Mix the ingredients together
2. Roll the dough and cut the biscuits about 1 / 2 inch thick
3. Bake at 400 degrees for 10-15 minutes i use a cast iron biscuit skillet

title: black bean blender soup
steps:
1. In a blender , combine beans , broth , salsa , and cumin
2. Blend until fairly smooth
3. Heat soup in a saucepan over medium heat
4. Serve topped with chopped cilantro

title: chocolate hedgehog
steps:
1. For the slice :
2. Line a baking tin with baking paper
3. Melt butter and sugar in a small saucepan over a low heat , add cocoa and mix well
4. Remove from heat and add beaten egg
5. Place all other ingredients into a bowl
6. Add melted mixture and stir well
7. Press into pan and chill until set
8. Spread with the icing
9. For the icing:
10. Sift icing sugar and cocoa together and add water
11. Mix to a smooth consistency , adding more water if needed
12. Sprinkle with some extra coconut if you like
13. Chill until set and then cut into squares

title: sweet dill pickled okra
steps:
1. Pack washed okra in 6 pint jars
2. Divide garlic , celery seed , hot pepper and dill seed between the jars
3. Combine salt , sugar , water and vinegar in large saucepan
4. Bring to boiling and pour into jars to within 1 / 2 inch of top
5. Seal jars and place in hot water bath for 7 minutes
6. Remove to wire rack to cool

title: peanut butter s more cookie bars
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f spray 13x9-inch pan with nonstick cooking spray
2. Spoon cookie dough in bottom of sprayed pan
3. With floured fingers , press dough evenly to form crust
4. Bake at 350f for 16 to 19 minutes or until golden brown
5. Remove pan from oven
6. Sprinkle with marshmallows
7. Return to oven
8. Bake an additional 2 to 3 minutes or until marshmallows are puffy
9. Meanwhile , in small saucepan , melt chocolate chips with oil over low heat , stirring until smooth
10. Remove pan from oven
11. Sprinkle with colored candy pieces
12. Drizzle melted chocolate mixture over warm bars
13. Cool 45 minutes or until completely cooled
14. Cut into bars

title: wanda s cutout cream cookies
steps:
1. Sift together dry ingredients: flour , baking powder and pinch of salt
2. In a mixing bowl , cream butter and sugar with electric mixer , till light and fluffy
3. Add eggs , light cream and flavoring
4. Turn out dough onto plastic wrap
5. Flatten with hands chill in refrigerator for 1 hour
6. Remove dough and roll on on a lightly floured board 1 / 8" thick
7. Press with favorite cookie cutters
8. Preheat oven at 425 degrees and bake for 12-15 minutes
9. Dust with confectionery sugar or frost with favorite icing

title: tasty tea baked apples
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. In a 1 quart saucepan , bring water to a boil
3. Remove from heat
4. Add tea bags and brew 1 1 / 2 minutes , dunking occasionally
5. Remove tea bags and squeeze
6. Set aside
7. Peel top one-third of each apple
8. In an 8-inch square baking dish , arrange apples , peeled end up
9. Set aside
10. In a small bowl , combine brown sugar , walnuts , raisins and cinnamon
11. Evenly spoon walnut mixture into center of apples , then evenly top with butter
12. Pour tea over and around apples
13. Bake apples uncovered , basting occasionally , 1 hour or until tender
14. Enjoy !

title: broiled haddock fillets
steps:
1. Place fillets on lightly greased broiler pan
2. Brush fillets lightly with oil
3. Combine mayonnaise , mustard , and parmesan cheese
4. Spread on fillets
5. Broil 4" from heat approximately 10 minutes
6. Per inch of thickenss or until fish is close to point of flakiness

title: quick asian chicken salad
steps:
1. Place bok choy , chicken , carrots and chives in serving bowl
2. Combine chili sauce , oil , vinegar , soy sauce and ginger in small bowl
3. Mix well
4. Pour over chicken mixture and toss gently

title: joyce s easy dinner party parmesan potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425
2. Throw oil and butter into a glass baking dish and put in oven to melt
3. I usually use a little more butter and 'cut' it with drizzles of olive oil
4. Rinse potatoes and pat dry
5. Put potatoes into butter / olive oil mixture and turn to coat
6. Liberally sprinkle with parmesan cheese
7. As potatoes are baking keep turning and sprinkling with more parmesan until well coated
8. Bake , sprinkle and turn 30 - 40 minutes until potatoes are crispy & golden brown

title: the ultimate chocolate pudding dessert
steps:
1. Mix first layer ingredients together and spread into a 9x13-inch pan
2. Bake at 325f for 15 minutes
3. Cool
4. Mix together second layer and spread onto cooled first layer
5. Mix together third layer and spread on and refrigerate
6. Top with softened cool whip just before serving
7. Enjoy !

title: gnocchi with sage  mushrooms   mascarpone
steps:
1. Heat the oil , add the shallots and cook for 5 minutes , stirring occasionally
2. Add the mushrooms and cook for a further 5 - 6 minutes , stirring occasionally until golden
3. Stir in the sage , mascarpone and seasoning to taste
4. Meanwhile , bring a pan of lightly salted water to the boil and cook the gnocchi following instructions on the pack
5. Drain , reserving approximately 3 tablespoons of the cooking liquid and place the gnocchi in a serving dish
6. Stir the reserved liquid into the sauce , pour over the gnocchi and serve straight away garnished with fresh sage leaves and parmesan shavings

title: sun dried tomato soup with wild mushrooms and wild rice
steps:
1. In a large pot , heat the oil over medium-high heat
2. Cook the onions until golden brown , about 8 minutes , stirring occasionally
3. Stir in garlic
4. Cook for 2 minutes
5. Stir in the mushrooms and celery
6. Cook for 5 minutes , stirring occasionally
7. Stir in the tomatoes
8. Reduce the heat to medium low
9. Add the beef broth , tomato paste , red pepper flakes , salt , and cayenne
10. Cook for 1 hour , reducing the heat to low when the soup starts to boil , stirring occasionally
11. Meanwhile , cook the wild rice using the package directions , omitting the salt and margarine
12. Be careful not to overcook
13. Just before serving , stir the rice into the soup
14. Garnish with green onions

title: patatas a lo pobre   potatoes with onion and parsley   spain
steps:
1. Cut the potatoes into rough slices about 1 / 8 to 1 / 4" in width
2. Heat the oil over medium-high heat and add the onions and garlic and cook for about 5 minutes over medium heat
3. Now add the potatoes and cook over medium heat for about 20 minutes stirring occasionally until the potatoes are done
4. Be careful not to cook on very high heat as this will brown the potatoes and it is also important not to overcook the potatoes as they will be soft and mushy
5. When done , remove from the heat and strain off the extra oil
6. Put into a bowl and toss with the parsley , add salt and pepper to your taste and enjoy !

title: potato leek mushroom soup
steps:
1. Heat butter in large stock pot over low heat
2. Cook shallots and garlic until tender
3. Add potato and leeks- cook for 10 minutes , uncovered , stirring occasionally
4. Add stock or water , salt and pepper and bring to boil
5. Reduce to simmer , add mushrooms and continue for 15 minutes , or until potato is tender
6. Whiz with blender stick , or blender in batches
7. Add cream or milk and adjust salt and pepper to taste
8. Serve with my spicy croutons

title: braised pork loin chops with thyme lemon sauce
steps:
1. Put pork in large glass baking dish
2. Mix 2 t lemon juice , thyme , lemon peel and garlic in small bowl and rub mix over both sides of chops
3. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour , & up to 1 day
4. Put pork chops on baking sheet , sprinkling each lightly with flour , then salt and pepper
5. Heat oil in large nonstick skillet over high heat
6. Working in batches , add pork to skillet and cook until lightly browned , about 1 minute per side
7. Return all pork to skillet
8. Add milk and boil until pork is cooked through and sauce thickens slightly , about 1 minute
9. Transfer chops to platter
10. Whisk remaining 1 t lemon juice into sauce in skillet and stir to blend , about 30 seconds
11. Season with salt and pepper , then pour sauce over pork and serve

title: grilled salmon salad
steps:
1. Rub the salmon filets with a little olive oil so they don't stick to the grill and salt and pepper them lightly
2. Cook the filets on a hot grill for about 5- 6 min
3. Per side
4. They should still be rare in the middle
5. Cover with plastic wrap and chill for several hours until cold and firm
6. Remove from frig and remove any skin
7. Break filets up into small chunks and put into a bowl
8. If there is any juice on the plate they chilled on , dump it into the bowl with salmon
9. Add the celery , onion , capers and dill
10. Mix the olive oil , vinegar salt and pepper and pour over salmon
11. Mix well and serve cold or at room temp

title: silky chocolate peanut butter pie
steps:
1. Melt chocolate chips in a small bowl in microwave at high power 90 seconds
2. Stir until smooth
3. Cool slightly
4. Place tofu , peanut butter , sugar & vanilla in blender or food processor and whirl until smooth
5. Add chocolate and whirl until combined
6. Pour into crust
7. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate several hours until filling is set
8. Can garnish with peanuts , melted chocolate or whipped cream

title: baked rice for a crowd
steps:
1. In large pot , bring rice and 3 and 1 / 2 cups of broth to a boil , then lower heat and simmer for 20 minutes or until tender
2. Meanwhile , melt butter in skillet and saute onions and celery until softened , then add remaining broth and all other remaining ingedients
3. Combine rice with sauteed vegetables , pour into a greased 13 x 9 baking dish , and bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes

title: trattoria salad
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients including marinade from artichokes except for romaine lettuce
2. Add black pepper to taste
3. Let marinate in the refrigerator until serving time
4. Toss in lettuce at serving time and serve with hot french bread

title: creamed ham   potatoes
steps:
1. Place potatoes and onion in a large pot with enough water to cover by an inch
2. Cover and bring to a boil over high heat
3. Remove cover , reduce heat to med-high and cook an additional 15 minutes or until potatoes are easily pierced with a paring knife
4. Drain well
5. Meanwhile , melt butter in a saucepan over medium heat
6. Combine flour , 1 / 2 tsp salt , and 1 / 4 tsp pepper
7. Whisk into butter until smooth
8. Gradually whisk in milk , ensuring liquid has been fully incorporated before adding more
9. Cook 2-3 minutes until slightly thickened , whisking frequently
10. Add mustard to sauce
11. Sauce should have a strong flavor on its own as the potatoes mellow it out a lot
12. Combine drained potatoes , sauce , and ham in the large pot by stirring with a heavy spoon
13. This will break down some of the potatoes and the released starches will finish binding up the sauce
14. Add remaining salt and pepper , more to taste if needed , and heat through

title: blue heaven banana pancakes
steps:
1. Beat egg until fluffy
2. Add milk and oil / melted butter
3. Add vanilla
4. In another bowl , combine all dry ingredients
5. Take bananas out of skin and cut into very small pieces
6. They do not have to be perfect , and do not worry about then getting a bit "mashed"
7. Add dry ingredients gradually to egg mixture
8. Add cut bananas
9. In a non-stick 8-10" skillet , heat pan to medium
10. Pan is ready when water dances on surface
11. Pour batter in pan using ladle or pitcher , forming a pancake approx 4-5" wide
12. When the edges start looking a little "matte" and the pancake is bubbly , flip
13. When you see steam start "wisping" from the edges of the pancake , it is done
14. Top with syrup , whipped cream , or more bananas and nuts

title: vegan breakfast sausages
steps:
1. Combine all dry ingredients in a large bowl
2. In separate bowl whisk all the wet ingredients
3. Stir the wet into dry and mix lightly until combined and spongy dough forms
4. Form 1 / 4 to 1 / 3 cup of dough at a time into a small log about 6 inches long
5. Individually wrap in aluminum foil (tightly , twisting the ends at the top and bottom like sausage casings
6. If they aren't wrapped tight enough they will burst out
7. When they are all wrapped up arrange them into a steamer basket over boiling water , and steam for 30 minutes
8. Cool , and remove from foil
9. Keeps in the fridge for up to a week
10. I freeze mine and take out as needed
11. What you have here when you're done is equal to raw sausage ! is isn't done yet ! :) i like to saute it in a little oil in a cast iron skillet
12. It also crumbles up swell for tofu scrambles etc
13. Or slices for sausage and peppers
14. Sometimes after i unwrap these i immediately throw them in the oven with a little oil for another 10-15 minutes to crisp up the "skin"
15. I use a strainer fitted over the top of a pot making sure the bottom of the strainer doesn't touch the water in the bottom of the pot
16. Then cover with a lid

title: buttercream dream  by agentcakebaker
steps:
1. Bring butter to room temperature
2. In a mixing bowl , whip butter and crisco together
3. Add the extract and whip
4. Slowly add the powdered sugar and mix well
5. Add one tbs milk at a time until you get your desired stiffness
6. Whip for 5-10 minutes until fluffy

title: pineapple barbecued  meatballs
steps:
1. Mix all together leaving meatballs frozen
2. Cook slowly over low heat til meatballs thaw , and heat through
3. Serve hot

title: oriental steak
steps:
1. In a small bowl combine all of the marinade ingredients
2. Put the steak in a plasic bag
3. Pour in the marinade
4. Close the bag and place in a shallow baking pan
5. Marinate in the refrigerator for at least 4 hours or overnight
6. Preheat the broiler
7. Remove steak from bag and discard marinade
8. Place on broiling pan
9. Broil for 5-7 minutes on each side

title: bay smoked potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Dry washed potatoes and toss with 1-3 t olive oil
3. Place bay leaves on the bottom of a heavy , shallow casserole with cover
4. Sprinkle with 1 t coarse salt
5. Place potatoes on top and sprinkle with remaining 1 t coarse salt
6. Cover tightly , using aluminum foil if necessary and bake 1 hour
7. Remove potatoes , cut in half and drizzle with remaining 1-2 t olive oil
8. Season with salt and pepper and serve hot

title: pineapple mango chutney dipping sauce
steps: 1. Mix all ingredients together in a medium bowl

title: white chocolate raspberry tart  with almonds and pistachios
steps:
1. You will need a tart pan with a removable bottom that has been lined with baking parchment
2. Roast the nuts by popping them into a medium oven for 10 minutes or so , until they are just going brown - keep a close eye on them
3. Put to one side
4. For the tart crust , put the flour , sugar and butter into a food processor and pulse until you have fine crumbs
5. Add the egg and 2 tablespoons of the water and pulse until a dough ball starts to come together , add the rest of the water gradually until you have a smooth dough
6. Shape the dough into a disk , pop into a plastic bag and let it rest in the fridge for 30 minutes
7. When rested , place the dough onto a floured surface and roll it out to fit the tart pan
8. Trim excess pastry and chill for 20 minutes
9. Heat the oven to 350f while the pastry is chilling
