10. After removing the case from the fridge , pop a piece of foil or baking parchment onto the crust and fill with baking beans or pie weights
11. Bake for about 15-20 minutes , edges should be just tuning brown , remove the weights and cook for 5-10 minutes more , or until golden
12. Remove from oven and cool completely on a wire rack
13. For the tart filling:
14. Spread the raspberries evenly over the tart crust , sprinkle half the almonds and pistachios over the raspberries
15. In a double boiler , over a gentle heat , melt the chocolate and butter
16. Stir gently and remove from heat , add the vanilla / almond extract and the cream and stir gently until mixed
17. Pour the chocolate cream over the raspberries and nuts , work quickly as the chocolate will begin to set , smooth top with a spatula or spoon
18. Immediately sprinkle with remaining nuts
19. Refrigerate for 4-5 hours and remove from fridge 30 minutes before serving , dust with icing sugar
20. You must use fresh fruit , not frozen
21. Time does not include refrigeration time

title: the best cheese manicotti
steps:
1. Cook the manicotti shells according to the directions on the box
2. Drain in colander and set aside to dry
3. Mix all the ricotta , 2 cups mozzarella , and 1 / 4 cup parmesan in a bowl
4. Add an extra handful of mozzarella and a little more parmesan if you like it cheesier
5. I like a lot of flavor in my manicotti so i just keep adding the basil and italian seasoning until i think its enough
6. If you dont like a lot of seasoning , just put 1 tsp
7. Of each in
8. If not , just keep adding until it's seasoned to your taste
9. You can also add a dash of salt and pepper if you like or a little bit of garlic
10. Preheat oven to 350
11. Once the shells are drained and the cheese is mixed together , begin stuffing the shells
12. Be careful because they have a tendency to split
13. Pour about half of the marinara sauce in the bottom of the baking dish and spread evenly before you place the shells in the dish
14. Once all the shells arranged in the baking dish , pour the remainder of the marinara sauce on top
15. Then add any leftover cheese on top of the sauce
16. Sprinkle with basil and italian seasoning
17. Cover with aluminum foil
18. Bake for about 30 minutes

title: gyros burgers
steps:
1. Preheat an outdoor grill for medium-high heat and lightly oil grate
2. In large bowl , combine ground meat garlic and bread crumbs
3. Knead and add all of the seasonings
4. Knead until mixture is stiff and shape into 4 patties
5. Cook patties for 5-7 minutes on each side or until cook all the way through

title: apple stuffed pork loin with raspberry sauce
steps:
1. In large skillet , cook onion and celery in butter until tender
2. Add apples , allspice and cardamom
3. Cook , uncovered for 5 minutes , stirring occasionally
4. In large bowl , combine apple mixture with bread and raisins
5. Toss gently until bread is coated
6. Preheat oven to 325
7. Trim excess fat from meat and split lengthwise almost through
8. Spoon about half of the stuffing over the meat
9. Fold and tie with string to secure
10. Place remaining stuffing in 1-quart baking dish
11. Place meat on rack in a 17x12-inch roasting pan
12. Sprinkle with garlic powder , pepper and salt
13. Insert meat thermometer
14. Roast meat , uncovered , 60-70 minutes or until thermometer registers 160-170
15. Cover and heat remaining stuffing during the last 40 minutes of roasting
16. To serve , slice pork , serve with additional stuffing and raspberry sauce
17. To prepare raspberry sauce:
18. In medium saucepan , combine raspberries , nectar , jelly , brandy and honey
19. Over low heat , stirring frequently , cook until mixture boils
20. Strain to remove seeds
21. Return mixture to saucepan
22. In small bowl , combine cornstarch and water
23. Add to raspberry mixture
24. Makes about 1-3 / 4 cup sauce

title: steak and potato soup
steps:
1. Trim excess fat from beef
2. Cut beef into 1x1 / 4 inch pieces
3. Mix beef and remaining ingredients except water and flour in 5-quart crock pot slow cooker
4. Cover and cook on low heat setting for 8-9 hours or until beef and vegetables are tender
5. Mix water and flour
6. Gradually stir flour mixture into soup until blended
7. Cover and cook on high heat setting about 30 minutes or until slightly thickened

title: mediterranean pork and orzo
steps:
1. Rub pork with pepper
2. Cut into 1-inch cubes
3. In a large nonstick skillet , cook pork in oil over medium heat for 8-10 minutes or until no longer pink
4. Meanwhile , in a large saucepan , bring water to a boil
5. Stir in orzo and salt
6. Cook , uncovered , for 8 minutes
7. Stir in spinach
8. Cook 45-60 seconds longer or until orzo is tender and spinach is wilted
9. Add tomatoes to the pork
10. Cook and stir for 1 minute or until heated through
11. Drain orzo mixture
12. Toss with pork mixture and feta cheese

title: yummy cincinnati chili
steps:
1. Brown meat and onion together and drain off fat
2. Add tomato sauce , undrained beans , undrained tomatoes , chili powder and salt and pepper to taste
3. Simmer for 20 minutes
4. Serve over hot spaghetti
5. Sprinkle cheddar cheese and sour cream on top
6. Enjoy

title: crock pot ham   scalloped potatoes
steps:
1. Put half of ham , potatoes and onion in crock pot
2. Sprinkle with salt and pepper , then add grated cheese
3. Repeat with remaining half
4. Spoon undiluted soup over top
5. Sprinkle with paprika
6. Cover and cook on low for 8-10 hours or on high for 4-5 hours

title: beer battered onion rings
steps:
1. Combine the flour , baking powder , salt , black pepper , and red pepper in a bowl
2. Add the beer and vanilla and stir to make batter
3. Once mixed cover and let stand 30 to 50 minutes
4. Next separate the egg whites into a bowl
5. Using an electric mixer beat the egg whites until soft peaks form
6. Fold egg whites into the batter
7. Place the bread crumbs into a separate dish
8. Dip the onion slices in the batter , then dredge through the bread crumbs and place in a single layer , on wax paper lined cookie sheet
9. Use wax paper to separate the layers
10. As soon as possible put the cookie sheet in the freezer
11. Freeze rings for at least 1 hour
12. After 1 hour place rings in an air tight container for longer storage time
13. They can be frozen for up to 3 months
14. Remove rings and fry in 375 degree soy or peanut oil for appox
15. 2 minutes
16. For more even frying flip the rings
17. Fry in small batches , being careful not to crowd the pan
18. For a slightly spicy taste double the red pepper
19. For spicy taste that will stand up to the ranch or other dairy based dips , double the red pepper and add 1 / 8 cup sriracha sauce to the batter

title: cran rosemary grilled chicken thighs
steps:
1. Mix the drink with the rosemary in a large , plastic , zipper bag
2. When it stops fizzing add the chicken thighs
3. Marinate for at least 3 hours
4. Grill skin side up over very low heat for about 15 minutes
5. Turn over and continue grilling -- turning every 5 minutes -- for another 15-20 minutes , or until done
6. Keep heat low , do not close the lid , and avoid flare-ups as far as possible

title: sunshine curry chicken
steps:
1. Combine curry powder with 1 / 2 tsp
2. Of salt and pepper
3. Sprinkle / rub this mixture onto chicken
4. In skillet , combine juice , rice , water , sugar , mustard and rest of salt
5. Arrange chicken over this mixture
6. Bring to a boil
7. Cover and simmer for 20-30 minutes
8. Remove from heat and let stand 5 minutes
9. Adjust seasonings
10. You may add more curry for desired spice

title: dads cookies
steps:
1. Cream margarine and sugar , and add in egg and spices
2. Then add in molasses and vanilla
3. Add in dry ingredients and mix together
4. Stir in oats and coconut
5. Shape into balls and place on a greased cookie sheet about two inches apart
6. Bake @ 325 or 350 until brown
7. About 15 min or more
8. Enjoy

title: pickled kohlrabi
steps:
1. Combine kohlrabi and carrots and pack in a 1 quart glass jar along with garlic , bay leaf and fresh dill
2. In a saucepan combine pickling mixture ingredients and heat , stirring , until it boils and sugar is dissolved
3. Pour boiling mixture over kohlrabi and carrots , filling jar completely
4. Cover jar
5. When cool , refrigerate 3-4 days before using to let flavors blend

title: cow pound cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Grease and flour 9x5in loaf pan
3. In a small bowl , mix flour and baking powder
4. In a large bowl , beat butter and shortening
5. Beat in sugar , vanilla , lemon extract and lemon juice
6. Beat in eggs
7. Add flour mixture and milk
8. Place 1 / 3 batter in a small bowl
9. Whisk in cocoa powder
10. Pour 1 / 2 of vanilla batter into pan
11. Spoon 5 dollops of chocolate batter on top
12. Pour remaining vanilla batter on top
13. Spoon remaining chocolate batter on top
14. Using a butter knife , swirl batters to create a marbled effect
15. Bake for 1 hour or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
16. Cool completely , then frost

title: double down dark chocolate raspberry cookies
steps:
1. 1
2. Sift dry ingredients together and set aside
3. 2
4. Cream together butter , white sugar and brown sugar
5. 3
6. Add eggs , one at a time
7. 4
8. Add vanilla , then the pureed or mashed up raspberries
9. Jam can be substituted or 2 tsp can be added for a stronger flavour
10. That being said , i am 95% sure starbucks use to fold in jam after the chocolate chip stage to give it the raspberry ripple effect
11. 5
12. Slowly stir in 1 / 2 of dry mixture , mix well , then the remaining half
13. Do not overmix
14. 6
15. Fold in dark chocolate chips
16. Sometimes i use two bags if you want a strong dark chocolate flavour
17. 7
18. Drop in teaspoonfuls onto parchment paper and bake for 8-10 mins at 350f
19. 8
20. Finished batter can be frozen up to 4 weeks
21. Baked cookies can be stored in airtight containers for up to three days

title: chocolate strawberry banana smoothie
steps:
1. Blend in a blender
2. Enjoy !

title: small batch of chewy mini muffin cookies
steps:
1. Preheat your oven to 350f
2. Mix in a bowl butter , sugar , vanilla and water until blended
3. Stir in flour and salt until well blended
4. Stir in cinnamon , or any other flavorings , maybe some m&m's , chocolate chips , almond extract , nuts etc
5. Spray a mini muffin tin with butter flavored cooking spray , drop batter into molds
6. Bake in oven for 14 minutes , this is what i did and i got chewy centers
7. If you want harder , perhaps cook for an additional 3-5 minutes
8. Set on wire rack and carefully take mini muffins out using a butter knife and transfer to serving plate
9. This made 11 out of the 12 mini muffin molds for me !

title: butternut pear soup
steps:
1. Slice butternut into 4 and remove seeds and fiber
2. Place in a microwave oven and cook till tender for 10-15 minutes
3. Meanwhile saute onions in butter for 10 minutes till golden brown then add brown sugar and spices cook for 5 more minutes over low heat
4. Add broth to deglaze the pot !
5. Cube squash and if you have a good blender like a vita mix you don`t have to peel just put it in you blender along with all the ingredients and process till smooth
6. In a pot add all ingredients and simmer 10 minutes
7. Taste and season with salt and sherry if desired

title: oatmeal topped apple pie
steps:
1. Combine apples with sugar , flour and cinnamon
2. Spoon filling into pastry lined 9" pie plate
3. Combine rolled oats , flour , brown sugar , cinnamon
4. Cut in butter until it resembles coarse crumbs
5. Spoon topping over apple filling
6. Bake in a preheated 375 oven for 35 minutes

title: turkey fried rice
steps:
1. In a saucepan , bring broth to a boil
2. Stir in rice
3. Reduce heat
4. Cover and simmer for 45-50 minutes or until liquid is absorbed and rice is tender
5. Remove from the heat
6. Cool
7. Cover and refrigerate overnight
8. In a bowl , combine turkey and soy sauce
9. Cover and refrigerate
10. In a large nonstick skillet , cook and stir the egg over medium heat until completely set
11. Remove and set aside
12. In the same skillet , saute onion , green pepper and celery in oil until tender
13. Add rice and turkey
14. Cook and stir over medium heat for 6-8 minutes
15. Add lettuce and reserved egg
16. Cook and stir for 1-2 minutes
17. Serve immediately

title: soft pumpernickel bread  abm
steps:
1. Add ingredients to bread machine in order as per your manufacturer's directions
2. Select dough setting
3. Place in greased loaf pan , cover and let rise for 30 minutes
4. Bake at 375 for 25 to 30 minutes
5. Remove from pan and let cool on wire rack

title: baked falafel sandwich
steps:
1. Combine chickpeas , onion , parsley , garlic , cumin , coriander , salt and baking soda in a food processor or blender
2. Process until mixture is coarsely pureed and transfer to a large bowl
3. Stir in flour and shape mixture into 4 large patties and let stand for 15 minutes
4. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
5. Heat oil in a large ovenproof skillet over medium-high heat
6. Add patties and cook until golden brown , flipping once , about 2 minutes per side
7. Transfer skillet to oven and bake 10 minutes more
8. Meanwhile , whisk together tahini , water and lemon juice in a small bowl
9. To assemble sandwiches , place lettuce , tomatoes and cucumber in the pitas inside each pita with 1 falafel patty and drizzle with tahini dressing
10. Enjoy !

title: quick flatbread pizza
steps:
1. Place tortillas over parchment paper on a cookie sheet
2. Spread a teaspoon of olive olive oil over each tortilla
3. Spread 3 oz of tomato paste over each tortilla
4. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
5. Next place pepperoni over tomato paste
6. Slice and spread onions and mushrooms next
7. Add basil and oregano and drizzle remaining olive oil
8. Top with crumbled feta and pizza cheese
9. Bake for 12 minutes or until cheese is browned and crust looks crispy
10. Enjoy !

title: spicy mustard
steps:
1. Combine mustard , brown sugar , salt and turmeric in processor or blender and mix well
2. With machine running , add beer through feed tube in slow steady stream and blend until mixture is smooth and creamy , stopping frequently to scrape down sides of work bowl
3. Transfer to jar with tight-fitting lid
4. Store in cool , dark place

title: marinated tuna
steps:
1. Separate tuna into chunks
2. Combine remaining ingredients and pour on top
3. Chill

title: auntie goldie mae s shoe peg casserole
steps:
1. Preheat over to 350f
2. Spray 9x13-inch casserole dish
3. Layer corn and green beans in casserole dish , combine soup , sour cream , garlic , johnny's , grated cheese and pour over vegetables
4. Melt butter and combine with crackers
5. Spread dry mixture over top and bake for 30 minutes
6. Great add ins: cooked cubed chicken , cooked and crumbled bacon , turkey , or hamburger meat
7. I also like to add in sauted yellow onions
8. I prefer tony's seasoning salt over johnny's so i guess it's just a personal preference

title: lemon walnut scones
steps:
1. Sift together flour , brown sugar , baking powder , soda and salt
2. Blend in butter until mixture resembles coarse meal and stir in whole wheat flour , bran , walnuts and raisins
3. In a small bowl , whisk together lemon rind , egg and buttermilk
4. Add to flour mixture and stir with a fork until it just forms a sticky but manageable dough
5. Knead dough lightly on a floured surface for 30 seconds and pat gently into a inch thick round
6. Cut out rounds with a 2 2 inch cutter dipped in flour and arrange on a buttered baking sheet
7. Form scraps into a ball , reshape and cut more rounds
8. Brush tops with egg wash and bake in the middle of a preheated 390f oven for 15-17 minutes , or until golden
9. Serve warm

title: carrot raisin nut cookies
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees
2. Line baking sheet / s with parchment paper
3. In a bowl cream butter with brown sugar until fluffy
4. Add in egg and vanilla
5. Beat until well blended
6. Mix in carrots and coconut
7. In a small bowl mix the flour with salt , baking powder , nutmeg , cloves and cinnamon
8. Add to the creamed mixture and mix until combined
9. Mix in raisins and nuts
10. Drop large spoonfuls on prepared baking sheet / s
11. Bake for about 10-12 minutes or until browned

title: mrs  g s garlic cilantro pine nut hummus
steps:
1. On a cutting board mince and mash the garlic to a paste with the salt
2. In a food processor puree the chick-peas with the garlic paste , the tahini , the lemon juice , the oil and water , scraping down the sides , until the hummus is smooth
3. Add water / oil , if necessary , to thin the hummus to the desired consistency
4. Add salt to taste
5. Add cumin and blend , taste and adjust if necessary
6. Add cilantro and process until chopped into mixture
7. Add toasted pine nuts and process until blended -- or you can just add them on top , whole , as garnish
8. Transfer the hummus to a bowl and serve

title: frozen wine slushes   3 variations
steps:
1. These are all assembled the same way
2. Add fruit juice or fresh fruit , blend until smooth , and freeze
3. The alchohol will prevent the mixture from becoming solid ice
4. Serve in a margarita glass

title: adult orange dreamsicle
steps:
1. In blender , add orange juice , sherbet , non dairy creamer , ice cream , ice , vanilla extract , liqueur and blend on high until smooth
2. Serve immediately

title: the queen of hearts   valentine s jam tarts
steps:
1. Sieve the flour into a large mixing bowl , add the butter and rub it in using your finger
2. Use a knife to mix in the water , a little at a time stirring with the knife until the mixture comes together and you can form a ball with your hands
3. Wrap the pastry in a piece of clingfilm and put it in the fridge for 30 minutes this will make it easier to roll out
4. Turn the oven on to 200c / 400f / gas mark 6
5. Sprinkle the work surface and your rolling pin with a little flour and roll the pastry out to about cm thick
6. Dip the cutter in flour then cut out as many circles as you can you may need to gather the bits of pastry up and roll them out again to make 12 to 18 circles
7. Once you have the desired amount of pastry cases , roll out the pastry scraps and cut out the required amount of hearts , using a mini heart shaped biscuit / cookie cutter
8. Lay the rounds of pastry in the tart tin , which has been buttered or greased and press them gently into place
9. Prick the base of each tart once with a fork
10. Put the tart tray into the oven and bake for 6 minutes until the pastry is very pale golden
11. Using oven gloves take the tray out of the oven
12. Carefully put 1 heaped teaspoon of jam into each tart , and then top them off with a pastry heart
13. Using oven gloves put the tray back into the oven for 6 minutes
14. Using your oven gloves take the tray out of the oven
15. Leave them to cool for a few minutes then use a palette knife to gently lift the tarts out of the tin and leave to cool completely on a wire rack
16. Arrange them on an attractive serving plate and sprinkle with caster sugar

title: crazy oven fried fish filets  nutty that is
steps:
1. Combine peanuts and bread crumbs , salt& pepper
2. Mix oil with beaten eggs
3. Pat the fish filets dry
4. Dip filets in the eggs then the crumbs
5. Place on a greased baking sheet
6. Bake uncovered in 450f degrees oven for 6 minutes turn over and bake a further 1-3 minutes

title: crock pot garlic brown sugar chicken
steps:
1. Place chicken in crock pot
2. Mix all remaining ingredients and pour over chicken
3. Cook on low for 6-8 hours
4. Serve over rice or noodles
5. You can thicken the juices after cooking with a little cornstarch

title: shrimp con queso dip
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients except shrimp in top of large double boiler
2. Heat , stirring frequently , until cheese is melted and mixture is well blended
3. Add shrimp to cheese mixture
4. Pour into chafing dish
5. Serve with large corn chips
6. Makes approximately 11 cups
7. Dip may be frozen for up to 6 weeks

title: watercress soup with a kick
steps:
1. Place potatoes , watercress and shallots in broth and bring to a boil on medium high
2. Reduce heat and let simmer for approximately 20 minutes , or until potatoes are cooked
3. Place veg in blender with some broth and blend til smooth
4. Pour back into pot and add milk and white pepper , and heat through , season with salt if needed

title: cheesy bacon cheeseburger
steps:
1. In a non stick frying pan , fry sliced provolone cheese over medium high heat
2. You can add spices such as oregano , basil , chopped garlic
3. You can add grated parmesan or romano cheese to soak up some of the excess oil from the provolone
4. Watch carefully
5. When first side is golden brown , turn once and cook until it is a nice brown and crispy on both sides
6. Fry hamburger patty and bacon to taste
7. Serve on hamburger bun with lettuce and tomato

title: baby artichokes
steps:
1. Rinse artichokes under cold , running water
2. Combine the 2 quarts of water with the lemon juice
3. Use this water to drop the artichokes in as you trim them
4. Cut off stems and top 1 / 3 of artichoke petals
5. With your thumb , bend artichoke petals back , about 3 to 4 petals at a time , until they snap off
6. Make a quarter turn and continue to snap , working around until pale yellow leaves remain
7. Cut in quarters
8. Fill deep fryer to line with oil , or pour at least 3 inches of oil into deep 3-quart saucepan
9. Begin heating to 375 degrees
10. In medium bowl , beat eggs , garlic , cayenne and salt
11. Pour panko crumbs into pie plate or small shallow pan
12. Drain artichokes well , then dip each baby artichoke quarter in egg / garlic mixture , then roll in panko crumbs
13. When oil is hot , carefully drop coated baby artichoke quarters in , a few at a time , and fry until well-browned , about 2 minutes
14. Lift out and drain on paper towels
15. Serve hot

title: sugar free coconut cream pie  diabetic
steps:
1. Mix together stevia , cornstarch and salt in saucepan
2. Stir in milk gradually
3. Add coconut
4. Cook over medium heat , stirring constantly , until mixture boils
5. Boil 1 minute
6. Remove from heat
7. Blend in 1-1 / 2 teaspoons vanilla
8. Cool 10 minutes
9. Pour into pie shell
10. Refrigerate
11. When cool , top with whipped cream and toasted coconut

title: shrimp bisque    barefoot contessa   ina garten
steps:
1. Place the shrimp shells and seafood stock in a saucepan and simmer for 15 minutes
2. Strain and reserve the stock
3. Add enough water to make 3 3 / 4 cups
4. Meanwhile , heat the olive oil in a large pot or dutch oven
5. Add the leeks and cook them for 10 minutes over medium-low heat , or until the leeks are tender but not browned
6. Add the garlic and cook 1 more minute
7. Add the cayenne pepper and shrimp and cook over medium to low heat for 3 minutes , stirring occasionally
8. Add the cognac and cook for 1 minute , then the sherry and cook for 3 minutes longer
9. Transfer the shrimp and leeks to a food processor fitted with a steel blade and process until coarsely pureed
10. In the same pot , melt the butter
11. Add the flour and cook over medium-low heat for 1 minute , stirring with a wooden spoon
12. Add the half-and-half and cook , stirring with a whisk , until thickened , about 3 minutes
13. Stir in the pureed shrimp , the stock , tomato paste , salt , and pepper and heat gently until hot but not boiling
14. Season , to taste , and serve hot

title: campbell s orange dijon chicken
steps:
1. Cut a lengthwise pocket in each chicken breast and stuff in a slice of cheesese and a slice of prosciutto put oil in a skellet and brown the breasts on both sides
2. Add soup , orange juice , & sage , heat to a boil
3. Cover and cook for apprs 5 minutes or until the chicken is done add orange segments , heat through& serve

title: easy chicken pad thai  without tamarind
steps:
1. Place prepared chicken in a bowl and toss with 1
2. 5 tablespoons soy sauce
3. Set aside
4. Combine 'pad thai sauce' ingredients together in a cup , stirring well to dissolve sugar
5. Set aside
6. Bring a large pot of water to boil
7. Dunk in rice noodles and switch off heat
8. Allow noodles to soak approximately 6 minutes , or until soft enough to bend easily , but still firm and 'undercooked' by regular standards
9. Drain and rinse noodles briefly with cold water to keep from sticking
10. Set aside
11. Heat a wok or large frying pan over medium-high heat
12. Drizzle in the oil and swirl around , then add the garlic , chili , galangal / ginger , and half of green onion , reserving remaining for later
13. Stir-fry 1 minute to release the fragrance
14. Add chicken and stir-fry 3-4 minutes , or until cooked
15. If pan becomes dry , add 1-2 tablespoons of the pad thai sauce , just enough to keep ingredients frying nicely
16. Push ingredients aside and crack egg into center of pan
17. Stir quickly to scramble , then combine with other ingredients
18. Add prepared noodles plus 3-4 tablespoons of the pad thai sauce
19. Using two utensils , lift and turn noodles to stir-fry and combine with other ingredients
20. Continue frying in this way , adding more of the sauce every minute or two , until all sauce has been added and the noodles are chewy-delicious and a little bit sticky
21. When sauce has been absorbed and noodles are cooked , fold in the bean sprouts
22. Remove from heat and taste-test , adding more fish sauce until desired taste is achieved
23. Portion out onto individual plates and add a lime wedge on the side
24. Before eating , top with remaining green onion and squeeze over the lime wedge , then finish with a generous sprinkling of chopped / ground nuts
25. For those whole like it extra spicy , serve with thai chili sauce on the side , and enjoy !
26. Traditionally , pad thai was made in just this way - without tamarind - and versions of this original formula can still be found in various regions of thailand
27. This particular recipe was taught to me by a local thai chef in south-western phuket , thailand
28. Use wheat-free soy sauce for gluten-free diets

title: dulcet s chinese chicken salad
steps:
1. Shred the cabbage and carrots
2. Slice pepper , snap peas and celery diagonally
3. Cut lettuce so it looks like confetti
4. Toss all vegetables and lettuce with dulcet asian dressing
5. Top with chicken
6. Sprinkle wontons over top if using

title: chicken   spinach fettuccine bake
steps:
1. Cook pasta in a pan of boiling , salted water until al dente , and drain
2. Mix the mustards and cream in a small bowl until they are well-combined
3. Thaw and drain spinach , squeeze out moisture and chop coarsely
4. Saut the onion and garlic in butter over a medium heat until it has just softened but not browned
5. Add chicken
6. Cook , stirring occasionally for about 5 minutes or until it has changed colour and is clearly cooked through
7. Add the mustards and cream mixture and increase the heat so that the mixture just comes to the boil
8. Reduce the heat slightly and stir in the cheese and spinach , mixing until everything is well-combined
9. Season with salt and freshly ground black pepper , to taste
10. Stir in the pasta , and make sure that everything is well-combined
11. Spoon the mixture into a large ovenproof and if you are planning to freeze the dish also freezer-proof 10-cup capacity dish
12. Arrange garlic bread slices over the top and cook uncovered in a moderately hot oven for about 30 minutes , or until the bread is golden brown
13. Stand for 5 minutes and serve
14. To freeze: make the recipe to the end of step 8
15. Cool for 15 minutes
16. Cover tightly with plastic wrap
17. Label and date
18. Freeze for up to 2 months
19. To serve: thaw pasta in its dish in the refrigerator
20. Remove plastic wrap
21. Cover tightly with foil
22. Place on an oven tray
23. Cook in a hot oven for about 11 / 2 hours , or until hot
24. Remove foil
25. Arrange garlic bread slices over the top of the pasta and cook uncovered for a further 15 minutes or until the bread is golden brown
26. Stand for 5 minutes and serve

title: buca di beppo lentil soup
steps:
1. Bring the stock to a boil
2. Add lentils , carrot , onion , celery , sausage and sage
3. Turn heat down to med and cook for about 1 hour or until the soup thickens
4. Stir in tomatoes salt and pepper to taste
5. Serve soup in individual bowls with a little extra virgin olive oil

title: chili lime shrimp kabobs
steps:
1. In a large resealable plastic bag , combine the first seven ingredients
2. Add the shrimp
3. Seal bag and turn to coat
4. Refrigerate for 1 hour
5. Drain and discard marinade
6. On each of 12 metal or soaked wooden appetizer skewers , thread two shrimp and any veggies you want to add
7. Grill kabobs , covered , over medium heat or broil 4 inches from the heat for 5-8 minutes or until shrimp turn pink , turning once

title: no bake coconut cake
steps:
1. Crumble angle food cake in large dish
2. Mix instant pudding& milk according to the instructions on the package
3. Add coconut
4. Pour over cake and mix thoroughly
5. Top with cool whip , chill

title: summertime grilled onions
steps:
1. Slice the ends off the onion and peel the outer skin off
2. Place the onion on the aluminum foil
3. With a sharp paring knife , scoop out some of the onion in the center to make an indentation
4. Place the butter in the hollowed out area
5. Then place the bouillon cube in the butter
6. Wrap the onion up in the foil , sealing it tightly and place on a medium to low temperature grill and cook 30 to 40 minutes
7. The onion is done when it feels soft to the touch
8. Open the foil packet and put the onion in a shallow bowl or right on your plate
9. Be careful , it's juicy !
10. You can leave out the butter or use a beef bouillon cube if you want
11. If you find the bouillon flavor to be too strong , use half a cube per onion

title: irish style potato chive pancakes
steps:
1. Place potatoes in large saucepan
2. Cover with cold water
3. Bring to a boil over high heat
4. Reduce heat
5. Simmer uncovered until potatoes are tender , 15 to 20 minutes
6. Drain potatoes , then return to saucepan
7. Turn heat under saucepan to medium-low
8. Cook potatoes until dry , about 2 minutes , stirring occasionally
9. Add milk
10. Using a potato masher , mash potato mixture until fairly smooth
11. Remove from heat
12. Stir in chives , salt and pepper
13. Transfer to a medium bowl , cover and refrigerate until cold
14. Potatoes will thicken as they cool
15. Form potato mixture into 12 patties about 3 1 / 2 inches in diameter and 1 / 2 inch thick
16. Melt 1 teaspoon butter in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat until hot and sizzling
17. Add three or four patties to skillet
18. Cook until golden brown , about 2 minutes per side
19. Keep warm in a 200 degrees f oven while cooking remaining patties in remaining butter
20. Serve warm with sour cream

title: spaghetti with turkey meat sauce
steps:
1. Spray a large skillet with nonstick spray coating
2. Preheat over high heat
3. Add turkey
4. Cook , stirring occasionally , for 5 minutes
5. Drain fat and discard
6. Stir in tomatoes with their juice , green pepper , onion , garlic , oregano , and black pepper and bring to a boil
7. Reduce heat and simmer covered for 15 minutes , stirring occasionally
8. Remove cover
9. Simmer for 15 minutes more
10. Meanwhile , cook spaghetti in unsalted water
11. Drain well
12. Serve sauce over spaghetti

title: shrimp stuffed potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Begin by washing potatoes , drying them , and gently pricking them with a fork on the sides
3. Coat each potato with vegetable oil , place on foil covered pan , and bake for approximately 1 hour
4. Place the butter in a large bowl
5. Remove the potatoes from the oven and slice each potato in half
6. Gently scoop out the potato and place in the bowl
7. Using a mixer on high , mix the potatoes , butter , sour cream , salt , and pepper
8. Fold the shrimp and both cheeses into the mixture
9. Gently stuff the mixture back into the potato shells , making sure not to break them
10. Pile the mixture as high as you can on top of the potato shells
11. Sprinkle each potato with cheese and paprika for color
12. Bake in the oven for approximately 20 to 30 minutes until browned on top

title: green chili stuffing
steps:
1. In a large skilled , cook the onion and celery in 8 t butter over medium heat , stirring occasionally , until softened and light golden
2. Add the green chilies with the juice , the jalapenos , chili powder , thyme , oregano , cumin and salt and pepper to taste
3. Cook the mixture , stirring , for 3 minutes
4. Transfer the mixture to a large bowl , add the pecans , toasted bread cubes , and salt and pepper to taste
5. Combine the stuffing gently but thoroughly
6. Baking: preheat oven to 325f spoon the stuffing into a buttered 3- to 4- quart casserole , drizzle it with the broth and dot the top with the additional 2 t butter
7. Bake the stuffing , covered , in the middle of the oven for 30 minutes
8. Uncover and bake 30 minutes more

title: garlic prawns in the microwave
steps:
1. Peel and devein prawns , leaving tails intact
2. Put prawns into a microwave proof dish or divide prawns into 4 microproof ramekins
3. Combine all other ingredients and pour over prawns or divide between the 4 ramekins
4. Microwave on high for 5 minutes , stirring occasionally
5. Serve with crusty bread

title: mexican dish
steps:
1. Brown and drain ground beef
2. Add garlic salt and onion and cook until tender
3. Add remaining ingredients and simmer on low heat for about 15 minutes
4. Fry tortillas in oil for about 10 seconds each and drain on paper towel
5. Layer casserole dish with tortillas
6. Follow with a layer of meat mixture
7. Repeat until dish is full
8. Finish with layer of meat mixture
9. Add shredded cheese on top
10. Bake at 360 degrees for about 15 minutes or until cheese is ooey and gooey ooooooh comfort food
11. Enjoy !

title: alfredo potatoes
steps:
1. Grease a 13" x 9" baking dish
2. In a small saucepan , combine cream , milk , garlic , salt and pepper
3. Bring just to a simmer over medium heat
4. Remove from heat
5. Let stand while preparing potatoes
6. Peel and thinly slice potatoes
7. Layer half of the potatoes in prepared baking dish
8. Top with half of the cream mixture and half of the cheeses
9. Repeat layering once with remaining potatoes , cream mixture and cheeses
10. Drizzle the melted butter and sprinkle paprika evenly over top
11. Bake in a preheated 350 degree oven for 55 to 60 minutes or until potatoes are tender
12. Let stand 5 to 10 minutes before serving

title: hot beefy dip
steps:
1. In a large skillet , cook beef , onion , green pepper , and garlic until meat is browned
2. Add the tomato sauce , ketchup , sugar , oregano , salt , and pepper
3. Simmer for 10 mintutes
4. Remove from heat and stir in cheeses until melted
5. Serve warm with tortilla chips

title: chicken in wine sauce el salvador
steps:
1. Rinse the chicken pieces
2. Pat dry with paper toweling
3. In a large skillet over medium heat , brown the chicken pieces in hot oil on all sides for 15 minutes
4. Remove the chicken from the skillet
5. Add the onion to the drippings in the skillet
6. Cook until tender but not brown
7. Drain off the fat
8. Return the chicken to the skillet
9. Combine wine , vinegar , worcestershire sauce , salt , garlic powder , coriander , and red pepper
10. Pour over the chicken in the skillet
11. Bring to a boil
12. Reduce heat
13. Cover and simmer for 25 minutes
14. After 25 minutes , stir in green pepper , prunes , olives , tomato paste , and capers
15. Cover and simmer about 20 minutes more or till the chicken is tender
16. Skim off the fat
17. Transfer chicken and sauce to a heated serving platter and enjoy !

title: risi e bisi with ham and parmesan
steps:
1. In a large pot , melt the butter over moderately low heat
2. Add the onion , celery and garlic and cook , stirring occasionally , until the vegetables start to soften , about 5 minutes
3. Add the wine and boil until it almost evaporates , about 5 minutes
4. Add the broth and bring to a boil
5. Boil until the liquid is reduce to approximately 7 cups , about 20 minutes
6. Add the rice , parsley and salt and cook at a low boil , stirring occasionally , until the rice is just tender , 10-15 minutes
7. Stir in the peas , ham , parmesan and pepper

title: quick chili con carne
steps:
1. Saut ground beef , onion , green pepper and garlic cloves in dutch oven
2. Add rest of ingredients , with the exception of the beans
3. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes , stirring occasionally
4. Add small amount of water if mixture becomes too thick
5. Start with less than 1 / 4 c of sugar and add to sweetness preference
6. Stir in beans ,
7. If making ahead , transfer to crockpot and place on lowest setting to keep warm
8. You may also let cool and warm for next day
9. Optional: top with shredded cheese , sour cream and corn chips !

title: dried fruit and coconut macaroons
steps:
1. Preheat over to 325 , lightly grease cookie sheet
2. Coarsley chop the dried fruit
3. Combine coconut , sugar , flour and salt
4. Stir in egg whites and vanilla
5. Fold in fruit and nuts
6. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls onto prepared cookie sheet
7. Bake 15 minutes
8. Immediately remove the macaroons to a rack to cool
9. Repeat with remaining dough

title: beef szechuan
steps:
1. Cut steak into bite-sized strips
2. Steam carrots until tender
3. Mix sherry , soy sauce , hot bean sauce and spices for sauce , set aside
4. Preheat wok over high heat
5. Heat cooking oil , then add chili oil
6. Stir-fry carrots , pea pods and mushrooms until crisp-tender
7. Remove from wok
8. Stir-fry beef , push to side
9. Warm sauce in center of wok
10. Stir in vegetables and beef , add peanuts

title: coconut bun bread
steps:
1. Mix yeast with the 1 / 4 cup warm water with 1 tsp sugar let stand for 5 minutes till foamy
2. In another bowl mix milk and and melted butter
3. Slowly pour half of the milk / butter mixture to the yeast mixture continue beating
4. Add the flour , alternate with milk / butter mixture
5. Set aside
6. Then add 4 tbs sugar beat for 1 minute then last the salt
7. Beat till smooth 2 to 3 minutes
8. Put on oil bowl and cover with cloth
9. Let rise for 1 hour till double bulk
10. After 1 hour punch down the dough shape into balls and filled with coconut filling
11. I use 2 tbs spoon
12. Let rise for another 30 minutes to 40 minutes till double bulk
13. Bake for f350 for 30 minutes before baking brush with egg wash
14. Coconut filling
15. Boil water and sugar in a saucepan
16. Add the flour until dissolve
17. Add the coconut flakes cook until little dry
18. Then add margarine or butter

title: raw aam ka guramma
steps:
1. Heat oil in karaahi , add methi , dried red chilly , tejpatta , saunf and mango slices
2. Saute for 2 minutes
3. Add jaggery and let the ripe mango cook with it on slow flame for 20- 25 minutes
4. Leave a little jaggery syrup remaining with the cooked mango
5. Serve as an accompaniment to snacks or rice- daal

title: fresh bbq corn with honey butter
steps:
1. Mix salt , pepper , and garlic powder together
2. Let stand for one hour before use
3. This may be stored in a plastic container for future use
4. Whip all but 2 tablespoons butter with honey
5. Using wax paper , roll honey butter into shape of sausage and refrigerate overnight
6. Brush frozen corn with 2 tablespoons room-temperature butter
7. Sprinkle with a dash of the seasoning mix
8. Place corn on the grill
9. Turn often until brown on every side
10. Cut corn from cobs
11. Place in a bowl and cover until ready to serve
12. Cut refrigerated honey butter into 1 / 2" thickness slices and serve over hot corn kernels

title: game day beef stew
steps:
1. Combine 2 tbsp flour , sugar , salt and pepper in a large bowl and whisk the tomato juice until smooth
2. Set aside
3. Combine beef and next 5 ingredients in a crockpot and add tomato juice mixture over top
4. Cover and cook on high for 5 1 / 2 hours or until beef is tender
5. Whisk together 2 tablespoons hot water and remaining 2 tablespoons flour until smooth
6. Add to crockpot and stir until blended
7. Cover and cook 30 more minutes

title: sweet salad dressing
steps:
1. Mix ingredients until sugar dissolves completely
2. Serve on salad fixings of your choice !

title: spinach salad with warm bacon dressing
steps:
1. Place enough water in a small saucepan to cover three eggs and bring to a boil
2. Add the eggs when water is boiling and allow to boil for 7-minutes
3. Remove sauce pan from heat and add cold water from the tap until there is no more hot water - and let sit
4. Meanwhile - fry bacon over medium low heat until cooked and the fat is rendered
5. Remove bacon to plate with paper towels to drain
6. Chop / crumble when cool
7. Peel cooled eggs and slice , cube or cut in wedges as preferred
8. Combine reserve bacon drippings with a wire whip , along with the mustard , vinegar and honey
9. Blend until smooth
10. Season to taste with salt and pepper
11. Toss spinach with warm dressing , garnish with eggs & remaining ingredients & serve immediately

title: sauteed fresh spinach
steps:
1. Melt butter in a large saut pan
2. Add spinach , salt and pepper
3. Cook over high heat , turning spinach with tongs , for about 2 to 3 minutes
4. Serve immediately

title: mom s chicken enchiladas
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Saute' celery and mushrooms in small amount of oil and drain
3. Set aside
4. Skin chicken and cook
5. Let cool and then chop into bite size pieces
6. Place chicken in large mixing bowl
7. To chicken , add the onions , celery , mushrooms and diced green chilies
8. Add a little less than 1 / 2 the cheese to the chicken mixture
9. Mix the soup with the container of sour cream plus 1 c milk to thin it
10. Add 3 / 4 c of the soup mixture to the chicken mixture and mix well
11. Set aside while you get the tortillas ready
12. Heat a skillet on low heat
13. Place two or three tortillas in the skillet and warm on both sides
14. Remove from skillet as they soften up and place them on a plate covered with a kitchen towel
15. When they are all ready you can begin to fill them
16. Use a 9x13 casserole
17. Place a large serving spoon of the soup mixture on the bottom of the casserole and spread out evenly
18. In the center of each tortilla place a spoon full of filling
19. Fold over to middle as you roll to a tight tortilla
20. Place seam side down in casserole and continue to fill each tortilla
21. When they are all filled and in casserole , cover with the the remaining sauce and cheese
22. Bake 30-35 minutes until cheese is melted and they are bubbly hot
23. Let stand a few minutes after they come out of the oven

title: aunt clara s rice balls
steps:
1. Mix cold sticky rice with 1 egg beaten , parsley , parmesan , mozzarella , salt and pepper
2. Use ice cream scoop to scoop up a rice ball
3. Hand roll ball
4. Roll in flour
5. Dip in beaten egg and roll in bread crumbs
6. Heat 1" cooking oil in pan on stovetop over medium-high heat and brown until golden
7. Drain on paper towels and serve warm
8. Leftovers do well in microwave

title: brownie candy cups
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 f
2. Place paper baking cups in muffin pans
3. Combine brownie mix , fudge packet from mix , eggs , water and oil in a large bowl , stir with spoon until well blended , about 50 strokes
4. Place 2 level measuring tablespoons batter in each paper liner
5. Bake at 350 f for 10 minutes
6. Remove from oven
7. Push 1 peanut butter cup candy into center of each cupcake until even with surface of brownie
8. Bake 5 to 7 minutes
9. Remove to cooling racks
10. Cool completely

title: spicy steak casserole
steps:
1. Place cut up steak into a casserole dish
2. Blend the following ingredients in a bowl or jug and pour sauce over meat
3. Marinate for at least 2 hours
4. This step is unnecessary if using the crockpot
5. Bake at 160 c for 1 1 / 2 - 2 hours
6. Thicken with cornflour and water if necessary and put back in oven for 10-15 minutes

title: potatoes divine
steps:
1. Cooking day instructions:
2. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
3. Grease 13x9x2 casserole dish
4. Put potatoes directly on oven rack and bake for 45-60 minutes or till done
5. I put the potatoes in the microwave till done and use a small cookie scoop to remove potato pulp
6. Mash potatoes with mixer or by hand until smooth
7. Add butter / margarine and milk and mix
8. Spread in a prepared pan
9. Freeze using foil & plastic wrap method
10. Serving day instructions:
11. When casserole is thawed , preheat oven to 500 degrees
12. With electric mixer , whip cream to soft peaks , then fold in gruyere by hand
13. Spread evenly over potatoes and sprinkle with parmesan
14. Bake until heated through and topping is golden brown
15. Garnish with parsley and serve

title: menemen
steps:
1. Wash potatoes thoroughly , dry , peel and dice small
2. Dice onion and peppers into very small pieces
3. Beat eggs slightly in a pan and set aside
4. Skin tomatoes and cut into very small pieces
5. Heat oil in deep frying pan
6. Add onion and peppers , and saute until soft
7. Add potatoes and cook until crisp
8. Add tomatoes and let cook for 5 minutes , stirring occasionally
9. Stir salt into frying mixture and mix well
10. Add beaten eggs quickly into frying pan , stir briskly and cook until hardened uniformly
11. Place over toasted bread slices immediately
12. Grate a few shavings of nutmeg

title: white house chicken  oregano chicken
steps:
1. Combine butter , lemon juice and seasonings
2. Marinate chickens for 3-4 hours in this butter sauce
3. Grill , basting often with remainder of the sauce or you can bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour or until chicken is cooked , basting often

title: chicken fried steak with mushroom gravy
steps:
1. Mix flour , breadcrumbs , parmesean cheese , and seasonings in a bowl
2. Dip steaks into a small amount of milk and then dredge in the flour mixture
3. Place 3-4 tablespoons of olive oil in frying pan over medium-high heat
4. Cook steaks for 5 minutes on one side
5. The juices from the steak might soak up the flour , so before you flip the steaks add some more of the flour mixture , patting it down with a spatula
6. When brown , flip over and continue to cook for another 3 mintues
7. When finished cooking , remove steaks and keep warm
8. For gravy:
9. Once steaks are finished cooking add a small amount of oil and cook the mushrooms
10. Add 1 / 4 water , salt&pepper , and continue cooking
11. Make sure to get all of the scraps from the sides of the pan that the steaks left into the liquid you are cooking the mushrooms in
12. When most of liquid is cooked off , sprinkle remaining flour over mushrooms and cook for 1 minute
13. Add milk and cook until thickened to your liking
14. Serve with mashed potatoes and enjoy !

title: steak tip marinade
steps:
1. Place steak
2. Pour remaining ingredients over them
3. Seal bag and toss to coat
4. Place bag in fridge for 3-4 hrs
5. , tossing occasionally
6. Grill or broil as you normally would

title: magic bread box  yeast bread all week with barely any work
steps:
1. Start by putting 700g water in a 6qt container with a lid
2. Just make sure it's not a screw-top container , because you want it to be able to pop off if the dough really expands or gases build up inside
3. But you don't want the dough to dry out during the long rise time , so you want something with a decent seal to keep in the moisture
4. Sprinkle a tablespoon of salt and 4-8 g of yeast on top
5. The warmer it is inside where you are going to set the dough to rise , the less yeast you need
6. In the summer i use 4g , and the winter 8g
7. Great for stretching that pricey jar of yeast as far as it will go !
8. Dump 1000g of unbleached all-purpose flour on top of that and mix it up with a big spoon just until all the flour is damp
9. Don't knead ! it's very sticky at this point , but still , more of a lump than a batter
10. Cover and let it sit out on the counter all day or all night , until you can see big bubbles in the dough through the clear sides of the container and the container is almost full
11. For me this usually takes 6-12 hours
12. Recently i've found i can let it sit out just a short amount of time and then just chuck it in the fridge overnight with the same results
13. Technically it's ready to bake at that point , but i find it's very difficult to handle until it sits in the fridge for a good chunk of time first
14. The coolness makes it a little stiffer
15. So once it's risen , chuck it in the fridge for another half a day
16. When you're ready , sprinkle the top of the dough with a few tablespoons of flour , just to make the part where you're going to stick your fingers less sticky , but don't work it in at all
17. Grab the dough by the floury part , lift it partially out and cut off a piece with a bread knife
18. Tuck the edges underneath to form a ball and put it on a pan sprayed with oil and dusted with cornmeal
19. You want to use a pan deeper than the bread is tall
20. A dutch oven is ideal , but i use a large loaf pan
21. I make about 1 / 5 of the dough at a time , which is about the size of an orange , but you can use less or more if you adjust baking times
22. Put the remaining dough back in the fridge , and use it all up in a 10-14 days
23. When you make the next batch , you can even skip cleaning the container out if you want
24. The little smudges of leftover flour and dough should incorporate into the new batch with no ill effects
25. Recently i've discovered that if you take an extra minute to shape the remaining dough into a ball before putting it back in the fridge , it pays huge dividends
26. Just pick up the whole thing and spend a minute tucking the edges under , going around and around , and then plop it back in the container
27. Next time you go to cut a hunk of dough off , you'll find the dough is extra bubbly , and it bakes up extra fluffy with nice big air-pocket holes in it
28. Let the newly shaped loaf sit for 30-60 minutes , then cover tightly to keep in the moisture as the bread bakes
29. This eliminates the need for a pan of water in the bottom of the oven
30. I used to preheat , but recently i've been putting it in a cold oven with good results
31. The large toaster oven i use heats up pretty fast , so that may be why it works so well for me
32. At any rate , you want to bake at 450 for a good long time , then take the lid / foil off to brown for a little more
33. In my oven , for the size i make that takes about 30-35 minutes , plus 5-10 for the browning
34. You will have to experiment with your own equipment
35. Let it sit until it cools , then slice and enjoy ! once it's cut , it goes stale pretty quickly , so don't resist that good bread smell too long --
36. Whole wheat , rye , oatmeal , flax , wheat bran , cinnamon , etc
37. If you don't want to improvise , just find another recipe you like and use that with this method
38. See the book "artisan bread in 5 minutes a day" for other variations and options like pizza , bagels , pretzles , etc
39. Mix the dough , refrigerate for half a day , take the dough and spend a minute shaping into a ball , then put it back in the fridge for another half a day before taking it out and putting it in its final shape

title: all american beef burgers
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients in a large bowl
2. Form into 4 patties , brush with oil and grill

title: the best chocolate cake
steps:
1. Preheat ovento 350f prepare 2 round 9 inch cake pans by spraying with pam , then sprinkle with flour and tap out the extra
2. In a large bowl sift all dry ingredients together
3. In a smaller bowl combine eggs , milk , vanilla , water and oil
4. Mix with an electric hand mixer until combined
5. Add wet ingredients to the flour mixture and stir until well combined
6. Pour batter into pans and bake for 30-35 minutes

title: christmas casserole
steps:
1. Cut crusts off loaf of bread
2. Cut bread into half inch cubes
3. Melt butter in a bowl and toss bread cubes to coat
4. Grease a 9" x 13" glass casserole dish
5. Layer bread cubes , grated cheese , mushrooms , ham , etc
6. In dish
7. Combine the eggs , milk salt and pepper and beat
8. Pour over casserole
9. Cover with foil and let set overnight in the refrigerator so bread absorbs some of the egg mixture
10. To bake , place casserole in larger pan with 1 inch hot water
11. Bake , at 375 degrees for 1 1 / 2 hours or until silver knife inserted in center comes out clean
12. I start the baking with the foil on , then uncover for the last half hour
13. Casserole can be cooked without the water bath , but the sides will be a little crustier
14. It also bakes faster this way

title: stove top spinach balls
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Mix stuffing mix , hot water and butter in large bowl until well blended
3. Add remaining ingredients
4. Mix lightly
5. Shape into 60 balls , each about 1-inch in diameter
6. Place in single layer in 15x10x1-inch baking pan sprayed with cooking spray
7. Bake 15 to 20 minutes or until lightly browned

title: nectarine juice   smoothie
steps:
1. Pit peaches or nectarines
2. Put all ingredients in a blender and blend to consistency of a smoothie
3. You may need to adjust liquid amounts depending on the size of your peaches or nectarines

title: rick s cajun jambalaya
steps:
1. Saute sausage , onions , bell pepper and garlic until sausage is browned
2. Add the chicken , water , salt , cayenne , bay leaf and tomato paste
3. Bring to a boil with the lid on
4. When water boils add the shrimp and the rice
5. Stir and lower fire
6. Let rice simmer , stirring every five minutes until rice is cooked
7. About 30 minutes

title: mom s best ever pineapple  pork chops
steps:
1. Heat frying pan and greese lightly
2. Add chops and brown , drain off all fat
3. Sprinkle meat with soup mix and gradually blend in 1 3 / 4 cup water
4. Add green pepper , pineapple , ketchup , vinegar , brownsugar , soya sauceand mustard
5. Mix well cover simmer stiring occasionally until pork is real tender appox 1 hour -2 hours longer it sits the more tender it is
6. Blend cornstarch with remaining 1 / 4 cup water , add to thicken cooking 10 minutes longer
7. Serve over hot rice or potatoes
8. Yummmmmmmy

title: zesty tomato salad
steps: 1. Toss all ingredients together in a big bowl , and allow to sit for at least 20 minutes

title: oatmeal fruit cookies  low fat
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300 degrees
2. Prepare cooking sheet with a light coat of cooking spray or parchment paper
3. Using a mixer , blend together the margarine / butter , sugar , extract and egg white in a medium sized bowl
4. Combine oatmeal , flour , baking soda , cinnamon , and ginger
5. Mix into the wet ingredients
6. Stir in by hand the cranberries , raisins and nuts
7. Drop mounded tablespoons of dough onto the prepared cookie sheets
8. Bake for 16-18 minutes
9. Lightly flaten the dough with the back of a spoon
10. Remove from the oven and allow the cookies to rest for 2 minutes
11. Cookies should be lightly browned on the edges
12. Transfer to wire racks and allow the cookies to cool
13. Serve or store in an air tight container

title: almond chicken
steps:
1. In large bowl , combine tamari sauce , ginger and garlic powder
2. Cut chicken into bite size chunks and marinate in tamari mixture while preparing other ingredients
3. In another bowl , combine flour , almonds , salt and pepper and mix well
4. Heat oil in large skillet or wok on high heat
5. When oil is hot , coat the chicken pieces with the flour mixture and add to pan / wok
6. Reduce heat to medium
7. Cover and cook until chicken is done , stirring often
8. Serve over brown rice

title: easy coconut lime sorbet
steps:
1. In a bowl , whisk together all ingredients
2. Chill mixture several hours or overnight
3. Before adding to the ice cream maker , shake mixture well
4. Freeze mixture in an ice-cream maker
5. Transfer sorbet to an airtight container and put in freezer to harden

title: country pork chops dinner
steps:
1. Brown chops in oil with onion till browned
2. Drain and return to pan
3. Top with vegetables
4. Mix soup with water , salt and thyme
5. Pour over vegetables
6. Bring to a boil and reduce heat to medium low
7. Simmer for 25 to 30 minutes or till vegetables are tender

title: three bean award winning chili
steps:
1. Add salt , black pepper , garlic powder to ground beef and cook with onions and red / green peppers in dutch oven
2. Drain excess grease
3. Add balance of ingredients
4. Cover and simmer for 90 minutes or more
5. Serve with toppings

title: gluten free flour tortillas
steps:
1. Combine all of the dry ingredients , then cut in or work in the shortening using a pastry blender or two knives or your hand
2. Add the warm water , starting with 3 / 4 cup and mix well
3. Continue to add water until a soft , cohesive dough is formed
4. Heat a comal , tapa or griddle to medium heat
5. Then , form a ball of dough into a flattened disk , cupping the outside edges a bit to form a round
6. Dust a work surface with corn starch and , esing a bollilo or rolling pin , roll into a round disk about 1 / 8 inch thick and about 8 inches in diameter or to your preference
7. Bake one at a time on a hot griddle until the surface bubbles
8. Turn only once , the first side should have brown flecks
9. Bake until the second side has slightly browned - should brown in a very short time
10. Keep warm in a tortilla keeper or wrapped in a cloth until served

title: pomodoro  al fornos tomato sauce
steps:
1. Heat the olive oil , garlic , and salt in a saucepan over medium heat , stirring often
2. Keep a close watch here and adjust the heat as necessary because you want the garlic to slowly turn from opaque white to slightly translucent golden without a hint of browning
3. As soon as the garlic is golden , immediately add the wine and stockbe careful not to burn yourself as the oil has a tendency to splatter
4. Bring to a boil , decrease heat , and simmer until the garlic is soft and has taken on a nutty color , and the liquid has reduced to about 1 cup
5. Add the tomatoes , bring to a boil , decrease the heat and simmer for 5 minutes

title: skillet squash au gratin
steps:
1. Melt butter in skillet
2. Add squash , onion , salt , pepper and tomatoes
3. Cook , covered 12-15 minutes or until tender
4. Sprinkle with soy sauce to taste , if desired
5. Transfer to a serving bowl and sprinkle with cheese
6. You can use canned italian- or mexican-flavored tomatoes for a different flavor

title: yummy ginger biscuits
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 160c , and line a tray with baking paper
2. Sift the flour and ground ginger into a large bowl
3. Add the crystallised ginger
4. Melt the butter , sugar and golden / maple syrup in a saucepan on medium heat , or in the microwave in 30 second bursts , mixing in between
5. Allow the mixture to come to the boil
6. Add melted butter , sugar and syrup to the dry ingredients and mix well
7. Roll 1 tbs of the mixture at a time into balls , then flatten slightly and place on the tray
8. Brush each biscuit with a small amount of water on a pastry brush , and sprinkle with brown sugar
9. Place tray in the preheated oven and bake for 15 minutes
10. Cool on a wire rack , though i think these taste best when still warm !

title: crock pot lamb chops dinner
steps:
1. Spray crock pot with non-stick spray
2. Brown lamb chops on both sides if desired
3. Place in bottom of crock pot
4. In fry pan used to brown lamb chops , cook onions and garlic , with curry powder , just until beginning to turn transparent
5. Transfer onions and garlic to crock pot , spreading evenly over lamb chops
6. Lay bay leaves on top
7. Arrange potato quarters evenly on top of previously arranged ingredients being sure they do not touch the sides of the crock pot
8. Arrange carrots over top
9. Try to avoid leaving any potatoes exposed as they will tend to turn dark
10. Salt and pepper to taste
11. Cover
12. Cook on high for at least 3 hours , or cook on low for at least 6 hours , or cook on high , then reduce to low allowing 2 hours on low for each hour on high
13. When there is only an hour left of cooking time , place asparagus spears on top of all and sprinkle a little more curry powder on top
14. If you wish , you can add a tablespoon of butter on top of the asparagus

title: chewy gluten free chocolate chip cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 f degrees
2. Blend butter , sugars , egg and vanilla with a wooden spoon until creamy
3. In a separate bowl , blend flours , baking soda , almond meal and salt
4. Fold dry ingredients into wet ingredients and mix well
5. Grease a baking sheet
6. Drop a tablespoon of the batter at a time onto the cookie sheet , leaving ample room between cookies
7. Bake for 10 minutes
8. Remove from oven and allow to sit for 5 minutes before transferring carefully to cooling rack

title: bruschetta grilled
steps:
1. In a bowl mix together the chopped tomatoes , garlic and olive oil until combined
2. Season with salt and black pepper to taste
3. Cover and chill
4. Brush olive oil over one side of the bread slices then place on the grill to toast
5. Place a spoonful of the prepared tomato mixture onto the toasted bread then sprinkle with parmesan cheese
6. Delicious !

title: red cooked lamb with sweet potatoes
steps:
1. Heat a large heavy pot or dutch oven over high heat
2. Add oil and heat until hot
3. Add scallions , garlic , ginger , cinnamon sticks , chile paste and aniseed
4. Stir-fry until fragrant , about 15 seconds
5. Add soy sauce rice wine and sugar
6. Pour in 5 cups of water and bring to a boil
7. Add lamb and return to a boil
8. Reduce the heat to low , partially cover , and simmer until the lamb is just tender , about 1 hour
9. Add sweet potatoes and continue to cook , partially cover , until they are tender , about 20 minutes
10. Discard the ginger and cinnamon sticks
11. Lightly mix in spinach
12. Cover and cooked until spinach has wilted , about 1 1 / 2 minutes
13. Ladle into soup plates and serve

title: tuna tuesday
steps:
1. Boil kd until noodles are done
2. Strain , rinse with hot water
3. Transfer noodles back into pot on low heat
4. Add 2 tbsp margarine , stir to melt
5. Add 1 / 2 cup milk
6. Slowly add powdered cheese mixture while stirring and add remaining milk as needed
7. Mixture should be creamy with no clumps and you should have a somewhat loose sauce in the pot to make sure to cover other ingredients
8. Stir in parsley and garlic
9. Break up tuna chunks while adding to mixture and fold together
10. Ready to serve

title: quick and yummy butterfinger bars
steps:
1. Heat sugar and corn syrup together in heavy pan until boiling
2. Add peanut butter
3. Mix until well blended
4. Pour over corn flake cereal , coating the cereal well
5. Press into a 9 x 13 inch pan
6. Melt chocolate chips in a small pan
7. Spread over batter
8. Chill for 20-25 minutes
9. Cut into bars

title: canning sweet pickles
steps:
1. Slice cucumbers in chips
2. Fill your jar with vinegar , salt , sugar , and pickling spice
3. Close up jar and stor for 8 weeks or longer
4. Open jar after 8 weeks and enjoy !

title: crock pot turkey tater tot casserole
steps:
1. Lightly spray your crock with a non stick spray
2. Brown the turkey
3. Empty the whole bag of tater tots on bottom of crock- pot
4. Mix all other ingredients together and then poor those over top of taters
5. Cook on low for 4 1 / 2 to 5 hours
6. If adding cheese sprinkle it on in the last 10 or so minutes

title: broccoli   tortellini
steps:
1. Cook tortellini in a large pot of boiling water until tender but firm
2. Add broccoli and cook until tender
3. Drain
4. In a large saucepan or dutch oven , combine tomatoes , garlic , oregano , salt and pepper
5. Bring to a boil , reduce heat and simmer , stirring occasionally , until sauce has thickened slightly
6. Add green onions and cook 2 more minutes
7. Add sauce to pasta / broccoli mixture and toss together
8. Sprinkle with parmesan and serve

title: apple butter cake
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350
2. Grease 13x9x2 inch baking pan , dust with flour
3. Beat all ingredients except raisins and frosting , in large bowl
4. Stir in raisins and nuts
5. Pour into prepared pan
6. Bake aprox 30 min or until cake test done
7. Cool and frost with the coconut-pecan frosting

title: old fashioned boston baked beans
steps:
1. Rinse beans
2. Discard any discoloured ones
3. In large saucepan , soak beans overnight
4. Drain
5. Add water to cover by at least 2 inches
6. Bring to boil and simmer for 30 minutes
7. Drain
8. In bean pot or 8 cup casserole , spread onion slices
9. Add drained beans
10. Combine molasses , tomato paste , sugar , vinegar , salt , mustard , pepper and hot water
11. Pour over beans and top with chopped bacon
12. Cover and bake in 250 degree oven for 6 hours
13. Uncover and add about 1 / 2 cup ketchup -- and stir
14. Add more water if you need to
15. Bake uncovered for another hour

title: t g i  friday nutty accountant
steps:
1. Add ingredients into blender and blend until smooth
2. Garnish and enjoy !

title: gooey coconut pineapple butter cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Lightly grease a 13 by 9 by 2-inch baking pan
3. For the cake: in the bowl of an electric mixer , combine cake mix , egg , and butter and mix well
4. Pat into bottom of prepared pan and set aside
5. For filling: still using an electric mixer , beat the cream cheese until smooth
6. Beat in the eggs and vanilla
7. Dump in confectioners' sugar and beat well
8. Reduce the speed and slowly pour in butter
9. Mix well
10. Fold in coconut and pineapple
11. Pour filling onto cake mixture and spread evenly
12. Bake for 40 to 50 minutes
13. Don't be afraid to make a judgement call on the cooking time , because oven temperatures can vary
14. You want the center to be a little gooey , so don't bake it past that point
15. Remove from oven and allow to cool completely
16. Cut into squares

title: porcupine meatballs
steps:
1. Combine first 5 ingredients together in mixing bowl , mix well
2. Form meat mixture into walnut size balls
3. Place meatballs in greased 9 x 13 pan
4. Cut up celery and onion over the top of the meatballs
5. Combine soup and water and pour over all
6. Bake at 350 for 1 hour

title: apple syrup
steps:
1. Put prepared apples , cinnamon , nutmeg , mace , lemon juice and butter into a deep pot
2. Cover and cook apples on medium heat until softened
3. Puree the softened apples
4. Place the pureed apples back into the pot
5. Add the remaining ingredients , except for the cornstarch and 1 / 4 cup of water
6. Stir until the sugar is dissolved and the mixture starts to boil
7. Allow to boil for 5 minutes
8. Mix the cornstarch with 1 / 4 cup of water , until all cornstarch is dissolved
9. Stir into syrup mixture and cook until slightly thickened
10. Pour into jar and refrigerate

title: brhuberry pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
2. Line 9 inch pie pan with pastry
3. In large bowl combine all filling ingredients except butter and toss lightly
4. Spoon filling into crust lined pan
5. Cut butter into small pieces and dot top of filling
6. Top with second crust , seal edges , and flute
7. Cut 4 slits in top of crust
8. Bake for 40 to 45 minutes or until crust is golden brown
9. Cover edge of crust with strips of foil after 20 minutes of baking to prevent excessive browning

title: acorn squash with pineapple
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Cut squash in half and remove seeds
3. Place each half , cut-side down on a nonstick baking sheet
4. Bake for 45 to 60 minutes until soft and tender
5. Meanwhile mix pineapple with spices and set aside
6. Now place squash into a baking dish
7. Divide pineapple mixture in half and place inside squash cavity
8. Return to oven and bake 5 more minutes or until pineapple mixture bubbles
9. Serve hot
10. You may want to try half the amount of spices first , then add the rest if needed

title: clam dip
steps:
1. Using electric mixer , beat cream cheese , sour cream , and lemon juice until smooth in medium bowl
2. Mix in clams and chives
3. Add reserved clam juice by tablespoons to thin to desired consistency
4. Season to taste with salt and pepper
5. Can make 1 day ahead
6. Cover and chill
7. Bring to room temperature before serving
8. Place bowl in center of platter surrounded with fresh veggies and chips

title: baked salmon topped with crab
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f
2. Take a baking pan and line it with foil
3. Spray a thin layer of pam
4. Crumble crab meat
5. Take your salmon and cut open so it opens up like one of those science project boards
6. Season with one teaspoon lemon pepper
7. Close flaps
8. Spread mayonnaise on top of the fillet and sprinkle remaining lemon pepper onto salmon
9. Top salmon with crab meat
10. Sprinkle cheese onto the crab meat
11. Bake about 25 to 30 minutes
12. Then broil for 2 minutes or until the cheese turns brown

title: easy vegetarian chili
steps:
1. Saute onion in the margarine
2. Add everthing else
3. Cook one hour

title: veal chops topped with yum
steps:
1. Heat oil in pan and brown both sides of veal om high heat 1 minutes each side
2. Remove the stems and dice , remove gills and discarded from the mushrooms
3. Remove veal from pan lower heat and add thyme , butter , onions , garlic and mushroom stems saute till onions are translucent
4. Adding oil if needed
5. Add port wine and cream to onion mixture mix through
6. In a casserole pan lay onion mixture on bottom , top with veal chops then lay on sliced tomato , pepper , portabella and cheese on each veal chop
7. Bake in 350 oven for 30 minutes covered with foil so not to touch the cheese

title: portuguese green soup
steps:
1. Wash the kale and cut off any stems
2. Slice into thin shreds
3. Put the potatoes , water , oil , salt and pepper in a saucepan and bring to a boil
4. Lower the heat and cook slowly , covered , for about 25 minutes , or until the potatoes are tender
5. Remove from the stove , and put the mixture through a sieve or puree it
6. Return to the saucepan
7. Add the strips of kale
8. Continue to cook about 12 minutes longer , or until the kale is tender
9. Add the sausage rounds , and leave on the stove long enough to heat through
10. Menu: portuguese green soup , warm garlic bread , baked bananas in orange juice
11. Soups & stews one dish meals

title: bacon  egg and cheddar scones
steps:
1. I'm a libra , so i do both
2. Preheat the oven to 450f
3. Lightly butter a baking sheet or line it with parchment paper
4. Sift the flour , baking powder , and salt together
5. Place in either a medium bowl or the work bowl of a food processor fitted with a steel blade
6. Cut the butter into the flour so that it is completely incorporated , using two knives , a pastry blender , your hands , or food processor until incorporated
7. Beat 2 of the raw eggs and the cream together and add to the dry ingredients
8. Mix or process just to incorporate the eggs into the flour and butter
9. Do not overmix
10. Dump the flour-and-butter mixture into a clean bowl
11. Fold the cheese , scrambled eggs , and bacon into the flour mixture
12. It will be sticky and chunky
13. Stir and knead the dough as little as possible while distributing the cheese , scrambled eggs , and bacon throughout
14. Transfer the dough to a well-floured work surface
15. Pat the dough into a rectangle about 12 x 4 x 3 / 4 inch high
16. Cut the dough into three 4-inch squares
17. Cut the squares on the diagonal to form six triangles
18. Place the scones at least 1 inch apart on the baking sheet
19. Beat the remaining 1 egg with 2 tablespoons water and use this wash to brush the tops of the scones
20. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes , or until golden brown
21. Remove and serve warm

title: quickie tom yum soup
steps:
1. Set water to boil in a pot , add water and mix in tom yum soup
2. Put garlic , celery , tomatoes , mushrooms , chicken and prawns inside the pot
3. Leave to boil
4. Add chicken , stock cube , salt and pepper
5. Leave to boil for another 5 - 10 minutes , until the fragrant smell of the soup wafts around the kitchen or until the oil from the tom yum soup appears on the surface on the soup
6. Garnish with coriander and serve

title: nana chase s  favorite  shepherd s pie
steps:
1. Brown and drain hamburger
2. Place hamburger in a 9x13 baking dish
3. Mix tomato soup with hamburger
4. Pour corn over hamburger mixture
5. Cover mixture with the mashed potatoes
6. Cover potato with cheese strips making sure to cover as much of it as you can
7. Bake at 350 degrees fahrenheit until cheese starts to bubble , approximately 30 minutes
8. Be careful not to burn the cheese
9. We have a large family
10. This recipe can be cut in half to downsize it for a smaller family
11. Be warned this recipe is even better as a leftover !

title: spinach   bacon haloumi salad
steps:
1. Heat a large frying pan over moderate heat
2. Cook and stir bacon for 3-4 minutes , or until brown
3. Transfer to paper towel to drain
4. Reheat pan
5. Add haloumi
6. Cook for 1 minute each side or until golden brown
7. Remove from heat
8. Place spinach , onion , bacon , tomato , olives and haloumi in a large bowl
9. Whisk reserved oil , olive oil , garlic , juice , capers and chilli in a small jug
10. Drizzle dressing over bowl of salad
11. Toss to combine
12. Serve at once with grilled pide or sausages

title: best zucchini brownies ever
steps:
1. Cream sugar & margarine
2. Add eggs and vanilla
3. Add remaining ingredients
4. Stir in shredded zucchini last
5. Spread in a 13 x 9 greased pan
6. Sprinkle 1 cup chocolate chips on top along with 1 tbls sugar
7. Bake @ 350 for 25 to 30 minutes

title: strawberry and cream cheese filled muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Combine the cream cheese and preserves
3. Stir with a whisk
4. Lightly spoon flour into dry measuring cups
5. Level with a knife
6. Combine flour , sugar , baking powder , poppy seeds , baking soda and salt in a medium bowl
7. Make a well in center of mixture
8. Combine buttermilk , oil , egg whites , and egg
9. Stir well with a whisk
10. Add to flour mixture , stirring just until moist
11. Spoon the batter into 12 muffin cups coated with cooking spray , filling one-third full
12. Top each with about 1 teaspoon cream cheese mixture , divide the remaining batter evenly over the cream cheese mixture
13. Bake at 375 for 25 minutes or until muffins spring back when touched lightly in center
14. Remove the muffins from pans immediately , and place on a wire rack

title: smothered fried chicken
steps:
1. For chicken: wash the chicken and pat it dry
2. Heat the shorting or oil to 365f for frying chicken
3. Salt and pepper the chicken
4. Mix the flour , salt , pepper , and garlic powder together
5. After the oil is at the right tempura , roll the chicken in the flour and place in the skillet
6. Cook 3 to 4 pieces at a time until golden brown and almost done
7. Drain the chicken and place in a baking dish
8. Set aside
9. Preheat the oven to 350f
10. Prepare gravy: on medium heat , heat the 4 tablespoons oil
11. Stir in the flour and cook , stirring constantly , for 2 to 3 minutes
12. Add the water and stir until boiling
13. Salt and pepper to taste
14. Gravy will be kind of thin , but will thicken as it cooks in the oven
15. Pour gravy over the chicken
16. Turn the chicken to coat completely
17. Cover and cook for 30 to 45 minutes until smothered and fork-tender

title: ham and chive mini muffin appetizers
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Spray 36 mini muffin tins with cooking oil spray
3. Whisk dry ingredients together
4. Whisk together the milk , oil , egg or substitute , and dried chives
5. Let this mixture set for a couple of minutes to soften chives and bring out their flavor
6. Stir wet and dry ingredients together until just blended
7. Spoon mixture into muffin tins , filling each about 3 / 4 full
8. Bake for 15-20 minutes , or until lightly browned
9. Cool on racks
10. These can be made ahead , sealed in plastic bags and refrigerated or even frozen
11. Mix honey , mustard , mayonnaise , and worcestershire sauce
12. This can also be made ahead if covered and refrigerated
13. To assemble: cut each muffin in half crosswise , spread each half with honey sauce
14. Drape ham slices over bottom half , letting some hang over sides
15. Replace muffin top
16. Arrange on a platter
17. Garnish with fresh chives or parsley
18. Cover tightly with plastic wrap and refrigerate until about 1 / 2 hour before serving
19. Or serve right away
20. These are best if they come back to room temperature before eating

title: broccoli orange salad
steps:
1. Combine broccoli , onion , raisins and pecans and set aside
2. Mix mayonnaise , sugar and vinegar
3. Add mayo mixture to broccoli and stir
4. Gently fold in mandarin oranges
5. Chill at least 3 hours

title: a1 derful grilled chicken  a1
steps:
1. Place a1 , chicken thighs , and pineapple juice in 1 gallon zip lock bag
2. Marinate for at least 3 hours turning bag occasionally
3. Preheat gas grill for medium heat
4. Grill pineapple rings for 2 minutes on each side
5. Set aside
6. Grill chicken until done
7. About 6 minutes on each side
8. Place about 10 spinach leaves layered on each piece of chicken
9. Place grilled pineapple ring on each piece
10. Place 1 tablespoon of goat cheese in each hole of each pineapple ring
11. Shut lid of grill for 3 minutes
12. Open grill , serve chicken and enjoy
13. Thankyou

title: veggie pot pie
steps:
1. Saute red onion garlic and celery in olive oil for 2 minutes
2. Add 5 cups diced vegetables , cumin , salt and pepper , cook for 5 minutes
3. Add quartered tomatoes and cook another 2 minutes
4. Prepare pastryfor 9 inch pie plate or oven proof skillet
5. Bake at 350 for 45 minutes

title: crunchewey carrot cranberry cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Lightly spray cookie sheets with vegetable cooking spray
3. Combine oats , flour and soda
4. Set aside
5. Combine splenda granular , eggs , and canola oil in a large mixing bowl , stirring until blended
6. Add pineapple with juice , coconut , carrots , cranberries , walnuts , and vanilla , stirring until blended
7. Add dry ingredients , stirring until blended
8. Drop dough by tablespoonfuls , 1 1 / 2 inches apart , onto prepared cookie sheets
9. Bake 10 to 11 minutes or until lightly browned
10. Transfer to wire racks to cool

title: pimento salad
steps:
1. Cook macaroni and drain well
2. Rinse with cold water
3. Mix in the rest of the ingredients , paprika actually goes in salad
4. Feel free to use more or less of any item to make the dish to your liking
5. Chill for at least 1 hour

title: mushroom salisbury steak
steps:
1. In a bowl , combine cornstarch and consomme until smooth
2. Stir in mushrooms , worcestershire sauce and basil
3. Set aside
4. In another bowl , combine egg , bread crumbs , onion , seasoned salt and pepper if desired
5. Add beef and mix well
6. Shape into six oval patties
7. Place in a shallow 1-1 / 2-qt
8. Microwave-safe dish
9. Cover and microwave on high for 6 minutes
10. Drain
11. Turn patties , moving the ones in the center to the outside of dish
12. Pour consomme mixture over patties
13. Cover and microwave on high for 8-10 minutes or until meat is no longer pink
14. Let stand for 5 minutes
15. Serve with potatoes or noodles

title: italian lemon cookies
steps:
1. In a small bowl , sift flour and baking powder together
2. In mixing bowl , beat eggs with sugar until light and lemon colored
3. Add the softened butter and lemon zest
4. Slowly beat in the flour and baking powder
5. Gradually add milk and vanilla
6. Dough should be soft
7. Divide dough into 6 sections
8. Roll out each section into a rope 1 / 2-inch wide
9. Cut into 3-inch pieces and twist each piece to form a loop
