10. Place on a greased baking sheet or a parchment lined baking sheet
11. Bake in a 350f oven for 10-12 minutes or until light brown
12. Remove from oven and cool
13. Combine the powdered sugar and enough orange juice to form a thin icing
14. Brush on top of cookies and sprinkle with colored candies
15. Makes about 4 dozen cookies , depending on size and shape of cookie

title: autumn vegetable succotash
steps:
1. In a skillet over medium-high heat , melt butter
2. Add onion
3. Cook until translucent , 2 minutes
4. Add garlic , bell peppers , zucchini , squash , lima beans and corn
5. Season with salt and pepper
6. Cook , stirring until vegetables are tender , 10 minutes
7. Stir in sage and serve

title: lamb stew with currants
steps:
1. Seaon lamb stew meat with salt and pepper and sear in a heavy iron skillet
2. Saute all ingredrients until wine in a deep casserole for long enough to soften onions
3. Add the lamb pieces once they are well browned all over
4. Add wine and orange juice and allow to reduce to 1 / 4
5. Add chicken stock to casserole and allow stew to simmer for an hour and a half
6. Add celery and carrots and simmer for another 15 minutes

title: kalasouna   cheese and onion pie
steps:
1. In a large bowl , mix together the flour , baking powder and salt
2. Add the oil and rub the ingredients between your hands until their texture is similar to breadcrumbs
3. Gradually add enough water to made a soft , elastic dough
4. Cover with plastic wrap and let rest for 2 to 3 minutes
5. To make in a food processor , combine the dry ingredients and pulse to mix , then , with the motor running , add the liquids
6. Place the onions and scallions in a colander and sprinkle generously with salt
7. Knead with your hands for a few minutes to wilt the onions and scallions , then rinse under very warm running water
8. Drain well and squeeze with your hands to extract as much liquid as possible
9. In a large bowl , combine the onions and scallions , cheese , yogurt , breadcrumbs and pepper to taste
10. Taste and add salt if necessaryfeta is usually quite salty
11. Stir in the eggs
12. Preheat the oven to 400f oil the bottom and sides of a 13 x 9-inch baking dish and sprinkle with 2 tablespoons of the sesame seeds
13. Divide the dough into 3 pieces
14. Take 2 of the pieces and cover the other
15. Briefly knead together the pieces and roll the dough out on a lightly floured surface into a sheet large enough to cover the bottom and sides of the baking dish , with a 1 / 2 inch overhang
16. Fit the dough into the dish and add the filling
17. Roll out the remaining piece of dough into a rectangle just a little larger than the dish and place it over the filling
18. Fold the overhanging bottom crust inward
19. Pinch the two edges together , turn them inward and press to seal , making a neat cord around the edge of the pan
20. Flatten the cord with the tines of a fork , to prevent it from sticking out , because it will burn during baking
21. If you like , with a pastry wheel , score parallel lines on the top of the crust , crossing them to make diamond-shaped patterns on the pie , being careful not to cut through the crust
22. Brush with the milk and sprinkle with the remaining 2 tablespoons sesame seeds
23. Bake for 1 hour , or until the crust pulls away from the sides of the pan and is golden brown on top
24. Let cool before cutting
25. Serve warm or at room temperature

title: spaghetti stuff
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. In a large skillet , add the meat , season all and onion powder
3. Brown your meat
4. Add the 2 cans of spaghetti and heat until warm
5. Put everything in a casserole dish
6. First , top with the shredded mozzarella cheese , then top with the shredded cheddar cheese
7. Put in the oven and bake for about 10 minutes or until the cheese is melted

title: frangelico chocolate sauce
steps:
1. Combine cream , chocolate and sugar in a medium saucepan over low heat
2. Cook stirring with a metal spoon for 8 minutes or until the chocolate melts and the mixture is smooth
3. Stir in the frangelico and cook stirring for 2 minutes
4. Remove saucepan from heat and serve immediately

title: apple cranberry streusel custard pie
steps:
1. Place rack in lower third of oven and preheat to 425
2. In large bowl , combine sweetened condensed milk and cinnamon
3. Add eggs , water , and fruits
4. Mix well
5. Pour into pie crust
6. In medium bowl , combine brown sugar and flour
7. Cut in butter until crumbly
8. Add nuts
9. Sprinkle mixture over pie
10. Bake 10 minutes
11. Reduce oven temperature to 375 , continue baking about 30-40 minutes or until golden brown
12. Cool
13. Store covered in refrigerator

title: cure a cold chicken soup
steps:
1. In a soup pot place the chicken and cover with cold water about two inches from the top of the chicken
2. Bring to a simmer-- skim the white foam off of the top-- this will take about 10 minutes
3. When the foam stops coming to the top-- add the carrots , celery , onion , garlic , poultry seasoning , salt peppercorns and ground pepper and bay leaves
4. Simmer for about 45 minutes
5. Add the remaining ingredients and simmer another 20 minutes or until potatoes are fork tender
6. Taste soup and adjust seasonings to your taste
7. Remove the chicken pieces to a platter and let cool enough to handle--take the meat off the bones and put the chicken meat back into the soup pot
8. Enjoy and your cold will go away sooner

title: baltimore peach cake
steps:
1. First , grease or spray a 9" cake pan , sides and bottom
2. Combine all the dry ingredients together in a mixer bowl
3. Start the mixer on low , and add the softened butter
4. Beat together for two minutes or so
5. Add the egg while the mixer is running
6. Slowly add the water
7. You'll have a very sticky dough
8. You may want to use the oil spray on your hands so you can work the dough a little
9. Press the dough into the bottom of the prepped cake pan
10. You'll need to stretch it out a bit and pinch closed the holes
11. You'll end up with a very thin dough
12. Spread the raspberry jam on top of the cake in an even layer
13. Arrange the peach quarters in the pan on top of the cake , pressing lightly on each to dent the dough
14. Cover with plastic wrap and set aside to rise in a warm place for one hour
15. Preheat the oven to 400f remove the plastic wrap and bake for 25 minutes
16. When 15 minutes or so have passed , cut your orange in half and juice it into a small saucepan
17. Scrape some of the pulp out of the orange and into the pot , leaving any membrane or white pith behind
18. Turn the heat on under the juice to medium
19. Add the sugar and 1 / 2 cup water
20. Stir well to dissolve the sugar into the water and make a simple syrup
21. Cook over medium heat to reduce for seven minutes or so
22. Remove the cake from the oven
23. Brush and spoon the syrup mixture over the top of the cake while it is hot
24. You don't have to use up all the syrup , but make sure the entire top of the cake is well coated with the syrup
25. Let the cake cool for at least 30-45 minutes before serving
26. It's also very good refrigerated

title: linda s italian baked chicken
steps:
1. Clean chicken
2. You can opt to keep the skin on or take it off
3. If you keep the skin on:
4. Pull skin back on each breast , and take 1 teaspoons garlic , and rub it into the skin of each breast
5. Sprinkle each breast with 1 / 2 teaspoons of italian seasoning
6. Pull skin back over chicken , and cover each breast with 1 teaspoons bread crumbs , and place in pan
7. Salt and pepper , to taste
8. Drizzle oil or spray with i can't believe it's not butter , all over the top
9. Bake at 350 , for 50-60 minutes , until juices run clear
10. If you take the skin off:
11. Put chicken pieces in baking pan
12. Put 1 teaspoons garlic on each breast , and rub around
13. Sprinkle with 1 / 2 teaspoons italian seasoning , salt , and pepper
14. Sprinkle 1 teaspoons bread crumbs over each chicken breast
15. Drizzle oil or i can't believe it's not butter over all the breasts , and bake at 350 , for 50-60 minutes , until juices run clear

title: fettuccine with chardonnay and red pepper
steps:
1. Boil wine until it is reduced to 1 / 2 cup
2. Puree peppers and add to wine
3. Stir in cream
4. Bring to a boil , stirring constantly
5. Cut basil into strips and add to sauce
6. Add sauce to pasta and toss well
7. Top with parmesan and serve

title: portabella  cheese steaks
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
2. Heat 1 tbs
3. Olive oil over medium-high heat in a 12-inch skillet until hot
4. Remove mushroom stems and slice mushrooms into 1 / 4 inch slices
5. Cook in skillet until tender and browned , about 10 minutes , stirring occasionally
6. Transfer to a bowl and set aside
7. In the same skillet , heat remaining 1 tbs
8. Olive oil over medium heat until hot
9. Add bell peppers , onions , salt , pepper , and water
10. Cook , stirring frequently , until vegetables are tender and golden , about 15 minutes
11. Stir in vinegar
12. Remove from heat
13. Gently stir in sliced mushrooms
14. Set aside
15. Place pitas on a large cookie sheet
16. Sprinkle with mozzarella cheese
17. Heat pitas until cheese is melted , about 5 minutes
18. Evenly distribute vegetables and mushrooms on the pitas
19. Roll each pita into a cone and tightly wrap the bottom half of each with foil to hold shape & prevent leakage

title: chocolate chip meringues  using powdered egg whites
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 275 f
2. Beat powdered egg whites with sugar , water and flavoring on high speed of an electric mixer for 4-5 minutes or until stiff peaks form
3. Gently hand stir in chocolate chips and nuts
4. Drop tbsps of batter onto parchment-lined cookie sheets and bake for 55-60 minutes or until lightly browned and dry
5. Do not overbake
6. These only keep a few days in a wax paper lined cookie tin , so don't make too far in advance

title: ham  egg and cheese sandwich stuffing
steps:
1. Dice one whole egg and just the whites of the other three
2. Add the diced ham and the shredded cheese , mix in the salsa
3. Salt and pepper to taste
4. Stuff a pita or make it into a wrap with a tortilla

title: carrot applesauce pineapple muffins
steps:
1. Heat the oven to 350
2. Drain the pineapple and save the juice in a seperate bowl
3. Shred carrots in the food processor and set aside
4. In a large bowl whisk together the flour , splenda , baking soda , baking powder , salt , and cinnamon
5. Make a well in the center of the mixture and pour in the pineapple juice , 2 eggs , egg white , oil , and vanilla extract
6. Beat at medium speed until blended - about 90 seconds
7. With a spoon , stir in the crushed pineappe , shredded carrots and applesauce
8. Next spoon the mixture into baking cups set in muffin tins
9. Bake until a toothpick comes out clean , about 25 minutes
10. Remove from oven and remove from tins
11. Set on wire racks to cool
12. Serve warm ! serves 24

title: pork au poivre
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425
2. Heat a cast iron skillet over medium high heat
3. While skillet is heating coat the exterior of the loin with the black pepper
4. Place olive oil in pan and add the pork and cook for 5-6 minutes , turning so that all sides of the meat are seared
5. You should hear some sizzling
6. Place the semi-cooked meat and skillet into the pre-heated oven , and bake for 12-16 minutes or until meat thermometer registers 155 degrees
7. Remove pork from pan and cover with foil and let it rest for 8-10 minutes
8. (in that time the meat will reach 160 degrees
9. Add broth and remaining ingredients to the cast iron skillet stirring well to scrape the peppery bits into the sauce
10. Bring to a boil over medium heat , cook until reduced to 1 / 2 cup

title: mexican huevos rancheros
steps:
1. In large skillet , heat olive oil
2. Add onion and green pepper , cook until tender
3. Add tomato , garlic , jalapeno , if using , oregano , salt , hot pepper sauce , tomato sauce and water
4. Simmer , covered for 20 minutes
5. Uncover
6. Break eggs , one at a time , into cup and slip into sauce
7. Cover and simmer over low heat until eggs are set , about 5 minutes
8. Serve over tortillas or toasted english muffins , topped with some of the sauce
9. Enjoy !

title: easy raspberry vinaigrette   5 ingredients
steps:
1. Place raspberries , vinegar , honey and thyme in blender
2. Turn on blender and mix well
3. With blender running , slowly add oil
4. Dressing will thicken as the mixture emulsifies

title: saute of chicken livers  bacon and apples
steps:
1. Pat livers dry
2. Saute the bacon with 1 t butter in a 10-inch skillet , until the bacon fat has rendered out
3. With a slotted spoon , remove the bacon bits and reserve until later
4. In the remaining bacon fat , saute the chicken livers over medium-high heat
5. Remove livers and reserve
6. Remove all but 1 t of the fat in the skillet
7. In the remaining fat , saute the shallots until soft
8. Then add the apples , calvados and heavy cream
9. With a wooden spoon , scrape up the browned particles in the bottom of the pan and incorporate
10. Return the chicken livers and bacon to the simmering cream and cook them about 3 minutes more , keeping the heat low so they do not toughen
11. Taste and adjust seasonings
12. Whisk in the last tablespoon of btuter
13. Dust with parsley
14. Serve

title: sliced carrots and apples
steps:
1. Place of apples in greased 13x9 baking dish
2. Cover with of carrots
3. Mix flour , sugar and salt to taste together
4. Sprinkle over carrot layer
5. Repeat layers again
6. Pour orange juice over top
7. Cover
8. Bake at 350 for 30 minutes
9. Cool slightly and serve warm

title: old south lost bread
steps:
1. Tear up bread into bite size pieces
2. Mix all other ingredients together in a bowl , then mix in bread pieces
3. Let set 2 hours up to overnight
4. Put in 1 1 / 2" shallow baking dish
5. Place small pieces of butter on top , and cover with foil
6. Put in 350f
7. Oven
8. Cook for 30 miutes covered , then uncover and cook for another about 15 minutes
9. Enjoy !

title: cream cheese with buttered pecan frosting
steps:
1. Cream together butter , cream cheese and confectioners sugar , add milk last
2. Add enough milk to make creamy according to how creamy you want your frosting
3. Brown pecans in 3 tblspoons of butter
4. Frost between each layer and sprinkle with browned nuts
5. Frost side of cake and pat on remaining nuts
6. Frost top of cake

title: stuffed onions
steps:
1. Peel onions without cutting through the bases
2. In large pot of boiling water , cook onions about 20 minutes
3. Drain & immerse in a pot of cold water
4. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f & oil a baking dish big enough to contain the 6 onions without crowding
5. Using a small sharp knife , cut around & scoop out the central section of each onion
6. Remove about half the inside
7. Lightly salt empty cavities , then let onions drain upside down
8. In a small bowl , beat the ham into the egg
9. Stir in bread crumbs , parsley , garlic , nutmeg & all but 3 tablespoons of the grated cheese
10. Add 3 tablespoons of the oil & season with salt & pepper
11. Pat insides of the onions dry with paper towels , then stuff them using a small spoon
12. Arrange onions in one layer in prepared baking dish
13. Sprinkle tops with remaining cheese & then with oil
14. Bake for 45 minutes , or until onions are tender & golden on top
15. Remove from oven & serve hot !

title: better that mean chef s
steps:
1. Heat oven 350
2. Coat roast with flour , shaking off excess
3. Let stand 5 minutes
4. Re-coat
5. Heat some oil in a dutch oven
6. Brown roast on all sides
7. Combine the broth , wine
8. Sugar , sour cream and bay leaves
9. Pour over roast
10. Cover
11. Bake 1 hour , basting often
12. Remove roast to a platter
13. Let stand 5 minutes
14. Reduce juices by half
15. Slice pork
16. Serve with sauce

title: citrus chocolate cupcakes
steps:
1. In a medium bowl combine flours , sugar , cocoa and baking soda
2. In a large bowl combine juice , water , oil , vinegar , vanilla , and orange extract and orange zest
3. Add flour mixture to the juice mixture
4. Stir until just moistened
5. Fold in chocolate chips
6. Spray 12 medium muffin cups or use paper liners
7. Fill cups half full with batter
8. Bake at 375f 13-16 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean
9. Cool 5 minutes before removing from pan

title: lauchkuchen   phyllo leek pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300f
2. Butter the bottom& sides of a 9x9x2 inch baking dish
3. Brush one sheet of phyllo with butter , fold in half horizontally and gently press it into the baking dish allowing equal amounts to hang over two sides
4. Brush the bit hanging over the sides generously with butter
5. Butter the second sheet , fold horizontally and place it across the first sheet , , again let the excess hang over with even amounts on both sides , brush excess with butter each time
6. Continue to butter& alternate the sheets until you have layered all 8 sheets
7. When they are all in the dish roll the excess phyllo under to just cover the edge of the dish forming an edge to the pastry
8. For the filling melt the 2 tbsp of butter in a small pan over medium& saute the leeks until they are golden
9. Place leeks over the bottom of the phyllo shell
10. Sprinkle in the cheese
11. Whisk the eggs , milk , half& half , nutmeg , kirsch , pepper& salt- blend well
12. Pour over the leeks& cheese
13. Bake uncovered for apprx 1 hour or until the custard is set
14. Let it rest for 30 minutes cut into squares& serve

title: chicken stir fry wraps
steps:
1. Season chicken with salt and pepper
2. In a large nonstick skillet , heat 1 tablespoon oil over high heat
3. Add half the chicken
4. Cook , stirring constantly , until opaque throughout , 2 to 4 minutes
5. Transfer to a plate
6. Repeat with remaining chicken
7. Add remaining tablespoon oil to pan , along with the onion and bell pepper
8. Cook , stirring constantly , until onion is tender and golden , about 4 minutes
9. Reduce heat to medium
10. Add garlic , ginger , and red-pepper flakes
11. Cook , stirring , until fragrant , 30 to 60 seconds
12. Stir in soy sauce , vinegar , and cornstarch mixture
13. Remove from heat
14. Add chicken and any accumulated juices
15. Toss to coat
16. Serve in lettuce cups

title: italian zucchini crescent pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Saute zucchini and onion in butter over medium low heat until zucchini is tender , about 10 minutes
3. Stir in parsley , salt , pepper , garlic powder , basil and oregano
4. Remove from heat
5. In a seperate bowl stir together eggs and cheese
6. Add vegetable mixture
7. Seperate rolls into triangles
8. Arrange in an 11 inch quiche pan or 10 inch pie pan pressing seams together to cover the bottom and sides of pan to form a crust
9. Spread the crust with the mustard
10. Add vegetable mixture
11. Bake for 35-40 minutes if using a quiche pan or 30-35 minutes if using a pie pan or until knife inserted in center comes out clean
12. Let stand for 10 minutes before slicing

title: mac n cheese
steps:
1. Before you start to make your sauce bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook your macaroni until its almost al dente
2. Start out by adding your cup of butter to a wide stainless steel saucepan , saucier , or large saut over medium heat
3. Once the butter is melted add your garlic onion and salt and cook until soft and the garlic is just getting brown around the edges
4. After that add the flour and while whisking furiously turn the heat to medium-low
5. Cook while whisking until the roux takes on a blondish color then add your spices , in this case black pepper and smoked paprika
6. Add the milk whisking constantly then boost the heat to medium and cook whisking frequently until the mix comes to a simmer and the sauce thickens
7. Once the sauce has thickened beat the egg in a separate bowl and slowly , while whisking , add some of the sauce a little at a time until the egg is "tempered"
8. Then add the cheese a little at a time until well incorporated
9. Poor all the sauce and macaroni into a casserole dish and fold together so the sauce is evenly distributed
10. Mix the melted butter bread crumbs and parmesan cheese
11. Spread more cheese over the top of the casserole and then the bread crumb topping
12. Park in a 375 degree oven for anywhere from 30mins to 45mins or until the cheese is bubbly and the topping is golden brown
13. Remove from the oven and enjoy
14. If you want more cheese in your sauce go for it , its completely up to you , i just wouldn't go above 24 ounces
15. The flavorings you put in are also completely up to you i'm making the classic mac and cheese , but you could add bacon , mushrooms , anything really

title: gluten free low carb pizza
steps:
1. Spread cream cheese on bottom of 9 x 13 pan
2. Beat eggs
3. Add seasonings and cheese
4. Pour over cream cheese
5. Bake at 350 for 22-25 minutes
6. Pull it out of oven
7. Add regular toppings - seasoned tomato sauce or pizza sauce
8. Cheeses as you like
9. Toppings as you like
10. Bake additional 15-20 minutes

title: birthday squishies
steps:
1. Unwrap kisses
2. Mix sugar and cinnamon together in a bowl
3. Split biscuits in half
4. Wrap each kiss in a biscuit half and roll into a ball
5. Dip each ball into melted butter and roll in cinnamon / sugar mixture
6. Drop balls into bundt pan and bake at 350 for 20-25 minutes
7. Let cool briefly , loosen around edges of pan with knife , and turn onto serving platter

title: pop up rolls
steps:
1. In a bowl , stir together all ingredients until thoroughly combined
2. Fill greased muffin cups half full
3. Bake at 375 for 18-20 minute or
4. Until lightly browned
5. Yield: 9 rolls

title: beet greens
steps:
1. Wash the greens thoroughly several times in deep water
2. Cook in very little boiling salted water until just tender , a few minutes
3. Drain thoroughly
4. Season with salt , pepper , vinegar and butter
5. Garnish with sliced eggs over the top

title: peanut butter pie ii
steps:
1. Whip cream cheese for 10 minutes with an electric mixer
2. Add powdered sugar and whip 10 minutes more
3. Blend in cool whip , peanut butter and vanilla
4. Beat 5 minutes
5. Pour into pie crusts and freeze at least 2 hours
6. Before serving , garnish with whipped cream and peanuts
7. For a special touch , top pie with hot caramel or chocolate sauce

title: slow cooked korean beef
steps:
1. Stir all ingredients but meat together in the bowl of a slow cooker
2. Remove string from roast
3. Cut roast in half
4. Place meat in the soy mixture and turn to coat
5. Cover and cook until beef is fork-tender , 5-6 hours on high or 8-10 hours on low
6. Remove beef from slow cooker and shred with a knife and fork , then return it to the sauce
7. Pile onto mashed potatoes , or buns with toppings
8. Dee-licious !

title: royal chicken tarkari
steps:
1. Grind garlic , ginger , fresh red chilies , curry powder , nutmeg , timur , cardamom and almonds with water into a paste
2. In a large bowl , season chicken pieces with salt and pepper
3. Heat oil and brown chicken in a sauce pan
4. Reserve browned chicken in a bowl
5. Drain oil and clean the pan , heat butter
6. Add turmeric , chopped onion and saut till brown
7. Transfer the almond paste to the onion mixture
8. Stir for a few minutes till the oil starts to separate from the mixture
9. Turn down heat to low
10. Add cream , broth , salt and pepper
11. Mix well and cook until a consistent mixture is achieved
12. Transfer browned chicken to the almond sauce
13. Cook on low heat till chicken is tender and the almond sauce has thickened
14. Garnish with chopped cilantro
15. Serve with rice or roti

title: 20 minute honey granola   easy
steps:
1. Heat oven to 300 degrees
2. Combine oats , nuts , salt , cinnamon and flax in a large bowl and set aside
3. Combine oil , honey and vanilla in another , smaller bowl
4. Mix wet ingredients into dry - you may need to use your hands
5. Then spread the mixture onto two cookie sheets lined with foil or parchment
6. Bake 10 minutes
7. Then remove from oven and stir
8. Bake an additional 10 minutes or until slightly golden
9. Remove from oven and allow to cool completely
10. When cooled , transfer into an airtight container for storage

title: spicy mexican chicken soup  south beach style
steps:
1. Cut your chicken breasts into small strips about 2 inches long
2. Heat oil in a large saucepan over medium heat
3. Add onion and jalapeo
4. Cook , stirring often , until vegetables are tender , 5 minutes
5. Stir in garlic and cumin
6. Cook 30 seconds more
7. Add broth , increase heat to high , and bring to a rapid simmer
8. Add chicken and cook until no longer pink , about 3 minutes
9. Stir the pan making sure to get all the bits of onion , jalapeo and cumin are well mixed into the soup and not stuck to the bottom of the pan
10. Stir in salsa , bring back to simmer , season with salt and pepper to taste and top with cilantro if desired

title: ww smoky jalapeno burgers   8 pts
steps:
1. Combine first 7 ingredients in a large bowl , and stir well
2. Divide mixture into 6 equal portion , shaping into patties
3. Combine 3 tablespoons jalapeno jelly , 3 tablespoons chili sauce , and 1 / 2 teaspoon smoke seasoning in a small bowl
4. Stir well
5. Prepare grill
6. Brush 1 side of each hamburger patty with jelly mixture
7. Place patties , jelly side down , on grill rack coated with cooking spray
8. Cover and grill 5 minutes
9. Brush patties with remaining jelly mixture
10. Turn patties over
11. Cover and grill an additional 5 minute or until done
12. Combine remaining 2 tablespoons jelly and remaining 2 tablespoons chili sauce
13. Stir well and spread evenly over bottom halves of buns
14. Top with lettuce , patties and top halves of buns

title: caprese blt
steps:
1. Place tomato slices on several layers of paper towels and sprinkle with 1 / 2 teaspoon salt
2. Let sit for 15 minutes , then press with additional paper towels to extract excess moisture
3. Mix oil and vinegar together in small bowl
4. Slice bread in half horizontally and use fingers to remove and discard all but 1 / 2 inch of interior crumb
5. Puree 1 cup basil , mayonnaise , lemon juice , garlic , hot sauce , and 1 / 4 teaspoon salt in blender or food processor until smooth , stopping to scrape down sides several times
6. Spread basil mayonnaise on both cut sides of bread
7. Sprinkle bacon on bottom half of bread and place romaine on top of bacon
8. Shingle tomatoes and mozzarella alternately over romaine and drizzle wih oil and inegar mixture
9. Place remaining 1 / 3 cup basil in single layer on top and replace top half of bread
10. Cut crosswise into 2 inch sandwiches
11. Serve

title: iced mocha cafe
steps:
1. Pour the hot coffee into a heatproof 10-ounce glass
2. Add the ice cubes and stir until coffee is chilled
3. Add the ice cream and top with the whipped cream
4. Taste and add sugar , if desired
5. Serve with a long-handled spoon and a straw

title: tomato butter  tomatsmor
steps:
1. Cream the butter until it is light and fluffy
2. The butter should be almost white in colour
3. Add the remaining ingredients and beat into the butter so as to mix thoroughly
4. Transfer to a serving dish or small individual sized pots
5. Chill until ready to use

title: shrimp chip and vegetable dip
steps:
1. Mix together all of the ingredients except the shrimp
2. Carefully fold in the shrimp so it doesn't break up
3. Serve with potato chips or cut vegetables

title: my gramma s graham bread
steps:
1. Mix altogether and let stand 1 hour
2. Pour batter into 2 9x5 inch loaf pans
3. Bake for 1 hour at 350 degrees

title: grandma hoort s delicious dessert
steps:
1. Mix flour , nuts and margarine and pat into the bottom of a 9 x 13 pan
2. Bake crust at 350f for 10-15 minutes
3. Beat cream cheese , confectioners sugar and 1 / 2 the tub of whipped topping and spread over crust
4. Mix milk and pudding mixes and spread over the cream cheese mixture
5. Top with remaining whipped topping
6. Serve cold

title: lit l smokies hash browns bake
steps:
1. 13hash brown crust:
2. Preheat oven to 425 fahrenheit
3. Press potatoes onto bottom and up sides of a 9 pie plate
4. Drizzle with cup melted butter
5. Bake at 425fahrenheit for 20 to 25 minutes or until crust is lightly browned
6. While crust bake , prepare filling
7. Let crust cool slightly
8. Filling:
9. Reduce oven temperature to 350 fahrenheit
10. Add 1 cup of cheese
11. Spoon into hash brown crust
12. Cut smokies in thirds and top with hillshire farm lit'l smokies
13. Combine eggs , milk , salt , and pepper
14. Beat with a wire whisk
15. Pour over litl smokies and cheese
16. Top with additional cheese
17. Bake at 350 fahrenheit for 25 to 30 minutes or until filling is set
18. Let stand 10 minutes before serving
19. Recipe altered to our tastes
20. You can use whatever variety of cheeses you want

title: boliche relleno  stuffed boliche    eye of the round roast
steps:
1. Clean the meat by trimming excess fat
2. With a knife make a deep cut along the center of the beef , leaving both ends uncut
3. Place the meat in a large pot
4. Line with plastic liner - so as to be able to mix the marinade and roast
5. To prepare marinade , mix garlic , oregano , cumin , bay leaf , bitter orange juice , lime juice , wine , 1 packet of goya con azafran seasoning , 1 tablespoon goya adobo seasoning , 1 / 2 of the cilantro , salt , if using , and pepper , if using
6. Add 3 tablespoons of the marinade to the opening inside the meat
7. For best results , marinate for 3 hours or up to overnight , refrigerated
8. In food processor container mix the stuffing: ham or bacon , carrot , onions , bell peppers and chorizo , 1 packet of goya con azafran seasoning , 1 tablespoon goya adobo seasoning , olives , capers to a fine grind
9. Mix the contents with the marinade in a bowl
10. Loosely stuff mixture into the cavity of the roast by pressing it with a long handled spoon as far into the cavity as possible
11. Tie stuffed roast closed , tightly
12. Add the rest of the marinade to the outside of the meat
13. Preheat oven to 350f
14. Heat a large frying pan that can be used on stove as well as in the oven , add olive oil
15. When olive oil is heated and begins to "smell fragrant" , add the roast and brown on all sides , turning with a large fork several times
16. Add the remaining marinade , cover and place in oven
17. Roast for approximately 3 hours
18. Discard bay leaves
19. Remove meat to a separate dish and allow to cool , at least 30 minutes , before slicing into 1 / 4" slices using a very sharp knife , so that roast doesn't crumble
20. Combine the chunky tomato sauce and remaining badia cilantro with the marinade that remained in the pan and simmer for 3 minutes
21. Pour over sliced meat
22. Cover meat with aluminum foil and reheat if necessary , be careful not to dry out !
23. Can be served with roasted potatoes , a vegetable , an avocado salad , good warm cuban bread to sop up the juice and a lovely wine
24. Que les aproveche !

title: salsa roja
steps:
1. Grill all veggies except cilantro and salt until they blacken , removing each one as they do
2. Remove stems froom veggies and also seeds from peppers , if preferred
3. Place ingredients in a food processor and pulse until desired consistency is achieved
4. Taste for salt and adjust if needed
5. Chill until needed

title: warm imported olive appetizer
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Rinse and drain the olives well
3. In 3 separate , small oven proof pans divide the olives up and toss with the olive oil
4. Add the spicy ingredients to one pan , the zesty mixtures to the next and finally the zingy olive ingredients to the last pan
5. Toss to coat
6. Bake approximately 15-25 minutes
7. Transfer to divided serving platter

title: peppermint brownies
steps:
1. Center a rack in the oven and heat the oven to 350f
2. Butter the bottom and sides of a 9x13-inch baking pan , line it with parchment , and butter the paper
3. Put about 2 inches of water in a small pot and heat to a gentle simmer
4. In a heatproof bowl set over the water , melt 8 ounces of the butter and 8 ounces of the unsweetened chocolate
5. Be sure that the water is hot but not boiling and that it doesnt touch the bottom of the bowl
6. Stir occasionally with a heatproof spatula until the mixture is completely melted and uniform , 6 to 7 minutes
7. Turn off the heat , but leave the bowl over the water
8. In a food processor , finely grind the peppermint leaves with the sugar
9. In a medium bowl , whisk together the eggs , peppermint extract , salt , and peppermint sugar until just combined
10. Whisk in the melted chocolate mixture
11. Slowly add the flour , gently folding it in with a spatula , until incorporated
12. Spread the batter into the prepared pan and bake until a pick inserted into the center comes out almost clean , 35 to 40 minutes
13. Put the pan on a rack to cool to room temperature , about 2 hours
14. Lift the paper lining to pull the brownies out of the pan
15. Peel the paper off the brownies and put them on a cutting board
16. To make the glaze , bring the pot of water back to a gentle simmer
17. Set a heatproof bowl over the pot and add the semisweet chocolate , corn syrup , and the remaining 2 ounces each butter and unsweetened chocolate
18. Stir frequently with a heatproof spatula until the mixture is melted and smooth
19. Set aside
20. Put the white chocolate in a separate heatproof bowl and set it over the water
21. Stir frequently until its melted and smooth
22. Remove it from the heat
23. Spread the chocolate glaze over the cooled brownies in an even layer using a spatula
24. Drizzle the white chocolate over the glaze in lines
25. Use a toothpick or a wooden skewer to drag the white chocolate into the glaze
26. Lift the cutting board and firmly tap it on the counter to settle the glaze
27. Refrigerate until the glaze is set , at least 20 minutes and up to 12 hours
28. Cut into thirty bars , about 2 inches square
29. Keep well covered and serve at room temperature
30. These brownies only get better after a couple of days , as their texture gets fudgier and their flavor richer
31. Yields about 30 brownies

title: baked cavatappi with smoked ham and fontina
steps:
1. Bring 6 quarts of salted water to a boil
2. Meanwhile , saute mushrooms in 1 tbs
3. Butter over medium heat for two minutes
4. Add sherry , stir for 1 minute and remove mushrooms from heat
5. Cook the cavatappi in the boiling water until al dente and drain
6. While pasta is cooking , melt 3 tbs
7. Butter in a saucepan over medium heat
8. Add the flour and whisk until smooth
9. Gradually add milk and continue whisking
10. Stir over heat until sauce thickens , about 10 minutes
11. Remove from heat and add sauteed mushrooms , nutmeg , salt and pepper
12. Butter a large ovenproof dish , and arrange 1 / 3 of the cavatappi in the dish
13. Top with 1 / 3 of the cheese and ham and spoon on 1 / 3 of the sauce
14. Repeat the layers two more times , ending with sauce
15. Bake in a preheated 350 degree oven until heated through and bubbly , about 20 to 30 minutes minutes

title: anderson tartar sauce
steps:
1. Mix all ingedients together well
2. Chill overnight

title: moist  cinnamon apple quick bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven 350 degrees
2. Spray loaf pan with nonstick spray
3. In large bowl combine flour , sugars , baking soda , baking powder , salt , nutmeg and cinnamon
4. In small bowl combine wet ingredients , egg whites , vanilla , applesauce and apples
5. Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients and mix until just blended
6. Pour mixture into loaf pan and spread evenlysprinkle with cinnamon and sugar or streusel topping if desired
7. Bake 35-45 minutes

title: diced potatoes in soy sauce
steps:
1. Heat oven to 450
2. Place butter in a 13x9 or 10x15 rimmed baking pan
3. Set pan in oven until butter is melted
4. Add potatoes to pan and stir to coat with butter
5. Bake stirring occasionally , until potatoes are tender when pierced
6. Add soy sauce to potatoes and stir to coat
7. Continue to bake until potatoes look dry
8. Good served with beef roast or steak

title: dixie cafe baked squash
steps:
1. Trim squash , cut into large chunks & boil to tender
2. Drain & mash
3. Mix all ingredients , saving half of the crumbs and put into sprayed 8x8 baking dish
4. Cover with remaining bread crumbs
5. Bake at 350 until lightly browned

title: orange tea punch
steps:
1. In pitcher , combine tea , orange juice , lemon juice , and sugar
2. Stir until sugar dissolves
3. Chill
4. Just before serving , pour tea mixture into large punch powl
5. Add scoops of sherbet and ginger ale

title: easy savory meatloaf
steps:
1. For meatloaf:
2. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
3. In a large bowl , mix chopped onion and stuffing mix , and pour in the broth and let set while you prepare the pan
4. Line a jelly roll pan or cookie sheet with deep sides with foil
5. Set a baking rack large enough to hold the meatloaf in the pan and spray lightly with cooking spray , or brush lightly with oil
6. In the large bowl , mix in remaining ingredients until evenly blended
7. Form the meat mixture into a large loaf pan , pressing down with a rubber spatula or large spoon until the meat is evenly pressed into the pan
8. Cut a piece of foil slightly smaller than the top of the meatloaf and press it onto the top
9. Run a dull knife around the sides of the meatloaf to loosen it from the pan
10. Invert the meatloaf onto the prepared rack on the cookie sheet and tap the bottom of the loaf pan so it slides out on the rack
11. You will now bake the meatloaf with no pan
12. The lets the grease drain away as it cooks
13. Bake about 60 minutes , then remove from oven and glaze the top with the three remaining ingredients blended into a sauce
14. Return to oven and cook about 15 minutes further or until any juices run clear
15. Serve with more of the sauce used for the glaze

title: simply heavenly potatoes  5fix
steps:
1. Fry the bacons in a skillet , drain and crumble
2. Chop up the green onions
3. Spray a 9 x 15 cassarole dish with cooking spray
4. Add potatoes and 1 c gouda
5. Add sour cream
6. Stir together until just mixed
7. Sprinkle bacon and green onions on top
8. Top with 1 c gouda
9. Bake in a 350f oven for 30 minutes until the cheese is bubbly and the mixture is heated through

title: mustard rub for pork
steps:
1. Place the first 5 ingrediants in a dry skillant
2. Place over medium heat , moving the skillet to keep seeds from burning , until aromatic , about 2 minutes
3. Mustard seeds will begin to pop
4. Transfer seeds to a spice grinder , cool slightly , and pulse until finely chopped but not powdery
5. Transfer to a small bowl and stir in rest of the ingrediants

title: spicy grilled chicken
steps:
1. Mix spice mixture in a food processor or by hand and set aside
2. Rub chicken pieces with olive or canola oil
3. Coat chicken pieces with spice mixture and rub some under the skin
4. Grill over medium heat for 35-45 minutes , turning as needed
5. You may also bake chicken at 350 f
6. For 40-45 minutes

title: cherry zucchini bread
steps:
1. Put eggs in large mixing bowl
2. Beat with an electric mixer on medium speed 3-4 minutes or until eggs are thick and lemon colored
3. Add sugar , oil , lemon juice and water
4. Mix well
5. Combine flour , baking powder , cinnamon , baking soda and salt
6. Add flour mixture to egg mixture
7. Mix well
8. Stir in zucchini , cherries and lemon peel
9. Grease and flour bottom of 8 1 / 2 x 4 1 / 2 inch loaf pan
10. Pour batter into prepared pan
11. Bake in preheated 350 degrees f oven 55-65 minutes or until wooden toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
12. Let cool in pan on wire rack 10 minutes
13. Loosen edges with a metal spatula
14. Remove from pan
15. Let cool completely
16. Wrap tightly in plastic wrap and store in refrigerator

title: sauteed savoy cabbage and pears
steps:
1. In a large skillet over medium heat , melt 2 tbsp of the butter
2. Add the shredded cabbage and toss to coat with the butter
3. Cover and cook over low heat for 10 minutes or until it is crisp-tender
4. While the cabbage is cooking , in a seperate skillet , over med-high heat , melt the remaining 1 tbsp butter
5. Add the thinly sliced pears and sugar
6. Cook for 1-2 minutes
7. Stir the pears into the cabbage skillet
8. Cook over medium low heat for about 1-2 minutes
9. Season with salt and pepper
10. Serve

title: fried catfish with a creamy thai sauce
steps:
1. Combine spices , salt , cornmeal , flour
2. Coat catfish with mixture
3. Let sit while making sauce
4. In a saucepan heat 2 teaspoons oil add and saute onions , ginger , garlic and lemon grass until soft
5. Add red curry paste and cook add brown sugar , fish sauce , coconut milk , basil and lime juice
6. Stir mixture
7. Place 1 cup of sauce mixture in a blender with cashews blending well add back to pot
8. Cook over medium heat until thick about 5 minutes
9. Heat 2 tablespoons oil shaking off excess breading
10. Add catfish and fry until golden brown , about 3-4 minutes on each side depending on size
11. Remove and drain on paper towels
12. Salt fish
13. Serve with white rice
14. Placing the fish over the rice and topping with coconut sauce

title: creamy mashed potato bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Combine potatoes , sour cream , milk and garlic powder in a large bowl
3. Mix well
4. Spoon half the mixture into a 2 quart lightly greased baking dish
5. Sprinkle with 2 / 3 cup of french fried onions and 1 / 2 cup of cheese
6. Top with remaining potato mixture
7. Bake for 30 minutes until hot all the way through
8. Top with remaining onions and cheese
9. Bake for 5 minutes or until onions are golden

title: garden burger with mushroom and peppers
steps:
1. Toast the pecans in a dry frying pan over a low heat for about 5 minutes , stirring often , until slightly browned but not burned
2. Grind in a blender or food processor or chop finely
3. Chop the onion and garlic
4. Saute in vegetable stock or until softened and golden
5. When the onions are ready , add the other vegetables and cook for a further 10-15 minutes until everything is tender , adding a little water if necessary to prevent sticking
6. Add the hoisin sauce , mix well and continue to cook until the sauce is thick
7. Place the vegetable mixture in a blender along with the cooked rice , and pulse a few times to blend things together , leaving some pieces of vegetables whole
8. Mix in the nuts and breadcrumbs
9. If the mixture does not want to hold , mix in some potato flakes , instant mashed potato or more breadcrumbs to help bind it
10. If possible , leave in the refrigerator to firm up for 30 minutes - it will keep there for a few days
11. To cook them , fry or bake

title: barbecue pretzels
steps:
1. Seperate dough into 10 pieces
2. Flour hands and a flat surface
3. Roll each piece of dough into a 10" rope
4. Wind each dough rope around a stick , leaving space between spirals and pinching dough together tightly at each end
5. If desired , roll in salt or sesame seeds , pressing coating into dough
6. Bake over coals , turning to bake and toast evenly
7. To remove from stick , twist pretzel counter clockwise , then turn clockwise and pull off
8. Serve with tangy barbecued beans

title: amazing almonds
steps:
1. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil , set aside
2. In a medium sauce pan combine all ingredients , then place on burner that is on medium heat
3. Occasionally stir the almond mixture in the beginning
4. Near the end you will notice a change in the mixture it will become harder to stir , that is when you have to constantly keep stirring it
5. This can last anywhere from 15-20 minutes
6. You will know the almonds are done when the liquid is all gone and the almonds are coated in crystallized sugar , and when in doubt keep stirring , it takes sometime
7. Dump the almonds on baking sheet and allow them to cool , enjoy

title: blender mayonnaise
steps:
1. Combine eggs , juice and salt in a blender at high speed for 1 minute
2. Slowly add 1 tsp oil while blender is set on medium
3. Contunue adding the rest of the oil until mayo is emulsified store in the fridge in a glass jar for up to three days

title: tahitian coconut bread
steps:
1. Combine coconut , sugar and water
2. Blend flour and baking powder together
3. Mix all ingredients to a doughy texture adding a little flour as needed so is not too sticky
4. Wrap in aluminum foil and bake in oven at 350 for 1 hour to 1 1 / 2 hours
5. Makes 5 loaves

title: grubstake brownies
steps:
1. Melt butter and chocolate in microwave in large glass bowl
2. Let cool a bit
3. Add eggs , stirring with a spoon to break and combine with chocolate mixture
4. Add all remaining ingredients except nuts , and blend thoroughly with a spoon
5. Add nuts and stir til mixed
6. Turn into a buttered 13x9 baking pan
7. Bake at 350 for 25 - 30 minutes
8. The hardest part of making these , is it seems impossible to tell when they are done
9. You really just have to know your oven
10. I've finally decided it's 30 minutes - i set the timer , when it dings , i take them out - no matter what they look like , and call it done
11. But your oven might cook hotter
12. If you like a more cake like type brownie , you can add another egg

title: katie s roasted red pepper dip
steps:
1. Place all ingredients except scallion in a food processor and pulse until smooth
2. Garnish with scallion
3. Serve with crudites

title: fat free lemon herb roasted veggies
steps:
1. Peel and chop the veggies as directed and place them in a large ziplock bag
2. In a non-metallic bowl , mix together the marinade ingredients and mix well
3. Pour the marinade into the ziplock bag , seal it , and shake it well such that all the veggies are coated with the herb marinade
4. Let it sit for at least 30 minutes
5. Preheat oven to 200 degrees celcius
6. Spray a casserole dish or baking sheet lightly with cooking spray
7. Remove the veggies from the ziplock bag and arrange them on the dish / tray
8. Bake on the top rack of the oven for 35 to 40 minutes , or until the veggies are as done as you want them
9. Turn once or twice during baking
10. Alternately , you can also grill the veggies in skewers , i prefer that way !
11. After they're done , pile the veggies onto a large plate , season with extra salt and pepper if required , pour yourself a tall glass of cold fruit juice , and sit down to a shockingly healthy and light lunch !

title: baked tarragon chicken
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375f
2. In a shallow dish , combine butter , mustard and garlic powder
3. In another dish , combine the bread crumbs , tarragon leaves , salt and pepper
4. Dip breasts in butter mixture and then coat with crumb mixture
5. Place in a baking dish
6. Sprinkle remaining crumbs over chicken
7. Bake at 375 f for 30-35 minutes or until chicken is fork-tender and juices run clear

title: chicken with orzo and veggies
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large frypan over medium high heat
2. Add onion , garlic and red pepper
3. Cook 2 minutes
4. Add broth , broccoli and orzo
5. Reduce heat to medium , cover and cook for 6 minutes , stirring occasionally
6. Add chicken and corn , cook an additional 8 minutes or until chicken juices run clear
7. Remove from heat , season with salt and pepper and gently stir in cheese
8. Serve immediately

title: ground turkey helper
steps:
1. Fry the ground turkey , onion and garlic in large non-stick frying pan for 4-5 minutes
2. Add zucchini and mushrooms
3. Cook for 6-7 minutes , stirring occasionally , until turkey is no longer pink
4. Drain
5. Add water , spaghetti sauce , basil , and oregano
6. Heat until boiling
7. Add pasta
8. Reduce heat
9. Cover
10. Simmer for 30 minutes or until pasta is tender but firm and liquid is mostly absorbed
11. Add mozzarella cheese
12. Stir until melted

title: spelt muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Mix all dry ingredients together in a large bowl
3. Add the eggs , applesauce or yogurt , vanilla , honey , and buttermilk to the mashed banana
4. Add the liquid ingredients to the dry ingredients and gently stir
5. Do not overmix
6. Combine the fruit and nuts with the batter
7. Fill oiled muffin cups 3 / 4 full
8. Sprinkle tops of muffins with additional flax seed meal and bake for 15-20 minutes

title: gosh  what easy squash
steps:
1. Put the squash cubes , pecans , and apple slices into the crockpot then toss them around a bit to mix
2. In a medium bowl
3. Mix the pineapple tidbits with their juice , yogurt , melted butter , curry powder , cinnamon , nutmeg , allspice , salt , pepper , cayenne , and lemon juice
4. Pour the mixture over the squash and turn on the crockpot to low
5. Cook for 4 hours , stirring occasionally then serve !

title: cajun french fries  lowfat
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Combine potatoes and oil in a large bowl and toss well to coat
3. In a small bowl , combine cayenne pepper , chili powder , cumin , salt , and black pepper
4. Sprinkle over potatoes and toss well until all potatoes are coated with seasoning
5. Coat a large baking sheet with cooking spray
6. Spread potatoes evenly on baking sheet
7. Bake for 30 minutes or until golden brown and crispy

title: pork tenderloin medallions in a  sherry mushroom cream sauce
steps:
1. Heat 10 " skillet
2. Add oil
3. Season medallions on one side
4. Place in pan season side down
5. Season other side
6. Brown until golden and turn
7. When both sides are nice and golden , remove from pan and set aside
8. Add more oil if needed and onion , mushrooms , and garlic
9. Saute until onion is soft and mushrooms are lightly browned
10. Add sherry , dried thyme and salt and pepper
11. Cook til sherry is almost evaporated , 2 minutes
12. Add stock , mustard and cream
13. Bring to a boil
14. Add meat back to pan , along with herbs
15. Reduce heat , cover and simmer 15 -20 minutes

title: crispy sweet potato
steps:
1. Beat egg whites and garlic powder together in a small bowl
2. Combine crushed cereal , parsley , and basil in a pie plate
3. Dip each potato slice into egg mixture and then into cereal mixture
4. Cost well
5. Place slices on a lightly greased baking sheet and bake in a preheated 435 oven for 20 minutes
6. Turn slices over and bake for 10 more minutes until tender
7. Enjoy !

title: easy spinach casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Thaw the spinach and squeeze out as much juice as you can
3. This will keep your casserole from being watery
4. Combine spinach , egg , salt , pepper , onion , cheese , and celery soup in a bowl
5. Spoon into a greased 2 quart pyrex dish
6. Top with bread crumbs
7. Bake covered with aluminum foil 30 to 35 minutes

title: pecan pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Prick pie shell with fork
3. Bake 10 minutes
4. Set aside
5. Decrease oven temperature to 330 degrees f
6. Combine sugar and flour in large bowl
7. Stir in milk and beat in eggs , one at a time
8. Mix in vinegar and vanilla
9. Gradually stir in butter
10. Fold in pecans
11. Pour into pie shell
12. Bake until puffed and brown , 45-50 minutes
13. Let cool to room temperature before serving

title: four happiness pork
steps:
1. Put pork in boiling water
2. Boil 1 minute
3. Drain
4. Rinse in cold water
5. Cut pork in 2-inch cubes
6. Put pork and 1 cup water in an earthenware or any other heavy pot
7. Bring water to boil
8. Add sherry , soy sauce , ginger , and scallions
9. Cover pot tightly
10. Simmer over very low heat 2 hours
11. Add sugar
12. Bring to high heat
13. Baste until gravy coats the meat
14. May be prepared in advance
15. May be frozen
16. Reheat before serving

title: salsa de las sirenas
steps:
1. Combine all of the ingrdients and use as desired
2. Would be fantastic as a dip with cornchips , as a topping for mexican dishes

title: old fashioned potato pancakes
steps:
1. Rinse potatoes in cold water
2. Drain thoroughly
3. In a bowl , mix potatoes , eggs , onion , flour , parsley , salt and pepper
4. Pour batter by 1 / 3 cupfuls onto a greased hot griddle
5. Fry 5-6 minutes on each side or until potatoes are tender and pancakes are golden brown

title: golden crumble plum pie
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine flours , sugar , polenta , baking powder and salt
2. Take the butter and rub it into the flour mixture with your fingers until it looks like fine crumbs
3. Stir in egg and olive oil and enough cold water to form a smooth dough
4. Next grease a 9-inch spring-form pan and press 2 / 3 of the dough evenly over the base and up the sides of the spring-form pan
5. Wrap the rest of the dough in plastic wrap and refrigerate it while you are preparing the filling
6. At this time you will want to preheat your oven to 350 degress f
7. Sprinkle the sugar and polenta into the pan
8. Cut your plums in half and remove the pits , and then place the halves cut-side down on top of the sprinkled polenta
9. Remove the remaining dough from the fridge and crumble it between your fingers , and then combine it with the oats
10. Sprinkle this mixture evenly over the plums and then sprinkle the raw sugar on top of that
11. Place in the oven and bake for 50 minutes until golden brown
12. Remove from oven and allow it to sit for approximately 15 minutes before you remove it from the spring-form pan
13. Once you remove it , leave it to cool on a wire rack
14. When serving , top slices with custard or cream
15. Enjoy !

title: red snapper marinated with 3 kinds of chilies in banana leaves
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 475 degrees f
2. Combine chilies , onion , garlic , tomato , epazote , bay leaves , cumin , and apple cider vinegar
3. Boil for 15 minutes
4. Remove the bay leaves and epazote
5. Blend in blender until smooth
6. Pour over fish , cover with banana leaf and bake for 15 minutes
7. Serve with white rice and vegetables
8. In a saucepot , heat oil
9. Add the onion and garlic
10. Once onion is caramelized , add rice and toast until aromatic
11. Add chicken stock , vegetables , salt , and pepper
12. Cover and simmer until cooked , about 20 minutes

title: crock pot sweet and sour polish sausage
steps:
1. Slice polish sausage into 1 / 2 inch wide pieces
2. Put into bottom of crock pot
3. Mix grape jelly and cocktail sauce
4. Pour over sausage
5. Cook for about 3 hours
6. Being that crock pots are all different , yours might be done a little sooner or a little later
7. I make these with cheesy potato casserole #102296 , very good meal
8. Enjoy !

title: maple baked apples with toasted oats and almonds
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
2. Combine apples and 2 tbsp of the maple syrup in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
3. Saute until apples are tender , about 10 minutes
4. Transfer apples to a 9-inch pie plate and set aside
5. In a small bowl , whick together remaining 4 tbsp maple syrup , cinnamon , and nutmeg
6. Add oats , almonds , and flour and mix well
7. Spread mixture over apple slices
8. Bake 40 minutes , until top is golden brown
9. Cool slightly before serving

title: upside down meatloaf
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Lightly grease a 5x9-inch loaf pan
3. On the bottom of the pan , press brown sugar , then spread the ketchup over the sugar
4. In a large mixing bowl , combine remaining ingredients
5. Make loaf out of mixture and place it carefully on top of the sugar / ketchup mixture
6. Bake for 45 minutes to 1 hour , or until juice runs clear

title: chocolate covered bourbon cherries
steps:
1. Pour bourbon over drained cherries
2. Cover , refrigerate and allow to set for 2 days
3. Combine butter , corn syrup and salt
4. Blend until smooth
5. Add confectioners sugar and mix well
6. Knead until smooth and shiny
7. Chill for 30 minutes wrapped in waxed paper
8. While chilling , drain cherries well on paper towels
9. Pat dry
10. Reserve bourbon marinade for a cake or other dish
11. Shape a marble-sized piece of fondant around each cherry
12. Place on waxed paper and chill at least 2 hours until firm
13. Melt chocolate in top of a double boiler over simmering water
14. Dip cherries in chocolate and set back on waxed papers
15. Allow trays to cool in refrigerator
16. Store in airtight containers
17. Candy will ripen well in about 2 days

title: 5 ingredient yummy layered mexican dip w  no beans
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 - don't nuke it !
2. Use large rectangular 11x14 glass baking dish / pyrex
3. Spread cream cheese on bottom of pan
4. Spread chili no beans on top of that
5. Spread green chilis on top of that
6. Spread green onions / scallions on top of that
7. You can add olives here if you wish
8. Spread cheese on top of that
9. You get the picture it's a layered dip
10. It's simple
11. Bake at 350 until bubbly around edges
12. Don't burn your mouth trying to eat it too soon
13. It's hot ! but not spicy -- and
14. Hand out recipe cards
15. Everyone will want it

title: gingersnap raspberry sandwich cookies
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375f
2. Line a baking sheet with parchment paper and set aside
3. Cream together butter , shortening and 1 cup sugar on medium speed
4. Sift together flour , soda , cinnamon and ginger
5. Set aside
6. Add maple syrup to butter mixture
7. Beat to combine
8. Beat in egg until well combined
9. Slowly add the flower mixture , a little at a time , until well blended
10. Place remaining cup of sugar in a bowl
11. Measure 2 tsp
12. Of dough
13. Roll into a ball
14. Roll dough in sugar and place on cookie sheet
15. Repeat , placing balls 3 inches apart
16. Bake until golden , about 12 minutes
17. Cool on a wire rack
18. Repeat with remaining cookie dough
19. Spread about 2 tsp
20. Jam over half of the cookies
21. Place a second cookie on top of jam covered ones , maing sandwiches

title: bourbon mashed sweet potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
2. Place the potatoes on a foil-lined baking sheet
3. Bake until tender and starting to ooze sugary syrup , about 1 hour and 15 minutes , depending on their size
4. Remove from the oven and let sit until cool enough to handle
5. Cut a slit down each potato and scoop the flesh into a large bowl
6. Discard the skins
7. Add the cream , bourbon , brown sugar , molasses , and salt and beat on high speed with an electric mixer until smooth
8. Cover to keep warm , or gently reheat before serving

title: chocolate nuggets
steps:
1. In a heavy medium saucepan over very low heat , combine chocolate chips and evaporated milk
2. Cook until chocolate melts completely
3. Remove from heat and stir in graham cracker crumbs , confectioners' sugar , 1 / 2 cup pecans and extract
4. Let stand 30 minutes
5. Form into one-inch balls and roll in remaining pecans
6. Refrigerate at least one hour or until well chilled

title: chicken   mushrooms  ww
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Place chicken in 6x10 baking dish
3. Sprinkle with onion flakes
4. In a small bowl , combine soy sauce , honey and garlic powder and pour mixture evenly over chicken
5. Cover and bake for 30 minutes
6. Spread green peppers and mushrooms evenly over chicken , and continue to bake , covered 20 or more minutes until mushrooms are tender

title: mixed berry banana smoothie
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together in blender
2. Enjoy

title: new york style pizza   calzone crust
steps:
1. In large bowl of mixer , dissolve the sugar in the water
2. Add oil and 2c of flour
3. Mix on medium , 2 minutes
4. Add salt and yeast , combine
5. Add remaining flour
6. Turn out onto lightly floured surface and knead 5 minutes
7. Divide into 2 equal balls , place in oiled bowls and cover with plastic wrap
8. Allow to rise for 1 1 / 2 hours in warm location
9. Place dough on a lightly floured surface and sprinkle flour over the top
10. Working from the edges to the center , press dough into a circle
11. Add sauce and ingredients , bake in a 500 degree oven for 20-25 minutes

title: garlic hasselback potatoes with herbed sour cream
steps:
1. Using a wooden spoon as a cradle , place each potato in the spoon and make several parallel slits into each potato top making sure not to slice completely through
2. Place 3 garlic slices between slits at the crown of each potato
3. Toss in a medium bowl with butter and olive oil
4. Place on a baking sheet and sprinkle generously with salt and pepper
5. Bake at 400 degrees until tops are crispy and potatoes are cooked through , about 1 hour
6. Transfer to a platter and top with herbed sour cream
7. Herbed sour cream
8. Combine 1 / 2 cup sour cream , 1 / 2 teaspoon garlic powder , 1 tablespoon finely chopped parsley leaves , salt and freshly ground black pepper in a small bowl
9. Refrigerate until use

title: delhi style lamb with potatoes
steps:
1. Fry onions , garlic , meat
2. Add tomatoes , cumin , coriander , turmeric , cayenne , salt
3. Cook on high for 10-15 mins until oil seems to separate
4. Add potatoes , lentils
5. Cook on low for 70 mins

title: bigfatmomma s slow cooked meat sauce
steps:
1. Saute tomato , mushrooms , garlic , onion in the butter , olive oil and molasses , until soft
2. Place this mixture into a crockpot
3. Brown the beef in a non-stick pan until no longer pink , and drain
4. Pour on top of onion mixture in crockpot
5. Pour tomato sauce into crockpot
6. Add spices , bay leaves and cheese , and stir to mix evenly
7. Slow-cook on low for 2-3 hours , stirring twice , or alternately , cook over very low heat on stovetop , stirring occasionally so that the cheese doesn't burn
8. Serve over thick pasta

title: spicy oriental chicken
steps:
1. Cut chicken into a 1-2 inch size and season with salt and pepper
2. Place the chicken in a bowl and evenly coat with flour
3. Slice green peppers and onion into strips
4. Combine sugar , soy sauce , chili paste and chicken stock or water in a small bowl
5. Heat a saute pan with olive oil
6. Place chicken and brown both sides
7. Add green pepper and onion strips , put a lid and cook until chicken is heated through and the onion and pepper strips become tender
8. Add the seasoning mixture and cook until heated through
9. Serve immediately

title: hearty beef and rice minestrone soup
steps:
1. Melt butter with oil in a 6-quart pot over medium heat
2. Add in beef cubes and cook stirring occasionally until the beef is browned remove to a bowl
3. Add in onions , red pepper flakes , jalapeno pepper carrots , celery , itaian seasoning and thyme , adding more oil and / or butter if needed
4. Saute for about 5 minutes adding in the garlic the last 2 minutes of cooking time
5. Add in the browned beef back to the pot along with the water , broth , worcestershire sauce , canned tomatoes with juice , potatoes and zucchini slices
6. Bring to a boil
7. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer covered for about 50 minutes , or until the veggies are crisp-tender
8. Season with salt and pepper to taste , then stir in the cooked rice and kidney beans
9. Cook until heated through
10. Ladle into bowls and top with grated parmesan cheese
11. Delicious !

title: quick and easy black bean nachos vegetarian
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 350
2. Put black beans , turkey chili chili and taco seasoning in small sauce pan
3. Heat until warm
4. Spread tortilla chips on cookie sheet
5. Spoon bean mixture over chips
6. Sprinkle with cheese
7. Bake until cheese is melted approixmately 10-15 minutes
8. Top with salsa and sour cream

title: taco shortcakes
steps:
1. Put the trimmed pork shoulder in a crock pot
2. Sprinkle with taco seasoning , and spoon the beans on top of pork and seasoning
3. Cover and cook on low for about 8 to 10 hours
4. Remove pork from the crock pot and place on a cutting board
5. Take 2 forks and shredded the pork
6. Return the shredded pork back into the crock pot and stir everything well
7. Stir in the velveeta cubes , and let it melt
8. To serve - split the corn muffins in half
9. Place the bottom of the muffin on a plate and put about 1 / 2 cup of the pork mixture on the muffin bottom
10. Top with a little bit of lettuce and tomato , and then replace the muffin top
11. Serve with the sour cream , and sprinkle with cilantro if you want

title: taco rice casserole
steps:
1. Brown beef , drain fat
2. Add taco seasoning and stewed tomatoes to beef
3. Put meat mixture into a casserole dish
4. Top meat mixture with rice
5. Sprinkle with shredded cheese and bake at 350 degrees until cheese is melted
6. Serve with sour cream and green olives

title: chicken with cashew nuts
steps:
1. Mix 2 tablespoons of the sherry , the egg white and cornflour together
2. Add the chicken and toss well until evenly coated
3. Heat the oil in a wok or frying pan , add the spring onions and stir-fry for 30 seconds
4. Add the chicken and cook for 3 minutes
5. Add the remaining ingredients and cook for 2 minutes
6. Pile into a warmed serving dish and serve immediately

title: beef   n  gravy on potatoes
steps:
1. Place potatoes and water in a microwave-safe dish
2. Cover and microwave on high for 8-10 minutes or until tender
3. Meanwhile , in a large skillet , cook beef over medium heat until no longer pink
4. Drain
5. Stir in garlic powder and onion powder
6. Prepare gravy according to package directions
7. Place the potatoes in a mixing bowl
8. Add milk , butter , salt and pepper
9. Beat on medium speed until smooth
10. Serve beef and gravy over mashed potatoes

title: easy crock pot teriyaki chicken
steps:
1. Wash and dry chicken
2. Place in slow cooker
3. Combine remaining ingredients
4. Pour over chicken
5. Cover
6. Cook on high 1 hours reduce heat to low , cook 6-7 hours

title: cranberry orange fudge
steps:
1. Combine cranberries and orange juice in a small microwave-safe bowl
2. Cover and microwave on high 2 minutes , stirring after 1 minute
3. Allow to stand covered 10 minutes
4. Coarsely chop cranberries
5. Line and 8" square baking pan with greased foil that extends over on two sides
6. Butter sides of a heavy large saucepan
7. Combine sugar , whipping cream and corn syrup
8. Stirring constantly , cook over medium-low heat until sugar dissolves
9. Using a pastry brush dipped in hot water , wash down any sugar crystals on the sides of the pan
10. Attach a candy thermometer to pan , make sure it does not touch the bottom of the pan
11. Increase heat to medium and bring mixture to a boil
12. Cook , without stirring , until mixture reaches soft ball stage
13. Test 1 / 2 tsp mixture in ice water
14. Place pan in 2" of cold water in the sink
15. Add butter and vanilla
16. Do not stir
17. Cool to approximately 110 degrees
18. Remove from sink
19. Using medium speed of and electric mixer , beat until fudge thickens and begins to lose its gloss
20. Stir in orange peel and cranberries
21. Pour into prepared pan
22. Cover and chill two hours
23. Cut into 1" pieces

title: the best basic hummus recipe
steps:
1. Rinse the chickpeas in cold water and
2. Add the tahini , crushed garlic , salt , lemon juice and seven tablespoons of the reserved liquid from the cans
3. Turn on the food processor and slowly pour in the oil while it runs
4. When the mixture is fully combined and smooth ,
5. Drizzle with some more extra virgin olive oil and decorate with a few whole chickpeas
6. Sprinkle with paprika and finely chopped coriander or parsley leaves , for colour

title: strawberry papaya passion
steps:
1. In blender , combine yogurt and milk
2. Add papaya , strawberries and honey
3. Add ice cubes
4. Cover and blend until nearly smooth

title: hominy salad
steps:
1. Rinse hominy and drain well
2. Chop green pepper , onion and celery
3. Toss hominy and veggies together
4. Stir in pickle relish , celery seed , salt cheese and mayonnaise
5. Chill and serve cold

title: pan grilled steak  biftek  la parrilla
steps:
1. Marinate the steaks in olive oil for at least 30 minutes
2. Drain off the oil leaving a light film of oil on the steaks and salt the steaks on both sides
3. Heat a well-seasoned cast-iron skillet over a high setting
4. When hot add the steaks and char on one side
5. Turn the heat down to medium and continue cooking for about 3 minutes for medium rare
6. Turn the steaks with tongs and turn up the heat to high
7. Be careful not to cut into the steaks while turning so that you don't lose any of the juices
8. Sear the second side of the steaks , then turn the heat to medium and cook for another 3 minutes to medium rare
9. Add 2 to 3 minutes per side for well-done steaks
10. Variations:
11. If using an electric oven broiler , char one side of the steaks on a high broil on a preheated broiler pan with the rack as close as possible to the broiler element
12. When browned , turn steaks with tongs and brown the other side
13. Total cooking time with this method is about 5 minutes per side for medium rare
14. Less time is required for gas broilers and outdoor charcoal barbecues
15. If using the latter , char meat directly on a rack over very hot coals on the hottest part of the barbecue , then move the meat to a cooler area of the rack over the drip pan leaving the barbecue lid open about one inch
16. Return the meat to the hotter area to char the second side and then move it back over the drip pan

title: pork tenderloin with creamy herb sauce
steps:
1. Heat oil in a skillet over medium heat
2. Cook carrots in oil for 5 minutes , stirring often
3. Add pork , and cook until lightly browned
4. Remove only pork , and keep warm
5. In the skillet , stir together flour , basil , parsley , pepper , and beef granules
6. Whisk in light cream , stirring until thick
7. Stir in wine
8. Return pork to pan , reduce heat to low , and cover
9. Simmer for 20 minutes , stirring occasionally

title: apple juice roast
steps:
1. Cook onions in 1 tbsp butter or shortening in dutch oven until tender-crisp
2. Set aside
3. Brown roast in remaining butter or shortening in dutch oven over medium heat 15 to 20 minutes or until browned on both sides
4. Pierce entire surface of meat with fork
5. Combine apple juice , catsup , salt , pepper , thyme , mustard and basil
6. Add to meat
7. Top meat with reserved cooked onions
8. Cover and cook slowly 2 1 / 2 hours or until almost tender
9. Brush sweet potatoes with lemon juice for bright color
10. Add to meat
11. Continue cooking , covere d , 30 to 40 minutes or until meat and potatoes are tender
12. Place meat and potatoes on warm platter
13. Sprinkle potatoes with chopped parsley or garnish with apple rings and parsley , if desired
14. Serve gravy over sliced meat
15. If dutch oven is cast iron , transfer to a glass dish
16. Gravy: skim excess fat from cooking liquid
17. Add water if needed to make 1 1 / 2 cups
18. Mix 1 / 2 cup water and 2 tbsp unbleached flour
19. Stir gradually into cooking liquid
20. Heat to boiling
21. Cook , stirring 3 to 5 minutes
22. Season with salt and pepper , if desired
23. Gravy may be served in large apple that has been scooped out , if desired

title: artichokes sauteed in herb infused butter
steps:
1. In a large skillet over medium high heat , add butter and oil
2. Saut onions , garlic , chile , and herbs , reduce heat , making sure garlic doesn't burn
3. Once oil is infused , place artichoke , heart side down , into oil
4. Saut for a few minutes , and then add enough water to steam them
5. Cover and reduce heat
6. Steam artichokes gently for up to 2 hours , or until flesh removes from leaves easily
7. More water will need to be added to the pan periodically
8. Serve with lemon-garlic-butter for dipping

title: cream cheese and crab spread
steps:
1. In mixer , beat until creamy: cheese , reserved liquid , onion , lemon juice , salt and hot pepper sauce
2. Stir in crab meat
3. Turn into shallow greased baking dish
4. Sprinkle with almonds
5. Bake uncovered in preheated 350 f oven 20 to 30 minutes or until bubbly
6. Serve hot as a spread on bread rounds or crackers

title: crunchy parsnip ribbons
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 200 c
2. Use a vegetable peeler to cut parsnips into long strips
3. Place on lined baking tray
4. Toss with butter , sugar and salt
5. Roast for 10 minutes and toss
6. Roast for another 8 - 10 minutes or till golden and crispy

title: chicken and watercress soup
steps:
1. Marinate chicken with salt , cornflour and rice wine , pepper and sesame oil
2. Bring chicken stock to boil in a saucepan
3. Add in the mushrooms and cook for 2 minutes
4. Add in the chicken and stir to separate the chicken slices
5. When soup starts to boil , add in the watercress and stir
6. Cook for 1-2 minutes
7. Remove and serve in a soup bowl

title: a   p spanish bar cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit
2. Blend apple pie filling , eggs , apple pie spice and cloves until smooth
3. Place in large bowl
4. Add cake mix
5. Beat for 4 minutes
6. Stir in nuts and raisins
7. Pour into a 13 x 9 pan that has been greased and floured or sprayed with baker's joy
8. Bake for 55 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out dry
9. Cool on rack
10. Frost when cool using either of the above recipes
11. Or dust with confectioners sugar
12. Frosting: for either method: combine all ingredients
13. Beat until creamy and spreadable consistency

title: freezer strawberry daiquiri
steps:
1. Mash your strawberries using your hand , a masher , a blender stick , etc
2. - to your desired consistency
3. Combine everything in an airtight container
4. Place in freezer until firm
5. Break up / stir frozen concoction and serve as needed !
6. Sometimes adding a bit more lemon-lime soda to your glass makes it just the right consistency

title: roasted spring carrots with cumin and lime
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 425 degrees
2. Combine all of the ingredients in a large ovenproof skillet and add 2 tablespoons of water
3. Bring to a boil
4. Transfer the pan to the oven and roast , tossing halfway through until the carrots are tender and glazed , about 15 minutes
5. Serve

title: vegetarian manicotti
steps:
1. Cook and drain manicotti shells
2. Make tomato sauce with last 10 ingredients
3. First , saut garlic and onion in large skillet 2-3 minutes
4. Then add tomatoes and other ingredients-bring to a boil
5. Reduce heat and simmer , covered , 20 minutes
6. Remove bay leaf
7. Mix ricotta , 3 / 4 cup parmesan cheese , eggs , 1 / 4 cup parsley , 2 cloves garlic , salt and pepper
8. Stuff shells with mixture and arrange in baking dish
9. Spoon tomato sauce over shells
10. Bake at 350f for 20-25 minutes , covered in tinfoil
11. Add 1 / 4 cup parmesan cheese and parsley
12. Remove tinfoil and cook for five minutes more

title: welsh rabbit  rarebit    sort of toasted cheese
steps:
1. Melt the butter or margarine in the top of a double boiler over boiling water
2. Add the milk or beer
3. When this is warm , add the grated cheese
4. With a fork , stir lightly but constantly until the cheese is melted
5. Season with worcestershire sauce , mustard , salt and cayenne
6. Remove the saucepan from the heat , and stir in the lightly beaten egg , which will cook in a few seconds
7. Pour the mixture over the hot toast
8. Sprinkle with a little paprika if liked , and serve immediately

title: easy oven baked ribs
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 250 f
2. Season all sides of the ribs with your favorite rub
3. Using a 13x9x2 baking dish , place the ribs into the pan , do not over crowd
4. If using baby back slabs , place bone side facing up
5. If using individual country style , lay on their side
6. Cover the baking dish with foil and place on center rack of pre-heated oven
7. Bake for approximately 2 1 / 2 - 3 hours
8. Remove the ribs from oven and drain any grease from dish
9. Reserving the foil for later use
10. Flip the ribs over and slather with your favorite bbq sauce and return the dish to the oven for an additional 30 minutes
11. Once done , remove the ribs to a platter , loosely tent the platter with the reserved foil , and allow to rest for 10 minutes
12. Enjoy !

title: chocolate raspberry truffle cake
steps:
1. Puree raspberries in a food processor
2. Press raspberry mixture through a wire mesh sieve , using the back of a spoon to squeeze out the juice
3. Discard seeds
4. Bring juice and the 1-2 t sugar to a boil over high heat , then cook over medium heat , stirring often until the mixture is reduced to 1 / 2 cup
5. Remove from heat and cool completely
6. Butter an eight inch cake pan and line bottom with parchment or waxed paper
7. Heat the 1 / 3 cup sugar and the chambord in a saucepan over medium heat until sugar dissolves , stirring occasionally
8. Add butter and continue heating and stirring until butter melts
9. Remove from heat and add chocolate , stir until smooth and cool
10. Whisk together the raspberry reduction , eggs , flour , and almond extract in a large bowl
11. Add chocolate mixture and beat at medium speed with an electric mixer until well blended
12. Pour into prepared cake pan
13. Place cake pan into a larger pan and add hot water to a depth of one inch
14. Bake at 325f for 42 to 45 minutes
15. Cake will have risen and not be completely "set"
16. Remove from water bath and cool cake completely on a wire rack
17. Cake will "collapse" as it cools down
18. Run a thin knife around pan to loosen cake
19. Invert cake onto a plate , remove the parchment or waxed paper , and invert again onto a serving plate
20. To serve , cut cake into small wedges and place on plates that have been drizzled with the chocolate syrup
21. Garnish with whipped cream and a few fresh raspberries and serve
22. If desired , cake can be made a day ahead of time
23. Cover and chill in refrigerator then let stand at room temperature for at least one hour before serving

title: hot mulled cider
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in saucepan
2. Bring to a boil , stirring constantly
3. Reduce heat
4. Simmer 10 minutes
5. Remove cinnamon sticks and cloves
6. Serve at once , garnishing with cinnamon sticks , if desired

title: hillbilly chili
steps:
1. Cook ground beef until brown in a skillet
2. While beef is cooking sweat the onion , garlic , and green bell pepper in the pot you plan to make the chili inches
3. Drain ground beef
4. Add beef into the pan with the garlic , onion , and green bell pepper
5. Stir until combined
6. Season the mixture with the salt and pepper
7. Cook mixture for 2 minutes
8. Add the tomato sauce , chili beans , diced tomatoes , and tomato juice into the pot
9. Stir until combined
10. Add the bay leaf , chili powder , tabasco , paprika , and worcestershire sauce
11. Stir until combined
12. Simmer for one hour , stirring the chili every 15 minutes
13. At the end of the hour taste the chili , add more salt and pepper to taste
14. Serve with cheese and sour cream

title: pasta salad con salami
steps:
1. Cook pasta
2. Meanwhile , whisk together oils , vinegar , garlic and pepper
3. Reserve
4. Drain pasta and immediately toss with dressing
5. When cool , add salami , peppers , olives , onion , cheeses and parsley
6. Toss until all ingredients are coated well
7. Serve at room temperature

title: low sodium red chili sauce
steps:
1. In a suitable sized saucepan , whisk together all the ingredients until thoroughly blended and smooth
2. Taste , and adjust seasonings to taste
3. Cook over low heat , stirring frequently , for 25 minutes or until desired consistency is reached
4. Refrigerate unused portion in airtight covered containers

title: sarasota s so called crockpot beer bratwurst   veggies
steps:
1. Chop -- simply cut the brats in 3 pieces each on a angle
2. Carrots , peel , again chop on a angle in about 2" pieces
3. Onion , i use 2 large onions , rough chopped
4. Potatoes , small ones i leave whole , if they are large i will cut in half
5. Not too small or they get mushy
6. Crockpot -- brats on the bottom with the carrots , then onions and topped with potatoes
7. Top all that with the sauerkraut
8. Sauce -- in a small bowl or measuring cup , add the butter and melt in the microwave for 10 seconds , remove and then add in the beer , mustard , bay leaf , 1 teaspoon black pepper and garlic
9. Pour over the brats and vegetables
