10. Lay 3 springs of thyme right on top of the sauerkraut
11. Cook -- crockpot - low 6-8 hours
12. My crock pot takes 7 hours , but every crockpot is different
13. You just want the potatoes and carrots to be tender
14. The brats will easily be done
15. Right at the end of cooking , check for seasoning
16. No salt was added , but the sauerkraut even though it was rinsed can be salty , so go easy
17. Besides you are serving a sauce with this dish which also has seasoning
18. Sauce -- this is a great compliment to this dish
19. You can always just serve it with some mustard , but i love this sauce served on each persons plate in a small side bowl for dipping or for pouring over the vegetables
20. It is similar to the consistency of gravy
21. Remove the cooking liquid to let it cool slightly before you add it to the sour cream so it does not break the sour cream
22. It will cool in just a few minutes
23. In a small bowl add the sour cream , horseradish , mustard , salt and pepper
24. It is a nice creamy spicy sauce to serve with the brats and vegetables
25. My mom always adds more mustard to her portion , so just go by taste
26. I happen to love my horseradish sauce , so -- each person is unique in their own taste

title: thai spicy beef
steps:
1. Heat oil in wok or large frying pan
2. Add vegetables and stir-fry until crisp tender
3. Remove and keep warm
4. Add garlic and curry paste and stirfry for 45 seconds
5. Immediately add coconut milk and lime zest
6. Stir-cook for 1-2 minutes until it's bubbling and thick
7. Add beef
8. Stir-fry for 1 minute
9. Add fish sauce and sugar and stir-fry for 2-3 minutes
10. Return veges to pan
11. Add 3 / 4 of basil leaves
12. Stir-fry just until veges are hot
13. Transfer to serving dish and garnish with remaining basil
14. Serve immediately accompanied by steamed rice

title: easy ham  cheese  egg quiche
steps:
1. Thoroughly mix ingredients together
2. Grease a 10" pie plate with butter
3. Pour in the mixture
4. Bake for 40-45 minute at 350f
5. Let quiche stand about 5 minutes before cutting

title: val s cranberry salsa
steps:
1. Add first 4 ingredients above together in food processor
2. Pulse well to combine
3. Add sugar and lemon juice , and pulse until combined
4. Pour over cream cheese and serve !

title: sindhi hara murgh   chicken in green curry homemade sindhi style
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a pan
2. Fry the paste for 5 minutes , stirring continuously
3. Add the powdered spices , salt and tomatoes
4. Fry till the oil bubbles to the top
5. Add the chicken and cook on low heat till the chicken is tender , usually takes about 20-30 minutes
6. Serve hot

title: baked shrimp appetizers
steps:
1. Wash mushrooms
2. Chop stems
3. Set aside 16 shrimp
4. Chop remaining shrimp
5. Combine chopped shrimp , chopped mushrooms , crumbs , egg , milk , lemon juice , onion and salt
6. Spoon into mushroom caps
7. Top with whole shrimp and brush each appetizer with melted butter
8. Bake at 375 degrees for 15 minutes until tender

title: roasted jalapeno and cheese cornbread
steps:
1. Prepare peppers: over grill or under broiler , roast peppers until skin is charred , transfer to covered bowl and let cool
2. Peel , seed and chop finely
3. Set aside
4. In 425 degree oven , heat 8 or 9 inch cast-iron skillet while you prepare the batter
5. Batter: in saucepan , bring milk to boil , stir in prepared peppers
6. Remove from heat and let stand until at room temperature , beat in egg and melted butter
7. In a large bowl , whisk together cornmeal , flours , sugar , baking powder , cumin and salt
8. Stir in milk / pepper mixture until just blended
9. Fold in cheese
10. Remove heated skillet from oven and grease with a little oil , scrape in batter , smooth top
11. Return to oven and bake until golden brown on top and bottom , approximately 25 minutes
12. Let cool in skillet for 10 minutes , with offset spatula , loosen bottom of bread and remove from skillet
13. Serve warm
14. Enjoy !

title: yummiest chewy coconut cranberry bars
steps:
1. Base:
2. Preheat oven
3. Mix flour , coconut , sugar , soda and salt
4. Add butter and molasses and mix until crumbly
5. Press mixture into greased 9x13 pan
6. Bake at 350 degrees f for 10 minutes
7. Topping:
8. Stir sugar , molasses and almond extract into beaten eggs
9. Mix together flour , baking powder and salt and stir into egg mixture
10. Add coconut and cranberries and mix
11. Pour over crust , spreading evenly
12. Sprinkle with almonds
13. Bake at 350 f for 25 minutes or until medium brown
14. Cool and ice with lemon frosting
15. Lemon frosting: whisk 1 cup powdered sugar with 3 tsp of lemon or lime juice
16. Add a bit of milk or more juice to achieve the taste and consistency you prefer
17. Thanks for trying it
18. Glad you liked the taste

title: teriyaki vinaigrette or marinade
steps:
1. Whisk together all ingredients
2. Serve over salad or use as a marinade or stir fry sauce

title: chicken taco rice
steps:
1. In a large skillet , cook and stir chicken in hot oil until lightly browned
2. Add water , tomato sauce and seasoning mix
3. Bring to a boil
4. Reduce heat , cover and simmer 5 minutes
5. Add corn and red bell pepper
6. Bring to a boil
7. Stir in rice
8. Cover
9. Remove from heat
10. Let stand 5 minutes
11. Fluff rice with a fork
12. Sprinkle top with cheese
13. Serve with tortilla chips or hot floured tortillas , if desired

title: stuffed cabbage rolls  kaldolmar
steps:
1. Remove core from cabbage
2. Cover cabbage with cold water
3. Let stand about 10 minutes
4. Remove 12 cabbage leaves
5. Cover leaves with boiling water
6. Cover and let stand until leaves are limp , about 10 minutes
7. Drain
8. Mix beef , rice , milk , onion , egg , salt , pepper and allspice
9. Place about 1 / 2 cup beef mixture at stem end of each leaf
10. Roll leaf around beef mixture , tucking in sides
11. Place cabbage rolls , seam sides down , in ungreased 13 x 9-inch baking dish
12. Pour water over rolls
13. Cover and bake at 350 degrees f until beef is done , about 1 hour
14. Remove cabbage rolls with slotted spoon
15. Keep warm
16. Drain liquid from baking dish , reserving 1 / 2 cup liquid
17. Skim fat
18. Gradually stir half-and-half into flour in saucepan until smooth
19. Stir in reserved liquid and bouillon
20. Heat to boiling , stirring constantly
21. Boil and stir 1 minute
22. Serve sauce with cabbage rolls

title: chicken fruit low calorie fat free diet poultry
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Lightly grease baking pan and set aside
3. Place chicken breasts between sheets of plastic wrap and pound with meat mallet to 1 / 4-inch thickness
4. Set aside
5. Place apples , raisins , nuts , onion , and sage in bowl and stir to combine
6. Place 1 tablespoon apple mixture in center of each breast and roll up , enclosing filling completely
7. Secure with wooden toothpicks and place , seam-side-down , in single layer in prepared pan
8. Brush with melted butter and set aside
9. To make glaze , melt some lowfat margarine or butter in small saucepan and stir in apple jelly , orange juice , and sherry
10. Simmer 3 minutes until jelly is completely melted
11. Bake chicken in preheated oven , basting frequently with glaze , 30-45 minutes or until no longer pink inside
12. Remove toothpicks before serving

title: mexicali spaghetti bake
steps:
1. While making sauce , cook spaghetti or noodles
2. Drain well
3. Brown beef until partly done
4. Add onion , pepper and garlic
5. When beef is brown , add spagetti , tomatoes , corn , salt , pepper , chili powder , worcestershire sauce and olives
6. Bake 1 hr covered at 325f

title: almond blueberry cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. In a medium bowl , combine flour , baking powder and salt
3. In another medium bowl , cream together the butter and sugar using a hand mixer
4. Add egg andbeat to incorporate
5. Add milk , almond extract , and lemon zest
6. Stir the dry ingredients into the wet ingredients
7. Fold in the almonds , then the blueberries
8. Chill dough in the refrigerator for about 30 minutes
9. Using two small spoons , dollop dough onto cookies sheets
10. Bake until golden brown around the edges , about 15 minutes
11. Cool on a wire rack
12. Save in sealed storage container

title: north end tuna salad
steps:
1. Flake tuna into a small bow
2. Add remaining ingredients and mix

title: effie pearl s pie crust
steps:
1. Stir together the flour , salt and sugar in a large mixing bowl
2. Add lard and cut into the flour with a pastry blender until the lard is completely incorporated into the dry mixture and it becomes pebbly
3. Add the water and egg mixture and stir until a dough forms , making sure to incorporate all the flour / lard mixture in the bottom of the bowl
4. Gather into a large ball , roll into a long log and cut into 4 or 5 pieces , depending upon size of pie plate
5. Flatten each piece into a disc about 8 inches in diameter
6. Wrap each disc tightly in wax paper , then put into freezer bag
7. To use , remove and let thaw in the fridge
8. Crusts should be cold when rolled out

title: cajun pork chops and rice
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Brown the pork chops , onion , bell pepper , and garlic together in small amount of oil in heavy skillet
3. When chops are browned and vegetables are tender , place in a casserole dish with cajun seasoning , rice , broth , and worcestershire sauce
4. Bake covered about 20 minutes or until rice is done and chops are tender

title: malaysian coconut milk rice  nasi lemak
steps:
1. In medium saucepan , combine everything
2. Add enough water to cover with liquid--about 1 / 4 cup
3. Bring to a boil over med-high heat
4. Turn heat to low and cover
5. Cook for 15 minutes or until all liquid is absorbed and rice is tender
6. Serve or keep warm over very , very low heat for up to 15 minutes
7. To serve , pile rice in center of plate
8. Flank iedges with hard-cooked , boiled eggs , sliced cucumber , fried peanuts , sambal oelek
9. Fried peanuts: put at least 1 inch of oil in deep saucepan
10. Over med-high heat , heat to 300 degrees
11. Don't overheat it
12. Add raw , shelled , skin-on peanuts
13. Cook , stirring occasionally , until they are a rich golden brown , about 5 minutes
14. Remove with a slotted spoon and spinkle with salt

title: shirataki noodles with sun dried tomatoes
steps:
1. Re-hydrate sun-dried tomatoes
2. Rinse and drain tofu noodles
3. Microwave tofu noodles for one minute and drain again
4. Toss noodles with oil
5. Add chopped sun-dried tomatoes , olives and basil and toss until distributed
6. Warm noodles in microwave until temperature is desired
7. Top with fresh parm and enjoy !

title: elibet  ethiopian hummus
steps:
1. Rinse the sunflower seeds with cold water
2. In a cooking pot , cover it in cold water
3. Boil for 15 minutes or until soft
4. Strain in colander , discard the liquid
5. Place the sunflower seeds in a food processor , add 5 cups of cold water
6. Grind and mash until all the seeds are crushed
7. Strain and pour the sunflower juice into a cooking pot
8. Rinse and put the broad beans in the sunflower juice
9. Cook it for 30 minutes or until it is very soft
10. Place the cooked beans in a blender or food processor
11. Add garlic , oil , salt , lemon , 1 cup or more of the boiled sunflower liquid , and two cube ice
12. Blend it for 4-5 minutes until thoroughly mixed and smooth
13. Place the elibet in a container or serving bowl
14. Serving it immediately with injera , pita bread or any bread of your choice
15. Keep the rest in fridge
16. If broad beans are unavailable , you may use chickpeas

title: zero oil channa  chick peas  masala
steps:
1. Soak kabuli channa overnight
2. Boil the channa over slow heat in a covered pot with lots of water and salt
3. Keep checking the level of water often
4. Boil till channa is soft and can be broken by pressing between fingers
5. This can take several hours
6. Time can be reduced by adding baking soda
7. Mix all spices together in a bowl
8. Once the channa is boiled and done add the spice mixture and bring it to a boil
9. Do not leave much water
10. Garnish with chopped coriander
11. Clove powder can make it spicy and hot
12. If you do not like it spicy avoid clove powder
13. If you want to make it tangy increase the quantity of dry mango powder or add a little tamaring juice

title: potato  ham   cheese bake
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375f
2. Melt butter in 10 inch , oven safe , skillet over medium heat and then add hash browns
3. Sprinkle potatoes with seasoned salt and stir to blend and continuing heating the potatoes for 5 minutes
4. Take off heat and press potatoes onto bottom and up sides of the pan
5. Combine half & half , eggs and pepper in medium bowl
6. Beat until well mixed
7. Stir in ham , 2 tablespoons green onions and bell pepper
8. Sprinkle half of cheese over potatoes
9. Pour egg mixture over cheese
10. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean
11. Top with remaining cheese and green onions
12. Let stand 10 minutes before serving

title: greek style summer squash
steps:
1. Prepare a large cast-iron skillet with non-stick cooking spray
2. Put skillet on very low-heat burner
3. Add the oil and garlic
4. Then add the squash
5. Sprinkle the chopped tomatoes over the squash
6. Cook , uncovered , for 10 minutes
7. Cover and cook 30 minutes
8. Make sure the heat is low enough to not cause burning
9. Do not be alarmed if one side of the squash is browned , that is good and how it should be
10. Uncover and stir carefully
11. Increase the heat , stir gently occasionally , until the liquid is evaporated and the squash is the consistency of a chunky puree
12. Remove from heat
13. Season with salt , pepper , and cayenne to taste
14. Add in the dill and stir
15. Serve immediately

title: latin marinade
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a jar and shake well
2. Makes enough to marinate 2-3 lbs of beef , pork or chicken

title: beer and orange marinated tuna steaks
steps:
1. Mix all the ingredients except the tuna in a medium size bowl or in a gallon size ziplock bag
2. Marinade your tuna right in the ziplock bag , or pour over tuna in a marinader or bowl or pan and refrigerate for 30 minutes turning occasionally
3. Prepare grill for direct cooking over medium-high heat
4. Lightly oil grill
5. Remove tuna from marinade and discard the rest
6. Grill tuna 3 minutes per side or until nicely marked and pink in the center
7. Enjoy !

title: coke to float your boat
steps:
1. Place 2 scoops of ice-cream in bottom of two tall glasses
2. Fill up with coke / sprite
3. Pop in 2 straws and a long spoon and drink up

title: scalloped sweet potatoes
steps:
1. Place 2 cups cream in a pot to warm
2. Add nutmeg
3. Butter a gratin or casserole dish
4. Layer sliced potatoes and cheese in casserole
5. Salt and pepper each layer and finish with cheese on top
6. Pour warm cream over top and place casserole on a baking sheet to protect oven from possible over bubbling
7. Bake 30-35 minutes in 350 degree oven

title: chicken and dumpling casserole
steps:
1. Lightly grease 13x9x2 baking dish
2. In a large kettle melt butter and saute onions , celery , garlic until tender
3. Add flour , sugar , salt , basil , pepper and chicken broth
4. Bring to a boil
5. Boil a minute then add chicken and frozen peas
6. Pour into previously prepared pan
7. For dumplings combine biscuit mix , basil and 2 / 3 cup milk stir until moistened and use fork to drop dumplings onto casserole bake uncovered at 350 for 30 min
8. Cover and bake 10 min more or until dumplings are done

title: grandma s cauliflower
steps:
1. Cut up cauliflower and cook until it is tender but still has a bite
2. Then drain very well and set aside
3. Fry bacon until crisp but not burnt , crumble and put into heated pan
4. Add sugar and mayonnaise and stir until the mixture turns smooth and nearly translucent
5. Add cauliflower to pan and gently mix until cauliflower is coated in mixture
6. Serve hot

title: honey garlic carrots
steps:
1. Peel and slice carrots , i do a two lb
2. Bag
3. Place in saucepan with water and cook just till crisp
4. Drain
5. Meanwhile in small saucepan over med
6. Heat , melt margarine and add the brown sugar , stirring to dissolve
7. Peel garlic and put through garlicpress into saucepan with sugar mixture
8. Stir in soy sauce and grated ginger and allow to simmer 5 minutes stirring to meld the flavours
9. Place carrots in serving bowl and pour sauce over top
10. Stir to combine and enjoy

title: libby s pumpkin cranberry bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Grease and flour two 9 x 5 inch loaf pans
3. Combine flour , pumpkin pie spice , baking soda and salt in large bowl
4. Combine sugar , pumpkin , eggs , vegetable oil and orange juice in large mixer bowl
5. Beat until just blended
6. Add pumpkin mixture to flour mixture
7. Stir just until moistened
8. Fold in cranberries
9. Spoon batter into prepared loaf pans
10. Bake for 60 to 65 minutes or until wooden pic inserted in center comes out clean
11. Cool in pans on wire racks for 10 minutes
12. Remove to wire racks to cool completely

title: tilapia corn chowder
steps:
1. Chop bacon and cook in a large dutch oven over medium heat until crispy , 3 to 4 minutes
2. Drain on paper towels
3. Add oil & cooking spray to the pan
4. Add celery , leek , onion , mushrooms , salt , black pepper , pinch of crushed red pepper flakes and cook until the vegetables just begin to soften , about 2 minutes
5. Add broth , potatoes and corn
6. Bring to a gentle simmer
7. Cook until the potatoes are just tender and the corn is cooked through , about 8 minutes
8. Stir in tilapia and thyme
9. Return to a gentle simmer
10. Cook until the tilapia is cooked through , about 4 minutes more
11. Remove from the heat
12. Stir in half-and-half , lemon juice and the reserved bacon
13. Garnish with chives , if using

title: empanadas de pollo  chicken empanadas
steps:
1. Place the chicken breasts and bouillon cube in a sauce pan
2. Cover with water and bring to a boil
3. Simmer the chicken for 45 minutes to an hour until tender enough to shred
4. While the chicken is cooking , heat the oil in a saute pan , add the onions
5. Saute for 5 minutes on medium heat or until onions are soft and translucent
6. Add in the tomatoes and cook until mushy about 10 minutes
7. Add in the garlic and cook for 1 minute
8. Then using a bean or potato masher mash the tomatoes until they are broken up
9. Add the oregnao , salt to taste
10. Then turn the heat off of the tomatoes and set them aside
11. Pull the meat out of the sauce pan and set aside to cool
12. In a large bowl combine the fresh masa , corn flour and white flour
13. Once all is combined add cup water at a time until dough is easy to knead and slightly sticky
14. I usually add around to 1 / 3 cups water
15. Add in the salt and knead the dough for 2 minutes to make sure the salt is incorporated
16. Shape the dough into egg size balls and flatten slightly into discs
17. Shred the chicken into thin shreds and add it to the tomato mixture
18. Stir and set aside
19. Press each disc in a tortilla press or between two sheets of plastic until it is flat and around inch thick
20. As you press each empanada fill with approx 1 tbsp of the chicken mixture on one side , then fold the other side over and press the edges together
21. Then peel away the plastic and drop the empanada in oil for frying
22. I serve these with salsa , chile de arbol , sour cream and shredded lettuce
23. Enjoy !

title: asian ginger sauce for fish
steps:
1. In a small bowl , mix together the first seven ingredients
2. Add the chillies , if using
3. Preheat the oven to 205c / 400f
4. Place the fish fillets in a baking dish
5. Drizzle the marinade over the fish
6. Bake for 10-12 minutes or until the fish flakes easily with a fork
7. Plate the fish and spoon the sauce over it
8. Serve with rice

title: vegan creme brulee
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 325f
2. Drain and slightly press the tofu while you prepare the remaining ingredients and tools
3. Prepare 6 ramekins and a shallow brownie baking pan , cutting a piece of parchment to evenly cover the pan
4. Boil a kettle full of water
5. In the bowl of a food processor , combine the tofu , sugar , vanilla , soy milk and salt
6. Once smooth , whisk in the arrowroot with the motor running
7. Pour prepared custard into the ramekins and distribute them into the baking pan
8. Carefully pour the boiling water from the kettle into the bottom of the pan so the water comes 2 / 3 of the way up the sides of the ramekins
9. Taking care not to splash water into the custard
10. Cover the pan with the parchment paper and slowly transfer everything into the oven
11. Bake for about 45-50 minutes or until set
12. The centers may have a slight jiggle , but well set more as they cool
13. Remove the ramekins from the water and transfer to the refrigerator to cool completely , about an hour
14. To brle the custards , sprinkle enough sugar to evenly coat each top
15. Using a hand held blowtorch , pass the
16. Once finished , the caramel should be thin , crisp and crackly
17. Bon appetit !

title: hot  sweet and sticky chicken drumettes
steps:
1. In large bowl stir preserves , garlic sauce , brown sugar , vinegar , minced rosemary and mustard
2. Add the drumettes and toss well to coat
3. Cover and marinate in the fridge stirring occasionally for 1 hour
4. Grill turning often basting and cooking a total of about 30 minutes
5. Dont bast at the last 10 minutes of cooking

title: whole wheat cocoa candy cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees
2. Combine the first 3 ingredients in one bowl
3. In a second bowl , mix the last 5 ingredients
4. Slowly incorporate the dry ingredients from the first bowl into the second
5. Add candies
6. Roll dough into 1 1 / 2 - 2 inch balls
7. Bake on a greased cookie sheet for 18 minutes

title: coffee cream  kaffeecreme
steps:
1. In a medium pan bring coffee , cream or milk , and sugar to a boil
2. In a small bowl add corn starch and dissolve in water
3. Constantly stirring , add cornstarch to coffee mixture and cook for 3 minutes
4. Remove from heat
5. Beat egg yolk and stir into coffee mixture , bring to a boil
6. Remove from heat
7. Fold in beaten egg white and pour into glass serving bowl
8. Chill thoroughly in refrigerator and decoreate with whipped cream before serving

title: macaroni   hot italian sausage
steps:
1. Spray a skillet with oil , heat
2. Add sausage , cook until crumbly , break it up as you are cooking the sausage , pour off excess fat
3. Add mushrooms and onion , cook until tender
4. Turn sausage , mushrooms and onion into an oven proof dish
5. Pour sherry into the skillet and bring to a boil , stirring constantly to scrape up the brown bits
6. Pour sherry over the sausage mixture
7. Stir in the tomato sauce , beef consomm , water and pasta
8. Bake in 375f oven for 1 hour or until pasta is tender
9. Stir in sour cream
10. Sprinkle with parmesan and parsley
11. Serve

title: venison teriyaki
steps:
1. Soak wooden skewers in warm water for 20 minutes
2. Cut cubed venison in 2-inch wide strips
3. Place in sealable plastic bag
4. In large bowl mix all marinade ingredients and pour over venison
5. Push air out of bag when sealing
6. Marinade for 3 hours or overnight , but not more than 24 hours
7. Mix glaze ingredients together
8. This can be saved unrefrigerated for several months
9. Preheat outdoor grill to high
10. Remove venison from marinade , reserving marinade in cup for basting
11. Thread venison on skewers
12. Grill close to heat source for 2 minutes , basting twice
13. Turn , baste again , and grill 1 more minute
14. Cooking time will vary with different grills , but do not overcook as the meat will dry out
15. Remove skewers from grill and place on platter
16. Immediately brush with glaze
17. Serve

title: scrambled eggs with avocado and cheese
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl , whisk the eggs , water , salt , and pepper
2. Let the butter melt in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat
3. Tilt pan around to coat the bottom of the skillet with melted butter
4. When butter foams , pour in egg mixture all at once
5. Let stand for 20 seconds
6. Cook , stirring , until light and fluffy but not too dry
7. Add in cheese and avocado
8. Stir until blended and cheese is melted
9. Garnish with parsley
10. Serve hot

title: creamy butterscotch pudding recipe from toh
steps:
1. In a small saucepan , combine the brown sugar , cornstarch and salt
2. Add milk and egg yolks
3. Stir until smooth
4. Cook and stir over medium heat until mixture comes to a boil
5. Cook and stir 1-2 minutes longer or until thickened
6. Remove from the heat
7. Stir in butter and vanilla
8. Cool to room temperature , stirring several times
9. Pour into four individual dessert dishes
10. Cover and refrigerate for 1-2 hours or until chilled

title: pea nut raisin sandwich
steps:
1. Put bread in toaster , toast to preference
2. Meanwhile , put first five ingredient on a plate together and microwave for about 20 seconds on high
3. Remove from microwave and squish it all together with a fork , crushing the chickpeas and peas
4. When the toast is done , spread the peanut butter on one side , cover with the pea mixture , the cinnamon and the raisins
5. Cut in half , put the other half ontop , squish down and eat

title: catfish pilaf
steps:
1. Put catfish fillets into a lightly greased oblong baking dish
2. Drizzle with melted butter and lemon juice
3. Bake at 350 for 20-25 minutes or until fish flakes easily
4. Drain fish , place in a bowl and flake with a fork
5. Cook bacon in a skillet
6. Transfer to paper-towel lined plate to drain
7. Crumble and set aside
8. Reserve 2 tablespoons bacon drippings in skillet
9. Add green pepper and onion to bacon drippings
10. Cook , stirring constantly , until tender
11. Add in bacon , tomatoes , water , rice , pimentos , and salt and pepper
12. Bring to a boil
13. Cover , lower heat , and simmer 25 minutes or until most of the liquid has been absorbed
14. Add catfish
15. Stir to combine
16. Cover and let stand 5-10 minutes
17. Serve

title: strawberry crisps
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 110c / 225f
2. Slice the strawberries very thinly
3. Blot any excess juices with kitchen paper and lay on a baking tray lined with parchment paper
4. Dry the slices in the oven for 1 hour until almost dry , turn over , then continue to dry out in the oven until crisp but not golden
5. Turn off the oven and leave to cool
6. If you are not using the crisps straight away , store them in an airtight container

title: charleston shrimp supreme
steps:
1. Cream butter and flour
2. Add milk and make a thick cream sauce
3. Add remaining ingredients except shrimp
4. Salt and pepper to taste
5. Add cooked shrimp and heat until very hot
6. Serve with rice

title: sausage and apple pie in a cheddar crust
steps:
1. Used a combination of granny smiths and cortlands
2. If you use all granny smiths or all cortlands , adjust the amount of sugar to your taste
3. Crust:
4. In a medium-size mixing bowl , whisk together the flour and salt
5. Using an electric mixer , a pastry blender or fork , or your fingers , cut and mix the cheese and butter into the flour mixture until the fat and flour form a crumbly mixture
6. Add the lemon juice or vinegar , then sprinkle on just enough water so that you can gather the dough into a cohesive ball
7. Divide the dough in half , and flatten each half into a 1-inch thick round
8. Wrap one of the rounds in plastic wrap or waxed paper , and refrigerate it while you work with the other
9. Transfer the remaining dough to a well-floured work surface
10. Roll it into a 12-inch circle , using as few strokes of the rolling pin as possible
11. The fewer times you touch the crust at this point , the more tender it'll be when it's baked
12. Transfer the circle of dough to a 9-inch pie plate , and gently fit it to the pan's contours
13. Again , if you push and stretch the dough too much during this stage , it'll shrink when you put it in the oven
14. Filling:
15. Peel , core and slice the apples
16. In a large , shallow frying pan , cook the apples with the salt , cinnamon , cider or juice , and sugar for 15 minutes , or until the apples are tender and the liquid is syrupy
17. Add the cooked sausage
18. Spray the crust with some nonstick vegetable oil spray , then spoon the filling into the crust
19. Roll out the remaining crust , and center it over the filling
20. Press the edges of the top and bottom crust together , fold them under , and crimp
21. Bake:
22. The pie in a preheated 425f oven for 15 minutes , then lower the heat to 375f and bake for an additional 35 to 45 minutes , till the crust is very brown
23. Remove the pie from the oven , and serve it warm or at room temperature

title: mascarpone cheese sauce  for chicken breasts or fish
steps:
1. Melt butter in a skillet
2. Add cornstarch , stirring constantly with a whisk until blended
3. Add the mascarpone cheese
4. Stir slowly while you add the dry white wine
5. When the cheese and wine is blended thoroughly , add the dried basil
6. Mix well and spoon sauce over the already cooked chicken breasts or fish fillets

title: egg and dairy free marbled cupcakes
steps:
1. Line a 12-hole muffin pan with paper cases
2. Place flour , sugar , water , oil and table spread in a large bowl
3. Using an electric mixer , beat on low speed , until ingredients are combined and mixture is smooth
4. Increase speed to high and continue beating for about 2 minutes or until mixture is slightly thickened
5. Divide cake batter evenly between two bowls
6. Tint one half pink and remaining half blue using food colourings
7. Spoon tablespoons of mixture , alternately , into holes of prepared pans
8. Run a skewer through batter to create a marbled effect
9. Cook in a moderate oven for about 25 minutes or until cooked when tested
10. Stand cakes in pan for 5 minutes before turning onto a wire rack to cool
11. To make frosting , beat table spread in a small bowl with an electric mixer until light and fluffy
12. Gradually beat in icing-sugar until well combined
13. Add water and beat until smooth
14. Spoon frosting into a piping bag fitted with a 1
15. 5cm-fluted tube
16. Pipe frosting onto tops of cakes
17. Serve cakes sprinkled with confetti decors

title: r bs classic guacamole
steps:
1. Slice avacados , remove pits and scoop out meats in a non-reactive bowl
2. Add garlic and lime juice and mash with a fork
3. Stir in remaining ingredients and mix thoroughly
4. Refrigerate for 2 hours or more to let flavors blend before serving

title: broccoli amandine casserole
steps:
1. Cook broccoli til tender
2. Drain& put in 2 quart casserole dish
3. Dissolve bouillon cube in water
4. In 1 quart saucepan , melt butter& add flour
5. Cook , stirring constantly 1-2 minutes
6. Pour in cream& bouillon , beating vigorously with wire whisk
7. Bring sauce to boil& stir til thick& smooth-about 3-5 minutes
8. Remove from heat& add sherry , lemon juice& pepper
9. Pour sauce over broccoli& sprinkle with cheeses and almonds
10. Bake@ 350 for 20 minutes

title: xacuti chicken
steps:
1. In a pan , heat a tbsp of the oil and lightly fry the coconut
2. When brown remove from the heat and put in into your blender
3. To the blender , add all of the spices and the garlic , add a little water , blend to make a smoothish paste
4. In the same pan heat the remaining oil and fry the onions till well browned
5. Add the spice mix that you blended , to the onions and fry till fragrant
6. Add the chicken and 2 cups of water , stir to blend all together
7. Season with salt
8. Cover the pot and simmer for approximately 30 mins till chicken is tender
9. Stir in the nutmeg
10. Adjust seasoning to your taste
11. Serve hot with a rice dish , and , a vegetable curry

title: orange  tomato  broccoli  and sweet onion salad with orange vina
steps:
1. Steam broccoli until crisp-tender and put in a large bowl
2. Cut peel and white from oranges
3. Holding oranges over a small bowl , break apart into slices and then cut the slices into thirds- catching the juice in the bowl
4. Add orange pieces , tomatoes , basil and onions to the bowl with the broccoli
5. Add oil , vinegar and orange peel to the bowl with the orange juice
6. Whisk until combined
7. Season dressing with salt and pepper to taste and pour over broccoli
8. Toss to coat
9. Enjoy !

title: rhubarb cream delight dessert
steps:
1. Make crust: mix flour , sugar and butter
2. Pat into 10" pie plate and set aside
3. Make rhubarb layer: combine rhubarb , sugar and flour
4. Toss lightly and pour into crust
5. Bake at 375 degrees for 15 minutes
6. Meanwhile , prepare cream layer: beat cream cheese and sugar until fluffy
7. Beat in eggs , one at a time , then pour over hot rhubarb layer
8. Bake at 350 degrees for about 30 minutes or until almost set
9. Combine topping ingredients and spread over hot layers
10. Chill

title: easter ham
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325f
2. Cut slices in the top of the ham on a diagonal , and press one whole clove into each square
3. Mix up the orange juice and dark brown sugar
4. Bake in oven for 20 minutes per pound at 325f
5. Baste every 1 / 2 hour or so , making sure you work fast to get the ham back into the oven quickly
6. You'll probably notice that the top may start to burn , cover with a strip of tin foil
7. As the cooking process continues , you'll have to lightly cover the whole ham with a larger piece of aluminum foil

title: veronica s wasabi cream sauce for fondue
steps:
1. Mix the wasabi powder and water until smooth
2. Add the sour cream and chives / green onions
3. Mix well
4. Taste and add salt if desired

title: avocado and lime with bacon on toast
steps:
1. Halve , deseed and peel the avocados
2. Slice lengthways into 1 cm thick slices
3. Place in a large bowl , drizzle with lime juice and season with pepper and salt
4. Toss gently to coat with the lime juice
5. Set aside for ten minutes
6. Preheat the grill on a medium-high heat
7. Cut bacon rashers in half , unless your have bought middle rashers in which case they are probably just the right size
8. Place the bacon on the grill in a single layer
9. Grill for 2 to 3 minutes on each side or until the bacon is beginning to crisp
10. Drain on the bacon paper towels
11. Grill the bread for one to two minutes on each side or until golden and toasted
12. Some people may want their bread untoasted
13. Spread lightly with butter
14. Place toast on plates
15. Top with avocado , bacon and a sprig of parsley
16. Serve

title: jerk wings with ranch dipping sauce   low carb
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450
2. Spray broiler pan with nonstick cooking spray
3. For ranch dipping sauce , combine mayonnaise , yogurt , 1 / 2 teaspoon salt , 1 / 4 teaspoon garlic powder , 1 / 4 teaspoon black pepper and onion powder in small bowl
4. Combine orange juice , sugar , thyme , paprika , nutmeg , red pepper , remaining 1 teaspoon salt , 1 teaspoon garlic powder and 1 / 4 teaspoon black pepper in small bowl
5. Cut
6. Place wings in large bowl
7. Drizzle with orange juice mixture
8. Toss to coat
9. Transfer chicken to greased broiler pan
10. Bake 25 to 30 minutes or until juices run clear and skin is crisp
11. Serve with ranch dipping sauce

title: chicken pot pie filling   dairy free
steps:
1. In deep skillet , bring chicken , stock , parsley , celery and bay leaf to simmer
2. Cover and cook for 20 minutes on medium-low heat
3. Add carrots and onions , cook for about 10 minutes
4. Remove chicken and let cool
5. Transfer carrots and onions to 1
6. 5 ltr casserole dish
7. Discard parsley , celery and bay leafs
8. Cut chicken into 1-1 / 2 inch chunks and add to casserole along with the ham and peas
9. In small dish blend flour with butter until smooth
10. Stir in a few tbs of stock to make paste
11. Blend back into remaining stock in skillet , bring to simmer and cook until thickened stirring constantly
12. Pour into casserole and cool
13. Fit pastry over casserole and seal edges
14. Cut slits for steam
15. Bake at 425f for 10 minutes
16. Reduce heat to 350f and cook for another 50 - 60 minutes , until filling is bubbly
17. If pastry begins to get too brown , cover with foil while cooking
18. For freezing for later use either freeze filling and make the crust and bake when ready to eat or make pie but freeze before baking and bake it when ready to eat it

title: basic mojo sauce
steps:
1. In the bowl of a food processor , add garlic , salt , pepper , orange juice , lime juice , onion and oregano
2. Process for 2-3 minutes or until smooth
3. Through the feeder tube add the oilve oil until the mixture is throughly blended
4. Store in the refrigerator until ready for use

title: pumpkin soup base recipe
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a large saucepan and add the onion , garlic and celery
2. Cook until softened but don't colour
3. Add the pumpkin , stock
4. Stir and bring to the boil , reduce the heat and simmer until the pumpkin is tender
5. Blend or process until smooth
6. Cool quickly and freeze in 5x1 litre portions
7. Thissoup is really quite thick at this stage , so when thawed you can add:
8. 1 / 2cup of cream and nutmeg for a traditional finish
9. 1 / 2cup of cream , crispy bacon and thyme
10. A220g can of tomatoes for another change of flavour
11. Asplash of fish sauce , a tablespoon of red curry paste , fresh coriander and basil and 1 / 2 cup of coconut cream for an asian style soup

title: baked cabbage  bulgaria
steps:
1. Mix the cabbage with the peppers and tomatoes , add the spices , oil , vinegar and water and transfer to a baking dish
2. Bake for 1 to 2 hours or until the cabbage is soft

title: oriental chicken with cashews
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine 2 tablespoons butter , margarine or i can't believe it's not butter spread , apple juice , soy sauce and brown sugar
2. Set aside
3. Season chicken with salt and pepper
4. In a 12" skillet , melt remaining 2 tablespoons butter , margarine or spread over medium-high heat and lightly brown chicken , garlic and scallions
5. Add red pepper flakes
6. Add broth
7. Reduce heat to low and simmer covered 20 minutes or until chicken is thoroughly cooked
8. Remove chicken to serving platter and keep warm
9. In same skillet , add soy sauce mixture
10. To serve , pour sauce over chicken and sprinkle with cashwes
11. Serve , if desired , with hot cooked rice

title: momz s sweet and sour meatballs
steps:
1. In a large pot , dump guava jelly and chili sauce , and fill chili sauce jar with water and add to the mix
2. Heat to blend
3. Mix beef , rice , egg , water , dash of garlic pepper , bread crumbs in bowl and form meatballs and add to sauce
4. Cover and heat on low for 1 1 / 2 - 2 hours

title: savory italian rounds
steps:
1. Preheat over to 400 degrees
2. In a small bowl combine the first seven ingredients
3. Separate biscuits and place on two ungreased baking sheets
4. Let stand for 5 minutes
5. Flatten biscuits into 4 inch circles
6. Spread with about 1 tablespoon mayo mixture over each circle to within 1 / 2 inch of edge
7. Bake at 400 degrees for 10 - 13 minutes or until golden brown
8. Serve immediately

title: spinach and cheese stuffed shells
steps:
1. Cook shells according to package directions
2. Be careful not to overcook them or they will tear easily
3. Drain and set shells out so they don't stick together
4. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
5. Lightly grease 9 x 13 baking dish
6. In large bowl , combine all ingredients except spaghetti sauce and 1 cup of mozzarella cheese
7. Spoon into shells
8. Spread a small layer of spaghetti sauce in bottom of casserole dish
9. Arrange filled shells over sauce and top with remaining sauce
10. Cover tightly with aluminum foil
11. Bake covered for 40 minutes
12. Uncover , sprinkle with remaining mozzarella cheese and bake uncovered for 5 to 10 more minutes

title: italian style vegetables
steps:
1. When oil is hot in wok , stir fry onion , garlic and zucchini 2 minutes or until desired texture
2. Add green beans , continue until hot , add tomatoes and seasoning and olives , cook until heated through
3. Serve

title: broccoli with sauce  amish
steps:
1. Cook broccoli , drain put 1 / 2 into buttered casserole dish add onion , make cheese sauce by cooking flour , salt , milk until thick then add cheese until melted
2. Pour over half and then add remainder of broccoli and then add rest of cheese
3. Bake at 375 for 45 minutes

title: chocolate strawberry desserts
steps:
1. Beat milk and pudding mix till thick and smooth and set aside
2. Drain strawberries and place berries in a blender
3. Cover and process until smooth
4. In a mixing bowl , beat cream and sugar until stiff peaks form
5. Gently fold in strawberry puree
6. Divide half of the chocolate pudding among four dessert dishes
7. Top with half the strawberry mixture
8. Repeat layers and garnish with strawberry slices

title: chicken spaghetti  with cheesy cream sauce
steps:
1. Stew the hen
2. Debone and tear / cut into small pieces
3. Cook the , onions , green peppers and spahetti , in the water used to boil the chicken
4. Drain water , mix in the chunked chicken , add mushrooms if desired
5. Cream sauce melt butter over low heat
6. Mix in flour and salt
7. Add milk , cook , stirring constantly till mixture thickens and bubbles
8. Add cheeses , stirring till melted and blended
9. Combine all ingredients
10. Put in casserole dish and bake at 350 for 30 minutes

title: dill rice
steps:
1. Cook rice according to package directions
2. Cool 20 minutes
3. Stir together rice , artichoke hearts , and remaining ingredients

title: big batch pumpkin bread with flavored butter variations
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Mix sugar and oil together in a large bowl
3. Add eggs and pumpkin , mix well
4. Sift all dry ingredients together
5. Stir in small amounts of dry ingredients and water until everything is mixed well
6. Pour into 3 5x9 loaf pans or 6 mini loaf pans
7. Bake for 1 hour or until it test done
8. Cool in pans 10 minutes , then remove to wire racks to finish cooling
9. Maple butter
10. Mix 2 sticks butter and maple syrup together until well blended
11. Honey / cinnamon butter
12. Mix 2 sticks butter and honey and cinnamon together until well blended

title: creole sauce
steps:
1. Heat the butter and oil in a medium saucepan
2. Add the chopped onion , garlic , chopped celery and bell pepper
3. Saut until tender
4. Stir in all remaining ingredients
5. Simmer over low heat for about 10 minutes
6. Taste and adjust seasoning
7. Serve with fried green tomatoes or eggplant , or use with shrimp or other seafood

title: cheater s pasta
steps:
1. Prepare the macaroni and cheese dinner according to box
2. Steam the veggies and the meat until hot
3. Mix the prepared macaroni and cheese dinner , the drained veggies , meat , and the seasonings
4. Stir in grated cheese
5. Serve

title: caramelized tofu and brussel sprouts with cilantro and nuts
steps:
1. Brown tofu and garlic in olive oil until crispy one side
2. Add butter , brown sugar , nuts , chili , and stir
3. Separately cut brussels sprouts in half lengthways and steam in pot or microwave
4. When tofu is caramelized , drain brussels sprouts and add to mix
5. Toss , remove from heat , then add cilantro , salt , and lemon juice
6. Serve hot

title: honey banana tea sandwiches
steps:
1. Cut the bread into decorative shapes with a knife or cookie cutter
2. If the bread is very crumbly , heat the honey just slightly to make it easier to spread
3. Spread both the top and bottom slices with honey and fill with the bananas
4. Trim the crust and cut into fourths

title: water chestnut salad with asian dressing
steps:
1. For the dressing-in a large bowl add garlic , ginger , vinegar , tamari , honey , sesame seeds , and water
2. Whisk until all ingredients are combined
3. Cut all veggies as directed above and transfer into an insanly large bowl or container , add dressing and mix well
4. Cool in the fridge or eat right away
5. You may also cook this and add chicken / beef / seitan / tofu

title: baked beans balti
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a small saucepan
2. Put in the chopped onion and fry for 1 minute
3. Add seeded and chopped chilli and cook for a couple of mins stirring continuously until onion begins to turn golden brown
4. Add spices and fry for another minute
5. Add beans reduce heat and cook for 3 minutes
6. Taste and season if necessary
7. Serve hot with toast or chapatis , naan or pita bread
8. Stir in a knob of butter at end of cooking if creamier taste is required

title: easy  lemon  cilantro  rice
steps:
1. In a saucepan , combine water or chicken broth , lemon juice , rind , garlic salt and bring to boil
2. Reduce heat and stir in rice
3. Cover and simmer for about 30 minutes or until all liquid has been absorbed
4. While rice is still hot and just before serving , add chopped fresh cilantro and toss gently
5. Serve with fish , seafood or any meat

title: crispy italian chicken
steps:
1. Place chicken in a large glass bowl with dressing
2. Cover and marinate for 2 hours in the refrigerator
3. Drain chicken
4. Brush mayo onto chicken
5. Then roll each breast in the bread crumbs till all coated
6. Place in a baking dish and bake in oven for about 40-45 mins on 350
7. Wait till golden brown , then remove

title: sunday rib roast
steps:
1. Two hours before roasting , remove meat from frig and allow it to come to room temperature
2. Place oven rack on 2nd lowest position
3. Preheat oven to 500 degrees
4. Be sure your oven is very clean before heating to 500 to reduce smoking
5. Place roast in pan large enough to hold it comfortably , bone-side down , and spread the top thickly with the salt and pepper
6. Roast meat for 45 minutes
7. Without removing the meat from the oven , reduce the oven temperature to 325 degrees f and roast for anouther 30 minutes
8. Finally , increase the temperature to 450 degrees f and roast for another 15-30 minutes , until internal temperature of the meat is 125 degrees f
9. Be sure thermometer is exactly in the center of the roast
10. The total cooking time will be between 1 1 / 2 and 1 3 / 4 hours
11. Meanwhile , make the sauce
12. Remove the roast from the oven and transfer it to a cutting board
13. Cover tightly with aluminum foil and allow to rest for 20 minutes
14. Carve and serve with mustard horseradish sauce or stilton sauce

title: vegan chile con queso  chile with cheese
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients , except chips , in a crockpot and let go for about an hour on high , stirring every so often
2. Reduce temp to low until ready to serve with chips for dipping

title: auntie lolo s ribs
steps:
1. Boil the ribs in a stock pot for 1 1 / 2 - 2 hours
2. You'll find they start falling off the ribs at 2hours
3. Preheat oven 350 deg
4. Place ribs in a roasting pan or your pan of choice and cover ribs with sauce
5. Make sure the ribs are fully covered in the sauce , so they don't dry out in the oven
6. Always best to have too much than not enough !
7. Cover and cook approx 2 hours

title: the nightgown
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f
2. Put the bread crumbs , flour , and eggs each in separate shallow , lipped plates
3. Pour the oil in a medium skillet to a depth of 1 / 2-inch , and heat over medium-high heat
4. Dredge the eggplant in the flour , shake off any excess , and then dip in the eggs
5. Add the eggplant to the skillet and fry , turning once , until golden brown , about 2 minutes per side
6. Transfer to a paper towel-lined plate to drain and season with salt and pepper
7. Season the veal with salt and pepper , and dredge in the bread crumbs
8. Lay 1 / 2 of the prosciutto over each veal cutlet , place 1 rectangle of the mozzarella along the center of each , and roll tightly
9. Tuck in the ends of the rolls and press to seal
10. Dip each roll in the eggs , add to the skillet and cook , turning occasionally , until well browned , about 4 minutes
11. Meanwhile , spread about 2 tablespoons of tomato sauce on 1 side of each eggplant slice , and sprinkle with some of the parmesan
12. Wrap each veal roll in an eggplant slice
13. Spread about 2 tablespoons of the tomato sauce in the bottom of a small , shallow baking dish or skillet and arrange the veal rolls on top
14. Spoon the remaining 2 tablespoons of sauce on top of the rolls and cover with the mozzarella slices
15. Sprinkle with a little parmesan and bake in the oven until hot and browned , about 15 to 20 minutes
16. Using a spatula , transfer the veal rolls to a plate and serve

title: choco holic cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Grease and flour 12-inch bundt pan or tube pan
3. Combine cake mix , pudding mix , milk , sour cream , and eggs in large mixing bowl
4. Beat on low speed just until blended
5. Beat on high speed for 2 minutes
6. Stir in morsels and nuts
7. Pour into prepared pan
8. Bake for 55-65 minutes or until tooth pick comes out clean
9. Cool in pan for 20 minutes
10. Invert onto wire rack and cool completely
11. Glaze:
12. Melt baking chocolate and butter in a saucepan on low heat stirring until smooth
13. Remove from heat
14. Stir in powdered sugar alternately with water until desired consistency
15. Stir in vanilla extract
16. Pour glaze over cake

title: cream puffs or eclairs with vanilla pastry cream
steps:
1. Make vanilla pastry cream:
2. In 2 quart saucepan , combine sugar , flour and salt
3. Stir in milk
4. Over medium heat , cook , stirring until mixture thickens and boils , about 10 minutes
5. Boil 1 minute
6. In a small bowl with fork , beat 6 egg yolks slightly
7. Beat small amount of heated milk mixture into yolks
8. Slowly pour egg mixture back into milk mixture , stirring
9. Cook over medium low heat , stirring till mixture thickens and coats spoon well , about 8 minutes
10. To check thickness , lift metal spoon from mixture and hold up 15 seconds - spoon should not show through mixture
11. Remove from heat
12. Stir in vanilla
13. At this point i usually put this custard through a strainer to get out any lumpy cooked egg pieces
14. Cover surface with plastic wrap , and chill well , about 2 hours
15. When custard is cool , in a small bowl with mixer at medium speed , beat heavy / whipping cream till stiff peaks form
16. With a rubber spatula , gently fold whipped cream into custard
17. Puffs:
18. Spray 1 or 2 large cookie sheets with nonstick spray
19. Heat oven to 375
20. In 2 qt saucepan over medium heat , heat butter , water and salt till butter mixture boils
21. Remove from heat
22. Add flour all at once
23. With a wooden spoon , vigorously stir until mixture forms a ball and leaves sides of pan
24. Add eggs to the flour mixture , one at a time , beating well after each addition , till smooth
25. Cool mixture slightly
26. Using a large spoon and rubber spatula , drop batter onto cookie sheets int 12 large mounds , 3 inches apart , swirling the top of each
27. Bake 50 minutes
28. At this point , remove from oven , cut a small slit in the side of each puff and return to the oven and bake for 10 minutes
29. Turn off oven and let dry for 5-10 minutes
30. When puffs are cool , slice top off of each - there will probably be some webby looking soft dough inside - carefully pull this out to make it hollow
31. Fill each shell with the chilled pastry cream
32. Replace top and sprinkle with powdered sugar
33. For eclairs:
34. Go through the same process , but top with semisweet chocolate glaze: in saucepan , melt 2 squares semisweet chocolate and 2 t butter , stirring constantly stir in 1 cup powdered sugar and 3 t milk till smooth

title: mom s salmon patties
steps:
1. Saute' onion , green pepper , and celery to soften , then mix it all with the remaining ingredients
2. Fry each side in oil and / or butter until lightly crispy
3. Serve with tartar sauce
4. Makes 4 to 6 patties

title: mexican stuffed peppers
steps:
1. Brown the meat and drain off any fat
2. Stir in the salt , pepper , cumin , oregano , garlic powder , and red pepper flake
3. Add all of the other ingredients except for the peppers and stir to combine
4. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees
5. Slice the peppers in half , remove seeds and ribs
6. Fill the peppers and place in a 9x13 baking dish
7. Cover with foil and bake for 40 minutes
8. Pull out and sprinkle with cheese
9. Continue baking uncovered until the cheese is just starting to brown
10. About 15 minutes

title: emeril s bourbon braised chicken and apple sausage with onions
steps:
1. Heat medium-size skillet over low heat for 30 seconds
2. Melt 2 tablespoons butter and add onions and brown sugar
3. Cook , stirring occasionally for 20 minutes until onions are partially browned
4. Season with salt and pepper , and place thyme sprigs in skillet
5. Add sausage whole and cook , stirring occasionally until sausage is browned , about 15 minutes
6. Add chopped garlic and cook , stirring for 2 minutes
7. Add beer
8. Reduce heat and cook , covered for 15 minutes
9. Remove pan from heat and stir in remaining butter and boubon
10. Remove thyme springs before serving
11. Serve sausages and onions in toasted french or hoagie roll with emerils kicked up horseradish mustard

title: poached eggs a la romana
steps:
1. Heat sauce in a skillet over medium heat
2. Carefully drop eggs one at a time into the sauce , season with salt and pepper , cover and let simmer 5 minutes
3. Transfer 1 egg and some sauce to each slice of toast and sprinkle top with cheese

title: super chocolate ice cream sundae
steps:
1. Heat hot fudge to taste
2. When fudge is hot , put ice cream in serving dish or bowl
3. Top with hot fudge
4. Dollop on whipped cream
5. Sprinkle chocolate jimmies on top
6. Enjoy !

title: pizza  steak
steps:
1. Combine flour , salt , & pepper
2. Pound into steaks
3. In large skillet , brown onions in oil over medium heat
4. Remove & set aside to drain
5. Add steaks to skillet , & brown well on both sides
6. Return onion to skillet , piling them on top of steaks
7. Pour pizza sauce over all
8. Cover skillet , reduce heat to medium low , and simmer 10-12 minutes , until steaks are cooked through
9. Uncover and top evenly with parmesan and mozzarella
10. Cover , and cook 3-5 minutes until cheeses are melted

title: apple sunrise punch
steps:
1. Combine apple and cranberry juices
2. Pour over ice in glasses or cups
3. Carefully top off with carbonated water
4. If desired , add an apple or orange slice to the rim of each glass

title: egyptian chicken panne  breaded fried chicken breasts
steps:
1. Take and slice your chicken breasts into thinner slices
2. Put slices into glass mixing bowl or dish
3. Squeeze the juice of lemon onto chicken slices
4. Add the onion liquid
5. Add salt & pepper and cover with plastic wrap , put in refrigerator for at least an hour
6. When ready to fry , take a slice and dip into bowl filled with bread crumbs
7. Do this until all chicken is breaded , setting each slice on a plate
8. Add oil in a large frying pan , not too much , just enough to cover bottom of each slice
9. Fry until golden brown on each side

title: top ramen chow mein
steps:
1. Boil the veggies in a pot just until tender , slightly firm
2. In a seperate pot , boil the noodles 3 or 4 minutes , and drain the water out
3. In a skillet , heat the oil over med-high heat and add the noodles
4. As they are sizzling , open only one packet of the seasoning provided in the top ramen packet , and sprinkle over the noodles
5. Stir the noodles occasionally allowing them to brown and crisp up a little
6. Add the veggies and meat , and drizzle lightly with soy sauce
7. Cook a few more minutes until veggies are tender and noodles are seasoned and cooked well
8. Serve and enjoy

title: watermelon feta salad
steps: 1. Toss all ingredients together and enjoy !

title: santa s biscotti
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f & grease or spray a large cookie sheet
2. Mix sugar & butter till light & fluffy
3. Add vanilla & eggs , beat until smooth
4. Stir in baking mix , spices & salt till combined
5. Turn dough onto baking sheet and pat into a 10-inch by 3-inch rectangle
6. Bake for 25 minutes or until a tester comes out clean
7. Remove from oven and let cool for 10 minutes
8. Cut into 3 / 4-inch slices & place cut side up on cookie sheet
9. Bake for 10 minutes
10. Turn each piece over & bake 10 minutes more
11. Remove from oven & sheet & cool on a rack
12. In a small saucepan , heat chocolate chips over low heat , stirring constantly , until fully melted
13. Spread chocolate on 1 side of cooled biscotti or dip to coat 1 / 2 of length

title: whole wheat pastry crust
steps:
1. Combine flour , salt and wheat germ in bowl
2. Cut in butter until mixture is crumbly
3. Add egg yolk and water , stirring until mixture forms a ball
4. Wrap in waxed paper or plastic wrap
5. Chill for 30 minutes to 24 hours before using

title: eggplant  aubergine   timbale with two sauces
steps:
1. For timbale: preheat oven to 375f
2. Butter four , 4-oz timbale molds generously
3. Heat olive oil in large skillet over medium-high heat
4. Add garlic
5. Add eggplant and cook until tender and slightly caramelized , stirring often , about 25 minutes
6. Add cream to eggplant and cook until absorbed , about 5 minutes
7. Transfer to processor and puree until smooth
8. Transfer to bowl
9. Stir in cheese , then egg , and season
10. Spoon into prepared molds
11. Set molds in roasting pan
12. Pour enough hot water to come halfway up sides of molds
13. Bake until firm to touch and tester comes out clean , about 40 minutes
14. Cover with foil if browning too quickly
15. Prepare broccoli sauce: heat olive oil in large skillet over medium heat
16. Stir in shallot
17. And broccoli and broth and cook until crisp-tender , about 5 minutes
18. Do not overcook or broccoli will lose colour
19. Transfer to processor
20. Add cream and puree until smooth
21. Season
22. For gorgonzola sauce: stir cream , cheese and butter in small skillet over medium heat until cheese and butter melt and sauce thickens , about 3 minutes
23. Season
24. To serve: spoon broccoli sauce onto each plate
25. Unmold timbale atop sauce
26. Spread gorgonzola sauce on top
27. Garnish with arugula and chopped tomato

title: simple orzo pilaf
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , bring the broth to a boil over medium-high heat
2. Stir in the orzo and reduce the heat to medium-low
3. Simmer the orzo and broth uncovered , stirring now and then to prevent sticking on the bottom of the pot , about 8-10 minutes , until the orzo is tender
4. The orzo mixture should be thick and syrupy when it is finished cooking not dry
5. If it seems as though the orzo isnt finished cooking but looks dry , add 1 / 4 cup chicken broth and continue to cook
6. When the orzo is tender , remove the pot from the heat
7. Stir in the green onions and cheese
8. Add the pepper and additional salt to taste , if needed
9. Garnish with additional green onions and serve immediately !
10. She states "the dish has a tendency to become a bit dry the longer it sits so make haste and serve as quickly as can be ! "

title: ham   stuffing casserole
steps:
1. Spray skillet with cooking spray and add about 2 tbsp
2. Butter and saute onion and celery till almost tender
3. In large bowl add the corn bread stuffing mix , the two cans of soup , mushrooms with liquid , corn and the onion and celery mixture
4. Mix thorougly
5. Spray a 13x9 casserole dish with cooking spray and put enough ham to cover the bottom
6. Sprinkle the cheese evenly over the ham
7. Spoon the stuffing mixture over the ham and cheese spreading the mixture evenly
8. Bake at 400 for approximately 30 minutes

title: greaneyes chipotle tabasco egg sandwich
steps:
1. Cook eggs over hard and toast bread
2. Mix desired amount of smoked chipotle tabasco into about 2t ranch dressing and taste and adjust as you see fit
3. Spread chipotle ranch dressing on toast , add eggs , and enjoy !

title: western skillet omelet
steps:
1. Place potatoes in large saucepan
2. Cover with water
3. Bring to boil
4. Continue boiling 5 minutes
5. Drain well and set aside
6. Cook bacon in large skillet on medium-high heat until crisp , turning occasionally
7. Remove bacon from skillet
8. Drain on paper towels
9. Discard bacon drippings
10. Add peppers , tomatoes and onions to skillet
11. Reduce heat to medium
12. Cook and stir 3 minutes
13. Add potatoes , cook an additional 15 minutes , stirring occasionally
14. Make 6 small wells in potato mixture
15. Add 1 egg to each well
16. Top potato mixture with bacon
17. Sprinkle with cheese
18. Cover skillet with lid
19. Cook 5-8 minutes or until eggs are set

title: roasted fennel and red onion salmon
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400f
2. In a roasting pan , toss the fennel , onion , garlic , tomatoes , thyme , 1 / 2 teaspoons salt , 1 / 4 teaspoons pepper and the oil
3. Spread evenly and roast for 20 minutes
4. Move vegetable to side of pan and add salmon , redistribute vegetables around the salmon fillets
5. Squeeze the lemon halves over the salmon and vegetables , sprinkle with remaining salt and pepper
6. Return to oven and roast until the salmon is the same color throughout and flakes easily
7. Serve immediately , over rice if desired

title: watermelon pudding or sauce
steps:
1. Prepare watermelon juice by scooping the meat and removing the seeds
2. Liquefy in blender or food processor
3. Stir sugar and cornstarch in a saucepan
4. Add about half the juice stirring until thoroughly combined , then add the rest
5. Cook over moderate heat
6. Stir , scraping the bottom with a wide spatula , occasionally at first , then constantly as it begins to thicken
7. Reduce heat to low when the mixture begins to bubble and continue stirring for 3-5 minutes
8. Pour into a bowl , stirring occasionally , until it reaches room temperature then stir in the vanilla
9. Add the optional ingredients if desired and pour into individual serving cups or a serving dish
10. Chill well before serving and serve with whipped cream or cookies if desired
11. If using as a sauce , thin if necessary to the consistency desired with additional watermelon juice

title: easy baked salmon
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees
2. Mix together soy sauce , lemon juice , and spices
3. Place salmon in a shallow baking dish , and pour liquid mixture over the filets
4. Bake about 25 minutes or until salmon is flaky

title: slow cooker vegetable beef soup
steps:
1. Place the beef in a skillet over medium heat
2. Mix in green bell pepper
3. Cook and stir until beef is brown and peppers are tender
4. Drain grease , and transfer to a slow cooker
5. Mix crushed tomatoes and mixed vegetables into the slow cooker
6. Pour in beef broth , soy sauce , and worcestershire sauce
7. Season with salt and pepper
8. Cover and cook 7 hours on low
9. Mix pasta into the slow cooker during the last 15 minutes of cook time

title: make ahead mini cheese bacon balls
steps:
1. In a bowl mix together the cream cheese with mozzarella cheese until well blended
2. Add in the crumbled bacon , green onion and pinch italian seasoning
3. Mix to combine
4. Add in hot sauce to taste
5. Shape the mixture into 40-50 balls
6. Roll into the ground walnuts
7. Place on a plate / s
8. Cover tightly with plastic wrap and chill for 24 hours or freeze up to 2 weeks
9. Serve on a platter with a long coloured toothpick in the center of each ball

title: tasty and light berry parfait
steps:
1. Place strawberries in small bowl and add 1 tsp of splenda
2. Mix well
3. In separate bowl , place blueberries and mix with 1 tsp of splenda
4. In a mixing bowl , combine cottage cheese , yogurt , vanilla and almond extracts
5. Mix well
6. In 2 large dessert glasses , layer in order: 1 / 2 of the blueberries , 1 / 4 of the yogurt mixture , 1 / 2 of the strawberries , 1 / 4 of the yogurt mixture
7. Reserve a couple of each berry to top each glass

title: fresh lemon meringue pie
steps:
1. In large saucepan , combine 1 1 / 2 cups sugar , cornstarch and salt
2. Gradually blend in cold water and lemon juice
3. Stir in egg yolks
4. Add butter and boiling water
5. Bring to a boil over medium high heat , stirring constantly
6. Reduce heat to medium and boil 1 minute
7. Remove from heat , stir in lemon peel and food coloring
8. Pour into baked pie crust
9. Top with meringue
10. Meringue - in a large bowl with electric mixer , beat egg whites with cream of tartar until foamy
11. Gradually add sugar and beat until stiff peaks form

title: devilish pie
steps:
1. Melt the marshmallows and chocolate bars with the milk in the top of a double boilet
2. Cool
3. When the mixture is cold , whip the whipping cream and fold inches
4. Pour into crumb crust , and sprinkle with a few reserved crumbs
5. Chill 3 hours , but serve at room temperature
6. Sinful with every bite !

title: fresh corn risotto
steps:
1. Reserve 1 / 2 the quantity of kernels , and puree the rest in a blender with some of the stock / broth
2. Strain through a sieve and add this strained liquid to the rest of the stock in a saucepan
3. Taste for seasoning
4. Heat to boiling point when ready to prepare risotto
5. In another pot , saute the onion and garlic in 2 tbs butter , until onion is translucent
6. Add the rice , and coat well , cooking another minute or so
7. Add reserved corn kernels
8. Add the hot broth to the rice / corn mix , one or two ladles at a time , stirring very frequently
9. Add more broth as it is absorbed by the rice
10. Continue this way for about 20 minutes , or until rice is cooked but"al dente" , in a creamy base of"sauce"
11. Orsee optional method of cooking , below
12. If rice isn't done after using all the corn stock , continue to cook using hot water , 1 / 2 cup at a time
13. When rice is done to taste , add the remaining butter , cheese or cream , and taste again for salt and pepper
14. Serve at once
15. Optional"cheater's"method of cooking risotto: add 1 / 2 the hot stock to rice
16. Stir only occasionally
17. When stock is absorbed , add kernels and rest of stock , stirring enough to avoid rice sticking to bottom
18. Continue as above
19. For vegetarians use vegetable stock

title: watermelon and cucumber gazpacho
steps:
1. Puree 4 cups watermelon in blender until smooth
2. Transfer puree to large bowl
3. Add remaining 1 cup diced watermelon and next 10 ingredients
4. Stir to combine
5. Cover gazpacho and refrigerate until cold , at least 1 hour and up to 4 hours
6. Divide gazpacho among bowls and top with dollop of crme frache or sour cream
7. Makes 4 servings
8. Bon apptit
9. August 2005

title: easy baked honey mustard chicken with curry
steps:
1. Place chicken in large baking dish
2. Combine ingredients and bring to a boil
3. Pour over chicken
4. Bake at 350 for 45 minutes to 1 hour or until juices run clear
5. I like to baste it at least once during cooking

title: best ever french onion dip
steps:
1. In a medium saute' pan , heated over medium heat , add oil and onions
2. Caramelize the onions in oil
3. They will be completely browned and be reduced in size by about half
4. This will take about 30 minutes , stir occasionally meanwhile , in a medium bowl , stir together all the rest of the ingriedents after the onions are caramelized , remove them from heat and cool them stir the onions into the sour cream mixture
5. Let chill for atleast 8 hours before serving

title: easy spinach lasagna
steps:
1. Chop the onion and peppers into small pieces
2. Fry lightly in the olive oil for a few minutes and add some black pepper
3. Add the garlic
4. Mix well and add the canned tomatoes
5. Heat until a few bubbles appear and slowly add the puree , then all the parsley except a little for decoration
6. Set aside
7. Make sure the spinach is totally clean
8. Steam in a stainless steel drainer over a pot of boiling water for no more than 3 minutes
9. While it is cooking , set the oven to 300 degrees f
10. Drain the spinach and put in a pan
11. Mix with the sour cream and plenty of black pepper
12. It should be smooth and creamy and a lovely color
13. Pour about 2 inches of the red sauce into a baking dish , smooth with a wooden spoon and cover with a layer of lasagne
14. Top with a layer of the spinach mix
15. Smooth it out and add another layer of pasta
16. Keep doing this- alternating red and green- until no more sauce is left
17. The last layer of pasta must have a little sauce on it to keep it moist
18. Cover with the cheese
19. Bake , uncovered , for about 1 1 / 2 hours
20. When the lasagne is done it needs to sit about 3 minutes before being sprinkled with parsley and served with a fresh green salad and a glass of dry red wine

title: salmon loaf with cucumber dressing
steps:
1. Loaf
2. Combine all ingredients and pour into a greased loaf pan
3. Bake at 350 for 1 hour
4. Slice and serve with cucmber dressing
5. Cucumber dressing
6. Combine all ingredients and refrigerate until ready to serve

title: easy meatball parm hero
steps:
1. Heat sauce and meatballs in a 3 quart saucepan over medium-high heat to a boil
2. Reduce heat to low
3. Cook for 20 minutes or until meatballs are heated through , stirring occasionally
4. Serve meatballs and sauce in rolls
5. Sprinkle with mozzarella and parmesan cheese

title: bbqd bacon wrapped pork fillet
steps:
1. Place the pork fillet into a shallow dish
2. Brush with melted butter and sprinkle with dried sage and chopped garlic
3. Pour the roasted garlic alfredo sauce over the meat , cover and refrigerate for four hours or preferably over night
4. Cut each of the slices of bacon into halves lengthwise
5. Plait these strips around the pork in a criss-cross pattern
6. Reserve the marinade for heating and serving with the pork
7. Cook the bacon wrapped pork fillet on a heated barbecue on a medium heat for approximately 30 minutes or until the pork is cooked through , turning halfway through cooking
8. Place the remaining marinade into a small saucepan and bring to the boil
9. Lower the heat , add 1 / 4 cup of wine and simmer for an extra minute and serve with the sliced pork as a sauce
10. The closest acceptable ingredient i could find was roasted garlic alfredo sauce
11. Use whatever equivalent to one of these is available in your region
12. The pork can be cooked in a conventional oven at 180c for 40 minutes or in an outdoor kettle oven following manufacturer's weight for cooking time

title: ramen stir fry
steps:
1. Following directions on package , cook the noodles and drain , reserving 1 / 2 cup cooking liquid
2. Meanwhile , prepare stir fry: in a wok or large skillet set over moderately high heat , warm the oil until it is hot , add the gingerroot and garlic and stir-fry 30 seconds
3. Add onion , carrots , and celery , and stir-fry 2 minutes
4. Add mushrooms and stir-fry 3 minutes more
5. Add chicken and broccoli and stir-fry until chicken is no longer pink
6. Add seasonings from the ramen packages along with the szechuan sauce and stir-fry 1 minute
7. Add the reserved 1 / 2 cup cooking liquid and let simmer , stirring occasionally until chicken is thoroughly cooked
8. Add the noodles to the pan and cook , stirring just until heated through
9. Season with the chili paste and cilantro

title: healthy veggie scramble
steps: 1. Sautee veggies with non-fat cooking spray , add scrambled eggs , cook until done

title: ham  noodle and swiss cheese casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees
2. Prepare egg noodles in a large dutch oven , boiling as described on package
3. Drain and return to the dutch oven
4. While the noodles are boiling , melt butter in skillet over medium to medium high heat
5. Stir in flour until thickened a bit
6. Slowly add half and half and chicken broth , stirring to prevent lumps
7. Cut heat up a bit if needed
8. Slowly add swiss cheese , dry mustard and salt and pepper , stirring constantly
9. When the sauce is medium thickness , cut heat down to low
10. In the large dutch oven containing the drained noodles , add the frozen peas , ham and the sauce
11. Mix well and pour into rectangular baking dish approximately 9 by 13
12. Cover with french fried onions
13. Bake for 20 minutes

title: crock pot maple sauced pears
steps:
1. Peel pears
2. Core pears from bottom , leaving stems attached
3. Place pears upright in slow cooker
4. Mix remaining ingredients except cornstarch and orange juice
5. Pour over pears
6. Cover and cook on high heat setting 2 to 2 1 / 2 hours or until tender
7. Remove pears from cooker
8. Place upright in serving dish or individual dessert dishes
9. Mix cornstarch and orange juice
10. Stir into sauce in cooker
11. Cover and cook on high heat setting about 10 minutes or until sauce is thickened
12. Spoon sauce over pears
13. Use 1 / 4 cup honey instead of the maple syrup for a change of pace

title: incredible shredded barbecued beef
steps:
1. In a dutch oven , brown roast on all sides in 1 tablespoon oil
2. Meanwhile , in a large saucepan , saute onions in remaining oil until tender
3. Add remaining ingredients except rolls
4. Bring to a boil
5. Reduce heat
6. Simmer , uncovered , for 15 minutes , stirring occasionally ,
7. Pour over roast
8. Cover and bake at 325 degrees for 2 hours
9. Turn the roast and bake for 2 more hours or until meat is very tender
10. Remove roast
11. Shred with a fork and return to sauce
12. Serve on rolls
13. To freeze: prepare as directed
14. Allow to cool and place in a freezer bag
15. Seal , pushing out as much air as possible
16. Label and freeze
17. To serve: thaw in fridge and reheat on stovetop

title: chili   sweet and spicy
steps:
1. Heat oil in a heavy-bottomed stock pot over medium-high heat
2. Add ground beef and cook until browned thoroughly about 8 minutes
3. Drain off excess fat
4. Add sirloin , garlic , onions , shallots , green and red bell peppers and continue to cook for an additional 12 minutes , making sure to thoroughly brown the sirloin and get a good carmelization on the vegetables
5. Add the tomato paste , espresso , dried seasonings , and sugar
6. Saute and thoroughly mix over medium heat for 10 minutes
7. Add beans , stock , tomatoes , beer , and hot peppers and let simmer for one hour over medium-low heat , stirring the mixture every 10 minutes
8. Reduce heat to low and continue to simmer for additional one hour , using the reserved drained tomato juice to thin if needed
9. Serve hot with the garnish of your choice: cheddar cheese , sour cream , green onions , etc

title: warm halloumi salad with chilli dressing
steps:
1. Make the chilli dressing by mixing the chilli , coriander , rice vinegar and honey in a small jug
2. Cut each peach half into 5 wedges
3. Pat the cheese dry on kitchen paper and cut into thin slices using a small sharp knife
4. Heat 1 tablespoon of the oil in a large frying pan or wok and fry the cheese for 30 seconds on each side until lightly coloured
5. Remove from the pan and keep warm
6. Add the chicory and salad onions and fry quickly over a high heat , stirring for 1-2 minutes , until beginning to colour
7. Spoon onto some kitchen paper and keep warm
8. Heat the remaining oil in the pan , add the peach wedges , then fry for 1 minute on each side until slightly softened
9. Toss all the ingredients together in a warm salad bowl
10. Pour the chilli dressing over and serve with a seeded bread

title: coquito  puerto rican holiday drink for christmas and new year s
steps:
1. Mix all the ingredients in a blender
2. Refrigerate
3. Serve cold and enjoy !

title: kielbasa with potatoes  peppers   onions
steps:
1. Cut potatoes into bite-sized pieces
2. Thinly slice both bell peppers and the onion
3. Quarter kielbasa length-wise and cut into bite-sized pieces
4. In a large skillet , heat olive oil over medium heat
5. Place kielbasa and potatoes in skillet
6. Season with old bay and seasoning salt
7. Cover and cook 25 minute or until potatoes are almost tender
8. Stir occasionally
9. Add peppers and onion
10. Cook 5 minute or until peppers and onion are just tender
11. Adjust seasoning if needed

title: seasoned potatoes  kamjanamul
steps:
1. In a large pot place cut potatoes
2. Add water to cover , put lid on pot and bring to a boil
3. Simmer for 10 minutes or until fork tender
4. In medium mixing bowl , add remaining ingredients
5. When potatoes are done , drain liquid and add potatoes to seasoning mix
6. Mix well to coat and serve immediately

title: caramelized mango tart with mexican chocolate and pepitas
steps:
1. Caramelize the mangoes
2. In a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat , melt the butter
3. When it begins to brown , add the mangoes
4. Stir frequently for a couple of minutes until the fruit releases its juice
5. Sprinkle the sugar over the mango and continue stirring frequently until all the liquid has evaporated and the mango has begun to caramelize , about 4 minutes
6. Cool
7. Make the chocolate-pepita filling
8. Turn on the oven to 400f and position the rack in the middle
9. Scoop the 2 chocolates into a food processor
10. Pulse until finely chopped , then add the pepitas and continue pulsing until they , too , are finely chopped
11. Scrape down the sides , then scrape in the almond butter
12. Process until the mixture is smooth , scraping down the sides as needed
13. Bake the tart
14. Unroll the puff pastry
15. Cut into 2 rectangles 5 x 10 inches each and place them onto a baking sheet lined with parchment paper or a silicone mat
16. Spread the chocolate mixture over the puff pastry , leaving a full 1-inch border all around
17. Top with the cool mango slices in an even layer
18. Bake until the pastry is richly brown and mango richly caramelized , about 25 minutes

title: cauliflower fried  rice   paleo
steps:
1. In a large pan , saute garlic and onions in olive oil on a medium / high heat , until onions become soft and transparent
2. Next add in peas , and carrots and cook until carrots begin to soften and peas are heated through , about 3-4 minutes
3. Next stir in scrambled eggs , cauliflower and soy sauce
4. Cook stirring frequently for about 5-7 more minutes
5. Enjoy adding in your favorite protein and veg
6. Possible add-ins: broccoli , cabbage , bok choy , water chestnuts , chicken , and shrimp !

title: terry s white chocolate macadamia biscotti   tender biscotti
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy
2. Beat in eggs , vanilla and liqueur
3. In a bowl combine the flour , baking powder and salt
4. Add to the creamed mixture , mixing until blended
5. Fold in nuts and chocolate chips
6. Divide dough in half
7. On a greased and floured baking sheet pat out into two logs about 1 / 2 in high , 1 1 / 2 inches wide and 14 inches long , placing them at least 2 inches apart
8. Bake in the middle of a preheated 325 degree oven for 25 minutes or until lightly browned
9. Transfer from baking sheet to a rack
10. Let cool for 5 minutes
11. Place on a cutting board
12. With a serrated knife slice diagonally on a 45 degree angle about 1 / 2 inch thick
13. Place the slices upright on the baking sheet and return to the oven for about 8 minutes longer to dry slightly
14. Let cool on a rack
15. Store in a tightly covered container

title: jota  sauerkraut  bean and pork soup
steps:
1. Bring the kidney beans to a boil in a large pot with plenty of salted water
2. Remove from the heat , cover and set aside for 1 hour
3. In a large casserole or dutch oven , heat the olive oil over high heat
4. Season the pork well with salt and pepper and sear on all sides , working in batches if necessary , and remove the meat when it is browned
5. Add the speck , sage , parsley , and garlic and saute for 5 minutes before returning it to the casserole
6. Drain the beans and add them to the casserole with the stock and the sauerkraut and bring to a simmer
7. Cook the mixture slowly for 45 minutes , or until the pork is very tender and the beans are cooked through
8. Slowly sprinkle the polenta over the stew and stir constantly for 10 minutes , or until the polenta has expanded
