9. Season with salt and pepper , to taste , and serve

title: cauliflower popcorn  diabetic friendly
steps:
1. Break a head of cauliflower into popcornlike , bite-size florets , then spread them on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper
2. Spray the cauliflower lightly with butter-flavor cooking spray , then sprinkle lightly with turmeric , freshly ground pepper , and sea salt
3. Bake 20 to 30 minutes at 425 degrees f or until the cauliflower is slightly browned

title: dry onion soup mix
steps:
1. Mix all together and store in container
2. 1 / 4 cup of this = 1 envelope

title: yoghurt corn muffins with corn
steps:
1. In a big bowl combine all of the dry ingredients and mix well
2. Make a well in the centre
3. In a separate bowl combine yoghurt and egg
4. Add corn kernels , water and cheese if using
5. Mix well and pour into the well in the dry ingredients
6. Mix to form a soft , thick dough
7. If it its too dry , add more water tbs by tbs until your dough looks right
8. Pour into prepared muffin tins
9. Bake in the preheated oven at 200c / 400f for 15-20 minutes or until lightly golden and baked through
10. Enjoy !

title: david  the latke king  firestones crispy latkes
steps:
1. Pulse the onion in a food processor a few times until the onion is diced into crunchy bits
2. Remove the blade and scrape the onion into a small bowl
3. Return the food processor bowl to the machine
4. Cut the potatoes lengthwise to fit in the food processor feed tube
5. Put the medium-coarse food processor shredding disk and turn it on
6. Begin feeding the potato slices into the machine
7. When the potatoes are shredded , put them in a colander over a large bowl
8. Dump in the onion bits and mix everything around with your hands , squeezing the potato moisture out as you work
9. Let the mixture drip for a few minutes
10. Pour out the potato liquid from the bowl , but leave the starch that clings to the bowl
11. Dump in the shredded potato and onion mix
12. Add the eggs , matzoh meal , parsley , salt , and pepper
13. Stir well
14. Then let it sit for about 10 minutes
15. In a large cast-iron skillet , pour in inch of oil
16. Over high heat , get the oil very hot
17. Using a -cup measure or a long-handled serving spoon , spoon the batter into the skillet
18. Flatten each with a metal spatula to a diameter of 4 to 5 inches
19. Don't worry about them being uniformly round
20. Reduce the heat to medium and cook the latkes until golden brown on one side
21. Then turn over and fry them some more
22. When crispy on the outside and moist inside , about 5 minutes per side , remove and place on several thicknesses of paper towels
23. Keep doing this until you run out of batter
24. Serve the latkes immediately

title: rhubarb butter crunch
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit
2. Grease 9x13 baking dish
3. Combine rhubarb with sugar and place in greased baking dish
4. Combine brown sugar , oatmeal , butter , shortening and flour and mix to pebble-like consistency
5. Mixture will be crumbly
6. Sprinkle crumbly mixture over rhubarb
7. Bake uncovered for 40 minutes

title: raspberry fruit salad
steps:
1. Make jello , using 1 1 / 2 cup hot water , add crushed banana , raspberries , pineapple less the juice , mandarin oranges less the fluid , in a 9 x 13 pan or serving dish , cool , until firm
2. Topping: add water to pineapple juice making 1 cup
3. Heat in sauce pan adding sugar , egg , corn starch , butter
4. Heat while stirring until mixture thickens
5. Fold into cool whip and let cool
6. When jello is firm , spread topping over jello and continue to cool , until ready to serve

title: caramel eggnog
steps:
1. Separate the egg , and beat the white until stiff
2. Combine egg yolk , sugar and salt
3. Fold whites into yolk mixture
4. Add milk , vanilla and caramel
5. Top with whipped cream and additional caramel syrup
6. If you desire to serve this hot - use hot milk and do not beat the whites before adding to yolk mixture

title: jo mama s hot and spicy grilled chicken
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients except for the chicken and bring to a rolling boil
2. Remove from the heat and cool
3. Refrigerate sauce overnight to blend flavors
4. Heat a grill to medium-high heat
5. Apply sauce to chicken
6. Grill to desired doneness , applying sauce liberally as you turn chicken
7. Cook until done through
8. If you don't contaminate the sauce with the raw chicken , you can serve it with the cooked chicken
9. If it gets contaminated , simmer it on the stove for a few minutes

title: super easy gluten roast
steps:
1. Place roast ingredients in a bread machine on dough setting or in stand mixer with dough hooks
2. Mix on high for 15 minutes
3. You may need to scrape down occasionally in mixer
4. Set aside for 5-10 minutes
5. Prepare broth
6. Do not make it hot ! if using bouillon cubes , crush them and just add to your water , it will mix as it cooks
7. Form roast into oval
8. Place in slow cooker , add broth
9. Set on low , for 8 hours
10. Turn halfway through
11. When done , remove and drain on paper towels
12. Serve immediately or place in sealed container or ziploc baggy with some leftover broth

title: finger lickin  baby back ribs
steps:
1. Spray sides of 5 quart slow cooker with vegetable cooking spray
2. Cut ribs in serving size pieces
3. Sprinkle with black pepper and place in slow cooker
4. Combine chili sauce , apple cider vinegar , brown sugar , and water
5. Pour mixture over ribs
6. Cover and cook for 6 to 7 hours on low
7. After 3 hours move ribs around in slow cooker to spread sauce over ribs

title: hot cheddar bean dip
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Stir all ingredients together until well mixed
3. Spoon into a 1 - 1
4. 5 qt ovenproof dish
5. Bake for 30 minutes or until bubbly
6. Serve hot with tortilla chips

title: crabmeat quesadillas
steps:
1. Coat 12" skillet with cooking oil and warm over medium heat
2. Place tortilla in skillet and rub meat from roasted garlic on tortilla
3. Place jalapeno , tomato , crabmeat and cilantro on 1 / 2 of the tortilla
4. Spread cheese on top
5. Add the rest of the items and fold over tortilla to cover cheese
6. Cook for 1 minute and flip tortilla to the other side continue to cook for an additional minute
7. Remove from skillet , slice and serve

title: pepper jack meatloaf
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees
2. In large bowl combine the egg , bread crumbs , onion , salt and pepper
3. Crumble beef over mixture and mix well
4. In a 8x4-inch greased pan press half of the beef mixture onto the bottom and halfway up the sides
5. Sprinkle 3 / 4 of a cup of cheese over meat within 1 / 2 in of sides
6. Pat remaining beef mixture over cheese
7. Bake uncovered for 50 - 55 minutes
8. Sprinkle the remaining cheese on top and bake for another 5 minutes or until cheese is melted
9. Let stand for 10 minutes before slicing

title: lime chicken avocado salad
steps:
1. Chop chicken breasts into chunks and place in a resealable plastic bag
2. Whisk together lime juice , olive oil , honey , and cayenne pepper and pour half of the mixture over the chicken
3. Seal bag and marinate in refrigerator for 1 hour
4. Reserve remaining marinade for later use
5. When chicken is ready , spray large saucepan with nonstick cooking spray and heat to medium
6. Place chicken in pan and discard bag with the marinade inside
7. Cover and cook chicken until no longer pink , about 8-10 minutes , flipping chicken pieces occasionally
8. Combine chicken , avocado , tomatoes , onion , and cilantro in a bowl
9. Pour reserved marinade over all and mix well

title: spinach and artichoke pie   ww core
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Saute mushrooms and onions in olive oil with garlic
3. Add spinach and cook until liquid has reduced
4. Mix vegetables with remaining ingredients , salt and pepper to taste
5. Pour into pie dish sprayed with nonstick spray
6. Bake 45 minutes

title: coquille st  jacques     france
steps:
1. Add in pot: water , wine , shallot , bay leaf , a drop of oil , lemon and salt
2. Add scallops sliced --they should be covered by the liquid
3. Simmer covered with a lid and let cook 5 minutes
4. Remove scallops from cooking liquid and strain , keep the juice
5. In frying pan , cook sliced mushrooms in the 2 tablespoons of olive oil for about 5 minutes , stirring often
6. Prepare 4 dishes
7. Divide scallops in each
8. Divide shrimp in each
9. Divide mushroom and put on top
10. In medium saucepan , prepare white sauce: melt butter over medium flame and pour flour in
11. Stir
12. Reduce heat and add a bit at a time the cooking juice
13. Stir and mix
14. Do this until the sauce is thickened
15. Season with salt and pepper
16. Add the cream
17. Pour over the seafood equally
18. Sprinkle with the breadcrumbs and dot with butter
19. Put under grill for about 10 minutes

title: easy buttermilk pie
steps:
1. In a large bowl cream together sugar , butter and flour
2. Add eggs , buttermilk and vanilla
3. Pour into unbaked pie shell and bake for 1 hour at 325 degrees or until knife inserted in center comes out clean
4. Cool and serve

title: oven fried spicy pork tenderloin sandwich
steps:
1. In a freezer bag or a non-reactive 13x9 glass baking dish , combine buttermilk , cayenne , black pepper and kosher salt
2. Place a loin chop between two sheets of plastic wrap or in a gallon size freezer bag
3. Using a smooth meat mallet or a rolling pin , pound the meat until it is 1 / 8 in thick
4. Repeat with remaining loin chops
5. Place the 1 / 2 cup of self rising flour in a paper plate
6. Dredge each pounded chop in the flour and pat off excess leaving a very thin coating
7. Place each floured chop in the buttermilk
8. Cover and marinate in the fridge 2 hours , up to overnight
9. Preheat over to 400 degrees
10. Mix 1 hot and spicy shake bake packet with the 1 / 2 cup of panko crumbs on a paper plate
11. Pull marinating chops from the fridge
12. One by one , allow as much of the excess marinade to drip off as possible
13. Dredge chops in the shake and bake / panko crumbs
14. Place chops on a baking / cooling rack , or a sheet pan , that has been sprayed with non-stick cooking spray
15. Allow to sit for 10 minutes
16. Place chops in the oven and bake for 15-18 minutes
17. Meanwhile , chop bread and butter pickles and mix with the mayonnaise
18. Spread 1 tablespoon of the mayo on each side of the buns
19. Place one tomato slice on the bottom of each bun slice and sprinkle lightly with cracked pepper and kosher salt
20. Place one chop on the tomato and finish with the top bun
21. Serve hot

title: chef tracey s macaroni and cheese
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , combine whipping cream , rosemary , the 1 teaspoon kosher salt and the 1 / 4 teaspoon black pepper
2. Bring to boiling: reduce the heat
3. Boil gently , uncovered , for 25 to 30 minutes or unil the mixture is reduced to 1 1 / 3 cups , stirring occasionally
4. Cook pasta according to package directions
5. Drain: keep pasta warm
6. In a large skillet , heat the olive oil over medium-high heat
7. Add chicken
8. Cook and stir for 2 minutes
9. Sprinkle with paprika , the 1 / 4 teaspoon kosher salt and the 1 / 8 teaspoon pepper
10. Cook and stir for 1 to 2 minutes more or until chicken is no longer pink
11. Stir the cooked pasta , chicken , cheese and tomatoes into the whipping cream mixture
12. Cook and stir for 2 minutes or until heated throughout
13. Serve immediately

title: islander cheese ball
steps:
1. Mix cheese and pineapple with mixer
2. Stir in onion , green pepper , salt and 1 / 2 cup pecans
3. Roll into one large ball , 2 logs or fill a scooped-out fresh pineapple half
4. Roll or top with remaining pecans
5. Makes about 2 cups

title: pork loins in tarragon sauce
steps:
1. Cut pork into serving size pieces
2. Sprinkle with salt and pepper , rub with mustard
3. Melt butter , and fry pork chops
4. Remove when dome
5. Stir beef broth and tarragon into the skillet
6. Add whipping cream , and salt and pepper to taste
7. Return pork chops and simmer until cooked through

title: hawaiian beans
steps:
1. Drain beans and mix all ingredients together
2. Bake 1 hour at 350 degrees or cook in a crock pot for 7 hours

title: roasted fish bruschetta
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 475 degrees f
2. Heat a sauce pan over medium heat
3. Add 1 tb
4. Of oil , onions and anchovies
5. Saute for 2 minutes , then add the garlic , tomatoes and tomato paste
6. Salt and pepper to taste
7. Bring to a boil and reduce heat to a simmer
8. Simmer 10-15 minutes
9. Meanwhile , pat the fish with a paper towel
10. Then lightly oil , salt and pepper on both sides
11. Roast on a rimmed baking sheet for 6-8 minutes--depending on the thickness of the fish
12. Brush the bread with olive oil and toast in the oven for 3-5 minutes
13. You could put them on a lower rack with the fish to save time !
14. Stack the basil leaves
15. Roll them into a tight cylinder
16. Slice them thin into fine ribbons
17. To assemble the bruschetta , top bread with a fish fillets
18. Then add tomato sauce and sprinkle fresh basil ribbons
19. Serve immediately

title: bechamel sauce
steps:
1. Melt the butter in a heavy-bottomed pan
2. Remove from heat and add the flour , stirring briskly so that it is absorbed by the butter and forms a smooth paste
3. Add a little of the milk and stir in well , there is no need to put the pan back on the heat as it will be hot enough to start cooking the bechamel sauce
4. Continue adding a little more milk , gradually blending it with the flour and butter , until you begin to obtain a smooth , even consistency
5. Then return the pan to very low heat and gradually add the rest of the milk , stirring continuously until the sauce thickens
6. Stir gently for a first 2-3 minutes to cook the flour
7. Season with salt and pepper and a little freshly grated nutmeg

title: butter pecan muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Grease muffin pans
3. Combine flour , pecans , and brown sugar in mixing bowl
4. Set aside
5. In another bowl , beat egg
6. Stir in milk , butter , and vanilla
7. Add liquid ingredients all at once to flour mixture
8. Stir only until flour is moistened
9. Fill muffin cups 2 / 3 full
10. Bake about 15 minutes or until golden brown
11. Serve warm with butter or jam and enjoy !

title: philly cheese steak soup
steps:
1. Melt butter in large , heavy-bottomed stock pot or dutch oven over medium heat
2. Add green peppers , onion , and mushrooms and saute until tender
3. Add flour and cook another 5 minutes stirring often
4. This is an important step to cook out the flour taste
5. Slowly whisk in milk and bring to a simmer stirring often until soup thickens
6. Reduce heat to medium low and stir in beef consomme , salt and pepper
7. Slowly stir in provolone until all is melted and incorporated into soup
8. Remove from heat and stir in roast beef
9. Serve with a crusty loaf of french bread
10. To freeze: prepare soup as directed and allow to cool
11. Place in rigid freezer container
12. Seal , label and freeze
13. To serve: thaw in fridge
14. Reheat in microwave or on stovetop , stirring to recombine the soup

title: reese s chewy chocolate cookies
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees
2. Stir together the flour , cocoa , baking soda and salt
3. Beat butter and sugar in a large bowl with mixer until fluffy
4. Add the eggs and vanilla
5. Beat well
6. Gradually add the flour mixture
7. Beating well
8. Stir in peanut butter chips
9. Drop by rounded teaspoons onto ungreased baking sheet
10. Bake 9 minutes
11. Do not overbake
12. Cool slightly
13. Remove from cookie sheet to wire rack

title: barbecue glazed drumsticks
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f , coat an 8-inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray
2. In a medium saucepan , combine all the ingredients except the drumsticks over medium heat , bring to a boil and allow to boil for 5 minutes or until the sauce thickens , stirring constantly
3. Place the drumsticks in the baking dish and pour the sauce mixture over them , coating them completely , bake for 40-45 minutes , or until the chicken is no longer pink and the juices run clear

title: shortchefs mac and cheese
steps:
1. Prepare shells how you prefer to eat them as you do for any pasta dish
2. Drain water
3. Put back on stove and mix in cheese soup
4. Put into bowls and put a dollop of sour cream on top

title: shoney s cabbage beef soup
steps:
1. Chop the tomatoes and reserve the juice
2. Brown the beef with the onions
3. Drain the fat
4. Add the beef broth , beans , tomatoes , and juice and tomatoe paste if desired
5. Add the cabbage , and simmer till tender
6. Add salt and pepper

title: chinese chicken salad  houston s copycat
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine the lime dressing ingredients and mix well
2. In a large bowl , combine the salad greens , carrots , sliced chicken and tortilla strips
3. Pour the lime dressing over the salad and toss to combine
4. Transfer the salad to 4 salad plates
5. In another bowl , combine the ingredients for the peanut sauce and mix well
6. Drizzle each salad with the peanut sauce and serve

title: seva   bean   vegetable stew
steps:
1. Cook onions& garlic with ghee on low heat
2. When onions golden , add carrots and shortly after potatoes
3. After 2 minutes add beans
4. Do not rinse beans
5. Add bean"juice" as well
6. Cover veges with water plus a little bit
7. Add curry / garam masala
8. Bring to a boil
9. Simmer for 20 minutes or until veqes are done
10. Salt , pepper and spice to taste
11. If needed , add corn starch to thicken

title: revani  greek cake using semolina
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Butter and flour a 13 x 9 inch pyrex baking pan
3. Sift flour , baking powder and salt
4. In large electric mixer bowl , beat egg whites until frothy
5. Gradually beat in 1 / 2 cup of the sugar
6. Continue beating until very stiff and glossy
7. Set meringue aside
8. Beat egg yolks , remaining sugar , and butter until very light and fluffy
9. Add orange rind and vanilla
10. Beat in dry ingredients alternately with orange juice and semolina until incorporated
11. Fold in meringue
12. Turn into prepared pan and sprinkle with almonds
13. Bake for 40-50 minutes , or until it tests done
14. Cool
15. For syrup: boil sugar , water and cinnamon stick for 8 minutes
16. Add brandy and remove cinnamon stick
17. Pour hot syrup over cooled cake
18. Cool and cut into squares
19. Serve with a dollop of whipped cream

title: penne with saffron and prawns
steps:
1. Cook pasta in boiling water in a large pot according to package directions , drain and set aside keeping warm
2. To make sauce , melt butter in a small pan over medium heat , blend in flour and cook for 1 minute
3. Remove from heat and whisk in the milk , saffron and sage
4. Return to heat and cook stirring 3 minutes or until sauce comes to boil and thickens
5. Add prawns and snow peas to pasta and toss gently
6. Top with sauce and serve immediately

title: cottage cheese dip spread
steps: 1. Blend all ingredients until smooth and chill

title: shirley s sausage stuffing
steps:
1. In a saucepan over med
2. Heat , boil the fresh pork sausage and gizzards , along with the margarine , onions , and celery , in 1 quart of water , for 30 minutes strain , saving water
3. Put the onions , celery , and sausage in a lg
4. Bowl , and set aside
5. Put the gizzards , and meat picked from the neck , in a blender , and press chop
6. When all is chopped fine , put in the lg
7. Bowl , along with onions , celery , and sausage
8. You may also grind the gizzards , and other meat parts in a meat grinder instead of the blender if you have one
9. Add to the sausage , onion and celery
10. When ready to stuff the bird and bake:
11. In a lg
12. Bowl crumble your bread , crust and all ,
13. Crush the crackers right in the closed sleeves ,
14. When crushed , open the sleeve and put in the bowl , along with the bread
15. Mix up well
16. Mix the meat mixture with the dry mixture
17. Add enough liquid from the sausage , gizzards , heart and neck stock , to make the stuffing to the desired consistency , of if not using these parts , use some chicken or turkey broth
18. Toss with a fork , until well mixed
19. Gently knead the mixture to distribute the ingredients
20. (the stuffing should have enough liquid so it holds together in a ball if you squeeze it in your hands , but not mushy , especially if you are stuffing your turkey , as the juices from the turkey make it moist as it is cooking
21. Add poultry seasoning , tasting as you go , to get it the way you like it
22. Salt and pepper , to taste
23. Stuff the bird right before putting it in the oven
24. Do not stuff the bird and let it sit overnight in the refrigerator
25. The stuffing should be warm or room temperature when you are ready to put it in the bird
26. Plan to use 3 / 4 cup stuffing for each pound of turkey
27. To stuff the neck , first pack it loosely with stuffing
28. Pin the neck skin over the exposed stuffing with a skewer , or flip the wing
29. Spoon stuffing loosely in the main body cavity
30. Cover exposed stuffing with a swatch of aluminum foil or a piece of bread
31. Roast turkey using desired method
32. I bake mine at 350 , and go by the pounds on the turkey label for the hours needed to roast
33. Baste turkey with pan drippings at least 3 times during cooking time to get nice crispy skin , and help to keep turkey moist
34. Use a meat thermometer to make sure the center of the stuffing reaches 165 degrees f before removing from the oven
35. Keep in mind that a "pop-up" thermometer that comes with a turkey won't tell you the temperature of the stuffing
36. Place any extra stuffing in a baking dish coated with cooking spray
37. Cover , and refrigerate until ready to bake , no more than 8 hours before cooking the bird
38. Pour 1 / 2 cup turkey or chicken stock over the extra stuffing , and bake at 350 , for 30-60 minutes covered with aluminum foil
39. After the turkey is done roasting , remove stuffing immediately from the bird , and place in a bowl
40. (i use an aluminum bowl and cover with aluminum foil to keep it nice and hot , until serving time
41. Refrigerate leftovers within 2 hours of taking out of the oven
42. Store leftover turkey and stuffing in shallow containers with covers , and use within 2-3 days
43. You may freeze but use within 3 months
44. Avoid pre-stuffed fresh turkeys , and do not stuff birds to cook on a grill or smoker , or if you plan to deep fry
45. Always stuff a bird just before roasting
46. The stuffing should be warm , not hot or cold , when you pack it in the bird , otherwise the roasting time will be off , and the temperature will not reach 165 degrees f before the rest of the bird is done
47. Don't overstuff the turkey , because the stuffing will expand as the bird roasts
48. Following these simple steps is the safest way to stop airborne bacteria from invading your turkey and stuffing and making you sick

title: mc donald s classic french fries  copycat
steps:
1. Mix the brine in a 3 quart pot with an accompanying lid
2. Peel 4 medium russet potatoes
3. Cut potatoes into 1 / 4" shoestrings
4. Place cut potatoes into the brine container
5. Seal and refrigerate for at least 2 hours
6. Bring pot with brine and potatoes to a full boil
7. Boil for 1 1 / 2-2 minutes
8. Drain and rinse potatoes under cold water
9. Blot potatoes as dry as possible
10. Place potatoes side-by-side into freezer bags without touching , and without crowding
11. Seal bags and freeze flat in refrigerator for at least 2 hours
12. Fill deep-fryer with proper amount of beef tallow , to manufacturer's recommended amount
13. Heat fryer in gradual increments to 375f
14. Place 1 / 2 of the potatoes at a time into elevated deep-frying basket
15. Gently lower basket into hot fat
16. Fry for about 2 minutes but pay attention to the color -- potato color should be light golden brown with just slightly darker ends
17. Elevate fry basket and shake to drain excess fat
18. Secure basket and let drain for 30 seconds
19. Transfer fries into colander placed in sink
20. Repeat with remaining potatoes
21. Season french fries lightly with fine flake sea salt while tossing
22. Serve french fries with your favorite condiment and enjoy !

title: ginger asparagus salad
steps:
1. Combine the vinegar and gingerroot in a small saucepan
2. Bring to a boil
3. Boil 7 minutes or until the liquid is reduced by half
4. Remove from the heat , and stir in the sugar
5. Set aside
6. Snap off tough ends of the asparagus
7. If you want to , remove the scales from the sides of the asparagus stalk -- i don't
8. Place the asparagus in a large skillet and add cold water to cover
9. Bring to a boil and immediately remove from heat
10. Plunge the asparagus into cold water to stop the cooking process
11. Drain the water off the asparagus
12. Arrange the asparagus on a serving platter
13. Combine the vegetable oil and next 4 ingredients , stirring well
14. Drizzle over the asparagus
15. Cover and chill at least 30 minutes before adding the vinegar mixture
16. One hour before serving , drizzle the vinegar mixture over the asparagus
17. Chill for one more hour

title: sesame lemon marinated chicken
steps:
1. Wash chicken and pat dry with paper towels
2. Set aside
3. In a gallon-size zip-lock plastic bag , combine the lemon juice with the next seven ingredients
4. Add the chicken
5. Turn the sealed bag to coat and marinate in the refrigerator for eight hours
6. Turn occasionally
7. Remove chicken from the marinade
8. Reserving marinade
9. Pour the reserved marinade into a small saucepot
10. Bring to a boil
11. Reduce the cooking flame
12. Simmer for two minutes
13. Set aside
14. Coat the grill rack with cooking spray
15. Place chicken on preheated grill over medium heat
16. Sprinkle toasted sesame seeds over chicken
17. Grill chicken until it is fork tender and juices run clear , turning occasionally and brushing frequently with marinade

title: orange  honey  and chipotle glaze
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients except chiles in a saucepan and boil until reduced to 1 / 3 cup , about 30 minutes
2. Stir in chiles
3. Use as a glaze in the last few minutes of grilling , or as a sauce when baking or roasting

title: kicking southern style collard greens
steps:
1. Heat oil in large pot of medium high heat
2. Add bacon , cook until crisp and remove from pan
3. Crumble and return to pan
4. Add onion and cook with bacon until tender , about 5 minutes
5. Add garlic and cook until fragrant
6. Add collard greens , cook until they start to wilt
7. Add chicken broth , salt , and pepper
8. Bring to boil , reduce hit , and simmer for about 45 minutes

title: grandma s butternut frosting
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in order
2. Mix well
3. Use to frost pound cake or bake cake in 3 layers and frost the butternut pound cake

title: rich and hearty pork chops
steps:
1. Cut fat and bone from pork chops
2. In a shallow bowl , mix the flour , salt and pepper
3. Heat shortening in a large skillet
4. Dredge the pork chops in flour mixture
5. Cook pork chops for about 4 minutes on each side or until browned
6. Place pork chops in a single layer in an ungreased roasting pan or 13 x 9 x 2 baking dish
7. In another bowl , combine mushroom soup , chicken broth , half the container of sour cream and rosemary with a wisk
8. Pour over pork chops
9. Sprinkle half the can of fried onions on top
10. Bake at 350 degrees for about 45 minutes
11. Then , stir remaining sour cream into gravy
12. Sprinkle remaining can of fried onions on top of pork chops
13. Return to oven and bake uncovered for about ten more minutes

title: santa fe casserole
steps:
1. Brown ground beef in skillet , stirring untill no more pink remains
2. Drain fat
3. Add taco seasoning and mix well
4. In small bowl wisk together flour and chicken broth
5. Add to meat mixture and bring to a boil , cooking untill slightly thickened
6. Stir in sour cream and green chilies
7. In lightly greased baking dish place 1 / 2 of the chips 1 / 2 of the beef 1 / 2 of the picante sauce 1 / 2 of cheese and 1 / 2 of onions
8. Repeat layers with remaining 1 / 2 of ingredients , ending with onions
9. Bake at 350 for 25 minutes or until hot and cheese is melted
10. Let stand 5 minutes before serving

title: blueberry cake with brown sugar sauce
steps:
1. For the cake , cream sugar and shortening
2. Add egg and vanilla , mix and then add all dry ingredients alternately with milk , stirring to mix completely
3. Add blueberries last and pour into 9" x 9" baking dish
4. Bake for 35-40 minutes at 300 degree or until centre is set
5. For the sauce , mix brown sugar , flour and salt together in a saucepan
6. Add boiling water and cook over low heat until thickened
7. Add butter and vanilla last
8. Stir and serve over warm blueberry cake

title: moist cornbread muffins
steps:
1. Heat oven to 425f
2. Grease two 12 muffin tins or line with liners
3. Put all dry ingredients in large bowl and mix well
4. Add buttermilk , mayonnaise , butter and shortening to dry ingredients
5. Mix well
6. Add eggs and blend thoroughly
7. Pour into prepared muffin tins and bake 10-12 minutes till lightly browned
8. Use toothpick to test for doneness

title: oven roasted sweet  potato wedges
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Peel potatoes and cut into 1" wedges
3. In a large bowl , toss potatoes with oil
4. Mix sugar and seasonings together and add to potatoes
5. Toss until evenly coated
6. Spread on a non stick baking sheet and roast for 30 minutes , turning every 10 minutes until browned and done

title: pop up pizza casserole
steps:
1. Brown meat
2. Add all but cheese
3. Simmer 10 minutes , stirring occasionally
4. In a small bowl , beat the milk , oil and eggs for 1 minute on medium speed
5. Add flour and salt , beat 2 minutes more on medium speed until smooth
6. Pour hot meat mixture into a 13x9 inch pan
7. Place cheese on top
8. Pour batter over cheese , covering filling completely
9. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese
10. Bake 25-30 minutes at 400 degrees
11. Serve immediately

title: bacon and egg casserole
steps:
1. Cook bacon crisply and crumble
2. Coat a 9x12x2 casserole dish with vegetable spray
3. Place croutons in casserole and pour margarine over them
4. Sprinkle grated cheese over all
5. Mix milk , eggs and mustard and pour over cheese
6. Sprinkle bacon crumbs over all
7. Bake at 325f for 45 minutes
8. Allow casserole to stand for 15 minutes

title: classic vanilla ice cream
steps:
1. Bring milk and cream to boiling point in saucepan
2. Remove from heat and stir in vanilla
3. Whisk eggs and sugar together with a little milk
4. Place bowl over saucepan of simmering water
5. Whisk in milk until mixture thickens slightly
6. Pour into a metal tray and semi freeze
7. Beat well in a bowl
8. Put back into freezer over night

title: shrimp and green chile enchiladas
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 350 and oil a medium-size casserole dish
2. Bring the chicken broth to a simmer in a saucepan
3. Cut the shrimp into bite-sized pieces and cook in the broth for 3-4 minutes or until pink
4. Remove the shrimp to a bowl and save the broth
5. Cook the onion , garlic and mushrooms in the butter until softabout 10 minutes
6. Add the flour and stir well
7. Add 1 cup of the saved chicken broth and simmer until thickened
8. Stir in the shrimp , salt and pepper
9. Using a hand blender or food processor , blend the green chile sauce , chopped chiles , and remaining 1 cup of the saved chicken broth
10. Heat the sauce in a small skillet and keep warm
11. Steam the corn tortillas a few at a time in the microwave
12. Put them in a plastic food bag and heat for 10-15 seconds on high , or just until softened
13. Dip each tortilla into the green chile sauce , fill with about cup of the shrimp & mushroom mixture
14. Roll and place seam side down in a lightly oiled casserole
15. When all the tortillas have been rolled , pour the remaining sauce on top
16. Sprinkle with cheese
17. Bake 25 minutes
18. Sprinkle with chopped tomatoes and serve
19. The usual mexican-style accompaniments for enchiladas are great served with theserefried beans , ensalada de col , guacamole , etc

title: chiles rellenos puffs
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400f spray 24 regular-size muffin cups with cooking spray
2. In 3-quart saucepan , heat water and butter over high heat to a full rolling boil
3. Remove from heat
4. Stir in flour , cornmeal and salt until mixture forms a dough and all lumps have disappeared
5. Gradually stir in beaten eggs until well blended
6. Stir in both cheeses and the chiles
7. Spoon dough evenly into muffin cups , filling each 3 / 4 full
8. Bake 25 to 29 minutes or until golden brown
9. Cool 2 minutes
10. Remove from muffin cups
11. Serve warm

title: pumpkin and spinach pizza
steps:
1. Heat oven to 220 c
2. Line 2 baking trays with baking paper
3. Place bases on trays , spread with pesto
4. Sprinkle on 1 / 2 the cheese , top with spinach
5. Add tomatoes and pumpkin and rest of cheese
6. Bake 15 - 20 mins till bases are golden and pumpkin cooked through
7. Season as desired

title: baked herbed  potatoes
steps:
1. Scrub potatoes , leaving the skins on cut into small cubes , 1 / 2" to 3 / 4" pieces
2. Place in a colander and rinse under cold water , shake to remove excess water
3. Drizzle with olive oil , stir and drizzle with a little more olive oil , stir again and shake to remove excess
4. In a zipper type food storage bag add the remaining ingredients , shake to blend
5. Add potatoes and shake yet again
6. Place on a baking sheet sprayed with non-stick spray-or-my favorite line the baking sheet with non-stick foil , not only does it work great but you usually have a clean pan afterwards !
7. Place potatoes single layer in pan
8. Bake 350' 40 minutes , turning at the half way point

title: chilled lemon sunset
steps:
1. Combine 1 / 2 cup water and sugar in small saucepan ovr medium-high heat
2. Bring to boil , stirring to dissolve sugar
3. Cook 1 minute , transfer mixture to bowl
4. Cool to room temperature
5. Chill 1 hour
6. Combine remaining 1 cup water , sugar , syrup , sorbet , orange juice and lemon juice in blender container
7. Puree
8. Pour 1 teaspoon grenadine into bottom of each of 4 glasses
9. Pour in sorbet mixture and garnish each with 1 lemon slice
10. Serve immediately

title: japanese noodles in miso soup  miso nikomi udon
steps:
1. Cut the chicken into small pieces and salt lightly
2. Soak the shiitake in water until the tops are soft
3. Remove the stems and cook briefly in a small amount of water flavored with soy sauce and sugar , to flavor mildly
4. I would use about 1 / 4 cup water with 2 to 3 teaspoons each soy sauce and sugar
5. Prepare the aburage by placing it in a metal sieve in the sink and pouring 1 to 2 cups boiling water over each side , being careful not to burn yourself
6. This is to remove some of the oil
7. Rinse in warm water , squeeze dry and cut into 3 by 1 / 2 cm rectangles
8. Wash and scrape the gobo with the edge of a knife , and cut into slivers , as if you are sharpening a pencil , into a bowl of water
9. Cut the green onion into thin slices
10. Peel the hard boiled eggs and slice horizontally
11. Stir the miso and dashi together and strain
12. Place miso mixture into a large pan
13. Add the milk and just bring to a boil
14. Immediately lower the heat to simmer
15. Boil the udon in a lot of boiling water in a separate pan
16. Stop cooking when the udon is still a little firm
17. Drain and rinse under cold running water to remove starch
18. Add the drained udon , chicken , drained shiitake , aburage , and gobo to the pan containing the simmering miso mixture , in this order
19. When the udon and chicken are cooked through add the kamaboko and green onion and increase heat so that the soup will just boil up once more
20. Remove from heat , divide into individual bowls , garnish with hard boiled egg slices and sprinkle on sansho

title: skillet beef and macaroni
steps:
1. Cook beef , onion and italian seasoning in skillet until browned
2. Pour off fat
3. Add soup , water and corn
4. Heat to a boil
5. Cover and cook over low heat 5 minutes or until corn is tender
6. Add pasta and heat through
7. Sprinkle with cheese

title: sweet fizzy smoothie
steps:
1. Place in your blender the cantaloupe , the banana broken into pieces , the grapes , and the seltzer
2. Blend until they come together as a smoothie
3. Add a little more seltzer if you need it
4. Enjoy !

title: black bean and corn tuna salad
steps:
1. Combine mayo and creole seasoning
2. Drain tuna and corn
3. Drain and rinse black beans
4. Combine all with the seasoned mayo
5. Enjoy on a corn tortilla !

title: fried potatoes and squash
steps:
1. Heat oil over medium high heat in large , flat-bottomed skillet
2. Slice potatoes and squash into rounds
3. Slice onions and separate into rings
4. Layer in hot oil , starting with potatoes
5. Sprinkle each complete layer lightly with flour , salt and pepper
6. Continue to fry , turning occasionally for even browning
7. Drain on paper toweling

title: orange chili vinaigrette
steps:
1. Whisk together all the ingredients
2. Chill and serve

title: easy moroccan orange cake
steps:
1. Preheat your oven to 350 f
2. Grease and flour a tube pan
3. If using fresh oranges , zest and juice them
4. With an electric mixer or by hand , beat together the eggs and sugar until thick
5. Gradually beat in the oil
6. Stir in the flour , baking powder and salt , and then the orange juice
7. Beat until smooth , and then mix in the zest and vanilla
8. Pour the batter into your prepared pan , and bake for about 40 minutes , or until the cake tests done
9. Allow the cake to cool in the pan for 7 to 10 minutes , then turn out onto a rack to finish cooling
10. Garnish with slivered almonds and powdered sugar if desired

title: chocolate stout float
steps: 1. Scoop ice cream into a pint glass and pour stout over top

title: chicken   wild rice soup   mmmmmmmmm
steps:
1. Bring rice to boil , then reduce heat& simmer 10 minutes
2. Add broccoli& carrots
3. Simmer 5 minutes
4. Add soup& cream cheese
5. Stir until melted
6. Just before serving , top each serving with slivered almonds , if desired

title: broccoli with almond breadcrumb topping
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees
2. Cook the broccoli in boiling water for 2 minutes , and drain
3. Rinse with cold water , and drain well
4. Place the broccoli in an 11 x 7 inch baking dish
5. Combine the breadcrumbs , cheese , almonds , basil , oregano and 1 / 4 teaspoon each salt and black pepper , and sprinkle the crumb mixture evenly over the broccoli
6. Bake at 450f degrees for 15 minutes or until the topping is golden

title: blender yeast rolls
steps:
1. In a blender , combine the warm milk , yeast , sugar , eggs and oil
2. Cover and process on low speed for 30 seconds or until blended
3. In a large bowl , combine the flour and salt
4. Add the yeast mixture and stir with a spoon until combined
5. Cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled in size , about 30 minutes
6. Stir dough down
7. Fill greased muffin cups half full
8. Cover and let rise ntil doubled , about 30 minutes
9. Bake at 350 for 18-20 minutes or until golden
10. Serve warm

title: canadian bacon and chicken pasta bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Cook pasta according to package directions without added fat or salt
3. In a large skillet sprayed with nonstick cooking spray saut chicken , onion , garlic , green pepper for 10-15 minutes
4. Add zucchini , tomatoes , tomato paste and red pepper
5. Cover and simmer 10-15 minutes , stirring frequently
6. In a prepared 9-x 13-inch baking dish layer pasta , ricotta cheese , canadian bacon and sauce
7. Sprinkle with mozzarella and parmesan cheese
8. Bake uncovered 15-20 minutes or until cheese is melted and dish is warmed throughout

title: anita baker s smothered chicken
steps:
1. Heat olive oil and 1 tablespoon butter in a large heavy skillet set over medium heat
2. Season chicken with salt and pepper , rubbing it into the skin
3. Add chicken , skin-side down to the skillet
4. Cook , turning once , until well browned
5. Remove and set aside
6. Melt remaining 4 tablespoons butter in the same skillet
7. Sprinkle in flour and cook , whisking constantly , until golden brown
8. Add onion and cook until softened , about 2 minutes
9. Whisk in chicken broth
10. Bring to a boil
11. Return chicken to skillet
12. Cook , partially covered , until chicken is cooked through and sauce has thickened
13. Transfer to a serving platter
14. Garnish with parsley
15. Serve immediately

title: broiled herb chicken with lemon butter sauce
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine the salt , oregano , garlic powder , lemon pepper , paprika and red pepper
2. Cover a roasting pan with foil and place a rack in it
3. Lightly spray the rack with cooking spray
4. Skin side down , place the chicken on the rack
5. Sprinkle the chicken with 2 t of the seasoning mixture
6. Making sure your oven rack is about 7-8" from the heat , broil the chicken until golden brown
7. Turn the chicken pieces over and sprinkle with the remaining spice mixture
8. Broil about 8-10 more minutes , or until chicken is done
9. Lemon butter sauce: combine the melted butter , lemon rind and lemon juice
10. Mix well and add in the parsley
11. Spoon a small amount of sauce over each piece of chicken when served

title: easy enough creamy lemon meringue pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325f
2. In a medium bowl beat egg yolks well
3. Stir in condensed milk , lemon juice , lemon peel and food coloring , if desired
4. This will thicken
5. Pour mixture in pie crust and bake 30 minute at 325f
6. Preparing the meringue
7. Beat egg whites , vanilla , and cream of tarter in a large bowl with a electric mixer on medium speed until soft peaks form
8. Add sugar gradually , turning up mixer on high speed , until stiff peaks form
9. Turn oven up to 350f
10. Spread meringue on top of hot pie filling all over the entire pie
11. Put in oven and bake another 15 minutes or until golden brown
12. Take out of oven and cool on stove or counter top for at least 1 hour
13. Place in refrigerator and chill at least 2 to 3 hours before serving

title: cabbage and tomato chicken soup
steps:
1. Cover chicken with water in a large pot
2. Cook 1 hour and remove chicken
3. Meanwhile , prepare remaining ingredients , and add to pot after removing chicken , and cook for 1 hour
4. Meanwhile , place chicken in baking dish and roast it in a 350 f oven for 30 minutes
5. After roasting , let chicken cool for 10 minutes before removing meat from the carcass and adding the meat to the soup pot
6. Simmer until the meat is heated through , and serve

title: feta  avocado and tomato in vinaigrette
steps:
1. Halve the avocado lengthwise and take out the stone
2. Skin and cut avocados into slices
3. Pour vinaigrette over avocado slices
4. Stir them if necessary to coat them completely to prevent discolouration
5. Cut each tomato into 8ths , mix together with cheese and olives
6. Drizzle the vinaigrette dressing over the top and sprinkle with the chopped marjoram

title: chocolate pixies  modified with cocoa powder
steps:
1. Combine cocoa with oil
2. Add sugar
3. Add eggs , one at a time
4. Add vanilla
5. Sift together flour , baking powder and salt
6. Add to cocoa mixture
7. Chill for an hour
8. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
9. Drop by teaspoon in powdered sugar , coating entirely
10. Bake on a greased cookie sheet for 10 minutes
11. Remove immediately , taking care so as to retain shape
12. Cookie will be solid on the outside and soft on the inside

title: crustless  lime  cheesecake
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 325f
2. Place the cream cheese and sugar in a large bowl and beat well
3. Beat in the eggs , one at a time
4. Add the lime juice and spoon the mixture into a greased 9-inch glass pie plate
5. Bake for 45 to 50 minutes , until golden brown
6. Remove from the oven and let cool for 10 to 15 minutes
7. Meanwhile , in another large bowl , mix together the topping ingredients
8. Spread over the top of the cheesecake and bake for 10 minutes longer ,
9. Let cool , then refrigerate for 4 hours or overnight
10. Cover the cheesecake with fresh berries before serving , if you like

title: port cranberry sauce
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan , combine the port with the orange zest and orange juice and bring to a boil
2. Add the cranberries and sugar and simmer over moderately low heat until the sauce is jamlike , about 25 minutes
3. Transfer to a bowl and serve warm or at room temperature

title: rice with garlic and pasta
steps:
1. In a medium sauce pan brown the pasta in the oil until golden brown
2. Add chicken broth bring to a boil
3. Add rice and garlic
4. Cover and cook over low heat 20 minutes
5. Remove from heat and let rest for ten minutes
6. Stir and enjoy

title: college student icebox sandwiches
steps:
1. Mix pudding and milk according to package directions and refrigerate until set
2. Fold in whipped topping and chocolate chips
3. Place 24 graham crackers on a baking sheet
4. Top each with about 3 tablespoons filling
5. Place another graham cracker on top
6. Freeze for 1 hour or until firm
7. Wrap individually in plastic wrap
8. Freeze for 1 hour or until firm
9. Serve sandwiches frozen

title: chicken castellina
steps:
1. Sauce:
2. In a 3-qt sauce pan or large pot , saut pancetta over medium / high heat until crisp and golden
3. Lower heat , add butter and melt
4. Add garlic and sun-dried tomatoes
5. Saut for approximately one minute stirring frequently
6. Whisk in cream , milk and cornstarch
7. Raise heat to medium / high
8. Whisk in parmesan and gouda
9. Once cheese melts , add remaining ingredients and bring to a boil stirring continuously
10. Remove from heat and let stand uncovered
11. Chicken & pasta preparation:
12. Mix flour with salt and pepper
13. Coat chicken in seasoned flour , shake off excess flour
14. Heat olive oil in large saut pan
15. Add chicken in a single layer and cook until golden brown on both sides
16. Using a meat thermometer , make sure the internal temperature of the thickest piece of chicken reaches 165 degrees
17. Begin pasta in a separate pot according to package directions
18. Add wine to chicken in pan
19. Toss gently until wine is evaporated
20. Once reduced , add sauce and bring to a boil on medium / high heat
21. Place 6 oz of cooked pasta on each plate
22. Evenly distribute chicken and sauce over pasta
23. Garnish with chopped parsley

title: plain popovers
steps:
1. Put flour and salt on paper towel
2. Put milk in a bowl and add eggs
3. Break eggs& yoke by lifting a fork under them 2 or 3 times do not beat it
4. Add flour and salt all at once
5. With a fork fold into milk and leave it very lumpy
6. Liberally spray an 8 cup muffin tin with pam
7. Fill cups 3 / 4 full
8. Place in a cold oven
9. Set oven to 450 degrees and cook 30 to 35 minutes
10. A 12 cup muffin tin can be used but the cooking time must be adjusted lower
11. These have always come out crisp outside , soft inside and puffy
12. They can be done ahead and reheated as well

title: smoky pesto cheeseburgers
steps:
1. Slice zucchini lengthwise into 1 / 4 inch thick slices
2. Place in bowl
3. Add oil , salt and pepper
4. Toss
5. Place on greased grill over medium heat
6. Close lid and grill turning once , until tender , 15 to 20 minutes
7. Burgers: in large bowl , beat egg with pesto
8. Stir in bread crumbs , onion , mustard , salt and pepper
9. Add beef
10. Mix just until combined
11. Shape into four 3 / 4 inch thick patties
12. Place patties on greased grill over medium heat
13. Close lid and gril , turning once , until digital thermometer reads 160f , 12 to 14 minutes
14. Top with cheese
15. Grill until melted , about 2 minutes
16. Top with zucchini
17. Sandwich in buns

title: sweet cherry chutney
steps:
1. Add all ingredients except raisins in a large stainless or enamel pot
2. Bring to a full rolling boil stirring constantly until sugar is dissolved
3. Reduce heat a bit to a gentle boil , stirring frequently until mixture thickens , about 60 minutes
4. Stir in raisins and boil for 5 more minutes
5. Ladle into clean hot jars leaving 1 / 2 inch head space
6. Process 10 minutes in a boiling water bath at altitudes up to 1000 feet

title: lamb shanks my way
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350
2. Brown the shanks in oil in a frying pan
3. Place shanks in a roasting pan
4. Spread mustard on shanks
5. Sprinkle on the oregano , salt and pepper
6. Brown onions , carrots and celery
7. Add onions and celery to the roasting pan
8. In the browing pan add the consomme and burgundy wine reduce by 1 / 3
9. Pour over the shanks along with garlic
10. Place in oven approx 2 1 / 2 hours
11. Turn shanks several times
12. Adding more broth if needed

title: jeni s lemon herb tilapia
steps:
1. Place tilapia in a glass baking dish in a single layer
2. Mix herbs in a bowl , and mix together
3. Sprinkle herb mixture evenly over fish
4. Cut butter into small chunks and place evenly over tilapia
5. Place sliced lemons over fish and butter , about 2-3 slices per piece
6. Cover pan , and bake at 350 until fish is done , about 20 minutes

title: crunchy deep fried chicken wings
steps:
1. Preheat deep fryer to 375 degrees , and oven to 250 degrees
2. Combine garfava bean flour , cornstarch , tapioca starch , sorghum flour and stubbs seasoning in a plastic container with a lid
3. Shake to mix well
4. Combine egg and milk in a bowl and beat until mixed well
5. Put chicken in the container of flour , and shake to coat
6. Shake off extra flour , dip in egg mixture , then return to container of flour for another shake
7. Remove from flour , shake off excess , and move to plate
8. Continue to coat remaining pieces of chicken
9. Select largest pieces of chicken first
10. Dip chicken in flour one more time just prior to putting in fryer , and shake off excess flour
11. Fry chicken pieces for about 10 minutes , or until golden brown and juices are running clear
12. Do not cook all chicken at one time , or your oil will cool down too much
13. I cook "drummies" with "drummies" and "flatties" with "flatties"
14. When finished frying , move to wire rack on cookie sheet , and put in preheated oven while frying other pieces
15. Serving suggestions:
16. Wings may be served "naked" , with sauces on the side , or tossed in sauce
17. You could also tweak the seasonings and serve with sesame our sweet and sour sauce

title: commander s shrimp   andouille sausage with creole mustard
steps:
1. Heat a heavy skillet and saute sausage
2. Drain off fat and discard
3. Add shrimp , scallions , mushrooms , and garlic and saute 1 minute
4. Remove from the skillet and set aside
5. Pour in the wine to deglaze the pan and cook until reduced by half
6. Add cream and reduce by one-third
7. Stir in mustard and worcestershire sauce
8. Season with salt and pepper
9. Return sausage and shrimp mixture to the skillet and cook for about 2 minutes to heat well
10. Serve over pasta

title: shape magazine s brown rice  oat and cherry custard
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Lightly coat 4 8 oz
3. Custard cups with cooking spray and place in a deep roasting pan / casserole dish , leaving space around each cup for water
4. Spoon 1 / 4 of rice and oats into the bottom of each cup and sprinkle with cinnamon
5. In a medium bowl , beat together eggs , sugar , vanilla and milk
6. Gently pour over the rice and oats
7. Add 1 / 4 of dried cherries to each cup
8. Place pan on the middle oven rack
9. Pour very hot tap water into pan to about 2 / 3 of the way from the top of cups
10. Bake for 35 minutes or until a knife inserted in center of one custard comes out clean
11. Remove custards from water and set aside to cool to room temperature
12. Serve warm or refrigerate for later use

title: buttered spinach and rice
steps:
1. Melt butter in a saucepan with tight-fitting lid
2. Gently saute the onion for 3 or 4 minutes
3. Stir in the chopped tomatoes
4. Add the rice and crushed garlic , gently cook for 5 minutes
5. Gradually add the stock or water , stirring constantly
6. Season to taste with salt and pepper
7. Cover and simmer gently for 10-15 minutes , till rice is almost cooked , then reduce heat to low
8. Spread the spinach in a thick layer over the rice
9. Cover the pan and cook over low heat , 5-8 minutes , till spinach has wilted and rice is tender

title: dessert fruit skewers
steps:
1. Place fruit in marinade for a few minutes
2. Skewer fruit on pre-soaked bamboo skewers
3. Spray grill with oil and bbq fruit on medium heat , turning to caramelize marinade
4. Cook until grill marks form
5. Mix hazelnut spread with rum and serve over hot fruit
6. I added a handful of fresh , wild blueberries for a little zing
7. Option: serve over vanilla ice cream

title: mashed potato stuffed bell peppers
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 350 degrees
2. Slice the tops off the peppers , just below the stem , to make a cup
3. Seed them , & remove the spines
4. Gently parboil peppers for about 5 minutes , remove& drain upside down
5. Saute onion& red pepper in oil until onions are soft
6. Add salt& pepper , chives , & mix into the mashed potatoes
7. Stuff the peppers
8. Stand peppers in a deep-sided casserole dish& pour the tomato sauce into the bottom
9. Bake at 350 degrees , covered , about 20 minutes
10. Uncover , & bake 5 minutes longer
11. Serve hot

title: meatballs in beer
steps:
1. Brown onion in butter , salt , pepper and nutmeg
2. Mix pork , beef and dry bread rolled into crumbs
3. Combine with onions
4. Add the egg
5. Mix well , and form into small balls
6. Roll them in a small amount of flour
7. Brown the meat balls in the 3 tablespoons of butter
8. When well browned , add beer and lemon juice
9. Cover and let simmer 30 minutes
10. Serve with buttered noodles sprinkled with toasted crumbs

title: ground turkey lettuce wraps
steps:
1. In a large mixing bowl , combine the ground turkey , lemon grass paste , fish sauce and salt / pepper until thoroughly mixed and let sit for 10 minutes
2. In a large saucepan or wok , heat peanut oil and stir fry the green onions , serrano peppers , ginger , mushrooms , water chestnuts , and garlic until soft
3. Now add the ground turkey and hoisin sauce then cook until done
4. Chop the fresh herbs as above and place each in an individual serving container
5. To make the sauce: in a small mixing bowl , soak the crushed red pepper in lime juice for several minutes add the garlic , sugar , and fish sauce and stir to dissolve the sugar
6. Transfer to a serving container and add the grated carrots and serve at room temperature refrigerated , the sauce will keep in a tightly covered container for up to 5 days
7. To serve: arrange lettuce on a large platter surrounded by the containers of chopped herbs , etc
8. And the sauce
9. To make a wrap take a lettuce leaf in hand , scoop a large tablespoon of meat on to lettuce leaf , then add any herbs that you like
10. Add a teaspoon of sauce onto the mixture on the leaf and then roll and eat
11. Yum !

title: lemon and condensed milk biscuits  botswana
steps:
1. Cream together the butter and sugar , then add the condensed milk and keep blending until well mixed
2. Add the lemon juice and grated zest , then sift together the dry ingredients and add that too
3. Keep blending until the ingredients are well-incorporated
4. Take teaspoons of dough and roll them into balls , then place them on a greased baking sheet and flatten gently with a fork
5. Bake at about 335 degrees for 12 to 15 minutes , or until starting to brown underneath
6. Let cool , then dust with powdered sugar

title: grandma s raisin filled cookies
steps:
1. Raisin mixture: soak raisins in hot water
2. When plumb and soft , drain water and grind
3. Put in saucepan and add sugar , salt , and water
4. Mix the flour with just enough water to make smooth paste , then add to raisin mixture
5. Let come to boil , then set off to cool
6. Cookie: in large mixing bowl , cream together butter& sugar
7. Beat in eggs
8. Add milk and vanilla
9. Mix until well blended
10. Combine dry ingredients together and add to butter mixture
11. Roll out onto flour surface to about 1 / 4 inch thickness
12. Cut with round cutter
13. Lay on cookie sheet , and add 1 tablespoon ground raisin mixture to each cookie
14. Top with another round cookie , pinch sides together
15. Bake@ 350 8-10 minutes or until just starting to brown

title: tasmanian pepper poached salmon with orange
steps:
1. Finely grate 1 / 2 teaspoon of zest from the lemon
2. Wrap the grated zest in plastic
3. Using a vegetable peeler , remove the remaining zest from the lemon in wide strips
4. Cut the strips into thin julienne
5. Squeeze 1 tablespoon of juice from the lemon
6. In a medium skillet , combine the olive oil with the pepper berries and the lemon julienne and bring to a boil
7. Simmer the oil over low heat for 20 minutes
8. Pour the oil through a fine strainer set over a bowl , pressing on the solids
9. Return the oil to the skillet and bring to a simmer
10. Add the salmon fillets , season with salt and pepper and simmer over moderately low heat until cooked on the bottom , about 5 minutes
11. Using a metal spatula , carefully turn the fillets over and cook until just opaque throughout , about 5 minutes longer
12. Transfer the salmon to a warmed platter or plates
13. Ladle out all but 1 / 4 cup of the olive oil and set the skillet over moderately high heat
14. Add the lemon juice and orange juice and boil for 1 minute
15. Remove the skillet from the heat
16. Add the grated lemon zest and gradually whisk in the butter
17. Season the sauce with salt , pour it over the salmon fillets and serve

title: death by chocolate in a trifle bowl
steps:
1. First , cut the frozen cake into squares
2. I first cut the cake into half and it's easier this way
3. Take 1 / 2 of the cake that you cut into squares and place them in the bottom of the trifle bowl
4. Put 1 can of the pudding on top of the cake then spread 1 carton of the cool whip on top of the pudding
5. I put the candy bars in a ziploc bag and crush with a rolling pin , put 1 / 2 of the candy mixture on top of the cool whip
6. Then put the remaining cake , pudding , cool whip and top with remaining candy bars on top
7. This needs a warning , very addictive

title: tender glazed pork chops
steps:
1. Combine the onion powder , garlic powder and oregano
2. Sprinkle over pork chops
3. In a small saucepan , combine the apricot preserves , lime juice and lemon juice
4. Cook and stir over low heat for 10 minutes or until preserves are melted
5. Meanwhile , in a large skillet , cook pork in oil over medium-low heat for 8-10 minutes or until lightly browned on one side
6. Turn chops
7. Generously brush with apricot glaze
8. Cook 8-10 minutes longer or until juices run clear
9. Serve with remaining glaze

title: finnish mustard  which goes with everything
steps:
1. Mix the mustard powder , sugar and salt together in a bowl
2. Squash out any lumps with the back of a spoon
3. Mix the cream , oil , vinegar and lemon juice in a small saucepan
4. Add the mustard powder mix to the pot , stir constantly with a whisk or spoon , and bring to the boil
5. Simmer 7 - 8 minutes , stirring very often
6. Remove from heat when it darkens and thickens
7. Cool , but stir now and then while it's cooling
8. Pour into a glass jar , but two smaller bottles are better
9. Keep in the fridge

title: chargrilled swordfish on warm avocado corn salad
steps:
1. Heat a non-stick pan to high , add the oil and sear the swordfish for 1 to 2 minutes or until starting to soften
2. Remove from pan
3. Cover with foil and keep warm in a low oven
4. Add the shallot , corn and red pepper to pan and cook , stirring for 1 to 2 minutes or until starting to soften
5. Add the avocado , coriander and white wine
6. Cover and steam for 1 minute until heated through
7. Place avocado corn mixture on heated plates and top with swordfish
8. Add lemon and vinegar to the pan and whisk into pan juices
9. Pour over the fish and serve immediately

title: bugeah s peanut chicken
steps:
1. Mix peanut sauce ingredients and set aside
2. Heat 2 tbs peanut oil in a large skillet or wok on medium-high heat
3. Add chicken and cook until chicken is cooked through
4. Remove from skillet and set aside
5. Heat remaining 2 tbs of peanut oil in the skillet
6. Add veggies and saute until tender crisp
7. Toss the veggies with the chicken and peanut sauce , then serve over rice
8. You should have plenty of leftover sauce for that

title: italian stuffed peppers
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f
2. In a large bowl , mix ground beef , ricotta cheese , 1 / 2 cup mozzarella , salt , pepper and half the tomato sauce until well combined
3. Slice tops off peppers and remove seeds and ribs
4. With a small knife , cut a few small slits in the bottom of each pepper to drain liquid released by the filling as it cooks
5. Select a baking dish that will hold the peppers snugly
6. Pour remaining sauce in bottom of the dish
7. Arrange peppers , open side up , and stuff with the filling mixture
8. Top with remaining mozzarella cheese
9. Spray a large piece of aluminum foil with nonstick spray
10. Place sprayed side down over peppers
11. Bake , covered , 30 minutes
12. Uncover and baked 50 minutes more , or until meat has cooked through and cheese is bubbly ,

title: gourmet girl s famous decadent rich and gooey saucepan brownies
steps:
1. Preheat your oven to 350
2. Melt the butter in a medium saucepan
3. Remove from heat and stir in sugar and cocoa
4. Stir in the eggs , one at a time , and vanilla till just combined
5. Add flour , baking powder , and salt
6. Fold in the nuts
7. Pour into a greased 8x8x2-inch baking pan
8. Bake in oven for 25 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean
9. Do not over bake
10. Cool in pan on a wire rack

title: deep dish chicken pot pie
steps:
1. Heat over to 375
2. Cook chicken in dressing in large skillet on medium heat for 2 minute
3. Add neufchatel cheese
4. Cook and stir until melted
5. Stir in flour
6. Add broth and vegetables , stir
7. Simmer for 5 min , stirring occassionally
8. Pour into 10 inch deep dish pie plate and cover with crust
9. Flute edge
10. Cut slits in crust to allow steam to escape
11. Bake 30 minutes or until golden brown

title: apricot oat bran muffins   low fat
steps:
1. Preheat ove to 400
2. Spray 6 large 3" muffin cups with no-stick spray
3. In large bowl , stir oat bran , brown sugar and baking powder
4. Make a well in the center
5. In a small bowl , beat the egg whites until foamy
6. Stir in buttermilk and molasses
7. Add buttermilk mixture to the oat-bran mixture and stir just until moistened
8. Fold in apples and apricots
9. Spoon the batter into the prepared cups , filling each 3 / 4 full
10. Bake for 18 to 20 minutes
11. Cool in muffin cups for 5 minutes , then remove and cool on a wire rack
12. To make standar sized muffins spray 12 2 1 / 2" muffin cups with no-stick spray , spoon batter into cups
13. Bake for 15 to 17 minutes

title: charlene s apple cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease a 9x13 pan& set aside
3. In a large bowl , beat eggs& oil until well blended
4. Add sugar slowly , beating at medium speed
5. Add vanilla
6. Sift together the flour , baking powder , baking soda , salt , cinnamon& nutmeg
7. Add dry ingredients to egg / oil mixture , combining well
8. Add nuts& apples
9. Pour batter into prepared pan
10. Bake 45-60 minutes , or until cake tests done with a wooden pick or sharp knife in center
11. Cool in pan on a wire rack
12. For the 8x8 , bake approximately 45 minutes
13. 9x5 may take a little longer
14. If using one of these sizes , cool baked cake in pan 10-15 minutes before removing to a wire rack to cool

title: chocolate almond balls
steps:
1. Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy
2. Add vanilla
3. Gradually add flour
4. Stir in nuts and chocolate chips
5. Chill dough in fridge for one hour
6. Preheat oven to 325 degrees f
7. Shape into small balls
8. Place on ungreased cookie sheet
9. Bake for 12-15 minutes
10. Roll in confectioners sugar while cookie is slightly warm

title: floral garnish without the flowers  dedicated to bergy
steps:
1. Do not peel the cucumber
2. Start by cutting off 1 tapered end of the cucumber & discard it
3. Cut 3 segments from the cucumber & halve each thru the center
4. You now have 6 segments
5. Place 4 of the segments on your cutting board & cut ea diagonally so you have 8 segments that will form the petals of the flower
6. Use 1 of the last 2 segments to thinly slice the half-moon pieces that will form the stem of the flower & trim them as shown in the pic
7. Using a vegetable peeler , peel 1 or 2 strips of cucumber rind & cut into several leaf shapes as shown in the pic
8. Using a 1-inch diameter cookie cutter , cut cheese slices for the pieces that will be the center of your flower
9. Assemble the garnish on your platter as shown in the pic or as desired
10. All done !

title: jen s spinach chicken enchiladas
steps:
1. Blend all sauce ingredients together in a blender
2. For the filling , mix chicken , cheese and 1 reserved cup of sauce
3. Coat the bottom of a 9x13" pan with some of the sauce
4. Fill flour tortillas with the chicken mixture , roll and line up in your pan
5. Cover with remaining sauce and extra jack cheese
6. Bake at 375 degrees for approx
7. 20 minutes or until sauce is bubbly and cheese is melted

title: arroz con pollo with salsa verde  rice and chicken casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Mix spice paste in a small bowl
3. Wash chicken , pat dry
4. Rub chicken with spice paste , refrigerate 30 minutes , 60 is better
5. In a dutch oven heat remaining oil over medium heat
6. Fry chorizo'til crisp , remove , dry on paper towel
7. Add chicken , skin side down , brown well on all sides
8. Remove , drain on paper towel
9. Make a sofrito , saute the onion , garlic , bell pepper , and bay leaves'til they are almost disolved
10. Remove bay leaves
11. Stir in rice , coat well with sofrito
12. Add tomatoes and stock
13. Season with salt and pepper
14. Place chorizo and chicken on top of rice mixture
15. Bring to a boil , simmer 5 minutes
16. Cover pot , transfer to oven
17. Bake 20 minutes'til rice is done and has absorbed the liquid
18. ---salsaverde---
19. Puree all salsa ingredients'til smooth
20. Garnish arroz con pollo with salsa verde and green olives just before serving

title: rosemary grilled pork tenderloins
steps:
1. Pour mixture of wine vinegar , 1 / 2 cup olive oil , water , garlic , 2 tbls mustard , salt , sugar , basil , and 1 / 8 tsp pepper over pork tenderloins in a sealable plastic bag
2. Marinate in refrigerator for 8 hours or longer , turning occasionally
3. Drain , discarding marinade
4. Pat tenderloins dry with paper towel
5. Rub mixture of honey , brown sugar , molasses , 1 tbls mustard , 1 tbs olive oil , soy sauce , ginger , and 1 / 2 tsp pepper on all sides of tenderloins
6. Sprinkle with rosemary leaves
7. Place tenderloins on grill rack over medium-hot coals spiked with wet pecan or mesquite wood chips
8. Grill for 10 to 15 minutes or until cooked through , turning once
9. Remove to serving platter
10. Cut each tenderloin into 12 medallions just before serving

title: bistro chicken with peppers
steps:
1. Preheat broiler
2. Cut bell peppers in half lengthwise , and discard seeds and membranes
3. Place pepper halves , skin sides up , on a foil-lined baking sheet
4. Flatten with hand
5. Broil 15 minutes or until blackened
6. Alternately , you can blacken the skins on a gas range
7. Place the peppers in a paper or zip-top plastic bag
8. Seal
9. Let stand 20 minutes
10. Peel and cut into strips
11. Set aside
12. Combine salt and garlic on a cutting board
13. Chop until mixture becomes a coarse paste
14. Rub garlic mixture over chicken
15. Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
16. Add chicken
17. Cook 5 minutes or until golden , turning once
18. Add onions
19. Cook 1 minute , stirring frequently
20. Add broth , curry , tarragon , and crushed fennel
21. Cover , reduce heat , and simmer 8 minutes
22. Add peppers
23. Cook 5 minutes or until chicken is done
24. Serve with rice or potatoes

title: panda express   thai cashew chicken
steps:
1. Cut chicken in 1 inch cubes
2. In a bowl , mix sauce of cornstarch , soy sauce , sherry , hoisin sauce and chicken broth
3. Heat oil in wok
4. When oil starts to smoke , add chicken and stir fry for 5 minues stir in bamboo shoots
5. Pour sauce over chicken and stir until sauce thickens
6. Stir in cashews
7. Garnish with mandarin orange sections , cilantro , and / or green onions sliced on the bias
8. You can check the readiness of the oil by putting the

title: sensational cucumber salad
steps:
1. In medium size bowl with tight lid , combine mayo , chili powder , garlic powder , and pepper
2. Stir well
3. Add all other ingredients except beans
4. Stir well
5. Stir in beans gently
6. This will last a couple of days and then get soggy
7. It is best an hour or so after making it

title: easy pie crust
steps:
1. Blend together the flour , sugar and salt
2. Cut in cold butter flavor crisco with pastry cutter until the mixture is evenly crumbly , and the pieces are the size of small peas
3. Add the cold water and mix with hands just until the dough holds together
4. Do not knead ! pie dough will be tough the more you work it
5. Roll out on floured board or table
6. This will give you enough dough for 2 pie crusts

title: history project chicken nuggets
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 f
2. Combine crushed cereal , parmesan cheese , seasoned salt , paprika , and garlic powder
3. Mix together the mayonnaise , honey , and mustard
4. Stir chicken strips into mayo mixture
5. Roll in cereal mixture to coat evenly
6. Place on rack in shallow baking pan
7. Bake 12-15 minutes or until strips are no longer pink in center
8. Serve hot with your favorite dipping sauces
9. My family likes bbq sauce , mixed with extra ketchup !

title: fruit salad with cranberry dressing
steps:
1. For the dressing , in a medium saucepan combine cranberries and water
2. Bring to boiling
3. Reduce heat
4. Simmer , covered , for 4-5 minutes or until berries just begin to pop
5. Remove saucepan from heat and stif in sugar and orange juice
6. When cool , press misture through a sieve
7. Discard , compost , or use the cranberry skins in something else
8. Cover and chill the dressing about 2 hours until thoroughly chilled
9. To serve line each plate / bowl with lettuce leaves and arrange fruit on top
10. Drizzle with dressing & enjoy !

title: grilled corn on the cob with roasted jalapeno butter
steps:
1. Preheat grill to medium high heat , and place jalapeno on grill rack coated with cooking spray , cover and grill 10 minutes , or until blackened , turning occasionally
2. Place jalapeno in a small paper bag , and fold tightly to seal
3. Let stand 5 minutes
4. Peel and discard skins , and cut jalapeno in half lengthwise , and discard stem , seeds , and membranes
5. Finely chop jalapeno
6. Combine jalapeno , butter , lime rind , honey , and salt in a small bowl , and stir well
7. Place corn on grill rack , cover and grill for 10 minutes , or until lightly charred , turning occasionally
8. Place corn on serving plate and brush with jalaoeno butter

title: jazzy broccoli casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. In sauce pan , cook rice according to package directions
3. Cook broccoli until just tender and drain
4. In large bowl , combine rice , broccoli , soup , sour cream , green chilies , jalapeos , jalapeo juice and 1 cup of shredded cheese
5. Put mixture in a prepared casserole dish
6. Sprinkle top with remaining cheese
7. Bake in preheated oven for 35-45 minutes

title: mushroom   garlic dip
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a frypan and add the mushrooms and salt
2. Cook over a medium heat for about 10 minutes or until very soft , and all the liquid has evaporated
3. Cool
4. Place this mixture and the remaining ingredients in a bowl and mix well
5. Season to taste with salt and pepper , and add more lemon juice if you wish

title: seafood soup with ginger broth
steps:
1. Heat oil in large saucepan or dutch oven
2. Add garlic , ginger , lemon peel and hot pepper flakes
3. Cook gently until very fragrant
4. Add broth , soy sauce and lemon juice and bring to boil
5. Add carrots
6. Reduce heat and simmer gently for 15 minutes
7. Add scallops , shrimp , sesame oil and green onions , cook for just a few minutes , or until seafood is barely cooked
8. Serve sprinkled with cilantro

title: buffalo chicken pizza
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425f
2. In a medium bowl combine the cubed chicken , melted butter and hot sauce
3. Mix well
4. Spread whole bottle salad dressing over crust , then top with chicken mixture and sprinkle with shredded cheese
5. Bake in preheated oven until crust is golden brown and cheese is bubbly , about 5-10 minutes
6. Let set a while before slicing

title: mean chef s asparagus with orange sesame butter
steps:
1. Snap the ends from the asparagus they'll break at the point of tenderness
2. Or slice the ends off closer to the root end and peel spears with a swivel-bladed vegetable peeler
3. Rinse , then soak for a few minutes in a couple of changes of cold , lightly salted water
4. Agitate lightly to release grit that may be trapped
5. Rinse well again
6. Drain and pat with paper towels to absorb moisture
7. Spread asparagus in a single layer on a large , rimmed baking sheet
8. Drizzle with olive oil and sprinkle with 1 / 4 teaspoon salt
9. Shake pan to distribute ingredients
10. Roast in a preheated 425-degree oven 12 to 15 minutes
11. Test for tenderness
12. While the asparagus is cooking , melt the butter in a small saucepan
13. Whisk in the juice concentrate , sesame oil , teaspoon salt and several grindings black pepper
14. Keep warm
15. Transfer asparagus to a serving dish
16. Drizzle with the butter , sprinkle with sesame seeds and serve immediately

title: lentil soup with ham and bacon  crock pot  slow cooker
steps:
1. Heat olive oil in saute pan over medium heat
2. Saute bacon until firm
3. Remove from heat and move to crock pot
4. Add remaning ingredients to crock pot
5. Cook on low for 8-10 hours or on high for 6-8 hours , until lentils are tender

title: paul s chambord mojito
steps:
1. Muddle the sugar & mint in a cocktail shaker
2. Add lime juice , cranraspberry juice , vodka , chambord & ice
3. Shake well
4. Pour into glasses
5. Top with soda
6. Stir
7. Garnish with mint leaves

title: penne alla vecchia bettola
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. Heat the olive oil in a large oven proof saute pan over medium heat , add the onions and garlic and cook for about 5 minutes until translucent
3. Add the red pepper flakes and dried oregano and cook for 1 minute more
4. Add the vodka and continue cooking until the mixture is reduced by half
5. Meanwhile , add the tomatoes and crush them into the pan with your hands
6. Add 2 teaspoons salt and a pinch of black pepper
7. Cover the pan with a tight fitting lid and place it in the oven for 1 1 / 2 hours
8. While the sauce simmers in the oven , prepare the cream:
9. Add cashews and non dairy milk to a blender and blend until completely pureed and smooth , set aside
10. Remove tomato sauce from the oven and let cool for 15 minutes
11. Place the tomato mixture in a blender and puree in batches until the sauce is a smooth consistency
12. Return to the pan
13. Reheat the sauce , add 2 tablespoons fresh oregano and enough cashew cream to make the sauce a creamy consistency
14. Add salt and pepper , to taste , and simmer for 10 minutes
15. Meanwhile , bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the pasta al dente
16. Drain
17. Toss the pasta into the sauce and cook for 2 minutes more

title: zucchini beef italiano
steps:
1. Sason the flour with salt & pepper &
2. Melt the butter in a pan and brown the beef over high heat
3. Transfer beef to an oven-proof casserole dish
4. Add remaining ingredients to the frypan and stir briskly until it reaches a boil
5. Pour the sauce over the beef , cover dish & bake at 180
6. C for 1 1 / 4 hours
7. Meanwhile mix the cheeses together
8. Take the casserole out of the oven and layer the zucchini over the top in a decorative pattern , sprinkle cheese over the top and bake for a further 30-45 minutes

title: southern style pork chops
steps:
1. In a skillet , brown pork chops in 1-2 tb
2. Vegetable oil , 2-3 minutes per side
3. Do not cook through
4. Place in a large dutch oven
5. Mix together sauce ingredients
6. Personally , i tend to double the sauce and put in more or less of the ingredients to your own taste
7. Pour 1 / 2 of sauce over pork chops
8. Add vegetables on top
9. Pour remaining sauce over the vegetables
10. Bake , covered , in a preheated 375 degree oven for 1 hour to 1 hour and 15 minutes , or until vegetables are tender

title: spicy mint tea
steps:
1. Steep 1 tea bag , 6 mint stems and cayenne pepper in 2 cups of boiling water
2. Strain the mixture , keeping only the liquid
3. Add the sugar , lemon juice and cinnamon stick to the mint mixture and refrigerate
4. When ready to serve , remove the cinnamon stick and dilute the mint mixture with equal parts of water
5. Serve in a tall glass with ice , add a fresh mint sprig and a lemon slice for garnishing

title: tortellini soup with kale
steps:
1. Saut leeks and garlic until tender
2. Add stock and heat to boiling
3. Stir in kale and mushrooms
4. Reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes
5. Add tortellini
6. Simmer until tender
7. Season to taste with salt and pepper

title: cocktail franks al a orange
steps:
1. Combine sugar , cornstarch , cloves and cinnamon in sauce pan
2. Blend in orange juice and vinegar
3. Cook over medium heat , stirring constantly till thick
4. Add cocktail franks and warm through
5. Keep warm in chaffing dish or crock pot

title: spiced shredded beef brisket
steps:
1. Whisk beef broth , hoisin sauce , 1 / 2 cup water , vinegar , five-spice powder and garlic powder in a small bowl
2. Place celery and carrot strips in the bottom of a large slow cooker
3. Add the brisket
4. Season on all sides with salt and pepper
5. Pour in beef broth mixture
6. Cover and cook on high heat for 5 hours or on low for 9 to 10 hours
7. Remove meat from cooking liquid to cutting board
8. Cool slightly
9. Skim any fat off top of sauce in cooker and discard
10. If necessary , increase heat to high and add bok choy to slow cooker
11. Cook 15 minutes
12. Meanwhile shred beef with two forks
13. Add back to slow cooker
14. Stir to coat with sauce and serve with soft sandwich buns or warmed flour tortillas

title: big john s steak and onion sub
steps:
1. Slice bun 2 / 3 through lengthwise and spread open
2. Place cheese slices on bun
3. Heat skillet or grill to medium to high heat
4. Stir fry steak and onions until cooked through
5. Salt and pepper to taste while cooking
6. Place cooked steak and onions immediately onto bun
7. Top with the mushrooms and peppers to taste

title: brussels sprouts  flash curried
steps:
1. Heat the oil in an iron skillet or wok or other heavy-bottom saute pan or dutch oven until very hot but not smoking
2. Add the sprouts and sear them , stirring often , until they are sort of flash-fried
3. If they dry out and seem ready to burn , add a couple of tablespoons of water
4. Add the salt and test a sprout for doneness
5. Stir in the curry powder and cook 5 minutes longer

title: dad s butter tarts
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients in a large bowl
2. Fill tart shells and bake at 350f for about 15 minutes

title: key s cafe famous caramel rolls
steps:
1. Blend brown sugar and butter in a 9x13 pan , add cream
2. Spread over bottom of pan
3. Flatten bread dough , sprinkle cinnamon-sugar mixture on top and roll up and cut each loaf into 4 pieces
4. Place on top of caramel mixture in pan
