5. Let rise in a warm place to double in size or overnight
6. Bake at 350f degrees for about 45 minutes or until brown on top

title: garden salad with an asian touch
steps:
1. Mix dressing ingredients and toss 2 teaspoons of mixture into lettuce and basil
2. Place lettuce on 4 plates
3. Mix together cucumber , tomato , scallion toss in dressing
4. Place on top of greens
5. Garnish with seeds

title: scallops jardiniere
steps:
1. Rinse scallops in cold water
2. Pat dry with paper towels
3. In a large saute pan , heat 3 tablespoons butter on high heat until sizzling
4. Add scallops
5. Reduce heat to medium and cook scallops 2 to 3 minutes per side , until lightly browned , turning once
6. Melt the rest of the butter in with the scallops and add the chopped onions and the garlic , tossing to coat and saute for 1 minute
7. Add the lemon juice and the chopped tomato , and cook for 2 minutes more
8. Remove from heat and season with the salt and pepper
9. Sprinkle with the snipped parsley
10. Serve hot with fresh quartered lemons , a crusty baguette , and a glass of chablis !

title: nutella crunch french toast
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 250
2. Line a baking sheet with a wire rack
3. Take 8 slices of texas toast and spread about a tablespoon of nutella on each slice
4. Put two slices together to make 8 sandwiches
5. In a large bowl , whisk eggs , cream , and vanilla
6. In another large bowl , add the cornflakes
7. Take one of the sandwiches and dip it into the egg mixture and then into the cornflakes covering the entire sandwich
8. Heat a skillet to medium heat and melt one tablespoon of butter
9. Cook sandwich for about 2 to 3 minutes on each side
10. Once cooked , place sandwich on baking sheet to keep warm in oven
11. Repeat process until all sandwiches have been made
12. To serve: put sandwich on plate
13. Add strawberries and blueberries and dust with lots of confectioners sugar ! oh , and drizzle the maple syrup on top , of course !

title: herbed vegetable bake
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400
2. Arrange broccoli along one long side of ungreased
3. Rectangular baking dish , 13 9 2 inches
4. Arrange cauliflower along
5. Other side of dish
6. Arrange carrots down center between broccoli and
7. Cauliflower
8. Drizzle with margarine
9. Sprinkle with salt , pepper , basil ,
10. Tarragon and garlic
11. Arrange onions evenly over top
12. Cover with aluminum foil and bake about 30 minutes or until vegetables are
13. Crisp-tender

title: feta stuffed chicken with green olives
steps:
1. Oven to 350 degrees f
2. In a small bowl , mix the feta , butter , rosemary and pepper to taste together
3. Using your fingers and a spoon , push the feta mixture under the skin of the chicken parts , being gentle to avoid ripping the skin
4. Put some stuffing under the tenderloin portion of the breast
5. Season all parts well with salt and pepper
6. Heat an oven-proof dutch oven or a very deep oven proof skillet over medium heat until it's very hot
7. Add the olive oil and sear the chicken pieces , skin side down , until the skin is golden brown , about 4 minutes per piece
8. Transfer the chicken to a plate , drain off the fat , and deglaze the pan with the wine and the broth
9. Return the chicken to the pan , add the olives , and put the skillet in the oven
10. Bake until the juices run clear when pricked with a fork , about 40 minutes
11. Transfer the chicken and olives to a warm plate
12. Boil the juices over high heat until they reduce and thicken enough to coat the back of a spoon , about 4 minutes
13. Pour the sauce over the chicken and serve with orzo or some other small pasta shape

title: chickpea and coriander dumplings  garbanzo and cilantro
steps:
1. Roughly chop the chickpeas it takes no time at all with a mezzaluna)
2. Mix the flour , vegetable suet , chickpeas , coriander and seasoning together
3. Add water and mix to form a soft dough
4. Divide and shape the dumpling dough into 8 balls
5. Place dumplings on the top of a part cooked soup , stew or casserole and return dish to the stove top or oven to finish cooking
6. Cooking

title: 30 minute jambalaya skillet
steps:
1. Coat chicken with 1 tbsp of the creole seasoning
2. Cook in 1 tbsp oil in a large skillet
3. Add celery , onion and green pepper and continue cooking until done
4. Stir in tomatoes , sauce , water , and shrimp
5. Add 1 tbsp of creole seasoning
6. Bring to a boil and simmer for 2 minutes
7. Add rice , cover and cook 5 minutes or until rice is done

title: southwestern barbecue sauce
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in saucepan
2. Bring to boil and cook on low for 10 minutes

title: favorite chicken and wild rice casserole
steps:
1. Prepare rice according to package directions
2. Set aside
3. Saute onion , celery and water chestnuts in butter until tender
4. In a very large bowl , combine rice , onion mixture , 3 cups cheese , chicken , soup , sour cream , milk , salt and pepper
5. Pour into a lightly greased 15x10 inch baking dish or 4 qt casserole
6. Bake at 350 for 30 minutes
7. Sprinkle with remaining 1 cup cheese and bake 5 minutes

title: halibut italiano
steps:
1. Place fish in oiled baking pan
2. Top with mushrooms and olives
3. Pour spaghetti sauce over the top and bake for 10 minutes at 400 degrees
4. Remove from oven and sprinkle with cheese
5. Bake 10 more minutes or until fish flakes easily with a fork
6. Serve with chopped parsley over the top and a lemon wedge on the side

title: bread machine sourdough
steps:
1. Spray bread machine pan
2. Bake as per instructions for your machine

title: cocoa bombs
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Beat butter , margarine and powdered sugar together until light and fluffy
3. Beat in vanilla extract and water and blend thoroughly
4. Beat in cocoa
5. Slowly add flour and nuts and mix until completely incorporated
6. Roll dough into walnut-sized balls and place on ungreased baking sheet
7. Flatten balls slightly
8. Bake until cookies are set but not browned , about 8 minutes
9. Roll in powdered sugar while still warm
10. Do not skip this step
11. When cooled , roll in powdered sugar again
12. Do not skip this step
13. If you want it to be moister , try underbaking by 1-2 minutes

title: curried red lentil salad
steps:
1. In large bowl , whisk together all ingredients for dressing
2. Set aside
3. Wash lentils
4. Cook in boiling water 5-6 minutes or until just tender
5. Rinse and drain well
6. Add capers , currants and onions to lentils
7. Combine with dressing and let marinate at least 2 hours in the refrigerator before serving
8. Enjoy !

title: brussels sprouts medley
steps:
1. Wash brussels sprouts thoroughly and remove discolored leaves
2. Cut off stem ends and slash bottom of each sprout with a shallow x
3. Place water and bouillon cubes in a medium saucepan
4. Bring to a boil
5. Add brussels sprouts , carrot , and celery
6. Return to a boil
7. Cover , reduce heat and simmer 12 to 15 minutes or until vegetables are tender
8. Drain , place vegetables in a serving bowl
9. Melt butter in a small skillet
10. Add cashews and seasonings
11. Cook over low heat 3 to 4 minutes or until cashews are lightly toasted
12. Pour over vegetables

title: turkey scaloppine with parmesan cheese
steps:
1. Rinse turkey slices and pat dry
2. Stir together flour , salt and pepper in a shallow bowl
3. In another shallow bowl beat the egg with the water
4. In another shallow bowl mix the cheese and the bread crumbs
5. Dip each turkey slice in the flour , then the egg then the bread crumbs
6. In a 12 inch skillet melt butter over med-high heat
7. Add coated turkey slices and cook 2-3 minutes per side or until no longer pink
8. Move to serving platter and garnish with parsley

title: homemade multi grain hot cereal
steps:
1. Feel free to omit any grain or substitute your favorite grain
2. In dutch oven on medium heat , lightly toast the hardy grains for approximately 8-10 minutes or until fragrant
3. Keep stirring grains constantly so they don't burn
4. Add remaining grains and toast another 5 minutes , stirring constantly
5. Cool mixture slightly
6. Process grain mixture in batches in food processor , grain mill or blender fitted with steel blade
7. Grind grains to medium coarse consistency transfer ground grains to airtight container and store in refrigerator or freezer
8. To prepare hot cereal: to 1 cup of rapidly boiling water add 1 / 3 cup scant of cereal
9. Continue boiling 30 seconds , breaking up lumps with a fork
10. Reduce heat , cover pan and simmer cereal for 10-12 minutes
11. For thinner consistency cereal either increase water or reduce amount of cereal
12. Season with salt to taste
13. Add your favorite toppings such as cinnamon , flax seeds , milk , etc

title: sweetpea s chili
steps:
1. In skillet , brown and drain ground beef
2. In large pot , combine the beer , water , tomato sauce , diced tomatoes , and the beans
3. Add the peppers , garlic , and onion
4. Heat thoroughly
5. Add the beef and all of the spices
6. Cook for about an hour to allow the flavors to combine
7. Garnish with the cheese and sour cream if desired

title: reese s cup pie
steps:
1. In medium mixing bowl with mixer on low
2. Cream peanutbutter until soft
3. Gradually add milk while continuely to mix
4. When all milk is mixed with peanutbutter , add pudding mix and continue to blend until ingredients are smooth and combined well
5. Pour mix into baked shell , chill at least 4 hours

title: baked chicken with spaghetti squash
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f line a large baking sheet with foil and spray with cooking spray
2. Arrange squash , cut side up , on baking sheet
3. Brush with 3 tablespoons dressing and sprinkle with garlic and pepper
4. Bake for 30 minutes
5. Meanwhile , toss chicken in remaining dressing and marinate while squash is baking
6. Add chicken to baking sheet and bake 20 minutes
7. Spread 1 / 3 cup pasta sauce over chicken and sprinkle evenly with cheese
8. Bake until cheese is melted an squash is tender , about 10 minutes
9. Drag a fork over squash to release the spaghetti-like strands
10. Discard rinds
11. Serve chicken over squash
12. Warm remaining sauce and serve on the side

title: gwen s old fashioned potato beef casserole  trisha yearwood
steps:
1. Place the potatoes in a large saucepan with water to cover by 1 inch
2. Add a generous pinch of salt and cook for 15 minutes , or until tender
3. Potatoes cook quickly
4. Test often for tenderness and don't overcook them
5. Alternatively , cook the potatoes in a pressure cooker for 5 minutes , releasing the pressure immediately to prevent overcooking
6. Drain the potatoes and arrange them in a 6- by 9- by 2-inch casserole dish
7. In a large skillet , add a little oil to coat the pan
8. Combine the beef and onion and cook together over medium heat until the beef is browned and the onion softened , about 10 minutes
9. Drain excess fat
10. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
11. Melt the butter in a medium saucepan and whisk in the flour to make a roux
12. Cook over medium heat , whisking constantly , until the mixture bubbles and the flour turns light brown in color
13. Gradually whisk in the milk and continue to stir while cooking over medium heat
14. When the mixture thickens , season with salt and pepper , then stir in the cheese and browned beef and onions
15. Pour the ground beef mixture over the potatoes and bake the casserole for 20 minutes , until heated through and bubbling
16. Sprinkle the breadcrumbs on top of the casserole and bake until the crumbs are toasted , about 5 minutes longer
17. Cook's
18. Because all the ingredients are fully cooked , if they are still hot when you assemble the casserole , the baking time can be greatly reduced or even eliminated
19. Simply brown the crumb topping under the broiler for a couple of minutes

title: pear smackdown
steps:
1. Preheat oven to really hot
2. Slice pears in half and core
3. Rub pear meat with butter , stuff walnuts into pear center
4. Cover with with a little bit of honey and some maple syrup
5. Bake"meatdown" until pears are soft
6. Serve immediately
7. You can also sprinkle cardamom and cinnamon on top !
8. Good cognac or brandy helps too

title: caramel cinnamon muffins
steps:
1. Grease muffin pans and place 1 / 2 teaspoon of butter and 1 teaspoon brown sugar in each cup
2. Sift flour , baking powder , salt and cinnamon together
3. Beat egg
4. Add milk , shortening and remaining 1 / 2 cup brown sugar
5. Add to sifted dry ingredients , stirring only enough to dampen all the flour
6. Fill prepared muffin pans 3 / 4 full and bake in hot oven for 20 minutes
7. If desired , chopped nuts or raisins may be added to the butter and brown sugar of the cup

title: chicken shish kabob with pineapple sauce
steps:
1. Mix together all the ingredients for the marinade
2. Marinate the meat for at least 2 hours in the refrigerator
3. Put the cubes of meat on the skewers , alternating with the peppers , onions , and mushrooms
4. Grill on the bbq or in the oven at 350f for about 20 minutes
5. Mix all the ingredients for the sauce and bring to a boil for a few minutes until it starts to thicken a little
6. Serve with rice

title: baba gannoujh    middle eastern eggplant spread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f and prepare a baking dish that will accommodate the eggplant with cooking spray
2. Halve each eggplant lengthwise , sprinkle with salt , and place cut side down in the baking dish
3. Spray skin with cooking spray , then roast until tender when pierced , about 20-25 minutes
4. Place all ingredients in the bowl of your food processor fitted with the steel blade , and blend until smooth

title: triple treats  copycat oh henry bars
steps:
1. In a double boiler , melt chocolate and shortening
2. Stir until smooth
3. Remove from heat
4. Pour 1 / 2 into a foil lined 8 inch square pan
5. Refrigerate until firm
6. Combine caramels , water and butter
7. Place mixture on low heat until smooth
8. Stir in nuts
9. Pour into chocolate lined pan
10. Spread evenly and top with remaining melted chocolate
11. Refrigerate until firm , about 1 hour
12. Cut into bite sized pieces

title: grandma s busy day casserole
steps:
1. Brown and drain hambuger
2. Peel and slice potatoes into thin slices
3. Add two cans of vegetable soup
4. Mix well
5. Cover and bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour

title: aunt mag s spoonburgers
steps:
1. Cook onions over low to med heat until tender
2. Add hamburger , cook until brown
3. Add 57 sauce , ketchup and hot sauce
4. Simmer 15 minutes
5. Spoon over the buns of you choice

title: kay s sesame chicken
steps:
1. Dredge the chicken pieces in flour seasoned with salt and pepper
2. In a large frying pan , heat the oil and cook the chicken chunks 3 to 4 minutes or until done
3. Work in batches if necessary to avoid crowding the pan
4. Drain the chicken on paper towels and set aside , covered to keep warm
5. Combine the sugar and soy sauce in a saucepan and heat uintil the sugar dissolves
6. Add the chicken chunks
7. Toss the chicken in the sauce with the sesame seeds and scallions
8. Serve at once

title: chilli plum beef
steps:
1. Trim beef , slice thinly
2. Combine beef , sauces , garlic , ginger , chilli , sugar , sherry and cornflour in a large bowl
3. Cover , marinate for 30 minutes or overnight
4. Drain beef and reserve marinade
5. Heat a little oil in a wok , add beef in batches , stir-fry until browned
6. Remove from wok as each batch is cooked
7. Repeat with remaining oil and beef
8. Return beef to wok with reserved marinade , blended extra cornflour and water and the stock cube
9. Stir until mixture boils and thickens
10. Serve with rice

title: strawberry sauce  for french toast
steps:
1. Mix cornstarch and water , set aside
2. Heat jam to a boil , add cornstarch mixture
3. Stir constantly , bring to a boil , simmer 3 minutes
4. Add lemon juice and chopped walnuts
5. Spoon over french toast

title: toasted sesame coleslaw
steps:
1. Toss cabbage , onion and carrot well
2. Whisk dressing ingredients together
3. Add dressing to cabbage mixture , and toss well
4. Refrigerate for two hours to allow flavors to blend
5. Just prior to serving , add the sesame seeds and peanuts , toss well

title: creamy low fat garlic salad dressing
steps:
1. In a medium glass bowl , whisk together all the ingredients till well mixed
2. Pour into medium jar , cover and refrigerate
3. Serve on salad cold

title: healthy and yummy berry muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Lightly grease a muffin tin
3. Set aside last four ingredients for crumb topping
4. Mix together all of the dry ingredients so that they are evenly distributed throughout
5. You can also tweak the cinnamon to your liking
6. We really like cinnamon , so i tend to just keep adding it
7. One at a time , add blueberries , strawberries , and nuts
8. In a separate bowl , lightly beat egg
9. One at a time , add mashed banana , buttermilk , oil , and vanilla
10. Mix wet ingredients into the dry
11. Be careful not to over-mix
12. Just mix enough to moisten all of the dry ingredients
13. To make topping , mix all dry ingredients and cut in butter with a fork
14. Continue mashing until the mixture resembles small crumbs
15. Spoon mix into each cup of the muffin tin , filling to the top
16. Top the muffin with desired amount of crumb topping
17. Bake at 350 for 16-18 minutes
18. To test doneness , do not poke with a knife
19. Gently press the center of a muffin
20. When it's done , it will spring back when touched
21. Allow to cool for about 10 minutes before removing from the pan

title: baked macaroni ala the joy of cooking
steps:
1. Cook macaroni according to pkg directions
2. Drain
3. Place half macaroni in 3-4 qt casserole or 9x13" pan
4. Sprinkle w / half grated cheddar
5. Top with remaining macaroni
6. Sprinkle w / remaining cheese
7. Mix remaining ingredients in small bowl til well blended
8. Pour over macaroni and cheese
9. Sprinkle w / stuffing mix
10. Dot w / butter
11. Sprinkle w / remaining cheddar
12. Bake at 350 degrees for 40-50 minutes

title: orange pecan oatmeal muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Prepare muffin tin with vegetable cooking spray
3. In a large bowl , whisk egg whites until frothy
4. Add the maple syrup , orange juice , milk , extract , spices and orange peel
5. Mix with a wooden spoon , until well blended
6. Stir in the oats , flour and baking powder until all ingredients are moistened
7. Fold in the pecans
8. Fill 12 muffin cups about 2 / 3 full and bake for 20 minutes or until muffin tops are golden and spring back to the touch

title: low carb taco patties
steps:
1. Mix meat , onion , salt , worcestershire sauce and pepper
2. Shape mixture into 6 patties , each about 3 / 4-inch thick
3. Brown patties in a large skillet over medium-high heat , turning once
4. Remove patties and set aside
5. Pour fat from the skillet
6. Mix water and seasoning mix in the same skillet and heat to boiling
7. Reduce the heat and return the patties to the skillet
8. Turn each one to coat with the sauce
9. Peel avocado and cut into 6 rings
10. Top each patty with an avocado ring
11. Cover and simmer 10 minutes
12. Sprinkle with the cheese
13. Cover and heat until the cheese has melted , about 2 minutes
14. Serve sauce over the patties

title: mango bellini
steps:
1. Chill the champagne flutes in the freezer for at least 30 minutes
2. Pour 2 oz of mango nectar into the bottom of each flute
3. Squeeze a lime wedge into each flute
4. Top off with the chilled prosecco , to within 1 / 2 inch of the top of the flutes

title: quiche a la chance
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Cook bacon until crisp and chop into small pieces
3. Sprinkle on the bottom of the pie shell
4. Whisk together eggs and milk
5. Add chopped vegetables , pepper and salt
6. Mix together
7. Add cheese to milk mixture and mix
8. Pour mixture into pie shell and sprinkle parsley over top
9. Cooke for 30 to 40 minutes
10. Let stand 5 minutes before serving

title: grilled tomato risotto with roasted portobello mushrooms
steps:
1. Preheat the grill to 400f
2. , or heat a grill pan to medium high
3. In a mixing bowl , toss the tomatoes with the olive oil , salt and pepper
4. Place on the grill and cook for 2 to 3 minutes on each side
5. Remove from the grill and set aside
6. Preheat the oven to 400f
7. Place the portobello mushroom on a parchment lined baking sheet , cavity side up
8. Drizzle both sides of the mushrooms with the olive oil
9. Season both sides with salt and pepper
10. Fan a quarter of the cheese over each cavity of the mushroom
11. Place in the oven and cook until the mushrooms are tender and the cheese is bubbly , about 10 minutes
12. Heat the olive oil in a large saute pan over medium heat
13. Add the onions and thyme
14. Season with salt and pepper
15. Saute until the onions are slightly soft , about 3 minutes
16. Add the water , wine and garlic
17. Bring the mixture to a boil , reduce the heat to medium , and simmer for about 6 minutes
18. Add the rice and simmer , stirring constantly until the mixture is creamy and bubbly , about 18 minutes
19. Stir in the butter , cream , cheese , and green onions
20. Simmer for about 2 minutes , stirring constantly
21. Remove from the heat and stir in the tomatoes
22. To serve , slice each portobello into quarters
23. Spoon the risotto into each serving dish
24. Lay 2 slices of the portobello on top of the risotto
25. Garnish with parsley

title: oatmeal cookie brittle
steps:
1. Set oven to 350
2. Stack two large baking sheets together then line the top one with parchment paper
3. In a large mixing bowl beat melted butter with both sugars and vanilla
4. Add in egg
5. Beat until combined
6. In a small bowl mix together the flour , salt and oatmeal
7. Add to the butter mixture
8. Mix well to combine
9. Add in the chocolate chips
10. Mix to combine
11. Spread out on top of the parchment paper to about 1 / 2-inch thick
12. Bake middle oven rack for about 17- 20 minutes or until set and dry
13. Cool well then cut or break into pieces

title: mars bars
steps:
1. Cut up butter and mars bars into coarse even chunks
2. Melt in microwave for 3 minutes
3. Stir at minute intervals
4. You have to be very careful so that you don't burn the chocolate and butter !
5. After the butter and mars bars have melted , stir in 1 cup of rice bubbles at a time
6. Place mixture in a slice tray and place in refrigerator until hard

title: kentucky steak marinade
steps:
1. Mix all the ingredients
2. Marinate steaks for at least 2 hours but preferably longer
3. Grill the steaks over an outdoor grill for best flavor

title: state famous deep fried walleye
steps:
1. Mix cracker crumbs flour garlic and seasoning salt in a medium bowl
2. Scramble the eggs and mix in the water in a small bowl
3. Melt shortening in deep frier and heat to 380 degrees
4. Put walleye fillets in the egg mixture put walleye fillets in the crumb mixture and coat until you can't see the fish put in deep frier and cook until golden brown and flaky serve with lemon wedges and tartar sauce

title: muffin   top apple oatmeal cookies
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375
2. In a large bowl on med speed beat butter , ssugar , vanilla , cinnamon , baking soda , allspice , baking powder , and salt 3 minutes until fluffy
3. Beat in eggs 1 at atime until blended
4. On low speed beat in flour just until combined
5. Stir in oats and apples
6. Drop level 1 / 4 cups dough about 4 inches apart on ungreased baking sheets
7. Bake 17 or until cookies are golden
8. Remove to a wire rack to cool

title: curried couscous with dried cranberries
steps:
1. Stir the couscous , cranberries , curry powder , salt , and sugar together in a heatproof bowl
2. Bring water to a boil and pour it over the couscous
3. Add the orange juice
4. Give it a big stir , cover the bowl tightly and let it stand , giving it a big stir once or twice , until the water is absorbed and the couscous is tender , about 5 minutes
5. Fluff up the couscous with a fork
6. Add the olive oil , scallions , parsley , lemon juice , and walnuts
7. Stir around until everything is distributed evenly throughout the couscous
8. Make up to 2 hours ahead of time and keep at room temperature until you're ready to serve
9. Check the seasonings just before you serve the salad and add salt and pepper , to taste

title: sesame eggplant  aubergine  salad
steps:
1. Place wok or skillet over high heat , when hot , add 2tbs oil and swirl to coat the pan
2. When hot but not smoking , about 1 minute , add eggplant , stir fry about 1 minute
3. Add water , or more as needed , and continue to stir-fry moving pan off and on the heat as necessary to prevent scorching , until water evaporates and eggplant is tender when pierced , about 5 minutes
4. Transfer to a bowl and let cool to room temperature
5. Mix all dressing ingredients in a bowl , whisk to blend
6. Pour over cooled eggplant and toss to coat well
7. To serve , mound on a serving plate and garnish with onions

title: three ingredient cocktail sauce
steps:
1. Scrape lime to get approximately 1 teaspoon of zest
2. You can use a grater , but a zester really yields the intense flavor and no bitterness
3. Zest the lime before you cut it
4. Pour catsup , horseradish , lime juice & lime zest into medium bowl
5. Stir thoroughly
6. Chill & serve with shrimp or other seafood

title: horlicks banana smoothie
steps:
1. In a blender , combine all ingredients
2. Blend until smooth and frothy
3. Serve immediately

title: holiday yams
steps:
1. Add yams to a pot of boiling water , cover and after allowing water to return to a boil , cook for 30-35 minutes
2. Rinse in cold water
3. Remove the skins from the yams
4. Cut into 1 / 4 inch slices
5. Quarter the apples and cut into 1 / 4 inch slices
6. Spray a large rectangular or oblong pan with cooking spray of your choice
7. Layer the yams and the apples
8. Pour the orange juice over both layers
9. Dot with butter or margarine if desired
10. Top with the raisins
11. Sprinkle with cinnamon and nutmeg
12. You can adjust these amounts to your own personal preference
13. Bake at 350 for 30-35 minutes

title: easy hamburger stew
steps:
1. Saute ground beef , garlic and onion
2. Add potatoes , carrots and corn
3. Stir in soup , water and seasonings
4. Cover and simmer until veggies are tender
5. Serve over steamed white rice

title: pytt i panna   swedish fried hash with pickled beetroot
steps:
1. Heat up a large frying pan and melt the half the butter
2. Add the diced potatoes and saute until the potatoes are golden brown and soft
3. In another smaller frying pan , add the remaining butter and melt
4. Add the diced onions and cook until golden brown and soft
5. Add the fried onions to the fried potatoes , then add the parsley , mix gently but well - cover and keep warm
6. Put the chopped meat into the onion pan and saute quickly and over a high heat
7. Add the meat to the potatoes and onion mixture
8. Heat up the sunflower oil and fry the eggs
9. Serve the pytta i panna immediately with a fried egg on top of the potato , onion and meat mixture
10. Accompany this dish with a bowl of pickled beetroot and rye bread

title: pasta with roast vegetable sauce
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Arrange eggplant and onion on large rimmed nonstick baking sheet
3. Drizzle with oil
4. Sprinkle with salt and pepper
5. Roast vegetables until beginning to brown , stirring occasionally , about 25 minutes
6. Stir zucchini and garlic into vegetables
7. Continue to roast until all vegetables are tender , about 20 minutes longer
8. Stir crushed tomatoes into vegetables on baking sheet
9. Roast until heated through , about 10 minutes
10. Meanwhile , cook pasta in large pot of boiling salted water until just tender but still firm to bite , stirring occasionally
11. Ladle 1 / 2 cup pasta cooking liquid into small bowl
12. Reserve
13. Drain pasta
14. Return pasta to same pot
15. Add roasted vegetable sauce and all herbs to pasta and toss to blend
16. Gradually add enough reserved pasta cooking liquid to moisten as desired
17. Season to taste with salt and pepper
18. Transfer pasta to bowl and serve

title: coconut haystack cookies
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400 degrees
2. Mix sugar with salt
3. Mix sugar mixture with coconut
4. Mix in eggs
5. Butter one large cookie sheet
6. Drop by tablespoonfuls on cookie sheet and shape like small haystacks
7. Bake at 400 degrees for 15 minutes
8. Cool 5 minutes then remove from sheet
9. Before adding any spices to this recipe , if you have never had these before , you should make them plain like the recipe is first then decide if you want to add any thing else
10. We like them the way they are
11. You may be surprised at the flavor as they are
12. Recipe does not include cooling time

title: pork chops with dijon cream sauce
steps:
1. Trim fat from chops
2. Sprinkle both sides with salt and pepper
3. Spray a large heavy skillet with cooking spray
4. Heat skillet over medium high heat until hot
5. Add chops and cook 3 to 4 minutes on each side until browned
6. Remove chops from skillet and keep warm
7. Add broth to skillet
8. Stir to loosen browned bits
9. Combine mustard and evaporated milk and add to skillet
10. Reduce heat and simmer 7 minutes or until sauce is thickened slightly
11. Spoon sauce over chops
12. Serve and enjoy !

title: quick crab stew
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , melt the butter and saute the onion until translucent , about 3-4 minute
2. Add the soups , milk , and half and half , and stir to combine
3. Add the crabmeat and bring just to a boil
4. Add the sherry , salt and pepper , to taste
5. Serve immediately , or allow to cool to room temperature , then refrigerate or freeze immediately in serving sizes

title: next door lady s kringla  norwegian
steps:
1. Beat all the liquids together well in a large bowl
2. Mix the dry ingredients together well in a medium bowl
3. Add dry ingredients to liquids
4. Then add either the vanilla or lemon extract
5. Refrigerate overnight
6. Set oven to preheat at 400 degrees
7. The dough is very sticky
8. Using a tablespoon , scoop out about a'golf ball size' spoonful of dough
9. Having your counter or bread board covered with flour , drop the spoonful onto the flour and roll it enough to get all the outside coated with a thin film of flour
10. Then roll the dough like a thin rope
11. Putting the rope on your pre-greased cookie sheet , twist the ends over one another one time
12. Bring the loop at the top down over the twisted ends
13. That should make the shape you want
14. Put about 12 on each cookie sheet , and begin baking
15. Put the first cookie sheet on the lower rack in your oven
16. Bake for 6 minutes then transfer that sheet to the top rack of your oven
17. Bake another 6 minutes and take them out
18. They should be lightly browned on both the top and the bottom , if you have the correct temperature in your oven

title: stuffed date orange cookies
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 325f
2. To make the filling: puree the filling ingredients in a food processor until evenly combined , about 1 to 2 minutes
3. Remove and set aside
4. Clean the processor bowl
5. Put the flour , baking powder , the 1 tablespoon confectioners' sugar , and salt in the bowl of food processor and pulse 3 to 4 times to mix
6. Add the butter , oil , and milk pulsing until the dough just comes together
7. Take care not to overwork the dough
8. It will be slightly wet
9. Remove dough from the processor , and roll into 20 equally sized balls
10. In the palm of your hand , press and pat each ball of dough into a 2 3 / 4-inch round
11. Place a rounded teaspoon of filling in the center of each round and draw the edges up and around the filling
12. Pinch the dough together to make a sealed ball , and then carefully roll the cookie between your palms to make a smooth round ball
13. Press gently to flatten the cookie slightly , then place them seamed side down on a parchment-lined baking sheet
14. Repeat with the remaining dough and filling
15. Gently prick the cookies with a fork or a wooden skewer in a decorative pattern taking care not to pierce the dough to the filling
16. Bake the cookies until firm and slightly puffed , and the tops are pale but the bottoms are just beginning to turn slightly golden , about 25 to 30 minutes
17. Dust generously with confectioners' sugar , cool and dust again

title: korean stir fried pork with red pepper
steps:
1. Cut the pork against the grain into slices about 2" x 1" x1 / 8"
2. Cut the spring onion crosswise into very fine rounds
3. Combine pork , spring onion , garlic
4. Ginger and hot fermented bean paste in a bowl
5. Mix well
6. Cover and set aside for 30 minutes or longer
7. Cut the pepper into 1 / 2" squares
8. Cut the onion into 1 / 2" cubes and then separate the layers
9. Just before serving put the oil in a large non stick frying pan and set over a high heat
10. When hot put in the pork together with all its marinade and stir fry for 3 minutes until the pork is white all the way through
11. Add about 6 tablespoons of water and the red pepper and onion
12. Stir and cook for a further 2 minutes on a high heat
13. Serve with noodles or plain rice

title: food processor whole wheat buttermilk biscuits
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees f
2. In the food processor , put the flour , baking powder , baking soda , and salt
3. Pulse the food processor to thoroughly mix the dry ingredients
4. While pulsing the food processor , drizzle in the canola oil
5. Keep on pulsing until the oil appears to be evenly distributed
6. You may have to stop and scrap down the sides a couple of times to ensure it is thoroughly worked into the flour mixture
7. After the oil is worked in , add the buttermilk
8. Keep on rapidly pulsing until the dough becomes a lump
9. Remove the dough from the food processor and form it into a flatten ball on a floured surface
10. Roll out the dough until it is approximately 1 / 2 inch thick
11. Using a biscuit cutter cut out the biscuits and put them on an ungreased baking sheet
12. Space the biscuits about an inch apart
13. Pull together the scraps and re-roll for more biscuits
14. Bake for approximately 15 minutes or until nicely browned

title: copycat yoohoo by todd wilbur
steps:
1. Mix all contents in a blender and blend for 30 seconds
2. Refrigerate until cold , then serve

title: en fuego chili verde
steps:
1. Roast poblano chilies over an open flame or a bbq until skins turn black
2. Put in a plastic bag and seal to steam
3. After 15 minutes remove skins and seeds
4. Chop into small pieces and set aside
5. Brown pork in pan with small amount of oil
6. Set aside
7. Heat onions and garlic in a large dutch oven until shiny
8. Add epazote and jalapenos stir until heated through
9. Add pork , cumin , tomatillos and two cups of chicken broth
10. Cook covered on low for two hours , adding broth as needed
11. (dont add too much , it will be too thin
12. The last 30 minutes , add poblanos
13. Salt and pepper to taste
14. The longer it cooks on low the better it is
15. Serve by itself with warm buttered tortillas or over rice
16. Great the next day

title: low fat chicken parmesan
steps:
1. Mix together egg white and juice from lemon
2. Pound chicken with a meat tenderizer
3. Wash chicken and place in bowl with egg white / lemon juice mixture
4. Coat both sides of each chicken breast with bread crumbs
5. Spray the bottom of a frying pan with diffused olive oil or cooking spray
6. Sautee each breast on both sides until the chicken is no longer pink on the outside
7. Cover the bottom of a 9x11 baking dish with some of the marinara sauce until you can no longer see the bottom of the dish
8. Arrange the sauteed chicken in the pan
9. Cover the chicken with the remaining sauce
10. Combine the two types of chees and spread over the top
11. Bake at 350 degrees farenheit for 45 minutes to 1 hour or until chicken is cooked through

title: kielbasa and kale soup
steps:
1. Put broth and frozen kale into a heavy 4 quart pot over high heat
2. Slice sausage into 1 / 4 inch thick rounds
3. Add to pot
4. When mixture boils , reduce heat , cover and simmer
5. Meanwhile , rinse and drain beans
6. Add to pot with macaroni
7. Simmer 8 minutes or until macaroni is tender

title: snake meringues
steps:
1. Beat whites in a small bowl with an electric mixer until soft peaks form
2. Gradually add sugar , 1 tblsp at a time , beating until dissolved between additions
3. This process will take about 10 minutes
4. Beat in cornflour and tint mixture with food colouring
5. Spoon the mixture into a piping bag fitted with a 1cm-fluted nozzle
6. Pipe 16cm-long snake shapes , 4cm-apart , on oven trays lined with baking paper
7. To decorate snakes , cut forked tongues from licorice using a small sharp knife and lightly press into front of meringue heads
8. Lightly press m&m's on top of heads for eyes
9. Cook in a very slow oven for about 40 minutes , swapping trays halfway through cooking , or until firm to touch
10. Cool trays in oven with door slightly ajar

title: koulourakia smyrneika  smyrna biscuits
steps:
1. Sift the flour into a large bowl
2. Make a well in the centre and add melted butter , eggs , salt , sugar and vanilla
3. Dissolve baking ammonia in the milk and add that to the flour mixture , too
4. Knead the ingredients together well until you have a soft , pliable dough
5. Shape dough into shapes of your choosing
6. 's' shapes , braids and snails are popular in greece
7. Place on a greased cookie sheet , or parchment-lined or silpat and brush with beaten egg white
8. Bake at 375f for 20 minutes

title: vanilla custards with roasted berries
steps:
1. In a small saucepan , combine your milk and vanilla bean flecks
2. Heat the mixture until it is warm , then set aside
3. You can also do this in a microwave
4. If your saucepan or microwave dish has a small spout , even better
5. In the bottom of a small saucepan , off the heat , beat or whisk your egg yolks and 1 / 4 cup sugar together vigorously , until it pales in color and a ribbon of batter falls off your whisk when you lift it from the bowl
6. This will take a few minutes by hand , and likely just one minute with an electric mixer
7. Whisk in the flour until fully incorporated
8. Whisking the whole time , drizzle the warm vanilla-milk mixture into the egg yolk mixture , just a tiny bit at a time at first
9. Once youve added about 1 / 4 of the milk , you can add the rest in a thin stream , whisking constantly
10. Bring the saucepan to your stove and heat it over medium-high heat , whisking constantly , until it begins to bubble
11. Once bubbling , whisk it for 1 to 2 more minutes , then remove it from the heat
12. Immediately stir in vanilla extract and butter until combined
13. [updated to add] as a final step for a perfectly smooth and silky custard , you can press the mixture through a fine-mesh strainer
14. You can also skip this step if youre not terribly concerned about an imperfect custard
15. To cool your custard quickly , place the saucepan in a larger bowl of ice water that will go halfway up the sides of the saucepan and stir the custard until lukewarm , then divide among serving dishes or ramekins
16. You can also pour it into serving dishes or ramekins still hot , but you should then press a film of plastic wrap against each custard in the fridge so it doesnt form a pudding skin
17. Custards keep in fridge for up to 4 days
18. To serve: preheat oven to 450f
19. Place blueberries in a heatproof , shallow roasting dish and sprinkle with 1 1 / 2 teaspoons sugar
20. Roast in oven for 12 to 15 minutes , rolling around once or twice during cooking time to ensure they roast evenly
21. The goal is not to let the blueberries fully slump or turn to sauce
22. You just want a little trickle of juices puddled across in the bottom
23. Squeeze a bit of lemon juice over berries the second they come out of the oven and roll them back and forth to evenly incorporate it
24. Spoon hot roasted blueberries and some of their juices over each custard
25. Eat immediately , passing any extra roasted blueberries alongside

title: spicy three pepper shrimp
steps:
1. Combine 1 tbsp olive oil and the next 6 ingredients , garlic through shrimp
2. Stir and let rest for at least 15 minutes
3. If refrigerated , the mixture can rest up to two hours
4. Heat the oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
5. Add the peppers and saute about 2 minutes
6. Add the shrimp mixture and saute for 5 - 6 minutes , or until shrimp are opaque and cooked through
7. Be careful not to overcook the shrimp
8. Sprinkle the cilantro on the shrimp and serve with the rice

title: middle eastern lebanese fattoush bread salad
steps:
1. Cut open the breads and toast them under the broiler until they are crisp turning them over once
2. Break them into small pieces in your hands
3. Put all the vegetables in a large bowl with the onions , rocket and purslane leaves or lambs lettuce , flat leaf parsley , and mint
4. For the dressing , mix the olive oil with the lemon juice , garlic , salt , pepper , and sumac
5. Just before serving , add the toasted bread and toss well with the dressing
6. Serves 6-8
7. Variation: for the old style version , put the broken pieces of toast in a bowl
8. Moisten and soften with a little cold water or lemon juice before adding them to the salad
9. The new book of middle eastern food

title: rosy cinnamon apples for 2
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees
2. Core the apples
3. Pare the upper half of each apple to prevent the skin from splitting
4. Or score skin in a fancy design
5. Place apples upright in small baking dish , fill center of each with 1 to 2 tablespoons brown sugar and 1 tablespoon red cinnamon candies
6. Pour water into baking dish to 1 / 4 inch depth
7. Bake until apples are tender when pieced with fork , 30-40 minutes , spooning syrup on apples several times during baking
8. Serve warm , with cream or ice cream

title: potato tomato gratin
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450f spray a large casserole dish with nonstick spray
2. Saut the onions in the olive oil in skillet over medium high heat until just soft
3. Stir in the garlic and cook another minute , just until aromatic
4. Add the tomato and rosemary
5. Continue to cook until all moisture is evaporated , about 10 minutes
6. Layer 1 / 2 the sliced potatoes in the prepared casserole and season with salt and pepper
7. Top with 1 / 2 of the tomato mixture and 1 / 2 of the cheese
8. Repeat layers ending with cheese
9. Cover and bake 30 minutes
10. Remove foil and bake 15 minutes more to brown cheese
11. Let stand 5 minutes before serving so the cheese will set

title: lemon dill  dump  chicken  oamc
steps:
1. Combine everything into ziploc bag
2. To freeze and use later: freeze
3. Then thaw to let chicken marinade when ready to use
4. To use now: let sit 30 min to 1 hour to marinade
5. Grill or bake until chicken is done

title: macadamia crusted onaga
steps:
1. Season fillets in salt and pepper , then dredge in flour
2. Dip the dredged fillets in egg and press macadamia nuts into each side
3. Heat oil and cook fillets in the oil for about 2 minutes per side
4. Drizzle the fillets with hawaiian pesto before serving

title: chocolate   macadamia baked bananas
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 180&#730
2. C
3. Leaving the skin on , cut along the inside curve of each banana , without cutting all the way through
4. Open the bananas out a little and fill them with chocolate and macadamias
5. Place the bananas on a baking sheet for 10 minutes or until they are heated through and the chocolate is melted
6. Serve hot

title: german pancake with marinated berries
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f
2. In a medium bowl , whisk together the eggs , salt , sugar , milk , vanilla , and butter
3. Whisk in the flour to make a smooth batter
4. Set aside
5. Heat a well-seasoned 10-inch cast-iron skillet in the oven for 10 minutes
6. Remove and brush the inside with the shortening
7. Pour in the batter and bake for 15 minutes
8. Lower the oven to 350 degrees f
9. And continue baking until puffed and golden brown , about 13 to 15 minutes more
10. Run a knife around the edge of the skillet
11. Sift the confectioners' sugar over the pancake
12. Serve immediately in the skillet with maple syrup and marinated berries
13. To make marinated berries: in a small saucepan , combine the sugar , vanilla bean and seeds , citrus zests , and water
14. Bring to a boil and then reduce the heat to low
15. Simmer very gently until syrupy , about 25 minutes
16. Remove from the heat and add the citrus juices and / or liquor such as grand marnier
17. Combine the berries in a bowl
18. Strain the warm syrup over the berries and marinate at room temperature for 30 minutes
19. Serve with the pancakes

title: fruit salad in a pineapple boat
steps:
1. Stand pineapple upright
2. Vertically cut about a third from one side , leaving the top attached
3. Remove fruit and discard outer peel from the smaller section
4. Remove fruit from the large section , leaving a 1 / 2-in
5. Shell
6. Chop fruit
7. Place in a large bowl
8. Add the cantaloupe , strawberries , blueberries and lime juice
9. Toss to coat
10. Place in pineapple shell
11. In a small bowl , combine the sauce ingredients
12. Serve with fruit

title: lisa s vegan chickpea  very nice  soup
steps:
1. In a soup pot over medium heat saute onions , carrots , and celery in oil for about 10 minutes
2. Add garlic , dried herbs , and spices
3. Saute for another 5 minutes
4. Deglaze pot with mirin
5. Add broth , barley , and chickpeas
6. Cover and bring to a boil
7. Lower to simmer for about 45 minutes or until barley is cooked
8. Turn off heat and ladle 1 cup into a bowl
9. Add miso and stir until well disolved and combined
10. Pour back into pot and stir

title: bbq pulled pork and cole slaw sandwich
steps:
1. Submerse pork butt in a container of salty water
2. Place in refrigerator for 12 to 16 hours
3. Take pork butt out of water and pat dry
4. Discard brine
5. Mix the cumin , thyme , garlic powder , black pepper , cayenne pepper , salt , curry powder , and onion power
6. Rub on each side of pork butt
7. Wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate for 24 hours
8. In the mean time make the cole slaw by combining the shredded cabbage , shredded carrots and minced onion
9. Combine the last seven ingredients and whisk
10. Stir into cabbage and refrigerate for 24 hours
11. Place pork butt in oven heated to 250 degrees and cook until internal temperature reaches 190 degrees
12. About 10-12 hours
13. I start it before i go to bed
14. Carefully take pork butt out of cooking vessel and place on a cutting board
15. Reserve pan drippings
16. Cover with aluminum foil and let rest for 1 / 2 hour
17. Shred pork by pulling it with two forks
18. Place in serving dish and pour pan drippings on the pork
19. Smack some pork on a bun , top it off with the cole slaw and enjoy

title: portabellas stuffed with parmesan potatoes
steps:
1. Place the peeled potatoes , garlic , and bay leaf in large saucepan of boiling salted water and cook until the potatoes are very tender , about 12 minutes
2. Drain and discard the bay leaf
3. Return the potatoes to pot
4. Mash them together until they are smooth and set aside to cool for about 5 to 7 minutes
5. After the waiting time mix in 3 to 4 tablespoons of parmesan cheese and season with salt and pepper
6. Whisk in the eggs and set the mixture aside
7. Remove the mushroom stems from the portobellos and chop them very fine
8. Heat 2 teaspoons oil in large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
9. Add mushroom stems and onion and saut 5 minutes
10. Stir in parsley and rosemary and season with salt and pepper
11. Preheat oven to 400
12. Brush rounded sides of mushrooms with 3 teaspoons oil
13. Place them on a baking sheet , gill sides up
14. Bake for 10 minutes
15. Reduce oven temperature to 350
16. Divide the onion mixture among mushroom caps
17. Mound the potato on top of the onion mixture inside the caps
18. Sprinkle the
19. Bake until heated through , about 25 minutes
20. While the mushrooms are cooking heat 1 teaspoon oil in large pot over medium heat
21. Add the fresh spinach and saut 2 minutes
22. Season with salt and pepper
23. Divide the spinach among 4 plates
24. Top each serving with 1 stuffed mushroom
25. Season to taste
26. Can be doubled or tripled

title: uncle bill s best buckwheat pancakes
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , whisk together buttermilk , egg and 3 tablespoons of melted butter
2. In another bowl , mix together , all-purpose flour , buckwheat flour , sugar , salt and baking soda
3. Pour the dry ingredients into the egg-mixture
4. Stir until the two mixtures are just incorporated
5. Heat a griddle or large frying pan on medium-high heat
6. In a small saucepan , add 2 teaspoons of canola oil and 1 teaspoon butter and let melt
7. Use as required to rub the griddle or frying pan before frying each batch of pancakes
8. Spoon about 3 tablespoons of batter onto griddle or frying pan for each pancake to form 4 inch pancakes
9. Fry until bubbles form on the top of the pancakes , about 3 minutes
10. Flip them over and cook for another 3 minutes or until done
11. Continue to fry pancakes with the remainng batter
12. Serve with melted butter and syrup or your favorite jams

title: tapioca pudding parfaits
steps:
1. Fill a large bowl with ice water and set aside
2. Mix the sugar , tapioca , milk and egg yolks together in a medium saucepan
3. Cook on medium-high heat , stirring constantly , until mixture comes to a full boil
4. Remove from heat , transfer the pudding to a medium bowl , and set in the ice bath
5. Chill for at least 1 hour or until pudding cools completely
6. To prepare the parfaits: place 3 tablespoons tapioca in a small parfait glass
7. Spread one tablespoon of sauce or preserves over the tapioca
8. Top with 3 more tablespoons tapioca and 1 more tablespoon sauce or preserves
9. Finish with a final layer of 2 tablespoons tapioca
10. Repeat with 5 more parfait dishes and garnish with nuts , candies , chocolate pieces , or a sprinkle of cinnamon , if desired

title: dry curry paste  panaeng
steps:
1. Using a pestle and mortar or grinder blend all ingredients together until they form a smooth paste
2. You should have about 6 tablespoons

title: chicken and pepper stir fry with basil
steps:
1. Heat 1 tablespoon of high oleic safflower oil in a cast iron skillet over medium heat and add the shallots
2. Cook the shallots until they are translucent and soft , about 3 minutes
3. Turn the heat up to medium high and add the chicken , bell peppers , grated ginger , minced garlic , ground pepper , and sliced chilies
4. Continue to stir fry until the chicken is nearly cooked through , about 2 minutes , then add the sauce
5. Cook for another minute and the sauce will thicken
6. Add more soy sauce or salt if you need to
7. Stir in the fresh basil at the end
8. Squeeze a little lime juice on top if you have some limes on hand

title: sour cream  and lemon pepper corn
steps:
1. Drain corn
2. Place all ingredients into pan and cook until hot and bubbly
3. Let rest for a short time before serving to allow it to thicken so it is not runny

title: cornmeal cheddar biscuits
steps:
1. In a large mixing bowl , combine flour , cornmeal , baking powder , sugar , and salt
2. Cut in butter until mixture is coarse and crumbly
3. Stir in cheese and milk just until moistened
4. Drop by 1 / 4 cupfuls 2 inches apart onto an ungreased baking sheet
5. Bake at 450 degrees for 12 to 15 minutes or until golden brown
6. Serve warm with butter

title: chewy triple chippers
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , whisk together flour , salt , baking soda and baking powder
2. Set aside
3. In a large mixing bowl , cream together butter , peanut butter , white and brown sugars
4. Mix until creamy and light
5. Add vanilla and add eggs one at a time , mixing well after each addition
6. Beat in corn syrup and cream
7. Add flour mixture in small batches , stirring it into the creamed mixture with a wooden spoon until well combined , but try not to overmix
8. The mixture will become quite thick , and when you are down to the last cup of flour you may want to use your hands to mix if it is too difficult with the spoon
9. Fold in semisweet , milk and peanut butter chips with the wooden spoon or by hand
10. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight preferably , or at least 4 hours
11. To bake cookies: preheat oven to 325 degrees
12. Line cookie sheets with silpat or parchment paper
13. Using a cookie scoop or medium ice cream scoop , scoop out balls of dough and place on lined cookie sheet
14. Slightly press down the top of each scoop of dough
15. These cookies do not spread a lot , so you don't want them to be too tall or too flat before baking
16. Bake for 12-15 minutes or until cookie is golden brown around the edges and bottom is firm but golden
17. They will seem to be not quite done in the middle at first , but this is from the corn syrup which will firm up as it cools , leaving a nice soft and chewy center
18. Let the cookies cool for 2-3 minutes on the cookie sheet before removing to a cooling rack to cool completely
19. Before baking more batches , make sure cookie sheets have completely cooled before adding new scoops of dough
20. Enjoy !

title: garlic dill crackers
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 175degf
2. Combine first 5 ingredients in a large bowl , plus cayenne pepper , if using , and stir until well combined
3. Add crackers , and toss well to combine
4. Transfer mixture to a baking sheet
5. Bake for 30-40 minutes or until dry , stirring occasionally
6. Store in an airtight container

title: jiffy chocolate cake  one pan
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350melt chocolate and shortening in microwavable container
2. 2 minutes on medium power
3. Break into liquid measuring cup , 1 egg
4. Fill to 1 cup level , sour cream
5. Approximately 1 cup
6. In small bowl , measure flour , salt , soda , sugar and blend well --
7. Grease 8 x 8 pan
8. Add all the above ingredients and mix well
9. Bake for 30 minutes

title: sweet chili   onion jasmine rice
steps:
1. Cook rice per package instructions using 1 3 / 4 cups water and 1 / 2 teaspoon salt
2. Keep warm
3. In the meantime , in a medium-sized skillet , heat oil over medium heat
4. Add onions and garlic
5. Cook , tossing frequently , 15 minutes or until onions are golden
6. The onions should reduce to about 1 cup
7. Stir in brown sugar , salt , chili paste , and rice vinegar
8. Cook another 3-4 minutes , stirring constantly
9. Gently fold rice into onion mixture
10. Garnish with peanuts and cilantro

title: pork shoulder  pernil  with cilantro citrus adobo
steps:
1. Place the pork , fat side up , in a roasting pan fitted with a rack insert , and using a sharp knife , score the surface of the meat with small slits
2. Prepare the adobo: in a food processor , add the garlic , oregano , cilantro , cumin , salt , and pepper
3. Add lime juice and orange juice
4. Drizzle in olive oil and pulse until you have a nice puree
5. Rub the marinade all over the pork , being sure to get into the incisions so the salt can penetrate the meat and pull out the moisture - this will help form a crust on the outside when cooked
6. Preheat the oven to 300 degrees f
7. Roast the pork for 3 hours , uncovered , until the skin is crispy-brown
8. Let the meat rest on a cutting board for 10 minutes before slicing , covered lightly with aluminum foil
9. Drizzle with lime juice and garnish with cilantro

title: marinade for grilled meats and or veggies
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients in a container
2. Use your choice of chicken , pork , salmon , green squash , onions , mushrooms etc
3. Marinade for 2 or more hours
4. And grill
5. Enjoy !

title: martha stewart s guilt free brownies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Line bottom and sides of an 8-inch-square baking pan with foil , leaving a 2-inch overhang
3. Set aside
4. In a small saucepan , bring an inch of water to a simmer over low heat
5. Place chocolate and butter in a medium heatproof bowl
6. Set bowl over pan
7. Stir occasionally until melted
8. Remove from heat
9. Immediately whisk in sugar , egg , egg white , prune puree , vanilla , and salt until smooth
10. In a medium bowl , sift together flour and cocoa
11. Stir into chocolate mixture just until incorporated
12. Spread batter in prepared pan
13. Bake until top is firm , about 30 minutes
14. Let cool completely in pan
15. Using foil , lift brownies from pan
16. Peel off foil
17. Using a serrated knife , cut into 16 squares

title: copycat olive garden seafood portofino
steps:
1. Portofino sauce:
2. Start by getting your ingredients ready
3. Dice the onion
4. Make the roux
5. The amount of oil is about equal to the amount of roux required by the recipe
6. For instance , the original recipe calls for 2 oz of roux
7. So 4 tbsp oil and 4 tbsp white flour
8. Set aside
9. Melt butter on medium heat
10. Add diced onion and garlic , stirring frequently , about 5 minutes
11. Add white wine
12. Turn up heat to high until boiling then back down to medium
13. Cook 5 minutes on medium
14. Stir in roux , shrimp stock , and old bay seasoning
15. Cook 3 minutes
16. Add milk and heavy cream
17. Turn heat on high just until mixture starts to boil
18. Turn to medium / low , cover , and stir occasionally for 5 minutes
19. The sauce is now ready ! it can be store for up to one week in the regrigerator
20. Seafood portofino:
21. Heat oil in saute pan over medium flame
22. Put mushrooms inches cook 2 minutes
23. Add mussels , and cook 30 seconds
24. Add shrimp , crawfish , and scallops
25. Cook until heated through , stirring
26. Add portofino sauce
27. Cook until bubbling throughout
28. Move mushrooms and seafood to one side of pan
29. Add linguine to other side
30. Using tongs , coat pasta with sauce

title: ragot de pattes de cochon  pork stew with meatballs
steps:
1. Stock:
2. The day before serving the ragout , season pork hocks with salt , pepper , cinnamon , cloves and nutmeg
3. Caramelized onions in a deep saucepan in 2 tbsp butter
4. Remove from saucepan
5. In same saucepan , melt 2 tbsp fat and , then brown hocks until dark brown in colour on all sides
6. Add water , chicken bouillon cube , and onions to pork hocks
7. Bring to a boil , and then simmer for at least two hours , until meat falls from bones
8. At this point it's a good idea to remove pork hocks from saucepan and refrigerate the hocks and ragout overnight in fridge so that you can
9. Remove / skim the congealed fat
10. Roast flour in 350f oven until caramel brown
11. This takes about 1 hour
12. Alternatively you may brown the flour in a hot dry pan , stirring continuously until it's a rich , deep , brown colour
13. Remove meat from bone and set aside
14. Thicken ragout by using a jar or blender to mix the roasted flour with the 1 / 2 cup water and pour into the ragout , stirring until well mixed and broth has thickened to a nice consistency
15. Season with salt , pepper and allspice to taste
16. Add cooked pork meatballs and pork meat and heat thoroughly
17. Meat balls:
18. Mix all ingredients and pat mixture into a 1 inch thick rectangle , then cut into 1 inch squares
19. Shape each square into a 1 inch meatball
20. Bake in 400f oven for 10 minutes
21. Add to ragot de pattes to complete cooking
22. Ragout is sometimes served with boiled or mashed potatoes

title: royal rice dish
steps:
1. Saute rice and onion in butter until rice is golden brown
2. Add rest of ingredients and bring to a boil , with the exception of salt , since it's suggested to add it to taste when rice is done
3. Cover , reduce heat , and simmer over lowest heat for 45 minutes to 1 hour , stirring occasionally , until rice is tender and liquid absorbed

title: french herbed omelette
steps:
1. Beat the eggs , pepper and salt in a bowl
2. Stir in the herbs
3. Heat 1 teaspoon each of the oil and butter in a nonstick frying pan over high heat
4. When the oil and butter are hot , add half the egg mixture
5. Stir it continuously with a fork while shaking the pan for about 2 minutes to create small curds
6. When most of the mixture is solid , cook it without stirring for 10 seconds to create a thin``skin on the underside of the mixture , binding it together
7. Roll the omelet by bringing together 2 opposite edges
8. Invert in a plate
9. Repeat process using remainder of ingredients to create a second omelette
10. Serve immediately , half an omelet per person

title: meni meniyong  malinese sesame honey sweet
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450f
2. Spread the sesame seeds on a baking sheet and toast in the oven for about 10 to 12 minutes
3. Remove and cool
4. Heat the honey and butter in a small saucepan over medium-low heat , stirring until it bubbles and darkens somewhat , about 3 to 5 minutes
5. Stir the toasted sesame seeds into honey mixture
6. Spread the mass onto a buttered baking sheet to a thickness of about 1 / 4 inch
7. Cool until it is just warm and cut into finger-sized pieces
8. Cool completely and serve

title: citrus chicken strips
steps:
1. In a large skillet over medium heat , melt the butter
2. Add the garlic , cayenne pepper , salt and black pepper - stirring to mix - taste to adjust seasonings
3. Add the chicken strips- cook for about 10 minutes , stirring to throughly cook the chicken strips
4. Add the juices of the lime , orange and lemon - stirring to mix
5. Lower the heat , simmer about 5 minutes or until sauce thickens slightly
6. Sprinkle with fresh parsley
7. Serve on rice or noodles

title: cashew ranch
steps:
1. Put all ingredients except for parsley in a magic bullet or other high powered blender
2. Blend until smooth and creamy
3. Pour into serving dish
4. Mix in chopped parsley

title: sesame crisp crackers
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Stir together whole wheat flour and soy flour , sesame seeds , and salt
3. Add oil and blend in well , then add enough water to make the dough soft enough to roll out very easily into a thin sheet
4. Gather the dough into a ball , then roll out to 1 / 8 inch thick
5. Cut in cracker shapes or sticks and put on an unoiled baking sheet
6. Bake until the crackers are crisp and golden

title: holiday tofu loaf
steps:
1. Drain off excess water from tofu
2. In a food processor or with a potato masher , crumble tofu avoiding any large lumps
3. Add the vegetable bullion along with 1 tsp each of the sage , rosemary and savory and 1 tbsp of the maple syrup , mix well
4. Line a medium sized colander with cheese cloth , fill with tofu mixture
5. Cover the tofu mixture with a plate topped with a five lb weight
6. Leave tofu to press for at least three hours in the fridge
7. In the mean time , prepare your stuffing
8. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
9. Combine remaining ingredients in a bowl , whisk together and set aside
10. After three hours remove the plate and weight from the tofu
11. Using a spoon , hollow out the tofu leaving a one inch shell
12. Fill shell with stuffing and cover with the extracted tofu
13. Pack the tofu layer down , then turn colander right-side up onto a deep baking sheet
14. Cover tofu loaf with half of the sauce mixture , being sure to spread the mustard grains evenly over the surface
15. Bake until golden brown , basting with remaining mixture after the first 45 minutes

title: refreshing far east fruit salad
steps:
1. Whip cream with confectioner's sugar in large chilled bowl
2. Mix next 4 ingredients & fold into whipped cream
3. Chill thoroughly , at least an hour
4. Confectioner's sugar helps stabilize whipped cream
5. If planning to keep overnight , stabilize whipped cream with gelatin
6. Stir in nuts just before serving

title: salmon stuffed baked potatoes
steps:
1. Wash the potatoes& poke with a fork so they don't explode
2. Wrap in paper towels& cook for 10 minutes until soft
3. If your microwave doesn't have a turntable inside it , turn the potatoes yourself a few times during cooking
4. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
5. Slice a bit off the top of each potato , and scoop out the flesh , leaving a bit of a wall near the skin
6. Mash the potatoes with butter , milk , dijon , salt& pepper until blended
7. Mix in the salmon , broccoli , lemon rind , dill& feta then stuff the potatoes gently , so as not to break the skins
8. Put potatoes on a baking sheet& bake for 20 minutes , or until the top of the potatoes are golden brown

title: curried noodles with tofu
steps:
1. Place noodles in a large bowl
2. Add hot water to cover
3. Let stand 5 minutes
4. Drain
5. Combine coconut milk , sugar , soy sauce , ginger , garlic , curry paste , and salt in a small bowl
6. Heat a large nonstick skillet coated with cooking spray over medium-high heat
7. Add tofu
8. Saut 10 minutes or until golden brown
9. Remove tofu from pan
10. Keep warm
11. Add bell pepper to pan
12. Saut 1 minute or until crisp-tender
13. Add cabbage
14. Saut 30 seconds
15. Stir in noodles , coconut milk mixture , and tofu
16. Cook 2 minutes or until noodles are tender
17. Stir in green onions and cilantro

title: french bread
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients well , knead dough until is elastic
2. Let rise , punch down , let rise again
3. Punch down and form in a long loaf
4. Roll gently back and forth to length and taper ends
5. Place on greased or floured cookie sheet
6. Sprinkle with corn meal , make slashes crosswise at 2 inch intervals
7. Brush with cold water
8. Let rise
9. Brush again with water
10. Sprinkle sesame seeds and bake at 375 f for 30 minutes

title: hawaiian toast
steps:
1. Line a baking sheet with foil
2. Toast bread slices in a toaster
3. Place toast slices onto foil lined pan and top with 1 slice each ham , then a pineapple ring , then top with a slice of cheese
4. Pop under the broiler briefly , just until the cheese melts- watch carefully- don't let the cheese burn
5. This only takes a few minutes , depending upon your broiler , and will vary depending upon the type of cheese you use
6. Remove toast from oven- the cheese should have melted around the pineapple ring , leaving a well to place the cherries
7. Serve immediately

title: fresh figs with ice cream and amaretto chocolate sauce
steps:
1. Pack 1 / 4 cup vanilla ice cream into each of 8 small paper cups and freeze
2. Preheat oven to 350f
3. Lightly butter baking sheet , then set aside
4. In a small bowl , mix grated chocolate , cookies , almonds , butter honey and amaretto
5. Scopp 2 tablesoons of this mixture onto each fig half
6. Arrange on baking sheet and bake 6 to 7 minutes at 350f
7. For the sauce , combine sugar , water , chocolates and butter in a heavy saucepan
8. Heat on medium , stirring until mixture boils , thickens and is smooth
9. Remove from heat , stir in amaretto liquer
10. To serve , unmold ice cream and and place a stuffed fig on plate
11. Drizzle sauce over the ice cream and fig
12. Serve while filling is still warm

title: halibut san juan
steps:
1. Cut halibut into serving size pieces
2. Make bearnaise sauce according to package directions , using the butter and milk
3. Add 1 / 2 cup of the shredded cheddar and stir till melted through
4. Roll halibut filets in the sauce , and place in a lightly greased baking dish
5. Drizzle the remaining sauce over top of the fish , top with the remaining 1 cup of cheddar cheese and bake for 15 minutes in a 350f oven
6. After 15 minutes , sprinkle with the sliced almonds and paprika and bake another 15 minutes , or till your fish flakes as when done
7. Baking times will vary according to thickness of fish

title: almond banana bread
steps:
1. Preheat your oven to 350 degrees
2. In a large bowl , mix together the almond flour , eggs , oil , sugar , mashed bananas , vanilla , cinnamon , nutmeg , baking powder , and salt until there are no clumps
3. Fold the walnuts , chocolate chips , or any other mix-ins you might want into the batter
4. Lightly grease a 5 x 10 or similar sized loaf pan and pour in the batter
5. Bake for 55 minutes or until a cake tester inserted in the center comes out clean
6. Remove from the oven and let cool completely before slicing

title: the lady and sons easy peach cobbler   paula deen
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Place butter in oven in a 2-quart baking dish to melt
3. Stir sugar and flour together and mix well
4. Slowly add milk and continue to stir to prevent the batter from lumping
5. Being careful not to burn yourself , remove hot baking dish containing melted butter from oven
6. Pour batter directly over butter in baking dish
7. Spoon fruit on top of batter , then gently pour syrup on top
8. Sprinkle with cinnamon , if using
9. The most important part of this dish is not stirring the mixture
10. Bake for 30 to 45 minutes or until golden brown
11. Your batter will rise above your fruit , producing the most wonderful of crusts
12. Serve warm with vanilla ice cream or fresh whipped cream

title: instant potato soup mix
steps:
1. Combine all ingrediants in a bowl and mix
2. Place in a 1 quart canning jar to store
3. Directions to attach to jar:
4. Shake well before using
5. To serve: place 1 / 2c soup mix in a large bowl or mug and add 1c boiling water
6. Stir until smooth

title: all pro appetizer
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees
2. Lightly brush a baking tray with vegetable oil or spray with vegetable spray
3. Set aside
4. In a medium bowl , combine the potatoes , spinach and eggs
5. Beat with mixer until well-blended
6. Season with nutmeg and cayenne pepper
7. Add the cheese and 4 tablespoons of the flour
8. Stir until flour is well-blended
9. Spread the remaining flour onto a glass plate and season with salt and pepper
10. Using two teaspoons , form the spinach mixture into 1-inch balls
11. Drop the spinach balls onto the flour-covered plate
12. Roll the spinach balls in the flour to coat and place on the prepared baking sheet
13. Place the tray in the refrigerator for 20 minutes before baking
14. Bake for 12 to 14 minutes until golden brown and firm to the touch
15. Serve plain or sprinkle with lemon juice

title: rutabaga apple salad
steps:
1. Lightly toast sesame seeds in a dry saut pan over medium heat until golden and fragrant , about 3-5 minutes
2. Set aside and let cool
3. Grate rutabaga with a large-holed grater or a food processor
4. Toss with chopped apples and 2 tbsp of lemon juice , to prevent browning , in a large bowl
5. Add grated carrot , and raisins , and chopped dates - mix it all up
6. In a medium bowl , whisk together tahini , lemon juice , and sea salt , to taste , then add water and continue to whisk until smooth
7. Drizzle dressing over salad , and stir to combine , then add sesame seeds
8. Serve at room temperature or chilled
9. Enjoy the energy !

title: lemon filling
steps:
1. Mix ingredients in a saucepan
2. Bring to a rolling boil and boil for 1 minute , stirring constantly
3. Remove from heat and cool stirring occasionally
4. Chill before using

title: buttermilk apricot scones
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Lightly spoon flour into dry measuring cups
3. Level with knife
4. Combine flour with next 4 ingredients in a bowl
5. Cut in butter with a pastry blender until mixture resembles coarse meal
6. Add apricots
7. Toss well
8. Combine egg , buttermilk , and nectar
9. Add to dry ingredients , stirring just until moist
10. Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface and knead 4 or 5 times with floured hands
11. Pat dough into a 9-inch circle on a greased baking sheet
12. Score the dough into 12 wedges , by cutting into , but not through the bottom of dough with a large knife
13. Brush egg white over surface of dough , and sprinkle with 1 tbsp sugar
14. Bake at 400 for 15 minutes or until golden
15. Serve warm

title: berry wonderful berry banana vanilla soy smoothie
steps:
1. Starting with banana's put all ingredients except ice into blender
2. Blend until smooth and creamy , about 3-4 minutes
3. Add ice cubes , this will thicken and lighten the color of your smoothie
4. Pour into glasses , and use a straw
5. Yum !

title: super soft caramel popcorn
steps:
1. Combine sugar , corn syrup , margarine , and salt in medium saucepan
2. Bring to boil
3. Reduce heat to medium and add stir in milk
4. Cook , stirring frequently , to soft ball stage
5. Remove from heat then stir in vanilla
6. Pour slowly over popcorn , stirring until caramel is evenly distributed throughout
7. Store caramel popcorn in covered container
8. I like a little less caramel coating and usually make this recipe with 8 quarts of popcorn

title: marmalade monkey bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Grease a loaf pan with cooking spray
3. In a small bowl , combine the marmalade , nuts , honey and butter
4. Cut each biscuit into 4 pieces
5. Layer half the pieces in the loaf pan , top with half the marmalade mixture
6. Repeat with another layer of biscuit pieces and then the rest of the marmalade mixture
7. Bake for 27-30 minutes or until golden brown
8. Enjoy !

title: bittersweet chocolate biscotti
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 375f
2. Lightly grease a cookie sheet and set aside
3. Beat the butter in a large mixing bowl with an electric mixer on medium to high speed for 30 seconds
4. Add brown sugar , baking powder , and salt
5. Beat until combined , scraping sides of bowl occasionally
6. Beat in the eggs and cocoa powder
7. Beat in as much flour as you can with the mixer
8. Stir in any remaining flour , the hazelnuts , and 4 ounces bittersweet chocolate with a wooden spoon
9. Divide the dough in half
10. Shape each portion into a 9" long roll
11. Place rolls 4 inches apart on the prepared cookie sheet
12. Slightly flatten each roll to 2 inches wide
13. Bake in preheated oven for 20-25 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted near center comes out clean
14. Cool on cookie sheet for about 45 minutes
15. Reduce oven temperature to 325f
16. Cut each roll diagonally into 1 / 2-inch-thick slices , slicing carefully with a serrated knife
17. Place slices , cut sides down , on cookie sheet
18. Bake in 325f oven for 8 minutes
19. Carefully turn slices over and bake for 7-9 more minutes or until dry and crisp
20. Move to wire racks and let cool , about 1 hour
21. Makes 2 dozen
22. Microwave chopped chocolate and shortening in a small microwave-safe bowl on 50 percent power for 1 to 2 minutes or until melted , stirring twice
23. Dip one end of each cookie into melted chocolate
24. Let excess drip back into bowl
25. Place cookies on waxed paper
26. Let sit until set
27. Bake in a preheated 375f oven for 4-5 minutes or until nuts are slightly golden brown , stirring once or twice
28. Wrap warm nuts in a clean kitchen towel
29. Rub nuts in towel to remove any loose skins
30. Cool completely
31. Chop nuts and set aside
32. To store: place cookies in layers separated by pieces of waxed paper in an airtight container
33. Cover
34. Store at room temperature for up to 3 days or freeze for up to 3 months
35. Thaw cookies , if frozen , before serving

title: lamb chops with dijon mustard
steps:
1. In a large frying pan over high heat sear chops on both sides
2. Remove from pan and allow to cool
3. Melt butter in frying pan add garlic , parsley , rosemary and breadcrumbs and toss gently to mix
4. Remove from heat
5. Brush chops with dijon mustard
6. Press each chop into breadcrumbs to coat
7. Bake a 350 for 20 -30 minutes

title: cucumber yoghurt raita
steps:
1. Combine cucumber , spring onion , garlic , ginger , mint , lemon juice and yoghurt in a bowl
2. Season with salt and pepper to taste
3. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes to allow flavours to blend
4. Sprinkle over cumin seeds just before serving and serve chilled

title: cormac purple smoothie
steps:
1. Chop bananas into small pieces , easier to blend
2. Freeze bananas , strawberries , blueberries , blackberries
3. Pour orange juice and pomegranate juice , along with frozen fruit , into blender carafe the night before blending
4. Blend for 2 minutes , or until smooth

title: grilled cinnamon and brown sugar apples
steps:
1. Preheat grill to medium heat
2. Place apple slices in a bowl with water and lemon juice to prevent them from turning brown
3. In another bowl mix cinnamon and sugar
4. Drain apples and place them on grill rack and allow to cook for 6-8 minutes on each side , turning once
5. Remove from grill and sprinkle with the cinnamon brown sugar mixture
6. Garnish as desired and serve !

title: asian vegetable soup with noodles
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , heat vegetable oil over moderately low heat
2. Add scallions , garlic , and ginger and cook , stirring occasionally until fragrant
3. Add soy sauce , red pepper flades , water , and broth and bring to a boil
4. Add carrots and simmer for 5 minute
5. Stir in cabbage and salt and simmer for 5 minute
6. Add bod choy and lemon zest and simmer until bok choy starts to soften , about 5 minute
7. Stir in lemon zest
8. Meanwhile , in large pot of boiling salted water , cook vermicelli until just done , about 9 min
9. Drain
10. Return noodles to the pot and toss with the sesame oil
11. Put some noodle in each of 4 bowls and ladle soup over the noodles

title: affordable basic restaurant style tomato and macaroni soup
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan
2. Bring salted water , onion and pasta to a boil
3. Boil approximately 8 minutes till pasta and onion are cooked
4. Stirring occasionally to ensure pasta does not stick to the bottom of the pan
5. Do not drain
6. Add tomato juice and bring back to a slow boil for about another 2 minutes

title: betty crocker blueberry banana bread
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f
2. Grease bottom of loaf pan , 9x5x3 inches
3. Stir bisquick , oats , sugar , bananas , milk and eggs in large bowl until moistened
4. Beat vigorously 30 seconds
5. Gently stir in blueberries
6. Pour into pan
7. Stir bisquick , oats , sugar , bananas , milk and eggs in large bowl until moistened
8. Beat vigorously 30 seconds
9. Gently stir in blueberries
10. Pour into pan
11. Expert
12. This produces a drier , crisper surface
13. If left in the pan , the bread would become steamed and soft
14. Try using fresh raspberries instead of the blueberries in this flavorful , moist bread

title: berry good morning breakfast casserole  oamc
steps:
1. Trim crusts off the bread and cut into cubes
2. Cut cream cheese into i / 2 inch cubes
3. Spray a 13x9 inch baking pan with non stick baking spray
4. Arrange 1 / 2 of bread cubes in the bottom of the pan
5. Top with 1 / 2 of the cream cheese cubes , mixing the layers somewhat
6. Mix all berries together and pour on top
7. Top with remaining cream cheese and then ending with remaining bread cubes
8. In large bowl beat together remaining ingredients
9. Pour entire mixture on top
10. This can be frozen as is or baked at 350 degrees for 30 minutes and then frozen
11. Be sure to wrap and label before freezing
12. To reheat:
13. From raw: thaw in fridge overnight then bake as directed above
14. From baked: cover with oven proof lid and bake at 375 degrees for 30-45 minutes or until completely warmed through
15. Serve with your favourite syrup

title: chocolate brownie cupcakes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325f and use muffin pan lined with paper liners
2. In a small bowl , mix together flour , cocoa powder , baking powder and salt
3. In a large bowl , whisk together granulated and brown sugars and butter until smooth
4. Whisk in vanilla and almond extract
5. Add eggs , one at a time , beating well after each addition
6. Add flour mixture , beating until combined
7. Stir in chocolate chips
8. Scoop batter into prepared pan
9. Bake in preheated oven for 28 minutes or until a tester inserted into center comes out with a few crumbs attached and a little melted chocolate
10. The tops of cupcakes will not spring back when touched
11. Let cool in pan on rack for 10 minutes
12. Remove from pan and let cool completely on rack
13. Top cooled cupcakes with favorite frosting

title: twinkie toffee temptation
steps:
