1. Prepare pudding with milk , as directed on package
2. Set aside
3. Line 13x9-inch casserole dish with bottom halves of sponge cakes , cream side up
4. Sprinkle with 1 / 2 cup candy
5. Top with reserved pudding
6. Arrange top halves of sponge cakes on pudding
7. Spread on whipped topping
8. Top with remaining candy
9. Cover and refrigerate 2 hours

title: thai squid with chilies and basil
steps:
1. Pound of grind the red and green chilies , the garlic , the cilantro , and salt to a paste
2. Heat the oil in a wok or skillet and fry the paste over high heat for 2 to 3 minutes until fragrant
3. Add the squid and banana peppers and stir-fry for about 3 minutes until squid is cooked
4. Add fish sauce , sugar , lime leaves and basil
5. The mixture should taste hot , salty and sweet , so adjust seasonings if necessary

title: trout meuniere
steps:
1. Rinse trout filets and pat dry
2. Mix salt and pepper with the flour and roll fillets in the flour mixture
3. Melt the butter in a large frying pan and saute the filets for five minutes
4. Turn the fish and saute the other side for about four minutes
5. Put the trout on a warm serving dish and sprinkle with a little more salt and pepper
6. Add the lemon juice and the parsley to the butter remaining in the pan and heat until foamy
7. Pour over the trout and serve

title: mango and strawberry smoothie
steps:
1. Mix well all ingredients in blender
2. Enjoy

title: corn biscuits
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Pour melted butter in 13 x 9 pan
3. In a medium bowl mix bisquick and creamed corn
4. Drop by teaspoons onto melted butter
5. Turn over to coat top and sides with butter
6. Bake 15-20 minutes until golden brown

title: bacon roasted chicken breast smothered in smoked gouda
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. In an oven-safe skillet , cook bacon over medium heat or until crispy and fat-rendered
3. Set bacon slices aside on a paper towel to drain
4. Once cooled , crumble and set aside
5. Do not drain bacon fat from skillet
6. While bacon is cooking , season chicken breasts on both sides with thyme , garlic powder , onion powder , salt and pepper
7. Then dust both wides of each breast with 1 tbs
8. Flour each
9. Bring skillet to medium-high heat
10. Lightly brown both sides of chicken breasts for approximately five minutes each side
11. Don't worry if they don't cook through
12. Remove breasts to a clean plate , cover and set aside
13. Remove skillet from heat and deglaze with white wine
14. Remove from heat
15. Return breasts to skillet , arrange crumbled bacon evenly over both and arrange gouda slices atop bacon layer
16. Roast in oven for 10 minutes or until chicken is cooked through , and cheese has melted and begun to brown

title: twin chocolate delights
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. , rack in the middle position
3. Melt butter in a large microwave-safe bowl
4. Add the sugar and mix
5. Then add the cocoa , soda , salt , vanilla and stir until smooth
6. Add the beaten eggs and stir throughly
7. Mix in the flour , the chopped nuts , and then the chocolate chips
8. Place rounded teaspoons of dough on a greased cookie sheet , 12 to a standard sheet
9. Bake at 350 degrees f
10. For 10 minutes
11. Cool on the cookie sheet for 2 minutes , then remove them to a wire rack to complete cooling

title: grits and greens casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f coat an 8-inch-square baking dish with cooking spray
2. Place bacon in a large dutch oven
3. Cook over medium heat , stirring often , until crispy , 4 to 6 minutes
4. Remove with a slotted spoon to a paper towel-lined plate to drain
5. Pour off the bacon fat
6. Return the pot to medium-low heat
7. Add oil , onion , and garlic and cook , stirring often , until fragrant and starting to brown in spots , 2 to 8 minutes
8. Add 1 cup broth and salt
9. Bring to a boil over high heat
10. Add collards
11. Stir until wilted down to about one-third the volume and bright green , 1 to 2 minutes
12. Cover , reduce heat to medium-low , and simmer , stirring occasionally , until tender , 18 to 20 minutes
13. Adjust heat during cooking to maintain a simmer , and add water , 1 / 4 cup at a time , if the pan seems dry
14. Meanwhile , bring 2 cups water and the remaining 1 cup broth to a boil in a large saucepan
15. Pour in grits in a steady stream , whisking constantly
16. Bring to a simmer , whisking constantly
17. Reduce heat to medium-low and cook , whisking often , until thick , about 5 minutes
18. Combine 1 / 2 cup cheese , salsa , and egg in a small bowl
19. Remove the grits from the heat and quickly stir in the cheese mixture until combined
20. Working quickly , spread about half the grits in the prepared baking dish
21. Top with greens , spreading evenly
22. Spread the remaining grits over the greens
23. Sprinkle with the remaining 1 / 4 cup cheese and the reserved bacon
24. Bake the casserole until hot and bubbling , about 20 minutes
25. Let stand for about 10 minutes before serving

title: almond poppy seed shortbread
steps:
1. Cream together the butter , sugar , cream cheese , poppyseed and almond extract
2. Add the flour and blend well
3. Roll the dough into balls and press down with the palm of your hand to desired size
4. The cookies will not spread
5. Place a sliced almond on top for accent
6. Bake at 350 for 15 minutes

title: vegetable stuffed chicken breasts with tomato basil coulis
steps:
1. Take the chicken breast and place it under plastic wrap and gently pound it with a meat hammer until it's neatly flattened
2. Place the julienne leek , carrot , zucchini and peppers in the middle and roll the chicken breast
3. Wrap it in saran wrap and poach it in boiling water for 8-10 minutes until the chicken is fully cooked
4. Take crushed garlic and gently saute it , add the tomato puree and let simmer for about 10 minutes
5. Season lightly with salt and pepper
6. Add the chopped basil at the end for about three minutes
7. Add the parmesan cheese at the very end
8. Slice the chicken , pour the sauce over top
9. Serve with pasta and fresh vegetables

title: moroccan lentil soup with chickpeas
steps:
1. In a large stockpot , heat oil over medium heat
2. Add mirepoix and garlic
3. Cook , stirring , until soft but not browned , about 5 minutes
4. Stir in lentils , tomtoes , stock , coriander , cumin , turmeric , cinnamon and cayenne
5. Cook , covered , about 25 minutes
6. Using a stick blender , puree for about 15 seconds
7. Stir in garbanzo beans and cilantro
8. Add salt if desired
9. Heat through and serve

title: shanna s favorite chicken kiev
steps:
1. Make seasoned butter: in a medium sized bowl , mix butter , garlic powder , and parsley
2. Slowly add the soy sauce to incorporate
3. Place in the fridge to firm up a bit while you prep the chicken
4. Prepare chicken: preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit
5. Place one chicken breast between two sheets of plastic wrap
6. Using a mallet , flatten to an even thickness of about 1 / 2"
7. Repeat with remaining breasts
8. Dredge chicken breast in flour and place it on the counter smooth side down
9. Take 1 / 8 of the butter and roll it in a log shape the width of a breast
10. Place the butter log on one end of the breast
11. Dust with a little more flour
12. Roll the breast up , securing with a toothpick if needed
13. Take another 1 / 8 of the butter and spread over top
14. Place in baking dish
15. Continue with the other 3 breasts
16. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes

title: canadian aboriginal peoples seafood chowder toody ni
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , bring fish stock to a boil
2. In a large heavy soup pot over medium high heat , heat bacon fat
3. Saute onion , celery , garlic and bay leaf until onions are transparent
4. Stir in flour and cook , stirring , 2 minutes
5. Slowly add hot stock to the roux , stirring well to prevent lumps
6. Bring to a simmer
7. Add potato , carrot and green pepper
8. Simmer until vegetables are tender
9. Add clams , salmon and red snapper
10. Cook over low heat until fish is cooked through and tender , about 10 minutes
11. Discard bay leaf
12. Season with salt and pepper
13. Remove from heat and stir in just enough cream to turn the chowder white
14. Serves 10 to 12 as a starter , 6 to 8 as a main course
15. Feast ! canadian native cuisine for all seasons

title: beef liver   onions curried
steps:
1. Cover bottom of very large skillet with olive oil
2. Slice the onions 1 / 8 of an inch thick & place into skillet
3. Add 1 / 4 tsp salt , 1 tsp pepper , 1 tsp paprika & 1 tsp curry
4. Saut on low heat & covered about 2 1 / 2 to 3 hours
5. Cut liver into 1 1 / 2 to 2 inch cubes
6. Place the cubed liver into a plastic bag with 4 tbsp flour , 1 / 2 tsp salt & 1 / 2 tsp pepper
7. Shake the bag to fully coat all of the liver
8. In a clean skillet , cover bottom with olive oil & on high heat get the oil very hot !
9. Place the liver into the extremely hot oil & sear the liver on both sides
10. Add a little more salt , pepper & curry if needed
11. Add the liver & onions together & fold & serve
12. This could be served , if desired , over either rice , coos coos , polenta or pasta
13. Potatoes are only recommended as a side dish

title: blueberry oat muffins
steps:
1. Combine oats and milk
2. Let stand
3. Mix dry ingredients
4. Add egg and melted butter
5. Add oat mixture
6. Stir til moist
7. Fold in blueberries
8. Fill greased muffin tins 3 / 4 full
9. Bake 400f 15-22 mins

title: german lentil soup
steps:
1. Rinse lentils very well with cold water- pick them over and remove any nasty bits or pieces of stone
2. You can soak them overnight in cold water if you like , then drain before using
3. In a large stockpot , place drained lentils , 6 cups fresh cold water , bouillon cubes , and just half of the diced onion
4. Cook for 1 1 / 2 hours on medium-low heat , covered
5. Add the potatoes and cook until they are tender- 30-40 minutes approximately
6. In a small pan , melt the butter and saute the remaining onions until browned
7. Add the flour to the onions and stir until combined
8. Add to the soup , stirring constantly to combine
9. Add the vinegar and season with salt& pepper to taste
10. Optional:if you would like to add some meat to the soup , simply have pre-cooked sausages sliced into small rounds and drop them into the pot during the last 15 minutes of cooking time

title: chocolate coffee slushies
steps:
1. Put cold coffee , coffee ice cubes , hot chocolate mix , and milk into your blender
2. Use low to medium speed , or whatever speed is recommended for crushing ice , to blend until the coffee ice cubes are thoroughly crushed
3. Pour into serving cups
4. For an attractive presentation top with a dollop of whipped cream and lightly dust with cocoa powder , shaved chocolate , or ground coffee
5. Adding a shot of kahlua to each serving makes a nice drink for the adults on a warm evening
6. Using sugar-free hot chocolate mix and low-fat milk cuts calories if desired

title: flower pot cake
steps:
1. Empty cake mix into a large bowl
2. Mix in water , oil and eggs
3. Bake according to package directions
4. You will have leftover cake -- i usually make mine into muffins and freeze what i dont use
5. Empty pudding mix into another bowl
6. Add milk and beat , according to package directions
7. Let thicken in fridge
8. Grind cookies in blender or food processor until you have very fine crumbs that resemble dirt
9. In a bowl , beat cream cheese and maragrine together
10. Add powdered sugar and beat until smooth and creamy
11. Fold cream cheese micture into thickened pudding
12. Get your flower pot and line the bottom with small square of aluminum foil if the pot has drainage holes
13. Layer ingredients into the flower pot in the following order-
14. Cookie crumbs first
15. Top with crumbled chocolate cake
16. Then pudding mixture
17. Lastly , cool whip
18. Repeat layering 3 to 4 times
19. Top off entire pot with 1" of cookie crumbs
20. Chill until set
21. Garnish with flowers
22. Add gummy worms if you wish
23. Serve with spade

title: pork chops with rhubarb stuffing
steps:
1. Combine rosemary , salt&pepper and sprinkle on pork chops
2. Brown in oil , set aside
3. Make sure you have 1 tbsp of drippings left adding some water if needed
4. Stir together all the stuffing ingredients
5. Grease a casserole dish that will hold chops in a single layer
6. Spoon half stuffing in , top with pork chops and then the remaining stuffing
7. Drizzle with reserved drippings and cover
8. Bake in a 350 oven for 45 minutes
9. Uncover and bake an additional 15 minutes ot till chops are tender

title: eat your fruit and veggies mole
steps:
1. In a blender , puree sauce ingredients
2. Add last cup of broth and blend until combined
3. In a large pot , heat olive oil over medium heat , add onion and bell peppers , saute until softened , about 5 minutes
4. Stir in mole sauce and potatoes , bring to a boil , turn down heat and simmer for 45 minutes
5. Stir in zucchini , yellow squash and vinegar
6. Simmer until they are crisp tender , about 10 minutes
7. Adjust salt and splenda to taste
8. Serve over cooked rice and top with chopped tomatoes , cilantro , and feta cheese

title: butterfinger delight
steps:
1. Mix 2 cups crushed graham cracker and melted butter
2. Press into a 9 x 13 pan
3. Freeze
4. Mix pudding and milk , blend in softened ice cream
5. Pour into pan and freeze until set
6. Spread with whipped topping
7. Mix the crushed butterfingers and 1 / 2 cup of crushed graham cracker and sprinkle over the cool whip
8. Freeze

title: roquefort pasta
steps:
1. In a saucepan , prepare noodles as label directs
2. In a 2 quart saucepan over medium heat , melt butter , stir in flour until blended
3. Cook 1 minute
4. Gradually stir in milk , cook , stirring constantly until mixture thickens and is smooth
5. Add pepper and 1 cup crumbled roquefort , cook , stirring just until cheese melts
6. Drain noodles , return to saucepot
7. Add sauce to noodles
8. Toss to coat well
9. Sprinkle with remaining cheese

title: chicken baked chops
steps:
1. Brown pork chops in oil
2. Place in greased baking dish
3. Combine remaining ingredients in a bowl and stir
4. Pour over chops
5. Bake 1 hour at 350 degrees

title: spicy mexican beef
steps:
1. Heat a small amount of olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat
2. Add the onion , beef and garlic
3. Cook , stirring frequently until meat is browned
4. While meat is cooking , stir together the lime juice , cilantro and salt
5. When the meat is browned , stir in the cilantro mixture
6. Pour in the salsa
7. Cover and simmer for about 1 hour
8. Stirring occasionally , until meat is tender
9. To serve fill tortilla shells with about 2 tablespoons beef mixture and top with lettuce , tomatoes , cheese and sour cream or your choice or taco toppings
10. Crock pot variation: place beef in crock pot
11. Add remaining ingredients and cover
12. Cook on low setting 8 hours or until beef is tender

title: creamy pork tenderloin
steps:
1. Cut tenderloin into 3 / 4" slices
2. In a shallow dish , combine egg , water , rosemary , pepper , and garlic powder
3. Dip pork slices into egg mixture and then into bread crumbs
4. In a large skillet over medium heat , brown pork in oil and butter for 5 minutes on each side
5. Remove pork to a 13x9 baking dish
6. In the same skillet , combine soup and sour cream
7. Heat through
8. Pour sauce over pork
9. Cover and bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes

title: pumpkin crescent rolls  oamc
steps:
1. In a med mixing bowl combine flour , baking powder , baking soda , nutmeg , and salt
2. In a small mixing bowl combine the pumpkin , oil , and brown sugar
3. Add pumpkin mixture to dry mixture stirring with a fork until combined
4. Form into a ball
5. Line a large baking sheet with foil
6. Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface
7. Knead dough gently for 10-12 strokes
8. Divide dough in half
9. Roll each half to a 10" circle
10. Cut each circle into 8 wedges
11. To shape begin at the wide end of each wedge and loosely roll toward the point
12. Place point down about 2" apart on greased baking sheet curving ends slightly
13. Combine the granulated sugar and cinnamon sprinkle over crecents
14. Bake 400f for 9-11 min or until golden brown
15. Serve warm make ahead
16. Freeze in a freezer container or bags up to 1 month
17. Wrap frozen rolls on foil and thaw at room temp for 2 hours
18. Reheat in a 375f oven for 3-5 min

title: ella mae s creamy sure fudge
steps:
1. Mix first five ingredients in saucepan , stirring
2. Constantly , heat to boiling , and boil five minutes
3. Remove from heat , add chocolate and stir till melted
4. Stir in vanilla and walnuts / or pecans
5. Spread in buttered 8" pan
6. Cool until firm
7. Makes about two pounds of fudge

title: jammin  jamaican spice blend
steps:
1. In a large mixing bowl , combine all ingredients and stir until well blended
2. Store mixture in an air-tight container
3. To use: rub the seasoning on meat , or use as the base of a marinade

title: double chocolate pudding
steps:
1. Whisk together in a medium saucepan , sugar , cocoa , cornstarch , x salt
2. Slowly add 1 cup milk and stir til smooth
3. Wisk in rest of milk
4. Set over medium heat and stir until it thickens and comes to a boil[about 5 min]
5. Remove from heat , add the chocolate and vanilla
6. Stir gently til smooth
7. Pour into 6 dessert bowls , cool 20 min and serve warm or chill up to 8 hours

title: kolobki  russian cottage cheese donuts
steps:
1. Combine first 7 ingredients to form a very thick batter
2. Heat oil in a wide frying pan
3. Use a tea-spoon to quickly scoop and drop dough balls
4. Since the batter is pretty thick , use your finger to make the drop
5. Alternatively , form balls roughly 1" in diameter , then drop into oil
6. Do not crowd the pan or drop so many that you won't be able to flip them comfortably
7. Fry past golden-brown , about 90 sec
8. Adjust oil temp if needed
9. Flip using 2 forks
10. Fry the other side
11. Carefully lift each kolobok out onto racks lined with paper towels , sprinkle with powdered sugar
12. Repeat until batter runs out , and serve whatever hasn't been stolen from the plate
13. Top with sour cream or possibly syrup / jams ? should keep well overnight

title: chocolate spice zucchini cake
steps:
1. To make the cake: preheat the oven to 350^f
2. Generously coat a bundt pan with nonstick spray
3. In a medium bowl , whisk together the flour , sugar , cocoa , baking powder , orange peel , baking soda , cinnamon , and salt
4. Set aside
5. In a large bowl , using an electric mixer set on high speed , beat the eggsand egg whites for 2 minutes , or until frothy and thickened
6. Add the buttermilk , applesauce , and vanilla extract
7. Beat just until blended
8. Gradually beat in half of the flour mixture
9. Beat in the remaining flour mixture
10. Stir in the zucchini and walnuts
11. Scrape into the preapared pan
12. Bake for 45 to 50 minutes , or until a wooden pick inserted in the center comes out clean
13. Cool in the pann on a rack for 15 minutes
14. Loosen the edges of the cake by gently inserting a thin rubber spatula or knife around the sides and center
15. Invert the cake onto the rack to cool completely
16. To make the glaze: in a small microwaveable cup , combine the chocolate chips and oil
17. Cook in the microwave on high for 30 seconds and stir
18. Repeat just until the chocolate can be stirred into a smooth glaze
19. Drizzle the warm glaze over the cooled cake

title: honey french toast
steps:
1. Add flour , sugar , salt , milk , and eggs to a mixing bowl
2. Whisk until well blended
3. In a skillet over medium-high heat , melt butter
4. I start with 1 tablespoon and add to it as needed
5. Dip both sides of bread slice into egg mixture
6. Place 2-3 slices of bread in skillet and cook for 2-3 minutes on each side or until golden brown
7. Transfer to individual plates and drizzle with warm honey
8. Enjoy

title: stromboli with prosciutto  peppers  onions  garlic   shrooms
steps:
1. In a large pan heat oil add the onions , peppers , mushrooms , garlic and spices
2. Go ahead and season to taste with salt and pepper if desired
3. Saute till soft and translucent
4. Cool
5. Preheat oven to 425
6. Roll out the dough into about 12x10
7. Place prosciutto on the end near you covering 1 / 4-1 / 3 of the dough
8. Place the cheese over the prosciutto
9. Top with the vegetable mixture dot the sauce over the veggies
10. Roll the side with the toppings into the bare dough
11. Bringing the side up and pinching so nothing leaks out
12. Score the top of the dough for steam to escape
13. You can do an egg wash of just brush with water
14. Bake for 25 minutes
15. Remove and let rest for 10 minutes before slicing
16. Enjoy !
17. Live , love , & laugh

title: eggplant  aubergine  bharta
steps:
1. Cut eggplants in half
2. Rub some oil over the cut side of the eggplant
3. Roast or broil , until the skin is lightly burned , and the eggplant is completely soft
4. Peel eggplant
5. Put pulp into a bowl , and mash with a potato masher
6. Add onion , garlic , chilies , salt , cilantro , and 1 / 2 tsp oil , and mix very well
7. Heat remaining oil in a frying pan
8. Add eggplant mixture , and fry for 3-5 minutes , until fairly dry
9. Serve alone , or with basmati rice

title: batter bread
steps:
1. Mix together all ingredients and add flour
2. Put into loaf pan and put in cold over
3. Turn oven on 350 degress for 1 min
4. , then turn over off for 15 minutes
5. Turn oven back on 350 degrees for 35-40 minutes let cool

title: santa fe chicken and rice  quick
steps:
1. Cook rice according to directions on the bag
2. While rice is cooking , cook chicken in oil over medium heat
3. Cut chicken into 1 inch cubes
4. Mix together chicken , rotel , santa fe corn , black beans , and monterey jack cheese until cheese is melted

title: chicken   green beans parmesan
steps:
1. Run water over beans to separate
2. Place in baking dish , mix with 3 / 4 c sauce , parmesan and pepper
3. Arrange chicken overall
4. Drizzle with remaining sauce
5. Bake , covered , for 40-45 minutes
6. Sprinkle with mozzarella cheese
7. Bake 2 minutes more

title: chicken stuffed manicotti or jumbo shells with chive cream sauce
steps:
1. Cook manicotti or shells according to package directions
2. Drain shells
3. Rinse with cold water
4. Drain again
5. Meanwhile , for sauce , in a small heavy saucepan melt cream cheese over medium-low heat , stirring constantly
6. Slowly add milk , stirring until smooth
7. Stir in romano or parmesan cheese
8. Remove from heat
9. For filling , in a medium bowl stir together 3 / 4 cup of the sauce , chicken , broccoli , roasted red peppers and black pepper
10. Using a small spoon , carefully fill each shell with about 1 / 3 cup of the filling
11. Arrange the filled shells in a 3-quart rectangular baking dish
12. Pour the remaining sauce over the shells
13. Sprinkle with paprika
14. Cover with foil
15. Bake in a 350^ oven for 25 to 30 minutes or until heated through

title: creepy crawler
steps:
1. Combine ingredients in a shaker with ice
2. Serve in a mason jar and garnish with gummy worms
3. That's it !

title: beef tenderloin
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325f
2. Smear outside of the tenderloin liberally with olive oil
3. Sprinkle liberally with garlic salt and pepper
4. Put the tenderloin on a broiler pan , and roast in 325f oven for 15 minutes per pound for rare or 20 minutes per pound for medium rare
5. Let rest 10-15 minutes before carving

title: italian chicken  crock pot  slow cooker
steps:
1. Place chicken in crock pot
2. Combine the tomatoes , 3 / 4 cup water , onion , bouillon and seasonings and pour over chicken
3. Cook on low for 3-4 hours
4. Pour cooking juices from crock pot into a saucepan
5. Combine cornstarch and 3 tablespoons of water until smooth
6. Stir into cooking juices and bring to a boil
7. Cook and stir until thickened
8. Serve with chicken and rice

title: stove top chocolate pudding
steps:
1. Combine dry ingredients in a small saucepan
2. Grate chocolate into mixture , make a well
3. Mix in chocolate milk with wisk
4. Heat on a low medium for 5-10 minutes , stirring constantly until desired thickness is reached
5. Pour quickly into two small ramekins or bowls , try not to scrape the sides too much or you'll get small chunks in the middle of the pudding
6. Chill or eat warm

title: cracker dip
steps:
1. Combine and bake at 350f for approxomately 30 minutes
2. Serve warm with crackers or hard breaded rounds

title: hot lime and mango chutney
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in large noncorrosive saucepan and heat , stirring occasionally , over high heat to boiling
2. Reduce heat to low and simmer uncovered , stirring occasionally , until thickened , 25-35 minutes
3. Remove chutney from heat and let cool to room temperature
4. Transfer to serving bowl and refrigerate covered 1 hour
5. Serve cold with roast pork or chicken , curried dishes , or fish
6. Store covered in refrigerator up to 1 month

title: oriental ramen cole slaw salad
steps:
1. For the dressing , combine vinegar , vegetable oil , sugar and the two flavor packets from the ramen noodles , set aside
2. In a large bowl , combine cole slaw mix , crushed ramen noodles and sunflower seeds
3. Pour dressing mixture over salad and toss well to coat
4. Cover and let it sit for 2 to 3 hours in the fridge
5. Enjoy !

title: the lunchbox
steps: 1. Chill & strain into a glass

title: snowman bouquet or pops
steps:
1. The pops are very heavy after dipping
2. Popsicle sticks could be used if making only individual pops
3. Place two marshmallows on the flat end of each of the 16 skewers
4. Do not pierce all of the way thru the top marshmallow
5. Be sure the pointed end of the skewer is down and not inside the marshmallows !
6. Break almond bark into chunks
7. Place into micro safe bowl & cook 1 minute in the microwave
8. Stir
9. Continue microwaving 30 seconds at a time until melted
10. Stir each time
11. Dip the skewers into the melted almond bark
12. Roll until well covered
13. Let dry
14. Color the royal icing in desired colors and pipe on eyes , a carrot nose , mouth , and a scarf or buttons
15. Let dry completely before proceeding to arrange or wrap
16. You can also use icing in the tubes if a long hold time is not needed
17. Cut skewers into desired lengths
18. Arrange into a bouquet in a coffee mug or other container
19. I placed styrofoam and shredded paper in the mug so there would be a base to hold the pops
20. After the bouquet is made wrap it in a printed or clear cellophane bag & tie with ribbon
21. You can also wrap individually with plastic wrap & tie with a ribbon or poke them into a vase with a flower frog

title: mr  funk s punch
steps: 1. Mix and serve over ice

title: basil parmesan pasta salad
steps:
1. Cook and drain pasta , add oil , garlic , onion and spices and while the pasta is hot
2. Allow to cool for a few minutes and add herbs , cheese and mayo
3. Salt and pepper to taste
4. Can be served cold or room temperature

title: garlic and herb cheese stuffed chicken rollups
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees
2. Spread garlic and herb cheese spread over chicken
3. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese
4. Roll up chicken
5. Spear with toothpicks to hold in place
6. Dip in butter
7. Roll in stuffing
8. Place , seam-side down , in shallow baking pan
9. Pour any remaining butter over chicken
10. Bake 30 minutes or until no longer pink in center
11. Remove toothpicks before serving

title: cheese meat loaf with chili sauce
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients , and shape into loaf
2. Place in a greased slow cooker
3. Cover , cook on low 6-8 hours
4. Slice and serve with tomato sauce or ketchup

title: molasses maple glazed beef brisket crock pot
steps:
1. Combine cayenne pepper , salt and pepper in a small bowl
2. Rub mixture all over the brisket
3. Place brisket in resealable plastic bag
4. Combine olive oil , maple syrup , molasses , brown sugar , tomato paste , orange juice , garlic and orange peel in a small bowl
5. Pour mixture over brisket in plastic bag
6. Refrigerate marinated brisket for at least 2 hours or overnight , turning bag several times
7. Transfer brisket and marinade to crockpot and cook on low for 7-9 hours or on high for 3 1 / 2-4 hours , turning once or twice
8. Adjust seasonings to taste
9. Slice thinly across the grain and serve
10. Enjoy

title: pizza dough  abm
steps:
1. Add lukewarm water and oil to pan
2. Add flour , sugar , italian seasoning and salt to the pan
3. Tap pan to settle dry ingredients , then push some ingredients to the corner
4. Make a well in the center of dry ingredients
5. Add yeast
6. Lock pan into breadmaker
7. Program breadmaker for the dough cycle
8. When done , remove dough from the pan and place on a floured surface
9. Knead for 1 minute the let dough rest for 15 minutes
10. Roll dough out to fit your pizza pan
11. Place on greased pan
12. Top as desired and bake in a 425 degree oven for 10 - 15 minutes or until nicely browned

title: homemade tortilla chips
steps:
1. Heat oil in heavy pot
2. While waiting , stack tortillas in an even pile
3. With a sharp , heavy knife cut the stack in half , then into quarters , then into eighths
4. When oil is very hot , drop tortilla triangles in oil a few at a time
5. Fry for 2-3 minutes or until turn lightly brown and crisp
6. Place in colander and sprinkle salt over chips
7. Shake lightly

title: orange coffee
steps:
1. Mix all together
2. For 1 cup coffee , place 2 rounded teaspoons in a cup and fill with hot water

title: peach french toast bake
steps:
1. Coat a 9 x 13-inch baking pan with cooking spray
2. Cut the baguette into 1 / 2 inch thick slices and arrange them in a single layer in the pan
3. In a medium bowl , whisk together the whole eggs , egg whites , milk and vanilla
4. Pour the egg mixture over the bread in the pan
5. Scatter the peach slices evenly over the bread
6. Sprinkle the brown sugar and cinnamon over the peaches
7. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight
8. Preheat the oven to 350f uncover and bake until it is slightly puffed and the bread is golden brown , about 40 minutes
9. Top with yogurt and drizzle with maple syrup , if desired

title: carrots with mango chutney
steps:
1. Cook carrots until tender crisp
2. Drain well
3. Reduce heat and add butter , ginger and orange juice concentrate
4. Cook 2 - 3 minutes
5. Add chutney and cook until very hot
6. Season
7. P
8. S
9. These are not too sweet , but i am sure sugar could be added to suit personal tastes

title: feta topped broiled chicken
steps:
1. In a small bowl , stir together the tomato paste , vinegar , rosemary , oregano , paprika , salt , and pepper
2. Rub the mixture onto the chichen breasts and set aside
3. Preheat the broiler
4. Broil the chicken 6 inches from the heat , turning once
5. Broil for 6 min or until chicken is cooked through
6. Top the chicken with tomato slices and broil for 1 minute
7. Top with the feta and broil for 1 min , or untill the cheese is melting
8. Place the chicken breasts on 4 plates and serve

title: warm german potato salad
steps:
1. In a 5-quart saucepan , bring 1 inch salted water to a boil
2. Reduce to a simmer
3. Add potatoes
4. Cover
5. Cook until tender when pierced with the
6. Drain
7. Cool slightly and halve
8. In a small skillet over medium heat , cook bacon until crispy , 3 to 5 minutes
9. Add onion
10. Cook , stirring often , until tender , 2 to 4 minutes
11. Remove from heat
12. Add 3 tablespoons vinegar and mustard
13. Toss with warm potatoes
14. If desired , season with salt and pepper , and add up to 1 tablespoon more vinegar
15. Serve warm

title: turkish spice mix
steps:
1. Stir spices together
2. Store in an airtight jar

title: awesome apricot chicken curry
steps:
1. Cook onion , garlic , and curry in margarine for a couple of minutes
2. Push mixture to one side of skillet and cook chicken for five or six minutes until pink is gone
3. Stir together chicken and onion mixture
4. Add preserve , apple , raisins , cashews , and 1 / 3 cups water or white wine
5. Mix yoghurt and cornstarch together and stir until there are no lumps
6. Then add it to the skillet and mix everything well
7. Let it all boil slowly for at least two minutes to get rid of the starchy flavor from the cornstarch
8. Plate it up over the base of your choice
9. Traditionally the base is rice
10. But try being daring and use angel hair pasta or toasted english muffins
11. Burp

title: weekday cassoulet
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
2. Rinse the chicken , then pat very dry
3. Season with salt and pepper
4. Let sit at room temperature for 15 minutes
5. Meanwhile , in a small saute pan over low heat , add the oil and the garlic
6. Stir until the oil is fragrant , about 1 minute
7. Add the bread crumbs and cook , stirring often , until the bread crumbs start to turn golden , about 2 to 3 minutes
8. Season with salt and pepper , remove from heat and set aside
9. Put the bacon in a large dutch oven over medium-low heat , and slowly render the fat
10. When crispy , remove the bacon to a paper-towel-lined plate with a slotted spoon , leaving the fat in the pan
11. Raise the heat to medium-high and add the chicken , skin side down
12. Brown the chicken on both sides and then remove to a plate and tent with foil
13. Add the onion , celery , carrots and garlic to the pot and saute until soft , about 5 minutes
14. Deglaze the pan with white wine
15. Simmer until reduced by half
16. Stir in the beans , bay leaf and thyme
17. Nestle the chicken thighs and bacon into the pot
18. Add the chicken stock , cover and bake in the oven for 20 minutes
19. Remove from the oven , remove the lid and top the cassoulet with sliced tomatoes and the garlic bread crumbs
20. Return to the oven and bake , uncovered , 15 minutes longer
21. Serve the cassoulet with baguette slices

title: running creek spaghetti sauce
steps:
1. In a large stock pan , saute onions , garlic , and green peppers in the olive oil until the onions are translucent
2. Add oregano , marjoram , basil , rosemary and crushed red peppers
3. Saute a few minutes longer
4. Add tomatoe juice and bring to a boil
5. Reduce heat to low and add the brown sugar
6. Squeeze the whole tomatoes through your hand when adding to the pot and add the juice from the can to the pot also
7. Add the remaining ingredients
8. Simmer at least 3 hours the longer the better i usually start it in the morning and simmer all day

title: celestial french toast
steps:
1. Slice each croissant almost in half , so that when they open they resemble a butterfly shape
2. Beat the eggs , milk , and spices together
3. In a seperate bowl , whip the cream cheese until soft and smooth
4. Spread the cream cheese on both sides of each croissant , and top with strawberry slices and blueberries , pushing the fruit slightly into the cream cheese
5. Fold the croissant back into full shape
6. Melt the butter in a large frying pan over medium to high heat
7. Dip the filled croissants into the egg mixture - allowing both sides to soak up the egg mixture
8. Gently lift the filled croissants out of the egg mixture and place onto frying pan
9. Fry on one side until golden , turn over and fry the other side until golden , about two minutes per side
10. Serve warm with fresh fruits , flavored syrups , honey , or preserves

title: asparagus pasta salad    vegetarian
steps:
1. Put the pieces of asparagus stem in a steamer basket & steam for 8 to 10 minutes before adding the top pieces , then steam another 5 to 7 minutes or until all is crisp-tender
2. Drain & cool
3. In a large bowl , combine asparagus & the remaining ingredients , tossing to coat
4. Cover & refrigerate 3 to 4 hours or overnight

title: basic biscuits my style
steps:
1. In a large mixing bowl , mix the flour , baking powder , and salt together
2. Then , using a pastry cutter or a pair of knives , a spoon , or your hands , cut the butter into the flour
3. Basically , cut the butter and mix with flour to coat and separate the pieces
4. Continue until you get pea sized pieces of butter
5. It is important that the butter be cold for this process and not begin to melt
6. If it starts to get a little mushy , you can slip it into the refrigerator for 15 minutes to firm back up a bit before continuing
7. Pour the milk in and mix gently with a spatula
8. Do not knead , just gently mix
9. Using your hands , form the dough into a ball once the milk has been evenly distributed through the dough
10. You might need to use a kneading action to get it into a manageable shape and to remove some dough from the sides of your container , but try not to knead too much
11. Transfer the dough to a piece of parchment paper or clean surface and roll out into a large sheet about 1 / 4 inch in thickness
12. Use a cup or biscuit cutter to cut rounds out of the dough
13. Do not twist the cup or cutter
14. Twisting will result in uneven or failed rising
15. Usually it's a good idea to press the top of the biscuit down a little or else you will get biscuits with rounded tops
16. Now , biscuit placement is key to getting good rise out of the biscuits
17. Place the biscuit dough circles into two 9" cake rounds or onto a half sheet pan
18. Have the biscuits just touching
19. This should give enough air between the biscuits to allow even heating , but not so much space that the biscuits spread out when they rise
20. Bake in a 425f oven until golden

title: delicious chicken poblano
steps:
1. Shake pepper and thyme on chicken breasts
2. Melt butter in skillet and brown the chicken
3. Set aside in a baking dish and preheat oven to 375 degrees
4. In a saute pan , melt butter and saute onion and poblano peppers till soft
5. Take 3 / 4 of the onion and pepper mixture and place in blender along with a dash of salt
6. Add sour cream and whipping cream to reach a thick consistency
7. Turn on blender and puree , leaving some of the texture- set aside
8. Place chicken breasts in a baking dish , squeeze lime juice on each breast , then pour the pureed mixture over them
9. Take the remainder of the peppers and onion and place them on top of the chickens
10. Cover the top with cheese and lightly sprinkle thyme on top of everything
11. Place in the oven uncovered for 25 minutes- the cheese will be starting to brown by then
12. Serving suggestion: with rice !

title: pesto chicken spaghetti
steps:
1. Saute onion and garlic for 2 minutes
2. Brown chicken meat with onion and garlic so it gets some color but is not cooked through
3. Add broccoli , carrot , pesto , cook for a few minutes , stirring so pesto is mixed through
4. The carrot will be crisp but that's how we like it
5. For a softer carrot add it in earlier , or even microwave it prior to starting the recipe
6. Add evaporated milk to chicken , pesto and vegies
7. Stir thoroughly and taste for seasoning
8. Add more pesto if you would like and a good grinding of black pepper
9. Simmer sauce ubtil milk is hot & everything is combined
10. Add spaghetti to pan and toss to coat
11. Serve hot with parmesan cheese if desired and good crusty bread

title: pulled pork and sweet potato quesadillas  sp5
steps:
1. Warm sweet potatoes and pulled pork in microwave according to package directions
2. Spread half the tortillas with 1 / 2 cup sweet potatoes
3. Top each with 1 / 3 of the pork and 1 / 3 of the cheese
4. Cover with remaining tortillas
5. Spray large nonstick skillet with cooking spray
6. Heat over medium-high heat
7. Cook quesadillas 2-3 minutes on each side or until golden brown and cheese is melted
8. Cut each quesadilla into 4 wedges and sprinkle with green onions

title: potatoes pancakes
steps:
1. Dry potatoes with paper towels
2. Combine all ingredients except for oil
3. Warm oil in a large skillet
4. Pour 1 / 4 cup of mixture for each pancake into oil , flatten slightly with spatula
5. Cook until golden brown on both sides

title: rice with carrots and peas  rice cooker
steps:
1. Melt 1 tbsp of butter in a small skillet over medium heat
2. Add the carrots and cook , stirring , until they begin to soften , 2-3 minutes
3. Place rice in rice cooker bowl
4. Add beef stock , parsley , thyme , peas and sauteed carrots
5. Stir to combine
6. Close cover
7. Set to regular cycle
8. When machine switches to keep warm cycle , let the rice steam for 10 minutes
9. Fluff rice with wooden or plastic rice paddle or wooden spoon
10. This rice will hold for 1-2 hours on keep warm cycle
11. When ready to serve , add remaining 1 tbsp butter and almonds
12. Stir to distribute
13. Serve immediately

title: easy slow cooker french dip
steps:
1. Trim excess fat from the rump roast , and place in a slow cooker
2. Add the beef broth , onion soup and beer
3. Cook on low setting for 7 hours
4. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
5. Split french rolls , and spread with butter
6. Bake 10 minutes , or until heated through
7. Slice the meat on the diagonal , and place on the rolls
8. Serve the sauce for dipping

title: potato slices made like potato skins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Brush both sides of potato slices with butter and place on an ungreased baking sheet
3. Bake for 30 to 40 minutes or until lightly browned on both sides , turning once during baking
4. Remove from oven and top with bacon , cheese and green onions
5. Return to oven and bake until cheese melts
6. Serve topped with a dollop of sour cream

title: low fat yogurt hollandaise sauce
steps:
1. Beat eggs , yogurt , lemon juice in double boiler
2. Cook for about 15 min or until thickened
3. Remove from heat and stir in dill , salt , pepper and mustard
4. Serve warm
5. Can be refrigerated for up to 1 week
6. Reheat over hot not boiling water

title: homemade granola without nuts
steps:
1. Place brown sugar and water in a large microwavable bowl and dissolve the sugar in the water for 2-3 minutes
2. Add the oatmeal and mix until well coated
3. Add honey or cinnamon or any other ingrediens you desire
4. Mix well
5. Line a couple cookie sheets with parchment paper
6. Place the oatmeal mixture in a thin layer onto sheets
7. Bake at 275 for one hour , stirring every 15 minutes
8. Let cool and place into air tight container
9. Will keep for about 2 weeks

title: godiva tiramisu
steps:
1. Mix 3 ounces of godiva liqueur with coffee and set aside
2. For each serving , trim 4 ladyfingers to fit along the sides and bottom of a 1 cup souffl dish
3. Pour 1 ounce of the reserved coffee into each souffl dish and set aside
4. Beat together the mascarpone cheese , egg yolks , sugar and remaining 2 ounces of godiva liqueur until smooth
5. Whip the egg whites until stiff
6. Fold into the cheese
7. Divide the filling evenly among the souffl dishes
8. Sprinkle with chocolate and refrigerate overnight

title: blue cheese   chive dip
steps:
1. Combine first 6 ingredients in a bowl and mix well
2. Season dip with salt and pepper to taste
3. Serve with chips or crackers

title: texas brownies
steps:
1. In large mixing bowl , combine flour and sugar
2. In heavy saucepan , combine butter , shortening , coffee and cocoa
3. Stir and heat to boiling
4. Pour boiling mixture over the flour and sugar in bowl
5. Add buttermilk , eggs , baking soda& vanilla
6. Mix will , using wooden spoon or on high sprrd electric mixer
7. Pour into well buttered 85 1 / 2 by 11 inch jelly roll pan
8. Bake at 400f degrees for 20 minutes or until brownies test done in center
9. While brownies bake , prepare the frosting
10. In saucepan , combine butter , cocoa and milk
11. Heat to boiling , stirring
12. Mix in powdered sugar and vanilla stir until smooth
13. Pour warm frosting over brownies as soon as you take them out of the oven
14. Cool

title: roasted bananas with maple syrup
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 200 degrees c
2. Line a baking tray with baking paper
3. Halve each banana lengthways leaving the skin on
4. Place on the baking tray flesh side up
5. Sprinkle top of each banana with sugar and lime juice and dot with the butter
6. Bake for 15 minutes until softened and golden with dark skins
7. Serve drizzled with maple syrup and topped with icecream and zest

title: gomashio  toasted sesame salt
steps:
1. In a heavy skillet , toast salt until it turns a grey color
2. Set aside
3. Toast the 2 cups sesame seeds , stirring constantly , till they start popping and turn a nice brown
4. Watch them closely , or they will burn !
5. The traditional way to grind them is with a mortar and pestle , just until the seeds crack open and release their oils
6. The texture should be light and sandy
7. They should ultimately be 95% crushed
8. Because i do not currently own a mortar and pestle , i have put them in the blender and whiz them a few times till blended thoroughly
9. Update: now i use a coffee grinder or a food processor to grind
10. Store gomasio in a tightly closed glass jar , keep in a cool dry place
11. Do not refrigerate !
12. I have kept this for over 6 months without spoiling
13. This is delicious over brown rice , salad , baked potatoes , veggies , almost anything !
14. Enjoy !

title: healthy vegan muffins
steps:
1. Preheat over to 375f
2. Prepare a 12-muffin tin with paper liners or non-stick spray
3. In a medium mixing bowl , combine the flours , baking powder , cinnamon , nutmeg , allspice , salt , sugar , raisins and flax seeds
4. In a small bowl , whisk the molasses , applesauce , soymilk and oil
5. Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until the mixture is blended
6. Distribute batter evenly in the 12-muffin tin
7. Bake 20-25 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the middle of a muffin comes out mostly clean

title: panera saint louis bread co s asiago bagel breakfast bake
steps:
1. This dish must be prepared the night before you plan to bake it
2. In a large mixing bowl , beat together the eggs , salt , milk , tarragon and paprika
3. Add fresh ground pepper to taste
4. Mix the grated cheeses together in a bowl
5. Cut the bagels into small bite-size pieces
6. Grease a 2-quart souffle or casserole dish and , starting with the bagel pieces , place them in the dish in alternating layers with the grated cheese
7. Pour the egg mixture evenly over all , cover the dish , and place it in the refrigerator overnight
8. Bake it uncovered , in a pre-heated 350 degree oven for 1 hour , until the top is golden brown

title: hamburger round the pan
steps:
1. Start macaroni cooking
2. Fry hamburger in large skillet with salt / pepper / garlic powder / onion powder / chili powder to taste
3. Drain when cooked through
4. Drain macaroni and add to hamburger in skillet
5. Add tomato soup and water heat through
6. Serve
7. Very tasty with a salad and italian bread and butter

title: easy peasy pot roast
steps:
1. Place roast in crockpot
2. Mix both cans of soup and dry beefy onion seasoning in bowl , and pour over roast
3. Turn on low , and cook for 8 hours , or until the roast is desired tenderness
4. That's it -- really !
5. We usually serve this with cowboy mashed potatoes and rolls
6. Enjoy !

title: old fashioned bbq chicken
steps:
1. Whisk first 10 ingredients well in med bowl
2. Remove 1 1 / 2c of mix
3. Cover& refrigerate
4. Place chicken in lg zip bag
5. Add rest of marinade , seal& toss to coat
6. Chill overnight , turning several times oil grill rack
7. 4-5inches from heat
8. Prepare med
9. Fire& place legs and thighs on for 10 mins& then add other pieces
10. Cover leaving vent open , cook turning often for 30-35 mins internal temps should be 170 for breasts , 180 thighs , legs and wings
11. Heat sauce in fridge and brush each piece generously
12. Garnish with watercress

title: thai cabbage coleslaw
steps:
1. Combine lime juice , vinegar , fish sauce , water , peanut butter , chile paste and garlic in a large bowl , stirring with a whisk until blended
2. Add cabbages , bell pepper , and carrot , and toss gently to coat
3. Cover and marinate in refrigerator 1 hour
4. Stir in the peanuts , cilantro , and mint just before serving

title: italian spaghetti soup with garlic
steps:
1. Place everything except for spaghetti and spinach in a large kettle with 2 quarts of water
2. Bring to a boil
3. Cover and simmer 1 hour
4. Add seasonings , spaghetti and spinach
5. Simmer 10-12 minutes until spaghetti in tender
6. Drain
7. Add a small drizzle of olive oil to each bowl when serving

title: shrimp and cilantro pesto quesadilla
steps:
1. Make the cilantro pesto: in a food processor , blend all of the ingredients except for the olive oil
2. While the processor is running , slowly add the olive oil
3. Cover the pesto and refrigerate
4. Preheat oven to 450f
5. Place two tortillas on an undgreased baking sheet
6. Sprread each with 2 tbs of the pesto and sprinkle with the cheeses
7. Season with salt and pepper
8. Stack one tortilla on top of the other and cover with the remaining tortilla
9. Brush the top with 1 tbs of olive oil and sprinkle evenly with the ancho powder
10. Bake until the tortillas are slightly crisp and the cheese has melted , 8 to 12 minutes
11. Meanwhile , heat the remaining 2 tbs of olive oil
12. Season the shrimp and saute for 2 1 / 2 minutes on each side
13. Cut the quesadillas into quarters
14. Garnish with the remaining tablespoon of pesto , the shrimp and the sour cream and serve hot

title: super spinach lasagna
steps:
1. Cook noodles al dente , drain , rinse& let sit in cold water until needed
2. Add olive oil and red pepper flakes to frying pan ,
3. Add onion , red pepper , and garlic , and cook until tender
4. In a large bowl , combine saut mix with spinach , mushrooms , mozzarella , ricotta , and 1 / 3 cup parmesan cheese , 1 t oregano , and eggs
5. Mix well , and set aside
6. In frying pan , melt butter , add flour making a paste , and stir for 2 minutes
7. Slowly add milk and add 1 / 3 cup parmesan cheese , oregano , and salt& pepper
8. Stir sauce over medium heat until thickened
9. Coat lasagna pan with non-stick spray , then wipe gently with paper towel
10. Add some white sauce to thinly coat bottom of pan
11. Rotate rows of drained noodles , spinach mixture , and sauce
12. Sprinkle last row of noodles with 1 / 3 cup parmesan cheese , and a few sliced mushrooms
13. Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour or so , until bubbling

title: spaghetti meat sauce
steps:
1. In a large 4 quart sauce pan heat the oil and saute the onion and garlic over med-low heat for about 5 minutes or until onions are translucent
2. Add beef and continue to cook for about 5-10 minutes
3. Drain the grease
4. Add remaining ingredients and blend well together
5. Cover the pan , reduce heat and cook on low for 1 hour

title: pecan pumpkin biscuits
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine the first six ingredients
2. Cut in butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs
3. Stir in pecans
4. Combine pumpkin and cream
5. Stir into dry ingredients
6. Turn onto a floured surface
7. Knead four to six times
8. Roll to 1 / 2-in
9. Thickness
10. Cut with a 2-1 / 2-in
11. Biscuit cutter
12. Place on a greased baking sheet
13. Bake at 400 degrees f for 12-15 minutes or until golden brown

title: homemade corned beef   dry brine
steps:
1. Rub seasonings all over meat
2. Place in a large plastic bag , pressing as much air out of the bag as you can
3. Seal
4. You will see red juice exude inside the bag which lets you know the cure has begun
5. Set bag in a pan or bowl
6. Weight with a second pan or bowl for the first 2 days
7. Once or twice a day , massage meat and turn
8. The cure is done in about 2 weeks
9. It will keep in its present state for several months
10. It just needs to be turned every few days
11. Before cooking , the meat needs to be de-salted
12. Twenty-four hours before cooking wash the cure off the beef and soak the meat in a large bowl of cold water in the refrigerator
13. Change the water 2 or 3 times in the 24 hour period
14. Please

title: berry trifle
steps:
1. Cube angel food cake with a serrated knife
2. It's easier if you handle the knife lightly so you don't crush the cake
3. Cream together the cream cheese , powdered sugar , 1 / 2 teaspoon vanilla extract and almond flavoring
4. Add the sour cream to the cream cheese mixture and blend thoroughly
5. In a separate bowl add 4 tablespoons powdered sugar to the whipping cream
6. Whip until soft peaks form
7. This step works best if you chill the whisk and metal bowl ahead of time
8. Mix the whipped cream into the cream cheese mixture until thoroughly combined
9. Clean and rough chop the fruit as is necessary
10. Mix it with 3 tablespoons powdered sugar or to taste
11. Layer angel food cake with cream cheese "fluff" and berries or fruit

title: autumn apple cupcakes with cream cheese frosting
steps:
1. For cupcakes: position rack in the middle of the oven-- preheat to 350
2. Line 12 medium muffin tins with paper lining
3. Put grated apple in small bowl and stir with brandy
4. Put flour , sugar , baking soda , salt , cinnamon , nutmeg , and cloves in large mixing bowl
5. Mix on low speed to combine ingredients
6. Mix in eggs , oil , vanilla , and apple mixture
7. Divide the batter between the 12 muffin tins , about 3 tbsp
8. Batter each
9. Bake 23-25 minutes , or until toothpick comes out clean
10. Turnmuffin tins about 12 minutes into baking time to ensure cupcakes bake evenly cool cupcakes 5 minutes in pan
11. Transfer to wire rack and cool completely
12. For frosting: put butter , cream cheese , and vanilla in mixing bowl
13. Beat on medium speed for about 1 minute until mixture is blended and smooth
14. Decrease the speed to low , and gradually beat in powdered sugar
15. Beat until frosting is smooth
16. Spread frosting over cooled cupcakes

title: pineapple milkshake
steps:
1. In a food processor , combine pineapple , ice cream , milk , and cinnamon
2. Process until smooth

title: julie s spiced apple cider
steps:
1. Place juices and cloves in large saucepan on stove , bring to boil then remove from heat
2. Strain out cloves
3. Add cinnamon sticks
4. Transfer to crock pot and keep warm for 1-6 hours
5. Party guests can serve themselves directly from crock pot

title: gazpacho shrimp salad
steps:
1. Combine salad greens , tomato , avocado and cucumber in a large bowl
2. Combine salsa , balsamic vinegar , garlic and olive oil in a small bowl
3. Add salt and black pepper if desired
4. Add dressing to salad greens and toss well
5. Transfer to salad plates , top salads with shrimp
6. Sprinkle with cilantro

title: chocolate raspberry loaf
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Spray 9x5-inch loaf pan with nonstick cooking spray
3. Set aside
4. Melt chocolate chips and butter in small saucepan over low heat
5. Combine flour , sugar , baking soda , baking powder and salt in large bowl
6. Add walnuts
7. Mix well
8. Lightly beat eggs in medium bowl with wire whisk
9. Add milk , spreadable fruit and vanilla
10. Beat until well blended
11. Add chocolate and milk mixtures to flour mixture
12. Stir just until moistened
13. Pour into prepared pan
14. 3
15. Bake 50 to 60 minutes or until toothpick inserted into center comes out clean
16. Cool in pan on wire rack 10 minutes
17. Remove from pan and cool completely on wire rack

title: grilled jerk chicken
steps:
1. Make marinade:
2. Blend all marinade ingredients in a blender until smooth
3. Marinate and grill chicken:
4. Divide chicken pieces and marinade between 2 sealable plastic bags
5. Seal bags , pressing out excess air , then turn bags over several times to distribute marinade
6. Put bags of chicken in a shallow pan and marinate , chilled , turning once or twice , 1 day
7. Let chicken stand at room temperature 1 hour before cooking
8. To cook chicken using a charcoal grill:
9. Open vents on bottom of grill and on lid
10. Light a large chimney of charcoal briquettes and pour them evenly over 1 side of bottom rack
11. When charcoal turns grayish white and you can hold your hand 5 inches above rack for 3 to 4 seconds , sear chicken in batches on lightly oiled rack over coals until well browned on all sides , about 3 minutes per batch
12. Move chicken as seared to side of grill with no coals underneath , then cook , covered with lid , until cooked through , 25 to 30 minutes more
13. To cook chicken using a gas grill:
14. Preheat burners on high , then adjust heat to moderate
15. Cook chicken until well browned on all sides , 15 to 20 minutes
16. Adjust heat to low and cook chicken , covered with lid , until cooked through , about 25 minutes more
17. Serve chicken with salsa
18. Cooks'
19. If you can't grill , you can roast chicken in 2 large shallow baking pans in upper and lower thirds of a 400f oven , switching position of pans halfway through roasting , 40 to 45 minutes total
20. Cook time does not include marinating the chicken for 24 hours

title: honey raspberry iced tea
steps:
1. Add all ingredients to a large , heat-proof pitcher
2. Whisk mixture until honey is dissolved
3. Chill until ready to serve
4. To serve , pour tea into ice-filled glasses

title: apple cake with a crumble topping
steps:
1. Fruit filling: mix apples with other ingredients and set aside
2. Dough: cream together margarine and sugar
3. Mix in the rest of the ingredients
4. Press 1 / 2 of the dough into a greased 9 x 13- inch pan
5. Pour fruit on top
6. Crumble rest of dough on top
7. Bake for 1- 1 / 4 hours at 350 degrees f

title: homestyle skillet chicken
steps:
1. Combine cajun seasoning , 1 / 2 teaspoons pepper and 1 / 4 teaspoon salt in small bowl
2. Rub mixture on all sides chicken
3. Heat oil in large heavy skillet over medium-high heat
4. Add garlic and chicken
5. Cook until chicken is browned , about 3 minutres per side
6. Transfer chicken to plate
7. Set aside
8. Add potatoes , onions , carrots , celery and bell pepper to skillet
9. Cook and stir 3 minutes
10. Sprinkle flour over vegetables
11. Stir to coat
12. Slowly stir in chicken broth , scraping up browned bits from bottom of skillet
13. Bring mixture to a boil , stirring constantly
14. Reduce heat to medium-low
15. Return chicken to skillet
16. Cover and cook about 30 minutes or until juices of chicken run clear
17. Increase heat to medium-high
18. Cook , uncovered , about 5 minutes or until sauce is thickened
19. Season with remaining 1 / 4 teaspoon salt and 1 / 8 teaspoon pepper
20. Sprinkle with parsley before serving

title: creole habenero venison sausage
steps:
1. Coarse grind for the pork and the venison
2. Mix seasonings with water
3. Pour in water and mix with meat
4. Let sit in refridgerator over night
5. Stuff and smoke 3 hrs at 165

title: mexican chicken in phyllo
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375
2. Lightly butter cookie sheet
3. In a large bowl , combine all ingredients excpet phyllo and butter
4. Set aside
5. Layer phyllo sheets , brushing each with butter - 2 stacks of 6 sheets
6. Spread 1 / 2 chicken mixture along short edge of each stack of phyllo sheets
7. Allow mixture to cover only 1 / 4 of sheets and leave 1 1 / 2 inches uncovered at each side
8. Fold sides in and brush with melted butter
9. Roll jelly-roll fasion and place on cooke sheet , seam side down
10. Brush with butter
11. Bake at 375 for 20-25 minutes , or until phyllo is browned and crispy
12. Cut each in half

title: mean chef s almond crunch   chocolate confetti chiffon cake
steps:
1. To prepare the almond crunch topping--heat the oven to 325f
2. Have ready an ungreased nonstick baking sheet
3. In a medium bowl , whisk the egg white with a fork until foamy , about 30 seconds
4. Stir in the nuts until they're evenly coated
5. Sprinkle the sugar over the nuts and stir the mixture
6. Spread the nuts in a single layer onto the baking sheet
7. Bake for 5 minute
8. Stir the nuts with a wooden spoon to loosen them from the baking sheet
9. Bake until golden , another 5 to 8 minute
10. Remove the nuts from the oven and immediately stir them to loosen them from the baking sheet
11. The nuts will become crisp as they cool
12. Set aside
13. To prepare the cake--heat the oven to 325f
14. Have ready a 9-1 / 2- or 10-inch tube pan with sides at least 3-3 / 4 inches high
15. In a food processor , pulse the chocolate chips until some of them are finely grated and the rest have formed small crumbs
16. In a large bowl , sift together the cake flour , 1 cup of the sugar , the baking powder , and the salt
17. Make a well in the center and put in the oil , egg yolks , water , vanilla , almond extract , and amaretto
18. Beat the mixture on medium speed until smooth and thick , at least 3 minute
19. Fold in the reserved chocolate chips
20. Set aside
21. In a large , clean bowl with clean beaters or a whisk attachment , whisk the egg whites and the cream of tartar on medium speed until the cream of tartar is dissolved and the whites are foamy
22. Increase the speed to high and beat the whites until the movement of the beaters forms lines in the mixture
23. Slowly pour in the remaining 1 / 2 cup sugar , about 2 tbs
24. At a time , and beat the mixture until soft peaks form
25. With a large rubber spatula , stir about one-third of the egg whites into the yolk mixture
26. Gently fold in the remaining egg whites until no white streaks remain
27. Pour the batter into the tube pan , spreading it evenly
28. Bake until you can gently press your fingers on top of the cake and it feels firm , about 1 hour and 15 minutes
29. Any cracks that form on the top should look dry
30. Invert the pan onto a bottle with a narrow neck and cool thoroughly , about an hour and a half
31. Use a small , sharp knife to loosen the cake from the sides of the pan and the center of the tube , if necessary
32. Remove the cake from the pan and slide it onto a serving plate
33. To make the glaze--in a small bowl , stir together the confectioners' sugar , milk , and almond extract , adding enough milk to make a smooth glaze with a thick , syrupy consistency
34. Set aside 2 tbs
35. Of the glaze
36. Spread the remaining glaze over the top of the cake , letting it drip down the sides of the cake and into the center hole
37. You may not need to use all of it
38. Cover the top of the cake with the prepared almonds
39. Drizzle the reserved glaze over the almonds

title: bread machine west african banana fritters
steps:
1. Add all the ingredients for the dough to your bread machine in the order suggested by the manufacturer and process on the dough cycle
2. Remove the dough after the cycle ends and place on a lightly floured work surface
3. With a floured rolling pin , roll out the dough into an 8-by-12-inch rectangle
4. Cut into 2-inch squares
5. Place on a nonstick or greased tray , cover , and let rise in draftfree area about 30 minutes
6. Heat 1-inch of oil in a large saucepan or skillet until it reaches 365 degrees f on deep-frying thermometer
7. Fry 3 or fritters at a time 10 to 15 seconds on one side until golden
8. Carefully flip fritters and fry until lightly browned , 5 to 7 seconds
9. Drain on crumpled brown paper bags or on several layers of newspaper covered with a sheet of paper towel
10. Sprinkle confectioners' sugar over fritters
11. Serve warm

title: pasta with yogurt and caramelized onions from kassos
steps:
1. In a large skillet , melt the butter over medium high heat
2. Add the sliced onions and stir to coat with the butter
3. Reduce heat to medium and continue to cook the onions , stirring occasionally for about 45 minutes or until they are really brown and soft
4. Meanwhile , bring a large pot of salted water to boil and cook the pasta to desired doneness
5. Mix the yogurt with 1 / 2 cup of the pasta water and mix well
6. Add the yogurt mixture to the onions and stir in until the onions are evenly coated with the yogurt mixture
7. Add the drained pasta and about half the cheese and toss
8. Transfer to a serving bowl and garnish with the rest of the cheese and the herbs

title: lemony glazed carrots
steps:
1. Boil carrots in soda in a saucepan over medium-high heat until tender - 10-15 minutes
2. Transfer carrots to a serving platter and reserve 3 tablespoons of the hot soda
3. Whisk marmalade , reserved soda , salt and pepper together in a bowl until blended
4. Drizzle over carrots and garnish with chives

title: lentil soup with balsamic roasted winter vegetables
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Combine sweet potato , parsnip , carrot , 2 tablespoons vinegar , oil , and salt in a large bowl
3. Toss well
4. Arrange vegetable mixture in a single layer on a large foil-lined jelly-roll pan
5. Bake at 375 for 30 minutes or until lightly browned , stirring occasionally
6. Set aside
7. Cook pancetta in a dutch oven over medium-high heat 8 minutes or until crisp
8. Remove from pan with a slotted spoon
9. Set aside
10. Add shallots and onion to drippings in pan
11. Cook 15 minutes or until golden brown
12. Add remaining 1 tablespoon vinegar , thyme , garlic , and pepper
13. Cook 1 minute
14. Add wine , scraping pan to loosen browned bits
15. Add pancetta , lentils , and 4 cups broth to pan
16. Bring to a boil
17. Cover , reduce heat , and simmer 30 minutes
18. Add remaining 2 cups broth and roasted vegetables to pan , and simmer 15 minutes , uncovered
19. Add chard , and cook 2 minutes or until wilted

title: zucchini rotini
steps:
1. Prepare rotini per package directions
2. Drain and set aside
3. In a small baking dish , combine cottage cheese and italian seasoning
4. Stir in rotini , zucchini , and tomatoes
5. Sprinkle with mozzarella cheese
6. Microwave on high 3 minutes to warm through or broil 5 minutes until bubbly

title: old fashion apple pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees f
2. Melt the butter in a saucepan
3. Stir in flour to form a paste
4. Add water , white sugar and brown sugar and bring to a boil
5. Stir in the vanilla and cinnamon
6. Reduce temperature and let simmer
7. Place the bottom crust in your pan
8. Fill with apples , mounded slightly
9. Cover with a lattice work of crust
10. Gently pour the sugar and butter liquid over the crust
11. Pour slowly so that it does not run off
12. Bake 15 minutes in the preheated oven
13. Reduce temperature to 350 degrees and continue to bake for 35 to 45 minutes , until apples are soft

title: kalbi short ribs
steps:
1. Combine all sauce ingredients
2. Dip each piece of meat in the sauce
3. And layer in a flat dish or pan
4. Pour more marinade on top
5. Marinate
6. 4-12 hours
7. Preheat grill to medium-high heat
8. Remove short ribs from marinade pat dry and discard marinade
9. Grill short ribs until slightly charred and tender and cooked to desired degree of doneness
10. Garnish with the sesame seeds and additional scallions if desired

title: golfer s chicken
steps:
1. Combine the dry soup mix , dressing , and jam
2. Mix well until there are no lumps
3. Wash the chicken , pat dry
4. Slightly overlap in glass dish
5. Spoon and spread 1 tablespoon or more of the sauce over each piece
6. Bake / slow cook at 225f for 4 to 5 hours or it can be done for 1 hour at 350f

title: sticky buns
steps:
1. Scald milk and cool to lukewarm , then stir in sugar , salt and yeast
2. Stand for 2 minutes
3. Beat in the eggs , potato and 1 cups of the flour until just mixed
4. Stand for 10 minutes
5. Melt cup of butter , cool to lukewarm , and after the 10 minutes has elapsed mix the butter into the yeast mixture
6. Stir in the remaining flour 1 cup at a time , until dough is smooth and not sticky
7. Knead for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic , adding more flour if needed
8. Transfer to a greased bowl , cover and let rise until tripled in size , about 3 hours
9. Melt another cup of butter
10. Divide dough in half and roll each piece into a inch thick rectangle and brush with the melted butter
11. Combine cup brown sugar with the cinnamon and sprinkle on each piece of dough
12. Roll up like a jelly roll and slice into 1 pieces
13. Melt the remaining butter and add 2 cups brown sugar in a saucepan over a medium heat and pour the mixture into a greased pan
14. Sprinkle the nuts evenly over the sugar mixture and place rolls flat side down
15. Cover and let rise again until doubled , about 1 hour
16. Preheat oven to 180c
17. Cook rolls until golden brown , about 25-30 minutes
18. Invert rolls onto a plate as soon as they come out of the oven so the caramel runs over the tops
19. Best served warm

title: honey lime vinaigrette
steps:
1. Whisk together lime juice , honey , salt & cayenne pepper
2. Add oil
3. Whisk until thoroughly blended
4. Can be made up to 2 days ahead
5. Cover & refrigerate
6. Whisk to blend before using

title: olive oil butter table spread
steps:
1. Beat butter in mixer until soft
2. Gradually add the olive oil and milk
3. When it is completely blended , pour into containers , cover and store in fridge
4. It will harden as it cools

title: liberian sweet potato pone
steps:
1. In a 3-quart saucepan , combine all ingredients and simmer slowly , stirring constantly , for 10 minutes
2. Pour into well-greased 9-inch baking pan
3. Bake at 325f for 30 minutes , stirring up every 5 minutes for the first 20 minutes
4. Smooth down the top and allow to brown
5. Cut into squares and serve either hot or cold

title: crunchee barley salad
steps:
1. 1 cup uncooked barley equals 2 cups cooked barley , drained well
2. You can use turkey ham for a lower calorie salad
3. Mix salad ingredients
4. Combine dressing ingredients and mix well
5. Pour over salad and toss
6. Cover and chill several hours
7. You can garnish the salad with tomato wedges and parsley

title: olive oil  garlic  and crushed red pepper pasta sauce
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a large saucepan over medium heat
2. Add the garlic and cook , stirring , for 30 seconds , making sure it doesn't brown
3. Add the pasta water , red pepper , salt , and parsley and bring to a boil
4. Toss with cooked pasta

title: spicy red pepper jelly
steps:
1. In a small bowl , whisk cup sugar with pectin
2. Set aside
3. In a bowl of a food processor , combine red peppers and red pepper flakes
4. Process for 15 seconds or until somewhat finely chopped
5. You should have about 2 cups give or take
6. In a large pot over medium-high heat , add red peppers , sugar , white vinegar , butter , fresh tarragon and sea salt
7. Stir very well and bring it to a boil
8. Cook for 4 minutes
9. Add sugar-pectin mixture and cook for an additional 4 minutes
10. If there are some larger chunks of pepper , pure with an immersion blender
11. To find out if its ready , dip a metal spoon in iced cold water
12. Dry it off and scoop up some jelly
13. Let it cool off to room temperature
14. If it sets up , it means its ready otherwise cook it a little longer
15. Remove from the heat and fill up the prepared jars
16. Process the jars in the boiling water bath for 10 minutes
17. Place them in a draft-free area and wait until the lids snap down
18. Makes 6 jars of 250ml

title: bloomer bread
steps:
1. Mix the dry ingredients , except for the yeast , in large mixing bowl
2. Mix the yeast with the warm milk
3. Add to the dry ingredients , mix well , then knead the dough for 8 minutes until smooth and elastic
4. Roll the dough in flour , put in a warm bowl and leave at room temp for 4 hours
5. Punch down dough , knead it again , roll it in flour and let rise again another 2-3 hours
6. Punch down the dough , give it a final kneading , shape into a baguette shape , cut slashes across the top with a sharp knife , brush with water and let rise another 30-50 minutes
7. Bake in preheated 400f oven for 20 minutes
8. Reduce temp to 325f and bake for another 20-30 minutes until brown and loaf sounds hollow when tapped on the bottom

title: mexican chickpea salad
steps:
1. In a small skilled or saucepan on low heat , saut the chilies in the olive oil for about 4 minutes
2. Add the garlic and cook for another minute , stirring constantly , until the chilies are soft and the garlic is just golden
3. Remove from heat and set aside
4. Combine the chickpeas , tomatoes , red onions , cilantro , lime juice , salt and pepper in a serving bowl
5. Add chilies and garlic with their sauting oil and toss well
6. Serve immediately or chill to allow flavours to develop

title: very berry bagel spread mix
steps:
1. Place in a small bowl and mix
2. Store in resealable bag in refrigerator
3. To serve: in small bowl mix 3 tbsp mix into one 8oz packaged softened cream cheese until well blended
4. Cover and chill 2 hours to let flavors blend
5. Serve spread on bagels

title: easy honey garlic ribs
steps:
1. Set oven to 300 to 325 degrees
2. Slice ribs into individual pieces
3. In a large bowl , combine honey , soy sauce vinegar , fresh minced garlic and brown sugar
4. Stir until honey and brown sugar are completely dissolved
5. Stir in the baking soda
6. Transfer ribs to the bowl
7. Turn to coat
8. Cover a cookie sheet with foil , and arrange the ribs meat side up on the sheet
9. Pour the excess sauce all over them , and sprinkle with garlic salt
10. Bake for 1 hour , turning every 20 minutes

title: lightened up breakfast burrito
steps:
1. In a skillet sprayed with a lot of pam combine onion and pepper over medium high heat , cook stirring until soft
2. I added the leftover salsa from recipe #341779s - but any other salsa or veggies would be great
3. Stir in beans and egg beaters
4. Cook until eggs and veggies are cooked and set
5. Top with cheese
6. Place on warmed tortilla , topping with salsa and roll up -- or skip the tortilla and eat as scrambled eggs

title: roasted veg with caribbean dressing
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees
2. Peel the veg that need peeling
3. Cut up your veg into chunks , slightly larger than bite sized
4. Keep the harder veg to one side
5. Make the dressing by whisking the ingredients together in a bowl - or better yet , process until smooth in a blender or food processor
6. Set aside
7. Parboiled route: cook the harder veg briefly in plenty of lightly salted boiling water for about 2 minutes
8. Drain well
9. Combine all of the veg together , along with the dressing -- tossing well to coat
10. Place the veg in a single layer on a large , lightly oiled , baking sheet
11. Bake , stirring every 15 minutes or so , until all of the veg are tender - about 45 minutes
12. Not parboiling: bake the veg in sequence
13. Start by preparing a large baking tray with a light coating of oil
14. Place the potatoes and carrots on the tray and bake for 15 minutes
15. Add the sweet potatoes , if using , and cook for another 15 minutes
16. Remove from the oven and transfer to a large bowl - adding in the rest of your veg and tossing with the dressing
17. Spread back onto the baking tray in a single layer and return to the oven - baking until all veg are tender , about 45 minutes
18. Stir occassionally to prevent sticking and watch closely for burning

title: almond biscotti
steps:
1. Preheat your oven to 350f
2. Grease a large cookie sheet whisk the egg , sugar , and vanilla extract in a mixing bowl with an electric mixer until it is thick and pale-ribbons of mixture should trail from the whisk as you lift it sift the flour , baking powder , and cinnamon in a separate bowl , then sift into the egg mixture and fold in gently
3. Stir in the chocolate , almonds , and pine nuts turn out onto a lightly floured surface counter and shape into a flat log about 9-inches long and 3 / 4 inches wide
4. Transfer to the prepared cookie sheet bake for 20-25 minutes , or until golden
5. Remove from the oven and let cool for 5 minutes , or until firm transfer to a cutting board
6. Using a serrated bread knife , cut the log into slices about 1 / 2 inch thick and arrange them on the cookie sheet
7. Bake for 10-15 minutes , turning half way through the cooking time let cool for about 5 minutes , then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely

title: banana eggs
steps:
1. Preaheat skillet over medium heat
2. Place eggs , banana , cinnamon , and salt in a blender
3. Blend until smooth
4. Melt butter in skillet and add egg mixture
5. Cook until eggs begin to set
6. Flip
7. Cook until fully set and enjoy with toast

title: moroccan ground beef kebab   skewers
steps:
1. Combine the beef , onion , parsley , cilantro , & spices in a large bowl , refrigerate for 1 hour
2. Wash your hands but don't dry them
3. Gently pack small amounts of the meat mixture around the skewers , forming a 4-inch long sausage shape on each skewer
4. Grill over charcoal , turning the kebab time to time so not to burn
5. Cook throughly
6. Serve with recipe #260654 or some other dense bread

title: fluffy yellow layer cake
steps:
1. Adjust oven rack to middle position and heat oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease two 9-inch-wide by 2-inch-high round cake pans and line bottoms with parchment paper
3. Grease paper rounds , dust pans with flour , and knock out excess
4. Whisk flour , baking powder , baking soda , salt , and 1 1 / 2 cups sugar together in large bowl
5. In 4-cup liquid measuring cup or medium bowl , whisk together melted butter , buttermilk , oil , vanilla , and yolks
6. In clean bowl of stand mixer fitted with whisk attachment , beat egg whites at medium-high speed until foamy , about 30 seconds
7. With machine running , gradually add remaining 1 / 4 cup sugar
8. Continue to beat until stiff peaks just form , 30 to 60 seconds
9. Transfer to bowl and set aside
10. Add flour mixture to now-empty mixing bowl fitted with whisk attachment
11. With mixer running at low speed , gradually pour in butter mixture and mix until almost incorporated , about 15 seconds
12. Stop mixer and scrape whisk and sides of bowl
13. Return mixer to medium-low speed and beat until smooth and fully incorporated , 10 to 15 seconds
14. Stir 1 / 3 of whites into batter to lighten , then add remaining whites and gently fold into batter until no white streaks remain
15. Divide batter evenly between prepared cake pans
16. Lightly tap pans against counter 2 or 3 times to dislodge any large air bubbles
17. Bake until cake layers begin to pull away from sides of pans and toothpick inserted into center comes out clean , 20 to 22 minutes
18. Cool cakes in pans on wire rack for 10 minutes
19. Loosen cakes from sides of pans with small knife , then invert onto greased wire rack and peel off parchment
20. Invert cakes again and cool completely on rack , about 1 1 / 2 hours

title: stir fried hoisin chicken with sesame seeds
steps:
1. In a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat , warm the oil
2. Add the sesame seeds and ginger to the oil and saute until fragrant and seeds golden , about 2 minutes careful have a lid ready , it pops !
3. Add the onions , bell pepper and salt
4. Saute for 1 minute
5. Add the chicken , more oil if necessary and continue to saute until chicken is cooked through and no longer pink
6. Add water chestnuts , hoisin sauce , soy sauce , worcestershire sauce , vinegar
7. Cook until flavors are well blended , about 2-3 minutes
8. Serve over rice and top with green onions

title: crock pot curried chicken   rice
steps:
1. Combine curry , onion , ginger , oil and cayenne in a medium mixing bowl
2. Stir in meat , working spice mixture into meat with fingers
3. Place in ziploc and refrigerate 1 24 hours
4. Brown meat mixture and place in crock pot
5. Add rice and broth to crock pot and mix well
6. Cook on low 3-4 hours or until chicken is cooked through and all liquid is absorbed

title: how to make ice cream in a bag  no cooking  no ice cream machine
steps:
1. For each child you will need:
2. 2 pint-size resealable plastic freezer bags
3. 1 gallon-size resealable plastic freezer bag
4. Gloves or towel to protect fingers
5. In a pitcher or large measuring cup , stir together the whipping cream , half-and-half , sugar , and vanilla extract until sugar has dissolved
6. Pour about 1 / 2 cup of mixture into a pint-size plastic bag and seal carefully , squeezing out extra air
7. Place each sealed bag into a second pint-size bag , again squeezing out extra air
8. Seal carefully
9. Fill each gallon-size plastic bag about halfway with ice and add 1 / 2 cup coarse salt
