10. Place one sealed small bag into the large bag , squeeze out most of the air , and seal the large bag
11. Wear mittens or thick gloves , or wrap the bag in a towel to protect hands against the extreme cold
12. Shake and massage the bag for about 5 minutes or until mixture thickens into ice cream
13. Add more salt and ice to the outer bag if ice cream hasn't formed after 10 minutes of continuous motion
14. Remove the outer pint-size bag before you open the inner bag so you don't get any of the salty ice on your ice cream !

title: brat  beer and cheese soup
steps:
1. Heat olive oil in soup pot over medium heat
2. Add onion , celery , carrots and a pinch of salt
3. Sweat vegetables until tender , about 15 minutes
4. Add flour and cook , stirring often , until raw taste has cooked out the flour , about 1 minute
5. Add potatoes , chicken broth and beer
6. Bring to a boil and cook 10-15 minutes or until potatoes are tender
7. Add mustard , garlic powder , salt , pepper and chipotle pepper
8. Add milk and worcestershire sauce
9. Stir well
10. Remove 2 cups of vegetables with liquid and puree in a blender or food processor
11. Return to soup
12. Remove pot from heat and add cheese , stirring well until cheese melts and soup is smooth
13. Slice bratwurst and add to soup
14. Return to low heat until brats are hot , 5-10 minutes

title: vegan  buttermilk  southern style biscuits
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Use your mixer , or use a large-ish mixing bowl
3. Add dry ingredients and mix together with a fork so ingredients are combined thoroughly
4. Then add the earth balance and cut into the dry mixture with two knives scissoring against another
5. The consistency should be lumpy / flaky and e
6. B
7. Should be about pea-size , as it is important to keep it mealy / flaky for flakier biscuits
8. Next measure the soymilk and add the lemon juice to it , allowing it to sit for a few minutes
9. Add the soymilk mixture and mix thoroughly but do not over mix
10. The dough texture should be able to be handled and formed easily , without losing shape
11. Flour a board and gently roll dough into a log , cut into 7-8 generous slices , place on sheet and bake until golden

title: boston market creamed spinach
steps:
1. In a large saucepan over medium heat , whisk together celery soup , flour , butter , garlic salt , salt and pepper until smooth and piping hot
2. Add cooked and drained spinach and the onion

title: strawberry spread
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , combine cream cheese , jam , and orange peel
2. Stir in pecans
3. Cover and chill until firm
4. Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator
5. Serve with toast or muffins

title: gluten free no bake chocolate oatmeal cookies
steps:
1. In a saucepan over medium heat , combine the maple syrup , honey , oil , cocoa and cinnamon
2. Boil for 3 minutes , stirring constantly
3. Remove from heat and stir in the peanut butter and vanilla until melted
4. Mix in the remaining ingredients and drop by 2 tablespoonfuls onto waxed paper and chill to set , about 30 minutes , in the fridge
5. Keep extras in fridge , especially in warmer weather

title: marinated venison tenderloin wrapped in prosciutto
steps:
1. Combine marinade ingredients
2. Marinate tenderloins for 24 hours
3. Preheat oven to 400f
4. Remove tenderloins from marinade and pat dry
5. Wrap tenderloins in prosciutto and place in roasting pan
6. Roast for approximately 30 minutes or until internal temperature is 150f
7. Allow tenderloins to rest for 10 minutes before slicing on diagonal to serve

title: cajun snapper  and don t forget the garlic
steps:
1. Take a large piece of aluminum foil and lay two slices of bacon in an x pattern
2. Lay the snapper on the bacon and place the other two slices in an x pattern on top of the snapper
3. Pour the melted butter on the snapper and add the onion , bell pepper and lemon lay the fresh garlic on the snapper
4. Sprinkle the cayenne pepper , cajun seasoning , and garlic powder
5. Add the lemon juice
6. Seal the fish in the foil and place on a baking pan
7. Place in oven at 400f for 40 minutes or until flaky
8. You can also cook on a grill for appx 20-25 minutes
9. Remove the snapper out of the foil and discard the cooking juices
10. I love to serve this with a slice of fresh lemon , a small dinner salad and then dirty rice on the side with corn
11. And let us not forget to have tobasco on the table for those who like it spicer !

title: crunchy rice salad
steps:
1. Cook rice using package directions and let cool
2. Combine the rice , oranges , onions , celery , water chestnuts , and mushrooms in a serving bowl , tossing to mix
3. In a small bowl , whisk together the rice vinegar , oil , and soy sauce
4. Pour dressing over rice mixture and mix gently
5. Chill until ready to serve

title: kielbasa appetizers
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients , except kielbasa , in a medium saucepan , and stir well
2. Cook over low heat 2 to 3 minutes , stirring constantly
3. Add kielbasa , and cook until sausage is thoroughly heated
4. Serve warm

title: tuna and potato salad a la espanola
steps:
1. Boil potatoes , covered in water , until almost done , about 6 minutes
2. Add haricots vert , cook an additional 4 minutes , then drain
3. Rinse under cold water and drain again
4. Place potatoes and beans in a large bowl , add tomatoes , shallots , salt , paprika , cayenne , and tuna
5. Drizzle salad with vinegar and oil
6. Toss
7. Arrange lettuce on 5 serving plates , divide potato and tuna salad on top

title: parmesan and garlic dipping oil
steps:
1. Whisk together all ingredients except oil until combined
2. Gradually whisk in oil until blended

title: sourdough chocolate mallow cake
steps:
1. In a large mixing bowl add the starter , evaporated milk and flour , cover loosely with a clean towel and allow to sit overnight
2. The next morning place the beets , eggs and vanilla in a blender container and process until combined and smooth
3. Set aside
4. Cream the butter and sugar add in the beet and egg mixture
5. Add starter
6. Combine the flour , salt , baking soda and cocoa
7. Add to batter mixing well
8. Fold in crme fraiche
9. Pour into a 13 x 9 inch pan that has been greased and floured
10. With a tablespoon drop marshmallow cream over the cake and swirl mixture with a knife
11. Bake in preheated 375 degree oven for 30 to 35 minutes or until the top springs back when lightly touched
12. Allow cake to stand 10 minutes while preparing frosting
13. Place the sugar , and vanilla in large mixing bowl , melt together the butter , nutella and 6 tablespoons milk
14. Pour melted ingredients over the sugar and beat until combined and spreading consistency adding additional milk if needed
15. Spread quickly and carefully over cake

title: rigatoni with creamy tomato and sausage sauce
steps:
1. Take a large deep fry pan and put in the olive oil and put on medium heat
2. Remove the casings from sausage and crumble the meat into the fry pan along with the chopped onions and cook slowly until sausage is lightly browned then drain
3. Add the tomato sauce , wine , garlic , and diced tomatoes
4. Turn heat up to medium high and bring mixture to boil
5. Cover , reduce heat and simmer for 1 / 2 hour
6. Turn heat back up to medium high and add the half and half
7. Bring mixture to slight boil
8. If you want thicker sauce mix corn starch with water and then add to sauce stirring in to desired thickness
9. Turn down heat and let simmer while you cook your rigatoni shells according to package directions
10. Drain shells well
11. Serve individual serving of noodles with sauce spooned over
12. Top with parmesan cheese if desired

title: awesome twice baked potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
2. Wash potatoes and pierce several times with a fork
3. Place potatoes on a cookie sheet and bake in oven for 1
4. 5 to 2 hours
5. When potatoes are baked , remove from oven and cool for about 15 minutes
6. Slice each potato in half and scoop out contents into a large mixing bowl - be sure to leave 1 / 4 thick inch shell
7. Mix together - potato content and sour cream and gradually add heated milk
8. Stir in salt , pepper and garlic to mixture
9. Fill a large baggie with mixture and cut off the bottom
10. Use the baggie mixture to fill your potato halves
11. Place potato halves on a cookie sheet and garnish with cheddar cheese , bacon and green onion tops
12. Bake potato halves in a 400 degree f oven for 30 minutes or until golden brown

title: green beans  black eyed peas salad
steps:
1. Steam and drain the green beans and allow them to cool completely
2. Drain and rinse the black eyed peas
3. Combine all ingredients and mix well
4. May be served chilled

title: panfried fish
steps:
1. In wide shallow dish , mix flour , old bay seasoning , salt , pepper and cayenne pepper
2. Heat oil in pan over high heat
3. Dredge fillets in flour mixture , then add to pan in batches
4. Cook 1-2 minutes each side , depending on thickness

title: creamsicle papaya smoothie
steps:
1. Peel , seed , and coarsely chop papayas
2. Add all ingredients to blender and process until smooth

title: chicken mushroom   rice bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Spread the rice in a baking dish & place cubed chicken on top and set aside
3. In a skillet , saute onion , bell peppers , garlic , and mushrooms in olive oil until golden brown
4. In a bowl , combine ketchup , chicken broth , worcestershire sauce , and pepper
5. Pour this mixture over the sauteed vegetables in the skillet & bring to a boil , then pour mixture over the chicken
6. Place chicken dish in the oven and bake 1 hour covered
7. Remove cover and bake until the liquid evaporates

title: weight watchers asian inspired zero points soup
steps:
1. Put bok choi , chinese cabbage , garlic , ginger , mushrooms , green onions , red pepper flakes and vegetable stock into a large soup pot
2. Cover and bring to a boil over high heat
3. Reduce heat to low and simmer , partly covered , for about 10 minutes
4. Toss in beansprouts and sugar snap peas during the last 3 to 4 minutes of simmering
5. Add soy sauce
6. Serve

title: brussels sprouts with white beans and pecorino
steps:
1. Heat 3 tablespoons oil in heavy large skillet over high heat
2. When just about to smoke , add half of brussels sprouts
3. Cook until brown , stirring occasionally , about 5 minutes
4. Transfer to large bowl
5. Heat 3 tablespoons oil in same skillet
6. Add remaining brussels sprouts , reduce heat to medium-high , and cook until brown , stirring occasionally , about 5 minutes
7. Transfer brussels sprouts to same bowl
8. Add remaining 2 tablespoons oil to skillet
9. Increase heat to high
10. Add garlic
11. Saut until brown , stirring constantly , about 1 minute
12. Add broth and brussels sprouts
13. Cook until brussels sprouts are crisp-tender , stirring frequently , about 3 minutes
14. Add beans and butter
15. Stir until butter melts and broth is reduced to glaze , about 1 minute
16. Season with salt and pepper
17. Stir in cheese

title: caramel chocolate trifle
steps:
1. Prepare and bake cake according to directions for an 8 inch square baking pan
2. Cool on a wire rack
3. Prepare pudding according to pkg
4. Directions
5. Cut cake into 1 1 / 2 inch cubes
6. Place 1 / 2 of the cubes in a 3 quart trifle bowl , or large glass serving bowl
7. Lightly press down to fill gaps
8. Top with 1 / 2 of the cool whip , pudding , caramel topping and toffee bits
9. Repeat layers
10. Cover and refrigerate

title: beefy noodle bake
steps:
1. Boil noodles according to package directions
2. Meanwhile brown beef and onion till cooked
3. Drain off fat
4. Add sloppy joe sauce and soup to meat
5. Stir to combine well
6. Add mushrooms
7. Cook til bubbly
8. Combine cooked and drained noodles with meat mixture
9. Stir well
10. Place mixture in greased 2 qt
11. Casserole
12. Sprinkle top with cheese
13. Bake at 350 for 25 minutes or until cheese is melted and casserole is heated through

title: dill icious deviled eggs
steps:
1. Cut boiled eggs in half lengthwise , empty yolks into medium sized mixing bowl , and set egg whites aside on serving platter
2. Mash egg yolks with fork or pastry cutter
3. Add mayonnaise , mustard , pickle juice , salt , pepper , sugar , garlic powder , and parsley to the bowl with the yolks
4. Blend until mixture has a thick , creamy consistency
5. Spoon yolk mixture into the hollowed out yolk portion of the egg whites
6. Sprinkle each finished egg lightly with paprika for color
7. Chill at least one hour before serving

title: pioneer woman s delicious  creamy mashed potatoes
steps:
1. Peel potatoes and rinse off
2. Cut them in half or quarters into about the same size and place in saucepan and cover with water
3. Bring to a boil over high heat
4. Reduce heat , cover and cook until just done
5. Drain potatoes into a colander
6. Shake off the excess water from potatoes and return them to the saucepan you cooked them and place back on the burner
7. Turn the heat on low and mash potatoes
8. Turn the heat off and slice in the softened butter and cream cheese
9. Next add the half and half-start with 1 / 2 cup , then add more if needed , seasoned salt and pepper
10. Mash everything together
11. Add more half and half and seasoning if needed
12. Pw says try not to oversalt but definitely don't undersalt !
13. Spread mashed potatoes into a greased baking dish
14. If you like , slice 1 / 4 cup butter into pats and place on top of the poatatoes
15. Cover the dish
16. At this point you can bake it in a 350 degree oven for 20 to 30 minutes or cover and refrigerate a day or two
17. If refrigerated , remove an hour before baking so the center can warm up and then bake as directed
18. Pw says to bake it covered but she has baked it uncovered with no problems

title: spaghetti with garlic and cumin
steps:
1. Mix first 5 ingredients in small bowl
2. Set aside
3. Cook spaghetti in large pot of boiling salted water until just tender but still firm to bite , stirring occasionally
4. Drain spaghetti , reserving 3 / 4 cup cooking liquid
5. Return pasta to pot
6. Add oil mixturre and toss over medium heat to coat , about 1 minute , adding reserved cooking liquid by 1 / 4 cupfuls if dry
7. Season with salt and pepper
8. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese and serve

title: broccomoli
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in a food processor and blend until very smooth
2. Chill at least a few hours before tasting
3. Can serve with chips , crackers , or as a veggie dip
4. Keeps well in fridge
5. Cooking time listed is for chilling time

title: irish eyes godiva cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven 325
2. Grease and flour bundt pan
3. Sprinkle chopped nuts on bottom
4. Mix all the other ingredients at low speed until combined and then on high for 3-4 minutes
5. Pour into bundt pan and tap gently to release large bubbles
6. Bake for 55-60 minutes
7. Let cake rest for 5 minutes and invert
8. Poke cake gently with skewer
9. Pour glaze slowly until it is completely absorbed
10. Serve with a dollop of whipped cream if desired
11. Cake is even better the next day

title: spanikopita pie
steps:
1. Chop onions and mince garlic
2. Saute in 1 tbs olive oil until soft
3. Add drained spinach , spices , and lemon juice and cook until liquid absorbs but spinach is not brown
4. Remove from heat
5. Let cool for 10 min , add crumbled feta and taste
6. Adjust seasonings if needed
7. Stir eggs into spinach mix , preheat oven to 350f , grease pie plate
8. Phyllo sheets here are big so i fold them in half
9. Lay one doubled sheet in pan , drizzle , spray , or brush with oil , lay another sheet cross-ways , add more oil and lay two more sheets , diagonal to the first cross , with oil in between
10. Press down to form the bottom crust
11. Add spinach / feta filling and fold all the edges inches
12. Add four more layers of doubled phyllo with oil in between , staggered like the bottom layer
13. Tuck the edges in and under to encase filling
14. Brush with the last of the oil
15. Bake at 350f for 25-30 min or until golden brown
16. Serve topped with tatziki with a nice salad and bread on the side

title: pumpkin black bean soup
steps:
1. Place tomatoes and beans in a food processor , process until about half of the beans are smooth
2. Set aside
3. Heat oil in a dutch oven coated with cooking spray over medium-high heat
4. Add onion to pan , saut 5 minutes or until lightly browned
5. Add cumin and garlic
6. Saut 1 minute
7. Add bean mixture , broth , and next 3 ingredients
8. Bring to a boil
9. Ladle about 1 cup of soup into each of 6 bowls
10. Sprinkle each serving with about 2 tablespoons queso fresco and about 1 tablespoon green onions
11. Garnish with pumpkin seed kernels , if desired

title: chocolate dessert fondue
steps:
1. Rub butter on the sides on your fondue pot
2. Break candy into small pieces
3. Melt candy , marshmallows and milk in a covered fondue pot
4. Stir once in every 15 minutes until ingredients are melted and smooth
5. Then , add whipping cream
6. Cover and continue heating for 30 minutes or until desired
7. Serve with bite-size pieces of strawberries , chocolate cake , pound cake , marshmallows , peaches , etc

title: peking chicken burger
steps:
1. Preheat grill to medium-high
2. Mix onion with garlic , egg , hoisin sauce , sesame oil , and pepper in a large bowl until well combined
3. Crumble ground chicken into the bowl
4. Incorporate well
5. Divide into 4 parts
6. Oil your palm and shape into 4 patties , about 10-cm wide
7. Grill the patties
8. Turn once
9. About 10 minutes

title: greek lamb meatballs
steps:
1. Preheat broiler in a large bowl , mix together all ingredients
2. Mix until well blended
3. Form into 1 inch meatballs
4. Place on a large broiling pan about 1 inch apart
5. Broil about 3 inchs from heat until well browned
6. Turn over and broil other side until well browned

title: low fat italian wedding soup
steps:
1. Mix ground turkey , basil , oregano , garlic and cayenne pepper in a bowl using your hands
2. Lightly roll meat into 1 / 2 inch diameter meatballs and set aside on a plate
3. Over medium-high heat , cook meatballs in a fry pan until browned on all sides
4. Place cooked meatballs on a plate , covered with a paper town to absorb excess fat
5. In a 3 quart saucepan , bring chicken stock to a boil
6. Reduce heat and add kale
7. Simmer for 15-20 minutes until kale is tender
8. Stir in meatballs , beans and tomato and let simmer until heated through for 5 minutes

title: chicken caesar salad wraps
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , combine the lettuce , chicken , tomato , water chestnuts , salad dressing and parmesan cheese
2. Toss until well combined
3. Divide the mixture evenly among the tortillas
4. Wrap the tortillas around the filling , and serve
5. Servings: 4
6. Nutritional information per serving:
7. Calories 330
8. Total fat 14g
9. Saturated fat 3g
10. Cholesterol 25mg
11. Sodium 840mg
12. Carbohydrate 34g
13. Fiber 4g
14. Protein 18g

title: sesame chicken wings
steps:
1. Cut chicken wings into three sections
2. Discard
3. In a large resealable plastic bag , combine the bread crumbs , sesame seeds , paprika and salt
4. Place cream in a shallow bowl
5. Dip chicken wings in cream , then place in the bag and shake to coat evenly
6. Pour melted butter into a 13 x 9 baking dish
7. Add chicken , turning to coat
8. Bake uncovered at 375 degrees for 40-45 minutes or until juices run clear , turning every 10 minutes

title: poached halibut with green beans and red potatoes
steps:
1. Place the potatoes in a large pot with enough cold water to cover them by 2 inches
2. Add 2 teaspoons of the salt and bring to a boil
3. Reduce heat and simmer until almost fork-tender , about 15 minutes
4. Add the green beans and cook 5 minutes more , until just tender
5. Drain and set aside
6. In the same pot , melt the butter over low heat with the chives , 1 / 4 tsp of the salt , and 1 / 8 tsp of the pepper
7. Quarter the potatoes and return them to the pot with the green beans
8. Stir gently to combine
9. Season the fish with the remaining salt and pepper and place in a large skillet
10. Pour in just enough wine to reach halfway up the sides of the fish
11. Bring to a simmer over medium-low heat
12. Cook 6-8 minutes , covered , until the fish is opaque
13. Serve with the beans and potatoes
14. Spoon any extra chive butter on top of the fish
15. The fillets should be 1 inch thick

title: my way creamy sauce   chicken casserole
steps:
1. In a sauce pan combine all ingredients except the sour cream and linguine pasta
2. Stir several times over medium / low heat until the cheese is melted
3. Remove from heat and add the sour cream and blend well
4. In a bowl blend together the pasta and 1 / 2 of the sauce and pour into a 9x13 baking dish
5. Set aside the other 1 / 2 sauce and cover with a lid
6. Bake at 375 degrees for 20-25 minutes
7. Sprinkle of grated parmesan is always a nice touch

title: fragrant beef curry with rice
steps:
1. Sprinkle beef with salt and pepper
2. Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in large pot until hot
3. Working in batches , brown beef on all sides
4. Drain and transfer to plate
5. Heat remaining tablespoon oil in same pot over medium-high heat
6. Add onions and saute until tender and golden brown
7. Return beef to pot
8. Add cloves , garlic , cinnamon sticks , bay leaf and dried red pepper
9. Stir 1 minute
10. Stir in milk , tomatoes , chutney , lemon juice , ginger , curry powder and salt
11. Bring to a boil
12. Reduce heat
13. Cover , and simmer until beef is tender , about 2 hours , stirring occasionally
14. Remove meat to platter
15. Cover and keep warm
16. Thicken juices in pot
17. Return meat and heat through
18. Serve hot over cooked rice

title: chickpea  vegetable and tuna soup
steps:
1. Heat the butter and oil in a pan over high heat
2. Add onion and garlic and saute until onions are transparent
3. Add the carrots and zucchini and saute another 2 minutes
4. Add the tomato sauce , water , dried onion , stock cubes , basil , parsley and oregano and chile , if used
5. Bring to a boil , stirring , then reduce heat
6. Cover and simmer for 15-20 minutes
7. Stir occasionally
8. Then add the mushrooms , corn kernels , chickpeas and tuna
9. Be sure to add the juice from the mushrooms and corn
10. Simmer for 5-10 minutes or until the carrots are tender and everything is heated through
11. Stir occasionally
12. Check for seasoning
13. Ladle soup into bowls and sprinkle each serving with 2-3 tablespoons of grated cheese
14. Garnish with chopped cilantro if desired

title: oh no  not another salad recipe
steps:
1. Important
2. Dressing: combine cranberry juice , vinegar , basil , honey , dijon mustard and fennel pollen in a small non-reactive bowl
3. Whisk vigorously
4. Whisk in both oils in a slow steady stream
5. Season to taste with salt and pepper
6. Salad: combine spinach , red leaf lettuce , sweetened dried cranberries , onion and nuts in large bowl
7. Drizzle salad with dressing
8. Gently toss to coat well
9. Sprinkle with cheese
10. Garnish with fresh basil leaves
11. Serves 2 as a meal or 4 as a side salad
12. "

title: b b l t sandwiches
steps: 1. Assemble sandwiches by layering bacon , tomato slices , lettuce , and basil on toast that has been spread with mayo

title: honey and chili roasted duck
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 375f
2. Coat a shallow roasting pan , and rack , with non-stick cooking spray
3. In a small bowl , combine the wine , honey , lemon juice , mustard and chili paste
4. Set aside
5. Rinse the duck and cut down the center of the back , to butterfly
6. Pat dry
7. Pierce skin several times with a metal skewer
8. Season with some of the salt and pepper
9. Place the celery , onion and carrot in the bottom of the roasting pan
10. Place rack over the vegetables and arrange the duck on the rack , skin side up
11. Place in oven
12. After 20 minutes , baste with the honey-chili mixture
13. Roast for a total of 1 1 / 2 to 2 hours , basting every 15 minutes
14. Remove the duck from the oven , place on a platter and keep warm
15. Combine the orange juice and cornstarch
16. Set aside
17. Strain the pan juices into a saucepan
18. Discard vegetables
19. Bring to a simmer , adding any leftover baste
20. Thicken with the cornstarch mixture and season with salt and pepper
21. Cut duck into pieces
22. Serve the duck with the sauce on the side

title: asparagus soup with mini meatballs
steps:
1. Combine the first 8 ingredients to make the meat ball mix
2. Roll the meat balls into small 1 / 2 inch balls
3. Cook the meat balls in a large pot of slightly boiling water for 5 minutes
4. Remove with strainer and set aside
5. Cut the asparagus spears into bit sized pieces , keep the asparagus liquid
6. In a large pot melt the butter and stir in the flour with a whisk
7. Add the liquikd from the asparagus and whisk well
8. Add the chicken broth and whisk well
9. Let the soup simmer for 5 minute
10. Add the cream
11. Add the asparagus and meatballs and warm through

title: honey bunches of oats diwali chivda  hot mix
steps:
1. Heat oil
2. Add cumin seeds and curry leaves
3. Stir till they sizzle 1 minute
4. Lower heat add raisins and nuts and stir for a minute
5. Add salt , turmeric and chili powder
6. Add lemon juice keeping away face from the pan in case it splashes
7. Add cereal
8. Stir till the cereal is coated with the spices
9. Add sev
10. When cool store in an air tight container

title: spanish lamb shanks jerez
steps:
1. Salt and pepper lamb and brown in olive oil
2. Add onion / shallot , carrots and garlic and saute a few minutes
3. Deglaze with sherry and add remaining ingredients
4. Simmer on low for 1 hour or until lamb is tender
5. Serve as is or remove lamb and puree sauce
6. Garnish with parsley

title: rigatoni with pumpkin and bacon sauce
steps:
1. Cut pumpkin into bite-size pieces and steam until soft
2. Mash the pumpkin gently
3. Cook the pasta in boiling salted water until al dente
4. Drain
5. While pasta is cooking , prepare the sauce
6. Saut the bacon with the garlic until the bacon is crisp
7. Put the mashed pumpkin into a saucepan and gradually stir in the cream
8. Add the bacon and garlic mixture and the parsley and gently warm the sauce
9. Season with freshly ground pepper
10. Stir the grated parmesan into the drained pasta
11. Add the sauce and toss to mix well
12. Serve immediately in heated bowls

title: olive garden minestrone soup
steps:
1. Slowly saute finely minced onion , celery and carrot in butter until very brown
2. Add peas and beans and about 3 quarts of water
3. Cook slowly until beans are almost done about 2 to 2 1 / 2 hours
4. Add the remaining vegetables , rice and spices and more water if necessary and cook another hour
5. About 20 minutes before serving time add the macaroni and more water if needed
6. Ladle into bowls and sprinkle with parmesan cheese
7. Serve with crusty garlic bread

title: manouri me kythoni  fried cheese w  quince preserves
steps:
1. Cut cheese into 1 / 4" slices and then cut slices into quarters
2. Coat slices with flour , dip in egg , and fry in hot oil , turning until golden brown on both sides
3. Allow to cool slightly , and serve with a dollop of quince preserve on each slice

title: grilled salmon candy
steps:
1. Soak 6 6" bamboo skewers in water 1 hour
2. Prepare charcoal or gas grill to medium hot
3. Weave salmon strips onto skewers and season with salt and pepper
4. Combine honey , molasses and soy sauce in a small bowl
5. Brush salmon with mixture
6. You will not use it all
7. Let salmon rest 10-15 minutes , then grill on open , greased grill , basting with a little of the honey mixture as it cooks
8. Cook 6-8 minutes , turning once or just cook until done
9. Don't overcook
10. Place salmon skewers on serving plate , brush with a little more honey mixture and sprinkle with the sesame seeds

title: glazed finger wings
steps:
1. Oven to 400
2. Bake 30 minutes , turn once
3. Mix sugar , cornstarch , salt , ginger , and pepper in a saucepan on the stove
4. Add water , lemon , and soy sauce
5. Mix together , bring to simmer , cook until slightly thickened
6. Brush sauce over wings
7. Continue baking and basting until chicken is richly glazed , about another 30 minutes
8. Serve hot with lemon slices

title: pizza quesadillas
steps:
1. In a small saucepan , cook spaghetti sauce over medium-low heat for 3-4 minutes or until heated through
2. Meanwhile , spread butter over one side of each tortilla
3. Sprinkle unbuttered side of two tortillas with mozzarella cheese
4. Top with salami and pepperoni
5. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese and oregano
6. Top with remaining tortillas , buttered side up
7. Cook on a griddle over medium heat for 2-3 minutes on each side or until cheese is melted
8. Cut into wedges
9. Serve with warmed spaghetti sauce

title: sherry s outstandingly fresh guacamole
steps:
1. Peel the avocado's and lightly mash them in a medium bowl
2. Add the corn , tomato and onion to the avocado mixture and blend
3. Mix in the taco seasoning , garlic salt and lime juice and mix well
4. Cover and refrigerate for 20 minutes before serving

title: cilantro guacamole
steps:
1. Peel , seed and mash the avocado in a bowl
2. Add all the other ingredients
3. Serve right away , or refrigerate for a few hours after sprinking with some extra lime juice , then pressing plastic wrap onto the surface
4. Serve with tortilla chips

title: super simple doggie treat nibblets
steps:
1. Mix dry ingredients then add in hot water
2. Mix with a fork or spoon until all ingredients blended
3. Spoon by 1 / 2 tsp onto a greased / sprayed cookie sheet
4. Bake in oven at 350 for 15 min , let cool and then store if you can in an airtight container
5. Depending on size i made min a quarter size mound reduce or increase cook time)
6. Feel free to add in mashed leftover veggies that are safe for your beloveds
7. --if you have beef broth already made use that and do not add in the water
8. When winter comes i keep a standby of chicken and beef broth in the freezer
9. - 15 min per cycle / cookie sheet
10. Edited 2 / 15 / 11 optional
11. Roll out the dough onto a cookie sheet and bake approx 8 min or until cooked through for a soft cookie consistancy
12. Remove from oven and use a pizza cutter to cut 1x1 in squares
13. For crisper biscuits return to oven for 4- 5 minute
14. For soft like my babies like do not return to oven , let cool and then put into a container

title: harry s island bouillabaisse
steps:
1. Saute garlic , onions and celery in the butter
2. Cut up the fillets of fish in 1 1 / 2" chunks
3. In a large pot combine the sauted mixture with tomatoes , clam nectar , water , basil , bayleaves and pepper
4. Bring to a boil , reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes
5. Add fish chunks , cook 5 minutes
6. Add clams , crab and salmon cook final 5 minutes
7. Add scallops , prawns , cook 5 minutes
8. Enjoy

title: italian meatball subs
steps:
1. Combine all the ingredients for meatballs
2. Mix well
3. Shape into 1" balls and broil or saute till brown
4. Put into a crock pot
5. Combine sauce ingredients in a sauce pan and heat pour over meatballs
6. Cover and cook on low for 4-6 hours
7. Put on sub rolls along with provolone cheese and put under the broiler for a few minutes till cheese melts
8. Serve hot

title: mint cream cheese swirl brownies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Line a 9x13 baking pan with foil , then grease the foil
3. In a large bowl , melt the unsweetened chocolate and butter together
4. Set aside and let cool about 10 minutes
5. Add sugar , vanilla , and 4 eggs to chocolate mixture , and stir until well-combined
6. Add 1 cup flour and stir until flour is completely incorporated
7. In a separate mixing bowl , melt 1 cup green mint chips
8. Add softened cream cheese , 1 egg , and 2 tablespoons flour , and beat on medium speed until mixture is well-combined
9. Spread the chocolate mixture into the greased foiled pan
10. Drop spoonfuls of the mint / cream cheese mixture evenly over the chocolate and swirl a knife around the pan several times to create a marbled effect
11. Bake for 40 minutes at 350 degrees , or until a toothpick inserted in the middle comes out with fudgy crumbs

title: single serving deep dish blueberry pie
steps:
1. To prepare crust:
2. In a bowl , combine flour and salt
3. Cut in butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs
4. Gradually stir in water until mixtre forms a ball
5. Wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 40 minutes
6. To prepare filling:
7. Preheat oven to 425f
8. Lightly spray a 7 oz
9. Baking custard cup with cooking spray
10. Mix sugar , cornstarch , salt and cinnamon in a small bowl and then sprinkle over blueberries
11. Remove dough from refrigerator and roll out to a circle
12. Press dough into custard cup , covering the entire bottom and sides of the cup
13. Reserve about a tablespoon of dough for the top of the pie
14. Pour blueberry mixture into custard cup and dot the top of the pie with cut up butter
15. Roll out remaining dough and use a cookie cutter such as a star , to cut out the pie top
16. Place dough star on the top of the pie
17. Bake for 12-15 minutes or until crust is golden brown

title: the best pecan pie in the world
steps:
1. Line a 9 inch shallow pie pan with pie crust
2. Press the pecan halves into pie crust edge at 1 / 2 inch intervals
3. Then , with floured fork , press edge of pie crust to pie plate in between each pecan half
4. Set aside
5. Preheat oven to 325 degrees
6. In saucepan combine the sugar , salt and corn syrup , simmer until sugar dissolves
7. Meanwhile beat the eggs until foamy
8. Into syrup stir the butter , vanilla and chopped pecans
9. Add eggs
10. Pour into prepared pie shell
11. Bake at 325 degrees for 1 hour or until center is almost set
12. Store in refrigerator but serve at room temperature
13. Top with whipped cream if desired

title: bourbon glazed cajun tenderloin
steps:
1. Make the marinade: in a small bowl , whisk all the marinade ingredients together
2. Trim the tenderloin of excess fat and silver skin
3. Place tenderloin in a large zip-lock plastic bag
4. Pour in the marinade
5. Press the air out of the bag and seal tightly
6. Turn bag to distribute the marinade , place on a plate , and refrigerate 8-24 hours
7. Make the rub: in a small bowl , combine the rub ingredients
8. Make the glaze: in a small bowl , whisk the glaze ingredients together until the sugar is dissolved
9. Remove tenderloin from bag and discard marinade
10. Wipe excess marinade off the tenderloin with paper towels
11. Press the rub into the tenderloins
12. Let stand at room temperature for 20-30 minutes before grilling
13. Lightly brush or spray tenderloin with olive oil
14. Sear over direct medium heat until well marked , about 20 minutes , turning a quarter turn every 5 minutes
15. Continue grilling over indirect medium heat until internal temperature reaches 135 for medium rare , 10-20 minutes
16. During the last 10 minutes of grilling time , turn and baste with the glaze
17. Remove the tenderloin from the grill and let rest for 5-10 minutes
18. Cut into -1 inch slices and serve warm

title: creamy sweet onion soup
steps:
1. In a large soup pot over medium heat , melt butter
2. Add onions and saut for 7-10 minutes , stirring often , or until onions start to brown
3. Scrape browned pieces from bottom
4. Stir
5. Reduce heat and add flour
6. Stir briskly to dissolve
7. Add broth , wine , pepper , paprika , and basil
8. Stir well and bring to a simmer
9. Continue to simmer for 20-25 minutes , stirring occasionally , until onions are tender
10. Stir in cream
11. Heat through
12. Salt to taste
13. If needed
14. Serve garnished with chopped parsley

title: vanilla cake
steps:
1. Cream shortening and sugar , add eggs and beat
2. Add flour , milk and baking powder
3. Add vanilla and nuts
4. Place in greased and floured pan
5. Bake at 350 degrees until top of cake springs back when touched

title: tropical breeze milk shake
steps:
1. Combine the fruit in a blender and pure
2. Add the milk , sugar , and ice
3. Blend until thick and frothy

title: ihop buttermilk pancakes
steps:
1. Place first 5 ingredients into a bowl , add buttermilk , oil and egg
2. With a spoon mix all ingredients and beat until smooth
3. Spray a griddle for frying pan with nonstick spray
4. Heat pan or griddle to medium low heat
5. Fry pancakes until small bubbles show on top before flipping pancakes
6. If batter is too thick add a little more buttermilk

title: savoy cabbage and corn chowder
steps:
1. Put vegetables-- except for corn-- spices and bouililon powder into a large saucepan and add boiling water until vegetables are just covered
2. Simmer until potatoes are cooked
3. Puree 1 / 2 the soup
4. Add corn and milk
5. Cook for a couple minutes , until corn is cooked and soup is heated through
6. Top with some freshly picked thyme and serve with a salad or fresh biscuits

title: one two three salad
steps:
1. Mix together the cauliflower , parsley and olives
2. Stir in the sald dressing
3. Chill for 3 hours
4. Spoon over a slice of tomato on a lettuce leaf
5. Chill

title: bow ties with basil cream sauce  peas and prosciutto
steps:
1. Cook bow ties according to package directions and drain
2. While pasta is cooking , stir together the evaporated milk and flour , then add basil and garlic
3. Cook and stir for 1 minute , then add peas , prosciutto and parmesan cheese
4. Stir until cheese is melted , but do not boil
5. Pour over cooked pasta and toss gently to coat
6. Sprinkle with additional parmesan , if desired
7. Adjust salt and pepper seasonings to taste and garnish with additional fresh basil

title: best blueberry rhubarb crumble
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Thoroughly mix sugar and cornstarch in the bottom of a large pot
3. Add rhubarb , blueberries , apple juice , lemon juice and butter to pot
4. Stir to combine with sugar and cornstarch
5. Continue to stir and cook over medium heat until thick and glossy
6. Transfer to pie pan
7. Top with crumble
8. Bake for 30 - 35 minutes
9. Enjoy with vanilla ice cream -- yummy !

title: tgi friday s 9 layer dip
steps:
1. Fry diced bacon until done , add refried beans and cook slowly and stirrer frequently until the bacon and bacon drippings are mixed through about 15 minutes , remove from heat
2. Mix taco seasoning with sour cream and set aside
3. To built 9 layer dip place ingredients in this order
4. Place refried beans on serving platter spread out to 1- 1 1 / 2 inches thick
5. Then layer: 1 / 2 c shredded cheese , 1 / 2 c prepared sour cream , 3 / 4 c guacamole , diced tomatoes , diced cilantro , black olives , sliced green onion , and 1 / 4 c cheese for garnish serve with crisp corn chips and a very cold beverage of choice
6. Makes a great snack or light lunch

title: beef tenderloin with bordelaise sauce  caramelized carrots and s
steps:
1. To make the bordelaise sauce , in a 3-quart saucepan over medium heat , melt the butter
2. Add the shallots and saut , stirring occasionally , until tender and lightly golden , 6 to 8 minutes
3. Add the pepper , bay leaf and thyme and stir to mix
4. Add the wine , bring to a boil and cook , stirring occasionally , until the liquid is reduced to 1 / 2 cup , 15 to 20 minutes
5. Add the stock and bring to a simmer , skimming off any excess fat , and cook for 15 minutes
6. Strain the sauce through a fine-mesh sieve into a clean saucepan and keep warm over very low heat
7. In a 10-inch fry pan over medium-high heat , melt 1 tbs of the butter
8. Season the filets with salt and pepper
9. When the butter is hot , add the filets and sear until golden underneath , about 2 minutes
10. Using a pair of tongs , turn the filets , and add the carrot , shallots , the 1 / 8 tsp pepper , the thyme and bay leaf
11. Cover and cook for 3 minutes for medium-rare , or until done to your liking
12. Transfer the filets to warmed individual plates
13. Continue cooking the vegetables , uncovered , until just tender , 1 minute more
14. Add the sauce , bring to a boil and stir in the remaining 2 tbs butter
15. Cook , stirring occasionally , until the sauce thickens , 7 to 10 minutes
16. Remove the thyme sprig and bay leaf and discard
17. Stir in the parsley
18. Spoon the sauce and vegetables around the filets and serve immediately

title: bananas foster cheesecake squares
steps:
1. Heat oven to 325f in small bowl , combine graham cracker crumbs , sugar and butter until well mixed
2. Press evenly in bottom of 15 x 10 x 1 inch baking pan
3. In large bowl , combine cream cheese , brown sugar , cornstarch and cinnamon until smooth
4. Add eggs and egg yolks one at a time , beating well after each addition
5. Beat in all remaining ingredients
6. Pour into crust-lined pan
7. Bake at 325f for 55 to 65 minutes or until center is firm to the touch
8. Cool completely before serving
9. Store in refrigerator

title: seafood salad
steps:
1. Shred imitation crab by hand
2. Drain tuna
3. Partially thaw shrimp& peas in strainer under cold water
4. Toss all ingredients together
5. If you have time refrigerate for a few hours , if not just make sure the shrimp& peas have had time to thaw
6. Add more veggies to make it more of a veggie salad
7. Looks nice served with dark greens , and sliced red peppers

title: parslied mushroom patties
steps:
1. In a large mixing bowl , combine eggs , mushrooms , flour , bread crumbs , onion , jalepeno , if using , parsley and pepper
2. Mix well
3. In a 10 inch , nonstick , frypan , heat oil over medium high heat
4. Using 1 / 3 cup mixture for each patty , shape mixture into 3 1 / 2 inch patties
5. Using a spatula , place 4 patties at a time into hot oil in frypan
6. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side till brown
7. Remove from frypan
8. Drain on paper towels
9. Keep warm in oven
10. Cook and drain remaining patties

title: rapini with garlic   chili flakes
steps:
1. Chop off bottom inch of stalks
2. Bring a large pot of salted water to boil
3. Add rapini
4. Return to boil and boil about two to three minutes or until crisp-tender
5. Drain
6. Heat olive oil in a skillet on medium high heat
7. Add garlic , pepper flakes and rapini
8. Toss together for a minute or two , reduce heat , cover pan and cook three minutes
9. Remove cover , season and serve

title: oatmeal raisin walnut breakfast bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Mix dry ingredients in a medium mixing bowl
3. Mix wet ingredients in a small bowl
4. Add to dry ingredients and stir until just mixed
5. Batter will be lumpy
6. Pour into a greased 8 or 9 inch square pan
7. Bake 40-45 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean
8. Cool for 10 minutes before cutting

title: artichoke and green olive dip
steps:
1. Drain artichoke hearts and rinse in cool water
2. Pat them dry with paper towels and place in a food processor with olive oil , lemon juice and garlic
3. Puree until smooth , 2 to 3 minutes
4. Transfer to a bowl and stir in green olives
5. Season with pepper to taste
6. Chill at least 2 hours
7. Before serving , stir in the chopped parsley

title: rosemary chicken oreganata
steps:
1. Combine lemon juice , olive oil , & garlic in a zip-lock plastic bag
2. Add chicken , seal , & marinate in refrigerator 3-8 hr , turning occasionally
3. Preheat oven to 350
4. Remove chicken from bag
5. Discard marinade
6. Coat broiler pan with cooking spray & place chicken in a single layer on pan
7. Sprinkle with salt and pepper
8. Press in oregano & rosemary
9. Bake 45 minutes or until chicken is done

title: saucy apple swirl cake
steps:
1. Blend the sugar and cinnamon
2. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
3. Grease a 10 inch tube pan and dust it with 1 t of the cinnamon sugar mixture
4. Save remainder for cake
5. Blend cake mix , applesauce and eggs until moistened
6. Then beat as directed on cake mix package
7. Reserve 1 1 / 2 cup batter
8. Pour remaining batter into prepared tube pan
9. Sprinkle batter in pan with remaining cinnamon sugar mixture
10. Top with reserved batter
11. Bake for 35-45 minutes or until cake tests done
12. Cool cake in pan top side up for 15 minutes
13. Invert on serving plate and serve

title: yellow summer squash soup
steps:
1. Put the chopped onion , squash , and butter into a big pot and pour in the chicken broth until it is about two-thirds of the way up the vegetables
2. Bring to boil and continue to boil gently for about 20 minutes
3. Take off heat and cool
4. When mixture is cool enough to handle , put it in a blender or food processor and blend
5. Return mixture to the pot and season with salt and pepper
6. Slowly stir in the cream or half-and-half
7. Add herbs , if desired
8. Serve hot or cold

title: dave s tacos
steps:
1. Preheat the oil on medium-hi
2. In a separate pan , brown onion with meat and drain grease
3. Add tomato paste and spices
4. Continue to simmer meat while frying shells
5. Fry each tortilla quickly , less than a minute each , folding in the middle while frying
6. Drain on paper towels
7. Add more oil if needed
8. Shells should still be fairly soft
9. Fill taco shells with meat and serve
10. Cheese , lettuce , tomato , sour cream and taco sauce should be served with the tacos so that everyone can fix their own

title: sausage and apples
steps:
1. Spoon pie filling into crockpot
2. Stir in water
3. Sprinkle with nutmeg
4. Top with sausages
5. Cover
6. Cook on low 4-6 hours

title: creamy tarragon sauce
steps:
1. In a small bowl combine all ingredients , mix well and chill , covered until needed
2. Beautiful served with fresh grilled seafood
3. I hope you will enjoy this treat

title: irene s rhubarb custard pie
steps:
1. Place rhubarb in a bowl and cover with boiling water for about 5 minutes
2. Meanwhile , with a mixer , mix sugar , egg , butter and flour until smooth
3. Strain rhubarb well
4. With wooden spoon , add rhubarb to batter and mix
5. Pour into uncooked pie shell
6. Mix topping ingredients with a fork , and sprinkle over uncooked pie
7. Bake at 375 for 50 minutes or until set
8. Top with whipped cream if desired

title: oven beef stew with sweet potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 275 degrees
2. In a oven proof dutch oven or large casserole pan , combine all the ingredients except the broth and soup , mixing well
3. In a seperate bowl , blend the broth with the soup and pour over meat mixture
4. Cover and bake 2 to 3 hours
5. Check after 2 hours to see if the meat is tender and cooked throughout
6. If to much liquid has evaporated , add a cup or two more of beef broth , stir the mixture and bake and additional 15 minutes
7. Also mixed 2 tablespoons cornstarch with 1 / 4 cup water to thicken broth for gravy

title: olive and thyme bread
steps:
1. Additional ingredient: 1 1 / 4 cups basic bread sponge
2. Can use any fleshy black olive in place of kalamatas
3. In a bowl , dissolve the yeast in the water
4. Allow to proof for three minutes
5. Stir the sponge into the water , breaking the sponge up using your hands or a spoon
6. Add 3 1 / 4 cups of the flour and salt and mix , scraping and folding until the dough gathers into a single mass
7. Mix in the olives and thyme until distributed
8. This dough will be wet and sticky
9. Turn the dough out onto a lightly floured surface , and knead as much of the 1 / 3 cup of flour as is required to make a smooth and elastic dough
10. Place the dough in a lightly oiled bowl , cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight
11. Halve the dough and shape each piece into a ball and place in an oiled bowl and cover with plastic
12. Allow to rise in a draft-free location for two hours
13. Turn out each piece of the dough onto a lightly floured work surface and press out any large bubbles
14. Shape each half into a loose oval
15. Transfer each of the ovals into a 9x5 loaf pan , with the seam on the bottom
16. Cover again with plastic and allow to double in bulk , which should take 2 to 2 1 / 2 hours
17. Preheat the oven for at least thirty minutes along with a baking stone or tiles on the middle rack to 425
18. Place a baking pan with decent sides on the bottom shelf
19. Boil two cups of water
20. Place the loaf pans on the stones and then immediately pour the boiling water into the baking pan
21. Bake for 35-40 minutes until the loaves are hollow sounding when removed from the pans and tapped on the bottom
22. Take the loaves out of the pans and cool on a rack

title: mushrooms a la galera
steps:
1. Wipe the mushrooms clean with a slightly damp cloth or paper towels
2. Trim the bottoms of the stems and cut the mushrooms lengthwise into slices
3. Set aside
4. In a medium heavy skillet , fry the bacon over medium-high heat until crisp but not overbrowned
5. Lift out the bacon onto paper towels , letting as much fat as possible drain back into the pan
6. Heat over medium-high heat until the fat is rippling
7. Add the onion and cook , stirring occasionally , until translucent , about 3 minutes
8. Preheat the broiler
9. Add the mushrooms , chiles , and epazote and cook , stirring , for 10 minutes , or until the juices released by the mushrooms have nearly evaporated
10. Remove from the heat
11. Transfer the mushrooms to a wide broilerproof baking dish and scatter the bacon and the shredded cheese over the top
12. Run under the broiler for a few minutes , until the cheese is melted and bubbling
13. Serve at once

title: authentic moroccan bread
steps:
1. Add the sugar to 1 / 4 cup of lukewarm water
2. Then add the yeast and stir to soften
3. Let it sit in a warm place until the yeast is bubbly & doubles in volume , roughly 2 minutes
4. Mix the flours & salt in the large mixing bowl
5. After yeast is ready add it to the flour along with the milk
6. Add enough lukewarm water to the mixture to form a stiff dough
7. Add a small amount at a time
8. If you have added too much the mixture will be extra sticky and it will be hard to get off your hands
9. The right consistency should allow the dough to pull easily off your fingers
10. Place the dough onto a lightly floured board & knead hard with closed fists , pushing outward
11. During the final part of kneading , add 1 tsp of cumin or sesame seeds
12. It will take between 10-15 minutes to knead the dough thoroughly
13. You will know it is ready when it achieves a smooth , elastic consistency
14. Take the thoroughly kneaded dough & form it into two balls & let it stand for 5 minutes on the board
15. Sprinkle cornmeal onto two baking sheets & place to the side
16. Then lightly grease a mixing bowl with oil
17. Transfer the first ball of dough to the bowl
18. Roll the dough along the sides while rotating bowl with your other hand , this will make the dough into a cone shape
19. Place the dough , wide end down , onto the first baking sheet
20. Flatten the cone with the palm of your hand to form a disc about 5 inches in diameter with a slightly raised center
21. Repeat with the second ball
22. Lightly sprinkle the remaining seeds on top of the bread
23. Cover each disc loosely with a damp towel & let it rise for about 2 hours in a warm place
24. The dough will be ready when you can gently pole your finger into it & it will not spring back into place
25. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees
26. Using a fork , poke the bread 3 to 4 times & place in the center shelf of the oven
27. Bake for 12 minutes , then lower the heat to 300 degrees & make 25-30 minutes more
28. To give the bread a nice brown color , turn the oven on broil
29. Watch the bread carefully , once it is golden , turn it over to brown the other side
30. Remove from the oven & let cool

title: chicken  potato  and leek soup
steps:
1. Cook bacon and oil together in a large saucepan over medium heat , stirring occasionally , until crisp and browned , about 8 minutes
2. Using a slotted spoon , transfer the bacon to paper towels to drain , leaving the fat in the saucepan
3. Add the chicken to the fat , skin side down
4. Cook until the skin is deeply browned , about 4 minutes
5. Turn and cook the other side until lightly browned , about 2 minutes
6. Transfer to a plate
7. Pour off any fat in the saucepan
8. Add the butter to the saucepan and return to medium heat
9. Add the leeks and cook , stirring occasionally , scraping up any browned bits in the bottom of the saucepan , until tender , about 8 minutes
10. Stir in the stock with the potato and thyme
11. Return the chicken to the saucepan and bring to a boil
12. Decrease heat to medium-low
13. Simmer until the chicken is cooked through and the potato is tender , about 25 minutes
14. Transfer the chicken to the cutting board
15. Remove the skin and bones and coarsely chop the meat
16. Set aside
17. Add the cream to the soup and heat until piping hot , but do not boil
18. Season with salt and pepper to taste
19. In batches , puree the soup in a blender and return to the saucepan
20. Serve hot , topping each serving with some of the chicken and bacon

title: the best german sweet chocolate cake with frosting
steps:
1. Frosting
2. Prepare coconut: preheat oven to 350f take coconuts and drain milk
3. Place in preheated oven 20 - 30 minutes
4. Remove from oven and allow to cool slightly
5. Take a flat-head screwdriver and pry shell off of meat
6. Next , taking a vegetable peeler , peel the brown outer layer from coconut
7. Next , peel a few long strips for garnish and set aside , if desired
8. Cut coconut into manageable pieces
9. Shred coconut either by hand or with a food processor , using a fine shredding blade
10. Place flaked coconut in two bowls , equally
11. Mix milk , sugar , butter , egg yolks and vanilla in large saucepan
12. Cook on medium heat approximately 12 minutes until thickened and golden brown , stirring constantly
13. Remove from heat
14. Add flaked coconut and pecans
15. Mix well
16. Let sit for 2-3 hours to achieve a "raw honey"-like texture
17. Frost as directed below
18. Cake
19. Line bottoms of 3 round cake pans with wax paper
20. Butter sides of pan
21. Microwave chocolate and water in large microwavable bowl on high 1-1 / 2 to 2 minutes or until chocolate is almost melted , stirring after each minute
22. Stir until chocolate is completely melted
23. Preheat oven to 350f
24. Beat egg whites with whisk attachment in mixer until stiff peaks form
25. Remove to separate bowl
26. In mixer , combine butter and sugar on medium speed until light and fluffy
27. Add egg yolks , 1 at a time , beating well after each addition
28. Stir in cooled chocolate mixture and vanilla
29. Add flour , baking soda and salt
30. Add buttermilk slowly , beating until well blended
31. Gently fold egg whites into batter
32. Pour evenly into prepared pans , making sure batter is evenly distributed
33. Bake for 20-30 minutes or until toothpick inserted into centers comes out clean
34. Immediately run spatula between cakes and sides of pans
35. Cool 15 minutes
36. Remove cake layers from pans
37. Remove wax paper
38. Cool completely on wire racks
39. Take sharp serrated knife and gently go around top of each cake , cutting away excess cake so that it has a flat top
40. Place one cake upside down on a 9" cake round
41. Spread coconut-pecan filling and frosting between layers and onto top of cake
42. Taking your hand , scoop up some frosting and press into side of cake until covered
43. Then take some of the extra coconut and secure the frosting by pressing it into the sides of the cake
44. Pat around cake twice until you receive a nice finished product
45. Transfer cake onto a pretty round plate , if desired
46. Garnish suggestions: use whole pecans and coconut on top
47. Coconut curls may be created by shaving a strip of coconut , cutting it into 1 / 4" slices then securing it around a straw with butcher's twine until dry
48. Serving suggestion: place mini chocolate morsels around cake
49. Serve with natural vanilla ice cream

title: pomegranate  banana and pistachio bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Grease one 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan and set aside
3. Score 1 fresh pomegranate and place in a bowl of water
4. Break open the pomegranate under water to free the seed sacs
5. The seeds will sink to the bottom of the bowl and the membrane will float to the top
6. Sieve and put the seeds in a separate bowl
7. Measure out 1 / 2 cup of the seeds and set aside
8. In a large bowl , stir together flour , sugar , baking powder and salt
9. In a small bowl , stir together bananas , oil , milk and egg
10. Stir into flour mixture with pomegranate seeds and the chopped pistachios just until moistened
11. Do not over-mix !
12. Spoon batter into prepared pan
13. If desired , sprinkle a few whole shelled pistachios and a few additional pomegranate seeds over the batter for garnish
14. Bake for 50 to 60 minutes until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean
15. Cool in pan 10 minutes
16. Remove loaf from pan and cool on wire rack
17. Store bread tightly covered , or wrap tightly in foil and freeze for up to 1 month

title: ground beef chow mein casserole
steps:
1. Cook and stir hamburger , celery and onion until hamburger is light brown , then drain
2. Pour water on rice and add salt in greased 2qt casserole
3. Stir in hamburger , soup , mushrooms , sugar , soy sauce and margarine
4. Cover and cook in 350f oven for 30 min
5. Stir
6. Cook uncovered for 30 min longer
7. Stir in noodles , serve immediately

title: mediterranean seafood chowder
steps:
1. In a large saucepan or dutch oven , saute the peppers , onion and garlic in oil until tender
2. Add the tomatoes , water , broth , rice , wine or additional chicken broth and seasonings
3. Bring to a boil
4. Reduce heat
5. Cover and simmer for 15-20 minutes or until rice is tender
6. Stir in the shrimp and cod
7. Cover and simmer for 2-4 minutes or until shrimp turn pink and fish flakes easily with a fork

title: crock pot pork chops with apricots and prunes
steps:
1. In large skillet , heat oil over medium-high heat
2. Brown pork chops
3. Transfer to crock pot
4. Add onions , garlic , apricots and prunes to pork chops
5. Whisk together orange juice , chicken stock , cumin , paprika , coriander , cinnamon , salt and pepper
6. Add to crock pot
7. Cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours , or until meat is tender
8. Remove pork chops to plate and keep warm
9. Increase heat to high
10. Cover and cook for about 5 minutes or until sauce is slightly thickened
11. Serve with chops

title: brinjal eggplant  aubergine   pickle  goa  india
steps:
1. Julianne or dice small brinjal-eggplant
2. Layer brinjal with salt alternately
3. Let stand 4-5 hours till water separates from vegetable
4. Squeeze in handfuls brinjal till water is removed
5. Keep in separate bowl
6. Grind ginger and garlic in some of the vinegar to paste
7. Heat oil till smoke starts rising
8. Fry brinjals two hand fulls at a time
9. Drain with slotted spoon and set aside
10. Wait for water to evaporate from oil , till the bubbles stop before frying another lot of brinjal
11. Add and fry garlic and ginger paste for 5 minutes
12. Add dry spices , fry 2 minutes
13. Add vinegar and tamarind , mix well for 1 minute
14. Add curry leaves and sugar , mix well
15. Add brinjal mix well and cook 1-2 minutes
16. Cool and bottle

title: corned beef with guinness
steps:
1. Remove excess fat from corned beef
2. Place onions in a crock pot then brisket with season packet on top of onions
3. Pour beer and water over place lid on
4. Set crock pot on low for 6 hours
5. Place cabbage on and cook on high for 1-2 more hours
6. Remove meat carefully
7. It is very tender and can fall apart easily
8. Slice any excess fat
9. It should slide right off
10. Then proceed with recipe #57813 if desired
11. Serve with cabbage , onions and your favorite irish sides
12. Do check the menu above

title: peppermint christmas cookies
steps:
1. Cream together butter , sugar , egg , vanilla , and salt
2. Add coloring and mix well to distribute color evenly
3. Stir in flour
4. Shape in 1 inch balls
5. Place 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet
6. Flatten each by pressing a chocolate in each center
7. Bake at 350 degrees for 10 minutes , or until bottom starts to brown

title: buckwheat and oat pancakes
steps:
1. Mix dry ingredients in a large bowl
2. Beat liquid ingredients in a small bowl
3. Add to dry ingredients and stir until just mixed
4. Spray or lightly oil a hot griddle or non-stick skillet and add batter by 1 / 3 cup measures
5. Turn when bubbles form on top surface and underside is browned
6. Cook second side until browned
7. This should result in 10 each 5" pancakes
8. Serve with syrup or topping of choice

title: tasty fried pork
steps:
1. Heat oil in pressure cooker
2. Saute chopped onion with a dash of garlic powder or crushed clove
3. Add meat and saute briefly until it browns slightly
4. Add spices , lemon juice and water and cover pressure cooker
5. Cook over medium heat for 30 minutes depending on your cooker
6. (mine takes 40 minutes , my mil's 20 minutes
7. Be careful not to burn !
8. You should end up with tender pork and a little juice left
9. Serve with rice and a green salad

title: trout gremolada
steps:
1. In bowl , combine parsley , lemon rind , oil , garlic , salt and pepper
2. Pat fillets dry
3. Spread parsley mixture over skinless sides
4. Place fillets , skin side down , on greased grill over medium heat
5. Close lid and cook for 8 to 10 minutes or until fish flakes easily when tested with fork
6. Enjoy !

title: cheese ravioli with grape tomatoes
steps:
1. Add ravioli to a pot of boiling water
2. Cook 3-5 minutes or until ravioli floats to the surface
3. Remove from heat , drain and set aside
4. Heat oil in a oversized skillet on medium heat , add spinach , tomatoes , onion powder , salt and pepper , and saute for about 7 minutes or until spinach and tomatoes wilt
5. Add ravioli to skillet and cook for 3 more minutes
6. Serve hot and sprinkle with parmesan cheese

title: oreo and dulce de leche brownies
steps:
1. Grease a 9 x 13-inch baking pan , and preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
2. Mix together the cookie crumbs with the melted butter until well combined
3. Press mixture into bottom of greased baking pan and sprinkle both chocolate chips over oreo crust
4. Pour the sweetened condensed milk over chips and bake for 25 to 30 minutes in preheated oven
5. Let brownies cool completely before cutting into bars

title: pineapple puffs
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375f
2. Beat sugar , butter , sour cream , egg , and pineapple in large bowl with electric mixer on medium speed , or mix with spoon
3. Stir in flour , baking soda , vanilla and salt
4. Stir in almonds
5. Drop dough by rounded teaspoonfuls about 2 inches apart onto ungreased cookie sheet
6. Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until almost no indentation remains when touched in center
7. Immediately remove from cookie sheet to work rack
8. Cool completely
9. Mix together the glaze ingredients
10. Spread with vanilla glaze

title: easy indian butter chicken
steps:
1. Cut chicken into 3 / 4" cubes
2. Heat oil and cook the onion and ginger until brown stir in the garam masala
3. Put in onion and ginger in blender together with tomato paste and chicken stock blend until smooth
4. Put back into the pan and add the cream reduce a little set aside
5. Heat 1 tablespoon of butter and add chicken cook until no longer pink in the middle
6. Pour the butter sauce back into the pan and add remaining butter
7. Garnish if you like with fresh cilantro

title: the best no bake chocolate oatmeal cookies
steps:
1. Add milk and butter to a medium or large sauce pan and heat over medium heat until butter is melted
2. Add sugar and cocoa powder and stir until well blended
3. Turn heat to high and boil for 3 minutes
4. Take off of heat and add marshmallows
5. Once marshmallows are well blended , add vanilla
6. Add coconut and oats and mix well

title: bisquick chocolate chip bars
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients except chips
2. Spread in a 13 x 9-inch pan , greased and floured
3. Sprinkle chocolate chips over top
4. Bake 25-30 minutes at 350

title: florida salad with ginger dressing
steps:
1. Add the dressing ingredients to a blender container
2. Blend until smooth
3. Toss the salad greens with half of the dressing
4. Divide salad greens on individual salad plates
5. Add papaya cubes to the center of each salad plate
6. Arrange the mango , avocado , and grapefruit pieces around the papaya like a pinwheel
7. Drizzle the rest of the dressing over the fruit
8. Garnish with kiwi slices and walnuts

title: grape wine
steps:
1. Mash grapes and let ferment 3 to 5 days
2. Draw off 5 quarts of juice
3. Dissolve sugar in hot water
4. Pour all into a 5 gallon jug container
5. Add water to fill jug to top
6. Cover jug opening with a small sandsack for 3 to 4 months
7. Draw off and rejug and seal jug with a tight-fitting cork or other kind of stopper

title: blender ketchup
steps:
1. Quarter tomatoes
2. Remove stem ends
3. Add peppers , seeded and cut into chunks , and onions , peeled and quartered
4. Mix
5. Put vegetables into blender , filling 3 / 4 full
6. Blend at high speed for about 10 seconds
7. Or until vegetables are pureed
8. Repeat as necessary
9. Pour all into a large kettle
10. Add rest of ingredients
11. Stir to blend thoroughly
12. Bring to boil over medium heat
13. Lower heat and simmer , uncovered until volume is reduced by half
14. Pour into hot jars
15. Adjust lids
16. Process in boiling water bath for 10 minutes at 212 degrees
17. Remove jars and complete seals

title: chocolate oreo ice cream cake roll
steps:
1. Grease and lightly flour a 15 by 10 inch jelly roll pan
2. Prepare chocolate cake mix according to package instructions
3. Pour chocolate mixture evenly into jelly roll pan
4. Spread out a kitchen towel and sprinkle it lightly with powdered sugar
5. Bake for 12 -15 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean in the center
6. Remove cake from oven and immediately loosen edges of cake and turn it over into the towel
7. Roll the cake up from short end to short end within the towel , jelly roll style
8. Cool on wire rack until completely cool
9. This could take up to one hour
10. Place 14 oreo cookies into a zip lock bag
11. Crush the cookies using a roller pin or meat mallet
12. Unroll cake
13. Spread the softened ice cream
14. Top with crushed cookie topping
15. Carefully roll cake back up and transfer onto plate or serving tray
16. Place cake into freezer and store for at least 2 hours
17. To serve , garnish the top of the cake with powdered sugar and line the sides with remaining whole oreo cookies

title: southwestern black eyed peas
steps:
1. Heat water and peas to boiling in 2 quart saucepan
2. Boil uncovered 2 minutes
3. Reduce heat to low
4. Cover and simmer 30-40 minutes , stirring occasionally , until beans are tender
5. Drain peas
6. Heat oil in same saucepan over medium heat
7. Cook okra , onion , salt , pepper sauce and garlic in oil about 5 minutes , stirring occasionally , until onion is tender
8. Stir in cilantro , tomato and beans
9. Cook , stirring occasionally , until hot

title: vegan vegetarian  mock tuna
steps:
1. Combine almonds , cashews , water , salt , mustard and relish in a food processor and grind until smooth
2. I also add in part of the onions and celery to blend the flavors nicely
3. Take out of processor , mix in celery and onions

title: stuffed zucchini   hairy melon
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Cut zucchini lengthwise and scoop out seeds
3. Lightly rub olive oil on zucchini set on a cookie sheet pan or a large casserole dish with a cover
4. Soak noodles in hot water off heat for 5 minutes , drain , and rough chop
5. Heat oil and saute the onions and mushrooms for 5 minutes
6. In a food processor pulse pork to mince
7. Add remaining seasonings
8. And pulse to mince and blend
9. Toss in the noodles , onions and mushroom into the minced mixture
10. Fill zucchini and or hairy melon
11. Bake covered for 30 minutes uncover and bake for 10-15 minutes

title: lemon dream cheesecake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees
2. Grease 10 inch springform pan and wrap foil on bottom
3. In a small bowl , combine the cracker crumbs , butter , and sugar
4. Press onto bottom and 2 inches up sides of pan
5. Place pan on a baking sheet
6. Bake for 10 minutes
7. Cool on wire rack
8. In large bowl , beat cream cheese and sugar until smooth
9. Beat in cream , juice , flour , zest , extracts , and food coloring if desired
10. Add eggs
11. Beat on low speed just until combined
12. Pour into crust
13. Return pan to baking sheet
14. Bake for 55 to 65 minutes or until center is almost set
15. Cool on a wire rack for 10 minutes
16. Carefully run a knife around edge of pan to loosen
17. Cool 1 hour
18. Leave sides on pan until serving
19. Refrigerate overnight
20. Remove sides of pan

title: crock pot cherry cobbler
steps:
1. Lightly grease the inside of a 31 / 2-quart crock pot , or spray it with cooking spray
2. Place the pie filling into the crock pot
3. Beat the remaining ingredients until the consistency of the batter is smooth
4. If adding liqueur and / or slivered almonds , add these to the batter now
5. If the batter is a little too moist after adding the liqueur , adjust the consistency with an extra sprinkling of flour
6. Spread the batter over the pie filling
7. Cover and cook on high for 11 / 2 to 2 hours , or until a skewer pierced into the centre of the cobbler comes out clean
8. Serve with cream , custard or ice cream

title: chop suey cake
steps:
1. In large bowl , do not use mixer , combine flour , sugar , eggs baking soda , pineapple and can juices , walnuts and coconut
2. Mix with a wooden spoon until thoroughly moistened and combined
3. Pour into greased 9x13 inch pan
4. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 to 40 minutes until brown on top
5. Remove from oven and place on wire rack
6. Mix cream cheese and butter together until well blended
7. Gradually add confectioners sugar , milk and vanilla
8. Spread icing on cake while cake is still warm
9. Top with chopped nuts
10. Cool cake completely and refrigerate until serving time
11. Store leftovers in the refregerator
12. Makes about 20 servings

title: corn pone
steps:
1. Crush crakers
2. Combine ingredients
3. Bake in moderate oven till brown on top

title: totally easy taco soup
steps:
1. Brown chicken pieces in dutch oven
2. Add all other ingredients and simmer for 45 minutes
3. Serve with grated cheddar or monterey jack cheese and sour cream

title: the easiest hot sausage   kidney beans with rice
steps:
1. Get your rice started so that it'll be finished cooking when you are ready to eat
2. Slice the hot links lengthwise and then cut into bite-sized pieces
3. Peel your onion & de-seed the pepper
4. Cut the green pepper and onion into 1 / 2 inch chunks
5. Heat your oil in a large skillet over medium heat
6. Add your peppers and onions and cook until they are the desired "done-ness"
7. Remove peppers & onions from skillet
8. Place sausage in skillet and cook until desired "done-ness"
9. Drain most of the oil from skillet and then return onions / peppers
10. Add the can of kidney beans
11. Continue cooking for several minutes to heat the beans and get some of the sausage flavor in the veggies
12. To serve: spoon a scoop of cooked rice on each plate / bowl then top with the sausage mixture
13. A hearty spoonful of salsa on top finishes it off !
14. This is usually from cabinets / fridge to plate in about 30 minutes
15. This time-range depends on how well cooked you like the vegetables , if you do any pre-cooking in the microwave , etc
16. In our house this recipe , as indicated above , serves 2 adults and 2 children , with one serving leftover
17. I estimate that to serve about four

title: orata sciortino  chilean sea bass w  shiitake mushrooms
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Preheat an ovenproof skillet large enough to accommodate both fillets over high heat
3. Dredge fillets in flour , shaking off excess
4. Add olive oil to skillet and add fillets , skin side up
5. Cook until golden brown on one side
6. Turn over and add shiitake mushrooms , turning to cook evenly
7. When mushrooms are slightly wilted , add shallot and season with salt and pepper
8. Remove skillet from heat and deglaze pan with the cognac
9. Add currants
10. Once cognac has stopped sizzling , return skillet to the heat and cook until cognac is almost entirely reduced
11. Add chicken stock
12. Place skillet in the oven for about 8 to 10 minutes , or until fish is tender
13. Place each fillet on a plate and return the skillet to high heat
14. Reduce sauce to half its original volume and add butter , stirring to incorporate
15. When butter is completely melted and blended into sauce , spoon over each fillet and serve
16. Suggested wine:
17. 2002 ferrari-carano fum blanc

title: radish dip
steps:
1. In a bowl , combine all ingredients
2. Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve

title: grilled shrimp with garlic  gambas al ajillo
steps:
1. Soak wooden skewers in water for at least 20 minutes
2. Heat the grill to medium
3. Whisk together 1 / 4 cup of the oil , 2 tablespoons of the thyme , ancho chili powder and chopped garlic in a small bowl
4. Skewer the shrimp and brush with marinade
5. Place the remaining 1 / 2 cup of the oil in a small saucepan , add the sliced garlic and cook until the sliced garlic is lightly golden brown
6. Remove the garlic slices with a slotted spoon to a plate lined with paper towels
7. Reserve the oil
8. Increase the heat of the grill to high
9. Remove the shrimp from the marinade , season with salt and pepper and grill until golden brown on each side , about 1 1 / 2 minutes per side
10. Remove the shrimp from the skewers , transfer to a platter and drizzle with some of the reserved garlic oil and the garlic chips
11. Sprinkle with the remaining thyme and garnish with oregano leaves

title: nif s 1 ww pt  light  low fat spinach and feta omelette  omelet
steps:
1. Heat a 6" or 8" good quality nonstick pan that has been sprayed with nonstick spray over low-medium heat
2. Pour in egg whites
3. Sprinkle with fresh spinach and feta
4. Cover with pan lid
5. Let set for 5 minutes or so , while checking for doneness
6. This would be when you no longer see uncooked egg whites settling on top of the omelette
7. Fold omelette in half onto plate and top with salt and pepper to taste

title: porter beef
steps:
1. Roll the steak in the flour
2. Brown in hot fat and then remove from heat
3. Fry the onions for 3 minutes and then put the meat and all other ingredients in with the onions
4. Bring to a boil , reduce heat and simmer for 2 hours

title: hunter s steak
steps:
1. Trim fat from beef
2. Cut beef into 6 serving size pieces
3. Combine undrained tomatoes , mushrooms , celery , and carrots in 5-6 quart slow cooker
4. Place beef on vegetables
5. Stir together broth , soup , and seasoning mix
6. Pour over beef
7. Cover
8. Cook on low-heat setting for 8-10 hours , or on high-heat setting for 4-5 hours
9. Serve with cooked noodles

title: key lime buttercream frosting
steps:
1. 1
2. Beat first 4 ingredients at medium speed with an electric mixer until creamy
3. 2
4. Gradually add powdered sugar alternately with key lime juice , 1 tablespoons at a time , and 1 tablespoons milk , beating at low speed until blended and smooth after each addition
5. Beat in up to 1 tablespoons additional milk for desired consistency

title: steamed sugar snap peas with wasabi butter
steps:
1. Stir together softened butter and wasabi powder until well combined
2. Microwave sugar snap peas with water , covered , at high 3 to 4 minutes , until crisp-tender
3. Toss with wasabi butter
4. Sprinkle with salt

title: sweet peppercorn coleslaw
steps:
1. Toss together the cabbage , carrots and raisins or cranberries in a large mixing bowl
2. Dressing:
3. Add soymilk to a small mixing bowl
4. Stir in lemon juice and allow to sit for a few minutes
5. It will curdle and become like buttermilk
6. Whisk in the remaining ingredients
7. Toss dressing with the slaw and serve immediately

title: three alarm italian style chili mac
steps:
1. Bring a large covered pot of water to a boil
2. Add in salt and then the pasta
3. Cook to al dente
4. Preheat broiler
5. While the water for the pasta comes to a boil and the pasta cooks , heat the oil in a deep skillet over medium-high heat
6. When the ripples or smokes , add the beef and break it up with a wooden spoon , stirring and crumbling it for 5-6 minutes
7. Season the meat with chili powder , salt , and pepper
8. When the meat has browned , add the onions , peppers , and garlic
9. Cook until the vegetables are soft , 6-7 minutes
10. Add in the stock and scrape up the pan drippings
11. Stir in the crushed tomatoes
12. Simmer the sauce for 10 minutes
13. Fold in the basil
14. Drain the pasta
15. Toss the pasta in the pan to combine , and transfer the mixture to a casserole dish
16. Sprinkle the chili mac with the cheese
17. Brown under the broiler for 3-4 minutes

title: kittencal s buttery flaky  shortbread pan cookies
steps:
1. Set oven to 325f
2. Prepare two round cake pans
3. In a food processor blend the first 4 dry ingredients
4. Add in the cold butter pieces , and blend for about 30 seconds or more to combine
5. Mix in the chopped maraschino cherries or cranberries
6. Divide the mixture evenly between the two pans , then press the dough in firmly
7. Bake for about 30-35 minutes or until baked through and pale golden
8. Cool the baked dough in pans for 10 minutes
9. While the baked dough is still warm cut into small squares then cool completely
10. Using a spatula transfer to a plate
11. Sprinkle lightly with powdered sugar if desired
12. Delicious !

title: chicken with creamy sun dried tomato sauce
steps:
1. Pat chicken dry and season with salt and black pepper
2. Heat oil in a 12-inch heavy skillet over moderately high heat until hot but not smoking , then brown chicken , turning once , about 6 minutes total
3. Transfer with tongs to a plate
4. Add garlic , tomatoes , and red pepper flakes to skillet and saut , stirring , until garlic is pale golden , about 1 minute
5. Add wine and boil , stirring and scraping up brown bits , until reduced by half , about 1 minute
6. Add chicken broth and bring to a boil , covered
7. Add chicken to skillet with any juices accumulated on plate and simmer , covered , until just cooked through , 3 minutes approximately
8. Transfer chicken with tongs to a platter and keep warm , loosely covered with foil
9. Stir cream and 2 tablespoons basil into sauce in skillet and bring just to a simmer
10. Season with salt and pepper
11. Serve sauce over chicken and sprinkle with remaining 2 tablespoons basil

title: southern cornbread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Spray 9x9-inch baking pan with bakers' joy or grease and flour
3. In large bowl , add all dry ingredients and mix well
4. Add liquid ingredients and stir by hand just enough to mix
5. Do not over-mix
6. Pour into prepared pan
7. Bake 20-25 minutes or until top is lightly browned
8. Cut into nine 3-inch squares
9. Variation: substitute non-fat buttermilk for the skim milk and add 1 / 2 tsp
10. Baking soda

title: spring rolls
steps:
1. Heat peanut oil in wok or skillet over medium high heat
2. Add broccoli slaw mixture , onions and pepper
3. Add salt and pepper to taste
4. Cook for 2-3 minutes , maintaining the crispness of the vegetables
5. Removed from heat and put vegetables in medium bowl
6. Meantime , put noodles in hot water and cover for 10 minutes
7. Drain noodles and chop to make smaller pieces
8. Add noodles to vegetables
9. Add sesame oil and soy sauce
10. Stir to combine ingredients
11. To prepare rolls:
12. Take individual rice paper and add to hot water
13. Remove paper after it softens
14. Remove paper and place on a surface , such as a cloth , to which it will not stick
15. Place about a tablespoon or so of the vegetable filling into the roll
16. Start by pulling the paper over the filling
17. Then roll like you would a burrito
