18. Repeat the process
19. To serve:
20. Use any prepared dipping sauce
21. I like using a thai spicy peanut sauce with it

title: dill tofu on rice
steps:
1. In a large freezer bag , place the tofu
2. Squeeze out as much air as possible
3. In a 2nd large freezer bag , combine the onion , garlic , tomatoes , mushrooms , lemon juice and dill weed
4. Seal the bag and toss baggie to mix well
5. Gently squeeze out as much air as possible
6. I choose at this point to also add in the cooked brown rice in quart size baggie
7. I like to have a "dinner kit" in the freezer
8. Place the 3 filled bags into a large freezer bag , along with this printed recipe and seal
9. Freeze
10. To cook
11. Thaw
12. Cook brown rice if you didn't prior
13. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
14. Place tofu in a greased baking dish
15. Bake , uncovered , for 15 minutes , or until golden brown
16. While the tofu is cooking , heat a large skillet over medium heat
17. Add tomato mixture and heat thoroughly for about 10 minutes or until veggies are done
18. Salt and pepper the cooked tofu to taste
19. Make a bed of rice on each dinner plate and top with a tofu fillet
20. Spoon vegetable mixture evenly over each tofu steak

title: crostini with olives and feta spread
steps:
1. To make crostini: partially freeze the unsliced bread loaf
2. Cut into 40 slices
3. Arrange on a cookie sheets
4. Drain the tomatoes , reserving oil
5. Lightly brush one side of each slice with the reserved tomato oil or olive oil
6. Bake in a 300 degree oven for 6 minutes
7. Turn over the slices
8. Bake for another 6 minutes more , or until golden brown
9. Finely chop the drained tomatoes
10. Stir in the olives and the minced garlic
11. Set aside
12. In a small bowl , beat the cream cheese until softened
13. Beat in the feta cheese and milk until smooth
14. Spread the feta / cream cheese mixture on top of the oiled side of the baked crostini
15. Top with a small dollop of tomato mixture
16. Garnish the crostini with shredded fresh basil

title: chocolate cheesecake
steps:
1. Set aside one cup of dry cake mix
2. Mix remaining cake mix with oil and 1 egg
3. Spray 9x13 pan with pam and pat mix in dish to form crust
4. In bowl , mix 3 eggs , softened cream cheese , sugar and the reserved cup of cake mix for 1 min at medium speed
5. Turn on low speed and add milk and vanilla
6. Mix till smooth
7. Pour onto crust and bake 300 for 55-65 min or until center is firm
8. Cool 1 hour then refrigerate for at least 3-4 hours before serving
9. Serve with cool whip and chocolate curls

title: granny s slow cooked sunday smothered pork chops
steps:
1. Rinse the pork chops and pat dry with paper towels
2. Sprinkle salt and pepper over chops , then dredge in flour to lightly coat
3. Reserve the remaining flour
4. In large , deep skillet , heat oil over medium heat
5. Add two of the pork chops and cook , turning once until well browned , about 5 minutes per side
6. Transfer the chops to a plate
7. Repeat with remaining chops
8. Add onions and garlic to the fat in the pan and cook , stirring , for 1 minute
9. Reduce the heat to low and add reserved flour
10. Cook , stirring , until it begins to brown , about 8 minutes
11. In a small bowl combine the stock , water , worcestershire , vinegar , mustard , molasses and allspice
12. Add to pan and stir until well incorporated
13. Bring to a boil , then reduce the heat to maintain a simmer
14. Return the pork chops and their accumulated juices to the pan
15. Cover and simmer until the chops are very tender , about 45 minutes , turning the chops halfway through cooking
16. Serve hot

title: green beans with walnuts and shallot crisps
steps:
1. Make shallot crisps by spreading shallot rings on paper towel , sprinkle with salt , and cover with another paper towel then let them stand 10 minutes
2. Blot excess moisture from shallots
3. Heat oil in small saucepan over medium heat , add shallots and fry 2 to 4 minutes , or until golden brown , stirring frequently
4. Pour shallots and oil through fine mesh strainer , or remove shallots with slotted spoon
5. Spread shallots on paper towels to drain and cool and discard oil
6. Make green beans by cooking beans in large pot of boiling salted water 5 to 8 minutes , or until just tender and drain
7. Whisk together vinegar , mustard , oil , and maple syrup in serving bowl , add green beans and toss to coat
8. Season with salt and pepper , top with shallot crisps and chopped walnuts , and serve

title: 3 cheese manicotti
steps:
1. Cook shells according to the package directions
2. Rinse well in cool water and dry
3. While the pasta is cooking , mix together the cream cheese and 3 cups of mozzeralla cheese
4. Stuff shells with cream cheese mixture put a thin layer of sauce on the bottom of a 13 by 9 baking dish
5. Place manicotti in dish and cover with remaining sauce
6. Sprinkle 1 cup of mozzarella over the top
7. Cover with foil and bake for 30 minutes at 375
8. Uncover , sprinkle with parmesan cheese , and bake for 15 minutes more

title: uncle larry s texas short ribs
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300 degrees
2. Season flour with salt and pepper
3. Roll ribs in flour to coat
4. Arrange in a 9 x 13 glass baking dish
5. Spread onions and peppers over meat
6. Combine remaining ingredients in a bowl and spoon over the top of the meat
7. Bake for 3 hours or until meat is well done
8. Serve over rice or noodles

title: peanut butter caramel chocolate bars
steps:
1. Make the bars: in a large mixing bowl , combine the dry cake mix , butter , and egg
2. Beat with an electric mixer on medium speed until no longer crumbly , about 3 minutes
3. Stir in the peanut butter cups
4. Press the mixture into a greased 9 x 13 baking pan
5. Bake in a preheated 350f oven for 18-22 minutes or until lightly browned
6. Meanwhile , in a saucepan , combine the cornstarch , caramel topping , and peanut butter until smooth
7. Cook over low heat , stirring occasionally , until the mixture comes to a boil , about 25 minutes
8. Cook and stir 1-2 minutes longer
9. Remove pan from heat and stir in the peanuts
10. Spread the mixture evenly over the warm crust
11. Bake for 6-7 minutes longer , or until almost set
12. Cool completely on a wire rack
13. Spread evenly with the frosting
14. Sprinkle with chopped peanuts
15. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour before cutting into bars
16. Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator
17. Bring to room temperature before serving
18. But they're just as yummy cold !

title: chunky blue cheese salad dressing
steps:
1. Combine mayonnaise , sour cream and buttermilk , mixing well
2. Add remaining ingredients mixing thoroughly
3. Must refrigerate for 24 hours before serving for best flavor

title: poor man s lobster newburg
steps:
1. In a skillet , sautee the lobster in butter along with paprika , until browned
2. Set aside
3. In a saucepan , combine the cream and worcestershire sauce and bring to a boil
4. Combine beaten egg yolks , sherry or water and salt
5. Remove cream mixture from heat and slowly stir in egg mixture
6. Return pan bringing this to a boil and cook while stirring for 5-7 minutes or until thickened
7. Stir in lobster
8. Pour mixture into a shallow 9 inch pie plate or divide between four 10oz individual baking dishes
9. Sprinkle with the cracker crumbs and broil 6 inches from heat for about 2 minutes or until a golden brown

title: mint french vanilla coffee  chilled
steps:
1. Blend coffee , ice cream , cinnamon and hot chocolate mix together until smooth
2. Pour into glasses and top with whip cream
3. Sprinkle with cinnamon and top with mint for that extra kick
4. Serve and enjoy !

title: krabby patties
steps:
1. Grill the patties until they are almost cooked through
2. Add the cheese on top and cook until melted
3. Spread the mustard and ketchup on the buns
4. Put a patty on top of each
5. Add the lettuce , tomatoes , pickles , and onion
6. Top with the top bun and serve

title: mediterranean lemon pasta salad
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to package directions
2. Rinse with cold water
3. Drain
4. Meanwhile , melt butter in 4-quart saucepan until sizzling
5. Add bell peppers , onion and italian seasoning
6. Cook over medium-high heat , stirring occasionally , until peppers are just tender
7. Remove from heat
8. Combine cooked pasta , pepper mixture and all remaining ingredients except belgian endive and additional parsley
9. Toss gently
10. Cover
11. Refrigerate at least 2 hours to blend flavors
12. Garnish with belgian endive and additional parsley , if desired

title: tuna mornay
steps:
1. Cook pasta until al dente
2. Drain and put aside
3. In a frypan saute onion and garlic until just softened
4. Remove from heat
5. In a pan melt butter and add milk , when warmed slowly add grated cheese until melting
6. Dont let the mixture boil though
7. Once cheese is melted through add the cornlour or sifted flour to thicken the sauce
8. Put aside
9. Cook the corn and peas until almost cooked
10. Remove from heat or microwave and drain
11. In a large mixing bowl add the tuna , the corn and peas , the fresh chopped basil , onion and garlic , sweet chilli sauce , dried basil and a dash of dried chilli powder
12. Mix thoroughly
13. Add cooked pasta to the mixture and slowly mix through the cheese sauce mixture
14. I usually taste here to make sure enough sweet chilli has been added
15. Pour mixture into a baking dish , top with a very thin layer of grated cheese and then a layer of breadcrumbs on top
16. Cover with foil
17. Bake in oven at 180 degrees for approximately 40 minutes or until cooked in the middle
18. Remove foil approximately 30 minutes into the cooking so the breadcrumbs brown up

title: pork rub  or chicken or beef
steps:
1. Coat both sides of pork chops with olive oil
2. Mix together all spices in a small bowl and then rub into both sides of pork chop

title: easy spanish yellow rice
steps:
1. Heat oil in a medium saucepan on medium-high heat
2. Add the shallots and garlic and cook until they start to brown , around 2-3 minutes
3. Add rice , broth , tumeric , and salt
4. Add frozen peas
5. I usually add enough to cover the surface of the broth
6. Bring to a boil
7. This may take a few minutes
8. Reduce heat to medium-low , cover , and simmer until tender and liquid is absorbed , this takes anywhere from 15 to 20 minutes depending on tastes and your stove !
9. Sprinkle with fresh cilantro for a little extra flavor

title: argentine marinade
steps:
1. An argentine asado or barbecue is not authentic without this delicious marinade called chimichuri
2. It is similar to a multi spiced vinaigrette and is given an earthier tone with the addition of saffron
3. I serve this with poultry or shellfish and brush it on top of garlic bread before toasting
4. Powder threads and steep in lemon juice for 20 minutes
5. Combine all ingredients with whisk and store in covered jar

title: fried chorizo with garlic
steps:
1. Cut the sausages into 5mm slices
2. Cook the sausage slices in a large heated pan , preferably non-stick , stirring until crisp
3. Drain on absorbent paper
4. Discard the fat from pan and wipe the pan clean with kitchen paper towelling
5. Heat the olive oil in the same pan
6. Cook the sausage slices , garlic , italian herbs and red pepper flakes until they are heated through and serve the sausage slices on toothpicks , sprinkled with the fresh parsley , as part of an an

title: chile blanc
steps:
1. In a large saucepan cook turkey and onion till turkey is no longer pink and onion is tender
2. Drain fat from pan , if necessary
3. Stir in beer , water , jalapeno peppers , bouillon granules , chili powder , and cumin
4. Bring mixture to boiling
5. Reduce heat
6. Simmer , uncovered , for 20 minutes , stirring occasionally
7. Stir in the drained beans and lime juice
8. Cook 5 minutes more
9. If desired , mash half of the beans to thicken the chile
10. Stir
11. Ladle into bowls
12. If desired , garnish with sour cream , cilantro , and lime wedges
13. Sprinkle with additional chili powder
14. Pass pepper sauce , if desired
15. Makes 4 servings
16. Do not touch your eyes , or any other sensitive part of your body

title: glorified rice
steps:
1. Mix together the rice , sugar , pineapple and vanilla
2. Stir in the marshmallows and cherries
3. Fold in the whipped cream
4. Refrigerate until ready to serve

title: spicy eggplant slices with variation  indian
steps:
1. Make slits on the eggplant slices
2. Mix all the other ingredients except the oil
3. Add about a tablespoon of water to wet the mix
4. Apply the spice mix on the eggplant slices
5. Add about a tablespoon of oil to the frying pan and fry a batch of the eggplant slices on one side
6. Turn over the eggplant slices and pour some more oil and fry
7. Complete with the remaining slices
8. Serve with indian bread
9. Variation:
10. Cut up the eggplant into thin strips
11. Heat the oil
12. Put all the ingredients and saute for 2-3 minutes
13. Add eggplant strips
14. Cook for about 15-20 minutes on fairly high heat
15. Stir in between so that nothing sticks to the bottom of the pan
16. Enjoy this easier version :)

title: boca crumbles vegetarian stuffed bell peppers
steps:
1. Saut onions and garlic in oil until soft
2. Meanwhile , cut peppers lengthwise and clean out seeds & membrane
3. Add undrained tomatoes , boca crumbles and rice to softened onion mixture
4. Simmer until well combined
5. Add ketchup and mustard
6. It should be just thick enough to remain in peppers
7. Play with it and add it to taste !
8. Put pepper shells in a 13x9 and spoon mixture into peppers and cook covered with foil for 1 to 1 1 / 2 hours at 350f or until peppers are soft

title: tropical shrimp paella
steps:
1. Slice the linguica or smoked sausage or chorizo into 1 / 4-inch rounds , then quarter the sausage
2. Marinate the prawns in olive oil which has been infused with saffron
3. Season with kosher salt and crushed red pepper
4. In addition , other seafood may be added such as clams and mussels
5. Cook the onion in half the olive oil until translucent over medium-high heat
6. Add the thyme , turmeric , salt and rice
7. Stir well
8. Add the stock , stir once and set on low heat for about 20 minutes , or until just al dente
9. In large sauce pan , warm the garlic in the remaining olive oil and add the diced red pepper
10. Add the fruit , sausage and prawns and saut for one minute
11. Add the rum and cook for another minute to burn off the alcohol
12. Add the cooked rice
13. Toss all together carefully until thoroughly incorporated
14. Moisten with a little more stock if necessary
15. Mound the paella in a bowl or on a plate
16. Garnish the paella with two spears of pineapple , some sliced chives and sliced starfruit if desired

title: grandmother s banana bread
steps:
1. Mix sugar and butter , then add eggs
2. Mix
3. Add sour cream
4. Mix
5. Add bananas
6. Mix
7. Add flour , soda , salt and nuts
8. Mix
9. Bake in 2 greased loaf pans at 350 degrees for 45 to 50 minutes

title: greens  n beans pasta with italian sausage
steps:
1. Cook pasta in boiling salted water according to package directions until al dente
2. Meanwhile , in a large skillet , heat olive oil and saute sausage and garlic together until sausage is browned
3. Stir in escarole and cook until wilted
4. Stir in chicken broth , cover and simmer for about 10 minutes
5. Add drained cooked pasta , beans and parmesan cheese to skillet and stir over low heat for about 5 minutes until juices thicken
6. Serve topped with additional grated parmesan cheese

title: cheesy hominy casserole
steps:
1. Combine first six ingredients in a large mixing bowl
2. Spoon into a lightly greased 13" x 9" x 2" baking dish
3. Sprinkle with breadcrumbs
4. Dot with butter
5. Bake , uncovered , at 350 degrees for 30 minutes
6. Garnish with green chiles and pimiento strips

title: simple breakfast scramble
steps:
1. Start by putting cleaned , but not peeled , whole potato in microwave for 5 minutes
2. While microwaving potato: melt butter in skillet , dice up ham into small bits
3. Once potato is done , remove skin and dice up your "baked" potato
4. Throw potato and ham in skillet and turn heat up high
5. Once potatoes begin browning , crack eggs and add to skillet--no need to scramble
6. Add pepper and tabasco
7. Stir vigorously till eggs are almost done
8. Add cheese to the skillet and scramble up with the rest
9. As soon as cheese is mostly melted , pour skillet onto a plate
10. Smother the top with sour cream

title: ultimate bruschetta
steps:
1. Cut tomatoes in half , squeeze out seeds and juice
2. Chop into small dice and place in bowl
3. Add onion , garlic , basil , vinegar , half the olive oil , salt and pepper to your taste
4. Let stand at room temperature for about 1 hour , drain liquid
5. On broil , toast bread on both sides until golden
6. Quickly brush one side of each slice with remaining olive oil
7. Spoon tomato mixture on top& serve
8. Also we have made this using dried basil instead of fresh and although it does not call for it in the recipe we also use some fresh parsley

title: lamb shank rogan josh
steps:
1. With paper towels , gently pat any excess moisture from the lamb shanks
2. Set aside
3. In a gallon-sized ziplock or other bag , combine the flour , chili powder , coriander , ginger , cumin , salt and nutmeg
4. Add the lamb shanks and shake to dust the shanks in the mixture
5. In a large dutch oven , heat the oil over medium heat
6. Add the dusted lamb shanks from the bag
7. Reserve any remaining flour / spice mixture from the bag , setting it aside
8. Brown the lamb on all sides for about 7 to 10 minutes , careful not to let the flour / spice mixture burn
9. Transfer the browned meat to a plate and set aside
10. Add the thinly sliced onion and celery to the dutch oven and saut for 5 to 7 minutes until the onion is golden brown
11. Add the reserved flour / spice mixture and cook for 1 minute , stirring continuously
12. Stir in the stock and yogurt until well mixed
13. Return the browned lamb to the dutch oven , turning the shanks so that they're covered in sauce
14. Add the cracked cardamom pods and saffron and bring to a gentle boil
15. Cover tightly with dutch oven lid and cook at medium low for 90 minutes
16. Add the tomatoes and cook for an additional 40 to 60 minutes until the lamb is tender and falling away from the bone
17. Separate the meat from the bone / fat / gristle and serve with the sauce
18. Serve hot with rice and naan
19. Saag aloo or curried lentils also go well with this dish !

title: sweet potatoes with parmesan sage butter
steps:
1. Steam or boil potatoes until teneder , about 15-20 minutes
2. Drain if necessary , and allow to cool
3. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
4. Grease a 13x9-inch casserole or baking dish and set aside
5. In a large skillet , melt butter and cook until butter just starts to brown , about 3-5 minutes
6. Add the sage leaves and the salt and pepper and cook until the butter darkens to a deep golden color
7. Pour butter mixture over potatoes , add 3 / 4 cup of the parmesan cheese and toss well
8. Place potates in the prepared baking pan and cover with a lid or seal with aluminum foil
9. Bake in the preheated oven for about 18-20 minutes or until heated through
10. Sprinkle with the remaining parmesan and serve

title: quick and fruity crescent waffles
steps:
1. Heat oven to 200f heat square or rectangular waffle maker
2. Spray with cooking spray
3. Meanwhile , in 8-inch nonstick skillet , toast pecans over medium heat 5 to 7 minutes , stirring frequently , until lightly browned
4. Remove from skillet
5. Set aside
6. Separate crescent dough into 8 triangles
7. Place 2 or 3 triangles at a time on waffle maker , leaving at least 1 / 2 inch of space around each triangle
8. Close lid of waffle maker
9. Cook 1 to 2 minutes or until golden brown
10. Place cooked waffles on cookie sheet in oven to keep warm
11. In 1-quart saucepan , heat spreadable fruit and yogurt over medium heat 2 to 3 minutes , stirring occasionally , until hot
12. To serve , stack 2 crescent waffles , slightly overlapping , on each of 4 serving plates
13. Spoon 1 / 4 of the fruit sauce over each serving
14. Top each serving with 1 / 4 of the banana slices and 1 tablespoon of the pecans
15. Top with whipped cream
16. Sprinkle lightly with cinnamon
17. Garnish with blueberries

title: skillet meatloaf dinner
steps:
1. Dissolve bouillon in water
2. Mix 1 / 4 cup of the bouillon and the remaining ingredients except potatoes , cheese and mushrooms
3. Pat mixture in 9" skillet to within 1" of edge
4. Pour remaining bouillon around edge
5. Place potato wedges on meatloaf in spoke fashion
6. Cover and cook over low heat until potatoes are tender , 30 to 40 minutes
7. Arrange cheese on potatoes
8. Sprinkle with mushrooms
9. Cover and cook until cheese is melted , 2 to 3 minute sprinkle with snipped parsley if desired

title: entrecote bourgignon   burgundy style steak
steps:
1. Sear the steaks over high heat in half the butter and all the oil until cooked to your desired doneness- the time depends on how you like your steaks
2. Medium rare is how my friend made them
3. Remove and keep warm in oven on low heat
4. In the same pan , cook the mushrooms until tender , about three minutes , remove and keep warm
5. In another pan , cook the shallots over medium heat until just transparent , and then add the bottle of wine and reduce by 2 / 3 on high heat
6. Add salt , and then add the mushrooms , taste to adjust the seasonings
7. Add one turn of the mill of black pepper , and then serve over the steaks
8. The sauce should be fairly thick
9. If you are in a hurry , you can thicken the sauce with a roux
10. Serve with mashed potatoes , and a good salad

title: lemon herb marinade
steps:
1. Mix all ingredieants well
2. Pour over chicken and marinate at lease 2 hours
3. If using fish , only marinate 1 / 2 hour
4. Grill chicken or fish on b-b-q , or broil in broiler
5. This makes enough for 6 boneless , skinless chicken breasts

title: dr pepper taco mac
steps:
1. Brown meat and onions in large stock pot , drain grease
2. On low-med heat add the rest of the ingredients- except the macaroni , cheese , corn chips and sour cream
3. Simmer 60 minutes or more
4. Add the cooked macaroni just before serving
5. Serve with cheese and sour cream
6. Chips if you want

title: salmon with sage butter   root vegetables in parchment
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
2. Cut the tough green tops from the leek and slice the tender lighter-colored section into very thin rounds
3. Cut carrot and parsnip into matchsticks approximately 1 / 2 inch long and 1 / 4 inch wide
4. Slice crimini mushrooms in half lengthwise and then into 1 / 4 inch slices
5. Combine butter , lemon juice , thyme , sage , pepper and salt in a food processor and pulse until thoroughly pureed
6. Mix vegetables together
7. Lay in a nest about the size of the salmon filet on one side of the parchment paper
8. Place 1 / 3 of the sage-butter mixture on top of the vegetables
9. Place salmon on top of vegetables and spread with the rest of the sage-butter mixture
10. Sprinkle chopped chives on top , distributing evenly
11. Fold the other side of the parchment paper over on top of the salmon
12. Roll and crimp edges together to create a tightly-sealed half-moon shaped packet
13. Place packet on baking sheet and bake for 12-15 minutes for a thin fillet , or 20-30 minutes for a thicker filet
14. Remove from oven and allow to sit for 5 minutes
15. To serve , place the packet on a dinner plate and create two slashes on the top of the paper in the shape of an x
16. Peel back paper and enjoy !

title: honey horseradish dip
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together in a bowl
2. Store in the refrigerator

title: port a pitt bbq chicken  copycat recipe
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients
2. Pour over chicken in large roasting pan
3. Cover with aluminum foil
4. Bake in 325 degree oven 30 to 45 minutes
5. Grill chicken until browned dipping in marinade several times

title: easy onion relish
steps:
1. Saute onions , celery and red bell pepper in the butter in a dutch oven for about 15 minutes or until tender
2. Add in vinegar and remaining ingredients to the mixture
3. Bring to a boil , reduce heat and simmer uncovered for about 20 minutes
4. Store in refrigerator for 1 day before using
5. Serve chilled or at room temperature

title: applesauce crazy cake  no bowl
steps:
1. In 8 or 9-inch square pan , combine flour , sugar , baking powder , cinnamon , baking soda , salt , cloves and nutmeg
2. Blend well
3. Stir in apple sauce , oil and vanilla
4. Mix well
5. Stir in raisins and nuts
6. Use a rubber spatula to scrape any ingredients clinging to sides , corners or bottom of pan into the batter and even the batter in the pan
7. Bake at 350f for 25 to 30 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
8. Makes 9 servings

title: braised pork spareribs
steps:
1. Brown spareribs in frying pan in small amount olive oil
2. Remove spareribs and place in oven proof pan
3. Add brown sugar , vinegar , soya sauce , ginger and garlic in frying pan and cook at low heat until melted and blended
4. Pour over ribs and cover with tight covered lid or tin foil
5. Cook at 350 for 1 hour and turn ribs
6. Continue for another hour

title: garlic   lemon roast chicken thighs
steps:
1. Puree garlic , lemon juice , worcestershire sauce& salt
2. Combine marinade and chicken in a plastic bag
3. Marinade at room temperature for 15 minutes
4. Arrange chicken on greased rack in a broiler pan
5. Roast chicken at 425 for 25-35 minutes until cooked

title: french vanilla cheesecake
steps:
1. Yogurt cheese
2. Wrap yogurt in cheesecloth and inverting over an open container
3. Place in refrigerator overnight and excess water in the yogurt will drip to the bottom of the container
4. The remaining yogurt cheese will be richer and creamier
5. Cheesecake
6. Preheat oven to 325 degrees
7. Lightly coat a 10in
8. Spring form pan with canola oil
9. In a medium bowl , combine graham cracker crumbs and applesauce
10. Mix well
11. Press into the bottom of spring form pan and set aside
12. Bring 1 cup water to a boil in a small saucpan
13. Add vanilla bean and simmer until softened , about 1 minute
14. Remove from water and when cool enough to handle , slit bean lengthwise
15. Scrape out vanilla bean paste with a knife and reserve
16. In a blender container , puree cottage cheese until smooth
17. In a mixing bowl , combine pureed cottage cheese , cream cheese , and yogurt cheese and blend with electric mixer on high until smooth , about 2 minute
18. Add eggs , one at a time and blend well
19. Add flour , sugar , vanilla bean paste and vanilla extract
20. Blend well and pour into crust
21. Bake for 40 minute
22. Turn off oven and allow cheesecake to cool in oven an additional 30 minute
23. Remove from oven and let rest for 20 minute before refrigerating
24. In a medium saucepan , combine cherries and sugar and bring to a boil
25. Reduce heat and simmer until sugar is dissolved and cherries begin to break down , about 10 minute you may need to add a little water to keep from scorching
26. When cheesecake is cold , remove spring form sides and slice into 16 portions
27. Serve 1 tablespoons of cherries over cheesecake

title: spaghetti meatballs with tomato basil sauce
steps:
1. Heat oven to 425 degrees f
2. Bring a medium sauce pot of water to a boil over high heat , salt water and cook pasta to al dente 7 minutes or so , drain and quick-cool on a baking sheet
3. While pasta cooks , toast pine nuts
4. Make a thick herb pesto by placing the herbs , cheese , garlic and nuts in food processor with salt and pepper
5. Turn processor on and stream in about 1 / 3 cup olive oil - make the pesto very thick
6. Place meat in a bowl
7. Season the meat with salt and pepper
8. Add cooked pasta , egg , bread crumbs and half the pesto to the meat
9. Mix to combine and form into 16 balls , and place on a parchment paper lined baking sheet
10. Let the spaghetti pop out of meatballs like porcupine quills
11. Coat balls with a little olive oil and roast 12 to 15 minutes until firm and golden in color
12. Remove from the oven and place on a serving platter
13. While meat roasts heat a healthy drizzle olive oil in a sauce pot over medium-high heat
14. Add onions and carrots , season with salt and pepper , and saute for 5 minutes
15. Stir in the stock , add tomatoes and crush with the back of a wooden spoon
16. Cook for 5 minutes more , then stir in remaining pesto and transfer to a serving bowl or 4 individual ramekins for dipping

title: lamb sandwich
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
2. Remove all visible fat from lamb
3. Combine seasoning in a small cup or bowl
4. Rub lamb with oil then rub with the seasoning mixture
5. Place lamb in a baking dish and roast for 30-40 minutes or until done
6. Let lamb stand for 10 minutes before slicing
7. Make 4 sandwiches with thinly sliced lamb and the remaining ingredients

title: naturally gluten free macaroons
steps:
1. Mix coconut , sugar and rice flour together , add the egg whites and almond extract , the egg whites don't have to be beaten , just broken up a bit with a fork
2. Drop heaping about a tablespoon full on a well greased baking sheet
3. Should only make 12 cookies
4. Bake for around 15 minutes at 325 degrees until the edges and top are browning

title: lazy peach cobbler
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375f
2. Stir together bisquick , milk and nutmeg in ungreased square baking dish , 8x8x2 inches
3. Stir in butter until blended
4. Stir together sugar and peaches
5. Spoon over batter
6. Bake 50 to 60 minutes or until golden

title: chocolate pudding cake ii
steps:
1. Combine flour , sugar , cocoa , baking powder and salt
2. Blend in milk , vegetable oil and vanilla
3. Stir in nuts
4. Pour into a greased 9 x 9-inch pan
5. Spread evenly
6. Combine brown sugar and 1 / 4 cup cocoa
7. Spread evenly over batter
8. Pour hot water over batter
9. Do not stir
10. Bake at 350 degrees f or 45 minutes

title: gluten free blueberry pudding
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 and grease a 9-inch pie plate
2. Place blueberries in a medium bowl
3. Combine 1 / 4 cup of the brown sugar and 1 tbsp of the gluten-free flour blend
4. Toss with blueberries to coat
5. Spoon mixture into pie plate
6. In separate bowl , stir together remaining flour and margarine
7. Mix in remaining 1 / 2 cup of brown sugar
8. Add soy milk , egg , vanilla , and lemon peel
9. Blend well
10. Pour batter over blueberry mixture
11. Bake until firm , and juices are bubbling well
12. About 55 minutes
13. Cool ten minutes
14. Top with whipping cream or ice cream just before serving

title: mocha mint warmer
steps:
1. In a mug , combine the espresso and creme de menthe
2. Fill with hot cocoa
3. Dollop with some whipped cream and garnish with mint sprig

title: chicken salad with walnuts  easy   simple
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl
2. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour
3. As a sandwich filling - spread mixture on 9 slices of white or wheat bread
4. Top with 9 slices of bread
5. Trim bread crusts and cut diagonally into four triangular sections

title: kosher jewish  pickles
steps:
1. Cut 1 / 16" off the ends of the cucumbers and scrub very well
2. Soak the cucumbers in ice water for a couple of hours
3. When cucumbers are almost done soaking , mix the salt and water
4. Sterilize or wash your giant pickle jar from the food warehouse
5. Make sure you have properly disposed of all the lousy pickles that use to be in it , i recommend your compost heap or the garbage
6. Wash the jar or sterilize it so it no longer stinks like the vinegar they used to make there inferior pickles
7. Now it gets real easy
8. Pack as many of your pickles into the jar as you can
9. Use the rest for a salad or something
10. Stick in all the dill , all the garlic cloves , all the seeds , then stop , and look at your beautiful jar
11. If you have the grape leaves , stick them in at this time
12. I don't ever use them , but my buddy does
13. Pour the salt water in the jar
14. All the way up to the top minus an inch , or a half inch or so
15. If you are short water , add some
16. Tightly cover the jar with the lid that came on the giant pickle jar
17. Cover it tightly , as hard as you can turn , stop , then tighten again just to make sure
18. Stand back , and look at the beauty of what you have made
19. Place jar upside down , with a towel over it , in a cool place in your home
20. Put a plate under the jar to see if it leaks
21. The next day check to see if the jar leaked
22. If it did , it means you didn't follow my instructions
23. Tighten the lid and turn it upright , cover it with the towel , and ignore it
24. Walk away
25. Leave in cool dark place for five days
26. If you want to leave them for a full week , more power to you
27. Both time frames will result in a great authentic kosher pickle
28. Enjoy , then leave feedback on this recipe

title: ruth chris s raspberry rosemary martini
steps:
1. Ill cocktail shaker with ice
2. Add muddled raspberries and everything but garnish
3. Shake well and strain into chilled martini glass
4. Pierce 2 raspberries onto rosemary sprig
5. Put into drink and serve

title: grilled chicken yakitori
steps:
1. Mix all marinade ingredients together
2. Pierce each chicken breast with fork several times
3. Marinate chicken breasts in marinade several hours
4. Cook on greased grill over medium heat 10 minutes or until done

title: chocolate hazelnut bars
steps:
1. Base
2. Preheat oven to 350
3. Grease a 9x13 baking pan
4. Stir together the flour with the brown sugar and salt
5. Slowly stir in the butter and mix until crumbly
6. Press mixture into the bottom of the pan
7. Bake until golden , around 15 minutes
8. Reduce heat to 325
9. Topping
10. In a small bowl whisk together the cocoa with the flour , baking powder and salt
11. In a large bowl whisk together eggs with the butter , vanilla and sugar
12. Whisk in cocoa mixture and stir to well blended
13. Stir in the nuts and coconut
14. Pour over top of baked crust
15. Shake a bit to level top
16. Bake in oven until middle is firm , around 30 minutes
17. Remove and cool in pan on a rack

title: novak family cucumber salad
steps:
1. Mix together onion , cucumber , salt , pepper , dill , and parsley
2. In a separate bowl , combine sugar , oil , and vinegar
3. Pour over cucumber mixture
4. Toss
5. Marinate several hours in the refrigerator before serving

title: cheesy chicken stuffed peppers
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Place chicken pieces in a bowl and pour the dressing over them
3. Mix well
4. Let marinate at room temperature 10 minutes
5. Meanwhile , cut tops off peppers
6. Do not discard
7. Remove seeds and membranes from peppers
8. Set peppers aside
9. Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat
10. Add chicken and marinade and cook , stirring , until marinade comes to a boil and chicken is lightly colored
11. Stir in garlic , paprika and tomato , and cook , stirring , for 1 minute
12. Reduce heat to medium-low and stir in shredded muenster
13. Cook , stirring , just until cheese melts
14. Remove from heat and let cool slightly
15. Spray a baking dish with cooking spray
16. Stand peppers upright in dish
17. Spoon chicken mixture into peppers
18. Pour any leftover sauce over and around them
19. Replace tops on peppers
20. Bake for 30-40 minutes , or until chicken is cooked through and peppers begin to soften
21. Remove dish from oven and remove pepper tops
22. Place a slice of cheddar on each pepper
23. Replace tops
24. Return to oven and bake just until cheddar melts , about 5 minutes

title: lemon streusel bars
steps:
1. Combine filling ingredients until fully blended
2. Blend butter and brown sugar together , add flour and oats , and mix with pastry blender until mixture resembles coarse crumbs
3. Reserve 2 cups streusel and press remaining streusel onto bottom of sprayed 9-inch baking pan
4. Spread filling over crust , sprinkle with reserved streusel , and pat streusel gently into filling
5. Bake 30-35 minutes at 350 or until light golden brown , and cool completely before cutting into bars

title: bacon and egg cups
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Pre- cook bacon for 5-10 minutes
3. Using a muffin / cupcake pan , line the holes with a slice of bacon , pressing the bacon around the sides of the hole , not on the bottom
4. Crack one egg into each hole
5. Sprinkle with salt and pepper and cheese if desired
6. Bake at 350 degrees for 20 minutes or until the egg is the doneness you like
7. These bacon and egg cups should pop right out of the pan

title: mexicali chicken  slow cooker
steps:
1. Put sliced peppers and onions in slow cooker and top with chicken
2. Sprinkle chili powder and oregano over chicken and add salsa
3. Cover and cook on low for 7 to 8 hours or on high for 2 to 3 hours
4. Remove chicken from slow cooker and place in a serving bowl to keep warm
5. Stir ketchup cumin , and salt into mixture in slow cooker
6. Cook , uncovered , on high 15 minutes or until hot
7. Pour mixture over top of noodles or rice

title: fruit quick bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Blend butter , sugar , vanilla , salt and lemon juice
3. Beat in eggs one at a time
4. Dissolve baking soda in sour cream , and add to butter mixture
5. Fold in flour , preserves , nuts and food coloring
6. Pour batter into two greased and floured loaf pans
7. Bake 35-40 minutes
8. )

title: roasted chicken on grill  ww
steps:
1. Remove grill rack and preheat grill to medium
2. Soak wood chips in a pan of water for 30 minutes
3. Meanwhile combine next 6 ingredients in a small cup
4. With your fingers loosen the skin on the chicken breasts , legs and thighs
5. Rub herb mixture under the skin and then pull skin back into place
6. Put the lemon wedges , garlic cloves and rosemary sprigs into chicken cavity
7. Tuck the wings under the chicken and tie the legs together with kitchen string
8. Drain wood chips
9. If using a gas grill , place the chips in a disposable foil pan wit a few holes poked in and place on a lit burner
10. If using a charcoal grill , sprinkle chips over the coals
11. Spray grill rack with pam and place back on the grill
12. Place chicken breast side up on the cooler portion of the grill
13. Grill covered without turning for 1 1 / 2 hours or until meal thermometer registers 180 degrees f
14. Transfer chicken to a cutting board and let stand for 10 minutes before carving
15. Discard ingredients in cavity and cut chicken into 6 servings
16. If following ww remove skin before eating or add points for the chicken skin

title: yams with ginger and scallions
steps:
1. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil
2. Add yams and cook until tender , 810 minutes
3. Drain yams in a colander and transfer to a large shallow serving dish
4. Return pot to the stove-top
5. Heat oil in the pot over medium-high heat
6. Add the garlic , shallots , scallions , jalapeos , ginger , and salt and pepper
7. Cook , stirring often , until fragrant , 12 minutes
8. Reduce heat to medium-low and cook , covered , stirring occasionally , until ginger has softened , 1520 minutes
9. Stir the basil into the ginger mixture
10. Cook , uncovered , until basil has softened and released its fragrance , about 30 seconds
11. Spoon the gingerbasil mixture over the yams
12. Season with salt and pepper
13. Right before serving , drizzle the lime juice over the top

title: easy oven omelette
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees
2. Brush the 1 tbsp melted butter into a square baking dish
3. Beat the eggs , sour cream , milk and mustard together until well blended
4. Stir in the scallions , swiss cheese , salt and paprika
5. Pour into the buttered baking dish
6. Bake at 325 for about 30-35 minutes or until eggs are set but still moist

title: florida snapper with couscous
steps:
1. Saute onions , carrots and peppers in oil over med high heat for approximately 10 minute
2. Cut snapper into bite size pieces and add with tomato , salt , pepper , and basil
3. Stir well , reduce heat , cover and simmer 15 minutes
4. Prepare couscous by bringing broth , chilis , and garlic butter to a boil in a saucepan , add couscous , cover and remove from heat
5. Let stand 5 minute
6. Fluff couscous with fork and place on plates
7. Serve snapper mixture over couscous

title: cottage pie ala pantry
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
2. First prepare mash potato topping by boiling the potatoes until just tender
3. Combine potatoes with butter and cheddar cheese
4. Add salt and pepper to taste
5. Mash and mix ingredients
6. The potatoes should be stiff when finished
7. Set aside
8. Cook carrot , celery and onion in olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat until they are soft
9. Add the ground beef
10. If raw , cook until evenly browned
11. If pre-cooked , cook for about 5 minutes sprinkle the flour over the mixture and cook for about 2-3 minutes , stirring occasionally
12. Add the chicken broth and the seasonings , stirring well to distribute
13. Reduce heat to low and simmer , stirring occasionally until it thickens
14. Place beef mixture in a 9 inch pie plate and then spread potatoes over it
15. Distribute the potatoes evenly but they do not need to smooth
16. Randomly sprinkle the cold butter over the top of the potatoes and pop in the oven for 30-35 mins , until browned and heated through

title: fennel and cucumber relish
steps: 1. Stir together all ingredients in a bowl and let stand 15 minutes

title: nectar chocolate orange
steps:
1. Put chocolate liqueur , kahlua , grand marnier , cream in a shaker half filled with ice
2. Shake vigorously and strain in an iced cocktail glass
3. When ready to serve , sprinkle with grated chocolate

title: pecan squares with dipped chocolate ganache
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f
2. Making the crust:
3. Beat the butter and granulated sugar in the bowl of an electric mixer fitted with a paddle attachment , until light , approxiamtely , 3 minutes
4. Add the eggs and the vanilla , and mix well
5. Sift together the flour , baking powder , and salt
6. Mix the dry ingredients into the batter with the mixer on low speed until just combined
7. Press the dough evenly into an ungreased 18x12x1" baking sheet , making an edge around the outside
8. It will be very sticky
9. Sprinkle the dough and your hands lightly with flour
10. Bake for 15 minutes , until the crust is set but not browned
11. Allow to cool
12. Topping:
13. Combine the butter , honey , brown sugar and zests in a large , heavy-bottomed saucepan
14. Cook over low heat until the butter is melted , using a wooden spoon to stir
15. Raise the heat and boil for 3 minutes
16. Remove from heat
17. Be very careful - it is hot caramel !
18. Stir in the heavy cream and the pecans
19. Pour over the crust , trying not to get the filling between the crust and the pan
20. Bake for 25-30 minutes , until the filling is set
21. Remove from the oven and allow to cool
22. Wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate until cold
23. Cut into small bars
24. Make ganache:
25. Cook the heavy cream , chocolate chips , and instant coffee in the top of a double boiler over simmering water until very smooth and warm , stirring occasionally
26. Dip only one end of pecan bars in the ganache , & place on white muffin cup liners
27. Smoosh to open and place the dipped pecan bar in it
28. This way it can drip into the liner ! serve with or without liners

title: american lasagna
steps:
1. In a skillet , brown ground beef , onions and garlic
2. Drain fat
3. Stir in basil , oregano , brown sugar , 1 1 / 2 teaspoons salt , diced tomatoes and tomatoes paste
4. Simmer for 30-40 minutes
5. Preheat oven to 375f
6. Bring large pot of salted water to a boil
7. Add lasagna noodles and cook for 5-8 minutes , or until al dente
8. Drain
9. In a medium bowl , mix together eggs , ricotta , parmesan cheese , parsley , and 1 teaspoon salt
10. Layer 1 / 3 of noodles in the bottom of a 9x13 inch baking dish
11. Cover noodles with 1 / 2 of ricotta mixture , 1 / 2 of mozzarella and 1 / 3 of sauce
12. Repeat
13. Top with remaining noodles and sauce
14. Sprinkle with 2 tablespoons parmesan
15. Bake for 30 minutes
16. Let stand 10 minutes before serving

title: chocolate rum delight
steps:
1. Blend the cocoa with the sugar
2. Gradually stir in the milk
3. Heat to a boiling point
4. Remove from the heat and add the coffee and the brandy
5. Chill until ready to serve
6. Pour the cocoa mixture to make a glass two thirds full
7. Add about 1 / 4 cup whipped cream for each serving
8. Blend well and serve at once

title: fried portabella mushrooms
steps:
1. Mix egg and soy sauce together
2. Dip mushroom slices in egg mixture
3. Dredge mushroom slices in bread crumbs and cheese that has been mixed together
4. Fry in a pan

title: another bircher muesli
steps:
1. Combine oats & orange juice & let refrigerate overnight
2. Just before serving add remaining ingredients
3. Sprinkle with cinnamon to serve if you like

title: spaghetti squash casserole with sweet sausage   peppers
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Halve spaghetti squash and place cut side down on buttered baking sheet
3. Bake for 40 minutes or until tender
4. Cool to the point of being able to handle , remove and discard seeds then shred pulp gently with a fork so that strands resemble spaghetti noodles
5. Reduce oven temperature to 350 degrees
6. While squash bakes , cook and crumble bratwurst in a skillet over medium heat
7. Add peppers , onion and garlic and continue cooking until vegetables are crisp tender
8. Add squash , tomatoes , basil , oregano , salt and pepper to skillet and heat through
9. Remove from heat and drain excess liquid
10. Mix in 3 / 4 cup parmesan and transfer to a greased 913 or oval 2 quart casserole dish
11. Bake uncovered for 30 minutes , topping with remaining parmesan for the last five minutes of baking time

title: vegan avgolemono soup
steps:
1. Add vegetable broth , rice , nutritional yeast , and tamari to medium stockpot
2. Bring to a boil , and then lower heat , cover , and simmer for 25 minutes , until rice is cooked
3. Meanwhile , in a small bowl , mix the soymilk , cornstarch , and tumeric with a fork or whisk and set aside
4. When 25 minutes is up , re-stir the soymilk mixture , and add to soup
5. Stir well , until thickened
6. Add seitan , margarine , lemon juice , and lemon zest to soup
7. Mix well , and test for tartness
8. If more tart flavor is desired , add extra lemon juice
9. Add parsley , salt , and pepper to taste
10. Stir well
11. Serve with some freshly snipped dill , if desired
12. This recipe will double well

title: herbed artichoke cheese tortellini
steps:
1. Drain tomatoes , reserving 2 / 3 cup juice
2. Set aside
3. Drain artichokes , reserving 3 / 4 cup liquid
4. Chop and set aside
5. Cook tortellini according to package directions
6. Meanwhile , in a large skillet , saute the onions , parsley , basil , garlic , oregano and pepper flakes in oil for 4-5 minutes or until onions are tender
7. Add the reserved tomatoes , tomato juice and artichoke liquid
8. Bring to a boil
9. Reduce heat
10. Simmer , uncovered , for 10-12 minutes or until slightly thickened
11. Drain tortellini
12. Add to tomato mixture
13. Stir in the olives , salt and reserved artichokes
14. Heat through
15. Sprinkle with cheese

title: lori s smothered cube steaks
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. In large saute pan , on medium high , heat 2 tbsp of the oil
3. Meanwhile , place flour along with season salt in a dish
4. Mix
5. Dredge steaks , coating well on both sides
6. Reserve remaining flour
7. Fry steaks in oil for 3 minutes on both sides
8. Place in oven going baking dish coated with non stick spray
9. Add the remaining oil to the pan
10. Saute the onions for 5 minutes , then add mushrooms and continue sauteing for another 5 minutes
11. Add garlic and cook until fragrant
12. Add 1 tablespoons of the reserved flour , stir and cook for 2 minutes
13. Add the wine , cooking briefly and then the stock
14. Stir
15. Should it become thicker than you want , just add more stock
16. Cook until desired consistency
17. Add the bacon , tarragon and pepper to taste
18. Stir
19. Pour mixture over the steaks and bake 45 minutes

title: date   nut dip or spread
steps:
1. Beat softened cream cheese until smooth , blend in milk
2. Add dates , almonds , cinnamon and almond essence , mix well & chill
3. Serve with cracker biscuits or fresh fruit as a dip or use as a spread on bagels , mmm yum !

title: detoxifying hummus
steps:
1. Puree cilantro , salt , and garlic in a mixer or food processor
2. Add olive oil to help get it moving if needed
3. Add chickpeas and puree , adding oil if needed
4. Sometimes if it's too dry to mix well , i'll add water too so i don't have to use a lot of oil
5. Freezes well !

title: sumptuous salmon pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Melt 1 / 4 cup butter in saucepan
3. Stir in 3 / 4 cup finely crushed stuffing
4. Press stuffing mixture on bottom and up sides of greased 9-inch pie pan
5. Set aside
6. Stir together all filling ingredients in same saucepan
7. Spoon into crust
8. Bake for 50 to 55 minutes or until heated through
9. Let stand 10 minutes
10. Meanwhile , melt 1 / 3 cup butter in 2-quart saucepan
11. Stir in cornstarch
12. Stir in all remaining sauce ingredients except tomatoes
13. Cook over medium heat , stirring occasionally , until mixture comes to a full boil
14. Add tomatoes
15. Boil 1 minute
16. To serve , cut pie into 6 wedges
17. Serve sauce over wedges

title: easy cinnamon chicken
steps:
1. Sprinkle pepper on both sides of chicken breasts
2. Press pepper onto chicken with back of spoon
3. Sprinkle 1 / 2 tsp of cinnamon on both sides of each piece of chicken , press with spoon
4. Sprinkle onion powder on top side only , press with spoon
5. Place chicken in 8x8 pan
6. Combine prepared boullion , water , and remaining cinnamon
7. Pour into botton of pan , not over chicken
8. Loosely cover with foil and bake 1 hour at 350 degrees
9. Check liquid level halfway through cooking , may require more water -> additional 1 / 4 cup

title: cornflake haystacks
steps:
1. Add the peanut butter and package of butterscotch morsels to large pan over a low / med heat
2. Melt , stirring often
3. Once your mixture is smooth and creamy , turn off heat and add cornflakes
4. Mix well until all flakes are coated
5. Place your cookies on wax paper , and let cool

title: roast kumara salad
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 200c
2. Line 2 large baking trays with baking paper and spread kumara over the prepared trays and sprinkle with the fennel seeds and then drizzle with the oil and season with sold and pepper to taste and then bake for 30 to 35 minutes or until lightly browned and just tender and then cool on the trays
3. Combine the kumara , pine nuts , currants and coriander in a large bowl
4. Whisk vinegar and extra oil in a small jug and pour over kumara mixture , tossing well to coat and then serve

title: the best chicken salad
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , whisk together the mayonnaise , salt , poultry seasoning , onion powder , garlic powder , pepper , and lemon juice
2. In a large bowl , toss together the chicken , celery , green onions , water chestnuts , and swiss cheese
3. Add the mayonnaise mixture , and stir to coat
4. Chill until serving

title: the dampest  darkest  deadliest brownies of all time
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Coat a 9-inch-square baking pan with nonstick cooking spray
3. In a large , heavy-bottomed saucepan over medium heat , begin melting the butter
4. When it is half melted , add the chocolate
5. Remove from heat and stir until the butter and chocolate are completely melted
6. Stir in the sugar , salt , vanilla and eggs until smooth
7. Stir in the flour until well-combined
8. Mix in the chocolate chips
9. Pour and scrape the batter into the prepared pan
10. Bake for 20-25 minutes , until the top is dry but the center is still damp
11. Do not overbake
12. Remove from the oven and cool on a rack until the brownies are cool and firm , about 30 minutes

title: individual pumpkin cheesecakes with cranberry caramel sauce
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325f
2. Using electric mixer , beat cream cheese and 1 / 3 cup sugar in large bowl until smooth
3. Add egg and beat until smooth
4. Mix in pumpkin , creme fraiche , cream , and spices , scraping down sides of bowl occasionally
5. Place 8 tart shells on baking sheet
6. Divide filling among tart shells
7. Bake until filling is set in center , about 20 minutes
8. Cool completely
9. Cover and refrigerate until cold , about 3 hours
10. Combine remaining 1 cup sugar and 1 / 4 cup water in heavy medium saucepan
11. Stir over medium-low heat until sugar dissolves
12. Increase heat to high and boil without stirring until syrup turns deep amber color , swirling pan occasionally and brushing down sides of pan with wet pastry brush
13. Add cranberries and remaining 1 / 2 cup water
14. Reduce heat to medium and continue cooking until caramel bits dissolve , stirring constantly , about 2 minutes
15. Cool caramel to room temperature
16. Carefully push cheesecakes out of foil molds
17. Transfer to plates
18. Spoon sauce over and serve

title: christmas chocolate pistachio thumbprints
steps:
1. Beat powdered sugar , butter , vanilla , almond extract , pudding mix and egg
2. Add flour and chocolate chips
3. Mix well
4. Shape into 1-inch balls
5. Roll in nuts
6. With thumb , make imprint in center
7. Bake at 350 degrees , 10 minutes or until light golden brown
8. Cool completely
9. Combine all filling ingredients
10. Melt butter and mix into powdered sugar
11. Add milk and food coloring to make a thick red filling
12. Spoon scant teaspoon in the center of each cookie
13. Melt chocolate chips and shortening
14. Drizzle over cookies
15. Let set until icing is hard

title: 1 2 3 4 cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Grease and flour 3 cake pans ,
3. Using an electric mixer , cream butter until fluffy
4. Add sugar and continue to cream well for 6 to 8 minutes
5. Add eggs , 1 at a time , beating well after each addition
6. Add flour and milk alternately to creamed mixture , beginning and ending with flour
7. Add vanilla and continue to beat until just mixed
8. Divide batter equally among prepared pans
9. Level batter in each pan by holding pan 3 or 4 inches above counter , then dropping it flat onto counter
10. Do this several times to release air bubbles and assure you of a more level cake
11. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until done
12. Cool in pans 5 to 10 minutes
13. Invert cakes onto cooling racks
14. Cool completely and spread cake layers with your favorite frosting to make a 3-layer cake

title: hearty taco casserole
steps:
1. In a small saucepan , bring rice and 1-1 / 3 cups water to a boil
2. Reduce heat
3. Cover and simmer for 30-35 minutes or until rice is tender and water is absorbed
4. Meanwhile , in a large bowl , combine flour , baking powder and salt
5. Cut in butter until crumbly
6. Stir in enough remaining water to form a soft dough
7. On a floured surface , roll dough into a 12-in
8. X 8-in
9. Rectangle
10. Press into a 13-in
11. X 9-in
12. X 2-in
13. Baking dish coated with nonstick cooking spray
14. Bake at 400 for 13-15 minutes or until very lightly browned
15. For filling , in a large nonstick skillet , cook the beef , onion , green pepper and garlic over medium heat until meat is no longer pink
16. Drain
17. Add water , taco seasoning and cooked rice
18. Bring to a boil
19. Reduce heat
20. Simmer , uncovered , for 2-3 minutes or until thickened
21. Remove from the heat
22. Stir in eggs and cilantro
23. Spread over crust
24. Cover and bake for 15-17 minutes or until filling is set
25. Cut into squares
26. Top with cheese , lettuce and tomatoes
27. Serve with salsa and sour cream

title: minestrone soup gift mix in a jar
steps:
1. Directions:
2. In a two-cup jar , layer from bottom in the order given , then seal the jar
3. Include these instructions on your gift tag:
4. In a very large saucepan , combine 8-10 cups of water , a 28 oz can of crushed tomatoes and soup mix
5. Add 2 chopped carrots , and 2-4 chopped potatoes
6. Bring to a boil
7. Reduce heat and cover and simmer for one hour or until peas are tender --

title: peach cream crumble pie
steps:
1. Crust: cut together ingredients , roll it out , and place in 9 inch deep dish pie pan
2. If you use the ready made or your own , put in pie pan and crimp edges
3. Filling: place peaches in a bowl and sprinkle with 1 / 4 cup sugar , mix and let set
4. Combine flour , cornstarch , egg , vanilla , salt , and remaining sugar
5. Mix well and then add the sour cream
6. Stir in with the peaches mixing well but not smashing peaches
7. Pour into pie crust bake at 400 degrees for 15 minutes
8. Reduce heat to 350 degrees bake for another 20 minutes
9. Wait you bake it more after you sprinkle on the topping
10. Topping: combine sugar , flour , and cinnamon in a small bowl
11. If your butter is slightly melted from the microwave that is okay
12. Just mix it in and after it is all mixed add the oatmeal
13. Put in fridge while the pie is baking
14. Then by the time it is ready to sprinkle on the top , it will be just right
15. Now bake at 400 degrees for 15 minutes longer and cool on a rack
16. I serve it cold from the fridge with a french vanilla ice cream or nothing
17. You don't need whip cream

title: corn salsa just like chipotle s
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine all ingredient and mix well
2. Adjust salt and pepper , lime and jalapenos to your desired taste

title: green onion smashed potatoes  champ
steps:
1. Cook the potatoes in a pot of boiling water until very tender
2. While the potatoes are cooking: in a small saucepan bring the cream and butter to a simmer over medium heat , stirring often
3. Add in the green onions
4. Remove from heat
5. Cover with lid and let steep while the potatoes are cooking
6. Drain the potatoes thoroughly , then return to the same pot and mash with a potato masher
7. Add in the cream / onion mixture
8. Mix with a wooden spoon to combine
9. Season with salt and pepper to taste
10. Spoon smashed potatoes onto each plate in a pile and make a indentation
11. Put 1-2 tablespoons hard butter in the indentation
12. Delicious !

title: filipino pancit
steps:
1. In a zip lock bag , marinade the cubed chicken with the teriyaki sauce and 2 cloves of minced garlic overnight
2. The next day , in a large bowl , soak the rice noodles in warm water for 15-30 minutes , drain completely
3. Drain the marinade off the chicken and discard the marinade
4. In a skillet , heat 1 tablespoon of oil on medium high heat and brown the chicken , drain and set aside
5. In a large pot , heat 2 tablespoons of oil on medium high heat and sautee 3 cloves of minced garlic and accent for 30 seconds
6. Add the carrots and stir fry for about 5 minutes
7. Add the cabbage , onions , and 1 tablespoon of soy sauce and stir fry until the vegetables are tender
8. Add the chicken to the vegetables and continue stir frying
9. Now add the noodles to the pot with 1 / 8 cup of oil and 1 / 4 cup of soy sauce and mix very well
10. Keep cooking and mixing until the noodles are tender and cooked thoroughly
11. Serve with the green onions and / or lemon juice from the lemon slices

title: tex mex scrambled eggs
steps:
1. In a non stick skillet melt butter
2. Pour eggs into skillet
3. Cook while stirring from the bottom
4. When eggs are almost set add cheese dip
5. Cook for short time and then turn off heat
6. Let set until cheese is runny and sausage is heated through

title: bacon wrapped chicken with sour cream sauce
steps:
1. In a bowl , mix cream of chicken soup and sour cream
2. Set aside
3. Wrap 1 raw chicken breast with 2 pieces of raw bacon
4. Continue to do this 3 more times and place in a 9x13-inch baking dish
5. Pour soup and sour cream mixture on top of bacon-wrapped chicken , making sure all the chicken is covered
6. Bake uncovered at 400f for 1 hour
7. Serve with baked or mashed potatoes
8. Use leftover cream sauce over potatoes

title: 99 bananas  foster oatmeal
steps:
1. Cook oatmeal in amount of water called for on your oatmeal , and add the divinci syrup
2. Slice the banana into the oatmeal so it can cook into the oats
3. Cook , over low heat , for 6-8 minutes , stirring frequently
4. Add rest of ingredients , except the whipped topping
5. Bring to a gentle boil , and remove
6. Top with a generous serving of chocolate flavored whipped topping which will melt into the oatmeal giving it a delicate but delicious chocolate flavor

title: weight watchers gob cake
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees and prepare 13x9 pan with non-stick spray
2. Drain the juice from the can of mandarin oranges into a measuring cup
3. Crush the mandarin oranges
4. Put the crushed mandarin oranges in to a large mixing bowl
5. Take the juice from the mandarin oranges that was drained into the measuring cup and fill the cup with water until you have 1 and 1 / 4 cup
6. Put applesauce , egg whites and whole egg into the mixing bowl
7. Mix all the wet ingredients then add in dry cake mix and mix with mixer until blended
8. Pour into pan and bake for 35-40 minutes
9. Let it cool then frost with ff cool whip and store in the fridge

title: apple orange cranberry sauce
steps:
1. Squeeze the juice from the orange and set the juice aside
2. Remove and discard the membrane from inside the orange rind and cut the rind into small dice
3. In a small saucepan over high heat , combine the rind and the water and bring to a boil
4. Cook for 10 minutes , then drain and set aside
5. Peel , core and quarter the apple
6. Cut into 1 / 2-inch dice and place in a saucepan
7. Sort the cranberries , discarding any soft ones
8. Add to the apples along with the orange juice , orange rind , sugar , cinnamon and cloves
9. Bring to a boil over high heat , reduce the heat to low and cover the pan partially
10. Simmer gently , stirring occasionally , until the sauce thickens , the apple is tender and the cranberries have burst , 10 to 15 minutes
11. Transfer the cranberry sauce to a heatproof bowl and let cool for 1 hour before serving
12. Or cover and refrigerate
13. Bring to room temperature before serving
14. Transfer the cranberry sauce to a sauce boat and pass at the table

title: aunt darlene s cream cheese frosting
steps:
1. In medium bowl , beat cream cheese and butter on high speed until smooth
2. Gradually add powdered sugar and continue beating until spreadable
3. Stir in vanilla
4. Add pecans , coconut and red food coloring

title: marie callender s banana cream pie by todd wilbur
steps:
1. Beat together the butter and shortening until smooth and creamy and chill until firm
2. Sift together the flour , sugar , and salt in a medium bowl
3. Using a fork , cut the butter and shortening into the dry ingredients , until the mixture has a consistent texture
4. Mix egg yolk , ice water , and vinegar into the dough , then form it into a ball and refrigerate it for 1 hour so that it will be easier to work with
5. Preheat the oven to 450f
6. When the dough has chilled , roll it out and press it into a 9-inch pie plate
7. Press parchment paper or aluminum foil into the crust and weight the crust down with ceramic pie weight or another pie pan filled with dried beans
8. This will prevent the crust from putting up and distorting
9. Bake for 15 minutes , then remove the weigh or pan filled with beans and prick the crust with a fork to allow steam to escape
10. Bake for another 5 to 10 minutes , or until the crust is golden brown
11. Let the crust cool
12. Make the filling by sifting together the sugar , cornstarch , and salt into a medium saucepan
13. Blend the milk and eggs in a medium bowl , then add the mixture to the dry ingredients and cook over medium heat stirring constantly for 6 to 8 minutes or until the mixture boils and thickens , then cook for 1 minute more
14. Remove the filling from the heat , and mix in the vanilla and 1 teaspoons butter
15. Put plastic wrap on the surface of the filling and let it cool to about room temperature
16. Once cooled to room temperature remove the plastic wrap and add the sliced bananas
17. Stir
18. Pour the filing into the pie shell and chill for a couple of hours before serving
19. Slice across the pie 3 times to make 6 large slices
20. Serve each slice topped fresh whipped cream and slivered almonds
21. Substitution: use one of the below in place of homemade crust
22. 9 inch pie crust baked and cooled
23. Or
24. 9 inch graham cracker pie crust

title: upside down strawberry shortcake
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease a 13 x 9-inch baking pan
3. Sprinkle the 4 cups of mini marshmallows on the bottom of the prepared baking pan
4. In a bowl , combine the frozen strawberries and jello gelatin powder
5. Set aside
6. To make the cake: in a bowl , cream together the crisco shortening , butter and sugar for about 2 minutes
7. Add in eggs and almond extract
8. Beat for about 3-4 minutes
9. In a small bowl , combine the flour , baking powder and salt
10. Add to the creamed mixture alternately with the half and half cream
11. Mix well until combined
12. Pour over the marshmallows in the pan
13. Spoon the strawberry mixture over the batter
14. Bake for 45-50 minutes
15. Cut in squares and serve with whipping cream of cool whip topping
16. Delicious !

title: weight watchers blueberry corn muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Grease and flour a cupcake pan
3. Toss blueberries with 1 tbs
4. Flour
5. Mix together remaining flour , cornmeal , baking powder and salt
6. On medium-high speed , beat the 2 egg whites to stiff peaks
7. On low , beat in the extra egg and applesauce
8. Alternately beat in flour mixture and 1 cup milk
9. Fold in blueberries
10. Divide among the cupcake pan
11. Bake 25 minutes , until toothpick inserted comes out clean
12. Cool in pan for 10 minutes
13. Remove from pan and put them on a cooling rack
14. For the topping , mix confectioner's sugar , 1 tbs milk and lemon zest
15. Drizzle over completely cooled muffins
16. These bake wonderfully and are so much better for you than the high fat and calorie bakery muffins !

title: lemon pepper turkey breast  crock pot
steps:
1. Sprinkle turkey with lemon pepper
2. Place turkey breast halves , meaty sides down in a 5 quart crock pot
3. Cover and cook on high for 1 hour
4. Reduce heat to low and clook for 5 hours
5. Remove turkey to platter , reserving cooking liquid in cooker
6. Set turkey aside and keep warm
7. Combine flour and water in a saucepan , stirring with a whisk unti blended
8. Gradually add reserved cooking liquid , stirring constantly
9. Bring to a boil over medium high heat , stirring constantly
10. Reduce heat and simmer for 3-5 minutes or until thick , stirring ocassionaly
11. Serve turkey with gravy

title: oven baked beef casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Toss beef with flour
3. Bake uncovered for 20 minutes
4. Blend soup mix with water and add to beef along with carrots , tomatoes and mushrooms
5. Bake covered for 1 1 / 2 hours until beef is tender
6. Serve over hot noodles or rice

title: mille foglie
steps:
1. Oven 425 or 450
2. For the puff pastry - place between 2 sheet pans with a piece of parchment paper above and below the pastry
3. Bake for 10 minutes - if pastry isn't crisp and golden brown - remove top sheet pan and parchment and bake about 1-2 minutes longer
4. Cool on wire rack
5. For the pastry cream - whisk together the flour , salt , sugar , and cornstarch , in a non-reactive saucepan
6. In a mixing bowl , whisk the milk into the yolks
7. Then whisk them into the sugar-starch mixture
8. Whisk well to be sure all the cornstarch and flour is picked up off the pan bottom and dissolved
9. Set the pan over medium heat and cook the custard mixture for about 12 minutes , until it thickens and comes to a boil until the mixture really thickens and reaches a boil , and you see fat heavy bubbles work up to the surface and burst between stirs
10. Occasionally use a whisk instead of the spoon to break up and remove any lumps
11. Then boil for 1 full minute while stirring constantly , covering the entire bottom of the pan with the spoon
12. Remove the pan from the heat
13. The cream is sufficiently cooked if it is smooth and thick and will generously coat the spoon--it should hold a clearly defined line when you draw your finger
14. If you suspect that the cream may be lumpy , pass it through a strainer set over a bowl
15. Stir in the butter and the vanilla extract , if using
16. Spoon the cream into a bowl
17. To prevent a skin from forming , press a piece of buttered plastic wrap onto the surface , or dab it with butter or sift on a very light coating of confectioners' sugar
18. Cool , then cover and refrigerate
19. Cut the puff pastry in half , place 1 half on the bottom of a pyrex
20. Spread the cream over the pastry , and top with remaining half
21. Sift powdered sugar over all , and chill till ready to serve
22. Cut with a serrated knife
23. You can double this by doubling the cream and using 2 sheets of pastry - you will have to trim the pastry to fit into a 9x13 pan on the sides

title: banana brunch cake
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 and grease 13x9 pan
2. Combine bisquick , 3 / 4 cup brown sugar , and cinnamon
3. Add bananas , milk , egg , and oil
4. Mix well
5. Spread into prepared pan
6. Combine nuts , 1 / 2 cup brown sugar , and butter
7. Sprinkle evenly over batter
8. Bake 30 minutes or until golden brown and toothpick stuck in center comes out clean
9. Cool and enjoy !

title: bacon cream cheese cocktail swirls
steps:
1. Combine cream cheese , onion and milk in a small mixing bowl
2. Beat well
3. Stir in bacon
4. Sparate dough into 4 rectangles , press perforations to seal
5. Divide cream cheese mixture into fourths and spread on each rectangle
6. Starting at long side , roll up rectangles and pinch edges to seal
7. Cut each roll into 8 pieces
8. Place pieces cut side down on an ungreased baking sheet
9. Sprinkle lightly with parmesan cheese
10. Bake at 375 degrees for 12 minutes or until golden brown
11. Serve warm
12. Two hours before baking , remove from refrigerator and let come to room temperature
13. You can also bake swirls wrapped in foil and freeze
14. To serve thaw in aluminum foil , loosen wrap and reheat at 350 for 8 minutes

title: sizzled sausage pasta
steps:
1. Peel the skins from off of the sausages and chop the meat into small hazelnut sized pieces
2. Chop the sun dried tomatoes into small chunks
3. Heat a tbs of the tomato oil in a large frying pan and sizzle the sausage pieces for 8 to 10 minutes , stirring occasionally , until they are golden
4. Stir in the sun dried tomato chunks and the remaining oil and heat everything through
5. Toss the pasta into the sausage mixture along with the parsley
6. Make sure eveything is well mixed and coated with the oil
7. Season generously with salt and pepper , and serve straight from the pan

title: gluten free graham crackers
steps:
1. Mix together gluten-free flour mix , brown sugar , cinnamon , baking powder , xanthan gum , baking soda and salt
2. Using your finger
3. Stir in 3 tablespoons cold water , honey and vanilla
4. If dough is too dry , add a little more cold water , a teaspoon at a time
5. Gather dough into a soft ball
6. Cover in plastic wrap and refrigerate for an hour
7. Preheat oven to 325 degrees
8. Lightly grease a cookie sheet and line with parchment paper
9. Cut two zip lock bags down each parallel side so that each opens out into one long sheet
10. Roll a piece of dough between the two sheets to about 1 / 8-inch thickness , depending on how thick you like your graham crackers
11. Cut into 2 x 3-inch pieces and prick lightly all over with a fork
12. Remove top zip lock sheet
13. Take remaining sheet with dough on it and turn it over
14. Lay it flat , rolled dough side down , onto prepared pan
15. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes or until golden brown
16. If cookies spread and bake together , re-cut while still warm and loosen them
17. Let cookies cool slightly before transferring to cooling rack

title: italian vegetable melt
steps:
1. Chose crusty italian bread that are 6-7 inches long
2. Split bread in half horizontally
3. Place halves on baking sheet , cut side up
4. In a 10-inch skillet or wok heat the salad dressing
5. Add onion , zucchini , green pepper , and garlic
6. Stir-fry for 3 to 5 minutes or until crisp-tender
7. Stir in tomato
8. Sprinkle half of the provolone or mozzarella cheese on bread halves
9. Spoon vegetable mixture on cheese
10. Sprinkle with remaining provolone or mozzarella and the parmesan cheese
11. Broil 3 to 4 inches from the heat about 2 minutes or until cheese melts
12. Serve immediately

title: sourdough sams
steps:
1. Sift dry ingredients , stir into liquid , roll out and cut with regular donut cutter
2. Then heat some oil in a deep fryer to 390 degrees f and fry
3. Just before serving dust with powdered or cinnamon sugar
4. These doughnuts are virtually greasless
5. And if you want you can make several batches at a time and freeze
6. They keep well and to me taste after a while in the freezer
7. Take out as many as needed and thaw and put sugar on or eat plain

title: raspberry and cream salad
steps:
1. Pour the raspberry gelatin into a mixing bowl and combine with boiling water until gelatin is melted
2. Add the raspberry pie filling
3. Pour into a glass 9x13" pan and place in the refrigerator until set
4. With a mixer , combine the cream cheese , sugar and whipped topping until smooth and thoroughly mixed
5. Spread over the set gelatin mixture
6. Combine the melted margarine , pretzels , walnuts and sugar until well mixed
7. Sprinkle the topping over the cream cheese layer
8. Keep refrigerated until ready to serve

title: blue chimney smoke
steps:
1. Place ice in a large wineglass
2. Add the tequila and orange juice and stir
3. Float the syrup on top

title: mulled apple cider
steps:
1. Tie small spices in a small cheesecloth and drop into the cider
2. Allow cinnamon to just go on its own
3. Heat mixture on the stove and simmer for at least 30 minutes before serving , stirring occasionally to agitate the spices
4. Float orange slices on top of the cider
5. Pour into mugs and serve , with a cinnamon stick , if desired
6. Makes 1 gallon

title: tuna canape spread
steps:
1. Drain tuna
2. Combine tuna , celery and onion
3. Blend together mayonnaise , lemon juice ,
4. And worcestershire sauce
5. Add to tuna mixture
6. Toss lightly
7. Yield: 16 canapes
8. I just made this because of the concern that it was too "liquidy" according to the reviewer , and it was perfect
9. I just added "drain well" , because my only conclusion is that she didn't drain it
10. I just used water packed , and i think the "oil" probably gives it a bit more flavor
11. I would also suggest letting it set for a few hours so the flavors meld

title: sweet   sour spam
steps:
1. Spray wok or large pan with pam-type spray
2. Add cut up spam and saute until browned , remove and set aside
3. Cut up pineapple and set aside
4. Spray again and saute veggies until mushrooms have released their liquid
5. Mix rest of ingredients into the cold water , add to pan
6. Stir until mixture has thickened , add pineapple and spam , heat until warmed through
7. Serve over rice

title: how to make french fries
steps:
1. Heat oil in large skillet on medium-high heat
2. Scrub potatoes
3. Peel them if you like
4. Stand each potato on end , and slice in half
5. Slice each half in half again
6. Lay the quarters on top of each other , and cut into thin strips
7. If you can't get the quarters to lay together , just slice each one individually
8. No biggie
9. Check to see if your oil is hot enough by dipping the end of one fry in it
10. If the oil bubbles up and makes noise , the oil is ready
11. Put about a quarter of the fries in at a time
12. Cook until they turn the color that you like
13. Some people like soft fries , other crispy
14. Go with what looks good to you
15. While the fries are cooking , get a plate and place about four paper towels on it
16. When the fries are done , put them on the paper towels to drain
17. Put the skillet back on the heat , and let it heat back up
18. Put the next batch of fries in the oil
19. Salt the finished batch of fries
20. Add more paper towels on top of the fries
21. Eat and enjoy !

title: chocolate chip cookie   amaretto dessert
steps:
1. In a 9x13x2 glass dish , put a thin layer of cool whip
2. Pour 1 cup milk into a tall 2 cup measuring cup and add 1 / 4 cup ameratto , stir to mix
3. Dip cookies quickly into milk / ameratto mix , do not soak , just dip quickly or cookies will crumble
4. Layer cookies over the thin layer of cool whip , top cookies with more cool whip
5. Make two or three layers ending with cool whip
6. Leave as is or sprinkle with shaved chocolate
7. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for several hours or overnight
8. It is better if you can refrigerate overnight
9. Chip ahoy choc
10. Chip cookies are what i use
11. Do not use a soft cookie
12. 6 hours prep
13. Time is for chilling

title: pappardelle with artichokes and sun dried tomatoes
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large pan
2. Add onions and saute for 5 minutes
3. Add garlic and saute 2 minutes
4. Add tomatoes , artichokes and cayenne
5. De glaze pan with wine and reduce by 1 / 2
6. Sprinkle flour over onion mixture and stir to blend well
7. Pour in stock and bring to a boil and cook 5 minutes
8. Toss pasta into pan mix all ingredients together
9. Add pasta water if needed
10. Plate and top with pine nuts , cheese and parsley

title: hippie rice pilaf
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a pan over a medium-high flame
2. Add the rice and pasta , stirring constantly
3. Cook until both are slightly browned
4. Add the garlic and cook for a minute longer
5. Add the water and bring to a boil
6. Cover and reduce the heat to medium low
7. Cook for 15 minutes or until the water is abosorbed and the rice is tender
8. Stir in fresh herbs and salt and pepper to taste

title: alberta flank steak
steps:
1. Combine soya sauce , wine , oil and ginger or garlic in a shallow bowl
2. Score meat with shallow cuts , criss-cross-style at 2-inch intervals and add to marinade , turning to coat meat
3. Cover and refrigerate for at least four hours but preferably overnight , turning occasionally
4. Remove meat from bowl , reserving marinade
5. Barbecue over medium-hot coals or at medium-high setting , brushing occasionally with marinade , 4 to 6 minutes per side , or until cooked to desired doneness
6. Remove from barbecue and let stand for 5 minutes , then cut diagonally across the grain , in extra-thin slices
7. Wrap well and chill

title: granddad s corn pone
steps:
1. Mix together butter or margarine with eggs , salt , sugar , and baking powder with a spoon till well blended
2. Add in corn meal , flour , and milk with a spoon till mixture is completely mixed up
3. This will be a thick batter
4. Grease and flour a 9" x 13" cake pan
5. Pour batter into greased pan and bake for 20 to 25 minutes at 400f till a knife inserted in center comes out clean
6. Tastes great with butter or we always liked it with our favorite jelly or jam

title: polenta casserole with sauteed bell peppers and sausage
steps:
1. Heat the oven to 400 degrees
2. Slice the polenta in half-inch slices and cover the bottom of a 9-by-13-inch casserole dish
3. Press together to make one layer
4. Heat the oil in a 12-inch skillet over medium-high heat
5. Add peppers , onion and 1 / 2 teaspoon salt
6. Cook until peppers are soft , about 5 minutes
7. Add sausage and cook until the meat loses its raw color , about 5 minutes
8. Add garlic , thyme and red pepper flakes , cook about 1 minute
9. Add tomatoes and juice
