10. Bring to a simmer and cook , stirring occasionally , about 5 minutes
11. Take off heat and stir in the vinegar
12. Season with salt and pepper to taste
13. Spread sausage mixture evenly over the polenta and sprinkle with cheese
14. Bake in middle rack of oven until the polenta is heated through , about 20 minutes
15. Cool 10 minutes
16. Sprinkle with parsley before serving
17. Serves 6 to 8

title: chewy molasses cookies
steps:
1. In a medium bowl
2. Whisk flour , baking soda , salt , cinnamon , cloves and ginger
3. In a large mixing bowl , whisk egg white , 1 cup sugar , fruit puree , oil and molasses
4. Add dry ingredients and stir gently until combined
5. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until firm at least 2 hours or overnight
6. Preheat over to 375f
7. Coat 2 baking sheets with nonstick spray or line them with parchment paper
8. Place remaining 1 / 4 cup sugar in a shallow dish
9. Scoop out dough by the scant tablespoonful and , with lightly oiled hands , roll into 1-inch balls
10. Roll balls in sugar and place 2-inches apart on prepared baking sheets
11. Bake cookies , 1 sheet at a time , for 10-15 minutes or until golden on the bottom
12. Transfer to a wire rack to cool
13. Fruit puree fat replacement: cut fruit into eighths
14. Place in a heavy medium saucepan
15. Add water , lemon juice and lecithin and bring to a simmer
16. Reduce heat to low
17. Cover and simmer , stirring and mashing fruit occasionally , until mushy , 35-45 minutes
18. Let cool slightly
19. Press through a fine sieve into a bowl
20. Let cool completely
21. Makes about 1 3 / 4 cups

title: orange butter  2
steps:
1. Beat butter until fluffy
2. Gradually add orange juice
3. Blending well
4. Stir in orange peel
5. Chill

title: easy tamale pie
steps:
1. Cook ground beef and onion with garlic powder until meat is brown and onion is tender
2. Stir in tomato sauce , milk , egg , corn , cornmeal , chili powder , and salt
3. Spoon into an 8x8 square baking dish
4. Bake at 350f for 40-45 minutes
5. Knife inserted in the middle will come out clean
6. Cut in squares and serve immediately

title: better then bush s  baked beans
steps:
1. In a very large sauce pan cover the beans and bouillon cubes in 3 inches of water
2. Bring to a boil , cover , and let sit for 1 1 / 2 hours
3. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
4. Drain and pour beans into a 9'x11' pan
5. Add the rest over the ingredients , stir , and bake until all the water has evaporated , about 3 hours
6. Remove from oven , cover , and let sit overnight
7. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
8. Add the next 5 cups of water , and bake until all the water has evaporated , about 3 hours
9. Serving suggestions: challah bread , steak , hamburgers

title: never fail dumplings
steps:
1. Combine all dry ingredient together
2. Cut in shortening
3. Add milk and mix
4. Drop by spoonfuls into simmering soup or stew
5. Cook 10 minutes uncovered , and 10 minutes covered
6. Do not take the lid off until the 10 minutes are up

title: peanut butter chocolate pudding
steps:
1. In a small bowl , mix 2 tbsp milk with the peanut butter until smooth
2. Fold in 3 / 4 cup whipped topping
3. Set aside
4. In another mixing bowl , beat pudding mix with the remaining milk until blended
5. Let stand for 5 minutes
6. Spoon half of the pudding into six parfait glasses or bowls
7. Evenly divide and top the chocolate pudding mixture with peanut butter mixture , and then with the remaining pudding
8. Garnish top with remaining whipped topping

title: mexican beef tortilla casserole
steps:
1. Melt butter in a medium saucepan
2. Add 3 tbsp of flour and stir over medium
3. Heat for 1 minute
4. Do not brown
5. Add chicken broth and milk
6. With a wire
7. Whisk , stir mixture until it comes to a boil and add salt , garlic powder and
8. Pepper
9. Continue to cook one minute more
10. Add the tomato sauce , sugar ,
11. Chili powder , paprika , oregano , ground cumin and cayenne
12. Stir well with a
13. Wire whisk
14. Cook 2 minutes longer and remove from heat
15. Brown beef , mushrooms and onion in a large skillet
16. Drain liquid , then add
17. Sauce and mix well
18. Spray a baking dish , 8 or 9 inch round or square would
19. Work
20. Cut each tortilla into 6 pieces and layer half of the tortilla pieces
21. In the bottom of the tins
22. Layer half of the meat mixture and half of the
23. Cheese
24. Repeat layers
25. Let cool , cover with heavy duty aluminum foil and
26. Store in freezer , or continue to baking instructions
27. Bake , covered , in a 375 degree oven
28. Approximately 45 minutes
29. You can easily add ingredients of your liking to alter the recipe , such as sliced black olives or some diced green chili

title: aussie bushman s brekkie   breakfast for two
steps:
1. Trim chops of excess fat , pierce sausages with a fork
2. Place chops and sausages on oiled grill tray , cook under high heat for 2 minutes , turn , cook 2 minutes , continue cooking chops and sausages until they are done to your liking
3. In a pan , fry bacon until crisp , remove , keep warm
4. Add mushrooms , cook until browned , remove and keep warm
5. Then place tomato , cut side down on grill tray , cook for 2 minutes , turn , sprinkle with cheese on top , cook until tender
6. About 3 minutes before serving , heat oil in frying pan , cook eggs over low heat , serve with cooked meat , tomato , bacon and mushrooms
7. Serve with toast if you wish & hot , strong tea !

title: venison bites
steps:
1. Cut roast into 1 / 2 inch cubes , soak in milk for 2 hours in refridgerator
2. Drain from milk
3. Combine remaining ingrds in large zip lock bag , add venison and toss lightly to coat
4. Fry in a kettle or fryer for 5 mins or until med golden brown
5. Drain and serve before cooled

title: bob evans sausage cups
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Crumble sausage in medium sized skillet
3. Cook over medium heat until lightly browned , stirring occasionally
4. Drain
5. Spray mini muffin tins and insert wonton wrappers to form a small cup
6. Bake 5 minutes in preheated oven
7. Allow wrappers to cool
8. Mix sauasage , cheeses , and ranch together
9. Fill wonton wrappers
10. Bake 10 minutes until bubbly

title: shrimp alfredo
steps:
1. In a meduim saucepan prepare alfredo sauce mix according to directions
2. Add all other ingredients except for rice , and simmer for 7 minutes
3. Serve over rice

title: creamy low fat coconut rice pudding
steps:
1. Combine sugar , cornstarch , salt , coconut and milk in saucepan
2. Cook over medium heat , stirring constantly , until thick and bubbly , 7-8 minutes
3. Temper eggs by whisking a little of the hot milk into them before adding to the hot milk mixture
4. Whisk egg mixture into milk mixture
5. Add rice , vanilla , coconut extract and nutmeg
6. Stir gently and spoon into dessert dishes , eat hot or chill

title: meow mix
steps:
1. Melt chocolate and butterscotch chips together with butter over low heat , stirring until blended
2. Pour over cheerios and mix until evenly coated
3. Pour powdered sugar into large paper grocery bag
4. Pour in the coated cheerios
5. Close bag tightly and shake well

title: giant cauliflower cheese puff
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
2. Lightly spray a 9 by 13 inch pan with nonstick spray , then add the butter
3. Place the pan in the preheated oven for a minute or so to melt the butter , then take it out and carefully tilt it in all directions to let the butter coat the bottom
4. Set aside
5. Place a 10 inch skillet over medium heat and wait a few minutes
6. Add the olive oil , wait about 10 seconds , then swirl to coat the pan
7. Add the onions , saute` for 5 minutes , then stir in the salt and the cauliflower
8. Saute` over medium heat for 8 to 10 minutes , or until the cauliflower is just tender
9. Transfer this mixture to the prepared pan
10. While the cauliflower is cooking , combine the eggs , milk , flour , and cheese in a blender
11. Whip into a smooth batter and pour it over the cauliflower mixture in the pan
12. Bake in the center of the oven for 35 to 40 minutes , or until puffed and golden
13. Serve hot or warm , cut into squares

title: huevos serranos mountain eggs
steps:
1. Discard seeds from tomatoes
2. Chop ham
3. Divide evenly in tomatoes
4. Broil 5 minutes
5. Add poached egg and shredded cheese
6. Sprinkle with paprika
7. Broil until cheese melts

title: zucchini courgette  onion saute
steps:
1. Heat olive oil in heavy skillet
2. Add garlic and saute until starting to brown
3. Add in zucchini and onions and turn frequently until browned thoroughly
4. Serve as is or season to taste with salt an pepper

title: potato fried tilapia
steps:
1. In a shallow dish , whisk together the egg , mustard , and salt and garlic powder
2. Set aside
3. (i place in fridge for 15 minutes to blend flavors
4. Place the flour and potato flakes in 2 other shallow dishes
5. Heat oil in a large heavy skillet over medium-high heat
6. Dredge fillets in flour
7. Shake off excess
8. Dip fish fillets in the egg mixture
9. Dredge the fillets in the potato flakes , completely coating the fish
10. For extra crispy , dip into egg and potato flakes again
11. Fry fish fillets in oil for 2 to 3 minutes on each side , or until golden brown

title: mom s salami and iceberg lettuce lunch salad
steps:
1. Gently toss lettuce , tomatoes , salami and cucuber in a bowl
2. Put into 4 salad bowls and add dressing , to taste and sprinkle with oregano , to taste
3. Add hard boiled egg slices if you like

title: blueberries n cream cheesecake
steps:
1. Combine cookie crumbs and butter
2. Press into bottom and 1" up the sides of a lightly greased 9 springform pan
3. Bake at 325 for 12 minute cool on wire rack
4. Process 2 cups blueberries and 1 t
5. Cornstarch in container of electric blender until smooth - can also use a food processor
6. Cook blueberry puree in saucepan over med-high heat 8 minutes or until slightly thickened , stirring constantly
7. Set mixture aside to cook
8. Reserve cup puree for glaze
9. Beat cream cheese at med
10. Speed with an electric mixer until light and fluffy
11. Gradually add 1 cup sugar , beating well
12. Add eggs , 1 at a time , beating after each addition
13. Stir in 2 t
14. Cornstarch and salt
15. Pour batter into prepared crust
16. Pour blueberry puree over cheesecake batter
17. Gently swirl with a knife
18. Bake at 325 for 1 hour and 5 minutes or until almost set in center
19. Remove from oven , and cool in a wire rack 20 minutes
20. Combine sour cream , 2 t
21. Sugar and vanilla in small bowl
22. Stir well
23. Spread sour cream mixture over cheesecake
24. Bake at 325 for 10 more minutes
25. Cool completely on wire rack , cover and chill 8 hours
26. Combine reserved cup blueberry puree , cup sugar and water in a small saucepan
27. Cook over med
28. Heat , stirring constantly , 8 minutes or until thickened
29. Gently fold remaining 1 cup blueberries
30. Remove from heat and cool
31. Remove sides of pan before serving
32. Spoon blueberry glaze over cheesecake , allowing it to drip down sides
33. Garnish with fresh blueberries or strawberries , if desired
34. Makes 1 nine inch cheesecake

title: vegetable medley casserole
steps:
1. Preheat your oven to 350f degrees
2. Fill a large saucepan with one to two inches of water , and add your potatoes , carrots , cauliflowerets , and green beans
3. Bring to a boil over high heat , reduce to simmer , cover and cook for approximately 10 minutes
4. Remove from heat and drain in colander
5. If you wish to save the juices for another use , make sure to drain the veggies over a dish to catch the juices
6. Thats what i do !
7. Heat oil in large skillet over medium high heat and add your onions and garlic
8. Stir and saute them until they are soft , approximately 3-5 minutes
9. Add your tomatoes , salt and pepper , and thyme , and stir , reduce heat to simmer , and cover and cook for 5 minutes to allow flavors to develop
10. Remove from heat and keep covered
11. Set aside
12. Spread potato mixture over bottom of greased medium casserole or baking pan , add salt and pepper to taste , and then sread half of your tomato mixture over the potato layer
13. Continue by layering your zucchini slices and chopped green pepper on top of the tomato mixture , and then pour the remaining tomato mixture on top of the zucchini-green pepper layer
14. Bake in oven , covered , for approximately 50 to 60 minutes until all of your veggies are tender
15. Enjoy !

title: elegant lemon bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit
2. Grease a loaf pan
3. Stir together the 1 1 / 2 cups of flour with the 1 / 2 cup sugar
4. Cut or"pull" butter into the bowl with a fork
5. Blend with hands until mixture is soft and resembles coarse crumbs
6. Press half of the mixture into the bottom of the pan
7. If the dough does not completely spread , add more of the dough into the holes and press in
8. Bake for ten minutes
9. In a smaller bowl , mix the two eggs with the cup of sugar
10. Add the three tablespoons of flour , the 1 / 2 teaspoon baking powder , and blend well
11. Mix in the lemon juice
12. When it is lightly brown , remove the bottom of the bars from the oven , and pour the lemon mixture immediately into it
13. Sprinkle the remaining dough atop the lemon gently
14. Carefully place in the oven and bake for 15 minutes
15. Remove the bars from the oven and spread dough on top around gently
16. Replace in the oven for five to seven minutes and remove when bars are golden brown
17. Let cool for five minutes , and then remove bars from the pan
18. Refrigerate for at least an hour
19. If desired , reheat in the microwave for two minutes after cutting into one-inch squares

title: spicy sizzle red lentil soup
steps:
1. Heat 2 teaspoons oil in a soup pot or dutch oven over medium heat
2. Add onion and cook , stirring , until softened , 3 to 5 minutes
3. Add garlic and cumin
4. Cook for 1 minute
5. Add broth , lentils , bulgur , tomato paste and bay leaf
6. Bring to a simmer , stirring occasionally
7. Cover and cook over low heat until the lentils and bulgur are very tender , 25 to 30 minutes
8. Discard the bay leaf
9. Ladle about 4 cups of the soup into a food processor and puree
10. Return the pureed soup to the soup pot and heat through
11. Stir in lemon juice and season with pepper
12. Just before serving , ladle the soup into bowls
13. Heat the remaining 4 teaspoons olive oil in a small skillet and stir in the paprika and cayenne
14. Drizzle about 1 / 2 teaspoon of the sizzling spice mixture over each bowlful and serve immediately
15. Make ahead
16. Cover and refrigerate for up to 2 days or freeze for up to 2 months

title: victory s deli  pickle wraps
steps:
1. Drain pickles and pat dry
2. Arrange deli lunch meat on dry large cutting board
3. Spread room temp cream cheese on meat
4. Put pickle on meat and cheese wrap up and cut in half
5. Place pickle wraps in refrigerator in air tight container 2 hours before serving

title: mushroom   swiss cheese quiche
steps:
1. For pastry: sift together the flour and salt
2. Using a pastry blender , cut the shortening in until mixture resembles cornmeal
3. Slowly sprinkle ice water over the top , while tossing the mixture up from the bottom of the bowl with a fork
4. Gather the dough into a ball , using only enough water to hold the ball together
5. Wrap ball in waxed paper and refrigerate for 20 minutes
6. Remove from fridge and roll out into a circle which is 2 inches larger than the diameter of the pie pan being used
7. Put dough into pan
8. Place a piece of aluminum foil on the bottom and up the sides of the pie pan
9. Fill with dry beans
10. Bake in preheated 450f degree oven , on lowest rack , for 12 minutes
11. Take from oven and remove beans and foil
12. Meanwhile , prepare filling: melt butter , add onions and cook for 1 minute
13. Stir in mushrooms , 1 tsp salt and lemon juice
14. Cook , stirring occasionally , until mushrooms are done and all the liquid has evaporated
15. Continue frying the mushrooms in the butter for about 1 minute
16. In a large bowl , beat the eggs and cream together
17. Add the remaining salt , pepper and nutmeg
18. Stir in the mushrooms
19. Pour into prepared pastry shell , sprinkle with swiss cheese and dot with softened butter
20. Bake in preheated 350f degree oven for 35 minutes or until quiche is puffy and browned , and a knife inserted into center comes out clean
21. Let sit for 10 minutes before serving

title: red curry chicken skewers
steps:
1. Thread chicken onto 8 skewers
2. Whisk curry paste , coconut milk and juice in a large shallow dish
3. Add skewers , turning to coat
4. Cover with plastic food wrap
5. Chill for 1 hour
6. Heat a large frying pan over moderately high heat
7. Drain skewers , reserving marinade
8. Spray skewers with oil
9. Cook and turn skewers for 2-3 minutes or until browned lightly
10. Add reserved marinade
11. Bring to the boil
12. Reduce heat to low
13. Simmer , uncovered , for 10-12 minutes or ntil chicken is cooked through
14. Serve skewers drizzled with a little of the sauce from the pan

title: peanutty apple trifle dessert
steps:
1. In bowl , combine cracker crumbs , brown sugar , 1 / 2 cup peanut butter and butter and spoon 1 / 2 of mixture into 3 qt bowl
2. In a mixing bowl , beat cream cheese and sugar until smoothed and fold in the whipped topping
3. Spread 1 / 2 of this mixture into the trifle bowl or deep dish bowl
4. Top w / one can apple pie filling
5. Then combine powdered sugar , cinnamon and the remaining peanut butter until crumbly and sprinkle half over pie filling
6. Repeat the layers and refrigerate until serving

title: asian flavored grilled salmon
steps:
1. In small saucepan , melt butter and brown sugar
2. Whisk in dijon mustard , olive oil , grated gin and soy sauce
3. Construct a "tray" for salmon fillets out of aluminum foil
4. Place fillets on aluminum foil , and pour sauce over salmon
5. Place on grill and cook for approximately 20 minutes

title: cucumber cocktail
steps: 1. Mix in blender until smooth

title: crisco buttercream
steps:
1. Add all ingredients except powdered sugar to mixer
2. Mix until combined scraping sides to make sure mixture is fully mixed
3. Add the sugar gradually until all sugar is in mixer
4. Once icing starts to come together run the mixture until desired consistancy is reached
5. There really is no time limit

title: ultimate blue frozen margarita
steps:
1. Put ice in the blender
2. Then put the remaining ingredients , in the order listed , over the ice
3. Blend on high for a few seconds
4. Pour into margarita glasses
5. Serve immediately

title: pumpkin pecan bread
steps:
1. Cream butter , granulated sugar and brown sugar in large mixer bowl until light
2. Add eggs , one at a time , beating well after each addition
3. Beat in pumpkin
4. Combine flour , pumpkin pie spice , baking powder , baking soda , salt and pecans in small bowl
5. Add to pumpkin mixture
6. Mix just until blended
7. Spoon into 2 greased and floured 8 1 / 2x4 1 / 2-inch loaf pans
8. Bake in preheated 350f oven for 1 hour 10 minutes , or until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean
9. Cool for 10 minutes
10. Remove from pans
11. Cool on wire racks

title: president roosevelt s birthday cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Grease and dust an 8 x 8 cakepan with cocoa
3. Cream butter and add sugar a little at a time
4. Cream well
5. Add eggs
6. Sift flour , salt , soda and cocoa together 3 times
7. Add coffee to batter alternatively with flour mixture
8. Then add vinegar and vanilla
9. Bake at 350 degrees about 30 to 40 minutes

title: north croatian fried chicken crepes
steps:
1. For the stuffing: saut finely minced onion until translucent
2. Cut chicken meat to small pieces and saut with onion until white and done
3. Cut pickled cucumbers into small pieces and add into chicken
4. Add salt , pepper , nutmeg and saut for 2-5 minutes
5. Cool it and add sour cream (if you think stuffing is too liquid you can add some breadcrumbs in it , but be careful not too much
6. Make crepes , approximately 6-8 pieces
7. Put stuffing on each crepe and fold it like cigar
8. Close the ends folding ends of cigar with finger
9. Whisk eggs like you make omelet
10. Put each cigar crepe first into flour , than eggs , and than breadcrumbs
11. Fry them in deep oil until golden on each side
12. Serve with tartar sauce and lettuce salad

title: cumin dry rub salmon
steps:
1. Combine dry ingredients and rub evenly over both sides of salmon
2. Place salmon on grill rack coated with cooking spray
3. Grill 4 minutes on each side , or until fish flakes when tested

title: shred s margarita on the rocks
steps:
1. Combine tequila , juices , agave nectar , and grand marnier in a shaker with ice
2. Sprinkle kosher salt onto a small plate
3. Wet edge of cocktail glass with lime wedge and press glass into salt
4. Drop a pinch of salt into the bottom of the glass , add ice and pour contents of shaker into the glass
5. Garnish with lime wedge

title: fusilli with creamy tomato  garlic  and meat sauce  or rotini
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , over medium heat , cook beef , red pepper flakes , and onion until the meat is browned and onions soften
2. Add garlic and mushrooms , and cook , stirring frequently , until mushrooms soften
3. Drain off fat
4. Stir in undrained tomatoes , cheese , italian seasoning , sugar , salt , and pepper
5. Bring to a boil
6. Reduce heat to low , and simmer , uncovered , stirring occasionally , until most of the liquid has evaporated
7. Cook pasta according to package directions
8. Drain and keep warm
9. Gradually stir the whipping cream into the sauce
10. Arrange the pasta on plates or on a serving platter
11. Spoon sauce over pasta
12. If desired , garnish with rosemary

title: lemon pepper ahi tuna
steps:
1. Sprinkle salt and black pepper on both sides of the tuna steaks
2. Squeeze fresh lemon juice over the steaks
3. Heat 1 tbs of oil in a pan
4. Add 1 tbs of butter
5. Turn the heat down low to medium-low
6. Place the tuna in the pan
7. Add capers , and squeeze more lemon juice into the pan
8. Add slices of lemon to the pan and 2nd tbs of butter
9. Shake the contents of the pan a bit and let cook for about 4 minutes
10. Turn the steaks over and cook for another 5 minutes
11. Serve the tuna with the slices of lemon and capers from the pan
12. It's your personal preference how well done you like the steaks
13. Thanks for all the wonderful reviews !

title: season s berry delicious
steps: 1. Using the whisk attachment on either your stand mixer or hand mixer mix eggs and sugar until frothy texture , pour over berries and enjoy

title: peppered steak in sherry cream sauce
steps:
1. Slice the meat into thin strips , discarding any fat or gristle
2. Sprinkle the meat with pepper and spice seasoning and set aside to marinate in a cool place for 30 minutes
3. Melt the butter in a large frying pan and saut the meat for 4-5 minutes until browned on all sides
4. Remove to a plate and set aside
5. Add the shallots and garlic to the pan , fry gently for a few minutes , then add the sherry and water and simmer for 5 minutes
6. Stir in the cream
7. Reduce heat and adjust the seasoning
8. Stir in the meat and heat until hot but not boiling
9. Serve with plantain and garnish with chives

title: cilantro coconut rice
steps:
1. Put oven rack in middle position and preheat oven to 350f
2. Wash rice in several changes of cold water in a bowl until water is almost clear
3. Soak rice in cold water 30 minutes , then drain well in a sieve
4. Spread coconut in a shallow baking pan and toast in oven , stirring occasionally , until pale golden , 10 to 12 minutes
5. Cool completely
6. Cook ginger and jalapeo in 1 tablespoon oil in a 4-quart heavy pot over moderate heat , stirring , until chile is softened , about 2 minutes
7. Add rice and cook , stirring , until fragrant , about 2 minutes
8. Stir in water and 1 / 2 teaspoon salt and bring to a boil , covered
9. Reduce heat to low and cook , covered , until rice is tender and water is absorbed , 12 to 15 minutes
10. Remove from heat and let stand , covered , 5 minutes
11. Fluff rice with a fork and transfer to a large bowl
12. While rice cooks , pulse together coconut , cilantro , scallions , and remaining 2 tablespoons oil and 1 / 2 teaspoon salt in a food processor until finely chopped
13. Add cilantro mixture to cooked rice and stir gently until combined well

title: applets and cotlets  old fashioned candy  like persian delights
steps:
1. Mix gelatin with 1 / 2 cup applesauce and let stand for 10 minutes
2. Put sugar and remaining applesauce in a saucepan
3. Bring to a boil
4. Stir in gelatin-applesauce mixture and cook over low heat for 15 minutes , stirring frequently
5. Add walnuts and vanilla
6. Mix well
7. Pour into greased 8 inch x 8 inch pan
8. Let stand overnight
9. Cut in squares and toss the squares in a paper bag of powdered sugar
10. From:

title: roasted idaho and sweet potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees
2. In large plastic bag or bowl , combine all ingredients
3. Close bag and shake , or toss in bowl , until potatoes are evenly coated
4. In a 13 x 9 inch baking or roasting pan , arrange potatoes in one layer , discard bag
5. Bake uncovered , stirring occasionally , 40 minutes or until potatoes are tender and golden

title: bell peppers ole
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f
2. In medium bowl , combine all the filling ingredients
3. Spoon heaping 1 / 2 cup of filling into each pepper half
4. Place the filled peppers into a ungreased 13x 9-inch baking dish
5. Cover with foil and bake at 350f for 50-60 minutes or until peppers are tender
6. Garnish with 1 tablespoon of salsa and a tortilla chip

title: chunky apple cake
steps:
1. In large mixing bowl combine sugar , oil , eggs , and vanilla
2. Mix with an electric mixer until well combiined
3. In seperate bowl wisk together flour , soda , salt , cinnamon and nutmeg
4. Add dry ingredients to liquid mixing with an electric mixer--batter will be thick
5. Fold in walnuts , raisins and apples until all is incorporated
6. Pile batter into a well greased and floured 12 cup bundt pan or well greased and floured 9 x 13 x 2 pan
7. Bake for one hour at 350 or until cake tester comes almost clean
8. If using bundt pan let cake cool in pan for 20 minutes and turn onto to rack to continue cooling
9. If using 9 x 13 x 2 pan cool in pan and cut cooled cake into squares and serve directly from pan

title: lemon cilantro eggplant dip
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees f
2. Line a 15 1 / 2" by 10 1 / 2" jelly-roll pan with nonstick foil
3. Place eggplant halves , skin-sides up , in foil-lined pan
4. Wrap garlic in foil and place in pan with eggplants
5. Roast vegetables 45 to 50 minutes or until eggplants are very tender and skin is shriveled and browned
6. Unwrap garlic
7. Cool eggplants and garlic until easy to handle
8. When cool , scoop eggplants' flesh into food processor with knife blade attached
9. Squeeze out garlic pulp from each clove and add to food processor with tahini , lemon juice , and 3 / 4 teaspoon salt
10. Pulse to coarsely chop
11. Spoon dip into serving bowl
12. Stir in cilantro
13. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours
14. Serve dip with pita and vegetables

title: breakfast egg bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Spray a 9- by 12-inch casserole dish with non-stick spray
3. Saute the mushrooms and onions in margarine
4. Set aside
5. Mix the soup with water
6. Set aside
7. Pour half of egg substitute in bottom of dish
8. Layer onion and mushrooms , soup and canadian bacon
9. Pour remaining egg substitute over all
10. Top with cheese
11. Bake until cheese is melted and the dish is hot and set all of the way through
12. About 30 minutes

title: the alkalizer detoxing vegetable juice
steps:
1. Wash vegetables and parsley very well and shake to dry
2. Slice cucumber portion in half lengthwise so it will fit easily into the juicer's feeder
3. Juice cucumber and carrot
4. Juice parsley , and then finish with celery
5. Squeeze lime into juice , stir gently and enjoy

title: sweet chicken bacon wraps  paula deen
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Cut chicken breasts into 1-inch cubes
3. Cut each bacon slice into thirds
4. Wrap each chicken cube with bacon and secure with a wooden pick inserted on the diagonal starting where bacon seam overlaps
5. Stir together brown sugar and chili powder
6. Dredge wrapped chicken in mixture
7. Coat a rack and broiler pan with non-stick cooking spray
8. Place chicken on rack in broiler pan
9. Bake at 350f for 30 to 35 minutes , or until bacon is crisp

title: fancy sos
steps:
1. Add beef , sausage , mushroom and onions to fry pan and cook until brown
2. Add the rest of the ingredients and simmer for 10 minutes
3. Add salt and pepper to taste
4. Serve over toast or whatever you like
5. Sit by a fire and enjoy !

title: no bake cookies made with chocolate chips
steps:
1. Put oatmeal , optional peanut butter , chocolate chips and vanilla in a mixing bowl
2. Combine butter , milk and sugar in a saucepan and heat over medium high until boiling
3. Let boil for 1 minute
4. Pour hot mix into the oatmeal mix and stir well
5. Drop spoonfuls onto wax paper and let harden before eating
6. Freeze to harden faster

title: lauren s spanish rice
steps:
1. Saute rice , onion , bell pepper and garlic in olive oil and butter , stirring until onions are translucent
2. Add remaining ingredient and bring to a gentle boil
3. Cover and simmer 30-35 minutes , or until rice is tender
4. Don't remove lid until suggested cooking time is over

title: root beer glazed pork chops
steps:
1. To make the glaze , combine the root beer and stock in a medium heavy saucepan
2. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat
3. Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer until reduced to a thick syrup , about 1 cup , about 50 minutes to 1 hour
4. Remove from the heat
5. Preheat a grill to medium-high
6. Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f
7. Season each chop on both sides with 1 teaspoon of the essence
8. Grill for 3 minutes
9. Turn each chop 1 / 4 turn to make grill marks and cook an additional 2 minutes
10. Turn and cook on the second side for 5 minutes
11. Transfer to a baking sheet
12. Drizzle 1 teaspoon of the olive oil over each chop
13. Roast until cooked through and an instant-read thermometer inserted into the center reaches 150 degrees f , 12 to 15 minutes
14. Place the chops on 4 serving plates and drizzle with the glaze

title: sage rub for roast turkey
steps:
1. Clean turkey , removing giblets
2. Pat dry and put aside
3. Combine the butter , salt , pepper , sage , and paprika
4. Rub the sage mixture over the outside and inside of the turkey
5. Truss turkey as usual
6. Bake turkey at 350f until meat thermometer reads 180f
7. Baste the turkey occasionally with drippings
8. Cover loosely with foil if turkey browns too quickly

title: kabocha curry
steps:
1. To make kabocha puree: preheat oven to 375
2. Halve a kabocha squash and place both sides cut side down in a baking dish
3. Fill the baking dish with water
4. Bake for 40 minutes or until the flesh can be easily pierced with a knife
5. The baking time may need to be adjusted depending on the size of your kabocha
6. Remove the kabocha from the oven and let cool
7. Remove and dispose of seeds using a spoon
8. Scoop out the flesh using a spoon
9. Use an immersion blender or food processor to puree the flesh , adding water until you have a smooth puree
10. To roast butternut squash: preheat oven to 450
11. Remove skin and cut the butternut squash into bite-sized pieces
12. Toss with olive oil , salt and pepper
13. Roast for 15 minutes or until the squash is soft and has just started to caramelize
14. Heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil at a high heat in a heavy bottomed pan
15. Add chicken and cook until sealed
16. Take chicken out of the pan and set aside
17. Reduce heat to medium , add onions and ginger and stir until onion has become translucent
18. Add garlic and stir for 30 seconds more
19. Add chopped tomatoes and kabocha puree to the pan , bring to boil and reduce to a simmer for 10 minutes
20. Add stock , coconut milk , curry and chili powder
21. Bring to a boil and reduce to a simmer for 10 minutes , stirring occasionally
22. Add chicken and roasted butternut squash and simmer for 10 minutes
23. Add cilantro and additional salt and pepper to taste
24. Serve with naan and / or rice

title: sour cream noodle casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Spray 2-quart casserole dish with pam and set aside
3. Brown meat
4. Drain
5. Add tomato sauce and set aside
6. Cook pasta
7. Drain
8. Add cottage cheese , sour cream and green onions to pasta
9. Combine meat mix to pasta mix and pour into casserole
10. Top with cheese
11. Bake 30 minutes
12. Serve and enjoy !

title: kidney bean burgers
steps:
1. Mash up kidney beans
2. Then add spices , carrot and bread crumbs until they form patties
3. Place patties in a baking dish and bake at 350 for 20min

title: granny s red french dressing
steps: 1. Put all the ingredients into a blender and process until smooth

title: mulled raspberry tea
steps:
1. In a 2- or 3-quart saucepan lightly mash raspberries with potato masher or fork
2. Stir in the brewed tea , cranberry-raspberry juice , lemonade , water , and allspice
3. Bring to boiling
4. Reduce heat
5. Simmer , uncovered , for about 10 minutes
6. Strain and discard the fruit pulp and spices
7. Ladle the tea into heat-proof glass mugs or cups
8. Sweeten with sugar or honey , if desired
9. Serve with lemon slices and additional raspberries , if you like
10. Enjoy !
11. Makes 6 servings

title: cream of watermelon soup
steps:
1. Puree watermelon chunks in blender until smooth
2. Add vanilla , sugar , and using an ordinary flatware soup spoon , add 3 dollops of sour cream , blending well
3. Taste and add a little more sugar if needed- if you added too much sour cream , you may need a little more watermelon
4. Chill overnight and serve garnished with a couple of mint leaves atop each bowl

title: butternut squash and yukon gold gratin with gruyere cheese
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f degrees
2. Butter a 9x13 baking dish
3. Melt butter in large skillet over med-high heat- add onions and saute until deeply carmelized- about 20-30 minutes
4. Lay alternating layers of squash and potatoes in pan
5. Layer onions on top
6. Mix 1 / 2 and 1 / 2 and salt and pepper , pour over top
7. Cover tightly with foil and bake 90 minutes
8. Increase oven temp to 400f degrees
9. Mix breadcrumbs , sage and cheese in bowl
10. Sprinkle over gratin
11. Bake uncovered until top is golden brown and crisp , about 30 minutes

title: giardiniera spread
steps:
1. Remove stem from pepperoncini and place all ingredients in a food processor or blender
2. Process till a nice paste
3. Taste to season with salt and pepper
4. Spread on your favorite hero sandwich

title: beetroot dip   beet dip
steps:
1. Discard all the liquid from the beetroot and beets can
2. Place all ingredients in a blender and puree until it's smooth
3. Serve with warm pita bread , turkish bread , white bread or flat bread
4. Enjoy

title: sweet bread with raisins
steps:
1. Soften yeast in 1 / 2 cup warm water
2. Combine milk , 1 / 2 cup butter , and sugar in a large mixing bowl and cool to lukewarm
3. Stir in eggs , vanilla , salt , and the yeast
4. Gradually add flour , beating well after each addition
5. Cover and let rise in a warm place until light and doubled in bulk , about 1-1 1 / 2 hours
6. Beat down and let rise again until doubled , about 45 minutes
7. Turn batter onto a floured board and knead with your hands
8. Drain water from raisins and knead them into the dough
9. If dough is too thin , add a bit more flour
10. Divide batter into 2 well-greased 9x5x3-inch pans
11. Let rise in a warm place until light , about 45 minutes
12. Bake in 350&#61616
13. Oven for 25-30 minutes or until a deep golden brown
14. When done , remove from oven and while still warm , brush with melted butter
15. Bread should be very light and sweet

title: glaze for salmon
steps:
1. Saute onions in butter
2. Add rest of items and simmer for 15 minutes
3. Brush on top of salmon during barbeque or broiling

title: gingerbread pancakes w  fresh blueberry syrup
steps:
1. Whisk dry ingredients together
2. Whisk egg white in a medium size bowl , then add yolk and milk
3. Add dry ingredients and stir just until combined
4. Pour by 1 / 4 cup measure onto hot griddle coated with cooking spray
5. I served these with fresh blueberry syrup
6. Mash 2 cups frozen blueberries with 2 tbs splenda
7. Add a little lemon juice and maple syrup to desired sweetness and consistency

title: detox carrot  orange and ginger soup
steps:
1. In a medium pot , fry onion , garlic , and ginger in a dash of olive oil until clear
2. Add carrots and sweat for 8-10 minutes
3. Add stock and bring to a boil
4. Simmer until carrots become cooked and tender
5. Add in some orange zest and squeeze in all of the juices
6. Blend in blender until smooth
7. Serve hot or cold
8. Enjoy !
9. For vegan , use vegetable broth !

title: cantaloupe salad  insalata di melone
steps:
1. With a melon baller scoop out 1 inch balls from the melon and place into a medium bowl
2. Toss with remaining ingredients and serve

title: gooseberry tart
steps:
1. Place the gooseberries , sugar and elderflower heads in a saucepan with a little water and simmer until the gooseberries are very soft
2. Remove the elderflower heads , sieve the gooseberries or puree in a processor or blender , allow to cool and then stir in the eggs
3. Fold the cream and honey together and stir into the gooseberry mixture
4. Set the oven to 400f , or mark 6
5. Roll out the pastry on a lightly floured surface and use to line a lightly greased 8 inch flan dish or pie plate , trimming the edges neatly
6. Pour the gooseberry mixture into the case and bake for 30 to 40 minutes or until the filling is golden
7. Place on a wire rack and allow to cool before serving , either on it's own or with pouring cream as an accompaniement

title: shrimp or crab louis
steps:
1. Whisk all dressing ingredients together and season with salt and pepper
2. Prepare four large bowls
3. Divide the shredded lettuce in the bowls
4. Divide and top with seafood , then place egg wedges and tomatoes around the seafood , with a lemon wedge
5. Pass the dressing on the side
6. Delicious !

title: sweet  n spicy black beans
steps:
1. In a saucepan over medium to high heat , combine all ingredients but the thickener
2. When ingredients have simmered for about 5 minutes , sprinkle in the thickener and stir well
3. Remove saucepan from heat and let the sauce thicken
4. Serve and enjoy !
5. Makes 2-4 servings
6. If your store doesn't carry black soy beans you can order them at the eden website
7. They're low in carbs and high in fiber , perfect for diabetic and lowcarb menus , and they taste great , to boot

title: vermont maple pumpkin pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Beat or blend all ingredients thoroughly and pour into unbaked pie shell
3. Bake for 45 minutes or until just firm in the center

title: vietnamese bistro burgers
steps:
1. To make the pickled daikon and carrot , combine the daikon , carrot , vinegar , and sugar in a bowl , tossing well to coat
2. Set aside to marinate
3. Prepare a medium-hot fire in a charcoal grill with a cover , or preheat a gas grill to medium-high
4. If a grill is unavailable , simply heat a grill pan over medium-high heat on your stovetop
5. To make the patties , combine the pork , garlic , diced chiles , ginger , fish sauce , soy sauce , five-spice powder , sugar , and lime zest and juice in a bowl , mixing well to incorporate
6. Divide the mixture into 6 portions and form into round patties
7. Brush the grill rack with vegetable oil
8. Place the patties on the rack and grill for 6 to 7 minutes per side , until cooked through
9. Turn the patties 90 degrees halfway through cooking on each side , to attain grill marks
10. Spread the cut side of each bun half with 1 / 2 tablespoon butter and grill until golden brown , 1 to 2 minutes
11. Spread 1 tablespoon of the mayonnaise on the cut side of each bun bottom and 1 tablespoon of the pate on the cut side of each bun top
12. Place the cucumber and chile slices on the bun bottoms and top with burger patties
13. Drain the carrot and daikon pickles and pile a generous amount atop each patty
14. Add the cilantro sprigs and the pate-smeared bun tops
15. Enjoy !

title: chicken souvlaki wrap
steps:
1. Combine all chicken ingredients in a bag and place in fridge for about 30 minutes at least
2. Remove chicken from bag and grill or broil until done
3. Cut chicken into strips and place on tortilla with lettuce , tomato , feta and spread on sauce
4. Roll up and enjoy !
5. Sauce:
6. Combine all ingredients and place in fridge to let flavors "mellow"

title: delicious baked salmon with creole mustard sauce
steps:
1. In a saucepan , combine all the sauce ingredients
2. Simmer until very thick , stirring frequently , keep warm
3. Arrange the fish fillets in single layer on a a small cookie sheet or a shallow pan , lined with foil
4. Mix 1 / 4 cup melted butter with brown sugar , soy sauce , lemon juice , wine and seasonings in a bowl
5. Pour over the fish
6. Cover with foil , and refrigerate for at least 1 hour
7. Remove from the fridge
8. Set oven to 400 degrees
9. Uncover the fish
10. Bake until just cooked through , basting with pan drippings
11. Meanwhile , rewarm the sauce over low heat , stirring constantly
12. Add in 1 cup sour cream
13. Whisk just until heated through arrange the salmon on the plate
14. Serve with sauce-- delicious !

title: peach melba crisp
steps:
1. Toss the peaches with the lemon juice
2. Combine the peaches with the raspberries , sugar and cornstarch in a large bowl
3. Toss gently and spoon into an 8-inch square baking dish coated with spray
4. Drizzle the jam evenly over the top
5. Combine the flour and sugars in a bowl and cut in the butter until it resembles coarse meal
6. Sprinkle over the top of the jam& fruit
7. Bake at 375f 45 minutes
8. Serve warm or cold
9. Top each serving with a scoop of ice cream

title: warm chocolate chunk pizza cookie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Grease large cookie sheet
3. On waxed paper , combine flour , baking soda , and salt
4. In 3 qt saucepan , melt butter over medium heat
5. Remove saucepan from heat
6. With wire whisk , stir in sugars , vanilla , and egg until mixed
7. With spoon , stir in flour mixture just until blended
8. Stir in chocolate and walnuts
9. Spoon batter onto center of cookie sheet and , with spatula , flatten and spread into 8" round
10. Bake 20-23 minutes , until cookie is golden brown
11. Cool on wire rack 5 minutes , then slice warm cookie into 16 wedges
12. Eat immediately
13. Or cool , wrap in foil
14. To serve warm , reheat in 375 degree oven 5-8 minutes

title: not your mama s zucchini bread
steps:
1. Bread:
2. Preheat oven to 350f
3. Combine flour , salt , baking soda , cinnamon and 1 tablespoon orange zest
4. Than mix in honey , eggs , vanilla and oil
5. Stir in zucchini and walnuts
6. Pour into a greased loaf pan
7. Bake for one hour or till tooth pick comes out clean
8. Let cool 10 minutes in pan before turning out
9. Glaze:
10. In mini mixer beat cream cheese , confection sugar , orange juice and orange zest until well blended and smooth
11. Drizzle glaze over top of slightly warm bread allowing to run down sides
12. Allow to finish cooling before slicing

title: saudi okra stew with meat  bamia
steps:
1. Wash okra and chop off stems
2. Cut onions into fine pieces
3. Saut onions in oil till golden on medium
4. Add garlic and stir for a few seconds
5. Add spices stir for a few seconds add meat cook till water from meat drys on medium heat
6. Stir at intervals
7. Add tomato paste stir for a few seconds add blended tomatoes and water to meat , cook until meat is done
8. Add okra to meat and simmer on medium low for 13 minutes
9. Add the chopped coriander and lemon juice , simmer another 3 minutes
10. Serve hot with basmati white rice

title: tuna patties with three dipping sauces
steps:
1. In a food chopper , processor or blender , process the crackers into crumbs and set aside
2. In a bowl , combine the flaked tuna , onion , bell pepper , cheese , mayonnaise , egg , salt , pepper , giner and dill
3. Add 6 tablespoons of the cracker crumbs and mix very well with a fork , making as smooth as possible
4. The texture should be soft , but firm enough to be able to form into patties
5. If needed , add a bit more of the cracker crumbs
6. Put the remainder of the cracker crumbs in a shallow dish
7. Scoop out a scant 1 / 4 cup of the tuna mixture , roll into a ball , put into the crumbs , press down to flatten the pattie to about 1 / 2 to 3 / 4 inch thick , then turn and dredge the other side with the crumbs
8. Put on a plate and continue until all the tuna mixture is used up
9. If you can , let the tuna patties sit in the fridge for about 1 / 2 hour to set a bit
10. In a large skillet add enough oil to coat the entire bottom with a thin layer
11. When heated , add the patties and cook until well-browned and crispy on one side , then turn to brown and crisp the other side
12. Add more oil if needed as you go along
13. Remove to a plate lined with a paper towel and top with a 2nd paper towel to help drain some of the oil , then serve with your favorite dipping sauce , or even plain
14. They are also good served cold
15. Mustard dill sauce: in a bowl , combine the mustard , lemon juice , dill , sugar , salt and pepper and whisk until smooth
16. Add the oil gradually while whisking until all the oil is incorporated and the sauce is thickened
17. Let this chill in the fridge to blend flavors
18. Honey mustard: combine all the ingredients in a bowl and whisk until smooth and well blended
19. Let chill in the fridge to blend flavors
20. Curried mayonnaise: combine all the ingredients in a bowl and whisk until smooth and well-blended
21. Let chill in the fridge to blend flavors

title: no bake  lemon angel pie
steps:
1. Mix together gingersnap crumbs with butter and blend well
2. Press into a 9 inch glass pie plate
3. Set to the side
4. Combine boiling water with lemon jello and stir for 2 minutes or until completely dissolved
5. In a small bowl , add enough ice and water to the lemon juice to make 1 cup
6. Add to lemon gelatin , stir in lemon peel
7. Stir until lightly thickened
8. Remove any unmelted ice from gelatin
9. Stir in cool whip lightly with a wire whisk
10. Refrigerate 20 minutes or until mixture mounds
11. Spoon into pie crust
12. Refrigerate 4 hours or until set

title: noodle pudding
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Generously grease an 8-inch square pan
3. In a large bowl , combine all the above ingredients together
4. Mix well
5. Spread in the prepared pan
6. Bake for 30 to 45 minutes

title: seven layer magic bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. In 13x9" baking pan , melt butter in oven
3. Sprinkle crumbs over butter
4. Pour sweetened condensed milk over crumbs
5. Top with remaining ingredients in order listed
6. Press down firmly
7. Bake 25 minutes or until lightly browned
8. Cool
9. Chill if desired
10. Cut into bars
11. Store covered at room temperature
12. When bars are baked , cool
13. Lift of edges of foil to remove from pan
14. Cut into individual squares
15. Lift off of foil
16. Keebler / realemon / borden

title: cheesy italian tortellini  crock pot
steps:
1. Brown beef
2. Drain
3. Spray crock pot with cooking spray
4. Mix beef , marinara sauce , mushrooms and tomatoes in crock pot
5. Cook on low 7 - 8 hours
6. Stir in the tortellini and sprinkle with cheese
7. Cover and cook for 15 minutes more
8. Update
9. If frozen for oamc this heats well and does not dry out if you can reheat in freezer bags or sealable bags
10. Excellent

title: elsie s chocolate chip cookies
steps:
1. Cream margarine , sugars , egg and vanilla
2. Combine flour , baking powder and soda
3. Add flour mixture to the wet mixture
4. Stir in the oatmeal , chocolate , coconut
5. Stir in rice krispies last
6. Drop by spoonful onto cookie sheets and bake at 375f for 8-10 minutes

title: apple pie coffee cake
steps:
1. Set aside 1 tblsp
2. Cake mix
3. Set aside 1-1 / 2 cups pie filling
4. In mixing bowl , combine eggs , sour cream , water , oil , extract , remaining cake mix , and remaining pie filling
5. Beat on med
6. Speed for 2 minutes
7. Pour 1 / 2 batter into 10 inch bundt pan , coated with non-stick cooking spray
8. Combine brown sugar , cinnamon , and reserved cake mix
9. Sprinkle over batter
10. Spoon reserved pie filling over batter , to within 3 / 4 of edges
11. Top with remaining batter
12. Bake at 350 degrees for 40-45 minutes , until toothpick inserted near center comes out clesn
13. Cool in pan 10 minutes before removing from pan to wire rack
14. Turn cake upright , on rack
15. In a small bowl , combine glaze ingredients
16. Drizzle over cooled cake , on plate from which it is to be served

title: penne offa da floora
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a frying pan over a medium to high heat
2. Have a large glass of wine to calm the nerves down
3. Add the onion and chili and cook for two minutes
4. Add the chorizo and cook for a further five minutes , or until golden brown all over
5. Add the remaining ingredients to the pan , apart from the pasta
6. Bring to the boil , then reduce the heat and simmer for 15 minutes
7. Season , to taste , with salt and freshly ground black pepper
8. To serve , stir the pasta into the sausage mixture , then drop it on the floora
9. Scrape it together , put it on a clean plate and garnish with fresh basil

title: bitochki
steps:
1. Melt the butter in a large saute pan on medium heat , add onion and saute for 10-15 minutes or until carmelized
2. Remove from heat
3. And save to roll the meatballs into this onion mixture during step 6
4. Preheat oven to 400 degrees and line a rimmed cookie sheet with foil
5. Cut the crusts off the bread and break into 1 / 2 inch pieces
6. Soak the bread in milk
7. Squeeze so it is almost dry
8. And discard milk
9. Mix the beef and bread in a large bowl
10. Add salt , pepper , parsley , tarragon , lemon juice , garlic , and egg
11. Blend well
12. Shape into 1 inch sized balls
13. Roll meatballs in caramelized onion
14. Mix bread crumbs and paprika on a dinner plate
15. Roll the meat balls in the bread crumb mixture
16. Put meatballs onto cookie sheet
17. Bake at 400 degrees for 12 minutes or until browned-check after 6 minutes to see if they need turning
18. While the meatballs are browning , add butter to the saute pan you started with , when almost melted add in next 1 / 4 cup of onion
19. Saute onion until soft
20. Add mushrooms
21. Cook till soft-here you might want to add two tablespoons or more of water to keep things going
22. Add the wine , sour cream , and milk but do not let it boil
23. Stir in pepper and nutmeg
24. Taste test to see how much salt you want to add-i added 1 / 4 teaspoon
25. Add in spinach , if you want a bit of green vegetable
26. Blend thoroughly
27. After meatballs brown , check to see if centers are done , if not remove with slotted spoon to an oven safe casserole dish
28. Reduce oven temperature to 350 degrees and put casserole into oven to finish cooking
29. Top with sauce when cooked
30. Flavor improves with standing
31. Serve with noodles or potatoes

title: pig pickin  cake
steps:
1. Mix cake mix , eggs , oil and oranges
2. Pour into 3 or 4 greased layer cake pans
3. Bake at 350 degrees for 15 minutes , cool on racks
4. Mix pineapple , cool whip and pudding
5. Fill and frost
6. Decorate with coconut and cherries , or not

title: bangor big fat fudge brownies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Cream butter , sugar , and vanilla in mixing bowl , and beat in eggs
3. In another bowl , stir together flour , cocoa , baking powder and salt with a fork , then blend dry ingredients into egg mixture , but do not over-beat
4. Spread batter into an ungreased 8-inch square pan , and bake 40-45 minutes , until brownie begins to pull away from the edges of the pan
5. Cool completely
6. Dust with powdered sugar , and cut into squares

title: tropical crock pot chicken
steps:
1. Place the chicken pieces on the bottom of your slow cooker
2. In a bowl , mix together all remaining ingredients
3. Evenly pour over the chicken
4. Cover and cook on low for 5-8 hours or cook on high for 3-4 hours

title: sweet and fruity butter
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in small bowl
2. Beat at medium speed until smooth
3. Store refrigerated in container with tight fitting lid up to 2 weeks

title: oeufs au xrs et  l  orange   eggs with s
steps:
1. Beat eggs until frothy
2. Blend in sherry and tomato sauce
3. Add seasonings
4. Melt butter in frying pan and pour in the mixture
5. Cook slowly , stirring until eggs begin to set
6. Sprinkle with grated orange rind and serve at once

title: au gratin artichokes
steps:
1. Cut artichoke hearts into thin slices and saute with garlic and onions until tender
2. Arrange artichoke , garlic , and onion mixture in a baking dish , reserving the butter
3. Add the salt , pepper , and butter to the butter
4. Stirring constantly , slowly add the milk until thick
5. Remove from heat
6. Add the egg and white wine and half of the cheese , stirring until smooth
7. Pour over the artichokes and sprinkle with the remaining cheese , bread crumbs , and paprika
8. Bake at 400 degrees for 20 minutes

title: lentil vegetable soup  barefoot contessa
steps:
1. In a large bowl , cover the lentils with boiling water and allow to sit for 15 minutes
2. Drain
3. In a large stockpot on medium heat , saute the onions , leeks , and garlic with the olive oil , salt , pepper , thyme , and cumin for 20 minutes , until the vegetables are translucent and very tender
4. Add the celery and carrots and saute for 10 more minutes
5. Add the chicken stock , tomato paste , and lentils
6. Cover and bring to a boil
7. Reduce the heat and simmer uncovered for 1 hour , until the lentils are cooked through
8. Check the seasonings
9. Add the red wine and serve hot , drizzled with olive oil and sprinkled with grated parmesan

title: hot mustard sauce
steps: 1. Just mix and refrigerate

title: my own mexican rice
steps:
1. Saut green peppers , onion , and garlic in oil in a frying pan or electric skillet with rosemary and basil until vegetables are tender
2. Stir in rice , tomato , salt , pepper and picante to taste- cook and stir for about 5 minutes
3. Add water
4. Cover and cook on low till rice is done , stirring occasionally

title: shrimp   baby greens with walnut raspberry dressing
steps:
1. Make salad dressing ahead of time
2. Mix all ingredients together and blend with a hand blender or put into blender and mix until emulsifed
3. Put into a container with lid or salad dressing bottle
4. In large salad bowl add baby grens , grapes and shrimp
5. Toss with salad dressing and add walnuts
6. Enjoy

title: chapchae  noodles with beef and mixed vegetables
steps:
1. To prepare beef , sprinkle cornstarch over beef
2. Toss to combine
3. Add 1 tablespoon soy sauce and next 4 ingredients
4. Toss well to coat
5. Cover and refrigerate 30 minutes to 1 hour
6. Heat a large nonstick skillet or wok coated with cooking spray over medium-high heat
7. Add beef mixture
8. Stir-fry 3 minutes or until done
9. Remove mixture from pan
10. Cover and keep warm
11. To prepare noodles , pour boiling water over noodles
12. Let stand 10 minutes or until tender
13. Drain and rinse with cold water
14. Drain
15. Snip noodles several times with kitchen shears
16. To prepare vegetables , wipe skillet or wok clean with paper towels
17. Heat 1 teaspoon sesame oil and vegetable oil in pan over medium-high heat
18. Add red pepper and 5 garlic cloves
19. Stir-fry 30 seconds
20. Add mushrooms , onions , and carrot
21. Stir-fry 3 minutes
22. Add half of spinach
23. Stir-fry 2 minutes or until spinach wilts
24. Add remaining spinach
25. Stir-fry 2 minutes or until spinach wilts
26. Reduce heat to medium-low
27. Add beef mixture and noodles to pan , stirring well to combine
28. Combine 1 / 3 cup soy sauce , brown sugar , vinegar , and 1 tablespoon sesame oil , stirring with a whisk
29. Drizzle over noodle mixture
30. Stir well to combine
31. Cook over medium-low heat 3 minutes or until thoroughly heated
32. Sprinkle with sesame seeds

title: slow cooker pork chili verde
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a large skillet or dutch oven over medium heat
2. Add the onion and garlic
3. Cook and stir until fragrant
4. Add the cubed pork , and cook until browned on the outside
5. Transfer the pork , onions , and garlic to a slow cooker , and stir in the green salsa , and jalapeno peppers
6. Cover , and cook on high for 3 hours
7. Reduce the setting to low , and cook for 4 to 5 more hours
8. Serve in tortillas with cheese , sour cream , and salsa

title: reunion pasta salad with chicken
steps:
1. Cut chicken into 1-inch chunks
2. Salt and pepper lightly
3. In medium bowl , blend dressing ingredients
4. In dutch oven , cook pasta according to package directions , adding frozen vegetables after 8 minutes
5. Return to a boil
6. Cook 3 to 4 minutes or until pasta and vegetables are tender
7. Rinse in cold water to cool
8. Drain
9. Spray large nonstick skillet with nonstick cooking spray
10. Heat skillet over medium-high heat
11. Add chicken
12. Cook and stir 7 to 9 minutes or until chicken is browned and internal juices run clear
13. In very large bowl , combine pasta , vegetables , chicken , mushrooms and tomatoes
14. Mix well
15. Add dressing to salad
16. Toss to coat
17. Cover and refrigerate thoroughly before serving

title: warm greek sandwiches
steps:
1. Preheat barbecue and lightly oil grill
2. Thinly slice cheese
3. Slice baguette in half horizontally
4. Then slice each half into 4 pieces
5. Stir oil with garlic
6. Lightly brush bread with oil mixture
7. Grill , cut-side down , until toasted , about 2 to 3 minutes
8. Turn bread and top with feta
9. Grill 2 to 3 minutes , until grill marks start to appear on baguette and feta begins to soften
10. Place on serving plates
11. Cover with tomato slices and basil leaves
12. Then drizzle with any remaining garlic-and-oil mixture and add a grinding of fresh pepper
13. Serve right away

title: spicy cuban pork chops   maya style
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees
2. Season pork chops with dry ingredients
3. Mix salsa , honey , garlic and lime juice
4. Marinate pork in salsa mixture for 1 hours
5. Pat pork dry and sear both sides in olive oil
6. Place pork in the oven and baste with marinade
7. Bake for 15 minute

title: really great stir fried snap peas
steps:
1. Pinch off the stems on the ends , and the small strings off of the seams of the snap peas
2. Heat a wok or fry pan over high heat with 2 tablespoons vegetable oil
3. When oil is hot , add in the sesame oil
4. Stir-fry the pine nuts and fresh ginger until light brown
5. Add in the snap peas , and stir-fry
6. Mix in the sherry and soy sauce
7. Lower heat and cook for about 2 minutes
8. Delicious !

title: moroccan pumpkin soup  l hamraak garagh
steps:
1. Cover the chickpeas with water
2. Cover and allow to soak overnight
3. Drain
4. Saute the leeks in the oil over medium heat until soft and translucent , approximately 5-10 minutes
5. Add the broth , pumpkin cubes or puree , chickpeas , honey , spices and salt to the pan
6. Cover and simmer until the chickpeas are tender , about 1 1 / 4 hours
7. If using the cinnamon stick , discard it
8. If desired , transfer the soup to a blender and puree until smooth
9. Season to taste
10. They are considerably smaller than ornamental carving pumpkins
11. For vegan option do not use honey
12. And for vegetarian do not use chicken broth

title: romano s macaroni grill nachos napoli
steps:
1. Stack the wonton wrappers and slice into 3-4 sections lengthwise and then cut each strip 3 more times to make little rectangles or chips
2. Deep fry in hot canola oil till light golden brown , drain on paper towels and set aside
3. Cheese sauce:
4. Mix cornstarch and water in a small bowl , then add granules
5. Set aside
6. In a sauce pan heat the cream
7. Slowly add cornstarch mixture , mix till thick and slowly add in cheese
8. Stir till cheese is totally melted and then turn heat to low and stir occasionally
9. Place the chips on a plate and sprinkle with1 / 2 the mozzarella cheese
10. Dot the top with about 2 / 3 c hot cheese sauce
11. Sprinkle all other ingredients evenly over the top
12. Sprinkle with as much remaining mozzarella cheese as desired
13. Serve while hot
14. Cheese sauce makes about 3 cups
15. Servings are for a meal , for an appetizer it would feed around 2-4 people

title: roasted bell peppers
steps:
1. Turn on the broiler in the oven
2. Put one shelf at the lowest level and the other shelf at the highest level
3. Cut off the top of the garlic bulb and discard
4. Put the bulb in a small ramekin , drizzle the 2 teaspoons olive oil over the top , and cover with foil
5. Place on the bottom shelf of the oven
6. Set the timer for 45 minutes
7. In the meantime , slice off the tops of the peppers , slice in half lengthwise and in half , lengthwise again , so that you have four long pieces of pepper
8. Lay flesh side down on a baking sheet
9. Place under the broiler / grill until the skins have turned bubbly and black , about 20-30 minutes
10. The blacker the skin is , the easier it will be to peel them
11. Remove the peppers to a brown paper bag or to a bowl covered with cling film , to steam for about 10 minutes
12. Check on the garlic
13. It should be soft enough for you to sqeeze the pulp out
14. If not , return to oven for another 5-10 minutes
15. Squeeze the pulp out into a medium bowl and set aside
16. Remove the peppers from the brown bag or bowl to a cutting board
17. Carefully peel the blackened skin from the peppers and discard
18. Put the peppers , basil , oregano and salt into the bowl with the garlic
19. Using your fingers , gently mix together until well combined , adding more seasonings to suit your taste
20. Transfer mixture to jar
21. Pour olive oil over peppers until covered
22. Place lid on jar and leave to sit about 1-2 hours
23. Stir peppers and store in fridge for up to 3 weeks
24. If oil solidifies , remove from fridge 30 minutes prior to consuming
25. Enjoy !

title: easy jelly roll trifle
steps:
1. Cut small jelly rolls into 1 / 2" slices
2. Or use a full-size jelly roll and freeze any leftover cake for another time
3. Thaw the cool whip topping
4. Divide it into one cup and two cup portions
5. Save a few strawberries for garnish
6. Slice the rest of the strawberries , lightly sugar them and set aside
7. Arrange jelly roll slices on the sides and bottom of a clear 2-1 / 2 quart glass bowl or trifle dish or use a 9 x 13 glass dish
8. For presentation , arrange some strawberry slices around the bottom edge of the bowl before adding the jelly roll slices
9. Prepare instant vanilla pudding according to box directions using 1-1 / 2 cups milk
10. Let stand for 5 minutes to thicken
11. Fold in the 1 cup of whipped topping
12. Arrange 1 / 2 of the strawberries on jelly roll slices
13. Top with pudding , then remaining strawberries and 2 cups of whipped topping
14. Cover and chill for 8 hours
15. Garnish with whole strawberries with stems or strawberry halves

title: different deviled eggs
steps:
1. Peel eggs and halve lengthwise
2. Place yolks in a mixing bowl and set whites aside
3. Mash yolks with the cream cheese , then add the relish and the dry mustard
4. Substitute 2 tsp prepared yellow mustard if dry mustard powder is not available
5. Stir well
6. Taste filling and add salt and pepper to taste
7. Fill whites , either with a teaspoon or get fancy and use a pastry bag with a star
8. Traditional garnish is a sprinkling of paprika

title: queso frito  fried cheese
steps:
1. Mix together flour and paprika in a bowl
2. Have the beaten eggs in a separate bowl
3. Mix the bread crumbs and oregano in a third bowl
4. Dredge the cheese in the flour mixture , then egg and then coat well in bread crumbs
5. Refrigerate for at least an hour
6. Heat oil in a heavy skillet under med-high
7. Fry cheese until golden brown
8. About 20-30 seconds per side

title: three cheese dill artichoke bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. In a food processor , combine artichoke hearts , mozzarella and swiss cheeses , dill , yogurt , mayonnaise , lemon juice , garlic and cayenne
3. Process by pulsing on and off until combined but still chunky
4. Spoon into a small casserole dish
5. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese and bake uncovered 10 minutes
6. Place under the broiler and broil 3 to 5 minutes just until top is slightly browned
7. Serve the dip warm with crackers or crusty bread

title: beer cheese soup
steps:
1. Saute vegetables in butter until done , but not browned
2. Blend in flour , dry mustard , and chicken stock
3. Cook 5 minutes
4. Blend in cheddar cheese , parmesan cheese , m and beer
5. Let simmer 30 minutes
6. Season with salt and pepper

title: greatest ever loco chicken burritos
steps:
1. Disolve boullion cube in 2 cups boiling water
2. Add rice , bring to a boil , cover , and turn heat to low
3. Cook 20 minutes
4. Meanwhile , heat the olive oil in a skillet and add the onions
5. Cook over high heat until carmelized , about 3-4 minutes- then add garlic and allow to sweat a bit
6. Cut chicken into bite size pieces and lightly season with salt and pepper if desired
7. Add to onions and garlic in pan
8. Cook chicken thoroughly
9. Add taco seasoning and 3 / 4 cup water
10. Mix well and allow to simmer for about 2-3 minutes
11. Mix in the crushed tomatoes
12. Add 2 cups of the cooked rice to the chicken mixture and mix until all the rice is coated , adding some water if you feel the mixture is too thick
13. Stir in the sour cream until well blended
14. Serve on flour or corn tortillas !
15. Ps-if you are serving on corn tortillas , be sure to use 2 tortillas for each serving because they tend to fall apart !

title: glazed   grilled flank steak
steps:
1. Place flank steak flat on large shallow pan
2. Cut both sides of beef into diamond pattern 1 / 8th inch deep
3. In medium saucepan , combine pepper jelly , garlic , kosher salt and worcestershire sauce
4. Heat mixture to simmer , stirring constantly until jelly melts and all ingredients are heated through
5. Reserve two-thirds of glaze
6. Brush both sides of steak with remaining one third of the glaze
7. Cover and marinate in refrigerator 30 minutes
8. In large skillet , saut onions in oil until softened
9. Add 1 / 2 of the reserved glaze and continue to saut until onions are a deep golden brown and caramelized
10. Keep warm
11. Set oven to broil
12. Broil beef 2 to 3 inches from heat until brown , about 5 minutes
13. Turn beef
14. Brush with remaining glaze and broil 5 minutes longer
15. Cut beef across the grain at slanted angle into thin slices
16. Serve with caramelized onions
17. Enjoy !

title: falafel with taratoor sauce
steps:
1. Place chickpeas in a large bowl , cover generously with water and soak overnight
2. Drain chickpeas
3. Add onion , garlic , bread , parsley , and red sweet pepper
4. Run through the fine blade of a meat grinder
5. Add spices , flour , 10 ml baking powder and water
6. Mix well
7. In a small dish mix the remaining baking powder and water
8. Use it to moisten the palm of your hands and form balls of the chickpea mixture the size of walnuts , then flatten a bit
9. Deep fry in oil at medium high heat until golden brown
10. Serve piping hot
11. Serving suggestion: using a 6-inch arabic pita bread , lay 4-5 falafel down the length of the pita
12. Turn the pita over the falafel and using the heels of your hands , smoosh down on the falafels
13. Open the pita again and add fixings of your choice
14. We like slices of tomato , dill pickle and a hearty sprinkle of parsley and lots and lots of fresh spearmint
15. Dress with sauce
16. Roll up as in a sandwich wrap and enjoy an extremely flavourful sandwich !
17. For taratoor sauce: in a deep bowl beat the tahini with the crushed garlic and lemon juice until creamy
18. Add water bit by bit , beating well after each addition if using blender put all the ingredients in and blend
19. Add salt and parsley and stir
20. Taste and add more lemon juice if needed - the sauce should be tangy
21. Refrigerate until ready to use
22. This is also a great dip for crudites

title: veggie burritos
steps:
1. Put about a quarter-sized drop of oil in a large frying pan , and place on medium-high heat
2. Once the oil is hot , add onion and bell pepper
3. Cook , stirring often , for about 7-10 minutes or until they're almost cooked enough to eat
4. Add zuccini , squash , tumeric , cumin , cayenne pepper , and salt
5. Cook for about 5 minutes or until the zuccini and squash is soft
6. Add garlic and beans
7. Cook until warm
8. Place 3 slices of cheese inside each tortilla
9. Spread beans mixture over the cheese , and fold up as you want

title: wild mushroom  red onion and sage pizza
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 500
2. In a large bowl , place mushrooms with onions
3. Toss with the olive oil
4. In a large non-stick skillet , cook mushrooms and onions over medium-high heat , stirring frequently , until mushrooms soften 3-5 minutes
5. Season with salt and pepper
6. Place mushrooms on paper towels and blot dry
7. Spoon mushroom-onion mixture over crust
8. Sprinkle with sage
9. Top with half of the cheese
10. Bake pizza about 12 minutes , until crust is golden
11. Remove from oven
12. Slide pizza onto a large cutting board
13. Top with remaining cheese and sprinkle with parsley
14. Let rest for 5 minutes before serving
15. Cut into wedges and serve

title: south african sosaties   malay kebabs
steps:
1. Make the marinade first , as it has to cool down completely
2. Use a large pot
3. Fry the onion rings in oil until light brown
4. Stir now and then
5. While onion fries , mix all the dry ingredients in a bowl: the crushed coriander , all the spices , the brown sugar , the cornflour and the salt
6. When the onions are light brown , stir in the mixed dry ingredients , and fry for a minute or so to release the flavours
7. Add an extra splash of oil , stir , and don't let the spices burn
8. Turn heat lower , and add the liquids: vinegar , wine , apricot jam , grated ginger and garlic to taste
9. Also add the lemon or bay leaves , or julienned lemon peel
10. Stir well and simmer slowly until thickened
11. Now taste carefully: the sauce should neither be too acidic or too sweet , just spicy and tangy
12. Adjust by adding either a little more vinegar or lemon juice , or more sugar
13. And no , the 6 tblsp sugar are not too much
14. You do not want an acidic sauce , just a tangy one !
15. Cool the sauce , and stir in the milk and a little water
16. It must be of a coating consistency
17. If you think it is too thick , add a little more water and stir well
18. Leave sauce in pot , and cut up the meats
19. Cut the meat off the leg of lamb , and cut into bite-sized chunks , not too small
20. Do the same with the pork
21. The pork should have fat on it , and the best ratio of lamb to pork is about 2 - 1
22. The number of apricots , onions and skewers given could vary , as it will depend on how much meat you cut off the lamb leg , and how much meat you put on a skewer
23. The meats: the meats should be strung on the skewers , alternating the different ingredients , with about 2 apricot halves and 2 onion rings per skewer
24. The lamb chunks should predominate
25. Using a rectangular glass or ceramic dish pack in the skewers of meat , and cover every layer with sauce
26. I take the pot of sauce , roll each sosatie skewer in the sauce , and pack in a plastic container
27. When all the skewers have been "sauced" , up-end the leftover sauce over the sosaties in the container
28. Seal airtight and refrigerate
29. You will probably have 2 - 3 layers of skewers
30. To make sure they're all coated , turn the container upside down once a day
31. Cover and keep in fridge for 2 - 3 days before use
32. The sosaties will improve on standing , and can be kept up to 5 days in the sauce
33. Grill as explained in the introduction
34. Goes well with traditional yellow rice or basmati , or potato salad and a mixed green salad
35. Ideal food to take on a picnic !

title: healthy sandwich
steps:
1. 1 spread the avocado over the tortilla
2. 2 combine all the other ingredients in a small bowl , then spoon it into the center of the tortilla
3. 3 fold the tortilla from the bottom first , then the sides , and enjoy immediately

title: carrots elegante
steps:
1. Cook the carrots in water , covered , for about 8 minutes
2. Drain the carrots
3. Put the butter , honey , lemon juice & ginger in a microwavable bowl
4. Microwave for 30 seconds , then stir
5. Continue until all butter is melted and all ingredients are combined
6. Put the carrots into a 1 1 / 2 to 2 quart greased dish
7. Pour the sauce over the carrots & stir
8. Bake , uncovered , at 375 degrees for 30 minutes , stirring every 10 minutes
9. Sprinkle almonds over carrots just before serving

title: pumpkin sage pasta
steps:
1. Heat a medium , non-stick skillet over medium-high heat
2. Add extra virgin olive oil and brown the sausage , breaking it up
3. Transfer sausage to a paper towel-lined plate , and add the onion and garlic to the pan
4. Cook over moderate heat until tender but not brown
5. Add the wine and return the sausage to the skillet , continue to cook a couple of minutes
6. Add the chicken stock , heavy cream , sage , cloves , and pumpkin
7. Bring up to a bubble and simmer until thick , a couple of minutes
8. Add the pasta and cheese tossing to coat the pasta with the sauce
9. Add salt and pepper to taste
10. Serve and garnish with a sprinkle of chives

title: school days peanut butter cookies 1930s 1940s
steps:
1. Cream the butter and the peanut butter together
2. Add the sugar gradually creaming thoroughly
3. Add the egg to the creamed mixture
4. Sift flour once before measuring
5. Sift the flour , soda , baking powder and salt together and add to the creamed mixture
6. Chill dough well
7. Then form into balls the size of walnut
8. Place on a lightly floured greased baking sheet
9. Flatten with a fork dipped in flour making a criss-cross patter
10. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes at 375f to make about 4 dozen cookies

title: pasta salad w feta and cherry tomatoes
steps:
1. Cook pasta al dente and drain
2. Blend olive oil , garlic , balsamic vinegar , jam , salt and pepper until smooth
3. Set aside
4. In large bowl mix green onions , carrot , tomatoes , cucumber
5. Stir well
6. Add pasta and stir
7. Add feta and parsley and stir
8. Add dressing , mix and serve

title: tomato corn soup
steps:
1. Saute onion in the olive oil in a heavy sauce pot over medium heat for 3 minutes
2. Stir in flour , curry powder , and tomato paste
3. Slowly add the chicken broth
4. Stir until soup starts to boil
5. Reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes
6. Add milk , corn , tomatoes and black pepper , and green bell pepper
7. Simmer 5 minutes

title: halloween carrot fingers
steps:
1. Fill a serving bowl with the cream cheese dip
2. Wash and peel 4 long carrots for fingers and 1 medium carrot for a thumb
3. With a paring knife , cut a flat , shallow notch in the
4. Then use a dab of dip or softened cream cheese to glue a sliced-almond fingernail atop each notch
5. Stick the fingers in the dip and serve with baby carrotsor crackers for dipping

title: sweet onion turnovers
steps:
1. In a bowl , combine the flour , sugar and salt
2. Cut in 3 / 4 cup butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs
3. Gradually , add water , tossing with a fork until mixture forms a ball
4. Shape into a flattened ball
5. Wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate
6. In a large skillet , cook the onions , rosemary and thyme in remaining butter over medium-low heat until onions begin to turn golden brown
7. Add broth and pepper
8. Cook over high heat until liquid is absorbed
9. Cool slightly
10. In a bowl , beat eggs
11. Set aside 2 tablespoons
12. Stir cream and mustard into remaining beaten eggs
13. Stir in breadcrumbs , parmesan cheese and onion mixture
14. Divide dough into six portions
15. On a lightly floured surface , roll each portion into a 6-inch circle
16. Place on two greased baking sheets
17. Spoon about 1 / 2 cup onion mixture on one side of each
18. Fold dough over filling
19. Press edges with a fork to seal
20. Brush with reserved beaten egg
21. Bake at 400 f for 20-25 minutes or until filling reaches 160 degrees and crust is golden brown

title: fresh veggie and chicken pasta
steps:
1. Lightly coat grill rack or grill pan with nonstick cooking spray
2. Heat grill or grill pan to medium high
3. Cook pasta following package directions
4. Season chicken with 1 / 4 t of the salt and 1 / 4 t of the pepper
5. Grill chicken , about 6 minutes per side until cooked through
6. Set aside to cool slightly , then cut into thin strips
7. When pasta is done , drain and toss in a bowl with 2 t of the oil
8. Set aside
9. Heat remaining 2 t oil in a 12-inch skillet over medium heat
10. Add garlic
11. Cook 1 minute
12. Add tomatoes with their juice , zucchini and yellow pepper
13. Cook 3 more minutes
14. Add vinegar , tomato paste , remaining 1 t salt and 1 / 4 t pepper
15. Cook 3 minutes
16. Stir in chicken and heat through
17. Remove from heat
18. Toss sauce with pasta , basil and mozzarella and serve

title: crock pot chicken
steps:
1. Place chicken in the crockpot
2. Cover with soup
3. The more soup , the better
4. Cook on low for 6-8 hours
5. Serve over egg noodles or rice

title: coconut roughs
steps:
1. Place coconut and chocolate in a bowl and mix well to combine
2. Line a baking tray with non-stick baking paper and drop rounded teaspoons of coconut mixture onto tray
3. Refrigerate until set

title: breakfast in a pan
steps:
1. Melt butter in heavy skillet over low coals
2. Toss in bread cubes and stir until lightly browned
3. Mix remaining ingredients together and pour over bread cubes
4. Cook over medium coals until set and browned on the bottom
5. Serve immediately

title: new potatoes and anchovy sauce
steps:
1. Place potatoes in a saucepan and cover with cold water
2. Bring to the boil covered , over a medium high heat
3. Reduce to medium and cook until tender , about 15 to 20 minutes
4. Meanwhile , make the sauce
5. Melt the butter in a heavy-based saucepan over a medium heat
6. Add the garlic , anchovies and onions
7. Stir until the anchovies form a paste texture-about 2 minutes
8. Reduce heat to very low and add the sour cream , yogurt and parsley
9. Stir continuously until heated through
10. Do not boil
11. Place the potatoes in a warm serving bowl and pour the sauce over to coat
12. Serve immediately

title: mexican pizza with ranchero sauce
steps:
1. Ranchero sauce: in a large skillet , heat oil over medium heat and add onion
2. Cook 2 minutes , stirring constantly
3. Add garlic and cook 2 minutes more or until onion is translucent
4. Add tomatoes , chilies , sugar , salt and pepper
5. Simmer until slightly thickened , about 15 minutes , stirring ocassionally
6. Stir in cilantro
7. Preheat oven to 500
8. Spread 1 cup ranchero sauce evenly over pizza
9. Cover with cooked sausage and sprinkle cheese over top
10. Add onion , red pepper strips and jalapeno peppers over cheese
11. Bake 15 - 20 minutes

title: tortilla casserole  oamc
steps:
1. Fry ground beef and onions until meat is cooked through
2. Add taco seasoning and water and cook until thickened
3. Line the pan or casserole dish with 3 tortillas , then layer with 1 / 2 of the meat , 1 / 2 of the beans , 1 / 2 of the sour cream and 1 / 2 of the cheese
4. Repeat
