5. If you like it spicy , then top it with some hot sauce or salsa
6. Bake at 350 until bubbly
7. Oamc directions: after baking , place in rigid container and seal with a lid
8. Place in freezer
9. When ready to eat , thaw , place in baking dish , and reheat in 400 degree oven for 30 minutes

title: snow peas with cashews
steps:
1. In nonstick skillet , heat oil
2. Add orange peel and cook over low heat for 2 minutes
3. Add snow peas and salt and pepper , to taste
4. Turn heat to medium
5. Stirring constantly , cook 3 to 4 minutes or until snow peas are bright green and crunchy
6. Sprinkle with cashews and serve

title: breakfast casserole ll
steps:
1. Place sausage in a skillet over med-high heat , and cook until evenly brown
2. Drain , and set aside
3. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
4. Lightly grease a 9x13 inch baking dish
5. In a large bowl , beat together the eggs , condensed cream of mushroom soup , and milk
6. Stir in the sausage and mushrooms
7. Pour into the prepared baking dish
8. Mix in the frozen potato rounds & extra cheese
9. Bake in preheated oven for 45-50 minutes
10. Sprinkle with cheese , and bake an additonal 10 min
11. Or until cheese is melted

title: drunken sweet potato casserole
steps:
1. Boil the potatoes until done
2. Skin and mash potatoes while still warm
3. Add butter and salt to taste
4. Add milk until the consistency is like creamy mashed potatoes
5. Put potatoes in a 2 quart casserole dish
6. Scoop a hollow in the center of the potatoes and create a rim of potatoes around the edge of the pan
7. Set aside
8. In a double boiler , cook 1 / 4 lb butter , brown sugar , egg , and bourbon , stirring constantly , until thickened
9. Poor this syrup into the center hollow of the casserole and over the whole top
10. Line the edges of the casserole with the mini marshmallows
11. Bake at 350f for 45 minutes or until the sauce is a very dark brown

title: smoked beef brisket  texas style
steps:
1. You will also need 2 medium aluminum pans & 1 / 2 cup hickory chips , 1 / 2 cup cherry wood chips
2. 1 medium bag of charcoal
3. Dry off brisket & coat lightly with oil
4. Cover with sea salt & pepper
5. Don't be stingy ! let brisket rest in the refrigerator for 30 minute
6. While the meat is chillin' out let's get the grill ready
7. Place 1 aluminum pan filled with hot water off to one side of the bottom of the grill & the coal to the other side
8. Use a coal chimney if you have one
9. Put on the lid & let heat up to 225 degrees
10. Don't go over 250
11. This method is called indirect heating
12. Once the coals are ready place the brisket fat side down over the pan of water
13. Put the cherry & hickory chips on the coals & place the other aluminum pan filled with water over the fire
14. Helps keep the heat just right
15. Cook for 8-10 hours @ 225
16. Checking on the coal every hour or so & replacing as needed
17. Don't add any more wood ! will be too smokey
18. Check with meat thermometer when core temperature is about 180 or 190
19. Remove from grill & let rest for 20 minute
20. Slice up & serve on a bun dry or with your favorite sauce

title: polynesian cake and cream frosting
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a large bowl and mix with a spoon
2. Pour into a greased and floured 13x9 baking pan and bake at 350 for 50 minutes
3. Cool
4. Prepare frosting by whipping all ingredients together and cover cake
5. Garnish with coconut and refrigerate

title: 90 minute beer brined pot roast
steps:
1. The success of this recipe relies on two things: the use of a dutch oven or similar heavy pot with a heavy bottom
2. And that you use a very large piece of aluminum foil to cover not only the roast , but also go up the sides of the pot and over the pot's edge
3. The cover must make contact with the foil all around the edge
4. This is what permits the pot roast to cook quickly
5. Brining: put all of the brine ingredients into a zippered gallon-sized plastic bag
6. Seal the bag and shake it until the salt and sugar are dissolved and the beer has lost most of its carbonation
7. Add the pot roast , seal and shake to coat the roast
8. Open an inch long section of the zipper , expel as much air as you can , reseal
9. Place on counter for 45 minutes
10. Roast: place the oven rack in the middle of the oven and preheat to 450 degrees f
11. Remove the roast from the brine and pat dry
12. Put the dutch oven over medium high heat and add the oil
13. Brown both sides of the roast , about 5 minutes per side
14. '
15. Remove to a platter and season with salt and pepper
16. Add onions to the pot and saute until golden
17. Add the wine and simmer about 1 minute
18. Turn off the heat
19. Return the meat to the pot
20. Protecting your hands with oven mitts , place a sheet of heavy-duty aluminum foil over the meat , pressing down until it is covered from edge to edge , letting the excess foil drape over the edge of the pot
21. Press the foil against the pot
22. Cover the pot with its lid , raise the heat to medium-high , and cook until you hear the liquids bubbling
23. Place the pot in the oven and cook for 90 minutes - the roast should be dark brown at this point
24. Remove and let rest covered for 10 to 15 minutes
25. Carefully remove the foil - steam will billow up , i suggest that you pull away the foil from the side farthest away from you first - and remove the roast to a platter
26. Skim fat from the liquid , then place the pot over medium high heat
27. Whisk the flour into the chicken broth and stir into the liquid in the pot
28. While the gravy thickens , slice the roast against the grain into slices
29. Cover with gravy and serve

title: kang jyd taohu  thai tofu soup
steps:
1. Combine the pork , garlic , and salt in a small bowl and mix until well blended
2. Set aside
3. Bring the chicken stock to a boil in a large saucepan over medium heat
4. Using a small teaspoon , drop small bits of the pork mixture into the soup and bring the mixture back to a boil again
5. Add the tofu , bok choy , and season with the fish sauce , sugar and pepper
6. Simmer uncovered for 5 minutes before removing from heat
7. Serve hot , garnished with the green onions and cilantro leaves

title: cinnamon extract
steps:
1. Put ingredients in container
2. Combine
3. Place in dark area such as cabinet for 3 to 4 months or longer
4. The taste improves with length
5. Servings are based on 1 / 2 cup vodka

title: fried fish with moroccan herb sauce
steps:
1. In a food processor or blender pure the coriander , the parsley , the garlic , the lemon juice , the paprika , the cumin , the cayenne , 3 tablespoons of the oil , and salt and pepper to taste
2. In a skillet heat 1 inch of the additional oil to 375f on a deep-fat thermometer , dredge the fish in the flour , shaking off the excess , and in the oil fry it , turning it once , for 1-1 / 2 to 2 minutes on each side , or until it is cooked through
3. Transfer the fish to paper towels to drain , divide it between 2 plates , and drizzle the sauce over it

title: italian ham and cheese stuffed chicken breasts
steps:
1. Slice chicken breasts horizontally without cutting all the way through
2. Open so breasts are flat
3. Place between 2 pieces of plastic wrap
4. Pound gently with flat side of meat mallet
5. In small bowl , stir together parsley and mustard
6. Spread over half of each chicken breast
7. Top each with half slices of cheese and prosciutto
8. Fold breasts to enclose stuffing
9. Pressing edges together to seal
10. Sprinkle with salt
11. Place flour on plate
12. Dip chicken in flour , tapping to remove excess
13. Heat oil in large nonstick skillet over meium heat until hot
14. Add chciken , cook 6-10 minutes or until golden brown , no longer pink in the center , and juices run clear
15. Place of serving platter
16. Increase heat to medium high
17. Add wine to skillet
18. Cook 30-60 seconds until slightly reduced , stirring to scrape up any browned bits from bottom of skillet
19. Pour over chicken

title: spiedino   spiedies   speedies marinade for chicken
steps:
1. Whirl all ingredients in the blender
2. Chill until needed for marinating

title: breakfast apple cobbler
steps:
1. Core and slice apples ,
2. Place in crockette
3. Add the remaining ingredients
4. Mix thoroughly
5. Cover and cook for 8 to 10 hours
6. Serve with toppings of your choice

title: buffet roast
steps:
1. Place meat in a dutch oven
2. Top with the sauerkraut , tomatoes , sugar , apple , onion and salt and pepper
3. Cover and simmer several hours until meat is very fork tender
4. Correct seasonings if need be

title: bacon and lentil soup
steps:
1. Cut the bacon up into tiny pieces and fry with the oil
2. Once the fat begin to melt off , add in the roughly chopped carrots , celery , onions , or other veggies that you desire
3. I used leeks
4. Let cook for another 5 minutes or so
5. Add in garlic and let cook for one more minute
6. Add in the can of tomatoes , chicken stock and washed lentils
7. Let simmer for about 20 minutes or so
8. After 20 minutes , add in any other veg you want
9. I added green beans
10. Let simmer for another 15 minutes
11. Add in cabbage if you want
12. Simmer for another 5 minutes
13. Yum !

title: maple pecan sandwich cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Spread the 1 cup of pecans in a small baking pan and toast in the oven , stirring frequently , for 6-9 minutes , or until lightly browned , be careful not to burn
3. Immediately turn out into a small bowl
4. Let stand until completely cooled
5. Set aside
6. In a medium bowl , thoroughly stir together the flour , baking soda , and salt
7. Set aside
8. In a food processor , process the pecans and brown sugar continuously until the pecans are completely pureed and form a paste , 3-4 minutes -- scraping down sides of processor and bottom several times
9. Add the butter and process until well blended
10. Add the powdered sugar , maple syrup , egg yolk , and vanilla and process until very well blended and smooth
11. Add the flour mixture and process in on / off pulses just until evenly incorporated
12. Divide the dough into thirds
13. Place each portion between large sheets of wax paper
14. Roll out each portion to a generous 1 / 8" thick
15. Check the underside of dough and smooth out any wrinkles that form
16. Stack the rolled portions , paper and all on a baking sheet
17. Freeze for 30 minutes or until chilled and firm
18. The dough may be frozen for up to 24 hours , let thaw before using
19. Prehat oven to 350
20. Grease several baking sheets or coat with nonstick spray
21. Working with one portion at a time and leaving remaining portions chilled , gently peel away , then pat one sheet of wax paper back into place
22. Flip dough over , then peel off and discard the second piece of paper
23. Using a
24. 1 1 / 2-1 3 / 4" round or oval , scalloped or fluted cookie cutter , cut out cookies
25. If at any point the dough softens too much to handle easily , transfer dough to freezer to firm up
26. Using a spatula , carefully transfer the dough to the baking sheets , spacing about 1 1 / 2" apart
27. Reroll any dough scraps
28. Continue cutting out the cookies until all the dough is used
29. Lightly sprinkle half the cookies with the finely chopped pecans , patting them down to embed them slightly -- these rounds will be the sandwich tops
30. Bake the cookies one sheet at a time in the upper third of the oven for 6-8 minutes or until just tinged with brown and slightly darker around the edges
31. Reverse sheets halfway through from front to back to ensure even browning
32. Transfer sheet to wire rack and let set 2-3 minutes so cookies firm up slightly
33. Using a spatula , transfer cookies to wire rack to cool completely
34. Buttercream
35. In a small heavy saucepan , bring the maply syrup to a simmer over medium-high heat
36. Simmer briskly for 2 minutes
37. Remove from heat
38. Let cool slightly
39. Pour the syrup into the food processor
40. Let stand until barefly warm
41. Add the powdered sugar , butter and vanilla and process just until well blended and smooth
42. Spread a generous measuring teaspoon of buttercream over the underside of each untopped round
43. Cover each with a pecan-topped round
44. Gently press down and then adjust the top if necessary
45. Store in an airtight container for up to 1 week or freeze up to one month

title: extra easy pizza
steps:
1. Heat oven to 450f
2. Grease 12-inch pizza pan
3. Stir together bisquick mix and very hot water
4. Beat 20 strokes until soft dough forms
5. Press dough in pizza pan
6. Spread pizza sauce over dough
7. Top with remaining ingredients
8. Bake 12 to 15 minutes or until crust is golden brown and cheese is bubbly

title: wilted garlic spinach
steps:
1. Heat the olive oil in a pan
2. Add the garlic , either chopped or smashed
3. Cook the garlic for about 3 minutes
4. Add spinach and with tongs , turn constantly until wilted
5. Sprinkle with nutmeg , salt and pepper
6. Enjoy !

title: cheese sizzlers
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients and mix well
2. Spread over bread slices
3. Broil 4 inches from heat until cheese melts
4. Can be done in a toaster oven , also !

title: basmati rice with nuts and spices
steps:
1. Melt the butter in a saucepan over medium heat
2. Add in the onion and garlic
3. Stir / saute for 5 minutes or until soft
4. Add in the nuts and rice
5. Stir to coat
6. Add in the broth and spices
7. Bring mixture to a boil
8. Lower heat , cover , and simmer for about 20 minutes or until all liquid is absorbed
9. Add in parsley , lemon juice , raisins , and salt / pepper to taste
10. Fluff with a fork

title: apple granola loaf
steps:
1. Combine the first 6 ingredients in a large bowl
2. Combine the next 4 ingredients in a separate bowl
3. Fold the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients
4. Place batter in a prepared loaf pan
5. Combine topping ingredients and sprinkle on top of loaf
6. Bake at 350 for about 1 hour

title: carrots di amore
steps:
1. Saute carrots in butter in large skillet until lightly cooked
2. Add almonds
3. When carrots are softening , but still have crunch , add amaretto and warm through
4. Season with salt and pepper

title: six onion soup
steps:
1. Melt the butter in a pot
2. Add the onions , leeks , shallots and garlic and cook , covered , over low heat until vegetables are tender and lightly colored , about 25 minutes
3. Add the stock , thyme and bay leaf , and season to taste with salt and pepper
4. Bring to a boil , reduce heat , and cook , partially covered , for 20 minutes
5. Pour the soup through a strainer set over a bowl , transfer the solids and 1 cup of the liquid to the bowl of a food processor fitted with a steel blade , and puree
6. Return the puree and remaining 3 cups of liquid to the pot and set over medium heat
7. Whisk in the heavy cream and bring to a simmer
8. Add the scallions and simmer for another 5 minutes , or until they are tender
9. Ladle into heated bowls and garnish with croutons of toasted french bread and snipped fresh chives
10. Enjoy !

title: strawberry papaya shake
steps:
1. Combine papaya , strawberries , milk , yogurt , and honey in a blender
2. Cover and blend until smooth
3. With the blender running , add ice cubes , one at a time , through the opening in the lid , until ice is crushed and mixture is smooth
4. Pour into 2 tall glasses
5. Garnish with papaya or strawberry slices and mint , if desired
6. Serve immediately
7. Makes 2 servings

title: bacon  potato  white bean and red pepper soup
steps:
1. Place the bacon in a large saucepan and cover with water
2. Simmer over moderately high heat for 5 minutes
3. Drain and pat dry the bacon on paper towels
4. Wipe out saucepan and return the bacon to pan
5. Fry over medium high heat until golden and crisp about 4 minutes
6. Drain the bacon on paper towel , discard all the fat from pan and wipe out with paper towels
7. Reserve bacon on the side
8. Add butter to pan and reduce heat to moderate heat
9. Add vegetables and saute until soft
10. Add broth and simmer until potatoes are soft and start breaking down
11. Simmer for 45 minutes and serve with crumbled bacon on top

title: basic soy burgers
steps:
1. Place everything except bread crumbs in a food processor or blender and puree until fairly smooth
2. Transfer to a bowl , and add the bread crumbs
3. Stir until well combined
4. Form into patties abut 4 inches in diameter and 1 / 2 inch thick , using about 1 / 2 cup of mixture for each patty
5. Heat a heavy , non stick skillet and brush with oil
6. When pan is hot , add burgers and turn the heat down to medium , and cook for about 10 minutes on each side
7. Watch them carefully so they get nice and brown but don't burn
8. Serve burger style

title: lemon  basil   mascarpone pasta
steps:
1. Cook the pasta in a large pot of boiling salted water , until firm to the bite
2. While the pasta is cooking , place the lemon juice , zest and mascarpone in a skillet over medium-low heat
3. Warm gently , stirring constantly , until heated through , about 3 to 4 minutes
4. Add salt and pepper to taste
5. Drain the pasta , reserving 1 / 2 cup pasta water
6. Add the pasta with the basil to the hot sauce
7. Toss well to coat , adding reserved water as needed
8. Serve immediately

title: caramel apple breakfast pudding
steps:
1. In a saucepan , add apples and water
2. Bring mixture to boiling
3. Lower heat
4. Cover and cook over medium-low for 5-7 minutes or until apples are tender
5. Stirring frequently
6. Drain apples and transfer to a small bowl
7. Stir in cinnamon and set apples aside
8. In the same saucepan , add brown sugar , corn syrup , and butter
9. Cook and stir over medium heat until just reaches boiling
10. Remove from heat
11. Pour mixture into an ungreased 2-quart square baking dish
12. Sprinkle evenly with pecans
13. In another bowl , add eggs , milk , vanilla , and nutmeg
14. Mix well
15. Place half of the bread slices on top of the caramel , trimming bread to fit
16. Spoon apples evenly over the bread slices
17. Place remaining bread slices over apples
18. Pour egg mixture evenly over bread slices
19. Press bread down gently to moisten completely
20. Cover and chill if refrigerator for 3 to 24 hours
21. In a 325f oven , bake , uncovered , for 40-45 minutes or until knife comes out clean
22. Run a knife around the edges to loosen
23. Cool in pan on a wire rack for 15 minutes
24. Carefully invert pudding onto a platter
25. Cut and serve warm

title: balsamic chicken breasts with peppers and onions
steps:
1. Season chicken with salt and pepper
2. In a large skillet , saute chicken in 2 tablespoons of oil over medium high heat , turning once for a total of about 8 minutes or until golden brown
3. Transfer chicken to a plate
4. Add 2 remaining tablespoons of oil to the skillet and cook peppers and onions , stirring often until just softened
5. Add garlic and stir for about 1 minute
6. Stir in basil and vinegar and return chicken and juices to the skillet
7. Reduce heat to low and simmer until chicken is cooked through , about 3 more minutes
8. Taste and adjust salt and pepper seasonings

title: vegan apple bread
steps:
1. Combine and set aside the first five ingredients
2. Sift flours , flax , cinnamon , soda , and salt
3. Add dry ingredients to wet ingredients gradually
4. Blend in walnuts
5. Bake in 2 regular loaf pans or 3 foil loaf pans for 1 1 / 2 hours at 300 degrees
6. Cool 10 minutes in the pan

title: mariel s amazing salad dressing
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a blender and blend until smooth
2. Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator until ready to use
3. Mixture can be used as salad dressing or marinade

title: cheesy sausage crescent roll
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Brown sausage and drain
3. Add cream cheese and stir until melted and mixed thoroughly
4. Set aside
5. On cookie sheet roll out package of crescent rolls as one rectangular piece--pinch perforations closed
6. Spread sausage / cheese mixture onto crescent roll 1" from the sides
7. Starting at one end , roll up
8. Pinch ends closed
9. Move roll to center of cookie sheet using two spatulas placed under ends to avoid breaking the roll apart
10. Beat egg and brush over entire roll
11. Wipe any excess thoroughly from cookie sheet to avoid crusting at the bottom of the roll
12. Sprinkle poppy seed over the top of roll
13. Bake at 375 degrees for 30 minutes
14. Before serving let set for 30 minutes

title: gorgonzola stuffed eggplant rolls with mushroom tomato sauce
steps:
1. Sweat onions over medium heat in a skillet for 5 minutes , then add garlic and continue cooking for another 3 minutes
2. Then , add mushrooms
3. Saute together for 3 to 4 minutes and then add canned , crushed tomatoes , basil , oregano , salt and pepper
4. Stir together and let it simmer on medium , low heat
5. While sauce is simmering , combine artichokes , spinach , gorgonzola , and mozzarella cheese in a sauce pan over medium , low heat
6. Add salt and pepper and stir until cheese in melted and all the ingrediants are combined
7. Take the eggplant and cut off both ends and discard
8. Cut the eggplant lengthwise into 1 / 4 inch slices
9. Salt and pepper the strips of eggplant and spoon the cheese mixture onto one end of the eggplant
10. Roll the mixture up in the eggplant and secure with toothpicks
11. Repeat with the rest of the rolls
12. Spoon some of the sauce into the bottom of a baking dish
13. Place the eggplant rolls in the dish and cover with remaining sauce
14. Bake at 325 degrees for 25 minutes or until eggplant in tender
15. During the last 5 minutes of baking sprinkle parmesan cheese on top
16. Add chopped basil for garnish when done

title: basil basmati rice
steps:
1. In a saucepan , bring to boil the rice and water
2. Reduce heat , cover and let simmer at low heat 10 to 15 minutes or until water is absorbed
3. Let rest for 5 minutes
4. Meanwhile , in a food processor , reduce the basil , oil , lemon juice , garlic , salt and pepper in a rough puree
5. Incorporate the basil mixture to the rice and stir

title: chili fruit salad
steps:
1. In a small saucepan , heat vinegar and sugar until sugar dissolves
2. Stir in crushed red pepper and allow to cool
3. Pour cooled sauce over fruit and stir
4. Chill until ready to serve

title: noah s lasagna
steps:
1. Boil big pot of water for the lasagna noodles
2. While waiting for the water to boil , go ahead and brown the ground beef in another pot
3. After ground beef is browned , drain the beef
4. Let sit 2 minutes while the grease drains
5. While waiting for the grease to drain , put the noodles in the boiling water
6. Boil for around 10 minutes or until noodles are soft
7. After beef has drained 2 minutes , put back in the same pot and add tomato sauce , garlic , sugar , salt , pepper , and oregano
8. Bring to boil then reduce heat to low-med
9. Heat and simmer 10 minutes
10. In an 8x8 pan , lightly spray with nonstick cooking spray
11. Set aside
12. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
13. Drain the noodles and line the bottom of the pan overlapping with noodles , about 5-6 noodles on bottom of pan
14. Add about 2 / 5 of the sauce mixture on top of the noodles
15. Then add about of one package of cheese to the top of the meat sauce
16. Layer a second layer of noodle on top of the cheese , then about of the remaining meat sauce and then about of the other package of cheese
17. Then sprinkle a little parmesan cheese on top
18. Put pan in oven for abut 30 minutes or until cheese is slightly browned
19. Pull out of oven and let sit and cool 10 minutes
20. The rest of the cheese can be used on garlic bread

title: green chile stuffed chicken breasts
steps:
1. In a bowl , combine the cream cheese , green chilies , chili powder , salt and pepper
2. Place a generous dollop on each flattened chicken breast , then roll up
3. Place chicken in crockpot , seam side down
4. Top chicken breast rolls with remaining cheese mixture , soup and enchilada sauce
5. Cover and cook on low for 6-7 hours

title: apple orange noodle kugel
steps:
1. Cook noodles according to package directions
2. Toss with margarine
3. Beat eggs , orange juice , sugar , salt and orange zest together
4. Pour over the noodle mixture and toss together
5. Mix grated apples with lemon juice and add to the noodles
6. Mix all ingredients together and pour into a greased 9 x 13- inch baking pan
7. Sprinkle the top with chopped nuts and bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour

title: cream of cashew soup with armagnac mathilda s restaurant  m d
steps:
1. Melt butter with oil in heavy large pot over medium heat
2. Add cashews and shallots
3. Cook until shallots are golden brown , stirring occasionally , about 10 minutes
4. Add broth and sherry
5. Increase heat to high and bring to boil
6. Add half and half and cream
7. Reduce heat to medium and simmer uncovered until cashews are tender , about 20 minutes
8. Working in small batches , puree soup in blender until very smooth
9. Strain soup into large saucepan , discarding solids left in strainer
10. Whisk 2 t water and 1 t
11. Cornstarch in small bowl to blend
12. Bring soup to boil
13. Whisk cornstarch mixture into soup , stirring until soup thickens slightly , about 2 minutes
14. Stir in armagnac
15. Season soup to taste with salt and pepper
16. Divide soup among 6 bowls
17. Sprinkle with chopped chives and serve

title: funny cake
steps:
1. Combine bottom layer ingredients in a saucepan
2. Cook , stirring constantly just to boilng , lower heat and simmer gently 2 to 3 minutes
3. Set aside
4. For cake layer , blend eggs , sugar& butter
5. Beat 2 to 3 minutes
6. Alternately beat in milk& flour / baking powder mix
7. Add vanilla
8. Pour into unbaked pie shells
9. Pour chocolate mixture over top of batter
10. Chocolate will be very runny but will thicken and"sink" below batter as it bakes
11. Bake at 350 for 35 to 40 minutes

title: lasagna cupcakes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. To start the lasagnas: cook hamburger meat , season to taste , drain
3. Reserve 8 tablespoons of parmesan and 8 tablespoons of mozzarellathis will be the topping
4. The remaining cheese will be used in the lasagnas
5. Start assembling the lasagnas
6. Line each cupcake mold with a round wonton wrapper
7. Put a little parmesan , a little mozzarella , and a little ricotta into each mold
8. Top with a little meat and a spoonful of sauce
9. Repeat layers of wonton wrappers , cheeses , meat and sauce , creating 6 layers in all , and ending with sauce
10. Sprinkle each lasagna with reserved parmesan and mozzarella
11. Bake until the lasagnas are nicely browned , about 20 minutes
12. Serve warm garnished with cherry tomatoes and basil leaves

title: low cal spicy 2 bean and chicken soup
steps:
1. Place a large dutch oven coated with cooking spray over medium-high heat until hot
2. Add onion , carrot , and garlic
3. Saut 5 minutes
4. Stir in broth and remaining ingredients
5. Bring to a boil
6. Cover , reduce heat , and simmer 2 hours
7. To use a slow cooker , combine everything in the pot , and cook on high for the first hour
8. Then turn the temperature down to low , and cook 7 more hours

title: awesome and easy non dairy ice cream
steps:
1. Whip egg whites and sugar until stiff
2. Whip remaining ingredients in a separate bowl
3. Fold two mixtures together
4. Freeze as is

title: hummus with pine nuts turkish style
steps:
1. Toast the cumin seeds and crush lightly
2. In a food processor or blender combine all the garbanzo bean puree ingredients
3. Blend until smooth
4. Tasting and adding more lemon juice to preference
5. If too thick to process effectively , add some of the reserved garbanzo bean liquid , about 1 tablespoon at a time
6. Adjust other seasonings , too if necessary
7. Transfer hummus to serving bowl or platter
8. In a small saute pan , heat up the olive oil and saute the pine nuts over medium heat for about 3-5 minutes or until golden
9. Stirring constantly
10. Be careful not to burn !
11. Sprinkle pine nuts with the cayenne , and cook an additional 1-2 minutes
12. Stirring often
13. Garnish the hummous with the pine nut mixture including any olive oil left in the pan
14. Serve with pita bread to scoop up the dip

title: flavorful  filling  granola
steps:
1. Mix all ingrediants together except the sugar , almonds , and all bran
2. Bake at 300 for 30-40 min stirring occationally
3. Stir in the sugar and then let it cool completely
4. Stir in almonds and all bran and put into a large storage container

title: thai pork and baby corn stir fry
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large pan or wok , stir-fry pork until browned all over , add paste stir to coat
2. Add lime juice , fish sauce , ginger , sugar and milk stir-fry a few minutes to cook pork through
3. Add capsicum and corn and stir-fry about 4 min's , add spinach and basil , stir-fry tossing until leaves are just wilted

title: italian style mayonnaise
steps: 1. Mix all ingredients together and spread onto your sandwich of choice

title: sweet potato gratin with pecan crumb topping
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 deg f with rack in center position
2. Prick potatoes several times with fork and wrap each in foil
3. Roast until very tender , about 45 minutes
4. Unwrap foil and halve potatoes
5. Scoop out the flesh into a bowl
6. Mash the potatoes with the butter , zest , juices , garlic , allspice and salt to taste
7. Toss together the bread crumbs , pecans , green onions and parmesan in a bowl
8. Reduce the heat to 375 deg f and grease a 1 quart pie plate or other shallow ceramic baking dish
9. Spoon the potatoes into the dish and cover with the crumb mix
10. Bake until the crumbs are golden and the potato mixture is hot , about 30 minutes

title: preserved lemon vinaigrette
steps: 1. In a mixing bowl , stir together all the ingredients

title: mc donald s southern style chicken biscuit
steps:
1. Cut each chicken breast horizontally down the center into 2 pieces , so that you have 4 pieces
2. Place chicken pieces in a bowl and cover with chicken broth
3. Refrigerate and let chicken soak in broth for about 2 hours
4. In a large bowl mix egg and buttermilk
5. Remove chicken pieces from chicken broth and dip in the egg & milk mixture
6. Season chicken with pickling spice or dill , pepper , onion powder , poultry seasoning and monosodium glutamate
7. In a medium skillet or saucepan heat oil to 350 degrees
8. Coat chicken pieces evenly in breadcrumbs
9. Place chicken in oil , and fry for about 15- 25 minutes until chicken is well done , turning chicken pieces once in oil
10. Remove from oil and pat grease off chicken
11. Prepare biscuits as directed on box or package that biscuits came inches
12. Place one chicken breast in each biscuit , and serve

title: johnny cakes
steps:
1. Sift flour , salt , and baking powder
2. Cut in the shortening with a knife and add milk
3. Mix lightly and press in a pan
4. Bake at 350 degrees until light brown for about 30 minutes

title: korean chap chae  vegetarian
steps:
1. Soak chinese mushrooms in 1 cup hot water for 20 minutes
2. When they have softened , cut off the hard stems and slice the caps fine
3. Drop spinach into 10 cups of boiling water and boil rapidly for 2 minutes
4. Drain , run under cold water then squeeze out as much moisture as possible
5. Peel carrot , cut into 3 sections and then into fine julienne strips
6. Wipe off the fresh mushrooms and break off their stems
7. Cut the caps into very fine slices
8. Cut the nonwoody part of the stems into matchstick pieces
9. Cut away and discard the curly , tender part of the cabbage leaves
10. Save only the v-shaped core of the leaves and cut this into julienne strips
11. Cut the scallions into 2 1 / 2 inch sections and quarter the section with the bulb lengthwise
12. Combine the chinese mushrooms , spinach , carrot , zucchini , mushrooms , cabbage , and scallions in a bowl
13. Mix well , separating all the spinach leaves
14. Heat the vegetable oil and the sesame oil in a wok over a medium-high flame
15. When hot , put in the garlic and stir-fry for 10 seconds
16. Add all the vegetables in the bowl
17. Stir-fry for 3 to 4 minutes or until the vegetables are tender-crisp
18. Turn the heat to low , and add the drained noodles , soy sauce , and salt
19. Stir well , distributing the noodles evenly , and cook 2 to 3 minutes
20. Season to taste

title: the burgerdude s burger buns
steps:
1. Place all ingredients except the sesame seeds , egg , and milk into the bread machine as per your machines instructions
2. I have a zojirushi machine
3. I use the homemade setting without the bake cycle
4. It takes 2 hours and 50 minutes , and has two rises
5. When the dough is ready , you will take pinches off the dough about the size of a golf ball
6. Turn the ball into itself so you have one smooth side with a pinched seam at the bottom
7. Flatten into a disk with your hands
8. This disk needs to be no more than a half inch thick
9. Dont worry it will rise
10. Place disk on ungreased cookie sheet
11. Complete until all the dough is gone
12. You should have eight to twelve buns
13. Cover with a towel , keep in a warm place , and let rise until at least doubled in size
14. If you make these using the ingredients above , they will triple in size
15. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f
16. When the dough is ready , prepare the sesame seeds
17. In a hot nonstick skillet , toast while constantly stirring / moving sesame seeds until lightly toasted
18. Remove from heat and from pan
19. Prepare the glaze
20. Beat 1 egg with 1 tbsp milk and set aside
21. Gently brush the tops and sides of the buns with the glaze , and sprinkle with sesame seeds
22. Place sheet in oven and bake for 15 minutes or so until done
23. Your nose will tell you
24. Remove from oven , cover with a clean towel , and let cool for five or ten minutes before slicing
25. Covering and cooling are important steps

title: cajun kabobs
steps:
1. Preheat broiler
2. Line baking tray with foil and spray with cooking spray
3. Place rack about 5-inches from heat
4. Mix garlic , paprika , cayenne , oregano , thyme , 1 / 2 teaspoon salt , and 1 / 4 teaspoon black pepper together in a small bowl
5. Cut chicken into 1-inch pieces
6. Spray chicken with cooking spray and toss them in spice mixture
7. Divide in half and thread on 2 kabob skewers
8. Place olive oil in small bowl and season with salt and pepper
9. Cut zucchini and squash into 2-inch pieces and toss in oil to coat
10. Divide in half and place on 2 skewers
11. Remove tray from oven and place skewers on the foil
12. Return to the oven and broil for 5 minutes
13. Nutritional info per serving
14. 263 cal
15. 42g pro , 7g carbo , 7g fat , 108mg chol , 632mg sodium exchanges - 1 veg , 4
16. 4 meat ,
17. 5 fat

title: raw marinated mushrooms
steps:
1. Place all ingredients except for the mushrooms in a container with a lid that can store the mushrooms
2. Stir well
3. Add the mushrooms , and stir to ensure all mushrooms are coated
4. Store in the fridge , turning the container often so that the mushrooms remain coated
5. Marinate for at least 4 hours
6. Keeps for up to a week

title: sweet and sour pineapple ham steaks
steps:
1. Combine pineapple , vinegar , brown sugar , ketchup and soy sauce in a saucepan and heat to boiling
2. Stir cornstarch with water
3. Stir into sauce and boil 1 minute
4. Spoon over warmed slices of leftover ham
5. Serve extra sauce on the side

title: doctored gefilte fish
steps:
1. In a large dutch oven , place gefilte fish , sprinkle with paprika
2. Cover with vegetables
3. Add reserved liquid
4. Cover and cook over low heat for 1 hour
5. Uncover and cook for 1 / 2 hour
6. Put in refrigerator with all the liquid serve cold with red beet horseradish

title: cupid s cocktail
steps:
1. Shake ingredients and strain into a chilled highball glass
2. Garnish with a slice of orange and a cherry

title: light roasted cauliflower soup
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Combine florets with oil
3. Toss well
4. Add thyme and salt and toss well again
5. Arrange on a jelly-roll pan coated with nonstick spray
6. Bake at 400 1 hour or until golden brown , stirring after 30 minute
7. Combine florets , 2 c broth , and milk in a blender
8. Process 3 min or til smooth
9. Pour pureed mixture into a large saucepan
10. Add remaining broth and pepper
11. Cover over medium until heated
12. Garnish with fresh parsley or fresh thyme , if desired

title: montana wild rice beef stew   with five ingredients
steps:
1. Place mushrooms , carrots , and rice mix with seasoning packet in crockpot and stir to combine
2. Top with beef
3. Pour beef broth over all
4. Cover and cook on lo setting for 8-10 hours
5. This is nice served with garlic toast

title: typically tropical mango chicken
steps:
1. Soak the raisins in the rum for a minimum of 4 hours or overnight
2. Mix the coconut with the milk , set aside
3. In a large skillet , heat 1 tablespoon of the oil and brown the chicken , remove from the pan
4. Heat the other tablespoon of oil , add to the pan: the onion , butternut squash , garlic , scotch bonnet and some salt and pepper , fry for approx 5 minutes on medium heat
5. Now add the ginger and the curry powder , fry for another 5 minutes whilst stirring
6. Add the sweet bell pepper strips , coconut / milk mixture and chicken stock and return the chicken cubes to the skillet
7. Bring to the boil and simmer for 15 minutes
8. Then add the soaked raisins and the mango cubes
9. Heat through , add the lime juice and taste to check if you want to add more
10. Serve with rice and fried slices of plantain

title: crock pot sweet   sour brisket
steps:
1. Place all the ingredients , except the corn starch into a crock pot and cook for 12 hours on low
2. When finished , remove the brisket , shred , and return to the crock pot
3. Mix the corn starch with a tablespoon of water and add to the stew , mix well

title: roast wild duck with blackberry sauce
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Prick skin all over duck , remove as much fat as possible on the domestic bird
3. Rub wild duck with walnut oil or wrap in bacon
4. Domestic duck is more greasy and does not need oil or bacon
5. Stuff 1 / 2 the onions and turnip cubes into the cavity
6. Season cavity with salt and pepper
7. Place duck in roasting pan with about 1 / 2 inch of water on center rack in oven , breast side down
8. Turn breast side up after cooked for 20 minutes and bake about 40 minutes longer , til just done
9. While duck is roasting , place giblets and remaining onions and turnips in a small dutch oven or oven proof saucepan and roast in the oven with the duck til well browned , about 20 minutes
10. Remove dutch oven to the stove top
11. Over medium heat , deglaze the dutch oven in the stock , scraping all the bits stuck to the bottom and sides of the pan
12. Add the seasonings , wine and vinegar
13. Continue to cook til liqid is reduced by 1 / 3 , about 20 minutes
14. Add preserves and blackberries
15. Cook another 10 minutes or until the preserves are melted into the liquid and the berries have cooked down and are soft
16. Strain liquid into a clean sauce pan and set aside
17. Discard the solids strained out
18. Remove roasted duck from the oven and let stand tented under aluminum foil for 15 minutes before carving
19. Reheat sauce just before serving
20. Carve duck or quarter , discarding the stuffing and serve hot with sauce poured over top

title: morning sunshine bars
steps:
1. Set oven to 375 degrees
2. Lightly grease a 13 x 9-inch baking dish
3. In a large mixing bowl whisk together flours , baking powder , cinnamon , baking soda , ginger and salt
4. In another medium bowl whisk together eggs , brown sugar , mashed bananas , yogurt and oil until thoroughly combined
5. Add to the flour mixture
6. Mix to combine
7. Add in the carrots , chopped dried apricots and pecans
8. Using a spatula mix until just combined
9. Spread the batter into prepared baking dish
10. Bake for about 30 minutes , or until baked
11. Cool completely in pan on a wire rack , then cut into bars

title: snickerdoodle coffee cake
steps:
1. Mix together the flour , sugar , baking powder , salt , cinnamon , milk , margarine and egg
2. Pour into a greased and floured 8 or 9 inch square pan
3. Sprinkle top heavily with sugar
4. Bake at 400 degrees for 25 minutes

title: spam  broccoli   cheese wreath
steps:
1. After you have made this once , you can play with the ingredients- i like tons of broccoli and just a little spam and cheese
2. Preheat oven to 375
3. Cut broccoli into bite size pieces
4. Place in large microwaveable bowl
5. Add 2 tablespoons water and the chopped onion
6. Microwave approx 1 1 / 2 minutes
7. Cut spam into tiny cubes and saute in small frying pan just to brown the meat
8. Remove broccoli from microwave , drain the water off and add the mustard , spam& cheese
9. Cover a cookie sheet pan with foil
10. Unroll the crescent rolls and place in a circle on the sheet pan
11. The wide ends of the rolls should be overlapping in the middle with the pointed ends hanging off the side of the pan
12. Place the spam mixture in a circle around the wide ends on the cookie sheet
13. Fold the pointed ends over the mixture and tuck underneath
14. Bake for 25 minutes or until the crescent rolls are golden brown

title: creole salad
steps:
1. Coarsely chop the tomatoes , green pepper and olives
2. Whisk together the remaining ingredients
3. Toss with vegetables

title: balsamic braised chicken
steps:
1. Sprinkle chicken pieces evenly with pepper and salt
2. Cook chicken in hot vegetable oil in a large skillet or dutch oven over medium-high heat 10 minutes or until slightly brown on all sides , turning pieces often
3. Remove chicken from skillet , and drain on paper towels
4. Drain excess oil from skillet
5. Add chopped garlic to skillet , and saute over medium heat 2 minutes
6. Add tomato paste and 1 / 2 cup chicken broth , stirring to loosen particles from bottom of skillet
7. Add 2 / 3 cup balsamic vinegar and 3 tablespoons honey
8. Increase heat to medium-high , and bring glaze to a boil
9. Add chicken , reduce heat to medium-low , and cook , uncovered , turning occasionally , 45 minutes to 1 hour or until chicken is done
10. Spoon balsamic glaze mixture over chicken , and sprinkle evenly with green onion

title: pork chili
steps:
1. Heat the oil over medium heat and fry onion and garlic gently until softened
2. Add pork and chorizo sausage and cook unti pordk changes colour
3. Add the spices , sugar , cocoa , stock powder and sugar and stir cooking for about 1 minute
4. Add the tomato paste to the pan and cook it for a few minutes-i think this takes away the "raw" taste
5. Add the water and tomatoes and simmer for about 1 1 / 2 hours and until it is a nice thick consistency
6. About 15 minutes before serving , add the kidney beans to the chili
7. We like to eat our chili topped with sour cream , grated cheese and pickled jalapenos and sometimes guacomale

title: crock pot polenta
steps:
1. In large bowl combine cornmeal and 2 cups cold water
2. Pour 8 cups boiling water into 4 qt crock pot add salt and butter
3. When butter melts carefully add wet cornmeal stirring
4. Cover and cook on low for 6 to 9 hours , stirring occasionally
5. Transfer polenta mixture to greased loaf pans
6. Chill til cold and firm
7. Remove from pans
8. Wrap individual loaves in foil or slice for desired recipes and carefully place in large freezer bags
9. 1 layer per bag
10. Stack bags after frozen
11. Makes 3 - 4 loaves depending on pan size

title: stacked cheese enchiladas
steps:
1. In a small frying pan , heat about 1 / 4 inch salad oil over medium heat
2. Dip each tortilla into oil and fry a few seconds , until it begins to blister and becomes limp -- be careful not to fry until firm or crisp
3. Add more oil as needed
4. Remove with tongs and drain briefly
5. As soon as you take the tortilla out of the hot fat , dip it into the heated sauce
6. A cake pan just larger than the tortilla is ideal for holding sauce
7. Lay fried and sauced tortilla in a small , shallow , ungreased baking dish
8. Spoon over surface about 2 tablespoons shredded cheddar , about 2 tablespoons chopped green onion , and a little of the chile sauce
9. Add remaining tortillas , preparing each layer the same way
10. Pour remaining sauce over stack , and top with remaining cheese
11. Bake , uncovered , in a 350 oven for 15 to 20 minutes or until hot
12. Cut in wedges to serve

title: campania style mussels
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 250f
2. Pick all mussels , tap all the opened ones and discard those that do not close up after tapping
3. Arrange bread slices on a cookie sheet , drizzle with 1 tablespoon of the olive oil , turn and drizzle on the other side with another 1 tablespoon of oil
4. Place in the oven until lightly toasted , about 10 minutes
5. Remove from oven and let cool
6. In a medium pot with a lid bring white wine , bay leaf and chicken broth to a boil and cook for about 5 minutes
7. Add garlic slices and let cook for another minute
8. Add all mussels at once to boiling pot , and follow with tomatoes , capers and olives
9. Season with some freshly ground pepper
10. Reduce heat to medium
11. Put lid on pot , shake pot vigorously and let cook until mussels are done , no longer than 5 minutes , shaking pot halfway through and using a slotted spoon to mix mussels if needed , pouring juices from below on top of the mussels
12. Once almost all mussels have opened up , turn the heat off and sprinkle with the lemon juice and half of the chopped parsley
13. Mix well and taste liquid in bottom
14. Season with salt and pepper if needed bearing in mind that both the capers and olives will already have added plenty of salt to the dish
15. Discard all mussels whose shells did not open up
16. Serve immediately in 4 large bowls , sprinkle the rest of the parsley on top and place a couple of toasted bread slices on the side to mop up all the liquid
17. If desired , drizzle the remaining 2 tablespoons of olive oil over the mussels
18. Finally , sprinkle each serving with lemon zest

title: mango graham cracker crust
steps:
1. Combine ingredients
2. Pat into 9 inch pie plate
3. Bake at 350 degrees for 15 minutes until firm
4. Cool on wire rack before filling

title: beef buns
steps:
1. Prepare dough: in small bowl or 1-cup measuring cup , combine water , yeast , and 1 / 2 tablespoon sugar
2. Stir to dissolve yeast
3. Let stand until foamy -- about 5 minutes
4. In medium-size bowl , combine 1 1 / 2 cups flour , the remaining 3 tablespoons sugar , and the salt
5. Stir in yeast mixture , eggs , and oil , mixing until combined
6. Turn dough out onto floured surface
7. Knead dough , adding as much of remaining bread flour as necessary to prevent stickiness , until smooth and elastic -- about 8 minutes
8. Wash , dry , and oil mixing bowl
9. Place dough in bowl and turn to bring oiled side up
10. Cover with clean cloth and let dough rise in warm place , away from drafts , until double in size -- about 1 1 / 2 hours
11. Meanwhile , prepare filling: in large skillet , heat oil over medium heat
12. Add gingerroot and saut 1 minute
13. Add garlic and cook 30 seconds
14. Stir in beef , hoisin sauce , soy sauce , paprika , and ground red pepper
15. Cook until beef browns
16. Remove from heat and stir in green onions and sweet red pepper
17. Set aside
18. Grease 2 baking sheets or line with parchment paper
19. When dough has doubled , punch down and shape into a 10-inch-long log
20. With serrated knife , cut log crosswise into ten 1-inch-thick slices
21. On lightly floured surface , roll out one slice to a 4-inch round
22. Roll out or press just around the edge of round so that the middle is slightly thicker and the round is 5 inches wide
23. Fill center of round with 1 heaping tablespoon beef filling
24. Gather up edge to form a pouch and pinch together tightly to seal bun
25. Turn bun over and gently shape into a ball
26. Place seam side down on greased sheet
27. Repeat with remaining slices and filling
28. Cover beef buns with clean cloths or plastic wrap and let rise 30 minutes
29. Meanwhile , prepare egg glaze
30. Heat oven to 350 degrees f
31. Brush buns with egg glaze and sprinkle , if desired , with sesame seeds
32. Bake 20 to 25 minutes or until well browned
33. Cool buns on wire rack
34. Serve warm
35. Egg glaze: in small bowl , beat together 1 large egg and 2 tablespoons milk until blended
36. Refrigerate when not using

title: cheesy broccoli bacon casserole
steps:
1. Make a white sauce with butter , flour , milk and salt and pepper
2. When thickened , add cheese and stir until melted
3. Pour sauce over cooked broccoli in 9" baking dish
4. Top with almonds , bacon and buttered crumbs
5. Bake at 350 degrees for 20 minutes or until bubbly

title: arctic summer cocktail
steps:
1. Add ingredients to an ice-filled highball glass
2. Serve with a cherry and lemon slice

title: murgh makhani  indian butter chicken
steps:
1. Stir the yogurt and tandoori masala powder together in a large bowl until thoroughly combined
2. Add the chicken and toss to coat evenly
3. Marinate in refrigerator for 1 hour
4. Drain and discard any excess marinade
5. Puree the onion , ginger , and garlic with the water in a blender until it forms a smooth paste
6. Set aside
7. Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a large skillet over medium heat
8. Cook the chicken in the hot oil until lightly browned on all sides , about 5 minutes
9. Remove from skillet and set aside
10. Heat the remaining 2 tablespoons in the skillet
11. Fry the onion paste in the hot oil until the moisture is mostly evaporated , about 3 minutes
12. Sprinkle the garam masala and chili powder over the mixture
13. Cook 1 minute more
14. Pour the tomato sauce into the mixture , reduce heat to medium-low , and cook another 5 minutes
15. Return the chicken to the pan along with the half and half
16. Bring to a boil
17. Add the butter , fenugreek leaves , and salt
18. Reduce heat to low and simmer uncovered until the chicken pieces are no longer pink in the middle , 15 to 20 minutes

title: berry pink smoothie
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in the order listed into blender container
2. Cover and blend on high until thick and slushy
3. Pour into two tall glasses
4. Top with whipped cream or nondairy whipped topping and garnish with a fresh strawberry
5. Serve immediately

title: roasted fresh chilies like poblanos jalapenos bell peppers
steps:
1. Stove top the most common method:
2. Place clean and towel dried poblanos right on the open medium flame turning with tongs as it is charred
3. Takes about 5-10 minutes depending on the heat of flame and size of chilies
4. Immediately place in a paper bag or closed container to steam for 15 minutes
5. Called letting the chilies sweat ! this makes the skin easier to remove and cool enough to handle , as they continue to cook
6. On a comal or heavy skillet:
7. Heat skillet to medium high
8. Place chilies on pan turning till charred being careful not to scorch as for they will have a bitter taste
9. Takes about 5-10 minutes depending on the heat of flame and size of chilies
10. Immediately place in a paper bag or closed container to steam for 15 minutes
11. In the broiler:
12. Heat broiler to medium high
13. Lightly brush with oil
14. Place chilies in pan and place in broiler
15. Char as above
16. In oil:
17. This method is used for stuffing them a time saver when making many
18. Heat oil over medium high heat
19. Place 1-2 at a time in oil
20. Using a slotted spoon to turn and fry till golden brown and skins swell about 5-10 seconds
21. Transfer to a bowl of cold water and use finger to peel off the skins
22. I like to dry peel so not to loose any flavor
23. But you can peel the skins under running water but do not soak them
24. Use a parring knife to remove any skin that won`t be finger removed

title: cherry coffee cake
steps:
1. Combine 1 1 / 2 cups cake mix , flour , and yeast in a bowl
2. Add warm water , stirring until smooth
3. Stir in eggs
4. Spoon batter into a greased 13 x9 inch pan
5. Spoon pie filling evenly over batter
6. Set aside
7. Cut butter into remaining cake mix with a fork until mixture is crumbly- sprinkle or pie filling
8. Bake at 350 for 25-30 minutes
9. Cool in pan on wire rack
10. Combine powdered sugar , corn syrup and water for glaze and drizzle over cake

title: mexican tortilla appetizers
steps:
1. Spoon dip over each tortilla using all the dip
2. Spread dip all the way to edges
3. Sprinkle 1 / 4 the chicken over each tortilla
4. Roll up each tortilla
5. Place on plate seam side down
6. Cover with wrap and refrigerate for at least 2 hours
7. Cut each roll into 6 slices
8. Serve with salsa

title: maple bacon pancakes
steps:
1. Cook bacon until crisp
2. Drain on paper towels , then break into 1" pieces
3. Reserve drippings and wipe out skillet
4. Preheat oven to 200 degrees
5. Whisk together flour , baking powder , baking soda , and salt in a medium bowl
6. Whisk together buttermilk , syrup , eggs and butter
7. Add to flour mixture and whisk until just combined
8. Heat 1 teaspoon drippings in skillet over medium-low heat
9. For each pancake , arrange some of the bacon pieces in a circle in skillet
10. Slowly pour 1 / 3 cup batter over bacon , starting in center and moving outward in a swirling motion to prevent bacon from shifting
11. Cook until small bubbles form on surface
12. Flip , and cook until golden brown
13. Transfer finished pancakes to a baking sheet and keep warm in oven
14. Repeat with remaining ingredients
15. Serve with syrup

title: italian chicken  or shrimp  w tomato cream sauce
steps:
1. Cook pasta
2. Cook chicken , onion& garlic in hot oil until no longer pink
3. Drain and return to pan
4. Stir in undrained tomatoes , sauce& seasonings
5. Bring to a boil , simmer uncovered until thickened slowly add cream and stir constantly
6. Serve over pasta
7. You can garnish with black pepper and green onions
8. To help thicken sauce , dredge chicken or seafood in flour prior to cooking it

title: summer vegetable pasta
steps:
1. In large pot of boiling , salted water , cook the pasta until al dente
2. Drain , reserving 1 cup of the pasta cooking water and the pot
3. Meanwhile , in a small skillet , heat 2 t olive oil over medium heat
4. Add half of the garlic and cook until golden , about 30 seconds
5. Stir in the breadcrumbs and remove from the heat
6. In the reserved pasta pot , heat the remaining 2 t olive oil over medium heat
7. Add the remaining garlic and cook until golden , about 30 seconds
8. Add the zucchini and cook , turning occasionally , until crisp-tender , about 5 minutes
9. Stir in the corn , cooked pasta and reserved 1 cup pasta cooking water
10. Add 1 cup cheese and toss
11. Season with salt and pepper
12. Stir the remaining cheese and basil into the breadcrumb mixture and sprinkle on top of the pasta

title: quinoa chicken salad
steps:
1. Rinse quinoa in a seive under cold water very well to remove natural , soapy film residue
2. 1
3. To prepare salad , bring broth to a boil in a medium sauce pan , gradually stir in quinoa
4. Cook 18-20 minutes
5. Remove from heat , transfer to a bowl to cool slightly
6. 2
7. In a cast iron skillet , over medium heat , add pine nuts and shake constantly until golden brown , about 3 minutes
8. 3
9. Add chicken , onions , radishes , cucumber , parsley , and toasted pine nuts
10. , toss gently to combine
11. 4
12. To prepare dressing , combine vinegar , and remaing ingredients stirring with a whisk
13. Drizzle over salad , toss to combine

title: oatmeal breakfast bars
steps:
1. Combine all the dry ingredients and mix well
2. Add mashed bananas , egg , oil and honey and mix well until blended and mixture is sticky
3. Press entire mixture into an 8"x8" pan lined with parchment paper
4. Bake for 20 minutes in a 350 degree oven

title: pineapple and cardamom upside down cake
steps:
1. Combine brown sugar and butter in a heavy-based saucepan and stir over low heat until well combined and smooth
2. Remove from heat and pour into a well-greased , round , 20cm cake tin , spreading evenly
3. Arrange pineapple pieces on top of brown sugar mixture
4. Sift flour , bicarbonate of soda and cardamom into a mixing bowl
5. Add caster sugar , stir and make a well in the centre
6. Melt butter with golden syrup , then pour into the well with eggs and milk
7. Beat thoroughly with a wooden spoon
8. Pour mixture over pineapple pieces and bake at 175c for about 1 hour or until a cake skewer inserted in the centre comes out clean
9. Cover with foil if cake browns before it is cooked through
10. Stand in tin for 5 minutes before turning out onto a plate

title: workperson s roast
steps:
1. Rip out a large sheet of foil-- enough to cover the bottom of baking dish and go over too !
2. I spray foil with pam
3. Place roast in center in the pan on the sheet of foil
4. Cut slits in the roast and push in sections of garlic
5. Pour canned cream soup over roast
6. Add the worcestershire sauce
7. Sprinkle the top with onion soup packet
8. Add salt and pepper
9. Pull foil up and seal across top and ends making sure the roast is sealed tightly but leaving enough space above and around roast
10. Now put in over at 250f and leave in for about 10 hours

title: nutty buddy pumpkin spread
steps:
1. Combine pumpkin , peanut butter , honey , and cinnamon
2. Mix well
3. Chill for one hour
4. Before serving , top with chopped peanuts

title: marzipankartoffeln   german marzipan potatoes
steps:
1. Whirl candy ingredients in the food processor or mix by hand until well blended and sticky
2. Add additional rosewater or orange water a little at a time until the dough forms
3. Form balls containing about a tablespoon each
4. Mix the cocoa powder and cinnamon together in a bowl
5. Roll the "potatoes" in the coating mixture and set aside to dry

title: chicken florentine panini
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375f
2. Unroll dough
3. Place in ungreased 15x10x1-inch baking pan
4. Starting at center , press out dough to edges of pan
5. Bake at 375f for 10 minutes
6. Cool 15 minutes or until completely cooled
7. Meanwhile , cook spinach as directed on package
8. Drain well
9. Squeeze dry with paper towels
10. In small bowl , combine mayonnaise and 1 of the garlic cloves
11. Mix well
12. Refrigerate
13. Heat oil in small saucepan over medium-high heat until hot
14. Add onion
15. Cook and stir 2 to 3 minutes or until crisp-tender
16. Add sugar and vinegar
17. Reduce heat to low
18. Simmer 3 to 5 minutes or until most of liquid has evaporated , stirring occasionally
19. To flatten each chicken breast half , place , boned side up , between 2 pieces of plastic wrap or waxed paper
20. Working from center , gently pound chicken with flat side of meat mallet or rolling pin until about 1 / 4 inch thick
21. Remove wrap
22. Sprinkle chicken with italian seasoning and minced garlic
23. Spray large skillet with nonstick cooking spray
24. Heat over medium-high heat until hot
25. Add chicken
26. Cook 8 minutes or until browned , fork-tender and juices run clear , turning once
27. Cut cooled pizza crust into 4 rectangles
28. Remove rectangles from pan
29. Spread each with 1 tablespoon mayonnaise mixture
30. Top 2 rectangles with chicken , spinach , onion mixture , cheese and remaining crust rectangles , mayonnaise side down
31. Heat large skillet or cast iron skillet over medium heat until hot
32. Place sandwiches in skillet
33. Place smaller skillet on sandwiches to flatten slightly
34. Cook about 1 to 2 minutes or until crisp and heated , turning once
35. Cut each warm sandwich into quarters

title: all american olive burgers
steps:
1. Set aside 2 tablespoons of the chopped olives
2. Combine remaining olives , meat , onion , breadcrumbs and garlic salt
3. Mix well
4. Shape to form four one inch thick patties
5. Grill or pan grill over medium heat 5 minutes per side or until no longer pink in center
6. Combine remaining olives , mayonnaise and tomato
7. Spread over burgers
8. Serve in buns

title: cinna sugar cream cheese spread
steps:
1. Once cream cheese is soft , quickly beat it until it's smooth
2. Beat in brown sugar & cinnamon
3. Can serve immediately or refrigerate for later

title: cavatelli with broccoli and sausage
steps:
1. Fill large pot or dutch oven half way full of water and add salt if desired
2. When water is boiling add pasta , stir often , and cook to al dente
3. Set aside one cup of pasta cooking water before draining
4. Do not rinse pasta
5. Wash and dry broccoli , trim and peel stems , cut into florets
6. Over medium heat in large skillet , brown and mash ground sausage into bite size pieces
7. Transfer sausage to a large serving bowl and add broccoli , oil , garlic , and red pepper flakes to pan
8. Cook for approximately 3 minutes or until garlic is golden brown
9. Add chicken broth and cook another 3 minutes or until broccoli is tender
10. Add mixture to sausage that was set aside
11. Add reserved pasta cooking water as needed to add moisture
12. Season with salt and pepper to taste and add grated cheese if desired

title: lemon blueberry shortcakes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Bake biscuits as directed on package
3. Place on plate
4. Cool in refrigerator 5 to 10 minutes
5. Meanwhile , stir together yogurt , whipped topping and lemon peel
6. To serve , split shortcakes
7. Fill with blueberries and yogurt mixture
8. Sprinkle with powdered sugar

title: nestle s mexican spoon bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f grease 13 x 9-inch baking dish
2. Cook water , corn meal and bouillon in large saucepan over medium-high heat , stirring frequently , until mixture comes to a boil and bouillon is dissolved
3. Boil , stirring constantly , for 1 minute
4. Remove from heat
5. Add beans , cheese , evaporated milk , eggs , jalapeos and butter
6. Stir until blended
7. Pour into prepared dish
8. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean
9. Top with salsa , sour cream , sliced ripe olives and chopped cilantro before serving , if desired

title: cranberry walnut muffins
steps:
1. Pour boiling water over bran and let sit
2. Mix flours , soda and salt in large bowl
3. Cream butter with sugar
4. Add eggs and buttermilk
5. Add to dry ingredients and bran
6. Add oats , nuts and cranberries
7. Mix well
8. Fill in greased muffin tins
9. Bake in batches

title: creamy swiss chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Arrange chicken in a lightly greased 9x13 inch baking dish
3. In a medium bowl , combine the soup , wine , garlic powder , cayenne pepper , mustard seed and sour cream and blend together
4. Set aside
5. Top each chicken breast with a slice of swiss cheese and pour sour cream mixture evenly over the chicken
6. Crush the bag of croutons and sprinkle evenly over all , then drizzle with melted butter
7. Bake at 350 degrees f for 50 minutes , or until chicken is cooked through and juices run clear

title: spanish sangria
steps:
1. In a large pitcher , mix together the first 4 ingredients
2. Cover and refrigerate for several hours or overnight
3. Just before serving , add the club soda and plenty of ice cubes
4. Serve very cold garnished with a slice of fruit

title: stew chicken  belize
steps:
1. Mix the achiote paste with the vinegar and rub it all over the chicken pieces
2. Put the pieces in a large bowl and add the worchestershire , cumin , thyme , oregano and black pepper
3. Chop the onion , pepper and garlic and set aside
4. Melt the coconut oil in a large saucepan
5. When it has melted completely , add the sugar and swirl to distribute
6. Remove the chicken from the bowl , reserving the marinade , and brown both sides in the oil and sugar mixture
7. Add the onions , peppers and garlic
8. Saute until the onions are translucent
9. Add the reserved marinade to the pot and then add enough water to "almost cover" the chicken
10. Let simmer for 40 minutes to an hour , until the chicken is tender and the juices run clear
11. Adjust the seasonings if necessary

title: bean   basil soup
steps:
1. In large saucepan , bring chicken stock to a boil over medium heat
2. Add tomatoes , onion and oregano and simmer about 10 minutes
3. Add beans and continue cooking until onion is tender , about another 10 minutes
4. In blender or food processor , finely chop the garlic and basil
5. Add olive oil and process until combined
6. Using a slotted spoon , transfer half the beans and veggies to the basil mixture
7. Process until smooth , then stir puree back into the soup
8. Cook pasta , reserving 1 cup of cooking water
9. Stir the pasta into the soup and season with salt and pepper
10. If the soup is too thick , thin out with the pasta cooking water
11. Garnish with basil and serve

title: elk stew bourguignon
steps:
1. Cut meat into 1" cubes and pat dry
2. Mix flour , salt and pepper in a bowl or plastic bag
3. Add meat cubes , a few at a time to coat
4. Shake off excess flour and reserve
5. Heat a large heavy pot over medium-high heat and fry bacon until crisp
6. Remove , blot excess fat , chop and reserve
7. Heat olive oil in the same pot and quickly brown meat in batches on all sides
8. Transfer to a large bowl and reserve
9. Reduce heat to medium , add onions , carrots , celery and potatoes
10. Cook , stirring until onions are softened
11. Stir in tomato paste , juniper , thyme and bay leaf , then add wine and wine vinegar
12. Bring to a boil , scraping up browned bits from the bottom
13. Add stock and reserved meat with juices to the pot
14. Return to a boil , then reduce heat , cover and simmer for 2 hours , stirring occasionally until meat is tender
15. Add additional flour to thicken or water to thin to desired gravy consistency
16. Stir in bacon

title: sweet   sour chicken pita burgers
steps:
1. Put the garlic , green onions , cilantro leaves , ginger , pineapple chunks and soy sauce into a food processor and blitz for about 45 seconds to 1 minute until everything is chopped up very finely
2. You want the mixture to almost be a paste
3. Scrape the mixture into a large bowl and set aside
4. Put the raw chicken into the food processor , in batches if necessary , and whiz for a minute or so until it is very finely chopped up and looking close to ground chicken
5. Put into the bowl with the first mixture and add in the breadcrumbs and egg
6. Use your hands to combine all the ingredients , making sure everything gets well mixed in with each other
7. Form into four burger patties and put into the fridge to chill for 30 minutes or longer
8. Once the burgers are ready either cook them in a skillet with a bit of oil for 5 minutes on each side or cook on a foreman type grill for about 10 minutes
9. Either way make sure the chicken is fully cooked before finishing
10. While the burgers are cooking put the pineapple juice into a small bowl and mix with the cornstarch
11. Put to one side
12. Put the ketchup , rice wine vinegar , pineapple chunks , soy sauce and sugar or splenda into a saucepan
13. Turn the burner on to a medium high heat and stir just to combine the ingredients
14. Pour in the pineapple juice mixture and stir until the mixture thickens up
15. This only takes a matter of minutes so keep a close eye on it because it can very easily burn
16. Toast the pita breads and split them open lengthwise
17. Stuff them with whatever you like in your burger
18. We went with just some crisp lettuce
19. Then put one burger into each pita and spoon on the amount of sweet and sour sauce to fit your taste
20. Keep a napkin handy because they can get messy !

title: eggnog kringla cookies
steps:
1. In a bowl combine flour , baking powder and soda , and nutmeg
2. Set aside
3. In a large bowl beat butter and sugar till fluffy
4. Add egg and beat well
5. To the butter / sugar / egg mixture , stir in half of egg nog
6. Then stir in half of flour mixture
7. Stir in remaining eggnog and then flour mixture
8. It will be very stiff
9. Cover and chill at least 2 hours
10. To make them quickly , drop them by small spoonfuls on a baking sheet
11. To make them in the traditional manner: working with 1 / 3 of dough at time , separate dough into 1-inch balls and roll between floured hands into a pencil-like shape , about as long as your hand
12. On a baking sheet loop one end over the other to form an oval with two ends overlapping
13. Bake at 350 for 8-12 minutes before edges brown
14. They won't look done , but they are
15. Sprinkle with nutmeg and powdered sugar

title: easy szechuan style linguine noodles
steps:
1. Cook the noodles in a large pot of boiling salted water until just tender
2. Drain and return the noodls to the pot
3. Mix in about 1 tablespoon sesame oil with the chopped peanuts
4. In a skillet heat about 3 tablespoons sesame oil over medium-low heat
5. Add in ginger garlic and chopped red pepper saute for about 2 minutes
6. Add in the teriyaki sauce , lime juice and chili sauce
7. Simmer about 1 minute
8. Add the sauce to the cooked noodles along with the green onions
9. Toss to coat
10. Season with salt and pepper

title: penne with cannellini beans
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to package directions
2. In large saucepan , combine the tomatoes and beans , and bring to a boil
3. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 10 minutes
4. Add spinach , cook and stir for 2 minutes , or until spinach is wilted
5. Drain pasta , top with the tomato mixture
6. Sprinkle with cheese

title: quick and easy no bake chocolate cookies
steps:
1. Mix first four ingredients
2. Bring to a boil , boil 1 minute
3. Remove from heat and add vanilla and peanut butter
4. Stir until well blended
5. Stir in oatmeal
6. Drop by spoonfuls onto waxed paper
7. Store in refrigerator or freezer

title: wheat sweets
steps:
1. Combine both flours , salt and baking powder and reserve
2. In a separate bowl cream butter , sugar and vanilla
3. Blend the reserved dry ingredients into the butter mixture using a fork or pastry blender
4. Sprinkle the water over the mixture , stirring with a fork until the dough is moist enough to hold together
5. Do not use more water than necessary
6. Roll out to 1 / 8-inch thickness
7. Cut with cookie cutters
8. Place on greased baking sheets
9. Bake in a pre-heated 350 degree oven 14 to 17 minutes
10. Cool on racks
11. Frost when cool
12. To make the frosting: combine the powdered sugar , vanilla and butter
13. Blend in enough milk to reach desired consistency

title: 15 minute chili and rice wraps
steps:
1. Bring chili and water to boil in medium saucepan
2. Stir in rice
3. Cover
4. Cook over low heat for 5 minutes
5. Spoon approx 1 / 2 cup chili mixture onto each tortilla
6. Top with cheese and sour cream , and fold up

title: sugar free maple cookies
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl , combine butter , sour cream , apple , eggs , maple flavoring and vanilla
2. Combine flour , splenda , baking soda and baking powder
3. Add to apple mixture and mix well
4. Drop by heaping tablespoonfuls onto baking sheets coated with nonstick cooking spray or parchment paper
5. Bake at 375 degrees f for 9-10 minutes or until lightly browned
6. Cool on wire racks

title: honey crusted chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Lightly coat a small baking dish with cooking spray
3. In a small bowl , crush the crackers
4. Add the paprika and stir to mix well
5. Brush 1 teaspoons honey on each side of the chicken breasts
6. Dredge the chicken through the cracker mixture , coating both sides
7. Place the chicken in the prepared baking dish
8. Bake until lightly browned and cooked through , about 20-25 minutes
9. Serve immediately

title: chocolate chip oatmeal cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Pour boiling water over rolled oats and let stand 20 minutes
3. Beat butter until creamy
4. Gradually add sugars beating until fluffy
5. Blend in vanilla and eggs
6. Add softened oatmeal and mix well
7. Set aside
8. In medium bowl , combine flour , salt , baking soda , cinnamon and nutmeg
9. Add dry ingredients to creamy mixture
10. Stir in 1 cup dark chocolate chips and 1 / 4 cup toffee bits
11. Pour batter in 9x13 greased pan
12. Sprinkle remaining chocolate chips
13. Toffee bits and pecans on top of cake
14. Bake for 45 minutes

title: low carb ham and black bean soup
steps:
1. In a large pot combine all ingredients
2. Bring to a boil - reduce heat and allow soup to gently simmer for approximately 2 hours stirring occasionally
3. The closer to 2 hours this soup cooks the better it tastes
4. Approximately 6 grams of carbs per serving

title: sweet braised chicken
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees
2. Mix the liquid ingredients in a small oven proof lidded bowl
3. Place the chicken in upside down and marinate 30 minutes
4. Turn the chicken over and cover the bowl
5. Braise for 1 hour
6. Serve over a bed of rice with additional sauce ladled over it

title: low carb   campbell s  tomato soup
steps:
1. Mix all the ingredients together in a saucepan
2. Heat and serve

title: rice with pigeon peas   arroz con gandules
steps:
1. 1
2. Heat olive oil in a 6-quart pot
3. Saute the sofrito and chopped ham for 1 minute
4. 2
5. Add the rice , water , sazon and pigeon peas
6. 3
7. Bring to a boil
8. Let boil for 2 to 3 minutes
9. 4
10. Cover , reduce heat to medium low , and cook for 35 to 40 minutes
11. Never lift the lid while cooking
12. 5
13. When finished cooking , stir the rice before serving
14. It should be light and fluffy

title: grandma s crock pot spaghetti sauce
steps:
1. In heated heavy skillet break up ground beef and sausage cook chopping up large pieces til meat is no longer pink , drain off fat
2. Saute seasonings and vegetables in olive oil for 3 to 4 minutes
3. Scrape into crock pot , add meat and remaining ingredients to crock pot , stir well
4. Turn crock pot on low simmer 8-12 hours
5. Stirring occasionally
6. Serve over cooked spaghetti

title: pumpkin pie with streusel topping   shortbread crust
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Crust- mix flour sugar , orange zest , and salt in a bowl on low speed for 30 seconds
3. Add butter on low speed until mixture looks crumbly
4. I use a pastry cutter
5. Add egg and cream , mixing on low speed til dough is just combined
6. Mold dough into a 1-inch-thick disk and wrap in plastic wrap
7. Refrigerate at least 1 hour or for up to a week
8. Filling - place pumpkin into a bowl and whisk in the eggs one at a time
9. Add both sugars , flour , ginger , cinnamon , cloves and salt and whisk about 30 seconds
10. Whisk in heavy cream and bourbon
11. Struesel topping - combine flour , both sugars , cinnamon , and salt in a food processor or bowl
12. Add the butter and pulse until butter has blended and mixture is crumbly
13. Stir in the walnuts and crystallized ginger
14. Assemble the tart
15. Unwrap dough and let it warm up until it is pliable
16. Roll the disk into a 13 inch round and drape around a 10 inch tart pan
17. Pour the pumpkin mixture into the unbaked tart crust
18. Scatter the struesel topping evenly over the pumpkin mixture
19. Bake until the topping is evenly cooked and no longer looks set in the center
20. Let the tart cool for at least 2 hours before serving
21. Serve with lightly sweetend whip cream or with vanilla ice cream

title: spinach   tortellini soup
steps:
1. In large saucepan heat olive oil and saute garlic
2. Add chicken stock and bring to a boil
3. Add pasta and cook until desired tenderness
4. Add beans and heat
5. Add spinach
6. The heat should cook the spinach
7. Add seasonings
8. Ladle into bowls and sprinkle with parmesan cheese

title: french toasted hot dog buns
steps:
1. Pre-heat an oven to 150 - 175 degrees
2. Heat a pan & coat it in butter
3. Mix eggs , milk , vanilla extract in a square bowl
4. Cut the buns on their seam , so you have 8 pieces of bread
5. Dip each bun half in the mix & then drip excess mix back in to bowl
6. Place each bun half about an inch apart on your pan
7. Sprinkle cinnamon sugar on each side
8. Then place the finished pieces on a cookie sheet in the oven
9. Com is super mobile friendly !

title: dr  oz s green drink
steps:
1. Put all ingredients in blender and blend until smooth
2. This recipe makes 28 to 30 ounces or about three to four servings
3. This will be very thick and you may need to add water - if you have a juicer this may work better
4. The green drink has a strong taste and if you are used to drinking soda or sweet tea , the taste will take some getting used to
5. Dr
6. Oz suggests adding other items at first to sweeten the green drink to your taste

title: tex mex carnitas
steps:
1. Cook pork roast 3 hours at 325
2. Cool
3. Shred meat , discarding any fat
4. Place shredded meat , taco seasoning , water and green chilies in a large saucepan and simmer over low heat for 2 hours
5. When ready to serve , steam tortillas to soften
6. Place a generous portion of shredded pork mixture on each tortilla and fold over
7. May be served with refried beans , guacamole , shredded lettus , shredded cheese , sour cream , pico de gallo , picante sauce , or any other garnish of your choice

title: tuscan style slow roasted spareribs with balsamic glaze
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine the olive oil , rosemary , kosher salt , black pepper , sage , thyme , paprika , crushed red pepper , coriander and allspice
2. Rub the spice paste all over the spareribs and let stand at room temperature for 2 hours or refrigerate overnight
3. Preheat the oven to 325
4. Arrange the ribs on a large , rimmed baking sheet or roasting pan , meaty side up
5. Roast the ribs for 2 hours , or until tender
6. Preheat the broiler
7. Brush the meaty side of the ribs with the balsamic vinegar and broil 6 inches from the heat until browned , about 2 minutes
8. Let stand for 5 minutes , then cut between the ribs and serve

title: california chicken wraps
steps:
1. Spread hummus on tortillas
2. Top with chicken , peppers , cheese , basil , and kalamata
3. Roll up

title: tofu with pineapple
steps:
1. Cut drained tofu into small cubes
2. Drain syrup from the pineapple , retaining 1 tbsp of it
3. Dissolve cornflour in this
4. Stir in sherry and soy sauce
5. Add tofu and let stand for 15 minutes
6. Heat oil in a wok and stir fry the marinated tofu till the liquid has been absorbed
7. Remove and drain
8. Add a little more oil and stir-fry the green onion , bean sprouts and pineapple for 1 minute
9. Add tofu , cook for 2 minutes
10. Serve with boiled rice

title: pumpkin salad  tirshi
steps:
1. Cut the the pumpkin in half
2. Place cut side down on a foil-lined baking sheet
3. Bake at 350f for 1 hour or until tender
4. Separate pulp from skin and seeds
5. Mash pulp to make pure
6. Mix pumpkin pure with remaining ingredients , blending well
7. Refrigerate
8. Serve chilled with cous cous

title: acorn squash with bacon  apple and swiss
steps:
1. Halve squash
2. Remove seeds and pulp
3. Place squash , cut side down , in a shallow baking dish
4. Add water
5. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes
6. In a medium saute or sauce pan over medium heat , cook bacon until some fat is rendered
7. Add onion and saute / sweat for 3 minutes-ish
8. Add sage , rosemary , thyme , and pepper
9. Add apple and saute / sweat for 2 minutes-ish
10. Add garlic and saute / sweat for 2 minutes-ish
11. Drain if needed
12. Stir in stuffing mix and water
13. Once stuffing mix is moist , stir in cheese
14. Spoon stuffing into prepared squash
15. Cover with loosely with foil
16. Bake about 20 minutes more
17. I removed foil
18. Topped with optional topping and baked for last five minutes
19. Optional topping:
20. Mix bread crumbs and olive oil
21. Mix in parsley and green onions

title: tuna and coleslaw wrap
steps:
1. In a bowl , add the tuna , cabbage , pineapple , and dressing
2. Stir to mix evenly
3. Top each tortilla with one-fourth of the mixture
4. Fold both sides of tortilla up over the filling and roll to close

title: shepherd s casserole
steps:
1. Cook beef and onion until meat loses redness
2. Drain fat
