3. Stir in green beans , hunt's sauce and 1 / 2 cup cheese
4. Pour in shallow 10" x 6" x 2" casserole
5. Spread mashed potatoes over meat mixture
6. Sprinkle remaining cheese over top
7. Bake at 375 degrees for 20 minutes

title: raspberry topped lemon pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 deg
2. In saucepan , combine raspberries and cornstarch
3. Cook and stir until thickened
4. In bowl , beat egg yolk
5. Stir in sweetened condensed milk , realemon juice and food coloring if desired
6. Pour over crust
7. Bake 8 minutes
8. Spoon raspberry mixture over top
9. Chill 4 hours
10. Spread with whipped topping
11. Garnish as desired
12. Refrigerate leftovers

title: sweet peat
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Melt chocolate with water , set aside
3. Beat egg whites until stiff
4. Cream together sugar , egg yolks and butter
5. Cream in molten chocolate
6. Stir in flour , salt and baking powder
7. Fold in stiff egg whites
8. Pour into greased 9x13'' pan
9. Bake about 25-30 minutes , cut into small cubes while warm
10. Store in airtight container after completely cooled
11. Store in cool place - as they're very moist you can't keep them too long
12. Well , you won't be able to store them long anyway --
13. Fix a post-it on the lid with the emergency number - just in case
14. Enjoy !

title: sole fish layered casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f degres
2. Saute onions in oil until trasparent and slightly browned , add spinach and heat just until wilted
3. Spray an 8 x 8 inch glass dish with veggie spray
4. Place macaroni on bottom of dish to cover the bottom
5. Place slices of tomato in one layer over macaroni
6. Sprinkle salt and pepper to taste
7. Sprinkle 1 / 4 cup cheddar over tomatoes
8. Add onion and spinach mix and spread evenly over
9. Lay sole pieces in one layer over spinach mix
10. Season with salt and pepper to taste
11. Sprinkle the other quarter cup of cheddar cheese over top
12. Bake for 30 minutes or until fish is cooked through and flaky

title: citrus salad spray
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in a bottle and shake well to blend
2. The seeds will settle to the bottom of the bottle , so don't worry about putting this in a spray bottle
3. Enjoy !

title: easy  cheesy artichoke appetizer
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Unroll both cans of crescent roll dough onto a jelly roll pan
3. Press into sides and bottom , until pan is covered with a solid crust
4. Bake for 10 minutes
5. Combine remaining ingredients , mixing well
6. Spread evenly onto the baked crust
7. Bake for 15 minutes , or until cheeses are melted
8. Allow to stand 5 minutes before cutting into squares to serve

title: guacamole   the right way
steps:
1. Grind spices together with mortar & pestle
2. Add to rest of ingredients , partially mashing the avocado leaving at least in good-sized chunks
3. Cover tightly with plastic wrap and chill overnight
4. Taste for seasonings , then sprinkle with a bit more paprika , some more fresh cilantro leaves and diced red onion on top , and serve with tortilla chips

title: pecan crescent twists
steps:
1. Unroll crescent rolls and separate each can into 4 rectangles , pressing perforations to seal
2. Brush evenly with 4 tablespoons of melted butter
3. Stir together pecans and next 3 ingredients
4. Sprinkle 1 tablespoon of mixture on each rectangle
5. Pressing gently , roll up starting at the long side and twist
6. Cut 6 shallow -inch long diagonal slits into each roll
7. Shape into rings , pressing ends together
8. Place on lightly greased baking dish
9. Brush the twist with remaining 2 tablespoons butter
10. Bake at 375f for 12 minutes or until golden brown
11. Stir powdered sugar and syrup together and drizzle over warm twist

title: lentil and wild rice loaf
steps:
1. Put lentils , brown and wild rice and veggie broth in a covered pan
2. Get it boiling on a higher heat and then turn down to low and cook until the rice is cooked and the liquid is absorbed , but the result is still somewhat wet and mushy , not dry
3. This will be approximately an hour
4. I usually watch this as it's cooking and add more broth as needed
5. While lentils and rice are cooking , heat oil in a separate pan and saute onions , garlic and carrot
6. Add steamed broccoli , cook another minute and then season with basil , salt and pepper to taste
7. This will be mixed with the other ingredients , so you'll want to be a bit generous with the spices
8. Add the lentil / rice mixture to the vegetable mixture when both are done
9. Add cashews
10. Mix everything together well
11. Put mixture into a greased loaf pan
12. Bake at 350 for 30 minutes covered and 15 minutes uncovered
13. Serve with cashew gravy

title: pumpkin   pesto penne
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large frying pan over moderate heat
2. Add leek
3. Cook , stirring for 5 minutes or until soft
4. Add garlic
5. Cook for 1 - 2 minutes or until fragrant
6. Stir in pumpkin and stock
7. Cook , covered for 5 minutes or until pumpkin is tender
8. Stir in tomatoes
9. Cook for 5 minutes , stirring occasionally
10. Meanwhile , cook pasta in a large saucepan or boiling salted water for 10 - 12 minutes or until tender
11. Drain
12. Return pasta to pan
13. Add pumpkin mixture and pesto to pasta
14. Season with salt and pepper
15. Toss to combine
16. Gently fold in ricotta
17. Spoon into shallow serving bowls
18. Serve at once

title: peach pie quick bread
steps:
1. Heat chopped pecans in a small non-stick skillet over medium-low heat , stirring often 5 to 8 minutes or until toasted
2. Stir together flour and next 3 ingredients in bowl of an electric mixer
3. Whisk together sugar , oil , and eggs
4. Gradually add sugar mixture to flour mixture , beating at low speed until blended
5. Stir in vanilla
6. Fold in fruit filling and pecans just until blended
7. Pour batter into 2 greased loaf pans
8. Bake at 350 for 45 minutes
9. Shield with aluminum foil to prevent excessive browning , if necessary , and bake 15 more minutes or until a long wooden pick inserted into the center comes out clean
10. Cool loaves in pans on a wire rack 10 minutes
11. Remove from pans to wire rack , cool 15 minutes

title: scrambled bread
steps:
1. Melt butter in frying pan
2. Add the bread and saute until golden brown
3. Add remaining ingredients and scramble until fluffy

title: penne with sun dried tomato pesto
steps:
1. Cook the pasta in a large pot of boiling salted water until tender but still firm to the bite , stirring occasionally , about 8 minutes
2. Drain , reserving 1 cup of the cooking liquid
3. Meanwhile , blend the sun-dried tomatoes and their oil , garlic , salt and pepper , to taste , and basil in a food processor and blend until the tomatoes are finely chopped
4. Transfer the tomato mixture to a large bowl
5. Stir in the parmesan
6. Add the pasta to the pesto and toss to coat , adding enough reserved cooking liquid to moisten
7. Season the pasta , to taste , with salt and pepper and serve

title: honey mustard chicken with roast vegetables  ww aust  5 5 pnts
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 200c line base of a large roasting pan with baking paper and set aside
2. Heat a large non-stick frying pan over high heat
3. Spray chicken with oil and cook for 2 minutes each side to brown
4. Remove from pan and set aside
5. Meanwhile , combine honey , rosemary , mustards and vinegar in a bowl
6. Season to taste with salt and pepper
7. Arrange carrots , parsnips and onions in roasting pan and toss with olive oil
8. Roast vegetables in the preheated oven for 40 minutes , turning once
9. Arrange chicken amongst vegies
10. Spoon over marinade and roast for a further 15 minutes , or until chicken and vegies are golden and cooked through
11. Set aside to rest for 5 minutes
12. Slice chicken into 4 pieces and serve with roasted vegetables

title: cabbage paratha
steps:
1. Grate the cabbage and finely chop the green chillies & coriander leaves
2. Take the wheat flour in a bowl , add the ghee and mix
3. Add the grated cabbage , ginger , tomato , coriander leaves , green chillies & salt
4. Knead & make a dough by adding small amount of water as needed
5. Make 6-8 balls , roll them into round parathas with a rolling pin
6. Roast them on both sides on a tawa by adding oil to it
7. Serve hot with pickles or curd

title: pineapple passion smoothie
steps:
1. Put all the ingredients in a blender and blend well for about 1 minute
2. Pour the smoothies into fancy glasses and add straws
3. Place a wedge of pineapple on the rim of the glass and serve promptly

title: dallaspulla   awesome finnish pastry
steps:
1. Prepare filling by mixing ingredients into a smooth paste
2. Refrigerate until needed
3. In a saucepan over low heat , warm the milk and butter to about 40c / 104f
4. In a bowl , crumble the yeast into the warm milk and butter mixture
5. Add sugar , salt and egg
6. Mix together well until the yeast is dissolved
7. Add flour gradually until the dough forms a ball
8. Add more flour only if it's still sticky and add only a little at a time
9. Knead dough for about 5 minutes until smooth and elastic
10. Place a towel over the bowl and let the dough double in a warm , draft-free place for about 30 minutes to 1 hour [warming the oven to ~40c / 100f works very well as a proofing box]
11. Turn dough out onto lightly floured work surface
12. Gently shape dough into rough rectangle with long side nearest you
13. Lightly flour dough and roll into a 16-inch x 12-inch rectangle
14. Spread filling on the dough leaving a 1cm /
15. 5in border on the far edge
16. Beginning with long edge nearest you , roll dough into taut cylinder
17. Firmly pinch seam to seal and roll cylinder seam-side down
18. Very gently stretch and roll to cylinder of even diameter and 18-inch / 45cm length
19. Push ends in to create even thickness
20. Using a sharp serrated knife and gentle sawing motion , slice cylinder in half , then slice each half in half again to create evenly sized quarters
21. Slice 3 , 8cm / 1
22. 5in pieces from the rolls and place into a rectangular pan using a spatula
23. Cover with a towel and allow to rise for about 30 minutes while the oven warms to baking temperature
24. Make icing
25. Bake in a pre-heated oven at 200-225c / 390-435f for about 13-15 minutes
26. Cut pulla apart and drizzle icing over the tops
27. Try not to eat them all in one sitting
28. :)

title: blackberry batter pudding
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Arrange berries in the bottom of a greased 10" baking dish
3. Combine eggs , egg yolks , flour , sugar , salt and milk in a blender or food processor
4. Process until well mixed
5. Pour batter over berries
6. Place dish on a baking sheet
7. Bake for 30-40 minutes , or until puffed and golden
8. Remove from oven and cool
9. Batter may sink a little
10. Just before serving , spoon brandy over top and dust with powdered sugar

title: turkey swedish meatballs
steps:
1. Combine the turkey breast with the egg , breadcrumbs , and seasonings and form into 10 little meatballs
2. Place on foil lined cookie sheet and bake at 375f for 20-25 minutes
3. Meanwhile , prepare the egg noodles and brown gravy mix according to the packaging
4. When the noodles are cooked , drain well and return to the pot
5. Mix in the brown gravy and stir well
6. Remove the meatballs from the cookie sheet and divide the noodles and meatballs into bowls
7. Serve and enjoy !

title: strawberry oatmeal cookies
steps:
1. Oven at 375 degrees f
2. In bowl , mix oat bran , flour , cinnamon , nutmeg , baking soda , butter buds , sugars , ad salt
3. Add oats
4. In another bowl , combine oil , milk , yoghurt , egg whites and vanilla
5. Combine dry and wet ingredients very well
6. Drop tablespoon pieces of dough into cookie tray with cooking spray
7. Bake for 15 minutes , or until cookies are golden

title: wilma s mexican casserole
steps:
1. Brown meat with onions , drain fat
2. Add all the remaining ingredients except the cheese and tortillas
3. Grease a large casserole dish
4. Now alternate torn tortillas , the meat and soup mixture then the cheese
5. You can do this twice
6. I like to end with the cheese or save some of the cheese for the top
7. Top with remaining cheese
8. Bake in 350 oven for 30 minutes

title: gluten free 2 minute fudge
steps:
1. In a 1-1 / 2-quart casserole , stir together sugar , cocoa , salt , milk , and vanilla until partially blended
2. Put butter or margarine over top in center of dish
3. Microwave on high power 2 minutes
4. Stir well until smooth
5. Pour into a greased 8-inch square dish
6. Chill about 1 hour

title: mama vi s spinach salad with curry and chutney dressing
steps:
1. Make salad dressing with first seven ingredients , blending to make the salad dressing in a food processor
2. Set dressing aside , cover and chill in the refrigerator for later use
3. Prepare the vegetables by tearing the fresh spinach leaves into bite sized pieces
4. Dice the apple into bite size pieces
5. Dice the green onions
6. Measure out raisins and peanuts
7. In a large salad serving bowl , place torn fresh spinach , apple bits , raisins , peanuts and diced green onion
8. Dress the salad veggies pouring over them the desired amount of dressing you find appropriate to start with , and lightly toss to coat the salad
9. Serve immediately
10. Salad wilts and gets soggy if not eaten right away , when prepared

title: asian noodles with asparagus and shrimp
steps:
1. Cook noodles according to package directions , omitting salt and fat
2. Meanwhile , combine chicken broth and the next 6 ingredients , stirring well
3. Heat vegetable oil in a large nonstick skillet over med-high heat
4. Add in garlic
5. Stir / saute 45 seconds
6. Add in asparagus
7. Stir / saute 2 minutes
8. Add in shrimp and stir / saute 2 minutes or until shrimp are done
9. Add in broth mixture and onions to pan
10. Cook over medium heat until hot
11. Add in noodles , tossing gently to coat

title: lemony angel hair w   parmesan and artichoke hearts
steps:
1. Fill large pot with water and bring to boil
2. Add one tablespoon salt , then add pasta and cook according to package directions
3. Separate the watercress leaves from their stems and combine leaves with the parmesan and artichokes hearts and set aside
4. Drain pasta after it cooks , reserving 2 tablespoons of pasta water
5. Quickly return drained pasta to warm pot and stir in lemon juice and the reserved pasta water
6. Mix pasta with crme frache then add watercress mixture
7. Salt to taste and serve warm

title: spinach rockefeller roulades
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. In 5 quart heavy dutch oven heat butter over medium heat
3. Add onions , celery , bell peppers , jalapenos and tasso
4. Saute for 5 minutes or until vegetables are soft
5. Add spinach to vegetables mixing well and cooking for approximately 5 minutes
6. Add flour , stirring well
7. Add heavy whipping cream and cheese
8. Season to taste with salt , pepper , and hot sauce
9. When cheese has melted remove from heat and allow to cool
10. Remove puff pastry sheets from freezer and let thaw for approximately 5-10 minutes
11. Cut pastry sheets into 6 pieces , four inches square each
12. Spoon approximately 2 tablespoons of the spinach mixture into the center of the pastry square and spread evenly from end to end
13. Roll , jelly roll style , making sure that the seam end is well sealed
14. Please seam side down on large baking sheet and continue with remaining sheets
15. Brush top lightly with egg
16. Bake until golden brown approximately 15-20 minutes
17. Slice in 1 / 2 inch slices for an hors d'ouvres

title: austin s chili
steps:
1. Over medium heat brown the bacon & the onion together
2. When the onions are carmelized add the balsamic vinegar & worchestershire sauce
3. Mix well , as you are mixing add in the brown sugar , dry mustard , & paprika
4. Then the jalapenos , carrot , ancho pepper , the granny smith apple , & the green pepper
5. Stir often don't let it burn
6. When everything is cooked pull from heat & set aside
7. In large pot brown the grnd beef , sausage & venison
8. Use a spatula if you need to , but break the meat into small chunks
9. When completely browned , drain the grease in a colander & return the meat to the pot
10. Then blend in the mixture you created earlier
11. When blended add in the chili beans , tomato puree , sauce & paste
12. Blend well and return to medium heat for about 35 minutes to an hour
13. Don't let it burn on the bottom of the pot so stir often
14. When cooked to your satisfaction this can be used over pasta , as taco filling , or placed in large flour tortillas with shredded cheese to make burritos or by it's self
15. If it isn't spicy enough use your favorite hot sauce to crank up the heat
16. I found one that i like called tapatio salsa picante

title: the greatest pinto beans
steps:
1. Sort out any dark , oddly shaped or broken beans and rinse beans well
2. Cover beans in water in a stock pot and bring to a boil , drain
3. Cover with water again , about 2 above beans
4. Add all remaining ingredients except salt
5. Bring to a boil
6. Reduce heat to low and simmer covered until beans are soft
7. Add more water only if necessary
8. Boil for approximately 2
9. 5 - 3 hours
10. The last half hour check often , the beans will start to stick to the bottom of the pot when theyre done
11. Season with sea salt to taste
12. To make refried beans take 4 cups beans and strain out excess juice
13. Heat 2 tbs vegetable oil in a skillet
14. Add beans and start mashing & stirring rapidly until beans are almost smooth
15. Try with my steak picado recipe for a fantastic burrito !

title: broccoli   bacon quiche
steps:
1. Bake pie crustf at 400 for 10 minutes , cool
2. In a large bowl , combine broccoli , onion , bacon , and cheeses
3. Season with salt & pepper
4. Place into cooked crust
5. In medium bowl , combine eggs , sour cream , thyme , and worcestershire
6. Pour over broccoli mixture in crust
7. Bake at 400f for 40 minutes , or until knife inserted in center comes out clean

title: whole wheat banana nut muffins
steps:
1. Peel the bananas and add to mixer - turned on medium speed
2. Begin adding wet ingredients
3. In another bowl place all dry ingredients and stir together
4. Slowly begin adding to mixture in bowl
5. Once this is all mixed together spoon into greased muffin pans 3 / 4 of the way up
6. Bake at 350 degrees for 20 minutes

title: chicken parmesan with basil
steps:
1. Combine breadcrumbs , cheese & parsley
2. Cook bacon until crisp & add to breadcrumb mixture
3. Melt butter in a saucepanj , add garlic , worcestershire sauce and mustard
4. Mix well
5. Dip chicken fillets in butter mixture and place in an ovenproof dish
6. Press crumb mixture on top of each fillet
7. Bake at 180
8. C for 20-25 minutes
9. Prepare sauce: combine all ingredients except egg yolk & stir until heated through
10. Add egg yolk & stir until sauce thickens but do not allow to boil
11. Serve fillets with sauce

title: coconut crumb cake  made with vanilla wafers
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325f grease and flour a bundt pan - i used the pam cooking spray with flour already in it
2. Place vanilla wafers in a food processor and pulse until you end up with fine crumbs
3. Combine crumbs with coconut , sugar and pecans in a large bowl
4. Mix
5. In a medium bowl , whisk eggs , butter and milk together
6. Pour egg mixture over dry ingredients and mix well
7. Batter will be thick
8. Pour batter into prepared pan
9. Bake 1 hour and 35 minutes

title: spicy peanut coconut shrimp
steps:
1. Roast the coconut in a small nonstick skillet over medium-high heat 2-3 minutes until golden , stirring constantly
2. Immediately remove from skillet
3. Heat oil in large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
4. Add shrimp and red pepper flakes
5. Stir-fry 3-4 minutes until shrimp are pink and opaque
6. Add cilantro
7. Toss well and transfer to serving plates
8. Top each serving with 1 tablespoons toasted coconut and 1 tablespoons chopped peanuts
9. Garnish with lime wedges

title: melomel   honey mead
steps:
1. Mix ingredients in a glass or ceramic bowl
2. Cover with layers of cheesecloth or a towel
3. Put bowl in a warm place and stir once a day to incorporate yeast from the air
4. Start tasting when the mixture gets bubbly
5. When it is to your taste strain and refrigerate or strain bottle and age
6. If aging put a balloon on top of bottle and regularly release when full of co2

title: janet millard s party perfect potatoes
steps:
1. Boil potatoes , and allow to cool
2. Peel and shred potatoes
3. Place potatoes in 9"x13" casserole dish
4. Melt butter in 2-quart sauce pan
5. Add onions and saute
6. Add soup , sour cream and cheese
7. Pour sauce over potatoes in casserole dish
8. Top with corn flakes
9. Bake to 300f for 30 to 45 minutes or until heated through

title: chinese style fried rice
steps:
1. Bring water to boil in a small saucepan
2. Stir in instant rice
3. Remove from heat , cover , and let stand 5 minutes
4. In a skillet , melt butter and lightly cook egg
5. Add onion and rice and saute , stirring , over medium heat until mixture is slightly browned
6. Mix water with soy sauce and stir into rice
7. Cover and cook until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed
8. Serves 4

title: easy red cabbage and apple saut
steps:
1. Shred cabbage and place in a large saucepan or a pot
2. Add in remaining ingredients
3. Bring to a boil , reduce heat and cover
4. Simmer for about 1 hour , stirring occasionally
5. Adjust all ingredients to taste

title: kittencal s crock pot french dip roast
steps:
1. Trim all visible fat from the roast then using a fork poke deep holes all over the meat
2. Place the beef roast in the crock pot
3. In a bowl combine the soy sauce , beef broth , black pepper , thyme , onion powder or onion flakes and fresh garlic or garlic powder
4. Pour the mixture over the roast
5. Place the bay leaf into the crock pot
6. Add in enough water to almost cover the roast then mix to combine
7. Cover and cook on high setting for 2 hours
8. Reduce the setting to low and continue to cook for about 5 hours more or until the meat is very tender
9. After cooking skim off the fat that has accumulated on the top
10. Remove the gravy and reserve
11. Discard the bay leaf
12. Shred the meat with a fork or slice thinly
13. Divide / pile the meat onto the rolls
14. Serve as sandwiches , then serve the reserved broth for a dipping

title: mushroom stuffed eggplant  aubergine
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Halve the eggplant lengthwise
3. With a serrated spoon or a knife , scoop out pulp of eggplant , leaving about a 1 / 2" shell
4. Place shells on a lightly sprayed cookie sheet and bake in oven for about 10-12 minutes
5. While eggplant shells are in oven , finely chop the eggplant pulp
6. In a pan , over medium heat , melt butter
7. Add eggplant pulp , onion , parsley , salt , oregano , garlic and mushrooms
8. Cover and saut , stirring occasionally , until eggplant pulp and mushroom are tender -- about 10 minutes or so
9. Stir in parmesan cheese and half of the breadcrumbs
10. Turn oven down to 350f remove eggplant shells
11. Spoon mixture into eggplant shells
12. Mix remaining half of breadcrumbs with melted butter
13. Sprinkle over filled eggplant
14. Place filled eggplant shells back in the oven bake at 350f for 20-25 minutes

title: tex mex dip aka seven layer dip
steps:
1. Peel , pit and mash avocados in a medium-size bowl with lemon juice , salt and pepper
2. Combine sour cream , mayonnaise , and taco seasoning mix in a bowl
3. To assemble: spread bean dip on a large shallow serving platter
4. Top with seasoned avocado mixture
5. Layer with sour cream-taco mixture
6. Sprinkle with chopped onions , tomatoes and olives
7. Cover with shredded cheese
8. Serve chilled or at room temperature with round tortilla chips

title: lemon rosemary mayonnaise
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together
2. Keep in refrigerator
3. You may substitute parsley for rosemary , if desired

title: braciole  stuffed beef rolls in tomato sauce
steps:
1. Place beef between two pieces of plastic wrap
2. Pound gently with a meat pounder or mallet to 1 / 4-1 / 8 inch thickness
3. Remove and discard plastic wrap
4. Place one slice of the prosciutto on each beef slice
5. Sprinkle beef slices with the finely chopped garlic , cheese , parsley , salt and pepper
6. Roll each of the beef slices into a tight roll and secure with a toothpick
7. Heat the olive oil in a large pot
8. Add the braciole and crushed garlic
9. Cook , turning the meat occasionally , until it is browned on all sides and the garlic is golden
10. Add the red wine and simmer for 2 minutes
11. Remove and discard the crushed garlic cloves
12. Stir in the tomato puree and basil
13. Cover and cook on low heat , turning the meat occasionally , until it is tender when pierced with a fork , about 2 hours
14. Add a little water if the sauce becomes to thick
15. If you want to serve it the italian way: serve the sauce over the hot , cooked ziti as a first course , followed by the braciole
16. Don't forget to remove the toothpick from the braciole

title: blueberry muffins from the magnolia cafe
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Grease well a 12 cup muffin tin
3. In a large bowl , mix together the dry ingredients , making a well in the center
4. Stir in the liguid ingredients until just combined , being careful not to overmix
5. Batter may be lumpy
6. Gently fold the blueberries into the batter
7. Fill the muffin cups about three-quarters full
8. Lightly sprinkle with the 1 tablespoon of sugar
9. Bake for 20-22 minutes until lightly golden or a cake tester inserted near the center comes out with moist crumbs
10. Do not overbake !

title: mexi ranch salad dressing
steps:
1. Mix the first 4 ingredients together
2. Add salt and pepper to taste
3. Serve immediately , or refrigerate for an hour or longer so that the flavor goes through it
4. Enjoy !

title: cranberries sour cream cake
steps:
1. Garnish: mix brown sugar , sugar , almonds and cinnamon
2. Set aside 3 / 4 of this mixture
3. In the remaining mixture , add flour , butter and vanilla
4. Stir well and set aside
5. Cake: grease and flour a 9 inch springform pan
6. Preheat oven at 350f
7. Beat egg yolks with half sour cream , almond extract and vanilla for 2 minutes
8. Set aside
9. In another bowl , mix flour , sugar , baking soda , baking powder , salt and almonds
10. Add butter and remaining sour cream and mix for 2 minutes
11. Add mixture of egg yolks and beat until you obtain a good consistency of the dough
12. Add cranberries and mix with a spatula
13. Pour half the dough in the pan and cover with the first dry mixture
14. Add remaining dough and sprinkle with the second dry mixture
15. Bake in the center of oven for about 60 minutes
16. Let cool before to unmold

title: garlic cheese balls of love
steps:
1. Mince garlic in food processor
2. Add cream cheese , hot sauce , worschestshire sauce whip well
3. Add half of shredded cheese mixture to food processor and pulse several times
4. Turn cream cheese mixture into remaining shredded cheese and mix well
5. Refridgerate for 1 hour
6. Form into 3 softball size balls
7. Pulse fresh parsley in food processor add nuts pulse 3-4 times to mix well
8. Roll balls in parsley mixture
9. Chill for several hours
10. Serve with crackers and veggies

title: mayo free tuna salad
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in bowl
2. Serve as is , or as a light and fresh tuna sandwich

title: enchilada soup
steps:
1. Cube steak and brown
2. Add garlic and onions and saut in olive oil until onions are slightly transparent
3. Add remaining ingredients and simmer for at least 20 minutes
4. The longer you simmer it , the better it will taste
5. Top with sour cream , shredded cheese , fritos or tortilla chips

title: southwestern quinoa burrito
steps:
1. Add dry , unwashed quinoa to a large dry skillet
2. Toast until fragrant , stirring occasionally
3. Add veggie broth and bring to a boil
4. Cover , lower heat , and simmer until tender
5. Add beans , water , garlic , nutritional yeast , salt & pepper
6. Cover , and heat over low flame until beans are warmed through
7. Add more water if needed to keep the quinoa from sticking
8. In an oven or toaster oven , lightly toast 2 tortillas until warm and slightly crispy
9. Make the sauce: add all sauce ingredients to a blender and process until sauce is smooth
10. Plate
11. Divide quinoa / bean mixture in half , and place half the filling inside each tortilla
12. Roll up or fold tortillas in half
13. Drizzle with southwestern sauce and chopped avocados

title: clubhouse pepper jelly chicken salad
steps:
1. To make the pepper jelly vinaigrette: in a mixing bowl combine all ingredients
2. Place into an airtight container
3. Refrigerate
4. Will last a month
5. To assemble: in a mixing bowl place lettuce and all other ingredients except chicken and toss together with a pinch of salt and pepper
6. Place onto a plate or in a bowl and place the fresh grilled chicken over the salad
7. Serve immediately

title: everything jambalaya or  jambalika
steps:
1. Cook rice to package directions
2. Place a large , deep skillet over medium high heat
3. Add oil and butter to the pan
4. Cube chicken and place in hot oil and butter
5. Brown chicken 3 minutes , add sausage , and cook 2 minutes more
6. Add onion , celery , pepper , bay , and cayenne
7. Saute vegetables 5 minutes , sprinkle flour over the pan and cook 1 or 2 minutes more
8. Stir in tomatoes and broth and season with cumin , chili , poultry seasoning , and worcestershire
9. Bring liquids to a boil and add shrimp
10. Simmer shrimp 5 minutes until pink and firm
11. Remove the pot from the heat and place on a trivet
12. Ladle jambalaya into shallow bowls
13. Using an ice cream scoop , place a scoop of rice on to the center of the bowlfuls of jambalaya
14. Sprinkle dishes with salt , pepper , chopped scallions , and thyme leaves

title: shrimp and dill canapes
steps:
1. Blanch shrimp for 15 seconds and drain
2. Refresh under cold water and drain well
3. Reserve 25 of the smallest shrimp and chop remainder
4. In a bowl , combine chopped shrimp , onion , dill , lemon juice , cream cheese and mayonnaise and pepper to taste
5. Stir until combined well
6. Spread 1 tsp of mixture on each toast round , mounding , and top each canap with 1 of the reserved shrimp
7. Preheat broiler
8. Broil in a jell-roll pan , about 4 inches from heat , for 3-4 minutes , or until pale-golden

title: carol s creamed cucumbers
steps:
1. Medium slice cucumbers and soak in salt water this will take the burb out of the cucumbers
2. Mix sour cream , sugar , vinegar , salt and pepper until smooth
3. Add drained cucumbers
4. Slice onion and add , stir until well mixed
5. Put in a sealed container and place in fridge
6. Stir whenever you think about it
7. Takes about 2 days to ferment and get done
8. It is normal to see air bubbles from the fermentation process , it's ok , let it do it's thing
9. Serve as a side salad , or the sauce can be a topper on potatoes

title: ali s dill pickle deviled eggs
steps:
1. Boil eggs for approximately 20 minutes
2. Once eggs are hard , drain water and allow eggs to cool
3. You may also let them sit in cold water for 15 minutes
4. Peel eggs then cut them long wise
5. Set hardened egg whites to the side
6. Put egg yolks in a small to medium size mixing bowl
7. Mash yolks with a fork
8. Add mayonnaise , mustard , relish , and salt
9. Stir until all ingredients are blended and a thick , creamy texture is achieved
10. Take a small spoon and spoon a small mound of yolk mix into the hardened egg whites
11. Once all of the yolk has been used , sprinkle paprika over the top of all eggs
12. There you have it ! dill pickled deviled eggs !

title: mom s chicken asparagus casserole
steps:
1. Cut chicken into bite sized pieces and brown
2. Combine all ingredients in large casserole dish and blend well
3. Bake at 350 for 30 minutes

title: baker s prune butter  substitute for oil in chocolate cakes
steps:
1. Pour boiling water over tea bags and steep for 5 minutes , discard bags
2. Combine tea and prunes in a medium saucepan
3. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat , reduce heat , cover and boil gently for 5 minutes or until prunes are softened
4. Remove from heat and puree mixture in a food processor until smooth
5. Return prune mixture to saucepan , add sugar and lemon rind , and boil gently , uncovered for 15 minutes or until thickened , stirring occasionally
6. Remove from heat and stir into vanilla

title: spicy honey roasted cauliflower
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Combine the honey , mustard , butter , bread crumbs , crushed red pepper flakes , half of parmesan cheese & 1 / 2 cup chopped herbs in a small bowl
3. Mix well and set aside
4. Use a long slim paring knife to pierce the heart of each cauliflower stem
5. Place each head , stem side down , in a deep baking dish , large enough to hold both heads
6. Add about 1 / 4 inch of hot water to the dish
7. Cover with foil
8. Bake 8-10 minutes , or until the water turns to steam
9. Remove foil
10. Carefully pour off the water
11. Return to oven
12. Increase oven temp to 400f
13. Bake for 5 minutes to dry the heads
14. Remove from oven & coat well with the bread crumb mixture
15. Pour half of the cheese on top of mixture
16. Return to oven & roast 12 to 15 minutes or until the cauliflower heads are browned
17. To serve , top with additional chopped fresh herbs

title: creamy cooker chicken
steps:
1. Combine soup mix , sour cream , and cream of mushroom soup in crockpot
2. Add chicken , submerging it into sauce so it's covered
3. Cover and cook on low for 8 hours
4. Serve over rice or noodles

title: italian sausages skewers
steps:
1. Put sausages in a plate going in the microwave and poke them
2. Cover with plastic wrap leaving an open corner to let escape the steam and cook at high power for about 5 minutes or until not pink inside
3. Cut in slices of 1 1 / 2 inches of thickness
4. Meanwhile , in a bowl , mix oil , garlic , salt and pepper
5. On metal skewers or wood skewers previously soaked in water , thread sausages alternating with bread cubes and onions squares
6. Baste the skewers with the mixture of oil
7. Set the barbecue to medium heat
8. Put the skewers on an oil grill
9. Close the cover and cook about 10 minutes or until sausages are grilled and onions are tender

title: sunshine s shrimp mold
steps:
1. Dissolve gelatin in water and set aside
2. Over low heat , melt cream cheese into soup
3. Combine mayonnaise , horseradish , mustard and pepper in bowl
4. Remove cheese and soup from when blended
5. Add add ingredients together and mix well
6. Pour into mold and refrigerate until set
7. Serve with crackers

title: simplest spanish rice
steps:
1. Heat water to boiling
2. Add rotel and rice
3. Prepare enchilada sauce by combining all ingredients in a medium bowl and mixing until butter is melted
4. When most of water is absorbed in rice , reduce heat and add enchilada sauce
5. Cover and simmer until tender
6. When using canned enchilada sauce this recipe takes only 20 minutes to prepare
7. Makes a delicious appetizer when served with corn chips and salsa or pica de gallo

title: polenta with italian sausage
steps:
1. Combine water , cornmeal and salt in a double boiler or heavy saucepan
2. Bring to a boil , stirring constantly
3. Reduce heat
4. Cover and simmer for 1-1 / 2 hours , stirring occasionally
5. Meanwhile , brown sausage and garlic in a large skillet
6. Drain
7. Cool slightly
8. Cut sausage into 1-in
9. Pieces
10. Return to skillet
11. Add tomatoes , tomato paste and parsley
12. Bring to a boil
13. Remove from the heat
14. Spread half of the cornmeal mixture in a serving dish
15. Top with half of the sausage mixture
16. Repeat layers
17. Sprinkle with cheese
18. Serve immediately

title: sweet and sour pork kebabs
steps:
1. In a large bowl whisk together the balsamic vinegar , garlic , chili flakes and canola oil-add pork chunks , toss well , and if you have a freezer bag pour into that-remove as much of the air as you like and place in the fridge overnight-turnning a few times
2. At this point you can also freeze for later use
3. If using wooden skewers pre-soak 1 hour before using , and you will need 14
4. In a large bowl whisk together the ketchup , vinegar , brown sugar , soy , ginger , salt and sesame oil
5. Preheat your grill to medium high
6. Skewer the pork , pineapple , tomatoes and peppers , repeat until all skewers are done
7. Brush skewers with the ketchup / soy sauce and place kebabs on grill , basting often and turning twice
8. Test one for pork doneness

title: sour cream raspberry swirl loaf
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f coat an 8x4 loaf pan with cooking spray
2. Combine jam and nuts in a small bowl
3. Set aside
4. Combine flour , baking powder , baking soda , and salt in a bowl , stirring with a wisk
5. Combine sugar , butter , lemon rind , 1 teaspoon vanilla , egg , and egg white in a large bowl
6. Beat with a mixer at medium speed until well blended
7. Add flour mixture and sour cream alternately to sugar mixture , beginning and ending with flour mixture
8. Spread half the batter into loaf pan and spoon jam mixture over top , leaving a 1 / 4 inch border
9. Spread remaining batter over raspberry mixture
10. Bake for 55 minute or until toothpick comes out clean
11. Cool in pan 10 minute then transfer loaf to wire rack
12. Combine 1 / 4 teaspoon vanilla , powdered sugar , and milk in a small bowl
13. Drizzle over loaf while still slightly warm

title: steamed scallops with ginger  soy and sesame   scallions
steps:
1. Fill the base of a steamer with water and bring to the boil
2. Sprinkle the scallops with the ginger
3. Place in the steamer and steam for about 4 minutes until only just set
4. Put the sesame oil and soy sauce in a small pan and warm through
5. Arrange the scallops on four plates and pour over the sesame oil and soy sauce
6. Sprinkle on the cilantro and sliced scallions then serve

title: open faced jarlsberg sandwiches with greens
steps:
1. Preheat broiler
2. In 12-inch nonstick skillet , heat oil on medium 1 minute
3. Add garlic and cook 3 to 4 minutes or until garlic is golden , stirring occasionally
4. Stir in spinach and cook 1 to 2 minutes or until spinach wilts
5. Stir in 1 / 8 teaspoon each salt and freshly ground black pepper
6. Remove skillet from heat
7. Meanwhile , place bread on cookie sheet and toast in broiler 2 minutes or until beginning to brown
8. Turn toasted bread over and spread dijon on top of bread slices
9. Top with spinach , sliced tomatoes , then cheese
10. Broil sandwiches 2 to 3 minutes or until cheese melts and begins to brown

title: safari biscuits  cookies
steps:
1. Put butter , sugar , milk , soda and syrup into a pot and melt
2. Add vanilla and cool slightly
3. Add flour and sultanas
4. Roll into balls and place on a greased baking tray
5. Flatten slightly
6. Bake at 180 for 10-12 mins

title: fried zucchini
steps:
1. Pour enough oil into a large frying pan to reach a depth of 2 inches
2. Heat the oil over medium heat until a deep-fry thermometer registers 350 degrees f
3. Stir 1 1 / 2 cups parmesan , the panko , and salt in a medium bowl to blend
4. Whisk the eggs in another medium bowl to blend
5. Working in batches , dip the zucchini in the eggs to coat completely and allow the excess egg to drip back into the bowl
6. Coat the zucchini in the panko mixture , patting to adhere and coat completely
7. Place the zucchini strips on a baking sheet
8. When the oil is hot , working in batches , fry the zucchini sticks until they are golden brown , about 3 minutes
9. Using a slotted spoon , transfer the fried zucchini to paper towels and drain
10. Arrange the fried zucchini on a platter
11. Sprinkle with the remaining parmesan and serve

title: quickie pasta bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees fahrenheit
2. Cook pasta on stove and drain
3. Meanwhile , heat oil in saucepan
4. Add onion and garlic , saute until soft
5. Add tomatoes , oregano , salt and pepper , cook until heated through , about 5 minutes
6. Combine cooked pasta , sauce , and 1 / 2 of the grated cheese in an ovenproof dish
7. Mix onion mixture with pasta / cheese mixture
8. Sprinkle remaining cheese on top
9. Bake 15 to 20 minutes in preheated oven

title: ceviche de camaron
steps:
1. Bring 1 quart salted water to a boil and add 2 tablespoons of the lime juice
2. Scoop in the shrimp , cover and let the water return to the boil
3. Immediately remove from the heat , and pour off all the liquid
4. Replace the cover and let the shrimp steam off the heat for 10 minutes
5. Spread out the shrimp in a large glass or stainless steel bowl to cool completely
6. Peel the shrimp and devein if you wish
7. Toss the shrimp with the remaining 1 / 2 lime juice , cover and refrigerate for about an hour
8. In a small strainer , rinse the onion under cold water , then shake off the excess liquid
9. Add to the shrimp bowl along with the cilantro , ketchup , hot sauce , optional olive oil , cucumber and / or jcama and avocado
10. Taste and season with salt , usually about 1 / 2 teaspoon
11. Cover and refrigerate if not serving immediately
12. Spoon the ceviche into sundae glasses , martini glasses , or small bowls and garnish with sprigs of cilantro and slices of lime
13. Serve with tortilla chips if desired

title: shredded brussels sprouts   pecans salad
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Spread pecans on a rimmed baking sheet and toast until fragrant and lightly browned , about 10 minutes
3. Set aside
4. Meanwhile , with the shredding disk of a food processor , shred brussels sprouts
5. In a large nonstick skillet , heat butter and oil over medium-high heat
6. Add mustard seeds and cook , stirring occasionally , until fragrant , about 30 seconds
7. Add brussels sprouts and cook , tossing occasionally until tender and beginning to brown , 7 to 9 minutes
8. Remove from heat , stir in lemon juice , and season with salt and pepper
9. Serve topped with pecans

title: peasant girls in the mist   scandinavian apple and cream pudding
steps:
1. Put the cubed and peeled apple chunks into a large saucepan with the caster sugar and 2 to 3 tablespoons water
2. Cook them over a gentle heat until they are completely tender - stirring them every so often to mash them down
3. Put them into a bowl to cool
4. Melt the butter in a frying pan and add the breadcrumbs and brown sugar
5. Saute , stirring constantly over a medium heat until the breadcrumbs are golden brown
6. Add the cinnamon and stir well
7. Remove from the heat and allow to cool
8. Whip the cream and add the icing sugar & lemon juice
9. Take a large glass bowl or 4 individual glass bowls and layer the stewed apples , breadcrumbs and cream - ending with a layer of cream
10. Scatter with the chopped hazelnuts and serve

title: spicy beef or chicken asian noodle salad
steps:
1. To make the dressing: combine all the dressing ingredients in a processor blend well
2. Season with salt and pepper
3. Refrigerate the dressing until ready to use
4. Cook the pasta in boiling salted water until just firm-tender drain , and rise under cold water , drain again
5. Transfer the pasta to a large bowl
6. Add in cooked beef , carrots , green onion , bell pepper
7. Toss to combine well
8. Pour the dressing over and toss to blend , adding in more broth if the dressing is too thick
9. Season with salt and pepper
10. Sprinkle with peanuts
11. Delicious !

title: blue stuffed mushrooms
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , combine the blue cheese and the cream cheese
2. Beat them together with an electric mixer so that they are smooth
3. Add the half & half and beat it in so that the mixture is fluffy
4. Fill the mushroom caps with the cheese mixture
5. Top each with a pecan half and a basil leaf

title: grape pudding   crema fredda di uva nera
steps:
1. Smash grapes
2. Reserve liquid
3. Simmer pulp over medium heat for 15 minutes
4. Mix cornstarch and lemon juice
5. Add to boiling pulp
6. Cook until thinkened
7. Adjust taste with sugar if necessary
8. Pour into bowl or individual cups
9. Refrigerate until cold
10. Top with whipped cream if desired and serve

title: grandpa parker s french onion soup
steps:
1. Heat butter and then add onion and simmer for 10 minutes
2. Add bouillon and bring to boil and then simmer for 20 minutes
3. Season to your taste with salt , pepper and worcestershire sauce
4. Pour the hot soup into earthenware cups
5. On top of each , float a slice of sauteed french bread and sprinkle with grated cheese

title: roasted marinated peppers with goat cheese
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375 degrees f
2. Arrange peppers on a foil-lined baking sheet and bake until blackened and soft , 25-30 minutes , turning once or twice
3. Transfer to a bowl , cover with plastic wrap and let stand 10 minutes
4. Meanwhile , make the marinade: combine oil , vinegar , lemon juice , garlic , leaves from about half the thyme , salt and pepper in a large bowl
5. While peppers are still hot , slip off the skin and scrape out seeds
6. Remove stems
7. Cut each pepper into quarters
8. Add roasted peppers to the marinade and refrigerate for 2-3 hours
9. To serve , arrange peppers on 4 plates , garnish with olives , oranges and remaining thyme , and crumble goat cheese over and season with additional freshly ground pepper
10. Chopped basil is also a delicious garnish

title: creamy ham and cauliflower bake
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 350
2. Chop cauliflower into bite sized pieces and rinse in a strainer
3. Chop ham and garlic
4. Put cauliflower , ham , garlic and all other ingredients in a large bowl and mix
5. Pour into ungreased baking dish and top with reserved cheese
6. Bake , covered for 30 minutes
7. Uncover and bake until top is brown
8. Cool for 5-10 minutes
9. Enjoy

title: betty s baked cranberry relish
steps:
1. In a bowl combine cranberries and sugar
2. Toss well
3. Place in a lightly greased baking dish
4. Bake at 350 , covered , for 1 hour
5. Remove from oven and stir in marmalade , lemon juice and grated peel and walnuts
6. Stir well to combine
7. Leave at room temp to cool for 45 minutes
8. Refridgerate

title: white radish chutney  mooj
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350-degrees f
2. Spread walnuts out on a cookie sheet and bake for 10 minutes
3. Turn oven off but let walnuts sit in oven for another 5 minutes
4. In a food processor , puree radish and chili using on / off turns
5. Add walnuts and salt and puree
6. Add vinegar
7. Remove from processor to a covered bowl and refrigerate

title: sweet and spicy texas pecans
steps:
1. Mix the pecans and melted butter in a foil-lined jellyroll pan
2. Put in a 350 degree oven and bake for 5 minutes
3. Mix together the sugar and pepper
4. Sprinkle half the sugar mixture over the pecans and bake for 5 more minutes , stirring once
5. Take pan out of oven and sprinkle remaining sugar mixture over pecans
6. Toss to coat

title: karfiol leves  hungarian cauliflower soup
steps:
1. Place cauliflower in a pot with stock , milk , and salt and bring to a boil
2. Cook until stalks can be easily pierced with a knife , but are still firm
3. In a small saucepan , make a roux , by heating the butter and mixing in the garlic and flour , stirring constantly until flour turns golden beige
4. Add the parsley and white pepper
5. Thin the roux with 1 / 2 cup of the cauliflower broth and slowly pour back into the soup
6. Simmer until cauliflower is done and soup no longer tastes floury
7. Let cool thoroughly
8. In a small bowl stir a little of the soup into the sour cream until smooth
9. Return this to the remaining soup
10. Reheat before serving

title: german quark crumb bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f mix the ingredients under the quark filling section and set aside
2. Blend crumb topping ingredients with a pastry blender
3. Measure out 2 1 / 2 cups of crumbs
4. Pat into a greased 13x9 glass baking dish
5. Pat crumbs up about 1 / 2 inch up sides of baking dish
6. Bake at 350f for 10-12 minutes
7. Pour quark mixture over baked crust
8. Sprinkle remaining crumb mixture evenly over quark layer
9. Pat down very lightly
10. Bake 30-35 minutes
11. Cool before cutting
12. Storage: keep refrigerated but bring to room temperature before serving

title: healthy salmon salad
steps:
1. In a small saucepan heat olive oil over medium-low heat
2. Cook and stir garlic in hot oil for 1 minute or until garlic is lightly golden
3. Transfer garlic to a blender container
4. Add lemon juice , worcestershire sauce , mustard , water , and pepper
5. Cover
6. Blend until combined
7. Reserve 2 tablespoons of garlic mixture
8. Set aside
9. Add yogurt to remaining garlic mixture in blender
10. Cover and blend until smooth
11. Chill until serving time
12. Thaw salmon , if frozen
13. Rinse salmon
14. Pat dry
15. Brush the reserved garlic mixture evenly over salmon
16. Cover and chill for 30 minutes
17. Spray the unheated rack of a broiler pan with nonstick coating
18. Place the salmon on the rack
19. Broil 4 to 5 inches from heat for 8 to 12 minutes or until salmon flakes easily when tested with a fork , turning once
20. Meanwhile , in a large bowl toss romaine , onion , and parmesan cheese with the chilled yogurt mixture
21. Divide romaine mixture among 4 salad plates
22. Place one salmon fillet on each salad
23. Top with tomatoes and , if desired , olives

title: nutty soda cracker candy
steps:
1. Set oven to 400f
2. Line a 10 x 15-inch baking sheet with non-stick foil
3. Place each cracker in a single layer in the baking sheet
4. In a medium saucepan bring the butter and brown sugar to a boil over medium heat
5. When the mixture comes to a full boil , boil for 3 minutes you may reduce the heat so that the mixture does not boil over the saucepan
6. Mix in vanilla then immediately pour the hot mixture over the top of the crackers
7. Bake in a 400f oven for 5 minutes
8. Sprinkle the chocolate chips over the crackers , then spread using a back of a spoon to smooth out and cover
9. Sprinkle the nuts evenly over the top
10. Place in the refrigerator for about 3-4 hours or until set
11. Break into pieces and store in a covered container in the refrigerator
12. Delicious !

title: roasted pork with apples and potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450
2. Stir together apple jelly , brown sugar and ginger
3. Set aside
4. Combine apples , potatoes , onions , olive oil , salt , pepper and rosemary
5. Place pork in center of roasting pan
6. Arrange apple mixture around pork in a single layer
7. Roast 15 minutes
8. Reduce oven temp to 350 and roast another 20 minutes
9. Stir apple mixture
10. Spread apple jelly glaze on pork and roast another 15-20 minutes or until center of pork reaches and internal temp of 145

title: knife   fork egg salad sandwiches with chives
steps:
1. Arrange eggs in a single layer in medium pot and cover with cold water by 1
2. Bring to a boil over medium-high heat , then immediately remove pot from heat
3. Cover and let rest for 8-10 minutes undisturbed
4. Drain eggs , leaving them in the pot
5. Shake the pot to crack their shells
6. Cover eggs with cold water , swish around , then drain
7. Cover again , this time with icy-cold water , and set aside to let chill for 20 minutes
8. Peel and coarsely chop eggs
9. Combine eggs , half the chives , celery leaves and salt and pepper to taste in a medium bowl and fold together gently to combine
10. Add mayonnaise , vinegar and mustard and fold again , being careful not to mash up the eggs
11. Toast bread lightly , then butter each slice on one side
12. Arrange a bit of the watercress on top of each piece of toast , buttered side up
13. Dollop each piece with a generous scoop of egg salad
14. Transfer the sandwiches to plates
15. Sprinkle with remaining chives and serve immediately

title: tims  mom s blueberry muffins
steps:
1. Cut butter into flour , sugar , baking powder and salt
2. Add egg , lemon , milk vegetable oil and vanilla , stir just til moist fold in blueberries
3. Bake in well-greased muffin tin at 400 degrees for 20 to 25 minutes
4. Muffin cups will be about 2 / 3 full

title: quick veggie beef soup with parsley dumplings
steps:
1. Combine water , boullion cubes , carrots , onion , celery , tomatoes , peas and garlic in a large stew pot
2. Bring to a boil
3. Brown and drain ground beef
4. While ground beef is browning , mix bisquick , milk and parsley
5. Add ground beef to pot and cook for 10 minutes
6. Drop dumpling mixture by the spoonful into boiling soup
7. Cook uncovered for 10 minutes
8. Cover tightly and cook for 10 minutes

title: fried potato and olive sandwich
steps:
1. Peel and slice potato into rounds
2. Boil until almost fork-tender and drain
3. Let cool down a little
4. Heat olive oil in fry pan and fry potato until golden brown on both sides
5. Salt and drain on paper
6. Toast bread and slather each piece with mayo
7. Stack potatoes , olives and tomato
8. Drizzle a little balsamic vinegar over this
9. Crack some fresh pepper over the top of this and you're set !

title: lentil veggie soup  crock pot
steps:
1. Rinse lentils
2. Place all ingredients except the pepper into a 4-6 quart slow cooker
3. Cover and cook on low for at least 12 hours , or high for at least 5 hours
4. Season with pepper and remove the bay leaves before serving

title: ground turkey lasagna
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. If no-bake or no-boil fresh noodles are used , no preparation of noodles is required
3. If you use standard dry lasagna noodles , boil and drain , then rinse with cold water
4. Heat olive oil in large skillet over medium-high heat
5. Add onions , saute until onions are opaque and starting to brown
6. Add freshly minced garlic and 1 tsp fresh minced rosemary
7. Also add 1 / 2 of each portion of herbs and spices
8. Saute for 2 minutes
9. Add ground turkey to pan , mashing and pushing apart meat with the edge of your spatula
10. Cook until meat has begun to brown
11. Add 1 / 2 cup of milk , and simmer on medium-low heat for 5 minutes or until meat is entirely cooked
12. Mix in 2
13. 5 cups of marinara sauce , reserving 1 cup
14. Turn off heat
15. In a medium sized bowl , combine ricotta cheese , 1 cup of shredded parmesan , remainder of all herbs and spices
16. Mix with hands or spoon
17. In the bottom of a standard lasagna pan , spread reserved cup of marinara sauce in a thin , even layer
18. Place a layer of lasagna noodles lengthwise in pan , slightly overlapping
19. Spread 1 / 2 of ricotta mixture in a thin , even layer over noodles
20. Spoon 1 / 3 of meat sauce over ricotta mixture
21. Add another layer of lasagna noodles , and repeat previous step
22. Add 3rd layer of lasagna noodles , and spread remaining sauce over noodles evenly
23. Mix remaining mozzarella and parmesan , and spread in a thin layer , completely covering the top of the lasagna
24. Cover in tin foil , making sure the foil is not touching the cheese
25. Bake for 20 minutes
26. Remove foil , and bake for another 20 minutes or until the cheese is bubbling and is starting to brown around the edges
27. Remove from oven and allow to cool for 10-15 minutes before slicing into 8 pieces

title: spicy vodka cream pasta with hot sausage
steps:
1. Slice sausage links into inch rounds and brown for several minutes in a large saut pan
2. Add butter , garlic , and shallots
3. Saut shallots for 3 to 5 minutes
4. Add vodka and heat 4-5 minutes to reduce vodka by half
5. Add marinara sauce , can tomatoes and red pepper
6. Bring sauce to a boil and reduce heat to simmer for approximately 10 minutes
7. While sauce is simmering , cook pasta until it is al dente
8. Add cream into sauce and return to a boil
9. Add drain pasta to the sauce and add the basil leaves
10. Add salt and pepper to taste

title: tom s general tso s chicken
steps:
1. Save yourself a little time and chop the all the garlic and ginger when you make the marinade !
2. Mix together the chili peppers , 1 tbsp ginger , 1 clove garlic , sugar , soy sauce , vinegar and sesame oil in a wok until sugar is dissolved
3. Heat it up a little just to make sure sugar is totally dissolved
4. Let it cool for a couple minutes
5. Put the chicken and broccoli into a large bowl and coat it with the flour
6. Pour the marinade over the chicken and broccoli
7. Mix to coat , and marinate for at least 15 minutes but no longer than 2 hours
8. Heat wok over high heat until very hot and add the oil
9. Working quickly add the ginger , garlic , chili , sugar , soy sauce , and rice wine vinegar and stir to combine
10. Add the chicken and broccoli in the wok along with the marinade and continue to cook until the chicken is brown
11. Once the chicken is brown , add the tomato paste and water and stir it until the tomato paste is incorporated
12. Continue to cook for another 1-2 minutes , until chicken is done and sauce has thickened
13. Taste the sauce and season to taste with more soy , vinegar , sugar , chiles , etc --
14. Serve with rice

title: cellophane noodles with pork   tomato
steps:
1. Cut pork into bite-size pieces
2. Mix cornstarch , soy sauce , sugar , chili powder , & a pinch of salt in a medium bowl
3. Add pork to soy mix , stir well to coat pork pieces , and marinate , covered in the fridge , for 15 minutes
4. Soak noodles in lukewarm water for 15 minutes
5. Prepare tomatoes: submerge in boiling water for 30 seconds
6. Remove and rinse under cold water
7. Peel , remove seeds , and chop
8. Peel and mince garlic and green onions
9. Heat oil in a wok or large skillet and stir-fry onions and garlic til translucent
10. Add pork & stir-fry for 2 minute
11. Drain noodles & add to wok
12. Add stock and tomatoes and stir well
13. Bring to a boil then reduce heat and simmer til nearly all the liquid is gone
14. Salt to taste after liquid has evaporated

title: red curried cauliflower
steps:
1. In a large pot of boiling water , cook the cauliflower until crisp-tender , 5 minutes
2. Drain in a colander , then plunge into a bowl of ice water until cooled
3. Drain very well
4. This can be done 1 day ahead
5. In a medium skillet , heat the oil over medium-high heat
6. Add the onion and saute until golden , 6 minutes
7. Add the garlic and cook until the onion is lightly browned about 1 minute
8. Add the coconut milk
9. When it boils , reduce the heat to medium
10. Stir in the ginger , chili sauce , fish sauce and the chili paste
11. Add the cauliflower and saute until heated through , 2-3 minutes
12. Let the cauliflower sit briefly to serve warm , not hot

title: saskatoon  coleslaw
steps:
1. A day ahead of time , put cabbage , carrots and onions in a large non metal bowl and chill
2. Combine remaining ingredients in a saucepan and bring to a boil
3. Pour over the vegetables , mix well
4. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate overnight
5. Drain before serving if you wish

title: one bite pecan pies
steps:
1. Beat cream cheese and butter with electric mixer on medium speed until well blended
2. Add flour , mix well
3. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour or until chilled
4. Preheat oven to 375
5. Divide dough into 24 balls
6. Place 1 ball in each of 24 miniature muffin pan cups
7. Press onto bottoms and up sides of cups to form shells
8. Beat egg lightly in small bowl
9. Add brown sugar and vanilla and mix well
10. Stir in pecans
11. Spoon evenly into pastry shells , filling each shell 3 / 4 full
12. Bake 25 to 30 minute or until lightly browned
13. Let stand 5 minute remove tarts from pans and cool completely on wire racks
14. Drizzle with melted chocolate
15. Let stand until set

title: mushroom and herb salad
steps:
1. Combine mushrooms , spring onions carrots parsley , chives and sprouts in a bowl
2. Combine dressing ingredients together , shake well and add to mushrooms etc

title: butter brush ons for the bbq
steps: 1. Spread these butters or brush on food before or during cooking

title: salami and cream cheese sandwich
steps:
1. Spread mustard on one slice of bread
2. Top with salami and arugula
3. Spread cream cheese on the other slice of bread
4. Close sandwich
5. Serve , or refrigerate , wrapped tightly in wax paper or plastic , up to overnight
6. Cut in half

title: mushroom asiago chicken
steps:
1. Pound chicken breast with a meat mallet between 2 sheets of waxed paper or plastic wrap until meat is uniform thickness
2. About 1 / 4-inch
3. Cut into serving-sized pieces
4. Heat the butter with 1 tablespoon of olive oil in deep , heavy skillet or saute pan over medium heat
5. Dredge chicken in seasoned flour
6. Add to hot oil / butter in skillet
7. Saute until golden on each side , about 5 minutes per side
8. Remove from pan
9. Add remaining olive oil to hot skillet
10. Saute mushrooms and garlic until mushrooms begin to brown
11. Add white wine to skillet , scraping up all the browned bits that are at the bottom of the pan
12. Bruise the fresh thyme by twisting it between your fingers or hitting it with the dull side of a knife in a few places
13. Add thyme to mushroom / wine mixture in pan
14. Add the chicken back to the pan
15. Bring to a boil , then reduce heat , cover and simmer for 15-20 minutes
16. Remove chicken from pan
17. Add the cream and heat through
18. Add the asiago cheese
19. Cook , stirring constantly over low heat until cheese melts
20. Continue cooking until sauce is reduced by about half
21. If you wish to skip the reduction step , you may thicken the sauce slightly with about 1 tbs instant flour or 1 tbs cornstarch mixed with 2 tbs water -- however , the reduction will taste better
22. Add chicken back to pan and heat through
23. Garnish with sprigs of fresh thyme
24. May be served over any pasta

title: awesome  yummy monterey jack dip
steps:
1. Grate cheese
2. Combine with remaining ingredients , toss well and enjoy !

title: sweet brie
steps:
1. Preheat broiler
2. Place brie in 10-inch quiche dish or other oven-proof dish or pie plate and sprinkle with nuts
3. Cover top and sides with sugar , patting gently with finger
4. Broil on lowest rack until sugar bubbles and melts , about 3 minutes
5. Serve immediately with crackers

title: blueberry cream cheese bread pudding
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425
2. Spray a 2 quart shallow baking dish
3. Bake the cubed bread for 8-10 minutes on a cookie sheet
4. Beat eggs and 3 / 4 cup sugar in bowl , until light colored
5. Add the orange peel and vanilla , then half & half
6. Mix well
7. Put the toasted bread cubed in the dish and cover with half of the berries
8. Combine cream cheese and 2 tablespoons sugar , mixing well
9. Drop this over the berry and bread mixture
10. Sprinkle the remaining berries on top
11. Pour egg mixture over
12. Wait 5 minutes , then bake 50-55 minutes
13. Sprinkle the confectioners' sugar over before serving warm

title: plain muffins  pre 1940 s
steps:
1. Sift dry ingredients
2. Add graduall eggs and milk , beat well
3. Melt crisco and add
4. Grease muffin tins
5. Fill2 / 3 full
6. Bake 25 minutes in a hot oven 400 degrees
7. Cup less milk may be used and 1 cip berries added to the mixture

title: gooey butter bars
steps:
1. Spray 13x9 in pan , preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Mix cake mix , egg and melted butter in a bowl together with a spoon until cake mix is completely moist
3. Press into bottom of pan
4. In another bowl mix cream cheese , the 2 eggs together slowly until it starts to get a little smooth
5. Then slowly start adding the powder sugar
6. Mix until smooth and creamy
7. Well blended
8. Pour over the cake mix crust
9. Put in the oven right away after its preheated
10. Bake at 350 for 30 minutes
11. Top will be golden brown all over , if not it needs just a few extra minutes until it is evenly golden
12. Let cool before you dig in so you don't burn yourselt and to let it completely set up
13. Once cooled for the most part enjoy heaven !

title: grandiose gazpacho
steps:
1. Rinse do not dry 4-6 wine or martini glasses and spoons and put into freezer to chill
2. Put everything but vodka in blender and blend till almost smooth
3. Check seasoning and adjust to taste
4. Chill till nice and icy cold
5. Pour into frosted glasses rimmed with seasoned salt
6. Top with vodka and garnish with slice of lemon , celery stalks and or cilantro leaves
7. Ice can be added to mixture in blender for a more liquid drink
8. Meanwhile iced spoons will keep the soup nice and cold while eating
9. Serve in chilled wine glasses with chilled spoons

title: tex mex summer squash
steps:
1. Place butter or olive oil in a large teflon-coated skillet on low heat
2. Wash and cut squash into 1 / 2 to 3 / 4 inch cubes and add to skillet
3. Chop onion and add to skillet
4. Cover and turn heat up to medium
5. Cook with occasional stirring until squash is tender but not soft
6. Meanwhile grate cheese
7. Lightly toast the tortillas , then cut into 1 / 4 inch wide strips with scissors
8. Pour tomato sauce into a small bowl and add 1 / 4 cup water
9. Stir spices into the diluted tomato sauce
10. A soon as the squash is tender add the tomato sauce mixture
11. Stir in and cook with lid off until squash is soft and tender and tomato sauce is slightly thickened
12. Stir in tortilla strips , sprinkle grated cheese on top , and cover
13. Cook on low heat another 2-3 minutes until the cheese is melted and serve
14. As an option you may add 1 or 2 precooked cubed chicken breasts and make this into a main course

title: 20 second peanut butter chunk ice cream
steps:
1. In a food processor , add the almond milk followed by frozen bananas and two tablespoons of the crunchy peanut butter
2. Blend until smooth
3. Add remaining 3 tablespoons peanut butter and pulse once or twice to incorporate
4. Do not overblend
5. Transfer ice cream to a loaf pan and cover with plastic wrap
6. Freeze until hardened , at least 8 hours , or overnight
7. Alternatively , for a soft-serve consistency , serve immediately
8. Alternative flavors:
9. Mixed berry: omit peanut butter and add 2 cups mixed frozen berries
10. Strawberry: omit peanut butter and add 1 1 / 2 cups frozen strawberries at the initial blending
11. When smooth , 1 cup chopped frozen strawberries at the end , pulsing just until incorporated
12. Do not overblend
13. Chocolate mint: omit peanut butter and add 2-3 drops mint extract at the initial blending
14. When smooth , add a few drops of green food coloring to reach desired color , blending until color is well-distributed
15. Add 3 1 / 2 ounces roughly chopped semi-sweet chocolate , pulsing just until incorporated
16. Do not overblend
17. Nutella: omit peanut butter and add 5 tablespoons nutella at initial blending
18. When smooth , add 3 tablespoons nutella and pulse just until incorporated
19. Do not overblend

title: roasted sweet potato salad
steps:
1. Make the salad: peel sweet potatoes and cut into 1-inch cubes
2. Cut onions into quarters and cut each quarter into half
3. Toss the potatoes , onions , garlic , and olive oil together
4. Place on lightly greased foil-lined 15x10 inch jelly-roll pan
5. Sprinkle evenly with salt and pepper
6. Bake at 400 for 40-45 minutes or until tender and lightly browned , stirring occasionally
7. Make the dressing: cook bacon slices in a skillet over med-high heat 8-10 minutes or until crisp
8. Remove bacon and drain on paper towels
9. Reserve 1 tablespoon bacon drippings in skillet
10. Crumble bacon and set aside
11. Stir red wine vinegar and remaining dressing ingredients into hot drippings in skillet
12. Cook over medium heat , stirring occasionally , 2-3 minutes or until thoroughly heated
13. Serve roasted sweet potato mixture over fresh baby spinach
14. Drizzle with warm bacon dressing
15. Garnish with crumbled bacon

title: mochaccino pecan pancakes
steps:
1. Whisk flour , sugar , salt , baking powder and baking soda in a large bowl
2. Set aside
3. In a medium or large glass measuring cup , stir instant coffee and hot water until dissolved
4. Add sour cream to coffee and mix
5. Slowly stir in milk
6. Then add brandy and egg , and whisk to combine
7. Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients , and whisk until combined
8. Batter will be a little lumpy
9. Stir in melted tub margarine
10. Ladle approximately cup of batter for each pancake onto prepared sprayed griddle
11. Batter will be thin
12. Sprinkle with 4 or 5 chocolate chips and a large pinch of pecans
13. Cook until bottom is golden brown and bubbles are forming
14. Flip and cook second side until done
15. I like to use a tiny bit of cooking spray in between batches to prevent sticking
16. These are sweet enough and have a lot of flavor just plain , but feel free to also serve them with your favorite topping
17. Enjoy !

title: torte nicole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Remove chocolate and caramel toppings from fridge
3. Only grease the bottoms of two 9" round pans
4. Beat cake mix , pudding , hot chocolate , milk , oil and eggs on low for one minute , then on medium speed for three minutes
5. Pour into prepared pans
6. Bake at 350f for 28 to 33 minutes
7. Cool 10 minutes in pan then turn out onto wire racks to cool completely
8. Freeze cakes uncovered for 1 hour
9. Beat whipping cream , sugar and vanilla until stiff peaks form
10. Place in fridge until ready to use
11. Remove cake from freezer and split each cake into two layers
12. Spread whip cream over cake layer , then drizzle caramel sauce and chocolate sauce , sprinkle on 1 / 4 of toffee bits
13. Repeat process three more times , stacking the cakes on top of each other
14. Sprinkle sliced almonds on top layer of cake
15. Cover and refrigerate for at least two hours
16. Store in fridge

title: corn and shrimp pot
steps:
1. Fill large pot half full with water
2. Add spice
3. Bring to boil
4. Add:
5. New potatoes that have been sliced at 1 / 4 inch
6. Cook for 4 to 5 minutes
7. Kielbasa , sliced at 1 / 4 inch slices
8. Add to potatoes and cook another 7 minutes
9. Corn on cob , whole or halved add to previous ingredients
10. Cook for 7 minutes
11. Shrimp , not peeled , add to previous ingredients
12. Cook for no more than 4 minutes or until pink
13. Watch closely
14. Mix in big bowl
15. Serve with butter , sauce and good crusty bread

title: puffy pancake with banana berry compote
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425f
2. Prepare pancake: place 10-inch skillet with oven-safe handle in oven
3. Heat until very hot
4. In blender , at medium speed , blend eggs , milk , flour , sugar , and salt until smooth
5. Remove skillet from oven
6. Add butter and swirl until melted
7. Pour batter into hot skillet
8. Bake until puffy and golden , 15 minute
9. Meanwhile , prepare comote: in bowl , toss bananas and berries with sugar and lemon juice
10. Spoon compote onto pancake
11. Sprinkle with confectioner's sugar
12. To serve , cut into wedges

title: the realtor s parmesan salad dressing
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients together and mix well
2. Cover and refrigerate overnight
3. Great as a salad dressing or dip for vegetable crudites or chips

title: streuseled sweet potato casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Place potatoes in large pot of water and cook until tender
3. Drain , cool slightly and peel
4. Cut into chunks
5. Combine the half-and-half and next 4 ingredients in a large bowl , stirring with a whisk
6. Add potato to egg mixture , beat with a mixer at medium speed until smooth
7. Spoon potato mixture into a 13 x 9-inch baking dish coated with cooking spray
8. Combine flour and sugar in a food processor
9. Pulse to combine
10. Add chilled butter , pulse until mixture resembles coarse meal
11. Stir in pecans
12. Sprinkle over potato mixture
13. Cover and bake at 375 degrees for 15 minutes
14. Uncover and bake 25 minutes more or until the topping is browned and the potatoes are heated through

title: tia maria barbeque sauce
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients in a medium size saucepan and heat on medium
2. Slowly bring the liquid to a boil , stirring all the time
3. Reduce the liquid amount by 1 / 4 or until it reaches the thickness you like

title: healthy lasagna
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. In a large pot over medium heat heat 2 tablespoons of the olive oil
3. Stir in onion and minced garlic
4. Cook stirring occasionally for 5 minutes
5. Stir in tomatoes , oregano , 1 / 2 teaspoon salt and 1 / 2 teaspoon pepper
6. Reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes or until thick
7. Set aside
8. While the sauce is cooking in a 12 x 15 inch baking pan , place squash and sprinkle with the thyme , remaining olive oil and remaining salt and pepper
9. Add whole garlic cloves and toss
10. Bake for 10-15 minutes or until squash is soft
11. While squash is cooking in a large pot bring 3 quarts of water to a boil
12. Reduce oven temperature to 350f
13. Transfer squash mixture to a food processor and puree
14. Tear kale leaves from ribs --discard ribs
15. Boil leaves for 5-10 minutes or until soft
16. Drain and let cool
17. In the same pot bring another 3 quarts of water to a boil
18. Add noodles and cook according to package directions
19. Drain and rinse with cold water
20. In a bowl mix together the ricotta , nutmeg , 1 cup of mozzarella and the remaining salt and pepper
21. In a 9 x 13 inch pan pour in 1 / 3 of the tomato sauce , lay 3 noodles over and top with squash
22. Sprinkle 1 / 2 of the kale over
23. Arrange 3 more noodles on top and top with ricotta and remaining kale leaves and the noodles
24. Cover with remaining tomato sauce and remaining mozzarella
25. Bake for 30 minutes and let stand 10 minutes before serving
26. For make ahead directions see description

title: greek seasoned smothered chicken
steps:
1. Sprinkle cavender's seasoning on each piece of chicken , front and back
2. Do not over season , as the flavor may be too strong , but adjust according to your tastes
3. Slice mushrooms , peppers and onion
4. Brown veggies in butter , to desired doneness , set aside
5. In skillet , heat oil and butter on medium heat and brown the chicken breasts coated with seasoning
6. Cover and cook slowly until done
7. Heat may have to be adjusted down to allow cooking all the way through without burning
8. When chicken is cooked , top each piece with the vegetable mixture
9. Top each chicken piece with 1 or 2 slices of provolone cheese
10. Heat on low until cheese is melted

title: instant potato bread  bread machine
steps:
1. Place all the ingredients in the pan according to the order in the manufacturer's instructions
2. Set crust on medium and program for the basic cycle
3. Press start
4. The dough ball will be nicely formed and slightly sticky but stiff at the same time when tested
5. It should feel a bit sticky , so take care not to add any more than an extra tablespoon of flour
6. The potato flakes will soak up the extra moisture during the rises and will become smooth during the risings
7. When the baking cycle ends , immediately remove the bread from the pan and place it on a rack
8. Let cool to room temperature before slicing

title: marshmallow fridge tart
steps:
1. Mix lemon juice and condensed milk
2. Mix in marshmallows and cherries
3. Whip cream stiffly then add vanilla extract and pineapple
4. Mix everything together and pour into prepared crumb crust
5. Refrigerate to set

title: championship cookies
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl , cream shrtening and brown sugar
2. Beat in egg and vanilla
3. Combine the flour , baking powder , baking soda , cinnamon and salt
4. Gradually add to the cramed mixture
5. Stir in chopped candy bars and oats
6. Drop by rounded tablespoonfuls 2 inches apart onto greased or parchment-lined baking sheets
7. Bake at 350 degrees for 10-12 minutes or until lightly browned
8. Remove to wire racks to cool

title: roquefort blue cheese chicken   oamc
steps:
1. Season chicken breasts with salt and pepper
2. Brown in skillet on both sides in butter
3. Mix together sour cream , cheese and garlic
4. Arrange in shallow baking dish
5. Pour over cheese mixture over chicken
6. Freeze
7. To serve , defrost and bake at 350f for 45 minutes
8. Good served with buttered egg noodles !

title: funky purple smoothie
steps:
1. Process banana in a blender until pureed
2. Add the black grapes and process again until smooth
3. Now add the ice cubes and process until some of them are crushed
4. Finally , add the milk , process until smooth , pour into a tall , pretty glass , and drink !

title: asparagus soup  spargelsuppe
steps:
1. Scrape asparagus stalks to remove tough portion and cut into bite-size pieces
2. Place in boiling salted water with a pinch of sugar
3. Simmer gently for 20 minutes
4. Remove from heat and stir in cream
5. Blend in lightly beaten egg yolks
6. Season with pepper , add lemon juice and white wine
7. Fry diced ham in butter till crisp
8. Sprinkle on top
9. Serve at once

title: mustard pickled eggs
steps:
1. Place the peeled eggs in a non-metal bowl or jar
2. In a saucepan over medium heat , mix together cider vinegar , sugar , onion , mustard powder , garlic powder , salt and food coloring
3. Bring just to a simmer
4. Pour over the eggs and allow to cool
5. Cover and chill for at least 48 hours to allow flavor to develop

title: cashew asparagus
steps:
1. In saucepan , add 1 tablespoon butter and then nuts
2. Cook over medium heat stirring for 2 minutes
3. Spoon to paper towels and drain
4. Add to saucepan the remaining butter and cook the asparagus for 1 minute
5. Add water
6. Cover , and cook for 4 minutes
7. Pour into serving dish and sprinkle with nuts

title: roasted turkey breast
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients to make a paste
2. Now for the messy part- rub the paste between the skin and the flesh for the turkey breast , everywhere possible
3. Use all the paste
4. Roast per mfg
5. Instructions , usually about 2 hrs

title: condensed cream of chicken or mushroom soup  gluten free
steps:
1. For 1 can of condensed cream soup: in a saucepan , whisk 8 tablespoons of powdered soup mix with 1 / 4 cup cold water
2. Follow either step 2 or 3 to make the equivalent of 1 can of condensed cream of chicken or mushroom soup
3. Condensed cream of chicken soup: add 1 cup of water and cook over medium high heat until soup thickens , stirring frequently
4. Condensed cream of mushroom soup: pour liquid from canned mushrooms into a measuring cup and add water to measure 1 cup
5. Add liquid to saucepan and cook over medium high heat until soup thickens , stirring frequently
6. After soup has thickened , stir in mushrooms

title: german onion cake
steps:
1. In medium skillet , saute the onions in butter over low heat until they just begin to brown , about 15 minutes
2. Season with 1 / 4 tsp of the salt , the marjoram and the pepper
3. Set aside to cool
4. Preheat oven to 450f
5. In a food processor bowl place flour , cornstarch , baking powder , and the remaining salt
6. Mix
7. Add the shortening and process just until it is the texture of soft crumbs
8. Add the milk and mix quickly to form a soft dough
9. Oil a 10 inch round cake pan and lightly use your fingers to spread the dough out evenly
10. Spread the cooked onion over the top
11. Beat the egg and sour cream together
12. Spoon the mixture over the onion , and spread it out to the very edge of the pan
13. Sprinkle lightly with poppy seeds and paprika
14. Bake for 20 minutes
15. Let cool slightly , then cut into wedges

title: asian spareribs
steps:
1. In a small bowl , whisk together oil , pineapple juice , light soy sauce , hoisin sauce , wine , vinegar , peanut butter , brown sugar , garlic , ginger , pepper and onions until well-blended
2. If grilling , reserve about 1 / 2 of this mixture for brushing meat while grilling or double the marinade recipe for brushing during grilling
3. Place spare ribs in a glass pan and coat with the sauce
4. Cover and refrigerate for 8 hours or up to 24 hours
5. Bake at 375 degrees fahrenheit for about 45 minutes
6. Or grill for 10 to 15 minutes , turning ribs occasionally and brushing with the reserved marinade

title: grape nuts   bran muffins
steps:
