1. Preheat oven to 400f and lightly spray muffin pans with cooking spray or line with cupcake papers
2. In a large bowl , combine first four ingredients
3. In another bowl , pour in milk and cereal and let set 3 minutes
4. Stir in the egg , applesauce , sugar and margarine
5. Add to flour mixture and stir in the cereal of your choice
6. Spoon batter into prepared muffin cups
7. Bake 20 minutes or until golden and done

title: risotto with asparagus rice cooker 2008
steps:
1. So rice needed for this recipe is 1 1 / 2 cups in a regular measuring cup
2. Measure out the rice and rinse with cold water well
3. Add thefirst 7 ingredients together in the rice cooker
4. Close lid and press cook lever down
5. When the rice cooker switches to warm , add the grated fresh parmesan cheese
6. Stir in well
7. Serve

title: portabella mushrooms on tomato basil fettuccini
steps:
1. Tomato sauce: heat oil in large pot on low heat
2. Add onion& simmer very slowly for 20 minutes or until onion is translucent& completely limp , stirring occasionally
3. Raise heat to medium& add garlic
4. Cook for another 3 minutes or until garlic is soft
5. Add tomatoes& bring to a boil
6. Lower heat& simmer for 40- 50 minutes , stirring frequently
7. Using an electric hand blender or a wire whisk , emulsify the contents of the pot
8. Season to taste& simmer for another 5 minutes
9. Remove from heat , stir in basil leaves& cover
10. Reheat just before serving
11. Prepare mushrooms: trim stems& cut into pieces 1 / 2 inch thick
12. Combine in a bowl with other ingredients , being careful not to break mushroom pieces
13. Place on a foil lined baking sheet& bake in a preheated 350f oven for 15 minutes or until tender
14. Remove from oven , cover& set aside
15. Prepare pasta: add fettuccini noodles to a large pot of salted boiling water& cook according to package directions until el dente
16. Drain well
17. Assemby: combine pasta& tomato sauce and place on dishes
18. Top with parmesan , parsley& mushrooms

title: grapefruit cranberry relish
steps:
1. Put cranberries through food chopper
2. Add sugar
3. Mix well
4. Peel , section , and dice grapefruit
5. Stir into cranberries
6. Chill

title: vegetarian green enchilada lasagna
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit
2. Saute the onion until translucent
3. Add garlic salt and black pepper
4. Add mushrooms and cook until tender
5. Add corn and black beans to heat through
6. Add spinach and cook until wilted
7. Mix together the enchilada sauce and salsa
8. Spread a thin layer of sauce in a 9x13 baking dish
9. Lay out 4
10. 5 tortillas to cover the bottom
11. Spread out half of the veggies
12. Pour half of remaining sauce over veggies
13. Sprinkle half of the cheese
14. Repeat with tortillas , veggies , sauce and cheese
15. Bake for 30 minutes at 400 degrees

title: power pizza
steps:
1. Orange puree
2. In medium pot , cover carrots and potatoes with cold water
3. Boil 20 minutes until tender
4. Drain vegetables
5. Puree on high in food processor with two tablespoons water , until completely smooth
6. Use rest of water to make a smooth puree
7. Makes about 2 cups of puree
8. Store in refrigerator up to 3 days , or freeze 1 / 4 cup portions in plastic containers
9. White bean puree
10. Rinse and drain the beans and put in the bowl of your food processor
11. Pulsing in on / off turns , puree the drained beans with just 1 tablespoon of water in processor until smooth , stopping occasionally to scrape down sides of bowl
12. The goal is a smooth , but not wet , puree
13. If necessary , thin with a little more water by one teaspoonful at a time until there are no flecks of whole beans visible
14. Store in the refrigerator up to 3 days , or freeze 1 / 4 cup portions in sealed plastic bags or small plastic containers
15. Makes about 1 cup of puree
16. Double this recipe if you want to store another cup of puree
17. Steam cauliflower in a vegetable steamer over 2 inches of water , using a tightly-covered pot , for about 10 to 12 minutes until very tender
18. Alternatively , place cauliflower in a microwave-safe bowl , cover with water , and microwave on high for 8 to 10 minutes until very tender
19. While waiting for the cauliflower to finish steaming , start to pulse the raw peeled zucchini with the lemon juice only
20. Drain the cooked cauliflower
21. Working in batches if necessary , add it to the pulsed zucchini in the bowl of the food processor with one tablespoon of water
22. Puree on high until smooth
23. Stop occasionally and push contents from the top to the bottom
24. If necessary , use the second tablespoon of water to make a smooth puree
25. Makes about 2 cups of puree
26. Double recipe if you want to store even more , which can be done in the refrigerator for up to 3 days , or freeze 1 / 4 cup portions in sealed plastic bags or the small plastic containers
27. Preheat oven to 400 degrees and preheat a pizza stone or spray a baking sheet with oil
28. Stretch pizza dough , or roll out with floured rolling pin on floured surface , to form a pie
29. Transfer to stone or baking sheet
30. If using pocketless pitas , place them on the prepared baking sheet
31. Combine tomato sauce with orange puree
32. Mix well
33. Spread 1 / 2 to 1 cup of the sauce mixture across the large pizza dough , then top with 1 cup of mozzarella
34. Cover and refrigerate at this point , or bake for 15 to 20 minutes until bubbly and lightly browned
35. Allow to cool a few minutes , then cut into triangles and serve

title: sage   sesame rice
steps:
1. Add water , all of the seasonings except the butter & half of the seasame seeds to a microwave safe measuring cup & heat in the microwave for 2 minutes to dissolve the bullion , set aside
2. Brown rice in hot oil in a large skillet for approximately 5 minutes
3. Add chopped onion , minced garlic & saute til onions are soft
4. Add seasoned water to the browned rice , reduce heat to low , cover and simmer for 15 minutes
5. Do not check on the rice before the 15 minutes is up , this will allow steam to escape and may make your rice turn out undercooked
6. After 15 minutes uncover , turn rice over , place butter pats on top recover & let steam for 3-5 more minutes
7. Fluff with a fork to distribute the butter , sprinkle with remaining sesame seeds & serve

title: french canadian tourtiere ii
steps:
1. In a saucepan melt the butter and saute the garlic , onion & celery approximately 4 minutes
2. Add pork and break it up so there are no lumps , cook the meat until it changes color
3. Add chicken stock , thyme , salt , allspice and the bay leaf
4. Cover and simmer for 30 minutes
5. Remove the bay leaf
6. Let the mixture cool and add bread crumbs
7. Place in pie crust and put top crust on sealing the edges by fluting the crusts together
8. Cut an x in the center of the top crust
9. Glaze with egg & cream
10. Start baking it in lower 1 / 3 of the oven in a 425 oven for 10 minutes , lower heat to 375 , transfer the pie to the middle of the oven and bake for 25 minutes or until the crust is golden

title: linda s bean salad
steps:
1. Dump drained and rinsed beans into a bowl
2. In a small bowl , combine the yogurt , mayonnaise , garlic powder , cumin , salt and pepper
3. Pour mixture over the beans and stir it around well
4. Cover and refrigerate
5. This is better the next day

title: carrots and cream cheese cracker dip
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together
2. May need to add more / less milk for desired consistency
3. Serve with crackers or carrots

title: seven minute frosting   diabetic
steps:
1. Combine egg whites , cream of tartar , sugar substitute , water and salt in top of double boiler
2. Beat til frothy
3. Place over boiling water
4. Beat constantly until it thickens and will hold peaks
5. Remove from boiling water
6. Beat in vanilla
7. Continue beating until smooth and of spreading consistency

title: polish style roast chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Remove giblets from chickens
3. Place hearts , necks , and gizzards in roasting pan
4. Discard livers
5. With a sharp knife , remove excess fat from chickens
6. Dry insides with a paper towel
7. With fingers , loosen skin over breast and thighs to make pockets , being careful not to tear the skin
8. In a food processor or blender , combine onion , garlic , paprika , salt , and pepper
9. Puree until smooth
10. Spread 1 / 4 cup onion puree in the bottom of the roasting pan
11. Place chickens in pan , at least 1 inch apart
12. Rub 1 tablespoon puree in each cavity and spread remaining puree under skin
13. Tuck wing
14. Roast chickens for 20 minutes
15. Drizzle with 1 / 4 cup chicken broth and roast for 40 minutes more , basting with pan drippings every 20 minutes
16. Tent chickens with foil and continue roasting for 30 minutes , or until meat thermometer measures 180 and the cavity juices run clear
17. Transfer chickens to a platter and cover with foil to keep warm
18. Pour pan juices into a bowl and chill in freezer 10 minutes to bring fat to the surface
19. Meanwhile , add remaining chicken broth and vodka to roasting pan and bring to boil over medium heat , scraping up any brown bits adhering to pan
20. Add any juices accumulated on the platter
21. Skim off fat from chilled pan juices , add to roasting pan , and return to a boil
22. Strain juices through a fine sieve into a medium saucepan
23. Bring to a simmer over medium heat
24. In a small bowl , blend water and cornstarch
25. Whisk into simmering gravy
26. Cook , stirring , until slightly thickened , about 1 minute
27. Whisk in dill and sour cream , if using
28. Season with salt and pepper
29. Carve chickens , discarding skin
30. Serve with gravy
31. Serve with egg noodles and sauteed cabbage

title: quiche loaf supreme
steps:
1. Set oven to 350f
2. Grease a 9 x 5-inch loaf pan or a 8 x 4-inch loaf pan
3. In a large bowl , blend together flour , baking powder and garlic powder
4. Stir in the water or vegetable bouillon , oil , half and half cream and eggs
5. Mix well to combine
6. Fold in the green onions or scallions olives , roasted peppers salt , pepper , dill and shredded cheeses
7. Mix to combine well
8. Transfer / spoon into prepared loaf pan
9. Sprinkle with grated parmesan cheese and paprika
10. Bake for 45-50 minutes , or until set
11. If serving this hot , allow to cool slightly before cutting and serving
12. Refrigerate if serving later to serve cold

title: moody mountain blueberry frump cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Mix egg , molasses , sugar , butter and cinnamon in medium bowl
3. Add baking powder , baking soda blueberries , salt , sour cream and flour
4. Turn into greased 8 x 8 baking pan
5. Sprinkle top with sugar
6. Cook 40 to 45 minutes
7. Recipe can be doubled and cooked in a 9 x 12 baking pan

title: fettuccine with swordfish
steps:
1. Bring 6 quarts water to a boil in a large pot over high heat
2. Add about 1 tablespoon salt and return to a boil
3. Cut swordfish into 1 inch cubes
4. Season lightly with salt
5. Add 6 tablespoons olive oil to a large skillet over medium- high heat
6. Add fish to skillet and toss until opaque , about 1 minute
7. Transfer fish to a plate and season with salt
8. Add onion to skillet
9. Season with 1 / 4 teaspoon salt and crushed red pepper flakes
10. Cook until softened and sizzling , about 3 minutes
11. Add tomatoes and stir to combine
12. Fill tomato can with 1 / 2 cup hot water and add to pan
13. Increase heat and bring mixture to a boil
14. Stir in 3 / 4 teaspoon salt and mint
15. Reduce heat to a simmer and cook for 5 minutes
16. Return fish and any juices that have accumulated on plate to skillet
17. Stir until fish and sauce are well combined , about 1 minute , and turn off heat
18. Add pasta to boiling water and cook until al dente , according to package directions
19. Return fish and sauce to medium heat
20. Transfer pasta to skillet using tongs
21. Toss pasta in sauce , along with remaining 2 tablespoons olive oil , until well combined
22. Season with salt and serve immediately

title: perfect gluten free pie crust
steps:
1. Spray 9 inch pie pan with cooking spray
2. Generously dust with flour
3. Mix flours , sugar , xanthan gum , and salt in large bowl of an electric mixer
4. Cut butter into 6 piece and add to mix until crumbly and resembling coarse meal
5. Add egg and orange juice
6. Mix on low speed until dough holds together
7. It should not be sticky
8. Form dough into ball , using your hands , and place on a sheet of wax paper
9. Top with a second sheet of wax paper and flatten dough to 1 inch thickness
10. Roll out dough between the 2 sheets of wax paper
11. If the dough seems tacky , refrigerate for 15 minutes before proceeding
12. Remove top sheet of wax paper and invert dough into pie pan
13. Remove remaining sheet of wax paper , and crimp edges for single crust pie
14. (dough can also be frozen at this point for up to one month
15. Kine pie shell with wax paper , wrap in plastic wrap , then foil
16. To prebake a bottom crust: preheat oven to 375&deg
17. F gently prick pastry in 3 or 4 places with a fork
18. Bake for about 25 minutes or until golden and cool completely on wire rack
19. To partially bake a bottom crust: preheat oven to 375&deg
20. F bake pastry for 10 minutes , remove from oven
21. Fill and bake as per recipe

title: salad with orange vinaigrette and glazed almonds
steps:
1. Glazed almonds:beat egg white at high speed with an electric mixer until foamy
2. Gradually add sugar , beating until stiff peaks form
3. Fold in almonds
4. In an 8-in baking dish , combine melted butter and almonds , stir to coat
5. Bake at 325 degrees for 20 minutes , stirring every 5 minutes
6. Cool
7. Yield 1 cup
8. Orange vinaigrette: combine olive oil , red wine vinegar , orange rind , orange juice , poppy seeds , salt and pepper
9. Yield 1 / 2 cup
10. Combine salad greens , mandarin oranges and green onion
11. Drizzle with orange vinaigrette and sprinkle with glazed almonds

title: kotlecky  ukrainian meatballs
steps:
1. Squeeze the milk out of the bread and discard
2. Mix together with the meats , onion , garlic , eggs , salt and pepper and sour cream
3. Mix well , then shape into 8 large balls
4. Brown the balls in hot oil , then place in a oven proof casserole dish
5. Bake covered , for 30 minutes at 325f
6. Remove cover and bake 15 minutes longer

title: speculaas tart with almond filling
steps:
1. For filling:
2. Blend first 8 ingredients in processor until nuts are finely chopped
3. Transfer to small bowl
4. Cover
5. Chill at least 2 hours and up to 2 days
6. For dough:
7. Sift first 6 ingredients into medium bowl
8. Using electric mixer , beat butter and sugar in large bowl until blended
9. Beat in egg
10. Add flour mixture and beat until moist clumps form
11. Gather dough into ball
12. Divide into 2 pieces , 1 slightly larger than the other
13. Flatten dough into disks
14. Wrap and chill at least 2 hours
15. Preheat oven to 325f
16. Butter 9-inch-diameter springform pan
17. Roll out larger dough piece on lightly floured surface to 13-inch round
18. Transfer to pan and press gently over bottom and up sides , pressing any tears together
19. Spread filling in dough
20. Trim dough on sides to 1 / 2 inch above level of filling
21. Fold dough in over filling
22. Roll out second dough disk on lightly floured surface to 12- to 13-inch round
23. Using bottom of cake pan as aid , cut out 9-inch-diameter round of dough
24. Slide dough round onto plate and freeze 5 minutes to firm
25. Place chilled dough round on tart
26. Press to adhere and seal edges
27. Bake tart until crust is brown , about 50 minutes
28. Remove sides of springform pan
29. Cool tart completely on pan bottom
30. Maintain oven temperature
31. Line 2 baking sheets with parchment paper
32. Roll out dough scraps on lightly floured surface to scant 1 / 4-inch thickness
33. Using 2-inch gingerbread-man cutter , cut out cookies
34. Transfer cutouts to prepared sheets
35. Repeat , using all of dough
36. Bake cookies until golden , about 8 minutes
37. Cool cookies on sheets
38. Sift powdered sugar over top of tart
39. Place small dab of preserves on back of 1 cookie
40. Place at top edge of tart
41. Repeat with more cookies , forming border around tart
42. Transfer tart to platter
43. Let stand at room temperature at least 1 hour

title: caramel apple  cream cheese dip
steps:
1. Spread cream cheese on platter
2. On top of cream cheese spread caramel dipping sauce
3. Sprinkle toffee bits on top of caramel sauce
4. Serve with green apple slices

title: huevos pericos  colombian scrambled eggs
steps:
1. Heat olive oil and butter in skillet
2. Saute diced tomato and green onion until liquid from tomato evaporates
3. Sprinkle a little salt over cooked vegetables in pan
4. Add milk to 4 eggs and beat slightly with a fork
5. Add eggs to pan and scramble them over medium heat until done
6. Add salt and pepper

title: carrots sauted in bay leaf
steps:
1. Add oil to large non stick skillet
2. Swirl to coat
3. Add bay leaves to infuse the oil
4. Add carrots and water
5. Partially cover the pan and cook for 10 minutes until carrots are almost tender
6. Add salt and pepper to taste , increase heat to medium-high and cook for approximately 4 minutes , until carrots are tender and lightly browned
7. Stir frequently
8. These directions are so easy , they can be adjusted for time , amount of bay leaves , etc
9. I have also used with sage and rosemary
10. All variations are delicious !
11. If you like a softer carrot , cook longer , shorter time for more crunch

title: home made pizza sauce recipe from scratch
steps:
1. Heat your oil in an 8 quart pan
2. Add your onionswe want to sweat them until they are transparent
3. This should take about six minutes
4. Then , add your garlic
5. By now , your kitchen should be filling with a delectable aromaexcellent !
6. At this point , we want to add the tomato puree we made , along with the sugar , salt , and red pepper
7. Bring the whole mixture to a boil
8. Then reduce heat and simmer , stirring occasionally , as the sauce thickens
9. The sauce should be pretty smooth when we finished , provided we did okay during the food-processing
10. Voila ! youve made all-natural , excellent pizza sauce from all whole ingredients
11. This pizza sauce recipe can be canned or frozen , so if you have left overs after you prepare your pizza , go ahead and save some for next time
12. Please
13. One pint is good for 2 -12 inch pizza's

title: herb loves her herb bread
steps:
1. Add ingredients according to manufacturer's directions
2. Select basic cycle
3. Operate machine
4. Enjoy your loaf !

title: crockpot sweet   sour chicken
steps:
1. Place the frozen chicken in the crockpot and dump the pineapple on top
2. Scatter the chopped vegetables over the chicken and pineapple
3. Whisk together the soy sauce , thai sweet chili sauce , and the chicken broth , then pour over all
4. Cover and cook for 6 hours on low
5. Remove chicken to cutting board and cut into slices or cubes
6. Return chicken to pot
7. Whisk together the cold water and the cornstarch until smooth , then stir into the pot
8. Cover and continue to cook on low for at least 1 hour
9. Serve over hot cooked rice

title: broccoli egg cups
steps:
1. Grease six 8-oz
2. Ramekins
3. Set aside
4. Preheat oven to 350f
5. In a large saucepan , bring 3 cups water to a boil
6. Add broccoli
7. Cover and boil for 3 minutes
8. Drain and immediately place broccoli in ice water
9. Drain and pat dry
10. In a large bowl , whisk 4 eggs , cream , cheese , parsley , salt , basil and cayenne
11. Pour into prepared dishes
12. Break an additional egg into each dish
13. Place broccoli around each egg
14. Bake at 350 for 30-35 minutes or until set

title: the only main course salad recipe you need to know
steps:
1. Combine salad ingredients , dress and allow to rest for 10 minutes
2. Serve on a bed of lettuce
3. For vegetarian omit the cooked chicken breasts or salmon and use the temphe or the beans instead

title: balsamic dipping sauce for bread
steps:
1. Blend all ingredients together thoroughly
2. Serve with your favourite hearty , crusty bread
3. Store unused portion in an airtight container and refrigerate it will last at least 6 months

title: sunday pineapple
steps:
1. Mix the pineapple , cheese , sugar and flour and spread in a 9x13 pan
2. Cover with ritz crackers and drizzle with melted butter
3. Bake 350 degrees for 30 minutes

title: blender egg custard pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees
2. Combine milk , sugar , flour , eggs , butter , and vanilla in blender container
3. Blend at medium speed for about 30 seconds
4. Pour into greased and floured 10-inch pie plate
5. Sprinkle with nutmeg
6. Bake for 45 minutes or until firm
7. It will form its own crust as it bakes

title: quick  colourful tofu stir fry
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large frying pan or a wok
2. Add in all of the veggies except for the pak choi leaves
3. Sautee over medium heat for 5 minutes stirring once in a while
4. Season with rosemary and curry powder
5. Add the tofu and sautee for another 5 minutes
6. Now add the pak choi leaves
7. Sautee until leaves have shrunken
8. Remove from heat and stir in any optional toppings
9. Season with salt to taste
10. Enjoy plain , with brown rice or noodles
11. :)

title: low carb pasta with gorgonzola and walnuts
steps:
1. Cook penne according to package directions
2. Meanwhile , combine remaining ingredients in large serving bowl
3. Stir gently and season to taste
4. Drain pasta thoroughly and toss with sauce
5. Sprinkle parmesan cheese on top
6. Serve hot

title: cinnamon spiced chard pancakes  passover
steps:
1. Stir chard with any water still clinging to leaves in large pot over medium-high heat until just wilted but still green , about 3 minutes
2. Place in sieve
3. Press out moisture
4. Cool completely
5. Combine eggs , onion , matzo meal , cinnamon , salt , allspice and pepper in medium bowl
6. Blend well
7. Mix in chard
8. Preheat oven to 300f place baking sheet in oven
9. Heat 3 tablespoons olive oil in heavy medium skillet over medium heat
10. Working in batches , drop heaping 1 tablespoon swiss chard mixture for each pancake into skillet
11. Flatten to 1 / 2-inch thickness
12. Fry pancakes until golden brown and cooked through , adding more olive oil to skillet as necessary , about 3 minutes per side
13. Transfer pancakes to baking sheet in oven to keep warm after each batch
14. Serve pancakes warm with lemon wedges

title: caramelised onion  goat cheese   thyme tarts
steps:
1. Pre-heat the oven to 435f
2. Melt half the butter in a saucepan over a medium heat
3. Add the onions and cook for 25-30 minutes until soft and golden
4. Stir in the sugar , balsamic vinegar , thyme and garlic granules
5. Leave to cool
6. Melt the remaining butter
7. Unroll the pastry sheets and cut each one into four
8. In a patty tin , layer two quarters on top of each other , brushing lightly with butter between the sheets and on top
9. Spoon 1 / 4 of the onions into the centre and set aside
10. Repeat with the remaining pastry and onions to make 4 tarts
11. Place a slice of cheese on top of the onions on each tart
12. Lightly brush the edges of the pastry with butter
13. Chill for 30 minutes
14. Bake for 15-20 minutes , until the pastry is golden and the cheese is melting
15. Serve with a few salad leaves

title: long grain and wild rice mix
steps:
1. Mix ingredients and store in an air-tight container
2. Attach these instructions
3. To prepare , bring 3 1 / 4 cups water to boil in a medium saucepan
4. Add rice mix , cover , and simmer for 50 minutes
5. Remove from heat , and wait 10 minutes before fluffing with a fork
6. Use long grain white rice to decrease cook time to about 35-40 minutes
7. Wild rice takes quite awhile to cook

title: oatmeal drop cookies
steps:
1. In medium pot mix margarine , sugar , cocoa and milk
2. Boil 1 minute
3. Remove from burner and add peanut butter , vanilla and oatmeal
4. Stir until thick
5. Drop by spoon onto a greased cookie sheet or wax paper
6. Let cool
7. Be ready to munch

title: tofu noodle  tuna casserole
steps:
1. Drain tofu noodles
2. Using a scissors , cut them into 1-2" pieces
3. Parboil for 2-3 minutes to remove the "shirataki" aroma from the noodles
4. Preheat oven to 375f spray a small casserole dish with non-stick cooking spray
5. Mix the noodles , soup , tuna , peas , and seasonings together in the dish
6. Add breadcrumbs to top if using , and sprinkle with a bit more black pepper
7. Bake , uncovered , for about 30 minutes , until casserole is hot and bubbly
8. If you are adding cheese to the top , sprinkle it on about 20 minutes into baking

title: beef n potato bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. In a shallow 1 1 / 2 quart baking dish , combine oil , hash browns and pepper
3. Press firmly to sides and bottom of dish
4. Bake uncovered@ 400 degrees for 15 minutes
5. Brown beef , drain
6. Stir in gravy pkgs , water , garlic salt
7. Bring to boil
8. Add veggies and reduce heat and cook for 5 minutes
9. Stir in 1 / 2 cheese and 1 / 2 can fried onions
10. Bake 15 minutes@ 350 degrees
11. Sprinkle remainder of cheese and onions on top and bake another 5 minutes

title: spinach salad with lemon
steps:
1. Tear or cut the spinach into small pieces & put in a salad bowl
2. Add chopped pimientos
3. Toss well
4. In a small bowl mix the lemon juice , pepper& sugar , mix well
5. Drizzle over the salad & toss well

title: savory ham and swiss breakfast pie
steps:
1. Bring first 6 ingredients to a boil in a medium saucepan
2. Gradually whisk in grits
3. Cover , reduce heat , and simmer , whisking occasionally , 5 to 7 minutes
4. Add 1 / 2 cup cheese , stirring until cheese melts
5. Remove from heat , and let stand 10 minutes
6. Lightly beat 2 eggs , and stir into grits mixture
7. Pour into a lightly greased 10-inch-deep pie plate
8. Bake at 350 for 20 minutes
9. Remove from oven
10. To freeze: prepare and bake as directed
11. Allow to cool
12. Wrap well in plastic wrap and then foil
13. Freeze
14. To serve: thaw in fridge and reheat in oven
15. Increase oven temperature to 400
16. Saut ham and onions in a nonstick skillet over medium-high heat 5 minutes or until onion is tender
17. Layer ham mixture evenly over grits crust
18. Whisk together milk and remaining 6 eggs
19. Pour over ham mixture
20. Sprinkle remaining 3 / 4 cup cheese evenly over egg mixture
21. Bake at 400 for 35 minutes
22. Let stand 10 minutes , and cut into wedges
23. Garnish , if desired

title: crispy chocolate squares
steps:
1. In a large microwave-safe bowl
2. Combine the marshmallows , peanut butter , chocolate chips and butter
3. Cover and microwave on high for 2 1 / 2 minutes
4. Stir until well blended add cereal and peanuts
5. Stir until well coated
6. Spread into a greased 13x9 pan
7. For the frosting , combine chocolate chips , butter and milk in another microwave-safe bowl
8. Cover and microwave on high for 1 1 / 2 minutes
9. Mix well
10. Add powdered sugar and vanilla
11. With an electric mixer , beat frosting until smooth
12. Spread over the cereal mixture
13. Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours or until firm
14. Cut into squares

title: lemon pesto buttermilk salad dressing
steps: 1. Mix all ingredients together in an airtight container in the fridge , up to one week

title: pistachio pesto sauce
steps:
1. Combine basil , garlic , cheese and pistachios in a food processor or blender
2. Process to mix
3. With the machine running , slowly add the olive oil
4. Season with salt and pepper and process to the desired consistency
5. Let stand for 5 minutes
6. To serve , thin the pesto with a few tablespoons of hot pasta cooking water and toss with hot fettuccine or linguine

title: prosciutto  nectarine  and fontina panini
steps:
1. Preheat grill or panini maker to high
2. Grill nectarine slices until grill marks appear , but they are not mushy , less than a minute
3. Spread butter on what will be the outsides of your sandwich and place on a clean work surface
4. Layer a slice of fontina on the unbuttered side of the bottom , top with prosciutto , nectarine
5. Season generously with pepper , add a handful of arugula , top with fontina slice and sliced bread , buttered side up
6. Place sandwich on grill or panini maker and cook until the bread is browned and crispy , 2 to 3 minutes
7. Cut in half , if desired , and serve immediately

title: magic minestrone
steps:
1. In a large pot , over medium heat , cook the garlic , onion , celery and thyme in the olive oil , stirring , for 2 minutes , or until softened
2. Add the broth , carrots , tomatoes , zucchini , green beans , water and salt
3. Bring to a boil
4. Add barley
5. Reduce heat , simmer 15 minutes
6. Stir in white beans and spinach , cook 5 more minutes

title: darlene s pumpkin bars
steps:
1. Cream together eggs , sugar , oil and pumpkin
2. Beat until light and fluffy
3. Mix flour and other dry ingredients
4. Add pumpkin mix and mix thoroughly
5. Spread batter in ungreased 15x10 pan
6. Bake at 350 degrees for 25-30 minutes

title: beef noodle one pot meal
steps:
1. In dutch oven or large covered pot saute onions & minced garlic in olive oil
2. Add ground beef and cook until done
3. Add green chiles and corn and season to taste
4. Spread uncooked egg noodles on meat mixture
5. Sprinkle shredded cheese on top of noodles
6. Pour diced tomatoes and tomato sauce on top of noodles
7. Sprinkle with more seasonings
8. Turn stove to low and simmer for 1 hour or until noodles are cooked

title: honey miso salad dressing
steps:
1. Mix the miso , honey , and mustard together
2. Add the remaining ingredients , mix until smooth
3. Let sit 15 minutes before using

title: italian style cream of tomato soup
steps:
1. Combine chicken broth , onion , green bell pepper , celery , garlic powder , salt , herbs and pepper in a large saucepan and bring to a boil
2. Reduce heat and simmer until vegetables are tender , about 5 minutes
3. Add the undrained tomatoes , tomato sauce , tomato paste and sugar
4. Bring to a boil
5. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 15 minutes
6. Stir in half-and-half and heat through
7. Serve !

title: pineapple chicken or pork balls
steps:
1. Place first 5 ingredients in a bowl and stir well
2. Add ground chicken or pork
3. Mix and shape into 1 1 / 2 inch balls
4. Arrange on a broiler tray and broil , turning once , until browned , about 4 - 5 minutes per side
5. Place meatballs in a 3 1 / 2 quart slow cooker
6. Combine next 8 ingredients in a saucepan
7. Mix water and cornstarch in a small cup and then add to saucepan
8. Heat and stir until boiling and
9. Thickened
10. Pour over meatballs
11. Cover and cook on low for 4 to 5 hours or on high for 2 to 2 1 / 2 hours
12. Great with rice or all alone

title: beef   andouille burgers with asiago cheese
steps:
1. Finely chop sun-dried tomatoes in food processor
2. Blend in mayonnaise and mustard
3. Transfer to small bowl and cover and chill
4. Can be made up to 1 day ahead
5. Finely chop andouille sausage in processor
6. Transfer to large bowl
7. Add beef , shallots , salt , pepper and fennel seeds
8. Stir with fork just until blended
9. Form mixture into 6 patties
10. Prepare barbecue on medium high heat
11. Grill hamburger buns until golden brown for 2min
12. Transfer to plate
13. Brush onion slices with oil
14. Sprinkle with salt & pepper
15. Grill until golden about 7min
16. Per side
17. Grill until desired doneness
18. Sprinkle cheese over top of burgers
19. Spread hamburger buns with sun-dried tomato mayonnaise
20. Top with red bell peppers
21. Top with onion slices
22. Then place hamburgers on and tops of buns

title: meat stuffed french loaves
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
2. Cut off the ends of the bread , and carefully hollow out the center portion
3. In a food processor , make soft crumbs out of the bread that was removed from the middle of the loaf
4. Brown the sausage and ground meat in a skillet over medium heat
5. Add onion , and continue to cook until soft
6. In a bowl , combine the cooked meat and onion , the bread crumbs , grated cheese , the egg , mustard , parsley , fennel , basil , salt and pepper and pepper to taste
7. With a long handled wooden spoon , stuff the hollowed out french bread with the stuffing mixture
8. Place the ends of the bread back in place and secure with small skewers
9. Melt the butter and stir in the garlic , let cook over low heat for about 1 minute
10. Brush the loaf with the butter / garlic mixture and wrap in a piece of aluminium foil , leaving it open at the top , slightly so the top browns
11. Bake until heated through , 15 to 20 minutes
12. Cut into 1 inch slices for hors d'oeuvres , or into 4 larger pieces for main course servings

title: spicy pork tenderloin
steps:
1. Place tenderloins in plastic bag
2. Combine remaining ingredients in a small bowl
3. Rub over tenderloins
4. Refrigerate 6 hours or overnight
5. Bake , uncovered , at 425 degrees for 25-35 minutes , or until meat thermometer reads 150-155 degrees
6. Cover with foil and let rest for 10 minutes before slicing

title: summer vegetables in parchment paper
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees
2. Combine all ingredients in a bowl and gently mix
3. Fold four 15 inch square pieces of parchment paper in half
4. Cut each into heart shapes
5. Unfold and place vegetables on one side of each sheet next to fold
6. Fold and tightly seal the edges with narrow folds
7. Place packets on a rimmed baking sheet and bake 15 minutes
8. Remove packets from oven and transfer to individual serving plates
9. Cut open packets and serve

title: italian meatballs  joy of cooking style
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients up to the dried oregano with your hands
2. Scoop out mixture in heaping tablespoons and form into 2-inch balls
3. Dredge the meatballs in the flour
4. Heat in a large skillet over medium heat the 2 tablespoons of olive oil
5. Brown the meatballs in batches
6. Place in baking pan and cook in a preheated 375 degree oven for 10 minutes
7. Or , if desired finish cooking in the sauce of your choice
8. Enjoy !

title: em s cheese   buttermilk muffins
steps:
1. Mix the dry ingredients together in a mixing bowl
2. Mix the wet ingredients together in a jug
3. Mix the wet ingredients into the dry ingredients
4. Spoon into 12 greased muffin cups
5. Bake in moderatly hot oven 20 to 25 minutes

title: rosy radish relish
steps:
1. Put radishes , celery and onion through the coarse blade of a grinder , or chop them finely
2. Mix remaining ingredients and allow to stand for three hours
3. Bring to a boil in large pan and cook 10 minutes
4. Pour into hot jars , leaving 1 / 2 inch head space
5. Adjust lids and process 1 / 2 pints or pints in a boiling water bath for 20 minutes

title: mawmaw bellard s pralines  microwave recipe
steps:
1. Combine all except for vanilla extract in a microwave safe 1 quart bowl or measuring cup
2. Microwave on high for about 6 minutes , stirring every 2 minute
3. Add vanilla extract and stir quickly
4. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto waxed paper and allow to harden
5. If it sets up too fast while in the bowl just add a bit of evaporated milk
6. My problem was always spooning them out before the sugary mixture was thick enough or had cooled enough
7. I solved that by stirring quickly and checking to see if it starts to harden around the edges of my spoon or bowl
8. That's when it's ready to spoon out
9. It's very humid here so unsure how different climates will affect the outcome

title: middle eastern vinegar
steps:
1. Pour vinegar over herbs
2. Cover tightly and steep 2-3 weeks
3. Strain into decorative bottle
4. Add a cinnamon stick for decoration

title: oven baked crusty herbed cauliflower
steps:
1. Cut cauliflower into medium-size florets
2. Steam the florets in a steamer basket over simmering water
3. Cover
4. Cook for just a few minutes until barely tender
5. Remove and cool slightly until you can handle the pieces
6. Meanwhile , beat together eggs , salt and pepper in shallow pie plate
7. Toss together bread crumbs , basil and parsley in another shallow pie plate
8. Preheat oven to 400 degrees fahrenheit
9. Coat baking sheet with nonstick vegetable oil spray , or lightly oil with a pastry brush
10. Place flour in a bag
11. Add florets in batches , shake to coat
12. Shake off excess flour
13. Discard leftover flour
14. Dip lightly floured pieces into egg mixture then into crumb mixture , turning to coat
15. Place on prepared baking sheet
16. Drizzle with melted butter
17. Bake in preheated 400 degree fahrenheit oven for 20 minutes or until golden and crispy
18. Serve hot

title: leek and carrot soup
steps:
1. Bring your stock to the boil , add the leeks , carrots and bay leaf
2. Bring back to the boil , then simmer for 20 to 30 minutes until the vegetables are tender
3. Let cool slightly , remove the bay leaf , puree the soup in a food processor or with a hand blender to your own liking
4. Add the milk , if you find the soup is too thick add some more milk or water , adjust the seasoning and serve , with or without the cream

title: oriental poached fish
steps:
1. Combine poaching liquid ingredients with water to bring the mixture within 1 1 / 2 inches from top of fish poacher , dutch oven or lidded pan
2. Bring to a boil and boil for 5 minutes
3. Add fish to poaching liquid
4. Cover pan
5. Immediately turn off heat
6. Let fish cook , undisturbed for 10 minutes
7. Stir together soy sauce , sugar , sherry , vinegar , pepper and chicken stock in mixing bowl
8. Set aside
9. Transfer fish to warmed platter
10. Discard poaching liquid
11. Heat peanut oil in a wok or large nonstick skillet over high heat
12. When a wisp of smoke appears , add ginger and scallions
13. Cook , stirring and shaking for 1 minute
14. Add sauce
15. Once sauce boils , pour contents of pan over fish
16. Serve at once

title: chilled cream of cucumber soup
steps:
1. Coarsely pure cucumbers in a blender or food processor
2. Transfer to a metal bowl and whisk in remaining ingredients and salt to taste
3. Cover bowl and chill 30 minutes , stirring occasionally
4. Serve in chilled bowls

title: ksekuchen  cheesecake
steps:
1. Sift flour on a flat surface and make a well in the middle of it
2. Add sugar , salt and egg yolk into the well
3. Cut butter into small pieces and add into the well
4. Cut all with a knife first and then knead quickly with cool hands to form a dough
5. Cover dough and place in the fridge for at least for 20 minutes
6. Meanwhile grease a 9-10 inch spring form
7. Soak raisins in small bowl with dark rum
8. Sprinkle work top lightly with flour
9. Roll out dough large enough to cover bottom and sides of spring form
10. Line form with dough
11. Prick dough several times with a fork
12. Cover and place pan in the fridge
13. Preheat oven
14. Meanwhile prepare the filling: take raisins from rum and drain on paper towels
15. Put curd in a clean kitchen towel , gather 4 corners and wring as much whey as possible out of the curd
16. It has to be as dry as possible
17. Save the whey
18. Weigh dry curd
19. You will need 1 2 / 3 pounds of dried curd for the recipe
20. Measure whey
21. Fill up with low fat milk to 1 cup
22. Mix vanilla pudding mix with 2 / 3 of the sugar and milk
23. Bring whey to a boil
24. Remove from heat
25. Add vanilla pudding mixture and stir
26. Boil up for a few times
27. Remove from heat again
28. Under perpetual stirring add curd and vanilla extract
29. Bring to a boil for a last time
30. Put mixture in bowl and add raisins
31. Beat egg white until stiff
32. Add remaining sugar
33. Fold stiff egg white under the curd mixture
34. Take dough out of the fridge and add curd filling and flatten
35. For brushing mix egg yolk with milk and spread carefully over the filling after 30 min of baking time
36. Bake ksekuchen in the middle of the oven for about 45-60 minutes
37. Important
38. If cake gets too brown , cover it with baking paper and reduce heat
39. Cake should not rise much
40. If necessary reduce heat
41. Cake is done , when toothpick comes out dry with no filling attach to it
42. When cake is done remove from oven and detach side of the cake immediately from pan , but leave in pan for another 10 minutes
43. Open spring form pan and let cake cool completely
44. You can replace it by low fat ricotta or low fat cottage cheese
45. If you replace curd by ricotta or cottage cheese use low fat milk instead of whey
46. Or you can make german quark to make it a typical german cheesecake

title: elegant vanilla sauce for desserts
steps:
1. In small bowl , whisk together whipping cream , confectioners sugar , and salt
2. Add the vanilla extract and maple syrup , rum , and kirschwasser
3. Mix well
4. As a final touch , add the ground nutmeg
5. The sauce should be rich and creamy
6. To thicken , add more powdered sugar

title: italian inn chicken parmigiana
steps:
1. Mix breadcrumbs and 1 / 4 c parmesan cheese in shallow plate
2. Salt & pepper chicken
3. Breasts on both sides , then dip in eggs , then crumbs
4. Heat 2 t oil and 2 t butter in skillet
5. Add chicken and saute
6. When lightly browned on both sides , remove and set aside
7. Heat oven to 350
8. In saucepan , saute onion and garlic in 2 t olive oil until soft
9. Add
10. Tomatoes , tomato sauce , basil , thyme , 1 t salt , t pepper
11. Cover and simmer 15 minutes
12. Cut mozzarella into 8 slices to cover each piece of chicken
13. Spoon some sauce into
14. Shallow baking dish
15. Arrange alternate , overlapping slices of cheese and chicken in dish
16. Spoon remaining sauce around edge
17. Sprinkle with 1 / 2 c parmesan cheese
18. Bake 15-20
19. Minutes in 350 oven
20. This is a really good dish !

title: buttery bread sticks
steps:
1. Place the margarine in a 9 x 13 rectangular pan and place in a 425 degree oven to melt the margarine
2. Meanwhile combine the flour , sugar , baking powder and salt in a large mixing bowl
3. Using a fork to stir , gradually mix in the milk
4. Add a little more milk if needed
5. Stir up the dough until it is cohesive and forms a soft ball
6. Coat the ball with flour if it seems sticky
7. Rip off a sheet of waxed paper and pat or roll the dough out on top of the wax paper
8. Make a roughly regtangular shape to fit the hot pan
9. Remove the hot pan from oven once margarine is melted
10. Gently place the large sheet of dough into the pan , overtop the hot margarine , being very careful not to burn yourself
11. Next , use a pizza cutter or sharp knife to cut the dough in thin strips , as well as down the middle if desired
12. The margagine will ooze up between the sticks
13. You may sprinkle parmesan cheese on at this time if you like--or add garlic salt or garlic powder to the butter before adding the dough
14. Bake at 425 degrees for about 15 to 20 minutes
15. They will bake up golden brown , crunchy on the outside and soft in the center

title: hibiscus sangria
steps:
1. Add to the hot water cardamom , hibiscus and sweetener , steep for 30 minutes
2. Strain into a picture add fruit and chill till cold
3. Add brandy if using and dozen of ice cubes top with rosa regal by banfi , processco or champagne
4. Pour into ice filled wine glasses adding some fruit

title: olive garden chicken formaggio pizza
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees
2. Saut or bake chicken breast
3. Cool
4. Cut into 1 / 4-inch wide strips
5. Spray or grease a 12-inch pizza pan
6. Saut onions and garlic briefly in the olive oil and add them to the tomatoes , salt and basil
7. Spread the tomato mixture over the top of the crust
8. Lay the chicken strips down over the tomatoes
9. Top with fontinella and mozzarella cheeses
10. Add the sliced mushrooms and sprinkle with parmesan cheese
11. Bake at 450 degrees for 8 minutes or until cheese is melted and the crust is piping hot

title: brussels sprouts with bacon  pistachios and balsamic vinegar
steps:
1. Pre cook brussels sprouts in microwave , by steaming , or pan roasting until almost tender , depending on method and size of sprouts , 5-15 minutes
2. Fry bacon in sauce pan until crisp
3. Remove from pan and add brussel sprouts to bacon grease , saute for 1-2 minutes
4. Add pistachios and balsamic vinegar
5. Stir around for 1-2 minutes , reducing balsamic and glazing sprouts and nuts
6. Add bacon back to pan and season with salt and pepper

title: chicken or shrimp biryani
steps:
1. Rinse rice and place in medium bowl
2. Add enough cold water to cover rice and let stand 10 minute
3. While rice is soaking , heat oil in large nonstick skillet on medium-high heat
4. Add cumin seed
5. Cook and stir 30 sec
6. Stir in onions , garlic and ginger
7. Cook 5 minute or until crisp-tender , stirring constantly
8. If using chicken add now
9. Cook and stir 2 minute
10. Drain rice and add to chicken mixture with remaining ingredients
11. Mix well
12. Cover
13. Bring to boil
14. Simmer on medium-low heat 25 minutes , add peas and cook another 5 minutes or until rice is tender and liquid is absorbed
15. Remove from heat
16. Let stand 5 minute

title: mocha
steps:
1. Combine cocoa , cinnamon , sugar , and coffee in large mug
2. Microwave on high for 90 seconds
3. Add soy milk and creamer
4. Microwave on high for 90 seconds more
5. Whisk and serve

title: lamb and rosemary potato pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180c
2. Place potatoes into a saucepan of boiling salted water and cook for 20 minutes or until tender
3. Drain and return to the saucepan and add butter and milk and mash until smooth , set to one side
4. While potatoes are cooking heat oil in a saucepan over medium heat and add onions and garlic and cook for 5 minutes until softened
5. Add mince and carrot and cook until browned and then add tomato paste and rosemary and cook stirring for 2 minutes
6. Remove from heat and stir in flour and slowly add stock stirring after each addition until combined
7. Return to heat and cook for a further 5 minutes , stirring constantly until sauce has thickened
8. Spoon into a 2 litre capacity ovenproof dish
9. Top with mashed potato then sprinkle over cheese and bake for 15 minutes or until golden

title: pesto chicken salad for sandwiches
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients
2. Spread on bread
3. Makes enough for 2 sandwiches

title: swiss mocha coffee mix
steps:
1. Measure all of the ingredients into a clean , dry bowl
2. Use a fork to combine everything evenly
3. Transfer this mixture into a resealable container
4. To prepare: measure 3 or 4 tablespoons of mixture in resealable container into a coffee mug
5. Fill coffee mug with hot water and stir to dissolve

title: easy awesome nutty toffee  no thermometer
steps:
1. Spread the nuts on the bottom of a 8x8-in square pan
2. Heat the sugar and butter
3. Boil on med heat , stirring constantly for 7 minutes
4. Immediately spread mixture evenly over the nuts in the pan
5. Chill until firm
6. While still hot cut into squares
7. Delicious !

title: cheesecake dip
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl , beat cream cheese until smooth
2. Add the sour cream , sugar , milk and extract
3. Mix until smooth
4. Transfer to a serving bowl
5. Place the strawberries and crumbs in separate serving bowls
6. Dip strawberries into cheesecake mixture , then into crumbs

title: tiramisu  lift me up
steps:
1. Beat egg yolks and sugar in 2 quart sauce pan , beat in milk until sugar is dissolved
2. Heat to a boil over low to medium heat , stirring constantly
3. Reduce heat and boil for one minute
4. Cover and refrigerate until cold
5. Mix egg milk mixture with cheese and grated chocolate , set aside
6. Beat whipping cream and 2 tablespoons of cocoa in chilled bowl until stiff , refrigerate
7. Mix coffee with rum , or brandy and coffee liqueur ,
8. Dip half savoiardi in coffee mixture ,
9. Arrange in single layer in ungreased rectangular baking dish
10. Spread half cheese mixture over savoiardi
11. Spread half of the whipped cream over the cheese mixture
12. Repeat with remaining savoiardi , cheese mixture and whipped cream mixture
13. Sprinkle with cocoa and or grated chocolate
14. P s you can add vanilla extract when beating eggs and sugar

title: south ga turnips
steps:
1. Wash / rinse leaves and roots carefully checking for sand and bugs
2. Place leaves in collander to drain and set aside
3. Place water , salt , and meat in large boiler
4. Bring water to a boil
5. Add turnip leaves and roots
6. Cook for 120 minutes or longer until very tender
7. Serve hot in a bowl with a side of fresh baked cornbread
8. The green liquid is called pot liquor

title: overnight spinach salad for fifty
steps:
1. In two 5 quart bowls , layer spinach , eggs , bacon , mushrooms , romaine , and onion
2. In seperate bowl , combine sour cream , mayonnaise , lemon juice , salt , and pepper , and spread the mixture evenly over both salads
3. Sprinkle both salads with cheddar cheese and refrigerate for 12 to 24 hours
4. Just before serving , add peas to salad and toss to combine

title: buttermilk apple coffee cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. To prepare the cake , combine the first 4 ingredients in a small saucepan over med-high heat
3. Cook 5 minutes or until syrupy , stirring
4. Cool
5. Spoon the flour into a dry measuring cup
6. Combine flour , baking soda , and salt in a small bowl , stirring well with a whisk
7. Combine granulated sugar and butter in a large bowl
8. Beat with a mixer at medium speed until well blended
9. Add the egg and extracts , beating well
10. Add the flour mixture to sugar mixture alternately with buttermilk , beginning and ending with flour mix
11. Beat well after each addition
12. Spoon the batter into 8 inch round cake pan coated with cooking spray
13. Arrange apple mixture over cake
14. Top with almonds
15. Bake at 350 for 25 minutes or until cake begins to pull away from sides of pan
16. Cool in pan on a wire rack for 10 minutes
17. Quickly invert cake onto wire rack , then invert onto serving plate
18. Prepare the glaze and drizzle over cake
19. Serve warm

title: mashed rutabaga  yellow turnip or swede  and potato
steps:
1. Place the rutabaga in a 6 quart pot with ample water and a pinch of salt
2. Boil for 15 minutes
3. Add the turnips and potatoes and boil 15 minutes more , until all the vegetables are tender
4. Drain well
5. Mash the vegetables with the remaining ingredients
6. You can also use an immersion blender to puree them

title: crock pot pork and pineapple curry
steps:
1. Mix flour and salt together and toss pork pieces in mixture until coated
2. Heat oil in frying pan and brown meat on all sides
3. Transfer to crock pot
4. Add onion to pan and saute until transparent
5. Add all remaining ingredients to pan and bring to boil
6. Transfer to crock pot
7. Cook on low for 5- 8 hours until tender
8. Discard bay leaves and stir well
9. Serve with rice

title: blueberry picnic bars
steps:
1. Oven to 350
2. Line an 8" square baking pan with foil , letting ends extend above pan on 2 sides
3. In a large bowl , mix oats , flour , brown sugar , baking soda and salt
4. Add melted butter and stir with a fork until evenly moistened
5. Reserve 1 / 2 cup crumb mixture for topping
6. Press remaining mixture evenly and firmly over bottom of ungreased , foil-lined pan
7. Bake 12 minute to set crust
8. Filling: in a small saucepan stir berries , sugar , cornstarch and lemon juice over med
9. Heat until simmering
10. Simmer , stirring occasionally , until juices are no longer cloudy , about 2 minute
11. Spoon over crust
12. Crumble reserved crumb mixture over top
13. Bake for 30 minute
14. Let cool completely in pan
15. Lift foil by ends onto a cutting board
16. Peel off foil
17. Cut into 2" squares

title: easy cocoa 1 layer cake
steps:
1. Stir dry ingredients together in a bowl
2. Cream butter and sugar in another bowl , add eggs , vanilla and water
3. Mix in dry ingredients
4. Mix well
5. Bake in preheated 350 oven in buttered and floured 9 inch cake pan for about an hour or til cake tests done with a toothpick
6. Cool in pan for an hour then remove to rack and sift powdered sugar over top

title: salsa salad
steps:
1. Place lettuce on salad plates
2. Layer remaining ingredients on top of lettuce in the order given with the crushed chips on top

title: sweet potato and spinach curry
steps:
1. Cook the sweet potato in boiling water for 10 minutes , drain and set aside
2. Heat the oil and fry the onion , garlic and turmeric over a gentle heat for 3 minutes , add the chilie and paste and cook for another 2 minutes
3. Add coconut milk and simmer for 5 minutes
4. Add the sweet potato and season with salt if desired
5. Continue to simmer for a further 5 minutes
6. Stir in spinach , cover the pan and simmer for 2 - 3 mins until the spinach has wilted and the curry is hot throughout

title: shiitake mushroom soup
steps:
1. Saute mushrooms and ginger in olive oil until soft and fragrant
2. Add chicken stock and water and bring to a boil
3. Add soba noodles and boil until soft
4. Lower heat and add spinach , cook until wilted
5. Finally add soy sauce and lime juice to taste

title: raspberry white chocolate pudding shot
steps:
1. Mix pudding with milk until creamy
2. Add vodka and and raspberry liquor then mix well
3. Add the cool whip
4. Put the pudding mix into individual serving cups with lids
5. Add a raspberry to each cup
6. You may want to provide some plastic spoons
7. Keep in the freezer

title: christmas cake   australian
steps:
1. Prepare all ingredients first
2. Chop pineapple , apricots and dates into pieces the same size as the brazil nuts , leave nuts whole , combine fruit and nuts in a large bowl
3. Beat eggs in a bowl until thick and creamy , add sugar , essence , rum and softened butter , beat until well combined
4. Stir into fruit mixture and add sifted flours
5. Spread mixture evenly and firmly into a large loaf pan which has been greased and lined
6. Bake at 150c for about 2 hours

title: saffron orzo with asparagus
steps:
1. Heat butter in skillet , add orzo and stir
2. Add broth and saffron , bring to boil , cover , reduce heat to simmer , cook 8 minutes add asparagus , cover , cook 5 minutes more
3. Uncover and simmer until liquid is absorbed
4. Stir in parmesan cheese , salt , pepper
5. Serve in a bowl garnished with shavings

title: creamsicle dessert mousse
steps:
1. Microwave the cream cheese for 20-30 seconds and stir
2. Blend with whipped cream by gently folding or stirring
3. Set aside
4. In a seperate bowl , thoroughly mix pudding with the warmed orange drink to dissolve
5. Let sit for a few minutes , then mix again
6. Gently fold or stir in the cream cheese mixture a little at a time
7. Cover top of mousse with plastic wrap and chill for at least 4 hours
8. Scoop into dessert or champagne glasses using a large melon baller and garnish with fresh orange slices on the side of the glasses and top with a mint leaf

title: peanut butter treats
steps:
1. Combine peanut butter and honey in a bowl
2. Using a spoon shape mixture into 1 inch balls and place them on a tray
3. Sprinkle the cocoa over the tops of the balls
4. Refrigerate 30 minutes
5. Enjoy !

title: sea chicken  tuna  spread
steps: 1. Mix all the ingredients together until a smooth but firm consistency

title: smoked salmon and cream cheese frittata
steps:
1. In a bowl whisk together eggs , milk , onions , basil , salt and pepper
2. Preheat broiler
3. Heat butter or oil in a 12-inch oven-proof skillet over medium heat until hot
4. Pour egg mixture into skillet and scatter cream cheese cubes over top
5. Cook , lifting up cooked eggs around edges using a spatula to let the raw egg flow underneath until the frittata is set on bottom , and egg is almost set but still moist on top
6. Remove from heat
7. Sprinkle salmon all over frittata , then press lightly , the shake skillet to allow salmon to settle into the top
8. Broil about 6 inches from heat for 1 - 1-1 / 2 minutes , or until set , slightly puffed and golden in spots
9. Cool 5 minutes , then loosen edge with spatula , and slide onto a large plate
10. Cut into wedges and serve warm or at room temperature

title: no bake chocolate cheesecake pie
steps:
1. Beat cream cheese , brown sugar , granulated sugar , milk and vanilla extract in small mixer bowl on high speed for 2 minutes
2. Add melted chocolate
3. Beat on medium speed for 2 minutes
4. Spoon into crust
5. Refrigerate for 1 1 / 2 hours or until firm
6. Top with whipped cream

title: black and white chile
steps:
1. Rinse and drain the beans in separate pots , cover the beans with about an inch of cold water and bring to a boil
2. Cover the boiling pots and remove from the heat
3. Allow them to soak off heat , for 2 hours
4. Put the chicken pieces in a stock pot and cover with about 2 inches of cold water , bring to a boil then simmer for about an hour
5. Remove the chicken and allow to cool , bone it and chop to about 1 / 4 inch
6. Drain each of the bean pots and add your new chicken stock to each to cover the beans by at least 1 inch
7. If theres not enough stock , add water
8. Bring the beans to a boil , then reduce to a simmer and cook until each is just getting tender
9. When the beans are done , drain into a large bowl
10. In a large stock pot , add 4tbs olive oil , onion , garlic and chilies
11. Over a low heat , saute until the onions are just translucent
12. Remove from the pot and set aside
13. Add the flour and an equal amount of the olive oil to the pot and mix until smoothly blended
14. Over a low heat , continue stirring until it starts to bubble
15. Slowly start adding the hot stock , mixing until there are no lumps
16. If you do end up with lumps , a stick blinder works great
17. When the stock is all blended , bring it to a boil to thicken
18. Reduce the heat , add both batches of beans , the onion mixture , the chicken and all the spices
19. Stir well and simmer for 30 to 45 minutes and the beans are well done
20. After the simmering , stir in the raw bell pepper and serve
21. This is great served over crushed tortilla chips and covered with shredded lettuce and cheddar cheese
22. It even better the next day so if you can , make it a day or two early

title: chicken and fresh grapefruit stir fry
steps:
1. Peel and section grapefruit over bowl
2. Reserve juice
3. Drain pineapple well
4. Reserving juice
5. Combine juices and add enough water to equal 1 cup of liquid
6. Combine with cornstarch and soy sauce
7. Rinse chicken breasts and pat dry
8. Remove any excess fat
9. Cut across grain into thin strips
10. In large non-stick skillet , sprayed with no stick cooking spray , stir-fry chicken with garlic in oil over medium heat for 5 minutes , or until lightly brown
11. Add snow peas and cornstarch mixture
12. Cook , stirring until thickened
13. Add grapefruit , pineapple and green onions
14. Heat

title: sugar cream pie cake
steps:
1. Mix yellow cake mix , melted butter or margarine and 1 beaten egg
2. Spread on the botttom of a greased and powdered sugar coated 9x13 pan
3. Mix the 2 beaten eggs , 8 oz bar of softened cream cheese , and 1 pound of powdered sugar
4. Spread the mixture over the crust
5. Bake in a 350f oven for 30-35 minutes or until the top is lightly browned

title: gluten free oatmeal bread
steps:
1. Mix together the warm water , sugar or honey and yeast and let themixture stand for abotu 10 minutes or until foamy
2. Stir together the dry ingredients in a large stand mixer bowl
3. Add the yeast mixture and oil and beat the dough for 3 minutes at medium speed
4. Scrape the dough from the beaters and sides into the bottom of the bowl and cover the bowl with a towel
5. Let rise in a warm place for 1 to 1 1 / 2 hours
6. Beat the dough again for 3 minutes
7. Oil an 8x4-inch loaf pan and coat the inside with oatmeal
8. Put dough in the pan and allow to rise in a warm place for about 20 minutes , or unitl it barely doubles
9. Preheat oven to 350 f and bake the loaf for about 75 minutes , loosely covering with foil after the first 15 minutes to prevent excessive browning

title: burgers  well done but still juicy
steps:
1. Heat grill
2. Mash bread and milk in large bowl with fork until pasty
3. Stir in salt , pepper , garlic , and steak sauce
4. Break up beef into small pieces over bread mixture
5. Using fork or hands , lightly mix together until mixture forms cohesive mass
6. Divide meat into 4 equal portions
7. Gently toss one portion of meat back and forth between hands to form loose ball
8. Gently flatten into 3 / 4-inch-thick patty that measures about 4 1 / 2 inches in diameter
9. Press center of patty down with finger
10. Repeat with remaining portions of meat
11. Lightly dip wad of paper towels in vegetable oil
12. Holding wad with tongs , wipe cooking grate
13. Grill burgers on hot side of grill , uncovered , until well seared on first side , 2 to 4 minutes
14. Using wide metal spatula , flip burgers and continue grilling , about 3 minutes for medium-well or 4 minutes for well-done
15. Distribute equal portions of cheese on burgers about 2 minutes before they reach desired doneness , covering burgers with disposable aluminum pan to melt cheese
16. While burgers grill , toast buns on cooler side of grill , rotating buns as necessary to toast evenly
17. Serve burgers on toasted buns

title: whole roasted pork loin
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f
2. In a food processor , puree 1 / 2 of one of the onions , grainy mustard , marmalade , butter , salt and pepper
3. Place the pork roast in a roasting pan and slather with the mustard glaze
4. Slice the remaining onions and arrange , along with the pears , orange and fresh herbs , around the pork loin
5. Roast uncovered for 15 minutes , then reduce the oven temperature to 350 degrees f , roasting for about 75 minutes , until an internal temperature of 175 degrees f is reached
6. Remove the roast from the pan and let rest on a cutting board or platter for 15 minutes before slicing
7. For the sauce , remove the orange segments , thyme and sage sprigs , and discard
8. Place the pan over medium heat and add the white wine , stirring to pull up any caramelized bits for the bottom of the pan
9. Add the chicken stock and sage and simmer until reduced by half
10. Reduce the heat to low and stir in the cold butter just until melted
11. Season to taste and serve beside slices of the roast pork

title: slow cooked salmon
steps:
1. To marinate salmon , put a large piece of aluminum foil on work surface
2. In a small cup or bowl whisk together lime juice and cognac
3. Rub both sides of salmon steaks with mixture
4. In another cup or bowl combine sugar , salt and pepper and then rub both sides of each salmon steak with about 2 teaspoons of the mixture
5. Lay half of the dill in the center ofthe aluminum foil and then place steaks over the dill and then place remainder of the dill on top of the steaks
6. Pull foil over salmon and seal to form package
7. Cover foil package with a plate or heavy weight and refrigerate for 24 - 48 hours
8. 2 hours before serving or thirty minutes before starting to cook the salmon , pour oil into the insert of the slow cooker and preheat it on high with cover on
9. Remove salmon from foil and discard dill and with a damp towel wipe seasonings off fish
10. Place the salmon steaks in one layer in slow cooker
11. Cook on high for 90 minutes - check temperature - it should read 140-degrees f
12. Do not open cover or check fish for 90 minutes
13. Serve fish with mustard dill sauce
14. To make the mustard dill sauce: whisk sauce ingredients together in a small bowl

title: hg s hot tamale pie   weight watchers   4 points
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Mix together cornbread mix , egg substitute and applesauce
3. Set aside
4. In a large pan sprayed lightly with nonstick spray , begin to cook onions and soy crumbles over medium heat
5. Once crumbles have thawed , add in taco seasoning , cumin and 1 / 4 cup of water
6. Stirring occasionally , continue to cook until the water has absorbed
7. Then add the taco sauce , corn , and black beans , and mix well
8. Pour mixture into a large round casserole dish sprayed lightly with nonstick spray , and then evenly cover with the cornbread topping mixture
9. Bake in the oven for 20 minutes , or until top is golden brown and firm

title: celeriac salad  celery root
steps:
1. Place celery root& cucumbers in a salad bowl
2. Mix remaining ingredients mix well and pour over the celery root& cukes
3. Chill well
4. Serve on a bed of greens and if you wish garnish with strips of red& green sweet pepper

title: farfalle with chicken  mushrooms  spinach and ricotta cheese
steps:
1. Bring a large pot of water to a boil
2. Add salt , and then add the farfalle
3. Cook until al dente
4. Meanwhile , heat a large , heavy-bottomed pan over medium heat and add the oil
5. Sprinkle the chicken with salt and pepper and , once the oil is hot , add the chicken to the pan
6. Brown on all sides , and then add the onions and cook for a minute or two
7. Stir in the mushrooms , garlic , and some salt and pepper
8. Saut until all vegetables are tender
9. Increase the heat to medium high and add the vermouth
10. Cook until almost all the liquid has evaporated , and then stir in the diced tomatoes , red pepper flakes , parsley , oregano , basil , and salt & pepper to taste
11. Bring to a simmer and then reduce heat to medium-low , simmering until the flavors have developed
12. Add the spinach and cook until wilted down , about 2-3 minutes
13. Season to taste
14. Add the pasta to the sauce and stir to coat
15. Off the heat , stir in the ricotta cheese

title: sullivan potatoes for a crowd
steps: 1. Mix all together and bake at 300 degrees for 1 1 / 2 hours

title: soprano shrimp with angel hair pasta and salsa
steps:
1. Grease a 12x8 pan with 1 tablespoon butter
2. Combine eggs , half and half , yogurt , swiss cheese , feta cheese , italian parsley , basil and oregano in a medium bowl
3. Mix well
4. Spread half of the pasta on the bottom of the pan
5. Add half of the shrimp
6. Spread half the salsa over the shrimp cover with the remaining pasta and spread the egg mixture over the pasta top with the remaining shrimp and salsa
7. Sprinkle parmigiano-reggiano cheese over the top
8. Bake the angel hair pasta concoction at 350 degrees for 30 minutes
9. Let stand 10 minutes before serving
10. Bon appetito always !

title: slow cooker cranberry chicken
steps:
1. Place chicken pieces in a 3-1 / 2- or 4-quart slow cooker
2. In a small bowl , stir together cranberry sauce , dry soup mix , and tapioca
3. Pour over chicken pieces
4. Cover
5. Cook on low-heat setting for 5 to 6 hours or on high-heat setting for 2-1 / 2 to 3 hours
6. Serve chicken and sauce over hot cooked rice

title: low stress baked eggs
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Grease ramekin with butter
3. Sprinkle half of the cheese on the bottom of the dish
4. Add the eggs
5. Break egg yolks with a knife but do not stir
6. Drizzle milk over eggs
7. Sprinkle with remaining cheese
8. Add pre-cooked or semi-crunchy bacon if being used
9. Salt and pepper according to your tastes
10. Bake for 20-25 minutes
11. Eggs should be "set" but not "hard
12. " cheese will be bubbly
13. Run a knife around the edge of the pan , slide onto dining plate
14. Add 1 t
15. Milk per each eggie
16. Remember to break yolks
17. Pre-preparation: great dish for serving overnight company
18. Prepare ahead , pop in the oven on timed-bake , and it will be ready when you get up ! even the maid isn't that organized--but you are ! :-)

title: fried tacos
steps:
1. Brown beef over low heat , break up into fine pieces
2. Drain
3. Add beans , smash & mix into beef
4. Add salt , chili powder , & 2 t of taco sauce
5. Remove from heat
6. Wrap tortillas in towel & microwave 20-30 seconds to soften
7. Heat oil in deep fryer
8. Spread meat mixture on center of each tortilla
9. Fold tortilla over & press closed
10. Drop each taco into hot oil & fry until crispy
11. Drain cooked tacos on paper towels
12. Open shells & add 1 / 2 slice cheese , lettuce , and taco sauce
13. Spend next several hours on treadmill

title: pot roasted pork in beer
steps:
1. Place oil in large oven proof pot and cook over medium heat until pork in browned evenly all over
2. Add the onion , garlic , bay leaves and pancetta
3. Lower the heat and cook for 10 minutes until pancetta colours
4. Stir in the beer , scraping up all the sediment and bring to the boil
5. Cover and simmer over low heat , basting frequently for 1 and a half hours
6. While pork is cooking preheat oven to 180 degrees
7. Transfer cooked pork to roasting tin , baste with cooking juices and place in oven
8. Cook , basting frequently for 15-20 minutes
9. Rest meat for 15 minutes before shredding or slicing thickly
10. Serve with vegetables of your choice

title: slow cooker cranberry relish
steps:
1. Zest the oranges
2. Cut off the remaining outer peel and pith and discard
3. Cut the peeled orange sections into small chunks and add to the slow cooker along with cranberries , sugar , cinnamon , and zest
4. Add water
5. Cover and cook on high for about 2 hours

title: sugar free bbq sauce
steps:
1. Saut onion in small amount of olive oil until caramelized
2. Add other ingredients , blend well and heat through
3. Adjust heat or sweetness with more or less spices or preserves
4. May add other ingredients as desired such as smoke flavor , worcestershire sauce or fresh ginger
5. Delicious on ribs , pork or chicken
6. Simple , yet very good !

title: creamy crescent roll cheesecake
steps:
1. Beat cream cheese , sour cream , sugar and vanilla until smooth
2. Add eggs one at a time , beating thoroughly after each addition
3. Line a 9x13 pan with the crescent rolls
4. Pinch dough together to seal seams
5. Pour in filling and sprinkle with cinnamon
6. Bake at 350 for 35 minutes

title: chicken fried rice  low gi
steps:
1. In saucepan , bring 1 1 / 4 cups of the chicken stock , rice and salt to boil
2. Reduce heat to low , cover and cook for 25 minutes or until liquid is absorbed
3. Fluff with fork and set aside
4. In large non-stick skillet heat sesame oil over medium high heat and cook chicken and mushrooms for about 8 minutes or until chicken is no longer pink
5. Add green onions , carrot , celery , chickpeas and cooked rice
6. Cook , stirring for 2 minutes , to combine
7. Add remaining chicken stock and soy sauce and cook for 5 minutes
8. Add bean sprouts and toss to combine

title: bubba bean s this and that casserole  bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Grill the italian sausage and sliced in half and sliced again to bite size pieces
3. Slice green beans length wise in half and place in boiling salted water and blanch for 10 minutes
4. Drain well
5. Dice up potatoes and boil in water with 1 chicken bouillon cube , salt and pepper too , drain well
6. To make the cream of mushroom soup:
7. Boil 1 cup water in microwave and add 1 chicken bouillon cube
8. Stir to dissolve cube
9. In a medium sauce pan over medium heat , add 2tbs
10. Margarine and let melt
11. Add 2tbs
12. Diced onions and saut 2 minutes
13. Add 1c
14. Diced fresh mushrooms and saut another 2 minutes
15. Add 3 tbs
16. Self rising flour and blend together
17. Add chicken bouillon broth and stir well
18. Add 1 / 2 cup whipping cream and stir well
19. Add black pepper , and a dash of cayenne pepper and stir till soup thickens
20. Or if not thick enough add another tbs
21. Of flour
22. In a large bowl mix together diced up italian sausage , green beans , potatoes , 1 cup fresh mushrooms , green peppers , onion , cheddar and monterey jack cheese , french's fried onions , and the cream of mushroom soup
23. Add rest of seasonings
24. Place into a 2 quart baking dish
25. Bake casserole in oven for 30 minutes

title: spectacular spaghetti squash saute
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Bake whole squash 1 hour or until tender when pierced with fork
3. Remove from oven and allow to cool 5-10 minutes
4. Halve lengthwise and remove seeds
5. With fork , pull out spaghetti-like strands and place in large serving bowl
6. Set aside
7. In large skillet , heat olive oil and butter over medium heat
8. Add mushrooms , tomatoes , zucchini , green onions , garlic , bell pepper , and snow peas
9. Cook until soft
10. Pour over squash and toss to combine
11. Sprinkle with parmesan and serve immediately

title: lentil bulghur salad
steps:
1. Place lentils in a sieve , and rinse thoroughly
2. Transfer lentils to sauce pan with 2 1 / 2 cups water and bring to a boil
3. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 30-45 minutes , until lentils are tender but not mushy
4. Lentils should hold their shape
5. While lentils are simmering , place the bulghur wheat in a bowl
6. Boil the remaining cup of water and pour over the bulghur wheat
7. Cover and let stand until all water has been absorbed , about 15 minutes
8. Fluff bulghur wheat with a fork
9. When the lentils are done , pour off any remaining liquid and let the lentils cool
10. Heat an iron-cast skillet over high heat
11. Add walnut pieces and stir them constantly with a wooden spoon until they begin to brown
12. Turn off the heat and set aside
13. In a small bowl , mix olive oil , lemon juice , vinegar , garlic , and salt and pepper with a fork to make a dressing
14. Place lentils in a large bowl , preferably glass
15. With a wooden spoon , carefully mix in the bulghur wheat , followed by the chopped vegetables and the toasted walnuts
16. Pour dressing evenly over the salad , and mix in with a fork
17. Refrigerate salad at least one hour to allow the flavors to blend
18. Suggestions french lentils are small , dark-green lentils that can be found in most health food stores
19. If they are unavailable , substitute brown lentils
20. Bulghur wheat can also be found in health food stores and ethnic groceries
21. It comes in several different degrees of coarseness
22. For this recipe , the finely cracked variety is preferred

title: classic guacamole  weight watchers
steps:
1. Scoop avocado pulp into small bowl and coarsely mash
2. Add all remaining ingredients , gently mixing until combined
3. Serve at once or press piece of plastic wrap directly onto surface to prevent browning
4. Store at room temperature and serve within 2 hours

title: mediterranean squash
steps:
1. Heat 1 teaspoon of the oil in a wide nonstick frying pan or wok over medium-high heat
2. When oil is hot , add half each of the chopped onion , mushrooms , squash and thyme
3. Stir fry until squash is hot and bright in color
4. Add 1 / 4 cup water and 1 1 / 2 tablespoons of the lemon juice to pan
5. Cover and cook until vegetables are just tender to bite
6. Uncover and continue to cook , stirring until liquid has evaporated
7. Remove vegetables from pan and set aside
8. Repeat to cook remaining chopped onion , mushrooms , squash and thyme , using remaining 1 teaspoon oil
9. Add 1 / 4 cup water and remaining 1 1 / 2 tablespoons lemon juice after the first 3 minutes of cooking
10. Return all cooked vegetables to pan
11. Gently stir in tomatoes
12. Transfer vegetables to a serving dish
13. Sprinkle with green onions , cheese and olives

title: grandma s old fashioned sweet relish
steps:
1. Combine cukes , onions , ice and salt
2. Let stand for 2 hours ,
3. Then drain
4. Mix the next 6 ingredients in a large pot
5. Bring to a boil , add ground cuke mixture , and cook for 20 minutes , or until it begins to thicken
6. While still hot , seal in sterilized jars
7. As far as preparation time , i use grandma's old hand grinder , so i'm sure it would be much faster with a motorized food grinder

title: boy scout foil dinner
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Take 1 lb hamburger and mix it by hand with 1 pkg lipton onion soup mix and set aside
3. Chop red potatoes and onion and mix together with desired amount of baby carrots and toss with olive oil and salt and pepper then set aside
4. Pull out a sheet of tin foil and pam spray it
5. Layer it with the hamburger then salt and pepper the hamburger before adding the potato , carrot , onion mixture
6. Salt and pepper again before folding up
7. Place foil packets on cookie sheep and place on lowest shelf in oven
8. Bake 25 minutes and turn over and bake another 25 minutes
9. Take out and check for doneness
10. If vegetables or hamburger are not done place back into oven and bake longer till done

title: golden graham candy
steps:
1. Over low heat , melt white chocolate chips
2. Stir in cereal , mixing thoroughly
3. Spread on wax-paper lined cookie sheet
4. Cool in refrigerator
5. Break into pieces

title: california wrapper
steps:
1. Warm tortilla in a skillet or microwave
2. Spread half of ranch dressing on tortilla
3. Place deli meats on tortilla
4. Put cheese slices on meat
5. Place bacon on cheese slices
6. Toss lettuce with remaining ranch dressing and add to tortilla
7. Add tomato slices and place avocado slices on tomato
8. Roll tortilla up in a roll
9. If you wish to slice it , secure with toothpicks and with seam side down slice into even pieces

title: mary s zesty bean dip
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients , ecpect the sour cream and chips
2. In a medium saucepan or chafing dish , heat until the cheese melts , stirring occasionally
3. Serve warm , topped with sour cream and accompanied by tortilla chips

title: mango  pineapple    kiwi salad
steps:
1. Place mangos , kiwi , and pineapple in a large bowl
2. Toss gently
3. Add remaining ingredients
4. Stir to coat
5. Let stand 10 minutes
6. Serve at room temperature or refrigerate until serving time

title: ww core friendly sweet corn cakes
steps:
1. Mix yogurt , water and egg together in bowl
2. Add in cornmeal and baking powder and stir together until batter is moist
3. If you like sweeter cakes , especially for breakfast , add splenda at same time
4. Let batter stand for 15-20 minutes
5. Quickly fold in corn and grated onions
6. Heat pan over medium heat and lightly coat with cooking spray
7. Add batter to the pan in spoonfuls
8. For best results , keep the cakes 2-3 inches in diameter
9. Let first side cook until tops is dry around the edges
10. Turn and cook other side
11. Serve with a dollop of soft yogurt cheese

title: crispy baked potato wedges   low fat
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Spray baking sheet with non stick cooking spray
3. Cut potatoes into wedges , and place onto baking sheet
4. Lightly spray the potato wedges with non stick spray until evenly coated
5. Sprinkle generously with sea salt and chopped rosemary
6. Bake in oven for 35-45 minutes until crisp and golden , turning occasionally

title: lobster rolls
steps:
1. Combine lobster meat and mayonnaise in medium bowl
2. Season to taste with salt and pepper
3. Butter along outside surfaces of hot dog rolls
4. Heat medium skillet over high heat
5. Place rolls , 1 buttered side down , in skillet
6. Cook until browned slightly , about 2 minutes per side
7. Open rolls
8. Fill with lettuce , then lobster mixture , serve immediately

title: tofu chicken and rice
steps:
1. Dice tofu inot 1 / 2 inch chunks
2. Saute in oil for about 3 minutes
3. Add soy sauce , thyme , sage and poultry seasoning
4. Cook together about 3 minutes
5. Empty into bowl and set bowl aside
6. Dice onion
7. Add onion to frying pan along with 1 t olive oil
8. Dice stalk of celery and add to onion
9. Saute together until the onion turns translucent
10. Add garlic to cooking onion and celery
11. Add the tofu to the onion and celery
12. Shred carrots and add to the mix
13. Add water and boullion to mix
14. Return to simmer
15. Add rice
16. Let simmer until rice is tender stirring occasionally

title: t v  french dressing
steps: 1. Combine all ingredients and shake well before using !

title: smores brownies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease 9 x 13 pan using shortening
3. Line 9 x 13 pan with graham crackers until bottom is completely covered
4. Prepare brownie mix according to directions for cake-like brownies
5. Pour prepared batter over graham crackers
