6. Cook for 25-30 minutes until toothpick comes out clean (or if you like gooey brownies , you can underbake them by a few minutes
7. Remove from oven and sprinkle marshmallows over the top of the brownies , cover completely
8. Break chocolate bars into small pieces and sprinkle on top of marshmallows , try to distribute evenly for best results and appearance
9. Place back into oven for an additional 2-3 minutes , or until marshmallows have melted
10. Remove and let cool and cut into pieces

title: avocado   grapefruit salad  aka friendly flavor fusion
steps:
1. Make dressing by blending 1st 5 ingredients in a blender till smooth & chill
2. To serve: arrange grapefuit sections & avocado slices on mixed greens or lettuce leaves & drizzle w / dressing

title: santa s snicker s brand surprises
steps:
1. Combine the butter , peanut butter , and sugars using a mixer on a medium low speed until light and fluffy
2. Slowly add eggs and vanilla until thoroughly combined
3. Then mix in flower , salt , and baking soda
4. Cover up and chill dough for 2-3 hours
5. Remove dough from refrigerator
6. Divide into 1 tablespoon pieces and flatten
7. Place a snickers brand miniature in the center of each piece of dough
8. Form the dough in a ball around each snicker brand miniature
9. Place each on a greased cookie sheet and bake at 325 for 10-12 minutes
10. Let cookies cool on baking rack or wax paper
11. (holiday hint: spruce up santa's surprise by drizzling melted dove brand milk or dark chocolate gifts over the top of each cookie

title: patriotic drink  for kids
steps:
1. Place the ice cubes in the bottom 3rd of a tall 12 ounce clear glass
2. Pour the cranberry juice or fruit punch in to fill the bottom 3rd
3. Place a few more cubes in to the middle and pour in the blue gatorade to fill the glass 2 / 3 full
4. Place the final 3rd of ice in the glass
5. Pour in the diet 7up or diet sprite
6. Serve and enjoy !

title: vodka blush
steps:
1. Fill shaker 2 / 3 with fresh ice
2. Go light on the grenadine , it's more like a few drops
3. Maybe 1 / 4 tsp ?
4. Look at the picture , it's very pale
5. Add ingredients
6. Shake and strain into chilled cocktail glass

title: cheese pie with sour cream topping
steps:
1. To make pie crust add melted butter to graham cracker crumbs and press into pan
2. Mix cream cheese , sugar , eggs and vanilla , pour over graham cracker crust
3. Bake for 30 to 40 minutes at 350 degrees
4. Meanwhile , blend together ingredients for topping
5. Remove pie let cool for about 10 minutes
6. Pour sour cream topping mixture over cake
7. Return to oven for about 12 to 15 minutes
8. Remove pie from oven , let cool some , then chill and serve
9. You can serve it plain or use cherry , strawberry or blueberry pie filling to top this pie
10. Makes for a great change
11. You can also press the graham cracker crumbs into a 9" x 13" cake pan and follow the rest of the recipe to finish as a cheese cake

title: crock pot mexican creamed corn
steps:
1. Whisk all , except corn and chilies , together
2. Add corn and chilies , cover and cook 2-3 hours on low
3. Stir occasionally

title: peanut butter pie v
steps:
1. Whip cream cheese until fluffy
2. Add the sugar and peanut butter
3. Fold in 1 / 2 to 3 / 4 cool whip
4. Spoon into baked shell and refrigerate
5. To serve , top with balance of cool whip
6. Garnish with chopped peanuts if desired

title: mexican bean dip
steps:
1. Mix taco seasoning with beans and spread in a 13x9 inch glass dish
2. Layer sour cream , onion , peppers , lettuce , tomatoes , cheese& olives in that order
3. Serve with tortilla chips or scooper size fritos

title: balsamic olive oil bread dip
steps:
1. I never make this quite the same way twice but man is it good to keep on hand
2. Mix everything together in a bowl and pour into a nice glass container
3. I get wide mouth ones at ross , but they have them everywhere
4. Let it sit for a few hours and shake it up lots to mix all the flavors together
5. I keep it on my counter and use it for about a million things from boneless chicken thighs braise to salad dressing
6. If you get a really great loaf of crusty french bread and put a bit of this into fancy little dishes , you can serve it with any meal allowing each person his own dipping sauce
7. It's addictive and sooooo easy to make and keep on hand
8. Enjoy !

title: cow pattie cookies
steps:
1. Boil the first five ingredients for 5 minutes
2. Then add the last three ingredients
3. Stir
4. Remove from heat
5. While hot , drop by spoonful onto waxed paper

title: peruvian baked quinoa and cheese
steps:
1. 1
2. Heat oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat
3. Add leak and bell pepper
4. Cover , and cook 5 minutes , or until tender
5. Stir in quinoa , garlic , and sesame seeds , and cook , uncovered , 3 to 4 minutes , or until quinoa grains turn opaque
6. 2
7. Add 3 cups water , and season with the chicken granules
8. Taste for salt and add more granules or salt as desired
9. Cover , reduce heat to medium low , and simmer 3 or 4 minutes more , or until most liquid has been absorbed
10. Remove from heat , and let stand for 5 minutes
11. 3
12. Preheat oven to 350f coat 13 x 9 inch baking dish with cooking spray
13. Whisk together eggs and milk in large bowl
14. Fold in quinoa mixture and 80% of the cheese
15. Transfer to a prepared baking dish , level contents , and add remaining 20% of the cheese to the top , and bake 30 to 35 minutes , or until browned around the edges and top
16. 4
17. Jims additional step: once removed from the oven , sprinkle top with additional shredded cheese
18. Lay a piece of aluminum foil over the top and set on stove top for a few additional minutes
19. The goal is to allow the additional cheese to melt as a second layer of melted cheese on the top of the hot casserole
20. Dont worry , the casserole will retain all the heat required to melt the addition cheese dont go wild here just a nice additional thin melted topping
21. A little bright red paprika on this layer would also add some additional color
22. Enjoy !
23. Suggest for a smaller serving that you just make of everything and place in a small 7 x 9 pan
24. This is the perfect size for a smaller meal and will cut into very nice 4 piece serving pieces
25. We both loved this dish and will make it again
26. Recipe comes from ralphs optimum wellness magazine march / april 2009 , page 10
27. Recipe has been modified as
28. Quinoa has been grown for more than 5000 yearsin the andes mountains of peru , chile , ecuador , and bolivia , where it is a primary food source
29. Quinoa is unique because it contains eight essential amino acids and is a complete protein in itself
30. A 2007 study at osaka city university in japan showed that quinoa is high in antioxidants , making it an exceptionally heart healthy snack
31. Try substituting quinoa in recipes that call for rice , couscous , or pasta

title: cheesy mexican chicken
steps:
1. Combine the black and red pepper , paprika and garlic powder
2. Sprinkle evenly over chicken
3. Melt butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat
4. Add chicken and cook for 5-6 minutes on each side or until golden brown
5. Remove from heat
6. Top with chiles and cheese
7. Cover and let stand 2-3 minutes or until cheese melts
8. Sprinkle with additional paprika

title: greek garlic sauce
steps:
1. Cover potatoes with water in 3-quart saucepan and bring to a boil over high heat
2. Reduce heat to low and simmer until potatoes are tender , 15 to 20 minutes
3. Drain , rinse with cold water and mash thoroughly
4. Meanwhile , put garlic and salt in a large wooden bowl and mash with a pestle until a paste
5. Gradually add potatoes and mash them with garlic
6. If mixture is still hot , let cool 15 minutes , then add egg yolk , if using , and heartily mash in with a wooden spoon
7. Alternating olive oil with lemon juice and vinegar , gradually add both to potato mixture , mashing
8. Add pepper , and using a fork mix briskly until very smooth
9. Mix in more olive oil , a little at a time , if sauce is too thick to use as a dip
10. Spoon into a container and store , covered , in refrigerator
11. It will keep for about 1 week
12. Bring to room temperature several hours before serving
13. Spoon into a bowl and serve with fresh vegetables and / or pita for dipping
14. Enjoy !

title: jan s pizza bread
steps:
1. Cook sausage and break into bite size pieces
2. Cut french bread in half , long ways
3. Then partially cut bread into individual size servings without cutting all the way through
4. Melt butter and spread on top of bread evenly
5. Spread italian tomato sauce on top evenly
6. Sprinkle with parsley , garlic and oregano as desired
7. Sprinkle parmesan on top
8. Place pieces of sausage
9. Spread mozzarella on top
10. Bake for 10 minutes in a 350 degree oven

title: eggs a la goldenrod
steps:
1. Melt butter , add flour and stir until the mixture is smooth and well blended
2. Add milk very slowly stirring as you add
3. Continue to stir and cook over a low heat
4. Cook until the mixture starts to thicken
5. Add salt and pepper to mixture and set aside
6. Peel boiled eggs and remove the yolks from the eggs
7. Chop the whites of the eggs and add them to the white sauce
8. Toast bread and slice it diagonally
9. Arrange the bread slices on a plate and pour the sauce over the toast
10. Take a grater and grate the egg yolks over the sauce
11. Serve warm

title: irish scallop chowder
steps:
1. Melt butter in a large saucepan over medium heat
2. Add scallops and cook , in batches , for 5 minutes , until just opaque
3. Remove from pan and set aside
4. Add the bacon to the pan and cook 3-4 minutes , until it starts to brown
5. Add the onion , celery , carrots and potatoes
6. Season with salt and pepper , cover and cook over medium-low heat , stirring occasionally , until vegetables start to soften
7. Add thyme and 2 tablespoons of the parsley to the vegetables
8. Pour in broth and cover
9. Bring to a boil
10. Reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes
11. Remove thyme sprigs
12. Discard
13. Lightly crush some of the vegetables with the back of a wooden spoon
14. This will help thicken the liquid
15. Pour in the scalded milk
16. Add the scallops and mixed cooked seafood to the pan
17. Cook until heated through but do not let mixture boil
18. Check seasonings , and add lemon juice
19. Ladle into warm bowls and sprinkle with remaining parsley

title: banana blueberry pancakes
steps:
1. Mix flour , sugar , baking powder and salt
2. Add eggs , milk , butter , bananas and vanilla
3. Stir until well blended and smooth
4. Fold in blueberries
5. Spoon about 1 / 3 cup of batter onto greased , preheated griddle or skillet
6. Once bubbles begin to appear in the batter , flip only once
7. Cook until the pancakes until light brown color
8. Remove from heat and serve

title: cooling mint cucumber raita
steps:
1. Stir all the ingredients together in a large bowl and blend till mixed well
2. Chill well and serve

title: cinnamon tortilla chips
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450
2. Cut the flour tortillas into 6 wedges each
3. Brush cut edges with water
4. Sprinkle with a mixture of 1 tablespoon sugar and 1 / 2 tablespoon cinnamon
5. Bake 5 to 10 minutes or until crisp
6. Serve with fruit salsa

title: nutritious flour blend
steps:
1. Mix thorougly and keep in a covered container , preferably in the refrigerator
2. Use in place of whole wheat flour in any recipe calling for whole wheat flour
3. Or try substituting for a portion of white flour in your favorite bread , muffin , roll , etc
4. Recipe

title: carolyn s antipasto salad
steps:
1. Mix all salad ingredients except for cheese
2. Mix dressing according to directions on package substituting the vinegar& oil called for with the balsamic vinegar and olive oil
3. Pour over salad ingredients and toss
4. Allow salad to marinate in the fridge for at least 3 hours preferably over night
5. To serve , toss in the cheese and allow salad to come to room temperature for the best flavor

title: cranberries jubilee
steps:
1. Combine sugar and water in saucepan , stirring to dissolve sugar
2. Bring to boiling
3. Boil 5 minutes
4. Add cranberries and bring to boiling again
5. Cook 5 minutes
6. Turn into heat-proof bowl or blazer pan of chafing dish
7. Heat brandy
8. Ignite brandy and pour over cranberry mixture
9. Blend into sauce and serve immediately over ice cream

title: scottish toast
steps:
1. If loaf is unsliced , cut it into thick slabs
2. Set out the sliced bread beside the stove
3. Pour oats onto a big plate , and layer a fine amount of them for dipping the toast into
4. Beat eggs , milk , salt and vanilla in a bowl deep enough to hold a slice of your bread
5. Put butter and oil in a saucepan and let oil / butter come to a good heat , not too high but not too low
6. Dip a slice of bread in egg mixture , let it absorb wet mixture until it is saturated but not too soggy
7. Put slice in oats and cover and turn to cover again
8. Place it in butter / oil mixture and cook on both sides until golden
9. Set the slices that are done on a plate lined with paper towel
10. If you are cooking for a few people , transfer to cookie sheet in low-heat oven until all slices are cooked
11. Transfer to serving plate and sprinkle with powdered sugar , or serve with honey or syrup

title: hoagie salad
steps:
1. In a small bowl , whisk together the oil and vinegar
2. Add oregano , salt , and pepper to taste
3. Whisk and set aside
4. Rinse cooked macaroni in cold water
5. Drain well and transfer to a large bowl
6. Add remaining ingredients to the macaroni
7. Toss gently
8. Pour oil / vinegar mixture on top
9. Toss gently
10. Cover and refrigerate a few hours before serving

title: british columbian blueberry  shake
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in blender , starting with liquids , until smooth
2. Serve in a pretty glass with a straw , garnished with 2 or 3 fresh blueberries

title: baked sausage potatoes and cheese
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Put oil in skillet and place over medium heat until hot
3. Brown sausage on both sides
4. Place sausage in between layers of paper towels to get out as much of the grease as possible
5. Spray deep baking dish with crisco and place sausage into it
6. Brown potatoes , in the sausage grease left in skillet
7. You may need to add a bit more oil
8. Follow the same paper towel method as you did in step #3
9. This time with the potatoes
10. Place potatoes on top of sausage in deep baking dish
11. Bake at 375f until potatoes are soft
12. Check often , as not to burn
13. Place a layer of sliced cheese over top when potatoes are soft
14. Put back in the oven until cheese is melted
15. Serve and enjoy

title: chicken  taos
steps:
1. Roll the chicken in the combined flour , salt , pepper
2. Brown in the margarine on both side , till nice and golden
3. Now add in the onions and the garlic and saute till transparent
4. You may now add in the remaining ingredients , bring to a boil
5. Then cover and reduce heat let simmer for about 35 minute or till its cooked
6. Serve chicken and sauce all the way around a platter of rice of pasta
7. Sprinkle parsley over the chicken , and serve with a crispy salad

title: cucumber mint salad
steps:
1. Peel cucumber and chop into 1 / 4-inch cubes
2. Combine all ingredients in bowl and mix
3. Serve at room temperature

title: bountiful barley
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Cut the onion into a medium dice
3. Saute in a non-stick skillet with the butter until you start getting those browned edges
4. Pour the barley into the skillet and coat with the onion and butter mixture
5. Spray a medium size casserole with cooking spray
6. Transfer the barley to the casserole
7. Pour the chicken broth and tomato juice into the casserole
8. Do not place a lid on the casserole
9. Bake for 60 to 75 minutes until the liquid is absorbed
10. Fluff before serving

title: chocolate crispy rice clusters
steps:
1. Line a mini-muffin pan with mini-muffin paper cups
2. Fill each cup about halfway with rice krispies
3. No real measurement required here
4. Carefully melt the chocolate chips either on stovetop or in the microwave
5. If microwaving , be very careful because culinary chocolate can burn if nuked too hard !
6. When it's a nice stirring consistency , stir in the vanilla and cinnamon
7. While the chocolate is still hot , spoon over the rice krispies , coating them well
8. Gently re-microwave if mixture begins to stiffen
9. Freeze the pan for at least 2 hours prior to eating

title: quinoa chicken fried rice
steps:
1. Cook the quinoa first and let it stand and cool down
2. Its important to let the quinao sit in its water for at least an hour before you start cooking it so you get no bitter taste
3. In a saucepan big enough to hold all the quinoa fried rice , heat some oil and then stir fry the chicken until its mostly cooked
4. Add salt & pepper to taste
5. Add in the carrots , and sautee about a minute with the chicken to start softening the carrots up a bit
6. Add in the peas and corn and sautee with the chicken and carrots for about a minute
7. Scramble the eggs in a cup and then pour in with the chicken , carrots , peas , and corn
8. It is important to cook the scramble eggs before adding in the quinoa
9. If you pour the raw egg onto the quinoa , the quinoa will get soggy
10. When the eggs are scrambled , pour in the quinoa and the green onions along with the soy sauce
11. Mix all ingredients together well
12. Let cook in pan , stirring continually for about 1-2 minutes

title: squash pancakes
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients and mix well
2. Pour by spoonfuls onto a hot pan
3. Fry until golden brown

title: sweet and sour beets
steps:
1. In a bowl mix together the sugar , cornstarch and salt
2. Stir in a little of the wine or vinegar to make a smooth paste
3. Slowly drizzle in the remaining wine or vinegar and the water
4. Transfer the mixture to a saucepan
5. Cook over low heat stirring and scraping bottom of the pan often
6. Cook until liquid is clear
7. Stir in cooked beets , butter and orange zest
8. Stir until the beets are heated through
9. Season with black pepper is desired

title: surin s coconut soup
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a large stockpot or dutch oven over medium heat
2. Add the lemon grass , ginger , and garlic and cook , stirring constantly , until aromatic , 30 to 60 seconds
3. Add the curry paste and cook , stirring constantly , for 30 seconds
4. Add 1 / 2 cup chicken stock to the pot and stir to dissolve the curry paste
5. Add the remaining stock , fish sauce , and sugar and bring to a boil over medium-high heat
6. Reduce the heat to low , partially cover , and simmer to blend flavors , about 20 minutes
7. Stir in the coconut milk , chicken , mushrooms , and lime juice
8. Bring back to a simmer and cook until the stock is hot and the chicken is no longer pink , about 5 minutes
9. Taste for seasoning and add salt if desired
10. Serve immediately , garnishing each bowl with cilantro and scallions
11. Variation: thai shrimp and coconut soup
12. Substitute 1 / 4 pound peeled and deveined medium shrimp for the chicken in step 3

title: basil chicken in coconut curry sauce
steps:
1. Rinse chicken , pat dry
2. Cut into 1" pieces
3. Place in medium bowl
4. In small bowl stir together the cardamom , cinnamon , cloves , coriander , , cumin , salt , pepper , turmeric , and chili powder
5. Sprinkle over chicken , toss to coat
6. Cover and let stand at room temperature for 30 minutes or in fridge for 1 to 2 hours
7. In a large nostick wok or skillet cook and stir onion , garlic , and jalapeno peppers in hot oil over medium heat for 2 minutes
8. Remove onion mixture
9. Add about half of the chicken to the wok or skillet
10. Cook and stir 2 to 3 minutes or till chicken is tender and no pink remains
11. Remove chicken from pan
12. If necessary , add more oil
13. Cook and remove remaining chicken as above
14. Stir together coconut milk and cornstarch
15. Carefully add to wok or skillet
16. Cook and stir till thickened and bubbly
17. Return chicken and onion mixture to skillet
18. Stir in snipped basil and gingerroot
19. Cook and stir about 2 minutes more or till heated through
20. Serve over rice
21. Garnish with fresh basil , if desired
22. Makes 4 servings
23. Enjoy !

title: strawberry banana fruit smoothie
steps:
1. Put the milk in your blender first , then the yogurt
2. Then add blueberries , peaches , banana and half of the strawberries last
3. Blend then add the other half of strawberries
4. I do it this way because some blenders have a real hard time blending frozen strawberries and doing it this way may help
5. Pour in a tall glass grab a straw and enjoy

title: sugar crunch pumpkin muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Grease 18 regular muffin cups
3. In a large bowl , whisk together flour , baking powder , baking soda , cinnamon , and salt
4. In a medium bowl , whisk together sugar , eggs , pumpkin , sour cream , milk , oil , and vanilla until well blended
5. Add the egg mixture to the flour mixture and stir until just blended
6. Divide batter equally among prepared muffin cups
7. Sprinkle with turbinado sugar
8. Bake for 24-28 minutes or until a pick comes out clean
9. Let cool in pans on a wire rack for 3 minutes , then transfer to the rack to cool

title: lime salsa chicken skewers with cilantro crme sauce
steps:
1. Chicken & marinade: in a large zip-lock bag , make the marinade by mixing together the lime juice , sherry , oil , oregano , and garlic salt
2. Remove three tablespoons of marinade
3. Set aside
4. Add chicken to the remaining marinade , turning to coat
5. Marinate chicken in refrigerator for at least 1 hour
6. Soak wooden skewers in hot water at least 30 minutes
7. Salsa: in a bowl , mix all ingredients well , and chill for an hour or more before serving
8. Cilantro crme sauce:
9. Combine all ingredients in a blender or food processor
10. Blend until smooth and creamy
11. Place in a serving bowl , chill a few hours or overnight
12. Skewers: toss bell peppers and onion quarters in with marinating chicken for last 30 minutes
13. Starting and ending with red bell pepper , make 7-8 skewers
14. Place the skewers chicken on grill with rack about 8 inches from heat source
15. Brush the heated marinade over chicken
16. Grill , turning and basting frequently with marinade , about 16 - 20 minutes , or until chicken is fork-tender
17. Arrange skewers on the platter , with cilantro cream sauce underneath , and salsa on top

title: spiced tomato drink
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , combine the first siz ingredients and bring to a boil
2. Reduce heat , simmer , uncovered , for 20 minutes and remove from the heat and stir in lemon juice
3. Serve warm or cold

title: liver cleansing juice drink
steps:
1. Cut into pieces as necessary for your juicer
2. Drink immediately for greatest benefit

title: tomato and roasted red pepper soup
steps:
1. Broil the red peppers , turning them so they blacken on all sides
2. Once theyre black , put them in a bowl , cover tightly with plastic wrap , and leave them until theyre cool enough to handle
3. Peel , seed , and roughly chop them
4. Warm the olive oil in a thick-bottomed pot over medium heat
5. Add the peppers , chili paste , and a pinch of salt , stir to combine , and cook for 5 minutes
6. Finely chop the garlic , add to the pot , and cook for 2 minutes
7. Drain the tomatoes , and add to the pot with the red wine vinegar and a pinch of salt
8. Cook for 10 minutes
9. Add the chicken stock
10. Puree with a stick blender until smooth , and simmer for 15 more minutes

title: veggie stuffed portabella mushrooms
steps:
1. Scoop out insides of portabella mushrooms and place insides into food processor
2. Rub 1 tsp of olive oil on top of portabella mushroom caps and sprinkle with salt , place caps upside down into baking dish
3. Add 16 oz of mushrooms to food processor and blend with portabella mushroom insides until paste forms , set aside
4. Chop red pepper and onion into small cubes and saut on medium heat use 1 tsp of olive oil
5. Add mushroom paste to pepper and onion
6. Saut for about 15 minutes stir occasionally
7. Toast pita bread until crispy , crumble into medium bowl
8. Add 1 cup cheese and eggs to bowl , mix well
9. Add mixture to mushroom , pepper , and onion
10. Stir until evenly blended
11. Spoon mixture into portabella mushroom caps , cover all caps with remaining cheese
12. Bake at 350f for 20 minutes
13. Serve warm

title: berry mocha fudge
steps:
1. Grind walnuts in a blender
2. Melt butter over high heat
3. Add sugar , stirring until it foams up well
4. Continue over high heat , adding almonds
5. Continue to cook , stirring continually until mixture is color of caramel and sugar is all melted
6. Stir as you take it off the heat permanently and pour quickly onto a large , flat pan with sides
7. Tilt to spread evenly , wait 5 minutes , then pour on chocolate chips
8. Spread chocolate over top of the hot mixture with a rubber scraper once melted
9. Scatter ground walnuts over the top , shaking to even
10. Cool at least three hours at room temperature
11. Break into pieces

title: honey carrot soup
steps:
1. In large saucepan combine carrots , chicken broth and onion
2. Cover and simmer over medium heat about 15 minutes or until carrots are tender
3. Transfer mixture to blender or food processor and blend until smooth
4. Return to saucepan
5. Add milk and honey
6. Return to simmer
7. Serve hot or chilles with a swirl of sour cream and a sprinkle of nutmeg

title: crock pot cheddar mashed potatoes
steps:
1. Place cut up potatoes and water into a slow cooker
2. Dot with butter
3. Cook on low for 6 hours or high for 3 hours
4. Check potatoes for doneness
5. Drain potatoes and place in a large mixing bowl
6. With an electric mixer , mash potatoes
7. After potatoes are mashed , add milk , salt and pepper
8. Whip until smooth
9. Stir in chopped green onions and cheese
10. Blend well
11. Cover bowl with aluminium foil and place in a 200 degree oven for 15 minutes so flavors blend and cheese melts

title: way too easy fruit dip
steps:
1. In a bowl , beat cream cheese until smooth
2. Fold in cool whip with a spatula
3. When cool whip is completely folded in , fold in marshmallow fluff
4. Serve with fruit pieces

title: chocolate pigs
steps:
1. Melt the chocolate and copha together
2. Meanwhile , with scissors or hot knife , make a cut in the "rounded" part of the large marshmallow
3. Insert 2 almond flakes , small point upwards
4. Or cut your ice cream wafers into small triangles and use them for ears
5. Dip the end of the small marshmallow into the choc and position on lower half of the "top" of the large marshmallow
6. Allow to set ,
7. Using any method you prefer , coat the entire pig face into the chocolate , let drip a little , then position on a baking tray covered with baking paper
8. Allow to set , about an hour
9. Re-melt the remaining chocolate and use tweezers to dip the "eyes" into the chocolate and position above the nose
10. Wipe tweezers between uses
11. Melt your tiny amount of white chocolate and using a toothpick , give your pig nostrils
12. If your really arty , you can give them curly tails on the back of the creation !

title: molasses and cream coffee
steps:
1. Combine all in a mug
2. Stir well to dissolve the molasses
3. Serve hot

title: bbq cheeseburger bake
steps:
1. Brown ground chuck and drain off fat
2. Mix together all the ingredients
3. Pour into 8x8 baking dish
4. Put slices of cheese on top
5. Put biscuits on top
6. Bake@ 350 for 15 minutes or until biscuits are brown

title: nif s lightened artichoke dip
steps:
1. Mix everthing together in a small casserole dish and bake at 350f for 30 minutes
2. Serve warm

title: mademoiselle grey cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Cream together butter and sugar
3. Add vanilla
4. Add flour , tea leaves and lavender
5. Mix well
6. Divide dough in half and roll into a log , wrap and chill at least 30 minutes
7. Once chilled slice to desired thickness and place on a backing sheet
8. Bake 12 minutes or untill just browned on the edges

title: simply italian sicilian tomato sauce
steps:
1. Wash the whole tomatoes , bring to a boil in a pan with water , until the skin of tomatoes are breaking , don't over cooked
2. Remove from pan and peel off the skin of tomatoes by using a knife
3. Cut into pieces and place in a non stick skillet together with garlic
4. Let it boil and simmer until the tomatoes turn into thick sauce , then add the basil
5. Cook for another 5 minutes
6. Turn off the heat , add the olive oil
7. Stir
8. Pour into cook pasta , spaghetti or macaroni , sprinkle with parmesan cheese , serve

title: white chocolate chip strawberry fudge drop cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Combine butter , sugar , egg and strawberry extract in a large bowl
3. Beat at medium speed until well blended
4. Beat in buttermilk and strawberry puree
5. Combine flour , cocoa , baking soda and salt in a medium bowl and mix into creamed mixture at low speed until blended
6. Stir in white chocolate chips
7. Drop by rounded tablespoonfuls about 2-inches apart onto greased cookie sheets
8. Bake 10-12 minutes or until tops spring back when touched lightly
9. Remove immediately to wire racks to cool completely

title: caribbean fish in a packet
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 450 deg f
2. Cut 2 sheets of aluminium foil , 12 x 24 inches
3. Fold each sheet of foil over to make a square of double thickness
4. Brush a little oil on the centre portion of each square
5. Rinse the fish and prepare all of the ingredients
6. Place a fish fillet on each square
7. Top with the capsicum , and sprinkle with the oliv oil , spring onions , cilantro , lime juice , chiles , salt and pepper
8. Fold the foil into airtight packets
9. Bake for 20 minutes
10. Open carefully[to avoid a blast of steam] , and check that the fish is done
11. Transfer the fish , vegetables and juices to serving plates

title: pine nut crusted chicken with garlic and white wine
steps:
1. Combine wine , garlic , 2 teaspoons salt , savory and rosemary in a small bowl
2. Place half the marinade in a heavy duty plastic zip lock bag
3. Cover and refrigerate the remaining marinade until ready to bake the chicken
4. Add the chicken to the bag , tossing to coat
5. Refrigerate 8 hours or overnight
6. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
7. Combine breadcrumbs , pine nuts , paprika and remaining teaspoon of salt
8. Roll chicken in the breadcrumb mixture
9. Throw out the marinade the chicken was sitting in
10. Place the chicken on a lightly greased baking pan , or on a pan covered in parchment paper
11. Drizzle with olive oil
12. Bake the chicken , covered , for 45 minutes
13. Uncover and pour reserved marinade over chicken
14. Bake , uncovered , for 1 hour or until chicken is done and golden brown

title: pineapple pork ribs
steps:
1. Lay each rack on a chopping board upside down
2. Using a very sharp paring knife , carefully remove the membrane that runs underneath
3. Using a tea towel , hold one corner of the ribs firmly , and pull the membrane sheet off in one long strip
4. Place the rib racks in a large non-metallic dish you may need to split them into two dishes
5. Whisk all marinade ingredients together and when the marinade is completely cool , pour over the pork ribs
6. Cover the ribs tightly in cling film and let marinate for a minimum of 4 hours or overnight
7. If using a charcoal barbecue , organize it for indirect grilling - two small piles of hot charcoal on either side of the barbecue with a drip pan made from aluminum foil in the centre
8. If you are using a gas grill , set the grill on medium heat
9. Place the ribs in the middle of the barbecue , away from direct heat
10. Close the lid of the barbecue and leave the vents open for 1 hours
11. Turn the ribs after 40 minutes
12. Baste them every 20 minutes with the remaining marinade
13. The ribs are ready when the meat has shrunk back away from the end of the bones
14. Slice between the bones and serve slathered in extra barbecue sauce

title: blueberry balsamic glazed rosemary chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Heat 1 tablespoon each olive oil and butter in a large , heavy , nonreactive saut pan
3. Season the chicken with salt and freshly ground black pepper and add to the pan when the oil and butter are hot and bubbly
4. Sear the chicken breasts over medium high heat until golden brown , about 1 minute per side or until a light crust forms
5. Remove to a baking dish and set aside
6. Add the remaining olive oil and butter to the pan and , when hot , stir in the shallots and cook until soft and lightly caramelized , about 4 minutes
7. Add the blueberries and stir 1 minute , followed by the balsamic vinegar , maple syrup , rosemary , salt and pepper and simmer about 10 minutes , or until the blueberries have collapsed
8. Pour the blueberry balsamic mixture over the chicken and put the pan in the top half of the oven for about 10 minutes , until the chicken has cooked through to a temperature of 170 degrees f

title: spicy rice bake
steps:
1. Peel and dice the sweet potato into 1 / 2 inch cubes
2. Remove the ribs of the greens , tear them in half lengthwise and cut into 1 / 2 inch strips
3. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
4. Heat oil over medium high heat
5. Saut the onion and salt for about 2 minutes or until onion begins to soften then add the the garlic and saut until the onion is almost translucent , about 3 to 4 minutes more
6. Stir in the sweet potato and collard greens
7. Saut , stirring occasionally , until the collard greens are bright [not dark] green and wilt , about 5 minutes
8. Place the rice and black eyed peas in a 9x13 inch baking dish
9. Add the sweet potato mixture and cayenne pepper and mix well
10. Pour 6 cups of boiling water , the tamari , the balsamic vinegar into the baking dish and mix carefully
11. Cover tightly with foil and bake for one and one half hours , or until the rice and black eyed peas are tender
12. Stir gently and serve hot

title: chocolate tia
steps:
1. In a highball glass , fill with ice
2. Add vodka and tia maria
3. Fill glass with chocolate milk
4. Stir and enjoy

title: spanish rice skillet dinner
steps:
1. In a large skillet stir together first six ingredients
2. Cover and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes until rice is tender
3. Stir in soup and simmer until liquid is almost absorbed
4. Stir in the nuts
5. Sprinkle with grated cheese just before serving

title: easy pleasing meatloaf
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients except 1 / 4 cup ketchup
2. Shape meat mixture into an oval loaf
3. Place loaf in a 9x13 baking dish
4. Top with remaining ketchup
5. Bake at 375 degrees fahrenheit for 1 hour

title: cherry pineapple holiday ham glaze
steps:
1. Heat pineapple juice , cherry juice , and ham drippings in saucepan over medium / high heat
2. Stir in brown sugar until dissolved completely
3. Stir occasionally until bubbling
4. Add pineapple slices and cherries , continuing to stir over medium / high heat
5. Glaze is ready when thickened to the consistency of syrup
6. Pour hot glaze over ham and add pineapple slices and cherries as garnish

title: mexican grits
steps:
1. Mix grits water salt , pepper , oleo , and chilies
2. Cook in microwave about 3 minutes or till done

title: salmon and spinach rosti bake
steps:
1. Parboil the potatoes for 8 minutes , then drain and set aside to cool
2. Dry the pan and return to medium heat , adding the oil
3. Saute the onion for about 7 minutes , stirring , until softened
4. Add the garlic , cook for 1 minute , then add the spinace and cook , stirring until just wilted down
5. Pre-heat the oven to 220c
6. Place the salmon strips neatly in 1 layer across the spinach mixture
7. In a bowl , mix the cream , lemon zest and dill or parsley , seasoning well
8. Pour all over the salmon and spinach and onion base
9. Remove the peel from the potatoes with your fingers , and coarsely grate the potatoes directly onto the creamy salmon in a craggy layer
10. Drizzle with a little olive oil , season to taste and place on a baking sheet
11. Bake for 30 minuttes , or until it's bubbling and the potato is a deep golden brown and crispy
12. Serve with steamed fine green beans

title: key lime pie  sugar free   splenda
steps:
1. Use a food processor to turn cookies into crumbs
2. Combine crumbs with melted butter and press mixture into the botom of a pie plate
3. Combine gelatin and milk in a pot on the stove
4. Whisk while cooking over low heat until gelatin is dissolved
5. Pour whipping cream into a blender and blend until thick and fluffy
6. Pour into small bowl and stir in 1 tsp spenda
7. Cover and refrigerate
8. In the blender , combine yogurt , cream cheese , lime juice , and zest in blender until smooth
9. Add gelatin and remaining splenda
10. Blend an additional 15 seconds
11. Pour into crust and refrigerate the pie for 3 hours or overnight for best results
12. Top with whipped cream to serve

title: homemade clam chowder   rachael ray
steps:
1. In a medium pot over medium high heat melt butter
2. Add bacon , onions , celery , carrot , and thyme sprigs
3. Season with salt , pepper and hot sauce and cook 5 minutes
4. Add flour and cook a minute more
5. Add half-and-half and stock and bring to a bubble , then stir in potatoes and clams
6. Bring soup back to a boil , reduce heat and simmer 15 minutes , until potatoes are cooked and soup has thickened to coat the back of a spoon
7. Remove the thyme sprigs from the soup
8. The thyme leaves will have fallen off into the soup
9. Stir and adjust seasonings in your soup
10. Pour soup into mugs
11. Top with shredded cheese or green onions if desired

title: bucatini with peppers and anchovies
steps:
1. Slice the chilli
2. Wash the capers and anchovies from excess salt , dry on a paper towel and chop roughly , together with the peppers
3. Chop the onion and saute in the oil
4. Add the chilli and the pepper mixture
5. Cook for 5 minutes stiring from time to time
6. Add the cherry tomatoes and cook for 15 minutes more
7. Season as needed
8. Cook the pasta , then toss with the mixture , adding the orn basil leaves
9. Serve

title: pineapple chicken tenders
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Place chicken in a greased 13x9-inch pan
3. Combine salt , pepper , and ginger in a small bowl
4. Season chicken with the mixture
5. Drain pineapple , reserving 1 / 3 cup juice
6. Mix sauce , pineapple , minced garlic , and reserved juice
7. Add to chicken
8. Stir to evenly coat chicken
9. Bake 30 minutes or until chicken is done and sauce is thickened
10. Serve over hot rice

title: creamy pork chops  n cabbage casserole
steps:
1. Coarsley chop cabbage and boil in salted water for about 3 minutes , then drain thoroughly
2. Add salt , pepper and cream , cover and simmer for about 10 to 15 minutes
3. Meanwhile , saute pork chops in butter until they are brown and almost cooked through
4. Remove chops and season them with salt and pepper
5. Stir white wine into the saute pan juices and add a pinch of sage
6. Simmer wine for a few minutes , then stir juice into creamed cabbage
7. Spread half the cabbage in the bottom of a casserole
8. Add pork chops , then cover them with the rest of the cream and cabbage
9. Sprinkle generously with parmesan cheese and drizzle with a little melted butter
10. Bake uncovered at 350 degrees for 20 minutes or until top is golden brown

title: sour cream strawberry muffins
steps:
1. Mix together dry ingredients
2. Mix together eggs , melted butter , sugar , and sour cream
3. Sift dry ingredients into the egg mixture and add strawberries
4. Bake at 350 for 25 to 27 minute

title: chocolate orange rum balls
steps:
1. Mix all dry ingredients and set aside in big bowl
2. Mix corn syrup , and rum together
3. Pour wet ingredients into dry and mix well with a fork
4. Let stand for 2 hours
5. If you like your rum balls super"rummy" you can add 1 / 2 cup more at this point and let it sit again for 2 hours
6. You can repeat the adding rum and waiting 2 hour step till it suits your taste
7. There is a good midpoint where the mix is not too wet and not too dry
8. Rolling the 1" balls should not be a sticky or crumbly task
9. Roll into balls and then roll in powdered sugar to coat
10. Store in sealed container

title: criehaven crab cakes
steps:
1. Mix all together as a hash and fry in oil until browned on both sides
2. Great for breakfast with eggs or main meal
3. Can substitute fish for crab

title: rose s crescents  holiday shortbread cookies
steps:
1. Sift the flour and salt together and set aside
2. Chop the almonds in a food processor or with a hand chopper until finely chopped
3. In a large bowl , combine butter , margarine , sugar and almonds
4. Beat at medium speed until light and fluffy
5. It may require stopping the mixer and scrapping the sides
6. Gradually add the flour mixture and beat until well mixed
7. You'll likely have to scrap the sides of the bowl occasionally to ensure that all the ingredients are combined
8. The result will be a fairly sticky dough
9. Place the dough on wax paper and shape into a rectangle and then wrap tightly in plastic wrap
10. Refrigerate for a minimum of two hours or overnight
11. Preheat the oven to 325
12. Cut the dough into eight sections
13. Working with two sections at a time , pinch off small balls of dough
14. On a floured surface , roll the dough into a rope about the size and length of your pinkie
15. Shape the ropes into crescent shapes
16. Place on ungreased cookied sheets and bake for 10-13 minutes until set
17. The edges should be golden brown
18. Cool on the cookie sheet for 10 minute
19. Remove promptly and roll in topping mixture

title: broccoli and cheddar kugel
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375 f
2. Fill a large bowl with ice water and set aside
3. Bring a large pot of water to a boil
4. Add the salt and the carrot and cook for 1 minute
5. Add broccoli and cook 1 more minute , transfer vegetables to ice water , let cool , and drain
6. Bring the pot of water back to a rolling boil , add the noodles , and cook for 8 minutes
7. Strain and cool under cold running water
8. Combine the remaining ingredients , except 1 / 2 cup cheddar , in a large bowl
9. Add the broccoli , carrots , and noodles , and gently toss
10. Pour the noodle mixture into a 3-quart casserole or eight 8-ounce dishes
11. Top with the remaining cheese
12. Cover and bake for 30 minutes
13. Uncover the pudding and continue to bake for 20 more minutes
14. Let the pudding cool for 10 minutes before serving

title: black cod with miso
steps:
1. 1
2. Mix the marinate ingredients thoroughly in a plastic container and set aside
3. Save some for plating purposes
4. 2
5. Pat the fish fillets dry with paper towels and put them into the plastic container with the marinate
6. Cover the lid and leave to steep in the refrigerator overnight or for 24 hours
7. 3
8. Preheat oven to 400 degree f
9. 4
10. Preheat an indoor grill at the same time
11. 5
12. Lightly wipe off any excess miso marinate clinging to the fish fillets but dont rinse it off
13. Place the fish on the grill and lightly grill on both sides until the surface turns brown
14. 6
15. Transfer the fish fillets to the oven and bake for 10-15 minutes
16. 7
17. Add a few extra drops of the marinate on the plate and serve hot

title: quick   easy poached salmon
steps:
1. Place filet , skin side down , in a small stock pot
2. Pour enough water over to cover the salmon by about two inches
3. Place pot on high heat until just beginning to boil
4. Remove salmon from water and pat dry
5. Sprinkle with kosher salt and pepper to taste
6. This goes great with a little garlic mayonnaise or a vinaigrette

title: cafe rio pork
steps:
1. Roast in crock pot for 5-6 hours
2. Shred meat
3. Cook one more hour
4. Serve with cafe rio beans , rice , and tomatillo dressing

title: milo slice
steps:
1. Grease the base and sides of a 27cm x 18cm baking tin
2. Place condensed milk and the 150g butter in a medium saucepan
3. Heat , stirring constantly , until the butter has melted
4. Remove from heat and stir in the milo
5. Combine the biscuit crumbs , coconut and raisins in a bowl
6. Pour the milo mixture into the biscuit mixture and mix thoroughly
7. Press firmly into the prepared tin and refrigerate for 20 minutes
8. Icing
9. Place the icing sugar , cocoa and 1 tbsp butter in a small bowl
10. Add the vanilla and boiling water
11. Mix to a spreadable consistency , adding a little extra water if required
12. Ice the slice with the icing , allow to firm , then cut into bars

title: quick chili sauce
steps:
1. If tomatoes are not ready crushed , mash thouroughly
2. Put in dutch overn
3. Add onion , green pepper , and garlic
4. Remove seeds from hot pepper , crumble pepper and add to mixture
5. Add brown sugar , corn syrup , vinegar , salt , pepper and spices
6. Bring to a boil
7. Boil rapidly , stirring occasioanlly for 30 minute or until of desired consistency
8. Turn into storage jar
9. Cool , then cover and keep refrigerated
10. Sauce keeps well for a long time

title: traditional beef in guinness stew
steps:
1. Cut the beef into chunks and dice the onions and carrots
2. Toss the beef in the flour and fry quickly in hot fat
3. Remove the beef and fry the onions until transparent
4. Return the beef and add the carrots and the liquids
5. :)
6. Bring just to the boil
7. Reduce the heat and bring to a very gentle simmer
8. Cover closely , and cook for 1
9. 5 to 2 hours
10. Check that the dish does not dry out
11. Add more water if necessary
12. Garnish with a little chopped parsley

title: spring chicken pasta
steps:
1. Cook spaghetti as directed on package , but without salt
2. Drain
3. Cook asparagus , tomatoes , garlic , bell peppers , onion and broth in 3 quart saucepan over medium heat 5 minutes
4. Stir in chicken
5. Cook 5-7 minutes , stirring constantly until asparagus is crisp-tender and chicken is cooked through
6. Stir in spaghetti and remaining ingredients
7. Toss bout 30 seconds or until heated through

title: farfalle with sausage  tomatoes  and cream
steps:
1. Heat oil in heavy large skillet over medium-high heat
2. Add sausage and crushed red pepper
3. Saut until sausage is no longer pink , breaking up with back of fork , about 5 minutes
4. Add onion and garlic
5. Saut until onion is tender and sausage is browned , about 3 minutes longer
6. Add tomatoes and cream
7. Reduce heat to low and simmer until sausage mixture thickens , about 3 minutes
8. Season to taste with salt and pepper
9. Meanwhile , cook pasta in large pot of boiling salted water until tender but still firm to bite
10. Drain , reserving 1 cup cooking liquid
11. Return pasta to same pot
12. Add sausage mixture and toss over medium-low heat until sauce coats pasta , adding reserved cooking liquid by 1 / 4 cupfuls if mixture is dry
13. Transfer pasta to serving dish
14. Sprinkle with basil
15. Serve , passing cheese separately

title: bbq chicken with sesame chili sauce
steps:
1. For sesame-chili sauce: in a small saucepan combine all of the ingredients except chicken
2. Cook over medium heat until bubbly , stirring frequently
3. Reduce heat
4. Cover and simmer for 5 minutes and set aside
5. Rinse chicken and pat dry
6. Remove skin if desired
7. Place chicken , bone side down , on an uncovered grill over medium coals
8. Grill for 20 minutes
9. Turn , grill 15-25 minutes more or till tender and no longer pink
10. Brush with sauce frequently during the last 10 minutes of grilling
11. Transfer chicken to a serving platter
12. Heat any remaining sauce and pass with chicken

title: glamorgan sausages  welsh veggie sausages
steps:
1. Whizz the bread in a food processor to make fine breadcrumbs
2. Place in a bowl
3. Whizz the onion , parsley and thyme in the processor until finely chopped , then add the cheese andmustard and process until finely chopped
4. Spoon the cheese mixture on to the bread crumbs
5. Season well with salt and pepper , then add the 1 whole egg and 1 egg yolk and stir well
6. Use your hands to form the mixture into 8 to 10 sausages
7. Place the egg white in a bowl and whisk with a fork
8. Roll the sausages in the egg white , then in flour
9. Heat the oil in a pan over medium heat and cook the sausages until brown all over , about 10 to 15 minutes
10. To make the sundried tomato gravy
11. Heat the oil in a saucepan over a low heat , then cook the onion until softened
12. Add the tomato puree and vegetable stock , bring to the boil , then reduce the heat to low and simmer for 15 minutes
13. Season with salt and pepper
14. Serve with the sausages and mashed potatoes

title: avocado salad
steps:
1. Cut the avocado into medium thick slices
2. Sprinkle the avocado slices with lemon juice to prevent browning
3. Cut the mozzarella into cubes
4. Cut the tomatoes into quarters
5. Place all the ingredients into a salad bowl and toss with olive oil , pinch of fresh majoram and salt until the desired taste is achieved
6. Serve at room temperature
7. Use firm ripe tomatoes and firm avocado to achieve best results

title: aussie shrimp on the barbie with orange ginger sauce
steps:
1. Soak 12 long wooded skewers in water for 30 minutes
2. Push skewers through shrimp lengthwise from top to tail , 1 shrimp per skewer
3. Combine all other ingredients in saucepan and cook over low to medium heat , stirring , until butter is completely melted
4. Dip skewered shrimp in orange sauce and position on oiled grill rack about 4 inches above the coals
5. Baste liberally with sauce and grill for 2 minutes
6. Turn shrimp over and baste again , cooking for another 2 minutes
7. Smaller shrimp will be done at this point , but continue basting and turning larger shrimp until they are pink and cooked through
8. Remove from heat immediately when done , as they will get tough if overcooked
9. Use any remaining sauce for a dip for shrimp

title: black  white  and red all over vegetarian tacos
steps:
1. Drain and rinse black beans
2. Drain corn and tomatoes
3. Mix beans , corn and tomatoes in pan and heat until heated throughout
4. Serve on tortillas with any additional toppings desired
5. Mixture can also be heated in microwave

title: chocolate hazelnut butter
steps:
1. General directions- food processor: place roasted hazelnuts in food processor container with all-purpose blade
2. Process to coarse butter texture , about 3 minutes
3. Gradually add sugar , salt or other ingredients through feed tube
4. Scrape down sides
5. Continue to process until desired texture is achieved , 4 to 7 minutes
6. Blender: place roasted hazelnuts and 1 tablespoon vegetable oil in blender container and grind to meal on low speed
7. Continue to blend on low for several minutes , scraping down sides of container as required and adding another tablespoon of oil , if necessary
8. When butter is fairly fluid , blend on high for 2 to 3 minutes or until desired texture is achieved
9. Gradually add other ingredients and blend on low until thoroughly mixed
10. For crunchy butter: stir in 1 / 4 cup roasted , chopped hazelnuts or raw sunflower seeds to finished butter
11. Makes 1-3 / 4 cups butter
12. These butter recipes are for"old-fashioned" butters with no stabilizers
13. If they are kept refrigerated , very little oil separation will occur
14. Shelf life is about 3 months in the refrigerator

title: horseradish crab dip
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl , beat cream cheese , picante sauce and horseradish
2. Mix well
3. Stir in the crab
4. Serve

title: sparkling fruit juice
steps:
1. In a large pitcher , stir together the apricot nectar , orange juice , grapefruit juice , and lemon juice
2. Slowly stir in the mineral water
3. Serve juice mixture over ice
4. If desired , garnish with blood orange slices

title: refreshing picnic tea
steps:
1. Bring 5 cups water to a boil in a medium saucepan , remove from heat
2. Add tea bags and cinnamon stick to water and let stand 5 minutes
3. Remove tea bags
4. Add sugar and stir to dissolve
5. Stir in orange juice and lemonade concentrates
6. Pour tea mixture into pitcher
7. Add remaining 5 cups water and stir well
8. Chill 4 hours , or until cold
9. Discard cinnamon stick
10. Fill glasses with ice and pour tea
11. Garnish each glass with one lemon slice
12. Serve !

title: homestyle minestrone soup
steps:
1. Browning ground chuck and seasonings in a medium-large frying pan , drain and set aside
2. Simmer the kidney beans in a small sauce pan
3. Chop , then saute the fresh vegetables in the olive oil , using a large stew pot , covered
4. When the onions and celery are somewhat clear , add the water , potatoes , and seasonings to the stew pot
5. Cook on high heat til it comes to a boil , then turn the heat down to medium , cover and slowly boil for 8 minutes , or until the carrots are done
6. Add the cabbage and let it cook , covered , for another 5-8 minutes , or until the potatoes seem to be half-cooked
7. Add the ground chuck , kidney beans , and the remaining ingredients , bring to bubbling , then simmer for 10-15 minutes more , or until potatoes are done
8. Don't allow the potatoes to cook too much or they will just fall apart
9. Serve steaming hot with crackers& crusty buttered bread
10. Sprinkle some parmesean cheese ontop , if you want
11. For all you vegetarians , simply omit the ground chuck , cut down 1- 1 / 2 cups of water and i think it would taste great !
12. I hope you all enjoy my soup !

title: easy delicious garlic shrimp
steps:
1. Place the shrimp in a bowl , and toss with salt
2. Let stand for 20 minutes
3. Heat olive oil and butter in a medium skillet over high heat
4. Add in chopped garlic , bay leaf and crushed red pepper
5. Stir for 1 minute
6. Add in shrimp and stir just until cooked through
7. Season with black pepper
8. Transfer to a serving dish

title: thanksgiving cake
steps:
1. Mix together: spice cake mix , canned pumpkin , salad oil , vanilla pudding mix , 3 eggs , cinnamon and water in a bowl and beat for 4 minutes at medium speed
2. Then add pecans
3. Grease a bundt pan liberally with butter / margarine and sprinkle with flour
4. Pour batter and bake at 350 degrees for 40-45 minutes
5. Let cool in pan for 15 minutes
6. Remove cake from bundt pan and add frosting
7. Frosting:
8. Mix all ingredients together until mixed well and put on cake
9. You can use just cool whip if you prefer

title: raisin pumpernickel bread
steps:
1. Stir together the lukewarm water and molasses in a large mixing bowl
2. Sprinkle in the yeast and stir to dissolve
3. Let stand for 10 minutes , or until slightly foamy
4. Stir in instant coffee , salt and rye flour
5. Sprinkle in the cocoa and stir well to combine
6. Add whole-wheat flour and 1 cup of the bread flour , or enough to make a sticky dough
7. Turn the bread out onto a lightly floured work surface and let it rest
8. Wash and dry the bowl
9. Sprinkle additional flour over the dough and begin to knead
10. Continue until most or all of the remaining bread flour is incorporated and you have a smooth elastic ball
11. Pour the vegetable oil into the mixing bowl , turn the ball of dough to coat well , cover bowl with a towel , and set aside to rise until dough is tripled in bulk , 3 to 4 hours
12. Lightly flour the work surface and turn the dough out onto it
13. Flatten it into a large rectangle and sprinkle with the raisins
14. Roll up the dough and knead it , to distribute the raisins and let rise until doubled
15. Sprinkle a large baking sheet with 3 to 4 tablespoons cornmeal
16. Turn the dough out , cut it into 3 pieces , and shape each piece into a small round loaf
17. Set loaves on the baking sheet , leaving as much room as possible between them , cover , and let rise until doubled
18. Preheat oven to 400
19. Beat egg white together with 1 tbls
20. Cold water in a small bowl
21. When the loaves have risen sufficiently , brush the tops with the egg white mixture
22. Bake loaves on the middle rack of the oven for 35 to 45 minutes , or until they are dark brown and sound hollow when bottoms are rapped
23. Cool completely on racks before cutting or wrapping
24. Makes 3 loaves
25. Enjoy !

title: vegetarians mock macdonald s cheeseburgers
steps:
1. Spread the ketchup on the bottom of the buns , top with onions , then burgers , cheese , pickles , then mustard
2. For some reason the order of toppings changes the taste
3. Microwave the whole mess until cheese melts and burger is warm
4. Good to take with for lunches
5. Serve with coke and fries for the full experience :p remember when planning servings that most veggie burgers are a healthy size and not the tiny hockey pucks of micky dee's

title: thai chicken sandwich
steps:
1. 1
2. Mix soy sauce , lime juice , vegetable oil , chili garlic sauce and ketchup
3. 2
4. Add chicken breasts to mixture and refrigerate for at least 6 hours
5. 3
6. Remove from refrigerator and season chicken with salt and pepper
7. 4
8. Place on a hot grill or bake in a 400 degree oven until cooked completely through
9. A meat thermometer should read at least 155-160 degrees
10. 5
11. Mix mayonnaise and thai chili sauce
12. Both the thai chili sauce and the chili garlic sauce should be available in the asian food section of the grocery store
13. 4
14. Brush 1 tbl of the mayonnaise-thai chili sauce mixture over each hamburger bun
15. 5
16. Place chicken on the bun and serve with lettuce and tomato

title: arugula  pear and goat cheese salad with pomegranate vinaigrette
steps:
1. Vinaigrette dressing:
2. In a small bowl combine the shallot , pomegranate molasses , vinegar , salt and pepper and whisk until the salt is dissolved
3. Whisk in the olive oil and let vinaigrette stand at room temperature until salad is assembled
4. Salad:
5. Combine the arugula , romaine , pears and half of the pomegranate seeds in a large bowl
6. Crumble half of the goat cheese over the ingredients in the bowl
7. Whisk the vinaigrette until uniform and add all but 2 tablespoons of it to the bowl
8. Gently toss the salad with your hands or salad tongs , coating the ingredients well with the vinaigrette
9. If the salad seems dry , add the vinaigrette in small increments until it is dressed to your liking
10. Crumble the remaining cheese over the salad and sprinkle the remaining pomegranate seeds and the pistachios over the top
11. Serve immediately

title: chicken rice skillet
steps:
1. In 12-inch skillet , heat oil over medium-high heat
2. Cook chicken in oil 3 to 4 minutes , stirring occasionally , until no longer pink in center
3. Add water and margarine
4. Heat to boiling
5. Stir in vegetables , rice , salt and pepper
6. Sprinkle with cheese
7. Remove from heat
8. Cover and let stand about 5 minutes or until water is absorbed
9. Make the most of this recipe
10. Time saver
11. Purchase precut chicken for stir-fry from the meat department of your supermarket and save time
12. Success
13. Boost flavor when you stir in 2 teaspoons chicken bouillon granules with the water , and omit salt
14. Add 1 teaspoon onion powder if you like

title: mom s macaroni   cheese
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Boil macaroni till tender
3. Make a white sauce and add dry mustard and paprika
4. Thouroughly blend
5. Add 4 oz
6. Cheddar cheese to white sauce and stir until melted
7. Add worcestershire sauce and blend
8. Spray a 9x13-inch baking dish with cooking spray
9. Layer noodles and sauce alternately for two layers
10. Sprinkle with 1 / 4 c cheddar cheese and paprika
11. Bake for 20-30 minutes or until lightly browned

title: baked cauliflower a la the frugal gourmet
steps:
1. In a stainless steel vegetable steamer , steam the cauliflower for about 15 minutes , until tender
2. When the vegetable is tender , remove it from the steamer , and place it in a casserole , with a cover , just large enough to hold the head
3. Pour the egg over the top of the cauliflower , add salt and pepper , and top with the cheese
4. Bake , covered at 375 degrees for 10 minutes , or until the cheese has melted and the egg is cooked

title: baked acorn squash with mustard and honey
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Cut squash in half , trim a piece off of bottom of each squash half so they will lie flat in pan
3. Mix butter , mustard , and honey in a small bowl until blended
4. Fill each cavity with 2 tablespoons of the butter mixture
5. Season with salt and pepper
6. Bake until the squash is very tender , 1 1 / 2 to 2 hours

title: so tasty and simple crabmeat spread
steps:
1. Spread and smooth out cream cheese onto plate
2. Shred crabmeat with fork
3. Blend garlic into cocktail sauce and then into crab meat
4. Spread over cream cheese
5. Chill in fridge at least 20 minutes
6. Garnish with scallions or chives
7. Serve with a smile and napkins

title: linda s spicy mayonnaise sauce for sushi
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together
2. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours for flavors to meld

title: lola richard s easy potato salad
steps:
1. Quarter the potatoes and eggs and put them in a large bowl
2. Mash them with a potato masher to a course consistancy
3. Add the onion , sweet pickles , mayo and yellow mustard and stir to combine
4. Add salt and pepper to taste
5. Sometimes i add a little finely diced cucumber if i have it
6. Sweet pickle relish can be substituted for the diced sweet pickles

title: pork cutlets
steps:
1. Place cutlets between waxed paper and flatten to 1 / 4 - 1 / 2 inch thickness using a meat pounder or rolling pin
2. Cut small slits around the edges of the pork and set aside
3. In a pie dish or bowl combine 1 / 2 cup flour , salt and pepper
4. In a second pie dish beat eggs with milk
5. In a third pie dish combine bread crumbs and paprika
6. Dip cutlets in flour , then egg mixture and finally in the breadcrumb mixture , coating well with the crumbs
7. Set aside until all the pork cutlets are coated
8. In a large skillet melt crisco over medium heat
9. Add three cutlets to the skillet at a time and saute on both sides until golden brown and then transfer to a plate and keep warm and repeat with the remaining shortening and cutlets
10. In a small cup combine remaining flour with dillweed and then add mixture to skillet
11. Stir in broth , stirring to combine well and then stir in sour cream until heated through
12. Spoon sauce or pass separately--the sauce is wonderful over noodles

title: flounder spinach bake
steps:
1. Thaw fish if frozen
2. Combine spinach , croutons , corn and cheese
3. Combine egg and water
4. Add to spinach mixture , mix well
5. Spread mixture in 12x2 inch pan , cover with foil and bake at 375 degrees for 10 minutes
6. Arrange fish over spinach , sprinkel with salt and pepper
7. Cover with foil and bake 15 minutes
8. Remove foil and arrange tomatos on fish , sprinkle with cheese and bake 5 more minutes

title: summertime soy granita
steps:
1. Combine sugar and water in a small saucepan
2. Bring to a boil , and cook 1 minute or until sugar dissolves
3. Remove from heat and whisk in vanilla , cinnamon and soy milk
4. Cool mixture completely
5. Pour into an 8-inch square baking dish
6. Cover and freeze at least 8 hours or until firm
7. Remove from freezer
8. Scrape entire mixture with a fork until fluffy
9. Spoon into a freezer-safe container
10. Cover and freeze for up to 1 month
11. When ready to serve , scoop into dessert cups , sprinkle with almonds and garnish with mint sprigs

title: orange date nut bran muffins
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400 degrees
2. Grease one 12-cup muffin tin
3. In a large bowl , combine bran cereal , water and oil , stirring until bran softens
4. In a small bowl , whisk buttermilk , orange juice , molasses , honey , orange zest , and egg until blended
5. In a small bowl , combine flours , baking soda and salt
6. Add buttermilk mixture to bran , stirring to combine
7. Add flour mixture , dates and walnuts to bran mixture , stirring just until flour is moistened
8. Spoon into muffin cups , and bake until top springs back when lightly pressed , about 18 minutes
9. Let cool in pan 5 minutes before removing to wire rack

title: spinach   blue cheese salad with walnut dressing
steps:
1. For the dressing
2. Preheat your oven to 180c
3. Spread the walnuts on a baking tray and cook in the preheated oven for 5-8 minutes until aromatic and toasted
4. Combine the walnuts , oil , vinegar , salt and pepper in a screw top jar and shake well to combine
5. For the salad
6. Place the spinach , tomatoes and blue cheese in a large bowl
7. Drizzle with the dressing , toss gently to combine and serve immediately

title: east asian style bbq chicken  or broil
steps:
1. Mix together the broth , soy , sugar , garlic 1 tbsp white vinegar & chili pepper
2. Save 1 / 2 cup of the marinade
3. Place the remaining marinade in a zip lock plastic bag or a bowl large enough to hold the chicken
4. Place chicken in the marinade seal and place in the fridge for at least 1 hour
5. Remove from marinade grill or broil the chicken approx 20-30 minutes o until the chicken is cooked , baste at least twice with the reserved marinade , turn while basting
6. Heat remaining marinade and serve with the chicken

title: chocolate coconut macadamia drops
steps:
1. Microwave chocolate in glass bowl at 50% power , in 30 second increments , stirring after each , until chocolate is melted and smooth when stirred
2. Stir in nuts and coconut , mixing well to combine
3. Drop the mixture by heaping teaspoons onto wax paper lined baking sheets
4. Refrigerate until firm , approximately 15-30 minutes
5. Enjoy !

title: st  louis style chicken salad
steps:
1. In a large bowl , mix together the chicken , celery , bell pepper , and green onions
2. In a small bowl , stir together the mayonnaise , sour cream , feta cheese , and dill weed
3. Pour sauce over the chicken and stir to blend
4. Taste and season with salt and pepper as desired
5. This is best refrigerated for 4 hours or more before serving , covered with plastic wrap

title: beef and spinach pasta bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 190c
2. Place the beef , bacon , onion and garlic in a fry pan and cook gently until meat has changed colour and onion is softened
3. Add in the wine , tomatoes and their juice , basil , chili flakes , mixed spice and brown sugar
4. Bring to the boil , then reduce to a simmer and cook about 20 minutes
5. Sadd the spinach cook a couple of minute more , season with sall and pepper then add the cooked pasta
6. Spray a 6 cup oven proof dish and spoon in the pasta mix
7. Lightly beat the eggs , add in the milk and season with salt and pepper
8. Pour over the pasta mix then sprinkle with the grated parmesan
9. Bake in the oven for 20 minutes or untl set and golden brown

title: crispy toast cups
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Carefully press each slice of bread into ungreased muffin cups
3. Brush bread with butter
4. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes , or until lightly golden brown
5. Store in an airtight container for up to two days

title: shish taouk toum   grilled   bbq chicken with garlic sauce
steps:
1. Cut the chicken breasts into 2 cms pieces and place in a bowl
2. Add the olive oil , tomato puree , garlic 1 tablespoon toum , salt , pepper and lemon juice
3. Mix well to coat the chicken and leave to marinate in the fridge for at least 1 hour or overnight
4. Tread the chicken pieces on to skewers and grill for about 10 minutes on the barbecue or under a preheated grill
5. Turning from time to time
6. Serve with toum for dipping and a salad
7. Toum - put the garlic clove and salt in a blender or food-processor and whiz to a smooth puree
8. Add the egg white and whiz again until smooth
9. Very slowly pour in the vegetable oil in a constant , steady stream until all the oil is used up and the sauce is the consistency and colour of mayonnaise
10. Add the lemon juice and keep whizzing until smooth
11. Taste and add more lemon if necessary

title: beef   corn noodle casserole
steps:
1. Brown beef in butter in iron skillet and add onion
2. Brown slightly & pour off some of the grease
3. Add tomatoes and noodles
4. Cook until noodles are tender , adding some water if necessary
5. Add corn & olives
6. Turn into a 13x9-inch greased casserole
7. Sprinkle with cheese
8. Bake at 350 degrees , 40 minutes

title: quick sticky buns
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375 drgrees
2. Drop a piece of butter in the bottom of each of 10 compartments of a muffin tin
3. Arrange the banana slices on top
4. Sprinkle the pecans and brown sugar over the bananas
5. Top each compartment with a biscuit
6. Bake until golden , about 8-10 minutes
7. Remove from oven
8. Place a baking sheet on top of the buns in the muffin tin while they are atill hot
9. Carefully flip the tin over , tapping the bottom to release the buns
10. Transfer to a platter , serve warm

title: big and yummy choc chip cookies
steps:
1. In a big bowl cream butter , nutella and sugar for about 5 minutes
2. Add the egg and beat it inches
3. In a second bowl combine baking powder , flour and vanilla bean
4. Add this to the wet mixture and mix to combine
5. Fold in both types of chocolate chunks
6. Use your hands to form large round heaps of dough
7. Flatten slightly on the baking sheet
8. These will spread , so leave enough room between them
9. Bake in the preheated oven at 180c / 350f for about 15 minutes
10. Take them out when theyre still a bit soft , theyll crisp up while cooling
11. Allow to cool on the baking sheet for 2 minutes , then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely

title: triple chocolate raspberry cordial
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in a cocktail shaker , and shake vigorously
2. Pour into cordial or cocktail glass

title: juneann s chewy bisquick brownies
steps:
1. Put all ingredients into one bowl and mix with a hand mixer until blended good
2. The batter will be thick
3. Put into 9x13 pan and bake at 350 for 18-25 minutes

title: bacon and tomato tarts
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees
2. Thinly slice tomatoes
3. Lightly salt and pepper the tomatoes
4. Layer the tomatoes between paper towels for ten minutes
5. Melt the butter in a skillet
6. Cook onions and shallots until translucent
7. Mix mayonnaise and cheeses
8. Lightly brush mustard in bottom of tart shells
9. Layer tomatoes and onions in shells
10. Sprinkle the tops of each tart with crumbled bacon
11. Top each tart with the mayonnaise cheese mixture
12. Place tarts on a baking sheet
13. Bake for 45 minutes

title: blue cheese meatballs
steps:
1. Add all the ingredients to a large mixing bowl
2. Mix well to combine
3. Form mixture into 1 / 2-inch balls
4. Put the balls on a baking sheet with a rim
5. Bake in a 375 oven for about 10 minutes or until browned
6. Serve immediately with toothpicks for spearing

title: body for life strawberry cheesecake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Spoon cottage cheese into blender and blend until smooth , about 30 seconds
3. Add vanilla extract and splenda
4. Blend for about 15 more seconds
5. Add the softened cream cheese and blend for about 30 seconds , scraping down sides as needed
6. While blending , gradually add the egg substitute and continue to blend until smooth , about 45 seconds
7. Pour cheese filling into ready crust and bake until set , about 35 minutes
8. Remove cheesecake from oven and cool for about 15 minutes
9. Then cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours
10. Prior to serving , in a small mixing bowl , combine sour cream and sugar substitute
11. Slice cheesecake into 8 portions , top with sliced strawberries and sour cream
12. Serve and enjoy !

title: citrus dip
steps:
1. Mix altogether
2. Chill

title: ham n  cheese scalloped potatoes
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees
2. In 13x9 pan layer potatoes , ham and onion
3. In 2 quart saucepan melt butter until sizzling
4. Stir in flour , mustard and pepper
5. Cook over medium heat , stirring constantly , until smooth and bubbly
6. Add milk , continue cooking , stirring occasionally , until sauce is thickened
7. Stir in cheese until melted
8. Pour sauce over potatoes
9. Sprinkle with chives
10. Bake for 60 to 75 minutes or until bubbly and potatoes are fork tender

title: rib eye steaks that are superb
steps:
1. Remove steaks from the refrigerator and let them sit for about 30 minutes to take the chill out of the meat
2. Now , coat both sides generously with coarse black pepper and granulated garlic powder
3. Heat an iron skillet or a heavy bottomed frying pan until very hot on high heat
4. For each steak , sprinkle onto the skillet , 3 / 4 teaspoon of coarse salt and allow salt to heat up for at least 1 minute
5. Place the steaks on the coarse salt and cook for 3 minutes
6. Do not disturb at all , do not look or even move the steaks
7. Turn the steaks over and cook for an additional 3 minutes
8. Again do not disturb at all
9. The cooking time of 6 minutes gives you a medium-rare steak
10. Do not overcook
11. If you desire to cook it to medium , then cook for an additional 30 seconds to 1 minute per side
12. Remove steaks to a plate , cover with foil and let rest for 5 minutes , so that all juices are absorbed by the meat
13. Scrape off any excess coarse pepper and salt if desired and discard
14. I prefer to slice the steaks on an angle about 1 / 4 inch to 3 / 8 inch thickness
15. Serve with freshly processed horseradish
16. This will vary depending on your cooktop
17. Do not use ordinary table salt
18. Beef tenderloin steaks are also real great cooked in this manner
19. If using a steak thicker than 1 inch , add 1 extra minute per side for medium-rare

title: shrimp quesadillas
steps:
1. Heat 10" non-stick skillet over med-high heat
2. Place 1 tortilla in skillet and sprinkle with 1 / 4 cup cheese and 1 / 4 of tomato , bacon and shrimp
3. Sprinkle with additional 1 / 4 cup cheese
4. Top with another tortilla
5. Cook 1-2 minutes or until bottom is golden brown
6. Turn
7. Cook 1-2 minutes longer or til bottom is golden brown
8. Repeat 3 more times
9. Cut each quesadilla into wedges
10. To keep quesadillas warm , place on a ungreased cookie sheet in oven

title: honey mustard ham
steps:
1. Cut ham into 4 serving pieces
2. Mix water and honey mustard in a large skillet
3. Add ham
4. Cover and heat to boiling
5. Reduce heat to low and simmer about 10 minutes , turning ham once , until ham is hot
6. Remove ham from skillet and keep warm
7. Stir sour cream into skillet and heat for 1 minute
8. Do not boil !
9. Pour over ham and sprinkle with green onion

title: skillet cornbread with prunes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. In a medium sized bowl , combine the flour , cornmeal , sugar and baking powder
3. Make a well in the center
4. Pour margarine into the well
5. Add egg , buttermilk and prunes
6. Stir just to mix all ingredients together
7. Do not overmix
8. Put the batter into a greased baking dish
9. Bake for 30 minutes or until the bread is golden on top
10. Allow it to cool
11. Cut into 8 wedges

title: jumbo shrimp with asparagus
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan , bring two cups of water to a boil
2. Cook asparagus in boiling water for 3 minutes
3. Drain , reserving 2 tablespoons of liquid
4. Heat the oil in a skillet over medium-high heat
5. Saut the shrimp pieces until the color changes , about 3 to 5 minutes
6. Stir in asparagus with reserved liquid , and season with ginger , soy sauce , sugar , sherry and salt to taste
7. Continue to cook for 5 more minutes

title: cream cheese filled crumb cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Grease a 13x9x2-inch cake pan
3. In a large bowl , combine the butter , flour , sugar , salt and baking powder
4. Mix with your hands to form crumbs
5. Take out just enough for crumbs on top of cake , about 3 / 4 cup
6. Set aside
7. To the remaining crumbs add the eggs and milk
8. Beat well
9. Place all filling ingredients into a medium bowl and beat with a whisk or mixer until smooth
10. Spread half the batter into the cake pan
11. Pour the cream cheese mixture on top to within about 1 / 2-inch of the edges
12. Gently spread the remaining batter on top of the cream cheese
13. Sprinkle the top with the reserved crumbs
14. Bake for 40-45 minutes or until cake tester inserted in center comes out clean
15. Remove from oven and set on a rack to cool
16. To serve , cut into squares
17. Leftover cake should be refrigerated after a day

title: potato casserole with spinach and feta
steps:
1. Peel potatoes , cut in half and drop into cold water
2. Drain and place in a large saucepan and cover with hot water
3. Cover saucepan and bring to a boil
4. Reduce heat and continue boiling gently , partially covered until potatoes are tender , about 20 to 30 minutes
5. Mash with a potato masher
6. Stir in butter , sour cream , salt and pepper
7. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
8. Butter a 9x13 inch baking dish
9. Wash fresh spinach leaves
10. Place wet leaves in a microwave-safe dish , cover and microwave on high until just wilted , from 2 to 3 minutes
11. Or place in a wide saucepan and stir over medium heat just until wilted , about 5 minutes
12. When cool enough , squeeze handfuls of spinach until dry
13. Coarsely chop and place in a medium size bowl
14. Combine the spinach , garlic and feta cheese
15. Stir spinach mixture into potatoes
16. Spoon into buttered dish swirling top slightly
17. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese
18. Bake , uncovered until golden and a knife inserted in center feels warm , 40-50minutes

title: reef   beef
steps:
1. Place soup , salad dressing , garlic , and worcestershire sauce in a saucepan , and heat to a simmer
2. When sauce just starts to thicken , add prawns and scallops , stir through , and continue heating to cook the seafood
3. Grill steaks to personal prference
4. Stir cream through the sauce , remove from heat
5. Place steaks on plates , and top with sauce , dividing seafood between the steaks
6. Serve with hot chips & salad !

title: french merguez sausages   culinary communion
steps:
1. Marinate: toss the lamb , fatback , and dry seasonings together , then chill well
2. Grind: grind meat mixture through grinder using a medium plate into a mixing bowl over an ice bath
3. Mix and develop protein: in an electric mixer , mix on low speed for 1 minute , adding the red wine a little at a time
4. Mix on medium speed for 15 to 20 seconds , or until the sausage mixture is sticky to the touch
5. Make a tester: make a test patty and pan fry
6. Adjust the seasoning and consistency if necessary before putting sausage into casings
7. Stuff: stuff the sausage into the prepared casings and twist into 15-inch links
8. Cut into individual links
9. Make a spiral with each link and secure with a 6-inch skewer
10. Cook: the sausage is now ready to prepare for eating by pan frying , baking , grilling , or broiling to an internal temperature of 150 degrees f , or hold under refrigeration for up to 7 days
11. It's up to you , of course , how you make them
12. These sausages are absolutely delicious , and i hope you'll try the recipe ! the recipe appear to definitely be a french version of merguez , rather than the turnisian version -- all i know is that they're very , very tasty
13. :)

title: razor clams oregon style
steps:
1. Drizzle lime juice on clams , dip in buttermilk , dredge in panko
2. Refrigerate about 10 minute to set breading
3. In a pan large enough to hold clams without them touching , heat oil and butter on medium-high until foaming stops
4. Salt and pepper clams to taste and saute until golden , about 1 minute on each side
5. Drain

title: johnsonville easter breakfast casserole
steps:
1. Cook sausage according to package directions
2. Cool slightly , cut into 1 / 4 inch slices
3. Place english muffin cubes in the bottom of a greased 13x9 baking dish drizzle with butter
4. Layer with sausage , cheese , onion and bell pepper
5. In a large bowl , combine the eggs , milk , salt and pepper
6. Pour over cheese
7. Sprinkle with bacon , cover and refrigerate overnight
8. Remove from the fridge 30 minutes before baking
