9. Uncover and bake 350 for 45-50 minutes or until a knife inserted in the center comes out clean
10. Let stand

title: halloween or fall pumpkin bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Grease 2 loaf pans or 3 medium size disposable gift pans or one large 11 1 / 2 inch size cast iron fry pan
3. The fry pan makes it nice and crusty on the edges and bottom
4. Dissolve baking soda and hot water together
5. Stir and set aside
6. Mix together the following: oil , sugar , eggs , pumpkin
7. Then add soda water into it
8. Spices
9. Flour 1 / 2 cup at a time until all is added stir in between
10. Bake for 50-60 minutes until golden brown and done by toothpick test

title: 1 spicy sweet honey chili
steps:
1. Crumble ground beef in large pan
2. Add accent flavor enhancer
3. Brown ground beef
4. Add onion , green pepper , and garlic
5. Cook until onion is translucent / brown
6. Drain oil
7. Add tomatoes , jalapeo peppers , chili beans , chili powder , cumin , thyme , salt and cinnamon
8. Stir and simmer on low for at least 25 minutes
9. Add honey
10. Stir again
11. Serve alone , over rice , or spaghetti
12. Serve with cheese & crackers is a must !
13. Oh--great with corn bread as well !

title: quick okra curry
steps:
1. Saute onions in oil until golden brown
2. Add spices and half cup water
3. Saute for two minutes on medium heat
4. Add okra , salt , and rest of water
5. Cook covered for 5 minutes
6. Add tomatoes
7. Cover and cook until okra is cooked on medium heat

title: onion spaghetti
steps:
1. Boil , in a large pot enough water and then add the spaghetti
2. Season with enough salt
3. Cook for 8-10 minutes
4. Cut onions in small pieces
5. Drain the spaghetti and heat the olive oil in the pot
6. Cook until onion is soft
7. Add the spaghetti and mix well
8. Season with white pepper

title: easiest dessert ever
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Grease a 9 x 13 cake pan
3. Add peaches and the juice
4. Sprinkle dry cake mix on top
5. Pour melted butter over dry cake mix
6. Spread around a bit with a spoon
7. Bake for 35-40 minutes
8. Serve warm with whipping cream

title: uncle bill s low fat dressing
steps:
1. In a medium size saucepan , add 2 cups of water and bring to boil
2. In a small dish , mix together cornstarch and 1 / 4 cup of cold water until well dissolved
3. Add cornstarch mixture to saucepan , stirring constantly until well blended
4. Remove from heat and let cool
5. In a medium size mixing bowl , mix together salt , pepper , chopped shallots , diced sweet red pepper , dijon mustard , chopped garlic , chopped parsley , paprika , white and red vinegar and honey
6. Mix well to blend
7. Now add cooled water mixture to mixed ingredients and mix well to blend
8. Store in a glass jar with lid in the refrigerator

title: guisado de chorizo y papas
steps:
1. Briefly saut the onions and mushrooms in olive oil
2. Add the garlic , potatoes and chorizo and saut until the potatoes are browned slightly but not so much that the garlic starts to burn
3. Add the paprika , chicken broth , black pepper , and bay leaves
4. Bring to a boil , reduce heat to low , and continue cooking until the potatoes are soft , between 20-30 minutes
5. Add more chicken stock if necessary
6. About five minutes before the stew is done , you may want to skim off some of the fat that will have risen to the top as the chiorzo cooked
7. When you are done , stir in the basil
8. Once the potatoes are cooked , if the stew is too thin just make a paste of cornstarch and water and stir rapidly into the stew
9. It will thicken up after just a couple minutes over the heat
10. Season with additional salt and pepper to taste

title: tuna linguine primavera
steps:
1. Cook the pasta and add the frozen vegetables to the water for the last 5 minutes of cooking
2. Drain all and return to the pan
3. Add the rest of the ingredients and toss to coat
4. I serve it with more grated cheese on top

title: shrimpy macaroni and cheese
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees f
2. Cook macaroni according
3. To package directions , drain well , set aside
4. In a sauce pan , melt 2 t butter over medium heat , add flour ,
5. Stirring constantly
6. Whisk in the milk and bring
7. To a boil
8. Cook until smooth , stirring frequently
9. Remove from
10. Heat and stir in cheese and cayenne pepper
11. In a large bowl , toss macaroni with cheese sauce , shrimp , and
12. Bell pepper
13. Pour into lightly greased 9x13 baking dish
14. Cover
15. With bread crumbs and drizzle on the 2t of melted butter
16. Bake uncovered until golden brown , about 15-20 minutes
17. Serves 4-6

title: easy and fast soft chicken tacos
steps:
1. Remove chicken meat and make into bite size pieces , place in a 10-12" skillet
2. Add salsa to the chicken and simmer on low for 10-15 minutes
3. Place lettuce , tomatoes and sour cream into individual bowls and set aside
4. Place two tortillas in a brown lunch bag ,
5. Close tightly and microwave for 30 seconds
6. Place 2 tortillas on a plate and add ingredients in any order you like
7. There is no real way to make a taco
8. While the first person is making their tacos , heat the second person's tortillas , and so on
9. This way everyone's food is hot
10. If you have a tortilla warmer , that would work great

title: maple squash
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Line a baking sheet with foil , then lightly brush or spray with oil
3. You may have to cut the pieces into chunks no bigger than 1 inch wide
4. In a medium-size bowl , stir oil with maple syrup , thyme and salt
5. Add squash and toss until evenly coated
6. Spread out on baking sheet
7. Scrape maple mixture from bottom of bowl evenly over squash
8. Roast squash , 25 to 30 minutes , uncovered , in centre of preheated oven , until tender and bottom edges are golden
9. To ensure a rich , dark-golden glaze on top of squash , do not turn squash pieces over or stir during roasting
10. Remove from oven and serve immediately

title: butternut shrimp soup topped with sherry
steps:
1. Clean out the squash
2. Remove the skin and cut into 1 / 2 inch dice
3. Measure 3 cups of cut-up squash
4. In a saucepan , simmer the squash , celery salt , cinnamon , nutmeg , curry powder , milk , and broth for about 30 minutes
5. Stir to keep the milk from burning
6. Season with salt and pepper
7. Add half the shrimp and pears to the pumpkin mixture and process in a food processor or blender until smooth
8. Return to saucepan and simmer
9. Add the remaining whole shrimp and pears and simmer for 5 more minutes
10. Top with sherry , more cinnamon and nutmeg to taste
11. Optional seving bowl:
12. If you are going to serve the soup in a pumpkin , boil 2 quarts of water
13. Cut the top off of the squash and clean out carefully
14. Cut a notch in the top for the ladle to stick through
15. Pour the boiling water into the squash and swish around and then pour into sink
16. Pour the soup into the pumpkin

title: rivvels for soup
steps:
1. Put the flour in the mixing bowl and add a couple shakes of salt
2. Cut in the egg
3. Cut in milk a tablespoon at a time until the mixture is crumbly
4. Use your hands to crumble little pieces of dough into your boiling stock
5. Should be pea-sized or slightly larger
6. Simmer for 10-15 minutes

title: halibut with rosemary
steps:
1. Sprinkle fish with salt and pepper
2. Coat with flour
3. Heat oil in frying pan over medium heat
4. Arrange fish in a single layer in pan
5. Cook , turning once , until fish is brown and flaky , app
6. 5 minutes per side
7. Remove fish to a warm platter
8. To pan , add vinegar , garlic , rosemary , and water
9. Boil until reduced by half
10. Remove garlic
11. Spoon sauce over fish

title: no sugar freezer jam
steps:
1. Combine lemon juice , water , gelatin and cornstarch in a saucepan
2. Heat slowly , stirring constantly , until gelatin and cornstarch dissolves
3. Add fruit to gelatin mixture
4. Heat to boiling point over low heat , stirring constantly
5. Boil berries 3 minutes
6. Remove from heat and add sugar substitute
7. Pour into heat proof jars and cover
8. Let set at room temperature until cooled
9. Store in refrigerator or freeze

title: down home succotash
steps:
1. In a large skillet , cook the bacon until it's crisp
2. Put the bacon on paper towels and reserve 1 tbsp of drippings
3. Add the corn , beans , green pepper and onion to the drippings
4. Simmer for 10-15 minutes or until the vegetables are almost tender , adding water if necessary
5. Stir in tomatoes and bacon
6. Cook just until tomatoes are heated through

title: ground pork sandwiches
steps:
1. Make 4 large , flattened patties from the ground pork
2. Dredge first in flour , then in egg , then in breadcrumbs
3. Fry on high heat in about 1 / 8" of vegetable oil until crisp and golden brown
4. Heat buns in the microwave for a minute , wrapped in a kitchen towel
5. Serve garnishes separately

title: peanut butter   banana pudding
steps:
1. Combine first 3 ingredients in a heavy saucepan
2. Whisk in eggs and milk , and cook , whisking constantly , over low heat until thickened remove from heat and stir in butter and vanilla
3. Set custard aside
4. Spread a 1 / 2 teaspoon of peanut butter between 2 chocolate wafers , forming a sandwich
5. Repeat with remaining peanut butter and chocolate wafers
6. Place sandwich cookies in the bottom of a 3-quart glass bowl or trifle bowl
7. Top with banana slices
8. Pour custard over bananas
9. Cover and chill 4 hours
10. Spread whipped topping evenly over the custard and sprinkle with peanuts before serving

title: philly fudge
steps:
1. Butter 9x9x2" baking pan well , set aside
2. Melt chocolate chips in double boiler over hot , not boiling , water
3. Blend cream cheese and milk in large electric mixer bowl , beating at high speed until smooth
4. Add powdered sugar , 1 / 2 cup at a time , and beat at low speed until creamy
5. Blend in melted chocolate chips , vanilla and salt , beating until smooth
6. Stir in pecans
7. Press mixture into pan , cover with plastic wrap , and chill over night or until firm
8. Cut into 1 1 / 4" squares

title: mexican hot pot
steps:
1. Brown meat in hot oil in a dutch oven
2. Add onions and saute until tender
3. Add remaining ingredients and simmer uncovered for 11 / 2 hours

title: cranberry almond chocolate bars with tangerine zest
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Line a 13 by 9-inch baking pan with foil
3. Lay out almond slivers on baking sheet
4. Bake in oven until light brown , shaking the baking pan occasionally to mix , about 10 to 15 minutes
5. Melt the chocolate morsels in a double boiler over low heat
6. Mix in the cranberries , almond slivers and tangerine zest
7. Pour into prepared pan
8. Smooth the chocolate mixture out into an even layer
9. Cool to room temperature and then refrigerate until hard , at least 1 hour
10. Break up chocolate into jagged , varied sized pieces
11. Or you may pour circles of the chocolate mixture on the foil and let cool , then you don't have to break them up
12. :)

title: turkey jook
steps:
1. Remove excess skin from the turkey carcass but leave any browned , crispy pieces for additional flavor
2. To help fit the carcass into a pot , cut it in half , breaking it across the back-bone along the ribs
3. Place the halves in a large stockpot and add the cold water
4. Bring to a boil
5. Boil for 5 minutes , skimming the scum that rises to the top
6. Reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes
7. Rinse the rice well in several changes of water until water runs clear
8. Add the rice to the pot
9. Bring back to a boil , stirring occasionally
10. Add the ginger
11. Reduce heat to low , cover , and simmer for about 3 hours , stirring occasionally
12. Remove the carcass and skin from the jook
13. Discard bones and skin
14. Shred any large pieces of meat or cut into bite size pieces and return them to the soup
15. Add the salt and simmer for about 30 minutes , until a good consistency is reached
16. Finish with the sesame oil
17. Serve with small dishes of garnishes and condiments

title: vegan mango lassi
steps:
1. Combine all in a blender and blend until smooth and creamy
2. Serve chilled

title: garlic   herb salad dressing
steps:
1. Shake all ingredients in a small jar with a tight fitting lid
2. Let stand at room temperature for at least 1 hour
3. The longer the better
4. Shake again and use to dress any crisp green salad
5. Store in jar and refrigerate 4 to 5 days
6. Always shake before using

title: low fat broccoli cornbread
steps:
1. Combine first five ingredients in a large bowl
2. Add the onion , broccoli , and muffin mix and stir until well blended
3. Pour into a 9" by 13" baking pan coated with cooking spray
4. Bake until lightly browned on top at 375 degrees f in glass or 400 f in metal pan

title: spicy honey kissed chicken
steps:
1. In a small dish , combine the dry ingredients
2. Rub the mixture all over the chicken
3. Cut into strips about 1 / 2 inch wide
4. Heat a large skillet over medium-high heat
5. Add the oil and coat the bottom of the skillet
6. Cook the chicken until nearly cooked through , 3 to 5 minutes , stirring or turning often
7. Meanwhile , in a small bowl , whisk together the wet ingredients
8. Stir into the chicken , increase the heat to high , and cook for 1 to 2 minutes , or until the chicken has just cooked through

title: lamb chops with honey and wine
steps:
1. To marinate the meat: place lamb in a wide deep baking dish
2. In a small bowl combine chopped onions , garlic , honey , oil , soy sauce , wine , pepper , cinnamon , and lemon juice
3. Mix well and pour mixture over lamb
4. Cover and marinate for 20-45 minutes
5. Bake in preheated over for 70 minutes or until cooked through
6. Serve with rice or vegetables or both

title: quick chicken with gouda gravy
steps:
1. Season both sides of the chicken with thyme , salt and pepper
2. Heat pan with olive oil or spray with pam
3. Add chicken , cook for 6 minute each side
4. In a small heavy saucepan , melt butter
5. Add flour , cook for 1 minute
6. Whisk in chicken broth and 1 / 2 cup milk until thickened , 2-3 minute
7. Season with salt and pepper
8. Using a wooden spoon , stir in cheese in a figure-eight motion until melted
9. Remove from heat
10. Slice the chicken at an angle and top with the gouda gravy

title: camembert basil croquettes
steps:
1. Cut rind from cheese and chop into small chunks
2. Chop the basil finely
3. Make a thick bechamel: melt the butter in heavy medium saucepan over medium heat , and add 4 t flour , stirring with a whisk until it begins to turn slightly golden
4. Pour in all the milk at once , whisking continuously until the milk reaches boiling and becomes a thick , smooth sauce
5. Add nutmeg
6. Add the cheese and basil and stir until the cheese melts
7. Remove from heat
8. Salt and pepper to taste
9. Stir in 1 egg , and set the mixture aside , in a large , flat dish like a pie plate
10. Press plastic wrap or waxed paper onto the surface to prevent air from getting to the mixture
11. Chill overnight
12. Form cheese mixture into walnut-sized balls and dust with a little flour
13. Chill until firm , about 1 hour
14. Beat the remaining egg
15. Now squish the cheese balls slightly , until about 3 / 4-inch thick , and dip into the egg and then into the bread crumbs , to coat thoroughly
16. Heat oil in a large , heavy-bottomed skillet over medium heat
17. Fry the cheese rounds in batches just until brown , about 1 minute per side
18. Drain on paper towels , and serve warm

title: beef burgundy stew
steps:
1. Trim fat from steak
2. Cut steak into 1 inch cubes
3. Combine all ingredients into a large crockpot
4. Cover and cook on low for 8-10 hours

title: chicken and dressing
steps:
1. Cook chicken until tender and cut into bite-size pieces
2. Mix together celery through mayonnaise
3. Place chicken in bottom of 9"x13" baking dish
4. Salt and pepper to taste
5. Spread mayonnaise mixture over chicken
6. Melt margarine and mix into stuffing mix
7. Spread on top of casserole and sprinkle with paprika
8. Cover and bake for 30 minutes at 350-degrees f
9. Uncover and bake 15 minutes longer

title: nanny s famous cheese dip
steps:
1. Cook the sausage in a skillet until done and drain on paper towels
2. In your large crock pot , empty the 2 cans of rotel ,
3. Break the cheese into chunks and add it
4. Add the garlic and sausage
5. Heat it on high until the cheese melts , stirring often
6. Turn the crock pot to the warm setting for serving
7. Ladle this dip over a plate of tortilla chips and enjoy !
8. Feel free to use hot sausage if you like your dip spicy
9. I'm totally guessing on how many servings there are
10. Usually people get so many helpings , the crock-pot is licked clean in no time !

title: langley blackberry muffins
steps:
1. Soak oats in buttermilk for 10 minutes
2. Grease 12 muffin cups
3. Preheat oven to 375f
4. Measure flour , baking powder , baking soda , salt and sugar into large bowl making well in centre
5. Whisk egg , then stir in butter and extract
6. Combine egg mixture with oat mixture before adding into flour mixture
7. Mix gently until almost combined
8. Add frozen berries to batter
9. Do not over mix
10. Bake for 25-30 minutes until cake tester comes out clean
11. Remove pan from oven and let it sit for about 5 minutes before inverting the muffins onto a cake rack

title: spinach beef spaghetti pie
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to package directions
2. Drain
3. Add eggs and parmesan cheese
4. Press onto the bottom and up the sides of a greased 9-inch deep dish pie plate
5. Bake at 350 degrees for 10 minutes
6. Meanwhile , in a skillet , cook the beef , onion and green pepper over medium heat until meat is no longer pink
7. Drain
8. Stir in spaghetti sauce and seasonings
9. Bring to a boil
10. Reduce heat
11. Cover and simmer for 10 minutes
12. Between two pieces of waxed paper , roll out cream cheese into a 7 inch circle
13. Place in the crust
14. Top with spinach and meat sauce
15. Sprinkle with mozzarella cheese
16. Bake at 350 degrees for 20-30 minutes or until set

title: reiko s won tons
steps:
1. Mix the first 6 ingredients in bowl
2. Then use a heaping teaspoon of mixture and place in the middle of a won ton wrap
3. Fold at opposite ends to the middle and place a drop of water to stick in place
4. It will be in the shape of a square
5. You can then flatten it a bit
6. Continue until all the mixture is gone
7. Heat oil in a frying pan and fry for 2 minutes on each side
8. Drain on paper towels
9. Put some soy sauce in a small bowl and dip won ton in it
10. Serve with hot steamed rice or fried rice

title: sauteed spinach  mushrooms and pancetta
steps:
1. Heat oil in pan
2. Add pancetta , onion , red pepper flakes and garlic , saute until tender , 5 minutes
3. Add mushrooms , saute 5-7 mintes more
4. Add spinach , saute until soft and add nutmeg and pepper to taste , stir in , remove from heat
5. Season to taste and serve

title: orange drizzled strawberries
steps:
1. Rinse the strawberries and remove the hulls
2. Cut into halve or quarters
3. In a large bowl , toss the berries with 1 tbsp of the sugar and the cointreau or other orange liqueur
4. Cover and transfer to the refrigerator to chill , at least 1 hour , or up to 4 hours , stirring from time to time
5. In a medium saucepan , combine the orange juice , 1 / 2 cup sugar , and the orange or lemon zest
6. Bring to a boil over high heat
7. Reduce the heat to medium-high and simmer until thick , syrupy , and liquid reduced to 1 / 2 cup- about 20 minutes
8. Set a small bowl inside a larger bowl filled with half-ice and half cold water
9. Strain the reduced orange juice into the small bowl and stir until chilled
10. Spoon the strawberries into dessert dishes and drizzle liberally with the orange syrup
11. Sprinkle with pistachios and serve

title: kitchen princess rainbow jelly
steps:
1. In a small pot , add 1 cup juice over low heat
2. When it warms up , add the granulated sugar and stir
3. When the sugar melts , stop the heat
4. Make sure you dont let the mix boil !
5. Put gelatin in the pot and stir it until it is completely melted
6. When you stir it , white foam will form , so remove it with a ladle
7. The jelly becomes smoother with this step
8. Put the pot from step 3 in a bowl filled with ice to cool
9. When the mix is cool , pour it into eight glasses
10. Put the glasses in the refrigerator and leave them for about an hour , when the jelly hardens , you repeat the steps and add the different juices one at a time in the glass

title: thai chicken noodle salad  gluten free
steps:
1. Place noodles in a large heat-proof bowl
2. Bring 5 cups of water to a boil and pour water over the noodles
3. Make sure noodles are fully submerged
4. Let stand , stirring occasionally , until noodles become tender , 20 to 25 minutes
5. Drain well and place noodles back in the bowl
6. While noodles are standing , stir together rice vinegar , soy sauce , fish sauce , sesame oil , honey or sugar , hot sauce , garlic and ginger in a small bowl
7. After noodles have been drained , add this dressing to noodles and toss to coat
8. Add chicken , carrots , red pepper , cucumber , bean sprouts and green onions to noodles , tossing to combine
9. Divide noodles among serving plates and garnish with cilantro or basil and sesame seeds
10. Serve with lime wedges on the side

title: diet pumpkin pie
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , mix together the pumpkin , milk and instant pudding mix
2. Stir in the pumpkin pie spice , and fold in half of the whipped topping
3. Pour into an 8 inch pie plate , and spread remaining whipped topping over the top
4. Chill for 1 hour , or until set

title: fast chicken parmesan
steps:
1. Mix together vegetable oil and lemon juice in small bowl
2. Mix cheese , biscuit mix , and pepper in a shallow small bowl
3. Dip chicken into oil mixture , then coat with cheese mixture
4. Heat margarine in large skillet over medium heat until hot
5. Saute chicken until golden and done
6. Serve with a squeeze of lemon , spaghetti sauce , or parmesan cheese

title: toasted pumpkin seeds
steps:
1. Rinse pumpkin seeds
2. Boil water
3. Add salt
4. Pour seeds into boiling water
5. Boil until seeds are soft
6. Drain the broiled seeds ion a colander , and pat seeds dry
7. Put in a bpwl with olive oil , salt , and the rosemary
8. Mix lightly
9. Preheat your oven to 350 degrees
10. Spread the seeds on a large cookie sheet covered with aluminum foil
11. Make a single layer of seeds
12. Put seeds in oven 20-30 minutes
13. If the seeds turn brown , you are overcooking them
14. They should look white and dry
15. You do not need to turn theb seeds
16. When finished , use a spatula to slide the seeds off the foil and into a bowl
17. Allow to cool before little hands touch them

title: taco potato shells
steps:
1. Scrub and pierce potatoes
2. Bake at 375f for 1 hour or until tender
3. Cut potatoes in half lengthwise
4. Carefully scoop out pulp , leaving a thin shell brush inside and outside of potato shells with butter
5. Place cut side up on an ungreased baking sheet
6. Bake , uncovered , at 375f for 20 minutes
7. Meanwhile in a skillet , cook beef over medium heat until no longer pink
8. Drain
9. Add tomatoes and taco seasoning
10. Bring to a boil
11. Reduce heat
12. Simmer , uncovered for 20 minutes
13. Spoon into potato shells
14. Sprinkle with cheese
15. Bake , uncovered , 5- 10 minutes longer or until cheese is melted
16. Top with sour cream and onions

title: tomato papaya salsa
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl
2. Stir well
3. Serve at room temperature

title: hawaiian sweet bread for the bread machine
steps:
1. Measure ingredients into the bread machine in the order suggested by the manufacturer
2. I use the order listed in the recipe
3. Set the machine for medium crust , and press start
4. Makes 1 2 1 / 2 pound loaf
5. Ilike to use the bread machine just to do the dough
6. Then i take the dough out and form a round loaf , let rise , then bake in the oven at 400 degrees

title: irish rutabagas swedes or yellow turnips  with caramelized onion
steps:
1. Heat olive oil in a heavy skillet add the onions , cook over low heat for approximately 45 minutes or until they are golden and caramelized
2. Meanwhile boil the rutabagas in salted water , cook until soft , drain and mash well then beat in the butter
3. Stir in the caramelized onions , taste and adjust seasoning
4. Serve piping hot

title: chicken sausage farfalle
steps:
1. Slice and fry sausage in the listed spices , as much as you like
2. Cook noodles until el dente
3. Fry onions and garlic , with some of the above spices in olive oil until onions are just translucent
4. Turn off onions and gently mix in tomatoes
5. You do not want to cook the tomatoes
6. Mix together the sausage , onion mixture , cheese , basil , cream and noodles
7. Cook gently over med high heat
8. You may not want to add all the cream at once
9. Cook for a little and then adjust the amount of cream to your liking
10. Adjust the spices and add more as you need it
11. Serve and enjoy

title: chipotle pork burritos
steps:
1. In large skillet , heat half of the oil over medium heat
2. Fry pork , breaking up with fork , until no longer pink , about 8 minutes
3. Drain off fat
4. Remove pork and set aside
5. In same skillet , heat remaining oil
6. Fry onion , garlic , cumin , ground coriander , salt and pepper , stirring occasionally , until onion is softened , about 5 minutes
7. Return pork to pan
8. Add salsa and chipotle peppers
9. Simmer , stirring , until thickened and saucy , about 3 minutes
10. Stir in fresh coriander
11. Spoon one-quarter of the pork mixture onto centre of each tortilla
12. Sprinkle evenly with cheese , green pepper and tomato
13. Fold bottom edge over filling , then sides
14. Roll up
15. Bake on rimmed baking sheet in 400f oven , turning once , until golden , about 7 minutes

title: cheeseburger tacos
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees
2. Line each tack shell with 1 slice of cheese
3. Arrange taco shells on an ungreased cookie sheet
4. Bake 5 to 7 minutes or until cheese is melted
5. Meanwhile , in a 8 inch skillet , cook beef over medium high heat until done
6. Drain well and return to skillet
7. Stir in cheese dip and cook until heated through
8. To serve: spoon about 2 tablespoons beef mixture into each taco shell
9. Top each with lettuce and tomato
10. Serve with salsa
11. Don't forget the pickles for those diehard cheeseburger fans !

title: tangy onion relish
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in a 3-quart , non-aluminium saucepan over medium heat
2. Heat to boiling
3. Reduce heat to low and simmer uncovered 20 minutes , stirring occasionally
4. Spoon relish into bowl
5. Cover and refrigerate about 3 hours
6. Store unused relish in covered container in refrigerator for up to 2 weeks

title: 4 cheese cheesecake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Thoroughly butter the bottom and sides of a 9x3-inch springform pan
3. Dust pan well with fine zwieback crumbs , pressing any remaining crumbs into the bottom of the pan and about 1 / 2 to 1 inch up the sides
4. Set aside
5. Sift flour and corn starch together into a small bowl or cup , and set aside
6. In a small bowl , beat eggs and sugar together until thick and sugar is dissolved , set side
7. Mix together ricotta and baker's cheese , place into a fine sieve and using a wooden spoon , force the cheeses through the sieve into a large bowl
8. With mixer on medium speed , beat cheeses for about 2 minutes or until creamy
9. Add cream cheese , and beat on low speed for about 1 minute , or until well blended
10. Add mascarpone , and beat by hand with a wooden spoon or spatula until well blended
11. Add melted butter , mixing by hand until well blended
12. Add egg / sugar mixture , mixing by hand until well blended
13. Add flour / corn starch mixture , stirring until thoroughly incorporated
14. Add lemon juice and vanilla , stir until well blended
15. Fold sour cream into cheesecake batter
16. Tap bowl of batter on counter several times to get any bubbles in the batter to the top
17. If necessary , run the spatula through the batter to break up any air bubbles
18. Slowly pour the batter into prepared pan , lightly tap pan on counter to remove any remaining bubbles
19. Place cheesecake on middle rack in oven and bake at 350f for 50 to 60 minutes
20. Turn off oven , and let cheesecake sit undisturbed , 60 minutes longer
21. Remove from oven and continue to cool on wire rack
22. When completely cooled , cover and refrigerate for at least 2 hours before serving
23. When ready to serve , run a thin bladed knife or icing spatula between the cake and sides of pan to loosen cake from the sides
24. Remove the side of the springform pan , leaving the cake on the pan base / bottom to serve
25. Cake may be topped with fresh fruit , pie filling or your favorite fruit glaze

title: egg free french toast
steps:
1. Preheat griddle to just above medium heat
2. In a medium bowl , combine all ingredients except bread and butter
3. Mix until the cornstach is disolved
4. Transfer mixture to a shallow bowl or pan
5. Dip both sides of each bread slice into the mixture
6. Melt butter on the griddle or skillet
7. Place bread on heated surface and cook each side to a light golden brown
8. Serve immediately

title: gougeres french cheese puffs
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425
2. Add butter , salt , pepper and nutmeg to 1 cup water in a medium saucepan and bring to a boil over medium-high heat
3. When butter melts , reduce the heat to low
4. Add flour to saucepan all at once and beat with a wooden spoon over low heat for about a minute until mixture pulls away from sides of the pan
5. Remove pan from heat
6. Add cheese to pan and beat with wooden spoon until thoroughly mixed
7. Add 4 eggs , one at a time , beating each into the batter until well mixed before adding the next
8. Continue beating mixture until it is smooth , shiny and firm
9. Drop batter in small spoonfuls onto a lightly greased baking sheet
10. Beat remaining egg with 1 / 2 tbsp water , then brush tops of uncooked gougeres with egg wash
11. Bake in upper third of the over for 15-20 minutes or until golden and doubled in size
12. Remove from oven serve hot or can be served at room temperature

title: coconut crunch pudding parfaits
steps:
1. Coconut crunch: combine flour and brown sugar in medium bowl
2. Cut in margarine until crumbly
3. Add coconut
4. Rub mixture until no lumps of margarine remain
5. Turn into ungreased 9x9 pan
6. Bake at 400f for about 20 minutes , stirring with fork every 5 minutes , until golden
7. Stir to break up large clumps
8. Cool
9. Makes 1 1 / 3 cups crunch
10. Coconut custard: microwave milk in glass bowl for 3 minutes , or until very hot but not boiling
11. Combine flour , cornstarch , sugar and salt in small bowl
12. Gradually stir in half-and-half until smooth
13. Slowly stir into milk
14. Microwave until boiling and thickened stirring at least every minute
15. Combine some of milk mixture with egg yolks
16. Mix well
17. Stir into milk mixture
18. Cook 1-2 minutes more until thickened
19. Stir in margarine , coconut and flavouring
20. Cover with plastic wrap directly on surface to prevent skin forming
21. Cool
22. Makes 2 1 / 3 cups custard
23. Layer custard and crunch several times in parfait glasses , ending with crunch

title: cioppino  seafood stew
steps:
1. Saute the onion , green pepper and garlic in olive oil in large pot
2. Add the tomatos , tomato paste , wine , lemon , one half cup or the parsley and all the seasonings
3. Bring to boil and simmer 20 minutes
4. Add the fish , lobsters and shrimp and simmer , covered 15 minutes
5. Add clams and mussels and simmer another 10 minutes more or until the clams and mussels open
6. Sprinkle remaining parsley on top
7. Serve in soup plates from the pot it was cooked in
8. A nice touch is a piece of garlic bread in each soup plate as a blotter
9. Have plenty more bread to pass

title: best fish batter
steps:
1. Using a fork , mix the melted butter through the flour and salt
2. Add the soda water or beer and mix
3. Don't worry about the lumps of butter
4. They disappear while frying and make the crispy batter bubbly
5. To make aussie potato cakes , take a large potato and cut into thin , large slices
6. Coat with flour and then dip into the batter before frying

title: baked flounder    very easy
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees& spray large baking dish with cooking spray
2. Rub the fillets on both sides with lemon juice , then salt and pepper them to taste
3. Place the fillets in the baking dish& completely dab with butter
4. Then sprinkle evenly with chopped scallions& tarragon
5. Bake for about 5 to 15 minutes until fish is done but not over cooked
6. Sprinkle with parsley

title: chilled fruit and champagne soup
steps:
1. You need some plain , flat white soup or pasta bowls for this to work well
2. Place a 440g can of red fruit and a 440g can of orange fruit in the fridge overnight
3. Process each can separately
4. Puree the fruit and the juice or syrup in a blender , use enough of the syrup or juice to puree the fruit easily , this will be between about half to all of it
5. Then pass through a sieve to a 1litre jug
6. Rinse the blender and sieve before doing the second can of fruit and putting it in a different jug
7. Cover each jug with plastic wrap and put in the fridge until just before serving
8. Add the champagne to each jug so they are have increased by half again once you have stirred the fruit and champagne together and the foam has been mixed inches this will only use about half of the bottle
9. Hold a jug in each hand and pour both fruit mixes into a chilled bowl at the same time from opposite sides of the bowl
10. They should meet in the middle
11. Use a toothpick to make a small swirling pattern where the two colours meet
12. If you have a helper in the kitchen to pour a third jug , you could add a third can of white fruit
13. This is a very simple dish and once you have made it a couple of times you will feel able to experiment quite happily but remember to use cans of fruit rather than fresh as it saves a lot of hassle cooking the fruit and there is consistency in the amount of fruit in each can
14. Beware that the combination of fruit and alcohol can affect people more noticeably that they would expect

title: lentil stew over couscous
steps:
1. Combine lentils , water , tomatoes , broth , celery , onion , bell pepper , carrot , garlic , marjoram and black pepper in the crockpot
2. Stir
3. Cover and cook on low for 8 to 9 hours
4. Add vinegar and olive oil , stir , serve over couscous
5. Garnish with carrot curls and celery leaves

title: grilled stuffed grape leaves with goat cheese and black pepper
steps:
1. Spread 12 grape leaves on the countertop
2. In a mixing bowl , blend the goat cheese and black pepper until homogeneous
3. Place a generous tablespoon of goat cheese in the center of each leaf
4. Fold in the sides of each leaf , then roll up burrito fashion and tie with kitchen string
5. Drizzle 1 teaspoon olive oil over each and refrigerate for one hour
6. Preheat the grill
7. Place the chilled packets over the medium hot part of the grill
8. Cook until the leaves are just starting to char all over , 1 to 2 minutes per side
9. Place 3 packets on each plate and drizzle with a teaspoon of balsamic vinegar and a dusting of fresh thyme
10. Serve immediately

title: chicken in a garden
steps:
1. Place chicken breast on large square of tin foil
2. Place onion on top of chicken
3. Place vegetables on top of onion slice
4. Pour on kitchen bouquet
5. Sprinkle with parsley , salt , and pepper
6. Seal tin foil around chicken and vegetables
7. Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes , add about 15 minutes if the chicken is frozen

title: strawberry angel fluff
steps:
1. Tear the cake into walnut-size pieces and scatter over bottom of 10" x 13" sheet cake pan
2. Dissolve jello in 2 cups of boiling water and then 2 cups cold water
3. Allow to jell a little
4. Fold in the frozen strawberries and whipped topping which has thawed a little
5. Pour over cake and refrigerate until set
6. Decorate with whipped cream or additional whipped topping and fresh strawberries

title: quick naan  bread machine
steps:
1. If the yogurt is cold , heat it for 15 seconds in the microwave
2. Add ingredients to your bread machine according to the manufacturer's directions
3. After 5 minutes , check your dough
4. After another 5 minutes take the dough out and divide into 8 pieces
5. Turn each piece in flour , cover , and allow to rest on a tray for 20 minutes
6. Meanwhile , heat your oven to 500f
7. If you have a pizza stone , allow it to heat in the oven , otherwise , put heat-resistent metal cooling racks in the oven
8. Baking sheets do not work very well
9. With your fingers , flatten each piece of dough into a tear-drop shape , 1 / 2 inch thick
10. Moisten hands , then turn naan briefly in your hands to moisten it , and place it on the stone / rack
11. Bake for about 4 minutes
12. Brown tops using the broiler
13. Wrap naan in a towel while you make the rest
14. It shouldn't stick to the pan at all
15. If it isn't sticky enough , add 1 t water
16. If it sticks to the pan , add 1 t flour , till you reach the correct consistency

title: fruit topped cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f grease a 9-inch round pan
2. Sift flour , baking powder and salt into a small bowl
3. In a medium saucepan , melt 6 tablespoons butter over low heat
4. Stir in 6 tablespoons sugar and let cool 10 minutes
5. Add egg to butter / sugar mix , stir well
6. Stir in flour mix , spread dough in pan with the back of a spoon
7. Arrange fruit slices in a circle filling in to the center , press lightly into the dough
8. Drizzle fruit with lemon juice and sprinkle with remaining 4 tablespoons sugar
9. Sprinkle with cinnamon and dot with remaining 2 tablespoons butter
10. Bake 25 to 30 minutes , or until fork inserted in center comes out clean
11. Cool on a wire rack and serve warm or at room temperature

title: ginger banana nut muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. In a large bowl , combine oil , brown sugar , bananas , eggs , buttermilk and vanilla
3. In a medium bowl , combine flour , baking soda , salt , baking powder , pecans , candied ginger , nutmeg , powdered ginger , and cinnamon
4. Add flour mixture to banana mixture
5. Mix well
6. Divide batter among greased or paper-lined muffin cups
7. Bake for 20-25 minutes

title: shrimp lo mein
steps:
1. Boil lo mein noodles for 3 minutes then drain and rinse in cold water
2. Place in a bowl , toss with 2 tbsp of sesame oil and refrigerate until well-chilled , about 30 minutes
3. Peel and devein shrimp , if necessary
4. Mix together 1 tsp rice wine , 1 / 2 tsp salt , egg white , and cornstarch and pour over shrimp , and marinate 15-20 minutes
5. In a small bowl , mix together 2 cups water , 3 tbsp soy sauce , 3 tbsp rice wine 1 1 / 2 tbsp cornstarch , 1 tsp sugar , and the 1 / 2 tsp salt
6. Set aside as your seasoning sauce
7. Heat 1 tbsp peanut oil and 1 tbsp sesame oil in wok and add ginger slices
8. Cook until fragrant , then add shrimp and stir-fry until just pink , about 2-4 minutes
9. Add green onions , bean sprouts , celery , bamboo shoots , and shredded carrot and stir-fry another minute
10. Place chilled noodles into the wok and cook , stirring , until the noodles are hot , 2-3 minutes
11. Add the seasoning sauce and cook until hot and lightly thickened , about half a minute
12. Serve hot

title: fudge jumbles
steps:
1. Mix butter , sugar , brown sugar , eggs , baking soda , flour and oatmeal
2. Press 2 / 3 of batter into bottom of 9 x13 pan and set remaining batter aside
3. Melt chocolate chips , sweetened condensed milk and butter in a saucepan
4. Pour over the top of batter and sprinkle remaining batter over the top
5. Bake 350f for 18-20 minutes
6. It will still look soft until the "fudge" cools

title: southern jambalaya
steps:
1. Cook the onions , bell pepper , celery , and garlic in two tbsp of the oil in a dutch oven , about 3-4 minutes
2. Add shrimp and cook until shrimp are pink , about 5 minutes
3. Remove shrimp mixture and reserve
4. Add last tbsp oil to the pan along with the rice and cook over med-high heat about ten minutes , until the rice is a light brown , stirring frequently to prevent scorching
5. Stir in the broth , tomatoes , salt , pepper , thyme , tabasco , and the bay leaf
6. Heat mixture to a boil then cover , reduce hear and simmer , about 15-20 minutes or until rice is tender
7. Stir in the reserved shrimp and also the ham
8. Cover and cook until heated through
9. Remove bay leaf , and serve

title: creamy parmesan brussels sprouts
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Lightly coat baking dish with non-stick spray
3. In large skillet , cook onions and garlic in butter over medium heat until onions are soft
4. Stir in brussels sprouts and thyme
5. Cook for 5 minutes or until onions begin to brown
6. Add broth and bring to a boil
7. Cook 7-8 minutes , stirring occasionally until broth is nearly evaporated
8. Add cream and nutmeg
9. Cook for 4 minutes or until broth begins to thicken
10. Transfer to baking dish , stir in 1 / 2 cheese , salt and pepper
11. Sprinkle with remaining cheese
12. Bake , uncovered , 20-25 minutes

title: tutti frutti muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Grease 12 muffin tins or line with paper liners
3. In a large bowl , whisk together oat bran , white flour , whole-wheat flour , salt , baking soda , ground cinnamon , splenda and sugar
4. In a medium bowl , stir together bananas , pineapple , strawberries , eggs , vanilla , applesauce and oil
5. Stir fruit mixture into flour mixture
6. Streusel: in a small bowl , stir together flour , brown sugar and cinnamon
7. Cut butter into flour mixture
8. Stir in pecans
9. Put a mounded tablespoon of batter into each muffin tin
10. Put 1 teaspoon of raspberry preserves over the center of the batter in each muffin tin
11. Use remaining batter to nearly fill muffin tins
12. Sprinkle streusel over the top of batter
13. Bake for 30-40 minutes until toothpick tests clean
14. Let sit for 5 minutes and turn out of tins
15. Optional glaze: stir together powdered sugar , blood orange juice and zest
16. Once muffins are room temperature , drizzle glaze over them
17. Good with whipped cream too !

title: besciamella sauce
steps:
1. Heat butter in a medium saucepan until melted
2. Add flour , stirring until smooth
3. Cook gently over medium heat until light golden brown , 6-7 minutes
4. Meanwhile , heat the milk in a separate pan until almost boiling
5. Add milk to the butter mixture 1 cup at a time , whisking continuously until very smooth
6. If lumps begin to form , you need to adjust the heat up a bit higher
7. Bring to a boil , and cook for 30 seconds , continuing to stir
8. Remove from the heat and season with salt and nutmeg
9. I continued to cook it over high heat , stirring constantly , until it thickened down , and began to coat the back of the spoon

title: low fat double chocolate chip cookies
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375
2. In large bowl , combine brown sugar and margarine until light and fluffy
3. Add vanilla and egg white
4. Blend well
5. Add dry ingredients
6. Mix well
7. Mix in chips
8. Drop by teaspoonfuls 2-inches apart onto ungreased cookie sheets
9. Bake for 8-9 minutes
10. Cool 1 minute before removing from cookie sheet

title: healthy apple crisp
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Dice your apples and put them in the bottom of an 8x8-inch baking pan
3. Mix the remaining ingredients , except for the honey and cooking spray
4. I start with a spoon and then use my fingers to get that butter mixed in thoroughly
5. Spread the above mixture on top of the apples
6. Spray with cooking spray and drizzle with honey
7. Bake at 375f for 35 minutes

title: original n y  buffalo wings
steps:
1. If you don't have the good season dressing packet you can substitute this seasoning mixture using some or all of these items and use one teaspoon and save the rest:
2. 1 tsp oregano
3. 1 / 2 tsp basil
4. 1 / 4 tsp thyme
5. 1 tsp garlic powder
6. 1 tsp onion powder
7. 1 / 2 tsp celery salt
8. If making seasoning mix , add some to the flour with salt and pepper
9. Cover wings in flour
10. Fry in hot oil
11. Let drain on wire rack
12. Melt butter in pan but do not allow to boil
13. Add redhot sauce , lemon juice and dressing mix or seasoning mix and stir
14. Heat but again do not boil
15. Add wings to a large bowl or bag for coating wings
16. Add sauce and shake or
17. Stir to coat well
18. Remove wings and serve with celery and blue cheese or
19. Ranch dressing

title: asian steak salad
steps:
1. Preheat grill to medium high
2. Sprinkle steaks with just salt and pepper
3. Combine cabbages , 2 t
4. Of the lime juice and 1 t
5. Of the hoisin sauce
6. Toss well and set aside
7. Grill steaks to personal preference
8. When done cut crosswise into this slices
9. Combine the remaining ingredients with the slightly marinated cabbage and toss well
10. Arrange salad on four plates and divide the meat equally between them

title: lobster thermidor
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 425f if you have whole claws , remove the meat whole and reserve for garnishing
2. Cut the lobster meat into 1 / 2 inch dice and set aside
3. In a saucepan over medium heat , melt 4 tablespoons of butter
4. Add the green onions and saut until the white part is translucent , about 3 minutes
5. Stir in the diced lobster and saut until heated through , about 3 minutes
6. Add the brandy , bring to a simmer , and cook for 1 minute
7. Stir in the thyme and salt and pepper to taste
8. Remove from the heat and set aside
9. In a frying pan over medium heat , melt 1 tablespoon of the butter
10. Add the mushrooms and saut until golden , about 5 minutes
11. Stir in 1 tablespoon of the lemon juice
12. Remove from heat and set aside
13. In a saucepan over medium heat , melt the remaining 4 tablespoons of butter
14. Stir in the flour to make a roux and cook , stirring constantly , for 2-3 minutes
15. Do not let the mixture color
16. Gradually whisk in the stock
17. Cook , stirring frequently , until thickened , about 10 minutes
18. Stir in the half-and-half and cook , stirring frequently , for 5 minutes longer
19. Stir in the paprika , salt to taste , tabasco sauce to taste , and the remaining 1 / 2 tablespoon of lemon juice , or more to taste
20. Taste and adjust seasoning
21. Stir the lobster mixture and mushrooms into the white sauce
22. Spoon the lobster mixture into 4 individual gratin dishes
23. Sprinkle each with one-fourth of the parmesan
24. Place the dishes on a baking sheet and bake until bubbling and lightly browned , about 20 minutes
25. Serve at once , garnished with the claw meat , if available

title: peppery citrus olives
steps:
1. Drain olives and place them in a glass or other nonreactive container
2. With a wooden mallet or back of a wooden spoon , hit peppercorns just enough to bruise or barely crack them
3. Add to olives
4. Cut lemon into about 12 or 15 pieces and remove seeds
5. Add lemon to olives
6. Rub thyme sprigs between your hands over olives , dropping some of leaves
7. Add sprigs and olive oil
8. Turn to coat
9. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 1-3 days before serving

title: a very interesting smoked salmon sandwich
steps:
1. Spread both slices of bread with the cream cheese , scatter each slice with red onion then lay smoked salmon on top and drizzle with mango chutney
2. Top this with the crispy bacon and capers
3. Finish with a scattering of snipped chives and season well

title: spicy autumn pie
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine apples , zucchini , carrots , and nuts with flour
2. Toss to coat
3. In medium bowl , beat brown sugar and butter until well blended
4. Mix spices , salt , vanilla , lemon juice , orange peel , and eggs together
5. Add to apple mixture , mix well
6. Spoon into pie crust-lined pan
7. Bake at 425 degrees for 45 to 50 minutes
8. Serve warm with whipped cream

title: beaten biscuits
steps:
1. Sift dry ingredients together , blend in shortening and just enough milk to make a very stiff dough
2. Knead on a floured board until dough becomes soft and pliable
3. Run dough through a meat grinder or a food processor using a coarse knife or beat steadily with a wooden potato masher for 30 minutes , or until dough blisters , keeping edges turned into the center
4. Roll to 1 / 2" thickness , cut with a biscuit cutter , prick with a fork and bake at 350f for 30 minutes or until golden-ivory in color

title: cheesy tuna and rice dish
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Melt butter in medium saucepan
3. Add onion
4. Cook for 5 minutes
5. Blend in flour , salt and ground black pepper
6. Stir in evaporated milk
7. Cook over medium heat , stirring constantly , until mixture comes just to a boil
8. Stir in cheddar cheese and parmesan cheese until melted
9. Combine rice , parsley , paprika , oregano , cayenne pepper , and tomatoes in 11 x 7-inch baking dish
10. Top with tuna
11. Spread cheese sauce over tuna
12. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until edges are bubbly

title: quinoa tomato salad
steps:
1. Cook the quinoa in the vegetable stock for 10-15 minutes or until quinoa is tender
2. I found that sometimes the quinoa absorbs all the liquid and sometimes not , seems to depend on the quinoa
3. Pour the cooked quinoa into a sieve and let cool to room temperature
4. Chop onion , sprinkle with salt and add red wine vinegar
5. Let stand until quinoa has cooled to room temperature
6. Add olive oil to the onion and vinegar , then add quinoa
7. Chop tomatoes and add to the quinoa
8. Add pepper to taste , mix well and serve either at room temperature or chilled

title: arroz con pollo 1 dish meal
steps:
1. In a large skillet , heat oil over medium heat then add mushrooms , onion , and garlic
2. Let cook for 2 minutes or so
3. Season chicken with salt , pepper , cumin , and cayenne- add to skillet , cook until chicken is brown on all sides
4. Add salsa and rice stir frequently while the chicken continues to cook
5. Add chicken broth a little bit at a time , like you're making risotto
6. When chicken is cooked through and the surrounding rice is creamy , turn off heat and stir in cheese
7. Top with some chopped cilantro or parsley for a pop of color

title: spinach and ricotta calzone
steps:
1. Dough
2. In a small mixing bowl , whisk together yeast , warm water , sugar and olive oil
3. Let sit for about 3 minutes to fully dissolve and activate the yeast
4. In a large mixing bowl , whisk together flour and salt
5. With a rubber spatula , gradually mix the yeast mixture into the flour until just combined and dough barely holds together
6. Turn the dough out onto a clean counter surface dusted with flour
7. Knead the dough with flour-dusted hands until the dough has become smooth and elastic , about 10 minutes
8. The surface should be tight and silky and bounce back slightly when pressed
9. Lightly grease a large mixing bowl with olive oil and place the dough in it
10. Cover the bowl tightly with plastic wrap and set in a warm place to rise until doubled in size , 1 to 2 hours
11. Once doubled , punch the dough down and divide it into 2 equal pieces
12. Knead each 1 slightly to form a uniform ball
13. Set aside and cover them with a kitchen towel or plastic wrap to rest for 30 minutes
14. Cook's
15. Keep covered tightly in plastic wrap or in a sealed food storage bag
16. Yield: 2 dough balls
17. Preheat oven to 450 degrees f
18. Lightly dust the work surface and rolling pin with flour
19. Roll the dough out into an 8 by 11-inch oval
20. In a medium bowl , mix the spinach , ricotta , and mozzarella and season with salt and pepper , to taste
21. Place all the filling on 1 half of the dough leaving a 3 / 4-inch border along the edge
22. Fold the remaining dough over the filling until the edges line up and pinch the edges together to seal
23. Gently roll the pinched edges under to form a decorative rim
24. Place the calzone on a baking sheet dusted with cornmeal and brush the top with olive oil
25. Bake until golden brown and the center is hot and melted , 25 minutes , rotating midway through cooking

title: pioneer woman s migas
steps:
1. In a bowl , whisk together eggs and half & half
2. Salt and pepper eggs , then set aside
3. Cut up tortillas into strips then dice
4. In a small skillet over medium heat , heat oil and fry until crisp
5. Remove to a paper towel-lined plate to drain
6. In a large skillet over medium-high heat , melt butter
7. Add onions and bell peppers and cook until starting to turn brown / black , about 3 to 4 minutes
8. Add in diced jalapenos and stir to combine
9. Reduce heat to low
10. When the heat has decreased , pour egg mixture into skillet
11. Stir gently to cook with the peppers , folding mixture very gently as it cooks
12. Add tomatoes and cilantro and heat through
13. Top with grated cheese at serving

title: banana protein smoothie shake  ibs safe
steps:
1. Blend all in blender or magic bullet until smooth
2. Enjoy !

title: sun dried tomato and garlic bread  abm
steps:
1. Add all the ingredients except the tomatoes , onion and garlic to the machine in the order recommended by the manufacturer
2. Select the basic white bread cycle , and start machine
3. When the"additions" beeper sounds , add the remaining three ingredients

title: pineapple pork ribs for 2
steps:
1. Place ribs meaty side up on rack in foil-lines shallow roasting pan
2. Mix remaining ingredients
3. Pour about 1 / 3 cup sauce on ribs
4. Bake uncovered in 350 degree oven until done , 1-1 / 2 to 2 hours , basting 3 or 4 times with remaining sauce

title: sausage rolls or party scrolls
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 210 degrees celcius
2. Except for pastry , sesame seeds , egg and milk , mix all other ingredients well in a bowl
3. Mix egg and milk in a bowl and set aside
4. Place mince mix along the length of the pastry aprroximately an inch thick and roll into a long sausage roll
5. Seal opposite long edge with egg mix
6. Cut to preferred size - 2cm for scrolls , 6cm for party sausage rolls and half or thirds for regular sausage rolls , these are all approximate measurements , it depends on the length of the pastry
7. For sausage rolls , paint the top of the pastry with the egg mix and sprinkle with sesame seeds
8. For scrolls , paint one side with egg mix and sprinkle with sesame seeds
9. Can be frozen at this stage for later use
10. Thaw prior to baking
11. Place on a tray with grease proof paper and bake for 35-45 minutes

title: chicken salad with zucchini  lemon and pine nuts
steps:
1. In a small bowl , cover the currants with hot water and let stand until softened , about 10 minutes
2. Drain
3. In a large nonreactive bowl , combine 2 tablespoons of the olive oil with the garlic , cumin , lemon zest , half of the lemon juice , 1 / 2 teaspoon of salt and 1 / 4 teaspoon of pepper
4. Add the zucchini and currants and toss to coat
5. Let stand at room temperature for 2 hours , stirring occasionally
6. Meanwhile , in a large , shallow glass or ceramic dish , combine the minced shallot with 2 tablespoons of the olive oil and the remaining lemon juice
7. Add the chicken breast halves , turning to coat thoroughly with the marinade
8. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour , turning a few times
9. In a small skillet , toast the pine nuts over moderate heat , tossing a few times , until golden brown , about 2 minutes
10. Transfer to a plate and let cool
11. Remove the chicken breast halves from the marinade , scraping off the shallot
12. Slice the chicken on the bias 1 1 / 2 inches thick and season with salt and pepper
13. In a large skillet , heat the remaining 2 tablespoons of olive oil
14. Add the chicken slices and cook over moderately high heat , turning a few times , until lightly browned and cooked through , about 8 minutes
15. Transfer the chicken to a large , shallow serving bowl and let cool slightly
16. Add the marinated zucchini and currants , toasted pine nuts , arugula and preserved lemon and toss lightly
17. Serve right away

title: george foreman s mustard lemon chicken
steps:
1. Mix 1st five ingredients and marinade chicken in mixture for approx 30 minutes
2. Cook on your pre-heated grill machine or bbq & cook for approx 3 mins each side until cooked

title: patrick s south beach low carb chicken bake
steps:
1. In a medium frying pan , saute chicken breast in olive oil until fully cooked and lightly browned
2. Meanwhile , in a medium bowl , mix together cheese , mayonnaise and cream of chicken soup
3. In a medium casserole dish , layer first the broccoli florets , then the cooked chicken , then give the mixture a good squeeze of lemon juice for flavor
4. Continue layering with the cheese sauce mixture and top with chopped almonds and parsley flakes until fully covered
5. Bake casserole at 350 degrees for 45 minutes
6. Enjoy !

title: creamy roquefort salad dressing
steps:
1. Combine all the ingredients in a medium mixing bowl
2. Beat at medium speed of an electric mixer until blended
3. Serve dressing over salad greens

title: kittencal s holiday cranberry stuffing balls
steps:
1. Remove the sausage from casings , then place the sausage in a skillet
2. Brown over medium heat breaking up the meat into very small pieces while cooking set aside
3. Melt 3 tablespoons butter in the same skillet
4. Add in onion and celery
5. Saut for about 5-6 minutes or until very soft
6. Add in the cooked sausage back to the skillet , then add in the chicken broth
7. Bring just to a simmer , scraping up any browned bits in the bottom of the skillet , then place the sausage / onion mixture into a large bowl
8. Add in the stuffing mixture packet along with the chopped cranberries , parmesan cheese and eggs
9. Mix until well combined
10. Season with lots of black pepper and a little salt
11. Cover and chill the mixture for about 2 hours
12. Using moistened hands form the mixture into small even balls and place the balls into a shallow greased casserole dish
13. If you find that the mixture is too moist and will not hold together well just add in a little dried bread crumbs , if it is too dry add in more broth or water , add in just enough to hold the balls together when shaped
14. Brush or drizzle the balls with melted butter
15. At this point you can cover the balls and refrigerate for up to 24 hours to bake later
16. Set oven to 350f
17. Bake covered loosely with foil or bake uncovered for about 12-15 minutes

title: cajun tilapia
steps:
1. In large skillet , medium heat , melt butter and saute garlic and green onion 5 minute
2. In mixing bowl , coat tilapia in mixture of flour , cajun and creole seaonings
3. Place tilapia in skillet and cook 5-7 min on each side , or until fish is white and flakey

title: upside down vegetable cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425f and butter a nine inch baking pan or casserole dish
2. Sift dry ingredients together
3. Cut in shortening
4. Combine egg and milk
5. Add to dry ingredients , stirring until well mixed
6. Place cooked vegetables in the bottom of the prepared pan , add vegetable stock and dot with butter
7. Spread dough over vegetables and bake for 20 to 25 minutes
8. Turn out onto hot serving plate with vegetables on top and serve
9. Very nice with a hot tomato , cheese or mushroom sauce

title: greek pasta
steps:
1. Cut chicken into chunks and stir fry in olive oil until cooked
2. Add olives , red onion , and green pepper
3. Fry until softened
4. Add spaghetti , dressing , feta cheese and tomato
5. Stir fry until thoroughly heated and well combined
6. Serve hot
7. Serves 4 generously

title: black tea lemonade
steps:
1. Boil 5 cups of water in tea kettle , then transfer boiling water to saucepan
2. Add sugar , mix till disolved
3. Add teabags , and mint , and bring back to boil
4. Take off burner , and let tea bags and mint steep for 7-10 minutes , depending upon how strong you like your tea
5. Discard tea bags and mint
6. Add lemon juice and stir well
7. Add ice cubes , and they will begin melting right away
8. Stir , then pour contents into juice jug - ice cubes don't have to finish melting , they will do so in the jug
9. Chill well
10. If you are in a hurry , serve over several ice cubes in a glass
11. The flavor is quite different when adding the mint , so try it both ways to see which way you prefer it

title: swirled holiday snowball cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Beat butter , sugar , fanilla extract and salt in a large mixer bowl until creamy
3. Gradually beat in flour
4. Stir in morsels and nuts
5. Shape level tablespoons of dough into 1 1 / 4-inch balls
6. Place on ungreased baking sheets
7. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes or until cookies are set and lightly browned
8. Remove from oven
9. Sift powdered sugar over hot cookies on baking sheets
10. Cool on baking sheets for 10 minutes
11. Remove to wire racks to cool completely
12. Sprinkle with additional powdered sugar , if desired
13. Store in airtight containers

title: sausage  bacon breakfast pie
steps:
1. Pie crust:
2. Add flour and salt in bowl
3. Cut in shortening till flour resembles small peas
4. Add water and knead till dough is soft and pliable
5. Cover in plastic and chill in refrigerator for 30 minutes
6. Filling:
7. While crust is chilling cook bacon and sausage
8. Do not drain
9. Whisk eggs in bowel with spices till eggs are fluffy
10. Set aside
11. Putting it all together:
12. Roll out pie crust on floured surface
13. Should be thin 1 / 8 in to 1 / 4 in will do nicely
14. Roll dough up onto your rolling pin and roll out over 9in deep dish pie plate
15. Gently lift up edges and help crust down into the pie plate starting in the center and moving to the outer edges to remove air out from under crust
16. With a fork poke holes in bottom of pie crust
17. Flute edges as desired
18. Whisk an egg yolk and brush over the crust
19. Mix sausage and bacon together and put in pie crust
20. Pour egg and spice mixture into the pie
21. Top with extra sharp cheddar cheese
22. Take the second pie crust and use as a lid on the pie
23. Press edges of both crusts together
24. Using a knife cut vent slices in center of crust in an x pattern
25. Brush lid with rest of whisked yolk
26. Bake at 350 degrees f for 30 min or until crust is golden brown
27. A toothpick inserted in center of pie should come out clean if eggs are done

title: canadian tea
steps:
1. Combine the cranberries , cinnamon , lemon juice , orange juice and sugar in a large saucepan and pour on the rapidly boiling water
2. Stir well and let the mixture steep for 10 minutes
3. Strain and serve hot , or chill and serve cold over ice

title: mexican style tampiquena steak
steps:
1. Mix together the vegetable oil , garlic , lime juice , salt , black pepper and white onion
2. Coat the meat with the onion mixture , cover and marinate in the refrigerator for 24 hours
3. Preheat the oven to 350f
4. Spread the tortillas with enchilada sauce , fill with cheddar cheese and roll up over the cheese
5. Place the filled tortillas in an ovenproof dish
6. Spread with the remaining enchilada sauce and sprinkle over the reserved cheddar
7. Bake in the oven for 5-10 minutes until the cheese has melted
8. Meanwhile , preheat a grill or griddle pan until very hot
9. Cook the steak on the grill or griddle until cooked to taste
10. Serve the freshly grilled steak with the tortillas and guacamole , garnishing with the green chili

title: english sausage rolls
steps:
1. Set oven to 200c or 390f
2. Mix the sausage with the onion
3. Set aside
4. Separate the puff pastry sheets into three sections
5. Flour your hands , rolling pin , and workspace lightly to avoid sticking
6. One section at a time , roll the pastry thin , and set it lengthwise on floured workspace
7. Place the sausage / onion mixture along the middle of the pastry sheet
8. Brush the top and bottom edges of the pastry sheet with egg
9. Bring them together at the top of the sausage and seal them
10. Brush the entire top of the roll with egg
11. Cut the roll into one-inch sections
12. Cut two small vent slits on top of each section
13. Place sections on ungreased baking sheet and bake until the pastry is golden brown

title: italian spiced olives
steps: 1. Combine all ingredients except oil in a clean jar-shake gently , top with olive oil , shake again and store in the fridge for up to 1 month

title: shorbat adas middle eastern lentil soup
steps:
1. Wash and drain lentils
2. In a large pot , combine all ingredients
3. Bring to a boil , then let simmer on medium / low for about 35 minutes
4. Make sure to stir occasionally to avoid the lentils burn or sticking to the pot
5. Serve in with lemon wedges , on side
6. Enjoy !

title: golden cadillac
steps:
1. Put all ingredients in a blender and blend for 10 seconds
2. Strain into cocktail glasses

title: seventh heaven curried sausage rolls
steps:
1. Mix all 1st ingredients
2. Add pepper to taste
3. Roll into two rolls and cover with
4. 1 packet flaky pastry or wrap on filo pastry
5. Cook at 350 degrees for 1 hour

title: super fast and easy pizza dough  crust
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine 2 cups flour , yeast and salt
2. Add any other spices / herbs that you like
3. Stir in the very warm water and oil
4. Mix well
5. Add enough of the remaining flour to make a soft dough
6. Knead on a lightly floured surface until smooth and elastic , about 5 minutes
7. Cover and let rise about 10 minutes
8. Lightly oil one 14" or two 12" round pizza pans
9. Sprinkle with cornmeal
10. Form dough into smooth ball
11. Roll dough to fit the pan
12. Top with your favorite sauce and toppings
13. Bake at 400f for 20 to 30 minutes or until done

title: moroccan salad of raw grated carrots citrus cinnamon dressing
steps:
1. Grate the carrots on the large holes of a box grater
2. Cook carrots for 2 minutes--optional step
3. Toss with only 1 / 4 cup of the dressing ,
4. Garnish with nuts , raisins , and pine nuts if desired , and serve

title: linguine with shrimp  venetian style
steps:
1. Rinse shrimp and pat dry
2. Cut each shrimp into inch pieces
3. Add oil to a skillet large enough to hold all of the cooked pasta
4. Add in garlic , ginger , and crushed red pepper
5. Cook over medium heat until garlic is golden , about 2 minutes
6. Add in shrimp and a big pinch of salt
7. Cook / stir until the shrimp are cooked through , about 2 minutes
8. Add in lemon juice and wine
9. Bring to a simmer
10. Cook 2 minutes
11. Stir in parsley
12. Remove from heat
13. Bring at least 4 quarts water to boil in a big pot
14. Add in 2 tablespoons salt , then the pasta
15. Stir well , gently pushing the pasta down until it is completely covered with water
16. Cook over high heat , stirring often , until the pasta is al dente
17. Drain pasta , reserving some cooking water
18. Add the pasta to the skillet and toss over high heat 1 minute until well mixed
19. Add a little of the cooking water , if needed
20. Remove the ginger
21. Serve immediately

title: chocolate strawberry tofu shake
steps:
1. Blend all the ingredients together in a blender until the ice is fully crushed
2. Garnish with a strawberry and some chocolate shavings

title: vanilla milk tea
steps:
1. Put powdered milk , vanilla bean and sweetener in a teapot
2. Pour 2 tbsp of the boiling water in the teapot and mix well with a spoon , you should get a smooth paste
3. Add the teabag to the teapot and pour remaining boiling water , mixing well
4. Let steep 5-7 minutes
5. Strain to get rid of the vanilla pieces
6. If you have a milk "frother" you can use it to have a lightly foamy version
7. A stronger-adult version can be made by substituting vanilla bean / essence with a vanilla flavoured liqueur
8. Or , you can just add it
9. Sip preferably on a comfy couch , cuddled up under a blanket with a good book , a pet , and a nice background music-- enjoy !

title: chocolate meringue gateau
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 150c or 130c fan
2. Using a pencil , draw an 18cm circle on each of 3 pieces of non-stick baking paper
3. Spray 3 oven trays lightly with oil , and place paper onto them , pencil-side down
4. Beat egg whites until soft peaks form
5. Add sugar gradually , beating well between each addition
6. Beat in vanilla
7. Sift cocoa over meringue and gently fold through until evenly combined
8. Spread meringue onto the trays within pencil lines
9. Sprinkle almonds onto the meringue
10. Bake for 45 minutes , swapping trays from top to bottom shelf halfway through
11. Turn off oven , prop the door ajar and leave to cool completely
12. Meanwhile , to make candied oranges: cut orange into 5mm slices
13. Combine water and sugar in a wide frying pan and stir over low heat , without boiling , until sugar has dissolved
14. Add orange slices and bring to the boil
15. Reduce heat slightly and cook at a gentle boil for 20 minutes
16. Turn off heat , and , using tongs , transfer each slice to a wire rack to cool
17. Beat cream until soft peaks form
18. Set 1 / 3 of cream aside , and beat orange rind briefly into the larger portion , unti1just combined
19. To assemble , spread orange cream over two of the meringues
20. Stack on a serving plate
21. Spread plain cream on remaining meringue , and place on top
22. Halve orange slices and arrange into cream
23. Run a vegetable peeler down long side of chocolate bar to make curls , quantity to taste , and put on top with easter eggs

title: linda s coney island sauce
steps:
1. Saute onions , garlic and beef til red is gone
2. Drain fat
3. Add rest of ingredients except for the breadcrumbs and vinegar
4. Bring to boil stirring often
5. Remove from heat
6. Add the breadcrumbs and vinegar
7. Cover and bake 325f for 1 hour as an option because sauce too spicy i added 1 tsp each ketchup and mustard or to taste
8. Can freeze leftovers

title: chorizo mushroom quiche
steps:
1. In a medium mixing bowl , stir together eggs , cream and spices , set aside
2. Saute chopped mushrooms , green onions and chorizo together in a pan until mushrooms and chorizo are no longer raw , about 5 - 7 minutes
3. You may need a dash of olive oil to prevent sticking
4. Have ready a buttered baking dish
5. Place chorizo mixture on the bottom , then cheese , then pour egg mixture over top
6. Sprinkle with paprika , if desired
7. Bake at 375 degrees for 20-40 minutes , depending on your pan and your oven
8. Check often as ovens vary
9. My cast iron scone pan only took 20 minutes !
10. Cook until slightly brown on top and eggs do not jiggle
11. Let set for 10 minutes
12. You might sprinkle extra green onions or chili flakes on top , if you like - get creative ! sliced black olives make a nice touch

title: butter fluff icing
steps:
1. Thicken milk and flour over medium heat
2. Once thickened , remove to cool
3. Next , mix sugar , shortening , vanilla with the flour / milk mixture
4. Beat until fluffy and creamy

title: carrot raisin pb sandwiches
steps:
1. Preheat broiler
2. Spread peanut butter over half of the bread slices
3. Top with raisin , carrot , and remaining bread slices
4. Broil 4 inches from heat for 1 to 2 minutes
5. Turn sandwiches over broil for 1 to 2 minutes more or until toasted
6. Cut sandwiches into triangles or squares

title: lox  cornucopia  appetizer
steps:
1. Roll each slice of salmon into a cone shape
2. Place on wax paper
3. Cream the cheese until soft
4. Stir in the parsley
5. Pipe into the wee cones of salmon
6. Top with a tiny spoon of caviar
7. Arrange on a platter and refrigerate until serving time

title: apple raisin bread
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine yeast , 1 / 2 cup water and sugar
2. Set aside
3. In a large bowl , combine eggs , applesauce , honey , oil , salt and remaining water
4. Mix well
5. Stir in yeast mixture
6. Gradually add enough flour to form a soft dough
7. Knead on a floured surface until smooth and elastic , about 10 minutes
8. Place dough in a greased bowl , turning once to grease top
9. Cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled , about 1 hour
10. Punch down and turn over in bowl
11. Cover and let rise 30 minutes
12. In a small bowl , combine apples , raisins and lemon juice
13. Divide dough into three parts
14. Knead one-third of the apple mixture into each part
15. Shape each into round flat balls
16. Place each in a greased 8-in
17. Round baking pan that has been sprinkled with cornmeal
18. Cover and let rise until doubled , about 1 hour
19. Brush each loaf with egg and sprinkle with sugar
20. Bake at 350f for 30 to 35 minutes or until brown sounds hollow when tapped

title: kochujang sauce
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together well
2. Keeps a long time in the refrigerator
3. This recipe also mul
4. If making kochujang sauce for bi bim bap
5. Double this recipe for 4 servings
6. I usually quadruple the recipe so i always have some on hand in the fridge

title: pesto pasta salad with pine nuts
steps:
1. Cook the corkscrew pasta in salted boiling water until tender
2. Drain and stir in the butter
3. Let cool for about 15 minutes
4. Transfer the pasta to a large serving bowl
5. Chop up the sundried tomatoes and stir into the pasta
6. Place the pasta in the fridge for at least 30 minutes , to cool some more
7. Add the prepared pesto , parmesan cheese , red chili flakes , ground black pepper and garlic powder
8. Mix well
9. Add the pine nuts , adjust seasonings if needed , and check for salt
10. Put back into the fridge and thoroughly chill the salad before serving
11. The time for cooling the salad is not included in the active or passive work time

title: lazy cabbage roll casserole
steps:
1. Put 1 / 2 of the shredded cabbage in greased casserole dish
2. Brown hamburger and onion , pour off grease
3. Add rice , soup , water , and seasonings to hamburger mixture
4. Put 1 / 2 mixture on top of cabbage in casserole dish
5. Repeat with remaining cabbage and beef mixture
6. Bake for 30 minutes at 350 degrees , top with cheese and bake for another 25-30 minutes

title: warm double chocolate brownie cakes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Butter and flour 8 cups in a standard-size muffin pan
3. In a small saucepan , melt butter
4. Add milk chocolate and whisk until melted
5. Let cool slightly
6. In a small bowl , whisk cake flour with all-purpose flour , unsweetened cocoa powder , and salt
7. In a large bowl , using a handheld electric mixer , beat eggs with sugar at medium speed until pale and thick , about 5 minutes
8. Beat in vanilla extract
9. Beat in melted chocolate mixture and dry ingredients in 3 additions , scraping down bowl occasionally with a spatula
10. Stir in remaining chopped chocolate
11. Spoon cake batter into prepared muffin cups and bake about 22 minutes , until cakes are risen and springy
12. Let cakes cool in muffin pan 15 minutes , then turn out onto a wire rack and let cool 15 minutes longer
13. Serve cakes warm , with ice cream

title: nif s 30 minute tuna casserole
steps:
1. Cook pasta as directed
2. Preheat oven to 400f
3. While waiting for the water to boil , add mushrooms , onion , celery and garlic to a nonstick pan sprayed with olive oil
4. Saute over medium heat until just tender
5. The moisture from the veggies will keep them from sticking
6. While cooking the pasta , stir tuna , sour cream , worcestershire sauce , salt and pepper into the pan
7. Remove from heat and add cheddar cheese
8. When pasta is al dente , stir into pan
9. Pour into a casserole dish sprayed with olive oil
10. Cover with bread crumbs
11. Cook for 15 minutes
12. The higher heat will ensure that you have some crunch to the bread crumbs

title: campfire taco salad
steps:
1. Cut tops off each bag of chips
2. Set aside
3. Heat chili in saucepan until completely heated through , stirring occasionally
4. Spoon about 2 tablespoons chili into each bag of chips
5. Top with cheese , sour cream , salsa and lettuce

title: peach bread pudding
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. In mixing bowl , beat together first 6 ingredients , eggs through salt
3. In another bowl , combine milk & water , then beat it into the egg mixture
4. In greased 1 1 / 2-quart casserole , layer bread , milk mixture & peaches until all ingredients are used
5. Set casserole in pan of hot water & bake 30-40 minutes or until a knife inserted in center comes out clean
6. Remove from oven , cool & serve
7. Refrigerate leftovers

title: cinnamon coffee
steps:
1. Mix all together
2. For 1 cup coffee put 2 rounded teaspoons in cup and fill with hot water

title: quick chili
steps:
1. In a large pot , at medium heat , saute onions and garlic until lightly browned
2. Add soy crumbles , salsa , beans , and chili powder
3. Add 1 / 2 cup of water and stir thouroughly
4. Cover pot and lower heat , simmer for about 20 to 25 minutes until thouroughly heated
5. Adjust "heat" by using more or less chili powder

title: as close as i ll ever get to greece salad
steps:
1. Whisk together the vinaigrette ingredients and set aside
2. Place tomatoes , cucumbers , red onion and bell pepper on two salad plates
3. Top with the feta slices , kalamata olives and sprigs of fresh oregano
4. Drizzle the vinaigrette on the salad

title: improvisation pasta
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
2. Combine the tomatoes and olive oil in a mixing bowl and toss well
3. Mix in garlic , parsley , and anchovies if using
4. Season with salt and pepper
5. Layer half the tomato mixture in a 9x13 baking dish
6. Dot with half of the blue cheese crumbled into small blobs
7. Sprinkle with half the olives , red pepper flakes to taste , and half the basil
8. Top the remaining tomato mixture and then layer again with cheese , olives , red pepper flakes and basil
9. Bake uncovered for 45 minutes
10. The mixture should be bubbling and lightly crusted on top
11. Cook linguini in a large pot of boiling , salted water until at dente
12. Drain
13. Divide the hot linguine among serving plates or bowls and spoon a generous amount of the roasted sauce over the top of each serving
14. For vegetarian option omit the anchovy fillets

title: cheesy pepperoni pasta pizza salad
steps:
1. Cook the pasta to directed
2. Rinse with cold water and drain
3. Combine pasta and remaining ingredients in large bowl , tossing well to coat
4. Cover and chill until cold , 2-3 hours
5. Serve and enjoy !

title: vertonic  vermouth and tonic
steps:
1. Fill a highball glass 2 / 3 full of ice
2. Add vermouth
3. Add tonic
4. Stir , garnish and serve

title: southern peach pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f prepare pie crust as directed on package for two-crust pie , using a 9-inch pie plate
2. Mix sugar , cornstarch and apple pie spice in large bowl
3. Add peaches
4. Toss gently
5. Spoon mixture into pastry-lined pie plate
6. Top with second pie crust
7. Seal and flute edge
8. Cute small slits in top crust
9. Bake 50-60 minutes or until crust is golden brown and filling is bubbly
10. Cool on wire rack
11. After 15-20 minutes of baking , cover edge of crust with strips of foil to prevent excessive browning

title: snickerdoodle pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Prepare pastry crust and line 9-inch pie plate
3. In bowl combine raw sugar and 1 / 2 teaspoons cinnamon
4. Brush melted butter over crust and sprinkle with 1 teaspoon of cinnamon-sugar mixture
5. Set aside
6. For syrup:
7. In saucepan combine brown sugar , 1 / 4 cup butter , the water , corn syrup , and 1 / 2 tbsp vanilla , 1 / 4 tsp cinnamon
8. Heat to boiling over medium heat , stirring to dissolve sugar
9. Boil gently for 2 minutes
10. Remove from heat
11. Stir in 1 / 2 teaspoon vanilla
12. Set aside
13. For filling:
14. In mixing bowl beat 1 / 4 cup softened butter with electric mixer on medium speed for 30 seconds
15. Beat in granulated sugar , powdered sugar , baking powder , salt , and cream of tartar until well combined
16. Beat in egg and 1 teaspoon vanilla
17. Gradually beat in milk until combined
18. Beat in flour
