19. Spread evenly in crust-lined pie plate
20. Gently pour the syrup over the filling
21. Sprinkle with remaining cinnamon-sugar mixture
22. Cover edges of pie with foil
23. Bake pie 25 minutes
24. Carefully remove foil
25. Bake about 20 minutes more or until top is puffed and golden brown , and a toothpick inserted near center comes out clean
26. Cool 30 minutes on wire rack
27. Serve warm

title: apple orange glazed chicken for two
steps:
1. Salt and pepper chicken breasts
2. Melt butter in an 8-inch skillet or 3-qt
3. Saucepan over medium heat
4. Cook chicken in butter about 5 minutes , then add red wine vinegar
5. Cook another 10 minutes , turning once , or until juice of chicken is no longer pink when center of thickest piece is cut
6. While chicken is cooking , mix cornstarch and mustard in a small bowl
7. Stir in remaining ingredients
8. Place chicken on serving plate
9. Cover to keep warm
10. To make the glaze , pour orange mixture into skillet
11. Heat to boiling over medium heat , stirring constantly
12. Boil about 1 minute , stirring constantly , until glaze is thickened
13. Pour over chicken

title: feta cheese spread
steps:
1. Beat cream cheese , feta cheese and sour cream until fluffy
2. Add chopped green onion and garlic salt
3. Refrigerate , covered , several hours
4. Garnish with additional green onion

title: aunt rhoda s vegetable dip
steps: 1. Mix all and let stand overnight or for a couple hours

title: fastnachts  german doughnuts
steps:
1. Dissolve yeast in lukewarm milk
2. Sift in flour and salt in bowl
3. Make a hole in the center
4. Pour dissolved yeast and all other ingredients into the hole and mix until not sticky
5. Cover and let rise until doubled
6. Punch down , then let rest for 10 minutes
7. Roll out to about 1 / 4-inch and cut
8. Let rise another 20-30 minutes
9. Fry in deep fat until light brown
10. While still hot , roll in sugar

title: sparkling rhubarb spritzer
steps:
1. In dutch oven , bring rhubarb and water to a boil
2. Boil for 15 minutes
3. Cool for 10 minutes
4. Strain and reserve juice
5. Discard pulp
6. Add sugar and pineapple juice to reserved juice
7. Stir until sugar is dissolved
8. Chill thoroughly
9. Just before serving , add soda and ice cubes

title: becky s oatmeal bread
steps:
1. Add ingredients into the bread machine in the order listed
2. Set to dough cycle
3. My machine takes 1 hr 50 minutes
4. When dough cycle is finished , shape as desired and allow to rise until double in size
5. Bake approximately 20-30 minutes until the top starts to brown and it sounds hollow when you tap it
6. Brush top with butter if desired
7. Makes a nice sandwich bread

title: andes crme de menthe cookies   andes mint cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f do not do this until after dough has been refrigerated
2. Blend butter , brown sugar , white granulated sugar , baking soda , baking powder , vanilla and eggs until ingredients are mixed
3. Add andes baking chips and mix
4. Add flour and continue to mix until all ingredients are well blended together
5. Cover and chill in the refrigerator for 45-60 minutes
6. Spoon out approximately 1 oz of dough per cookie
7. Form a ball and then slightly flatten
8. Place on non-stick baking pans and bake for approximately 8-10 minutes
9. Cool on pans for 2 minutes , then remove

title: turkey and potato enchiladas
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f preheat large saut pan on medium 23 minutes
2. Place turkey , onions and green chiles in pan
3. Brown ground turkey 57 minutes until meat is brown and no pink remains
4. Stir frequently and break meat up as it cooks
5. Drain , if needed
6. Stir in taco seasoning , water and potatoes , and cook another 3-5 minutes
7. Assemble enchiladas as follows: lay tortilla flat and place 1 / 4 cup meat mixture on tortilla
8. Roll tortilla to form cylinder shape , arrange seam side down in 10x13-inch baking pan
9. Repeat with all tortillas
10. Pour enchilada sauce over filled enchiladas
11. Sprinkle with cheese and bake 15 minutes
12. Top with your choice of tomatoes , shredded lettuce and sour cream , if desired
13. Serve

title: polynesian sausage supper
steps:
1. In a skillet , cook the sausage , onion and green pepper until the sausage is lightly browned
2. Drain
3. Add tomatoes , broth brown sugar , garlic powder , and pepper
4. Drain pineapple , reserving juice
5. Stir pineapple into sausage mixture
6. Bring to a boil
7. Cook uncovered for 5 minutes
8. Combine cornstarch and reserved pineapple juice until smooth
9. Gradually add to sausage mixture
10. Bring to a boil
11. Cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened
12. Serve over rice

title: crock pot artichoke jalapeno cheese dip   easy
steps:
1. Dice jalapeno and artichokes
2. Put jalapeno , artichoke , mozzarella , mustard , milk , worcestershire , soup , velveeta in crock pot and mix
3. Cook on low in crock pot for 2-3 hours and serve with some chips

title: joan s pear tart
steps:
1. Beat the first 4 ingredients together until well blended and then add the pecans to the mixture and mix well
2. Press into an 11 inch round tart pan
3. Beat together the cream cheese , sugar , eggs and vanilla for the filling and pour over the crust
4. Arrange the drained pear halves in a pretty design on top and sprinkle with cinnamon sugar
5. Bake at 450 degrees for 10 minutes and then turn the heat down to 400 degrees and bake for an additional 25 minutes
6. Remove side from tart pan to serve
7. Serve warm and if desired garnish with whipped cream

title: old fashioned oatmeal muffin
steps:
1. Gather up 3 bowls
2. In the first bowl , place 1 cup of old fashioned oats
3. Pour the milk into the measuring cup and add the vinegar or lemon juice to the milk
4. Mix it a little bit then pour into the bowl with the oats
5. Stir to be sure the oats are relatively evenly coated
6. Let stand for at least an hour , grab your keys and take a stroll around the neighborhood , or watch a little tv
7. In the second bowl , mix 1 / 3 cup softened butter , 1 / 2 cup splenda for baking , 1 tablespoon of molasses and 1 egg
8. In the third bowl , sift 1 / 2 cup all purpose flour , 1 / 2 whole wheat flour , 1 teaspoon baking powder , 1 / 2 teaspoon baking soda and 1 teaspoon salt together
9. After the oats have soaked for an hour , gently fold the butter / sugar mixture and the flour mixture into the oats alternatively
10. You may add additional ingredients
11. Raisins and walnuts are good
12. I have put chocolate chips in with a very nice result
13. I have also used ghiadelli white chocolate chips and a couple chopped macadamia nuts
14. Spray some pam into the bottom of a muffin tin
15. You can of course also use muffin tin liners
16. Fill each cup a 2 / 3 full
17. Bake in a 400 degree oven for 20 to 25 minutes
18. Cool off and enjoy
19. Allowable substitutions in the recipe are as follow: you may substitute lemon juice for white vinegar to "sour" the milk
20. You may substitute shortening for butter or you can substitute unsweetened apple sauce for the butter
21. You may substitute brown sugar for both the splenda and molasses

title: garlic and herb cream cheese spread by todd wilbur
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , combine garlic , italian seasoning , salt , and onion powder
2. Add cream cheese and gently fold in the seasonings , being careful not to overmix as the cream cheese will lose it's "fluff"
3. Allow the flavors to blend by storing in an airtight container in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour
4. Stir once more before serving

title: french bistro steak on garlic croutes and potato frites
steps:
1. Potato frites:
2. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
3. In bowl , toss potatoes with oil , thyme , salt and pepper
4. Arrange on foil-lined rimmed baking sheet
5. Bake , turning once , for 40 minutes or until tender inside and crisp outside
6. While potatoes cook , start the bistro steak
7. Bistro steak on garlic croutes:
8. Rub bread all over with cut side of garlic
9. Brush with 2 teaspoons of the oil
10. Toast on baking sheet for 10 minutes or until golden
11. Meanwhile , trim off all but 1 / 8 inch fat from steak , if needed
12. Roll edges in peppercorns to coat
13. In skillet , heat remaining oil over medium-high heat
14. Cook steaks for 4 to 6 minutes per side or until medium-rare inside and browned
15. Transfer to plate
16. Cover and keep warm
17. Add wine and stock to skillet
18. Bring to boil , scraping up any brown bits
19. Boil for about 1 minute or until reduced by half
20. Remove from heat
21. Stir in red pepper , shallot , butter and any juices accumulated on plate
22. Cut steaks in half
23. Place on crotes
24. Pour sauce over top
25. Serve with potato frites

title: chicken creole
steps:
1. Heat vegetable oil in heavy skillet over high heat
2. Stir in 1 / 4 cup flour
3. Cook , stirring constantly , about 5 minutes or until the mixture is the color of a copper penny
4. Reduce heat , add green pepper and onion and cook 10 to 15 minutes or until tender , stirring occasionally
5. Add chicken , tomatoes , mushrooms , parsley , worcestershire sauce , garlic , soy sauce , sugar , pepper , salt and hot sauce
6. Cover and simmer 20 minutes
7. Stir occasionally
8. Serve creole over hot cooked rice or pasta of choice
9. Sprinkle with fil powder if desired

title: celeriac salad with mustard dressing
steps:
1. With a whisk , beat the oil into the mustard
2. Add mayonnaise and continue to beat , then add the sour cream or yogurt
3. Season to taste and add more mustard for a tangier taste
4. Thin dressing if desired with a little bit of cream
5. Mix with the celeriac
6. Marinate in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours before serving
7. This salad will keep for several days and get tender from sitting in the marinade

title: greek french fries
steps:
1. In a large skillet , heat the olive oil
2. To test when it's ready , use the handle on a wooden spoon by placing it erect in the oil
3. If bubbles start forming around it , you know it's ready
4. Add the potatoes , being careful not to crowd them
5. If you put too many , the temperature of the oil will drop , and they will come out mushy
6. Fry them in batches instead
7. Once golden brown , remove and place on paper towels
8. Season with salt , pepper , and oregano
9. Add some grated cheese if you wish
10. Just remember not to salt the potatoes too much if you add the cheese
11. A few drops of lemon juice on top is a must for my greek taste buds

title: slow cooker chicken tagine
steps:
1. In slow cooker combine squash , tomatoes , onion , garlic , beans , broth , and raisins
2. In cup , combine coriander , cumin , cinnamon , salt , pepper
3. Rub spice mixture all over chicken thighs and place chicken on top of vegetables
4. Cover slow cooker and cook on low for 8 hours or high for 4 hours
5. About 10 minutes before serving , prepare couscous as directed on package
6. To serve fluff couscous with fork
7. Stir olives into chicken mixture
8. Serve chicken mixture over couscous

title: gluten free soda crackers
steps:
1. Sift the flour , salt and baking soda into a bowl
2. Cut in the butter until very fine
3. Add the milk and egg and mix to make a stiff dough
4. Knead thoroughly and then roll the dough very thin - about 1 / 16"
5. Cut into square or rounds and place on lightly buttered cookie sheets
6. Prick the crackers with a fork and sprinkle with coarse salt
7. Bake in a 400 degree oven for 10 minutes or until very lightly browned
8. Allow to cool completely and store in an air tight container

title: sharlotka  russian apple pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Combine flour , sugar , and eggs , beat well
3. Core the apples and cut them into thin slices
4. Grease a pan and dust it lightly with flour
5. Arrange all apple slices on the bottom of the pan
6. Pour the batter mixture over the apples
7. Bake for 25 - 30 minutes
8. Cool
9. May be served warm or at room temperature

title: texas style picante sauce
steps:
1. Substitution: 1 1 / 2 habanero instead of jalapeno makes this warm but not too hot for making texas style picante sauce: combine jalapeno pepper , garlic , tomato paste , sugar , vinegar , alum and spices in blender or food processor
2. Process until desired consistency
3. Combine chopped vegetables in large sauce pan
4. Bring to a boil , reduce heat and simmer for 45 minutes
5. Pour into hot sterilized 1 pint jars leaving 1 / 2 inch headspace
6. Seal and process in boiling water bath for 15 minutes or pressure canner for 5 minutes at 10 pounds of pressure

title: cool whip jello
steps:
1. Combine cool whip and jello together until cool whip is softened
2. Add cottage cheese and stir
3. Put in fridge--the longer the more like jello

title: corn fritters with vermont maple syrup
steps:
1. Mix all of the ingredients except oil and maple syrup together
2. Amount of flour can vary
3. If the corn is very milky and wet , use more flour
4. Batter should not be runny
5. Heat the oil in a cast iron skillet to cover 1 / 4"
6. Add large spoonfuls of batter to the hot oil
7. Cook 3 to 4 minutes per side
8. Flatten with a spatula after turning
9. Serve with real maple syrup
10. Enjoy !

title: con canela mexican salad dressing
steps:
1. Whirl all ingredients in a blender until smooth or use a handheld immersion blender
2. Taste and adjust seasonings if necessary
3. If thinner consistency desired , thin with more milk
4. Store in refrigerator until ready to use
5. Yield is estimated

title: cherry cookies
steps:
1. Pre heat oven to 375 and grease well cookie sheets
2. Combine butter , sugar , vanilla , salt and flour
3. Will be stiff
4. Stir in chopped cherries
5. Form into balls and place on sheets 2 inches apart
6. Bake for 15 minutes , do not let brown

title: norman s golden three fruit marmalade
steps:
1. Scrub the fruit , and dry
2. Using a zester , remove the peel , being careful not to get any pith
3. If you do not have a zester , use a vegetable peeler , being careful to remove only the zest
4. Then , using a sharp knife , or shears , cut the peel into fine strips
5. I have also grated the peel , but it doesn't look as pretty
6. Place the zest in a small saucepan with the water and the baking soda , and bring to a boil
7. Reduce the heat and simmer for 20 minutes
8. In the meantime , slice the top and bottom of each fruit , so that it sits flat on your cutting board
9. Using a sharp knife and following the contour of the fruit , cut away all the pith , leaving only the pulp
10. While holding the fruit over a bowl , use the knife to cut out the flesh , leaving the membrane
11. Remember , it's the pith and the membrane that make marmalade bitter
12. Add the pulp and juice to the simmering zest
13. Simmer , covered , for 10 minutes
14. Measure 3 cups of the mixture and mix it together with the sugar in a large pot
15. Bring to a rapid boil
16. Stir and boil hard for 1 minute
17. Immediately remove the pot from the heat
18. Add the pouch of pectin , and stir for 10 minutes
19. This will cool the mixture slightly and prevent the zest from floating
20. Pour into sterilized jars and seal

title: bourbon barbecue sauce
steps:
1. In a deep frying pan , melt the butter and gently fry the onions , chilies and garlic for about 5 minutes
2. Lower the heat and add all the other ingredients , except the bourbon , stirring after each addition
3. Simmer for about 10 minutes , stirring frequently , then add the bourbon and cook for another 3-5 minutes
4. Let the sauce cool , stir now and then
5. Put in clean jars or wide neck bottles and label
6. Store in a cool dark place

title: pork with roasted peppers   potatoes
steps:
1. Season chops with black pepper
2. Heat oil in nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
3. Add chops and cook 10 minutes or until browned
4. Remove chops
5. Add potatoes , onion and oregano
6. Cook 5 minutes or until browned , stirring occasionally
7. Add chops , broth and peppers
8. Heat to a boil
9. Cover and cook over low heat 5 minutes or until done

title: lemon   fresh mint marinade
steps:
1. Blend all ingredients in blender until cloves of garlic are small
2. Flecks of green mint leaves are perfect
3. Pour over your favortie veggies and let set for up to 3 hours
4. Grill !

title: ellington s mushroom jack s
steps:
1. Toast bread
2. On 1 pre-toasted slice of bread top mushrooms , followed by one slice of cheese
3. Place under broiler until cheese is bubbly
4. While first side is broiling cover remaining slice of toasted bread with yogurt and top with alfalfa sprouts
5. Smoosh 2 completed sides together and enjoy !

title: orange freeze
steps:
1. Place one clean , dry , room temperature glass in the freezer ahead of time and remove when ready to prepare
2. Place orange juice and orange sherbet in blender container and mix to the consistency of a milkshake
3. Pour mixture into frosted glass , and garnish with orange slice
4. Serve with straw and long-handled spoon

title: poor woman s tagine
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 300f
2. Combine all ingredients in a baking dish and cover with foil
3. Bake covered for 1 hour and 30 minutes
4. Let sit covered for at least 15 minutes before eating
5. Even better the next day , after the flavors have developed a bit more

title: cinnamon bun bread pudding
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 325f spray an 8-inch square pan with nonstick spray
2. To prepare the pudding , place the bread cubes in the prepared pan
3. In a medium bowl , whisk together the milk , eggs , sugars , vanilla and cinnamon
4. Pour over the bread cubes in the pan
5. To prepare the topping , in a medium bowl , combine the topping ingredients
6. Crumble the topping over the top of the pudding
7. Bake for 45 to 55 minutes , or until the custard is set , a knife inserted into the center of the pudding should come out fairly clean and the top is beginning to brown
8. Let the pudding cool for 15 minutes
9. Slice and serve warm
10. Change it up : classic cinnamon buns often contain nuts and / or raisins
11. Sprinkle nuts or raisins into the bread pudding if you'd like

title: hungarian goulash under pressure
steps:
1. Dice the salt pork
2. Melt the butter in the pressure cooker
3. Add the salt pork and cook until brown and crisp
4. Add the beef and brown lightly on all sides
5. Meanwhile , peel the onions and cut them into wedges
6. Peel the potoes and cut in half
7. Cut the green peppers into 1" squares
8. Add the onions , potatoes , and green peppers to the pan
9. Stir together the wine , tomato paste , paprika and salt and pepper to taste and add to the pressure cooker
10. Cover pressure cooker and bring up to full pressure
11. Reduce heat to stabilize pressure and cook for 12 minutes
12. Release pressure
13. Stir in the sour cream and caraway
14. Serve hot topped with additional sour cream , if desired
15. This goulash can be made in advance and refrigerated or frozen

title: zucchini and feta appetizer
steps:
1. Boil a large pot of salted water
2. Cut the zucchini in half , lengthwise
3. Use a teaspoon to scrape out the seeds , to form a little canoe , if you will
4. Blanche the halves in the boiling water for a minute , remove and let drain on a paper towel for a few minutes
5. Pre-heat your broiler / grill on high
6. Fill each "canoe" with feta cheese and broil for a couple of minutes
7. When the cheese has turned a little brown in spots , remove from the broiler
8. Drizzle each with a tbsp of olive oil , a sprinkle of pepper and salt if you like , and serve with crusty bread

title: dumpling
steps:
1. Bring a large pot of water to boil mix flour , salt , baking soda , sugar , cinnamon
2. Mix in shortening until crumbs form
3. Add raisins , currants , grated apple and carrot
4. Blend well
5. Add water bit at a time until sticky dough forms
6. Use a large cloth and dip the center of it in the water and wring out excess water
7. Lightly flour this surface
8. Dump dough onto surface and gather sides leaving a bit of room for expansion
9. Tie bundle together tightly with some string or something
10. Place into boiling water and boil for a minimum of 2 hours
11. After boiled take dumpling and place into a small roaster and bake at 350 just until browned and dried a bit
12. Not long
13. After cooled , slice and serve with whipped cream , canned cream or a brown sugar sauce

title: shrimp stuffed chicken with cream sauce
steps:
1. Soften the cream cheese slightly
2. Mix green onions , shrimp , worcestershire and tabasco into the cream cheese
3. Divide into 4 equal portions
4. Gently loosen skin at one end of each breast piece , making sure to keep as much skin intact on the long sides as possible
5. Push one portion of shrimp mixture under skin of each breast piece
6. Carefully smooth the mixture down the length of the chicken as evenly as you can
7. Bake the chicken at 350 degrees for 35-40 minutes , or until chicken tests done
8. I put mine on a rimmed cookie sheet , you could also use a 9x13 baking dish
9. Meanwhile , heat the olive oil in a small skillet over medium heat
10. Saute the minced shallot until it just begins to brown
11. Add the wine to the shallots and simmer 5-10 minutes , until the wine has reduced to half
12. Add the tomato to the wine and heat through , then pour in the cream
13. Bring the wine mixture to a boil , then simmer until sauce reduces and thickens , another 5-10 minutes
14. Taste sauce and add salt and pepper to your liking
15. Spoon sauce over chicken and serve

title: mexican sweet potato fries
steps:
1. Wash , peel and cut up potatoes into fries or cubes
2. Toss with oil then with taco seasonings
3. Add to slightly greased pan and bake in 425f oven 10 minutes , turn , 10 more minutes
4. These will likely come out better if you place a cooling rack on / in the cookie sheet and then place the fries on the rack
5. The air gets right around the fries

title: pakistani kima  hamburger curry
steps:
1. Saute onion and garlic in butter till soft
2. Add meat and brown well
3. Stir in curry powder and seasonings , and remaining vegetables
4. Cover and simmer 25 minutes , stirring several times and adding more water if needed
5. Serve with rice

title: silverbeet   swiss chard  salad
steps:
1. Slice the silverbeet and mix with the onion and tomato
2. Make dressing by putting all ingredients into a container and shake well
3. Pour the dressing over the salad and toss lightly
4. Optional: you can also add some finely sliced celery and some radishes if you like , or add some cooked crisp bacon pieces

title: michelle obamas white and dark chocolate chip cookies
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375
2. In a small bowl , whisk together flour , baking soda and salt
3. In a large bowl with an electric mixer , cream butter , vegetable shortening , granulated sugar , brown sugar and vanilla extract
4. Add eggs , 1 at a time , beating well after each addition
5. On low speed , beat in flour mixture
6. By hand , stir in white and milk chocolate chips , mint chips and walnuts
7. Drop rounded tablespoons of dough onto ungreased baking sheets
8. Bake at 375 for 10 to 12 minutes or until golden brown
9. Cool on baking sheets for 5 minutes
10. Remove to wire racks to cool completely

title: quick chicken and noodle soup
steps:
1. Place a large pot over moderate heat and add extra-virgin olive oil
2. Work close to the stove and add vegetables to the pot as you chop , in the order they are listed
3. Add bay leaves and season vegetables with salt and pepper , to taste
4. Add stock to the pot and raise flame to bring liquid to a boil
5. Add diced chicken tenderloins , return soup to a boil , and reduce heat back to moderate
6. Cook chicken 2 minutes and add noodles
7. Cook soup an additional 6 minutes or until noodles are tender and remove soup from the heat
8. Stir in parsley and dill , remove bay leaves and serve
9. This is a thick soup
10. Add up to 2 cups of water if you like chicken soup with lots of broth

title: whole grain honey mustard potato salad  344cals per serve
steps:
1. Don't peel the potatoes
2. Just wash if needed
3. Then cut in to medium dice
4. Put in pan with enough water to cover
5. Add the amount of salt for your taste
6. Bring to the boil
7. Cook until tender , but not mushy
8. Cool a little
9. While the potatoes are cooking mix all the other ingredients for the dressing together in a bowl or jug
10. You may want to add more or less milk to the dressing , depending how thick or thin you want to coat the potatoes

title: chef boy i be illinois  lighter chicken fried steak and gravy
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f coat a baking sheet with cooking spray
2. Place all-purpose flour on a large plate
3. Place egg in a shallow dish
4. Whisk cornmeal , whole-wheat flour , 1 / 4 cup cornstarch , onion and garlic powders and paprika in another shallow dish
5. Season both sides of steak with 1 / 2 teaspoon each salt and pepper
6. Dredge the steak in the flour , shaking off excess
7. Dip in the egg whites , then dredge in the cornmeal mixture
8. Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
9. Reduce heat to medium and add 2 pieces of the steak
10. Cook until browned on both sides , turning once , 3 to 5 minutes total
11. Transfer the steak to the prepared baking sheet and repeat with the remaining 1 tablespoon oil and 2 pieces of steak
12. Transfer the baking sheet to the oven and bake until cooked through , about 10 minutes
13. Meanwhile , add broth and wine to the pan and boil over medium-high heat , stirring occasionally , until reduced to about 1 cup , 3 to 5 minutes
14. Whisk water and the remaining 1 tablespoon cornstarch until smooth
15. Remove the pan from the heat and stir in the cornstarch mixture
16. Return to the heat and cook , stirring , until thickened , 1 to 2 minutes
17. Season with the remaining 1 / 4 teaspoon salt and pepper
18. Serve the steak topped with the gravy

title: world s best fried zucchini
steps:
1. Heat electric fry pan to 250f
2. Mix eggs and milk in bowl
3. Soak handful of zucchini slices in mixture
4. Lightly shake them off and coat them with flour
5. Place each slice in the fry pan with plenty of butter
6. Repeat until all slices are in the pan
7. Cook until each side is dark brown
8. Salt and pepper slices to taste
9. Enjoy !

title: skor chocolate bar dessert
steps:
1. Mix crumbs , 1 / 4 cup sugar and butter in a 13 by 9 inch pan
2. Press firmly onto bottom of pan
3. Refrigerate for 10 minutes
4. Beat cream cheese and remaining 1 / 4 cup sugar in medium bowl until smooth
5. Gently stir in 1 / 2 of the cool whip
6. Spread evenly over crust
7. Sprinkle chopped skor bars over cream cheese layer
8. Pour milk into a large bowl
9. Add pudding mixes
10. Beat for one minute
11. Pour over skor layer
12. Let stand for 5 minutes or until thickened
13. Spread remaining cool whip over pudding layer
14. Refrigerate for 2 hours
15. Cut into squares
16. Store leftovers in fridge
17. Actually , i used a hammer to break them into pieces

title: mom s broccoli   green olive salad
steps:
1. Mix broccoli , bacon and green olives together
2. Mix in enough mayo to hold the above ingredients together
3. Gently mix in the eggs , adding more mayo to hold all ingredients together
4. We serve this on lettuce leaves

title: lightly peppered strawberries
steps:
1. Hull the strawberries , cut them in half and put into a bowl
2. Sprinkle with pepper , sugar and finely chopped mint
3. Toss gently and let sit for 1 hour at room temperature
4. Toss again after 1 / 2 hour
5. Serve sprinkled with a little mint on top
6. Enjoy !

title: army   lou s soul food macaroni and cheese
steps:
1. Let cheeses and butter stand at room temperature
2. Cook macaroni according to package directions until almost al dente'
3. Drain macaroni and transfer to a large bowl
4. Add 1 cup shredded cheese and velveeta cubes to hot pasta and stir gently til cheeses start to melt
5. In a medium mixing bowl , whisk the eggs , butter , milk , soup , salt and pepper
6. Stir this mixture into the cooked macaroni mixture
7. Transfer half into a 13x9 sprayed baking dish
8. Sprinkle with 1 / 2 cup of shredded cheese
9. Top with remaining macaroni mixture
10. Bake covered at 325 degrees for 30 minutes
11. Uncover
12. Sprinkle with remaining 1 / 2 cup of shredded cheese
13. Return to oven and bake 15 minutes more until cheese is melted and bubbly brown
14. Let stand 10 minutes before serving to meld flavors

title: polish pancakes
steps:
1. Beat eggs until foamy
2. Add milk , flour , salt and sugar
3. Beat well
4. Melt 1 teaspoon butter in a 9-inch skillet , tilting to cover entire bottom
5. Pour 1 / 4 of egg mixture into hot skillet , covering the surface evenly
6. Cook until firm enough to roll
7. Slip pancake from skillet onto clean cloth
8. Spread with jam and peaches and roll up
9. Repeat process making 4 rolls
10. Sprinkle with confectioners sugar
11. Slice and serve warm

title: creamy chicken ramen noodles for 2
steps:
1. Bring water to boil in small saucepan
2. Add dry noodles and flavor packet and cook until tender
3. Drain noodles
4. Meanwhile , in a large saucepan , add ingredients butter to broccoli
5. Heat on low until combined and chicken and broccoli are heated through
6. Add noodles and stir together until noodles are coated
7. Season with salt and pepper if seasoning packet is not used

title: slow cooker  meal in one casserole
steps:
1. Brown ground beef and onion
2. Drain
3. Combine ground beef and onion mixture with tomato soup
4. Combine chicken soup and noodles
5. Layer beef mixture , chicken mixture , and green beans
6. Sprinkle with salt
7. Lay cheese over top
8. Cover
9. Cook on low 2-3 hours

title: leslie s sloppy joes
steps:
1. Saute pepper and onion , till soft
2. Add ground meat , ketchup , worcestershire , mustard and sugar
3. Let simmer for half an hour to hour , on med or med low heat
4. Serve on a toasted hamburger bun
5. I enjoy this served with chips and pickle spears

title: baked capsicum  bell peppers
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to gas mark 4 / 180c / 350f
2. In a bowl , mix the tuna , black olives , grated garlic , chopped parsley and breadcrumbs until you have a smooth mixture
3. Season with salt and pepper
4. Cut the peppers in half and remove the seeds but leaving the stalks intact
5. Stuff each half with 3-4 tbsp of the mixture
6. Place on a well-greased baking tray
7. Drizzle the top with olive oil and bake the capsicums in top shelf of the oven for about 45-50 minutes
8. Remove from oven and transfer them onto a serving dish , with all the juices from the tray poured over the peppers
9. Drizzle with a little more of olive oil if desired

title: hawaiian  bbq oven baked ribs
steps:
1. Trim as much fat off ribs as possible
2. Mix all ingredients in a med bowl
3. Place ribs and marinade into a oven-safe dish
4. Mix to combine
5. Cover
6. Marinate overnight
7. When ready to cook , let ribs sit out at room tempt for at least 1 hours
8. Preheat oven 325f
9. Bake for 2 1 / 2~3hrs
10. Serve over rice ! enjoy !

title: luleh kebabs  persian ground lamb kebabs
steps:
1. Soak wooden skewers in warm water for 20-30 minutes prior to preparing food
2. Place meat in a large bowl
3. Add the onion , egg , salt , pepper , and cinnamon
4. Beat with a spoon until well mixed and the meat turns lighter in color
5. Take a handful of the mixture and form it around the skewer to approximately 6" long and 1" in diameter to make an elongated patty
6. If your meat is too wet to work with , as sometimes happens with too much onion or wet meat , it can help to just shape the kebabs on a piece of non-stick foil and grill them that way , on the foil , turning the kebab over as it cooks and comes together
7. Set kebabs aside on wax paper on another plate until ready to grill
8. Grill kebabs over hot coals or under broiler until cooked through , turning once
9. Serve with lemon wedges , and chelou with a sprinkling of sumak seasoning

title: farmers brownies
steps:
1. Mix the first four ingredients together
2. Add in the next five ingredients
3. Butter a brownie pan
4. Pour in the batter
5. Bake at 350 degrees for 20 minutes
6. For the frosting: melt the 1 / 2 cup butter and 3t buttermilk together
7. Bring to a boil
8. Add 3-4t cocoa and 3 cups powdered sugar
9. Frost the brownies
10. Enjoy !

title: wild   creamy mushroom soup  joey s restaurant
steps:
1. Grind dried porcini in a blender until powderly
2. Cook onion in 1 t butter in a 4 to 5 quart heavy pot , covered , over moderate heat , until softened , about 5 minutes
3. Add fresh mushrooms , porcini powder , seal salt , tarragon oregano , and pepper and cook , stirring occasionally , until mushrooms are tender , about 5 minutes
4. Add remaining 2t butter and cook , stirring , until melted , then sprinkle in flour and cook , stirring constantly , until mixture is very thick and golden , about 5 minutes
5. Whisk in 1 c chick broth , scraping up any brown bits , until mixture is smooth
6. Add remaining broth in a stream , whisking until liquid is smooth
7. Bring to a simmer , whisking , then stir in cream and sherry and simmer , uncovered , stirring occasionally 10 minutes

title: short ribs with sauce
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350
2. Place ribs in 13x9 baking pan
3. Add water
4. Cover and bake for 2-1 / 2 hours
5. Pour off water
6. In small saucepan , mix all other ingredients
7. Bring to a boil
8. Reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes
9. Set in refrigerator until needed
10. When done , uncover ribs and spoon sauce over
11. Bake , uncovered , for 1 / 2 hour , turning often to coat with sauce

title: lasagna for 4
steps:
1. Preparation:
2. Remove 6 pieces of pasta from package
3. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
4. Brown hamburger in large skillet , remove from heat , drain
5. Stir in pasta sauce
6. In a medium bowl beat two eggs with basil and oregano
7. Add ricotta and feta cheese
8. Assembly:
9. In a 9 x 9 x 2 inch baking dish , spread cup meat sauce
10. Place 2 pieces of uncooked pasta over the sauce
11. Spread about 1 cup of ricotta mixture over the pasta
12. Spread 1 cup meat sauce over ricotta
13. Sprinkle with 1 cup mozzarella cheese
14. Repeat step 3 two more times
15. Top with pasta , spread remaining ricotta , meat sauce , and mozzarella cheese
16. Bake:
17. Cover with foil and bake at 375 degrees for 30 minutes
18. Remove foil and bake for an additional 10 to 15 minutes until bubbly
19. Let stand 5 minutes , cut and serve

title: french doughnut muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Lightly spray muffin tin
3. Beat egg
4. Add 1 / 2 cup milk and 1 / 3 cup melted margarine
5. Combine flour , 3 / 4 cup sugar , baking powder , salt , and nutmeg
6. Blend well with egg mixture
7. Fill greased muffin tins 1 / 2 full
8. Bake 15 minutes until browned
9. Immediately remove muffins from pan and dip in remaining 1 / 3 cup margarine
10. Roll in cinnamon / sugar / vanilla mixture
11. Serve warm

title: p b   j energy squares
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees and grease a 9" x 13" pan
2. Mix flour , baking soda and salt
3. Set aside
4. In a large bowl , beat butter and brown sugar at high speed until creamy
5. Beat in peanut butter until blended
6. Reduce speed to low
7. Blend in flour mixture and oats
8. Spread 2 / 3 of the batter in the pan with a spatula
9. Spread grape jam / jelly carefully over the batter
10. Sprinkle with wheat germ , if used
11. Spoon out small dollops of remaining batter and scatter over the jam / jelly
12. Bake 25 minutes , until golden

title: apricot almond bread   breadmaker 1 1 2 lb  loaf
steps:
1. Measure all ingredients into bread machine pan in the order suggested by manufacturer , adding apricots and nuts with flour
2. Process in basic / white bread cycle
3. Light or medium / normal color crust setting , depending on how your machine bakes
4. Remove baked bread from pan
5. Cool on wire rack

title: rosemary raisin bread
steps:
1. Soften the yeast in about 1 / 4 cup of the warm water
2. Soften the raisins in the rest of the warm water
3. Combine flour , salt , and rosemary in a large bowl
4. Mix in the oil , water , raisins , and yeast mixture
5. Knead in enough flour to make a smooth , elastic dough
6. Dough should be"tacky , " but not"sticky
7. "try to add just enough flour so that the dough doesn't stick to the board and then stop adding it
8. Too much flour will make the dough rise less
9. Place in an oiled bowl and cover with plastic wrap
10. Let rise in a warm place until doubled
11. Punch dough dough
12. Divide into 2 portions , form into loaves , and press each into a loaf pan
13. Let rise until doubled
14. Bake in a preheated 350 degree oven until brown

title: orange cake suggested by aylmer macpherson
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Grease and flour a 10" springform pan
3. I used recipe #78579
4. Mince the orange in a food chopper or processor
5. Peel and all
6. No seeds please ! set aside
7. Cream together the butter and sugar
8. Add eggs one at a time , blending well
9. Add orange mush
10. Mix together the sour cream and soda
11. Mix together salt and flour , and add to the butter / orange mixture , alternating with the sour cream
12. Pour into prepared pan
13. Bake for 50 minutes or until done
14. Cool on a rack for 10 minutes before removing the outer rim
15. The original recipe called for the addition of 1 cup raisins and 1 cup nuts
16. These are folded into the batter after the sour cream and flour
17. As you may see from the photo , the cake sunk in the center
18. I don't know why
19. It was completely baked so i just told dh "it's suppose to be that way" :)

title: oatmeal waffles
steps:
1. The night before you plan to serve the waffles , combine the buttermilk , orange juice and oats in a medium bowl
2. Mix well , cover , and refrigerate over night
3. In a large bowl , whisk the egg
4. Add the sugar and mix
5. Add the flours , baking soda , salt and the oat mixture and mix well
6. Stir in the melted butter
7. The batter will be slightly lumpy
8. Preheat and lightly grease a waffle iron
9. Spoon a generous 1 / 2 cup of batter onto the hot iron and close the lid
10. Cook until no more steam escapes from the iron and the waffle is golden on both sides , about 5 minutes
11. Serve immediately with butter and maple syrup

title: artichoke   cranberry stuffing
steps:
1. Trim stems and
2. Place stem-down in a deep saucepan or pot with 3 inches boiling water
3. Boil gently , covered , for 25 to 40 minutes or until a center petal pulls out easily
4. Drain upside-down on rack and cool
5. Remove outer petals from artichokes
6. Save to enjoy as an appetizer or snack
7. Remove center petals and fuzzy centers of artichokes
8. Trim out hearts
9. Chop hearts and place in a large bowl
10. Set aside
11. Steam carrots and onions for 8 to 10 minutes , or until carrots are nearly tender
12. Add steamed vegetables to artichokes
13. Stir in bread crumbs , cranberries , thyme , and allspice
14. Toss until well combined
15. Sprinkle orange juice over mixture to moisten stuffing as desired
16. Toss well
17. Season with pepper
18. Use to stuff a 12- to 15-pound turkey , a large roasting chicken , or other poultry
19. Bake at 350f , any remaining stuffing in a lightly greased baking dish , covered , during the last 30 to 40 minutes of roasting

title: cranberry meringue pie   eating well magazine
steps:
1. Preparation
2. Preheat oven to 350f coat a 9-inch pie pan with cooking spray
3. To prepare crust: stir flour , 1 / 2 cup sugar and 1 / 4 teaspoon salt in a medium bowl
4. Stir in oil and butter with a fork until well blended and crumbly
5. Using the back of a spoon , firmly press the dough into the bottom and up the sides of the prepared pan
6. Bake the crust until it just begins to brown , about 20 minutes
7. To prepare filling: meanwhile , combine cranberries and orange juice in a medium saucepan
8. Bring to a boil over high heat and cook , stirring occasionally , until all the cranberries are beginning to break down , 5 to 6 minutes
9. Pour through a fine-mesh sieve into a medium bowl , pressing on the solids to extract all the juice
10. Whisk 3 / 4 cup sugar into the juice until combined
11. Whisk in whole egg and 3 egg yolks
12. Return the cranberry mixture to the saucepan and cook over medium heat , stirring constantly and vigorously , until it thickens and just starts to bubble as you are stirring , 4 to 5 minutes
13. Pour the warm filling into the warm crust
14. Set aside while you prepare the meringue topping
15. To prepare topping: beat the 3 egg whites in a large bowl with an electric mixer on medium speed until frothy
16. Add cream of tartar and pinch of salt and beat at high speed until soft peaks form
17. Very slowly add 1 / 3 cup sugar , beating constantly , until the mixture holds stiff , shiny peaks
18. Beat in vanilla
19. Spoon the meringue over the filling , then gently spread to the edges of the crust
20. Make peaks in the meringue with the back of a spoon or a small off-set spatula
21. Bake until the top is lightly browned , about 15 minutes
22. Cool the pie on a wire rack to room temperature , at least 3 hours , before serving
23. Bake with white whole-wheat flour , made from a special variety of white wheat , and whole-wheat pastry flour , milled from soft wheat and containing less gluten
24. Both provide the nutritional benefits of whole grains
25. Find them in large supermarkets , natural-foods stores and online at bobsredmill
26. Com and kingarthurflour
27. Com
28. Store in the freezer

title: slow cooked southwestern pork stew
steps:
1. Place chopped onion and garlic in the bottom of slow cooker
2. Top with pork
3. Mix cornmeal , cumin , oregano and salt
4. Sprinkle over pork and mix well
5. Next , add beans , tomatoes and broth
6. Mix well
7. Cook on low for 8 to 10 hours or until pork is tender
8. A half hour before serving , add corn and cook on high

title: quick taco soup
steps:
1. Brown the meat and onion
2. Add to a large pot with all the canned items
3. Add the water and dry package ingredients
4. Stir until well mixed over a medium heat
5. Cook until hot
6. Serve in soup bowls topped with chopped onion and grated cheese
7. Serve with corn chips and other toppings on the side

title: cheese tortellini with cherry tomatoes
steps:
1. Cook tortellini according to package instructions
2. Drain and set aside
3. While the pasta cooks , gather and cut up the vegetables and other ingredients
4. Heat the olive oil and garlic in a large pan over medium heat for about one minute
5. Add tomatoes , onion powder , salt , and pepper to the pan and saute for about 5 minutes
6. Add spinach , parsley and basil to the pan and cook for about 2 minutes more
7. Gently stir in the tortellini and cook for 2-3 more minutes
8. Remove from heat and top with parmesan cheese

title: cranberry coconut orange bread
steps:
1. Sift together dry ingredients and cut in shortening
2. When shortening has been incorporated add orange juice , eggs and coconut
3. When all ingredients have been mixed smoothly together , fold in cranberries
4. Spray two loaf pans with cooking spray and fill 3 / 4 full with batter
5. Bake in a 350 degree oven for one hour or until a knife inserted into the center comes out clean
6. Be careful not to over cook - as this will be dry
7. After removing from the oven , separate the bread from the sides of the pans with a knife and turn out loaves onto a cooling rack
8. Let sit at least 3 hours before cutting
9. If you try to cut the bread when it's hot , it will fall apart on you :-)

title: black eyed susan cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Grease and flour two 8-inch cake pans , or grease and line with circles of parchment paper
3. Cake: cook apricots in 2 cups water , about 12 minutes , until very soft
4. Measure out 1 cup apricots and liquid
5. Set aside
6. Put remaining apricots and liquid in blender and puree
7. Add peas to blender and puree again
8. Put oil , brown sugar and eggs in mixing bowl
9. Beat on high 3 minutes or until creamy
10. Whisk flour , cinnamon , cloves , baking soda and baking powder in separate bowl
11. Pour egg mixture over puree and fold together
12. Gently fold in flour mixture
13. Fold in raisins and pecans , if using
14. Pour into prepared cake pans
15. Bake 35-40 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center of the cake comes out clean
16. Remove from pans and cool completely on wire racks
17. Frosting: beat cream cheese in mixer until creamy
18. Beat in remaining ingredients
19. Frosting will be soft but it will firm upon standing
20. Place one cake layer on plate and spread reserved apricots over it
21. Top with second layer
22. Spread frosting over top and sides of cake
23. To decorate: cut apricots into slices
24. Place chocolate kiss or star on cake , and arrange 8 apricot "petals" around it , skin side up
25. Repeat until cake is covered

title: awesome soft baked chocolate chip cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Combine flour , baking soda and salt in small bowl
3. Beat butter , granulated sugar , brown sugar and vanilla extract in large mixer bowl until creamy
4. Add eggs , one at a time , beating well after each addition
5. Gradually beat in flour mixture
6. Stir in morsels and nuts
7. This helps get a chunky cookie instead of a flat one
8. I also cool my sheets down with cold water in between batches so they don't start to melt before they get into the oven
9. Drop by rounded tablespoon onto ungreased baking sheets
10. Bake for 9 to 11 minutes or until golden brown
11. Cool on baking sheets for 2 minutes
12. Remove to wire racks to cool completely
13. Pan cookie variation: grease 15 x 10-inch jelly-roll pan
14. Prepare dough as above
15. Spread into prepared pan
16. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until golden brown
17. Cool in pan on wire rack
18. Makes 4 dozen bars
19. Slice and bake cookie variation:
20. Prepare dough as above
21. Divide in half
22. Wrap in waxed paper
23. Refrigerate for 1 hour or until firm
24. Shape each half into 15-inch log
25. Wrap in waxed paper
26. Refrigerate for 30 minutes
27. Preheat oven to 375f cut into 1 / 2-inch-thick slices
28. Place on ungreased baking sheets
29. Bake for 8 to 10 minutes or until golden brown
30. Cool on baking sheets for 2 minutes
31. Remove to wire racks to cool completely
32. Makes about 5 dozen cookies
33. May be stored in refrigerator for up to 1 week or in freezer for up to 8 weeks
34. For high altitude baking : increase flour to 2 1 / 2 cups
35. Add 2 teaspoons water with flour and reduce both granulated sugar and brown sugar to 2 / 3 cup each
36. Bake drop cookies for 8 to 10 minutes and pan cookie for 17 to 19 minutes

title: jim s easy mushroom sauce for steak
steps:
1. Saute mushrooms in butter and oil for 3-5 minutes , stirring occasionally
2. Add red wine and simmer for a few minutes
3. Add beef broth and simmer to reduce a bit , about 5 minutes
4. Combine flour and cold water and whisk until smooth
5. Stir into the mushrooms until well blended
6. Season to taste and simmer for about 1 minute , until thickened
7. If too thick , add a bit more broth
8. Add parsley

title: ground turkey tortilla casserole
steps:
1. Brown turkey and small onion until meat is completely done
2. Add taco seasoning packet and follow directions for cooking on back
3. Spray non-stick casserole dish with non-stick cooking spray
4. Cut flour tortillas into bite size pieces and layer 1 / 2 of tortillas on bottom of casserole dish
5. Add 1 / 2 of the cheese , sour cream , salsa and black beans
6. Start with the remaining tortillas and repeat layering
7. You may top with extra cheese or salsa if preferred
8. Other options include: corn , red pepper , green pepper , jalapenos , or any other ingredient
9. Play with ingredients , if you like more sour cream , simply add more , if you like less , add less
10. Don't be afraid to test different options
11. Bake at 350 until all cheese is melted and everything is heated thoroughly
12. You may wish to cover the dish with foil to prevent overbaking the top -- then removing it for the last 5-10 minutes

title: salmon with sweet chile glaze  crock pot
steps:
1. Preheat the crock pot to high
2. Lightly rinse salmon , set aside
3. Stir together the chile , garlic , brown sugar , soy , lime zest & juice and chili sauce
4. Place salmon in the crock pot and pour the sauce over the top
5. Cover , reduce heat to low and cook for 2-3 hours
6. If you want a stickier glaze , pour the cooking liquid into a small saucepan , add the honey and boil for 3 minutes
7. Garnish with cilantro and lime wedges and serve

title: bar b  q pork chops
steps:
1. Put chops in baking dish
2. Salt and pepper and lay onion and lemon over the chops
3. Mix remaining ingredients and pour over chops
4. Cover and bake for 1 hour at 350

title: radish and cheese sandwiches
steps:
1. Mix cream cheese and radishes well
2. Spread mixture on slice of bread and top with another slice of bread

title: veggie spring rolls
steps:
1. Cut up all veggies into small pieces
2. In large pan or wok heat up veg
3. Oil and add mushrooms and ginger
4. After a minute , add rest of veggies
5. Cook for 2-3 minute
6. Add sesame oil , soy sauce , sugar , salt and pepper , to taste
7. Cook another 3 minutes
8. Remove from heat
9. Take a wrapper , use fingers to moisten the edge with water , lay the wrapper in a diamond shape and place veg mixture in middle
10. Fold up bottom , sides and then roll up to the top
11. I bake mine in a cake pan that has been greased with some oil spritzed on top , 400 degrees for 10-15 min , but you could steam or fry

title: tho ruung red curry stir fry
steps:
1. Whisk together curry paste , sugar , garlic , and 2 tbsp water in small bowl
2. Set aside
3. Heat oil in wok or large skillet over medium-high heat
4. Add eggplant and onion , and cook 5 minutes , or until eggplant is browned
5. Stir in curry mixture , and cook 30 seconds , or until vegetables are coated
6. Add mustard greens , and cook 1 to 2 minutes , or until leaves are wilted
7. Stir in coconut milk and 1 1 / 2 cups water , and season with salt , if desired
8. Cover , and bring to a simmer
9. Reduce heat to medium-low , and simmer 10 to 15 minutes , or until eggplant is tender
10. Serve with lime wedges

title: rindfleisch eintopf  beef stew
steps:
1. Melt shortening in a dutch oven
2. Add the meat and brown on all sides
3. Place the onions on top of the meat
4. Mix the flour and seasonings with 1 / 4 c water
5. Blend with the tomatoes and add the misture to the dutch oven
6. Bake at 325 degrees f about 2 hours , until the meat is fork-tender
7. Serve with oven-browned potatoes

title: spicy jalapeno bacon cheese dip
steps:
1. Add cheese to bowl
2. I put the onion and jalapeno in the electric chopper until they are chopped fine
3. Add to cheese
4. Add bacon and mayo
5. Mix all together
6. Chill 30 minutes
7. I guessed on the mayo measurement -- so could be a little more or a little less
8. If it is too hot , take the seeds out of one of the jalapenos
9. Doesn't have to be chilled to eat

title: tropical banana smoothie
steps:
1. Place all ingredients into a blender and blend until smooth& thick
2. Strain into glasses

title: lemon cheesecake  pressure cooker
steps:
1. Grease the bottom and sides of a round baking dish or springform pan that fits into the cooker
2. Coat the sides with crumbs and distribute the remaining crumbs on the bottom
3. Using an electric mixer or food processor , blend the cream cheese and sugar until smooth
4. Add eggs , lemon juice , zest and vanilla
5. Beat until smooth , then pour into the prepared pan
6. Pour 2 cups water into a 6 qt or larger cooker
7. Set a trivet on the bottom to raise the bottom of the pan above the water
8. Lock the lid in place
9. Over high heat , bring to high pressure
10. Reduce heat just enough to maintain high pressure and cook for 15 minutes
11. Turn off the heat and allow the pressure to come down naturally
12. Remove lid , tilting away from you to release steam
13. Let the steam subside before removing the pan from the cooker
14. St on a wire rack to cool
15. If there is a small pool of condensed water in the middle of the cake , blot with paper towel
16. Serve warm , or cool to room temperature , cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours or overnight
17. Serve plain or with fresh fruit or cherry-pie filling on top

title: spagetti and meatballs with italian sausage and mushrooms
steps:
1. Saute onion and mushroom in olive oil for about5 minutes
2. Add crushed tomatoes and rest of ingredients into large pot
3. Simmer for about 6 hours , covered
4. Stir occasionally
5. In large bowl , combine meatball ingredients , mix well but do not over handle the meat
6. Form into 11 / 2 to 2 inch meatballs
7. In large skillet heat oil and when hot add meatballs and brown on all sides
8. Remove with slotted spoon and add to sauce while sauce is simmering
9. Meatballs and sausage will cook in sauce
10. Add parmesean cheese or serve on side over pasta
11. I prefer thin spagetti , but you can use what you like best

title: the hot brown
steps:
1. To make the sauce: in a saucepan , melt the butter over medium heat
2. Whisk in the flour to make a thick roux
3. While whisking constantly , gradually add the milk
4. Cook slowly , whisking frequently , for 5-10 minutes to remove any taste of raw flour
5. Whisk in parmesan cheese
6. Let the mixture cool slightly
7. Add in the egg
8. Place saucepan back on burner
9. Stir until sauce is thickened
10. Remove from heat
11. Fold in whipped cream if desired
12. Set aside and keep warm
13. To make sandwiches: preheat broiler
14. For each sandwich: place 2 slices of toast on a flameproof plate
15. Cover with a liberal amount of turkey
16. Pour a generous amount of sauce over the turkey and toast
17. Sprinkle with additional grated parmesan cheese
18. Place the dish under the broiler until the sauce is speckled brown and bubbly
19. Remove from oven
20. Cross two pieces of bacon over the top and serve immediately

title: mango kheer
steps:
1. Peel and extract mango pulp from the ripe mangoes and sieve it
2. In a deep pan , cook mango pulp with equal quantity of water
3. Prepare sugar syrup and mix it with mango mixture while continuously stirring
4. Add milk to it
5. Mix well and keep it boiling until the mixture thickens
6. Decorate it with nuts and serve

title: deep dish spinach pizza
steps:
1. Crust: proof yeast in water with sugar
2. In a food processor or in a bowl , mix 2 cups of the all-purpose flour , whole-wheat flour and salt
3. Add oil to bubbly yeast mixture and stir or process into flour mixture until dough pulls away from sides of bowl
4. Scrape dough onto floured work surface and knead until smooth and elastic , using up to 1 / 4 cup more all-purpose flour , if needed , to keep dough from sticking
5. Place dough in oiled bowl , cover with plastic wrap and allow to rise , in warm place , until doubled
6. Punch dough down , wrap it well and refrigerate until needed
7. Sauce: in a skillet , saute onion and garlic in oil until soft
8. Reduce heat to low and add tomatoes and their liquid
9. Break up the tomatoes slightly and add the salt , sugar , pepper , and pepper flakes
10. Simmer , uncovered , stirring occasionally , until very thick , about 30 minutes
11. Topping: cook spinach in covered saucepan until wilted , about 3 minutes
12. Drain , rinse with cold water and squeeze dry
13. Chop coarsely
14. Saute garlic in hot oil for 15 seconds
15. Add spinach and cook , stirring , for 1 minute
16. Set aside
17. In a small bowl , mix the cheeses and set aside
18. Assembling: move oven rack to lowest position and preheat to 475
19. Grease a 9" springform pan and sprinkle with corn meal
20. Roll half the dough out to a 12" circle
21. Reserve other half of dough for another use
22. Line the bottom and sides of the pan with the dough , but don't let any dough hang over the edge
23. Spread 1 1 / 2 cups of the cheese mixture over the bottom of the crust
24. Spread tomato sauce evenly over the cheese
25. Spread spinach over the tomato sauce
26. Sprinkle with remaining cheese
27. Arrange the tomato slices vertically , along the side of the pie , alternating the slices with the basil leaves
28. Place the remaining tomato slices in a circle in the center , alternating with the pepper slices , interspersing red and green strips
29. Bake for 25 minutes or until crust is golden and filling is bubbly
30. Let set 5 minutes before removing side of pan and cutting

title: egyptian kebabs
steps:
1. Cut chicken breasts into 1 inch cubes , 16 in total
2. Combine the yogurt , salt , turmeric , mustard , curry powder , cardamon , lemon juice and vinegar in a non reactive bowl
3. Add chicken cubes and let sit in fridge 30-45 minutes
4. Soak skewers in water
5. Thread chicken , onions and tomatoes onto skewers alternating as follows: chicken-onion-chicken-onion-tomato- onion-chicken-onion-chicken-onion
6. Grill or broil about 8-10 minutes , turning half way through cooking time
7. Garnish with parsley and serve with lemon wedges for squeezing on top

title: cooking light s crock pot italian pot roast
steps:
1. Slice roast in half for even cooking
2. Place in crock pot
3. Add onion and remaining ingredients
4. Cover and cook on high setting 5 hours or until roast is tender
5. Or , cover and cook on high setting one hour
6. Reduce to low setting , and cook 7 hours
7. Slice meat to serve

title: margarita mousse
steps:
1. Combine sugar with 1 tsp lime zest
2. Rub the rims of 4-6 margarita glasses with lime wedges to moisten , crunch into granulated sugar mixture , and place in the freezer
3. In a separate bowl , combine remaining lime zest , condensed milk , triple sec , tequila , and 1 / 3 cup lime juice
4. Set aside
5. Whip cream until stiff peaks form
6. Fold whipped cream into tequila mixture , working carefully to keep the air in the whipped cream
7. Spoon into prepared frozen glasses , making sure not to disturb the sugared rims
8. Refrigerate for 4 hours or until firm

title: squash sauteed with onions
steps:
1. Prepare squash and place slices on a paper towel
2. Sprinkle with salt and allow to stand 10 minutes
3. Heat olive oil in a medium size skillet and saute chopped onions
4. Dip out and set aside
5. Pat squash slices with a paper towel to soak up beaded water drops
6. Add vegetable oil to skillet and heat to medium temperature
7. Add squash slices and saute
8. Sprinkle with garlic powder
9. Lift squash to serving dish and top with onion pieces
10. Enjoy !

title: simple roast veggies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Chop up potatoes
3. Put in microwave for 2 minutes while chopping rest of veggies
4. Place all veggies in bowl
5. Add oil , vinegar and garlic , and toss to coat
6. Spread out in roasting pan and cook for about an hour

title: sausage stroganoff  korv stroganoff
steps:
1. Slice sausage into strips
2. In a skillet , brown over high heat
3. Add chopped onion and paprika to the skillet
4. Add tomato puree , mustard , bouillon cube , and water
5. Bring to a boil , then reduce heat to simmer and let simmer briefly over low heat
6. Season with pepper and salt to taste
7. Garnish with sour cream just before serving
8. Serve with rice

title: salted roast turkey with herbs
steps:
1. Herbed salt: rub first six ingredients in small bowl to crush herbs finely , or put in small food processor
2. Can be made a week in advanced
3. Cover and store at room temperature
4. Stir in peel before using
5. Turkey: rinse turkey inside and out
6. Remove excess fat , neck and giblets , wrap and refrigerate to reserve for roast or making gravy
7. Place turkey in a roasting bag and sprinkle inside and out with all of the herbed salt
8. Close bag , place on cookie sheet and chill 18 - 24 hours
9. Set rack at lowest position in oven and preheat to 325f rinse turkey inside and out
10. Pat very dry
11. Stir onion and next 5 ingredients into a bowl and stuff turkey in main cavity and neck cavity
12. Fold neck skin over cavity and secure with a skewer
13. Tuck wing
14. Place turkey on rack in roasting pan
15. Spread butter all over turkey
16. Place reserved fat , neck and giblets into bottom of roaster and pour 2 cups of chicken stock
17. Roast turkey 45 minutes
18. Baste with pan juices
19. Continue to roast until thermometer inserted into the thickest part of the thigh registers 165 - 170f , basting every 45 minutes and adding additional stock or water if the pan becomes dry
20. Tent loosely with foil if browning too quickly , roasting 3-3 1 / 2 hours total
21. Transfer turkey to a platter and tent with foil , letting rest for 45 minutes
22. Reserve juices in pan for making your favorite gravy

title: blueberry surprise french toast casserole
steps:
1. Place half of the bread cubes over the bottom of a well-buttered 13x9x2-inch baking dish
2. Sprinkle cream cheese and blueberries over bread cubes
3. Arrange remaining bread cubes over blueberries
4. In a large mixing bowl , beat eggs with a rotary beater , beat in milk and the 1 / 2 cup syrup
5. Carefully pour egg mixture over the bread mixture
6. Cover and chill in the refrigerator for 2 to 24 hours
7. Bake , covered , in a 375 oven for 25 minutes
8. Uncover and bake about 25 minutes more or till a knife inserted near the center comes out clean , and topping is puffed and golden brown
9. Let stand for 10 minutes before serving
10. Serve warm with blueberry-flavored or maple syrup
11. Or cut bread into 1 / 2-inch cubes , spread in a large baking pan
12. Bake , uncovered in a 300 oven for 10 to 15 minutes or till dry , stirring twice , cool

title: pumpkin bake
steps:
1. Steam the pumpkin till tender
2. Drain
3. Melt the butter in a pan and fry the onions , carrots and celery till soft but not brown
4. Add the breadcrumbs and herbs , season with salt and pepper
5. Set aside
6. Lightly butter a baking dish , and place half of the pumpkin on the bottom
7. Top with the vegetable mix , and , then the remaining pumpkin
8. Mix the yogurt , oil , egg and cheese together and put in the pan in which you fried the vegetables
9. Cook over low heat till cheese has melted
10. Pour the cheese mix over the pumpkin , place in over for 30 minutes , at 180c or till the cheese topping just begins to change colour

title: not your usual fruit and vegetable dip
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients
2. Stores well in the fridge , but may thin after awhile
3. Use dip with fruit or vegetables

title: pecan baklava cups
steps:
1. Preheat your oven to 375f spray a muffin pan with nonstick spray and set aside
2. Taking the dough from each crescent , gently press it into and around the sides of each muffin cup , making sure to seal the edges together
3. In a small bowl mix together the pecans , brown sugar , sea salt and cinnamon
4. Spoon the filling evenly into the crescent-lined muffin cups , gently tamping down with the back of a spoon
5. Place one tablespoon of butter on top of each cup
6. Bake for 15 minutes until the dough is puffed and golden and all of the butter is melted
7. Serve warm with a drizzle of honey or some vanilla ice cream

title: pistachio and poppy seed slices
steps:
1. Cream sugars with fats
2. Add the next eight ingredients
3. Mix well
4. Divide dough into 2 seven inch rolls
5. Cover and chill overnight
6. Preheat oven to 375f
7. Brush with two tablespoons milk , roll in poppy seeds then pistachios , and cut into 1 / 4 inch slices
8. Places slices 1 inch apart on a baking sheet
9. Bake at 375 degree for 8 minutes , keeping a close watch as they are easily scorched

title: chicken breasts baked with curried cream sauce
steps:
1. Preheat overn to 350f
2. Arrange chicken in single layer in baking dish
3. Mix yoghurt , flour and curry and pour over chicken
4. Sprinkle bread crumbs over top
5. Add water
6. Bake uncovered for 40 minutes

title: eagles grilled shrimp wrapped in patriots prosciutto
steps:
1. Pre-heat grill or stove-top grill pan
2. Place all ingredients for dressing in large bowl and whisk to combine
3. Reserve small amount in separate bowl as final garnish
4. Set both aside
5. Lay out prosciutto on work surface and cut each in half crosswise
6. Place a shrimp at one end of each slice and wrap with the prosciutto
7. Place on grill and cook about 3-4 minutes per side until done
8. Toss shrimp in dressing to coat well
9. To serve , arrange the colorful greens in the center of a large platter and surround with the shrimp
10. Drizzle the reserved dressing over shrimp and greens

title: fresh corn chowder  raw food
steps:
1. In the bowl of a blender , place half of the corn & then the water , tahini , scallions & pumpkin pie spice , & process until smooth
2. Add the rest of the corn & pulse several times , but don't process until smooth
3. Add salt & pepper to taste , then pour into 2 serving bowls & garnish , if desired , with the bell pepper & cilantro

title: simple hamburger vegetable soup
steps:
1. Brown beef and onion
2. Drain
3. Combine everything in a large pot and simmer for about an hour
4. Good soup to use leftovers in - beans , zucchini , etc
5. Very good the next day

title: easy oatmeal squares
steps:
1. In an 8-inch square glass or microwavable dish , microwave margarine at high power for 40 to 60 secnds , or until melted
2. Stir in extract and sugar , mix well
3. Stir in oats and mix well
4. In oven , bake at 350 degrees f or until bubbling and golden brown

title: roasted corn and tomato salad
steps:
1. Core tomatoes and cut into 1 / 2" cubes
2. Combine tomatoes , corn , diced onions , oil , vinegar , salt , basil and freshly ground pepper in a large bowl and toss gently to blend
3. Let sit for a few minutes
4. Add croutons and toss just before serving

title: southwestern corn soup
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients except cilantro in a 3-quart saucepan
2. Cook over medium heat stirring occasionally , until heated through and cheese is melted
3. Garnish with cilantro

title: copycat steak egg and cheese bagel from americans  1 fast food
steps:
1. Place the ribeyes on a cutting board
2. Using the rough side of a meat mallet pound the steaks on both sides covering the entire surface of the meat twice
3. Put the steaks in a plastic bag , add the worcestershire sauce and garlic salt and set aside to marinate for 15 minutes
4. You can cut up your veggies and get everything else ready ready
5. Heat a grill on medium high heat
6. Cook the steaks for 3 minutes on each side
7. Turn the grill off , place the bagels cut side down on the grate and keep the lid closed until you are ready to assemble the sandwiches
8. Heat two saute pans on medium heat
9. Add 1 tbsp butter to each pan , once the butter is almost melted add the peppers and onions equally to both pans
10. Add in the salt and stir
11. Saute the peppers and onions for 5 minutes or until soft
12. Whisk an egg one each into two separate bowls
13. Whisk in the mayonnaise into each bowl with the egg
14. Pour the egg mixture into each pan
15. Once the egg is set , flip over the entire egg to the other side
16. I use a small saute pan for this
17. Once the other side is set fold the egg in half like an omelet and then over again so that its folded in quarters
18. Take one side of each bagel off of the grill onto each plate
19. Top the bagel with the steak , then the egg , the cheese and lastly the top of the bagel
20. Cut in half and enjoy !

title: peanut butter rice krispie treats
steps:
1. Prepare a 9x9 pan by spraying with cooking spray
2. Over low heat , melt butter and marshmallows in a large , non-stick pan
3. Stir frequently until creamy
4. Add in peanut butter , and stir until smooth
5. Turn off heat and add in the cereal
6. Stir gently until cereal is evenly coated with mixture
7. Scrape into the 9x9 pan and smooth down until flat on top
8. Let cool , then cut into bars

title: prosciutto wrapped beef cubes with mustard pan sauce
steps:
1. Sprinkle beef on all sides with black pepper
2. Wrap beef cubes with enough prosciutto to cover entirely
3. Be sure that prosciutto doesn't overlap more than once
4. Place wrapped cubes seam side down on a plate
5. In a large skillet over medium heat , add oil and butter
6. When butter has melted add beef cubes , seam-side down to seal , then saute until crisp on all sides , about 8 to 10 minutes for medium rare
7. Remove beef and let rest 5 minutes before serving
8. Add shallots to pan and saute 1 minute to soften
9. Add chicken stock and scrape up brown bits stuck to the bottom of the pan with a wooden spoon
10. Whisk in mustard and heavy cream and cook 1 minute more to thicken sauce
11. Remove from heat
12. Season , to taste , with salt and pepper and garnish with parsley

title: buttermilk fried chicken with dill
steps:
1. Rinse chicken and pat dry
2. Set aside
3. Fill a large frying pan to 1 / 2 its depth with cooking oil
4. Heat to 325 degrees
5. Combine flour , dill weed , garlic salt and pepper in a medium bowl
6. Fill another bowl with the buttermilk
7. Place chicken , one piece at a time in the buttermilk
8. Shake of excess milk
9. Coat lightly in flour mixture
10. Shake off excess flour
11. Dip again in the butter milk and the flour mixture
12. Fry chicken , a few pieces at a time skin side down for 10 to 15 minutes
13. Turn chicken to fry 12 to 15 minutes longer or until juices run clear when pierced with a fork
14. Drain on paper towels
15. Let stand for 5 minutes before serving

title: portuguese chicken livers   rice
steps:
1. Heat butter in a skillet and saute livers over medium heat about 3 minutes until brown , but still pink inside
2. Remove and season with salt& pepper , chop coarsely and put aside
3. Heat the oil on medium heat
4. Add onion and garlic and saute until soft
5. Add rice , saute until rice just starts to take on a clear color
6. Don't scorch the rice
7. Add broth and tomato sauce
8. Mix well and bring to a boil
9. Add all other ingredients , except livers
10. Cover& cook over med
11. Heat for about 10 minutes
12. Stir lightly with a fork , reduce heat , cover and cook for about 10 minutes more until liquid is almost absorbed
13. Mix in the livers , stir , cover
14. Cover and cook until the liquid is absorbed and the rice is cooked through
15. Add more liqid if needed

title: the best no oil warm egg dressing over greens
steps:
1. Salad greens -- prepare your greens
2. Whatever you like
3. Tomato , bacon and onion are my favorites , but any of your favorites will work
4. This is about the dressing
5. Dressing -- i make this in a small tupperware container or small microwavable bowl
6. Add all the ingredients and mix well
7. Heat on medium for 30 seconds and stir well
8. Then heat again on medium power same thing just 30 seconds at a time and mix well
9. You do not want do scramble the eggs
10. Just a couple of times in the microwave to heat up the dressing is all you need
11. It should be served warm not boiled
12. Serve -- toss with the greens and enjoy ! one of my favorite dressings , and so easy

title: creamy honey mustard chicken or ham casserole
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine the soups , mayonnaise , milk and honey mustard
2. Stir in the hash browns , chicken or ham and mushrooms
3. Transfer mixture to a greased 13x9x2 baking dish
4. Cover and bake at 350 degrees for 45-50 minutes
5. Uncover and bake 15-20 minutes longer or until bubbly
6. Turn on the broiler for 2-3 minutes to brown the top if desired

title: creamy coriander   cilantro soup
steps:
1. Simmer the carrot , potato and leek in the broth until soft , roughly 10 minutes
2. To make the bchamel sauce , melt the butter over low heat in a deep saucepan
3. Sprinkle the flour over the butter and whisk until a pale golden color
4. Add the milk and whisk constantly for 10 minutes until the sauce is smooth and creamy
5. Season with the soy sauce and pepper
6. Remove from the heat , whisk in the egg yolks , being careful not to curdle the mixture , which will happen if it's too hot
7. Cook , stirring constantly , until the sauce thickens
8. In a food processor or blender , puree the carrot , potato and leek mixture with the broth
9. You'll have to do this in a few batches unless you have a really big blender
10. )
11. Add the coriander leaves and soy sauce and blend until smooth
12. Add the bchamel sauce and nuts to the food processor or blender and blend / chop
13. I added the nuts to about 2 cups of fluid so they'd break up easier instead of flying around in a huge sea of soup as far from the evil blades at the bottom as possible
14. I tricked them ! nya-ha-haaaaa !
15. Ahem sorry
16. Pour everything back into the saucepan over low heat and heat through , stirring
17. While still warm , toss in the cheese , stir for one minute and serve

title: tomato mozzarella  phyllo crust pizza
steps:
1. Set oven to 375
2. Brush a 15 x 10-inch baking pan with butter
3. Place 1 phyllo sheet in prepared pan
4. Brush with melted butter and sprinkle with 1-2 tablespoons parmesan cheese
5. Repeat layer with remaining phyllo , melted butter and parmesan cheese
6. Top with layers of mozzarella cheese onion , then tomatoes
7. Sprinkle with oregano and thyme
8. Bake for about 25-30 minutes until the edges are golden brown , the cheese melts and the tomatoes are tender
9. Let stand for 6 minutes before slicing
10. Delicious !

title: sardinian parchment bread
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f at least 40 minutes before baking
2. In a large bowl combine flours and salt and mix ingrediants thoroughly
3. Slowly add water , stirring with a wooden spoon until the mixture forms a soft dough with your hands , work the dough into a ball
4. Place on a clean , floured work surface and knead for about one minute
5. The dough should be firm and pliable , not sticky
6. Divide the dough evenly into 12 balls
7. Place the balls on a lightly floured surface
8. Flatten each ball into a thick 4-inch pancake
9. Generously flour the work surface and with with a heavy-duty rolling pin roll each portion of the dough as thin as possible into an 8" to 9" round
10. These breads are meant to be roughly shaped
11. Thinness is more important than the shape
12. The dough should be thin enough to see your hand through it
13. Place several rounds of dough on an ungreased baking sheet and place in the oven or place on a baking stone with a baker's peel
14. Bake until the top of the bread is firm and lightly browned , about 3 to 4 minutes
15. Baking time will vary and will also depend on the number of breads placed in the oven
16. With tongs or your fingers , turn the bread over and bake until the other side is slighly browned , 3 to 4 minutes more
17. Transfer the bread to a wire rack to cool
18. Repeat wtih the remaining rounds of dough
19. The bread cools quickly and can be served immediately

title: easy chicken and cheese enchiladas
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. In a medium bowl , stir together the soup , sour cream , picante sauce & chili powder
3. In a large bowl , stir together one cup of the soup mixture , the chicken & cheese
4. Divide the chicken mixture among the tortillas , roll them up & place them seamside up in a 11"x8" shallow baking dish
5. Pour remaining soup mixture over the filled tortillas , then cover with aluminum foil
6. Bake 40 minutes or until enchiladas are hot & bubbling , then top with tomato & onion

title: german potato cheese soup
steps:
1. Peel and prepare vegetables
2. In a large cooking pot , add water , chicken broth , chicken soup base , black pepper , carrots , potatoes , onions and bring to boil
3. Reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes or until vegetables are tender
4. Stirring occasionally
5. Add celery , sweet red pepper and simmer for 5 minutes more
6. Gradually add mayonnaise to hot soup , whisking until smooth
7. Reduce heat to medium and add processed cheese , sharp cheddar cheese and swiss cheese and simmer for 5 minutes or until cheese melts and soup is creamy
8. Stirring constantly
9. Add instant mashed potatoes and stir well
10. Let soup sit for 15 minutes before serving
11. This soup is very rich , but good
12. Refrigerate any unused portion
13. Serves 12

title: oven fried chicken thighs with panko and parmesan
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400
2. Line a large baking pan with foil and lightly grease or spray with nonstick cooking spray
3. Wash chicken thighs and trim excess fat and skin
4. Remove skin , if desired
5. Pat dry and sprinkle with salt and pepper
6. Combine the melted butter with mustard , honey or syrup , and garlic powder in a shallow bowl
7. In another shallow bowl , combine the panko crumbs with shredded parmesan , paprika , 3 / 4 teaspoon salt , 1 / 4 teaspoon pepper , and parsley
8. Brush or rub the chicken thighs with the butter and mustard mixture then press all sides in the panko mixture to coat thoroughly
9. Place on prepared baking sheet
10. Bake for 40 to 50 minutes , or until juices run clear when chicken is pierced with a fork

title: tofu migas
steps:
1. Ingredient prep: dice pepper and onion , drain and crumble tofu , and tear corn tortillas into 9 pieces each
2. Set ingredients aside
3. Spray a saut pan with cooking spray and saut onions until almost translucent
4. After cooking the onions almost completely , add the salsa , , peppers , and spices to the pan , saut on medium heat until onions are translucent
5. Add crumbled tofu , salt , and half of the margarine , saut until all of the margarine is fully incorporated
6. Add tortilla pieces and the rest of the margarine , and cook until the tortilla pieces are softened and incorporated
7. Serve in a bowl with a side of salsa , or serve with cheese on top for a heartier version

title: lentil casserole
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients except cheese in casserole dish
2. Cover and bake at 300 for 1hr
3. 45 minutes to 2 hours
4. My children will not eat this without cheese , so i top half with cheddar cheese and put back in the oven for five minutes to melt cheese

title: spinach rice bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325f
2. Cook rice in 1 1 / 2 cups water and olive oil according to package directions
3. Squeeze all of water out of thawed spinach and let set in colander while preparing other ingredients
4. In a large bowl beat eggs
5. Add milk , chopped onion , garlic , pepper and salt
6. Mix well
7. Add cooked rice , and drained spinach , stir well
8. Mix in cheddar cheese
9. Treat 2-qt casserole dish with nonstick cooking spray
10. Pour mixture into casserole dish
11. Bake for 30-40 minutes

title: deliciously soft gingersnaps
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Cream together the butter and sugar
3. Stir in eggs , molasses and vinegar
4. Stir in flour , baking soda , ginger , cinnamon and cloves- mix well
5. Form dough into 3 / 4" balls
6. Bake on a greased cookie sheet for 12 minutes

title: simple salsa soup
steps:
1. Place broth into your favorite soup pot
2. Heat broth on medium
3. Meanwhile , in a food processor , chop the onion and garlic , using 1 second pulses until well chopped , but not mushy , about 8 pulses
4. Add tomatoes , jalapeos , cumin , 1 tablespoon lime juice and pulse until mixture is very fine , almost pureed
5. You should have just about 1 cup of salsa
6. Turn up heat under soup
7. Add shredded chicken to broth
8. When soup just starts to simmer add salsa mixture , 1 tsp lime juice , and 1 tablespoon cumin
9. Quickly stir and remove from heat
10. Adjust seasonings to taste
11. To serve:
12. Cut mozzarella into to half inch thick round slices and place slices in bottom of soup bowls
13. Ladle the simmering broth into bowls over the cheese
14. Let the soup sit for about 2 minutes , to allow the heat of the soup to soften the mozzarella
15. Serve with garnishes on the side
16. Make sure to tell your guests that there is wonderful melted cheese on the bottom of the bowl !
17. Enjoy !

title: brown sugar chicken and veggies
steps:
1. Slice the veggies and layer in crockpot
2. Place chicken on the veggies
3. Combine sauce ingredients and pour over chicken
4. Cook on high for 4 hours or low for 8 hours

title: portuguese style pork chops  or chicken
steps:
