1. Prepare portuguese-style paste
2. Place pork chops in a shallow glass dish and rub pepper paste over both sides
3. Pour wine over the chops
4. Cover and refrigerate for at least six hours or overnight , turning once or twice
5. Drain marinade into a small saucepan
6. Add oil and bring to a simmer
7. Reduce heat to medium-low and cook , stirring occasionally , until slighly thickened , about 15 minutes
8. Stir in pepper and salt
9. Measure out 1 / 4 cup sauce for basting
10. Keep remainder warm
11. Meanwhile , heat grill to medium-high
12. Lightly oil grill rack
13. Place the chops on the grill
14. Cook , basting occasionally with pepper sauce , until browned and just cooked through , 2 to 2 1 / 2 minutes per side for 1 / 2 inch thick chops
15. Serve immediately , passing remaining pepper sauce separately
16. Variation: substitute boneless , skinless chicken breasts or skinned bone-in chicken for pork chops
17. Allow 4-6 minutes per side for boneless breasts , 20 to 30 minutes for bone-in pieces
18. Serves 6

title: vincent s lemon drop martini
steps:
1. Sugar the rim of a chilled martini glass
2. Shake the liquids with ice and strain into the glass
3. Garnish with the lemon slice

title: red snapper and nopalitos in cilantro sauce
steps:
1. Rinse and drain the nopalitos
2. In a large mixing bowl , combine the nopalitos with the cilantro , olive oil , lemon juice , salt and pepper
3. Place snapper filets in a 9x13-inch baking dish and top with the nopalitos mixture
4. Bake at 350f for 20 minutes or until the filets are cooked through

title: hot seasoned french bread with ham and tomatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Split loaf of bread in half , lengthwise
3. Set the bread , crusts side down , on a baking sheet
4. In a mixing bowl , combine the cheese , onion , olive oil , vinegar , oregano and olves
5. Season to taste
6. Spread the mixture over each bread half
7. Bake until hot
8. Remove from oven
9. Top the hot loaves with tomato slices , then ham
10. Eat hot accompanied with a green salad

title: black and berry  beer
steps:
1. Pour all of your 6oz frambois into a pint glass
2. Using a spoon to defuse , slowly pour guinness over back of spoon
3. Let settle a few minutes
4. It takes a few tries and a steady hand to get a perfect pour , but it tastes great whether you've got the layering effect down or not
5. You can substitute lindman's other flavors such as pomme , cassis , kriek , or peche
6. Also try with double chocolate stout instead of guinness
7. I like to use large wine glasses and layer for dinner parties
8. A very nice presentation for after dinner as a sort of dessert

title: linda s marsala pork and pasta bake
steps:
1. Brown pork chops in oil in a frying pan
2. Put aside when done
3. In a small saucepan , saute onions and garlic , in oil
4. When cooked , add marsala wine
5. Let come to boil , and simmer for a few minutes
6. Meanwhile cook the zita according to box directions
7. Drain
8. To the onions and garlic add soup , and sour cream , and turn down to low , so it doesn't boil
9. Mix well , and let simmer for about 5 minutes until heated
10. Add velveeta cheese cubes , and let melt , stirring until cheese is completely melted
11. Place pork chops in a single layer , in a lg round or square casserole dish but if you don't have one , use a casserole dish for this dish
12. Pour enough of the sauce mixture over the pork chops to completely cover
13. Add salt and cracked pepper , to taste
14. Pour drained pasta over the sauce and pork chops
15. Pour the rest of the sauce over pasta , and season again with salt and cracked pepper , to taste
16. Put in the oven and bake for 25-30 minutes until heated and bubbly

title: country style breakfast sausage
steps:
1. Mix meat and seasonings together
2. Shape into 12 patties
3. Spray skillet with non-stick spray
4. Brown patties on each side
5. Add a few tablespoons water to pan , cover to reserve moisture , and cook till done

title: strawberry daiquiris
steps:
1. Put all but garnish berries in blender
2. Mix until smooth
3. Pour immediately into 4 glasses
4. Garnish with strawberries
5. Serve at once

title: braised rabbit  italian style
steps:
1. Rinse the rabbit pieces in cold water and pat dry
2. In a deep wide skillet with a lid , put the oil , celery , garlic , and the rabbit in a single layer
3. Cover and simmer over low heat for about 2 hours
4. Turn the meat once or twice
5. If some of the ingredients begin to scorch , add a little water
6. After 2 hours , the rabbit may have thrown off a lot of liquid
7. Uncover the pan , turn the heat up to medium , and cook until the liquid has evaporated , turning the meat from time to time
8. Add the wine , rosemary , salt and pepper
9. Simmer , uncovered , until the wine has evaporated
10. Dissolve the bouillon cube , tomato paste , and sugar in the warm water
11. Pour it over the rabbit , and cook gently for another 12 to 15 minutes , basting and turning the rabbit two or three times
12. Serve immediately , accompanied by polenta if desired

title: cola braised pork stew
steps:
1. Heat oil in large pot over high heat
2. Add half of pork
3. Saut until brown
4. Transfer pork to bowl
5. Repeat with remaining pork
6. Return pork to pot
7. Turn off heat and slowly add cola into pot
8. Bring to a boil
9. Reduce heat to med-low , cover and simmer 30 minute
10. Add garlic , soy sauce , ginger , mushrooms and half of the onions
11. Cook and simmer until pork is tender , about 40 minutes
12. Uncover and simmer until sauce is slightly thickened
13. Season with salt and pepper
14. Transfer to bowl
15. Sprinkle with remaining onions
16. Serve over rice

title: new york style cheesecake adapted for india
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 150
2. Line a 13 by 9" pan
3. Crush the biscuits into fine crumbs with a hammer or in the grinder
4. Mix the crumbs , 3tbsp sugar and butter and press it firmly onto the bottom of prepared pan
5. Bake the crust for 10 minutes
6. Crumble the paneer and put in the jar of blender with the yoghurt , 3 / 4c sugar , flour and vanilla
7. Blend until smooth , pushing the mix down with a spatula if needed
8. Add eggs , one at a time , mixing well after each addition
9. Pour gently over crust
10. Dot tiny spoonfuls of jam over the batter
11. Bake 40 min or until centre is set
12. Cool completely
13. Refrigerate overnight

title: sally s red potato salad
steps:
1. Place unpeeled potatoes in the bottom of a large saucepan
2. Cover with water
3. Bring to a boil , cook until potatoes are soft , about 30-40 minutes
4. Drain
5. Let potatoes cool
6. Cube potatoes and place in a large mixing bowl
7. Add sour cream , mayo and celery
8. Stir to combine all ingredients well
9. Add salt and pepper , to taste
10. Top with papirka
11. Chill

title: grilled sweet peppers   onions
steps:
1. Grilled onion and pepper over medium coals until tender 12 to 15 minutes
2. Then saute for few minutes in a skillet until soften

title: cornflake chews
steps:
1. Heat all but cornflakes and peanut butter to boiling stirring constantly
2. Take off heat and stir in peanut butter until melted
3. Stir in cornflakes
4. Spread in greased pan
5. Cut when cool

title: swiss chard tacos with caramelized onion  cheese and chipotle
steps:
1. Cut the chard crosswise into 1-2 inch slices
2. In a large skillet heat the oil over medium-heat
3. Add the onion and stir occasionally for about 10 minutes , until they become golden and caramelized
4. Add the garlic and red pepper and stir for 1 minute , until fragrant
5. Add the broth , greens and a pinch of salt
6. Cover reduce heat to low and cook until the greens are almost tender , stirring occasionally
7. Remove lid and turn heat back to medium , stirring , until the mixture is nearly dry and adjust salt to taste
8. Meanwhile , heat a flat skillet over medium-high heat and warm the tortillas for a minute or so per side
9. Fill the warm tortillas with veggies and top with crumbled queso and salsa
10. You can use your favorite salsa , or make a quick , smokey chipotle salsa
11. Place 1-2 tomatoes , cut in half , half side down under the broiler with a few peeled cloves of garlic until slightly charred - a few minutes
12. Blend , tomatoes , garlic and 2-3 chipotles in adobo sauce with a splash of olive oil and salt and pepper to taste

title: holiday presents rice crispy treats
steps:
1. In large saucepan melt butter over low heat
2. Add marshmallows and stir until completely melted
3. Remove from heat
4. Add kellogg's rice krispies cereal
5. Stir until well coated
6. Using buttered spatula or wax paper evenly press mixture into 13 x 9 x 2-inch pan coated with cooking spray and / or lined with waxed paper
7. Cool
8. Cut into 2-inch squares
9. Use frosting to fasten stacks of two squares together
10. Decorate with additional frosting and / or candies
11. Tie bows on packages with licorice , if desired
12. Best if served the same day

title: phyllo wrapped asparagus
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. Snap off the tough ends of the asparagus
3. Unwrap the phyllo and cut the stack in half lengthwise
4. Reserve 1 stack for later use
5. Cover the phyllo with a damp towel to keep it from drying out
6. Take 1 sheet of phyllo and brush lightly with some melted butter
7. Sprinkle with some parmesan
8. Place 2 to 3 asparagus spears on the short end of the sheet
9. Roll up , jelly-roll style
10. Place each piece , seam side down , on a baking sheet
11. Brush with more melted butter and sprinkle with more parmesan
12. Repeat until all the asparagus spears are used up
13. Place baking sheet in oven and bake for 15 to 18 minutes , or until golden brown and crispy

title: sour cream babka
steps:
1. To prepare dough , combine cranberries and amaretto in a small bowl
2. Set aside
3. Heat milk over medium-high heat in a small , heavy saucepan to 180 or until tiny bubbles form around edge
4. Remove from heat
5. Stir in sour cream
6. Cool to room temperature
7. Dissolve yeast in warm water , and let stand 5 minutes
8. Place 1 / 2 cup granulated sugar , eggs , and egg yolks in a large bowl
9. Beat with a mixer at high speed until thick and pale
10. Add milk mixture , yeast mixture , 1 teaspoon almond extract , and salt
11. Beat until well blended
12. Lightly spoon flour into dry measuring cups
13. Level with a knife
14. Add 5 1 / 2 cups flour to egg mixture
15. Stir until a soft dough forms
16. Turn dough out onto a floured surface
17. Knead until smooth and elastic
18. Add enough of remaining flour , 1 tablespoon at a time , to prevent dough from sticking to hands
19. Place dough in a large bowl coated with cooking spray , turning to coat top
20. Cover and let rise in a warm place , free from drafts , 1 hour or until doubled in size
21. Punch dough down
22. Cover and let rest 10 minutes
23. Coat a 12-cup bundt pan with cooking spray
24. Dust with 1 tablespoon granulated sugar
25. Knead cranberry mixture , raisins , and almonds into dough
26. With floured hands , pat dough into an 8-inch circle
27. Form a 2-inch hole in center of dough
28. Place dough in prepared pan , allowing center of bundt pan to emerge through hole in dough
29. Gently press the dough into pan
30. Lightly coat top of dough with cooking spray
31. Cover and let rise 45 minutes or until doubled in size
32. Preheat oven to 350
33. Uncover dough
34. Bake at 350 for 45 minutes or until loaf is browned and sounds hollow when tapped
35. Cool in pan 5 minutes on a wire rack
36. To prepare icing , combine powdered sugar , 1 / 4 cup milk , and 1 / 4 teaspoon almond extract , stirring with a whisk
37. Remove babka from pan , and place on a serving platter
38. Drizzle with icing
39. Cool completely

title: meyer lemon gnocchi
steps:
1. Cover the potatoes in a medium sauce pan and bring them to a boil
2. Reduce heat and simmer over medium heat , until potatoes are tender
3. Drain potatoes and return them to the pan- shaking over medium heat until dry
4. Use a large rimmed baking sheet and rice the hot potatoes in an even layer
5. In a small bowl whisk the egg yolks , lemon zest , 1 teaspoon olive oil and the salt and pour over the potatoes
6. Sprinkle the flour over the potatoes and stir gently until a dough forms
7. Carefully roll the dough into four 1 / 2 inch thick ropes
8. Using a sharp knife , cut each rope into 1 / 2 inch pieces
9. Using a fork , roll each piece along the tines to make ridges in the gnocchi
10. Transfer the gnocchi to the baking sheet , cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate
11. Bring the chicken broth to a simmer in a small sauce pan
12. Remove from the heat and whisk in the 1 stick of butter- a few pieces at a time- until the sauce is creamy
13. Stir in the lemon juice and season with salt
14. Cook the gnocchi in a large pot of boiling salted water- until they rise to the surface , then cook them for 1 minute longer
15. Gently drain the gnocchi , toss with the remaining 2 tablespoons of olive oil and transfer to a baking sheet until cool
16. Melt 1 tablespoon of the butter in a large nonstick skillet
17. Add half the gnocchi and cook in a single layer over high heat until golden brown- about 2 minutes
18. Transfer to a large bowl and repeat with the remaining 1 tablespoon of butter and gnocchi
19. Reheat the sauce and pour it over the gnocchi and fold gently with a rubber spatula
20. Garnish with the chives
21. Enjoy !

title: gumbo z herbes
steps:
1. Wash the greens thoroughly and drain
2. Chop them coarsely , discarding any tough center stems
3. Put the greens in a large kettle with 1 cup cold water
4. Cover , bring to a boil and cook until the greens are wilted depending on type of greens being used
5. Drain , reserving the liquid
6. Add enough water to the liquid to yield 1-1 / 2 quarts
7. Heat the fat or oil in a heavy pot , add the flour and cook , stirring , about 15 to 20 minutes or until the roux is medium brown
8. Add the onion , garlic and green pepper and cook 5 to 10 minutes or until softened , stirring occasionally
9. Stir in the measured liquid with the bay leaf , thyme , salt , peppers and cayenne to taste
10. Add the greens , ham and sausage and mix well
11. Bring to a boil , then simmer for 1-1 / 2 to 2 hours , stirring occasionally
12. Discard the bay leaf , and taste and adjust the seasoning before serving , over rice

title: first daily ritual  meditation and tea
steps:
1. Boil water , add freshly cut ginger root
2. Turn off heat , let steep 5 minutes
3. Pour into your favorite coffee cup add juice of 1 / 2 a lemon , a little less if you are not used to having lemon at all
4. I sprinkled in some bee pollen here for a boost of b vit's first thing in the morning

title: chocolate chocolate chip cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Grease a 12 cup bundt pan
3. In a large bowl , mix cake and pudding mixes , sour cream , oil , eggs and water
4. Stir in chocolate chips and pour batter into prepared pan
5. Bake for 50 to 55 minutes
6. Serve plain , sprinkled with confectioner's sugar or drizzled with warm icing

title: ground pork tacos
steps:
1. Brown the ground pork in a large skillet
2. Add in undrained tomatoes , onion , and seasonings
3. Bring to a boil , then reduce heat to a simmer , stirring occasionally , until most of the liquid is gone- about 10 minutes
4. Spoon mixture into tortillas or taco shells , garnish as desired , and enjoy !

title: black raspberry ice cream
steps:
1. Puree raspberries
2. Strain through a jelly bag to remove seeds , if desired
3. Blend all ingredients in blender for one minute to thoroughly dissolve the sugar
4. Pour mixture into freezer can of ice cream maker and follow the manufacturers directions to process the ice cream

title: apple crunch
steps:
1. Sprinkle cinnamon and sugar over apples in baking dish
2. Mix dry ingredients with egg until crumbly
3. Sprinkle over apples
4. Bake at 350 degrees for 35-40 minutes

title: outdoor grilled cheese sandwich  curtis stone
steps:
1. For sandwich:
2. Preheat the barbecue for medium heat
3. Using a large serrated knife cut the ciabatta horizontally in half leaving one long side attached if possible
4. Lightly brush the cut sides of the ciabatta with olive oil and season lightly with salt and pepper
5. Rub the cut sides of the ciabatta with the garlic clove
6. Place the ciabatta oiled side down on the grill and cook until just barely golden brown rotating but not turning over to toast evenly about 3 minutes
7. Remove the ciabatta from the grill and reduce the heat of one burner to low
8. Spread the toasted side of the bottom ciabatta piece with the mustard
9. Spoon the chutney over the other toasted side
10. Scatter half of the gruyere cheese evenly over the mustard
11. Tear off pieces of the st andre cheese and scatter it over the gruyere
12. Then scatter the remaining gruyere cheese over
13. Cover with the top half of the ciabatta chutney side down and press firmly to hold the sandwich together
14. Lightly brush the sandwich with oil
15. Place the sandwich on the grill over the burner on low heat
16. Close the hood and grill until the cheese melts and the bread is golden brown rotating the sandwich as needed to brown evenly about 8 minutes per side
17. Transfer the sandwich to a cutting board
18. Open the sandwich and scatter the arugula over the cheese
19. Close the sandwich
20. Using the serrated knife cut the sandwich into 8 pieces and serve
21. Nectarine chutney:
22. Heat the oil in a heavy large saucepan over medium heat
23. Add the mustard seeds and saute until they begin to pop about 30 seconds
24. Add the onion and saute until tender and translucent about 4 minutes
25. Stir in the sugar , vinegar , ginger and pepper flakes
26. Simmer until the sugar dissolves
27. Add the nectarines and cook until the nectarines are tender but still hold their shape and the syrup tthickens slightly , stirring occasionally about 10 minutes
28. Now , stir in the salt

title: apple pie sausage stuffing
steps:
1. Combined all ingredients
2. Bake in a 9x13 baking dish 40 minutes on 375 in a preheated oven , or until firm and golden brown
3. You may also use this recipe for stuffing your turkey , chicken , or pork chops
4. I use this recipe for my boneless stuffed pork tenderloin
5. As follows: use 1- 3 to 5 pound boneless pork tenderloin that has been marinated and butterflied and pounded as flat as possible
6. Spread stuffing over entire loin and roll like a pumpkin roll
7. Tie and secure pork loin with butcher's twine , sear in a large skillet to seal in juices , cover in heavy duty foil for the first 30 minutes and uncover after that
8. Bake in a 350 preheated oven for 45 minutes to 1 hours
9. Let rest 10 minutes and slice

title: chicken tenders
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. In one bowl , whisk together egg , milk , optional tabasco sauce , paprika , and garlic powder
3. Place potato chips in another bowl , and crush thoroughly
4. Dip chicken in egg mixture , the roll in chips , carefully
5. Put chicken bits on a single layered greased baking sheet
6. Bake at 400 degrees for 10-13 minutes or until juices run clear
7. Serve with barbecue sauce , or creamy horseradish sauce

title: shortcut turkey chili
steps:
1. Thoroughly combine all ingredients in crockpot
2. Cover
3. Cook high 3-4 hours or til onion is tender

title: kl salat   cabbage salad
steps:
1. Mix the first four ingredients together thoroughly , stirring until sugar is dissolved
2. Add to prepared vegetables , toss lightly together until well mixed
3. Pile in a serving dish and keep refrigerated until ready to serve

title: vermont apple pie
steps:
1. Mix apples with 1 / 4 cup melted butter , cinnamon , nutmeg and 2 / 3 cup maple syrup
2. Place mixture in pie crust
3. Combine sugar , flour and softened butter
4. With a pastry blender , two forks or your fingers , mix until crumbly
5. Top apples with crumb mix
6. Bake at 450 degrees for 15 minutes
7. Reduce heat to 350 degrees and cook for 45 minutes

title: bulls eye
steps:
1. Butter each side of the bread
2. Put the bread on a frying pan at medium heat until warm and slightly soggy
3. Take a used can or a cup and make a hole in the middle of the bread
4. Put the egg in the new hole
5. Cook until the egg is done

title: couscous basics
steps:
1. In a saucepan , bring water to a boil
2. Add butter , salt and stir
3. Add couscous and remove from heat and allow to sit for about 5 minutes
4. Fluff with a fork

title: cinnamon apple dip
steps:
1. Mix the three ingredients together and chill
2. Serve with slices of raw apple and dip like potato chips

title: kabul party rice
steps:
1. Place carrots in saucepan add water , cover
2. Bring to a boil , reduce heat , cover and simmer for about 5 minutes
3. Drain
4. Melt margarine in a skillet on medium heat
5. Add onions , saut until lightly brown
6. Combine drained carrots , rice and onions
7. Stir in pine nuts , raisins , chilies , and spices
8. Simmer over low heat for about 10 minutes
9. Serve hot

title: honey dijon chicken with capers
steps:
1. Salt and pepper chicken on both sides to season
2. Heat oil over med
3. High in frying pan , cook chicken 5-6 minutes per side
4. Pour in broth , capers , rosemary and thyme
5. Return to simmer for 5 minutes
6. Stir in mustard , butter and honey and immediately remove from heat
7. Serve with spooning remaining sauce over each breast

title: very raspberry frappes
steps:
1. Thaw raspberries , if frozen
2. Place 1 cup berries in blender or food processor
3. Cover and blend or process until smooth
4. Press pured berries through fine-mesh sieve into bowl
5. Discard seeds
6. Add liqueur and jam to pureed berries
7. Whisk until smooth
8. For frappe:
9. Iin blender or processor combine berry mixture , gelato , and milk
10. Cover and blend or process just until combined , stopping blender to scrape down sides as needed
11. Stir in chopped chocolate or crushed cookies
12. Divide remaining berries and frapp between two chilled glasses
13. Top with chocolate or cookies
14. Serve with long-handled spoons

title: white bread
steps:
1. Combine milk and water in a microwaveable jar and heat for 1 minute
2. Put yeast in a small bowl with the sugar and a little of the warm milk and water mix and allow to prove
3. It takes about 10 minutes
4. It should have doubled in volume be frothy
5. Put flour in a large mixing bowl add salt and pepper and stir to combine
6. Add butter and crisco to the flour and rub into the flour
7. When the yeast has proved make a well in the middle of the flour and add the yeast and some of the milk and water mixture , stir into the flour , adding a little of the milk and water a little at a time , till a soft dough is formed
8. It may take more or less of the milk mix depending on the moisture content of your flour
9. Put flour on your hands and turn dough out onto a floured surface and knead for 10 minutes , add extra flour to dough and hands to prevent it from sticking
10. When dough is smooth , put into a large bowl that has been sprayed with pam to prevent it sticking , and cover with clingfilm and leave to rise , for about 1-1 1 / 2 hours or till it has doulbed in size
11. Its is best left in a warm area for this
12. After the dough has risen turn out onto a floured surface and knead for 5 minutes , then shape into desired loaf shape or put into pre greased loaf pan
13. Preheat oven to 400f
14. Cover the dough and leave to rise again for about 15 minutes
15. When dough has risen brush with egg wash and sesame seeds and a little kosher salt
16. Bake at 400f for about 30 minutes

title: truly creamy low carb reduced fat mini cheesecakes
steps:
1. Preheat your oven to 350 degrees
2. Using a stand mixer or hand mixer , combine cream cheese , sweetener , and vanilla
3. Mix until creamy and smooth
4. Add eggs , one at a time , blending until completely incorporated and very smooth
5. Using a 6 yield jumbo muffin tin , spray a very small amount of non-stick cooking spray into each muffin cup , or use paper liners
6. Carefully spoon batter into each cup , making sure they are evenly filled
7. Bake for 25 minutes , or until the cakes just begin to golden on the edges and the top
8. The consistency should be slightly "wiggly" when you remove them from the oven
9. This prevents over-baking , and produces a rich , creamy cheesecake rather than "spongey" cheesecake
10. Place the muffin tin on a cooling rack , and allow to cool for 10-20 minutes before removing
11. Chill in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours before serving
12. I recommend cool whip light , and a few fresh berries as a garnish
13. Enjoy !

title: witches  brooms
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f
2. Mix brown sugar , butter , water , and vanilla in a medium sized bowl until well combined
3. Stir in flour and salt
4. Shape dough inot 20 - 1 1 / 4" balls
5. Place pretzel rods on ungreased cookie sheet
6. Press a ball of dough onto the cut end of each pretzel rod
7. Press dough with fork to resemble "bristles" of a broom , making sure to leave the pretzel rod inside the dough covered
8. Bake about 12 minute or until set but not brown
9. Remove from cookie sheet
10. Cool completely on wire rack , about 30 minute
11. Cover cookie sheet with waxed paper
12. Place brooms on waxed paper
13. Heat shortening and chocolate chips over low heat in a small saucepan , stirring occasionally , until melted and smooth
14. Remove from heat
15. Spoon melted chocolate over brooms at the point where the dough meets the pretzel rod
16. Cover some of the pretzel rod and some of the cookie , but not the bristles
17. Drizzle with melted butterscotch chips across the chocolate to resemble string holding the bristles and broom together
18. Let stand until chocolate is set

title: italian eggplant  aubergine
steps:
1. Peel eggplant , cut in 1" cubes
2. Sprinkle with salt and let stand at room temperature for 30 minutes
3. Drain , dry with paper towles
4. Sprinkle with flour
5. Toss to coat eggplant lightly
6. Heat oil in large skillet , add eggplant
7. Saute 3-4 minutes
8. Melt butter in skillet over medium heat
9. Saute garlic 1 minute
10. Add tomatoes , celery salt , bay leaf , basil , salt , pepper and sugar
11. Bring to boiling
12. Reduce heat
13. Simmer uncovered 10-12 minutes
14. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
15. Place eggplant in buttered 2-2 1 / 2 qt baking dish
16. Pour tomato mixture over eggplant
17. Sprinkle with cimbined crumbs and cheese
18. Bake 25 minutes

title: monster  chocolate chip cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Spray cookie sheets with baking spray
3. Toast pecans in oven or in saucepan over medium heat
4. Cream shortening , butter , and sugars
5. Add eggs and vanilla
6. Combine dry ingredients
7. Add them to the creamed mixture and stir well
8. Stir in toasted pecans and chocolate chips
9. Dip a 1 / 4 cup baking scoop into a bowl of extra flour , tap excess flour off the scoop
10. Drop cookie dough by 1 / 4 cupfuls onto greased cookie sheet at least 2 inches apart
11. Bake 13-15 minutes
12. Cool on cookie sheet for about 5 minutes before removing from the baking sheet

title: sauteed swiss chard and corn
steps:
1. In a large saute pan cook bacon until crisp and remove all grease except for 2-tablespoons
2. Add bacon bits , corn , chopped shallots , chopped garlic and saute until garlic is soft
3. Add red swiss chard , fresh lemon thyme , lemon zest , salt and pepper
4. Saute until chard starts to wilt , add fresh lemon juice and saute for 1-2 minutes
5. Season with fine sea salt and fresh ground pepper to taste
6. Place the red swiss chard on hot plates and serve
7. Garnish with fresh lemon wedges

title: italian pepper and sausage dinner
steps:
1. In a large , skillet brown the sausage until it is cooked through
2. Drain the fat and drain the sausage on paper towels
3. In the same pan heat your olive oil add and saut the peppers , and onions , until the onion is translucent , then add the garlic and saut gently but do not brown your garlic
4. This will make the dish bitter
5. The vegetables should be tender
6. Stir in the tomatoes , spices , romano cheese and sausage
7. Cover the pan and simmer all over a medium-low heat for 8-10 minute
8. If your mixture seems too thick you can add a little water or red wine
9. While the meat mixture is cooking , the pasta can be prepared as per directions
10. You do not want to overcook your pasta
11. You want a little firmness to your noodles
12. When you are ready to serve use a large platter
13. The noodles first , then spoon the meat mixture over
14. Mix slightly
15. Sprinkle with the parigiano-reggiano and place your fresh basil leaves atop
16. This goes well with a full bodied red wine , a green salad with italian oil and vinegar dressing , and most of all a good hard crusted peasant bread

title: applesauce cookies
steps:
1. Cream margarine and sugar
2. Add eggs and applesauce blending well
3. Add dry ingredients and fold in raisins and nuts
4. Chill 1 hour
5. Bake on greased cookie sheet 350 for

title: best low carb bread  bread machine
steps:
1. Using a 1 pound capacity bread machine , combine ingredients according to order given in bread machine manual
2. Select 'light' browning setting
3. Don't remove bread until it is cooled
4. Cut into slices , and store , covered , in the refrigerator

title: spicy rice with fruit
steps:
1. Heat a large dry pan ove medium heat
2. Add the rice and stir it , dry , for 5 minutes
3. Add the juice and water , the vanilla , the allspice and lemon rind
4. Bring to a boil and let it boil for 5 minutes
5. Add the fruit and reduce heat to a simmer
6. Put a top on , leaving it slightly open , and simmer for about 20 minutes or until the rice is tender
7. Add more apple juice if it is needed
8. Serve warm or cold

title: easy tofu scramble
steps:
1. Grease a small skillet with 1 / 2 tablespoon olive oil and add to the oil the chopped soy sausage , onion and garlic
2. Cook until browned
3. In a second skillet , add the remainder of the oil and add the crumbled tofu , salt , pepper , and spices
4. Cook for a couple of minutes and then add the contents of the first skillet to the second
5. Cook together for about 5 minutes
6. Serve hot

title: toasted oatmeal
steps:
1. Melt butter or margarine in a small frying pan over medium / medium low heat
2. Add the oatmeal and stir so that it is evenly coated
3. Cook until the oatmeal starts turning golden brown and a little crunchy , about 3 to 5 minutes
4. Add the brown sugar , again stirring well to coat the oatmeal
5. Cook 1 to 2 minutes more , until the brown sugar is completely melted and dispersed , and the oatmeal is very golden brown
6. Serve on top of yogurt , or with a small amount of milk or cream

title: diva licious pesto pizza
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425
2. Prepare pesto sauce by combining basil , pine nuts , garlic and parmesan in blender or food processor
3. Blend well
4. Slowly drizzle olive oil in blender or processor while blending , until thick
5. Season to taste with salt
6. Set aside
7. Heat a little olive oil in skillet and saute mushrooms a few minutes to increase flavor
8. Cool slightly
9. Spread pesto sauce over pizza crust
10. Evenly distribute provolone , red bell peppers , black olives and artichokes over pesto
11. Sprinkle with additional parmesan , if desired
12. Bake in preheated oven 15 minutes or until cheese is bubbly

title: the best chicken riggies
steps:
1. Saute chicken , onion , and garlic in butter and oil , until lightly browned in a heavy saucepan over med-high heat
2. Season with salt and pepper
3. Add mushrooms , olives , peppers , basil and oregano
4. Season with salt and pepper
5. Cook 5-10 mins over med
6. Heat
7. Add tomato puree and chicken broth
8. Bring to a boil , then reduce heat to low , cover and simmer
9. Cook pasta in a large pot of boiling salted water
10. Once al dente , drain and return to pot
11. Right before draining pasta add cream to sauce and turn off heat
12. Add sauce to pasta
13. Serve with grated cheese and lots of italian bread

title: cabbage kielbasa supper
steps:
1. In a 5-qt slow cooker , combine the cabbage , potatoes , onion , salt and pepper
2. Pour the broth over all
3. Cut sausage into serving-size pieces and place on top
4. Cover and cook on low for 8-9 hours

title: quick   easy taco dip
steps:
1. In a deep casserole dish or pie plate , spread cream cheese on bottom with spoon
2. Spread chili on top of cream cheese layer
3. Spread shredded cheese on top
4. Bake in a 350 degree oven until cheese on top is completely melted
5. Remove from oven
6. Let dip settle for about 10 minutes
7. Serve with your favorite tortilla chips

title: meatball soup   avgolemono
steps:
1. Combine the first 8 ingredients and make meatballs 1 inch diameter
2. Let them stand in the refrigerator
3. Put the vegetables in a large pot and cover with water
4. Add the 4 tbsp of live oil , salt and pepper and let simmer in medium heat for 20-30 minutes , until they are just becoming tender
5. Add the meatballs and let simmer for 20-25 minutes more
6. You should add more water if it evaporates
7. When meatballs and vegetables are cooked , remove from the heat
8. Beat the egg whites until they become frothy
9. Add the egg yolks and the juice of the lemon and beat until they are incorporated
10. Now this step is crucial if you don't want your eggs to be fried in the soup
11. Add one table spoon of hot soup in the bowl with the beaten eggs and stir
12. Repeat adding one tablespoon of hot soup at a time , until the egg and soup mixture is hot in itself
13. I think 1 cup of soup is enough for that
14. Then add the egg and soup mixture into the pot with the hot soup and gently stir
15. Serve with fresh grounded black pepper
16. Correction: forgot to mention that it is usually served hot in cold winter days
17. But i find no reason why a cold serving wouldn't be appealing to some as a cold soup , as a reviewer mentioned

title: cucumber salad with sour cream and chives  german gurkensalat
steps:
1. Peel cucumbers and slice them paper thin , and drain if watery
2. In a medium bowl , mix together the sour cream and chives
3. Add cucumber slices and stir gently to coat
4. Season to taste with salt and pepper
5. Serve immediately , or cover and chill for up to one day

title: angel hair pasta with basil tomato sauce  and chicken
steps:
1. Saut garlic and shallot in oil over medium heat until garlic golden and shallot wilted
2. Add tomatoes and season with salt , pepper , and basil
3. Chop cooked chicken into bite size pieces
4. Add pasta , water , and chicken to sauce , stir gently in to coat
5. Move to serving platter , sprinkle with parmesan cheese , and serve

title: mom s orange curry chicken
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375 degrees f
2. Rinse and remove skin from chicken pieces and dry thoroughly
3. Sprinkle chicken with curry powder to cover and a little salt on both sides and rub into meat
4. Arrange chicken in baking dish sprayed with cooking spray , "skin"-side down
5. Combine orange juice , honey and mustard in saucepan
6. Simmer for 5 minutes
7. Pour over chicken and bake for 30 minutes
8. Turn chicken and continue baking another 20-30 minutes or until richly browned
9. Remove chicken to heated serving dish
10. Add orange cartwheels to sauce and heat on stove 1 minute , scraping bottom of pan
11. Pour sauce over chicken and serve

title: chick fil a slaw
steps:
1. To make the dressing: mix everything together except the cabbage and carrots
2. Mix dressing with cabbage and carrots

title: tajik non  flat bread with shallots
steps:
1. Place 1 / 2 cup warm water in a large bowl , stir in sugar , then sprinkle on yeast and stir to dissolve
2. Set aside
3. Place yogurt and one cup water in a saucepan , stir to mix , then place over medium heat , stirring occasionally , until lukewarm
4. Add the yogurt mixture to the yeast and water mixture and stir
5. Add the whole wheat flour one cup at a time , stirring in one direction only as you add the flour then stir for about one minute in the same direction to activate the gluten
6. Let this sponge stand , covered , for 10 minutes or for as long as 2 hours
7. Sprinkle 1 tablespoon salt over the sponge , then stir in unbleached flour one cup at a time until dough is too stiff to stir
8. Turn it out onto a lightly floured surface and knead for 10 minutes , until the dough becomes smooth and elastic , incorporating more unbleached flour as necessary to prevent dough from sticking
9. Rinse out , wipe and lightly oil your bread bowl
10. Add the dough , cover with plastic wrap , and let rise until doubled in volume , approximately 1 1 / 2 hours
11. Position a rack in the top third of your oven
12. Arrange unglazed quarry tiles on it , leaving a 1-inch gap between tiles and the oven walls
13. Preheat the oven to 500 degrees f
14. Gently punch down the dough and turn out onto a lightly floured surface and let rest , covered , for 10 minutes
15. Place shallots and remaining salt beside your work surface , together with a bowl of lukewarm water
16. Divide dough into 8 equal pieces
17. Using lightly floured hands , press each piece into a 4-inch round
18. Work with one round at a time , leaving the others covered at the back of your work surface
19. Working on a lightly floured surface , roll out to a 6-inch round
20. With a fork or bread stamp , or the edge of a wire whisk , stamp a 1 1 / 2-inch diameter circle at the center of the bread thoroughly , to flatten and pierce it
21. Sprinkle onto the center approximately 1 / 2 teaspoon chopped shallot , a pinch of salt , and a sprinkle of water
22. Quickly roll out and prepare one , two , or three more breads , then transfer prepared breads to the hot tiles , stone , or baking sheets
23. Begin shaping your next breads as the first batch is baking
24. Let bake for approximately 7-8 minutes , or until lightly golden
25. Use a long-handled peel to remove from the oven
26. Place on a rack to cool , then stack and wrap loosely in a cotton cloth to keep soft and warm
27. Shape and bake remaining breads in the same way

title: aloo phujia
steps:
1. Lightly brown onion in oil in medium skillet
2. Stir in salt cayenne turmeric and cumin
3. Add potatoes and cook 20 minutes stirring occasionally
4. Add tomatoes
5. Cover and cook until potatoes are soft , about 20 minutes

title: baked beans and pineapple
steps:
1. Spray a medium sized pot with no stick spray
2. Add oil enough to barely cover and add onions- saut slowly until just soft place in medium sized casserole
3. Add remaining ingredients- stir to mix
4. Bake uncovered in 350f oven for 1 1 / 2 hours or until bubbly , stirring once or twice

title: spicy jumbo shrimps with old cape flavours
steps:
1. In a large bowl mix the ingredients from the yoghurt , down to the salt
2. Whisk well
3. It's best to do this well ahead , and leave this sauce , covered , at room temperature -- the flavours meld and improve a lot
4. Place the cleaned shrimps in a large oven dish or tin , and coat the shrimps with the mixture
5. Keep some of the sauce for later , if there is enough
6. Shake the dish , so the thickish sauce penetrates to the bottom of the dish
7. Marinate the shrimps in the fridge for 1 hour
8. To grill over hot coals , skewer the shrimps close together on skewers
9. Grill quickly and carefully only until they curl up and turn pink , using any leftover or extra sauce to brush them with
10. Or bake in a 350 deg f / 180 deg c oven , brushing once with the rest of the marinade
11. Bake only until they turn pink and curl up -- better watch this , as i forgot to time this bit ! if they're cold out of the fridge they will take longer -- it's better to take the dish out of the fridge 30 minutes before cooking time
12. If done in the oven , serve with the juices , over rice
13. If grilled on skewers , serve with salads and bread
14. Be warned that shrimps shrink a lot in cooking , and as a main dish 2 lbs / 1 kg will really only serve 4 adults !
15. You could stretch it by serving it as a starter , on baby mixed greens moistened with vinaigrette
16. Serve with crusty bread
17. Prep time does not include cleaning the shrimps or the marinating time

title: red snapper with tomato saffron vinaigrette
steps:
1. Broil the snapper if you wish
2. I prefer to pan broil them in a heavy non-stick pan
3. First , rub salt and freshly ground pepper into the surface of the fish
4. Add a film of oil to the pan and set over medium high heat
5. Cook the fillets until done , about 3-5 minutes on each side , according to the thickness of the fish
6. When done , remove to serving a plate and keep warm
7. Heat the oil in a small skillet
8. Add the saffron and cook over low heat for 5 minutes
9. Add the shallot and minced garlic and cook , stirring occasionally , until fragrant , about 2 minutes
10. Add the tomatoes and cook until slightly softened , about 3 minutes
11. Add the chicken broth and cook just until the tomatoes begin to break down , about 3 minutes longer
12. Remove from the heat
13. Add the vinegar and chopped parsley and season with pepper
14. Spoon the tomato vinaigrette sauce on the fish and serve

title: salmon with couscous vegetable salad
steps:
1. Combine couscous and broth in a saucepan , bring to a boil
2. Turn off heat and let stand for about 10 minutes , or until the water is absorbed
3. Add the next 8 ingredients to the couscous , mixing thoroughly
4. Heat the grill or broiler
5. Grill or broil the salmon for 4-5 on each side , or until fish flakes easily with a fork
6. Serve salmon with couscous vegetable salad
7. Place lemon wedge on plates for individual use

title: toddler tahini dip spread
steps: 1. Mix the two and enjoy

title: kicked up monte cristos
steps:
1. Place 4 pieces of bread on work surface
2. Evenly divide gouda , ham and turkey between the bread slices
3. Top with remaining 4 slices of bread , making 4 sandwiches
4. You can cut the sandwiches in half , or leave them whole
5. Secure with toothpicks , if necessary
6. In a shallow dish combine eggs , milk and flour
7. Beat well
8. Heat oil to 375 in large skillet to about 1 / 2 inch depth
9. Carefully dip each sandwich into egg batter , coating both sides
10. Fry sandwiches , a few at a time , about 1 minute each side , until golden brown
11. Drain on paper towels
12. Meanwhile , gently heat raspberry preserves with cayenne in microwave , or small pan
13. Dust with powdered sugar and serve with warmed preserves for dipping

title: sausage and summer squash
steps:
1. Preheat broiler
2. In a small bowl combine dressing and garlic
3. In an extra-large skillet cook sausage and squash in 2 tablespoons of the dressing mixture for 8 to 10 minutes or until sausage is heated through and squash is almost tender , stirring occasionally
4. Meanwhile , toast italian bread lightly
5. Or if you prefer , you can place the bread slices on a broiler pan , brush with 1 tablespoon of the dressing mixture , and broil 3 to 4 inches from heat for 1 to 2 minutes , until lightly toasted
6. Serve sausage and squash with the toasted bread
7. Drizzle with any remaining dressing
8. Sprinkle with oregano
9. Top with a little parmesan cheese , if desired

title: chris  texas style chili con carne
steps:
1. Cut beef into 1 / 2 inch cubes
2. In an 8 quart dutch oven over medium high heat , in hot cooking oil , cook 1 / 3 of the meat at a time until browned on all sides
3. With a slotted spoon , remove the meat to a bowl and set aside
4. Add the onions , green peppers , and garlic to the drippings in the dutch oven
5. Cook 10 minutes over medium heat stirring occasionally
6. Add more oil if necessary
7. Return the meat to the dutch oven
8. Add tomatoes and remaining ingredients except the cheese
9. Over high heat , heat to boiling
10. Reduce heat to low , cover and simmer 1 1 / 2 hours or until meat is fork tender
11. Stir occasionally
12. Serve with cheese and additional raw onions

title: gluten free smoky ginger quiche bites
steps:
1. Crush the cookies in food processor or large ziplock bag , then stir in melted butter
2. Put 1 teaspoon cookie mixture into 18-22 mini tart or mini muffin cups
3. Tamp down with thumb or tart press to create a bottom crust
4. Combine the rest of the ingredients except the turkey bacon
5. Spoon about 1-2 tablespoons of the mixture into each mini tart cup
6. Sprinkle turkey bacon over the tops of each quiche
7. Cover with foil and bake at 350 for 15-20 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean
8. Remove foil and broil 2-5 minutes or until lightly browned on top
9. To bake a full pie: cover with foil and bake at 350 for 50-60 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean
10. Remove foil and broil 2-5 minutes or until lightly browned on top

title: spanish bulgur
steps:
1. In large skillet with lid combine oil , onion , green pepper , red pepper , and garlic
2. Cook over medium heat , stirring occasionally , until softened
3. Add bulgur , tomatoes , broth , carrots , paprika , and black pepper
4. Cover , reduce heat to medium low for 10 minutes
5. Add artichokes hearts , eggplant and zucchini
6. Recover , and continue cooking for 10 more minutes
7. Stir in peas and parsley
8. Serve !

title: cat s eyes
steps:
1. Spread peanut butter on crackers and top each with a slice of banana
2. Place a raisin in the center of each banana to form a cat's eye and repeat for all banana topped crackers
3. Eat and enjoy !

title: easy pot roast
steps:
1. Place roast in large pot
2. Pour mushroom soup and onion soup packet over the roast
3. Cook at 350 degrees covered for 1 1 / 2 hours

title: medley of oven roasted veggies with lime juice and feta cheese
steps:
1. Wash , clean and cut veggies into long finger-thin pieces
2. Make sure to separate kohlrabi and carrots from the other veggies as they need to bake longer
3. Pre-heat the oven to 200c / 400f
4. Mix lime / lemon juice , oil , cinnamon , salt and sugar
5. Spread carrots and kohlrabi pieces on a baking sheet
6. Pour some of the marinade on top and make sure to coat well
7. Bake for 5 minutes
8. Add rest of the veggies and coat with remaining marinade
9. Bake for 10 more minutes and then crumble the feta cheese over the veggies
10. Return to the oven and bake for another 10 minutes
11. Serve with crusty bread or enjoy as is
12. :)

title: pacific blue sangria
steps:
1. Combine all the ingredients except the 7-up in a large ceramic or glass container and stir well
2. Cover and refrigerate for at least 4 hours
3. Serve over ice and top with 7-up
4. Garnish with an orange wheel or pineapple wedge

title: tulum style hand held burritos
steps:
1. Heat oil in a wide skillet
2. Saute onion and garlic until soft
3. Season to taste with pepper
4. Add spinach and cilantro , remove from heat and cover until greens are wilted
5. Stir in adobo sauce , cooked rice , beans and sausage , until well mixed
6. Return to burner and heat gently until hot through
7. Remove from heat and stir in diced bell pepper
8. Place a warmed tortilla on a plate
9. Spoon a half cup or more of hot rice mixture down the center
10. Top with shredded cheese , guacamole , sour cream and olives , to taste
11. Fold the bottom of the tortilla up , then fold one side over filling and roll closed , leaving the top open to see what you're eating ! repeat with remaining tortillas and filling

title: potatoes au gratin with brie and chives
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Coat a 2 -quart baking dish with cooking spray and set aside
3. Cut potatoes into quarters and place in a steamer basket set over boiling water
4. Steam 15 minutes
5. Drain in a colander
6. When cool enough to handle , peel potatoes and dice into -inch cubes
7. Spread potatoes in prepared baking dish
8. Add salt , pepper and chives , mixing well
9. Cut the rind off the brie and discard
10. Cut brie into pieces and place on top of potatoes
11. Pour cup broth over potatoes
12. Place baking dish in oven and bake 20 minutes
13. Check liquid surrounding potatoes and add a little additional broth if necessary
14. Reduce heat to 350 degrees and bake 40 minutes longer , or until top is golden brown and the potatoes are soft
15. Remove from oven and let rest 5 minutes before serving

title: kieran s fave chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Grease a 13x9 baking dish
3. Rinse & pat dry chicken pieces
4. Place chicken , skin side up , in the dish
5. Mix remaining ingredients together , pour evenly over chicken
6. Bake , uncovered , for 1 hour

title: creamy jalapeno dipping sauce
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine all ingredients
2. Stir until smooth
3. Serve with spicy wings or other favorite appetizer as a dip

title: pan fried mackerel with red  pepper and squash
steps:
1. Prepare mackerel:
2. Clean , remove heads and tails , split fish down the spine and remove bones , wash fillets and set aside
3. This will yield 4 fillets
4. Cook vegetables:
5. Heat 1 tablespoon olive oil in large frypan over medium heat
6. Add onion , saut stirring for 1 minute , add ginger , stir
7. Add the squash , chayote , salt , pepper and lemon juice , continue to saut until vegetables are tender crisp
8. Add the pepper strips , parsley and cook for 1 minute
9. Remove from heat , set aside , keep warm
10. Cook fish:
11. On a flat dish combine cornmeal , flour , salt , cayenne pepper and paprika
12. In a large frypan over medium-high heat melt butter and 3 tblsp
13. Olive oil
14. Roll fillets in cornmeal mixture , shake off excess
15. Place in frypan skin side up , cook 3 to 5 minutes , flip over and cook another 3 to 5 minutes
16. Serve immediately with warm vegetables on the side
17. Enjoy !

title: incredibly simple yogurt smoothie
steps:
1. Combine the milk and yogurt in a sippy cup [or regular cup for older kids and adults]
2. Put the sippy cup lid on and shake , or stir with a spoon
3. If your child is a slow drinker , add ice to keep it cold
4. Enjoy !

title: chicken and tortillas in chili cheese sauce
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Place chicken , chopped onion , celery , garlic slices and peppercorns in medium saucepan
3. Cover with water and bring to boil over high heat
4. Reduce heat and let simmer 20 minutes
5. Remove chicken and cool slightly , shred chicken
6. Toss tortilla strips and oil in large bowl
7. Arrange on baking sheet and bake until crisp let cool slightly
8. Transfer chicken to large bowl
9. Add tortilla strips , cheese and chilis
10. Stir to coat well
11. Pour into 8x8 baking pan
12. Combine sour cream , green onion , cilantro and garlic
13. Mix well
14. Spread sour cream mixture over chicken
15. Bake until cheese melts , about 20 minutes

title: mocha ganache
steps:
1. Microwave whipping cream in a glass bowl at high 1 minute and 30 seconds or until hot , stirring once
2. Add chocolate morsels and coffee granules
3. Stir until smooth
4. Chill 30 minutes or until spreading consistency

title: vegan challah
steps:
1. In one small bowl , dissolve yeast in the warm water , put to the side to stand for 5-10 minutes
2. Mash bananas in other small bowl
3. In large bowl mix: oil , sugar , salt , and boiling water , stirring so it's all mostly dissolved
4. 4add the cold water to the large bowl
5. Stir in yeast mix
6. Add bananas
7. Add flour , one cup at a time
8. Turn out onto lightly floured surface
9. Knead for 5-10 min , dough should be smooth , not too stiff or too runny
10. Lightly coat the large mixing bowl in oil , turn the dough in it to just coat it with oil , place a towel over the dough in the bowl and let it rise for about 1 hr , till double in volume
11. Punch dough down , turn out and knead again 2-3 minute divide dough into 2 balls , divide each ball into 3 sections , roll each section into long ropes and make 2 braids
12. Preheat the oven to 350
13. Let the braids rise 45 minute boil a little more water
14. Just before putting braids in the oven , brush them with boiling water , then sprinkle with sesame seeds , poppy seeds , or sea salt

title: ceviche
steps:
1. Juice lemons
2. Chop up everything
3. Mix it up , add lemon juice
4. Refrigerate for 8 hours , or overnight

title: oats and peanut butter giant cookies
steps:
1. In a bowl , with an electric mixer , beat peanut butter and butter
2. Add brown sugar , sugar , baking powder , baking soda and mix until creamy and homogeneous
3. Add eggs and vanilla while beating
4. Add oats , peanuts and m & m chocolate
5. Mix with a wooden spoon
6. Let drop dough , 1 / 4 cup at a time , on an ungreased baking sheet , leaving room of 4 inch between cookies
7. Cook in a preheated oven of 350 f for 15 minutes or until the sides of cookies are lightly golden
8. Put baking sheets on racks and let cool for 2 minutes
9. Removed the cookies and let cool completely on a rack

title: mexican pinwheels
steps:
1. In a bowl , add the first 9 ingredients
2. Stir to combine
3. Spread 1 / 2 cup mixture onto each tortilla
4. Roll up
5. Wrap individually in saran wrap
6. Chill for 8 hours
7. Remove saran wrap
8. Cut each roll into 12 slices
9. Secure with wooden toothpicks
10. Serve with salsa

title: easy chocolate banana cream pie
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl , combine pie filling , milk , vanilla and half of the whipped topping
2. Mix on low speed until well blended
3. Increase speed and beat until thick , about 2 minutes
4. Pour 1 / 3 of the mixture into crust
5. Layer sliced bananas on top reserving 1 / 2 the bananas for garnish
6. Pour remaining filling into crust , chill 2 hours
7. Garnish with remaining bananas , whipped topping and drizzle with chocolate syrup

title: veal and avocado
steps:
1. Cut avocado in half all around and down to the pit
2. Twist the avocado to separate the halves
3. Hit the pit with your knife to pop it out
4. Scoop the avocado out of each half of skin with a large spoon
5. Slice the avocado and squeeze a little lemon juice on it to retard the browning
6. Reserve the avocado
7. Season the scallops of veal with salt and pepper
8. Heat the extra-virgin olive oil and butter in a large skillet over medium to medium high heat
9. Add the veal and cook 2 minutes on each side
10. Remove the veal to a platter or individual plates
11. Add vermouth or wine to the pan and deglaze it , lifting up any color or veal bits
12. Add cream and stir it inches
13. Turn off the heat and let cream bubble 1 minute
14. Arrange the avocado on the scallops of veal
15. Strap the meat and avocado with sauce and garnish with a generous sprinkle of chopped thyme or chives

title: corn and black bean wraps
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees f
2. In a medium bowl , combine black beans , corn , cheese , cilantro and salsa
3. Mix well
4. Spoon 1 / 4 of bean mixture down center of each tortilla
5. Fold in ends and then roll up each tortilla
6. Wrap each in aluminum foil
7. Bake at 350 degrees f for 10 minutes or until heated through and cheese is melted
8. Serve with guacamole and additional salsa

title: indian guacamole
steps: 1. Combine all ingredients and mash to desired consistency

title: one bowl pumpkin bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Spray loaf pan with pam or other cooking spray
3. In medium-sized bowl , mix oil and splenda until combined
4. Add egg and mix well
5. Add vanilla extract and pumpkin
6. Mix well
7. Add flour all at once
8. Mix until smooth
9. Sprinkle baking soda and baking powder over batter
10. Mix well
11. Sprinkle cloves and cinnamon over batter
12. Mix well
13. Fold in walnuts
14. Pour batter into loaf pan , scraping sides
15. Bake in center of the oven at 350 degrees for one hour

title: spinach and cheese turkish pides
steps:
1. Melt butter in frying pan over medium heat , add garlic and spinach
2. Cook , stirring for 30 - 60 seconds until spinach just wilts
3. Transfer to bowl and cool for 10 minutes
4. Add the scallions , ricotta , feta , pine nuts and breadcrumbs to the spinach
5. Season with salt and pepper
6. Preheat oven to 200c lightly grease two large baking trays
7. Cut pizza dough into four
8. Roll out to a 25cm oval shape
9. Spoon filling onto centre of each oval , fold in sides and twist ends
10. Place onto prepared trays , allowing room for spreading
11. Spray lightly with oil
12. Bake for 25-30 minutes or until crisp and golden
13. Serve with lemon wedges

title: martha s gingerbread men
steps:
1. Cream the butter and sugar until fluffy
2. Add egg yolks
3. Add golden syrup or honey
4. Add vanilla extract
5. Beat thoroughly
6. In another bowl combine all dry ingredients and mix
7. Add to creamed mixture about a cup at a time
8. Knead lightly with floured hands towards the end
9. The dough will be quite soft but should hold its shape
10. Cut into 4 pieces and refrigerate for half an hour
11. Take out a quarter of the mixture and lightly knead on a floured surface then roll out about 1 / 4 inch thick
12. Cut into'men' with cookie cutters or into circles if preferred
13. I use an egg lifter to help get them onto the baking trays
14. Lightly beat the egg whites and brush over the shapes then sprinkle with a little granulated sugar
15. Bake at 180 degrees c for 12 to 15 minutes depending on the size you make
16. They should be golden brown
17. Cool , then store in airtight container with a lining of kitchen paper to keep them crisp

title: mahogany buttercrunch toffee
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Place almonds on a cookie sheet and bake them for 5-10 minutes until golden
3. Watch carefully , they go from getting hot to dark brown in just a few seconds !
4. Cool to room temperature
5. In a food processor pulse the almonds until they are finely chopped
6. Sprinkle half of the nuts over a 7 inch by 10 inch area of a greased baking sheet
7. Set aside
8. In a medium , heavy saucepan combine the brown sugar , water and butter
9. Have your baking soda and vanilla extract ready
10. Over medium heat bring the sugar mixture to boil
11. Stir occasionally to prevent burning until the mixture reaches 285 degrees f
12. Immediately remove the saucepan from the heat as the temperature will rapidly rise
13. Immediately add the baking soda and vanilla extract
14. Pour this mixture over the nuts on your baking sheet
15. Quickly scatter the chocolate over the hot toffee
16. Press lightly so it starts melting
17. After about five minutes , the chocolate will be soft enough to spread with a long metal spatula in an even layer over the toffee
18. Spread the remaining chopped almonds over the melted chocolate
19. Cool completely and break into irregular pieces using a sharp knife
20. Store in an airtight container at room temperature for about one month
21. Makes one pound
22. Can be doubled

title: microwave applesauce cake
steps:
1. Put all ingredients in mixing bowl
2. Blend at low speed , then turn to medium for 2 minutes
3. Grease a 8x8 glass square cake pan and coat with graham cracker crumbs
4. Pour in batter
5. Microwave at 50% power for 6 minutes , rotating 1 / 4 every 3 minutes
6. Increase power to high
7. Microwave 2 to 5 minutes , or until done
8. The top of the cake will have alittle batter that will seem not to be cooked
9. Let stand on countertop 5 to 10 minutes

title: lc chocolate raspberry cheesecake
steps:
1. Prepare the crust:
2. Melt butter and add ground almonds to skillet
3. Heat until almonds brown slightly then press mixture into bottom and sides of 9 pie pan
4. Put crust-lined pan in freezer for a few minutes to cool
5. After crust has cooled , smear raspberry spread over the bottom
6. Prepare the filling:
7. Dissolve gelatin in cold water and set aside
8. Put 1 / 4 cups of the cream in a saucepan and bring to a boil
9. Cut the cream cheese into small pieces and stir into boiling cream along with the chocolate until cream cheese is smooth and the chocolate is melted
10. Add the gelatin , vanilla and sweetener and let cool down
11. While this is cooling , whip remaining cream until very stiff
12. After cream cheese mixture is cool , add it to whipped cream and mix until thoroughly blended
13. Pour about of filling into prepared pie pan
14. Scatter the thawed raspberries on on top of the filling

title: grill seasoning
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together well and store in an airtight container
2. Use it for anything you're grilling or when you're looking for a grilled taste
3. This is the one i hear called for most often
4. Experiment !
5. Another
6. Make any amount , just allow for 3 parts pepper , 1 part each of salt , onion powder , garlic powder and corriander , and 1 / 3 part crushed red pepper flakes
7. Using tablespoons , this makes enough for 7 or 8 meals under normal usage

title: banana buttermilk buckwheat pancakes
steps:
1. In a large bowl combine the first 6 dry ingredients
2. In another bowl whisk together the eggs , melted butter , buttermilk and milk until well combined
3. Add in the mashed banana
4. Mix to combine
5. Add the liquid ingredients to the dry ingredients
6. Stir well to combine
7. Drop by 1 / 3 cupfuls onto a greased griddle
8. Brown on both sides

title: salmon yakitori
steps:
1. In a saucepan bring the soy sauce , sake , mirin and ginger to the boil and simmer for about 15 mins until it has reduced to about 2 / 3 cup
2. Pour half the sauce over the salmon
3. Cook the salmon in a non stick frying pan for 2 mins , turn the fillets over and turn off the heat , leaving the salmon in the pan to cook on the other side in the residual heat
4. Heat the 2 oils in a wook until very hot
5. Toss the pepper and scallions together in the wok for 2-3 minutes
6. Add the noodles and left over sauce and toss to heat through
7. Spoon the noodles into bowls and place the salmon fillets on top
8. Sprinkle with cilantro and seeds and serve with extra soy sauce on the side

title: perfect basic beef tenderloin
steps:
1. Heat oven to 500 degrees
2. Spray a small roasting pan with nonstick cooking spray
3. Rub beef with just enough olive oil to moisten
4. Season to taste with garlic powder , seasoned salt and seasoned pepper , taking care to do both sides
5. Place in roasting pan
6. Add water to pan , but do not pour over beef
7. Cook 15 minutes uncovered at 500 degrees
8. Turn oven down to 375 degrees
9. Cook an additional 45 minutes at 375 degrees
10. Let sit 5 to 10 minutes before slicing
11. Place meat on platter and pour pan juices over

title: rosy potato salad
steps:
1. Place chilled , chopped potatoes , celery , eggs , pickles in a large mixing bowl
2. Mix mayo , and salad dressings , in medium mixing bowl
3. Add paprika to dressing mix and blend
4. Adjust seasonings to dressing---salt , pepper , paprika
5. Pour over potatoes and veggies and mix well
6. If salad looks too dry add the dressing of your choice !
7. Chill
8. Enjoy !

title: turkey pastrami scrambles on rye
steps:
1. Heat a medium nonstick skillet over medium heat
2. Add in the butter and let it melt
3. Add the pastrami to the skillet
4. Cook 2-3 minutes
5. Beat eggs together with salt , pepper , paprika , hot sauce , and chives
6. Add to pastrami and scramble eggs and meat together
7. To serve , spread mustard on the rye toast
8. Place a slice of toast on each plate and top with pastrami scrambles , making open-faced sandwiches

title: lemon wafers
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Lightly grease cookie sheets , or line with parchment paper
3. Sift together flour and baking powder , set aside
4. Cream butter and sugar until fluffy
5. Beat in eggs , vanilla , lemon extract and lemon zest
6. Add dry ingredients
7. Drop by spoonfuls onto prepared cookie sheets , 3" apart
8. Sprinkle with yellow sugar crystals
9. Bake 8-10 minutes , or until lightly browned
10. Cool on wire racks

title: ricardo s bolognese sauce
steps:
1. In a saucepan , brown the pancetta in oil
2. Add veggies and garlic
3. Cook a few minutes
4. Add meat and break with spoon at high heat until cooking juice has evaporated
5. Add wine and let reduce by half
6. Add milk and let simmer slowly 5 minutes
7. Add remaining ingredients and keep cooking at low heat for about 2 hours
8. Serve the sauce on pasta

title: baby bok choy and garlic in sweet chili sauce
steps:
1. Heat a large saut pan over medium-high heat
2. Add oil , garlic and ginger
3. Cook until fragrant but not brown , about 2 minutes , stirring frequently
4. Add bok choy leaves and cook until leaves are wilted but stems are still crunchy , stirring occasionally , about 5 minutes
5. Add sweet chili sauce , stir and let cook for another 2 to 3 minutes , tossing to coat all leaves
6. Taste and adjust seasoning with salt and pepper
7. Serve immediately and spoon leftover sauce in pan over bok choy

title: mozzarella tuna melts
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine the tuna , celery , onion , and mayonnaise
2. Spread on bottom of buns
3. Set bun tops aside
4. Top tuna mixture with a slice of cheese and tomato
5. Place on an ungreased baking sheet
6. Bake , uncovered at 350f for 12-15 minutes or until heated through and cheese is melted
7. Top each with a lettuce leaf , replace bun tops

title: polish sausage   sauerkraut
steps:
1. Cook sausages over medium heat in 10 inch skillet until brown
2. Remove
3. Cook onion in the same skillet until soft
4. Stir in sauerkraut
5. Cover and simmer 3 minutes
6. Place sausages on top of sauerkraut
7. Cover and cook 2 minutes or until heated through

title: espresso soymilk shake
steps:
1. In a small bowl combine syrup and 1 / 8 teaspoon coffee granules , stir well
2. Using a spoon , drizzle half the syrup mixture inside the rim of 2 narrow small glasses
3. In a blender combine the ice cream , milk , and remaining 2 teaspoons of coffee granules and process until smooth
4. Pour ice cream mixture into each glass , approximately 1 cup per glass
5. Serve immediately

title: cheesy spaghetti bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f grease a 13x9-inch baking dish
2. Set aside
3. Boil spaghetti noodles to al dente according to package
4. Drain
5. While spaghetti is boiling , brown the ground beef with the onion
6. Drain and return to skillet
7. Add the spaghetti sauce to the meat in the skillet
8. Add the hot cooked , drained spaghetti to the skillet
9. Stir well
10. Add salt and pepper to taste
11. Pour into the prepared baking dish
12. In a saucepan , melt butter
13. Add the flour , stirring constantly to make a roux
14. Slowly whisk in the evaporated milk
15. Turn heat to low and stir in the parmesan cheese and 1 / 2 cup only of the mozzarella
16. Stir constantly until melted and smooth
17. Pour the cheese mixture evenly over the spaghetti in the 13 x 9 dish
18. Sprinkle with the remaining 1 cup of parmesan cheese and then the oregano
19. Bake
20. Uncovered , for 30-35 minutes or until bubbly and starting to brown on top

title: healthy brown rice krispies treats
steps:
1. Put oil in a large pot and heat
2. Add rice syrup and nut butter
3. Stir and heat until bubbles form
4. Turn off heat and add vanilla extract
5. Add cereal and mix well
6. Stir in any optional items and mix lightly
7. Put mixture into a 9 x 13 pan
8. With slightly wet hands , press mixture flat
9. Let set to room temperature
10. Slice and serve
11. Lasts a week in an airtight container

title: frozen chocolate peanut butter ribbon torte
steps:
1. To prepare chocolate sauce: in a small saucepan , combine 2 / 3 cup honey , 1 / 2 cup cream , cocoa powder and 1 / 2 teaspoon vanilla
2. Cook about 5 minutes , stirring constantly , over medium heat , until mixture is well blended and smooth
3. Set aside
4. Cool to room temperature
5. Using a 9-inch springform pan: place parchment paper at bottom and spread a thin layer of honey around inside pan with spatula
6. Now the lady fingers will stick to the side
7. Gently press lady fingers , curved side facing out , upright around sides of springform pan
8. Pack ice cream in even layer into bottom of pan
9. Freeze while preparing peanut butter mixture
10. In medium bowl , mix peanut butter , cream cheese , remaining 2 / 3 cup honey and 1 / 2 teaspoon vanilla extract until well blended
11. Whip remaining 1 / 2 cup cream until soft peaks form
12. Fold into peanut butter mixture
13. Spread peanut butter mixture over chocolate ice cream layer in pan
14. Top evenly with cooled chocolate sauce
15. Freeze for 2 to 3 hours , or until firm , before serving

title: four layer hamburger and macaroni casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 f
2. In large skillet , combine beef and seasoning mix
3. Cook over medium-high heat until beef is no longer pink , stirring occasionally
4. In medium bowl , mix one package macaroni and cheese with sour cream
5. Spread over bottom of 8-inch-square baking dish
6. Top with beef mixture
7. Spread remaining package macaroni and cheese over beef mixture
8. Top with tomato , potato chips and cheese
9. Bake for 20-25 minutes or until bubbly around edges
10. Top with taco sauce and additional chips if desired , when serving

title: almond tabbouli salad
steps:
1. Soak the cracked wheat in boiling water 1 hour
2. Drain
3. Mix in tomatoes , parsley , green onions and almonds
4. Combine almond or olive oil with lemon juice , mint , salt and pepper
5. Toss dressing with cracked wheat mixture
6. Chill several hours for flavors to blend
7. Enjoy !
8. Makes about 2 quarts

title: green bean and onion vinaigrette
steps:
1. Cook the beans in boiling , salted water until tender crisp , about 5 minutes
2. Drain and run under cold water to stop the cooking process
3. Drain again
4. In a small bowl , combine the parsley , vinegar , and mustard
5. Whisk in olive oil , salt and pepper
6. Place the beans in a serving dish
7. Garnish with the red onion rings
8. Spoon sauce over top and toss lightly

title: veggie chili
steps:
1. In large pan sprayed with pam , saute onion , bell peppers , and garlic just til tender , over medium heat
2. Add all other ingredients as listed
3. Stir well and bring to boil over medium heat
4. Reduce heat
5. Simmer 20-30 minutes , stirring occasionally
6. Makes great veggie burritos !
7. Freezes well , too

title: broccoli n cheese puffle
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375 degrees f
2. Line a greased 9x9 pan with bread
3. Combine broccoli with margarine , cheese , salt , tobasco , and onion
4. Spoon over bread
5. Beat eggs , add milk powder and water , mix well , pour over broccoli
6. Bake at for 20-25 minutes

title: sweet cottage cheese and bananas
steps:
1. In a small serving bowl , stir together the cottage cheese , honey , and banana slices
2. Serve or eat immediately

title: carmela s chicken rigatoni  copycat romano s macaroni grill
steps:
1. In a hot saut pan add butter flavored oil , mushrooms , chicken , basil , caramelized onions , salt and pepper and saut for approximately 60 to 90 seconds
2. Add the wine and saut for 60 seconds
3. Add the heavy cream and bring to a boil over high heat
4. Dip pre-cooked pasta in boiling water for 10 seconds , drain thoroughly
5. Put pasta in saut pan and saut until well incorporated
6. Toss briefly over fire , add parmesan cheese and continue to toss until cheese is completely incorporated
7. Transfer to plate , garnish with parsley

title: spiced chicken with honey ginger glaze
steps:
1. Heat the oven to 325 degrees
2. Line rimmed baking sheet with foil
3. In a small bowl , combine the ginger , coriander , peppers and salt
4. Add just enough oil to make a paste
5. Rub the spice paste under and over skin of chicken
6. Bake on prepared pan 20 minutes
7. Meanwhile , combine the honey , sherry , ginger and lemon juice
8. Spoon some of the glaze over the chicken and continue to bake , spooning on additional glaze every few minutes , until chicken is cooked through , about 15 minutes longer
9. Makes 4 servings

title: cranberry marmalade holiday muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Grease 12 muffin cups
3. In a large mixing bowl , mix flour , sugars , baking powder , baking soda , salt , cinnamon , nutmeg and allspice
4. Make a well in the center
5. In a separate bowl , whisk together buttermilk , marmalade , melted cooled butter and egg
6. Pour into well in the center of the dry ingredients
7. Mix with a fork until dry ingredients are moistened
8. Stir in chopped nuts and cranberries
9. Spoon batter into muffin tins , filling cups about 2 / 3 full
10. Bake until tops are firm and lightly browned , about 20 minutes
11. Cool muffins in pan on a rack for about 5 minutes
12. Turn out of pan to cool completely

title: potato fries with onion and chilli
steps:
1. Bring water to boil in pot and cook potatoes until they are just tender
2. Cool to handle and then cut each quarter into thick slices
3. Heat oil in large skillet and add potatoes and onion
4. Turn until the vegetables are pale gold
5. Add garlic and cook until the garlic turns golden
6. Add chilli powder , salt and pepper
7. Cook , stirring to coat the potatoes and lightly toast chilli powder
8. Sprinkle with lime juice before serving

title: cornish pasties filling  cornish pasty   omaha steaks
steps:
1. Place the beef , potato , carrot , onion , peas , and water in a mixing bowl , and season generously with salt and pepper
2. Mix well
3. Fill pasty pastry with mixture

title: riverboat crescent
steps:
1. Separate dough and cut each triangle into half to form 2 triangles
2. Sprinkle each with approximately teaspoonful combined cheese and dill weed and press lightly
3. Roll up and place on ungreased cookie sheet with point side down
4. Brush with butter and sprinkle with remaining cheese mixture
5. Bake at 375 degrees for 10-12 minutes or until lightly brown

title: olive latkes
steps:
1. Put the olives in a food processor and chop
2. Squeeze out as much moisture as possible
3. Set aside
4. Heat 1 / 4 c olive oil and saute onions and garlic until golden
5. Add to olives
6. Mix flour , baking powder , baking soda , salt , cumin in a bowl
7. Add beaten eggs
8. Add olive onion mixture
9. Add water if batter is too thick
10. Heat 1 / 4 c olive oil in skillet , add batter by ladlefuls , and cook 4 at a time for 3-4 minutes per side
11. Remove , keep warm , and cook additional latkes
12. Garnish with sour cream

title: chicken and corn tortilla bake
steps:
1. In bowl , combine chicken , chilies , broth , soups and onion
2. Set aside
3. Layer half of the tortillas on the bottom of a greased 9x13 baking pan , cutting to fit pan if desired
4. Top with half of the chicken mixture and half of the cheese
5. Repeat layers
6. Bake uncovered at 350 for 30 minutes

title: wedding cupcakes
steps:
1. Bake white cake as directed in white paper lined muffin cups to make 24 cupcakes
2. When cupcakes have cooled , frost with the white frosting
3. Top some of the cupcakes with the chocolate curls and some with the rose petals
4. Cut handmade paper into 8 1 1 / 4" strips
5. Wrap handmade paper around each cupcake and attach with double-stick tape
6. Sprinkle decorator sugar crystals or edible glitter over frosting
7. Wrap ribbon around each cupcake and tie in a bow

title: yoghurt homemade
steps:
1. Homemade yoghurt
2. Makes two quarts / liters
3. A thermometer for liquids
4. A batch jar , or dishwasher-safe plastic container , with lid
5. Insulation
6. 2 u
7. S
8. Quarts / 2 liters milk , any kind including powdered
9. 4 tbsps yoghurt for the starter
10. Scald milk
11. Pour the milk into a pot to heat until it just comes to a boil , about two minutes
12. Let cool down in cold water to about 45c / 112f to measure properly stir the milk , then leave the thermometer in about 30 seconds
13. Batch jar
14. Prerinse with boiling water
15. Add the yoghurt starter to the cooled milk and mix well until completely dissolved
16. Pour into the batch jar and cap
17. Incubate
18. The yoghurt bacteria , like yeast , is a live organism , to be kept warm and out of drafts
19. I've used a small foam cooler , an insulated drinks cooler , a thick old small quilt successfully
20. Let stand , wrapped , until it curdles , usually about 3 - 5 hours
21. Refrigerate
22. Just put it in for about 8 hours before serving
23. Keeps about 3 - 4 weeks
24. Comments
25. The creamy consistency and taste is amazing when you're used to store-bought
26. Save 4 tbsps for the next starter batch
27. Add whatever you fancy to eat--fruit , honey , crumbles , cereals
28. My family used to go through a whole batch in a couple of days
29. I substitute it in many recipes that call for mayonnaise , sour cream , creme fraiche , salad dressing
30. A friend commented she now has yoghurt coming out the wazoo but she's trying it for frozen yoghurt to take to work
31. I've never tried microwaving to scald the milk but then , back when , i didn't have a microwave either
32. Do not use imperial measure !

title: stone sour
steps: 1. Shake all ingredients with ice , strain into a chilled whiskey sour glass , and serve

title: spicy almond soba noodles with edamame
steps:
1. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil over medium-high heat , add the soba noodles and cook 6 to 8 minutes , or until barely tender
2. Use tongs to remove the noodles to a bowl , reserving the cooking water
3. Return pot to the boil
4. Add the edamame to the pot and cook until tender , about 5 minutes
5. Drain and add to the noodles
6. Toast the almonds in a small , dry skillet over medium heat , shaking frequently , until lightly browned and toasty , 2 to 3 minutes
7. Remove immediately to a plate and allow to cool
8. Coarsely chop
9. Combine the nut butter , vinegar , garlic and red pepper flakes in a small bowl
10. Add the hot water , stirring to mix well
11. If it seems too thick , add more hot water , a teaspoon at a time , until it has reached the right consistency
12. Add salt to taste and more vinegar and red pepper flakes if you want it tangier / spicier
13. Pour over the noodles , add the scallion , bell pepper , and chopped almonds , and toss well

title: chocolate chip pumpkin muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees f
2. Lightly grease muffin pan , or use paper muffin cups to avoid sticking
3. Mix spice cake , pumpkin , chocolate chips , walnuts , and water in a large mixing bowl
4. Fill cups to the brim for large muffins , fill half-way for smaller ones
5. Bake for 25-35 minutes , depending on size
6. Spread icing over the tops when they have cooled

title: patates skortou  garlic potatoes
steps:
1. Bring a large stockpot of water to a boil
2. Meanwhile , scrub potatoes and cut in half
3. Peel garlic
4. Place the potatoes and whole garlic in the boiling water
5. There should be enough water to cover them
6. Boil for about 30 minutes , or until potatoes are soft all the way through when tested with a knife
7. Using a slotted spoon , transfer the potatoes to a large mixing bowl and remove garlic
8. Set the potato water aside
9. Press or mash the garlic cloves , add to the potatoes , and combine lightly with a potato masher or large fork
10. Stir in remaining ingredients , adding a little hot potato water to adjust consistency , if necessary

title: thai style tilapia with coconut curry broth
steps:
1. In a large saute pan , heat the oil over moderate heat
2. Add the shallots and cook , stirring occasionally , until beginning to brown , 3-5 minutes
3. Add the curry paste and cook , stirring until fragrant , about 30 seconds
4. Add the chicken broth , coconut milk , 1 / 2 teaspoon salt and simmer until reduced to 2 cups , about 5 minutes
5. Season the tilapia with 1 / 4 teaspoon salt
6. Arrange the fish in the pan and gently shake the pan so the fish is coated with the sauce
7. Cover and cook until the fish flakes easily with a fork , about 7 minutes
8. Arrange a pile of steamed spinach in the bottom of 4 soup plates
9. Top with the fish fillets
10. Stir the cilantro , scallions and lime juice into the sauce and season , to taste , with salt and pepper
11. Ladle the sauce over the fish and serve with rice

title: easy peasy coleslaw
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together , then season with salt and pepper to taste
2. Refrigerate for a minimum of half an hour to allow flavours to develop

title: salisbury steak with mushrooms
steps:
