1. Saute onions , chopped mushrooms , and garlic in 2 tablespoons butter until translucent and set aside to cool
2. Mix beef with cooled onion mixture , eggs , bread crumbs , parsley , and chopped mushrooms
3. Form into 4-ounce patties and saute in the 2 tablespoons of butter until golden brown on both sides and set aside
4. In saucepan melt 2 tablespoons of butter and add flour and cook over low heat for 1 minute
5. Begin to add stock 1 / 3 at a time whisking and bringing to simmer each time making sure there are no lumps
6. Add mushrooms and simmer for 1 / 2 hour
7. Place patties in a roasting pan and pour gravy over patties and bake in a preheated 375 degree oven for 45 minutes
8. Garnish with grilled onions and serve

title: yogurt and cucumber soup
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients except the last three
2. Mix thoroughly with 1 cup water
3. Refrigerate several hours or overnight
4. Just before serving stir in rose petals and add a few ice cubes
5. Garnish with additional mint and pita bread croutons

title: vegetable sushi
steps:
1. Place the rice in a strainer and rinse under cold running water until the water is fairly clear , about 5 minutes
2. Shake the water out and allow the rice to dry in the strainer for 15 minutes
3. Put the rice in a pot with exactly 3 cups of water and cook covered over high heat until it starts to foam , about 5 minutes
4. Reduce the heat to low and cook until tender , about 15 minutes
5. Turn off the heat and sprinkle with 1 / 4 cup mirin
6. Replace the lid and allow the rice to steam for 15 minutes
7. Place in a bowl and cool to room temperature
8. To prepare the sushi , place a bamboo sushi roller flat on a table with the bamboo reeds horizontal to you
9. Sprinkle lightly with water
10. Place 1 nori sheet on top , smooth side down , and moisten lightly with mirin
11. With damp hands , press 1 1 / 4 cups rice flat on top of the nori , leaving 1 1 / 2-inch edges on the top and bottom , but pressing all the way to the sides
12. Make sure the rice is pressed even and smooth
13. Spread 1 / 4 teaspoon of wasabi paste in a horizontal stripe near the lower edge of the rice
14. Over the wasabi , lightly sprinkle the red onions in a horizontal stripe
15. Place strips of carrots in a horizontal stripe , on top of the wasabi and onions , and follow by piling the red and yellow peppers , scallions , and cucumbers on top , making a tight , straight bundle of vegetables
16. Place 1 layer of pickled ginger slices on top
17. To roll the sushi , pick up the near edge of the bamboo roller and hold it with the nori , then pull them up and over the vegetable bundle until the nori reaches the rice on the other side
18. Press the roller to make a round bundle , then roll the bundle to the far edge of the nori and press again to make a round bundle
19. (the nori should totally enclose the rice and vegetables in a round tube , but the ends will have rice and vegetables sticking out
20. Repeat the process with the remaining ingredients
21. Keep the rolls under a damp towel and refrigerate until ready to serve
22. To serve , slice off the ends with a very sharp knife and slice each roll into 8 equal pieces
23. Meanwhile , for the sushi dipping sauce , combine the wasabi powder and water to make a paste
24. Mix in the red pepper flakes , ginger , scallions , vinegar , soy sauce , and sesame oil
25. Serve the sushi at room temperature with the dipping sauce

title: baked asparagus dip
steps:
1. Steam or microwave asparagus until soft
2. Process in food processor , leaving some texture
3. Blend with remaining ingredients
4. Bake at 350 degrees f for about 15 minutes or until hot and bubbly

title: wine and cheese muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. In a medium bowl , combine baking mix , wine , oil and egg
3. Using a fork , beat the mixture for 30 strokes
4. Stir in the cheeses and chives
5. Divide the mixture between 12
6. Muffin cups , greased or lined with paper cups
7. Bake 15-20 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean

title: hazelnut butter toffee
steps:
1. Prepare cookie sheet or jelly roll pan by covering it with waxed paper
2. Sprinkle 1 / 4 cup hazelnuts on pan , spread out evenly

steps:
1. Season chicken breasts with salt & pepper
2. In a small bowl , mix together the cream cheese and feta with a fork
3. Fill the chicken breast with the cheese mixture , spinach , and ham
4. To freeze: wrap individually , label , and freeze
5. To prepare: preheat oven to 350
6. Place frozen chicken breasts in a baking dish coated with non-stick cooking spray and bake , covered with foil , for one hour or until tender
7. You can also defrost the chicken breasts and bake them covered for 45-50 min or until tender

title: vegetable makhani
steps:
1. Blanch carrots , cauliflower , broccoli , & potatoes boiling water
2. Drain and keep aside
3. Heat oil and butter in a pan add bay leaf , cinnamon , cloves , cardamom , fennel seeds , ginger paste and a little water
4. Saut for two minutes then add green chillies , red chilli powder , coriander powder and cumin powder
5. Saut well
6. Add the blanched vegetables and stir
7. Add cashewnut paste , sufficient water and salt to taste
8. Mix and bring it to boil
9. Add tomato puree , stir and cook for additional two to three minutes
10. Add honey and stir
11. Add frozen peas and fresh cream and stir again
12. Heat until peas are warmed
13. Add garam masala powder and if adding paneer cubes , fold it into the mixture
14. If adding , add roasted and crushed kasoori methi and stir gently

title: delicious bread pudding
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
2. Butter a 9x13-inch baking dish
3. In a large bowl , combine bread , milk and cream
4. Chop with two knives to combine well
5. Let stand 10 minutes
6. Stir in eggs , sugar , melted butter , orange peel , vanilla , cinnamon , nutmeg and raisins
7. Pour into prepared pan
8. To make topping: combine sugar , water and cinnamon in a small bowl
9. Sprinkle over bread pudding mixture and dot with butter
10. Bake for 30-40 minutes or until tester comes out clean
11. Cool in pan on rack and cut into squares to serve
12. Delicious topped with whipped cream

title: ruby tuesday s creamy mashed cauliflower by todd wilbur
steps:
1. Divide head of cauliflower into florets that are roughly the same size
2. Steam cauliflower pieces over boiling water for 15 to 20 minutes or until cauliflower is tender
3. Drain the cauliflower and toss it in a bowl of ice water to end the cooking process
4. When the cauliflower has cooled , put the florets in a food processor along with 1 / 4 cup water
5. Puree the cauliflower on high speed until smooth , but with some very small pieces of cauliflower remaining for just a bit of texture
6. Pour all of the pureed cauliflower into a medium saucepan
7. Dissolve the cornstarch in the remaining 1 / 2 cup of water and add the solution to the cauliflower
8. Add the cream , sugar and remaining spices and stir
9. Set the saucepan over medium heat and cook , sirring often for 5 to 10 minutes or until thick

title: berry wheat germ pancakes
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients and let stand at least 5 min
2. Make pancakes per usual
3. Top with yogurt and honey !

title: watermelon  cucumber and feta salad
steps:
1. Cut all fruit and add to medium sized bowl
2. Add cheese
3. To sliver herbs roll and cut with sharp knife
4. Wish together vinigar , oil and salt
5. Pour over salad and serve immidiately

title: pomanders
steps:
1. Use a push pin or darning needle to make holes in rind of orange
2. Insert a whole clove into each hole
3. Cover the whole fruit with cloves , or make a spiral , stripe , diamond or checkerboard pattern
4. Roll in cinnamon if desired
5. Tie a ribbon around the pomander and knot it securely
6. Then tie a bow
7. Or to hang the pomander on a tree , use a heavy duty paper clip and open one end enough to pull a knotted ribbon through
8. Use the paper clip tohang the pomander over a branch
9. Can be made ahead
10. The more cloves used , the longer the pomander will keep

title: apple jack spread
steps:
1. In a food processor or by hand , combine cheeses and mustard , blending until smooth
2. Remove to a medium bowl
3. Add apples and chives and gently combine mixture
4. Sprinkle with pecans
5. Chill and serve with crackers

title: sweet  n  sour pork chops
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine the pineapple , barbecue sauce , onion and chili sauce
2. Pour half into a greased 3-qt
3. Slow cooker
4. Top with pork chops and remaining sauce
5. Cover and cook on low for 4-1 / 4 to 5-1 / 4 hours or until meat is tender

title: copycat sunny delight
steps:
1. Combine all of the ingredients and stir until well mixed
2. Chill well before serving

title: chicken corn soup with rivels
steps:
1. Put chicken in a pot with the water , bring to a boil , then cover and simmer until tender
2. Remove chicken from broth
3. Discard skin and cut meat into bite size pieces
4. Put back into broth
5. Add everything else except for chopped egg and parsley
6. Bring to a boil
7. Cook for 15 minutes until vegetables are soft , while you make the rivels
8. Make the rivels by rubbing flour and egg together into crumbs
9. Add milk if necessary
10. Should be dry and crumbly
11. Drop into boiling soup , stirring to prevent clumping
12. Cover and simmer for 7 minutes
13. Add chopped egg and parsley
14. Serve and pass cream to be poured into soup

title: warm cranberry glazed brie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. With sharp knife , cut circle in top of rind of cheese , leaving 1 / 4-inch border around top of cheese
3. Carefully remove center circle and discard
4. Place cheese on pie plate or other small shallow ovenproof baking dish
5. In small saucepan , stir together cranberry sauce , sugar , ginger , orange zest , cornstarch and allspice
6. Stir over medium heat until mixture comes to a boil and thickens slightly
7. Remove from heat
8. Spread cranberry mixture on top of cheese
9. Bake 5 to 10 minutes , until cheese is soft but not runny
10. Sprinkle with nuts and chives
11. Serve with toasteds crackers

title: quarterback calzones
steps:
1. For each calzone , press two dinner rolls together
2. On a lightly floured surface , roll dough into a 6-in
3. X 3-1 / 2-in
4. Oval
5. Spread 1 / 4 cup sauce to within 1 / 2 inches of edge
6. Top with 1 / 4 cup cheese , 1 tablespoon green pepper , 1 to 2 teaspoons olives if desired and 4 pepperoni slices
7. Press two more rolls together and roll into a slightly larger oval
8. Place over filling
9. Firmly press edges to seal
10. Cut another roll in half and roll out to 1 / 8-in
11. Thickness
12. Cut a 3-in
13. X 1 / 4-in
14. Strip
15. Place lengthwise down center of calzone
16. To form laces , cut four 1-in
17. X 1 / 8-in
18. Strips
19. Place across center strip
20. Cut two 4-in
21. X 1 / 4-in
22. Pieces of dough
23. Place one across each end of calzone , curving to form a crescent shape
24. Transfer to a greased baking sheet
25. Lightly brush tops with oil
26. Cover and let rise in a warm place for 15 minutes
27. Bake , uncovered , at 375 for 16-17 minutes or until golden brown
28. Cut calzones in half before serving
29. Yield: 8 calzones

title: grandma vi s green jello salad
steps:
1. Drain juice from can of crushed pineapple into a measuring cup
2. Add enough pineapple juice to make 2 cups
3. Bring the 2 cups of juice to a boil
4. Remove from heat and dissolve completely 2 pkgs
5. Of lime jello in the juice , stir , stir , stir
6. Add all the cream cheese pieces using a gravy whip to blend
7. Add 6 ice cubes and pineapple , stir until ice dissolves
8. Put in the freezer until cool and syrup-like
9. Fold in chopped nuts , cabbage , and cool whip
10. Refrigerate several hours

title: scallops in garlic cream sauce
steps:
1. Melt butter in a pan over medium-low heat
2. Add the garlic , parsley , scallions , wine , salt and pepper
3. Cover
4. Simmer 10 minutes
5. Add the scallops
6. Simmer for another 5 minutes
7. Remove cover
8. Stir in the cream
9. Continuing heating , but do not boil , stirring constantly until sauce begins to thicken
10. Serve immediately while scallops are hot
11. Spoon excess sauce from pan and drizzle it over the scallops

title: ukrainian christmas kutya
steps:
1. Wash wheat in cold water and soak overnight in the 3 to 4 quarts of water
2. The next day , bring the water to a boil then simmer for 4 to 5 hours , stirring occasionally to prevent sticking
3. The wheat is ready when the kernels burst open and the fluid is thick and creamy
4. Chop the poppy seed in a food processor and set aside
5. Mix honey , sugar and hot water
6. Mix the honey mixture , poppy seeds , and chopped nuts and wheat
7. More honey can be added to taste
8. Keep in refrigerator

title: tropical breeze smoothie
steps:
1. Place all ingerdients in blender
2. Cover and process 15-30 seconds till smooth , using on / off pulsing action to break up chunks

title: teriyaki vegetables stir fry
steps:
1. In large pan add and stir-fry the first 8 ingredient in order for 6 minutes
2. Add water and leave for 2 minutes
3. Add cabbage and stir-fry for 6 minutes until tender
4. Add the teriyaki sauce and salt and pepper
5. Stir for another 1 minutes
6. Your side dish is ready
7. Enjoy

title: brown rice and pine nut casserole
steps:
1. Saute the pine nuts in a medium-sized skillet with 2 tablespoons butter over moderate heat until browned , approximately 5 minutes , stirring occasionally
2. To the same skillet add and melt the remaining butter
3. Add the rice , bulgur , and onion
4. Brown for about 10 minutes , stirring frequently
5. Spoon this mixture into a 2-quart casserole
6. Add 3 / 4 cup parsley , chives , salt , and pepper
7. Bring broth to a boil and stir into rice mixture
8. Bake uncovered in a preheated 375 oven for 1 hour and 15 minutes
9. Garnish with the remaining parsley

title: mexican sp iced  chocolate sorbet
steps:
1. Combine the sugar and cocoa in a saucepan to get rid of lumps
2. Stir in 2 cups of water or milk and put it over medium-high heat
3. (feel free to make part of this coffee if you like
4. Bring to a simmer and cook for 2 minutes
5. Take off heat and stir in the chocolate
6. Stir until its melted
7. Let the mixture cool , and then refrigerate until cold
8. Pour into ice cream maker and freeze according to manufacturers directions
9. The one i used was so easy: pour in , turn on , wait for magic to happen
10. Store in freezer for extra firmness

title: simplest 5 ingredient sweet heaven
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Generously butter a 9 inch baking pan
3. In a large bowl , combine all ingredients
4. Mix thoroughly
5. Press mixture into the prepared pan
6. Bake for 25-30 minutes
7. Let cool thoroughly !
8. Do not try to cut into squares until completely set and cooled
9. Cut into 1-inch squares
10. If you use a dark pan lower heat to 325 and bake for 30 minutes
11. I have made several batches of these and i recommend using parchment paper

title: cannellini piccata
steps:
1. Saute onion , mushrooms and garlic over medium heat in oil until onion softens
2. Add flour and stir until the flour starts to lightly brown
3. Slowly add the warmed broth to the flour mixture , stirring to prevent any lumps
4. When mixture thickens add beans
5. Add lemon juice , salt , black pepper & pepper flakes
6. Cook until thickened and bubbly
7. Serve over hot rice , noodles or couscous
8. Garnish with parsley

title: baby kate s beefaroni  oamc  toddler style
steps:
1. Heat oil in skillet
2. Add beef , carrots , tomatoes and onions
3. Cook until beef is completely cooked and crumbly
4. Carrots will be soft , onions and tomatoes will be virtually non-existent
5. During this cooking stage , add the water to make a "sauce"
6. Set aside when done
7. While cooking meat mixture , cook pasta according to package directions
8. Drain pasta and combine with meat mixture
9. Tear up the 6 slices of cheese and stir into beef / pasta mixture until a creamy sauce forms
10. It's done !
11. Freeze in small containers
12. To reheat , defrost in refrigerator and heat in microwave or sauce pan
13. You can add a little water to keep moist while reheating

title: easiest brownies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Grease a 13x 9 inch baking pan
3. Melt the chocolate chips and butter in a saucepan over low heat and stir until smooth
4. Remove mix from heat , add vanilla extract and set aside
5. Mix flour , sugar , baking soda
6. Add eggs to mix and stir well
7. Add dry mix and stir gently
8. Spread into prepared pan
9. Bake for 18 to 20 minutes or until toothpick or fork inserted in center comes out slightly sticky
10. Cool before cutting into squares

title: batter for fried pork
steps:
1. Mix all but soy sauce together
2. Cut meat in approximately 1 / 2" wide pieces for pork , season with your favorite seasonings
3. Shake a little bit of soy sauce and let meat marinate a few minutes
4. Dip meat in batter , fry in deep oil , temperature 375 degrees for 5-6 minutes till brown
5. Mix all but soy sauce together
6. Cut meat in approximately 1 / 2" wide pieces for pork , season with your favorite seasonings
7. Shake a little bit of soy sauce and let meat marinate a few minutes
8. Dip meat in batter , fry in deep oil , temperature 375 degrees for 5-6 minutes till brown
9. Part of preparing time is the marinating and cooking is for all the meat

title: mock puff pastry dough  made so easy
steps:
1. Using a food processor , pulse butter into flour until it resembles crumbs
2. Pulse in sour cream just until a ball forms and it just begins to hold together , being careful not to over-mix
3. Roll out and fold over in three sections
4. Repeat 2-3 times to get the layers of puff pastry
5. Wrap in plastic wrap and refrigerate for a minimum of 30 minutes before using
6. Let sit for a few minutes or pound with rolling pin to get it pliable

title: robert redford s whole wheat quick bread
steps:
1. Grease a 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan
2. Heat oven to 400 degrees
3. Mix flour , baking powder , baking soda and salt
4. Beat egg in a large bowl
5. Stir in buttermilk , molasses and butter
6. Stir in flour mixture
7. Mix in walnuts and raisins
8. Scrape batter into prepared pan and bake 50 to 60 minutes , or until well browned
9. Remove from oven and place pan on a wire rack to cool

title: gramma s chocolate sauce
steps:
1. Melt and mix all together , getting all powdered sugar lumps out
2. Bring almost to boil
3. Don't boil
4. Remove from heat
5. Store in fridge , it gets thick
6. You can warm it up very slowly or serve it like it is --
7. Or you can eat it with a spoon !

title: quick sauteed skirt steak
steps:
1. Brush the steak with the worcestershire , and marinate in a pyrex dish for about 15 minutes
2. You can leave on the counter or refrigerate
3. Lightly pat the steaks dry with paper towels , and season well with the salt
4. Heat half of the oil in a nonstick or heavy skillet , over medium-high heat until hot
5. Saute half the steaks , about 3 minutes on each side
6. Cook in batches , with additional oil , until all the steaks are done
7. Transfer to platter , loosely cover with foil , and let stand about 5 minutes before serving

title: blueberry biscotti
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Line baking sheet with parchment or wax paper
3. In the bowl of your mixer , beat the butter and sugar on medium speed until combined , about 1 minute
4. Add flour , baking powder , salt and lemon zest and beat just until combined
5. Add the eggs one at a time , beating well after each addition and scraping down the bowl as necessary
6. Add the nuts blueberries and anise seeds and mix until combined
7. Transfer the dough to a lightly floured work surface and shape it into a 12-inch-long log
8. Transfer log to the prepared baking sheet with a spatula
9. Bake for 30 minutes , or until the top is firm to the touch
10. Allow log to cool on baking sheet for 10 minutes
11. Leave oven on
12. Using a sharp serrated knife , cut the log on the diagonal into 1 / 2-inch-thick slices
13. Place the biscotti cut side up on the lined baking sheet and bake an additional 12 to 14 minutes , or until golden brown and crisp
14. Cool completely on wire rack
15. Store in a airtight container in a cool dry place up to 2 weeks

title: carrot coconut barfi
steps:
1. In a pan add grated carrot and coconut
2. Add sugar stir it
3. In the mean time add ghee little by little
4. When the mixture leaves the sides of the pan , pour over a greased plate
5. Cut into pieces

title: sesame pork rice
steps:
1. Cook rice as package directs , but omit salt
2. Drain well and set aside
3. Toss pork pieces with 1 / 2 tsp garlic and 1 / 2 tsp ginger in a medium bowl
4. In a large nonstick skillet heat 2 tsp sesame oil over medium-high heat
5. Add the pork and saut 3 minutes or'til done
6. Remove from the skillet and keep warm
7. Heat the remaining 1 tsp sesame oil in the skillet
8. Add the remaining tsp of garlic and 1 / 2 tsp of ginger and saut for 30 seconds
9. Add rice , soy sauce , hoisin sauce and vinegar and cook 2 minutes stirring constantly
10. Stir in the pork and cook 2 minutes or'til thoroughly heated
11. Sprinkle with green onions and sesame seeds

title: cheesy vegetable soup 3 w w  points
steps:
1. Cube cheese for easier melting
2. Set aside
3. In large stock pot place all ingredients
4. Cook over medium heat for approximately 30 minutes or until vegetables are tender
5. Add cheese and continue cooking until cheese melts
6. Stir often so it doesn't burn on bottom of pan

title: strawberry sparkle punch
steps:
1. Puree strawberries in blender
2. Pour into punch bowl
3. Dissolve jell-o in boiling water
4. Stir until dissolved
5. Add to punch bowl with remaining ingredients
6. Serve right away
7. Or you can chill all the ingredients , except ginger ale in a covered container overnight
8. Add ginger ale just before you serve

title: banana oatmeal rocks
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f line cookie sheets with non-stick aluminum foil or spray with pam spray
2. For cookies , beat sugar and margarine in large bowl until creamy
3. Add bananas , egg and lemon peel
4. Beat well
5. Add combined flour , cinnamon , baking soda , salt , ginger and nutmeg
6. Mix well
7. Add oats , raisins , and nuts
8. Mix well
9. Drop dough by rounded tablespoonfuls onto cookie sheets
10. Bake approximately 10 minutes or until light golden brown
11. Slide cookies and foil from cookie sheets onto wire rack
12. Cool while preparing glaze
13. For glaze , combine all ingredients in small bowl
14. Mix until smooth
15. Spoon small amount of glaze over each warm cookie , letting glaze run down sides of cookie
16. Cool completely
17. Remove cookies from foil
18. Store tightly covered

title: butter pecan pie squares
steps:
1. Combine 1 1 / 4 cups flour and 1 / 3 cup sugar in a medium bowl
2. Cut in 1 / 2 cup butter with a pastry blender until mixture resembles coarse meal
3. Press mixture evenly into a greased 9-inch square pan
4. Bake at 375 degrees for 15 minutes
5. Combine next 7 ingredients , and beat well
6. Stir in pecans
7. Pour filling over prepared crust
8. Bake at 350 degrees for 25 minutes or until firm
9. Let cool on a rack
10. Cut into squares

title: melt in your mouth sugar cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. On waxed paper , combine flour , baking soda , cream of tartar and salt
3. In a large bowl , beat butter , confectioners sugar , and 1 / 2 cup granulated sugar on medium speed about 2 min or until creamy
4. Reduce speed to low , beat in egg , then beat in oil and vanilla
5. Gradually beat in flour mixture just until blended , occasionally scraping bowl
6. Place remaining 2 tbsp sugar in a small bowl or saucer
7. Shape dough by rounded tsp into 3 / 4 inch balls
8. Place balls 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet
9. Dip punch cup or glass with raised or cut design on bottom , or coarse side of meat mallet into sugar in bowl , use to flatten each ball into a 1 1 / 2 inch round
10. Bake 10-11 min until edges are golden
11. Transfer to wire rack to cool
12. Store cookies in tightly covered container at room temp up to 1 week or in freezer up to 3 monthes

title: pork and apple stew
steps:
1. Heat the oil and butter in a heavy-bottomed stew pot and add the pork cubes
2. Brown them
3. Add the onion and cook until just beginning to turn golden
4. Add the carrots , parsnips and squash
5. Pour in the beer and some of the water
6. Hit the cheesecloth bag of spices with a rolling pin to break the seeds and add it to the pot
7. Cover and simmer 30 minutes
8. Add the fennel , cabbage and apples , and any water or additional beer if needed
9. Cover and simmer another 5-7 minutes , until the apples are tender
10. Season to taste
11. Fish out the cheesecloth bag
12. Serve in a tureen with as much or little liquid as you like , and sprinkle it with chopped fresh parsley

title: macaroon angel cakes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300 degrees
2. In a large mixer bowl , beat the egg whites and cream of tartar until soft mounds form
3. Gradually add in the 1 / 3 cup sugar , heating until stiff peaks form
4. Blend in extracts
5. Mix together 1 cup sugar and flour
6. Add to egg white mixture
7. By hand , fold in gently , but thoroughly
8. Fold in coconut
9. Spoon into paper-lined muffin cups filing to within 1 / 4 an inch of the top
10. Bake for 30-35 minutes or until light golden brown and the cake is set
11. If using the mini muffin liners , bake 20-25 minutes
12. Allow 2 hours to thaw at room temperature

title: spicy mandarin noodles
steps:
1. In a food processor or blender
2. Pour in the oranges with their juice , sambal , vinegar , and the seasoning packet for the ramen noodles
3. Mix together until the oranges are finely chopped into a sauce
4. In a large bowl
5. Put the ramen noodles and drained bamboo shoots
6. Pour the orange mixture over them to cover
7. Let the noodles soak for 45 minutes to an hour until they absorb lots of the liquid and get soft
8. Heat the noodles and shoots with the orange marinade in a skillet over medium heat for about 5 minutes until the sauce bubbles
9. Top with green onions and peanuts then serve

title: gramma s  i told you so   peanut butter cookies
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 350f
2. Mix ingredients together
3. Using a teaspoon to scoop dough , roll and place on ungreased cookie sheet
4. Flatten with a fork dipped in sugar
5. Bake in oven 8 - 10 minute
6. Do not over cook
7. Allow to cool slightly before removing from cookie sheet , cookies will be very soft until completely cooled , this is normal
8. Enjoy with a glass of milk !

title: hawaiian pesto
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients except oil in food processor
2. With processor running , gradually add oil

title: tea milk   theemelk
steps:
1. Heat milk to boiling point , taking care not to scorch
2. Add tea bags and sugar to taste
3. Steep for at least 3 minutes
4. Serve hot or cold

title: greek lemon chicken with potatoes
steps:
1. Wash the chicken well and pat dry
2. Combine all the remaining ingredients and massage the chicken , inside and out , with this mixture
3. Put the chicken in a big bowl and put in the fridge while you prepare the potatoes
4. Put the potatoes and all remaining ingredients into a large baking pan
5. Wash your hands and put them in the pan and toss the potatoes around to coat with other ingredients
6. Put in the oven and crank up the heat to 250c
7. Start roasting the potatoes and when they're golden-brown , stir them to bring the white sides up and push to the side of the pan to make room in the middle for the chicken
8. If all the water has evaporated , and potatoes have started to stick to pan , add 1 / 2 cup more
9. Add the chicken , breast-side down , and pour any juices that have accumulated in bowl over
10. Return to very hot oven and roast until chicken is golden-brown
11. Turn over , breast-side up and continue roasting until chicken is nearly as golden-brown on other side
12. At this point , i turn the oven off- don't open it- and leave the chicken in for another 1 / 2 an hour
13. I like to think i'm saving energy this way , but it also cooks the chicken beautifully
14. In all , i'd say from when you put the potatoes into the cold oven to when you remove the chicken to carve after sitting in off oven for 1 / 2 an hour , we're talking 2 hours
15. Serve with pan juices

title: cream cheese penguins
steps:
1. Cut a slit lengthwise from top to bottom in each jumbo olive
2. Fill the cavity of each jumbo olive with about 1 tsp of cream cheese
3. Cut carrot into 1 / 4 inch slices , then out of each slice cut a small notch , save the piece you cut out this will become the beak
4. Cut a small slit in the center of each small olive and press the cut out piece of carrot into the hole with the pointed end out
5. Using a frill toothpick , stack head , body and feet , adjusting so that beak , cream cheese breast and notch in carrot slice line up

title: unique tuna lasagna casserole
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350
2. Lightly , grease a 12x8x2 baking pan
3. In a medium saucepan , combine the first 6 ingredients
4. Stir well and bring to a boil
5. Cover and reduce the heat , simmer 15 minutes
6. Stir on occasion
7. Cook the lasagna noodles as directed on package
8. Drain
9. With spoon , add one third of the tunafish mixture into the dish
10. Layer half each of the noodles , ricotta , and mozzerella cheese
11. Top with one third of tuna mixture
12. Repeat the layers with the remaining noodles , ricotta , mozzerall and tuna
13. Sprinkle on top layer , the parmesan cheese
14. Uncovered , bake for 40 minutes

title: cabbage   sausage
steps:
1. Shred cabbage & cook 15 minutes in salted water
2. Cook sausage & remove from skillet
3. In same skillet , cook onion until clear
4. Set onion aside & save drippings
5. Beat eggs & add to milk
6. Layer sausage & onions in casserole
7. Repeat layers & pour egg mixture over all
8. Top with crumbs & drizzle with 2-3 tablespoons sausage drippings
9. Cover & cook at 350f for 45 minutes

title: easy garlic bread
steps:
1. In a larger bowl , blend together flour , cheese , sugar , both powders , and italian seasoning
2. In a medium bowl , add milk , oil , and egg , mixing well
3. Stir into wet bowl into dry bowl , until moistened
4. Pour into a greased 9x5-inch loaf pan
5. Bake at 350 f for 50 to 55 minutes or until toothpick inserted near centre comes out clean
6. When you remove from oven , spread margarine over top with paper towel
7. Cool for 10 minutes in pan
8. Remove to wire rack and cool for 10 more minutes , then enjoy

title: upside down lemon custard cups
steps:
1. In bowl blend butter , egg yolks and lemon juice , stir in zest , salt , sugar and flour beat til smooth
2. Add milk and stir to blend
3. Beat egg whites til stiff but not dry
4. Fold whites into yolk mixture
5. Turn into 6 buttered custard cups set in pan of hot water bake 30-35 minutes at 375 degrees f
6. Chill , turn out onto dessert dish upside down

title: garlic extravaganza cheese spread dip with jalapeno jelly or ras
steps:
1. Fill a soup / salad bowl with grated cheese
2. It will take up less room as you mix
3. Add garlic & onion to your preference
4. This recipe is meant to have a powerful amount of garlic flavor
5. Add mayo by spoonful & mix until it's about the same consistency as pimento cheese spread
6. Of course , taste with a dab of jalapeo jelly on a cracker & adjust garlic & onion & mayo to your preference
7. Best if chilled for an hour before serving
8. Do not top with jelly or preserves until you are ready to serve it
9. Serve cheese spread smushed out a little on a saucer / plate
10. Spoon jalapeo jelly or raspberry preserves over the top
11. You want to have about the same amount of jelly / preserves as cheese spread
12. You want about a 1:1 ratio of cheese spread to jelly on your cracker for it to taste perfect
13. I usually have one dish with the jalapeno jelly & another dish with the raspberry preserves because many of my people are scared of the jalapeno jelly
14. The recipe's creator says you must use club crackers , but i prefer the ritz type

title: golden coconut drops
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Grease cookie sheet
3. Cream the butter and gradually add the sugar , beating until light and fluffy
4. Add the eggs and mix well
5. Stir in the coconut , flour , vanilla , and orange rind
6. Drop by teaspoonfuls on the cookie sheet and bake for 10-15 minutes , or until golden
7. Cool slightly before removing cookies from sheet

title: chicken  tikka masala   vegan style
steps:
1. Chop 'chicken' into 1" cubes
2. Mix all marinade ingredients together and add the cubed gardein chicken
3. Marinate for about 1 hour
4. Soak bamboo skewers in warm water while preparing sauce
5. For sauce , melt 'butter' on medium heat until melted
6. Add garlic and cook for 1 minute
7. Stir in coriander , cumin , paprika , garam masala and salt
8. Stir in tomato sauce and simmer for 15 minutes
9. Add peas and stir in coconut milk
10. Simmer on low heat while preparing the gardein chicken
11. Thread gardein chicken onto skewers and discard marinade
12. Broil gardein chicken , turning occasionally , to cook through for about 8-10 minutes
13. Remove gardein chicken from skewers and add to sauce and simmer for 5 minutes
14. Garnish with fresh cilantro and serve with basmati or jasmine rice

title: spanish style halibut
steps:
1. Cook bacon in skillet until crisp
2. Remove from pan , crumble and set aside
3. Combine salt , paprika , and pepper in a small bowl
4. Sprinkle spice mixture evenly over fish
5. Add fish to bacon drippings in skillet and cook for 3 minutes on each side or until fish flakes easily
6. Remove fish from pan and keep warm
7. Add garlic to pan and cook for 1 minute
8. Stirring frequently
9. Add bacon and spinach to pan and cook until spinach begins to wilt
10. Serve with fish

title: cashew chicken lettuce wraps
steps:
1. Stir hoisin , vinegar , and water in a small bowl until well blended and set aside
2. Season chicken with salt and set aside
3. Heat wok on high until hot , then add oil , swirling to coat then add ginger , stirring until fragrant
4. Add chicken and stirfry for about a minute then add carrot and stirfry another 2 minutes or until chicken is just cooked and carrots are tender
5. Add hoisin mixture and green onions and toss until heated through
6. Remove from heat and add cashews
7. Spoon mixture into lettuce leaves , wrap up , and enjoy !

title: hummus bi tahina
steps:
1. Drain chickpeas , reserving 1 / 4 cup liquid , and set aside
2. Process garlic 10 seconds in food processor or until minced
3. Add chickpeas , reserved 1 / 4 cup liquid , tahini , lemon juice and water
4. Process 3 minutes or until smooth , scraping sides of bowl occasionally
5. Spoon tahini mixture into a serving bowl
6. Serve immediately or cover and chill
7. Nutrition information : 44 cal , 1
8. 8 g fat , 2
9. 4 g pro , 5
10. 5 g carb , 1
11. 1 g fiber , 0 mg chol , 0
12. 7 mg iron , 74 mg sod , 28 mg calc , 1 ww point

title: cheesy flower power pasta bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. In a large bowl , combine pasta sauce and water
3. Stir in ricotta , 1 cup mozzarella , and parmesan cheese , then uncooked pasta
4. Evenly spoon pasta mixture into a 13x9-inch baking dish
5. Cover tightly with aluminum foil and bake 45 minutes
6. Remove foil , then sprinkle with remaining 1 cup mozzarella cheese
7. Bake , uncovered , an additional 5 minutes or until mozzarella is melted
8. Let stand 10 minutes before serving

title: oatmeal carmelitas
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350
2. Grease 13x9 inch pan
3. In large bowl , blend all crust ingredients at low speed until crumbly
4. Press half of crumb mixture , about 3 cups , in bottom of greased pan
5. Reserve remaining crumb mixture for topping
6. Bake at 350 for 10 minutes
7. Meanwhile , in small bowl combine caramel topping and 3 tbls
8. Flour
9. Set aside
10. Sprinkle warm crust with chocolate chips and nuts
11. Drizzle evenly with caramel mixture
12. Sprinkle with reserved crumb mixture
13. Return to oven and bake an additional 18 to 22 minutes or until golden brown
14. Cool completely
15. Refrigerate 1 to 2 hours or until filling is set
16. Cut into bars
17. Enjoy !

title: carries macaroni and cheese with ham
steps:
1. Cook macaroni according to package directions , adding the diced onion when you put the dry pasta into the boiling water
2. Drain and rinse
3. While pasta is draining , melt margarine in the pot and then add the flour , garlic powder & salt
4. Stir constantly until thick and turning a dark butter color
5. Add the milk and stir until it starts to thicken , then slowly , a bit at a time , add the cheese , stirring constantly
6. When everything is melted together and smooth , add the macaroni and ham in and mix well
7. Serve or bake in an oven proof dish for 20 minutes at 375 for a crispy top

title: clams in sherry sauce
steps:
1. Soak the clams in cold water for an hour to help remove any sand or grit inside them
2. Heat the olive oil in a medium-sized , heavy-based saucepan until hot but not smoking hot
3. Add the garlic and onion and reduce the heat
4. Fry , stirring , for 2-3 minutes
5. Add the chili and bay leaves and fry , stirring now and then , for a further 2-3 minutes , until the onion has softened
6. Drain the soaking clams and add to the saucepan
7. Increase the heat to high and pour in the sherry
8. Cover the pot and cook , covered , for 2-3 minutes , shaking the pot once or twice
9. Uncover the saucepan , check that the clams have opened and , using a slotted spoon , remove the clams from the pot
10. Place the clams in a warm serving bowl , cover and set aside
11. Meanwhile , briskly cook the sherry in the saucepan until reduced by a third
12. Stir in the paprika
13. Pour the sherry sauce over the clams , sprinkle with parsley and serve at once with lemon wedges

title: it s so easy banana fritters
steps:
1. Coat bananas lightly with flour
2. Sift the flour , cornflour and baking powder into a bowl
3. Make a well in centre and gradually add milk
4. Mix to a smooth consistency similar to thickened cream
5. Dip bananas into batter and fry in hot oil until golden brown
6. Coat thinly with sugar

title: puto
steps:
1. Combine ingredients together
2. Mixing well
3. Using muffin pans or egg poacher for molds
4. Grease pans with butter or pam spray
5. Ok , i found a similar recipes on other sites -- they used muffin cups
6. Pour mixture into pans
7. Steam for about 10-15 minutes
8. Makes about 15-20 large muffins or 25-30 small ones

title: make ahead glazed sprouts   onions
steps:
1. Rinse sprouts , trim stems& remove loose outer leaves
2. Cut a cross in the stem bottoms
3. If larger than a walnut , cut in half
4. Seal in a plastic bag& refrigerate until ready to cook- up to 2 days
5. Slice onion into rings& cut rings in half
6. Saute in butter over medium heat until softened , about 5 minutes
7. Add broth , sugar , vinegar , pepper& salt and bring to a boil
8. Let cool , place in a covered jar& refrigerate until ready to assemble
9. To assemble , combine sprouts& jar contents in a large pan set over medium-high heat
10. Bring to a boil , then reduce to medium-low
11. Partially cover& boil gently , stirring often , until sprouts are fork-tender , from 15- 17 minutes
12. Place in a serving dish& sprinkle with dill

title: graham and fruit bars
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f
2. In medium bowl , mix flour , cereal , brown sugar and cinnamon
3. Stir in butter until well blended
4. Reserve 3 / 4 cup of the cereal mixture
5. Press remaining cereal mixture in bottom of 8-inch square pan
6. Spread jam over cereal mixture in pan
7. Sprinkle with reserved cereal mixture
8. Bake 23 to 25 minutes or until top is light golden brown and jam is bubbling
9. Cool 15 minutes before cutting
10. For bars , cut into 6 rows by 4 rows

title: shirley temple black
steps:
1. Fill a tall glass with ice
2. Add the rum , then cranberry juice
3. Fill the glass with 7-up and garnish with cherries

title: cabbage non rolls  casserole
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f
2. Mix the seasonings in a small bowl and set aside
3. Peel and chop the onion , peel and grate the carrot , and chop the celery
4. Break up the meat and cook it in a skillet until browned through
5. If it is very lean , you may need to add a little oil
6. Add the onion , carrot and celery after it has cooked for a few minutes
7. When the meat is browned and the vegetables softened , add the spices and mix them in
8. Let cook just until the garlic is fragrant
9. Remove the meat mixture to a very large lasagne pan or shallow casserole
10. Mix in the chopped cabbage , sauerkraut , rice and tomatoes
11. Spread evenly in the pan
12. Add the water
13. It should come up to near the top of the mixture
14. Cover the pan with foil
15. Bake at 350f for one hour
16. Stirring once in the middle

title: syrian style lentil and chard soup
steps:
1. Sort and wash the lentils and cook in the water or vegetable broth with the spices and the nutritional yeast , if you choose that option
2. Meanwhile , chop the onions , garlic and chard and saute in the olive oil , briefly , then cover and turn heat to low to steam the chard
3. When the lentils are nearly done , add the chard / onion mixture , cover and simmer until lentils are soft
4. Adjust the amount of water as needed
5. Add salt to taste
6. With a stick blender or in a food processor blend the soup partially
7. Finish with lemon / lime juice to taste
8. Do not add the juice until the lentils are completely cooked

title: microwave twist on potatoes for 2
steps:
1. Cook potatos according to your microwave specifications
2. Let cool just so you can handle them and then cut into bit size pieces
3. Place in a container with a lid
4. Add lemon juice , cilantro , salt and pepper
5. Place lid on and give a good shake
6. Adjust spices to your liking
7. Enjoy !

title: amazing double peanut butter cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Line baking sheets with parchment or a silpat
3. Cream butter , sugars , peanut butter , baking powder , baking soda , and salt
4. Add eggs one at a time
5. Stir in the flour until incorporated
6. Stir in peanut butter chips
7. Drop by rounded teaspoonfuls onto prepared sheets
8. Bake for 10-12 minutes , until set
9. And brown around the edges
10. Remove from oven and cool on pan 5 minutes
11. Remove from pan to finish cooling

title: tortilla  black bean  corn and tomato soup
steps:
1. Heat oil over medium heat
2. Add garlic , hot pepper and chili powder and cook until fragrant
3. Add tomatoes , beans , broth , corn and 1 cup of water
4. Season with salt and pepper
5. Bring to a boil
6. Reduce to simmer and add tortilla chips
7. Cook until softened
8. Remove from heat and stir in lime juice
9. Season with salt and pepper if it needs it
10. Serve with either lime wedges or sour cream -- maybe add some more crunchy chips -- all are optional
11. Enjoy

title: zesty chicken soup with tomatoes and rice
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large , heavy soup pot or stew pan
2. Add onion and saute over medium heat until golden
3. Add chicken , sprinkle with salt and pepper and saute 7 minutes
4. Add water , tomatoes , garlic , paprika and turmeric and and bring to a simmer
5. Skim foam from surface
6. Cover and simmer 45 minutes , skimming fat occasionally
7. Add squash and cook for 10 minutes or until zucchini and chicken are tender
8. In a separate saucepan , bring 4 cups water to a boil and add salt
9. Add rice and cook uncovered over medium-high heat for 15 minutes or until just tender
10. Drain well
11. Rinse with cold water if cooking it ahead , and drain well

title: roast beef and swiss tortilla roll ups
steps:
1. Spread 1 t dressing on each tortilla , covering entire surface
2. Top each with lettuce leaf and half of beef , cheese and onion
3. Roll up each tortilla tightly
4. To serve , cut roll-ups into 1-inch slices
5. Insert cocktail toothpick into each to secure
6. Serve with pickle wedges

title: vicki bickies
steps:
1. Mix the flour , sugar , oats and coconut in a bowl
2. Make a hole in the center
3. Melt the margarine with the maple syrup
4. While that's melting , mix the baking soda with the boiling water
5. Add the baking soda / water mixture to the margarin / maple syrup mixture
6. Mix well
7. Pour this into the hole in the dry ingredient mix
8. Mix well
9. Add the egg , mix well
10. Form into cookies and place on a greased baking sheet
11. Bake at 180 degrees celcius until the cookies are golden , around 20 minutes or so

title: hot and sour shrimp soup
steps:
1. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil
2. Add pasta and cook for 8-10 minutes or until al dente
3. Drain
4. Heat oil over medium heat in a large saucepan
5. Cook mushrooms and garlic in oil until soft
6. Stir in tomato , pineapple , celery and sugar and cook until tomatoes begin to soften
7. Stir in chicken broth and water and bring to a boil
8. Reduce heat and stir in lime juice and soy sauce and simmer 5 minutes
9. Stir in shrimp and red pepper and simmer 3 minutes more , until shrimp are pink
10. Stir in bean sprouts , onion and reserved noodles
11. Heat through and serve

title: curried red lentil  chickpea and kale soup
steps:
1. Saute onion , carrots and celery in nonstick pan , about 5 to 7 minutes , use a little water to prevent sticking of burning
2. Precook kale in large saucepan of boiling water for about 2 to 3 minutes
3. Add drained kale , lentils , chickpeas and broth to carrot mixture , bring to a boil
4. Cover , reduce heat and simmer for about 15 minutes or until lentils are tender
5. Allow soup to cool , then puree in blender , once soup is blended return to pan
6. Add coconut milk , ginger , spices and salt
7. Stir well
8. Cover and simmer for 10 minutes
9. Add garnish of coconut and peanuts when served in bowls

title: quick tomato mac  n  beef
steps:
1. In large skillet , cook beef and onion until beef is no longer pink
2. Drain
3. Season with salt and pepper if desired
4. Add tomatoes and water
5. Bring to a boil
6. Stir in macaroni
7. Cover and simmer 10 minutes or until macaroni is cooked
8. Stir in cheese
9. Garnish with green onions and sour cream if desired

title: black bean hummus
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a food processor and process until smooth
2. Serve with pita bread and / or crackers

title: sugar free  fat free  5 minute creamsicle mousse
steps:
1. Mix jell-o with 1 cup boiling water
2. Dissolve jell-o completely and add 1 cup cold water and let it sit for 5 minutes
3. Using electric beater , beat in pudding mix until well combined
4. Fold in cool whip
5. Chill and serve until set
6. 4 servings

title: cinnamon ginger cake
steps:
1. 1
2. Cream butter and sugar in a small bowl with electric mixer until light and fluffy
3. Add egg , beat until combined , gradually add honey , beat well
4. 2
5. Transfer mixture to large bowl , stir in half the sifted dry ingredients with half the water , then stir in remaining dry ingredients with water
6. Stir until smooth
7. 3
8. Pour into prepared tin , bake at 190 degrees celsius for about 1hour
9. Stand 5minutes before turning onto wire rack to cool

title: mighty miso soup
steps:
1. In a medium pot , add the water , tofu , mushrooms , and seaweed and bring to a boil on medium-high heat
2. Reduce heat and simmer for 5-8 minutes , until mushrooms are tender
3. Remove from heat , stir in the miso , onions , and spinach and let sit for another 30 seconds

title: crispy chocolate peanut butter pretzel balls
steps:
1. In a double boiler or microwave melt the chocolate and peanut butter
2. If microwaving , start with a minute and then add additional time until melted
3. Be careful not to burn the chocolate
4. Mix in the pretzels and rice cereal until everything is coated and well incorporated
5. Drop by the teaspoonful onto a lined cookie sheet and place in the fridge
6. Once hardened , you can transfer to a bag or container
7. These are best stored in the fridge

title: a different green bean casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Grease / spray a casserole dish
3. Set aside
4. Melt butter in a saucepan
5. Add coarsley chopped onions and sautee until soft and translucent but not brown
6. Stir in the flour until dissolved
7. Whisk in the mlik , stirring constantly for several minutes until thickened
8. Stir in the dijon , parmesan cheese , salt , pepper and red pepper flakes
9. Stir constantly until thick and cheese is melted
10. If too thick at this point , add more milk
11. Remove from heat and gently stir in the drained green beans
12. Pour into the prepared casserole dish
13. Sprinkle with the crushed buttery crackers
14. Bake at 375 for 30 minutes or until cracker crumbs brown

title: creamy salmon bake
steps:
1. Mix ingredients for topping and refrigerate for at least an hour
2. Preheat oven to 350
3. Pat salmon fillets dry with paper towel
4. Place skin side down in baking sheet and spread topping generously completely over top of fillet
5. Bake for about 12 minutes , or until fish easily flakes

title: lemon and thyme grilled asparagus
steps:
1. Mix olive oil , garlic , thyme , salt and pepper in a shallow pan
2. Toss aparagus in the mixture and coat thoroughly
3. Cook immediately , or for more flavorful asparagus , let sit in fridge for twenty minutes
4. Fire up the grill and cook until asparagus are browned or until desired
5. Serve immediately

title: winterfresh fudge bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Brownies:
3. Melt the chocolate and butter together over low heat , stirring frequently
4. Remove from heat to cool slightly
5. In the bowl of a stand mixer , combine chocolate-butter mixture with sugar , vanilla , and eggs on medium speed for 1 minute , scraping down the sides of the bowl frequently
6. Mix in flour and salt and beat for 30 seconds
7. Scrape bowl and beat for 1 minute
8. Stir in chocolate chips
9. Mint filling:
10. Beat the cream cheese until smooth with electric mixer
11. Scrape sides of bowl and beat in sugar , eggs , and creme de menthe until smooth and fully blended
12. Add 2 drops food coloring to heighten filling color
13. Spread half of brownie mixture in a greased 13 by 9 by 2-inch pan
14. Pour mint filling on top of brownie batter and spread to edge
15. Carefully spread the other half of the brownie mixture on top of the mint filling
16. Bake for 40 to 45 minutes until sides pull away from pan and a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean
17. Cool in pan
18. Frosting:
19. Beat butter until smooth with electric mixer
20. Add sugar and melted chocolate to butter and beat
21. Slowly add mint extract and enough milk , 1 tablespoon at a time , to make desired consistency
22. Spread frosting on top of cooled chocolate mint brownies
23. Sprinkle the crushed candy canes on top of frosting
24. Cut the bars into 8 rows by 6 rows and serve or package as gifts

title: delicious caramel apple bars
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees f
2. Grease a 15 x 10" baking pan
3. In a small pan over low heat , melt butter
4. In a large bowl , combine 2 cups flour , 2 cups oats , brown sugar , baking soda , and melted butter
5. Mix until crumbly
6. Press half of the mixture in the prepared baking pan
7. Bake for 8 minutes
8. Set aside the remaining crumbs
9. In a small pan over medium heat , combine caramel topping and 1 / 2 cup flour
10. Bring to a boil , stirring constantly
11. Boil for 2-3 minutes , or until slightly thickened
12. Spread the apples and the chopped nuts onto the baked crust
13. Pour the hot caramel mixture evenly over apples and nuts
14. Sprinkle reserved crumbly mixture evenly over the top of caramel
15. Return pan to oven
16. Bake for 20-25 minutes , or until golden brown
17. Cool completely in the pan
18. Cut into bars
19. Store tightly covered

title: kabocha squash with sage and leeks
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Prepare squash by washing , poking 2-4 holes into center with sharp knife
3. Bake whole squash in oven for 60-90 minutes , until soft
4. When squash is done , cut in half , remove seeds and fibers , and scrape flesh from skin into a bowl , mash but do not puree squash
5. Melt butter in a large skillet
6. Add sage leaves and fry until crisp 1-2 minutes
7. Add leek and salt and continue heating 2-5 minutes until leeks are soft and translucent
8. Now add squash to skillet and mix until all butter is incorporated

title: meat and potatoes casserole
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan , bring carrots , onion , and 4 cups water to a boil over high heat
2. Reduce heat to medium
3. Cook , covered , until veggies are tender
4. Add peas and cook
5. Remove from heat
6. Drain , reserving 2 cups of the veggie water
7. Set aside water and veggies
8. Stir beaten egg into prepared mashed potatoes
9. Set aside
10. Heat oven to 350 degrees
11. Lightly oil a 9x9x2-inch casserole
12. In large skillet over medium heat , saut ground round and garlic in oil for 5 minute stir in worcestershire sauce , thyme , hot-pepper sauce , and salt
13. Add flour to meat mixture and cook , stirring
14. Stir in 2 cups reserved veggie water
15. Bring to a boil over high heat and cook until thickened
16. Remove from heat
17. Stir in carrot mixture
18. Pour into prepared pan
19. Spread mashed potatoes evenly over top
20. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes or until bubbly and the potatoes are browned
21. Makes 6 servings

title: white bean salad with lemon and cumin
steps:
1. Place beans in large bowl
2. Add enough cold water to cover by 2 inches
3. Let beans soak overnight
4. Drain beans
5. Place in heavy large saucepan
6. Add bay leaves and enough cold water to cover by 2 inches
7. Bring to boil
8. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer 30 minutes
9. Add salt and continue to simmer until beans are tender but still hold shape , about 15 minutes longer
10. Drain beans and place in large bowl
11. Discard bay leaves
12. Add onion and parsley
13. Whisk oil , lemon juice , cumin , and cayenne in medium bowl
14. Season dressing with salt and pepper
15. Pour over bean salad
16. Toss gently to combine
17. Do ahead can be made 2 hours ahead
18. Let stand at room temperature
19. Arrange lettuce leaves on individual plates or on large platter
20. Spoon bean salad into lettuce and serve

title: easy sauerkraut hot dish
steps:
1. Brown hamburger , drain grease
2. Place in large casserole
3. Add hash browns
4. Then spread soup over potatoes
5. Drain sauerkraut and layer on top
6. You don't have to use the whole can
7. Bake at 350 for 1 hour
8. Sprinkle cheese and bake until melted
9. Stir well before serving

title: our family favorite  john wayne casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees f
2. Mix chiles and cheeses and put into a buttered shallow casserole
3. In a small bowl combine milk , egg yolks , flour , salt and pepper
4. In a large bowl beat egg whites to stiff peaks
5. Gently fold whites into the yolk mixture
6. Then pour the mixture over the cheese and chile mixture and carefully blend
7. Bake for 30 minutes
8. Remove from oven and lay tomato slices over the entire top
9. Return to oven and bake 30 minutes longer , or until an inserted knife comes out clean
10. Garnish with a sprinkling of green chiles
11. Serves 8

title: pizza casserole   easy and kid pleasing
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350
2. Cook noodles according to package directions
3. Drain and reserve
4. Meanwhile , cook ground beef , onion , and garlic over medium high heat for 6 minutes or until beef is no longer pink
5. Drain off excess liquid
6. Stir in oregano , salt , soup , 1 / 3 c water , and noodles
7. Remove from heat and add half the cheese
8. Spoon into 11x7 baking dish and sprinkle the remaining cheese over the top
9. Bake for 25-30 minutes until bubbly
10. Allow to cool for 5-10 minutes before serving
11. "

title: sauteed spring peas  asparagus  red peppers and onions
steps:
1. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil
2. Boil the fresh peas and asparagus separately until crisp-tender , about 1 minute each
3. Plunge into cold water to stop the cooking process
4. Drain
5. In a large skillet , heat olive oil and butter over medium heat
6. Add onion and bell pepper and cook until slightly wilted , about 3 minutes
7. Add peas , asparagus , salt and pepper , and cook for 1 to 2 minutes
8. Increase heat to high and add chicken stock
9. Cook until reduced by half-- about 3 minutes
10. Enjoy !

title: herbed macaroni and cheese
steps:
1. Cook macaroni according to package directions
2. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
3. Meanwhile , in a saucepan , melt butter over medium heat
4. Stir in the flour and seasonings
5. Gradually add milk
6. Cook and stir until thickened
7. Remove from heat
8. Add sour cream , havarti cheese and 1 / 2 cup cheddar cheese
9. Stir until melted
10. Drain macaroni
11. Place in an ungreased 1-1 / 2 quart baking dish
12. Add cheese sauce and mix well
13. Combine parmesan cheese , bread crumbs and remaining cheddar cheese
14. Sprinkle over casserole
15. Bake , uncovered , at 350 for 15-20 minutes

title: greek chicken pasta
steps:
1. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil
2. Cook pasta in boiling water for 8 to 10 minutes , or until al dente
3. Drain
4. Meanwhile , heat olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat
5. Add garlic and onion , and saute for 2 minutes
6. Stir in the chicken
7. Cook , stirring occasionally , until chicken is no longer pink and the juices run clear , about 5 to 6 minutes
8. Reduce heat to medium-low , and add the artichoke hearts , tomato , feta cheese , parsley , lemon juice , oregano and cooked pasta
9. Stir until heated through , about 2 to 3 minutes
10. Remove from heat , season to taste with salt and pepper , and garnish with lemon wedges

title: overnight fluffy rolls
steps:
1. Dissolve the sugar then the yeast in the warm water
2. Let "proof" for about 10 minutes - it should swell and get bubbly
3. In a large bowl , beat together the eggs and sugar until light
4. Mix in the oil , milk , and proofed yeast until well blended
5. In a separate bowl , mix together the dry ingredients
6. Add mixture to the wet ingredients and mix until dough is smooth and elastic
7. Pour dough into large oiled bowl and let rise for 4 hours or overnight in refrigerator
8. Spray baking sheets with baking spray or lightly butter
9. Pour onto floured board , divide the dough in half
10. Roll out each half as you would for a pie crust , then cut the dough into 12 pie-piece shaped pieces
11. Roll each piece into a crescent shape or shape rolls however you wish
12. Place shaped rolls on the baking sheets , then put in a warm place to rise , about 2 to 3 hours
13. When ready to bake , preheat oven to 350 degrees f
14. Bake for 10 to 12 minutes until golden

title: festive cream cheese ball
steps:
1. Mix cream cheese , ham , onions , worcestershire sauce & salt
2. Form the mixture into a ball or log and roll in the nuts or bacon bits
3. Chill 2 hours
4. Serve with crackers enjoy !

title: chocolate crunch mud pie
steps:
1. Make the crust first
2. Melt chocolate and butter in the microwave
3. Mix in rice krispies
4. Quickly press mixture into a 9 inch pie plate
5. The bottom and up the sides
6. Freeze for 1-2 hours or until hard
7. Then blend first five filling ingredients well
8. Fold in cool whip and pour into frozen crust
9. Top with real whipped cream and chocolate shavings or a dusting of cocoa powder
10. Serve cold

title: 5 minute   double layer chocolate pie
steps:
1. Beat milk , pudding and 1 / 2 of the whipped topping in medium bowl with wire whisk 1 minute
2. Spread in crust
3. Spread remaining whipped topping over pudding layer in crust
4. Enjoy immediately or refrigerate until ready to serve
5. Garnish as desired

title: campbell s skillet beef and macaroni
steps:
1. Cook beef , celery , and oregano in skillet until browned
2. Pour off fat
3. Add soup , salsa , corn , and pasta
4. Heat through
5. Top with cheese and heat until cheese is melted

title: kathleens 3 bean salad
steps:
1. Drain the canned beans and place in large bowl
2. Cut the red onion into slices , then separate into rings
3. Cut the bell pepper into medium thin rings
4. Add optional pimentos if you are going to add them
5. Add optional sliced water chestnuts if you are going to add them
6. Make dressing by combining dressing ingredients in the following manner
7. With wire whisk or in food processor ,
8. Mix sugar and oil and process or beat in by hand until sugar is dissolved in oil
9. Then add vinegar as the processor is going and add add garlic , salt and pepper
10. Pour dressing over salad
11. Taste and adjust for balance of sweet / sour , add a little oil or water as needed if too strong
12. Sprinkle dried parsley over the finished salad
13. It will soak into the dressing
14. Let marinate and blend in refrigerator
15. It really gets good when it is refrigerated and sits overnight but can be eaten sooner
16. This is a great dish to accompany picnic foods

title: stuffed french toast with strawberry grand marnier
steps:
1. Cut french bread into 8-10 1-inch thick slices
2. Make a slit in the crust of each slice
3. Combine cinnamon , nutmeg , cream cheese and sugar
4. Spoon cream cheese mixture into slits of bread
5. Whisk eggs and half-and-half together
6. Dip each slice of bread into egg mixture and place in well-greased 9 x 13-inch pan
7. Pour remaining egg mixture over all and soak overnight
8. Bake at 350 degrees 35 minutes or until golden and puffed
9. Serve with strawberry grand marnier sauce
10. Strawberry grand marnier sauce:
11. 1 / 3 cup butter - melted
12. 1 / 2 cup sifted powdered sugar
13. 1 tablespoons corn starch
14. 3 tablespoons grand marnier
15. 2 cups strawberries - sliced
16. Melt butter in skillet
17. Slowly add powdered sugar , cornstarch and grand marnier and allow mixture to thicken over low heat
18. Add strawberries at last minute
19. Spoon small amount of mixture over each piece of french toast

title: mom s cranberry bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Sift dry ingredients together
3. Add cranberries and nuts
4. Add eggs mixed with oj and oil , mix slightly
5. Bake in greased loaf pan at 350 for one hour

title: red bean  rice and sausage soup
steps:
1. Saut onion and garlic in oil in large saucepan until onion begins to brown
2. Add remaining ingredients except sausage and salt
3. Heat to boiling
4. Reduce heat and simmer , covered , 20 minutes , stirring occasionally
5. Add sausage and simmer , uncovered , 10 minutes or until soup has thickened slightly
6. Discard bay leaf and season with salt

title: chicken with artichokes and melted lemons
steps:
1. Heat the olive oil in an 8-inch skillet over medium high heat , and swirl to cover the bottom of the pan
2. Add the chicken breasts and sear them until browned
3. Turn the chicken , and brown them on the other side
4. Remove the chicken breasts to a plate and increase the heat to high
5. Deglaze the pan with the lemon juice , scraping up any browned bits into the sauce
6. Add the stock and bring to a simmer
7. Add the lemon slices to the pan , reduce the heat to medium , and place the chicken breasts on top of the lemon slices
8. Add the capers , cover , reduce the heat to medium and cook , covered , for 10 minutes
9. Remove the lid and add the drained artichoke hearts
10. Cover and continue cooking for five minutes , or until the breasts are cooked through
11. Remove the chicken to a warm plate
12. Increase the temperature and reduce the sauce to a glaze
13. Taste the sauce and adjust the seasoning with salt and pepper as needed
14. Just a little salt will reduce the acidity of the lemons , capers and artichokes and balance the flavors
15. Serve the chicken with the artichoke hearts , capers and melted lemons drizzled with the glaze

title: fast and easy icing
steps:
1. Put all ingredients in a bowl and whisk together just until all ingredients are combined
2. Frost cake !

title: bo s coleslaw from one world cafe
steps:
1. In a bowl , combine the green and red cabbage onion , carrots and celery
2. In a separate bowl , combine dressing ingredients
3. Toss vegetables with dressing

title: garlic butter   cheese popcorn
steps:
1. Place the popcorn in a large bowl and set aside
2. Saute the garlic in the butter or oil for about 3 minutes , until golden
3. Pour over the popcorn and mix thoroughly
4. Stir in the cheese , add salt to taste , and toss again
5. Enjoy !

title: acorn bread
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400 degrees
2. Grease a loaf pan
3. Sift together dry ingredients in a bowl
4. In a separate bowl , combine egg , milk , and oil
5. Combine dry and liquid ingredients
6. Stir just enough to moisten dry ingredients
7. Batter will be a bit lumpy
8. Pour into a greased pan , bake at 400 degrees for 30 minutes
9. Acorns are very easy to use , similar to chestnuts
10. First examine the acorns as you pick / gather them
11. Throw away any that are wormy / moldy / cracked / etc
12. Next , shell them
13. Early in the season the shell is usually soft enough to cut through
14. Later in the season acorns may require a nut cracker , though many times the shells are rather thin and brittle
15. Taste the raw acorns- if they are bitter , they need to be boiled
16. Tannic acid causes the bitterness , and is easily leached out by boiling the acorns in successive pots of water
17. When the water no longer turns brown , the acorns are ready
18. The next step is to roast the acorns slightly
19. Use a warm oven , no more than 250 degrees
20. Acorns that have not been boiled will take 60 minutes or so , boiled acorns will take longer
21. Once they're roasted , the acorns can be used in place of nuts in most recipes , although they are less oily than most nuts
22. They can be glazed like chestnuts , simmered in a soup , ground and used as a flour extender

title: soy pickled jalapenos
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a small heavy saucepan and bring to a boil
2. Remove from heat and cool to room temperature , stirring occasionally
3. Marinate , chilled , at least 8 hours
4. Chilled jalapenos will keep chilled 3 days

title: layered vegetable enchiladas
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
2. Mix the corn , green pepper , lime juice , 1 1 / 2 tbsp chili powder and tomatoes
3. Cook over medium-high heat
4. Simmer the mixture until liquid is almost evaporated , about 10 minutes or more
5. In a bowl , mash the beans with 1 / 2 tbsp chili powder
6. Lay four tortillas on a lightly sprayed baking pan
7. Spread the bean mixture on the tortillas , then 1 / 2 cup of the vegetable mixture and a little cheese
8. Add another tortilla , about 1 / 4 cup more of the veggies and any leftover cheese
9. Bake for 15 minutes or until warmed through and browned to your liking

title: microwave sweet pickles
steps:
1. In small bowl mix salt , tumeric , mustard seed , celery seed , vinegar and sugar
2. In microwavable bowl , mix cucumbers and onion
3. Pour vinegar mixture over cucumbers and onion
4. Microwave , uncovered , on high for 5 minutes
5. Stir well , return to microwave for 5 minutes more
6. Cool
7. Pour into quart jar and refrigerate
8. Pickles are ready to eat when thoroughly chilled

title: old virginia carrot tea cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Prepare 10" tube or bundt pan by greasing well
3. In large bowl blend sugar and oil , beat in eggs one at a time
4. Add flour , tea powder , baking soda , baking powder , spices and salt
5. Beat well , then fold in carrots and pecans
6. Spoon into pan and bake 70 minutes
7. Remove from oven when done and cool on wire rack for 15 minutes , them remove from pan
8. For glaze: mix together icing sugar and lemon juice then drizzle over cake when cooled
9. Option: dust lightly with icing sugar instead of glaze

title: peach delight
steps:
1. In a small mixing bowl , beat butter and sugar on medium speed for 2 minutes
2. Gradually beat in flour
3. Mix in walnuts
4. Press onto the bottom of a 13-in
5. X 9-in
6. X 2-in
7. Baking pan coated with nonstick cooking spray
8. Bake at 350 for 14-16 minutes or until lightly browned
9. Cool on a wire rack
10. For filling , in a large mixing bowl , beat cream cheese and confectioners' sugar until smooth
11. Fold in half of the whipped topping
12. Carefully spread over crust
13. Top with peaches
14. For glaze , in a small saucepan , combine cornstarch and water until smooth
15. Bring to a boil
16. Cook and stir for 2 minutes or until thickened
17. Gradually stir in gelatin until dissolved
18. Cool to room temperature
19. Spoon over peaches
20. Cover and refrigerate until firm
21. Dollop with remaining whipped topping

title: another recipe for a loaf of meat
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375 degrees
2. In a large bowl mix all ingredients together
3. It's easiest to use your hands !
4. Shape into a loaf and place into a loaf pan or in the middle of a 13x9 pan
5. Bake for 1 hour

title: russian barley mushroom soup
steps:
1. Thoroughly rinse the mushrooms under cold water
2. Soak the mushrooms in the 6 cups of water for at least one hour
3. Don't drain the water
4. Reserve the mushroom water
5. Uniformly chop the mushrooms and return to the water
6. Add the mushrooms , water , and chicken stock into a large cooking pot
7. Bring to boil
8. Add the barley and cook until the barley is tender
9. This will be about 10 minutes with 'quick' barley or about 35 minutes with regular
10. While the barley is cooking , peel and cube the potatoes to about 3 / 4 inch cubes
11. Cut up the onions and saute them in a skillet until golden
12. Finely chop the cooked onions
13. Chop the carrots
14. Once the barley is tender , put the potatoes , carrots , onions , salt , and pepper into the pot
15. On low-med heat cook until the potatoes are done
16. When serving , add two tablespoons of sour cream and finely chopped parsley to each bowl of soup as garnish

title: caramel coated spiced nuts
steps:
1. In a large mixing bowl , beat egg whites and water until foamy
2. Add the almonds , pecans and cashews
3. Stir gently to coat
4. Combine the brown sugar , pie spice and pepper
5. Add to nut mixture and stir gently to coat
6. Spread into a greased 15"x10"x1" baking pan
7. Bake at 325 degrees for 30 minutes , stirring every 10 minutes
8. Cool
9. Store in airtight container

title: mom s ham and vegetable stew
steps:
1. Saute onion and garlic in olive oil in a large pot until onions are clear
2. Add everything except the seasonings , cabbage , beans , and corn
3. Bring to a boil and reduce heat to simmer
4. After 5 minutes , pour the corn on top , and pour the cabbage on top of the corn
5. Simmer until the potatoes are fork tender , about 20-30 minutes
6. Stir in the beans in the last 5 minutes of cooking
7. Add crushed red pepper , salt , pepper , tabasco to taste

title: old mexico spinach cheese dip
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
2. Saute onion in skillet over medium heat in oil until softened , about 4 minutes
3. Stir in tomatoes and chilis , let cook 2 minutes
4. Transfer the mixture to a large bowl and stir in spinach , cheese , cream cheese , half and half , and vinegar
5. Season with salt and pepper to taste
6. Spoon mixture into shallow baking dish like a 9-inch quiche dish or pie plate
7. Bake in the preheated oven until the dip is bubbly and the top is light brown , about 35 minutes

title: almond pepper green beans
steps:
1. 1
2. Steam green beans for about 10 minutes , drain and rinse with cold water
3. 2
4. Heat oil in skillet over medium heat , add pepper and onion , saute until onions and peppers start to soften
5. 3
6. Add butter to skillet
7. 4
8. Once butter is melted , add green beans to the pot , mix ingredients well , and heat through
9. Sprinkle in the almonds and season to taste with salt and pepper

title: war cake
steps:
1. Put the first 7 ingredients in a heavy gauge saucepan and bring to a boil
2. Cook gently for 5 minutes and remove from heat and let cool until mixture is comfortably cool to your finger
3. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
4. Grease and flour 2 loaf pans
5. Sift together flour , salt , baking soda , and baking powder
6. Add them to the cooled sugar mixture , beat well
7. Stir in walnuts
8. Bake for 45 minutes or toothpick comes out of center clean
9. Cool in pans 10 minutes and then turn out on plate and cool completely

title: sweet and sour meatballs  oriental sweet and sour  meatballs
steps:
1. In large mixing bowl combine and mix: ground meat , sugar , black pepper , dry ginger , soy sauce , the tapioca or cornstarch , minced onion and
2. Knead above for at least two minutes to insure proper marination , form into even sized balls
3. Fry in oil and drain
4. Meanwhile make the sweet and sour sauce: in sauce pot on medium heat whisk together vinegar , sugar , tomato paste , the tapioca starch or cornstarch , the cup of water bring to boil stirring while cooking
5. When mixture reaches boiling point add the meatballs and heat through
6. Add the carrots , peppers and pineapple chunks and cook until vegetables are 'just done'
7. Do not overcook
8. It can then be quickly reheated in the microwave and kept hot in a crockpot
9. This freezes well
10. I also find cooking the carrots separately and then adding , assures they don't get overcooked

title: cheesy quesadillas
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together in a bowl
2. Divide mix into two , and scoop on two tortillas
3. Place the other tortillas on top of the two with the mix
4. Brush corn oil on each side of the quesadilla
5. Throw each one on the barbecue for about 5 minutes , or until each one's cheese is melted
6. Dip in salsa

title: apple cranberry crumble muffins
steps:
1. Mix both types of flour , baking powder , brown sugar and cinnamon in a bowl
2. In another bowl mix together milk , butter and eggs
3. Make a mould in the middle of the flour mixture and add the milk mixture into it
4. Blend in diced apples and cranberries
5. Fill the dough into a lined muffin pan and pre-heat the oven to 190c
6. For the crumble-topping combine flour , butter , sugar and oats using your fingers
7. Knead until a crumbly mixture has formed
8. Spread each muffin with 2 ts of the crumble-topping
9. Bake for 25 minutes

title: another mint chutney
steps:
1. Remove the mint leaves from the stalks
2. Wash and dry and place in a food processor with remaining ingredients
3. Process until smooth
4. Transfer mixture into warm sterilised jar
5. Seal and label when cold
6. Store in the refrigerator until required

title: chicken chow mein casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. In bottom of 9x13 casserole dish , put a layer of chow mein noodles followed by chicken and vegetables
3. Top with remaining noodles
4. Mix soup with 1 can of water
5. Spoon soup mixture over vegetables
6. Drizzle soy sauce over all
7. Bake at 350f for 30-40 minutes
8. Enjoy !

title: sunset s chunky lemon meringue pie
steps:
1. Quarter lemons lengthwise
2. Slice quartered lemons crosswise as thinly as possible , discarding the end pieces that are just peel and pith
3. Put lemon slices in a large bowl with the sugar
4. Toss to combine , cover , and let sit at least 24 hours and up to 2 days at room temperature
5. Put an oven rack on the lowest rung and preheat oven to 450 degrees
6. Lightly dust counter and rolling pin with flour , then unwrap dough
7. With short strokes from center outward , roll dough into a 12-inch circle , turning 90 degrees after every 3 or 4 passes of the rolling pin to keep it from sticking
8. Transfer dough to a 9-inch pie pan , letting it fall into place
9. Trim overhang to 1 / 2 inch , then tuck edge under
10. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate 20 minutes
11. Meanwhile , whisk the whole eggs and egg yolk in a medium bowl until frothy
12. Drain lemons and add lemon slices and 1-1 / 4 cup of the reserved liquid to the eggs
13. Stir to combine
14. Pour filling into crust
15. Cover with foil and bake 15 minutes
16. Remove foil , reduce heat to 325 degrees , and bake another 20 minutes
17. Remove from oven , but leave oven on
18. In a large clean bowl , beat egg whites , salt , and cream of tartar to create soft peaks
19. Add brown and granulated sugars and beat until shiny , firm peaks form
20. Spread meringue in a mound over hot pie and return to oven
21. Bake until top is puffed and deep brown , about 25 minutes
22. Let cool completely , at least 3-1 / 2 hours

title: california mushroom tart
steps:
1. Press pie dough into 9 tart pan
2. Press dough into pans fluted edge , trim excess
3. Cover dart shell with aluminum foil and fill with dried beans or baking weights
4. Bake according to package instructions
5. Let cool 5 minutes and remove weights
6. Slice veges into 1 / 8 slices
7. Pat dry with paper towels
8. Sprinkle cheese , spinach and basil over bottom of tart
9. Arrange vegetables around the edge of tart shell , repeatedly overlapping 2 slices each of mushroom , red bell pepper , and onion
10. Arrange a smaller circle inside the first
11. Put onions in the center , covered by more mushrooms
12. Sprinkle with diced sun-dried tomatoes
13. Drizzle the tart with olive oil
14. Season with salt and pepper
15. Bake at 350f until tart is golden brown around the edges , about 30 minutes

title: salsa topped chicken breasts
steps:
1. Cover and chill salsa 2 hours
2. Sprinkle chili powder , cumin , salt , and pepper over chicken
3. Melt butter in skillet and cook chicken 5-7 minutes on each side
4. Stir cilantro into salsa and serve over chicken

title: easy crab puffs
steps:
1. Combine cheese , crab meat , garlic salt , mayonnaise , and butter / margerine
2. You may need to beat it with an electric mixer to make it semi-smooth
3. Spread evenly between the english muffins halves
4. Cut each half of english muffin into quarters
5. Place the quarters on a baking sheet
6. Bake at 350 degrees for 20-30 minutes , or until slightly brown

title: guacamole muy facil
steps:
1. I felt obligated to point that out
2. In serving bowl , juice the lime
3. Scoop the avocado into the bowl with the lime and lightly mash the ingredients together to stop the avocados from turning brown
4. Next add the salt , a few dashes of pepper and the sour cream , mashing the avocado mixture with fork until very smooth
5. Adjust seasoning and add more lime juice if necessary
6. Cover bowl well and refrigerate at least one hour
7. Guacamole is best eaten within a day
8. Leftover guacamole doesn't exist in our household
9. Yield: approximately 1 cup

title: new orleans skillet pork chops and rice
steps:
1. Saut onion and celery in butter and oil in heavy deep skillet for 2 minutes , or until slightly softened
2. Season pork chops with salt and pepper
3. Brown in skillet on both sides
4. Remove from pan
5. Set aside
6. Add water , brown sugar and 1 1 / 2 cups of the tomato sauce to skillet
7. Bring to boiling , scraping up browned bits from bottom of skillet
8. Stir in rice and fennel seeds
9. Return the chops to skillet
10. Spoon sauce and rice over them
11. Cover and cook over medium low heat 20 to 30 minutes
12. Pour in remaining tomato sauce
13. Cover and cook 10 minutes more or until rice and chops are tender

title: mom s pimento cheese
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together with a mixer until light and fluffy
2. More or less mayo may be needed to make it spreading consistency
3. Refrigerate overnight to let the flavors blend

title: pimiento cheese  the best
steps:
1. In small bowl , stir all ingredients gently until well mixed
2. May seem as though 1 / 2 cup of mayo is not adequate , but don't add more for best , most flavorful results

title: homemade veggie bouillon
steps:
1. Place the first four ingredients in your food processor and pulse about twenty times
2. Add the next four ingredients , and pulse again
3. Add the salt , pulse some more
4. Then add the parsley and cilantro
5. You may need to scoop some of the chopped vegetables on top of the herbs , so they get chopped
