6. Mine tended to want to stay on top of everything else , initially escaping the blades
7. You should end up with a moist , loose paste of sorts
8. Keep 1 / 4th of it in a jar in the refrigerator for easy access in the coming days , and freeze the remaining 3 / 4 for use in the next month
9. Because of all the salt it barely solidifies making it easy to spoon directly from the freezer into the pot before boiling
10. Start by using 1 teaspoon of bouillon per 1 cup , and adjust from there based on your personal preference
11. Makes roughly 3 1 / 2 cups

title: oriental beef noodle bowl
steps:
1. Coat a 3 quart saucepan with cooking spray
2. Add beef and cook 3 to 4 minutes
3. Mix in remaining ingredients except pasta
4. Bring to a boil , simmer , uncovered for 5 minutes
5. Add pasta and cook 5 minutes

title: poblano rigatoni
steps:
1. Heat large covered saucepot of salted water to boiling
2. Add pasta
3. Meanwhile , in non-stick 12-inch skillet , heat oil over med-high heat
4. Add chiles and onion
5. Cook until lightly charred and tender crisp , about 7 minute add zucchini
6. Cover , cook 3 minute add garlic , oregano , and 1 tsp salt
7. Cook 30 seconds
8. Stir in tomatoes
9. Cover and cook until slightly softened
10. Drain pasta
11. In serving bowl , toss pasta with veggies and cheese

title: pink lime
steps:
1. Shake all ingredients over ice
2. Add a splash of sprite or club soda
3. Garnish with a lime and cherry
4. Enjoy !
5. You can mul

title: key lime muffins
steps:
1. Add the first 4 ingredients to a mixing bowl
2. Stir to combine
3. Make a well in the center of the mixture
4. In another mixing bowl , combine the milk and remaining ingredients
5. Add liquid ingredients to dry ingredients
6. Stir until just moistened
7. Spoon batter into lightly greased muffin cups
8. Fill 3 / 4s full
9. Bake at 400 for 18 minutes or until lightly browned
10. Turn muffins out of pan immediately

title: buttermilk cutouts
steps:
1. In a large bowl combine flour , baking powder , baking soda and salt
2. Set aside
3. Cream together sugar , butter , shortening , eggs and vanilla until light
4. Add flour mixture alternating with buttermilk
5. Add more flour if needed
6. Refrigerate until well chilled
7. Roll to desired thickness and cut
8. Bake at 350 for 8 minutes
9. Be careful not to over bake
10. Frost and enjoy
11. I have also made with all butter and all shortening , i like half and half the best

title: chicken ole
steps:
1. Coat chicken pieces with flour
2. In 8 quart dutch oven over medium high heat , cook chicken in oil until brown all over
3. Remove to bowl and set aside
4. Leave dripings in the pan and add the diced onion , cook for 10 minutes
5. Add all remaining ingredients and return chicken to the pot
6. Heat to boiling then reduce heat to low , cover and simmer 45 minutes or until tender

title: chunky chewy choc chip cookies
steps:
1. Melt butter and cool
2. Meanwhile combine sugars , sifted flours and macadamias in a large bowl
3. Add combined butter , egg , egg yolk and essence
4. Mix to a soft dough
5. Stir in chocolate
6. Place level scoops of biscuit dough about 6cm apart on lightly greased oven trays
7. Bake in moderate oven 180 degrees for about 18 minutes or until browned lightly
8. Cool on trays

title: ginger spice cookies
steps:
1. Combine first 6 ingredients in medium bowl
2. Whisk to blend
3. Mix in crystallized ginger
4. Using electric mixer , beat brown sugar , butter in large bowl until fluffy
5. Add egg and molasses and beat until blended
6. Add flour mixture and mix just until blended
7. Cover and refrigerate 1 hour
8. Preheat oven to 350f lightly butter 2 baking sheets , or line with parchment paper
9. Spoon sugar in thick layer onto small plate
10. Using wet hands , form dough into 1 1 / 4-inch balls
11. Roll in sugar to coat completely
12. Place balls on prepared sheets , spacing 2 inches apart
13. Bake cookies until cracked on top but still soft to touch , about 12 minutes
14. Cool on sheets 1 minute
15. Carefully transfer to racks and cool
16. Makes about 30
17. The original recipe called for light molasses and dark brown sugar
18. I found that regular molasses and light brown sugar worked great
19. The original recipe also called for 1 / 4 cup shortening and 1 / 4 cup butter
20. I followed the suggestions to omit the shortening and to use 1 / 2 cup of butter and it also worked out great

title: rigatoni with steak sauce
steps:
1. Heat 2 t olive oil in heavy frying pan over high heat
2. Sprinkle steaks with salt and pepper to taste
3. Cook steaks until they are brown but still rare in the center , about 3 minutes each side
4. Transfer steaks to a plate to cool down
5. Save steak juices in plate
6. Add 2 t olive oil to same pan
7. Saute the onion and carrots until onions are translucent , about 8 minutes , with add'l salt & pepper to taste
8. Add garlic and oregano , saute for another minute
9. Add marinara sauce and broth
10. Cover and simmer over medium-low heat to allow the flavors to blend , about 10 minutes
11. Season with salt & pepper to taste
12. Meanwhile , trim fat from each steak and cut into bite-size pieces and set aside
13. Bring a large pot of salted water to boil over high heat
14. Add rigatoni and boil until tender but firm to the bite , about 10 minutes , stirring often
15. Drain
16. Toss the rigatoni and steak pieces and any accumulated juices from the steaks with the sauce to coat
17. Transfer to individual serving bowls , top with cheese

title: oil and vinegar vinaigrette
steps:
1. Pour lemon juice in measuring cup
2. Add enough vinegar to make 1 / 2 cup of liquid
3. Combine lemon juice , vinegar , dry mustard , garlic , salt and pepper in blender
4. With motor running , slowly drizzle in the oil
5. For a creamier dressing , whisk in 1 tbsp of mayonnaise and 1 tbsp freshly grated parmesan cheese to cup of dressing before tossing with greens

title: lemon meringue square cookies
steps:
1. Cream butter
2. Gradually blend in the confection sugar until light and fluffy
3. Add the egg yolks
4. Mix in the flour and the grated lemon peel
5. Spread evenly in bottom of greased 8" square pan
6. Bake 10 minutes at 350f
7. Let cool while you prepare the meringue topping
8. Beat egg whites till foamy
9. Gradually add the regular sugar and the lemon juice
10. Beat until stiff
11. Spread over baked mixture
12. Bake 25 minutes longer at 350f
13. Cool and cut into bars

title: hamburger potato stroganoff
steps:
1. Cut pieces of raw bacon into small bites
2. Place ground beef and raw bacon in a skillet
3. Cook over medium heat , stirrring , until ground beef is well browned and bacon is browned
4. Drain off excess grease / fat
5. Add onion
6. Blend flour , salt , paprika , pepper , and cream of potato soup in a bowl with enough milk to make a thick pourable mixture
7. Cook over low heat uncovered 15 to 20 minutes , stirring occasionally
8. Add remaining milk as needed to keep sauce from getting too thick stirring well after each adddition
9. Take out any portion that doesn't want sour cream
10. Reduce sour cream by 1 / 4 cup for each serving removed
11. Add sour cream to remaining portions and heat through
12. Serve over biscuits or noodles or toasted bread

title: baba ganoush   the best in the world
steps:
1. Prepare a medium-hot fire in a charcoal grill
2. Preheat an oven to 375f
3. Prick the eggplant with a fork in several places and place on the grill rack 4 to 5 inches from the fire
4. Grill , turning frequently , until the skin blackens and blisters and the flesh just begins to feel soft , 10 to 15 minutes
5. Transfer the eggplant to a baking sheet and bake until very soft , 15 to 20 minutes
6. Remove from the oven , let cool slightly , and peel off and discard the skin
7. Place the eggplant flesh in a bowl
8. Using a fork , mash the eggplant to a paste
9. Add the 1 / 4 cup tahini , the garlic , the 1 / 4 cup lemon juice and the cumin and mix well
10. Season with salt , then taste and add more tahini and / or lemon juice , if needed
11. Transfer the mixture to a serving bowl and spread with the back of a spoon to form a shallow well
12. Drizzle the olive oil over the top and sprinkle with the parsley
13. Place the olives around the sides
14. Serve at room temperature

title: basic sugar cookies
steps:
1. Beat butter until fluffy , beat in sugar in 3 additions
2. Beat in egg and vanilla
3. In separate bowl mix flour , baking powder and salt
4. Beat into butter mixture in 3 additions
5. Divide dough in 2 equal portions and shape into discs
6. Wrap in plastic wrap and place in fridge for 1 hour
7. Preheat oven to 375f
8. On lightly floured surface roll out dough to 1 / 4 inch thickness , cut into shapes
9. Place cookies 1 inch apart on baking sheets , greased or lined with parchment paper
10. Bake until light golden for about 10 minutes
11. Depending on your oven you may have to turn pans halfway through
12. Mix cookie glaze ingredients until preferred consistency and have fun decorating !

title: fusilli with sausage  spinach and peppers   weight watchers
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to package instructions
2. Meanwhile , crumble sausage into a large nonstick skillet
3. Cook , breaking apart with a wooden spoon , until no longer pink , about 5 minutes
4. Add spinach , broth , red peppers , salt , pepper and oregano
5. Heat to serving temperature , about 3 minutes
6. Drain fusilli , add to sausage mixture and toss to combine

title: swiss cheesy cauliflower
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Lightly butter a small baking dish
3. Place the cauliflower in a saucepan with enough water to cover
4. Bring to a boil and cook for 5 minutes , or until tender but crisp
5. In a separate saucepan , melt the butter over medium heat and gradually mix in the flour , salt , pepper , garlic powder {or roast garlic} , onion powder , nutmeg , red pepper flakes , and milk
6. Bring to a boil , remove from heat , and mix in the swiss cheese until melted
7. Spread about 1 / 4 cup of the melted swiss cheese mixture in the bottom of the prepared baking dish
8. Place cauliflower in the dish , and top with the remaining cheese mixture
9. Bake uncovered 20-25 minutes until bubbly

title: indonesian chicken in coconut gravy  opor ayam
steps:
1. Cut chicken into smaller pieces
2. If using boneless , skinless chicken breast then cut into bite size pieces
3. Squeeze the juice of one lime over chicken and let sit for about 15-20 minutes
4. Boil the eggs and peel , set aside
5. Saut the tofu in oil until lightly brown
6. Blend the shallots , garlic , candlenuts , turmeric powder , coriander powder , salt and pepper in a food processor or blender until it forms a smooth paste
7. Saut the paste in oil for a few minutes
8. Once bumbu is sauted , add 1500 ml water and chicken
9. Stir occasionally until it comes to a boil
10. Add 2 pieces of lemon grass that have been bruised , 5-7 pieces of lime leaves , galangal & 3 bay leaves
11. Bring to a boil add tofu and eggs
12. For extra flavor you can saut sliced shallots to sprinkle in once cooked

title: low fat healthy spices cake  kosher pareve
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 360f
2. Spray two 12x6 baking pans
3. In a bowl , mix with a hand mixer egg + oil + orange juice
4. In a separate bowl , mix flour + sugar + vanilla sugar + baking powder + spices + lemon peel
5. Gradually , add liquid mixture to dry ingredients
6. Mix well to a homogenous mixture
7. Pour evenly to baking pans
8. Bake 30-40 until light brown and bouncy to touch
9. Enjoy !
10. Upgrades and other options:
11. >> take about 2 tbs from sugar and mix with cinnamon
12. Slice some apples and arrange on bottom of baking pan
13. Sprinkle sugar and cinnamon mixture and than pour cake mixture
14. When cake is ready turn upside down to a serving tray
15. The top is lovely , crunchy and surprising !
16. >> oil can be substitute with 80 grams butter - if this is the taste you're going for --
17. >> soak 50 grams raisins in some brandy for 1 / 2 hour , and add to cake mixture
18. Nutritional values per one serving: 92
19. 4 calories , 15

21. 3 grams protein , 2

23. 27% fat !

title: sweet sesame five spice popcorn
steps:
1. Place popcorn , sugar , oil , five spice powder and salt in a large kettle or pot with a tight fitting lid over medium heat
2. When corn begins to pop , shake the pot constantly
3. When popping slows , remove from heat , sprinkle with sesame seeds and transfer kettle corn to a bowl

title: philadelphia meatball heroes
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , cook meatballs in spaghetti sauce over medium heat for 10 to 12 minutes or until meatballs are hot , stirring occasionally
2. Meanwhile , spray a medium skillet with nonstick cooking spray
3. Add the bell peppers and onion
4. Cook for 5 to 6 minutes over medium-high heat or until peppers are crisp-tender , stirring often
5. Split buns lengthwise , making sure not to cut all the way through
6. Place on an ungreased cookie sheet
7. Place meatballs in buns
8. Top each with pepper mixture
9. Sprinkle each with cheddar cheese
10. Broil 4 to 6 inches from heat for 2 to 3 minutes or until cheese has melted

title: pina colada cream pie
steps:
1. In a saucepan sprinkle gelatin into pia colada mix and heat stirring to simmer
2. Add rum
3. Chill in freezer 10 minutes
4. Beat mixture until smooth
5. Fold half of the whipped cream into the pia colada mix and then place in crust
6. Chill until firm , about 2 hours
7. Serve: topped with remaining whipped cream and garnished with cherries and / or pineapple if desired

title: lou s african beef
steps:
1. Preheat oven 325
2. Heat oil on skillet and brown beef cubes
3. Spoon into a heavy casserole
4. Add the rest of the ingredients to the casserole and bake at least 2 hours until well done
5. Serve with rice or noodles
6. The olives are superb in this recipe

title: hot beer soup  heisse biersuppe
steps:
1. Pour beer and sugar into a heavy 4 to 5 quart saucepan
2. Bring to a boil over high heat , stir constantly until sugar is dissolved , then remove from heat
3. In a small bowl , whisk egg yolks and beat in the sour cream a little at a time
4. Stir about 1 / 4 cup of the hot beer into the mix then whisk it into the beer
5. Add cinnamon , salt and grindings of pepper
6. Return to heat and cook stirring constantly until it thickens slightly
7. Do not let it boil or it could curdle
8. Serve

title: dad angulo s sauce
steps:
1. Put all of ingredients in blender and blend
2. Serve with chips

title: blueberry peach almond crisp
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees
2. In 8-inch square baking dish , combine peaches and lemon juice
3. Toss gently
4. Stir in blueberries , 3 t flour and sugar
5. Toss with peaches
6. In small bowl , combine all topping ingredients except margarine
7. With fork or pastry blender , cut in margarine until crumbly
8. Sprinkle over fruit
9. Bake at 350 for 30 minutes or until golden brown and bubbly
10. If desired , serve with light frozen whipped topping , thawed

title: thermomix apple teacake
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f
2. Grease an 8 inch round cake pan
3. Melt the butter 2 minutes / 90 degrees / speed 1
4. Add milk , vanilla and egg
5. Mix 5 seconds / speed 7
6. Add flour , sugar and salt
7. Mix 10 seconds / speed 5
8. Poke apple slices into the batter
9. It won't matter if bits stick out here and there
10. Bake 30-35 minutes

title: oysters gourmet
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450
2. Place oysters in a strainer and rinse under cold running water
3. Drain well and arrange in an 8" square dish
4. Sprinkle dried herbs , salt , pepper , garlic , lemon juice , and parsley evenly over the top , then drizzle with melted butter evenly
5. Cover with crumbs
6. Bake until bubbly , about 10 minutes
7. Serve at once in decorative shells or small bowls

title: fruity nutty pasta salad
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients
2. Add generous amounts of good mayonnaise to taste
3. Mix and chill until needed

title: peppered steak with brandy flambe
steps:
1. Steaks should have been out of refrigeration for at least 30 minutes
2. Sprinkle bottom of a large heavy weight skillet with the salt and preheat using high heat
3. Press the steaks into the crushed peppercorns and work it into both sides of the meat with the palm of your hand
4. When skillet is well heated , add the steaks and quickly brown each side , uncovered
5. Reduce heat to medium , turning steaks once and cooking to the desired degree of rareness
6. In a separate pan combine and heat the butter , lemon juice and worcestershire
7. Place cooked steaks on serving platter , pour heated butter mixture over steaks and flambe
8. To flambe: use 1 ounce of hot brandy per steak
9. Pour brandy over steak , light a match , and let the liquor burn out on its own
10. Serve immediately

title: apple crumb pie  zwt midwestern region
steps:
1. Place apple slices in large bowl , mix with sugars , spices and flour
2. Pour apple mixture into a pastry-lined 9-inch pie pan
3. Mix together 1 / 2 cup sugar , 3 / 4 cup flour
4. Cut in butter till crumbly
5. Sprinkle over apples in pan
6. Bake in 400 degree oven for 40-50 minutes
7. Variation:
8. Spread double pie crust recipe across a cookie sheet or other long shallow baking pan
9. Spread apple mixture on the pastry-lined pan
10. Double the topping mixture and spread across apples
11. Bake as directed above

title: oatmeal to the max
steps:
1. Put oatmeal , water , raisins , fiber one cereal and pumpkin in large microwave safe bowl
2. Set on high for 5 minutes
3. Add remaining ingredients and stir well
4. Top with sliced banana and skim milk or light soymilk

title: healthier mashed potatoes
steps:
1. In 3-quart saucepan , place potatoes
2. Add just enough water to cover
3. Heat to boiling
4. Reduce heat
5. Cover and simmer 15 to 20 minutes or until potatoes are tender
6. Drain
7. In same saucepan , mash potatoes , oil and salt with potato masher just until lumpy
8. Gradually add buttermilk , mashing until combined but still lumpy
9. Season to taste with pepper
10. Stir in chives

title: healthy blueberry milkshake
steps:
1. Place all ingredients into a blended
2. Blend until smooth
3. Alternatively , blend in a tall 16-17 fl oz cup using a stick blender

title: applesauce with cranberry loaf cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f and prepare a 9x5 inch loaf pan with butter and then line bottom of loaf pan with parchment and butter the paper
2. Beat butter and sugar with a mixer until light and fluffy
3. Beat in egg
4. Stir baking soda into applesauce
5. Mix dry ingredients , theen add to butter mixture in 3 additions , alternating with applesauce
6. Stir in craisins
7. Pour batter into prepared pan and bake for 45-50 minutes
8. Cool in pan on a wire rack for 10-15 minutes then turn out onto rack
9. Make glaze by mixing lemon juice and confectioner's sugar and spoon glaze over cooled cake

title: cake in a mug
steps:
1. Combine cake mix ingredients and blend well
2. Measure 1 / 2 cup of mix into a sandwich bag
3. Label this bag"cake mix
4. "place the glaze mix ingredients into a sandwich bag
5. Label this bag"glaze mix" and attach it to the other bag with a twist tie
6. Place one bag cake mix and one bag glaze mix in each coffee cup and attach the baking instructions
7. The mug must be microwavable
8. Flavor options: lemon cake mix-lemon pudding , yellow mix-chocolate pudding , devils food mix-chocolate pudding , pineapple mix-coconut pudding , butterscotch mix-butterscotch pudding
9. Attach the following
10. Empty cake mix into cup
11. Add 1 egg white , 1 tablespoon
12. Oil and 1 tablespoon water
13. Mix well
14. Microwave on full power 2 minutes
15. Empty glaze mix into a small bowl and add 1 teaspoon water
16. Mix well
17. Pour glaze over baked cake

title: healthy pancakes  really    they re healthy
steps:
1. Add flour , egg , milk , sauce , sugar , powder , salt , and vanilla
2. Mix well
3. You may want / need to add a little more flour or milk based on the consistency you want
4. Add in any extra goodies and cook over med heat griddle
5. Makes about 6-8 pancakes
6. I usually double batch to feed my large family
7. But , if you make smaller pancakes , you get a lot
8. Enjoy !

title: roasted garlic herb new potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. Fill a large pot with salted water and bring to a boil
3. Add potatoes and garlic and bring back to a boil
4. Reduce heat and cook for 10 minutes
5. Drain well
6. Arrange the potatoes and garlic on a baking pan and toss with the olive oil
7. Sprinkle with the thyme , salt , and pepper
8. Place in the preheated oven and bake for 20-25 minutes or until the potatoes are tender and cooked through
9. Place on a serving platter or dish and garnish with parsley ,

title: easy peel no fail hard cooked eggs
steps:
1. Bring the water to a rolling boil - not a simmer
2. Using a push pin gently poke a hole in the fat end of the egg
3. It's easy to do
4. This will prevent the egg from breaking when you put it in the water , however , if you skip this , only the occasional egg will pop
5. Using a slotted spoon gently lower each egg into the boiling water , get them all in quickly
6. Boil - not simmer - the eggs for 6 minutes
7. Turn off the heat and let eggs sit for 6 minutes , this will give you a very slightly moist yolk , add 30 seconds or so to boil time if you like them a little drier -to your preference
8. Remove eggs using the slotted spoon and set on a towel or in a dish rack , allow to cool to room temp or until you can handle , don't put in cold water
9. Crack and peel shells , they will slip right off , the whites are tender so be gentle !
10. Chill and use as desired
11. To cook more eggs increase the volume of boiling water , it should remain boiling when the eggs are added
12. Hint: to season the eggs nicely for lunches , snacks or deviled , put the peeled eggs in a ziploc bag and sprinkle with salt to taste and refrigerate overnight , makes a big difference in the flavor

title: maple glazed pork chops with roasted corn relish
steps:
1. For corn relish
2. Fry bacon in a large skillet and set aside
3. Remove most of the bacon grease leaving about a tablespoon in the pan
4. Sautee the corn , onions , and bell pepper in the reserved bacon grease for about 5 minutes
5. Crumble the bacon on top and add the balsamic vinegar
6. Mix together
7. Salt and pepper to taste
8. Add more balsamic if you like the tang !
9. For pork chops
10. Bring the maple syrup and balsamic vinegar to a simmer in a small sauce pan
11. Simmer for about 5 minutes or until the mixture coats the back of a spoon
12. Add freshly ground pepper to taste
13. Preheat and oil grill
14. Grill smoked pork chops over medium heat basting with the maple syrup / balsamic vinegar glaze
15. It should only take about 3 to 4 minutes per side to heat through

title: calas  fried rice balls
steps:
1. Mix together the flour , sugar , baking powder , salt , and vanilla
2. Thoroughly mix the rice and eggs together in a separate bowl
3. Add the dry ingredients to the rice and egg mixture
4. When thoroughly mixed , drop by spoonfuls into the hot deep fat and fry until brown
5. Drain on paper towel
6. Sprinkle with powdered sugar and serve while hot
7. Other variations are to serve with honey

title: smoky potato gratin  for bbq
steps:
1. Bring a large pot of water to a boil over high heat
2. Salt the water
3. Add the potato slices and cook until they are slightly softened but not completely tender , about 8 minutes
4. Drain the potatoes well and let cool
5. Prepare a charcoal or gas grill for indirect grilling over medium-high heat
6. Using the side of a chef's knife , smash the garlic cloves and sprinkle with a generous pinch of salt
7. Continue smashing and scraping the garlic into a paste
8. In a small saucepan over medium heat , melt the butter
9. Stir in the garlic paste , parsley and thyme , and season with salt and pepper
10. Spray a mesh grill pan with nonstick cooking spray
11. Place 2 potato slices in the center of the grill pan , then create 2 separate rings of potato slices: starting with the inner ring , arrange the slices , slightly overlapping the center slices as well as the previous slice , to create a fanned effect
12. Then form an outer ring of potato slices , slightly overlapping the inner ring
13. Brush the first layer of potatoes with some of the garlic-herb butter and season with salt and pepper
14. Repeat to create a second layer on top of the first one
15. Brush the top layer with garlic-herb butter and season with salt and pepper
16. Transfer the grill pan to the center of the grill and cover the grill
17. Cook , basting the potatoes with garlic-herb butter every 10 minutes , until they are tender and browned on top , 35 to 45 minutes

title: 3 step strawberry jam
steps:
1. Stir throughly in large bowl: the strawberries and sugar
2. Let stand 10 minutes , stirring occasionally
3. Mix in small sauce pan: sur jell and water
4. Bring to a boil over high heat , stirring constantly
5. Continue boiling and stirring 1 minute
6. Stir surjell mix into fruit mixture
7. Continue stirring 3 minutes (a few sugar crystals may remain
8. Fill plastic container to within 1 / 2 inch of top
9. Cover
10. Let stand at room temperataure 24 hours
11. Jam is now ready to use
12. Store in refrigerator or freeze extra containers
13. Thaw in refrigerator
14. Important: measure sugar and fruit exactly
15. Do not change amounts or jam will not set
16. Potato masher works best for strawberries

title: melting meatballs with pasta
steps:
1. Cut the mozzarella into little chunks
2. You'll need one for each meatball
3. Put the beef into a mixing bowl and season with salt , pepper , cumin and thyme
4. Add the egg and mix it all together , preferrably with your hands
5. Have a bowl of water ready to wet your hands after making each meatball
6. Take some of the meat mixture in one hand , flatten it a bit with your palm and put a chunk of mozzarella on top
7. Then roll the meat around the mozzarella until you have a walnut-sized ball
8. Place finished meatballs on a plate and chill for an hour
9. Heat the olive oil and half the butter in a frying pan
10. Add the onion and garlic and saut until softened
11. Add the meatballs and cook for five minutes , until a little crisp and golden , stirring gently from time to time
12. Add the tomato passata and bring to a simmer
13. Reduce the heat , cover and cook for 30 minutes , keeping the heat low and stirring occasionally
14. Cook the pasta according to the packet directions
15. Drain well and toss in a bowl with the remaining butter
16. To finish , stir the pasta into the tomato and meatball mixture
17. Serve , sprinkled with parmesan

title: mushroom  n  steak linguine
steps:
1. Cook linguine according to package directions
2. Meanwhile , sprinkle beef with salt and pepper
3. In a large skillet , saute beef in 2 teaspoons oil until juices run clear
4. Remove and keep warm
5. In the same pan , saute red pepper and onion in remaining oil until tender
6. Add spinach and rosemary
7. Cook and stir until spinach is wilted
8. Stir in cream cheese , sour cream , and milk
9. Heat through
10. Drain linguine , top with mushroom mixture and beef

title: eggless oatmeal raisin cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Place oats and walnuts on ungreased baking sheet and toast for 5-7 minutes
3. Set aside
4. Combine water and raisins in saucepan and simmer over low heat for about 10 minutes
5. Set aside
6. Combine everything and mix well
7. Drop one inch size dough "balls" onto baking sheet covered with parchment paper
8. Bake one sheet at a time for about 14 minutes , until lightly browned
9. Place cookies on rack to cool
10. Enjoy !

title: corn waffles with maple strawberry butter
steps:
1. Whip 8 tablespoons butter and the maple syrup on high speed until light and fluffy
2. Add the strawberries slowly and blend to incorporate
3. The powdered sugar should be added sparingly if the moisture from the strawberries causes the butter to seperate
4. The sugar will bind it back together
5. Refridgerate until waffles are ready
6. Preheat waffle iron
7. Mix together flour , cornmeal , baking powder , baking soda , sugar , and salt in a large bowl
8. Mix together eggs , buttermilk , and butter in another bowl
9. Mix the liquid ingredients into the dry ingredients until just combined
10. Stir in the corn
11. Cook according to waffle makers instructions
12. They should be browned and crispy
13. Serve warm with maple-strawberry butter

title: green chili rice
steps:
1. Combine rice , broth , chilies , onion , oregano , salt and cumin in a large saucepan
2. Bring to boil , uncovered
3. Reduce heat to low , cover and simmer until liquid is absorbed
4. Stir in green onions and cilantro

title: ooey gooey cinnamon rolls
steps:
1. In a cup , combine yeast , warm water and 1 tsp sugar
2. Stir and set aside
3. In a large bowl , mix milk , remaining sugar , butter , salt and eggs
4. Stir well
5. Add yeast mixture
6. Add half the flour and beat until smooth
7. Stir in enough of the remaining flour until dough is stiff
8. Turn out onto a well-floured board
9. Knead for 10 minutes
10. Place in a plastic bowl and cover
11. Let dough rise in a warm place until double in bulk
12. This may take 1 1 / 2 hours
13. Punch down dough and let it rest for 5 minutes
14. Roll out on a floured surface into a 15x20 inch rectangle
15. To prepare filling----------
16. Spread dough with half cup butter
17. Mix together 1 1 / 2 cups sugar and cinnamon and sprinkle over buttered dough
18. Sprinkle with walnuts and raisins
19. Roll up and pinch edge together to seal
20. Cut into 12 slices
21. Coat bottom of a 13 by 9 inch baking pan and an 8 inch square pan with remaining 1 / 2 cup melted butter
22. Sprinkle with remaining 1 / 4 cup sugar
23. Place cinnamon roll slices close together in pans
24. Let rise in a warm place until dough is doubled in bulk i
25. E
26. For about 45 minutes
27. Topping----------
28. In a saucepan , place all ingredients except for pecans
29. Melt these ingredients on range top
30. Mix in pecans and then pour over the top of rolls
31. Preheat oven to 350f
32. Bake for 25 minutes or until done
33. Cool

title: pam cakes with buttered honey syrup
steps:
1. Pancakes: combine the flour and next 4 ingredients in a bowl
2. In another bowl , whisk the buttermilk and eggs together
3. Gradually stir egg mixture into the flour mixture
4. Gently stir in the butter
5. Pour about 1 / 4 cup batter for each pancake onto a hot buttered griddle or large nonstick skillet
6. Cook pancakes 3-4 minutes or until tops are covered with bubbles and edges look dry and cooked
7. Turn and cook 3-4 minutes or until golden brown
8. Place pancakes in a single layer on a baking sheet , and keep warm in a 200 oven up to 30 minutes
9. Buttered honey syrup: do not make this ahead of time
10. Heated honey will crystallize when cooled and will not melt if reheated
11. Melt butter in a small saucepan over med-low heat
12. Stir in 1 / 2 cup honey and cook 1 minute or until warm
13. Drizzle over pancakes

title: cream cheese salsa dip w  cheddar   olives
steps:
1. Spread cream cheese evenly in the bottom of a casserole dish with a butter knife
2. Pour salsa over cream cheese
3. Sprinkle cheese over salsa
4. Layer olives over cheese
5. Serve with tortilla chips

title: sausage   cheese stuffed shells with tomato mushroom sauce
steps:
1. Tomato mushroom sauce:
2. In a frying pan or dutch oven , cook bacon strips until crisp
3. Remove cooked bacon , and drain on paper towels
4. Reserve 3 tablespoons bacon fat and discard the rest
5. Using the same frying pan , place 3 tablespoons bacon drippings , mushrooms and garlic into the pan
6. Cook mixture over low heat until mushrooms are softened
7. Add tomatoes , basil and pepper
8. Cook uncovered over medium-high heat for about 15 minutes or until sauce boils and thickens
9. Crumble the bacon and stir it into the sauce , season with a bit of salt
10. While waiting for the pasta water to boil , start the sausage filling
11. When water is at a rolling boil , add the pasta and cook it according to package directions , until it is almost done
12. When pasta is cooked , drain it , rinse it with cold water , and drain it again
13. Stuff the shells with the sausage ricotta mixture
14. Pasta stuffing: if necessary , remove casings from sausage , and crumble the meat
15. In a frying pan , cook crumbled sausage over medium to medium-high heat until its browned
16. Drain cooked sausage
17. In a bowl , beat egg into ricotta , stir in cooked sausage , 2 tablespoons parmesan cheese , salt and parsley
18. Stuff the cooked shells with the sausage cheese filling
19. Bake:
20. Place about half the sauce into a shallow 1 1 / 2-quart casserole dish or a 9-inch square baking dish
21. Arrange stuffed pasta in sauce lined pan
22. Spoon remaining sauce on top of the stuffed pasta
23. Cover pan with tin foil , and bake in a preheated 350f for 30-45 minutes , or until bubbly and heated through
24. Remove from oven , remove foil and sprinkle remaining 4 tablespoons grated parmesan cheese on top of the baked shells

title: buttery banana bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f lightly grease loaf pan or put liners in muffin pan
2. In medium bowl , combine flour , baking soda and salt
3. Set aside
4. In large bowl , add 2 bananas and sugar
5. Whip for a good 3 minutes until light & fluffy
6. Add melted butter , eggs and vanilla
7. Beat well scraping sides
8. Mix in dry ingredients until just blended
9. Mash other 2 bananas so they still have a bit of texture and fold into
10. Pour batter into loaf pan or muffin cups
11. Bake for 1 1 / 4 hours if in loaf pan
12. Approx 15-20 minute if large muffins
13. Check with toothpick
14. Cool for 10 minutes then turn out loaf or pull muffins out of pan to cool completely
15. Dust with powdered sugar
16. Optional , toast bread slices

title: tom ka gai  spicy chicken soup w  coconut milk
steps:
1. Place the chicken stock in a stockpot , add lemon grass , ginger and lime leaves
2. I recommend slicing the lime leaves along the veins almost to the midrib to allow for more flavor release
3. These kaffir lime leaves are used in the same fashion we season soups with bay leaves
4. Bring the broth to a slow boil over medium heat
5. Add sliced chicken , mushrooms , water chestnuts , salt , lime juice , fish sauce and sugar , reserving more lime juice and fish sauce to add later to taste
6. Cook slowly , uncovered for 10 - 15 minutes , then add coconut milk , cilantro , green onion , tomato , fresh coconut meat , bruised chilies , and red curry paste
7. Stirring frequently , bring almost to a boil , then remove from heat and serve if you are happy with the flavor of lime juice to fish sauce in conjunction with the other ingredients
8. Cook this soup gently to prevent the coconut milk from separating

title: easy and quick beef teriyaki
steps:
1. In a wok or stir-fry pan , heat oil on high
2. Stir in garlic and dried red pepper flakes
3. Add in the beef strips
4. Cook for about 1 minute
5. Add in oyster sauce , soy sauce , salt , pepper , sugar and paprika
6. Cook and stir for 1 minute
7. Add in the stock
8. Boil for 5 minutes over medium-low heat
9. Add green onion and onion
10. Stir-fry for 1 minute
11. Add in dissolved flour , mixed with 3 tbsp water into the mixture
12. Stir until blended and thickened
13. Serve on cooked rice

title: cold fashioned potato salad   alton brown
steps:
1. Place potatoes into a large heavy-bottomed pot
2. Cover with cold water and place over medium heat
3. Cover the pot and bring to a boil
4. Immediately reduce heat and remove lid
5. Gently simmer until potatoes are fork tender
6. Drain and place into an ice bath to cool
7. Remove skin by rubbing with a tea towel
8. Slice potatoes into rounds and place into a zip top bag
9. Add the vinegar and toss to coat all of the potatoes
10. Place the bag into the refrigerator overnight
11. In a large mixing bowl , combine the mayonnaise , mustard , parsley , tarragon , garlic , cornichons , onions , and celery
12. Once evenly combined , add the potatoes and season with salt and pepper
13. Let the salad chill in the refrigerator for at least an hour before serving

title: strawberry cranberry salad
steps:
1. Open and drain all liquid from pineapple
2. In casserole dish fix jell-o with hot water only , stir until dissolved
3. Add can of cranberry sauce
4. Gently stir until thoroughly mixed
5. Add pineapple , stir
6. Cut whole strawberries into halves or quarters , gently stir berries into jell-o mixture
7. Cover and refrigerate until set , usually a few hours
8. As salad sets out some watering effect will occur , but not harmful
9. Cooking time is refrigeration time

title: peppered petrale sole with mushrooms and lavender
steps:
1. In a large skillet on medium heat , saut mushrooms and garlic in butter for 1 minute
2. Place fillets over mushrooms and sprinkle with the dried lavender , cracked black pepper , and smoked paprika
3. Cover and cook over low-medium heat for 5-10 minutes or until fish flakes easily with a fork , adding the tomato slices the last minute of cooking
4. Garnish each fillet with lemon slices , green onions and a sprig of fresh lavender
5. Season with salt , to taste

title: roasted asparagus
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees f
2. Trim the woody ends from the asparagus
3. Spread the spears in a single layer on a baking sheet , drizzle with olive oil , sprinkle with the salt and pepper , and roll to coat thoroughly
4. Roast the asparagus until lightly browned and tender , about 8 to 10 minutes , giving the pan a good shake about halfway through to turn the asparagus
5. Arrange the roasted asparagus on a serving platter and top with some parmesan
6. Serve warm or at room temperature

title: buttermilk mushroom baked chicken breasts
steps:
1. Set oven to 425 degrees
2. Melt butter in a greased 13 x 9-inch baking dish for about 5 minutes or until the butter is hot and melted
3. Season the breasts with seasoned salt , pepper and garlic powder
4. Dip the chicken pieces in about 1 / 2 cup buttermilk , then dredge in flour
5. Arrange the chicken in baking dish with melted butter breast-side down
6. Bake in a 425 degree oven for 25 minutes
7. Remove from oven turn chicken over and bake for another 10 minutes more
8. In a bowl stir together 1 cup buttermilk with the undiluted soup , well drained mushrooms and black pepper to taste
9. After 10 minutes of baking , pour the sauce over the chicken , then sprinkle with parmesan cheese
10. Return to oven and bake for another 10-15 minutes or until the chicken is done and the sauce is heated through and bubbly

title: instant pudding icing
steps:
1. Blend all together
2. Store in fridge in sealed container until ready to ice cake

title: rhubarb berry coffee cake
steps:
1. In a bowl , combine 2 / 3 cup cake mix and sugar
2. Cut in butter until crumbly
3. Add walnuts
4. Set aside
5. Place remaining cake mix in another bowl
6. Add the eggs and sour cream
7. Fold in rhubarb and strawberries
8. Spread into a greased 13 x 9 x 2-inch baking dish
9. Spring with reserved crumb mixture
10. Bake at 350f for 40-50 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean
11. Cool on a wire rack
12. If desired , place fosting in a microwave-safe bowl and heat for 15 seconds
13. Drizzle of cake

title: dom deluise s vegetable stew
steps:
1. In a large pan , gently heat the oil , add the garlic and onions
2. Saute for a few minutes
3. Then add the carrots and celery , potatoes , both kinds of tomatoes , pepper , oregano and basil
4. Cover and simmer for 40 minutes or until the carrots and potatoes are just tender
5. Then add mushrooms and peas and allow the stew to cook for 5 minutes more

title: easiest roast ever  5 ingredients and delicious
steps:
1. Heat a skillet on high and sear the meat on all sides until browned
2. Put meat and all ingredients into slow cooker / crock pot
3. Cook on high for 5 hours , then turn to low until ready to serve
4. About 30 minutes before serving remove meat and 1 cup liquid from cooker
5. Stir flour into the 1 cup of liquid and return it to the slow cooker to thicken the gravy
6. Trim excess fat off of roast and return to slow cooker until ready to serve

title: two cheese squash casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Cook squash in boiling water to cover in a large skillet 8-10 minutes or just until tender
3. Drain well and gently press between paper towels
4. Melt 2 tablespoons butter in skillet over medium-high heat
5. Add onion and garlic , and saut 5-6 minutes or until tender
6. Remove skillet from heat , stir in squash , 1 cup breadcrumbs , 3 / 4 cup parmesan cheese , and next 7 ingredients
7. Spoon into a lightly greased 13x9-inch baking dish
8. Melt remaining butter
9. Stir together melted butter , remaining 1 1 / 2 cups soft breadcrumbs , 1 / 2 cup parmesan cheese , and garlic salt
10. Sprinkle mixture evenly over top of casserole
11. Bake at 350f for 35-40 minutes or until set

title: crock pot sweet sour chicken
steps:
1. Combine ketchup , water , vinegar , soy sauce and sugar in slow cooker
2. Whisk together well
3. Add chicken pieces and stir
4. Cover and cook on low for 6 to 8 hours or on high for 3 to 4 hours
5. Combine cornstarch and second amount of water in a small bowl
6. Stir into slow cooker when above times have been reached
7. Cook on high , stirring often , for 15 to 20 minutes or until thickened
8. For faster cooking , pour into saucepan and heat on stove , stirring often , until thickened

title: 1 minute apple tortilla
steps:
1. Core , half and slice your apple
2. Place 4 apple slices and the cheese on top one half of the tortilla
3. Microwave on high for 30 seconds fold in half and serve

title: chocolaty decadence banana muffins
steps:
1. In and 8 cup measuring cup , mix together the banana , applesauce , eggs and oil
2. In a large mixing bowl , whisk together all the dry ingredients but the chocolate chips
3. Fold in wet mix until just blended slightly
4. Add in chocolate chips and mix just until evenly moist
5. Distribute between 2 muffin trays (12 muffins / tray
6. Bake at 350f for 20 minutes
7. Let cool slightly and enjoy with a large glass of milk or , even better , hot chocolate !

title: cheesy zucchini   onion flatbread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Line baking sheet with parchment paper and spray w / nonstick spray
3. Unroll dough onto parchment paper
4. Spread 1 / 2 the herb cheese over one long half of dough , leaving 1 / 2" plain borders
5. Sprinkle with 1 / 2 parmesan and 2 t parsley
6. Using parchment paper as aid , fold the dough over filled half do not seal edges
7. Spread remaining cheese on top , sprinkle with remaining parmesan cheese
8. Peel off enough outer layers of onion to have 2" circles
9. Cut into 1 / 8" thick rounds
10. Arrange 1 row of zucchini down along one side of dough
11. Arrange onions down the center
12. Add one more row of zucchini along the outside of onio row
13. Brush veggies with olive oil
14. Sprinkle w / salt and pepper
15. Bake until the bread is puffed up & golden brown , about 24 minutes
16. Sprinkle with1 t parsley before serving

title: the very best hummus   no tahini garbanzo bean spread
steps:
1. Blend all ingredients except for beans in a food processor
2. Add beans and process until it resembles a chunky dip
3. Not completely smooth
4. Enjoy !

title: peaches in port
steps:
1. Slice peaches and place 1 peach to each dessert dish
2. Drizzle 2 tablespoons port over peaches in each dish
3. Place in refrigerator for 30 minutes
4. When ready to serve , top each peach with large scoop of ice cream

title: chipotle turkey panini
steps:
1. Preheat a panini grill
2. Stir together mayonnaise and chipotle chile sauce in a small bowl
3. Stir half of the chipotle sauce in with the turkey
4. Spread one side of each slice of sourdough with remaining chipotle sauce
5. Layer bottom halves with equal amounts turkey , onion , bacon , tomato and cheese
6. Top with remaining bread slices , forming 4 sandwiches
7. Gently press sandwiches together with your hand
8. Brush both outer sides of sandwiches with olive oil
9. You will probably not use an entire 1 / 4 cup of olive oil
10. Grill paninis about 5 minutes in the preheated grill , or until bread is golden brown and cheese is melted
11. Or heat them over medium-low heat , covered , in a large skillet for about 4 minutes on each side , until bread is toasted on both sides and sandwich is heated throughout

title: hornswaggle peachy keen ginger mojito
steps:
1. Place in a blender everything but 6 ice cubes , soda and garnishes
2. Blend till smooth
3. Place three ice cubes into two tall glasses
4. Divide the drink mix into both glasses
5. Top with seltzer or lemon lime soda if you want more sweetness
6. Garnish with mint leaves

8. Place in a blender everythin' but 6 ice cubes , soda 'n garnishes

11. Divide th' drink mix into both monocle
12. Top wit' seltzer or lemon lime soda if ye want more sweetness
13. Garnish wit' mint leaves
14. Blimey !

title: pineapple ginger preserves
steps:
1. In a heavy kettle , combine the sugar and water
2. Bring the mixture to a boil , stirring until the sugar is dissolved
3. Boil until it registers 220f on a candy thermometer
4. Stir in the pineapple and the ginger
5. Simmer the mixture , uncovered , stirring to prevent scorching for 1 hour , or until it registers 220 f on a candy thermometer
6. Remove the kettle from the heat and ladle the preserves into 5 sterilized 1 / 2-pint jars , filling the jars to within 1 / 4 inch of the tops
7. Wipe the rims with a dampened towel and seal the jars with the lids
8. Screw on bands finger-tight
9. Put the jars in a water bath canner or on a rack set in a deep kettle
10. Add enough hot water to the canner or kettle to cover the jars by 2 inches , and bring it to a boil
11. Process the jars , covered , for 10 minutes
12. Transfer them with tongs to a rack or countertop protected with a heat-resistant mat , and let them cool completely
13. Store the jars in a cool dark place

title: beef  n bean burrito stack  crock pot  slow cooker
steps:
1. First , make foil "handles
2. " fold a 30-inch long piece of foil in half lengthwise
3. Place in bottom of a slow cooker with both ends hanging over top edge of cooker
4. The foil strip will make it much easier to remove the burrito stack when done
5. Lightly grease crockpot
6. In saucepan , combine the first six ingredients
7. Simmer for 20 minutes over low heat
8. In a large skillet over medium heat , brown ground beef with onion , bell pepper , and minced jalapeno or mild peppers
9. Drain off fat
10. Stir about 1 / 3 of sauce mix into the browned beef mixture
11. Spoon a small amount of sauce into bottom of the slow cooker
12. Spread a small amount of refried beans over one of the flour tortillas
13. Place the tortilla on top of sauce in crock pot , tearing to fit if necessary
14. Spoon meat mixture over tortilla and then top with a small amount of the shredded cheese
15. Continue layering until tortillas are used or within an inch of top of crockpot
16. Cover and cook on low 6 to 8 hours or on high for 3-4 hours
17. Lift burritos out by the foil handles and place on serving plate
18. Cut in wedges
19. Garnish with chopped tomato , shredded lettuce , sour cream , sliced ripe olives , or your own favorite combination
20. Serves 4 to 6

title: six pepper salsa
steps:
1. Combine everything in a large pot and bring to a boil
2. Reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes
3. Ladle hot salsa into hot jars leaving 1 / 4 inch headspace
4. Wipe jar rim with clean cloth and top with heated two-piece caps
5. Process for 15 minutes in a boiling-water canner

title: bloody mary piquant
steps:
1. In a blender or food processor combine vodka , red onions , lemon juice , jalapeo , dijon mustard and capers and puree until smooth
2. Add v8 , horseradish , celery salt , ground pepper , worcestershire , and salt and blend
3. If you like your bloody mary on the slightly thick side then pour into a tall glass filled with ice
4. Add kahlua and tabasco and stir
5. If you like your bloody marys on the thin side , then strain into tall glass filled with ice
6. Add kahlua and tabasco and stir
7. Serve with lemon wedge and celery rib

title: pamela s gluten free brownies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Mix all ingredients together until there are no lumps
3. Pour into a greased 8" square pan
4. Bake for 25 minutes or when a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean
5. Be careful not to overbake

title: zesty chicken and black bean salad   starbucks copycat
steps:
1. Place first 7 ingredients into a cruet or shaker
2. Shake until well blended
3. Set aside
4. Divide quinoa onto individual plates or bowls
5. Divide salad greens and layer on top of quinoa
6. Divide tomatoes , black beans , corn , jicama , and feta cheese on top of each salad
7. Layer sliced chicken breast on top
8. Drizzle with salad dressing
9. Enjoy !

title: tortilla chicken casserole
steps:
1. Lightly grease 8'x11 1 / 2' casserole dish
2. Spray a non stick skillet with vegetable oil and brown the chicken along with the garlic & onions
3. Remove from skillet
4. Add corn , red pepper , jalapenos and warm through
5. Add tomato sauce , cumin , cilantro , hot sauce , all spice , salt & pepper , bring to a simmer
6. Add tomatoe & return the chicken to the skillet , stir , bring to a simmer
7. Line the greased pie plate with 3 tortillas
8. Pour in half the chicken mixture & top with half the cheese
9. Cover with 3 more tortillas
10. Pour in the remaining sauce , top with 3 more tortillas
11. Sprinkle the top with the remaining cheese
12. Bake in 350f oven for apprx 25 minutes or until the casserole is heated through the cheese has melted and is nicely browned
13. Let it rest 5 minutes , slice & serve

title: very berry bread pudding
steps:
1. This meant that i had to use a 17" x 13" x 2" deep broiler pan for the bain marie or water bath
2. If you choose to use a different size baking dish , results may vary , such as a longer baking time
3. My bread pudding ended up being 2
4. 5" deep
5. Directions for bread pudding:
6. Preheat oven to 335 degrees
7. Fill tea kettle with enough water to fill a 13" x 17" pan , half way up with boiling water
8. Bring water to boil , then turn down heat to a simmer , for later use
9. Butter the casserole dish
10. Set aside
11. Place the 2 cups of milk in a large saucepan , uncovered , over medium heat
12. Let the milk heat in the pan , without stirring , until a skin forms on top and it is scalded
13. Or , if this makes you uneasy , stir the milk and continue heating until small bubbles form along the edges of the pan
14. Remove from heat
15. Meanwhile , place the eggs and yolks in a large mixing container with a pouring spout
16. Beat or whisk briefly , only to mix , not until they are foamy or light
17. Gradually add the sugar , vanilla and almond extracts , ground cinnamon , ground ginger and salt , beating only until well mixed
18. Using a 1 / 4 cup measuring cup , slowly add 1 / 4 cup amounts of the hot milk to the egg mixture , stirring gently
19. When 1 cup of warm milk has been added into the egg mixture , add the remaining milk and stir gently
20. This process is called "tempering" , making sure that your eggs don't "scramble" in the pan from the heat of the milk ! set aside custard mixture
21. In a large bowl , tear the hawaiian rolls apart into large chunks , totaling 6 cups
22. Using a large mesh strainer , pour your custard mixture slowly over the bread roll cubes
23. Stir very gently , making sure that the bread rolls are all thoroughly coated
24. Allow to rest in the bowl for 10 minutes
25. Stir twice
26. While the bread is soaking up the custard , measure out your frozen berries
27. I'm lucky enough to have a deep freezer so i have individual bags of the berries , but a quality brand of mixed berries with blueberries , strawberries , raspberries and black raspberries can be used
28. They should not be mashed !
29. Gently fold the 2 cups of mixed frozen berries into the custard / bread mixture
30. Pour this into the prepared casserole dish , using a spoon to make sure that the berries are well distributed and that the raspberries are pushed down into the custard , to fill their little centers
31. Place the casserole dish into the broiler pan and place this into the oven , leaving the oven door open
32. Carefully pour the hot , boiling water into the pan , going up to 1 / 2 the height of the casserole
33. However , if you feel more comfortable filling the broiler pan with the hot water prior to placing it into the oven , do what makes sense for you !
34. Bake for 50 to 60 minutes until a sharp knife inserted 1 inch into the middle of the custard comes out clean
35. Carefully remove the broiler pan and place on a heat-proof surface
36. Lift the casserole out of the water , place it on a wire rack and cool for 1 hour or until a comfortable eating temperature
37. Allow water in broiler pan to cool , dump out when safe to the touch
38. Serve warm , cool , cold
39. Plain or with topping of choice
40. Just enjoy it , however you please !
41. Directions for orange whipped cream:
42. Have all of your ingredients and equipment ice cold ! i store the beaters in the bowl in my frig and have a small dish of the sifted powdered sugar in there , too
43. Remove bowl , beaters , whipping cream and powdered sugar from the refrigerator
44. Insert beaters into machine , shake whipping cream mul
45. Starting out at the lowest speed , beat whipping cream until it slightly thickens
46. Starting out at a lower speed prevents splashing all over
47. Once cream begins to thicken , increase speed to medium high and whip until soft peaks begin to form
48. Increase speed to high and slowly add the powdered sugar to the whipped cream , being sure to reach all corners of the bowl if doing this with a hand mixer
49. When firm peaks have formed , add vanilla extract and 2-3 drops of orange oil and blend only until combined , about 10 seconds
50. Serve a dollop of this on top of the still warm very berry bread pudding
51. The whipped cream is also good in your coffee , with a dash of cinnamon !

title: easy cheesy breadsticks
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425
2. Unroll pizza dough onto a greased cookie sheet and brush with butter
3. Sprinkle cheeses and spices evenly over the dough
4. With a pizza cutter , cut dough lengthwise into 12 long strips
5. Then cut those in half to make 24 strips
6. Do not seperate strips
7. Bake for 10-12 minutes or until light golden brown
8. Recut along each strip and remove from cooking sheet
9. Serve sticks warm with marinara sauce

title: lemon oregano marinade
steps: 1. Combine all ingredients and allow them to get happy together for at least a couple of hours before using

title: cheesy smoked sausage and beans
steps:
1. In a large dutch oven or pot , brown the ground beef with smoked sausage , onion , garlic , bell pepper , chili flakes and jalapeno peppers until the meat is well browned drain fat
2. Add in the undiluted soup , diced tomatoes with juice , green chilies pinto beans with juice and pork and beans with juice
3. Stir to combine then season with salt and pepper to taste
4. Bring to a boil and simmer uncovered for about 1 hour , stirring occasionally
5. At the end of cooking stir in the cheddar cheese until combined

title: oh henry bars
steps:
1. In a large mixing bowl , cream butter& sugar
2. Add oatmeal , corn syrup and vanilla
3. Pat dough into a 13x9x3 / 4" cookie sheet
4. Bake at 350 for 15 minutes
5. While bars are baking , melt chocolate chips and peanut butter together
6. Spread chocolate / peanut butter mixture on slightly cooled dough
7. Cut into bars when cool

title: nana s sausage bread
steps:
1. In frying pan , brown sausage over medium high heat
2. Drain drippings and let cool
3. Mix 2 eggs , basil , fennel seeds and mozzarella into cooled sausage and set aside
4. In large bowl , combine 5 cups flour , sugar , salt and yeast
5. In small sauce pan , heat water , milk and butter until hot to the touch , and stir into dry mixture
6. Mix in only enough of the reserved 1 cup of flour to make a soft dough
7. Knead dough on a lightly floured surface until smooth and elastic
8. Cover dough and let rest for about 10 minutes
9. Divide dough in half , set one half aside
10. Roll half the dough into a 6" x 18" rectangle
11. Spoon half the sausage mixture evenly over the dough to within a 1 / 2 of the edges
12. Fold the dough over the sausage filling and overlap the dough by about 1 1 / 2" , seal seam and ends by pinching dough together
13. Carefully transfer filled dough to a greased baking sheet in a horseshoe shape
14. With a very sharp knife or razor , make slashes in the top of dough about 1 / 2" deep and about 2" apart
15. Repeat rolling and filling with remaining piece of dough
16. Beat remaining egg and brush over both loves of bread
17. Lightly sprinkle 1 tb of locatelli or parmesan cheese over each loaf
18. Cover loaves and let rise until doubled
19. Bake in preheated 375 oven for about 25-30 minutes or until done
20. Remove from baking sheets and cool slightly
21. Serve warm
22. Refrigerate leftovers
23. Bread can be made a day ahead of time and then warmed in the oven before serving

title: happy family sesame chicken
steps:
1. Combine honey , sesame seeds , soy sauce and garlic
2. Set aside
3. In a seperate bowl , combine egg whites and cornstarch
4. Add chicken to egg mixture
5. Add salt and pepper to taste
6. Combine thoroughly
7. To freeze: put honey mixture in a quart sized freezer bag
8. Squeeze out air and seal
9. Put chicken mixture in a gallon sized freezer bag
10. Squeeze out air and seal
11. Place both bags in another gallon sized bag , and label for the freezer
12. Defrost for 24 hours before cooking
13. On cooking day:
14. Heat the oil in a skillet over medium high heat
15. Add the chicken and cook until browned , turning as needed
16. Pour the honey mixture over the chicken , turning to coat all the pieces
17. Top with the sliced green onions and sesame seeds , and serve

title: pomegranate chicken drumsticks
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Line a roasting pan with on top of a foil and spray with non-stick cooking spray
3. Rinse chicken under running water and pat dry
4. If desired , lightly salt and pepper to taste
5. Go lightly on the salt due to the soy sauce in the glaze
6. Arrange chicken on foil and place in preheated oven
7. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes
8. While the chicken is baking place the pomegranate juice in a small saucepan
9. Bring to a boil and reduce by about half
10. Add remaining ingredients and cook a few minutes to thicken
11. Preheat grill to 350 degrees
12. Remove precooked chicken from oven and baste with glaze
13. Grill until cooked through and glazed , basting and turning every 3 to 5 minutes
14. The chicken should be cooked through in about 15 to 20 minutes
15. Watch carefully so as not burn the glaze

title: spinach rice casserole
steps:
1. In a large saucepan cook the onion and garlic in hot oil until onion is tender but not brown
2. Add undrained tomatoes , and oregano or basil
3. Bring to a boil
4. Reduce heat
5. Simmer , uncovered , about 3 minutes
6. Meanwhile , place tofu in a food processer bowl or blender container
7. Cover and process or blend until smooth
8. Add tomatoes to mixture
9. Stir in cooked rice , spinach , half of the swiss cheese , the salt and pepper
10. Grease a 2 quart rectangular baking dish
11. Spoon mixture into casserole
12. Bake , uncovered in a 350 degree oven for 30 to 40 minutes
13. Sprinkle with remaining cheese and toasted sesame seeds

title: snickers cheesecake  no bake
steps:
1. Spread 1 / 2 the jar of ice cream topping and over bottom of crust
2. In a medium size bowl whip the cream cheese and remaining ice cream topping , and mix well
3. Whip in the cool whip
4. With a spoon fold in the snickers candy pieces
5. Spread over the the crust
6. Refrigerate for at least one hour
7. Keep refrigerated

title: almond cookies  gluten free
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Mix butter , eggs , vanilla extract , almond extract , and honey in a bowl
3. Whisk until well blended
4. Add almond flour and coconut flour and mix with spoon until well blended and creamy
5. Texture will be much like peanut butter cookie dough
6. Add any optional ingredients and mix until well distributed
7. Place balls of dough on greased cookie sheet
8. Bake for 5 minutes , then remove and press with a fork to flatten cookies and make criss cross pattern
9. Return to even and bake another 10-15 minutes or until golden brown

title: southern sweet potato salad
steps:
1. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil
2. Add sweet potato cubes
3. Boil about 5-7 minutes just until tender but firm enough to hold their shape
4. Drain into a colander and rinse under cold water
5. Drain well
6. In a large bowl gently toss sweet potatoes with celery , green onions , raisins , pineapple and pecans
7. In medium bowl , mix together mayonnaise , sour cream , vinegar , honey , salt and pepper
8. Gently toss with sweet potato mixture
9. Cover and refrigerate until serving time

title: easy thai chicken wraps
steps:

2. Mix dressing , peanut butter and ground red pepper until smooth
3. Set aside half of mixture to serve with wraps

5. Spray 10 inch nonstick skillet with cooking spray
6. Heat over medium-high heat
7. Cook chicken and gingerroot in skillet , stirring occasionally , until chicken is brown
8. Reserve about 1 / 4 cup of remaining dressing mixture

10. Cover and cook over medium-low heat 3 to 4 minutes , stirring occasionally , until chicken is no longer pink in center
11. Remove chicken from skillet
