title: grilled chicken with oregano  cinnamon and paprika
steps:
1. Mix together everything but the chicken in a glass baking dish or zip lock bag
2. Add chicken pieces and coat well and let stand 1 hour or overnite in the frigde
3. Grill over medium coals till done
4. Turning once
5. About 15 minutes for the breast

title: popeye s lasagna
steps:
1. Saute the onion , garlic , and mushrooms in olive oil in a large skillet until tender
2. Add the tomatoes and next 4 ingredients
3. Stir well
4. Bring to a boil
5. Reduce the heat and simmer , uncovered , for 20 minutes
6. Remove and discard the bay leaf
7. Set the sauce aside
8. Meanwhile , cook the lasagna noodles according to the package directions
9. Drain well , and set aside
10. Combine the ricotta cheese , spinach , 1 / 4 cup parmesan cheese , egg , salt , and pepper
11. Stir well and set aside
12. Grease a 13x9x2 inch baking dish
13. Spread 1 1 / 3 cups of the tomato sauce into the dish
14. Layer one third of the lasagna noodles , 1 / 2 of the spinach mixture , 1 cup mozzarella cheese , and 1 / 4 cup parmesan cheese in the order listed
15. Top with 1 1 / 3 cups of tomato mixture , one third of the lasagna noodles , and the remaining half of the spinach mixture
16. Top with the remaining one third lasagna noodles , 1 1 / 3 cups tomato mixture , 1 / 4 cup parmesan cheese , and 1 cup mozzarella
17. Cover and bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes
18. Let it stand for 10 minutes before serving

title: grilled antelope steak
steps:
1. In plastic bag or large shallow bowl , combine all ingredients except meat
2. Add meat and marinate 6-8 hours
3. Prepare barbeque for cooking
4. Place steak on rack 6 inches above hot coals
5. Grill 10-15 minutes , basting occasionally
6. Turn , continue basting , and grill 10-15 minutes longer for medium steak
7. Serves 6-8

title: 7 layer ranch dip
steps:
1. In 2-quart shallow dish , combine dressing mix , mayonnaise and sour cream
2. Evenly layer remaining ingredients , ending with cheese
3. Chill if desired
4. Serve with tortilla chips

title: german baked eggs a la conifer house
steps:
1. Beat eggs
2. Mix in remaining ingredients
3. Bake at 350 for about 40-50 minutes
4. Test by inserting a knife
5. It will come out clean when done

title: cocktail wieners
steps:
1. In a saucepan over medium heat , combine the cocktail sauce and grape jelly
2. Mix in the little smokie sausages
3. Cook 5 minutes , or until the sausages are hot
4. An optional way would be to put all ingredients into a crock pot on low and slowly bring up to temperature

title: mexican chicken rice soup  caldo cantina
steps:
1. Put stock in medium saucepan
2. Bring to a boil over med-high heat
3. Add rice , some salt and pepper
4. Lower heat so that it just bubbles
5. Cook , stirring occasionally , until the rice is tender , about 20 minutes
6. Meanwhile , combine vegetables with chicken , lime juice , cilantro and chiles
7. Put in the bottom of one large bowl or 4 small ones
8. When the soup is ready , ladle it over the stuff in the bowls
9. Taste
10. Adjust seasoning if necessary

title: my favorite cheesecake
steps:
1. In a bowl , mix crumbs , butter , sugar and salt
2. Press to the bottom of a 9 1 / 2 inch spring form pan
3. In a bowl with an electric mixer beat cream cheese until fluffy and add eggs a little at a time
4. Beat in sugar and vanilla on low speed until just combined
5. Pour filling into crust and bake at 350 f in the middle of oven for 45 minutes
6. Transfer cake to pan rack and let stand for 5 minutes
7. Leave oven on
8. In a bowl stir together sour cream , sugar , and vanilla
9. Drop by spoonfuls on top of cheesecake and spread evenly
10. Bake an additional 10 minutes
11. Transfer cake to cooling rack and cool completely
12. Chill cake overnight covered
13. Let cheesecake stand for 30 minutes before serving with your favorite topping

title: baked marrow with sweetcorn
steps:
1. Peel the marrow , cut in half and scoop out the seeds
2. Cut into 2cm thick slices , then into chunks
3. Pile the flesh in the middle of a large square of kitchen foil
4. Add the corn
5. Dollop the butter on top , then add a generous grind of pepper and some salt
6. Pull the sides of the foil up around the veg and seal loosely
7. Bake at 220c / 400f gas mark 6 for 30 minutes

title: dos leches cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Whip eggs , sugar and salt until tripled in bulk
3. Fold in flour
4. Pour mixture into 9x11-inch , well buttered pan
5. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes
6. Set aside to cool
7. Poke holes on top of cake
8. Combine milks and flavoring and pour over cake
9. Allow to soak in at least 2 hours

title: limeade screwdriver
steps:
1. In a glass , combine all ingredients
2. Stir
3. Insert straw and enjoy !

title: saucy shrimp and potato salad  rsc
steps:
1. Directions:
2. Combine the yogurt , ranch dressing , onion , celery , chives , eggs , hot sauce , red potatoes , shrimp , and lemon juice in a medium bowl and mix well
3. Season with salt and pepper to taste
4. Serve mixture over lettuce or baby greens , and garnish with tomato wedges

title: peach   raspberry crisp
steps:
1. Peel and slice peaches , you should have about 4 cups
2. In a shallow 1 1 / 2 to 2-quart casserole , combine peaches , 1 / 3 c of the sugar , lemon juice , and cinnamon
3. Mix lightly
4. Spread raspberries over peach mixture
5. In a food processor or a medium-size bowl , whirl or stir together flour , remaining 1 / 3 c
6. Sugar and nutmeg until well blended
7. Add margarine
8. Whirl with on-off bursts until mixture begins to cling together in lumps
9. Spoon over raspberries
10. Bake in a 375f oven until fruit mixture is bubbly in center and topping is golden brown , about 45 minutes
11. Let cool for at least 10 minutes
12. Serve warm or at room temperature
13. Top with frozen yogurt if desired

title: hungarian chocolate cake  rigo jancsi
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f
2. Line a 10 1 / 2 x 15 1 / 2-inch jellyroll pan with parchment and spray with nonstick vegetable spray
3. In a dry bowl , melt chocolate over barely simmering water
4. Whisk the eggs and sugar until they hold a ribbon shape for 2 seconds
5. Whisk in the coffee mixture
6. Sift , then fold in the cocoa
7. Fold in the melted chocolate
8. Spread in the prepared pan and bake for 9 minutes until set
9. Let cool
10. Meanwhile , make the filling
11. Sift the cocoa and confectioners' sugar into the cream and whip to the consistency of shaving cream
12. Divide the sheet cake in half
13. Lightly spread one layer with apricot preserves
14. Spread on the whipped cream
15. Lightly spread the other half with raspberry preserves and flip on top of the whipped cream
16. Refrigerate
17. Make the ganache: put the chocolate in a small bowl
18. Over medium heat , bring the cream to a scald
19. Pour the hot cream over the chocolate
20. Working from the center out , gently stir with a whisk to melt and blend
21. Continue stirring until smooth
22. Stir in the nibs , if using
23. Pour over the cake
24. Allow cake to chill in the refrigerator for 30 minutes , until chocolate is set

title: canned carp
steps:
1. Pack each pint jar with fillet carp
2. To each pint add 1 teaspoon salt , 2 teaspoons catsup , 3 tablespoons white vinegar
3. Fill with water so there are no air bubbles
4. Seal
5. Boil in hot water bath 3 hours
6. Better to set aside for 3 months before eating

title: coleslaw with peanut dressing
steps:
1. Whisk together vinegar , peanut butter , oil , brown sugar , ginger , garlic , and soy sauce in a small bowl until well blended
2. In a large salad bowl , toss together cabbages , carrots , peppers , green onions , and cilantro
3. Drizzle dressing over the veggies , toss to coat
4. Sprinkle chopped peanuts on top before serving
5. You can make this up to 24 hours ahead and chill , then let stand at room temperature for 30 minutes before serving

title: tuscan delight soup   bobby flay
steps:
1. Heat oil in a 4 quart pot
2. Add the onion , celery , garlic , carrot and ham and cook until soft
3. Add the cabbage , chard , potato , zucchini , water , broth , tomatoes and bouquet garni
4. Bring soup to a gentle simmer and cook for 15 to 20 minutes
5. Place half of beans in a food processor and process until smooth
6. Add the puree and the whole beans to the simmering soup
7. Simmer the soup for about 5 minutes
8. Add the spinach and cook for another 2 minutes
9. Season with salt and pepper to taste
10. You may adjust the consistency by simply adding more water
11. Ladle the soup in bowls , garnish with croutons and cheese

title: beans and sweet italian sausage
steps:
1. Put the olive oil and garlic in a heavy saucepan that will hold the sausage in a single layer
2. Place it over medium-high heat and saute the garlic cloves until lightly browned on all sides
3. While garlic is browning , coarsely chop the fresh sage
4. When the garlic has browned , discard it
5. Add the sage to the pan and cook , stirring , for about 1 minute
6. Add the tomatoes and beans
7. Season with salt and pepper
8. Add the sausage
9. When tomatoes begin to bubble , turn the heat down to medium-low
10. Cover the pan and cook at a gentle simmer until the sausages feel tender when pricked with a fork , about 20 minutes
11. Check the pan occasionally and add a little water if all the liquid evaporates before the sausages are done

title: indian style pumpkin soup
steps:
1. Heat oil and cook onion for 3 minutes
2. Add curry paste , cook 2 minutes till fragrant
3. Add pumpkin and water
4. Bring to boil and simmer covered for 20 - 30 minutes
5. Puree with stick blender
6. Add coconut cream
7. Serve with chopped herbs on top

title: curry cauliflower bake
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease a casserole dish large enough to hold the cauliflower mixture
3. Cook the cauliflower until firm-tender
4. Place the cauliflower in a prepared baking dish
5. In a bowl , combine the undiluted chicken soup , milk , 2 tablespoons melted butter , mayo , cheese and curry powder , salt and pepper
6. Mix to combine
7. Pour the soup mixture over the cauliflower in the dish
8. In a small bowl , combine the cracker crumbs with melted butter
9. Sprinkle over the soup mixture in the baking dish
10. Bake for about 30 minutes

title: soft puffy pretzel sticks
steps:
1. In a large bowl , stir the brown sugar into 2 cups of warm water until dissolved
2. Sprinkle the yeast over the water and let stand until foamy , about 5 minutes
3. Stir in the vegetable oil and 3 cups of the flour
4. Knead in the remaining 2 3 / 4 cups flour
5. Dough will be slightly sticky
6. Transfer dough to a floured surface and knead until silky , about 3 minutes
7. If the dough is very sticky , knead in up to 1 / 4 cup more flour
8. Transfer dough to a large oiled bowl , cover with plastic wrap , and let stand at room temperature until doubled in bulk , about 45 minutes
9. Heat oven to 450f
10. Line 3 large cookie sheets with parchment paper
11. Butter the paper
12. Punch dough down and turn out onto a floured surface
13. Knead dough lightly , flatten it out , and cut into 24 pieces
14. Roll each piece into a 9" stick about 1 / 2" thick
15. Transfer sticks to the cookie sheets , spacing them 2" apart
16. Let stand , uncovered , until puffed , about 25 minutes
17. In a large , deep skillet , stir the baking soda into 2 qts
18. Water and bring to a simmer over high heat
19. Reduce heat to medium
20. Using 2 slotted spoons , carefully transfer 6 pretzel sticks at a time into the simmering water for 30 seconds , turning once
21. Add about 1 cup of hot water to the soda mixture before cooking each batch of pretzels
22. Drain pretzels on paper towels , then return them to the cookie sheets
23. Brush pretzels with the egg wash and sprinkle with salt
24. Bake until richly browned , about 10 minutes
25. Serve warm
26. The baked pretzels can be stored overnight in an airtight plastic storage bag
27. Reheat before serving

title: herbed adobe pork chops
steps:
1. Trim fat from chops
2. Place chops in a plastic bag and set in a shallow dish
3. For marinade , in a small bowl , combine brown sugar , oil , orange juice , cilantro , vinegar , chili powder , cumin , oregano , salt , red pepper , cinnamon and garlic
4. Pour over chops , seal bag
5. Marinade in the fridge for 2 to 24 hours , turning occasionally
6. Drain chops , discard marinade
7. For a charcoal grill: grill chops on rack of an uncovered grill directly over medium coals for 12-15 minutes or until chops are done , turning once halfway through grilling
8. For a gas grill: reduce heat to medium , place chops on grill rack over heat
9. Cover and grill as above
10. I do the crockpot version: i marinade the meat then dump it in the crockpot and let it cook all day long
11. I use a roast or boneless ribs
12. Either way my family loves it !

title: shrimp and crab au gratin
steps:
1. Melt the butter in a heavy bottom saucepan over very high heat
2. When the butter is completely melted , stir in the flour with a wooden spoon
3. Cook for about 1 minute over low heat , stirring constantly
4. Slowly add the milk
5. Using a whisk , stir briskly until you have a smooth sauce , about 2 minutes
6. Add the wine , lemon juice , salt , black pepper , and cayenne and whisk again
7. Switch to the wooden spoon and keep stirring the white sauce until it is completely smooth and thickened , about the consistency of mayonnaise
8. Remove from the heat
9. Bring 2 cups of water and old bay seasoning to a boil in a medium saucepan and add the shrimp
10. When the water returns to a boil
11. Cook the shrimp for 1 minute
12. Drain immediately
13. Roughly chop the shrimp and put in a large mixing bowl
14. Add the crabmeat and with your hands , toss gently to mix
15. Pour the sauce over the seafood
16. With a large spoon , gently combine , taking care not to break apart the crabmeat
17. Spray an 8-inch square disposable aluminum foil pan with vegetable oil cooking spray or use an 11 by 7-inch casserole dish
18. Pour the mixture into the pan
19. Place the grated cheese on top , completely covering the seafood mixture
20. Bake in a preheated 350 degrees f oven uncovered for about 25 minutes , until bubbly

title: corn with garlic cilantro butter
steps:
1. Place corn in large container
2. Cover with cold water
3. Let stand 2 hours
4. Make garlic cilantro butter by mixing all ingredients
5. Cover and refrigerate until serving
6. Heat coals or gas grill for direct heat
7. Cover and grill corn in husks 4 to 6 inches from medium heat 20 to 30 minutes or until corn is tender
8. Remove husks
9. Serve corn with garlic cilantro butter

title: almond chocolate chip cookies  no baking powder soda
steps:
1. - mix with spoon flour , chocolate chips and almonds
2. - in another bowl mix with electric mixer egg , oil , sugar and salt until thick and the consistency resemble to mayonnaise
3. - add the flour mix into the egg mix
4. Fold with spatula , just until all wet
5. - put the dough in the fridge at about 15 minutes , while we heat up the oven to 170c
6. - line a cookie tin with a baking paper
7. - with two teaspoons make a ball of dough and put onto the the tin
8. You can press the dough a little with your finger to make it wider if you like
9. - bake about 10 minutes
10. - take out from the oven and let it cool
11. The first time they took out from the oven they might seems a bit soft , but after cooled it will be harden a bit
12. It will be chewy inside and crunchy on top

title: chocolate chip cookie sticks
steps:
1. Line a 13x9-inch pan with foil
2. Set aside
3. In a large mixing bowl beat butter and shortening with an electric mixer on medium to high speed for 30 seconds
4. Add brown sugar , sugar or splenda , and baking soda
5. Beat until combined , scraping sides of bowl occasionally
6. Beat in eggs and vanilla until combined
7. Beat in as much of the flour as you can with you mixer
8. Using a wooden spoon , stir in any remaining flour
9. Stir in chocolate and nuts
10. Press dough evenly into the prepared pan
11. Bake at 375f for 22-25 minutes or until golden brown and center is set
12. Cool in pan on a wire rack 1 hour
13. Preheat oven to 325f
14. Holding securely to the foil lining , gently remove cookies from pan and place on cutting board , leaving cookies on foil lining
15. Cut cross-wise into 9 x 1 / 2-inch slices
16. Place slices , cut side down , about 1 inch apart on ungreased cookie sheet
17. Bake for 6-8 minutes or until cut edges are crispy
18. Carefully transfer cookies to wire rack
19. Cool

title: artichoke and green bean casserole
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together
2. Bake in casserole dish at 350 degrees for 30 minutes

title: dried cranberry shortbread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325f with rack in center
2. Put butter , sugar , vanilla , flour , and salt , in large mixing bowl
3. Stir together by hand until combined , but not creamy
4. Stir in dried cranberries
5. Press dough evenly into 8" square baking pan
6. Bake until firm and pale golden , about 30 minutes
7. Let cool in pan on wire rack about 20 minutes
8. Run knife around edges to loosen from pan and move to work surface , right side up
9. Cut out using cookie cutter , or cut in to squares using knife

title: brewers nun
steps:
1. Pour all ingredients , except cherries , into 18 oz wine glass
2. Fill with ice and stir well
3. Garnish with cherries

title: grilled  eggplant romano
steps:
1. Turn your barbecue on to high
2. Cut the eggplants into 1 / 2 inch pieces
3. Grill them until they are lightly charred
4. Remove from the grill and set aside
5. If you can't grill them all at once , remove the first batch and do the second
6. Once they are cook do the following:
7. In a 9x2x13 inch ceramic dish coat the bottom with a good layer of the pasta sauce
8. Lay the eggplant in a single layer over the sauce
9. Sprinkle with 1 cup of the cheese over the eggplants
10. Then sprinkle 1 tablespoons of the garlic powder over top of that
11. Repeat ending with the cheese and garlic powder
12. Sprinkle the bread crumbs on top and drizzle with a little olive oil if you like
13. Cook in a 375'f oven for about 45 minutes or until the bread crumbs are a golden brown and the eggplant is bubbling around the edges
14. Bon appetit !

title: vegan apple crisp
steps:
1. 8x8x2 pan or 2qt baking dish
2. Place rolled oats , flour sugar salt and cinnamon in large bowl and mix
3. Add butter and blend well
4. Arrange apple slices on top

title: pan de cafe infectado
steps:
1. Put ice , strawberrries , and bananas into a blender and blend for 5 seconds
2. Add malibu and bailey's and blend until there is a smoothie-like consistency
3. Finally add mint leaves into blender and stir
4. Pour into a suitable glass and serve

title: spinach cheese bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Spray a 13x9" pan with spray and add melted butter to coat
3. Place spinach in bottom of dish , sprinkle with cheeses
4. Combine remaining ingredients in a bowl and mix well
5. Pour into pan and bake for 40 minutes until lightly browned

title: southwest caesar dressing
steps:
1. Whisk brown sugar with vinegar until sugar dissolves
2. Combine remaining ingredients together and whisk until smooth
3. Serve immediately or chill if using later in the day

title: grilled salt   pepper shrimp
steps:
1. Place shrimp in a colander , rinse in cold water and pat dry
2. In a large bowl , combine shrimp , lime juice , salt , black , white and cayenne peppers and chili powder then toss to coat
3. Add splash of vermouth and 1 / 4 cup of oil then toss to coat and refrigerate until ready to use
4. Prepare a charcoal or gas grill for direct grilling over medium high heat
5. Brush and oil the grill grate
6. Working in batches , grill shrimp , turning once , until bright red and nicely charred , 2-3 minutes per side
7. Transfer to platter and tent with aluminum foil

title: award winning beef stroganoff
steps:
1. In large skillet add butter , diced onion until butter begins to sizzle , turn temperature down to simmer and allow onion to saut
2. After 3 minutes add sliced mushrooms and allow to simmer an additional 8 minutes
3. In large mixing bowl add bullion , sour cream , flour , garlic , parsley , salt , and pepper , mix all ingredients together well
4. Add sauted onion and butter from skillet
5. Place diced beef cubes in skillet , add an additional 2 tablespoons butter , 1 cup red wine and allow to simmer for approximately 20 minutes or until browned and tender
6. Add beef cubes and wine mixture to other ingredients and mix well
7. Add all beef and sauce that you prepared into a large pot and heat for 10 minutes
8. Cook noodles according to directions
9. Place noodles on large serving dish put beef and sauce on top of noodles , garnish with additional parsley and serve

title: vegetable barley soup
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large stock pot over medium low heat
2. Add onions , celery and carrots and stir until onions and celery soften , not browning , about 10 minutes
3. Add remaining vegetables , tomatoes , broth , water , boullion , barley , bay leaf and italian seasoning
4. Bring to boil , then reduce heat and simmer one hour uncovered
5. Add salt and pepper to taste

title: family pleasing sloppy joes
steps:
1. Brown beef and onion over medium heat
2. Drain
3. Add ketchup , water , brown sugar , vinegar , salt mustard , chili powder and allspice
4. Bring to a boil
5. Reduce heat , simmer , uncovered for 30 minutes until heated through
6. Spoon onto buns
7. Enjoy !

title: so easy pineapple short ribs
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees f
2. Season the ribs with seasoning salt and pepper all over
3. In a large oven-proof pot , heat oil over medium heat , add in the ribs working in batches and brown on all sides
4. Then add in the chopped onion , garlic , pineapple chunks with the juice , broth , chili sauce , cider vinegar , honey , worcestershire sauce red pepper flakes or cayenne mix to combine and to coat the ribs
5. Cover the pot and bake for 1 hour
6. Remove from the oven , season sauce with salt and pepper
7. Place back in the oven uncovered for another hour or until the ribs are tender

title: healthy oatmeal pancakes
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine dry ingredients
2. Add buttermilk , eggs , and oil
3. Stir into dry ingredients just until blended - do not overmix
4. Pour batter by 1 / 4 cupful onto a lightly greased hot griddle
5. Turn when bubbles form on top of pancakes
6. Cook until second side is golden
7. Serve with freshly cut strawberries if possible and warm maple syrup
8. Yum !

title: shrimp and goat cheese grits
steps:
1. Add stock to a medium saucepan or large skillet and bring to a boil
2. Stir in the grits and continue to stir for approximately 4 minutes , then reduce heat to a simmer
3. Add cream as needed to keep the grits moist
4. Place shrimp in a large ziplock bag with the garlic , red pepper flakes , salt , pepper and lemon zest
5. Make sure the spices are mixed well and coating the shrimp , then place the bag in the refrigerator to marinate for 20 minutes
6. After the 20 minutes are up , add butter , goat cheese , parsley and basil to the grits
7. Stir and add salt and pepper
8. Heat a saute pan to medium high heat
9. In a little butter , add shrimp and saute for 5 minutes , or until shrimp are opaque and form a "c"
10. Do not overcook the shrimp !
11. To serve , spoon grits onto a serving plate , and add 4 shrimp and some liquid from the saute pan on top of the grits

title: gretchen s hot italian soup
steps:
1. Brown italian sausage and drain
2. Add garlic , onion and stir until limp
3. Stir in tomatoes and juice , break into pieces , add broth , and basil
4. Simmer uncovered for 30 minute then add the rest of the ingredients
5. Cover and cook 25 minutes longer

title: carol allen s meat
steps:
1. Brown beef with onions
2. Drain off any fat
3. Mix in remaining ingredients
4. Pour into casserole dish
5. Bake at 375 for 10 minutes
6. Serve on rice , noodles , or biscuits
7. Myfamily likes me to go easy on the onions , so i use less than 1 cup chopped onions

title: applesauce oat muffins for 2
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Coat 4 regular size muffin cups with cooking spray
3. Combine flour , oats , brown sugar , baking powder , cinnamon & salt
4. In another bowl , mix the egg , milk , applesauce & oil
5. Stir into dry ingredients just until moistened
6. Don't over mix or the mufins will toughen up
7. Fill prepared muffin tins 2 / 3 full
8. Bake for 12-15 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean
9. Cool for 5 minutes in pan
10. Remove to rack
11. Serve warm

title: peaches continental
steps:
1. Arrange peach halves , cut side up , in 9 inch pie plate
2. Sprinkle evenly with rum
3. Spoon 1 t
4. Sour cream into center of each peach
5. Sprinkle brown sugar and almonds evenly over peaches
6. Bake at 350 for 30 minutes

title: kona k s oven baked garlic baby potatoes
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 375 degrees
2. Spray baking spray with non-stick cooking spray
3. Throw potatoes into ziploc baggie
4. Spray liberally with non-stick cooking spray
5. Add salt , pepper , garlic and paprika
6. Shake well until potatoes are well-coated
7. Place on baking tray , in single layer
8. Bake for about 45-50 minutes , or until potatoes are tender

title: pizza flavored snack mix
steps:
1. Combine the parmesan , sauce mix and garlic powder
2. In a large plastic bag , combine crispix and pretzels
3. Pour oil over cereal mix
4. Seal bag and toss gently until well coated
5. Pour in the parmesan mixture and seal bag
6. Again , toss mixture until coated evenly
7. Enjoy as a quick snack

title: legal seafood style coleslaw
steps:
1. Add green cabbage to the boiling water , remove from heat , let sit 5 minutes , drain , and press dry
2. In a large bowl , combine green and red cabbage , onion and carrot
3. Stir in mayonnaise , sour cream and salt to taste , and chill

title: creamy cabbage and carrot soup
steps:
1. In a big soup pot , heat the oil over moderate heat
2. Add the onion and garlic and saut for 7 minutes or until the onion is soft
3. Add the carrots and saut for 5 minutes or until the carrots are crisp-tender
4. Stir in the cabbage , cover and cook , stirring occasionally for 10 minutes or until the cabbage is wilted
5. Add the broth , 2 cups water , dill , tomato paste , ginger , salt and pepper
6. Bing to a boil
7. Reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes or until the cabbage is very tender
8. Stir the sour cream into the soup

title: apricot white chocolate chippers
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl , cream butter and sugars together
2. Add egg and vanilla and beat well
3. Dissolve 3 tbsp milk powder in the 1 / 4 cup water , then add to bowl
4. Mix in salt , baking soda , cream of tartar , and lemon zest
5. Add flour and mix thoroughly
6. Mix in remaining ingredients and stir to combine
7. Using two tablespoons , drop small amounts of dough onto a greased cookie sheet and bake for 10-15 minutes at 325f or until bottoms of the cookies are light brown
8. Cool slightly before removing from baking sheet
9. Makes 2 dozen cookies

title: light fruitcake ii
steps:
1. Cook raisins in water 10 minutes and then drain , cool and set aside
2. Cream butter and sugar , add beaten eggs , beat well
3. Add flour , baking powder and salt , sifted together
4. Add milk , lemon juice and mixed fruit
5. Mix together raisins , walnuts , blending well
6. Grease and flour angel food pan
7. Fill half full , put rest of batter in a loaf pan and bake 1 1 / 2 to 1 3 / 4 hours at 300 degrees

title: chocolate salad  pms salad
steps:
1. Add everything to a large serving bowl and toss lightly to mix
2. You may add or take away anything that your chocolate loving heart desires
3. If your feeling festive , you could use seasonal colored m&m's

title: hearty grilled vegetables
steps:
1. Place potatoes and sweet potato on a large piece of heavy duty foil
2. Drizzle with half of the butter , garlic , parsley , salt and lemon pepper
3. Seal packet tightly
4. Grill , covered for about 20 minutes each side
5. Meanwhile , place mushrooms , onion , green pepper , zucchini and squash on a large piece of heavy duty foil
6. Drizzle with the remaining butter and seasonings
7. Seal packet tightly
8. Grill for about 10 minutes each side or until the veggies are crisp-tender
9. Combine the ingredients of both packets in a serving bowl , sprinkle with cheese
10. Serve with sour cream if desired

title: lemon poppy seed coleslaw
steps:
1. Combine red and green cabbage , carrot , and spring onion in a bowl
2. Mix together the dressing , lemon rind and poppyseeds and toss with salad until well combined
3. Chill before serving

title: salmon wellington
steps:
1. Make mushroom onion filling: melt butter or margarine in skillet and saute onion until lightly browned
2. Add mushrooms and cook , stirring , until most of the liquid has evaporated
3. Season to taste
4. Remove to bowl and chill
5. Fillingmay be refrigerated up to 2 days or may be frozen
6. Roll half the pastry on a floured board into a rectangle approximately 14 inches long and 12 inches wide
7. Cut into 4 rectangles
8. Repeat with remaining dough
9. Place salmon fillets on a greased baking sheet
10. Tuck the thinner parts of fillet underneath , making them all the same thickness
11. Divide mushroom onion filling among the fillets and spread evenly on top
12. Cover each with a rectangle of pastry
13. Tuck 1 / 2 inch of pastry under fillets
14. Trim off excess dough
15. Do not cover the entire bottom with pastry or it will become soggy
16. Brush top and sides with egg yolk glaze , being careful not to let glaze drip
17. Re-roll scraps of pastry and cut out small decorations
18. Place on wellingtons and glaze the entire pastry again
19. Maybe refrigerated up to 8 hours
20. Make light white wine sauce: place wine , vinegar and shallots or onion in medium saucepan
21. Bring to a boil , lower the heat , and simmer until slightly thickened and reduced to approximately 4 tablespoons
22. Slowly whisk in the cream
23. Simmer , stirring occasionally , until sauce thickens to desired consistency
24. This will take a little time , but as the water evaporates from the cream , it will thicken
25. Season to taste with salt and pepper
26. Stir in chives or parsley
27. Reheat before serving
28. If sauce becomes too thick , thin down with additional wine or cream
29. Serve hot
30. Before serving , bring wellingtons to room temperature for 1 hour
31. Preheat oven to 425f
32. Bake wellingtons for 20-25 minutes or until the pastry is golden
33. At this time , if the fillets are 3 / 4 inch thick , they will be moist and flaky
34. Spoon a small amount of sauce on each plate , place wellingtons on sauce and pass remaining sauce
35. The fine art of cooking involves personal choice
36. Many preferences , ingredients , and procedures may not be consistent with what you know to be true
37. As with any recipe , you may find your personal intervention will be necessary
38. Bon appetit !

title: popeye s favorite muscle booster  sandwich spinach  chicken
steps:
1. Beat the egg with the water
2. Dip prepared chicken breast in the egg then in the seasoned bread crumbs
3. Add 1 tbsp of oil to a large skillet , medium heat , pan fry the chicken for apprx 5 minutes each side or until golden
4. Add mushrooms for the last 5 minutes
5. Stir fry them so they get well browned on both sides
6. Meanwhile put 1 tbsp oil in another skillet over medium heat add garlic , saute 1 minute , add fresh spinach for 1-2 minutes or until it wilts or if using frozen heat it through
7. Add lemon and nutmeg
8. Keep spinach warm
9. Cut the focaccia bread through the middle and toast the inside - butter it if you wish
10. Place chicken on the bottom half , top with spinach and mushrooms - add any other condiments like sweet onion , tomato and cheese
11. If you are using cheese melt it a bit on the chicken before removing it from the pan
12. Put on the top half of the bread
13. Cut into 2 or 4 pieces

title: dark beer and fresh ginger cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Grease a bundt pan or tube pan
3. Dust with flour
4. In a large saucepan , bring to boil the beer and molasses
5. Remove from the heat and add baking soda
6. Let rest
7. In a large bowl , beat the eggs with sugar
8. Add oil and beat well
9. Set aside
10. In another bowl , mix flour , baking powder , cinnamon , cloves , nutmeg , cardamom and pepper
11. Incorporate the mixture of molasses to the egg mixture , stirring well
12. Then add gradually the mixture of flour and the ginger
13. Put the dough in the pan and bake in the oven for 1 hour or until a tooth-pick inserted in the middle comes out clean
14. Let cool 15 minutes , then remove the cake from the pan
15. You can serve the cake with whipped cream or another frosting you like

title: zuccuash bake  from nimz territory
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Lightly spray a 9-in rd glass pie plate w / cooking spray & set aside
3. Over med-heat in a lrg non-stick skillet , melt butter
4. Add garlic , sliced zucchini + onion & saute for 2 minutes
5. Then add sliced squash & cont to cook till onion is transparent & veggies start to soften
6. Remove from heat
7. Add cream cheese in sml pieces + lemon pepper seasoning salt to taste , stir gently to fully mix w / veggies & put mixture in the prepared dish
8. Combine breadcrumbs w / parmesan cheese & sprinkle evenly over the top of the veggie mixture
9. Bake till lightly browned & bubbling
10. Serve immediately

title: pineapple mandarin chicken
steps:
1. Heat oil in a non-stick saute pan
2. Cut chicken into bite-size pieces and add to oil and brown
3. Turn often
4. Add salt , pepper , garlic to taste
5. Add cornstarch to a little water , stir and add to chicken
6. Sprinkle with ginger and add pineapple and mandarin oranges
7. Stir until mixture begins to thicken and all ingredients are cooked well
8. Place on a plate and sprinkle over the almonds
9. Serve immediately

title: cranberry upside down cornbread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. In 10-inch ovenproof , nonstick skillet , combine cranberries , raspberry spread , 1 tablespoon of brown sugar , orange zest , and orange juice
3. Bring to a boil over medium-low heat , reduce to a simmer , and cook , stirring frequently , 7 minutes or until berries have popped and sauce is thick
4. Meanwhile , in a large bowl , stir together cornmeal , flour , baking powder , baking soda , salt , and remaining 3 tablespoons brown sugar
5. In measuring cup , combine buttermilk , oil , and egg
6. Make well in center of dry ingredients , pour in buttermilk mixture and stir to combine
7. Pour cornmeal mixture over cranberries
8. Bake 20 minutes or until knife inserted in center comes out clean
9. Cool 5 minutes in pan , then invert onto plate , scraping any berry mixture that sticks to the pan on top of cornbread
10. Serve warm or at room temperature

title: quick steamed pudding
steps:
1. Melt butter and golden syrup together and put in bottom of pudding basin
2. Beat all other ingredients to a pikelet / crepe batter and pour into basin
3. In a large pot bring enough water to come halfway up basin to a boil
4. Put uncovered basin in water and place lid on pot
5. Steam for 1 / 2hour
6. Serve with custard or cream if wished

title: scallop and pineapple kabobs
steps:
1. For dressing , combine lime peel and juice , cilantro , jalapeno , sugar , 1 / 2 tsp salt , and 1 / 2 tsp pepper
2. Whisk in oil and set aside
3. Combine scallops pineapple , and avocado
4. Toss with 2 tbsp of the dressing
5. Reserve remaining
6. Marinate 15 minutes
7. Stirring often
8. Thread pieces on four 12-inch skewers
9. Grill on greased rack directly over medium-high heat for 4 minutes , turn , and heat 4 more minutes
10. Serve with remaining dressing

title: balsamic beets and greens
steps:
1. Whisk the vinegar , olive oil , sugar , and mustard together in a bowl
2. Toss with the beets and marinate at room temperature for at least 1 hour
3. In a large , skillet , heat the oil over medium heat
4. Place the garlic in the pan and saute for 1 minute
5. Add the greens , lemon juice , salt and pepper to taste
6. Cook for 2-3 minutes , stirring well
7. Cover and cook until the greens are wilted , about 5 minutes
8. Divide the hot greens among four salad plates and top with the beets and vinaigrette
9. Serve immediately and enjoy !

title: chocolate malted whopper cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Sift together flour , malted milk powder , cocoa , baking powder and salt set aside
3. Beat the butter and sugar together on medium speed for 3 minutes , until very smooth
4. Add the eggs one at a time , beating for a minute after each one
5. Beat in the vanilla
6. Reduce mixer to low add 1 / 2 of the dry ingredients and mix well
7. Pour in the milk & mix
8. Add the rest of the dry ingredients and mix well
9. The batter will look more like frosting than cookie dough
10. Put mixer on low or mix by hand the malt balls and the chocolate chips / chunks or whatever you are using
11. I prefer doing this by hand
12. Drop by rounded teaspoons 2" apart
13. Bake for 11-13 minutes , when cookies are done they will be puffed and slightly soft to the touch
14. Let cool for 2 minutes then place on cooling rack
15. Cookies freeze well up to 2 months
16. Enjoy !

title: season bee crock pot spaghetti sauce
steps:
1. Cook beef and next 5 vegetables until the meat is brown
2. Stir a lot
3. Drain any fat off
4. Throw everything into a slow cooker and cook 4-6 hours over low heat serve over noodles
5. Optional: italian tomatoes and cup wine

title: buttermilk chocolate swirl bread
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Coat an 8 1 / 2 x 4 1 / 2-inch loaf pan with nonstick spray and flour lightly
3. Mix flour , sugar , baking powder , baking soda and salt in a large bowl
4. Whisk buttermilk , eggs , egg white , oil and extracts in medium bowl
5. Stir into flour mixture just until blended
6. Melt chocolate in microwave on high about 1 minute , stirring every 15 seconds
7. Stir in 1 1 / 3 cups batter
8. Working quickly , pour some of the white batter over bottom of pan , then dollop with chocolate batter
9. Fill pan by alternating dollops of white and chocolate batter
10. Pull knife through batter to swirl
11. Bake 1 hour or until pick inserted in center comes out clean
12. Cool in pan on wire rack for 10 minutes
13. Remove from pan
14. Put cake right side up on rack to cool

title: buffalo shrooms
steps:
1. Start with butter in skillet at med
2. Heat
3. Bring to boil
4. Place mushrooms in butter and had a few pinches of garlic salt
5. Let shrooms simmer for 5-10 minutes
6. Add about 6 dashes of hot sauce
7. Stir in hot sauce in and let sit another 5-10 minutes
8. Add wing sauce
9. Start with 1 / 2 a cup and add accordingly
10. Just stir in , sprinkle with black pepper

title: courgette  zucchini    feta fritters
steps:
1. Grate courgettes , add a few pinches of salt and allow to drain for approximately 20 minutes
2. Place in a clean towel and squeeze out excess water
3. Mix courgette ball with onion , dill , parsley , eggs and paprika
4. Season with salt and pepper to taste
5. Work in the cheese and flour , mixture should have the consistency of porridge
6. For each fritter spoon out 1 tbsp of mixture into hot oil and fry until golden
7. Serve with slices of lemon

title: banana cinnamon waffles
steps:
1. In a large mixing bowl combine flour , baking powder , cinnamon , nutmeg , and salt
2. In a separate bowl beat together egg yolks , milk , banana , and oil
3. Gradually stir in the yolk mixture with the flour mixture until combined but slightly lumpy
4. In a medium bowl whisk the egg whites until stiff peaks form
5. Gently fold the egg whites into the rest of the batter , leaving a few white fluffs of egg white
6. Don't over mix
7. Pour 1 to 1 1 / 4 cup batter into grids of a preheated , lightly greased waffle iron
8. Close lid quickly and do not open during baking
9. Bake according to manufacturer's directions
10. When done use a fork to lift waffle from grid
11. Repeat with remaining batter
12. Keep waffles warm in oven while cooking remaining waffles
13. Serve with maple syrup

title: simple cinnamon syrup
steps:
1. Combine in a pan over medium heat , bring to a boil and boil about ten minutes
2. Cool and strain

title: hungarian style brussels sprouts
steps:
1. Heat 1 inch salted water to boiling
2. Add brussels sprouts
3. Heat to boiling
4. Cover and reduce heat
5. Simmer 8-10 minutes , or until tender
6. Drain
7. Fry bacon over medium heat until crisp
8. Remove bacon with slotted spoon
9. Reserve drippings
10. Cook and stir onions in hot bacon drippings until tender
11. Stir in brussels sprouts , sour cream and pepper
12. Salt to taste
13. Heat until hot
14. Sprinkle with bacon and paprika

title: simple scotch shortbread
steps:
1. Cream butter and sugar
2. Add flour a little at a time
3. Divide mixture in half and knead each piece 5 minutes or more
4. Gently roll out into a circle , place on a baking tray and prick all over with a fork
5. Bake at 325 degrees for 40 to 45 minutes
6. Cut into 8 wedges and lightly sprinkle with sugar
7. Leave to cool

title: barbecued chicken pot pie  from cooking light
steps:
1. Melt butter in a large nonstick skillet coated with cooking spray over medium-high heat
2. Add onion , peppers and garlic and saute 5 minutes
3. Stir in cumin and coriander and cook 2 minutes
4. Stir in vinegar , scraping skillet to loosen browned bits
5. Add the chicken and the next 4 ingredients and cook 15 minutes or until thick , stirring occasionally
6. Spoon chicken mixture into 11x7 inch baking dish coated with cooking spray
7. Unroll corn bread dough , separating into strips
8. Place strips in a lattice fashion over chicken mixture
9. Bake at 375 degrees for 25 minutes or until golden brown
10. Let stand 15 minutes before serving

title: pan fried potatoes  bratkartoffeln
steps:
1. Cut potatoes into evenly thick slices
2. Use a large pan that will hold potatoes in a single layer or use two pans
3. Heat oil over medium high heat
4. If using bacon and onion fry together until onion is translucent
5. Add potatoes , stir once to mix and then be patient !
6. Don't stir until potatoes are nicely golden brown on the bottom , 3-5 minutes , only check for color occasionally
7. Sprinkle with half the salt
8. Use less salt when using bacon
9. Turn and fry the same way on the other side until nicely gold-brown
10. You might need to add a little more oil to the pan if all the oil is soaked up by the potatoes
11. Taste with salt and pepper
12. Serve sprinkled with parsley

title: cranberry sauce with raspberry vinegar
steps:
1. Combine first 3 ingredients in heavy medium saucepan over medium-high heat
2. Bring to boil , stirring until sugar dissolves
3. Mix in cranberries , cinnamon stick and orange peel
4. Reduce heat , cover partially and simmer until berries burst , about 10 minutes
5. Remove from heat
6. Cool completely
7. Discard cinnamon stick
8. Can be prepared up to 1 week ahead
9. Cover and chill

title: my mom s tuna casserole with potato chips and eggs
steps:
1. Butter a 2-quart casserole dish
2. In sauce pan , bring water and soup to a boil , stirring occasionally
3. Remove from heat
4. Layer cooked noodles , tuna , chopped eggs , mushroom soup and crumbled potato chips
5. Top with chips
6. Bake uncovered at 350 f for 30 minutes
7. Serve with vegetable of your choice

title: hot gruyere spinach dip
steps:
1. Melt butter in medium saucepan over medium heat
2. Add onions
3. Cook and stir for 5 minutes , or until tender
4. Add creamed spinach and half-and-half
5. Cook and stir 5 minutes , or until hot
6. Stir in cheese and the dry sherry
7. Cook 2 minutes , or until cheese is melted
8. Serve with breadsticks or french bread slices , if desired

title: chocolate crunch brownies
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl , cream butter and sugar
2. Add eggs
3. Stir in cocoa , flour , vanilla , and salt
4. Spread into a greased 13-in x 9-in x 2-in baking pan
5. Bake at 350 degrees for 25 minutes or until brownies test done
6. Cool
7. Spread marshmallow creme over cooled brownies
8. In a small saucepan , melt peanut butter and chocolate chips over low heat , stirring constantly
9. Remove from heat
10. Stir in the cereal
11. Spread over marshmallow layer
12. Chill before cutting

title: squashy corn and jalapeno bake
steps:

4. To cook squash: roughly chop zucchini and yellow squash

title: revani
steps:
1. Syrup: combine 1-1 / 2 cups of the sugar with the cold water in a saucepan and cook until dissolved , then add the cinnamon stick , cloves , and orange peel and simmer for 15 minutes
2. Remove the flavorings
3. Cool

8. Pour immediately into a buttered 9 x 12 x 3-inch cake pan and bake on the center rack of a moderate oven for 30 to 35 minutes , or until the cake springs back when touched by a finger
9. Remove from the oven and set the pan on a cake rack

11. Shapes
12. Spoon the cooled syrup over the entire cake and cool

title: cranberry sparkle
steps:
1. Beat the cranberry sauce until smooth , then stir in the orange & lemon juices
2. Pour this mixture over ice cupes in a 2-quart pitcher or punch bowl
3. Carefully pour in the ginger ale , mixing carefully before serving

title: shrimp stuffed celery
steps:
1. Cut celery ribs into 2 inch pieces
2. Finely chop one piece and set aside
3. In a mixing bowl , beat cream cheese and mayonnaise until smooth
4. Stir in the remaining ingredients and reserved chopped celery
5. Stuff into celery ribs
6. Refrigerate until serving

title: pumpkin chocolate chip bundt cake
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees rack set at second lowest position grease and flour a bundt pan in mixing bowl , blend sugar and oil
2. Add eggs , beating well after each addition combine all dry ingredients
3. Add to egg mixture , alternately with pumpkin add in chocolate chips transfer to a bundt pan
4. Bake for 60-65 mins , or until done

title: healthy blueberry peach oatmeal
steps:
1. Prepare your oatmeal as you would normally
2. I microwave mine
3. Put your blueberries in the microwave for about 40 seconds or until thawed and sitting in own juice
4. Mix all ingredients together in a bowl and enjoy !

title: pear gingerbread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Grease a 7 x 11 , or 5 small loaf pans , with butter
3. Dust with flour and tap out excess
4. In a large frying pan over med-high heat , melt the 1 tablespoons butter
5. Add the pear and cook , stirring often , until softened , 3-4 minute transfer to bowl and let cool
6. In another bowl , sift together the all-purpose and whole-wheat flours , baking soda , ground ginger , cinnamon , salt , and nutmeg and set aside
7. In a separate bowl , using tan electric mixer on med
8. Speed , beat together 1 / 2 cup butter and 3 / 4 cup brown sugar , until light and fluffy , 2-3 minutes
9. Gradually beat in the molasses
10. Add the eggs one at a time , beating well after each addition
11. Beat in fresh ginger
12. With the mixer on low speed , beat the flour mixture into the egg mixture in three batches alternately with the buttermilk , beginning and ending with the flour
13. Beat just until mixed
14. Stir in the pear
15. Pour into prepared pan / or pans
16. Bake until a cake tester inserted into the center comes out clean , 45-50 for large cake , check at 30 for small pans transfer pan to a rack and let cool for 15 minute

title: whole wheat and semolina flour pizza dough
steps:
1. 1
2. Add hot water , sugar and yeast to your bread maker pan
3. 2
4. Add the three types of flours
5. Remember: it's the semolina that makes this recipe unique
6. 3
7. Add the salt
8. 4
9. Process in the bread maker on the dough setting including the rising time or process as you would by hand , allowing the dough to triple
10. When finished , the dough will be easy to work and slightly sticky
11. Rub your hands with olive oil so the dough doesnt stick
12. For my use , i divide the finished dough into 4 pieces
13. Use olive oil to season 4 , 9 inches cake pans and press the dough into each pan
14. Brush additional olive oil onto the top of each then cover the pans and let the dough raise again for about a half hour
15. You can also divide into two 13 inches crusts or one 16+ inches
16. Next , prick the dough with a fork to prevent air bubbles then par-bake the crusts for 5 minutes in a 425 degree oven
17. Place the cooked crusts on a rack and when cool , wrap with foil and freeze for use whenever you want a great pizza or let cool and make them right away ! i've tried these not par-baking first but it seems par-baking makes the better "lite crunch" on the outside of the crust
18. When making a pizza from a frozen crust , thaw the crust first
19. Place the crust back into the pan , which has again been seasoned with olive oil and also brush the top of the crust again
20. If you use a pizza screen , brush top and bottom
21. Apply the toppings of your choice and bake for 12-15 minutes at 425 degrees
22. Youll have a finished pizza that has a light crunch on the outside and a delightfully chewy texture
23. When checking cooking time , look for a golden brown edge on the crust

title: passover chocolate toffee matzo
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees
2. Line 2 jellyroll pans with aluminum foil
3. Spread the matzo on the pans in a single layer with no space between the pieces
4. Melt butter and brown sugar on stove
5. Boil until mixture coats a spoon , about 3-5 minutes
6. Pour mixture over matzo and spread evenly with a knife
7. One sheet at a time , bake for 4 minutes in the middle of the oven
8. As soon as you remove the pan from the oven , sprinkle 1 / 2 of the chocolate chips on the matzo , returning the pan to the oven for one additional minute
9. Using a table knife , gently spread the chocolate to cover the matzo as completely as possible
10. Sprinkle with 1 / 2 of the chopped pecans
11. Repeat with second pan
12. Place the pans in the refrigerator to cool
13. After the chocolate is completely cooled , break into small pieces

title: date and pecan cake with a gooey topping
steps:
1. Sprinkle bicarbonate of soda on dates pour the water over and allow to stand for 15 minutes
2. Sift the flour and baking powder
3. Cream butter and sugar well
4. Add eggs one at a time beating well after each addition
5. Add sifted flour mixture to the egg mixture
6. Fold in the date mixture and pecans into the butter and flour mix bake in a tube or bundt pan@ 180 celsius for 35-45 minute
7. Allow to cool and pour topping over

9. Topping:
10. Combine all the topping ingredients in a saucepan and cook on hight for 6-8 minutes

steps:
1. Heat oven to 375 degrees
2. Brown pork sausage with green pepper in medium skillet
3. Drain well
4. Stir in tomato sauce , tomato paste , fennel seed , sugar and oregano

6. Using 14-inch pizza pan or 15 x 10-inch jelly roll pan , prepare pizza crust following package directions

8. Bake on lowest rack of oven at 375 degrees for 35 to 45 minutes or until crust is golden brown and cheese is melted

title: brown bag burritos
steps:
1. In a large skillet , brown the ground beef
2. Drain
3. Add the next 8 ingredients
4. Bring to a boil
5. Reduce heat
6. Cover and simmer for 20 minutes
7. Heat 3-4 tortillas in a microwave until warm , about 45 seconds
8. Spoon 3-4 tablespooms of the beef mixture down the center of each tortilla
9. Top with 2-3 tablespooms of cheese
10. Roll up
11. Wrap each burrito in paper towel
12. Then in foil
13. Repeat with the remaining ingredients
14. Refrigerate if using right away
15. Or freeze
16. Burritos can be eaten cold
17. If warming , remove the foil and place in microwave for about a minute
18. However , if frozen , they will take longer
19. I suggest warming for 45 seconds to a minute on 50% power to thaw some , and then completing the warming process at a higher power

title: quicky ground turkey or beef casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425
2. Brown and drain ground beef
3. Add in garlic , oregano , tomato sauce , salt and pepper
4. Cook noodles according to package while beef mixture simmers
5. Drain noodles and return to pot

title: elegant   easy lemon thyme chicken
steps:
1. Combine flour , salt and pepper

8. Gradually add broth , stirring continuously , deglazing the pan of any brown bits

title: grandma s brown bread  graham bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300 degrees f
2. Grease medium sized loaf pan
3. Mix dry ingredients together
4. Add wet ingredients to dry
5. Fold in nuts if desired
6. Batter will be thick
7. Bake in very slow 300 degree oven for about 55-60 minutes
8. Test near center with wooden skewer
9. Serve warm or room temperature with butter or your favorite spread
10. Or alone with a cuppa tea !
11. Thanks grandma !

steps:
1. Preheat oven to 250 degrees

4. Combine peach mixture , bourbon , brown sugar , and 1 / 4 teaspoon salt in a food processor , or blenderand process for 1 minute or until smooth

6. Preheat grill to medium-high heat
7. Sprinkle remaining 1 / 2 teaspoon salt , and pepper evenly over chicken

title: lots a bean chili
steps:
1. Fry ground beef until browned in large stockpot , add garlic and onion , saute over medium heat for 5 min stirring now and then add celery , green pepper and carrots and saute 5 minutes
2. Add beans , tomatoes , paste and spices , hot peppers if desired

1. Preheat the oven to 350f
2. Cut about a half inch off the top of the garlic bulb
3. Place the bulb in a small baking dish
4. Drizzle the top with the olive oil
5. Cover the dish with aluminum foil , and bake for 1 hour

steps:

2. In a bowl , whisk together lime juice and zest , orange juice and zest , oil , oregano , garlic , jalapeno
3. Pour marinade into plastic bag over chicken and lay flat in a shallow dish
4. Refrigerate for at least 90 minutes or up to 4 hours , turning occasionally
5. Remove chicken from marinade and season with salt and pepper

title: debbie s taco dip
steps:
1. Spread refried beans on a pizza pan
2. Sprinkle with 1 / 3 of taco seasoning

title: beef in stout   northern ireland
steps:
1. Heat the butter and oil in a large flameproof casserole and cook the meat for 10 minutes , until browned all over
2. Remove the meat from the pan with a slotted spoon
3. Add the onions and mushrooms to the pan , adding more oil if necessary , and fry until softened

title: the perfect cup of tea british style
steps:
1. First , you have to boil the water - don't just heat it , boil it
2. Second , add the boiling water to the tea bag , not the other way round
3. - putting the water in the cup and adding the bag to it - is a recipe for disaster
4. Unless the water is at boiling point when it makes contact with the tea , the tea will never properly brew
5. Make sure the cup or pot is nice and hot before you start
6. If necessary , rinse it out with near-boiling water
7. And keep it covered while the tea is brewing
8. Leave the bag in the water for at least two minutes - longer if you like your tea strong
9. And for goodness sake , resist the temptation to dunk
10. Just leave the bag alone until the drink is ready ! add milk and sugar to taste

title: good potato salad  216cals per serve
steps:
1. Place the peas in a microwaveable bowl and cook on full power to either defrost the frozen peas or too just cook the fresh peas
2. Set aside
3. Wash the potatoes if they are dirty , place in a pan with enough cold water to cover them

5. While the potatoes are cooking you can mix the mustard and mayonnaise together in the bowl you will serve the potato salad from

10. Place the potatoes in the bowl that has the mayo / mustard in it

13. Chill the salad if you like yours chilled
14. I prefer it warm or at room temperature
15. Only keep at room temperature if you are just about to eat , other wise put in the fridge to chill

title: company garlic chicken

2. Salt and pepper chicken

4. Remove papery outer covering of garlic
