title: ambrosia squares
steps:
1. Prepare graham crumb crust recipe , adding nuts to mixture
2. Press firmly into 13 x 9" pan
3. Chill
4. Beat cream cheese until soft
5. Gradually add 1 / 2 c of the milk , beat until smooth
6. In seperate bowl , prepare pudding mix as directed on pkg using the remaining 2 1 / 2 cups milk
7. Add prepared pudding to cream cheese mixture in three additions , beating on low speed
8. Fold in oranges
9. Layer bananas on crust
10. Spoon pudding mixture over bananas , spread prepared dessert topping evenly over pudding mixture
11. Sprinkle with toasted coconut
12. Chill 4 hours
13. Cut into squares

title: instant  sugar free spiced chai mix
steps:
1. In a food processor , combine all ingredients
2. Cover and process til powdery
3. Store in an airtight container in a cool dry place for up to 6 months
4. To prepare 1 serving , dissolve 3 tablespoons of mix in 3 / 4 cup boiling water
5. Dollop with whipped cream if desired
6. Alternately to use less , brew a chai tea bag and add 1+tablespoons of mix
7. Comments: i no longer use powdered coffee cream , so i substituted powdered coconut milk and some vanilla powder

title: simple chicken enchilada casserole
steps:
1. Combine onion , green chilis , soups , and chicken together in a large bowl
2. Place a layer of flour tortillas on the bottom of a 13 x 9 x 2 pan
3. I use a pizza cutter to cut up the tortillas
4. Spread 1 / 3 of the soup mixture over the top
5. Spread 1 / 3 of the cheese
6. Layer 1 / 3 of the black beans , if using
7. Repeat two more times
8. Bake for 30 minutes at 350 f or until bubbly
9. Top with salsa , black olives , and sour cream , if desired
10. Great freeze ahead casserole , don't bake first
11. To use:thaw overnight
12. Bake for about 30-45 minutes or until bubbly

title: halibut creole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
2. Lightly butter a shallow baking dish large enough to place fish in one layer
3. Salt and pepper fish steaks , place in baking dish
4. Mix together tomato , green pepper , onion , and jalapeno and top each fish steak with mixture
5. Melt butter and mix in lemon juice and tabasco , then drizzle over each fish steak
6. Bake approx 25 minutes , basting w / pan juices about every 10 minutes

title: shrimp scampi with linguini
steps:
1. For the pasta , put a large pot of water on the stove to boil
2. When it has come to the boil , add a couple of tablespoons of salt and the linguini
3. Stir to make sure the pasta separates
4. Cover
5. When the water returns to a boil , cook for about 6 to 8 minutes or until the pasta is not quite done
6. Drain the pasta
7. Meanwhile , in a large skillet , melt 2 tablespoons butter in 2 tablespoons olive oil over medium-high heat
8. Saute the shallots , garlic , and red pepper flakes until the shallots are translucent , about 3 to 4 minutes
9. Season the shrimp with salt and pepper
10. Add them to the pan and cook until they have turned pink , about 2 to 3 minutes
11. Remove the shrimp from the pan
12. Set aside and keep warm
13. Add wine and lemon juice and bring to a boil
14. Add 2 tablespoons butter and 2 tablespoons oil
15. When the butter has melted , return the shrimp to the pan along with the parsley and cooked pasta
16. Stir well and season with salt and pepper
17. Drizzle over a bit more olive oil and serve immediately

title: crock pot tuna noodle casserole
steps:
1. Follow pasta package directions to cook pasta
2. Drain pasta
3. Meanwhile , in a sprayed slow cooker combine soup with 1 / 4 cup water
4. Choose between the following two methods of assembling the casserole , with the first yielding the prettiest result but both working well
5. Pour cooked , drained pasta in slow cooker in the first layer
6. Add onion for the next layer
7. Add tuna for the third layer
8. And add thawed frozen peas for the top layer
9. In a large bowl , mix cooked , drained pasta and onion and tuna and peas and put into sprayed slow cooker
10. Cover and cook on high 1 1 / 2 to 2 hours to heat through
11. And , if you like , add cheese during the last 1 / 2 hour of baking

title: weight watchers yummy cheese soup  easy too
steps:
1. Add 2 cans chicken broth
2. Add 1 can rotel tomatoes
3. Add 2 packages frozen broccoli
4. Cook together 8 minute and then stir in 8 oz
5. Velveeta light cheese

title: lemon molasses marble cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Butter and flour a 9 to 10 inch bundt pan or tube pan and set aside
3. To make the molasses batter , cream together the butter and brown sugar until very light
4. Beat in the egg yolks one at a time
5. Beat in the molasses
6. Sift the dry ingredients together and add the batter alternately with the yoghurt , beginning and ending with the dry ingredients
7. Do not over mix
8. To make the lemon batter , cream together the butter and the sugar and lemon zest until very light
9. Add the lemon extract
10. Sift the dry ingredients together and add to the creamed mixture alternately with the yoghurt beginning and ending with the dry ingredients
11. Do not overmix
12. Beat the egg whites with the salt until nearly stiff
13. Fold about 1 / 4 of them into the batter to lighten it , then gently fold in the remainder
14. Drop 3 or 4 large dollops of the lemon batter into the prepared cake pan
15. Top with 3 or 4 dollops of molasses batter
16. Continue layering batters until all is used up
17. Gently rap the pan once against the countertop to settle the batters
18. With a butter knife , swirl the batters together a few times without over-doing it
19. Bake until the cake is golden brown and a toothpick inserted near the centre comes out clean , about 1 hour
20. Cool the cake in the pan on a wire rack for 10 to 15 minutes
21. Loosen the cake from the pan and unmold onto the rack to cool completely
22. Dust with icing sugar before serving
23. A lemon glaze is also nice on this

title: tomato  aubergine and courgette gratin
steps:
1. In a non-stick frying pan , heat 1 tsp of the oil over medium-high heat
2. Cook onion , mushrooms , garlic and 2 tbsp water , stirring , for 3 minutes or until softened
3. Add tomatoes , marjoram , thyme and salt and pepper to taste
4. Cook for 20 minutes or until thickened , stirring often
5. Slice courgettes and aubergines diagonllay into 5 mm thick slices
6. Toss aubergine with remaining oil
7. Spread 125 ml of the tomato sauce in a glass baking dish
8. Layer with half of the courgette , aubergine and sauce , repeat layers
9. Mix breadcrumbs with cheese
10. Sprinkle over top
11. Bake , uncovered at 200 c for 35 minutes or until bubbling

title: baked brie en croute
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Defrost puff pastry for approximately 15 to 20 minutes and unfold
3. In a saucepan , melt the butter over medium heat
4. Saute the walnuts in the butter until golden brown , approximately 5 minutes
5. Add the cinnamon and stir until walnuts are coated well
6. Carefully slice the top rind only off of the brie round
7. Spread your choice of fruit preserves over the top of the brie
8. Then place the walnut mixture on top of the brie ad fruit and sprinkle the brown sugar over the top
9. Lay the puff pastry out on a flat surface
10. Place the brie in the center of the pastry
11. Gather up the edges of the brie , pressing around the brie and gather at the top
12. Gently squeeze together the excess dough and tie together with a piece of kitchen twine
13. Brush the beaten egg over top and side of brie
14. Place brie on a cookie sheet and bake for 20 minutes until pastry is golden brown
15. Serve with crackers

title: hungarian goulash casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325f
2. Spray a 13"x9" casserole dish with nonstick cooking spray
3. Combine meat , salt , nutmeg , and pepper in a bowl
4. Shape mixture into 1" meatballs
5. In a large skillet , heat oil over med-high heat
6. Cook meatballs and mushrooms in oil until meatballs are browned on all sides and no longer pink in the center
7. Remove meatballs and mushrooms from skillet
8. Discard drippings
9. In a small bowl , mix cornstarch into 1 / 4 cup sour cream
10. Spoon into the skillet the meatballs were cooked inches
11. Add remaining 3 / 4 cup sour cream , soup , mik , garlic powder , and paprika , and stir until smooth
12. Place cooked noodles into casserole dish
13. Arrange meatballs on top of noodles and cover with sauce
14. Bake until hot

title: mac o  lantern
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Cook macaroni according to package directions
3. Remove and set aside 1 / 4 cup pizza sauce
4. Combine prepared macaroni , half the ground beef , remaining pizza sauce , garlic powder , egg , and basil
5. Spoon evenly into a 9 inch pie plate
6. Sprinkle with cheese
7. Combine remaining meat with the reserved pizza sauce
8. Use to create a jack-o'-lantern face on top of the casserole
9. Bake 15 minutes
10. Let stand 5 miutes before serving
11. Serve with salad

title: peanut butter oatmeal biggies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. In a large bowl , combine the first six ingredients making sure all ingredients are blended well
3. Add in remaining ingredients
4. Blend well
5. Line your cookie sheet with parchment paper
6. Using a 1 / 3 measuring cup , scoop out your cookie dough and place on the parchment paper
7. Press the centre of the cookie dough a bit with the back of a spoon
8. They will spread out to almost 5-6 inches per cookie so make sure you have lots of room on the cookie sheet for them to bake
9. Bake for 13-17 minutes
10. Remove from oven and allow to cool completely on the cookie sheet
11. With carry over cooking , they continue to bake for another 5 minutes while cooling out of the oven
12. This is what gives them the chewy consistency
13. Store in an airtight container

title: greek asparagus salad
steps:
1. Wash and trim asparagus , disgarding the tough ends
2. Cut each spear into 3 pieces
3. Bring a large pot of water to a boil and cook asparagus about 2 minutes
4. Drain and rince in cool water to stop the cooking
5. Combine the asparagus , pepper strips , artichokes , parsley and feta in a large bowl
6. Mix all of the dressing ingredients together and whisk to blend
7. Pour over asparagus mixture & toss
8. Chill several hours

title: carrie s couscous
steps:
1. Melt 2 tbls of butter in a pan , saute the onion until it's translucent , add the garlic and heat for about 1 minute , remove from heat bring 2 cups of chicken broth to a boil with 1 tbls of butter
2. Add the couscous , cover and remove from heat , let sit 5 minutes
3. After 5 minutes , add the couscous to the onions and garlic , drain and add tomatoes , mix together
4. Spray a baking dish with pam
5. Put 1 / 3 of the couscous mixture in the bottom of the pan , top with half the spinach and 1 / 3 of the cheese , repeat again using 1 / 3 of the couscous , the remaining spinach and 1 / 3 of the cheese
6. The third layer is just couscous and cheese
7. Bake in the oven at 375 for 20 minutes

title: big family meatloaf
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325
2. In a very large bowl put hamburger , crackers crumbled , salt , essence , boullion powder , and black pepper - set aside
3. Cut onion into larger pieces and put it in the food processor with the garlic -- pulse until pieces are small
4. Dump onion mixture into the bowl with the meat
5. Beat the three eggs and add them to the meat bowl
6. Add the tomato sauce to the meat bowl and use your hands to mix all very well
7. Divide meat mixture in half
8. Form into two loaves on the botton of your broiler pan or a roasting pan
9. Leave room between loaves for even baking
10. In smaller bowl mix together with a fork
11. Ketchup , brown sugar , water , mustard and cider vinegar
12. This is your topping -- brush tops and sides of loaves with this before baking and again while baking
13. Bake for 1 hour and 15 minutes to 1 hour and 25 minutes
14. When i remove the pan from the oven i like to pour off the excess oil in the bottom of the pan
15. Let cool for about 5 minutes before serving
16. Slice thick and pieces should hold together well

title: algerian farina rolls
steps:
1. Mix the yeast with 1 / 4 cup of salted water
2. Let the yeast rest until it rises & becomes bubbly , roughly 5 minutes
3. Place the flour , farina , & salt in a large bowl then stir in the olive oil
4. Add the yeast mixture to the dry ingredients & stir
5. Slowly add 1 / 2 cup of water , stirring well to combine all the ingredients
6. Make sure you get rid of any lumps
7. Cover the dough in a clean damp cloth & let it rise in a warm place for 1 1 / 2 hours
8. Optional: brown the sesame seeds on a pan in a hot oven for 2 minutes before using , this enhances their flavor
9. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees
10. Lightly spray a baking sheet with cooking spray
11. Mix the seeds into the dough , stirring gently
12. Place small amounts of dough in the shape of balls on the baking sheet
13. Brush lightly with the egg & bake for 20 minutes

title: silky kiss
steps:
1. Combine the rum , orange-flavored liqueur and eggnog in a cocktail shaker filled with ice
2. Strain into a champagne flute and add the champagne
3. Garnish with a cinnamon stick

title: tomato and basil sauce   salsa di pomodoro e basilico
steps:
1. If using fresh tomatoes , core them , cut them into coarse chunks , and puree them in a food processor , blender , or food mill until smooth
2. Strain the flesh of canned tomatoes through a fine sieve , to remove skins and seeds
3. Set aside
4. Heat the olive oil in a large pot , and cook the onion over a medium heat , stirring , until soft
5. Add the garlic and cook , stirring occasionally , until it becomes soft
6. Do not let the garlic brown , or an acid taste will be imparted in the sauce
7. Add the remaining ingredients , reduce the heat to low , and simmer until thickened , about 15 minutes

title: cajun corn and crab bisque
steps:
1. Melt the butter in a small saucepan over medium heat
2. Then gradually whisk in the flour
3. Cook 5 to 7 minutes , whisking constantly , until a golden roux forms
4. Set aside
5. Heat the oil in a dutch oven over medium heat
6. Combine the onion , garlic , and celery and cook 1 minute
7. Add the cajun seasoning to taste
8. Stir in the broth , corn , and bay leaf
9. Bring to a simmer , then pour in the milk , cream , and liquid crab boil
10. When the mixture begins to simmer , reduce heat to low and simmer 7 minutes
11. Stir in the roux , 1 tablespoon at a time , blending thoroughly
12. Continue to cook , on low heat , whisking until mixture thickens
13. Stir in crabmeat , green onions , and worcestershire sauce
14. Simmer 6 to 8 minutes more
15. Season with salt and pepper to taste

title: stir fry chicken with garlic sauce
steps:
1. Combine garlic , soy sauce , water , honey , 1 tablespoon oil , cornstarch and black / red pepper
2. Stir chicken into marinade and mix to coat
3. Cover and refrigerate at least 2 hours , stirring once to twice
4. In large skillet , heat remaining oil
5. Using slotted spoon , transfer chicken to skillet
6. Stir-fry about 5 minutes
7. Add reserved marinade
8. Continue to cook and stir about 30 seconds until thickened
9. Remove to platter
10. Garnish with green onion
11. Serve with snow peas , if desired

title: magic finger jello
steps:
1. Dissolve unflavoured gelatin in one cup of cold water
2. Set aside
3. In saucepan bring one cup of water to a boil and add jello
4. Bring back to a boil and then remove from heat
5. Add gelatin mixture to hot jello mixture
6. Stir and add 1 / 2 cup cold water
7. Pour into a greased pan , cover with plastic wrap , and set aside in fridge until solid
8. Cut into squares or use cookie cutters to make interesting shapes
9. Store in an airtight container in the fridge
10. In our family we make green and red jello fingers at christmas , at valentine's day red heart-shaped ones , st
11. Patrick's day green clovers , halloween orange circles - it's fun for the kids and the mom and dad !

title: asparagus chicken
steps:
1. Slice chicken in thin strips
2. Heat 4 tbsp of oil in large pan
3. Stir in chicken and saute until chicken is thoroughly cooked and no longer pink
4. Remove and keep warm
5. Split asparagus lengthwise , then cut into 1 1 / 2 inch lengths
6. Heat remaining 2 tbsp vegetable oil in same pan
7. Stir in asparagus and onions
8. Saute 2 minutes
9. Stir in chicken , mushrooms & liquid , chicken broth , ginger , salt , sugar , and garlic powder , cover
10. Simmer 3 minutes
11. Mix cornstarch , sherry and soy sauce until smooth in cup , stir into mixture in pan
12. Cook , stirring constantly until mixture thickens and boils 3 minutes
13. Serve over rice

title: hawaii island energy bars
steps:
1. Toasts oats and sesame seed in skillet , stirring occasionally , for 3 minutes or until lightly browned
2. Melt marshmallows , peanut butter , and margarine over medium flame , stirring constantly
3. Add oats , sesame seed , and remaining ingredients
4. Mix well
5. Press into a 9x13-inch pan
6. Cool and cut into bars

title: easy sausage mushroom risotto
steps:
1. In saucepan , heat water to boiling
2. Add salt and butter , then pinch off bite size pieces of sausage and drop into water
3. Add rice and soup
4. Stir for one minute
5. Turn heat down to low , cover , and simmer for 18-20 minutes
6. Stir occasionally
7. When finished cooking , allow to cool for five minutes then serve

title: fresh peaches in sauternes soak with angelica and lavender
steps:
1. Arrange the peach slices into the bottom of a large serving dish
2. Sprinkle over the lavender heads and then add the angelica leaves
3. Pour over enough dessert wine to cover the peaches
4. Turn the peach slices over a couple of times to coat them in the liquid , then cover the dish and chill the mixture in the fridge for at least four hours , or preferably overnight
5. To serve , spoon a portion of peaches in sauternes into each of six serving bowls
6. Serve with a dollop of crme frache

title: barbecued garlic shrimp
steps:
1. Melt butter in heavy large skillet over medium-low heat
2. Add 12 chopped green onions and garlic and saute 3 minutes
3. Add white wine and simmer 15 minutes , stirring occasionally
4. Mix in fresh lemon juice
5. Season to taste with pepper
6. Transfer to large bowl and let cool
7. Cut shrimp down back through shell
8. Do not peel
9. Remove veins
10. Add shrimp and 1 cup parsley to garlic mixture and toss well
11. Cover and chill 6 hours , turning occasionally
12. Prepare barbecue
13. Remove shrimp from marinade
14. Thread 2 shrimp on each skewer
15. Transfer marinade to heavy medium saucepan
16. Simmer over medium heat until thick , stirring occasionally , about 12 minutes
17. Strain through a sieve , set over a bowl , pressing on solids
18. Season marinade with pepper sauce and salt
19. Spoon into 8 small ramekins
20. Sprinkle with minced onion and 3 tbsp parsley
21. Place 1 ramekin on each plate
22. Place shrimp on grill and cook until just pink and cooked through , turning once , about 3 minutes
23. Divide shrimp among plates
24. Garnish with lemon wedges and serve

title: cold pasta salad
steps:
1. Cook noodles per directions and rinse in cold water
2. Dice the peppers , onion , and carrots
3. Drain the tomatoes , and add all the vegetables to the pasta
4. Pour dressing over top , and refrigerate until ready to serve

title: quick  easy oatmeal bars with chocolate topping
steps:
1. Combine butter , brown sugar , and vanilla and beat until creamy
2. Beat in the eggs
3. Add the flour and oatmeal
4. Spread in a greased 9x13 pan
5. Bake at 350f for 20 minutes
6. Cool slightly
7. Combine chocolate chips and shortening and melt in a double boiler or carefully in a saucepan
8. Spread over baked mixture
9. Sprinkle with chopped nuts

title: mini chicken satay patties
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a large mixing bowl
2. Mix well with hands
3. Heat some peanut oil in a non-stick frying pan and fry spoonfuls of mixture , flattened out into patty shapes , until golden and cooked through
4. Serve as an appetizer with a bought satay sauce

title: roasted jumbo shrimp with potatoes  lemon and capers
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 450f
2. Wash the shrimp and pat them dry with paper towels
3. In a medium bowl , combine shrimp , 1 tablespoon olive oil , garlic , lemon zest , lemon juice , 1 / 2 teaspoon salt , and 1 / 2 teaspoon pepper
4. Toss together and refrigerate
5. Rub a 9-inch baking dish with olive oil
6. Place the potato slices , slightly overlapping , in the pan
7. Drizzle them with the remaining 2 tablespoons olive oil , 1 / 2 teaspoon salt , and 1 / 2 teaspoon pepper
8. Roast the potatoes in the oven for about 15 minutes , until golden and just tender
9. Remove potatoes from the oven , top with the shrimp and the marinade , and return to the oven
10. Cook an additional 10 minutes , until the shrimp is opaque and slightly roasted looking
11. Remove from the oven and sprinkle with the capers
12. Serve at once with a green salad

title: creamsicle cubes
steps:
1. Fill ice cube tray cubes half full with yogurt
2. Top off with orange juice
3. Freeze 3 hours to overnight

title: nut  n  honey smoothie
steps:
1. Using a blender , mix the almonds , milk , peanut butter and honey on high speed until smooth , about 1 minute
2. Add the ice cubes and blend until slushy , about 15 seconds
3. Enjoy !

title: southern long island iced tea
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a pitcher
2. Serve over additional crushed ice

title: stove top tuna noodle with orzo  reduced fat
steps:
1. Cook orzo according to packet directions
2. Mine says to cook for 15 minutes
3. Meanwhile heat a large skillet and either spray with cooking spray or add a bit of oil
4. Saute onions and mushrooms for about 2 minutes just until the onions start to soften
5. Stir in the corn and cook for another minute or so just to warm through
6. Add the tuna , peas and carrot ribbons
7. Add the can of soup to the pan and stir so that all the vegetables are coated
8. Add milk and stir until the sauce thickens up slightly
9. Add in the garlic powder , parsley and ground pepper
10. By now the orzo should be finished cooking
11. Drain it well and stir into the pan containing the vegetables and soup mix
12. Stir really well so that the orzo and is well blended with the mixture
13. Add cubes of cheese and stir until the cheese has melted and evenly distributed itself amongst the dish
14. Serve

title: lemon breaded fried chicken
steps:
1. Place chicken and lemon juice into a zip-lock bag
2. Refrigerate for 2 hours turning pieces occasionally
3. Remove chicken from bag and pat dry with paper towels
4. In a medium mixing bowl , blend together salt and flour
5. Place each chicken breast into flour and shake off excess
6. In another bowl , lightly beat egg
7. After chicken is dipped into flour dip it then into the beaten egg
8. In a skillet , brown chicken breasts in oil
9. The oil should be 1 / 4 inch at all times during frying
10. If you can't fry all the chicken at the same time , place cooked chicken on a warm platter in an oven preheated to 200f
11. Cover cooked chicken with aluminum foil
12. Place cut lemon wedges on platter with chicken before serving

title: french toast topping
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients thoroughly with blender until it reaches a smooth , firm texture
2. Add a generous amount to the french toast
3. If desired , sandwich topping between two slices of french toast and pour syrup over the top

title: smothered minute steak  atkins
steps:
1. Season steaks with 1 / 4 teaspoon of the salt and 1 / 8 teaspoon of the pepper
2. Heat 1 tablespoon of the butter and 1 tablespoon of the oil in large nonstick skillet over high heat
3. Add half of the steaks and sear until just cooked through , about 3 minutes per side
4. Transfer to plate and keep warm
5. Repeat with remaining steaks
6. Heat remaining 2 tablespoons butter and 2 tablespoons oil in skillet over high heat
7. Add mushrooms and onion
8. Saut until golden , about 8 minutes
9. Add broth , any accumulated juices from the steaks , lemon juice , paprika , remaining 1 / 2 teaspoon salt and remaining 1 / 8 teaspoon pepper
10. Cook until sauce thickens slightly , about 3 minutes
11. Pour over steaks , sprinkle with parsley and serve hot

title: kittencal s fried parmesan zucchini sticks
steps:
1. In a shallow bowl whisk the eggs with water
2. In another shallow dish combine dry bread crumbs , flour , parmesan cheese , italian seasoning , dried parsley , seasoned salt , black pepper , garlic powder and cayenne pepper
3. Dip the zucchini sticks in egg / water mixture then coat into the breadcrumb mixture
4. Heat oil in a skillet until hot
5. Fry zucchini in hot oil until golden brown and crispy , turning occasionally
6. Transfer to a paper towel-lined plate
7. Serve immediately

title: frozen watermelon margaritas for a crowd
steps:
1. Place the seeded watermelon cubes in a sealable plastic bag and freeze for a minimum of 8 hours
2. You can do this days ahead if you are planning a party
3. Before starting to make the beverage itself , cut one of your limes into 8 wedges for garnish
4. Cut the second lime in quarters and use it to moisten the rim of of your serving glasses
5. Place the sugar in a shallow bowl or small plate
6. One by one , wipe the rim of each glass with the quartered lime , then dip in the sugar until you have a nice rim
7. Place half of the frozen watermelon , along with half the limeade and tequilla in a blender
8. Blend until the beverage is mixed and there are no fruit bits but it is still frosty and slushy
9. Pour into prepared glass and serve with a lime wedge for garnish
10. Repeat with second half of ingredients

title: easy coleslaw with a kick
steps:
1. Mix everything but the coleslaw together
2. Pay special attention to be sure the wasabi is well blended
3. A trick i learned that works very well , is to put all the ingredients but the coleslaw mix into a big ziploc bag , then squish , shake , and massage the ingredients into a nice smooth blend
4. Then add the coleslaw mix and the ingredients together in a large bowl and mix well
5. Cover and put it in the fridge for a couple hours to overnight to allow all the flavors to blend inches it will be soupy on the bottom , but the salad will be crisp

title: banana nut bundt cake
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine the flour , sugar , baking soda and cinnamon
2. In another bowl , combine the eggs , oil , bananas , pineapple and vanilla
3. Stir into dry ingredients just until combined
4. Fold in coconut and nuts
5. Pour into a greased 10-inch fluted tube pan
6. Bake at 350 for 60-70 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean
7. Cool for 10 minutes before removing cake from pan to a wire rack to cool completely

title: lingonberry bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Spray a 9x9 baking pan or line with parchment
3. Combine all ingredients together , except for lingonberry preserves
4. Mix on low speed until crumbly
5. Set aside one cup of crumb mixture
6. Press remaining crumb mixture onto bottom of prepared pan
7. Spread the preserves evenly
8. Crumble rest of mixture over the preserves
9. Bake approximately 45 minutes or until lightly browned
10. Cool and cut into desired servings

title: asian tossed salad with wonton strips
steps:
1. In a large salad bowl , combine the romaine , tomatoes , pineapple and onion
2. Set aside
3. In a large skillet , heat vegetable oil to 375
4. Fry wonton strips , in batches , for 10-20 seconds or until lightly browned
5. Drain on paper towels
6. Sprinkle over salad
7. In a blender , combine the vinegar , mustard , lemon juice , salt and pepper
8. While processing , gradually add olive oil in a steady stream
9. Transfer to a pitcher or bowl
10. Serve with salad

title: mixed berry coulis
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan , combine all but the lemon juice
2. Bring just to simmer and cook until berries are warm and sugar is dissolved
3. Transfer to a blender and puree until smooth
4. Strain through a fine sieve
5. Press as much through as possible , leaving only the seeds behind
6. Stir in the lemon juice and adjust sweetness if desired with additional sugar
7. Can be refrigerated for up to 4 days in an airtight container

title: brown and wild rice with asparagus
steps:
1. Put the brown and wild rices , water , salt , and crushed almonds into the rice cooker
2. Cook until the cooker turns from cook to warm
3. Add the asparagus on top of the rice , pour in the vegetable broth , cover and re-set to "cook
4. "
5. Cook until the asparagus is tender but not overcooked
6. Remove from rice cooker and toss gently with lemon juice
7. Garnish with more almonds

title: ceviche lettuce wraps
steps:
1. Combine shrimp , radish , red pepper , red and green onions in a bowl
2. Squeeze fresh lime juice over top and stir
3. Cover and let marinate in refrigerator for 2 hours
4. Stir in cilantro , and chili paste
5. Just before serving , core and peel avocado
6. Cut into six slices , lengthwise
7. For each serving , take one lettuce leaf , place an avocado slice inside , some chopped tomato , a few green peas if using , and then heap with a couple of spoonfuls of ceviche
8. Season with salt and pepper , if desired

title: easy marinara sauce
steps:
1. Add olive oil to hot sauce pan
2. Add garlic and cook for a minute
3. Add tomatoes , sugar , oregano , and basil
4. If desired , add meatballs
5. Bring sauce to a boil
6. Cover and simmer the sauce for 10-20 minutes or until desired thickness
7. Serve with desired pasta

title: peanut butter s mores
steps:
1. Spread the bottoms of four cookies with fudge topping
2. Using a long-handled fork , grill marshmallows 6 inches from medium-hot heat until golden brown , turning occasionally
3. Carefully place a marshmallow and a peanut butter cup on each fudge-topped cookie
4. Top with remaining cookies
5. Serve immediately

title: carrot salad in sweet sour dressing
steps:
1. Slice the carrots into thin slivers , either by hand or in food processor
2. Heat , in small saucepan , lemon juice and sugar until sugar is dissolved
3. Take off the heat and add oil , garlic , ginger , chili pepper and chives
4. Mix and season with salt
5. Pour dressing over carrots
6. Mix
7. Let salad marinate in refridgerator for at least one hour before serving

title: heavenly rhubarb cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Coat a 13 x 9 inch pan with non-stick cooking spray
3. In a small bowl , combine 2 tbsp sugar and 1 / 2 tsp cinnamon
4. Set aside
5. In a large bowl , combine remaining 1 1 / 3 cup sugar , oil , applesauce , egg substitute , and sour milk
6. In separate bowl , combine baking soda and flour
7. Stir flour mixture into wet ingredients
8. Stir in rhubarb
9. Pour into prepared pan
10. Sprinkle top of cake with walnuts and cinnamon / sugar mixture
11. Bake in preheated oven for 40 minutes , or until top of cake springs back lightly when touched
12. Add enough milk to equal one cup
13. Let mixture sit several minutes to allow milk to curdle
14. Buttermilk may be used in place of sour milk

title: paula deen s chicken georgia
steps:
1. Melt butter over medium heat
2. Add mushrooms and shallots and sprinkle with salt and pepper
3. Cook 10 minutes
4. Add chicken and cook 10 minutes on each side or until tender
5. Transfer chicken to platter and sprinkle with grated cheese
6. Top with mushroom mixture
7. Cook and let stand 5 minutes or until cheese melts

title: creme brulee gelato
steps:
1. To make the gelato custard: in a medium-size bowl , stir together the sugar , egg yolks , vanilla and corn syrup to blend thoroughly
2. In a heavy , medium-size saucepan , bring the half-and-half just to a simmer
3. Gradually pour the warm half-and-half into the yolk mixture , stirring constantly
4. Return the blended mixture to the saucepan
5. Using a wooden or rubber spatula , stir the mixture over medium-low heat until custard thickens and leaves path on back of spatula when finger is drawn across , about 10 minutes
6. Strain the custard through fine-mesh sieve into a bowl
7. Cool in ice bath , then cover and refrigerate until cold
8. Process the cold custard in an ice cream maker according to manufacturer's instructions
9. To make the brulee crunch: line a baking sheet with foil and generously butter the foil
10. Or use the reynold's"release" foil , or use a silpat sheet or other silicone coated baking mat
11. In a heavy , medium-size saucepan , over medium-low heat , stir together the sugar and water until the sugar dissolves
12. Increase the heat and boil the mixture without stirring until it becomes amber colored , brushing down the sides of pan with a wet pastry brush to remove sugar crystals and swirling the pan occasionally to cook evenly
13. Remove the pan from the heat
14. Stir in the baking soda and immediately transfer the caramel mixture to the buttered baking sheet
15. Allow the caramel to cool completely , and break it into small pieces to make the brulee crunch
16. Swirl 3 / 4 of the crunch into the gelato , then freeze gelato until firm
17. Sprinkle servings with remaining crunch before serving

title: my famous rosemary garlic chicken and potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Line a large baking pan with foil
3. In a bowl mix together the olive oil , rosemary , garlic , salt and pepper
4. Rub about 1 / 3 of this mixture all of the chicken and work some of it under the skin
5. Mix the potatoes and the rest of the herb mixture together and scatter over the baking pan
6. Lay the chicken on top of the potatoes
7. Some will be under the chicken and some will not
8. Place in the oven for about 1 hour or until the chicken is done
9. Check the potatoes and move them around from time to time
10. Cook until the juices from the chicken run clear and the potatoes are soft
11. Remove chicken to cutting board to rest for at least 10 minutes
12. Return potatoes to oven while chicken is resting
13. You might even turn the oven up to 400 degrees for a few minutes if you want the skin of the chicken crisper

title: cheese and hot dog burritos
steps:
1. Heat wieners as directed on package
2. Heat tortillas
3. Place 1 hot wiener on lower third of each tortilla
4. Sprinkle each wiener with 1 / 4 cup of the cheese , and about 1 tbs ketchup or taco sauce
5. Fold in sides and roll up

title: easy peachy oat crisp
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Lightly grease a 9x9 baking dish
3. Blanch peaches by dropping into boiling water for 45 seconds then plunging into ice water
4. Remove the peel and slice peaches
5. You want enough peaches to fill a 9x9 pan about halfway to the top
6. Mix rest of ingredients
7. Sprinkle evenly over the peaches
8. Bake uncovered for 30-45 minutes or until topping is golden , and peaches are bubbling slightly
9. Serve warm with vanilla ice cream

title: my mom s famous white rice
steps:
1. Pour water and white rice in a rice cooker
2. Add butter and olive oil
3. Slice the garlic clove in half and add both halves
4. Slice a small onion in half and add the onion half to the rice cooker
5. Add salt
6. Cook in covered rice cooker

title: sweet potato  queen  cornbread
steps:
1. Mom's is the ultimate example of a life well-lived
2. I am in total awe of her
3. She's smart , accomplished , beautiful-inside and out-loving , courageous , and bubbling over with the sheer joy of living
4. It's been an easy fifty years for dad , clearly
5. To further endear her to me personally , she and her friends turn out some excellent eats ! mom herself makes this sweet potato cornbread that is worth driving all the way to mountain pine , arkansas , for , but you won't have to-here's how you do it
6. Mix together this dry stuff: 1 cup all-purpose flour , 1 cup yellow cornmeal , 4 teaspoons baking powder , 1 teaspoon salt , and 1 / 2 cup sugar
7. Separetely , mix together this wet stuff: 3 sweet potatoes , cooked and mashed , 2 eggs , 6 tablespoons milk , and 3 tablespoons oil
8. Then mix the dry stuff and the wet stuff , just until it's all moist , then put it in greased muffin tins and bake at 425 until done-usually about 15 to 20 minutes

title: almond orange tossed salad
steps:
1. In a small skillet over medium-low heat , cook sugar , without stirring , for 12-14 minutes or until melted
2. Add almonds
3. Stir quickly to coat
4. Remove from the heat
5. Pour onto waxed paper to cool
6. In a large serving bowl , combine the iceberg lettuce , romaine , oranges , avocado , celery , onions and almonds
7. In a jar with a tight fitting lid , combine the dressing ingredients
8. Shake well
9. Drizzle over salad
10. Toss gently to coat
11. Yield: 8 servings
12. Taste of home

title: zhajiang mian   minced pork tossed noodles
steps:
1. Make the brown bean sauce by combining the ingredients and mixing them well
2. Heat a wok over a high heat and once it is hot , add the oil and the white part of the onions and the garlic
3. Stir-fry for 20 seconds , add the pork and cook it until it turns white and begins to separate
4. Add the brown sauce
5. Reduce the heat to medium and simmer for 5-10 minutes
6. Add another cup of stock if you prefer a thinner consistency
7. Season , to taste , with sea salt , freshly ground black pepper and sugar
8. Meanwhile , cook the noodles in boiling water for 3-4 minutes
9. Drain , rinse off excess starch , if necessary , and add the noodles to the wok with the remaining green onion and toss the noodles and green onion through the mince mixture
10. Serve topped with the cucumber
11. To prevent them sticking together after cooking , add a splash of oil and toss through
12. This is particularly useful if you are cooking them ahead of time

title: rainbow veggie pizza
steps:
1. Slice all the vegetables into small , bite-sized pieces
2. Thaw out , then roll out the pizza dough on a pizza pan
3. Spread olive oil on top
4. Spread pizza sauce
5. Sprinkle mozzarella cheese
6. Place all the vegeatables on top
7. If you want a rainbow effect then start in the middle and make concentric circles with each color
8. Drizzle olive oil on top
9. Bake at 400f for 20-25mins
10. Slice and serve

title: jif banana bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Grease 9 x 5 x 3-inch loaf pan
3. Combine flour , sugar , baking powder and salt in large bowl
4. Add banana , jif , milk , crisco oil and egg
5. Beat at medium speed of electric mixer , scraping sides and bottom of bowl
6. Mix just until blended
7. Bake at 350f for 60 to 65 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
8. Cool 10 minutes in pan
9. Remove to cooling rack
10. Makes one loaf
11. If using glass , reduce temperature to 325f

title: easy marble cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease and flour 9x12 baking dish
3. Mix all ingredients together in large bowl
4. Pour mixture into baking dish
5. For topping:
6. Blend all topping ingredients together in bowl
7. Sprinkle on cake , then swirl once with knife
8. Bake 45 minutes to 1 hour

title: apple nut cinnamon muffins with brown sugar cinnamon topping
steps:
1. Set oven to 400 degrees
2. Line 16 muffin tins with paper liners
3. In a large bowl , sift together flour , sugar , baking powder , 1 / 2 teaspoon cinnamon and salt
4. Cut in the butter with a pastry blender
5. Measure out 1 / 4 cup to add to topping ingredients
6. Set aside
7. Add in the chopped apples and nuts to the flour mixture
8. In a small bowl , whisk together egg and half and half cream , then add to the flour mixture
9. Stir just until combined , mixture will be lumpy
10. Spoon into muffin tins about 2 / 3 full
11. To the reserved 1 / 4 cup butter mixture add in 1 teaspoon cinnamon and 2 tablespoons brown sugar
12. Toss to combine
13. Sprinkle the topping mixture over each muffin
14. Bake for 15-20 minutes

title: marshmallows   alton brown
steps:
1. Place the gelatin into the bowl of a stand mixer along with 1 / 2 cup of the water
2. Have the whisk attachment standing by
3. In a small saucepan combine the remaining 1 / 2 cup water , granulated sugar , corn syrup and salt
4. Place over medium high heat , cover and allow to cook for 3 to 4 minutes
5. Uncover , clip a candy thermometer onto the side of the pan and continue to cook until the mixture reaches 240 degrees f , approximately 7 to 8 minutes
6. Once the mixture reaches this temperature , immediately remove from the heat
7. Turn the mixer on low speed and , while running , slowly pour the sugar syrup down the side of the bowl into the gelatin mixture
8. Once you have added all of the syrup , increase the speed to high
9. Continue to whip until the mixture becomes very thick and is lukewarm , approximately 12 to 15 minutes
10. Add the vanilla during the last minute of whipping
11. While the mixture is whipping prepare the pans as follows
12. Combine the confectioners' sugar and cornstarch in a small bowl
13. Lightly spray a 13 by 9-inch metal baking pan with nonstick cooking spray
14. Add the sugar and cornstarch mixture and move around to completely coat the bottom and sides of the pan
15. Return the remaining mixture to the bowl for later use
16. When ready , pour the mixture into the prepared pan , using a lightly oiled spatula for spreading evenly into the pan
17. Dust the top with enough of the remaining sugar and cornstarch mixture to lightly cover
18. Reserve the rest for later
19. Allow the marshmallows to sit uncovered for at least 4 hours and up to overnight
20. Turn the marshmallows out onto a cutting board and cut into 1-inch squares using a pizza wheel dusted with the confectioners' sugar mixture
21. Once cut , lightly dust all sides of each marshmallow with the remaining mixture , using additional if necessary
22. Store in an airtight container for up to 3 weeks

title: rhubarb streusel bread
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f
2. Grease and flour 8x4-inch loaf pan
3. Combine 1 cup sugar and 1 / 2 cup butter in large bowl
4. Beat at medium speed , scraping bowl often , until creamy
5. Reduce speed to low
6. Add orange juice and eggs
7. Continue beating just until mixed
8. Stir in flour , baking powder , baking soda and salt by hand just until moistened
9. Gently stir in rhubarb
10. Reserve 1 1 / 2 cups batter
11. Spread remaining batter into prepared pan
12. Combine all streusel ingredients in small bowl
13. Stir until mixture resembles coarse crumbs
14. Sprinkle half of streusel over batter in pan
15. Gently press into batter
16. Carefully spread reserved batter into pan
17. Top with remaining streusel
18. Press streusel into batter
19. Bake for 65 to 70 minutes or until toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
20. Cool 10 minutes
21. Remove from pan

title: grandpa s puttanesca sauce
steps:
1. Pit oil cured olives and cut green olives in half and place in a bowl along with capers
2. Make sure you drain the green olives and capers good before mixing these 3 ingredients together
3. Set aside
4. Put crushed tomatoes in sauce pan on low light
5. In a separate frying pan , start to fry garlic and anchovies with red pepper flakes
6. When the anchovies disintegrate , and they will very quickly , add mixture to tomatoes
7. Add olives and capers and simmer on low light until hot , about 15 minutes
8. Stir occasionally
9. Serve immediately over angel hair pasta

title: montreal steak
steps:
1. Combine olive oil , soy sauce and montreal steak seasoning in a glass dish or plastic bag
2. Add steak and cover dish or seal bag
3. Refrigerate 30 minutes or longer for extra flavor
4. Remove steak from marinade and discard marinade
5. Grill or broil to desired doneness

title: kids favorite zucchini muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Mix all ingredients
3. Spray muffin tins w / flour and oil spray
4. Bake for 30 min or until done

title: velvet mashed potato chocolate cake
steps:
1. Peel the potatoes , cover with water , and boil until tender
2. About 25 minutes
3. Mash thoroughly , do not add milk or seasonings
4. Measure out 1 cup , cover to keep warm , set aside
5. Preheat the oven to 300f
6. Sift together the flour , ginger , baking powder , baking soda , salt , cinnamon , cocoa
7. In a large mixer bowl , cream the butter and granulated sugar for 3 minutes
8. Add the egg yolks and beat 1 minute longer
9. Stir the vanilla into the buttermilk , then add the flour mixture to the creamed mixture alternating with the buttermilk , beginning and ending with the flour mixture
10. With the beater running , add the 1 cup of potatoes , raisins , and nuts , combine lightly , not over beating
11. Beat the egg whites until stiff peaks form , and by hand fold into the cake batter just until blended
12. Pour the batter into a greased and floured 10-inch tube pan and bake for 1 1 / 2 hours , or until the cake springs back when touched lightly with your finger
13. Cool completely in pan on wire rack while you prepare the frosting
14. To prepare the frosting:
15. In a large mixer bowl , cream the butter , orange rind , cinnamon , salt , and cocoa
16. Add the confectioners' sugar alternately with the lemon juice and milk until the mixture is creamy and smooth , beating well after each addition
17. Remove the cooled cake from the pan and spread the frosting on the top and sides of the cake
18. Cover tightly until ready to serve
19. Bring to room temperature before serving

title: bacon   egg fried rice
steps:
1. Scramble eggs until dry
2. Set aside
3. Rinse cooled rice with cold water and drain well
4. Cut bacon into 1 / 4 inch pieces across the strips
5. Pan fry until crisp
6. Drain off excess fat
7. Stir in onion , mushrooms , and eggs
8. When onions begin to turn color , add peas
9. Add rice and stir until hot
10. Add salt and soy sauce
11. Everything should be evenly mixed
12. Take from heat and stir in shrimp

title: peachy keen banana sherbet
steps:
1. Peel and slice your banana
2. Slice peaches and remove pits
3. Place all ingredients in your food processor and puree
4. Place in freezer overnight or for at least 3 hours
5. Allow to partially thaw just before serving so your sherbet has a thick , cold texture like ice cream
6. Top off each serving with a tablespoon of fresh blueberries and a teaspoon of crushed walnuts , if desired

title: texas roadhouse rolls and cinnamon butter
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Soften yeast in warm water with a teaspoon of sugar
3. Scald milk
4. Cool to lukewarm
5. Add yeast , sugar , honey , and enough flour to make medium batter
6. Beat thoroughly
7. Let stand until light and foamy
8. Add melted butter , eggs , and salt
9. Beat well
10. Add enough flour to form soft dough
11. Sprinkle small amount of flour on counter and let dough rest
12. Grease the surface of a clean bowl
13. Knead dough until smooth and satiny
14. Then put dough in greased bowl
15. Turn over to grease top
16. Cover , let rise in warm place until double in bulk , then punch down
17. Turn out on floured board
18. Divide into portions for shaping
19. Let rest 10 minutes
20. Shape dough into desired forms and place on greased baking sheets
21. Let rise until doubled
22. Bake for 10 minutes
23. Then reduce temperature to 350 degrees for 10 to 15 minutes more
24. Cool on rack
25. For cinnamon butter , blend all ingredients at room tempature

title: maple orange syrup
steps: 1. Heat all ingredients until warm

title: steak teriyaki
steps:
1. Salt the steaks lightly on both sides to season and extract juices
2. Heat 1 tablespoon of the oil in a medium skillet over medium heat
3. Saut the mushrooms and shallot for about 4 to 5 minutes , until the mushrooms and well-cooked
4. Set aside
5. Heat the remaining 2 tablespoons of oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat
6. Carefully place the steaks in the pan and brown on one side uncovered , about 3 to 4 minutes
7. Flip the steaks and brown on the other side for another 2 minutes
8. Reduce the heat to medium
9. Splash on the sake , cover the pan , and allow the steaks to cook for another 2 to 3 minutes for medium doneness
10. Transfer the steaks to a plate and set aside
11. Add the mirin and dark soy sauce to the meat juices and sake in the pan
12. Cook uncovered for another 1 to 2 minutes as the meat glaze thickens
13. Return the steaks to the pan to coat with the sauce , about 30 seconds more on each side
14. You can either serve the steaks whole or cut them against the grain into 1 / 2-inch slices
15. Spoon over with the rest of the teriyaki sauce , the mushrooms , and the shallots
16. Sprinkle the sesame seeds and scallions on top and serve

title: spiced french toast
steps:
1. Whisk eggs together with brown sugar and pumpkin pie spice until well blended
2. Coat each side of the bread slice with the mixture
3. Cook in a heated pan at medium heat or 325 degrees on electric skillet until both sides are crisp
4. Dust with powdered sugar and serve hot

title: apple custard bars
steps:
1. For crust:
2. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
3. Combine flour and salt
4. Cut in butter until crumbly
5. Press into bottom and up sides of a 13"x9"x2" cake pan
6. Put in apples
7. Combine 2 / 3 cup sugar with cinnamon
8. Sprinkle over apples
9. Bake for 20 minute
10. Remove from oven
11. For custard:
12. Whisk milk , eggs , and rest of sugar until smooth
13. Pour over apples
14. Bake 25-30 minutes longer or until knife in center comes out clean
15. If you're worried the crust will be too browned , whatever is showing up above the custard , just put foil all the way around the edges

title: lamb biriani
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients , except yogurt , cornstarch , salt and pepper , and rice , in slow cooker
2. Cover and cook on low 6-8 hours
3. Stir in combined yogurt and cornstarch , stirring 2-3 minutes
4. Season to taste with salt and pepper
5. Serve over rice

title: creamy zucchini soup
steps:
1. Roughly chop onion and zucchini
2. Cook onions in oil for 3-4 minutes over medium heat , then add zucchini and cook for another 1-2 minutes
3. Add enough broth to cover the vegetables and bring to a boil
4. Reduce to a simmer and cook , stirring occasionally , until the zucchini is soft
5. Remove from heat and puree the soup in batches
6. When pureed , return to pot and stir in cream
7. Add salt and pepper to taste

title: beef jerky ii
steps:
1. Remove fat from meat and place [meat] in freezer
2. When semi-frozen , it is easily cut into 3 / 8- or 1 / 4-inch strips
3. Combine everything in large bowl
4. Marinate meat 1 hour with sauce in refrigerator , then drain in colander
5. Place meat on cookie sheets to dry
6. For fastest drying do not overlap meat and turn at least once during drying
7. Dry in 145-degree oven [i use 155 degrees - tom] for 8 to 10 hours on cookie sheets
8. It is ready when it bends like a green willow without breaking
9. Refrigerate for long-term storage

title: rachael ray s bacon fried green beans
steps:
1. In a skillet , heat a drizzle of oil over medium-high heat , when hot add bacon and pepper and cook the bacon until crisp , 5 minutes
2. Add beans to bacon and cook about 3 to 5 , tossing
3. Season with vinegar and sugar prior to serving

title: missy s mexican style eggs
steps:
1. Heat oven to 250f wrap the tortillas in foil and place in oven
2. In a saucepan , over medium-low heat , heat the beans
3. In a large skillet , over medium heat , bring the enchilada sauce or salsa to a simmer
4. Break the eggs into skillet
5. For runny yolks , leave the tops of the eggs uncovered
6. For firm yolks , spoon some of the sauce over the top
7. Cover , reduce heat , and simmer for 5 to 7 minutes
8. Top each tortilla with some of the beans , eggs , sauce or salsa , cheddar , scallions , salt , and pepper

title: lemon pepper vinaigrette
steps:
1. Process first 5 ingredients in a blender
2. With blender running , add oil in a slow steady stream until smooth
3. Chill until ready to use

title: toad in the hole   traditional
steps:
1. Sift flour and salt into a bowl
2. Add beaten egg , along with some of the milk
3. Beat for a minute or two
4. Add remaining milk
5. Place the batter mixture into the refrigerator for an hour or so to get really cold
6. Preheat oven 420 degrees fahrenheit
7. Use a medium roasting dish and place oil in the pan
8. Heat in the oven until the oil is really hot
9. If you flick a spot or two of water in the oil and it really sizzles then it is hot enough
10. Quickly pour in all the batter and add the sausages , spaced a bit apart
11. Cook for 30 to 40 minutes
12. Lovely served with fresh vegetables of your choice and a gravy
13. I often freeze gravy to use with this type of dish

title: veggie calzones   5 ww points
steps:
1. Heat oven to 425 degrees
2. Spray cookie sheet with non-stick cooking spray
3. In bowl , combine mushrooms , zucchini , pepper and onions
4. Sprinkle with garlic salt and basil and mix well
5. Unroll dough and place on cookie sheet
6. Roll into a 14 inch square and cut into 4 pieces
7. Place 1 / 4 cup of cheese on each square and spread to within 1 / 2 inch of edge
8. Top each with 1 / 4 of vegetable mixture
9. Fold dough over in half and press edges with fork to seal
10. Brush each pastry with egg white
11. Cut 2 or 3 slits in top of each pastry to allow steam to escape
12. Bake at 425 degrees for 12-15 minutes or until golden brown

title: orange pink grapefruit smoothie
steps:
1. Cut the fruits to pieces removing all of the white stuff and the seeds
2. Chill the fruits in the freezer for a while for smoother consistency
3. Stick the fruits in the blender with the ice and as much honey as you like
4. Enjoy

title: peanut butter krispies
steps:
1. Bring corn and sugar to a boil , and remove from heat
2. Stir in peanut butter until smooth
3. Add rice krispies and stir to incorporate
4. Dump into a 9x13 pan and press down
5. Cut into squares , and enjoy !

title: paradise ham   pineapple dip
steps:
1. Mix cream cheese to smooth
2. Add sour cream & mix until no lumps remain
3. Fold in ham & drained pineapple
4. Mix well
5. Spread into pretty glass bowl or platter
6. Top with nuts
7. Chill for 2 hours
8. Serve on crackers

title: fresh garden salsa
steps:
1. Dice the zuccini and squash into uniform pieces
2. Transfer to a bowl and combine with the tomatoes , bell and poblano peppers , and onion
3. Mix in the oregano and lime juice
4. Season to taste with salt and black pepper
5. Let the salso sit 15 minutes before serving to allow flavors to meld

title: seitan marsala
steps:
1. In a hot skillet , saute the seitan in hot olive oil
2. When brown , gently flip it over with tongs
3. Add garlic to the side of the seitan and let it brown with the seitan in the oil
4. Add salt and pepper to taste
5. When the garlic has started to brown , cover the whole pan with the mushrooms
6. Remove from heat and add the marsala
7. Return to heat , add the stock and fresh herbs
8. When the mushrooms have cooked down , slowly stir in the slurry
9. Boil for about 30 seconds
10. Stir and serve

title: scooters quick hot artichoke dip
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f and lightly spritz a baking dish with cooking spray
2. Drain and finely chop artichoke hearts
3. Chop onion , garlic and jalapeno if not pre-minced / diced
4. Combine everything into bowl
5. Mix everything together with spoon and place in prepared baking dish
6. Place in oven for 20-25 minutes or until slightly brown on top
7. Serve with sliced veggies , triscuits or whatever you like
8. Enjoy !

title: curried chicken soup
steps:
1. Begin cooking rice as instructed on the bag
2. In a large saucepan , combine chicken stock , bay leaf , cream of coconut and pineapple juice
3. Bring to a boil
4. Thicken the broth with a roux made of the butter and flour
5. To do this , in a separate pan , melt the butter with the flour until it bubbles and is foamy , then add to the broth and stir to thicken
6. Keep the broth on a low simmer to continue thickening while you prepare the chicken
7. Preheat a stock pot with 1 / 4 cup olive oil
8. Add black pepper and chicken to the stock pot , cook until 3 / 4 done
9. Add onion to the chicken and cook until transparent
10. Mix together spices and add them to the chicken mixture
11. Stir , saute lightly and finish with the heavy cream
12. To combine the ingredients , add the stock to the chicken mixture
13. Add the celery and the cooked wild rice
14. Season to taste with salt and pepper
15. When serving , top with toasted coconut or other ingredients as you choose
16. Or - make this in the crock pot
17. To make it in the crock pot , put all ingredients except butter , flour , heavy cream and celery in the crock pot
18. Don't cook the rice or the chicken - just dice the chicken and put it inches i used frozen stock and frozen chicken
19. Doesn't matter
20. Cook on high for about 4 hours or low for longer - as long as the rice is cooked , it's done
21. Then add chopped celery
22. Make roux and add to thicken
23. Add cream or milk , and you're done
24. Garnish as usual

title: orange sherbet party punch
steps:
1. Heat 2 cups water to boiling
2. Add gelatin and sugar , stirring until dissolved
3. Add 2 cups cold water and fruit juices
4. Chill until ready to serve
5. Just before serving , spoon in sherbet and pour in ginger ale

title: ultimate chocolate cappuccino cookie cups  cookie mix
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375f
2. Line 36 miniature muffin cups with paper baking cups , or spray with cooking spray
3. In large bowl , dissolve coffee mix in water
4. Add cookie mix , oil and egg
5. Stir until soft dough forms
6. Shape dough into 36 balls
7. Place in muffin cups
8. Bake 8 to 9 minutes or until set
9. Immediately make indentation in center of each cookie with end of wooden spoon to form a cup
10. Cool 30 minutes
11. Remove from pan
12. In small bowl , stir frosting and liqueur until well blended
13. Gently stir in whipped topping
14. Spoon frosting mixture into decorating bag with star
15. Pipe frosting into each cookie cup
16. Top each with espresso bean
17. Store covered in refrigerator

title: cheesy english muffin appetizer
steps:
1. Mix the first six ingredients together
2. Spread mixture on halves of english muffins
3. Cut frosted halves into 4 wedges
4. Place on cookie sheet and bake in oven at 350 until top is bubbly , about 10 minutes
5. You can broil them , but then you will have to watch them carefully
6. These can be frozen uncooked- just put the topping on the english muffin and freeze in an airtight container

title: broccoli  cauliflower  and carrot salad
steps:
1. In a large bowl , whisk together the mayonnaise , sugar , rice wine vinegar , salt , and ginger
2. Add the broccoli , cauliflower and carrots
3. Toss to coat with dressing
4. Sprinkle evenly with nuts
5. Enjoy !

title: beef with green peppers
steps:
1. Dredge beef with cornstarch , sherry , 1 tbsp soy sauce and ginger
2. Heat
3. Oil and saute beef strips
4. When beef changes color , remove to a plate and in remaining oil saute bell peppers for 1 minute
5. Add salt
6. Combine beef , peppers , 1 tbsp soy sauce & sugar
7. Heat well
8. Serve on rice
9. Mrs r
10. W

title: fish burgers

title: strawberry oat mini muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Spray 24 miniature muffin cs
3. With nonstick cooking spray
4. Combine flour , oat bran , baking powder , baking soda and salt in a medium bowl
5. Whisk together buttermilk , apple juice concentrate , applesauce and vanilla in a small bowl

title: fried chicken
steps:
1. In a small bowl , mix egg beat and milk together and set aside
2. In a shallow dish or bowl , mix together the flour , salad dressing mix and soup mix
3. Dip chicken pieces in egg / milk mixture , then in flour mixture and roll until well-coated
4. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium high heat and fry chicken in skillet , turning often , for 25 to 35 minutes or until juices run clear

title: almond joy challah
steps:
1. I use a bread-maker , on dough setting only
2. Put all liquid ingredients in first , making sure all liquid is warm , not hot
3. Then add your brown sugar , sugar , coconut and then flour
4. Poke four holes in the flour and add your two teaspoons of yeast
5. Turn on the dough setting
6. It should run for an hour and thirty minutes
7. When dough is done , take out and cut in half
8. Then cut each half section into thirds , you should have 6 even pieces
9. Take a dough ball and squeeze it down into a rectangle
10. Insert desired amount of mini chocolate chips into center of the rectangle , then close it up and roll , as you would , lets say , roll a cigar ?
11. Then after you have 3 rolled doughs with the chips in the center , you can braid the three together as you would your hair ! this will give you two braided challah's
12. Let rise for an hour , sometimes an hour and fifteen minutes
13. After the bread has risen and before putting in the over , whisk an egg with water and powdered sugar - brush the wash over your bread and sprinkle with coconut flakes and crushed almonds
14. Bake at 350 for 12 minutes , then turn , and bake at 325 for another 12 -15 minutes
15. Depending on your oven , you may need to cover with aluminum foil so the bread does not get too dark
16. Enjoy ! :)

title: rice griddle cakes
steps:
1. Boil the rice and drain thoroughly
2. Sift the flour , salt and baking powder together
3. Rub the butter into the flour and add the rice
4. Beat the egg and add with enough milk to make a soft dough that will drop off a spoon
5. Drop a tablespoonful of the mixture at a time on to a hot greased griddle

title: soft batch chocolate chip cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Mix butter , sugar , brown sugar , vanilla and eggs together until creamy
3. Add the remaining ingredients and blend well
4. Bake until lightly browned
5. Store in an air tight container

title: beer marinated steaks
steps:
1. Combine the ingredients and pour over steaks
2. Marinate for at least , 2 hours or overnight in refrigerator , turning steaks occasionally
3. Remove the steaks from the marinade and reserve marinade
4. Bbq your meat over a medium heat for desired time , basting occasionally with the reserved marinade until cooked to your liking
5. Serve immdeiately

title: blueberry mojito
steps:
1. In a tall 16-ounce glass , muddle mint leaves , lime juice and sugar
2. Add 2 tablespoons of the blueberries and mash until juicy
3. Fill the glass three-quarters with ice
4. Add lemonade until the glass is two-thirds full
5. Add splash of soda , light rum and remaining blueberries
6. Stir
7. Slowly pour dark rum into the drink so it floats on top
8. Garnish with a sprig of mint and slice of lime
9. Serve immediately

title: kathy s cake mix cookies
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together
2. Spoon balls , about 1 t , onto cookie sheets
3. Bake at 350 for 10 minutes
4. Cool completely on cooling rack

title: super easy chicken pot pie
steps:
1. Lay the bottom crust in a deep-dish pie plate and press in lightly
2. Arrange the vegetables and chicken in the crust and cover with the condensed soup
3. Cover with the top crust and seal the edges
4. Cut a couple of vents in the top crust and bake as if for a two-crust pie until golden brown and bubbly
5. Put some foil or a cookie sheet underneath the pie plate to prevent this

title: oven baked bar b qued ribs
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450f
2. Cut ribs into serving size pieces
3. Place ribs in 9x13-inch pan and pour beer over top
4. Cover tightly and bake 1 hour 30 minutes
5. Remove ribs from oven and transfer to a platter
6. Drain grease and beer from pan
7. Place ribs back in pan and coat with sauce cover again tightly
8. Reduce oven temperature to 250f
9. Bake additional 45 minutes
10. After cooking at a high temperature you may think that you have burned up your ribs , but after baking again at low temp with the sauce you will see how tender and juicy they turn out to be !

title: traditional persian basmati rice with tadig
steps:
1. Bring a large pot of water to a boil
2. Add 3-4 tablespoons of salt to the water
3. Scoop out the desired amount of rice into a bowl
4. Pour water over it to rinse it and then pour the water off
5. Repeat this until the water runs clear
6. Add the rice to the boiling water
7. Boil rapidly for 5 minutes
8. Bring pot to the sink and turn the cold water on to make the starchy water overflow
9. Drain into a colander
10. Put the pot back onto the stove at medium to medium high heat and add oil
11. In a small bowl , melt butter with a pinch saffron in it
12. Sprinkle the rice with a spoon into a mound in the pan on the stove
13. Poke 3-4 holes into the top and pour the butter down the holes
14. Take a scoop of the rice from the mound and stir in the bowl used to melt the butter
15. Put the rice back into the pot
16. Place about 3 layers of paper towels to cover the top of the pan and then place the lid tightly over the pan
17. Cook at the medium-medium high heat for 8 minutes
18. Turn the stove down to the lowest temperature it will go and steam for 35 more minutes
19. To serve , scoop the rice out from the top of the pan being careful not to brake the crust on the bottom
20. Once all the rice is out except for the crust , take another plate , big enough to cover the opening of the pan and flip the crust out onto the pan
21. It should be golden brown and beautiful ! if it is black , the temperature of your stove was too high and the entire pot of rice may taste burnt
22. Once you get the hang of this you can try using sliced rounds of potato or pita bread on the bottom of the pan before you sprinkle in the boiled rice

title: super easy dark chocolate fudge
steps:
1. Over low heat , melt the chips in the sweetened condensed milk
2. Remove from the heat and stir in the nuts and vanilla
3. Spread evenly into an wax paper lined 8x8 pan
4. Chill and pop out of pan
5. Peel off wax paper and cut into 1-inch squares

title: scout s salsa chicken
steps:
1. Put chicken , jam , salsa , and seasoning in crockpot and cook on low for 5 hours
2. Put rice in crockpot and swirl and stir as best you can to mix the sauce and rice together around the chicken pieces
3. Cook for 30 more minutes
4. This amount of liquid made perfect rice

6. Of jam called for in the original recipe , and will bag and freeze everything together raw

title: yukon sourdough flapjacks  pancakes
steps:
1. To proof your starter , feed it with equal amounts of flour and water
2. Cover and let sit overnight
3. Next morning , measure 2 cups of the proofed starter into a mixing bowl
4. Add egg , oil , sugar , and salt to the starter and mix briefly
5. Add enough flour to attain the desired consistency and mix until lump-free
6. Just before cooking the pancakes , dissolve baking soda in 1 tbsp of warm water and gently blend into batter
7. Once baking soda is blended in , do not stir again
8. With a pitcher or ladle , pour 2 to 3-inch rounds on a hot griddle
9. Cook 2 to 4 minutes , until bubbles form on surface
10. Turn and cook for an additional 2 minutes
11. Serve hot
12. Proof , covered , for 1 hour at 85 degrees f , and then without stirring pour batter onto hot griddle--this will make pancakes extraordinary

title: garlic olive oil plate with capers
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 300f cut the garlic through the equator so that the
2. Pour the olive oil into a small roasting dish
3. Add the salt , pepper , thyme and capers to the oil
4. Nestle the garlic cut-side down in the dish and cover tightly with foil
5. Roast the garlic for 45-50 minutes , until the bottoms are well browned and the garlic is soft
6. Set aside to cool for at least 20 minutes
7. To serve: add the olives , if using , and turn the garlic cut side up
8. Dip your bread in the oil , and scoop out garlic cloves and spread on bread with capers , munch on olives , and enjoy

title: cranberry sauce  hot chutney
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a large saucepan
2. Bring to a boil
3. Reduce heat
4. Simmer , stirring occasionally , for 15-20 minutes , or until sauce thickens to a jam-like consistency
5. Chill until serving time
6. Keeps well in the fridge or freeze extra in small containers

title: individual sweet potato frittatas
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180c
2. Spray 10x 1 / 3 cup muffin holes with cooking spray
3. Steam or microwave the sweet potato until tender , and roughly mash with a fork
4. Whisk together the eggs , skim milk , nutmeg and cheese
5. Fold through the chives and mashed sweet potato
6. Season with salt and pepper
7. Divide the mixture among the muffin holes and bake for 15 mins or until set and golden
8. Leave to stand for 5 mins before removing form muffin pan

title: beef tenderloin steaks with red wine tarragon sauce
steps:
1. Combine first 6 ingredients , stirring with a whisk
2. Heat a nonstick skillet coated with cooking spray over medium-high heat
3. Add steaks
4. Cook 3 minutes on each side or until desired degree of doneness
5. Remove from pan
6. Keep warm
7. Add shallots to pan
8. Saut 1 minute
9. Add broth mixture
10. Bring to a boil
11. Cook until reduced to 1 / 4 cup
12. Serve sauce with the steaks
13. Sprinkle with parsley

title: crunch top apple pie  paula deen
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425f
2. Line a 9-inch pie pan with half of the dough
3. Toss apples with 1 tablespoon lemon juice in a medium-sized bowl
4. Combine sugar , flour , cinnamon and salt in a small bowl
5. Pour over apples and toss
6. Stir in applesauce
7. Spoon this mixture into pie pan and dot with butter
8. Cut remaining crust into strips
9. Using every other one arrange over top of pie
10. Lattice in remaining strips
11. For crunch topping , combine flour , sugar and salt in a bowl
12. Cut in butter with a fork until mixture is crumbly
13. Sprinkle over the top of crust
14. Bake for 10 minutes , then reduce heat to 350f and continue to bake for about 45 minutes , or until crust and topping are golden brown

title: super protein strawberry smoothie
steps:
1. Blend the berries , kool aid , soy protein powder , yogurt , splenda and soy milk
2. Blend in ice
3. Serve

title: smoky chipotle black beans
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan , heat the bacon grease or olive oil over medium heat until shimmering
2. Add the onion and garlic and saute until lightly browned
3. Add the cumin , bay leaf and chopped chipotle
4. Add the black beans to the saucepan along with just enough chicken stock to make the beans saucy
5. Stir to make sure everything is well combined and simmer over low heat for 20-25 minutes to allow the flavors to meld
6. Add more stock if the beans become too dry
7. Season the beans with salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste
8. Serve the beans warm , garnished with a few cilantro sprigs and a generous crumble of queso fresco or crema

title: creamy chocolate pie
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine the cocoa powder and oil , add the sugar and milk
2. Mix with a spoon until smooth
3. Add the cream cheese and beat with an electri mixer on medium speed until smooth , with a spoon , fold in the whipped topping until well blended
4. Pour into the pie crust , cover loosley , and freeze for at least 4 hours , or until firm
5. Finishingtouch:serve as is , or toss on some raspberries or a dallop of low fat whipped topping with a few sprinkles

title: white chocolate caramel slice
steps:
1. Preheat oven to moderate , 180c lightly grease an 18 x 28cm slice pan
2. Line base and sides with baking paper
3. In a large bowl , combine flour , sugar , coconut , oats and cocoa
4. Add butter , stirring until well combined
5. Press firmly into prepared pan
6. Bake for 10 minutes
7. Cool
8. Filling
9. Place condensed milk , golden syrup and butter in a medium saucepan
10. Stir over low heat until mixture is combined
11. Pour mixture over base
12. Bake for a further 10 minutes
13. Allow to cool
14. Topping
15. In a small saucepan , combine chocolate and copha
16. Stir over low heat until melted
17. Spread over filling
18. Chill for 1 hour until firm
19. Using a hot knife , cut into squares
20. Store in an airtight container

title: best molasses cookies 1961
steps:
1. Sift flour , sugar , soda , spices and salt together
2. Add the egg and molasses and melted shortening
3. Combine well
4. Add oats

title: sesame ginger chicken lettuce cups
steps:
1. Sprinkle chicken pieces with salt and pepper
2. Lightly coat a large skillet with nonstick cooking spray
3. Heat over medium-high heat
4. Add chicken
5. Cook and stir for about 3 minutes or until browned
6. Add 1 t
7. Of the dressing and the carrots to the skillet
8. Cook and stir for 2 to 3 minutes more or until the carrots are crisp-tender and chicken is no longer pink
9. Stir in red pepper
10. Stack lettuce leaves on plates
11. Top with chicken-carrot mixture
12. Sprinkle with chopped nuts
13. Serve with remaining dressing and lime wedges

title: easy diet turkey soup
steps:
1. Brown gound turkey in pan , place in pot after browning , add remaining ingredients and bring to boil
2. Enjoy ! ~

title: potatoes o brien breakfast
steps:
1. Fry the sausage , and add to the potatoes , the 5 beaten eggs , milk , cheese , and salt

3. Put in a greased 2-quart casserole dish
4. Bake at 350 degrees for 50 minutes

title: raw vegan chocolate fruit balls
steps:
1. Mix the coconut and cinnamon in a small bowl and set aside for rolling
2. Put all other ingredients in a food processor , and slowly add in the orange juice if it doesnt bind together completely
3. Roll into small balls and coat with the coconut mixture
4. Store in a sealed glass container in the fridge

title: carrot and celery cream  soup
steps:
1. Bring to boil chicken stock in a saucepan
2. Add carrots , celery , leaves , onion and parsley
3. Add salt and pepper
4. Season with bay leaf and cloves
5. Reduce heat and let simmer 20 to 30 minutes , until veggies are tender
6. Put in blender and reduce in puree
7. Put back in the saucepan and add the cream
8. Simmer 2 to 3 minutes , just to reheat

title: very creamy cheese dip for nachos
steps:
1. Empty ro-tel and cream of mushroom into a saucepan and mix together
2. Dice up velveeta and add to ro-tel and cream of mushroom mixture
3. Cook on low to medium heat stirring occasionally until cheese has melted
4. Do not let the cheese scald
5. Serve with tortilla chips and enjoy
6. We like to add jalapeos and sour cream on top of ours
7. It kinda gives it a spicy flavor

title: south seas shrimp and mango
steps:
1. Place shrimp in large resealable bag
2. Combine mustard , oil , juice , hot sauce and orange peel in small bowl
3. Pour over shrimp
4. Seal bag and place in refrigerator for 20 minutes
5. Alternately thread shrimp , mango , bell pepper and onions onto 4 , 10 inch skewers
6. Place skewers on oiled grid
7. Grill over high heat for 7 minutes or until the shrimp are opaque , turning and basting once with mustard mixture

title: kittencal s apple crisp dessert
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees f
2. Set oven rack to second-lowest position
3. Grease a 13 x 9-inch baking dish
4. Prepare two separate medium bowls
5. In each bowl place 1 cup oats , 3 / 4 cup brown sugar , 1 cup flour , 1-1 / 2 teaspoons cinnamon , 1 / 4 teaspoon baking powder and 1 / 4 teaspoon baking soda
6. Toss to combine
7. To each bowl mix in 1 / 2 cup plus 2 tablespoons melted butter
8. Mix well to combine then finish mixing using your hands until the mixture is crumbly
9. To one bowl only add in 1 / 2 cup nuts
10. Sprinkle the bowl without the nuts into the bottom of the baking dish
11. Pat down only slightly with hand
12. For the apple filling
13. In a bowl toss the apple slices with lemon juice
14. In a small bowl mix together 1 cup sugar , 2 tablespoons flour , 2 teaspoons cinnamon and nutmeg
15. Toss to combine
16. Add to the sliced apples then toss to combine
17. Place the apples over the crumb crust
18. Sprinkle the remaining topping over the apple mixture
19. Bake for about 40-45 minutes or until apples are fork-tender
20. Serve with vanilla ice cream

title: 5 spice carrots
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Peel carrots , and split lengthwise , and then cut in 1 / 2 diagonally , trying to keep them of equal length and thickness
3. Arrange carrots in baking dish and toss with 2 tablespoons vegetable oil
4. Sprinkle with 5-spice and salt
5. Mix throughly with hands
6. Arrange carrots equally in dish and bake for 30-40 minutes , tossing with tongs after 15-20 minutes

title: scrambled cabbage rolls
steps:
1. Saute the ground beef in the butter
2. Drain off any extra fat
3. Add onion and garlic
4. Saute

title: patriotic trifle
steps:
1. Cream together cream cheese and powdered sugar
2. Add sour cream , vanilla and cool whip
3. Mix pudding as directed and add to cheese mixture
4. In separate bowls add sugar to each type of fruit and let sit
5. You can also add a bit of orange juice to fruit mixture if fruit isn't very juicy
6. In a trifle dish , or clear glass bowl , put a tightly packed layer of angel food cake pieces
7. Drizzle a little orange juice over cake layer
8. Now alternate layers of berries , pudding / cheese mixture and cake til dish is full
9. Last layer should be pudding / cheese mixture
10. Garnish with fresh berries
11. Refrigerate at least 4 hours
12. This is really good made the day before too
13. This is a beautiful dessert and looks very difficult so get ready to enjoy all the compliments you'll receive when you bring this dish to your next event

title: tofu with eggplant  aubergine   and peppers
steps:
1. Place tofu cubes into a steamer and allow to steam for 20 to 30 minutes while chopping vegetables
2. Meanwhile , heat oil in a wok or large skillet until very hot
3. Transfer tofu to pan and saut until brown on all sides , then remove from pan and set aside
4. In same pan , saut onion for one minute
5. Add soy sauce and one tablespoon water if necessary
6. Add tomatoes , red peppers , hot peppers , eggplant , mushrooms , squash , scallions , and tomato paste and reduce heat
7. Simmer for about 10 minutes , or until vegetables are soft
8. Add tofu and continue cooking until tofu is heated through
9. Serve on platter , garnished with cilantro and rice or noodles
10. We recommend forbidden rice , though not exactly traditional , for its exotic nutty flavor and psychedelic color that beautifully compliments the eggplant and peppers

title: 15 minute chicken  broccoli  and rice dinner
steps:
1. Brown chicken in oil in large frying pan on medium heat for 5 minutes on each side
2. Remove from pan
3. Add soup and milk to pan
4. Bring to boil
5. Stir in rice and broccoli
6. Top with chicken and cover
7. Cook on low heat for 5 minutes

title: polynesian barbecued pork  crock pot
steps:
