2. Stir well
3. Add pork and stir to combine thoroughly
4. Cover and cook on low for 8-10 hours
5. Serve with the sauce for dunking

title: halibut with vegetable confetti
steps:
1. Lightly season the halibut fillets with salt and pepper
2. Heat olive oil in skillet and saute' halibut until golden on both sides and fish is opaque in center
3. Remove fillets from pan and set aside on heated serving plates
4. Add diced leek , red pepper , asparagus , celery and carrot to the pan and saute' on high heat about 30 seconds
5. Add wine and butter to the vegetable mixture and continue saute'ing while moving the pan back and forth to prevent scorching
6. Continue saute'ing until a sauce is formed , about 1 to 2 minutes
7. Spoon the sauce around the halibut on each plate
8. Garnish with a sprinkle of chipped chive

title: beef tater tot casserole
steps:
1. Dice onion
2. Brown hamburger meat and onion , add cajun salt , garlic powder , and black pepper to taste
3. Drain any grease
4. On the bottom of 9x13 pan , layer meat and onion mix
5. Layer tater tots on top of meat
6. Pour / spoon soup over tater tots
7. Top with cheese
8. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes

title: vegan fluffy buttercream frosting
steps:
1. Beat the shortening and margarine together until fluffy
2. Add the sugar and beat for 3 more minutes
3. Add the vanilla
4. Add the soy milk / creamer slowly
5. You should be left with a light fluffy frosting
6. You can also stir in a 1 / 2 cup of crushed cookies , or vegan chocolate cream filled sandwich cookies

title: grapevine salad
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients for the dressing in blender , except olive oil
2. Blend while streaming in olive oil
3. Pour dressing over salad and enjoy

title: cool whip cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Combine egg and coolwhip
3. Add cake mix and beat well
4. Roll into small balls
5. Roll balls in powder sugar
6. Place on baking sheet and criss cross cookies with fork
7. Bake for 11 to 13 minutes

title: rich low fat chocolate cake  kosher dairy
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 390 degrees f
2. Grease baking pan with a little bit of the margarine
3. Mix the rest of the margarine with sugar and 1 whole egg until mixture is unified
4. Gradually and alternately add: flour , cocoa , 1 whole egg , pudding , flour , cocoa , apple sauce , pudding -- and so on , until all mixes up nicely to a homogeneous mixture
5. Pure into greased baking pan and bake for about 30 minutes , or until cake is ready: dry and bouncy to touch
6. When the cake is ready i take it out of the oven and cover-seal it with aluminum foil until cools
7. This ensures the crust keeps moist
8. To decorate , i use chocolate syrup , usually hershey's - and spread it all over as if it was frosting

10. Enjoy !
11. You may substitute the dairy pudding with soy pudding to make this cake pareve

14. 2 grams proteins , 6
15. 6 grams fat , 21

title: sesame broccoli salad
steps:
1. Whisk soy sauce , vinegar , oil , and honey in a large bowl until blended
2. Season with salt and pepper
3. Steam broccoli florets until crisp-tender , about 5 minutes
4. Cool
5. Stir sesame seeds in heavy large skillet over medium heat until golden , about 5 minutes
6. Transfer to small bowl
7. Cool
8. Mix broccoli and half of sesame seeds into dressing
9. Let marinate at room temperature at least 30 minutes or up to 2 hours , tossing occasionally
10. Transfer broccoli to platter
11. Pour dressing over broccoli
12. Sprinkle with remaining sesame seeds

title: chessie s fruit dip
steps:
1. Whip everything together lightly
2. Chill
3. Enjoy

title: hot buttered yum chex mix
steps:
1. In large microwavable bowl , place cereals
2. In 2-cup microwavable measuring cup , microwave butter , brown sugar and honey uncovered on high 2 minutes , stirring after 1 minute , until mixture is bubbly
3. Stir in spices and rum flavoring
4. Pour over cereal mixture , stirring until coated
5. Microwave uncovered on high 3 minutes , stirring and scraping bowl after every minute
6. Cool slightly
7. About 5 minutes
8. Stir in marshmallows
9. Spread on waxed paper
10. Store in airtight container

title: any night of the week chicken  pasta  and broccoli
steps:
1. Heat cooking oil over medium high heat in large skillet with tall sides
2. On a plate combine breadcrumbs , garlic powder , italian seasonings , chili powder , and seasoning salt
3. Wash chicken breasts and dredge in breadcrumb / spice mixture until fully and evenly coated on both sides , adding more breadcrumbs if needed
4. Place chicken pieces in hot oil and cook on each side 6 minutes or until completely cooked through
5. Remove chicken from pan and set aside 15 minutes , then chop into bite sized pieces and set aside
6. Leave drippings in pan for further use
7. While chicken is cooking , boil enough water for 1 / 2 pound pasta and add 1 / 2 teaspoon salt to the boiling water
8. Add pasta and cook according to the number of minutes on the box
9. While the pasta and chicken are still cooking in a medium bowl mix 1 tablespoon olive oil , 1 / 2 teaspoon salt , and 1 / 8 teaspoon pepper
10. After pasta is al-dente , drain water then add pasta into the bowl with the olive oil , salt and pepper
11. Stir until all pasta is coated and set aside
12. In the skillet where the chicken cooked , turn it back onto medium high heat , and add 1 tablespoon olive oil
13. Add chopped onion to hot oil and saut 4 minutes , stirring often
14. Lift skillet away from heat and add white wine
15. Return to heat and add balsamic vinegar
16. Stir together and scrape breadcrumbs / drippings from skillet , as the wine will loosen everything up
17. Bring to medium high heat and add the cut broccoli
18. Pan fry for 5 minutes , turning once
19. In small cup combine 1 / 4 cup water , 1 / 4 teaspoon salt , and 1 / 8 teaspoon pepper until salt is dissolved
20. Add mixture to broccoli and bring to a quick boil
21. Turn down to simmer , cover 5 minutes to steam cook and leave broccoli tender crisp
22. Add to the skillet: cut up breaded chicken , and al-dente pasta with olive oil dressing , and toss to coat with pan fried balsamic broccoli
23. Add freshly grated parmesan cheese and toss everything together in skillet ! serve hot and serve immediately with a crusty bread and green salad

title: creamy chicken and mushrooms
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to package directions , omitting salt and fat
2. While pasta cooks , heat a large nonstick skillet coated with cooking spray over medium-high heat
3. Add chicken
4. Saute 4 minutes or until done
5. Remove from pan
6. Heat oil in pan over medium-high heat
7. Add chopped shallots
8. Saute 1 minute
9. Add mushrooms , saute 4 minutes
10. Add wine , cook 3 minutes or until liquid almost evaporates
11. Combine milk and flour in small bowl
12. Stir well with a whisk
13. Add milk mixture to pan
14. Cook 3 minutes or until slightly think
15. Add chicken , cheese , parsley , and pepper
16. Reduce heat and simmer 3 minutes , or until thoroughly heated
17. Server over pasta
18. Sprinkle with additional parsley , if desired

title: chocolate shortcakes with bananas and caramel
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. To prepare the shortcakes , combine flour , sugar , unsweetened cocoa , baking soda , baking powder , and salt in a large bowl , stirring with a whisk
3. Cut in 1 / 4 cup butter with a pastry blender or 2 knives until mixture resembles coarse meal
4. Add buttermilk
5. Stir just until moist
6. Knead lightly in bowl 5 to 6 times
7. Turn dough out onto a lightly floured surface
8. Pat dough into an 8-inch circle on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper
9. Cut dough into 8 wedges , cutting into , but not through , dough
10. Bake for 18 minutes or until just firm to the touch
11. Remove from pan
12. Cool on a wire rack
13. Place shortcake on a cutting board or work surface
14. Cut along score lines with a serrated knife to form 8 wedges
15. To prepare filling , combine 1 / 4 cup sugar and 2 tablespoons water in a small saucepan over medium-high heat
16. Stir gently just until sugar dissolves
17. Cook , without stirring , until pale golden , gently swirling pan if needed to cook sugar evenly
18. Remove from heat
19. Add cream and 1 teaspoon butter , stirring with a whisk until smooth
20. Cool 5 minutes
21. Place whipped topping and 1 / 8 teaspoon cocoa in a medium bowl
22. Fold just until combined
23. Split shortcakes in half horizontally using a serrated knife
24. Arrange about 1 / 4 cup bananas over bottom half of each shortcake
25. Top each serving with about 1 teaspoon caramel sauce , about 2 tablespoons whipped topping mixture , and top of shortcake
26. Drizzle 1 / 2 teaspoon caramel sauce over top of each shortcake

title: goldena yoiche  ashkenazic chicken soup
steps:
1. Put the chicken in a large pot and cover with cool water
2. Bring to a boil , reduce heat , and simmer for 30 minutes , occasionally skimming the foam off the top
3. Peel and slice the onions
4. Add the onions to the soup and simmer 30 minutes longer
5. Peel the parsnip and carrots
6. Trim the carrots , parsnips , and celery and cut each in half crosswise or as needed to fit your pot
7. Add the peppercorns , carrots , celery , parsnip , parsley , and bay leaf to the soup
8. Cover partway and keep simmering over low heat at least one hour longer
9. The chicken should be very tender , almost falling apart
10. Add salt and dill and simmer 10 minutes longer
11. Chop the cooked vegetables into spoon-sized pieces and return to soup
12. Remove the chicken from the soup , separate the chicken meat from the bones and skins , shred or cut the meat into spoon-sized bits , and return it to the soup
13. Serve hot with matzo balls , noodles , or kreplach
14. You may also save the meat for another use and serve the broth with just the vegetables and noodles or dumplings
15. It's nice to chill the soup briefly to solidify the fat , then remove the fat , before reheating to serve
16. You can save the fat to use in another recipe , for example in matzo balls

title: sherry vinaigrette
steps:
1. Pound the garlic with 1 / 4 teaspoons salt in a mortar and pestle until it breaks down into a puree
2. If you don't have a mortar and pestle , chop the garlic , then use the side of a large knife and press the garlic with the salt to make a paste
3. Combine the garlic , vinegar , and mustard in a small bowl , then whisk in the oil and seasoning with pepper
4. Taste and balance the flavors to taste
5. Enjoy !

title: spinach  cheese  and sausage stuffed shells oamc
steps:
1. Cook pasta shells according to directions
2. Drain , rinse , and let drain again
3. Saute onion in oil about 5 minutes
4. Add ground sausage and garlic
5. Cook until sausage is done
6. Cool
7. Beat egg slightly
8. Add ricotta cheese , mozzerella cheese , parmesan cheese , spinach , and cooled sausage mixture
9. Mix well
10. Stuff shells
11. Put 1 c of spagetti sauce in bottom of corningware
12. Add shells
13. Pour the rest of the sauce on top
14. Sprinkle with more mozzerella or parmesan cheese , if desired
15. Cook at 350 for 30 minutes , covered
16. Cook 10 minutes uncovered

title: slammin  southwestern salmon patties or salmon cakes
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together in bowl
2. Cover with plastic wrap and let sit , refrigerated for at least half-hour to allow flavors to blend
3. Heat non-stick skillet on med-hi , spray with olive oil spray
4. Form patties and cook in skillet for about 5 mins each side or until outside is crispy
5. The cheese helps the patties stay together and keeps everything moist
6. Yum !

title: drug store banana split
steps:
1. Split the peeled banana in half lengthwise and put in a banana split dish or individual dessert bowl
2. Place the ice cream scoops in a row between the banana halves
3. With a spoon , dribble the jam over the ice cream
4. Top with the chocolate sauce
5. Spoon the whipped cream all over
6. Sprinkle with the chopped nuts and top with a cherry

title: vegan spelt buns or rolls
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f grease a 9"x13" and set aside
2. Mix the 1 tbsp flaxseed meal with 3 tbsp water , let sit 15 minutes
3. It should absorb the water , resulting in a thick and goopy mixture
4. In your mixer bowl combine water , coconut oil , yeast and sugar
5. Mix and allow to rest for 15 minutes
6. Using your dough hook attachment , mix in the salt , flax mixture and flour
7. Knead with hook until dough is smooth and soft
8. You may add 2 tbsp more flour if it seems too sticky
9. Form dough into 12 equal sized balls and place into the greased 9"x13" pan and allow to rest for 10 minutes
10. Bake for 18 minutes or until tops are golden brown
11. Brush with melted vegan butter and sprinkle some poppy or sesame seeds on top

title: world class peanut butter cookies
steps:
1. Cream together peanut butter and sugar
2. Add egg and baking soda and mix thoroughly
3. Roll into 1 inch balls and drop onto cookie sheet
4. Using the back of a spoon flatten in a cross-hatch pattern
5. Bake at 375 degrees for 12- 15 minutes

title: shiner bock beer bread
steps:
1. The night before: pour beer into mug , cover with paper towel , and let sit out on counter overnight
2. Next day: dissolve yeast in warm water in mixing bowl
3. Mix in honey
4. Add both flours & salt , and stir to mix
5. Stir in oil and slowly add beer
6. Mix well
7. Place dough on floured work surface and knead 15 minutes
8. Place lightly oiled bowl & cover
9. Let rise to double in size
10. Punch down and let rest 5 minutes
11. Shape dough into four oval shaped loaves
12. Place loaves on lightly oiled cookie sheet
13. Score with a knife (i usually make 2 diagonally placed scored a couple of inches apart
14. Preheat oven to 350f
15. Cover loosely with saran wrap and allow to double in size again
16. Bake 30 minutes

title: apple sparkler  cocktail
steps:
1. Fill a martini shaker halfway with ice cubes
2. Add brandy and apple juice
3. Cover an shake vigorously until very cold
4. Strain into 2 champagne glasses
5. Add 2 tablespoons soda water into each glass and garnish with apple slices

title: baked spinach and eggs
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180c
2. Lightly spray 4 x 1 cup capacity oven proof dishes with oil
3. Place spinach and 1 tablespoon water in a medium saucepan over moderate heat and cook and stir for 3 minutes or until wilted and then drain and cool
4. Using hands , squeeze excess liquid from spinach and chop coarsely
5. Melt spread in a small saucepan over moderate heat and add flour and cook and stir for 1 minute or until bubbling and remove from heat and gradually stir in milk and increase heat to moderately high and cook stirring constantly until mix boils and thickens slightly and then remove from heat and stir in cheese and nutmeg until smooth
6. Whisk in 2 of the eggs until well combined and then add spinach and onion to cheese sauce
7. Pour mix into prepared dishes and using the back of a spoon make a slight indent at the centre of each dish and break an egg into each indent
8. Place ramekins on a baking tray and sprinkle with cayenne pepper and bake for 18 to 20 minutes or until eggs are just set and then stand for 5 minutes before serving with buttered toast

title: bacon green chili quiche
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Preback prepared pie crust 5 minutes or until golden brown
3. Sprinkle crumbled bacon , then chilies and green onion over crust
4. Combine cheeses and sprinkle over bacon , chilies and onions
5. Beat half and half and eggs in separate bowl
6. Salt and pepper to taste
7. Pour egg / half and half mixture into crust
8. Bake quiche until knife inserted into center comes out clean , about 45 minutes
9. Let quiche rest 5 minutes before cutting

title: grandma katies famous sausage rice
steps:
1. Use a food processor to finely chop the onion and celery
2. Brown sausage , celery and onions in a large skillet , drain off fat
3. Place in large casserole dish
4. Mix dry soup mix with the 9 cups of boiling water and cook for 5 minutes
5. Mix all ingredients together and bake covered at 325f for 1-2 hours

title: apples and walnuts with stilton cheese
steps:
1. Put one-third of the cheese in the bottom of a large bowl
2. Add the olive oil and , using a fork , mash together the cheese and oil
3. Add the vinegar and continue to mash and to mix
4. Add the cream and pepper and mix well to make a thick , chunky dressing
5. Add the apples , sliced celery , currants and lemon juice to the dressing and mix well
6. Crumble the remaining cheese and sprinkle it over the salad along with half the walnuts
7. Mix them into the salad gently and evenly
8. Transfer the salad to a serving bowl and garnish with the remaining walnuts and the celery leaves
9. Serve immediately

title: low fat chicken enchiladas with high fat taste
steps:
1. Make salsa if you are using home made
2. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
3. Combine cream cheese , sour cream , onions , cumin , cilantro , jalapeno and green chilis
4. Fold in cooked chicken
5. In a small baking dish layer the bottom with salsa
6. Warm the wraps in the microwave and layer 1 / 4 to 1 / 3 cup of chicken mixture on each , wrap and place seam side down in dish
7. Cover with more salsa and bake a half hour until heated through
8. Sprinkle with 2 tbs of cheddar cheese and place back in the oven until bubbling
9. Serve with extra salsa and sour cream if desired

title: dip sauce  for chicken or sausages
steps:
1. Melt butter in a sauce pan
2. Cook the onions until transparent
3. Add paprika , and then the sour cream , regular and light
4. Warm the sauce through , and taste with tomato pure , salt , pepper and the optional sugar

title: anticuchos  peruvian beef kebabs
steps:
1. To prepare the beef , combine first 7 ingredients in a large bowl
2. Toss well
3. Cover and chill 3 hours
4. To prepare fiery rub , combine 1 teaspoon paprika , 1 teaspoon salt , 1 / 2 teaspoon pepper , turmeric , and parsley
5. Prepare grill
6. Remove beef from bowl , discarding marinade
7. Thread beef onto each of 6 skewers
8. Press fiery rub onto beef
9. Place kebabs on grill rack coated with cooking spray
10. Grill 6 minutes or until desired degree of doneness , turning once

title: ultimate fudgy rocky road brownies
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f grease bottom only of 13 x 9 inch baking pan
2. Set aside
3. Melt 1 cup of butter and 4 oz
4. Unsweetened chocolate in 2 quart saucepan over low heat , stirring occasionally , until smooth
5. Remove from heat
6. Stir in sugar and vanilla
7. Add eggs , one at a time , mixing well after each addition
8. Add flour , baking powder and salt
9. Mix just until all ingredients are moistened and brownie mixture is smooth
10. Spread brownie mixture into prepared baking pan
11. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes or until brownies just begin to pull away from sides of pan
12. Meanwhile , combine 1 / 4 cup of butter , cream cheese , 1 oz
13. Chocolate and milk in 2 quart saucepan
14. Cook over medium heat , stirring occasionally , until melted
15. Remove from heat
16. Stir in powdered sugar and vanilla until smooth
17. Stir in marshmallows and peanuts
18. Immediately spread over hot brownies
19. Cool completely
20. Cut into bars
21. Store refrigerated

title: green bean and potato salad
steps:
1. Remove 'tails' from the green beans , cut them into 2 inch lengths , and simmer them until just soft
2. Peel the potatoes , cut in 2cm chunks , and boil gently until cooked but not falling to pieces
3. Allow the potatoes and beans to cool
4. Combine all ingredients in a bowl and chill for 2 hours

title: layered pumpkin cheesecake
steps:
1. Coat an 8x3-inch springform pan with nonstick spray
2. Place cookies in food processor
3. Pulse until finely chopped
4. Add melted butter
5. Process until crumbs begin to stick together
6. Press over bottom of prepared pan
7. Stir in 1 tub cheesecake filling in large bowl until smooth
8. Spread onto crumb layer
9. Stir remaining tub of cheesecake filling , pumpkin puree and pumpkin pie spice in same large bowl until blended and smooth
10. Evenly spread over plain cheesecake in pan
11. Cover and refrigerate at least 4 hours or until set
12. To serve , remove pan sides and place pecans around top edge of cake
13. Put caramel sauce into a small ziploc bag , snip a small
14. Plan ahead: make cheesecake 2 days ahead , then top with pecans and caramel sauce just before serving

title: baked potatoes with a  spicy filling
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400
2. Scrub the potatoes and pat dry
3. Prick all over with a fork , brush with oil if you are using it and season with salt and pepper
4. Place the potatoes on a cookie sheet and bake for 1 1 / 2 hours or until cooked through
5. Cool for 10 minutes
6. Meanwhile , mash the garbanzo beans with a fork or potato masher
7. Stir in the spices and half the chopped cilantro
8. Cover and set aside
9. Halve the cooked potatoes and scoop the flesh into bowl keeping the potato shells intact
10. Mash the flesh until smooth and gently mix into the garbanzo bean mixture with the yogurt
11. Season well with salt and pepper
12. Fill the potato shells with the potato / garbanzo bean mixture and place on a cookie sheet
13. Return the potatoes to the oven and bake for 10-15 minutes longer , until heated through
14. Serve sprinkled with the remaining chopped cilantro

title: the best sangria
steps:
1. Add sliced orange and lemon and sugar to large pitcher
2. Mash gently with wooden spoon until fruit releases some juice , but is not totally crushed , and sugar dissolves , about 1 minute
3. Stir in orange juice , triple sec , and wine
4. Refrigerate for at least 2 , and up to 8 , hours
5. Before serving , add 6 to 8 ice cubes and stir briskly to distribute settled fruit and pulp
6. Serve immediately

title: touchdown chocolate fantasy bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease 13 x 9 pan
3. In a large bowl , combine cake mix , oil , egg
4. Beat on medium speed until crumbly
5. Stir in nuts
6. Reserve 1 1 / 2 cups of crumb mixture
7. Firmly press remaining crumb mixture on bottom of prepared pan
8. In a small saucepan over medium heat , combine remaining ingredients
9. Cook and stir until chips melt
10. Pour evenly over prepared crust
11. Sprinkle reserved crumbs evenly over crust
12. Bake 25-30 minutes until edges are firm
13. Cool
14. Cut into bars
15. Store loosely covered at room temperature

title: boeuf bourguignon in slow time
steps:
1. Heat oil in large saucepan and brown beef a small quantity at a time
2. Spoon into slow cooker
3. Brown pearl onions
4. Set aside
5. Sprinkle flour in hot fat to make a roux
6. Season with pepper
7. Add garlic , bay leaves , thyme , herbes de provence
8. Add 1 / 2 cup wine to roux
9. Simmer to thicken
10. Pour in slow cooker
11. Add the remaining wine and just enough bouillon to barely cover the meat
12. Cover and cook in slow cooker on low for 6 hours
13. Add carrots and pearl onions
14. Continue cooking another hour and 1 / 2
15. Melt butter in saucepan and saut mushroom caps
16. Set aside
17. Just before serving , remove bay leaves
18. Add sauted mushroom caps and sprinkle with chopped parsley

title: spaghetti with cheesy tahini sauce
steps:
1. Mince garlic
2. Add tahini , garlic , lemon juice and water
3. Mix well
4. Cook pasta
5. Add tahini sauce to pasta and garnish with nutritional yeast

title: orzo with spinach  feta and olives
steps:
1. Cook orzo according to package direction
2. Add spinach for last minute of cooking
3. Drain and rinse with cold water to stop cooking
4. Place red onion , feta , olives , and pine nuts in a mixing bowl , add orzo and spinach
5. In a small bowl , whisk together the olive oil , vinegar , salt , pepper and cayenne , if using
6. Pour over orzo mixture and toss to combine
7. Taste and adjust seasoning
8. Serve at room temperature

title: orange raisin oatmeal bread
steps:
1. Plump raisins by pouring boiling water to cover
2. Let stand 10 minutes
3. Drain and pat dry with a paper towel
4. In a large bowl , combine flour , salt , baking powder , sugar , rolled oats and raisins
5. Beat oil , eggs , orange juice , rind and milk
6. Pour over dry ingredients
7. Stir just until moistened
8. You may need a little more orange juice or milk
9. Spoon batter into 2 greased loaf pans , spreading evenly to all corners
10. Bake 350f for 50-60 minutes or until done when tested with toothpick stuck in centre
11. Cool on a rack for 10 minutes before removing from pans

title: slow cooker winter beef stew
steps:
1. Lightly brown beef cubes
2. If you don't have time , you can skip this step
3. Place beef cubes in bottom of slow cooker
4. Place chopped onion and minced garlic cloves on top of beef
5. Layer the potatoes , carrots and cooked bacon
6. In a medium mixing bowl , combine the broth , apple juice , tomato paste , quick cooking tapioca , parsley , bay leaves , salt , thyme , and pepper
7. Pour over meat
8. Cover and cook on low for 8- 9 hours or on high 4-5
9. Until vegetables are tender
10. Remove bay leaf before serving
11. Enjoy !

title: bow ties with asian chicken
steps:
1. Stir the soy sauce , honey , lime juice , orange juice and mustard in a shallow dish
2. Add the chicken and toss until all of the pieces are coated
3. Refrigerate for 30 minutes or more
4. Cook chicken and marinade over medium heat until chicken is cooked
5. Remove from the heat and pour in the chicken broth , vegeatable broth or white wine
6. Prepare pasta until tender , but not soft
7. Drain and then return the pasta to the pot , add the chicken , the red peppers and the scallions , onion and baby corn
8. Simmer on low heat for 5 to 8 minutes , or until heated through
9. Toss the pasta once or twice and sprinkle with pepper
10. Serve and sprinkle with sesame seeds if you choose

title: chicken   broccoli bake supreme
steps:
1. Defrost frozen broccoli throughly
2. In a large skillet sautee chicken breasts and garlic& mushrooms in chicken broth and white wine about 4 minutes each side or until no longer pink
3. In a large bowl mix together sour cream , cream of chicken soup , mayonaise& spices
4. In a casserole dish layer thawed broccoli and then chicken& mushrooms
5. Bake at 350 for 35 minutes until mixture bubbles
6. Remove and sprinkle cheddar cheese and return to back 10-15 minutes more until cheese slightly browns

title: sundried tomatoes vinagrette
steps:
1. Place all ingredents in blend
2. Add salt and pepper to taste
3. Blend until creamy
4. Serve over green salad , garden fresh vegitables or other salad of your choice

title: mushroom stuffed mushrooms
steps:
1. Wash mushrooms and scoop out stems
2. Chop stems as you did with celery and onion
3. Melt butter in large pan on low-medium heat
4. Add everything except the bread crumbs to the butter
5. Turn to medium heat
6. Saut over medium for about 15-20 minutes
7. Add bread crumbs , remove from heat
8. Mix well , let cool for 20 minutes
9. Preheat oven to 400f
10. Scoop stuffing into mushrooms so it's heaping quite a bit
11. Put mushrooms on cookie sheet , no need to grease it
12. Place in 400f oven for 20 minutes
13. Serve hot !
14. Just leave prepared mushrooms on counter top until you want to bake them

title: the real oatmeal raisin cookies
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375f
2. In large bowl , beat margarine and sugars until creamy
3. Add egg and vanilla
4. Beat well
5. Add combined flour , baking soda , cinnamon , salt and nutmeg
6. Mix well
7. Add oats
8. Mix well
9. Drop dough by rounded tablespoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheets
10. Bake 8 to 9 minutes for a chewy cookie or 10 to 11 minutes for a crisp cookie
11. Cool 1 minute on cookie sheets
12. Remove to wire rack
13. Cool completely
14. Store tightly covered

title: better than average canned green beans
steps:
1. Drain one can of the green beans
2. Empty both cans in to a medium sauce pan and add onions , bacon bits , salt and pepper
3. Cover and cook on medium heat for about 10 minutes
4. The trick is to let it bubble and do not take the lid off
5. The bacon bits and onions soften and enhance the flavor of the beans

title: orange potato bread
steps:
1. In large bowl sift together flour , sugar , baking powder , baking soda and salt
2. In small bowl , beat together egg , oil , orange juice , orange rind and vanilla
3. Stir in prepared potatoes
4. Add orange mixture all at once to dry ingredients and stir to mix well
5. Sift in nuts
6. Turn into greased 9x5x3 loaf pan
7. Bake in 325 oven 60 min
8. Until cake tester inserted comes out clean
9. Cool 10 min
10. Remove from pan and cool completely

title: chocolate dipped pretzels
steps:
1. Double boiler method: fill lower pan with water to below level of top pan
2. Bring water to simmer , then remove from heat
3. Put candy melts in top pan and set in position on lower pan
4. Stir constantly , without beating , until smooth and completely melted
5. Microwave method: in microwave-safe container , microwave 1 package of candy melts at half power or defrost setting for 1 minute
6. Stir throughly
7. Continue to microwave and stir at 30 second intervals until smooth and completely melted
8. With a fork or dipping spoon , place pretzels into completely melted chocolate
9. Roll around gently but quickly with the dipper until well covered
10. Carefully remove and allow excess to drip off and then place on waxed paper to set
11. Drizzle with coloring melts for added decoration
12. Leave pretzels to sit for 30 minutes until firm

title: vegetable barley casserole ww
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Heat oil in very large nonstick skillet over medium heat
3. Add onion , garlic , corn and swiss chard
4. Cook , stirring frequently , until onion is translucent and swiss chard is tender , about 5 minutes
5. Stir in tomatoes , barley , cumin , oregano , salt and pepper
6. Heat through
7. Coat a 2 1 / 2- to 3-quart baking dish with cooking spray
8. Spoon barley mixture into prepared dish in an even layer
9. Sprinkle with cheese
10. Bake until cheese melts and mixture is hot , about 25 to 30 minutes
11. Remove from oven and let stand for 5 minutes before slicing into six pieces

title: vegetarian mulligatawny soup
steps:
1. In a soup pot , saute the onions in the ghee for 5 minutes
2. Add chili , turmeric and coriander
3. Saute for 2 to 3 minutes , stirring
4. Add the stock and the vegetables
5. Simmer for 10 to 15 minutes , until veggies are tender
6. Add the coconut , coconut milk and cook for a further 5 minutes
7. Remove from heat and let cool for a few minutes
8. Add lemon juice and cilantro
9. The longer this soup sits , the better its flavor
10. Re-heat gently before serving

title: sugar free baked ricotta custard  south beach diet friendly
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 250 degrees
2. Mix ricotta and cream cheese until creamy
3. Add sugar substitute , eggs , half-and-half , and vanilla
4. Beat until well blended
5. Transfer into ramekins
6. Place into larger baking dish and add hot water to depth of 1 inch
7. Bake until set
8. Remove and cool
9. Serve chiled or at room temperature
10. Sprinkle with cinnamon

title: walnut taco meat
steps:
1. Put ingredients in a food processor
2. Pulse until course and crumbly
3. Don't pulse for too long , or else you'll end up with butter !

title: crock pot smothered beef patties   starting from frozen patties
steps:
1. Place 1 patty in crock pot or 2 patties side by side if they fit -- depending on your crock pot
2. Put 1 tsp of worcester sauce on the patty , sprinkle onion , salt and pepper and a little tomatoes w / chillies
3. Put another patty on top and repeat step two
4. Layer over and over finishing with the tomatoes
5. Cook on high for 4-5 hours
6. I usually serve with ketchup

title: pork chops and applesauce
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Brown chops in skillet
3. Remove to baking dish that you've sprayed with a non-stick spray
4. Mix applesauce , spices and sherry
5. Spoon half of this mixture on chops
6. Bake 20 , turn chops and spoon on remainder of sauce
7. Return to oven for another 20 minutes

title: chef berry s stuffed manicotti
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Cook manicotti shells according to package directions
3. In a hot skillet add ground beef , mushrooms , onions , garlic , italian seasoning , pepper , and 1tsp salt
4. Cook until ground beef is no longer pink
5. Remove the ground beef from heat and stir in spinach
6. Set aside and let cool
7. In a large bowl lightly beat the eggs
8. Combine the ricotta , bell pepper , and mozzarella cheese , and remaining salt in with the eggs
9. Stir together well
10. Stir in the ground beef mixture until well mixed
11. In a baking dish add stewed tomatoes and 1 cup of spaghetti sauce
12. Stuff the manicotti with the meat and cheese mixture and arrange in the baking dish
13. Pour on remaining sauce and sprinkle on the parmesan cheese
14. Cover and bake in the oven for 45 minutes

title: easy fish chowder
steps:
1. Place haddock and water in a dutch oven and heat to boiling
2. Cover and reduce heat to low and simmer approximately 10-15 minutes or until the fish is white and flakes easily
3. Remove the halibut , reserving the 'broth'
4. Cut the haddock into bite size pieces
5. Return 1 cup of the reserved broth to the dutch oven
6. Add the potatoes , onion and green pepper and simmer 15 minutes or just until the potatoes are tender
7. Add the remaining broth , the haddock , tomato , milk , salt and pepper
8. Heat until hot , but do not boil
9. Sprinkle with cheese before serving

title: coconut breakfast pancakes
steps:
1. Use coconut oil to grease the pan for delicious results
2. Add chocolate chips and that makes them even more amazing !
3. In a bowl whisk the rice flour , coconut flour , starch , baking powder , and sugar together
4. In a separate bowl whisk the buttermilk , sugar , and eggs together until well incorporated
5. Make a well in the center of the flour mix and pour the liquid mix into it
6. Carefully stir the dry and the liquid ingredients together until batter is formed
7. The batter will be very thick , don't worry , this is normal !
8. Spray your non-stick pan with cooking spray over low heat
9. Drop a little less than 1 / 3 of a cup of batter onto the pan
10. It may need to be spread slightly with a spatula or the edge of your measuring cup
11. Cook approximately 1 minute then turn over and cook the other side
12. The pancake should puff up slightly and feel firm if pressed on in the center with your finger
13. This takes about 45-60 seconds
14. Remove pancake and hold on a warmed plate with a clean kitchen towel covering it until served
15. Repeat until remaining batter is used
16. Enjoy !

title: another red lentil soup recipe
steps:
1. Put 1 tbsp of olive oil into a large saucepan and add the onion , ginger and cumin
2. Cook over medium heat until the onion is soft and transparent
3. Add the carrot , jalapeo , lentils and stock
4. Bring to a boil then reduce to a simmer
5. Cook for 30 minutes , or until the lentils have completely disintegrated
6. Meanwhile , heat the remaining olive oil in a frying pan over medium heat and add the red onions
7. Wash the cilantro and finely chop the roots and stems , leaving the top leafy section for garnishing later
8. Add the chopped cilantro roots and stems to the red onion and continue to cook , stirring occasionally , until the onions are caramelized
9. To serve , ladle into bowls , garnish with a sprinkling of cilantro leaves then top with a spoonful of the caramelized onions

title: meatball   appetizers
steps:
1. Meatballs: mix all ingredients and form into 1" meatballs
2. Sauce: mix well and pour over meatballs
3. Bake at 325 f
4. For 1 hour
5. Baste frequently

title: skillet supper
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350'
2. Brown ground beef in oil
3. Add celery , onions , and carrots
4. Cook 5 minutes , stirring constantly
5. Drain off any extra fat
6. Add remaining ingredients except cheese
7. Stir to mix
8. Put into casserole dish
9. Sprinkle cheese on top
10. Bake for 25 minutes at 350'f

title: cran apple crisp
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine the first 6 ingredients
2. Toss to coat , and mix well
3. Spray the inside of a 2 1 / 2 qt casserole baking dish with a nonstick vegetable spray
4. Add the apple mixture to the casserole baking dish
5. In a small bowl , combine the oats , wheat flour , sugar and cinnamon
6. Mix well
7. Add the apple juice
8. Stir until moist and crumbly
9. Sprinkle the oats mixture evenly over the apple mixture
10. Bake in a 375 degree oven for 30 minutes
11. Remove from oven , cover loosely w / aluminum foil
12. Return to oven and bake 15 minutes more , or until bubbly and golden rown
13. Serve warm

title: melitzanosalata  greek eggplant  aubergine  spread
steps:
1. Wash eggplant , place in baking pan and bake in at 375f for about one hour , or until soft when pierced with a fork and the eggplant has sort of collapsed into itself
2. Allow the skin to turn black and charred so as to give a smoky flavour to the salad
3. Skin eggplant when cool enough for you to stand it and chop in small pieces
4. Mash it up a bit with a fork
5. Mix well with onion , garlic , tahini , oil , vinegar , salt and pepper

title: sweet   savory butternut squash and wild rice saut
steps:
1. Warm oil in a large saut pan over medium heat
2. Place green beans and shallots in pan and cook 3 minutes
3. Add garlic , squash and herbs
4. Cook another 2-3 minutes , until beans are crisp but tender
5. Add rice and cook until heated through
6. Season to taste with salt and pepper
7. Spray cut surface with olive oil , and place cut side up on a baking pan
8. Place pan on center rack in a preheated 400f oven and roast 45 minutes , until fork-tender
9. When squash is cool enough to handle , scoop out flesh and cut into cubes

title: crock pot boston butt shoulder for pulled pork
steps:
1. Rinse roast and remove as much fat from the outside as is practical
2. Dry the roast and slather with mustard
3. Add enough rub to cover the roast evenly
4. Using hands , rub the spices and mustard into the roast on all sides
5. Place 1 1 / 2 inch balls of aluminum foil in a 4 or 5 quart crock pot to raise the roast above liquids that will collect in the pot
6. Place the roast into the crock pot and set on low
7. Cook the roast until it is 190 to 200f internal temperature
8. During the cook , the liquids collected may be removed and chilled for defatting
9. Depending on how "hot" your crock pot cooks , this may take 8 to 12 hours on low or 5 to 8 hours on high
10. I recommend using temperature rather than time
11. Another indication of doneness is to try to remove the blade bone by hand
12. If it can be easily removed , it is done
13. Rest the roast until it can pulled apart by hand or with forks
14. Remove fat as you pull the pork
15. Wet the roast with a portion of the defatted juices and mix
16. Serve with your favorite sauce , applied on the side or on top for sandwiches

title: sausage   apples
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a large non-stick skillet
2. Saute' over medium heat until slightly browned
3. Don't over do it or the apples get mushy
4. Serve immediately

title: cucumbers with dill
steps:
1. Place the diced cucumber in a colander over a plate
2. Sprinkle with the salt and toss
3. Let stand for 15 minutes , stirring once
4. Rinse and drain well
5. In a large bowl , combine the vinegar , dill , sugar and pepper
6. Add cucumbers and toss to coat
7. Cover and refrigerate for at least 15 minutes prior to serving

title: dark cherry cranberry crisp
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. In a medium saucepan , combine filling ingredients
3. Place over medium heat and stir constantly until thickened
4. Cranberries will swell and begin to pop
5. Remove from heat and set aside
6. Combine oats , brown sugar , flour and cinnamon in a medium bowl
7. With a fork , thoroughly cut in softened butter
8. Pour filling into a lightly greased 8" x 8" baking pan , smoothing to edges of pan , and sprinkle evenly with topping
9. Bake for 25-30 minutes or until filling is bubbly and topping is lightly browned
10. If desired , serve over vanilla ice-cream

title: watermelon and feta salad
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine the watermelon , feta , and black pepper to taste
2. Add red pepper flakes if you like
3. Serve immediately

title: meatball barbecue
steps:
1. Combine egg , milk , oats , worchestershire , and dry mustard
2. Add salt , pepper , and ground beef
3. Mix well
4. Shape meat around olives , forming 20 meatballs
5. Thread balls on skewers , pushing through olive
6. Brush with barbecue sauce
7. Grill over hot coals for 8 minutes
8. Turn skewers and brush with more barbecue sauce
9. Grill 4 minutes longer

title: open face veg burgers with sauteed onions
steps:
1. In large skillet heat olive oil over medium-high heat
2. Add onion slices and cook 8 to 10 minutes or until very tender , stirring frequently
3. Meanwhile , prepare burgers according to package microwave directions
4. In small bowl combine mayonnaise and mustard
5. Spread mixture on one side of each bread slice
6. Top bread with spinach and burger
7. Stir steak sauce into cooked onions
8. Spoon onion mixture on burgers
9. Makes 4 servings

title: chicken in white wine
steps:
1. Fry the bacon in its own fat in a large frying pan until beginning to brown
2. Add the onions and fry until browned , then add the mushrooms and fry for 2 minutes
3. Transfer the bacon and vegetables to a flameproof casserole with a slotted spoon
4. Coat the chicken joints with the flour , seasoned with salt and pepper
5. Heat the butter and the oil in the frying pan , add the chicken and fry until browned all over
6. Transfer the chicken to the casserole
7. Gradually stir the white wine into the frying pan
8. Bring to the boil , scraping any sediment from the bottom of the pan , then pour over the chicken joints in the casserole
9. Add the chicken stock , garlic herbs and seasoning to taste to the frying pan
10. Bring to the boil , then pour over the chicken
11. Cover and cook in the oven at 170c mark 3 for 1 hour or until the chicken is tender
12. Skim any fat from the cooking liquid
13. Garnish with chopped parsley

title: pioneer woman cinnamon rolls 101
steps:
1. Mix milk , vegetable oil , and sugar in a pan
2. "scald" the mixture turn off heat and leave to cool 45 minutes to 1 hour
3. When the mixture is lukewarm to warm , but not hot , sprinkle in yeast
4. Let this sit for a minute so the yeast gets all warm and moist and happy
5. Then add 8 cups of all-purpose flour
6. Stir mixture together
7. Cover and let sit for at least an hour
8. Now add 1 more cup of flour , baking powder , baking soda , and salt
9. Stir mixture together
10. At this point , you could cover the dough and put it in the fridge until you need itovernight or even a day or two , if necessary
11. Just keep your eye on it and if it starts to splurge out of the pan , just punch it down
12. Or , of course , you can just go ahead and make the rolls
13. Lets do that , shall we ?
14. Sprinkle surface generously with flour
15. Take half the dough and form a rough rectangle
16. Then roll the dough thin , maintaining a general rectangular shape
17. Rectangle should increase in both width and length as you roll it out
18. Now drizzle melted butter over the dough
19. Dont be shy
20. Lay it on thick , baby
21. You know you want it
22. Oh , by the way ? this is not non-caloric
23. In case anyone asks
24. Sprinkle sugar over the butter , followed by a generous sprinkling of cinnamon
25. Starting at the opposite end , begin rolling the dough in a neat line toward you
26. Keep the roll relatively tight as you go
27. Some of the butter / sugar / cinnamon mixture may ooze out toward the end , but thats no big deal
28. Next , pinch the seam to the roll to seal it
29. Spread 1 tablespoon of melted butter in seven round , foil cake or pie pans
30. Then begin cutting rolls approximately 3 / 4 to 1 inch thick and laying them in the buttered pans
31. Repeat this process with the other half of the dough
32. This recipe makes approximately seven pans of rolls
33. Let the rolls sit for 20 to 30 minutes to rise , then bake at 400 degrees until light golden brown , about 15 to 18 minutes
34. Glaze:
35. While the rolls are in the oven , make the deliciously sinful maple frosting
36. To a mixing bowl , add powdered sugar , maple flavoring , 1 / 2 cup milk , 1 / 4 cup melted butter , brewed coffee , and salt
37. Stir until mixture is thick but pourable
38. Taste and adjust as needed
39. Generously drizzle frosting over warm rolls after you pull them out of the oven
40. And take a walk on the wild side
41. Dont be afraid to drown them puppies
42. Be sure to get frosting around the perimeter of the pan , too , so the icing will coat the outside of the rolls

title: chicken garlic ginger healing soup
steps:
1. Heat olive oil in a large pan
2. Add fresh garlic , fresh ginger , and onion
3. Cook for 3-4 minutes
4. Add ginger paste , cayenne pepper , and salt & pepper
5. Cook for an additional 3-4 minutes , stirring often
6. Add the chicken broth , water , chicken , and carrots
7. Bring to a boil
8. Reduce heat and simmer for 30 minutes
9. Add spinach and let cook for 5 minutes just before serving
10. Simply add to the soup at the same time you add the carrots

title: the cheesecake factory pumpkin cheesecake by todd wilbur
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Make the crust by combining the graham cracker crumbs with the melted butter and 1 t sugar in a medium bowl
3. Stir well enough to coat all of the crumbs with the butter , but not so much as to turn the mixture into paste
4. Keep it crumbly
5. Put foil partway up the outside part of an 8-inch springform pan
6. Press the crumbs onto the bottom and about two-thirds of the way up the sides of the springform pan
7. You don't want the crust to form all of the way up the back of each slice of cheesecake
8. Bake the crust for 5 minutes , then set aside until you are ready to fill it
9. In a large mixing bowl combine the cream cheese , 1 c sugar , and vanilla
10. Mix with an electric mixer until smooth
11. Add the pumpkin , eggs , cinnamon , nutmeg and allspice and continue beating until smooth and creamy
12. Pour the filling into the pan
13. Bake for 60-70 minutes
14. The top will turn a bit darker at this point
15. Remove from the oven and allow the cheesecake to cool
16. When the cheesecake has come to room temperature , put it into the refrigerator
17. When the cheesecake has chilled , remove the pan sides and cut the cake into 8 equal pieces
18. Serve with a generous portion of whipped cream on top

title: chicken apricot salad
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine mixed greens , sliced apricots , chicken , sprouts and cashews
2. In a small bowl , whisk together reserved syrup , cumin , soy , lemon juice & splenda
3. Pour over salad just before serving and toss to combine

title: bisquick buttermilk lemon pancakes
steps:
1. Beat all ingredients with whire whisk until well blended
2. Pour by spoonfuls onto a hot griddle , greased
3. Cook until edges are lightly brown
4. Turn , cook until golden brown

title: white chocolate  irish cream   berry trifle
steps:
1. Cut each sponge cake into small squares
2. Whip cream and icing sugar together until soft peaks form
3. Place mascarpone in a large bowl and fold cream lightly through mascarpone until well combined
4. Line the base of 4-6 serving dishes with half the sponge
5. Drizzle with half the irish cream and spread the mascarpone mixture over sponge
6. Sprinkle with half the combined white and milk chocolate and half the mixed berries
7. Repeat layers , cover and chill for 3 hours or overnight
8. To serve sprinkle trifle with any remaining berries and chocolate curls
9. Accompany with cream if desired

title: creamy potato soup
steps:
1. Start boiling potatoes
2. In a soup pot , saute the onions and celery over medium heat for about 5-8 minutes , until it is soft
3. Add the garlic and cook for another 2 or 3 minutes
4. Add the flour and stir constantly for a minute
5. Stir in the milk and vegetable broth
6. Bring to a slow simmer for about 5 minutes
7. Add paprika and season with salt and pepper
8. By this time , your potatoes should be done - you don't want them to be falling apart , but just fork-tender
9. Drain the potatoes and divide in half
10. Mash half of the potatoes and stir them into the soup
11. Simmer for another five minutes
12. Add the remaining potato chunks , and adjust seasonings to taste - i added a bit more pepper and another dash of smoked paprika
13. Serve with whatever toppings you like - bacon , fried onions , grated cheese , scallions , etc

title: cheese pastries   vegetarian epicure
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees f
2. Stir together the flour , salt , paprika and pepper
3. Put in food processor , add butter and process until mixture resembles coarse meal
4. Add and process with both grated cheeses
5. Sprinkle cream over mixture and process until you have a smooth dough
6. Put glob on waxed paper , press to form a disk , wrap in the waxed paper and chill for about an hour
7. Roll the dough out on a lightly floured pastry cloth , until it is a thickness of a little less than inch
8. Cut into small or medium circles or strips
9. Arrange them on ungreased cookie sheets
10. Then brush with the beaten egg / water mixture
11. Bake in preheated 325 degrees f oven for 12-14 minutes

title: white bean   rosemary stew
steps:
1. In large saucepan , heat oil over medium heat and cook the onion and garlic until tender , about 5 minutes
2. Stir in broth and bring mixture to a boil over high heat
3. Stir in beans , rosemary and pepper
4. Reduce heat to medium-low and simmer , uncovered , 10 minutes , stirring occasionally
5. Stir in roasted peppers and cook 3 minutes more

title: garlic boiled potatoes with sour cream
steps:
1. Cook potatoes in large enough pot to cover potatoes with water
2. Add the garlic and salt to pot
3. Cook until potatoes are done yet remains firm
4. Drain and return to pot to dry
5. Do not remove the garlic ! you will find that it is a sweet surprise when you bite into it
6. Add 1 / 2 of sour cream to pot and fold gently
7. Add dill , if using
8. Plate and top with the remaining sour cream
9. Here's where the pepper comes in -- as a topping
10. So easy , so good !

title: tomato pie
steps:
1. Bake pie crust at 400 degrees on bottom rack of oven for about 10-12 minutes
2. Remove from oven
3. Peel tomatoes and thinly slice
4. Sprinkle tomato slices with salt , set aside and allow to drip in colander for about 15 minutes then dab with paper towels to remove some of the moisture
5. Chop together the basil , oregano , chives and green onions and mix together with greek seasoning , salt and pepper , mixing well
6. Add in layers half of the tomato slices in crust , sprinkle liberally with half of the herb mixture , add the other layer of tomatoes and sprinkle with other half of herb mixture
7. Mix together the mayonnaise and cheddar cheese and spread over top of pie , sealing with sides of crust
8. Bake in 350 degree oven about 30 minutes until golden brown

title: rum louis cocktail
steps:
1. Pour all liquids into shaker over ice
2. Shake until well blended
3. Pour into hurricane or collins glass
4. Garnish with orange slice and cherries

title: cajun banana smoothie
steps:
1. Place bananas& strawberries in a bowl and freeze
2. Remove after frozen& place in a blender
3. Add skim milk , yogurt , orange peel , & sugar
4. Blend at medium speed until thick
5. Add rum& brandy
6. Pour into a chilled champagne saucer
7. Arrange strawberries , banana slices , & mint on long toothpicks
8. Rotate into drink& serve
9. Varation: you could use about any berry in this and it will still be great

title: sea salted coffee toffee bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. In a mixing bowl , beat together butter , brown sugar and salt until light and fluffy
3. Add flour , 1 cup at a time , stirring between additions
4. Add instant coffee crystals and blend until well incorporated
5. Pat batter into ungreased 9x13x2-inch baking pan in an even layer
6. Bake until edges are lightly browned and center is puffy , 12 to 15 minutes
7. Meanwhile , in heavy saucepan , stir condensed milk and 2 tablespoons butter over low heat until butter melts
8. The mixture will thicken and become smooth
9. Stir in vanilla or rum , remove from heat and let sit until bottom layer is done baking
10. Sprinkle nuts over baked bottom layer and pour hot condensed milk mixture evenly over nuts using a spatula to spread
11. Return to the oven and bake until top is golden and bubbling , 10 to 12 minutes
12. Immediately sprinkle desired amount of sea salt over bubbling toffee top
13. Cool slightly in pan and cut into bars
14. Bars can be kept up to one week in an airtight container

title: italian sausage and pepper casserole
steps:
1. Heat over to 375 deg
2. F
3. Spray 11x7-inch glass baking dish with cooking spray
4. Cut each sausage link into 4 pieces
5. In 12-inch nonstick skillet , cook sausage over medium heat 10 to 12 minutes , stirring occasionally until brown
6. Drain
7. In baking dish , mix sausage and remaining ingredients except cheese
8. Cover baking dish with foil
9. Bake 45 minutes
10. Uncover and stir well
11. Sprinkle with cheese
12. Bake uncovered about 10 minutes longer or until sausage is no longer pink and orzo is tender

title: lemon and mustard calamari
steps:
1. Heat oil in pan and cook white onion and garlic , stirring until onion is soft
2. Add spring onion , cook stirring until just soft
3. Combine rice , onion mixture , cheese , rind , egg and mustard in a large bowl
4. Spoon mixture into calamari hoods , securing end with toothpicks
5. Cook calamari on oiled barbecue , uncovered until browned all over and tender
6. Serve drizzled with lemon and mustard dressing
7. Lemon and mustard dressing: combine all ingredients in a jar and shake well

title: chicken bacon rolls in creamy basil sauce
steps:
1. For chicken---------------------
2. Place each chicken breast between 2 sheets of plastic wrap and , using a meat pounder , pound until 1 / 4 inch thick
3. Place 1 cheese slice and bacon slice on top of each breast half
4. Fold the sides in toward the center and then , begin at the bottom end , rollup tightly
5. Secure with toothpicks
6. Preheat an oven to 425 degrees f
7. Add oil to frying pan heat over medium-high heat , while the oil is heating , put milk and flour in separate shallow bowls
8. Dip chicken rolls in milk
9. Then coat them in the flour , coating lightly and evenly
10. Add the chicken to the pan and brown lightly on all sides , 5-7 minutes
11. Save pan drippings and pan for sauce
12. Using a slotted spatula , transfer the chicken to a baking dish
13. Place in the center of the oven and immediately reduce the heat to 375' bake until cooked through , 10-12 minutes
14. Let stand for a few minutes , remove the toothpicks
15. For sauce--------------
16. While the chicken is baking , in same frying pan you browned chicken in , add broth bring to a boil over med heat , lossening browned bits from pan
17. Stir in cream and pimientos bring to a boil over med
18. Heat stirring for 1 minute
19. Reduce heat , add parmesan cheese , basil
20. Salt and pepper to taste
21. Cook stirring til heated through
22. Pour over chicken serve

title: quick camping cheesecake
steps:
1. Blend cream cheese into milk until smooth
2. Add pudding mix and whisk for about 2 minutes
3. Pour over graham crackers and enjoy

title: breaded turkey breasts
steps:
1. In a shallow bowl , combine the bread crumbs , italian seasoning , garlic , basil and oregano
2. Pour milk into another shallow bowl
3. Dip turkey in milk , then roll in crumbs
4. In a large skillet , cook turkey over medium heat in oil for 4-5 minute on each side or until juices run clear
5. Dreain on paper towels

title: american sandwich bread   abm or oven
steps:
1. Abm method
2. Add ingredients in order recommended by your abm manufacturer
3. Select quick setting , and start
4. After 8 minutes of kneading , check the dough consistency
5. If too dry , and dough is not pulling in all of the flour , add a tablespoon of water , and check again
6. If too wet , and dough is visibly wet , add a tablespoon of all-purpose flour , and check again
7. Remove from abm when done
8. Remove the bread from the pan , transfer to a wire rack , and cool to room temperature
9. Slice and serve
10. Oven method
11. Set one oven rack on lowest possible level
12. Set second rack in middle position
13. Preheat oven to 200 degrees f
14. Once the oven has reached 200 degrees , maintain the heat for 10 minutes , then turn off the oven
15. If using standing mixer
16. Mix the flour and salt in the bowl of a standing mixer fitted with the dough hook
17. Mix the milk , water , butter , honey and yeast in a 2-cup liquid measuring cup
18. Turn the mixer to low and slowly add the liquid
19. When the dough comes together , increase the speed to medium and mix until the dough is smooth and satiny , stopping the mixer 2-3 times to scrape dough from the hook , if necessary , about 10 minutes
20. Turn the dough onto a lightly floured work surface
21. Knead to form a smooth , round ball , about 15 seconds
22. Go to step 20
23. If using food processor
24. Mix flour and salt in bowl of food processor fitted with the steel blade
25. Add liquid ingredients
26. Process until rough ball forms
27. Let dough rest 2 minutes
28. Process 35 seconds
29. Turn dough onto a lightly floured work surface
30. Knead dough by hand until dough is smooth and satiny , 4-5 minutes
31. Place the dough in a very lightly oiled large bowl , rubbing the dough around the bowl to coat lightly
32. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and place in the warmed oven until the dough doubles in size , 40-50 minutes
33. Gently press the dough into an 8-inch square that measures 1-inch thick
34. Starting with the side farthest from you , roll the dough firmly into a cylinder , pressing with your fingers to make sure the dough sticks to itself
35. Turn the dough seam-side up and pinch it closed
36. Place the dough seam-side down in a greased 9x5-inch loaf pan and press it gently so it touches all 4 sides of the pan
37. Cover with plastic wrap
38. Set aside in a warm spot until the dough almost doubles in size , 20-30 minutes
39. Heat the oven to 350 degrees f
40. Boil 2 cups of water and pour into a baking pan , and place it on the bottom rack
41. If possible , place the loaf on a rack above the baking pan of water
42. Otherwise , place the 2 pans side by side
43. Bake until an instant-read thermometer inserted at an angle from the short end just above the pan rim into the center of the loaf reads 195 degrees f , about 40-50 minutes
44. Remove the bread from the pan , transfer to a wire rack , and cool to room temperature
45. Slice and serve

title: healthy peanut butter chocolate chip cookies
steps:
1. Combine all-purpose flour , whole wheat flour , baking soda , cinnamon , and salt together in a medium mixing bowl
2. Set aside
3. Beat butters , sugars , applesauce , and honey on medium speed until creamy , about 3 minutes
4. Beat in egg and vanilla
5. Gradually beat in flour mixture , just until combined
6. Scrape down bowl and stir in chocolate chips
7. Set oven to 375f
8. Drop dough by rounded tablespoon onto ungreased cookie sheets
9. Bake 8-10 minutes or until edges are set but centers are still soft
10. Cookies should not be browning yet
11. Optional: you can quickly chill dough or dropped cookie dough on baking sheets in the freezer 10-15 minutes before baking , for a thicker cookie
12. You can also position oven racks to top and bottom thirds of oven
13. Halfway through baking , rotate cookie sheet top to bottom and front to back

title: jello pretzel salad
steps:
1. Crust:
2. Mix all ingredients and bake in a greased 9x13 pan at 400 for 8 minutes
3. Cool completely
4. Middle layer:
5. Mix cream cheese , sugar , milk , and pineapple together
6. Fold in large container of cool whip
7. Spread on first layer
8. Top layer:
9. Dissolve jello and add strawberries
10. Let set slightly
11. Pour over middle layer and let set

title: baking mix cheese and garlic biscuits
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450
2. Mix baking mix , milk , and cheese until soft dough forms and beat for 30 seconds
3. Drop by spoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet
4. Bake 8 to 10 minutes
5. Mix melted butter or olive oil with garlic and brush over warm biscuits before removing from cookie sheet

title: pork roast with peppercorn mustard crust and cider gravy
steps:
1. For pork roast: position rack in lowest third of oven and preheat to 475f add 1 tablespoon butter to a heavy large skillet over medium-high heat and roast and cook until brown , about 4 minutes per side
2. Remove from skillet
3. Cool 10 minutes
4. Transfer to roasting pan
5. Combine remaining 1 / 4 cup butter with mustard seeds , flour , sugar , mustard , thyme , and peppercorns in bowl
6. Spread paste oven top and sides of roast
7. Roast 30 minutes
8. Reduce heat to 325 degrees
9. Continue cooking about 1 hour 20 minutes
10. Transfer roast to cutting board and tent with foil
11. Transfer 2 tablespoons drippings in pan to heavy small saucepan
12. Discard remaining drippings
13. For cider gravy: heat roasting pan over medium-low heat
14. Add cider and boil until liquid is reduced to 3 / 4 cup scraping up any browned bits , about 8 minutes
15. Stir in apple jack , boil 1 minute
16. Heat drippings in saucepan over medium-high heat
17. Add flour and stir until golden brown , about 2 minutes
18. Whisk in cider mixture and stock
19. Simmer until thickened , stirring occasionally , about 2 minutes
20. Remove from heat
21. Mix in vinegar and mustard
22. Season with salt and pepper
23. Carve roast and serve with gravy

title: best blackberry cobbler
steps:
1. Place filling ingredients in a pot and barely cover with water and bring to a boil
2. Place first three dumpling ingredients in a bowl
3. Cut shortening into flour using pastry cutter , forks or your hands until it resembles course meal
4. Add water one teaspoon at a time until dough holds together in a ball and does not crumble when pressed
5. Flour a work surface and roll out dumpling dough to about 1 / 4 - 1 / 8 inch thick and cut into squares
6. Drop dumplings into berry filling and cook 30 minutes
7. Make sure to stir when dropping in dumplings so they don't stick together
8. Pour filling into a 4 quart rectangle baking dish
9. Roll out pre-made crusts and place over berries
10. Most pre-made pie crust boxes come with 2 single crusts
11. You will need both crusts and trim the extra off
12. If you have the patience you can create a lattice crust using the pre-made dough for a pretty presentation
13. Bake your cobbler according to the pillsbury ready crust box directions
14. This recipe can be halved or 2 smaller cobblers made by using two 2 quart dishes and using one pre-made crust per cobbler

title: cucumber pineapple salsa
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a mixing bowl and mix well
2. Best to cover and refrigerate a few hours for flavors to blend

title: hot bacon cheese dip
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients except bread in a large bowl
2. Set aside
3. Cut off top of bread round and hollow out to make a bowl
4. Place mixture into bread round
5. Bake at 350f for 1 hour

title: mixed berry oatmeal crisps  bon appetit  vegan
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425f
2. Toss frozen berries and cornstarch in large bowl and let stand until cornstarch dissolves , tossing occasionally
3. Divide berry mixture among six 4
4. 5" diameter x 1" high ramekin dishes
5. Toss brown sugar , flour , oats , nuts , cinnamon and 1 / 4 t salt in large bowl
6. Add chilled margarine and using your fingers , blend together until coarse crumbs form
7. Sprinkle oat mixture evenly over dishes
8. Bake 10 minutes
9. Reduce heat to 350f and continue baking until topping is golden brown and fruit filling is bubbling
10. About 30 minutes
11. Cool crisps at least 15 minutes
12. Serve warm or at room temperature

title: summer tomato bake
steps:
1. Mix spinach with lemon juice , sour cream , and mushrooms
2. Season with salt and pepper to taste
3. Place in a greased casserole dish and cover with tomato slices
4. Dust top with salt and pepper to taste , and a thick layer of parmesan cheese
5. Bake in a preheated 300 degree f oven until brown and bubbly , usually about 15 minutes

title: sauerkraut casserole
steps:
1. Brown beef and onion
2. Set aside
3. Mix sauerkraut and margarine , heating through
4. Set aside
5. Alternate layers of beef , sauerkraut , and rice in a 1 1 / 2 quart deep casserole that his been greased
6. Mix milk , egg , and sour cream together and spread on top of casserole
7. Bake at 350 for 30 minutes uncovered

title: lemon  olive  and caper sauce for vegetables
steps:
1. Prepare vegetable per your method of choice and put aside after preparation
2. Meanwhile in a small saucepan over medium heat , melt the butter
3. Add the oil and garlic and cook , stirring for 1 minute
4. Then stir in the olives , lemon juice and capers and cook until heated through , about 2 minutes
5. Pour the sauce over vegetables , season with pepper
6. Toss well to coat
7. Lime juice can be substituted for lemon juice for a different take on the same theme
8. Nutritional information: per serving , 43 calories , 28 calories from fat 2mg cholesterol , 3 grams carbohydrate , 2 grams protein , i gram fiber , 67 milligrams sodium

title: southern style oven fried chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 365f
2. Lightly coat an 8 x 8 x 2-inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray
3. Set aside
4. Combine flour , salt and cayenne pepper together in a medium-size bowl
5. Place buttermilk and corn flakes crumbs in 2 separate shallow bowls
6. Roll chicken breast halves in flour mixture and evenly coat each side
7. Next dip chicken into buttermilk and then corn flakes crumbs
8. Place coated chicken breasts in prepared baking dish
9. Bake until chicken is tender and no longer pink , about 20 minutes
10. It ended up taking about 45-50 minutes to cook

title: egg roll dipping sauce
steps:
1. Combine cashews , cilantro , garlic , green onions , sugar , black pepper and cumin in a food processor or blender
2. Blend with short bursts until the mixture is well blended
3. The cashews and garlic must be well chopped
4. They should be about half the size of a grain of rice
5. Combine the vinegars , honey , tamarind and saffron in a small bowl
6. Heat mixture for about 1 minute in microwave and stir until tamarind pulp dissolves completely
7. Pour tamarind mixture into blender or food processor with the cashew mixture and mix with short bursts until well combined
8. Pour blended sauce into small bowl and add oil
9. Stir by hand
10. Cover and refrigerate at least 30 minutes before serving

title: plantain fritters  andre  style
steps:
1. Prepare pot / skillet for frying the fritters
2. Combine all the batter mixture together and whisk until well blended
3. Dip plantains into the batter , allow the extra mixture to run off
4. Fry until each side is golden brown

title: banana crispy rolls
steps:
1. Cut bananas in half lengthwise and sprinkle with lemon juice
2. Set aside
3. Cut phyllo sheet in half and brush with melted butter
4. The pastry sheets will dry out unless covered with plastic wrap or damp towels
5. Using one phyllo sheet , place one piece of caramel in between two pieces of banans
6. Fold pastry sheet over bananas long side and roll up
7. Place on greased baking sheet
8. Repeat with remaining bananas , pastry sheets and caramels
9. Bake at 350-degrees f for 15 minutes or until rolls are crisp and golden
10. Let cool
11. Sprinkle rolls with powdered sugar and drizzle with hot fudge sauce
12. Serve with ice cream and berries

title: spinach and mushroom quesadillas
steps:
1. Prepare spinach according to package directions
2. Drain and pat dry
3. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
4. Sprinkle 1 / 4 cup cheese on one side of each tortilla
5. Place tortillas cheese side up on baking sheets , and bake 5 minutes , or until cheese is melted
6. Melt the butter in a skillet over medium heat
7. Stir in garlic and mushrooms , and cook about 5 minutes
8. Mix in spinach , and continue cooking 5 minutes
9. Place an equal amount of the mixture on the cheese side of each tortilla
10. Fold tortillas in half over the filling
11. Heat a separate skillet over medium heat
12. Spray quesadillas with veggie spray place quesadillas in the skillet one at a time , and cook 3 minutes on each side , until golden brown
13. Cut each quesadilla into 4 wedges to serve

title: chocolate crunch cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Mix butter , sugars , eggs and vanilla together in a large bowl until well blended
3. I just did this with a wooden spoon rather than a mixer
4. Blend flour , baking powder , baking soda and salt together and add to the bowl , then oats , rice krispies , chocolate chips and pecans
5. Stir well
6. Drop batter on parchment covered baking sheets in mounds of about 3 t
7. , 3 inches apart , and flatten well with your hand
8. Bake for about 10 minutes until pale gold and let rest on sheets for a few minutes before removing to a cooling rack

title: minced pork noodles  negi to buta niku no itame
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a wok or large frying pan over high heat
2. Add the pork and chopped mushrooms
3. Stir-fry for 5 minutes before adding the spring onions
4. Add the sake and soy sauce to the work
5. Stir well , then serve over noodles or rice

title: island chicken stew
steps:
1. Cook chicken , onion and garlic in olive oil for 5-7 minutes in a hot skillet
2. Melt butter in a large stock pot and add the flour , stirring constantly for 2 minutes to make a roux
3. Add 4 cups of 1 / 2 and 1 / 2 and whisk until smooth
4. Add chicken stock , papaya , sweet potatoes , red pepper , scotch bonnet pepper , curry paste , grated ginger , zante currents , coconut , orange zest , orange juice , marjoram , salt , pepper , and wine and simmer for 1 / 2 hour
5. Steam spaghetti squash for 10-15 minutes and scrape out into a bowl
6. Mound squash into a bowl or deep plate , ladle some chicken stew around it , top with sour cream and sprinkle on grated coconut , mango and papaya

title: easy garlic pepper chicken
steps:
1. Throw all in the crockpot
2. Season to your liking with the spices
3. Cook on high for about 4 hours or low all day
4. If it starts to dry out add a little water just to keep moist
5. Extras you can do is add some cream of chicken soup or at the end a package of chicken gravy and some water
6. Some times i just shred and let the kids add what they want
7. Ketchup , bbq sauce or just plain and make sandwiches

title: katie s healthy banana bread
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f lightly spray bottom only of 9 x 5-inch loaf pan with cooking spray
2. In medium bowl , combine oats and milk
3. Mix well
4. Let stand 10 minutes
5. Stir in bananas , egg substitute and oil until blended
6. In large bowl , combine flour , sugar or sweetener , baking powder , cinnamon , baking soda , salt and nutmeg
7. Mix well
8. Add oat mixture to dry ingredients all at once
9. Stir just until dry ingredients are moistened
10. Pour batter into pan
11. Bake 55 to 65 minutes or until wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean
12. Cool in pan on wire rack 10 minutes
13. Remove from pan
14. Cool completely
15. Store tightly wrapped

title: koala float    with alcohol
steps:
1. Blend first 4 ingredients in blender until smooth
2. Pour into 2 tall glasses
3. Sprinkle with chocolate shavings and serve

title: island cookies
steps:
1. Sift together flour , baking powder and salt
2. Cream butter or margarine and peanut butter with the sugar until light and fluffy
3. Add egg and pineapple
4. Stir in flour mixture
5. Form into oblongs , using one heaped tsp
6. To each cookie
7. Bake in a 375 degree oven for about 10 minutes

title: honey ginger chicken  crock pot
steps:
1. Combine melted butter , honey , lemon / lime juice and ground ginger in a bowl
2. Mix well
3. Place chicken in crock pot
4. Pour mixture over chicken and cook on low for 6 hours
5. Spoon mixture over chicken periodically to make sure it gets covered in the sauce

title: chocolate chip cream cheese dessert ball   unique
steps:
1. Beat the cream cheese , butter and vanilla in a mixing bowl
2. Gradually add the sugars , mixing just until combined
3. Stir in the chocolate chips
4. Cover in plastic wrap and shape into a ball
5. Chill for at least 3 hours
6. Just before serving , roll the cheese ball in the chopped pecans
7. Serve with graham crackers

title: chicken breast with roasted potatoes
steps:
1. Blend all the ingredients for spice mixture
2. Rub chicken with spice mixture
3. Let chicken marinade in refrigerator for 6 hours
4. On the stove top heat oil in a large oven safe pan
5. Brown chicken on all sides add potatoes toss to distribute evenly through out pan
6. Place in 350 oven till meat registers 185
7. About 30 minutes
8. If potatoes are not done remove chicken and place potatoes back in oven
9. This is when i would raise the temperature of the oven to 425 to get them crispy !

title: black russian bundt cake
steps:
1. Grease and flour 12-cup bundt pan
2. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
3. In large bowl , combine cake mix , sugar , pudding mix , oil , eggs , vodka , kahlua and water
4. Mix at low speed for 1 minute
5. Beat 4 minutes more at medium speed
6. Pour into pan
7. Bake until toothpick inserted in center comes out dry , 60 to 70 minutes
8. Let cake cool in pan for 10 minutes then take out of pan
9. Meanwhile , prepare glaze by mixing powdered sugar with 1 / 4 cup kahlua
10. Put cake on wire rack or cake plate
11. Poke holes in cake with fork and slowly pour glaze over cake

title: vanilla freezer biscuits  cookies   with variations
steps:
1. Scrape seeds from vanilla bean
2. Beat butter , sugar and bean seeds until pale and creamy using an electric mixer
3. Add egg and beat until combined
4. Sift flour over butter mixture and use a wooden spoon , stir to combine
5. Place dough on a lightly floured surface and divide in half
6. Using hands shape each half in a 30cm long log
7. Wrap each log in baking paper , twirling ends to seal
8. Freeze for 2 hours or until firm
9. Remove logs from freezer 15 minutes before slicing
10. Preheat oven to 180 degree c
11. Line 2 baking trays with baking paper
12. Remove paper from logs and slice into 1
13. 5cm thick rounds
14. Place rounds , 3cm apart on prepared trays
15. Bake for 12 to 14 minutes or until light golden colour
16. Cool on trays for 5 minutes and transfer to wire rack to cool completely
17. Dust with icing sugar and serve
18. You can leave logs in freezer for up to 2 months , thaw for 1 hour before slicing and baking
19. Variations
20. Chocolate chips - stir 1 / 2 cup chopped dark chocolate chips at the end of step 4
21. Pistachio - stir in 2 / 3 cups of roughly chopped pistachio kernels at the end of step 4
22. Citrus - add 1 tablespoon finely grated lemon or orange rind with vanilla bean seeds in step 2

title: walnut double chocolate fudge
steps:
1. Line a square baking pan with foil
2. Combine sugar , milk , salt and butter in pan and bring to a boil over med
3. Heat for 4 minutes and remove from heat
4. Make sure not to let it burn by stirring constantly
5. Do not leave it !
6. Once boiling , stir nuts , marshmallows and vanilla
7. Stir until marshmallows are melted and pour into pan
8. Refridgerate until firm (a couple hours
9. Once cool , lift the whole thing out by pulling up on the foil
10. Cut into pieces

title: home on the free range chicken wings
steps:
1. Combine the rub ingredients in a bowl
2. Rinse the chicken wings in cold water and cut in half at the joint , discarding the
3. Rub the dry spice mixture well into the wings , cover and refrigerate
4. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f
5. Melt the butter in a small saucepan
6. Add the garlic , tabasco , lemon juice and dried herbs
7. Simmer for 15 minutes
8. Arrange the chicken on a roasting pan or baking dish and bake 15 minutes , turning once
9. Remove the wings from the oven and baste generously with the sauce
10. Return to the oven , reduce the heat to 350 f and continue cooking about 20 minutes , or until crisp and brown
11. Ifyou want to reduce the fat , use butter buds and / or chicken breast strips

title: baked beans and sauerkraut
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325
2. Combine all ingredients well
3. Pour in a 2 1 / 2 to 3 quart casserole
4. Bake at 325 for about 2 hours
5. Can make in crockpot on low for about 4-6 hours

title: vegetarian taco salad  for the dieter
steps:
1. Heat griller crumbles according to package , adding water according to your taste for consistency
2. Add taco seasoning and let heat for 30 seconds longer so that the onion bits soften
3. I add extra cumin here for a smokier flavor , but you could also had a tiny bit of cayenne if you like the heat
4. Top lettuce with "meat , " then sprinkle on taco sauce
5. Enjoy ! :3 you could also top with shredded cheese , sour cream , or tomatoes , but i don't like any of those

title: just the way we like it chili
steps:
1. Heat oil in large dutch oven or other stewpot over medium heat
2. Cook onions , garlic , ground beef and steak for ten minutes or until meat is well browned and the onions are tender
3. Add the tomatoes , beer , coffee , tomato paste and broth
4. Mix well
5. Add brown sugar , chili powder , cumin , cocoa , oregano , cayenne , coriander , and salt
6. Stir again
7. Add two cans of beans and the chili peppers
8. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 1 1 / 2 hours or until steak pieces are beginning to fall apart , uncovered
9. This can be done in advance , or even the previous day
10. Before serving , stir in the remaining can of beans
11. Simmer for 30 minutes , and serve
12. Extra-nice served with cornbread , and a dollop of sour cream and shredded cheddar on top

title: all i want is meat and potatoes sirloin
steps:
1. Sprinkle the roast evenly with 1 1 / 2 teaspoons salt and 1 teaspoon pepper
2. Heat oil in a big skillet over high heat
3. Add the meat and brown on all sides
4. Transfer the meat to the insert of a 5-7 quart slow cooker
5. Add the onions and thyme to the same skillet and saute until the onions begins to soften , 3-4 minutes
6. Transfer the onion mixture to the slow cooker
7. Add the broth , worcestershire sauce , and potatoes to the cooker , surrounding the meat
8. Cover cooker and cook on high for 4-5 hours or on low for 8-9 hours
9. Remove the meat and potatoes from the cooker and cover with foil
10. Allow to rest for about 15 minutes
11. Skim off any fat from the surface of the sauce
12. Transfer the sauce to a saucepan and strain through a fine-mesh sieve , if desired
13. Put the butter and the flour in a small bowl and stir to form a paste
14. Bring the sauce to a boil and add the butter mixture in pieces to the sauce , bringing the sauce back to a boil after each addition
15. Season with salt and pepper
16. Slice the meat
17. Serve sliced meat , potatoes and onions with sauce

title: turkey breakfast burritos
steps:
1. 1 warm turkey in small frying pan
2. 2 add cayenne , and cumin mix well
3. N
4. B
5. Add water if appears to dry
6. 3 once mixed well add eggs and scramble all together until eggs are cooked
7. 4 remove egg mixture into bowl
8. 5 place a spoon full of egg mixture , cheese and salsa in tortilla and wrap
9. 6 toast wrapped buritto in frying pan until tortilla is firm and holds shape
10. Enjoy

title: power smoothie
steps:
1. Blend all ingredients together
2. Sip and enjoy !

title: chicken hacienda
steps:
1. Roll chicken in seasoned flour
2. Brown in skillet with butter
3. Preheat oven to 350
4. Remove chicken and saute onions , garlic and green pepper
5. Add pimento and uncooked rice
6. Stir over heat 2 minutes
7. Add chicken broth , chili powder , comino seed , salt and pepper
