8. Put rice mixture into greased casserole dish and arrange chicken breasts over top
9. Bake uncovered for 1 1 / 2 hours

title: zucchini and stuffing casserole
steps:
1. Boil zucchini and onion for 5 minutes , drain
2. In separate bowl , stir melted butter into stuffing mix
3. Place 1 / 2 of stuffing and butter mixture into bottom of a 9 x 13 casserole pan
4. Mix sour cream and cream of chicken soup into drained zucchini and onions
5. Poor zucchini mixture over first layer of stuffing mix
6. Top with remaining stuffing
7. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes , uncovered

title: sweet potato marshmallow puffs
steps:
1. In a bowl , combine the mashed sweet potatoes with the egg yolks salt and melted butter
2. Mix thoroughly
3. Divide into 12 portions
4. Mold each portion into a circle , and flatten place 1 marshmallow in the center of each portion
5. Mold the potato batter around the marshmallow , leaving a small opening on top of the ball
6. In a bowl , combine the cereal flakes and the melted crisco shortening
7. Roll the potato balls in the cereal flakes
8. Place the coated sweet potato balls on a cookie sheet and freeze
9. When ready to bake , remove the balls from the freezer
10. Place in a shallow greased baking dish
11. Bake in a 350 degree oven , for about 20 minutes
12. Do not defrost the puffs before baking

title: grilled tandoori style chicken
steps:
1. Whisk yogurt and next 9 ingredients in large bowl to blend
2. Add chicken and turn to coat
3. Cover and refrigerate overnight
4. Remove from refrigerator and wipe off marinade and discard
5. Drizzle with oil , add salt and pepper
6. Prepare barbecue for medium heat and oil grill
7. Transfer chicken to barbecue grill
8. Grill chicken until cooked through , about 7 minutes per side
9. Remove from grill and let rest for 5 minutes
10. Transfer chicken to cutting board
11. Cut crosswise on diagonal into 1 / 2-inch-thick slices
12. Transfer to platter

title: smoked salmon and capers in a champagne sauce for pasta
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a large frying pan and cook the garlic over a medium heat for 30 seconds
2. Pour in the champagne and cook for 2-3 minutes , or until reduced slightly
3. Add the cream and cook for 3-4 minutes , or until reduced and thickened
4. Add the remaining ingredients and pour over the pasta of your choice
5. Toss through gently and season to taste with salt and freshly ground black pepper

title: mimi s southern style corn
steps:
1. At medium heat , add corn to butter in a large skillet
2. Stir in flour , sugar , salt and 1 / 2 cup of milk
3. Cook , covered , for 10 minutes
4. Add remaining 1 / 2 cup of milk before serving and stir well
5. Variation: use 8 ears of fresh white corn with large kernels
6. Cut corn from cobs by first cutting down through the kernels , then scraping the pulp from the cob with the back of the knife
7. This frees the pulp from the shells

title: buttery poppy seed egg noodles
steps:
1. In a large , heavy skillet , heat butter ,
2. Saute chopped onion until just to the browning stage
3. Add cooked noddles to pan
4. And cook until just turning brown
5. Mix in poppy seeds , salt / pepper to taste , green onions
6. Heat through
7. Toss with chopped parsley
8. Serve hot

title: cheerios peanut butter cookies
steps:
1. Mix sugar and syrup in saucepan and bring to a boil until it bubbles
2. Add peanut butter and stir
3. Stir in cheerios
4. Drop by teaspoon onto cookie sheet
5. Do not bake

title: fruit lassi
steps:
1. Put all ingredients , except almonds , in a blender or food processor and blend until smooth
2. Serve with ice cubes and sprinkle with almonds
3. Enjoy !

title: un potato salad  low carb
steps:
1. In a microwave safe casserole dish , add a tbsp of water along with the chunked cauliflower
2. Cover and cook on high for 7 minutes until tender but not mushy
3. Remove
4. Leave dish covered and let dish sit for another 3-5 minutes
5. Or , you can steam the cauliflower , until tender
6. Drain
7. In a large serving bowl , combine cauliflower with celery and onion
8. In a separate bowl , combine mayo , vinegar , salt , splenda and pepper
9. Pour this mixture over the cauliflower
10. Mix well
11. Lightly stir in chopped egg
12. Chill and serve

title: cilantro lime jalapeno chicken salad in avocado cups
steps:
1. Shred or dice cooked chicken
2. Add the mayonaise , dijon , cumin , lime juice , salt and pepper
3. Stir to incorporate
4. Mix in red onion , jalapeno and cilantro
5. Refrigerate for several hours to let flavors meld
6. Serve mounded in avocado halves
7. Season well with salt and pepper then placing in a flat microwavable dish
8. Cover loosely microwave high for about 5-10 minutes , testing at intervals for doneness
9. Do not over cook

title: lamb meatballs and orzo
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl , beat the egg
2. Add in the ground lamb , garlic , onion , bread crumbs , milk , dill , salt and pepper
3. Mix well to combine
4. Cover and refrigerate for 1 hour
5. Shape lamb mixture into 1-inch balls
6. Place balls on a large baking sheet with a rim
7. Bake in a 400 oven for about 10 minutes or until browned
8. Take out of oven and set aside
9. Bring to chicken stock , lemon juice , and lemon zest to a boil in a saucepan over high heat
10. Add in the orzo
11. Stir to combine
12. Boil for 1 minute
13. Transfer orzo mixture into a 2 1 / 2 quart baking dish that has been sprayed lightly with non-stick cooking spray
14. Spread mixture out evenly
15. Place meatballs on top
16. Decrease oven temp to 350 and bake , covered , for 40-50 minutes or until liquid is absorbed
17. Let rest for 5 minutes before serving

title: vegetable noodle casserole
steps:
1. In a bowl , combine undiluted soups , milk , 3 / 4 cup parmesan cheese , garlic , parsley , pepper and salt
2. Mix well
3. Add noodles and vegetables
4. Mix well
5. Pour into a greased 9"x13" baking dish
6. Sprinkle with the remaining parmesan
7. Cover and bake at 350 degrees f for 45-50 minutes or until heated through

title: steamed pot stickers
steps:
1. Filling:
2. Mix all filing together
3. Place one rounded teaspoon into center of won ton wrapper
4. Brush edges of wrapper with water and pinch ends up to seal and form a little pouch around the filling
5. Steam for about 5 minutes
6. Sauce:
7. Saut red pepper flakes in sesame oil , add remaining ingredients , heat through
8. Drizzle over pot stickers or use as a dipping sauce

title: hazelnut pie
steps:
1. In a large bowl , mix everything except the hazelnuts until smooth
2. Add hazelnuts and mix until well incorporated
3. Pour into pie shell
4. Bake in a 350 degree oven for 45 minutes
5. Remove from oven and allow to stand of at least 20 minutes before cutting
6. Serve with a scoop of vanilla ice cream or a dollop of whipped cream

title: roasted lemon garlic broccoli
steps:
1. Whisk together oil , lemon juice , salt , pepper and garlic until well combined
2. Pour over broccoli and toss to coat
3. Bake at 400 for 10-15 minutes until lightly browned

title: yummy honey curry chicken  with rice and veggies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. Place chicken in a oven safe dish
3. Mix honey , mustard , curry powder and salt in a dish or cup
4. Pour over chicken , making sure to coat every yummy inch
5. If you like things hotter , just add more curry powder
6. Place chicken in oven , and set time for 50 minutes
7. In a new oven safe dish , mix rice and water
8. Place beside chicken in hot oven
9. When timer rings for chicken , they're both good to go
10. Rinse your frozen veggies under cold water , then place 1 / 4 cup of water in a pot , and place veggies in
11. Turn heat on low , and allow to boil , stirring occasionally
12. Again , when the timer rings , veggies are good to go too
13. Salt veggies only if necessary when timer rings , put everything on the table , and pretend that you have just cooked a feast for your family
14. They'll love you for it

title: crustless crab quiche
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400f
2. Saut onions in butter until caramelized
3. Add salt to taste
4. Beat eggs and milk together in small bowl
5. Sprinkle parmesan in bottom of well greased muffin trays or pie dish
6. Layer onions , then crab , then feta cheese
7. Pour egg mix over top
8. Cook 20 minute
9. Let cool 8-10 minutes
10. If it is sticking , scrape the edges with a knife to help release

title: crunchy biscuit chicken casserole
steps:
1. In medium saucepan , combine chicken , soup , green beans , mushrooms , cheese , mayonnaise and lemon juice
2. Bring to a boil , stirring occasionally
3. Pour hot chicken mixture into ungreased 13x9-inch glass baking dish
4. Separate dough into 8 biscuits
5. Arrange over hot chicken mixture in dish
6. Brush each biscuit with butter
7. Sprinkle with crushed croutons
8. Bake at 375 degrees for 23-27 minutes or until biscuits are deep golden brown and bottoms are no longer doughy

title: artichoke and jack dip with pita chips
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375f in small bowl stir together butter and taco seasoning mix
2. Cut each pita into 6 wedges
3. Separate each wedge in half
4. Brush both sides of each pita wedge with butter mixture
5. Place pita wedges , not overlapping , on 15x10x1-inch jelly roll pan
6. Bake 8 minutes
7. Remove from oven
8. Turn each wedge over
9. Continue baking for 2 to 5 minutes or until wedges are golden brown and crisp
10. Meanwhile , in large mixer bowl beat mayonnaise , cream cheese , garlic salt and hot pepper sauce on medium speed , scraping bowl often , until smooth
11. By hand , stir in 1 1 / 2 cups cheese and artichoke hearts
12. Spread artichoke mixture in 9-inch pie pan
13. Sprinkle with tomato , onions and remaining cheese
14. Bake for 12 to 15 minutes or until heated through
15. Serve with pita chips

title: grilled shrimp w 2 sauces
steps:
1. Heat the grill to medium-high
2. For lemon sauce , whisk ingredients together
3. For butter sauce , melt butter in small pan or microwave
4. Add worcestershire , garlic , stir place shrimp in large bowl , toss with oil , salt , pepper
5. Place on grill for 3 minutes , turn over and grill 3 minutes more
6. Serve with sauces and lots of napkins

title: grilled corned beef
steps:
1. Soak the beef for about 30 minutes per pound and no less than 2 hours
2. You can do this overnight
3. You also need to change the water a couple times and rinse the corned beef off when you change the water
4. Place the seasonings in a pan to warm then grind them
5. Rub this on the rinsed and dried corned beef brisket
6. Corned beef is frequently sold with a spice packet you can use it in place of the spices i have listed
7. You want it to get deep inside so the flavors will spread
8. Braise:
9. Rinse and simmer your corned beef for 1 hour
10. Hopefully in guinness and some carrots , onions , and parsnips
11. )
12. Remove meat and place on paper towels to dry
13. Lightly spread olive oil over corned beef
14. Being careful not the burn your hands
15. The liquid can be use for potaoes
16. Grill:
17. Over high heat sear the simmered beef over high heat just to get grill marks
18. Remove to indirect heat with a drip pan below it
19. You can add some beer to the drip pan for some steaming
20. You want to grill your corned beef for about 1 to 2 hours at a low temperature of 250 degrees f
21. Charcoal and hardwoods will give you better flavors but you can use a gas grill
22. Over indirect heat and use a drip pan under the corned beef
23. Grill until the internal temperature of the meat reached more than 165 degrees f
24. Meanwhile prepare glaze:
25. Mix the glaze ingredients together
26. Cook over medium heat , stirring constantly , until mixture comes to a boil
27. Spread over cooked meat then proceed with cooking
28. Baste the corned beef every 30 minutes
29. Remove and let sit 10 minutes before slicing
30. Pop open a stout and serve with your favorite irish sides

title: beef burgers from n z
steps:
1. Mix ingredients together with a fork until well combined
2. I like to add 1tsp crushed garlic to mix but it is not essential
3. Shape into patties sized to suit and dust lightly with cornflour
4. Grill or pan-fry for approx 4-5mins each side on med-high heat
5. These are good for barbques as part of a platter , or serve in burger buns or toasted bread slices with other fillings of choice such as , tomato slices , shredded or leaves of lettuce , a pineapple slice , onion slices , cheese and of course your favourite sauce !

title: oven baked lamb with eggplant  peppers   spices
steps:
1. Place oil in a pan with all of the spices and tomato paste , and heat for 2-3 minutes until an aroma starts to develop
2. Place the meat in a casserole or oven-proof dish and pour over the hot spice mixture
3. Work through the meat
4. Mix in all the other ingredients aside from the fresh herbs and lemon zest
5. Cover tightly and bake for 2 hours at 150c until lamb is meltingly tender
6. Just before serving mix through lemon zest and chopped herbs
7. Adjust seasonings to taste
8. Recipe easily doubles cook in a covered roasting dish
9. Substitute beef for the lamb and add other vegetables such as zucchini , mixed peppers or okra
10. The vegetarian variation: use a cup or two of cooked chickpeas instead of the meat along with your choice of vegies

title: cherry berry smoothies
steps:
1. In blender , combine cranberry juice , cherries , raspberries , honey , and lemon juice
2. Cover and blend until smooth

title: super easy chocolate pancakes or waffles
steps:
1. Combine pancake mix , cocoa and sugar in large bowl
2. Stir in water with wire whisk until large lumps disappear
3. Add walnuts and chocolate chips , stir until evenly mixed
4. Let batter rest for five minutes
5. Cook according to package directions

title: butternut squash   cauliflower soup
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , sautee the onion and garlic until golden
2. Add cauliflower , apples and squash and stir together
3. Add broth and spices
4. Bring to a boil and simmer for 30 minutes or until vegetables are soft
5. Either with a blender , stick blender or food mill , puree the soup until creamy
6. Season with salt and pepper
7. If desired , swirl in sour cream

title: weiner schnitzel  veal cutlettes with lemon
steps:
1. Pound veal with a meat pounder until very thin , being careful not to tear the meat
2. If you don't have veal , you can also use pork or chicken cutlets
3. I have used all 3 at one time or another and they are all delicious
4. Beat the eggs with lemon juice
5. Set aside
6. Combine bread crumbs , cheese , and seasonings
7. Dip the veal in egg mixture and then in the bread crumb mixture , coating evenly
8. Place the meat on a cookie sheet in single layer and refrigerate , covered with wax paper , for at least 1 hour to help keep coating intact when cooking
9. Saute veal until lightly browned on both sides , 7-10 minutes in all , in butter or olive oil
10. Serve immediately , garnished with lemon wedges and parsley

title: chicken with tabbouleh  barefoot contessa  ina garten
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
2. In a heat-proof bowl , pour the boiling water over the bulgur wheat
3. Add the lemon juice , 1 / 4 cup olive oil , and 1 teaspoons of salt
4. Stir
5. Cover the bowl with plastic wrap and allow the bulgur to stand at room temperature for about 1 hour
6. Place the chicken breast on a baking sheet and rub it with olive oil
7. Sprinkle liberally with salt and pepper
8. Roast for 35 to 40 minutes , until just cooked
9. Set aside until cool enough to handle
10. Remove the chicken meat from the bones and discard the skin
11. Cut the chicken into medium dice and add to the tabbouleh
12. Add the scallions , mint , parsley , cucumber , tomatoes , 1 teaspoon salt , and 1 teaspoon pepper
13. Season , to taste , and serve immediately or cover and refrigerate
14. The flavors will improve as it sits

title: potato   bacon flan
steps:
1. Liberally butter a 9 inch non stick baking dish& line the bottom with parchment paper
2. Butter the parchment also
3. Place potatoes in salted water , bring to a boil& cook until tender- about 8 minutes
4. Drain& set aside
5. Cook the bacon in a saute pan over medium high heat until browned- or under the broiler
6. Blot excess fat from bacon with a paper towel , cut into 1 inch pieces& set aside
7. Cook the onions in a small amount of bacon fat until they begin to brown , about 5 minutes
8. Add to the bacon pieces& stir the mixture
9. Evenly layer 1 / 3 of the potatoes in the prepared baking dish
10. Season with salt& pepper
11. Scatter 1 / 2 the bacon / onion mixture& 1 / 2 the cheese on top
12. Repeat these layers and finish with the last 1 / 3 of the potatoes
13. Season to taste and dot with a few pieces of butter
14. Bake in a preheated 375f oven for 30 minutes or until starting to turn golden brown
15. Remove from the oven& let rest for 5 minutes
16. Cover with a piece of foil or parchment and , using your hand , gently compress the pie so it will hold together better
17. Run a thin spatula or knife around the edges& a little of the pan bottom to loosen the potatoes from the edge
18. Invert onto a serving platter , gently remove the parchment and cut into wedges or slices

title: lemon cream pie cafe
steps:
1. Brew the coffee and pour it into your cup
2. Add the lemon extract , splenda and creamer
3. Stir and enjoy

title: black pepper cinnamon honey with fruit and ice cream
steps:
1. Heat the honey , pepper , and cinnamon stick in a small pot over low heat
2. When ready to serve , add the fruit to the honey mixture and toss
3. Put a scoop of ice cream into each serving dish and top with the honey mixture
4. Garnish with cookies and serve

title: caramelized pecans  raw foods
steps:
1. Soak pecans overnight in 2 cups of water
2. Drain and rinse
3. Spread the pecans on a dry towel and blot them dry
4. Toss with honey , vanilla , cinnamon , nutmeg , and sea salt
5. Marinate 30-60 minutes
6. Spread on dehydrator trays and dehydrate 12-20 hours or until dry
7. Store in an air-tight container in a cool , dry place

title: pineapple garlic pork chops
steps:
1. Honey mustard instead of combining dijon mustard and honey
2. In a bowl , combine pineapple , mustard , honey , garlic and salt
3. Place mixture in a large resealable plastic bag
4. Add the pork chops to the bag , seal the bag and turn to coat pork chops
5. Refrigerate pork chops in the bag and remaining mixture separately for up to 24 hours
6. In a nonstick skillet , brown pork chops in the canola oil for apx 5 minutes per side over a medium heat
7. Add reserved pineapple mixture to the skillet ,
8. Reduce heat to low and cover and cook for 8 - 10 minutes or until juices run clear
9. Enjoy !

title: black pepper cake
steps:
1. Cream margarine until it resembles whipped cream
2. Add brown sugar and stir
3. Add white sugar and vailla
4. Beat well
5. Add eggs , one at a time , beat after each
6. Sift together dry ingredients
7. Add to mixture , alternating with buttermilk
8. Beat well and pour into greased and floured pans
9. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes at 350 degrees
10. Bundt pans take about 40 minutes
11. If loaf pan us used , and can be , bake for 45 to 60 minutes at 325 degrees

title: oreo cookie cheesecake with chocolate glaze
steps:
1. Crust:
2. Mix 2 cups cookie crumbs , melted butter , brown sugar , and cinnamon in a medium bowl
3. Firmly press mixture evenly into bottom and 1 inch up sides of a 10-inch springform pan
4. Bake at 350 f
5. For 5 minutes
6. Set aside
7. Filling:
8. In a large bowl , beat cream cheese at medium speed of an electric mixer until smooth
9. Gradually add 1 1 / 4 cups sugar , beating well
10. Add 1 / 3 cup whipping cream , flour , and 1 teaspoons vanilla
11. Beat well
12. Add eggs , one at a time , beating after each addition
13. Pour 1 / 3 of batter into prepared pan
14. Top with 1 1 / 2 cups crushed cookie pieces
15. Pour in remaining batter
16. Bake at 350 f
17. For 45 minutes
18. Sour cream layer:
19. Combine sour cream , 1 / 4 cup sugar , and 1 teaspoons vanilla
20. Spread evenly on cheesecake
21. Bake at 350 f
22. For 7 minutes
23. Turn oven off and leave in oven 30 minutes
24. Remove cheesecake and let cool completely on a wire rack
25. Chocolate glaze:
26. Combine 1 cup whipping cream and chocolate chips in a saucepan
27. Stir over low heat until chocolate melts
28. Stir in 1 t vanilla
29. Pour mixture over cheesecake while still warm
30. Refrigerate at least 8 hours before serving
31. Remove about 1 / 2 hour to 1 hour before serving , remove ring from springform pan
32. Decoratively place 14-16 whole oreo cookies around edges of cheesecake
33. Serve chilled
34. Cook time does not include chill time

title: rosemary and herb fried potatoes in olive oil
steps:
1. Wash , then slice your beautiful fresh red potato into 1 / 8 inch slices
2. Put olive oil into a 12-inch skillet , and heat over med / high heat
3. Add potato slices to skillet
4. Cover and reduce heat to med / low
5. Sautee potatoes for about 10 minutes , checking constantly to make sure they don't get too brown
6. After about 10 minutes , when potatoes are brown on bottom layer , turn the whole layer
7. Brown the underside just a couple of minutes till slightly brown
8. Add herbs and water
9. Cover and cook till potatoes are tender
10. Sometimes i end up with crispy parts , and sometimes i don't , but they are great either way

title: mandarin orange almond salad
steps:
1. Toss lettuce , celery , parsley , and green onions
2. Mix oil , vinegar , tabasco , sugar , salt and pepper
3. Dress salad , sprinkle with oranges and almonds , serve

title: whole wheat pumpkin bread
steps:
1. Cream together brown sugar and eggs
2. Add pumpkin and oil and beat well
3. Add remaining ingredients and beat well
4. Pour into two greased and floured loaf pans
5. Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour and 10 minutes , or until a toothpick inserted in middle comes out clean
6. Makes 2 loaves

title: lobster florentine crepes
steps:
1. Over medium heat in a medium sized saucepan , heat butter and add garlic , onions , and mushrooms
2. Saute until soft
3. Add walnuts , black pepper , lemon , spinach and white sauce
4. Blend thoroughly and remove from heat
5. In individual shallow baking dishes , assemble crepes
6. Place 2 oz
7. Of lobster in each crepe , top with spinach mixture , and wrap each crepe
8. Place in baking dish , approximately 2 to a dish , with folded side down
9. Bake in preheated oven for 10 minutes at 350 degrees
10. While crepes are baking , make hollandaise sauce
11. Remove crepes from oven , top with hollandaise , garnish with chopped parsley and paprika and serve

title: tofu cottage cheese  vegan
steps:
1. In a small bowl , rinse and crumble tofu
2. Place remaining ingredients in blender and blend until smooth
3. Add just enough pickle juice or water to form a creamy sauce
4. Pour blended sauce over crumbled tofu and mix well
5. Chill and serve

title: anns rum meltaways
steps:
1. Cream everything but flour
2. Stir in flour
3. Drop by teaspoons on un greased cookie sheet , 2" apart
4. Bake at 400 for 8 minute
5. Cool two minutes on sheet
6. Then roll in confex sugar and set on paper to cool
7. When totally cool roll again in sugar or shake sugar on as you put them in a can

title: sucre a la creme
steps:
1. Combine first 3 ingredients in a saucepan and heat , stirring , until boiling
2. Reduce heat and simmer for 15 minutes
3. Remove from heat
4. Add remaining ingredients and mix
5. Spread into ungreased 8x8 inch pan
6. Cool to room temerature and then cut into squares

title: best blueberry pie
steps:
1. Combine first five ingredients in mixing bowl and mix
2. Line a 9 inch pie plate with bottom crust
3. Pour mixture into bottom pie crust
4. Dot with butter and cover with top crust
5. Cut holes in top crust to vent
6. Cover crust edges with pie ring or foil
7. Bake at 375 for 25 minutes
8. Remove foil and continue to bake for about 15 minutes or until golden brown

title: williamsburg turkey soup
steps:
1. Place turkey carcass and water in dutch oven
2. Bring to a boil
3. Cover , reduce heat , simmer 1 hour
4. Remove carcass and pick off meat
5. Broth should measure 3 quarts
6. Heat butter in dutch oven
7. Add flour and cook over medium heat stirring constantly 5 minutes
8. Stir onion , carrot and celery into roux
9. Cook over medium heat 10 minutes , stirring often
10. Add broth , turkey , rice , salt and pepper
11. Bring to a boil
12. Cover , reduce heat
13. Simmer 20 minutes
14. Add half and half
15. Heat through

title: braised coconut cabbage
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , saute onions , and butter until onions soften
2. Add cabbage and cook , stirring , until cabbage begins to lose its crispness
3. Stir in unsweetened coconut milk , and season with salt and pepper
4. Simmer 5 minutes or more or until cabbage and onion is done to your liking

title: steak soup
steps:
1. Brown ground beef , remove from pan and set aside
2. Add to same pan , oil , carrots , onion , and celery , cover and cook till veggies are soft about 5 minutes
3. Gradually add beef broth , and tomatoes , water , worcestershire sauce , salt and pepper
4. Return ground beef to pan bring to a boil and simmer about 25 minutes
5. Stir in frozen peas and parsley and simmer 5 minutes more

title: amish pineapple delight
steps:
1. In a bowl , mix orange gelatin according to instructions
2. In separate bowl , mix lemon gelatin according to package directions
3. Put in refrigerator till each is set
4. Drain pineapple and cherries
5. Cut gelatin into cubes
6. In a large bowl , combine all ingredients
7. Chill several hours and serve

title: aunt diane s bacon scallops with portabella parmesan pasta
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450
2. Wrap each scallop with 1 / 2 slice of bacon and secure with toothpick
3. Place in single layer on foil lined baking sheet with sides so grease doesn't spill
4. Place in oven for 15-25 minutes , depending on size of your scallops
5. Watch closely as you want the bacon to be crispy but you don't want the scallops to be rubbery
6. While scallops are baking , saute garlic and portabello mushroom in 3 tablespoons olive oil over medium heat for 3-4 minutes
7. Toss garlic and mushrooms with pasta and parmesan , adding more olive oil if desired
8. Once scallops are removed from oven , place with pasta and serve
9. Enjoy !

title: leanna s satay sauce
steps:
1. Put everything in a pan
2. Stir over medium heat until it is smooth
3. If it is too thick , add a little water
4. Or if you want it creamier , add a little coconut milk

title: spinach stuffed shells with a mushroom sauce
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Spray a 9x13 inch pan with nonstick spray
3. Soak mushrooms in hot water
4. In a large saute pan , pour oil saute onions and garlic 1 minute add spinach cook till wilted
5. Remove spinach from pan leaving some garlic and onions in pan
6. Chop the soaked mushrooms and add to pan with the remaining onions and garlic
7. Add the mushroom soaking water , white wine and herbs
8. Season with salt and pepper
9. Cook till liquid is all absorbed
10. Add crushed tomatoes
11. Simmer while preparing shells
12. Squeeze liquid from cooled spinach and place juice into sauce and spinach into a bowl with cheeses , egg , nutmeg
13. Mix to blend
14. Adding salt and pepper to taste
15. Spoon evenly into shells and place into pan
16. Pour sauce over shells
17. Reserving some sauce for serving at the table
18. Bake covered for 30 minutes
19. Garnish with grated cheese
20. Mangia !

title: frozen french toast  oamc
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients except the bread in a large bowl
2. Dip each slice of bread in mixture so it is soaked through
3. Brown on both sides in margarine over medium heat
4. Let cool on cooling racks completely
5. Once the slices have cooled completely , retuns to bread bag alternating with wax paper to avoid the slices sticking together
6. Freeze until ready to eat
7. Reheat in toaster when ready to eat

title: pumpkin brioche
steps:
1. First day:
2. Place pumpkin in a small saucepan and warm over low heat to a temperature of 105-110f
3. Remove from heat and stir in brown sugar and yeast
4. Let stand 10 minutes
5. Place flour , salt , cinnamon , nutmeg and cloves in the food processor and process 10 seconds
6. Add pumpkin mixture and eggs and process 30 seconds , stopping once to scrape bowl
7. With machine running , add the butter and process 20 seconds
8. Dough will be very sticky
9. Place dough in an oiled bowl
10. Cover with oiled plastic wrap and let rise in a warm place until almost tripled in bulk , about 3 hours
11. Punch down , using lightly floured hands
12. Cover bowl tightly and refrigerate overnight
13. Second day:
14. Generously grease 24 muffin cups
15. Remove dough from refrigerator and place on a lightly floured surface
16. Turn dough to coat with flour
17. Divide dough into 24 portions and press into muffin cups
18. Using sharp scissors , make a 1 / 4" deep cut in the top of each roll
19. Cover with oiled plastic wrap and let rise until doubled in size , about 1 1 / 2-2 hours
20. Preheat oven to 425f
21. Beat egg and salt together and brush over tops of rolls
22. Try not to let it run down the sides
23. Place on center rack of oven and bake for 5 minutes
24. Reduce heat to 350f
25. Bake 5 minutes more , or until browned
26. Serve immediately , or cool and freeze

title: boneless pork chops with gravy
steps:
1. Place chops in ziplock bag add the dressing
2. Marinade for 3 hours
3. Drain dressing off and flour and fry in frying pan
4. Drain any oil left over and put the chops back in fring pan
5. Mix soup and milk together and pour over chops
6. Let simmer till they are tender
7. Gravy is great over potatoes

title: cold 3 bean salad
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients well together
2. Chill overnight for best flavors

title: apple walnut cake with cider sauce
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees
2. Coat a 10-inch tube pan with removable tube insert with nonstick spray
3. Whisk sugar , oil , apple cider , eggs , vanilla , cinnamon , nutmeg , baking soda and salt in a large bowl until blended
4. Stir in flour until blended
5. Stir in apples and walnuts
6. Scrape mixture into prepared pan
7. Bake 1 hour and 10 to 20 minutes
8. Let cool in pan on wire rack 1 hour
9. Remove sides of pan
10. Cool completely before lifting cake off bottom of pan
11. For cider sauce ,
12. Whisk cider , brown sugar and cornstarch in a medium saucepan until blended
13. Place over medium-high heat and bring to a boil , whisking occasionally
14. Boil 1 minute or until slightly thickened
15. Remove from heat and add butter and vanilla
16. Stir until butter melts
17. Let cool to room temperature or refrigerate until serving

title: mulligatawny soup with lentils
steps:
1. Puree the ginger and garlic in a blender or food processor
2. Heat oil and add onion and ginger and garlic , until tender
3. Add the mustard seed and cook until they begin to pop
4. Add in garam masal , tandoor spice mix , curry salt , cardamom and cayenne and stir to coat onion , ginger and garlic
5. Add the tomatoes and simmer for 5 minutes
6. Add the stock and lentils and bring the mixture to a boil
7. Reduce heat , partially cover and simmer for 1 hour , until the lentils are tender stir in coconut milk and simmer 2 minutes
8. Remove from heat and stir in spinach and lemon juice and sugar
9. Garnish with cilantro

title: baked panko chicken nuggets
steps:
1. Cut chicken into bite size nugget pieces
2. Mix in bowl with oil , garlic , salt , pepper and chili power to taste
3. You can add variety here , but using whatever type of seasonings you want !
4. Allow to marinate for 30 minutes
5. Do not drain
6. Stir in panko bread crumbs into the chicken until well coated and allow to sit for 5-10 minutes to absorb the moisture and stick better
7. Bake in a glass dish for 15 minutes at 475 degrees
8. Serve with dipping sauces

title: mashed canned potatoes with toppings oven style
steps:
1. Cut the potatoes into slices , then mash with a fork or mixer
2. On the road i didn't have a mixer
3. Add all of the ingredients except the toppings
4. If you need a little more milk , add
5. Grease a 8 or 12 cup muffin pan or raised side square baking pan
6. Place mashed potatoes in the pan
7. Make dents with a spoon every four inches in the square pan
8. Make a dents in each muffin cup
9. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
10. Cover with foil
11. Bake 20 to 25 minutes
12. Gas ovens seem to be hotter than electric ovens
13. Add all toppings in the order given , except the sour cream
14. Cover with foil , bake about 5 to 7 minutes
15. Let set about 5 minutes covered
16. Use a heat resistant spatula to take out of muffin tin or cut into squares from pan
17. Add dollop of sour cream if desired
18. Serve

title: something special mashed potatoes
steps:
1. Peel and cut potatoes into small chunks
2. Boil in salted water until you cannot pick up a piece with a fork
3. Drain all the water from the potatoes and place all ingredients in a large mixing bowl
4. Beat until creamy smooth
5. Serve hot

title: chicken enchiladas with green sauce
steps:
1. Place chicken pieces in large pot and cover with 1 1 / 2 quarts water
2. Add celery , onion , salt and pepper and cook until chicken is tender , about 40 minutes
3. Remove chicken from broth and set aside to cool
4. Strain stock and reduce further , if necessary , until 1 quart remains
5. Reserve for sauce
6. For sauce :
7. Combine all ingredients except butter and flour in large saucepan
8. Bring to boil over medium heat , stirring occasionally , and skimming foam off as it rises to the surface
9. Reduce heat and simmer , stirring occasionally , until sauce is the consistancy of puree gently piercing tomatillos with a fork as they become soft
10. Strain sauce and return to pan
11. Combine butter and flour to form a paste
12. Add to sauce and cook over medium heat until sauce returns to boil and thickens slightly
13. Set aside and keep hot
14. For filling :
15. Combine peppers , onion , tomatoes , and chilies in a large skillet
16. Place over medium heat and cook until soft , stirring constantly and moistening with chicken stock if necessary
17. Remove meat from cooled chicken and shred
18. Add chicken to filling and cook a few minutes more
19. Mix well and salt and pepper to taste
20. To assemble :
21. Preheat oven to 250 degrees
22. Lightly oil skillet and fry tortillas about 10 to 20 seconds on each side until soft
23. Roll each tortilla gently in paper towel to remove excess oil and keep pliable
24. Place about 1 / 4 cup filling in each tortilla , roll up and place seam side down in a lightly greased 9x13 baking dish
25. Top each with a thin slice of cheese
26. Bake until heated through and cheese melts , about 20 minutes
27. Cover with hot green sauce , and top each enchilada with sour cream and olive slices
28. Serve immediately

title: macaroni and cheese  betty crocker
steps:
1. Preheat oven at 350f
2. Cook macaroni according to package directions
3. Drain
4. For cheese sauce , in a saucepan melt butter
5. Cook onion in butter till tender but not brown
6. Stir in the flour , salt , and pepper
7. Add milk all at once
8. Cook and stir till thickened and bubbly
9. Cook and stir 1 to 2 minutes more
10. Add cubed cheese
11. Stir till melted
12. Stir macaroni into cheese cause
13. Turn into a 1 1 / 2 quart casserole
14. Arrange tomato slices atop macaroni
15. Sprinkle with a little salt
16. Bake in a 350f oven 30 to 45 minutes or until heated through

title: very low cal banana oat cookies
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients , beating well
2. Let stand 5 minutes so oats will absorb moisture
3. Drop dough by heaping teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheets
4. Bake at 350 degrees for 15-20 minutes
5. Let stand 1 minute on cookie sheets
6. Transfer to wire racks and cool

title: fettuccine chicken salad
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Slice the chicken breasts lengthwise into 1-inch strips
3. Place chicken on a baking sheet , sprinkle with 1 teaspoon of house seasoning and all of the thyme and then drizzle with olive oil
4. Bake for 15-20 minutes or until cooked through
5. While the chicken is cooking , cook the pasta according to directions on package
6. Drain and rinse with cold water
7. Drain well and place in large bowl for tossing
8. Remove chicken from baking sheet , set aside
9. Pour the juices from the baking sheet into a med
10. Bowl
11. To the bowl add mayonnaise , green onion , parsley , basil , the remaining 1 teaspoons of house seasoning , and the seasoning salt and stir until well blended
12. Pour the dressing over the pasta and toss gently
13. Place the chicken strips on top of the pasta
14. Garnish with tomato wedges and some green onion
15. ~~house seasoning~~ 1 cup salt , 1 / 4 cup black pepper , 1 / 4 cup garlic powder--mix ingredients together and store in an airtight container for up to 6 months

title: oriental vegetable  noodle soup
steps:
1. Combine the chicken broth , soy sauce , scallions , and peas in a large saucepan
2. Bring to a boil
3. Reduce heat , cover , and simmer for an additional 5 minutes
4. Add the bean sprouts , mushrooms , and ginger
5. Simmer for 5 more minutes
6. Add the cooked noodles and heat for 2-3 minutes
7. Serve hot

title: creamy macaroni and cheese
steps:
1. Cook macaroni according to package directions
2. Meanwhile , in a large saucepan , melt butter
3. Stir in flour until smooth
4. Gradually add milk
5. Bring to a boil
6. Cook and stir for 2 minutes
7. Reduce heat
8. Stir in the sour cream , process cheese , parmesan cheese , salt , mustard and pepper until cheese is melted and smooth
9. Drain macaroni
10. Toss with cheddar cheese
11. Transfer to a greased 3-qt
12. Baking dish
13. Add cream sauce and mix well
14. Bake , uncovered , at 350 for 35-40 minutes or until golden brown and bubbly

title: butter pecan ice cream
steps:
1. Melt butter in a heavy skillet over a low heat
2. Add the pecans and salt and saut , stirring constantly , until pecans start to turn brown
3. Drain the butter into a small bowl and transfer the pecans to another bowl and let cool
4. Whisk the eggs in a mixing bowl until light and fluffy , 1 to 2 minutes
5. Whisk the sugar , a little at a time , then continue whisking until completely blended , about 1 minute more
6. Pour in the cream and milk and whisk to blend
7. Add the melted butter and blend
8. Transfer the mixture to an ice cream maker and freeze following the manufacturer's instructions
9. After the ice cream stiffens , add the pecans , then continue freezing until the ice cream is ready
10. Makes generous 1 quart
11. Sweet cream bases----:
12. Favorite sweet cream base: most popular base , has creamy texture , medium body , and a subtle , understated taste
13. It's especially good as a background for fruit , cookies , and candy
14. 2 large eggs 3 / 4 cup sugar 2 cups heavy or whipping cream 1 cup milk whisk the eggs in a mixing bowl until light and fluffy , 1 to 2 minutes
15. Whisk in the sugar , a little at a time , then continue whisking until completely blended , about 1 minute more
16. Pour in the cream and milk and whisk to blend
17. Simple sweet cream base: this simple recipe is made with a minimum of ingredients and requires no cooking
18. It makes a very creamy ice cream with 25% butterfat , but it does not store well in home freezers , so be prepared to eat it all
19. 2 cups heavy or whipping cream 3 / 4 cup sugar 2 / 3 cup half-and-half pour the cream into a mixing bowl
20. Whisk in the sugar , a little at a time , then continue whisking until completely blended , about 1 minute more
21. Pour in the half-and-half and whisk to blend
22. Condensed milk sweet cream base: this recipe makes a less creamy , less rich ice cream
23. Ben likes the slightly "cooked" flavor of the sweetened condensed milk
24. 2 cups light cream 1 cup sweetened condensed milk , cold whisk the light cream and the sweetened condensed milk together in a mixing bowl until blended

title: chimichurri stuffed pork loin
steps:
1. With kitchen shears , snip 2 tablespoons parsley and 2 tablespoons cilantro , and combine with 1 / 2 teaspoon lime zest , 1 tablespoon oil , and 1 clove of garlic
2. Set aside
3. Butterfly pork loin and brush with oil
4. Spread remaining garlic on cut side of pork loin , season with pepper , and add remaining parsley , cilantro and lime zest
5. Roll loin back to original shape and tie at 2 inch intervals with kitchen string
6. Spread reserved herb mixture over outside of pork and season with black pepper
7. Grill pork over medium , indirect heat , covered , until internal thermometer registers 150 degrees f , about 1 to 1 1 / 2 hours
8. Meanwhile , brush corn with melted butter and season with salt and pepper
9. Grill corn during last 20 minutes of grilling the pork , turning occasionally
10. Grill pineapples during last 5 to 10 minutes of pork grilling time
11. When pork is done , remove pork and cover with foil
12. Let rest 10 minutes
13. Remove string , slice and serve

title: delicious green smoothie
steps:
1. Using blender , blend the water , kale , and mint
2. Then add the banana and mango and blend again
3. Serve and enjoy

title: hot water pastry
steps:
1. Put shortening in a medium bowl and boil the water
2. Pour water over shortening and blend till all the water is absorbed and the mixture is smooth
3. Add the flour , salt and baking soda
4. I put the soda and salt in the first cup of flour and mix in one cup at a time in case you don't need all of the flour
5. Usually you do
6. Once it is mixed and in one large ball , you can then cut this down to 3 individual balls of dough , wrap in plastic wrap and chill for at least 2 hours
7. If you want a larger pie crust , just do 2 balls of dough
8. If you do not use all the dough it can be kept in the fridge for about a week or so or even frozen
9. Bake these pie crusts up as you would any others
10. I usually bake them at 350-400 for 12-15 minutes , or till golden brown
11. Follow instructions for double crust fruit pies when using those recipes

title: curtido de repollo   el salvadorean cabbage salad
steps:
1. Using a hand-grater or the grater attachment of your food processor , shred cabbage , carrots and onion
2. Combine all ingredients in a large mixing bowl
3. Use the back of a wooden spoon to press all the ingredients down so they are submerged in liquid
4. Allow to rest at room temperature or in the refrigerator before serving , ideally for at least 4-6 hours
5. Serve with pupusas , or as a topping for fish , quesadillas , or other dishes

title: gretchen s baklava
steps:
1. You should make baklava at least 24 hours ahead of time -- a week is best
2. The longer you let the baklava sit , the better it gets
3. After you have everything gathered and the nut mixture done , you can assemble the baklava in about 45 minutes -- the time before you need to start working on the syrup for the batch in the oven
4. Use those darn corner and funky shaped edge pieces to test how it's doing or as your private reward !
5. Remember that the frozen phyllo dough needs to thaw in the refrigerator for around 6 hours
6. If you thaw it at room temperature , the individual sheets of phyllo dough will stick together
7. Once you open the phyllo dough you will want to keep working
8. Half sheets work better
9. You can melt all of the butter and keep it in a crock pot on low so you don't have to melt butter as you go
10. Preheat the oven to 300f
11. Combine and set aside walnuts , 1 / 2 cup sugar , and cinnamon
12. Using a pastry brush , lightly brush the bottom and sides of a jelly roll pan with melted butter
13. Open the phyllo dough and layer 6 whole leafs in the pan , buttering each layer as you go
14. Spread 1 cup of the walnut mixture
15. Cut the remaining phyllo dough in half
16. Layer 8 half sheets -- butter each layer
17. Each sheet will be an inch or so short , so stagger the sheets from corner to corner to cover the whole pan
18. Spread 1 cup of the walnut mixture
19. Repeat 8 sheets and walnut mixture twice
20. You will end up with 4 layers of nuts
21. Layer the remaining half sheets on top -- butter each layer
22. Brush the top with the remaining butter
23. Trim the edges off
24. Cut halfway through the layers using the pattern shown
25. This is done now since it will be very fragile after it's been baked
26. Bake 1 hour or until golden brown
27. 15 minutes before the baklava should be done , mix 1 cup sugar , water , and lemon juice in a sauce pan
28. Cook sauce over a medium heat , stirring occasionally for 15 minutes
29. Remove from heat , add the honey and vanilla , and stir until well blended
30. Remove the baklava from the oven and finish cutting through the layers
31. Pour the sauce over the hot baklava
32. Cool
33. Let it sit for at least 24 hours -- longer if you can stand it !
34. A nice way to serve individual pieces is to put each one into a muffin cup that has been partially flattened

title: tinga
steps:
1. Put the chicken into a large pot with 1 / 4 c sliced onion , garlic and enough water to cover
2. Bring to a boil and cook until the chicken is no longer pink , about 25 minutes
3. Remove chicken , cool , and shred meat
4. If using bone-in chicken , discard skin and bones
5. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat
6. Add remaining onion slices , and fry until transparent
7. If using fresh tomatoes , place them in a pan of boiling water and boil until they split open
8. Place the tomatoes , chipotle peppers , and boullion into a blender or food processor
9. Process until smooth
10. Pour into a large pan and add the shredded chicken and cooked onions
11. Heat through
12. To serve , spread a layer of sour cream on a tostada , top with the chicken and shredded lettuce

title: inspired rice
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients in a pot
2. Bring to a boil
3. Stir , cover and lower heat
4. Cook for 15 minutes
5. Do not lift lid
6. Turn off heat and allow to stand for 5 minutes without lifting lid
7. Lift lid and fluff with a fork
8. Serve

title: crumb topped sole
steps:
1. Combine the mayonnaise , 2 tablespoons parmesan cheese , mustard seed and pepper
2. Spread over tops of fillets
3. Place on broiler pan coated with nonstick cooking spray
4. Broil 4-inches from heat for 3 to 5 minutes or until fish flakes easily with a fork
5. Meanwhile , in a small bowl , combine the bread crunbs , onion , ground mustard and remaining parmesan cheese
6. Stir in butter
7. Spoon over fillets
8. Spriz topping with nonstick cooking spray
9. Broil 1 to 2 minutes longer or until golden brown , enjoy

title: blueberry banana surprise
steps:
1. For crust: mix graham crackers crumbs , melted margarine and 1 / 4 cup sugar in a 9x13 glass pan
2. Press into the bottom of the pan to make a crust
3. Chill in the refrigerator while making the topping
4. In a deep bowl , mix cream cheese , dream whip , milk and 1 / 2 cup sugar with a hand mixer until smooth
5. Pour cream cheese mixture over crust
6. Slice bananas in 1 / 4 inch slices and cover cream cheese mixture
7. Pour blueberry pie filling over bananas and spread evenly
8. Chill until ready to serve

title: teresa s peanut butter chews
steps:
1. Put corn flakes in a large mixing bowl and set aside
2. Bring corn syrup and sugar to boil in medium pan
3. Remove from heat and add peanut butter , mix well
4. Pour mixture over cereal and quickly mix well
5. Drop by spoonfuls onto wax paper
6. Let cool
7. Place in airtight container

title: caramel cupcakes with butterscotch frosting
steps:
1. Position a rack in the lower third of the oven and heat the oven to 350 degrees
2. Line 12 standard-size muffin cups with paper liners
3. Make the caramel: bring 1 / 3 cup water to a boil in a small saucepan
4. Keep it very hot
5. Put the 1 / 3 cup sugar in a heavy-based 8-inch skillet or shallow saucepan
6. Set the pan over medium heat
7. Shake the pan to level the sugar and leave it alone until it's about half melted
8. Shake and swirl the pan to help the sugar melt completely
9. Cook the melted sugar , constantly swirling or stirring with a wooden spoon , until it bubbles and turns a deep reddish caramel color
10. Immediately take the pan off the heat and carefully drizzle the boiling water over the caramel
11. The mixture will sputter
12. Return the pan to medium heat
13. Stir constantly with the wooden spoon just until the caramel is completely dissolved
14. Pour the caramel into a heatproof liquid measuring cup
15. Pour about 1 / 3 cup water into the empty caramel pan and return to medium heat until very hot , stirring to dissolve any remaining caramel
16. Spoon enough of this liquid into the measuring cup with the caramel to bring the level up to 1 / 2 cup
17. Let cool until warm
18. Make the cupcakes: sift the flour , baking powder and salt into a small bowl
19. In a large bowl , beat the butter with a stand mixer fitted with the paddle attachment on medium speed until smooth , 30 to 60 seconds
20. With the mixer running , slowly pour in the remaining 3 / 4 cup sugar , stop the mixer and scrape the bowl and beaters
21. Beat on medium-high speed until light and fluffy , about 2 minutes
22. Beat in the eggs , one at a time , on medium speed until the batter is smooth , 30 to 60 seconds after each addition
23. Scrape the bowl each time
24. Beat in the vanilla
25. On low speed , add the dry ingredients in three installments , alternating with the caramel
26. Mix only until the batter is smooth
27. Divide the batter evenly among the prepared muffin cups
28. Don't smooth the batter
29. Bake until the cupcakes are golden brown and spring back when gently pressed in the center , 18 to 20 minutes
30. Let the cupcakes cool in the tin for 5 minutes on a wire rack
31. Carefully remove the cupcakes from the tin , set them on the rack and let cool completely
32. Spoon a slightly heaping tablespoon of the frosting on top of each cupcake and use the back of the spoon to spread and swirl the frosting
33. If the frosting starts to stiffen , rewarm it briefly over medium-low heat until it's spreadable
34. Holding a cupcake by its liner , dip it into the chopped pecans , if using , turning to coat the frosting thoroughly
35. Repeat with the remaining cupcakes
36. Let the frosting set for about 30 minutes before serving
37. To make frosting: melt the butter in a heavy 2-or 3-quart saucepan over medium-low heat
38. Add the brown sugar and stir almost constantly with a wooden spoon
39. After 2 to 3 minutes , the sugar will melt and smooth out , and the mixture will begin to bubble
40. Once this happens , stir constantly for 2 minutes
41. Carefully add the 1 / 4 cup cream and stir constantly for another 2 minutes
42. The mixture will thicken slightly and look smooth and glossy
43. Remove the pan from the heat and let cool for 5 minutes , stirring frequently
44. Beat in the confectioners' sugar and vanilla with the wooden spoon
45. If the frosting seems a little dry , beat in more cream , a half tablespoon at a time , until frosting is thick , smooth , and spreadable

title: creamy peppery chicken
steps:
1. Spray a large non-stick skillet with nonfat cooking spray
2. Sprinkle the chicken breast with pepper to taste
3. Place in pan , cover and cook over medium heat for 4-5 minutes
4. Turn the pieces over and reduce the heat to low
5. Put sour cream on top of chicken and in the middle of the pan
6. Cover and continue cooking for 4-5 minutes or until completely cooked and chicken is white all the way through
7. The sour cream will absorb the pepper flavor
8. You may want to go easy with the pepper to start , a little gives a lot of flavor

title: barley rice pilaf
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. In medium skillet , over medium heat , melt butter
3. Add almonds and stir until lightly browned , about 2 mintues
4. Add onion and garlic and saute until tender about 5 minutes
5. Stir in rice and barley
6. Add stock , wine and seasonings
7. Stir and bring to a boil
8. Transfer to 2 1 / 2-quart casserole lightly coated with cooking spray
9. Cover and bake until rice and barley are tender and liquid is absorbed , about 1 hour and 15 minutes

title: that s shallota flavor spaghetti
steps:
1. Heat the extra-virgin olive oil with the butter over medium-low heat in a skillet with high sides
2. Add garlic and shallots and season with salt and pepper then cook gently until caramelized about 20 minutes , stirring occasionally
3. Meanwhile heat a large pot of water to boil for pasta , salt the water very liberally then add spaghetti and bring to a rolling boil
4. Cook to al dente
5. Add 2 ladles of starchy cooking water , about 1 cup , to the shallots and stir
6. Drain pasta and add to shallots
7. Add the parsley and cheese and more black pepper , to taste
8. Toss 1 to 2 minutes for liquid to absorb and serve
9. Wow ! talk about yum-o !

title: mum s  quick   easy throw it all in lemon drizzle cake
steps:
1. Heat oven to 180 degrees celsuis
2. Mix margarine , sugar , flour , milk , eggs , & rind of lemon in a bowl
3. Put in rectangular tin & bake for 40 - 45mins
4. Mix icing sugar with the juice of the lemon & drizzle over the top of the cake whilst still hot
5. Leave to cool then enjoy ! :o)

title: vera s famous noodle dish
steps:
1. Melt 1 stick of butter in pan
2. Cook green pepper and onion until carmalized
3. Add tomatoes and warm thru
4. Cook noodles according to package
5. Add to tomato mixture and stir up good
6. Butter a 9 x 13 pan and put mixture into it
7. Dot top with the remaining 4 tablespoons of butter
8. Bake at 350 degrees until crusty on top
9. Serve as a side dish to beef or chicken or turkey , or as a vegetarian dish --

title: big bend texas style chili
steps:
1. Heat the olive oil in a arge saucepan
2. Add the garlic and onions , and saute over medium-high heat for 5 minutes
3. Add the beef and saute for 7 to 8 minutes longer , while stirring frequently , or until the beef is well browned on all sides
4. Season with salt and pepper , stir in the chili powder , and cook for 2 minutes more
5. Add the tomatoes , tomato paste , beef stock , beer , vinegar , cumin , oregano , and parsley , and stir well to combine
6. Bring to a simmer , turn down the heat to low , and cook , covered , for 45 minutes
7. Add the beans and cook for 15 minutes longer , stirring occasionally
8. Ladle into serving bowls and sprinkle with the goat cheese

title: beef stroganoff with dill
steps:
1. Cut meat into 1 / 4" strips and brown in butter
2. In a separate pan , saute mushrooms and add to meat
3. In the separate pan , saute onions and add to meat mixture
4. Add beef stock
5. Cover and simmer 1 hour
6. At about 40 min
7. , begin to cook noodles
8. Mix corn starch and water in small container and add , stirring rapidly until sauce is thickened
9. Stir in sour cream and dill weed
10. Serve over paprika noodles: drain noodles and p ut in bowl
11. Toss gently with chicken stock base , butter , and paprika
12. Let diners salt and pepper to their own tastes
13. Robert boston

title: swiss   alpine macaroni
steps:
1. Place the potatoes in a large pot and fill with enough water to cover them
2. Bring to a boil and cook until tender
3. Drain and cool slightly , then remove the peels , and slice into 1 / 4 inch thick slices
4. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f and lightly grease a 9x9 inch baking pan
5. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil and add the macaroni and cook until barely tender , about 6 minutes , then drain and set aside
6. Melt the butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat and add the onion and cook and stir until onion starts to turn translucent
7. Next stir in the garlic , and cook for a few more minutes then remove from the heat and set aside
8. Layer the macaroni , onions and potatoes into the prepared baking dish and season with salt and pepper
9. Sprinkle the shredded gruyere cheese over the top , and drizzle cream evenly over the entire dish and bake in the preheated oven until the top is golden brown , 15 to 20 minutes

title: beet  chickpea and almond dip
steps:
1. Cook beets in a medium saucepan of boiling salted water until tender , about 12 minutes
2. Drain and place into food processor , add garbanzo benas , almonds , oil and garlic and blend until smooth
3. Add vinegar and blend , then season to taste with salt and pepper
4. Serve with pita chips or veggies for dipping

title: coconut mound balls
steps:
1. In a medium to large pot , melt the butter
2. Add eagle brand milk and stir well
3. Remove from heat and add coconut , almonds and powdered sugar
4. Stir well
5. Let cool down 15 minutes
6. Shape into small to medium balls
7. Place on a lightly greased pan and put in freezer for 30 minutes to harden
8. After 30 minutes or the balls have harden , remove from freezer and set aside
9. Melt shortening in pan and add chocolate chips
10. Stir until chips melts or until smooth
11. Dip balls in chocolate and place on wax paper and allow to set up

title: chicken in cream sauce
steps:
1. Cut chicken into 1 1 / 2 inch pieces
2. Combine chicken and half the garlic in a skillet with wine over medium heat
3. When chicken is nearly cooked add broccoli and mushrooms
4. In a saucepan , heat cream on medium-high setting
5. Bring to a simmer , but do not boil
6. Add remaining garlic and white pepper
7. Stir corn starch into water
8. Mix
9. Pour in half of the cream
10. Whisk , stirring in the cornstarch mixture until desired thickness is obtained
11. The sauce will continue to thicken gradually as it sits
12. Sauce must be cooked for at least 10 minutes after last corn starch is added to prevent a "powdery" uncooked taste from the corn starch
13. Add chicken and cheese during final 5 minutes of cooking , and serve over pasta or rice

title: georgia cornbread cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Lightly grease and flour a 9x13-inch baking dish
3. Stir together sugar , brown sugar , , eggs and oil in a medium bowl until smooth
4. Stir in flour and vanilla
5. Add pecans and stir until evenly mixed
6. Spoon into prepared pan and bake for 30 to 35 minutes
7. Good served with a dollop of whipped cream , enjoy

title: quick breakfast sandwiches
steps:
1. Trim crusts off bread slices , and spread margarine on 1 side of each bread slice
2. Place 4 slices in a buttered 8-inch square baking pan
3. Top bread slices with chopped ham , and top with remaining bread slices
4. , buttered side up
5. Sprinkle with shredded swiss cheese
6. In a bowl , combine eggs , milk , onion flakes , prepared mustard , and salt and mix well
7. Slowly pour over over bread slices
8. Cover and refrigerate overnight , or for 8 hours
9. Remove baking pan from refrigerator about 10 minutes before cooking
10. Bake uncovered at 325 degrees for 30 minutes or until center is set
11. To serve cut into 4 sandwiches

title: sweet and spicy pork burgers
steps:
1. In a large bowl mix bbq sauce , breadcrumbs , and pepper blend
2. Add pork and mix well
3. Shape into 4 patties
4. Direct grill over medium coals for about 15 minutes , turning halfway through grilling
5. Serve on kaiser rolls , topped with lettuce , tomato , onions , or your favorite toppings !

title: honey cocoa curry marinade for salmon
steps:
1. Dump all ingredients into a ziplock bag and marinade for 1-8 hours
2. Broil or grill salmon until it flakes

title: dr  pat s hot toddy cold remedy
steps:
1. Place the whisky - honey - tea bag:
2. In a large microwave safe mug with 1 cup of very hot water
3. Add the honey
4. Pour the hot water into the mug over the spoon you used for the honey to get off the last little drops
5. Add the lemon juice and stir well
6. Add the lemon slice and serve

title: sunkist cremesicle
steps:
1. Pour the cream into a pint glass
2. If you want , put some ice cubes in next to make it cooler
3. Pour the sunkist in and stir it up until it is well blended
4. Drink and enjoy

title: choco mint chip smoothie
steps: 1. Combine all ingredients in blender

title: ginger   lemon grass crme brule
steps:
1. Pre-heat the oven to 325 degrees
2. Place ginger and the lemongrass into a medium saucepan
3. Add the heavy cream and simmer gently for 25 minutes to infuse the flavours
4. Remove the infusion from the stove and strain through a fine sieve
5. In a mixing bowl whisk together the yolks , the sugar the lemon extract and the bitters
6. Slowly mix in the heavy cream infusion
7. Pour into ramekins or an oven casserole dish
8. Remove any foam from the top of mixture with a teaspoon
9. Place ramekins into a large casserole dish and pour hot water until the level is halfway up the sides of the ramekin dish
10. Put into oven and bake until the custard is firm approximately 40 -50 minutes
11. Remove the ramekins from the water bath and completely cool before you cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate
12. To serve
13. Sprinkle the top with granulated sugar and using a blow torch caramelize the sugar
14. The oven broiler can be used in place of the torch
15. Place the ramekins in a tray of cold water and ice and leave in the broiler for 3-5 minutes--just enough to caramelize the sugar
16. Variations: 1 / 4 teaspoon grated lime peel can be substituted for the lemon grass

title: kritharaki me rize  greek orzo and rice pilaf
steps:
1. Saute orzo in butter in a medium saucepan , until lightly brown
2. Add rice , stir to coat with the butter
3. Add stock
4. Bring to boil
5. Reduce heat to simmer , cover and cook for 25 minutes
6. Serve on a platter with grated kefalotiri cheese if desired

title: anzac biscuits with macadamia nuts
steps:
1. To toast nuts: put them in an ungreased , shallow baking pan in a single layer
2. Bake at 325 for 3 - 5 minutes , stirring once halfway through
3. Once you start smelling them or they are a golden brown , take them out of the oven
4. Don't leave them in the cooking pan
5. Put into another cool pan / plate to cool
6. Chop them
7. Combine the flour , rolled oats , sugar , coconut and cooled macadamia nuts
8. In a small saucepan , combine the water , honey and baking soda
9. Bring to a boil , then stir in the butter
10. Set aside to cool for 5 minutes , then stir into the flour mixture with a wooden spoon
11. Place tablespoons of dough onto the cookie sheets lined with parchment
12. Flatten slightly with the back of the spoon
13. Leave a little room between cookies
14. Bake at 325 for 9 to 12 minutes
15. Remove from the baking sheet to cool on wire racks

title: white house broccoli soup
steps:
1. In a medium-size saucepan , over medium heat , add the garlic , shallots , leeks , onion and thyme
2. Sweat in the butter until fragrant
3. Add the broccoli stem slices and saute until softened
4. Pour in the chicken stock and bay leaf and simmer for about 20 minutes
5. In the meantime , blanch the broccoli
6. Remove the
7. Drain the green
8. Set aside
9. Puree the soup in a blender and strain through a fine chinoise into a large serving bowl
10. At this point , if you really want to , you could add about 1 / 4 cup cream
11. Add the green
12. Serve piping hot

title: dip for fruits
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together and let chill for about 30 minutes
2. Slice apple pieces in quarters
3. Use strawberries , grapes or any fruits
4. It is great , kids will love to eat fruits with this dip

title: tiroler speckknodel  tirolian bacon dumpling
steps:
1. Salt bread cubes
2. Lightly whisk together milk and eggs
3. Pour milk-egg mixture over bread cubes
4. Stir until moistened , cover and let stand 30 minutes
5. Mince bacon and sausage
6. Fry bacon
7. Saute onion in butter , adding parsley and chives
8. Bring the beef stock to a gentle boil
9. Add bacon , sausage , and onion mixture to soaked bread mixture
10. Sprinkle with flour
11. The mixture should be thick enough to form into 8-12 dumplings drop one dumpling into broth and cook about 12 minutes
12. The dumplings should rise to the top when they are done
13. Cut the first dumpling open and check to make sure it is of the proper consistency
14. If it is too hard , add more egg-milk mixture
15. If it is too soft and falls apart , add flour
16. Add remaining dumplings as space allows , cooking approximately 12 minutes each
17. Kndel are served either in broth or over sauerkraut

title: tangerine caipiroshka
steps:
1. Peel the tangerine put it in the glass
2. Sprinkle with the sugar and crush the pieces with a pestle
3. Add the vodka and stir to mix
4. Add the ice and stir again

title: balsamic red pepper jelly
steps:
1. Wash , stem and seed red and jalapeno peppers
2. Finely chop enough red pepper to measure 1 / 2 cup and set aside
3. Puree remaining red and jalapeno peppers and garlic in food processor
4. Pour prepared mixture into dampened jelly bag or cheese cloth lined sieve suspended over a deep container and let drip for 30 minutes
5. While peppers and garlic puree drips , prepare 7 125 ml mason jars and snap lids per canning directions
6. Measure sugar and set aside
7. Measure 1 1 / 2 cups of pepper juice into a large sauce pan
8. Stir in chopped red pepper , wine and balsamic vinegars and lemon juice
9. Whisk in fruit pectin until dissolved
10. Add 1 / 2 tsp of oil to reduce foaming
11. Stirring frequently , bring mixture to a boil over high heat
12. Add sugar then stir constantly while returning mixture to a full , rolling boil
13. Boil hard for 1 minute
14. Remove from heat and skim foam
15. Fill and heat process jars as directed in canning process

title: longhunter s bear roast
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 500 degrees
2. Cut deep slits in top of roast and insert garlic slices
3. Salt and pepper the meat well
4. Lay a few fat slices under the roast , put it in preheated oven , and roast 20 minutes or so until the fat browns
5. Turn the heat down to 300-325 degrees and roast about 2 1 / 2 hours
6. When done , remove roast and the fat cracklings to a hot pan or platter
7. Gravy: retain 2-3 tablespoons of fat in the roasting pan with the drippings and in it saute the finely chopped onions and celery
8. Stir in the flour and herbs
9. Stir on a low flame until thickens , stir in the herbs
10. Add worcestershire sauce

title: pasta with chicken  broccoli  and sun dried tomatoes
steps:
1. Bring 4 quarts water to rolling boil , covered , in stockpot
2. Meanwhile , heat 1 tablespoon butter in 12-inch nonstick skillet over high heat until just beginning to brown , about 1 minute
3. Add chicken in single layer
4. Cook for 1 minute without stirring , then stir chicken and continue to cook until most , but not all , of pink color has disappeared and chicken is lightly browned around the edges , about 2 minutes longer
5. Transfer chicken to clean bowl
6. Set aside
7. Return skillet to high heat and add 1 tablespoon butter
8. Add onion and 1 / 4 teaspoon salt and cook , stirring occasionally , until browned about edges , 2 to 3 minutes
9. Stir in garlic , red pepper flakes , thyme , and flour
10. Cook , stirring constantly , until fragrant , about 30 seconds
11. Add wine and chicken broth
12. Bring to simmer , then reduce heat to medium and continue to simmer , stirring occasionally , until sauce has thickened slightly and reduced to 1 1 / 4 cups , about 15 minutes
13. While sauce simmers , add 1 tablespoon salt and broccoli to boiling water
14. Cook until broccoli is tender but still crisp at center , about 2 minutes
15. Using slotted spoon , transfer broccoli to large paper towel-lined plate
16. Return water to boil
17. Stir in pasta and cook until al dente
18. Drain , reserving 1 / 2 cup pasta cooking water
19. Return pasta to pot
20. Stir remaining 2 tablespoons butter , asiago , sun-dried tomatoes , parsley , and chicken into sauce in skillet
21. Cook until chicken is hot and cooked through , about 1 minute
22. Off heat , season to taste with pepper
23. Pour chicken / sauce mixture over pasta and add broccoli
24. Toss gently to combine , adding pasta cooking water as needed to adjust sauce consistency
25. Serve immediately , passing additional asiago and the lemon wedges separately

title: pan grilled salmon with lime and dill
steps:
1. Rinse salmon and pat dry
2. Remove any bones that are sticking out
3. Rinse limes
4. Put 3 / 4 cup mayonnaise in medium bowl
5. Cut limes in half
6. Ream juice of limes into bowl
7. Mix with whisk or fork until smooth , taking care to remove any seeds that get in the bowl
8. If necessary , add more mayonnaise until mixture is consistency of a smooth , fairly thin cream sauce with no lumps
9. When mixture is smooth , add dill to taste
10. Crumple between fingers before adding to release extra flavor
11. Add salt to taste
12. Mix until dill and salt are evenly distributed
13. Add salmon to mayonnaise-lime mixture
14. Prepare a nonstick frying pan: spray with non-stick cooking spray and place on stove over medium-high heat
15. When pan is hot , carefully place salmon in pan
16. With a pastry brush , brush additional mayonnaise-lime mixture over the top surface and sides of the salmon periodically
17. When salmon is opaque about halfway through and lightly browned , brush salmon once more and flip
18. Brush sides a few more times , then allow to cook through salmon is done when opaque and firm all the way through the thickest part
19. Remove salmon from pan and serve while very hot !

title: sweet  n  sour sausage crock pot
steps:
1. In a slow cooker , combine the first 10 ingredients
2. Cover and cook on low for 4-5 hours
3. In a small bowl , combine the cornstarch and water until smooth
4. Pour into crock , turn on high for about 30 mins or till desired thickness
5. Serve over rice or noodles

title: c o railroad jelly omelette
steps:
1. Mix eggs& milk with a fork until blended
2. In a non-stick omelette pan melt 1 tablespoon butter over medium-high heat , when butter stops foaming pour in eggs , swirling around pan to distribute evenly
3. Cook , lifting sides of omelette to let uncooked egg flow underneath , until almost set , spread jelly or jam of choice over half of omelet
4. Fold plain side of omelette over jelly and cook for an additional 20 seconds
5. Serve at once
6. Salt& pepper to taste

title: homemade sauerkraut pierogies   perogies   old fashioned recipe
steps:
1. Sauerkraut filling: rinse the sauerkraut well in warm water , squeeze dry , and chop very fine
2. Cook the onion in the fat or shortening until tender
3. Add the sauerkraut and cream
4. Season to taste with salt and pepper
5. Cook over low heat for 15 minutes or until sauerkraut is tender and the flavors blend
6. Do not over cook
7. Chill thoroughly
8. Mix the flour with the salt in a deep bowl
9. Add the egg , oil and water to make a medium soft dough
10. Knead on a floured board until the dough is smooth
11. Caution: too much kneading will toughen the dough
12. Divide the dough into 2 parts
13. Cover and let stand for at least 10 minutes
14. Prepare the filling
15. The filling should be thick enough to hold its shape
16. Roll the dough quite thin on a floured board
17. Cut rounds with a large biscuit cutter , or as most old-world grandmothers did , with the open end of a glass
18. Put the round in the palm of your hand
19. Place a spoonful of filling in it , fold over to form a half circle and press the edges together with the fingers
20. The edges should be free of filling
21. Be sure the edges are sealed well to prevent the filling from running out
22. Place the pierogi on a floured board or tea towel and then cover with another tea towel to prevent them from drying out
23. Cooking: drop a few pierogies into a large quantity of rapidly boiling salted water
24. Do not attempt to cook too many at a time
25. Stir very gently with a wooden spoon to separate them and to prevent them from sticking to the bottom of the pot
26. Continue boiling for 3-4 minutes
27. The cooling period will depend upon the size you made it , the thickness of the dough and the filling
28. Pierogies will be ready when they are puffed
29. Remove them with a perforated spoon or skimmer to a colander and drain thoroughly
30. Place in a deep dish , sprinkle generously with melted butter to prevent them from sticking
31. Cover and keep them hot until all are cooked
32. Serve in a large dish without piling or crowding them
33. Top with melted butter- chopped crisp bacon and / or chopped onions lightly browned in butter
34. Reheating: one of the great things about pierogies , is that they can be made in large quantities , refrigerated , frozen and reheated without lost of quality
35. Many prefer reheated pierogies as compared to freshly boiled ones
36. To re-heat , you can 1) pan fry pierogies in butter or bacon fat until they are light in color or 2) heat the pierogies in the top of a double boiler or in the oven until they are hot and plump or 3) deep fry them

title: pickled eggs and red beets  pennsylvania dutch style
steps:
1. Cook , drain , and skin beets if not using canned
2. Combine remaining ingredients , except eggs
3. Pour over beets and cook for about 5 minutes
4. Cool
5. Place eggs in a large jar and pour cooled beet mixture over
6. Place in the refrigerator
7. Let pickle at least two days before using

title: grilled steaks with peppery peach salsa
steps:
1. Sprinkle both sides of beef steaks with 1 / 4 teaspoon each salt and pepper
2. Remove seeds from bell pepper , leaving pepper whole
3. Place steaks and bell pepper on grid over medium , ash-covered coals
4. Grill steaks , uncovered , 15 to 18 minutes for medium rare to medium doneness , turning once
5. Grill bell pepper 2 to 3 minutes , turning occasionally
6. While steaks continue to cook , cut four 1 / 2-inch thick rings from bell pepper
7. Set aside for garnish
8. Coarsely chop enough remaining bell pepper to make 1 / 4 cup
9. In small saucepan , combine the 1 / 4 cup chopped bell pepper with salsa ingredients
10. Place on grid near edge of grill to heat until warm
11. Approximately 5 minutes before steaks are done , remove 2 tablespoons salsa from saucepan and brush on both sides of steaks
12. To serve , place 1 bell pepper ring on each steak
13. Fill rings with warm salsa
14. Makes 4 servings
15. Broil bell pepper 5 minutes
16. Remove and proceed as directed above
17. Broil steaks 13 to 17 minutes , turning once
18. Approx
19. 5 minutes before steaks are done , brush both sides with 2 tablespoons salsa

title: grandma myrtle s chicken and noodles
steps:
1. Cook 1 chicken in pot with water nearly covering chicken , 1 stalk of celery , and salt and pepper
2. Simmer slowly until chicken is tender
3. Remove meat from bones and cut into bite sized pieces
4. Add water to strained broth until desired amount is reached
5. If wanted , add 1 teaspoons instant chicken boullion or oleo
6. To make the noodles , combine 2 beaten eggs , 1 teaspoon salt , 1 / 4 cup milk , and then add 2 cups flour
7. Roll thin
8. Let stand for 20 minutes
9. Roll up loosely and slice
10. Spread out and let dry
11. Add chicken pieces to broth
12. Drop noodles into boiling broth and cook uncovered for about 10 minutes
13. If desired , cook chopped onions and carrots in butter or margarine and add them to the mix

title: thai ribbons
steps:
1. Prepare basting mixture by mixing teriyaki sauce , vegetable oil , ginger , garlic and crushed red chili peppers
2. Cover and refrigerate
3. Cut beef diagonally , against the grain , into 1 / 4 inch slices
4. Thread each slice onto a skewer
5. Cover and marinate overnight
6. For each serving: brush 2 beef ribbons generously with basting mixture
7. Broil or grill to desired doneness , basting once or twice

title: cake mix italian cream cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. In a large mixer bowl add the cake mix , vanilla pudding , water , eggs and oil
3. With electric mixer , beat for 2 minutes at medium speed
4. Fold in the chopped nuts and coconut
5. Pour the batter into a 9 x 13 inch pan that has been sprayed with non-stick cooking spray or lightly greased and floured
6. Bake for 45 minutes or until toothpick inserted off center comes out clean
7. Cool completely before frosting
8. In a medium sized mixer bowl , blend the butter and cream cheese
9. Add the confectioners' sugar and enough cream to make it a smooth spreading consistency
10. Frost cake with frosting and sprinkle with coconut

title: oatmeal bannock  low fat
steps:
1. Combine flour , oats , baking powder , sugar and salt
2. With pastry knife cut in cold butter until crumbs are size of peas
3. Pour in milk and mix quickly just until dry ingredients are moistened
4. Turn dough onto lightly floured board
5. Knead 3 - 5 times
6. Pat out dough to about 3 / 4" thickness
7. Cut into rounds with a 2" cutter
8. Bake on parchment or ungreased sheet at 425 for 12 - 15 minutes or until lightly browned

title: chicken wings with jalapeno pepper sauce
steps:
1. Combine the first 9 ingredients in the container of an electric blender and process for 30 seconds or until the mixture is well blended
2. Set the sauce mixture aside
3. Remove and discard the chicken wing
4. Cut the wings in half at the joint
5. Place in a greased roasting pan
6. Pour half the sauce over the wings
7. Bake at 375 degrees for 30 minutes
8. Turn the wings , and top with the remaining half of the sauce
9. Bake an additional 30 minutes or until done
10. Serve warm

title: sugar and spice cookies
steps:
1. Cream crisco , sugar , egg , and molasses till fluffy
2. Add flour , baking soda , baking powder , salt , and spices
3. Form into small balls using a teaspoon
4. Roll into sugar
5. Place on ungreased cookies sheets
6. Bake at 350 for 10-12 minutes
7. Watch carefully towards end so they do not burn

title: grilled stuffed tomatoes
steps:
1. Preheat the grill to medium heat
2. Cut the tomatoes and core them , removing all the seeds and juice
3. In a medium bowl add the onions , basil , and goat cheese
4. Mix and season with salt and freshly ground black pepper
5. Add cooked orzo and combine
6. Stuff the tomatoes with the mixture
7. Drizzle olive oil over the tomatoes
8. Top the tomatoes with the parmesan
9. Place the tomatoes directly on the grill with the cover closed and cook for 10 minutes
10. The juices will begin to run
11. Remove from grill and place on platter

title: super fantastic vegan cashew cheese  slices  sauce or dip
steps:
1. To sterilize your cashew nuts: spread your nuts out on a baking sheet and bake in a preheated 350 degree oven for 10 minutes and then cool completely before using them
2. Whiz first 7 ingredients in blender or food processor until nuts are liquefied
3. Slowly drizzle in oils to thicken and then add lemon juice after oils are incorporated
4. Mix agar agar in 1 cup cold water
5. Cook in separate sauce pan until clear
6. With a spoon stir cooked agar agar into cheese mixture
7. Immediately pour into loaf pan lined with plastic wrap and fold plastic wrap ends and sides over top
8. Refrigerate until set and slice as needed
9. To use as a spread or dip , do not add agar agar
10. When the loaf version is set , my mom slices into sections
11. She puts them side to side with clear wrap in between and freezes then for individual later use

title: kaleidoscopic vegetables
steps:
1. Clean and cut mushrooms in half
2. Slice zucchini and yellow squash in 1 / 2 slices
3. Slice onion into 1 / 4 inch rings
4. Place butter in glass measuring cup or any microwave safe bowl
5. Melt in microwave on high
6. Add dill , tarragon , salt and pepper to butter and mix well
7. Place veggies in flat 3 quart oven-safe casserole
8. Pour butter mixture over veggies and toss to coat
9. Bake at 325 degrees for 30 minutes
10. Vegetables will still be semi-crunchy
11. You may bake an additional 15-20 minutes if you prefer your vegetables not crunchy

title: holiday cranberry fruit salad
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , sprinkle unflavored gelatin over the 1 cup chilled juice
2. Let stand for 1 minute
3. Meanwhile , heat remaining 1 cup juice to boiling
4. Stir the boiling juice into the gelatin mixture
5. Stir until the gelatin is completely dissolved
