6. Refrigerate until chilled but not set
7. Remove from the refrigerator
8. Stir in the chopped cranberries , pineapple tidbits , grapes , chopped apple , marshmallows , and chopped pecans
9. Chill until set , about 3 hours

title: tray baked meringue w pears  cream  toasted hazelnuts  chocolate
steps:
1. Preheat your oven to 150c / 300f / gas mark 2 and line 40 x 25cm baking tray with a sheet of greaseproof paper
2. Put your egg whites into a squeaky clean bowl , making sure there are absolutely no little pieces of egg shell or egg yolk in them
3. Whisk on medium until the whites form firm peaks
4. With your mixer still running , gradually add the sugar and the pinch of salt
5. Turn the mixer up to the highest setting and whisk for about 7-8 minutes , until the meringue mixture is white and glossy , to test whether it's done you can pinch some between your fingers- if it feels completely smooth it's ready
6. If it's slightly granular it needs a little more whisking
7. Dot each corner of the greaseproof paper with a blob of meringue , then turn it over and stick it to the baking tray , spoon the meringue out onto the paper , using the back of a spoon , shape and swirl it into a a4 size rectangle
8. Place in the preheated oven and bake for a hour or until crisp on the outside and a little soft and sticky on the inside , at the same time bake the hazelnuts on a separate tray in the oven for a hour or until golden brown
9. Drain the tin of pears , reserving the syrup from the tin , cut each pear into 6 slices
10. Pour the pear syrup into a saucepan and warm gently over a medium heat until it starts to simmer
11. Take off the heat and snap the chocolate into saucepan with the syrup , stirring with a spoon until its all melted
12. Take the meringue and hazelnuts out of the oven and leave to cool
13. Place the meringue on a nice rustic board or platter
14. Whip the cream with the icing sugar and vanilla seeds until it forms smooth soft peaks
15. Smash the toasted hazelnuts and sprinkle half of them over the meringue
16. Spoon half the whipped cream over the top of the meringue and drizzle with some of the chocolate syrup sauce
17. Divide most of the pear pieces evenly over the top , pile on the rest of the whipped cream , drizzle with the chocolate syrup sauce and the rest of the hazelnuts
18. Serve straight away

title: granny s chicken soup
steps:
1. Combine ingredients in a bowl , and mix well
2. In a saucepan , bring 3 cups of water , 1 tablespoons butter or margarine and 2 / 3 cup of granny's chicken soup mix to a boil
3. Reduce heat
4. Cover and simmer for 30 to 35 minutes or until rice is tender
5. Store dry product in an airtight container for up to 6 months
6. Makes 2-3 servings per batch

title: e z banana creme bundt cake
steps:
1. In large mixing bowl , mash bananas
2. Add rest of ingredients , except pecans and mix for 2 minutes at medium speed of mixer
3. Add chopped pecans
4. Pour into greased and floured bundt pan
5. Bake at 350 degrees for 60 minutes
6. Cool in pan for 15 minutes
7. Remove from pan and let cool
8. Sprinkle with powdered sugar before serving

title: cointreau fruit punch
steps:
1. Freeze half the cranberry juice in ice cube trays or a gelatin ring -- if adding to a punch bowl
2. , combine remaining fruit juices and chill
3. Just before serving , add cranberry ice cubes , cointreau and ginger ale
4. Garnish with lemon slices

title: cream cheese dessert wedges
steps:
1. Separate biscuits into 10 pieces
2. Place in an ungreased 9-inch round baking dish
3. Press onto the bottom and 1-inch up the sides , pinching edges together to seal
4. Bake at 350 for 5-7 minutes or until slightly puffed
5. Meanwhile , in a small mixing bowl , beat cream cheese , sugar , egg and flour until smooth
6. Pour over crust
7. Combine topping ingredients
8. Sprinkle over filling
9. Bake for 15-20 minutes or until filling is set and crust is golden brown
10. Cool on a wire rack for at least 30 minutes before cutting
11. Serve warm or chilled
12. Refrigerate leftovers

title: thai tuna wraps
steps:
1. In a bowl whisk together dressing ingredients
2. In a separate bowl combine all filling ingredients
3. Stir in dressing
4. Place filling in a tortilla , top with bell pepper and spinach
5. Roll and cut diagonally

title: caramel muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Grease , line or spray muffin pan
3. Sift flour , salt and baking powder in a bowl
4. Stir in brown sugar and pecans
5. In a separate bowl , stir together eggs , milk , vanilla , butter and melted chocolate
6. Stir dry mixture into wet mixture , mixing only until combined
7. Don't overmix the batter
8. Gently stir in vanilla chips
9. Divide evenly among 14-18 muffin cups
10. Bake for about 20 minutes , or until done
11. Glaze directions: place butter , brown sugar , sugar and cream in a saucepan over medium heat
12. Bring to a rolling boil , stirring constantly
13. Let boil for 1 minute longer , stirring constantly
14. Remove pan from heat and stir in the vanilla extract
15. Spoon , spread or drizzle warm glaze over cooled muffins

title: appetizer cheese tart
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375 degrees
2. Remove one crust from pouch and place on ungreased cookie sheet , pressing out fold lines
3. Mix all ingredients well , except for the cilantro
4. Spread on crust to within about an inch of the edge
5. Fold the edges over and flute
6. Bake 25 to 40 minutes until the crust is golden brown
7. Sprinkle with the cilantro and let stand 10 minutes before serving

title: cabbage waldorf salad
steps:
1. In a medium bowl combine cabbage , celery , raisins and walnuts
2. Whisk yogurt , mayonnaise , and lemon juice
3. Stir in to cabbage mixture
4. Season with salt and pepper
5. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour
6. Stir in apples before serving
7. Diabetic exchanges - 1 1 / 4 cup serving = 2 fruit , 1 fat

title: tequichis
steps:
1. Placec all ingredients in a blender and chop / crush / puree to smooth , around 1 minute
2. Make more !

title: savory onion bread
steps:
1. Begin by proofing your yeast
2. I do this by warming up the water , about a minute in most microwaves
3. You don't want it to boil , or you'll kill the yeast
4. That's not so good if you want your bread to rise
5. Once the water's heated , put in the 2 t of yeast and stir , and then set aside somewhere dark
6. Assemble the rest of your ingredients
7. I grind the flax right before i put it in the bread , because flax is very perishable
8. If you have any leftover , freeze it
9. Add flour , spices and ground flax to bowl or bread machine
10. Chop up the onion and add to the rest of the ingredients
11. Check your water and yeast mixture
12. If it's bubbly , add it to the other ingredients
13. Add olive oil and agave
14. If you're using a bread machine , put it on the white bread cycle , or if you're like me , put it on the dough cycle , pull it out once that's finished and then bake it in a loaf pan at 400 degrees for thirty minutes in the oven

title: bread dumplings
steps:
1. Sift flour , baking powder , and salt together in a large bowl
2. Add beaten egg
3. Add the lukewarm water and mix well with wooden spoon
4. Add bread
5. Mix well and roll into oblong dumplings
6. Place into boiling water , cover and cook about 20 minutes , stirring once

title: mexican chocolate popcorn shake
steps:
1. Mix
2. Shake over popcorn whenever you make some ! (freshly air popped will cause the mix to stick , and will keep the fat content low , though it is a bit dry
3. Still a healthy option , oil-popped popcorn will stick better and be moister
4. Feel free to add butter as u wish)
5. Eat !

title: stir fried shrimp with lemon sauce   scallion noodles
steps:
1. Crush 1 clove garlic through press and combine with 1 t
2. Soy sauce , 1 / 2 t
3. Sesame oil , pepper flakes , and shrimp in bowl
4. Let stand 15 minutes
5. Put large pot of water on to boil for noodles
6. Mix remaining 1 t
7. Soy sauce , 1 / 2 t
8. Sesame oil , the lemon juice , sugar , and cornstarch in small bowl
9. Heat wok or large heavy skillet over high heat
10. Add peanut oil
11. Lightly crush remaining garlic and peel
12. Salt water and add noodles to boiling water
13. Cook according to package directions , about 6 minutes
14. Add peeled garlic to oil with 3 / 4 of the scallions , zest , and ginger
15. Stir-fry until fragrant , about 30 seconds
16. Remove garlic
17. Add green beans and stir-fry until barely tender , about 3 minutes
18. Add mushrooms and bell pepper
19. Stir-fry until tender , about 3 minutes
20. Drain noodles well
21. Transfer to serving bowl and mix with 1 t
22. Oriental sesame oil and 1
23. 4 of the scallions
24. Toss well
25. Add shrimp with marinade to wok
26. Stir-fry just until shrimp turn pink
27. Add lemon juice mixture and cook , stirring constantly , 20 seconds
28. Serve over noodles

title: dijon parmesan salad dressing
steps:
1. Blend all ingredients together
2. Refrigerate

title: trimlestown roast sirloin
steps:
1. Roast the sirloin for one hour at 350 degrees
2. Baste with whiskey and wine and cook another hour , basting frequently
3. Remove roast from oven , place on a serving dish , and cover with foil
4. While the roast is sitting , add water to the juices to make one pint of liquid
5. Bring to a simmer and add butter and flour
6. Simmer 2-3 minutes
7. Slice the roast and serve with gravy

title: kris  bada   pie
steps: 1. "blend it and then refridge for some time ! "

title: mint orange squash
steps:
1. Heat oven to 325f
2. Brush each squash wedge with about 1 teaspoon olive oil , then sprinkle with about 1 / 4 teaspoon salt and a pinch of cayenne if using
3. Place the squash quarters on a baking sheet skin-side down
4. The squash is done when it is fork-tender
5. Meanwhile , grate the zest and squeeze the juice from the orange
6. Remove the squash from the oven and immediately sprinkle with the mint , orange juice , and zest
7. To fake it -- and save 35 minutes: prepare three 12-ounce packages frozen winter squash according to the label directions
8. With a wooden spoon , beat in the grated zest of 1 orange , 3 tablespoons butter , 2 tablespoons chopped fresh mint leaves , 1 tablespoon sugar , 1 teaspoon salt , and 1 / 4 teaspoon cayenne
9. Sprinkle with mint-zest mixture immediate after squash is done cooking

title: sassy strawberry banana smoothie
steps:
1. Blend all ingredients in your favorite blender !
2. Pour all of it in your favorite glass !
3. Enjoy in your favorite sunny spot !

title: candied almonds
steps:
1. Bring water , sugar and cinnamon to a boil
2. Stirring constantly
3. Add almonds and toss to coat
4. Remove almonds with slotted spoon
5. Arrange on greased baking pan
6. Bake at 350 for 20 minutes , basting twice with reserved syrup
7. Cool
8. Store airtight

title: single serve pizza slice
steps:
1. Combine 1 tbs flour and 2 tsp water in a bowl and stir until combined
2. Take dough out of bowl and place on a cutting board coated with cooking spray followed by a light sprinkling of some of the extra
3. 5 tbs flour
4. Roll dough into a ball and roll out with a roller coating in cooing spray until it is very very very thin
5. Place in oven set a 400f for 2 minutes on lowest rack
6. Flip and bake another 2 minutes , then remove from oven
7. Place tomatoes , italian seasoning and 1 / 4 cup water on stove and cook until water dissolves
8. Place cooked tomatoes and left over 1 / 4 cup water in blender , puree until smooth
9. Shred mozzarella
10. Place tomato sauce and cheese on pizza
11. Broil 2 minutes on high or until desired doneness
12. Don't let it burn !
13. Enjoy !

title: honey glazed shallots with mint
steps:
1. Melt the butter in a heavy skillet
2. Add the shallots , honey , salt& pepper pour in the stock and cook over medium heat , simmering until almost all of the liquid has evaporated , about 30 minutes
3. Stir in the mint and serve

title: creamy cashew brownies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. In a large bowl , combine the brownie mix , water , oil and egg
3. Stir in chips
4. Spread into a greased 13-in
5. X 9-in
6. X 2-in
7. Baking pan
8. Bake for 25-27 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean
9. Cool on a wire rack
10. For topping , in a large mixing bowl beat the cream cheese , confectioners' sugar and vanilla until smooth
11. Spread over brownies
12. Sprinkle with cashews
13. Drizzle with hot fudge topping
14. Refrigerate before cutting
15. Store in the refrigerator

title: sour cream beef enchiladas
steps:
1. Brown meat , then drain grease
2. Add taco seasoning and green chilies
3. Combine sour cream , soup , and other chilies in a saucepan and heat through
4. Pour enough soup mixture into a 9 x 13 pan to coat bottom
5. Heat tortillas 30 seconds in the microwave
6. Fill tortillas with meat mix , wrap , and place in pan
7. Pour the rest of the soup mixture over the top of tortilla wraps and sprinkle with cheese
8. Bake at 350 degrees
9. For 35-40 minutes , or until cheese is melted and soup is bubbling on the sides
10. Serve with salsa , if desired

title: kiwi orange mango juice  rachael ray
steps:
1. Using a blender , puree the kiwis , mangoes and orange juice
2. Pour into a pitcher , add water and stir

title: roasted garlic pasta
steps:
1. In a 9 x 12 inch baking dish , combine 1 1 / 2 cups chicken broth and the peeled whole garlic cloves
2. Roast , uncovered , tossing every 10 to 15 minutes , until golden brown , set aside
3. In a large saucepan , cook the pasta in boiling water over high heat for 8 to 12 minutes , until al dente
4. Drain , reserving 3 / 4 cup of the cooking water
5. Return to the saucepan , cover and keep warm over low heat
6. In a large skillet , heat the remaining 1 1 / 2 cups broth and the oil over medium heat
7. Add the minced garlic and pepper flakes
8. Stir and cook for 2 to 3 minutes , until garlic turns golden brown but not brown
9. Add the pasta , roasted garlic and reserved pasta water
10. Toss and cook for 1 to 2 minutes to allow the pasta to absorb the sauce
11. Add oregano and toss again
12. Season with salt and pepper
13. Serve with a salad and garlic toast

title: apple   ricotta slice
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 220c / fan200c / gas 7 & lightly grease a baking sheet
2. Slice the apple into thin slices & toss with the mixed spice & demerara sugar
3. Set to one side
4. Roll out the pastry on a lightly floured surface to a 30cm bt 28cm rectangle
5. Spread half of the apple mixture onto half of the pastry leaving a 1
6. 5cm rim round the three edges
7. Place the ricotta into a bowl & beat with a wooden spoon to soften
8. Add orange rind & juice to the ricotta & mix well together
9. Spoon the ricotta over the apple , then spread the remaining apple over the ricotta
10. Brush the edges of the pastry with water then fold over the other half of the pastry to enclose the other mix
11. Press the edges together & pinch to decorate
12. Make diagonal slashes over the top at 2cm intervals , do not cut all the way through the pastry
13. Brush the pastry with milk the sprinkkle over the demerara sugar & flaked almonds
14. Carefully lift onto the pre greased baking sheet & place in oven
15. Bake for 15 minutes then reduce the temperature to 180c / gas4 for a further 15 minutes till golden
16. Remove from oven & allow to cool for 10 minutes on the baking sheet , then move to a cooling rack

title: cindy s cornbread casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. While preheating , place butter in 8x8 baking dish to melt
3. Mix ingredients and pour in baking dish with melted butter
4. Bake 30 minutes or until top is crusty
5. For a 9x13 dish , double recipe

title: hot dogs memphis bbq style
steps:
1. Heat grill to medium heat
2. Wrap bacon tightly around hot dogs
3. Grill 10 - 12 minutes or until bacon is crisp and hot dogs are heated through , turning frequently
4. Add buns to the grill the last 2 or 3 minutes of cooking to toast
5. Drain hot dogs on a paper towel
6. Place in buns and top with bbq sauce , onions and cheese

title: creamy chicken and peas noodle toss
steps:
1. Cook noodles in medium saucepan as directed on package
2. Meanwhile , cook chicken in medium nonstick skillet sprayed with cooking spray on medium-high heat 5 minute or until cooked through , stirring occasionally
3. Add neufchatel cheese and milk
4. Cook and stir 1 to 2 minute or until neufchatel cheese is melted and mixture is well blended
5. Add soup and peas
6. Cook 5 min
7. , stirring occasionally
8. Drain noodles
9. Return to saucepan
10. Add chicken mixture and half of the shredded cheese
11. Cook until shredded cheese is melted and mixture is well blended
12. Sprinkle with the remaining shredded cheese

title: chicken with orange sage sauce
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat
2. Season both sides of chicken with salt and black pepper
3. Add chicken to pan and cook 3-5 minutes per side , until golden brown
4. In a medium bowl , whisk together orange juice , mustard , cornstarch , thyme , and sage
5. Add mixture to pan and bring to a simmer
6. Simmer 2 to 3 minutes , until sauce thickens and chicken is cooked through
7. Serve chicken breast halves with all of the sauce

title: crispy spicy french fries
steps:
1. Slice potatoes into french fries , and place into cold water so they won't turn brown while you prepare the oil
2. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat
3. While the oil is heating , sift the flour and spices into a large bowl
4. Gradually stir in enough water so that the mixture can be drizzled from a spoon
5. Dip potato slices into the batter one at a time , and place in the hot oil so they are not touching at first
6. The fries must be placed into the skillet one at a time , or they will clump together
7. Fry until golden brown and crispy
8. Remove and drain on paper towels

title: french brioche bread in breadmaker
steps:
1. Add yeast and flour to breadmaker
2. In a microwave safe bowl , combine water , salt , sugar , and butter and microwave until butter is melted
3. Mix butter mixture with a whisk and add to the breadmaker
4. Turn breadmaker on to "dough mixing mode"
5. After dough has been mixed together add eggs
6. Add more flour to mixture if dough is too sticky one tablespoon at a time
7. Allow breadmaker to run through cycle
8. After cycle is complete , let dough rise in breadmaker until it rises to the top of breadmaker canister
9. Grease a 9 x 4 inch loaf pan with butter
10. Dust the surface of the dough with flour
11. On a floured counter , pat the dough into a 7 by 14 inch rectangle
12. Using your bench scraper to cut the loaf in half lengthwise
13. Gently roll each half into a 14" tube
14. Pinch the two ends of the dough together and braid dough by laying the left piece over the right until pieces of dough are tightly twisted
15. Pinch ends together
16. Transfer loaf to prepared loaf pan
17. Cover pan loosely with plastic wrap and allow to rise until doubled in size
18. Top of the loaf should rise about 1 inch over the lip of the pan
19. Could take up to 3 hours
20. Before baking , beat 1 egg to create an egg wash and spread over top of bread
21. Preheat oven to 350
22. Bake approximately 25 minutes until the crust is golden brown and internal temperature registers 200
23. Let cool for 5 minutes in the pan on a wire rack
24. Remove loaf from pan and cool completely on a wire rack before slicing , about 2 hours

title: chicken marinade   ecuadorean
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients and use as marinade
2. You can also just throw it all into the food processor or a blender to puree it

title: hamburger skillet supper
steps:
1. In a skillet , cook beef until no longer pink
2. Drain
3. Add noodles with contents of seasoning packet and water
4. Bring to a boil
5. Cook for 3 minutes or until noodles are tender
6. Add the veggies and cook until tender , about 3 minutes as well
7. Makes about 4 servings
8. Here is another way to do it: cook the beef as stated previously
9. During this time , heat up a saucepan of water to cook the ramen noodles in
10. Rather than just using 1 packet , use 2 packets of the beef flavor ramen noodles
11. When cooking the noodles , cook them without the flavoring
12. During this time , add the veggies to the meat and continue to cook
13. As the veggies become cooked , add the two packets of flavoring to the beef-veggie mixture
14. The ramen noodles don't take long to cook , so be sure to watch them
15. When they are done , drain them , and add them to the beef-veggie mixture
16. The completed dish will have more flavor , and more noodles for the noodle lovers ! enjoy !

title: all purpose ground meat mix
steps:
1. Brown meat in a large pot
2. Drain
3. Stir in celery , garlic , onion , green pepper , salt and pepper
4. Cover and simmer about 10 minutes until vegetables are tender but not soft
5. You can use this mixture immediately during your cooking session or freeze in two-cup portions for later use
6. Suggested uses
7. Tacos: add one package taco seasoning to two cups all-purpose ground meat mix
8. Freeze
9. To serve: thaw and heat taco mixture
10. Prepare tacos as you would normally
11. Taco potatoes: follow instructions for taco mixture , but serve the mixture over baked potatoes instead of tortillas or taco shells
12. Top with grated cheese , diced tomatoes , sour cream , sliced green onions , sliced black olives and salsa
13. Easy taco salads: follow instructions for taco mixture
14. Place a layer of corn chips or tortilla chips on plate
15. Spoon taco mixture over chips
16. Add layer of shredded lettuce
17. Add diced tomatoes , sliced green onions , sliced black olives , sour cream and salsa
18. Sloppy joes: in a large skillet , place two cups ground meat mix , one can tomato soup , two tablespoons brown sugar , and one teaspoon prepared mustard
19. Stir
20. Cover and simmer ten minutes
21. Serve ladled onto hamburger buns
22. The all-purpose ground meat mix can also be used for: stuffed peppers , chili , spaghetti , and baked ziti
23. See my cookbook for additional ideas: [url= to make with all purpose ground beef mix[ / url]

title: danish aebelskiver
steps:
1. Beat eggs , sugar and cardamom
2. Add flour and 3 cups buttermilk and blend until smooth
3. Dissolve baking soda in remaining 1 / 2 cup buttermilk
4. Stir into batter
5. Put about 1 / 4 teaspoon butter or margarine in each cavity of the aebelskiver iron
6. When bubbly hot , drop in about a level tablespoon of dough
7. When browned and puffed , turn over with a skewer and brown other side
8. Serve these little browned puffs of dough with either preserves , maple syrup or applesauce and a dusting of confectioners' sugar
9. If you like , add a little grated sharp cheese to the dough for a different taste treat
10. The resultant little muffins are garnished in several ways and served for breakfast or dessert
11. These are obtainable in most kitchen supply stores or online

title: smokey southwestern pasta salad
steps:
1. Cook the pasta until al dente , then drain & shock to stop the cooking process
2. While the pasta is cooking , zest the lime & reserve zest to one side
3. Roll the lime on your counter , placing enough pressure to soften the pulp inside without breaking the lime's skin , then squeeze the juice into a large-sized bowl
4. Add the olive oil to the lime juice , whisk briefly , then add the cumin , oregano , cilantro & half the lime zest
5. Whisk thoroughly
6. Put all ingredients except the pasta into the bowl & toss to coat
7. Taste at this point , adding salt , pepper and / or chiles as needed
8. Return the cool pasta to its pot
9. Pour the contents of the bowl over the pasta and stir together to combine
10. Pour the pasta mix back into the bowl , sprinkle the remaining lime zest over the top to garnish , then cover & chill until ready to serve

title: cheesy stuffed baked potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Cut off top 1 / 2 inch from garlic head
3. Wrap garlic in foil
4. Prick potatoes with fork
5. Bake potatoes and garlic on baking sheet until tender , about 1 hour
6. Let stand 10 minutes
7. Separate garlic cloves
8. Pinch bottom of each clove to remove from skins
9. Throw skins away
10. Cut slit lengthwise down center of eat potato
11. Scoop potato from skins , leaving 1 / 4-inch thick shells
12. Mash potatoes with 1 / 2 cup cheese , butter , oil , salt , paprika , black pepper , and garlic
13. Scoop potato mixture into shells
14. Top with remaining cheese
15. Bake on ungreased baking sheet until cheese is melted

title: grilled garlic cheese grits
steps:
1. I a sauce pan , bring water to a boil
2. Slowly add grits and salt , stirring constantly
3. Reduce heat:simmer , uncovered , for 40-45 minutes or untill thickened , stirrin occasionally
4. Add cheese and garlic
5. Stir until cheese is melted , spray 9-inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray
6. Cover and refrigerate for 2 to 2 1 / 2 hours or until frim
7. Before starting the grill , coat the grill rack with nonstick cooking spray
8. Cut the grits into 3-inch squares
9. Brush both sides with olive oil
10. Grill , covered , over medium heat for 4 to 6 minutes on each side or until lightly browned

title: rye bread stuffing
steps:
1. Toss bread cubes in a large bowl
2. In a skillet , cook and crumble sausage just until cooked thru
3. Remove to paper towels to drain
4. To same skillet , add onion , apples , celery , garlic and butter
5. Saute until apples and vegetables are tender
6. Add both the onion mixture and sausage to bread
7. Add nuts , seasonings and enough broth to moisten
8. Cover and refrigerate til ready to bake
9. Stuff turkey just before baking
10. Bake any additional stuffing separately in a greased 2 quart casserole dish
11. Or bake all stuffing separately in a greased 13x9x2 baking dish
12. To bake stuffing separately , place in greased dish , cover and bake at 325 degrees for one hour
13. Uncover and bake for 10 minutes longer

title: chuck s all up in ya hot sauce
steps:
1. Fill a pot with water so that the peppers will float
2. Add peppers and bring water to a boil and cover
3. Boil for 10 minutes
4. While peppers are boiling , in a food processor add all other ingredients: drained tomatoes , minced garlic , vinegar , olive oil , sugar , and salt
5. When peppers are done boiling cut off the tops of them , leaving the seeds in the peppers
6. Add the peppers , seeds and all , to the food processor
7. Pulse until the desired consistancy is reached , about 30 seconds will be more than enough
8. Pour into a sealable container and store in the fridge for at least 12 hours
9. Enjoy !

title: giant soft pretzels
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425
2. Place water , flour , sugar & yeast in a large bowl
3. Mix and knead dough for 5 to 10 minutes
4. Turn dough onto a lightly floured surface
5. Divide into 8 balls
6. Roll each ball out into 20-inch ropes and form into pretzel shape
7. In a large sauce pan , bring water and baking soda to a boil
8. Drop pretzels into water 2 at a time , boil for 10-15 seconds
9. Remove with slotted spoons and drain on paper towels
10. Place pretzles on a greased baking sheet and bake at 425 for 8-10 minutes or until golden brown
11. Spritz or lightly brush with water
12. Sprinkle with salt and enjoy !

title: lunchbox hummus vegetable sandwich
steps:
1. Spread 1 slice whole wheat bread with half the mixture of hummus and tapenade
2. Do the same on the second piece of bread
3. Top hummus and tapenade with the 1 / 4 cucumber thinly sliced and the 1 carrot coarsely grated
4. This recipe makes 1 sandwich

title: godiva chocolate covered banana
steps:
1. Pour godiva into blender
2. Add rum , banana and ice cream
3. Blend until smooth
4. Pour into serving glass
5. Garnish with banana slice if desired

title: spinach enchiladas
steps:
1. Combine first 5 ingredients in container of electric blender and process until smooth
2. Set aside
3. Try tortillas , one at a time , in hot oil about 5 seconds on each side
4. Drain on paper towells
5. Spoon 1 tbs
6. Of each cheese on onion on each tortilla , roll up and place in a lightly greased 12 x 8 baking dish
7. Spoon spinach mixture over and sprinkle with remaining cheese
8. Bake uncovered , at 325 for 30 minutes

title: deviled swiss steak
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325
2. In a large shallow bowl , combine flour , salt , pepper , and mustard powder
3. Dredge round steak in this mixture
4. Heat oil in large skillet over medium-high heat
5. Brown steak on both sides
6. Remove and place in a shallow baking dish
7. Add remaining ingredients to skillet , stirring well to pick up the bits on the bottom of the pan
8. Pour over the steak
9. Cover with tin foil and bake for 2 hours

title: popovers
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425f
2. Brush a deep muffin pan with a small amount of oil
3. Place the flour in a bowl and make a well in the centre
4. Add the egg white and milk and gradually beat in the flour
5. Gradually add the water , beating until smooth and bubbly
6. Place the pork mince , celery , oats , chives , worcestershire sauce , and seasoning in a bowl and mix well
7. Mould the mixture into 10 small balls and place in the patty tins
8. Cook for 10 minutes , remove from the oven , and quickly pour the batter into the tins
9. Cook for 20-25 minutes more , or until puffed and golden brown
10. Nice served with a thin gravy

title: hicham s fabulous beef
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a skillet then add the beef , onion , parsley , 1 / 2 tsp paprika , ginger , salt , & pepper
2. Saute over medium heat for 10 minutes
3. Stir in 1 / 2 cup of water , 1 / 2 tsp paprika , & bouillon
4. Cover with a lid & simmer for additional 10 minutes
5. Stir occasionally
6. Uncover , add the last of the water & diced tomato
7. Recover & continue to simmer for 15 minutes , stirring occasionally
8. Serve over couscous or by itself with bread

title: spicy sausage patties
steps:
1. In large bowl , beat egg until foamy
2. Add pork , breadcrumbs onion , garlic , chili powdeer , hot pepper sauce , salt and pepper , oregano , cinnamon , cumin and cloves
3. Mix well
4. Divide mixture into 8 equal portions
5. Form into patties
6. Place on roasting rack
7. Cover with paper towel and microwave on high for 2 minutes
8. Turn patties over
9. Microwave covered with paper towel at high for 3 minutes or until cooked through , rotating rack once

title: bacon   egg casserole
steps:
1. Grease a 9x13 glass baking dish and set aside
2. Fry the bacon , drain on paper toweling , cut into 1 inch pieces
3. Cube the bread into 3 / 4 inch pieces and set aside
4. In a large bowl , beat the eggs
5. Add the milk , mustard powder , salt , and blend well
6. Stir in the bacon , cheese , and bread cubes
7. Stir well to combine
8. Pour the mixture into the baking dish , cover with plastic wrap , and refrigerate overnight
9. Preheat oven to 350f and bake for one hour

title: spanish chicken with peppers
steps:
1. In plastic bag , toss chicken with flour to coat
2. In large nonstick skillet , heat the oil over medium high heat
3. Brown chicken on both sides , for about 5 minutes per side
4. Transfer chicken to a plate
5. Reduce heat to medium
6. Add red peppers , prosciutto , onion , garlic , thyme , paprika , cayenne , and salt
7. Cook , stirring occasionally , until onion is softened , about 5 minutes
8. Stir in wine and tomatoes
9. Nestle chicken in sauce and bring to a boil
10. Reduce heat , cover and simmer , occasionally spooning sauce over chicken , until juices run clear when chicken is pierced , about 20- 25 minutes
11. Sprinkle with parsley right before serving

title: low carb pancakes   almond flour
steps:
1. Simply combine and cook in skillet
2. Use sugar free syrups or cool and use as "bread"
3. Serves 2
4. I use splenda as sugar substitute --

title: apple pumpkin bisque
steps:
1. Melt butter over medium heat in a large , heavy saucepan
2. Saut the onion and ginger until onion is tender , about 4 minutes
3. Add pumpkin , applesauce , chicken broth , honey , vinegar , cinnamon stick , chile pepper , nutmeg , salt and pepper , and simmer about 15 minutes until flavors are blended
4. Stir in sour cream just before serving

title: chinese 5 spice oatmeal cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. In a large bowl , mix together the oats , flour , ground nuts , 5-spice powder , cinnamon , baking powder , and salt
3. In another bowl , using an electric mixer , cream the butter and both sugars until light and smooth
4. Add eggs and vanilla to the butter mixture and beat well
5. Add flour mixture to the butter mixture and beat until blended
6. Drop by mounded tablespoonfuls onto lightly greased cookie sheets , leaving about 1 1 / 2" gap between each mound of batter
7. Bake at 350 for 12-15 minutes or until done to your liking
8. Cool on wire racks
9. Makes about 3 dozen cookies

title: seafood parrillada
steps:
1. In large skillet add the oil and heat
2. Add onions , saute until soft
3. Add salmon and cook for 10 minutes
4. Add remaining veggies and the soy sauce and wine and cook for another 3 minutes
5. Add all of the seafood ingredients and old bay seasoning and cook for 3 -5 minutes or until shrimp are done , do not overcook or your shrimp will be tough and rubbery
6. Serve with rice , salad , and tortillas

title: french country soup
steps:
1. Melt 3 tablespoons butter in a soup kettle
2. Add carrots , leeks , cabbage and celery
3. Saute over low heat , stirring occasionally , about 20 minutes
4. Add salt , sugar , water and beef broth
5. Bring to a boil
6. Add beans and potatoes
7. Cover , reduce heat and simmer 45 minutes or until vegetables are tender
8. Strain vegetables , reserving the liquid
9. With a food mill , blender or food processor , puree vegetables
10. Return cooking liquid and puree to the soup kettle , stir to combine and reheat
11. Season with salt and pepper if desired
12. Meanwhile , melt 2 tablespoons butter in a skillet
13. Saute bread slices in butter , turning to saute both sides , until golden
14. Place one slice of bread into each of 6 soup bowls
15. Cover with soup
16. Sprinkle with grated cheese

title: halloumi cheese and tomato salad in a caper vinaigrette
steps:
1. In a bowl , mix the oil , lemon , capers , garlic and rosemary
2. Add the sliced cheese , turning to coat and cover
3. Marinate for at least one hour
4. Preheat the grill to medium-high heat
5. Remove the cheese from the marinade reserving the vinaigrette
6. Grill the halloumi until browned , about 2 minutes each side
7. Don't overcook
8. Cool and cut into smaller pieces and toss with the basil , tomatoes and reserved vinaigrette
9. Season with salt and pepper and serve over greens , if desired

title: garden fresh bruschetta  taste of home
steps:
1. Rub cut side of garlic over one side of each slice of bread
2. Place bread garlic side down on an ungreased baking sheet
3. Bake at 350 for 5 minutes on each side or until lightly browned
4. In a bowl , combine the tomatoes , onion , oil , minced basil , salt and pepper
5. Spoon about 2 tablespoons onto each piece of toast
6. Top each with a basil leaf
7. Top with optional parmesan if you like as well

title: simple mushroom rolls
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Remove crusts from a few bread slices
3. Set crusts aside for another use
4. Flatten bread slices lightly , with a rolling pin
5. Spread with undiluted soup , then roll up jelly-roll style and secure with a couple of toothpicks
6. Keep making slices until you run out of soup
7. Place rolls on an ungreased baking sheet and brush with melted butter
8. Bake until bread is toasted , about 10 to 15 minutes-- keep an eye on them

title: green beans and pears
steps:
1. Steam together for 6 minutes , until beans are tender
2. Or just cover with water and boil
3. Then drain
4. Cool and puree

title: hp sauce
steps:
1. Cook fruit , onions , and garlic
2. Press though sieve , puree in a blender , or use a berry press
3. Add spices and boil down until fairly thick
4. Process in hot water bath for 15 minutes

title: lemon lime pots de creme
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 275 degrees f
2. Peel zest from the lemon and the lime with either a vegetable peeler or a paring knife , being careful to avoid the bitter white pith
3. Bring about 2 cups of water to a boil in a small saucepan and add the zest
4. Cook for 5 minutes
5. Meanwhile , juice the lemon and the lime
6. Discard the juiced rinds
7. Remove the peeled zest from the boiling water and place the zest in a blender
8. Add remaining ingredients and blend on high for 5 minutes
9. Strain mixture through a fine sieve if you want a smooth texture , otherwise leave it and enjoy the super tiny bits of citrus rind in your custard
10. Fill 6 half cup ramekins 3 / 4 full with the custard mixture
11. Place ramekins on a baking pan and fill the pan with hot water to the level of the custard in the ramekins
12. Place the baking pan in the oven , carefully , and bake for 30-35 minutes until set
13. Remove ramekins from water bath and set on a rack to cool
14. Garnish with kiwi and / or strawberry , if desired
15. Please
16. These really are nice light citrus custards that can be served warm or cool --- a little whipped cream and a sprig of mint and you're over the top ! see the pics i posted to get an idea of the texture on the spoon and the look both cooked in the ramekin and plated
17. Thanks !

title: bailey s original irish cream by todd wilbur
steps:
1. Blend together
2. Refrigerate
3. Serve over ice

title: fire ants and fleas
steps:
1. Rinse the wild rice well and drain
2. Melt 4 tablespoons butter in a large heavy saucepan and saute the onion for several minutes until soft
3. Add the dried cranberries and rice and mix well
4. Add the chicken stock and salt
5. Bring to a simmer , cover , and continue to cook over very low heat , checking occasionally , for 45 minutes or until the rice is cooked
6. Add additional broth if needed
7. Add parsley to the cooked rice
8. Taste and season with salt and pepper

title: silky chocolate butter frosting
steps:
1. In 2-quart saucepan , combine sugar , flour and cocoa
2. With wire whisk , gradually stir in milk until smooth
3. Cook over medium heat , stirring frequently , until mixture has thickened and boils
4. Reduce heat to low
5. Cook 2 minutes , stirring constantly
6. Remove from heat
7. Cool completely
8. In medium bowl , with mixer at medium speed , beat butter until creamy
9. Gradually beat in milk mixture , melted chocolate and vanilla

title: stuffed pattypan squash
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f
2. Heat 1 inch water to boiling
3. Add squash
4. Cook 6 to 8 minutes or until crisp-tender , drain
5. Cut off stem ends
6. Hollow out squash
7. Reserve squash shells
8. Chop squash meat finely
9. Mix squash and remaining ingredients except cheese
10. Spoon 1 heaping tsp filling into each squash shell
11. Sprinkle with cheese
12. Place in ungreased square pan
13. Bake uncovered 10 to 12 minutes
14. Microwave directions: place squash and 2 tbsp water in square microwavable dish
15. Cover tightly and microwave on high 3 to 5 minutes or until crisp-tender
16. Drain
17. Hollow out and fill squash shells as directed
18. Place in square dish
19. Cover tightly and microwave 2 to 3 minutes or til hot
20. 8 small pattypan squash can be substituted for the tiny squash
21. Spoon 1 heaping tbsp filling into each squash shell

title: bacardi rum balls
steps:
1. Crush the vanilla wafers using a food processor or if you don't have one , put the wafers in a sealed plastic bag and use a rolling pin to crush finely , no chunks or lumps
2. Crush the nuts using the same process as for wafers
3. Place in a large bowl , add the honey and rum
4. Form into small balls and roll in powdered sugar

title: fantasy
steps:
1. Pour the milk into a cocktail shaker half filled with ice
2. Stir in the creme de menthe and then the amarula cream
3. Strain into a martini glass and serve
4. Garnish with chocolate sprinkles / chocolate powder if desired
5. Warm:
6. Warm the milk and pour into a mug , then gently stir in the creme de menthe and amarula cream

title: grilled pesto stuffed chicken thighs
steps:
1. Preheat the grill
2. Loosen skin from thighs to form a pocket
3. Stuff with pesto
4. Season chicken with salt and pepper
5. Grill the chicken , turning once , until cooked through , about 35 minutes
6. Meanwhile , mash garlic with 1 / 8 teaspoon salt to form a paste
7. Stir in 1 tablespoon olive oil and brush on bread slices
8. Toast bread on grill
9. Serve chicken on bread , garlic side up

title: gourmet cappuccino biscotti
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. In bowl of a electric mixer fitted with the paddle attachment , combine the flour , sugar , baking soda , baking powder , salt , cinnamon and cloves
3. Blend until the mixture is combined well
4. In small bowl , whisk together espresso , milk , egg yolk and vanilla extract
5. Add egg mixture to flour mixture
6. Beat until a dough is formed
7. Stir in the hazelnuts and chocolate chips
8. Turn out the dough onto a floured surface
9. Knead it several times and halve it
10. On a large buttered and floured baking sheet with floured hands , form each piece of dough into a flat log 12 inches long by 2 inches wide
11. Arrange logs at least 3 inches apart on the sheet
12. Bake the logs in the center of oven for 35 minutes
13. Let cool on the baking sheet on a rack for about 10 minutes
14. Reduce the oven temperature to 300
15. On a cutting board , cut the logs crosswise on the diagonal into 3 / 4 inch slices
16. Arrange the biscotti , cut side down , on the baking sheet
17. Bake 5-6 minutes on each side , or until they are pale golden
18. Transfer the biscotti to racks to cool and then store in airtight containers

title: summer frappe  low fat
steps: 1. Put all ingredients in a blender , and blend until frothy and ice cubes are ground up

title: jean s preserved root ginger
steps:
1. Peel and cut root ginger into 1 inch pieces and place in jars
2. Cover with dry sherry
3. This keeps indefinately in the fridge and as you use your ginger the sherry can be used in marinades

title: mean chef chili
steps:
1. Red chile sauce---------
2. Stem and seed chiles , roast at 250 for 3- 4 minutes
3. Add to the water in a covered pan and simmer for 20 minutes
4. Cool
5. Blacken tomatoes under broiler
6. Saute onion in oil over low heat until browned
7. Put tomato , onion , garlic , chiles , cumin , oregano , adobo sauce and salt in a blender
8. Add stock and puree to a fine paste
9. Add lard to a skillet and heat to almost smoking
10. Fry sauce at a sizzle for 5 minutes
11. Do not allow to get too thick
12. Add more stock if necessary
13. Extra can be frozen and use for any mexican / southwestern recipe whic calls for red chile sauce
14. For chili--------
15. Place chile sauce , ale , beef stock , tomato sauce and enchilada sauce in large stock pot and let simmer for 20 minutes
16. Brown meat in lard in cast iron skillet
17. Saute onion in same pan to brown
18. Place meat and onion in bowl and sprinkle with 1 / 2 cup of masa
19. Add to stock pot including accumulated juices
20. Add peppers to stock pot
21. Add spices to stock pot
22. Simmer slowly until meat is tender
23. Correct seasoning
24. Add sausage

title: ziti with hot sausage sauce
steps:
1. In a skillet over medium heat , cook the sausage until evenly brown
2. Mix the red onion , garlic , and capers into the skillet , and cook until onion is tender
3. Mix in the mashed whole tomatoes , crushed tomatoes , tomato sauce , and red wine
4. Season with basil , parsley , oregano , red pepper , black pepper , and salt
5. Bring to a boil , and reduce heat to low
6. Simmer 45 minutes , stirring occasionally , until thickened
7. Bring a large pot of lightly salted water to a boil
8. Place the ziti in the pot , cook 10 minutes , until al dente , and drain
9. Serve the sauce mixture over the cooked pasta
10. Top with cheese

title: asparagus with balsamic butter  weight watchers 0 points
steps:
1. Snap off tough ends of asparagus
2. Bring 1 inch of water to a boil in a large skillet and add asparagus
3. Cook 4 to 5 minutes or until crisp-tender
4. Drain and place on a serving platter
5. While asparagus cooks , heat a large nonstick skillet over medium heat and coat with cooking spray
6. Add shallots and saute 1 to 2 minutes until soft
7. Remove from heat and stir in butter and balsamic vinegar
8. Pour balsamic butter over asparagus , sprinkle with salt and pepper and toss well

title: phyllis  chocolate syrup
steps:
1. Heat sugar , milk , cocoa in saucepan over medium-high heat to a boil
2. Remove from heat , add butter and vanilla
3. Serve over biscuits

title: south of the border hash brown bake
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f spray 13x9-inch glass baking dish with nonstick cooking spray
2. In large bowl combine allwhites and milk
3. Mix well
4. Add hash browns , black beans , corn , red pepper and 1 cup cheese
5. Stir to mix well
6. Pour into prepared baking dish
7. Bake for 40 to 45 minutes or until center is set and edges are browned
8. Sprinkle top with remaining 1 cup cheese
9. Continue baking for 3 to 5 minutes or until cheese is melted
10. Sprinkle with cilantro
11. Let stand 5 minutes before serving

title: romaine  radicchio   arugula salad
steps:
1. Whisk together first six ingredients in medium bowl
2. Gradually whisk in oil and season generously with fresh ground pepper
3. Toss greens with dressing

title: braised onions a la julia child
steps:
1. If you are using fresh pearl onions , they are easier to peel if you blanch them in boiling water for 30 seconds and then run them under cold water to cool
2. If you are using frozen pearl onions , make sure they are defrosted and drained
3. Heat the butter and oil in a large skillet and add the onions to the skillet
4. Saute over medium heat for about ten minutes , rolling the onions about so they brown as evenly as possible without breaking apart
5. Pour in the stock , add the herbs , and cover
6. Simmer over low heat for about 40 to 50 minutes until the onions are perfectly tender but retain their shape and the liquid has mostly evaporated
7. Remove the herbs , season with salt and pepper to taste , and serve

title: gramflour squares
steps:
1. Heat a pan on medium flame
2. When hot , spoon ghee into it
3. Allow to melt
4. Add gramflour and flour
5. Cook till the rawness of the gramflour is gone
6. This will take about 20 minutes
7. You will know when it's done when you see bubbles on the sides of the pan
8. When this happens , remove the pan from heat and keep aside
9. Now , put sugar in another pan
10. Add water and yellow food colour
11. Cook on low-medium flame till the sugar melts
12. Add the gramflour-desi ghee mixture and mix well
13. Now grease a tray with desi ghee
14. Transfer the above prepared mixture into it
15. Garnish with chopped pistachios or edible silver foil
16. Do not use both together
17. Allow to cool completely
18. Refrigerate to allow it to set
19. Once set , cut into squares or triangles or blocks and serve as a dessert after your meal

title: diabetic raspberry pork chops
steps:
1. Place raspberry jam in microwave for 60 seconds to liquify
2. Add in the raspberry vinegar
3. Set aside
4. Spray a frying pan with cooking spray and fry the pork chops until done
5. Remove from pan and place on serving dish
6. Pour raspberry sauce over pork chops and serve

title: chocolate bundles with chocolate ganache
steps:
1. Unfold puff pastry and cut the sheet into 4
2. Beat eggs and cream together to create an egg wash
3. Brush pastry squares with egg wash
4. Place 2 chocolate kisses and mini candy bars in the center of each pastry square
5. Pull corners of the square up around the chocolate , brushing edges with more egg wash if necessary to secure bundle
6. Brush exteriors of bundles with additional egg wash
7. Place bundles on a cookie sheet lined with parchment paper
8. Bake for 35 minutes or until golden brown
9. Ganache:
10. In a sauce pan bring heavy cream to a boil
11. Place the chocolate pieces in a bowl and pour hot cream over top
12. Whisk until smooth
13. Puddle ganache onto a plate and place 1 bundle on top
14. Top with whipped cream and other garnishes as desired
15. Top whipped cream with additional ganache if desired
16. Enjoy !

title: linda s blueberry pomegranate martini
steps:
1. Fill a shaker half-way with ice
2. Shake ingredients in a shaker and put in chilled martini glasses

title: beef stroganoff in the mellinkoff manner
steps:
1. Saute mushrooms and onion in the 3 t butter and add salt and pepper
2. Cook 3 minutes and add the 1 / 2 c sherry wine and stir
3. Slowly mix in the sour cream using a wire whisk and add the paprika , and lemon juice
4. Set aside
5. In a small saucepan , melt the 2 t butter with 2 t flour
6. Add the beef stock over low heat and stir until sauce is very thick
7. Add this into the sour cream mixture
8. Cut the meat into slices 2" by 1 / 4" and then season with some salt and pepper
9. Sear them quickly in the 1 t oil until browned on both sides and remove from the pan
10. Don't do too many slices at a time
11. Continue with remaining meat slices and remove from pan
12. Drain fat from the skillet and add 1 / 4 c sherry wine to the pan and deglaze
13. Stir in tomato paste , sour cream mixture , and meat
14. Taste and add more salt , lemon juice or paprika as needed
15. Serve over egg noodles

title: apple walnut bread
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine oil , applesauce , eggs , sugar and vanilla
2. In a separate bowl , combine flour , cinnamon and baking soda
3. Gradually add dry ingredients to oil mixture
4. Stir in apples and nuts
5. Pour into loaf pans , bake at 325f for 1 hour and 10 minutes , or until a knife inserted in the center of loaf comes out clean
6. Cool 10 minutes before removing from pan

title: taramosalata
steps:
1. Soak the bread in water for 5 minutes and squeeze dry between hands
2. Put in food processor along with tarama , onion and garlic
3. With processor running , drip in olive oil and lemon juice , alternately , until tarama has a light , mayonnaisey consistency and is completely emulsified

title: spicy tangy chicken and broccoli stir fry
steps:
1. Rinse and pat dry the chicken and place in a tupperware with lid or a plastic baggie
2. Toss chicken with the flour to lightly coat it
3. Combine lime juice , vinegar , sesame oil , ginger , garlic , red pepper flakes , and corn starch in a small bowl
4. Heat 2 frying pans , each with half the oil , at medium heat
5. Place broccoli and cashews in one pan
6. In the other pan , place chicken strips
7. Fry chicken until lightly browned , turning once
8. About 3 minutes per side
9. Add broccoli and cashews to the pan with the chicken
10. Pour sauce in pan and stir to coat
11. Reduce heat slightly and let cook for 5 to 7 minutes
12. Serve over rice

title: mustard seed potato salad
steps:
1. Clean and slice potatoes into bite sized rounds and boil until fork tender
2. Squeeze out the pulp from the head of garlic
3. Make vinaigrette by whisking garlic , mustard and vinegar in a bowl and then slowly whisking in olive oil , season with salt and pepper and add mustard seeds at the end
4. While potatoes are still warm and drained , toss with vinaigrette
5. Just before serving add onions , herbs and watercress

title: chicken skewers with chirmol salsa
steps:
1. For the skewers: heat outdoor grill
2. Mix ingredients in a plastic food bag and seal
3. Marinate for 15 minutes
4. Have ready 8 skewers
5. For the salsa: coat tomatoes with nonstick spray
6. Grill , turning , for 5 minutes or until the skins are charred
7. Remove to a bowl
8. Mash until almost smooth
9. Stir in rest of ingredients
10. Thread chick on skewers
11. Coat with nonstick spray
12. Grill 4 minutes , turning once , or until lightly charred and cooked through
13. Serve with salsa

title: herbed pumpkin
steps:
1. Chop your pumpkin into cubes , enough to cover the bottom of the frypan in a single layer
2. Melt about 100gr butter , add pumpkin , and coat in butter
3. Sprinkle with mixed herbs , and a little salt and pepper
4. If the pumpkin isnt very sweet , you can sprinkle with the sugar
5. Shake the pan to stop the pumpkin from sticking , and when the cubes start to colour , add 1 cup chicken stock
6. Enough to come about half way up the pumpkin
7. Cover and turn heat right down
8. Shake the pan occasionally , and check every few minutes , add a little more stock or water if necessary
9. When the pumpkin is cooked , turn off heat
10. When you are ready to serve , put the pan over very high heat , take the lid off and let all the liquid evaporate , and the bottom of the pumpkin brown a little ,

title: tofu in almond sauce
steps:
1. Soak the flaked almonds in warm water for a couple hours
2. Drain and process almonds in a food processor into a fine puree
3. Heat the oil in a pan , adding cumin seeds , cloves , cardamom pods , minced garlic , ground turmeric and bay leaves
4. When spices begin to crackle , add chopped onions and fry for 5-10 minutes
5. Add the tofu and continue to fry , stirring continuously
6. Stir in the almond puree
7. Cook over low to medium heat for 15-20 minutes
8. Stir in the light cream , ground cardamom and garam masala
9. Add sugar and salt to taste , cook for another 3-5 minutes
10. Garnish with almond flakes and cilantro

title: zesty cincinnati chili
steps:
1. Cook ground beef in dutch oven over medium-high heat , stirring occasionally , until browned
2. Drain off fat
3. Add onion and garlic
4. Continue cooking until lightly browned
5. Stir in all remaining ingredients except spaghetti
6. Continue cooking until mixture comes to a boil
7. Reduce heat to low
8. With cover ajar , cook until flavors are blended and sauce thickens
9. Meanwhile , cook spaghetti according to package directions
10. Drain
11. To serve: divide cooked spaghetti among 5 bowls
12. Top each serving with 1 cup chili and your favorite toppings
13. It was great !
14. When doubling the recipe , reduce the tomato sauce to 3 cans and 1 can for a total of 53 oz
15. In cincinnati the true enthusiasts have their chili 1 - 5 ways:
16. 1
17. Plain
18. 2
19. "two way" - spaghetti and chili
20. 3
21. "three way" - chili , spaghetti , and cheddar cheese
22. 4
23. "four way" - chili , spaghetti , cheddar cheese , and onions
24. 5
25. "five way" - chili , spaghetti , cheddar cheese , onions and kidney beans

title: rusty s chocolate vegan brownies
steps:
1. With vegetable oil , lightly oil a 9 x 12 glass pan
2. Preheat oven to 325 degrees
3. With a fork , mix together the flour , cocoa , sugar , baking powder , baking soda and sea salt
4. In a small bowl , blend the chocolate soy milk and applesauce
5. Combine the liquid ingredients into the dry ingredients and thoroughly mix together
6. Fold in the chocolate chips
7. Pour batter into the oiled pan and bake for 35-40 minutes
8. Smaller pans have a longer cooking time

title: penne with asparagus and smoked salmon cream
steps:
1. Cook pasta in plenty of boiling salted water per package directions
2. Melt butter in frying pan and add shallots
3. Sautee 1-2 minutes until they begin to sweat
4. Add asparagus and continue to sautee until crisp-tender
5. Once the asparagus are crisp-tender add half and half , lemon zest , 2 tablespoons dill and salt
6. Bring to a light simmer
7. Drain pasta and add the pasta and the salmon to the cream sauce , lightly toss and heat through
8. Turn into serving bowl or platter and top with remaining dill and sprinkling of grated cheese

title: maid rites
steps:
1. Cook beef , salt and pepper for 30 minutes in a medium saucepan
2. Add the rest of the ingredients and cook 20 minutes longer over low heat

title: mediterranean chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Combine feta and tapenade in a small bowl
3. Rinse chicken and pat it dry with paper towels
4. With a sharp knife , make a 2-inch slit in thickest part of each chicken breast half to form a pocket
5. Using a spoon , stuff some of the feta mixture into each pocket
6. Season chicken with pepper
7. Heat 2 tablespoons oil in non-stick skillet over medium heat
8. Add chicken and cook until browned , about 2 minutes per side
9. Transfer to baking dish and bake until cooked through , about 15 minutes
10. Meanwhile , heat remaining oil and salsa in skillet over medium heat until warmed through , about 5 minutes
11. Add spinach and cook , tossing frequently , until barely wilted , about 1 minute
12. Place spinach and salsa on individual plates , top with chicken , and sprinkle with capers , if desired
13. Serve lemon wedges on the side

title: nuts for you chocolate molten lava cakes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425f spray six jumbo muffin cups with non-stick cooking spray
2. Microwave chocolate and butter in large microwaveable bowl on high 1 minute or until butter is melted
3. Stir with wire whisk until chocolate is completely melted
4. Stir in sugar until well blended
5. Blend in eggs and egg yolks with wire whisk
6. Stir in flour and nuts
7. Divide the batter amongst the cups
8. Bake 13 to 14 minutes or until sides are firm but centers are soft
9. Let stand 1 minute carefully run small knife around cakes to loosen
10. Invert cakes onto dessert dishes
11. Serve immediately , topped with cool whip or powdered sugar
12. To make batter a day ahead: prepare the batter as directed and pour into greased jumbo muffin cups
13. Cover with plastic wrap
14. Refrigerate up to 24 hours
15. Let stand at room temperature 1 hour before baking as directed

title: southern egg salad
steps:
1. Chop eggs into small pieces
2. Mix together all ingredients
3. Serve on toasted bread , crackers , or alone !

title: linguine with smoked salmon
steps:
1. Cook linguine pasta according to package directions to al dente
2. Drain and return to pan to keep warm
3. Toss pasta with butter , olive oil , pepper , and salt
4. Place pasta in individual plates
5. Place smoked salmon chunks in an attractive design on top of the pasta
6. Serve and enjoy !

title: the easiest  simplest vegan bread ever
steps:
1. In a large bowl mix together flour , salt , and yeast , and form a well in the bottom
2. Pour in water and add the oil
3. With a wooden spoon slowly pull the flour into the liquid until it's fully adsorbed
4. Work it into a ball with your hands and place on a floured work surface
5. The dough should be tacky but not hopelessly sticky
6. Sprinkle flour on the work surface and hands if needed
7. Continue to knead the dough for 5-10 minutes or until the dough becomes elastic
8. Rinse and grease the large bowl , then place the dough back in it
9. Cover lightly with damp cloth or plastic wrap
10. Let rise in warm place until double in size
11. Turn dough back out onto floured surface
12. Punch down and kneed slightly to work out air bubbles
13. Divide the dough in half , form round loaves and place on lightly oiled pans
14. Preheat oven to 375f and let dough rise 20 more minutes
15. Bake 30-40 min until crusts golden
16. You can also throw 1 / 2 c of water on the bottom coils 10 minutes in for "crustier" bread

title: easy double chocolate cheese cake
steps:
1. Set aside 1 cup of cake mix
2. Mix remaining cake mix with oil and 1 egg
3. Mixture will be crumbly
4. Press mixture into bottom of a greased 9 x 13" pan
5. Blend softened cream cheese and sugar together
6. Add 3 eggs and the reserved cup of cake mix
7. Beat with electric mixer until smooth
8. Slowly add milk and vanilla , blending at low speed
9. Mixture will be thin
10. Pour mixture over crust and bake at 300 for 55 to 65 minutes or until center is firm
11. Cool at room temperature
12. Cover with cool whip and chill at least 1 hour before serving

title: speedy stroganoff
steps:
1. Slice steak diagonally across the grain into thin strips
2. Toss with the flour
3. Brown steak in butter in a large skillet over medium heat
4. At the same time , add the mushrooms and garlic
5. Once the steak is brown , add the water and soup mix
6. Bring to a boil
7. Reduce heat , and stir in sour cream
8. Cook uncovered until thoroughly heated
9. Serve over noodles or rice

title: german chocolate and milky way bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f and grease / flour a 13 x 9 cake pan
2. Melt the margarine
3. Add cake mix and sweetened condensed milk
4. Stir well
5. Put 1 / 2 of the batter in prepared pan
6. Bake for 10 minutes
7. Cut up milky way bars in small pieces and place on top of hot cake
8. Spread the rest of the cake batter on top and bake 20 minutes more

title: chocolate cola cake
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients and pour into a greased 9x9 pan
2. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 to 40 minutes
3. The 9x9 pan is very important for the moistness and brownie like texture of the cake
4. If you don't like chocolate use a yellow cake mix and either diet mt
5. Dew or diet sprite and leave out the cinnamon

title: matt s shrimp and grits
steps:
1. For the shrimp stock
2. After peeling the shrimp , add the shells to the chicken stock and simmer for 30 minutes
3. Strain and reserve
4. For the grits
5. Bring milk and cream just up to a boil and slowly pour in grits while stirring with a whisk
6. Continue to cook for another 15 minutes
7. Season with salt and pepper
8. Allow grits to cool and solidify
9. Cut them into rounds , bread them , and deep fry each round until the exterior is crispy
10. For the shrimp sauce
11. Heat a saut pan over medium-high heat
12. Add bacon and render for 2-3 minutes
13. Add garlic and onion and cook 3 minutes
14. Add peppers and cook another 2 minutes
15. Add butter to pan and allow to melt
16. Add flour and stir in the mixture to create a roux
17. Begin to add shrimp stock 1 cup at a time until the desired consistency is achieved
18. Allow to cook for 30 minutes
19. Season sauce with worcestershire , vinegar , and finish with s&p
20. For the shrimp
21. Mix together paprika , chili powder , onion powder , garlic powder , salt and pepper and sprinkle on shrimp
22. Saute shrimp over high heat until crisp and cooked through
23. For plating
24. Center the grits in the middle of a bowl
25. Place desired serving of shrimp over top of the grits and ladle shrimp sauce around the grits
26. Garnish with freshly mince parsley

title: yankee collards
steps:
1. Heat olive oil gently in a large , heavy skillet
2. Saute the collards , onions , and garlic slowly and gently in the olive oil
3. Give it plenty of time since collards are tough if not slow-cooked -- letting them stew in their own juices until tender
4. Serve with balsamic vinegar and parmesan

title: pescado sudado  peruvian steamed fish fillets
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a large skillet over low heat
2. Add the onion , garlic , tomatoes , paprika and salt and stir-fry for 2 to 4 minutes
3. Cover the mixture completely with the fish fillets
4. Add the wine , cover the skillet , and cook for 5 minutes over low heat , which is just enough time to steam the fish
5. Garnish with the parsley
6. Serve with lemon slices , accompanied by sliced boiled potatoes , sliced boiled yuca , or hot white rice

title: corn grits cornbread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425f
2. Combine the dry ingredients
3. Stir the baking soda into the buttermilk and add that to the dry ingredients
4. Add eggs and melted butter
5. Stir together and pour into a 9x9 pan
6. Bake for 20 minutes

title: pork carnitas with green chiles
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Heat 2 tablespoons of the oil in an ovenproof , heavy , large covered pot over high heat
3. Add half of the pork cubes
4. Sprinkle with half of the salt and half of the black pepper
5. Cook pork until starting to brown , stirring often
6. Remove pork
7. Repeat with remaining pork cubes , salt and black pepper , adding more oil if necessary
8. Drain drippings from pot
9. Heat remaining 1 tablespoon oil in the same pot over medium heat
10. Cook onion in hot oil until tender
11. Stir in undrained chiles and garlic
12. Cook for 2 minutes
13. Return pork to pot
14. Add chicken broth
15. Cover and put in oven to bake for 1 hour
16. Serve pork in tortillas topped with cheddar cheese , tomato and sour cream if desired

title: macadamia and white chocolate biccies
steps:
1. Cream butter and caster sugar until light and fluffy
2. Add eggs one at a time , beating well after each addition
3. Mix in vanilla
4. Sift flour and baking powder , stir into creamed mixture along with chocolate and nuts
5. Take heaped teaspoons of mixture and roll into balls
6. Place on greased oven tray , allowing room for spreading
7. Flatten slightly with a floured fork
8. Bake at 180c degrees for approx 15 minutes until golden
9. Cool on wire racks

title: thanksgiving pie  leftovers shepherd s pie
steps:
1. Heat vegetables , meat , and gravy on the stove until warmed then pour into a greased casserole dish
2. Mix mashed potatoes with egg and spread over the warmed filling
3. Bake at 400f for about 25-30 minutes until filling is bubbly
4. Want a change ? sprinkle cheese on top , or mash ranch dressing mix into the potatoes with 2 tbs sour cream

title: mom sykes  hungarian goulash
steps:
1. Melt butter in large pot
2. Put in meat , paprika and onions and simmer until onions have turned clear and beef is browned on all sides
3. Add garlic and lemon zest
4. Add tomato paste and beef consume' to cover and simmer until meat is tender
5. Serve over hot noodles

title: cherry danishes
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl , dissolve yeast in water
2. Add milk , 1 / 4 cup shortening , sugar , 2 eggs , salt , mace , extracts and 2 cups of flour
3. Beat until smooth
4. Add enough remaining flour to form a soft dough
5. Turn onto a floured surface
6. Knead until smooth and elastic , about 6-8 minutes
7. Place in a greased bowl , turning once to grease top
8. Cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled , about 1 hour
9. Punch dough down
10. On a large floured surface , roll dough out to a 24-in
11. X 16-in
12. Rectangle
13. Dot half of the dough with 1 / 4 cup of shortening
14. Fold dough lengthwise
15. Fold the dough three times lengthwise , then two times widthwise , each time dotting with some of the remaining shortening
16. Place dough in a greased bowl
17. Cover and let rise 20 minutes
18. On a floured surface , roll dough into a 16-in
19. X 15-inch rectangle
20. Cut into 8-in
21. X 3 / 4-in
22. Strips , coil into a spiral shape , tucking end underneath the coil
23. Place in two greased 15-in
24. X 10-in
25. X 1-inch baking pans
26. Cover and let rise in a warm place until doubled , about 1 hour
27. Beat remaining egg
28. Make a depression in the center of each roll
29. Brush with egg
30. Fill with 1 tablespoon of pie filling
31. Bake at 375 for 15-18 minutes or until golden brown
32. Cool on a wire rack
33. Combine the first three glaze ingredients
34. Drizzle over rolls
35. Sprinkle with almonds
36. Yield: 40 rolls

title: day old bathwater punch
steps:
1. About 45 minutes before serving time , set cans of lemonade and limeade and container of sherbet out to thaw
2. After 15 minutes , scoop out half of the sherbet container's contents
3. Mix it into a brownish color
4. Return this mixture to the empty half of the sherbet container and to the freezer
5. Prepare lemonades and limeade according to the can directions
6. Pour into punch bowl
7. Float scoops of the brownish sherbet on top of the lemonade mixture spreading it around to look like dirty brown suds
8. Do not stir

title: pecan crunch fudge
steps:
1. Combine brown sugar , butter and evaporated milk in a 3 quart saucepan
2. Cook over medium heat , stirring constantly until mixture reaches soft ball stage
3. Remove from heat
4. Stir in butterscotch morsels and marshmallow creme
5. Beat vigorously with a wooden spoon until mixture is smoooth and just begins to cool
6. Stir in chopped pecans , brickle chips and vanilla
7. Spread mixture evenly into 2 buttered 8-inch square pans
8. Cool completely , and cut into squares
9. Gently press pecan half on each square if desired
10. Store in airtight container

title: pumpkin yogurt
steps: 1. Just mix it all up !

title: green bean and mushroom salad
steps:
1. Bring water to a boil and add the beans and salt and cook 5 minutes
2. Do not overcook
3. Drain and cool
4. Wash and dry the mushrooms and slice them thinly
5. Prepare the sauce by whisking together the mustard , vinegar , cumin , tobasco , salt and pepper
6. Slowly add the oil while whisking vigorously
7. In a salad bowl add the beans , mushrooms , onion and parlsey
8. Pour the sauce over the vegetables and toss well but gently
9. Serve

title: super easy potato soup
steps:
1. Cut potatoes into small pieces , add onion and boil in water just covering potatoes , about 20 minutes or until done
2. Do not drain
3. Mix 1 packet of original country gravy in small amount of water until lumps are gone
4. Add to potatoes , slowly and heat until thickened
5. If soup still looks watery , add another packet of country gravy
6. Some people have used 1 / 2 cup spud flakes to make it thicker also but i haven't needed it
7. Serve hot , topped with bacon bits and shredded cheese

title: honey snack mix
steps:
1. Heat oven to 300 degrees
2. In large bowl combine cereal , pretzels , and pecans
3. In microwave melt butter and combine with honey
4. Pour honey mixture over cereal mixture
5. Stir until well coated
6. Spread onto 15x10-inch jelly roll pan and bake for 10 minutes
7. Stir
8. Continue baking for 15 minutes or until cereal is glazed and honey mixture is absorbed
9. Immediately place snack mix on waxed paper
10. Cool
11. Store in tightly covered container

title: cecile s creamy mashed potatoes
steps:
1. Add broth and potatoes to a large pot
2. Bring to a boil
3. Cover and reduce heat to medium
4. Cook for 10 minutes or so , until the potatoes are tender
5. Drain , saving the broth
6. Mash the potatoes and add 1 / 4 cup broth , half-and-half , butter and pepper
7. Add more broth if needed until you get the desired consistency

title: jamaican bulla cake
steps:
1. Melt butter , set aside for a minute , meanwhile add water to sugar to form a syrup , only add enough water to saturate the sugar
2. Combine all the dry ingriedients with a wooden spoon , making a well in the middle add syrup and butter and slowly fold together to form a dough
3. Flour a board and knead for 5 mins , roll out into 1 / 8 inch thick , cut dough into 4 inch circles , place on a greesed baking sheet in a pre-heated oven
4. Bake for 25 mins or until bullas rise
5. This is a basic bulla cake recipe , you can add other ingriedients like ginger root or chocolate

title: middle eastern inspired fruit platter
steps:
1. Arrange sliced fruit artfully on a pretty platter
2. For presentation , i like to place the strawberry slices upright between the slices of melon
3. The grapes i arrange around the outer edge of the platter
4. Drizzle with the rose water and orange blossom water
5. Garnish with mint leaves

title: pineapple icebox cake
steps:
1. Cut the cake into one inch thick slices
2. Cream butter and icing sugar until fluffy
3. Add egg yolks one at a time , beating after each addition and scraping the sides
4. Add vanilla , pineapple and brazil nuts
5. Beat egg whites until stiff but moist and fold into mixture gently
6. Place a layer of cake in a dish , then a layer of pineapple-butter mixture
7. Continue to layer until all the cake and mixture are used up , ending with the pineapple mixture
8. Cover with foil and freeze for 24 hours
9. When ready to use take out and thaw for a 10 minutes
10. Garnish with whipped cream , a maraschino cherry and sprig of mint , or candied orange pieces -- whatever suits you
11. Variation: drained peaches or ripe mangoes could be substituted for the pineapple
12. I have only ever made it with pineapple

title: sausage and polenta   a layered baked casserole
steps:
1. In large skillet brown sausage and break into small pieces with onion , fennel , garlic , oregano , and pepper
2. Drain
3. Add tomatoes and sauce
4. Simmer , uncovered 10-15 minutes
5. In microwave safe bowl add polenta , chicken broth , and butter
6. Cover with saran wrap and microwave on high for 12 minutes
7. Stir every 3 minutes
8. Remove , stir in salt and pepper to taste
9. Place in sprayed casserole
10. Top w / meat mixture and the feta
11. Make the polenta recipe again
12. Place polenta on top of meat mixture and top w / parmesan and parsley
13. Loosly cover with foil
14. Bake at 375 for 45 minutes until lightly browned and hot :o)

title: french fry seasoning
steps:
1. Mix ingredients together a salt shaker
2. Sprinkle on fries fresh from the oven or fryer !

title: low sodium rotel tomatoes   homemade copycat
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in a 4-quart saucepan , and simmer until the mixture is reduced to 1 quart
2. Freeze in 8 fluid ounce portions

title: 15 minute no bake chocolate peanut butter fudge
steps:
1. Melt butter , let cool
2. Mix peanut butter , vanilla and butter by hand
3. Add cocoa , add 10x sugar , mix well by hand
4. Place in a square pan
5. In 15 minutes its ready ! cut into squares and enjoy~

title: spaghetti sauce   ww core
steps:
1. Heat olive oil in a large skillet on medium heat
2. Add the chopped onion , mushrooms , garlic , and herbs
3. Cook until onions are transparent and liquid is reduced
4. Reduce the heat to low , add tomatoes and tomato paste
5. Cover the skillet and cook for 15 to 20 minutes , stirring occasionally
6. Add salt and pepper to taste

title: applebee s oriental dressing
steps: 1. Mix em up

title: jalapeno hot sauce
steps:
1. In a med sauce pan over hight heat , combine oil , peppers , garlic , onion and salt
2. Saute for aprox
3. 4 minutes
4. Add the water and cook for 20 minutes , stirring often
5. Remove from heat and cool to room temperature
6. Transfer mixture to a food processor or use a hand blender to puree until smooth , add vinegar and continue to process until blended

title: vegan macaroni with soy cheeze
steps:
1. Cook macaroni until soft or al dente
2. Drain and put back into pot
3. Blend soy butter , nutritional yeast , soy milk , garlic powder and paprika until smooth
4. Add blended ingredients to macaroni
5. Stir in half of the soy cheese
6. Put rest of soy cheese on top of macaroni
7. Cover and let it sit for 5 minutes so cheese can melt
8. Enjoy !

title: knorr spinach dip
steps:
1. Thaw , rinse , and drain spinach
2. Mix ingredients together and serve with hawaiian or twist bread
3. Refrigerate before serving

title: s mores oatmeal for one
steps:
1. In a microwave safe bowl , mix together the oatmeal and water
2. Microwave on high 90 seconds or until bubbly and thickened
3. Stir in 1 tablespoon miniature chocolate chips until melted
4. Stir in miniature marshmallows
5. Arrange teddy grahams into oatmeal
6. Sprinkle with remaining chocolate chips

title: strawberries and cream bread pudding
steps:
1. Lay out 10 slices of bread on board
2. Usually overnight until it is dry and hard
3. Break into two or three inch pieces
4. Set aside
5. In medium mixing bowl add eggs , milk , vanilla and salt
6. Wisk to whip and mix
7. In large mixing bowl add cream cheese and sugar
8. Mix well
9. Add egg milk mixture a little at a time until cream cheese and egg milk mixture is totally mixed
10. Fold in 2 cups sliced strawberries , reserving 1 / 2 cup for the top
11. Add the hard bread pieces and mix
12. Preheat oven 350
13. Spray pam into two quart casserole
14. Put mixed bread mixture in casserole
15. Sprinkle 1 / 2 cup reserved strawberries on top
16. Bake 40 to 50 minutes , covered

title: basic muffin batter  and variations
steps:
1. Get out the additional ingredients for the variation you have chosen
2. Heat oven to 375f
3. Grease 12 regular or 24 mini-muffin cups
4. In a large bowl with an electric mixer , beat butter , sugar , baking powder and salt until pale and fluffy
5. Beat in eggs
6. Gently stir flour in alternately with buttermilk , beginning and ending with flour until well blended
7. Follow the directions for the variation you've chosen and divide the batter among the muffin cups
8. Bake 17 to 20 minutes for regular size , or 14 to 16 minute for mini muffins , until a toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
9. Cool in pan for 5 minutes , then remove and cool completely on wire rack
10. Chocolate cinnamon:
11. Add 1 teaspoons cinnamon to flour in basic batter
12. Stir in 1 cup melted semi- sweet chocolate chips after flour
13. Divide among muffin cups
14. Cut up 4 ounces light cream cheese and press into batter
15. Sprinkle with 2 tablespoons sugar mixed with teaspoons cinnamon
16. Bake as above
17. Apple almond:
18. Crumble 1 can or 1 roll almond paste on top of basic batter and stir in with 1 cup chopped apple
19. Divide among muffin cups and top each with 2 thin slices apple
20. Bake as above
21. Brush tops with 2 tablespoons warmed honey
22. Pumpkin struesel:
23. Mix 2 / 3 cup solid-pack pumpkin , cup brown sugar , 2 tablespoons molasses , and 1 teaspoons pumpkin-pie spice into basic batter
24. Divide among muffin cups
25. Top with crumbly mix of 3 tablespoons cold butter , 1 / 3 cup flour , 3 tablespoons brown sugar and 1 / 3 cup chopped pecans
26. Bake as above
27. Cranberry upside down:
28. Thoroughly grease muffin cups
29. Mix cup whole-berry cranberry sauce , cup chopped pecans , 2 tablespoons sugar and teaspoons nutmeg
30. Divide among muffin cups
31. Press 1 pecan half into center
32. Spread basic batter gently over cranberries
33. Bake as above
34. Cool in pan 15 minutes
35. Cranberry:
36. Mix cup whole-berry cranberry sauce , cup chopped pecans , 2 tablespoons sugar and teaspoons nutmeg into basic batter
37. Bake as above
38. Spicy mincemeat:
39. Stir 1 cup mincemeat and teaspoons allspice into basic batter
40. Divide among muffin cups
41. Bake as above

title: lemon delicious
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180 c
2. Grease six 1 cup capcity ovenproof dishes
3. Place butter , lemon rind , lemon juice , sugar , flour , milk and egg yolks in a bowl and whisk to combine
4. Using an electric mixer , beat eggwhites on high speed until soft peaks form
5. Using a metal spoon , fold in 1 / 4 if the eggwhite mix into the lemon mixture
6. Gently fold in remaining eggwhite
7. Spoon mixture into prepared dishes
8. Place dishes in a large baking dish and pour boiling water into baking dish until halfway up the sides of the smaller dishes
9. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes or until golden and set
10. Dust with icing sugar mixture

title: italian sandwich  pasta salad
steps:
1. Cook pasta and set aside
2. Place onions , dill pickles , olives , water chestnuts , chives and peppers in a bowl
3. Add oil , vinegar and spices
4. Marinate for 15-20 minutes or so
5. Add pasta , tomatoes , meat and cheese and toss lightly
6. Serve cold

title: raspberry peach melba
steps:
1. Reserve 4 peach slices for garnish
2. Pure the remaining peach slices with the reserved peach syrup and lemon juice in the work bowl of a food processor or blender
3. Spoon the pure into 4 dessert dishes
4. Add scoops of sherbet
5. Garnish with raspberries and reserved peach slices

title: baked chicken with pasta sauce
steps:
1. Set oven to 375 degrees f
2. Grease a 13 x 9-inch or a 2-quart baking dish
3. Pat the chicken pieces dry using paper towels
4. Season the chicken pieces with seasoned salt , black pepper and garlic power
5. Place into the baking dish
6. Bake for 30 minutes
7. Drain any fat in the dish
8. Pour the pasta sauce over the chicken then return to oven for another 25-30 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through
9. Sprinkle parmesan cheese over
10. Serve with cooked spaghetti

title: canadian bacon quiche
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Spray a 9-inch pie dish with vegetable oil spray
3. With a rolling pin , flatten each slice of bread on a cutting board or flat surface
4. Cut 5 slices in half vertically
5. Cut a 3-inch circle from the remaining slice with a round cookie cutter or a knife
