6. Place slices of bread in the bottom of the pie dish , slightly overlapping each piece to form a crust , gently pressing in the bottom and partially up the side of the pie dish
7. Place the reserved bread circle in the center and gently press down into the other slices of bread
8. Bake for 10 minutes , or until bread is toasted and golden brown
9. Remove from oven and place on a cooling rack
10. Scatter canadian bacon evenly in the bottom of the crust
11. Top evenly with red bell pepper and green onions
12. In a medium bowl , whisk together the milk , egg substitute , eggs , parmesan cheese , oregano , salt , and pepper , until blended
13. Carefully pour egg mixture over the meat and vegetable filling and place the pie dish on a baking sheet
14. Bake for 35 to 40 minutes , or until center is set
15. Remove from oven and let mixture rest 5 minutes before cutting into wedges

title: vicki s pineapple upside down dream cake
steps:
1. Drain pineapple reserving 2 tablespoons juice
2. Combine brown sugar and butter in a 13 x 9- inch pan
3. Arrange pineapple slices in pan--place a cherry halve in each slice
4. Cut side up in center of each slice
5. Sprinkle with reserved juice and nuts
6. Combine cake mix dream whip envelope eggs and water in large mixer bowl for 4 minutes
7. Carefully spoon over pineapple
8. Bake at 350 for 50 to 55 minutes or until top springs back when pressed
9. Let stand for 10 minutes , then invert and let stand 1 minute then remove from pan

title: whole wheat rolls
steps:
1. Combine ingredients in the order your bread maker calls for on dough cycle
2. Check on dough half way through needing adding a bit more flour or water as needed so dough is fairly tacky
3. Turn out onto greased cutting board and work with greased hands
4. Shape into 15 rolls and place in greased 9x13 pan making 5 rows of 3
5. Let rise 30-45 minutes or until doubled in size
6. Bake at 350 for 15-20 minutes

title: mini cheesecake bites
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Place foiled muffin cups into mini-muffin tin
3. Add one vanilla wafer to each muffin cup
4. In a medium bowl , mix cream cheese , sugar and vanilla on medium speed until smooth
5. Add eggs , one at a time , mixing well after each addition , then mix until creamy
6. Fill each muffin cup 3 / 4 full
7. Bake 12 to 15 minutes or until the center is set and bounces back after lightly tapping it
8. Cool completely on wire rack
9. Refrigerate at least 3 hours , overnight is best
10. Top with fresh sliced berries , or berries with powdered sugar , whip cream or berry glaze before serving
11. Even try your favorite candy bar crushed

title: slow cooker lentil and rice soup
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in a small slow cooker
2. Cover and cook on low for 7 to 8 hours or until lentils and rice are cooked

title: swedish crepes
steps:
1. Mix together all ingredients
2. Pour into hot buttered crepe pan
3. Tilt pan to make a thin , even crepe
4. Peel back edges and flip
5. Serve with desired toppings

title: poached eggs on crumpet
steps:
1. Sired doneness while the crumpets are toasting
2. Poach eggs to disired doneness
3. Toast crumpets
4. Spread crumpets with butter and top with eggs
5. Place strawberries or tomatoes on the side

title: rice noodle salad
steps:
1. Soak noodles in hot water for 10 minutes , drain
2. Cook noodles in a pot of boiling water for 1 minute
3. Drain and rinse under cold water
4. Drain again
5. Whisk together vinegar , sugar , fish sauce and salt in a large salad bowl until sugar is dissolved
6. Add noodles and remainder of ingredients
7. Toss

title: family style bruschetta
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400 degrees
2. Spread sliced bread onto aluminum baking pan , drizzle with olive oil
3. Toast bread 10-20 minutes , turning once
4. In medium bowl , combine diced tomatoes , onions , sugar , and garlic and stir well
5. Add sweet basil , and red wine vinegar
6. Stir well
7. Add approximately 1 tablespoon olive oil , stir well
8. When bread comes out of oven , top bread slices with approximately 2 tablespoons of tomato / onion mixture
9. I have seen fresh mozzerella slices used below the brushetta topping , which is very pretty and probably delicious !

title: the creamiest apple crisp
steps:
1. Put apples in a 2 quart baking dish
2. Combine the rest of the ingredients
3. Stir mixture into apples
4. In a separate bowl , cut butter into the rest of the
5. Topping ingredients , and sprinkle on top of apples
6. Bake at 350f for 35-40 minutes or until golden brown

title: new england scalloped oysters and scallops
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Mix the melted butter and bread crumbs together and put one third of them in a thin layer in the bottom of a buttered baking dish
3. Cover with half of the oysters and seasonings
4. Add some of the cream
5. Layer half of the scallops next , seasonings , and another third of buttered crumbs
6. Add the remaining oysters and cream
7. Top with the final half of scallops and top with remaining buttered crumbs
8. Bake for 30 minutes
9. Serve hot

title: ibby s metaphysical english toffee
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees , using the middle rack
2. Line a 10-inch by 15-inch jelly roll pan with foil
3. Spray the foil with cooking spray
4. Line the pan completely with crackers , salt side up
5. Cover the whole bottom
6. Set aside
7. Combine the butter and brown sugar in a saucepan
8. Bring to a boil over medium high heat , stirring constantly
9. Boil for exactly 5 minutes , stirring constantly
10. If it sputters , reduce the heat
11. If it stops boiling , reduce the heat
12. Never stop stirring
13. Pour the mixture over the crackers as evenly as possible
14. Slide the pan into the oven
15. Bake at 350 degrees for 10 minutes
16. Remove pan and sprinkle with chocolate chips
17. After a minute or two of melting , spread the chips with a spatula
18. Sprinkle chopped pecans over the top and refrigerate
19. When the toffee has chilled thoroughly , peel it from the foil and break it into random sized pieces

title: zucchini chocolate chip cookies
steps:
1. Combine egg through vanilla in a mixing bowl
2. Combine white flour through nutmeg in a medium bowl and add to liquid mixture
3. Stir zucchini and chocolate chips into other ingredients , mix well
4. Drop by spoonful onto greased baking sheet , and flatten with the back of a spoon
5. Bake at 350 , 10 to 15 minutes

title: beer and date coffee cake
steps:
1. Grease a 10-inch tube pan
2. Line with waxed paper and grease again
3. If you dont line the pan , you may never get the cake out
4. Beat brown sugar and butter together well
5. Add the eggs , beating well after each one
6. Sift cinnamon , allspice , cloves , flour , baking soda and salt together
7. Use a small amount of the flour mixture to dust the walnuts and dates
8. Add remaining flour mixture to the creamed mixture , alternately with the beer , blending well after each addition
9. Stir in the walnuts and dates
10. Spoon batter into prepared pan
11. Bake in preheated 350 oven for 1 hours or until cake tester comes out clean
12. Let stand 10 minutes , invert onto a wire rack
13. Carefully peel off paper
14. Sprinkle with powdered sugar and place on a serving plate

title: millennium mocha rocky road oatmeal cookies
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f
2. Spray cookie sheets with cooking spray
3. Beat butter and sugars with electric mixer until creamy
4. Add eggs and vanilla
5. Beat well
6. Add coffee if using or milk substitute and mix well
7. Add combined flour , baking soda and salt
8. Mix well
9. Stir in oats , chocolate chips and walnuts
10. To shape cookies , flatten 1 heaping tbsp of dough in palm of hand
11. Arrange 4 marshmallows in center
12. Wrap dough around marshmallows to cover completely
13. Repeat with remaining dough and marshmallows
14. Space cookies 2" apart on cookie sheets
15. Bake 10-12 minutes or until edges are golden brown
16. Let stand 2 minutes on cookie sheets
17. Remove to wire racks
18. Cool completely
19. Store tightly covered

title: baked austrian rice pudding   reisauflauf
steps:
1. Slice vanilla bean in half lengthwise and scrape out seeds
2. Bring milk and if using cream to a boil and add rice and vanilla seeds
3. Reduce heat , cover pot and let rice steam until soft
4. Separate eggs and beat egg whites with a dash of salt until firm
5. Mix butter , sugar until creamy
6. Add egg yolks , cinnamon and lemon zest
7. Mix again
8. Cut bananas in 5mm slices / rounds
9. Add rice and mix until "batter" is homogeneous
10. Incorporate beaten egg whites slowly
11. Butter a casserole or a cake pan and pour in half of the rice batter
12. Spread mixture evenly
13. Cover rice batter with banana slices and cover with the other half of rice batter
14. Spread evenly
15. Sprinkle with 3 tablespoons brown sugar
16. Let bake at 175c for about 25-30 minutes until a golden brown crust has formed
17. Enjoy !

title: mexican chicken penne
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to directions
2. Meanwhile , combine chicken , dip , milk and salt
3. Drain pasta
4. Add to chicken mixture and toss to coat
5. Top with tomato , onions and cheese

title: onion fritters  bhajas
steps:
1. In a bowl , mix the flour , chili powder , turmeric , baking powder and salt
2. Add the crushed cumin seeds , onion , green chili's and coriander leaves , toss well
3. Very gradually mix in enough cold water to make a thick batter coating all of the ingredients
4. Heat enough oil in a wok or deep frying pan
5. Drop by spoonfuls into the hot oil and fry until golden brown leaving enough space to turn fritters easily
6. Drain well and serve hot

title: scallop  shiitake and prosciutto skillet surprise
steps:
1. Cut mushrooms into 4 or 6 pieces and cook in skillet with 3 tablespoon of olive oil
2. Add prosciutto , jalapeno and clam juice
3. Continue cooking for another 5 minutes
4. Remove from the skillet and set aside
5. In the same skillet , add scallops with 1 tablespoon of olive oil and caramelize quickly
6. Add preparation obtained in step 1 and mix well
7. Season with salt and let mixture warm for 1 or 2 minutes , stirring constantly
8. Serve in endive leaves as appetizers
9. As en entre , arrange about 24 of these appetizers on a serving plate and heat in oven preheated to 375 f for about 3 minutes
10. Chef's
11. Sprinkle with finely chopped coriander and serve with steamed broccoli

title: cinnamon peach coffee cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Prepare peaches
3. Spray a 9x13-inch pan with nonstick cooking spray
4. In a large bowl , whisk together the sugar , oil , eggs , vanilla and lemon zest
5. Stir in flour , baking powder , baking soda , cinnamon , nutmeg and salt
6. Fold in the prepared peaches and nuts
7. Gently combine
8. Spoon into prepared pan
9. Bake in preheated oven for 30 minutes , then reduce heat to 325 degrees for an additional 40-45 minutes , or until cake tests done
10. This is great served with lemon sorbet

title: kelly s wedding salad
steps:
1. In a bowl or shaker , combine olive oil , vinegar , basil , brown sugar , garlic and salt
2. Mix and chill for at least 1 hour
3. In a large bowl add salad greens , almonds , feta cheese , bacon and pear slices
4. Drizzle with dressing and toss gently to coat

title: pecan pralines  old fashioned
steps:
1. Combine sugar , margarine and milk
2. Cook to a soft ball stage
3. Remove from heat and stir in vanilla and pecans
4. Stir until it begins to thicken
5. Drop by tablespoons on waxed paper or buttered dish
6. Ready to eat when cooled
7. Store remainder in airtight container

title: paula deens baked french toast casserole rasberry syrup
steps:
1. Slice french bread into 20 slices , 1-inch thick each
2. Arrange slices in a generously buttered 9x13 casserole dish in 2 rows , overlapping the slices
3. In a large bowl , combine the eggs , half-and-half , milk , sugar , vanilla , cinnamon , nutmeg and salt and beat with a rotary beater or whisk until blended but not too bubbly
4. Pour mixture over the bread slices , making sure all are covered evenly with the milk-egg mixture
5. Spoon some of the mixture in between the slices
6. Cover with foil and refrigerate overnight
7. The next day , preheat oven to 350 degrees f
8. Spread praline topping evenly over the bread and bake for 45 minutes , until puffed and lightly golden
9. Serve with raspberry syrup
10. Praline topping:
11. Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl and blend well
12. Spread over bread as directed above
13. Raspberry syrup:
14. Combine ingredients in a small saucepan and place over medium heat
15. Stir until warm and thinned out like syrup

title: shawarma djaj    chicken shawarma  lebanon    middle east
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl , combine chicken breasts with 1 / 2 cup of onion , lemon juice , olive oil & spices , then add the thyme before adding the salt to taste
2. Stir well & then let marinate , covered , in the refrigerator for about 3 hours , stirring occasionally
3. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f , then place chicken breasts in a roasting pan & bake for 25-30 minutes or until done
4. Remove from the oven & shred the chicken into slivers
5. Open oval pitas at the seam to create a large pocket , then spread a tablespoon of garlic sauce on the bottom half before filling each pits with equal amounts of sandwich ingredients
6. Wrap the bottom of the 'sandwiches' with a napkin & serve immediately

title: grilled baby potato kabobs
steps:
1. Place potatoes in salted water to cover in large sauce pot
2. Boil until potatoes are tender , about 10 to 12 minutes
3. Drain and transfer potatoes to large bowl
4. Toss with oil , garlic , thyme and pepper
5. Preheat grill
6. Thread potatoes evenly on 6 metal skewers
7. Grill for about 9 minutes , turning every 3 minutes and brushing with oil mixture until evenly browned

title: apple cake  apfelkuchen
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Cake:
3. In a large bowl , cream together shortening and sugar
4. Add eggs and lemon extract
5. Beat well
6. In another bowl , sift together flour , baking powder and salt
7. Add to creamed mixture alternately with milk , beating after each addition
8. Pour mixture into a lightly greased and floured 10-1 / 2"x14-3 / 4" pan
9. Top with filling and bake for 1 hour or until cake tests done
10. Filling:
11. Combine all ingredients in a bowl
12. Mix well
13. Spread over cake to cover

title: yakni pilau  chicken rice
steps:
1. Make a well-flavoured stock by simmering chicken in water to cover along with cardamom pods , peppercorns , 2 teaspoons salt and the onion stuck with cloves
2. Simmer for approximately 2 hours
3. Cool slightly , strain stock and measure out 4 cups
4. Remove meat from bones , cut into bite-size pieces and set aside
5. Wash rice thoroughly in water , drain in a colander and allow to dry for at least 1 hour
6. Heat ghee in a large pot and fry sliced onion until golden
7. Add saffron , garlic and ginger and fry for 1 minute , stirring constantly
8. Add rice and fry 5 minutes longer over a moderate heat , stirring with a slotted metal spoon
9. Add hot stock , garam masala , cardamom , 1 1 / 2 teaspoons salt , rose water , sultanas and reserved chicken pieces
10. Stir well
11. Cover pan tightly and cook over a very low heat for 20 minutes
12. Do not uncover pot or stir rice during cooking time
13. When rice is cooked , remove from heat and stand , uncovered for 5 minutes
14. Fluff up rice gently with a fork and place in dish , again using a slotted metal spoon
15. Garnish with almonds , peas and eggs

title: momma simo s popcorn
steps:
1. Heat the olive oil in a large soup pot over medium high heat
2. Add popcorn kernels and cover pot with lid
3. Shake pot constantly while popcorn pops
4. You should hear the sounds of the corn popping
5. When the pot is silent , it is done
6. Toss the popcorn with salt and cumin and serve

title: sugar free snickerdoodles
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Mix together margarine , sweetener , vanilla , and egg substitute
3. Slowly add flour , salt , baking powder and cornstarch
4. Then add water 1 tablespoon at a time until you reach a medium consistency
5. In a separate shallow bowl , put the 2 tablespoons of cinnamon
6. Using an ice cream scoop , scoop the cookie batter , then roll it in-between your hands to form a bowl
7. Roll is lightly through the cinnamon , place on a cookie sheet , and flatten with your hand
8. Space cookies about 1" apart on a cookie sheet
9. Bake at 350 degrees for 12 minutes , or until the bottom is crisp
10. Let cool on baking sheet for 5 minutes before transferring to a cooling rack

title: sweet potato and peanut stew
steps:
1. Heat cup peanut oil over medium heat in 5 qt pan
2. Add red pepper flakes , onion , pepper , and garlic
3. Cook until vegetables are tender
4. Add ginger , chili powder , and cumin , cook for 1 minute
5. Add sweet potatoes , tomato paste , salt& pepper
6. Add enough water to barely cover vegetables and mix well
7. Bring to a boil , lower heat , cover and simmer for 45 minutes , stirring occasionally
8. In a separate pan , heat remaining peanut oil over medium heat
9. Add ground beef or turkey , sautee until brown
10. Drain , and transfer to plate until stew is done , then mix in with stew
11. Add zucchini to stew and cook for another 15 minutes
12. Place peanut butter in a small bowl , stir in 1 cup of the stewing mixture until smooth
13. Add peanut butter mixture to the stew
14. Mix well and cook stew another 15 minutes
15. Re-season to taste
16. Serve with hot cooked rice or couscous

title: asian noodles  my sister s recipe
steps:
1. Sauce:
2. Mix all ingredients , set aside
3. You'll need half-the remainder stores well in the fridge
4. Noodles:
5. In a bowl , pour boiling water over the hokkien noodles , broccoli and shredded snow peas
6. Allow to stand for 3 minutes , drain
7. Heat a wok as high as possible , add the oil and stir fry the pork slices and garlic until fragrant
8. Add the noodles , broccoli and snow peas and toss for a few minutes
9. Add the chili paste and half the sauce and toss a couple more minutes , then add the beaten egg continuing to toss
10. Lastly add the bean shoots and chives , toss briefly and serve

title: amish bean soup
steps:
1. Boil the beans in the water for 2 minutes before removing them from the heat to let stand for 1 hour
2. Add the ham bone , garlic and bay leaf to the beans , and cover and simmer them for 2 hours or until the ingredients are almost tender
3. Add the vegetables and salt and pepper to taste , and simmer them for 1 hour longer
4. Remove the ham bone , cut off the meat and dice it to add to the beans
5. Reheat the soup almost to boiling , then remove the bay leaf

title: new years good luck soup
steps:
1. In a large stock pot or dutch oven , brown sausage along with onion and garlic
2. When the sausage browned add all of the other ingredients and mix well
3. Bring up to a boil
4. Reduce heat to simmer and cook for 45 minutes to an hour
5. If you want to do this in your slow cooker
6. Brown the sausage with the onion and garlic first in a skillet
7. When browned place the meat with the other ingredients in a 5 - 6 quart slow cooker and cook on low 6-8 hours or on high for 3-4 hours
8. Serve with your favorite cornbread
9. Letting this soup sit a day or 2 will meld the flavors even more

title: rosemary smoked halibut with balsamic vinaigrette
steps:
1. In a baking dish , place rosemary beside halibut
2. Light rosemary with match
3. Cover tightly with foil
4. Bake at 425 oven for 8 - 12 minute or until fish flakes easily when tested
5. Balsamic vinaigrette: meanwhile , in a small bowl , whisk together oil , balsamic vinegar , pepper and salt
6. Stir in tomato and shallot
7. Serve with halibut

title: pizza muffins
steps:
1. Drain tomatoes , reserving 1 / 4 cup liquid
2. In a bowl , combine the flour , baking powder , sugar , oregano and salt
3. Combine the egg , butter , tomatoes and reserved juice
4. Stir into dry ingredients just until moistened
5. Stir in 1 / 4 cup mozzarella cheese and 1 tablespoon parmesan cheese
6. Fill greased jumbo muffin cups two-thirds full
7. Sprinkle with the remaining cheeses
8. Bake at 350 for 20-25 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean
9. Cool in pan for 5 minutes before removing to a wire rack

title: mom s chili
steps:
1. Brown hamburger with onions and garlic
2. Add all remaining ingredients and simmer for 2 hours
3. I also like to brown the hamburger the night before and add all ingredients in my crockpot , refridgerate , and then set on low while at work the next day dinner will be ready when you get home !

title: deceptively delicious chocolate chip pumpkin muffins
steps: 1. Mix it all up and bake in 12 pre-sprayed muffin tins at 350 for 23 minutes

title: 2lb basic white french bread from breadman
steps: 1. Add all ingredients to bread pan in the order given

title: quick pumpkin spice muffins
steps:
1. Mix ingredients
2. Pour into cupcake papers
3. Bake according to spice mix directions for longest time

title: strawberry margarita ice pops
steps:
1. Combine lime juice , water , triple sec , tequila and sugar in a blender and blend until sugar is disolved
2. Set aside two strawberries and cut into quaters
3. Place the rest of the strawberries into the blender and combine until pureed
4. Place one quater of a strawberry and place it on the end of the popsicle stick
5. Pour the blended mix into each of the popsicle molds
6. Finally add the popsicle sticks to the molds
7. Freeze overnight
8. Unmold the popsicles and serve

title: billy s red  white  and bleu pasta
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to package directions
2. Melt butter and olive oil over medium heat , then add onions , garlic , and capers
3. Break up the onions with a spoon as you saute them and cook until softened and slightly browned
4. Sprinkle the flour over the top and stir constantly for 1 minute
5. Slowly add the half & half while stirring to combine
6. Let it come to a boil , stirring occasionally
7. Turn the heat to low and add the cheese , stirring until completely melted
8. Add the tomato paste and olives and stir to combine
9. Add red pepper flakes , basil , and parsley
10. Add salt and pepper to taste
11. Pour the sauce over the pasta and toss to coat
12. Serve with parmesan cheese if desired and enjoy !

title: cheese souffle with blueberry sauce
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees
2. Lightly spray a 8" x 8" x 2" baking dish with pam and set aside
3. Filling: in a small bowl , beat cottage cheese , cream cheese , egg yolk , sugar and vanilla with electric mixer till nearly smooth
4. Set aside
5. Batter: in a medium bowl , beat sour cream , butter , orange juice , and eggs with electric mixer on low speed until smooth
6. Add flour , 3 tablespoons of sugar and baking powder
7. Beat for 2 more minutes until smooth
8. To assemble: spread 1 / 2 the batter in the greased baking dish
9. Spoon cheese filling in small spoonfuls on top
10. Carefully spread remaining batter on top
11. Place in the oven for approximately 40-45 minutes until puffy and golden
12. Serve immediately with blueberry sauce or syrup
13. Blueberry sauce:
14. In a sauce pan over medium heat , stir together the sugar , cornstarch , cinnamon and nutmeg
15. Slowly stir in water
16. Cook and stir frenquently until thickened , then cook 2 more minutes
17. Carefully stir in blueberries and lemon juice

title: sage and lemon chicken
steps:
1. Place chicken breasts between wax paper or plastic wrap and pound to 1 / 2 inch thickness
2. Press 2 or 3 sage leaves on the surface of each breast
3. Combine flour , salt and pepper to taste on a plate , and gently dust chicken with the seasoned flour
4. Heat olive oil in a medium skillet and add chicken , sage-side down
5. Brown for 3 to 5 minutes , then turn over chicken and brown 3 minutes longer
6. Set chicken aside and pour off any fat
7. Add lemon juice and broth to the skillet and scrape up any browned bits with a wooden spoon
8. Return chicken to skillet and simmer for 5 minutes or until heated through
9. Place chicken on 2 serving plates then add butter to skillet and swirl to melt
10. Spoon sauce over chicken

title: hamburger hash brown recipe
steps:
1. Combine beef , onion , tomatoes , worcestershire sauce , and salt
2. In a separate bowl , combine corn , potatoes , flour , and chopped green bell pepper
3. Add the melted margarine
4. Spray 13 x 9 x 2 inch pan with non stick spray
5. Pat the beef mixture into baking pan
6. Top with the corn and potato mixture
7. Bake uncovered at 375f for 45 minutes
8. Sprinkle with the cheese and bake ground beef casserole 15 to 20 minutes longer , until potatoes seem done
9. I usually drain the casserole of the fat two times during cooking , once at about 20 minutes and again before i add the cheese

title: lobster stuffed tenderloin
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 425 degrees
2. Make a lengthwise slit in the middle of the tenderloin , cutting down within 1 / 2 inch of the bottom
3. This should form a pocket big enough to accommodate the two lobster tails
4. Place the lobster in boiling salted water
5. Return to a boil , reduce the heat and then simmer for 5-6 minutes
6. Carefully remove the lobster from shell
7. Cut in half , lengthwise
8. Place the lobster tails end to end inside the beef pocket
9. Combine 1 tbsp
10. Butter and lemon juice
11. Pour over the lobster
12. Close the meat around the lobster and tie securely with string at 1 inch intervals
13. Place the meat on the oven rack in a shallow roasting pan
14. Bake for 45-50 minutes for rare meat
15. Lay the bacon slices on top of the roast
16. Bake for 5 minutes more
17. In a saucepan , cook green onion in 1 / 2 cup butter over very low heat until tender , stirring frequently
18. Add the wine and garlic salt and heat through
19. To serve: slice the meat and then spoon the sauce over it
20. Garnish with fresh mushrooms , cherry tomatoes and parsley , if desired

title: spicy creamy pasta with shrimp
steps:
1. Mix in a bowl - chipotle powder , paprika , cajun , thyme and rosemary
2. This will be our spice blend
3. Heat the olive oil over medium heat in a skillet
4. Add the finely chopped garlic and red pepper flakes and stir for a minute
5. Then add half the spice blend and mix well
6. Now is the time to add a tiny bit of butter for flavor if you want - i rarely do
7. Add the shrimp and let it cook for 2 minutes before stirring
8. Toss the shrimp in the mixture for a minute more , then remove into a bowl and keep warm
9. Into your skillet , add the white wine and the other half of your spice blend
10. Stir
11. Cook until the wine comes to a boil then reduces to almost half
12. In the meantime , cook your pasta according to package directions
13. Back to your sauce - add the half and half , mix well
14. Season to taste with salt
15. Taste and adjust the spice to your taste
16. Remove the sauce from heat before the cream starts to boil
17. Pour the sauce into cooked , drained pasta , add the shrimp you set aside earlier and toss
18. Cover , set aside
19. Put the same skillet back on heat , spray with cooking spray and add the asparagus
20. Cook for a few minutes until tender crisp
21. In the meantime , place the sun-dried tomatoes in a small bowl and pour boiling water over it
22. Let it soak for 2 minutes , then drain and squeeze out the water
23. Add the asparagus and sun-dried tomatoes into the pasta and toss
24. Serve the pasta topped with grated good quality parmesano-reggiano and some chopped parsley
25. Pasta will taste better when it is kept covered for a while to allow the pasta to soak the sauce
26. It will also taste better when served with homemade bread brushed lightly with garlic butter and the rest of that bottle of wine
27. Enjoy !

title: jalapeno corn casserole
steps:
1. Cook the rice according to the package directions
2. Set the rice aside
3. Saute onion , garlic , bell pepper , and celery in the melted butter in a large skillet until the vegetables are tender
4. Combine the reserved rice and sauteed vegetables in a large bowl
5. Add the jalapeno peppers , corn , cheese , and sugar
6. Stir well
7. Spoon the corn mixture into a lightly greased , shallow 2 quart casserole
8. Bake at 350 degrees for 40 to 45 minutes or until thoroughly heated
9. Garnish , if desired

title: sweet potato crumble
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f / 200c
2. Bake sweet potatoes on a baking tray for 45minutes to one hour or more depending on the size of your sweet potatoes , they should be very tender
3. Turn down oven to 375f / 175c
4. Let sweet potatoes cool slightly and peel off the skins
5. Mash sweet potatoes then mix in the 1 / 8 cup brown sugar and spices , set aside
6. In another bowl , rub / fork the softened butter through the flour until crumbly and large breadcrumb-like
7. Mix in the one and a half ounces light brown sugar into the flour and butter mixture
8. Spread the sweet potato mixture into a casserole dish and top evenly with the crumble mix
9. Bake at 375f / 175c for 15-20 minutes , until the crumble is nicely browned and crisped

title: giant pizza cookie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. In small bowl , combine flour , oats , baking soda , and salt
3. Mix well and set aside
4. In medium bowl , beat butter and brown sugar until well blended and creamy
5. Add egg and vanilla
6. Beat well
7. Add flour mixture to butter mixture
8. Mix well
9. Stir in chocolate chips
10. Shape dough into a ball and place in center of round pizza pan
11. Pat dough into an 11 inch circle , about 1 / 4 inch thick
12. Bake 14-16 minutes are until light golden brown
13. Remove from oven
14. Cool 10 minutes
15. Transfer to serving platter
16. Spread with frosting
17. Decorate with candies

title: crispy cabbage and chicken wraps
steps:
1. Cook chicken till juices run clear
2. Add cloeslaw mix
3. Reduce heat to med
4. , coverand cook till cabbage wilts
5. Add seasons to tastes
6. Remove from heat and add mayo
7. Spoon on warm tortillas

title: lobster scallop sesame salad
steps:
1. Cut lobster meat and scallops if large into bite sized pieces and place in a large salad bowl
2. Trim peas and diagonally cut into 1 / 4 inch slices
3. Julieen the cabbage , jicama , carrots and yellow pepper , adding to the bowl
4. Slice the green onions into 1 / 2 inch slices
5. In a dry hot skillet toast sesame seeds for 1-2 minutes and transfer to a small bowl to cool
6. In another bowl whisk together the vinegar , soy sauce , sugar , sesame oil , ginger and garlic
7. Pour over salad and toss well
8. Sprinkle on the sesame seeds , toss again and serve

title: vegetarian lentil burger
steps:
1. Combine the lentils , eggs , and salt in a food processor
2. Puree until the mixture is the consistency of a runny yet textured hummus
3. Pour into a mixing bowl and stir in the onion
4. Add the breadcrumbs , stir , and let sit for a couple of minutes so the crumbs can absorb some of the moisture
5. At this point , you should have a very moist mixture that you can easily form into twelve 1 1 / 2-inch-thick patties
6. You can always add more bread crumbs a bit at a time to firm up the dough if need be
7. Conversely , a bit of water or more egg can be used to moisten the batter
8. Heat the oil in a heavy skillet over medium low , add 4 patties , cover , and cook for 7 to 10 minutes , until the bottoms begin to brown
9. Turn up the heat if there is no browning after 10 minutes
10. Flip the patties and cook the second side for 7 minutes , or until golden
11. Remove from the skillet and cool on a wire rack while you cook the remaining patties
12. Carefully cut each patty in half , insert your favorite fillings , and enjoy immediately

title: angel hair   chicken
steps:
1. Cook chicken in 1 tbsp oil , drain on paper towels
2. Heat remaining oil in same pan , cook carrots 4 minutes
3. Add broccoli & garlic , cook 2 minutes
4. Add broth & parsley
5. Reduce heat & simmer 4 minutes
6. Toss with angel hair

title: creamed salmon on toast
steps:
1. Over medium heat , melt the butter in a large saucepan
2. Add in flour and stir until smooth
3. Add in onions
4. Stir in milk gradually
5. Bring mixture to a boil while stirring constantly
6. Cook and continue stirring for 2 minutes or until thickened
7. Lower heat
8. Add in salmon and salt and pepper
9. Stir to combine
10. Cook about 10-12 more minutes or until well heated
11. Serve over toast

title: mushroom salad with mustard vinaigrette
steps:
1. In a large mixing bowl combine mustard , vinegar , oregano , tarragon , salt , and pepper
2. Using a wire whisk , blend in oil
3. Stir in mushrooms and olives
4. Cover and chill at least 2 hours
5. Serve on individual plates with tomato slices and a watercress sprig

title: drommar
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees
2. Place butter in a large , heavy skillet
3. Cook over medium-low heat without stirring , about 15 minutes , or until butter becomes a light tan color
4. Remove pan from heat and allow to cool in a very cool place so butter can become solid again
5. I will put it out on the covered back porch or inside of the refrigerator for 10-15 minutes , checking often until it solidifies
6. Break up the hardened brown butter with a wooden spoon or spatula
7. In a separate bowl add sugar , flour , baking powder , and cardamom
8. Mix well and add the browned butter , stirring well with a pastry blender to combine all ingredients
9. Add vanilla and almond extract
10. Initially , it will feel like it will not combine but it always does
11. Scoop enough dough into your hands to form a 1 inch ball and roll it around , allowing the heat from your hands to melt the butter
12. The dough feels gritty and when each ball is done , it will hold together beautifully and feel less gritty
13. Shape dough into 1" balls
14. Place each ball 1" apart from other cookies on a parchment-lined cookie sheet
15. Top each with an almond
16. Press down slightly so it lays flat on ball
17. Boil enough water in a kettle to cover almonds
18. Allow to sit for 3-5 minutes
19. Drain off the water and the almonds slip out of their skin very easily
20. Just pinch the almond between two fingers and out pops the clean almond
21. Bake in a 350 degree oven for 12-15 minutes or until lightly golden brown
22. Slide parchment paper with cookies attached to a flat surface to cool
23. Allow cookies to cool on the parchment until completely cold ! they fall apart if taken off too soon !

title: tasty tuna
steps:
1. Mix everything together and refrigerate for an hour or two to spread the flavors
2. Overnight is better
3. Serve on lettuce as a salad , on bread as a sandwich , on a flour tortilla as a wrap , or get creative and serve it in flat bottomed ice cream cones

title: apricot and muesli sesame balls
steps:
1. Place the apricots , water cinnamon , nutmeg and cardamom in a small saucepan and bring to the boil over medium heat
2. Reduce the heat to low and cover and simmer stirring occasionally for 12 minutes or until apricots soften
3. Remove from the heat and uncover and set aside for 20 minutes to cool
4. Meanwhile place the sesame seeds in a saucepan and toss over medium heat for 2-3 minutes until golden
5. Transfer to a heatproof bowl and set aside
6. Place the muesli in the bowl of a food processor and process until finely chopped , add apricot mixture and process until a stiff dough forms
7. Transfer to a bowl and use your hands to knead well until combined
8. Use your hands to roll 2 teaspoonfuls of mixture into a ball
9. Repeat with the remaining mixture and toss the balls in sesame seeds to lightly coat

title: turkey sausage quiche
steps:
1. Spray 9 x 13-inch dish with pam
2. Trim crust from bread
3. Place crusts in blender and blend until crumbled
4. Place bread over bottom of dish
5. Brown sausage and drain
6. Layer over bread
7. Mix bread crumbs with remaining ingredients and pour over bread and sausage
8. Bake at 350 degrees for 25 to 30 minutes , or until puffed and firm

title: pampered chef double chocolate mocha trifle
steps:
1. Prepare / bake brownies according to cake-like directions
2. Cool completely
3. In separate bowl , whisk pudding mix with milk until it begins to thicken
4. Dissolve coffee granules with warm water , then add to pudding mixture , mixing well
5. Fold in whipped topping
6. Cut brownies into 1 inch cubes
7. Layer 1 / 3 of brownie cubes into bowl , top with 1 / 3 of pudding mixture , pressing lightly , and 1 / 3 of chopped toffee
8. Repeat layers 2 more times
9. Chill 30 minutes before serving

title: avgolemono soup with leek and celery
steps:
1. In a stock pot saute the leeks and celery in olive oil until softened
2. Add the chicken stock and simmer 20 minutes
3. Puree the mixture with an immersion blender
4. Just before serving , beat the lemon juice and eggs together until light and frothy
5. Slowly beat a ladleful of hot soup into the egg and lemon mixture , stir well , then whisk back into the soup pot
6. Stir the soup well to make sure the eggs are incorporated so that they do not curdle
7. Adjust seasoning , add salt and pepper and serve warm
8. Garnish each serving with fresh dill if desired

title: martha washington balls
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients except chocolate chips
2. Refrigerate over night
3. Shape coconut mixture into walnut-size balls
4. Freeze until firm
5. Melt chocolate chips in a double boiler
6. Pierce balls with a tooth pick or wooden skewer , dip balls into chocolate
7. Lay on wax paper
8. Refrigerate until set
9. Store in an airtight container
10. I don't care for the wax , so i don't add it
11. It's just a personal preference

title: chewy gingersnaps sparkle cookies
steps:
1. In a large bowl , cream butter and sugar together using a hand mixer
2. Add other wet ingredients and mix
3. Add dry ingredients and mix
4. Dough should be easy to handle and not sticky
5. Add a little more flour if necessary
6. The dough should not be dry
7. Shape dough into one inch balls and roll in white sugar
8. Bake on an ungreased cookie sheet at 350 degrees for about 10 minutes
9. Remove immediately from cookie sheet onto cooling rack
10. Enjoy !

title: linda s fiesta crab wheels
steps:
1. Drain crab meat , and set aside
2. Put the cream cheese into a glass dish , and microwave for 45-60 secs
3. , to soften
4. Blend softened cream cheese with black olives , chilies , and green onions
5. Gently fold in crab meat
6. Spread crab mixture over entire surface of each tortilla with a thin coating
7. Roll tortillas up , and wrap tightly in plastic wrap
8. Refrigerate at least 4 hours
9. When ready to serve , cut each tortilla into 1 / 2" slices
10. Put on a serving dish , and garnish with lime wedges and jalapeno slices
11. To spice it up a little more , you can also add jalapenos into the mixture , to your taste
12. If you like it more on the mild side , remove the seeds and the white part of the jalapeno , then cut into strips and dice into small pieces
13. You can make and freeze these ahead of time
14. Just take out well before serving time , to thaw out

title: garlic sauteed artichokes
steps:
1. Rinse artichokes under cold water , and use a sharp knife to cut the top 1 / 3 off of each one
2. Trim the stems to about 1 inch , and remove the smaller leaves from around the base
3. Use scissors to remove any remaining leaf
4. Cut each artichoke in half from the bottom to the top , then use a spoon to scrape out the hairy choke
5. Rinse again to remove any residual hairs
6. Melt the butter in a large skillet over medium heat
7. Add the garlic , and saute for about 1 minute to flavor the butter
8. Arrange artichoke halves cut-side down in the skillet
9. Saute for about 5 or 10 minutes , or until lightly browned
10. Reduce heat to low , and pour in water& chicken broth , cover , and let steam for 15 to 20 minutes , or until the artichokes are tender
11. A fork should easily pierce the stem

title: chicken bacon roulades
steps:
1. Cook bacon until lightly brown but still flexible
2. Remove from pan and let dry
3. Cook the shallots in the remaining bacon fat over low heat , stirring , until softened
4. Transfer shallots with a slotted spoon to a small bowl and leave any fat remaining in skillet
5. Preheat oven to 300f
6. Place each chicken breast half between 2 sheets of plastic wrap
7. With smooth side of a meat pounder pound each breast to 1 / 8-inch thickness
8. Discard plastic from boned side of each breast
9. Sprinkle chicken with lemon pepper and salt
10. Place 2 1 / 2 slices of bacon lengthwise along middle of each breast
11. Top with shallots and parmesan
12. Using plastic wrap to help you , tightly roll up each breast lengthwise , tucking in the ends to enclose the filling
13. Secure seams with wooden toothpicks
14. Add 1 tbsp olive oil to reserved fat in skillet and heat over medium high heat
15. Brown roulades on all sides , about 5 minutes total
16. Transfer the skillet to middle of oven and bake roulades until just cooked through , 20 to 25 minutes
17. Transfer chicken to a plate with tongs and keep warm , covered with aluminum foil
18. Pour off fat from skillet
19. Add wine to the skillet and deglaze over medium high heat , scraping up brown bits
20. Boil wine until reduced to about 1 tablespoon
21. Add garlic and butter
22. Cook mixture over medium low heat , stirring , for 1 minute
23. Add flour and cook roux , stirring , 1 minute
24. Add broth and cream and bring to a boil , whisking
25. Simmer the sauce , whisking , 2 minutes
26. Pour through a fine mesh sieve into a small saucepan
27. Keep sauce warm
28. Remove the wooden toothpicks from roulades and cut crosswise into 1 / 2-inch slices
29. Spoon some sauce in center of each of 4 plates and arrange roulade slices decoratively on sauce

title: abuelita s almond chicken
steps:
1. Blend the whipping cream and buttermilk to form the "crema"
2. In a saucepan , combine 3 / 4 cup of the crema with the stock , milk , almonds , 2 of the chiles and garlic and bring the mixture just to a boil over medium heat
3. Let it sit for 5 minutes for the chiles to soften
4. Transfer the mixture to a blender and puree
5. Add salt to the sauce to taste
6. Salt the chicken lightly
7. Warm the oil in a large skillet over medium heat
8. Add the chicken and brown it on both sides
9. It may be easier to brown the chicken in batches , but return all the pieces to the skillet before proceeding
10. A snug fit is desireable
11. Pour the sauce over the chicken , cover , reduce the heat to low , and simmer until the chicken is cooked through and tender , about 12-14 minutes
12. Stir up from the bottom at least once to make sure the sauce isn't sticking
13. While the chicken cooks , cut the remaining chile into slivers with scissors
14. Transfer the chicken to a serving plate
15. Top with dollops of the remaining crema , the chile slivers and sesame seeds
16. Serve hot

title: the realtor s buttermilk  garlic salad dressing
steps:
1. Place mayo and buttermilk in a covered container and shake to combine
2. Add all the other ingredients and shake until well blended
3. Store in refrigerator for up to 1 week
4. Shake before using

title: sweet cottage cheese latkes
steps:
1. Beat cottage cheese , egg yolks , flour , sugar , cream salt and lemon zest until smooth
2. Beat egg whites until stiff but not dry and fold into the cheese mixture
3. In a frying pan over medium high heat , heat oil until hot
4. Drop 2 to 3 tablespoons batter into the pan to form each latke
5. Fry until golden , about four minutes per side
6. Use more oil as needed
7. Drain latkes on paper towels and keep warm in a 250 degree f oven until ready to serve

title: steve s garlic and lime sauce
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a small saucepan until very hot
2. Add the garlic and cook , swirling the pan , until just golden
3. Remove from heat and whisk in the lime zest and juice
4. Season with salt and pepper
5. Drizzle over cooked fish

title: chicken pot pie yumm
steps:
1. Boil chicken , keeping broth , when done cool chicken on plate
2. Mix cream of chicken with 1 1 / 2 cup broth from chicken
3. Mix with mixer till smooth
4. Place aside shredd chicken and place at bottom of casserole dish
5. Poor 1 / 2 chicken mixture over chicken
6. Spread vegall over that , then pour the rest of cream of chicken mixture over that
7. Mix butter , milk , and , flour together in a seperate bowl with a mixer
8. Pour over other ingredients in casserole dish bake in preheated oven at 375 degrees 45 minutes or till crust golden brown

title: samosa filling with mashed potatoes
steps:
1. Heat oil in a pan
2. Add cumin seeds , fennel seeds and pounded coriander seeds
3. If using ground cumin , use it later
4. When the seeds brown , add ginger and stir for 10 seconds
5. Add the peas , followed by turmeric , chili powder , salt and cumin powder
6. If the spices seem to start burning , sprinkle some water
7. Add the mashed potatoes
8. Stir well to mix
9. Saute until the mixture is dry
10. Lastly add garam masala powder and mix
11. Remove from heat
12. Mix in cilantro and lemon juice
13. Let cool and use in samosas
14. This mixture can be made without fennel seeds , if needed

title: potato bacon torte by melissa d arabian
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f
2. In a skillet over medium heat , cook the bacon until just crispy
3. Drain on paper towel lined plate and set aside
4. Crumble the bacon when cool to the touch
5. Meanwhile , in a small saucepan , heat the thyme and cream over low heat to a bare simmer
6. Turn off the heat and let steep for about 5 minutes
7. Remove the thyme sprigs
8. Remove the pie pan from the refrigerator
9. Slice the potatoes in half lengthwise and then finely slice the potatoes
10. Working in circles , arrange the potato slices in the pie crust , stopping to season each layer with salt , pepper , and about 1 / 4 of the crumbled bacon
11. Continue layering until the pie pan is nearly full
12. Top with an even layer of the cheese and gently pour cream around and over the entire pie , allowing it to seep down between the potato slices
13. Roll out the remaining disk of refrigerated dough
14. Cover the pie with the dough and crimp the edges closed
15. Brush the top and edges of the crust with egg wash
16. Make a few slits in the center of the top crust , for the steam to escape , and put the pie pan on a baking sheet
17. Bake the torte until the crust is browned and crispy and the potatoes are cooked through , about 50 to 60 minutes
18. If the crust edges get too brown , cover them with some strips of aluminum foil
19. Remove the pie from the oven and let rest at least 15 minutes before cutting into wedges and serving
20. For the pie crusts:
21. Put the butter , flour , and salt in the food processor , and pulse lightly just until the mixture resembles wet sand
22. Add the water , 1 tablespoon at a time , pulsing briefly after each spoonful of water
23. Keep adding water until the dough just begins to gather into larger clumps
24. Transfer equal amounts of the dough into 2 resealable plastic bags and pat each into a disk
25. Let rest in the refrigerator for at least 30 minutes
26. Remove 1 of the disks from the bag to a flour coated surface
27. Using a rolling pin , roll the dough out to a 10-inch round
28. Gently fit the rolled dough into a 9-inch pie pan , and refrigerate while you prepare the torte ingredients
29. Yield: 2 pie crusts

title: sweet potato ravioli
steps:
1. Mix sweet potatoes , garlic and ginger
2. Season to taste with salt and pepper
3. Spoon about 1 tablespoon potato mixture onto wonton wrapper
4. Brush edges of wrapper with water
5. Top with a second wonton wrapper and press edges together to seal
6. Repeat with remaining wonton wrappers and potato mixture
7. Heat 3 quarts of water to boiling
8. Add 4-6 ravioli
9. Reduce heat and simmer , uncovered , until ravioli float to surface and are cooked al dente
10. Remove with a slotted spoon and repeat the cooking procedure with the remaining ravioli
11. Serve topped with your favorite sauce

title: dilly red potato salad
steps:
1. Make dressing:
2. Mix all of the ingredients in a bowl
3. Place potatoes , green onions and hard boiled egg in a serving platter
4. Add dressing and mix gently to combine
5. Garnish with dill sprigs
6. Serve immediately , or chill until served

title: killer potato soup
steps:
1. Place bacon in a large soup pot or dutch oven and cook until crisp
2. Drain off all but 1 / 4 cup of grease
3. Add celery , onion and garlic to bacon grease and cook until just softened
4. Be careful not to burn garlic
5. Add potatoes and toss in grease to coat
6. Add chicken broth
7. Bring to a boil , then simmer until potatoes are tender , stirring occasionally
8. Place butter in a small saucepan over medium heat
9. When melted , whisk in flour
10. Brown mixture , stirring constantly , for approximately 2 minutes
11. Add heavy cream slowly , while whisking constantly
12. Bring to a boil , then reduce heat and continue whisking until mixture thickens
13. Stir cream mixture into the potato mixture
14. Gently stir in cheddar cheese and reserved bacon
15. Add salt and pepper to taste
16. Garnish with green onion and addtional cheese , if desired

title: taralee s apricot chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Put chicken chunks in a 9x13 baking dish
3. In a medium bowl mix rest of the ingredients well
4. Pour over chicken
5. Bake uncovered for 60-75 minutes or until chicken starts to brown
6. Serve over hot rice
7. For a variation you could substitute the apricots and apricot jam for pineapple tidbits and orange marmalade

title: sauted scallops with lime
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a large nonstick skillet until almost smoking
2. Add the scallops and cook over moderately high heat until browned on the bottom , about 2 minutes
3. Turn the scallops and cook until just opaque throughout , about 2 minutes longer
4. Add the cilantro , garlic and lime juice , season with salt and pepper and toss to combine
5. Serve with bread

title: orecchiette with hot sausage and roasted red   yellow pepper
steps:
1. Heat broiler
2. Place peppers , skin side up , on a foil-lined baking sheet
3. Broil 4 inches from heat until charred , 18 to 20 minutes
4. Transfer to a large bowl
5. Cover with plastic wrap or brown paper bags
6. Steam 2 to 3 minutes
7. Using a paper towel , rub off pepper skins , reserving any juices in bowl
8. Thinly slice peppers crosswise into 1 / 4-inch strips
9. Return to bowl
10. Set aside
11. In a large pot of boiling salted water , cook pasta until al dente , according to package instructions
12. Drain , reserving 1 / 2 cup pasta water
13. Meanwhile , heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat
14. Add garlic until it turns golden
15. Cook sausage , breaking it up with a spoon , until browned , 7 to 10 minutes
16. Add roasted peppers
17. Cook until heated through
18. Transfer sausage mixture to bowl
19. Add pasta , butter , reserved pasta water , and parmesan
20. Season with salt and pepper
21. Toss to combine
22. Serve with a robust wine , a loaf of italian bread & a salad of arugula

title: hummus  jalapeno flavored
steps:
1. Place garlic , and jalapeno in a food processor and blend until very smooth
2. Pour the chic peas , and salt in and blend again until smooth
3. Add the oil and lemon juice and blend until creamy smooth

title: simple spanish green salad
steps:
1. Whisk the dressing ingredients together until well mixed
2. Just before serving , toss with salad

title: dates and cream  a dessert from oman
steps:
1. Wash and remove seed from100 grams dates
2. Beat 200 ml cream until its thick , beat in any sugar you will be using if desired , being sure to beat until sugar is dissolved
3. Slice 5 almonds and 5 pistachios finely
4. In a deep platter place cream and dates and garnish with almonds and pistachios
5. Chill and serve

title: italian wine biscuits
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Mix wet ingredients into dry
3. Knead until smooth
4. Cut off piece of dough about the size of a pencil and roll between palms
5. Knot the dough like making a pretzel
6. Brush top of biscuits with milk or egg yolk
7. Bake for about 10-12 minutes

title: steak marinade  quick and easy
steps:
1. Mix it all together and marinade steak for 30 minutes to overnight
2. Garlic will be stronger the longer you marinade
3. Don't be afraid of the garlic it makes the steak taste wonderful !
4. Either grill the steaks or pan fry them in butter
5. Either way they're great !
6. I do both
7. I grill them til they're almost done then finish the cooking by pan frying
8. This turns an average grocery store steak into a delicious good restaurant tasting steak

title: broccoli brownies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Mix ingredients together
3. Put in 8x8 pan
4. Cook for 35-40 minutes
5. Cut and eat !

title: hot buttered garlic noodles
steps:
1. Heat olive oil in medium skillet over medium heat
2. Add garlic , cook 2-3 minutes
3. Add 1 / 2 stick of butter , melt completely
4. Add noodles and toss with salt and pepper to taste
5. (you may want to add more butter according to your preferences !

title: richest chocolate cake ever
steps:
1. Bake german chocolate cake mix according to package directions
2. While cake is still warm poke holes in top of cake with the end of a wooden spoon , pour sweetened condensed milk over top
3. Let cake cool
4. Pour hot fudge topping over top of cake and let set
5. Spread on whipped topping
6. Dig in !

title: black bean   tomato quinoa
steps:
1. Whisk together lime zest and juice , butter , oil , sugar , 1 / 2 teaspoon salt , and 1 / 4 teaspoon pepper in a large bowl
2. Wash quinoa in 3 changes of cold water in a bowl , draining in a sieve each time
3. Cook quinoa in a medium pot of boiling salted water , uncovered , until almost tender , about 10 minutes
4. Drain in sieve , then set sieve in same pot with 1 inch of simmering water
5. Cover quinoa with a folded kitchen towel , then cover sieve with a lid and steam over medium heat until tender , fluffy , and dry , about 10 minutes
6. Remove pot from heat and remove lid
7. Let stand , still covered with towel , 5 minutes
8. Add quinoa to dressing and toss until dressing is absorbed , then stir in remaining ingredients and salt and pepper to taste

title: piparkakut   finnish ginger cookies
steps:
1. Combine butter , sugar , corn syrup and spices in a saucepan
2. Over low-medium heat , stir ingredients constantly until ingredients look like they are about to boil
3. Remove from heat and transfer to a mixing bowl
4. Allow sugar mixture to cool to room temperature
5. Stirring occasionally might help speed up this process
6. Stir eggs into cooled sugar mixture
7. Sift flour and baking soda together and add to sugar mixture
8. Mix well
9. Roll dough into a ball
10. Cover and chill in the refrigerator for 8-12 hours or overnight
11. Split dough into 2 parts
12. Roll dough about 1 / 4-inch thick on a clean , floured surface
13. Cut into desired shapes
14. Bake in preheated oven at 350f for about 10-15 minutes , or until firm to the touch
15. Cookies can be left plain , or decorated with pipped icing

title: fried bannock
steps:
1. Mix half the flour with the remaining dry ingredients
2. Add water until the mixture becomes thick , "like a paper mache paste"
3. Add more flour until the dough feels like a soft earlobe
4. Heat the oil or lard over a medium-high heat until very hot , but not smoking
5. Break off small pieces of the dough and flatten each to the size of your palm , about 1 / 2-inch thick
6. Place the pieces in the hot oil , turn after about 3 minutes , or when golden brown
7. Place the bannock on a paper towel to soak up the excess grease
8. Serve plain or with jam

title: santorini roasted leg of lamb
steps:
1. Trim excess fat and silver skin from lamb leg
2. Make crisscross cut in both sides of leg , about 1 / 2 inch deep
3. Mix all other ingredients , except lemons , together and allow wet ingredients to partially hydrate dried herbs for 15 minutes
4. Place lamb in roasting pan and rub marinade all over lamb on both sides , making sure to get lots into the cuts
5. Squeeze lemons gently over lamb
6. Cut up potatoes and onions if desired and place around roast , along with lemons
7. Cover and roast at 300 degrees until internal temperature reaches 170
8. Degrees , approximately 30 minutes per pound
9. Remove cover and roast at 425 degrees until skin is browned

title: lebanese laban  yogurt
steps:
1. Place a couple of tablespoons of the milk in a small container and stir in the yogurt to make it more liquid
2. Bring milk to a boil
3. Place aside until lukewarm
4. Stir in yogurt
5. Cover pot with lid
6. Wrap pot with a wool cover
7. Place in a warm place for 6 hours
8. Be careful not to move the pot during this time
9. Cool in refrigerator for at least 3 hours

title: savory green beans with rice
steps:
1. Heat green beans with butter , seasonings and onion until onion is wilted , drain
2. Combine with rice
3. In a small sauce pan blend sour cream , dill weed , salt , lemon juice and worcestershire sauce
4. Heat
5. Serve sauce over beans and rice
6. Sprinkle with crumbled bacon

title: skinless sausage  skinless longanisa
steps:
1. Mix everything by hand in a large bowl
2. Form into thin logs and refrigerate
3. Fry in a little hot oil
4. Serve with garlic fried rice or hot pandesal buns

title: bourbon pecan pound cake
steps:
1. Combine butter and sugar in bowl of electric mixer and blend until light and fluffy
2. Add eggs one at a time , beating constantly
3. Sift together flour , baking powder , salt , and nutmeg
4. Blend sour cream and bourbon
5. Alternately add flour and sour cream mixture to batter
6. Add pecans
7. Grease bottom and sides of tube or bunt pan
8. Pour in batter and bake at 325 degrees for about one hour and 30 minutes
9. Test cake frequently after first hour and 15 minutes for doneness
10. Let cake cool in pan for 15 minutes before turning out on wire rack
11. To prepare glaze , combine sugar and bourbon
12. Stir while gradually adding water
13. Add only enough water to make a pourable glaze without allowing mixture to become too thin
14. Pour glaze over top of warm cake and let dribble down sides

title: banana tarte tatin
steps:
1. Preheat oven to hot 220 c degrees or 200 c degrees fan forced
2. Combine butter , sugar , cream and cinnamon in a small saucepan , stir over low heat until sugar dissolves
3. Bring to the boil , reduce heat and simmer , uncovered for 2 minutes
4. Pour caramel sauce into the base of a 23cm pie dish , arrange bananas over the pie dish
5. Trim the corners from the pastry sheet to form a 24cm circle
6. Place the pastry sheet over bananas , ease pastry into side of dish
7. Brush pastry with egg , cook in a hot oven for 15 minutes or until pastry is browned
8. Invert tart , serve with ice-cream or cream

title: albanian spinach pie  byrek me spinaq or pite
steps:
1. Brush the pan with some of the oil , and start laying the filo leaves inside
2. First , lay two leaves , sprinkle or brush with oil , then lay two other leaves , and repeat the procedure until half of the leaves are laid
3. Make sure that they cover the pan by hanging them about one inch over the edges of the pan
4. Change directions , so that the entire pan is evenly covered
5. Sprinkle spinach with salt , then mix well by hand
6. Let sit for a minute
7. Add the feta cheese , onions , eggs and stir
8. Spread spinach mixture over the filo leaves in the pan
9. Cover the spinach with the rest of the pastry leaves repeating the first-half procedure
10. Roll the hanging edges of the bottom leaves over the pie , sprinkle top with oil
11. Bake at 350 degrees for about 45 minutes , or until golden brown
12. Serve hot

title: zupas roasted red pepper soup
steps:
1. Start by melting 2 tablespoons of butter in a medium sized soup pot
2. When melted add diced onion , celery , thyme , basil , cayenne pepper , salt and garlic
3. Sautee vegetables for about 10 minutes until the vegetables are tender , stirring frequently
4. Add the water , vegetable base , heavy cream , and roasted red peppers into the soup pot and bring to a simmer
5. Place the burr mixer in the soup and blend until the soup has a smooth texture
6. Add the bay leaf and simmer for an additional 20 minutes
7. Pick out the bay leaf to finish

title: walnut buttermilk bread
steps:
1. Coarsely chop 1 / 2 cup walnuts
2. Reserve remaining walnut halves
3. Preheat oven to 350f
4. Lightly coat a 5-by-9-inch loaf pan with non-stick cooking spray
5. In a large bowl , with mixer on medium-high speed , beat to blend egg , buttermilk , and butter
6. Add chopped walnuts , flour , brown sugar , baking soda and powder , salt and vanilla
7. Stir just until evenly moistened
8. Pour into loaf pan and arrange remaining walnut halves evenly on top of batter
9. Bake 45 to 50 minutes , until bread begins to pull away from side of pan
10. Let bread cool in pan on wire rack for 10 minutes
11. Run a knife between bread and pan sides , then turn out onto wire rack
12. Let cool 10 minutes
13. Slice and serve

title: blarney blondies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. In a mixing bowl , cream butter and sugars together
3. Add the eggs , whiskey , and vanilla then mix well
4. Combine flour , baking powder and salt in a bowl then sift
5. Add the sifted flour mixture to the creamed mixture little by little and blend well
6. Stir in vanilla chips and 1 / 2 cup nuts
7. Spoon into a greased 13x9 pan , spread and press to cover bottom of pan
8. Mix up the streusel ingredients in a little bowl and let them sit for a bit to soak up the whiskey
9. Spread the streusel over the blondie batter in the pan
10. Bake at 350f for 30 minutes or until golden brown
11. Cool on wire rack

title: zoo tosopy  paraguayan ground beef stew
steps:
1. Place beef in a large pot or dutch oven
2. Add water and stir until blended
3. Bring to a boil , cover , and simmer for about 10 minutes
4. Meanwhile , heat oil in a skillet
5. Saute onions , tomatoes , and bananas for about 5 minutes
6. Add to beef mixture
7. Add salt , pepper and rice
8. Cover and simmer 30 minutes

title: baked veggie burgers
steps:
1. Spray pan with cooking spray
2. Add chopped veggies and cook on medium heat for about 5 minutes , or until tender
3. Crush beans and mix in egg and bread crumbs
4. Spoon into 4 equal patties on a cookie sheet coated with non stick spray
5. Bake at 375 - 400 degrees for 20 minutes
6. Flip burgers and cook for another 10 - 15 minutes

title: chicken and rice stew gone wild
steps:
1. Place mushrooms , carrots , leeks and rices in bottom of crock pot
2. Place chicken on veggies and rices
3. Top with seasonings and pour broth over all
4. Cover and cook on low 7-8 hours or on high 3 1 / 2-4 hours
5. Stir in cream of mushroom soup at end of cooking

title: my family s favorite sloppy joes  pizza joes
steps:
1. In a large skillet , brown ground beef , celery and onion
2. Drain the fat , who needs it ?
3. Stir in remaining ingredients , simmer covered , 15-20 minutes , stirring occasionally
4. If joes appear too'loose' , leave cover off and let moisture evaporate
5. Cook until it's the consistency you like for serving on toasted buns , with french fries and cole slaw

title: fudgy buttermilk brownies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Lightly spray a 9" square baking pan with vegetable oil spray
3. In a medium bowl , stir together the flour , brown sugar , cocoa powder , baking soda , and salt
4. In a small bowl , lightly whisk the egg whites
5. Whisk in the remaining brownie ingredients
6. Whisk into the flour mixture until well-blended
7. Pour the batter into the baking pan
8. Bake for 30 minutes
9. Let cool in the pan on a cooling rack
10. In a small bowl , stir together the sugar and cocoa powder
11. Stir in the vanilla extract , then gradually stir in the milk until the frosting is spreading consistency
12. Spread over the cool brownies
13. Cut into 16 squares

title: down home baked beans
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Place bacon in a large , deep skillet
3. Cook over medium high heat until evenly brown
4. Drain , crumble and set aside
5. In a large bowl combine beans , chili sauce , onion , brown sugar and bacon
6. Pour into a 9x13 inch casserole dish
7. Bake in preheated oven for 45 minutes to 1 hour

title: green beans with baby corn and pine nuts
steps:
1. Remove
2. Heat butter in a large skillet over medium heat
3. Add thyme and rosemary , allow herbs to warm in the butter
4. Add sherry , chicken broth , maggi seasoning , salt , and pepper , and bring to a boil
5. Lower heat , and mix cornstarch with water and stir into sauce , whisking to incorporate , and stirring constantly until thickened
6. Fold in cooked green beans and baby corn , mixing well to get sauce all over vegetables
7. Heat gently for 2-3 minutes , stirring occasionally , or until heated through
8. Serve garnished with toasted pine nuts

title: broccoli chicken rice casserole   low fat
steps:
1. Bring the one cup of water to a boil and add oxo and chicken , cook until chicken is done
2. Steam broccoli and carrots until tender
3. Line bottom of a casserole dish with rice and top with carrots , broccoli and chicken
4. In a bowl , mix together soup , parmesan cheese , milk and seasonings , and pour over the casserole
5. Mix melted butter and breadcrumbs together and sprinkle over top , bake at 350 for 30 minutes

title: chip s salad
steps:
1. Mix all salad ingredients above , except eggs and cheese , in bowl
2. Let sit , covered , for 30 min - 1 hour
3. Just before serving , add eggs , cheese
4. Toss with dressing

title: zesty drumsticks
steps:
1. For the sauce: combine all of the ingredients except the chicken drumsticks in a small saucepan
2. Cook over low heat about 5 minutes or until bubbly , stirring occasionally to melt the jelly
3. Remove skin from chicken , if desired
4. Rinse chicken
5. Pat dry
6. Grill chicken on the rack of an uncovered grill directly over medium coals for 35 to 45 minutes or until chicken is tender and no longer pink , turning once halfway through grilling time and brushing with sauce frequently during the last 10 minutes of grilling

title: red lentil  chickpea  garbanzo    chili soup
steps:
1. Heat a large saucepan and dry fry the cumin seeds and chili flakes for 1 min or until they start to jump around the pan and release their aromas
2. Add the oil and onion , and cook for 5 minutes
3. Stir in the lentils , stock and tomatoes , then bring to the boil
4. Simmer for 15 mins until the lentils have softened
5. Whizz the soup with a stick blender or in a food processor until it is a rough puree , pour back into the pan and add the chickpeas
6. Heat gently , season well and stir in the cilantro
7. Finish with a spoonful of the greek yogurt

title: dijon beets
steps:
1. Wash beets
2. Cut off tops
3. Put beets in a pot with water to cover them
4. Bring beets to a boil , covered
5. Cook until tender when pierced with a fork
6. Drain and cool
7. Slice beets into 1 / 4 inch slices
8. Combine remaining ingredients
9. Pour over beets
10. Stir to combine
11. Serve warm or let marinate in the fridge for a couple hours

title: rakott krumpli  hungarian layered potatoes
steps:
1. Boil peeled potatoes until fork inserted tells you it's cooked
2. Boil eggs until hardboiled
3. Slice potatoes to form medallions
4. Slice eggs
5. In casserole dish , layer butter , sour cream , potatoes and eggs until used up
6. Sour cream should be top layer
7. Cover , put in 350 degree oven for about 1 hour or until brown
8. Add salt to taste and enjoy
9. Best if eaten fresh

title: mexican chicken and rice casserole
steps:
1. Set oven to 375 degrees
2. In a large pot or dutch oven over medium-high heat , saute onion , bell pepper and garlic until softened
3. Add in beans , tomatoes , broth , chilies , corn , rice , chili powder , salt and pepper
4. Stir to combine
5. Transfer the mixture to a greased 13 x 9-inch baking dish
6. In a 1-gallon plastic bag , combine flour , garlic salt and paprika
7. Shake the bag to mix spices
8. Add in the chicken pieces and shake to coat
9. Place the chicken in a single layer on top of rice
10. Press lightly into rice
11. Cover tightly with foil
12. Bake for 1 hour , or until the chicken if fork-tender , and the rice is tender and the liquid is absorbed
13. Remove foil , bake an additional 15 minutes to brown chicken

title: jell o delight
steps:
1. In bowl add boiling water to jello
2. Stir until jello is completely dissolved
3. Add 4 cups frozen whipped topping
4. With whisk mix until topping is dissolved
5. Add mandarin oranges
6. Refrigerate for 2 hours or until set
7. Layer sliced strawberries on top
8. Spread 2 cups thawed whipped topping on top of strawberries
9. Garnish with extra strawberry slices and mandarin oranges , if desired
10. Do not add oranges before adding and dissolving frozen topping ! the oranges will be mashed up and you won't even know they are there

title: frosted ginger rounds  originally called sally ann cookies
steps:
1. In large bowl , combine shortening and molasses , blend well
2. Add all remaining cookie ingredients
3. Mix well
4. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate at least 2 hours for easier handling
5. Heat oven to 350
6. On well-floured surface , roll dough to 3 / 4" thickness
7. Cut with floured 2 1 / 2" round cookie cutter
8. Place 1" apart on ungreased cookie sheet
9. Bake at 350 for 6-9 minutes or until set
10. Cool 1 minute on sheet and remove to wire rack to cool completely
11. At least 10 minutes
12. In a 2 quart pan , combine water and gelatin
13. Let stand at least 5 minutes
14. Stir in sugar , bring to a full rolling boil
15. Reduce heat to medium
16. Simmer 10 minutes , without stirring
17. Temperature should read 220 on candy thermometer
18. Remove from heat
19. Add powdered sugar , beat with electric mixer at low speed until foamy
20. Add baking powder and vanilla
21. Beat on low speed for 5 minutes or until glossy and of spreading consistency
22. Spread frosting on underside of each cookie to within 1 / 2" of edge
23. If desired , decorate each cookie
24. Let stand until frosting is set before storing
25. These sure bring back memories
26. Important
27. Gelatin must be soaked 5 minutes in a cool liquid before it is heated
28. While it soaks , the gelatin softens and swells , making it wasy to dissolve completely when it's heated

title: spicy southwest baked beans
steps:
1. Saute onion , bell pepper , chili and garlic in oil in large skillet until tender , about 8 minutes
2. Combine onion mixture and remaining ingredients in 1 1 / 2 quart casserole
3. Bake at 350 degrees , covered , 30 minutes
4. Uncover and bake 15-20 minutes or until liquid is nearly absorbed
5. Discard bay leaf

title: spaghetti piccata
steps:
1. Cook spaghetti according to package directions
2. Meanwhile , heat olive oil in skillet over med
3. Heat
4. Saute` mushrooms and garlic lightly for 2 minutes
5. Add white wine and lemon juice
6. Simmer over low heat until liquid has cooked down by one-half
7. Stir capers into sauce and heat thoroughly
8. Add cooked spaghetti to skillet and season with salt and pepper
9. Sprinkle with parsley
10. Garnish with lemon wedge and serve

title: jerk pasta
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to package directions
2. In saucepan , combine cheese , flour and seasoning , making sure to remove any clumps
3. Add milk , a little at a time , and stir to avoid the dry ingredients from clumping
4. Add the butter and cook on medium heat until melted and well-incorporated
5. Serve over pasta
6. I usually use a pound of pasta but if you like a lot of sauce , you might want to go with a 12-oz package of pasta
7. To make an entree , this would taste great with chicken

title: zesty spinach soup
steps:
1. Heat oil over medium heat in a large soup pot or dutch oven
2. Add onion and saute over med-low heat until translucent
3. Add carrots , celery , garlic and salt
4. Saute until vegetables are golden about 5 minutes
5. Add stock
6. Unwrap cubes and add to liquid
7. Add tomatoes , quinoa , beans and spices
8. Bring to a boil and reduce heat to simmer for 15-20 minutes or until quinoa is tender
9. Add spinach and cover
10. Cook briefly until leaves are wilted
11. Season with salt and pepper
12. Serve with crusty bread

title: bacon county  georgia peachy pizza  rsc
steps:
1. Dough:
2. A
3. Combine instant yeast , bread flour , kosher salt in a food processor
4. Pulse the ingredients 3 times for 5 seconds for each pulse then stop
5. B
6. Add 1 cup of warm water and 2 tablespoons oil through the feeding tube and turn on processor for 30 seconds
7. Celsius then add additional water , a little at a time until the mixture becomes a ball
8. This ball will be slightly sticky to the touch
9. D
10. Turn dough onto floured surface and kneed by hand until dough forms into a smooth , round ball
11. This step shouldn't take very long
12. E
13. Grease a bowl with 1 / 2 teaspoon of remaining olive oil and place dough in the bowl
14. Cover bowl with dough inside using a damp cloth and let rise in a warm area that is free of drafts until dough doubles , approximately 1 1 / 2 to 2 hours
15. F
16. Once risen , roll dough into two 10 inch rounds
17. Sauce:
18. 1) in a large pot , heat extra virgin olive oil over medium heat , then add red crushed peppers if you elect to use them maybe a pinch , then add 2-3 cloves of minced garlic , stirring continuously so that garlic does not burn
19. Cook until aeromatic which takes about a minute
20. 2) add chopped medium onion and saute until onion is translucent
21. 3) add crushed tomatoes and lemon zest and simmer until sauce thickens , which takes about 20 minutes
22. 4) carefully remove from heat and allow to cool
23. Toppings:
24. Do recommend what's best for you
25. Fry bacon on both sides until fully cooked and crisp
26. Once cooked set aside , on towel to drain and crumble
27. Reserve in a separate cup
28. Slice 12 ounces of fresh mozerella into thin slices
29. Set aside on plate
30. In a separate bowl mix cream cheese with goat cheese
31. Set aside
32. Thouroughly wash , peel , pit the ripe peaches
33. Cut into 1 / 4 inch slices and set aside
34. Assembly:
35. Preheat oven to 450 degrees f
36. Cut two long sheets of reynolds wrap aluminum foil
37. You may fold in half if you wish
38. Very lightly spray 2 generous sheets of reynolds wrap aluminum foil , shiny side with pam
39. Place one pizza dough round in the center of each sheet
40. There should be enough excess foil to allow you to lift the pizza carefully
41. Brush each pizza dough round with olive oil , be sure to brush the edges
42. Spread thin layer of sauce on the dough of each pizza allowing for a one inch border all the way around the dough
43. Then add mozzarella , spinkle peaches evenly , crumbled bacon , use a spoon to finish the topping with the cream cheese / goat cheese mixture
44. Place both pizzas in the oven
45. Cook for 12 - 16 minutes
46. Carefully rotate pizza when time is half way through to allow for even cooking
47. Watch for when crust and cheese is lightly golden brown in color
48. Carefully remove from oven , cut into slices
49. <serve and enjoy ! >

title: three berry crepes with creme anglaise and strawberry sauce
steps:
1. Place all crepe ingredients together and mix well
2. Allow to stand for 30 minutes
3. Make crepes in a heavy crepe pan
4. Spray crepe pan with cooking oil and pour in enough mixture to form a thin and even layer over pan
5. When crepes begin to bubble turn and cook other side
6. Makes 10-12 crepes
7. While the crepe mixture is'standing'combine the berries and sugar for the filling in a bowl and allow to stand for 20 minutes
8. Filling-------------
9. Blend together all ingredients and put through a fine sieve to remove pips
10. Creme anglaise-----------
11. Bring the milk to the boil with vanilla extract
12. Beat egg yolks and sugar until pale yellow
13. Pour milk over the eggs and blend
14. Return to a low heat and stirring constantly , thicken the sauce
15. Do not boil
16. The mixture is'thickened' when it coats the back of a spoon
17. Cover sauce and chill in the fridge
18. To assemble dessert-------------
19. Place generous spoonfuls of berries in the centre of each crepe
20. Fold in the sides of each crepe to form a square'parcel'
21. Allow 2'parcels' per person
22. Spoon the creme anglaise on one side of a flat plate and the strawberry sauce on the other so that the 2 sauces just meet in the middle
23. Arrange the crepes gently on the sauce
24. Garnish each plate with a strawberry sliced in half
25. Voila !

title: ben s chocolate chip cookies
steps:
1. Mix each ingredient well , then bake at 400 degrees for 8-10 minutes
2. Use a small ice cream scoop to scoop out the dough , and only place 1 dozen to each cookie sheet spacing them about 2 inches apart

title: cool ranch doritos hot dish
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Spray an 8x8 pan with cooking spray
3. Cover the bottom of the pan with half of the broken doritos
4. Brown the ground beef with the onion and bell pepper , drain grease
5. Stir in taco seasoning and water , simmer for 5 minutes
6. Stir in the corn and salsa
7. Spread meat mixture evenly over chips
8. Sprinkle with cheese and top with remaining chips
9. Bake 25-30 minutes or until bubbly

title: sex  drugs and rocky road rice pudding from nyc s rice to riches
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan combine milk and rice
2. Bring just to boiling over medium heat
3. Stir in pudding mix
4. Cook , stirring constantly , until mixture comes to a full boil
5. Remove from heat
6. Cover and let stand 5 minutes
7. Stir in the marshmallows , chocolate pieces , and nuts
8. Pour into six cups or dessert dishes
9. Cool at room temperature about 1 hour before serving
10. If desired , garnish with additional marshmallows , chocolate pieces , nuts or whip cream

title: lamb casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180c
2. Lightly seal the lamb forequarter pieces with some oil in a large frying pan and then remove from the pan
3. Using same pan add onion , garlic and carrot and lightly fry until onions are clear
4. Add the tomato base , stock and water and stir
5. Add oregano , salt and paper
6. Add the lamb forequarter pieces again and mix through
7. Remove from heat and transfer into casserole dish
8. Add peas
9. Add more water and tomato base if needed
10. The lamb forequarters should be almost covered
11. Bake in oven for at least two and a half to three hours at 180c check after one and a half hours , stir through , add water / base if necessary
12. Serve with boiled potatoes

title: sfoglia s spaghetti carbonara
steps:
1. Fill a large pot with water and bring to a boil over high heat
2. Add a generous amount of salt , then pasta to boiling water
3. Fry bacon in large pan until crisp , add pepper
4. Once pasta is cooked to al dente , lightly drain pasta , add pasta to bacon in pan
5. Add egg yolks all at once , break and start tossing with the pasta and bacon very quickly
6. If eggs start looking scrambled , add more pasta water
7. Your finished dish should look like cream has been added , but without needing to have added cream
8. Add parmesan and toss well
9. Garnish with additional parmesan and pepper , and serve immediately on warmed plates

title: szechuan eggplants
steps:
1. Mix bean paste , soy sauce , dry sherry , vinegar , sugar and szechuan peppercorns in one bowl
2. Mix cornstarch , water and sesame oil in another bowl
3. Heat wok until hot , add oils and heat until the oil streams freely on the side of the wok
4. Add eggplant to the wok and toss until coated with oil
5. Cook until it's soft and golden brown
6. Add sauce and cook for 3 seconds
7. Add starch mixture and cook until the starch turns translucent
8. Serve with rice

title: dee s santa fe green chile stew
steps:
1. Sprinkle the pork with flour to lightly coat
2. In a large pot , brown the meat in oil
