3. Add chiles , chicken stock , vegetables , salt& pepper , and water if needed
4. Bring to a boil , lower heat to medium low
5. Cover and simmer until meat and vegetables are done , and the stew is slightly thickened
6. You may cook in a crockpot for 6-8 hours
7. Serve with flour tortillas

title: spanish baked shrimp
steps:
1. Heat the oven to 425f
2. Divide the shrimp , garlic , chili , sherry and olive oil between 4 small ovenproof dishes
3. Cook for 6-8 minutes until pink and sizzling
4. Sprinkle with the parsley and serve with crusty bread

title: chicken noodle tetrazzini   a little healthier
steps:
1. Cook egg noodles according to package directions
2. Drain , cover and set aside
3. Preheat oven to 425
4. Melt margarine in medium saucepan
5. Blend in flour until smooth
6. Cook for 1 minute but don't let it brown
7. Slowly whisk in milk , chicken broth , thyme and black pepper
8. Cook sauce over medium heat , stirring constantly until mixture thickens and comes to a boil
9. Stir in peas , yogurt and two tablespoons of parmesan cheese
10. Mix together noodles , mushrooms , sauce and chicken
11. Taste for seasonings
12. Add salt and more pepper if desired
13. Turn mixture into lightly greased 9"x13" baking dish
14. Sprinkle with remaining parmesan cheese and bread crumbs
15. Bake 15 minutes or until heated through and golden brown on top

title: buttermilk
steps: 1. Mix together and let stand for 5 minutes

title: spiced up tofu
steps:
1. Cut tofu into 1 / 2 inch cubes and set aside
2. Mix the peppercorns , soy sauce , sesame oil and chile black bean sauce together and set aside
3. Heat a skillet or wok on high heat until hot
4. Add the olive oil to the skillet or wok and swirl around to coat sides and bottom
5. Add the garlic and chile pepper and cook , stirring until fragrant
6. Add the sauce mixture , stir and cook for about 1-2 minutes
7. Add the tofu and cook , stirring gently , until tofu is coated and heated through
8. "pour" into a serving bowl and garnish with the green onion

title: chocolate almond cookies
steps:
1. Beat butter and 1 cup sugar in large bowl until fluffy
2. Add egg , almond and vanilla extracts
3. Beat well
4. Combine flour , cocoa , baking powder , baking soda and salt
5. Gradually add to butter mixture , beating to form smooth dough
6. Stir in small chocolate chips
7. If necessary , refrigerate dough about 1 hour or until firm enough to handle
8. Heat oven to 350f
9. Shape dough into l 1 / 8-inch balls
10. Roll in sugar
11. Place about 2 inches apart on ungreased cookie sheet
12. Place three slivered almonds on top of each ball
13. Press slightly
14. Bake 9 to 10 minutes or until set
15. Cool slightly
16. Remove from cookie sheet to wire rack
17. Cool completely

title: rachael ray s tortoni
steps:
1. Mix together softened vanilla ice cream , crushed coconut cookies , semi-sweet chocolate chips and chopped cherries
2. Refreeze for at least 1 hour
3. When ready to serve , scoop ice cream into 6 serving bowls
4. Top with heated hot fudge sauce or chocolate syrup and nut topping
5. Garnish each sundae with a whole cherry and serve

title: citrus rum collins
steps:
1. Place the lime wedges in the bottom of a highball glass
2. Add the sugar and muddle the limes with the sugar
3. Pour in the citrus rum and stir well
4. Fill glass with ice
5. Top up with club soda
6. Stir gently
7. Garnish with additional lime slices if desired

title: almond joy dark
steps:
1. Pour liquors over ice
2. Fill with pineapple
3. Add grenadine to color
4. Shake
5. Garnish with pineapple flag

title: lime ricotta
steps:
1. Mix the ricotta with the honey and lime
2. Add almonds if a richer dessert is wanted
3. Serve chilled

title: lemon compound butter
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients and blend well
2. Roll into a log , using plastic wrap
3. Use immediately or refrigerate for use in 1-2 days
4. To freeze: wrap the log in waxed paper , place in a freezer bag and freeze for up to 2 months

title: gingerbread man  drink
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in a shaker glass with ice
2. Shake
3. Pour into 3 shot glasses
4. 1 , 2 , 3 drink

title: dube s brandy apple pie
steps:
1. Make the crust:
2. In a large bowl , sift together flours , sugar , salt , baking powder , and mace
3. Cut in butter with a pastry blender until pea-sized clumps form
4. In a small bowl , whisk together brandy , vanilla , and whole egg
5. Pour into flour mixture and blend with a fork until mixture is moist and holds together
6. Turn the dough out onto a work surface
7. Divide in two
8. Sprinkle with just enough flour and sugar to coat
9. Place each half on a sheet of plastic wrap
10. Flatten and form two discs
11. Wrap , and refrigerate at least 1 hour before using
12. Make the filling:
13. In a large bowl , sift together sugars , flour , cornstarch , cinnamon , nutmeg , cloves , allspice , and mace
14. Set aside
15. Place apples in another large bowl
16. In a small bowl , mix together brandy and vanilla
17. Pour over apples
18. Add 3 / 4 of the flour mixture to the apples
19. Toss to combine
20. Preheat the oven to 400
21. Butter and flour a 12-inch pie plate
22. Set aside
23. Place two large sheets of plastic wrap on top of one another on a work surface
24. Sprinkle with enough flour and sugar to lightly coat
25. Place 1 disc of dough on plastic wrap , and lightly sprinkle with flour and sugar
26. Cover dough with 2 large pieces plastic wrap
27. Roll out dough between plastic wrap to a 14-inch circle
28. Peel off top layers of plastic wrap and flip dough over into prepared pie plate
29. Carefully peel off remaining layers of plastic wrap
30. Using scissors or a sharp paring knife , trim edges to 1 inch
31. Reserve trimmings
32. Sprinkle reserved flour mixture into pastry-lined pie plate
33. Fill with apple mixture , mounding in the center
34. Dot with butter
35. Roll out second disc of dough between plastic wrap following the same process as above
36. Lay over apples
37. Cut vents into top crust
38. Trim edges to 1 inch and seal crimping edges with thumb and forefinger
39. Divide beaten egg yolk in half
40. Add enough red food coloring to half the yolk to create desired shade of red
41. Set remaining yolk aside
42. Gather reserved pastry trimmings together and roll 1 / 8-inch thick
43. Brush with colored yolk
44. Cut out into leaf shapes
45. Brush top of pie with reserved egg yolk and attach decorative shapes
46. Sprinkle with sugar
47. Place pie on a baking sheet
48. This will catch any juices that may overflow during baking
49. Loosely cover pie with parchment-lined aluminum foil
50. Transfer pie to oven and bake for about 1 hour
51. Reduce temperature to 375 and continue baking for another hour
52. During the last 10 minutes of baking , remove foil so that the pie has a nice golden color
53. Serve pie warm

title: banana  cake
steps:
1. Cream oleo & sugar , add eggs and beat well
2. Sift flour with salt & baking powder and add alternately with the milk and vanilla to the creamed mixture of sugar and egg & oleo
3. Add nuts
4. Mash the bananas and add the soda
5. Add to above mixture
6. Bake in a 9 x 13 baking pan which has been greased
7. 325 to 350 degrees for 35 to 40 minutes or until lightly brown

title: best bread machine pizza dough
steps:
1. Always start with liquids on the bottom and pile up dry ingredients as listed
2. Set bread machine for "dough" setting and remove when machine finishes
3. Depending on your dough cycle allow bread to rise if it hasn't once
4. Punch down , divide in half and let rise
5. Throw or roll into 14" circle , place on pan and let rise again for about 20 minutes
6. Top with your favorite toppings and enjoy !
7. We bake in a hot 450 degree oven for between 12-20 minutes depending on the pizza and where it is in the oven

title: french fries
steps:
1. Wash your potatoes , making sure you scrub all the dirt off
2. Cut any bad spots off the potato
3. Slice the potato into 1 / 4-1 / 3 inch slices , holding the potato upright while doing so
4. Turn the potato a quarter turn , and slice it again into 1 / 4-1 / 3 inch slices
5. This will give you perfectly cut fries
6. Repeat with each potato
7. Place the sliced potatoes into a bowl
8. Mix 2 tbsp sugar with 2 cups of water , stirring until the sugar is dissolved
9. Pour over the potatoes
10. Add enough water to cover the potatoes , swirling it around to make sure the sugar is equally distributed
11. Let the potatoes sit in the water at least 2 hours
12. Pour the oil into your dutch oven or pot to about half full
13. Heat the oil on high
14. After about 2 1 / 2 minutes , test the oil by placing a dried fry into the oil -- if it fries vigorously , your oil is ready
15. Meanwhile , pour the water off the fries and blot with a paper towel
16. This will cause less oil splatter
17. Cook the potatoes in hot oil for 2-3 minutes
18. Remove and drain on paper towels
19. Repeat until all have been cooked for 2-3 minutes
20. Return the first batch of fries to the oil until they are golden brown
21. Repeat with the other fries
22. Sprinkle with onion powder and salt to taste
23. Keep them warm in the oven until ready to serve

title: goat cheese stuffed pork chops
steps:
1. Heat 2 oil and butter over medium-high heat in a skillet
2. Insert paring knife into chop at end away from bone & open a 2 inch hole almost to bone
3. Work knife back & forth until the pocket is almost the full size of chop
4. Set aside
5. Saute celery in melted oil / butter mixture for 3-4 minute
6. Add chopped onion and saute for 5-6 minutes more
7. Remove onions & celery with slotted spoon , reserving as much oil / butter combination as possible
8. Remove skillet from heat
9. Mix 1 / 2 of the goat cheese and the stripped leaves from 2 sprigs of the thyme with the celery & onion in a bowl & allow cheese to slightly melt from the heat of the vegetables
10. When mixture is cool enough to work with divide stuffing evenly and stuff chops
11. Do not be afraid of over stuffing
12. Season both sides with salt & pepper
13. Return skillet to a medium-high heat and bring to temperature
14. Sear stuffed chops , turning once until browned on each side
15. About 2-3 minutes per side
16. Once chops are browned add the 1 / 2 cup of wine and the remaining sprig of thyme
17. Immediately reduce heat to a simmer and cover
18. Cook at simmer 30 minutes or until internal temp is 160
19. Once chops are done , remove & keep warm
20. Discard thyme sprig
21. Increase heat to high & add remaining goat cheese
22. Stir pan sauce constantly until reduced by half
23. Plate with kluski or egg noodles & green beans
24. Pour a generous amount of sauce over chops and reserve the rest for you and your partner

title: golden puffs with honey butter dip
steps:
1. Beat eggs on high until well mixed , 3 minutes , give or take
2. Add yogurt and butter , mixing on low
3. Once yogurt and butter are well mixed , keep the mixer on low , and slowly add the dry goods--flour , baking powder , baking soda , nutmeg and salt
4. Heat 2-3 inches of oil to 360 degrees f / 186 degrees c in a heavy frying pan , 3-quart pot , or electric deep fryer
5. Drop dough by the teaspoonful into the oil , and fry till light golden brown , about 2 minutes
6. Drain well
7. Serve warm with honey-butter dip
8. Honey-butter dip: beat 1 / 4 cup softened butter and 1 / 4 cup honey together on medium-low speed until light and fluffy

title: double brownies
steps:
1. Chocolate layer: beat the 2 eggs together until foamy
2. Add sugar , flour , walnuts and salt
3. Melt cocoa and butter in a saucepan , at low heat
4. Add to the egg mixture and stir well
5. Pour in a greased baking dish
6. Set aside
7. Caramel layer: in a clean bowl , beat butter and brown sugar until creamy
8. Add 2 eggs and vanilla
9. Beat to combine everything
10. Add other ingredients of the caramel layer
11. Stir
12. Put this mixture on the chocolate layer with a spoon
13. Spread it uniformly , do the best as you can
14. Cook in the oven at 350 f for 30 minutes until the cookie begins to detach from the sides of the pan
15. Let cool
16. Icing: bring the butter , brown sugar and milk to boil in a saucepan
17. Let simmer 2 minutes then let cool
18. Add the icing sugar , adding icing sugar or milk if needed
19. Spread on the cold cookie
20. Garnish: melt chocolate and butter in microwave
21. Garnish the icing with melted chocolate
22. Cut in 54 squares

title: gluten free waffles
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together with a whisk , and pour into waffle iron , in batches
2. Add a bit more milk if too thick or a bit of rice flour if too runny
3. Can be made without eggs , if necessary
4. Just add a little more liquid to make up for them

title: grenoble tart  walnut tart
steps:
1. Make tart shell: in a medium bowl , with wooden spoon or electric mixer , beat 1 / 3 cup butter with granulated sugar until light and fluffy
2. Add egg yolk
3. Beat well
4. Gradually beat in flour just until blended
5. Preheat oven to 375f
6. With hands , form dough into a ball
7. Press evenly into bottom and side of a 9-inch fluted tart pan with removable bottom
8. Bake in center of oven 12 minutes , until lightly browned
9. Cool on wire rack
10. Make filling
11. Spread nuts on cookie sheet in single layer
12. Bake 375f oven for 5 minutes
13. Set aside to cool
14. Sprinkle walnuts in bottom of tart shell
15. In heavy 2-quart saucepan , stir sugar with butter , corn syrup and 2 tablespoons heavy cream
16. Stirring constantly , bring to boiling over medium heat
17. Boil 1 minute
18. Pour over walnuts
19. Bake in center of 375f oven 10 minutes , or just until mixture is bubbly
20. Place on wire rack to cool
21. Meanwhile , beat remaining cream just until stiff
22. Refrigerate until serving
23. Serve tart at room temperature with bowl of whipped cream
24. Serves 12
25. Tartlets: divide pastry into 16 pieces
26. With fingers , press evenly into 16 tart pans
27. Bake
28. On cookie sheet , at 375f 8 to 10 minutes
29. Cool
30. Divide 1 cup finely chopped nuts into shells placed on cookie sheets
31. Pour filling into shells , dividing evenly
32. Bake 8 minutes , or just until filling is bubbly
33. Remove tarts from cookie sheets
34. Cool on wire rack
35. To serve: with
36. Lift out gently to serving plate
37. Serve with chilled whipped cream
38. Makes 16 servings
39. Mccalls cooking school

title: molasses brown bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees f
2. Grease a 9 x 5 x 3-inch pan
3. Combine flour , wheat germ , brown sugar , salt and raisins in a mixing bowl
4. Mix well
5. In a second mixing bowl , mix baking soda , buttermilk and molasses , using a wooden spoon
6. This misture will start to bubble
7. Immediately mix it into the dry ingredients
8. Spoon the batter into the greased pan
9. Bake at once
10. The bread is done when a toothpick comes out clean , about 1 hour
11. Turn out of the pan and cool on a wire rack

title: kielbasa and pasta
steps:
1. Spray pan with cooking spray and saute sausage
2. Drain as much grease as possible
3. Put 1 large diced onion and one diced red bell pepper in pan with sausage and cooked until the tender
4. Sprinkle with garlic powder
5. Add can diced tomatoes and tomato sauce
6. Cook pasta separately and add in at end of cooking time

title: cranberry raspberry green tea spritzer
steps:
1. Pour boiling water over tea bags , then cover & brew for 5 minutes
2. Remove & squeeze the tea bags over the brewed tea , then pour into a large pitcher , stir in the sugar , & set aside to cool
3. When cooled , add fruit juice to the tea , & stir to combine
4. Chill at least 2 hours before serving
5. When ready to serve , add club soda & pour into ice-filled glasses

title: crock pot creamy ranch potatoes
steps:
1. Put potatoes in 3 1 / 2 quart crock pot
2. In a small bowl combine cream cheese and salad dressing mix
3. Stir in soup
4. Add potatoes
5. Cover - cook on low heat for 7-9 hrs or on high heat 3 1 / 2-4 1 / 2 hours
6. Stir to blend before serving

title: salisbury steak gravy
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine beef , 1 / 4 can mushroom soup , bread crumbs , egg , onions , and steak seasoning
2. Mix thoroughly and shape into 4 oval patties
3. Heat oil and 1 tablespoon butter in large skillet over medium-high heat
4. Brown patties on both sides and transfer to a plate
5. Add remaining butter and saute mushrooms for 7 to 8 minutes
6. Whisk beef stock and gravy mix until smooth and add to mushrooms
7. Stir in remaining mushroom soup
8. Return patties to skillet ad spoon gravy over top
9. Cover pan and simmer for 20 to 25 minutes
10. Serve over rice or mashed potatoes

title: stuffed reuben sandwiches
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375f
2. Separate dough into 8 biscuits
3. Press or roll each biscuit to form a 5 inch round circle
4. Spread about 1 teaspoon dijon mustard on each biscuit
5. Place 1 ounce corned beef , 1 tablespoon sauerkraut and 1 tablespoon cheese in center of each biscuit
6. Fold in half
7. Seal edges
8. Prick top with a fork to allow steam to escape
9. Place on ungreased cookie sheet
10. Brush tops with egg
11. Bake at 375f for 13-16 minutes or until golden brown
12. Dip into thousand island dressing and enjoy !

title: easy homemade chicken salad
steps:
1. In medium mixing bowl combine first three ingredients
2. Stir in the lemon juice and pepper
3. Combine the mayo , pickle relish and prepared mustard
4. Add this sauce to chicken and gently stir in the eggs
5. Cover and chill until ready to serve

title: fall apple dip
steps:
1. Blend together cream cheese , brown sugar , vanilla and peanuts
2. Serve with sliced apples that have been dipped in lemon juice to prevent browning

title: decadent double chocolate zucchini bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Spray two 9x5-inch loaf pans with cooking spray
3. In a large bowl , combine chocolate , cocoa , eggs , egg whites , sugar , oil , yogurt , zucchini , and vanilla
4. Beat well
5. Stir in the flour , baking soda , salt and cinnamon
6. Fold in the chocolate chips
7. Pour batter into prepared pans
8. Bake in preheated oven for 60-70 minutes , or until a knife or toothpick inserted into the center of a loaf comes out clean

title: southern style okra   tomatoes
steps:
1. Cook bacon slightly
2. Saute onion and garlic with bacon until tender
3. Add tomatoes , chicken base , sugar and pepper
4. Stir well and let simmer for about 20 minutes
5. Adjust seasoning if needed
6. Meanwhile wash okra and remove fuzz if using fresh and cut into pieces
7. Add the okra and simmer until okra is done , about 20 more minutes

title: asian flavored rib eyes
steps:
1. Season steaks with salt and pepper
2. Rub with 1 t
3. Oyster sauce on each steak
4. Flip steaks and rub 1t
5. Of oyster sauce again
6. Let marinate in room temperature for 1 hour
7. Before grilling steaks , brush each with 1t of sesame oil
8. Great with piping hot rice !
9. Bon appetit !

title: stuffed zucchini
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Cut off end of zucchini and slice in half lengthwise
3. Scoop out pulp to leave 1 / 8" shell
4. Put pulp in mixing bowl and chop up well
5. Cook sausage and drain well
6. Mix zucchini pulp , mushrooms , and sausage
7. Scoop mixture into zucchini shells
8. Pour sauce over top
9. Place in baking dish
10. Cover with tinfoil
11. Make sure tinfoil is tight on pan
12. If it isn't this will take a long time !
13. Bake in oven 45 minutes
14. Remove from oven , remove tinfoil and sprinkle with cheese
15. Bake uncovered 5 minutes or until cheese is melty and bubbly

title: crunchy chinese pork salad
steps:
1. In a large skillet , cook bacon just until crisp
2. Drain and set aside
3. In a large bowl toss together bacon , pork , lettuce , water chestnuts and green onions
4. For dressing , in small bowl stir together soy sauce , honey , catsup and dry mustard
5. Add dressing and chow mein noodles to salad
6. Tossing lightly to coat

title: lemon mousse  weight watchers
steps:
1. Dissolve jello in hot water and then add lemon juice and 7-up
2. Refrigerate mixture till firm
3. Then beat at high speed with hand mixer for 5 minutes
4. Fold in whipped topping
5. Place in jello mold , and refrigerate till ready to serve
6. Variations:
7. Lime mousse: substitute lime-flavored jello and unsweetened lime juice for the lemon
8. Lemon & lime mousse: use 1 pkg
9. Each of lemon and lime jello and 1 / 4 cup each of lemon juice and lime juice
10. Cranberry mousse: substitute cranberry jello and unsweetened cranberry juice for the lemon
11. Mousse parfait: if you want to make a "fancy" dessert , try this: make separate lemon mousse and a lime mousse according to recipe , then alternate layers of each in a parfait glass , top with whipped topping and sprinkle with lemon and lime zest

title: sugar free jalapeno jelly with truvia
steps:
1. Wash and sterilize 12 - 8oz
2. Canning jars
3. The 12 lids should be place in a pan of water and brought to a simmer , not boiled and then removed from heat
4. I try to have jars and lids hot and ready at the same time as the jelly
5. Make sure you wear disposable rubber gloves to prepare the jalapenos
6. Rinse jalapenos , cut off stems , cut in half lengthwise and remove the seeds and ribs
7. I seed the jalapenos under water in a large bowl of cold water to keep the peppers from spraying on my skin or in my eyes
8. I chopped the jalapeno peppers and the bell peppers in a food processor a few at a time
9. Optional method if you like hotter spicier jelly and don't want seeds in the jelly
10. Try this method: place all the seeds and ribs from the jalapenos in the pan you will be making the jelly inches add the cider vinegar , cover and simmer for about 30 minutes , strain the vinegar to use for the jelly and discarded the seeds and ribs
11. I prefer not so spicy , but my husbands loves it and i'm always trying to find ways to make it spicier !
12. In a large pan , add finely chopped jalapenos , finely chopped red , green and / or yellow peppers , and cider vinegar
13. Bring to a simmer , add food coloring and stir in 2 pkgs
14. Sure-jell to the peppers
15. Turn heat to med / high and bring to a full rolling boil and boil exactly one minute
16. Remove from heat and stir in truvia sweetener
17. Use a ladle and fill hot sterilized jars with hot jelly , make sure to leave about of air space for better sealing
18. Wipe top of rim with clean damp towel to remove any drips
19. Place hot lid on top and screw ring on snugly , but not real tight
20. You want to allow air to escape for better sealing
21. Fill a canning kettle or large pot with water , and bring water to a boil
22. Gently lower jars into water
23. Water should cover jars by at least 1"
24. Bring water to a full boil
25. Reduce heat to a gentle boil , cover , and process for 5 minutes
26. When processed , carefully remove jars from water using tongs or a jar-lifter
27. Place upside-down on a rack or thick towels , and let cool without moving for 12-24 hours
28. Jars will make popping sounds while cooling if sealed
29. Remove ring , wipe jars with a clean damp towel , put ring back on and store in your pantry until ready to use
30. To check the seal just press down on lid , if you are able to push it and the lid flexes it is not sealed but will keep well in the in refrigerator until ready to use
31. To serve , stir to soften , pour over an 8 oz softened block of cream cheese , add a knife and let guests spread on assorted crackers
32. Or gently mix jelly and cream cheese until coarsely mixed and serve as a dip or spread
33. Make a great glaze on fish , chicken or pork !
34. Great pb & jj sandwich !

title: persian chicken and rice
steps:
1. In a soup pot , melt the butter and cook the chicken for about 15 minutes , until brown on both sides
2. Remove the chicken to a platter
3. Add the onion , apricots , and raisins and saute over medium heat for 2-3 minutes
4. Add the chicken broth , salt , pepper , and cinnamon and bring to a boil
5. Add the rice and mix well
6. Return the chicken to the pot
7. Reduce the heat to low , cover , and cook for about 25 minutes or until all the liquid is absorbed and the chicken is cooked through

title: german style kielbasa
steps:
1. Combine the apples and sauerkraut in a deep skillet over medium heat
2. Bring to a simmer then cook for about 10 minutes , until apples are starting to soften
3. Stir in the brown sugar and kielbasa
4. Cook for another 5 minutes , or until heated through

title: baked salmon
steps:
1. Drain salmon juice into a cup , add milk
2. Place in saucepan over medium heat
3. Blend in flour , salt , and hot sauce
4. Cook , stirring , until thick
5. Flake salmon and add to mixture along with lemon juice , egg whites , bell pepper and oatmeal
6. Stir
7. Place mixture in a 4" x 8" pan and cook at 400 degrees for 25-35 minutes or until lightly browned

title: spanish chicken in orange sauce
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine flour , salt & pepper
2. Coat chicken with flour imxture
3. In a large skillet , heat oil
4. Add chicken and brown well on both sides
5. Place in a shallow 1 1 / 2 quart baking dish
6. Add onion , garlic and almonds to the skillet and cook , stirring occasionally , until onion is tender and almonds are lightly browned
7. Pour over chicken
8. Combine remaining ingredients except wine and cooked rice
9. Pour over chicken
10. Cover and bake at 350 for 30 minutes
11. Uncover , add wine , and bake uncovered 15 minutes longer
12. Serve with rice

title: fijian tomato soup
steps:
1. Wash the rice , add to 3 cups boiling water and boil for 30 minutes
2. Cook the onion in a pan with the dripping till tender but not brown
3. Add the tomatoes and pepper and simmer for 10 minutes
4. Rub the mixture through a strainer into the boiling rice and water
5. Add the salt , pepper and sugar and sprinkle the parsley and paprika on top of the soup when serving

title: chocolate mint surprise christmas cookies
steps:
1. Using a medium sized ziploc bag , crush the candy canes in little pieces
2. Cut the hershey kisses in half
3. I found that a whole hershey kiss was too much for the cookies , but a half one is perfect !
4. Heat your oven to 375
5. Add the butter to a stand or hand-held mixer and mix well until smooth
6. Add the sugars and mix well
7. Add the almond and vanilla extract and mix well
8. Add the flour and mix very well on low speed until well mixed
9. With a wooden spoon mix in the crushed candy canes and the mini chocolate chips well
10. Scoop out a teaspoon of dough and add one half of a hershey kiss
11. Roll up the dough in a ball to keep the kiss inside ! place the dough balls on a parchment covered cookie pan and bake for 10-12 minutes and golden
12. Allow them to cool for about 2 minutes before removing from the pan and allow to cool
13. I have found having a sheet of tin foil on your table or counter works great in cooling cookies !
14. In a medium sauce pan , add the white chocolate chips and the 6 tablespoons of shortening
15. Melt slowly on medium / low heat as not to burn the chocolate
16. Divide the melted chocolate into 3 cups
17. In the first two cups , add a bit of green and a bit red food coloring seperately to the shades that you like
18. Using a fork , drizzle the colored chocolate over the cookies to decorate
19. The kids will love this part ! enjoy !

title: black olive mayonnaise
steps:
1. Place the garlic cloves into the bowl of a food processor and pulse until finely chopped
2. Add the olives and parsley and pulse again until the mix is almost a puree
3. Add the mayonnaise , lemon juice and salt and pulse until just combined
4. With the processor running , add the olive oil in a stream
5. Pour into a bowl and chill until ready to use
6. Great served with sandwiches , over toast , flatbread , pita chips , etc

title: crunchy batter fried fish  no beer
steps:
1. Mix together 1 cup flour , 1 / 4 cup cornstarch , baking powder and salt in a bowl
2. Stir in enough club soda to make a batter about the consistency of thin pancake batter
3. You don't want it too thick , just thick enough to nicely coat a spoon
4. Season the batter to taste if desired with seasoning of your choice
5. I suggest old bay , lemon pepper seasoning , or seasoned salt
6. Set aside
7. In another bowl , mix together remaining 1 / 4 cup flour and 1 / 4 cup cornstarch
8. Heat oil in a deep pan to 375f use a candy thermometer if you need to
9. Oil in pan should be about 3" to 4" deep
10. Cut fish into portion sizes and remove any pin bones , and pat dry
11. Dredge the fish in the dry flour / cornstarch mixture
12. Shake off any excess
13. This allows the batter to stick to the fish
14. Dip dredged fish into batter allowing any excess to drip off before carefully adding the fish to the hot oil
15. Cook the fish one or two pieces at a time until golden brown
16. Drain on paper towels or better yet , on a cake cooling rack set up over paper towels
17. Serve while hot

title: apple slice with creamy topping
steps:
1. Mix first 3 ingredients together: press into slice tin , and cook in a moderate oven 20-25 minutes , til very lightly browned
2. Cool for 10 minutes and then spread cooked apple carefully over base
3. Pour over about 400gr light sour cream , spread out with the back of a spoon
4. Sprinkle with cinnamon and bake a further 10 to 15 minutes
5. Hints: you'll need to cook about a kilo of granny smiths for this , peel and slice your apples and cook with 1 / 2 cup water , and sugar to taste
6. Drain and cool before use
7. Be generous with the baking paper , it makes it easier to lift the slice out of the tin
8. Cut the slice when it is cold
9. Nice warm too , but cut in the tin

title: sausage  tomato  macaroni and cheese casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Grease a 2 quart shallow casserole
3. Heat water for the macaroni
4. Brown sausage in a large skillet , breaking up the sausage with the side of a spoon as it cooks
5. Pour into a colander to drain
6. Add the milk and processed cheese to the skillet , cook and stir over low heat until the cheese is melted
7. Stir in the sausage and tomatoes and remove from the heat
8. Cook the macaroni according to package directions while making the sauce , drain and mix into the sausage , cheese , tomato mixture
9. Spoon into the prepared casserole , top with grated cheese and bake 25-30 minutes
10. Let stand 5-10 minutes before serving

title: how to brine a ginormous turkey
steps:
1. Line a big picnic cooler with a food grade plastic bag
2. Boil water and salt together until all salt is dissolved and cool in fridge several hours
3. Wash turkey inside and out and place into cooler
4. Add your optional add-ins to the cooled brine and cover turkey with ice and pour brine over all
5. Let turkey brine overnight making sure the cooler stays closed and adding ice if needed
6. Rinse bird and continue with your recipe
7. Your turkey will be moist , flavorful and tender !

title: derbyshire fruit loaf
steps:
1. Put the dried fruit and the sugar into a mixing bowl , add the hot tea and leave to soak overnight
2. The next day , preheat oven to 300 degrees
3. Spray and line a 7 inch cake pan or a loaf pan
4. Stir the egg , flour , spices and the marmalade into the fruit , sugar and tea mixture
5. Pour into the cake pan or the loaf pan
6. Bake for 1 1 / 2 -2 hours until firm to the touch or until a skewer pushed into the cake comes out clean
7. Do not open the oven during the first hour of baking time

title: frozen beef and bean burritos  oamc
steps:
1. Sort beans and place in a pot with 6 cups water
2. Soak overnight , or bring to a boil , cook for 3 minutes , then cover and remove from heat , allowing to sit undisturbed for 1 hour
3. Drain and rinse beans , and cover with 6 cups water
4. Bring to a boil , then cover , and simmer for 1- 1 1 / 2 hours or until tender and creamy
5. Drain beans and retain cooking liquid
6. Brown ground beef with 6 cloves minced garlic , 1 tsp adobo or salt , 1 / 2 tsp black pepper , and 1 tsp ground cumin
7. Cook until thoroughly done , breaking up any lumps as you cook
8. Cook onion and 6 cloves minced garlic in 4 tbsp lard in a deep skillet until tender
9. Add drained beans and mash until smooth and creamy , adding some of the cooking liquid if necessary
10. Season beans to taste with adobo seasoning or seasoned salt
11. Stir in cooked beef , tomato paste , and chopped green chilies
12. Warm tortillas briefly to soften them and make them easier to handle
13. Place about 1 / 2 cup beef / bean mixture on the center of the tortilla
14. Top with about 2 tbsp shredded cheddar
15. Fold sides of tortilla toward the center , being closer together towards the side farthest from you
16. Fold tortilla over filling and finish rolling up , but not too tightly
17. Place in plastic wrap , wrapping tightly to help keep its shape
18. Proceed the same way with remaining burritos
19. Place wrapped burritos into freezer bags or freezer containers and freeze until needed
20. To use , remove wrapping from burrito and place on a microwave-safe plate
21. Microwave 2-3 minutes or until hot , turning halfway through cooking

title: maui sweet potato bake
steps:
1. Mash potatoes in a large bowl until almost smooth
2. Stir in coconut milk& seasonings and mash until smooth
3. Stir in next 4 ingredients , test for seasoning , turn into a greased 9 x 13 inch baking dish& spread evenly
4. Sprinkle coconut over the top
5. Bake in the center of a preheated 350f oven for 30- 35 minutes
6. Broil until the top is golden , about 3 or 4 minutes

title: boca breakfast sandwich  meatless egg mcmuffin
steps:
1. Toast bread
2. Heat smart balance or oil in non-stick pan on medium high
3. Meanwhile , microwave boca burger in package for 2 minutes
4. When pan is hot , crack egg into it and break yolk with edge of shell
5. Sprinkle egg with salt and pepper
6. Turn egg over with plastic spatula when ready
7. Cook until yolk reaches desired consistency
8. While egg is cooking , spread mayo on one side of toast and put boca burger on top
9. Put cheese on other piece of toast
10. When egg is done , put put it on top of cheese
11. Put sandwich together and eat before it gets cold !
12. Optional: add some hot sauce for extra kick

title: kickin  brownies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Spread nuts in single layer on baking sheet
3. Bake 10 to 12 minutes or until skins begin to flake off
4. Let cool slightly
5. Wrap hazelnuts in kitchen towel
6. Rub to remove as much of skins as possible
7. Cool completely
8. Process nuts in food processor until finely chopped
9. Set aside
10. Lightly grease 2 square baking pans
11. Line bottoms of pans with foil
12. Lightly grease foil
13. Set aside
14. Melt butter in medium saucepan over medium heat
15. Remove from heat
16. Blend in sugar and cocoa powder
17. Stir in eggs and vanilla until smooth
18. Stir in flour just until blended
19. Pour batter evenly into prepared pans
20. Press raspberries gently into batter
21. Bake 15 to 20 minutes or until center is just set
22. Cool completely in pans on wire rack
23. Hold wire rack over top of 1 pan
24. Invert to release brownie
25. Remove foil
26. Discard
27. Place cut over brownie
28. Invert brownie
29. Prepare ganaches
30. Reserve 2 tablespoons white ganache
31. Spread remaining white ganache evenly over brownie
32. Spread raspberry jam on top of ganache
33. -------whiteganache----------
34. Combine 1 / 2 cup white chocolate chips and whipping cream in medium saucepan
35. Heat over medium heat until chocolate is half melted , stirring occasionally
36. Remove from heat
37. Stir in remaining 1 / 2 cup white chocolate chips and almond extract until smooth
38. Keep warm
39. Makes 3 / 4 cup
40. ------chocolate ganache-------
41. Combine whipping cream and butter in small saucepan
42. Heat over medium heat until mixture boils , stirring frequently
43. Remove saucepan from heat
44. Stir in chocolate and vanilla until smooth , returning to heat for 20 to 30 second intervals as needed to melt chocolate
45. Keep warm
46. Makes 1 / 3 cup

title: tiger shrimp with pasta
steps:
1. Cook spaghetti or ribbon pasta 'al dente' according to package directions
2. Drain , but not rinse
3. Meanwhile heat olive in a small pot to medium high heat
4. Add tiger shrimps and cook on each side for about 1 minute
5. Take shrimps out , drain and peel
6. Cook onions and the whole peeled garlic in the same oil for about 1 minute until onions are tender
7. Add anchovy filets and crush them
8. Reduce heat to low and cook for an additional minute
9. Add tomatoes and thyme
10. Do not cook
11. Tomatoes should only be heated through
12. Season with a pinch of sugar , salt and pepper to taste
13. Add peeled tiger shrimps and heat through for about 5 minutes
14. Remove garlic clove and add drained noodles or pasta
15. Mix well , cover and let rest for 2 minutes
16. Serve
17. But if you like you can mince 1 / 2 of the garlic clove and leave it in the sauce

title: greek chili
steps:
1. Saute ground beef , onion and garlic in a large saucepan until beef is browned
2. Add the spices , herbs and cocoa and cook about 1-2 more minutes
3. Stir in tomatoes , beans and honey
4. Heat to boiling , then reduce heat and simmer , covered for about 15 minutes
5. Uncover and simmer another 10 minutes
6. Spoon chili over pasta
7. Garnish with feta cheese and olives

title: ham tortilla stack
steps:
1. Beat cream cheese , mayo and salad dressing together till smooth , stir in green pepper , onion and olives
2. On a plate , place 1 tortilla , spread with about 1 / 2 cup of cheese mixture and 1 / 7th of the ham
3. Repeat six times and top with last tortilla
4. Cover and chill 2 hours or over night , cut into wedges to serve

title: slow cooked pork ala michael chiarello
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 275 degrees f
2. Combine first 9 ingredients in a food processor
3. Can also be mixed by hand in a bowl , but make sure to combine well
4. If necessary , trim fat from top of pork , leaving a 1 / 8-inch thick layer of fat
5. Spread roasted garlic rub all over pork and inside any cavities , concentrating on boned side
6. Put pork , fat side up , in a roasting pan and roast in middle of oven 6 to 8 hours
7. Transfer roast to cutting board and let stand 15 minutes
8. Pull shreds apart with tongs into chunks
9. Serve

title: cheese ball 2
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients very well
2. Chill mixture for about 20 minute
3. Then form into 2 balls and roll into chopped nuts , and serve

title: garlic chicken wings in coke
steps:
1. Fry wings in the oil in a skillet until browned
2. Mix remaining ingredients and pour over wings in pan
3. Cover pan and cook slowly for 45 minutes
4. Remove cover for the last 15 minutes to thicken sauce
5. Watch carefully , turning often

title: ahoy there   moules marinires   french sailor s mussels
steps:
1. Place the live mussels in fresh water
2. Scrub and debeard the mussels , discarding any that are open , broken or cracked
3. Fry the chopped onion and chopped garlic cloves in a little butter in the biggest saucepan you have
4. Add half of the finely chopped fresh herbs - i have used a mixture of parsley , oregano and tarragon
5. Season with black pepper , wait to season with salt to taste later
6. Add the white wine to the butter and herbs , and then
7. Cover the pan and let the mussels steam for about 5 minutes
8. Shake the pan every minute or so to coat the mussels in the liquid
9. Take the pan off the heat and add the double cream or creme fraiche
10. Then add of the remaining finely chopped herbs
11. Mix through thoroughly
12. That's it ! enjoy with crusty bread , frites and a chilled white wine -- divine !
13. Nb: discard any mussels that don't open during cooking

title: shepherd s pie with leftover turkey
steps:
1. Put potatoes in pan with water and cook until fork-tender
2. Drain potatoes
3. Add sour cream and 1 / 2 c broth
4. Mash until smooth and set aside
5. Meanwhile , heat oil in large skillet over med-hi heat
6. Add onion , carrots and celery
7. Cook until soft
8. About 5 minute
9. Add garlic
10. Cook 1 more minute
11. Add turkey and cook till warmed through
12. Add flour , thyme , salt and pepper
13. Stir to coat
14. Add remaining broth and bring to simmer
15. Simmer until mixture thickens , about 4 minute
16. Transfer turkey mixture to 9" casserole dish
17. Spread mashed potato over top and using the back of the spoon , make swirls on the top
18. Bake until potatoes are golden , about
19. 30 minutes @ 400 degrees

title: crock pot green beans   bacon
steps:
1. Place bacon at the bottom of the crockpot
2. Place other ingredients on top of the bacon in crock pot
3. Stir
4. Cover and cook on low for 6 hours
5. If you have a large crock pot , you can double the recipe

title: estonian milk soup with pasta shapes  makaroni piimasupp
steps:
1. Bring the water to a vigorous boil , add the salt and the pasta
2. Reduce to a simmer , then cook for 5 to 7 minutes , or until the pasta is al dente
3. Add the milk , stir and cook for a few minutes longer , until the milk is hot and the pasta is fully cooked
4. Season with the sugar and more salt , if necessary
5. Stir in the butter and serve

title: brazil nut chips
steps:
1. Cover shelled nuts with water
2. Bring to a boil and simmer 5 minutes
3. Cut into slices lenghtwise with a very sharp knife
4. Spread in shallow pans
5. Add the butter
6. Salt well
7. And toast at 350f until the chips are brown and toasty
8. Drain on absorbent paper
9. Keep an eye on them

title: dr  bateman s brown sugar sauce
steps:
1. In a medium-sized heavy saucepan , whisk together the brown sugar , flour , cold water and wine until mixture is a smooth paste
2. Over medium heat , cook until mixture is thick and clear , whisking frequently
3. Whisk in cream , butter , vanilla , salt and nuts , if using
4. Sauce is ready when butter melts

title: butterscotch peanut butter cookies
steps:
1. Mix together shortening , butter and peanut butter until well blended
2. Add sugars , eggs and mix well
3. Blend the flour and soda then add to creamy mixture and mix well
4. Add butterscotch morsels , nuts and mix well
5. Drop by teaspoonful onto greased cookie sheet and flatten"a little" with fingers
6. Bake at 375 degrees for 10 to 12 minutes
7. Let cookies set on cookie sheet a few minutes before removing

title: quinoa black bean and vegetable salad
steps:
1. Prepare quinoa with water and let cool
2. Chop all the vegetables and toss with the quinoa and black beans
3. Place lime juice , lime rind , salt , garlic , olive oil , and cilantro in a bowl and whisk it until blended then pour it over the salad and toss
4. Serve cold

title: orange balls    adult
steps:
1. Mix first six ingredients
2. Form into one- to one-and-a-half-inch balls
3. Roll in powdered sugar
4. Store in covered container

title: chicken noodle delight casserole dinner
steps:
1. In a skillet , or large saucepan combine the first 5 ingredients through and including margargarine , and saute for 5 minutes
2. Remove from heat , add chicken , mushrooms , alfredo sauce , cream , salt , chicken bouillon , and noodles , and mix well
3. Pour into a buttered 3 quart baking dish
4. Combine topping ingredients and sprinkle over casserole
5. Bake uncovered at 325 degrees for 20 minutes or until casserole is bubbly around edges

title: golden five spice  sticky chicken
steps:
1. Whisk together the marinade ingredients
2. Put the chicken into a dish , then pour over the marinade , mixing to coat it
3. Cover and then chill for at least 20 minutes or up to 24 hours if you have time
4. Heat the oven to 180 / 160 / gas 4
5. Lift the chicken out of the marinade into a roasting tin
6. Roast for 40 minutes , then pour over the remaining marinade and cook for a further 30 minutes until golden and sticky

title: out of this world chocolate cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy
3. Add eggs and combine well
4. Stir in dry ingredients
5. Fold in m&m's
6. Spoon onto cookie sheet about 1 inch apart
7. Bake 10-12 minutes , until golden brown

title: green mayonnaise sauce
steps:
1. Place all ingredients , except mayonnaise , in a blender jar and process until smooth
2. Stir into mayonnaise and whisk until smooth
3. Makes 2 1 / 2 cups

title: vegetarian stuffed zucchini
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees
2. Cut zucchini in halves , lenghtwise and scoop out seeds , leaving a 1-inch shell intact
3. Steam zucchini shells 3-4 minutes
4. Saute onion , greeen pepper , and garlic in butter
5. Add spinach
6. Stir to combine and coat well
7. Cool , then add mushrooms , eggs , bread crumbs , and seasonings to taste
8. Add wine
9. Place zucchini in baking dish and fill with stuffing mix
10. Cover with sauce , and sprinkle with cheese
11. Bake for 20-25 minutes , until cheese is bubbly

title: pineappleade  southeast asia
steps:
1. In a small saucepan combine sugar & water over medium heat
2. Cook for about 5 minutes , stirring occasionally , until sugar dissolves , then set aside to cool
3. Put pineapple in a blender with enough water to cover the fruit , then puree
4. Strain the pineapple mash , pressing on the solids to extract as much juice as possible
5. Combine the pineapple juice with enough water to make 1 quart , then add lime juice & sugar syrup to taste
6. Chill & serve

title: southern fried green tomatoes
steps:
1. Cut tomatoes into inch thick slices
2. Sprinkle both sides of each slice with salt and pepper
3. Dip slices into milk then in flour
4. Dip into eggs then into breadcrumbs
5. In a 10-inch skillet cook half of the slices at a time in hot oil over medium heat for 8-10 minutes on each sides or till brown
6. Add more oil , if needed
7. Season to taste with salt and pepper

title: marinated flank steak sandwiches
steps:
1. Combine all marinade ingredients and simmer for ten minutes uncovered
2. Cool to room temperature and pour over 1 1 / 2 lbs of scored flank steak
3. Cover and let stand in refrigerator for several hours , basting occasionally
4. Place on grill , cook for five minutes , turn and cook five minutes more or until no more than medium
5. Slice very thin diagonally across the grain

title: finger licking chicken drumsticks
steps:
1. In a large bowl or casserole dish , mix all ingredients but drumsticks
2. Skin meat and make 2-3 small slashes in flesh
3. Add to marinade
4. Coat well
5. Cover and refrigerate for 2 hours or overnight
6. Arrange drumsticks in a roasting pan and pour on leftover marinade
7. Bake in a 425f oven for 40 minutes , or until cooked through , basting occasionally with sauce

title: taste of louisiana spiced bread braid
steps:
1. Place water , oil , paste and cheese in bread machine
2. Top with flour , place the spices and garlic in one corner , salt and sugar in separate corners
3. Make a hole in the center and place the yeast
4. Set machine to dough cycle and press start
5. Lightly spray baking pan
6. When dough cycle has finished turn out on to a flour surface
7. Divide into 3 pieces making a rope of each
8. Place each next to each other
9. Start at center and braid to end and tuck ends under
10. Turn dough around and braid the remaining ropes and tucks ends under
11. Place the bread on the oiled pan cover with plastic wrap and let rise for 45 minutes
12. Meanwhile preheat oven to 400 degrees
13. Remove wrap and glaze the bread with the egg
14. Bake for 30 minutes

title: sunrise breakfast casserole  prepared night before
steps:
1. Put sausage on a 15x10x1 inch baking pan
2. Bake at 375 degrees for 15-20 minutes or until the sausage is no longer pink
3. Drain , then slice into 1 / 4 inch coins
4. In a large bowl , combine the eggs , milk , mustard , salt and pepper
5. Add the hash browns , sausage , cheese , sweet red pepper and green onions
6. Mix well
7. Pour into a greased 13x9x2 inch baking dish , cover and refrigerate overnight
8. Remove from refrigerator 30 minutes prior to baking
9. Bake uncovered at 350 degrees for 65-70 minutes or until set and golden brown
10. Let stand 10 minutes before serving
11. Serve with salsa or picante sauce , if you like

title: chocolate peanut butter treats  gluten free
steps:
1. Place the sugar , corn syrup and peanut butter in a large saucepan over medium low heat
2. Stirring constantly , cook the mixture until blended and the mixture begins to bubble
3. Remove from heat and set aside
4. Combine the cereal with the chocolate chips in a large bowl
5. Stir in the hot peanut butter mixture until combined
6. Spread the mixture into a 13x9" lightly greased baking pan
7. Let cool to room temperature
8. Transfer to the refrigerator and let chill for 15-20 minutes or until set
9. Cut into squares or fun shapes with cookie cutters
10. Serve
11. `

title: crock pot asian inspired beef ribs
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients except for ribs in crock pot
2. Add the ribs one at a time , coating them with sauce and stacking them as you go
3. Cover and cook on low for 8 hours
4. Remove ribs and pour sauce into a separate container
5. Allow fat to separate and skim off of top
6. Return sauce to meat , and serve

title: grilled salmon spinach salad
steps:
1. Drain pineapple reserving 1 / 3 c of juice
2. Mix 1 / 3 c pineapple juice , soy sauce , mustard , garlic , ginger and brown sugar
3. Cut fish into 4-5 servings and place in a pan
4. Pour marinade over fish let stand 20 min turn over and marinate 20 more minute
5. Heat grill or broiler in oven
6. Remove fish from marinade , reserving marinade
7. Spray fish with non-stick spray
8. Grill or broil 3-4 minutes per side
9. Grill pineapple slices at the same time fish is grilling
10. Place marinade in a small saucepan boil then remove from heat
11. After cool wisk in vinegar and oil
12. Place washed spinach on plates , arrange tomatoes and crumbled feta over spinach
13. Place grilled fish in middle of plate and drizzle with 1-3 tablespoons dressing

title: fairly authentic cincinnati chili
steps:
1. Saute the onion in the olive oil until translucent
2. Add the water , tomato sauce and tomato paste and stir
3. Add the beef without browning it
4. Break it up and stir
5. Add the rest of the ingredients up to and including the chocolate
6. Simmer at least 1 hour , preferably 2 or 3 until spaghetti sauce consistency
7. Boil spaghetti to al dente
8. And now the 'ways':
9. One-way: chili alone with some oyster crackers
10. Two-ways: chili on spaghetti
11. Three-ways: chili on spaghetti with cheese on top
12. Four-ways: chili on spaghetti with chopped onion , then cheese on top
13. Five-ways: chili on spaghetti with onions , kidney beans , then cheese on top
14. Offer extra chili flakes to the hot-heads

title: salmon cakes
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , beat eggs
2. Add cream , cornmeal , onions , flour , baking powder , pepper and salt if desired
3. Add salmon
4. Mix well
5. Melt butter in skiller or griddle
6. Drop salmon mixture by 1 / 3 cupfuls and cook over medium heat for 5 mins
7. On each side or until lightly browned
8. Serve hot

title: easy mexican taco dip
steps:
1. With your mixer on medium speed , beat the cream cheese spread until creamy
2. Add the taco seasoning mix to the cream cheese
3. Beat until well blended
4. Spread onto bottom of a quiche dish or a 9 inch flat bottomed bowl or pie plate
5. Add the remaining ingredients in layers over the cream cheese mixture
6. Cover and refrigerate for a minimum of 1 hour before serving
7. Serve with tortilla chips
8. Garnish with chopped fresh cilantro

title: zesty marinated pork chops
steps:
1. In a large resealable plastic bag , combine the vinegar , wine , 1 tsp oil , chili powder , horseradish , dill , garlic powder , and salt
2. Add the pork chops
3. Seal bag and turn to coat
4. Refrigerate for eight hours or overnight , turning occasionally
5. Drain and discard marinade
6. In a large nonstick skillet over medium heat , cook chops in remaining oil for 4-5 minutes on each side or until a meat thermometer reads 160 degrees

title: swedish cabbage
steps:
1. Core cabbage , then shred cabbage
2. Place in large pot and cook in a small amount of water until tender
3. Will probably take about 10 minutes
4. Drain cabbage
5. Add remaining ingredients to cabbage , and stir
6. Serve

title: weird marinade
steps:
1. Empty bottle of worcestershire sauce in a bowl
2. Pour liquid smoke into empty worcestershire sauce bottle
3. Then fill bottle to top with worcestershire sauce
4. That is it !

title: cindy s meatloaf
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Saute vegetables and thyme in olive oil until soft , but not browned
3. Allow to cool somewhat
4. Mix veggies , meats , salt and pepper , 1 / 2 cup of ketchup , egg and breadcrumbs gently together
5. Form mixture into two loaf shapes on foil lined baking sheet
6. Mix remaining ketchup and brown sugar
7. Spread ketchup mixture over loaves
8. Bake at 350 degrees for one hour and 15 minutes
9. Allow to rest on baking sheet 10 minutes before cutting

title: casaba melon with coconut milk
steps:
1. Mix together the coconut milk , lime juice , and zest in a large bowl until well mixed
2. Add the melon and toss well
3. Chill for at least one hour , and up to three hours
4. Garnish with the toasted coconut and lime zest and serve chilled

title: seven sisters secret sauce
steps:
1. Put natural yogurt , mayonnaise and tahini sauce in a bowl and mix thoroughly
2. Add mustard , honey , lemon and stir
3. Salt and pepper
4. Add any of the ingredients again to suit your taste

title: south indian vegetable korma
steps:
1. Blend or process the grated coconut , chillies , onion , ginger , turmeric and cilantro together with a little water , in a blender or processor , until they form a fine paste
2. Set to one side
3. For the masala , heat a small , heavy-based skillet or pan over a medium-high heat
4. Add the anise , cinnamon , cloves , cardamom pods and poppy seeds , and dry-roast them until they give off a strong aroma
5. Be careful they do not burn
6. Grind them to a fine paste and set aside
7. Place all the vegetables except the tomato in a heavy saucepan , and add enough water to just cover them
8. Bring to to boil , reduce heat and simmer , covered , until the vegetables are just tender
9. Add the chopped tomato and salt , to taste , and simmer 1 - 2 minutes longer
10. Add the coconut / cilantro paste to the vegetables , and stir , before adding the masala powder
11. Mix well
12. Heat the oil or ghee in a small skillet , and saute the curry leaves for a minute or two before adding them to the korma
13. Garnish the finished dish with fresh cilantro leaves

title: lime chutney
steps:
1. Cut 10 ripened yellowed limes into eight wedges each
2. Place in large glass bowl , sprinkle with 2 tablespoons cooking salt and stir well , cover with plastic wrap or lid and leave for 48 hours in cool dark place , stirring occasionally
3. Drain , rinse well and mix with raisins and sultanas
4. Process in batches in food processor until coarsely chopped
5. Heat 3 tablespoons peanut oil in large heavy based pan , add cumin , coriander , mustard seeds , chilli powder , black pepper , garlic and ginger
6. Cook over medium heat for 2-3 minutes , or until very aromatic
7. Add the lime mixture , vinegar and soft brown sugar
8. Bring to the boil , stirring until the sugar dissolves
9. Reduce the heat and simmer for 1 hours , stirring occasionally
10. Pour into warm , sterilized jars and seal
11. Refrigerate after opening
12. Makes about 2 cups

title: vanilla popcorn
steps:
1. Place popcorn in a large bowl
2. Set aside
3. In saucepan , combine sugar , butter , corn syrup and baking soda
4. Bring to a boil over medium heat
5. Boil and stir until mixture is golden , about 2 minutes
6. Remove from the heat
7. Stir in vanilla
8. Pour over popcorn and toss to coat
9. Cool slightly
10. Break apart while warm

title: onion smothered ham sandwich
steps:
1. Melt butter in medium skillet on medium heat
2. Add onion and sugar , and cook about 15 minutes or until onions are tender and golden brown , stirring frequently
3. Add ham and toss to coat
4. Cook 2 minutes or until heated through , stirring frequently
5. Spread cut sides of rolls with mustard
6. Fill with ham mixture and cheese
7. Serve with your favorite pickle and chips , or french fries and cole slaw for a complete meal

title: couscous fruity salad
steps:
1. Heat oil in a saut pan , add onions and first 8 spices , stirring
2. Add chicken broth , bring to boil
3. Add couscous , cover and remove from heat
4. Let it sit 5 minutes , fluff with fork pour couscous into a large bowl
5. Add oil and remaining ingredients , toss well

title: lentil rice comfort stuff
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in rice cooker
2. Boil till desired consistency

title: mexican chocolate crunch brownies
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350
2. Spray a 9x13 pan
3. Finely crush cereal
4. In a large bowl , stir butter and corn syrup until well blended
5. Add cereal and mix thoroughly
6. Press evenly into sprayed pan
7. Make brownie mix as directed on box using oil , water , eggs , and adding cinnamon
8. Stir in 2 / 3 cup of chocolate chips
9. Pour over cereal and sprinkle remaining 2 / 3 cup of chocolate chips on top
10. Bake 20 minutes
11. Sprinkle cinnamon sugar evenly over brownies
12. Bake 14-18 min longer or set
13. Cool 10 minutes then loosen edges but do not cut
14. Cool 2 hours in total
15. To make cinnamon sugar combine 3tbsp sugar and 1 / 2 tsp cinnamon

title: schnitzla   polish meatballs
steps:
1. Chop onion and saut in 1 stick margarine until very soft
2. Drain and reserve margarine
3. Mix raw pork , ground round , cooked onion , 1 / 4 box finely crushed cracker crumbs , and 2 eggs
4. Form patties with 1 1 / 2 to 2 tablespoon meat
5. Crush another quarter box of the saltines into very fine crumbs , coat each meatball in the crumbs and gently flatten very slightly
6. Fry in reserved margarine , keeping margarine level in pan to at least 1 / 4 inch
7. Drain and enjoy

title: hearty trail mix cookies   jar mix
steps:
1. Jar mix instructions
2. In 1-quart jar , pack brown sugar on bottom and level
3. Pour sugar in jar and level
4. Pour oats in jar and level
5. In small bowl , combine flour , baking powder and baking soda , mixing well
6. Spoon flour mixture into jar and level
7. Sprinkle in raisins , leveling as necessary
8. Sprinkle coconut over raisins and level
9. Sprinkle m&m's and place lid on jar
10. Preparation instructions
11. Preheat oven to 375 degrees fahrenheit
12. Empty jar contents into large bowl
13. Add egg and butter
14. Beat on low speed to blend
15. Drop heaping teaspoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheet
16. Bake 10- 12 minutes or until edges are lightly browned
17. Cool on cookie sheet for 1 minutes , then transfer to cooling rack

title: cranberry chocolate dessert sauce
steps:
1. Combine cranberry sauce and chocolate bits in a medium saucepan
2. Melt over medium heat , whisking occasionally until smooth
3. Cool
4. May store in glass jar in refrigerator
5. Serve over desserts , fruit , ice cream , etc
6. Makes 2 cups

title: barley and lentil soup
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , add oil and heat over medium-high heat
2. Add onions and garlic
3. Saute onions for 10 minutes or until clear
4. Add next 6 ingredients
5. Cook until red bell pepper is just softened , stirring occasionally
6. Add 5 cans of broth , tomatoes , and tomato paste
7. Bring to a boil
8. Stir in barley and lentils
9. Lower heat and simmer about 1 1 / 2 hours or until barley and lentils are tender
10. Stirring occasionally
11. Add more broth to reach desired consistency
12. Add salt and pepper to taste
13. Ladle into soup bowls and sprinkle with parsley

title: copycat perkins family restaurant pancakes
steps:
1. Place the dry pancake mix into a large bowl
2. Add the eggs , club soda and melted shortening
3. Use a wire whisk to mix carefully until there are no lumps
4. Allow the batter to rest while you preheat your griddle or skillet over medium-high heat
5. Use about 1 tablespoon vegetable oil in the preheated skillet for each pancake
6. Use 1 / 2 cup batter for each pancake
7. Flip pancake only once when you see open bubbles appear on the surface and the edges appear dry around the pancake
8. Makes about 10 pancakes 8 inches in diameter

title: pasta with spiced tomato basil sauce
steps:
1. In a food processor 9or by hand , combine all the ingredients except the pasta
2. Taste for seasoning , adding salt and pepper as needed
3. Set aside
4. Bring a large pot of water to the boil
5. Add pasta and boil for 10-12 minutes or until"al dente"
6. Drain , reserving 1 / 3 cup of pasta water
7. Place spaghettini in a bowl and immediately toss with pasta water and sauce
8. For those who like it , serve with extra olive oil and parmesan cheese

title: salted caramel strawberries
steps:
1. To prepare strawberries do not remove green caps before washing
2. Water will seep into the berry , softening the texture and weakening the flavor
3. Wash strawberries just before using then patting dry with paper towels
4. Microwave caramels , 3 tablespoons whipping cream and 1 / 4 teaspoon salt in a 1-quart microwave-safe bowl at medium for 3 1 / 2 minutes or until smooth , stirring at 1-minute intervals
5. Dip each strawberry halfway into caramel mixture
6. Roll in nuts and place on lightly greased wax paper
7. Let stand for 15 minutes
8. Serve immediately or cover and chill up to 8 hours

title: pizza noodle bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit
2. Bring water to a boil in a 3 quart sauce pan
3. Boil noodles and set aside
4. These steps are if you are using pre-cooked sausage:
5. Heat butter and oil in a skillet
6. The oil keeps the butter from burning
7. Add your mushrooms , onions and garlic and saute until almost done
8. Add your precooked sausage and cook for an additional 5 to 7 minutes or until sausage is heated through
9. In a 2 quart casserole dish , add 2 tablespoons spaghetti sauce to the bottom
10. Layer 1 / 2 of the cooked noodles , sausage mixture , 1 / 2 of the remaining sauce and 1 / 2 cup of the mozzarella cheese
11. Layer the remaining noodles , remaining sauce , 1 / 2 cup mozzarella cheese
12. Top the dish off with pepperoni slices
13. Bake for 40 to 45 minutes or until cheese is melted and dish is heated through

title: lentil and bulgur salad
steps:
1. Cover lentils with water by 1 inch in a medium pan
2. Bring to a boil
3. Reduce to a simmer
4. Cover and cook until lentils are tender but still holding their shape , 15-20 minutes
5. Drain the lentils
6. Bring 1 cup of water to a boil in a small saucepan
7. Stir in the bulgur , 1 / 2 teaspoon salt , and pepper to taste
8. Cover , remove from heat and let sit until bulgur has absorbed liquid , about 30 minutes
9. Transfer bulgur to a large bowl
10. Gently stir in the lentils and all remaining ingredients

title: moroccan lamb with couscous
steps:
1. Toast almond slivers in dry frying pan over medium heat , tossing until golden
2. Transfer to a small bowl , cool before using
3. Melt butter in large saucepan , saute garlic until softened
4. Add stock and saffron , bring to a boil
5. Stir couscous through boiling stock , remove sauce pan from heat: cover and stand 5 minutes until all stock is absorbed
6. Using a fork , seperate the couscous grains
7. Preheat grill to medium , rub sersoning and oil into lamb , grill 3 - 4 minutes per side , or until cooked to your liking
8. Remove from grill and set aside to rest , keep meat warm until needed
9. Cook red peppers and zucchini on grill for 2 - 3 minutes per side
10. Toss red peppers , zucchini , chickpeas and herbs through the warm couscous , top with sliced lamb and sprinkle with the almonds
11. Enjoy !

title: plain cake jamaican style
steps:
1. Grease 8-inch round baking tin and set aside
2. Preheat the oven to 375f
3. Cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy
4. Add eggs folding into mixture until blended
5. Combine all dry ingredients in a separate bowl and fold one or two times
6. Add dry ingredients to wet ingredients and fold
7. Add water and vanilla then continue to fold
8. Bake in oven set at 350f bake for 25 - 30 minutes or until when tested with toothpick comes out clean
9. Cool before attempting to remove

title: cheese bake dip
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400
2. Mix all ingredients in a small casserole dish , and bake for 20 minutes until bubbly and golden on top
3. Serve with raw veggies or crackers

title: good eats indian summer soup
steps:
1. Rinse the chicken breasts , pat dry , and brush with oil
2. Season with salt and pepper
3. Slice onion into rings 1 / 4 inch thick , but don't separate the rings
4. Rinse the poblano pepper and pat dry
5. Grill the onion , pepper and chicken over medium heat for 10 to 15 minutes , or until the vegetables are soft and chicken is cooked through
6. Place the pepper in a small paper sack while it is still hot and let it cool for 20 minutes , then peel off the skin and scrape out the seeds
7. Chop the onion , pepper and chicken into bite-size pieces
8. Melt butter in a large heavy pot over low heat
9. Saute garlic and mushrooms in the butter for 5 minutes or until softened
10. Add the chicken , onions , pepper , corn and 2 cups of water
11. Mix and simmer for 5 minutes
12. Add cubed cheese and simmer until the cheese has melted
13. Do not allow the soup to boil
14. In a separate bowl , mix the cornstarch with 1 / 2 cup water
15. Stir dissolved cornstarch into the remaining 1 1 / 2 cups of water and add to soup
16. Cook over low heat until thickened , stirring constantly

title: rb s copycat progresso pepper salad
steps:
1. In a large frypan , add evoo , garlic , and italian seasoning
2. Saute for 3 minutes to let the flavors meld
3. Add the package of frozen pepper & onion mix and saute over medium high heat to let the water boil off
4. When the peppers start to look cooked reduce heat to medium low and add the red wine vinegar
5. Allow to cook for 2 more minutes and remove from heat
6. Place in container and refrigerate for at least 8 hours before using

title: pork balls in curry sauce
steps:
1. Combine ground pork , bread crumbs , egg , onion and salt
2. Shape into 1 1 / 2-inch balls
3. Heat oil in a fry pan
4. Add half pork balls and cook , shaking pan to brown all sides
5. Remove browned balls from pan and repeat with remainder
6. Remove browned balls from pan
7. Pour off fat , measure and return 2 tablespoons to pan
8. Add red peppers , curry powder and ginger
9. Cook and stir about 1 minute
10. Add onions , garlic , vinegar , tomato sauce , sugar and chicken broth
11. Stir to blend and bring to a boil
12. Add pork balls
13. Cover
14. Reduce heat and simmer for 45 minutes
15. Push balls to one side and stir in sour cream
16. Carefully mix sauce and balls
17. Serve with noodles or rice , if desired and fresh herbs scattered to garnish

title: chicken and yoghurt curry
steps:
1. Place onion , ginger , crushed garlic and fresh coriander in blender
2. Blend as smooth as possible adding a small amount of water if necessary
3. Heat oil in large pan and fry the blended mixture on low heat for 2-3 minutes
4. Add turmeric , garam masala , salt and chili , fry for a further minute
5. Stir in yoghurt and tomato
6. Simmer for 5 minutes
7. Add chicken , turning to coat
8. Simmer gently for 40 minutes
9. Thicken if necessary
10. Serve with rice , and accompaniments

title: creamy mashed potato casserole
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients except topping mixture in a large bowl
2. Use an electric mixer to blend well
3. Spread into a casserole dish and top with sliced butter
4. Sprinkle paprika over top
5. Bake at 350f for 30 minutes

title: shape toast
steps:
1. Toast 2 pieces of bread
2. Put one on top of the other
3. Cut the desired shape out of the 2 pieces

title: lemon   ginger tofu
steps:
1. Cut tofu into slices of the size you desire
2. Mix together garlic , ginger , shallots , coriander powder , cumin , chilli paste , soy sauce , water , lemon juice , lemon rind , sugar , 1 tablespoon of the oil , and the salt in a dish to make a marinade
3. Stir it well
4. Place the tofu in the marinade , making sure each piece is well coated
5. Cover and leave in the refrigerator for at least 1 hour
6. Heat a frying pan to medium-hot and put the rest of the oil in it
7. Take the tofu out of the dish , letting excess marinade drip back into the dish
8. Do not discard the leftover marinade ! cook tofu in pan for 5 to 10 minutes , until nicely browned
9. When the tofu is cooked , put it aside and keep it warm
10. Turn the heat down to medium-low and pour the leftover marinade into it
11. Stir for a minute or two and add the coconut milk , turning the heat down to low as you do so
12. Bring to a boil , or until it reaches consistency you desire , and its all ready !
13. Place the tofu on the steamed rice and pour the sauce over it
14. Serve the steamed vegetables next to the rice , garnish with coriander leaves and enjoy !

title: yummu fruit smoothie
steps:
1. Toss all the ingredients into a blender and mix for about two minutes
2. You can also substitute any of the fruits for anything else you might like !

title: crockpot ham
steps:
1. Place ham into crockpot
2. Mix together all remaining ingredients
3. Pour over ham
4. Cook on high for first hour
5. Reduce heat to low for next five hours

title: excellent potato vegetable side dish
steps:
1. Cook green beans in boiling water for about 3 minutes
2. Drain beans and place in ice water
3. Set aside
4. Peel away the dry outer layers of skin from the head of garlic
5. Leave skins of cloves intact
6. Do not separate
7. Cut off pointed top portion exposing the tops of individual cloves
8. Place the head of garlic , cut side up , in a shallow roasting pan
9. Add green beans , potatoes , peppers , and onion
10. Sprinkle with salt and pepper
11. Drizzle with chicken broth
12. Roast vegetables in a 400 degree fahrenheit oven about 1 hour
13. Cool slightly
14. Remove roasted garlic
15. Press the paste from individual cloves into a separate bowl
16. Add vinegar , olive oil , and rosemary
17. Stir to combine
18. Transfer vegetables to a serving bowl

12. Brush each cake layer with 2 tablespoons amaretto
13. Combine butter and cream in medium saucepan
14. Stir over medium-low heat until butter melts and mixture comes to simmer
15. Remove from heat
16. Add remaining 2 cups chocolate chips and whisk until melted
17. Mix in remaining 3 tablespoons amaretto
18. Cool until barely lukewarm , about 5 minutes
19. Whisk in sour cream and remaining 1 / 4 teaspoon almond extract , then powdered sugar
20. Refrigerate frosting just until thick enough to spread , whisking occasionally , about 10 minutes
21. Place 1 cake layer on platter
22. Spread 1 / 3 cup frosting over
23. Top with second cake layer
24. Spread 1 / 3 cup frosting over
25. Top with third cake layer
26. Spread remaining frosting over top and sides of cake
27. Press nuts around the sides of the cake
28. Chill at leat 2 hours

title: potatoes in spicy cheese sauce   papa a la huancaina
steps:
1. For the sauce - remove seeds from yellow chile peppers and chop into 1 inch pieces
2. Saut the onion , garlic , and chile peppers in the oil until onion is softened , about 3-5 minutes
3. If using the tumeric option , add it now
4. Once onion is softened remove from heat and let cool
5. Place the onion-chile mixture in a food processor or blender , add the evaporated milk and blend
6. Next add the cheese and crackers and blend until smooth
7. The sauce should be fairly thick
8. If necessary thicken you can thicken the sauce with more saltines or thin the sauce with more
9. Season with salt and pepper to taste and serve at room temperature or chilled
10. For the potatoe dish - heat a large pot of salted water to boiling and add the potatoes
11. Boil the potatoes until tender , drain and let cool
12. Slice the potatoes and place on top of the lettuce leaves
13. Then pour the huancana sauce over the potatoes and garnish with slices of hard-boiled egg and black olive halves

title: chocolate whiskey layer cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Butter and flour 2 9-inch round cake pans
3. On ungreased baking sheet , bake pecans 6-8 minutes or until golden
4. Remove from pan
5. Cool completely , 10 minutes
6. Meanwhile , in bowl combine cake mix , buttermilk , oil , eggs , and whiskey
7. With mixer at low speed , beat until combined
8. Increase speed to medium
9. Beat 2 minutes
10. Stir in chocolate chips and cooled pecans
11. Divide batter between pans
12. Bake 30 minutes or until toothpick inserted into centers comes out clean
13. Cool on racks 5 minutes
14. Remove from pans
15. Cool completely on racks
16. Place 1 cake layer on serving platter
17. Spread with 1 cup frosting
18. Top with remaining layer
19. Spread top and sides with remaining frosting
20. Press pecan pieces onto side , if desired

title: kentucky mint julep cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees f
2. Grease and flour a 10-inch bundt pan
3. Whisk together flour , sugar , salt , baking powder , and baking soda in a large bowl
4. Make a well in the center
5. Add wet ingredients to flour mixture& beat at low speed for 1 minute , then increase to medium speed for 3 more minutes
6. Pour into prepared pan and smooth evenly around bundt center
7. Bake for about 50 minutes or until toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean
8. Ten minutes before cake should be done , prepare bourbon butter sauce
9. For the sauce , in a saucepan over medium heat , combine 1 / 2 cup confectioners' sugar , 1 / 3 cup butter , and 3 tablespoons water
10. Stir until melted and combined but do not boil
11. Remove from heat , continuing to stir for 2 minutes , then stir in bourbon
12. When cake is done and still warm from the oven , use a skewer to poke holes around the top of the cake and pour bourbon butter sauce evenly over the top of the cake
13. Let cake cool to room temperature in the pan before removing
14. For the frosting , melt chocolate chips with sweetened condensed milk in heavy saucepan over low heat , stirring constantly until chips are melted
15. Remove from heat and stir in creme de menthe liqueur
16. Let cool for 10 minutes , then spread evenly over the cooled cake
17. Garnish with fresh mint leaves
18. I am also using white chocolate curls
19. Chill to set chocolate ganache
20. Take cake out of the refrigerator 30 minutes before cutting to serve

title: crock pot minestrone soup
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients except pasta and cheese in a 4-5 quart crock pot
2. Cover crock pot and cook on low for 7 to 8 hours until vegetables are tender
3. Stir in pasta
4. Cover and cook on high setting for 15-25 minutes until pasta is tender
5. Sprinkle each serving with freshly grated parmesan cheese

title: nalgene lemon refresher
steps:
1. Microwave the lemon for 15 seconds , take out and roll on the counter pushing down with a medium amount of pressure , microwave for an additional 20 seconds
2. Slice lemon in half and sqeeze as much juice as you want into the bottom of your nalgene bottle
3. We like the juice of a whole lemon in each 32 ounces but you might like more or less
4. Open and empty the sweet-n-low into the bottom of the nalgene
5. Fill to the top with ice
6. Pour water over top and close nalgene , shake for about 20 seconds to combine
7. Enjoy ! :)

title: sneaky chef parmesan mashed potatoes
steps:
1. Place the potatoes in a large pot of cold , salted water and bring to a boil
2. Lower the heat , cover , and simmer for 25 to 35 minutes , until the potatoes are completely tender
3. Drain the potatoes into a colander , then return them to the pot
4. Add the parmesan , the white puree , the yogurt , margarine , salt , and pepper
5. Mash with a potato masher until well combined
6. Add a bit more margaine , if needed
7. Garnish with the chives , if using
8. Serve immediately , or keep the mashed potatoes hot on the stovetop in a metal bowl set over simmering water

title: roasted red pepper pasta
steps:
1. Place first five ingredients in food processor
2. Pulse 15-20 seconds or until mixture is smooth
3. Place hot pasta in serving bowl and toss with red pepper mixture , and pine nuts
4. Top with shredded parmesan
5. Enjoy !

title: raw pad thai
steps:
1. Combine the dressing ingredients in a glass jar with lid and shake
2. Prepare all salad ingredients and toss in a salad bowl
3. Pour dressing over salad and coat well

title: crock pot pork with sauerkraut  apple   potato
steps:
1. Place the cut apple and potato on the bottom of the crock pot
2. Pour in the apple juice
3. Add pork
4. Cover with the kraut
5. Sprinkle in the caraway seeds
6. Smear mustard on top
7. Cook on low 5 hours

title: the ultimate spaghetti carbonara
steps:
1. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil for the spaghetti
2. Heat a 3-count of olive oil in a skillet over medium heat
3. Add the bacon and onion and cook for 7-8 minutes , until the onion is caramelized and the bacon is crisp
4. While cooking the onion and bacon , crack the eggs into a big serving bowl
5. Add the cream and cheese and whisk
6. Scrape the bacon and onion into the bowl along with the cooking fat
7. Before draining pasta , scoop out 1 / 4 cup of the pasta cooking water and add it to the bowl with the bacon and eggs
8. Drain the spaghetti and add it to the bowl - toss well
9. Place a plate on top of the bowl to hold in the heat and let sit 5 minutes
10. Remove the plate , toss in some salt and cracked black pepper and the parsley

title: crock pot chicken parmesan
steps:
1. Place chicken , milk , and butter in crock pot and cook on low 5-6 hours
2. When chicken in cooked through , remove from crock pot and add cornstarch and parmesan cheese to juices in crock pot and stir until thickened
3. Spread cheese mixture on chicken , sprinkle with parsley , and serve

title: peta s pancakes
steps:
1. Combine the flour , sugar , baking powder , and salt in a bowl and mix thoroughly
2. Mix in the soy milk and oil , and , with an electric mixer or wire whisk , beat just until the batter is smooth
3. Measure 1 / 3 cup batter onto a hot , oiled griddle
4. When bubbles appear on the upper surface of the pancake , lift with a spatula and flip the pancake
5. Cook the pancake for another 2 minutes
6. Remove from the pan and keep warm while you make the remaining pancakes
7. Serve warm with maple syrup or fruit syrup

title: kumquat s savory rice and cheese bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Cook rice in 2 quart pot according to instructions , except substitute vegetable broth for water and omit salt and / or butter
3. Meanwhile , chop onions and mince garlic and then melt butter in non-stick skillet
4. Add onion and saute for about 5 minutes
5. Add garlic and saute for about 2 more minutes
6. Remove from heat
7. Add basil , thyme , oregano , black pepper and soy sauce to onion mixture
8. When rice is done , add onion and spice mixture to pot and mix
9. Add 1 / 4 cup or more wine and fluff with fork
10. Place rice in 2 quart casserole sprayed with non-stick cooking oil and sprinkle with shredded cheese
11. Bake uncovered for 20-30 minutes or until cheese is melted

title: spicy cranberry chutney
steps:
1. 1
2. Combine all ingredients in a large saucepan
3. Bring to a boil over high heat
4. Simmer , uncovered , stirring often , until the cranberries have broken down and the mixture has thickened somewhat , 10 to 15 minutes
5. 2
6. Let cool completely
7. Ladle the chutney into clean jars and refrigerate
8. 1
9. Refrigerate chutney in an airtight container for up to 1 month
10. To can it for pantry storage
11. 2
12. Put it in boiling bath water for 10 minutes
13. Cool and store

title: chicken tagine with green olives   preserved lemon
steps:
1. In a medium-sized tagine or dutch oven , arrange chicken thighs in a single layer
2. Sprinkle the onion , cilantro , parsley , garlic , cumin , ginger , paprika , teaspoon of the pepper , and saffron over the chicken
3. Add 2 cups of water and cover
