4. If using a tagine , set it on a flame-tamer over medium heat
5. If using a dutch oven , set it over medium-high heat
6. Bring to a boil
7. Reduce heat and simmer gently for 30 minutes
8. Meanwhile , pit each olive by placing on a cutting board and smashing firmly with the flat side of a heavy knife
9. Discard pit
10. Add the olives , preserved lemon , and lemon juice to the tagine and cook 20 minutes more , until the chicken meat is falling off the bones
11. Season with salt and pepper to taste

title: crock pot meatball stroganoff
steps:
1. Dump the meatballs in the crock pot
2. Add the jar of gravy and mix it to cover all
3. Cook on low for 8 hours
4. Stir in the sour cream and warm through about 30 minutes before serving
5. Serve over noodles , rice or mashed potatoes

title: hash browns stroganoff pie
steps:
1. Combine the egg , potatoes and sour cream
2. Press into a greased 8 inch pie plate
3. Bake at 350f for 15 minutes
4. In a large skillet , brown the beef
5. Add the optional cajun spice when cooked about half way
6. Continue to brown beef until it's just finished cooking and drain off excess fat
7. Add the onion and celery to the meat and saute until the onions are transparent
8. Remove from heat
9. Add the soup , sour cream , salt & pepper
10. Mix well
11. Spread beef mixture into hash brown shell and top with grated cheese
12. Bake at 350f for 30 minutes
13. Let sit for 5 minutes after removing from oven before serving

title: rice n peach salad
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients in large bowl
2. Refrigerate until ready to serve

title: banana mango smoothieeeeeeeee
steps:
1. Put all ingredients into blender
2. Blend until smoothie consistency is reached !
3. If drink is too thick , add more orange juice

title: columbian gold
steps:
1. Make 1 cup of strong coffee , keep warm
2. In a small pot add half and half cream with chocolate and coffee liquers
3. Heat on low about 3 minutes , whisking constantly to blend flavours
4. Pour cinnamon liquer and white sugar onto small plates
5. Rim your glass first in cinnamon liquer and then dip your glass into the white sugar to coat rim evenly
6. Reserving any left over liquer and sugar for garnishing
7. Add warm liquer mixture to coffee and stir
8. Pour the coffee & liquer mixture into the prepared glass and top with whipped cream
9. Slowly drizzle the reserved cinnamon liquer over the whipped cream and then sprinkle with sugar and chocolate flakes

title: dessert crepes with strawberry cream filling
steps:
1. To make strawberry cream: combine the strawberries and sugar and chill , anywhere from an hour to overnight
2. Drain excess water from strawberries and sugar
3. In mixing bowl blend cream cheese and powdered sugar until smooth
4. Stir in reserved strawberries
5. To make dessert crepes: beat eggs
6. Add remaining ingredients
7. Heat pan over med-high heat
8. When a few drops of water sprinkled on the pan bounces is about the right temperature
9. Pour about 1 / 8 c of batter into pan , tilting to spread evenly
10. When the crepe has turned a light brown color you may or may not want to turn to brown other side
11. Turn to brown other side if batter has not set
12. Fill crepes with strawberry cream
13. May serve immedietly or chills well in the refrigerator
14. Before serving i usually sprinkle a little extra powdered sugar on the crepes
15. The dessert crepe receipe will also work well with many other fillings

title: vegan peanut butter rice krispies squares
steps:
1. Grease a tray about 9x13 inches
2. Also grease the spoon you'll use for mixing and something like a cake slice
3. Pour sugar and syrup into a large pan and bring to a boil
4. Remove from heat and add crunchy peanut butter mixing well
5. Add 6 cups of rice krispies cereal , mixing till coated
6. Using the spoon pour out the mix into the greased tray
7. With the cake slice press the mixture down
8. Allow to stand till squares firm up then cut into even squares
9. I usually use a large pizza cutter but any good knife should do
10. They should last about 2 weeks

title: big star meatloaf
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325f
2. In large bowl , mix steak sauce , ground beef , garlic , thyme , worcestershire sauce , eggs , and steak seasoning until well blended
3. Then , add bread crumbs and mix until incorporated
4. Place in a 9 x 13-inch casserole dish and shape into a loaf
5. Add water to pan to come up to 1 / 4-inch of the meat loaf
6. Bake for 50 minutes or until done

title: cranberry oatmeal bar cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees , rack in the middle position
2. Melt butter in a large microwave safe bowl
3. Add both sugars and let cool a bit
4. Add eggs , baking powder , baking soda , salt , cinnamon , nutmeg , and vanilla
5. Add flour and mix
6. Add the cranberries and oats and mix everything up
7. The dough will be quite stiff
8. With a spatula spread dough evenly into a greased 8x8 baking pan
9. Bake at 350 for 25 30 minutes
10. Cut into bars when cool
11. These freeze well if you roll them in foil and put them in a freezer bag

title: summer berry jam  no pectin
steps:
1. Place the mixed berries and minced apple into a bowl
2. Mash with a potatop masher
3. The apple will help to thicken the mixture without the use of pectin
4. Place berry mixture into a heavy pot on medium high heat and stir
5. Add honey , sugar , and cinnamon to the berry mixture
6. Stir frequently
7. Cook on medium high heat for approximately 45 minutes until desired consistency is reached
8. Towards the end of the cooking time , stir in the lemon juice
9. Add the jam to your sterilized jam jars and enjoy !

title: rainbow squares
steps:
1. Mix base with pastry blender and press into 9x9 pan
2. Bake 15 minutes@ 350
3. Cook topping ingredients on stove until thickened
4. Pour over base mixture
5. Beat 2 egg whites with 4 tbsps
6. Sugar until stiff peaks form
7. Pour over top and put in oven to brown

title: princess flavored water
steps:
1. Add all ingredients in a gallon pitcher or jug
2. Mix well
3. Chill

title: pumpkin raisin cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f mix flour , sugar , baking powder , baking soda , salt , cinnamon , and nutmeg together in a large bowl
2. Add pumpkin , milk , and raisins
3. Mix completely
4. Drop by tablespoonfuls onto an oil-sprayed baking sheet
5. Bake 15 minutes , until bottoms are lightly browned
6. Remove from oven and let stand 2 minutes
7. Carefully remove from baking sheet with a spatula and place on a rack to cool

title: thai red rubies
steps:
1. For sugar syrup ---------------
2. Dissolve sugar in water by bringing it to a boil
3. This takes about 1 minute
4. Then remove and chill in the fridge
5. For the water chestnuts -------
6. Peel the skin from the water chestnuts
7. Diced them into small cubes about 3 to 5 by 3 to 5mm
8. Mix the diced water chestnuts with red food colouring
9. Add the diced water chestnuts into a plastic bag of tapioca flour and shake well to cover them with flour
10. Pour the water chestnuts from the bag into a sieve
11. Sieve away the excess flour
12. Boil water in a saucepan
13. Pour the water chestnuts into the boiling water and simmer for just 2 minute
14. Remove and drain the water chestnuts
15. Allow it to cool in iced water
16. For serving --------------------
17. Combine the sugar syrup , coconut milk and rose or jasmine essence
18. Scoop a couple of spoonfuls of the water chestnuts into each dessert serving glass bowl and fill it with coconut milk mixture
19. Add some ice cubes into the bowl and serve immediately

title: elly may s wedding punch
steps:
1. Dissolve the gelatin in the boiling water in a large saucepan
2. In a separate saucepan boil together the sugar and 4 cups water
3. Add the pineapple juice , orange juice and lemon juice
4. Cool
5. Combine the gelatin and juice mixtures
6. Pour into plastic containers and freeze
7. Set out about 3 hours before serving
8. Add the ginger ale just before serving
9. The punch will be slushy

title: bar b qued moose
steps:
1. Five easy steps:
2. Make sure moose is dead
3. Put moose on skewer or ina a very , very , very large skillet
4. Cook over medium-high heat until done , about 9 days , basting occasionally with all the other stuff mixed together -- 'cept the beer
5. Drink the beer
6. Serve the moose with potatoes anna and a asparagus souffle

title: spinach won tons
steps:
1. Wash the spinach thoroughly and trim any tough stems or bad spots on the leaves
2. Drain the spinach and pat dry with a paper towel
3. Coarsely chop the spinach
4. Assemble all of your prepared ingredients beforehand as the cooking is quick
5. Place a wok or large skillet over medium-high heat
6. When the pan or wok gets smoking hot , add the peanut oil with the garlic and onion
7. Stir fry the onion and garlic for 30 seconds , the add the spinach and water chestnuts
8. Continue to cook an additional 3 minutes , allowing the water from the spinach to cook off
9. Transfer the vegetables from the wok or pan to a bowl
10. Season with salt and pepper to taste
11. Allow the spinach to cool for 5 minutes
12. To form the wontons , pull one wonton from the package an moisten the edges with water
13. Place a scant teaspoon of the spinach mixture in the center of the wonton
14. Fold the wonton over into a triangle
15. Now , fold the long corners together and give them a wee pinch to hold together
16. Cover the completed wontons with plastic wrap to prevent the wrappers from drying out
17. There are several options on how to cook prepared wontons
18. You can simmer them in some vegetable or chicken broth for a good soup
19. Add some nice veggies to make this a soup entree
20. You can also steam them and serve with a soy dipping sauce
21. You can also deep fry them in oil , also serving them with dipping sauce
22. Prepared won-tons can be frozen by placing single-layer them on a cooking sheet
23. Once frozen , transfer them to a resealable bag and you can take out what you need

title: perfectly easy pork   mushrooms
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Season pork while heating oil over medium high heat
3. Quickly brown pork on all sides and remove to a roasting pan
4. Deglaze skillet with 1 / 4 cup water and pour over pork
5. Make hunter gravy in skillet according to package directions
6. Pour over pork
7. Cover and bake 45 minutes
8. While pork bakes , saute mushrooms in butter and garlic over medium low heat for 10-15 minutes until nicely brown
9. After initial 45 minutes baking time , stir in mushrooms and continue baking uncovered for 15 minutes
10. Slice pork into medallions and fan over rice pilaf or egg noodles
11. Spoon sauce over and pass the extra

title: hamantashen
steps:
1. Place rack in upper third of oven
2. Preheat to 350f line baking sheets with parchment paper , or grease them
3. Sift flour , baking powder and salt
4. In a mixing bowl with electric mixer , cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy , about 2 minutes
5. Add egg and mix 1 minute
6. Mix in orange juice , vanilla and almond extracts
7. Add flour mixture and mix until incorporated
8. Shape into a flat disk , wrap in plastic and refrigerate until firm enough to roll out , at least 15 minutes
9. Divide the dough in half
10. It will be very sticky
11. Cover 1 portion with plastic wrap and refrigerate
12. Place other half between sheets of floured wax paper and roll to 1 / 8 inch thick
13. Use a 3-inch circle cookie cutter or biscuit cutter , cut circles
14. Using a floured spatula , pick up circles and place on prepared baking sheets
15. Spoon 1 1 / 2 teaspoons filling in the center of each circle
16. Press three edges together to make a triangle , leaving an opening in the center with the filling showing
17. Place 1 1 / 2 inches apart on baking sheets
18. Repeat with remaining dough , rerolling scraps and cutting out as many circles as possible
19. Bake for 15-18 minutes , or until golden on the bottom
20. If baking more than one sheet in the oven at a time , rotate baking sheet positions after 7 minutes
21. Cool 5 minutes and remove to racks to finish cooling
22. May be stored , airtight , for several days

title: beef burgundy  simple
steps:
1. Cut the steak into strips
2. Place beef in bowl and add wine
3. Let marinate while you prepare vegetables
4. Slice mushrooms
5. Cut green onions into 1" lenghths
6. In large skillet , melt 2 tbsp butter until hot
7. Add garlic , mushrooms and green onions and stir fry until limp
8. 5 min
9. Scoop vegetables out and place juices in bowl and set aside
10. Place the flour , salt and pepper in a bag
11. Place beef in it
12. Coat
13. Wipe the skillet dry
14. Add remaining butter and melt
15. Add beef and brown
16. Add vegetables and any liquid , marinade , the broth and tarragon
17. Bring to a boil and simmer until sauce thickens

title: super simple smoked salmon crostini
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400f place the baguette slices on a baking sheet and brush both sides of the bread with the oil
2. Bake until golden brown , 4 to 5 minutes per side
3. In a small bowl , combine the cream cheese , horseradish , and 1 tablespoon dill
4. Season with teaspoon each salt and pepper
5. Dividing evenly , spread the cream cheese mixture on the toasted baguette slices
6. Top with the salmon and sprinkle with the remaining tablespoon of dill

title: easy lasagna rolls
steps:
1. Mix cottage cheese , 1-1 / 2 cup mozzarella and parmesan cheese with eggs and parsley
2. Place one lasagna noodle on work surface
3. Spread 1 / 3 cup cheese mixture on noodle evenly
4. Roll up tightly like a pinwheel
5. Place seamside down in microwave-safe baking pan , that has 2 cup of spaghetti sauce in bottom
6. Continue until with remaining ingredients
7. Cover rolls with remaining sauce and sprinkle with additional mozzarella cheese
8. Cover with microwave-safe wrap and microcook on high 10-20 minutes , until cheese is melted

title: creamy carrot soup with star anise
steps:
1. In large stock pot over medium heat melt the butter
2. Add chopped onion , 3 star anise , bay leaves and garlic
3. Saute until the onion starts to soften and glisten , about 5 minutes
4. Add the carrots and fresh stock
5. Cover , bring to boil and simmer until carrots are very tender , approximately 30 minutes
6. Remove star anise and bay leaves
7. Using an immersion blender puree the soup until very smooth
8. Season with salt and pepper to taste
9. Take the remaining star anise and grind to a fine powder
10. Stir a little into the soup
11. Adjust seasoning and add more star anise to taste
12. Stir in the fresh minced chives
13. Serve hot

title: meatballs and sauce
steps:
1. Mix hamburger and other ingredients together
2. Make into meatballs
3. Pour sauce over the top
4. I use a slow cooker but can be done in the oven
5. If using the oven set at 350 degrees

title: raspberries creme pie
steps:
1. In saucepan combine cream , sugar and gelatin
2. Heat stirring constantly until sugar and gelatin are completely dissolved
3. Stir in vanilla
4. Cool stirring occasionally to prevent skin from forming
5. Cover and chill until slightly thickened
6. Fold in sour cream until throughly blended
7. Gently fold in 1 1 / 2 cup raspberries
8. Pour into prepared pie shell , garnish with remaining raspberries
9. Chill several hours or over night

title: vegetarian lasagna for veggie haters
steps:
1. I usually put the cottage cheese in my electric chopper to mimic the texture of ricotta
2. I also use the 4% minimum fat kind
3. Saute onion and garlic in olive oil and salt for 5 minutes
4. Add mushrooms , and saute with the onions until cooked
5. I chop up the mushrooms in the pan with a spatula , to make them small
6. Don't drain the liquid
7. Meanwhile , soak the tvp in boiling water to soften , then drain
8. Add the tvp , and mix together
9. Add the sauce , and mix
10. Ladle some sauce onto the bottom of the crockpot
11. Make a double layer of noodles on the sauce--break those suckers up to fit
12. Spread the cheeses over the noodles
13. Sauce , then noodles , then cheese , until layers are done
14. I usually finish with a layer of mozzarella
15. Cook on low for 4-5 hours

title: sara s pumpkin soup
steps:
1. Place all ingredients nto a large soup pot
2. Bring to the boil , reduce heat to simmer
3. When vegetables are tender , blend with a stick blender until smooth
4. Serve with sour cream , and chives

title: quark  german cheese
steps:
1. You will need a saucepan , a bowl , a sieve , and a scalded cloth to line sieve
2. If using yogurt , bring the milk to a boil and then leave it to cool to finger temperature
3. Mix the milk with the yogurt in a basin
4. Put in a warm place for 4 to 5 hours to set as solid as yogurt
5. If using vinegar or lemon juice , stir into the milk and bring it to a near boil in a bowl set in a saucepan of water
6. Remove and keep in a warm place for 4 to 5 hours
7. Pour the mixture into a sieve lined with a scalded clean cloth
8. After an hour put a plate on top to weight and encourage the whey to drip through
9. The curds in the cloth are the cheese
10. Cover and store the quark in a cool pantry , and it will keep for about a week
11. You can use the whey , flavored with fruit juice , as a beverage- or use it to make scones
12. Store the whey in refrigerator and use within 2 days

title: saffron fruit cake
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 180c / 350f and grease a square cake pan , lining the bottom with greaseproof paper
2. In a pestle and mortar , grind the saffron with some of the sugar , alternatively , soak in 2tbsp of boiling hot water
3. Bring the dried fruit to the boil in a pan of water , once boiling point is reached , turn off the heat and drain the fruit well using a sieve
4. Return to the pan and add the butter until it has melted perhaps over a low heat if necessary
5. Add the saffron sugar and eggs and mix thoroughly then sift in the flour , salt and baking powder
6. Mix well but do not over work the mixture then pour into the cake pan
7. Bake for 30mins or until browned on top , then reduce heat to 160c / 300f , cover with foil and bake for a further 20 minutes
8. Allow to cool for 15 minutes before turning out to cool completely on a wire rack
9. Now thats special

title: hot gingered cocoa
steps:
1. Grab a large mug and add sugar , cocoa and salt
2. Heat the milk and cream in a pot on the stove for 10 minutes on low , until desired temperature is reached
3. Add 1 / 8 cup of the heated milk to the cocoa in your mug and blend into a smooth paste
4. Slowly add the rest of the heated milk
5. Stirring briskly add the vanilla and ginger to your cocoa
6. Top with whipped cream and garnish with a sprinkle of cocoa powder
7. Sooo good

title: little feta and chickpea fritters with herb salad
steps:
1. Process chickpeas , cumin and egg in a food processor until almost smooth
2. Transfer to a small bowl and stir in remaining ingredients ,
3. Then season to taste with sea salt and freshly ground black pepper
4. Form level tablespoonfuls of mixture into 4cm rounds ,
5. Then shallow-fry fritters , in batches , in hot olive oil for 2-3 minutes on each side or until golden
6. Drain on absorbent paper
7. Makes about 24 fritters
8. For herb salad , combine herbs and peas in a bowl ,
9. Drizzle with oil and vinegar ,
10. Season to taste and toss gently to combine
11. Divide lettuce leaves among plates and top with warm fritters and herb salad
12. Serve immediately

title: portabella mushroom stir fry
steps:
1. In a large skillet , cook chopped onion and red pepper strips in hot cooking oil for 2 minutes
2. Add sliced mushrooms and stir-fry over medium-high heat for 2 to 3 minutes or until vegetables are tender
3. Stir in balsamic vinegar , soy sauce , and worcestershire sauce
4. Cook and stir for 1 to 2 mintues or until most of the liquid is absorbed
5. Serve over hot cooked brown rice

title: asian sesame cucumber salad
steps:
1. Peel and seed cucumbers and cut on the diagonal into thin slices
2. Toss the cucumber pieces with kosher salt , transfer to a colander , and let drain for 1 hour
3. Toast white sesame seeds in a dry skillet until theyre golden brown
4. Whisk together rice wine vinegar , toasted sesame oil , sugar , and crushed red pepper flakes
5. Rinse the cucumber slices thoroughly under cold running water and pat dry with paper towels
6. Toss the cucumbers with the dressing and toasted sesame seeds and serve

title: abm banana yeast bread
steps:
1. Layer ingredients in machine in the order listed or as per your machines instructions
2. Set to 1
3. 5 lb loaf and press start
4. Towards the end of the mix cycle your dough ball should move freely in the machine without sticking to the sides and should pick up all the loose ingredients
5. One your dough ball looks fine you can let the machine do the rest of the work for you

title: low fat lemon herb roasted chicken
steps:
1. Mix first four ingredients
2. Gently loosen skin of the chicken without removing it
3. Under the skin of each breast , rub the berb mixture and tuck in two pieces of orange
4. Place chicken in an oven proof glass dish
5. Pour the juice or win over it and allow to marinate for 20 minutes in the refrigerator
6. Roast the chicken at 400 degrees for 15 minutes , skin side down
7. Turn over and continue roasting for another 15 minutes
8. Let set for a few minutes before serving

title: emeril s shredded chicken nachos
steps:
1. In a 3-quart saucepan with lid heat the oil to the pan to medium-high
2. Season the chicken pieces with the chili powder and salt and toss the evenly coat
3. Add the chicken to the pan and sear for 3 minutes per side
4. Add the onions to the pan and saut for another 3 minutes
5. Add the garlic to the pan and saut for 1 minute
6. Pour the chicken stock over the chicken and bring to a boil
7. Reduce to a low heat and cover
8. Continue to cook the chicken until very tender , about 1 hour
9. Stir the chicken to shred it and continue to cook , covered , for another 30 minutes
10. Once the chicken is cooked , stir and mash to shred the chicken meat and add the lime juice to the chicken
11. Set aside as you prepare the nachos
12. In a medium saucepan , melt the butter over medium-high heat and whisk in the flour
13. Cook , stirring constantly , for 2 to 3 minutes , but do not allow the flour to color
14. While whisking constantly , add the milk in a steady stream
15. Add the green chilies and bring the sauce to a boil
16. Cook , stirring frequently , for about 5 minutes , or until the sauce is thickened and bubbly
17. Add the cheddar , salt , and cayenne pepper and stir until the cheese is melted and the sauce is smooth
18. Cover and remove from the heat
19. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f
20. In a large , ovenproof shallow casserole , spread half of the tortilla chips in an even layer
21. Top with half of the chicken , and half of the monterey jack cheese
22. Top with the remaining tortilla chips and chicken
23. Pour the hot cheese sauce over the chicken , then evenly spread the remaining grated monterey jack over the top
24. Bake until the cheese is melted and bubbly and the nachos are heated through , 8 to 10 minutes
25. Garnish with the sliced green onions , sour cream , pickled jalapeos and cilantro

title: couscous with dried apricots and pistachios  vegan
steps:
1. Combine broth , olive oil and salt in medium size saucepan
2. Bring to boil
3. Combine the couscous , dried apricots and spices in a large serving bowl
4. Add the boiling water
5. Cover immediately and let stand until the water is absorbed
6. Approximately 5 minutes
7. Uncover couscous and fluff with fork
8. Cool
9. Bring salad to room temperature and stir in the pistachios , green onions and basil ribbons
10. Season with salt and pepper to taste

title: mushroom soup smothered chicken breasts
steps:
1. Brown chicken breasts on both sides in olive oil in large skillet , but don't fully cook
2. Remove when done
3. In same skillet , cook garlic , mushrooms and red onion in olive oil till tender
4. Add cream of mushroom soup , water , salt , pepper , basil and cayenne
5. Stir till mixed
6. Add chicken breasts to skillet , spoon sauce over chicken
7. Cover skillet
8. Bring to simmer
9. Cook until chicken is done--time will vary depending on size of chicken breasts
10. Serve chicken with sauce
11. Sauce is good on stuffing and mashed potatoes

title: whirlaways
steps:
1. Prheat oven to 350 degrees in a large bowl cream together confectioners sugar , and butter until fluffy and smooth
2. Add vanilla extract and blend in well
3. Alternate flour and oats , adding a little at a time until well mixed
4. Roll dough into log
5. Then roll into sprinkles
6. Slice and bake on a cookie sheet that has been lightly sprayed with cooking spray
7. Bake for 15 minutes

title: tangerine tea
steps:
1. Heat water to boiling in large saucepan
2. Stir in tangerine juice , sugar , cinnamon and cloves
3. Heat to boiling
4. Simmer and stir until sugar dissolves
5. Remove from heat and add tea bags
6. Let steep 3 to 4 minutes
7. Serve immediately

title: dutch crumb cake
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f
2. Grease an 8"x8" pan
3. Sift together the flour , salt , and baking soda
4. Cream the shortening , then gradually add the brown sugar and cream until light and fluffy
5. Gradually add the flour , salt , and baking soda mixture
6. Remove 3 / 4 cup of the dry mixture and set aside
7. Combine the raisins , egg , and milk
8. Add to the main mixture and beat well
9. Pour into the pan
10. Drizzle the reserved 3 / 4 cup over the batter already in the pan
11. Sprinkle the cinnamon and sugar over the top of the batter
12. Bake for 25 minutes

title: mexican hot   chocolate
steps:
1. In a medium sized saucepan , heat the milk over medium heat until scalding , but not boiling
2. Break the chocolate into pieces
3. Add to the hot milk along with the cinnamon , sugar and salt
4. Stir until melted
5. Beat with a wire whisk until frothy
6. Add the vanilla
7. Continue to whisk
8. Pour into 4 mugs
9. Garnish with a cinnamon stick

title: bacon and sun dried tomato alfredo pasta  ww recipe
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to package directions
2. Omitting salt and oil
3. Drain pasta and keep warm
4. While pasta cooks , combine alfredo sauce and sun-dried tomatoes in sauce pan
5. Cook over low heat stirring occasionally
6. 6-8 minutes or until thoroughly heated and tomatoes are juicy and plump
7. While sauce cooks , microwave bacon according to package directions
8. Crumble bacon and set aside
9. Combine cooked pasta and alfredo sauce in a large bowl
10. Top with bacon , basil and black pepper

title: orange ginger carrots
steps:
1. In a large sauce pan cook the carrots , covered in a small amount of boiling water for 3 to 5 minutes or until crisp-tender
2. Drain well
3. Meanwhile , in a small bowl stir together the orange juice , honey , and ginger
4. Drizzle over warm carrots
5. Toss to coat
6. To serve , sprinkle with parsley and , if desired , orange peel

title: asian noodle bowl
steps:
1. Cook spaghetti according to package directions , drain and rinse
2. Heat a large nonstick skillet over medium-high hear
3. Add oil and saute garlic and chili powder until golden , about 1 minute
4. Add water and vegetables
5. Cook until vegetables are tender-crisp , about 3 minutes
6. Add the bbq sauce and peanut butter , stir until sauce is smooth
7. Toss sauce and vegetables with spaghetti and garnish with chopped peanuts

title: mango pineapple sorbet
steps:
1. Peel the mango and cut the flesh away from the pit
2. Cut the flesh into chunks and put them in a blender with the chopped pineapple , sugar , water , lime juice , rum and salt
3. Squeeze the mango pit hard over the blender to extract as much of the pulp and juice as possible
4. Puree the mixture until smooth
5. Taste , then add more lime juice or rum if desired
6. Chill the mixture thoroughly
7. Freeze it in your ice cream maker according to manufacturer's instructions

title: super pork burgers
steps:
1. Drain pineapple and reserve the juice
2. Coarsely chop ham
3. Place ham in food processor bowl , process about 30 seconds or until coarsely ground
4. In mixing bowl , combine pineapple , ground ham , ground pork , green pepper
5. Flour and allspice
6. Mix well
7. Shape into six inch thick patties
8. Place patties on unheated rack in broiler pan
9. Broil about 6 inches from heat about 8 minutes
10. Meanwhile , in small saucepan cook pineapple juice over medium heat until reduced by half
11. Brush patties with half of pineapple juice , turn and broil 6 minutes longer
12. Brush patties with remaining pineapple juice

title: chinese beef with veggies and cashews
steps:
1. In a skillet , brown beef , and stir well breaking up meat
2. In a large bowl , combine onion , bell pepper , celery , rice , soysauce , tabasco , salt , chinese veggies , mushrooms , and cashew nuts
3. In a saucepan , combine soup , water , and beef bouillon , and heat just enough to mix well
4. Combine beef and soup mixture with onion-vegetable mixture
5. Pour into greased 9x13 inch baking dish
6. Cover and bake at 350 degrees for 50 minutes
7. Remove from oven and sprinkle noodles over casserole
8. Bake uncovered for 20 minutes

title: baked ziti with vegetables and mushrooms
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
3. Add onion and bell peppers , and saut 5 minutes
4. Add mushrooms and garlic
5. Saut 2 minutes
6. Stir in basil , salt , black pepper , tomatoes , and tomato sauce , and bring to a boil
7. Reduce heat
8. Simmer 5 minutes or until slightly thick
9. Stir in spinach
10. Cook 1 minute or until spinach wilts
11. Stir in pasta
12. Spoon into a 13 x 9-inch baking dish coated with cooking spray
13. Dollop with ricotta
14. Cover and bake at 375 for 20 minutes
15. Uncover
16. Sprinkle with parmesan
17. Bake an additional 5 minutes or until lightly browned
18. Cover and refrigerate overnight
19. Let stand 30 minutes at room temperature , and bake as directed

title: lemon roast potatoes
steps:
1. Peel and quarter potatoes
2. Place in roaster , in one layer
3. Whisk together chicken stock , olive oil , lemon juice , dry mustard , salt and pepper
4. Taste and adjust
5. Pour mixture over potatoes
6. Bake in a slow oven at 300-350f for 2-3 hours , uncovered , 'til fork tender

title: fresh greek pasta salad
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to package directions
2. Drain in a colander
3. Rinse with cold water
4. Drain again
5. In a large bowl toss together the cooked pasta , tomatoes , cucumber , green onions , and olive
6. In a screw-top jar combine the olive oil , lemon juice , basil , the 2 tablespoons oregano , anchovy paste , garlic , salt , and pepper
7. Cover and shake well
8. Drizzle over past mixture
9. Toss to coat
10. Cover and chill in refrigerator for as least 2 hours or up to 24 hours
11. To serve , add feta cheese
12. Toss
13. Sprinkle fresh oregano leaves

title: whipped topping substitute
steps:
1. Chill bowl and beaters of electric mixer in freezer for 30 minutes
2. In chilled mixing bowl , combine powdered milk , ice water , sugar , lemon juice and vanilla extract
3. Beat on high speed until peaks form

title: cream of caramelized onion and mushroom soup
steps:
1. Melt 1 tablespoon butter with 1 / 2 tablespoon olive oil in saucepan over medium heat
2. Add onions and saute , stirring every few minutes , until they are caramelized , about 15-20 minutes
3. Add the mushrooms , celery , carrot , garlic and salt , and saute , stirring occasionally , for a further 5 minutes
4. Add chicken stock , thyme and bay leaf to saucepan
5. Reduce temperature to a slow boil and cook , covered , for 15-20 minutes longer , or until vegetables are tender
6. Remove from heat
7. Discard bay leaf
8. Blend soup in batches , either in blender , or using immersion blender , until soup is mostly pureed , leaving a bit of texture in the vegetables
9. Return to saucepan and over a low heat , whisk in half and half , ricotta and swiss cheeses , until cheeses have entirely melted into the soup
10. Season to suit your taste with salt and freshly-cracked black pepper
11. Serve in deep bowls , garnished with a sprinkle of minced , fresh parsley

title: lobster tagliatelle with chili  tomato and parsley
steps:
1. Remove the lobster flesh from its shells
2. Chop into 3 / 4in chunks and set aside
3. Place a large saut pan over a medium heat
4. Add the olive oil , garlic and chili then cook for 2 minutes to infuse the oil with the flavours
5. Add the white wine and cook until reduced by about half
6. Then add the stock and continue to cook until the liquid has reduced by half
7. Place the pasta into the pan of boiling water and cook according to pack instructions
8. Remove and discard the garlic cloves and chili from the sauce
9. Toss the lobster flesh into the sauce with the creme fraiche
10. Cook for 2 minutes until the lobster is hot
11. Add the drained pasta and parsley , toss to combine and season

title: the best jell o salad ever    strawberry jello salad with banana
steps:
1. Prepare the jello as directed on box in large bowl the night before so it is set & hardened for recipe
2. Then , whisk jello in its bowl and add to large bowl that you will serve the dessert in
3. Fold in the bananas , cherries , & whipped cream until all combined
4. Refrigerate until thick or ready to serve

title: cinnamon coffee pecans
steps:
1. Spread pecans in an ungreased roasting pan or 15x10-inch jelly roll pan
2. Bake at 350 for 10 minutes , stirring after 5 minutes
3. Combine sugar and remaining 4 ingredients in a saucepan
4. Cook over medium-low heat until sugar and coffee dissolve , stirring often
5. Add pecans , and cook 3 minutes , stirring constantly
6. Remove from heat
7. Spread pecans in ungreased pan
8. Bake at 300 for 15 minutes , stirring every 5 minutes
9. Cool completely
10. Store in an airtight container

title: potato saffron omelet
steps:
1. Dissolve saffron in heated broth
2. Let steep at least 5 minutes
3. Cook potatoes in boiling , salted water 8 minutes
4. Drain
5. In 12" non-stick skillet , saut onions in 2 tbs oil over medium heat , stirring occasionally , until golden
6. Stir in potatoes to coat
7. Transfer to a bowl
8. In a large bowl whisk together eggs through pepper
9. Whisk in saffron broth
10. Stir into onion and potato mixture
11. In skillet over medium-high heat , heat 3 tbs oil until hot but not smoking and add egg mixture , spreading potatoes evenly
12. Reduce heat to medium and cook omelet , stirring occasionally , about 1 minute until eggs just begin to set
13. Shift skillet so that 1 / 4 of omelet is directly over center of burner and cook 1 minute
14. Shift skillet 3 more times to cook remaining quarters 1 minute each
15. Reduce heat to low , center skillet and cook omelet about 4 more minutes until almost set
16. Turn omelet over and cook about 4 minutes until other side is golden
17. Slide omelet onto a platter , cool to room temp and cut into wedges
18. May be made 1 day ahead: cover and chill
19. Bring to room temp before serving

title: shrimp on the barbie
steps:
1. Combine coconut milk , curry paste and garlic in a saucepan and bring to boil , reduce heat and simmer for 8 to 10 minutes or until coconut milk has thickened slightly
2. Stir in lime juice and fish sauce , cool then toss with shrimp and marinate for 1 hour
3. Remove shrimp from marinade and thread shrimps onto lemon grass stalks , spearing shrimps in 2 places so that they don't turn on the skewers
4. Season with salt and pepper
5. Preheat grill to high
6. Brush shrimp with extra oil and grill about 2 minutes per side or until shrimps are cooked
7. While shrimp is cooking , place reserved marinade in a small pot over high heat , bring to a boil and boil for 3 minutes or until quite thick
8. Remove from heat , stir in extra lime juice and sugar
9. Drizzle over grilled shrimp and sprinkle with mint

title: spinach and rice
steps:
1. Heat oil in large skillet & saute onions until translucent
2. Add spinach and cook until wilted , stirring occasionally
3. Add tomatoes and water
4. Bring to a boil
5. Add rice , lower heat & let simmer , stirring occasionally , for 20-25 minutes until rice is done

title: paul newman s chocolate   orange angel food cake
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f
2. Make sure a 10" x 4" tube pan is clean , dry and free of grease
3. Grate the chocolate bars on the fine holes of a cheese grater , not a teeny-holed citrus grater
4. Separate the eggs , and let the egg whites come to room temperature
5. About 15 minutes
6. Sift 1 cup of flour , 1 / 4 cup of the sugar , and the salt onto a piece of waxed paper
7. Sift them together a total of three times
8. Beat the egg whites until frothy
9. Add the lemon juice and continue beating
10. Sprinkle the remaining cup of sugar , 1 / 4 cup at a time , over the egg whites and continue beating at medium speed until the egg whites are glossy and form soft peaks that bend over at the top
11. Do not overheat , or the egg whites will lose their volume
12. Sift 1 / 4 cup of the dry ingredients over the egg whites and fold
13. Gently stir in the vanilla extract and orange rind
14. Alternately fold in the chocolate and remaining dry ingredients , working in small batches , until just incorporated
15. Pour the batter into the tube pan and bake for 45 minutes , until the top is lightly browned
16. A knife inserted in the center of the cake should come out clean
17. Remove from the oven and invert the pan
18. Allow the cake to cool for 30 to 45 minutes
19. Run a knife around the edges of the pan and tube to loosen the cake
20. You can serve this as is , or with a little whipped cream , or ice cream-- whatever your heart desires
21. Enjoy !

title: moroccan spiced coffee
steps:
1. Put everything except the sugar in a coffee pot and heat over a gas flame
2. Keep on the heat for 3-4 minutes until the milk froths and rises up in the pot
3. Take off the heat and add sugar to your taste , remembering that sugar brings out the flavour of the spices

title: marinated goat cheese and walnuts meets  green beans
steps:
1. To marinate goat cheese:
2. Cut the cheese into thick slices and arrange in a single layer on a plate
3. Combine the olive and walnut oils , shallots , garlic , thyme , and coriander and fennel seeds , then pour over the cheese
4. Cover with plastic wrap , set aside till serving
5. Trim green beans
6. Bring water to simmer in a saucepan and cook green beans about 5 minutes , then drain
7. Toast the walnut halves in a hot dry pan until fragrant
8. Turn on broiler
9. Drain off a little marinade from the cheese and toss the beans in it , adding sea salt and pepper to taste
10. Arrange the green beans on large serving plates
11. Gently lift the cheese slices onto a sheet of foil and place under the broiler until just melted , about 2 minutes
12. Place on top of beans
13. Spoon the remaining marinade over and sprinkle the toasted walnuts on top
14. Serve and enjoy !

title: egg and bacon tarts
steps:
1. Brush each piece of bread with butter
2. Press into greased deep patty tins
3. Break an egg into each bread case
4. Top with an even amount of chopped bacon
5. Sprinkle with a little parsley
6. Bake in a moderate oven 180oc for 15 to 20 mins or until egg is firm
7. Serve warm or cold
8. Store in an airtight container in the fridge for up to 3 days

title: egg burritos
steps:
1. Whisk the eggs together with a little salt and pepper and a tiny splash of water
2. Either spray a nonstick pan with cooking spray , or put a dab of margarine in pan
3. Add the eggs to pan and gently scramble until light and fluffy
4. Heat tortilla over open flame of burner and few seconds per side until heated
5. Spoon eggs down center of tortilla and top with cheese and a little taco sauce
6. Roll up burrito style !

title: turtles cheesecake
steps:
1. Crust: preheat oven to 300
2. Stir together graham cracker crumbs , pecans , butter & sugar in a bowl until well combined
3. Press into bottom and up the sides of a 9-inch springform pan
4. Bake 12 minutes or until golden & firm
5. Refrigerate until chilled
6. Filling: beat cream cheese , sugar & vanilla until smooth
7. Beat in eggs & flour
8. Gradually beat in evaporated milk and the sour cream
9. Stir in chopped turtles
10. Pour over crust
11. Bake 25 minutes
12. Cover loosely with foil , bake an additional 30-40 minutes or until edges are set but centre still jiggles slightly
13. Let cool to room temp on baking rack
14. Run a sharp knife around edge of pan
15. Remove pan edges
16. This cheesecake is nice decorated on top with additional turtle snackin' size candies (in a circular pattern nearly to the outer edge of cake , or in the middle , or both ! ) and dripped melted chocolate and / or dripped melted caramels

title: loosemeat pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven 375
2. Prepare crust
3. Combine dry ingredients
4. Add water and mayonnaise
5. Mix well
6. Spread half mixture in bottom of greased 9x11 cake pan
7. Set aside
8. Prepare filling
9. Brown hamburger , drain all but 2 tbls of grease
10. Add seasonings
11. Add 1 tbls flour
12. Place mixture on crust by spooning onto top
13. Carefully spread evenly
14. Top with remaining crust mix by dropping spoonfuls on top
15. Bake 25 - 30 mins until light golden brown

title: chicken breasts with brandied cherry chocolate sauce
steps:
1. In a non-reactive bowl , mix the salt and water until dissolved
2. Add the chicken and allow to brine for 30 minutes in the refrigerator
3. Remove the chicken from the brine , rinse under cool running water , and pat dry with paper towels
4. Preheat oven to 300 degrees
5. Pour the flour into a shallow dish and roll each breast into the flour , patting gently to lightly coat
6. Allow the chicken to rest for 10 to 15 minutes
7. In a heavy 12-inch skillet , heat the butter and oil over medium-high heat
8. Swirling to mix and cook until the butter begins to brown lightly
9. Lay the chicken breasts in pan and cook , undisturbed , until brown , about 5 minutes
10. Turn the chicken pieces over and cook on second side , undisturbed , an additional 5 to 7 minutes
11. Remove the chicken and place in warm oven while making the sauce
12. Add the chicken stock to the skillet , scraping to release any brown bits
13. Boil until reduced to 1 cup
14. This should take 8 to 10 minutes
15. Add the cherries and vinegar
16. Boil until spoon scraped across the bottom of the pan leaves a visible path in sauce , 8 to 10 minutes
17. Stir in chocolate and brandy
18. Plate the chicken on serving plates and spoon the sauce over
19. Sit back and enjoy with a green side salad

title: whole wheat biscuits
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 450 degrees f
2. Whisk together the flour , baking powder , and salt in a large mixting bowl
3. Cut in the oil with a fork or pastry blender until the mixture resembles coarse crumbs
4. Using a fork , stir in just enough of the milk so that the dry ingredients are moistened and the dough comes together
5. Gather the dough in a ball and turn it out onto a lightly floured work surface
6. Knead it gently 20 to 25 times
7. Then smooth it into a ball
8. Roll or pat the dough into a 1 / 2-inch thick round and cut it with a floured 2 1 / 2-inch biscuit cutter or the rim of a glass
9. Push the center straight down into the dough without twisting it
10. Reroll and recut the scraps of dough
11. Place the biscuits on an ungreased baking sheet about an inch apart for crusty sides or touching for soft sides
12. Bake on the center shelf of the oven for 10 to 12 minutes , or until the bottoms are lightly browned
13. Do not overbake
14. Serve hot or warm

title: thai sweetcorn fritters
steps:
1. Place half the sweetcorn in a blender and whiz until smooth
2. Scrape into a bowl , add the remaining ingredients and beat until you have a thick batter
3. Heat enough oil in a frying pan for shallow frying
4. Use a teaspoon to put spoonfuls of batter in the oil and fry until golden
5. This will take no more than 30 seconds on each side
6. Drain on paper towel
7. Don't make the fritters too big or they won't cook through
8. Mix the ingredients for the dipping sauce together and serve immediately

title: easy calamari cajun style with lime vinaigrette
steps:
1. Calamari:
2. Slice squid tubes in to rings
3. Combine flour and cajun seasoning in a ziploc bag and toss
4. Deep fry for 30 / 40 seconds
5. Vinaigrette:
6. In a food processor , process everything except the oil
7. Slowly drizzle in the oil until emulsified
8. Add chopped coriander
9. Place into a bowl for 30mins for the flavours to develop
10. Serve on the side or drizzle some of the vinaigrette over the calamari

title: chef jon s white bean  chicken and spinach soup
steps:
1. In a large sauce pan , sautee the shallots & garlic in the olive oil
2. Add water , chicken base , tomatoes , beans , diced chicken , rosemary , basil and oregano to pot
3. Season with black and red pepper
4. Bring to boil
5. Add pasta and cook 12 minutes
6. If the soup seems too thick for your liking add more water
7. Add spinach and cook until wilted
8. Serve topped with freshly grated parmesan cheese

title: oyster stuffed tomatoes  or mussels stuffed tomatoes
steps:
1. Drain smoked oysters and / or smoked mussels well and place on paper towels
2. Slit the tops of each cherry tomato and place an oyster or a mussel inside the slit
3. Oysters will peek out the top of the tomatoes
4. If the oysters are too large , cut them in half
5. If the mussels are very small , you may need 2 mussels per tomato
6. Arrange on a platter and serve

title: bread machine condensed milk sweet bread
steps:
1. Put ingredients in bread machine according to your machine's manufacturing directions and set the dough cycle
2. When done , remove and seperate into 3 sections
3. Roll each section out like snakes and mesh ends together
4. Braid and press ends together
5. Place in baking dish and allow to rise for 25-30 minutes
6. Brush melted butter or egg white on top after rising
7. Bake at 340 degrees for 30-45 minutes , until top is golden brown
8. If a better crust is wanted: heat some water in an oven proof container in the microwave until near boiling
9. Then place water in the oven beside the bread

title: kfc extra crispy chicken  copycat
steps:
1. You may use masa harina flour in place of corn flour
2. You may use 1 / 4 teaspoon lemon pepper in place of 1 / 8 teaspoon citric acid
3. : rinse and blot chicken pieces
4. Mix 2 quarts cups cold water with 2 tablespoons morton lite salt and 2 teaspoons accent seasoning in a large wide saucepan until dissolved
5. Add chicken pieces
6. Cover and transfer to refrigerator
7. Marinate chicken at least 4 hours in refrigerator , turning chicken as needed
8. Into a large mixing bowl , add the seasoned flour ingredients except the self-rising flour and cornstarch
9. Break up any clumps if present , by hand or using the back of a spoon
10. Whisk well with a wire whisk until well blended
11. Add 3 3 / 4 cups self-rising flour and 1 / 4 cup packed cornstarch
12. Whisk mixture well until thoroughly combined
13. Add 4 quarts water to a large bowl or saucepan for the water wash
14. Remove chicken from marinade with tongs
15. Place chicken into large bowl containing the seasoned flour and coat well
16. Remove chicken from seasoned flour bowl using tongs
17. Place chicken portions onto a platter
18. Repeat procedures with remaining chicken pieces
19. Dip one piece breaded chicken using tongs , into the water wash to wet completely
20. Drop wet chicken into the seasoned flour again and toss until slightly clumpy
21. Place double-breaded breaded chicken onto a platter to rest for 15-20 minutes
22. Preheat manufacturer's recommended amount of pure shortening or vegetable oil in deep-fryer to 315f preheat enough fat to immerse chicken completely in deep heavy stovetop pot to 315f - 325f
23. Place breaded chicken to the elevated fry basket in deep-fryer without crowding
24. Lower the basket slowly into the hot fat
25. Fry chicken between 16-20 minutes until golden brown and fully cooked , depending on chicken portions / sizes
26. Drain on a wire rack over a paper towel-lined baking sheet
27. Repeat the same cooking procedures until all chicken is fried
28. Drain chicken on a wire rack over a paper towel-lined baking sheet
29. Transfer rack over a baking sheet and keep chicken warmed in a preheated 170f oven until serving
30. Serve and enjoy !

title: baked cheese   garlic grits
steps:
1. Bring the water and salt to a boil
2. Stir in the grits
3. Cook until the grits are done
4. Remove from the heat and add the next 4 ingredients
5. Stir until the cheese and butter has melted
6. Add a very small amount of grits to the eggs and stir well
7. Add a little more and stir well again
8. The pour this mixture back into the grits and mix well
9. Pour the mixture into a greased 2 quart casserole dish
10. Bake at 325f for 1 hour

title: sarasota s ham  pea  penne  in a fontina cheese sauce
steps:
1. Bread crumbs -- in a large sauce pan , which you will use for the bacon and finishing the dish , just toast up some bread crumbs
2. No butter or oil , just heat on medium until the bread toasts up
3. Once toasty and brown , just remove to a paper towel on the side
4. This will go in the pasta dish
5. Bacon -- now , in that same saute pan , add the bacon and saute on medium heat until golden brown and crisp
6. I don't add additional oil , the bacon will give off enough grease on it's own
7. Just saute on medium so it doesn't burn
8. Remove to a plate lined with a paper towel to drain
9. Don't throw away those drippings
10. Onion -- in the pan with the bacon drippings , save about 1 tablespoon to saute the onion inches just toss out the rest - you don't want too much grease
11. Add the onion , garlic and cook until tender
12. Add in the chopped ham and season with pepper
13. Hold off on the salt until later , the cheese you will add is salty so we don't want to over salt
14. Slowly add in the cream and cheese and stir until all melted and creamy
15. Add the peas and the bacon and cook just another minute on medium to medium low heat
16. You will add a little of the pasta water to thin it , so don't worry if it is very thick
17. You can also add a little more cream if you want , but the pasta water is what i prefer
18. Pasta -- now if using fresh pasta , you know if cooks up in 1 / 2 the time
19. If you are using dried , just start the pasta about the same time you start the bacon
20. Just cook in salted water according to direction
21. Done -- just finish the dish by adding in the parsley to the ham sauce and then the pasta and toss
22. If too thick , just add a little pasta water , but this is not meant to be a creamy sauce but just to coat the pasta , so don't make it too creamy
23. Serve -- just top with the bread crumbs and toss ever so lightly and sprinkle on the remaining parmesan and enjoy !

title: butternut squash mashed potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. Toss squash with olive oil and sprinkle with salt and pepper
3. Spread on a baking sheet lined with aluminum foil
4. Transfer to oven along with whole potatoes and roast until tender , 30-40 minutes for squash
5. 45 minutes to 1 hour for potatoes
6. Stir squash cubes occasionally to avoid browning on sides
7. When fork-tender , split potatoes down middle and scoop out insides
8. Discard skins
9. Combine potatoes with squash in a bowl
10. Meanwhile melt butter with cream in a small saucepan
11. Pour mixture over vegetables
12. Add salt and pepper to taste and mash with a hand masher

title: corn dog casserole
steps:
1. In skillet , saute celery in butter for 5 min
2. Add onions
3. Saute 5 min
4. Place in a large bowl
5. Set aside
6. Cut hot dogs lengthwise into 1 / 4s , then cut into 1 / 3s
7. In the same skillet , saute hot dogs for 5 min
8. Or until lightly browned
9. Add to vegetables
10. Set aside 1 cup
11. In a large bowl , combine eggs , milk , sage and pepper
12. Add the remaining hot dog mixture
13. Stir in corn bread mixes
14. Add 1 1 / 2 cup cheese
15. Spread into a shallow 3 quart baking dish
16. Top with reserved hot dog mixture and remaining cheese
17. Bake , uncovered , at 400 degrees for 30 min
18. Or until golden brown

title: morning mix up
steps:
1. In a large skillet , saute potatoes , ham and onion in oil for 10 minutes or until potatoes are tender
2. In a small bowl , beat eggs , salt and pepper
3. Add to the skillet
4. Cook , stirring occasionally , until eggs are set
5. Remove from the heat and gently stir in cheese
6. Spoon onto a serving platter
7. Top with chives

title: corned beef hash with fried or poached  egg
steps:
1. Heat the butter and olive oil over medium-high heat in a large cast-iron or heavy-bottomed skillet
2. Add potatoes and allow to get golden and crusty on one side
3. Gently turn over with a spatula and do this a couple more times to get a golden crust all over
4. Add onion and garlic and saute with potatoes for 4-5 minutes
5. Then add peppers , sauteeing a couple of minutes more
6. Finally , add corned beef and cook for 8-10 minutes , always flipping hash over every couple of minutes to ensure a crust develops on all sides
7. This should take about 20 minutes in all
8. Adjust seasoning - it won't need too much salt because of the corned beef , but lots of freshly ground black pepper is a good thing
9. You can prepare the eggs in another pan during these steps
10. Distribute hash mixture amongst 4 plates and top each serving with a fried or poached egg
11. Season with hot sauce at table , to taste
12. Enjoy !

title: mu shu style pork roll ups
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degree f
2. Wrap tortillas tightly in foil
3. Heat in preheated oven for 10 minutes to soften
4. Meanwhile , in a large skillet heat sesame oil over medium-high heat
5. Add pork strips
6. Stir-fry for 2 to 3 minutes or until done add stir-fry vegetables
7. Cook and stir for 3 to 4 minutes or until vegetables are crisp-tender
8. Spread each tortilla with 1 tablespoon of the plum or hoisin sauce
9. Place a quarter of the meat mixture just below the center of each tortilla
10. Fold the bottom edge of each tortilla up and over the filling
11. Fold in the sides until they meet
12. Roll up over the filling
13. Makes 4 servings

title: muddy river
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together
2. Shake
3. Chill and enjoy

title: szechuan garlic chicken
steps:
1. Chop chicken breasts into 2-inch square pieces
2. Mix marinade ingredients in a medium bowl
3. Add chicken
4. Mix well
5. Let stand 20 minutes
6. Heat vegetable in wok over medium heat 1 minutes
7. Add chicken pieces
8. Stir-fry until chicken is almost cooked , 3-4 minutes
9. Remove chicken , draining well over wok
10. Set aside
11. Remove all but 4 tablespoons oil from wok
12. Dissolve cornstarch in chicken broth to make a paste
13. Set aside
14. Heat oil in wok over medium heat 1 minutes
15. Add cooked chicken , garlic , water chestnuts and bamboo shoots or carrots
16. Stir-fry about 2 minutes
17. Add salt , sugar , soy sauce and water
18. Cover and cook over low heat for 10 minutes
19. Add cornstarch paste
20. Stir-fry until sauce thickens slightly , about 30 seconds
21. Stir in 1 teaspoons sesame oil
22. Serve hot

title: just peachy individual hand pies
steps:
1. Melt butter in a skillet over medium heat
2. Combine cornstarch with 1 / 3 cup sugar
3. Add to skillet
4. Stir in peaches , cinnamon and salt
5. Cook until mixture thickens and boils , about 25 minutes , stirring frequently
6. Boil for one minute
7. Remove from heat and stir in lemon juice
8. Cool completely
9. Set aside
10. Cut crusts into quarters
11. Spoon 2 tablespoons filling into the center of each quarter , leaving 3 / 4-inch dough uncovered on each side
12. Fold dough over filling
13. Press edges together to seal
14. Transfer pies to 2 ungreased baking sheets
15. Brush tops of pies with egg
16. Sprinkle with remaining sugar
17. Cut a one-inch slit in the top of each pie
18. Bake at 425 degrees for 18 to 20 minutes until golden , rotating baking sheets between upper and lower racks halfway through baking
19. Remove to wire racks to cool

title: emeril s kicked up tuna melt
steps:
1. Preheat the broiler and position the oven rack about 6 inches from the broiler
2. Combine the tuna , olives , mayonnaise , red onion , capers , black pepper , lemon juice , and salt in a medium bowl
3. Stir until well mixed
4. Arrange the bread slices on a work surface
5. Lightly spread each slice of bread with additional mayonnaise and top with 2 tomato slices each
6. Divide the tuna salad evenly among the 4 bread slices over the tomatoes
7. Top the tuna salad with slices of cheese
8. Place sandwiches on a sheet tray and place under broiler
9. Cook until cheese is golden and bubbly , about 3-4 minutes

title: chocolate snowball cookies   christmas
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325
2. Mix 1 cup confectionary sugar and 1 teaspoon vanilla
3. Set aside
4. Cream butter until fluffy
5. Beat in evaporated milk and vanilla
6. Add dry ingredients and nuts
7. Mix well
8. Shape into 1" balls
9. Bake for 15-20 minutes
10. Roll immediately in vanilla and confectionary sugar mixture
11. Let cool

title: whole wheat pizza dough
steps:
1. In a large mixing bowl , combine all dry ingredients except sugar and yeast
2. Stir together thoroughly and form a well in center
3. Blend remaining ingredients and pour into well
4. Brush flour into liquid with finger
5. Knead on a floured work surface for about 10 minutes or until dough is smooth and elastic
6. Shape into ball , place in lightly greased bowl and turn once to grease entire surface
7. Cover bowl with clean towel , place in a warm , draft-free location and let rise until double
8. Punch down dough , form into a small circle and place on floured work surface
9. Let rest for 5 minutes , then press out dough until it is slightly larger than pan size
10. Fold dough in half and in half again
11. Place"wedge" onto greased pizza pan that's been"dusted" with corn meal
12. Unfold dough and crimp edges to form a crust
13. Top with favorite sauce and toppings and bake in 500 f oven for about 20 minutes

title: butter mochi
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease a 13x9x2" pan
3. In a large bowl , sift together mochiko flour , sugar , baking powder , and cinnamon if using , and mix well
4. In a medium bowl , combine evaporated milk , coconut milk , eggs , and vanilla , and mix well
5. Make a well in the dry ingredient and incorporate the liquid ingredients
6. Stir in melted butter
7. Pour into pan , and tap pan to settle batter
8. Bake for 45-60 minutes until golden brown
9. Cool at least 2 hours before cutting

title: minted sweet pea and spinach soup
steps:
1. Melt the butter in a pot
2. Add the chopped onions , cover , and cook over low heat until tender and lightly colored , about 25 minutes
3. Meanwhile , drain the spinach and squeeze out excess liquid
4. Pour the stock into the pot , stir in the peas and spinach , and bring to a boil
5. Reduce heat and simmer , partially covered , until peas are tender , about 20 minutes
6. Pull the mint leaves from their stems
7. There should be 2 cups loosely packed leaves
8. Rinse thoroughly and pat dry
9. When peas are tender , add mint to the pot , cover , and simmer for another 5 minutes
10. Pour the soup through a strainer , reserving liquid , and transfer the solids to the bowl of a food processor fitted with a steel blade , or use a food mill fitted with the medium disc
11. Add 1 cup of the cooking stock and process until smooth
12. Return pureed soup to the pot
13. Add the heavy cream and additional cooking liquid , aboout 1 cup , until the soup is of the desired consistency
14. Season to taste with salt and pepper , simmer briefly to heat through , and serve immediately

title: pork and kielbasa cassoulet
steps:
1. In a large ovenproof pot or dutch oven cook the chopped bacon until crisp
2. Transfer the bacon to a large bowl and discard all but 3 tablespoons fat from the pot
3. Add in the pork shoulder cubes and kielbasa slices and brown transfer to a bowl with the bacon
4. Add in onions , garlic , celery , carrots , dryed thyme and dryed chili flakes
5. Saute until tender
6. Add in the tomato paste and cook stirring for 1 minute
7. Add in chicken broth and tomatoes with juice
8. Bring to a boil
9. Add in the meats from the pork , kielbasa and bacon
10. Stir to combine
11. Cover pot and transfer to 325 degree oven for 1 hour
12. After 1 hour of cooking stir in the wine and canned beans , season with salt and pepper
13. In a bowl , mix together the fresh breadcrumbs , parmesan and 1 tablespoon olive oil , then sprinkle over cassoulet
14. Return to the oven uncovered and cook until the pork is tender and the dryed beans are tender and the topping is golden and crisp
15. Add enough cold water to cover by 3 inches
16. Bring to a boil
17. Remove from heat , cover and soak for 1 hour
18. Drain and rinse under cold water
19. Return the beans to the pot , add in enough cold water to cover the beans by 3 inches
20. Bring to a boil
21. Cover and simmer over medium-low heat until beans are almost tender drain , then add them into the cassoulet as directed

title: nonna s easy italian bean soup
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , sautee onions and garlic in oil
2. Add diced tomatoes , tomato sauce , oregano , parsley , salt and pepper
3. Rinse beans and add to sauce
4. Let simmer for 10 minutes
5. While sauce is simmering , boil water and make pasta according to package
6. When ready , drain 3 / 4 of the water but leave 1 / 4 with pasta
7. Add to simmering sauce and stir in basil
8. Top with parmasan and serve !

title: vanilla yogurt pancakes with strawberry syrup
steps:
1. Spray griddle with cooking spray and heat over medium heat or to 375
2. In a large bowl , mix flour , sugar , baking powder , baking soda , and salt
3. Set aside
4. In another bowl , beat eggs , yogurt , and water with wire whisk
5. Beat in butter
6. Pour egg mixture all at once into flour mixture
7. Stir just until moistened
8. For each pancake , pour by 1 / 4 cupfuls onto hot griddle
9. Cook pancakes 1-2 minutes or until bubbly on top
10. Turn and cook other sides for an additional 1-2 minutes
11. Top each serving with 1 / 4 cup sliced strawberries and syrup

title: chutney rice
steps:
1. Pour chicken broth into a saucepan and bring to a boil
2. Slowly add rice to broth
3. Reduce heat and simmer , covered 20 minutes
4. Remove from heat and add the chutney , raisins and curry powder and stir until well mixed
5. Let stand approximately 5 minutes for flavors to blend
6. Sprinkle with the toasted almonds before serving

title: the alfafara avocado smoothie
steps:
1. Put the avocado and the milk and sugar in the blender
2. Mix for a minute then stop and taste for sweetness
3. Add sugar if necessary
4. Add the ice and fill to the top of the blender
5. Mix till the product forms a smooth consistency
6. Remove from blender and pour into small 8 ounce glasses--and enjoy

title: almond snowball cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Have ready a cookie sheet lined with parchment paper or a silpat liner
3. In a medium-sized mixing bowl with an electric mixer , beat the egg whites and salt together just until they form soft peaks , then sprinkle in the sugar and continue beating until peaks are stiff
4. Add almond extract and give it a quick buzz with the beaters just to incorporate it
5. Now , with a wooden spoon , stir in half the coconut
6. Then the nutmeg
7. Then the flour
8. Then finally fold in the remaining coconut
9. Using a scoop or just working with two spoons , form snowballs a couple of inches apart on your cookie sheets--i aim for about 10 and so keep them on one sheet
10. If you want more , you'll need more than one baking sheet
11. Bake in preheated oven for approximately 15 minutes or until the snowballs are just a light golden colour
12. Remove from oven and , if desired , press half of a candied red cherry in the top
13. It looks pretty but it isn't necessary
14. Remove to a cooling rack and let cool

title: awesome and easy stuffed mushrooms
steps:
1. Clean the mushrooms by popping the caps off and wiping them with a damn rag
2. Brown the sausage and onion together
3. Once fully cooked , add the cream cheese
4. Remove from heat and add the shredded cheese
5. Spoon into the mushrooms and bake at 350f for 25-30 minutes
6. Then enjoy !

title: basic cake or muffin mix   wheat and egg free
steps:
1. Rub the dry ingredients in with the butter
2. Add the wet ingredients , adding a little milk at a time to get a soft dropping consistancy
3. Beat the mixture well to combine
4. Add paper liners to the muffin tin and fill with the mixture
5. Sprinkle a little sugar on the tops of the muffins
6. Bake at about 190 degrees celsius for about 20 - 25 minutes for muffins and about 50 minutes for a loaf tin
7. Makes about 12 muffins

title: easy chicken almondine
steps:
1. Boil chicken on stove top until no longer pink
2. Dice or shred chicken and layer on bottom of 9 x 13-inch pan
3. In seperate bowl , mix cream of chicken soup with sour cream
4. Blend well
5. Spread soup sour cream mixture on top of chicken
6. Add shredded cheese , then layer with crushed ritz crackers
7. Pour melted butter over crackers
8. Sprinkle almonds on top
9. Bake at 350 degrees for approximately 25 minutes , until bubbly

title: uncle bill s pork chops in mushroom soup
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Prepare a 9" x 9" oven-proof casserole dish by rubbing inside with butter
3. In a frying pan on medium-high heat , add 2 tablespoons of olive oil , then add pork chops and sear for about 3 minutes on each side until lightly browned
4. Transfer the pork chops to the prepared casserole dish in a single layer
5. In a mixing bowl , whisk together , mushroom soup , whole milk , padano cheese , salt , sambal oelek and freshly grated nutmeg
6. Pour mixture over the pork chops
7. Sprinkle the sliced onion over the top , then sprinkle with the grated potato over the top
8. Layer the julienned sweet red pepper over the top
9. Cover tightly with aluminum foil
10. Bake in preheated 400 f oven for 30 minutes
11. Reduce heat to 375 f and continue to cook covered , for another 15 minutes
12. Serve over cooked rice if desired
13. You can double this recipe but will require a larger casserole dish

title: county fair turkey legs
steps:
1. Preheat grill
2. Combine all ingredients , except house seasoning and honey , in a large stock pot and bring to a low boil
3. Add turkey legs and boil for 30 minutes or until turkey legs register 165 degrees f
4. Put turkey legs on the grill , season with paula deen's house seasoning and brush with honey
5. Grill over medium heat about 15 minutes , rotating occasionally as needed
6. The turkey legs should be crispy and golden brown when done

title: the best clam dip you will ever eat
steps:
1. In a medium size mixer bowl blend the cream cheese and sour cream until smooth
2. Add remaining ingredients and stir until well blended
3. Chill , garnish with fresh parsley and serve with your favorite ridged potato chip and a vegetable platter

title: rustic lamb soup from florence  minestra dagnello
steps:
1. Chop finely the celery , carrot and onion and saut in 3 tablespoons of olive oil
2. As soon as the onion begins to change colour , add the lamb and continue to cook
3. After a few minutes , add the wine and allow to evaporate completely , then add the tomatoes
4. Continue to cook over a low heat for about one hour , then add the broth
5. Finally add the noodles and cook for a few minutes
6. Serve with freshly ground pepper

title: healthier vanilla ice cream
steps:
1. Beat eggs and egg substitute until frothy
2. Add sugar and beat well
3. Add condensed milk , evaporated milk and vanilla , mixing well
4. Pour mixture into a large , heavy saucepan
5. Cook over medium heat until mixture comes to a boil
6. Boil 1 minute , stirring constantly
7. Let mixture cool
8. Add milk
9. Pour into freezer can and freeze mixture according to manufacturer's instructions
10. Let ice cream ripen about 1 hour

title: parmesan peas
steps:
1. Steam peas as normal
2. Once cooked , stir in all other ingredients , and serve immediately

title: yummy  good for you pizza   also my family s favorite
steps:
1. In a small bowl combing yeast and warm water
2. Let stad for 5 minutes
3. Stir in honey and the 1 tablespoon olive oil
4. In a large bouwl combine whole wheat flour , cornmeal , and salt
5. Stir in yeast mixture
6. Stir in as much all-purpose flour as you can
7. Turn dough onto a lightly floured surface
8. Knead in enough remaining flour to make a moderately stiff dough that is smooth and elastic
9. Shape dough into a ball , cover and let rise until nearly double
10. Meanwhile , prepare spinach pesto
11. In food processor bowl place spinach , basil , garlic , parmesan cheese , the 1 / 3 cup of olive oil , and lemon juice
12. Cover and process until smooth
13. Set aside
14. Preheat oven to 425f
15. Punch down dough , let rest 10 minutes
16. On a lightly floured surface roll dough to a 12-inch round or a 10-inch square
17. Transfer to greased baking sheet
18. Bake for 12 minutes or until browned
19. Top with pesto sauce , pepperoni , tomatoes , and cheese
20. Bake for 10 to 15 minutes or until bubbly
21. Makes 8 servings

title: orange pecan green beans
steps:
1. Bring a medium pot of water to boil
2. Add salt , add green beans , cook 5-6 minutes , drain rinse in cold water to stop cooking , drain on paper towels
3. In a small bowl whisk together orange juice , mustard and sugar , set aside
4. In a large skillet melt butter over medium heat add onion and pecans , saute stirring often , until onions are browned and pecans are toasted , 10 minutes
5. Add green beans , season with salt , pepper , thyme , stir
6. Add mustard mixture , lower heat and stir to combine sauce and beans , 1-2 minutes

title: chicken cashew curry
steps:
1. Heat butter in a large skillet over medium heat until melted , then cook onions , garlic , and ginger , stirring , until softened , about 5 minutes
2. Add curry powder , salt , cumin , and cayenne and cook , stirring , 2 minutes
3. Add chicken and cook , stirring to coat , 3 minutes
4. Add tomatoes , including juice , and cilantro and bring to a simmer , then cover and simmer gently , stirring occasionally , until chicken is cooked through , about 10 minutes
5. Pulse cashews in a food processor until finely ground , then add to curry
6. Add yogurt , mix well , and simmer uncovered , stirring , until sauce is thickened , about 5 minutes
7. Serve over basmati rice
8. This can be milder or hotter depending on the hotness of your curry powder

title: sage potatoes
steps:
1. In a large skillet , melt butter over medium low heat
2. Stir in onion and garlic and cook until translucent
3. Add potatoes and sage
4. Cover pan and cook for 10 minutes , stirring occasionally
5. Turn potatoes over and continue cooking for 5 minutes or until bottom of potatoes is golden brown

title: tahitian pork curry with taro
steps:
1. Get all the ingredients and tools ready
2. Wash and peel the taro , cut into cubes and blanch 10 minutes in salted water
3. Drain and put aside
4. Peel and chop the onion and the garlic
5. Cut the meat into cubes
6. Sear the meat in a heavy dutch oven , add the onion , paprika and curry , singe with the flour
7. Add salt and pepper
8. Put water , add garlic and the taro
9. Cook for 40 minutes stirring regularly
10. Check seasonings , bind with the coconut milk and serve hot

title: peanut butter cake and frosting
steps:
1. Cake
2. In large bowl mix flour , sugar , salt , and baking soda
3. In small bowl mix eggs and buttermilk
4. Bring peanut butter , water and butter to a rapid boil
5. Pour boiling mixture over dry mixture and mix well
6. Add buttermilk and egg mixture
7. Pour into greased jelly roll pan
8. Bake at 350 for 20-25 minutes
9. Cool
10. Frosting
11. Bring 1 stick butter , 1 / 2 cup peanut butter and 6 tbsp buttermilk to a rapid boil
12. Add 1 teaspoons vanilla
13. Mix in 1 box powered sugar
14. Mix well
15. Frost cake while frosting in hot
16. Optional: drizzle with warmed hot fudge ice cream topping

title: mama s started in texas buttermilk biscuits
steps:
1. Heat oven to 450
2. Mix the dry ingredients in medium size bowl
3. Cut in the shortning until it looks like little peas
4. Stir in the buttermilk and plop it onto a floured surface
5. Work in just enough flour to pat the dough into a circle about 1 / 2 inch thick
6. Take a drinking glass about 3-inches across and cut out your biscuits
7. Leftover dough is easy to roll back out to sqeeze out a couple more !
8. Place on cookie sheet about 1-inch apart and bake for 10-12 minutes until the crust is just brown
9. In a pich , use buttermilk powder or even milk
10. Serve warm- we don't even bother with butter but it is your choice
11. Makes great leftovers if heated in the microwave for 10-15 seconds and topped with jam

title: amazing ny style white garlic pizza
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425
2. Brown sausage
3. Add onion to pan and saute until soft and slightly brown
4. Drain fat
5. Spread alfredo sauce evenly on pizza crust
6. Top with sausage / onion mixture and italian cheese blend
7. Bake on center oven rack for 12 - 16 minute or until cheese is brown and bubbly
8. Remove from oven and cool for 5 minutes to allow toppings to set

title: tortilla and bean casserole
steps:
1. In a large skillet , combine onion , green bell pepper or red bell pepper , tomatoes , picante sauce , garlic , and cumin
2. Heat to a boil , lower heat , and simmer 10 minutes
3. Stir in beans
4. In a 13 x 9 x 2 baking dish , spread 1 / 3 of the bean mixture
5. Top bean layer with 6 tortillas , overlapping tortillas to fit the dimensions of dish , layer 1 cup of the cheese over the tortillas
6. Layer another 1 / 3 of the bean mixture , remaining tortillas , and then remaining bean mixture
7. Cover tightly with foil and bake at 350 degrees for 30 to 35 minutes or until hot
8. Uncover and top with the remaining 1 cup of cheese
9. Continue baking 5 more minutes
10. Let stand for 10 minutes
11. Top with garnishes of choice

title: pumpkin fruit scones
steps:
1. Boil or steam 1 cup pumpkin and mash it
2. Set aside to cool
3. Preheat oven to 200c
4. Lightly flour a heavy baking sheet and set aside
5. Place flour , sugar , baking powder , bicarb soda and salt in a food processor and whiz to mix thoroughly
6. Add the butter& process until the mixture resembles coarse breadcrumbs
7. Transfer mix to large bowl
8. Add the cherries , or fruit of choice and toss to mix
9. Make well in the center
10. Whisk together pumpkin& buttermilk and pour into the well
11. Stir mix very lightly with a fork until thoroughly moistened
12. Turn out onto floured surface , knead a few times to just combine
13. Pat into a 3cm think round , dip a scone cutter or small glass into flour and cut out scones
14. Place fairly close together on baking sheet , brush with milk for a dull glaze or egg yolk mix for shine
15. Bake for 12-20 minutes
16. Remove from oven
17. Wrap in a tea towel for five minutes
18. Serve hot with butter , or go the full hog and use your favourite jam topped with a dollop of cream

title: hot faux crab dip
steps:
1. Mix all
2. Pour into a heatproof dish and top with breadcrumbs or cheese
3. Bake at 350 degrees f
4. For 15 to 20 minutes or until bubbly
5. Serve with crackers or thin slices of french bread

title: chocolate pumpkin cake
steps:
1. Cake:
2. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees
3. Line the bottoms of two 8-inch cake pans with parchment paper and lightly butter
4. Sift the flour , cocoa , baking powder , baking soda , and salt together
5. Stir the buttermilk , pumpkin , and vanilla extract together in a small bowl
6. Beat the butter and sugars together using an electric mixer on medium speed until light and fluffy
7. Beat in the eggs and yolk , one at a time
8. Reduce mixer speed to low and alternately beat in the flour and buttermilk mixtures in thirds
9. Pour the batter into the prepared pans
10. Bake until a tester , inserted in the center , comes out clean--about 35 minutes
11. Cool layers completely before icing
12. Frosting:
13. Beat cream cheese using a mixer set on medium-high speed until fluffy
14. Add confectioners sugar , cinnamon and vanilla and beat on low speed until well combined
15. In a separate bowl beat heavy cream confectioners sugar and orange food coloring on medium-high to soft peaks
16. Gently fold the whipped cream into the cream cheese mixture until well combinted
17. Spread 1 cup between the two layers and use the remaining for frosting the top and sides of the cake
18. Cake
19. Chill the whole cake after frosting for 30 minutes
20. Glaze:
21. Bring heavy cream to boil , pour over chocolate , butter and corn syrup
22. Let stand 3 minutes and whisk until smooth
23. Cool 3 to 5 minutes until the glaze thickens slightly
24. Pour the glaze onto the center of the frosted cake and smooth out to the edges to allow the glaze to drip over the sides

title: crawfish etouffee
steps:
1. In a heavy pan melt butter and add flour to make a roux
2. Stir constantly over a low heat until it takes on a beige color and loses the floury taste
3. About 30 minutes
4. When the roux is done , stir in vegetables , bacon and parsley
5. Add in beer , clam juice , bay leaf , seasonings and half-and-half
6. Stir , and cover pot
7. Let simmer for 30 to 45 minutes
8. Nearing the end of cooking , add in precooked crawfish and serve over rice

title: honey mustard vinaigrette
steps:
1. Whisk garlic , vinegar , mustard , honey , salt and pepper in a small bowl
2. Slowly whisk in oil

title: martha s chicken soup with parsley dumplings
steps:
1. Chop chicken , celery , carrots , onion , and mince garlic
2. Bring two quarts water , chicken , carrots , onion , celery , garlic , bay leaf , stock , and some salt to a boil
3. Reduce heat to medium-low
4. Simmer 20 minutes
5. Add thyme
6. In a mixing bowl , whisk cornmeal , flour , baking powder , parsley , 1 / 2 tsp salt , shallot , zest and cheese
7. Cut butter into small pieces , add butter to mixture with finger
8. Add milk , and stir until a dough forms
9. Roll into 1 inch balls , add all at once to simmering broth
10. Cover , simmer undisturbed , for 20 minutes
11. Don't forget to remove the bay leaf before serving !

title: beefy mexican lasagna
steps:
1. In a large skillet-brown meat& drain
2. Add beans& burrito seasoning to meat
3. Simmer 5 minutes
4. Stir in 1 / 2 can durkee onion rings
5. In a large bowl-add cottage cheese , eggs and 1 cup cheese
6. Place about 3 flour tortillas in the bottom of a greased 9x13 dish
7. Overlap more tortillas up the sides
8. Spoon meat mixture over tortillas-add the jar of picante sauce
9. Top with another layer of tortillas
10. Top with the cottage cheese mixture
11. Cover with foil& bake at 350 for 45 minutes
12. Sprinkle with cheese& remainder of onion rings
13. Bake 5 more minutes uncovered

title: savoury scones
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 500 degrees add flour , baking powder , salt , cayenne pepper and thyme together in bowl
2. Add 2 / 3 cup shredded cheese to flour mixture
3. In separate bowl add beaten eggs , cream and milk together
4. Add the egg mixture and jalapeno pepper to flour mixture
5. Mix lightly , dough will be very moist
6. Knead the dough lightly and roll out 3 / 4" thick on a well floured board and cut with 2" cookie cutter
7. Sprinkle the remaining shredded cheese over the tops of the scones
8. Place the scones on a greased sheet and bake in a 500 degree oven for 10 minutes
9. Make sure to bake the scones in the center of the oven

title: killer champagne punch
steps:
1. Have all ingredients chilled , then mix together and enjoy !
2. Haven't made this myself yet , so am guessing at the number of servings

title: vegetable and tomato chicken fettuccine
steps:
