1. Bring 1 saucepan water to the boil
2. When that's done , add the fettuccine
3. While that's cooking on very high , heat oil in frying pan at medium heat
4. Add garlic and chilli for 1 minute
5. Add vegetables and stir fry for 2 minutes
6. Add chicken to warm it , and pour in canned tomatoes
7. Add tomato paste and any herbs / black pepper / salt you wish to add for taste
8. Stir and let it cook for a minute
9. Water may need to be added but it should thicken , allow to simmer
10. Add cooked pasta and allow to mix for a good minute
11. Serve and enjoy :)

title: buttered snow peas
steps:
1. In a large saucepan of boiling salted water blanch the snow peas for 1 minute , or until they are crisp-tender
2. Drain the snow peas well and in a bowl toss them with the butter

title: coconut chicken noodle soup with thai flavors
steps:
1. Saute onion , garlic , and ginger in oil over medium heat
2. When onion is tender , add black pepper and cayenne , stirring to coat all
3. Add broth , coconut milk , soy sauce , and lime zest and bring to a boil
4. Reduce heat to a simmer
5. Break noodles in half and add to the pot
6. Partially cover and let simmer for 10 minutes , stirring occasionally
7. Add chicken and simmer until cooked through , about 2 minutes
8. Stir in lime juice and cilantro just before serving

title: pizza hut or olive garden breadsticks
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients in bread machine on dough setting
2. Then , roll it out into a log and divide it into 16 pieces
3. Roll these pieces into cigar-shaped sticks of bread
4. Arrange on a baking sheet
5. Cover , and let rise for 45 minutes
6. Preheat your oven to 400f
7. Use your brush to butter each stick , saving some butter for later
8. Sprinkle with kosher salt
9. Cook for 15 minutes
10. Remove , then brush twice more and add another sprinkling of kosher salt and a light sprinkle of garlic powder
11. Tada ! olive garden breadsticks
12. For pizza hut:
13. Mix: 1 / 3 cup of parmesan cheese 1 tsp ground black pepper 1 tsp italian seasoning 1 / 2 tsp garlic powder
14. Then shake these onto your breadsticks to your liking for cheesesticks sprinkle shredded mozzarella onto the tops , then pop under the broiler until the cheese bubbles and burns a bit

title: smoky tomato soup with gruyere toasts
steps:
1. In a soup pot , melt the butter in the oil
2. Add the onion and garlic and cook over medium-high heat until tender , about 5 minutes
3. Add the paprika and cook until it gets fragrant , about 30 seconds
4. Add the tomatoes , water , thyme and bay leaf , then season with salt and pepper to taste
5. Bring to a boil
6. Cover and simmer until the tomatoes start breaking down , about 15 minutes
7. Discard the thyme sprig and bay leaf
8. Preheat the broiler
9. In a blender , puree the soup in batches
10. Strain the soup back into the pot - pressing on the solids stir in the cream and season with salt and pepper again , to taste
11. Meanwhile , put the baguette slices on a baking sheet and broil 6 inches away from the heat until lightly toasted on both sides , about 2 minutes total
12. Top the toasts with the gruyere and broil for about 30 seconds more , until the cheese gets bubbly
13. Ladle the soup into bowls and serve with the gruyere toasts
14. Enjoy !

title: skillet sweet potatoes
steps:
1. Heat oil over medium heat in a nonstick skillet
2. Cook onions , stirring occasionally , until softened and golden
3. Add sweet potatoes and stock to skillet
4. Cover tightly
5. Simmer , stirring every 5 minutes , for about 15 minutes or until tender
6. Season with salt & pepper to taste

title: exotic chicken kebabs
steps:
1. Combine oil , curry and ginger in a bowl
2. Salt and pepper to taste
3. Cut chicken breasts into same sized cubes , and place them in a plastic freezer bag
4. Add marinade and shake to coat the chicken
5. Let it marinade for 30 minutes in the refrigerator
6. Preheat the bbq to high
7. Skewer the chicken breast cubes , diced mango and onions
8. Grill about 6 to 8 minutes , making sure to turn a few times
9. Salt and pepper to taste
10. When ready to serve , sprinkle with fresh coriander and serve with a spinach salad or rice

title: salmon with crab sauce
steps:
1. Cut salmon into four portions and season with 1 teaspoon f the lemon pepper
2. Set aside
3. Melt butter in a saucepan over low-medium heat , wisk in flour and cook until bubbly for 1 minute
4. Slowly wisk in milk and remaining lemon pepper and continue stirring until thick , about 12 minutes
5. Remove from heat
6. Add cream cheese and stir until melted
7. Add lemon juice and zest , green onion and the crab and any liquid from th can
8. Keep warm over a very low heat
9. Broil or pan fry seasoned salmon about 3-5 minutes per side until salmon just flakes when press with a fork
10. Plate salmon and pour crab sauce over each filet

title: garlic ranch chicken
steps:
1. Flatten chicken slightly , and set aside
2. In a shallow bowl , combine milk , and garlic
3. In another shallow bowl , combine the flour , salad dressing mix , and pepper
4. Dip chicken in milk mixture , then coat with flour mixture
5. In a large skillet , cook chicken in oil and butter over medium high heat for 6-8 minutes on each side or until no longer pink

title: thai curry chicken   vegetables
steps:
1. Heat oil over medium-high until hot
2. Stir in 5 spice powder , garlic powder , ginger , peppers , soy sauce and salt
3. Add chicken , cook and stir for 5-8 minutes or until coated with spices and no longer pink
4. Add chicken broth , curry , vinegar and coconut milk
5. Stir
6. Bring to a boil
7. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 20-25 minutes , stirring occasionally
8. Add vegetables to skillet and bring to a boil
9. Cook for 3-5 minutes or until vegetables are tender - crisp
10. Serve over rice

title: butter bean  tuna   celery seed
steps:
1. In a small bowl , whisk the lemon juice with the mustard & a drop or two of hot sauce , then slowly whisk in the olive oil
2. Stir in the chives and season the lemon-mustard vinaigrette with salt and pepper
3. In a large bowl , gently toss the drained tuna with the sliced celery , butter beans and capers
4. Add the lemon-mustard vinaigrette and toss to coat the salad
5. Season the salad with salt and pepper and serve at once

title: twix bar cookies
steps:
1. Shortbread:
2. Preheat oven 350 degrees
3. Grease with butter a 9x9" baking pan
4. In bowl of electric mixer , cream the butter and sugar until light and fluffy
5. Beat in the vanilla extract
6. Add flour and salt and beat until the dough just comes together
7. Press onto the bottom of a greased pan
8. Bake about 20 minutes or until pale golden in color
9. Remove from oven and place on rack to cool
10. Caramel filling:
11. Pour the can of sweetened condensed milk into a heatproof bowl and place bowl over a saucepan of simmering water
12. Cover and cook , over low heat , stirring occasionally , for 60 to 90 minutes or until the milk has thickened and has turned a caramel color
13. Remove from heat and beat until smooth
14. Pour the caramel over the baked shortbread and leave to set
15. Topping:
16. Melt chocolate and butter either in the microwave oven or in a heatproof bowl set over a saucepan of simmering water
17. Pour the melted chocolate evenly over the caramel and leave to set
18. Cut the shortbread in to pieces using a sharp knife
19. Store cut bars in refrigerator to keep chocolate firm
20. Chilled chocolate doesn't cut clean

title: quick cocoa mexicana for one
steps:
1. Combine dry milk , sugar , cinnamon , and cocoa in mug or cup
2. Stir in boiling water
3. Stir in vanilla extract , inhale deeply , and indulge immediately !

title: tarragon orange chicken
steps:
1. Rinse chicken or turkey and pat dry
2. Slice chicken or turkey into thin bit-size pieces
3. Set aside
4. In small bowl , stir together sauce ingredients: water , orange juice , cornstarch , honey , vinegar , chicken bouillon granules , and tarragon
5. Set aside
6. Place wok or large skillet over medium-high heat and add cooking oil
7. Add more oil as needed during cooking
8. Add asparagus
9. Stir-fry fresh asparagus for 4 to 5 minutes or thawed asparagus about 3 minutes or till asparagus is crisp-tender
10. Remove from wok and set aside
11. Add carrots and stir-fry for 3 minutes
12. Add mushrooms and green onions
13. Stir-fry for 1 to 2 minutes more or until carrots are crisp-tender
14. Remove vegetables from the wok
15. Add chicken or turkey to the hot wok
16. Stir-fry for 2 to 3 minutes or till cooked through
17. Push chicken from the center of the wok
18. Stir sauce and add to the center of the wok
19. Cook and stir till thickened and bubbly
20. Return cooked vegetables to the wok
21. Stir all ingredients together , coating with sauce
22. Cook stir another minute to heat through
23. Serve immediately over hot cooked noodles

title: linda s excellent artichoke and spinach dip
steps:
1. Lightly grease a large baking dish
2. Mix all ingredients
3. Place in baking dish and bake at 350 degrees 35-45 minutes
4. Serve with wheat crackers or chips

title: creamed celery with blue cheese
steps:
1. Bring chicken broth to a boil in a large skillet over medium heat
2. Add celery
3. Saut 5 minutes or until tender
4. Add cream cheese stirring until cheese melts
5. Add milk and blue cheese , stirring until well blended
6. Sprinkle with slivered almonds
7. Serve immediately
8. Serves 4
9. Points-1

title: maple beef teriyaki
steps:
1. Mix maple , tamari , veg and sesame oils , and five-spice in large non-reactive bowl
2. Add beef and toss well to coat meat
3. Cover and refrigerate over night
4. Stir occasionally
5. Prepare grill or broiler to med-high heat
6. Drain beef and pat dry w / paper towels
7. Thread meat onto skewers alternately with the onion and bell pepper
8. Grill or broil , turning occasionally , about 6 min for med-rare
9. Makes about 12 skewers

title: stella doro anginetti s
steps:
1. Drain most of the juice from pineapple
2. Cream the cream cheese until soft and add the rest of the ingredients
3. Mix well
4. Split the anginetti's in half , spoon the filling on the lower half and replace the top half
5. Refrigerate before serving

title: salisbury steaks
steps:
1. In a bowl blend: cream of mushroom soup , prepared mustard , worcestershire sauce , prepared horseradish
2. In another bowl mix: egg , bread crumbs , onion , salt , pepper , 1 / 4 cup soup mixture from above , and ground meat and mix well
3. Form into 6 patties
4. Brown patties on both sides on top of stove in lightly oiled pan
5. Mix remaining soup mixture with 1 / 2 cup of water
6. Add to pan
7. Cover and simmer 10-15 minutes or until beef is fully cooked

title: apricot nut spread
steps:
1. Soak apricots in 1 / 2 cup water overnight
2. Drain , reserving 2 tablespoons of the liquid
3. Place apricots and 2 tablespoons reserved liquid into food processor or blender
4. Process for about 10 seconds
5. Add cream cheese and process just until blended
6. Add walnuts and blend until mixed
7. Store spread in the refrigerator

title: cranberry eggnog rolls
steps:
1. Prep time includes rise time
2. In a large mixing bowl combine 1 1 / 2 cups all-purpose flour , whole wheat flour , and active dry yeast
3. Set aside
4. In a medium saucepan heat and stir eggnog , water , granulated sugar , butter , and salt until warm and butter almost melts
5. Add to flour mixture
6. Beat with an electric mixer on low speed for 30 seconds , scraping bowl constantly
7. Beat on high speed for 3 minutes more
8. Using a spoon , stir in an additional 1 1 / 4 cups all-purpose flour
9. Turn out onto a lightly floured surface
10. Knead in enough additional flour to make a moderately soft dough that is smooth and elastic
11. Shape into a ball
12. Place in a greased bowl , turn once
13. Cover
14. Let rise in a warm place until double
15. Punch dough down
16. Turn out onto a lightly floured surface
17. Cover and let rest 10 minutes
18. Meanwhile , in a saucepan heat together brown sugar , butter , and eggnog until mixture bubbles
19. Pour into an ungreased 13x9 inch baking pan
20. Sprinkle with cranberries and walnuts
21. On a lightly floured surface roll dough to a 15x12 inch rectangle
22. Spread with softened butter
23. Sprinkle with mixture of sugar , ground nutmeg , and ground cinnamon
24. Roll up loosely , starting at a short side
25. Moisten and seal edge
26. Cut roll into twelve 1 inch slices
27. Place , cut side down , on top of brown sugar mixture
28. Cover and let rise in a warm place until nearly double
29. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
30. Bake about 30 minutes or until golden brown
31. If necessary , cover loosely with foil the last 5 minutes of baking to prevent overbrowning
32. Remove from oven
33. Let stand 5 minutes on wire rack
34. Invert to remove from pan
35. Cool slightly or completely

title: fruity pebbles cookies
steps:
1. Sift together flour , salt , and baking soda , and stir in cereal
2. Set aside this dry mixture
3. Cream together butter / margarine , oil , vanilla extract and sugar / splenda
4. Add egg to wet mixture and mix well
5. Slowly stir in dry ingredients
6. Add the milk , mixing well
7. Drop with teaspoon onto cookie sheet lightly sprayed with pam or other cooking spray
8. Bake in preheated 350 degree oven for 10-12 minutes or until golden
9. Enjoy with milk !

title: cheese stuffed breadsticks
steps:
1. Separate breadstick dough
2. Open each package of string cheese
3. Divide string cheese pieces in half
4. Take 1 piece of cheese and wrap breadstick dough around it taking care to seal it completely
5. Place each breadstick on a cookie sheet sprayed with pam
6. Spread garlic seasoning that is provided in the package on breadsticks
7. Sprinkle with parmesan cheese
8. Bake at 375 for 11-12 minutes
9. Do not overcook
10. Serve immediately

title: pork steak italiano
steps:
1. In large skillet , brown pork steak
2. Season with salt and pepper
3. Pour peas on top of steaks , cover with tomato sauce
4. Distribute worcestershire sauce and basil over all
5. Cover , simmer for 1 1 / 2 - 2 hours
6. Enjoy !

title: chicken chorizo hotpot
steps:
1. Place all ingredients except the cornflour in a fairly large pan
2. Cover and simmer gently for about 1 hour
3. It should generate enough of its own moisture but check and stir occasionally and add some hot water if necessary
4. When it is ready , combine the cornflour in a cup with enough cold water to make a runny paste
5. Pour the cornflour paste into the stew , stir , and replace the lid for about 5 minutes
6. It will thicken to make a nice gravy
7. I like this with steamed broccoli

title: blue cheese   sun dried tomato dressing
steps:
1. In a food processor or blender combine all ingredients except the 1 cup of the blue cheese and sun dried tomatoes
2. Blend until smooth and creamy
3. Place in a bowl and add the sun dried tomatoes and remaining blue cheese , mix well
4. Refrigerate until needed

title: rice with onions  garlic and herbs
steps:
1. Combine the first 4 ingredients in a food processor and puree
2. Put the oil in a large saucepan over medium heat and add the rice , stirring for a few minutes
3. Stir in all but 1 tablespoon of the onion mixture , add the salt and pepper , and cook for a couple minutes stirring
4. Add the stock and bring to a boil
5. Cover and turn heat to medium / low cooking until liquid is absorbed , about 15-20 minutes
6. Stir in the reserved tablespoon of the onion mixture and serve

title: potato cakes with tuna filling  batata charp
steps:
1. Scrub potatoes and boil in their jackets until tender
2. Drain , peel and mash to a smooth puree
3. Leave to cool
4. Then blend in egg , rice flour or plain flour , sea salt and freshly ground black pepper , to taste
5. Gently fry onion in oil until transparent , add turmeric and fry for a further minute
6. Remove from heat
7. Peel tomatoes , halve crosswise and remove seeds and juice
8. Chop finely and place in a bowl , add onion mixture , tuna , parsley , sea salt and freshly ground black pepper to taste
9. Take about a tbs of the potato mixture and flatten it in the palm of your hand
10. Put a tsp of the filling in the center and close potato around filling
11. Roll into a ball and then roll in flour and flatten to make thick cakes
12. Arrange on a tray
13. Add oil to frying pan to a depth of 1 / 4 inch
14. Heat well and fry potato cakes until golden brown on each side - about 3 minutes in all
15. Drain on paper towels and serve hot on a plate with your choice of condiments

title: hot toddy  spiced red wine   rum
steps:
1. In a saucepan , combine sugar water with the orange juice , rum , wine , cinnamon , and clove
2. Add the lemon rind and bring to a boil
3. Remove lemon rind , and serve drinks very hot , garnished with nutmeg

title: creamy hash browns potato casserole
steps:
1. Preheat overn to 350
2. Placed shredded hashbrowns in large bowl and set aside
3. Bring cream and broth to simmer in small saucepan
4. Remove pan from heat and stir in garlic , butter , and parmesan
5. Pour cream mixture into bowl with potatoes and stir to combine
6. Stir in salt and pepper
7. Scrape potato mixture into 2-qt
8. Baking dish and sprinkle with cheddar cheese
9. Cover with foil and bake for 30 minutes
10. Uncover and continue to bake until top is nicely browned , 20 to 25 minutes
11. Cool for 10 minutes before serving

title: spiced rum orange scone butter
steps:
1. With an electric mixer , cream all of the ingredients together to a smooth and fluffy consistency
2. Serve on freshly baked scones , biscuits , muffins or croissants
3. It's also good as a topping for pancakes , crepes , and bagels
4. Storing
5. For easier spreading , let the spiced butter reach room temperature before using
6. Substitution - if you don't have any rum extract on hand--or you just want to try something different , try replacing the rum extract with 1-2 tablespoons captain morgan's spiced rum , grand marnier , triple sec , cointreau or other orange liqueur

title: simple southern potato salad
steps:
1. After peeling and dicing potatoes place them in a large pot to boil until tender
2. Drain the potatoes , add pickles , onions , and eggs then mix in mayo until its the desired consistancy
3. Mix in mustard
4. Salt and pepper to taste

title: asparagus spears with mushrooms
steps:
1. Place asparagus in skillet , adding just enough water to cover
2. Boil for 5 to 7 minutes , or until asparagus is crisp-tender
3. Drain well , return asparagus to skillet , and add remaining ingredients
4. Cook over medium heat for 5-7 minutes or until mushrooms have heated through

title: super stuffed french bread pizza rustica
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425
2. Defrost spinach in the microwave , 6 minutes on high
3. Wring spinach dry in a clean kitchen towel
4. Split bread lengthwise and hollow it out
5. Cut in half crosswise , making 4 shells for pizzas
6. Heat a skillet over med-high heat
7. Add in olive oil , then the sausage
8. Brown and crumble sausage using a wooden spoon
9. Add in bell pepper , onions , and garlic
10. Cook 3-5 minutes , then add in the spinach
11. Remove pan from heat
12. Season with salt and pepper
13. Transfer mixture to a bowl
14. Mix the sausage mixture with the ricotta , parmesan , sopressata , and pepperoni
15. Fill pizzas with the mixture
16. Top with mounded mozzarella and provolone cheese
17. Place pizzas on a cookie sheet and bake 10-12 minutes until cheese melts and bubbles and bread is super crisp
18. Top pizzas with oregano and hot pepper flakes
19. Serve immediately

title: arkansas avalanche
steps:
1. Pour goldschlager , sprite and grenadine into a cocktail shaker half-filled with ice cubes
2. Shake well , strain into a highball glass , and serve

title: white wine substitute  non alcoholic substitute
steps:
1. Put both ingredients in a bowl and stir well
2. Keep refrigerated till ready for use

title: blue cheese caesar salad
steps:
1. Whisk garlic , anchovies , lemon juice , worcestershire sauce , mayonnaise , and half the blue cheese in a medium bowl until blended
2. Continue whisking while adding oil in thin stream until thickened
3. Cover and chill for several hours if desired
4. Reblend if necessary
5. Toss crisp letuec in very large salad bowl with dressing until thoroughly coated
6. Add croutons and remaining blue cheese and toss again
7. Serve with parmesan cheese

title: garlic mushroom pasta bake
steps:
1. Heat halve the oil in a large frying pan
2. Fry the garlic and mushrooms over a high heat until just browned adding more oil if necessary
3. Remove the pan from the heat and stir in the spinach
4. Meanwhile cook the pasta in a large pan of lightly salted water according to the packet instructions until just tender
5. Drain well and rinse under cold water
6. Preheat the oven to 190c , 375f , gas 5
7. Heat the butter in a pan , then stir in the flour and cook for 1 minute
8. Gradually add the milk , whisking all the time
9. Simmer for 2-3 minutes until thickened
10. Stir in the cheese and season with salt and freshly ground black pepper
11. Stir the pasta into the cheese sauce and add the mushroom and spinach mixture
12. Spoon into a large ovenproof dish and top with tomatoes
13. Bake for 20-25 minutes until golden and bubbling

title: dal makhani  spicy black lentils
steps:
1. Clean , wash and soak the whole black lentils and kidney beans overnight
2. Drain and keep aside
3. Combine the lentils and beans with salt and 2 cups of water and cook till the dals are overcooked
4. Whisk well till the mixture is almost mashed
5. Heat the butter in a pan and add the cumin seeds
6. When the cumin seeds crackle , add the green chillies , cinnamon , cloves , green cardamom , onions , ginger-garlic paste and saut till the onions turn golden brown in color
7. Add the chilli powder , turmeric powder and tomato puree and cook over a medium flame till the oil separates from the tomato gravy
8. Add the dal mixture , water and salt if required and simmer for 10 t 15 minutes
9. Add the cream and mix well
10. Garnish with the cilantro and serve hot

title: apple cinnamon friendship bread
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 325
2. To the remaining batter add eggs , baking powder , oil , baking soda , milk , vanilla , 1 cup sugar , flour , salt , pudding , 2 tsp cinnamon and apples
3. Grease bottom and sides of 2 large loaf pans or spray with pam
4. Mix cup sugar and 1-1 / 2 tsp cinnamon in a small bowl
5. Dust the insides of each of the pans with half of the mixture , making sure to cover the bottom and sides well
6. Pour batter evenly into the 2 pans and sprinkle with remaining sugar mixture over top of the batter
7. Bake for approximately 1 hour cool until the bread loosens from the pan easily
8. Turn onto serving dish
9. May be served warm or cold
10. Enjoy

title: baklava cups
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees
2. Place the shells on a baking sheet
3. Mix the sugar and chopped nuts and fill the shells
4. Bake for 8 minutes or until the shells are lightly browned
5. Mix the honey and water in a small bowl and drizzle over the nuts
6. Serve warm or at room temperature

title: mussakhan  baked chicken on bread  middle east  palestine
steps:
1. Wash cut pieces of chicken , and place in a large pot and cover with water
2. Add salt and let boil
3. Remove froth from the top of pot and let the chicken boil until cooked
4. Mix the onions with the salt and 2 tbsp sumac , and saute in olive oil until tender
5. When chicken is done , remove from broth and rub with salt , 1 tbsp of sumac , and lemon juice , and brush with olive oil
6. Set aside the broth to cool
7. Place the pieces of arabic or pita bread in a baking pan , and pour some of the chicken broth you just made on top of the bread
8. Turn the bread over to make sure both sides are covered
9. Make sure the broth is cooled off completely , otherwise you will end up with soggy bread that you cannot pick up !
10. Place the sauted onions with the olive oil on top of each piece of bread
11. Spread the onions out to cover the top of the bread
12. Place 1-2 pieces of chicken on top of the sauted onions
13. Bake at 400 degrees for 20 minutes , or until the chicken is browned
14. Garnish with the sauted pine nuts

title: kale vegetable medley
steps:
1. Wash the potatoes and cut them into 1 / 2 inch pieces
2. Steam potatoes for about 10 minutes after a boil , until they are just tender
3. While the potatoes steam , wash the kale & discard the stems
4. Chop into 1 inch slices
5. When the potatoes are done , remove from heat , uncover and set aside
6. Heat the oil in a large skillet over medium heat
7. Add the onion , garlic and thyme
8. Saute , stirring often for about 3 minutes or until the onion softens
9. Add the kale and cook over low for 20 minutes
10. Add tomatoes , potatoes and beans and heat for another minute or two
11. Season with salt & pepper to taste , serve immediately

title: german skillet
steps:
1. In a skillet melt butter
2. Layer with sauerkraut , rice , onion and beef
3. Sprinkle with salt and pepper
4. In a bowl , combine water and tomato sauce
5. Mix well
6. Pour over beef mixture
7. Bring to a boil
8. Reduce heat
9. Cover and simmer for 50 minutes or until meat is no longer pink and rice is tender

title: hiker s chowder
steps:
1. Saute the onion and smoked sausage pieces until lightly browned
2. Mix all the ingredients in a large pot and simmer at least 1 hour
3. For a thinner chowder , add some of the reserved broth from the potatoes

title: dian s cajun pasta salad
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to directions
2. While the pasta is cooking combine the rest of the ingredients in a large bowl
3. Rinse the pasta under cold water to cool and stop the cooking process
4. Add the rinsed pasta and enjoy ! refrigerate leftovers if you have any !

title: big mac daddy roni salad
steps:
1. In a medium saucepot , boil water and add salt
2. Add pasta , cook until al dente , about 8-9 minutes , and place into an ice water bath
3. In a medium mixing bowl add mayonnaise , garlic , mustard , and vinegar
4. Mix to combine and place in refrigerator to keep chilled while pasta cools
5. To cool quickly , spread pasta on a baking sheet and place in refrigerator for about 20 minutes , or till cool
6. When pasta is cool , mix in mayonnaise mixture and all vegetables
7. Mix thoroughly , season with salt and pepper
8. Place into refrigerator and chill for 1 hour for the flavors to combine
9. This is even better the next day !

title: scottish pancakes  pikelets
steps:
1. Sift together the flour , sugar , and baking soda in a large bowl
2. Slowly add the egg and milk while stirring constantly until smooth
3. Place a skillet over medium heat
4. Lightly coat with butter
5. Pour 1 / 8 cup of batter into the skillet
6. Cook until bubbles appear on the surface of the batter
7. Flip and continue to cook until lightly browned on the bottom , 1-2 minutes on each side
8. Reapply butter to the skillet between batches
9. Serve with butter and jam

title: cheeseburger noodle casserole
steps:
1. Prepare noodles according to the directions on the box
2. While the noodles are cooking , saute beef , onions and garlic together in a pan sprayed with cooking spray
3. Drain
4. Into meat mixture , add chopped green chilies , tomatoes , and red pepper flakes
5. Mix well
6. Drain noodles , and in a casserole dish , mix together noodles and meat mixture
7. Mix cheese into the noodles and meat , until it has melted
8. Salt and pepper to taste
9. Goes well with a fresh green salad

title: greek egg lemon chicken rice soup
steps:
1. Boil the chicken until done , 15-20 minutes
2. Remove the chicken from the stock and debone
3. Hold chicken meat on the side
4. Add the rice to the chicken stock and cook at a boil for ten to fifteen minutes , or until done
5. Meanwhile , beat two eggs in a bowl and add the lemon juice
6. Measure one cup of hot stock
7. Add slowly to the bowl containing the eggs and lemon and continue to beat until combined
8. Add egg mixture into stockpot
9. Add chicken meat , stir well and serve
10. Makes 6 servings

title: chicken on the run
steps:
1. Rub salt and pepper into the chicken pieces and then place them into a casserole dish
2. Pour over the apricots and their juice
3. Sprinkle the dried soup mix over the chicken and apricots
4. Drizzle the wine over the top
5. Bake at 375 f for 1 hour 15 minutes

title: not my grandma s chicken salad
steps:
1. Tear lettuce into small pieces and place into bowl
2. Add red pepper and onion
3. Add ramen noodles
4. Add chicken and mayonaise
5. Mix well
6. Add salt and pepper for taste
7. Serve with tomatoes on your favorite bread and just by it self

title: roasted eggplant  aubergine  dip
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Lightly pierce eggplant with a fork and brush with 1 t olive oil
3. Place on a foil lined cooke sheet and roast , turning occasionally until the flesh is tender
4. Let cool slightly
5. Remever the skin from the eggplant and place in a food processor with yogurt , garlic , parsley , tahini , lemon juice , red pepper flakes and remaining olive oil
6. Process until smooth
7. Adjust seasoning and serve on top of bruschetta , with pita chips or vegetables

title: tilapia   spinach bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. In a small bowl , mix the spinach , 1 / 2 c cheddar cheese , 1 / 4 c bread crumbs , egg , onions and garlic powder
3. Spread the mixture into the bottom of a 9-inch square or 7x11-inch baking dish
4. Arrange the tilapia on top of the spinach and season with tarragon , parsley , salt and pepper
5. Top with the remaining cheddar cheese and bread crumbs
6. Cover and bake 15-20 minutes , or until fish flakes easily with a fork

title: cream of chanterelle soup
steps:
1. In a saucepan , heat the olive oil , then add the onion , garlic and chanterelles
2. Cook until the onions are transparent
3. Dust with the flour
4. Add the white wine and chicken stock
5. Stir to combine
6. Simmer for 30 minutes
7. Add the heavy cream and simmer for another 5 minutes
8. Add salt and pepper to taste
9. Serve in prewarmed bowls , and garnish with chives or parsley

title: instant strawberry peach frozen yogurt
steps:
1. Place the yogurt , honey and vanilla in the work bowl of a food processor and process until just smooth
2. While the machine is running , drop the frozen fruit down the feed tube in a steady stream until it has combined with the yogurt into a smooth mixture
3. Garnish with strawberry halves and serve immediately

title: pistachio goat cheese balls
steps:
1. Bring goat cheese to room temperature
2. Using your hands , roll forty-eight 1 / 2-inch balls , and place them on a piece of parchment paper
3. Shake the nuts in a fine mesh sieve to remove dust , then place in a small shallow bowl
4. Roll each cheese ball in the nuts to coat evenly
5. To serve , arrange the spinach leave on a serving tray , and place each cheese ball on a leaf

title: atomic hot sauce
steps:
1. Roasted all the peppers and bulb of garlic outdoors on the grill is best for fumes may over take the home
2. I also peeled the hot peppers outdoors
3. Place all but vinegar in food processor and blend till smooth and fine
4. Place in a large pot , mix in vinegar
5. Heat ad boil stirring often for 30 minutes
6. Fill sterilized hot bottles or jars
7. Give jar a hot water bath for 10 minutes
8. Pepper jar invert

title: slow cooker lasagna
steps:
1. In a skillet , cook beef , onion and garlic over medium heat until meat is no longer pink
2. Drain
3. Add the tomato sauce , water , tomato paste , canned tomatoes salt , oregano , italian seasoning
4. Mix well
5. Spread a fourth layer of the meat sauce in an ungreased 5 quart slow cooker
6. Arrange a third of the noodles over the sauce ,
7. Repeat meat and noodle once
8. Put layer of cottage cheese
9. Repeat layer of meat then layer of noodles
10. Top with remaining meat sauce
11. Cover and cook on low for 4-5 hours or until noodles are tender
12. Cover with mozzarella and parmesan cheese , and turn on high until cheese melts
13. Delicious !

title: peaked and tweaked tater tot casserole
steps:
1. Brown the ground beef , onion , and garlic in a heavy skillet
2. Drain off excess fat
3. Place the meat mixture back in the skillet and add the soups and a handful of the cheese
4. Once the cheese is melted , add the seasonings and sour cream
5. Place the heated mixture into a greased 9 x 13 inch pan
6. Top with remaining cheese
7. Place tator tots in rows on top of the cheese
8. Bake in a 350 degree oven until tator tots are golden brown
9. I have also used mased potatoes instead of the tator tots

title: old fashioned baked beans
steps:
1. Soak beans overnight , well covered with cold water
2. Pour off soaking water and pick over beans to remove any bad ones , or debris
3. Put beans in a pot
4. Cover with fresh cold water and add 1 tsp
5. Baking soda
6. Bring to a boil and cook until skins of beans crack when you take one out on a spoon and blow on it
7. Cut onion in quarters and put in bottom of a bean crock or large casserole
8. Add the partially cooked beans
9. Put cut up salt pork on top
10. Combine brown sugar , molasses , mustard and salt with 1 1 / 2 cups boiling water
11. Pour over the beans
12. Add more boiling water , if needed , to come just to the top of the beans
13. Also , if needed during baking tme , add more boiling water
14. Bake , covered , at 300 degrees f for 6 hours , or until beans are tender

title: pineapple pepper jelly
steps:
1. Bring boiling-water canner , half-full with water , to simmer
2. Wash jars and screw bands in hot , soapy water
3. Rinse with warm water
4. Pour boiling water over flat lids in saucepan off the heat
5. Let stand in hot water until ready to use
6. Drain jars well before filling
7. Pare and finely chop or grind pineapples
8. I prefer grinding because it releases the juices better
9. Place 3 layers of damp cheesecloth or jelly bag in large strainer over bowl
10. Pour prepared fruit into cheesecloth
11. Tie cheesecloth closedand let drip into bowl until dripping stops
12. Press gently
13. Measure exactly 3 cups juice into 6- or 8-quart saucepot
14. You should have enough juice , but if you don't you can add up to 1 / 2 cup water , or unsweetened canned pineapple juice
15. Add finely ground peppers to juice
16. Stir sugar into juice in saucepot
17. Add butter to reduce foaming , if desired
18. Bring mixture to full rolling boil on high heat , stirring constantly
19. Stir in pectin quickly
20. Return to full rolling boil and boil exactly 1 minute , stirring constantly
21. Remove from heat & skim off any foam with metal spoon
22. Ladle quickly into prepared jars , filling to within 1 / 8 inch of tops
23. Wipe jar rims and threads
24. Cover with two-piece lids
25. Screw bands tightly
26. Place jars in a water bath canner , water must cover jars by 1 to 2 inches
27. Add boiling water if needed
28. Cover
29. Bring water to gentle boil & process 5 minutes
30. Remove jars and place upright on a towel to cool completely
31. After jars cool , check seals by pressing middle of lid with finger
32. (if lid springs back , lid is not sealed and refrigeration is necessary

title: boston cream cheesecake
steps:
1. Grease bottom of 9-inch springform pan
2. Prepare cake batter as directed on package
3. Pour into prepared pan
4. Bake at 325f for 25 minutes if using a silver springform pan
5. Cool
6. Beat cream cheese , granulated sugar and 1 teaspoon of the vanilla in large bowl with electric mixer on medium speed until well blended
7. Add sour cream
8. Mix well
9. Add eggs , 1 at a time , mixing on low speed after each addition just until blended
10. Pour over cake layer in pan
11. Bake at 325f for 40 to 45 minutes or until center is almost set if using a silver springform pan
12. Run knife or metal spatula around rim of pan to loosen cake
13. Cool before removing rim of pan
14. Place chocolate , milk and butter in medium microwavable bowl
15. Microwave on high 2 minutes or until butter is melted , stirring after 1 minute
16. Stir until chocolate is completely melted
17. Add powdered sugar and remaining 1 teaspoon vanilla
18. Mix well
19. Spread over cooled cheesecake
20. Refrigerate 4 hours or overnight

title: roasted parmesan potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Place butter in a 9 x 13 pan and place in the oven to melt
3. While butter melts , wash and quarter potatoes
4. In a large ziploc bag , mix together flour , salt , pepper , garlic powder , paprika , parsley , rosemary and cheese
5. Add potatoes to bag and shake well to coat with flour mixture
6. You can do this a few at a time if you wish
7. Remove baking dish from oven and as you place each potato piece in the dish roll it in the butter
8. Arrange pieces in a single layer
9. Bake until potatoes are tender and brown , about 50 minutes
10. Sprinkle with chives before serving
11. Melt butter in a small dish in the microwave
12. Place potatoes in sprayed pan and drizzle with the melted butter before baking

title: perfect smoked pork chops
steps:
1. Start your work at least 8 hours before you want to eat
2. Brine the meat
3. In a bowl or pot large enough to hold chops and 1 gallon of water , combine brine ingredients
4. Start with 2 cups of hot water to dissolve salt and sugar
5. After salt & sugar are completely dissolved , add more cold water and some ice to bring volume to 1 gallon
6. Make sure the brine solution is cold and add chops -- they should be completely submerged
7. Cover and refrigerate for 6-8 hours
8. Smoke the chops
9. Smoking methods can vary
10. I use a barrel-smoker with an external firebox
11. Other methods will work , but be sure your temperature stays in the range of 175-200 f and never expose the chops to direct heat
12. When fire / smoke is ready , remove pork from brine and pat dry with paper towel
13. Place in smoker
14. Use hickory , mesquite or apple wood , smoke for 1 hour
15. At this point , the chops can be cooked or reserved in refrigerator for several hours
16. Cook the chops
17. Just before cooking , apply about 1 tablespoon of the rub to both sides
18. Grill on direct heat
19. This will take about 30 minutes
20. Be prepared to move the chops to indirect heat for a while of they are getting too brown prior to being done
21. Cook to an internal temperature of 140f remove from grill and rest 5 minutes before serving
22. Meat will be pink and very juicy -- don't worry about the pink ! as long as you achieve a temperature of 140 in the thickest part of the chop , it's safe to eat
23. If you prefer a more well-done chop , cook to 150 before removing from heat
24. But , in my opinion , at that temperature , you've just wasted a day's work

title: yummy apple mango cobbler
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Combine the apples , mango slices , 1 / 2 cup sugar and water in a sauce pan and mix well
3. Bring to boil and let it simmer for 7-8 minute
4. Put the butter in 8x8 square baking dish
5. Place it in the oven until it melts
6. Mix flour , remaining 1 / 2 cup sugar , baking powder and milk
7. Mix well
8. Pour mixture over melted butter
9. Do not stir
10. Spoon fruit on top , gently pour syrup on top as well
11. Sprinkle with ground cinnamon
12. Bake for 35-40 minute until its light brown and clean toothpick comes out clean

title: greek meatloaf with feta
steps:
1. In a large bowl , stir the spices and crushed crackers into the ground beef
2. Stir the eggs into the milk , stir into meat mixture
3. Mix in the feta cheese and press into a 9x13 pan
4. Cover loosely with foil
5. Bake for 30 minutes , at 350 , drain
6. Resume baking without foil for 15 minutes or until done

title: ham   cheese ring
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Mix chopped ham , onion & parsley w / brandy & allow to sit for 20 minutes
3. Whisk eggs w / salt , paprika , mustard & cottage cheese or cream cheese
4. Combine ham & egg mixtures & ladle into a well-buttered 2-pint fluted mold
5. Stand mold in a roasting pan half-filled w / water & cook for 40 minutes
6. Allow to cool till well-set & able to be easily handled
7. Then carefully turn out onto a serving plate , cut into cake-like wedges & serve

title: tomato cheese pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. In a medium bowl combine the bisquick , 1 / 2 cup parmesan cheese and buttermilk and mix until just blended
3. Pat into the bottom and up the sides of a lightly greased 9 inch pie plate
4. Bake for 7 minutes
5. Toss the tomato slices with the flour and arrange one layer over cheese crust
6. Sprinkle with 1 / 2 cup of feta , 1 / 2 of the onion , basil , salt and pepper
7. Repeat without the feta layer
8. Stir together the remaining parmesan , mustard mayo , and 1 cup of the feta
9. Spread evenly over top of pie
10. Bake for 25 minutes or until lightly browned
11. Remove and let stand 15 minutes on a wire rack before cutting
12. Real or imitation crab is an awesome addition for a whole meal pie with a side salad

title: chocolate oatmeal chunk cookies
steps:
1. Beat butter and sugars at medium speed with an electric mixer until creamy
2. Add eggs and vanilla , beating well
3. Combine flour , baking soda , and salt
4. Add to butter mixture , mixing well
5. Stir in oats , morsels , and pecans
6. Drop by rounded tablespoonfuls unto ungreased baking sheets
7. Baking at 350 for approximately 9 minutes until golden
8. Cool slightly on baking sheets
9. Transfer to wire racks to cool completely

title: galley wench s spice sea chili
steps:
1. In a large pot brown ground beef , sausage , onion and garlic , breaking meat into small pieces
2. Drain of excess grease
3. Add poblano pepper and cook for about 2 minutes
4. Stir in tomatoes , tomato sauce , brown sugar , 1 cup beer and one can of black beans
5. Add ground cumin , chili powders , chipoltes , adobe sauce , oregeano , and cocoa
6. Bring to a boil , cover and turn down to a simmer and cook for 35 - 45 minutes , adding additional beer or broth as needed
7. Drain the remaining can of beans and lightly mash
8. To thicken , add the crushed black beans and adjust spices and liquid as needed
9. Bring to a simmer again for 5 minutes
10. Squeeze in juice of one lime before serving
11. Garnish with cilantro cream recipe
12. Serve with cornbread or tortillas

title: royal energy bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 275f
2. Spread apples on parchment lined baking sheet
3. Bake for approximately 90 mintues or until apples are the consistency of raisins , then let cool
4. In large bowl combine oats , coconut , sunflower seeds , pumpkin seeds and cereal
5. Set aside
6. Add dates and sunflower butter to oat mixture and work thoroughly together with hands until well combined and mixture holds its shape when squeezed
7. Mix in dried apples
8. Line an 8 x 11 inch baking dish with parchment paper or aluminum foil and fill with apple mixture , pressing firmly to compact
9. Refrigerate for 1 hour , remove from baking dish and slice into 16 pieces
10. Wrap each piece with plastic wrap and store in the refrigerator for up to 2 weeks or in the freezer for up to 2 months

title: simple beef stroganoff
steps:
1. Prepare the egg noodles according to package directions and set aside
2. In a separate large skillet over medium heat , saute the ground beef over medium heat for 5 to 10 minutes , or until browned
3. Drain the fat and add the soup and garlic powder
4. Simmer for 10 minutes , stirring occasionally
5. Remove from heat and combine the meat mixture with the egg noodles
6. Add the sour cream , stirring well , and season with salt and pepper to taste

title: mouth watering baked chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Wash chicken thoroughly and cut into individual pieces
3. Melt butter and pour just enough in casserole dish to coat the bottom
4. Sprinkle each piece of chicken with seasoned salt , pepper and garlic
5. Place pieces of chicken in dish
6. Slice onion and place on each piece of chicken
7. Pour remaining melted butter over top of onions and chicken
8. Place in oven and bake uncovered
9. This is good served with cresent rolls , a salad , mashed potatoes and green beans or steamed broccoli with melted cheese and a baked potato

title: my very popular banana cake with caramel icing
steps:
1. Grease a 14cm x 21cm loaf tin
2. Cream butter and sugar in a small bowl until light and fluffy , preferably with an electric mixer
3. Beat in the eggs one at a time and transfer the mixture into a large bowl
4. Stir in mashed banana
5. Stir in half sifted dry ingredients and half sour cream and milk
6. Stir well
7. Stir in remaining dry ingredients and sour cream
8. Stir until smooth
9. Pour mixture into pan
10. Bake in a moderate over for about 1 hour
11. Stand for five minutes before turning onto a wire rack to cool
12. Icing:
13. Melt butter and sugar , stir constantly without boiling for two minutes
14. Add sour cream , bring to boil
15. Remove from heat , stir in sifted icing sugar
16. Ice immediately as it sets very quickly

title: sambuca cafe ole
steps:
1. Combine the coffee , cream , sambuca , coffee liqueur and ice cubes in a cocktail shaker
2. Shake until well combined
3. Pour the coffee mixture among serving glasses and serve immediately

title: indian tacos  and fry bread
steps:
1. Mix the first 10 ingredients in a large sauce pan or skillet
2. Simmer on low heat for about 30 minutes or until fry bread is done
3. While this is simmering make fry bread
4. Fry bread:
5. Sift dry ingredients
6. Lightly stir in milk
7. Add more flour as necessary to make a dough you can handle
8. Knead and work the dough on a floured board with floured hands until smooth
9. Pinch off fist-sized lumps and shape into a flat disk shape
10. Fry in fat until golden and done on both sides , about 5 minutes
11. Drain on paper towels
12. Place hot fry bread on a plate
13. Spread a layer of refried beans
14. Top with meat sauce and shredded cheese
15. Add lettuce , tomatoes , salsa , etc
16. If desired

title: pumpkin soup with cilantro cream
steps:
1. Cilantro cream:
2. Whisk all ingredients together in a small mixing bowl
3. Spoon into a plastic squeeze bottle
4. Refrigerate , can be made 1 day ahead
5. Soup:
6. Melt butter in large sauce pan over medium heat
7. Add onions , carrots and celery
8. Saute 10 minutes
9. Stirring occasionally
10. Stir in pumpkin , chicken broth , cumin and cayenne
11. Bring to a boil , reduce heat and simmer uncovered 15 minutes
12. Stirring occasionally
13. Puree the mixture , using a hand blender until smooth
14. Add the half and half and cook over medium heat until heated through , about 5-10 minutes
15. Ladle soup into serving bowls , drizzle with cilantro cream and sprinkle with pepitas

title: white pizza with shellfish
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400
2. Place pizza crust on a greased baking sheet
3. Brush with oil
4. Sprinkle pizza with cheese and garlic
5. Scatter scallops , shrimp , tomato and green pepper on top
6. Season with salt and pepper
7. Bake on bottom oven rack until seafood is cooked and cheese is bubbly , about 15 minutes

title: strawberry icee hcg phase 2
steps:
1. Place all ingredietns into a blender or magic bullet
2. Serve immediately

title: tomata feta salad
steps:
1. For dressing , combine green onions , oil , vinegar , mustard , pepper , basil and sugar in a small bowl or shaker
2. Whisk / shake well
3. To serve , arrange tomato slices , onion slices and cucumber slices in layers on a platter
4. Top with feta cheese
5. Drizzle dressing over salad and serve

title: gluten free pastry
steps:
1. Using a pastry cutter of knife , blend the butter into the flour until in resembles breadcrumbs
2. Add the water and bring together into a soft ball of dough
3. Wrap in cling film and leave to stand for 30-60 minutes
4. Roll out gently and use as per your recipe ,

title: original tennessee barbecue beef   crock pot
steps:
1. Put all ingredients on crock pot
2. Stir well to combine
3. Cook on low setting for about 10 hours

title: baked kielbasa   beans
steps:
1. Drain 1 can of the pork & beans
2. Throughly mix together with the undrained can of pork & beans
3. Add the teriyaki baste & glaze , brown sugar , onion , and mustard in a 2-quart casserole
4. Arrange kielbasa on top of beans in a spoke like fashion
5. Cover and bake in a 400 degree oven 30 minutes , or until hot and bubbly

title: smashed potatoes with spinach
steps:
1. Place potatoes , garlic , and enough water to cover in a medium saucepan
2. Bring to a boil , then reduce heat and cook , covered , until the potatoes are fork-tender
3. Add in the spinach , stirring , just until wilted
4. Drain the potatoes , garlic , and spinach
5. Return the mixture to the saucepan and add sour cream
6. Mash with a potato masher until the mixture is chunky
7. Stir in the chives , salt , pepper , and nutmeg and serve at once

title: o charley s spinach dip
steps:
1. Thaw , drain , and squeeze dry the spinach
2. Mix all ingredients together thoroughly
3. Heat in microwave until hot , stirring frequently
4. Serve with tortilla chips

title: another garlic shrimp recipe
steps:
1. Place shrimp in a large broiler safe pan and pre-heat broiler , set aside
2. In a large saute pan , melt butter and oil until bubbly
3. Add garlic and saute 1-2 minutes-- be careful not to burn garlic
4. Add the dijon mustard , chili flakes and salt and stir until well blended
5. Pour sauce over shrimp and broil for approximately 5 minutes or until shrimp has turned pink
6. Remove from broiler and place on large platter , sprinkle with lemon juice and fresh parsley
7. Serve with fresh bread and extra lemon

title: cool chicken cones
steps:
1. Combine first 5 ingredients
2. Season to taste
3. Line cones with lettuce , and spoon in filling
4. Enjoy !

title: mexican beef stir fry
steps:
1. Trim excess fat from the steak
2. Slice steak diagonally across the grain into 1 / 8 inch strips
3. Set aside
4. Combine oil , garlic , cumin , and oregano
5. Stir well
6. Heat half of oil mixture in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat for 2 minutes
7. Add onion , red pepper , and jalapeno pepper , and stir-fry 2 minutes , or until crisp-tender
8. Remove vegetables from the skillet
9. Set aside , and keep warm
10. Add remaining oil mixture to the skillet
11. Add the reserved beef strips , and stir-fry 2 minutes
12. Return vegetables to the skillet and stir-fry until thoroughly heated
13. Serve over lettuce , and garnish if desired

title: bow tie salad with scallops  black olives  oranges  and mint
steps:
1. In a large pot of boiling , salted water , cook the bow ties until just done , about 15 minutes
2. Drain , rinse with cold water , and drain thoroughly
3. Meanwhile , season the scallops with 1 / 4 teaspoon of the salt and 1 / 8 teaspoon of the pepper
4. In a large nonstick frying pan , heat 1 tablespoon of the oil over moderately high heat
5. Sear the scallops , in two batches if necessary , until brown and just done , 1 to 2 minutes per side
6. Let cool
7. Using a stainless-steel knife , peel the oranges down to the flesh , removing all of the white pith
8. Cut the sections away from the membranes and put them in a large glass or stainless-steel bowl
9. Squeeze the juice from the membranes into the bowl
10. Add the remaining 4 tablespoons oil , the lemon juice , olives , onion , mint , and the remaining 1 / 2 teaspoon salt and 1 / 8 teaspoon pepper
11. Stir to combine
12. Add the pasta and scallops and stir again

title: oriental veggie puff pastry pasties
steps:
1. Place puff pastry sheets on a paper-lined baking sheet and allow to thaw until pliable
2. Roll out each piece to make it slightly bigger
3. Cook your frozen mixed veggies according to package directions and drain well
4. Mix veggies , hummus and spices in a bowl
5. Place about 2 heaping tbs of the veggie mix on the bottom part of each pastry sheet leaving a space around the edges
6. Using a brush or your fingers apply some water to the edges of each pastry sheet and fold down the top to make a pocket enclosing the filling
7. Now spread some yogurt on each pastie as a glaze
8. Place in the pre-heated oven and bake at 200c / 400f for 15 minutes or until puffy and brown on top
9. Enjoy !

title: no rise pizza dough
steps:
1. Sprinkle the yeast over 1 / 4 cup of water and stir in 1 tbl of the flour
2. Once it is puffy , stir into the rest of the water and add the olive oil
3. Add 1 1 / 2 cup flour , mix well
4. Knead on flour covered board 4-6 minutes , adding more flour if necessary
5. Cover and let rest 10 minutes
6. Divide dough in half to make two 12 inch rounds or use all of it for one deep dish
7. Top and bake as recommended for your favorite recipe

title: the people s pizza
steps:
1. Squeeze whole red tomatoes into a bowl with the rest of their juices and pour in vinegar with salt and pepper , cover and allow to sit for a minimum 30 minutes or overnight
2. In a saucepan saute onions and garlic in olive oil for 5-7 minutes , before pouring in the tomato mix and the rest of the ingredients
3. Bring to a boil , turn heat to low and simmer for 30 minutes
4. Transfer to a vitamix or blender , blitz until smooth and pour into a jar or airtight container
5. It lasts for 7 days and it can be used for any tasty option :)
6. Turn broiler to high and set up trays to be 6 inches below
7. If you have a pizza stone place in the oven to get searing hot
8. Spread an even layer of the sauce over the dough , finish with your favorite pizza toppings and cook in the oven for 2-4 minute or until dough is crispy and cheese is well melted

title: slow roasted beef atk
steps:
1. Season all sides of roast evenly with salt
2. Wrap with plastic wrap and refrigerate 18 to 24 hours
3. Adjust oven rack to middle position and heat oven to 225 degrees
4. Pat roast dry with paper towels
5. Rub with 2 teaspoons oil and season all sides evenly with pepper
6. Heat remaining 1 tablespoon oil in 12-inch skillet over medium-high heat until just smoking
7. Sear roast until browned on all sides , about 12 minutes
8. Transfer roast to wire rack set in rimmed baking sheet
9. Roast until meat registers 115 degrees , 1 to 1 hours , or 125 degrees , 1 to 2 hours
10. Turn oven off
11. Leave roast in oven , without opening door , until meat registers 130 degrees or 140 degrees , 30 to 50 minutes longer
12. Transfer roast to carving board and let rest for 15 minutes
13. Slice meat as thin as possible and serve

title: bosnian sataras  satarash
steps:
1. You will want to add the vegetables in this order to the cooking pan , onion , pepper and tomato
2. I usually cut the onion up first , into rings and then i either halve or quarter the rings depending on how large the onion is
3. It doesnt have to be chopped into small peices , but it's totally up to you
4. Heat a medium sized non-stick skillet over medium heat until it starts to get hot
5. Then add the oil and let the oil sit for 30 seconds or so until it gets hot
6. Add the chopped up onion and let it cook on medium heat for about 5-10 minutes or until it starts getting soft and translucent
7. While the onion is cooking , start chopping up the yellow pepper into strips about a quarter of an inch thick and as long or short as you like
8. Once the onion is nice and soft , add the yellow pepper
9. Let that cook for about 10 minutes or more , until it becomes soft
10. Make sure not to let the veggies burn at all , they should just be nice and soft during the cooking process
11. You may need to add a little more oil if the 2 tablespoons isnt quite enough to keep everything nicely coated
12. I usually have enough oil in the pan to let the veggies sort of "simmer" in it
13. You may want to add a little water here and there as well to keep the sauce from getting thick and from burning on the pan
14. The sauce should be thin enough to spoon onto meat and potatoes but thick enough to keep it's consistency
15. I usually add the water around the time where the tomatoes are added
16. Once the pepper starts getting soft , cut the tomato up into quart inch thick slices , again the length is up to you , and add to the onion and pepper mixture
17. Let the juices from the tomato cook out into the pan to add some more liquid
18. I usually lower the temperature on the stove to a nice simmering temp at this point
19. You can keep the skin on the tomato and let it shrink as the tomato cooks
20. Once you notice the skin starting to shrink up and almost peel away from the tomato , add the paprika and let it cook a few minutes to let the flavor come out of the paprika
21. Then add vegeta to taste
22. I usually add about at least a teaspoon , just depends on how salty and flavorful you like it
23. Spoon over potatoes , mashed , roasted , baked , anything

title: bangladeshi egg with paratha
steps:
1. For preparing egg:
2. In a bowl beat the eggs and add chopped onions , chopped green chili , chopped coriander leaves , coriander powder , black pepper , salt and tasting salt
3. Mix all the ingredients well
4. Now in a non-stick frying pan , heat butter and oil together
5. When butter is melted completely , add the egg mixture in butter and oil
6. When you think that the lower part of the egg has become brown , turn it to the other side
7. When the egg has been cooked , take off from stove
8. Remember that the fire of the stove while frying should not be large , it should be medium
9. For preparing paratha:
10. In the flour add milk , margarine , and salt
11. Mix with the help of spoon
12. Now make dough by adding bit warm water
13. Keep on adding until you get a soft dough
14. Making dough is not so easy
15. Be careful about the amount of water
16. You may do it in dough maker
17. Now keep on spreading this dough with the help of your hands
18. While spreading , you may spread some dry flour on your palm
19. You will now get a flat circle bread
20. In a non-stick frying pan , heat shortening
21. Put this paratha on frying pan and when lower part becomes light brown turn it to other side
22. When you think it is cooked well take in a flat dish
23. Serve it with the fried egg
24. For garnish use sliced carrots , cucumber and rose flower which is made of tomato peel and two or three mint leaves with it
25. Enjoy this great meal at lunch or at evening meal when you think of eating something delicious and different

title: vegetable pasta bake
steps:
1. Mix spaghetti sauce , pasta , vegetables and 1 / 2 cup of the parmesan cheese
2. Spoon into 13x9-inch baking dish or 3-quart casserole
3. Sprinkle with mozzarella cheese and remaining 1 / 4 cup parmesan cheese
4. Bake at 375 degrees for 20 minutes

title: special chocolate eggnog
steps:
1. In large bowl , beat together yolks , sugar , cocoa and vanilla until thick and smooth
2. Slowly stir in milk and rum , mix well
3. Cover and refrigerate until just before serving , at least two hours , so mixture becomes very cold
4. Beat whites with salt to soft peaks
5. Fold whipped cream into chocolate mixture , gently fold in whites
6. Serve immediately , garnished with grated chocolate

title: split pea soup  crock pot    dairy free
steps:
1. Layer ingredients in crockpot
2. Pour in water , so don't stir
3. Cover and cook on high 4-5 hours or on low for 8-10 hours
4. Remove bay leaf
5. Serve with some nice crusty bread or buns

title: sweet and spicy herbed chicken
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , blend the olive oil , soy sauce , honey , and vinegar
2. Mix in the thyme , paprika , cayenne pepper , allspice , and black pepper
3. Place chicken in a medium baking dish , and coat with the olive oil mixture
4. Let marinate at least one hour , or even longer
5. Sprinkle with sesame seeds if desired
6. Place chicken in a preheated 375f oven , and , basting occasionally with the olive oil mixture , cook 30 minutes , or until no longer pink and juices run clear
7. Serve over the rice with remaining olive oil mixture

title: easy salisbury steak and mushroom gravy
steps:
1. In a large bowl , whisk the egg with 2 tsp worcestershire sauce , 1 tsp mustard , 1 / 2 tsp salt and 1 / 4 tsp pepper
2. Add the beef , sausage , breadcrumbs , onion and garlic and mix until well combined
3. Shape into 4 oval patties about 1 / 2 inch thick
4. Heat the oil and 1 tbsp of the butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat until the butter stops foaming
5. Add the patties and cook , flipping once , until well browned and cooked through
6. Transfer to a plate and cover to keep warm
7. Wipe out the skillet
8. In a small bowl , stir 2 tbsp of the beef broth with the cornstarch
9. Melt the remaining 1 tbsp butter in the skillet over medium-high heat
10. Add the mushrooms and 1 / 2 tsp salt and cook , stirring occasionally , until the mushrooms are browned
11. Add the remaining beef broth , 1 tsp worcestershire , and 2 tsp mustard
12. Stir the cornstarch mixture again and then whisk it into the skillet
13. Cook , whisking occasionally , until the mixture is slightly thickened
14. Season to taste with salt and pepper
15. Return the patties to the skillet to reheat

title: apple crumble
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Coat a 12 x 8 inch baking dish with non-stick cooking spray
3. Cut apples in half lengthwise
4. Remove the cores and stems and discard
5. Cut the apples into thin slices
6. Place the apples and applesauce in the prepared baking dish
7. Toss to coat the apples evenly with the applesauce
8. Spread out evenly in the baking dish
9. In a small bowl , mix the oats , brown sugar , wheat germ and cinnamon
10. Drizzle with the oil
11. Add the butter
12. Mix with your fingers to work the oil and butter into the dry ingredients
13. Sprinkle the oat mixture evenly over the apples
14. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes , or until topping is golden and apples are bubbling
15. Serve warm

title: crock pot caramel rice pudding
steps:
1. Spray inside of 3 quart crock pot with nonstick cooking spray
2. Combine all ingredients in crock pot
3. Cover and cook on low for 3-4 hours or until liquid is absorbed and mixture is thickened
4. Stir well
5. Serve warm

title: herb baked fish
steps:
1. Mix dry ingredients together and set aside
2. Dip thawed fish fillets in milk to coat
3. Place in bread crumb mixture and coat completely pressing crumbs to adhere
4. Place fish fillets in greased baking dish
5. Drizzle melted margarine over fish
6. Bake at 500 degrees on top rack of oven for 10-12 minutes , or until fish flakes easily with a fork

title: pork chop bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Sprinkle salt and pepper on chops and brown in skillet
3. Pick an oven pan large enough to fit the number of chops and potatoes you are cooking
4. Spray bottom of pan with pam
5. Layer potatoes
6. Sprinkle with seasonings
7. Place mushrooms on potatoes
8. Mix soup , milk , and seasonings
9. Pour over chops
10. Cover tightly with foil and bake 1 hour for 6 chops
11. 45 minutes for 2
12. Chops and potatoes should be tender

title: crispy parmesan ranch chicken breasts  strips or tenders
steps:
1. Grease a 13 x 9-inch baking dish
2. Set oven to 350 degrees f
3. In a shallow dish mix together the cornflake crumbs with parmesan cheese , garlic powder black pepper and dry ranch dressing mix
4. Place the melted butter in a shallow dish
5. Coat the chicken breast or strips into the melted butter , then roll into the cornflake mixture
6. Place in prepared baking dish
7. Bake uncovered for about 30 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through

title: honey oatmeal  bread
steps:
1. Mix boiling water , oats , honey , and olive oil and let it sit 10-15 minutes
2. Meanwhile mix dry ingredients in standing mixer with dough hook- otherwise us bowl and wooden spoon
3. Make well in top of dry ingredients and add yeast
4. Start up mixer again and add the wet ingredients - add last 1 / 4 cup of warm water if needed
5. Dough should form ball after a minute or two in the mixer with the dough hook- if you are mixing by hand do so until it forms a ball
6. Dough should not feel sticky to the touch
7. Let it rise in a greased bowl for 1 hour- it should double in size
8. Form it into 1 loaf and put it in a buttered loaf pan
9. Let it rise again until doubled in size- about 45 minutes
10. Bake at 375 for 25-30 minutes or until sides separate a bit from the sides of the pan and it sounds hollow when you knock on the bottom

title: slow cooker hearty chili with beef or venison
steps:
1. Cook and drain meat
2. Add all ingredients except cheese to the crock pot
3. Mix ingredients well
4. Cook on low heat for 6 hours
5. When serving , top each bowl with shredded cheese

title: grandma lula s lime salad
steps:
1. Put jello and marshmallows in a mixing bowl
2. Pour boiling water over both
3. Stir to dissolve jello and melt marshmallows
4. In another bowl , mix cream cheese and whipping cream until smooth and creamy
5. Add cream cheese mixture and pineapple to jello and stir well
6. Add nuts if desired
7. Mix well
8. Pour in mold if desired or in the bowl you plan to serve the salad in and refridgerate for 3-5 hours

title: stacy s favorite vegetable beef soup
steps:
1. Heat vegetable oil in a large stew pot
2. Add the stew meat and thoroughly brown on all sides
3. Add red wine and deglaze pot , stirring in all the brown bits on the bottom until the wine is reduced by at least 1 / 2
4. Add the chopped onion and minced garlic and saute for about 5 minutes longer
5. Dump in all the other ingredients and stir well
6. Bring to almost a boil , then cover and reduce the heat to a simmer
7. Let simmer , covered with the lid slightly ajar , 1 hour , stirring occasionally , until all vegetables are tender
8. Add more salt and pepper to taste , if desired , and discard the bay leaf

title: smoked salmon tartare on toasted points
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine the salmon
2. Onion , capers , and lemon juice and mix thoroughly
3. Season with freshly ground black pepper , to taste ,
4. Combine the sour cream and dill in a small bowl and mix thoroughly
5. Top each toast points with about 1 / 2 teaspoon of "tartare" and a small dollop of dill sour cream
6. Garnish with a pinch of freshly ground pepper
7. Arrange on a small platter , garnished with fresh dill sprigs and lemon wedges

title: tropical wave
steps:
1. Arrange banana , pineapple , and mango in a single layer on a baking sheet
2. Freeze until firm
3. Remove from freezer , and let stand 10 minutes
4. Combine fruit , nectar , and juice in a blender
5. Process until smooth
6. Serve immediately

title: cranberry spice tea cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325
2. Spray cookie sheets with non-stick cooking spray and set aside
3. In a medium bowl , combine the butter , splenda and vanilla
4. With electric mixer , beat on medium until butter is softened
5. Add egg substitute and orange peel , mixing briefly
6. Add the cornmeal , flour , baking powder , cinnamon , and nutmeg
7. Mix on low speed until dough is formed
8. Stir in cranberries until blended evenly , taking care not to overmix
9. Divide the dough in half and roll each into a log about 1-inch in diameter
10. Cover with plastic wrap and freeze approximately 1 hour , allowing dough to chill
11. Remove dough from freezer , unwrap and cut into slices about 1 / 4-inch thick
12. Place 1-inch apart on prepared baking sheet
13. Bake 8-10 minutes or until lightly browed
14. Remove to wire rack to cool

title: baked cereal squares  gluten free
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Mix dry ingredients and make a well in the center of the bowl
3. Mix wet ingredients in the well , then stir everything together , using your hands to form a ball
4. Place ball of dough on a greased cookie sheet and roll out as thin as possible
5. Optional: at this point you can score the dough with a pizza cutter or knife so that it will easily break apart into uniform shapes when done
6. Bake for 12-15 minutes or until edges are browned and cereal feels slightly crisp and dry
7. If not dry , turn oven off and leave in longer
8. Remove from oven and break into small pieces
9. Store in an airtight container

title: creamy cauliflower soup with corn and mushrooms
steps:
1. Place the broth , potato , carrot , cauliflower , onion and garlic cloves together in a medium soup pot
2. Bring to boil and cook for 15 minutes or until the potatoes and cauliflower are tender
3. Place the vegetables along with some broth in a blender and puree until smooth
4. Do this in batches if need be to avoid splattering
5. Put the pureed vegetables back in the pot and put on low heat
6. Add the remaining ingredients except for the spring onions and cheddar and cook until the mushrooms are done
7. When the mushrooms are tender add the green onions , salt and pepper to taste , stir , and then ladle into bowls and top with 1 / 2 oz of cheddar per bowl
8. Enjoy !

title: lighter shrimp scampi
steps:
1. Set broiler rack 4 inches from heat
2. Place shrimp in a large broiler proof rimmed baking sheet
3. Sprinkle with oil and garlic and season generously with salt and pepper
4. Add 1 / 4 tsp red pepper flakes
5. Toss to coat
6. Arrange shrimp in a single layer
7. Broil 3-4 minutes , until opaque throughout
8. Sprinkle with lemon juice , toss to combine
9. Serve immediately

title: seven layer shrimp dip with mango salsa
steps:
1. Cream the cream cheese , sour cream , worcestershire sauce , lemon juice , pepper , garlic together until smooth
2. Spray the springform pan with a non-stick shortening spray
3. Spread the cream cheese mixture in 9" springform
4. Layer the spread the green chiles over the cream cheese mixture
5. Next layer the mango salsa , green onions , chopped shrimp , and black olives
6. Top with shredded cheese
7. Garnish with the chopped cilantro
8. Refrigerate until ready to serve
9. Place on large plate and remove springform sides
10. Serve with corn tortilla chips

title: smoked bucket chicken  native american style chicken
steps:
1. Well , you're going to need as well:
2. A 5 gallon metal bucket
3. 3 wooden stakes
4. Tin foil
5. 8 lb
6. Bag of matchlight charcoal
7. Cotton string
8. Make or acquire 3 sturdy wooden stakes
9. Drive them into ground after laying down foil
10. Place the stakes close enough together so that you can fit the three chickens on them and still fit bucket over them]
11. Place seasoned chickens , breasts outwards , on stakes , and tie string around them tightly so that when cooking , nothing falls off
12. Once chickens are placed and tied , spray a lot of butter all around the chickens and season them some more
13. You're almost there !
14. Place hickory chips around and underneath the chickens
15. Put bucket over chickens and pour all the charcoal around the bucket
16. Light it up !
17. The chickens should cook for at least 3-3 1 / 2 hours

title: my mom s very popular spaghetti sauce recipe
steps:
1. Saute ground beef
2. Add onion , celery and carrots , cook until soft
3. Add every thing else !
4. Simmer , for a good while
5. I usally don't time it , but let it sit on stove for at least an hour , some times two
6. I just add a bit more water if it gets too thick before supper time
7. Stir often , so it does not burn on bottom !

title: chipotle pork with strawberry avocado salsa
steps:
1. For pork , combine all but the salt in a large plastic zipper bag
2. Marinate in refrigerator , turning the bag occasionally , for 2 hours
3. Remove pork and discard marinade
4. Sprinkle pork evenly with salt
5. Grill pork over indirect heat for about 20 minutes , or until internal temperature reaches 155
6. Let stand 10 minutes
7. Slice crosswise
8. For salsa , combine all ingredients in a medium bowl and toss gently
9. Serve immediately with the sliced pork

title: fiddlehead pasta primavera
steps:
1. In saucepan of boiling water , cook fiddleheads for 5 to 7 minutes or until just barely tender
2. Refresh under cold running water and drain well
3. Set aside
4. In small bowl , beat eggs until smooth
5. Stir in cream , salt , pepper and 2 tbsp
6. Of the parmesan cheese
7. Set aside
8. In large skillet , melt butter over low heat
9. Cook mushrooms , garlic , ham and basil for 5 minutes or until mushrooms are tender , stirring occasionally
10. Add fiddleheads and peas
11. Simmer for 3 minutes
12. Meanwhile , in large pot of boiling salted water , cook pasta until al dente
13. Drain well
14. Add to fiddlehead mixture
15. Remove from heat
16. Pour egg mixture over top
17. Toss
18. Sprinkle with remaining parmesan and large grinding of pepper
19. Serve immediately , passing extra cheese
20. Makes 4 servings
21. Canadian living

title: egg salad sandwiches with roasted red peppers and capers
steps:
1. Place eggs in a medium saucepan in a single layer
2. Add enough water to cover eggs by 1 inch
3. Bring to a boil over high heat
4. Reduce heat to medium and simmer for 10 minutes
5. Remove eggs with a slotted spoon and plunge them into an ice-water bath
6. Shell the eggs and chop them into 1 / 2-inch pieces
7. Set aside
8. Meanwhile , in a large bowl , combine next 7 ingredients
9. Make sure to dice the red peppers and parsley
10. You also want to drain the capers
11. Mix well
12. Add eggs and mix gently to combine
13. Spoon egg salad onto 4 bread slices
14. Top with lettuce leaves and second slice of bread

title: oven fried chicken breasts  or fish
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f combine bread crumbs , wheat germ , salt , onion powder , sugar and red pepper in a shallow dish or pan
2. Place a wire rack coated with cooking spray on a baking sheet
3. Coat chicken with egg and then dredge in the bread crumb mixture , covering the meat completely
4. Shake off excess and place on wire rack
5. Coat with cooking spray and bake for 35 minutes or until cooked through

title: lemony potato  broccoli and goat cheese salad
steps:
1. Boil the potatoes for 12-15 mins until tender
2. Lift out with a slotted spoon , drain well then place in a serving bowl with the oil , lemon zest and juice
3. Leave to cool
4. Add the broccoli and beans to the pan of boiling water
5. Cook for 4 mins until tender but still with some bite
6. Drain then cool under running water
7. Stir the drained broccoli and beans into the cooled potatoes with the dill and salt and pepper
8. Brake the goat cheese into chucks and scatter over with the pine nuts if using
9. Serve

title: peach rum sauce
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a large stainless or enamel pot
2. Bring to a boil , stirring until sugar dissolves
3. Boil gently stirring often until thick-around 20-30 minutes
4. Ladle into clean hot jars leaving 1 / 4 inch head space
5. Process 10 minutes in a boiling water bath at altitudes up to 1000 feet

title: thomas keller s caramel popcorn
steps:
1. Pop the popcorn
2. To make the caramel , place the sugar , corn syrup , and 1 / 4 cup water in a large saucepan and cook until the caramel turns a light golden brown
3. Add baking soda and butter to the caramel
4. Then add the popcorn to the hot caramel and stir with a wooden spoon until the popcorn is evenly coated
5. Pour the caramelized popcorn onto a parchment-paper-lined baking sheet and set aside to cool
6. Break up the popcorn with your hands
7. Serve in colored-cellophane bags

title: grilled caribbean chicken with pineapple salsa
steps:
1. Drain pineapple juice into a 1-cup measuring cup
2. Add oil , lime juice , garlic , red pepper flakes and sugar
3. Mix well to make the marinade
4. Place chicken in a large resealable food storage bag
5. Pour all but 1 tablespoon of marinade over the chicken
6. Seal bag
7. Refrigerate 30 to 45 minutes
8. To make salsa , combine pineapple , red pepper , red onion , jalapeo pepper , cilantro and reserved 1 tablespoon marinade in a medium-sized serving bowl
9. Toss well
10. Season with salt and pepper to taste
11. Heat grill to medium
12. Remove chicken from marinade
13. Discard marinade
14. Season chicken with salt and pepper
15. Grill , turning once , for 10 to 15 minutes or until cooked through and juices run clear
16. Serve with pineapple salsa

title: cake decorator s frosting
steps:
1. Using electric mixer , cream shortening until very soft
2. Add salt , a little powdered sugar and flavorings
3. Alternately add water and powdered sugar , beating on medium speed until frosting is smooth after each addition
4. Do not mix on high speed as it will cause bubbles in the finished frosting
5. For the top of the cake
6. Decorations: roses , leaves and other decorations can be made by adding tasteless food coloring paste to the frosting
7. Make decorations , place on plastic wrap on cookie sheet and cover gently with plastic wrap
8. Freeze for up to 1 month
9. If you decide to freeze your frosted cake , do not put the decorations on it until after you have thawed both the cake and decorations , as the colored decorations will bleed into the cake frosting when they thaw
10. Defrost cake and decorations separately and then place decorations on the cake
11. Variations: for chocolate frosting , add 3 tbs powdered cocoa to the sugar mixture
12. For lemon , omit butter and vanilla flavorings and add 3 tsp
13. Lemon extract
14. Colored frostings: frosting can be made any color you want with tasteless food coloring , but be sure to mix well after adding the coloring
15. Wedding cakes: five recipes of this frosting will decorate wedding cakes as follows: top layer 6-inch cake , middle layer 14-inch cake and bottom layer 18-inch cake
16. This will serve 50-60 people

title: teriyaki salmon with marmalade butter
steps:
1. Make the marmalade butter by thoroughly combining the butter and marmalade a stand mixer with a paddle is ideal
2. Roll the butter in parchment paper into a 1" wide log and store in the refrigerator to harden
3. Heat the oil over medium-high heat
4. Add the garlic , ginger root and orange zest and cook two minutes
5. Add the soy sauce , wine , sesame oil and honey and cook until the alcohol has evaporated
6. Sniff the fumes to determine this
7. If the fumes irritate your nose , there is still alcohol present
8. Cool completely
9. Pour marinade over the salmon and refrigerate for at least two hours
10. Broil or grill the salmon for three minutes per side and top with the marmalade butter

title: tortilla beef casserole
steps:
1. Fry hamburger in skillet until browned
2. Drain well
3. Combine soup and salsa together and mix well
4. Add salsa-soup mixture to hamburger and mix well
5. Place hamburger mixture in a greased 3-qrt
6. Casserole dish
7. Bake , uncovered at 350 degrees for 25-30 minutes
8. Sprinkle with crushed tortilla chips and cheese
9. Bake 3-5 minutes longer or until cheese is melted

title: flavored butter  sweet brandy
steps:
1. Beat 3 tablespoons of brandy , 2 tablespoons of icing sugar into the butter till very smooth and spoon into a pretty jar and refrigerate
2. For gift:
3. Wrap each butter roll in foil and then tissue paper , twisting the ends like a sweet wrapper
4. Add a label with the flavour
5. Include suggestions for uses or recipes and bundle together in a gift basket

title: white chocolate fruit tarts
steps:
1. You may choose to purchase 2 large flat round yellow spongy tart shells from your grocery store instead of making your own
2. If making tart shells:if you do want to make your own tart shells , you will need 2 round tart pans as well as 2 circles of parchment paper , cut to fit inside the pans
3. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
4. Spray the tart pans with nonstick spray or grease lightly and set the parchment circles in the base of each
5. Either use you favorite yellow cake batter recipe or a box mix and prepare the batter according to the package directions or your recipe
6. Pour only 2 1 / 2 cups of the batter into each pan- there will be some extra batter if you have used a mix
7. Bake both tarts together on the same oven rack for 25-30 minutes or until golden brown
8. Let cool 10 minutes upright before removing from pans , but don't pull off the parchment until the tart shells have cooled completely
