9. If using purchased tart shells start here: prepare the glaze by combining the pineapple juice , lemon juice , cornstarch , and sugar in a small saucepan
10. Bring to a gentle boil , stirring constantly , over medium heat
11. Boil 2 minutes or until thickened
12. Let cool completely- can be made ahead and chilled , but make sure this is at room temperature before attempting to spread on fruit
13. For the filling: if you haven't already done so , melt the white chocolate chips according to the package directions and let cool slightly
14. Combine melted& slightly cooled white chocolate with the room temperature cream cheese and the cool whip or sweetened whipped cream
15. If you prefer a thicker layer of filling , you can double the recipe
16. Spread evenly into the base of the cooled tart shells using a cake spatula
17. Have your fruit all ready to go and make sure it is not dripping wet
18. Layer fruit in rings on top of the creamy filling , starting from the outermost edge , alternating pieces of fruit decoratively as desired to create colorful spirals of fruit , filling each tart shell completely
19. You may have extra fruit left over or you may need more of a particular type of fruit , depending upon you preferences
20. Brush glaze over fruit using a pastry brush
21. Store the completed tarts , covered with plastic wrap , in the refrigerator
22. Each tart serves about 10-12 people

title: self basting ham loaf
steps:
1. Prehat oven to 350 degrees
2. Spray a cooke sheet with cooking spray
3. In a large bowl mix all of the loaf ingredients well
4. Shape into a loaf on cookie sheet
5. Bake@ 350 degrees for 1 1 / 2 hours

title: apple cookies
steps:
1. Cream together sugars and shortening
2. Add eggs and vanilla
3. Stir in dry ingredients alternately with sour cream
4. Fold in apples , nuts , and raisins
5. Drop by tablespoonfuls onto cookie sheet
6. Bake at 325 about 8-10 minutes or until light brown

title: minty onion tomato salad
steps: 1. Layer ingredients , cover and chill 2 hours or more

title: not sagna pasta toss
steps:
1. Bring a large pot of water to a boil for pasta
2. Salt the water and cook pasta al dente
3. Save a ladle of the starchy pasta water to form the sauce
4. Heat a deep nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
5. Add oil , then add meat
6. Brown meat and then add onions , garlic , and red pepper flakes
7. Season with salt , pepper , worcestershire and allspice
8. Cook for another 5 minutes , then deglaze the meat mix with red wine
9. Cook off for 1 minute and then stir the stock into the meat
10. Stir in the tomatoes and bring it to a bubble
11. Reduce heat to a simmer for 5 minutes
12. Place the ricotta cheese in the bottom of a shallow bowl
13. Add a ladleful of boiling , starchy pasta water to the ricotta and stir to combine them
14. Add the parmesan cheese to the ricotta and mix it in
15. Toss the hot pasta with cheese mix
16. Add half of the meat sauce to the pasta mix
17. Toss to combine
18. Tear or shred basil and add it to the meat and pasta
19. Add rest of meat sauce and toss to combine everything
20. Serve with more parmesan cheese

title: grilled ham   pineapple burgers
steps:
1. Snip enough basil to equal 1 / 3 cup
2. In large bowl combine half the snipped basil and ground ham
3. Shape in four 3 / 4-inch-thick patties
4. Grill patties on rack of charcoal or gas grill , covered , directly over medium heat for 14 to 18 minutes , turning once , until patties register 160 degrees f with instant-read thermometer
5. Add pineapple to grill during last 6 minutes of grilling time for patties , turning once
6. Meanwhile , in bowl combine mayonnaise , mustard , honey , and remaining snipped basil
7. Spread on cut side of roll bottoms
8. Layer patties , remaining basil leaves , pineapple , and roll tops

title: myrtlewood pecan pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f degrees
2. In a food processor , process the cream cheese , 1 egg , 1 / 3 cup sugar and 1 teaspoon vanilla until fluffy
3. Spread the mixture in the bottom of the unbaked pie shell
4. Sprinkle the pecans over the cheese mixture
5. For the filling , beat the 3 eggs with an electric mixer until foamy
6. Add the corn syrup , 1 / 4 cup sugar , 1 teaspoon vanilla and the salt and combine
7. Pour over the pecans
8. Bake for 60 minutes
9. Serve warm or cold

title: autumn s best mulligatawny   chicken
steps:
1. In soup-pot , cook chicken , water , salt and two of the onions , celery and carrots
2. Bring to a boil , then reduce heat , cover & simmer for at least a half-hour
3. More finely chop the remaining onion , then in a large frying pan , saute onions in oil until transparent
4. Add chopped apples , continue sauteeing for 4-5 minutes , then add garlic to the pan
5. Quickly sprinkle flour and curry powder over the apple-onion mixture , mix and cook for about 1 minute
6. Remove one cup of broth from soup-pot , and pour slowly over the apple-onion mixture , stirring all the while
7. Add another cup of broth if you'd like , and let it simmer for about 5 minutes
8. Slowly pour roux from frying pan into soup-pot
9. Stir well to blend
10. Simmer for another half-hour
11. Serving suggestion: put 1 / 2 to 1 cup of rice in each bowl or over egg noodles , spoon stew-soup over rice and garnish with parsley
12. Optional variations: figure one piece of meat per serving
13. Or use 3-4 cups of meat picked from the turkey carcass at thanksgiving
14. Or add giblets to the stock as it cooks for additional flavor
15. Or use bite-size chunks of breast meat in place of the whole bird
16. Substitution: replace the water with chicken soup stock or bouillon
17. Warning: do not mix rice or noodles with the soup when you put away the leftovers -- the soup will turn into a soggy mess of curried pudding
18. Unless you like that sort of thing --

title: sweet thai chili chicken wings
steps:
1. In a bowl whisk together peanut oil , rice vinegar , 2 teaspoons soy sauce , garlic , ginger and chili oil
2. Place chicken wings in marinade and toss to coat
3. Cover and refrigerate for at least 1 hour
4. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
5. Line a baking sheet with aluminum foil
6. Place marinated chicken wings on top , cook 20 25 minutes or until chicken is cooked through and skin has darkened
7. Turning once
8. In another bowl whisk together sweet thai chili sauce , 1 teaspoon of sriracha and remaining teaspoon of soy sauce
9. Taste and add more sriracha if desired
10. Transfer hot wings to the bowl and toss to coat
11. Serve with plenty of napkins

title: amaretto coffee creamer
steps:
1. In a screw-top lid jar , place all ingredients and shake well to blend
2. Add 1-2 tablespoons of creamer to 6 ounces of coffee
3. Enjoy !

title: grilled zucchini   fig salad with a yogurt dressing
steps:
1. Heat griddle pan to medium heat
2. Brush zucchini slices with olive oil on both sides and grill for 3 minutes on each side until charred with stripes
3. Brush the fig quarters with olive oil and grill for 3 minutes in total , turning once
4. To make the dressing: whisk the yogurt , sugar and some salt & pepper in a bowl and thin it to drizzling consistency with the milk
5. Stir in the sliced spring onion
6. Shortly before serving , toss the spinach with enough olive oi to coat it and season with a squeeze of lemon juice and a pinch of salt
7. Mix the spinach leaves into the zucchini slices and figs on a large serving plate
8. Drizzle with dressing and sprinkle with chopped mint

title: ham  apple  and cheese omelet
steps:
1. In a bowl , combine the apple , cheese , and ham
2. Set aside
3. In another bowl , whisk the eggs , water , salt , and pepper together
4. In an 8-inch omelet pan or nonstick skillet over medium heat , melt the butter
5. Swirl to coat the bottom of the skillet
6. When butter foams , pour in egg mixture all at once
7. Let set until edges start to cook , about 20 seconds
8. Using a spatula , gently lift edges of mixture and
9. Continue doing this until the top is almost dry
10. Spoon cheese mixture over of the omelet
11. Fold over the other half to cover
12. Let stand a few seconds
13. Turn out onto a warmed plate
14. Serve immediately

title: pioneer woman s coffee cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease and flour two round baking pans
3. In a large bowl , mix sugar , flour , and 1 / 4 teaspoon salt
4. Set aside
5. Melt 2 sticks of butter in a pot over medium-low heat
6. While thats melting , add 3 tablespoons instant coffee to 1 cup boiling water
7. Set aside
8. Once butter has melted , add coffee mixture to the butter in the pot
9. Let it come to a boil for about ten seconds , then turn off the heat
10. Set aside for just a minute
11. In a separate bowl , add buttermilk , eggs , baking soda , and vanilla
12. Mix until well combined
13. Pour the butter / coffee mixture into the flour mixture
14. Stir the mixture together gently
15. The purpose here isnt to mix it together perfectly , but to cool down the heat before adding the egg mixture
16. Add in the egg mixture and stir gently until well combined
17. Then pour into pans
18. Bake for 20 to 22 minutes or until set
19. Allow to cool completely
20. Combine all icing ingredients , then ice the cake
21. Chill for an hour before serving

title: cobb salad wraps
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine the chicken , avocado , bacon , celery , onion , olives and cheese
2. In another small bowl , combine the lemon juice , honey , mustard , garlic , dill weed , salt and pepper
3. Whisk in the oil
4. Pour over the chicken mixture
5. Toss to coat
6. Place romain lettuce on each tortilla
7. Top with 2 / 3 cup chicken mixture , then with tomatoes
8. Roll up tortilla to make wraps

title: strawberry ripple coffee cake
steps:
1. 1
2. Beat butter and sugar in large mixer bowl until light and fluffy
3. Add 3 / 4 cup of the flour
4. Mix slowly just until mixture forms coarse crumbs
5. Set aside 2 / 3 cup of the crumb mixture
6. Add eggs , powder , salt , soda , cinnamon and nutmeg to remaining mixture in the bowl
7. Beat until smooth
8. Add the remaining 1 1 / 4 cups flour 1 / 2 cup at a time alternating with the buttermilk , beating until smooth after each addition
9. Spread batter in a greased 9x9 square baking pan
10. Drop jam by teaspoons onto the batter
11. Pull knife through the batter to give it a marbled effect
12. Sprinkle the reserved crumb mixture on top
13. Bake in a preheated 350f degrees oven until wooden toothpick inserted in centre is withdwarn clean , 30-35 minutes
14. Serve warm
15. Stir and let sit for 5 minutes

title: thunder thigh pecan pie
steps:
1. Beat together sugar , flour , cornsyrup , vanilla and eggs
2. Stir in the pecans& butter pour into the pie crust
3. Bake at 350f for 40-50 minutes or until the center is puffed and golden , cool& serve

title: egg   bacon muffin
steps:
1. Spray large frying pan with olive oil spray
2. Add bacon and eggs , cook to yoour liking , turning bacon once
3. Meanwhile , toast muffins , and spread with butter
4. On one half of each muffin , layer with cheese , bacon then egg
5. Top with relish , and other half of muffin

title: cajun oven fried potato chips
steps:
1. Pat the potato slices dry using paper towels
2. Arrange the potato slices in one layer on two buttered cookie sheets pans
3. Brush the slices with melted butter
4. Bake in a 500 degree oven for 15-20 minutes or until the edges are golden brown
5. Sprinkle lightly with cajun seasoning and coarse salt

title: mediterranean cheese ball
steps:
1. Beat cream cheese and feta cheese at medium speed with an electric mixer until smooth
2. Stir in the olives , capers , red pepper , basil , and garlic
3. Shape cheese mixture into a ball
4. Cover and chill at least 3 hours
5. Roll in the toasted pine nuts just before serving

title: ww 2 points   kellogg s rice krispies treats
steps:
1. Lightly coat a large nonstick saucepan or pot with cooking spray
2. Add the marshmallows , butter buds , water , vanilla , and salt to the pan and set over med / low heat
3. Stir constantly until completely melted
4. Remove from heat
5. Add rice krispies and stir until completely coated
6. Spray a 9x13 inch baking pan with cooking spray
7. Pour the rice krispies mix into the pan
8. Moisten your hands and press the mixture into the pan until flat
9. When the mixture cools completely , cut 4 times down and 4 across , making 25 bars
10. 2 points per serving

title: toasted quinoa  snow peas  tomatoes and mozzarella salad
steps:
1. Toast quinoa in a medium sauce pan , about 5 minutes
2. Add 3 cups of water to the pan , and bring to a boil
3. Cover , reduce heat , and simmer 15 minutes or until tender
4. Fluff with a fork and cool
5. In a large bowl , combine quinoa and peas , mozzarella , onion , cucumber , mint , basil , and tomatoes
6. Whisk lemon rind , juice , and olive oil in a small bowl
7. Toss with quinoa mixture to coat

title: spent grain beer bread
steps:
1. Proof yeast in mixture of water and sugar
2. You should see krausen in less than an hour
3. Put spent grain in large mixer bowl
4. Mix in starter , and start adding flour
5. Keep adding flour until the dough is smooth and no longer sticky
6. Place dough in a large bowl , cover with a clean towel , and let rise until doubled
7. Punch down dough , and either:
8. A) split into two loaves and place in greased bread pans
9. B) form into a round loaf and place on cookie sheet with a thin layer of corn meal under the loaf
10. Allow loaf to double in size , bake in 375 f oven 30 to 40 minutes until browned and a long pin , such as a turkey pan , comes out clean after being inserted into the center of the loaf

title: broccoli salad with apricots
steps:
1. Dressing:
2. Mix together the vinegar , mayo , miracle whip and sugar and mix well
3. Combine the remaining ingredients except nuts and bacon bits and mix with the dressing
4. Mix in the bacon bits and pecans just before serving
5. Chill before serving for about 30 minutes
6. Fell free to add additional fruit to taste

title: vegetable casserole  grnsaksgratin
steps:
1. Heat 1 inch salted water to boiling
2. Add carrots , beans , cauliflower and onion
3. Heat to boiling
4. Reduce heat
5. Cover and simmer until tender , 12 to 15 minutes
6. Drain vegetables , reserving 1 cup liquid
7. Place vegetables in ungreased 11 x 7-inch baking dish or 8-inch square baking dish
8. Heat butter over low heat until melted
9. Blend in flour , salt and pepper
10. Cook over low heat , stirring constantly , until mixture is smooth and bubbly
11. Remove from heat
12. Stir in reserved liquid and whipping cram
13. Heat to boiling , stirring constantly
14. Boil and stir 1 minute
15. Remove from heat
16. Pour sauce over vegetables
17. Sprinkle with cheese
18. Set oven to broil or 550 degrees f
19. Broil until top is light brown and bubbly , 3 to 5 minutes

title: award winning cinco de mayo guacamole with blue cheese and sage
steps:
1. Combine onion , tomato , jalapeno , cilantro , cumin powder , kosher salt and garlic in a bowl
2. Mix well , cover , and sit in refrigerator for at least 60 minutes
3. Chop 1 avocado into small chunks
4. Add to bowl with other ingredients
5. Mush remaining 2 avocados and add to bowl
6. Fold into mixture
7. Add blue cheese and bacon crumbles
8. Fold again , try not to stir the guacamole up too much , as you want to maintain the firmness of the avocados as much as possible
9. Add tabasco , chipolte powder , sage and six pepper blend to taste
10. Fold in as necessary
11. Squeeze 1 / 2 lime over mixture
12. Fold in again
13. Serve with chips and enjoy !

title: german coffee cake with nuts and chocolate   nusskuchen
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f
2. For best removal of cake: thoroughly grease pan with melted butter
3. Put it in the fridge for 5 minutes
4. Remove , fill with 2 tablespoons flour , shake pan over the sink until evenly dusted with flour
5. Discard any loose flour
6. Keep dusted pan in fridge until filling
7. Mix flour with baking powder
8. Beat egg whites with a pinch of salt in a large clean bowl with clean beaters until stiff but not dry
9. Set aside
10. In another large bowl beat soft butter and sugar until creamy white and fluffy
11. Add egg yolks , one at a time , beat until light in color and increased in volume , about 3 minutes
12. Put nuts and chocolate into bowl with the butter and egg yolks and mix a few seconds on low until just blended
13. Sift flour over mixture
14. Don't mix
15. Put 1 cup of egg white on flour
16. With a rubber spatula fold flour and the cup egg white into nut mixture , this will be rather stiff , but it does not need to be blended completely
17. Give rest of egg white on nut mixture and fold it in until completely blended
18. Fill batter evenly into pan
19. Bake in the middle of the oven for 60-75 minutes
20. If it browns too much reduce heat by 15 degrees and cover loosely with parchment paper
21. Test doneness by inserting a wooden skewer into the middle of the cake
22. If only melted chocolate but no crumbs stick to it the cake is done
23. Remove from oven
24. Let cool in pan for 10 minutes , then carefully lay it on the side and let cake slip out of form
25. You may cut with a thin knife along the sides between cake and pan to make sure it will come out
26. Best eaten while still a little warm but will keep several days
27. Dust with a little powdered sugar before serving if you like
28. Cut into 1 / 2 inch slices
29. Serve with a dollop of sweetened whipped cream
30. I usually make it with hazelnuts , and think this tastes slightly better than with walnuts :)

title: enzo s penne a la vodka
steps:
1. Saute onions in butter and olive oil until transparent
2. Add shredded
3. Or pureed tomatoes with juice
4. Cook over medium heat 20 to 25 minutes or until all liquid content is reduced
5. Meanwhile in separate saucepan , cook pasta according to package directions , drain very well and set aside
6. When tomato sauce is ready , stir in heavy cream
7. Bring to a near boil , reduce heat and cook 2 to 3 minutes until cream and tomatoes are well blended
8. Stir in sauce and pepper vodka , mix , stir in hot cooked penne pasta
9. Stir together to blend
10. Liberally sprinkle with grated parmesan cheese
11. -rosalind beck chef's
12. Red crushed pepper in 4 tbsp vodka
13. Marinate 3 hours or overnight
14. Using coffee filter or fine cloth napkin , allow peppered vodka to filter 3 hours
15. Remove and discard filter and set peppered vodka concentrate aside
16. Penne is large straight tubes of macaroni cut on the diagonal

title: chicken liver and tarragon pate
steps:
1. Melt a large knob of the butter in a large frying pan and cook the chicken livers for 3-4 minutes on each side until well browned but still slightly pink in the centre
2. Place in a food processor and whizz until smooth
3. Remove the pan from the heat , add the brandy and swirl around to gather up the pan juices
4. Add to the food processor with the garlic , tarragon and the remaining butter and whizz again until well blended
5. Add some salt and pepper followed by the cream and process again until well mixed
6. Spoon into 6 ramekins , smoothing the surface level , and leave to cool completely
7. To finish off , melt the butter and pour over the surface of the pate
8. Drop in a few tarragon leaves as decoration
9. Cover with cling film and chill for at least a few hours , but up to a day or two
10. Serve straight from the fridge with hot , buttered toast , or melba toast if you're feeling posh

title: ham and tomato omelet
steps:
1. Mix eggs and pepper parsley and chives
2. In pan heat butter until melted
3. Add eggs
4. Cook until almost set
5. Alternate ham slices with tomatoes
6. On half of omelet
7. Flip over top and sprinkle with cheese
8. Cover for a minute while cheese melts
9. Slide onto plate

title: bean and salsa dip
steps:
1. Place first 11 ingredients in a 4 quart slow cooker
2. Stir well
3. Cover with lid
4. Cook on low for 2 to 4 hours
5. Turn slow cooker off
6. Stir in cilantro
7. Sprinkle cheese over dip
8. Cover and let stand 5 minutes or till cheese melts
9. Serve with tortilla chips

title: asian chicken cashew dish
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients except the nuts in a slow cooker
2. Cover , cook on low 4-9 hours or on high for 2-3 hours
3. Stir in cashew nuts , before serving
4. Serve over white rice
5. 6

title: raspberry peach freezer jam
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 250-degrees f
2. Place sugar in a pan and warm in oven for 15 minutes
3. Combine raspberries , peaches , mint and warm sugar in a large bowl
4. Let stand 10 minutes , stirring occasionally
5. Add lemon juice and pectin to mixture , and stir constantly for 3 minutes or until sugar is dissolved
6. Spoon jam into clean jars or plastic containers and cover with tight fitting lids
7. Let stand at room temperature until set
8. Refrigerate for up to 3 weeks or freeze

title: roasted garlic couscous with tomatoes   basil
steps:
1. Cook couscous as directed but omit the butter and use olive oil instead , just a few good swirls in the water
2. Chop everything up and toss together with a fork !

title: soulfully good pork spareribs with pineapple and ginger
steps:
1. In a large deep bowl , combiner the reserved pineapple juice , soy sauce , and the next 6 ingredients
2. Add the ribs
3. Cover and marinate overnight in the refrigerator
4. Grease the slow cooker with oil and add the ribs and marinade
5. If you have a round cooker , stack the ribs , alternating them with the reserved pineapple chunks
6. If you have an oval cooker , put the ribs in the crock and scatter the pineapple around the ribs
7. Cover and cook on low for 8-9 hours or until tender and the meat starts to separate from the bone
8. Serve immediately

title: cranberry fig relish
steps:
1. In a sucepan over medium heat , heat the oil and then add in the onion and ginger , cooking until soft
2. Add teh garlic and cook for another 30 seconds
3. Stir in orange juice and brown sugar and bring to a boil
4. Stir in half of the cranberries and if using dried figs -- add them now
5. , cook , stirring ocassionally until berries pop and mixture thickens
6. Add the remaining cranberries and cook until berries pop
7. Remove from heat and stir in orange zest
8. Season with salt and pepper if desired

title: macadamia nut bars
steps:
1. Crust: mix together the ingredients for the crust , using a pastry blender or two knives , until the mixture resembles meal
2. Press the crust into an 8x8 inch pan and bake for 20 minutes in a 350 oven
3. Topping: beat together the eggs , sugar , and vanilla
4. Mix the flour , baking powder , and coconut and add to the egg mixture , beating until smooth
5. Add the lemon juice and stir in the nuts
6. Pour the mixture over the crust and return the pan to the oven for 35 minutes
7. When cool , cut into bars

title: roast pumpkin  feta and pine nut pasty
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 220c place pumpkin on a baking tray and toss with olive oil garlic and salt and pepper
2. Roast in oven for 40 minutes or until cooked and golden
3. Remove and allow to cool
4. Evenly divide the pumpkin among the four pastry squares , placing in the centre
5. Top with oregano , feta and pine nuts
6. Drizzle with a little of the feta marinating oil
7. Bring 2 of the diagonally opposite corners together and pinch to seal along the edges
8. The base will be square the top will be a pyramid shape
9. Twist the top to seal where the four corners meet
10. Place the egg yolk and milk in a small bowl and whisk with a fork to make an egg wash for the pastry
11. Place the pasties on a baking tray and brush with the egg wash
12. Sprinkle with sesame seeds and sea salt and bake for 15 minutes or until golden brown

title: spinach and cheese linguini
steps:
1. Melt butter
2. Add 1 / 2 garlic , italian seasoning and flour
3. Stir in milk
4. Cook over low heat until thickened
5. Boil linguini , drain
6. Toss pasta with sauce , spinach , cheese and remaining garlic

title: sour cream doughnuts 1972  canadian
steps:
1. Beat sour cream with sugar well
2. Add eggs and mix well
3. Mix all dry ingredients seperately and add into wet mixture
4. Roll out the dough onto a lightly floured surface about 3 / 4 inches thick
5. Cut with a doughnut cutter
6. Fry in deep hot fat
7. Deep fat should be temp of 370 degrees
8. Turn once to brown both sides
9. Place onto paper towels to drain
10. Sprinkle or dust with granulated sugar , powdered icing sugar

title: baby spinach salad with lemon and parmesan
steps:
1. Place the lemon juice in a small bowl
2. Whisking constantly , slowly add the oil in a steady stream , whisking until the vinaigrette is creamy
3. Set aside
4. Rub the inside of a large bowl with the cut sides of the garlic halves
5. Add the spinach
6. Drizzle with the reserved lemon vinaigrette
7. Toss gently to coat
8. Divide the salad among 4 plates
9. Shave the cheese in wide sheets over each salad with a vegetable peeler
10. Season with salt and pepper and serve

title: cream cheese chocolate cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 f
2. In large bowl , beat together sugar , butter , egg , melted chocolate and vanilla until smooth
3. Gradually add flour while stirring
4. Beat until smooth
5. Shape dough into 48 1-inch balls
6. Place balls on cookie sheet about 2-inch apart
7. Flatten with glass bottom to form 2-inch circles
8. Dip glass bottom in sugar , to prevent sticking
9. Bake for 15 minutes or until cookies are slightly shiny and golden
10. Remove from oven let cool for 5 minutes before removing cookies from sheet
11. Repeat process until all dough is used up
12. Spread half the cookies with cream cheese icing and top with remaining ones , pressing lightly
13. Dust with sugar
14. Cream cheese icing:
15. In bowl , whip all ingredients with cream cheese until creamy
16. Cover and set aside

title: sour cream banana cake
steps:
1. Cream brown sugar and 1 cup butter
2. Add eggs 1 at a time , beat well
3. Add mashed bananas , flour , salt , baking soda and 1 cup sour cream
4. Add vanilla and nuts last
5. Pour batter into 3 9" pans or a 13x9" pan
6. Bake in a preheated 350 degree oven until cake tests done with a tooth pick , about 30-40 minutes for the rounds or 40-50 minutes for the 13x9
7. To make frosting: mix 1 / 2 cup butter , 4 cups confectioners sugar and 1 / 4 cup sour cream
8. Add 1 teaspoons vanilla and beat until fluffy

title: sticky peachy chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Mix jam , bbq sauce , onion and soy sauce
3. Put chicken pieces in baking dish
4. Top with sauce
5. Cover and bake for 30 minutes , then turn and baste
6. Bake another 30 minutes or until done

title: chili s white chocolate molten cake
steps:
1. Prepare your cake mix as directed on box
2. Prepare a bundt cake pan with cooking spray
3. Bake as directed
4. Let you cake cool just a little -- you want to serve it warm
5. Now , if you want to be really creative , you can slice your cake so that you can fill it with the white morsels that you will be melting
6. We haven't worried about being that creative yet
7. So we melt the white morsels in the microwave just enough to warm them , stir them & spread over each cake slice
8. Scoop your desired amount of ice cream & place it on your cake slice
9. Drizzle with raspberry sauce & if you like , you can use a vegetable peeler & grate some vanilla bark to sprinkle over the top
10. Enjoy !
11. You can use your judgement on the white morsels , vanilla ice cream , raspberry sauce & vanilla bark to suit your taste

title: mushroom beef stroganoff
steps:
1. In a large skillet , heat butter and oil over medium-high heat
2. Brown steak
3. Remove with a slotted spoon and keep warm
4. Add mushrooms
5. Saute until tender
6. Return steak to pan
7. Add soup , sour cream , onions , thyme and marjoram
8. Heat gently
9. Serve over noodles or rice

title: banana toffee bread pudding
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 220c / 425f / gas 7
2. Cut the bread slices in half diagonally
3. In a medium pan gently melt the butter
4. Stir in the honey and sugar until melted
5. Add the bananas
6. In a separate pan gently heat the milk and cream together
7. In a medium ovenproof dish lay half the bread over the base
8. Top with half the banana mixture and pour over half the milk mixture
9. Lay the remaining bread on top , followed by the remaining banana and milk mixture
10. Bake in the oven for 12-15 minutes until golden

title: hazelnut layer cheesecake
steps:
1. Make sponge base first
2. Line and grease a 9inch cake pan
3. Preheat oven to 180degrees celsius
4. Whisk egg yolks and sugar till pale and quite fluffy
5. In another bowl , whisk egg whites till foamy
6. Gradually whisk in sugar till stiff peaks form
7. Fold white mix into yellow mix
8. Sieve in flour and fold it in by hand , and not with the mixer
9. Finally fold in the oil or melted butter till well incorporated
10. Pour into pan and bake for 25-30 mins , till cooked
11. Immediately remove from cake tin and cool
12. Slice into 2 layers
13. Then using either the ring of an 8inch springform tin , or an 8 inch cake ring , cut out circles from each sponge
14. For cheesecake:
15. If using gelatin leaves , soften in cold water
16. Then dissolve it in 40ml of hot water
17. If using gelatin powder , sprinkle onto 40ml water and leave for 5mins
18. Melt in the microwave and cool for a while
19. Whip whipping cream and set aside
20. Cream cream cheese and sugar till smooth and fluffy
21. Add in gelatin mix and mix well
22. Then fold in whipped cream
23. Fold in shredded chocolate and the diced hazelnuts
24. Assembly:
25. Lay one cake layer in the 8inch cake ring
26. Top with 1 / 2 of the cheese mix
27. Top with the second sponge layer and then top with the rest of the cheese mix
28. Refrigerate till set

title: regency queen cakes for jane austen s afternoon tea party
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 190c / 374f / gas mark 5
2. Sift the flour and mace together
3. Beat the eggs
4. Melt the butter and allow to cool slightly
5. Beat the eggs , rose water and melted butter together
6. Make a well in the centre of the flour mixture
7. Add the liquid mixture and mix thoroughly
8. Add the currants , sugar and the ground almonds and mix well
9. Put a heaped spoon of the cake mixture in to the paper cases , or a well buttered patty or muffin tin
10. Bake for 15 to 25 minutes , until well risen , firm and golden brown
11. You can ice them if you wish , using a thin mixture applied with a brush , more like a glaze
12. Serve with elegant china and some freshly drawn english tea in the drawing room or the parlour !

title: jolean s cheese potato   smoked sausage casserole
steps:
1. Cut skinless smoked sausage in half , lengthwise , and then chop into 1 / 2 inch "half moon" cuts
2. Cook in a frying pan for about 15 minutes , turning frequently to slightly brown
3. Meanwhile , put cooked & diced potatoes in 2 quart casserole
4. Add cooked meat and give it a gentle toss
5. Mix all remaining ingredients in a saucepan over medium heat until warm , melted and smooth
6. Pour white / cheese sauce over potatoes and meat
7. Sprinkle shredded sharp cheddar cheese on top , and then sprinkle paprika evenly over the top
8. Bake in preheated 350f oven for 35-45 minutes
9. Hot dogs , sliced into 1 / 2-inch slices or 1 / 2 lb
10. Ham diced into 1 / 2-inch dices or 12 oz
11. Can of spam diced into 1 / 2-inch dices , instead of the smoked sausage

title: lahanosalata  greek cabbage slaw   salad
steps:
1. Core the cabbage and shred as for making traditional coleslaw
2. Put the cabbage and carrot in a large bowl
3. Toss well
4. In a small bowl mix the olive oil , lemon juice and garlic
5. Add salt to taste
6. Just prior to serving , pour over the salad and toss to coat
7. Adjust seasonings and olive oil or lemon juice as needed

title: salmon with mustard dill sauce
steps:
1. Preheat grill to medium
2. For mustard-dill sauce , combine garlic , dill , lemon peel , salt , red pepper , lemon juice , mustard and olive oil in medium bowl
3. Spread some sauce over salmon filets
4. Grill , covered with grill lid , on grill rack coated with nonstick cooking spray 4 to 6 minutes on each side , or until fish flakes with a fork , basting occasionally with remaining sauce
5. I have also baked this in a 425 oven for about 20-30 minutes , uncovered

title: pink sunset cocktail
steps:
1. Fill cocktail shaker half full with ice
2. Add first 5 ingredients to shaker
3. Shake very well
4. Pour into a hurricane glass and garnish with a maraschino cherry and pineapple slice

title: autumn pumpkin waffles
steps:
1. Combine flour , baking powder , spices and salt in a large batter bowl
2. Set aside
3. Using a medium sized bowl slightly beat egg yolks
4. Whisk in milk , pumpkin , oil , butter and vanilla
5. Add pumpkin mixture to flour mixture , stirring to combine
6. In a small bowl , beat egg whites until stiff peaks form , gently fold into pumpkin mixture
7. Bake in preheated , lightly oiled waffle baker according to manufacturers instructions
8. I have a small waffle baker and this makes about 14 waffles

title: hamburger patties
steps:
1. Mix ingredients and form into hamburger patties
2. Place on cookie sheets in two layers and freeze

title: thai basil beef
steps:
1. Heat a large frying pan over medium high heat , film with sesame oil and saute onions , bell peppers and chilis until softened , ~3-4 minutes
2. Remove from pan
3. Cook ground beef with garlic & black pepper , crumbling into small bits until browned and cooked through , ~8-10 minutes
4. Add vegetables back to pan
5. Stir in chicken stock , oyster sauce , fish sauce , and sugar
6. Stir well and cook until reduced a bit , ~2 minutes
7. Fold in basil leaves and stir to combine
8. Serve over rice
9. Top with grated carrot , cilantro and a squeeze of lime juice if you want

title: jimmy dean hearty sausage mini quiche
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. In a large mixing bowl , combine eggs , milk or water , cheese , salt and pepper
3. Set aside
4. Heat olive oil or butter in a large skillet
5. Saut onions and any optional vegetables desired until vegetables are tender
6. Add vegetables and sausage to egg mixture
7. Stir well
8. Place 12 foil baking cups into cupcake pan
9. Distribute sausage and egg mixture evenly into baking cups
10. Bake for 22 minutes or until eggs are set
11. Remove from oven
12. Sprinkle with parmesan if desired

title: tortilla chicken soup
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375f
2. Brush 1 tablespoon melted butter on both sides of each tortilla
3. Cut tortillas into strips
4. Place on baking sheet
5. Bake for 5 to 7 minutes , stirring occasionally , or until crunchy
6. Melt 1 tablespoon butter in a saucepan until sizzling
7. Add onion , jalapeo , garlic and cumin
8. Cook over medium heat until onion is softened
9. Add broth and tomatoes and continue cooking until mixture just comes to a boil
10. Reduce heat to low and add 10 of the baked tortilla strips to the soup
11. Cover with a lid and cook , stirring occasionally , for 15 minutes
12. Stir in lime juice
13. Place 2 cups soup in 5-cup blender container or food processor bowl
14. Cover , blend on low until smooth about 60 seconds
15. Repeat with remaining soup
16. Heat chicken in microwave till hot
17. Add chicken breasts to bowls and cover with soup
18. To serve , top soup with remaining tortilla strips , shredded cheese and cilantro

title: key lime jewel cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. In a medium bowl mix the flour , baking powder , salt , and lime zest
3. Set aside
4. In a large bowl cream the butter and sugar together
5. Add the egg yolks , and combine well
6. Next , mix in the almond extract , and the lime juice
7. Gradually add the flour mixture to the wet ingredients , and mix well
8. Add the water to make the dough come together more easily
9. Add the green food coloring and work through the dough to get even color
10. Lay the chopped pine nuts out in one layer on a plate
11. Pinch off chunks of the dough and roll them between your hands to form 1 inch balls
12. Roll the dough balls in the pine nuts to get them evenly coated , and then place them on parchment paper lined baking sheets
13. Take your index finger and make an indent into the middle of each dough ball
14. Carefully drop 1 teaspoon of the raspberry preserves into each indent on your cookies
15. Bake for about 35 minutes , or when the pine nuts start to lightly brown on the edges
16. Let the cookies cool on the cookie sheets for a couple minutes
17. Then transfer the cookies to cooling racks to cool completely before lightly dusting them with the powdered sugar
18. Enjoy !

title: chocolate covered bacon with almonds
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. Place bacon on a sheet tray and cook until crisp , about 25 minutes
3. Melt chocolate in double boiler over low heat
4. Dip crisp bacon in chocolate and place back on sheet tray
5. Sprinkle with almonds and refrigerate for 30 minutes or until ready to serve

title: african style grilled peanut butter chicken
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients , if mixture is too thick , keep adding hot water until mixture is similar to cream
2. Reserve 1 / 2 cup of marinade mixture for basting while grilling
3. Place remaining marinade in zip loc bag , add chicken pieces , squish to combine , marinate for 2-3 hours
4. Heat grill , lightly oil grates , place chicken on grate and brush with reserved peanutbutter mixture while grilling
5. Grill until juices run clear
6. Serve with rice or potatoes

title: grilled ham and swiss sandwich with grilled onions on toast
steps:
1. First , grill your onions to your liking in a pan with a small amount of oil
2. Put aside
3. Wash lettuce and have your sandwich fillings ready for assembly
4. On a hot plate , skillet , etc
5. , place one slice of ham down , followed by swiss cheese , then the other slice of ham
6. The cheese should be as protected from the pan as much as possible
7. You want to heat on a medium / high heat and flip this after a minute or two so the top side gets a turn down on the pan
8. But don't cook this too long as it will make the meat tough and the cheese will melt and leak out all over the place
9. Just heat until meat is slightly brown on top and bottom and the cheese has mostly melted
10. While meat and cheese are cooking , place 2 slices of bread in toaster
11. When done , add mayo and / or mustard to toast and place ham / cheese on bottom slice of toast
12. Top with grilled onions , lettuce , tomato , pickle , and sprinkle with salt and pepper
13. Add top piece of toast , slice sandwich on the diagonal , throw on a plate with some potato chips and get busy -- back to the kitchen
14. These things are addictive
15. You've been warned !

title: peruvian marinade  rotisserie  grill  or oven chicken marinade
steps:
1. Combine ingredients in a large zip lock bag and whisk or shake till blended
2. Add chicken to bag and shake until it is coated
3. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour and up to 4 hours
4. Scrape marinade off chicken , season generously with kosher salt and pepper and place in rotisserie , in oven or on grill
5. Cooking time will depend upon size of poultry pieces
6. Do not let meat become dry
7. For reference
8. Whole fryer 60 - 70 minutes
9. Whole roaster 22 minutes a pound , butterflied whole chicken 45-50 minutes
10. 450 degrees for first 15-20 minutes and then lower to 350 for remainder of cooking
11. Remove from oven when meat thermometer reads 175-180f
12. Temperature will continue to rise as it stands

18. Temperature will continue to rise as it stands

title: raw vegan chocolate and raspberry birthday cake
steps:
1. Place the walnuts , salt , dates and carob / cocoa in your food processor and blend well until you get a soft and sticky paste
2. Divide the mixture in two and form two balls
3. Place these balls in the fridge
4. Place the bananas , carob / cocoa and honey in your food processor and mix well until you get a smooth paste
5. Place one crust ball in your cake form and spread it evenly
6. Spread some chocolate cream on top
7. Sprinkle the raspberries and press them gently into the chocolate cream
8. Place the other dough ball on top and spread it , but be careful not to crush the raspberries
9. Put some parchment paper on a large plate
10. Turn the cake upside down and put it on the plate
11. Garnish with the remaining chocolate cream , raspberries and dark chocolate flakes
12. Place in fridge for at least 2 hours before serving

title: moo shu noodles
steps:
1. Cook the pasta to al dente according to package directions
2. Drain the cooked pasta and reserve
3. Place a small skillet over medium heat with 1 turn of the pan of oil , about 1 tablespoon
4. Add the beaten eggs to the pan and scramble
5. When the eggs are done , reserve them in a bowl
6. Place a large skillet over medium-high heat with 3 turns of the pan of oil , about 3 tablespoons
7. Season the pork with salt and pepper , add to the pan and cook , stirring occasionally , until golden brown and cooked through , about 5 minutes
8. Remove the meat from the pan and reserve warm
9. Add the scallions , ginger and garlic to the pan , and cook until aromatic and the scallions are tender , about 1 minute
10. Add the shiitakes to the pan and stir-fry until golden brown , 4-5 minutes
11. Combine the hoisin and soy sauce together in a small bowl
12. Add the cabbage to the pan and stir-fry until tender , about 5 minutes

14. Stir-fry to fully heat through , about 1 minute , and then toss with the reserved cooked pasta
15. Cook to heat through and serve

title: winter squash soup with gruyere croutons
steps:
1. For soup:
2. Melt butter in large pot over medium heat
3. Add onion and garlic and saut until tender , about 10 minutes
4. Add broth , all squash and herbs
5. Bring to boil
6. Reduce heat , cover and simmer until squash is very tender , about 20 minutes
7. Working in batches , puree soup in blender
8. Return soup to same pot
9. Stir in cream and sugar
10. Bring to simmer
11. Season with salt and pepper
12. For croutons:
13. Preheat broiler
14. Butter 1 side of each bread slice
15. Arrange bread , buttered side up , on baking sheet
16. Broil until golden , about 1 minute
17. Turn over
18. Sprinkle cheese , then thyme and sage over
19. Sprinkle with salt and pepper
20. Broil until cheese melts , about 1 minute
21. Ladle soup into bowls
22. Top each with croutons and serve

title: yellow curry paste
steps:
1. Soak the red chillies in 5 tablespoons hot water for 1-2 hours
2. Put the chillies , together with their soaking liquid , into a blender along with all the remaining ingredients in the order listed
3. Blend , pushing down with a rubber spatula as many times as necessary , until you have a smooth paste
4. What you do not use immediately should be refrigerated or frozen

title: quick rice with olives
steps:
1. Place the rice , water and onion flakes in a microwavable container
2. Cook rice in microwave
3. I've found the best way to do this is to microwave on high for 2 minutes
4. Let stand for 5 minutes
5. Then microwave on high again for 2 minutes
6. After rice is cooked , place 1 slice of american cheese on top of rice
7. Top with olives
8. This recipe travels well and re-heats very well
9. I take it to work and re-heat it in a microwave for 2-3 minutes
10. Make sure the cheese melts
11. I've never made this recipe to eat right away
12. I'm sure it would taste just fine either way

title: delicious gluten free  dairy free  egg free pancakes
steps:
1. In a bowl , mix or sift together the rice flour , tapioca flour , potato starch , sugar , baking powder , baking soda , salt , and guar gum
2. Stir in eggs , water , and oil or apple sauce until well blended and few lumps remain
3. Heat a large , well-oiled skillet or griddle over medium high heat
4. Spoon batter onto skillet and cook until bubbles begin to form
5. Flip , and continue cooking until golden brown on bottom
6. Serve with real maple syrup on your choice of topping

title: golden couscous
steps:
1. Bring the broth to a boil
2. Cover with a lid to keep hot
3. Set aside
4. In a large skillet melt the butter with oil over medium-high heat
5. Add in chopped onions with 1 teaspoon brown sugar
6. Saut stirring until light golden brown
7. Add in the garlic , cayenne , turmeric , cumin and ground black pepper
8. Stir for 2 minutes
9. Add in couscous and stir until coated with the onion mixture
10. Mix in the hot broth and currants
11. Cover with a lid
12. Remove from heat and let stand for about 10-15 minutes or until all the water is absorbed
13. Fluff with a fork then mix in the almonds , then season with salt and more ground black pepper if desired

title: boston market  like creamed spinach
steps:
1. Take 2 tablespoons butter in saucepan on medium heat
2. Saute onion for 5 minutes or until soft
3. Set aside
4. Then take remaining butter , garlic salt , soup , flour , salt and pepper in saucepan and stir until smooth
5. Add onions and spinach
6. Serve immediately

title: carne en su jugo
steps:
1. Brown the bacon in a large dutch oven
2. Add the beef and cook until brown
3. Blend the tomatillos in your food processor and strain well to remove the seeds
4. Add about a cup of the tomatillo liquid back into the food processor and blend with the cilantro , and garlic
5. Add the tomatillo / cilantro / garlic sauce and the rest of the strained tomatillo liquid to the beef and bacon
6. Add salt to taste
7. Stir in pinto beans and bring to a boil
8. Reduce heat and simmer until beef is tender , about 1 hour
9. Ladle into bowls and serve with fresh lime , sour cream , diced onion and cilantro as garnish
10. Serve corn or flour tortillas on the side

title: cape verde vegetable soup
steps:
1. Sautee the onions and the garlic in the oil for 10 minute add the summer savory or thyme and the ground chiles and sautee gently , stirring often , for another 5 minutes
2. Add the rest of the ingredients , excet the lemon juice , and bring to a boil
3. Reduce heat and simmer until the vegetables are tender , about 20 minute add the lemon juice
4. Serve topped with chopped fresh parsley or more fresh cilantro or both

title: honey oatmeal bread  abm
steps:
1. In bread machine pan , place all
2. Ingredients in order suggested by manufacturer
3. Use complete cycle
4. Mine takes 4hrs 10 minute for the complete cycle

title: lattice crust apple pie
steps:
1. Preparing the crust:
2. In a large bowl , mix together flour , sugar , cinnamon and salt
3. Using a pastry blender or two knives , cut butter and shortening into flour mixture until coarse crumbs form
4. Add water , 1 tablespoon at a time , tossing with a fork until a dough forms
5. Divide dough in half
6. Shape each half into a disk
7. Wrap in plastic wrap
8. Chill for 1 hour
9. Making the filling:
10. Place oven rack in lowest position
11. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
12. In a large mixing bowl , combine apples , sugar , cinnamon and nutmeg
13. Assembling the pie:
14. On a lightly floured surface , using a lightly floured rolling pin , roll half of dough into an 11-inch circle
15. Fit into a 9-inch pie pan
16. Spoon filling into pan
17. Dot with butter pieces
18. Roll remaining dough into a 10-inch circle
19. Cut into 1 / 2 inch strips
20. To form a lattice crust , arrange 2 dough strips in a cross pattern in center of pie
21. Ends of strips should overlap edges of bottom crust
22. Alternately weave strips into a lattice pattern until filling is covered
23. Brush crust with egg
24. Bake until crust is golden and filling is bubbly , about 40 minutes

title: weiners and potatoes
steps:
1. Stir potatoes , sauce mix , hot water and milk in skillet
2. Stir in frozen peas or other canned or frozen vegetables
3. Heat to boiling , cover and simmer 15 minute
4. Stir occasionally , until potatoes are tender
5. Stir in weiners
6. Cover and heat 5 minutes or until weiners are hot
7. Sprinkle cheese over all
8. Cover and let stand 5 minutes until cheese melts

title: mexi egg scramble skillet
steps:
1. In a medium bowl combine eggs with tabasco , baking powder , salt and black pepper
2. In a large skillet melt butter over medium-high heat
3. Add in onion , bell pepper and fresh mushrooms
4. Cook until tender
5. Add in the chiles and egg mixture
6. Cook stirring until the eggs just begin to set
7. Sprinkle the cheese over the eggs
8. Cover and cook until the eggs are just set

title: duckling a la orange
steps:
1. Melt butter in heavy saucepan
2. Add flour
3. Blend well over medium heat
4. Reduce heat and simmer for several minutes
5. Heat bouillon , stir into roux , and continue stirring until sauce thickens
6. Add herbs , reduce heat and simmer for several minutes
7. Combine orange juice , orange zest , and lemon juice , with brown sauce
8. Simmer 5 minutes and add liquor
9. Clean duck
10. Heat oven to 325f
11. Place breast side up in shallow roasting pan
12. Brush duck with 1 / 2 of glaze
13. Roast uncovered for 2 1 / 2 hours , pricking skin with fork and brushing with glaze occasionally
14. Just before serving , add 1 / 2 cup orange sections to sauce
15. Heat through

title: zesty crouton salad
steps:
1. In large bowl , combine all ingredients
2. Serve
3. Enjoy !

title: hershey s cake
steps:
1. Cream butter and sugar together
2. Add eggs , one at time
3. Add and mix all the rest of the ingredients in order listed except candy bars
4. Blend well
5. Put batter in 9x13 greased pan
6. Bake 35 minutes at 350
7. Test with toothpicks , make sure they come out clean

9. Let melt and spread

title: tamal en casuela  cuban tamale soup
steps:
1. Cut pork into cubes and marinate in lemon and garlic
2. Brown pork and add enough olive oil to simmer with onion , green pepper , tomato sauce , and wine
3. Mix cornmeal and water thoroughly , then strain

title: audrey s corn frito dip
steps:
1. Preheat oven 350 degrees
2. Mix ingredients together
3. Spread over baking dish

5. Serve with corn chips

title: cherry streusel cake
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease a 13 x 9-inch baking pan
3. In a bowl , combine all streusel topping mixture
4. Set aside
5. In a bowl , combine the butter with 1-1 / 3 cups sugar , vanilla and lemon juice
6. Beat in the 2 eggs , then stir in sour cream
7. In another bowl , sift together flour , baking powder , baking soda and salt
8. Add to the butter / sourcream mixture
9. Mix well to combine
10. Combine the pie filling with 1 / 3 cup sugar , pecans and cinnamon
11. Spread 1 / 2 of the batter into a prepared baking dish , then spoon the cherry mixture over the batter
12. Spread the remaining batter on top of the cherry mixture

title: simple mac   cheese
steps:
1. Boil macaroni until al dente drain
2. In double boiler heat milk
3. Grate velveeta
4. Add velveeta stirring occasionally until melted

10. This serves 8 thetas or 4 frat boys lol !

title: super sunday tacos
steps:
1. In a large heavy skillet or big pot pour some olive oil to coat the bottom
2. Put in the onions , garlic and jalapenos and let cook for 5 minutes
3. Then add pork and beef but do not allow to brown
4. Add all the spices and half of the water and cook slowly over low heat for at least an hour
5. Adding extra water as needed , but when it is done it shouldn't be wet and drippy so don't add to much
6. Enjoy with tacos or whatever else you've chosen to have it with

title: veggie lovers macaroni and cheese
steps:
1. To make the cheese sauce: pour the evaporated milk into a bowl
2. Fill the empty can with water and pour that into the bowl as well
3. Mix and set aside
4. Melt the butter in a medium saucepan over medium heat
5. When melted , add the flour and start stirring
6. A whisk is the best utensil to use here
7. When all the flour has been absorbed by the butter , add the milk and water mixture , and keep whisking
8. After about 2 minutes the sauce will start to thicken
9. Keep whisking , making sure that there aren't any lumps
10. Lumps are not fun to eat
11. When the sauce has thickened , take it off the flame
12. Add the shredded cheese and keep whisking until it's melted completely
13. Add salt and pepper to taste , set aside
14. To make the vegetable sauce: melt the butter in a medium saucepan
15. Add the onion and saute until golden
16. Add the garlic , zucchini , corn kernels and red pepper
17. Saute , stirring every minute or so , until the vegetables have softened
18. Putting the whole thing together: mix the pasta with the sauteed vegetables
19. Add the cheese sauce and mix it all together , so everything is distributed evenly
20. Pour into a greased baking dish large enough to hold everything
21. Don't worry if your dish is too large , this makes for more surface area which makes for a more crunchy top for everyone to fight over
22. Bake in a preheated 350 degree f oven for 45-50 minutes

title: shrimp spring rolls with hoisin dipping sauce
steps:

7. Sprinkle with 1 t
8. Cilantro and 2 teaspoons mint

steps:

title: gram s banana bread

steps:

6. X 5-in

title: chicken marsala with pancetta   cream
steps:
1. Coat a large skillet lightly with olive oil and set it over medium-high heat
2. Add the pancetta and cook until just crisp and lightly browned
3. Remove with a slotted spoon , leaving the fat in the pan , and set aside
4. Put the flour on a plate
5. Pat the cutlets dry
6. Season them on both sides lightly with salt and amply with pepper
7. Heat the skillet with the pancetta fat over medium high
8. Add more olive oil , if needed , to get about 2 tbs
9. Fat in the pan
10. When the fat is hot , dredge a cutlet through the flour on both sides
11. Shake off the excess flour and immediately put the cutlet in the pan
12. Do the same with as many cutlets as will fit in the pan without touching
13. Saut the cutlets , turning once , until browned on both sides
14. If thin , they should cook through in just a few minutes total
15. Transfer the cooked cutlets to a plate and continue sauting the rest , adding more oil if necessary
16. Transfer these to the plate as well
17. Pour off the excess fat
18. With the pan over medium-high heat , add the marsala and scrape up any browned bits from the bottom of the pan
19. Cook until the marsala is reduced by about a quarter
20. Stir in the cream and boil until you get a nicely thickened sauce
21. Return the chicken and pancetta to the pan and turn the cutlets over to coat
22. Let them reheat for 30 seconds to 1 minute
23. Serve with the sauce and a sprinkling of parsley , if you like

title: dad s fish batter
steps:
1. Sift dry ingredients
2. Add water and mix well
3. Whisk until you have a smooth batter , if needed add a bit more water but do not make it too thin
4. Use to coat fish or chicken filets
5. Cover the fish completely
6. Deep fry until a nice golden brown
7. Some
8. Excellent !

10. It was all incredible ! next time i will make some hush puppies , and it will be just like eating at the restaurant !
11. This really was an excellent batter
12. I made it up an hour before i used it as i have heard that this makes batter 'stick' better to whatever you're frying
13. Anyway , it stuck
14. Light , crisp and not greasy
15. For fun i tried this on onion rings and i took some sweet banana peppers and split them and removed the seeds and battered them and fried to a golden brown , excellent
16. I think you could batter any thing with this recipe
17. Thank's dad !
18. I added a 1 / 2 cup of corn meal to the batter , also some garlic & onion powder to taste and / or fish seasoning
19. I also let the fish sit in the batter for 30 minute this made the batter a bit thicker on the fish and made it stick well
20. My entire family loved this recipe
21. I am also expected to make this recipe for my neighbor
22. She buys the fish i cook it
23. We now have an awesome batter for our fish
24. We all love it

title: pasta macaroni salad
steps:
1. Cook pasta to package
2. Drain and rinse with cold water
3. Set pasta to the side make sure all water is removed
4. In a big bowl combine mayo , buttermilk , dill , garlic powder , salt and pepper

6. Stir in pasta , celery , cucumber , scallions and sweet pepper

title: macaroni   cheese deluxe
steps:

title: rachael ray s cheddar soup with crispy tortilla crunch
steps:
1. In a medium soup pot , melt butter
2. Add onions and cook 5 minutes
3. Add the garlic and peppers and cook 2 to 3 minutes more

6. Bring soup to a bubble and reduce heat to simmer
7. Stir in cheese and season the soup with salt , pepper , chili powder and cumin
8. Let soup reduce 10 to 15 minutes over low heat then serve with crushed chips and dollops of salsa

title: pumpkin enchiladas
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Bring a pan sprayed with nonstick spray to medium heat on the stove
3. Add onion and , stirring occasionally , cook until it begins to brown , about 2 minutes
4. Transfer to a medium bowl
5. Add pumpkin , taco sauce , and taco seasoning to the bowl
6. Mix well
7. If you like , season to taste with salt and pepper
8. Set aside
9. Spray a small baking dish with nonstick spray and set aside
10. Warm tortillas slightly in the microwave
11. Lay tortillas flat on a clean , dry surface
12. Spread 2 tablespoons enchilada sauce onto each one
13. Place a half-slice of cheese in the center of each tortilla
14. Evenly distribute the pumpkin mixture between the centers of the tortillas
15. Wrap tortillas up tightly and place them in the baking dish with the seam sides down

17. Bake in the oven for about 8 minutes , until enchiladas are hot

title: martha stewart s roasted cauliflower
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees
2. Trim , and cut cauliflower into small florets
3. Spread in a roasting pan or rimmed baking sheet
4. Drizzle with olive oil
5. Season with coarse salt and ground pepper
6. Toss to combine
7. Roast , tossing once or twice , until cauliflower is golden brown and tender , 20 to 25 minutes
8. In a small skillet , melt butter over medium heat

steps:

3. Add the rest of the ingredients , and cook for 5 more minutes

steps:
1. Cook the pasta according to the package directions
2. Shred the chicken , using a fork or your fingers , while the pasta cooks
3. Discard the skin and bones
4. Drain the pasta , reserving 1 1 / 4 cups of the water
5. Return the pasta to the pot
6. Add the reserved pasta water , chicken , rosemary , 1 / 2 cup of the parmesan , 1 / 2 teaspoon salt , and 1 / 4 teaspoon pepper to the pot
7. Stir over medium-low heat until the sauce has thickened slightly , about 2 minutes
8. Divide among individual bowls and sprinkle with the remaining parmesan
9. Starchy and salted , it makes a light , flavorful sauce when tossed with cheese and herbs
10. It's also great for thinning pestos and marinaras

title: spicy sausage balls

steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Generously grease and flour a 9x13 baking pan

9. Cool the cake completely
10. Frosting-in large mixer bowl , beat cream cheese and butter until creamy

12. Beat just until smooth

title: ravioli and vegetable soup
steps:
1. Heat oil in large saucepan or dutch oven over medium heat

title: chicken in tomato sauce
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325f
2. Saut chicken portions in 1 tablespoon of olive oil until browned
3. Remove with a slotted spoon and put in a casserole dish
4. Heat remaining oil
5. Add onion and garlic , and cook for 3 minutes
6. Add peppers and cook for a further 2 minutes
7. Add tinned tomatoes and herbs and simmer for 5 minutes
8. Spoon sauce over the chicken and bake for 45 minutes

title: zucchini  bread
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients into a big bowl
2. Wash your hands up to your elbows and mix the ingredients together
3. This will take 3-5 minutes
4. Be careful pouring the mixture into the loaf pan to not get any on the sides of the pan
5. This amount will make 1 loaf
6. Bake in a greased loaf pan at 350f for approximately 35-55 minutes , according to your oven
7. Top will be slightly split , and golden brown
8. Do not overbake !
9. They freeze great !

title: zucchini relish
steps:
1. Mix all the veggies and salt and let it sit overnight
2. Rinse and drain
3. In a large kettle mix the sugar and cornstarch together
4. Mix well
5. Add the rest of the sauce ingredients
6. Bring to boil and add the veggies
7. Simmer for about 30 minutes
8. Seal in hot sterile jars
9. Put the lids on and then put in a water bath for about 20 minutes

title: shrimp with broccoli
steps:
1. In a wok or large skillet heat the olive oil over medium high heat
2. Add mustard seeds and cook for 30 seconds or until seeds pop
3. Add green onion and garlic to wok and stir for a few seconds
4. Add mustard , lemon juice , salt and cayenne pepper and cook stirring until smooth and then add 2 tablespoons water , stirring to combine
5. Add broccoli to wok and cover and cook for 3-5 minutes and then add shrimp
6. Cover and cook an additional 3-5 minutes or until broccoli is crisp tender and shrimp is done

title: grapefruit ginger tea bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Coat a 9x5" loaf pan with cooking spray
3. Spread pecans on baking sheet and toast 6-7 minutes
4. Cool slightly and chop
5. Whisk together flour , sugar , baking powder , salt , and baking soda in large bowl , set aside
6. Beat eggs in a separate bowl
7. Whisk yogurt , milk and canola oil into eggs
8. Stir in grapefruit pieces and zest
9. Fold egg mixture into flour mixture until just moistened and no lumps remain
10. Fold in crystallized ginger and chopped pecans
11. Transfer to prepared loaf pan and bake 55-60 minutes , or until deep brown around edges and toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
12. Cool 1 hour on wire rack
13. Remove from pan and cool completely
14. To make glaze: whisk together confectioner's sugar and 1 t grapefruit juice in a small bowl
15. Stir in additional 1 / 2 t juice to achieve thick , but pourable consistency
16. Add another 1 / 2 t juice drop by drop , if necessary
17. Place foil beneath wire rack to catch drips
18. Turn loaf upside down so that flat side is up
19. Drizzle glaze over loaf
20. Allow glaze to set before slicing

title: cajun sausage chowder
steps:
1. Brown sausge & onions in a large pan
2. Add tomato juice , tomatoes , bay leaf , salt , garlic powder , thyme and pepper to sausage
3. Bring to boil
4. Reduce heat , simmer covered 15 min
5. , stir in potatoes , green pepper & beans
6. Cook for 15-20 minutes longer or until potatoes are tender
7. Stir in hot pepper sauce , remove bay leaf and ladle into soup bowls
8. Garnish with parsley

title: lemon basil potato puff
steps:
1. Cook potatoes in a covered saucepan in boiling water 20-25 mins
2. Or until tender
3. Mash& set aside
4. In a bowl combine breadcrumbs , margarine , & parsley
5. Press mixture onto the bottom and up the sides of a lightly greased 1 1 / 2 qt
6. Casserole dish
7. In a bowl combine egg yolks , basil , lemon peel& juice , salt& ground white pepper , stir in milk& 1 cup of the cheese
8. Stir this milk mixture into mashed potatoes
9. Beat egg whites until stiff peaks form , fold into potato mixture
10. Transfer to prepared casserole and top with remaining cheese
11. Bake , uncovered at 350 for 45 mins
12. Or until knife inserted in the centre comes out clean
13. Garnish with fresh snipped parsley
14. Makes 8-10 servings

title: comfort pot roast  for the crock pot
steps:
1. Put 2 tablespoons water in bottom of crock pot
2. Place carrots in crock pot
3. Combine paprika , onion soup powder , garlic powder and pepper
4. Rub into roast , coating all sides
5. Place roast in cooker
6. Sprinkle 1 / 2 of the remaining soup mix over roast
7. Layer sliced onions on top
8. Sprinkle with remaining soup mix
9. Spoon cream soup over top
10. Cook low 8 to 10 hours

title: vegetarian portabella burger
steps:
1. Take the couscous and put in a bowl
2. Pour in the broth and garlic powder
3. Remove the mushroom stem and put in the bowl with underside facing up
4. Put gardenbuger on top of the mushroom
5. Put slices of cheese on top
6. Microwave everything together for about 1:30 or 2 minutes , until cheese is melted
7. Enjoy !

title: peanut butter crunch cheesecake squares
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Line an 8x8-inch baking pan with nonstick foil , allowing foil to hang over two sides
3. In a medium-size bowl , whisk together the flour , pecans and light brown sugar
4. Stir in the butter and mix until all dry ingredients are moistened and a crumbly dough forms
5. Press into the bottom of the prepared baking pan
6. Bake at 350 degrees for 14 minutes , until lightly browned
7. Remove from oven
8. In another medium bowl , beat the cream cheese and sugar until smooth
9. Beat in egg , lemon juice and vanilla until combined
10. Stir in 3 / 4 cup coarsely chopped candy
11. Pour into the baked crust
12. Bake at 350 degrees for 25 minutes
13. Remove from oven and sprinkle the finely chopped candy over the top
14. Cool completely
15. Gently lift from pan and pull back foil
16. Cut into 36 squares
17. Refrigerate until serving

title: holiday tini
steps:
1. In a medium pitcher blend together vodka , cranberry juice , grenadine , orange juice and lemon or lime juice
2. Add about 1 cup of ice and stir to chill
3. Strain into two 8-ounce martini glasses
4. Garinish wth lemon or lime peel
5. This recipe can be doubled or tripled

title: brown sugar and oatmeal shortbread
steps:
1. Position a rack in middle of oven and preheat oven to 350f
2. Prepare 9x9x2-inch square or 11x7x2-inch baking tray by lining with parchment or greasing with butter
3. Sift flour , cornstarch , salt and cinnamon together onto wax paper or medium bowl
4. Set aside
5. Beat butter and brown sugar together in a large bowl , until smooth and fluffy
6. Using low speed , mix in flour mixture , until dough comes together in big clumps
7. Add in oatmeal , mixing just to distribute evenly
8. Press dough evenly into prepared tray
9. Bake for 25 mins , until top is light-brown
10. Remove from oven and immediately cut shortbread into squares , cutting through to the bottom
11. Cool thoroughly in the pan and remove shortbread from pan using a spatula
12. The shortbread will become crisp on the outside as it cool , but remain slightly soft inside
13. Store cooled shortbread in an airtight contained for up to 4 days or freeze

title: berry sundaes with white chocolate sauce
steps:
1. For white chocolate sauce~ place the cream in a saucepan and bring almost to the boil over medium heat
2. Remove cream from heat
3. And add the chocolate and stir until smooth and melted
4. Stir in cognac or brandy if using
5. Transfer chocolate sauce to a jug then refrigerate sauce until chilled
6. Process sugar and 1 / 2 the strawberries in a food processor until smooth
7. For serving ~ place a few raspberries and a few remaining sliced strawberries in the base of a 2 cup-capacity dessert glass and top with scoops of ice-cream and a few more berries
8. Drizzle with a little strawberry sauce and white chocolate sauce
9. Repeat with remaining berries , ice-cream and sauces in 5 more glasses
10. Serve immediately

title: swiss green bean casserole
steps:
1. Melt 2 tbsp butter , stir in flour , salt , pepper , sugar , onion
2. Add sour cream gradually until smooth
3. Add beans
4. Mix together and heat thoroughly
5. Pour into greased casserole dish
6. Grate cheese over top
7. Crush cornflakes and mix with melted butter
8. Put on top of beans
9. Cover and bake 20 minutes at 400

title: orange almond cookies
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400
2. In medium bowl , beat butter , 1 / 2 cup powdered sugar , 1 1 / 2 t
3. Orange peel and 1 t
4. Almond extract with mixer on medium speed until smooth
5. Beat in flour , salt and almonds until well blended
6. Shape dough into 1 inch balls
7. On ungreased cookie sheet , place balls 1 inch apart
8. Bake 7-10 minutes or until edges are lightly browned
9. Remove from cookie sheets to wire racks
10. Cool completely , about 30 minutes
11. In small bowl , stir all glaze ingredients , adding enough water to make a pouring consistency
12. In another small bowl , mix topping ingredients
13. Dip tops of cookies in glaze , then sprinkle with topping
14. Place cookies in miniature paper baking cups if desired

title: fish in mustard sauce
steps:
1. Wash fish , sprinkle with salt and set aside to firm up
2. Grind first 10 ingredients with lemon juice to make a paste
3. Fry paste in oil for 6-7 minutes , adding water as and when required to prevent burning
4. Add tomatoes , saute for 2 minutes then add 2 cups boiling water
5. Season with salt to taste
6. Add fish pieces , cook until done and serve garnished with chopped coriander leaves

title: shredded chili beef filling
steps:
1. Trim visible fat from roast and tie it with string to hold the meat together
2. In a large pot or dutch oven , , mix the beef , 1 cup of water and the bay leaves
3. Bring to a boil , then reduce to medium low
4. Cover and simmer for half an hour , turning the beef twice
5. While the beef simmers , mix the broth , vinegar , chili powder , garlic , cumin and oregano
6. Uncover the pot , increase the heat to high , and boil for 5 minutes
7. The liquid in the pot will reduce to about two tablespoons of a thick , glazed sauce
8. Turn the meat with a fork to coat
9. Add the spice and broth mixture to the pot , and bring to a boil , then reduce heat to a simmer
10. Cover and simmer for 1 1 / 2 hours , turning the meat twice
11. Add the onions and tomatoes
12. Cover and simmer 1 hour more , or until the meat is fork tender and shreds easily
13. Remove the pot from the heat
14. Take out the meat and put it on a big cutting board
15. Cover it with foil and let it stand for 45 minutes so it gets cool enough to handle
16. While the meat's cooling , skim the fat from the sauce and remove the bay leaves
17. Bring the sauce to a gentle boil , and boil it for about 15 minutes-- or until it's reduced by almost half
18. Take the pot off the heat
19. Now , back to the beef
20. Using your fingers or two forks , pull it into bite-sized shreds
21. Stop sneaking bites !
22. Add the meat and green chilies to the sauce in the pot
23. Stir until the meat is evenly moistened

title: super bowl italian submarine sandwich
steps:
1. Slice the loaf of bread in half lengthwise
2. Dig out excess bread in the center so that each half resembles a shallow "canoe"
3. Drizzle the bread with italian salad dressing
4. Layer the ingredients on the bread as desired
5. Cut the finished sandwich into 1 1 / 2 inch slices and enjoy !

title: catfish meuniere
steps:
1. Combine egg and milk in a large shallow bowl
2. Combine flour , salt , and pepper in a shallow dish
3. Dip fish in egg mixture , and dredge in flour mixture
4. Melt 1 / 4 cup butter in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat
5. Add oil
6. Increase heat to medium-high
7. Place fish in skillet , and cook 4 minutes on each side or until fish flakes easily when tested with a fork
8. Drain on paper towels
9. Melt remaining 1 / 4 cup butter in skillet
10. Stir in chopped parsley , lemon juice and worcestershire sauce
11. Spoon over fish
12. Garnish , if desired

title: creole cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees
2. Mix sugar , cocoa , flour and baking soda until well blended
3. Add 2 eggs , milk , oil and vanilla , mix well
4. Slowly add the boiling water while mixing with mixer at low speed
5. Mixture will be very thin
6. Pour into a greased and floured 9 x 13 inch pan
7. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes
8. While cake is baking mix ingredients for frosting
9. As soon as cake is done , remove from oven and spread frosting evenly over cake
10. Place under broiler for 1 to 2 minutes or until mixture begins to brown
11. Let cool before cutting

title: classic chocolate mousse
steps:
1. For mousse: heat whipping cream gently in double-boiler or small saucepan until it comes to a simmer
2. Remove from heat and add chocolate
3. Stir until the chocolate has completely melted
4. Whisk in the egg yolks and brandy
5. Set aside to cool completely
6. Beat 1 / 3 cup cream , sugar and vanilla in medium bowl to stiff peaks
7. Fold into cooled chocolate mixture
8. Spoon into wineglasses
9. Cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate until firm , about 3 hours
10. For cream: beat cream , sugar and brandy in medium bowl to soft peaks
11. Top mousse with dollops of cream

title: portuguese yogurt cake
steps:
1. Blend yogurt and butter
2. Add eggs
3. Add sugar
4. Add flour and baking powder
5. Pour into greased tube pan
6. Bake 40 minutes at 375 degrees fahrenheit
7. Dust with sugar
8. Place raspberries on top

title: shrimp burger
steps:
1. Take shrimp and dice in to small pieces , chopped shallots , add seasoned bread crumbs , eggs , parsley and grated cheese
2. Mix all together well with spoon make into desired size and deep fry or pan fry or grill -- serve on bun with either tartar sauce or even better , hot sauce

title: flounder   zucchini bundles
steps:
1. For each bundle , place 2 fillets on the middle of a large square of foil
2. You will have four bundles
3. Sprinkle each fish bundle with lemon pepper
4. Top evenly with lemon slices , zucchini slices , and halved tomatoes
5. Sprinkle each with dill & basil
6. Fold foil up around fillets , sealing well , & leaving room for steaming
7. Place the bundles onto a shallow pan
8. Bake at 425 , for 15 minutes , or until fish is just flaky
9. Take care when opening bundles , as they will be hot

title: greek seasoned baked potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Scrub potato , then use a sharp knife to pierce the skin several times all over
3. Place the potato on a piece of foil and spray one side with pam
4. Sprinkle half of the seasoned salt and half of the greek seasoning on the potato
5. Flip the potato over and repeat steps with the rest of the seasonings
6. Wrap potato securely in the foil and place in the hot oven
7. They tend to leak so you might want to place them on a piece of foil to help with clean up
8. Bake for approximately 1 hour
9. Time will vary based on the size of the potato
10. I check mine by using a pot holder to gently squeeze the potato
11. It should feel soft and slightly mushy

title: southwest taco pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven and baking sheet to 400 degrees
2. Partially bake pie crust for 10 minutes
3. Cool , reduce oven temperature to 350 degrees
4. In large skillet brown meat & onion and drain
5. Stir in taco seasoning mix to directions on pkg
6. In small mixing bowl combine refried beans and 1 / 2 cup of taco sauce
7. Layer 1 / 2 seasoned meat in bottom of each pie crust
8. Top each with 1 / 2 of the bean mixture
9. Sprinkle cheese on top & bake for 25 minutes
10. Remove from heat and cool 10 minutes and top with remaining taco sauce
11. Serve with lettuce , tomatoes , and sour cream as desired

title: barbecue feta turkey burgers
steps:
1. In a large bowl , mix together the turkey , feta cheese , olives , oregano , and pepper until well blended
2. Divide the mixture into 4 or 6 and form each portion into balls
3. Turn each ball onto a lightly floured surface and pres between two plates to form burgers
4. Cook over hot coals for 10 to 12 minutes , turning halfway through
5. Serve hot

title: potato cakes with goat cheese   petites  galettes  de pommes de
steps:
1. Squeeze all of the liquid out of the potatoes with your hands , then add the thyme , garlic , scallions and seasonings
2. Heat half the oil and butter in a non stick frying pan
3. Drop two large spoonfuls of the potato mixture in the oil , press down with spoon
4. Fry for 2-3 minutes on each side
5. Remove and drain
6. Repeat with rest of mixture , keeping the others warm
7. Preheat the broiler
8. Cut the cheese into 4 slices
9. Place on potato cakes and broil until the cheese is golden
10. Garnish with sprigs of thyme and salad greens
11. Serve immediately

title: grilled margarita chicken
steps:
1. Combine the olive oil , lime juice , tequila , cilantro , triple sec , and salt in a medium bowl , whisking until blended
2. Pour into an ungreased 13x9x2 inch pan
3. Add chicken , turning to coat
4. Cover and marinate in the refrigerator for 1 hour
5. Remove the chicken from the marinade , reserving marinade
6. Grill , covered , over medium-hot coals for 10 minutes on each side or until the chicken is done , turning and basting occasionally with the reserved marinade

title: crab ranch gorgonzola slaw  rsc
steps:
1. Combine dressing ingredients in a large mixing bowl
2. Mix well
3. Fold in 1 / 2 of the crab meat , tomatoes , parsley and chives
4. Chill in fridge for at least 1 hour
5. When ready to serve , top slaw with remaining crab meat and fried garlic

title: rachael ray s mexican lasagna
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f
2. To cook the filling: preheat a large skillet over medium high heat
3. Add 2 tablespoons extra-virgin olive oil - twice around the pan
4. Add chicken and season with chili powder , cumin , and red onion
5. Brown the meat , 5 minutes
6. Add taco sauce or stewed or fire roasted tomatoes
7. Add black beans and corn
8. Heat the mixture through , 2 to 3 minutes then season with salt , to your taste
9. Assemble lasagna: coat a shallow baking dish with remaining extra-virgin olive oil , about 1 tablespoon oil
10. Cut the tortillas in half or quarters to make them easy to layer with
11. Build lasagna in layers of meat and beans , then tortillas , then cheese
12. Repeat: meat , tortilla , cheese again
13. Bake lasagna 12 to 15 minutes until cheese is brown and bubbly
14. Top with the scallions

title: red onion and black olive sauce
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a heavy based pan and stir in the onions to coat them with oil , then sprinkle with the sugar and cook for 5 minutes or until translucent
2. Add the vinegar and olives , season and simmer for a further 2 minutes
3. Remove from he heat and stir in the butter
4. Sprinkle with parsley , then check the seasoning and toss with hot pasta
5. This sauce can also be served with cold pasta

title: broccoli and cauliflower in mustard sauce
steps:
1. Blend butter , mustard and lemon juice together
2. Steam broccoli and cauliflower , covered , until tender drain vegetables , return to hot saucepan and toss to evaporate any excess moisture season with salt and pepper
3. Add mustard butter
4. Toss to coat well and serve immediately

title: low fat crab and corn chowder
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large stockpot over medium heat
2. Add onion and garlic and saute for a few minutes , stirring often
3. Add celery , carrot , potatoes and peppers and saute until slightly softened , about 5 minutes
4. If you prefer thicker chowder , add the flour now and stir constantly for 2 minutes until cooked
5. Add corn , broth and milk and bay leaf and bring to a simmer
6. Simmer over medium-low heat for about 20-25 minutes or until vegetables are softened
7. Gently stir in can of crabmeat and old bay seasoning
8. Salt , pepper and butter to taste

title: new england patriots beef and black eyed peas
steps:
1. In a 5-6 quart electric slow cooker , mix together the beans , undiluted soup , hot water , carrots , onions , garlic powder and seasoned salt
2. Place the roast on top
3. Press into the bean mixture to cover as much as possible
4. Cover and cook on the low heat setting 9-10 hours , or until the beef and beans are tender
5. Increase the heat setting to high
6. Stir in the liquid smoke , chiles , and bell pepper
7. Cook , uncovered on high for 10-15 minutes longer
8. Skim any excess fat from the top before serving

title: cheesy vegetable pikelets
steps:
1. Using your hands , squeeze moisture from zucchini
2. Heat oil in a large , non-stick frying pan over medium-high heat
3. Add zucchini , carrot and corn
4. Cook , stirring , for 2 to 3 minutes or until softened
5. Set aside
6. Sift flours into a large bowl
7. Add husks to bowl
8. Add buttermilk and egg
9. Whisk to combine
10. Add zucchini mixture and cheese
11. Stir to combine
12. Spray pan with oil
13. Heat over medium heat
14. Using 1 heaped tablespoon per pikelet , cook 4 pikelets for 3 to 4 minutes or until bubbles appear on the surface
15. Turn
