16. Cook for 2 minutes or until cooked through
17. Transfer to a plate
18. Cover to keep warm
19. Repeat to make 16 pikelets

title: melty monsieur
steps:
1. Preheat broiler to high
2. Place bread in a single layer on a baking sheet
3. Broil 1 1 / 2 minutes on each side or until lightly toasted
4. Spread 2 teaspoons mustard blend on each bread slice
5. Top each serving with 2 bacon slices , 3 tomato slices and about 3 tablespoons cheese
6. Broil 3 minutes or until cheese melts

title: breaded turkey cutlets with asiago
steps:
1. Place the oven rack in the top third of oven
2. Preheat oven to 425 degrees
3. Set a wire rack on a baking sheet and lightly coat cutlets with oil
4. Use a pastry brush and coat all sides of turkey breasts with the dijon mustard
5. In a shallow plate combine the breadcrumbs , asiago cheese , italian herb seasoning and black pepper
6. In another bowl whisk the egg whites until frothy and opaque
7. Dip each turkey cutlet into the beaten egg then dredge in the breadcrumb mixture
8. Coat the top of each cutlet with a light mist of oil
9. Place cutlets on the wire rack and bake 40 minutes or until coating is golden and meat is no longer pink in the center

title: ensalada russa   summer salad
steps:
1. Peel the potatoes and wash them
2. Boil the potatoes and eggs in the same pot if you want or in separate pots
3. The potatoes will be done once you stick a fork in them and they break apart easily
4. Drain and set aside to cool
5. Boil the green sweet peas in a pot
6. Drain and set aside
7. In the meantime , while the potatoes are cooking , slice the olives in four pieces
8. Set aside
9. Peel the shell off of the eggs as soon as they are done cooking
10. I find that it is easier to remove the egg shell under cold running water
11. Put one egg aside and cut the remaining eggs into very small pieces
12. Check to see if potatoes are cool enough
13. If they are you will need a mixing bowl
14. Put the potatoes in the bowl and mash them with masher mash the potatoes until there are a few lumps
15. Add the tuna , eggs , peas , and olives
16. Mix all these ingredients thoroughly together using an"under and over" motion so all ingredients are mixed well
17. Add the mayonnaise a little at a time
18. I usually only need to use 2 tbsp of it
19. Mix in the mayonnaise until blended together
20. You don't want too much mayonnaise in this salad
21. Once all ingredients have been mixed transfer mix to a serving salad dish of your choice
22. You can decorate the top of the salad with the 1 egg you set aside earlier cut into four length wise pieces and the 1 slice of pimento sliced into 4 thin pieces
23. Refrigerate for a few hours or overnight and serve at your favorite bbq gathering

title: ben s totally awesome baked haddock
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Stir together mayonaise , yellow mustard , brown mustard , garlic powder , parsley , and green onions
3. Place haddock on a greased pan and brush with olive oil
4. Bake haddock in the oven for 10 minutes
5. Remove haddock from oven and spoon on topping
6. Sprinkle with french onions
7. Broil on low setting for roughly 8 minutes
8. Fish should flake easily when fully cooked

title: asian noodles and broccoli
steps:
1. Cut broccoli into bite sized chunks
2. Bring a large pot of water to boil
3. Add broccoli and cook until crunchy tender , about 4-5 minutes
4. Remove broccoli with slotted spoon , rinse under cold water , and drain
5. Add the pasta to the boiling water and cook until al dente
6. While the pasta is cooking , heat the sesame oil and olive oil in a skillet
7. Add the broccoli , tofu cubes , soy sauce , vinegar , and surgar , and stir fry for 30 seconds , then remove from heat
8. Drain the pasta and toss it with the broccoli mixture
9. Serve warm or at room temperature

title: melt in your mouth pumpkin bread
steps:
1. Mix oil , eggs and pumpkin
2. Combine remaining ingredients and add to pumpkin mixture
3. Bake in a 9x5x3-inch pan at 325 for 1 hour

title: swiss turkey wrap with fresh basil
steps:
1. Heat skillet over medium heat
2. Meanwhile , spread cheese wedge onto tortilla
3. Next layer turkey , roma tomato slices , fresh basil and fresh ground pepper
4. Spray skillet with cooking spray and place tortilla on skillet
5. Heat until turkey feels warm to the touch - careful not to let the tortilla get too dark
6. Roll up and serve !

title: roasted vegetable stock
steps:
1. Heat oven to 450f
2. Toss the vegetables with the olive oil , until gently coated
3. Place the vegetables in a roasting pan or on a foil-lined baking sheet and roast for about half an hour , turning them occasionally
4. Place all the vegetables in a large pot , scraping all the good brown stuff from the roasting pan into the pot with the herbs and peppercorns
5. Fill with water and place on the stovetop on medium high heat
6. Bring to a boil , lower the temperature , and boil gently for 2-3 hours
7. Strain , pressing down on solids to extract as much liquid as possible
8. Discard the solids and place the remaining liquid in a sauce pan
9. Simmer until reduced by three quarters
10. This could take about an hour
11. You should end up with about one and a half to two quarts of stock

title: chicken spidini
steps:
1. Wash chicken and cut each breast into 8 pieces
2. Mix olive oil with lemon , fresh diced basil , garlic , red pepper flakes , black pepper and salt
3. Reserve 1 / 4 cup of oil mixture
4. Marinate chicken in remaining oil mixture in the refrigerator overnight
5. --next day-- bring water to a boil for pasta
6. Drain the chicken and roll the chunks in a mixture of breadcrumbs , dried basil , oregano and parmesan cheese
7. Skewer and put chicken on the grill , turning until done
8. Or fry the chicken in olive oil until browned on all sides
9. Toss the cooked fettuccine noodles or penne with the reserved oil mixture and serve

title: lemon apple coleslaw
steps:
1. Combine cabbage , apples , and carrots in a large bowl
2. Whisk together mayonnaise and next 6 ingredients
3. Toss with cabbage mixture
4. Cover and chill 1 hour

title: stir fried shitake mushrooms with tofu and bok choy
steps:
1. Whisk together cornstarch and 1 tsp
2. Water in bowl
3. Whisk in soy sauce , ginger , chile sauce , garlic and sesame oil
4. Heat 1 tbs
5. Canola oil in large skillet over medium high heat
6. Stir-fry tofu7 minutes , or until golden brown
7. Transfer to plate
8. Add 1 tbs
9. Oil to pan
10. Stir-fry bok choy 4 minutes , transfer to plate
11. Add remaining 1 tbs
12. Oil to pan
13. Stir-fry mushrooms 2 minutes or until tender
14. Return tofu and bok choy to pan
15. Stir in soy sauce mixture and stir-fry 1 minute until hot

title: kentucky pecan pie  lighter version
steps:
1. In medium bowl , mix 1 cup flour and the salt
2. Cut in shortening , using pastry blender , until particles are size of small peas
3. Sprinkle with cold water , 1 tablespoon at a time , tossing with fork until all flour is moistened and pastry almost cleans side of bowl (1 to 2 teaspoons more water can be added if necessary
4. Gather pastry into a ball
5. Shape into flattened round on lightly floured surface
6. Wrap in plastic wrap
7. Refrigerate about 45 minutes or until dough is firm and cold , yet pliable
8. This allows the shortening to become slightly firm , which helps make the baked pastry more flaky
9. If refrigerated longer , let pastry soften slightly before rolling
10. Heat oven to 375f
11. With floured rolling pin , roll pastry into round 2 inches larger than upside-down 9-inch glass pie plate
12. Fold pastry into fourths
13. Place in pie plate
14. Unfold and ease into plate , pressing firmly against bottom and side
15. Trim overhanging edge of pastry 1 inch from rim of pie plate
16. Fold and roll pastry under , even with plate
17. Flute as desired
18. In large bowl , beat sugar , margarine , corn syrup , bourbon , salt , egg product and vanilla with wire whisk or hand beater
19. Stir in pecans , oats and chocolate chips
20. Pour into pastry-lined pie plate
21. Cover edge with 2- to 3-inch strip of foil to prevent excessive browning
22. Bake 40 to 50 minutes or until crust is brown and filling is set , removing foil for last 15 minutes of baking
23. Cool 30 minutes
24. Refrigerate until chilled , about 2 hours

title: oriental chicken   green bean casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Mix together all ingredients except for fried onions , and place in a 2 1 / 2 quart casserole dish or baking pan
3. Bake until heated through and bubbly
4. Top with french-fried onions , if desired , the last 5 minutes

title: gooey caramel sauce
steps:
1. Heat 1 / 4 cup sugar in a stainless saucepan on medium heat , do not stir until sugar begins to melt
2. Once sugar begins to melt , stir it until it has completely melted and begins to turn golden brown
3. When sugar has started to turn caramel colored , remove pan from heat and immediately add butter and brown sugar and quickly stir together
4. Once the butter and brown sugar are completely melded with the caramel , add the vanilla , corn syrup , cream and salt
5. Stir together well
6. The caramel will thicken as it cools
7. If a thinner caramel is required , add water one tablespoon at a time until the desired thickness is reached
8. If a thicker caramel is needed , reduce the amount of corn syrup used

title: mince beef curry
steps:
1. Heat oil in saucepan
2. Add onion and beef
3. Cook until beef has browned
4. Add all other ingredients and stir thoroughly
5. Simmer for about 10 minutes
6. Serve

title: no bake cherry custard cake
steps:
1. Tear the cake into bite-size pieces
2. Press into an 11 x 7" baking dish
3. In a mixing bowl , combine the pudding mix , milk and light sour cream
4. Beat until thickened , about 2 minutes
5. Spread over the cake
6. Spoon the cherry pie filling evenly over the top of the cake
7. Chill thoroughly until serving time

title: crock pot stout corned beef
steps:
1. Peel and cut the medium onions into 8ths , and place them in the bottom of your crock pot
2. Open up the packaged corned beef and pour all of the juices contained in the bag into the crock pot
3. Place the corned beef on top of the onions , then sprinkle with the spice packet
4. Pour the beef broth over the corned beef , careful not to dislodge too much of the spice packet ingredients , then do the same with the can of stout
5. Arrange the sliced red onion over the top of the beef
6. Put the crock pot on low and cook for 4 hours , then turn the beef over and cook an additional 4 hours
7. Slice and serve with simmered cabbage recipe #100417 , carrots , and potatoes of your choice
8. Wonderful !

title: ridiculously easy oven potato wedges
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. Dice , cube or chop the peeled potatoes into whatever shape you feel like making them
3. Rinse then thoroughly in cold water , drain well and transfer to a large bowl
4. Add oil and toss the potatoes around so they are evenly coated
5. Add all of the spices and the cheese and toss so they are evenly coated
6. Place on a baking pan in one layer and bake for around 30-40 minutes , depending on person preference of potato texture
7. Suggestions ! it's really really handy to line the pan before you bake them , or else you will have a sticky baked on mess on your pans that takes an awful lot of elbow grease to get rid of
8. You could add lemon juice to the potatoes to give them an extra fresh taste

title: strawberry short cake  adult drink
steps:
1. Combine ingredients all ingredients in a blender
2. Blend on pulse setting until its the consistency of a milkshake about 30 seconds
3. Pour into glass
4. Top with whipped cream if desired
5. Enjoy !

title: stir fry chicken with lemon grass  ga xao xa
steps:
1. Optional: scallion oil and fish dipping sauce
2. I have put up these sauces seperatly but i highly recomend them
3. Mix the fish sauce and sugar until the sugar is disolved
4. Stir in 1 tbsp of the vegetable oil along with the lemongrass and garlic
5. Add the chicken pieces , makeing sure to coat pieces well and evenly
6. Allow the chicken to maranate in the mixture for 2 hours in the refrigerator
7. Heat the remaining oil in a wok or nonstick pan on high heat
8. When cooking chicken , add chili until the chicken is cooked through
9. Serve with scallion oil and nuoc cham on the side w / rice

title: tropical chicken with mango yogurt dipping sauce
steps:
1. To prepare dipping sauce place mango in a food processor or blender , add yogurt , jalapeno , lime juice , green onion and salt
2. Pulse until smooth and refrigerate until needed
3. Thread cubed chicken , pineapple , green peppers and red onion onto the soaked bamboo skewers sprinkling with salt and pepper
4. Heat bbq or charcoal grill to medium heat and spray with cooking oil if needed
5. Place skewers on grill and cook 5 to 7 minutes per side turning as needed until the chicken is thoroughly cooked
6. Serve with the dipping sauce

title: chicken ragu over saffron linguine
steps:
1. Put a pot of water on to boil for cooking linguine
2. Cut chicken breasts into strips
3. In a bowl toss chicken with 1 teaspoon oil , 1 / 8 teaspoon red pepper flakes and salt and pepper to taste
4. Heat a 12-inch non-stick skillet over moderately high heat and saute in 2 batches until lightly browned and cooked through , stirring , for 5 minutes on each side , transferring as cooked to a plate
5. To skillet add wine and boil until most is evaporated
6. Add the remaining 1 teaspoon oil , onion , garlic , mushrooms , remaining 1 / 8 teaspoon red pepper flakes and salt and pepper to taste and cook over moderate heat , stirring , until onion is softened and mushroom liquid is gone
7. In a bowl whisk together tomato paste , chicken broth and lemon zest
8. Add to skillet along with the red pepper
9. Simmer mixture , covered , 5 minutes
10. Add tomatoes , lemon juice , and simmer5 minutes - add lemon juice and spinach , bail , and parsley
11. Simmer until spinach is wilted , 2 minutes
12. Add capers if desired
13. In a very small bowl combine hot water and saffron
14. Cook the linguine until al dente
15. Drain linguineand return to the pot
16. Toss linguine with saffron mixture until evenly coated and keep warm
17. Divide the pasta onto 4-6 plates , top with chicken ragu , garnish with basil and parsley leaves ,

title: crock pot sour cream chicken
steps:
1. In a crock pot add all ingredients except chicken and potatoes
2. Whisk until smooth
3. Add chicken
4. Cook all day on low or cook on high for 4 hrs
5. Add potatoes and cook for 1 hour
6. If you cook all day , warm potatoes in a pan before you put them in soup mixture

title: beef and macaroni
steps:
1. Place hamburger in large skillet
2. Separate into small pieces and saute till meat is brown
3. Remove meat from skillet and drain off most liquid
4. Place pasta in boiling water for 8 minutes and drain
5. Add 1 tbsp olive oil to skillet and saute onion , celery , peppers , and garlic till soft
6. Add cooked pasta , hamburg , tomatoes , bouillon , parsley , sugar and pepper
7. Toss ingredients
8. Simmer slowly for 20-minutes while stirring frequently
9. Serve when flavors have blended
10. A small bowl of dry american cheese should accompany the meal with crusty bread , and green salad

title: nancy slice
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180c
2. Melt butter , golden syrup and brown sugar
3. Add to dry ingredients
4. Mix well and press into greased swiss roll tray
5. Bake at for 15-20 minutes
6. While hot spread caramel icing over and cut while warm
7. Caramel icing:
8. In a pot melt brown sugar , milk and butter , then bring to boil
9. Beat with wooden spoon till thickens and pour over cake immediately

title: tex mex hot sauce
steps:
1. Combine the tomato paste with the water in a medium saucepan and whisk until smooth
2. Add the remaining ingredients and stir until combined
3. Heat mixture over medium high heat until it begins to boil
4. Continue to cook for about 3 minutes , stirring often
5. Remove from heat
6. When sauce is cool enough to taste , try a sample and call your local fire department if necessary
7. If it's not hot enough for you , add some jalapenos and / or cayenne pepper and / or ground red pepper
8. When sauce has cooled sufficiently poured it into a sealed container and refrigerate

title: yule love these sugar plum cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f slice cookies into 1 / 8 inch slices
2. To half the cookies , cut out centers using a small christmas cookie cutter
3. To the other half , use a marble or small round item and indent a small well in the center , rolling almost to the edges with the marble
4. Place about 1 / 2 tsp of the plum preserves leaving the edges free of jam
5. Top with the cut out slices
6. Press edges to seal and sprinkle with the colored sugar crystals
7. Place onto a parchment lined baking sheet and bake aprox 8-10 minutes

title: the best fishcakes
steps:
1. Cook ther potatoes in salted water until they are very tender and then drain them and mash them finely
2. Combine with the fish and other ingredients down to and including the seasonsings and then using wet hands shape them into eight patties
3. Dust them with flour and then dip them into the egg and finallyu coat with the crumbs
4. Heat oil to moderate and cook them until they are golden browqn on both sides
5. For the sauce simply combine the ingredients and mix well together and serve over patties and a sharp green salad

title: pumpkin breakfast cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees
2. Spray 2 large baking sheets with non-stick butter cooking spray , set aside
3. Stir flours , sugar , baking soda , cinnamon and ginger in large mixing bowl until well combined
4. Add pumpkin , egg substitute and 1 / 4 cup sf maple flavored pancake syrup in a small bowl and mix well
5. Add pumpkin mixture to flour mixture and stir until well combined , but do not overmix
6. Scoop 1 / 2 cup + 1 tablespoons dough onto baking sheet
7. Flatten with moist spatula or fork
8. Continue with the rest of the dough
9. Bake 18-20 minutes or until browned on bottom and dark on top
10. Yield=6 big cookies @ 3pts
11. 4 @ 5pts
12. 10 @ 2pts
13. 12-30 cookies @ 1 pt
14. Ea

title: pennsylvania grange banana nut bread   grange   1751
steps:
1. Cream sugar and shortening
2. Add eggs one at a time and then add the mashed bananas and vanilla
3. Add dry ingredients alternately with the buttermilk and chopped nuts
4. Put batter in 2 greased and floured 9x5 inch loaf pans and bake at 350 degrees for 45 - 50 min
5. , or until a wooden toothpick comes out clean when inserted
6. Cool for 10 min
7. , then remove from pans
8. Slice when cold
9. Keeps moist when tightly wrapped
10. Freezes well
11. Delicious toasted !

title: spicy quinoa pilau
steps:
1. In a large pot , fry the onion in a little oil
2. Add the garlic , cloves , cardamom and chili pepper , and fry a bit more
3. Add the vegetables and continue frying
4. Add the quinoa , water , cinnamon , coriander seeds , and bay leaves
5. Bring to a boil , then lower the heat , cover and simmer for about 12 minutes , or until the quinoa has absorbed the water
6. About halfway through the simmering , stir in any frozen vegetables you want to add

title: spicy hummus
steps:
1. Drain 1 can of chick peas and use the other with the liquid
2. Add ingredients to blender in order listed
3. Mixture will be very thick and may need tamping
4. Blend until smooth
5. Taste , and adjust seasoning to your liking
6. This makes a large batch of hummus
7. It keeps very well in the fridge

title: mini mexican cherry pepper quiches
steps:
1. In medium-sized bowl , slightly beat egg , whisk in cream , tomato sauce , cumin , chili powder , salt , garlic and pepper
2. Set aside
3. In small frying pan , cook sausage , crumbling fine , drain grease
4. Add butter , corn , green onion , mushrooms and zucchini , cook 3-5 minutes longer til just tender
5. Add to egg mixture
6. Cut tops off of peppers and scoop out seeds , place in muffin pan according to size of peppers , fill , sprinkle top with cheese
7. Bake in 375 oven for 15 minutes til filling is puffed and golden brown
8. Cool 5 minutes , serve warm

title: breakfast hash
steps:
1. Crumble sausage into large skillet
2. Add potatoes , peppers and onion , and cook over low heat until sausage is browned and potatoes are fork-tender , stirring occasionally
3. Drain off any drippings
4. Whisk eggs and milk in small bowl until blended
5. Add to sausage mixture
6. Scramble until eggs are set but not dry
7. Serve hot , and refrigerate leftovers

title: aunt ernestines oriental salad
steps:
1. Shred cabbage
2. Toast sesame seeds and almonds
3. Break noodles uncooked into little pieces
4. Chopp green onions
5. Toss together
6. Mix dressing
7. Just before serving add dressing:

title: vegetable party sandwiches
steps:
1. Dissolve gelatin in water according to directions
2. In a large bowl , mix dissolved gelatin with carrots , celery , cucumber , onion , lemon juice and mayonnaise
3. Refrigerate for 25 hours
4. When ready to make sandwiches , if mixture is too jelled to spread well , add 1 / 3 to 1 / 2 cup more mayonnaise
5. Using an electric knife , trim crusts from bread edges
6. Spread vegetable mixture on bread and make 28 sandwiches
7. Cut into quarters
8. Layer cut sandwiches in a large plastic container with damp paper towels between layers until serving time

title: tuna hold the noodle casserole
steps:
1. Mix together tuna and soup
2. You may need to add a little more soup , if you want it a little more moist
3. Spread 1 / 3 of mixture in casserole dish
4. Spread crushed potato chips over top so that tuna mixture is covered
5. Spread another third of the tuna mixture on top of potato chips
6. Add another layer of crushed potato chips spread remaining tuna mixture on chips and top with another layer of crushed potato chips
7. Bake in over at 350 degrees f for about 35-45 minutes or until top layer of chips are slightly brown and casserole is heated through
8. Enjoy !
9. And be prepared to make more , because it goes fast !

title: old fashioned blueberry muffins
steps:
1. In a large bowl combine flour , sugar , baking powder and salt
2. Stir in blueberries until coated with flour
3. Put eggs in 4 cup glas measuring cup and add enough milk to measure 2 cups
4. Add oil and whisk until blended
5. Make well in center of flour mixture and pour milk mixture
6. With large spatula , gently fold dry ingredients into wet ingredients just until moistened
7. Spoon into greased muffin pan
8. 400f for 30 minutes or until tops are firm to the touch

title: swedish meat dumpling stoup
steps:
1. Heat a soup pot over medium to medium-high heat
2. Add in olive oil and butter
3. When the butter melts into the oil , add in the mushrooms , celery , carrots , onions , and bay leaf
4. Cook until the mushrooms are tender and the other vegetables begin to soften , 7-8 minutes
5. Season with salt and pepper
6. Add in the flour
7. Cook another minute
8. Whisk in the beef and chicken broth to combine
9. Cover the pot and bring to a boil
10. While the soup comes to a boil , mix the veal with the mustard , egg , bread crumbs , nutmeg , salt , and pepper
11. Roll the meat into small balls , 1-inch in diameter , tops
12. Remove the lid from the pot and add in the balls
13. After 2-3 minutes , stir in the egg noodles and cook 6 minutes more
14. Turn off the heat and stir in the sour cream into the stoup
15. Adjust taste w / salt and pepper
16. Discard bay leaf
17. Serve stoup with a generous sprinkle of chives or dill and chopped parsley

title: sausage and cabbage casserole
steps:
1. First of all , prepare the cabbage
2. Put a big pot with water to boil
3. Do it first , this way it will get to the boiling point by the time you're done with the cabbage
4. Cut the cabbage head in half , then again in half , and then cut the core out by cutting the corner diagonally
5. Then cut it in inches wide strips , and separate them a little
6. Once the water boils , salt well , and put all the cabbage inches it will look like a lot , but don't worry , it will wilt down a lot too
7. Cover
8. As soon as the water returns to a boil , count 10 to 15 minutes , and drain
9. Reserve
10. As the cabbage is cooking , you can get started on the other vegetables
11. First the carrots
12. Peel them and cut them in 1 / 3 of an inch slices
13. Reserve
14. Wash the leeks
15. Leeks need to be really washed thoroughly
16. First remove the first couple of peels , cut the dark green hard part of and trim the roots
17. Then cut them in half , almost all the way , but leaving the bottom inch still attached
18. Wash them really well , check each leaf on both sides for dirt
19. Then chop them 2 / 3 of an inch thick chunks
20. Put them in a colander , and separate them , under running water to be safe for dirt
21. Reserve
22. Now chop some bacon in half inch thick chunks
23. I use about 6-7 slices of bacon , but you can use more if you like
24. Just don't use less , we need both the fat the bacon is going to release , and the flavor as a base for the cabbage
25. Just before you actually start cooking the dish , rinse the pot you cooked the cabbage in , put your potatoes in , lukewarm water , cover and put to boil
26. When it boils , add 2 cubes of knorr vegetable bouillon cube , and salt liberally
27. Once it comes to a boil , pre-cook them for 20 minutes , then remove from the heat and leave in the scalding water untill you're ready for them
28. Now we are actually ready to start cooking
29. Start the bacon it in the braisier with a little olive oil on medium heat to get it started
30. Once its starting to become golden , remove it from the pan with a slotted spoon and reserve
31. In the same fat , add half a tbsp of lard and saute the carrots on medium heat with a little salt
32. Cover for 5-10 minutes , toss , cover again , for another 5-10 minutes , until they are starting to become golden
33. Remove from the pan with a slotted spoon and reserve
34. In the same fat , lower the heat to medium low , toss in the leeks , with a tbsp of butter , salt and pepper , and cover it until it begins to melt , about 10 minutes
35. Add the cabbage and the bacon back in the pan and toss everything together until its mixed well
36. Push it a little to make room for the 2 sausages , and hide the carrots behind the barrier made by the sausages
37. I use hillshire farm
38. Taste the cabbage for salt
39. Then cover with 2 cups of beef stock
40. When i don't have time to make my own , i use kitchen basics beef stock , because as its low in sodium , it allows me to control the salt
41. Now peel the potatoes , and nest them well in the cabbage so they can suck up all the flavors
42. If you have extra potatoes you can put the extra ones on top of the sausages too
43. Turn the heat to low , now its simmer time
44. Put a nob of butter on top of each potato , and sprinkle them generously with paprika
45. Cover
46. Flipp them once after 30 minutes
47. Baste them with the juices and sprinkle them with paprika on the other side
48. Cover for half an hour
49. After half an hour , spoon the juice over the potatoes and the cabbage to have them absorb the flavors
50. Do it again every half hour for the next 2 hours , keeping it covered
51. Check the cabbage for salt and rectify if necessary
52. Uncover , turn the heat up to medium / medium low , and let the beef stock reduce almost all the way through
53. Slice the sausage and put it back in the braisier
54. Serve with dijon mustard
55. Enjoy !
56. It's one of these vegetables that need a long cooking time to develop their sweetness and be good
57. The entire dish would be "cooked" per-se , an hour and a half earlier , but it needs that extra hour and a half , basting every 30 minutes , for the cabbage to taste right and the potatoes to absorb all the flavors of the dish
58. The more you cook this dish , the better it will get
59. It's also a great dish to make a day in advance and reheat covered on very low heat
60. In this case , stop it at the "pause" stage , when you uncover it and let the beef stock reduce for half an hour
61. It will finish reducing as you re-heat it , only , you would keep it covered first until it starts to simmer

title: aunt donna s tomato  cheese and macaroni casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Add beaten eggs and evaporated milk to the cooked macaroni and slowly bring to a simmer over low heat
3. Continue cooking on med
4. Heat until thick and creamy , about 6 to 8 minute
5. Remove from heat and add drained rotel tomatoes , tomato soup and the cooked onions
6. Next add the monterey jack cheese and mix well
7. Pour mixture into a greased or sprayed casserole dish , cover and bake for 20 minute
8. Last remove casserole from the oven and add cheddar cheese
9. Return casserole to the oven uncovered and bake until the cheese is melted
10. Option - i sometimes add diced mushrooms to this recipe and it's even better ! enjoy !

title: grilled chicken and mango salad
steps:
1. Combine dressing ingredients in a screw top jar and shake well
2. Combine everything else in a large bowl and top with dressing
3. Toss to coat

title: strawberry vinaigrette
steps:
1. Place the strawberries in a blender
2. Cover and process until smooth
3. Add lemon juice and sugar
4. While processing , gradually add vinegar and oil in a steady stream and process until thickened
5. Stir in poppy seeds
6. Place in a jar and refrigerate until serving time

title: layered ramen casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees
2. Separate the ramen noodles from their flavor packets
3. Brown beef , mixing in one ramen noodle flavor packet and the rehydrated onion
4. Add the other ramen flavor packet if beef needs more flavor
5. Typically you wont need to
6. Drain beef and pour into the bottom of a 8x8 dish or a 2qt glass dish , both work
7. Sprinkle 1 / 2 cup cheese over the top of beef while it's still hot , so it melts into it
8. Cook egg in same pan as beef , i usually just mix the egg really well and cook through , but you can scramble it if you prefer
9. Place egg on top of beef and add another 1 / 2 cup cheese
10. Boil ramen noodles until softened and drain
11. Mix prego into ramen noodles and pour on top of the eggs
12. Sprinkle the rest of the cheese on top of the noodles
13. Place in oven for 10 minutes or until cheese is melted

title: sos   creamed beef  the real one
steps:
1. Brown the beef do not drain the grease is needed for the gravy
2. Sprinkle the flour over the beef to coat it
3. Add the garlic powder
4. Slowly stir in the milk keep stiring or you get lumps until thick add more or less milk to desired thickness
5. Serve over toast add more garlic powder or garlic salt if like
6. Enjoy and be at ease

title: low fat chilaquiles
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f heat a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat
2. Add 1 tablespoon canola oil to coat the bottom of the pot
3. Add the ground turkey to the hot oil and brown , breaking it up as it cooks
4. Drain meat and reserve
5. To the same skillet , add the onions and cook over medium heat until soft
6. Then add the garlic and cook until soft
7. Stir in the chili powder and cumin
8. Add the chiles and their juices and the tomatoes and their juices
9. Add the meat back to the pan and stir until combined
10. Reduce heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes or until thick
11. Season with salt , to taste , and pepper
12. In a medium bowl , combine cheddar and cream cheese
13. Set aside
14. Line a casserole dish with half the tortillas and ladle half of the meat mixture over
15. Cover with half of the cheese mixture like a lassagne
16. Top with half of the green onions
17. Repeat layers 1 more time
18. Bake for 45 minutes or until bubbling and let stand for 5 minutes before serving

title: jell o 123
steps:
1. Mix jello and hot water in a blender about 1 minute on high
2. Add creamer and blend for 30 seconds
3. Add cold water and ice and blend until ice has dissolved
4. Add powdered egg whites and blend for about one minute
5. Pour into glasses slowly
6. Refrigerate and it will separate just like you remember it

title: ww 5 points   baked beef ziti
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Cook pasta according to package directions without added fat or salt
3. Drain and set aside
4. Meanwhile , heat oil in a medium saucepan over medium heat
5. Add garlic and saut 2 minutes
6. Add beef and cook until browned , breaking up the meat as it cooks , about 3 to 5 minutes
7. Drain off any fat and return pan to heat
8. Add oregano , thyme , rosemary , salt and pepper
9. Stir to coat beef
10. Cook until herbs become fragrant , about 2 minutes
11. Add tomatoes and bring mixture to a boil
12. Reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes
13. Spoon a small amount of tomato mixture into the bottom of a 4-quart casserole dish
14. Top with half of the cooked ziti and then layer with half of the remaining tomato sauce and half of the mozzarella cheese
15. Layer remaining ziti on top and top with remaining sauce and mozzarella cheese
16. Bake until cheese is golden and bubbly , about 30 minutes
17. 5 points yields about 1 cup per serving

title: kraft s fantasy fudge
steps:
1. Line 9" square pan with foil
2. Bring margerine , sugar & evaporated milk to
3. A full boil , stirring constantly
4. Boil 4 minutes , stirring constantly , until
5. Candy reaches 234 degrees
6. Remove from heat
7. Add chocolate & marshallow creme , until
8. Melted
9. Add walnuts and vanilla , mix well
10. Spread evenly in prepared pan
11. Let stand at room temperature for 4 hours
12. Cut into 1" squares

title: baked ziti  meatless
steps:
1. Cook ziti according to package directions
2. In lasagna pan , pour enough of the spaghetti sauce to cover bottom
3. Combine all ingredients except parmesan and about 1 / 3 cup of mozzarella
4. Add cooked ziti and stir to coat well
5. Pour pasta mixture into prepared lasagna pan
6. Sprinkle reserved cheeses over top
7. Cover and bake for 30 minutes at 375 degrees
8. Remove cover and brown cheese for 10 minutes more

title: aunt susan s taco soup
steps:
1. Brown beef & onion in pan , drain grease
2. Mix all ingredients in crock-pot
3. Cook on high for about an hour , or low for a couple of hours
4. It will produce more liquid as it cooks so it won't be dry when you eat it
5. We eat ours with scoops corn chips & throw some shredded cheese on top
6. Delicious !

title: cabbage zucchini stir fry
steps:
1. Saute the garlic in the oil , do not allow to burn
2. Add veggies& stir fry for 2-3 minutes
3. Add seasonings and continue to stir fry for about 3 minutes

title: easy tuscan chicken
steps:
1. In a skillet with a tight-fitting lid , heat oil until it shimmers
2. Add chicken strips and garlic and saute until chicken is beginning to brown , about 5 minutes
3. Add beans , tomatoes and italian seasoning
4. Stir well , cover , and simmer until chicken is cooked through , about 10 minutes

title: middle eastern tahini and yogurt appetizer
steps:
1. Put yogurt , tahini , cilantro , vinegar , garlic , salt , pepper and cayenne in medium bowl and stir with wooden spoon until blended
2. Spread mixture on small serving platter
3. Decorate with tomato and drizzle with olive oil before serving with assorted veggies and / or pita bread

title: penne with bacon  spinach   mushrooms
steps:
1. Cook pasta as package directs
2. Meanwhile , cook bacon in large , deep nonstick skillet over medium heat until browned
3. Remove bacon to paper towels to drain
4. Remove all but 2 t fat from skillet
5. Add onion and mushrooms to skillet
6. Saute 5 minutes until onion is golden
7. Add garlic and red pepper flakes
8. Cook 30 seconds until fragrant
9. Add spinach
10. Cover and cook , stirring occasionally , 2 minutes until wilted
11. Drain pasta , reserving 1 cup pasta water
12. Add pasta to skillet with some of the reserved pasta water
13. Toss
14. Add more water as necessary
15. Crumble bacon on top of pasta and serve with parmesan

title: red cabbage and bacon salad with blue cheese
steps:
1. Cut cabbage in half , remove the core , and then cut into quarters
2. Finely shred the quarters , and transfer to a large bowl
3. Heat the vinegar to boiling in a small saucepan
4. Pour the vinegar over the shredded cabbage and toss to mix so it's thoroughly coated
5. Pour the boiling water over the cabbage and let it stand until slightly softened , about 3-4 minutes
6. Drain thoroughly in a colander , then return it to the large bowl
7. Toss the cabbage with enough vinaigrette to moisten well
8. Taste for seasonings and add more vinegar , if needed
9. Cover the bowl and marinate the cabbage in the dressing 1-2 hours
10. The cabbage will turn a pinkish color
11. Twist off and discard the root end of the romaine
12. Wash romaine well , then drain the leaves well
13. Stack the leaves and roll them up tightly
14. Cut the rolled leaves cross-wise into wide strips
15. Crumble the blue cheese into a small bowl with your fingers
16. About 10 minutes before serving the salad , stack the bacon slices and cut crosswise into strips
17. Cook the bacon until crisp and the fat has melted , about 3-5 minutes
18. Spoon the hot bacon and pan juices over the red cabbage , reserving some bacon for garnish
19. Toss them together
20. Arrange a bed of shredded romaine leaves onto serving plates
21. Spoon any remaining dressing over the lettuce
22. Mound the red cabbage and bacon mixture in the center
23. Top the salads with blue cheese and reserved
24. Bacon in the center
25. The vinaigrette can be made ahead up to 1 week ahead
26. Times do not include marinating

title: apricot raisin coffee cake
steps:
1. I used my bread machine on the dough cycle but you may make your dough the traditional way if you prefer
2. Put water , eggs and oil in bottom of bread machine pan
3. Mix together the whole wheat flour , bread flour , and 4 teaspoons of the grated lemon rind , and add on top of your wet ingredients
4. On top of the flour mixture , add powdered milk , sugar , salt and yeast
5. Set bread machine to dough cycle
6. Meanwhile , using kitchen shears or a knife , cut up apricots to about the same size as your raisins , then measure them and mix together with the raisins
7. When dough cycle is complete , take out your dough and divide it into two pieces , one slightly larger than the other
8. Using your fingers or a dough roller , spread the larger piece of dough over the bottom of a well-greased 7"x11" or 9" square baking dish
9. Sprinkle approximately half of the brown sugar over the dough , then top with raisin-apricot mixture
10. Divide the other piece of dough into 24 small balls , then flatten each ball between your hands
11. Place the dough disks on top , distributing them evenly around the dish
12. Sprinkle with the remaining brown sugar , then the remaining 4 teaspoons grated lemon rind
13. Let rise in a very warm place for 30 to 45 minutes then bake in a preheated 350 degree oven for 12 to 15 minutes , or until lightly browned on top
14. Cut , eat and enjoy !

title: light cucumber canapes
steps:
1. Place the cottage cheese , mayonnaise , and parmesan in a blender or food processor and process until smooth
2. Drop about two teaspoons of the mixture onto each cucumber slice and garnish with a fresh parsley sprig

title: linguica con queso  cheese grilled sausage
steps:
1. Slice the sausage in half lengthwise
2. Preheat grill to medium-high
3. Brush and oil grill grate
4. Grill sausage , cut side down , until sizzling and golden brown , 3-5 minutes
5. Turn sausage over
6. Thickly sprinkle cut side with cheese
7. Close grill lid and continue grilling until sausage is browned on uncut side and cheese is melted and bubbling , about 3 minutes more
8. Using a spatula , carefully transfer the linguica to a cutting board , keeping the cheese on top
9. Cut crosswise into 1" pieces
10. Serve on toothpicks

title: fannie mae fudge
steps:
1. Mix sugar , milk , vanilla and butter in pan
2. Bring to a boil for 2 minutes , turn off heat
3. Add marshmallows and stir until melted
4. Add all chocolate and stir until melted
5. Add nuts and fold into mixture
6. Pour into a greased raised edge cookie sheet or jelly roll pan
7. Set aside and let cool to room temperature and then cut into bite size pieces
8. Enjoy !

title: crunchy granola
steps:
1. Heat oven to 275 degrees f
2. Line 2 cookie sheets with parchment paper
3. Combine brown sugar and water in a 4 cup microwave proof cup
4. Microwave on high 5 minutes until sugar is completely dissolved
5. Remove from microwave and stir in vanilla and salt
6. In large mixing bowl , mix oats , nuts , and brown sugar mixture
7. Mix thoroughly
8. Spread onto cookie sheets and bake 45 minutes-1 hour until golden brown
9. When granola has cooled completely , add fruits if you wish and store in airtight container

title: bacon wrapped grilled onions
steps:
1. Combine sugar , vinegar , and molasses in a zip-lock bag
2. Squish bag to combine ingredients
3. Wrap onion wedges with bacon
4. Secure with long wooden picks
5. Place in zip-lock bag
6. Put in refrigerator overnight
7. Turn bag over a couple of times
8. Remove onion wedges from marinade
9. Reserve marinade
10. Bake in a 350 degree oven until bacon starts to crisp , about 15 minutes
11. Grill to finish cooking onion and bacon
12. Basting with reserved marinade
13. Don't cook too long , the onion should still be crisp-tender
14. Or if you don't want to grill the onions , let them finish in the oven
15. Basting occasionally
16. Prep time reflects the overnight in the fridge

title: belinda s tilapia recipe
steps:
1. In a 9x13-inch roasting pan drizzle olive oil on bottom of pan
2. Place green beans on bottom of pan
3. Stuff spinach into pan , it will look overflowing do not worry about this it will cook down
4. Lay tilapia over top of spinach , top with garlic , onions , and tomatoes
5. Drizzle with olive oil
6. Cover with foil and cook 30-40 minutes at 350f
7. Uncover and sprinkle parmesan cheese and return to oven to bake for additional 10 minutes or until cheese is melted

title: texas dry rub beer can chicken
steps:
1. In a small bowl combine the rub ingredients
2. Remove and discard the neck , giblets , and any excess fat from the chicken
3. Rinse the chicken , inside and out , under cold water and pat dry with paper towels
4. Lightly spray or brush all over with the vegetable oil and season , inside and out , with the rub
5. Let rest at room temperature while you preheat your grill
6. Open the beer can an pour off half of the beer
7. Set the half-full can of beer in can holder , and add fresh rosemary leaves , minced shallot and lemon juice
8. This will help add moisture and flavor from the inside as your chicken cooks
9. You may need to use a funnel , to help add the ingredients to the can
10. Slide the chicken over the top so the can fits inside the cavity
11. Transfer the bird to your preheated grill , while carefully keeping the can upright
12. Carefully balance the bird on its two legs and the can holder
13. Grill over indirect medium heat until the juices run clear and the internal temperature reaches 170 f in the breast and 180 f in the thickest part of the thigh
14. 1 - 1 / 4 to 1 - 1 / 2 hours
15. Wearing barbecue mitts , carefully remove the chicken and the can from the grill
16. Do not spill the beer , it will be hot
17. Let the chicken rest for about 10 minutes before lifting it from the can
18. Discard the beer
19. Cut the chicken into serving pieces
20. Serve warm
21. Enjoy !

title: ultimate cream of tomato soup
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees
2. Adjusting oven rack to upper-middle position
3. Line cookie sheet with foil
4. Spread tomatoes in single layer on foil , and sprinkle evenly with brown sugar
5. Bake until all liquid has evaporated and tomatoes begin to color , about 30 minutes
6. Let tomatoes cool slightly , then peel them off foil
7. Transfer to small bowl and set aside
8. Heat butter over medium heat in medium nonreactive saucepan until foaming
9. Add shallots , tomato paste , and allspice
10. Reduce heat to low , cover , and cook , stirring occasionally , until shallots are softened , 7 to 10 minutes
11. Add flour and cook , stirring constantly , until thoroughly combined , about 30 seconds
12. Whisking constantly , gradually adding chicken stock
13. Stir in reserved tomato juice and roasted tomatoes
14. Cover , increase heat to medium , and bring to boil
15. Reduce heat to low and simmer , stirring occasionally , to blend flavors , about 10 minutes
16. Remove from heat and using an immersible blender puree the tomatoes
17. Add cream , and heat over low heat until hot , about 3 minutes
18. Remove from heat and stir in brandy or sherry
19. Season to taste with salt and cayenne , and serve immediately
20. To make ahead
21. This soup can be prepared through step 11 cooled , covered , and refrigerated for up to 3 days or frozen for up to 2 months
22. Reheat over low heat before proceeding with step 12

title: oriental chicken summer salad
steps:
1. Combine all salad ingredients
2. Drizzle with dressing & serve

title: carrot chocolate cupcakes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Finely mince carrots in a food processor
3. Combine carrots , sugar , oil , buttermilk , and eggs in a large bowl
4. Combine flour , soda and salt , in a separate bowl , stirring with a whisk
5. Add flour mixture to carrot mixture
6. Stir until all flour is incorporated ,
7. Stir in chocolate
8. Spoon batter into 22 muffin cups lined with paper liners
9. Bake for 22 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean
10. Cool muffins in tin for 10 minutes then sprinkle with powdered sugar

title: ginger marinated tuna steaks
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine all ingredients except tuna
2. Place tuna steaks in a plastic ziploc type bag
3. Add marinade to bag and seal
4. Set bag in a shallow pan
5. Refrigerate for 30 minutes , turning bag occasionally to coat
6. Lightly coat the grill rack with nonstick cooking spray
7. Drain tuna and discard marinade
8. Grill fish for 10 ro 12 minutes or until fish flakes with a fork , turning once

title: maple walnut pizzelles
steps:
1. In a large mixing bowl , beat eggs and sugar together
2. Add cooled butter , maple syrup and walnuts
3. In another bowl , sift flour and baking powder and add to egg mixture
4. Batter will be stiff enough to be dropped by spoon onto the grids
5. Drop one heaping teaspoon of batter on preheated pizzelle iron grid
6. Close iron and bake according to manufacturer's directions approximately 30-40 seconds depending on your preference for browning , or the consistency of the batter

title: baby carrots with lemon   walnuts
steps:
1. In a bowl , combine the walnuts , parsley , lemon zest , and raisins
2. Set aside
3. In a saucepan , combine the broth , lemon juice , and dill and heat over medium-high heat
4. When the liquid is just beginning to boil , add the carrots
5. Cover and steam until the carrots are tender-crisp , about 3 minutes
6. Uncover the pan and continue to cook , shaking the pan frequently , until the carrots are tender and the broth is nearly evaporated , about 3 minutes longer
7. Transfer to a bowl , add the salt and the walnut mixture , and toss to combine
8. Serve immediately

title: my mother s upside down cake
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 180-190c / 350-375f / gas mark 4
2. Prepare the fruit , melt the butter and pour into the bottom of a 7 inch ovenproof dish or cake tin
3. Top with the brown sugar and golden syrup and arrange the pineapple rings on the glaze
4. Add a piece of banana in the centre of each ring
5. For the cake: cream the butter and sugar
6. Gradually beat in the eggs , then fold in the flour
7. Spread over the fruit then bake for approximately 1 1 / 4 hours
8. Turn out , serve hot with a helping of cool double cream which soaks so yummily into the sponge -- or even cold as a cake rather than a dessert
9. Warning: to not leave the remaining cake batter on the side- you'll demolish it ! or the kids will :)
10. Serves 4 as a dessert , 6 for tea

title: italian pork tenderloin
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a skillet over medium-high heat
2. Saute the prosciutto , parsley , sun-dried tomatoes , onion and garlic 5 minutes , until onion is tender
3. Mix the pork strips into the skillet and brown about 10 minutes , turning once
4. Stir the broth and heavy cream into the skillet , and season with salt and pepper
5. Bring to a boil
6. Reduce heat to low , and simmer 20 minutes , stirring occasionally until pork reaches a minimum temperature of 160 degrees and sauce is thickened
7. For thicker sauce , mix a little flour with a little water and stir into sauce

title: my favorite caramel frosting
steps:
1. Sprinkle 1 / 2 cup sugar in a heavy saucepan
2. Place over medium heat
3. Cook , stirring constantly , until sugar melts and syrup is light golden brown
4. The sugar will start to clump , this is normal , just keep stirring
5. Combine reamaining 2 1 / 2 cups sugar , milk , beaten egg , and salt , stirring well , stir in the butter
6. Stir mixture into carmelized sugar , the mixture will lump again , just keep stirring
7. Cook over medium heat stirring frequently , until a candy thermometer registers at 230f , this takes about 15-20 minutes , but don't rely on the time ! check the thermometer ! )cool mixture 5 minutes
8. Beat mixture with a wooden spoon to almost spreading consistency
9. The mixture will cool and thicken quickly at this point
10. Spread on a cooled cake

title: provencal salmon
steps:
1. Court bouillon:
2. Slice carrots , celery and leek into 1 / 4 inch pieces
3. Place in the bottom of a saucepan
4. Add the remaining ingredients and bring to a boil
5. Boil for 20 minutes
6. Yield: makes about 2 quarts
7. Combine the olive oil , sherry vinegar , basil , shallots , tomatoes , lemon rind , chives , and tarragon
8. Season with salt and pepper to taste
9. Let marinate overnight , unrefrigerated
10. Cut carrots , leek and celery into julienne
11. Cook them in 1 cup strained court bouillon until tender but still crisp
12. Drain and reserve
13. Wrap each salmon fillet in foil and poach in court bouillon for approximately 5 minutes
14. To check the degree of doneness , remove 1 package from the liquid and unwrap
15. The center should still be slightly pink
16. To serve , divide julienne of vegetables among serving plates
17. Arrange salmon fillets in the center of the julienne and top each fillet with a tablespoon of the sauce pistou
18. Serve remaining sauce separately

title: bahamas bread
steps:
1. Mix all the ingredients together and knead for thirty to forty seconds
2. Let rise and knock down and knead for thirty seconds
3. Repeat
4. Allow final rise in a bread pan , about forty minutes , and preheat oven to 425 f
5. Place in oven and decrease temperature to 350 f
6. Bake for thirty minutes

title: dense  delicious brownies  gluten free  dairy casein free
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Lightly grease an 8x8 pan and set aside
3. In a small bowl , mix together flour , xanthan gum and salt
4. Set aside
5. In a large bowl , stir together cocoa and margarine 'til well combined
6. Mix in sugar until completely saturated
7. Break egg into a small bowl , then mix completely into cocoa mixture
8. Do the same with the second egg
9. Stir in extracts
10. Mix in flour , combining completely but not overmixing
11. Stir in non-dairy chocolate chips
12. Bake for 20-22 minutes , checking with a toothpick for doneness
13. Let cook in pan , then remove and eat it
14. Don't share

title: tomatoes stuffed with eggs and anchovies
steps:
1. Slice the top off of each tomato
2. Using a spoon , gently remove the pulp and seeds
3. Lightly salt the insides and then invert onto a plate for 30 minutes to drain
4. In a small bowel stir together the mustard and salt to taste until well mixed
5. Add the oil and stir vigorously until blended
6. Add the flat-leaf parsley , mint , basil , anchovies and eggs , mix well
7. Turn the tomatoes cut side up and place on a serving dish
8. Fill each tomato with one-fourth of the mixture
9. Place l lemon slice atop each tomato
10. Decorate each slice with 3 capers and a parsley leaf and serve

title: vanilla syrup
steps:
1. In medium saucepan over medium high heat , bring water and sugar to a boil
2. Cook until mixture thickens slightly , about three minutes
3. Remove from heat , stir in vanilla and let cool to room temperature
4. Refrigerate in an airtight container for up to two weeks

title: orange glazed acorn squash
steps:
1. Cut squash in half
2. Discard seeds
3. Place squash cut-side down in a 15-in x 10-in x 1-in baking pan
4. Add 1 / 3 in of hot water
5. Bake , uncovered , at 350 degrees for 30 minutes
6. Meanwhile , in a saucepan , melt butter over medium heat
7. Stir in the remaining ingredients
8. Bring to a boil
9. Reduce heat to medium-low
10. Cook , uncovered , for 30 minutes or until syrupy , stirring occasionally
11. Drain water from baking pan
12. Turn squash cut side up
13. Pour about 2 t
14. Orange glaze into each squash half
15. Bake 25-30 minutes longer or until squash is tender

title: corn flake drumsticks bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Line a shallow roasting pan with aluminum foil
3. Spray with cooking oil spray
4. In a large bowl , mix corn flake crumbs , salt , parmesan cheese , black and cayenne pepper and mix well
5. Lightly beat eggs in a bowl
6. Dip each drumstick in egg and roll in corn flake mixture coating well
7. Place each drumstick on the roasting pan
8. Spray a light coating of cooking spray over the drumsticks
9. Bake at 350f for 1 hour to 1 hour & 10 minutes

title: u  s  senate bean soup
steps:
1. Put beans and enough water to cover in pot
2. Bring to a boil , and boil for 2 minutes
3. Remove from the heat and soak for 1 hour
4. Drain and rinse beans
5. In large pot , put beans , ham bone , and 3 quarts water
6. Bring to a boil
7. Reduce heat , cover and simmer for 2 hours
8. Add next 5 ingredients
9. Add salt and pepper to taste
10. Simmer for 1 hour
11. Remove hambone
12. Remove meat from bone and cut in small pieces
13. Return to pot
14. Heat through

title: chocolate peanut butter crunchies
steps:
1. Melt down peanut butter in microwave
2. Combine with oats
3. In a small saucepan , melt together milk , cocoa powder , and brown sugar
4. Combine chocolate mixture with peanut butter / oats mixture
5. Add the peanuts , and mix the entire mixture until all is well mixed
6. Roll into small balls onto a sheet covered with wax or parchment paper , and leave to set

title: master cleanser
steps:
1. Cut up some lemons or limes
2. Heat up your water
3. Squeeze lemon / lime juice into the warm water
4. Sprinkle a little cayenne powder in and stir in your maple syrup
5. Drink this several times a day when you get hungry or thirsty
6. Use this as an exclusive food for 2-30 days , as you deem appropriate

title: santa fe corn salad
steps:
1. Whisk together oil , lime juice salt and pepper
2. Rinse black beans
3. Cook corn in microwave
4. Add all ingredients in a bowl and mix

title: grandmas carrot cake
steps:
1. Drain the carrots and mash them in large bowl
2. In a separate bowl mix the salt , allspice , cinnamon , wheat germ , baking soda , and flour
3. In another bowl whip the eggs til smooth
4. Add the sugar and the vegetable oil and cream together
5. Add the flour mixture and the egg mixture to the carrots , whip til mixed well
6. Add the buttermilk and the walnuts and mix again
7. Bake at 350 degrees in a well oiled and floured cake pan for 50 minutes
8. Cool completely
9. Mix the softened butter , softened cream cheese , vanilla , sugar , and lemon
10. Frost the cake and enjoy
11. Ps
12. I have been known to add another box of cream cheese and another
13. Stick of butter , more calories but oh so tasty

title: pan fried buffalo mozzarella with tomato relish
steps:
1. Ina bow , add relish ingedients and let stand while you prepare the following:
2. Heat 1 / 4 inch olive oil in a heavy bottom pan until it shimmers
3. Beat egg whites in a bowl until frothy and add salt and pepper
4. Pour breadcrumbs in a pie plate
5. Dredge mozzarella slices in egg and then breadcrumbs twice
6. Fry breaded cheese in oil for 1 and 1 / 2 minutes on each side
7. Top each slice with a scoop of relish
8. Enjoy !

title: cashew crab artichoke dip
steps:
1. I usually use anaheim chiles , which range from mild to moderate intensity , but you can use milder or hotter chiles depending on your preference
2. You may use canned or fresh chiles
3. If using fresh chiles , first roast them to remove their skins
4. Clean and finely chop the bell pepper , scallions and chile peppers then saute in olive oil until tender
5. Drain and pick through crabmeat with a fork , then roughly chop the artichoke hearts
6. Mix crabmeat , artichoke , mayo , parmesan and 1 / 2 cup of cashews , then stir in pepper mixture
7. Spoon into 1 quart casserole dish , pre-sprayed with cooking oil , then top with remaining 1 / 2 cup cashews
8. Bake at 375f for 25 minutes or until bubbly
9. Serve with assorted crackers
10. If you're taking this dip on the road , skip the oven and instead put the dip in a crock pot and cook at medium-high until bubbly

title: guadalupe s guacamole
steps:
1. Dice onion , tomato , cilantro , and jalapeno
2. If you don't like spice , then remove seeds
3. Place in medium bowl
4. Remove pits from avacados
5. Spoon the meat of the avacados from the skin
6. Smash with fork
7. I use a large meat fork
8. Add to bowl of vegetables
9. Add juice and salt
10. Stir well
11. Cover with saran wrap
12. Let set for one hour
13. Serve with chips or on tacos , etc

title: spinach salad with creamy dressing
steps:
1. Combine washed and torn spinach leaves , mushrooms and bacon in a large bowl
2. In a blender , combine the dressing ingredients
3. Toss salad with the dressing and serve

title: super easy crock pot plum roast
steps:
1. Place the meat into the crock pot
2. Mix the jam with the soup mix
3. Pour over the roast
4. Cook on high for 6 hours , or on low for 10 hours
5. Let the roast rest for a few minutes before slicing
6. If you are really patient , chill overnight , then you can cut sheer slices
7. Reheat gently

title: beef and pepper stir fry
steps:
1. Mix the marinade ingredients and pour over the steak in a dish , mix well , cover and marinate for 30 minutes
2. Heat the oils in a preheated wok / large frying pan , add garlic and ginger , stir fry for about a minute
3. Add the pepper and stir fry for a minute or 2
4. Add the steak and the marinade , stir fry for a further 5 minutes or until meat is cooked
5. Add oyster sauce and water , cook until sauce is thickened
6. Serve hot

title: cinnamon chocolate cake
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl , combine the first four ingredients
2. In a saucepan , combine water , oil , butter and cocoa
3. Bring to a boil over medium heat
4. Pour over dry ingredients
5. Mix well
6. Add eggs , buttermilk , vanilla and baking soda
7. Mix well
8. Pour into a greased and floured 15-in
9. X 10-in
10. X 1-in
11. Baking pan
12. Bake at 375 for 15-20 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean
13. Meanwhile , for frosting , combine the butter , cream , cocoa and cinnamon in a saucepan
14. Cook and stir over medium heat until butter is melted and mixture is heated through
15. Remove from the heat
16. Beat in sugar and vanilla until smooth
17. Stir in walnuts
18. Carefully spread over hot cake
19. Cool completely
20. Yield: 24-30 servings

title: christmas fudge
steps:
1. Combine the first 5 ingredients in a large 4-quart saucepan
2. Stir over medium heat till blended
3. Bring to a boil stirring constantly
4. Don't mistake the escaping air bubbles for boiling
5. Continue boiling for 5 1 / 2 minutes
6. Remove from heat and add the rest of the ingredients until the butterscotch bits are melted
7. Put into a buttered 9x13 pan or a little larger if you want
8. Makes 5 lbs
9. Fudge

title: homemade stock
steps:
1. Save a gallon freezer bag in your freezer
2. Wash all stock ingredients well before peeling
3. As you use your vegetables , chicken , or beef , save the peels , ends , leaves , skins , wing
4. Keep a vegetable bag , a chicken bag and a beef bag
5. Your vegetable bag will fill the fastest and beef the slowest
6. Once you have a full bag of mixed vegetables , place them all in a large stockpot or a crock pot
7. Pour the water over your ingredients and add the bay leaf , peppercorns and any other herb or spice that you desire
8. If you don't have much garlic or parsley in your freezer bag , then add more if desired
9. If you have too much , it is not necessary to use it all
10. Just use what you desire for the flavor you wish to achieve
11. If making meat stock , add meat pieces and bones to the vegetables
12. If using a stockpot , bring to boil
13. Reduce heat and simmer for 2 hours until vegetables are very soft
14. If using a crock pot , cover and cook on low overnight or for 6 to 8 hours
15. Strain stock through a colander to remove vegetables and herbs
16. Strain stock again through doubled layers of cheesecloth to remove all other small particles if desired
17. Stock can be reduced even further if desired or place in quart freezer bags , date and
18. Stock can be kept up to 6 months in your freezer
19. For vegetarian and vegan omit the beef and chicken

title: barbara s kitchen counter vinaigrette
steps:
1. Shake ingredients in a jar with a tight fitting lid
2. No need to refrigerate the left over dressing
3. You can leave it on the counter for a couple of days , just shake and serve
4. Number of servings is relative - this usually is enough for two or three bowls of salad ~ or 3 dinners

title: creamed spinach with mushrooms and onions
steps:
1. If using fresh spinach , unbundle and soak in a sink full of cold water
2. Swish around and drain water out of the sink
3. Repeat
4. This is to remove sand and grit
5. Chop coarsely when ready to cook
6. Drain spinach and steam on medium heat in large pan
7. Meanwhile saute mushrooms , onion and garlic in oil on med-high heat
8. When spinach is tender , drain all remaining water and add mushroom / onions
9. Turn off heat and stir in sour cream , add salt and pepper to taste and mix well
10. Add more sour cream if you wish-- this is up to the cook
11. Serve hot and enjoy !

title: herbed buttermilk popcorn
steps:
1. Combine 1st 6 ingredients in a sml bowl
2. Heat oil in a lrg saucepan over med-heat
3. Add popcorn & cover w / a lid
4. Shake pan freq & remove from heat when the popping subsides
5. Pour popcorn into a bowl
6. Wipe pan clean w / paper towel
7. Melt butter in the pan & pour butter over popcorn , tossing to distribute evenly
8. Sprinkle w / flavoring mixture & toss to coat

title: thai salad with grilled flank steak
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients for marinade , marinate the flank steak for several hours or overnight
2. Combine the ingredients for the dressing , whisk to combine
3. Set aside
4. Over medium high flame , grill the flank steak to desired doneness
5. Allow to rest at least 20 minutes
6. Prepare the vegetables: peel the cucumber leaving strips of the skin
7. Cut in half lengthwise and remove seeds , slice diagonally into thin slices
8. In a large bowl , combine the vegetables with the herbs and toss
9. Lightly dress to taste with the reserved dressing , adding salt , pepper , and additional lime juice to taste
10. Slice the steak thinly against the grain
11. Arrange the salad on six plates and top each with a portion of the beef
12. Garnish with chopped roasted peanuts or a few chives
13. Makes six servings

title: hearty vegetarian tofu chili
steps:
1. Saute first 4 in meduium heat
2. Add tofu , cumin , hot sauce , and salt and pepper and saute until crisp and lightly browned
3. Add rest of ingredients
4. Boil , reduce heat and simmer 45 to 55 minutes

title: mother bensen s red devil cocktail sauce
steps:
1. Combine first 5 ingredients in a small bowl , mixing well
2. Add horseradish gradually until the sauce has the amount of'bite' you want
3. Cover with plastic wrap or lid and refrigerate until serving time

title: sauteed chicken with tomato saffron vinaigrette
steps:
1. Mix vinegar , 1 / 2 teaspoon paprika , and saffron in medium bowl
2. Mix in 3 tablespoons oil , shallots , and 1 tablespoon thyme
3. Stir in tomatoes
4. Season to taste with salt and pepper
5. Heat remaining 1 tablespoon oil in large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
6. Sprinkle chicken breast halves with remaining 1 teaspoon paprika , 1 tablespoon thyme , and salt and pepper
7. Add to skillet and saute until cooked through , turning often , about 12 minutes
8. Transfer chicken to work surface and slice
9. Divide frisee among 4 plates and top with sliced chicken
10. Spoon vinaigrette over and serve

title: frost pineapple nog
steps:
1. In bender combine all the ingredients but the ice cubes and mint
2. Cover and whirl for 30 seconds
3. While running add the ice cubes one at a time through the opening on the lid
4. Blend until mixture is smooth and frosty
5. Pour into tall chilled glasses
6. Garnish

title: pulled pork in wolfgang puck pressure cooker
steps:
1. Season meat with salt and pepper , if your rub doesn't contain it
2. Rub meat on all sides with your chosen seasoning
3. Let stand under refrigeration for at least 30 minutes , or up to 60 minutes
4. Brown meat in large pan on top of the stove
5. Deglaze the pan with water or wine
6. Pour into cooker
7. Transfer meat to cooker
8. Add the entire can of chicken broth
9. Put on lid and set to seal
10. Select meat function , and set timer on cooker to 60 minutes
11. Unplug cooker at end of cooking time
12. Open lid when pressure has dropped , as per instruction manual
13. Leave liquid in cooker
14. Remove pork and shred
15. Return pork to cooker
16. Mix well with liquid in cooker
17. Add 1 to 2 20-ounce bottles of premium quality barbecue sauce , depending on consistency desired
18. Mix well
19. Plug cooker in , and set to warm function
20. Put on glass cover and let stand for at least 15 minutes
21. Yield: about 15 to 20 generous sandwiches
22. They're cut from the pork shoulder and are much more affordable

title: betsy s quick   easy  artichoke dip
steps:
1. Drain the artichokes from the can
2. Coarsely chop them
3. Combine chopped chokes , cheeses , mayo , and garlic in a small oven-proof serving dish
4. Add fresh ground pepper and salt to taste
5. Bake in oven at 375 - 400 until melted
6. To be served next day , just re-heat in microwave
7. Recipe can be doubled

title: mushrooms in balsamic sauce
steps:
1. Saute the garlic in olive oil for 1 to 2 minutes
2. Add mushrooms and cook 2 more minutes , stirring occasionally
3. Stir in balsamic vinegar and wine , cook another 2 minutes
4. Season to taste with salt and pepper

title: herbed chicken and broccoli
steps:
1. Cook spaghetti for about 6 minutes in boiling water
2. Add broccoli for another 5 minutes , or until both the pasta and broccoli is cooked
3. Drain and set aside
4. In the same pot , combine cream cheese , milk and pepper
5. Cook until cream cheese is melted
6. Mix in chicken , pasta and broccoli
7. Stir in more milk if desired

title: spicy oven fried chicken breasts
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Combine first 6 ingredients in a shallow dish
3. Place buttermilk in a shallow bowl
4. Dip chicken in buttermilk
5. Dredge in bread crumb mixture

title: beef chapatis  african version of tacos
steps:
1. Chapatis:

title: homemade cottage cheese pierogies   perogies   the old fashioned
steps:
1. Cottage cheese filling: combine the cottage cheese with the egg and season to taste with the salt
2. If the cheese is very dry , an additional egg or thick sour cream can be added
3. Mix the flour with the salt in a deep bowl
4. Add the egg , oil and water to make a medium soft dough
5. Knead on a floured board until the dough is smooth
6. Caution: too much kneading will toughen the dough
7. Divide the dough into 2 parts
8. Cover and let stand for at least 10 minutes
9. Prepare the filling
10. The filling should be thick enough to hold its shape
11. Roll the dough quite thin on a floured board
12. Cut rounds with a large biscuit cutter , or as most old-world grandmothers did , with the open end of a glass
13. Put the round in the palm ofyour hand
14. Place a spoonful of filling in it , fold over to form a half circle and press the edges together with the fingers
15. The edges should be free of filling
16. Be sure the edges are sealed well to prevent the filling from running out
17. Place the pierogi on a floured board or tea towel and then cover with another tea towel to prevent them from drying out
18. Cooking: drop a few pierogies into a large quantity of rapidly boiling salted water
19. Do not attempt to cook too many at a time
20. Stir very gently with a wooden spoon to separate them and to prevent them from sticking to the bottom of the pot
21. Continue boiling for 3-4 minutes
22. The cooling period will depend upon the size you made it , the thickness of the dough and the filling
23. Pierogies will be ready when they are puffed
24. Remove them with a perforated spoon or skimmer to a colander and drain thoroughly
25. Place in a deep dish , sprinkle generously with melted butter to prevent them from sticking
26. Cover and keep them hot until all are cooked
27. Serve in a large dish without piling or crowding them
28. Top with melted butter- chopped crisp bacon and / or chopped onions lightly browned in butter
29. Reheating: one of the great things about pierogies , is that they can be made in large quantities , refrigerated , frozen and reheated without loss of quality
30. Many prefer reheated pierogies as compared to freshly boiled ones
31. To re-heat , you can 1) pan fry pierogies in butter or bacon fat until they are light in color or 2) heat the pierogies in the top of a double boiler or in the oven until they are hot and plump or 3) deep fry them

15. Once the flour is folded in , scoop out spoonfuls of dough , and place them on the prepared pan
16. Press down with fork
17. Bake for 14 to 17 minutes until golden brown
18. Let cool on rack
19. The spicy walnuts add a crunch and a finish that is quite a fun surprise

title: potato ham and leek soup
steps:
1. In a large pot melt butter and saute leeks and ham till softened add the rest of the ingredients except for the betty crockers sour cream& chives mashed potatoes and cook till potatoes are soft 15-20 minutes stirring so cheese doesn`t stick
2. Add the 1 package of potatoes and stir till nice and creamy
3. Season with salt and pepper and serve

title: yummy and easy raisin muffins
steps:
1. Heat oven at 400 fahrenheit
2. Mix the dry ingredients together: flour , baking powder , salt , and sugar
3. In a separate bowl , mix milk , oil , egg , banana , and raisins together
4. Mix very well
5. Pour mixture on dry ingredients
6. Mix only until the dry ingredients are moistened
7. Put the batter on muffin pan carefully
8. Top with one raisin per muffin , if desired
9. Bake for 20 minutes or until light to medium brown

title: lamb chops  down under
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f in medium bowl , combine first 6 ingredients
2. Coat each chop by pressing mixture onto top and bottom
3. Wrap each chop in foil
4. Bake 20 to 25 minutes for medium-rare
5. Preheat broiler
6. Open foil
7. Sprinkle paprika over chops
8. Broil until browned , about 2 to 3 minutes

title: moroccan chicken with dates
steps:
1. Heat 2 tbl olive oil in a dutch oven over medium heat
2. Add the chicken pieces and cook , turning once or twice , until lightly browned , about 10 minutes
3. Remove to a dish and set aside
4. Mix together the ingredients for the ras el hanout in a bowl or jar
5. Heat remaining tbl oil in dutch oven
6. Add onion , and cook until slightly softened , about 2 minutes
7. Add the bay leaf , 1 tsp ras el hanout and chicken broth
8. Reduce heat to low , and cook , covered , for about 25 minutes
9. Return chicken to the pot , turning pieces to coat with the pan fluids
10. Cook another 25 minutes
11. Add dates , almonds , and honey
12. Cook for another 5 minutes
13. Store extra spice mix covered in cool , dark place

title: emeril lagasse s delmonico potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400f
2. In a large saut pan , melt the butter
3. Add the onions
4. Season with salt and pepper
5. Saut for 1 minute
6. Add the garlic
7. Stir in the flour and cook for 1 minute
8. Stir in the milk and bring the liquid to a boil
9. Remove from the heat and stir in the potatoes
10. Season with salt and pepper
11. Pour into a greased 6 cup baking dish
12. In a mixing bowl , add the bread crumbs and a drizzle of oil
13. Mix thoroughly
14. Season with essence
15. Stir in the parsley
16. Spread the crumb mixture evenly over the potatoes
17. Place in the oven and bake until golden brown , about 10 to 12 minutes
18. Remove from the heat and serve

title: shaker lemon pie
steps:
1. Combine the lemon slices and 1 1 / 2 cups of the sugar in a bowl
2. Gently toss together so the slices are well coated
3. Let stand at least 2 hours
4. Longer is better
5. Preheat the oven to 450 degrees
6. Divide the dough in half
7. Roll out one-half and line the pie pan with it
8. Stir the beaten eggs into the lemon mixture
9. Spread the mixture over the pie dough
10. Sprinkle the remaining 1 / 2 cup sugar over the filling
11. Roll the remaining dough out and place over the filling
12. Crimp the edges and cut vents on top
13. Bake for 15 minutes
14. Lower the heat to 375 degrees and bake for about 20 minutes more , until a knife comes out clean when inserted in the center

title: tea cakes  tekakor
steps:
1. Melt margarine in pan
2. Add milk , heat until 45 c
3. Dissolve yeast in liquid
4. Add sugar , salt , bread spices , most of the flour
5. Knead dough until mixed well
6. Rise for 20 minute
7. Knead dough
8. Use rolling pin to roll out large rounds
9. Cut circular shapes , about 4-5 inches in diameter
10. Put on cookie sheet , use fork to make air holes
11. Rise for 30 minute
12. Bake in oven at 440 f for about 10 min , or until golden
13. Serve and enjoy

title: garlicky shrimp with bread crumbs  de jonghe
steps:
1. Pulse bread in a food processor until coarsely chopped , some larger crumbs remaining
2. There should be about 1 cup of crumbs
3. In a 12" skillet , melt 2 tbs
4. Butter over medium heat
5. Add crumbs , shallots , 1 / 8 teaspoons salt and 1 / 8 teaspoons pepper
6. Cook and stir until crumbs are golden brown , 5 to 10 minutes
7. Stir in 1 tbs
8. Parsley and transfer crumbs to a plate to cool
9. Wipe out the skillet with paper toweling
10. Thoroughly dry shrimp n paper toweling
11. Sprinkle shrimp with sugar , 1 / 4 teaspoons salt and 1 / 4 teaspoons pepper
12. Heat skillet over high heat and add 2 teaspoons oil and heat to shimmering
13. Add half the shrimp in a single layer and cook until it's spotty brown and edges are pink
14. Remove pan from heat and transfer shrimp to a large plate
15. Wipe out skillet with paper toweling and repeat with remaining 2 teaspoons oil and shrimp , transferring it to the plate with the first batch of shrimp
16. Wipe out skillet , return to medium heat and melt 1 tbs
17. Butter in the pan
18. Add garlic and red pepper flakes , cooking and stirring for about a minute
19. Add the flour and cook about a minute then slowly add the clam juice and sherry , stirring constantly
20. Bring to a simmer and reduce to about 3 / 4 cup , 3 - 4 minutes
21. Then stir in remaining 3 tbs
22. Butter , 1 tbs
23. At a time , to add shine to the sauce
24. Stir in lemon juice and remaining 1 tbs
25. Parsley
26. Reduce heat to medium-low and return shrimp to sauce and toss to coat
27. Cook covered for 2 or 3 minutes until shrimp is pink and cooked through
28. Transfer to serving dish and sprinkle with the toasted bread crumbs
29. Garnish with lemon wedges , if desired

title: rigatoni campagnolo
steps:
1. Remove sausage from the casing and break into chunks
2. -cook sausage in olive oil over medium heat until browned slightly
3. -add onion and peppers saut until softened
4. -add garlic and cook for 1 minute
5. -add wine and allow to simmer for 3 minutes
6. -add tomatoes and red pepper
7. Season with salt and pepper
8. -bring to a boil over high heat , stirring constantly
9. -reduce heat to medium-low and simmer until thickened
10. -stir in pasta , romano , and basil and simmer for 3 minutes
11. -portion onto plates and top with the crumbled goat cheese

title: papas chorreadas  colombia  south america
steps:
1. Saute onion in oil until soft , about 10 minutes
2. Add tomatoes , salt and pepper
3. Saute 5 minutes
4. Stir in cream & cheese until cheese begins to melt
5. Arrange potatoes on serving platter and top with sauce
6. Enjoy !
7. Serves 6

title: cheesy sun dried tomato scones
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 220c / gas7
2. Lightly grease 2 baking trays
3. Sift the flour , peppers , mustard , salt & baking powder together in a bowl
4. Add the mixed herbs
5. Cut butter in to cubes and rub in until it forms 'breadcrumbs'
6. Add the cheese and tomatoes and mix well
7. Beat the eggs in a measuring jug and add enough milk to make the quantity up to 275ml
8. Put 2 tbsp of milk / egg mix to one side and add the remainder to the flour mixture
9. Mix well to create a soft pliable dough
10. Add a little flour if it comes too sticky
11. Roll out onto a floured surface to approximately 1'' thick
12. Cut into 6cm rounds and place on the trays
13. Continue in this way until dough is finished
14. Brush the tops of the scones with the milk / egg mix
15. Bake for 12-15 minutes until risen , golden and cooked all the way through

title: carbonnade a  la flamande
steps:
1. Combine first 5 ingredients in a large zip-top plastic bag
2. Seal
3. Shake to coat
4. Heat a large dutch oven over medium-high heat
5. Add bacon to pan
6. Cook one minute
7. Add beef mixture
8. Cook 3 minutes or until browned
9. Remove beef from pan
10. Add onion and garlic to pan
11. Saute 5 minutes or until tender
12. Return beef to pan
13. Stir in broth , scraping pan to loosen browned bits
14. Add water and the next 7 ingredients
15. Bring to a boil
16. Cover , reduce heat , and simmer 30 minutes
17. Uncover and cook 30 minutes or until beef is tender
18. Discard bay leaves
19. Garnish with parsley

title: our clean eating gyros
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Combine oregano , garlic powder , onion powder , salt , pepper and egg , add turkey and mix well
3. Press into a greased loaf pan
4. Bake for 60 minutes or until done
5. Let cool completely
6. I place it in the fridge for an hour or so
7. Meanwhile , stir your yogurt , sour cream , cucumber , garlic cloves , vinegar and dill together , and set in fridge until loaf is done
8. Once your meatloaf is cool , slice thinly and lay pieces on a plate for reheating
9. Place in microwave and heat until warm
10. This is how we like them: smear some tzatziki over the whole pita
11. Lay down lettuce to cover , add meat , then tomato and onion on top

title: low sugar pumpkin pie
steps:
1. Mix all except milk
2. Add milk and mix
3. Bake at 450' for 10 minutes , then at 350' for 40 minutes
4. When knife comes out clean , pie is done --
5. Optional: top with a dollop of sugar free cool whip

title: individual cheese balls
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine the first 6 ingredients
2. Mix well
3. Shape into 1 1 / 2 inch balls
4. Roll in nuts
5. Chill thoroughly
6. Serve with crackers

title: lone star steakhouse lettuce wedge salad by todd wilbur
steps:
1. Use an electric mixer to combine all ingredients for bleu cheese dressing in a medium bowl
2. Slice a head of iceberg lettuce into quarters through the stem end
3. Cut the stem off the wedges and arrange each one on a plate
4. Spoon about 1 / 4 cup of bleu cheese dressing over each lettuce wedge
