5. Sprinkle 1 / 4 cup of crumbled bleu cheese over the dressing
6. Sprinkle 1 / 4 cup of diced tomato over the top and serve

title: amazing hush puppies
steps:
1. Combine first 7 ingredients in a large mixing bowl
2. Add milk , buttermilk , and egg
3. Mix until blended
4. Stir in the onion and peppers
5. Carefully drop batter by level tablespoonfuls into deep hot oil
6. Fry 3-5 minutes , turning once , until hush puppies are golden brown
7. Drain on paper towels

title: chorizo and spinach omelet
steps:
1. Heat 10 grams of butter in a 18cm heavy based non stick frying pan over moderate heat and add chorizo and onions and cook and stir for 3 minutes or until chorizo is crisp and then add mushrooms and cook and stir for 2 minutes or until tender and then add the spinach and cook for 30 seconds or until wilted and transfer to a heatproof bowl
2. Whope pan clean
3. Whisk eggs , chives and 1 / 4 cup water in a large jug and season with salt pepper
4. For each omelet , melt 10 grams of the butter in clean pan over moderately high heat and add a quarter of the egg mixture and tilt to cover base and cook for 2 minutes until set underneath and then slide onto a serving plate
5. Top half the omelet with a quarter of the chorizo mixture and fold omelet over to enclose

title: basic fresh tomato sauce
steps:
1. In a large dutch oven , cook onions and garlic in olive oil over medium heat until golden brown , stirring occasionally
2. Meanwhile , immerse tomatoes , a few at a time , in a large pan of boiling water for 1 minute
3. Then lift out and plunge in plunge into cold water
4. Pull off and discard skin
5. Cut tomatoes into eighths and add cooked onions , along with green onion , green pepper , salt , pepper , anise seed , oregano , rosemary , paprika , and the 2 cups of dry red wine
6. Bring mixture to boiling , stirring with a heavy wooden spoon to break up tomatoes
7. Cover , reduce heat , and simmer for 1 hour
8. Remove cover and boil until reduced to 8 cups
9. You can use the sauce while hot , let it cool and refrigerate for 3 days , or freeze up to 4 months

title: potato and turnip patties
steps:
1. In a large saucepan of boiling salted water , cook the turnip and potato cubes for 15 to 17 minutes , until they are tender , and drain them
2. In a bowl , mash them with a fork and stir in the scallions , the egg , flour , and salt and pepper to taste
3. Coat the bottom of a large , heavy bottomed skillet with about 1 / 4-inch of the oil
4. Heat the pan on medium high heat until the surface of the oil begins to shimmer , but not smoke
5. Spoon 1 / 4-cup mounds of the turnip potato batter into the pan , flattening them into 1 / 2-inch thick patties with the back of a spatula
6. Fry the patties until they are golden , turning them once , about 4 minutes on each side
7. Transfer the patties to paper towels to drain off excess oil

title: phyllo wrapped salmon with roasted red peppers
steps:
1. Puree red peppers
2. Layer 2 sheets phyllo on work surface , brushing each with butter or spray with nonstick spray
3. Leave remaining sheets of phyllo covered with plastic
4. Place 1 fillet crosswise on the pastry , 5 inches from the narrow end
5. Top with 1 t
6. Puree
7. Fold the 5 inch section of pastry over the salmon and fold in the sides
8. Roll the pastry into a rectangular packet to enclose the salmon
9. Brush with butter on all sides or spray with nonstick spray
10. Repeat with the remaining pastry and salmon
11. Place packets on baking sheet and bake at 400 degrees for 30-35 minutes until the salmon is cooked through and the pastry is light golcen brown
12. Top with the remaining pepper puree

title: english pub beef   kidney stew in yorkshire pudding  adopted
steps:
1. Make yorkshire pudding first and let rest in fridge while stew is cooking
2. Beat 2 eggs in bowl
3. Mix in 1 cup of milk , sift in 1 cup of flour and 1 / 2 tsp salt
4. Beat until smooth
5. For the stew
6. Coat steak and kidneys with flour
7. Brown several pieces at a time in oil in stock pot
8. Remove
9. Saut onion in pan drippings until tender
10. Add mushrooms
11. Cok for several minutes longer
12. Stir in broth , wine , tomato paste and next 5 seasonings and diced carrots
13. Return meat to the pan
14. Cover and cook on a slow simmer , for 2 hours or until tender
15. Preheat oven to 200c
16. Heat 2 tbs oil in a 6-8 cup casserole
17. Pour batter into hot casserole dish
18. Spoon stew over batter to within 1 inch of edge
19. Bake at 200c for 30 minutes or until puffed and brown
20. Serve with mashed potatoes and greens

title: vietnamese chicken noodle soup
steps:
1. In a large pot , combine the first 9 ingredients
2. Bring to a boil
3. Decrease heat and simmer 15 minutes or until chicken is done
4. Remove chicken from pan
5. Cool slightly
6. Cut into bite-size pieces
7. Cook rice sticks in boiling water for 5 minutes
8. Drain
9. Divide chicken and noodles evenly among 4 large bowls
10. Ladle 2 cups soup into each bowl
11. Top each serving with cup sprouts , 1 teaspoons each of onions , cilantro , basil , and mint
12. Serve with lime wedges
13. Garnish with chopped chile , fish sauce , or chili oil

title: pasta salad with pepperoni and cheese
steps:
1. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil
2. Add 1 or 2 tbs
3. Vegetable oil to water , to keep pasta from sticking
4. Cook penne or rotini until cooked , but still firm , about 9 minutes
5. Rinse pasta under cool water to stop cooking , and drain
6. Combine bottled dressing with chopped parsley , chopped basil , dried italian seasonings , and crushed red pepper
7. Pour dressing over cooked pasta and toss
8. Add pepperoni , sun-dried tomatoes , artichoke hearts , ripe olives
9. Toss gently
10. Add cheese and toss again
11. Add salt and freshly ground pepper to taste
12. Cover and refrigerate until about 30 minutes before ready to serve

title: breakfast fondue
steps:
1. Combine peaches , maple syrup , cream cheese , vanilla and cinnamon in a blender or food processor , and with an adult watching pure on high until smooth
2. Its okay if there are a few lumps of cream cheese showing
3. They will disappear when you cook the peach mixture in the next step
4. Pour the mixture into a pot
5. If you are allowed to use the stove , warm it over medium- high heat , stirring often , until the cream cheese melts and the sauce is bubbling around the edges
6. If you arent allowed to use the stove , have an adult help you
7. Serve in a big bowl surrounded by whole-grain pancakes , waffles or french toast fingers , or a combination , for dipping
8. Use your fingers to dip , but remember , no double-dipping
9. Serving size: 1 / 2-cup fondue
10. 3 whole-grain mini-pancakes , mini-waffles or french toast fingers

title: indian tuna salad
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients except pine nuts and chill
2. Stir in nuts just before serving

title: crock pot mac   cheese
steps:
1. Spray crock pot with non-stick spray
2. Add ingredidents and mix lightly
3. Cover with lid and cook on low for 3 hours
4. Do not open lid while cooking
5. Stir gently and serve

title: beer brats with onions and peppers
steps:
1. Pour beer in large pot and bring to strong simmer
2. Pierce brats mul
3. Place in simmering beer
4. Simmer uncovered for 15 minutes
5. Meanwhile heat olive oil in skillet and saute onions until done
6. Stir in peppers
7. Remove brats from simmering pot and add to skillet with onions
8. Brown slightly , about 2-3 minutes
9. Can add some beer if needed for moisture
10. Serve brats , onions , peppers on rolls with mustard

title: skinny garlic mashed potatoes
steps:
1. Peel and chop potatoes
2. Boil potatoes until tender
3. Drain
4. Mash the potatoes with a masher , adding broth a little at a time to desired consistency
5. Add garlic and parsley
6. Chunk up the cheese slightly and mix in gently
7. Do not mix completely
8. Salt and pepper to taste

title: pumpkin blizzard pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Combine first two ingredients and press in the bottom and up the sides of a 9-inch pie pan
3. Bake at 375f for 8-10 minutes
4. Cool
5. Then blend the last three ingredients together and pour into pie crust
6. Freeze

title: bacon club macaroni salad
steps:
1. Cook the macaroni until firm-tender
2. Drain well
3. In a bowl , combine the oil and vinegar
4. Add in the bacon , cheese , celery , green onion , olives and the cooked macaroni
5. Toss well to combine
6. In another bowl , combine mayo , cream , horseradish , salt and pepper
7. Blend in with the macaroni mixture
8. Toss well to combine thoroughly
9. Chill in the fridge for 3 hours before using

title: grocery store gossip pound cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. In large mixing bowl , combine all ingredients together
3. Beat on medium speed for approximately two minutes
4. Pour into greased 9x13 cake pan , spread evenly
5. Bake 20-30 minutes at 350 degrees
6. Cake will spring back when done
7. It is great brushed lightly with melted butter or your favorite icing !

title: kelly and pam s key lime pie dip
steps:
1. Whip the cream cheese until it is fluffy
2. Add the key lime juice and sugar , and then the condensed milk
3. Continue to mix on high speed until fluffy and combined
4. Will have the consistency of a thick frosting
5. Refrigerate , and serve with graham crackers , vanilla wafers , ginger snaps , sliced fruit , etc

title: harvest streusel coffee cake
steps:
1. Peel peaches ,
2. Cut fruit in half and remove pits
3. Place , cut side down , on cutting board , slice thinly
4. Set aside
5. In a large bowl , beat butter with sugar until light and fluffy
6. Beat in eggs , one at a time , beat in vanilla
7. In a separate bowl , whisk together , flour , baking powder , baking soda , ginger and salt
8. Stir into butter mixture alternately with sour cream , making 3 additions of dry ingredients and 2 of sour cream
9. Spread batter evenly in greased 13 x 9-inch cake pan
10. Without overlapping , arrange sliced fruit attractively over top
11. Streusel: in a bowl , mix together sugar , flour , almonds and ginger with pastry blender of 2 knives , cut in butter until crumbly
12. Sprinkle evenly over fruit
13. Bake in centre of 350f oven for about 1 hour or until cake tester inserted in centre comes out clean
14. Let cool in pan on rack

title: black bean and avocado soup
steps:
1. In a large soup pot , saute onion and garlic in olive oil about 5 to 7 minutes , or until soft
2. Add cumin , cayenne powder , cinnamon , salt , sugar and cilanto
3. Saut an additional 2 to 3 minutes until very fragrant , stirring often
4. Add tomatoes and beans
5. Cook an additional 2 to 3 minutes
6. Add broth to the pot and bring to a boil
7. Simmer gently for 10 to 15 minutes
8. Puree 1 cup of this mixture and return back to pot
9. Stir in avocado , and lime juice
10. Heat through
11. Place in serving bowls and sprinkle with shredded cheese

title: easy southwestern pasta
steps:
1. Stir together sour cream and cornstarch in a small bowl
2. In a large skillet , stir-fry chicken and garlic in oil over medium heat 2 minutes
3. Add peppers and onions , salsa and seasonings and continue to stir-fry 4 more minutes
4. Add sour cream mixture and cook , stirring , 2-3 minutes until sauce thickens
5. Make sure chicken is no longer pink
6. Serve vermicelli topped with the sauce and sprinkled with cilantro

title: sticky soy wings
steps:
1. Wash the chicken wings and dry as much as possible
2. Preheat oven at 400 degrees
3. Place chicken in a deep baking dish
4. Mix all other ingredients together in a bowl
5. Pour over chicken
6. Place in oven or 1 1 / 2 hours or until chicken is done and sauce is sticky
7. Important: due to the hot cooked sugar , chicken will be extra hot and easy to burn
8. Be careful and let chicken sit for at least 15-20 minutes before serving

title: christmas cocoa
steps:
1. In a 2 quart saucepan , heat sugar , cocoa , water , cinnamon , and nutmeg over low heat , stirring constantly until mixture is smooth
2. Heat to boiling
3. Reduce heat
4. Simmer 4 minutes , stirring constantly
5. Stir in milk
6. Heat over low heat
7. Pour cocoa into 6 mugs
8. Top each with 2 t marshmellow creme

title: baked ranch chicken
steps:
1. Mix breadcrumbs and ranch seasoning
2. Melt about 3 t
3. Butter , dip chicken in butter to coat , dredge in breadcrumb mixture
4. Place in greased 9x13 pan , cut remaining butter and distribute evenly over chicken breasts
5. Bake at 375 for 30-45 minutes

title: hot corn
steps:
1. Combine all the ingredients in a mixing bowl
2. Pour into a 8x8 baking pan and cover with cheese
3. Bake uncovered at 350 for 45 minutes
4. Allow to cool for 5 minutes before serving

title: healthy macaroni and cheese
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Coat a 9 x 13 baking pan with cooking spray
3. Bring a large pot of water to a boil
4. Add the macaroni and cook until tender but firm , about 5 to 8 minutes
5. Drain the macaroni and transfer to a large bowl
6. Place the frozen squash and milk into a large saucepan and cook over low heat , stirring occasionally and breaking up the squash with a spoon until defrosted
7. Turn the heat up to medium and cook until the mixture is almost simmering , stirring occasionally
8. Remove the pan from heat and stir in the cheeses , salt , mustard , and cayenne pepper
9. Pour the cheese mixture over the macaroni and stir to combine
10. Transfer macaroni and cheese to the baking dish
11. Combine bread crumbs , parmesan , and oil in a small bowl
12. Sprinkle over the top of the macaroni and cheese
13. Bake for 20 minutes , and broil for 3 minutes so the top is crisp and nicely browned

title: coconut lime shrimp skewers
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , combine ginger , garlic , lime zest and juice , and coconut milk
2. Add shrimp , tossing to coat , and chill , covered , at least 1 hour and up to 1 day
3. Meanwhile , prepare your wooden skewers by soaking in water
4. For finger food / party portions , you'll want 24 6" skewers
5. Use about 12 long skewers if you're serving on dinner plates
6. Prepare a grill for high heat
7. Spear 2 or 3 shrimp onto each 6" skewer in a "c" shape
8. Cook , turning once , until flesh has just turned pink and is slightly charred , about 3 minutes on each side
9. Arrange skewers on a serving platter and sprinkle evenly with salt , a squeeze of lime juice , and coconut
10. Serve with extra lime wedges on the side

title: hidden valley ranch chicken
steps:
1. Rinse and pat dry chicken breasts
2. In a small dish or on a plate , combine the ranch dressing and the flour
3. Dip each breast in the mixture until well coated
4. Transfer to baking dish
5. Cover breasts with the cheddar cheese and bake at 350f for 35 minutes or until cooked through

title: scandinavian rice salad with smoked salmon
steps:
1. Bring water to a boil in a saucepan
2. Stir in rice and 1 / 2 teaspoon of the salt , reduce heat to maintain a gentle simmer and cover pan tightly
3. Cook until the rice is tender and has absorbed the water , 30 to 40 minutes
4. Rinse the rice under cold water until cool
5. Combine the rice with peas , cucumber , dill , scallions and smoked salmon in a serving bowl
6. Whisk together yogurt , oil , lemon zest and juice , pepper and remaining 1 / 4 teaspoon salt in a small bowl
7. Pour over the salad and stir to combine

title: instant oatmeal pancake
steps:
1. Mix and combine all ingredients
2. Pour into non-stick skillet and when you shake the pan and the pancake moves , it's time to flip
3. Brown on both sides , and enjoy !

title: rubbed pork tenderloin with dijon apricot mop sauce
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine rub ingredients
2. Using your hands or a spoon , rub mixture evenly over pork , set aside
3. Preheat oven to 350 degrees or preheat grill on medium-high
4. For mop sauce , heat oil in a small saucepan over medium-high heat , swirling to coat
5. Saute onion for 2 to 3 minutes , or until translucent , stirring occasionally
6. Stir in remaining sauce ingredients
7. Bring to a boil
8. Reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes , stirring occasionally
9. Lightly spray a broiling pan and rack with vegetable oil spray
10. Put tenderloins on rack in pan
11. Bake for 30 minutes
12. Using a pastry brush or basting mop , baste on all sides
13. Bake for 10 minutes , then baste again
14. Bake for 10 to 15 minutes , or until pork is no longer pink in the center or registers 165 degrees on meat thermometer
15. Or grill tenderloins for 10 minutes per side , then baste with mop sauce and cook for 2 to 3 minutes per side , or until pork is cooked through

title: sausage and pepper baked ziti
steps:
1. In a deep nonstick 12" skillet , cook sausage over medium-high heat , stirring occasionally , until browned on all sides , about 5 minute
2. Reduce heat to medium
3. Discard all but 2 t sausage fat
4. Add garlic , pepper and onion to sausage in skillet
5. Cook , covered , stirring occasionally , until vegetables are tender , 10 minute stir in whole tomatoes , tomato puree and salt
6. Bring to a boil over medium heat , breaking up tomatoes with side of spoon
7. Reduce heat to low
8. Cover and simmer 10 minute
9. Meanwhile preheat oven to 400 degrees f
10. In a large pot of boiling salted water , cook pasta 2 min less than cooking time recommended on label
11. Drain pasta and return to pot
12. Stir in sausage mixture to coat
13. Add mozzarella and toss to combine
14. Transfer pasta mixture to an ungreased 9x13" baking dish and spread it out evenly
15. Sprinkle with grated cheese
16. Bake , uncovered , until top browns and sauce is bubbling , 20 to 25 minute let stand 10 min before serving

title: oven baked mahi mahi with orange and graham cracker crust
steps:
1. Turn on oven to 375 degrees
2. Wash fish with lemon in a glass bowl and drain all liquid
3. Add all ingredients for fish marinade and let sit for 15 minutes
4. In another bowl , combine orange zest , brown sugar , lemon juice , orange juice and graham cracker crumbs until thoroughly mixed
5. Once marinade is set , coat fish with graham cracker mixture and place on non-stick baking tray
6. Drizzle with olive oil
7. Cover with aluminium foil and place in oven and let bake for 20-25 mins until tender and cooked in centre
8. Serve hot

title: cucumber shrimp tea sandwiches
steps:
1. Combine first 7 ingredients in a bowl
2. Trim the crusts from the bread slices
3. Spread the cream cheese mixture over the bread slices and cut into 4 triangles until you reach the number of shrimp you have
4. Arrange shrimp on each bread triangle
5. Arrange the cucumber evenly over shrimp
6. Chill , covered until serving

title: rigatoni with sausage and cream
steps:
1. Heat olive oil in heavy saucepan
2. Add sausage and brown
3. Add onion and garlic
4. Cook until the onion is translucent
5. Add tomato sauce , tomato paste , sugar , crushed fennel seed , and basil
6. Stir and cook over moderate heat for 20 to 30 minutes
7. Bring 4 quarts of water to a boil in a large pot and add all the pasta at once
8. Stir well
9. When the sauce is ready , put half-and-half in a bowl and add a little of the hot sauce to it to temper the milk
10. Add the milk to the rest of the sauce
11. When the rigatoni is cooked al dente , drain and put in large serving bowl
12. Add the sauce and stir to coat
13. Garnish with basil leaves and serve with fresh parmesan cheese

title: mrs  fields  chocolate chip raisin cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300 degrees f
2. Cream sugars and butter in a large bowl
3. Add eggs and vanilla , mixing at medium speed until smooth
4. In a separate bowl , combine flour and baking powder
5. Add flour mixture to sugar mixture
6. Fold in raisins and chocolate chips
7. Drop by rounded spoonfuls onto ungreased cookie sheets
8. Bake 22- 24 minutes
9. Transfer immediately to cool , flat surface

title: vanilla syrup for coffee
steps:
1. Combine the sugars and water in a saucepan
2. Boil for at least 10 minutes
3. Let cool
4. When solution has cooled , add the extract and stir well
5. Store in an airtight bottle or container

title: tomato paste
steps:
1. Peel , core and chop tomatoes
2. Measure to 8 quarts
3. Add salt
4. Place in a large stainless or enamel pot and simmer for 1 hour
5. Remove and put through a food mill
6. Return to pot and continue to cook-around 2 hours-or until it holds its shape-like tomato paste
7. Spoon into clean hot jars leaving 1 / 4-inch head space
8. Process in a boiling water bath for 30 minutes at altitudes up to 1000 feet

title: stephenson s restaurants baked chicken n  butter and cream
steps:
1. Dip chicken into water
2. Coat with mixture of flour and seasonings
3. Put skin side up into 13x9x2 inch baking pan
4. Dot with butter
5. Bake at 425 degrees for 30 minutes
6. Remove from oven
7. Mix 1 / 2 cup nonfat dry milk powder with 1 1 / 2 cups hot water
8. Pour milk around chicken
9. Cover with aluminum foil
10. Return to oven and bake at 350 degrees for 45 minutes

title: fire and ice tomatoes
steps:
1. Combine veggies in a bowl
2. In saucepan bring to boil vinegar , water , sugar , celery salt , salt , peppers
3. Pour over veggies and chill at least 8 hours

title: kurant cosmopolitan
steps:
1. Half-fill a cocktail shaker with ice and add the vodka , cranberry juice , rose's lime juice , and triple sec
2. Cover the shaker and shake vigorously until well chilled
3. Strain the cocktail into a martini glass , garnish the rim with the lime slice , and serve right away

title: shirley temple popsicles
steps:
1. Mix the soda and orange juice
2. Fill popsicle forms with about 2-4 cherries each
3. Pour about 1-2 teaspoons of the cherry juice in each popsicle form
4. Divide the soda / orange juice mixture in each popsicle form , filling about 80% full
5. Place sticks or tops on the popsicles and freeze
6. Freeze for about 4-6 hours until hard
7. Serve !

title: honey orange stir fry shrimp
steps:
1. Combine all the sauce ingredients
2. Mix until smooth
3. Set aside
4. Heat oil in wok or large fry pan over medium-high heat
5. Add the garlic and ginger
6. Saut for 1 minute
7. Add the diced pepper and snow peas
8. Stir-fry for 1 minute or until tender-crisp
9. Add the shrimp
10. Stir-fry just until shrimp turns pink
11. Add the sauce
12. Cook , stirring constantly , until the mixture comes to a boil and thickens
13. Stir in the green onions
14. Serve over cooked rice or noodles

title: black bean hummus  from 1001 low fat vegetarian recipes
steps:
1. Process black beans , vegetable broth , tahini , lemon juice and soy sauce in a food processor until smooth
2. Season to taste with salt and cayenne pepper
3. Blend garlic in , a clove at a time , to suit your taste
4. Refrigerate 1 to 2 hours for flavours to blend
5. Serve with dippers

title: nyte s grilled cheese
steps:
1. Lightly spread ranch dressing on one side of each slice of bread
2. Lay it dressing side down in hot skillet
3. Put cheese on top , and tomato if desired
4. Top with remaining slice of bread , dressing side up
5. Grill until golden brown , flip and repeat on second side

title: seitan and mushroom stroganoff  vegan
steps:
1. Gravy: stir cornstarch and soy sauce together in a 2-quart saucepan and make a thin , smooth , paste
2. Whisk in the broth or water and garlic granules
3. Cook over medium-high heat , stirring constantly until it thickens and comes to a boil
4. Remove from heat and beat in the tahini and vegan sour cream
5. Cover the saucepan and set aside
6. Place oil in a large skillet and heat over medium-high
7. When the oil is hot , saut the onion and garlic for 10 minutes
8. Add the mushrooms and cook , stirring often , for 5 to 7 minutes
9. Stir the seitan strips and the reserved gravy into the onions and mushrooms
10. Reduce heat to low and stir often , about 5 to 10 minutes , until the seitan is heated through
11. Season the stroganoff with ground pepper
12. Serve at once over egg-free noodles

title: homemade hash browns
steps:
1. Dice or shred the potatoes
2. Fry bacon in a non-stick skillet until crisp
3. Remove bacon from the skillet and drain on a paper towel
4. If there is too much grease , pour some of it into a measuring cup in case you need to use it later
5. Add the chopped onions to the bacon grease
6. Saute' on medium heat until the onions are tender and slightly brown
7. Add the potatoes and mix thoroughly with the onions , using an egg spatula
8. Fry the potatoes turning them over frequently for even cooking
9. If potatoes start to stick to the bottom of the skillet , add more bacon grease or vegetable oil fry until potatoes are a nice golden brown
10. Serve with the fried bacon

title: very cheesy casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Heat oil in large skillet
3. Saut onion , garlic and mushrooms until onion is nearly soft
4. Add all remaining ingredients except final three
5. Mix well and spread mixture in a large greased or sprayed shallow baking dish
6. Arranged tomato slices over the top
7. Mix together parmesan and crumbs and sprinkle over tomatoes
8. Bake for 40 minutes

title: shane s goulash
steps:
1. In a large pot , brown the deer and pork
2. Spoon off excess grease , but do not drain completely
3. Add onions and cook until tender
4. Add 3 cups water , tomato sauce , diced tomatoes , garlic , italian seasoning , bay leaves , soy sause , salt , black pepper , garlic powder and seasoned salt
5. Cook covered for 20-25 minutes
6. Add the elbow macaroni , cover and continue to simmer for about 20 minutes
7. Turn off the heat , remove the bay leaves and let sit about 30 minutes

title: spicy apple twists  pillsbury bake off winner
steps:
1. Heat oven to 425
2. Cut each apple into 8 wedges
3. Lightly spoon flour into measuring cup and level off
4. In a medium bowl , blend flour and salt
5. Using pastry blender or fork , cut in shortening until mixture resembles coarse crumbs
6. Sprinkle flour mixture with water 1 tablespoon at a time , mixing lightly with fork until dough is just moist enough to hold together
7. Shape dough into ball
8. On floured surface , roll dough lightly from cener to edge into 12 inch square
9. Spread with 1 tablespoon softened margarine
10. Fold 2 sides to center
11. Roll to 16 x 10 inch rectangle
12. Cut crosswise into 16 strips
13. Wrap 1 strip around each apple wedge
14. Place 1 / 2 inch apart in ungreased 13 x 9 inch pan
15. Brush each wrapped apple wedge with melted margarine
16. In small bowl , blend sugar and cinnamon
17. Sprinkle over wrapped apples
18. Bake at 425 for 20 minutes
19. Pour water into pan
20. Bake an additional 12-17 minutes or until golden brown
21. Spoon sauce in pan over twists
22. Serve warm or cool , plain or with whipped cream
23. If using self rising flour , omit salt

title: pagach quick and easy
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Fry onions in butter until soft
3. Spread a thin layer of soft butter on pizza crust or drizzle with a little olive oil
4. Place the 8 slices of cooper cheese on the pizza crust
5. Heat mashed potatoes and add the fried onions , 1 cup of the shredded sharp cheese , the sour cream and salt and pepper to taste
6. Spread mashed potato mixture on top of pizza crust
7. Top with the rest of the cheese and sprinkle with paprika
8. Bake for approx 30 minutes or until cheese is melted and bubbly
9. Place under broiler to brown top

title: tea toddy
steps:
1. Make tea , steep
2. Measure 3 / 4 cup tea pour in mug
3. Add baileys and a splash of whisky
4. Enjoy !

title: grape paste
steps:
1. Pick the grapes from the stem and wash well
2. Place them into a pot and just cover with water
3. Bring to the boil then reduce to a simmer and cook until the grapes are soft
4. Strain off the water and pass the grapes through a good mill or force through a sieve
5. Throw away the skins and any seeds and weight the resulting pulp
6. Place the pulp into a heavy-based pan with the required quantity of sugar
7. Cook until the pulp becomes very thick and is difficult to stir
8. If the fruit begins to stick and burn , remove it from the pot straight away and continue in a clean pot
9. Brush a biscuit tin with the grape seed oil then pour in the paste
10. Allow to set , and wrap in plastic
11. It is best kept in the fridge although in cooler climates may be stored in a pantry
12. It is tastiest after one month as flavour matures

title: broccoli cheese soup for the crock pot
steps:
1. Saut onion and green pepper in butter
2. Combine all ingredients on low in crockpot for 3-4 hours
3. Do not add salt

title: double chocolate scones with cinnamon butter
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees and line a baking sheet with parchment paper
2. In a food processor , combine flour , cocoa powder , brown sugar , baking powder , baking soda , and salt
3. Add the cut up pieces of butter and pulse until coarse crumbs form
4. Transfer to a large bowl and stir in the chocolate chips
5. In a small bowl , mix the egg and buttermilk until just combined
6. Add to the dry ingredients and stir until the dough just come together
7. Divide the dough into 2 equal parts and place on the prepared baking sheet
8. With lightly floured hands , shape each piece into a flat , round cake about 6 inches in diameter
9. Using a sharp , straight-edged knife , cut each round into 6 equal wedges , leaving them in place
10. Sprinkle the tops with the granulated sugar and bake until firm in the center when lightly touched , about 20-25 minutes
11. Transfer to a rack and let cool slightly before breaking into wedges
12. In a small bowl , using a hand mixer or a fork , beat the softened butter with the confectioners' sugar , vanilla and cinnamon until light and fluffy
13. Serve with the warm scones

title: no cook pineapple orange angel food cake
steps:
1. Cut angel food cake into 2 or 3 layers
2. Stir the crushed pineapple and vanilla pudding until blended
3. Add madarin oranges , mixing well with pudding mixture
4. The orange sections will resemble the crushed pineapple when finished
5. Fold in cool whip
6. Frost layers of cake generously with this mixture and use remaining to "frost" the outside of the cake
7. You can arrange more mandarin orange sections along the top of the cake if desired
8. Gives it some color
9. Let chill for a couple of hours , if you can wait that long
10. Last time i wanted to let it "chill" it was gone before the chill time was finished

title: p  f  chang s vegetarian lettuce wraps
steps:
1. Mix the cooking sauce in a bowl and set aside
2. For the spicy sauce: in small dish , mix the dry mustard and water until smooth
3. Add remaining ingredients and mix well
4. In medium bowl , combine sherry , soy sauce , chili sauce , sesame oil , cornstarch , and water
5. Mix well and stir in tofu
6. Allow to marinate for 15 minutes
7. Heat wok or skillet over medium-high heat
8. Add the mixed oil and stir fry tofu for 2-3 minutes set aside
9. Add the ginger , garlic and onion
10. Stir-fry for about a minute
11. Add bamboo shoots and water chestnuts
12. Stir-fry for another 2 minutes return tofu to wok / skillet
13. Add cooking sauce and cook until thickened
14. Place prepared cellophane noodles onto a platter
15. Pour tofu mixture over them and serve with lettuce and spicy sauce

title: blueberry burst granola
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300f
2. You will need 3-4 glass baking dishes approximately 9x13 inches
3. In a large metal roaster / pan , mix the first 8 ingredients together , make sure all the fruit in coated with the flour
4. Set aside
5. Bring water to a low boil , pour into a small glass mixing bowl and add the almond paste
6. Set aside
7. In a large glass mixing bowl add together the next 7 ingredients & whisk until emulsified & cloudy , stir the almond paste & water mixture , and add to wet ingredients & whisk briefly
8. Pour the wet ingredients over the dry ingredients and mix until all dry is covered with wet
9. This will take about 10 minutes
10. Divide the granola into the baking dishes , making sure not to add more than 1 inch to any one pan
11. Bake for 1 hour , stirring well every 15 minutes and rotating the lower rack to the upper rack as well
12. Remover pans from oven and stir once again
13. Let cool completely in pans
14. Store in tight close containers , can be frozen for up to 6 months and taken out as needed

title: curves cereal apple cran muffins
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400f place paper baking cup in each of 12 regular-size muffin cups
2. Spray bottoms with cooking spray
3. In large bowl , mix applesauce , milk , oil and egg until blended
4. Stir in remaining ingredients except coarse sugar just until moistened
5. Divide batter evenly among muffin cups
6. Sprinkle with coarse sugar
7. Bake 18 to 22 minutes or until golden brown

title: fried pie crust
steps:
1. Cut crisco into flour
2. Add everything else and mix until dough rolls up into a ball
3. Pinch off pieces and roll into 1-inch balls
4. Roll out and add 2 tablespoons of your favorite filling
5. Fold dough over filling
6. Seal with water and fry in hot oil
7. Make sure dough is sealed or filling will ooze out during cooking

title: leftover turkey   fixin  phyllo packets
steps:
1. Mix together the turkey , stuffing , mashed potatoes , green beans , and gravy in a large bowl
2. Cut the stack of phyllo dough in half both directions , creating four stacks of rectangles
3. Start with one rectangle , covering the rest with a damp towel to keep moist as you work
4. Brush melted butter on the first sheet
5. Repeat this process with two additional sheets
6. Place a large scoop of the leftover mixture to the center and fold over edges to seal in a rectangle shape
7. Be careful not to over fill and seal well
8. Repeat this process until you have used up all of your leftover mixture
9. Place the phyllo packages on baking sheets lined with parchment paper
10. Bake in a 350 degree oven for about 15-17 minutes , or until flaky and golden brown
11. You can make these in any size or shape with any mixture of leftovers desired
12. Also , they are freezable for up to 2 months

title: saucy eggs with english muffins
steps:
1. Saute onions in bacon fat
2. Stir in milk , cream of chicken soup and mustard- heat until warm
3. Place sauce in greased 9x13 pan
4. Break eggs on top of sauce- cover with crumbled bacon
5. Bake for 20 minutes at 350 degrees
6. Place 1 egg and sauce on toasted english muffin
7. Sprinkle with shredded cheese

title: food network chicken korma
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large deep frying pan adding chopped onions and fry for 4 to 5 minutes on a medium heat until the onions are slightly brown
2. Add the garlic and ginger and cook for a further 1 or 2 minutes
3. Add the salt , turmeric and ground cumin
4. Turn up the heat and further cook for another 1 minute then add the chicken
5. It is very crucial that spices are mixed within the pan at this point and stirred to ensure that the chicken cooks with texture and flavor
6. Add water after stirring the chicken into the spices
7. Turn down the heat slightly and stir in the garam masala and cream cook for a further 5 minutes
8. Serve sprinkled with green coriander

title: tofu with key west barbecue sauce
steps:
1. Cut the tofu on the short end into 1 / 4 inch slices
2. Drain on a dishcloth for 30 minutes
3. On a plate , mix together the flour , cornmeal , poultry seasoning , nutritional yeast , salt , and pepper
4. Brush the drained tofu on both sides with mustard , then roll in the cornmeal mixture
5. Set aside
6. Heat 1 tablespoon oil in a heavy skillet over medium heat
7. Carefully place four slices of tofu in the skillet , without crowding , and cook , stirring , until golden brown
8. Drain on paper towels
9. Keep warm in a slow oven while you cook the remaining tofu in the remaining oil
10. Sauce: in a heavy , medium saucepan , combine all the ingredients
11. Bring to a boil , lower the heat and simmer 20 to 30 minutes
12. To serve , pour the sauce over the tofu
13. Enjoy !

title: blue cheese and apple canapes
steps:
1. Unroll crescent roll of puff pastry dough and cut into matching triangles
2. Bake on a greased cookie sheet for 10 minutes then allow to cool completely
3. In a small bowl , mix together cream cheese and crumbled blue cheese
4. Peel , core , and slice apple
5. Toss with lemon juice to prevent browning
6. At the last minute assemble each piece by spreading a triagle with a small amoutn of the cheese mixture and topping with 2-3 slices of apple
7. Sprinkle with parsley for garnish

title: roasted cauliflower  lavender  rosemary and garlic
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees
2. Mix oil , garlic , rosemary , lavender , pepper , salt , lemon and oil together
3. Toss in cauliflower and place in a large casserole dish in a single layer not over crowdering
4. Roast 20 minutes give a toss and bake for 15 more
5. Season with salt and pepper to taste
6. Garnish with a lavender sprig

title: celery with shrimp
steps:
1. Drain any liquid from the sour cream and whip until thickened
2. Stir in the capers , chives and mustard
3. Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve
4. Cut shrimp in halves or thirds
5. Trim celery
6. Cut each stalk into 2 inch lengths
7. Trim base of each piece so they will sit flat
8. Spon sour cream mixture evenly into celery
9. Top with shrimp and serve

title: spaghetti goulash
steps:
1. Brown the ground beef in a large skillet
2. Drain out the fat into a paper towel
3. Slice the onion into small bits
4. Saute the onion in the fat that remains in the skillet after removing the beef
5. Boil the spagetti
6. Add the drained beef to the onions
7. Pour in the tomato soup
8. Add the cooked and drained spagetti
9. Add salt and pepper to taste
10. Simmer on low , stirring occasionally until you are ready to eat

title: tropical shake
steps:
1. Combine the fruit in a blender and pure to break everything up
2. Add the milk , sugar , and ice
3. Blend until thick and frothy

title: mongolian beef stir fry
steps:
1. Cook noodles in a large saucepan of boiling salted water for 6-8 minutes or until tender and then drain and rinse under cold water and drain well
2. Heat oil in a wok or large frying pan / skillet over high heat and add half the oil and swirl to coat surface
3. Stir fry beef in 2 batches for 2-3 minutes or until browned and remove from wok
4. Add remaining oil to wok and stir fry carrot , capsicum , broccoli , beans and garlic and ginger for 3 minutes or until vegetables are just tender
5. Return beef to wok , add onion , sherry , sugar , sauces , sambal oelek and noodles and stir fry until heated through
6. Serve

title: grandma s hot bell and banana peppers
steps:
1. Cut all peppers and onion into 1" to 2" pieces and put in large pot
2. Add in cans of tomatoes and tomato paste , oil and garlic powder to taste and let simmer until onion and peppers are soft
3. If you want it milder , remove the seeds from the peppers
4. If you want it hotter add jalepenos or hotter peppers
5. Serve as a side dish or with bread

title: lemon couscous
steps:
1. Bring water to a boil in a medium saucepan
2. Gradually stir in couscous
3. Remove from heat
4. Cover and let stand 5 minutes
5. Fluff with a fork
6. Stir in onions and remaining ingredients

title: fat witch cocoa brownies
steps:
1. Grease a 9x 9 inch baking pan with butter
2. Dust with flour and tap out the excess
3. Preheat oven to 350
4. In a small saucepan , heat the butter over low heat just until melted , but not brown
5. Set aside to cool for 5 minutes
6. Add the cocoa powder and sugar to the butter
7. Whisk until blended
8. Add in the eggs one at a time , whisking after each addition until the mixture is smooth and shiny
9. Add in the vanilla
10. Whisk to mix inches
11. Measure the flour and salt and sift together into the batter
12. Mix the batter gently until well combined and no trace of the dry ingredients remains
13. At this point , if desired , stir in any extras like walnuts
14. Spread the batter evenly in the prepared baking pan and bake for 30 minutes or until tests done with toothpick
15. Remove from the oven and cool on a rack for 1 hour
16. Cut just before serving

title: nebraska runzas
steps:
1. Brown hamburger and onion , drain and add kraut and caraway seed
2. Cook about 5 minutes
3. Remove from heat
4. Divide dough into 8 parts
5. Roll out each and fill pinch dough together
6. Place seam side down on lightly greased baking sheet
7. Let raise 20 minutes
8. Bake 15 mins at 350
9. Brush with soften butter

title: winter fruit and nut stuffing
steps:
1. Melt 2 tablespoons butter in large skillet over medium-high heat
2. Add pears
3. Sprinkle with sugar
4. Saute until pears are golden , about 5 minutes
5. Transfer to very large bowl
6. Mix in cinnamon
7. Melt remaining 10 tablespoons butter in same skillet over medium heat
8. Add onions and celery
9. Saute until golden , about 15 minutes
10. Add wine and next 5 ingredients
11. Simmer until liquid is reduced almost to glaze and mixture is soft and moist , stirring occasionally , about 15 minutes
12. Mix into pears
13. Mix bread and pecans into fruit mixture
14. Season stuffing with salt and pepper
15. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
16. Generously butter 13x9x2-inch glass baking dish
17. Transfer stuffing to prepared dish
18. Bake uncovered until heated through , about 35 minutes

title: enchiladas de zucchini
steps:
1. Fry each tortilla 2 minutes in hot oil , until heated through but still pliable
2. Drain on paper towels
3. Saute beef and onion in oil
4. Drain off grease
5. Add zucchini and saute 5 minutes more
6. Spoon the sauce into the 12 tortillas
7. Sprinkle the monterey jack cheese on top of the sauce and then roll the tortillas up and place in a shallow baking dish
8. Pour enchilada sauce over tortillas
9. Sprinkle with extra monterey jack cheese and bake at 350 degrees for 15 minutes

title: milk bread  bread machine
steps:
1. Place all the ingredients into the pan according to the order in the manufacturers directions
2. Set crust on medium or dark , and program for the basic cycle
3. Press start
4. When the baking cycle ends , immediately remove the bread from the pan and place it on a rack
5. Let cool to room temperature before slicing

title: sweet potato and ricotta lasagna
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180c
2. To make bechamel , melt butter in a pan over low heat
3. Stir in flour and cook for one minute
4. Remove from heat , add bay leaves and nutmeg and gradually stir in milk - i use a whisk from here
5. Return to low heat and keep whisking and stirring for about 5 minutes , should thicken nicely
6. Put aside , season and remove bay leaves
7. Now heat oil in a large frypan and add onion and garlic
8. Cook over med heat about 2 minutes , then add sweet potato
9. Cook another 3 minutes
10. Add mushrooms , oregano and zucchini and cook another 5 minutes til veggies are just softening
11. Remove from heat and add tomatoes and paste
12. To assemble , place half the veggie mix in the bottom of a large shallow oven dish
13. Top with 1 / 3 lasagna sheets , cover with all the ricotta and 1 / 4 the parmesan
14. Top with another 1 / 3 lasagna sheets , cover with other half veggies and 1 / 4 parmesan
15. Top with rest of lasagna sheets , cover with the bechamel and rest of parmesan - make sure completely covered
16. Bake for 45 minutes or until nicely golden and tender
17. Serve with a big crunchy salad !

title: super blueberry coffee cake
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease an 8 or 9" square glass baking dish
3. Melt butter and let cool
4. Wash and drain blueberries
5. Set out to dry on paper towels
6. Stir together flour , salt and baking powder in a large bowl , mixing well
7. Put melted butter in a separate bowl and add to butter the milk , sugar , and egg substitute
8. Whisk to blend well
9. Add butter mixture to the flour mixture , stirring to blend well
10. Fold in blueberries
11. Spread batter in prepared baking dish
12. Mix sugar and ground nutmeg
13. Sprinkle over batter
14. Bake 50-60 minutes , or until a toothpick inserted in the center of the cake comes out clean
15. Place the dish on a wire rack to cool at least 30 minutes before serving
16. Enjoy

title: curry dressing
steps: 1. Process all ingredients in a food processor or blender until smooth , stopping to scrape down sides

title: cheese and leek souffle
steps:
1. Heat oven to 200 degrees celsius
2. Melt butter in a large saucepan
3. Add the chopped leeks and cook gently until the leeks are soft but not brown
4. Stir in flour and mustard
5. Add the milk a little at a time stirring thoroughly to create a thick , glosy sauce
6. Season with salt and a little pepper
7. Add the egg yolks and beat well with a wooden spoon until completely incorporated
8. Add the cheese and stir until the cheese is melted
9. In a separate bowl beat the egg whites until stiff and firmly set
10. Using a metal spoon , stir 2 tbsp of the egg whites into the soufle base to loosen the mix
11. Carefully fold in the remaining egg whites in two parts
12. Be very gentle and try to retainas much volume as possible
13. Lightly grease 6 individual ramekin dishes with a little butter
14. Gently spoon the mixture into the dishes filling to within 1 cm of the top
15. Place the ramekins onto a bakingsheet and cook in a preheated oven for 15 minutes or until the souffles are golden and risen
16. Serve immediately with a green salad and crusty bread
17. Be quick though , the souffle will sink in a few minutes

title: salsa peru
steps: 1. Combine all ingredients in a blender and blend until all is mixed well

title: salmon loaf
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients only until blended
2. Pour into bread pan sprayed with pam
3. Bake at 350 degrees for 45 to 50 minutes , or until firm to touch

title: nif s nothing fancy tuna casserole
steps:
1. Boil pasta in salted water , as directed
2. While pasta is cooking , spray a 2 quart casserole with nonstick spray
3. Open cans of tuna , soup and mushrooms
4. Drain pasta , return to pot and add all other ingredients
5. Mix well and pour into casserole dish
6. Sprinkle cheddar cheese on top
7. Bake at 350f for about 30 minutes
8. You just need the casserole to heat through
9. Remove from oven when cheese has completely melted and let cool for 5 minutes before serving

title: easy overnight caramel rolls
steps:
1. Spray a bundt pan or an angel food cake pan with nonstick cooking spray
2. Place the rolls in the pan , sprinkle the whole package of butterscotch pudding mix over the rolls , sprinkle the brown sugar over the pudding mix , pour the butter over the brown sugar , and top with the pecans
3. Cover and place in the refrigerator overnight , or let rise for 4-5 hours before baking
4. Preheat oven to 350
5. Bake the rolls for 20-25 minutes
6. Let cool

title: pork chops and apple
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 180 c
2. Place pork chops in single layer in large baking dish
3. Saute onions and place on top of chops
4. Place apple on top
5. Drizzle with honey and lemon juice
6. Sprinkle cayenne , allspice , cinnamon and salt on top
7. Pour water around the edges
8. Cook covered for 1 hour or until chops are cooked through

title: light   moist rhubarb muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Mix topping ingredients
3. Mix muffin ingredients and fill muffin tin
4. Sprinkle topping over muffins
5. Bake for 15 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean

title: chocolate tunnel fudge cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degree f
2. Set oven rack to second-lowest position
3. Grease and flour a 12-cup bundt pan
4. In a bowl , beat 2 cups sugar with oil and and 2 eggs at high speed of an electric mixer , for 1 minute
5. Combine flour , baking cocoa , baking powder , baking soda and salt
6. In another small bowl , combine the coffee with the buttermilk
7. Add the flour mixture and the coffee mixture to the oil mixture
8. Beat at medium speed for 3 minutes
9. Stir in nuts and 1 tsp vanilla
10. Pour half of the cake mixture into the prepared bundt pan
11. In another bowl , beat cream cheese at medium speed until fluffy
12. Gradually add in 1 / 4 cup sugar , and the remaining egg
13. Beat just until blended
14. Stir in remaining 1 tsp vanilla , coconut and chocolate chips
15. Spoon over cake batter in pan , leaving 1 / 2-inch border around the center and the edge of the pan
16. Top with remaining cake batter
17. Bake for 1 hour and 10 minutes , or until cake tests done
18. Cool in the pan on a wire rack for 15 minutes
19. Remove from pan
20. Cool completely on wire rack
21. To make glaze: melt the butter in a saucepan over low heat
22. Stir in powdered sugar , and 1 tbsp water and the 2 tsp vanilla , mix until smooth , adding more water if necessary to achieve desired consistancy for glaze
23. Drizzle over the cooled cake

title: jazzed up grilled cheese and turkey pita
steps:
1. First step is to chop garlic up finely , preferrably in a mortar until is smashed all to pieces:}
2. Then combine garlic and margarine so that it makes a garlic butter of it's own in a separate bowl
3. Cut pita's in half and fill your pocket pitas as you like them
4. Coat the pita's on the outside with the garlic butter
5. Heat a pan up and grilled them to taste
6. Enjoy

title: greek island chicken
steps:
1. Add oil to a large skillet over medium heat , and saute chicken breasts on all sides , about 5 minutes
2. Remove from skillet , and set aside
3. Add onion and red pepper to skillet and saute for one minute
4. Add garlic , and continue cooking for 3 minutes , or until onion begins to go limp
5. Cut the sun-dried tomatoes in half , and add them to the skillet , along with all remaining ingredients except lemons and parsley
6. Mix well
7. Add the chicken breasts and any collected juices back to the pan , turning them over once to get them covered with the skillet juices
8. Lay the lemon slices on top of the other vegetables around the skillet
9. Cover , and simmer for 15 minutes , occasionally basting breasts with pan juices
10. Remove cover and cook 5 additional minutes , until chicken is tender and the sauce is slightly reduced
11. If you want a less liquid sauce , remove the chicken to serving dish at this point , increase heat and boil a minute or two , or until juices are boiled down to your desire
12. Spoon sauce and vegetables over chicken , garnish with parsley and serve

title: herbed pear jam
steps:
1. Cut 1 / 2 of pears into 1 / 2-inch pieces
2. Finely chop remainder in processor
3. Combine all pears with wine in heavy large saucepan and set aside
4. Using veg peeler , remove half of peel from orange and lemon
5. Thinly slice peel
6. Remove remaining peel and all white pith from orange and lemon
7. Chop pulp finely , discarding seeds and tough membrane
8. Stir sliced peel and chopped pulp into pears
9. Cover and simmer over medium heat 10 minutes to blend flavors
10. Reduce heat to low , add sugar and bay leaves to pears and cook till sugar dissolves , swirling pan occasionally
11. Increase heat and bring to rolling but not foaming boil
12. Cook about 40 minutes , stirring frequently toward end of cooking time
13. Fill chilled spoon with jam , then slowly pour jam back into pan
14. Last 2 drops should merge and sheet off spoon
15. One tbs jam ladled onto chilled plate and frozen 2 minutes should wrinkle when pushed with finger
16. Stir in lemon juice
17. Discard bay leaves
18. Spoon jam into hot jars to 1 / 4" from top
19. Immediately wipe rim using towel dipped in hot water
20. Place lid on jar
21. Seal tightly
22. Arrange jars in large pot , filled with water
23. Process 15 minutes in boiling water
24. Remove jars from water bath
25. Cool to room temperature
26. Store in cool dry place , for up to 1 year
27. Refrigerate after opening

title: zucchini ricotta bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Coat a 13 x 9 inch baking dish with nonstick cooking spray
3. Cut zucchini lengthwise into 1 / 4 inch slices
4. Place in a basket over 1 inch of boiling water
5. Cover and steam for 5-6 minutes or until just tender
6. Drain
7. Pat dry
8. In a bowl , combine ricotta , egg substitute , 3 tablespoons bread crumbs , 3 tablespoons parmesan , parsley , oregano , basil and pepper
9. Set aside
10. Spread a third of the spaghetti sauce in prepared baking dish
11. Sprinkle with 2 tablespoons bread crumbs
12. Cover with half of the zucchini , ricotta mixture and mozzarella
13. Cover with remaining sauce
14. Combine remainin crumbs and parmesan
15. Sprinkle over top
16. Cover and bake for 45 minutes
17. Uncover
18. Bake 15 minutes longer
19. Let stand 15 minutes before cutting

title: cherry grunt
steps:
1. Mix flour , baking powder , 1 / 2 t
2. Orange zest , and the salt in mixing bowl
3. Pour in half-and-half and stir quickly to mix
4. Combine cherries , 1 cup water , the sugar , orange juice , and remaining 1 / 2 t
5. Orange zest in 10-inch skillet
6. Cover and heat to boiling
7. Drop batter onto cherries , making 6 dumplings
8. Reduce heat to maintain steady simmer
9. Cover and cook until toothpick inserted into dumpling comes out clean , 20-25 minutes
10. Serve immediately , with cream , if desired

title: chicken and pasta
steps:
1. Melt margarine in a large sauce pan over low heat
2. Add package of dressing mix
3. Mix in broth and undiluted can of soup
4. Blend in the cream cheese until smooth
5. Reduce heat
6. In a 13x9 baking dish , place chicken
7. Pour hot sauce mixture over the chicken
8. Bake in a hot 350 degree oven for 1 hour 0
9. 15 minutes before end of baking time , cook pasta according to package directions and drain well
10. Serve chicken dish by pouring sauce over hot pasta

title: sunflower rye bread
steps:
1. In bread machine pan , place all ingredients in order suggested by manufacturer
2. Select wheat bread setting
3. Choose crust color and loaf size if available
4. Bake according to bread machine directions

title: segura pickles
steps:
1. Grow or buy kirbies that are small enough to fit neatly into quart canning jars
2. Make sure the skins are not wrinkled
3. Boil your jars to sterilize
4. Pack the cucumbers into the jars
5. Boil all the seeds and spices together with the vinegar , sugar , salt and water
6. Pour the brine over the cucumbers
7. If there isn't enough liquid to completely cover all the cukes , add some boiled water
8. Cover loosely with the lids and let sit for 1 hour to 24 hours or more , taste , then refrigerate
9. If you intend to keep the pickles more than a couple of weeks then go through the canning process and boil the jars immediately after pouring the brine
10. From phyllis: a
11. If you don't like that slightly yellowish color that is imparted to the pickles then eliminate the turmeric

title: msg free ranch dressing
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together in medium sized bowl with a whisk
2. Taste and adjust spices to your tastes
3. For a thicker dip , use less cream and more sour cream

title: cracked pepper   flax seed cheese ball
steps:
1. In medium bowl , mix together cream cheese , pepper , and seasoning with a fork until blended
2. Divide into 2 balls
3. In a small bowl , put 1 tbsp flax seed , put in one ball , turning to coat all sides with seeds
4. Repeat with other ball
5. Wrap with plastic wrap , refrigerate two hours
6. Serve with crackers or vegetables

title: slow cooker chicken pot pie
steps:
1. Mix the flour , salt , pepper , paprika , garlic salt , and seasoning salt
2. Add the cubed chicken to flour mixture , mix
3. Add vegetables , potatoes , and garlic
4. Add the chicken broth and water , mix all together
5. Turn crock pot on low , stirring occasinally for 8 hours
6. Topping:
7. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
8. Mix egg , milk , and pancake mix
9. Pour mixture over the top of chicken
10. Remove stone from bottom of crock pot
11. Bake in the oven for 15-20 minute

title: chocolate cake baked in a jar
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325
2. Pre-wash canning jars in hot , soapy water
3. Rinse well , dry and let them come to room temperature
4. Grease insides of jar well
5. Beat together butter and half of sugar until fluffy
6. Add eggs and remaining sugar , vanilla and applesauce
7. Sift dry ingredients together and add to the applesauce mixture a little at a time: beat well after each addition
8. Pour one cup of batter into each jar and carefully remove any batter from the rims
9. Place jars in a preheated 325 oven and bake for 40 minutes
10. While cakes are baking , bring a saucepan of water to a boil and carefully add jar lids
11. Remove pan from heat and keep lids hot until ready to use
12. When the cakes have finished baking , remove jars from oven
13. Make sure jar rims are clean
14. Place lids on jars , and screw rings on tightly
15. Jars will seal as they cool
16. Cakes will slide right out when ready to serve
17. Unsealed jars should be stored in the refrigerator and eaten within 2 weeks
18. Sealed jars may be stored with other canned food or placed in a freezer
19. Do not place hot jars in freezer !
20. The cake is safe to eat as long as the jar remains vacuum-sealed and free from mold
21. To enjoy the best flavor , try to eat all canned cakes within 6 months

title: corn and poblano lasagna
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
2. Melt 2 tablespoons butter in a medium , heavy saucepan over medium heat
3. Add 2 / 3 of the garlic and saute for 1 minute
4. Mix in the corn and saute for 5 minutes
5. Stir in the cream and thyme
6. Cook over medium-low heat for 5 minutes for the flavors to incorporate
7. Turn off the heat and let cool slightly
8. Transfer to a blender and puree until smooth
9. Season with salt and pepper
10. Heat the remaining 2 tablespoons butter in a small , heavy skillet over medium heat
11. Add the onions and saute until translucent , about 5 minutes
12. Add the remaining garlic and cook for 1 minute
13. Mix in the zucchini and poblano strips and cook for 5 minutes for the flavors to incorporate
14. Season with salt and pepper
15. Turn off the heat
16. Spread about 1 / 4 of the corn mixture over the bottom of an 11 by 8-inch baking dish
17. Cover with a layer of 3 lasagna sheets
18. Spread 1 / 4 of the poblano mixture and 1 / 4 of the cheese over the pasta
19. Repeat the layering 3 more times
20. Cover with foil
21. Bake until the pasta is cooked and tender , about 50 minutes
22. Remove the foil and turn up the oven temperature to broil
23. Broil until golden brown and bubbly , 8 to 10 minutes
24. Let stand for 15 minutes before serving

title: honey glazed rack of lamb with wine sauce
steps:
1. Set oven to 400 degrees
2. Prepare a greased baking sheet
3. For the wine sauce , in a saucepan melt butter over medium-high heat
4. Add in the onions and carrots
5. Saute for about 12-13 minutes , or until deep dark brown , adding in the garlic the last 3 minutes
6. Add in beef broth , red wine , chicken broth , tomato paste and fresh rosemary
7. Simmer for 10-12 minutes
8. Mix 1 tablespoon soft butter with 1-1 / 2 tablespoons flour to make a paste
9. Whisk into simmering sauce , stir until thickened
10. Using a strainer , strain the sauce and set aside
11. To make the lamb , in a bowl whisk together honey , soy sauce and dijon mustard
12. Add in 2 tablespoons of the mixture to the wine sauce , whisk to combine
13. Season the lamb racks with salt and pepper and a little garlic powder
14. Place the racks on a large baking sheet
15. Brush both sides of the racks with the the honey / soy glaze
16. Cook / roast until the lamb for about 35 minutes , or until the temperature of the lamb reaches 130f brush with more glaze once during cooking
17. Rewarm the sauce , season with salt and pepper
18. Slice the lamb between the bones and serve the sauce with the lamb
19. Delicious !

title: beef   cheese burritos
steps:
1. In a large skillet , brown ground beef over medium-high heat until no longer pink , pour off fat
2. Stir in salsa and velveeta and stir until melted
3. To serve , spoon about 1 / 2 cup beef mixture in center of tortilla and top with choice of toppings
4. Fold bottom edge up over filling and fold sides to center

title: balti seitan madras
steps:
1. Mix the tomato paste , fennel seeds , ginger , coriander , garlic , chilli powder , curry powder , turmeric , lemon juice , salt , and water in a bowl
2. Heat the vegetable oil in a pan and cook the onions until they are softened
3. Pour the spice mixture into the pan and let simmer
4. Break the seitan into pieces and add to the pan
5. Let the seitan simmer for about 10 minutes , until much of the liquid has been absorbed by the seitan or has evaporated
6. Remove the pan from the heat , stir in the chopped chiles , and serve

title: chicken  broccoli and rice casserole
steps:
1. Melt butter over high heat , add chopped mushrooms
2. Cook and stir for about 2 minutes
3. Add onion and chicken pieces
4. Reduce heat to medium high and cook until chicken is just cooked through
5. Stir in garlic and cook for about a minute longer
6. Add undiluted chicken soup and velveeta cheese , stir until cheese is melted
7. Remove from heat and add cooked rice , thawed broccoli , sour cream , and pepper
8. Spoon mixture together and spoon into casserole dish sprayed with cooking oil
9. Spread shredded cheese over top and bake for 20 minutes at 350 degrees
10. Instant rice can be made in the microwave in about 4 minutes while the chicken is cooking
11. If you prefer other rice then make it ahead of time

title: white cheese almond dip
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together and place in a baking dish
2. Bake 20 minutes at 350 degrees
3. Serve warm with tortilla chips , corn chips or triscuit crackers

title: mega mashed potatoes
steps:
1. Boil the potatoes for about 15-20 minutes or until cooked through
2. Drain well
3. While still hot , either mash or rice the potatoes in an oven-proof bowl
4. Add the butter and stir until the butter is completely melted
5. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
6. Add the sour cream until the potatoes are a little smoother , but you can still see more potatoes than you can sour cream
7. Add 2 splashes of milk to help smooth out the potatoes and stirr well
8. Add the heavy cream and stir
9. The potatoes will be super smooth , but be careful not to let this become a soup
10. Add the green onions and garlic and stir until well blended
11. Smooth the top over , leaving the potatoes more mounded in the center
12. Sprinkle the cheese over the top
13. Bake until the cheese is melted
14. If you're really daring , go a little further until the top starts to brown
15. Serve immediately and may god have mercy on your arteries

title: doodle cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Mix cake ingredients together
3. Pour into 13"x9"x2" cake pan
4. Bake for about 30 minutes
5. Topping: mix milk , margarine and sugar together in saucepan
6. Boil for 3 minutes over medium heat
7. Add pecans and coconut
8. Pour over cake while still hot

title: brisket of beef
steps:
1. Put brisket in roasting pan
2. Dump onion soup mix on top
3. Pour water over about 1 / 2 inch into pan
4. Stir a little
5. Cover tightly with foil
6. Put into oven at 250 degrees-middle rack
7. Forget about it for at least 5 hours
8. Take it out , cut against the grain , it should fall apart and be very tender
9. Season with salt and pepper to taste

title: chicken dinner in a dish and a dash
steps:
1. Mix together dressing , onion flakes , parsley , marjoram , basil , lemon pepper seasoning , soup and water
2. Arrange rice in bottom of a casserole or 13 x 9 pan and stir in 1 / 2 the liquid
3. Place chicken pieces on top and pour remaining liquid over top
4. Cover with foil or lid
5. Bake at 350 f for 30 min
6. Uncover
7. Stir rice mixture
8. You may need to add a little additonal water if it seems too dry
9. Bake 30 to 40 minutes longer until bubbly and rice and chicken are done
10. Serves 4

title: raspberry  red wine vinegar
steps:
1. Place raspberries , both vinegars and sugar in medium stainless steel saucepan
2. Bring to a boil on high
3. Reduce heat to medium-low , cover simmer gently for 5 minutes
4. Cool liquid
5. Chill overnight
6. Strain through fine sieve , pressing to extract liquid
7. Discard pulp
8. Pour liquid into glass jar with tight fitting lid
9. Chill
10. My family's favorite salad dressing
11. 1 / 2 cup oil
12. 1 / 4 cup raspberry vinegar
13. 1 / 4 cup white sugar
14. 1 / 4 cup ketchup
15. 1 tbsp steak sauce
16. In a 2 cup glass measuring cup add all ingredients and blend with a stick blender
17. This is a sweet dressing

title: kielbasa and vegetable bake
steps:
1. Spray a 13x9 inch baking pan with non stick cooking spray
2. Pour carrots into bottom of pan
3. Peel and quarter potatoes and add to carrots
4. Cut cabbage into wedges about 2 inches thick
5. Lay in pan with carrots and potatoes
6. Add water , seasonings , and butter
7. Cover and bake at 375 for 45 minutes or until vegetables are almost tender
8. Lay kielbasa on top of vegetables
9. Cover and bake 15 more minutes or till sausage is heated through
10. Serve with french bread or garlic bread

title: sunrise peach muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven: 350f
2. In a large bowl , combine flour , baking soda and salt
3. In a separate bowl , blend sugar with butter until smooth and light
4. Whisk in egg , buttermilk , vanilla and lime peel
5. Pour over dry ingredients
6. Add peaches and coconut
7. Stir just until dry ingredients are moistened
8. Spoon batter into lightly oiled or paper-lined muffin cups , filling 3 / 4 full
9. Bake on center rack in preheated oven for 30 to 35 minutes or until tops are firm to the touch
10. Gently lift from pan and cool on a rack
11. Storage: for freshness , keep muffins in an airtight container

title: salad w  black olive vinaigrette and almond crusted goat cheese
steps:
1. Vinaigrette:
2. In medium bowl , whisk the vinegar , mustard , honey and oil
3. Add olives , salt , pepper and the dried oregano
4. Combine thoroughly and refrigerate until chilled
5. Goat cheese:
6. Slice goat cheese and roll into 1" balls
7. Combine almonds and paprika in a shallow bowl
8. Roll the balls in paprika almond mix until completely covered all over
9. Salad:
10. Rinse the lettuce and cut into narrow slices
11. Put sliced lettuces into a large bowl and slowly add vinaigrette dressing , coating the salad entirely
12. Top with goat cheese balls as you would with croutons

title: disney grapefruit cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Sift together flour , sugar , baking powder , and salt in large mixing bowl
3. Make a well in center of dry ingredients
4. Add water , vegetable oil , eggs , grapefruit juice and lemon rind
5. Beat until smooth
6. Beat egg whites with cream of tartar until stiff but not dry
7. Gently fold egg whites into cake batter
8. Pour into an ungreased 10 inch cake pan and bake at 350 degrees f for 30 minutes
9. When cool , slice cake in half horizontally
10. Frost
11. Beat cheese until fluffy
12. Add lemon juice and rind
13. Gradually add sugar and beat until blended
14. Add food coloring
15. Add reserved 2 tablespoons of grapefruit juice and blend
16. Divide frosting in half and add roughly chopped grapefruit sections to one half
17. Spread this mixture on bottom half of cake
18. Top with several grapefruit sections
19. Cover with other cake layer and frost remainder of cake
20. Garnish with remaining grapefruit sections

title: toad in the hole with bacon
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f / 190c
2. The toad:
3. Wrap the sausages in the bacon and place in a large roasting tin
4. Scatter the onion over it
5. Drizzle the oil over it and bake for 20 minutes
6. The hole:
7. Sieve the flour and the salt into a bowl
8. Make a well in the center add the egg and gradually beat in half of the milk for two minutes
9. Stir in the rest of the milk and mustard
10. Remove the roasting tin from the oven when the sausages are just turning brown and pour the batter over them
11. Cook for a further 40 minutes or until done
12. The batter should have risen and it will be a lovely golden brown
13. :d you
14. The gravy:
15. Heat the oil in a saucepan and saut the onion for five minutes
16. Stir in the flour and cook for a minute then add the mustard , worcestershire sauce and chicken stock
17. Bring to the boil , stirring all the time
18. Simmer for 15 minutes , checking the seasoning
19. Serve the toad in the hole with the gravy poured over it with mashed potatoes and veggies on the side

title: caesar salad dressing
steps:
1. Press garlis into a jar with a resealable lid
2. Add remaining ingredients and 1 tbsp cold water
3. Cover tightly and shake well until combined
4. Taste and adjust salt and pepper if needed
5. Can be refrigerated for up to 2 weeks

title: caponata wraps
steps:
1. Stack spinach leaves , about 12 at a time , then cut crosswise into narrow strips and set aside
2. For each wrap , spread a fourth of the cheese to within half an inch of edge of each tortilla
3. Scattter spinach strips over the bottom two thirds of the tortilla and gently press onto the cheese
4. Mix hummus and mushrooms in a medium bowl , then spooon on top of spinach , spreading to cover
5. Top with a fourth of the caponata and roll up tightly from the bottom
6. To serve , cut each wrap diagonally

title: golden sesame braid
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Combine milk , shortening , sugar and salt
3. Allow to cool to lukewarm
4. Sprinkle yeast on lukewarm water , stir to dissolve
5. Add yeast , 3 eggs and 2 cups of flour to milk mixture
6. Beat with mixer on medium until smooth , about 2 minutes , occasionally scraping the bowl
7. Alternatively beat by hand with spoon until batter is smooth
8. Gradually add enough remaining flour to make a soft dough that leaves the sides of the bowl
9. Turn out on to floured surface and knead until smooth and satiny , about 8 to 10 minutes
10. Put dough in lightly greased bowl , turn to grease both sides
11. Cover and let rise in warm place until doubled , about 1 hour
12. Divide dough into 6 equal pieces
13. Roll each into 12" strips
14. Braid 3 strips together to form a loaf , continuing with remaining 3 strips for second loaf , place on separate greased baking sheets
15. Cover and let rise until doubled , about 45 minutes
16. Brush loaves with a glaze using 1 beaten egg and 1 tblsp of water
17. Sprinkle with sesame seeds
18. Bake in oven for 30 minutes or until loaves sound hollow when tapped
19. Remove from baking sheets
20. Cooling on racks

title: spiced wassail
steps:
1. Break the cinnamon stick into pieces , &--along with the whole cloves & whole allspice--tie the cinnamon pieces in a cheesecloth bag
2. Cut each orange in half
3. In a large covered saucepan , combine the cider , cranberry juice , sugar & orange bitters
4. Add the spice bag , oranges & rum extract , & simmer , covered , for 10 minutes
5. Remove spices & pour into a warm serving bowl , leaving the oranges to float on top

title: cider roasted chicken
steps:
1. Combine the first 5 ingredients in a pan and bring to a boil
2. Stir until all salt is dissolved
3. Remove from heat and cool completely
4. Remove and discard giblets and neck from chicken , rinse with cold water and pat dry
5. Pour brine into a two gallon ziplock plastic bag
6. Add chicken and seal
7. Refrigerate 8 hours or overnight , turn the bag occasionally
8. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
9. Bring 2 cups of cider to a boil in a small saucepan over medium-high heat
10. Cook until reduced and thickened to approximately 1 / 4 cup
11. Set aside
12. Remove chicken from bag
13. Discard brine and pat chicken dry
14. Place onion , parsley , and garlic into cavity
15. Place chicken on rack of broiler pan and bake for 1 hour and 30 minutes or until meat thermometer registers 175 degrees
16. Do not turn off oven just yet !
17. Carefully remove and discard skin
18. Baste chicken with half of reduced cider and then return to oven for ten minutes
19. Remove from oven , baste with remaining cider and then transfer chicken to a platter
20. Separate fat from drippings and serve au jus over chicken

title: smoked sausage supper
steps:
1. In medium skillet , cook onion and pepper in butter until tender
2. Do not brown
3. Add tomatoes , tomato paste and the seasonings
4. Simmer on low 10 minutes
5. In 10 inch skillet , bring cider to a boil
6. Add sausage , cover and simmer 10 minutes
7. Prepare macaroni according to directions
8. Drain and arrange on warm platter
9. Top with sauce and sausage

title: southern macaroni pie
steps:
1. Cook macaroni in salted water until almost done
2. Beat egg and flour with fork until there are no lumps
3. Beat in milk and salt
4. In a greased 2 quart shallow casserole dish , layer the macaroni , cheese , another layer of macaroni , and a final layer of cheese
5. Pour the milk mixture over the top of layered ingredients
6. Bake uncovered 45 to 55 minutes in a 350 degree fahrenheit preheated oven
7. Remove from oven and let sit for 15 minutes before serving
8. This last step is important to let the pie set-up

title: sweet sour beef stew
steps:
1. Brown meat , half at a time , in hot oil
2. (if cooking on stove top add the next 8 ingredients
3. Cover and cook over low heat for 1 hours or till meat is tender
4. )
5. If using crockpot , drain and transfer meat to crockpot
6. Add shredded carrot , sliced onion , tomato sauce , cup water , brown sugar , vinegar , worcestershire and salt
7. Stir
8. Cook on high for 6-8 hours
9. For both stove top and crockpot methods , at the end of the cooking time add the blended cornstarch and water
10. Cook and stir until thickened
11. Cook noodles according to package directions
12. Serve stew over noodles sprinkled with poppy seed

title: coffee crunch bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Blend all ingredients thoroughly
3. Stir in the almonds and chocolate chips
4. Spread batter evenly in an ungreased 15" x 10" x 1" , jelly roll pan
5. Bake 18-25 minutes , or until lightly browned and crisp
6. Cut into 2" x 1" bars while still warm

title: german ananas mango bowle  pineapple mango wine punch
steps:
1. 2-3 hours before your guests arrive arrive , peel , core , and cut the pineapple into bite-sized chunks on a ridged cutting board to catch any juices
2. Place pineapple chunks into a large clear glass punch bowl or bowle pitcher , pouring in any of the pineapple juices
3. Peel mango and cut into small cnunks and add to the pineapple
4. Pour the madeira and 1 bottle of white wine over the fruit
5. Cover and chill until the guests arrive
6. When the guests arrive , add the remaining wine and the champagne and serve

title: company s coming slaw
steps:
1. In a large bowl , mix yogurt , mayonnaise , pickle relish , chili sauce , and mustard
2. Add cabbage , carrots , bell pepper , and green onions
3. Mix well
4. Season to taste with salt and pepper

title: libby s applenut pudding from u   i
steps:
1. Beat eggs until fluffy
2. Add sugar gradually
3. Stir in sifted dry ingredients
4. Add vanilla , nuts and apples
5. Mix well
6. Pour into a greased 8-inch square pan
7. Bake at 325 for 40 to 50 minutes

title: vegetarian groundnut stew
steps:
1. Saute onions in the oil for about 10 minutes
2. Stir in the cayenne and garlic and saute for a couple more minutes
3. Add the cabbage and sweet potatoes and saute , covered , for a few minutes
4. Mix in the juices , salt , ginger , cilantro and tomatoes
5. Cover and simmer for about 15 minutes , until the sweet potatoes are tender
6. Add the okra and simmer for 5 minutes more
7. Stir in the peanut butter , place the pan on a heat diffuser , and simmer gently until ready to serve
8. Add more juice or water if the stew is too thick

title: brown butter creamy apple pie
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400f place cookie sheet in oven to heat
2. In 1-quart saucepan , cook 1 / 4 cup butter over medium heat , stirring constantly , until melted and lightly browned
3. Cool completely , about 15 minutes
4. In large bowl , beat 1 / 2 cup granulated sugar and the egg with wire whisk until light and fluffy
5. Beat in 2 tablespoons flour and 1 teaspoon vanilla
6. Beat in cooled butter
7. Gently stir in apples
8. Pour into crust-lined pan
9. In medium bowl , stir together all streusel ingredients except butter
10. With pastry blender or fork , cut in 1 / 4 cup butter until mixture looks like coarse crumbs
11. Sprinkle over apples
12. Place pie on cookie sheet in oven
13. Bake 20 minutes
14. Reduce oven temperature to 350f and cover edge of crust with strips of foil to prevent excessive browning
15. Bake 40 to 50 minutes longer or until apples are tender and crust is golden brown
16. Cool 2 hours
17. In small bowl , beat whipping cream until soft peaks form
18. Add remaining topping ingredients
19. Beat until stiff peaks form
20. Pipe or spoon onto pie

title: ice palace
steps:
1. Shake all ingredients with ice and strain into a collins glass over ice cubes
2. Garnish with the slice of orange and a cherry and serve

title: chicken pumpkin peanut stew
steps:
1. Over medium-high heat , heat oil in a dutch oven
2. Stir fry chicken breast until brown on all sides
3. Remove to a plate and reduce heat to medium
4. Add onions and green pepper , cook until tender
5. Add broth , tomatoes , cinnamon , tabasco sauce and salt
6. Bring to a boil , reduce heat , cover and simmer for 10 minutes
7. Add pumpkin and bring back to a boil
8. Cover and simmer for 5 minutes
9. Stir in corn and chicken , cover and simmer for 10 minutes or until chicken and pumpkin are tender
10. Combine peanut butter and cornstarch in a cup until smooth
11. Add to pot and stir until well blended
12. Simmer for another 2 minutes or until sauce thickened

title: lemon lemon garlic chicken
steps:
1. Season the flour generously with salt and pepper
2. Coat each piece of chicken in flour
3. Brown in hot oil in a large skillet , turning once
4. Pour off oil if desired
5. Add the lemon juice and garlic to the skillet and mix lightly
6. Cover , reduce heat to low , and simmer 30 minutes
7. Add the parsley and simmer until cooked through , about 20 minutes longer
8. Remove the chicken from the cooking liquid to serve

title: aromatic peas and carrot pilaf for one
steps:
1. Wash the rice well
2. Drain
3. Melt butter / margarine / ghee in a saucepan over low to medium heat
4. Saute garlic paste / powder / minced garlic in butter for about 15 seconds , then add the chopped onions and saute until browned , about 5-10 minutes
5. Add the rice , cumin seeds , bay leaf , cinnamon stick , peppercorns , and cloves to the onion-garlic mixture and saute for 10-15 minutes or until the rice is evenly browned
6. Now add carrots , peas , salt , and water , stir , bring to a boil , cover , reduce heat to low , and cook , without stirring , until the rice is tender , about 15-20 minutes
7. Uncover and evaporate excess water if any , remove from flame , and fluff up with a fork
8. Season with extra salt and pepper , if necessary , and serve hot !

title: best ever sour cream banana bread
steps:
1. Mix first 6 ingredients then add flour , soda , nuts
2. Grease 3 loaf pans
3. Pour
4. Mixture into pans
5. Bake 325 degreees for 1 1 / 2 hour or until done

title: thai tofu and green bean red curry
steps:
1. Heat approximately 1 / 3 of the coconut milk in a large pan
2. When it starts to separate , add the curry paste , fish sauce , and sugar and stir to mix well
3. Add the cleaned mushrooms and cook 1 minute
4. Pour in the rest of the coconut milk and bring to a boil
5. Add the green beans and tofu , then reduce heat , and simmer gently for about 4-5 minutes
6. Add the kaffir lime leaves and hot chillies
7. Garnish with cilantro before serving
8. Serve with hot cooked rice , if desired

title: blueberry lemon cobbler
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan combine blueberries , sugar , lemon juice , cornstarch , lemon peel , cinnamon and salt
2. Cook stirring over medium heat for about 5 minutes or until thickened
3. Pour into an 8-inch baking dish greased or sprayed with pam
4. Set aside
5. In a small mixing bowl stir together flour , 3 tablespoons sugar , baking powder , cinnamon and salt
