6. In a separate bowl whip together milk and egg , gradually pour into dry ingredients stirring until just moistened
7. Spoon over blueberry mixture
8. Bake at 375f for about 20 minutes or until golden brown
9. Best served warm

title: quick beef buns
steps:
1. Cook beef , pepper & onion in skillet over med
2. Heat until brown
3. Remove from heat and stir in bread crumbs , barbecue sauce and salt
4. Set aside
5. Preheat oven to 375
6. Separate crescent roll dough in 4 rectangles on lightly floured board
7. Roll dough in 8x4 rectangle-cut crosswise in half
8. Place 2 tbsp of meat mixture on each half
9. Top with some mozzarella
10. Pull corners of dough toward the center and twist
11. Pinch to seal
12. Place buns on greased cookie sheet
13. Repeat with rest
14. Makes 8 buns
15. In small cup , beat egg yolk and 1 tsp water with fork until blended
16. Brush top of buns
17. Bake 10-15 minutes or until golden

title: divine carrots
steps:
1. Mix carrots , croutons and cheese
2. Put in 1-quart buttered casserole dish
3. Mix remaining ingredients
4. Pour over carrot mixture
5. Bake , uncovered , at 400f for 20 minutes

title: the best baked ziti
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Grease a 9x13 inch casserole dish
3. Fill a large pot with water , add a teaspoon of salt and bring to a boil
4. Cook pasta as the package directs until al dente , then drain
5. Heat the olive oil in large pan over medium heat
6. Saute onion in oil until tender
7. Add the rosemary and garlic
8. Cook 2-3 minutes more then remove from pan and hold in a small bowl
9. Cook ground beef and sausage in the pan until done
10. Return the onion mixture and the spaghetti sauce to the pan
11. Add salt to taste
12. Simmer on low for 10 minutes
13. In greased baking dish , spoon 1 / 2 of the cooked pasta , provolone cheese , sour cream , cottage cheese , 1 / 2 of the meat sauce
14. Then repeat layering the rest of the ingredients in the same order: pasta , mozzarella cheese , and remaining meat sauce
15. Top with parmesan cheese
16. Bake for 20 to 30 minutes , or until sauce is bubbling and cheese is melted

title: weight watchers core mexican rice
steps:
1. Heat oil
2. Add rice and cook until golden and toasted
3. Add and lightly saute onion , bell pepper , and garlic
4. Put salt , 1 / 2 cup of tomatoes and broth in a blender
5. Process till smooth
6. Add liquid from blender to the rice mixture slowly
7. You can drain the rest of the tomatoes and add them to the rice at this point if you want extra tomato
8. Bring to a boil , cover , turn heat to low , and simmer until rice is tender , about 1 hour
9. Don't remove the lid during the cooking process
10. If you don't have fresh garlic , you can add 1 / 2 teaspoon of garlic powder to the blender

title: beef turnovers  empanadas
steps:
1. In a skillet , heat oil on medium
2. Stir in beef and cook until browned
3. Stir in remaining ingredients , except discos and frying oil
4. Lower heat and simmer for 15 minutes or until mixture thickens
5. Roll discos out to about 1 / 2-inch larger in diameter
6. Spoon about 1 tbsp
7. Meat mixture into middle , fold over
8. Moisten edges and seal with a fork
9. Heat 2-1 / 2 inches of oil in a deep saucepan on medium
10. Cook empanadas in batches , turning to brown on both sides
11. Drain on paper towels

title: turkey reubens
steps:
1. Preheat toaster oven to 400
2. Spread one side of each slice of bread with 1 teaspoon mustard and 1 tablespoon 1000 island
3. Divide the suarkraut and turkey evenly between 2 of the bread slices
4. Top each with 1 slice of cheese and remaining slice of bread
5. Place sandwiches on a baking sheet or toaster oven sheet and bake until cheese melts and sandwiches are hot , about 6 minutes

title: oven baked western frittata
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. In a medium sized skillet over medium high heat , fry the bacon until desired doneness in butter
3. Add the chopped vegetables and continue cooking until just softened
4. In the meantime , crack the eggs in a bowl , add half / half , salt and pepper to taste and whisk until combined
5. Pour mixture over the other ingredients in the skillet and cook until the bottom has just set
6. Place pan in the oven and bake for approximately 10 minutes or until the top is set
7. Watch closely !
8. Cut into four wedges and serve hot

title: orzo with parmesan and basil
steps:
1. Melt butter in heavy skillet over medium high heat
2. Stir in orzo and saute until lightly browned
3. Stir in chicken stock and bring to a boil
4. Cover , reduce heat and simmer until orzo is tender and liquid is absorbed , about 15 to 20 minutes
5. Mix in parmesan cheese and basil and season with salt and pepper to taste

title: lion house dinner rolls
steps:
1. In large bowl of electric mixer , combine water and milk powder , stir until dissolved
2. Add yeast , then sugar , salt , butter , egg , and 2 cups flour
3. Mix on low speed of mixer until ingredients are wet , then 2 minutes at medium speed
4. Add 2 cups more flour
5. Mix on low speed until ingredients are wet , then for 2 minutes as medium speed
6. Add about cup flour and mix again , by hand or mixer
7. Dough should be soft , not overly sticky , and not stiff
8. Scrape dough off sides of bowl and pour about 1 t
9. Vegetable oil all around the sides of the bowl so it is covered with oil
10. Cover with plastic wrap and allow to rise in warm place until double in size
11. After dough has risen , sprinkle cutting board or counter with flour and place dough on floured surface
12. Roll out and cut rolls in desired shape and size
13. Place on greased baking pans
14. Let rise in warm place until rolls are double in size
15. Bake at 375 for 15 to 20 minutes or until browned
16. Brush with melted butter while hot

title: grilled cheese crackers
steps:
1. Heat griddle or frying pan
2. Put the crackers on the pan , top down
3. Put cheese on every other cracker
4. Put plain crackers on top of cheese on cheesed crackers
5. Flip if needed

title: cheesy goats  pancetta crisps with goat cheese   pear
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450f
2. Arrange pancetta slices on a foil-lined baking sheet
3. Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until golden
4. Transfer to a paper towel-lined wire rack to drain
5. Let stand 10 minutes or until crisp
6. Core pear with an apple corer
7. Cut pear crosswise into 12 thin rings
8. Arrange on a serving platter
9. Top evenly with pancetta and goat cheese
10. Sprinkle with pepper
11. Drizzle with honey just before serving

title: brussels  sprouts with garlic and lemon
steps:
1. In a saucepan over a medium setting , heat the oil , then add garlic & cook about 30 seconds , or until fragrant , then reduce heat to low & add brussels sprout leaves & cores
2. Cook , stirring often , for about 10 minutes , or until brussels sprouts soften & just start to brown
3. Add 2 tablespoons of water , then cover & cook another 5 minutes or until cores are tender
4. Season with lemon pepper , & the lemon zest
5. , before serving

title: english pudding with cranberries and walnuts  rice cooker recipe
steps:
1. Set up your rice cooker for steaming by placing a small trivet or wire cooking rack in the bottom of the rice bowl
2. Fill the bowl 1 / 4 to 1 / 3 full of hot water and then close the cover and set for the regular cycle
3. If the water boils before you are ready to steam your pudding , turn the switch to "keep warm" and then when you are ready switch back to cooking
4. Grease or coat the inside of a 1 1 / 2 quart round melon-shaped tin pudding mold with a clip-on lid with butter-flavored pam spray
5. In a large bowl combine all the pudding ingredients in the order given with a rubber spatula to fold in ingredients until evenly moistened
6. Scrape batter into prepared mold , filling it 2 / 3 full , snap on the lid
7. Set mold on the trivet or rack in the bottom of the rice cooker , making sure it is covered and
8. Close cover and reset the cooker for the regular cycle to bring back to a boil , if necessary
9. Steam for one hour , checking to make sure the water doesn't boil off
10. Check pudding for doneness -- it will feel firm to the touch and it should be puffed , rising to fill mold and a cake tester inserted in center will come out clean
11. Unplug machine
12. Using oven mitts transfer mold from the steamer to a wire rack and remove the lid
13. Let stand for a few minutes and then turn upside down to unmold pudding on a serving plate
14. Serve warm cut into wedges with custard sauce
15. To make the custard sauce:
16. In a medium saucepan over medium heat scald milk
17. Set aside
18. In a large bowl or food processor combine sugar and cornstarch
19. Whisk in the egg yolks and vanilla
20. Beat with a whisk or process until light colored and foamy
21. Whisking constantly or with the food processor running add the hot milk to the mixture
22. Pour custard sauce back into the saucepan
23. Cook over medium-low heat , stirring constantly with a whisk until thickened and smooth and the sauce coats a wooden spoon
24. Do not boil
25. Pour sauce into a serving bowl and let cool to room temperature
26. Refrigerate , covered , until serving time and then serve cold over the pudding with a little vanilla around each pudding wedge

title: right side up pineapple cake
steps:
1. Bake cake according to pkg
2. Directions in a 13x9 pan
3. In a small saucepan combine the undrained pineapple and brown sugar over medium-high heat
4. Boil for 5 minutes , reducing heat if necessary--do not let sugar mixture burn--stirring constantly
5. Pour this mixture over warm cake and let cool
6. Meanwhile , prepare the instant pudding per pkg
7. Directions with the 2 cups of milk
8. Add the softened cream cheese to the prepared pudding and blend well
9. Pour this over top of cooled cake
10. Evenly place banana slices over the top of the cake , if desired
11. Top with cool whip , covering bananas completely
12. Sprinkle with pecans then sprinkle with coconut
13. Decorate with maraschino cherries
14. Refrigerate any leftover cake

title: a peach infused vodka
steps:
1. Add the ingredients in a bottle
2. Seal the lid tightly and store in a dark , cool place for 3 to 5 days
3. Gently shake the mixture now and then and check how the flavor is developing
4. The longer you leave it the stronger it will get
5. When you are done , strain the liquid
6. Into the original bottle and store in the freezer
7. Ready to drink

title: beef and vegetable cobbler
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Toss meat in the flour until coated
3. Reserve leftover flour
4. Heat oil in a heavy pot over medium heat
5. Brown meat
6. Add mushrooms and garlic , stirring constantly for about 1 minute
7. Stir in reserved flour and beef broth
8. Bring to a boil
9. Cover and simmer over low heat for 25 minutes
10. Mix egg and milk
11. Set aside 1 tablespoon
12. Combine baking mix and chives in a medium bowl
13. Stir in egg mixture until moistened
14. Knead until dough forms
15. Roll dough to fit a 13 x 9 baking dish
16. Cut the dough into 12 rectangles
17. Add frozen veggies and tomato to the meat mixture and transfer to the baking dish
18. Place rectangles on top of the mixture , fitting closely together
19. Brush the egg mixture over the top
20. Top with sesame or poppy seeds , or both , if desired
21. Bake until crust is golden and filling is bubbly , 20-25 minutes

title: turkey stuffing bread  bread machine
steps: 1. Place all ingredients in the order given into your bread machine , use your basic setting on the machine

title: zesty turkey chili
steps:
1. In a deep saucepan over medium high heat , saute onion and pepper in olive oil for 3 - 5 minutes
2. Add garlic and cook an additional minute
3. Add ground turkey and brown for 5 minutes
4. Add tomatoes and tomato puree and turn heat to low
5. Add beans and spices and simmer , stirring occasionally , until mixture thickens
6. Add hot sauce , salt and pepper to taste

title: love this chocolate glaze
steps:
1. Melt the butter in a small suacepan over low heat , about 2 minutes
2. Stir in the cocoa powder and milk
3. Cook the glaze , stirring , until it thickens and comes to a boil , about 2 minutes
4. Remove the pan from the heat and stir in 2 cups of confectioners' sugar , adding more if needed to make the mixture smooth and a little thicker than pancake syrup
5. Don't let the glaze get too thick
6. Ladle the warm glaze over a room temperature cake and let sit until the glaze hardens , about 30 minutes

title: beef cutlets
steps:
1. Mix all upto the egg ingredients well
2. Form into 16-18 cutlets that are of a diameter of around 2 inches when flattened or make them 3 inches across so get around 11-12
3. Coat with the bread crumbs or semolina
4. Heat a little oil in a pan to a medium high and shallow fry on low for around 5-6 minutes on each side or till they are cooked to the level you like
5. Add a little more oil if you require
6. I normally use non-stick pans and so need a minimum of oil

title: burnt sugar fudge
steps:
1. Mix four cups of sugar and cream in large heavy pan and bring to boil
2. Put remaining 2 cups of sugar into a heavy skillet and place on low heat , stirring constantly until sugar is completely melted and looks like brown syrup , light brown in color
3. When sugar is melted pour into 1st boiling mixture
4. Mix well and let cook until it makes a firm ball when dropped in cold water
5. Set off fire and stir in soda , until mixture foams
6. Add butter and stir until melted
7. Let mixture set for 20 minutes and then add vanilla and beat until heavy
8. Stir in nuts and pour into a buttered pan
9. Let cool and cut in squares

title: thai red curry
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a large saucepan over a medium heat and cook the onion for 5 minutes , stirring occasionally
2. Add the curry paste and garlic and cook , stirring , for a minute
3. Add the coconut milk , stock , fish sauce , sugar and salt , then bring to the boil
4. Add the red pepper and zucchini , cover with a lid , then reduce the heat to medium and simmer for 12 minutes
5. While the curry simmers , cook the rice
6. Add the chicken to the curry and simmer , covered , for a further 8 minutes
7. Add the cornstarch paste and stir continuously until the curry thickens , then stir in the lemon juice and basil
8. Serve on a bed of rice

title: skillet green beans and noodles
steps:
1. Cook onion and garlic in a skillet sprayed with pam for 3 minutes
2. Drain the bean liquid into the skiller
3. Add undrained tomatoes , oregan and pepper and bring to boil
4. Cook uncovered over medium heat for 5 minutes
5. Stir in pasta
6. Reduce heat
7. Cover and cook about 12 minutes or until pasta is almost tender
8. Add beans and cook 3 minutes more

title: banana coconut  milk freeze  dessert  non dairy
steps:
1. Peel the bananas and cut into 1 / 2 inch slices
2. Place on a large baking sheet in a single layer and freeze until solid , about an hour
3. To toast coconut , place in small skillet over high heat and cook , stirring often until coconut is fragrant and starts to turn light brown
4. Remove from pan immediately and set aside for garnish
5. In a food processor or blender , puree frozen bananas until smooth and creamy , scraping down sides occasionally
6. With motor running , slowly add coconut-milk , sugar , and rum or vanilla extract
7. Process until mixture has the consistency of soft ice cream
8. Serve immediately with a sprinkle of the toasted coconut and / or chocolate

title: healthy blueberry cornmeal pancakes
steps:
1. In a small bowl , stir together the flour , cornmeal , baking soda , baking powder and salt
2. Set aside
3. In a large bowl , whisk together the buttermilk , egg yolks and sugar , set aside
4. In another large bowl , using an electric mixer , beat the egg whites until stiff peaks form
5. Add the dry ingredients to the buttermilk mixture and stir until blended , then gently fold in the egg whites
6. Stir in the blueberries
7. Heat 1 / 2 teaspoons of oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium heat
8. Using 1 / 4 cup of batter for each pancake , make 4 pancakes , cooking them about 4 minutes on each side or until golden brown
9. Make 5 more batches of pancakes in the same fasion , adding 1 / 2 teaspoons of oil to the skillet before cooking each batch

title: parslied browned buttered carrots
steps:
1. Steam / boil carrots in salted water until fork-tender
2. Drain
3. In empty saucepan , heat butter over med-high heat until browning and nutty-smelling
4. Remove from heat
5. Add drained carrots to the saucepan of browned butter
6. Sprinkle with parsley , tarragon and salt and pepper
7. Toss to coat well

title: seared red snapper with ginger  garlic and cilantro soy  sauce
steps:
1. Dredge fish in cornstarch to coat
2. Heat the olive oil to hot , in an appropriate sized pan , and cook the fish until just done , about 2-3 minutes
3. Remove fish from pan and set aside
4. Heat sesame oil in the pan until steaming
5. Add ginger and garlic
6. Apply this mixture over fish
7. Combine the soy sauce and water and pour over the fish
8. Now add the cilantro on top and then the sesame seeds

title: bowl of sin
steps:
1. Prepare cake according to directions in a 9x13" pan
2. Cool and crumble in bite size pieces in a large bowl
3. Sprinkle liqueur over cake , cover bowl and allow to stand overnight
4. Prepare pudding and gently fold in whipped topping
5. Refrigerate overnight
6. The next day , place half the cake in a large trifle dish or glass bowl
7. Cover with half the pudding and sprinkle with half the candy crumbs
8. Repeat layers , ending with candy
9. Chill before serving

title: low low cal angel food cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees
2. In a medium bowl mix together flour and baking powder
3. In a large bowl beat eggwhites until they become frothy
4. Add cream of tartar to eggwhites and beat until stiff peaks form
5. Next sprinkle sugar and splenda / or twin carefully over the eggs until blended
6. Add vanilla to the egg white mixture
7. With hand mixer on med / low speed , slowly sprinkle flour mixture into eggs , aprox 1 tbsp at a time , mixing as each is added
8. When all mixed together , pour into med cake pan or into individual cupcake papers and bake until top springs up when poked
9. Approx 25 minutes

title: pineapple brown sugar cookies
steps:
1. Cream together butter and brown sugar
2. Beat in egg and vanilla
3. Stir together flour and baking powder
4. Slowly add to creamed butter
5. Chill 1 / 2 hour
6. Roll one tablespoon of dough , make thumb print to fill with colored pineapple
7. Sprinkle with coconut
8. Bake 400 for 8-10 minutes or until pale golden

title: french apple cake cook s illustrated
steps:
1. 1
2. Adjust oven rack to lower-middle position and heat oven to 325 degrees
3. Spray 9-inch springform pan with vegetable oil spray
4. Place prepared pan on rimmed baking sheet lined with aluminum foil
5. Place apple slices into microwave-safe pie plate , cover , and microwave until apples are pliable and slightly translucent , about 3 minutes
6. Toss apple slices with calvados and lemon juice and let cool for 15 minutes
7. 2
8. Whisk 1 cup flour , 1 cup granulated sugar , baking powder , and salt together in bowl
9. Whisk egg , oil , milk , and vanilla together in second bowl until smooth
10. Add dry ingredients to wet ingredients and whisk until just combined
11. Transfer 1 cup batter to separate bowl and set aside
12. 3
13. Add egg yolks to remaining batter and whisk to combine
14. Using spatula , gently fold in cooled apples
15. Transfer batter to prepared pan
16. Using offset spatula , spread batter evenly to pan edges , gently pressing on apples to create even , compact layer , and smooth surface
17. 4
18. Whisk remaining 2 tablespoons flour into reserved batter
19. Pour over batter in pan and spread batter evenly to pan edges and smooth surface
20. Sprinkle remaining 1 tablespoon granulated sugar evenly over cake
21. 5
22. Bake until center of cake is set , toothpick inserted in center comes out clean , and top is golden brown , about 1 1 / 4 hours
23. Transfer pan to wire rack
24. Let cool for 5 minutes
25. Run paring knife around sides of pan and let cool completely , 2 to 3 hours
26. Dust lightly with confectioners sugar , cut into wedges , and serve

title: shrimp tomato vinaigrette
steps:
1. In mixing bowl , combine shrimp , pea pods , and onion
2. To make dressing , in a screw top jar combine oil , wine , vinegar , italian salad dressing mix , capers , and pepper
3. Cover and shake well
4. Pour dressing over shrimp mixture
5. Cover and refrigerate several hours
6. Prepare tomato cups as follows: place tomatoes
7. Stem end down on cutting surface
8. With a sharp knife , cut the tomato into 4- 6 wedges , cutting to , but not through the base of the tomato
9. Spread the wedges apart slightly , sprinkle lightly with salt
10. Cover and chill
11. When ready to serve , spread the wedges apart and spoon in the salad mixture
12. To serve , drain shrimp mixture
13. Spoon into tomato cups
14. Place on lettuce lined plates if desired

title: gluten free  yeast free and sugar free  scone  bread
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 375f
2. Combine all dry ingredients in a bowl
3. Make sure to mix thoroughly
4. Beat the eggs
5. Stir in the milk and vegetable oil
6. Add wet ingredients to dry ingredients and mix thoroughly
7. The consistency will be more like muffin batter than bread dough
8. Grease a bread pan and spoon the mixture into the pan
9. Do your best to distribute the mixture evenly , squishing out big air pockets
10. Smooth out the top of the mixture with the back of a spoon as the batter will keep the form / shape it's left inches
11. Cook for about 1 hour , or possibly 5-10 minutes more , until a toothpick inserted into the centre of it comes out clean
12. 5 hours

title: johnny jalapeno s  cancun vacation  citrus shrimp medly
steps:
1. Carrot ribbons: peel the carrot and then continue peeling long strips , rotating the carrot so the strips dont get too wide
2. Heat oil and butter in a large skillet on medium heat
3. Add the garlic , jalapeno , onion , and ginger
4. Cook 1 minute to soften onions
5. Add carrots , and water chestnuts and continue cooking until carrots are just tender , about 2-3 minutes
6. Spoon the vegetables to a dish and cover to keep warm
7. In the same skillet increase the heat to med-high
8. Add the juices and honey
9. When the juice has simmered down some , add the shrimp and cook about 1 minute per side when shrimp is just about fully cooked
10. Add the vegetables back in along with the cooked rice and stir until sauce coats everything and thickens
11. Plate up , garnish with the dried parsley , and serve

title: peach   spice upside down cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease & flour 2-9" round pans
3. Mix melted butter and brown sugar and spread on the bottom of the round pans
4. Place peaches in a spiral design on top of sugar and butter mixture
5. Blend cake mix w / water , oil and eggs
6. Beat for 2 minutes and pour into pans
7. Bake 35-45 minutes until sides of cake come away from pan
8. While cake is baking make whipped cream and refrigerate until ready to frost cake
9. Immediately invert on cooling rack
10. Cool completely and frost bottom layer peach side up with 1 / 3 of whipped cream , top with 2nd layer and frost top and sides of cake with remaining whipped cream
11. Enjoy

title: ramos gin fizz
steps:
1. For the simple syrup:
2. In a small saucepan , combine sugar and water
3. Bring to a boil
4. Reduce heat to low
5. Simmer 10 minutes
6. Cool and refrigerate until chilled
7. Makes 2 cups
8. For the fizz:
9. In blender , combine ice cubes , gin , half-and-half , simple syrup , lime juice , and lemon juice and blend until mixture is smooth
10. Pour into 4 stemmed glasses
11. Fill each glass with club soda and stir gently

title: flax and ricotta breakfast pudding
steps:
1. Mix first three ingredients together in a saucepan
2. Cook stirring over medium heat until thick
3. Add flax and splenda
4. Sprinkle with cinnamon

title: tasty s    the power of flower7 salad
steps:
1. Of course , how you arrange the produce and what produce you choose , is left to creative license
2. Place the baby spinach or mixed greens towards the bottom of a platter
3. Set the green onions on the platter-these are your "flower stalks"
4. Place the slices of bell pepper in a "flower" pattern on the green onion stems
5. Place the strawberry slices between slices of bell pepper "petals"
6. Arrange each black olive half in the middle of the flower and garnish each olive with a chive blossom
7. Put the green peas on top of the spinach or mixed greens
8. Place mint leaves around the edges of the platter
9. Serve salad with the vinaigrette
10. 'be like the flower , turn your face to the sun'
11. Kahlil gibran

title: hors d asparagus
steps:
1. Trim crust from bread and flatten with a rolling pin
2. Beat cheeses and eggs together
3. Spread each piece with cheese mixture
4. Roll asparagus spears in bread
5. Dip in melted butter or margarine
6. Freeze with paper between layers
7. To serve , remove from freezer , slice in thirds , and bake for 15 minutes at 375f to 400f on a cookie sheet

title: rumarita
steps:
1. Blend all ingredients with crushed ice
2. Serve in a cocktail glass

title: healthy slow cooker polynesian chicken
steps:
1. Spray inside of slow cooker with non-stick cooking spray
2. Place chicken on the bottom of the slow cooker
3. Add all other ingredients into slow cooker , cover
4. Cook on high heat for 4 - 6 hours
5. As slow cooker temperatutres can vary , you may need to cook for more or less time
6. Chicken pieces will break apart durring cooking
7. Spoon chicken and sauce over rice

title: left over pork roast jambalaya
steps:
1. Into dutch oven
2. Add bite sized chunks of cooked pork roast
3. Add chicken broth and water
4. Add thinly sliced celery and onion
5. Add tomatoes with juice
6. Add salt
7. Add long-grained white rice
8. Add butter , thyme , garlic pepper and bay leaves
9. Add minced garlic
10. Combine all ingredients and bring to a boil
11. Turn heat down and simmer covered 45 minutes or longer
12. Keeping the dish on warm until serving only makes it taste better -- just keep it from boiling
13. Remove bay leaves before serving
14. More salt might be needed according to taste

title: marbled cheesecake brownies
steps:
1. Melt butter and chocolate , stir until smooth
2. Beat in sugar , eggs and vanilla
3. Add flour and baking powder , blend well
4. Spread in greased 8x8 baking pan
5. Microwave cream cheese until soft and warm , beat in sugar , egg , and vanilla
6. Spoon over brownie mixture
7. Swirl through batter with a knife
8. Sprinkle with chocolate chips
9. Bake at 350 for 25-30 minutes , until a toothpick comes out clean

title: daging bumbu bali   indonesian meat dish
steps:
1. Add enough water to the beef to cover , bring very slowly to a simmer and cook until done ,
2. Put in the food processor: onions , sambal , chilies , garlic and shrimp paste
3. Process until you have a paste
4. Fry this paste in the oil on a medium heat for a few minutes together with the kaffir and bay leaves
5. Add the soja sauce , a little vinegar , the cooked meat and 1 to 2 cups of the meat stock
6. Simmer for approx 15 minutes , and then taste for salt , sugar and maybe more vinegar
7. Serve this with rice and other indonesian dishes , what is really great as a little side dish is to quarter a few bananas and quickly fry them in butter until brown and starting to soften , keep warm in the oven until you are ready to serve
8. The little chilies make this dish pretty hot and i sometimes leave them out

title: good stuff maynard
steps:
1. Tear up tortillas into bite size pieces and mix with all ingredients except cheese- only add half of the cheese to mixture
2. Put it all in an 8x8-inch baking dish and top with remaining cheese
3. Cover and bake at 350 degrees until cheese is all melted and bubbly on sides
4. You can top each serving with a tablespoon of fat free or low fat sour cream and some salsa , just be sure to bump up the points for the sour cream

title: layered enchilada dinner
steps:
1. In large skillet , cook ground beef , onion and garlic over medium-high heat until browned and thoroghly cooked , stirring frequently , drain
2. Stir in soup and chiles
3. Spray 3 1 / 2 or 4- quart slow cooker with nonstick cooking spray
4. Spread about 1 / 4 cup of the enchilada sauce in bottom of slow cooker
5. Place 4 corn tortillas over sauce , overlapping and breaking in half as necessary to make an even layer
6. Top with 1 / 3 of beef mixture , spreading evenly
7. Drizzle with about 1 / 4 cup enchilada sauce
8. Sprinkle with 1 cup of the cheese
9. Repeat layering twice , using 3 corn tortillas and half of remaining beef mixture , enchilada sauce and cheese in each layer
10. Sprinkle paprika over top
11. Cover
12. Cook on low setting for 4 1 / 2 to 5 1 / 2 hours
13. Let stand about 5 minutes before serving
14. Sprinkle individual servings with cilantro

title: crab   fresh basil stuffed mushrooms
steps:
1. Combine cheese , breadcrumbs , salt , green onions and basil in a medium mixing bowl
2. Combine tabasco sauce , wine , lemon juice , garlic and egg in a separate bowl
3. Add to the breadcrumb mixture
4. Add crab meat to bread crumb mixture and fold until blended
5. Refrigerate for at least an hour , or overnight
6. Pre-heat the oven to 400 degrees f
7. Remove mushroom stems out of the caps
8. Take a small handful of stuffing in your palm and mold into a round ball
9. Place stuffing firmly inside the mushroom cap , being careful not to break the mushroom
10. Place stuffed mushrooms on an oiled cookie sheet about a half inch apart
11. Bake for 15 20 minutes or until the stuffing is lightly browned and serve
12. They can also be reheated if not served immediately

title: pork chops madrid
steps:
1. Mix all the ingredients , except for the pork chops , in a casserole dish
2. Best to use a casserole dish with a proper fitting lid
3. Place the chops in the mixture and let sit for at least an hour , longer if you have the time , and turning at least once half way through
4. Place casserole dish in a 350 degree oven for about 50 minutes , covered
5. Very important it be covered
6. Chops will be moist and tasty , you can spoon some of the juice over them once they're on the plate
7. I like to serve with spanish rice and salad

title: marmaliga
steps:
1. In a saucepan combine water , milk , salt , cornmeal & unsalted butter or margarine
2. Bring to a boil , stirring constantly
3. Cook until butter is melted and mixture is thick , about 15-20 minutes
4. Serve topped with a spoonful of cottage cheese and sour cream
5. Marmaliga can also be served plain with a little sugar or with freshly grated parmesan cheese
6. Enjoy !

title: chicken penne rigate
steps:
1. Heat olive oil in 12-inch skillet
2. Add onion and pepper and cook until tender
3. Add chicken and cook throughly
4. Add sauce and spices
5. Cook pasta according to package directions
6. Once all is done , add pasta to large bowl or dish and cover with sauce
7. Top with fresh ground parmesan cheese

title: south african seed bread
steps:
1. In small bowl or measuring cup combine sugar and 1 / 2 cup warm water
2. Sprinkle with yeast
3. Let stand for 10 minutes or until yeast bubbles up and doubles in volume
4. Meanwhile in a separate bowl combine remaining 2 cups warm water , molasses and oil
5. In large bowl combine wholewheat flour , rolled oats , rye flour , bran , wheat germ , sunflower seeds , sesame seeds , poppy seeds , flax seeds and salt
6. When yeast has risen , stir it into water / molasses mixture
7. Stir wet ingredients into flour mixture
8. Batter should be loose
9. Turn batter into one 10 x 6 inch or two 8 x 4 inch loaf pans that have been buttered and lined with parchment paper
10. Press extra seeds into top
11. Cover loosely with plastic wrap and let rise in a warm place for about 1 hour or until batter has risen to top of pan
12. Bake in a preheated 350 f oven for 1 hour for large loaf or 45 minutes for smaller ones

title: chili cheese roll ups
steps:
1. Preheat a larage saut pan on medium-high for 2-3 minutes
2. Spray pan with a cooking spray such as pam
3. Add onions and garlic
4. Saut 1-2 minutes , stirring occasionally
5. Add ground beef , cumin , chili powder , salt and pepper
6. Cook 5-7 until meat is brown and no pink remains
7. Stir frequently and break up meat as it cooks
8. While meat is browning , cut tomato into quarters and remove core
9. Dice into bite-size pieces and set aside
10. Dice cheese into bite-size pieces
11. Drain beef and return to pan
12. Add cheese and heat until cheese is melted , stirring frequently , and reducing heat if needed
13. Remove from heat and let stand 2 minutes
14. Remove tortillas from package and place on paper towel
15. Place in microwave and heat on high for 30 seconds
16. Assemble roll-ups as follows: place tortillas on flat surface and add 1 / 2 cup beef mixture to each tortilla
17. Divide tomato and lettuce between each tortilla
18. Fold one side up about 1 inch to form the bottom , and roll tortilla to make a cylinder shape
19. Serve

title: apricot peach smoothies
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a blender
2. Cover and process'til smooth
3. Pour into glasses

title: pork chop   o brien potato bake
steps:
1. Brown pork chops in a lightly greased skillet
2. Sprinkle with seasoned salt and set aside
3. Heat soup , milk , sour cream , pepper and 1 / 8 tsp seasoned salt in a large saucepan
4. Stir in potatoes , 1 / 2 c cheese and 1 / 2 can fried onions
5. Spoon into a 9x13" baking dish
6. Arrange pork chops over potatoes
7. Bake covered , @ 350 degrees for 40 minutes
8. Top with remaining cheese and onions
9. Bake uncovered 5 minutes longer

title: spicy daal
steps:
1. In a large sauce pan , add the lentils and fill with water to cover
2. Bring to a boil
3. Reduce heat and simmer for 10 minutes until the lentils open and are tender
4. While lentils are cooking , heat butter in a large pan on medium heat
5. Add the choppen onions and fry until starts to clarify and then add garlic and ginger and until aromatic
6. Add spices to pan
7. Drain the water from the lentils and add to pan with 1 cup of water
8. Cook for 1 hour , stirring occasionally , until the dal is thick , if it starts to get dry add more water
9. Remove from heat and stir in yogurt

title: crock pot kowloon chicken
steps:
1. Sprinkle chicken with salt and pepper
2. Place in slow cooker
3. Combine ginger , garlic , broth and syrup from pineapple
4. Set aside
5. Cut pineapple slices into fourths
6. Arrange pineapple and water chestnuts over chicken
7. Pour ginger sauce over all
8. Cover and cook on high 1 hour
9. Reduce heat to low and cook an additional 2 to 3 hours or until chicken is tender
10. Add green onions
11. Dissolve cornstarch in soy sauce and vinegar
12. Stir into pot
13. Cover and cook on high 10 to 15 minutes or until slightly thickened
14. Serve with crisp chinese noodles

title: cream cheese stuffed jalapenos w  bacon
steps:
1. Devein jalapenos by scraping insides with a potatoe piller
2. Wash well
3. Stuff each jalapeno with approx 1 oz of cream cheese
4. They come with several in a package but each packet is one ounce and you can easily squeese it into the jalapenos this way)
5. Much easier than using a spoon
6. Slice bacon in 1 / 2
7. Top the opening of each jalapeno with 1 / 2 slice of bacon and secure with a tooth pick
8. Cook on grill or open flame until done
9. We prefer the jalapeno to be black in some parts

title: chicken hamburger casserole
steps:
1. Brown hamburger
2. Season with salt and pepper to taste
3. Mix together all ingredients except chow mein noodles in a 2-qt casserole
4. Bake at 350 degrees for 30 minutes uncovered
5. Stir
6. Cover and bake for an additional 30 minutes or until rice is done
7. Uncover
8. Do not stir
9. Sprinkle chow mein noodles on the top and bake for an additional 10 minutes
10. Let stand 5 minutes before serving

title: ginger soy tempura sauce
steps:
1. Blend all ingredients well
2. Serve with fish or chicken

title: smores with reese s cups
steps:
1. Split or break the graham crackers into twos and set aside
2. Next , you need to heat the marshmallows
3. There are several ways to do this
4. If using the broiler: you need to place the marshmallows on top of 1 / 2 graham cracker and put under the broiler for a few seconds or until golden brown and toasted
5. Remove the graham and place a reese's cup on top then place the other 1 / 2 graham crack back on top and press it lightly to flatten the marshmallows
6. If using a campfire / fire-pit: prepare the graham cracker in an area near your fire , and using a utensil roast the marshmallows until golden brown and toasted
7. Place the marshmallow on 1 / 2 of the graham cracker , place a reese's cup on top , and the other 1 / 2 of graham , light press down to flatten the marshmallows
8. If using a gas stove-top or grill: prepare graham crackers near the stove top , place a marshmallow on a fork turn on flame to highest setting and let the marshmallow brown , being careful not to let it catch fire
9. Place the browned marshmallow on 1 / 2 graham cracker and place reese's cup on top , with the other 1 / 2 of graham
10. Lightly push down on to flatten the marshmallow

title: basic vegan pancakes for one
steps:
1. Combine flour , baking soda , salt , sugar , and spices in a bowl
2. Add soymilk to flour mixture and mix just until well combined , make sure there aren't any really big clumps , small ones are fine
3. Using a skillet sprayed with cooking spray , and heated over low heat , pour about 1 / 4 cup mixture of batter , less for smaller pancakes , more for larger
4. If using fruit , gently press it inches cook until bubbles appear and pop on surface and undersides are golden brown , about 3-4 minutes
5. Flip the pancake , and turn heat off if using fruit , and let pancakes continue to cook until undersides are firm and light golden brown , about 3 minutes
6. Transfer to a plate lined with paper towels , fruit side up , and place in your oven or microwave to keep warm
7. Respray pan and repeat to cook remaining , remember to always respray between each batch or pancakes will stick

title: toasty cheese ravioli
steps:
1. Slightly under-cook ravioli in boiling water and drain
2. In a large skillet , heat butter and let brown slightly
3. Add ravioli
4. Saute until brown
5. Mix breadcrumbs with rosemary and add to skillet to coat ravioli
6. Serve with favorite dipping sauce

title: ed s favorite baked potato soup
steps:
1. Bake potatoes in 350 degree oven about 1 hour
2. You may need to add more milk , to keep the soup from being too stiff
3. While potatoes are baking , fry bacon till crisp
4. Crumble bacon
5. Set aside on paper towel for garnish
6. Remove potatoes from oven
7. Cool to handling temperature
8. Remove skins
9. Cut 3 potatoes into large chunks
10. Mash two of the potatoes
11. Place all the potatoes in a large saucepan
12. Add butter , milk , sour cream , salt and pepper
13. Heat , stirring , till heated through
14. Ladle into bowls
15. Garnish with chopped green onions , crumbled bacon , and shredded cheddar cheese

title: pinwheel sausage rolls
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 200 degrees celsius cover 2 oven trays with baking paper
2. Grate onion and apple together , put in large bowl with all other ingredients
3. Mix with hands until well combined
4. Divide meat mix evenly between pastry sheets
5. Press down with hands until each sheet is evenly covered
6. Roll up from any side to make a long sauage shape
7. Cut each into 12
8. Place each pinwheel upright , with the loose end of pastry up , on baking trays - at least 3cms apart
9. Bake 20mins or until puffed and golden brown
10. Serve with tomato sauce or chutney

title: lurline s pear honey
steps:
1. Peel pears and run through a food chopper using the medium blade
2. Add to sugar and salt
3. Add crushed pineapple and juice and bring to a boil for 5 minutes
4. Add the fruit fresh and cook on medium
5. Boil for 20 minutes
6. Makes 8 pints

title: steak gorgonzola  la olive garden
steps:
1. Marinated steak preparation
2. Cut beef into 1 / 2" cubes and set aside
3. Mix the italian dressing , rosemary and lemon juice , if using , together
4. Add the marinade to the beef toss and let marinate for at least 1 hour
5. Spinach gorgonzola sauce:
6. Heat alfredo sauce in large saut pan
7. Add onion , spinach and gorgonzola cheese
8. To put the dish together:
9. Grill steak to desired doneness
10. Place drained pasta in saut pan with heated alfredo sauce
11. Toss pasta with sauce and place on a large platter
12. Place grilled beef on pasta and sauce
13. Drizzle with balsamic glaze
14. Sprinkle remaining gorgonzola cheese , sun dried tomatoes and parsley leaves
15. Enjoy with a nice tomato salad and a nice glass of wine !

title: herbed pan roast of salmon with warm greens and herb vinaigrette
steps:
1. Prepare emerils herb vinaigrette and set aside
2. Preheat the oven to 400
3. Sprinkle the salmon fillets on both sides with the salt and pepper
4. Spread the mustard on both sides of the salmon , dredge them in the herb mixture and pat the herbs into the fillets with your hand
5. Heat a large ovenproof skillet over high heat until very hot
6. Place the salmon in the skillet and sear them on the first side , for about 1 1 / 2 minutes flip the fillets over and remove skillet from heat
7. Add the water carefully around the salmon and place the skillet in the oven and bake for about 6 minutes
8. While the salmon is baking prepare the warm greens
9. To serve , place one serving of the greens on each plate , top with a salmon fillet , and spoon 1 / 4 cup of the vinaigrette over

title: 4 inch strawberry chocolate cheesecake
steps:
1. Crust: mix cookies and butter until crumbs are moistened and press into bottom of a 4 inch springform pan
2. Filling: combine cream cheese , 2 1 / 2 t sugar , and cornstarch
3. Beat until smooth
4. Beat in melted egg substitute and vanilla
5. Beat well after each addition
6. Remove 1 / 3 of the mixture , stir cocoa and 1 / 2 t sugar
7. Set aside
8. Stir strawberry schnapps into remaining cream cheese mixture
9. Fold in sliced strawberries
10. Pour half the strawberry mixture over crust , then top with half of chocolate mixture , layer remaining strawberry then chocolate mixtures
11. Without disturbing the crust , swirl the blade of a knife through the cake to create a marbling effect
12. Bake at 325f for 10 minutes
13. Reduce heat to 225 and bake for an additional 40-50 minutes or until the center no longer looks wet or shiny
14. Remove cake from oven and run a knife around the inside edge of the pan
15. Turn the oven off and return the cake to the oven for an additional 20 minutes
16. Chill , uncovered , overnight
17. Top with canned whipped topping and chocolate covered strawberry

title: simply exquisite cocktail
steps: 1. Pour ingredients into a stainless shaker over ice , shake until completely cold then strain into a chilled stemmed glass

title: my stuffed chicken breasts
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Combine stuffing , butter , parmesan cheese , parsley , basil and rosemary
3. Butterfly chicken breasts and lie flat on cutting board
4. Take slice of ham , spoonful of stuffing mixture and slice of cheese
5. Wrap breast around and place seam-side down in 9 inch glass baking dish
6. Repeat with other breast and cover dish with foil to prevent burning
7. Bake for 45 minutes to 1 hour , or until chicken is no longer pink
8. You can make a sauce with this or serve it alone

title: moosewood restaurant s fat free carrot cake
steps:
1. Combine carrots , sugar , water , raisins and vanilla in a saucepan
2. Simmer for 5 minutes , then remove from heat and let stand for at least 1 hour , preferably about 4 or 5
3. Stir together the remaining ingredients in a bowl
4. Make a well in the centre , add the carrot mixture and stir until just mixed
5. Spoon mixture into 2 x 12 piece muffin tins sprayed with oil
6. Bake at 180 degrees ceclius for about 10-15 minutes , or until a skewer inserted comes out clean
7. Do not overbake

title: strawberry freezer jam
steps:
1. Wash and rinse containers
2. Prepare the berries crushing one cup at a time using a potato masher
3. Measure exact amount of berries and juice and place in a large bowl
4. Measure the exact amount of sugar and stir into the prepared fruit
5. Mix well and let stand for 10 minutes stirring occasionally
6. While waiting , in a small bowl , stir the certo fruit pectin into the lemon juice
7. After the 10 minutes has gone by with the berries , stir the pectin mixture into the prepared fruit
8. Stir constantly until sugar is completely dissolved and no longer grainy--about 4 minutes
9. Pour into prepared containers , leaving a 1 / 2" space at the top for expansion during the freezing
10. Cover
11. Let stand at room temperature for 24 hours till set
12. You may store in the refrigerator for about 3 weeks or store in the freezer for up to one year
13. Thaw in the refrigerator

title: creole bread
steps:
1. Mix together the warm water , yeast , 2 teaspoons of sugar , and 2 tablespoons of flour in a small bowl and set aside for 10 minutes
2. Warm milk , oil , 2 tablespoons of sugar , and salt in the microwave for about 20 seconds-stir together and set aside
3. Don't let the mixture boil , you just want to heat it up a bit
4. Sift 5 cups of flour into a large bowl
5. Once the milk mixture has cooled enough that you can comfortably stick a finger in it , mix it into the yeast
6. Add all wet ingredients to the flour
7. Mix with a wooden spoon until a dough forms
8. If sticky , add flour until you have a dough that you can knead
9. Dust your counter with flour and knead the dough until smooth , about 5-8 minutes
10. If the dough becomes sticky as you knead just sprinkle with flour as required
11. You may have to add up to a cup of flour at this stage depending on the humidity of your kitchen
12. Put in greased bowl , cover with a damp cloth and let rise until double in size
13. Punch down and knead for two or three minutes
14. Make into two large or six small round balls
15. Place on a greased pan-let rise again , bake at 400 f / 205 c for 30-35 minutes until the tops brown and the bottom of a loaf , when tapped , sounds hollow

title: black bean and cream cheese enchiladas
steps:
1. Rinse and pick through beans , soak overnight
2. Drain beans and add enough clean water to cover the beans
3. Add onions , garlic , oregano , cumin , bay leaves , salt , and pepper
4. Cover and bring to boil , reduce heat and simmer until beans are tender
5. Remember to stir occasionally adding liquid only if absolutely necessary
6. The beans should be a bit saucy and tender , but should retain their shape
7. Discard the bay leaves
8. Mash about 1 / 4 of the beans against the sides of the pot and stir to blend them inches set aside to cool while making the sauce
9. Heat olive oil and saute the onions and garlic until the onions are translucent and the garlic is fragrant
10. Add the tomatoes with the juice , paste , water , chilies , and jalapeno
11. Stir to blend
12. Cook until the sauce has thickened
13. Preheat oven to 350f spoon a thin layer of sauce into the bottom of a large baking dish
14. Spoon a line of beans down the center of each tortilla and add some of the cream cheese chunks on top of the beans
15. Roll the tortilla and place it seam side down in the baking dish
16. Spread the remaining sauce over the tortillas , sprinkle on the grated cheese
17. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes until bubbly
18. If desired , garnish with sliced green onions
19. Serve with a green salad
20. Beans and sauce can be prepared the evening before and refrigerated
21. The tortillas may be assembled up to 2 hours before baking and refrigerated , add about 5-10 minutes to the baking time as needed

title: wild rice citrus salad
steps:
1. Make the rice according to package directions but omit butter or oil
2. Cool
3. Add celery , green onions , grapes , oranges and pecan halvs
4. Refrigerate several hours
5. About 1 hour before serving add dressing
6. To make dressing: shake orange marmalade and raspberry vinegar in a shaker jar and shake

title: easter egg nests
steps:
1. Melt chocolate with oil
2. Pour over chow mein noodles and mix well
3. With a large cookie scoop drop onto a wax paper lined cookie sheet and make a depression to shape into 2 1 / 2" to 3" nests
4. Let cool until chocolate it's firm
5. Top each nest with 4 jelly bellys

title: seminole garnet barbecue sauce
steps:
1. In a large skillet over medium heat , combine the onion , garlic and whiskey and saute for 10 minutes , or until onion is translucent
2. Add the ground black pepper , salt , ketchup , tomato paste , vinegar , liquid smoke , worcestershire sauce , brown sugar and hot pepper sauce
3. Mix well and bring to a boil
4. Reduce heat to medium low and simmer for 20 minutes
5. Run sauce through a strainer if you prefer a smooth sauce

title: vietnamese seafood volcano soup
steps:
1. Heat oil in a wok
2. Lightly brown garlic and shallots
3. Add chili sauce , tomato sauce , chopped tomato , fish sauce and sugar
4. Blend well , then simmer for 2-3 minutes
5. Add stock with tamarind juice or lime juice
6. Bring to a boil
7. Add seafood and wine to stock
8. Bring back to boil
9. Cover and simmer for 3-4 minutes until mussel shells have opened
10. Discard any that remain closed after cooking
11. Taste soup and adjust seasoning to your liking with salt & pepper
12. Garnish with cilantro leaves and serve hot

title: georgia french toast
steps:
1. In a saucepan , bring brown sugar , butter and water to a boil
2. Reduce heat
3. Simmer for 10 minutes , stirring frequently
4. Pour into a greased 13-in
5. 9-in
6. 2-in
7. Baking dish
8. Top with peahes
9. Arange bread over peaches
10. In a bowl , whisk the eggs , milk and vanilla
11. Slowly pour over bread
12. Cover and refrigerate for 8 hours or overnight
13. Remove from the refrigerator 30 minutes before baking
14. Sprinkle with cinnamon
15. Cover and bake at 350 degrees for 20 minutes
16. Uncover
17. Bake 25-30 minutes longer or until the bread is golden brown
18. Serve with a spoon

title: ritz poppy seed chicken
steps:
1. Brown cubed chicken with onions
2. Add soup , sour cream , and poppy seeds till well blended
3. Mix cracker crumbs and butter together
4. Place 1 / 2 crumbs in bottom of 9 by 13 pan
5. Pour chicken over top , and sprinkle top with remaining crumb mixture
6. Bake 350 for 30-40 minutes

title: knock your socks off chocolate sauce
steps:
1. Mix the sugar and cocoa in a small saucepan until well blended
2. Over medium heat , slowly add the water and mix well
3. Simmer for five minutes
4. Remove from heat and add butter
5. Mix well until butter has completely melted and is incorporated in the chocolate sauce
6. Cool
7. Whisk eggs in a small bowl
8. Slowly add eggs to the chocolate sauce and mix well
9. Return to heat until very hot , but not boiling
10. Remove from heat and add vanilla and imitation butter extract
11. Stir well
12. Can be refrigerated in a sealed container for up to seven days

title: baked chicken legs  mexican style
steps:
1. In a shallow bowl , beat eggs , salsa , and salt until blended
2. In another shallow bowl , combine bread crumbs , chili powder , cumin , garlic salt and oregano
3. Dip chicken into egg mixture and roll in crumb mixture
4. Repeat both steps 1 more time
5. In a shallow rimmed baking pan , melt butter as oven preheats to 400
6. Remove pan from oven
7. Add chicken , turn to coat with butter and arrange skin side up
8. Bake , uncovered , until meat near thighbone is no longer pink when slashed
9. Transfer chicken to a warm platter
10. Insulate to transport hot

title: black   white swirl cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400c
2. Beat eggs and sugar until light and creamy
3. Add oil and juice
4. Briskly stir in flour mixed with baking powder
5. Pour half of the batter into a 9-inch bundt pan
6. Stir cocoa into the remaining batter and pour into pan
7. Gently fold the batter in the pan a few times without mixing it
8. Bake cake in the oven for 50-60 minutes , let cool , and serve dusted with powdered sugar

title: lahori  chargha
steps:
1. Grind all of the ingredients and marinate chicken in them
2. Refrigerate for 2 to 3 hours
3. In a pan of water cook marinated chicken until tender and until all of the water dries up
4. Then add some oil in it and fry it
5. Serve hot with nan , raita , and salad

title: baked sweet and savory mashed potatoes
steps:
1. Bring potatoes , 1 teaspoon salt and water to to cover to a boil in a dutch oven
2. Cook 30 minutes or until tender
3. Drain
4. Return potatoes to dutch oven
5. Add sweet potatoes and cream cheese
6. Mash untl smooth with a potato masher
7. Stir in bacon , next 3 ingredients and remaining 2 teaspoons salt
8. Spoon mixture into a lightly greased 11-x7-inch baking dish
9. Bake , uncovered , at 350f for 20 minutes
10. Garnish with crumbled bacon , if desired

title: best steak marinade
steps:
1. Place the soy sauce , olive oil , lemon juice , worcestershire sauce , garlic powder , basil , parsley , and pepper in a blender
2. Add hot pepper sauce and garlic , if desired
3. Blend on high speed for 30 seconds until thoroughly mixed
4. Pour marinade over desired type of meat
5. Cover , and refrigerate for up to 8 hours
6. Cook meat as desired

title: the best chili ever
steps:
1. Brown ground beef and drain
2. Combine all ingredients in a large pot and simmer for 2-3 hours
3. You can also put all ingredients in crock pot and simmer on low for up to 9 hours

title: polenta pizza with brie and red grapes
steps:
1. Combine yeast with 1 / 4 cup warm water in medium mixing bowl and allow to set for 10 minutes
2. Stir in remaining water , olive oil , and salt
3. Then mix in flour and polenta
4. Turn out the soft dough onto a floured work surface and knead for 7 minutes
5. Place the dough in a large , oiled bowl , cover , and let rise in a warm place until doubled in size , about 1 1 / 2 hours
6. Punch down , pat , or roll into a 10-inch circle , place on a pizza paddle , cover , and let rise for 1 hour
7. Preheat oven with baking stone to 450f
8. Brush dough with melted butter and layer brie slices over the top
9. Scatter the grapes and walnuts over the brie , and then sprinkle the sugar over all
10. Transfer pizza to a baking stone and bake in preheated oven for 12 to 15 minutes , until the edges of the crust just begin to turn golden
11. Remove from oven
12. Allow to cool for 5 minutes
13. Cut into 8 slices and serve immediately

title: pork chops with pear sauce
steps:
1. Heat 1 teaspoon of the oil in a small saucepan over medium heat
2. Add pears , 1 / 2 teaspoon of the cinnamon , and nutmeg
3. Cook , stirring frequently and mashing the pears with a spoon , until thick and pears are tender , about 4 minutes
4. Remove pan from heat
5. Stir in lemon zest and vanilla
6. Set aside
7. Combine remaining 1 / 4 teaspoon cinnamon , salt , paprika and pepper in a bowl
8. Rub mixture over pork
9. Heat remaining 1 teaspoon oil in a medium nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
10. Add pork and cook until well browned and cooked through , about 4 minutes on each side
11. Serve with sauce

title: swordfish in spanish sofrito sauce
steps:
1. Wash fish and pat dry with a paper towel
2. Heat oil in a medium-size nonstick skillet on medium-high heat and add fish
3. Brown for 2 minutes
4. Turn and brown second side 2 minutes
5. Salt and pepper to taste
6. Lower heat to medium , add sofrito , cover and simmer 5 minutes for 1" thick fish
7. Simmer 3 to 4 minutes for 3 / 4" thick fish

title: pao de lo
steps:
1. Have a tube cake pan greased and floured
2. Preheat oven 375
3. First beat your egg-whites till very stiff , and set aside
4. Now beat your egg-yolks along with the sugar till very very creamy
5. This takes about 10 minutes beating so it'll be very very creamy
6. Add in your lemon grind and beat 1 more minute
7. Now gently fold in 1 tablespoon of meringue at a time and then 1 tablespoon of flour , repeat this procedure till done , always folding in your ingredients
8. This is very important to do this so your cake will not fall
9. Now carefully pour the cake batter into greased floured pan and bake till it's a golden yellow coulor
10. About 45-55 all depending on the ovens

title: chocolate peppermint scones
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine the first six ingredients
2. Cut in butter until mixture resembles coarse crumbs
3. In a small bowl , whisk the yogurt , buttermilk , egg and extract
4. Add to crumb mixture just until moistened
5. Stir in chocolate chips
6. Turn onto a floured surface
7. Knead 10 times
8. Divide dough in half
9. Transfer each portion to a greased baking sheet
10. Pat into a 6-in
11. Circle
12. Cut into six wedges , but do not separate
13. Sprinkle with sugar
14. Bake at 400 for 18-20 minutes or until puffed and tops are cracked
15. Remove to wire racks
16. Cool slightly
17. Drizzle with melted chocolate and sprinkle with peppermint candies
18. Serve warm

title: bev s banana daiquiris   pina coladas
steps:
1. Combine first 4 ingredients in blender and fill remainder of blender to the top with vanilla ice cream
2. Blend well
3. For pina coladas: omit banana liqueur and substitute 1 / 2 cup crushed pineapple

title: voodoo
steps: 1. Pour ingredients over ice and stir

title: salade de carottes rapes
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , whisk together the mustard , olive oil , salt and pepper
2. Add the shredded carrots , and mix until coated
3. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours before serving

title: indian tofu and spinach over almond rice
steps:
1. Prepare the rice according to the package directions
2. Preheat a large , deep nonstick skillet over medium-high heat with the vegetable oil
3. Add the tofu , season with salt and pepper , and lightly brown , 2 to 3 minutes per side
4. Remove the tofu from the skillet and reserve on a plate
5. To the same skillet , add the garlic , ginger , onions , cumin and coriander
6. Saut together for 4 to 5 minutes or until the onions are tender
7. Add the spinach and continue to cook for 2 minutes
8. Add the flour and cook for 1 minute
9. Add the vegetable stock and bring to a bubble
10. Add the curry paste , mango chutney , and chick peas , then return the browned tofu to the skillet , reduce the heat to medium low , and simmer the curry for 8 to 10 minutes
11. While the curry is simmering , toast the almonds in a small dry skillet over medium heat until golden
12. Once the rice is cooked , fluff it with a fork , add the toasted almonds , and stir with the fork
13. Serve the curry in shallow bowls with a scoop of almond rice on top

title: fresh peach tarts
steps:
1. Combine peaches , sugar , and lemon juice in bowl
2. Mix well
3. Let stand for 20 minutes
4. Drain , reserving juice then add enough water to reserved juice to measure 1 cup
5. Pour juice into saucepan
6. Stir in cornstarch and cinnamon gradually
7. Cook until transparent , stirring constantly
8. Cool
9. Spoon peaches into tart shells
10. Pour glaze over peaches
11. Chill until glaze sets
12. Garnish with whipping cream if desired

title: crock pot sweet potatoes   cranberries with toasted pecans
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients , except pecans
2. Toast pecans in the oven or dry skillet , set aside
3. Careful not to burn !
4. Cook for 6 - 8 hours , until the yams are tender
5. I stir to combine every hour or so
6. About 1-2 hours before serving , if the mixture is too wet , prop the lid open a bit with a toothpick to let some of the steam out and thicken up the sauce
7. Put in your favorite serving dish and top with pecans for serving

title: spaghetti with eggplant and goat cheese
steps:
1. In a big saucepan , heat 1 tablespoon olive oil at medium heat
2. Add garlic and cook for about 3 minutes or until golden
3. Add tomatoes , 1 / 2 teaspoon of salt , pepper and 1 big basil leaf
4. Bring to boil
5. Reduce heat and let simmer for about 45 minutes or until sauce has thicken
6. Meanwhile , chop remaining basil
7. Set aside
8. Put eggplants in a strainer , sprinkle with remaining salt and stir to coat well
9. Leave to drain in the sink for about 20 minutes
10. Spronge up with paper towell
11. In a skillet , heat remaining oil at medium-high heat
12. Add eggplants , in many batches , and cook for about 4 minutes or until golden
13. Let drain eggplants in a plate with paper towell
14. Meanwhile , in a big saucepan with boiling salted water , cook pasta 8 to 10 minutes or until al dente
15. Drain pasta and put back in the saucepan
16. Add tomato sauce and half eggplants and the basil you set aside
17. Stir to coat well
18. When ready to serve , sprinkle with goat cheese and remaining eggplants and basil and stir

title: chinese barbecued spareribs
steps:
1. Cut the spareribs into individual ribs and arrange them onto a rack in a baking pan
2. Roast for 45 minutes at 300f
3. Combine the remaining ingredients into a sauce
4. Brush the spareribs lightly with the sauce
5. Roast for 30 minutes more
6. Turn the spareribs and brush with more sauce
7. Roast until the ribs are well browned , approximately 30 minutes
8. Serve and enjoy !

title: german chocolate martini
steps:
1. Combine godiva original liqueur , captain morgan parrot bay coconut rum , and smirnoff black cherry vodka
2. Shake with ice and strain into martini glass
3. Garnish with chocolate shavings

title: ceci ragu
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients except salt and pepper in a large saucepan
2. Bring to a simmer , stirring occasionally
3. Reduce ragu to desired consistence
4. Season with salt and pepper to taste
5. Serve with brown rice or pasta

title: ricotta pound cake
steps:
1. 350f
2. Place oven rack in the center position
3. Grease and flour a 9-inch loaf pan
4. Sift flour , baking powder and salt into a mixing bowl
5. In a large stand mixer bowl , cream together the butter , ricotta , and sugar , then adding eggs , one at a time , allowing each to incorporate before adding the next
6. Add vanilla
7. Set mixer speed to low , and gradually add the dry ingredients
8. Once added , allow the batter to mix for 30 seconds or so
9. Pour the batter into the prepared loaf pan , smoothing the batter
10. Bake the cake on the center rack for 15 minutes , then lower heat to 325f and bake about 25-60 minutes more , or until cake springs back from touch and has slightly pulled away from pan sides , and a toothpick comes out clean
11. Cool the cake inside the loaf pan for 15 minutes before removing
12. Allow the cake to finish cooling outside the pan from then on

title: osso buco milanese
steps:
1. Combine flour , salt and pepper in a plastic bag
2. Add veal shanks and coat with flour mixture
3. Heat oil in a large skillet and brown veal on both sides
4. Remove veal from skillet , reduce heat and add butter , carrots , onion , celery , garlic , bay leaves , marjoram , basil , parsley and lemon rind
5. Saute for 5 minutes
6. Add wine and continue cooking for 5 minute more
7. Stir in tomatoes and broth
8. Place veal in a casserole with the sauce and bake , covered , at 325 for 2 hours
9. Garnish with gremolata

title: christmas spaghetti pie
steps:
1. Brown and drain the ground beef and sausage
2. Saute onion until tender and add the tomatoes , tomato paste , sugar , oregano and garlic salt
3. Combine the meat mixture and the tomato mixture , set aside
4. Cook spaghetti and combine with butter , parmesan cheese and eggs
5. Press mix into a 10 inch buttered pie plate making sure it goes up the sides of the plate making a sort of "pie crust"
6. Spread ricotta cheese over the spaghetti and fill with the meat mixture
7. Bake uncovered at 350 degrees for 20-25 minutes
8. Sprinkle with mozzerella and bake an additional 15 minutes

title: sunflower seed coleslaw
steps:
1. In large bowl , combine slaw mix and onion
2. In small bowl , mix sour cream , mayonnaise , tarragon , vinegar , and sugar
3. Add salt and pepper
4. Add dressing to cabbage mixture and toss to coat
5. Add sunflower seeds and toss again
6. Cover and refrigerate at least 1 hour for flavors to blend
7. Serve chilled or at room temperature
8. ~maybe made up to 1 day ahead

title: feel better chicken noodle soup
steps:
1. Place broth , chicken , carrots , zucchini , and celery in a pot and bring to a boil over medium heat
2. Simmer for about 5 minutes , until the veggies begin to soften
3. Add noodles and cook for an additional 10 minutes
4. Ladle into a large mug and serve with saltine crackers
5. Feel better !

title: tomato thyme roasted squash or zucchini with fennel
steps:
1. Heat oven to 450 degrees fahrenheit
2. In large bowl , combine zucchini , fennel , garlic and olive oil
3. Season with salt and pepper , if desired
4. Arrange vegetables in single layer on 2 foil-lined baking sheets
5. Top with thyme sprigs
6. Roast 12 minutes , or until vegetables are tender , adding chopped tomatoes during last 2 minutes
7. Arrange vegetables on serving platter

title: zebra bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Butter a 13 x 9-inch baking pan
3. Melt 1 cup of the chocolate chips in a small saucepan over low heat , let cool slightly- set aside
4. Sift together the flour and baking powder and set aside
5. In a large bowl , beat the butter and the brown sugar until light and fluffy
6. Beat in the eggs , one at a time , beating thoroughly after each addition
7. Add in the vanilla
8. Stir in the sifted dry ingredients until blended
9. Transfer half of the mixture to another bowl
10. Stir melted chocolate into one portion until blended
11. Spread chocolate batter in the prepared pan
12. Drop remaining batter by tablespoonfuls onto the chocolate batter
13. Spread carefully into an even layer
14. Sprinkle with remaining 1 / 2 cup chocolate chips and the walnuts
15. Bake on the center rack for 30 minutes , or until the edges begin to pull from the sides of the pan
16. Cool in the pan on a wire rack before cutting into bars

title: yummy dill dip
steps:
1. In small mixing bowl , combine cream cheese , mayonnaise , sour cream , dill weed , onion and beau monde seasoning
2. Blend well
3. Cover and refrigerate overnight before serving

title: allison s creamy veggie pasta salad
steps:
1. Cook pasta as directed on box
2. Combine other ingredients except for vegetables and cheese in a separate bowl
3. When pasta is done , combine mixture with pasta
4. Toss in cheese and vegetables
5. Chill for at least 3 hours

title: no crust broccoli quiche
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. In a medium bowl , combine broccoli , eggs , milk and spices
3. Spray a shallow 2 quart casserole with nonstick cooking spray
4. Pour egg mixture into casserole and sprinkle with swiss cheese
5. Bake 35 minutes , or until a knife , inserted in the center , comes out clean
6. In a small bowl combine mayonnaise and parmesan cheese
7. Spread over the quiche and return to the oven
8. Bake until lightly browned , about 5 minutes
9. Remove from oven and allow to set for 10-15 minutes

title: root beer
steps:
1. In a 5 gallon container , pour extract
2. Add water and sugar and stir until sugar is completely dissolved
3. Add dry ice and allow to bubble for about 1 hour before drinking
4. This gives the drink the "fizz" factor
5. Drink !

title: easiest campfire  or grill or oven  breakfast
steps:
1. Scrub potato and rub skin with either butter or oil
2. Wrap in foil and place in hot coals for about 1 hour ,
3. When baked remove from heat and upwrap from foil but do not remove from foil
4. Slice open potato in a cross fashion but do not slice all the way through
5. Open the potato pressing slightly so that the flesh come out
6. With a spoon make a slight hole in the center building up the flesh on the sides
7. Place the butter in the hole
8. Break the egg into the potato
9. Sprinkle with the cheese and bacon
10. Rewrap the in the foil
11. Return to heat , egg side up
12. Bake until egg is set about 5-10 minutes
13. Unwrap season with salt and pepper
14. Serve immediately

title: cheesy appetizers
steps:
1. Mix all together except bread
2. Spread mixture on each slice of bread
3. Set broiler at 550
4. Broil at least 4-5 inches from heat for about 1-2 minutes
5. These are yummy !

title: an american quilt chopped salad
steps:
1. Dressing: place all ingredients into blender and blend until well mixed
2. There will be little pieces of onion
3. Pour into samll saucepan and heat gently ,
4. Stirring
5. Do not boil
6. Let cool and then chill
7. You should have about 3 / 4 cup dressing
8. In serving bowl combine all vegetables
9. Chill
10. Just before serving , add 1 / 4 cup dressing and toss to combine
11. Taste and add more dressing if you like
12. Arrange each portion of salad on a lettuce leaf or red cabbage leaf

title: sweet potato pecan pie ii
steps:
1. Place crust in lightly greased pie tin
2. Filling: whis k together 1 cup of sweet potatoes and 1 tbsp
3. Butter
4. In a large bowl beat two eggs until well mixed
5. Add the sweet potatoes to the eggs
6. In a separate bowl , mix together the evaporated milk , brown sugar , corn syrup , vanilla , ginger , cinnamon , nutmeg , and salt , then add to the sweet potato mixture and mix well
7. Pour this combined mixture into the pie crust
8. Sprinkle 1 cup chopped pecans evenly over the top
9. Bake at 375 degrees for 35-45 minutes
10. Let pie cool
11. To make topping: whip cream until soft peaks form , then add confectioners' sugar and continue to whip until stiff peaks form
12. Use pastry tube with star

title: mexican flaming cheese
steps:
1. Brown the ground beef and drain
2. Add remaining ingredients and cook until cheese is melted
3. Pour into a casserole dish and bake at 400 degrees for 15 minutes
4. Serve with flour tortillas

title: chicken rollatini
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees f
2. Pound chicken breasts flat
3. Sprinkle parmesan cheese on both sides
4. Place a pinch of minced garlic and 1 teaspoon butter in the center of each breast
5. Cover each breast with a layer of prosciutto and mozzarella cheese
6. Roll up each chicken breast , and secure with toothpicks
7. In a 9x13 inch baking dish , combine white wine and olive oil
8. Arrange chicken rolls in dish
9. Place a small piece of prosciutto on top of each roll , and sprinkle with pepper
10. Bake in preheated oven for 30 minutes , or until chicken is no longer pink , an juices run clear

title: make your own frozen french fries
steps:
1. Peel the potatoes and soak them in water
2. Cut them into 1 centimeter thick slices and further cut them into finger sized pieces
3. Take a pan and pour sufficient water for boiling
4. Then put the potato pieces in the water and add salt
5. Boil till it is half done
6. Drain and cool them
7. Then put the pieces into a zip-lock bag and seal tightly removing excess air
8. Store them in a deep freezer
9. Whenever you need them , remove from freezer and deep fry directly in medium hot oil till they turn crispy and golden
10. Add salt only after removing from hot oil
11. Serve hot

title: fettuccine and sweet italian sausage alfredo
steps:
1. Prepare pasta according to package directions
2. Brown sausage in large skillet over medium heat
3. Drain
4. Return to skillet
5. Add pasta and sauce
6. Heat through
7. Top with cheese

title: ranch style brunch eggs
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees
2. Butter 4 individual 1-cup shallow baking dishes or one medium-size baking dish
3. Cook bacon in a large frypan , until crisp
4. Drain
5. Reserve about 3-4 tablespoons bacon drippings
6. Fry hash brown potatoes in the bacon drippings until browned , about 10 minutes
7. Divide potatoes evenly in the bottom of the prepared baking dishes or dish
8. Sprinkle with cheese , then with bacon
9. In a bowl , beat together eggs , baking powder , milk and green onions
10. Pour evenly into dishes
11. Bake uncovered for about 20-25 minutes , or until set
12. Delicious !

title: low fat jell o parfaits
steps:
1. Mix both packages of jell-o with the boiling water and stir till jell-o is disolved
2. Add cold water and stir
3. Refrigerate about 4 hours or until jell-o is firm
4. Put half of the jell-o into mixing bowl and add 1 container of yogurt
5. Set mixer on a medium -low setting and blend until blended but not creamy
6. Put about 2 teaspoons gramham cracker crumbs in the bottom of 6 half pint canning jars
7. Followed by about 2 tablespoons jell-o mixture
8. Follow with about 2 teaspoons graham cracker crumbs
9. Followed by about 2 tablespoons plain jell-o
10. Next 2 tablespoons of vanilla yogurt
11. Repeat layers until all ingreditents are gone
12. Wipe rims , add lids and refrigerate
13. Really i don't think the order matters
14. Just put graham crackers between each layer

title: blueberry almond tea bread
steps:
1. Combine almond paste and butter in a large mixing bowl
2. Beat until well blended
3. Gradually add sugar , beating until light and fluffy
4. Add eggs , one at a time , beating well after each addition
5. Combine flour , baking powder and salt
6. Add mixture to creamed mixture alternately with milk , beginning and ending with four mixture
7. Combine blueberries and 1 tablespoon flour , toss gently
8. Spoon one-third of batter into a greased and floured 9 x 5 x 3 loaf pan , and sprinkle with half of the dredged blueberries
9. Repeat layers once
10. Spoon remaining third of batter on top and smooth with a spatula
11. Bake at 350f for 1 hour and 20 minutes or until a wooden pick inserted in center comes out clean
12. Cool in pan for 10 minutes
13. Remove bread from pan and cool completely on a wire rack

title: snow balls  lamington copy
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350
2. Grease shallow muffin tray
3. Cream butter and sugar
4. Add vanilla
5. Add egg
6. Add flour and milk alternatively
7. Place in shallow muffin tray and bake 20-25 minutes until golden
8. Let cool
9. Mix icing sugar and cocoa and add enough water to make paste
10. Dip cakes completely in icing and cover in coconut

title: roasted  french fried   potatoes  low fat
steps:
1. Peel potatoes and cut into sticks as for french fries
2. In a large bowl , combine cornstarch , water , rosemary , garlic , salt and pepper
3. Stir until smooth
4. Add potatoes to cornstarch mixture and toss well
5. Arrange potatoes in single layer on a large baking sheet lined with parchment paper and brush with oil
6. Bake potatoes in preheated 425 oven for 15 minutes
7. Turn potatoes and continue to bake for 10 - 15 minutes longer , until brown , crisp and cooked through

title: apple whole wheat muffins  king arthur flour
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 375f grease and flour a 12-cup muffin tin , or line with papers and grease the insides of the papers
2. Mix together the flours , baking powder , baking soda , salt , and cinnamon , and set aside
3. In a separate bowl , cream the butter and add the granulated sugar and 1 / 4 cup of the brown sugar beat until fluffy
4. Add the egg and mix well
5. Stop once to scrape the sides and bottom of the bowl
6. Mix in the buttermilk gently
7. Stir in the dry ingredients and fold in the apple chunks
8. Divide the batter evenly among the prepared muffin cups , sprinkling the remaining 1 / 2 cup brown sugar on top
9. Bake for 25 to 30 minutes , or until a toothpick inserted into the center of a muffin comes out clean
10. Remove from the oven , cool the muffins for 5 minutes in the tin , then turn them out onto a rack to finish cooling completely

title: too simple berry crisp
steps:
1. Mix berries , flour and sugar
2. Scoop into 6 individual baking dishes , i used coffee cups
3. Then place on a big baking dish
4. Sprinkle with granola
5. Bake at 350 degrees for 45 minute
6. Serve warm or room temperature by itself or top with frozen or fresh yogurt !

title: chicken tajine with preserved lemon and olives
steps:
1. Chermoula marinade: in a small bowl add saffron threads in water and allow to soak for a few minutes
2. In a food processor add all the 'chermoula marinade' ingredients and combine until it forms a paste
3. Cover and allow 'chermoula marinade' to stand for 30 minutes before using
4. Wash and dry the chicken , then rub all over with half of the chermoula marinade and refrigerate overnight or for at least two hours
5. After marinating , cut tomato and onion into thin wedges and combine a little more chermoula marinade
6. Then spread the tomato and onion into the base of the tajine
7. Place the chicken pieces on top of tomato and onion mixture arranging them in the centre of the tajine
8. Coat potato wedges with the chermoula marinade and arrange the potatoes around chicken
9. Top the chicken with onion slices , then tomato slices and olives in between the potato wedges
10. Mix chopped coriander / cilantro with remaining chermoula marinade and water
11. Pour mixture on top of tomatoes and onions
12. Top with preserved lemon wedges then cover tajine with lid
13. Cook on a very low gas heat for 45 minutes
14. Do not stir or lift the lid during the cooking process
15. Serve with suggested couscous

title: barbara s ultimate 7 layer mexican dip
steps:
1. Layer each ingedient on top of one another in a 9
2. 5 inch casserole dish
3. Start by taking the cream cheese and spreading it along the whole bottom of your dish to create a layer
4. Next spread the layer of refried beans
5. Then spread your guacamole
6. Then spread your salsa
7. Sprinkle the cheese over the top of it all
8. Place chopped tomatoes and olives a top the layers and cheese
9. Enjoy !

title: thick fruit whip
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a blender & process until smooth
2. Pour into glasses & serve

title: cinnamon nutty sauce for ice cream topping
steps:
1. In a small saucepan combine: sugar , water , cinnamon
2. Bring to boil , allow to boil for 5 minutes
3. Remove from heat and stir in nuts

title: the best baked cheesecake in the world  no seriously
steps:
1. Cheesecake:
2. Preheat oven to 150c
3. & prepare 9" round cake pan
4. Process malt biscuits & butter until finely crumbled & line base of pan
5. Using a cake mixer or blender beat cream cheese , condensed milk , lemon juice & egg until completely smooth
6. Pour into cake pan
7. Bake at 160c for approximately 35mins
8. The top should be just set , if it is browning too soon reduce heat , if it is splitting on top you should probably take it out !
9. Cool then refrigerate for no less than 3hrs - it's one of those things that tastes better with age --
10. Topping:
11. Place juice / water mixture in a saucepan & bring to the boil
12. Reduce heat & simmer for approximately 5minutes
13. Add cornflour mixture to slightly thicken
14. Mix in lemon juice then add berries & stir gently so as not to break up the berries too much
15. You can use this mixture now or continue to reduce down if you wish
16. The last time i made this it was quite jammy but it was just as devine as any other time so no worries if you think it's too sloppy !
17. When you have reached the required consistency pour topping over cheese cake & return to the refrigerator to continue to chill & set
18. I usually make this about an hour after the cheesecake has been in the fridge so it has plenty of time to soak through the slightly brownish bits !
19. If you manage to bake the perfect cream coloured cheesecake you could omit this topping or serve it separately for your adoring fans to pour over their dessert themselves --
20. I transport this cheesecake in the baking pan & only remove just prior to serving - it's much cleaner / easier that way & then someone else usually ends up getting stuck with cleaning the pan , mwah haha ha haaa !
21. Enjoy !
22. I also reduced the cooking temperature to 150c & it turned out perfectly
23. It was sooo delicious , light & fruity ! i really am the cheesecake master mmm --
