title: lime chicken al fresco
steps:
1. Combine the first 9 ingredients in medium bowl and whisk to blend
2. Place the chicken in a 13x9x2-inch glass baking dish
3. Pour the marinade over the chicken , cover and refrigerate overnight , turning occasionally
4. Fire up the grill !
5. Remove the chicken breasts from the marinade
6. Grill the chicken until just cooked through , turning occasionally , about 10 minutes
7. Place a cheese slice atop each chicken breast half
8. Cover the barbecue grill and cook until the cheese melts , about 2 minutes
9. Transfer the chicken to plates
10. Serve with your favourite chili sauce

title: creamy mushroom and broccoli  chicken  atkins friendly
steps:
1. Season chicken well with salt , pepper , paprika , oregano and basil
2. Brown and cook the chicken breasts in oil on both sides until juices run clear and chicken is cooked through
3. Place the cooked chicken in a serving dish with high sides
4. In the same skillet , saute the onions , garlic and fresh mushrooms until onions are soft
5. Add broccoli florets , cream and mustard and bring to a boil
6. Reduce heat to low , cover and simmer for 5-6 minutes or until broccoli is crisp-tender and cream sauce is thickened
7. Remove from heat and stir in 1 / 2 cup parmesan cheese
8. Pour the sauce over chicken in serving dish
9. Sprinkle with minced , fresh parsley

title: easy  tasty veal osso bucco
steps:
1. Put the veal and flour into a plastic bag , seal and then shake so that the veal is coated in flour
2. Heat the oil in a deep , heavy based pot
3. Add the veal and cook all sides so that the veal shanks are browned
4. Remove from the pot
5. If necessary , add a bit more oil to the pan
6. Add the onion and cook about 5 minutes until browned , add the garlic and cook and extra minute
7. Add the stock and wine to the pan
8. Cook until bubbling
9. Return the veal shanks to the pot , and also add the chopped tomatoes and bouquet garni
10. Add salt and pepper to taste
11. Reduce heat and cook for an hour or until meat is falling off the bones

title: vegetable quiche
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Slice sweet potato uniformly
3. Lightly grease both the bottom and sides of the quiche plate
4. Spread out the pieces of sweet potato in a single layer , making sure that as much of the baking plate is covered as possible and the pieces are touching one another
5. Mix milk and eggs in a bowl and whisk briskly for about 30 seconds
6. Using the oil gently saut the onions , garlic , broccoli and mushrooms for about 4-5 minutes
7. Season with salt & pepper
8. Transfer vegetables into prepared egg mixture and stir to coat the vegetables with eggs
9. Pour egg mixture over sweet potatoes and gently even it out with a spatula
10. Bake for 35 minutes
11. Then , turn the oven off and let the quiche sit in the oven for additional 10 minutes so the eggs can set

title: cod with caesar crust
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450f
2. Combine mayonnaise , parmesan cheese , lemon juice , salt , anchovy paste , and pepper in a small bowl
3. Combine bread crumbs and parsley on a sheet of wax paper
4. Spread one side of each cod fillet with mayonnaise mixture , then dip coated side into crumbs to coat
5. Place crumb side up on a jelly roll pan which has been sprayed with nonstick cooking spray
6. Bake 15 to 20 minutes or until fish is cooked through and bread crumbs begin to brown
7. Serve with lemon wedges

title: aunt pauline s fruit salad
steps:
1. Drain the juice from all the fruits
2. Discard , or use for something else
3. Put sour cream in bowl
4. Add remaining ingredients in the following order , stirring to blend after each ingredient is added - pineapple , marshmallows , nuts , mandarin oranges , cherries
5. Add coconut last

title: mexican wontons
steps:
1. Grease 24 miniature muffin cups lightly with oil
2. Press one wonton wrapper into each cup
3. Brush the wontons with oil
4. Bake at 375 degrees for 10 minutes , or until golden brown
5. Remove from muffin cups and arrange on a baking sheet
6. Brown the sausage in a skillet , stirring until crumbly , and then drain
7. Combine the sausage , cheddar cheese , monterey jack cheese , salad dressing , red pepper and olives in a bowl and mix well
8. Spoon one tablespoon into each wonton
9. Bake at 325 degrees for five minutes , or until bubbly

title: i m hooked cocktail
steps:
1. Pour first three ingredients in a highball glass filled with ice
2. Fill with orange juice stir well , and serve

title: walnut dreams   biscuits
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 150c / 300f
2. Cream butter and icing sugar until light and fluffy
3. Stir in vanilla essence , flour , nutmeg , salt and walnuts , to create a soft dough
4. Roll the dough into 2 cm balls
5. Place them about 3cm apart on a lightly greased baking tray , pressing each ball with the heel of your hand , to a thickness of about 1 cm
6. Bake , uncovered , for 20 minutes , or until the bottoms are golden brown
7. Cool on a wire rack

title: brian s spicy  kung pao tofu stir fry
steps:
1. Whisk together ingredients for sauce into a bowl and set aside
2. In wok , add oil and lightly fry cubed tofu for about 3 minutes , continually tossing
3. Set aside
4. Add carrots to wok and cook on med
5. High heat for 3 minutes
6. Add onion , scallions , garlic and ginger
7. Cook for about 2 minutes and then add remaining vegetables , water chestnuts , chilis
8. Continue cooking for additional 2 minutes until vegetables are soft
9. Add tofu back into stir fry
10. Pour sauce over to coat stir fry , may not need all sauce
11. Cook until sauce is reduced to desired consistency
12. Spoon stir fry over 1 cup of steamed rice and garnish with chopped cashews

title: christmas sugar cookies
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl , cream butter and sugar
2. Beat in the egg , sour cream , honey and vanilla
3. Combine the dry ingredients
4. Gradually add to creamed mixture
5. Cover and chill for 2 hours or 24 hours or until dough is easy to handle
6. On a lightly floured surface , roll out dough to 1 / 8-inch thickness
7. Cut with 3-inch cookie cutters dipped in flour
8. Place 1-in apart on ungreased cookie sheet
9. Bake at 325 for 8-10 minutes or until lightly browned
10. Remove to wire racks and cool
11. Melt candy coating
12. Stir in food colouring
13. Drizzle over cookies

title: butternut squash crunch
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f lightly grease a 2-quart baking dish and set aside
2. Combine squash , white sugar , milk , cinnamon , vanilla , salt , nutmeg and eggs in a large bowl and stir well
3. Spoon into baking dish and top with marshmallows
4. Combine brown sugar , flour and butter in a small bowl and mix until crumbly
5. Sprinkle topping over marshmallows
6. Bake for 25 minutes or until filling is bubbly and marshmallows are lightly browned

title: blanquette de veau
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 330 degrees f
2. Combine onions , leek , celery , garlic and bouquet garni in large casserole
3. Melt butter in large skillet over medium heat
4. Add veal and cook until firm and white , turning occasionally , 8-10 minutes
5. Do not brown
6. Add flour and stir 1 minute
7. Add 4 cups stock and bring to boil , stirring constantly
8. Pour into casserole
9. Season
10. Cover and bring to boil
11. Transfer to oven
12. Cook until veal is very tender , stirring very often and skimming foam from surface , 1 to 2 hours
13. Transfer veal to large saucepan using slotted spoon
14. Degrease sauce
15. Boil in casserole until thick enough to coat back of spoon
16. Add crme fraiche and boil until thickened
17. Remove from heat
18. Stir in lemon juice
19. Adjust seasoning
20. Strain over veal
21. Rewarm over medium-low heat
22. Do not boil
23. Stir in gherkins and capers
24. Spoon rice into shallow bowls and ladle veal over

title: butternut pumpkin  squash   roasted hazelnut and feta salad
steps:
1. Preheat fan-forced oven to 230c / 445f
2. While the oven is heating , place hazelnuts on to a baking tray , roast for 10-15 minutes until skins crack and nuts are roasted
3. Wrap in a clean tea towel and rub hazelnuts in tea towel to remove skins
4. Chop nuts and set aside
5. Line a large roasting pan with non-stick baking paper and arrange the pumpkin in pan , spray with oil and season with salt and pepper
6. Roast , turning once , for 15 minutes or until golden brown and tender
7. Cool to room temperature
8. Place dressing ingredients in a screw-top jar and shake well to combine
9. Remove lid
10. Microwave on high for 10 seconds or until honey is melted
11. Shake again to combine
12. Combine pumpkin , hazelnuts and feta on a serving platter , drizzle with dressing and serve

title: asparagus and mushrooms
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Cut asparagus in pieces
3. Cook until tender and place in greased 1 1 / 2-2 qt baking dish
4. Saute mushrooms in butter
5. Combine all ingredients except crumbs and pour over asparagus
6. Sprinkle with crumbs
7. Bake for 20 minutes

title: kittencal s holiday sweet potato bake with nut topping
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease a 13 x 9-inch baking dish
3. Line a baking sheet with foil , then spray with cooking spray
4. Prick each sweet potato with a few holes
5. Place on the baking sheet and bake for about 1 hour or until fork-tender all the way through to the middle
6. Cool the potatoes slightly then scoop out the pulp
7. Place the pulp in a large bowl
8. Add in 1 / 3 cup sugar melted butter , eggs , pinch salt , vanilla and evaporated milk or milk
9. Mix with a wooden spoon to combine
10. Transfer / spread the mixture to the prepared baking dish
11. For the topping
12. In a small bowl combine 1 / 3 cup melted butter with brown sugar and flour
13. Mix to combine
14. Mix in the nuts
15. Spread over the sweet potato mixture in the baking dish
16. Bake for about 25 minutes or until completely heated through
17. Delicious !

title: desert safe double chocolate brownies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 f
2. Grease 9-inch square baking pan
3. Combine flour , baking soda and salt in small bowl
4. Heat shortening , sugar and water in medium saucepan to boiling , stirring constantly
5. Remove from heat
6. Stir in 1 cup morsels
7. Stir until smooth
8. Add eggs one at a time , beating well after each addition
9. Gradually add in flour mixture
10. Stir in remaining morsels
11. Spread into prepared baking pan
12. Bake for 30 to 35 minutes or until wooden pick inserted in center comes out slightly sticky
13. Cool completely in pan on wire rack
14. Cut into squares

title: garlic soup  soupe a l ail
steps:
1. Combine first 4 ingredients in medium saucepan
2. Bring to boil
3. Cover , reduce heat to low and simmer until vegetables are tender , about 25 minutes
4. Puree in batches in blender
5. Season with salt and pepper
6. Rewarm over medium heat
7. Drizzle with cream , if desired

title: creamy hamburger   rice casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Cook hamburger and onion together until meat is no longer pink
3. Drain grease
4. Stir the rest of the ingredients into the meat mixture
5. Pour mixture into lasagna casserole dish and bake for 1 1 / 2 hours or until rice is done

title: big batch bran muffins
steps:
1. In a bowl , combine the bran , cereal , boiling water and let sit for 30 minutes
2. Combine the sugar , buttermilk vegetable oil , molasses , eggs in another bowl
3. In another bowl , combine the flour , baking soda , salt and the raisins
4. Add the bran and cereal
5. Stirring well to combine
6. Add the dry ingredients to the flour mixture
7. Bake in a 375f oven for 25 minutes or until cooked

title: chorizo  mushroom and onion pizza
steps:
1. Topping -- in a large saute pan add the chorizo and cook until crumbled and golden brown
2. Remove to a plate with a paper towel and let it drain
3. Now to the same pan , remove most of the drippings but reserve a little to cook the onions and mushrooms inches if necessary you can a little more olive oil
4. Saute the onions and mushrooms until they are golden brown and soft
5. Add the chorizo back in the pan and mix well to combine all the flavors
6. Remove from the heat while you start your crust
7. Pizza crust -- follow directions for the pizza crust
8. Whether it is a store bought crust , dough or from a pizza place
9. But when i crisp mine up , i like to brush on a mix of olive , garlic , oregano and pepper
10. Then bake to firm up the crust
11. Top and bake -- top your pizza with the sausage , onion and mushroom mixture and then top with the grated cheeses
12. On a grill , medium heat
13. In a oven , 425 degrees until golden brown and the cheese is melted and bubbly
14. About 10-15 minutes
15. Enjoy this very unique pizza

title: magic cleaner
steps:
1. Add 8-1 / 2 ounces of dawn soap to two spray bottles
2. Heat vinegar in microwave until hot and pour 12 pounces into each bottle
3. Put the lid on and gently shake to incorporate
4. You now have a powerful cleaning product that will melt soap scum and tub and shower buildup , clean sinks , appliances and just about anything
5. Try using it on pots / pans / casserole dishes to remove stubborn baked on foods
6. I also use it on my grill - it really helps cut the grease ! just spray it on , scrub , rinse and be amazed
7. For tough soap scum build-up , spray the mixture on and allow it to sit as long as overnight
8. Then , scrub and rinse

title: parmesan oregano bread  aka pizza bread
steps:
1. Dissolve the yeast in the milk
2. Add salt , 1 / 4 cup olive oil , 1 tablespoon oregano , and 1 / 4 cup parmesan cheese
3. Add flour a little at a time
4. When dough is manageable , turn out dough onto lightly floured surface and knead until smooth
5. Place in bowl lightly oiled with olive oil
6. Rise for 1 hour in dark , warm place until dough has doubled
7. Knead dough for 2-4 minutes
8. Divide dough into 20 equal pieces , roll each piece into a ball
9. Butter large loaf pan and place 14 of the balls on the bottom in 2 rows , 7 in each row
10. Brush with olive oil
11. Place remaining 6 balls down the middle on top of the other 14
12. Brush with olive oil and sprinkle with 1 tablespoon oregano and 2 tablespoons parmesan
13. Cover and let rise for 45 minutes
14. Bake for 35-40 minutes at 400 degrees
15. The balls will produce a beautiful , "mountainous" surface on the bread- a real conversation piece !

title: crunchy christmas cookies
steps:
1. Cream butter
2. Add sugar , egg and vanilla
3. Sift in dry ingredients
4. Add cornflakes , oats , coconut and nuts
5. Roll into small balls an place 2-inches apart on a cookie sheet
6. Bake at 350 for 10-15 minutes

title: cherry pineapple relish
steps:
1. Dice one red onion
2. Heat olive oil in a saute pan over medium-high heat
3. Saute dried cherries , pineapple and diced red onion until the onion is soft
4. Add chicken broth , reduce heat and saute until the pan is almost dry
5. Serve warn

title: barbeque vinaigrette salad dressing
steps:
1. Whisk all of the above together in a bowl until blended thoroughly
2. Warm the dressing on the stove until barely hot and put aside to cool
3. It is recommended that the dressing sit over night so that the flavors can marry
4. It can be served warm or cold on salad
5. Salad ingredients: green lettuce , pecans , hard-boiled eggs , blue cheese , avocado , green onions , halved cherry tomatoes and chopped red pepper
6. You can also add corn , hominy or red beans

title: fettuccine carbonara
steps:
1. Coat a large not stick pan with cooking spray
2. Saut garlic and onion for 2 minutess
3. Toss in ham and cook 2 minutes
4. Add sliced mushrooms and cook a further 2-3 minutes
5. Remove from pan and set to one side
6. In same saucepan melt margarine , add flour mixing well
7. Slowly add in evaporated milk and then skim milk , mixing continually until smooth
8. Stir in dry soup mix , stock powder and parmesan cheese
9. Return mushroom mixture to pot and combine well , add salt and pepper to taste
10. Fill a large saucepan 3 / 4 full with water add a pinch of salt
11. Bring to boil , add pasta , bring back to boil then simmer stirring occasionally to keep pasta separated
12. Cook 10 minutes or until pasta is cooked , drain , divide into 4 serves
13. Pour sauce over pasta and serve

title: gingerbread pancakes with cranberry maple syrup
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan combine the syrup , cranberries , orange zest and cinnamon sticks
2. Bring to a boil , then reduce heat and simmer for 5 minutes
3. Remove from heat but keep warm
4. In a large mixing bowl combine flour , wheat flour , baking powder , pumpkin pie spice , ginger , soda , and salt
5. In a smaller bowl whisk the egg
6. Whisk in the milk , applesauce , molasses , and oil
7. Make a well in the center of the flour mixture and add the egg mixture
8. Stir until just moistened
9. Batter will be lumpy
10. Heat a lightly-greased griddle or skillet over medium heat
11. Using about 1 / 4 cup of batter per pancake , pour batter onto griddle and cook about 3 minutes total , turning when the surface is bubbly and the edges are dry
12. Serve warm with butter and warm cranberry syrup

title: pommes chef  anne w  anne burrell   secrets of a restaurant chef
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 425 degrees f
2. Working 1 potato at a time , slice very thin on the mandoline
3. It is important to work with purpose here because the potatoes will discolor
4. Do not put the potatoes in water because this will wash the starch off the potatoes
5. Coat an 8-inch nonstick saute pan with olive oil , using the potato slices starting from the center make concentric circles of potatoes
6. Remember that eventually the bottom will be the top so it is important for the first circles of potatoes to look pretty
7. Brush each layer with olive oil and every 2nd or 3rd layer sprinkle liberally with grated parmigiano and salt
8. After every layer of potatoes press the potatoes so they are very compact
9. Repeat this process with the remaining 2 potatoes
10. Place the pan of potatoes over medium heat and cook until the olive oil begins to sizzle and the potatoes begin to brown on the bottom
11. Put the pan in the preheated oven and bake for 20 to 25 minutes
12. Remove the pan from the oven and place a tight fitting lid on the pan
13. Drain the excess oil out the side of the pan
14. This step is extremely important !
15. After the excess oil has been drained , completely flip the pan so the cake is turned out onto the bottom of the lid , then slide the cake off the lid back into the pan so the brown side of the cake is now up and the top becomes the bottom
16. We see now why draining the excess oil is important- if you attempt this without draining the oil it will drain out on your wrist and burn you
17. Return the cake to the oven and bake for another 10 to 15 minutes or until the cake is fork tender
18. Cut into wedges and serve

title: easy red beans and rice for slow cooker
steps:
1. Put beans and chicken broth in slow cooker on high
2. Cut sausage into medallions , and cook in a large frying pan until lightly crispy on outside
3. Add onion and garlic to the pan and saute in the sausage grease
4. Put the contents of the frying pan and the remaining spices in the slow cooker
5. Add water until the level rises above the beans
6. Once the slow cooker starts a light simmer , you can continue to cook it on high for 3-4 hours , or low for 6-8 hours
7. Serve with white or brown rice

title: roasted capsicum  goat cheese and walnut salad
steps:
1. Cook pasta in large saucepan of boiling water , uncovered , until just tender
2. Drain
3. Rinse under cold water
4. Drain
5. Meanwhile , quarter capsicum , remove and discard seeds and membranes
6. Roast under grill or in oven at 250c , skin side up , until skin blisters and blackens
7. Cover capsicum pieces with plastic or paper for 5 minutes , peel skin away
8. Slice capsicum thinly
9. Place pasta and capsicum in large bowl with cheese , walnuts , basil and combined remaining ingredients
10. Toss gently to combine
11. Serve with fresh crusty bread

title: glazed corned beef   silver palate
steps:
1. Place corned beef in large pot and cover with boiling water
2. Bring back to boil , lower heat , cover partially , and simmer as slowly as possible for about 3 hours , or until very tender when tested with a fork
3. Preheat oven to 350f
4. Mix marmalade , mustard and sugar in a bowl until well combined
5. When meat is done , remove from pot and drain
6. Place meat in ovenproof dish and pour marmalade mixture over , coating thoroughly
7. Bake for 30 minutes , or until glaze is crisp and brown
8. Serve hot or at room temperature

title: almond energy blast smoothie  south beach diet
steps:
1. Place ingredients in a blender
2. Blend until smooth
3. Serve cold

title: paula deen s best ham salad sandwich
steps:
1. Mix all the ingredients until well blended
2. Spread on white bread
3. Paula says that the trick is to use the best ham you can find , preferably an authentic smithfield ham

title: tex mex baked potatoes with chili
steps:
1. Wrap the potatoes in aluminium foil and pierce with skewers all over
2. Bake at 425f for 45 minutes
3. Heat the oil in a pan and add the garlic , onion , and bell pepper
4. Fry gently for 4-5 minutes until softened
5. Add the ground turkey , and fry until it is browned
6. Stir in the chopped serrano pepper , ground cumin , cayenne pepper , salt , tomatoes , tomato paste , bbq sauce , water , and dried herbs
7. Cover and simmer for about 25 minutes , stirring occasionally
8. Add the black beans and cook for 5 more minutes
9. Turn off the heat and stir in the chopped cilantro
10. Cut the baked potatoes in half lengthwise and place one half in each serving bowl
11. Top them with the chili

title: nana s oatmeal chocolate chip cookies
steps:
1. Mix sugars , butter and crisco together
2. Add eggs
3. Mix in soda , salt and flour
4. Add oats and chocolate chips last
5. Cook at 350 for 8-10 minutes
6. I always eyeball the cookies and take them out when they're just turning golden but still seem a little jiggly so they stay soft once they've hardened

title: twice roasted potatoes with onion  herbs and chilli
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 200 degrees c
2. Prick the potatoes all over with a fork and place on a baking tray and roast for 1 hour until cooked
3. When they are cool enough to handle , tear the potatoes into 3 cm chunks
4. Return the chunks to the baking tray and scatter with the onion , herbs chilli flakes and garlic
5. Drizzle with the oil and toss well to combine
6. Dot with the pieces of butter and season with plenty of sea salt and ground black pepper
7. Roast on the top shelf for 15-20 mins , turning regularly , until crisp and golden

title: spicy tex mex meatloaf
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f in heavy skillet , saute onion , garlic , and jalapeno in olive oil until tender , about 5 minutes add bread crumbs
2. In large bowl , combine eggs , salsa , chili powder , refried beans , black olives , salt , cayenne pepper , cilantro and sauteed vegetables
3. Mix well until thoroughly combined
4. Add ground beef , pork and cubed cheese and mix gently but thoroughly with hands
5. Shape meat into a loaf and place on a pan
6. Bake at 350 degrees for 55-60 minutes , until internal temperatures registers 160f sprinkle meatloaf with shredded cheese and bake 5 minutes more until cheese melts
7. Place onto serving platter , cover with foil , and let stand 15 minutes before slicing
8. Serve with additional salsa , sour cream , cheese and jalapenos !

title: braised cannellini beans with onions and arugula
steps:
1. Heat the olive oil in a 1-quart pot over a medium-high flame
2. Add the garlic and cook 30 seconds , stirring constantly
3. The garlic should become aromatic and just lightly golden
4. Stir in the chili pepper and cook 15 more seconds
5. Add the onion and cook , still stirring , about 2 minutes , or until the onion becomes translucent and soft
6. Stir in the pepper and parsley and cook 1 more minute
7. Fold in the rinsed and drained beans , and then stir in the tomato paste
8. Add enough cool water to cover the beans by 1 / 4 inch
9. Season with the salt and bring to a gentle boil , uncovered
10. Cover and lower the heat to medium-low
11. Cook for 5 minutes
12. Uncover , stir in the arugula , and cover again
13. Cook for another 15 minutes
14. Adjust the seasoning if needed and serve hot

title: limeade pie with graham nut crust
steps:
1. To make crust: preheat oven to 350f
2. Place pecans in single layer on a rimmed baking sheet , and toast until fragrant , about 8 minutes
3. Remove from oven and cool
4. Place graham crackers in bowl of food processor fitted with metal blade
5. Pulse until fine crumbs form
6. Add sugar , salt and pecans
7. Pulse to combine
8. Add butter and pulse until fine crumbs form
9. Transfer to a rectangular , 13 1 / 2 by 4 1 / 4-inch tart pan with a removable bottom , and pat evenly onto bottom and up sides
10. Place pan on a baking sheet
11. Bake until crust is golden and fragrant , 8 to 10 minutes
12. Transfer to a wire rack to cool
13. For pie: in bowl of food processor fitted with metal blade , combine cream cheeses and sugar
14. Process until mixture is smooth
15. Add lime zest and juice
16. Pulse several times to combine
17. Transfer filling to prepared graham nut crust
18. Cover with plastic wrap after putting toothpicks throughout
19. Otherwise , plastic wrap will stick
20. Refrigerate until set , at least 2 hours or preferably overnight
21. Slice and serve

title: stove top unstuffed green peppers
steps:
1. Brown lean ground beef
2. Add onion , garlic , green pepper
3. Add tomato sauce , garlic powder , garlic pepper , salt , and pepper
4. Add cooked rice and canned mushrooms
5. Heat though

title: freda2 s crockpot chili recipe
steps:
1. Brown ground meat in 1 tbsp of the olive oil over medium to high heat
2. Drain
3. Add 1 tbsp of the olive oil to the bottom of the crock pot set on high heat
4. Add chopped onions and minced garlic to oil in crockpot
5. Add browned , drained ground meat
6. Add all of the rest of the ingredients , except beans
7. Cook on low for 4-6 hours
8. Then stir in chili beans
9. Cook for another hour on low
10. Serve w / corn chips , sour cream , chopped onion , shredded colby cheese , and sliced jalapenos if desired
11. Pass the tabasco if some like it hotter
12. Enjoy !

title: tomato and cucumber salad with a pesto like dressing
steps:
1. Place all dressing ingredients in a blender and process till smooth and creamy
2. Place all the lettuce on a large platter
3. Arrange tomatoes and cucumbers on lettuce
4. Pour some dressing on arrangement and serve some on the side for those that want it

title: mmmm   english toffee
steps:
1. Melt the butter in a saucepan
2. Add sugar , salt and vanilla
3. Boil gently several minutes , stirring frequently to prevent burning
4. Until it reaches 300 degrees on a candy thermometer
5. Arrange 1 cup pecans on 8 inch square pan
6. Pour the boiled mixture over top and spread to cover evenly
7. Let toffee set up for 15minutes until slightly firm but still very warm
8. Sprinkle with chocolate chips and allow them to melt completely
9. Gently spread chocolate to cover completely
10. Arrange pecan halves over top
11. Cool to set
12. Drizzle with melted white chocolate and let cool completely
13. Break into chunks to serve

title: blue cheese dessert sandwich   smrrebrd
steps:
1. Spread rye bread with butter
2. Cover with a layer of blue cheese
3. Top with cherry preserves

title: shepherds pie
steps:
1. Boil the potatoes for 20 minutes , or until tender
2. Drain and mash with the margarine and soy milk or nondairy creamer
3. Season with salt and pepper
4. In a medium pan , saut the onion in the oil until translucent
5. In a medium bowl , mix the cooked onions , faux beef crumbles , mushroom gravy , peas and carrots , and spices
6. Pour into a pie pan
7. Top the crumble mixture with the potatoes , spreading to the edges
8. Bake in a 350f oven for 30 to 40 minutes , until the potatoes are browned and the crumble mixture bubbles out the edges

title: stained glass cookies
steps:
1. Beat margarine or butter , sugar , honey , egg and vanilla in large bowl with electric mixer until creamy
2. Mix in flour , baking powder , baking soda and salt
3. Cover
4. Refrigerate at least 2 hours
5. Roll dough on lightly floured surface to 1 / 4-inch thickness
6. Cut dough into desired shapes with 2 1 / 2- to 3-inch floured cookie cutters
7. Trace smaller version of cookie shape on dough leaving 1 / 2- to 3 / 4-inch border of dough
8. Cut out and remove dough from center of cookies
9. Set aside
10. Place cut-out shapes on baking sheets lined with foil
11. Repeat with reserved dough , re-rolling scraps as necessary
12. Crush each color of candy separately between two layers of wax paper with a mallet
13. Spoon crushed candy inside centers of cut-out cookie shapes
14. Bake at 350f for 6 to 8 minutes or until candy is melted and cookies are lightly browned
15. Cool cookies completely before removing from foil

title: slow cooker enchiladas
steps:
1. In a skillet , cook beef , onion , and green pepper until beef is browned and veggies are tender
2. Drain
3. Add the next 8 ingredients and bring to a boil
4. Reduce heat
5. Cover and simmer for 10 minutes
6. Combine the cheeses
7. In a 5-quart slow cooker , layer about 3 / 4 cup of beef mixture , one tortilla and about 1 / 3 cup of cheese
8. Repeat layers
9. Cover and cook on low for 5 to 7 hours or until heated through

title: orange and almond cake  gluten free
steps:
1. Place orange in boiling water for 2 hours
2. Remove and allow to cool
3. This can be done ahead of time
4. Preheat oven to 180c
5. Break eggs into a blender
6. Add caster sugar and blend together
7. Cut up orange and place into egg mix , and blend together to a smooth consistency
8. Add the almond meal and baking powder and blend
9. Grease baking pan and dust with caster sugar
10. Pour batter into the pan and sprinkle caster sugar on top and bake for 1 hour or until top is golden brown
11. Dust with icing sugar to serve

title: baked northern pike
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Melt butter
3. Pour in a 9x13 inch cake pan
4. Place fillets in the butter
5. Season with salt and pepper
6. Slice onions and green peppers and place over fillets
7. Sprinkle 2 teaspoons of lemon juice over fillets
8. Cover the fillets with the 6-8 strips of bacon
9. Bake at 350 degrees for approximately 25 minutes

title: lashella s favorite oxtail stew
steps:
1. Wash and dry the oxtails
2. Add the meat to a large bowl and season with salt and pepper , to taste
3. Toss the meat in the flour until lightly coated
4. Add the olive oil to a large dutch oven over medium heat
5. Brown the oxtails on all sides , in batches , until well browned
6. Transfer the meat to a plate and pour off some of the drippings , if necessary
7. Add the onions , carrots , celery , thyme , and garlic to the pot and saute until the onions are tender and beginning to brown , about 5 minutes
8. Season with salt and pepper , to taste
9. Stir in the tomato paste and toast
10. Deglaze the pot with the bottle of red wine and stir up all the browned bits on the bottom of the pan
11. Stir in the beef broth , tomatoes with their juices and the bay leaves
12. Add the browned beef back into the pot along with any accumulated juices that may have collected on the plate
13. Bring the stew to a boil , then reduce the heat to a low simmer
14. Cover and cook until the beef is tender and falling off the bone , about 3 1 / 2 hours
15. Stir in the mushrooms and cook uncovered , for 30 minutes more
16. Taste for seasoning
17. Add salt and pepper , if needed , and stir in the red wine vinegar to brighten the flavor
18. Remove the meat from the pot and pull the meat off the bones , then add back to the pot
19. Discard the bones
20. Transfer the stew to a serving dish and serve hot over buttered noodles

title: texas roadhouse copycat cinnamon butter
steps:
1. In a small bowl , with a handmixer , beat butter till fluffy
2. Add confectioner's sugar at a time , blending well
3. Add cinnamon to mixture and blend well
4. Scoop into a small container-serve immediately or refrigerate

title: apricot almond buns
steps:
1. In a large bowl , mix 1 cup flour , 1 / 2 cup brown sugar , salt and undissolved yeast
2. Heat milk , water and 3 tbs margarine to 120f -130f
3. Add to dry ingredients
4. Beat 2 minutes at medium speed of mixer
5. Add eggs and 1 cup flour
6. Beat at high speed 2 minutes
7. Stir in enough remaining flour to make soft dough
8. Knead 8 to 10 minutes
9. Set in greased bowl
10. Grease top
11. Cover
12. Let rise until doubled , about 1 hour
13. Punch dough down
14. Divide in half
15. Roll each to a 14 x 9 inch rectangle
16. Brush with melted margarine
17. Sprinkle with remaining brown sugar , apricots and almonds
18. Roll each up from long side
19. Seal seams
20. Cute each roll into 7 slices
21. Make 2 cuts in side of each slice , 2 / 3 the way through
22. Fan sections
23. Set on greased baking sheet
24. Cover
25. Let rise until doubled
26. Bake at 375f 15 to 20 minutes
27. Cool
28. Glaze if desired

title: belgian mussels
steps:
1. Wash the mussels thoroughly and remove all the ones that are open
2. Melt the butter in a large pot and add the vegetables , some pepper and salt
3. Cook until the veggies have softened a bit
4. Add the mussels and put a lid on the pot
5. Cook for 5 minutes and shake the pot
6. Cook for another 5 minutes
7. The mussels should be done bu now
8. Serve with homemade belgian fries and a salad ! enjoy !

title: sweet and sour cabbage and carrots
steps:
1. In a large skillet over medium-high heat , melt butter
2. Add to the skillet the cabbage , carrots , onion and brown sugar
3. Cook , stirring often , for about 10-12 minutes until the veggies are well-browned and softened
4. Remove from heat and stir in the soy sauce , vinegar and pepper
5. Serve hot

title: tamale pancakes
steps:
1. Preheat a griddle
2. Put cornmeal in a bowl , and add the boiling water
3. Stir well and allow to cool
4. Add the wet ingredients: milk , oil , and egg
5. Stir
6. Sift in the dry ingredients: flour , cumin , salt , chili powder , baking powder
7. Add corn and olives
8. Stir
9. Each pancake will be made from about 4 tablespoons of batter
10. Spoon onto the griddle and let cook , flipping once
11. Should be nice and golden brown on both sides
12. Top with your choice from the tomato , cheddar , green onions , salsa and sour cream

title: edmonds banana loaf
steps:
1. Sift flour , baking soda and salt into a bowl
2. Mix in sugar
3. In another bowl beat eggs
4. Stir in milk , butter and banana
5. Mix quickly into dry inredients , stirring until ingredients are just combined
6. Spoon into a greased and lined 22cm loaf tin
7. Bake at 180c for 45-55 minutes
8. Leave in tin for 10 minutes before turning out onto a wire rack

title: quick asian lettuce chicken wraps
steps:
1. Cut chicken breasts into thin strips
2. Add butter to skillet and melt over medium to high heat
3. Add onion and garlic and cook 1 minute to get the flavors flowing into the butter
4. Add chicken , hoisin sauce and cook until chicken is white on the outside but still pink on the inside
5. Add the chinese five spice , black pepper and soy sauce and cook another 5 minutes on medium to high heat , reduce temperature and simmer covered 5-10 minutes so the chicken becomes tender
6. Fold into lettuce wraps !
7. This is very filling , low carb and low calorie
8. Enjoy !

title: tender turkey and peanut butter curry
steps:
1. Prehea the oven to 190 degrees centigrade
2. Heat the oil in a casserole dish and stir fry the turkey , onion , garlic , chillies , ginger and curry powder for 5 minutes until beginning to brown
3. Add some salt and pepper then stir in the tomatoes , coconut cream and peanut butter
4. Cover with a tight fitting lid and bake for 45 minutes
5. Check the seasoning , stir in the corriander and serve with pilau rice

title: orange strawberry shortcake
steps:
1. Combine strawberries , oranges , sugar and triple sec , stir
2. Cover and chill 2 hours
3. Combine bisquick mix , sugar , cinnamon and milk
4. Stir until moistened
5. Knead 4 or 5 times on floured surface
6. Place on greased baking sheet
7. Press into a 7 x 3 / 4-inch round
8. Bake at 425f for 15 minutes or until done
9. Cool on wire rack
10. Beat whipping cream until foamy
11. Gradually add powdered sugar , beating until soft peaks form
12. Split biscuit round in half horizontally
13. Place bottom half on a serving dish
14. Drain fruit , reserving liquid
15. Spoon 2 / 3 of fruit on bottom round
16. Drizzle with reserved liquid
17. Spoon half of whipped cream mixture over fruit
18. Add top biscuit
19. Top with remaining fruit and whipped cream

title: green beans and bamboo shoots
steps:
1. Cover and microwave frozen green beans in 1-qt casserole on high until tender , 6 to 7 minutes , drain
2. Stir in remaining ingredients
3. Microwave uncovered until hot , about 1 minute

title: hard strawberry lemonade
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in blender
2. Blend until smooth
3. Put 8 oz of ice in a shaker , pour drink into shaker and shake for 30 seconds
4. Pour into glass to serve

title: pan seared lamb medallions
steps:
1. Place lamb in a bowl
2. Mix all other ingredients together except salt , olive oil , stock and butter
3. Massage the lamb and marinate at room temperature for 15-30 minutes
4. Heat pan over medium high heat
5. Add olive oil and butter
6. When it just starts to smoke a little , sear lamb for 3 to 4 minutes on each side for medium doneness
7. Baste continuously with pan oil and butter when searing
8. Set lamb aside and drain oil
9. Deglaze pan with chicken stock to make pan jus
10. Pour jus over lamb when serving

title: caribbean baked tofu cutlets
steps:
1. Press tofu slices between two pans for one to two hours to squeeze out the wanter and compress the tofu
2. While tofu is draining , combine remaining ingredients
3. Mix well and set aside
4. Preheat over to 350 degrees
5. Lightly oil a 7 x 11 inch baking pan
6. Spoon about a third of the sauce into prepared pan
7. Place pressed tofu on sauce and top with remaining sauce
8. Bake uncovered , 45 minutes

title: pistachio mint pesto shrimp salad
steps:
1. Blend all pesto ingredients in food processor or blender except oil
2. Once ingredients are chopped together , drizzle in olive oil until blended
3. Mix shrimp , orzo , feta , and tomato together in large bowl
4. Toss with pesto
5. Serve chilled or at room temperature

title: grilled chicken gourmet style salad
steps:
1. Prepare and toss lettuces in large serving bowl
2. Set aside
3. Fry bacon
4. Set aside to cool
5. Then crumble
6. Slice radishes very thin , marinate with vinegar and sea salt
7. Stir and set aside
8. While bacon is frying , slice and cube bread , then toast until golden brown
9. Drizzle with melted butter
10. Sprinkle with garlic salt
11. Set aside
12. When bacon is done , pour off grease , add olive oil and saut chicken breast cubes
13. Stirring frequently
14. When browned , remove from pan and set aside to cool
15. Add butter to pan , when melted add onion rings and brown until almost crispy
16. While onions are working , mix mayo and barbecue sauce in a small bowl
17. Pour over chicken cubes , mixing well
18. Add bacon , radishes , bread cubes , chicken , onions and pine nuts to lettuce in large bowl
19. Toss well
20. Serve with home-made berry compote and fudgy brownies !
21. Option #1: try carrots or do half-n-half radishes & carrots for lovely color
22. Option #2: use a different "sauce" to marinate the radishes
23. Option #3: let each diner add each ingredient at the table
24. Option #4: include spinach or fresh swiss chard with the greens

title: orange lime fizz
steps:
1. Heat 1 cup orange juice to boiling
2. Add sugar and mint
3. Cool , covered , then strain
4. Add remaining orange juice and lime juice
5. Just before serving , mix with club soda
6. Serve over ice

title: puffed party squares
steps:
1. Place cornflakes , rice krispies and puffed wheat into a large bowl
2. Mix brown sugar , syrup and peanut butter in a pot over low heat until sugar dissolves , and simmer one minute
3. Stir mixture into the cereal and press into a buttered 8x8 pan
4. Cool and cut into squares

title: taco in a pan
steps:
1. Brown the ground beef and drain very well
2. Return to pan
3. Add the taco seasoning and follow the directions on the package
4. When done , drain it again
5. Line a 9x13 pan with the tator rounds
6. I only put one layer , but you can put in more
7. Follow the instructions on the package and bake
8. When tators are 1 / 2 done , remove from the oven and spread the taco meat on top
9. Sprinkle the taco cheese on top of the meat
10. Return pan to oven and finish cooking the tators
11. When done serve on plates and add to taste the salsa , lettuce , tomato , sour cream , and quacamole

title: drunk chicken
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees farenheit
2. In a large bowl , combine the cream of chicken , celerey , and mushroom soups with one can's worth of wine
3. Place the chicken breasts in a baking dish and pour sauce mixture overtop so that it covers the chicken
4. When the oven is heated , place the dish in the oven , bake for two hours
5. While baking the chicken , cook 3 / 4 cup of rice
6. Serve chicken over rice , pour spoonfuls of additional sauce overtop or mix with rice separately

title: viennese goulash  wiener rindsgulasch
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a large pot and brown the beef cubes
2. Add the onions and cook them with the meat until they are transparent or have a shiny appearance , about 5 minutes
3. Add the tomato paste , paprika and the rest of the seasonings and stir well
4. Add the stock and stir well again
5. Add a little salt and pepper it is best to use less salt during the cooking process and correct the seasoning when the meat is cooked to avoid over-seasoning
6. Bring the whole pot to a boil then turn to low or medium-low and let the goulash cook slowly until the meat is tender , 2-4 hours , depending on cut of meat used
7. The onions are the thickening agent , so if the liquid evaporates , just add extra water a little at a time to avoid a thin goulash

title: wagon wheel breakfast pie
steps:
1. Place the hash browns in a 7-inch pie plate coated with nonstick cooking spray
2. In a small bowl , combine the cream cheese , 2 tablespoons milk , onion , salt , and pepper
3. Spread over potatoes
4. Cut sausage links in half lengthwise
5. Arrange over potatoes in a spoke-like fashion
6. In a small bowl , whisk the biscuit mix , egg , nutmeg , and remaining milk until smooth
7. Pour between sausages
8. Sprinkle with paprika
9. Bake at 400 for 25-30 minutes or until golden brown and filling is bubbly

title: pyttipanna  swedish fry
steps:
1. Cut the peeled potatoes and the meat into 1 / 4-inch cubes
2. If using raw potatoes , soak in cold water for 30 minutes , then drain
3. Mix the meat cubes with the dry mustard
4. Fry the meat , potatoes and onions separately in a large skillet
5. Fry the eggs in another skillet
6. Mix the meat , potatoes and onions and heat them for a moment in the skillet
7. Add salt and pepper to taste
8. Garnish with the parsley and the eggs
9. Serve with the accessories

title: garlic and egg fried rice
steps:
1. Beat eggs and fish sauce together , heat a wok and drizzle with sesame oil
2. Add the eggs and turn over the cooked egg-the raw stuff will flood to the outside
3. Keep cooking until you basically have an omellete shape of just cooked egg
4. Remove from the wok and set aside
5. Heat wok to hot , and add the tablespoon of sesame and the tablespoon of vegetable oil
6. Add the garlic and cook sir frying until opaque-don't burn it
7. Add the rice and toss over a high heat for a few minutes , then add the egg omlette breaking it up gently as you toss it through the rice
8. When the whole lot is hot , add the oyster sauce , toss through and serve

title: hearty black eyed pea salad
steps:
1. In a big bowl , mix together peas , ham , tomatoes , onions , and carrot
2. Set aside
3. Add dressing ingredients to a krudit jar with tight fitting lid
4. Shake well
5. Pour dressing over salad and toss to coat
6. Cover and keep in the refrigerator for at least 2 hours before serving

title: tortellini soup with chicken
steps:
1. Rinse the chicken pieces and remove the skin
2. Place them in a large saucepan
3. Add the broth and 2 cups of water
4. Bring to a boil
5. Reduce heat and simmer gently until the chicken is cooked through , about 35 minutes
6. Skim any foam that rises to the surface
7. Transfer the chicken to a plate
8. Let cool
9. Shred the meat
10. Discard the bones
11. Meanwhile , strain the broth and return it to the saucepan
12. Bring to a boil
13. Add the carrots , swiss chard , tortellini , salt , and pepper
14. Simmer according to the tortellini's package directions
15. When the tortellini are done , add the chicken and heat for 3 minutes
16. Ladle the soup into bowls and sprinkle with cheese

title: ham and egg salad with crackers
steps:
1. Mix together all ingredients except crackers
2. Spoon into a container
3. Pack into lunch box with chiller brick
4. Pack crackers seperately

title: grilled turkey burgers with couscous
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together in a large bowl
2. Form into patties
3. Cook on grill until cooked through

title: decadent creamed eggs on toast
steps:
1. Peel and chop eggs , set aside
2. Melt butter over med-hi on stove
3. Stir flour in and brown slightly , being careful not to burn
4. Add cream a little at a time , stirring to incorporate after each addition
5. Use more or less cream to achieve desired consistency
6. Turn off heat and add salt and pepper to taste
7. Stir in eggs
8. Pour over toasted bread

title: french dressing  1908
steps:
1. Combine salt and paprika in a shallow dish
2. Add mustard , if using
3. Pour in the oil and mix well
4. Beat in vinegar a little at a time , beating constantly
5. Serve immediately

title: prawn and eggplant curry  kari udang dan terung
steps:
1. Shell and devein prawns , you can leave the tails intact if you like
2. Blend or process the shallots , chili , turmeric and sugar until the shallots are finely chopped
3. Heat ghee in a wok and add the onions and cook stirring until soft
4. Add the shallot mixture and cook stirring until fragrant
5. Add the coconut milk and water and simmer uncovered for 10 minutes
6. Add the eggplants and curry leaves to the coconut mixture and cook uncovered about 15 minutes or until the eggplants are tender
7. Stir in the prawns and cook until prawns are tender 5-10 minutes
8. Discard the curry leaves before serving

title: oriental sweet and sour sauce
steps:
1. Mix together paste ingredients and set aside
2. Melt butter in a heavy pan
3. Add chicken broth , diced green pepper , and pineapple
4. Cover and simmer for 5 minutes
5. Add the cornstarch paste and the finishing sauce ingredients
6. Simmer , stirring constantly , until the mixture thickens

title: moroccan tea
steps:
1. Cover stuff with boiling water
2. Let sit 5 minutes

title: santa anna s black bean casserole   authentic  mexican
steps:
1. In a large skillet over medium heat , combine first 6 ingredients , bringing the mixture to a boil
2. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 5 minutes
3. Stir in beans
4. Spread 1 / 3 of the bean mixture over the bottom of a 13x9-inch pan
5. Top that with half of the tortillas , overlapping as necessary and half of the cheese
6. Add another 1 / 3 of the bean mixture , then remaining tortillas and bean mixture
7. Cover and bake at 350f for 30 minutes or until heated through
8. Sprinkle with remaining cheese and let stand for 10 minutes
9. Garnish with shredded lettuce and chopped tomatoes
10. Serve by topping with the sliced avocado or guacamole

title: simply delicious  best margarita ever
steps:
1. Mix first ingredients and serve over ice
2. Yummmmmmmmmm

title: boudro s famous guacamole  riverwalk san antonio
steps:
1. Squeeze juice of orange and lime into bowl
2. Scoop avocado from skin , add to bowl and coarsely chop
3. Add tomato , peppers , onion , garlic , and cilantro , and fold into avocado mixture
4. Add salt to taste
5. Result should be crudely chopped , not mashed

title: cinnamon bun cookies
steps:
1. Mix the first 7 ingredients together with a wooden spoon in a bowl
2. Roll the dough out on a well floured surface
3. Rub with a spatula over the dough , the 1 / 4 cup of melted butter
4. Sprinkle with the cinnamon and brown sugar
5. Roll up into a long dough rope
6. Cut int 1 / 2 inch to 1 inch pieces and place on cookie sheet
7. Bake at 350f for 10 - 12 minutes

title: asian vegetable pasta salad
steps:
1. Heat a small saucepan to medium , and add the oils , garlic and red pepper flakes
2. Stir and dont let the oil get too hot
3. Once the garlic is cooked , stir in the vinegar , tamari , water and maple syrup
4. Turn the heat down to medium-low , and stir occasionally while you prepare the vegetables
5. The next part of this pasta salad is to sprinkle some sea salt on the broccoli and mushrooms in a bowl with a tight-fitting lid
6. Add some tamari if you like for flavor , put the lid on the bowl and shake for a few minutes , until the vegetables start to wilt
7. Let them marinate while you chop the tomato , green onion and optional cashews
8. Cook the noodles , drain , and set aside to dry
9. Place the vegetables in a large bowl and pour the sauce over them and toss
10. Add the noodles and optional wakame and toss again
11. Garnish with roasted , chopped cashews

title: puff pastry chicken pot pie
steps:
1. Pre-heat oven to 400 and lightly grease 2 quart square baking dish
2. Sit aside
3. In medium sized mixing bowl add small bite size pieces of chicken breasts , 1 / 2 teaspoon garlic powder , 1 / 2 teaspoon onion powder , rosemary , paul prudhomme poultry magic seasoning , 1 / 4 teaspoon sea salt and 1 / 4 teaspoon fresh ground black pepper and extra virgin olive oil
4. Stir until all pieces are covered in oil and seasonings
5. Heat remaining oil in skillet on medium - medium high heat
6. Add chicken and brown until light golden brown about 5 minutes
7. Cover a plate with a paper towel and using a slotted spoon put chicken on paper towel to drain oil
8. Make sure to cover with another paper towel so chicken won't dry out
9. On a lightly floured surface roll out the first sheet of puff pastry to 12 inch square
10. If the pastry cracks use a dab of water on your finger
11. Take the pastry and lay in the casserole dish
12. Position until all sides are even
13. Be careful not to tear but you don't need to handle with kid gloves either
14. It's always easy to reseal any tear
15. Trim any excess that hangs over the edges of the casserole dish
16. Cover with foil and bake for 25 minutes or until all darker , doughy areas are lighter and puffed
17. While the puff pastry is baking you can multi-task by making the vegetables and sauce
18. In a skillet melt butter on medium-medium high heat
19. Add vegetables and cook until tender crisp
20. About 5-7 minutes
21. Don't over cook because vegetables will be cooking while you make the sauce and also baking in the oven later
22. You don't want them to turn to mush
23. Add flour and stir cooking until flour turns golden brown approximately 3 minutes
24. Slowly add chicken broth , ground dry mustard , remaining salt , remaining fresh ground pepper , remaining garlic powder , remaining onion powder , 1 teaspoon parsley flakes , peas and corn starch
25. Reduce to simmer and stir constantly until sauce thickens
26. If it's too thick add a little extra chicken broth
27. Sit aside and wait until bottom shell is finished baking
28. Re-flour your surface and place 2nd puff pastry sheet
29. Using a pizza cutter cut into 1 / 4 inch strips
30. Once bottom shell is finished baking add chicken and sauce mixture
31. Place puff pastry strips on top using a weave design
32. Trim any excess puff pastry
33. Sprinkle with remaining parsley flakes
34. Place casserole on foil lined baking sheet and place in oven
35. Cook for 25 minutes or until sauce is bubbly and puff pastry is golden brown

title: chunky tomato salad
steps:
1. Combine tomatoes , artichokes , olives onions and cheese in medium bowl
2. Sprinkle on the basil , olive oil and lemon juice
3. Toss to blend well
4. Season salad to taste with salt and pepper

title: ruby s bbq sauce
steps:
1. Add all ingredients to stove pot and bring to a boil
2. Cover and simmer for 20 minute
3. Add liquid smoke

title: toasted pound cake with mascarpone and amaretto
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Place the pound cake slices on a large heavy baking sheet and toast in oven for 7 to 10 minutes until the slices turn golden brown
3. Alternatively , toast the pound cake slices in an electric toaster until golden
4. Stir the apricot preserves and amaretto in a small bowl to blend
5. Place 1 cake slice atop each of 6 plates
6. Spoon the mascarpone cheese atop the cake slices
7. Arrange the remaining cake slices offset atop the bottom cake slices
8. Spoon the apricot mixture over
9. Sprinkle with the almonds and serve immediately

title: sweet and sour cabbage stew
steps:
1. Place pieces of cabbage in bottom of crock pot
2. Place beef cubes , cranberry sauce and chili sauce on top
3. Do not mix !
4. Cover
5. Cook on low heat for 8 hours

title: flaky butter crust
steps:
1. Dissolve the salt in the water and refrigerate
2. Place the butter cubes and flour in the food processor bowl
3. Chill the bowl , ingredients and blade in the freezer until well chilled , at least 30 minutes
4. Cut the butter into the flour using the pulse until the mixture resembles flakes of oatmeal
5. With the machine running , slowly pour in the cold salted water , mix just until the dough forms a ball
6. Divide the dough into three equal portions and shape each into a disk about 6 inches in diameter
7. Refrigerate disks for at least 30 minutes
8. Roll out each disk into 11 inch circles , place in a 9 inch pie pan and return the pan to the refrigerator until ready to bake or fill
9. Make sure the crusts are cold when they go into the preheated oven at 375f bake until the edges are lightly browned , about 20 minutes
10. Remove the rice or beans and the parchment , prick each crust several times with a fork , and return the crust to the oven to bake an additional 5 - 10 minutes
11. Remove and cool before filling

title: chickpea curry gluten free
steps:
1. Soak chickpeas overnight ,
2. Place chickpeas in pressure cooker or ordinary pot and just , cover the chickpeas with water
3. Add half chopped onions , cardamoms , cloves , bay leaves , peppercorns , cumin seeds and salt and bring to a boil
4. In a separate pot fry the other half of onions in oil till brown then add the garlic and ginger and saute for 10 minutes
5. Add the turmeric , garam masala , coriander powder , pepper and mango powder and stir well
6. After 2 minutes add tomatoes and saute for 5 minutes
7. Add the pot of chickpeas stir and cook till tender
8. Add salt to taste

title: falafel i
steps:
1. Mash the chickpeas well
2. Combine with other ingredients
3. Chill well
4. With floured hands make the batter into one-inch-diameter balls
5. Dust each one lightly with flour
6. Heat a 2-in
7. Pool of oil in a heavy skillet to 365f
8. Deep-fry the falafel until golden , and serve immediately

title: easy turnip greens
steps:
1. Melt butter and cook slivered turkey ham for about 3 min
2. Add the can of turnip greens
3. Mix in sugar , salt , pepper and simmer for 10 minute
4. Add vinegar and hot chili sauce

title: alex goh s basic sweet bun dough
steps:
1. Mix flours , milk powder , yeast and sugar in a big bowl
2. Add the egg and cold water and mix to form a dough
3. Add in the butter and salt and knead till a smooth dough forms
4. This takes a while
5. At first the dough will be greasy and seem as if there is too much butter in it
6. But as you knead and knead and knead , it will eventually get to the point you want it to be
7. Cover with clingwrap and let rise for about 1 hour or till doubled in size
8. Preheat oven to 380 farenheit
9. Divide dough into portions of 50 or 60 gm each
10. Shape into balls and leave it to rest for abt 10 minutes roll out dough and wrap with desired fillings
11. Shape as required and let it proof on lined or greased baking tray for another 50-60 mins or until dough is double in size
12. Brush dough with egg wash , or milk , if you want it to be less brown , and bake till golden brown and cooked
13. Immediately brush with melted butter after taking it out of the oven and cover with a tea cloth to give it a soft crust

title: vanilla pudding dessert
steps:
1. In a large bowl , whisk milk and pudding mix for 2 minutes
2. Let stand for 15 minutes
3. Fold in condensed milk
4. Set aside 1 tablespoon whipped topping and 2 tablespoons wafer crumbs
5. Fold remaining whipped topping into pudding
6. In a 2 quart serving bowl , layer a third of the strawberries , wafer crumbs and pudding mixture
7. Repeat layers twice
8. Sprinkle with reserved wafer crumbs
9. Top with reserved whipped topping
10. Refrigerate until serving

title: dough enhancer
steps:
1. Mix all together in a bowl and store in refrigherator in an airtight container
2. Use 3 tbs of this mixture in a recipe for whole wheat bread for white bread use 1 tsp
3. For rye bread use 3 1 / 2 tbs

title: stuffed portabella mushrooms  raw vegan
steps:
1. Wash & destem the mushrooms and place them stem side up on a plate
2. Mash up the avocado and mix in the onions , tomato , and salt
3. Spoon this into the mushroom caps
4. Pour braggs lightly over each mushroom and around the plate so it soaks into the mushroom a bit
5. You can always add extras such as sprouts , more tomato , or olives
6. Enjoy !

title: extra easy bisquick pizza
steps:
1. Heat over to 450 and grease 12" pizza pan
2. Stir together bisquick and water , beat 20 strokes until a soft dough forms
3. Press dough into pizza pan
4. Spread sacue over dough
5. Top with remaining ingredients
6. Bake 12-15 minutes or untl crust is golden brown and cheese is bubbly

title: pacific rim chicken burgers with ginger mayonnaise
steps:
1. Mix chicken , panko , egg , onions , cilantro , garlic , chili sauce and salt in a large bowl
2. With oiled hands , form into 4 patties
3. Mix together teriyaki glaze and honey in a small bowl
4. In large nonstick fry pan over medium high heat , place 1 tablespoon oil
5. Add chicken and cook , turning and brushing with teriyaki glaze , about 10 minutes or until done
6. Place burgers on toasted buns and top with lettuce , cucumber and ginger mayonnaise
7. Garnish with additional cilantro and cucumber slices
8. Ginger mayonnaise: mix 1 / 2 cup mayonnaise , 2 teaspoons sweet pickle relish , 2 teaspoons minced fresh ginger , 2 teaspoons lime juice , 1 clove garlic , minced and 1 / 4 teaspoon salt in a small bowl

title: stuffed pumpkin wedges
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f in a bowl , mix all the filling ingredients well and set aside
2. Thoroughly clean the outside of the pumpkin
3. Cut off top of pumpkin to make a lid
4. Remove the seeds and scrape out any stringy pulp
5. Fill the pumpkin with the stuffing , leaving a little space at top
6. Cover with pumpkin top , and bake in a lightly greased shallow pan for about 2-3 hours or until the stuffing sets
7. Cut the pumpkin into six sections and top with cranberry chutney

title: broccoli and cream cheese tart
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Pre-bake pie crust for 10 minutes
3. Remove from oven
4. Steam broccoli 3 to 4 minutes
5. Pat dry
6. Scatter broccoli over cooked pie crust
7. Beat cream cheese until smooth
8. Beat in half & half , eggs and yolk
9. Season with salt and pepper
10. Stir in green onions
11. Pour cheese mixture over broccoli
12. Sprinkle top with parmesan cheese
13. Bake until set , 35 minutes or until browned and filling is set
14. Serve warm or at room temperature

title: country style green beans with red potatoes
steps:
1. Place the ham hock and onion into a 4 quart dutch oven and fill half way full with water
2. Season water with salt , pepper and garlic powder and bring to a boil , then cover and simmer over low heat until meat falls off the bones , about 2 hours
3. Remove the bones and skin
4. Return the meat to the pot
5. Discard bones and skin
6. Add the green beans to the dutch oven and simmer for 20 minutes , then add the potatoes
7. Simmer for 10 to 15 minutes more , or until they can be easily pierced with a fork

title: lee s whole wheat and nut pancakes
steps:
1. Mix oats , whole wheat flour , flour baking soda baking powder , salt sugar , almonds , pecans , sunflower seeds , wheat germ together in food processor pluse until nuts and seeds are finely ground
2. Transfer to bowl
3. In small bowl combine buttermilk egg and oil whisk together
4. Mix butter milk mixture with dry ingredients stir well
5. Lightly oil griddle
6. With a 1 / 3 cup measuring cup pour batter onto hot griddle
7. Cook til lightly browned and flip
8. Serve with maple syrup or topped with fresh fruit

title: marinated veggie kebabs
steps:
1. Put the vegetable pieces into a large bowl
2. Combine remaining ingredients in another bowl and whisk until blended
3. Pour marinade over veggies and toss to coat
4. Cover bowl and marinate in refrigerator for several hours or overnight
5. Drain vegetables , reserving marinade
6. Thread the vegetables onto metal skewers
7. Put the skewers on a broiler pan and cook under the broiler for 10-15 minutes , turning occasionally
8. Baste with the marinade several times during the cooking process
9. These are also excellent grilled on the barbecue
10. Excellent with couscous or wild rice

title: shells baked with pesto meat sauce
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400
2. Oil a 13x9 baking dish
3. Heat oil in a pan over med- high heat
4. Cook onion until it starts to soften
5. Add beef and cook until it is no longer pink
6. Drain off any excess fat
7. Add tomato and salt and bring to a simmer
8. Cook about 10 minutes , until most of the tomato liquid evaporates
9. Remove from heat and stir in the pesto
10. While all this is going on , you should be cooking your pasta in boiling , salted water
11. Drain pasta and toss with the sauce
12. Put 1 / 2 of the pasta in baking dish
13. Top with 1 / 2 the mozzarella and 2 tbsp of the parmesan
14. Layer the remaining pasta on top , topping it with the remaining cheeses
15. Bake until bubbling

title: mom s cheesy potato casserole aka funeral potatoes
steps:
1. Reduced or fat free ingredients it will change the overall flavor and consistency so keep that in mind if reviewing :)
2. Boil potatoes with skin on and 1 bay leaf for about 20-25 minutes
3. Prep or cook time doesn't include boil time
4. Peel and grate cooled potatoes into your 9x13 baking dish
5. In a saucepan heat butter , coc soup , sour cream , 1 c cheese , onions and chilies
6. Stir until ingredients have melted or are well combined
7. S & p to taste
8. Add grated potatoes to saucepan and mix until blended
9. Add 5 oz milk or just enough that mixture isn't too wet
10. Spoon into the 9x13 baking dish
11. Top with remaining cheese and bake @ 350 degrees for 20 minutes optional: if you like a little crunch , add corn flakes or broken potato chips to the top of the cheese

title: braised brussels sprouts in mustard sauce
steps:
1. Cut off base of a sprout with a sharp knife
2. Slice a piece from one side of the sprout
3. Place it cut side down and cut it crosswise into about 5 slices
4. Repeat with all of the sprouts
5. Heat a large heavy skillet over medium heat for 1 minutes
6. Add olive oil and swirl to coat skillet
7. Add shallots
8. Saut for 2 mintues
9. Stir in sprouts , salt , and 3 tablespoons water
10. Spread everything evenly across the pan
11. Reduce heat to medium-low , cover , and cook for 5 minutes
12. Meanwhile , combine mustard , brown sugar , and remaining water in a small bowl
13. Stir until blended
14. Once sprouts have cooked for 5 minutes , pour mustard mixture over them and stir
15. Reduce heat to low , cover , cook for 3 minutes , then stir
16. Remove from heat or , if you prefer , cook for 5 minutes more the sprouts will get browner and more intensely flavored
17. Serve hot or warm with black pepper

title: hedeg kilet  nut poppy seed roll
steps:
1. Dissolve yeast in lukewarm milk
2. Add 1 teaspoon sugar and 1 tablespoon flour
3. Set aside
4. Melt butter
5. Add 1 / 2 and 1 / 2 cream and beaten egg yolks
6. Add this mixture to the yeast mixture
7. To the combined mixture add salt , 1 tablespoon sugar and flour
8. Mix together , and divide into 4 parts
9. Put in refrigerator overnight
10. Oven at 375f
11. Roll each part 1 / 2 inch thick
12. Filling:
13. Mix all ingredients together to form a paste
14. Spread with filling
15. Sprinkle with butter
16. Roll into loaves as for a jelly roll
17. Let stand 2 hours
18. Brush with egg white slightly beaten
19. Bake for 35 minutes

title: crown roast of pork with savory fruit stuffing
steps:
1. Place pork roast in roasting pan , resting on bone
2. Insert a meat thermometer into the thickest part of the meat
3. Roast , uncovered , at 325f for 1 1 / 2 hours
4. In a medium skillet , heat vegetable oil
5. Saut onions and celery until onions are golden
6. Transfer to a large bowl
7. Add remaining ingredients and toss well
8. Remove roast from oven
9. Drain off excess fat
10. Turn roast right side up , and replace in pan
11. Fill cavity with stuffing
12. Spoon the rest of the stuffing into a greased baking dish
13. Bake stuffing uncovered with pork roast for another 1 1 / 2 to 2 hours or until meat thermometer registers 160f
14. Let roast stand 15 minutes , prior to slicing
15. Apple and sausage stuffing: saute sausage in heavy large skillet over medium-high heat until cooked through , crumbling sausage with back of spoon , about 10 minutes
16. Using slotted spoon , transfer sausage to large bowl
17. Add butter , onions and celery to skillet
18. Saute until onions are tender , about 15 minutes
19. Add apples
20. Saute until apples are tender but still hold shape , about 10 minutes
21. Add sage , thyme and allspice
22. Saute for another minute
23. Add to sausage
24. Stir in stuffing mix
25. Season with salt and pepper , generously butter 15x10-inch glass baking dish
26. Fill center of crown roast of pork with stuffing
27. Transfer remaining stuffing to prepared dish
28. Cover with foil and bake until heated through , about 40 minutes

title: butterscotch caramel salty dogs
steps:
1. In a medium-sized glass bowl , melt the butterscotch chips in the microwave on high for about 2 minutes
2. Remove bowl and stir in the marshmallow cream and powdered milk
3. Add the vanilla and mix well
4. The mixture will be very thick
5. At this point , use your hands and knead the mixture almost like bread dough
6. Roll the mixture into walnut sized pieces and shape like your little finger
7. Place finger shapes on wax paper to set
8. In a separate bowl , melt the caramels and milk together in the microwave on high for 1
9. 5 to 2 minutes
10. Remove from microwave and stir well
11. Roll set fingers into the caramel mixture , making sure the caramel is not too hot and won't burn your fingers
12. Once rolled in caramel , immediately roll in chopped nuts and place back on the wax paper to harden
13. You can vary the yield by how large or small you make the "fingers"

title: smokey guacamole
steps:
1. Cut avocados in half all the way around , length wise
2. Use a spoon to gently scoop out the avocado
3. Dice the avocado in large chunks and add to a bowl
4. Add the remaining ingredients and toss without completely mashing the avocado
5. Serve with chips or as a condiment

title: smoked sausages with mustard sauce
steps:
1. Add 3 / 4 cup half-and-half to a small saucepan
2. Place over low heat , stirring occasionally , until bubbly
3. In a bowl , combine the next 5 ingredients with the remaining half-and-half , stir to mix well
4. Gradually add heated half-and-half , and mix well
5. Return mixture to saucepan
6. Cook on low , stirring constantly until smooth and thickened
7. Remove sauce from heat and gradually stir in vinegar
8. Serve with sausages

title: dry rub for sirloin steaks
steps: 1. Mix together and rub on sirloan steaks prior to grilling

title: olive garden   fettuccine with shrimp   zucchini
steps:
1. Cut zucchini into 2 in by 1 / 4 in sticks
2. Peel and devein shrimp
3. Cook fettuccine according to package directions
4. While pasta is cooking , heat oil in large saute pan over medium heat
5. Add chopped garlic and parsley
6. Cook for 1 minute
7. Add zucchini
8. Cook additional minute
9. Add shrimp , wine , salt , pepper and butter
10. Stir well and cook shrimp for 5 minutes or until they are no longer opaque
11. Add drained pasta to the mixture
12. Toss all ingredients to mix
13. Season with salt and pepper to taste
14. Use tongs to pull pasta onto serving platter
15. Top with shrimp , zucchini and seasonings
16. Squeeze two lemon wedges over dish
17. Garnish with remaining wedges and parsley

title: sweet  hot and lime chili
steps:
1. Start by lighting up the grille , set to highest temperature
2. Place large pot on the stove burner and set medium heat , pour in olive oil and add the butter and chop up onions and place in the pot to slightly brown , chop-up the new mexican green chilies , roasted red peppers , garlic , red hot peppers and add brown sugar to the entire mix and simmernow place the whole london broil on the grill and char on both sides till the center is no longer pink and slice / chop or whatever to get into bite-size pieces and place in the pot
3. Drain the cans of beans , rinse and add to the pot of chili , add the can of tomatoes , add the extra strong coffee and the remaining ingredients stirring in each , cut one lime in half and squeeze in the juice , cut the second lime in half and squeeze in one side and chop the last half as finely as possible and add peel and all
4. Stir occasionally and simmer for 1 hours , serve with lime flavored tostitos and enjoy the game !

title: bread machine potato bread
steps:
1. Can make rolls and bread
2. Dough cycle and normal cycle
3. Follow manufacturers directions
4. Makes a 1 1 / 2 lb
5. Loaf

title: chicken kebab
steps:
1. In a shallow dish , combine pineapple juice , teriyaki sauce , and oil
2. Thread the skewer , alternating tomatoe , chicken , pineapple , and pepper
3. Dip in the marinade , coating well , and discard the marinade
4. Refrigerate for 30 minutes
5. Grill or broil until the chicken is cooked through
6. Remove from the skewer and serve

title: easy enchilada sauce
steps:
1. Melt margarine in saucepan
2. Add flour
3. Whisk in tomato sauce and then water
4. Add chili powder and garlic powder to sauce
5. Simmer for 15 minutes to blend flavors

title: to die for maple pecan buns
steps:
1. For dough , pour water into a large bowl
2. Add yeast and 1 tablespoon sugar
3. Stir
4. Let stand 5 minutes , until bubbly
5. Stir in remaining sugar
6. In medium bowl , blend sour cream , eggs and vanilla
7. Stir into yeast mixture
8. Add flour and salt
9. Stir until combined
10. Add butter
11. Knead by hand until smooth
12. Place the dough in a well-buttered bowl
13. Cover
14. Let rest at room temperature 2 hours
15. Place dough on floured board and cut in half
16. Roll each half to 1 / 4-inch thickness , forming a rectangle about 9 by 12 inches
17. For filling , in a medium bowl , blend butter , brown sugar and cinnamon
18. Add raisins if using
19. Spread equally over each rectangle and roll up lengthwise
20. Cut each roll into 8 equal sections
21. For maple pecan layer , melt butter in a small saucepan over medium-high heat
22. Stir in sugar until dissolved
23. Add syrup and cook 5 minutes
24. Remove from heat and stir in vanilla
25. Generously butter two 10-inch cake pans
26. Pour in the syrup
27. Sprinkle with pecans
28. Arrange the buns evenly in the pans
29. Cover and let rise in a warm place for 1 hour
30. Bake in a preheated 350 degree f oven 25 to 30 minutes or until golden
31. Cool 5 minutes at room temperature , then invert onto serving plate
32. Serve warm or at room temperature

title: appelpaj  swedish apple pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit
2. Lightly grease a 9" pie pan or glass pie plate
3. Peel , core and slice apples
4. Fill pie plate 3 / 4 full with apple slices
5. Mix 1 / 4 cup of the sugar , cinnamon and cardamom if using
6. Mix well and sprinkle over the apple slices
7. In a small saucepan melt butter or margarine and remove from heat
8. Add remaining sugar , flour and egg
9. Stir to mix well
10. Pour over apples
11. Bake for 45 minutes
12. Serve hot with ice cream
13. It is really a unique pastry

title: pierce brosnan s penne pasta
steps:
1. Heat olive oil in large skillet over med high heat
2. Saute' sliced mushrooms with garlic and parsley
3. Add wine and let simmer until wine begins to evaporate , add tomatoes and cook another 8-10 minutes
4. Meanwhile boil penne until al dente' , drain
5. Add to sauce , let cook about 2 minutes
6. Taste for seasoning
7. Add salt and fresh ground pepper to taste
8. Right before serving add parmiginao cheese
9. Toss to blend together
10. Place on serving dishes , and offer extra parmigiano cheese as desired

title: our family favourite lemon spring   easter cake
steps:
1. Cream the margarine & sugar until it's light & creamy
2. Beat in the eggs & lemon zest
3. Slowly add the sifted flour & baking powder & mix well but gently
4. Add the water & mix
5. Pour into a lined & greased baking tin
6. I use either a tall 5" round tin or a shallow 12" round tin - both work very well & i've also seen others using square pans & bundt tins -- bake in a preheated oven at 180c for 40-45 minutes
7. Test to see if it is done - it may need a few extra minutes
8. If cooked , turn off oven & allow cake to rest in it for around 3 minutes
9. Filling:
10. Beat the margarine / butter until creamy
11. Slowly add enough icing sugar to reach a consistency you like
12. Tint yellow if desired
13. When the cake has cooled completely , use a bread knife to cut the cake into 3 layers
14. Divide the filling in half & spread onto bottom & middle layers using a pallet knife or similar
15. Icing
16. After filling the cake , put the top layer back in place
17. Trim off any edges or bumps etc
18. Mix the sifted icing sugar with the lemon juice & enough water to get a very thick but spoonable consistency
19. Tint with colouring if desired & carefully spoon over the top of the cake
20. The icing will slowly begin to drip down the sides of the cake - take a pallet knife & carefully run it around the sides of the cake to ensure & even covering
21. When the icing is almost set , run a clean damp finger or knife handle around the rim of the plate & top with chocolate mini eggs or other decorations of your choice

title: exotic avocado salad
steps:
1. Dry-fry the pumpkin seeds in a frying pan for a few minutes , tossing and turning them until they look toasted
2. Peel the papayas , halve them lengthways and scoop out the seeds
3. Cut the flesh into long , thin slices
4. Halve the avocados and remove the stones , then peel off the skin and slice the flesh lengthways into thin slices
5. Put the papayas , avocados , pumpkin seeds and watercress into a large bowl
6. Chop about 1 tbsp of the mint leaves and set aside
7. Pick the remaining leaves from the stalks and tear them into the bowl
8. Mix the lime juice and olive oil with the rest of the chopped mint to make a dressing , and season with salt and pepper to taste
9. Pour over the salad and gently mix all the ingredients together with your hands
10. Taste and add more salt and pepper if you think it needs it , then transfer to a serving platter

title: carrot mango smoothie
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in blender and blend on high or frape`
2. Serve in a fun cup or glass with a straw

title: balsamic reduction sauce
steps:
1. In a small saucepan , combine vinegar and sugar
2. Bring to a boil
3. Reduce heat to medium-low , stirring occasionally and simmer 20-30 minutes
4. Remove from heat and let sauce thicken as it cools

title: add an ingredient risotto
steps:
1. Get a large , deep frying pan and heat oil
2. Put rice into pan and fry for a couple minutes , then add 1 cup water and wine
3. Stir occasionally , until water is nearly absorbed , then add another 1 / 2 cup water , stock cube , vegetables and shrimp or chicken , if using
4. Repeat , stirring and adding water until rice is cooked
5. This may take more or less than 4 cups , so taste occasionally and add water until you're happy
6. Add garlic and herbs in the last five minutes , to taste
7. Spoon onto plates and sprinkle parmesan cheese over dish
8. For vegetarian do not use meat , seafood , or poultry
9. Do not use a broth made from these

title: lobster and shrimp ranch frittata  rsc
steps:
1. First prepare sauce by wisking milk into sour cream until smooth
2. Wisk in one half of hidden valley ranch mix , chives , lemon zest , and garlic powder
3. Stir in tomato
4. Set aside in refrigerator to use later
5. Next prepare egg mixture for frittata by beating eggs until smooth
6. Wisk in half & half , milk , the other half of hidden valley ranch mix , sumac , lemon zest , salt , and pepper
7. Set aside
8. In a 10" oven safe skillet melt 2 tbsp butter over medium heat
9. Lightly sautee red potatos over medium high heat until lightly browned
10. If necessary add more butter or coconut oil to prevent sticking
11. Add shrimp and minced garlic to pan , and sautee until shrimp begins to turn pink
12. Salt lightly to taste
13. Then add spinach to pan in order to wilt for about a minute or so
14. Next add egg mixture to pan while stirring
15. Stir in swiss and lobster
16. Keep stirring every minute or so to keep circulating raw egg to bottom of pan as it begins to set up
17. When mixture is still moist but setting up at the top , add layer of parmesan to the top and pop under the broiler on high for 4 minutes turning a quarter turn every minute
18. Cheese should be nicely bubbling and lightly browned on top
19. Pull from the oven and let cool for about 10 minute sprinkle sauce on top
20. Sprinkle chives on top , and serve

title: moroccan orange and radish salad
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a medium-sized bowl and cover with plastic wrap or a damp dish towel
2. Let stand for 30 minutes at room temperature
3. Ethnicgrocer

title: grilled ham slices with horseradish basting sauce
steps:
1. Set outdoor grill for medium-high heat , then lightly oil the grates
2. In a bowl combine the lemon juice with brown sugar and horseradish
3. Heat in microwave for 1-1 / 2 minutes or until warmed
4. Score slices of ham , then season very lightly with black pepper if desired
5. Place on preheated grill
6. Baste continuously with the horseradish sauce while grilled
7. Grill time should take about 7-8 minutes per side
8. Delicious !

title: easy cheesy cheddar garlic biscuits
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees combine baking mix , milk and cheese into bowl , stir with wooden spoon until soft dough forms
2. Beat dough vigorously 30 seconds
3. Drop dough by heaping tablespoons onto cookie sheets , ungreased
4. Bake 8-10 minutes , or until golden brown
5. Combine garlic powder and melted butter
6. Brush over biscuits last minute

title: mini spinach   cheese cups  south beach
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Mix all ingredients except turkey until well blended
3. Flatten turkey slices
4. Place 1 slice in each of 24 miniature muffin pan cups
5. Fill each with 1 1 / 2 tsp of the spinach mixture
6. Bake 15 minutes or until heated through
7. Serve warm

title: kittencal s ground beef fried rice
steps:
