1. In a wok or a large skillet brown the ground beef with garlic and ginger over medium heat breaking up into small pieces
2. Drain the fat , then transfer to a bowl
3. Heat 2 tablespoons oil in the same skillet over medium-high eat until hot
4. Add in bell pepper and pea pods
5. Cook for 3 minutes or until bell pepper is crisp-tender , stirring occasionally
6. Stir in the cold cooked rice , soy sauce and sesame oil
7. Return the cooked ground beef back to the skillet
8. Toss to combine and heat though , then stir in the chopped green onions
9. Season with salt and pepper and more soy sauce if desired

title: rosemary olive oil cake
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees and butter a 10-inch loaf pan or an 8-inch round cake pan
2. Sift the flour , baking powder , baking soda and salt together
3. Using a mixer , whip the eggs and sugar together until thick and pale
4. Fold one-third of the flour mixture into the egg mixture
5. Add the orange juice , and then fold in half of the remaining dry mixture
6. Add the milk , and then fold in all of the remaining dry mixture
7. Fold in the olive oil , rosemary and orange zest
8. Pour the batter into the prepared pan and bake until firm to the touch and nicely browned , about 40 minutes
9. Serve warm or room temperature

title: lemon basil carrots
steps:
1. Cook carrots in a small amount of water for 20 minutes
2. In a different saucepan , melt butter
3. Stir in lemon juice , garlic , salt , pepper , and basil
4. Add carrots and toss

title: christmas ham in the slow cooker
steps:
1. Use a 6-quart slow cooker
2. Unwrap the ham , and discard the flavor packet
3. Place the ham into your insert
4. In a small mixing bowl , combine the honey , mustard , ginger , cloves , and cinnamon
5. Smear this paste evenly all over the ham
6. You can even do this the day before , if you'd like , to let the flavors meld , although it isn't necessary
7. Pour the juice and add the last little bit with the pulp into the sauce bowl and swirl it around to get all of the "good stuff" out of the bowl
8. Pour ginger ale evenly over the top
9. Cover , and cook on low for 6-8 hours , or on high for about 3 hours
10. Your ham can sit in the slow cooker for quite a while on the warm setting before carving , or you can take it out , carve it into pieces , then return it to the pot to stay warm in the yummy sauce until you and your guests are ready to eat

title: sliced peaches in lime rum sauce  diabetic
steps:
1. In a saucepan over medium heat , heat the lime juice , rum , honey , and water
2. Bring to a boil , lower the heat , and simmer for 5 minutes
3. Add the cloves
4. Mix together the cornstarch or arrowroot powder and water
5. Add to the sauce
6. Add to the peaches and cook for about 10 minutes
7. Chill and serve in individual dishes
8. Exchanges: 1 fruit

title: chicken florentine with fresh mushrooms
steps:
1. Put the chicken breasts and onions in a large and wide saucepan
2. Add enough water to cover the same
3. Cover the saucepan with a lid
4. Poach the chicken for 20 minutes on low-medium heat until just white throughout
5. Then , melt butter in a heavy non-stick skillet
6. Saute mushrooms until tender{about 5 minutes}
7. Then preheat the broiler
8. Put the spinach in a 20 x 20 cm square baking dish
9. Sprinkle nutmeg , salt and pepper to taste
10. Arrange the chicken in a single layer over the spinach
11. Top with mushrooms
12. Sprinkle with cheese
13. Broil for 1-2 minutes or until the cheese has melted
14. Remove from heat
15. Serve hot
16. Enjoy !

title: crescent roll breakfast
steps:
1. Unroll crescent rolls and press together to cover bottom of 9x13 pan
2. Seal perforations
3. Crumble cooked sausage evenly over crescent rolls
4. Beat together eggs , milk , salt and pepper
5. Stir in cheese and green pepper
6. Pour over sausage
7. Bake at 425 for 20 to 25 minutes until browned

title: swiss broccoli soup
steps:
1. Cut enough 1-inch florets from broccoli to measure 2 cups
2. Cut rest of broccoli into 1-inch pieces
3. Cook florets and broccoli separately , in lightly salted water
4. Until just tender
5. Immediately rinse in cold water to chill completely
6. Drain
7. Set florets aside until serving time
8. In a large saucepan , saute leeks in butter until tender
9. About 3 - 4 minutes
10. Sprinkle in flour and cook for a minute or so , stirring with a whisk
11. Remove from heat and stir in chicken stock
12. Return to heat and simmer 5 minutes stirring occasionally
13. Add broccoli pieces to chicken stock and puree in an electric blender , in batches , until smooth
14. Shortly before serving , blend in cream and cheese
15. Simmer gently until cheese melts
16. Add nutmeg , and salt and pepper to taste
17. Add reserved broccoli florets to heat through
18. Serve immediately

title: lamb shanks with chickpeas and olives
steps:
1. Finely slice the red onions and crush the garlic
2. Mince up the anchovies
3. Combine with the chickpeas , lamb shanks , tin tomatoes , chili and rosemary in a slow-cooker or casserole dish
4. Season with salt and pepper
5. Cook in the slow cooker on low for 6-8 hours , or in the oven at 180c for 3 hours , stirring occasionally
6. You might need to add stock or water if cooking in the oven
7. Five minutes before serving stir through the pitted green olives coarsely chopped , and just before serving finish with stirring in the lemon zest and chopped parsley

title: baked shrimp balls
steps:
1. Place everything into a bowl and mix together
2. Shape mixture into small balls
3. Place on a lightly greased cookie sheet
4. Spray balls with olive oil and bake at 350f for 25 minutes
5. Serve hot with lemon wedges or chili sauce

title: party shrimp
steps:
1. Arrange shrimp , artichoke hearts and mushrooms in a casserole
2. Melt butter in saucepan over low heat
3. Stir in flour , salt and pepper
4. Gradually add milk and cream , stirring constantly
5. Add worcestershire sauce and sherry
6. Pour sauce over shrimp mixture in casserole
7. Sprinkle parmesan cheese and paprika on top
8. Bake in 375 degree oven for 30 minutes
9. May be served over rice
10. This may be prepared in advance and baked before serving
11. Freezes well , but sauce will need to be thinned after being frozen

title: valentine cutouts
steps:
1. In a bowl , dissolve gelatin in water
2. Set aside for 30 minutes
3. In a small bowl , whisk milk and pudding mix until smooth , about 1 minute
4. Quickly pour into gelatin
5. Whisk until well blended
6. Pour into an oiled 13x9x2 in dish
7. Chill till set
8. Cut into cubes or use a heart shaped cookie cutter

title: deep fried artichoke hearts
steps:
1. Thaw the artichoke hearts
2. Place flour in a bowl and add egg yolks , nutmeg and salt , pepper and tabasco to taste
3. Gradually beat in 1 cup milk
4. Stir in baking powder
5. Coat artichokes in batter
6. Adjust the consistancy with the extra milk if needed
7. Drop the artichokes one at a time into oil , heated to 360 degrees
8. Cook , turning , until golden brown
9. Remove with a slotted spoon and drain on paper towels
10. Serve hot with your favorite dipping sauce !

title: festive pumpkin pie
steps:
1. Cream the cream cheese , brown sugar , spices and salt together , in a bowl , until they are light and fluffy , using an electric mixer set on medium speed
2. Add the eggs , one at a time , beating well after each addition
3. Blend in the pumpkin , milk , and vanilla
4. Pour the mixture into the unbaked pie shell
5. Bake in a preheated oven at 375 degrees fahrenheit for 45 to 50 minutes or until a knife inserted halfway between the edge and center comes out clean
6. Cool slightly on a wire rack
7. While cooling , blend the sour cream and sugar together , then spread over the top of the warm pie
8. Return the pie to the oven and bake an additional 3 to 5 minutes or just until the topping is set
9. Cool on a wire rack
10. Cover and chill in the refrigerator before serving

title: vegan cocoa applesauce bread
steps:
1. Combine dry ingredients , then add the wet ingredients to the mixture
2. Don't overmix
3. Bake at 350 degrees for 50 minutes in a loaf pan
4. Let cool and remove from pan
5. Mix together powdered sugar and soy milk for the glaze and drizzle over the top
6. Let sit at least 10 minutes and serve

title: sweet potato chocolate bars
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 375f
2. Rub the sweet potatoes with the vegetable oil and place on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper
3. Bake until fork-tender , 1 to 1 1 / 2 hours
4. Remove from the oven and let cool , then peel and mash in a large bowl
5. Add to the mashed potatoes the brown sugar , cinnamon , nutmeg , salt , vanilla , eggs , and 2 1 / 2 cups of the milk and mix well
6. Set aside
7. Lower the oven temperature to 350 degrees f
8. Combine the graham cracker crumbs and pecan pieces in a food processor and process for about 1 minute , to make a fine meal
9. With the motor running , gradually pour the melted butter through the feed tube and process for 1 minute
10. Transfer the crumb mixture to a 13 x 18-inch baking pan and , using your fingers , firmly press the crumbs evenly onto the bottom and up the sides of the pan
11. Pour the sweet potato mixture into the crust and spread evenly with a rubber spatula
12. Put the chocolate morsels and the remaining 1 / 2 cup milk in a medium-size saucepan over medium heat and stir constantly until the chocolate melts and the mixture is smooth
13. Spoon the chocolate in three rows , about 2 inches apart , lengthwise over the sweet potato mixture
14. Then , with a knife , make a zigzag pattern to marbleize the chocolate and the sweet potato mixture
15. Bake until the edges are browned and the filling is set , 20 to 25 minutes
16. Remove from the oven and let cool completely
17. To serve , cut into bars

title: 8 layer jello salad
steps:
1. Dissolve 1 pkg of jello in l cups of boiling water-
2. Pour into 9 x 13 pan and let gel in level frig-
3. In saucepan , combine 2 cups milk and 1 cup sugar , bring to boil
4. When boiling starts remove from heat
5. In mean time , dissolve 2 env unflavored gelatin in cup cold water ,
6. Slowly add to milk mixture after you remove it from the heat
7. Let mixture cool then add sour cream and 2 tsp vanilla , mix well
8. Pour 1 cup milk mixture over jello layer , let chill approximately 1 hour
9. Then carefully add next layer of jello , let chill approximately 1 hour or until solid
10. Continue until you have 8 layers
11. This can be made a day or two in advance

title: pesto rippled scrambled eggs
steps:
1. Place the garlic and pine nuts in a food processor and blitz until finely chopped
2. Add the basil and the parmesan and blitz again until well blended
3. Add the oil and some salt and pepper and pulse until well combined
4. Heat the butter in a small pan and crack the eggs , season , then leave to set for 2 minutes
5. With a wooden spoon , stir very gently so the eggs begin to set in clumps of white and yellow
6. Before the eggs have completely set , lightly stir in the pesto
7. Pile on to hot toast or bagels , scatter over the parmesan and serve immediately

title: well seasoned burgers
steps:
1. In a bowl , combine beef , cumin , salt , cayenne , thyme , garlic powder and minced dehydrated onion with a fork until spices are evenly mixed with meat
2. Divide mixture into 4 even portions and form each into a 3 / 4-inch-thick patty
3. Do not overwork the meat , and do not pack it tightly , or you will end up with a tough burger
4. Heat a nonstick skillet over medium heat
5. Add burgers and cook 5 minutes on each side , or to desired degree of doneness
6. Serve on rolls

title: basic vanilla glaze
steps:
1. In a small bowl , combine ingredients
2. Mix until smooth
3. Let stand for 5 minutes

title: vegetarian quiche with potato crust
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Press shredded potatoes into a lightly oiled large deep dish pie pan
3. Place pie plate in oven for 10-15 minutes until the potatoes are just beginning to brown
4. While potato-crust is cooking , work on the veggies
5. Brush fry pan with olive oil and saute the onions and peppers until onions are transparent , remove from heat
6. Cook the broccoli until slightly tender -- either by steaming for about 5 minutes or zapping in a covered microwavable dish with a splash of water for about 2 minutes
7. Beat the eggs in a bowl with the evaporated milk
8. After removing the potatoes from the oven , sprinkle about 2 / 3 cup of the cheese over the potato crust
9. Spread the cooked onions and peppers evenly in the pie pan
10. Spread the broccoli evenly over the onions and peppers
11. Sprinkle the crumbled veggie bacon over the veggies
12. This should basically fill the deep dish pie pan completely
13. Sprinkle the rest of cheese over the veggies
14. Carefully pour the milk and egg mixture into the deep dish pie pan
15. Place in the oven for 45 minutes or until egg is cooked and firm
16. Cool for 5 to 10 minutes before serving

title: provolone grissinis
steps:
1. Mix cheese , salami & cream together
2. Brush one sheet of phyllo with butter , top with another sheet and brush again with butter
3. Cut pastry sheet into 6 rectangles and place one teaspoonful of salami mixture at one end of each rectangle and roll the pastry up to enclose the filling
4. Repeat with remaining pastry & salami
5. Brush with remaining butter & bake at 200
6. C for 10-15 minutes
7. Serve with a tomato sipping sauce
8. Recipe #335677 is good !

title: pizzaghetti
steps:
1. Brown hamburger meat & drain
2. Mix in water , diced tomatoes , & tomato sauce
3. Bring to a boil then add olives , noodles , mushrooms & olive oil
4. Turn to medium low heat & let cook for 20-25 minute
5. You can top with parmesan cheese & serve with garlic bread ! enjoy !

title: chocolate peanut butter oatmeal protein bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Mix all ingredients together , adding water slowly until you can get it all mixed , but not too wet
3. Push mixture into a 9x13 baking pan
4. Bake approximately 8-10 minutes , or until mostly dry
5. Let cool , and store in refrigerator
6. Cut into however many servings you like , based on size

title: dillard s garden room dutch potato soup copycat
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large stockpot
2. Add onion , celery , carrots and garlic
3. Cook over medium heat about 15 minutes , stirring often
4. Add pepper , bay leaf , and 8 cups of the stock
5. In a separate pan , melt margarine over medium heat
6. Whisk in flour
7. Cook 10 minutes , whisking occasionally
8. Add remaining 4 cups stock , whisking to remove any lumps
9. Add thickened stock to vegetable mixture , increase heat to high and bring to a boil
10. Reduce to a simmer and cook until vegetables are soft , about 45 minutes
11. Remove from heat
12. Stir in potatoes
13. Stir well
14. Cover and let stand for 30 minutes
15. Salt and pepper to taste

title: cowboy ground chuck stew
steps:
1. Brown burger with the onion and gr
2. Pepper
3. Drain off grease
4. Then add rest of ingredients
5. Simmer till potatoes are soft
6. About 30 minutes

title: asparagus mousse
steps:
1. Whip juice into cream cheese
2. Add mayo and well mashed asparagus
3. Set aside
4. Dissolve jello in boiling water and cool
5. When cool combine with other indgredients
6. Add almond extract and almonds
7. Pour into 9x13 pan and refrigerate until firm
8. Cut into squares

title: south texas carne guisada
steps:
1. Cut beef into 3 / 4-inch cubes
2. In nonstick skillet over medium heat , saute beef until brown
3. Add oil and flour and toss with beef until flour is brown
4. Add water and spices , stirring well
5. Add beef broth and reduce heat to medium low
6. Simmer approximately 30 minutes until beef is tender
7. Serve spooned onto flour tortillas
8. Garnish with sour cream , cheese and pico de gallo

title: tequila lime halibut
steps:
1. Marinate the halibut in tequila , lime , cilantro , and garlic
2. Sauce preparation: blend sauce ingredients in blender or food processor
3. Broil the fish and drizzle with sauce
4. Serve with rice and seasonal vegetable and a wedge of lime

title: double chocolate bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Combine cookie crumbs and butter
3. Pat into bottom of an ungreased 13x9 baking pan
4. Combine milk and 1 cup of chocolate chips in a microwave-safe bowl
5. Microwave on high for 1 minute , or until chips are melted
6. Stir until smooth
7. Pour over the cookie crust
8. Sprinkle with remaining chips
9. Bake for 10 - 12 minutes or until the chips are melted
10. Cool and enjoy !

title: white chocolate pecan pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
2. Layer the pecans and white chocolate chips on the bottom of your pie shell
3. In a medium bowl , whisk together the eggs , brown sugar , corn syrup and flour until thoroughly combined
4. Carefully pour the mixture over the nuts and white chips
5. Bake the pie until the crust is golden brown and the filling is set in the center , about 35-40 minutes
6. Transfer pie to a wire rack and let cool for a couple of hours
7. Serve with whipped cream , ice cream , or all by itself

title: cream of cauliflower soup with saffron
steps:
1. Combine 2 cups water and 2 cups low-salt chicken broth in medium saucepan
2. Bring mixture just to simmer
3. Remove from heat
4. Add saffron threads
5. Cover and steep 20 minutes
6. Melt 3 tablespoons butter in heavy medium pot over medium-low heat
7. Add chopped onions and saut until very tender but not brown , about 10 minutes
8. Add cauliflower pieces
9. Stir to coat
10. Add saffron broth
11. Bring to simmer over high heat
12. Reduce heat , cover , and simmer until cauliflower pieces are tender , about 20 minutes
13. Working in batches , puree cauliflower mixture in food processor until smooth
14. Transfer cauliflower puree to large saucepan
15. Stir in half and half and bring to simmer
16. Season to taste with salt and pepper
17. Ladle soup into bowls
18. Garnish with sliced fresh chives and serve
19. Makes 6 first-course servings

title: hawaiian sunset cake
steps:
1. In a large mixing bowl , combine the first six ingredients
2. Mix well
3. Pour into three greased and floured 9 inch round baking pans
4. Bake at 350f for 25-30 minutes or until a toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean
5. Cool for 10 minutes before removing from pans to wire racks to cool completely
6. In a bowl , combine the pineapple , sugar , coconut and sour cream
7. Remove 1 c
8. To another bowl
9. Set aside
10. Place one cake on a serving plate
11. Top with one third of the remaining pineapple mixture
12. Repeat layers twice
13. Fold whipped topping into the reserved pineapple mixture
14. Spread over top and sides of cake
15. Sprinkle with toasted coconut if desired
16. Refrigerate

title: uber easy lentil chili
steps:
1. Cooked lentils as directed on package
2. When water is almost all absorbed , add tomato soup , garlic , pepper and onion
3. Season with sugar sweetener , salt and pepper to your taste
4. Cook further if you want a thick chili or add a little water if you want it thinner

title: cornmeal bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400-degrees f
2. In a large bowl combine dry ingredients , tossing with a fork to combine
3. In a small bowl beat egg with oil until combined and then whisk in the water
4. Meanwhile heat a cast iron skillet in the oven until hot
5. Oil pan with 1 tablespoon oil and then return to oven while mixing the batter
6. Add the wet to the dry ingredients , mixing to combine
7. Pour batter into hot skillet and bake for 15 minutes or until top is brown and firm
8. Or instead of baking it in the skillet you can use an oiled muffin pan and make 9-12 muffins

title: broiled tofu or tempeh
steps:
1. Spray a pyrex pie plate with oil
2. Put 1 / 4 of the soy in it
3. Cut the tofu or tempeh into small bite size pieces and put in the pie plate
4. Add the chopped mushrooms , garlic& ginger
5. Sprinkle remaining 3 tbsp of soy on top
6. Sprinkle with the parsley
7. Broil 6" from heat source for approximately 10 minutes or until the soy is bubbling and the tofu / tempeh is browned

title: ken hom s  dead easy  chicken
steps:
1. Remove as much fat as possible from chicken thighs
2. Place flour on a plate and roll chicken in flour , shaking off excess
3. Mix chicken broth , vinegar , five-spice powder , garlic , soy sauce and water together in a small bowl
4. Heat oil in a wok or skillet over high heat until smoking
5. Brown chicken on all sides , about 2 minutes
6. Add sauce and lower heat to medium
7. Simmer 25 minutes , turning chicken a few times
8. Liquid should be just at the bubbling stage
9. The sauce will boil down to a glaze
10. Serve over rice

title: easy bundt cake with flavors of almond and vanilla
steps:
1. Heat brown sugar , butter , and almond extract in a small saucepan
2. Stir until blended
3. Arrange frozen rolls in a lightly greased 10-cup bundt pan
4. Drizzle sugar mixture evenly over rolls
5. Sprinkle with pudding mix and almonds
6. Cover and let stand at room temperature 3 hours
7. Bake uncovered , on lower oven rack at 350 degres for 30 minutes or til golden brown
8. Remove from oven , and let stand 10 minutes
9. Invert pan onto a lightly greased plate
10. Serve warm

title: grasshopper pie
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , whisk mik and pudding mix for 2 minutes
2. Let stand for 2 minutes or until soft-set
3. Fold in 3 / 4 cup whipped topping
4. Fold in 3 / 4 cup chopped candies
5. Spoon into crust
6. In another bowl , combine mint extract and the remaninng whipped topping , and add food coloring if desired
7. Spread over the pudding layer and sprinkle with the remaining candies
8. Cover and refrigerate for 4 hours or until set

title: cheese chili dip
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients
2. Keep warm in chafing dish

title: weight watchers layered fruit salad
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan , combine the orange juice and zest , lemon juice and rind , brown sugar and cinnamon stick
2. Bring to a boil
3. Reduce the heat and simmer , uncovered , for about 5 minutes
4. Remove from the heat and let cool completely
5. Layer the fruit in a glass serving bowl
6. Remove the cinnamon stick from the sauce
7. Pour the sauce over the fruit
8. Cover and chill for several hours before serving

title: black eyed pea hummus
steps:
1. Add garlic to a food processor
2. Process to chop
3. Add the black-eyed peas , lemon juice , oil , salt and pepper to taste
4. Process until smooth
5. Add tahini with the processor running
6. Process until all ingredients come together
7. Adjust seasonings
8. If too thick , add additional lemon juice or oil

title: iced coffee chocolate soda frappe
steps:
1. In a large heat-proof mixing bowl stir together instant coffee granules with chocolate syrup , sugar and boiling water
2. Cool to almost room temperature , then refrigerate for at least 8 hours
3. Stir together the coffee mixture with half and half cream and 1 quart ice cream
4. Stir in ginger ale soda
5. Mix to combine
6. Ladle the mixture into large tall glasses about 3 / 4 full , then top with a scoop of vanilla ice cream
7. Serve immediately

title: south carolina mustard bbq sauce
steps:
1. Heat all ingredients in a saucepan for 5 minutes to dissolve the sugar
2. Allow to cool before using
3. Refrigerate leftover sauce in an airtight container

title: fish with cheese and crackers
steps:
1. Place fish in baking dish
2. Spread cheddar cheese over fish
3. Cover with parmesan cheese
4. Melt butter and mix with crushed crackers
5. Cover fish with cracker crumbs and bake at 350 degrees for 15 to 20 minutes

title: marinated grilled shrimp
steps:
1. In a large bowl , mix together all ingredients except for shrimp
2. Add shrimp to the bowl , and stir until evenly coated
3. Cover and refrigerate for 30 minutes to 1 hour , stirring once or twice
4. Preheat grill for medium heat
5. Thread shrimp onto skewers
6. Discard marinade
7. Lightly oil grill grate
8. Cook shrimp on preheated grill for 2 to 3 minutes per side , or until opaque

title: spring vegetable soup
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large saucepan and cook leek about 3 minutes until softened
2. Add the carrot and celery , cook 5 minutes
3. Add potato , tomatoes and stock , bring to a simmer and cook 15 minutes
4. Add beans and cook a further 5 minutes , season to taste
5. Add parsley and stir to combine
6. Divide soup between warmed bowls
7. Place a pile of shredded spinach on top of soup and serve immediately

title: tomato cheddar rarebit
steps:
1. Melt butter in large heavy casserole or dutch oven over medium heat
2. Add onion and cook 3 minutes
3. Stir in tomatoes and cook gently , breaking up tomatoes , about 5 minutes
4. Let stand until about 15 minutes before serving
5. Add beer to tomato mixture and heat to simmering
6. Reduce heat to maintain slow simmer , then stir in cheese 1 handful at a time , adding next handful when first is almost completely melted
7. Stir in mustard , worcestershire , pepper sauce , and ground pepper
8. Mix cornstarch and the cold water until completely smooth
9. Add to rarebit and cook , stirring constantly , until slightly thickened , about 2 minutes
10. Spoon over whole-wheat biscuit triangles

title: ww 6 points loaded bacon cheddar fries
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees
2. Scrub potato and rinse
3. Cut potato into 1 / 2" strips , leaving skin on
4. Spray baking sheet with cooking spray
5. Place potato strips on baking sheet , skin side down
6. Bake for 20 minutes , then turn potatoes and bake additonal 15 minutes
7. Top fries with cheese and sprinkle with bacon bits
8. Return baking sheet to oven for a minute to melt the cheese
9. Add optional dollop of sour cream to top or on the side

title: baked scotch eggs
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Combine sausage , rosemary , mustard , and fresh bread crumbs and mix well , then divide into 6 portions
3. Flatten each postion in the palm of your hand , put a hard boiled egg in the centre , and mold the sausage mixture around the egg to cover it completely , then set aside on wax paper
4. Combine raw eggs and sherry in a bowl and mix well and put the dry bread crumbs in a separate bowl
5. Roll each sausage covered egg in dry crumbs , then the beaten egg , then in crumbs again
6. On an ungreased cookie sheet , bake for about 30 minutes , until nicely browned
7. Serve hot , warm , or cold

title: blueberry and oatmeal pancakes
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , whisk together milk , quick-cooking oats 2 tablespoons of the maple syrup , melted butter and egg
2. Let stand for 15 minutes or until oats are slightly softened and mixture has thickened
3. In a large bowl , whisk together flour , baking powder , baking soda , and salt
4. Pour oatmeal mixture over dry ingredients
5. Sprinkle with 1 cup of the blueberries
6. Stir gently until combined
7. A few lumps will remain
8. I a large nonstick skillet over medium heat , melt 1 teaspoons of the butter
9. Ladle about 1 / 4 cup batter per pancake into skillet
10. Cook for 2 minutes or until bubbles break on pancake surface and edges appear slightly dry
11. Turn and cook for 1-2 minutes longer or until puffed and golden
12. Repeat with remaining butter and batter , adjusting heat as needed to prevent burning
13. In a small bowl , combine yogurt and remaining 2 tablespoons maple syrup
14. Top each pancake with 1 tablespoons maple yogurt
15. Sprinkle with a few of the remaining blueberries
16. Serve immediately

title: lemony fruit salad
steps:
1. Combine fruit in a bowl
2. Use a mixture of fruit-- about 1 / 2 cup of each
3. For example: cut-up peaches , apricots , apples , melon , orange segments , blueberries , halved seedless grapes , quartered strawberries , etc
4. Combine water , sugar , cornstarch and lemon juice in a small saucepan
5. Stir to dissolve cornstarch
6. Over medium heat , bring to a boil , stirring constantly
7. Cook and stir for 1 minute longer
8. Remove from heat
9. Add lemon zest and vanilla
10. Allow sauce to cool for 15 minutes
11. Pour sauce over fruit
12. Mix well
13. Chill in fridge until serving time

title: amish oats
steps:
1. Combine ingredients
2. Mix well
3. Spread evenly into 13x9x2 greased baking pan
4. Bake at 350 for 25-30 minutes or until edges are golden brown
5. Serve warm

title: rogene s fabulous caramel clusters
steps:
1. Heat oven to 300 degress
2. Melt caramels with water in 2-3 quart saucepan on low heat , stirring frequently until smooth
3. Add cereal and pecans
4. Mix lightly until well coated
5. Spread into greased 15x10 pan
6. Bake 25 minutes , stirring after 15 minutes
7. Turn out onto greased wax paper
8. Cool thoroughly , then break apart
9. Microwave
10. Variation: add 1 / 2 cup semi-sweet real chocolate chips to cooled mixture , mix lightly

title: died and gone to heaven cheesecake
steps:
1. Blend cream cheese and sugar in bowl
2. And eggs and vanilla
3. Beat well
4. Stir in mini-chips
5. Pour into crust
6. Bake at 450 degrees for`10 minutes without opening door , reduce temp
7. To 250 degrees
8. Continue to bake for 20- 25 minutes
9. Cool completely
10. Cover , chill thouroughly
11. Spread top w / chocolate topping
12. Chill several minutes or just until set
13. Chocolate topping: place mini chips and cream in microwave safe bowl
14. Microwave at high for 20 seconds or just until chocolate is melted and mixture is smooth when stirred
15. Cool slightly
16. Dig in and enjoy

title: cheesesteak calzone
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. In large skillet , cook chipped steak with onion until meat is no longer pink
3. Break up meat with spatula and drain meat
4. Lightly grease an 11" x 14" cookie sheet
5. Gently spread dough out on cookie sheet to a rectangle about 1 / 4" to 1 / 2" thick
6. Spoon ricotta cheese down the middle lengthwise
7. Arrange cooked chipped steak / onion mix on top
8. Top with green peppers and mushrooms
9. Top with slices of american cheese
10. Gently fold long ends together , pressing down seams to seal
11. Bake at 400 for about 20 minutes or until lightly brown
12. Serve with hot pizza sauce for dipping

title: lisa s streusel topping
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients except for the butter
2. Warm butter to room temperature
3. Cut butter into pieces then mix with the rest of the mixture
4. Use for apple crisp

title: lavender  honey chicken breast
steps:
1. Wash the chicken breasts well , remove the skin and pat dry
2. Combine honey , lavender blossoms , and black pepper in a small bowl and set aside
3. Sprinkle the chicken breasts with salt , pepper and lavender blossoms-rub well and place in a baking dish
4. Bake 1 hour 350 degrees
5. The last half hour of baking , baste the chicken with the honey mixture several times until the chicken is golden brown and cooked completely

title: lemon drops
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f line 2 large cookie sheets with parchment paper
2. Set aside
3. In the bowl of an electric stand mixer , beat the butter or margarine and the sugar on high speed , until smooth and creamy
4. Add the egg yolk and vanilla and lemon extracts
5. Mix for 1 minute , scraping down the sides
6. In a medium bowl , sift the flour and salt together
7. Add half the flour mixture to the egg mixture
8. Add the milk and then the remaining flour mixture
9. Mix until just combined
10. Set aside
11. Place the dough between two pieces of parchment paper and , with a rolling pin , flatten to 1 / 4-inch thickness
12. Using the top of a spice jar or a 1 1 / 2-inch round cookie cutter , cut out cookies
13. Re-roll the scraps into another mound of dough to be rolled out
14. Place the rounds 1 1 / 2 inches apart on the prepared cookie sheets
15. Bake for 10 - 12 minutes or until golden
16. Remove from oven and let cool for 10 minutes
17. Fill a fine mesh sieve with the confectioner's sugar
18. Hold it over the cookies and tap the sieve lightly with a fork or spoon to shake out the sugar , completely covering the cookies
19. When the cookies are completely cool , turn 1 cookie over , spread a small dollop of lemon pie filling on each and top with a second cookie to form a sandwich
20. Repeat with remaining cookies until all cookies are used up

title: tsr orange chicken
steps:
1. Combine all of the sauce ingredients-- except the corn starch-- in a small saucepan over high heat
2. Stir often while bringing mixture to a boil
3. When sauce reaches a boil , remove it from heat and allow it to cool a bit , uncovered
4. Slice chicken breasts into bite-size chunks
5. Remove exactly 1 cup of the marinade from the pan and pour it over the chicken in a large resealable plastic bag or other container which allows the chicken to be completely covered with the marinade
6. The chicken should marinate for at least a couple hours
7. Cover the remaining sauce and leave it to cool until the chicken is ready
8. When chicken has marinated , preheat 2-inches of vegetable oil in a wok or skillet to 350 degrees
9. Put corn starch in a small bowl , then add 3 tablespoons of water
10. Stir until corn starch has dissolved
11. Pour this mixture into the sauce and set the pan over high heat
12. When sauce begins to bubble and thicken cover and remove it from heat
13. Beat together the ice water and egg in a medium bowl
14. Add baking soda and salt
15. Add 3 / 4 cup of the flour and stir with a fork just until the flour in blended into the mixture
16. The batter should still be lumpy
17. Sprinkle another 1 / 4 cup of flour on top of the batter and mix with only one or two strokes
18. Most of the new flour will still floating on top of the mixture
19. Put the remaining flour into a separate medium bowl
20. Dip each piece of chicken first into the flour , then into the batter
21. Let some of the batter drip off and then slide the chicken into the oil
22. Fry up to 1 / 2 of the chicken pieces at a time for 3-4 minutes , or until golden brown
23. Flip the chicken over halfway through the cooking time
24. Remove the chicken to a rack or paper towels to drain
25. As the chicken cooks , reheat the sauce left covered on the stove
26. Stir occasionally
27. When all of the chicken is done , pour it into a large bowl , and cover with the thickened sauce
28. Stir gently until all of the pieces are well coated

title: family sized chicken pot pie
steps:
1. Heat the oil and butter in a pot over low heat
2. Add the onion
3. Cook , stirring , for 10 minutes
4. Add the garlic
5. Cook 2 minutes more
6. Sprinkle with the flour and tarragon
7. Cook , stirring constantly , for 1 to 2 minutes more
8. Add the carrots , potatoes , apple , and broth
9. Bring to a boil
10. Reduce heat to a gentle simmer and cook , partially covered , until the vegetables are tender , about 20 minutes
11. Add the peas , dill , and chicken
12. Season to taste with salt and pepper , then cook 5 minutes more
13. Preheat the oven to 350f
14. Spoon the mixture into a 2-quart round ovenproof casserole
15. On a lightly floured surface , roll puff pastry out to form a circle 2 inches larger than the casserole
16. Lay the pastry over the top , trim the overhang to 1 inch , and crimp the edges around the rim to seal
17. Cut several slits in the pastry to release the steam , then brush with remaining egg wash
18. Bake until crust is golden , 40 to 45 minutes

title: oriental blossom fizz
steps:
1. Shake all ingredients , straining optional
2. Top with champagne in a flute

title: mac and cheese
steps:
1. Cook macaroni al dente
2. Sweat onion
3. Add onion to heated mixture of cheese and milk
4. Add flour to thicken
5. Pour over macaroni
6. Cook at 375 for 30 minutes

title: lina s awesome lebanese spinach  beef   rice
steps:
1. In a cooking pot , add olive oil and heat for a moment
2. Add onions and saut
3. Add ground beef and cook until beef is brown
4. Add allspice , cinnamon , and salt
5. Mix
6. Add spinach and saut with meat for a moment
7. Once its all mixed well together , add water to the pot , just enough to cover the spinach cover and let the spinach meat mixure boil and then turn it down to medium heat and let it simmer / boil for a good 30 minutes
8. Meanwhile , get a saut pan and add some olive oil , the garlic , and the chopped cilantro and saut that mixture together
9. Add cilantro / garlic mixture to the spinach
10. Cover and let it simmer for about 15 more minutes
11. Serve with rice and squeeze lemon juice on top !
12. Using frozen chopped spinach works better than fresh spinach
13. It does not turn out the same if you use fresh
14. The frozen chopped is much better
15. I have tried both
16. Trust me !
17. Be sure when adding water to the pot that you dont add too much
18. You want just enough to cover the spinach
19. The spinach will release some water too !
20. Squeezing the lemon on top of the spinach dish when its being served is the most important part of the dish ! dont forget to do that , or youll miss out on the awesome taste of this dish !

title: hard rock cafe baked potato soup
steps:
1. Saut the onions in the reserved bacon drippings over medium high heat until transparent , about 3 minutes
2. Add flour , stirring to prevent lumps
3. Cook for 3-5 minutes , until mixture just begins to turn golden
4. Add chicken stock gradually , whisking to prevent lumps until liquid thickens
5. Reduce heat to simmer and add potatoes , cream , chopped bacon , parsley , garlic , basil , salt substitute , red pepper sauce and black pepper
6. Simmer for 10 minutes
7. Do not allow to boil
8. Add grated cheese and green onions , heat until cheese melts smoothly
9. Garnish each serving as desired with chopped bacon , grated cheese and chopped parsley

title: chinese lemon chicken
steps:
1. Place cut chicken breast pieces into a bowl and mix with 2 tablespoons of soy sauce and teaspoon of salt
2. Cover and marinate in the refrigerator for 30 minutes
3. To make the batter beat 2 large eggs with cup of cornstarch , a pinch of white pepper and baking powder
4. Coat the chicken with the batter
5. Heat deep fryer to 350 degrees and deep-fry in batches until chicken is fully cooked
6. Drain on paper towels and set aside
7. You can also cook the chicken using a wok if you dont have a deep fryer
8. Now , to make the lemon sauce combine 1 / 3 cup of sugar , 2 tablespoons cornstarch , 1 cup chicken broth , 2 tablespoons lemon juice , and teaspoon salt
9. Mix until well combined and add 3 slices of lemon to the sauce mixture
10. Heat 2 tablespoons of oil in your wok and stir in the lemon sauce mixture and heat until well mixed and sauce becomes clear
11. Remove lemon slices and pour the sauce over the chicken and mix

title: broccoli with cranberries salad
steps:
1. For the salad ~ in a large salad bowl , mix all salad ingredients
2. For the dressing ~ in a small bowl , beat all dressing ingredients with wire whisk until blended
3. Spoon over salad & toss to mix well
4. Refrigerate 1 hour before serving , & refrigerate any leftovers

title: healthy oatmeal cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Beat butter , splenda brown sugar , and splenda until creamy
3. Add eggs
4. Beat well
5. Add flour , soda , salt , and cinnamon
6. Mix well
7. Add vanilla
8. Stir in oats and raisins
9. Drop cookies on a greased cookie sheet
10. Bake for 10-12 minutes or until golden brown

title: sables  norman sugar cookies
steps:
1. Sift the flour and the sugar into a large bowl and add the butter , bit by but , mixing with an electric mixer or by hand
2. Continue mixing until the dough takes on a sandy consistency
3. Add four of the egg yolks , one by one , the salt and the vanilla , continuing to mix
4. Form the dough into a ball , wrap in plastic , and refrigerate for at least an hour
5. Pre-heat the oven to 350 degrees
6. Roll out the dough to a thickness of 1 / 4"
7. With a cookie or biscuit cutter cut out two inch circles and place on a lightly buttered cookie sheet
8. Mix the remaining egg yolk with the milk and , with a pastry brush , coat the top of each cookie
9. With the
10. Bake for 15 minutes or until lightly browned
11. Remove from oven , cool on a rack and store in an airtight container

title: horchata  ground rice drink
steps:
1. Need also large capacity blender
2. Place rice in a bowl with enough hot water to cover
3. Let sit overnight on counter
4. Next day , remove the water
5. Place rice , 1 / 2 cup fresh water and 2 cups milk in a blender until rice is all ground up
6. Add sugar , vanilla , and cinnamon
7. Blend
8. Add the remaining two cups milk , and 1 / 2 cup water
9. Blend
10. Strain through thickly layered cheesecloth
11. Chill and serve
12. Makes approximately 6 cups
13. Also , the rice starch in this drink is an excellent way to "put out the fire" on your tongue while eating hot / spicy meals
14. In summertime , add crushed ice to drink to make a slushy

title: crock pot venison stroganoff
steps:
1. Cut stew meat into 1" pieces
2. Dredge meat in flour
3. Brown meat in oil with onion
4. Transfer meat & onion to crock pot
5. Add garlic , spices , wine and crushed tomatoes
6. Cook on low for 4-5 hours
7. 30 minutes before serving add sour cream
8. Boil noodles according to package directions
9. Serve over noodles

title: lex s roast chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Saute onions and celery in olive oil over medium heat for about 10 minutes
3. Stirring occasionally
4. Add zest , salt , garlic , pepper , thyme , and red pepper
5. Continue to saute until onions and celery are soft and translucent , about 5 more minutes
6. Remove from hear
7. Stir in parsley and set aside
8. Spray chicken on both sides with cooking spray
9. Season with pepper and salt
10. Layer bread , onion mixture , then chicken in a lightly oiled pan
11. Pour lemon juice over chicken and roast , uncovered for 1 1 / 2 hours , or until golden brown and at least 160-165 degrees
12. Check for doneness the last 15 minutes
13. Remove from oven and serve , spoon some bread and vegetables onto each plate and top with chicken
14. Enjoy !

title: kick off nachos
steps:
1. Mix soup and salsa in small saucepan and heat through
2. Serve over tortilla chips
3. Top with tomato , onions , olives , and sour cream

title: zinfandel braised beef short ribs
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 deg f
2. Melt 1 tbl butter in heavy large ovenproof pot over medium-high heat
3. Sprinkle ribs with coarse salt and pepper , and add to pot in single-layer without crowding
4. When browned on all sides , remove to bowl
5. Add 1 tbl butter to pot
6. Add onions and saute until brown , about 6 minutes
7. Add parsnips and saute until they begin to color , about 6 minutes
8. Add garlic and then the rosemary
9. Add wine and broth and bring to a boil , scraping up the browned bits from the bottom of the pot
10. Return the ribs and any accumulated juices to the pot in a single layer
11. Bring to a simmer , cover , and place in oven
12. Braise until the ribs are very tender , about 2 1 / 2 hours
13. Using tongs , remove ribs to a serving bowl and keep warm
14. Skim fat from the gravy , and boil until it starts to thicken , about 10 minutes
15. In the meantime , mix together 1 tbl butter with the flour
16. Adding it in bits , whisk this into the gravy and continue to cook until it's thick enough to coat a spoon , about 5 minutes longer
17. Season with salt and pepper
18. Cover ribs with gravy
19. Rewarm over low heat before serving

title: beef skewers with yogurt dip
steps:
1. Slice the steak , across the grain , into long , thin strips
2. Mix lemon juice with the honey , garlic , marjoram and mint
3. Toss beef strips with the marinade and let stand at room temperature for 30 minutes
4. Meanwhile , soak 24 wooden skewers in cold water
5. To make the dipping sauce , stir the yogurt , feta , lemon juice , garlic , pepper , hot pepper flakes and mint until combined
6. Let stand for 15 minutes to blend the flavours
7. Preheat broiler or grill to medium high
8. Thread beef onto soaked skewers and place on a broiler pan or rack set over a rimmed baking sheet
9. Season with salt and pepper , if desired
10. Broil or grill beef , turning once , for 4 to 5 minutes , or until it reaches medium doneness
11. Serve with dipping sauce

title: coffee nut bars
steps:
1. Dissolve coffee in hot water
2. Set aside
3. Put butter and sugars in mixing bowl and combine
4. Stir in egg and vanilla
5. Sift in flour , baking powder , salt , and baking soda alternately with coffee
6. Spread evenly into 8x8 pan
7. Bake at 350 for 25-30 minutes or until done
8. Cool in pan then dust with powdered sugar
9. :)

title: yo momma     slow cooker beef brisket
steps:
1. Lay the potatoes across the bottom of the insert of the slow cooker
2. Heat 1 tablespoon of the oil in a large saut pan over medium-high heat
3. Brown the brisket well on all sides
4. Place the browned meat in the slow cooker insert
5. Add more oil , if needed , and saut the onions until soft , about 4 minutes
6. Add the garlic and cook 2 minutes more
7. Scrape the vegetables into the insert
8. Pour the beer and broth into the saut pan and bring to a boil , scraping up the meat bits in the pan with a wooden spoon
9. Pour over the meat
10. Add the celery , tomato paste , stewed tomatoes , bay leaves , brown sugar , mustard , vinegar , molasses , soy sauce , and paprika to the insert
11. Cover and cook for 8 hours on low or 5 to 6 hours on high , or until the meat is fork-tender
12. Remove the meat to a cutting board and slice it thinly against the grain
13. Skim any fat from the cooking liquid , discard the bay leaves , taste for seasoning , and add salt and pepper
14. Transfer the meat and potatoes to a serving platter or serve them on individual plates
15. Spoon the cooking liquid on top or on the side

title: dill and horseradish mayonnaise
steps:
1. Mix all together
2. Season to taste
3. Serve with salad

title: diabetic blueberry syrup
steps:
1. In saucepan , combine blueberries with 1 / 8 cup of water , margarine , nutmeg and lemon juice
2. Bring to a boil
3. Reduce heat and simmer til berries are soft
4. Dissolve cornstarch in remaining water
5. Add to blueberries and continue to cook , stirring constantly , until syrup thickens
6. Remove from heat and cool
7. Sir in sweetener
8. Serve warm or chilled

title: individual peach cobbler cups
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Unfold pie crust onto lightly floured surface
3. Cut 4 1 / 2" circles from each crust
4. Cut the scraps into strips or small uneven shapes
5. Place 1 pastry round in the center of a muffin tin and gently press the round down to fit the pan
6. Repeat with remaining 7 round circles
7. Coarsely chop peaches and place them in a medium saucepan or on their own if they are fresh
8. Bring to a boil over medium heat , stirring often , then simmer on low for about 5 to 7 minutes , then drain
9. Combine 1 / 2 cup sugar with the flour and cinnamon in a small bowl and stir into peaches
10. Spoon 1 / 4 cup peach mixture into each pastry lined cup and place 3 to 4 strips of dough over the top of each
11. Press the edges of the dough inward toward the fruit
12. Place cold bits of butter evenly on top of the pastry strips and sprinkle with the remaining 1 tablespoon sugar
13. Bake for 16 to 18 minutes or until crust is golden and filling is bubbly
14. Remove from oven and let pan cool on a wire rack for 5 minutes
15. Run a knife around edges of each cobbler and lift them up from the bottoms with your knife
16. Serve warm with vanilla ice cream

title: kathi s fruit punch
steps:
1. Add your fruit juice concentrates to a punch bowl
2. Fill with 7-up or sprite or other lemon-lime flavoured pop of your choice
3. Stir until concentrates are thoroughly mixed in
4. Float desired fruit or ice ring

title: big batch vegetable soup
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large stockpot over medium heat
2. Add onions or leeks , celery and italian seasoning
3. Season with salt and pepper
4. Cook , stirring frequently , until onions are translucent , 5-8 minutes
5. Add broth , tomatoes and their juice , tomato paste , and 3 cups water to pot
6. Bring mixture to a boil
7. Reduce heat to a simmer , and cook , uncovered , 20 minutes
8. Add vegetables to pot , and return to a simmer
9. Cook , uncovered , until vegetables are tender , 20-25 minutes
10. Season with salt and pepper , as desired
11. Let cool before storing

title: artichoke cheese dip
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Throw all ingredients in blender
3. Blend until smooth
4. Pour into 8x8 glass baking dish
5. Bake 20 - 30 minutes or until bubbly but not brown
6. Serve with bite sized pieces of bread
7. It was good , just not as good
8. Since i only make this for an occassional treat i just go all out with the full fat version
9. I wasn't sure what to list as the servings
10. It just depends on whether your guests will eat anything else you are serving or if they focus on the dip
11. :-) my 6 book club ladies gobbled up the whole batch

title: salmon with a macadamia nut crust
steps:
1. Sprinkle fish with coarse pepper and kosher salt or sea salt
2. In a shallow bowl , whisk egg white until frothy
3. Dip fish in egg white , then coat with nuts
4. Pat nut mixture onto fish
5. In skillet , cook fish in olive oil over medium heat for about 5-7 minute on each side or until fish flakes easily with a fork
6. Meanwhile , melt butter
7. Stir in fresh parsley and squeezed lemon juice
8. Drizzle over fish
9. Serve with brown rice

title: lori s baked pork chops
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees f
2. Pour a small amount of olive oil into casserole and brush to cover the bottom
3. Place the pork chops in the casserole
4. Sprinkle tops with salt and pepper
5. Bake for 15 minutes without a lid
6. While chops bake prepare the stuffing by sauteeing the onions and celery in olive oil until soft
7. Remove to a small mixing bowl
8. Add a small amount of olive oil to the pan and toast the bread cubes until slightly browned
9. Add the to the onion mixture
10. Stir in the oregano and milk
11. Let cool then add the asaigo
12. Remove the pork chops from the oven and place a teaspoon of pesto on the tops
13. Cover with the stuffing and sprinkle with olive oil and balsamic vinegar
14. Return to the oven for 15 minutes or until the chops are 155 degrees f
15. Take the chops out of the oven and sprinkle with a small amount of balsamic vinegar again
16. Serve while warm

title: apple peach crisp
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425
2. Place peaches in an 8x8 baking dish
3. Sprinkle oatmeal over peaches
4. Sprinkle splenda over oatmeal
5. Bake about 30 mins or until brown and bubbly
6. Can be topped with ff whipped topping

title: julie s chili
steps:
1. Brown the ground beef and drain
2. Put the drained beef and the remaining ingredients into a 6 quart pot
3. Cover the pot and let it simmer for 90 minutes
4. Stir every 20 minutes

title: cheesy summer pasta
steps:
1. Cook pasta , adding zucchini during last 2 minutes of cooking
2. Drain and return to saucepan
3. Add tomatoes , garlic , parsley and basil to pasta
4. Add 1 1 / 2 cups cheese and mix until melted
5. Garnish with remaining cheese
6. Serve immediately

title: sugar free cinnamon cookies
steps:
1. Beat eggs and water until light and fluffy
2. Beat in sugar replacement
3. And ground cinnamon
4. Combine flour , baking soda and salt in sifter
5. Sift
6. Half of the dry ingredients over egg mixture
7. Fold to completely blend
8. Repeat with remaining dry ingredients
9. Drop by teaspoonfuls onto greased cookie sheets , 2 to 3 inches apart
10. Bake at 375 degrees f for 10 to 12 minutes

title: gluten free buttermilk cornbread muffins from the baking beautie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. In a microwave safe bowl , melt butter
3. Stir in sugar
4. Add eggs and stir to combine
5. Stir in buttermilk
6. Add dry ingredients and stir until few lumps remain
7. Scoop into prepared muffin tin
8. Bake for 20 minutes in preheated oven , or until a toothpick inserted into the center comes out clean
9. Allow to cool in pan for 5 minutes before removing to cooling rack
10. Best served warm

title: super healthy veggie pita pizza
steps:
1. Put pita bread on baking sheet
2. Brush with olive oil and sprinkle with garlic salt
3. Place tomato slices on pita bread , top with olive slices
4. Cover with sliced spinach and artichoke hearts
5. Sprinkle with italian seasoning and sprinkle cheese evenly over pita
6. Bake at 400 degrees for about 10 minutes
7. Slice into quarters and enjoy !

title: oatmeal sesame bread
steps: 1. Add all ingredients to bread machine and set on whole wheat cycle

title: roasted garlic mashed potatoes lower  healthier fat
steps:
1. Add potatoes to water and bring to a boil add salt to taste and boil for about 20 minutes till tender
2. Drain potatoes into a strainer
3. Return pot to low heat , adding milk , and oil just to warm
4. Meanwhile rice the roasted garlic first then the potatoes into a large bowl
5. Top with fresh cracked black pepper , fresh cracked salt , milk , mayo and oil
6. Stir to blend all ingredients together till creamy and tasty ! go ahead taste it ! go ahead have an other taste
7. If wanted add additional salt and pepper

title: gruyre  apricot jam  and toasted walnut panini
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Place walnuts on baking sheet , and bake 8 to 10 minutes , or until fragrant
3. Cool , and finely chop
4. Preheat panini maker
5. Spread 4 slices bread with 1 teaspoons jam each
6. Sprinkle walnuts on top of jam , and top each with 1 slice gruyre
7. Cover with remaining bread
8. Place sandwiches in panini maker , and bake 2 to 4 minutes , or until bread is golden brown and cheese has melted
9. Slice each sandwich into 4 wedges , and serve warm

title: quick chicken with green beans
steps:
1. Spray a large skillet with cooking spray and place over medium-high heat on stove
2. Add chicken to skillet and cook until browned on all sides
3. Combine remaining ingredients except rice and add to skillet
4. Reduce heat to low , cover and simmer for 5-10 minutes
5. If mixture is too thick after simmering , add milk to desired thickness
6. Serve over warm white rice

title: pesto fettuccine alfredo with mushrooms
steps:
1. Heat butter over medium-high heat until melted
2. Add mushrooms , sauting 3 minutes
3. Add 2 cups of half and half , salt , and pepper , stirring for 5 minutes , but do not let it boil
4. Slowly add parmesan and pesto
5. Heat through and serve over fettuccine

title: 30 minute dinner rolls
steps:
1. Mix warm water , oil , sugar and yeast
2. Let rest for 10 minutes until yeast activates
3. Add salt and beaten egg
4. Blend well
5. Add flour , one cup at a time until soft dough if formed
6. Knead on a floured surface 5-10 minutes or until dough is smooth and elastic
7. Shape into small balls and put into a greased baking pan
8. Let rise at least 5-10 minutes
9. Bake at 425 degrees for 15-20 minutes
10. If you have more time , you can let the rolls rise in the pan until they have doubled in size

title: dreamy fruit dip
steps:
1. In a mixing bowl , combine the cream cheese , sour cream , whipped cream , brown sugar , sugar , maple syrup and vanilla extract
2. Mix until smooth
3. Serve immediately or chill for later

title: to your health  muffins
steps:
1. Blend together in large bowl flour , bran , brown sugar , baking soda , salt , cinnamon , carrots and raisins
2. In second bowl , beat buttermilk , oil , egg and vanilla
3. Add liquid ingredients to dry ingredients and mix just until moistened
4. Spoon into 12 greased or paper-lined muffin cups
5. Bake at 375f for 20 minutes

title: penne with blue cheese  pesto  walnuts  and asparagus
steps:
1. Bring a large pot of water to a boil over high heat
2. Add salt and stir in the penne
3. Reduce to medium-high and cook penne , uncovered , until al dente , 6-7 minutes
4. Meanwhile , place walnuts on a rimmed baking sheet and bake in preheated 350-degree o ven until lightly toasted , 4-5 minutes
5. Place pesto and blue c heese in a large serving bowl and using a fork , mash the blue cheese into the pesto
6. Rinse asparagus spears and snap off and discard their tough ends
7. Break spears into 1 1 / 2-inch long pieces
8. During the last 3 minutes of the penne cooking time , add asparagus to pot and cook until bright green and crisp-tender
9. Drain penne and asparagus well in colander
10. Add to the bowl with the pesto and stir to coat them well
11. Top with toasted walnuts and serve at once

title: egyptian yellow lentil soup
steps:
1. In large skillet over medium heat , heat ghee
2. Working in batches of 6 , saut pita pieces until crisp , about 4 minutes per side
3. Drain on paper towels and set aside
4. Wash lentils well in several changes of water until water runs clear
5. Drain
6. In large saucepan , combine lentils and enough water to cover by 2 inches
7. Add tomato , potato , carrot , and salt and bring to boil
8. Cover and simmer 30 minutes , skimming any foam that forms on top
9. Remove from heat
10. Strain , reserving cooking liquid
11. In blender , pure solids , adding enough reserved liquid to make mixture smooth
12. Set aside
13. In medium pot over moderately high heat , heat corn oil
14. Add onion and saut until golden , about 10 minutes
15. Add pured lentils , beef stock , and cumin
16. Simmer until soup thickens , about 10 minutes
17. Season with salt and pepper to taste
18. Ladle soup into bowls and sprinkle with chopped parsley
19. Serve with fried bread wedges

title: pizza hut hot submarine sandwiches
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Take out the sesame seed hoagie bun and open it up carefully , making sure not to split the bread into two separate halves
3. Lay the open bun flat on a baking sheet
4. On the sandwich put down two slices of salami
5. Top with two slices of ham
6. Place the mozzarella cheese on top of the ham
7. Bake just until the cheese melts
8. Remove from the oven
9. Top with the tomato , lettuce , and then drizzle with the creamy italian dressing
10. Close the sandwich and enjoy

title: singaporean fish curry
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients for the marinade in a bowl
2. Check if all bones are removed from the fish fillets
3. If not , use a pair of tweezers
4. Cut the fish into 1x4 inches pieces and marinate for 30 minutes at room temperature or longer in the fridge
5. Heat a wok on high temperature , put in oil
6. Reduce heat to the lowest temperature and add chopped onion , garlic and mustard seeds
7. Cook on very low heat for 5 minutes or more , stirring frequently
8. Add fish fillets , marinade , tomatoes , chillies , and palm sugar
9. Add a lid and cook for 10-15 minutes
10. Fish is cooked if it can easily be parted with a fork
11. Serve over basmati rice and sprinkle with the fresh coriander

title: absolutely best healthy pancakes
steps:
1. Beat all ingredients but the last three
2. Stir in last three ingredients
3. Batter will be thick

title: strawberry cheesecake bars  cookie mix
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f
2. Spray bottom of 13x9-inch pan with cooking spray
3. In medium bowl , stir cookie mix , butter , flour and 1 egg until soft dough forms
4. Press evenly in pan
5. Bake 15 to 18 minutes or until light golden brown
6. Cool 15 minutes
7. In large bowl , beat cream cheese , sugar , vanilla and 2 eggs with electric mixer on medium speed until smooth
8. Spread evenly over crust in pan
9. Place spreadable fruit in small resealable food-storage plastic bag
10. Seal bag
11. Cut off tiny corner of bag
12. Squeeze spreadable fruit in 3 lines the length of the pan
13. Use knife to pull spread from side to side through cream cheese mixture at 1-inch intervals
14. Bake 25 to 30 minutes longer or until filling is set
15. Refrigerate until chilled , about 2 hours
16. For bars , cut into 8 rows by 4 rows
17. Store covered in refrigerator

title: slow cooker beef and barley soup
steps:
1. Dry the beef with paper towels , then season with salt and pepper
2. Heat 2 teaspoons of the oil in a 12-inch skillet over medium-high heat until just smoking
3. Brown half of the beef , about 10 minutes , then add to the slow cooker
4. Return the skillet to medium-high heat and repeat with 2 more teaspoons oil and the remaining beef
5. Add the remaining 2 teaspoons oil to the empty skillet and heat over medium heat until shimmering
6. Add the onions , carrots , and 1 / 4 teaspoons salt
7. Cook until the vegetables are softened , about 5 minutes
8. Stir in the wine , scraping up any browned bits
9. Simmer until the wine has reduced by half , about 1 minute , then pour into the slow cooker
10. Add the tomatoes with their juice , the broths , thyme and barley to the slow cooker
11. Cover and cook , on either low or high , until the beef is tender , 6-7 hours on low or 4-5 hours on high
12. Before serving , stir in parsley and season with salt and pepper to taste
13. To make ahead: the night before prepare the recipe through step 2
14. Instead of adding the ingredients to the slow cooker , refrigerate them , but be sure to store the browned meat in one container and the vegetables and wine in another container
15. In the morning , add the chilled ingredients to the slow cooker , then add the tomatoes with their juice , the broths , thyme and barley to the slow cooker
16. Proced with step 3
17. The cooking time will run to the high end of the range given in the recipe

title: seashore chowder
steps:
1. In 3-qt saucepan cook bacon over medium heat for 5 minutes , add potatoes , onions and celery , continue cooking stirring often until potatoes are tender about 15 to 20 minutes
2. Remove from pan and set aside
3. In same pan melt butter , stir in flour until smooth and bubbly
4. Add potato mixture and remaining ingredients except parsley
5. Cook over medium heat , stirring often for 10 to 15 minutes
6. Stir in parsley and serve

title: vegetable stroganoff
steps:
1. Cook the broccoli , cauliflower , and carrot in a small amount of boiling water for 5 minutes or until the vegetables are crisp-tender
2. Drain well and set aside
3. Start the water for your linguine , and cook the linguine to the package directions
4. While the linguine is cooking , saute the mushrooms , onion , and garlic in melted butter in a large dutch oven over medium heat until the vegetables are tender
5. Add the flour , stirring well
6. Cook for 1 minute , stirring constantly
7. Gradually add the milk and bouillon granules
8. Cook over medium heat , stirring constantly , until the mixture is thickened and bubbly
9. Add the reserved vegetables and olives
10. Stir well , and set aside
11. Combine the ricotta cheese , sour cream , and 1 / 4 cup parmesan cheese
12. Stir well
13. Add the ricotta cheese mixture to the reserved vegetable mixture
14. Stir well
15. Cook over medium heat until thoroughly heated
16. Drain the linguine well
17. Combine the linguine and vegetable mixture in a large serving bowl , tossing gently
18. Sprinkle with the remaining 1 / 4 cup parmesan cheese

title: maple pear deep dish pancake
steps:
1. Toss pears , syrup , and lemon zest together in medium bowl
2. Let stand , stirring occasionally , 45 minutes
3. Heat oven to 350 degrees
4. Butter wide round 1-1 / 2-quart baking dish
5. Place milk , sour cream , eggs , vanilla , flour , sugar , and salt in blender or food processor and process just until blended , about 1 minute
6. Pour enough batter into prepared baking dish to measure 1 / 4 inch
7. Bake until slightly firm , 12-15 minutes
8. Remove pear slices from syrup with slotted spoon
9. Reserve syrup
10. Arrange slices closely together on baked batter and sprinkle with almonds
11. Cover with remaining batter
12. Spoon reserved syrup evenly over top
13. Bake until wooden pick inserted in center of pancake comes out clean , about 1 hour
14. Let pancake cool on wire rack 30 minutes
15. Serve warm , with cream

title: ultra moist starbucks chocolate cake  or cupcakes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. In a large bowl , whisk eggs , canola oil , vanilla and black coffee together
3. Stir in sugar , cocoa powder , salt , baking soda and baking powder
4. Alternate stirring in flour and milk
5. Don't worry if batter seems runny to you , this is normal and makes the cake so moist !
6. Pour batter into two greased 9-inch round cake pans
7. Or if you're making cupcakes , line two 12-cup muffin tins with cupcake papers
8. Spoon the batter into the cups about three-quarters full
9. Bake the 2 cake pans for 25 minutes or cupcakes for 20-23 minutes
10. After cake has cooled , remove and frost with your favorite icing
11. Frosting instructions: it is really easy to create the two-tone icing as shown in the photo above
12. Make your favorite buttercream icing recipe and divide it into 4 equal batches
13. Then add a dab of food coloring to each batch
14. I used 4 different wilton colors -- yellow , pink , sky blue and leaf green
15. Use a long metal spatula to fill a pastry bag with 2 colors
16. Put one color down each side of the bag
17. When you twist the top of the bag closed , the colors will form "striped" icing
18. Use the wilton 2d drop flower
19. Each cupcake will be unique and beautiful !

title: southern style pigs feet
steps:
1. Place all ingredients in large dutch oven
2. Add water to cover pigs feet
3. Boil until tender
4. Add more water if necessary
5. Serve with cornbread

title: artichokes parisienne
steps:
1. Mix first 7 ingredients in small bowl
2. Season to taste
3. Clean artichokes using lemon to prevent discolouration
4. Place artichoke hearts in heavy saucepan
5. Fill with cold water
6. Cover and boil until tender , approximately 30 minutes , drain and blot dry
7. Arrange 1 artichoke bottom on each plate
8. Top each with poached egg
9. Spoon mayonnaise over and serve with crusty bread

title: broccoli bacon quiche for 2
steps:
1. Divide the broccoli , cheese and bacon between two 5" pie plates coated with nonstick spray
2. In a small bowl , whisk the eggs , cream , salt , garlic powder and lemon pepper
3. Pour over broccoli and bacon
4. Bake uncovered at 350 for 15-20 minutes or until a knife inserted near the center comes out clean

title: garlic pull apart bread
steps:
1. Place 5c flour , sugar , 1 tbs garlic salt , and yeast in mixer bowl
2. Attach bowl and dough hook to mixer
3. Turn to speed 2 and mix 15 seconds
4. Combine water , milk and 1 / 4c butter in a small saucepan
5. Heat over low heat until very warm
6. Turn to speed 2 and gradually add warm liquid to flour mixture , about 30 seconds
7. Mix 1 minute longer
8. Continuing on speed 2 , add remaining flour , 1 / 2c at a time , until dough clings to hook and cleans sides of bowl
9. Knead on speed 2 for 2 minutes longer
10. Place in a greased bowl , turning to grease top
11. Cover
12. Let rise in warm place , free from draft , until double in size
13. Punch dough down and divide in half
14. Roll one half into 12x8x1 / 4 inch rectangle
15. Melt remaining butter and mix with remaining salt
16. Brush dough with mixture
17. Cut dough into four equal 8x3 inch strips
18. Stack strips and cut into four equal 3x2 inch strips
19. Place pieces on edge of greased loaf pan so strips form a row down lenght of pan
20. Repeat with remaining dough
21. Cover
22. Let rise in warm place free from draft
23. Bake at 400f for 30-35 minutes
24. Remove from pan immediately and cool on wire rack

title: peanut butter and jelly wraps
steps:
1. In a small bowl , stir cream cheese with a spoon until soft
2. Add peanut butter
3. Mix well to combine
4. Spread about 1 / 3 cups mix over each tortilla
5. Evenly spread 1 1 / 2 tbs fruit spread over top of each
6. Roll up tortillas
7. Serve at once or cover and refrigerate until ready to serve

title: sweet potatoes with pecan praline streusel
steps:
1. Wash and skin potatoes , chop into large chunks
2. Boil potatoes until tender and mash
3. Stir in butter , cinnamon , brown sugar and mini marshmallows to taste
4. Mix in a separate bowl , flour , sugar , cinnamon , and pecans , drizzle melted butter over mixture and stir to moisten , mixture should resemble chunky crumbs
5. Pour potatoes mixture into casserole dish and cover with a thin layer of mini-marshmallows
6. Top with pecan mixture
7. Bake at 350f for 30 minutes or until brown and bubbly

title: ginger noodle salad
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to directions
2. In a medium saucepan add ginger , splenda , ketchup , soy sauce , chilie paste and water
3. Simmer on medium-low for 1 minute
4. Remove from heat
5. Add lime juice and sesame oil , mix well
6. Add noodles and stir well
7. Place greens on a plate and noodles on top
8. Serve immediately for a warm salad
9. Chill noodles for 15-20 minutes for a cold salad

title: spaghetti and fried eggs
steps:
1. Bring a pot of salted water to the boil
2. Start the sauce in the next step , and start cooking the pasta when the water boils
3. Combine garlic and 4 tablespoons of the oil in a small skillet over medium-low heat
4. Cook the garlic , pressing it into the oil occasionally to release its flavor
5. It should barely color on both sides
6. Remove the garlic , and add the remaining oil
7. Fry the eggs gently in the oil , until the whites are just about set and the yolks still quite runny
8. Drain the pasta , and toss with the eggs and oil , breaking up the whites as you do
9. Season to taste , and serve immediately , with cheese if you like

title: easter bread in the bread machine
steps:
1. Mix according to your manufactures instructions
2. Adding the anise seeds after first kneading and signal
3. Add flour if needed or drop of milk if needed upon mixture , to form a nice soft ball of dough
4. Place on sweet bread setting dark crust

title: spicy hot sausage balls
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 f
2. Mix together all the ingredients in a large bowl and knead well , until a dough forms and all the ingredients are combined
3. Roll dough into 1 or 2 inch balls and place on a baking sheet with a rim
4. Bake for 12-15 or until there is no pink in the sausage
5. You can serve it with any sauce you like , but ketchup and mustard are great with them , too

title: larry s pork loin roast
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300 degrees
2. Put 1 / 2 inch water in bottom of baking pan
3. Put worcestershire sauce in water
4. Put roast in , fat side up
5. Sprinkle liberally with season-all salt
6. Salt and pepper roast
7. Cover with tin foil
8. Bake
9. 2 1 / 2 hours later , pour honey over top of meat and cover again
10. Bake
11. Bake for 5 hours until meat is falling off bone or fork pulls meat apart
12. Some people dont cook it this long see reviews they cooked for 3
13. 5 hours and was ok for them

title: balsamic pasta salad
steps:
1. Boil one pound of any type pasta of your choice
2. Tweak the amount of ingredients to your own taste
3. Mix ingredients with pasta and toss
4. Refrigerate for at least one hour before serving
5. The longer it marinates the better

title: yogurt sorbet
steps:
1. With a hand-held mixer , beat the egg whites in a medium bowl , until frothy
2. While still beating , slowly add the sugar or splenda and beat on high speed until the egg whites are stiff and shiny , about 4 minutes
3. In another bowl , whisk the yogurt until smooth
4. Fold in the egg whites
5. Transfer the mixture to an ice cream freezer and freeze according to the manufacturer's instructions
6. Freeze in a quart container until ready to serve
7. Raw egg warning- to reduce the slight risk of salmonella or other food-borne illness , use only fresh , properly-refrigerated , clean , grade a or aa eggs with intact shells , and avoid contact between the yolks or whites and the shell

title: tattie soup
steps:
1. Peel and slice the potatoes , coarsely shred the peeled onions and carrots and cut the bacon into squares
2. Bring the water or stock to the boil in a large pan and add the vegetables and bacon
3. Cover and simmer gently for 1 hours until the soup is thick and creamy
4. Season
5. Add the chopped nettle tops or parsley 10 minutes before serving

title: baked   apple oatmeal raisin cookie  oatmeal
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. In large bowl , combine oats , brown sugar , cinnamon , nutmeg and salt
3. In small bowl , whisk together milk , egg and vanilla
4. Add the milk mixture to the oat mixture and stir until combined
5. Stir in the apples , raisins and chopped nuts
6. Pour into 4-6 small souffle or brulee dishes or one larger baking dish
7. Bake 20-30 minutes or 30-40 minutes , or until slightly firm to touch
8. Sprinkle with sugar
9. Garnish with toasted pecans

title: better burgers   vegetarian
steps:
1. Combine all the ingredients , except the olive oil , and combine well
2. Shape into 6 patties
3. Heat the oil in a skillet or griddle and saute the patties for about 5 minutes on each side
4. Serve with your favorite condiments: tomatoes , onions , lettuce , etc
5. Feel no guilt about eating such delicious and nutritious burgers

title: sardines  parmesan and olive tapenade on pide
steps:
1. For the tapenade , blanch garlic cloves in boiling water for 2 minutes
2. Meanwhile , rinse the olive , capers and anchovies , then drain and pat dry with paper towel
3. Place the olives , capers and anchovies in a food processor with the garlic cloves and then pulse to form a coarse paste and now with the motor running drizzle in enough of the olive oil to make the tapenade glossy and supple and then add two good twists of black pepper from a pepper mill and then pulse again to combine
4. These proportions will give you a very olivey tapenade , so taste it and feel free to add more ca[ers , garlic or anchovies if your palate demands it - i'm not a huge fan of olives but i loved this once the sardines and lemon juice were applied
5. You can store the tapenade in a small jar , under a layer of olive oil , in the fridge for up to 1 week
6. Drain the sardines , then split each fish into 2 shiny fillets , you can remove the backbone if you don't like the crunchiness , set the sardines aside , you may also wish to remove the head if you sradines comes complete
7. Preheat the grill to medium high and toast the bread on each side for 1 to 2 minutes until golden and warmed through
8. Spread the cut side of the bread with tapenade and then cut into wedges and then top with sardines and garnish with shaved parmesan and chopped parsley
9. Drizzle with olive oil , and then serve with lemon wedges to squeeze over

title: bran bread   bread machine
steps:
1. Put the ingredients into the pan in order listed , making sure the yeast is on the top
2. Press the start button

title: campfire american chop suey
steps:
1. Brown ground beef with onion and pepper
2. Drain off excess grease
3. Add remaining ingredients
4. Let simmer for about 10 minutes

title: corn pup recipes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f line muffin pan with paper liners or coat with cooking spray
2. Stir together cornmeal , flour , sugar , baking powder , salt , chili powder , cumin , and garlic powder
3. Make a hole in the bottom of the bowl and pour in milk , beaten egg , and oil
4. Stir just until blended
5. Fold in cheese
6. Drop a spoonful of batter into each muffin cup
7. Place hot dog piece into batter
8. Fill with enough batter to cover the hot dog
9. Bake 10-12 minutes
10. Muffins should be lightly browned and clean when toothpick is inserted
11. Let cool before removing from pan

title: blue cheese muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Butter 10 muffin cups
3. Combine flour , sugar , baking powder , salt and cheese in a large bowl
4. Combine egg , milk and butter in small bowl until blended
5. Stir into flour mixture just until moistened
6. Spoon into prepared muffin cups , filling 3 / 4 full
7. Bake 20-25 minutes or until golden brown
8. Remove from pan

title: pipin  hot bakery whole wheat tortillas
steps:
1. Combine flours , baking powder , and salt
2. Stir in the oil and water all at once , using mixer or a fork , and toss quickly
3. When dough can be gathered into a soft mass , turn onto floured surface and knead a few times
4. Form 8 balls of dough , dredge in flour , and store in a plastic bag to prevent drying until ready to be used
5. Flatten first ball of dough into a disk
6. Roll out dough on floured surface until 7 inches or larger with even strokes that do not reach to the edge , turning over frequently
7. Place tortilla in ungreased , frying pan that has been preheated to medium-high heat
8. Cook 30-40 seconds on one side , turn over with spatula and cook 30-40 seconds on other side
9. , first side should be pale and sprinkled with brown spots and the other side will be blotched
10. Repeat process with other balls of dough
11. Stack tortillas on a plate as they are cooked and cover them with a dish towel , which will keep them soft

title: texas chocolate cupcakes
steps:
1. In a large mixing bowl , combine the flour , sugar , salt and baking soda
2. In a large saucepan over medium heat , bring cocoa , water , oil and butter to a boil
3. Gradually add to dry ingredients
4. Mix well
5. Combine eggs , buttermilk and vanilla
6. Gradully add to batter and mix well
7. Fill paper lined muffin cups three-fourths full
8. Bake at 350 for 15-20 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean
9. Cool for 10 minutes before removing from pans to wire racks to cool completely
10. For icing , in a heavy saucepan , combine the brown sugar , butter and milk
11. Cook and stir over low heat until sugar is dissolved
12. Increase heat to medium
13. Do not stir
14. Cook for 3-6 minutes or until bubbles form in center of mixture and syrup turns to amber
15. Remove from the heat
16. Transfer to a small mixing bowl
17. Cool to room temperature
18. Gradually beat in confectioners' sugar
19. Spread over cupcakes

title: toasted walnut salad with mandarin oranges and gorgonzola cheese
steps:
1. Melt butter in a sauce pan
2. Stir in walnut pieces and coat with butter
3. Stir for 4 minutes and remove from pan and set aside
4. Allow to cool to room temperature
5. Toss greens , mandarin orange segments and crumbled cheese
6. Toss with toasted walnuts and serve with raspberry vinaigrette salad dressing

title: extra rich chocolate peanut butter oatmeal no bake cookies
steps:
1. Measure and prepare all ingredients and have them and a timer within arm's reach
2. Its important to work quickly and pay attention
3. Combine the butter , sugar , cocoa , and milk in a heavy saucepan then bring to a boil , stirring constantly , over medium heat
4. Boil for 1 minute exactly , continuing to stir and reducing heat if necessary to prevent the chocolate from burning
5. Remove from heat then add vanilla
6. It will boil up violently -- just stir it in until it subsides
7. Add the peanut butter and stir
8. Once peanut butter melts completely stir int the oatmeal
9. Let rest 5 minutes
10. Drop mixture by the tablespoonfuls onto a sheet of waxed paper
11. Let sit an hour or more until fully cooled and hardened

title: juicy tender  cabbage wrapped  pork roast
steps:
1. Remove 6-8 outer leaves of cabbage
2. Cut thick rib out of the center of the leaf , just the thick part only , cutting in no farther than 1 / 4-1 / 3 of the leaf
3. Cut off root ends of green onions , , separate leaves
4. In dutch oven or pot , bring 3 qts
5. Water to a boil
6. Cook cabbage leaves in boiling water for 3-5 minutes til pliable
7. With tongs , remove cabbage leaves to colander
8. Add green onions to boiling water and blanch 10 seconds til just wilted
9. Drain and pat dry with paper towel
10. Preheat oven to 350
11. Trim all fat from roast
12. In very small bowl , mix thyme , pepper and 1 teaspoons salt
13. Rub roast with thyme mixture
14. Wrap roast in wilted cabbage leaves
15. Tie leaves with green onions
16. If you have trouble with this , you can always use string
17. Place roast in roasting pan , add 2 cups chicken bouillon
18. Roast 1 hour , basting 2-3 times with bouillon juices
19. Remove and let set at least 10 minutes
20. Remove cabbage and green onions
21. Discard or coarsely chop and serve with roast
22. Slice , and serve with strained pan juices

title: beer and cheese spread
steps:
1. Beat together first 5 ingredients at low speed with a heavy-duty electric stand mixer until blended
