2. Gradually add beer , beating until blended after each addition
3. Beat at medium-high speed 1 minute or until blended and creamy
4. Season with salt and pepper to taste
5. Cover and chill 2 hours
6. Garnish , if desired
7. Store in an airtight container in refrigerator up to 2 weeks
8. Grilled beer-cheese sandwich: spread 1 teaspoons softened butter evenly on 1 side of 2 bread slices
9. Place bread slices , buttered sides down , on wax paper
10. Spread 1 / 4 cup beer-cheese spread onto 1 side of 1 bread slice
11. Top with remaining bread slice , buttered side up
12. Cook sandwich in a nonstick skillet or griddle over medium heat 3 to 5 minutes on each side or until golden brown and cheese is melted

title: baked fillet of sole
steps:
1. Place fillets in a greased baking dish
2. Combine rosemary , wine , lemon juice and pour over the fish
3. Top with scallions and mushrooms
4. Cover with aluminum foil
5. Bake in preheated 350-degree oven for about 15 minutes or until flaky
6. Sprinkle with parsley and season with salt and pepper

title: pineapple bread   bread machine
steps:
1. In bread machine pan , place the first eight ingredients in order suggested by manufacturer
2. Select basic bread setting
3. Choose crust color and loaf size if available
4. Bake according to bread machine directions
5. Just before final kneading , add the pineapple if desired

title: not cheese dip
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in blender and blend until well mixed
2. Heat over medium-low heat , stirring constantly , until thickened and heated through

title: copycat  wendy s oriental dressing by todd wilbur
steps:
1. Place all ingredients except vegetable oil and sesame seeds in a blender
2. Blend on high speed and slowly add oil to emulsify
3. Add sesame seeds and blend for a couple of seconds

title: sugar free blueberry slushie  almost ice cream
steps:
1. Combine in a food processor at high speed until blueberries and yogurt form a stiff slush
2. Enjoy

title: smoky vegetarian chili
steps:
1. Heat oil in dutch oven over medium heat
2. Add scallions , celery , red pepper and garlic , and cook until softened , about 8-10 minutes
3. Stir in tomatoes , chili powder , cumin , salt and chipotle , and cook for 2 minutes
4. Add beans , corn and vegetable broth , and bring to boil
5. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered for about 25 minutes

title: debbie s molasses cookies
steps:
1. Cream together sugar and molasses
2. Beat in eggs
3. Mix together dry ingredients
4. Mix together oil , water and vanilla
5. Stir into sugar mixture alternately with the dry ingredients , mixing well
6. Roll out on lightly floured surface
7. Cut into rounds and bake in a 350f oven for about 10 minutes or until lightly springs back when touched

title: 3 veg cauliflower cheese
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 360f
2. Steam your vegetables , reserve the juice
3. Cut them into big bite size pieces and put in a oven dish
4. Melt butter in a medium saucepan
5. Add flour and mix in , it wont be smooth yet
6. Gradually add the milk stirring it in ,
7. You want to get to a custard consistency
8. If you run out of milk you can use the juices from the vegetables to get it to a custard-like consistency
9. Once it is the right consistency and is starting to boil , add the cheese
10. It will start to thicken now
11. Wait a little bit while the cheese melts
12. Pour over vegetables
13. If it doesn't go in between the vegetables and just sits on top , put it back on the element and add some more juice or milk to get it right
14. You can leave until you want to cook or cook straight away
15. Cook in oven for 30 minutes , or until done
16. If you like it extra cheesy , before you put it in the oven add some mozzarella cheese on top
17. It will be very hot , so be careful

title: x rated in the shower
steps: 1. Shake with ice and strain into champagne flute

title: chocolate kahlua bread pudding
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease an 8 1 / 2-by-4 1 / 2-inch loaf pan
3. Melt 1 cup chocolate chips and set aside to cool slightly
4. Whisk eggs , brown sugar , cinnamon , nutmeg , vanilla , melted chocolate and kahlua in a large bowl
5. Stir in milk: add bread cubes and let rest for 30 minutes
6. Stirring occasionally to make sure the bread is evenly soaked
7. Ladle half of the mixture into loaf pan , spread remaining chocolate chips on top
8. Add the remaining mixture
9. Bake for about 55 minutes or until the center is set , cool , enjoy

title: potato latkes  jewish potato pancakes    gluten free
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 200 degrees or "warm" setting
2. Peel potatoes and submerge in cold water
3. Grate the onion into a large bowl
4. Grate the potatoes using the larger grate of a box grater , or use the grater attachment of a food processor
5. Quickly squeeze a handful of grated potatoes at a time over a second bowl to remove all liquid
6. Add the dry potatoes to the onions and mix as you go
7. This step should be done as quickly as possible to prevent oxidation of the potatoes
8. Heat 1 / 4 inch of olive oil in a large , heavy skillet over medium-high heat , until just below the smoking point
9. Add remaining ingredients to the batter , and stir until fully combined
10. Place a small handful of batter in the hot oil at a time , gently pressing each latke with the back of the spatula so that it is no more than 1 / 3" thick
11. Do not press too hard , as the latkes will be more crispy if the the batter is not densely packed and each latke is thin and lacy
12. Fry until completely golden-brown on the bottom and crispy around the outside corners
13. Flip and brown on the second side
14. Transfer latkes to a plate lined with paper towels or several layers of brown paper
15. Allow paper to absorb excess oil , then transfer latkes to a cooling rack placed over a baking sheet in the preheated oven , where they will stay warm until ready to serve
16. Serve hot , with sour cream and applesauce
17. Extra latkes can be frozen on a baking sheet in the refrigerator , with parchment paper or freezer paper between the layers
18. When frozen , transfer to ziploc bags
19. Reheat in oven on 400 degrees f

title: my standard lasagna
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 f and lightly grease a deep 9x13" casserole , spread just a couple of spoonfuls of spaghetti sauce in the bottom of the pan and set aside
2. Brown meat in a skillet until fully cooked
3. Drain fat
4. Combine the cooked meat with the rest of the spaghetti sauce and a few shakes of garlic powder , heat until warmed through , about 5-10 minutes
5. Meanwhile , in a medium bowl , combine the ricotta cheese , half of the shredded mozzarella cheese , the parmesan cheese , the eggs , a few liberal shakes of garlic powder , parsley , salt and pepper , mixing well
6. Place a layer of lasagna noodles in the bottom of the prepared baking dish , then pour some of the meat sauce , spreading to cover evenly
7. Spread some of the cheese mixture on top of that , then top with another layer of noodles
8. Repeat layers until you have used up all of your filling
9. Sprinkle remaining mozzarella over the top , then place the slices of provolone cheese on top , leaving some gaps
10. Cover tightly with foil and bake 45 minutes
11. Remove from oven , leaving covered , set on top of the stove and let rest 20-30 minutes
12. While the lasagna is resting , you can pop in a loaf of garlic bread wrapped partially in foil

title: avocado grilling butter
steps:
1. Cut softened butter into small squares
2. Peel and seed avocado and cut into small pieces
3. Mash butter and avocado and add to a mixing bowl
4. Seed jalapeno pepper and dice
5. Add jalapeno and other ingredients and mix in the mixing bowl
6. Spoon mixture onto plastic wrap
7. Shape into a log shape
8. Put the log in the refrigerator to become firm
9. To use the butter , melt in the last minute of grilling over steak , poulty or fish
10. Add a slice on top of resting meat
11. Let melt
12. Or spread atop french bread as previously mentioned

title: basil chicken with feta  slow cooker
steps:
1. I use skin-on , bone-in chicken
2. I browned the chicken and froze it , and put it in a 4 quart slow cooker frozen
3. Stephanie used skinless boneless and just put it in the slow cooker
4. Add the entire can of tomatoes , the chickpeas , green olives , basil leaves , and feta cheese
5. Cover and cook on low for 6 to 7 hours
6. Mine was done without falling apart at 7 hours and i would test at 5 hours if using not-frozen chicken
7. Serve chicken and the copious juices over rice or couscous

title: greek yogurt pancakes
steps:
1. Place greek yogurt in a medium bowl
2. Add flour , sugar , baking powder and salt
3. Stir together very gently
4. Stop short of the mixture being totally combined
5. You want the pancakes to have some interesting texture
6. Whisk eggs in a separate bowl
7. Add vanilla to eggs and stir to combine
8. Pour egg mixture into the greek yogurt-flour mixture
9. Stir together gently
10. Dont worry about the mixture being totally combined
11. A little white and yellow swirling is fine
12. Pour the batter onto a griddle sprayed with cooking spray , cup at a time
13. Cook for 1 to 1 1 / 2 minutes , then flip the pancakes
14. Cook for another 45 seconds and remove to plate
15. Repeat with the remaining batter
16. Top pancakes with syrup , fruit , or desired toppings

title: chocolate party snack mix
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine cereal , pretzels , and cashews
2. Set aside
3. Over a double broiler , or on very low heat , carefully melt chocolate chips and oil in a medium saucepan
4. Once smooth , remove from heat
5. Pour melted chocolate into cereal mixture
6. Mix until evenly coated
7. Spread out on waxed-paper lined baking sheets
8. Let cool in freezer or fridge until chocolate has hardened
9. Break into chunks , and serve

title: savory muffins three ways
steps:
1. Adjust oven rack to lower middle and preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. Mix together flour , baking powder , baking soda , and salt in a medium bowl
3. Stir in flavor ingredients of choice
4. In a large bowl beat sugar with butter until fluffy
5. Add mustard and eggs and beat until small "peas" form
6. Beat in flour mixture alternating with yogurt , 1 / 3 at a time
7. Batter should be thick and smooth
8. Spray muffin tins with vegetable cooking spray
9. Fill muffin tins with batter and bake until golden
10. Flavor ingredients
11. 1 cup goat cheese , crumbled
12. 1 tbsp fresh rosemary , minced
13. 1 / 2 cup kalamata olives , chopped
14. Or
15. 1 cup feta cheese , crumbled
16. 1 tbsp dried oregano
17. 1 / 2 cup sun dried tomatoes , drained and chopped
18. Or
19. 1 cup parmesan cheese , grated
20. 1 / 2 cup proscuitto , minced
21. 1 tbsp dried basil

title: marmalade rye bread  a b m
steps:
1. Place wet ingredients into pan of the bread machine
2. Toast walnuts in dry hot iron skillet , stirring constantly until fragrant ~ be careful not to burn !
3. Chop walnuts and put into large bowl to cool
4. Measure flours , vital wheat gluten , and powdered milk into bowl with chopped walnuts ~ stir to mix
5. Place flour mixture into pan of the bread machine , on top of wet ingredients
6. Place yeast into one corner of bread machine pan , on top of dry ingredients
7. Place salt into opposite corner of bread machine pan , on top of dry ingredients
8. For baking in oven ~ select dough cycle
9. To bake in bread machine: select whole wheat cycle
10. 2-lb loaf
11. Light crust
12. ~~~~
13. To bake in oven:
14. Shape dough into two one-pound loaves and let rise until doubled in size
15. Bake at 375f for metal pans
16. 350f for pyrex or glass ~ bake 20 minutes
17. Cover loaves with foil and bake for 10-15 minutes more !
18. For a soft outside crust , brush hot loaves on all surfaces with melted butter

title: romaine  palm and artichoke salad
steps:
1. Place romaine on a platter and toss with parsley tops
2. Wrap hearts of palm in prosciutto and cut into bite size pieces on an angle
3. Arrange prosciutto wrapped palm sections and quartered artichoke hearts over romaine greens
4. Shred cheese with a vegetable peeler into short ribbons
5. Drizzle the salad with balsamic vinegar and oil
6. Season with salt and pepper

title: layered beef noodle bake
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Spray 12x8- or 11x7-inch glass baking dish with cooking spray
3. Cook noodles as directed on package
4. Drain
5. Rinse with hot water
6. Meanwhile , in 10-inch skillet , cook beef over med-high heat 5 to 7 minutes , stirring occasionally , until throoughly cooked
7. Drain
8. Stir in pasta sauce and cooked noodles
9. In medium bowl , beat cream cheese , sour cream and milk with spoon until smooth
10. Spoon half of the noodle mixture into baking dish
11. Top evenly with cheese mixture
12. Spoon spinach evenly of the cheese mixture
13. Top with remaining noodle mixture
14. Cover with foil
15. Bake 35 minutes
16. Uncover and sprinkle with parmesan chhese
17. Bake about 5 minutes longer or until hot
18. Cut into squares

title: penne with caramelized onions and fontina
steps:
1. Heat oil in large non stick skillet over med high heat
2. Add onions and cook stirring often for 5 minutes
3. Reduce heat to medium , add sage , s& p and cook stirring occasionally for 20 minutes until onions are golden
4. Add red pepper and stock and stir to combine
5. Cook pasta in salted water 8 to 10 minutes
6. Drain and return to cooking pot
7. Add onion mixture , toss to coat
8. Add cheese and parsley , toss to coat again

title: tuscan bean and vegetable soup
steps:
1. Place the onion , garlic , celery , and carrot in a large saucepan and stir in the tomatoes , red wine , vegetable stock and oregano
2. Bring to a boil , cover , and simmer for about 15 minutes
3. Stir the beans and zucchini into the mixture and continue to cook , uncovered , for another 5 minutes
4. Add the tomato paste and season well with salt and pepper
5. Heat through , stirring occasionally , and cook another 2-3 minutes but do not allow mixture to boil again
6. Ladle the soup into warm bowls and serve with a spoonful of low-fat pesto on each portion
7. Serve with fresh crusty bread
8. Pesto sauce:
9. Place all of the ingredients in a blender or food processor and process for a few seconds until smooth
10. You can finely chop the basil and mix all ingredients together if no blender or processor is available

title: haloumi and chickpea arugula salad with greek yogurt dressing
steps:
1. Toss tomatoes , chickpeas , cucumber , and haloumi in a bowl
2. Mix yogurt , olive oil , cumin , coriander , paprika , and garlic salt in another bowl , then toss with above ingredients
3. Toss all of the above with arugula leaves
4. Spoon into serving bowls

title: german bavarian meatball stew
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine the first six ingredients
2. Crumble beef over mixture and mix well
3. Shape into 1-in
4. Balls
5. Place on a greased rack in a shallow baking pan
6. Bake at 400 for 15 minutes
7. Drain
8. Meanwhile , in a large saucepan , combine the remaining ingredients
9. Add meatballs
10. Bring to a boil
11. Reduce heat
12. Cover and simmer for 30-35 minutes or until vegetables are tender
13. Discard bay leaf before serving

title: homestyle biscuits
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450 degrees f
2. In medium bowl , combine flour , baking powder , baking soda , salt , and sugar
3. In small bowl , stir together buttermilk and all of the oil
4. Pour over flour mixture and stir until well mixed
5. On lightly floured surface , knead dough gently for 10 to 12 strokes
6. Roll or pat dough to 3 / 4-inch thickness
7. Cut with 2-inch biscuit or cookie cutter , dipping cutter in flour between cuts
8. Transfer biscuits to an ungreased baking sheet
9. Bake for 12 minutes or until golden brown
10. Serve warm

title: haricots verts with warm shallot vinaigrette
steps:
1. In a large saucepan of boiling water , place haricots verts and cook 3 minutes or until tender crisp
2. Drain and plunge beans into ice water , drain and set aside
3. In a large non stick skillet over medium high heat add oil and shallots , saute 4 minutes or until golden brown
4. Add vinegar and stir , cook approximately 5 minutes or until mixture thickens
5. Place haricots verts to mixture , add salt and pepper and saute 2 minutes or until beans are heated through
6. Serve warm or at room temperature

title: applebee s veggie patch pizza
steps:
1. Pizza: in a hot saut pan or on a griddle , place sliced mushrooms and butter-flavor oil and season with salt , pepper and garlic
2. Cook until hot
3. Brush tortilla with oil and place on griddle
4. Spread spinach and artichoke dip evenly on top of tortilla to within 1 / 2 inch of the edge
5. Top with mushrooms , when cooked , italian seasoning and diced tomatoes
6. Sprinkle shredded mozzarella cheese over pizza and remove from griddle and place on a pizza pan in an oven preheated to 350 degrees f
7. Remove from oven when cheese is melted and top with shredded parmesan / romano cheese
8. Cut into wedges and serve
9. Spinach and artichoke dip: combine ingredients thoroughly in a bowl and spread mixture into a small baking dish
10. Bake in an oven preheated to 350 degrees f for 30 minutes or until cheeses are bubbling and melted
11. Serve as the "sauce" for the vegetable pizza or as a dip for chips

title: flint ridge pheasant
steps:
1. Put the wild rice in 9x9x2-inch baking dish that has been sprayed with nonstick vegetable spray
2. Layer the carrots over the wild rice
3. In large skillet , cook bacon until crisp
4. Drain and crumble over the carrots
5. Pour off grease from skillet and add a tablespoon or two of oil
6. Saute the pheasant until well browned on both sides
7. Transfer to baking dish
8. In same skillet , saute the mushrooms and green onions until tender , adding additional oil if needed
9. Add soup , cream and sherry , and mix well
10. Add mozzarella and gently stir in artichokes
11. Spread over the pheasant layer
12. Sprinkle with parmesan
13. Cover dish with foil sprayed with nonstick vegetable spray
14. Bake at 350 for 30 minutes
15. Remove foil and bake 15 more minutes until bubbly throughout

title: wisconsin broccoli cheddar cheese soup
steps:
1. Melt butter in a large saucepan over medium heat
2. Add flour
3. Cook and stir 30 seconds or until bubbly
4. Add milk , salt , mustard , and cayenne pepper
5. Bring to a simmer over high heat , stirring frequently
6. Add broccoli and red pepper
7. Return to a boil
8. Reduce heat to low
9. Simmer uncovered 5 minutes , stirring occasionally
10. Add cheese
11. Stir over low heat just until cheese melts
12. Ladle into four soup bowls
13. Top with chives

title: old man rafferty s tomato basil soup
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients , except for cream in a large soup pot
2. Simmer for 20 minutes over medium-low heat
3. Allow soup to cool a bit , then whisk in the cream
4. Reheat slowly to serving temperature , and serve with chiffonaded fresh basil , if available

title: pepperoni dip  2
steps:
1. Chop pepperoni into very small pieces and place in slow cooker
2. Add green onion , bell pepper , tomato , and pizza sauce and stir well
3. Cover and cook on low for 3 hours
4. Stir in mozzarella cheese , cream cheese , and cheddar cheese , until all the cheeses melts
5. Serve with wheat crackers , or tortilla chips

title: sheila s irish soda bread
steps:
1. Combine sugar , baking soda , baking powder , flour and salt in a large bowl
2. Stir in eggs and sour cream , then add raisins and caraway seeds
3. Pour into two greased and lightly floured 8x4-inch loaf pans or 8-inch round pans
4. Bake at 325 degrees f for approximately 60 minutes , or until a toothpick inserted in the bread comes out clean

title: giblet stock from turkey or chicken or     for soup or gravy
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , combine the wing , neck and giblets , 6 cups water , celery , carrot , onion , sage , garlic , bay leaf and peppercorns
2. Bring mixture to a boil , reduce heat and continue to cook at a simmer , skimming the froth occasionally for 1 hour
3. Add liver and continue to cook at a bare simmer for an additional 30 minutes
4. Strain the stock through a fine sieve into a bowl
5. There should be about 3 cups of stock
6. Reserve the turkey wing , liver , neck and remaining giblets
7. Chop the giblets finely and shred the meat from the wing for the gravy or soup

title: eila s salsa
steps:
1. Put everything in the blender or food processor and blend
2. Cover and refrigerate until ready to serve
3. This salsa recipe tastes great with lime-flavored corn chips

title: california turkey burger
steps:
1. Combine first seven ingredients in a large bowl
2. Shape into 4 patties
3. Grill over high heat for 15 minutes or until no longer pink in center
4. Top with cheese during last few minutes of grilling
5. Grill pepper rings for two minutes
6. Place burgers on bun , top with pepper rings

title: spinach mandarin salad
steps:
1. Combine all the ingredients except dressing , toss
2. Add dressing just before serving or serve on the side

title: sole casserole with potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. In a saucepan not too deep , soften leek in butter 5 minutes , without letting them taking colors
3. Add spinach and wine
4. Cook until spinach are wilted
5. Add stock , cream and potatoes
6. Stir well
7. Add nutmeg , salt and pepper
8. Cover and cook in oven 30 to 40 minutes
9. Remove from oven and put fish on potatoes
10. Add salt and pepper
11. Keep cooking uncovered 15 to 20 minutes
12. Sprinkle with parsley and serve

title: layered vegetable bake
steps:
1. Heat butter in a frying pan and saut the garlic and leek for 5 minutes , then add the spinach and cook a further minute
2. Layer half the potatoes in the base of a lined 24cm round spring form tin
3. Top with the spinach and leek mixture , then top with remaining potatoes
4. Sprinkle grated cheese over the top
5. Whisk together the cream cheese , eggs , cream , thyme and seasoning
6. Pour cream cheese mixture over the cheese and bake at 200c for 40-45 minutes
7. Serve with salad or your favourite cooked meat

title: alli s renegade cocktail sauce
steps: 1. Mix all ingredients together and chill

title: chicken zingarella
steps:
1. In a large skillet , saute mushrooms , onions , and garlic in olive oil until onions are translucent and mushrooms golden brown
2. Add chicken and cook until no longer pink
3. Add jar sauce , wine and brown sugar
4. Simer 15 minutes on medium-low heat
5. Drain roasted peppers of oil and slice into strips
6. Add to sauce and simmer 5 minutes more
7. Serve immediately over pasta of your choice

title: banana sticks
steps:
1. Peel bananas and halve
2. Insert icecream stick in cut end of each piece , to make a handle
3. Holding by stick , dip into yoghurt , cover completely to exclude air , allow to drain away slightly then roll in granola lightly
4. Place on tray covered with foil or cling and freeze immediately in coldest part of freezer
5. Yum !

title: microwave plum orange jam
steps:
1. Pit plums but do not peel
2. Coarsely chop
3. Place in a 16-cup microwave-safe dish
4. Stir in orange peel , sugar and lemon juice
5. Stir well
6. Microwave , uncovered , on high for about 15 minutes , until mixture comes to a full roiling boil and boils for 1 minute
7. Stir well 3 times during cooking
8. Immediately stir in pectin
9. Skim off foam with a metal spoon
10. Continue stirring often and skimming off foam for 10 minutes
11. Pour into sterilized jars and seal

title: pennsylvania dutch green beans
steps:
1. Cook bacon in large skillet until crisp
2. Drain , crumble and reserve
3. Pour off all but 1 tablespoon drippings
4. Add onion , and saute until tender
5. Blend in cornstarch , salt and mustard
6. Drain beans , reserving 1 / 2 cup liquid
7. Stir reserved liquid into skillet
8. Cook , stirring constantly , until thickened and bubbly
9. Stir in sugar and vinegar
10. Add beans
11. Heat until bubbly-hot
12. Sprinkle with crumbled bacon and egg

title: unknownchef86 s chinese pepper steak
steps:
1. Saute steak in oil
2. Add garlic , ginger , salt and pepper
3. Cook 1 minute
4. Remove meat and keep warm
5. Add peppers and onions to same pan
6. Cook til crisp-tender
7. Add beef flavoring , hot water , and water chestnuts
8. Combine cornstarch , soy sauce , cold water and sugar
9. Stir into skillet
10. Add meat
11. Bring to a boil
12. Cook and stir 2 minutes more
13. Serve over hot rice or noodles

title: our baby back ribs
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees
2. Line a jelly roll pan with foil
3. Cut sinew off the back of the ribs
4. Lay ribs onto foil and add 3 / 4 cup water
5. Cover with foil
6. Bake for 3 hours
7. Raise oven temperature to 375 degrees
8. Remove foil from ribs
9. Add your favorite barbecue sauce to ribs
10. Bake for another 30 minutes , or longer

title: chocolate lovers deluxe fudgy brownies
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease an 8 square baking pan with non-stick cooking spray
3. In medium bowl stir together butter , sugar , eggs and vanilla
4. Add flour , cocoa and salt stirring just until blended
5. Mix in half of the walnuts , if desired
6. Spread mixture and sprinkle with remaining walnuts
7. Bake about 30 minutes , until top appears dry and center is set
8. Cool brownies in pan on wire rack
9. To wrap , cut brownies into squares
10. Bake in 350 degrees oven stirring occasionally , about 10 minutes or until lightly browned
11. Remove from oven and cool completely
12. My dh has also added chocolate chips to the batter with wonderful results !

title: nutty deviled eggs
steps:
1. Cut eggs in half and scoop out yolks
2. Mix together all ingredients with the egg yolks and spoon into the whites
3. Garnish with paprika and gherkin slices

title: jagertee
steps:
1. Heat your tea , rum , wine , orange juice , brandy , spices , and lemons in a pot and let them come to a gentle simmer for about 5 minutes
2. Remove from heat
3. Add sugar to taste and serve

title: full of flavor taco chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Mix salsa and taco seasoning throughly until seasoning is completely dissolved into salsa
3. Crush tacos and place on plate
4. Dip chicken first in salsa mix then in shells and place on foil lined baking sheet
5. Sprinkle with any remaining shells
6. Bake for 40 - 45 minutes turning chicken halfway through cooktime
7. Serve and enjoy !

title: citrus cranberry sauce
steps:
1. Remove peel and pith from oranges and cut into large pieces
2. In a saucepan over medium heat , combine oranges , cranberries , sugar , water and ground ginger
3. Cook , stirring frequently for 15 minutes
4. Remove from heat and stir in lemon and lime juices
5. Cover and chill thoroughly before serving
6. Ideally made the day before you plan to serve

title: best barbecued pork sandwiches
steps:
1. Rub pork with brown sugar
2. Wrap loosely in foil
3. Roast at 350f for 2 -3 hours until very tender
4. Pull into shreds with fork
5. Spoon cup in each bun
6. Top each with 1 tbsp barbecue sauce

title: beef rolls
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees
2. Melt the butter in a large saute pan and fry the bacon and mushrooms for 3 minutes
3. Put into medium size bowl
4. Do not wash saute pan as you will use it again for step 7
5. Add to mushroom mixture , the chopped parsley , lemon rind and juice , bread crumbs , and seasoning
6. Spread an equal amount of the bread crumb mixture evenly over the beef slices , leaving a narrow border clear around the edges
7. Put flour onto dinner size plate and mix paprika into flour
8. Roll up the slices and tie securely with fine string , then dip the beef rolls in the flour / paprika mixture to coat lightly , shaking off any excess flour into a small bowl and reserve for thickening later
9. Heat the oil in the frying pan that you used earlier , saute the beef rolls until lightly browned and set rolls in casserole
10. Pour into frying pan the beef stock , onions , reserved flour
11. Stir constantly , bring to a boil , stirring , and simmer for 2-3 minutes
12. Taste test the sauce , add more salt and pepper if needed
13. Pour the sauce over beef rolls , then cover with tight fitting lid and bake in the oven for 2 hours
14. Lift out the "rolls" using a slotted spoon and remove the string
15. Return beef to the sauce and serve hot

title: pasta with roasted garlic  cherry tomatoes and basil
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400
2. Halve tomatoes and garlic cloves and toss with olive oil and balsamic in a baking dish
3. Combine bread crumbs , parmesan , and salt and pepper to taste
4. Spoon mixture evenly over tomatoes
5. Roast mixture for 30-40 minutes or until mixture is bubbly , browned , or slightly thickened
6. Meanwhile , in a large pot of salted water , cook pasta according to package directions
7. Drain well
8. Add pasta to the tomato mixture and toss with fresh chopped basil

title: olive cheese balls
steps:
1. Mix the cheese , flour and butter like pie crust
2. Shape into balls smaller than walnuts
3. Press an olive into the center of each , covering completely
4. Bake 10-15 minutes at 400 degrees
5. Serve as finger food
6. Makes 30
7. Can be frozen before baking
8. Best served warm

title: moms yellow squash casserole
steps:
1. Cook squash until tender , drain and mash
2. Add onion , stove top , mushroom soup , sour cream and mix well in a large casserole dish
3. Top with cheese and bake at 350 for 30 minutes or until cheese has totally melted

title: n  y   pushcart onion sauce
steps:
1. In a medium sized kettle , heat the oil over medium heat
2. Add the onions and saute until golden and limp , about 7 minutes
3. Mix in the ketchup , then add the cinnamon , chili powder , hot pepper sauce and salt
4. Pour in the water and stir
5. Bring the mixture to a boil , reduce heat , and simmer , uncovered , for about 10 minutes or until the mixture is heated through

title: to die for nut bars
steps:
1. In a large bowl , combine flours , brown sugar , baking soda and salt
2. Cut in butter until mixture resembles course crumbs
3. Press into a greased 15x10x1-inch baking pan
4. Bake at 350 degrees 10-12 minutes or until golden brown
5. Quickly spread nuts and chocolate chips over crust
6. Combine caramel topping with 3 tablespoons flour
7. Drizzle over nuts and chocolate chips
8. Bake 12-15 minutes longer or until golden and bubbly
9. Cool and cut into squares

title: almond flour pound cake   sugar free
steps:
1. Cream butter and splenda well
2. Add eggs , one at a time beating after each addition
3. Mix flour with baking powder and spices and add to egg mixture a little at a time wile beating
4. Add sour cream and vanilla butter nut extract
5. Pour into a greased 8-inch cake pan and bake at 350 degrees f for 50 to 55 minutes
6. Serve with sugar free cherry or apple pie filling and whipped cream

title: brussels sprouts mojo
steps:
1. Use a food chopper or food processor to roughly chop the brussels sprouts , leaving a few larger pieces
2. Heat the olive oil in a skillet over medium heat
3. Add the sprouts and garlic and saute 1 minute
4. Add the remaining ingredients and saute for 1 additional minute
5. Total cook time for the dish is 2 minutes
6. Do not overcook
7. Serve hot

title: pomegranate banana salad
steps:
1. Dice bananas , peppers and onions
2. Toss bananas , peppers , onions , pomegranate seeds and sugar together
3. In a separate bowl whisk together oil , vinegar , and pomegranate molasses
4. Drizzle over salad mixture and gently toss
5. Chill for 2 hours

title: asparagus  artichoke  and avocado salad
steps:
1. Rinse and cut the bottoms off of the asparagus , then blanch in boiling , salted water for 2 minutes , remove from water and immediately rinse with cold water
2. Place on large platter
3. Cut drained artichoke hearts into quarters and spread over top ot the asparagus
4. Chill until just before serving
5. Just before serving cut up the avocados , slice each avocado in half , remove seed and slice into chunks
6. Spread chunks over asparagus and artichoke hearts
7. Mix salad dressing according to directions except replace white vinegar with balsamic vinegar
8. Pour dressing over salad and top with blue cheese , serve immediately

title: pineapple snowball cake
steps:
1. Soften gelatine in cold water
2. Add boiling water , sugar , juice , pineapple and salt
3. Mix well
4. Refrigerate until partly jelled
5. Prepare 2 packages whipped topping mix according to directions
6. Fold into jelled mixture
7. Line a large mixing bowl with waxed paper or extra-wide plastic wrap
8. Break the angel food cake into 1-inch chunks
9. In the lined mixing bowl , make layers of cake and jelled mixture , alternating and finishing with jelled mixture
10. Chill overnight
11. Next day , prepare 1 package whipped topping mix
12. Take cake from refrigerator and turn upside down on large plate
13. Remove bowl and waxed paper
14. Frost with whipped topping mix
15. Chill until serving time
16. However , i can't speak to the results of using those ingredients

title: mom s banana chocolate chip muffins
steps:
1. Mix in the order given and fill muffin tins 3 / 4 full
2. Bake at 350 for approximately 20 minutes

title: microwave zucchini bread
steps:
1. In a large mixing bowl , blend eggs with sugar
2. Add oil and zucchini , stirring to blend well
3. Stir in remaining ingredients
4. Pour into a 12-cup microwave bundt pan , or use two 6-cup ring pans for the microwave
5. Microwave on high for 8-10 minutes , rotating a quarter turn halfway through cooking
6. Bread looks dry and begins to pull away from side when cooked
7. Cool 10 minutes in the pan
8. Invert bread onto serving plate

title: momeo s beanless spicy chili
steps:
1. Brown ground chuck and onions in a large pan
2. In a separate pot , heat all tomato goods , garlic , andoullie , chili powder , pepper flake , black pepper , brown sugar , worcestershire sauce , and cinnamon to a boil
3. Add cooked ground chuck and onion to pot with tomato mixture
4. Boil on low / medium until thick and some water is cooked out about 1 hour

title: ramadan date bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 f
2. Cream the butter and sugar together
3. Beat in the egg and vanilla essence
4. Fold in the flour , mix well
5. Add in chopped dates and walnuts
6. Baked in a greased 9x13 pan for 20 - 25 minutes
7. Cut into bars or squares when cooled

title: overly oreo pie
steps:
1. Place the oreo pie crust in the freezer for 30 minutes
2. Let the oreo ice cream soften on the counter are about 5-10 minutes and then gently press it into the crust
3. Smooth over the top and them press the whole cookies in the top and place in the freezer until needed

title: andy s fairfield granola
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300 degrees
2. Mix everything together
3. Spread on baking sheets and bake for 40-60 minutes
4. Cool and add raisins

title: cilantro salmon with spinach and mushrooms
steps:
1. Pre-heat the oven to 325 degrees
2. Microwave the spinach in a microwave safe / oven safe baking dish with the lemon for two minutes
3. Drain all the liquid
4. Add the mushrooms and stir--chop spinach into smaller pieces if desired
5. Add yogurt , ricotta , cilantro , egg white , garlic , cayenne pepper , and stir
6. Pour 3 / 4 of the mixture over the spinach and mushrooms in the oven safe pan
7. Slice salmon into very thin strips and place in layer over the spinach , mushrooms , and sauce
8. Then pour remaining sauce over the salmon
9. Shake salt and pepper over the top
10. Bake for 15-20 minute
11. Drain any excess liquids and enjoy !

title: sparkling peach splash
steps:
1. Combine first 3 ingredients in a blender
2. Process until smooth
3. Freeze 1 hour
4. Pour champagne into a pitcher
5. Spoon peach mixture into pitcher
6. Stir to combine
7. Garnish with peach slices , if desired
8. Serve immediately

title: spicy chicken in a creamy tomato sauce
steps:
1. Season chicken well with blackening seasoning
2. In heavy skillet heat to med- high
3. Add 1 t of butter and 1 t olive oil
4. Cook chicken until just done about 6-8 minutes and remove to a plate
5. Add mushrooms to skillet and 1 t butter
6. Cook mushrooms until they start to brown , add garlic and cook no more than 2 minutes being careful not to scorch the garlic
7. Add tomatoes , basil , blackening season and red pepper flakes
8. Let cook for 5-6 minutes until most of the tomato liquid is gone
9. Add cream and turn down the heat to medium and let cook for 5-6 minutes
10. Taste and adjust seasonings if needed
11. Sprinkle parmesan over and stir until well combined , add green onions
12. Return chicken to mixture and let cook 5 more minutes
13. Add pasta and spinach and stir to coat cook 2 minutes or until pasta is heated through
14. Serve

title: nectarine raspberry crisp with spiced oatmeal crumb topping
steps:
1. Mix flour , oats , sugar , brown sugar , cinnamon , salt and cardamom in medium bowl
2. Add melted butter and rub in with finger
3. This topping can be made 1 day ahead--just cover and refrigerate
4. Position rack in center of oven and preheat to 375 degrees
5. Butter a 11x7x2 inch glass baking dish
6. Combine nectarines , raspberries , 1 / 4 cup sugar and cornstarch in large bowl
7. Toss to blend
8. Transfer mixture to baking pan
9. Sprinkle topping evenly over fruit
10. Bake until fruit mixture is bubbling thickly and topping is golden brown , about 50 minutes
11. Cool 20 minutes
12. Serve warm with vanilla ice cream

title: blue cheese and bacon potato salad
steps:
1. In a vegetable steamer , steam potatoes for 8 to 12 minutes , depending on size
2. Test to make sure they are "just" done
3. Cool potatoes to touch , quarter them and place in a large glass bowl
4. Add the wine , chicken broth , parsley and green onions
5. Toss mixture gently !
6. Let cool
7. Add blue cheese crumbles and creamy caesar salad dressing , toss gently !
8. Cover and chill overnight
9. Before serving transfer to a salad bowl , sprinkle with crumbled bacon and serve

title: chicken frittata florentine an italian fusion recipe
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Spray a non stick oven proof pan with vegetable oil and pan fry the potatoes until golden , remove from pan
3. Add 1 tbsp butter and saute the chopped mushrooms for apprx 3 minutes , remove and add to the potatoes
4. Saute the garlic over medium heat until aromatic add spinach and stir fry for 1 minute add lemon juice & nutmeg
5. Remove from the pan
6. Wipe the pan clean with a paper towel
7. Beat the eggs in a large bowl , then add potatoes , spinach , mushrooms & chicken
8. Mix well
9. Over medium heat in the oven proof skillet melt 1 tbsp butter and 1 tbsp oil , when the pan is heated pour in the egg mixture and allow it cook undisturbed for 10 mintes or until the bottom is set - be careful not to burn the bottom
10. Place the skillet into the preheated oven , middle rack and bake for 5 minutes , sprinkle on the parmesan and continue baking for apprx 10 more minutes or until the top is firm and the cheese golden
11. If necessary place under broiler to finish browning the cheese but be careful it doesn't burn
12. Just before serving sprinkle with the parsley and pepper oieces if using
13. Let it rest 5 minutes then cut in wedges and serve
14. Serve with a spicy hot sauce or chutney on the side

title: gluten free dairy free chocolate chip cookie bars
steps:
1. Mix the first 6 ingredients together
2. Add honey , beaten egg , semi-softened vegan butter , vanilla , and 1 tbs
3. Applesause
4. Fold in chocolate chips
5. In a small greased pan , bake at 350 degrees
6. Check at 5 minutes to see if the bars are ready , then every 2 minutes after

title: cheese tomato potato bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Cook potato and onion in boiling salted water until potatoes are just tender , drain
3. Add butter , cheeses , tomatoes and sour cream , stir to combine
4. Place mixture in a baking dish , top with bacon and additional cheese if desired
5. Bake 20-25 minutes

title: portuguese sofrito bread  a b m
steps:
1. Cut onions into -inch dice
2. Saute slowly in olive oil until translucent and barely golden , about 15 minutes
3. Set aside to cool
4. Add all ingredients including the sauted onions to your bread machine in the order recommended by its manufacturer , and select the bread cycle

title: ww 4 points   general tso s chicken
steps:
1. Combine chicken , 2 tbsp of the sherry , 1 tbsp of the cornstarch , and the oyster sauce in a med bowl
2. Set aside and let marinade 5 minute
3. Combine the remaining 3 tbsp sherry , water , soy sauce , honey , rice vinegar , sesame oil , and the remaining 2 tsp cornstarch in small bowl
4. Set aside
5. Heat large nonstick skillet over med high heat until a drop of water sizzles
6. Add canola oil and chicken mixture
7. Stir-fry until lightly browned
8. Add the ginger , garlic , scallions , and red pepper
9. Stir-fry until fragrant
10. Add the celery and bell pepper , stir-fry until crisp-tender ,
11. Stir in the sherry mixture and cook , stirring constantly , until mixture boils and thickens , 1-2 minute
12. 4 points for 1 cup

title: multi seed loaf  bread machine
steps:
1. Add the ingredients into the bread-machine in the order they appear above , so water first and seeds last
2. Put the machine on the normal white bread cycle
3. Make sure the dough looks smooth after the first mixing stage - if not add flour or water as required
4. Sit back and relax
5. In 3-4 hours you will have a delicious and healthy bread

title: anya s peanut butter pie
steps:
1. Crust:
2. Combine flour , powdered sugar , and butter
3. Place in a 9 inch pie pan
4. Bake 375 degrees for 12 to 15 minutes
5. Filling / topping
6. Mix peanut butter and 1 / 2c
7. Powdered sugar until finely crumbled using a fork or food processer
8. Sprinkle 1 / 2 of the peanut butter / powdered sugar mixture over the baked pie shell
9. Custard:
10. Combine cornstarch , sugar , salt , milk , and beaten egg yolks in a saucepan stirring constantly until it boils
11. Cook until slightly thickened
12. Remove from heat
13. Stir in butter and vanilla
14. Pour over peanut butter / powdered sugar mixture
15. Meringue:
16. Beat 3 egg whites until stiffened and place over custard being sure to seal the edges of the custard
17. Sprinkle the rest of the crumbled peanut butter / powdered sugar mixture
18. Bake at 350 degrees for 20 minutes
19. Cool thoroughly before serving

title: jack daniel s chocolate pecan torte
steps:
1. Melt together butter and dark chocolate
2. Using a paddle mixer , mix sugar , cocoa , whiskey and eggs
3. Add melted chocolate mixture
4. Scrape well
5. Stir in pecans
6. Pour into a greased pan lined with wax paper
7. Bake in a water bath at 350f for approximately 50 minutes
8. Or until center is 170f
9. Chill
10. Serve cold or room temperature with your favorite fruit or caramel sauce

title: vietnamese fresh spring rolls   goi cuon
steps:
1. Cook the prawns , for 3 minutes until cooked , remove and peel , cut them lengthwise
2. Cook the pork , let it cool down and cut into thin slices
3. Spread one sheet of paper rice on a flat surface , use your fingers to wet it with water to make pliable , place another half in the middle to avoid cracking
4. Spread evenly a clump of noodles , 3 to 4 mint leaves , a pinch of bean sprouts at the bottom third of the rice paper
5. Fold the bottom portion over the filling , fold the left and right sides , roll one more time so it is 2 / 3 rolled
6. Place 2 or 3 halves of the prawns , face out so it looks nice when finished , next to them a leaf of chive half in and half out
7. Roll the paper tightly until the edges stick together
8. Place the rolls under a damp towel until serving time to keep them moist
9. Dipping sauce
10. Put 3 to 4 tbs of hoisin sauce with 1 tbs of cooking oil , warm it up and taste with sugar , avoid boiling
11. Chopped finely a pinch of roasted peanuts and spread on top when serving

title: the cheesecake factory s pumpkin ginger cheesecake
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees
2. Prepare a 10-inch springform pan
3. To make the crust
4. In a bowl place the melted butter with graham cracker crumbs , crushed gingersnaps , brown sugar and cinnamon
5. Mix with a fork until combined
6. Line bottom and side with parchment paper or wax paper , then spray with nonstick spray
7. Press the mixture into the bottom of the pan
8. For the filling
9. Pour the whipping cream into a medium bowl and beat just until soft peaks form
10. Refrigerate until ready to use
11. In a bowl beat the cream cheese with electric mixer until fluffy
12. Gradually add in sugar , beating well until combined
13. Add in eggs one at a time and beat the mixture until fluffy
14. Stir in pumpkin puree , ginger , cinnamon and cloves
15. Remove the whipped cream from the refrigerator and lightly whisk to reblend
16. Using a spatula or a flat spoon fold in the whipped cream into the cream cheese-pumpkin mixture
17. Pour the mixture into preapred crust
18. Wrap one continuous sheet of heavy foil around the springform pan then press firmly against the pan
19. Place the wrapped pan in a baking pan and fill with hot water to halfway up the spring form pan
20. Bake for 60-70 minutes
21. Cool the cheesecake to room temperature , the chill for at least 5 hours or until the cake is thoroughly chilled
22. Remove the sides of the springform pan
23. Just before serving place the pecan halves on top of the cheescake in a ring around the edges

title: whipped horseradish
steps:
1. Line a fine mesh sieve with cheesecloth
2. Strain the horseradish for 2-3 minutes , or until reduced to 3 / 4 cup
3. Press on the horseradish with a spoon or squeeze the cheesecloth to extract all the liquid
4. In a mixing bowl , whip the cream with a wire whisk until it thickens to the consistency of sour cream
5. You can use an electric mixer set on medium-high , but watch carefully so that the cream does not overwhip
6. Add the horseradish , mustard , salt , pepper and tabasco
7. Whisk until thickened using a wire whisk or electric mixer
8. The sauce should be moist and the consistency of whipped cream
9. Refrigerate for at least 1 hour , then serve immediately or transfer to a covered storage container and refrigerate up to an additional day

title: chicken bombay
steps:
1. Combine soups , mayonnaise , curry powder and lemon juice in medium bowl
2. Arrange cooked chicken and broccoli evenly in bottom of 2 qt shallow baking dish
3. Spoon soup mixture over top
4. Sprinkle with shredded cheese
5. Bake covered , in preheated 375f oven until top is melted and toasty- about 30 minutes
6. Serve over cooked rice

title: feta preserve
steps:
1. Cut cheese into cubes
2. Peel onion and slice into thin rings
3. Place alternating layers of cheese , olives and onion rings in a medium sized jar
4. Add rosemary and olive oil
5. Seal the jar and leave to marinate in the refrigerator for at least 3 weeks before serving
6. Cheese preserved like this will keep in the fridge approx 3 months
7. As you eat the cheese it can be replaced with fresh cubes
8. The oil absorbs all the wonderful flavours , so will make a delicious addition to any dressing

title: sleepy twisted sisters g n g breakfast ramekin
steps:
1. Lightly butter 2 ramekins using a pastry brush
2. Put 2 ounces flavourful mashed potatoes or seasoned fried potatoes in the bottom of the ramekins
3. Layer hard-boiled egg youve sliced w / your handy-dandy egg slicer over the potatoes , putting half the egg in ea ramekin
4. Layer ea ramekin w / a ham slice
5. Top ea ramekin w / 1 tbsp grated cheddar cheese & garnish w / chopped fresh chives
6. Refrigerate till your dh is ready to g-n-g & train him to be ever so quiet as he nukes his breakfast & leaves for work !
7. :-)

title: chipotles in adobo  bbq sauce
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients in a pot and simmer till nice a thick about 1 hour
2. Can be made the day before
3. Pour into jars and store in the refrigerator

title: woods baked b q chicken
steps:
1. Cover chicken with sauce
2. Baste
3. Bake 350 for 1 hours

title: kittencal s fluffy omelet
steps:
1. In a small bowl whisk together eggs , baking powder , cream , green onions , salt and pepper until frothy
2. Heat an 8-inch skillet over medium heat until your hands feel warm when held about 2-inches above the surface
3. Add in butter and swirl to coat the bottom of the pan evenly
4. Pour the whisked eggs into the skillet
5. Let set slightly
6. Using a heat-proof spatula , push eggs from edge towards the center
7. Tilt pan to let egg fill the spaces
8. Repeat until omelet if just set
9. Sprinkle the grated cheese down the center of the omelet
10. Using the same spatula , gently fold the omelet over the cheese
11. Tilt skillet and slide the filled omelet onto a serving plate

title: spicy honey ginger shrimp
steps:
1. Combine first 7 ingredients in a microwave safe bowl big enough to fit the shrimp in as well
2. Microwave the sauce for about 30 seconds just to melt the honey
3. Stir well , add shrimp and toss to coat them
4. Marinate for 30 min to an hour , stirring once
5. Stir fry the veggies in a large skillet or a wok
6. When veggies are thawed but not fully cooked , add the shrimp and marinade
7. Stir fry for 2-4 min until shrimp are done
8. Add cornstarch and stir until sauce thickens
9. Serve over rice
10. Enjoy !

title: pastitsio just like my sister s
steps:
1. Grease a 9" x 13" baking dish
2. Add the pasta to a large pan of boiling water
3. Boil , uncovered , until just tender
4. Drain
5. Combine the hot pasta , eggs and cheese in a large bowl
6. Mix well
7. Put to one side
8. To make the meat sauce , heat the oil in a large pan , add the onions and ground beef and cook , stirring , until the meat is well browned
9. Stir in the tomato puree , tomato paste , beef stock , wine and cinnamon
10. Simmer uncovered until thick
11. Cool
12. Stir in the egg
13. To make the topping , melt the butter in a large saucepan and add the flour
14. Stir over low heat until bubbling
15. Remove from the heat and gradually stir in the milk
16. Stir over low heat until the sauce boils and thickens
17. Stir in the cheese and cool slightly
18. Stir in the egg yolks
19. To assemble , press the pasta over the base of the prepared baking dish
20. Top the pasta evenly with the meat sauce , pour over the topping and smooth the surface
21. Sprinkle with the bread crumbs
22. Bake , uncovered , in a 350 degree f oven for 1 hour or until lightly browned
23. Let stand for 10 minutes before serving

title: philly pizza steak pasta
steps:
1. Boil mafalda pasta according to package directions
2. While pasta is cooking , preheat oven to 350
3. Then , break up steak-ums into small pieces with hands and place them in a large skillet with onion , pepper and mushroom
4. Cook over med-high heat , stirring often and chopping meat a bit more , until meat is browned and peppers are tender
5. Drain
6. In a large bowl , combine the browned meat / veggie mixture with cooked and drained pasta
7. Add salt , pepper , and oregano
8. Stir
9. Add 4 cups sauce and the cheddar cheese and stir well
10. Pour into at least a 13" x 9" baking dish
11. Cut 6 slices of american cheese in half so you have 12 half slices
12. Arrange 12 half slices of cheese evenly on top
13. Bake at 350 for 25-30 minutes

title: honey white wheat bread
steps:
1. Put everything in the bread machine's bread pan and turn the machine on
2. A 1 1 / 2 pound loaf makes 18 slices
3. Per serving-
4. Calories :86 sodiom : 90 mg
5. Cholesterol : 0 mg fat :3 g
6. Fiber:2
7. 5g

title: balsamic chicken and onions
steps:
1. In a deep skillet or large pot boil 4 cups water over high heat
2. Add container of balsamic dressing to water , chicken , onions , sherry and parsley
3. Boil on medium until moisture starts to evaporate , stir occasionally
4. Mix in brown sugar and continue to cook until moisture evaporates by half
5. About 30-45 minutes total boiling time
6. Chicken should be medium brown in color
7. Scoop out chicken and onions into serving bowl

title: give me a dime
steps:
1. Pour all ingredients into a shaker with ice
2. Shake
3. Strain into a cocktail glass
4. Garnish with grated chocolate if desired

title: tuna fish and spaghetti casserole
steps:
1. Boil spaghetti for 10 minutes
2. Drain
3. Spray frying pan with nonstick cooking spray
4. Saute pepper and onion until softened slightly
5. Season with salt and pepper
6. Mix together onion , pepper , tuna , spaghetti , soup , and milk
7. Add to greased casserole dish
8. Top mixture with chips
9. Bake at 375 for 35 minutes

title: quick chocolate chai
steps:
1. Boil or microwave water until hot
2. Mix in hot chocolate
3. Place tea bag in hot chocolate
4. Steep 3-5 minutes , depending on how much spice you want
5. Squeeze teabag to get more of the spice flavor in the chocolate
6. Enjoy !

title: erin s broccoli rice
steps:
1. Mix the sauce ingredients together and set aside
2. Put the water and the rice in a medium saucepan , bring the water to a boil and then lower the heat to a simmer , cover and simmer for 15-20 minutes or until done
3. Saute the onion and broccoli in the oils until the onions are soft
4. Add the garlic , saute for about 1 minute
5. Add the sauce mixture and heat through
6. Serve with the rice

title: italian cream cupcakes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325f
2. Line two 12 cup muffin pans with paper liners and coat with nonstick spray
3. Whisk together flour , baking powder , baking soda and salt in a bowl
4. Set aside
5. Cream sugar and butter in a stand mixer with a paddle attachment on medium speed until white and fluffy
6. About 5 minutes
7. Add egg yolks , 1 at a time , beating well after each addition
8. Mix in syrup and vanilla until incorporated
9. Mix 1 / 2 the dry ingredients into butter mixture , followed by the buttermilk , then remaining dry ingredients
10. Blend until just incorporated
11. Beat whites to stiff peaks in a bowl with a mixer on high speed
12. Fold into batter with coconut and hazelnuts
13. Fille liners to the top with batter and bake until toothpick inserted in center of a cupcake comes out clean , about 20-25 minutes
14. Cool cupcakes in pan for about 20 minutes , transfer to a rack , then when completely cool frost with icing
15. Icing:
16. Whip cream cheese and butter together in a large bowl with a mixer at medium speed until combined
17. Add syrup and cream , then beat in powdered sugar until creamy
18. Generously frost each cupcake
19. Garnish with shredded coconut and hazelnuts

title: crock pot carrot and parsnip soup
steps:
1. Peel carrots and parsnips and cut up coarsely
2. Chop onion and place in bowl with butter and garlic
3. Microwave on high for 5 minutes and set aside
4. In crock pot place parsnips , carrots , broth or water , the onion mixture and cover and cook high 6 to 8 hours or until vegetables tender
5. Puree with hand blender or remove and puree in batches
6. Season to taste
7. Stir in desired amount of cream to color and flavor soup
8. Serve hot
9. Garnish with chopped fresh parsley

title: crispy fish in chili sauce
steps:
1. The strength of the chili sauce will effect how hot this dish is
2. I recommend a sweet chili sauce for those who don't like it too hot
3. Place oil , ginger , garlic , tomato sauce and chili sauce in a pan on medium heat for 5 minutes
4. Add remaining ingredients and let it simmer on low for a few more minutes
5. Leave the sauce to sit while you prepare the fish
6. Chop the fish into approximately bite-size pieces
7. Sift the flour and cornflour into a bowl
8. Make a well in the flour and add the egg white and water
9. Mix to a smooth batter
10. Coat the pieces of fish with the batter
11. Heat oil in large pan and dip the fish into the oil
12. Cook the pieces for a few minutes each
13. Heat the sauce back up
14. Once the fish is all cooked add the sauce to the fish in a large frying pan
15. Serve when hot
16. Enjoy

title: nutty vegan pancakes
steps:
1. In a large bowl , mix flour , stevia , baking powder , salt , and flax seeds
2. Make a well in the center , and pour in remaining ingredients
3. Heat griddle or frying pan over medium high heat
4. Lightly spray with cooking spray or oil
5. Pour or scoop the batter onto the griddle , using approximately 1 / 4 cup for each pancake
6. Brown on both sides and serve hot

title: white spaghetti pie
steps:
1. Cook 3 servings spaghetti al dente , drain and set aside
2. In large skillet saute sausages until just cooked
3. I let them cool and peel the casings off , then cut them into 1 / 2 inch coins
4. Return sausage to the skillet and add garlic , red pepper flakes , basil , italian seasoning , olive oil , salt and pepper , saute 2 minutes
5. Add mushrooms , saute 2 minutes
6. Add broccoli and celery , saute 2 minutes
7. Add onion , saute 2 minutes
8. Turn off burner cover and let sit until egg milk mixture is ready
9. Quickly beat eggs and milk together
10. In greased 9x13 inch glass pan layer 1 / 2 the vegetable meat mixture , then 1 / 2 the pasta , repeat
11. Pour the egg mixture over the whole thing and top with grated cheese
12. Bake at 325 until bubbly , let stand 10 min before serving

title: lemon lime chicken
steps:
1. Place chicken in a shallow glass dish
2. Combine remaining ingredients , pour over chicken cover and refrigerate at least 4 hours or overnight
3. Drain and disgard marinade
4. Grill chicken over medium-hot heat , turning once until juices run clear , about 12- 15 minutes

title: grilled asparagus with caper butter
steps:
1. Preheat grill to high
2. Place butter in small saucepan and melt over low heat , whisk in dijon mustard and capers
3. Remove from heat and set aside
4. Brush asparagus with olive oil and sprinkle with salt and pepper
5. Place on hot grill and grill for 4 minutes
6. Turn asparagus over with tongs and grill an additional 4 minutes or just until crisp-tender
7. Transfer asparagus to serving dish and pour caper-butter over

title: herb and dried tomato risotto  gift mix
steps:
1. Combine bouillon granules and spices together in a small bowl
2. Divide equally among 4 half-pint canning jars to create the first layer
3. Snip the tomatoes into small pieces with kitchen scissors and divide them evenly among your jars to create the next layer
4. Top off each jar with the rice - filling to the top
5. Attach the following preparation directions to each jar
6. Additional ingredients provided by the recipient:
7. 3 cups of water
8. 1 / 4 cup freshly grated parmesan or romano cheese
9. In a large , heavy saucepan bring the water to a boil and add the contents of the jar
10. Stir well and return to a boil
11. Reduce heat cover and simmer for 20 minutes
12. Remove from the heat and let stand , covered for 5 minutes
13. Rice should be tender but slightly firm
14. Stir in the cheese and enjoy !
15. Makes 6 servings

title: variety oatmeal cookie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. In a large bowl mix the eggs and sugars
3. Mix well
4. Add peanut butter , buuter , salt , and vanilla and mix well
5. Add the baking soda (if using a stand mixer , use mix setting) , then add the oats
6. Stir in the m&ms , choc
7. Chips , coconut , and caramel
8. I use an ice cream scoop and place them on a slipmat on a baking sheet about two inches apart
9. Bake for 9 minutes
10. Leave on the cookie sheet for a couple minutes before rermoving to a rack or they will fall apart

title: strawberry raspberry jam
steps:
1. You will also need 6 jelly or jam jars , boiled or washed in hot soapy water , then rinsed in hot water smash the raspberries and strawberries and place them in a large sauce pot with the water
2. Bring to a simmer over medium-high heat then add the sugars
3. Turn heat to high and bring to a rolling boil , stirring often
4. Quickly stir in the pectin and let boil for 1 minute , stirring constantly
5. Remove from the heat and ladle into the jars to about 1 / 2-inch from the top
6. Place the lids on tight and turn the jars upside-down for 15 minutes then turn them right side up
7. The jam will last for about 6 months in a cool , dark pantry and about 1 year in the refrigerator

title: vegan mushroom stroganoff
steps:
1. In a large pot , bring the can of vegetable broth to a boil
2. Turn down the heat to let it simmer and add the sour cream
3. Stir well to combine
4. Add the crumbles or seitan , mushrooms , seasonings and uncooked noodles
5. Stir well and add the water until it just covers the noodles
6. Cover and let simmer for 20-30 minutes , stirring occasionally , until the noodles have absorbed all the liquids and are fully cooked
7. Season with salt and pepper

title: marcy goldman s world famous potato pancakes latkes
steps:
1. The best way to fry these are in tiny dollops , dropped from a spoon and use a deep wok
2. The cooking method is so important so follow the directions exactly for perfect results
3. Place potatoes in a medium saucepan and just cover with cold water
4. Turn heat to high and allow to come to boil
5. As soon as potatoes are boiling , put a kitchen timer on for 10 minutes
6. When timer rings , remove potatoes from stove and cover with cold water
7. Drain immediately , then cover again with cold water
8. Let sit five minutes
9. Remove potatoes and pat dry
10. Using a hand shredder or food processor fitted with a medium disc , shred potatoes
11. The potatoes should be slightly softened , but still firm enough to produce shreds
12. If the peel separates from the potato , discard it
13. If the peel gets grated in with the potatoes , it's fine and just incorporate it into the mixture
14. I like the hand grater best
15. When i use the processor , i use two thirds shredded then pulverized potatoes and one third shredded for a mixture than is bulky but still has shreds
16. Worth the trouble
17. In a large bowl , blend shredded potatoes , grated onion , eggs , flour , baking powder , salt , and pepper
18. Place newspaper on work surface and cover with a few paper towels
19. In a large deep skillet , pour in enough vegetable oil to fill about two thirds
20. If using an electric fry pan , set the temperature to 350f or 375f
21. Drop potato batter by teaspoons or soup spoonfuls in small dollops , flattening slightly with a metal spatula if desired
22. I use large metal tongs for dropping and turning
23. Brown one side , turn once , and complete cooking on other side
24. These cook quickly
25. You're looking for a puffy centre while retaining some crisp shreds of potato on edges
26. Serve immediately or freeze
27. To reheat , place latkes on a large wire cake rack on a cookie sheet
28. Warm at 250f until crisp
29. For freezing purposes , fry them a little underdone to allow for browning in the re-heating stage

title: tomato and swiss toasted sandwich
steps:
1. Toast the slice of bread
2. Put the slice of tomato on the bread
3. Put the slice of swiss cheese on top of the tomato
4. Add salt and pepper
5. Cook in a microwave for about 30 seconds or until cheese is melted

title: kennedy family brownies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees
2. Butter an 8 inch square pan
3. Melt 4 oz butter on low heat and then stir in 2 oz unsweetened chocolate to melt
4. Set aside
5. Beat 2 eggs and add in 1 cup sugar
6. Beat eggs / sugar for about 2 minutes , until the batter is very light
7. Beat in the melted butter and chocolate
8. Add flour and vanilla and mix just until blended
9. Turn batter into pan
10. Bake 25 minutes
11. Do not overbake
12. Let cool and cut into squares

title: dessert citrus sauce
steps:
1. In 1 quart saucepan , combine sugar and cornstarch
2. Gradually stir in water until smooth
3. Cook over medium heat , stirring often until boiling
4. Boil 1 minute , stirring constantly
5. Remove from heat
6. Stir in butter , juice , and peel until butter is melted
7. Serve warm

title: falls mill harvest bread
steps:
1. Dissolve yeast in warm milk in a large bowl
2. Let stand 5 minutes
3. Add 2 2 / 3 cups bread flour and next 7 ingredients , stirring until a soft dough forms
4. Turn dough out onto a floured surface
5. Knead until smooth and elastic
6. Add enough of remaining bread flour to prevent dough from sticking to your hands
7. Place in a large bowl coated with cooking spray , turning once to coat other side
8. Cover and let rise in a warm place , 1 hour or until doubled
9. Punch dough down , and divide in half
10. Roll one portion of dough into a 15x7-inch rectangle
11. Roll up dough , starting at short side , pressing to eliminate air pockets
12. Pinch ends to seal
13. Place loaf , seam side down , in an 8 1 / 2 x 4 1 / 2- inch loaf pan coated with cooking spray
14. Repeat with remaining dough
15. Cover and let rise in a warm place , free from drafts 40 minutes or until doubled
16. Bake at 375 for 35 minutes or until loaves sound hollow when tapped
17. Remove bread from pans
18. Cool on wire racks

title: classic entrecote bordelaise   steak in red wine with shallots
steps:
1. Saut the steaks
2. Season the steaks with salt and pepper on both sides
3. Heat the pan to smoking point and add half the butter
4. Place the steak in the pan and brown it on both sides - give it about two to three minutes on each side to seal it first , then let the meat cook through to your taste
5. Do both steaks in this way and then set them aside
6. Cook the shallots
7. In the same pan , , cook the shallots
8. Put them in the pan and stir from time to time until they are soft and starting to turn golden
9. Deglaze the pan
10. When the shallots are done add the red wine to the pan and give it a good stir
11. Now , add the demi glace or beef stock to the pan and stir until everything is blended , then leave it to simmer for 5 minutes or until reduced
12. Cut the remaining butter into small pieces and add them to the sauce one at a time , mixing so that they melt into the mixture: this will give the sauce a rich flavour and give it an appetising glossy finish ,
13. Plate the dish
14. Cut the meat across the grain into thick slices and arrange them on a plate
15. Add some chopped parsley to the sauce , then pour little of the sauce over each steak
16. Serve the rest of the sauce in a gravy boat
17. You might like to serve it with saut potatoes , frites and some haricot verts

title: strawberry soup with honey ice cream
steps:
1. Wash , hull and slice strawberries
2. Sprinkle with lime juice , toss and cover strawberries
3. Refrigerate till ready to assemble dessert
4. Bring water , sugar and 3 basil leaves to a boil over medium heat
5. Stir until sugar is completely melted and mixture becomes a syrup
6. Remove from heat and cool
7. Mix teaspoon of confectioner's sugar in just enough water to liquify it
8. Dip the four remaining basil leaves in the sugar / water mixture and set on a piece of waxed or parchment paper in the freezer
9. Combine cream , milk , sugar and honey in a saucepan and place over medium heat
10. Bring to just below a boil , stirring occasionally to dissolve the sugar
11. Once the mixture is about to boil , reduce the heat to low
12. In a bowl , whisk the egg yolks
13. Slowly add about a cup of the cream mixture to the egg yolks , whisking continuously
14. When well blended , add the yolk / cream mixture back into the cream in the saucepan , whisking continuously
15. Continue whisking over low heat until the mixture becomes 'custardy' enough to coat the back of a spoon without dripping off -- maybe ten minutes
16. Pour the custard mixture into an ice cream maker and freeze according to manufacturer's directions
17. If you don't have an ice cream maker , pour into a non-reactive container and place in freezer for about an hour
18. When mixture becomes 'slushy' vigorously stir it and return to freezer
19. Repeat until mixture has the consistency of frozen custard
20. When ice cream is almost ready , place strawberries in blender
21. Remove bay leaves from sugar syrup and add syrup to blender
22. Blend strawberries and syrup till smooth
23. Distribute strawberry liquid among four dessert bowls
24. Using ice cream scoop or two tablespoons , form balls or ovals of ice cream , placing three in each of the four dessert bowls
25. Garnish each bowl with one of the glazed basil leaves
26. Serve immediately

title: hummus with a twist
steps:
1. Blend first four ingredients with juice from 2 lemons in food processor until smooth and creamy , about 5 minutes
2. Add blend in remaining ingredients starting with 4 cloves of garlic
3. Taste and adjust seasoning as needed

title: serbian cabbage
steps:
1. Place cabbage and onions in a shallow 4 quart buttered casserole
2. Pour the milk over and sprinkle with the breadcrumbs
3. Dot with butter and sprinkle with paprika
4. Cover and bake at 350f for 30 minutes
5. Uncover and bake an additional 30 minutes or until crumbs are golden brown , and cabbage is tender
6. You can probably substitute low fat or non fat evaporated milk , but don't use regular milk
7. Some magic will occur , and the cabbage develops a wonderful creamy consistency
8. I just say it's comfort food at it's finest

title: double orange delight
steps:
1. Mix yogurt and orange juice concentrate
2. Spoon 2 tablespoons yogurt mixture onto each of 4 dessert plates
3. Arrange orange sections on yogurt mixture
4. Heat chocolate chips and shortening over low heat , stirring constantly until chocolate is melted
5. Carefully drizzle chocolate in thin lines over oranges

title: corn and cheese griddle cakes  arepas
steps:
1. Put the cornmeal and salt in a food processor and process until finely ground
2. Transfer to a large bowl and stir in the cheese and butter
3. Meanwhile , heat the milk in a small saucepan over medium-high heat until almost boiling
4. Gradually stir enough of the milk into the cornmeal mixture to make a very thick batter
5. Stir in the corn
6. Spray a large nonstick skillet with nonstick cooking spray and set over medium heat
7. Drop half of the cornmeal mixture , 1 heaping tablespoon at a time , in 6 mounds in the skillet
8. Flatten slightly and cook until golden brown , about 3 minutes
9. Spray the griddle cakes with nonstick spray and turn
10. Cook until golden brown , about 3 minutes , transferring them to a platter when they are done
11. Keep warm
12. Repeat with the remaining cornmeal mixture to make a total of 12 griddle cakes
13. Serve with pico de gallo , if using

title: low carb meatball minestrone
steps:
1. Chop the vegetables
2. Defrost the meatballs in the microwave according to directions , which helps remove some of the fat
3. If you want to skip this step , just drop the meatballs into the simmering soup
4. Saute the onion , celery , zucchini , pepper , and eggplant in the oil
5. Add all of the rest of the ingredients and bring to a simmer
6. Cover and simmer until vegetables are soft
7. Erve with grated parmesan cheese

title: poached egg toast sandwich
steps:
1. Toast the bread cool and lightly butter
2. Boil water , add a splash of vinegar and poach eggs
3. Top buttered toasts with a slice of american singles cheese or any other cheese you might have
4. Place poached egg on top of cheese , salt and pepper to taste
5. Place second slice of toast on top of egg , cut in half
6. Enjoy

title: anme s apple crumb pie
steps:
1. Crust
2. Mix flour and salt
3. With a pastry blender or two knifes cut in the cold shortening until it looks like crumbs
4. Sprinkle cold water over flour
5. Toss mixture with a fork to combine
6. Add more water if needed
7. Gently gather dough together into a ball and wrap in plastic wrap
8. Chill in refrigerator for at least 30 minutes
9. Roll dough and place into a 9 inch pie plate
10. Pie filling:
11. Mix apples , 1 / 3 cup sugar , flour , cinnamon and nutmeg together in a bowl then place in unbaked pie crust
12. Topping:
13. Mix 1 / 2 cup flour and 1 / 2 cup brown sugar together in a bowl
14. Cut in butter until mixture is crumbly
15. Sprinkle topping mixture over apples
16. Cover top loosely with aluminum foil
17. Bake at 375 degrees fahrenheit for 25 minutes
18. Remove foil and bake 25 to 30 more minutes , until top is golden brown
19. Cool on a wire rack

title: magical kiss cookies
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350 degrees
2. Beat butter , sugar , and vanilla in large bowl until creamy
3. Stir in flour and cocoa gradually to butter mixture until blended
4. Mold into balls around the kisses - about 1 inch balls or so , enough to cover kiss completely
5. Place on ungreased cookie sheet and bake for 8-10 minutes
6. Cool and roll cooies in powdered sugar
7. I did mine 2-3 times to make sure well coated

title: baked country ham
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Place ham in a heavy roasting pan
3. To make the glaze , mince garlic in a food processor
4. Add remaining ingredients
5. Process until smooth
6. Pour glaze over ham and bake 1 hour , until ham is fully heated and glaze is well browned
7. Serve hot or at room temperature

title: sweet onion mango chutney
steps:
1. Coarsely chop dried mango
2. Coarsely chop sweet onions
3. Force garlic cloves through press
4. Combine all ingredients in large heavy pot and simmer 2 1 / 2 to 3 hours (less time means chunkier consistency
5. Stir often to keep from scorching on bottom of pot
6. Spoon hot chutney into sterilized jars and put canning lids on loosely as will seal tightly as cools
7. Will keep for quite a long time
8. Store in refrigerator

title: peach pleasures
steps: 1. Blend all ingredients together , except the grenadine , pour over ice , float the grenadine over the top and garnish with cherry

title: loveless seasoned salt
steps: 1. Mix all the ingredients together and store in an air-tight container

title: like earl s santa fe salad
steps:
1. Dressing:
2. Combine ingredients in a food processor or use a hand immersion blender to process until mixture is green and tiny specks of peanuts and lime are visible
3. Makes 3 / 4 cup
4. Salad:
5. Heat oil to 375 degrees in a deep fryer or heavy pot
6. Add tortilla pieces and deep fry until golden and crisp
7. Drain on paper towels
8. Rub corn with vegetable oil and grill over medium-high heat until lightly browned
9. Cool and remove kernels
10. Place lettuces in a large bowl
11. Toss together with enough dressing to lightly coat
12. Add corn , dates , black beans and half the tortilla pieces and feta cheese
13. Toss well
14. Divide between 4 plates and top with remaining feta cheese and tortilla pieces
15. Sprinkle chopped peanuts over top
16. Peel and thinly slice avocado and divide between 4 plates
17. Place beside each salad

title: the best ever fudge brownies
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan , melt butter or margarine on low heat
2. Remove from heat and in same pan , stir in sugar , eggs and vanilla , stir well
3. Add in flour , cocoa , baking powder and salt
4. Stir in chips and nuts if desired
5. Bake at 350 for approx 25-30 minutes , depending on your oven
6. Do not over-bake

title: cheesy picante potatoes
steps:
1. In medium skillet mix soup , salsa , and garlic powder
2. Add potatoes
3. Over medium heat , heat through , stirring often
4. Sprinkle with paprika and cilantro
5. Serve with additional salsa

title: southwestern stir fry
steps:
1. Combine sherry , cornstarch , cumin , garlic and salt in medium bowl
2. Add pork slices and stir to coat
3. Heat oil over medium-high heat in heavy skillet
4. Add pork mixture and stir-fry about 3-4 minutes
5. Add remaining ingredients , cover and simmer for 3-4 minutes
6. Serve hot with green chile salsa , if desired

title: acadian peppered shrimp
steps:
1. The shrimp should be of a size to number 30-35 per pound
2. Melt the butter in a large deep-sided frying pan or iron skillet over low heat
3. When melted , raise the heat , and add the remaining ingredients except the shrimp
4. Cook , stirring often , until browned to a rich mahogany color , about 10 minutes
5. Add the shrimp , stir- ring and turning to coat well with the seasoned butter
6. Cook until the shrimp have turned a rich deep pink , about 10 minutes
7. Serve the shrimp in their shells , peeling them at the table

title: easy peppermint bark
steps:
1. Unwrap candy canes and place in a thick ziplock bag
2. The freezer kind or if using the regular ones just use two , one inside the other to make it thick
3. You can also use hard peppermint candies if you are making this after christmas
4. Place the candy inside the bag and crush it using a large metal spoon or a rolling pin- not too small , not too big
5. Martha would have you sift the candy to seperate the large pieces from the dust
6. I did not- it is up to you
7. Line a jelly roll pan or a 9x13 baking dish with tin foil
8. Spray with nonstick spray
9. Place white chocolate in a heatproof bowl set over a pot of simmering water
10. Test bowl before adding water to be sure it will sit on the pot and not dip down to low
11. Add water and test again- then heat up the water
12. Heat , stirring occasionally until chocolate is melted
13. Remove bowl from heat and stir in rice krispies
14. Pour mixture into prepared pan and spread
15. You can make it thick or thin
16. Sprinkle with crushed peppermint candy
17. Press them into the chocolate lightly otherwise they will fall off later- use waxed paper , the back of a spoon or your fingers
18. If you choose you can melt the mint chips and drizzle them over the top
19. Chill 20-30 minutes
20. Apparently if you leave it in the fridge longer it will get soft
21. Peel tin foil off and break into pieces
22. Store in an airtight container up to 1 week

title: crab artichoke melt
steps:
1. Mix crab , artichoke hearts , scallions , celery , white pepper , garlic , parmesan / romano / asiago cheese and mayonnaise in a large bowl
2. Spread 6 oz
3. Of crab mix on slice of sourdough bread
4. Top with cheddar / jack cheese: -- scallions
5. Bake at 425f for 8 minutes

title: smoked barbecue ribs
steps:
1. Combine all of the spices with the sugar and blend well forming a bbq spice mix to use as a rub
2. Trim the ribs of any excess fat and remove the membrane from the back of the ribs
3. Season the ribs all over with the spice mix
4. Place ribs bone side down in an enclosed smoker preheated to 230 degrees fahrenheit
5. Turn the ribs and baste with apple juice every hour for 4 to 5 hours , or until you can take two side by side ribs and tear them apart easily
6. During the last 30 minutes of smoking you will need to start glazing the ribs on both sides with bbq sauce of your choice , every 10 minutes
7. Remove the ribs from the smoker , cover and let rest for 10-15 minutes
8. Serve hot

title: wild rice stuffing
steps:
1. Heat a dutch oven over medium-high heat
2. Coat pan with cooking spray
3. Add celery , onion , wild rice , and garlic to pan
4. Saut 3 minutes
5. Stir in broth and sage
6. Bring to a boil
7. Cover , reduce heat , and simmer 25 minutes
8. Stir in brown rice , and bring to a boil
9. Cover , reduce heat , and cook for 30 minutes or until liquid is absorbed
10. Remove from heat
11. Let stand , covered , 10 minutes
12. Stir in cherries and remaining ingredients
13. Serve or stuff your turkey or chicken

title: gluten free cheese muffins
steps:
1. Beat egg and milk together very well
2. Mix all dry ingredients and cheese together
3. Add wet ingredients to dry ones
4. Don't overmix
5. Bake at 210 deg c for approximately 12 minutes
6. Diced bacon , onion , parsley and corn kernels can be added to an extra savoury and high protein muffin

title: strawberry cake with frosting
steps:
1. Combine cake mix , jello , and eggs
2. Mix well
3. Add oil , water , and 1 / 2 the strawberries
4. Beat on med for 2 minutes
5. Pour into greased 12x9 pan
6. Bake at 350 for 30 minutes
7. Cool
8. Frosting: combine powdered sugar , butter and remaining strawberries
9. Mix well
10. Spread on cooled cake

title: basic white cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease two 9-inch x 1 1 / 2 inch cake plans line bottoms with parchment paper grease bottom and flour entire pan
3. Prepare magic cake strips if using
