4. In a medium bowl lightly combine the egg whites , 1 / 4 cup milk , and vanilla , beat lightly with a fork to combine in a large mixing bowl combine the dry ingredients and mix on low speed for 30 seconds to blend
5. Add the butter and remaining 3 / 4 cup milk
6. Mix on low speed until the dry ingredients are moistened
7. Beat for 90 seconds at medium speed to develop cake structure
8. Stop mixer , scrape down the sides
9. Gradually add the egg / milk / vanilla mixture in 3 batches , beating 20 seconds after each addition
10. Stop mixer , scrape down the sides and give it a final mix by hand
11. Pour the batter in the prepared pans and smooth surface
12. Bake 25 to 35 minutes or until toothpick inserted in cake comes out clean and the cake springs back when pressed lightly in center
13. Cool the cakes in the pans for 10 minutes , then invert onto a buttered rack
14. Reinvert cakes so that tops are right side up
15. Cool to room temperature and wrap tightly with plastic wrap

title: make your own chocolate cake mix
steps:
1. Mix together flour , cocoa , soda , and salt
2. Stir to blend
3. Mix in sugar
4. Cut the shortening into the dry ingredients until the mixture looks crumbly
5. Label and store in a sealed plastic bag at room temperature
6. Makes 1 package of mix
7. Each package makes two 8 or 9 inch layers or one 9 x 13 x 2 inch rectangle
8. To use:
9. Pour 1 package of mix into a mixing bowl
10. Add 1 1 / 4 cups milk and 1 teaspoon vanilla or orange extract
11. Using an electric mixer , beat at a slow to medium speed for 2 minutes
12. Scrape the sides of the bowl frequently
13. Add 2 eggs
14. Beat 1 minute more
15. Grease and dust with flour your choice of pan
16. Spread batter evenly in pans
17. Bake round cake pans at 350 degrees f
18. For about 30 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean
19. Bake the 9 x 13 inch pan for 30 to 35 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean
20. Cool cakes in their pans for 10 minutes before turning out onto racks
21. Chocolate cupcakes: pour cake batter into greased cupcake tins or tins lined with paper baking cups
22. Fill 1 / 2 to 2 / 3 full
23. Bake at 350 degrees f
24. For 20 to 25 minutes or until a toothpick comes out clean
25. Makes about 2 dozen

title: hazelnut oatmeal cookies
steps:
1. Cream butter and sugars in a large bowl
2. Add eggs and vanilla and beat well
3. Slowly add dry ingredients , mixing well after each addition
4. Add rolled oats and raisins
5. Let stand for 30 minutes
6. Roll into balls , about 1 1 / 2 tsp in each
7. Place 2 inches apart on a greased cookie sheet and bake at 350 degrees for 8 minutes or until golden
8. Cool completely
9. Spread 1 tsp of nutella on the bottom of a cookie and top with another cookie
10. Repeat for remaining cookies

title: nitkos mushroom sauce
steps:
1. Cut mushrooms into pieces
2. Melt butter and put mushrooms and green pepper
3. Cook covered until mushrooms soften uncover , pour brandy and flamb
4. When fire is over , add nutmeg , salt , pepper and a little water
5. Cook until water almost evaporate than add cream and parmesan and mix until cheese melts
6. It depends how thick sauce you want add more cream or grated parmesan
7. At the end add parsley leaves and serve: goes excellent with steaks

title: eggnog shorties
steps:
1. Sift together the flour , nutmeg and salt in a medium sized bowl
2. In a large bowl , beat the butter and sugar with an electric mixer , until light and fluffy
3. Beat in the egg yolks and the extracts
4. Stir in the flour
5. Use a melon baller to scoop out cookies to an ungreased cookie sheet
6. Press them into a cross-hatch pattern with a wet fork
7. Bake at 350f for 12 to 15 minutes
8. Let cool completely before icing- cream the butter , and mix in the icing sugar and rum
9. Spread onto the cookies with a knife
10. Sprinkle the iced cookies with a little nutmeg

title: banana muffin tops  or muffins and mini muffins
steps:
1. Position an oven rack on the middle shelf of oven
2. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
3. Lightly grease and flour or spray muffin tin with non-stick cooking spray
4. In a medium bowl , combine the flour , baking powder , baking soda and salt
5. In a large mxing bowl , combine the bananas , brown sugar , oil , eggs , and vanilla
6. Beat on medium speed until well blended with only small bits of banana visible
7. Pour in the dry ingredients and gently stir with a rubber spatula just until blended
8. Add nuts or chocolate chips when the flour is almost blended and stir to incorporate
9. Fill the muffin top indentation to almost full with the batter
10. Gently tap the pan on the countertop to even out the batter
11. Bake until the tops are golden brown and a toothpick or a cake tester inserted comes out clean , about 13 minutes
12. Transfer the pan to a wire rack to cool for 5 minutes
13. Then carefully remove the muffin tops from the pan and set them on the rack to cool
14. Serve warm or at room temperature

title: fava bean soup
steps:
1. Saute onions
2. Add everything to a pressure cooker
3. Cook 30 minutes
4. Adjust water to taste
5. Add 1 / 2 lemon

title: tiramitwist
steps:
1. Mix together the mascarpone , peanut butter , powdered sugar , and vanilla until creamy and smooth
2. Gently fold the whipped topping into the cheese mixture until well incorporated
3. Combine the coffee and stout in a small bowl
4. Quickly dip lady fingers into the coffee / beer mixture
5. Gently squeeze out excess liquid if needed
6. Lay half of the lady fingers in an 8x8 casserole
7. Top the lady fingers with half the cheese mixture
8. Dust with 1 teaspoon of cocoa powder
9. Repeat using the rest of the dipped lady fingers , the cheese mixture , and finishing off dusting the top with the last teaspoon of cocoa powder
10. Place in the fridge to chill at least two hours

title: shrimp longhi
steps:
1. For garlic toast , preheat broiler
2. Saute garlic in butter for 2-3 minutes
3. Dip one side of each slice of bread into garlic butter and place , butter side up , under broiler until toasted
4. Put each slice of bread onto a serving plate and set aside
5. In the meantime , put butter and olive oil together in a large saute pan and heat over medium heat until butter is foamy
6. Mix flour with garlic salt and pepper , and use to dredge shrimp , shaking off any excess flour
7. Place shrimp in a single layer in butter / olive oil mixture
8. Saute shrimp for 3 to 5 minutes per side , until shrimp is cooked
9. Remove shrimp from pan and pour out any excess butter
10. Return pan to heat and deglaze with white wine
11. Reduce wine for 2 - 3 minutes then add lemon juice
12. Reduce liquid by half then stir in 4 - 6 t cold butter , whisking well after each tablespoon , until the sauce becomes emulsified
13. The sauce should not be thick but should just coat the back of a spoon
14. Add basil and tomato to the pan and stir
15. Return shrimp to the pan and toss
16. Put shrimp on garlic toast and pour sauce over the shrimp

title: tibetan green beans with potatoes  tema
steps:
1. Cut the green beans diagonally into 1 1 / 2-inch pieces
2. Cut the potatoes like french fries , about the same size as the beans
3. Slice the red bell pepper very thinly
4. In a wok or skillet , saute the onion in oil over high heat until softened , add the garlic , paprika and ginger and saute a few minutes more
5. Add the potatoes , jalapeno and tomato , and stir-fry until the tomato cooks dry
6. Add the green beans and stir-fry until just tender , about 8 minutes
7. Add the soy sauce , red-pepper and salt stirring in quickly

title: cherry almond chocolate cluster
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , toss together the almonds and cherries
2. Line a baking sheet with waxed paper
3. Melt half the chocolate in the top of a double boiler over about an inch of barely simmering water , over the lowest possible heat , stirring frequently
4. Remove the pan from the heat and stir in the rest of the chocolate
5. Remove the top pan with the chocolate in it , gently drying the bottom , and set it aside
6. Replace the simmering water in the bottom pan with warm water from the sink
7. Put the pan of melted chocolate on top of the warm water
8. This will keep the chocolate at the proper temperature while you make the clusters
9. Stir the fruit and nut mixture into the chocolate
10. Spoon out heaping tablespoon size clusters of the chocolate mixture onto the baking sheet about 1 inch apart
11. Put them in the refrigerator to set for at least 15 minutes
12. Store and serve at room temperature
13. Enjoy !

title: halloween monster of a cake
steps:
1. Cake:
2. Preheat oven to 350
3. Spray 4 , 8-9" round cake pans with nonstick spray and flour
4. Line bottom of pans with parchment paper , spray parchment
5. Set aside
6. Prepare devil's food cake mix according to package directions divide between 2 pans and bake according to package directions
7. Cool completely
8. Prepare white cake mix according to package directions , add green food coloring
9. Divide batter between 2 remaining pans and bake according to package directions
10. Cool completely
11. Put a sheet of wax paper on cake stand or plate then put cake layers on , when you are done just pull out the wax paper and your plate will be clean
12. Put the top of cakes facing down so you have a nice flat area to spread filling and frost top layer
13. Spread pistachio filling evenly between layers
14. Spread chocolate ganache icing evenly over top and sides of cake , if icing sets up on cake before you can blend it all put cake in oven on warm setting for a bit to soften then blend top and sides well
15. Garnish with chopped pistachios
16. Pistachio filling:
17. In a lg bowl , combine pudding mix , cream , sour cream , milk and powdered sugar
18. Beat at med speed with an electric mixer until stiff peaks form , refrigerate at least one hour or until ready to use
19. Chocolate ganache icing:
20. In a lg bowl , place chocolate
21. In a lg saucepan combine cream , butter , liquer and vanilla
22. Bring to a boil over med-high heat
23. Pour over chocolate whisking until chocolate is melted and smooth
24. Refrigerate for 45 min to an hour until spreading consistency is reached

title: chicken noodle soup express
steps:
1. In medium saucepan mix broth , pepper , carrot , and celery
2. Over medium-high heat , heat to a boil
3. Stir in noodles
4. Reduce heat to medium
5. Cook 10 minutes , stirring often
6. Add chicken and heat through

title: 7 up party salad
steps:
1. Combine 7-up and marshmallows in saucepan
2. Cook until melted
3. Add jello and stir until dissolved , cream cheese in mixing bowl
4. Add hot mixture to cheese and beat until smooth
5. Add pineapple and nuts
6. Chill until almost set
7. Fold in cool whip and mayonnaise
8. Pour into oblong dish or mold
9. Refrigerate until set

title: coconut basmati rice
steps:
1. Bring water to the boil
2. While water heats , rinse the rice well
3. When water boils , stir in the rice and all of the remaining ingredients
4. Return to a boil
5. Stir , cover , reduce heat to low and simmer for 15 minutes
6. Take off the heat and allow rice to rest for 10 minutes
7. Remove the cinnamon stick , stir to fluff the rice and serve

title: blue cheese and herb bites
steps:
1. Beat cheese and butter at medium speed with a an electric mixer until creamy
2. Add flour and nuts
3. Beat until blended
4. Shape dough into 2 logs
5. Wrap logs in wax paper , and chill 2 hours or until firm
6. Cut into 1 / 4" thick slices , and place on lightly greased baking sheets
7. Brush lightly with beaten egg white
8. Press herb sprigs firmly into each slice
9. Bake at 350 degrees for 12-15 minutes , or until golden
10. Cool 1 minute on baking sheets
11. Remove to wire racks to cool completely

title: pie a la italiana  aka  hot dog pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Unroll one of the crescent dough tubes and separate triangles
3. In a 9-inch pie plate , press pieces together to form a crust
4. In a mixing bowl , combine sliced hot dogs , 2 eggs , mozzarella cheese , parmesan cheese and black pepper , if desired
5. Pour into crust
6. Unroll the second crescent dough tube and cut into long strips
7. Crisscross strips to form a lattice top
8. Flute edges
9. Bake uncovered , 30-45 minutes , or until knife inserted near center comes out clean
10. Cool 10 minutes

title: don t bother with the canned stuff    sloppy joes
steps:
1. Brown beef til no longer pink
2. Strain away any fat and return meat to pan
3. Add steak seasoning , onion and pepper
4. Cover and cook about 5 minutes til veggies are tender
5. Add remaining ingredients
6. Simmer about 20 minutes till mixture thickens
7. Serve on hamburger buns or rolls -- enjoy !

title: quick moroccan chickpea and vegetable couscous
steps:
1. Melt 2 tablespoons butter in a large skillet over medium-high heat
2. When the foaming subsides , add the couscous and cook , stirring frequently with a heatproof rubber spatula or wooden spoon , until some grains are just beginning to brown , about 3 minutes
3. Scrape the grains from the skillet into a large bowl and return the pan to medium heat
4. Add the remaining 2 tablespoons butter to the empty pan
5. Once the butter melts , add the onion , carrots , and 1 teaspoon salt
6. Cook , stirring occasionally , until the onion softens and begins to brown , about 5 minutes
7. Stir in the garlic , coriander , and ginger and cook until fragrant , about 30 seconds
8. Add the chickpeas , broth , and 2 cups water , increase the heat to medium-high , and bring to a boil
9. Stir in the peas and pour the mixture over the toasted couscous
10. Cover tightly with plastic wrap and allow to sit for 12 minutes
11. Remove the plastic wrap , add the herbs , and fluff the grains with a fork
12. Adjust the seasonings with salt and pepper to taste
13. Serve immediately , accompanied by lemon wedges

title: gingersnap pears
steps:
1. Place pears in a large bowl
2. Sprinkle with flour and toss lightly to coat
3. Divide among 8 - 8 oz custard cups
4. Combine the gingersnaps , walnuts and butter
5. Sprinkle over pears
6. Place custard cups on baking sheet
7. Bake at 350 degrees for 15-20 minutes or until heated through
8. Serve with vanilla icecream or plain with a dallop of whip cream on top

title: slow cooker chicken and dressing
steps:
1. Place the chicken , corn bread , white bread , chicken broth , cream of chicken soup , onion , celery , eggs , sage , salt and pepper in a large mixing bowl
2. Stir to combine
3. Spray 5 quart slow cooker with vegetable oil spray and add chicken mix
4. Dot the top with butter
5. Cook until the eggs are done , 3 to 4 hours on high , or 7 hours on low
6. Stir before serving

title: spicy ginger chicken with peanuts
steps:
1. Add 1 tablespoon soy sauce , wine , and chicken to a heavy-duty zip-top plastic bag
2. Seal
3. Marinate in refrigerator for a minimum of 1 hour , turn occasionally
4. In a small bowl , mix together 2 tablespoons soy sauce , water , sugar , vinegar , and cornstarch
5. Set aside
6. Heat the oil in a wok or large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat until the oil is hot
7. Add in chile pepper
8. Stir-fry for 1 minute
9. Add in chicken mixture
10. Stir-fry for 3 minutes
11. Add in green onions , ginger , and garlic
12. Stir-fry for 1 minute
13. Add in cornstarch mixture and peanuts
14. Bring to a boil and cook 1 minute , stirring constantly
15. Serve chicken mixture over rice

title: my secret brandy truffles
steps:
1. Put the chocolate chips in a glass bowl
2. In a small saucepan , bring the cream to a boil and then pour it over the chocolate
3. Shake the bowl gently to let the cream settle into the chocolate , then cover the bowl with a plate or a lid to allow the chocolate to melt
4. Whisk to mixture until smooth and shiny
5. Stir in the brandy
6. Cover the surface of the chocolate with the plastic wrap and put in a cool place for about two hours to let the chocolate firm up
7. Line a baking sheet with wax or parchment paper
8. Use two spoons to drop 1 / 2 to 1-inch mounds of chocolate on the paper
9. Chill your hands under cold water , and roll the mounds between your palms to shape them into smooth round balls
10. Pour the cocoa / ground chocolate onto a plate or bowl , and roll the truffles in the chocolate using a clean spoon to help you coat them
11. Refrigerate the truffles until ready to serve
12. To serve , gently scoop the truffles out of the cocoa with a fork and put them in small candy cups or a decorate platter
13. I like to use a small silver platter than i've refrigerated for nice presentation

title: chicken with tomato cognac wine sauce and mushrooms
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees
2. Season the chicken pieces with salt and pepper
3. Heat oil and butter in a large dutch oven over medium heat
4. Add in the chicken pieces and brown on both sides
5. Remove and set aside
6. To the dutch oven add in the onions , mushrooms and chili flakes
7. Saute for about 6 minutes , adding in the garlic the last 2 minutes of cooking
8. Stir in the flour
9. Cook stirring with a wooden spoon until the butter is golden brown
10. Add in the wine , cognac , chicken broth and chopped tomatoes
11. Simmer for about 10-15 minutes
12. Return the browned chicken back to the pan
13. Cover and bake for about 45 minutes , or until the chicken is done
14. Remove the cooked chicken to a large platter , tent with foil to keep warm
15. Bring the sauce to a boil on top of the stove , and cook until it is reduced to about 3 cups
16. Add in parsley , basil and dried oregano
17. Simmer for a few minutes more
18. Season with salt and pepper to taste
19. Serve the sauce on the cooked linguine with the chicken
20. Pass the parmesan cheese at the table

title: delicious chewy peanut butter chocolate chip oatmeal bars
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees
2. Set oven rack to second-lowest position
3. Grease a 13 x 9-inch baking dish
4. In a large bowl using an electric mixer at medium speed cream the butter with both sugars and vanilla until no sugar granules remain
5. Add in the peanut butter and beat until combined
6. Add in eggs and beat until combined
7. In a bowl combine the flour with baking soda and oats
8. Add to the creamed mixture and mix on low speed until combined
9. Mix in chocolate chips
10. Transfer and spread into prepared baking dish
11. Bake for 22-25 minutes or until just set
12. Cool then cut into squares

title: mexican style goulash
steps:
1. Cook pasta accordingly
2. While pasta cooks , brown hamburger and drain
3. Transfer meat to stockpot and add all other ingredients
4. When pasta is done , drain excess water and add pasta to stockpot
5. Simmer on medium / low heat about 30 minutes

title: old fashioned oatmeal cookies
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375f
2. In large mixer bowl combine all ingredients except flour and rasins
3. Beat at low speed , scraping bowl often , until well mixed
4. Add flour
5. Continue beating until well mixed
6. By hand stir in raisins
7. Drop dough by rounded teaspoonfuls 2"in apart onto greased cookie sheets
8. Bake 8 to 10 minutes or until edges are lightly browned

title: buffalo style stuffed celery   ww 1
steps:
1. In a small bowl , stir together cream cheese , blue cheese , garlic and salt until smooth
2. Spoon about 1 / 2 tablespoon cheese mixture into each piece of celery
3. To serve , arrange stuffed celery on a plate , drizzle each with about 1 / 4 teaspoon hot pepper sauce
4. Sprinkle with chives if desired
5. Yields 2 pieces stuffed celery per serving

title: light vegetarian chili
steps:
1. Saut onion and bell pepper in oil over medium heat for 3 minutes
2. Add chili powder , cayenne pepper , cumin , oregano , garlic and green chilies , and cook for 1 minute
3. Stir in tomatoes , beans , broth and bring to a boil
4. Simmer for 10-20 minutes
5. Serve with the fresh sliced avocado , sour cream , and cheddar cheese

title: eggplant omelet
steps:
1. Dice the eggplant into small pieces
2. Heat the olive oil in a small , non-stick skillet over medium heat
3. Saute the eggplant pieces until they start to brown slightly
4. Add the onion and continue sauteeing until the eggplant is tender and the onion is translucent
5. Add the tomato and saute until the tomato is heated through
6. Add 2 eggs per serving and scramble with the vegetable mixture until well blended and the egg is cooked to your prefered level of done
7. If you prefer , make an omelet with the eggs and fill it with the vegetable mixture before folding
8. Season with seasoned salt and / or pepper to taste

title: asparagus with mushrooms
steps:
1. In a large skillet , saute asparagus and ginger in oil for 2-3 minutes or until asparagus is crisp-tender
2. Add mushrooms , salt , sugar and pepper
3. Cook and stir 2-3 minutes longer or until mushrooms are tender

title: light cream of carrot soup
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a large 8-quart soup pot over medium heat
2. Add the carrots , onions , and potatoes
3. Cook , stirring occasionally , until tender but not brown , about 25-30 minutes
4. Add broth , cinnamon stick , bay leaf , and thyme
5. Bring to a boil , reduce the heat , and simmer for 45 minutes
6. Remove the bay leaf and cinnamon stick
7. In a blender or food processor , puree the carrot mixture in batches
8. Return to the pot and warm over low heat
9. Add the nutmeg and salt and pepper to taste
10. Optional: swirl in the yogurt and top with pistachios just before serving

title: asparagus with citrus and oregano
steps:
1. Zest one of the oranges
2. Set zest aside
3. Slice off the ends of each of the oranges
4. Working with one orange at a time , set an orange on end
5. With a small knife , slice off and discard the peel and the white pith
6. Holding the orange in your hand , use a knife to cut the orange segments away from their membranes
7. Place the segments in a bowl and set aside
8. Over a separate bowl , squeeze the remaining orange pulp to extract any remaining juice and repeat with the second orange
9. Whisk 4 tablespoons oil , the lemon juice , oregano and spring onion into the orange juice and season with salt and pepper
10. Set the dressing aside
11. Cut off about 2cm from the tough end of the asparagus and transfer the asparagus spears to a 22cm x 33cm microwavable dish
12. Sprinkle the asparagus with reserved orange zest and drizzle with remaining oil and quarter cup water
13. Cover the dish tightly with plastic wrap and microwave on high heat for 2 minutes
14. Rotating the dish at interval's microwave until the asparagus is just tender , about 2 minutes more
15. Remove from microwave , uncover and drain off the cooking liquid
16. Toss the asparagus with reserved citrus dressing and season with salt and top with orange segments
17. Serve immediately

title: sweet repeat
steps:
1. Combine butter , flour , and pecans
2. Mix well
3. Spread on bottom and sides of a 9 / 12 inch pan
4. Bake at 350 degrees for 15 minutes
5. Cool
6. Mix confectioners sugar , cream cheese , and cool whip and beat thoroughly
7. Spread on top of crust
8. Beat pudding mixes with milk until thick
9. Spread on top of cream cheese mixture
10. Top with rest of cool whip & sprinkle with nuts
11. Chill

title: potato griddle cakes
steps:
1. Beat the egg and a little of the milk , then add the flour , sugar and remaining milk a little at a time while beating
2. Allow to stand for 2 hours
3. Peel and grate potatoes , then add to the batter and mix thoroughly
4. Season with salt and pepper
5. Heat a skillet over medium high heat
6. Melt a little butter in the pan , just enough to coat the pan
7. Add a thin layer of batter
8. Cook on each side until golden brown , and place on a warmed serving platter
9. Continue with remaining batter
10. Serve immediately with bacon and lingonberries

title: mom s peach cobbler
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400 degrees
2. Mix sugar and cornstarch
3. Gradually stir in water
4. Bring to boil and boil 1 minute , stirring constantly
5. Add peaches then pour into 1 1 / 2 quart baking dish
6. Dot with butter
7. Sprinkle with cinammon
8. Stir flour , sugar , baking powder , salt in bowl
9. Cut in shortening until mixture looks like "meal"
10. Stir in milk
11. Drop by spoonfuls onto hot fruit
12. Bake 25 to 30 minute
13. Serve warm

title: piemontese capsicums
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 190c
2. Cut the capsicums in half lengthways and remove the ribs and seeds
3. Place them on an oven tray , with the cut side up
4. Then place the tomatoes , garlic , thyme , anchovies and pepper in the centre of each half , capsicum and spray generously with oil and cook in the oven for about 40 minutes or until they are tender
5. When they are almost ready , place a slice or two of goats cheese on top of each capsicum and briefly return the capsicum to oven

title: lemon frosted golden raisin buns
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375f degrees
2. Bring water , butter , sugar and salt to boil
3. Add flour and beat until mixture leaves sides of pan
4. Remove from heat and beat 2 minutes to cool
5. Add eggs one at a time , beating until smooth and satiny after each addition
6. Add raisins and mix well
7. Drop by measuring tablespoons full onto greased cookie sheet
8. Bake 30 to 35 minutes
9. Ice while warm
10. Frosting: combine ingredients in order given

title: trim chicken primavera
steps:
1. Cook the linguine in plain water until done and drain
2. Cook the chicken in the oil until done and remove
3. Saute the vegetables , herbs and seasonings in the same pan until tender
4. Add the peas and cook until heated and tender
5. Add the cooked chicken and linguini to the pan and toss , cooking until all is heated
6. Adjust seasinging to taste
7. Top with parmesan cheese and serve
8. Serve with favorite breads or salad

title: bow ties with bacon
steps:
1. In a 12" skillet over medium heat , cook bacon until browned
2. Remove bacon to paper towels to drain
3. Drain all but 2 tablespoons of the bacon fat and cook until tender
4. Add tomatoes and liquid , sugar , salt , & pepper
5. Over high heat , bring to a boil
6. Reduce heat to low
7. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes to blend flavors
8. Meanwhile , cook bowtie pasta according to package directions
9. Drain
10. Stir cream and parsley into tomato mixture
11. Heat through
12. To serve , spoon sauce over pasta , sprinkle with bacon and toss

title: a diner breakfast
steps:
1. Make hash browns--using a food processor or stand mixer fitted with the shredding attachment or the large holes of a box shredder-grated , shred the unpeeled potatoes
2. A handful at a time , squeeze the potatoes to remove as much moisture as possible and place in a large bowl
3. Add the onion , 1 1 / 2 teaspoon salt , and 1 / 4 teaspoon pepper and mix well
4. In a frying pan , preferably cast-iron , heat 2 tablespoons oil over med-high heat until it shimmers
5. Add the potato mixture and spread it into a thick cake
6. Decrease heat to medium , cover , and cook until the underside is golden brown and crisp , about 6 minutes
7. Using a large , wide metal spatula , transfer the potatoes to a plate
8. Add the remaining oil to the pan and heat
9. Flip the potatoes back into the pan , browned side up
10. Continue cooking , uncovered , until golden brown and crisp on the other side , about 6 minutes more
11. Meanwhile , preheat the broiler
12. Season the steaks with salt and pepper
13. Place the steaks on the broiler pan and broil , turning after 2 minutes , until the steaks are browned on the outside and medium-rare , about 4 minutes total , or until done to your liking
14. Transfer to a platter and tent with aluminum foil
15. Turn off the broiler
16. Transfer the potatoes to a baking sheet and keep warm in the turned-off oven
17. Wipe out the frying pan with paper towels
18. Return the pan to medium heat , add the butter and heat until foamy
19. One at a time , crack the eggs into the pan
20. Season with salt and pepper , cover , decrease heat to med-low , and cook until the whites are set , about 2 minutes , for sunny-side up eggs
21. Or carefully flip the eggs and cook to the desired doneness
22. Meanwhile , toast the bread
23. To serve , divide the hash browns , steaks , and eggs evenly among 4 plates
24. Top the hash browns with sour cream and a sprinkle of chives
25. Serve with the toast

title: spicy cranberry relish
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a medium bowl
2. Chill at least 1 hour before serving

title: grilled salmon with strawberry salsa
steps:
1. Salsa
2. Mix together cucumbers , green onion , yellow pepper , cilanto and vinegar
3. Cover and chill at least 1 hour
4. Just before serving add strawberries
5. Sauce
6. In small sauce pan over low heat , melt butter with garlic
7. Stir in honey , soy sauce and lemon juice
8. Cook 2 minutes , then set aside
9. Grill
10. Prepare charcoal grill
11. When coals are ready , oil a fish grilling rack
12. Brush sauce on salmon pieces and place on well-oiled rack
13. Place rack over coals
14. Grill salmon about 4-5 minutes on each side
15. Brush fish with sauce after turning , and again when done
16. Place grilled fish on warm platter and top with salsa

title: homemade cloverleaf honey
steps:
1. Use fresh blossoms
2. Remove all green stems
3. Wash clover and rose petals throughly in cool running water
4. Drain well
5. Pat dry
6. Place in large metal bowl and set aside
7. In large heavy saucepan bring sugar , water and alum to a boil
8. Stirring constantly
9. Boil without stirring until candy thermorther
10. Reaches 220 degree
11. Remove from heat
12. Pour the above over clover and wild rose petals
13. Let stand 45 minutes
14. Pour through double thickness of cheesecloth
15. Discard clovers and petals
16. Pour honey in jars
17. Store in fridge
18. Do not use chemically treated plants

title: betty s shrimp dip
steps:
1. Squirt shrimp with lemon juice , set aside
2. Make sauce with all other ingredients & pour over shrimp
3. Refrigerate overnight
4. Serve with crackers

title: chris  steak sauce    a1 copycat
steps:
1. Bring to a boil for 2 minutes stirring
2. Remove from heat
3. Allow to cool to lukewarm
4. Put mixture in a blender till it is pureed
5. Pour in bottle
6. Cap tightly and refrigerate to use within 90 days

title: caribbean jerk grouper
steps:
1. In a large bowl , mix the jerk seasoning , olive oil , garlic , brown sugar , orange juice , and soy sauce
2. Place the grouper fillets in the marinade , then cover the bowl and refrigerate for 2 to 4 hours
3. Preheat a heavy skillet over medium-high heat
4. Remove the grouper fillets from the marinade and cook for 4 to 5 minutes , until fish is opaque throughout , turning the grouper every minute
5. Serve immediately , while nice and hot !

title: new delhi style summer squash
steps:
1. Cut zucchini lengthwise in half , then into 1 / 3 inch slices , like half moons
2. Heat oil in pan til simmering over moderate heat
3. Add mustard seeds , cooking for about 2 minutes , until they begin to pop
4. Add coconut , curry leaves , chilis , jalapeno , cumin seeds and turmeric to pot
5. Be careful- the curry leaves will pop and splutter !
6. Cook for about 2-4 mins , stirring frequently , until the coconut begins to brown
7. Add zucchini , mixing thoroughly , and turn the heat up to medium / high
8. Cook , stirring occasionally for about 8 minutes
9. Season with salt to taste , cook one more minute
10. Serve hot with your choice of flatbread

title: open faced pepper burgers
steps:
1. In a large skillet , cook beef , onions , and peppers , until meat is no longer pink , and drain
2. Stir in 1 / 2 salad dressing , and spread remaining dressing on cut sides of italian bread , and broil 4-5 minutes or until lightly toasted
3. Spoon beef mixture over cut sides of bread , and top with cheese slices
4. Return to broiler and broil until cheese is melted
5. Cut each half into 3 pieces and serve

title: sweet onion pizza
steps:
1. Heat oven to 425 degrees
2. Place pizza shell on baking sheet
3. Sprinkle on the cheese
4. Layer onions on pizza
5. Drizzle with olive oil
6. Top with sun-dried tomatoes and peppers
7. Sprinkle with herbs , salt and pepper
8. Bake until onions just begin to brown , about 10-15 minutes

title: clams in a spicy broth
steps:
1. Clean clams to remove sand and grit
2. Combine remaining ingredients , except salt and pepper
3. Cover and cook over high heat until clams open
4. Adjust seasoning with salt and pepper

title: upscale macaroni and cheese
steps:
1. Melt butter in heavy large skillet over medium-high heat
2. Add bell peppers and celery and saute until just beginning to soften , about 7 minutes
3. Remove from heat
4. Dseason with salt and pepper
5. Combine cream , half and half , and blue cheese in heavy medium saucepan
6. Stir over low heat until cheese melts
7. Remove from heat
8. Add celery seeds
9. Season sauce with cayenne , salt and pepper
10. Beat yolks in medium bowl to blend
11. Gradually whisk in half of cheese sauce
12. Return mixture to saucepan and whisk to blend
13. Add celery leaves
14. Butter 13x9" baking dish
15. Cook pasta in pot of boiling salted water until just tender but still firm to bite , stirring occasionally
16. Drain
17. Return to same pot
18. Add sauce and vegetables
19. Stir to blend
20. Transfer to baking dish
21. Can be made one day ahead , cover and chill
22. Let stand at room temperature 1 hour before continuing
23. Preheat oven to 400 degrees
24. Sprinkle parmesan over surface of pasta
25. Bake until pasta is heated through , sauce is bubbling , and top is beginning to brown , about 25 minutes

title: chili spaghetti
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a slow cooker
2. Cover , and cook on low for 4 hours , checking mixture half way through cooking time
3. If it is becoming dry , stir in additional cup of tomato juice

title: vietnamese tofu salad
steps:
1. Make up the dressing / marinade by mixing all the dressing ingredients together in a bowl
2. Set aside
3. Drain the tofu on kitchen paper and cut the block in half and then slice each block through on its horizontal line leaving 4 steaks
4. Place the steaks of tofu in a flat dish and pour over about a of the marinade leaving for about 20 minutes
5. Heat the oil in a fry pan over a medium setting and gently place the slices of tofu into the pan
6. Fry until brown and the edges are starting to crisp up
7. Remove from the pan and leave to cool
8. Once cooled slice into inch strips
9. In a large bowl mix together the shredded cucumber , red pepper , mange tout , spring onions , bean sprouts , crushed roasted peanuts , sliced marinated tofu and coriander
10. Pour over the remaining dressing and gently toss to coat all ingredients
11. Serve

title: 3 meat stromboli
steps:
1. To make the dough , start by measuring 1 cup of warm water and put in sugar and the package of yeast
2. Wait 10 min until top is frothy
3. While waiting for the yeast , place flour and salt in processor w / a dough blade or stand mixer
4. When yeast is ready , dump in water / yeast / sugar and knead until it makes a dough ball
5. Slowly add olive oil and mix for 1 min longer
6. Transfer to a large bowl and cover with saran wrap
7. Let rest for 45min to 1 hours dough will double in size
8. Creating stromboli , this will make two loafs , so make sure to divide dough in half
9. Roll out the dough into a 12" x 15" square
10. Slice up 1 / 2 head of garlic and arrange and press in the dough
11. Sprinkle any herbs that you are using over the dough
12. Arrange half of the salami , ham , pepperoni , and provolone cheese evenly over the dough
13. Sprinkle mozzarella cheese
14. Roll up each rectangle jelly-roll style , sealing the seams and the ends
15. Place seam side down on 2 greased baking sheets
16. Brush with egg yolk and sprinkle on parmesan cheese
17. Yo ucan also sprinkle pepper and salt over the top
18. Bake at 375 degrees for 30-35 min or until light golden brown
19. Let stand 5 min before slicing

title: grilled chicken breasts with chimichurri sauce and coconut rice
steps:
1. To make the sauce
2. In a food processor puree the garlic
3. Add the parsley and chili pepper and process until finely chopped
4. Add the oil , vinegar , broth and seasonings
5. Process to blend
6. Taste and adjust the seasonings
7. It should be very flavourful and spicy
8. In a zip lock bag combine 3 tbs of the chimichurri sauce with the 2 tbs of oil , stirring until smooth
9. Add the chicken breasts , turning to coat evenly
10. Close the bag and refrigerate for at least 30 minutes or up to 4 hours
11. Preheat a grill for medium heat grilling
12. Remove the chicken from the marinade and grill for 7 to 10 minutes on each side , or until no pink is showing
13. Set aside and keep warm while you prepare the rice
14. In a medium non-stick saucepan toast the coconut over medium heat , stirring constantly for 2 to 3 minutes , or until lightly browned
15. Transfer to a bowl and set aside
16. In the same saucepan , heat the oil over medium high heat
17. Add the rice and saut for about 3 minutes , until well coated and lightly browned
18. Add the broth and bring to a boil
19. Add the salt , pepper and lime slices
20. Stir with a fork
21. Cover tightly , reduce heat to low , and simmer for 15 to 20 minutes , or until rice is tender and fluffy
22. Add the toasted coconut and currants , stirring through with a fork
23. Divide the rice among 6 hot serving plates
24. Top each serving with a grilled chicken breast and a portion of the remaining chimichurri sauce on the side

title: speedy chili with macaroni
steps:
1. Preheat skillet to 350f
2. Spray skillet with vegetable spray
3. Add ground beef and onions and cook until beef is no longer pink
4. Add remaining ingredients and mix well
5. Cover and reduce heat to simmer for 20 to 30 minutes

title: grilled tequila lime chicken
steps:
1. In a marinating container add and mix well the first 8 ingredients
2. Add chicken
3. Turn to coat
4. Cover container or seal container and refrigerate overnight
5. Drain chicken from marinade and discard marinade
6. Grill chicken over medium heat until cooked through , turning occasionally--usually 16-18 minutes

title: skillet roasted potato salad
steps:
1. In a large skillet cook potatoes in hot oil over medium heat about 15 minutes , or until tender and brown on all sides , turning occasionally
2. Spoon potatoes into serving bowl
3. Sprinkle with salt and pepper
4. To same skillet add summer squash
5. Cook and stir over medium heat for 3 to 4 minutes or until just tender
6. Pour viniagrette dressing over potatoes and summer squash
7. Add sweet pepper , tomatoes , parsley anf thyme
8. Toss gently to mix
9. Cool
10. Top with thyme sprigs if desired

title: healthy king ranch casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Bring broth to a simmer in a medium saucepan
3. Whisk milk and flour in a small bowl until smooth
4. Add to the broth and cook over medium heat , whisking constantly , until thickened and smooth , about 3 minutes
5. Remove from the heat and stir in yogurt , tomatoes , chiles , cilantro , chili powder , oregano and cumin
6. Season with salt and pepper
7. Heat oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
8. Add onion , bell pepper and garlic
9. Cook , stirring occasionally , until tender-crisp , about 3 minutes
10. Line the bottom of a shallow 3-quart baking dish with half the tortillas
11. Top with half the chicken and half the onion mixture
12. Spoon half of the sauce evenly over the top
13. Repeat layers with remaining tortillas , chicken , onion mixture and sauce
14. Sprinkle with cheddar
15. Bake until bubbly , 25 to 30 minutes

title: italian zucchini lasagna
steps:
1. Cook lasagna noodles according to package directions or until tender but still firm
2. Drain , keep warm
3. Meanwhile , to make lasagna sauce , saute ground beef , garlic and onion is a large heavy skillet or cast iron frying pan until beef is done
4. Add sauce , mushrooms , oregano , thyme , basil , wine or 1 / 4 cup water , touch of pepper and mix well
5. Simmer 45-50 minutes
6. To prepare zucchini for this recipe , cut in half or cook whole in a large covered pot with 1-2 inches of water
7. Boil gently for about 5 minutes , drain and cut lengthwise into 1 / 4 inch slices
8. Grease a 9" x 13" or larger , baking pan
9. Arrange a first layer of noodles so the ends hang over both sides of the pan
10. These will be folded back-over the top on the final layer
11. Next , add a layer of the cooked zucchini , a layer of lasagna sauce , a layer of mozzarella cheese
12. Repeat
13. For the top layer , fold the ends of the pasta from the first layer over the top and add more sauce
14. Top with parmesan cheese and cover with foil
15. Bake at 350 degrees for about 35-40 minutes , uncover and bake until brown , approximately 10 minutes
16. Serve this italian food with french bread and have additional parmesan cheese at the table

title: roast goose with caramelized apples
steps:
1. Position rack in bottom third of oven and preheat to 350f
2. Rinse goose inside and out
3. Pat dry with paper towels
4. Sprinkle inside and out with salt and pepper
5. Using knife , cut small slits all over goose
6. Place garlic slices into slits
7. Place goose on rack , breast side down , in large roasting pan
8. Roast goose 2 hours 45 minutes , basting occasionally with drippings and removing excess fat
9. Reserve 6 tablespoons fat
10. Turn goose over
11. Roast until brown and thermometer inserted into thickest part of thigh registers 175f , basting occasionally with drippings , about 45 minutes longer
12. Meanwhile , toss apples and lemon juice in large bowl
13. Pour 6 tablespoons goose fat into 15 x 10 x 2-inch glass baking dish
14. Using slotted spoon , transfer apples to baking dish
15. Toss apples in goose fat
16. Add sugar , calvados and cinnamon to apples
17. Toss
18. Bake apples alongside goose until very tender and golden , about 1 hour
19. Serve goose with caramelized apples

title: grab  n  go crispy granola bars
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300f
2. Line a 9" square or 13x9" bakiing pan completely with foil or parchment paper and butter the foil
3. In a medium bowl , combine oats , almonds , wheat germ , ground flax seeds , cereal , fry milk , cinnamon , and salt
4. Mix in the oil , honey , vanilla , and the optional chocolate chips and fruit , if using
5. Mix well , then pour into the prepared baking pan
6. Press down with the palm of your hand , evenly distributing the mixture into the corners of the dish and bake for 15-18 minutes
7. Check occasionally to prevent burning
8. Remove from the oven and using the foil to help you , lift the giant bar out of the pan
9. Place on a flat surface and while still warm , cut into small bars
10. Store in an airtight container fo up to a week , or freeze in plastic bags
11. Enjoy !

title: tuna toast
steps:
1. Blend tuna , soup and milk in saucepan
2. Heat through
3. Tear toast into bite size pieces
4. Spoon tuna sauce over toast

title: delightfully different sandwich
steps:
1. If using a sandwich making iron , butter the outside of the bread so it won't stick to the iron
2. Put one slice of bread on the iron and place half of the cheeses on it
3. Put the apple slices on top of the cheese
4. Put the remaining cheeses on top of the apple
5. Put the top slice of bread on and close the iron
6. Trim off the overhanging bread and toast over medium low flame until the bread is golden brown
7. Check often so that it doesn't burn
8. Serve with fresh fruit and a scoop of sorbet

title: cranberry orange white chocolate fudge
steps:
1. Grease an 8" square pan
2. In a medium saucepan , combine butter , milk , sugar and salt
3. Bring to a boil over medium heat , stirring constantly for 5 minutes
4. Remove from heat
5. Stir in marshmallows , chocolate chips , craisins , nuts , vanilla and orange zest
6. Stir quickly for 1 minute until marshmallows melt and blend
7. Pour into pan , cool , and cut into squares

title: cinnamon bread pudding
steps:
1. Place cubed bread or rolls in slow cooker sprayed with vegetable cooking spray
2. In a mixixng bowl , combine milk , eggs , both sugars , butter , vanilla , and nutmeg and beat until smooth
3. Stir in pecans
4. Cover and cook on low for 3 hours
5. Seerve with lemon sauce or whipped topping

title: adorable veggie melts
steps:
1. Preheat the broiler
2. Arrange the bread slices in a single layer on a baking sheet
3. Broil 4 to 5 inches from the heat source for about 2 minutes per side , or until lightly toasted
4. Spread 1 side of each slice with mayonnaise
5. To make the topping: heat the olive oil in a large nonstick skillet over medium-high heat
6. Add the mushrooms , zucchini , onion , and garlic
7. Cook , stirring occasionally , until tender , about 5 minutes
8. Remove from the heat
9. Stir in the salt and pepper
10. Taste and adjust the seasoning
11. Combine the cheeses in a small bowl
12. Top each bread slice with 2 tomato slices , a sprinkling of pepper , and half of the sauted vegetables , lettuce or bean sprouts , and the cheese mixture
13. Place the sandwiches on the baking sheet
14. Broil for about 2 minutes , or until the cheese is melted
15. Enjoy !

title: banana caterpillars
steps:
1. Peel and slice each banana into 10 segments
2. Assemble "caterpillar" by spreading segments with peanut butter and pressing pieces together
3. Sprinkle half of coconut over each "caterpillar" and press lightly with finger
4. Use additional peanut butter to press raisins on one end to form "eyes
5. "
6. Break pretzel sticks into small pieces for "legs" and "antenna
7. "

title: herbed green bean casserole
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. If using fresh beans , rinse them & cut them into 3"-to'4" pieces , before steaming them for about 15 minutes , or until they are only slightly crisp
3. Set beans aside
4. In a large bowl whisk together breadcrumbs , basil , salt , pepper , thyme , oregano , parsley , garlic powder & parmesan cheese
5. Add vegetable oil to crumb mixture & stir well , before setting aside 2 tablespoons of the crumb mixture for topping the casserole
6. In an ovenproof dish , combine green beans & crumb mixture , then sprinkle with reserved crumb mixture
7. Bake about 30 minutes or until top is golden & crispy

title: finnish coffee bread  breadmaker recipe
steps:
1. Put all the ingredients in the bread machine on the dough setting , in the order specified for your machine
2. When the dough cycle completes , remove , divide in half and then split each part into 3 equal pieces
3. Roll into long strands , and braid strands into 2 loaves
4. Put loaves on greased cookie sheets
5. Let rise until doubled in size
6. Brush with second egg and sprinkle with sugar
7. Bake at 375f for 20-25 minutes or until golden brown
8. Immediately after taking them out of the oven , remove from pans
9. Cool on racks

title: pistachio muffins
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients together until just combined
2. Spoon into well-greased muffin pans and bake at 190c for 15-20 minutes

title: april fool s fake baked potato
steps:
1. Take 2 large scoops of vanilla ice cream and place on a large piece of plastic wrap
2. Wrap up and mold with hands into a potato shape
3. Put in freezer to set
4. Put cocoa powder into a bowl and roll unwrapped ice cream potato in the powder until completely covered
5. Slice the top of your ice cream potato and pull back edges a bit to make room for your whipped topping and starburst candy butter
6. Shake off excess cocoa powder and place on a plate
7. Top with a dollop of cool whip for the "sour cream"
8. Place your unwrapped yellow starburst candy in the microwave for 10 seconds to soften - then press the edges out to make a larger "pat of butter"
9. Top your potato and enjoy !

title: breaded fried chicken
steps:
1. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil , add chicken
2. Reduce heat , cover and simmer for 30-40 minutes or until tender
3. Drain well
4. Cool before continuing
5. Cut chicken into 8 pieces
6. In each piece put a long deep pocket
7. Fill each pocket with approximately 2 teaspoons herb seasoning
8. I use herb seasoning recipe#84791
9. Heat oil in a deep fryer or skillet to 375-degrees f
10. Combine flour with salt and pepper in a pie pan
11. Put eggs in seperate pie pan
12. In a third pie pan put in bread crumbs
13. Dip chicken in seasoned flour , then in eggs , and finally in the breadcrumbs
14. Set aside while coating all pieces
15. Add chicken to deep fryer or skillet in batches and cook until golden
16. Drain on paper towels before serving

title: millet oatmeal bread  gluten free
steps:
1. Make sure all dry ingredients and the eggs are at room temperature
2. Grease the bottom of a 10 inch loaf pan or two 8 inch pans
3. Heat the oven to 200 degrees and then turn off
4. In the bowl of your stand mixer , sift together the dry ingredients
5. In a separate medium bowl , mix eggs , molasses , vinegar , and melted butter
6. Heat your water for proofing the yeast
7. In a small prep bowl , stir together your active dry yeast and one teaspoon of sugar
8. Add 1 / 4 cup of the heated water to the yeast mixture
9. Let the yeast sit for 10 minutes
10. It should be foamy and active ! if not , start over with another packet of yeast
11. Once yeast is ready , add the egg mixture to the dry ingredients
12. Then add the yeast mixture
13. Then slowly add the remaining water to achieve the right consistency of the batter
14. Since different brands , flours , measuring techniques act different i do not recommend just blindly dumping in the rest of the water but adding gradually instead
15. The dough should be like very stiff cake batter
16. Beat dough on high for about 15 minutes in mixer
17. If you accidentally add too much water simply add a little rice flour until you achieve the dough consistency you are after
18. Put the dough in prepared pan and place in oven to rise for about 1 - 1 1 / 2 hours
19. Put plastic wrap or a towel over the pan
20. Once the dough has risen to the top of the pan , bake the bread for 40 minutes at 350 degrees or until internal temperature reaches 190 degrees

title: killer pizza muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Mix the cup of warm water with the sugar and dry yeast
3. Let stand 10 to 14 minutes
4. Add the butter , salt and flour
5. Stir well , turn out and knead until dough is smooth
6. Cover and allow to rise in a warm place
7. Punch down and allow to rise again
8. Cut dough into small-meduim sized balls , place each ball on oiled muffin tins , punch the ball with your thumb and spread the edges of the ball around the muffin tins to make a hollow muffin cup shape
9. Let rise again , press the edges to make sure they stick to their muffin cup figure
10. Bake for about 20 minutes or until slightly golden
11. Bring out of the oven
12. Press top of puffed muffins with the back of a spoon to create a slight dent
13. Spread the sauce and cheese or any other topping you have in mind
14. Bake until cheese is melted
15. Tada !

title: better than sex  strawberries
steps:
1. Crush vanilla wafers into fine crumbs and line a square 8" x8" pan
2. Mix butter or margarine and sugar
3. Add beaten eggs
4. Spread the mixture over the wafer crumbs
5. Crush strawberries and spread over sugar , egg , and butter mixture
6. Cover strawberries with whipped cream
7. Sprinkle with chopped nuts
8. Chill 24 hours

title: chocolate raspberry ganache frosting
steps:
1. In a small , heavy saucepan over medium heat , bring the heavy cream to a simmer
2. Remove pan from heat
3. Add the chocolate chips , preserves , and butter , shaking the pan to immerse the chocolate and as much of the preserves and butter as possible
4. Let stand for 1 1 / 2 minutes , or until the chocolate has melted
5. Beat the mixture with a wire whisk until smooth
6. Cool until thick enough to use as a glaze
7. Or , cool completely and whip to desired spreading consistency using an electric mixer on medium speed
8. Trywith milk chocolate or white chocolate chips

title: better than sex coffee
steps:
1. Mix together the coffee mix , hot water and sugar in a lare bowl or pitcher
2. Add the chocolate syrup , vanilla and milk
3. Mix well and cover and refrigerate overnight
4. Serve either hot or cold with a scoop of icecream on top of each serving

title: the apple lady s apple cake
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f
2. Butter a 9-inch springform pan and set it aside
3. In a large bowl , combine the flour , sugar , baking powder , and sea salt , and stir to blend
4. Add the vanilla extract , eggs , oil , and milk , and stir until well blended
5. Add the apples and stir to thoroughly coat them with the batter
6. Spoon the mixture into the prepared cake pan
7. Place the pan in the center of the oven and bake until fairly firm and golden , about 25 minutes
8. Meanwhile , prepare the topping: in a small bowl , combine the sugar , egg , and melted butter , and stir to blend
9. Set it aside
10. Remove the cake from the oven and pour the topping mixture over it
11. Return the cake to the oven and bake until the top is a deep golden brown and the cake feels quite firm when pressed with a finger
12. Transfer the cake pan to a rack and allow to cool for 10 minutes
13. Then run a knife around the sides of the pan , and release and remove the springform side , leaving the cake on the pan base
14. Serve at room temperature , cut into thin wedges

title: dee berger s grandmother s salmon loaf
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. In a medium sized bowl , debone salmon and remove skin
3. Drain liquid
4. Add all other ingredients , except sour cream and mix well
5. Fold in sour cream last
6. Spray a loaf pan with cooking spray
7. Spread salmon mixture in pan
8. Smooth out top
9. Bake for 30-45 minutes or until top is slightly brown and knife inserted in center comes out clean
10. Let sit for 5 minutes before slicing

title: chef comerford s cauliflower gratin
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350 degrees f
2. Spray a 1-quart casserole dish with cooking spray
3. Trim the cauliflower and cut into florets
4. Steam the cauliflower in a large pot with a little water over medium-low heat until tender
5. Remove the cauliflower from the pot to a towel to remove excise moisture
6. Heat the butter in a medium saucepan over medium heat
7. When the butter has melted , whisk in the flour
8. Cook , stirring , for 2 minutes
9. Add the milk , whisking all the time to make sure there are no lumps
10. Cook another 3 to 4 minutes , and let the sauce thicken
11. Season with salt and pepper , to taste and add the nutmeg
12. Put the cauliflower into the prepared pan
13. Top with half of the cheese
14. Pour the white sauce over the cheese
15. Top with the remaining cheese and the bread crumbs
16. Bake , uncovered for 20 to 30 minutes until golden and bubbly

title: taco twist soup
steps:
1. In a large saucepan , saute onion and garlic in oil until tender
2. Add the broth , beans , tomatoes , picante sauce , pasta , green pepper and seasonings
3. Bring to a boil , stirring frequently
4. Reduce heat
5. Cover and simmer for 10-15 minutes or until pasta is tender , stirring occasionally
6. Serve with cheese and sour cream

title: parmesan chicken with pasta rags
steps:
1. Chicken:
2. Heat oven to 475
3. Combine garlic , seasoned salt , 3 tablespoons olive oil and the butter
4. Microwave on high 1 minute , or till butter is melted
5. Mix well
6. Combine bread crumbs and grated cheese
7. Mix well
8. Coat chicken breasts with the garlic mixture then coat with the crumb mixture
9. Place in an ungreased 15x10x1-inch baking pan and bake for 20 minutes or till chicken is fork-tender and juices run clear
10. Pasta:
11. Cook broken lasagna noodles to desired doneness as directed on package
12. Drain and cover to keep warm
13. Heat 1 / 4 cup olive oil in a large skillet over medium-high heat until hot
14. Add 1 garlic clove , cook and stir for 1 minute
15. Add spinach and 1 / 2 teaspoon seasoned salt
16. Mix well and cook 2-3 minutes or till spinach is cooked , stirring frequently
17. Add cooked noodles , tomatoes and chopped basil
18. Cook 1-2 minutes or until thoroughly heated , stirring occasionally
19. Serve pasta mixture with chicken and garnish with shaved parmesan cheese

title: white bean and tuna pasta salad
steps:
1. Cook the pasta according to package directions
2. Run under cool water and drain well and transfer to a bowl
3. Add the beans , flake in the tuna , and add the celery , parsley , and / or basil
4. In a small jar or bowl , shake or whisk together the oil , vinegar , and garlic
5. Drizzle over the salad and toss to coat
6. Season with salt and pepper and serve or refrigerate until needed

title: asparagus walnut salad
steps:
1. Cook the noodles
2. Drain
3. Rinse with cold water
4. In a saucepan , cook the asparagus in boiling water until just tender
5. Drain and rinse with cold water
6. Transfer to a bowl with the pasta
7. Add the cheese , tomatoes , mushrooms and walnuts
8. Toss to combine
9. In a small bowl , whisk together the olive oil , vinegar and dressing mix
10. Pour over salad and toss to coat evenly
11. Serve salad chilled or at room temperature

title: mocha chiffon cake
steps:
1. For the cake: dissolve coffee powder in hot water , cool to room temperature
2. In a large bowl , combine flour , sugar , baking powder and salt , stir until well mixed
3. Make a well in center , add oil , egg yolks , vanilla and cooled coffee
4. Beat with a wooden spoon until smooth
5. In a large bowl , beat egg whites and cream of tartar until stiff but not dry
6. Pour batter over egg whites , fold in carefully , adding grated chocolate towards the end
7. Spoon batter into ungreased 10 inch tube pan
8. Bake in a 325 degree oven for 60 to 70 minutes or until cake springs back when lightly touched
9. Turn pan upside down and let cake hang until cool
10. Remove from pan
11. Frost with cocoa whipped cream
12. For the whipped cream: in a medium bowl , combine whipping cream , sugar , cocoa powder and vanilla , stir to blend ingredients , but do not beat
13. Cover and refrigerate for 1 to 2 hours
14. Whip until soft peaks form
15. Frost cake
16. Garnish with chocolate curls

title: tom collins
steps:
1. Mix the first 3 ingredients in a chilled glass
2. Stir
3. Add 3-4 ice cubes
4. Top with club soda , stirring gently
5. Garnish with lemon slice and cherry

title: carrot pumpkin bars with orange icing
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Grease a 15x10x1-inch baking pan
3. Set aside
4. In a large mixing bowl stir together the flour , baking powder , orange peel , baking soda , and salt
5. Set the flour mixture aside
6. In a medium bowl combine eggs and brown sugar
7. Stir in pumpkin , oil , milk , and vanilla
8. Then stir in carrots and chopped walnuts
9. Add egg mixture to flour mixture , stirring with a wooden spoon until combined
10. Spread batter into the prepared pan
11. Bake for 20 to 25 minutes or until a wooden toothpick inserted near the center comes out clean
12. Cool in pan on a wire rack
13. Spread with orange icing
14. Cut into triangles or bars
15. If desired , garnish each with a walnut half
16. Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator for up to 3 days
17. Makes 36 bars
18. For orange icing: in a mixing bowl combine powdered sugar and enough of the orange liqueur or orange juice to make an icing that is easy to drizzle
19. Make-ahead
20. Do not drizzle with icing
21. Place cut bars in a freezer container and freeze for up to 1 month
22. Before serving , thaw for 15 minutes
23. Prepare orange icing and drizzle as directed

title: bangers and mash in yorkshire pudding
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 220c / gas 7
2. First make the yorkshire pudding
3. Heat the lard in a large shallow , round roasting tray in the oven until very hot
4. Meanwhile , whisk together the flour , eggs and milk to form a smooth , lump-free batter
5. Pour the batter into the hot roasting tray and roast until well-risen , around 20-30 minutes
6. Remove the yorkshire pudding , keeping it in the tray , and set aside
7. Reduce the oven temperature to 180c / gas
8. Place the sausages in a greased oven tray and bake them for 30 minutes until cooked through , turning now and then so that they colour evenly
9. Half-way through the sausage's baking time , return the yorkshire pudding to the oven and heat through for 15 minutes until hot and crisp
10. Meanwhile , cook the cubed potatoes in boiling salted water until tender
11. Drain , add in the milk and butter and season with salt and freshly ground pepper
12. Beat with a hand whisk until smooth and creamy
13. Stir through the creamed horseradish
14. To make the onion gravy , gently heat the butter and olive oil in a frying pan
15. When hot , add the onions and begin to fry gently
16. After five minutes , add the chopped sage and garlic
17. On a gentle heat , add in the marsala wine and turn up the heat so that everything begins to bubble
18. Sniff the pan and see if alcohol smell has evaporated
19. If it has , turn the heat down
20. Stir the mustard into the pan and cook for a final 5 minutes
21. To serve , turn out the crisped yorkshire pudding from its tin
22. Place on a plate , fill with a generous serve of mash , stick several sausages into the mash pile and cover the bangers and mash with lashings of the onion gravy !

title: mom s cheap and easy goulash
steps:
1. Cook macaroni- reserving the cheese packet for later
2. Brown ground beef with onion , garlic powder , italian seasoning , salt and red pepper flakes
3. Cook until the ground beef is completely cooked through and the onions are soft
4. Drain the macaroni and add tomato sauce , butter and reserved cheese packet
5. Mix until well combined
6. Add the ground beef mixture , again , mix until well combined
7. Serve hot !

title: prairie land pot roast
steps:
1. Season the meat with salt and pepper
2. Brown the meat in a large dutch oven on high heat with 1 / 4 cup of the catalina dressing , turning to brown both sides
3. Add the onions and stir to brown
4. Add the rest of the dressing , the potatoes , the carrots , and enough water to come 3 / 4 of the way up the meat
5. Bring to a boil
6. Cover
7. Reduce heat to low
8. Simmer 2 hours or until meat and vegetables are tender
9. Remove meat from the pan and slice thinly against the grain
10. Serve the meat and potatoes with the pan gravy
11. Sprinkle with chopped parsley just before serving
12. If thicker gravy is desired , mix 2-3 tbsp flour with 1 / 4 c water
13. Mix well then add to liquid in the pan
14. Heat until thickened

title: gastro breakfast pizza
steps:
1. Heat up the vegetable oil in a skillet at medium-high then put in your frozen hashbrowns
2. Even them out to as flat as possible , then turn the temp down to about medium-medium-high
3. And add a little salt
4. While those cooking , in a separate large , skillet , start cooking bacon at medium-high
5. Now is a good time to cut your onions , beat some eggs and preheat the oven to broil
6. Once the bacon pan gets a good amount of grease in it , add your onions in the same pan
7. If your bacon is done , set them aside to dry off on some paper towels and cook the onions to however you want
8. I like them fried
9. Check your hashbrowns at this point
10. If they are browning , flip them over and lower the heat again
11. When they brown on the second side , just turn off the heat put them aside
12. Now grab an oven-proof skillet and heat it to medium-high
13. Pour in some bacon grease on the bottom and once it's warm , add your beaten eggs and try to spread out as evenly as possible
14. Cook until the eggs separate from the bottom and are partially solid , then flip the whole thing over , and cover it with the red sauce , cheese , oregano , basil , salt , and olive oil , in that order
15. Cook on the second side for about 2 minutes
16. If your onions , hashbrowns , and bacon are done , add it on top , then put it in the oven for a few minutes
17. When you see the bacon begin to burn , it's done !
18. After consumption , take 4 tums

title: simply perfect cream of broccoli soup
steps:
1. Bring chicken broth to a boil , then add broccoli
2. Cover and reduce heat to low
3. Cook for 5 to 7 minutes or until tender
4. Set aside
5. In another saucepan , melt butter over medium heat
6. Add onion and stir occasionally , for 1 to 2 minutes or until onion is tender
7. Stir in flour
8. Gradually stir in evaporated milk
9. Stir constantly , until mixture comes to a boil
10. Add broccoli and cook until heated thoroughly
11. Add 1 cup american or cheddar cheese , if desired

title: 1st place lemon ice cream  for ice cream maker
steps:
1. Place all ingredients directly into ice cream maker
2. Stir well , until smooth
3. Freeze according to manufacturer's directions

title: green chili and monterey jack quesadillas
steps:
1. Fresh green chilies , often called pasillas
2. Available at latin american markets and some supermarkets
3. Heat 3 tablespoons oil in heavy large skillet over medium heat
4. Add chilies
5. Cover and cook until chilies are soft , adding water by tablespoonfuls if chilies become too dark , stirring occasionally , about 10 minutes
6. Uncover
7. Add garlic
8. Saut 1 minute
9. Transfer to medium bowl
10. Stir in cilantro
11. Season chili mixture to taste with salt and pepper
12. Heat 2 teaspoons oil in each of 2 heavy large skillets over medium-high heat
13. Add 1 tortilla to each skillet
14. Top each with 1 / 4 of cheese and 1 / 4 of chili mixture , then 2 tablespoons salsa
15. Top each with 1 tortilla
16. Cook until bottoms are golden brown , about 3 minutes
17. Turn quesadillas over
18. Cook until bottoms are golden brown and cheese melts , about 3 minutes
19. Transfer to cutting board
20. Cut each quesadilla into 6 wedges
21. Transfer to platter
22. Repeat with remaining oil , tortillas , cheese , chili mixture , and salsa
23. Serve hot

title: pumpkin spice cream cheese spread
steps:
1. In a small bowl , beat softened cream cheese , sugar , and syrup til creamy
2. Add pumpkin , spices and vanilla and beat til smooth
3. Refrigerate for at least an hour

title: spinach sausage dip
steps:
1. In a large skillet over medium heat on stovetop , brown sausage
2. Drain
3. Add spinach , cream cheese , and sour cream
4. Cook over medium heat until bubbly , stirring occasionally to keep from burning on bottom
5. Add tomatoes and cheddar cheese and continue to cook , keeping the temperature at medium heat
6. When cheese is melted , add garlic
7. Add scallions
8. Turn heat down to low , to keep warm , until ready to serve
9. Serve with chips

title: slow cooked lamb shanks with lentil ragout
steps:
1. Preheat oven to moderately slow
2. Toss lamb shanks in seasoned flour , heat oil in a large saucepan and brown shanks in batches for 4-5 minutes or until browned all over
3. Transfer to a plate
4. Saute onion , carrot , celery and chili in same pan for 4-5 minutes until onion is tender
5. Stir through lentils , tomatoes water , wine and vinegar and bring to the boil
6. Place the lamb and sauce mixture into a large oven proof casserole dish
7. Bake covered , stirring a couple of times for 1 1 / 2 hours
8. Uncover and cook a further hour or until meat is almost falling off the bone
9. Stir parsley through and serve over mashed potatoes with green vegetables if desired

title: italian summer  cucumber sandwiches
steps:
1. Peel the cucumber if waxed , then slice into 1 / 4" slices
2. Combine cucumbers with the cream cheese and italian dressing mix
3. Spread on rye bread
4. Top with cucumber slices
5. Sprinkle pepper over the top
6. Enjoy !

title: shrimp tapas
steps:
1. Combine shrimp and olives in a serving dish
2. In a skillet over medium low heat the olive oil , adding the spices and cook for 30 seconds
3. Toss spice mixture with shrimp and add lemon
4. Refrigerate until chilled

title: peanut butter banana milk shake
steps:
1. Combine all ingredients in a container of an electric blender
2. Cover and process until smooth , stopping once to scrape down the sides
3. Serve immediately

title: zucchini dessert pie
steps:
1. To make the puree , skin the zucchini and cut it up into 1-inch chunks
2. Microwave on high , until easily pierced with a fork , about 9 minutes , stirring once
3. Pour off any water
4. Puree in the blender
5. Mix zucchini puree , honey and dry ingredients together
6. Warm milk and add with eggs to zucchini mixture
7. Use hand mixer to blend well
8. Pour into unbaked 9-inch pie crust
9. Bake at 425f for 10 minutes , then reduce to 350f and bake for 40-45 minutes longer
10. Or until knife inserted slightly off center comes out clean , center will be wobbly
11. Cool for about 2 hours and then chill for several , if desired
12. Serve with whipped cream

title: spicy fruit salsa with cinnamon sugar pita chips
steps:
1. In a large bowl combine brown sugar , honey and balsamic vinegar
2. Add next 9 ingredients and combine well
3. Transfer to serving dish and garnish with slice of orange and sprig of mint
4. Serve with sugar / cinnamon chips
5. Combine sugar , cinnamon and in a small bowl
6. Split each pita bread into two halves
7. Score with sharp knife , but dont cut completely through
8. Spread each half lightly with butter
9. Sprinkle each half with cinnamon / sugar mixture
10. Place on cookie sheet and bake at 350 degree oven for 7-10 minutes or until lightly brown
11. Cool and break into pieces
12. Serve with salsa

title: vegan quiche with mushrooms and shallots and a herb crust
steps:
1. Preheat your oven to 350 degrees f
2. Start by preparing a cake tin by greasing with oil or earth balance type spread , dust with flour well
3. Combine all the crust ingredients in a large bowl
4. You'll likely need to add quite a bit extra flour to get a soft , kneadable dough
5. Roll it out on a floured surface to about 12" round
6. Drag the bottom of it through corn meal then position in the cake pan
7. The dough is quite sturdy and elastic if you work with it right away
8. Fix your edges and then brush the crust lightly with oil
9. Poke a few holes in the bottom and then blind bake for 10 minutes
10. You'll want to protect the edges with some strips of parchment or foil , otherwise it will burn
11. Next start on the filling by sauteing the shallots , mushrooms and bell pepper in the olive oil over medium heat
12. Let them get nice and caramelized , but watch not to burn
13. Add in the cumin , red pepper flakes , parsley and lemon juice and set aside off the heat
14. Using a blender or food processor whiz together until smooth the silken tofu , arrowroot powder , s&p , soy milk and nutritional yeast , nuts and agave nectar
15. It should be a thick milky white mixture with no lumps
16. Fold into the sauteed veg and check seasoning
17. You may wish to add extra fresh parsley here
18. Fold in the grated vegan mozza the pour the entire mixture into the crust
19. Mix the topping ingredients of oil , vinegar and agave together and then pour over top , getting it as even as you can without mixing it inches sprinkle with the last 2 tbsp of vegan mozza
20. You can also add a few lemon slices to the top before baking
21. Bake at 375 for 45 minutes or until top is brown and edges are firm
22. Keep those strips of parchment or foil handy and use again once the edges are browning up
23. If the centre still seems soft that's probably ok , it will firm up as it cools - you should let it cool for one hour

title: ham and cheese pockets
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Unroll crescent roll dough and separate into four rectangles
3. Seal perforations in dough
4. Spoon 1 / 4 of ham mixture into each rectangle
5. Fold dough over mixture and seal corners together
6. Place on a lightly greased baking sheet
7. Bake for 15-18 minutes until golden brown

title: pinon butter  raw pine nut butter
steps:
1. Puree the pine nuts , olive oil , salt and herbs in a food processor by pulsing until it looks cheesy
2. Spread on your favourite raw bread or crackers
3. Bon appetit !

title: blackberry jam
steps:
1. Clean , de-stem and crush blackberries
2. In a large stainless steal or enamel pot combine crushed berries and sugar
3. Bring to a boil , stirring often until sugar is dissolved
4. Cook to jell point , stirring often
5. Remove from heat , skim off foam and ladle into clean hot jars
6. Leave 1 / 4 inch head space
7. Process in a boiling water bath for 10 minutes at altitudes up to 1000 feet

title: grandma s green beans
steps:
1. Fry bacon til' it's crisp , on the stovetop
2. Add onion , cook until tender
3. Drain "all" liquid off of canned green beans
4. Add beans to bacon and onion mixture
5. Add bullion cube and water
6. Cook very slowly until beans "shrivel"
7. Sometimes , ok well maybe always i have this compulsive need to add things to whatever i am cooking , and 98% of the time you can beat it's gonna be garlic or spices
8. Soo- there ya' go
9. Add in some garlic if you dare , or maybe some seasoning salt ? :) but whatever you do- enjoy !

title: bell peppers stuffed with chorizo and cheese
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Remove seeds from peppers and set aside
3. Make stuffing: saute onion in olive oil until soft
4. Add garlic and remove from heat
5. Add sausage , rice and cheese
6. Add egg , mix well , and set aside
7. Make sauce: place all sauce ingredients in saucepan
8. Bring to a boil , reduce heat and simmer 10 minutes
9. Use a spoon to chop tomatoes coarsely
10. Stuff peppers with chorizo mixture
11. Pour sauce into a glass or enamel baking dish
12. Arrange peppers on sauce , open side up
13. Cover with foil and bake for 45 minutes
14. Remove foil and bake an additional 15 minutes
15. Spoon sauce over peppers

title: cowboy stew  oamc
steps:
1. Assembly directions:
2. Dredge stew meat in flour
3. Brown in stockpot to which the 3 tbs
4. Oil has been added to
5. Once meat is browned well , add 1 cup broth to wich 1-1 / 2 tbs
6. Corn startch has been added and stir until thickened
7. Combine potatoes and carrots in a large saucepan
8. Add just enough water to cover vegetables
9. Cook 12-15 minutes until tender
10. In a small saucepan , cook onion and celery in broth until slightly tender
11. Use just enough broth to keep the vegetables from sticking
12. Drain liquid from carrots and potatoes
13. Add vegetables with broth to potatoes and carrots
14. Stir in beef cube mix
15. Freezing and cooking directions:
16. Divide stew into three batches and pour into gallon sized freezer zipper bags
17. Label and freeze
18. To reheat if eating as a stew , empty contents of bag into pot and reheat on med-low until mostly defrosted then you can increase heat to medium and continue to cook until heated through
19. If planning to use as a filling for pot pies , allow filling to defrost completely then add to your pie crust and bake at 350 degrees until crust is golden brown and pie is heated through

title: mollie katzen s mushroom popover pie
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f place a 10" skillet over medium heat
2. Melt 1 tbsp butter , then add onion
3. Saute until onion is soft and translucent , about 5 minutes
4. Turn heat up to medium-high
5. Add mushrooms , garlic , 1 tsp salt , thyme , rosemary and 1 / 8 tsp pepper
6. Cook , stirring occasionally , until the mushrooms wilt , most of the water evaporates , and the mushrooms begin to brown , 10-15 minutes
7. Transfer mushrooms and onion to a bowl
8. While the mushrooms cook , combine eggs , milk , flour , remaining salt and remaining pepper in a blender
9. Blend until smooth and allow to stand at room temperature until the mushrooms are cooked
10. Clean out the skillet
11. Melt the remaining 1 tbsp of butter in the skillet , swirling the pan to coat the sides as well as the bottom
12. Return the mushrooms and onions to the pan and spread into one even layer
13. Pour the batter over the top and shake gently to help it sink down
14. Transfer the skillet to the oven and bake until puffy and golden brown , 25-30 minutes
15. Cut into wedges and serve warm or at room temperature

title: empanadas de pina  pineapple
steps:
1. Mix all ingredients except preserves
2. Knead into dough , roll out and cut with biscuit cutter , making a round circle
3. Place slightly less than a teaspoon of preserves in each cut shape
4. Fold and crimp edges together with fork
5. Bake on a cookie sheet at 350 degrees f until light beige , about 12 minutes
6. After baking , roll in confectioners' sugar

title: amritsari fish  fried
steps:
1. Clean , wash and cut fish into one and a half inch size cubes
2. Apply salt , lime juice , ginger paste , garlic paste and red chili powder
3. Keep aside for 20 minutes
4. Make a batter of gram flour , yogurt , egg , ajwain , salt and water
5. Keep the already marinated fish pieces dipped in this batter for 15 minutes
6. Heat oil in a kadhai / wok and deep fry the fish till golden brown and crisp
7. Serve hot sprinkled with chaat masala and lemon wedges

title: blueberry banana muffins  gift mix in a jar
steps:
1. Creating the gift in a jar:
2. Wash and thoroughly dry a 1-quart wide-mouth canning jar
3. Layer the ingredients in the jar as listed above starting with the baking soda , baking powder , sugar and then flour - make sure to press firmly with a flat bottomed object after each addition
4. Make the layers as level as possible
5. Secure the lid and decorate as desired
6. Attach the instructions for making these cookies found below
7. Blueberry banana muffins gift tag:
8. Additional ingredients to be added by the recipient: 3 / 4 cup milk , 3 / 4 cup butter , melted , 2 eggs , 1 tsp vanilla extract , 2 cups fresh blueberries and 1 large ripe banana , mashed
9. Blueberry banana muffin instructions:
10. Preheat oven to 375
11. In a large bowl , combine the milk , butter , eggs and extract
12. Add the contents of the jar , and stir just until mixed
13. Do not overstir
14. Gently fold in blueberries and banana
15. Spoon the batter into greased or papered muffin tins , filling each cup two-thirds full
16. Bake for 20 minutes , or until a toothpick inserted in the center comes out clean
17. Cool for 10 minutes in the tin , then transfer to a wire rack and cool completely
18. Serve immediately or store in an airtight container for up to 1 week

title: buca di beppo macaroni rosa  copycat
steps:
1. Add all the ingredients together listed for brushetta
2. Set aside
3. Heat olive oil in a large saut pan
4. Add mushrooms and chicken tenders
5. Saut until chicken starts to brown along the edges
6. Add marinara and cream and reduce by a third
7. Add 4 oz of bruschetta mix and peas
8. Cook for three minutes
9. Drop macaroni and broccoli buds in boiling water for three seconds
10. Drain and toss in sauce along with romano cheese and serve on a large platter

title: flounder baked w  vegetables
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 450
2. Prepare 4 pieces of foil 12" sq
3. And fold in half and cut out half-heart shape on the fold
4. In a non-stick skillet , heat oil
5. Saute garlic and ginger for 15 seconds
6. Stir in soy sauce
7. Remove from heat , add vegetables and toss to coat
8. Place 1 fillet on each piece of foil
9. Top with 1 / 4 of the vegetables
10. Arrange shrimp on top and seal
11. Start at one end , close the edges by making small pleats
12. Work around the length of foil to seal package
13. Fold the end piece under the package
14. Repeat with other 3
15. Bake on a baking sheet 10-12 minutes or until fish is cooked
16. Transfer to individual dishes , carefully unwrap and serve at once

title: caramel pecan oatmeal bars
steps:
1. Place pecans in a single layer in a 13 x 9 inch pan
2. Bake at 350f for 4 to 5 minutes or until toasted , stirring occasionally
3. Remove nuts from pan
4. Line bottom and sides of pan with aluminum foil , allowing 2 to 3 inches to extend over sides
5. Lightly grease foil
6. Stir together cake mix and oats in a large bowl
7. Stir in butter with a fork until mixture is crumbly and dry ingredients are moistened
8. Press half of oat mixture evenly onto bottom of prepared pan
