9. Sprinkle chocolate morsels and toasted pecans evenly over oat mixture in pan
10. Sprinkle with remaining oat mixture
11. Bake at 375f for 30 minutes or until top is golden brown
12. Microwave caramels and 1 tablespoon water in a microwave safe bowl at high 1 minute or until caramels are melted
13. Drizzle evenly over warm bars in pan
14. Let cool on wire rack 1 hour or until completely cool
15. Lift baked bars from pan using foil sides as handles
16. Place on cutting board and cut into 24 bars

title: swimming pool  cocktail
steps: 1. Mix ingredients well , pour into a hurricane glass and float the blue curacao on top

title: flat iron steaks with lemon basil pesto
steps:
1. Chop 4 garlic cloves in a food processor until minced
2. Add the basil and pine nuts , and pulse a few times to combine
3. With the food processor running , slowly pour in the olive oil , stopping once or twice to scrape down the sides
4. Place the parmesan cheese , lemon juice , and red pepper flakes into the food processor , and pulse until blended
5. Season to taste with salt and pepper
6. The pesto should be quite thick , but loose enough to drip off a spoon in clumps
7. Remove 1 / 3 cup of pesto
8. Put the rest in an airtight container and refrigerate
9. Rub the flat iron steaks with the reserved pesto , then cover with plastic wrap and refrigerate for 2 hours
10. Preheat an outdoor grill or broiler for medium-high heat and lightly oil grate
11. Bring the steaks and pesto up to room temperature while the grill heats
12. Grill or broil the steaks to desired degree of doneness on preheated grill , about 4 minutes per side for medium
13. Baste the steaks occasionally with a little of the pesto sauce
14. Once done , serve topped with the remaining pesto

title: low fat chocolate buttercream
steps:
1. Combine coffee granuals with the milk , swish / stir to dissolve , set aside
2. Cream butter and cream cheese at medium speed until light and fluffy
3. Add vanilla and salt , beat well
4. Gradually add cocoa powder , sugar and milk , beating at low speed
5. Increase to high and beat until well blended and easy to spread
6. You may need to add a bit more milk if the consistency is too think

title: apple spice coffee cake
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f
2. Grease an 8-inch pan
3. Combine the ingredients from cool whip to the spices
4. Pulse in a food processor for 10 to 15 times
5. In a large bowl , mix with the 2 1 / 2 cups bisquick mix
6. Stir gently about 20 strokes until well mixed , moist , yet still lumpy
7. Spread into pan
8. Mix the crumb ingredients cold butter to 1 / 3 cup oatmeal until well mixed and crumbly
9. Put on the batter in pan
10. Bake for 30-35 minutes or until toothpick comes out clean
11. Mix the icing ingredients and add half & half until the icing is not too fluid
12. Drizzle over the warm , not hot cake

title: yeast rolls
steps:
1. Dissolve yeast and 2 teaspoons sugar in warm water and let rise be sure to use large enough container
2. Add remaining sugar , shortening and salt to scalded milk and stir to dissolve
3. Add flour until it falls off in sheets
4. At this point , add the 2 eggs and yeast
5. Mix well and begin adding additional flour until dough reaches desired consistency
6. Knead a few minutes
7. Lightly spray a bowl with cooking spray
8. Place dough in bowl , turn so the top has some of the spray on it , and let it rise until doubled
9. Shape into rolls of your choice and let rise again
10. Bake in 400 degree oven for approximately 10 minutes
11. The number of rolls will depend on what shape you make them
12. I usually get 16 crescent rolls

title: good for you tiramisu
steps:
1. In a muesli bowl place the three tablespoons cereal or granola and soak with coffee and amaretto liqueur
2. In a food processor blend first six ingredients and process until you have a smooth cream
3. Dump cream into muesli bowl
4. Blend 2 tablespoons grated dark chocolate and 1 teaspoon cacao powder and sprinkle evenly over cream
5. Enjoy !

title: stabilized whipped cream   corn syrup method
steps:
1. In a large chilled bowl , with chilled beaters , beat cold cream until it just starts to thicken
2. Add corn syrup and vanilla from the side of the bowl , and beat until stiff peaks form

title: cheesecake brownies
steps:
1. Prepare brownie mix as directed on package
2. Spread in greased 13x9-inch baking pan
3. Beat cream cheese with electric mixer on medium speed until smooth , add sugar , egg and vanilla and mix only until blended , pour cream cheese mixture over brownie mixture
4. Cut through several times with knife for marble effect
5. Bake at 350f for 35-40 minutes or until cream cheese mixture is lightly browned ,
6. Cool and cut into squares

title: buttery apple cinnamon cake
steps:
1. Set oven to 350 degrees
2. Prepare a 9-inch springform pan
3. In a bowl using an electric mixer beat the butter with 1-3 / 4 cups sugar , softened cream cheese and vanilla until smooth and well blended
4. Add in eggs
5. Mix well until completely blended
6. In a small bowl combine the flour , baking powder and salt
7. Add to the creamed mixture just until blended
8. In a small bowl combine 1 / 3 cup white or light brown sugar with 3 teaspoons cinnamon
9. In another bowl mix together the chopped apples with 3 tablespoons of the cinnamon mixture , then stir the apple mixture into the batter
10. Transfer the batter into prepared baking dish or springform baking pan
11. Sprinkle the top of the batter with remaining cinnamon / sugar mixture
12. Bake for about 50-60 minutes or until the cake test done
13. Cool cake completely in the pan , then remove to a wire rack

title: ham appetillas
steps:
1. Remove tortillas from regrigerator for about 30 minutes prior
2. Combine creme cheese , mayonnaise , onions , and olives
3. Spread thin layer of mixtures on tortilla
4. Arrange four slices of ham over cheese
5. Tightly roll up tortilla
6. Wrap individually in plastic wrap
7. Place in refrigerator for at least 3 hours
8. Or overnight
9. Cut in 3 / 4 inch slices

title: leslie s roast chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425
2. Clean chicken guts out
3. Rinse chicken thoroughly , inside and out
4. Dry chicken with paper towels , then coat inside of cavity with coarse salt and some pepper
5. Slice onions and line the bottom of pan
6. Palm the lemon and then stab it with a fork all over
7. Stick the lemon in the chicken cavity , as well as all the garlic
8. Put chicken in pan on top of onions
9. Put pats of butter on top of chicken
10. Salt and pepper the skin
11. Place in oven and cook 1
12. 5-2 hours
13. When you get the chicken out let it set at least 15 minutes so the juices settle and don't run out when it's cut

title: chicken burgers with avocado salsa
steps:
1. Slice each chicken breast in half lengthways and place chicken between 2 sheets of baking paper and using the flat side of a meat mallet , pound chicken until 1cm thick
2. Place oil , seasoning , oregano and garlic in a glass or ceramic bowl and add chicken and toss to coast and cover and refrigerate until needed
3. Place avocado , corn , capsicum and lemon juice in a bowl and toss gently to combine , cover and set aside
4. Heat a large non-stick frying pan over medium high heat and cook chicken in 2 batrches for 3 to 4 minutes each side or until cooked through and transfer to a plate , cover with foil to keep worm
5. Spread the base of each bread roll with mayonnaise and top with salad leaves , chicken breast and avocado mixture and top with roll tops and serve

title: pennsylvania dutch red beet eggs
steps:
1. Hard boil eggs
2. Slice onion thinly
3. In a sauce pan combine beets , onion sugar , water and salt
4. Add vinegar here ?
5. Bring to boil and simmer 10 minutes
6. After eggs are cooled , shell them and place in a large jar
7. Cool beet mixture a bit and add to jar
8. Put in refrigerator for at least 24 hours
9. The longer the eggs are in the juice , the better they'll taste
10. Best taste after about 3 days
11. Enjoy !

title: grandma perritt s pavlova with custard cream
steps:
1. Heat your oven - as hot as it will go while you prepare the pav mix
2. Place baking paper on a pizza tray and set aside
3. In a large clean bowl beat the egg whites on high until thick and "soft peak stage"
4. Turn the beaters down to low , add the sugar 1 tablespoon at a time
5. Once all in , return to high and beat for 7-10 minutes until the sugar is dissolved
6. Turn the beaters to low and add the flour and vinegar , mix well
7. Use a metal spoon to scrape out the mix onto the lined tray
8. I aim for a 10 inch circle , it will be a mound
9. Place in a hot oven and turn down to 130oc straight away
10. Bake for 1 hour
11. Turn the oven off and leave for another hour
12. Open the door and leave for another hour
13. The pav needs to be cold when it leaves the oven
14. Dress just before serving
15. Custard cream:
16. In a bowl beat the egg yolks , flour , sugar and vanilla
17. In a saucepan gently heat the cream and milk over a low heat
18. Pour the yolk mix in and whisk constantly until thick and almost to boiling point
19. Set aside and cool for 5 mintues , then pour into a clean bowl
20. Place cling wrap over the top
21. Serve on the side to a dressed pavlova

title: turkey spaghetti
steps:
1. 1
2. Heat olive oil over medium high heat
3. 2
4. Cook onion until soft , then add turkey and cook until almost completely cooked
5. 3
6. Add spices and seasonings and cook until turkey is completely cooked
7. 4
8. Add the rest of the ingredients - mushrooms , tomatoes , paste , and broth - and cook , covered , on medium low heat for 45 minutes to an hour
9. 5
10. Serve with spaghetti noodles

title: purple velvet torte  beet cake
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan , heat the beets and agave to a boil
2. Reduce to a simmer and cook for 30 minutes , until beets are soft
3. Transfer beet-agave mixture to a blender and puree on highest speed until smooth
4. Blend in eggs , oil , vanilla , almond extract , cocoa and salt until thoroughly incorporated
5. Pour batter into a well greased 9-inch cake pan
6. Bake at 350 for 20-25 minutes until a knife inserted into the center comes out clean
7. Cool and serve

title: ginger ale ice cubes
steps:
1. Bring water and sugar to a boil and add rest of ingredients
2. Freeze in ice trays
3. Serve with ginger ale

title: cadillac refrigerator pickles
steps:
1. You will also need 1 ice cream pail and lid
2. Combine and bring to a boil the water , vinegar , and pickling salt
3. Let cool , this is very important
4. Place remaining ingredients in pail
5. Cucumbers can be halved , quartered , or sliced
6. Pour cooled liquid mixture over cucumbers until covered
7. Leave uncovered and let sit at room temperature for 3 days
8. Cover , refrigerate , and enjoy

title: pear and grape juice
steps:
1. Juice together pears and grapes
2. Add water , taste and add more water until desired sweetness is obtained

title: creamy zesty herbed chicken
steps:
1. Season chicken on both sides with salt & pepper
2. Fry chicken thighs in 12" skillet
3. If there's skin , you won't need additional fat
4. If they're skinless , you may want a touch of oil
5. Remove to plate when cooked through
6. Add flour & whisk until smooth
7. Add roasted garlic , cream cheese , thyme , lemon zest & juice
8. Whisk until smooth & bring to a boil
9. Add chicken thighs back to pan
10. Cook for a few minutes
11. Taste for seasoning & add additional salt & pepper if necessary
12. Enjoy over rice or noodles

title: polish cheese slices
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. Grease an 8 inch square baking pan and also line with parchment paper
3. Beat the sieved cottage cheese , buttermilk , eggs , honey , sugar , and flour until smooth
4. Spoon into prepared pan
5. Bake in oven 30 minutes or until set
6. Prepare syrup by combining sugar , flavour , and water in saucepot
7. Bring to a boil , reduce the heat and simmer until sugar is all dissolved well
8. When the cheesecake is removed from the oven and still warm , pour warm syrup over warm cake
9. Let now to cool completely
10. To serve cut into small bars , garnish with a piece of orange segments on the side of plate

title: incredible blueberry tea cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Cream together first five ingredients
3. In separate bowl mix with whisk next 3 ingredients then add to wet batter
4. Fold in blueberries carefully
5. Spread into greased 9x13-inch pan
6. Mix topping ingredients in a bowl and crumble with pastry blender or 2 knives until mealy
7. Top batter with topping and bake for 35-40 minutes

title: mamas lemon icebox pie
steps:
1. To make the crust , combine the crushed granita with the melted butter and firmly press the crumb mixture evenly on the bottom and sides of two 9 inch pie plates
2. Bake at 350f for 7 minutes and let cool before pouring the pie mixture into it
3. Lightly whisk 6 egg yolk little and add condensed milk to the egg yolks and stir a little again
4. Pour juice from the lemons on top and let it sit a while as you make the meringue topping
5. To make the meringue , whip the egg whites until stiff with cream of tartar
6. Add vanilla and sugar
7. Stir the lemon juice into the condensed milk mixture until well combined
8. Pour the lemon mixture into 2 pie crusts and top with the meringue
9. Bake at 400f until slightly browned
10. Let the pie cool and then place in the fridge until ready to serve
11. When serving , dip the knife in cool water before slicing to get a clean cut on the meringue

title: steamed chocolate pudding   hard sauce
steps:
1. Hard sauce: chill and serve on top of steamy pudding
2. Cream butter with sugar and egg
3. Mix all dry ingredients and add to butter mixture
4. Add melted chocolate
5. Pour into greased pudding mold
6. Steam in simmering water for 2 1 / 2 hours
7. This can be done by filling a large casserole with water , enough to go 1 / 2 height of the mold

title: nif s sherry sauteed mushrooms
steps:
1. Heat the butter and olive oil in a frying pan over low-medium heat
2. Add shallots
3. Saute for 3 minutes
4. Add garlic and saute for 2 more minutes
5. Add mushrooms and sherry and stir to coat
6. Saute for 10 minutes , stirring occasionally
7. Salt and pepper to taste
8. Sprinkle parsley on mushrooms for garnish

title: halloween jack o lantern pasta dinner
steps:
1. Carve each bell pepper as you would a jack-o-lantern , cutting the top off and hollowing out the inside before carving a face
2. Discard the tops
3. Cook pasta according to package directions
4. Drain pasta
5. Mix pasta with warm sauce and spoon into each individual pepper , making sure the pasta 'oozes' out the eyes , mouth , and top of pepper
6. Serve with breadstick 'bones'--tie a knot at the end of each breadstick , bake , and enjoy !

title: raspberry cheesecake bars
steps:
1. Preheat over to 350 degrees
2. Grease a 13x9x2-inch backing pan
3. Mix together flour , pecans , brown sugar , cinnamon and salt
4. Gradually pour in butter , tossing with a fork until mixture is moistened
5. Pat mixture evenly into prepared pan
6. Bake 15 minutes
7. Cool for 5 minutes , then spread with 3 / 4 cup jam
8. Beat cream cheese , 3 / 4 cup sugar , 1 / 2 teaspoons vanilla , lemon zest with mixer until smooth
9. Add eggs one at a time , beating well after each addition
10. Pour over jam and spread with spatula
11. Bake 25 additional minutes
12. Cool for 5 minutes
13. Mix together sour cream , 3 tbs
14. Sugar , and 1tsp
15. Vanilla until smooth
16. Spread evenly over cheesecake
17. Warm remaining jam in saucepan over medium heat
18. Carefully pour into plastic baggie , snip off one end
19. Pipe jam in thin stream on top in a swirl pattern
20. Bake 5-7 minutes , until sour cream topping is set
21. Cool completely on wire rack
22. Refrigerate at least 1 hour or over night

title: lemon pudding pie
steps:
1. Cream butter well in large mixing bowl
2. Add 3 / 4 cup sugar in 2 additions , beating 1 minute after each portion added
3. Blend in the egg yolks , 1 at a time , beating well after each addition
4. Beat in the lemon juice and rind
5. Beat in flour and cream
6. Beat egg whites on moderately high speed in small deep bowl until frothy
7. Add cream of tartar
8. Continue beating until soft peaks form
9. Add remaining 1 / 4 cup sugar
10. Beat until firm but moist peaks form
11. Stir in small spoonful of the egg whites into lemon mixture
12. Then fold in remaining egg whites
13. Gently , pour filling into baked pie shell
14. Bake at 400 degrees 10 minutes , reduce oven temperature to 350 degrees and continue baking about 25 minutes or until top is well risen and firm to the touch
15. Transfer to cooling rack
16. Cool completely
17. Then refrigerate 6 hours before serving
18. Makes one 9" pie

title: tilapia coconut curry
steps:
1. In a small saucepan begin to cook the brown rice
2. Dice onions and chop broccoli , in a large pan or wok toss with 1 tsp of salt and a few sprays of pam , and sautee about 5 minutes , remove from heat
3. Spray another pan with pam , sprinkle tilapia with 1 tsp salt and 1 tsp curry powder , place in the pan and then pour the coconut milk over the tilapia
4. Add the rest of the curry powder and pineapple and stir gently
5. Cook on medium-high heat for 3 minutes , turn the tilapia over gently and cook an additional 3 minutes - or until the fish is fully cooked
6. Stir in the broccoli and onions and serve over rice

title: spanish rice bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
2. Brown the ground beef in a 2 qt oven- and range-safe dutch oven , over medium-high heat
3. Drain excess fat
4. Stir in the onion , green bell pepper , tomatoes , water , rice , salsa , salt , brown sugar , cumin , chili powder , worcestershire sauce and ground black pepper
5. Bring to a boil , then reduce to low and let simmer for about 30 minutes
6. Do not lift the lid for at least the first 20 minutes
7. Sprinkle with the shredded cheddar cheese , and bake for 10 to 15 minutes , or until cheese is melted and bubbly

title: sugar   spice salmon
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 f
2. Grease a 13x9x2 inch baking dish
3. Place salmon in dish
4. Combine brown sugar , mustard , salt , cayenne , and ginger , and sprinkle mixture over salmon
5. Dot with butter
6. Bake uncovered at 375 f for 20-23 minutes or until fish flakes easily with a fork
7. While salmon bakes , make salsa by combining all salsa ingredients in a small bowl and mixing together
8. Serve along with salmon

title: chicken cannelloni
steps:
1. To make chicken filling:
2. Cook chicken until pink is just gone - do not overcook ! chop finely or grind
3. Combine oil , onion , celery , carrots and parsley in saucepan and cook for 10 minutes
4. Beat egg yolks in large bowl , add parmesan and ricotta cheeses and beat until smooth
5. Add salt , oregano , basil , nutmeg and pepper
6. Add chicken and broth and beat until well mixed
7. This may be covered and refrigerated or frozen until ready to use
8. Cheddar sauce:
9. Melt butter in sauce pan , add flour and stir until smooth
10. Add chicken broth , stirring constantly
11. Add salt and pepper to taste
12. Stir in cheddar cheese until well blended and thick
13. Now add prepared meat sauce and cream
14. Prepare hollandaise sauce and add to cheddar sauce
15. Cook cannelloni shells according to package directions
16. When cool , fill each shell with approximately 2 tablespoons of chicken filling
17. Spoon a thin layer of sauce into two 9"x13" baking dishes
18. Place stuffed shells in dishes side by side 5 to a row
19. Spoon sauce around and over stuffed shells and sprinkle with monterey jack cheese
20. Bake at 425f for 10 minutes until cheese is bubbling
21. Serve at once
22. To make ahead: prepare the entire recipe to the baking stage and freeze

title: baked olive bundles
steps:
1. Position the rack in the center of the oven and preheat to 400 degrees f
2. Lightly grease a baking or cookie sheet
3. In a bowl , blend together the cheese , the puree and the butter
4. Blend in the flour , a little at a time , to form a sticky dough
5. Drop by tablespoons onto the prepared baking sheet , and form into patties
6. Press the olives into the centers , and pull the dough up to completely cover
7. Bake for about 15 minutes , or until golden brown
8. Remove from the oven and serve

title: hot artichoke spinach dip
steps:
1. Put the artichoke hearts and spinach in a microwave-safe bowl , and cover it with plastic wrap
2. Cut a small slit in the plastic to let the steam out , then microwave on high for 4 minutes
3. Stir , and zap it again for another 2 to 3 minutes or until the artichoke hearts are tender
4. If you don't want to use a microwave you can also boil the spinach and artichoke hearts in a cup of water in a small saucepan over medium heat until tender , around 10 minutes
5. Drain in a colander when done
6. Heat the cream cheese in a small bowl in the microwave set on high for 1 minutes
7. Or , use a saucepan to heat the cheese over medium heat just until hot
8. Add the spinach and artichoke hearts to the cream cheese and stir well
9. Add the remaining ingredients to the cream cheese and combine
10. Serve warm with crackers , chips , or toasted bread for dipping
11. To make a lighter version , use reduced fat cream cheese

title: cuban picadillo
steps:
1. Heat olive oil in a large skillet and add the sofrito
2. Cook the sofrito until it is fragrant and the onions are translucent
3. Remove from pan and set aside
4. Brown ground beef in pan and drain fat
5. Add sofrito to the beef along with the tomatoes , vinegar , and cayenne pepper
6. Simmer for 45 minutes on low heat
7. Serve over rice , with a fried egg on top , garnished with pimiento , if desired
8. Another option to serve is to spoon it into corn tortillas , with lettuce , tomato , green onions , jalapenos , cheese , and hot sauce , like a taco

title: mediterranean summer salad
steps:
1. Cook orzo according to package directions
2. Meanwhile , in a large bowl , combine tomatoes , basil , garlic , pine nuts , olives , feta , and spinach
3. Add cooked orzo
4. In a small bowl , whisk together oil , vinegar , and salt and pepper to taste
5. Toss with salad
6. Serve

title: vermont maple oatmeal pie
steps:
1. Unroll pastry into a 9-in
2. Pie plate
3. Flute edges
4. In a large bowl , combine the eggs , sugar , flour , cinnamon and salt
5. Stir in the oats , syrups , butter and vanilla
6. Pour into crust
7. Sprinkle with coconut
8. Bake at 350 for 50-60 minutes or until set
9. Cover edges with foil during the last 15 minutes to prevent overbrowning if necessary
10. Cool on a wire rack
11. Serve with ice cream if desired
12. Refrigerate leftovers
13. Yield: 8 servings

title: stewed lamb
steps:
1. Place flour , salt and pepper into a large bag and add lamb pieces
2. Shake until lamb is well coated
3. In a large skillet , heat olive oil
4. Saute lamb until golden brown , remove from pan and set aside
5. In the same pan , saute onion , garlic , carrots , celery , and dried oregano , adding a little more olive oil if necessary
6. Place all ingredients into a crock pot and simmer on medium-high for approx 4-6 hours or until lamb is tender
7. If stew becomes too thick , add additional beef broth as needed
8. Serve with white rice and greek salad

title: parmesan shortbread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325
2. Line an 8 inch square pan with buttered foil
3. Beat all ingredients except flour in a mixing bowl with an electric mixer until light and creamy , 3-4 minutes
4. Add flour and continue to mix at lowest speed until smooth dough forms
5. Scrape dough into pan and press evenly with the back of a spoon
6. Pierce dough randomly with a floured fork
7. Bake 35 minutes until firm
8. Let cool slightly then invert pan over your cutting board
9. Remove the foil and cut the shortbread into 2 inch squares

title: lorrie s mexican soup
steps:
1. Brown ground beef and set aside
2. In same pan saut raw veggies till softened
3. Empty corn , beans , tomatoes , beef broth and water in a large stock pot with sauted veggies and cooked ground beef
4. Add seasonings
5. Bring to a boil and simmer uncovered for 1 hour
6. This is best served the following day or made very early so the flavors can meld
7. Top with some freshly grated mozzarella or cheese of your choice

title: strawberry watermelon soup
steps:
1. Add the melon and sugar to the container of a food processor or electric blender
2. Process until smooth and pureed
3. Pour mixture into a large mixing bowl
4. Add berries to the container of a food processor or electric blender
5. Process until smooth and pureed
6. Pour into the bowl with the watermelon puree
7. Add the yogurt and lemon juice to the watermelon-strawberry puree
8. Stir well to combine
9. Chill until ice cold
10. Serve in chilled bowls
11. Garnish with mint sprigs

title: brined pork loin roast
steps:
1. Bring water , salt and sugar to boil
2. Add bay leaves , cloves , cinnamon stick , peppercorns and garlic
3. Simmer 5 minutes
4. Remove from heat and let cool to room temp
5. Pour over pork roast and marinate a minimum of 8 hours or overnight
6. Drain
7. Pre-heat oven to 250 degrees
8. Season meat with salt and pepper
9. Place in a roasting pan with meat side down
10. Drape bacon slices over the roast so the top and sides are covered with the bacon
11. Bake in pre-heated oven until internal temperature of the meat is 140 degrees
12. Let roast rest about 20 minutes before slicing
13. I've found it easiest to cut with an electric knife with the meat down and ribs up- slicing between the rib bones

title: pear and chocolate jam
steps:
1. Put a small plate in the freezer for later use
2. Peel and core pears
3. Dice them or use a food processor
4. Mix the pears and lemon juice in a large sauce pan
5. Add sugar and bring to boil
6. Lower heat and simmer for 20-30 minutes
7. Stir occasionally
8. Chop chocolate and put aside
9. Once you hit 20 minutes , take the plate out of the freezer and put a small amount of jam on it to test for gelling
10. Wait for a few seconds and then see if jam runs
11. If it does and you want a thick jam , cook for a few more minutes and repeat process
12. Stir chocolate into jam , stir and wait for a simmer
13. Turn off heat
14. Package jam in freezer dishes or can for 12 minutes

title: loubscoutch  norwegian hash
steps:
1. Boil potatoes , carrots and onion in water- until the potatoes split
2. Pour off about 2 / 3 of the liquid into a bowl
3. Add corned beef to pot
4. With mixer , mix everything to the consistency of mashed potatoes
5. Season with salt and pepper

title: chicken with strawberry salad
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. In a shallow bowl , mix panko , salt and pepper
3. In seperate bowl wisk egg whites to break them up
4. Dip each chicken breast first in the egg white and then in the panko until completely covered
5. Preheat a non-stick pan on medium-high heat with 2 tablespoons olive oil
6. Add two chicken breasts and cook until golden brown color on each side about 3 minutes per side
7. Lay them on a cooling rack , on top of a baking sheet and place in oven to finish cooking 3-5 minutes
8. Add your arugula to a large bowl and douse with balsamic vinegar and 2 tablespoons olive oil
9. Gently mix in strawberries , fennel and almonds
10. When serving , layer salad on top of chicken

title: chicken ragout
steps:
1. Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat
2. Add in the onion
3. Cook / stir 9-10 minutes , until golden
4. Add in mushrooms
5. Cook / stir for 4 minutes
6. Set mixture aside
7. Sprinkle chicken with salt and pepper
8. Heat a 5-quart dutch oven over med-high heat
9. Add in chicken
10. Brown it on each side
11. Deglaze pan with the wine , scraping up any browned bits on the bottom
12. Add in the soup mix , dried fines herbs , broth , bay leaf , and reserved onion / mushroom mixture
13. Cover the pan and simmer for 45 minutes , turning chicken several times during the cooking time
14. Remove bay leaf and serve

title: baked apples stuffed with cranberries and almonds
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
2. Cut 1 / 2 inch off the top of the apples and reserve tops
3. Use a paring knife or spoon to hollow out the apples , leaving about a 1 / 2-inch thick wall and base
4. Set aside
5. Melt butter in a large skillet over medium heat
6. Add cranberries , honey , cardamom , dates and orange juice and zest and cook until the cranberries begin to collapse and liquid thickens , 3 to 4 minutes
7. Stir in almonds
8. Spoon cranberry mixture into apples then replace the apple tops
9. Put into a small baking dish filled with 1 / 4 inch water , cover with foil and bake until tender , 15 to 30 minutes
10. Uncover , and carefully pour off the water and continue baking until very tender and golden , 10 to 15 minutes more

title: grapefruit guacamole salsa
steps:
1. Saute onion in the olive oil until tender and beginning to become lightly golden
2. Stir in sugar and saute until glistening
3. Place in bowl and toss in the rest

title: tan tan noodles
steps:
1. In a medium saucepan , with heavy bottom , heat the oil over moderate heat
2. Add the ginger and garlic and cook for about 3 minutes , or until they begin to turn golden brown
3. Watch carefully so they don't overcook
4. Add sesame oil , chili oil and the black beans
5. Cook 1 minute , stirring constantly
6. Add the green onions and cook 2 minutes
7. Stir in the chili paste , tamari and stir to create a smooth sauce
8. Add the peanut butter and tahini , again stirring to create smoth paste
9. Cook 1 minute , stirring constantly
10. If you want a really thick sauce , add an additional tbsp of peanut butter and tahini
11. Add the broth slowly and reduce the heat to low
12. Let the sauce simmer for a min of 15 minutes , as the flavors need to blend , and the broth thicken
13. Taste for spiciness - add more chili paste and chili oil if you want more heat
14. Saute ground beef , and when it is cooked through , spoon in some of the tan tan sauce and heat until liquid has been absorbed
15. The sauce can be made 24 hours ahead of time
16. Cover and refridgerate
17. Just before serving , bring back to temperature , but don't boil
18. To serve: place cooked noodles into individual serving bowls , top with beef , green onions , cilantro and peanuts
19. Ladle sauce over top

title: lemony asparagus and new potatoes
steps:
1. Cook potatoes , covered , in a small amount of boiling water in a 2 quart saucepan for 10 minutes
2. Add asparagus
3. Cook , covered , about 8 additional minutes , drain
4. Transfer vegetables to a serving bowl
5. Dressing: combine rest of ingredients
6. Add to the veggies and toss to coat
7. Serve

title: pork sausage pie
steps:
1. Place half the sausage meat into greased pie dish
2. Scatter onions over sausage meat
3. Add sliced tomatoes and top with the rest of the sausage meat
4. Season well
5. Mash potatoes thoroughly with butter and seasonings
6. Fork roughly over top of pie
7. Bake at 375 degrees for 45 minutes

title: calamari fra diavolo over linguine
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large skillet over medium heat
2. Add red onion and saute until tender , about 5-10 minutes
3. Add bay leaf and garlic
4. Cook for an additional minutes
5. Add calamari and saute for 2 minutes or so , until lightly colored
6. Add white wine , and cook for 3-4 minutes , until liquid is reduced
7. Add salt , red pepper , and marjoram
8. Stir to combine
9. Add marinara sauce , bring to a slow simmer , then cover and cook gently for 20-30 minutes
10. Meanwhile , cook linguine according to package directions
11. When sauce is done , stir in fresh basil then spoonover linguine and serve

title: savoury picnic muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 200c lightly grease a 12-hole , 1 / 3 cup-capacity muffin pan
2. Sift flour into a large bowl
3. Make a well in centre
4. Pour butter , egg and milk into a jug
5. Stir to combine
6. Pour into well
7. Stir until almost combined
8. Fold through feta , ham , tomatoes and olives
9. Spoon mixture into muffin holes
10. Insert a rosemary sprig in the top of each muffin
11. Bake for 20 minutes or until a skewer inserted in the centre comes out clean
12. Set aside in pan for 1 minute
13. Turn out onto a wire rack to cool completely
14. Place muffins in an airtight container
15. Serve with butter

title: indonesian spice cake  spekkuk bumbu
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees fahrenheit
2. Grease and flour a bundt pan
3. In a medium bowl , resift the sifted flour along with the baking powder , nutmeg , clove , cinnamon , and salt
4. Resift one more time , then set aside
5. In another bowl , beat the softened butter until it is soft and very pliant , about one minute , gradually add the sugar and beat on high speed until it is pale and fluffy , about 3 to 5 minutes
6. Beat in the 4 whole eggs by hand , one at a time , until the butter and egg mixture is light and fluffy , about 2 minutes
7. Add the flour mixture to the butter and egg mixture in 3 equal parts , beating on low speed until the batter is smooth and the flour is well combined with the butter and eggs
8. Add the lightly beaten egg yolks and the vanilla , and continue to beat or stir until they are well mixed into the batter
9. Pour the batter into the prepared pan , spreading it until the surface is even
10. Then place the pan in the middle reack of the oven and bake about one hour , test with a wooden pick
11. This cake will nearly double in size as it cooks
12. Remove the pan from the oven and set it on a wire rack to cool for about 10 minutes , when cool enough , invert the cake onto a wire rack to finish cooling
13. Then transfer the cake to a serving platter and sprinkle the top with sifted confectioner's sugar

title: italian sausage soup
steps:
1. Cook sausage in a 350f oven for 30 minutes
2. Drain and slice
3. Place onions , potatoes , broth , water and garlic in a heavy pot
4. Cook until potatoes are tender
5. Add sausage and bacon
6. Salt and pepper to taste
7. Turn to low heat and add kale and cream
8. Heat thoroughly and serve

title: fat free chocolate mocha cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Spray a 9 inch square pan with nonstick spray
3. Combine dry ingredients in a large bowl
4. In a small bowl , whisk wet ingredients together
5. Blend well
6. Add liquids to dry ingredients , whisking until smooth
7. Bake 35-40 minutes , or until done
8. Cool completely
9. Frost , if desired

title: witch s cauldron corn
steps:
1. Place popped popcorn , corn snacks , pretzels and pistachios in very large bowl
2. Set aside
3. Melt butter on high in microwave-safe bowl
4. Add sugar
5. Stir
6. Pour butter mixture over popcorn mixture
7. Stir to coat
8. Carefully stir in candy corn

title: cinnamon banana cake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325
2. Put egg and applesauce into large mixing bowl
3. Mix with a spoon
4. Add honey , and vanilla
5. Mix
6. Add bananas , flour , baking powder , and water
7. Mix well
8. Add cereal
9. Mix
10. Pour into 11 by 7 glass baking dish , lightly sprayed
11. Sprinkle top with cinnamon
12. Bake in oven at 325 for 25-30 minutes
13. Check with knife , it should come out almost clean , but be slightly warm and gooey inside
14. If not done then check every 3 or so minutes
15. Cool 30 minutes
16. Freezes superbly

title: yummy baked stuffed chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Boil water and 1 / 4 cup butter in medium saucepan
3. Stir in contents of stuffing mix pouch
4. Cover
5. Remove from heat
6. Let stand 5 minutes
7. Fluff with fork and set aside
8. Combine bread crumbs , salt , pepper and garlic powder
9. Place beaten eggs and bread crumbs in two shallow plates or bowls
10. Rinse chicken and pat dry
11. Slice each breast lengthwise to create a pocket
12. Stuff each breast generously with stuffing
13. Dip into beaten eggs , then into bread crumbs
14. Preheat large skillet with olive oil and 2 tablespoons butter
15. Fry breasts on both sides over medium-high heat until golden brown , about two minutes each side
16. Transfer to a lightly-greased 9x13 inch pan and bake covered for 20 minutes
17. Combine soup and milk and pour around chicken breasts
18. Cover and continue baking for 10 minutes
19. Uncover
20. Bake an additional 10 minutes
21. Serve with your favorite side dish and enjoy !

title: indian chili chicken with onions
steps:
1. Heat oil in a wok
2. Put in onions and fry until they are caramelized , stirring every so often
3. While the onions are caramelizing , cut the chicken into bite size pieces
4. Coat each piece with cornstarch
5. Add ginger and garlic to onions and fry some more
6. When the onions , ginger and garlic are done , push them up to the sides of the wok to make room for the chicken
7. Add chicken pieces to the hot oil
8. Fry until the chicken is brown and has crispy bits on the edges
9. Stir onion mixture from the wok sides into the chicken
10. Add green chilies and green onion
11. Stir around just enough to warm the chilies and green onion
12. Push the chicken mixture to the upper sides of the wok to keep it crispy as you make the sauce
13. Mix together water , sugar , 2 teaspoons cornstarch , soy sauce in a small bowl
14. Throw it into the centre of the wok
15. Remove from heat and stir sauce until thickened
16. Mix well with chicken and onions
17. Serve with plenty of steamed rice , broccoli and beer

title: tomatoes   mushrooms  and  onions
steps:
1. Cut onion into large dice
2. Heat oil in large skillet over medium-high heat
3. When oil starts to sizzle , add onions
4. Cook until edges start to brown
5. Stir frequently
6. While onion cooks , cut tomatoes and mushrooms into large dice
7. Cut green onions into small dice
8. Rough chop basil and then bruise slightly
9. When onion is ready , add rest of vegetables
10. Combine well and lower heat to medium
11. Cook 5 minutes , stir occasionally
12. Add water , puree , garlic , pepper and salt
13. Combine very well
14. Lower heat to simmer
15. Cook another 5-6 minutes or until mushrooms start to give off their liquid and and start to soften
16. Do not cover
17. Remove from heat
18. You want this dish to have consistency and not become mushy
19. This will not have alot of liquid when done
20. This can be divided , and packaged up for the freezer
21. It has a very long freezer shelf life
22. This makes a very good starter to a tomato sauce
23. It makes a very different pasta sauce when you add some sour cream or plain yogurt
24. It is wonderful for soups and stews
25. I use it mixed with some yogurt to top my salmon patties
26. It's yummy over baked potato or stirred into a bean dish
27. Save those stems ! clean them , cut off the very bottom and then cut the rest of the stems into small pieces
28. Put into a freezer container , just cover with water , add scant pinch of salt , seal and freeze
29. You can add to this container at any time , just make sure the the stems are covered by water
30. Now they are ready , water and all to use in a soup or stew !
31. I like to use a combo of fresh ground peppers , such as pink , and green along with the black
32. Nowadays , you can buy that type of combo in a handy small grinder in your supermarket

title: small avocado salads with warm bacon parsley vinaigrette
steps:
1. Fry bacon in a large skillet
2. Drain on paper towels ~ reserve 2 tablespoons bacon fat
3. Heat reserved bacon fat over medium heat
4. Add garlic , 14 cup water , the lemon juice , sugar , salt , and pepper , and simmer 1 minute , stirring constantly
5. Stir in parsley and crumble in bacon
6. Cool slightly
7. Prepare individual salad plates with about 1 / 2 cup spring greens on each plate
8. Top with avocado wedges
9. Immediately spoon a small amount of vinaigrette over avocado wedges on each plate ~ top each plate with 1 tablespoon gorgonzola , and serve

title: broccoli  cheese  rice casserole with chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Grease glass 2 quart cake pan
3. Chop 2 cups frozen broccoli florets into small pieces , you can thaw for better cutting
4. Mix in pan cream of mushroom , cream of chicken , rice , water broccoli , and 1 1 / 2 cups of cheese
5. Smooth evenly in dish
6. Place the thawed uncooked chicken breast on top of the mixture
7. Season with whatever spices you like
8. For a kick , i always put chile power , crushed peppers , and garlic salt
9. Around the chicken put the remaining cheese to cover the mixture , but not the chicken
10. Place in over , do not cover , and bake for 25 minutes
11. The chicken will be fully cooked and the broccoli cheese rice mixture will be creamy and cooked as well
12. Enjoy !

title: cranberry barbecued chicken
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325f
2. Place chicken pieces on a foil covered baking sheet
3. Season the chicken with salt and pepper
4. In a bowl , stir together remaining ingredients
5. Pour the sauce over the chicken
6. Bake for approximately 55-60 minutes , basting every 15 minutes or so , cooking until the juices run clear and chicken is done

title: smaen sr  fried cheese
steps:
1. In the begining its good to wash the cheese so the flour would stick on the cheese better when dipping
2. Now take three plates and put flour into one of them , egg and a little bit of milk and a hint of salt to the second one and the breadcrubs to the third one
3. Dip cheese slices into flour to form a light coating on all surfaces
4. Dip each slice into lightly beaten egg and coat completely
5. Dip each slice into breadcrumbs and coat completely , pat crumbs onto any areas that are not coated
6. If needed repeat the point 4
7. And 5
8. - tastes better
9. Pour oil into deep frying pan to a depth of 1 / 2 inch
10. Heat to 375 degrees f
11. Carefully place slices in pan and fry on one side until golden-brown
12. Turn and fry on the other side until golden brown
13. Pay attention so the cheese doesnt get out from the "coat" !
14. Serve with french fries and tatar sauce / ketchup

title: garlic mayo  ali oli
steps:
1. Put the egg , garlic and salt in a food processor
2. Turn on , and whir until garlic is completely blended--i sometimes mash it first , even before adding it to the machine
3. This is very important--add the oil in a thin steady stream--no thicker than spaghetti , especially at first
4. Continue to add the oil in a steady stream until the mayo thickens
5. Add the vinegar and process a couple seconds more

title: zesty dijon grilled onions
steps:
1. Cut each onion crosswise into 4 slices
2. Secure onion slices with toothpicks to hold shape& set aside
3. Blend mustard , oil , and chili powder in small bowl
4. Grill onion slices over medium heat 6 to 7 minutes each side , brushing with mixture and turing occasionally till fully cooked& well glazed
5. Remove toothpicks& serve !

title: my big fat greek lemon soup  made easy
steps:
1. One: in a wide 2-3 quart saucepan , add 3 cups chicken stock , 1 / 4 cup fresh lemon juice , 1 teaspoon recipe #488671 , 4 tablespoons unsalted butter , 2 teaspoons granulated sugar , and 1 / 8 teaspoon finely grated fresh lemon zest
2. Stir
3. Add 1 / 4 cup uncooked orzo pasta
4. Bring mixture to a rolling boil , then reduce heat to medium
5. Cover and simmer for 15 minutes
6. Remove from heat
7. Stir in 1 cup of the cold chicken stock , reserving the final 1 cup for the following step
8. Two: in a medium mixing bowl , add the remaining 1 cup cold chicken stock
9. Gradually whisk in 4 tablespoons flour until lump-free
10. Whisk 2 eggs into the flour mixture until smooth
11. Pour mixture all at once into saucepan mixture while whisking vigorously
12. Return to low heat
13. Three: if desired , add 1 1 / 2 - 2 cups diced boneless skinless rotisserie-cooked chicken
14. Heat over low to medium-low heat , stirring often with a wooden spoon , until completely thickened and heated through
15. Garnish with minced fresh parsley if desired
16. Serve and enjoy

title: jan s easy beef enchiladas
steps:
1. Brown beef add taco seasoning , and about 1 / 3 cup of enchilada sauce
2. In a separate pan , place oil and cook tortillas one by one just for a little bit -- they need to be soft
3. After that just roll the tortilla stuffed with beef and cheese , until you complete the 20 tortillas , and when you finish bath the tortillas with the rest of the enchilada sauce
4. Place some more cheese on top , and place in oven for about 20 min at 350 degrees

title: snack crackers
steps:
1. Mix together the flour , baking powder , salt and sugar
2. Crumble into the butter , mixing with a fork
3. Add the milk
4. Mix until the dough holds together
5. Roll out to a thickness of 1 / 16th inch
6. Cut crackers with round cookie cutter , using very little flour
7. Place on greased cookie sheet
8. Prick all over with a fork
9. Sprinkle lightly with salt
10. Use onion or garlic salt , if desired
11. Bake at 425 degrees for 8 to 10 minutes or until nicely browned
12. Cool completely before putting into tightly closed container

title: cheechako chicken
steps:
1. In a large fry pan , melt butter over medium heat
2. Add chicken and cook about 6 minutes or until brown on both sides
3. You want some good golden color here , so no skimping
4. Remove chicken to a plate and sprinkle with 1 / 4 tsp of the salt and 1 / 4 tsp of the pepper , and set aside for the moment
5. In a small bowl , mix remaining salt , pepper , thyme , rosemary , parsley and apple juice
6. Add the onion to the pan and stir to coat with the butter / meat juices left in the pan
7. Now add the apple juice-spice mixture to pan and scrap up those crusty bits at the bottom
8. Bring to a boil and return chicken to pan , just nestle it in there
9. Cover and cook over medium about 30 minutes , or until liquid has turned thick and mixture is a deep amber color
10. To serve , spoon onion mixture over or to the side of each piece
11. I usually will let the mixture boil for 3 to 5 minutes before returning the chicken to the pan and reducing the heat to medium

title: banana nut muffins
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375f
2. Grease muffin cups
3. Stir together flour , baking powder , baking soda and salt
4. Separately cream butter and sugar until light and fluffy
5. Beat in eggs , and stir in bananas , buttermilk and vanilla
6. Add dry ingredients and stir to combine
7. Add walnuts and stir
8. Pour into muffin cups
9. Bake 25-30 minutes
10. Cool for 5 minutes before eating

title: scrambled eggs with poblano chiles and cheese
steps:
1. Melt 2 tablespoons butter in a large saucepan over medium heat
2. Add onoin , garlic , and oregano and saute until onion is soft , about 3 minutes
3. Add tomatoes with juice and chili powder
4. Cover and simmer 5 minutes to blend flavors
5. Transfer sauce to blender
6. Puree until smooth
7. Season with salt and pepper ,
8. Return sauce to pan and keep warm
9. Melt remaining 4 tablespoons butter in large skillet over medium heat
10. Add chiles
11. Saute until tender , about 6 minutes
12. Add green onions and 1 / 4 cup cilantro
13. Add eggs and cheese
14. Cook until eggs are softly set , stirring occasionally , about 4 minutes
15. Divide eggs among 4 plates
16. Spoon sauce over
17. Sprinkle with remaining 1 / 4 cup cilantro

title: quick scampi with cream sauce
steps:
1. Dust shrimp with flour shaking off the excess
2. Heat oil in a heavy skillet , add garlic and shallot , cook over low heat 2 minutes
3. Increase heat to medium , add shrimp , salt , pepper , lemon juice and tabasco and cook 5 minutes
4. Add wine and cream , bring mixture to a soft boil and cook 2 minutes

title: lady baltimore cake  with frosting
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 350f
2. Butter and flour two 9 inch round cake pans
3. Line the bottom of each with a circle of wax paper
4. Prepare the cake:
5. Toss the flour and baking powder together in a bowl
6. In a mixing bowl , cream the eggs and sugar together just until blended
7. Beat in the oil and orange juice , then slowly beat in the flour mixture just until smooth
8. Spoon the batter into the prepared cake pan and bake until an inserted toothpick comes out clean--about 30 minutes
9. Cool in the pans on wire racks for 30 minutes then remove the cake from the pans and let cool to room temperature on wire racks
10. Prepare the frosting:
11. Whisk the egg whites , sugar , baking powder , orange juice , lemon juice , and orange zest together in the top of a double boiler
12. Cook over boiling water , beating constantly with a hand-held electric mixer for 7 minutes
13. Remove the pan from the heat
14. The frosting should be satiny and fluffy
15. Gently fold the pecans and raisins into the frosting and let the frosting sit for a few minutes
16. Fill the cake with frosting and spread over sides and top
17. (decorate with candied orange zest if you want ! )

title: rigatoni puttanesca
steps:
1. Heat 2 tablespoons of olive oil in a heavy saucepan
2. Add onion and garlic
3. Cook over low heat for10 to 15 minutes , or until vegetables are wilted
4. Crush tomatoes slightly
5. Add to the saucepan along with their liquid
6. Stir in tomato paste
7. Cook for 5 minutes over medium heat
8. Coarsely chop the anchovies and add to the saucepan along with their oil
9. Stir in olives , capers , basil , oregano , red-pepper flakes and black pepper
10. Stir gently and simmer over medium heat for 30 minutes , stirring occasionally
11. While sauce simmers , bring a large pot of water to a boil with remaining tablespoon of olive oil
12. Add pasta and cook until just tender
13. For rigatoni , allow 10 to 12 minutes
14. Drain pasta and serve topped with puttanesca sauce
15. Pass the parmesan

title: mojito cupcakes  also can be margarita cupcakes
steps:
1. Cupcakes
2. Mix together all ingredients for cupcake batter in an electric mixer
3. Use a ice cream scoop to add batter into paper lined muffin tin
4. Bake at 350f per box direction for cupcakes
5. Frosting
6. Blend together softened cream cheese and butter until smooth
7. Gradually add in lime juice and rum
8. Add lime zest then add powdered sugar , 1 / 2 cup at a time until smooth
9. Refrigerate
10. Frost cupcakes right before serving
11. Refrigerate any leftovers
12. If you choose to make margarita cupcakes substitute rum for tequila and mojito mix for margarita mix -- enjoy !

title: rogene s blizzard party mix
steps:
1. Spray a 13x9 inch baking pan with nonstick cooking spray
2. Combine cereal , pretzels , peanuts and caramels in a large bowl
3. Microwave morsels over med-high heat for 1 minute
4. Microwave additional 10-20 second intervals , stirring until smooth
5. Pour over cereal mixture , stir to coat evenly
6. Spread the mixture into a prepared baking pan or on waxed paper
7. Let stand for 20-30 min or until firm
8. Break into bite size pieces

title: chicken roasted with artichokes and tomatoes  w m
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. In 13 x 9-inch roasting pan , toss tomatoes , artichokes , garlic , vinegar and 1 tbsp butter
3. Set aside
4. In small bowl , blend remaining 1 tbsp butter with oregano and pepper
5. Evenly spread on tops of chicken breasts then arrange chicken on tomato mixture
6. Roast 25 minutes or until chicken is thoroughly cooked

title: nutty carrots
steps:
1. Steam carrots until tender but still firm
2. Grate carrots
3. Mix all ingredients
4. Reheat by sauting in clarified butter

title: basil shrimp
steps:
1. Melt 1 / 2 stick butter in medium size bowl
2. Add olive oil
3. Squeeze lemon juice into mix
4. Add grey poupon mustard , add minced fresh basil
5. Add minced cloves of garlic , add salt and pepper
6. Whip mixture and marinate cleaned shrimp for 1 hour
7. Place marinated shrimp on skewers and bbq until shrimp is pink and done

title: best cookie bars
steps:
1. Mix butter , flour and sugar until crumbly
2. Pat into a 9 x 13 pan and bake for 10 minutes at\375
3. Mix graham crackers , baking powder , chocolate chips , nuts and condensed milk and spread over crust
4. Bake for 25 minutes at 325
5. Mix butter , powdered sugar and vanilla and frost when cool

title: yankee pot roast
steps:
1. Heat large dutch oven , about 6-7 quarts , and brown the salt pork
2. Remove the pork from the pan , leaving the fat in the pan
3. Salt and pepper the chuck roast and brown it in the fat
4. Brown it well on both sides , turning it with a wooden fork or spatula so you do not puncture the meat
5. When brown , add 2 cups water to the pot and then the bay leaf , garlic , thyme and parsley
6. Cover and simmer slowly for 2 hours , keeping about 1 cup of water in the bttom of the pot
7. Add the carrots , onions and turnip
8. Cover and cook for 1 / 2 hour
9. Watch that there is always a cup of water in the bottom of the pot
10. Add the potatoes and cook until they are tender
11. Watch that water !
12. Prepare a roux of the flour and butter by melting the butter in a small frying pan and stirring in the flour
13. Cook for a few minutes
14. Remove the meat and vegetables from the pan and place on a serving platter
15. Thicken the gravy with the roux
16. Use as much or as little roux as you like
17. The thickness of the gravy is up to you
18. Correct the seasoning in the gravy and serve the pot roast
19. You may wish to darken the gravy with some kitchen bouquet

title: chili cheese cubes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Grease a 13- x 9- x 2-inch baking dish
3. In a large mixer bowl , beat eggs with electric mixer until light -- 4 to 5 minutes
4. Stir together flour , baking powder and salt
5. Add to eggs and mix well
6. Fold in the cheeses and chilies
7. Turn into prepared baking dish
8. Bake in preheated oven for 40 minutes
9. Remove from oven
10. Let stand 10 minutes
11. Cut into small squares
12. Serve hot as appetizers
13. Leftovers are good cold , also
14. Serve as a snack or as part of a luncheon dish

title: garlic schnitzel
steps:
1. Place unpounded pork cutlets in casserole pan , trying to not overlap meat
2. Use a garlic press to evenly distribute garlic over each piece of meat , and pour enough milk over the top to cover the meat and garlic
3. Let it sit in your refrigerator for at least an hour , or overnight for best flavor
4. Remove meat carefully , trying to keep garlic pieces on top , and put them into plastic wrap or storage bag to pound garlic into the pork with the flat side of a meat tenderizer
5. When removing the pounded pork , sprinkle both sides with salt or seasoned salt , and put onto a large plate
6. Prepare the breading step by tearing 2 square sheets of aluminum foil for the flour and breadcrumbs , and froth 2-3 eggs in large , flat bowl
7. Add some salt to the egg mixture
8. In an assembly line style , place aluminum foil square of flour , then the bowl of mixed eggs , and finally the bread crumbs
9. Have a large plate or cookie sheet ready to place the breaded meat
10. Dip the pounded , salted pork into the flour , then into egg , and using a fork , lift out of the egg mixture and let excess egg drip off , and place into breadcrumbs
11. The foil is good to use , so that you can lift the sides to shake on the breadcrumbs without using your fingers
12. Throw away the leftover flour and breadcrumbs with the foil
13. Heat oil in deep frying pan , making sure the oil is at least 1 inch thick in pan
14. Oil is ready when you drop a bread crumb into it , and it fizzes up to the top
15. Fry the meat on each side until golden brown and place onto plate lined with paper towels
16. For the special "tarter sauce , " mix equal amounts of mayonaise and sour cream , and squirt some mustard into it
17. You can add salt and pepper to taste , too
18. This is a great dip for the garlic schnitzel
19. Enjoy !

title: fettuccine con carciofi
steps:
1. Fill large bowl with cold water
2. Squeeze juice from lemon halves into water
3. Add lemon halves
4. Working with 1 artichoke at a time , cut off stem from artichoke
5. Using small knife , peel stem , then slice into 1 / 4-inch-thick rounds
6. Drop stem slices into lemon water
7. Pull off leaves from artichoke and discard
8. Using spoon , scoop out choke
9. Thinly slice artichoke bottom
10. Drop artichoke slices into lemon water
11. Repeat with remaining artichokes
12. Heat oil in heavy large skillet over medium heat
13. Add garlic
14. Saut 1 minute
15. Drain artichoke pieces
16. Add to skillet
17. Saut until artichokes are soft and beginning to turn golden , about 20 minutes
18. Add wine
19. Reduce heat to medium-low , cover , and simmer 3 minutes
20. Stir in 1 1 / 2 tablespoons parsley
21. Simmer 1 minute
22. Discard garlic
23. Season sauce with salt and pepper
24. Meanwhile , cook pasta in large pot of boiling salted water until just tender but still firm to bite , stirring occasionally
25. Drain pasta , reserving 1 cup pasta cooking liquid
26. Return pasta to pot
27. Add artichoke sauce and half of cheese and toss to blend , adding some of reserved pasta cooking liquid if dry
28. Season to taste with salt and pepper
29. Transfer to bowl
30. Sprinkle with remaining cheese and 1 1 / 2 tablespoons parsley and serve

title: everybody loves  em peanut butter cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. In a large mixing bowl , cream 1 stick of butter , 1 / 2 cup peanut butter , 1 / 2 cup packed brown sugar , and 1 / 4 sugar until well blended
3. Beat in the egg , milk , and vanilla
4. In a separate bowl , combine the flour , baking powder , and salt
5. Gradually add the dry ingredients to the creamed mixture
6. Drop a teaspoonful of dough per cookie onto an ungreased cookie sheet
7. Bake for 9-11 minutes or until edges are golden brown
8. Cool on cookie shee and then transfer to cooling rack
9. Mix 1 stick of melted butter and 3 / 4 cup of peanut butter together
10. Mix in powdered sugar until the mixture is thick enough to be spreadable
11. After cookies have cooled , spread the icing on them
12. Store in an air tight container
13. Enjoy !

title: gazpacho couscous salad
steps:
1. Add salt , olive oil , and 2 cups water to a saucepan
2. Place pan over high heat
3. Bring to a boil
4. Add in couscous
5. Stir to mix
6. Cover saucepan and remove from stove burner
7. Let sit for 5 minutes
8. Combine chopped tomato and cucumber , parsley and / or mint , salsa , and lemon juice in a small bowl
9. When couscous is ready , transfer to a large mixing bowl
10. Fluff with a fork
11. Add the tomato / cucumber mixture
12. Toss to combine
13. Adjust seasonings to taste with salt / pepper or whatever you fancy
14. Serve immediately or chill and serve later

title: pork roast with ginger peach glaze
steps:
1. Combine season salt and thyme , rub on all sides of roast
2. Grill over indirect heat or bakes 1 1 / 2 hours at 350 or until done
3. Combine preserves , worcestershire sauce , ginger
4. Coat pork roast with preserves mixture during the last 10 minutes of cooking

title: mexican stuffed shells
steps:
1. Brown ground beef and drain
2. Add seasoning , water , onion , and 1 / 2 cup of salsa and 1 / 4 cup cheese
3. Mix together remaining salsa , tomato sauce , and chili powder
4. Spread a thin layer of sauce on the bottom of a 9 x 12 baking pan
5. Fill each shell with the ground beef mixture and place in pan
6. Pour remaining sauce on top
7. Sprinkle on the rest of the cheese on top and garnish with green onion
8. Cover and freeze at this point
9. Defrost overnight and bake at 350f for 30 minutes
10. If desired sprinkle additional cheese on top after baking and return to oven for 5 minutes longer or until cheese melts

title: chicken chorizo stuffed sopaipillas
steps:
1. Combine flour , salt and baking powder in medium bowl
2. Stir in water , milk and 1 1 / 2 teaspoons oil until a ball of dough forms
3. Knead dough on a lightly floured surface 3 minutes
4. Cover and let rest 15 minutes
5. Divide sopaipilla dough into four portions
6. Roll each into a 6 to 7-inch circle
7. Heat 1 / 4 cup oil to 375f degrees in a deep fryer or deep skillet
8. Fry each circle , one at a time , 2 to 3 minutes on each side or until golden brown
9. Drain on paper towels
10. Combine chicken , chili powder , cinnamon , oregano , thyme , cloves , salt and vinegar in medium bowl
11. Mix well
12. Set aside
13. Boil diced potato in lightly salted water until tender
14. Drain , set aside
15. Heat 2 tablespoons oil in medium skillet over medium-high heat
16. Add ground chicken mixture
17. Saut , stirring frequently to break up pieces , until almost cooked through
18. Add boiled diced potato , diced onion and remaining 1 tablespoon oil
19. Continue to saut until potatoes begin to brown
20. Cut a slit on one side of each sopaipilla
21. Fill with 1 / 4 of the chicken mixture
22. Sprinkle tops with additional cheese
23. Serve with prepared salsa verde

title: blueberry and flax milkshake
steps: 1. Combine ingredients in a blender and serve cold

title: another weird pb sandwich
steps: 1. Make a sandwich

title: chipotle chicken enchilada chowder
steps:
1. In a large soup pot , add olive oil , onion , celery , and garlic
2. Saute about 2 minutes
3. Add chicken broth to pot , and stir
4. In a bowl whisk masa harina and 2 cups of water , and mix until well blended
5. Add masa mixture to the soup pot
6. Add remaining cup of water , enchilada sauce , cheese , spices , green onions , green chiles and the chipotle chile , and bring to a boil
7. Simmer for 20 minutes
8. Add cooked shredded chicken and potatoes to pot and simmer for 20 more minutes , or until potatoes are tender
9. Add cilantro and ladle into bowls
10. Dollop with sour cream , if desired

title: lemony s ugly but awesome spinach smoothie
steps:
1. Peel and slice fruit
2. Blend in blender until reasonably smooth
3. If you find the granny smith and spinach are too tart add some maple syrup or sweetener to taste
4. A golden delicious apple can be substituted for the granny smith
5. I used spinach but arugula or kale would also work
6. The amount is approximate

title: heathers miso salad dressing
steps:
1. Whisk together or blend in blender to emulsify
2. One serving is 2t

title: olive and sun dried tomato tapenade with endive leaves
steps:
1. In the bowl of a food processor , add the olives , sun-dried tomatoes and the olive oil it was packed inches pulse until smooth , but still chunky
2. Add more extra-virgin olive oil if mixture is too dry
3. Spoon into a serving bowl
4. If not serving immediately , cover tightly with plastic wrap and refrigerate up to 2 days
5. Be sure to bring it to room temperature and to mix it thoroughly before serving
6. Gently pull off the leaves from the endive , being careful not to tear the leaves
7. Wash thoroughly with cold water and dry completely
8. Place the bowl of tapenade in the center of a large platter
9. Decoratively circle the tapenade bowl with the endive leaves working your way to the rim of the platter

title: adult orange splash
steps:
1. Pour all ingredients over ice in a shaker or large glass
2. Shake vigorously
3. Rim a glass with sugar and serve on the rocks
4. Garnish with and orange slice

title: creamy peach salad
steps:
1. Dissolve gelatin in boiling water
2. Add cold water
3. Chill until slightly thickened
4. Blend yogurt into whipped topping
5. Then blend in gelatin
6. Stir in peaches and nuts
7. Pour into 8x4 inch loaf pan
8. Chill until firm , about 3 hours
9. Garnish with additional peach slices , if desired

title: yum o stewed beef in smoky mustard sauce
steps:
1. Remove all fat , gristle and silverskin from roast
2. Slice into 3 / 4 inch 'steaks'
3. Cut each steak into 3 / 4 inch strips , then cube strips into bite sized pieces
4. In a separate bowl , combine marinade ingredients , mix well with whisk
5. Add meat to marinade mixture , making sure all meat has been covered by liquid
6. Cover bowl with plastic wrap , pressing wrap to touch the marinaded meat
7. Refrigerate overnight
8. Place meat mixture in slow cooker on low for minimum of 5 hours
9. Test one piece after then to see if doneness is to your liking
10. Pour off sauce into separate pot and place on stove to boil , adding 3 tbsp thickening agent
11. Adjust to desired consistency
12. Serve with rice or pasta
13. Don't forget your veggies !

title: french style hot chocolate
steps:
1. Melt chocolate in 1 cup of milk , over low heat , stirring constantly
2. Gradually add remaining milk and half and half , followed by remaining ingredients , except vanilla and almond extract
3. Cook over medium heat , stirring constantly , until completely heated
4. Stir in vanilla and almond extract
5. Serve with whipped cream and sprinkle with nutmeg if desired

title: cabbage beef bake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Lightly grease / spray a deep 13 x 9 baking dish
3. Place shredded cabbage in bottom of baking dish
4. Set aside
5. Brown and crumble ground beef with the onion and red bell pepper
6. Drain and return to the skillet
7. To the drained beef mixture , add the diced tomatoes , salt , pepper , sugar and caraway seeds
8. Stir together well and spread this mixture over the cabbage in the baking dish
9. In a small bowl , stir together the tomato sauce and sour cream , blending well
10. Spread this mixture over the beef mixture in the baking dish
11. Cover and bake for 1 hour
12. Uncover , evenly sprinkle with the 1 cup of shredded swiss cheese and bake for an additional 15-20 minutes

title: fettuccine with asparagus  bacon  and browned bread crumbs
steps:
1. In large skillet , over medium heat , cook the bacon until crisp and brown , about 3-5 minutes
2. With slotted spoon , scoop browned bacon to paper towels to drain
3. Reserve drippings , wipe skillet clean add oil to skillet and heat 1 minute over medium heat
4. Dump in bread crumbs and pine nuts and cook , stirring until lightly browned , about 3 minutes
5. Transfer crumb mix to paper towels and wipe the skillet clean again
6. Add reserved bacon drippings to skillet and heat
7. Add garlic , parsley , and pepper and cook , stirring just until garlic turns golden , about 2 minutes
8. Add broth mixture and cook , stirring until mix thickens and no raw flour taste is found , about 5 minutes
9. Take skillet off heat cook fettuccine adding asparagus to the cooking water in the last 3 minutes before pasta is done drain well and dump into skillet mixture
10. Add cheese , reserved crumb mixture , and bacon and toss well
11. Serve with additional grated parmesan on top

title: skinny butter chicken
steps:
1. In the microwave , add double the water to the rice and cook it for 18 minutes uncovered
2. Melt butter and fry crushed garlic in the pan
3. Add the chopped chicken breast and brown for about 3 minutes , occasionally stir
4. Add the packet of butter chicken spices and the tomato puree , then lastly add the reduced fat cream and stir all together
5. Heat for about 10 minutes , while the rice cooks then serve atop the rice with sprigs of coriander

title: applesauce raisin cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f , grease cookie sheets
2. Cream butter with sugar and egg
3. Stir in everything else
4. Drop spoonfulls onto the cookie sheets with room for them to expand
5. Bake 12 min or until light brown

title: cheddar vegetable stuffed shells
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f
2. Cook shells according to package directions
3. Drain , rinse in cold water , dry on paper towel
4. Place shells in a 9in square baking pan
5. In a small bowl , stir together veggies and cheese
6. Stuff each shell with 1 / 4 cup of mixture
7. In a small bowl stir together melted butter and dill weed , brush over shells
8. Cover , bake for 20-25 mins or until heated through

title: potato crust vegetable pizza
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425f
2. Finely shred potatoes and onion into a bowl of water
3. Drain well , squeezing out excess moisture
4. In a large bowl , combine potatoes mixture , eggs , flour and salt
5. Mix well
6. Press into a well greased 15 x 10 x 1 baking pan
7. Bake for 15 minutes
8. Brush with 1 tablespoon of the olive oil
9. Bake 10 minutes more
10. Place under broiler for 2-3 minutes or until golden and crisp
11. Meanwhile , in a large bowl , combine zucchini , squash , pepper , red onion and garlic
12. In a large skillet , heat the remaining oil
13. Cook the veggies about 2 cups at a time until crisp tender
14. Spread goat cheese over golden potato crust
15. Top with cooked veggies and tomatoes
16. Sprinkle with fresh basil and mozzarella
17. Bake for 5-7 minutes or until cheese is melted

title: kfc potato wedges
steps:
1. Preheat shortening to 375f
2. Cut the potatoes into 16 to 18 equal size wedges
3. Mix the egg and milk till well blended in a big bowl
4. Mix the dry ingredients into a large bowl
5. Put some potatoes in the milk and egg then into the flour mixture till well coated
6. Fry in fryer for 3 minutes , remove from the oil and allow them to sit for one minute and then cook them again for 5 minutes or until cooked
7. It may take up to 6 minutes

title: quick and easy chicken vegetable soup
steps:
1. Pour cream of chicken soup , chicken broth , and frozen vegetable in a pot , heat just to boiling , stirring occasionally
2. Add chicken and chicken bouillon , keep stirring until bouillon is completely dissolved and chicken heated
3. Reduce heat and simmer uncovered for 5 more minutes
4. Serve and enjoy !

title: lamb chili with mushrooms  rick bayless
steps:
1. Roast the unpeeled garlic on an ungreased griddle or heavy skillet over medium heat , turning occasionally , until soft and blackened in spots , about 15 minutes
2. Cool and peel
3. While the garlic is roasting , stem and seed the chiles
4. Toast the chiles on another side of the griddle or skillet , 1 or 2 at a time , opening them out flat and pressing them down firmly with a spatula
5. In a few seconds , when they crackle , flip them and press down to toast the other side
6. In a small bowl , cover the chiles with hot water , and let them rehydrate for 30 minutes , stirring frequently to insure even soaking
7. Drain
8. In a food processor or blender , combine the chiles and a 1 / 2 cup of water , along with the garlic , oregano , black pepper and cumin
9. Blend to a smooth puree , scraping down and stirring frequently
10. With a rubber spatula , press the chile mixture through a medium-mesh strainer into a bowl
11. Heat the oil in a 4-quart pot over medium-high heat
12. When hot , add the lamb and brown thoroughly , about 8 minutes
13. Add the chile puree and stir for about 5 minutes as the mixture thickens
14. Stir in beef broth and simmer until lamb is tender , about 2 hours
15. Add mushrooms , epazote , hot sauce and masa harina
16. Partially cover and simmer gently over medium-low , stirring frequently , until mushrooms are soft and the sauce has reduced to coat the meat rather thickly , about 30 minutes
17. Taste and season with salt

title: tortellini basil soup
steps:
1. Bring broth to a boil
2. Add tortellini
3. Cook 6 minutes or until tender
4. Stir in beans and tomatoes
5. Reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes or until thoroughly heated
6. Remove from heat
7. Stir in basil , vinegar , and salt
8. Immediately before serving , sprinkle with cheese and pepper

title: curry tuna fish sandwiches
steps:
1. Toast the bread
2. Mix the first seven ingredients
3. Lay lettuce leaves down on each slice of bread
4. Spoon the tuna mixture and top with the tomato and top bread slice
5. Serves 2 generous sandwiches
6. Also , the tuna can be mixed the night before for cool , refreshing sandwiches

title: oreo crunch bars
steps:
1. Coarsely chop 8 cookies
2. Set aside
3. Finely crush remaining 26 cookies
4. Mix finely crushed cookies and butter in bowl
5. Press firmly in bottom of greased 8x8x2 inch or 9x9-inch baking pan
6. Place marshmallow creme over crust to within 1 / 2 inch of edges
7. Sprinkle chocolate chips , nuts and chopped cookies over marshmallow layer , pressing gently
8. Bake at 350 for 15 to 18 minutes or until marshmallow creme puffs slightly
9. Cool completely in pan on wire rack
10. Cut into triangles or squares to serve

title: sweet   spicy chai tea
steps:
1. Stirring constantly , lightly toast the anise , nutmeg , cinnamon , coriander , cardamom , black pepper , cloves , and allspice in a skillet over medium high heat
2. Take extra care not to burn the spices
3. You just want them to become fragrant
4. Let the spices cool slightly and coarsely grind in a spice mill
5. Split the vanilla bean and scrape out the seeds
6. Reserve the seeds for another use
7. Peel the ginger and cut into thin slices
8. Bring the water to a boil
9. Add the ground spices , orange zest , vanilla bean , and ginger
10. Reduce heat , cover , and simmer for 15 minutes
11. Add the tea bags and steep for 5 minutes
12. Remove the tea bags and strain the liquid
13. While still warm , add the honey and stir well to dissolve
14. Suggested serving is 2 parts chai to 1 part milk , water , or your favorite milk alternative
15. Serve hot or cold
16. The chai liquid can be stored in the refrigerator and used at your leisure
17. Makes approximately 12 12-ounce servings of tea

title: blini
steps:
1. Sift dry ingredients into a medium sized bowl
2. Gradually whisk in the egg , buttermilk and melted butter
3. Cook in batches , drop 2 teaspoon portions of butter into a non-stick heated frying pan
4. Cook the first side , turn and cook until browned on both sides
5. Place on wire racks to cool
6. Top with your favourite toppings- creme fraiche and salmon roe / caviar , creme fraiche mixed with some dill then topped with smoked salmon

title: stuffed cornish game hens with cranberry glaze
steps:
1. Prepare the glaze: combine cranberries and wine in saucepan , bring to a boil , reduce heat and simmer 5 minutes
2. Stir in honey and continue to simmer 2 minutes
3. Strain glaze , stir in oil and set aside
4. Prepare the game hens and stuffing: melt butter in saucepan over medium heat , add onion , celery and cranberries
5. Saute for 3 minutes
6. Add sauteed mixture to the french bread cubes
7. Let cool
8. Stir in chicken broth , parsley , sage , thyme , 1 / 4 tsp
9. Salt and 1 / 8 tsp
10. Pepper
11. Stuff game hens with the stuffing and tie drumsticks together with kitchen string
12. Place hens in a roasting pan
13. Brush some of glaze over each game hen and sprinkle with a little salt and pepper
14. Place in a preheated 450 degree oven for 20 minutes
15. Reduce heat to 350 degrees and continue roasting for 45 minutes longer
16. Baste hens with glaze and sprinkle with salt and pepper twice more during the cooking time
17. Remove hens from oven and let rest 5 minutes
18. Cut strings and serve

title: grilled cheese sandwiches with spicy grapefruit salad
steps:
1. In a medium bowl , combine the grapefruit and all but 2 tablespoons of the juice , the scallions , jalapeno and 2 tablespoons olive oil
2. Season with salt and pepper
3. Preheat an outdoor grill or a grill pan to medium-high
4. In a medium bowl , toss the fennel with 1 tablespoon of the olive oil and the remaining 2 tablespoons of grapefruit juice
5. Season with salt and pepper
6. Arrange the bread slices on a work surface
7. Top each with a slice of cheese , one-quarter of the fennel , one-quarter of the arugula and a second slice of cheese
8. Cover with the remaining bread slices
9. Brush one side of the sandwiches with olive oil
10. Place oil side down on the grill
11. Brush the tops with olive oil
12. Grill , turning once , until the cheese is melted and grill marks appear , about 7 minutes
13. Serve with the spicy grapefruit salad

title: super easy eggplant parmesan
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Peel eggplant and slice thin
3. Layer eggplant and other ingredients if desired
4. Cover with foil and back 45 minutes
5. Take the foil off for the last 5 minutes of baking
6. Enjoy !

title: church supper chops
steps:
1. Mix the flour , salt and pepper
2. Dredge chops in it
3. Brown chops in the oil in a skillet
4. When browned , remove chops to a platter and drain fat
5. Stir soup water and milk into skillet , mixing well
6. Put chops back in
7. Cover
8. Reduce heat to low and simmer 45 minutes
9. If gravy is too thin , stir in a teaspoon full of leftover flour and cook a bit

title: bite sized brownies
steps:
1. Melt sugar , butter , and chocolate until just melted
2. Cool 1 minute
3. Blend in vanilla and egg
4. Gradually fold in flour
5. Pour mixture into greased mini muffin tins lined with or without paper liners
6. Bake at 350 degrees for 10- 12 minutes
7. While still warm , place one chocolate on each
8. You could also use those chocolate advent calender pieces for the chocolates

title: meatball pasta bake
steps:
1. Set the oven to 350f
2. Cook the pasta in boiling water for 10 mins until just tender but still with a little bite
3. Mix together the beef , egg , oregano , 1oz of the breadcrumbs and season well with salt and pepper
4. Mix well and shape into about 20 meatballs
5. Heat the oil in a large frying pan and fry the meatballs for about 10 mins , turning occasionally until browned
6. Add the red pepper , pasta sauce and the beef broth or red wine
7. Bring to the boil
8. Stir the drained pasta into the meatballs and pour into a large baking dish
9. Sprinkle with the breadcrumbs , mozzarella and thyme and bake until golden and bubbling
10. Serve with a large green salad and crusty bread

title: elswet s baked potato soup   diabetic version
steps:
1. In a large pot , brown your bacon , drain the grease , crumble , and set aside
2. Over medium heat , melt the margarine substitute and add in the flour , whisking thoroughly
3. Slowly stir in milk and stir constantly until sauce thickens
4. Add in potatoes and onions , stir to mix well
5. Bring to a boil , stirring often to avoid scorching of the milk
6. Reduce heat , cover , and simmer 15 minutes
7. Mix in your crumbled bacon , cheese , sour cream , instant potato flakes , and salt and pepper
8. Cook until cheese melts , stirring often
9. Serve hot , topped with fresh unmelted shredded cheese , and a small sprinkling of chopped green onions

title: sweet potato   idaho fries
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375
2. Peel potatoes and slice thick fries
3. Blot slices dry with paper towels
4. Toss slices with the olive oil , rosemary and salt
5. Roast fries on a baking sheet with sides
6. Stir occasionally until cooked through and browned lightly , 30-35 minutes

title: banana nut chocolate chip scones
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400
2. In large mixing bowl , combine flour , sugar , baking powder& soda& salt
3. Cut in butter with a pastry blender until mixture resembles coarse meal , & set aside , in medium bowl , mix buttermilk , vanilla extract , egg whites& the banana
4. Add to dry mixture just until combined , blend in the chocolate chips
5. Place dough on lightly floured surface , & knead lightly
6. Spray large cookie sheet with cooking spray
7. Pat dough into a 9-inch circle on the cookie sheet
8. Sprinkle the nuts& brown sugar over dough , and gently press into dough
9. Cut dough into 12 slices
10. Bake 20 minutes

title: collucci bros  meatloaf recipe
steps:
1. Preheat oven at 375 degrees f
2. In a medium-sized saute pan , put 2 dribbles of salad oil and heat over medium-high heat
3. Add the carrots , celery , and onions and saute , about 5 minutes
4. Put aside and let cool
5. In large bowl put the carrot mixture , ground beef and remaining ingredients , except for the bread , the bread crumbs and ketchup
6. Soak the bread in cold water , then squeeze water out and drain it
7. Add to the ground beef and mix
8. Add the bread crumbs and mix
9. Roll into firm loaf , spread ketchup over the top , and place into preheated oven for approximately 45 to 55 minutes , or until cooked through
10. Take out and serve hot , perhaps with gravy

title: deep fried calamari  simple
steps:
1. Dredge calamari rings in corn starch and shake off excess
2. The rings may be prepared in advance up to this point , and refrigerated
3. Heat oil to fairly high heat
4. Deep fry rings about 1 minute or until golden
5. Drain on paper towels , and sprinkle lightly with salt
6. Serve with lemon wedges and garlic mayo or marinara sauce for dipping

title: staffordshire oatcake
