steps:
1. Place the porridge oats in a food processor and process just until fine
2. Mix the ground oatmeal , wholemealflour and plain flour together in a bowl with the salt , sugar , and quick yeast
3. Warm the milk and water together until you can hold your finger in it for 10 seconds without going "ow ! " - then it should be warm enough but not hot enough to kill the yeast
4. Mix the warm , milky water in with the dry ingredients and whisk
5. Leave to rise and plump in bowl for 40minutes
6. Heat a nonstick frying pan over medium heat
7. Whisk the batter a little then pour about 3 / 4cup of the batter into the hot pan , swirling it around
8. Do not try to spread the batter with anything
9. You'll just end up with a mess
10. If it's funny-shaped , that's how it will be
11. Cook until edges become dry , the underside of the oatcake is golden brown and the oatcake on top looks mostly dry and solidified all the way to the centre
12. Flip and cook until golden brown on the other side
13. Place oatcake on rack to cool
14. When they're completely cold you can stack them
15. Repeat with remaining batter
16. They should keep well for a day or two in the fridge or a few months in the freezer
17. When freezing , place waxed paper or plastic wrap between each oatcake for easier separation later
18. Usually to fill them , you reheat or toast them until warm under a grill on both sides then add your cheese , etc , and put back under the grill until the cheese has melted

title: spaghetti squash with mushrooms and herbs
steps:
1. Wrap the squash half in microwave-safe plastic wrap and microwave it , cut side up , at high power for 10 to 12 minutes , or until it feels soft when pressed
2. Let the squash stand for 5 minutes
3. In a small microwave-safe dish combine the butter , the onion , and the mushroom and microwave the mixture at high power , stirring once , for 5 minutes , or until the mushrooms are tender
4. Discard the squash seeds , scrape the flesh with a fork into a bowl , and toss it with the mushroom mixture , the parsley , the chives , the parmesan , and salt and pepper to taste

title: tasty snack ball things  vegan
steps:
1. Mix together all the ingredients
2. Roll into small balls and then roll the balls in the extra wheat germ

title: stuffed ground turkey burgers
steps:
1. Mix first 8 ingredients in a bowl
2. Form into 4 balls
3. Press 1 / 4 of the goat cheese into center of each ball and enclose
4. Then press into patties
5. Pour olive oil into non-stick skillet and preheat on medium to medium / low heat
6. Fry burgers , covered , till done
7. Never cook poultry to anything less than done
8. Serve on kaiser rolls with your favorite condiments

title: salad taverna
steps:
1. In large bowl combine oil , lemon juice , garlic , tabasco sauce , anise seed and salt
2. Mix well
3. Add noodles , cheese , tomatoes , olives , parsley and pine nuts
4. Toss to coat evenly
5. Cover
6. Refrigerate at least 1 hour
7. Serve with additional tabasco sauce if desired

title: raw broccoli salad  reduced calorie low fat
steps:
1. Discard broccoli stems and finely chop florets or broccolini
2. Set aside
3. In a medium mixing bowl , whisk the splenda , vinegar and mayonnaise toghether until it is an even , smooth consistency
4. Stir in the broccoli and remaining ingredients
5. Toss until coated
6. Chill until ready to serve

title: goat cheese   pear tarts
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400f
2. Grease well a mini muffin tin
3. Roll 1 sheet of puff pastry to a 20 x 20 inch square with a rolling pin
4. Cut into 2 x 2 inch squares
5. Press into tins
6. Chop the pears finely with the skins on
7. Stir pears , sugar and cinnamon together
8. Spoon approximately 1 / 2 tablespoon of goat cheese into the bottom of each tart
9. Add approximately 1 tablespoon of pear mixture on top
10. Bake for 25 minutes until edges of pastry are golden brown
11. Let cool 10 minutes in tins while you pour the wine

title: summery green gazpacho
steps:
1. Rinse cucumber and cut off ends
2. Cut into rounds and then into cubes , and put into food processor
3. Add the cold chicken broth / stock , and whizz at medium speed
4. Add parsley , onion , yoghurt salt , tabasco , oil and lemon juice
5. Whizz at high speed until soup is smoothly processed
6. It won't be , and shouldn't be , velvet smooth
7. Pour into , preferably , a glass bowl , cover , and chill
8. It's best to make this a day ahead
9. Taste before serving , and adjust seasoning

title: chicken parmesan meatballs  low carb
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees fahrenheit
2. Spray a large baking sheet with cooking spray
3. Mix ground chicken , egg , breadcrumbs , parmesan cheese , 3 tablespoons pizza sauce , spices , & cheese in a bowl
4. Shape into 24 small meatballs , about the size of a ping pong ball
5. Place meatballs onto the prepared baking sheet
6. Bake for 20-25 minutes
7. Serve with pizza sauce for dipping

title: spicy chicken stew
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large pot , saut onions for 2 minutes
2. Add garlic and stir in cinnamon , ginger , curry powder and cumin
3. Cook and stir for 2 minutes
4. Add chicken pieces and cook until all sides are lightly brown
5. Add can tomatoes , chicken broth , sugar , cauliflower , potatoes , green beans , chickpeas and salt and pepper to taste
6. Bring to a boil and then simmer covered on medium-low heat for at least 30 minutes or until vegetables are tender

title: winter vegetable chowder
steps:
1. Cut off roots and trim dark-green tops from leeks
2. Discard any tough outer leaves
3. Cut each leek lengthwise in half then crosswise into 1 / 2"-wide slices
4. Rinse leeks in large bowl of cold water
5. Swish to remove sand
6. With hands , transfer rinsed leeks to colander , leavving sand in bottom of bowl
7. Repeat rinsing and draining sereral times , until all sand is removed
8. Drain well
9. In a 6 qt saucepot , heat olive oil on medium-high heat until hot
10. Add leeks , celery , and parsnips , and cook 10 to 12 minutes , or until all vegetables are tender , stirring occasionally
11. Add potatoes , squash , broth , water , thyme , salt and pepper
12. Heat to boiling over medium-high heat
13. Cover saucepan , then reduce heat to medium-low and simmer for about 10 minutes or until the vegetables are tender
14. Stir in half and half and hat through , about 13 minutes
15. Spoon into tureen and garnish with the sprig

title: outback bloomin  onion sauce
steps:
1. Mix ingredients together in bowl until well blended
2. Refrigerate

title: celebrity walnut loaf
steps:
1. Toast the bread slices either in the toaster or on a baking sheet placed under the broiler
2. Let cool
3. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f
4. Generously butter a 9 by 5-inch loaf pan , then line the bottom with waxed paper and butter the paper
5. Tear up the toasted bread slices and make crumbs out of them in a food processor
6. Place in a large bowl
7. Process the walnuts until finely ground and mix into the bread crumbs
8. Combine the eggs and onions in the processor and process until fine but not liquefied
9. Stir into the bread crumbs
10. Place the green pepper , celery , parsley , tomatoes , and oil in the processor and grind until fine but still with some texture
11. Stir into the loaf mixture along with the poultry seasoning , salt , and pepper
12. Mix this all very well until evenly moistened
13. Scrape it into the prepared loaf pan and smooth over the top
14. Cover the loaf with foil
15. Bake 1 hour and 20 minutes , or until a knife inserted in the center of the loaf comes out dry
16. Let sit 5 minutes , then run a knife all along the sides of the loaf to help loosen it
17. Unmold the loaf onto a platter and remove the waxed paper
18. Let the loaf cool 20 minutes or so before slicing it
19. It's best to serve the loaf warm and the gravy hot
20. Mushroom gravy: melt the butter in a medium-size saucepan over medium heat
21. Add the mushrooms and saute until brown , about 7 minutes
22. Stir in the flour
23. It will become very pasty
24. Cook this roux for 2 minutes , stirring constantly
25. It will stick to the bottom of the pan a little bit
26. That's okay
27. Stir in the stock , wine , soy sauce , and pepper , and bring to a boil
28. Cook the sauce at a bubbling simmer for 5 minutes , stirring almost constantly and scraping any crusty bits that stick to the bottom of the pan
29. Serve in a pretty gravyboat

title: bill s secret teriyaki marinade
steps: 1. Mix ingredients well and combine with food

title: simple free gluten free rice waffles
steps:
1. Cook rice according to package directions
2. Place all ingredients in a food proceesor until smooth , stopping to scrape down the sides
3. Bake in a preheated , oiled waffle iron until golden brown

title: magic mayonnaise
steps:
1. In small mixer bowl , combine all ingredients
2. Beat
3. Until mixture thickens , about 2 minutes
4. Chill to blend flavors
5. Store leftovers in a clean jar

title: smoked salmon appetizers
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 375 degrees
2. Cut 2 inch rounds from pasty sheets
3. Place in greased muffin tins
4. Top dough rounds with flaked salmon
5. Mix cream cheese , chives and lemon juice until creamy
6. Place cream cheese mixture into small ziplock baggie and snip off the end of one corner
7. Pipe the cream cheese mixture onto the salmon by squeezing it through the hole in the baggie
8. Use about 1 tablespoon of cream cheese per dough / salmon
9. Bake for 15-18 minutes
10. Serve warm

title: spicy surprise chocolate chip cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. In mixing bowl , combine butter , brown sugar , white sugar , eggs and vanilla
3. Beat until smooth and light
4. In a separate bowl , sift together flour , baking powder , baking soda , salt , cinnamon , ginger , and cayenne pepper
5. Gradually mix into wet ingredients
6. Beat until just combined
7. Fold in chocolate chips until combined
8. Scoop cookies into 2-inch balls and place on cookie sheets
9. Bake until lightly golden , about 10 minutes
10. Let cool slightly , then remove from cookie sheets and transfer to a wire rack to cool completely

title: cheese stuffed manicotti  uncooked shells
steps:
1. Sauce: heat olive oil in a large saucepan
2. Saute onion and garlic in oil until onion is transparent
3. Add cut up tomatoes , tomato sauce , sugar , and basil
4. Simmer about 20 minutes
5. Filling: mix ricotta , mozzarella , parmesan , parsley , sugar , and egg together
6. Assemble: fill uncooked manicotti shells with cheese mixture
7. Place in a lightly greased 9 x 13-inch baking dish
8. Cover completely with sauce
9. Cover and bake at 400f for about 1 1 / 4 hours or until pasta is tender
10. Uncover and sprinkle with some parmesan cheese and bake 15 minutes longer
11. Let sit about 15 minutes before serving

title: my favorite carrot soup
steps:
1. Heat oil in a large soup pot over medium heat
2. Saute onions with ginger , cumin , and cayenne until onions are soft , 7 to 10 minutes
3. Add the garlic when you think there is about 45 secs to 1 minute left to achieve the soft onions [do not let the garlic burn]
4. Add salt , carrots , potatoes , and broth and bring to a boil
5. Reduce heat to low
6. Simmer until vegetables are tender , about 25 minutes
7. Add the peanut butter
8. Puree the soup
9. This is most easily done with a hand-blender right in the pot
10. Stir in orange juice
11. Ladle in bowls and garnish if desired
12. This soup freezes very well in tupperware
13. I'm sure it will freeze well for many months , however i don't know for sure because mine has never stayed frozen for longer than a month due to being eaten !

title: baked potatoes from the crock pot
steps:
1. Stab potatoes with fork
2. Wrap each in foil
3. Fill crock pot with potatoes
4. Cover and cook on high 2 1 / 2- 4 hours
5. Do not add water
6. Cooking time depends on how big your potatoes are
7. Use your best judgement
8. It doesn't hurt to cook them for the 4 hours
9. For large potatoes , i have cooked five to six on low for 8 to 10 hours and they turn out perfectly

title: simple beef stew
steps:
1. Coat meat with flour
2. Sear on all sides in oil
3. Put onions in pan and brown them
4. Put seared meat , browned onions , and all other ingredients in a large pot along with enough water just to cover
5. Simmer slowly on low heat at least 2 hours
6. The longer this stew cooks , the better it is

title: smoked gouda chorizo jalapeno poppers
steps:
1. Special equipment: parchment paper
2. Preheat oven to 375 degrees f
3. Brown chorizo in a skillet over medium-high heat , about 8 to 10 minutes
4. Drain and place into a large mixing bowl
5. Add the cheese , red onion , egg , cream cheese , sour cream , hot sauce , and salt and pepper , to taste
6. Press into jalapeno halves and assemble on a parchment lined baking sheet
7. Bake until golden and bubbly , about 20 minutes

title: chocolate coconut macaroons
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325 degrees f and line two baking sheets with parchment paper
2. In a stainless steel bowl , over a saucepan of simmering water , melt the chocolate
3. Set aside
4. Meanwhile , in a large bowl , whisk together the egg whites , cocoa powder , sugar , salt , and vanilla extract
5. Stir in the coconut and melted chocolate , making sure the coconut is well coated
6. If the mixture is too soft , refrigerate for about 30 minutes
7. Place small mounds of the dough on the parchment-lined baking sheet , spacing several inches apart
8. Bake for about 15 or until the macaroons are shiny
9. Remove from oven and let cool on the baking sheet for about 10 minutes and then place on a wire rack to cool

title: chinese style turkey meatballs
steps:
1. Heat the oven to 400 degrees
2. To make the meatballs: gently mix together the meatball ingredients , then form meatballs by rolling tablespoon-sized scoops between your palms
3. Arrange on a lightly oiled or parchment-lined cookie sheet and bake for 20-25 minutes , until well-browned and cooked through
4. Serve with toothpicks for dipping
5. To make the dipping sauce: in a small pot , stir all the sauce ingredients together over medium-low heat until the sugar dissolves
6. Simmer 3 or so minutes , stirring frequently , until the sauce thickens a bit
7. Fish out the ginger and serve in small cups for dipping

title: kandy kakes from scratch
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Mix eggs until nice and yellow then continue mixing in the the remaining cake ingredients
3. Pour into a 15 x 2 pan and bake for about 15 minutes or until tests done
4. Immediately after removing from oven spread the 1 1 / 3 cup of peanut butter over hot cake
5. Put aside and let cool
6. If i'm in a hurry i put it in the fridge to speed things up
7. When cake is cool but not cold melt the tablespoon of peanut butter along with the milk chocolate in the microwave , about 1 - 1
8. 5 minutes
9. Spread over cake and cool completely before cutting

title: bakesale betty s fried chicken sandwich
steps:
1. Season chicken breasts with kosher salt
2. Let sit at least 5 minutes
3. Fill a wide , shallow nonreactive bowl or casserole dish with buttermilk
4. Add the chicken and soak in the refrigerator for 1 hour up to overnight
5. For the vinaigrette: combine mustard , vinegar and salt in a bowl
6. Slowly whisk in olive oil until well blended
7. For the coleslaw: macerate onions in the cup of red wine vinegar , and let sit at least 20 minutes
8. Remove onions and discard vinegar
9. Toss onions with jalapeno , parsley , cabbage and salt
10. Toss with vinaigrette until evenly coated
11. To fry chicken: pour vegetable oil into a large stockpot
12. Do not fill up more than halfway , or the oil could splatter
13. Bring oil up to 365 , using a digital thermometer / candy thermometer to monitor the heat
14. Prepare the the breading while waiting for oil to heat up
15. In a wide shallow bowl , mix flour , cayenne , salt and pepper
16. Pull a chicken breast out of the buttermilk one by one , letting excess drip off , and dredge completely in flour
17. To create a thick crust , place in buttermilk and dredge in flour a second time
18. Do not drain or shake off excess buttermilk or flour during the breading process
19. When the oil is at 365 , carefully place chicken pieces into oil one by one
20. Let it cook for a minute before disturbing chicken , then help it swim in the oil with tongs , until it is evenly cooked , about 5-7 minutes
21. Remove chicken from oil and drain on paper towels
22. Season immediately with salt
23. For the sandwich: place fried chicken breast on bottom of torpedo roll and top generously with coleslaw
24. Per serving: 995 calories , 52 g protein , 63 g carbohydrate , 58 g fat , 95 mg cholesterol , 1 , 497 mg sodium , 6 g fiber

title: crock pot beef roast my version
steps:
1. Heat oil in large dutch , over high heat
2. Mix spices together
3. Pierce roast in several places with a knife and rub spice mixture over roast
4. Sear roast on all sides 2 to 3 minutes till nicely browned
5. Place small layer of onion slices in bottom of crock pot
6. Put roast on top of onions and surrond and cover roast with remaining vegetables
7. Put broth in dutch oven , bring to a boil and scrape up any browned bits from bottom of pan
8. Pour broth over roast and vegetables cover crock and cook on low 6 to 8 hours
9. At end of cooking time , remove roast to serving plate along with vegetables
10. Allow to sit for about 10 mins before slicing
11. For wonderful beef onion gravy
12. Remove about 2 cups of juice from bottom of crockpot and put in a small sauce pan
13. Add cornstarch to water till dissolved add to juice in pan
14. Bring to a slow boil on the top of stove stirring constanly for about 5 mins or till desired thickness
15. Serve with potatoes and roast

title: avocado  orange and jicama salad
steps:
1. Peel jicama and julienne by cutting into 1 / 4 inch thick slices , then stack and cut into 1 / 4 inch strips
2. Chop strips onto 2 inch sticks , place in a medium bowl
3. Remove peel and pith from oranges and cut into sections
4. Add sections and juice into bowl with jicama
5. Squeeze remaining juice from orange membranes into separate small bowl , add jelly and blend
6. Pour jelly / juice over jicama and orange sections
7. Cut avocado into 1 / 2 inch dice , chop cilantro and red onion to your preferred size
8. Toss with jicama and oranges and let stand 10 minutes or chill for 30 before serving
9. May be served over greens

title: beef jerky
steps:
1. Remove all fat from the meat
2. Wrap meat in plastic wrap and freeze until almost solid
3. This is important--makes it easier to cut thin , even slices
4. Remove from freezer and cut with the grain into neat 1 / 8-inch thick slices
5. Arrange in a shallow dish
6. Mix remaining ingredients in a saucepan and bring to a boil
7. Cool and pour over sliced meat
8. Marinate overnight in the refrigerator , stirring once or twice
9. Line oven bottom with foil
10. Preheat oven to 250
11. Pat meat dry with paper towels
12. Arrange in a single layer on a roasting rack and place in preheated oven
13. Immediately reduce heat to 150 and allow to dry slowly for 8 hours or so
14. Store in an airtight container in the refrigerator
15. Finished jerky should be stiff but still bendable
16. Meats need to be dried at 145 or above to kill microorganisms

title: bratwurst casserole
steps:
1. Cook brats and drain and cut into chunks
2. Mix together with the remaining ingredients
3. Place in buttered casserole
4. Cover and bake at 350 for 45 minutes

title: greek peach and grilled green pepper salad
steps:
1. Heat a nonstick skillet over medium high heat , not smoking
2. Add cumin seeds and toast until they begin to dance , about 1 minute
3. Turn off heat and give the seeds a quick press with the back of a wooden spoon
4. The object here is to help them release flavor , not to actually crush them
5. Whisk the seeds together with the other dressing ingredients and set aside
6. Quarter the bell peppers , removing the seeds and pith
7. Grill for 8 to 10 minutes until the skins are a bit charred and loose from the green flesh
8. Remove peppers from grill and place in a plastic resealable bag and close
9. Once the peppers are cool , slip off the skins and cut the peppers into thick strips
10. Halve and pit the peaches
11. Slice the peaches into eighths
12. If your peaches are smallish , consider sixths
13. Slice the olives in half
14. Dice the feta cheese into small cubes
15. Combine peppers , peaches , feta and olives in a large bowl
16. Give dressing a final whisk and pour over the salad
17. Chill for 1 hour before serving

title: crock pot lemon oregano  greek  chicken
steps:
1. Add chicken stock to crock pot
2. Wash the chicken and add to crock pot
3. Add lemon juice to chicken , save the skins
4. Rub spices all over chicken and inside
5. Add lemon skins to chicken cavity
6. Cook on high 4-6 hours low 6-8

title: white chocolate mousse torte
steps:
1. Line the base of a 23cm round spring form tin with greaseproof paper
2. Melt the butter and stir in the biscuit crumbs
3. Press into prepared tin and chill for 15 minutes
4. Break chocolate into small pieces and place in saucepan with half the cream
5. Heat very gently , stirring occasionally until almost smooth be careful not to overheat as it will solidify again
6. Pour into a bowl and cool for 15 mins or until just beginning to thicken
7. Stir occasionally
8. Whip the remainder of the cream until it forms soft peaks
9. Fold into the cool chocolate mixture
10. Pour over the biscuit base and chill for at least 3 hrs , preferably overnight
11. Sprinkle with icing sugar / cocoa powder , cut into squares and press a raspberry into the centre of each square

title: cathy s saucy meatballs
steps:
1. For meatballs: combine ground beef , cracker or bread crumbs , salt , milk , pepper and onions / herbs
2. Blend well
3. Make mixture into balls , and brown them on all sides
4. For sauce: simmer together ketchup , brown sugar , vinegar , water first quantity of water , until hot and sugar is dissolved
5. Thicken smoothly with cornstarch and second quantity of water
6. Add meatballs to sauce and simmer until meatballs are cooked through

title: pf changs crispy honey chicken  copycat
steps:
1. To make batter: mix ingredients till just combined
2. Let rest in refrigerator for a couple of hours
3. Coat chicken well with seasonings and marinate in the refrigerator for 20 minutes
4. Combine sauce ingredients , mix thoroughly and reserve for serving
5. Pour vegetable oil into fryer or heavy bottomed sauce pot
6. Heat slowly to 340-350 degrees
7. Put 1 / 4 of the marinated chicken in a clean bowl and pour enough better over to coat
8. Remove a few pieces at a time from the batter , using slotted spoon or large fork
9. Shake off excess batter
10. Carefully lower chicken into the hot oil
11. Suspend the chicken until the batter "sets , " 20-30 seconds
12. Chicken is done when golden to light brown and crisp
13. Remove to platter with paper towels to drain
14. Repeat for all the chicken
15. Remember to check the oil temperature , it must remain hot
16. To finish the sauce , heat it in sauce pan , bring to a boil
17. Mix cornstarch and water to make a slurry
18. Add cornstarch slurry , a little at a time
19. The sauce will thicken , let it come to a thickness of "loose honey
20. " let cook for a minute or two
21. Heat 2 more tablespoons of oil in a wok and add some minced garlic , red bell pepper and scallions and stir-fry briefly
22. Add 1 / 3 to 1 / 2 of the chicken and stir-fry briefly
23. Add enough sauce to just coat chicken
24. Stir-fry again briefly
25. Serve over noodles or rice

title: my turkey tortilla soup
steps:
1. Heat a large pot over medium heat , and lightly coat the bottom with cooking spray and add the olive oil
2. When the oil is hot add in the onions , garlic , chiles and turkey legs
3. Saute for about 5 minutes
4. Add in spices , diced tomatoes , tomato sauce , chicken broth , and worchesterchire sauce
5. Simmer over medium low heat for 30 minutes
6. Remove turkey legs and set aside to cool
7. Meanwhile add in frozen vegetable mix and let the soup continue to simmer over medium low heat for 5-10 minutes
8. Shred meat from the legs and add back into the pot , discarding bones
9. Serve using the following method:
10. Crush 4-6 tortila chips and place in the bottom of bowl
11. Top with a ladle or two of soup
12. Add about a quarter of an avocado , a spritz of lime , a dollop of sour cream , and a sprinkle of scallions and serve

title: lemon buttermik cupcakes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350
2. Line muffin tins with paper liners and set aside
3. In small bowl , whisk flour , baking powder , baking soda and salt
4. Set aside
5. In another small bowl , combine buttermilk , lemon zest and vanilla
6. Set aside
7. In a medium bowl , beat butter till light and fluffy , on high speed , beat in egg then egg yolk , lower speed to low , beat in flour mixture alternately with buttermilk mixture , just till blended
8. Spoon batter into prepared muffin tins
9. Bake till tops are golden and springy
10. About 20-22 minutes
11. Cool for 15 minutes in muffin tins on wire rack

title: easy new england clam chowder
steps:
1. In a 3 quart saucepan , brown bacon over medium heat
2. Add potato and onion and saute for about 7 minutes
3. Drain the minced clams and reserve the liquid
4. Add clam juice and reserved clam liquid to mixture in saucepan
5. Cover and simmer 15 minutes or until potato is tender
6. Stir in cream and clams and bring to a slow simmer
7. Do not boil
8. Serve with crackers

title: oatmeal peanut choconana cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. In a large bowl , cream together the butter , brown sugar and white sugar until light and fluffy
3. Add the eggs one at a time , beating well with eaceh addition , then stir in the vanilla , banana , and peanutbutter
4. Combine the flour , baking powder , baking soda and salt
5. Gradually stir into the creamed mixture
6. Stir in the rolled oats and chocolate chips
7. Drop by rounded spoonfuls on ungreased sheet
8. Bake for 12-14 minutes

title: easy crock pot rotisserie chicken
steps:
1. Crumple up 4-5 foil pieces into balls , or wrap potatoes in foil and place at bottom of crock pot
2. This will keep the chicken from sitting in it's juices and will make it roast not boil
3. Plus , if you do it w / potatoes , you just have to throw together a salad and you're done
4. Rinse chicken and pat dry w / paper towels
5. Sprinkle all over generously w / seasoned salt
6. Place on top of foil balls in crock pot or on the foil covered potatoes
7. Cover and cook on high , for 6 hours or until chicken is done

title: italian squash and zucchini casserole
steps:
1. In large skillet saute garlic and onions on medium heat in the dressing for 5 minutes
2. Add the seasonings and all the veggies except the tomatoes and saute another 5 minutes
3. Add cans of tomatoes undrained and bring to a boil
4. Reduce heat to low , cover and let simmer about 10 minutes or until vegetables are slightly tender
5. Pour into a glass casserole dish
6. Sprinkle with cheese
7. Crush saltines by hand over top of the casserole
8. Bake at 350 for 30 minutes

title: grannys holiday punch
steps:
1. Bring 1 qt of cold water to full roling boil
2. Remove from heat
3. Add tea all at once
4. Brew 4 minutes
5. Remove bags , and put brewed tea in punch bowl
6. Add sugar and stir until disolved
7. Cool to room temperature
8. Add juices and water
9. Refrigerate
10. When ready to serve , add ginger ale and block of ice
11. Garnish with lemon , and orange slices
12. Add cherries
13. Makes 50 servings

title: aggression cookies
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Mix all ingredients together like you would a pie crust
3. Then you can beat it , pound it , mix it like play-dough
4. When your aggression is gone , make 1 inch balls of dough
5. Place on ungreased cookie sheet 2 inches apart
6. Then flatten just slightly
7. Bake at 350 for 10 minutes
8. You have just turned you aggression into wonderful cookies

title: cajun rubbed pork chops
steps:
1. Combine spices , mix well
2. Rub mixture thoroughly onto both sides of each chop
3. Pan fry in oil , cooking both sides , until done

title: muftis   muesli balls
steps:
1. Combine all dry ingredients with the honey
2. Mix in the milk - but slowly
3. The required amount may be a little more or less than 1 1 / 2 cups to get a sticky dough
4. Let the dough rest 30 minutes , then preheat oven to 390 degrees and form walnut size balls
5. If the dough is too sticky to form balls , add some more ground hazelnuts
6. Bake for about 20-25 minutes until balls are golden brown

title: barb s unstuffed cabbage
steps:
1. Brown meat and onions in a dutch oven
2. Add tomatoes , cabbage , and 1 1 / 2 cups water
3. Cook covered on medium high heat for 20 minutes
4. Stir occasionally
5. Add packages of rice and 3 cups of water to pot
6. Cook uncovered for 10 minutes
7. Stir frequently

title: county fair chicken
steps:
1. Combine parmesan cheese , flour , paprika , salt , and pepper
2. Mix egg and milk
3. Dip chicken in egg mixture , then coat with cheese mixture
4. Place in 11 3 / 4 x 7 1 / 2 inch baking dish
5. Pour butter over chicken
6. Bake at 350 degrees for 1 hour

title: tsr version of claim jumper meatloaf by todd wilbur
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. Over medium heat , saut the green onion , garlic , green pepper , and carrot in vegetable oil until wilted
3. Combine beaten eggs with milk , salt , black pepper , garlic powder , and onion powder in a medium bowl
4. Mix bread crumbs and flour into ground chuck and ground pork with your hands
5. Add egg and milk mixture , sauted veggies , 1 / 4 cup ketchup and mix it up using your hands
6. Press the mixture into a large loaf pan
7. Bake for 30 minutes , then spread 1 / 4 cup of ketchup over the top of the meatloaf and bake it for another hour
8. Let it stand for 10 minutes after coming out of the oven

title: prawn and bacon fried rice
steps:
1. Spray a hot non-stick wok with oil spray
2. Pour in eggs
3. Swirl to cover the base of the wok and cook until set
4. Remove from the wok
5. Roll up and slice
6. Set aside
7. Spray the wok again and add bacon , stir-frying for 4 to 5 minutes until golden
8. Add the green onions , garlic and snow peas and stir-fry a further 2 to 3 minutes
9. Add the prawns to the wok along with the rice , egg , and soy sauce
10. Stir-fry for 2-3 minutes or until hot
11. Serve immediately

title: how to bake cakes in cans  aka tin can cakes
steps:
1. You'll need 2 cans and a good can opener
2. I like to use the cans that are left from pie filling
3. They are kinda wide and i find them easier to work with
4. They must be cleaned and free of dents
5. The important thing is to open the cans cleanly with no jagged edges which will tear the cakes when removing them and cut your hands
6. The second important thing is to grease and flour the can very well and line the bottom with a little circle of greased parchment paper
7. You can use the standard butter or shortening and flour but i prefer to spray them with baker's joy
8. It's just so much simpler
9. I make the recipes right in a 4 cup measuring cup and then simply pour / scrape the batter into the center of the cans
10. If you don't have one of those , drop the batter off of a serving spoon into the center of the can
11. Try to smooth the tops a little with a narrow rubber spatula
12. Tap the cans on the counter gently to remove air pockets
13. Bake according to your recipe
14. Test for doneness using a long thin skewer
15. After you bake the cake according to the recipe , let it cool on a rack for 10 minutes just like usual then run a thin knife around the edge of the cake and pop it out
16. Cool completely on the rack
17. If the cake gets totally stuck , cut the bottom of the can off with your can opener and push the cake gently up out of the can
18. Gently remove the can bottom from the cake with a thin knife
19. Once the cake is cool , carefully slice it in half horizontally to make your 2 layers
20. Fill and frost according to your recipe
21. Be very careful during this whole process not to cut yourself on the rims of the cans and supervise children when they're handling the cans
22. Replace the cans after 2 or 3 uses or when you see any rusting or discoloration

title: elena s linguine carbonara
steps:
1. In a small , stainless pan , heat oil and butter over medium heat
2. Add bacon and cool till brown , but not crisp - about 4 minutes
3. Add garlic , wine , and pepper
4. Simmer until wine is reduced - about 3 minutes
5. Remove from heat
6. In large bowl , whisk together eggs , cheese , and salt
7. In large pot of boiling water , cook pasta until just done
8. Drain pasta and add it to egg mixture immediately
9. The pasta will cook the eggs - toss quickly
10. Pour the bacon mixture over linguine
11. Toss with fresh parsley and serve immediately

title: fresh fruit cheese danish
steps:
1. Place the pastry sheets on work surface
2. Cut each sheet into fourths
3. Have 2 baking sheets lined with parchment or silpat ready
4. In a bowl , beat the cream cheese , half & half , egg , powdered sugar , and lemon zest
5. Divide the mixture among the 8 squares of pastry , placing the cheese in the center of each square
6. Top each with a tablespoon of fruit choice
7. Cut a small slit in the corners of each pastry square , then fold the pastry over the cheese so that the center is exposed
8. Sprinkle with sliced almonds
9. Bake in a 425 oven for 20 minutes or until golden
10. Remove from oven , sprinkle with powdered sugar , cool slightly before serving
11. The
12. Preparation time is an estimate
13. Enjoy !

title: nutty rice salad
steps:
1. Salad: in a small saucepan , bring water and rice to a boil
2. Reduce heat to low
3. Cover and cook 20 minutes or until done
4. Meanwhile , cut asparagus into 1 / 2" sections and blanch
5. Chop red pepper , green onion , peanuts and parsley
6. Zest and section orange
7. Mix all ingredients together including orange zest , but not orange slices
8. Refrigerate
9. Dressing: whisk ingredients together and spoon over servings of rice salad as desired
10. Serve with orange sections
11. Time to make includes prep and cook times

title: abc snack
steps:
1. Mix all the ingredients together in a large bowl
2. Store in airtight container
3. Yield is aprox

title: grannydragon s tomato aspic with pineapple sauce
steps:
1. In a large bowl , dissolve the jell-o in the boiling water , stirring for 2 minutes
2. Add the tomatoes , onion , tomato puree , and tomato juice
3. Mix well
4. Pour the mixture into a lightly greased 1-quart mold or 8-inch square glass dish
5. Refrigerate , covered , overnight
6. To remove from the mold , briefly dip it inot a bowl of hot water and un-mold onto a chilled plate
7. Briefly means about 10 seconds
8. If the aspic doesn't come out of the mold the first time , dip it again for 5 seconds
9. Have patience !
10. To make the sauce: in a small bowl , whisk together the lemon juice , mayonnaise , and pineapple juice
11. Add canned crushed pineapple and stir lightly with a fork
12. Serve at sauce at room temperature with the chilled aspic
13. Time quoted does not include chill setting time

title: bonbon cookies
steps:
1. Cream butter , 10x sugar , and vanilla
2. Add flour and salt
3. Shape dough into a round
4. If desired wrap dough around a nut , a raisin , a dried fruit piece , or an m & m
5. Bake at 350 degrees for 12 minutes
6. When slightly cooled , dip 1 / 2 cookie in colored 10x sugar made into a paste with a few drops and milk and choice of food coloring --
7. Now dip in the flaked coconut and marvel at their beauty !
8. Yield: about 30 cookies

title: double potato and halloumi bake
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 400 degrees f
2. Cut the sweet potato into rough 1-1 / 2-inch cubes and the red potato slightly smaller as the sweet potato will cook more quickly
3. Halve the red onion , then cut each half into 4 to 6 segments , discarding any tough outer skin
4. Seed the peppers and cut into 1-inch squares , and separate the cloves of garlic
5. Put everything into a 2- quart ovenproof casserole or whatever you want to use and , using your hands , give the vegetables a good coating of olive oil
6. Season with black pepper , but no salt as the cheese will make it salty
7. Cook for 45 minutes , by which time the vegetables should be cooked through and here and there tinged with brown
8. You'll need to turn the oven up to maximum or light the broiler for the endgame: so place the thinly sliced cheese on top of the bake , and put it back in the very hot oven or under the broiler until the cheese has melted and turned slightly brown on top , about 5 to 10 minutes
9. Serve straight out of the roasting pan

title: cape codder
steps:
1. Mix in highball or old fashioned glass with ice
2. Enjoy who you are with

title: boston baked beans pressure cooker
steps:
1. Do not pre-soak beans
2. Add beans and all other ingredients to pot
3. Do not fill pressure cooker over one half full
4. Close cover securely
5. Place pressure regulator on vent pipe and cook 45 minutes at 15 pounds pressure
6. Let pressure drop of its own accord

title: raspberry  rhubarb crunch
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 325f
2. Combine flour , oats , brown sugar , cinnamon and salt in large bowl
3. Cut in butter until crumbly
4. Reserve 1 1 / 4 cups for topping
5. Press remaining crumbs into ungreased 9-inch square pan
6. Drain raspberries , reserving syrup
7. Set raspberries aside
8. Add enough water to syrup to make 1 cup
9. Place mixture in small saucepan
10. Combine 1 / 2 cup sugar and cornstarch and add to syrup mixture in pan
11. Cook over medium heat , stirring constantly , until thickened and bubbly
12. Remove from heat and set aside
13. Top oat mixture in pan with reserved raspberries and rhubarb
14. Pour cooked syrup mixture over fruit and sprinkle with reserved topping
15. Bake for 1 hour or until golden brown
16. Cool in pan on rack
17. Cut into squares and serve with whipped cream or ice cream

title: jam   coconut filled muffins
steps:
1. Heat oven to 400
2. Sift together flour and baking powder
3. Stir in sugar and coconut
4. Beat the egg , vanilla extract , milk and oil together
5. Add the dry mix to the wet mixture
6. Mix just until combined
7. Drop a large tablespoon of batter into each tin
8. Add a teaspoon of jam to each and the rest of the batter
9. Sprinkle the tops with a little bit of coconut
10. Bake 25-30 minutes or until well risen and firm to the touch

title: super easy super tasty meatloaf
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
2. In a large mixing bowl , combine meat , bread crumbs , onion , ketchup , eggs , and onion soup mix
3. Use your hands to squish all of the ingredients together until all of the ingredients are well combined
4. Form the meat mixture into two "loaves
5. " at this point , i usually wrap one of the loaves in press and seal freezer wrap and toss it in the freezer
6. However , if you have a larger family , you'll probably want to cook both
7. Put the two loaves in a 13x9 baking pan and bake for 45 minutes
8. While the loaves are baking , mix up the sauce by stirring the ketchup , the brown sugar , and the mustard together until smooth
9. Set aside
10. After 45 minutes , take the meat loaves out and spread the sauce over the tops
11. Placed the sauced loaves back in the oven and bake for another 15 minutes or until cooked through
12. Let the meat loaves cool for 5 - 10 minutes before cutting them
13. Enjoy !

title: fresh raspberry sorbet
steps:
1. Combine berries with sugar and citrus juice , crushing them lightly with the back of a spoon
2. Let rest at least 30 minutes , or until the berries release their juice
3. Transfer berries and juice to a food processor and blend until smooth
4. Strain puree , if desired , then chill until cold
5. Freeze puree in an ice cream maker according to manufacturer's directions
6. When frozen , transfer to a freezer container , press a piece of wax paper to top , and freeze until firm , at least 3 hours

title: thai stir fried chile beef
steps:
1. Slice beef thinly into 1"x2" pieces
2. In a bowl , combine ginger , sugar , soy sauce and garlic
3. Add beef
4. Allow meat to marinate at room temperature for 30 minutes , or refrigerated , for up to several hours
5. In a wok , heat the oil
6. Drain beef , reserving marinade
7. Stir-fry beef over high heat until browned
8. Add corn , green peppers , mushroom , onion , and thai chilies , stir-frying for 1 minute
9. Add marinade and beef stock
10. Reduce heat to medium and cook for 3 minutes or until vegetables are crisp-tender
11. Meanwhile , stir the cornstarch mixture , oyster , and fish sauces together in a small bowl
12. Stir them into the stir-fry , blending them in well , until mixture thickens
13. Serve stir-fry with hot steamed rice

title: caramel oranges
steps:
1. Cut peel and white pith from oranges
2. Cut into rounds
3. Overlap on plates
4. Cook all remaining ingredients in heavy small saucepan over medium heat until mixture is syrupy , stirring frequently , about 3 minutes
5. Remove cinnamon stick
6. Drizzle caramel sauce over oranges and serve

title: burritos    simple  plain  easy
steps:
1. Place tortilla on microwavable plate
2. Spread refried beans across one end
3. Add onions , olives , and salsa
4. Grate cheese on other half of tortilla
5. Microwave 66 seconds on high
6. Top with sour cream
7. Fold up , and eat

title: parmesan breadstick candy canes
steps:
1. Unroll breadstick dough
2. Cut each strip in half lengthwise to make 16 breadsticks
3. Dip each breadstick in butter , then cheese
4. Twist slightly , shape into candy cane
5. Bake on ungreased baking sheet 14-18 min at 350 or until golden

title: fannie farmer s scalloped potatoes
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Butter a 1 1 / 2 quart casserole
3. Cover the bottom of the casserole with a single layer of potatoes& onion
4. Sprinkle generously with salt , pepper , flour and a few dots of butter
5. Repeat until all of the potato slices & onion are used
6. Pour milk over the potato slices until the top is almost covered
7. Dot with the remaining butter
8. Bake for 1 hour or until the potatoes are soft

title: pad thai
steps:
1. Mix together sauce ingredients and set aside
2. Prepare noodles according to package directions , leaving slightly al dente
3. Scramble eggs and cook completely in large skillet or wok
4. Remove eggs from pan and set aside
5. Add oil to pan
6. After heated , add minced garlic , carrots and mushrooms , cook approximately 2-3 minutes
7. Add sauce mixture to pan , stir to combine
8. Add green onion , eggs , chicken , shrimp , and peanuts to pan
9. Cook and stir about 2 minutes , until heated through
10. Add noodles and bean sprouts to pan
11. Cook approximately 2 minutes more
12. Serve with lime wedges to squeeze over the entree
13. Add crushed red pepper , if desired

title: bordeaux wine sauce for steak
steps:
1. Heat 1 tablespoon butter in a skillet over medium high heat
2. Add shallots and cook about 30 seconds while stirring
3. Add wine and cook until reduced by about 1 / 2
4. Add brown gravy and cook about 2 minutes
5. Season with salt and pepper to taste
6. Swirl in remaining tablespoon butter and serve

title: pumpkin cobbler
steps:
1. Melt the butter and pour into a 9 x 11 inch baking pan
2. In a medium size mixing bowl , mix ingredients for the crust together and pour slowly and evely over the melted butter
3. Beat all ingredients for the filling together in another bowl and pour slowly and evenly over the batter
4. Bake at 350 degrees for 1 1 / 4 hours

title: crabapple preserves
steps:
1. Wash and remove blossom end
2. Leave stems on
3. Do not peel !
4. Make syrup with sugar and water
5. Bring to boil
6. Boil for 5 minutes
7. Add apples to syrup
8. Boil until apples are tender and transparent
9. Fill hot jars with fruit and syrup to 1 / 2 inch of top
10. Put on canning lids
11. Process in hot water bath for 15 minutes

title: applesauce  date cake
steps:
1. Heat oven to 350f
2. Spray a 13 x 9-inch baking pan with nonstick cooking spray
3. In a small bowl , combine flour , rolled oats , baking soda , cinnamon , salt and cloves
4. Set aside
5. In a large bowl , combine sugar and butter
6. Beat until light and fluffy
7. Add vanilla and egg
8. Beat well
9. Add flour mixture alternately with applesauce , beating after each addition
10. Stir in dates
11. Spread batter into prepared pan
12. Bake 30 to 40 minutes or until a toothpick inserted in center comes out clean
13. Cool
14. Sprinmkle with powdered sugar just before serving

title: sausage egg mc muffin
steps:
1. Begin to toast the english muffin to liking
2. Put some butter in a pan , and put heat to medium
3. When melted , start the sausage patty
4. Once almost done , add egg and season with salt and pepper
5. When the english muffin is done , spread butter on both sides and place the slice of cheese on top of one piece
6. Place the muffin in the microwave until cheese is melted
7. Once the egg is finished , place it under the cheese
8. Finally , place the sausage under the egg
9. Enjoy - also adding another sausage patty and / or bacon is also good

title: olive garden cream of tomato and basil soup
steps:
1. Melt butter in a heavy sauce pan
2. Add red onions and saut until tender , about 5 minutes
3. Add white wine and reduce by 3 / 4
4. Add tomatoes and heavy cream , bring to a simmer and reduce by 1 / 2
5. Puree soup in a food processor
6. Stir in 2 tbsp chopped basil , salt and pepper
7. Garnish with remaining fresh basil and tomatoes and serve

title: grilled chicken and veggies with sauces by rachael ray
steps:
1. Preheat your grill pan or outdoor grill to high and the oven to 400f
2. Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil over high heat
3. While waiting for the water to boil , get the potatoes started: place the sliced potatoes on a baking sheet , season with 2 tablespoons grill seasoning and drizzle with the oil
4. Cook in the oven until golden brown and tender , about 35 minutes
5. While the potatoes are cooking , season the chicken breasts with the remaining 2 tablespoons of grill seasoning and drizzle with olive oil
6. Cook on the grill about 3-4 minutes per side , or until cooked through
7. Once the water has come up to a boil , drop the broccoli into the salted water and cook until tender
8. While the chicken and veggies are cooking , heat the butter in a medium-size skillet over medium-high heat
9. When the butter is melted , stir in the flour and cook for about a minute
10. Whisk in the chicken stock and milk , and cook until thick and bubbling , about 3 minutes
11. Pour half the sauce into a bowl and stir in the dijon and tarragon
12. Whisk the cheese into the other half of the sauce that is still in the pan then transfer into a serving bowl

title: smoked oyster spread
steps:
1. Roughly chop oysers and in a medium bowl mix with cream cheese , worcestershire sauce , hot sauce and lemon pepper
2. Chill at least one hour
3. Serve with sliced baguette or crackers

title: heavenly oatmeal bars jordan pond house
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. Grease a 13x9-inch baking pan
3. Beat butter and sugar in a large bowl with electric mixer until fluffy
4. Stir in corn syrup , oats and vanilla with wooden spoon
5. With buttered fingers , pat mixture evenly into prepared pan
6. Bake in middle of oven 16 minutes
7. Cool in pan on rack until lukewarm
8. Glaze: combine the semisweet chocolate chips and creamy peanut butter in a small saucepan
9. Stir over low heat until chocolate melts and mixture is smooth
10. Spread warm glaze over top
11. Cool completely before cuting into 2x1-inch bars

title: baked joghurt with figs in syrup  bhapa doi e gooler mishti
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 150c / 300f put 6 paper muffin cups into 6 small oven-proof dishes
2. Mix condensed milk , joghurt and cardamom with a whisk in a bowl
3. Fold in pistachios and roughly chopped raisins
4. Divide mixture into paper muffin cups
5. Set oven-proof dishes into a roasting tin filled with warm water up to the middle of the oven proof-dishes
6. Figs in syrup:
7. In the meantime heat 300ml water together with the sugar , the spices , the grated lemon rind and the lemon juice over low heat
8. When the sugar is dissolved , increase the temperature , so that the mixture simmers
9. Let simmer for 5 minutes
10. Divide each fig into four or six parts lengthwise and add them to the syrup
11. Simmer for 2 minutes and then remove pan from the heat immediately
12. Leave the figs to cool in the syrup
13. When the joghurt mixture in the oven is cooked through , remove individual dishes from water and let cool
14. To serve , turn out the baked yoghurt on individual plates and remove the paper cup
15. Place the fig parts on top or around the baked joghurt and pour a little bit of the syrup around the joghurt
16. Sprinkle with chopped pistachios

title: bow tie pasta salad with fontina and melon
steps:
1. Cook pasta according to package directions
2. Drain and rinse well
3. In a large bowl toss together pasta , melon , and cheese
4. Combine salad dressing and mint
5. Pour over pasta mixture and toss gently to coat
6. Serve immediately or cover and chill up to 24 hours
7. Add watercress to pasta mixture just prior to serving
8. For a pretty presentation , pasta salad may be served in melon shells :)

title: panic solutions  almond cookies
steps:
1. Spread crackers on baking sheet in single layer , then sprinkle with almonds
2. In pot , heat butter and sugar until it bubbles , then drizzle over crackers
3. Bake at 300 degrees for 15 minutes

title: belizean fu fu  mashed plantain
steps:
1. Plantains are ripe when the skin turns black and they are soft to the touch
2. Peel the plantain and cut in half
3. Put plantain in a pot covered with water and boil until soft
4. Drain water and mash in pot with a potato masher
5. Add butter and salt as to taste

title: copycat domino s cheesy bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven according to french bread package
2. Take dough out and flaten and stretch out a little bit to make a rectangle on a large cookie sheet
3. Melt butter in microwave and add garlic salt and garlic powder , brush over the top , flip and brush other side
4. Sprinkle corn meal on top and then flip over
5. Put all cheese on top over entire surface , sprinkle with 1 / 2 of parmesean , parsley , and remaining butter
6. Bake according to french bread package until cheese is melted and bubbly and bread is a light golden brown
7. Remove from oven and sprinkle with remaining parmesean cheese
8. Allow cheese to set for a minute or two
9. Cut widthwise into 1 inch slices , serve hot with warm marinara sauce

title: warm apple buttermilk custard pie
steps:
1. Fit pie crust into a 9-inch pie plate according to package directions
2. Fold edges under and crimp
3. Melt 1 / 4 cup butter in a large skillet over medium heat
4. Add apple slices , 1 / 2 cup sugar , and 1 / 2 tsp cinnamon
5. Cook , stirring occasionally , 3 to 5 minutes or until apple slices are tender
6. Set aside
7. Beat 1 / 4 cup butter and 1 1 / 3 cups sugar at medium speed with an electric mixer until creamy
8. Add eggs 1 at a time , beating just until yellow disappears
9. Add 2 tbsp flour and vanilla , beating until blended
10. Add buttermilk , beating until smooth
11. Spoon apple mixture into pie crust
12. Pour buttermilk mixture over apple mixture
13. Bake at 300 for 30 minutes
14. Stir together 3 tbsp butter , 1 / 4 cup sugar , brown sugar , 1 / 2 cup flour , and remaining 1 / 4 tsp cinnamon until crumbly
15. Sprinkle over pie
16. Bake 40 more minutes or until a knife inserted in center comes out clean
17. Let stand for 1 hour before serving

title: brie fresh herb and tomato omelette
steps:
1. Beat eggs , 2 teaspoons water , salt and pepper until frothy and light
2. Follow general directions for cooking an omelette
3. Lay out the herbs , tomato and cheese in that order over half of the omelette
4. Fold over omelette , add 1 teaspoon water to the pan to quicken melting process of cheese , cover and cook until just done

title: arroz con pollo  mccall s cooking school
steps:
1. Wash chicken pieces under cold running water
2. Drain well
3. Wipe dry with paper towels so fat won't spatter when chicken is browning
4. Combine oregano , pepper and 2 tsp salt
5. Sprinkle chicken all over with mixture
6. Rub in well
7. Let stand 10 minutes
8. In heavy , 6-quart round or oval dutch oven , heat olive oil over medium heat
9. Brown chicken a third at a time , until golden-brown all over , using tongs to turn chicken-this takes about 30 minutes in all
10. Remove chicken as it browns
11. Preheat oven to 350f
12. Wash green pepper
13. Cut into quarters
14. Remove ribs and seeds
15. Cut into lengthwise strips , 1 / 4 inch wide
16. To drippings in dutch oven , add onion , garlic , green pepper , bay leaf and red pepper
17. Saute , stirring , over medium heat until onion is tender-5 minutes
18. Using back of spoon , crush saffron threads on small piece of foil , or use a mortar and pestle
19. Add with 2 tsp salt and the rice to dutch oven
20. Cook , stirring , until rice is lightly browned-about 10 minutes
21. Add undrained tomatoes and chicken broth
22. Arrange browned chicken pieces over rice mixture
23. Bring just to boiling , uncovered
24. Bake in oven , tightly covered , 1 hour
25. Remove from oven
26. Add 1 / 2 cup water
27. Do not stir
28. Sprinkle peas and olives over top
29. Drain pimientos
30. Cut into 1 / 4-inch strips
31. Arrange pimiento strips attractively over top
32. Bake , covered , 20 minutes longer , or until chicken is tender , peas are cooked and rice has absorbed all liquid
33. Remove from oven
34. Let stand , covered , 10 minutes
35. Serve right from dutch oven
36. Serves 6

title: banana chocolate chunk bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350 degrees f
2. In a medium mixing bowl combine all ingredients except chocolate chunks on the low speed of an electric mixer
3. Stir in chocolate chunks by hand
4. Pour batter into a greased loaf pan
5. Sprinkle with a little sugar or cinnamon if desired
6. Bake for 1 hour , checking for 'doneness' at the 50 minute mark
7. Cook's

title: lemon mustard chicken
steps:
1. Skin chicken
2. Place chicken pieces , bone side up on unheated rack of a broiler pan
3. Broil 4-5 inches from the heat , about 20 minutes or until light brown
4. Meanwhile in a bowl stir together oil , mustard , lemon juice , lemon pepper seasoning , oregano and red pepper
5. Brush mustard mixture onto chicken
6. Turn chicken , brush with remaning mixture
7. Broil for 5-15 minutes more or until chicken is no longer pink

title: ali baba s oven fries
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 400 degrees f
2. Lightly oil a large baking pan
3. Mix the spices , oil and lemon juice together in a small bowl
4. Toss the potatoes with this mixture until evenly coated
5. Spread the potatoes onto the baking sheet and bake in the preheated oven for 30-35 minutes or until nicely browned and crispy , turning once halfway during cooking

title: sock em  seasoned corn
steps:
1. Preheat grill over medium-high heat
2. Peel back husk on corn and remove all the silk
3. Lay each ear of corn on individual pieces of foil
4. In a medium sized bowl , mix butter , cilantro and seasoning until well combined
5. Rub each ear of corn with butter mixture and pull leaves over to cover
6. Wrap corn with foil and grill for 20 minutes
7. If grilling , grill until slightly soft , about 10 to 15 minutes
8. Squeeze the lime over the corn , grill whole
9. Dip or brush with herb butter

title: old drover s inn stuffed eggs with hickory smoked salt
steps:
1. Scoop egg yolks into medium bowl and mash with fork
2. Add mayonnaise , vinegar , mustard , and curry powder and blend well
3. Spoon into pastry bag fitted with fluted or star
4. Pipe into reserved egg whites
5. Refrigerate for at least 2 hours
6. Just before serving , lightly sprinkle the eggs with hickory-smoked salt

title: chia hemp cereal
steps:
1. Chia seeds expand after sitting a few minutes in liquid
2. Mix all the ingredients up with two spoons to mash the honey and cashew butter in as much as you can
3. Wait 2 minutes and enjoy to your health !

title: succulent sour cream pot roast
steps:
1. Dredge pot-roast in flour
2. Brown all sides in cooking oil in dutch oven
3. Slip rack under meat
4. Sprinkle with salt and pepper
5. Add water , garlic , onion , tomato sauce , bay leaf and thyme
6. Cover and cook in slow oven 3 1 / 2 hours or until tender
7. Cook sliced mushrooms in butter in small frying-pan until tender and golden
8. When meat is tender , remove to cutting board
9. Remove bay leaf
10. Thicken cooking liquid with 2 t flour combined with 1 / 4 c water , if desired
11. Add mushrooms and sour cream to cooking liquid
12. Cook over moderate heat but do not allow to boil
13. Slice beef
14. Serve with hot buttered noodles sprinkled with paprika
15. Pass our cream sauce separately

title: ila s freckled pecans
steps:
1. Melt butter in skillet
2. Stir in seasonings
3. Add pecans and toss to cover well
4. Place in a single layer on a baking sheet and bake at 300 degrees f for about 20 minutes or until crisp

title: marinated baby mozzarella
steps:
1. Puree garlic and herbs with the oil
2. Add pepper , fennel seeds and lemon zest
3. Place cheese in a jar and pour over the marinade
4. Refrigerate overnight to allow flavours to infuse
5. To serve , bring cheese back to room temperature and serve with good bread , in a salad or part of an an

title: herbed rotisserie chicken
steps:
1. Pre-heat the oven to 450 degrees broil or top heat mode
2. Discard the innards of each chicken , rinse the cavity and dry thoroughly with paper towels
3. Combine the seasoning and olive oil , gently loosen the skin covering the breast , smear some of the mix over the meat and rub the remainder into the chicken skin
4. Squeeze some lemon juice into the cavity of each chicken and stuff the lemons inside
5. Tuck the wings under the legs and tie the legs together with a little dampened string
6. Thread the chickens onto the skewer and roast for 20 minutes , remember to add the drip pan to the oven
7. Lower the heat and continue cooking at 350 degrees for the remainder of the cooking time , approximately 50 minutes

title: homemade polenta squares with chunky tomato sauce
steps:
1. Bring milk , salt and cayenne to boil in larfe saucepan over med
2. High heat
3. While whisking milk , add cornmeal in a very thin but steady stream
4. Do not let lumps form
5. Reduce heat to low
6. Cook uncovered 50-60 minute until polenta is very thick , stirring frequently
7. It will be ready when you can stand a wooden spoon upright in middle of mixture
8. Meanwhile , melt butter over med
9. Heat
10. Add bell pepper , onion , and garlic
11. Cook 5 minutes or until tender
12. Remove with slotted spoon and set aside
13. When polenta is done , add bell pepper mixture and parmesan to saucepan
14. Stir to combine
15. Spray 13x9 pan with cooking spray
16. Spread polenta evenly into pan
17. Cover and let stand at room temp for 6hrs or until completely cooled and firm
18. Preheat oven to 350f
19. Cut polenta into 24 squares
20. Pour spaghetti sauce evenly over polenta
21. Bake 20 minutes or until bubbly around edges
22. Remove from oven and sprinkle with provolone
23. Bake 2-3 minutes longer to melt cheese
24. Let stand 5 minutes and loosen edges with spatula
25. Carefully lift out squares and serve

title: marshmallow sweet potato bake
steps:
1. Place sweet potatoes in a large saucepan , cover with water
2. Bring to a boil for 30-35 mins , or just until tender , drain
3. Cool slightly and peel in a large bowl , mash sweet potatoes , stir in butter , sugar and raisins place in a greased 2-qt baking dish
4. Sprinkle with nuts and marshmallows bake , uncovered at 350 degrees for 30 mins or until heated through , and marshmallows start to brown

title: chicken tetrazzini oamc
steps:
1. Cook spaghetti as directed until al dente
2. Drain
3. Saut onions in pam
4. Mix onions , peppers , soups , and milk together
5. Pour soup mixture over spaghetti and chicken in a large bowl
6. To eat now: pour in casserole dish and bake uncovered in a preheated 350 oven for about 30-40 minutes
7. For oamc put mixture in containers and freeze
8. To prepare for serving , thaw tetrazzini and put in a baking dish
9. Bake uncovered in a preheated 350 oven until bubbly , about 30-40 minutes

title: easy grilled cajun chicken
steps:
1. Combine the dry spices in a small bowl
2. In a shallow glass dish , or a gallon size zip lock bag , place the lemon juice and oil
3. Add half of the spice mix
4. Stir to combine
5. Add the chicken breasts , turning to coat both sides
6. Marinate for 30 to 60 minutes at room temperature or at least 2 hours to overnight in the refrigerator , covered
7. Drain the chicken and sprinkle both sides with the remaining seasoning mix
8. Place the breasts on a hot grill with the thin ends away from the flames
9. Cook , turning once , until just cooked through , 3 to 8 minutes per side , depending on the heat intensity and the thickness of the meat

title: grilled firecracker corn on the cob
steps:
1. Shuck the corn and trim the ends , then rinse off all of the silk strings
2. Lay each ear on a 12-inch square of foil and season with salt , chili powder , and cayenne
3. Cut each pat of butter into small pieces and scatter evely alongside the corn on the foil
4. Roll the foil tightly around the corn and crimp the ends shut
5. Place the corn packets over medium-high heat on the grill and roast for 12-15 minutes , turning 2 to 3 times durning cooking
6. As they cook , the ears will steam in the butter
7. Carefully unwrap the roasted ears and serve

title: filet mignon with red wine sauce
steps:
1. Whisk first 4 ingredients in a large bowl
2. Divide steaks between 2 glass baking dishes
3. Pour marinade over
4. Cover and refrigerate overnight
5. Remove steaks from marinade and pat dry
6. Transfer marinade to a large saucepan
7. Boil until reduced to 1 cup , about 20 minutes
8. Add stock and boil until reduced to 1 cups , about 20-25 minutes longer
9. Set aside
10. Divide oil between 2 large heavy skillets and place over high heat
11. Season steaks
12. Add 3 steaks to each skillet and brown on both sides
13. Reduce heat to medium-high and cook to desired doneness , about 4 minutes per side for medium-rare
14. Transfer steaks to warm plates
15. Tent with foil to keep warm
16. Add half of sauce to each skillet and bring to boil , scraping up any brown bits
17. Transfer contents of 1 skillet into the other and bring to slow simmer
18. Add butter , whisking in one piece until melted before adding the next
19. Spoon over steaks and serve

title: crimson pomegranate jelly
steps:
1. Score 1 fresh pomegranate and place in a bowl of water
2. Break open the pomegranate under water to free the arils
3. The arils will sink to the bottom of the bowl and the membrane will float to the top
4. Sieve and put the arils in a separate bowl
5. Reserve cup of the arils from fruit and set aside
6. Prepare fresh pomegranate juice
7. In a 6-quart saucepan or dutch oven , combine pomegranate juice , lemon juice and pectin
8. Over high heat , bring mixture to a boil
9. Stir in sugar all at once , then stir constantly
10. Heat mixture again until it comes to a full rolling boil
11. Boil 1 minute over medium-high heat
12. Remove from heat and skim foam from jelly with a spoon
13. Discard foam
14. Immediately ladle the jelly into clean jelly jars with lids or refrigerator containers with tight-fitting lids
15. Sprinkle reserved arils over the top of each container of jelly
16. Cover tightly
17. Let stand for 45 minutes to cool , then refrigerate for 1 hours
18. If not using immediately , refrigerate for up to 4 to 6 weeks or freeze for up to 1 year
19. For 2 cups of juice , cut 46 large pomegranates in half and juice them with a citrus reamer or juicer
20. Pour mixture through a cheesecloth-lined strainer or sieve
21. Set the juice aside

title: pollo maria  zia s on the hill  st  louis  mo
steps:
1. Marinate chicken in salad dressing for at least one hour at room temperature
2. Drain chicken
3. Discard marinade
4. Preheat oven to 350 degrees
5. Lightly coat chicken in seasoned bread crumbs
6. Arrange chicken in a baking dish
7. Bake until cooked through , about 30 minutes
8. In a small saucepan , melt butter over medium heat
9. Whisk in flour
10. Cook 3 to 4 minutes to make a roux
11. Set aside
12. In another pan , dissolve chicken base in 2 cups water
13. Stir in cream , pepper , and sage
14. Bring to a boil and add roux
15. Stir constantly until mixture returns to a boil and begins to thicken
16. Stir in 1 / 3 cup provel and remove from heat
17. Coat the bottom of a medium baking dish with sauce
18. Arrange cooked chicken on top of sauce
19. Top chicken with bacon , broccoli , and tomato
20. Pour remaining sauce over all
21. Sprinkle cheddar cheese and remaining provel cheese to cover
22. Return to oven and broil on high until cheese begins to melt and slightly brown , about 3 minutes
23. Buon appetito !

title: melissa s easy  cheesy  enchiladas
steps:
1. Brown ground beef
2. Drain
3. Add diced onion and continue cooking until onion is cooked through
4. Add 1 / 2 bag cheese
5. Add 1 cup salsa
6. Preheat oven to 350f
7. In a large baking pan , add half a cup of salsa to bottom of pan
8. Spread out evenly
9. Scoop generous portions of meat mixture into tortillas
10. I use about 4 tablespoons
11. Make sure you can still roll it
12. Roll and place it fold side down in the pan
13. Top with remaining salsa and cheese
14. Bake for 15 minutes
15. Make sure not to over cook
16. Its only placed in the oven to melt the cheese

title: banana split fruit salad
steps:
1. Place all ingredients except whipped topping into a bowl
2. Stir to mix up the preserves in with the fruit
3. Top with whipped topping and the cherry on top , and serve

title: mizerja   polish cucumber salad
steps:
1. Place sliced cucumbers in a strainer and sprinkle with kosher salt
2. Mix lightly , then let the cucumbers drain off their liquid for an hour
3. After that , you can squeeze a bit more liquid from the cucumbers with the back of a spoon
4. Discard all excess liquid
5. In a salad bowl , whisk together the yogurt / sour cream , vinegar , sugar and black pepper
6. Add the cucumbers and toss to combine
7. Serve , or let sit in the fridge for up to a day

title: cranberry almond coffee cake
steps:
1. In a large bowl , cream together margarine or butter and sugar
2. Beat in eggs , buttermilk or yogurt , and almond extract
3. In a separate bowl , mix together baking powder , baking soda , flour and salt
4. Add all at once to the wet ingredients , stirring just to blend
5. Grease and flour a tube pan
6. Spoon half of batter into pan
7. Spread half of cranberry sauce evenly atop batter , then spread remaining batter over that
8. Top with remaining cranberry sauce , and sprinkle toasted almonds evenly over sauce
9. Bake coffeecake in a preheated 350f oven for 55 minutes , or until cake tests done
10. Remove from oven , and cool in pan for 5 minutes
11. While cake is cooling , make glaze by mixing the confectioners' sugar , milk and almond extract
12. Turn cake out of pan , and dribble glaze over warm cake
13. Let cake cool completely before serving

title: vegan  strict vegetarian  pumpkin pie
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375f
2. Blend the tofu in a food processor or with a blender until smooth and cream-like
3. The blending may take three or four minutes total
4. Stop the machine every once in a while to scrape large pieces of tofu down into the machine's blades
5. Add two heaping cups of cooked pumpkin and blend some more , again stopping the machine and scraping the mixture down
6. The result should be a light orange-colored paste with no lumps of tofu
7. Put the paste into a large mixing bowl and add the sugar , salt , and spices
8. Mix well and spoon it into two pie crusts
9. Top with small bits of crust cut into shapes , if desired
10. Bake 30 to 40 minutes or until the crusts are dark brown

title: chocolate banana nut muffins
steps:
1. Set oven to 400 degrees
2. Line 12 muffin tins with paper liners
3. In a large bowl , sift together flour , sugar , cocoa , baking powder and salt
4. In a medium bowl , whisk together egg , milk , oil , bananas and vanilla
5. Mix well to combine
6. Add the dry ingredients to the wet ingredients , stir just until moistened
7. Gently stir in the nuts
8. Divide batter evenly between the lined muffin tins
9. Bake for 20-25 minutes , or until muffins test done)

title: udipi sambar
steps:
1. Cook the tuvar dal till tender then mash
2. Heat 1 tblsp oil in a heavy bottomed pan and roast the fenugreek seeds till light red , then add 1 / 2 tsp urad dal and let it saute till they change colour too
3. Add the red chilli and coriander seeds
4. Add a 3 sprigs of curry leaves and the grated coconut and roast
5. They should all turn light brown and aromatic
6. Cool and grind to a fine paste with a little water
7. Heat 1 tblsp oil in a pan
8. Add the mustard seed
9. When they splutter add 1 / 2 tsp of urad dal and the hing
10. Fry for a minute
11. Add the onions and green chillies , slit and the rest of the curry leaves
12. Add your choice of vegetables fry till you get a nice aroma
13. Add a little water
14. Cover and cook till the veges are done
15. Extract pulp from the tamarind and add to the vegetables
16. Add salt and crumbled jaggery and cook till the raw smell of the tamarind disappears
17. Add the mashed dal and the ground masala
18. Mix weel and add a little water if reqd
19. Simmer for a few mins
20. Serve with dosas , idlis or rice
21. And enjoy

title: chocolate chip cookie cake
steps:
1. Preheat the oven to 375 degrees f
2. Line a 14-inch , light colored , round pizza pan with parchment paper and grease the parchment paper
3. In a large bowl , cream the butter and sugars
4. Add the eggs , beating well after the addition of each
5. In a bowl , combine the flour , baking soda , and salt and mix with a whisk
6. Add to the butter mixture , mixing to incorporate
7. Add the vanilla extract
8. Fold in the dark and white chips and the nuts
9. Spread across the bottom of the prepared pan and bake until the edges are golden and the cookie is set but the center is still slightly soft , 20 to 25 minutes
10. Cool in the pan for 10 minutes , then transfer to a wire rack to cool completely
11. To serve , sift confectioners sugar and sweetened cocoa over the top , and cut into wedges
12. Serve sweetened whipped cream on the side

title: texan stir fry from the nice polish girl
steps:
1. Heat the oil in a large skillet or wok
2. Stir-fry pork with chili powder until lightly browned
3. Remove with slotted spoon and set aside
4. Add onions and garlic to drippings
5. Stir-fry 30 seconds
6. Add remaining ingredients except rice
7. Stir fry 2-3 minutes
8. Stir in pork
9. Heat through
10. Serve over hot texmati rice

title: lower fat chocolate cheesecake
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 300 degrees
2. Spray bottom of 9-inch springform pan with cooking spray
3. Combine crumbs and sugar
4. Sprinkle evenly over bottom of pan
5. In mixer bowl , beat cheese until fluffy
6. Mix in cocoa and flour
7. Add sweetened condensed milk , egg whites , egg , chips and vanilla
8. Mix well
9. Pour into prepared pan
10. Bake 45-50 minutes or until center is set
11. Cool
12. Chill
13. Garnish as desired
14. Refrigerate leftovers

title: creamy split pea   lentil soup
steps:
1. Cook your peas and lentils , in the water and broth in a large pot over medium heat for 90 minutes to two hours , or until soft
2. Do not drain
3. Transfer to a large bowl and set aside
4. In a saute pan , heat the oil
5. When heated , saute the onion , carrot , and celery with the bay leaves until soft
6. Make sure you remove the bay leaves
7. Puree the vegetables in a blender until smooth
8. Move to a large pot
9. Puree the peas and lentils in batches in the blender until smooth
10. Add that to the vegetable puree , and cook over medium low heat until warm
11. Serve in bowls
12. Enjoy !

title: cypriot pumpkin soup
steps:
1. Peel and dice pumpkin in 4 cm cubes
2. A
3. Lightly fry pumpkin cubes with the butter and olive oil in a large pot
4. Cover with water and add almonds
5. Simmer on low heat for about 20 minutes
6. Pumpkin should be soft to the touch , but still slightly crunchy
7. With a hand-held eletrical shredder , pulse for a few seconds , then stir and repeat as needed
8. You should end up with a creamy consistency throughout
9. Optionally , serve with bruschetti: preheat oven to 180 celsius
10. Place thickly-sliced baguette on a baking tray
11. Drizzle with olive oil
12. Sprinkle with cooking salt and oregano
13. Bake for 15 mins , or until golden

title: jim s tomato cilantro quick bread
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Place flour , baking soda , baking powder , salt and cumin in work bowl of food processor with metal blade and process for 2 seconds
3. Move dry ingredients to another bowl
4. Process cilantro and green onion for 5 seconds
5. Add tomatoes and tomato paste and process until tomatoes are pureed , about 10 seconds
6. Add sugar and process for 30 seconds , stopping to scrape down sides of bowl
7. Add eggs and process for 1 minute , or until mixture becomes fluffy
8. Return dry ingredients to processor and combine by turning machine on and off 4 to 5 times until mixture is just incorporated
9. Pour mixture into greased and floured 9-inch by 5-inch loaf pan
10. Spread the mixture evenly and bake at 350 f for 45 minutes or until browned
11. Let the bread cool in the pan for 10 minutes and turn onto wire rack to cool completely

title: persian chickpea flour cookies  nan e nokhochi
steps:
1. Beat butter & powdered sugar together until creamy
2. Add egg yolk & cardamom
3. With your hands knead in the chickpea flour until smooth
4. Pinch off tiny pieces of dough about the size of hazelnuts and roll them into balls between the palms of your hands
5. Decorate the tops of the cookies by pricking them with the tines of a fork or by pressing the back of the tines horizontally onto the cookies
6. Place on a lightly greased cookie sheet and bake in a slow oven for about 30 minutes
7. This dough is very "short" and needs to be well kneeded
8. For an even "shorter" dough , omit the egg yolk

title: breakfast in bread
steps:
1. Preheat your oven to 400f
2. Place split english muffin halves in a greased 13"x9" baking pan
3. Use a 1 1 / 2" to 2" cutter to cut a hole in the center of each muffin half
4. Place the cutouts next to muffins in baking pan
5. Crack open eggs and carefully put one egg in the center of each muffin hole
6. Move pan to preheated oven
7. Bake for 12 t 15 minutes or until eggs are just set
8. Meanwhile , for dressing:
9. In a small bowl whisk together the orange juice , vinegar , sugar , if using , olive oil , mustard , salt , and pepper
10. Gradually whisk in sour cream
11. Divide mesclun among four dinner plates
12. Place 1 egg filled muffin half atop greens
13. Cut remainig rounds from muffin halves into wedges and sprinkle around eggs
14. Drizzle with the dressing
15. Add walnuts and orange wedges
16. Enjoy !
17. To toast walnuts , place them in a shallow baking pan
18. Bake in a preheated 350f
19. Oven for 5 to 7 minutes , shaking the pan once or twice
20. Makes 4 servings

title: orange banana slush for diabetics
steps:
1. Peel the bananas and cut into chunks
2. Place in a food processor or blender
3. Add remaining ingredients and pulse until smooth
4. Pour into cups
5. Freeze for at least 15-20minutes
6. Remove from the freezer and serve
7. Eat as a slush with a spoon

title: my mom s raspberry pie filling
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 425 degrees
2. Crust:
3. Combine flour and salt in a medium bowl
4. Cut in shortening with either a fork or pastry blender
5. Sprinkle in cold water 1 teaspoon at a time until flour is moist enough to form a dough
6. On a lightly floured surface , role the ball of dough out into an 8 inch circle
7. Repeat above steps to make second crust
8. Place first crust into pie plate and set second crust aside
9. Filling:
10. Combine all ingredients in a large mixing bowl
11. Pour mixture into a 8 inch pie plate lined with one crust
12. Lay other crust on top , trim edges and minutes
13. Bake at 425 for 30 minutes or until crust is golden brown

title: jalapeno cranberry relish
steps:
1. Remove seed and stems from jalapenos
2. Chop jalapenos and cranberries finely
3. Add sugar
4. Refrigerate for 2 days before using
5. However , it was even better after 2 days

title: sesame butterfly pork chops
steps:
1. Heat sesame oil in large nonstick pan over medium
2. Add chops and sprinkle with sesame seed and ginger
3. Cook until browned on both sides
4. Add soy sauce and white wine to skillet , then add mushrooms and onions
5. Stir gently 1 to 2 minutes to saute vegetables
6. Remove chops to serving platter
7. Add butter to pan , stirring constantly to deglaze pan
8. Pour mushroom-onion sauce over chops

title: devils on horseback
steps:
1. Stuff each prune with an almond
2. Cut each bacon slice in pieces just long enough to wrap around a prune and overlap slightly
3. Secure bacon around prune with a wooden toothpick
4. Preheat broiler
5. Arrange bacon-wrapped prunes in a shallow pan and broil until bacon is crisp
6. Or , preheat oven to 400 degrees and bake 10 to 15 minutes , until crisp
7. Serve with chutney for dipping

title: pineapple peanut butter sweet potatoes
steps:
1. In large mixing bowl , beat all ingredients except marshmallows and peanuts
2. Pour into a 13x9 greased or buttered pan
3. Bake , covered at 350 for 30 minutes or til heated through
4. Top with marshmallows and peanuts , and bake til marshmallows are melted and lightly browned
5. Serves about 10 people

title: chocolate mint snowtop cookies   christmas
steps:
1. In a bowl combine flour , baking powder , and salt
2. Set aside
3. Over hot water , melt 1 cup mint morsels , stirring until smooth
4. In a bowl beat butter and sugar , until creamy
5. Add melted morsels and vanilla
6. Beat in eggs
7. Gradually beat in flour mixture
8. Stir in remaining morsels
9. Wrap dough in plastic wrap , and freeze about 30 minutes , until firm
10. Preheat oven to 350f
11. Shape dough into 1" balls
12. Coat with confectionery sugar
13. Place on ungreased cookie sheet
14. Bake 10-12 minutes , until tops appear cracked
15. Let stand 5 minutes on cookie sheet
16. Cool completely

title: savory spam crescents
steps:
1. Heat oven to 375'f
2. In skillet , cook bacon and onion until bacon is crisp
3. Drain
4. Stir in remaining ingredients except crescent roll dough
5. Separate each package of crescent dough into 8 triangles
6. Spread top half of each triangle with spam mixture
7. Roll up
8. Place on baking sheets
9. Bake 12-15 minutes or until golden brown

title: chocolate almond biscotti
steps:
1. Preheat oven to 350f
2. Toast almonds on baking sheet until golden start checking after 8 minutes to avoid burning
3. When you can smell the nuts , they are generally ready
4. Reduce oven to 300f
5. In a food processor or blender , chop chocolate chips with up to 1 / 2 c flour to make chocolate crumbs
6. Beat the eggs with the sugar and vanilla until well combined
7. Sift together the remaining flour , cocoa powder , baking soda , and salt
8. Combine flour mixture with egg mixture , then stir in the chocolate crumbs and toasted almonds
9. Using a spatula and floured hands , shape dough into long skinny loaves either 3 12-inch loaves or 2 16- to 18-inch loaves onto a parchment-lined baking sheet
10. Make sure to leave 2
11. 5 inches between loaves
12. Bake for 45 minutes on the lower rack
13. Remove from oven and cool on the pan
14. Carefully peel loaves from parchment
